translation.kha: ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon ryngkat jong nga , ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad ïa ka jingdap jngai ka , ïa ki jingpynriam baroh jrong ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translation.en: The tabernacle of the congregation , and the ark of the testimony , and the mercy seat that is thereupon , and all the furniture of the tabernacle ,

translation.kha: U dei ban ïuh bynda ma kat ka jingbam Rumah long kiwei pat ki lyngdoh , bad u lah ban buh ïa kano kano kaba ki ba-ha-ïing ha jong u ki phah sha u .
translation.en: They shall have like portions to eat , beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony .

translation.kha: Un long kiba khraw , bad yn khot ïa u , U Khun jong U Blei bahkhlieh Tam Eh . U Trai Uba U Blei un pynlong syiem ïa u , kumba u Dedan u kpa tymmen jong u , u la long ,
translation.en: He shall be great , and shall be called the Son of the Highest : and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David :

translation.kha: U Massah u long uta uba la shah kyntait da ki paid Jerusalem’ . ‘ Uei uba la pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar pynlang u nongbishar halor jong im ?’ ki la kyllaiñ . U longsem ma u , uba U Blei u la pah ban pynsynjor ïa ki briew badno ban pyllaitluid ïa ki da ka jingïapher jong u angel uba la mihpaw ha u ha ka bniap kaba mehding .
translation.en: This Moses whom they refused , saying , Who made thee a ruler and a judge ? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush .

translation.kha: uta u briew u dei ban siew ïa u Kpa jong sier ka briew sanphew tylli ki shai rupa , bad kata ka briew kan lama ka tnga jong u , namar u la pynbor ïa ka ban ïathiah shongkha bad u . Katba u dang im um lah shuh ban ïapyllait ïa ka .
translation.en: Then the man that lay with her shall give unto the damsel s father fifty shekels of silver , and she shall be his wife  ; because he hath humbled her , he may not put her away all his days .
Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust , and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away : yea , it shall be at an instant suddenly .
translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , baroh ki nongwei kiba tur ïaleh ïa pha kin shah beh noh kum ïa u pui pui , bad ki kynhun shipai bashyrkhei jong ki kin her kum u phlangïap .
Haba u la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la wan na Jedidah shai Galilaïa , u la otsher sha u bad kyrdoh ïa u ban leit sha Kapernam bad ban pynheh ïa u khun jong u , uba ba-don ha tmier ka jingïap .
translation.en: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee , he went unto him , and besought him that he would come down , and heal his son : for he was at the point of death .

translation.kha: To shahskhor , ko lapbah , ngan ai ha pa ïa ka lyngkha baroh kaei , sad ïa kata ka krem kaba khong hangta . Hangne ha ka jingdon ryngkat ki para jait jong nga , ngan ai ïa ka ha phi khnang ba phin ïew tep ïa la ka tnga .
translation.en: Nay , my lord , hear me : the field give I thee , and the cave that is therein , I give it thee  ; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee : bury thy dead .
He beholdeth all high things : he is a king over all the children of pride .
translation.kha: U peit ibeiñ wat ïa ki mrad kiba iphieng tam ; u long u syiem jong ki mradkhlaw baroh .

translation.en: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them : for the  Lord  thy God is among you , a mighty God and terrible .
translation.kha: Kumta wat sheptieng ïa kita ki briew . U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u don ryngkat bad phi ; u long U Blei uba donbor bad uba itieng .

To ai hukum , te , ba yn da ap phira bajngum wiang ïa ka jingtep jong u tad haduh ka sngi kaba lai , Khnang ba ki synran jong u kin ym lah ban sien ban tuh ïa ka jingsawa , bad nangta ban ïathuh ha ki briew ba u la mihpat na ka jingïalap . Kane ka jinglamler kiba khatduh kan un-long kaba khamtam sniew ban ïa kaba Nyngkong .
translation.en: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day , lest his disciples come by night , and steal him away , and say unto the people , He is risen from the dead : so the last error shall be worse than the first .

And Saul said , Let us go down after the Philistines by night , and spoil them until the morning light , and let us not leave a man of them . And they said , Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee . Then said the priest , Let us draw near hither unto God .
translation.kha: U Saul u ong ha ki rangbah jong u ,  Ïa ngin leit hiar bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia mynmiet , ngin lute ïa ki haduh ban da kynjat shai , bad ngin pynïap lut ïa ki baroh .   Leh ïa kaei kaba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam ,  ki jubab . Hynrei u lyngdoh u ong ,  To ngin da kylli shuwa na U Blei .
namar kim pat shym la sngewthuh ïa ka jingmut bashisha jong ka jingbsa ïa ki san hajar ngut ; ki jingmut jong ki kim lah ban ïohkem ïa kata .
translation.en: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves : for their heart was hardened .

translation.kha: U Manoah u jubab , Ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka kyrteng jong phi , khnang ba ngin lah ban ai burom ïa phi ynda ki ktien jongki phi ki la urlong .
translation.en: And Manoah said unto the angel of the  Lord  , What is thy name , that when thy sayings come to pass we may do thee honour ?
If thou sinnest , what doest thou against him ? or if thy transgressions be multiplied , what doest thou unto him ?
translation.kha: Lada me leh pop , kata kam ktah ei ei ïa U Blei . Lada bunsien me leh bakla , hato kata ka ktah ïa u ?

translation.en: Then the king arose , and sat in the gate . And they told unto all the people , saying , Behold , the king doth sit in the gate . And all the people came before the king : for Israel had fled every man to his tent .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ïeng joit , bad u leit shong hajan ka khyrdop shnong . Ki rangbah jong u ki ïohsngew ba u don hangta , bad baroh ki la ïalumlang sawdong jong u . Ha kajuh ka por , ki Israel baroh ki la phet krad sha la ki jong ki ïing .
Haba kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , ngim dadien ki khun jong kata ka kynoi mirr , hynrei jong ka kynthei kaba laitluid .
translation.en: So then , brethren , we are not children of the bondwoman , but of the free .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sngewkyiuh ki pdiang ïa ki jingpyn-i bakha dei , ki briew kiba kren bieit ki tur ruma shaei ka jingrisa .
translation.en: The wise in heart will receive commandments : but a prating fool shall fall .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki tim ïa uno Un uba put ïa u kew , ban ap haba un kiew pynsmai , hynrei ki ïaroh ïa uno uno uba sei ban die ïa u .
translation.en: He that withholdeth corn , the people shall curse him : but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it .
And these all , having obtained a good report through faith , received not the promise :
translation.kha: Ïa kine baroh la buh jingthoh naba ki la jop da ka jingngeit ! hynrei kim shym la ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .

translation.en: He is wise in heart , and mighty in strength : who hath hardened himself against him , and hath prospered ?
translation.kha: U Blei u long uba stad bad uba donbor katta katta ; ym don u briew uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: And he made his son pass through the fire , and observed times , and used enchantments , and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards : he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
translation.kha: U kñia ïa la u khun kum ka jingainguh thang . U khan bad u leh myntor , bad u ïasyllok bad ki nongpeit kti bad ki nongleh byrtong . U la leh pop palat pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad pynkhih bitar ïa u .

translation.en: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour : but through knowledge shall the just be delivered .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban jot noh da ka jingkren ki briew kiba khlem blei , hynrei ka jingstad jong kiba hok ka lah ban pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: Ye looked for much , and , lo , it came to little  ; and when ye brought it home , I did blow upon it . Why ? saith the  Lord  of hosts . Because of mine house that is waste , and ye run every man unto his own house .
translation.kha: Phi la kyrmen ïa ki jingot kiba bun , hynrei ki la kylla long tang khyndiat . Bad haba phi la wanrah ïa ka jingot sha ïing , nga pynher ïa ka sha jngai . Balei ba nga la leh ïa kata ? Namar ka Templ jong nga ka dang don ha ki jingjot katba uwei pa uwei na phi u bunkam ha ka jingtrei ïa la ka jong ka ïing .

Ki Jingkñia namar ka bapop ki donkam na ka pynbha kine ki jingleh . Lada une un u shah khot da ki bor ba-halor ban ai sohkhia ha ka ïingbishar bad um ïathuh ei ei ïa kata kaba u la ïohi ne u la ïohsngew , u Dei ban klet hi ïa kaba mih nangta .
translation.en: And if a soul sin , and hear the voice of swearing , and is a witness , whether he hath seen or known of it  ; if he do not utter it , then he shall bear his iniquity .
For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly , working not at all , but are busybodies .
translation.kha: Namar ngi ïohsngew ba don katto katne ngut ki briew hapdeng jong phi kiba im ka jingim bajaipdeh bad ki bym trei ei ei lait tang ban lushia ha ka kam jong kiwei pat ki briew .

U Petros u la ong ha ki , suit pa uwei na pa u dei ban phai noh na ki pop jong u badno ba yn pynbat ha ka kyrteng jongki U Jisu Khrist , khnang ba yn map ïa ki nongpop jong phi , bad phin ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid uba longkmie ka jngai jong U Blei .
translation.en: Then Peter said unto them , Repent , and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins , and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: sha kiba u briew u Lah ban phet rieh bad lait im lada jia ba u kumta pynïap ïa uno isangsot u briew u bym dei u nongsuhjaiñ jong u . U lah ban phet riew sha kiwei na kine ki shnong bad un ym shah pynpyut .
translation.en: That the slayer might flee thither , which should kill his neighbour unawares , and hated him not in times past  ; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live :

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la jop ïa ka ri , ka kynhun Eliel bhor kawei ka la ïalumlang ha Shelah bad pynïeng ïa ka Ïing Ka jingainong Ryngkat U Trai .
translation.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh , and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there . And the land was subdued before them .

translation.kha: U Dabid u Ong ha u Ahimelekh , Hato phi don u sum ne ka waitbnoh ba phi lah ban ai ïa nga ? Ki sah” jong u syiem ki la pynlong ïa ar ban mih kyrkieh kumne hajuh ba ngam don por ban leit shim ïa la ka waitlam lane ïa kano kano ka atiar .
translation.en: And David said unto Ahimelech , And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword ? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me , because the king s business required haste .
Sow to yourselves in righteousness , reap in mercy  ; break up your fallow ground : for it is time to seek the  Lord  , till he come and rain righteousness upon you .
translation.kha: Nga la ong , ‘ Lur ïa ka khyndew thymmai na ka bynta ïa lade , bet ïa ka jinglehhok , bad ot ïa ka jingkyrkhu ba ka jingmane ïa nga kan pynmih . Ka la dei ka por ïa phi ban phai sha nga , U  Trai  jong phi , bad ngan sa wan bad theh ki jingkyrkhu halor jong phi .’
Nga dang sha buh shwa ba phira phah hi .
translation.en: I had just put it before you ask me to .

translation.kha: U ter ïa u khun kada ha u dieng sohwaiñ Ha u diengsoh sohwaiñ uba bha tam ; U sait ïa la ki jaiñphong ha ka um sohwaiñ , kaba saw snam .
translation.en: Binding his foal unto the vine , and his ass s colt unto the choice vine  ; he washed his garments in wine , and his clothes in the blood of grapes :

translation.kha: Men ïap ha kaba Suk , pynlang kumba ki briew ki thang jingiwbih haba ki tep ïa ki kpa tymmen jong me , kiba longïing ki syiem ha shuwa jongngi me , ha kajuh ka rukom kin thang ki jingbeh na ka bynta jong me . Kin ïambriew Namar jong me bad kin ong , ‘ U syiem jongno ngi u la ïap !’ Ma nga , U Trai , nga la krai .
translation.en: But thou shalt die in peace : and with the burnings of thy fathers , the former kings which were before thee , so shall they burn odours for thee  ; and they will lament thee , saying , Ah lord ! for I have pronounced the word , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hobab ka mar ka la ïohsngew ïa khie , ka la ïeng joit bad ka la leit kyrkieh ban ïakynduh ïa u .
translation.en: As soon as she heard that , she arose quickly , and came unto him .

translation.kha: Hynrei kyllum ïa nga ha ka kyrteng U Trai ba phin ri pynim ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong per , ba kumta ka kthang jongno nga bad ka kyrteng ka jait lad nga kan ym jah junom .
translation.en: Swear now therefore unto me by the  Lord  , that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me , and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father s house .

translation.kha: U Trai un pynlamwir ïa phira , un pynmatlah ïa phi , bad un pynshaïong ïa phi .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall smite thee with madness , and blindness , and astonishment of heart :
For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death : he hath cursed his father or his mother  ; his blood shall be upon him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .  Uno uno uba tim ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie un shah pynïap ; u la kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .

translation.en: In the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised , and Ishmael his son .
translation.kha: La otsher ïa ki baroh ar ngut ha kajuh ka sngi ,
Ki nongleh myntor kim lai ïeng Shu ha iitkhmat u Moses namar ki la ïa-ïohi jaiñjot lut kumba un-long lem kiwei pat ki nong Ijipt .
translation.en: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils  ; for the boil was upon the magicians , and upon all the Egyptians .
And Menahem slept with his fathers  ; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap bad la tep , bad u Pekahaïah u khun shynrang jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

Nangta u Saul u ïai-ong ha u Dabid , “Kane ka dei ka Merab ka khun jong nga kaba kham shuwa . Ngan ai ïa ka ha me kum ka tnga jong me halor ka kyndon ba me dei ban shakri ïa nga kumto u shipai bashlur dara baïaineh , bad ïaleh ïa ki thma U Trai . ( U Saul u nang pyrkhat ba ha kane ka rukom ki Philistia kin eh pynïap ïa u Daberath bad um da donkam ban leh da laiñ . )
translation.en: And Saul said to David , Behold my elder daughter Merab , her will I give thee to wife : only be thou valiant for me , and fight the  Lord s  battles . For Saul said , Let not mine hand be upon him , but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him .

translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bam kaba dei da u purew ba la khleh malade ka umphniang Elul : lai kilo u puriskam lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw , ar kilo u purew lakam bad u langbrot ,
translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil : three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram  ;

translation.kha: Hadlai ar snem , u Absalom u la ai pynkhap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot ha Baal Hasor , ïasan ka shnong Ephraim , bad u la khot sngewma ïa baroh ki khunlung shynrang jong u syiem ïa-ban ïadat hangta .
translation.en: And it came to pass after two full years , that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baal–hazor , which is beside Ephraim : and Absalom invited all the king s sons .

translation.kha: Ha ka , la don baroh ki jait mrad , ki kynja bapar bad ki sim khlaw .
translation.en: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth , and wild beasts , and creeping things , and fowls of the air .
Ye ask , and receive not , because ye ask amiss , that ye may consume it upon your lusts .
translation.kha: Bad haba phi pan , phim ïoh ïa ka , namar ki jingthmu jong phi ki long kiba sniew ; phi pan ïa kiei kiei ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ki jingsngewbha jong phi hi .
Nangta u Daniel u la leit sha ïing sad u la ïathuh ïa ki paralok jong u — u Hananaïah , u Mishael , bad u Asaraïah — ïa kaei kaba la jia .
translation.en: Then Daniel went to his house , and made the thing known to Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah , his companions :
It is as high as heaven  ; what canst thou do ? deeper than hell  ; what canst thou know ?
translation.kha: Ka sahit bneng kam dei kaba kut ïa U Blei , hynrei ka don palat ïa kaba me lah ban kynjoh . U Blei u tip ïa ka pyrthei kiba ïap , hynrei me mem tip ïa ka .
Wat shim sut na la u para Jerusalem’ haba phi ai lam , lane phi ai jingbamsap , lane phi ai shah ïa kaei kaei ha u .
translation.en: Thou shalt not lend upon usury to thy brother  ; usury of money , usury of victuals , usury of any thing that is lent upon usury :

translation.kha: Ha lynti ki la ïakynduh ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Simon , uba dang wan sha ka nongbah na rudnong , bad ki shipai ki la pynroh ïa u ban buh ïa ka diengphna U Jisu . ( U Simon u dei na Kñia bad u la long u kpa jong u Aleksandar bad u Ruphos . )
translation.en: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian , who passed by , coming out of the country , the father of Alexander and Rufus , to bear his cross .

translation.kha: To ïakhublei eiei ïa iwei patiaw da ka jingdih jong ka jingieit Khristan . To ka jingsuk kan long ïa phi baroh kiba dih ki jong U Krit .
translation.en: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity . Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus . Amen .

translation.kha: U TRAI’ u ong , dalade u briew u pyllait ne ïa la ka tnga , bad ka iehnoh ïa u malu ka longsyiem noh ka tnga jngai uwei pat u briew , um den ban shim pat ïa ka . Kane kan pynpyut lut ïa ka ri . Hynrei , ko Israel , pha la kah khong shibun ki nongleh-ieit , malu mynta pha kwah ban waiñ blei sha nga !
translation.en: They say , If a man put away his wife , and she go from him , and become another man s , shall he return unto her again ? shall not that land be greatly polluted ? but thou hast played the harlot with many lovers  ; yet return again to me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jyllang ki Jiw ki la ïawad ïa u ha kata ka Jingkhawai Niam . Hangno u don ? ki la kulai .
translation.en: Then the Jews sought him at the feast , and said , Where is he ?

translation.kha: Naba kaei kaba i kumta ka jingibieit U Blei ka long kaba khlam stad ban ïa ka jingshad briew , bad kaei kaba i kumba ka hir ka jinglalot U Blei’ ka Long kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka bor briew .
translation.en: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men ; and the weakness of God is stronger than men .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Jonathan um shem la ïohsngew ba u kpa jong u , u la kham jur ïa ki rangbah da ka jingtim ; kumta u la kner da u dieng ba u phah , u pynngam ïa u ha ka nongpynïap , bad u bam khathynñiew ka napdeng . Hangto hi u la sngew ïohbor .
translation.en: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath : wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand , and dipped it in an honeycomb , and put his hand to his mouth  ; and his eyes were enlightened .

And Elijah the Tishbite , who was of the inhabitants of Gilead , said unto Ahab , As the  Lord  God of Israel liveth , before whom I stand , there shall not be dew nor rain these years , but according to my word .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa uba kyrteng u Elijah , uba na Tishbe kaba ha Gilead , u la ong ha u Syiem Ahab ,  Ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , U Blei uba im jong ki Israel , ïa uba nga shakri , nga ong ha phi ba ha ki ar ne lai snem kiba bud yn ym don ka umjer lane u slap tad haduh ba ngan ong kumta .
U Jisu u la jubab ïa u , Lydda nga mon ïa u ba un im dat ynda nga wei , ka pher aïu ïa me ? To buiñ ïa nga !
translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  If I will that he tarry till I come , what is that to thee ? follow thou me .

translation.kha: kumta u la ai ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki la pan khiah , bad u la phuh ruh ïa ka jingpang bashyrkhei hapdeng jong ki .
translation.en: And he gave them their request  ; but sent leanness into their soul .

translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew shaphang lad u dara ki la riam ïa u ha ka thliew . Da ki bnoh ki tan noh ïa u sha Ijipt .
translation.en: The nations also heard of him  ; he was taken in their pit , and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt .
He is the chief of the ways of God : he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him .
translation.kha: Uba phylla tam na ki jingthaw jong nga baroh ! Tang u Nongthaw jong u , uba lah ban jop ïa u .
Hynrei u Dabid u jubab , Ko ki hynmen ki para jong nga , phim dei ban leh kumta ïa kaba U Trai u la ai ha ngi ! U la ri la da ïa ngi , malu u la ai ha ngi ka jingjop halor tun ki nonglute .
translation.en: Then said David , Ye shall not do so , my brethren , with that which the  Lord  hath given us , who hath preserved us , and delivered the company that came against us into our hand .

translation.kha: Ki nongïamareh jong ka ki la sakma lyngba ki lynti bah kum ki rangbah kiba matlah , kiba la bit da ka snam haduh jaka katta ba ym don ma mano ban ktah ïa ki .
translation.en: They have wandered as blind men in the streets , they have polluted themselves with blood , so that men could not touch their garments .

translation.kha: Namar ba ki kyntoit ïa ka khrawbor Babha , ki Jiw ki long ki nongshun jong U Blei na ka bynta jngai phi ki Jentil . Hynrei ñiar ka jingjied U Blei , ki long ki paralok jong u namar ki khap tymmen Jong ki .
translation.en: As concerning the gospel , they are enemies for your sakes : but as touching the election , they are beloved for the fathers  sakes .

translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Mareshah , U Trai un aiti noh ïa phi! ha u nongshun , u ban kurup ïa ka shnong jong phira . Ki nongïalam ka Israel kin leit bad riat ha ka krem ha Adullam .
translation.en: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee , O inhabitant of Mareshah : he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel .
And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah , and all that he did , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Pekahaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage .
translation.kha: bad ha kane ka rukom , un pyllait ïa kita baroh kiba la long ki mraw shi lynter ka jingim jong ki , namar ka jingsheptieng jong ki ïa ka jingïap .

Neng thoh shad phi shaphang U Ktien ka jingim , Uba la kein naduh kambah mynnyngkong eh . Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u , bad ngi la ïohi ïa u da la ki khmat ; ho-oid , ngi la ïohi ïa u , bad ki ki jong ngi ki la ïohkem ïa u .
translation.en: That which was from the beginning , which we have heard , which we have seen with our eyes , which we have looked upon , and our hands have handled , of the Word of life  ;
Quench not the Spirit .
translation.kha: Wat khang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ;
Katba U Jisu u dang hikai ha ka Templ , u la kylli ka jingkylli , kumin ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum ki ong ba U Messaïah un long ibha jinghiarpateng na u Dabid ?
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said , while he taught in the temple ,  How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David ?
And the parched ground shall become a pool , and the thirsty land springs of water : in the habitation of dragons , where each lay , shall be grass with reeds and rushes .
translation.kha: u shyiap uba khluit un kylla long ka pung , bad ïa ka ri ryngkhiang yn pyndap da ki umpohliew . Ha ka jaka ba ju shong ki myrsiang , u phlang bad u khah ha ki jaka jyrsieh kin mih .

translation.en: And unto the married I command , yet not I , but the Lord , Let not the wife depart from her husband :
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew kiba la shongkurim , nga don ka hukum ym ka jong nga hynrei ka jong U Trai : Ka tnga kam dei ban iehnoh ïa la u tnga ;

Wat ïashah liang ha ki rai jong phi ; bishar ïa uwei pa uwei ha kajuh ka nongrit , kam pher la u long babha Kamon kumno . Wat sheptieng ïano ïabna , naba ki rai Kiba phi ai ki wan na U blem . ïada kano kano ka kam ïakajia ka eh na ïa phi ban rai , salm ïa ka Sha nga , bad ngan rai ïa ka .’
translation.en: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment  ; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great  ; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man  ; for the judgment is God s : and the cause that is too hard for you , bring it unto me , and I will hear it .

translation.kha: U dieng Dumbur , ko parabangeit jong nga , um haw ban seh ïa ki soh Olib ; ne u dieng sohwaiñ um lah ban sih ïa ki soh Dumbur , lymne ka umpohliew mluh kam lah ban pynmih ïa ka um kaba bang .
translation.en: Can the fig tree , my brethren , bear olive berries ? either a vine , figs ? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh .

translation.kha: Ki Amor ki daiñ kamar-tama ha Aijalon , Shaalbim , bad ha u Lum Heres , hynne ki jait Epher bad Maaseïah ki buh hapoh ka jingsuhsieng jongno ki bad ki pynbor ïa ki ban ba-thurmur na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon , and in Shaalbim : yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed , so that they became tributaries .

translation.kha: Nalorkata nga la ïohi ïa u angel uba la lah krong ha nga ba u jam sha khmat bad ba uwei pat u angel u la wan ba-bang ïashem ïa u .
translation.en: And , behold , the angel that talked with me went forth , and another angel went out to meet him ,

translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngdoh jaiñ ka long khatlai mitar ka lynter bad ar kilomitar ka kynïan ; bad bhor khatwei tylli i'u ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki long katjuh ka jingïoh .
translation.en: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits , and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain : the eleven curtains were of one size .

translation.kha: U Trei u la ïa-ong ha u Messaïah , Shaei ïan trep phyrngab , khih longing ap ïa u Pharaoh katba u dang leit shat ka wah , bad ïathuh ha u ba U TRAI’ u ong , ‘ Tylliat ïa ki briew jong ar ba kin ïoh mian ïa ar .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh  ; lo , he cometh forth to the water  ; and say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Let my people go , that they may serve me .

translation.kha: Te dalade pham don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ha ki balang !
translation.en: He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .
For this child I prayed  ; and the  Lord  hath given me my petition which I asked of him :
translation.kha: Ïa une u khunlung nga la pan na u , bad u la ai ha nga ïa kaba nga la pan .

translation.en: And he smote them hip and thigh with a great slaughter : and he went down and dwelt in the top of the rock Etam .
translation.kha: U tur ïaleh ïa ki khlem riej bad u pynïap shibun na ki . Nangta u leit bad u sah ha ka krem mawsiang ha Etam .
Haba ki briew basniew ki don ha ka ber synshar , ka kam sniew ka nang roi . Hynrei kiba hok kin im ban ïohi ïa ka jingkyllon jong kiba khem kita ki briew .
translation.en: When the wicked are multiplied , transgression increaseth : but the righteous shall see their fall .

translation.kha: Te ha ka jingjngem jong ki , ki ïakhot kyrpad ïa U Trai , malade u pynsum ïa ki na ka jingjot jong ki .
translation.en: Then they cry unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he bringeth them out of their distresses .

translation.kha: U Amasaïah u la don arphew san snem ka rta mynba u la hir u syiem , bad u synshar bapar khnai snem ha Jerusalem’ . Ka kmie jong u ka den ka Jehoaddin kaba na Jeruel .
translation.en: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem .
Knowing this , that the trying of your faith worketh patience .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , to ñiew ïa lade ba phi long kiba donbok eh haba phi ïakynduh ïa ki jingtynjuh kiba bun ha ka lynti ka jingim jong phi , naba phi tip ba haba ka jingngeit jong phi ka jop haba ïashem kum kita ki jingtynjuh , ka jingmih ka long ka jinglah ban ïaishah .

A Troas , ngat kaba nyngkong eh me hir U Blei . Me long U Blei jong nga , babha khuid bun uba bymjukut . A Trai , U Blei jongu de bad u nongïada , me la jied ïa ki nong Babilonia dara pynlong ïa ki , kiba khlem khnang ba kin lah ban pynshitom ïa ngi .
translation.en: Art thou not from everlasting , O  Lord  my God , mine Holy One ? we shall not die . O  Lord  , thou hast ordained them for judgment  ; and , O mighty God , thou hast established them for correction .

translation.kha: U Messaïah u la dap khat-ar snem ka rta mynnin u long skhem ka Jehudi , malu u synshar sahkynmaw san snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hephsibah .
translation.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign , and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hephzi–bah .

translation.kha: Hib ki paidbah ki la pule ïa ka , la pyndeng ïa ki da ka jingkmen da ka khubor ka jingpynbor .
translation.en: Which when they had read , they rejoiced for the consolation .

translation.kha: U Nongthaw u lah ban ïohsngew wat ïa ki jingïadei bajarjar .
translation.en: Our Creator can hear even silent prayers .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la jubab , nym tip nangno ka la wan .
translation.en: And they answered , that they could not tell whence it was .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kular ïa u Dabid , u kpa jong nga , ‘ U khun jong me , uba ngan pynlong syiem hadien jong me , un tei ka Templ ïa nga .’ Bad mynta nga la kut jingmut ban tei ka templ na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa U Trai U Blei jong nga .
translation.en: And , behold , I purpose to build an house unto the name of the  Lord  my God , as the  Lord  spake unto David my father , saying , Thy son , whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room , he shall build an house unto my name .

Then said he unto me , Son of man , lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north . So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north , and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , peit shaphang shatei .  Nga la peit , bad hangta hajan ka duwan harud ka jaka rung ka khyrdop nga la ïohi ïa ka dur bleithaw kaba long ka jingijli ba pynbitar ïa U Blei .
Katba u bet ïa u symbai ha ka lyngkha , katto kat na u , u la hap ha ka lynti ïaid , bad ki Da ki la wanrah dara ba-ima ïa u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he sowed , some fell by the way side , and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up .

translation.kha: Lada phi olib tang ïa ki briew kiba ieit ïa Phi , balei phi daiñ ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongpop ki olib ïa kito kiba ieit ïa ki !
translation.en: For if ye love them which love you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also love those that love them .

translation.kha: haba U Trai un wan ban synshar ïa ka pyrthei . Un synshar ïa ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei da ka hok bad ka jinglehhok .
translation.en: Before the  Lord  : for he cometh , for he cometh to judge the earth : he shall judge the world with righteousness , and the people with his truth .

translation.kha: Kumta ka Mari ka nong Magdala ka la leit bad ïashoh ïa ki synran ba ka la ïohi ïa U Trai bad pynshai ha ki ïa kaei kaba u la ïathuh ïa ka .
translation.en: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord , and that he had spoken these things unto her .

translation.kha: Haba U thri u la kren nyngkong eh ïa ki Israhaïah lyngba u Hosia , U la ong ïa u Hosia , Khie leit bad ïashongkurim , ka tngaw jong me kan long ka bymïaineh , bad ki khun jongnga me kan long kum ma ka hi . Ha kajuh ka rukom , ki briew jong nga ki la eh ïa nga bad ki la long ki bymïaineh .
translation.en: The beginning of the word of the  Lord  by Hosea . And the  Lord  said to Hosea , Go , take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms : for the land hath committed great whoredom , departing from the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki la pyrshah biang , To pynïap khong ïa u ! Pynïap noh ïa u ! Sahnarphna ïa u ! U pyllait u la kylli ïa ki , Phi kaweh ïa nga ba kun sahnarphna ïa u syiem jong phira ? Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la jubab , U sahmiet uba ngi don u dei tyngka u Patsha !
translation.en: But they cried out , Away with him , away with him , crucify him . Pilate saith unto them , Shall I crucify your King ? The chief priests answered , We have no king but Caesar .

translation.kha: badno da kaba khlem tlot jingngeit , u um shim hi ba kamai jongu mynta ka la iap , ha ka por ba u la dap shispah snoh ka rta , lap ïa ka blang jongnga ka Sarah .
translation.en: And being not weak in faith , he considered not his own body now dead , when he was about an hundred years old , neither yet the deadness of Sara s womb :

translation.kha: U Abijah u la ïap , mala la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Nadab , bad u Amasa u khun lad u , u longkmie syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Abijam slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him in the city of David : and Asa his son reigned in his stead .

And it shall be answered , Because they forsook the  Lord  God of their fathers , which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , and laid hold on other gods , and worshipped them , and served them : therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin jubab , ‘ Dei namar ba ki la iehnoh na U  Trai  U Blei uba la wan ïalam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki na ka ri Ijipt . Ki la ai ïa la ka jingnguh ïa kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki la mane ïa ki . Kata ka long balei ba U  Trai  u la pynngat ha ki ïa kane ka apot .’

translation.en: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years , and begat Terah :
translation.kha: Haba u Nahor u la dap arphew khyndai snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Terah ;
Ki nong Jephthah ki la sheptieng ïa ki bad ki la kmen hab ki la mih .
translation.en: Egypt was glad when they departed : for the fear of them fell upon them .

translation.kha: U ïabuaid u ong ha u , Haba nga iohi ïa u Doeg hangta ha kato ka sngi , nga la tip ïaskhem ba un sa ïathuh ha u Saul . Kumta nga kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jinghap jongki ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jongki phi baroh .
translation.en: And David said unto Abiathar , I knew it that day , when Doeg the Edomite was there , that he would surely tell Saul : I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father s house .

And they said , The man asked us straitly of our state , and of our kindred , saying , Is your father yet alive ? have ye another brother ? and we told him according to the tenor of these words : could we certainly know that he would say , Bring your brother down ?
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Uta u briew u ïai kylli bniah shaphang jong ngi bad shaphang ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ngi , u da ong , ‘ I pa jong phi i dang im ne em ? Phi dang don para shynrang shuh ?’ Ngi hap ban jubab ïa kita ki jingkylli . Kumno ngi lah ban tip ba un ong ïa ngi ban wan ïalam ïa u para jong ngi ?
U Mynsiem u la bat synshar ïa nga , bad u angel u la rai ïa la sha kliar jngai u lumbah uba jrong . U la pyn-i ha nga ïa ka Jerusalem , ka nongbanbor Bakhuid , kaba da wan hajar na bneng na U Blei
translation.en: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain , and shewed me that great city , the holy Jerusalem , descending out of heaven from God ,
Behold , thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly  ; and shalt thou be delivered ?
translation.kha: Me la ïohsngew kaei ba u patsha Assyria u leh ïa kano kano ka ri kaba u rai ban pynjot . Hato me pyrkhat ba men lait im ?
Ïa uno uno uba ïa ka kyrteng jong u ym syiem la thoh ha ka kitab kiba im la bret sha ka pung ka ding .
translation.en: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire .

translation.kha: Ki shipai samla kiba la ïalam ïa ka jingtur ïajah , ïa ibha la bud da ka kynhun shiphang Israel ,
translation.en: So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city , and the army which followed them .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u kyrshan ïa la ; U Blei jong de u ïada ïa nga .
translation.en: But the  Lord  is my defence  ; and my God is the rock of my refuge .

translation.kha: Kumta ka Hannah ka punkhun bun ka kha khun shajrong . Ka la pynkyrteng ïa u , u Ishmael , naba ka ong , Nga la mat ïa u na U thri .
translation.en: Wherefore it came to pass , when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived , that she bare a son , and called his name Samuel , saying , Because I have asked him of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki nong Rom kin wang ha ki liengbah bad kin pynshisha ïa u , bun un sa sheptieng . Te un leit phah pat ha ka jingbitar shla bad un pylleng ban pynjot ïa ka mane jong ki briew jong U Blei . Un bud ïa ka jngai jingmut lad kito kiba la iehnoh ïa kata ka niam .
translation.en: For the ships of Kittim shall come against him : therefore he shall be grieved , and return , and have indignation against the holy covenant : so shall he do  ; he shall even return , and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingïalap jong u Saul ka la nang khnam khrawbor , bun ki jingpynshisha jong u ba U Jisu u Long U Meshelemaïah ki longsyiem kiba skhem ba ki Jiw kiba shongsuk basah ha Dammim ktieh lah ngab jubab ïa u .
translation.en: But Saul increased the more in strength , and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus , proving that this is very Christ .

translation.kha: Ki la wan sha u , mala u la jied kharai ngut , ïa kiba u la khot apostol . Nga la jied ïa phi don long lem bad nga , u la ong ïa ki .
translation.en: And he ordained twelve , that they should be with him , and that he might send them forth to preach ,

translation.kha: U la ïatyngkhuh ha u Kpa jong u , Nga kwah ba phin pynïoh ïa ka dadien kumin ka tnga ïa nga .
translation.en: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor , saying , Get me this damsel to wife .

translation.kha: Ki kyntiew ïa ka ha la ki tyrpeng bad rah ïa ka ; ki bsuh ïa ka ha ka jaka jngai ka , bad hangta ka ïeng , khlem haka ban khih na ka jaka ba ka don . Lada dat uno uno ba duwai ha ka , mana lah ban jubab lane pyllait ïa u na ka jingjot .
translation.en: They bear him upon the shoulder , they carry him , and set him in his place , and he standeth  ; from his place shall he not remove : yea , one shall cry unto him , yet can he not answer , nor save him out of his trouble .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ka jingai ba lah ban kren ha ki tylliat bapher ka long ka jingpynshisha ha ki bymngeit , ym ha katba ngeit , katsha ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khor U Blei ka long ka jingpynshai ïa kiba ngeit , ym ïa ki pynngeit .
translation.en: Wherefore tongues are for a sign , not to them that believe , but to them that believe not : but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not , but for them which believe .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ban tip kaei ba un ong bad kumno un jubab ïa nga .
translation.en: I would know the words which he would answer me , and understand what he would say unto me .

translation.kha: Bad u Joshua u khun jrong u Nun bad u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh , ar ngut na kita ki nongsyntiat , ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ da ka jingsngewsih ,
translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun , and Caleb the son of Jephunneh , which were of them that searched the land , rent their clothes :
For meat destroy not the work of God . All things indeed are pure ; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence .
translation.kha: To wat pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh , na ka daw ka jingbam . Ki jingbam baroh ki long kiba lah ban bam , hynrei ka long ka bym dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka ban pynlong ïano ïano ban hap ha ka pop .

Bad ha ka shi kynta ka la duh lut ïa kane ka spah ! Baroh ki kapten jong ki liengbah bad ki nongshong lieng , ki maji bad baroh kiwei pat kiba la Ïoh kamai na ka duriaw , ki la ïeng na sha jngai bah ,
translation.en: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought . And every shipmaster , and all the company in ships , and sailors , and as many as trade by sea , stood afar off ,
For every man shall bear his own burden .
translation.kha: Manla u briew un hab ban kit ïa la ki jong ki jingeh .
Ki shipai ki la thmu ban pynïap ïa ki khoit baroh , khnang ban da ïa ki na kaba jngi shaei rud duriaw bad Ban lait phet .
translation.en: And the soldiers  counsel was to kill the prisoners , lest any of them should swim out , and escape .

translation.kha: Don ki ban pyndonkam da ka kseh ne da ka rupa ne da ki mawkordor ha kaba tei halor ka nongrim ; khiew pat kin pynbam da ka dieng ne da u phlang ne da u jyntang .
translation.en: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold , silver , precious stones , wood , hay , stubble ;
Hadar , and Tema , Jetur , Naphish , and Kedemah :
translation.kha: u Hadad , u Tema , u Jetur , u Naphish , bad u Kedemah .

translation.en: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments , which I have loved  ; and I will meditate in thy statutes .
translation.kha: Nga burom bad nga ieit ïa ki hukum jong me ; ngan puson ïa ki jingbthah jong me .

Khenani u Palal u la ong ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam , Ym shym la shem ïa ngi kiba la shah pynrem na kano kano ka kam runar , pynban ki la sympat ïa ngi ha khmat u paidbah — badno ngi dei ki tasngeng ka Hima Rom ! Nangta ki la thep ïa sem sha ka byndi , dara mynta ki kwah ban phah noh jam jar ïa ngi . Ka ngi haka long ! Ki rangïapom synshar ka Hima Rom ki dei ban wan hi da lade hangne mala pyllait ïa ngi .
translation.en: But Paul said unto them , They have beaten us openly uncondemned , being Romans , and have cast us into prison  ; and now do they thrust us out privily ? nay verily  ; but let them come themselves and fetch us out .
And Asa slept with his fathers , and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign .
translation.kha: Hadien ar snem u ïap noh
Ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang ki la ïakynduh lang ban pyrthat ïa kane ka jingkylli .
translation.en: And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter .

translation.kha: Kumta ynda phi shah jynjar , ngan sa ioh rkhie ïa ph . Ngan sa rkhiebeiñ ïa pa’ ynda phiah thap ha ka jingsheptieng —
translation.en: I also will laugh at your calamity  ; I will mock when your fear cometh  ;
And he went out from Pharaoh , and entreated the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u leit noh na u Pharaoh , bad u la duwai ha U  Trai .
Nangta ki paid Jesreel — ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi bad barhem Kiwei paw kiba la wan phad na ka jingshah ringmraw — da ka jingkmen ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And the children of Israel , the priests , and the Levites , and the rest of the children of the captivity , kept the dedication of this house of God with joy ,

translation.kha: ‘ Nga smai ba namar kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga , uwei ruh na ki rangbah uba arphew snem lane kham khah Uba la wan na Ijipt un ym ïohrung sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ha u Abraham , u Isaïah , bad u Jakob .’
translation.en: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt , from twenty years old and upward , shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob  ; because they have not wholly followed me :

translation.kha: Mynshuwa nga dang khmih , la shuh ïa ki khet ha la ki jaka . Uto uba la im junom u la shong halor kawei na ki khet . Ki jaiñ jong u ki la long kiba lieh kum ka ïor , bad u shñiuh jong u , u long kum u saiwul nongbylla . Ïa ka khet jong u , la buh halor ki shalyntem ding , Kaba la klang da ka ding ,
translation.en: I beheld till the thrones were cast down , and the Ancient of days did sit , whose garment was white as snow , and the hair of his head like the pure wool : his throne was like the fiery flame , and his wheels as burning fire .
And God spake unto Noah , and to his sons with him , saying ,
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Noah bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u ,

translation.en: Moreover , brethren , I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you , which also ye have received , and wherein ye stand ;
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga kwah ban pynkynmaw ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ïa ka Khubor Babha kaba nga la ïalap ha phi , ïa kaba phi la pdiang , bad ha kaba ka jingngeit jong phi ka ïeng skhem .
Ïa kiba hok la ïalam lynti bad ïada da U Trai , hynrei kiba sniew ki don ha ka lynti sha ka jingit jongno ki .
translation.en: For the  Lord  knoweth the way of the righteous : but the way of the ungodly shall perish .
Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God ? he hath said in his heart , Thou wilt not require it .
translation.kha: Kumno u riewbymman u ibeiñ ïa U Blei bad ong ha lade ,  Un ym pynshitom ïa nga ?
uba la shon ïa ka shab jong ka jinglong trai halor jong ngi , bad uba la ai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki dohnud jong ngi kamon ka jingïabujli ïa kata baroh kaba u la buh tyngkai na ka bynta jngai ngi .
translation.en: Who hath also sealed us , and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts .

translation.kha: Ka riewkynthei lynti ka kynthei kaba la ïapyllait tnga ka dei ban pyndep ïa Kawei pa kawei ka jingkular ba ka la ai ban kynïan noh na kan kano .
translation.en: But every vow of a widow , and of her that is divorced , wherewith they have bound their souls , shall stand against her .

And the men of Ai smote of them about thirty and six men : for they chased them from before the gate even unto Shebarim , and smote them in the going down : wherefore the hearts of the people melted , and became as water .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki beh krad ïa ki naduh ka khyrdop shnong haduh ki katto katne ki par bad ki la pynïap kumba laiphew hynriew ngut ha ka lynti sharum ki lumrit . Te ki Israel ki la duh ka jingshlur bad ki la sheptieng .
Hynrei u Abiathar , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Ahimelekh , u la lait im , bad u leit ïasoh bad u Dabid .
translation.en: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub , named Abiathar , escaped , and fled after David .

translation.kha: To bishar ha ka bujli Jong ang ; me tip ïa ki jingbakla kiba la leh pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: O  Lord  , thou hast seen my wrong : judge thou my cause .

translation.kha: U Blang u tip kino ki briew ki bymkohnguh ; u ioh ïa ki kam sngew jong ki baroh .
translation.en: For he knoweth vain men : he seeth wickedness also  ; will he not then consider it ?

translation.kha: Adonijah kata , ka thma ka khie biang pynlang ki Philistia ha Geser . Kane ka jia haba u Sibbekai na Hushah u pynïap ïa u Rabbah uba kyrteng u Sippai , bad ïa ki Pamphylia la jop .
translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines  ; at which time Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Sippai , that was of the children of the giant : and they were subdued .

translation.kha: Ma ka bad ki khun kynthei jong ka ki la sngewsarong namar ki la ne kyrhai ba bam mala im ha ka jingsuk bad ka jingjam jar , hynrei kim shym la sumar ïa kiba duk bad ïa Kiba rangli .
translation.en: Behold , this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom , pride , fulness of bread , and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters , neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy .

translation.kha: Dei ma phi ba ïoh ïa ka jingmyntoi , lada pa dat ka jingstad , bad lada phi kyntait ïa ka , phira hi phiah shem jinglur .
translation.en: If thou be wise , thou shalt be wise for thyself : but if thou scornest , thou alone shalt bear it .

translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa kwah ka burom kaba me la ai ha nga , khnam ba kin long kawei , kumba ma me bad nga ngi long kawei .
translation.en: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them  ; that they may be one , even as we are one :

translation.kha: Shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Tiras , buh ïa ka ha kata ka khi , bad thep ha kawei ka synduk kaba ha syndah jong ka ïa kita ki dulir uba da ka ksiar ba phi phah sha u kum ka jingainguh namar ki pop jongu phi . pyllait ïa ka katai ha ka lynti jong ka malade ieh kan saw hi .
translation.en: And take the ark of the  Lord  , and lay it upon the cart  ; and put the jewels of gold , which ye return him for a trespass offering , in a coffer by the side thereof  ; and send it away , that it may go .

translation.kha: Tang lada phi la sngi ïa ki hukum jong nga ! Te ki jingkyrkhu kin jing da la tuid ha phi! kumne ka wahduid ka bym ju rngad ! Ka jingjop kan jin da la wan ha phi kum ki jingat phyllung naba phaloh ha ka rud duriaw .
translation.en: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments ! then had thy peace been as a river , and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea :

translation.kha: Uta u bynriew u long Uba sarong bad kiba ïaleh pyrsa ; u batlot ïa la ka stieh ha ka jingmutlop bad u tur ban ïateh pyrshah ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Because he covereth his face with his fatness , and maketh collops of fat on his flanks .
These two things are come unto thee  ; who shall be sorry for thee ? desolation , and destruction , and the famine , and the sword : by whom shall I comfort thee ?
translation.kha: Ka jingjot kaba ar shah ka la hap halor jong pha : ïa ka jaka jong pha la pynjot ha ka thma , bad ki briew jong pha ki la ïapthngan . Ym don uno uno uba pyn-i jingsngewlem ïa pha .
da kaba iehnoh ïa u Rehoboam kum u syiem thrang ïa ki briew kiba sheng ha ka ri Judas .
translation.en: But as for the children of Israel that dwelt in the cities of Judah , Rehoboam reigned over them .

translation.kha: ba ka por ka poi haba ïa kiei kiei naba ha ka ïinglieng , kiei kiei kiba ki kba tymmen ki la kynshew haduh kñia ka sngi , yn rong noh sha Babilonia . Yn ym don ei ei ka ban sah” .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , that all that is in thine house , and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day , shall be carried into Babylon : nothing shall be left , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Wallam hangne ïa ka Ephod , u Samuel u ong ha u Isaïah u Lyngdoh . ( Ha kata ka sngi u Ahijah u dang rah ïa ka ha khmat ki paid Israel . )
translation.en: And Saul said unto Ahiah , Bring hither the ark of God . For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel .
The proverbs of Solomon . A wise son maketh a glad father : but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki proberb u Solomon : U khun uba stad u pynsngew sarong ïa la u jong u kpa ; uba bieit u wallam ka jingsngewsih ïa la ka kmie .
Kumta ki ksiew ki la jingkyrpad ïa U Jisu , Lada men beh noh ïa ngi shabar , to Pha ïa ngi sha katai ka kynran ki sniang .
translation.en: So the devils besought him , saying , If thou cast us out , suffer us to go away into the herd of swine .

translation.kha: Ka Hannah ka la duwai : U Trai u la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong nga da ka jingkmen ; katno por sngewtynnat namar kaei kaba u la leh ! Nga rakhe ïa ki nongshniah jong ang ; katno nga shadkmen Naamah ba U Blang u la ïap ïa nga .
translation.en: And Hannah prayed , and said , My heart rejoiceth in the  Lord  , mine horn is exalted in the  Lord  : my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies  ; because I rejoice in thy salvation .

translation.kha: Lada phi ïohsngew ïa ka jingput rudnong , ïalumlang sawdong jong nga . U Blei jongno ngi un ïaleh na ka pyntha jong I .
translation.en: In what place therefore ye hear the sound of the trumpet , resort ye thither unto us : our God shall fight for us .

translation.kha: U Blei , uta umbiah hok , u tip ïa katei kiba jia ha ki longïing ki riewbymman , bad un wallam ïa ki bymman sha ka jingjot jingpra .
translation.en: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked : but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness .

translation.kha: wahbah ki briew ki shah lehbeiñ , ki ud ; ki pyntha ba yn ni mano mano banbeiñ pynkoit im ïa ki .
translation.en: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry : they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty .

translation.kha: ibha u la ieh ïa u pynbah malu loit shwa la ïohnong , ki synran jong u ki la ong ïa u ban batai ïa kane ka jingong .
translation.en: And when he was entered into the house from the people , his disciples asked him concerning the parable .
Therefore speak I to them in parables : because they seeing see not  ; and hearing they hear not , neither do they understand .
translation.kha: Ka daw ba nga pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ha kaba ïakren bad ki ka long ba ki peit , hynrei kim ïohi , bad ki shahshkor , hynrei kim ïohsngew lane shemphang .

translation.en: Then call thou , and I will answer : or let me speak , and answer thou me .
translation.kha: To kren nyngkong , A Blei , bad ngan jubab . Lane to shah ngan kren , bad to jubab ïa nga .

translation.en: And Achish answered and said to David , I know that thou art good in my sight , as an angel of God : notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said , He shall not go up with us to the battle .
translation.kha: Nga mynjur ,  u Akhish u jubab ,  Nga ñiew ïa phi uba hok kum u angel U Blei . Hynrei kiwei pat ki syiem Philistia ki ong ba phim dei ban leit ryngkat bad ngi sha ka thma .

haba phi ïohi ïa kane ba ka jia , Phon sa shalyntem ; kan pynlong ïa phi ban long khlaiñ bad khiah krat . Te phin sa tip ba ma nga , U Trai , nga ïarap ïa kito kiba kohnguh ïa la , bad nga pynum ïa la ka jingtip pyrshah ïa ki nongshna jong nga .
translation.en: And when ye see this , your heart shall rejoice , and your bones shall flourish like an herb : and the hand of the  Lord  shall be known toward his servants , and his indignation toward his enemies .
Remember , O  Lord  , what is come upon us : consider , and behold our reproach .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , ko  Trai  , ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ngi . To khmih ïa ngi , bad peit ïa ka jingjahburom jong ngi .

Hato me wan ha ka jingsuk ? u Joram u kylli ïa u . U Jeush u jubab , Kumno tista don ka jingsuk haba ngi dang ei baroh ki jingleh byrtong bun ki jingmane bleithaw kba ka Jesebel ka kmie jong me ka la sdang ?
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joram saw Jehu , that he said , Is it peace , Jehu ? And he answered , What peace , so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many ?
And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold , graven , as signets are graven , with the names of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki pynkhreh ïa ki mawkordor Karnelian bad ki buh ïa ki ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar . Ha kita la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang u Jakob .
U Trai u ong ha u Moses nabar u Arnon ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
But they said , Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar among the people .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban leh ïa ka ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam ,  ki la ong ,  ïoh ba u paidbah un khihwin .

translation.en: Let brotherly love continue .
translation.kha: To ïaineh ha kaba ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei kum ki parabangeit .
Te u Moses u ainong ha u Pharaoh , U Trai U jong , ‘ Ha ka par shit synñia ngan ïaid lyngraw ïa ka Ijipt ,
translation.en: And Moses said , Thus saith the  Lord  , About midnight will I go out into the midst of Egypt :
That ye may suck , and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations  ; that ye may milk out , and be delighted with the abundance of her glory .
translation.kha: Phin ïoh leh sngewbha ha ka jingdap kyrhai jong ka , kum i khunlung ha ka shadem ka kmie jong i .

translation.en: And he is the propitiation for our sins : and not for ours only , but also for the sins of the whole world .
translation.kha: Bad U Khrist hi u long ka lynti da kaba yn ïohmap ïa ki pop jong ngi , bad ym tang ïa ki pop jong ngi , hynrei ruh ïa ki pop jong ki briew baroh .

Ynda haba ki shipai ki la lah sahnarphna ïa U Jisu , ki la ïashim ïa ki jaiñ lad u bad ki la ïabynta ha ki saw bynta , kawei ka bynta ïa uwei uwei u shipai . Ki la ïashim ruh ïa ka jaiñkup , ïa kaba la pynlong tang na kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ba la thain khlem kano kano ka jingsuh ha ka .
translation.en: Then the soldiers , when they had crucified Jesus , took his garments , and made four parts , to every soldier a part  ; and also his coat : now the coat was without seam , woven from the top throughout .

translation.kha: Ka hir ka jingshisha ba lyngba ka pop jong uwei u briew , ka jingap ka la sdang don synshar , namar jong uta uwei u briew . Hynrei katno kaba kham khroh ka long ka jingmih jong kaei kaba la leh da uwei u briew , U Jisu Khrist ! Bahok katba ïohpdiang ïa jingaiei bakhiah U Blei bad ba la pynïasuk bad u kin shihajar ha ka jingim lyngraw U Krit .
translation.en: For if by one man s offence death reigned by one ; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one , Jesus Christ .)

translation.kha: hynne uno uno uba pdiang ïa ka khlur jongno u , u pynskhem da Kanah ba U Blei u long uba shisha .
translation.en: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true .

translation.kha: Phi bam syndon ïa ki briew jyllang nga . Phi puid noh ïa ka sniew jong ki , pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong ki , bad shajan ïa ki kum ïa ka doh ha u khiew .
translation.en: Who also eat the flesh of my people , and flay their skin from off them  ; and they break their bones , and chop them in pieces , as for the pot , and as flesh within the caldron .
He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap : he layeth up the depth in storehouses .
translation.kha: U lumlang ïa baroh ki duriaw-rit ha kawei ka jaka ; u khang ïa ki jingjylliew ka duriaw-bah ha ki ïing jingkynshew .

translation.en: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea  ; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand , and on their left .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang , katba ki um ki ïeng kum ki kynroh na baroh arliang .
ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la sheng ban khñium , Une u briew u pdiang sngewbha ïa kiba shah kyntait bad u da ïasam lem malu ki !
translation.en: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured , saying , This man receiveth sinners , and eateth with them .

translation.kha: U pynphalang ban bsa ïa u , u mih ha ki lum ha kaba ki khrawbor ki ïalehkai .
translation.en: Surely the mountains bring him forth food , where all the beasts of the field play .

translation.kha: Wat shimti sha lade ïa kaei khie kaba la mang ban pynjot , te U Trai un pha na ka jingbitar shlei jong u bad un iwei ïa phi . Un pynlehnoh-ei ïa phi bad un pynroi ïa phi , kumba u la klun ïa ki kpa thom jongu phi ,
translation.en: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand : that the  Lord  may turn from the fierceness of his anger , and shew thee mercy , and have compassion upon thee , and multiply thee , as he hath sworn unto thy fathers  ;

Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; In those days it shall come to pass , that ten men shall take hold out of all languages of the nations , even shall take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew , saying , We will go with you : for we have heard that God is with you .
translation.kha: Ha kito ki sngi shiphew ngut ki nongwei kin wan sha uwei u Jiw bad ong , ‘ Ngi kwah ban ïoh bynta ha ka lawei jong phi , namar ngi la lah ïohsngew ba U Blei u don bad phi .’
Phim dei ban ber ha ki Lyngkha jong phi lane ot ïa u kew uba sha mih hi lane kheit ïa ki soh na ki ibhabriew jong phi kiba phim syiem la khyllad .
translation.en: A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you : ye shall not sow , neither reap that which groweth of itself in it , nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed .

translation.kha: To ngin shna kawei ka ruma Halor tnum ïing , ngin buh kawei ka jingthiah , kawei ka miej , kiwei ka shuki , bad kaweh ka sharak hapoh jong ka , bad u lah ban sah hangta man ba u wang jngoh ïa ngi .
translation.en: Let us make a little chamber , I pray thee , on the wall  ; and let us set for him there a bed , and a table , and a stool , and a candlestick : and it shall be , when he cometh to us , that he shall turn in thither .

translation.kha: dara baroh uba trei , u ne ka waitlam ba la teh ha ka syngkai jong u . U briew uba pynsawa ïa ka jingmaham da ka jingput ronsing u don bad nga .
translation.en: For the builders , every one had his sword girded by his side , and so builded . And he that sounded the trumpet was by me .

translation.kha: Bad U Trai u la ong , Kohnguh ïa ki hukum babha nga ai malade Wat bud ïa ki paw im jong kito ki briew kiba shong ha kata ka ri ha shuwa jong phi , bad wat pynshaitbor ruh ïa lade da kaba leh ïa kano kano na kine ki kam . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance , that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs , which were committed before you , and that ye defile not yourselves therein : I am the  Lord  your God .
For David , after he had served his own generation by the will of God , fell on sleep , and was laid unto his fathers , and saw corruption :
translation.kha: Naba u Dabid u la shakri ïa ki jingthmu jong U Blei ha ka por jong u ; bad nangta u la ïap , la tep ïa u bad ki kpa tymmen jong u , bad ka met jong u ka la pyut hapoh ka jingtep .

U Hiram u la kmen shabar palat haba u ïohpdiang ïa ka khohruh na u Solomon , bad u ong , Ïaroh ïa U Trai ha kane ka sngi ba u la ai ha u Dabid ïa u khun uba Stad kum une ban long u syiem hadien jong u ïa kata ka jaitbynriew barabor !
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Hiram heard the words of Solomon , that he rejoiced greatly , and said , Blessed be the  Lord  this day , which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people .
If a woman also vow a vow unto the  Lord  , and bind herself by a bond , being in her father s house in her youth  ;
translation.kha: Haba ka theisamla kaba dang sah bad la u kpa ka kular ban ai ei ei sha U  Trai  , lane ka kular ban kyndiah na kano kano ,
U Trai u ong , Ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki long ki bymriewblei ; nga la lap ïa ki ba ki leh bymman ha ka Templ hi .
translation.en: For both prophet and priest are profane  ; yea , in my house have I found their wickedness , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka ri jong ki longïing ka jait Ephraim : u pud jong ki u sdang na Ataroth Addar ha ka phang mihngi haduh Beth Halor kaba Shaneng ,
translation.en: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus : even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth–addar , unto Beth–horon the upper  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei ki jingïasylla jong phi ktieh wanrah jingbha ei ei ïa phin — ki long bymlarkam kum ka jaiñphong ba la thain da ka snur thapbawa !
translation.en: Their webs shall not become garments , neither shall they cover themselves with their works : their works are works of iniquity , and the act of violence is in their hands .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , me long ka sur jong u paidïapom . ieid men ïap , ka jingdeng jong me kan ïap lang dara me .
translation.en: No doubt but ye are the people , and wisdom shall die with you .

translation.kha: Haba me hukum ïa ki briew jong me ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki nongshniah jong ki bad ba ki duwai ha me , Hangno hangno ha kaba ki don , ki da phai khmat sha kane ka nongbah ïa kaba me la jied bad Sha kane ka Templ ïa kabu nga la tei na ka bynta jong me ,
translation.en: If thy people go out to battle against their enemy , whithersoever thou shalt send them , and shall pray unto the  Lord  toward the city which thou hast chosen , and toward the house that I have built for thy name :

translation.kha: myntan , A Trai , me la bat ïa la ka kular , bad men shah ïa u shakri jong me ban leit noh ha kaba suk .
translation.en: Lord , now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace , according to thy word :

translation.kha: Ka la im pah , bad ka la khie joit shisyndon , bad U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki pun ai ei ei ha ka ba kan bam .
translation.en: And her spirit came again , and she arose straightway : and he commanded to give her meat .
They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes , and take away thy fair jewels .
translation.kha: Kin pynkad ïa ki jaiñ jong pha bad kin shim ïa ki mawlynnai jong pha .

translation.en: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me .
translation.kha: Lymne ba ki lah ban ai ki jingpynshisha jong ki jingkynnoh jong ki kaba ki wallam mynta pyrshah ïa nga .
La jied ïa u da U Blei ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei bad la pynpaw ha kine ki sngap babha khatduh na ka bynta jongno phi .
translation.en: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world , but was manifest in these last times for you ,

translation.kha: Ki kmie ki kpa kim dei ngab shah pynïap namar ki kam runar ki khun jngai ki , bad ki khun umdih Kim dei ban shah pynïap namar ki kam runar ki kmie ki khop jong ki ; u briew u dei ban shah pynïap tang namar ka kam runar jong u hi .
translation.en: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers : every man shall be put to death for his own sin .
Whose end is destruction , whose god is their belly , and whose glory is in their shame , who mind earthly things .
translation.kha: Ka jingkut jong ki kan long ha dujok , namar u blei jong ki u long ki jingkwah brai ka doh jong ki . Ki sngewsarong ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban sngewlehrain , bad ki pyrkhat tang ïa kiei kiei kiba long ki jong kane ka pyrthei .
Ki synran ki la ïa-pasiaw Uei ïa iwei pah da ka jinglyngngoh kaba jur , shaphang jongno u mut .
translation.en: Then the disciples looked one on another , doubting of whom he spake .
To another faith by the same Spirit ; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit ;
translation.kha: Uwei bad ujuh hi U Mynsiem u ai ïa ka jingngeit ha uwei , katba ha uwei pat , u ai ïa ka bor ban pynkhiah .
‘ Da lei lwa ruh em ! ngam ithuh ïa phi ,’ u nongleitkurim u la jop .
translation.en: But he answered and said , Verily I say unto you , I know you not .
And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel : and blow ye with the trumpet , and say , God save king Solomon .
translation.kha: ha kaba u Sadok bad u Nathan ki dei ban pynsleh ïa u kum u syiem Israel . Nangta put ïa ka turoi bad pyrta , ‘ Im slem Syiem Solomon !’
U Solomon u la kiew khet kum u syiem hadien u Dabid , u kba jongnga u , bad ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem jong u la pynskhem bha .
translation.en: Then sat Solomon upon the throne of David his father  ; and his kingdom was established greatly .

translation.kha: Dei ruh ma ki kiba la ong ha u Pharaoh banbeiñ pyllait nep ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt : these are that Moses and Aaron .

translation.kha: Ha sier ka sngi , wat trei ei ei kumba phi ju trei man la ka sngi , hynrei ïalumlang ban mane Blei . Ki ïakhun ki kyiuh jong phi ki dei ban leh ïa kane ka hukum phang la pateng shaneng shano ba ki don .
translation.en: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day , that it may be an holy convocation unto you : ye shall do no servile work therein : it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations .

translation.kha: bad to U Blei! , umbiah longkmie ka tyllong jongngi ka jingïaishah bad ka jingpynshlur , un pynlah ïa phi ban don kajuh ka jingput hapdeng jrong phi da kaba bud ïa ka nuksa U Kynther Jisu ,
translation.en: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus :

translation.kha: Te ïa u Saul — ïa uba la khot shiah u Petros — la pyndap da U Mynsiem bakynjah ; u la khmied slipar ïa uta u nongpang mandriek dara u la ong ,
translation.en: Then Saul , ( who also is called Paul , ) filled with the Holy Ghost , set his eyes on him ,

translation.kha: bad u syiemsad Jehoïakhin lem bad ka kmie jong u , ki khwan shynrong jong u , ki radbah pynsngewrem jong u , Bad ki rangbah synshar ha ka ïingsyiem , ki la pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia . Ha ka snem kaba phira jong ka jingïashun u Nebukhadnessar u la rim koidi ïa u Jehoïakhin
translation.en: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon , he , and his mother , and his servants , and his princes , and his officers : and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jeshua u la jubab , Ka Jingthoh bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U bynriew um im tang da u kpu hi , hynrei u dumok ïa kawei pa kiwei ka kyntien kaba U Blei u kren .’
translation.en: But he answered and said ,  It is written , Man shall not live by bread alone , but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God .

translation.kha: Ïa u mrad na ka bynta kane ka jingkñia dih ban pynïap ha ka bynta bashatei jong ka duwan , ha kaba ju pynïap ïa ki mrad ba la wallam kum ki jingweng tdong , bad ïa ka snam jngai u dei ba-bang synreit ha baroh sawdong Jong ka kito .
translation.en: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering : and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar .

And thou shalt say unto him , The  Lord  God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee , saying , Let my people go , that they may serve me in the wilderness : and , behold , hitherto thou wouldest not hear .
translation.kha: Nangta ong ha u Pharaoh , ‘ U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u la phah ïa nga ban ong ha phi ba phin shah ïa ki briew jong u ban leit , khnang ba kin ïoh ban mane ïa u ha ri shyiap . Hynrei haduh mynta phim shym shahshkor .

translation.en: We are confident , I say , and willing rather to be absent from the body , and to be present with the Lord .
translation.kha: Ngi dap da ka jingshlur bad ngi kham kwah ban iehnoh ïa kane ka ïing jong ngi ha ka met bad ban ïoh long ha ka ïing bad U Trai .
Um shyiap la shong la tama ha Nasareth , hynrei u la leit ban shong ban hukum ha Harnepher , ka nongrit harud ka Duriaw Galilaïa ha ka thapniang Jong ka Sebulun bad ka Naphtali .
translation.en: And leaving Nazareth , he came and dwelt in Capernaum , which is upon the sea coast , in the borders of Zabulon and Nephthalim :

translation.kha: Haba u Samson Petros u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba lah jia , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat U Jisu bad u la ong , Khie leit noh na de , ko Trai ! Nga long u bariew uba pop! !
translation.en: When Simon Peter saw it , he fell down at Jesus  knees , saying , Depart from me  ; for I am a sinful man , O Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la khum ïa ki , ki da phong jaiñ pura — ki sopti-poh , ka jaiñkup jynsur , ki tupia , malade baher — bad ki la bret ïa ki ha ka lawar ngin baklang .
translation.en: Then these men were bound in their coats , their hosen , and their hats , and their other garments , and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace .
They did not destroy the nations , concerning whom the  Lord  commanded them :
translation.kha: Kim shym la pynïap ïa ki nongmane bleithaw , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki ban leh ,
bad u la ïew ruh ïa ka riewkai kaba hep Haduh kor katta ba ka thep ar thylliej ki sbai tama .
translation.en: And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites .

translation.kha: A Trai , katno slem nga dei ban pyrta jingïalap ha shuwa ba trai shahshkor , ha shuwa ba trai Pyllait im ïa ngi na ka jinglong jubor ?
translation.en: O  Lord  , how long shall I cry , and thou wilt not hear ! even cry out unto thee of violence , and thou wilt not save !

translation.kha: Ngi sngewsarong shwa ïa ki jingshah shitom jong ngi , namar sem ïatip ba ka jingshah shitom ka pynmih ïa ka jingïaishah ,
translation.en: And not only so , but we glory in tribulations also : knowing that tribulation worketh patience ;

translation.kha: Ha kito ki sngi ym anna mano mano ba lah ban wan sad leit ha ka jingshngain , namar ba ka la don ka jingjynjar bad jingkynnoh ha ka ri baroh .
translation.en: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out , nor to him that came in , but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries .
Therefore say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more , but the word which I have spoken shall be done , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Kumta ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong : Yn ym don shuh ka jingpyntud . Ïa kaei kaba nga la ong yn pyndep . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren !

translation.en: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel , and that I am the  Lord  your God , and none else : and my people shall never be ashamed .
translation.kha: Te , ma phi ki Israel , phin tip ba nga don hapdeng jong phi bad ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga long U Blei jong phi bad ym don uwei pat . Ki briew jong nga kin ym shah ñiewbeiñ shuh .

translation.en: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon .
translation.kha: Tang khat-ar bnai hadien , katba u dang ïaid halor ka tnum jong ka ïingsyiem jong u ha Babilon ,
U kpa mar kumta hi u la pyrthuh , Nga don ka jingngeit , hynrei kam da biang . To ïarap ïa nga ba ngan don shuh shuh !
translation.en: And straightway the father of the child cried out , and said with tears , Lord , I believe  ; help thou mine unbelief .

And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah , and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense , from Geba to Beer–sheba , and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city , which were on a man s left hand at the gate of the city .
translation.kha: U wallam sha Jerusalem ïa ki lyngdoh kiba ju don ha ki nongbah ka Judah , bad ha kylleng jong ka ri u la ñiewsang ïa ki duwan ha kiba ki ju ai jingkñia . U la pyntwa ruh ïa ki duwan ba la pynkyntang sha ki ksuid-durblang hajan ka khyrdop ba la tei da u Joshua , u lat ka nongbah , kiba don sha kadiang jong ka khyrdop bah kaba ki ju rung sha ka nongbah .

translation.en: After that , he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once ; of whom the greater part remain unto this present , but some are fallen asleep .
translation.kha: Nangta u la paw ha palat sanspah ngut ki nongbud jong u ha kajuh ka por , kiba kham bun na ki , ki dang im , wat la katto katne ngut ki la ïap .

translation.en: Then Peter said unto her , How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord ? behold , the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door , and shall carry thee out .
translation.kha: Kumta u Petros u la ong ha ka ,  Balei ba ma pha bad u tnga jong pha , phi kut jingmut ban tynjuh ïa U Mynsiem jong U Trai ? Ki samla kiba la tep ïa u tnga jong pha ki la don mynta ha ka jingkhang , bad kin bah noh ïa pha ruh shabar !
Wat pynslem pun pyllait ïa uno uno uba la jan shah rai pynrem bymhok .
translation.en: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death , and those that are ready to be slain  ;

translation.kha: ha U Bela , uba Tang ma u hi U Nongpynim jong ngi , da U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , to long ka burom , ka jingkhraw bor , ka jingkhlaiñ , bad ka jingsynshar , na ki rta ba la leit khong bhor , sad mynta , mala sha ki bymjukut bad bymjukut ! Amen .
translation.en: To the only wise God our Saviour , be glory and majesty , dominion and power , both now and ever . Amen .

translation.kha: Ka bor jong U Trai ka la long lymne bad ki , malu kiba bun ki briew ki la ngeit bad ki la phai Sha U Tiras .
translation.en: And the hand of the Lord was with them : and a great number believed , and turned unto the Lord .
When a few years are come , then I shall go the way whence I shall not return .
translation.kha: Ki snem jong nga ki la nang ïaid mynta , bad nga ïaid ha ka lynti bym lah phai dien shuh .
Ïa uno Uno u bymïaineh ha nga yn bret noh ïa u kum ka tnat bad u ïap tyrkhong ; kum ïa kita ki tnat , la lumlang bad la bret noh ha ka ding , ha kaba la thang ïa ki .
translation.en: If a man abide not in me , he is cast forth as a branch , and is withered  ; and men gather them , and cast them into the fire , and they are burned .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka sngi kan poi long ïa u nongleitkurim yn shim noh na ki , te Kin sa shahjingit .
translation.en: But the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them , and then shall they fast in those days .

translation.kha: Ka khlieh jong nga ka shoh , bad nga khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . ?(Nga la khmih lynti ïa ka janmiet ban wan , hynrei kam shym wallam ei ei hynrei tang ka jingtriem .
translation.en: My heart panted , fearfulness affrighted me : the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me .

translation.kha: Hobah ki shaniah ha pa , phi kheiñ noh , u dung ïa ki tohtit jong ki , bad pynlong ïa ki ban pynkdor ïa la ki met .
translation.en: When they took hold of thee by thy hand , thou didst break , and rend all their shoulder : and when they leaned upon thee , thou brakest , and madest all their loins to be at a stand .

translation.kha: Kumta ki shah ïa ka Rekhab bad ïa ka shakri iing batskhem jong ka ba kin loit ryngkat bad u Shakri jong u Abraham lak bad ki bri jong u .
translation.en: And they sent away Rebekah their sister , and her nurse , and Abraham s servant , and his men .

translation.kha: Ynda ki la pynïap ïa Uto u mai , ki ïalam ïa ita u khynnah sha u Eli .
translation.en: And they slew a bullock , and brought the child to Eli .
For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures , thou shalt also be taken : and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together .
translation.kha: Ko Moab , pha shaniah ha la ka jingkhlaiñ bad ha la ka spah , hynrei mynta wat ïa pha ruh yn jop noh ; ïa u blei Khemosh jong pha yn ringmraw , lem bad ki khun syiem bad ki lyngdoh .
Uta u briew u la ïathuh ïa nga ba ka dom kambah phai shaphang shathie ka la long na ka bynta ki lyndum kiba lehniam ha ka templ ,
translation.en: And he said unto me , This chamber , whose prospect is toward the south , is for the priests , the keepers of the charge of the house .

translation.kha: U Jephthah u pui na la ki hynmen bad u sien shong ha ri Tob . Tahan shi kynhun ki nongkamsniew ki ïapynlong paralok bad u , bad ki leit lang kylleng lem bad u .
translation.en: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren , and dwelt in the land of Tob : and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah , and went out with him .

translation.kha: U Trai u don ïa uta uba khlei pynlang badonbor uba la kloi ban turoi ïaleh ïa ki , uta u ban wan koum u phria baher , khem u lapbah , kum ka jingshai um bakhlaiñbor , bad lai tap lup ïa ka ri .
translation.en: Behold , the Lord hath a mighty and strong one , which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm , as a flood of mighty waters overflowing , shall cast down to the earth with the hand .

translation.kha: U Jonathan u ong ha u Dabid , To ai ba U Trai U Blei ki Israel un long u Shithi hapdeng jong ngi ! Ha koum kane ka por lashai bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ngan kylli jingkylli ïa i pa . Lada ka jingthmu jong i ïa phi ka bha , ngan sa pah ktien ïa phi .
translation.en: And Jonathan said unto David , O  Lord  God of Israel , when I have sounded my father about to morrow any time , or the third day , and , behold , if there be good toward David , and I then send not unto thee , and shew it thee  ;

translation.kha: Nga duwai ym tang na ka pynbha jong ki , hynrei na ka bynta kito ruh kiba ngeit ha nga namar ka khubor jong ki .
translation.en: Neither pray I for these alone , but for them also which shall believe on me through their word  ;
But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him , and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him , that stood before him .
translation.kha: Hynrei um kheiñ kor ïa ka jingai jingmut jong kita ki riewrangbah , bad u leit pynban sha ki samla kiba ïaheh ïasan ryngkat bad u bad kiba long mynta ki nongaibuit jong u .
