U kñia ki jingainguh ha ki blei jong ki Syria , kiba la jop ïa u . U ong , Ki blei Jong ki Syria ki la ïarap ïa ki syiem Syria , kumta lada nga ai jingkñia sha ki , ki lah ban ïarap ïa nga hima . Kane ka la wanrah jingpyut ïa u bad ha ka song jong u .
translation.en: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus , which smote him : and he said , Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them , therefore will I sacrifice to them , that they may help me . But they were the ruin of him , and of all Israel .

translation.kha: Hato don mano moi ba la leh ïa kaei naba de la leh ? moi ba la ïathuh lypa ïa baroh ka ban sa jia naduh kaba mynnyngkong hajuh kaba kut ka por ?
translation.en: And who , as I , shall call , and shall declare it , and set it in order for me , since I appointed the ancient people ? and the things that are coming , and shall come , let them shew unto them .

translation.kha: sad mudui ha u lyngdoh Lebi bad u nongbishar uba treikam ha kata ka jer , bad ieh kin rai ma ki ïa kata ka mokotduma .
translation.en: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites , and unto the judge that shall be in those days , and enquire  ; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment :

translation.kha: Shaphang mihngi , don hynriew ngut ki nongap pharia man la ka sngi ; shaphang shatei , bad shaphang shathie , met nud saw ngat la buh na ka bynta ka kamra pahuh tiar .
translation.en: Eastward were six Levites , northward four a day , southward four a day , and toward Asuppim two and two .
But when the Comforter is come , whom I will send unto you from the Father , even the Spirit of truth , which proceedeth from the Father , he shall testify of me :
translation.kha: U Nongïarap un wan — U Mynsiem , uba pynpaw ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei bad uba wan na U Kpa . Ngan phah ïa u na U Kpa , bad un kren shaphang jong nga .
Ko Trai’ , U Blei jong nga , ar long u shakri jong me . shahskhor ïa ka jingduwai Jong nga , bad to ai ïa ki jingkyrpad kiba nga la pan na me ha kane ka sngi .
translation.en: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant , and to his supplication , O  Lord  my God , to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer , which thy servant prayeth before thee to day :

translation.kha: Ka ia ban long ba u Onesimos u la don jngai na me katto katne por khnang ba manna ïoh paw ïa u ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season , that thou shouldest receive him for ever  ;

translation.kha: a Jinglamphrang Ïa Ka Shithi U Paul sha Ki Nong rhem la thoh ban pynkhreh lynti ïa ka jinghukum u Baal ban leit khmih ïa ka Balang ha Rom . Ka jingthmu jong u ka long ban Trei khappud ki Khristan kiba don Hangne katto katne por bad nangta , da ka jingkyrshan jong ki , ban leit sha Spain . U la thoh Ban batai ïa ka jingsngewthuh jong u ïa ka jingngeit Khristan bad ka jingpyntreikam ïa ka na ka bynta ka jingim Khristan . Ka shithi ka don ha ka ïa ka jingïathuh ba-dap pura shapoh ka khubor jong u Paul . Hodaïah ba u la ai khublei ïa kiba ha ka tong ha Rom bad ïathuh ïa ki ïa ka jingduwai jong u na ka bynta jong ki , u Baal u ïatih ïa ka phangpdeng jong ka shithi : Naba ka Gospel ka pynpaw kumno U Bel u pynlong ïa ki briew ban ne ka jingïadei kaba beit bad U hi : ka hir lyntang ka jingngeit naduh kabu Sdang haduh kaba kut (
translation.en: And when they were escaped , then they knew that the island was called Melita .

translation.kha: Lada ka ri ka phiah ïa lade ha ki kynjah babha ïalap pyrshah para ma ki , kata ka ri kan kyllon ne .
translation.en: And if a kingdom be divided against itself , that kingdom cannot stand .

translation.kha: bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ulla ki dei u Arah , u Hanniel , bad u Risia .
translation.en: And the sons of Ulla  ; Arah , and Haniel , and Rezia .

translation.kha: U Trai u ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor jong ki ; ki Israel ki tur ïaleh bad ki bad ki beh kthong ïa ki Shaphan shatei haw Misrephoth Amam bun Sidon , malu shaphang mihngi haduh ka them Mispah . Ka jingïaleh ka neh haduh ba ym don shuh uwei ruh u nongshniah uba lait im .
translation.en: And the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of Israel , who smote them , and chased them unto great Zidon , and unto Misrephoth–maim , and unto the valley of Mizpeh eastward  ; and they smote them , until they left them none remaining .
Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God , to confirm the promises made unto the fathers :
translation.kha: Naba nga ong ïa phi ba ka jingim jong ka jingshakri U Khrist ka la long na ka bynta ki Jiw , ban pyn-i ba U Blei u long uba ïaineh , ban pynlong ïa ki kular jong u ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ban urlong shisha ,

translation.en: No man , when he hath lighted a candle , putteth it in a secret place , neither under a bushel , but on a candlestick , that they which come in may see the light .
translation.kha: Ym don uba thang ïa ka sharak bad nangta u buhrieh ïa ka lane buh ïa ka hapoh ka shang ; pynban , u buh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharak , khnang ba ki briew ki lah ban ïohi ïa ka jingshai katba ki wan rung shapoh .
Balei ki nongsharai jylli ki wei ïakynduh ïa ki balang ?
translation.en: For what purpose do circuit overseers visit the congregations ?

translation.kha: Lada pa’ phla ba U Jisu u long U Trai bun ngeit ba U Blei u la pynjop ïa u na ka jingpah , phin lait im .
translation.en: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus , and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead , thou shalt be saved .

translation.kha: Ko pa kiba hok baroh to lehhok namar kaei kaba U Trai u la leh ! To kyntiew ïa kaei kaban U Blei uba khuid u la har , bad to ingiew ïa u .
translation.en: Rejoice in the  Lord  , ye righteous  ; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness .

For I know him , that he will command his children and his household after him , and they shall keep the way of the  Lord  , to do justice and judgment  ; that the  Lord  may bring upon Abraham that which he hath spoken of him .
translation.kha: Nga la jied ïa u khnang ba un hukum ïa la ki khun shynrang bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u ba kin kohnguh ïa nga bad ban leh ïa kata kaba dei bad kaba hok . Lada ki leh kumta , ngan leh lut ïa kata kaba nga la kular ha u .
Hangno don na ki symboh jong ki nongbah ka Hammedatha , Arpad , Sepharbaim , Hena bad Ibbah ?
translation.en: Where is the king of Hamath , and the king of Arpad , and the king of the city of Sepharvaim , Hena , and Ivah ?

translation.kha: to ai um ïa ki briew’ kiba sliang ibha wan sha phi . Phi ki briew jong ka ri Tema , to ai jingbam ïa ki nongphetwir .
translation.en: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty , they prevented with their bread him that fled .

translation.kha: Ka por ka wan ha ka ïa ki biria jong ka Jerusalem yn ïathiah ba ka lyer khluit ka beh shapoh shuh ki na ka ri shyiap . Na ym long ka lyer kaba her jai kaba Shuah beh pynher noh ïa u stait —
translation.en: At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem , A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people , not to fan , nor to cleanse ,

translation.kha: Haba phi rung sha ka ri ïa kaba U tharai u la klun ban ai ha phi , phi dei ban leh ïa kane ka jinglehniam .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when ye be come to the land which the  Lord  will give you , according as he hath promised , that ye shall keep this service .
To call passengers who go right on their ways :
translation.kha: bad ka khot ïa ki briew kiba ïaid nangta , kiba dang leit sha la ka kam :
Kan sa long kaba kut ïa wer kiba banbeiñ ïa kiwei bad kiba pyn-i jingibeiñ ïa U Bela . Ïa uwei pa uwei u nongpynkren yn pynjot .
translation.en: For the terrible one is brought to nought , and the scorner is consumed , and all that watch for iniquity are cut off :

translation.kha: Ngan pyni ïa ka jingbun briew jyllang phi . Phira sa shong ha ki nongbah bad tei pat ïa baroh kiba sah ha ka jingjot .
translation.en: And I will multiply men upon you , all the house of Israel , even all of it : and the cities shall be inhabited , and the wastes shall be builded :

translation.kha: Wah ïalaw ïa ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron ban pynphong sopti ïa ki .
translation.en: And thou shalt bring his sons , and put coats upon them .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingshisha ka long ba ïa U Khrist la pynmih na ka jingïap , kum ka jingbahkhlieh ba ïa kito kiba la ïap yn sa pynmihpat ruh ïa ki .
translation.en: But now is Christ risen from the dead , and become the firstfruits of them that slept .
Then shall ye remember your own evil ways , and your doings that were not good , and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations .
translation.kha: Phin sa kynmaw ïa ki jingleh bymman jong phi bad ïa ki jingbakla ba phi la leh , bad phin sa isih ïa lade namar ki pop jong phi bad ki jingleh palat jong phi .
namar ka spah kad Neah julam . Ym ei wat ki hima ruh ki ban kein junom .
translation.en: For riches are not for ever : and doth the crown endure to every generation ?

translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba eh ban prong bad rung shapoh ka ïing kaba slem jong u briew bad rai noh ïa ki tiar ki tar lypa u teh nyngkong ïa u briew uba khlam ; te un sa lah ban lute ïa ka ïing jongki u .
translation.en: No man can enter into a strong man s house , and spoil his goods , except he will first bind the strong man  ; and then he will spoil his house .

translation.kha: Bunni ki briew ki la siang ïa ki jaiñkup ha lynti . Kaba kiwei pat ki dang ïa-ot ïa ki tnat dieng ha ki lyngkha bad ki la diengtied ïa ki ha ka lynti .
translation.en: And many spread their garments in the way : and others cut down branches off the trees , and strawed them in the way .
By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison  ;
translation.kha: bad ha ka jingdon jong u ha ka mynsiem , u la leit bad ïalap ha ki mynsiem kiba la shah khum .
Nangta kito kiba myntri ki long babha khatduh kin hir nongking , malade re kiba mynta ki long nongking kin longkmie khatduh .
translation.en: And , behold , there are last which shall be first , and there are first which shall be last .

translation.kha: Ngi kohnguh ïa ka Aiñ ba u Massah u ai ha ngi , ka spah kordor tam jong ka jaitbynriew jongno sem .
translation.en: Moses commanded us a law , even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob .

translation.kha: Kaba mih na kaei ba ki apostol ki la leh , ka long ba ïa ki bri kiba pang la rah sha ki lynti bah bad la buh ha ki jingthiah bad ki shylliah khang ba la Kumno kumno ka syrngiew jong u Petros kan dei ha ki katto katne ngut na ki katba u dang ïaid dum .
translation.en: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets , and laid them on beds and couches , that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them .

translation.kha: Ki nongwei ken bam ei ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkhuh jongno phi ha bakha phira la trei shitom , katba phi pait phim ym ïoh ei ei lait tang ka jingshah banbeiñ bad ka jingshah lehniam suda .
translation.en: The fruit of thy land , and all thy labours , shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up  ; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway :
Hereby know we that we dwell in him , and he in us , because he hath given us of his Spirit .
translation.kha: Ngi sngewskhem ba ngi im ha U Blei bad ba u im hapoh jong ngi , namar ba u la ai ha ngi ïa U Mynsiem jong u .

translation.en: And they shall not come near unto me , to do the office of a priest unto me , nor to come near to any of my holy things , in the most holy place : but they shall bear their shame , and their abominations which they have committed .
translation.kha: Kim dei ban shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngdoh lane leit hajan kano kano kaba khuid ïa nga lane ban rung shapoh ka Jaka Bakyntang Tam . Kane ka dei ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki la leh .

ngi khot ïa ki kiba Suk namar ki la long kiba ïaishah . Phi la jingsngewsih ïa ka jingthiah u Ishbi , bad phi tip Kumno U Trai u la pyndap ïa u ha naba kut . Nob U Trai u long uba ïap da ka jinglehisynei bad jinglehsbun .
translation.en: Behold , we count them happy which endure . Ye have heard of the patience of Job , and have seen the end of the Lord  ; that the Lord is very pitiful , and of tender mercy .

translation.kha: Ki longïng na ka kur Kohath jong ka jait Lebi ki long kiba nyngkong eh ban ïoh ïa ki nongbah . Ki longïing uba hiarpateng na u Aaron u lyngdoh ki ïoh khatlai thyllah ki nongbam na ki jaka jong ki jait Judas , Solomon bad Benjamin .
translation.en: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites : and the children of Aaron the priest , which were of the Levites , had by lot out of the tribe of Judah , and out of the tribe of Simeon , and out of the tribe of Benjamin , thirteen cities .

translation.kha: To beh kthong ïa ki bad ñiad noh! ïa ki na ka khyndew !
translation.en: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the  Lord .

translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei tud haw ha uta u briew uba pynkheiñ bhor ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkhet bad katno ïano ka tnga u kpa jong u .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his father s wife  ; because he uncovereth his father s skirt . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: Nongbah kiwei ki la pynnoh ïa kiei kaba tam na ka sleh jong ki ; hynrei ma ka , ha ka jingduk jong ka , ka la pynnoh ïa Baroh kiba ka don — ka la ai ïa baroh kaweh kyrshan ïa ka jingim jong ka .
translation.en: For all they did cast in of their abundance  ; but she of her want did cast in all that she had , even all her living .

translation.kha: To pyllait ïa na na ki jingibeiñ kiba nga pynsheptieng ; A kano babha phylla long ki jingbishar jong me !
translation.en: Turn away my reproach which I fear : for thy judgments are good .

translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka long , U Blei u la buh ïa ki dkhot kiba ïapher ha ka set kumba u kwah ïa ki ba kin long .
translation.en: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body , as it hath pleased him .
When he made a decree for the rain , and a way for the lightning of the thunder :
translation.kha: Haba U Blei u rai hangno ba u slap un hap , bad ïa ka lynti ki lyoh ba pynlong pyrthat ;
U Judas Iskariot , uwei na ki synran jyllang u — uta u ban sa shalyngka ïa u — u la ong ,
translation.en: Then saith one of his disciples , Judas Iscariot , Simon s son , which should betray him ,

translation.kha: U Trai u isih ïa kiba lamler , hynrei u sngewbha ïa iar kiba bat ïa la ka kti .
translation.en: Lying lips are abomination to the  Lord  : but they that deal truly are his delight .

translation.kha: Haba la ïathuh ha u ïakob ba u Joseph u khwan jong u , u wan jngoh ïa u , u pyneh katba lah ban shong ha la jingthiah .
translation.en: And one told Jacob , and said , Behold , thy son Joseph cometh unto thee : and Israel strengthened himself , and sat upon the bed .
For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words , of him shall the Son of man be ashamed , when he shall come in his own glory , and in his Father s , and of the holy angels .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u lehrain ïa nga bad ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , te U Khun U Briew un lehrain ïa u haba u wan ha ka burom jong u bad ha ka burom jong U Kpa bad jong ki angel bakhuid .
Ngan pynwit ïa ki nongshniah jong ka — ki rangbah kiba stad , ki nongïalam , malu ki shipai . Kin ïohthiah bad kin ym kyndit haw . Ma nga u syiem , nga la kren . Ang longsyiem U Trai badonbok Baroh .
translation.en: And I will make drunk her princes , and her wise men , her captains , and her rulers , and her mighty men : and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep , and not wake , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts .
And they two made a covenant before the  Lord  : and David abode in the wood , and Jonathan went to his house .
translation.kha: Kita baroh ar ngut ki la pynlong ka jingïateh kular bakyntang iwei ïa iwei pat . U Dabid u sah ha Horesh , bad u Jonathan u leit noh sha ïing .
Hynrei la don u briew uba kyrteng u Ananias , uba , lem bad ka tnga jong u ka Sapphira , ki la die katto katjuh na ka jaka kaba dei ka jong ki .
translation.en: But a certain man named Ananias , with Sapphira his wife , sold a possession ,
Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee  ; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee , and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations .
translation.kha: Nga la jied ïa me ha shuwa ba nga ai jingim ïa me , bad ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa me , nga la jied ïa me ban long u nongïathuhlypa sha ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: These have power to shut heaven , that it rain not in the days of their prophecy : and have power over waters to turn them to blood , and to smite the earth with all plagues , as often as they will .
translation.kha: Ki don ka bor ban set ïa ka sahit bneng ba yn ym hap slap ha ka por ba ki pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei . Ki don ka bor ruh halor ki pukri um , ban pynkylla snam ïa ki ; ki don ka bor ruh ban shoh ïa ka khyndew da kano kano ka jait khlam katba shong ka mon jong ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Behold , the people is one , and they have all one language  ; and this they begin to do : and now nothing will be restrained from them , which they have imagined to do .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ,  Mynta te , kine baroh ki la long uwei u paid bynriew bad ki ïakren kawei ka ktien ; kane ka dei tang ka jingsdang jong kaei kaba kin sa leh . Shen shen kin lah ban leh ïa kano kano kat kaba ki thmu !

U syiem Dabid u ong , por dat ban pyn-i ïa ka jinglong paralok bashisha ïa u Hanun , kumba u kpa jong u , u Nahshon u la leh ïa por . Kumta u Sabad u phah ki nonglamktien ban pynnep ïa ka jingsngewlem jong u . wahbah ki la poi ha Amen bad ïakynduh ïa u syiem Hanun ,
translation.en: And David said , I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash , because his father shewed kindness to me . And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father . So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun , to comfort him .

translation.kha: Phi pule ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , Namarba phi pynkoit ba ha ki phin shem ïa ka jingim bymsngewnguh . Bad kine hi ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki kren shaphang jong nga !
translation.en: Search the scriptures  ; for in them ye think ye have eternal life : and they are they which testify of me .

translation.kha: lang ai ha me ïa ka ri kob nga la ai ha u Abraham dara ha u Isaak , malu ngan ai ïa ka ruh ha ki khun ki ksiew shadien jong me .
translation.en: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac , to thee I will give it , and to thy seed after thee will I give the land .

translation.kha: U Trai un wallam ka jingpang bashyrkhei shalor ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba ïaleh thma ïa ka Jeremaïah . Ka doh jong ki kuna pyllait noh katne ki ïalang im ; ki khmat bad ki thylliej jong ki kin pyut noh .
translation.en: And this shall be the plague wherewith the  Lord  will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem  ; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet , and their eyes shall consume away in their holes , and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth .
Do ye not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple ? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar ?
translation.kha: Da shisha phi tip ba ki rangbah kiba trei ha ka Templ ki ïoh bam na ka Templ bad kito kiba kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha ka duwan ki ïoh ïa ka bynta na ki jingkñia ?

translation.en: Behold , I cry out of wrong , but I am not heard : I cry aloud , but there is no judgment .
translation.kha: Nga pyrshah ïa kane ka jingleh jubor jong u , hynrei ym don ba shahshkor ; ym don uba ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam jong nga ban ïoh ïa ka hok .
Hynrei un Uno kaba ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien jong nga bad u bymkohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba bieit uba la ter ïa la ka ïing halor u shym .
translation.en: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them not , shall be likened unto a foolish man , which built his house upon the sand :

translation.kha: Naba ngi pynkdang ba u briew u don ka jinglonghok bad U Blei! thiang lyngba ka jingngeit , bad ym da kambah leh ïa kaei kiba ka Hukum ka dawa .
translation.en: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law .

translation.kha: Da shisha , kat kum ka Hukum , la jan baroh kiei kaei la pynkhuid da ka snam , bad ïa ki pop la map noh tangba lada la heh ïa ka snam .
translation.en: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood  ; and without shedding of blood is no remission .
It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck , and he cast into the sea , than that he should offend one of these little ones .
translation.kha: Kan kham bha ïa u lada la teh ha ka ryndang jong u ïa u mawtylliat uba heh bad bret ïa u sha ka duriaw ban ïa kaba ma u , u pynlong ïa uwei na kine kiba rit ban leh pop .

translation.en: Again he said unto me , Prophesy upon these bones , and say unto them , O ye dry bones , hear the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  To ïathuhlypa halor kine ki shyieng . Ïathuh ha kine ki shyieng kiba tyrkhong ban shahshkor ïa ka ktien U  Trai .

translation.en: And they shall pass through it , hardly bestead and hungry : and it shall come to pass , that when they shall be hungry , they shall fret themselves , and curse their king and their God , and look upward .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin ïaid sakma lyngba ka ri , kiba la noh mynsiem bad thngan . Ha ka jingthngan bad jingbitar jong ki , kin tim ïa u syiem jong ki bad ïa U Blei jong ki . Ki lah ban khmih sha ka sahit bneng

translation.en: When thou vowest a vow unto God , defer not to pay it  ; for he hath no pleasure in fools : pay that which thou hast vowed .
translation.kha: Kumta haba phi pynlong ka jingkular ha U Blei , pyndep kloi ïa ka katba lah . Um donkam ïa u bieit . Leh ïa kaei kaba phi kular ban leh .

translation.en: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary .
translation.kha: Ka Templ jong ngi ka long kum ka khet badonburom , kaba ïeng halor jong u lumbah bajrong naduh kaba sdang .

U Isaïah u jubab , Na la pynlong ïa u , u kynrad halor jong me , bad nga la pynlong ïa ki kur ki jait jong u ban long ki mraw jong u . Nga la ai ha u ïa u khep pynlang ka waiñ . Mynta mem don ei ei shuh ba ang lah ban leh na ka bynta jongno me , ko khur ?
translation.en: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau , Behold , I have made him thy lord , and all his brethren have I given to him for servants  ; and with corn and wine have I sustained him : and what shall I do now unto thee , my son ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la lai kumta , naba kata kan jingsan da la wallam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong de hateng ki jaitbynriew katba la ha ïohi ïa ar ba nga ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na Ijipt .
translation.en: But I wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted before the heathen , in whose sight I brought them out .

translation.kha: U Sekharaïah u la pan ïa ka kynja sleit badno u la thoh , Ka kyrthat jong u ka long u Ïoannis . A katno baroh ki la ïasngew kyndit !
translation.en: And he asked for a writing table , and wrote , saying , His name is John . And they marvelled all .

translation.kha: A woh ni ïa kata ! Kiar na ka kam bymman ! Kyntait ïa ka bad ïawad ha la ka lynti .
translation.en: Avoid it , pass not by it , turn from it , and pass away .

translation.kha: U thlim u don ar ngut ki khun kynthei , bad baroh ar ki kyrteng Ai ïa na ! Don saw tylli ki kiei ki bym ju kdang :
translation.en: The horseleach hath two daughters , crying , Give , give . There are three things that are never satisfied , yea , four things say not , It is enough :

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la ap sumar ïa ki sniang ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba lah jia , kumta ki la kjit noh bun ki la pynphriang ïa ka khur hapoh ka shnong bad ha ki jaka ri jingri .
translation.en: When they that fed them saw what was done , they fled , and went and told it in the city and in the country .

translation.kha: Haba pa shong bam bad u briew uba donburom , da shuh jingmut ba u long uei .
translation.en: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler , consider diligently what is before thee :
Then Peter said unto them , Repent , and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins , and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: U Petros u la ong ha ki ,  Uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban phai noh na ki pop jong u bad ba yn pynbaptis ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist , khnang ba yn map ïa ki pop jong phi , bad phin ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid uba long ka jingai jong U Blei .
Naba uno uno baroh uba pan un ïohpdiang , pynlang du uno uba wad un shem , bad ka jingkhang lai plie ïa uta uba tied .
translation.en: For every one that asketh receiveth  ; and he that seeketh findeth  ; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened .

translation.kha: Nga la pynduhbor ïa ki bhabriew kiba shyrkhei bad nga la pyllait ïa kiba shah lehbeiñ na ki .
translation.en: And I brake the jaws of the wicked , and plucked the spoil out of his teeth .

And David assembled all the princes of Israel , the princes of the tribes , and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course , and the captains over the thousands , and captains over the hundreds , and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king , and of his sons , with the officers , and with the mighty men , and with all the valiant men , unto Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar jong ki Israel ban ïalumlang ha Jerusalem . Kumta baroh ki rangbah synshar jong ki jait , ki rangbah synshar kiba pynïaid ïa ka kam jong ka Hima , ki nongïalam jong ki kur , ki nongpeit ïa ki jingdon jingem bad ki jingri kiba dei jong u syiem bad ki khun shynrang jong u — Shisha ki rangbah synshar ka ïingsyiem , ki shipai kiba lamkhmat , bad ki rangbah badonkam — ki la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: A people great , and many , and tall , as the Anakims  ; but the  Lord  destroyed them before them  ; and they succeeded them , and dwelt in their stead :
translation.kha: Ki long kiba jrong kat ki Anakim , kiba bun paid , bad kiba khlaiñ . Hynrei U  Trai  u la pynjot ïa ki baroh , kumta ki Ammon ki ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki bad ki shong hangta .

translation.en: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard , into the prison , the place where Joseph was bound .
translation.kha: bad u la set ïa ki hapoh byndi ha ka ïing jong u kapten jong ki nongap phira , ha kajuh ka jaka ha kaba la buh ïa u Joseph .
ka ri Naphtali baroh kawei ; ki ri Ephraim bad Manasseh ; ka ri —Judah shaduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian shaphang sepngi ;
translation.en: And all Naphtali , and the land of Ephraim , and Manasseh , and all the land of Judah , unto the utmost sea ,

translation.kha: Kynmaw shwa ïa ki jingtynjuh kiba shyrkhei kiba phi la ïohi , da ki kambah bad ki iphylla , bad da ka borbah da ka ksang ti kaba la kner da kaba U Trai U balui jong phi u la pyllait ïa Phi , kumta mad un pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew baroh ïa kiba phi sheptieng .
translation.en: The great temptations which thine eyes saw , and the signs , and the wonders , and the mighty hand , and the stretched out arm , whereby the  Lord  thy God brought thee out : so shall the  Lord  thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid .

translation.kha: Ko ïakhun u briew , hangne ka dei ka khet jong nga . Ngan shong hangtei hapdeng ki paidlang Israel bad synshar halor jong ki junom . Ki paid Jeruel Leummim ki symboh jong ki , kin ym pynjahburom shuh ïa Kyrteng bakhuid jong nga da kaba mane ïa Kiwei pat ki blei lane da kaweh tep ïa ki metïap jong ki syiem jong ki ha kane ka jaka .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , the place of my throne , and the place of the soles of my feet , where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever , and my holy name , shall the house of Israel no more defile , neither they , nor their kings , by their whoredom , nor by the carcases of their kings in their high places .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw , ki la rakhe ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha ka sngi kambah khatsaw jongki u bnai banyngkong jongno ka snem kaba burom .
translation.en: And the children of the captivity kept the passover upon the fourteenth day of the first month .

And he shall dwell in that city , until he stand before the congregation for judgment , and until the death of the high priest that shall be in those days : then shall the slayer return , and come unto his own city , and unto his own house , unto the city from whence he fled .
translation.kha: U lah ban sah ha ka nongbah haduh ban da bishar paidbah ïa u bad haduh ka jingïap jong u briew uba long u Rangbah Lyngdoh ha kata ka por . Hadien kata , u lah ban leit phai pat sha ïing sha la ka shnong , na kaba u la phet ïap .

Ngan pynlong ka jutang bad ki kaba pynseisoh ïa ka jingshongshngain jong ki . Ngan baheh noh ïa ki mrad kynshi baroh na ka ri , khring ba ki langbrot jong nga kin im ha ka jingshngain ha ki jaka phlang bad thiah ha ki khlaw .
translation.en: And I will make with them a covenant of peace , and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land : and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness , and sleep in the woods .

translation.kha: Ki brai kin wan na ki shnong jong ka Judah bun na ki shnongrit sawdong jong ka Jerusalem ; kin wan na ka thain Benjamin , na ki kjat lum , na ki lumbah , bad na ka bynta bashispah jong ka Judah . Kin Wallam sha ka Telem jong nga ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ïa ki jinganna , ki jingainguh bam bad ka jingbeh , kumjuh ruh ka jingainguh sngewnguh .
translation.en: And they shall come from the cities of Judah , and from the places about Jerusalem , and from the land of Benjamin , and from the plain , and from the mountains , and from the south , bringing burnt offerings , and sacrifices , and meat offerings , and incense , and bringing sacrifices of praise , unto the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki tur pyrshah ïa ki Ben-ammi ha ka sien kaban ar .
translation.en: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day .

translation.kha: To map ïa I ïa ki jingpalat Kiba I la leh , kumba ngi map ïa ki jingpalat babha kiwei ki la leh ïa ngi .
translation.en: And forgive us our debts , as we forgive our debtors .

translation.kha: U Jiw u la Khot ïa la ki synran sha lade Bad u la ong , Na isynei ïa kine ki brai , namar ki la ïadon bad nga la lai sngi bad mynta kim don ei ei ban bam . Ngam kwah baneh phah noh ïa ki khlem da bsa ïa ki , naba ki lah banbeiñ ïapler ha ka lynti jyllang ki sha la ïing .
translation.en: Then Jesus called his disciples unto him , and said ,  I have compassion on the multitude , because they continue with me now three days , and have nothing to eat : and I will not send them away fasting , lest they faint in the way .

translation.kha: U syiemsad u la bitar tyngeh ; kumta u la phah ïa ki shipai jong u , kiba la pynïap ïa kito ki nongpynïaid briew bad ki la thang duh ïa ka nongbah jongno ki .
translation.en: But when the king heard thereof , he was wroth : and he sent forth his armies , and destroyed those murderers , and burned up their city .

translation.kha: bad u la Kyrpad rit ïa u , Ka khunlung rit jong per ka pang jur . To jingsngewbha ban wan bad buh ïa la ki Ki halor jong ka , khnang ba kan khaweh bad ïoh im .
translation.en: And besought him greatly , saying , My little daughter lieth at the point of death : I pray thee , come and lay thy hands on her , that she may be healed  ; and she shall live .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki briew naba per ieit ki la leh ïa kiei kiei Kiba sniew . Ki don hok Aiu ban don hapoh ka Templ jong nga ? Hato ki pyrkhat ba ki lah ba ïada na ka jingpynjot da kaba pynlong ki jingkular pynlang da kaba ai ki jingkñia da ki mrad ? Hato kata kan pyndem ïa ki ?
translation.en: What hath my beloved to do in mine house , seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many , and the holy flesh is passed from thee ? when thou doest evil , then thou rejoicest .

translation.kha: U lyngngeit u dei shun thang noh ïa ka , namar ka den ka jingpang bthuh kaba pura! , kaba dei ban pynduh da ka ding .
translation.en: He shall therefore burn that garment , whether warp or woof , in woollen or in linen , or any thing of skin , wherein the plague is : for it is a fretting leprosy  ; it shall be burnt in the fire .
And he said unto them , Nay , but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ha ki ,  Em ! Phi la ïawan ban khmih ha-ei kane ka ri ka shong tlot .

translation.en: And Rebekah arose , and her damsels , and they rode upon the camels , and followed the man : and the servant took Rebekah , and went his way .
translation.kha: Te ka Rebekka bad ki kynthei samla jong ka ki la dep khreh bad kiew ban shong halor ki ut ban leit bad u shakri jong u Abraham , bad ki ïamih lang baroh .
U Jahath ruh u to para ngut ki khun shynrang : u Pasakh , u Bimhal , bad u Abishag .
translation.en: And the sons of Japhlet  ; Pasach , and Bimhal , and Ashvath . These are the children of Japhlet .

translation.kha: Ha ki por ki ban wang baroh uno uno na ki shynrang kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ki lah ban bam ïa ka pateng la pateng kum ka pyntha na ki jingkñia ainguh bam sha U Tlai . Ïano uno uwei pat uba ktah ïa ka jingainguh smam un mynsaw na ka bor ka jingkhuid jong ka .
translation.en: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it . It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire : every one that toucheth them shall be holy .

translation.kha: Ai ha Kiba duk bad phin ym don ha ka jingkyrduh lano lynnong ruh . Lada phi khapbrip la ki khmat sha kiba tun , ki brisoh Ibbah bun kin tim ïa phi .
translation.en: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack : but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse .

translation.kha: Me la thung ïa ki , malade ki la suhthied ; ki san bad ki pynmih soh . Ki ju krung bha shaphang jong me , pynbun kim da salia eh shisha shaphang Jong me .
translation.en: Thou hast planted them , yea , they have taken root : they grow , yea , they bring forth fruit : thou art near in their mouth , and far from their reins .

And David said on that day , Whosoever getteth up to the gutter , and smiteth the Jebusites , and the lame and the blind , that are hated of David s soul , he shall be chief and captain . Wherefore they said , The blind and the lame shall not come into the house .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi u Dabid u ong ha ki rangbah jong u ,  Hato don uno uno hangne uba isih ïa ki Jebus kumba isih ma nga ? Haduh katta kat ban pynïap ïa ki ? Te khie leit kiew lyngba ka nur-um bad tur ïaleh ïa kito ki bapli ki matlah bad ki dkoh .  ( Dei na kata ka daw ba la ong ,  Kiba matlah bad kiba dkoh kim lah ban rung sha ka ïing ka jong U  Trai .  )

translation.en: Take with you words , and turn to the  Lord  : say unto him , Take away all iniquity , and receive us graciously : so will we render the calves of our lips .
translation.kha: To phai sha u Trai , bad ai ba kane ka jingduwai kan long ka jingainguh sha u :  To map ïa ki pop jong ngi baroh bad pdiang ïa ki jingduwai jong ngi , bad ngin ïaroh ïa me kumba ngi la kular .
Kita ki ainguh myntor ki pyrshang ban pyndonkam ïa ki buit myntor jyllang ki ban pynmih mait , hynrei kim lah . Bad kat shab leit don tangba ki mait suda .
translation.en: And the magicians did so with their enchantments to bring forth lice , but they could not : so there were lice upon man , and upon beast .

translation.kha: kumta u ïa-ong ha u , I pa i pylleng ban pynïap ïa phi . Sngewbha da leh Hushah Lasaïa mynhyndai ; rieh ha ka jaka i don batbit bad praw hangta .
translation.en: But Jonathan Saul s son delighted much in David : and Jonathan told David , saying , Saul my father seeketh to kill thee : now therefore , I pray thee , take heed to thyself until the morning , and abide in a secret place , and hide thyself :

translation.kha: Wah la kiba shah ringmraw katba la wan phai , ki bthing ïa ki briew Ibbah shong basah ha ka ri , pynban ki tei biang ïa ka duwan ha ka kajuh ba ka ïeng mynshuwa . Hangta ki sdang biang ban thang halor jong ka ïa ki jingkñia man ka step bad man ka jingneit .
translation.en: And they set the altar upon his bases  ; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries : and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the  Lord  , even burnt offerings morning and evening .

translation.kha: Bad ka Law kaba dei ban wallam jingim , ha nga , ka la khlam ka jingïap .
translation.en: And the commandment , which was ordained to life , I found to be unto death .
So Rab–shakeh returned , and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah : for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish .
translation.kha: U rangbah synshar ka Assyria u ïoh jingtip ba u patsha u la mih na Lakhish bad u ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka nongbah Libnah kaba don marjan ; kumta u leit shata ban twad jingmut na u .
Uno uno uba Long u khun jong U Bel , um ïadei imat pop , nabar ka jingrang blei batynrai jongnga U blei hi ka don ha u ; bad namar U Blei u long u Kpa jong u , um lah ban ïai bteng ban leh pop .
translation.en: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin  ; for his seed remaineth in him : and he cannot sin , because he is born of God .

translation.kha: U la ai ïa ki ri jngai ki ha ki briew jong u ; ka jingibieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translation.en: And gave their land for an heritage : for his mercy endureth for ever :

translation.kha: U la bran ïa de ha ka ktieh ; ngam da ïahiar shuh na ka hajuh .
translation.en: He hath cast me into the mire , and I am become like dust and ashes .
And Laban said unto him , I pray thee , if I have found favour in thine eyes , tarry : for I have learned by experience that the  Lord  hath blessed me for thy sake .
translation.kha: U Laban u ong ha u ,  Shah ba ngan ong ïa kane : nga la ïoh jingtip da kaba wad na U Blei ba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa nga namar jong me .
U Isaak u khnam jied ïa u Iso , namar u bang bha ban ïam ïa ki mirr kiba u Iso u pynïap , hynrei ka Sabteka ka kham jied ïa u Jakob .
translation.en: And Isaac loved Esau , because he did eat of his venison : but Rebekah loved Jacob .

translation.kha: Ki nongbet kiba mynta ki don ha ka jingrisa kin sa dap da ki paidïapom kumba ka Jerusalem shisien ka ju dap da ki langbrot ba la wandur kum ki jingïania ha ka Jingkhawai Niam . Te kin sa tip ba la long U Trai .
translation.en: As the holy flock , as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts  ; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: U shaniah ha U Blei! bad u kam ba u long U Khun U Blei . Kumta , te , to ngin peit lama U blang u kwah ban pynim ïa u mynta !
translation.en: He trusted in God  ; let him deliver him now , if he will have him : for he said , I am the Son of God .

translation.kha: Nga shem ïa ka jingkmen jong nga ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki sah” jong me .
translation.en: This I had , because I kept thy precepts .

translation.kha: Ka jingngeit ka long ka umpohliew jong ka jingim ha ibha stad , hynrei kaba pyrshang ban ai jingïakhaïi ïa kiba mutlop ka long tong ka jingpynlut kai ïa ka por .
translation.en: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it : but the instruction of fools is folly .

translation.kha: Hadien ka pop bad ka jingiap ka la waiñ sha ka pyrthei , U Blei u la pynpaw ba ka long ka jingthmu jong u , ba kiba iap kin ieh biang ia ka jingim da ka jingmap .
translation.en: After sin and death entered the world , God revealed that it was his purpose that the dead be restored to life by means of a resurrection .
In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel , and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers .
translation.kha: Ka Israel kan ïasoh bad ka Judah , bad ryngkat lang kin ïawan na ka jingshah ringmraw ha ka ri kaba shatei bad kin wan phai sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi kum ka jingdon jingem kaba neh .
Kane kan jia ha ki namar kiei shym la kthong ïa ka khubor kaba ang ju ïai phah sha ki lyngngoh ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jong nga . Ki la kyntait ban shah .
translation.en: Because they have not hearkened to my words , saith the  Lord  , which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets , rising up early and sending them  ; but ye would not hear , saith the  Lord .
And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul :
translation.kha: U Blei u la leh ki kambah kiba kham phylla lyngba u Paul .

translation.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari , according to all their service , in the tabernacle of the congregation , under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .
translation.kha: Kine ki kur u Merari kin shong dara ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Ïingjaiñ , lem bad u Suriel u khun jong u Abihail kum u rangbah kur .

translation.en: If he called them gods , unto whom the word of God came , and the scripture cannot be broken  ;
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ïa kaei kaba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ka long kaba shisha junom ; bad U Blei u la khot ïa kito ki briew ki blei , ki briew ha kiba U Blei u la ai ïa ka khubor jong u .
Susah Ladan um khashor ïa ki , te to ïathuh ïa kawei kaei baroh ha ka balang . Khatduh , lada um shahshkor ïa ka balang , to ñiew ïa u kumba u un-long u nongmane blei thala lane u nonglum khnai .
translation.en: And if he shall neglect to hear them , tell it unto the church : but if he neglect to hear the church , let him be unto thee as an heathen man and a publican .

translation.kha: Ka Ïingjaiñ Ka ingdong Ryngkat jongno U Trai kiba u Moses u la thaw ha ka ri khlaw , bad ka duwan ha kaba la thang ïa ki jinganna ka dang don ha ka jaka mane ha Gibeon ha kane ka por ;
translation.en: For the tabernacle of the  Lord  , which Moses made in the wilderness , and the altar of the burnt offering , were at that season in the high place at Gibeon .

translation.kha: Kim sheptieng ïa U blem , dara kumta ki woh ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi haba phi la thain bad la duh bor , bad ki la pynïap lutphut ïa kito baroh kiba bud sorki nadien .
translation.en: How he met thee by the way , and smote the hindmost of thee , even all that were feeble behind thee , when thou wast faint and weary  ; and he feared not God .

translation.kha: U Trai um shym la don shuh ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta jong ki ; u la pynsakma ïa ki da lade” hi . Um shym pyn-at jingñiewkor ei ei ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam jong ngi .
translation.en: The anger of the  Lord  hath divided them  ; he will no more regard them : they respected not the persons of the priests , they favoured not the elders .

translation.kha: Hynrei uta u shakri u kylli , Kumne lada jia ba kata ka samla kim mon ban ino ïa la ka ïing ban wanpaw ryngkat bad nga sha Kanneh ka ri ? Hato ngan phad noh ïa u khur jong phi shiah kata ka ri na kaba pa’ wan ?
translation.en: And the servant said unto him , Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land : must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest ?
But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create : for , behold , I create Jerusalem a rejoicing , and her people a joy .
translation.kha: To kmen bad to shadkmen junom ha kaei kaba nga thaw . Ka Jerusalem bathymmai kaba nga pynlong kan dap da ka jingkmen , bad ki briew jong ka kin shem sngewbha .

Ha kaba khatduh , ka Joïada ka la ïor ïa ka kabu jong ka . Ka dei ha ka sngi Kha jong u Hahiroth , mynba la Pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta baroh ki rangbah synshar baheh kyrdan ha ka jingsynshar jong u , ki Rangbah shipor , bad ki nongshong shnong bapawkhmat jong ka Galilaïa .
translation.en: And when a convenient day was come , that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords , high captains , and chief estates of Galilee  ;

translation.kha: Beor kiwei pat ki nonghiarthma ki ong ïa kajuh . Tur byrsha ïa ka Raamah bun phin sa jop , ki nguh , U Trei un ai ïa phi ka jingjop .
translation.en: And all the prophets prophesied so , saying , Go up to Ramoth–gilead , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the hand of the king .
Therefore turn thou to thy God : keep mercy and judgment , and wait on thy God continually .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ko ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , shaniah ha U Blei jong phi bad wan phai pat sha u . Long kiba ïaineh bad kiba lehhok , bad ap da kaba ïaishah ïa U Blei jong phi ban leh .
To ïaroh ïa U Terah ! To rwai ka jingrwai baibam ïa U Trai ; to ïaroh ïa u ha ka jingiaseng lang jong ki bri baïaineh jong u !
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Sing unto the  Lord  a new song , and his praise in the congregation of saints .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïakren bad ïasaidnia , U Jisu hi u la leit hajan bad u la ïaid slem bad ki ;
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , while they communed together and reasoned , Jesus himself drew near , and went with them .

translation.kha: Bad mynta nga kwah ban pynkynmaw ïa phi , ko pyniwbih jong at , ïa ka Khubor Babha kaba nga la ïalap ha phi , ïa kaba phi la pdiang , bad ha kaba ka jingngeit jong phi ka ïeng skhem .
translation.en: Moreover , brethren , I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you , which also ye have received , and wherein ye stand ;

translation.kha: wat pynhiarkput ïano ïano lane ban ïai isih ïa u , hynne ieit ïa la u Pharpar kumba phi ieit ïa ailad . Nga erlangthari U Trai .
translation.en: Thou shalt not avenge , nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people , but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: uto u briew wahbah la don u mynsiem bymman u la tur puk sha ki da ka jinglehbeiñ kaba haduh mawria ba u la jop ïa ki baroh . Ki la phet noh na ka iing jongngi u , kiba la mynleh bad ha ki jaiñ-jin kiba la shiah tar .
translation.en: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them , and overcame them , and prevailed against them , so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded .

translation.kha: To shahshkor , phi baroh kiba shong ha ka pyrthei ! To ap ïa ka lama ai dak kaba yn kyntiew halor ki kliar jong ki lumbah ! To shahshkor ïa ka jingpait ïa ka ronsing !
translation.en: All ye inhabitants of the world , and dwellers on the earth , see ye , when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains  ; and when he bloweth a trumpet , hear ye .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa ki jaka rep kiba seisoh bun ngan pynkut noh ka jingïapthngan ha ka ri . Kiwei pat ki ri kin ym rkhiebeiñ shuh ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will raise up for them a plant of renown , and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land , neither bear the shame of the heathen any more .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ngan wallam ïa ki jingïapyndait kiba kum kine ha u bynriew ba uwei uwei baroh un tare shano shathie kum u briew bamatlah . Ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa ang , badno mynta ïa ka snam jong ki yn theh noh kum ka um , malade ki btep jong ki kin pyut ha khyndew .
translation.en: And I will bring distress upon men , that they shall walk like blind men , because they have sinned against the  Lord  : and their blood shall be poured out as dust , and their flesh as the dung .

translation.kha: banbeiñ ïohthiah kum ki syiem Bad ki nongsynshar ibha la tat pat ïa ki ïingjaiñ mynbarim .
translation.en: With kings and counsellors of the earth , which built desolate places for themselves  ;

translation.kha: ban ai ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ïa kine lep ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingainguh ïaryngkat . Ïa ka jingainguh thang dei ban ieh halor ka duwan baher shi miet , bun hangta ka ding ruh ka dei ban ïai meh .
translation.en: Command Aaron and his sons , saying , This is the law of the burnt offering : It is the burnt offering , because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning , and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it .

translation.kha: Kata ka nemsniew ka la jur katta katta ba ym don jingman sha hangto hangno , ki briew ha Ijipt bad ha Kaiwan ki la nang tlot namar ka jingthngan .
translation.en: And there was no bread in all the land  ; for the famine was very sore , so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine .

translation.kha: Dang step phlangïap nga la kren bad ki briew . Ha kata ka jingïamai ka tngen jong nga ka la ïap , bad ha ka sneng kaba bud nga la leh kitab la bthah ïa nga .
translation.en: So I spake unto the people in the morning : and at even my wife died  ; and I did in the morning as I was commanded .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , uba rit nabar uba tlot kamra me long , ko Israel , wat sheptieng ; kun ïarap ïa me . Nga , U Blei uba khwai ki Israel , nga long uta uba pynim ïa me .
translation.en: Fear not , thou worm Jacob , and ye men of Israel  ; I will help thee , saith the  Lord  , and thy redeemer , the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: Ma nga U Trai , sa maham ïa me ban ym shukor ïa lade da kaba pynduk ba ki nong Babilonia kin ym wan shuh , namar kin sa wanrah biang .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Deceive not yourselves , saying , The Chaldeans shall surely depart from us : for they shall not depart .
For he taught his disciples , and said unto them ,  The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men , and they shall kill him  ; and after that he is killed , he shall rise the third day .
translation.kha: Ïa U Khun U Briew yn sa ai noh ha ki briew ki ban pynïap ïa u . Pynban hadien lai sngi , un sa mihpat .
Ka pynlong ïa ki briew jong nga ban duh ka jingshlur bad ban kyllon . Nga byrtong ïa ka nongbah jong ki da ka waitlam kaba thaba kum ka leilieh bad ka pynkhreh ban pynïap .
translation.en: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates , that their heart may faint , and their ruins be multiplied : ah ! it is made bright , it is wrapped up for the slaughter .

translation.kha: Lada ne u para Israel uba kyrduh ha kano ïano ka shnong kaba ha kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , wat khie mynsiem bad wat kynjat ban ïarap ïa u ;
translation.en: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , thou shalt not harden thine heart , nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother :

translation.kha: Lada u nongshoh-nar u shahshkor ïa ka jingai jingtip balamler , Baroh ki rangbah synrai kin kylla un-long ki riewlamler .
translation.en: If a ruler hearken to lies , all his servants are wicked .

I told you before , and foretell you , as if I were present , the second time ; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned , and to all other , that , if I come again , I will not spare :
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban ïathuh ha kito na phi kiba la leh pop ha ki por ba la leit , bad sha baroh kiwei pat ; nga la ong ïa kane mynshuwa ha ka jingwan jngoh kaba ar ïa phi , hynrei ngan ong biang mynta ba nga don jngai : Ha kawei ka por ba nga wan yn ym don mano mano ban lait na ka jingshah pynshitom .
Ki nongpyntrei kur jong u syiem ki pynïaid ïa ka jingshalan kulai na musla bad Kilikia bun ïa ka jingshalan kila ïapom na Jephthah .
translation.en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt , and linen yarn : the king s merchants received the linen yarn at a price .

And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest , and the priests of the second order , and the keepers of the door , to bring forth out of the temple of the  Lord  all the vessels that were made for Baal , and for the grove , and for all the host of heaven : and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron , and carried the ashes of them unto Beth–el .
translation.kha: Nangta u Josaïah u hukum ïa u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , ïa ki lyngdoh ba ïarap ïa u , bad ïa ki nongap kiba treikam ha ka jaka rung sha ka Templ ban wanrah shabar ka Templ ïa baroh ki tiar kiba pyndonkam ha ka jingmane ïa u Baal , ïa ka blei Asherah , bad ïa ki khlur . U syiem u la thang ïa kine ki tiar baroh shabar ka nongbah hajan ka Them Kidron , bad nangta ïa u dpei la rah sha Bethel .
( Ka don ka Shong shajan hangthie ïa kaba la khot da ka kyrteng kynhun shipai . ) Bad kumta yn pynphong khuid biang ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah . Thus shall they cleanse the land .
For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly , saying , Peace , peace  ; when there is no peace .
translation.kha: Ki leh kumba ki jingmong jong ki briew jong nga ki long tang ki jingtrud . ‘ Baroh ka bit ka biang ,’ ki ong , haba baroh kam bit kam biang .
U Elijah shisha u wan shuwa , la jubab U Jisu , bad un pynrieh ïa kiei khie barhem .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Elias truly shall first come , and restore all things .

translation.kha: Ki la sdang baneh ïakren para ma ki hi , U ong ïa kane namar ngim shem la wanrah jingbam ei ei .
translation.en: And they reasoned among themselves , saying , It is because we have taken no bread .

translation.kha: Nalor kita , u don ki ïing kynshew ba la shna na ka bynta u kew , ka wat , bad umphniang Olib , ki sem masi , bad ki jaka suit ïa ki langbrot jong u .
translation.en: Storehouses also for the increase of corn , and wine , and oil  ; and stalls for all manner of beasts , and cotes for flocks .
How was the journey yesterday ?
translation.kha: Kumno ka Jingiaid lynti jong phi mynnin ?

translation.en: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day .
translation.kha: Ki tur pyrshah ïa ki Benjamin ha ka sien kaba ar .

translation.en: Saying , I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood . And they said , What is that to us ? see thou to that .
translation.kha: Nga la leh pop da kaba nga shetkylla ïa u briew uba lui lui ban ïap !  u la ong .  Kan ïadei aïu kata bad ngi ?  ki la jubab .  Kata ka dei ka kam jong me !

translation.en: And Jacob sent messengers before him to Esau his brother unto the land of Seir , the country of Edom .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ha shuwa jong u sha u Iso u hynmen jong u ha ri Edom .
Ki la ong ha u syiem Nebukhadnessar , Ai ba u syiem Kynrad un im junom !
translation.en: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar , O king , live for ever .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki jingthmu jong u ki neh jongu , ki jingthmu jong u ki long pang la pateng .
translation.en: The counsel of the  Lord  standeth for ever , the thoughts of his heart to all generations .

translation.kha: Hynrei kun pyn-i ïa la ka bor bad ngan pynshitom ïa ka ri jingïaphet da kiba kun hangta ïa kiei kiei Ibbah shyrkhei . hadien kata un sa shah ba phin sien .
translation.en: And I will stretch out my hand , and smite Egypt with all my wonders which I will do in the midst thereof : and after that he will let you go .

translation.kha: Baroh kiew kiei kiba u Menahem u la leh la buh jingthoh ha Ka histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Jesreel .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Menahem , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: Nga la diengtied pynitynnat ïa ka jingthiah jyllang nga da ka jait linen bun rong na Ijipt .
translation.en: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry , with carved works , with fine linen of Egypt .

translation.kha: kumto ka long bad u thylliej : La u long uba rit , u lah ban sngewsarong sanphew kiei kiei kiba khraw . Shu kyrkhoit kat ka lapbah lah ban pynpluh ïa ka da i thlia ding kharai rit !
translation.en: Even so the tongue is a little member , and boasteth great things . Behold , how great a matter a little fire kindleth !

translation.kha: Wat shna ïa ka duwan kaba don ki kyrdon ibha kiew sha ka ; lada phi leh kumta , phi pynpaw khlem akor ïa lade haba phi kiew ïa ki .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar , that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon .
And now , behold , I have brought the firstfruits of the land , which thou , O  Lord  , hast given me . And thou shalt set it before the  Lord  thy God , and worship before the  Lord  thy God :
translation.kha: Kumta nga wallam mynta sha U  Trai  ïa u soh nyngkong na ka jingot ba u la ai ha nga .’  Nangta buh ïa ka shang ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  bad mane hangta .

Hato phi pyrkhat ba ki paid Jerusalem’ ki don shiah ka jingtim ? Hato U Trai u la duh noh ïa la ka jingïaishah ? Hato un da leh shisha ïa kyang kiei kiei ? Hato um shym kren bha ïa kito kiba leh ïa kaba Dei ?
translation.en: O thou that art named the house of Jacob , is the spirit of the  Lord  straitened ? are these his doings ? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly ?

translation.kha: hynñiew to kynmaw , ko ki paralok jongu nga , ïa kaei ba la ïatyngkhuh ha phi mynshuwa da ki apostol jong U Jeshua Khrismas kiba U Trai jong ngi .
translation.en: But , beloved , remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ  ;

translation.kha: sad u noh ha u , Khie mareh , bad tam ïa ki khnam kiba kan sa siat . Uta u Mareh , bad u Jonathan u siat ïa u khnam sha shuwa jong u .
translation.en: And he said unto his lad , Run , find out now the arrows which I shoot . And as the lad ran , he shot an arrow beyond him .
The full soul loatheth an honeycomb  ; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet .
translation.kha: Haba phi la kdang , phin hap kyntait wat ïa ka ngap ruh ; hynrei haba phi thngan , wat ka jingbam kaba kthang ruh ka thiang .
Hangta kyang sa khot ïakyrpad ïa ka jingstad , hynrei ngan ym jubab ; Phin sa wan wan ïa nga kylleng Sawdong , hynrei phin ym shem ïa nga .
translation.en: Then shall they call upon me , but I will not answer  ; they shall seek me early , but they shall not find me :

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kabu laiphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Ita u syiem ka Judah , u Baasha u syiem ka Israel u hiarthma ïa ka Judah bad sdang ban tei kut ïa ka Ramah khnang ban khang noh ïa ka jingïaid lynti shapoh bad shabar ka Judah .
translation.en: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah , and built Ramah , to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .
As the apple tree among the trees of the wood , so is my beloved among the sons . I sat down under his shadow with great delight , and his fruit was sweet to my taste .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingiw kaba iwbih shaphang jong phi ; ka jingsawa ka kyrteng jong phi ka pynkynmaw ïa kata . Ym don kano kano ka briew ka bym lah khlem da ieit ïa phi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Aaron , Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land , neither shalt thou have any part among them : I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Aaron ,  Men ym ïoh ka jingdon jingem kum ka jingïohpateng bad ym don kano kano ka bynta na ka ri Israel ban ai ha me . Tang ïa nga U  Trai  , me donkam .
Ka jinglorni ka bang palat — katno Ngi sngewieit ban nguid tylliat ïa ka !
translation.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds , and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly .

translation.kha: U Jethro , u lyngdoh ka Madon , u kthaw kurim u Moses , u jingphohsniew ïa kaei kaei baroh naba U Blei u la leh na ka bynta u Moses bad ki paid Israel mynba u la ïalam neh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: When Jethro , the priest of Midian , Moses  father in law , heard of all that God had done for Moses , and for Israel his people , and that the  Lord  had brought Israel out of Egypt  ;

translation.kha: Te kin jingbabe ba ka long namar ba phi la lyndet ïa ka jutang jong pa’ Bad nga , U Blei jong phi , bad phi la myn bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki balieh .
translation.en: Then they shall answer , Because they have forsaken the covenant of the  Lord  their God , and worshipped other gods , and served them .
And as they were eating , Jesus took bread , and blessed it , and brake it , and gave it to the disciples , and said ,  Take , eat  ; this is my body .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , U Jisu u la shim shi lyngkhot u kpu , u la duwai ainguh , u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la ai ïa u ha ki synran jong u .  To shim bad to bam ïa u ,  u la ong ;  une u long ka met jong nga .
khlaw da shim ïa ki khun jong to bad khia ïa ki ha ki bleithaw ?
translation.en: That thou hast slain my children , and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them ?

translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U Tlai U Blei jrong phi ! Uba la pynpaw katno u sngewbha eh ïa phi bad pynlong ïa pa’ u shem ki Israel . Namar ba U Trai u ieit ïa ki Israel jongu , u la Pynlong ïa phi u syiemsad jong ki khnang ban synran bha bad bishar hok .
translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which delighted in thee , to set thee on the throne of Israel : because the  Lord  loved Israel for ever , therefore made he thee king , to do judgment and justice .

To offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord  upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening , and to do according to all that is written in the law of the  Lord  , which he commanded Israel  ;
translation.kha: Man ka step bad man ka janmiet kin thang tylli ïa ki jingkñia ha ka duwan kat kum ba la thoh ha ka Hukum kumba U  Trai  u la ai ïa ki Israel .
Anab phi hi da lade phoi tip bha ba ka Sngi jong U Trai kan wan kum u nongtuh mynmiet .
translation.en: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night .
And why take ye thought for raiment ? Consider the lilies of the field , how they grow  ; they toil not , neither do they spin :
translation.kha: Bad balei phi khuslai shaphang ki jaiñ ? Khmih kumno ki  tiewkhlaw ki san : kim trei lane thain jaiñ na ka bynta ïa lade .

translation.en: Behold , therefore I will bring strangers upon thee , the terrible of the nations : and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom , and they shall defile thy brightness .
translation.kha: ngan wanrah ki nongshun kiba sniew ban tur ïaleh ïa me . Kin pynjot ïa kiei kiei kiba itynnat baroh kiba me la pynïoh da ka jingtbit bad jingstad jong me .
To ai ki jingainguh ïa U Trai ha ki duitara , to ria ha u da ki jingtem kshaid .
translation.en: Praise the  Lord  with harp : sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings .

translation.kha: Da ka sur kaba jam u pipa ki jingkyrkhu na U Blei halor u paidbah baher Uba ïalumlang hangta .
translation.en: And he stood , and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice , saying ,
For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner , and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him .
translation.kha: Namar kam i shongnia ha nga ban phah ïa u koidi khlem da kdew shai ïa ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u .
U la don ïa ka khoit kli barit ba la plied ha ka kti jong u . U la buh ïa ka kjat kamon jong u halor ka duriaw-bah bad ïa ka kjat kadiang jong u Hamor ka khyndew ,
translation.en: And he had in his hand a little book open : and he set his right foot upon the sea , and his left foot on the earth ,

And they shall spread them before the sun , and the moon , and all the host of heaven , whom they have loved , and whom they have served , and after whom they have walked , and whom they have sought , and whom they have worshipped : they shall not be gathered , nor be buried  ; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka ban lumlang bad ban tep , ki shyieng jong ki kin long kum ka sboh kaba don ha madan . Yn pynphriang ïa ki shabar ha khmat ka sngi , u bnai , bad ki khlur , kiba kine ki briew ki ieit bad shakri , bad kiba ki la ïakylli bad mane .

U syiem Amam u ïajubab ïa ki nonglamktien u Jephthah , Mynba ki Israel ki mihnoh na Ijipt , ki la kynnoh ïa ka ri jong nga naduh ka haw Arnon haduh ka wah Jabbok bad ka wah Jordan . mynba me dei don pynwai noh ïa ka da kaba juk .
translation.en: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah , Because Israel took away my land , when they came up out of Egypt , from Arnon even unto Jabbok , and unto Jordan : now therefore restore those lands again peaceably .

translation.kha: Siba sah na ki phlang kin ai ka dud na ka bynta jong phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing jongngi phi , malu ïa ki shakri kynthei jongu phi kumjuh .
translation.en: And thou shalt have goats  milk enough for thy food , for the food of thy household , and for the maintenance for thy maidens .
Thou didst say , Woe is me now ! for the  Lord  hath added grief to my sorrow  ; I fainted in my sighing , and I find no rest .
translation.kha: Nangta u ïathuh ïa nga ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ,  Barukh , me ong , ‘ Nga la ngiah ! U  Trai  u la ban ïa ka jingsngewsih halor ki jingjynjar jong nga . Nga la thait na kaba shu ud , bad ngam shem kano kano ka jingjahthait !’
Hangta u la rung shapoh krem bad sahmiet hangta . Kynsan kynsan U Trai u kren ha u , Elijah me leh aïu Hangno ?
translation.en: And he came thither unto a cave , and lodged there  ; and , behold , the word of the  Lord  came to him , and he said unto him , What doest thou here , Elijah ?

translation.kha: U Shobakh u syiem ka Ijipt u tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem’ bad ka kynhun shaei kaba shajrong sanspah tylli ki kali ïamap , hynriewphew hajar ngut ki shipai shong balui , bad shibun ki shipai ban ïa kaba lah ban ïa kaba lah ban ñiew , kaba kynthup ïa ki nongtih lehbha , ki Sukki , bad ki kynhun Sudan .
translation.en: With twelve hundred chariots , and threescore thousand horsemen : and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt  ; the Libyans , the Sukkiims , and the Ethiopians .
Scornful men bring a city into a snare : but wise men turn away wrath .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki bym ñiewkor ïa kiwei pat , ki lah ban pynkhih kulmar ïa ki nongbah baroh . Kito kiba stad ki pynjai jai ïa kiei kiei .
Kin ing mynsngi bad mynmiet , bad ka dem kan kiew na ka junom . Ka khyndew kan sah lehnoh-ei na kawei ka rta sha kawei pat , bad yn ym kein shuh u ban ïaid lyngkha jong ka .
translation.en: It shall not be quenched night nor day  ; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever : from generation to generation it shall lie waste  ; none shall pass through it for ever and ever .
Cursed be he that doeth the work of the  Lord  deceitfully , and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood .
translation.kha: ( Long ba la tim ïa u briew u bym leh ïa ka kam U  Trai  da ka dohnud jong u baroh ! Long ba la tim ïa uno uno u bym pom bad pynïap ! )
Sa shisien pat ka la kham khun shynrong bad la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Shelah . U Jedaïah u don ha Akhsib mynba la khah ïa u khunlung .
translation.en: And she yet again conceived , and bare a son  ; and called his name Shelah : and he was at Chezib , when she bare him .
And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad : for Absalom hated Amnon , because he had forced his sister Tamar .
translation.kha: Bad u Absalom u la isih ïa u Amnon haduh katta katta namar ka jingbatbor ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u kat haduh ba um mon shuh ban kren ïa u .

translation.en: And the law is not of faith : but , The man that doeth them shall live in them .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka Hukum kam don ei ei ban leh bad ka jingngeit . Pynban kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Jar uba leh ïa baroh ïa kaba ka hukum ka dawa un ïoh im .

Ka por ka wan haba U Trai Badonbor Baroh un pdiang ïa ki jingainguh na kane ka ri ba la pynkhlur ïa ki Wah , kane ka jaitbynriew naba khlaiñ bad kaba dabor , ki briew ibha jrong bad kiba jlih ka sniehdoh , ïa uba la sheptieng ha ka pyrthei baroh . Kin wan sha u Lum Seïon , ha kaba la mian ïa U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: In that time shall the present be brought unto the  Lord  of hosts of a people scattered and peeled , and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto  ; a nation meted out and trodden under foot , whose land the rivers have spoiled , to the place of the name of the  Lord  of hosts , the mount Zion .
And she said unto her , All that thou sayest unto me I will do .
translation.kha: Ka Ruth ka jubab ,  Ngan leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi ong .

Nga long u nongshun jong pha ! ong U Trai badonbor Baroh . Ngan thang ïa ki kali ïapom jong pha . Ïa ki shipai jong pha yn pynïap ha ka thma , bad ngan Shim lut ïa kiei kiei baroh babha pha la smat na kiwei . Ïa ka jingdawa jong ki nongsngap jong Phah yn ym ïohsngew shuh .
translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will burn her chariots in the smoke , and the sword shall devour thy young lions : and I will cut off thy prey from the earth , and the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard .

translation.kha: To kynthrong ïa ki jingkular Jong me bad wat ñiewbeiñ ïa ngi ; wat wallam ka jingjahburom halor ka Jerusalem ka jaka jong ka khet badonburom jong me . Wat pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba me la pynlong bad ngi .
translation.en: Do not abhor us , for thy name s sake , do not disgrace the throne of thy glory : remember , break not thy covenant with us .

translation.kha: Phim tip ïa kaei kaba phi pan , U Jiw u la jubab ïa ki khun shynrang jong ka . Hato phi lah don dih ïa ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ïa kaba Ngan sa dih ? Ngi eh , ki la jubab .
translation.en: But Jesus answered and said ,  Ye know not what ye ask . Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of , and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ?  They say unto him , We are able .

translation.kha: Ki Briew ka Jerusalem kin sa bun kum u shyiap ka duriaw , ktang bun haduh bih haka shuh ban ñiew lane ban thew . Mynno U Blei u ong ïa ki , Phim dei ki bariew jong nga , hynrei ka sngew kad poi ha kaweh un ong ha ki , Phi dei ki khun jong U Blei uba im .
translation.en: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea , which cannot be measured nor numbered  ; and it shall come to pass , that in the place where it was said unto them , Ye are not my people , there it shall be said unto them , Ye are the sons of the living God .
And the mean man shall be brought down , and the mighty man shall be humbled , and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled :
translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei yn pynjahburom , bad ïa baroh kiba sarong yn pynrit .
Ko syiem Agrippa ! Neng ñiew ïa ailad naba donbok ba ha kane ka sngi nga dei banbeiñ ïasaid da ïa lade ha khmied jongno phi na baroh kita ktien kiei kiba ki jia ki mudui ïa nga ,
translation.en: I think myself happy , king Agrippa , because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews :

translation.kha: katba la ïohi ïa uwei u briew ibha wan mih dara ki ong ha u , Pynnep ïa ngi kumno ngi ïohrung shapoh ka nongbat bad ngin ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .
translation.en: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city , and they said unto him , Shew us , we pray thee , the entrance into the city , and we will shew thee mercy .

translation.kha: Nangta ngaiñ leit bad shimet ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , ïa kaba la leh bymsuidñiew mynba u saiwul u lama syiem .
translation.en: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us : for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul .
Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kumno kan jia ha ka sngi ba yn pynpaw ïa U Khun U Briew .
U syiem Bad ki nongïaleh ki phla ba ki la lai pop! , bad ki ong , kaei kaba U Trai u leh ka long kob sngewngiah .
translation.en: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves  ; and they said , The  Lord  is righteous .

translation.kha: Kumno kan long lada U Mynsiem jong U Trai u rah noh ïa phi sha ka jaka bymjukut tang mar ïamih ma nga ? ngat , haba ngan ïathuh ïa u Ahab ba phi anna hangne , bad um lah ban shym ïa Phin , un sa pynïap ïa sa . To kynmaw ba nga long babha mane khor ïa U thri naduh ba por tang khynnah .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , as soon as I am gone from thee , that the Spirit of the  Lord  shall carry thee whither I know not  ; and so when I come and tell Ahab , and he cannot find thee , he shall slay me : but I thy servant fear the  Lord  from my youth .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingshong jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka jingïadon Ryngkat jong nga ki dei ban bam ïa ka lem badno u kput uba dang sah ha kata ka shang .
translation.en: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram , and the bread that is in the basket , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Ym pat la ïalam bastang ïa nga shun barim ïa ki da kaba doh ïa la ki kti kum ka jingnguh ïa ki .
translation.en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed , or my mouth hath kissed my hand :

translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli ïa U Jisu shaphang ki synran jrong u sad shaphang ka jinghikai jong u .
translation.en: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples , and of his doctrine .

translation.kha: Ka jingshai ka sngi ka phyrnai eh ïa ki nongleh bymman , badno ka khanglad ïa ki na ki kam har jubor .
translation.en: And from the wicked their light is withholden , and the high arm shall be broken .
And he said unto me , To build it an house in the land of Shinar : and it shall be established , and set there upon her own base .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  Sha Babilonia , ha kaba kin tei ka templ na ka bynta jong ka . Haba la dep shna ïa ka Templ , ïa ka shang yn buh hangta ïa ka ba yn mane .

U Trai un wallam ka jingpang bashyrkhei halor ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba ïaleh thma ïa ka Jerusalem . Ka deng jong ki kan pud noh katba ki dang im ; ki khmat malade ki thylliej jongu ki kin pyut nong .
translation.en: And this shall be the plague wherewith the  Lord  will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem  ; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet , and their eyes shall consume away in their holes , and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth .

translation.kha: Ka jingïakajia ka la lud haduh katta Iso ba u rangbah ai Hukum u la sheptieng ïoh ba kin thir lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u Apostol . Kumba u hukum ïa ki shaei jong u ban leit sha ka kynhun , ban shim noh ïa u Paul na ki , malade ïalam ïa u shapoh ka kut shipai .
translation.en: And when there arose a great dissension , the chief captain , fearing lest Paul should have been pulled in pieces of them , commanded the soldiers to go down , and to take him by force from among them , and to bring him into the castle .

translation.kha: Me wan jngoh ïa ki man ka step , bad me tynjuh ïa ki Leit la ka minit ?
translation.en: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning , and try him every moment ?
He healeth the broken in heart , and bindeth up their wounds .
translation.kha: U pynkhiah ïa kiba la pait dohnud bad u sop spaiñ ïa ki jingmong jong ki .

Phi khot ïa u , U Kpu , haba phi duwai ha U Blei , uba bishar ïa ki briew baroh da kajuh ka jingthew , katba kumto kaei kaba uwei pa uwei u la leh ; kumta te , to pynteh ïa kaba sawa ka jingim jong phi jingeh ha ka pyrthei ha ka jingjahburom ïa U .
translation.en: And if ye call on the Father , who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man s work , pass the time of your sojourning here in fear :

translation.kha: U Philip u la ong ha u , Ko Kynrad , to pyn-i ha ngi ïa U kper ; kata ka long baroh kaba Ngi donkam .
translation.en: Philip saith unto him , Lord , shew us the Father , and it sufficeth us .

translation.kha: U Trai u la Ong ha u , ‘ lanot noh ïa ki juti , naba ka jaka ha kabu me ïeng ka long ka khyndew kaba khuid .
translation.en: Then said the Lord to him , Put off thy shoes from thy feet : for the place where thou standest is holy ground .

translation.kha: Hynrei salia u paidïapom u leh bymmyntoi ïa kata kaba u la leh bad kim pynïap ïa u ,
translation.en: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man , when he giveth of his seed unto Molech , and kill him not :

translation.kha: Ka jingieit ka ïaishah slem bad ka lehsbun ; kam ju pihuiñ lane kam ju kob stong ;
translation.en: Charity suffereth long , and is kind ; charity envieth not ; charity vaunteth not itself , is not puffed up ,

translation.kha: Hynrei me , me ïuh ; me khmih ïa ka jingjynjar bad ka jingshah shitom , bad me ïailong uba la kloi ïa-ban ïarap . U briew u bym don nongïarap u aiti ïa put ha me ; me la ju ïarap ïa uba kyrduh .
translation.en: Thou hast seen it  ; for thou beholdest mischief and spite , to requite it with thy hand : the poor committeth himself unto thee  ; thou art the helper of the fatherless .

translation.kha: Ai ha Kiba duk bun phan ym don ha ka jingkyrduh lano lano duh . Lydda phi khappud la ki khmat shwa kba duk , ki briew kiba bun ktien tem ïa phi .
translation.en: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack : but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse .

translation.kha: Bad ki la ong shibun kiwei pah ki jingkrenbeiñ ïa u .
translation.en: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him .

translation.kha: Don hynriew tylli ki mawkyrdon ba kiew shad ka klet bad ka don ka jingïuhkjat kaba la pyndait ha ka , ba la sip da ka ksiar . Ki don ki jingshan kti ha baroh rkhiang jong ka khet , bad ka dur u sing ka ïeng ha kaweh kawei ka liang .
translation.en: And there were six steps to the throne , with a footstool of gold , which were fastened to the throne , and stays on each side of the sitting place , and two lions standing by the stays :

translation.kha: Ki duriaw khyllah kin paw ha ki khmat jong phi , bad phin ym lah ban pyrkhat ne kren shai .
translation.en: Thine eyes shall behold strange women , and thine heart shall utter perverse things .
By faith Moses , when he was born , was hid three months of his parents , because they saw he was a proper child  ; and they were not afraid of the king s commandment .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa ki kmie ki kpa u Moses ban buhrieh ïa u lai bnai hadien ba la kha ïa u . Ki la ïohi ba u la long u khunlung uba bhabriew , bad kim shym la sheptieng ban pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum u Pharaoh .
U buh ïa me ki tnat dieng ha khmat ki kynhun langbrot ha ki shyngoid dih um jong ki . U buh ïa ki hangta , namar ki khunlangbrot ki ju ïa-pakor haba ki wan dih um .
translation.en: And he set the rods which he had pilled before the flocks in the gutters in the watering troughs when the flocks came to drink , that they should conceive when they came to drink .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki mihnoh na Rephidim , bad ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong Jong u bnai umbah lai naduh ba ki mih na jingtep ki wan poi ha ka ri shyngkub synñiang . Ki sher dara hangta ha kjat u Lum Sinai ,
translation.en: For they were departed from Rephidim , and were come to the desert of Sinai , and had pitched in the wilderness  ; and there Israel camped before the mount .

translation.kha: bad un wallam pat ïa ki briew babun sha U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God .

translation.kha: Wai ïalam ïa kiba na ka jait Lebi bad thung ïa ki kum ki sakhrai ïa u Aaron u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers  skins , and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue , and shall put in the staves thereof .

translation.kha: Hynrei uta u briew uba la ïohkhiah um shym tip ba U Jisu u la long uei , naba la don u paidbah ha kata ka jaka , bad U Jisu u la lah mihnoh jar jar .
