translation.en: And he that was healed wist not who it was : for Jesus had conveyed himself away , a multitude being in that place .

translation.kha: Bad ma phi ki Israel phi ong , ‘ Kaei kaba U Trai u leh ka long ka bym dei .’ Pha pynkoit ba ka lyndum jong nga kam shym long kaba dei , haei ym dei kumta ? Ka dei ka lynti jong phi ka bym long kaba dih .
translation.en: Yet saith the house of Israel , The way of the Lord is not equal . O house of Israel , are not my ways equal ? are not your ways unequal ?

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Philip u la leit bad ngi ban ïakynduh ïa u Jakob ; bad barieh ki nongsharai basngur jong ka balang ki la ïaid lang .
translation.en: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James  ; and all the elders were present .

translation.kha: Ki briew bakha beit Kam suidñiew lada ki leh pop , isynei ki briew kiba beit ki kwah ban ïohmap .
translation.en: Fools make a mock at sin : but among the righteous there is favour .

translation.kha: Kan ym long kumta! U Blei un long uba shisha , wat la uwei pa uwei u briew u longïng suba shukor . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Ba yn lah ban pyn-i ïa phiah ba ph long kiba shisha haba phi kren ; phi den ban jop ïa ka jingïaleh haba la bishar ïa phi .
translation.en: God forbid : yea , let God be true , but every man a liar ; as it is written , That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings , and mightest overcome when thou art judged .

translation.kha: To ïathmu ïa ngi lano kane kan sa long , ki la ong , bad to ïateh ïa ngi kaei ka ban jia ban pyndum ba ka por ka la poi na ka bynta ktien kiei kiei baroh ban long .
translation.en: Tell us , when shall these things be ? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled ?

translation.kha: Hynrei katba u Paul u dang batai shaphang ka jingbha , ka ba halor lade , bad ka sngi ka Jingbishar ka ban sa wan , u Pheliks u la shemphang bad u la ong , Mynta me lah ban leit noh shuwa . nur sa phah khot pat Haba nga ïohlad .
translation.en: And as he reasoned of righteousness , temperance , and judgment to come , Felix trembled , and answered , Go thy way for this time  ; when I have a convenient season , I will call for thee .

translation.kha: Nga la khmih biang , bad ha kane ka por at la ïohi ïa ka kjat kli naba her ha ka lyer .
translation.en: Then I turned , and lifted up mine eyes , and looked , and behold a flying roll .

And the  Lord  stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , and the spirit of all the remnant of the people  ; and they came and did work in the house of the  Lord  of hosts , their God ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynkhih mynsiem ïa uwei pa uwei ban trei ha ka Templ : U Serubbabel , u lat ka Judah ; u Joshua , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad ki briew baroh kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw . Ki la sdang ban trei ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ki ,

translation.en: The  Lord  is my strength and song , and he is become my salvation : he is my God , and I will prepare him an habitation  ; my father s God , and I will exalt him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u nongïada uba khlaiñ jong nga ; u long ma u , uba la pyllait im ïa nga . U dei U Blei jong nga , bad ngan ïaroh ïa u , U Blei jong u kpa jong nga , bad ngan rwai shaphang ka jingkhraw jong u .

translation.en: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship , and humility , and neglecting of the body ; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh .
translation.kha: Da shisha kiba kum kine ki kyndon ki i kumba la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingstad ha ka jingmane ba shu pynbor ïa ki angel , bad ka jingsngewrit bymdei , bad ka jingleh palat ïa ka met ; hynrei ki bymdondor ei ei ha kaba synshar ïa ki jingbrai ka doh .
Mar ïadep pynskhem ïa la ka bor kum u symboh , u Rehoboam bad ki briew jong u barieh ki iehnoh ïa ka Hukum jongno U Trai .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Rehoboam had established the kingdom , and had strengthened himself , he forsook the law of the  Lord  , and all Israel with him .

translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki la thoh , ‘ Uwei pa eiei barabor un ïoh hikai na U Blang .’ Uno du uba shahshkor ïa U Kpa dara ïoh hikai na u , u wan sha nga .
translation.en: It is written in the prophets , And they shall be all taught of God . Every man therefore that hath heard , and hath learned of the Father , cometh unto me .

translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah u wan phai khlem shah pynïap sha ka ïingsyiem ha Jesreel .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Yn sa Bam ma u .
translation.en: He will eat .
And God opened her eyes , and she saw a well of water  ; and she went , and filled the bottle with water , and gave the lad drink .
translation.kha: Te U Blei u pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong ka , bad ka la ïohi ïa ka pukri um . Ka la leit ban pyndap um ïa kata ka pla snieh bad ka la ai um ïa uta khynnah ba un dih .

translation.en: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full , and drink blood till ye be drunken , of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you .
translation.kha: Ynda haba nga pynïap ïa kine ki briew kum ki jingkñia , ki sim bad ki mrad ki dei ban bam lut ïa ka khleiñ haduh ba kin da ngiah bad dih ïa ka snam haduh ba kin da buaid .

translation.en: And yet I say unto you , That even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi ba wat u syiem Solomon lem bad ka spah jong u baroh um shym la don ki jaiñ kiba itynnat kum uwei na kine ki syntiew .

Namar phi long kum ka tnat jongki u dieng Olib khlaw ïa uba la pynkheiñ bad ngat , pyrshah ïa ka jinglong tynrai , la pynïasoh bad u dieng Abib ba la thung . Ki Jiw ki Long kum une u dieng uba la thung ; bad Kan long kaba kham suk ïa U Bel ngab pynïasoh bajngum ïa kine ki tnat ba la pynkheiñ sha ki dieng jong ki hi .
translation.en: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature , and wert grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree : how much more shall these , which be the natural branches , be grafted into their own olive tree ?

translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ïaroh ïa me , ko Trai , phangpdeng ki jingïohipaw , nga rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me .
translation.en: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee , O  Lord  , among the heathen , and I will sing praises unto thy name .

translation.kha: Nangta u Rangbah Lyngdoh un shim khynñiat ka snam jong uta u Massah bad rah ïa ka shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock s blood , and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation :

translation.kha: Uta u bynriew uba la ïap u la khie shong bad u la sdang Ban krenbeiñ , bad U Jisu u la ai ïa u pait shiah ha ka kmie jong u .
translation.en: And he that was dead sat up , and began to speak . And he delivered him to his mother .
Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there : and they came not for Jesus  sake only , but that they might see Lazarus also , whom he had raised from the dead .
translation.kha: Bun bah ki briew ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la don ha Bethania , kumta ki la leit shata , ym tang namar jong U Jisu hynrei ban ïohi ruh ïa u Lasaros , ïa uba U Jisu u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: Have you started studying the Bible with Jehovah’s Witnesses ?
translation.kha: Hato phi la sdang pule ïa ka Baibl bad ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ?
U syiem Solomon bad ki paid Israel barhem ki ïalang ha khmat ka Synduk ka jutang bad ki keiñ ainguh da bun bah ki langbrot bad ki masi — bun katta katta bym lah ñiew shuh .
translation.en: And king Solomon , and all the congregation of Israel , that were assembled unto him , were with him before the ark , sacrificing sheep and oxen , that could not be told nor numbered for multitude .

translation.kha: Nangta baroh’ ki jinglwet jong me kin shu jah noh na ki jingkynmaw jong me , kum ki jingsngewkhuslai um kiba la ïaid lait noh bad ym don jingkynmaw hajuh .
translation.en: Because thou shalt forget thy misery , and remember it as waters that pass away :

For , lo , thou shalt conceive , and bear a son  ; and no razor shall come on his head : for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb : and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: bad hadien ba la kha ïa u khun jong pha , wat pyndei syrti ha ka khlieh jong u , namar na ka sngi ba la kha ïa u un long uba la pynkyntang sha U Blei kum u Nasir . Un sdang ïa ka kam ban pyllait ïa ki Israel na ki Philistia .
U Hasael u syiem ka Sarai u thlim beiñ ïa ki Israel baroh shi lynter ka jingsynshar u Joahas ,
translation.en: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz .
Then went the captain with the officers , and brought them without violence : for they feared the people , lest they should have been stoned .
translation.kha: Kumta u rangbah pynïaidkam u la leit noh bad ki rangbah jong u bad wallam pat ïa ki apostol . Kim shym la pyndonkam ïa ka bor , namar ki la sheptieng ïoh ba ki paidbah ki lah ban lynthem maw ïa ki .
Haba nga pynsamthiah ïa ka Ijipt ha kane ka rukom , kin tip ba per long U Terah .
translation.en: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
And David saith , Let their table be made a snare , and a trap , and a stumblingblock , and a recompence unto them :
translation.kha: Bad u Dabid u ong ,  Ai ba kin ngat bad sahkut ha ki jingkhawai jong ki ; ai ba kin kyllon , ai ba kin shah pynshitom!
U syiem Josaïah u khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem ,
translation.en: And the king sent , and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem .
Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed ? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice , and lifted up thine eyes on high ? even against the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Ïano me pyrkhat ba me ibeiñ bad krenbeiñ ? Me la leh bymsuidñiew ïa nga , U Blei Bakhuid ki Israel .
bad U Trai u ong , Mynta sngem aiwai ngan ong ! Hobab don ki nongïathuhlypa hapdeng jong phi , na pynpaw ïa lade ha ki ha ka jingïohipaw mala nga kren ha ki ha ki jingsngew .
translation.en: And he said , Hear now my words : If there be a prophet among you , I the  Lord  will make myself known unto him in a vision , and will speak unto him in a dream .
Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction , and maketh him families like a flock .
translation.kha: Hynrei u pyllait ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingjynjar jong ki bad pynlong ïa ki longïing jong ki ban roi kum ki jingri .
To ai ba un leh-isynei borabor ïa ki paid Israel bad ïa u syiem jong ki katno kum ki jingpyndem jong ki kiba Man la ka sngi .
translation.en: And let these my words , wherewith I have made supplication before the  Lord  , be nigh unto the  Lord  our God day and night , that he maintain the cause of his servant , and the cause of his people Israel at all times , as the matter shall require :

translation.kha: nabar kumta u Ong ha u , Namar ba me la pita ïa ka jingstad ban synshar hok , ha ka bakwah ka jingim basngur na ka bynta ïa lade lieng ka spah lane ka jingïap ki nongshukor jong me , ngan leh ïa kaba me la pan .
translation.en: And God said unto him , Because thou hast asked this thing , and hast not asked for thyself long life  ; neither hast asked riches for thyself , nor hast asked the life of thine enemies  ; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki Bteng bad ka pyrthei ibha long myntoi la pynsah da kajuh ka hukum jrong U Blei , khnang ban ïohi pynjot da ka ding . Ïa ki la pynsah na ka bynta ka sngi haba ïa ki briew ki bymtip Blei yn bishar bad pynjot noh .
translation.en: But the heavens and the earth , which are now , by the same word are kept in store , reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men .

translation.kha: u ong , Samgar bha ban khlong ïa Kine ki hukum barieh kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Ïathuh ïa ki ha ki khun ki kti jong ph , ba ki hajuh kin ïaw kohnguh ïa baroh ki jinghikai jong U balui .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day , which ye shall command your children to observe to do , all the words of this law .

translation.kha: te ha ka jingbitar ngan pei pyrshah ïa phi , bad sa shisien ngan pynshitom jur shuh shuh ïa phi sa hynñiew shah ban ïa kaba la longïing mynshuwa .
translation.en: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury  ; and I , even I , will chastise you seven times for your sins .

translation.kha: lane kum ki kput harud ka wah , Kum ki Alos ba U Trai u la rung , Lane kum ki dieng Kedar harud ki um .
translation.en: As the valleys are they spread forth , as gardens by the river s side , as the trees of lign aloes which the  Lord  hath planted , and as cedar trees beside the waters .

translation.kha: Don wahbah pyrta ha ka ri shyiap , ‘ Pynshahshkor ïa ka lynti na ka bniat U Troas ; Pynbeit ïa ka lynti ïaid na ka bynta jong u ban ïaid !’
translation.en: The voice of one crying in the wilderness , Prepare ye the way of the Lord , make his paths straight .

translation.kha: Ngi la leh ïa kane , ym namar ba ngim don ka khor ban dawa jingkyrshan ïa ngi ; ngi la leh ïa ka , ban lama ka nala na ka bynta jong phi ban bud .
translation.en: Not because we have not power , but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us .
Because the ground is chapt , for there was no rain in the earth , the plowmen were ashamed , they covered their heads .
translation.kha: Namar bym don slap bad ba ka khyndew ka la tyrkhong ki nongrep ki pang ka dohnud ; ki buhrieh ïa la ki durkhmat .
Ki snieh ha ka kpoh jong u ki long kum ki syrwiang khiew kba nep ; ki tar ïa ka madan ktieh kumba longïing ka lyntang shohdab kew .
translation.en: Sharp stones are under him : he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire .

translation.kha: dih tang mynta ba nga pynurlong ïa ki ; ym don ei ei kum kane kob la jia mynshuwa . Lada ka la jia , phi jin da la kam ba phi la dep tip lut shaphang kane .
translation.en: They are created now , and not from the beginning  ; even before the day when thou heardest them not  ; lest thou shouldest say , Behold , I knew them .

translation.kha: Wat kular ban kitkhlieh na ka bynta ki riam jong khiew pat .
translation.en: Be not thou one of them that strike hands , or of them that are sureties for debts .

And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel , thirty thousand chariots , and six thousand horsemen , and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude : and they came up , and pitched in Michmash , eastward from Beth–aven .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïalumlang ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel ; ki don laiphew hajar tylli ki kali thma , hynriew hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai , bad ki shipai kiba bun kat u shyiap harud duriaw . Ki leit sha Mikhmash , kaba sha mihngi na Bethaben bad ki sher dara hangta .
Neng baroh i tip , A Trai , ba ki patsha jong ka Assyria ki la pynjot ïa shibun ki hima , ki pyntong ïa ki ri jong ki ban sah kynjah ,
translation.en: Of a truth ,  Lord  , the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands ,

translation.kha: Ka jingieit ka neh bymjukut . Ki don ki kyrhuh da ka jingpynsah mynsiem , hynrei ki long tang shipor ; ki don ki jingai ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher , hynrei kin dam noh ; ka don ka jingtap , hynriew kan sa jah noh .
translation.en: Charity never faileth : but whether there be prophecies , they shall fail ; whether there be tongues , they shall cease ; whether there be knowledge , it shall vanish away .

translation.kha: Kumjuh la buh ïa u Petros ha ka phatok , hynrei ki briew jong ka balang ki la duwai jur ha U Blei na ka bynta lad u .
translation.en: Peter therefore was kept in prison : but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him .

translation.kha: Adonijah ka jingïap u kpa jong ki , ki hynmen u Joseph ki ïa-ong , Tip kan jia aïu keiñ lada u Joseph u dang buhnud bad thmu ban pynsngap ïa ngi namar ka kam sniew ba ngi la leh ïa u ?
translation.en: And when Joseph s brethren saw that their father was dead , they said , Joseph will peradventure hate us , and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him .
Train up a child in the way he should go : and when he is old , he will not depart from it .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa u khynnah kumno u dei ban im , bad un kynmaw ïa ka baroh shi rta ka jingim jong u .
hynrei uwei uwei na ki u don saw tylli ki durkhmat dara saw tylli ki thapniang .
translation.en: And every one had four faces , and every one had four wings .

translation.kha: Ki shatri jong u Isaak ki la tyrnem ïa ka pukri ha kata ka them bad ki lapsan ba ka don um .
translation.en: And Isaac s servants digged in the valley , and found there a well of springing water .

Either how canst thou say to thy brother , Brother , let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye , when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye ? Thou hypocrite , cast out first the beam out of thine own eye , and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother s eye .
translation.kha: Kumno phi lah ban ong ha u para jong phi , ‘ Ko para , sngewbha shah ïa nga ban sei ïa u thiat na ka khmat jong phi ,’ pynban phim lah ban ïohi ïa ka lyngkhot dieng ha la ka jong ka khmat ? Phi kiba arsap ! Nyngkong to shim noh ïa ka lyngkhot dieng na ka khmat jong phi , bad nangta phin lah ban ïohi shai ban sei ïa u thiat na ka khmat jong u para jong phi .
Nangta ka khyndew ka ang badno nguid ïa u Dathan Bad tep ïa u Abiram bad ka longïing jong u ;
translation.en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan , and covered the company of Abiram .

translation.kha: Wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un pynbieit ïa ph ban pyrkhat ba U tharai un pyllait im ïa phi . Hato ki phai jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ki pyllait ïa ki ri jongki ki na u patsha ka Assyria ?
translation.en: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you , saying , The  Lord  will deliver us . Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?

translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ka jingtied jong U Blei la pyn-i ba ka long naba shisha da Baroh kiba pdiang ïa ka .
translation.en: But wisdom is justified of all her children .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngi ap ïa kaei kaban U Blei u la kulai : Ïa ki bneng kiba thymmai bad ïa ka khyndew kaba thma , ha kaba ka hok kan ni .
translation.en: Nevertheless we , according to his promise , look for new heavens and a new earth , wherein dwelleth righteousness .

translation.kha: U Kohath u don saw ñiut ki khun shynrang : u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebru , bad u Ussiel . U Khot u la im haduh shispah laiphew lai snem ka rta .
translation.en: And the sons of Kohath  ; Amram , and Izhar , and Hebron , and Uzziel : and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years .

translation.kha: ?(Nga la ong , ‘ Lur ïa ka khyndew thymmai na ka bynta ïa lade , bet ïa ka jinglehhok , bad ot ïa ka jingkyrkhu ba ka jingmane ïa nga kan pynum . Ka la dat ka por ïa phi ban phai shai nga , U Trai jong phi , bad ngan sa wanlam bad theh ki jingkyrkhu halor jong phi .’
translation.en: Sow to yourselves in righteousness , reap in mercy  ; break up your fallow ground : for it is time to seek the  Lord  , till he come and rain righteousness upon you .

translation.kha: Hynrei Uto uba la lehbeiñ ïa uta uwei pat u la khynñiuh sharud ïa u Moses . ‘ Mano ba la pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar bad u nongbishar halor jong ngi ?’ u la kylli .
translation.en: But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away , saying , Who made thee a ruler and a judge over us ?

Then the glory of the  Lord  went up from the cherub , and stood over the threshold of the house  ; and the house was filled with the cloud , and the court was full of the brightness of the  Lord s  glory .
translation.kha: Te ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon U  Trai  ka la kiew noh na ki kherub sha ka jaka rung jong ka Templ . Te u lyoh u la tap ïa ka Templ , bad kata ka phyllaw ka phyrnai da ka jingshai .

Hynrei kano baroh ka la Lah jia khnang ban pynlong ïa kaei kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ba-bang jied Shisha . Nangta baroh ki synran ki la iehnoh ïa u bad ki la ïaphet noh .
translation.en: But all this was done , that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled .  Then all the disciples forsook him , and fled .

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Abram u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw bad ïohsngew ïa U Trai ba u ong ha u , Wat pyrkhing , ko Abram . Ngan ïada ïa me na ka jingjam , bad ngan ai ha me ka bainong kaba khrong .
translation.en: After these things the word of the  Lord  came unto Abram in a vision , saying , Fear not , Abram : I am thy shield , and thy exceeding great reward .

translation.kha: Me daym ban sngewtlot ba U Trai u la jied ïa me banbeiñ tei ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong u . Mynta leh ïa Katai — malade leh ïa kata da ka jingkut jingmut baskhem .
translation.en: Take heed now  ; for the  Lord  hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary : be strong , and do it .

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad u Aaron ki la dem ngon ha madan ha khmat uta u paidbah baroh .
translation.en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Haba u shem ïa ka , to ong ha phi , u kham kilomitar ïa kan kamai ka longïng ban ïa ki khyndaiphew khyndai tylli ki bim shym la jah .
translation.en: And if so be that he find it , verily I say unto you , he rejoiceth more of that sheep , than of the ninety and nine which went not astray .

translation.kha: Hobah baroh ki la ïakynduh , u la ong ha la ki synran , To khar ïa ki lyngkhot Kiba tam ; ngiah dei ban pynsep-ei .
translation.en: When they were filled , he said unto his disciples ,  Gather up the fragments that remain , that nothing be lost .
He has a bruise on his right leg .
translation.kha: U don ka dakmong ha kjat kamon .

Ka la punkhun biang bad ka kha sa uwei pat u khun shynrang . Ka ong , U Trai u la ai ruh ha por ïa une u khun , namar u la ïohsngew ba ngam shym long kaba la ieit ; kamet ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Simeon .
translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and said , Because the  Lord  hath heard that I was hated , he hath therefore given me this son also : and she called his name Simeon .

translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko pynbang ba-ieit jong nga ! U Blei u la jied ïa ki briew kiba duk ha kane ka pyrthei ban long uba riewspah ha ka jingngeit malade ban kam kynti ïa ka hima kaba u la kular ha kito kiba ieit ïa u .
translation.en: Hearken , my beloved brethren , Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith , and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him ?
Greet all the brethren with an holy kiss .
translation.kha: To ïakhublei parabangeit da ka jingdoh parabangeit .

Bad nangta Kan don ka hima kaba saw , kaba eh kum ka nar , katba pynkheiñ bad pynpait ïa kaei kaei baroh . Bad kumba ka nar ka pynkitkhlieh ïa kaei kaei baroh , kan pynkhynñiuh bad pynlwet ïa baroh ki hima kiba mynshuwa .
translation.en: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron : forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things : and as iron that breaketh all these , shall it break in pieces and bruise .
Therefore shalt thou fall in the day , and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night , and I will destroy thy mother .
translation.kha: Mynmiet bad mynsngi phi ïaid bakla , bad ki nongïathuhlypa kim long kham bha ban ïa phi . Ngan sa pynjot ïa ka Israel , ka kmie jong phi .
Ka jingleh bymman kam nongrah ïa ka jingtasngeng , hynrei ki briew kiba hok ki ïeng skhem .
translation.en: A man shall not be established by wickedness : but the root of the righteous shall not be moved .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ngi ki dei Ban nang ban pynlut ïa la ka por ha kaba leh babha , khnang ba ki lah ban pyndeng ïa ki jingdam bashisha ; kim dei ban im ka jingimat ka bymlarkam .
translation.en: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses , that they be not unfruitful .

translation.kha: Nga la im ha ka jingsngur , hynrei U Blei u shim ïa nga na ryndang bad shohdab bad pynngeit ïa to . U Blei u pynbudnam ïa per kum ka sohpdung
translation.en: I was at ease , but he hath broken me asunder : he hath also taken me by my neck , and shaken me to pieces , and set me up for his mark .

translation.kha: Nangta , shim ïa ki na ki kti jongno ki bad thang ïa ki ha kata ka duwan , halor kata ka jingainguh thang , kum ka jingainguh bam sha nga . Ka jingiwbih kaba suhsieng na kane ka jingainguh ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt receive them of their hands , and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering , for a sweet savour before the  Lord  : it is an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
Now therefore what is under thine hand ? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand , or what there is present .
translation.kha: Te nangta , phi don jingbam ei ei ? Ai ïa nga san tylli ki kpu ne kano kano kaba phi don .
Lada ngi la ïit shuwa ïa lade , ngin ym hap hapoh ka jingbishar jong U Blei .
translation.en: For if we would judge ourselves , we should not be judged .

translation.kha: Ka jingjubab jong ki ka long , U Moses u la shat ïa u briew shun pyntip da ka jingthoh ïa ka jingpyllait tnga bad iohnong ïa ka tngen jong u .
translation.en: And they said , Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement , and to put her away .

translation.kha: Ko kaba bahynriew tam napdeng ki kynthei , shadong uba iktiar jongnga phi u la lytar ? To ïathuh ïa ngi na kano ka lynti uba ngeit jong pa’ u longing , ba kumta ngi ia ban ïarap ïa phi ban shem ïa u .
translation.en: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes , O prince s daughter ! the joints of thy thighs are like jewels , the work of the hands of a cunning workman .

translation.kha: Mynba U Trai u la kren ha u Moses ha ka ri Ijipt , u la ong , Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the day when the  Lord  spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt ,
That the  Lord  spake unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ngi ,
To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u da ka jingshad ; to tem ki ksing bad ki tyrha ha ka jingkhroh ïa u .
translation.en: Let them praise his name in the dance : let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp .

translation.kha: Naba , U jongu u la leit sha Kaphtorim , ka shnong ha Gamaliel , ha kaba u la hikai ïa u paidbah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: And came down to Capernaum , a city of Galilee , and taught them on the sabbath days .

translation.kha: Mynta , namar ka khubor jong ngi ka long ba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , kumno ba katto katne nongput na phi ki ong ba yn ym don ka jingmihpat na ka jingdap ?
translation.en: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead , how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead ?

translation.kha: Ka por ka la jan na ka bynta ka jingkhaïi Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ïa kaba la khot ka Niam Ka Jinglait .
translation.en: Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh , which is called the Passover .

translation.kha: U Jiw u la ïam .
translation.en: Jesus wept .

translation.kha: Ka jingïamai sngewbha aïu ngin phah ïa u ? Ki briew ki kyllan . Ki la jubab , San tylli ki tuh jong u thung kiba da ka ksar bad san tylli ki dur khnai kiba da ka ksiar , na ka bynta iwei pa uwei u syiem Philistia . Ïa kajuh ka kham la pynngat ha phi baroh bad ha baroh saiñ ngut ki syiem .
translation.en: Then said they , What shall be the trespass offering which we shall return to him ? They answered , Five golden emerods , and five golden mice , according to the number of the lords of the Philistines : for one plague was on you all , and on your lords .

translation.kha: 3 Hato ka khur Babha ka Dei Shisha mo Na U Blei ?
translation.en: 3 Is the Good News Really From God ?

translation.kha: U Khrist u la long uba khlem pop , isynei na ka bynta jrong ngi U Blei u la pynlong ïa u ban don bynta ha ka pop jong moi khnang ba hab i don ha u ngin lah ban ïoh bynta na ka hok U Blei .
translation.en: For he hath made him to be sin for us , who knew no sin ; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him .
And when he had received meat , he was strengthened . Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus .
translation.kha: bad hadien ba u la bam jingbam , u la ïohbor pat . U Saul u la sah katto katne sngi bad ki parabangeit ha Damaskos .
La pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka ngop bad phi la long pat ki mraw jong ka hok .
translation.en: Being then made free from sin , ye became the servants of righteousness .
On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets .
translation.kha: Ka Hukum u Moses baroh kawei bad ki jinghikai jong ki nongïathuhlypa ki shong halor kine ki ar tylli ki hukum .
Ngi la pynshlur ïa phi , me la pyntngen ïa phi , bad ngi ïai kyrpad ïa phi ban im ka jingim kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei , kaba khiat ïa phi ban ïa-ïoh bynta lem ha ka Hoham bad ka burom lad u hi .
translation.en: That ye would walk worthy of God , who hath called you unto his kingdom and glory .

translation.kha: Phi da lai hi phi phyllaw , te , ba Phi ïa-pdiang ïa kaei kiba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la leh ; ki la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , bad phi tei ïa ki mot jingtep jngai ki .
translation.en: Truly ye bear witness that ye allow the deeds of your fathers : for they indeed killed them , and ye build their sepulchres .

translation.kha: bad sha kilo u purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .
translation.en: A several tenth deal unto one lamb , throughout the seven lambs  ;
But let judgment run down as waters , and righteousness as a mighty stream .
translation.kha: Pynban , ai ba ka jingbishar hok kan tuid kum ka wahduid , bad ka jinglehhok kum ka wah ka bym ju rngad .

translation.en: The sword is without , and the pestilence and the famine within : he that is in the field shall die with the sword  ; and he that is in the city , famine and pestilence shall devour him .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingïashoh ha ki lynti ïaid , bad ka jingpang bad ka jingthngan hapoh ki ïing . Uno uno uba don ha rudnong u ïap ha ka jingïaleh , uno uno uba don ha nongbah u ïap da ka jingpang ne jingthngan .
Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ka Dorbar baroh kawei ki la pyrshang don lap ki sabon lamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu ban pynïap ïa u ;
translation.en: Now the chief priests , and elders , and all the council , sought false witness against Jesus , to put him to death  ;
I live in Shillong .
translation.kha: Nga sah ha Shillong .
U biria uba don ha ka lyngkha um dei ban phai dien ban ithuh shim ïa ka jingkup jong u .
translation.en: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes .

translation.kha: Te mynta ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga Ong ha ki ba ki long bymmyntoi ei ei kum kata hi . Ngan wallam lang ïa ki baroh ha Jerusalem
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye are all become dross , behold , therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ka khun jong ka Herodias ka la wan shapoh bad ka la shad , bad ka la pynsngewbha ïa u Herod bad ïa Kiba u la ïakhot sngewbha . Kumba u skhem u la ong ha kata ka khynnah , Kaei kaba phar Kwah ban ïoh ? Ngan ai ïa pha ïa kano kano kaba pha khwai .
translation.en: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in , and danced , and pleased Herod and them that sat with him , the king said unto the damsel , Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt , and I will give it thee .
And her two sons  ; of which the name of the one was Gershom  ; for he said , I have been an alien in a strange land :
translation.kha: bad ïa u Gershom bad u Elieser ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka . ( U Moses u la ong ,  Nga long u sohshnong ha ka ri nongwei  ; kumta u la jer kyrteng ïa uwei na ki  u Gershom .

translation.en: And it was about the sixth hour , and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour .
translation.kha: Ka la long kumba khat-ar baje haba ka sngi ka la sangeh ban tyngshaiñ bad ka jingdum ka la tap ïa ka ri baroh kawei haduh lai baje ;
namar , lada me pyrkhat ïa nga kum u Para ba-ïatrei lem jong me , to pynpdang sngewbha pah ïa u kumba men pdiang sngewbha ïa nga .
translation.en: If thou count me therefore a partner , receive him as myself .

translation.kha: Haba ka Israel ka ïohi khih katno ka pang jur bad haba ka Judah ka ïohi ïa la ki jingsarong , nongkit ki Ishmael ki leit sha Assyria ban pan jingïarap na u syiem uba khrawbor , hynrei um lai ban pynkoit ïa ki lane pynkhiah ïa ki jingmong jong ki .
translation.en: When Ephraim saw his sickness , and Judah saw his wound , then went Ephraim to the Assyrian , and sent to king Jareb : yet could he not heal you , nor cure you of your wound .

translation.kha: Kaba ar ka hukum kaba donkam tam ka long kum katei : ‘ Ieit ïa u paramarjan jong me kumba me olib ïa lade .’
translation.en: And the second is like unto it , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .
The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death .
translation.kha: Ka nongshun kaba khatduh ïa kaba dei ban pynjot ka long ka jingïap .
Ka jahthait Reuben ka tei biang ïa ka Heshbon , ka Eldaah , ka Kiriathaim ,
translation.en: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon , and Elealeh , and Kiriathaim ,
These values , as taught in the Bible , promote well-being and respect for others , along with such qualities as honesty and kindness .
translation.kha: Kumba la hikai ha ka Baibl , kine ki aiñ ki ïarap ïa ngi ban kyntiew ïa ka long-briew manbriew , ban burom ïa kiwei , bad ban long kiba sbun bad kiba leh hok .

translation.en: Let the saints be joyful in glory : let them sing aloud upon their beds .
translation.kha: Ai ba ki briew jong U Blei kin shadkmen ha ka jingjop jong ki bad rwai da kaba kmen baroh shi miet .

Nga la shim noh ïa ka hima na kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid bad nga la ai ïa ka ha me . jynreiñ ngam shym long khem u Dabid u shakri jong nga , uba buiñ tylli ïa nga , uba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong sa , bad uba har ïa kabu dei ha Khmut jong nga .
translation.en: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David , and gave it thee : and yet thou hast not been as my servant David , who kept my commandments , and who followed me with all his heart , to do that only which was right in mine eyes  ;

translation.kha: sad u la kit sha Babilon ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ha ka Templ bad ïingsyiem . Kumba U Trai u la pynthaba , u Nebukhadnessar u la pynpait ïa baroh ki khiew ki pliang ksiar kiba u Syiem Solomon u la thaw na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ .
translation.en: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house , and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the  Lord  , as the  Lord  had said .

translation.kha: U Eliab , u hynmen rangbah u Dabid , u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u ïakren sad kita ki rangbah . U la bitar ïa u Dabid bad u ong , Me har aïu hangne ? Mano ba sumar ïa Kito ki langbrot ki lad me kiba don ha ka ri khlaw ? Ma me , me uba sngewstad ! Me wan dang ban peit kai ïa ka jingïaleh tdem !
translation.en: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men  ; and Eliab s anger was kindled against David , and he said , Why camest thou down hither ? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness ? I know thy pride , and the naughtiness of thine heart  ; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle .
Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever , as I promised to David thy father , saying , There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel .
translation.kha: ngan pynneh junom ïa ka khet syiem jong me ha Israel , kumba nga la kular ha u Dabid u kpa jong me , da kaba ong , ‘ Men ym kyrduh u briew u ban shong ha ka khet Israel .’

translation.en: The Jews answered him , saying , For a good work we stone thee not  ; but for blasphemy  ; and because that thou , being a man , makest thyself God .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ,  Ngim kwah ban lynthem maw ïa me namar kano kano na ki kam babha , hynrei namar ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei jong me ! Me long tang u briew , hynrei me pyrshang ban pynlong Blei ïa lade !

translation.en: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob , and hath not pitied : he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah  ; he hath brought them down to the ground : he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof .
translation.kha: Baroh shi miet lynter ka ïam ; ki ummat ki tuid ha ki ngab jong ka . Na baroh ki paralok jong ka kiba mynshuwa , ym don iwei ruh iba sah ban pyntngen ïa ka . Kiba ïateh lok bad ka ki la shetkylla ïa ka bad baroh ki la long pyrshah ïa ka mynta .
Mynta aiti noh ïa kito ki riewbymman ha Gibeah , ba ngin ïoh pynïap ïa ki dara shun weng noh ïa kane ka jingbymman na Israel . Hynrei ki briew ka Benjamin kim salia ïa kiew pat ki jait Israel .
translation.en: Now therefore deliver us the men , the children of Belial , which are in Gibeah , that we may put them to death , and put away evil from Israel . But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel :

translation.kha: hynrei ki briew ka Sebulun bad Naphtali , Ki kheiñduh la ka jingim ha ka madan thma .
translation.en: Zebulun and Naphtali were a people that jeoparded their lives unto the death in the high places of the field .

translation.kha: Te utai uba la ïohlait u wan ïathuh ïa kane baroh ha u Abram , u Hebru , uba la sheng la sah hadien ki dieng kyntang jyllang u Mamre u kynoi Amor . U Merari bad ki para shynrang jong u , u Esekiel bad u Aber , ki dei ki paralok u Abraham .
translation.en: And there came one that had escaped , and told Abram the Hebrew  ; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite , brother of Eshcol , and brother of Aner : and these were confederate with Abram .

translation.kha: U shniah met tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar malu u pyndait ïa ki ha ki saw thylliej ki dong ha kiba don ki khait jong ka .
translation.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold , and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof .

translation.kha: Nga la wan sha ka pyrem kum ka jingshai , ba baroh kba ngeit ha nga kin ym Hukum ha ka jingdum .
translation.en: I am come a light into the world , that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness .

translation.kha: Katba nang ïaid sha khmat , u la beh noh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba kham khlaw bad kham khlaiñ ban ïa phi , khnang ba un buh ïa phi ha ka ri jong ki , badno ai ïa ka ha phi kum ka jingïohkynti jong phoi .
translation.en: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art , to bring thee in , to give thee their land for an inheritance , as it is this day .

translation.kha: Lada de uwei na ki riewpaidbah uba leh bapop khlem tip bad u long uba la rem ba u pynkyllaiñ ïa kiwei na ki hukum U Trai ,
translation.en: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance , while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which ought not to be done , and be guilty  ;

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi : Pyrkhat ïa u diengsoh thurmur bad ïa kiwei pat ki jait dieng .
translation.en: And he spake to them a parable  ;  Behold the fig tree , and all the trees  ;
And Absalom , and all the people the men of Israel , came to Jerusalem , and Ahithophel with him .
translation.kha: U Absalom bad baroh ki Israel baroh lem bad u ki rung sha Jerusalem , bad u Ahithophel u la don ryngkat bad ki .

translation.en: So I took the chief of your tribes , wise men , and known , and made them heads over you , captains over thousands , and captains over hundreds , and captains over fifties , and captains over tens , and officers among your tribes .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la shim ïa kita ki nongïalam kiba stad bad kiba khraw jingmut ïa kiba phi hi phi la jied na ki jait jong phi , bad nga la buh ïa ki ban peit halor ïa phi . Don na ki , kiba peit ïa ki shihajar ngut , don kiba peit ïa ki shispah ngut , don kiba peit ïa ki sanphew ngut , bad don ruh kiba peit ïa ki shiphew ngut . Nalor kitei , nga la thung ruh ïa kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar hapdeng jong phi .
hynrei ktem shym shem ka lad banbeiñ leh ïa kata , namar baroh ki briew ki la ïai shahshkor ïa u , kim khih ba-bang duh noh wat kawei ka kyntu .
translation.en: And could not find what they might do : for all the people were very attentive to hear him .
And he stretched himself upon the child three times , and cried unto the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  my God , I pray thee , let this child s soul come into him again .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u dem lai sien halor uta u khynnah bad u duwai ,  Ko  Trai  U Blei jong nga , pynwan biang ïa ka jingim ha une u khynnah !

translation.en: He will take the tenth of your sheep : and ye shall be his servants .
translation.kha: Un shim ïa kaba shiphew na ki kynhun langbrot jong phi , bad phi phin long ki mraw jong u .
Ngan ym leit phai bad phi , u Samuel u jubab . Phi la kyntait ïa ka suda U Trai , bad u la kyntait ïa phi kum u syiem ki Israel .
translation.en: And Samuel said unto Saul , I will not return with thee : for thou hast rejected the word of the  Lord  , and the  Lord  hath rejected thee from being king over Israel .

translation.kha: Ka jingkynnoh ka long ym ia baroh ki jaitniam , hynrei thrang ia wer ki niam kiba kyntiew ia ki kam bymman .
translation.en: The fault lies , not with all religion , but with false religion .

translation.kha: Haba ki hynmen shynrang Jong u ki la ïohi ba u kpa jong ki u kham ieit ïa u Joseph ban ïa ki baroh , ki la isih shibun eh ïa u kat khah ba kim kren bha kren imat shuh ïa u .
translation.en: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren , they hated him , and could not speak peaceably unto him .

translation.kha: Hynrei u kynti ïa ka jingai jingmut jong ki riewrangbah bad u leit pynban sha ki samla kiba la ïasan ryngkat bad u nabar babha long mynta ki nongaibuit jngai u .
translation.en: But he forsook the counsel of the old men , which they had given him , and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him , and which stood before him :

translation.kha: Lydia phi rkhiebeiñ ïa ki Briew kiba nur , phi ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei kaba la shrong ïa ki . Phira shuh pynmih lada phi sa sngewbha ha ka apot jongno jongno .
translation.en: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker : and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished .

translation.kha: Nga lah eh , da Shisha , ban shaniah ha kum kito ktien khie . Lada uno ine u pyrkhat ba u lah ban shaniah ha ki jinglehniam kiba sawar , nga don ka daw kaba kham khraw ban sngew kumta .
translation.en: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh . If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh , I more :

translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïakren ha khmat jong nga shaphang barhem ki ki bakha ibha u Tobiah u la leh bad ki ïathuh ha u ïa kiei ktieh baroh ba por la kren . Bad u ïaphai phah ïa nga ki shithi ban pyrshang ban pynkieng ïa nga .
translation.en: Also they reported his good deeds before me , and uttered my words to him . And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear .

translation.kha: U Balaam u ong ha u Balak , Seng hangne harud ka jingainguh thang jong phi , katba nga nang leit ïakynduh ïa U Blei’ hangtai .
translation.en: And he said unto Balak , Stand here by thy burnt offering , while I meet the  Lord  yonder .

translation.kha: Kane ka dat kaei ba ngin leh . Haba ki lyndang bad ki Lebi ki wan ban pyndih kam ha ka Sabbaton , shi bynta na ka lai bynta na ki kin ap Phira ïa ki khyrdop ka Templ ,
translation.en: This is the thing that ye shall do  ; A third part of you entering on the sabbath , of the priests and of the Levites , shall be porters of the doors  ;

translation.kha: Kiwei kiwei bhor ki kulmar lut — ka ri ka kynrei da ki jingïa-pynïap bad ki nongbah ki shlei da ka jingleh thombor .
translation.en: Make a chain : for the land is full of bloody crimes , and the city is full of violence .

translation.kha: Shim ïa ka duna , khie leit sawdong ïa ka shnongrit , Pha ka bapli ka nuti ba la klet noh ! To tei bad rwai biang ïa ki jingsngew jong pha To wallam ïa ki rangbah sa shisien pat .
translation.en: Take an harp , go about the city , thou harlot that hast been forgotten  ; make sweet melody , sing many songs , that thou mayest be remembered .

translation.kha: Nga kwah don ïohi ïa phi kham Palal ngab ïa kaba shu wan jngoh ha ka jingïaid lynti ; nga kyrmen ban pynlut shibun ka por bad phi , lada U Trai u shiah .
translation.en: For I will not see you now by the way ; but I trust to tarry a while with you , if the Lord permit .
And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple , for to hear him .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab man ka step baroh ki briew ki la leit sha ka Templ ban sngap ïa u .

translation.en: And said , I pray you , brethren , do not so wickedly .
translation.kha: U ong ïa ki ,  Paralok , nga kyrpad ïa phi , wat leh ïa kaba kum kane ka kam kaba sniew !

translation.en: It'd be about time to reply to his letter .
translation.kha: Lah jan dei por ban jubab iaka shithi jong u .

Don kiwei pat ki Langbrot ki bym dei na khnai ka me Langbrot . Nga dei ba-bang ïalam ïa ki ruh ; ngin shahshkor ïa ka sur jong nga , bad kin ïailong kawei ka kynhun longïng badno uwei u nongaplangbrot .
translation.en: And other sheep I have , which are not of this fold : them also I must bring , and they shall hear my voice  ; and there shall be one fold , and one shepherd .
Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest , the scribe , even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the  Lord  , and of his statutes to Israel .
translation.kha: U Artakserksis u ai ïa kane ka jingthoh ha u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad , uba don ka jingtip bajylliew ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel :

translation.en: As the partridge sitteth on eggs , and hatcheth them not  ; so he that getteth riches , and not by right , shall leave them in the midst of his days , and at his end shall be a fool .
translation.kha: U briew uba ïoh pisa da ka jingbymhok u long kum ka sim kaba pynmih khun na ki pylleng kiba ka khlem kha . Ha ka rta ba la ih bha un duh noh ïa ka spah jong u , bad ha kaba kut um long ei ei hynrei u bieit .

Kane ka longsem kaei ba U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , u ong Shaphan ki nongsynshar kiba la tharai ba kin sumar ïa ki briew jong u : kine shym la samla bha ïa ki briew jongu nga ; phi la pynsakma ïa ki bad phi la beh noh ïa ki . Mynta ngan pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingbymman jong phi kaba phi la sa .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people  ; Ye have scattered my flock , and driven them away , and have not visited them : behold , I will visit upon you the evil of your doings , saith the  Lord .
And he cometh to Bethsaida  ; and they bring a blind man unto him , and besought him to touch him .
translation.kha: Ki la wan sha Bethsaida , ha kaba katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ha U Jisu ïa u briew uba matlah , bad ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban ktah ïa u .
Kata ka erlangthari ka kupar jong ki briew kiba sniew , ka kupar Jong kito ki bymïap ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked , and this is the place of him that knoweth not God .
The slothful man saith , There is a lion in the way  ; a lion is in the streets .
translation.kha: Balei ba u briew uba jaipdeh um ju mih na la ïing ? Ïa kaei u sheptieng ? Ïa ki sing ?

translation.en: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Men ïap kum u ksew ha ka kti jong ki nongwei bym don blei . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la ai ïa ka hukum .

Haba ki Baïap ki la ïohi ba u Moses um pat Shim wan hiar na u lum hynrei u la sah snam hangta , ki la ïalam sawdong ïa u Araunah , pynlang ki la ong ha u , Ngim tip satia ka la jia aiwai ïa une u Moses , uba la ïalam ïa ngi ban mynhynne na ka ri Ijipt ; kumta to thaw ïa im’ u blei u ban ïalam ïa ngi .
translation.en: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount , the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron , and said unto him , Up , make us gods , which shall go before us  ; for as for this Moses , the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .

translation.kha: Kumta u leit phai pat bad u shem ïa ka ïing kaba khuid nabar kaba la pynbieit ryntih .
translation.en: And when he cometh , he findeth it swept and garnished .

translation.kha: U Jehosabad u ong ha ki , Em ! Phi la ïajan ban khmih ha-ei kane ka ri ka shong tlot .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Nay , but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come .

translation.kha: Nga kiew ïa tur u lum ban Pdiang ïa ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ka jutang ba U Trai u la pynlong bad phira . Nga sai hangta sawspah sngi bad sawphew miet , bad ngam shym la bam ne dih ei ei .
translation.en: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone , even the tables of the covenant which the  Lord  made with you , then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights , I neither did eat bread nor drink water :

translation.kha: U Isaak u la wan sha ka ri khlaw jong Ka Pukri jong uta Uba Im Uba Ïohi Ïa Nga bad ba u sah ha ka bynta ïashang shathie jong ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai–roi  ; for he dwelt in the south country .
And thou shalt go to thy fathers in peace  ; thou shalt be buried in a good old age .
translation.kha: Me pat , men im tymmen , men ïap ha kaba suk , bad yn sa tep ïa me .

translation.en: What shall we say then ? Shall we continue in sin , that grace may abound ?
translation.kha: Kaei te ngin ïa-ong ? Hato ngin ïai im ha ka pop ba ka jingaiei U Blei kan nang khraw ?

translation.en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money , or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life :
translation.kha: lada nga la bam ei ïa ka jingbam kaba la mih hangta hynrei nga pynshahthngan ïa ki nongrep kiba la rep ïa ka —
To shongduh , ki la ainong , bad to pule na ka kjat kli ha ngi . Te u Barukh u la leh kumta .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Sit down now , and read it in our ears . So Baruch read it in their ears .

translation.kha: Haba phiah rung bashapoh ka ïohnang , to ong , ‘ Ka jingsuk lem bad phi .’
translation.en: And when ye come into an house , salute it .

translation.kha: Ki jubab , lymda phi kwah ban shakri bha ïa kine ki briew , ai ïa ka jubab kaba biang ïa ka jingkyrpad jong ki , sad kin ïai shakri hok ïa phi .
translation.en: And they spake unto him , saying , If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day , and wilt serve them , and answer them , and speak good words to them , then they will be thy servants for ever .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Shaphang kaei ba phi ïakren para ma phiah , katba phi nang ïa-ïaid ? Ki la sheng , lem bad ka durkhmat basniew .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another , as ye walk , and are sad ?

translation.kha: Ki jingjam jong u ki la ju longkmie uba skhem , hynñiew mandriek u jynthut ; u kyllon — u Shah lehbeiñ ha la ka jong ka jingai jingmut jong u hi .
translation.en: The steps of his strength shall be straitened , and his own counsel shall cast him down .

translation.kha: Nga lah da ïateh ha u ba ngan pynshitom ïa ka ïohnang jong u junom , nalor ki khun shyieng jong u ki la kren sniew pyrshah ïa nga . U Eli u thup ba ki leh kumne ishyrkhei bad um shym la khang ïa ki .
translation.en: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth  ; because his sons made themselves vile , and he restrained them not .

translation.kha: Nga la ai kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki jait jong phi ïa ka ri jong kita ki jaitbynriew kiba dang sah , lymne bad ka jong wer ki jaitbynriew kba nga la dep jop , naduh ka wah Judah ha ka phang mih haduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian ha ka phang sepngi .
translation.en: Behold , I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain , to be an inheritance for your tribes , from Jordan , with all the nations that I have cut off , even unto the great sea westward .
