translation.kha: Kata ka long haba ka jingshai jong ka sngi , u bnai , bad ki khlur kan sdang lip ïa phi , bad ki lyoh slap kin ym leit noh da lei lei .

translation.en: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him , saying , Of a truth thou art the Son of God .
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran hapoh ka lieng ki la mane ïa U Jisu .  Da shisha me long U Khun U Blei !  ki la pynbna .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of seven days , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba la kut kita ki hynñiew sngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , nga la ïambriew haduh lai taïew .

translation.en: Neither is it beyond the sea , that thou shouldest say , Who shall go over the sea for us , and bring it unto us , that we may hear it , and do it ?
translation.kha: Kam don ruh ha shiliang duriaw . Phim donkam ban da kylli , ‘ Uei keiñ u ban leit sha shiliang duriaw bad wallam ïa ka sha ngi , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïohsngew bad kohnguh ïa ka ?’

translation.en: And were continually in the temple , praising and blessing God . Amen .
translation.kha: bad ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki baroh hapoh ka Templ da kaba ainguh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet ,
translation.kha: Bad kumta , kat kum kaei kaba U  Trai  u la lah ong pyrshah ïa u Baasha lyngba u Jehu u nongïathuhlypa , u Simri u la pynïap ïa baroh na ka longïing jong u Baasha .

Ka met jong u tieng sohwaiñ ka la kem ding ; ka tdong ka la bam haduh ïa ki tnat bad ïa u soh jong u . Ki tnat kin ym longïing shuh da lei lili kiba khlaiñ , kin ym long shuh da lei lei ki diengsynshar ba kynja syier . Kane ka dei ka jingjaw jong ka jingsngewsih ; la ju rwai badno ïai ri ïa ka .
translation.en: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches , which hath devoured her fruit , so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule . This is a lamentation , and shall be for a lamentation .

translation.kha: Katba u dang don ha lynñiar sha ïing , ki shakri jong u ki la waiñ shem ïa u bad ka khubor , U khun jong me un im !
translation.en: And as he was now going down , his servants met him , and told him , saying , Thy son liveth .

translation.kha: U shakri ïa U balui jong u khap jong u , u kumjuh ïa ki hukum U Blei , bad um shym kun ha ka rukom ba ki syiem Israel ki la leh .
translation.en: But sought to the  Lord  God of his father , and walked in his commandments , and not after the doings of Israel .

translation.kha: Me la peit bniah ïa u Job u shakri jong nga ? U Trai u kyllan . Ym to uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba ïaineh bad umbah bha kat ma u . U mane ïa nga bad u kiar ban ym leh kano kano kaba sniew .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ?

translation.kha: baïar arliang ki dei ban leit sha kata ka jaka manna Blei! ba yn bishar ïa ki da ki lyngdoh bad ki nongbishar kiba treikam ha kata ka por .
translation.en: Then both the men , between whom the controversy is , shall stand before the  Lord  , before the priests and the judges , which shall be in those days  ;

translation.kha: U shait ïa u slap ban theh na ki lieh ha kaba ai um ïa u khunbynriew baroh .
translation.en: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly .

translation.kha: Kumta bun ki bynriew ki la ïawanlang shisien wan ba ym don jaka shuh kaba laiñ , ym don kajuh shuh wat habar ha khmat ka jingkhang . U Jeshua u tdong ïalap ïa ka khubor ha ki ,
translation.en: And straightway many were gathered together , insomuch that there was no room to receive them , no , not so much as about the door : and he preached the word unto them .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga maham ïa ki ba da shisha nga long U Blei umbah im , ki briew kiba shong basah ha ki nongbah ba la pynïong kin shah pynïap . Kito kiba shongneh ha ka ri ktang shahïap bam da ki mradkhlaw . Kito Ibbah rieh ha ki lumbah bad ki krem kin ïap da ka jingpang .
translation.en: Say thou thus unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; As I live , surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword , and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured , and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence .

And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah , saying , The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon , saying , Give thy daughter to my son to wife : and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon , and trode down the thistle .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem Jehoash u phah kylla ïa ka jubab kumne :  Shisien u dieng shiah ha ki Lum Lebanon u phah ïa ka khubor sha u dieng Kedar : ‘ To ai ïa ka khun jong phi ban shongkurim bad u khun jong nga .’ U mradkhlaw u ïaid nangta bad u kyrdem ïa u dieng shiah shapoh .
Nga la sngewthikna bha shemphang kane baroh kumta nga la buh ki jingthmu nyngkong eh ban wan jngoh ïa phi , khring ba phin ïoh jingkynnoh ar shah .
translation.en: And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before , that ye might have a second benefit ;

translation.kha: Nangta u mutdur sha ka sharing lum ha ka Phan bahakhlieh jong ka Lus ( kaba la khot ruh ka Bethel ) , nangta arsut shaduh Ataroth Addar , ha u lum uba shait na ka Beth Horon kaba shakor .
translation.en: And the border went over from thence toward Luz , to the side of Luz , which is Beth–el , southward  ; and the border descended to Ataroth–adar , near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth–horon .

translation.kha: Kiei ki jingkylli ?
translation.en: What are the questions ?

translation.kha: ym don u briew uba sniew uba kmen slem .
translation.en: That the triumphing of the wicked is short , and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment ?
For I know the thoughts that I think toward you , saith the  Lord  , thoughts of peace , and not of evil , to give you an expected end .
translation.kha: Tang ma nga hi nga tip ïa ki jingthmu kiba nga don na ka bynta jong phi , ki jingthmu ban wallam ha phi ka jingmanbha bad ym ka jingpynjot , ki jingthmu ban wallam ïa ka lawei kaba phi ap kyrmen .

translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Blessed is the man that feareth the  Lord  , that delighteth greatly in his commandments .
translation.kha: A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! Suk uta u briew uba pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , uba shem sngewbha ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .

U ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syep ka Ammon bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jongki u bad u jop ïa ki . Nangta u pynpyiar ïa ki Ammon ban siew ïa u ka khñiang man ka snem haduh lai sniew kumto : lai hajar sawspah kilo ka ayu , shihajar ton u kew , badno shihajar ton u barli .
translation.en: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites , and prevailed against them . And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver , and ten thousand measures of wheat , and ten thousand of barley . So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him , both the second year , and the third .

translation.kha: Haba ym Don pisa shuh ha Ijipt bad ha Kanaan , barabor ki nong Ijipt ki ïawan Sha u Joseph , mala ki ïai-ong , Ai jingbam ba ngin bam ! Wat ai ba ngin shu ïapthngan ! Ngam don pisa sha .
translation.en: And when money failed in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , all the Egyptians came unto Joseph , and said , Give us bread : for why should we die in thy presence ? for the money faileth .

translation.kha: Waw khia ïa la ki khun da kaba thang ïa ki ha ka Eri jong phiah ; wiat shah ïa la ki brisoh Ban khan , lane ban shat ban kheiñduh , lane ban ai mandriek ,
translation.en: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire , or that useth divination , or an observer of times , or an enchanter , or a witch ,
For men shall be lovers of their own selves , covetous , boasters , proud , blasphemers , disobedient to parents , unthankful , unholy ,
translation.kha: Naba U briew u long u ba khwan myntoi , kiba lalot , kiba leh sarong , bad kiba kyr-eit ; kin krenbeiñ , kin ym kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , ki bymsngewnguh , bad ki bymriewblei ;
‘ Kato me kwah ban pynïap ïa nga , main me la pynïap ïa uta u nong Ijipt mynhynnin ?’
translation.en: Wilt thou kill me , as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday ?

translation.kha: Kan don ka jingpyrta da ka hukum , ka ar jong u angel rangbah , ka jingriew ka turoi jong U Blei , bad U Trai hi da lade” un sa wan thir na bneng . Kito kiba la ïap da kaba ngeit ha U Khristan kin ïamih pat shuwa ;
translation.en: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout , with the voice of the archangel , and with the trump of God : and the dead in Christ shall rise first :

translation.kha: Kata ka long jin bajai ba phi dei don siew ki khajna , ñiar ki bor synshar ki twa na ka bynta U Blei haba ki pynjop ïa la ki kamram .
translation.en: For for this cause pay ye tribute also : for they are God s ministers , attending continually upon this very thing .

translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la leh pep pyrshah ïa U Trai bad ki leh palat ban pynkhih bitar ïa U pyrshah ïa ki ban ïa kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ki barben ki la leh .
translation.en: And Judah did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed , above all that their fathers had done .
Man knoweth not the price thereof  ; neither is it found in the land of the living .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingstad ym lah ban shem hapdeng ki briew ; ym don batip ïa ka dor bashisha jong ka .
Nangno per la kdiah ïa u dieng uba ar , uta uba la khot U Jingtylli , bad ïa ka jinglui jong ka Judah bad ka Jeriel la pynkhynñiuh .
translation.en: Then I cut asunder mine other staff , even Bands , that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel .

translation.kha: Pha ïakhaïi pateng ha india nabar pha la shimet ïa ka rupa , ka nar , ka ton , bad ka sisa da kaba siewdor na ka bynta ki tiar ba-bang kyrhai jong pha .
translation.en: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches  ; with silver , iron , tin , and lead , they traded in thy fairs .

And all the cities of store that Solomon had , and cities for his chariots , and cities for his horsemen , and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem , and in Lebanon , and in all the land of his dominion .
translation.kha: ki nongbah ha kiba u kynshew jingbam , ki shnong buh kulai bad kali ïapom , bad kat ïa kaba u kwah ban tei ha Jerusalem , ha Lebanon , bad kylleng ka hima jong u .

Kut u Haman u ong ïa u syiem . Ka anna kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba la saphriang khyllung sawdong ka hima jong phi bad ba haka ban shem ha kawei pa kiwei ka probins . Ki bud ïa ki sopkjat kiba ïaphah na ki jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew . Nalor kata kim kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong ka shem , Kumta kuna ym long kaba bha ïa phi ban shah ïa ki .
translation.en: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus , There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom  ; and their laws are diverse from all people  ; neither keep they the king s laws : therefore it is not for the king s profit to suffer them .
And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days : so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki ïambriew ïa u laiphew sngi hangta ha ri them Moab .

Kaei me ïohi ? U la kylli . U diengpynïeng sharati ba la shane da ka ksiar , na la jubab . Ha ka kliar ka to ka pliang na ka bynta ka bymnang . khlur u diengpynïeng sharak don hynñiew tylli ki sharak , kawei kawei bad ki jaka na ka bynta ki hynrei thlia ki ksai sharak .
translation.en: And said unto me , What seest thou ? And I said , I have looked , and behold a candlestick all of gold , with a bowl upon the top of it , and his seven lamps thereon , and seven pipes to the seven lamps , which are upon the top thereof :

translation.kha: U Blei u kyrkhu ïa ka khyndew kaweh kjit noh ïa u thup uba hap bunsien ha ka bad kaba pynmih ïa ki jingthung naba ai jingtuid na ka bynta kita kiba rep ha ka .
translation.en: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it , and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed , receiveth blessing from God :

translation.kha: Ka la san khlaiñ eh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ka bneng , ïa ki khlur hi , bad ka la bret katto katne na ki sha khyndew bad ka la ïa-ïuh khlur jong ki .
translation.en: And it waxed great , even to the host of heaven  ; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground , and stamped upon them .

translation.kha: U uno uba kyntait ïa nga bad u bym pyngkiang ïa ka khubor jongngi nga , u don uwei u shun bishar ïa u . Ki ktem kiba to la kren ktang long u nongbishar jong u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh !
translation.en: He that rejecteth me , and receiveth not my words , hath one that judgeth him : the word that I have spoken , the same shall judge him in the last day .

And ye went over Jordan , and came unto Jericho : and the men of Jericho fought against you , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Girgashites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites  ; and I delivered them into your hand .
translation.kha: Phi la jam ïa ka Jordan bad wan poi sha ka Jerikho . Ki rangbah ka Jerikho ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi , kumba la leh ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Girgash , ki Hib bad ki Jebus . Hynrei nga la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor jong ki baroh .
Ïa ka pisa ba la ai na ka bynta ki jingainguh ba hap siew pat bad na ka bynshet ki jingkynjah pop ym shym thep ha ka synduk ; ka dei ka jong ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the  Lord  : it was the priests .
Sanctify them through thy truth : thy word is truth .
translation.kha: To pynkyntang ïa ki sha lade da kata ka jingshisha ; ka ktien jong me ka long ka jingshisha .
Ka jingsngewsih bakhraw ka la wan ha ki briew jong ka Gasa , bad ki briew jong ka Ashkelon ki sngap jar . katno slem kiba dang sawa ha Philistia kin ïam sngewsih ?
translation.en: Baldness is come upon Gaza  ; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley : how long wilt thou cut thyself ?

translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u phet na Naïoth kaweh ha Ramah bad u leit sha u Nathan . Kaei kaba ang la leh ? u kylli . Ka kam sniew aïu ang la leh ? Ka ki palat aïu nga la imat ïa i pa jong phi ba i da tmoh ban pynïap ïa nga ?
translation.en: And David fled from Naioth in Ramah , and came and said before Jonathan , What have I done ? what is mine iniquity ? and what is my sin before thy father , that he seeketh my life ?
And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa une u shakri bymmyntoi — bret ïa u shabar ha kaba dum ; hangta un lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .’

U symboh dab mynta u shong ha ka jingïam jongngi u . Ha kawei ka sngi u phah khot ïa u Nathan u nongïathuhlypa bad ong ha u , Hangne nga shong ha ka ïing ba la thaw da ki dieng Kedar , hynrei ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai la buh ha ka jingïaineh !
translation.en: Now it came to pass , as David sat in his house , that David said to Nathan the prophet , Lo , I dwell in an house of cedars , but the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  remaineth under curtains .
And they answered and said unto Jesus , We cannot tell . And Jesus answering saith unto them ,  Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things .
translation.kha: Kumta ka jubab jong ki ïa U Jisu ka la long ,  Ngim tip .  U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Nga ruh ngan ym ïathuh ïa phi te , da kaei ka hok ba nga leh ïa kine kiei kiei .

Peit ïa une u briew ki ïakynton para ma ki . Sngap ïa ki jingbah jongngi u . U syiem Saul un ai ka nong kambah khraw ïa u briew u ban pynïap ïa u ; u syiem un ai ruh ban shongkurim ïa ka khun kynthei jong u bad ka ïing u kpa jong u kam donkam ban siew khajna .
translation.en: And the men of Israel said , Have ye seen this man that is come up ? surely to defy Israel is he come up : and it shall be , that the man who killeth him , the king will enrich him with great riches , and will give him his daughter , and make his father s house free in Israel .
And David comforted Bath–sheba his wife , and went in unto her , and lay with her : and she bare a son , and he called his name Solomon : and the  Lord  loved him .
translation.kha: Te u Dabid u la pyntngen ïa ka Bathsheba ka tnga jong u . U la ïathiah shongkha bad ka ; bad ka la kha khun shynrang , ïa uba u Dabid u la ai kyrteng u Solomon . U  Trai  u la ieit ïa u khynnah ,
Hadien u lumlang ïa ka kynhun ki riewmadan , bad ki pynbor ïa ka mon jong ki ha u Rehoboam u khun jrong u Simeon , uba dang khynnah eh badno ba Dang lung ka jingtbit ba-bang ïeng pyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: And there are gathered unto him vain men , the children of Belial , and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon , when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted , and could not withstand them .

translation.kha: Mynta te , pynbynta ïa kane ka ri hapdeng kiwei pat ki khyndai jait bad ha ka shiteng na ka jait Massah , na ka bynta jong ki ba kin ïohkynti kum la ka jong .
translation.en: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes , and the half tribe of Manasseh ,
And Rehoboam slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David : and Abijah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Rehoboam u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid bad u khun jong u , u Abijah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And now , behold , the hand of the Lord is upon thee , and thou shalt be blind , not seeing the sun for a season . And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness  ; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand .
translation.kha: Ka kti U Trai kan sa wan ha me mynta ; men sa matlah bad men ym ïohi ïa ka jingshai jong ka sngi shipor .  Mar kumta hi u Elumas u la sngew ba u lyoh khyndew uba ïong u la tap ïa ki khmat jong u , bad u la ïaid kylleng da kaba pyrshang ban wad ïano ïano ban ïalam ïa u na ka kti .
U Ioannis u la phong da ki jaiñ-jin ba la shane na ki shñiuh ut , bun u panpoh snieh sawdong ïa ka syngkai jyllang u , bad ka jingbam jong u ka la longkmie da ki puit sad ka ra-ngiep khlaw .
translation.en: And John was clothed with camel s hair , and with a girdle of a skin about his loins  ; and he did eat locusts and wild honey  ;

translation.kha: Kumta u Ahab u khot shapoh ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kumba sawspah na ki , bad u kylli ïa ki , Hato lang! rupa bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth , ne em ? Tur ïaleh ïa ka , ki jubab . U Blei un ai jingjop ïa phi .
translation.en: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men , and said unto them , Shall we go to Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And they said , Go up  ; for God will deliver it into the king s hand .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba shahshkor ïa ka ktien hynrei u bym pyntreikam ïa ka u long kum u Briew naba peit ha ka ïitkhmih badno ïohi ïa lade kamar u long .
translation.en: For if any be a hearer of the word , and not a doer , he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass :

translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh eh , ka kyntiap ka la ïap .
translation.en: And last of all the woman died also .

translation.kha: Ha ka bujli , U Blei u la buh ïa baroh ha la ka pynbha : Ha ka bynta banyngkong u buh ïa ki Apostol , ha ka bynta kaba ar ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kaba kad ïa ki nongsakhi ; nangta ïa kito kiba leh ïa ki kaweh , bud sa kito ha kiba la ai ïa ka bor pun pynkhiah lane ban ïarap ïa kiwei lane ba pynum lem lane ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher .
translation.en: And God hath set some in the church , first apostles , secondarily prophets , thirdly teachers , after that miracles , then gifts of healings , helps , governments , diversities of tongues .

translation.kha: Ko syep ka Babilonia , u khlur step baphyrnai , me la hap na bneng ! Ha kaba mynshuwa me la jop ïa ki hima , hynrei mynta la kren ïa me sha madan .
translation.en: How art thou fallen from heaven , O Lucifer , son of the morning ! how art thou cut down to the ground , which didst weaken the nations !

Furthermore the  Lord  was angry with me for your sakes , and sware that I should not go over Jordan , and that I should not go in unto that good land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance :
translation.kha: Dei namar jong phi ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la bitar ïa nga bad u la kren da kaba shai ba ngan ym ïoh jam ïa ka wah Jordan ban leit sha kata ka ri kaba seisoh kaba u ai kum ka jingïohkynti jong phi .

translation.en: ( For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt  ; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by  ;
translation.kha: Phi kynmaw kumno ngi la im ha Ijipt bad kumno ka la jia bad ngi haba ngi ïaid lynti na ka ri jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
ka kynthup ïa ka Them Joanan naduh Duriaw Galatia arsut shaduh Beth Jeshimoth ( shaphang mihnoh jongno ka Duriaw Baïap ) bad sha trai jongngi u Lum Pynjah .
translation.en: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east , and unto the sea of the plain , even the salt sea on the east , the way to Beth–jeshimoth  ; and from the south , under Ashdoth–pisgah :

translation.kha: Pynban , paila phi shahshitom namar ba phi long u Khristan , ki sngewlehrain ïa kata , Hynrei ainguh ïa U Blei ba phi kup ïa ka kyrteng U Khrist .
translation.en: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian , let him not be ashamed  ; but let him glorify God on this behalf .
When the morning stars sang together , and all the sons of God shouted for joy ?
translation.kha: Hamar ka kynjat shai jong kata ka sngi , ki khlur ki ïarwai lang , bad baroh ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng ki risa da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: And , behold , they cried out , saying , What have we to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of God ? art thou come hither to torment us before the time ?
translation.kha: Shisyndon ki la lynñiar ,  Me kwah aïu bad ngi , me U Khun jong U Blei ? Hato me la wan ban pynshitom ïa ngi ha shuwa ka por kaba dei ?

Nga la jied ruh ïa u Oholiab u khun jong u Ahisamakh , na ka jaiñ Dan , ban ïatur lem bad u . Nga la ai pajut ïa ka jingjlan kaba bakhraw ha kiwei pat ki misteri kiba tbit , khnang ba ki lah ban shna ïa kiei kiei baher kiba nga la hukum ba dei ban shna :
translation.en: And I , behold , I have given with him Aholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan : and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom , that they may make all that I have commanded thee  ;

translation.kha: len ai ha me bun ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang pun ïa uno uno uba la don ha shuwa lane u ban sa ïoh pat hadien .
translation.en: Behold , I have done according to thy words : lo , I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart  ; so that there was none like thee before thee , neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee .

translation.kha: Ka kmie nabar ki para shajrong jong U ijuh ki la wan sha u , hynrei kim lai ban ïadon bad u namar u paidbah .
translation.en: Then came to him his mother and his brethren , and could not come at him for the press .
Who , having received such a charge , thrust them into the inner prison , and made their feet fast in the stocks .
translation.kha: Haba u nongpeit phatok u la ïoh ïa kane ka hukum , u la buh ïa ki sha ka kamra set kaba shapoh duh bad u la teh ïa ki kjat jong ki hapdeng ki dieng song kiba khia .
U Jakob u ong , Bel keiñ phi pynher sat ïa nga katne katne ba phi da ïathmu ha uta u briew ba pa’ ba-don sa uwei u para ?
translation.en: And Israel said , Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me , as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother ?

translation.kha: Pham shym la thab jingiwbih ïa sa lane pynneh ïa nga da ka khleiñ ki jingri jong phin . Pynban Phin la bankhia ïa nga da ki pop jongu phi ; phi la pynpyut ïa nga da ki jingbah ba phi la leh .
translation.en: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money , neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices : but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins , thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities .

translation.kha: Phi la sngewkwah ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei . Kaei ka jingrai jong phi ? Baroh ki la rai pyrshah ïa u : U long ba la rem bad dei ban pynïap ne ïa u .
translation.en: Ye have heard the blasphemy : what think ye ? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death .
And it came to pass , when God destroyed the cities of the plain , that God remembered Abraham , and sent Lot out of the midst of the overthrow , when he overthrew the cities in the which Lot dwelt .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba U Blei u la pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong kata ka them ha kaba u Lot u shong shnong , u la buh jingkynmaw ïa u Abraham , bad u la ailad ïa u Lot ban lait im .
Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Kaïaphas , uba la long u Rangbah lyngkhuit ha kata ka snem , u la ong , A kattne phi long kiba bieit !
translation.en: And one of them , named Caiaphas , being the high priest that same year , said unto them , Ye know nothing at all ,

translation.kha: Katba ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki dang mihnoh , U Jisu u la kren shaphang jngai u ha ki paidbah ; Haba phiah leit sha u Ïoannis ha ka ri shyiap , kaei kaba phoi khmih lynti ban ïohi ? Ïa u slem phlang ba la pynkhun ha ka lynter !
translation.en: And as they departed , Jesus began to say unto the multitudes concerning John ,  What went ye out into the wilderness to see ? A reed shaken with the wind ?

translation.kha: U la ïajubab , U briew ïa uba la khot U Jisu u la Pynlong ïa i sboh ktieh , u la kyllan ha ki khmat jong nga , bad u la ong ha to ban leit shwa Siloam malade bta ïa ka khmat jong nga . Kumne to la longing , Bad tong mar ïa-bta khmat , nga la lah banbeiñ imat .
translation.en: He answered and said , A man that is called Jesus made clay , and anointed mine eyes , and said unto me ,  Go to the pool of Siloam , and wash :  and I went and washed , and I received sight .

Then the soldiers , when they had crucified Jesus , took his garments , and made four parts , to every soldier a part  ; and also his coat : now the coat was without seam , woven from the top throughout .
translation.kha: Ynda haba ki shipai ki la lah sahnarphna ïa U Jisu , ki la ïashim ïa ki jaiñ jong u bad ki la ïabynta ha ki saw bynta , kawei ka bynta ïa uwei uwei u shipai . Ki la ïashim ruh ïa ka jaiñkup , ïa kaba la pynlong tang na kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ba la thain khlem kano kano ka jingsuh ha ka .

translation.en: Lest the  Lord  see it , and it displease him , and he turn away his wrath from him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u tip lada phi long uba rkhiebeiñ . Bad um sngewbha ïa kata ; bad nangta u lah ban ym pynshitom ïa u .

translation.en: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings , wherein thou hast transgressed against me : for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride , and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ma phi , ki briew jong nga phim donkam shuh ban lehrain ba phi la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ngan weng noh ïa uno uno baroh uba sarong bad uba sngewmeng , bad phin ym ïeng ïaleh pyrshah shuh da lei lei ïa nga ha u lum bakyntang jong nga .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Thou hast said : nevertheless I say unto you , Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power , and coming in the clouds of heaven .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Me ong kumta . Hynrei nga ong ïa phi baroh : Naduh kane ka por phin ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew ba u da shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Bakhrawbor tam bad u da wan ha ki lyoh bneng !
bad haba u la shem ïa uwei ibha ikordor tam , u leit Bad die lut ïa kaei kaei kaba u la don , sad u tlot ïa uta u mawlynnai .
translation.en: Who , when he had found one pearl of great price , went and sold all that he had , and bought it .
Behold , a whirlwind of the  Lord  is gone forth in fury , even a grievous whirlwind : it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked .
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar jong U ka long ka  erïong , ka  erlangthari ka ban khih bitar halor ki khlieh jong ki bymman ,
Wat la u Asa um shym pynjot ïa baroh ki jaka mano beit thala ha ka ri , u ïailong uba ïaineh ha U thri shi lyndet ka jingimat jong u .
translation.en: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel : nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days .

translation.kha: U Abram u la shaniah ha U Trai ; bad namar kane , U Tlai u la sngewbha ïa u bad u la pynhieng ïa u .
translation.en: And he believed in the  Lord   ; and he counted it to him for righteousness .

translation.kha: U shakri uba ar u la wei bad u la jong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga la kamai satang tylli ki sbai ksiar na kawei kaba me la ai ha nga .’
translation.en: And the second came , saying , Lord , thy pound hath gained five pounds .

translation.kha: hynriew u syiem Ammon um patiaw ei ei ruh em ïa kane ka khubor na u Jephthah .
translation.en: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him .
Artaxerxes , king of kings , unto Ezra the priest , a scribe of the law of the God of heaven , perfect peace , and at such a time .
translation.kha: Na u patsha Artakserksis ha u Esra , u lyngdoh , riewstad ka Hukum jong U Blei ka Bneng .

translation.en: And he brought the family of Judah  ; and he took the family of the Zarhites : and he brought the family of the Zarhites man by man  ; and Zabdi was taken :
translation.kha: U wan ïalam ïa ka jait Judah sha khmat , shi kur shi kur , bad la kdew ïa ka kur ki Serah . Nangta u wan ïalam ïa ka kur Serah sha khmat , shi ïing shi ïing , bad la kdew ïa ka ïing u Sabdi .

translation.en: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed ? for the end of those things is death .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi la ïoh jingmyntoi na kaba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba phi la sngewlehrain mynta ? Ka jingmih jong kita kiei kiei ka long ka jingïap !

translation.en: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands  ; as saith the prophet ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei Uba Hakhlieh Tam Eh um shong ha ki ïing ba la tei da ki briew , kumba u nongïathuhlypa u ong ,
Phi , phin ïap ha kane ka ri khlaw .
translation.en: But as for you , your carcases , they shall fall in this wilderness .

translation.kha: U Trai u la bitar ïa la ki briew bad u la kner ïa la ka kad don pynshitom ïa ki . Ki lumbah kin khynñiuh pynlang ïa ki jingsawa jongki Kito katba la ïap yn ioh ha ki lynti kum ka synrum . Pynban wat la katta ruh ïa ka jingbitar U Trai ym shym la pynkut , hynrei ka kti jong u kan ïadie kner ban pynshitom .
translation.en: Therefore is the anger of the  Lord  kindled against his people , and he hath stretched forth his hand against them , and hath smitten them : and the hills did tremble , and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets . For all this his anger is not turned away , but his hand is stretched out still .

translation.kha: Ki briew kin ïoh ïa kane mala kin tip ba to , U Trai , at la leh ïa ka . Kin wan ban tip ba U Blei bakhuid ki Israel u la pynlong ïa ka ban jat .
translation.en: That they may see , and know , and consider , and understand together , that the hand of the  Lord  hath done this , and the Holy One of Israel hath created it .

translation.kha: kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , badno ïa kata kawei pat khem ka jingangnud thang ryngkat sad ka jingainguh bam . kumno keiñ uta u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka niam ka rukom ka ïadei dara ka jingpynkhuid .
translation.en: Even such as he is able to get , the one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering , with the meat offering : and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka law jong ka Templ : Baroh ka tare sawdong jong ka halor jong u lum ka long kaba kyntang dara kaba khur .
translation.en: This is the law of the house  ; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy . Behold , this is the law of the house .

translation.kha: Namar ba ki langbrot kim ei u nongsharai , ki la sakma noh , mala ki mradkhlaw ki pynïap bad bam ïa ki .
translation.en: And they were scattered , because there is no shepherd : and they became meat to all the beasts of the field , when they were scattered .
But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive , and shall see this land no more .
translation.kha: Un ïap ha ka ri sha kaba ki la rah ïa u , bad un ym ïohi shuh ïa kane ka ri .
Haba u Mysia u ïohsngew ïa kane , u la dem khrup ha khyndew Bad u duwai .
translation.en: And when Moses heard it , he fell upon his face :

translation.kha: Hadien ba uta u khajna u la leit , u Dabid u ïeng nadien kata ka kynton maw , bad u dem khohsiew bad u nguh lai sien . Baroh ar ngut , ma u Bad u Jonathan ki ïa-ïam katba ki dang ïadoh markylliang ; ka jingsniew u Sabad ka kham jur ban ïa ka jong u Jonathan .
translation.en: And as soon as the lad was gone , David arose out of a place toward the south , and fell on his face to the ground , and bowed himself three times : and they kissed one another , and wept one with another , until David exceeded .

translation.kha: U Jisu Krist da lade hi u la ong : “ Wat sniew kyndit ia kano , namar ka por ka la jia , ha kaba kito babha don ha ki jing tep kin ioh sngew ia ka jingpyrta jongnga u bad kin ia mih noh! . ”
translation.en: Jesus Christ himself said : “ Do not marvel at this , because the hour is coming in which all those in the memorial tombs will hear his voice and come out . ”

translation.kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki la pynkhiah ïa ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka nongbah bad ïa ki kyntiew Jentil kiba don ha ki kyrdem kiba hajar ha ka imlang ka synrang kiba la ma ïa U Blei . Ki la sdang ban pynthnam beiñ pyrshah ïa u Paul bad u manbha bad ki la beh ïa ki shabar na ka thain jong ki .
translation.en: But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women , and the chief men of the city , and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas , and expelled them out of their coasts .

translation.kha: U la ong , Ko ïakhun u briew , pynpra ïa ka kynroh hangne . Nga la pynjop lyngba ïa ka Bad nga la skhem ïa ka jingkhang .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , dig now in the wall : and when I had digged in the wall , behold a door .

translation.kha: namar U Trai U Blei! jong pa u long kumno ka ding kaba bam duh ; um lah shah ba ki Israel kin mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei .
translation.en: For the  Lord  thy God is a consuming fire , even a jealous God .

translation.kha: U la ïakren bad u Joab ( uba ka kmen jong u ka dei ka Seruïah ) bad u Abiathar u lyngdoh , bad ki la ïambriew baneh kyrshan ïa ka jingthmu jong u .
translation.en: And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah , and with Abiathar the priest : and they following Adonijah helped him .
Thus saith the Lord  God  unto these bones  ; Behold , I will cause breath to enter into you , and ye shall live :
translation.kha: To ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki : Ngan pyrsad mynsiem ha phi , bad ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha ka jingim .
Kane ka la Pynmih ïa ka jingïatainia kaweh tyngeh hapdeng jong ki . Kumno eit u briew u lah ban ai ha ngi ïa ka doh jong u ban bam ? ki la kylli .
translation.en: The Jews therefore strove among themselves , saying , How can this man give us his flesh to eat ?
But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst  ; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life .
translation.kha: Ka um ïa kaba ngan ai ha u kan long ha u ka umpohliew ka ban pynïoh ïa u da ka um kaba ai jingim bad ai ha u ïa ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: Your lamb shall be without blemish , a male of the first year : ye shall take it out from the sheep , or from the goats :
translation.kha: Lah ban jied da ka langbrot ne da ka blang , tangba u dei ban long u shynrang uba shisnem bad u bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
Nangta ka jingïalang paidbah ka phah ktung sha ki Benjamin kiba don ha u Mawsiang Rimmon bad tyrwa ban pynwai ei ïa ka thma .
translation.en: And the whole congregation sent some to speak to the children of Benjamin that were in the rock Rimmon , and to call peaceably unto them .

translation.kha: na ka Them Jingjynjar pyrthat shwa donbor , nabar nangta ka phai shatei sha Galilaïa , kaba marpyrshah ka Khim Adummim ha ka phang bashathie jong ka them . Nalorkata ka ïaid sha ki riewpoh ka Enshemesh , ka mih sha Enrogel ;
translation.en: And the border went up toward Debir from the valley of Achor , and so northward , looking toward Gilgal , that is before the going up to Adummim , which is on the south side of the river : and the border passed toward the waters of En–shemesh , and the goings out thereof were at En–rogel :
Then we turned , and went up the way to Bashan : and Og the king of Bashan came out against us , he and all his people , to battle at Edrei .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , ngi la ïaleit shaphang shatei sha ka thain Bashan , bad u Og u Syiem jong ka u la wan ryngkat bad la ki rangïapom ban ïaleh ïa ngi hajan ka shnong Edrei .
Hato don kaei Kiei kaba eh ïa U Terah ? Kumba nga la ong , len sa wang bajrong hadien khyndai bnai , bad ka Sarah kan sa ïoh khun Shynrang .
translation.en: Is any thing too hard for the  Lord  ? At the time appointed I will return unto thee , according to the time of life , and Sarah shall have a son .
Say I these things as a man ? or saith not the law the same also ?
translation.kha: Ngam donkam ban ñiew tang na kine ki nuksa ba man la ka sngi , namar ka hukum ka ong hi ïa kajuh .
Katto katne ki ong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis , ki la Joab . kiei pait ki ong u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong u Jeremaïah lane uwei pateng u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And they said , Some say that thou art John the Baptist : some , Elias  ; and others , Jeremiah , or one of the prophets .

translation.kha: Ïa U Khun U Briew yn sa ai khong ha ki briew ki ban pynïap ïa u . Pynbna hadien lai sngaid , un sa mihpat .
translation.en: For he taught his disciples , and said unto them ,  The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men , and they shall kill him  ; and after that he is killed , he shall rise the third day .

translation.kha: Ka long ka bor jong ka kyrteng jong u kaba la ai jingkhlaiñ ïa une u briew uba dkhiew . Ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi bad tip , la leh da ka jingiw ha ka kyrteng jong u ; ka long ka jingngeit ha U Jisu kaba la pynkhiah ïa u , kam phi baroh phoi ïohi .
translation.en: And his name through faith in his name hath made this man strong , whom ye see and know : yea , the faith which is by him hath given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai ba u Belshassar u long syiem , nga la ioh ïa ka jingïohipaw kaba ar .
translation.en: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me , even unto me Daniel , after that which appeared unto me at the first .
Thy children shall make haste  ; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee .
translation.kha: Kito ki ban tei pat ïa pha kin sa wan shen , bad kito kiba pynjot ïa pha kin leit noh .

translation.en: The rich ruleth over the poor , and the borrower is servant to the lender .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duk ki long ki mraw jong u briew bariewspah , pan kylliang pisa bad phin long u mraw jong u nongai ram .
Ka jingïap jong u ka long na ka jingbakla jong u hi , namar um siewdor ïa ka jingmaham . Lada u la shahshkor un jingem da la lait im .
translation.en: He heard the sound of the trumpet , and took not warning  ; his blood shall be upon him . But he that taketh warning shall deliver his soul .
For our heart shall rejoice in him , because we have trusted in his holy name .
translation.kha: Ngi la kmen namar jong u , ngi shaniah ha ka kyrteng bakhuid jong u .
Ki nongshimwai ki la kem ïa ki mrad jong u , ki shohbeiñ ïa uwei , ki pynïap ïa uwei pat , bad ki la lyndet maw ïa uwei pat .
translation.en: And the husbandmen took his servants , and beat one , and killed another , and stoned another .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Ka Damaskos kan ym long shuh ka nongbud ; kan long tyngkan ka thup ki jingjot jingpra .
translation.en: The burden of Damascus . Behold , Damascus is taken away from being a city , and it shall be a ruinous heap .
And he had two wives  ; the name of the one was Hannah , and the name of the other Peninnah : and Peninnah had children , but Hannah had no children .
translation.kha: U Elkanah u don ar ngut ki tnga , ka Hannah bad ka Peninnah . Ka Peninnah ka don ki khun ki kti , hynrei ka Hannah kam shym la don khun .

Lada ka bhabriew kam tap ïa la ka khlieh , ka lah pun khapnoh ïa la u shñiuh . Bad namar ba ka longkmie kaba ikhlem-akor ïa ka briew don khi ïa la ka khleh ne khap ïa la u shñiuh , ka dei ban tap ïa la ka khlieh .
translation.en: For if the woman be not covered , let her also be shorn : but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven , let her be covered .

translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , U Trai u la bthah ïa de ban leit pat sha ka Ïuphratis bad shim ïa ki pyllun lyngkot .
translation.en: And it came to pass after many days , that the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , go to Euphrates , and take the girdle from thence , which I commanded thee to hide there .

translation.kha: Te paila uno uno u ïabun ban ïathuhlypa , u kpa bad ka kmie jong u hi kin ong ïa u ba u dei ban shah pynïap , namar u la kam ba u kriah ïa ka ktien jong U Trai , hynrei u kriah pynban ïa ki jinglamler . Haba u ïathuhlypa , u kpa bad ka kmie jong u kin dung pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that when any shall yet prophesy , then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him , Thou shalt not live  ; for thou speakest lies in the name of the  Lord  : and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth .
And also unto the Levites  ; they shall no more carry the tabernacle , nor any vessels of it for the service thereof .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Lebi kim donkam shuh ban kit ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  bad ïa ki tiar baroh ïa kiba la pyndonkam ha ka jingmane .

Hato phim don la ka jong ka ïing ban ïabam ïadih ? Lane hato Phi da kwah ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ka basngur U Blei bad ban pynïakren ïa ki briew kiba kyrduh ? Kaei ba phi ïakhmih lynti ïa nga ban ino ha phoi shaïong kaei ? Hato ngan ïaroh ïa Phin ? Em , lang ym lai donkam!
translation.en: What ? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in ? or despise ye the church of God , and shame them that have not ? What shall I say to you ? shall I praise you in this ? I praise you not .
What are the questions ?
translation.kha: Kiei ki jingkylli ?
U uno uba shoh ïa phi u shoh ïa ithuh uba kordit eh ha nga . Kumta U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa nga lem bad kane ka khubor ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba la lute ïa ki briew jong u :
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; After the glory hath he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you : for he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye .
They that tarry long at the wine  ; they that go to seek mixed wine .
translation.kha: Ki khmat jong u kiba saw snam , bad u don ki jingmong khlem daw .
nangta u phah noh ïa la ki hynmen , bad katba ki dang ïakhreh mih , u ainong , Wat ïakajia ha lynti .
translation.en: So he sent his brethren away , and they departed : and he said unto them , See that ye fall not out by the way .

translation.kha: haba ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u krai ha ka ktung Hebru , ki la kham sngap jar , bad u Apollos u la bteng :
translation.en: ( And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them , they kept the more silence : and he saith , )
Blessed is he that readeth , and they that hear the words of this prophecy , and keep those things which are written therein : for the time is at hand .
translation.kha: Suk uta uba pule ïa kane ka kitab , bad suk kito kiba shahshkor ïa ki ktien jong kane ka khubor jong ka jingïathuhlypa bad kiba kohnguh ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab ! Naba ka por ka la jan haba baroh kine kiei kiei kin sa jia .

translation.en: And when he was in the gate of Benjamin , a captain of the ward was there , whose name was Irijah , the son of Shelemiah , the son of Hananiah  ; and he took Jeremiah the prophet , saying , Thou fallest away to the Chaldeans .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba nga la poi ha ka Khyrdop Benjamin , u rangbah nongïalam uba dei khmih ïa ki shipai ba don ha ka kam hangta , u briew uba kyrteng u Irijah , u khun jong u Shelemaïah bad u ksiew jong u Hananaïah , u la pynsangeh ïa nga bad u la ong ,  Phi la phet noh ban ïasoh bad ki nong Babilonia !

translation.en: Let your conversation be without covetousness  ; and be content with such things as ye have : for he hath said , I will never leave thee , nor forsake thee .
translation.kha: Sumar bad kiar ïa la ka jingim na kaba ieit spah , bad sngewhun bad kita kiei kiei kiba phi don . Namar U Blei u la ong ,  Ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi , ngan ym kyntait ïa phi .

Hobah ki sharai kynthei jong ka Esther bad ki ïunukh ki ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei ka u Mordekai u ar , ka la shitom jingmut haduh katta katta . Ka phah sha u Marduk katto katne ki jaiñ ban phong ha ka tare ki jaiñ khihwin , hynrei um shym pdiang ïa ki .
translation.en: So Esther s maids and her chamberlains came and told it her . Then was the queen exceedingly grieved  ; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai , and to take away his sackcloth from him : but he received it not .

translation.kha: Ko Job , hato me la phla ïa ki pop jong me ha U Blei bad kular ban nym leh pop Shua ?
translation.en: Surely it is meet to be said unto God , I have borne chastisement , I will not offend any more :

translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab u Joshua u la khie bad lamwir ïa ki shipai . Nahath ma u Bad ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la ïalam ïa ki sha Ai .
translation.en: And Joshua rose up early in the morning , and numbered the people , and went up , he and the elders of Israel , before the people to Ai .

translation.kha: U Dabid , uba shu pien tang da ka jaiñ linen , u la shadkmen da ka bor jong u baroh ban burom ïa U Troas .
translation.en: And David danced before the  Lord  with all his might  ; and David was girded with a linen ephod .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u leit sha Baalgad Perasim bad hangta u la jop ïa ki Philistia . U ong , U Trai u la sar naphang lin ïa ki nongshun jong nga kum ka jinglehisynei um . Bad kumta ïa Katai ka khang la khot Abel Perasim .
translation.en: And David came to Baal–perazim , and David smote them there , and said , The  Lord  hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me , as the breach of waters . Therefore he called the name of that place Baal–perazim .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga kylli : ithuh ka long kaba shisha ba kim shym la ïohsngew ïa ka khlur ? Da shisha ki la ïohpdiang — naba kumba ka Jingkhot Bakhuid ka ong : Ka jingsawa jongngi ka sur jong ki ka la leit sha ka pyrthei baroh ; ki ktien jong ki , ki la pa shaduh kiba kut ka pyrthei .
translation.en: But I say , Have they not heard ? Yes verily , their sound went into all the earth , and their words unto the ends of the world .

translation.kha: To kyntiew , A Tiras , ba nga la shakri hok bad ïaineh ha me , bad ba nga la pyrshang borabor ban leh ïa katai kaba me kwah ïa nga banbeiñ leh , bad u sdang ban ïashang .
translation.en: And said , Remember now , O  Lord  , I beseech thee , how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart , and have done that which is good in thy sight . And Hezekiah wept sore .
What is written in the letter ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba Thoh ha ka Shithi ?

translation.en: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man , or by all thy people Israel , which shall know every man the plague of his own heart , and spread forth his hands toward this house :
translation.kha: to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki . Lada uno uno na ki briew jong me ki Israel , da kaba sngewkynduh ha la ka mynsiem , ki kner la ki kti ha ka jingduwai sha kane ka Templ , to sngap ïa ka jingduwai jong ki .

Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong na , nga la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban thoh sha phi shang ka jingpynim kaba ngi ïoh lang , haba nga la shem ïa ka jingdonkam ban thoiñ shisyndon ban pynjulor ïa phi , ban ïaleh na ka bynta ka jingngeit kaba U Blei u la ai shisien ai ha ki briew jong u .
translation.en: Beloved , when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation , it was needful for me to write unto you , and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints .

translation.kha: U Ahimelekh u Jobab , U Sabad u dei u rangbah pynïaidkam uba hok tam uba ph don ! U dei u pyrsa kurim Jong phi , u kapten jong ki shipai kba ïadei ïa phi , badno ïa uba la ñiewburom shikatdei eh da uwei pa uwei ha ka ïingsyiem jong phi .
translation.en: Then Ahimelech answered the king , and said , And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David , which is the king s son in law , and goeth at thy bidding , and is honourable in thine house ?

translation.kha: Khie leit bad rep ïa kata ka ri , phi ki Briew ha ki jaka buhai shnong ha Spain ! Ym don shuh mano mynshem ban ïada ïa ph .
translation.en: Pass through thy land as a river , O daughter of Tarshish : there is no more strength .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem naba khatsaw , u Khedorlaomer lem bad kita ki syiem kiba don ha ka liang jong u ki la wan jingset bad la ki shipai bad jop ïa ki Rephaim ha Ashteroth Karnaim , ïa ki syiem ha Ham , ïa ki Em ha ka pyntha jong ka Kiriathaim ,
translation.en: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer , and the kings that were with him , and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim , and the Zuzims in Ham , and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim ,
Wherefore Adoni–zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron , and unto Piram king of Jarmuth , and unto Japhia king of Lachish , and unto Debir king of Eglon , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta u Adonisedek u phah ïa kane ka khubor harum sha u Hoham u syiem ka Hebron , u Piram u syiem ka Jarmuth , u Japhia u syiem ka Lakhish , bad sha u Debir u syiem ka Eglon :

translation.en: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard , they have trodden my portion under foot , they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness .
translation.kha: Shibun ki nongsynshar nongwei ki la pynjot ïa ka bri sohwaiñ jong nga ; ki la ïuhroit ïa ki lyngkha jong nga ; ki la pynkylla ïa ka ri ba-itynnat jong nga sha ka ri shyiap .
( La don uwei pat u briew , u Uriah u khun jong u Shemaïah na Kiriath Jearim , kaba la kren ha ka kyrteng jongno U Trai pyrshah ïa kane ka nongbah bad ka jaitbynriew kumba u Jeremaïah u la leh .
translation.en: And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the  Lord  , Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath–jearim , who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah :
And they come unto him , bringing one sick of the palsy , which was borne of four .
translation.kha: haba saw ngut ki rangbah ki la poi , ki da rah ïa u briew uba pang ïapshiliang sha U Jisu .

translation.en: Therefore is judgment far from us , neither doth justice overtake us : we wait for light , but behold obscurity  ; for brightness , but we walk in darkness .
translation.kha: U paidlang u ong ,  Mynta ngi tip balei U Blei um pyllait ïa ngi na kito kiba banbeiñ ïa ngi . Ngi kyrmen ïa ka jingshai ban ïaid ryngkat , hynrei ka don tang ka jingdum ,

translation.en: Then Elisha said , Hear ye the word of the  Lord   ; Thus saith the  Lord  , To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel , and two measures of barley for a shekel , in the gate of Samaria .
translation.kha: U Elisha u jubab ,  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ! Kum ha kane ka por lashai ka sngi phin lah ban thied ha Samaria lai kilo u kew uba bha tam lane hynriew kilo u barli tang shi sbai rupa .

translation.en: And when they were by Jebus , the day was far spent  ; and the servant said unto his master , Come , I pray thee , and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites , and lodge in it .
translation.kha: Uta u briew um treh shuh ban sah ha kata ka miet , kumta ma u bad ka tnga kliar jong u ki sdang ïa ka jingleit jong ki , ryngkat bad u shakri jong ki bad kita ki kada ar tylli kiba kit jingkit ha ki jin . Ka sngi ka la jan sep haba ki wan poi hajan Jebus ( kata ka dei ka Jerusalem ) , kumta u shakri u ong ha la u kynrad ,  Balei ngim sangeh ban sahmiet ha kane ka nongbah ki Jebus ?
Te phin sa poi hajan ka ri ki Ammon , ki khup ki ksiew jong u Lum . “Wat pynjynjar ïa ki lane ïaleh thma bad ki , Namar ngan ym ai ei ei ïa Phin na dat ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha ki .’
translation.en: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon , distress them not , nor meddle with them : for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession  ; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession .

translation.kha: Naba don sian , khim kiba la kylla na ka Niam Jiw , kiba ïaleh pyrshah bad kiba shukor ïa kiaw da ka jingleh bym don jingmut jong ki .
translation.en: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers , specially they of the circumcision :

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki shihajar snem ki la khup , yn ïapyllait ïa u Soitan na ka bakhyndai jong u ,
translation.en: And when the thousand years are expired , Satan shall be loosed out of his prison ,
And he brake down the houses of the sodomites , that were by the house of the  Lord  , where the women wove hangings for the grove .
translation.kha: U pynjot ïa ki jaka ha ka Templ , ha kiba ju shong ki nuti ka Templ . ( Ka dei hangta ba ki kynthei ki ju thain ïa ki barandi kiba ju pyndonkam ha kaba mane ïa ka Asherah . )

Kumta u pyntong ïa ngi ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong u bad shah jynjar ïa ka jingshyrkhei ka thma . Kum ka ding ka jingbitar jong u ka meh kylleng ka Israel , hynrei jingtem ju tap aïu ka jhieh ; ngim shym ïoh jinghikai satia ei ei na ka .
translation.en: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger , and the strength of battle : and it hath set him on fire round about , yet he knew not  ; and it burned him , yet he laid it not to heart .

translation.kha: Hynrei kaei naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shaphang ka jingïada bad U Blei lyngba ka jingngeit ka long kane : Phim dei ban kyrhai ïa lade , utai u baneh leit shaei bneng ? ( Kata ka long , pun wallam ïa U Khrist shiah tbian ) .
translation.en: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise , Say not in thine heart , Who shall ascend into heaven ? ( that is , to bring Christ down from above : )

translation.kha: Kiwei pateng ki briew ki erlangthari Kum ki rymbai ba la bet hapdeng ki bniap shiah . Kine ki long kita kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ,
translation.en: And these are they which are sown among thorns  ; such as hear the word ,

translation.kha: Wat map ïa kaba sniew kaba ki leh bad wat kliang ïa ki pop jong ki , namar ba ki la pynlehrain ïa ngi kiba dang ïatei .
translation.en: And cover not their iniquity , and let not their sin be blotted out from before thee : for they have provoked thee to anger before the builders .
And the idols he shall utterly abolish .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsarong ba kynja briew yn pynkut bad ïa ka jinglehmeng ki briew yn pynjot . Ki bleithaw kin jah noh plain , bad tang ïa U  Trai  yn kyntiew burom ha kata ka sngi .
Ki Briew kiba riewspah ki ju pyrkhat borabor ba ki long kiba stad , hynrei u briew uba duk , uba don ka jingsngewthuh shapoh ka jinglongbriew u tip kham bha .
translation.en: The rich man is wise in his own conceit  ; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out .

translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki kynthih Ibbah da ka ksiar nylla ba la jyrthiaw kum u tyllai na ka bynta kata ka jingdeng shadem .
translation.en: And thou shalt make upon the breastplate chains at the ends of wreathen work of pure gold .

translation.kha: U Trai’ u la bthah ïa nga ban ong ha ki briew jong u , ibha du uno u kyllon , hato un ym ïeng pat ? Lada uno uno u bakla lynti , hato un ym wan peiñ pat ?
translation.en: Moreover thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Shall they fall , and not arise ? shall he turn away , and not return ?
And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee .
translation.kha: Kumta u la ïalap ha ki synagog ha kylleng ka ri .

translation.en: And he said to Jeroboam , Take thee ten pieces : for thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , Behold , I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon , and will give ten tribes to thee :
translation.kha: bad u ong ha u Jeroboam ,  Shim shiphew lyngkhot ha lade , namar U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ïa me , ‘ Ngan knieh noh ïa ka hima na u Solomon , bad ngan ai ha me shiphew jait .

translation.en: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads , neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard .
translation.kha: Wat khap ïa u shñiuh ha ki kynriang ka khlieh jong phi lane khih ïa ki tmain
Nga salia aïu ïa ka jingiwbih kiba ki wallam ïa nga na Sheba , lin ki mut na ka ri bajngai ? Ngan ym pdiang ïa ki jingiaseng jong ki lane ban sngewbha ha ki jingkñia jong ki .
translation.en: To what purpose cometh there to me incense from Sheba , and the sweet cane from a far country ? your burnt offerings are not acceptable , nor your sacrifices sweet unto me .

And they spake unto him , saying , No  ; but we will bind thee fast , and deliver thee into their hand : but surely we will not kill thee . And they bound him with two new cords , and brought him up from the rock .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , to  ki ong ,  ngin shu teh ïa me bad aiti ïa me ha ki . Ngin ym pynïap ïa me .  Kumta ki khum ïa u da ar tylli ki tyllai thymmai bad ki wanrah ïa u na kata ka krem .
Ki la sdang ban ïakren para ma ki hi , U ong ïa kane namar ngim shym la wanrah jingbam ei ei .
translation.en: And they reasoned among themselves , saying , It is because we have taken no bread .

translation.kha: Kham stet ban ïa ki pukni naba suh wia na sahit bneng , ki beh kthong ïa ngi shuh tbian . Ki lap ïa ngi ha ki lumrit ; ki kurup ïa ngi ha ka jingdeng ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven : they pursued us upon the mountains , they laid wait for us in the wilderness .

translation.kha: U Tlai u da kyrkhu pahara ïa ka Hannah , badno ka ïoh sa lai ngut ki khun shynrang bad ar ngut ki khun kynïan . Ulla u khynnah Samuel , u na san ha ka shakri ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And the  Lord  visited Hannah , so that she conceived , and bare three sons and two daughters . And the child Samuel grew before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Pynkup ïa u Araunah da ki jaiñphong lyngdoh , pynsleh ïa u , bad da kane pynkyntang ïa u , ba u lah ban sharati ïa nga koum u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And thou shalt put upon Aaron the holy garments , and anoint him , and sanctify him  ; that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .
Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened ? or who laid the corner stone thereof  ;
translation.kha: Mano ba bat ïa ki rishot kiba kyrshan ïa ka khyndew ? Mano ba buh ïa u mawdong jong ka pyrthei ?

Haba u briew u leh nongpop ha kano Kanah na Kinah , u dei ban siew pat ïa kata baroh kaba u la ïoh da ki lad bymneh . Ha Katai ka sngi ba la lap ba u la leh pum , u dei ban pynphai pura sha u trai , lem bad arphew bynta na ka shispah .
translation.en: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely  ; he shall even restore it in the principal , and shall add the fifth part more thereto , and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth , in the day of his trespass offering .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ka Jerusalem ïa kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ha ka : La kha ïa pha ha ka ri Kanah . U kpa jong pha u dei u nong Amor bad ka Kmen jong pha ka dei ka nong skud .
translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God  unto Jerusalem  ; Thy birth and thy nativity is of the land of Canaan  ; thy father was an Amorite , and thy mother an Hittite .
Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave . It was a cave , and a stone lay upon it .
translation.kha: Haba la ktah jur sa shisien , U Jisu u la leit sha ka jingtep , kaba long ka krem ba la khang da u mawkhang .
Shebuel shibun ba phoi la ai para ban peit bniah ïa kane ka kot lyngkdop khnang ban tip shaphang ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah , ïa ki kam jong ngi , bad ïa ki jingtreikam ka seng jongnga ngi .
translation.en: Thank you for taking the time to examine this brochure in order to familiarize yourself with Jehovah’s Witnesses as a people , to learn about our activities , and to see our organization in action .
And Jethro , Moses  father in law , took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God : and Aaron came , and all the elders of Israel , to eat bread with Moses  father in law before God .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jethro u la wanrah ïa ka jingainguh ban thang tylli bad ïa kiwei kiwei de ki jingainguh ban ai jingkñia sha U Blei ; bad u Aaron lem bad nongïalam jong ki Israel baroh ki la ïaleit bad u ban bam ïa ka jingbam kaba kyntang kum ka dak ka jingmane ïa U Blei .
Hynrei lada phim pyndik , te ïa kane ka nongap yn aiti noh! sha ki nong Babilonia , ki ban sa thang duh ïa ka , bad phna ym lait im na ki .
translation.en: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon s princes , then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans , and they shall burn it with fire , and thou shalt not escape out of their hand .

translation.kha: Te ka ri kan ïoh lehkmen ha ki snem ka jingshongthait kaba pura ha kaba phin ym ai ei ei ïa ka ; kad long kaba la iehnoh bad Kan ïor shongthait , katba phi dong don ha ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki nongshun jong phi .
translation.en: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest  ; because it did not rest in your sabbaths , when ye dwelt upon it .
Now the just shall live by faith : but if any man draw back , my soul shall have no pleasure in him .
translation.kha: La katta ruh , ki briew jong nga kiba hok kin ngeit bad kin im ; hynrei lada uno uno na ki u phai dien ngan ym sngewbha shuh ïa u .

Kynsan U Trai u phah ïa ka ding , bad ka bam duh ïa ka jingkñia ieit thang bad ïa ki bynta bakhleiñ baroh ha ka duwan . Haba ki paidbah ki ioh ïa kata , ki la ïa-pyrta jam , bad ki ïadem ngon haduh khyndew .
translation.en: And there came a fire out from before the  Lord  , and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat : which when all the people saw , they shouted , and fell on their faces .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u mynsiem , Sngap jar bad mihnoh na ine u briew !
translation.en: And Jesus rebuked him , saying ,  Hold thy peace , and come out of him .

translation.kha: To put ïa ka turoi ha kylleng ka ri ! To pyrta jam Bad shaei kdar ! Ïathuh ha ki bariew jong ka Judas bad Jesreel ban phet sha ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh .
translation.en: Declare ye in Judah , and publish in Jerusalem  ; and say , Blow ye the trumpet in the land : cry , gather together , and say , Assemble yourselves , and let us go into the defenced cities .

translation.kha: Hynrei kam lama tang kumta ; I lehkmen na ka bynta katai kaweh U balui u la leh lyngba U Jisu Khrist kaba U Trai jong ngi , uba mynta u la pynlong ïa ngi ki paralok jong U Blei .
translation.en: And not only so , but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ , by whom we have now received the atonement .

translation.kha: ibha ki kti u Moses ki la sakhrai , u Aaron bad u Hur ki rah uwei u maw ba un shong , katba ma ki pat ki ïeng ha synduk jong u , uwei sha kadiang bad uwei pat sha kamon , malu ki kyrshan ïa ki kti jong u , ki da kyrshan slem ïa ki kumne haduh banbeiñ da sep ka sngi .
translation.en: But Moses  hands were heavy  ; and they took a stone , and put it under him , and he sat thereon  ; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands , the one on the one side , and the other on the other side  ; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun .

translation.kha: Ma phi , kum ki kpa tymmen jong phi ha shuwa lad phi , phi la phai noh na ki aiñ jong nga bad phim shym la sum ïa ki . To pha pat sha nga , bad ngan phai sha phi . Hynrei phi kylli , ‘ Khie ba ngi dei ban leh ban phai pat shwa me ?’
translation.en: Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances , and have not kept them . Return unto me , and I will return unto you , saith the  Lord  of hosts . But ye said , Wherein shall we return ?

translation.kha: Nga la duh baroh ka jingkyrmen , te yn lei lada U Blang u pynïap noh ïa nga ? Ngan leit ba-bang ïasaid ïa ka kam jong nga ha u .
translation.en: Though he slay me , yet will I trust in him : but I will maintain mine own ways before him .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynsah katto katne na ki bad phah ïa ki sha ki jaitbynriew bad sha ki ri kiba jingaiei ki me pat shym la ïohsngew ïa ka ngam jong nga lymne ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw bad ka bor jong nga : sha Spain , shaei Libya bun sha Lydia , ryngkat dara ki nongrah ryntieh kba tbit , bad sha Tubal bad sha Gris . Hapdeng kine ki jaitbynriew kin pynthaba ïa ka jingproh jong nga .
translation.en: And I will set a sign among them , and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations , to Tarshish , Pul , and Lud , that draw the bow , to Tubal , and Javan , to the isles afar off , that have not heard my fame , neither have seen my glory  ; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles .
But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you : for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another .
translation.kha: Ym da donkam ban thoh sha phi shaphang ka jingïa-ieit ïa ki parabangeit jong phi . Ma phi hi phi long kiba la ïoh hikai na U Blei kumno phi dei ban ieit iwei ïa iwei pat .
Te mynta , lada phin kohnguh ïa nga dara sumar ïa ka jutang jong ang , pien Long ki briew jong nga . Ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka long ka jong nga , bad phi pat phin long ki briew kiba nga la jied ,
translation.en: Now therefore , if ye will obey my voice indeed , and keep my covenant , then ye shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people : for all the earth is mine :
The slothful man saith , There is a lion without , I shall be slain in the streets .
translation.kha: U briew uba alhia u shong hapoh ïing ; u ong ba u sing u lah ban ïoh ïa u lada u mih shabar .
Kumba nga la pyllait im ïa ka jingim jong phi ha kane ka sngi , ai ba U Trai un ar kumjuh ïa nga Bad pyllun ïa nga na ki jingjynjar jngai nga baroh !
translation.en: And , behold , as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes , so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the  Lord  , and let him deliver me out of all tribulation .

And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron , Because ye believed me not , to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel , therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la sneng tyngeh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron . U ong  Namar ba phim don ka jingngeit kaba skhem ban pynpaw ïa ka bor bakhuid jong nga ha khmat ki paid Israel , phin ym ïoh ban ïalam ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ban ai ha ki .

translation.en: For he said , Because the  Lord  hath sworn that the  Lord  will have war with Amalek from generation to generation .
translation.kha: U ong ruh ,  Rah shajrong ïa ka lama U  Trai  ! U  Trai  un ïai ïaleh ïa ki Amalek junom !

translation.en: And he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the way of his father , and in the way of his mother , and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin :
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh basniew jong u Ahab u kpa jong u , ka Jesebel ka kmie jong u , bad jong u syiem Jeroboam , kiba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
Ka Martha ka la ong ïa U Jisu , Lada men jin da la don hangne , ko Trai , u para jong na un ym jin da la ïap !
translation.en: Then said Martha unto Jesus , Lord , if thou hadst been here , my brother had not died .

translation.kha: Nga la kylli , Sa katno kuna long kumne , ko Trai ? U la jubab , Tad khah ba ki nongbah kin jot kin pra bad long thylli — den haduh ba ki ïing kin long ïingjah — tad haduh ba ka ri hi kuna long ka jaka thylli kaba kynjah .
translation.en: Then said I , Lord , how long ? And he answered , Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant , and the houses without man , and the land be utterly desolate ,

translation.kha: Kaba u dang bet ïa u symbai ha ka lyngkha , khyndiat na u symbai u la hap ha lynter ka lynti ïaid kjat , bad ki sim ki la wan bad bam noh .
translation.en: And when he sowed , some seeds fell by the way side , and the fowls came and devoured them up :

translation.kha: Ki jingïohipaw ba phi ïohi ki long ki bymdei , bad ki jingïathuh lymda ba phi pyningkhong ki long kiba shukor . Phi longkmie kiba bymman bad kiba sngew , bad ka sngi jong phi ka la wan , ka sngi jong ka jingpynjot kaba kut . Ka thnam kan khup ha ki ryndang jong Phi .
translation.en: Whiles they see vanity unto thee , whiles they divine a lie unto thee , to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain , of the wicked , whose day is come , when their iniquity shall have an end .
How many are the days of thy servant ? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me ?
translation.kha: Slem sa katno nga dei ban ap ? Lano men pynshitom ïa kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga ?
U Ephraim u don sa ar ngut ki khun shynrang nalor u Shaul : u Eser bad u Elead , kiba la shahshkor pynsep haba ki la pynjrong ban tuh ïa ki jingri kiba dei jong ki traishnong jong ka Gath .
translation.en: And Zabad his son , and Shuthelah his son , and Ezer , and Elead , whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew , because they came down to take away their cattle .
And he called the multitude , and said unto them ,  Hear , and understand :
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la khot ïa ki paidbah sha u bad u la ong ha ki ,  To shahshkor bad to shemphang !

translation.en: There is no fear in love  ; but perfect love casteth out fear : because fear hath torment . He that feareth is not made perfect in love .
translation.kha: Ym don ka jingsheptieng ha ka jingieit ; ka jingieit kaba janai ka beh noh ïa ka jingsheptieng baroh . Kumta te , ïa ka jingieit ym shym la pynjanai ha uno uno uba sheptieng , namar ka jingsheptieng ka don jingïadei bad ka jingpynshitom .

translation.en: That made the world as a wilderness , and destroyed the cities thereof  ; that opened not the house of his prisoners ?

translation.en: Beside their genealogy of males , from three years old and upward , even unto every one that entereth into the house of the  Lord  , his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses  ;

translation.en: And if so be that he find it , verily I say unto you , he rejoiceth more of that sheep , than of the ninety and nine which went not astray .

translation.kha: Phi lah ïa-ban bud ïa ki jingmlien jong ki bad phin ym lah shuh ïa-ban kyllan .
translation.en: Lest thou learn his ways , and get a snare to thy soul .

translation.en: Now among these were of the children of Judah , Daniel , Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah :

translation.kha: Baroh kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im , ki don mar hynriew tylli ki thapniang , bad ïa ki la tap da ki khmat , shapoh bad shabar . translation.en: The high places also of Aven , the sin of Israel , shall be destroyed : the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars  ; and they shall say to the mountains , Cover us  ; and to the hills , Fall on us .

translation.en: And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other .

translation.kha: Kam lili lei , hikai ïa de ; ïathuh ha nga ïa ki jingbakla jrong la . Ngan sngap jar bad shahshkor ïa phi .
translation.en: Teach me , and I will hold my tongue : and cause me to understand wherein I have erred .

Nga kyiuh bad sngew syier ; ka met jong nga baroh kawei ka khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: Fear came upon me , and trembling , which made all my bones to shake .

translation.en: And he said , Let me go , for the day breaketh . And he said , I will not let thee go , except thou bless me .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Pharaoh would hardly let us go , that the  Lord  slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both the firstborn of man , and the firstborn of beast : therefore I sacrifice to the  Lord  all that openeth the matrix , being males  ; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem .

translation.kha: Ki Jiw ki don ki Aiñ shaphang ka jinglehniam haba sait pynkhuid , bad na ka bynta kane ka jingthmu la don hynriew tylli ki khra-maw buh um , uwei iwei u ngiam kumba shispah litar ka um .
translation.en: And there were set there six waterpots of stone , after the manner of the purifying of the Jews , containing two or three firkins apiece .

translation.kha: Kumno re kumno pat , u shipai Sior u siat ïa u khnam uba dei ïa u skhem Abib hapdeng ka jaka bapyndait ïa ka jingkhein atiar jong u . Nga la mynsaw ! u pyrta shwa u nongñiah ka kali ïapom jong u . Phai nep bad phet noh na ka thma !
translation.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture , and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness : therefore he said to his chariot man , Turn thine hand , that thou mayest carry me out of the host  ; for I am wounded .

translation.kha: Ngan pyntylli ïa ki kum kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ka ri , halor ki lumbah ka Israel ; kin don tang aiwai u syiem u ban synshar halor Jong ki , bad kin ym hir shuh ka jingïaphiah ha ki ar ki jaitbynriew lane ïabynta ha ki ar tylli ki hima .
translation.en: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel  ; and one king shall be king to them all : and they shall be no more two nations , neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all :

translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad kito ki nongïathuhlypa kim don shuh .

translation.en: Forsake the foolish , and live  ; and go in the way of understanding .

translation.en: All nations before him are as nothing  ; and they are counted to him less than nothing , and vanity .

translation.en: Now after two days he departed thence , and went into Galilee .

translation.en: Again , I considered all travail , and every right work , that for this a man is envied of his neighbour . This is also vanity and vexation of spirit .

translation.en: And , behold , a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts , and cried unto him , saying , Have mercy on me , O Lord , thou Son of David  ; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil .

translation.en: And all king Solomon s drinking vessels were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold  ; none were of silver : it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon .
And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life : and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood .

Ki lai ban ai jingtngen bad kdew lynti ha ki por bajynjar .—Jakob 5 :14-16 ; 1 Petros 5 :2 , 3 .
translation.en: They can provide comfort and guidance in times of trouble .—James 5 :14-16  ; 1 Peter 5 :2 , 3 .

translation.en: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass , drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem .

translation.en: Then shall ye know that I am the  Lord  , when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars , upon every high hill , in all the tops of the mountains , and under every green tree , and under every thick oak , the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols .

translation.kha: U Solomon u la tei biang ïa Kine ki nongbah : ka Beth Horon Neng bad ka Beth Sharon kamra , ( ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh bad ki khyrdop kiba lah ban khang ) ,
translation.en: Also he built Beth–horon the upper , and Beth–horon the nether , fenced cities , with walls , gates , and bars  ;

translation.en: But his citizens hated him , and sent a message after him , saying , We will not have this man to reign over us .

translation.en: Then said Saul to his armourbearer , Draw thy sword , and thrust me through therewith  ; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me . But his armourbearer would not  ; for he was sore afraid . So Saul took a sword , and fell upon it .

Hynrei namar ba phi la pyn-i ïa Kum kane ka jingñiewbeiñ ïa U Trai ha kaba leh ïa kane , u khun jong phi un ïaphah .
translation.en: Howbeit , because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the  Lord  to blaspheme , the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die .

translation.kha: To U Blei ibha U Kpa bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha ki parabangeit baroh ïa ka jingsuh Bad ka jingieit da ka jingieit .
translation.en: Peace be to the brethren , and love with faith , from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Ka kham ibha ban longsem uba kun hynrei babha beit ïa-ban ïa kaba longïng u ibit uba sukher .
translation.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity , than he that is perverse in his lips , and is a fool .

translation.en: Son of man , behold , I take away from thee the desire of thine eyes with a stroke : yet neither shalt thou mourn nor weep , neither shall thy tears run down .

translation.en: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna : and it was like coriander seed , white  ; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Dabid u rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Kyndong Ryngkat U Trai , u shong bad u ïadie , Nangne long uba dei hok ïa kaei kaweh me la lah leh na ka bynta jongngi at , ko Trai U Blei , lane ka longïing jngai nga .

translation.en: Even a fool , when he holdeth his peace , is counted wise : and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding .

translation.en: Was the  Lord  displeased against the rivers ? was thine anger against the rivers ? was thy wrath against the sea , that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation ?
translation.kha: Hato la dei ki wah kiba la pynlong ïa me ban bitar , A  Trai  ! Hato la dei ka duriaw kaba la pynlong ïa me ban bitar shla ? Me shong kulai halor ki lyoh ; u lyoh ka  erïong u la long ka kali ïapom jong me , mynba me la wallam jingjop ha la ki briew .

Ha kaba wai noh , ko parabangeit jong nga , to pynap ïa ki jingman jrong phi da kito kiei kai kiba ba bad kita kiba dei ïaroh : kaei kiei kiba shisha , kiba donburom , bakha beit , kiba khuid , kiba itynnat , bad kiba donburom .
translation.en: Finally , brethren , whatsoever things are true , whatsoever things are honest , whatsoever things are just , whatsoever things are pure , whatsoever things are lovely , whatsoever things are of good report ; if there be any virtue , and if there be any praise , think on these things .

translation.kha: U Trai u soi ïa u Ussaïah da ka jingpang sniehdoh kob shyrkhei kaba la sah dara u shi lynter ka jingshim jong u . U sah hi marwei ha la ka jong ka ïing , la pyllait ïa u na ki kamram baroh , katba u Jotham u khulom jong u , u pynïaid ïa ka hima .
translation.en: And the  Lord  smote the king , so that he was a leper unto the day of his death , and dwelt in a several house . And Jotham the king s son was over the house , judging the people of the land .
