translation.en: But as for you , turn you , and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea .

translation.en: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning , which is for a continual burnt offering .

translation.en: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands , and that he was come from God , and went to God  ;
And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , the top thereof , and the sides thereof round about , and the horns thereof  ; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about .

translation.en: Wherefore hast thou despised the commandment of the  Lord  , to do evil in his sight ? thou hast killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword , and hast taken his wife to be thy wife , and hast slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon .

translation.en: And he made an house of high places , and made priests of the lowest of the people , which were not of the sons of Levi .
Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think , according to the power that worketh in us ,

translation.en: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah–jireh : as it is said to this day , In the mount of the  Lord  it shall be seen .

translation.kha: To beh kthong ïa ki sad ñiad noh ïa ki na ka khyndew !
translation.en: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the  Lord .

translation.en: And they said unto him , We can . And Jesus said unto them ,  Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of  ; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized :

translation.kha: Ka la leit sha ka ïing jong u Sekharaïah bad ka la khublei ïa ka Elisabeth .

translation.en: And when the living creatures went , the wheels went by them : and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth , the wheels were lifted up .

translation.en: And if the latter husband hate her , and write her a bill of divorcement , and giveth it in her hand , and sendeth her out of his house  ; or if the latter husband die , which took her to be his wife  ;

translation.en: And certain of the chief of Asia , which were his friends , sent unto him , desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre .

translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane katba nga dang don badno phi .
translation.en: These things have I spoken unto you , being yet present with you .
And the people answered and said , God forbid that we should forsake the  Lord  , to serve other gods  ;
translation.kha: U paidbah u jubab ,  Da lei lei ngin ym iehnoh ïa U  Trai  ban shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei !

Phi la sah hangne tang khyndiat por , kumjuh balei ngan pynlong ïa phi don ïada sakma kylleng bad nga ? Ngam tip shano Ngan wait . Khie leit phai noh bad ïalam bad phi ïa la ki Jong ki briew — bad to U Trai un lehsbun bad ïaineh bad phira .
translation.en: Whereas thou camest but yesterday , should I this day make thee go up and down with us ? seeing I go whither I may , return thou , and take back thy brethren : mercy and truth be with thee .
For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uwei pa uwei uba khot kyrpad ïa U Trai ban ïoh jingïarap , un ïohlait im .
ngin shaw na kine ki briew , bad ngan pynjot taiew ïa ki hangto hi . Baroh ar ngut ki la de khrup ha khyndew ,
translation.en: Get you up from among this congregation , that I may consume them as in a moment . And they fell upon their faces .

translation.kha: Leh ïa kiei kaba U Trai u ïong ba ka long kaweh dei bad kaba bha , te phin manbha . Phin sa ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba stong ïa kaba U Trai u la kular ha ki kpa thymmai jong phi ,
translation.en: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the  Lord  : that it may be well with thee , and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers ,

translation.kha: Wat shuwa Ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei , U Blei u la jied lypa ïa ngi ban long ki jongki u ha U Khrist , khnang ba ngin ïoh long kiba khuid bad kiba Khlem shah kynnoh pop ha khmih jyllang u .
translation.en: According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world , that we should be holy and without blame before him in love :

translation.kha: To kynmaw , A tharai , ba per la shakri hok bad ïaineh ha me , bad ba nga la jingpyrshang borabor ban leh ïa kaei kaba me kwah ïa nga ban leh , bad u sdang ban khanatang .
translation.en: And said , Remember now , O  Lord  , I beseech thee , how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart , and have done that which is good in thy sight . And Hezekiah wept sore .

translation.kha: Uno uno na ki jaitbynriew barben sawdong jong phalang uba dei ïaid lynti un rkhiebeiñ ïa pha bad un kiar na pha .
translation.en: Moreover I will make thee waste , and a reproach among the nations that are round about thee , in the sight of all that pass by .
My days are past , my purposes are broken off , even the thoughts of my heart .
translation.kha: Ki sngi jong nga ki la nang ïaid ; ki jingthmu jong nga kim shym urlong ; ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka la duh noh .
Ko khun , to sngewkynduh ïa kaei ba nga hikai ïa phi , bad wat klet ïa kaei kaba nga ïathuh ïa phi pun kun .
translation.en: My son , if thou wilt receive my words , and hide my commandments with thee  ;

translation.kha: Hato ngam don ka hok ban ni katba nga sngewbit ïa la ka jong ka pisa ? Ne phi ïa-bishni namarba ba nga long uba bsuh ?’
translation.en: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own ? Is thine eye evil , because I am good ?

translation.kha: U briew uba ïalam bakla ïano ïano bad nangto u nang ba u shu biria u un-long Kum u briew uba lamwir uba ïalehkai bad ka tiar kaba pynïap .
translation.en: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour , and saith , Am not I in sport ?

translation.kha: Ka jingangnud jyllang la borabor ka long ban pynnep ïa ka Khubor Baalah ha ki iaki ha kiba ïa U Khrist ym pat shym la jingsngewsih , khnang ba ym tei halor ka nongrim ba la seng da kiwei patar .
translation.en: Yea , so have I strived to preach the gospel , not where Christ was named , lest I should build upon another man s foundation :

translation.kha: Ha ki hynriew snieh , ma nga , U Trai , nga la tiduh ïa ka bna , ïa ka khyndew , ïa ka duriaw , bad ïa kiei kiew baroh’ kiba don ha ki , Hynrei ha ka sngi katba ingiew nga la shongthait . Namar kata , ang U tharai , nga la kyrkhu ïa ka Sabbaton , dara nga la pynkyntang khuid ïa ka .
translation.en: For in six days the  Lord  made heaven and earth , the sea , and all that in them is , and rested the seventh day : wherefore the  Lord  blessed the sabbath day , and hallowed it .
I love them that love me  ; and those that seek me early shall find me .
translation.kha: Nga ieit ïa kito kiba ieit ïa nga ; kita kiba wad ïa nga kin shem ïa nga .
Em , ym kumta ! Bad nga ong ïa phi ba lada phim phai noh na ki pop jong phi , phi barieh phin ïap kum ma ki .
translation.en: I tell you , Nay : but , except ye repent , ye shall all likewise perish .

Speak unto the children of Israel , and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations , and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue :
translation.kha: ban ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Shna ki ksai jyrthiaw ha ki dong jaiñkup jong phi bad buh ïa u ksai uba jngum ha uwei uwei u jyrthiaw . Phi dei ban leh ïa kane shi lynter .
Pha la ñiewbeiñ ïa ka jingai jingmut jong at barben , bad phim “mon ba ngan pynbeit ïa phi .
translation.en: But ye have set at nought all my counsel , and would none of my reproof :
Now therefore , our God , we thank thee , and praise thy glorious name .
translation.kha: Mynta ko Blei jong ngi , ngi ainguh ïa me , bad ngi ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng kaba donburom jong me .

translation.en: This is the interpretation , O king , and this is the decree of the most High , which is come upon my lord the king :
translation.kha: Kane , te , ka long kaei ba ka mut , ko Syiem Kynrad , bad kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la pynbna ba kan jia ha phi .

translation.en: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart , and be no more stiffnecked .
translation.kha: Kumta , naduh mynta , kohnguh ïa U  Trai  , bad wat long shuh kiba mutlop .
malu u la ai hukum ïa ki don ym ïathuh ha kiwei pud shaphrang jong u .
translation.en: And charged them that they should not make him known :
And the second came , saying , Lord , thy pound hath gained five pounds .
translation.kha: U shakri uba ar u la wan bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga la kamai san tylli ki sbai ksiar na kawei kaba me la ai ha nga .’
Wallam ïa u syiem Haggai hangne ha nga , u Samuel u hukum . U Agag u la woh sha u da kaba khynñiuh da ka jingtieng , u da pyrkhat ha lade , Katno ka long kob kthang ban ïap .
translation.en: Then said Samuel , Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites . And Agag came unto him delicately . And Agag said , Surely the bitterness of death is past .

translation.kha: Kum ka ding ki bah duh ïa ki jingthung . Ha khmat jong ki ka ri ka longsem kum ka kper Eden , hynrei sha lynti jongno ki ka long ka ri shyiap shrah . Ym don kano Kana naba lait im na ki .
translation.en: A fire devoureth before them  ; and behind them a flame burneth : the land is as the garden of Eden before them , and behind them a desolate wilderness  ; yea , and nothing shall escape them .

translation.kha: Kumta ha “kata ka sngem ki la kmen shikatdei katba ki ïabam ïadih ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai . Ha ka sien kaba ar ki la thung syiem ïa u Solomon . Ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ki la pynsleh ïa u kum u nongsynshar jong ki bad ïa u Sadok kum u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And did eat and drink before the  Lord  on that day with great gladness . And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time , and anointed him unto the  Lord  to be the chief governor , and Zadok to be priest .
And Hagar bare Abram a son : and Abram called his son s name , which Hagar bare , Ishmael .
translation.kha: Bad ka Hagar ka la ïoh khun shynrang na u Abram , bad u la kyrteng ïa u , u Ishmael .

translation.en: And this word , Yet once more , signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken , as of things that are made , that those things which cannot be shaken may remain .
translation.kha: Ki ktien  sa shisien pat  ki pyn-i shai ba ïa kiei kiei kiba la thaw yn pynkhynñiuh bad yn weng noh , khnang ba ïa kiei kiei ki bym lah ban pynkhynñiuh yn pynneh .

translation.en: And they turned thitherward , and came to the house of the young man the Levite , even unto the house of Micah , and saluted him .
translation.kha: Kumta ki leit sha ïing u Mikah , ha kaba u samla Lebi u sah , bad ki kylli ïa u Lebi kumno u long u man .
U Jisu uba na Nasareth u sdang ïaid nangne , ki la ïathuh ïa u .
translation.en: And they told him , that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by .

translation.kha: ngan ai ha me ïa ki shabi jong ka Hima ki bneng , kaei kaba me khang ha ka pyrthei yn khang ïa ka ha bneng , bad katei kaba me shah ha ka pyrthei yn shah ïa ka ha bneng .
translation.en: And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven : and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven : and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven .

translation.kha: Ha u khyllung u ieh , ka longsem ka ba eh da shisha ia ka kmie .
translation.en: When a child dies , it is particularly hard for the mother .
For a certain man named Demetrius , a silversmith , which made silver shrines for Diana , brought no small gain unto the craftsmen  ;
translation.kha: Uwei u bania uba kyrteng u Demetrios uba la thaw ïa ki dur templ jong ka blei Artemis da ka rupa , bad ka kam jong u ka la pynïohnong shibun eh ïa ki nongtrei .

translation.en: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls  ; every several gate was of one pearl : and the street of the city was pure gold , as it were transparent glass .
translation.kha: Ki khat-ar tylli ki khyrdop ki la long ki khat-ar tylli ki mawlynnai ; ïa kawei kawei ka khyrdop la shna na uwei u mawlynnai . Ka lynti bah jong ka nongbah ka la long da ka ksiar nylla , kaba lah ban ïohi lyngba kum ka ïit .

translation.en: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka waiñ , kaba rim bad kaba thymmai ruh , ka pyntlot ïa ka bor pyrkhat ki briew jong nga !

translation.en: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you , brethren beloved of the Lord , because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth :
translation.kha: Ngi dei ban ainguh ïa U Blei ha ki por baroh na ka bynta jong phi , ko parabangeit , phi kiba U Trai u ieit . Naba U Blei u la jied ïa phi kum kiba nyngkong ban pynim da ka bor U Mynsiem ban pynlong ïa phi ki riewkhuid jong u bad da ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka jingshisha .

translation.en: A man void of understanding striketh hands , and becometh surety in the presence of his friend .
translation.kha: Tang u briew u bym don jingsngewthuh un kular ban kitkhlieh ïa ki ram jong uwei pat .

U Shemaïah u nongïathuhlypa u leit sha u syiem Rephaim bad ki jingïalam jong ka Judia kiba la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem ban lait im na u Shishak . U ong ïa ki , Kana ka dei ka khubor na U Tlai ïa Phin : ‘ Phi la iehnoh ïa nga , te mynta nga la ioh ïa phi shad u Shishak .’
translation.en: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam , and to the princes of Judah , that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak , and said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  , Ye have forsaken me , and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak .
And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim . Then said Abner unto him , Go , return . And he returned .
translation.kha: U Paltiel u leit bud ïa ka haduh ka nongrit Bahurim , u da ïam katba u dang leit . Hynrei u Abner u ong ,  Khie leit noh sha ïing ,  bad u leh kumta .

translation.en: Keep therefore the words of this covenant , and do them , that ye may prosper in all that ye do .
translation.kha: Namar kata , kohnguh hok ïa ki ktien baroh ba la thoh ha kane ka jutang khnang ba phin manbha ha ki jingtrei jingktah jong phi baroh .
U mihnoh na Bethlehem ban leit wad jaka Shong shabi . Katba u dang don ha ka jinglanot kum , u wei poi ha ka ïing u Mikah kaweh ha ri lum Ephraim .
translation.en: And the man departed out of the city from Beth–lehem–judah to sojourn where he could find a place : and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah , as he journeyed .

translation.kha: U bariew u la lah don pynjuh bad u la pynjuh ïa baïar kiwei pat ki jait jingthaw — ki mradkhlaw bad ki sim , ki mirr bapar bad ki dohkha .
translation.en: For every kind of beasts , and of birds , and of serpents , and of things in the sea , is tamed , and hath been tamed of mankind :
Or a man that is brokenfooted , or brokenhanded ,
translation.kha: uba la duh bor ha ka kti lane ka kjat ;
u khun jong u Melkhi , u khun jong u Edrei , u khun jong u Mosah , u khun jong u Elmadam , u khun jrong u Er ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Melchi , which was the son of Addi , which was the son of Cosam , which was the son of Elmodam , which was the son of Er ,

translation.kha: Kumta kiba duk , kum ki kada khlaw , ki wad jingbam ha ka ri khlaw ba-tyrkhong ; ym don jaka hangno hangno ngab shem jingman na ka bynta ki khun jong ki .
translation.en: Behold , as wild asses in the desert , go they forth to their work  ; rising betimes for a prey : the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children .
For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head , and the  Lord  shall reward thee .
translation.kha: Phin pynlong ïa u ba la thang da ka jinglehrain bad U  Trai  un ainong ïa phi .
bad ïa ki Mosah bad ïa ka umphniang na ka bynta ki sharak , na ka bynta ka umphniang pynkhleh , pynlang na ka pynbha ka jingiwbih .
translation.en: And spice , and oil for the light , and for the anointing oil , and for the sweet incense .

translation.kha: haba u syiem u la pynmih ïa ka jingpynbna bathymmai bad shibun ki samla kynthei la wallam sha Susa , ka Esther ka la long kawei na ki . Ïa ka ruh la nguh ha ka ïingsyiem hapoh ka jingsumar u Hegai , uba peit ïa ka ïing ki kyntiew .
translation.en: So it came to pass , when the king s commandment and his decree was heard , and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace , to the custody of Hegai , that Esther was brought also unto the king s house , to the custody of Hegai , keeper of the women .

translation.kha: To khynñiuh , ko khynraw , ha ka jingwan jrong U Trai , ha ka jingainong ryngkat jongnga U Blei’ jong u Jakob ,
translation.en: Tremble , thou earth , at the presence of the Lord , at the presence of the God of Jacob  ;
Get thee hence , and turn thee eastward , and hide thyself by the brook Cherith , that is before Jordan .
translation.kha: Mihnoh na kane ka jaka bad leit shaphang mihngi , bad leit rieh ïa lade hajan ka wahduid Kherith , kaba sha mihngi jong ka Jordan .

translation.en: And said unto him , Run , speak to this young man , saying , Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein :
translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u la kren ha uta uwei pat ,  Khie mareh bad ong ha u samla uba don u ksai thew ba yn sa don bun byllien ki briew bad shibun bah ki jingri ha Jerusalem , ba kan long kaba heh katta katta ban don ki kynroh .
Te ha ka jinglwet jong ki , ki la khot kyrpad ïa U Trai , Bad u la pynim ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .
translation.en: Then they cried unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he delivered them out of their distresses .
And she conceived again , and bare a son : and she said , Now will I praise the  Lord  : therefore she called his name Judah  ; and left bearing .
translation.kha: Nangta ka punkhun biang bad ka kha sa uwei pat u khun shynrang . Ka ong ,  Ha kane ka sien ngan ïaroh ïa U  Trai   ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Judah . Nangta ka la wai noh ban ïoh khun .

translation.en: A voice was heard upon the high places , weeping and supplications of the children of Israel : for they have perverted their way , and they have forgotten the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: La ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa halor ki kliar lum : ki dei ki paid Israel kiba ïam bad ïasaid , namar ba ki la im ka jingim ba-dap da ka pop bad ba ki la klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: Thou shalt eat it before the  Lord  thy God year by year in the place which the  Lord  shall choose , thou and thy household .
translation.kha: Man ka snem , ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong phi , phi dei ban ïabam ïa ki ha khmat U  Trai  ha kata ka jaka mane Blei ba U  Trai  un jied .
pham ïa ka ha Kajuh ka sngi bad wat pynsah ei ei haduh ka step kaba bud .
translation.en: On the same day it shall be eaten up  ; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: U jubab , Phi tharai ba ma phi bad u syiem ki long tang kita Ibbah u patsha u la phah ïa nga ngab kren ïa kino kiei kiei baïar ? Em , nga kren ruh ha ki briew kiba shongsuk ha ka kynroh , kiba hap ba ïam ïa la ka jingthlia Bad dih ïa la ka um pynjuh , kumba phi pajut phi hap ban leh kamut .
translation.en: But Rabshakeh said , Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words ? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall , that they may eat their own dung , and drink their own piss with you ?
And when they had platted a crown of thorns , they put it upon his head , and a reed in his right hand : and they bowed the knee before him , and mocked him , saying , Hail , King of the Jews !
translation.kha: Nangta ki la thain pansngiat na ki tnat ba don shiah bad ki la buh ïa ka halor ka khlieh jong u , bad ki la buh ïa u dieng ha ka kti kamon jong u ; nangta ki la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u bad ki la kren ibeiñ ïa u .  Im slem u Syiem ki Jiw !  ki la ong .

translation.en: And after him Ibzan of Beth–lehem judged Israel .
translation.kha: Hadien u Jephthah , u Ibsan uba na Bethlehem u ïalam ïa ki Israel .

Kumta ki la pynhiar ïa u tyllai blem bad u sisa ba la teh ha u , bad ki la shem ba ka um ka don kumba sawphew mitar ka jingjylliew ; khim katto katne hain ki la leh kumjuh dara ki la shem ba ka don laiphew mitar ka jingjylliew .
translation.en: And sounded , and found it twenty fathoms : and when they had gone a little further , they sounded again , and found it fifteen fathoms .

translation.kha: U la jingjubab , U briew ïa Uba la khot U Jisu u la pynlong ïa i sboh ktieh , u la kyllan ha ki khmat jong nga , bad u la ong ha nga ban leit sha Siloam bun bta ïa ka khmat jong nga . Kumta nga la leit , bad tang miej ba-dait khmat , nga la lah ban imat .
translation.en: He answered and said , A man that is called Jesus made clay , and anointed mine eyes , and said unto me ,  Go to the pool of Siloam , and wash :  and I went and washed , and I received sight .
And Saul was afraid of David , because the  Lord  was with him , and was departed from Saul .
translation.kha: U Saul u sheptieng ïa u Dabid namar ba U  Trai  u don ryngkat bad u Dabid hynrei U la kynriah noh na u Saul .
ba-eh u don ? u kylli ïa la ki khun . Balei phi Shi eh ïa uta u briew ? Kheiñ leit khot ïa u baneh ïabam bad ngi .
translation.en: And he said unto his daughters , And where is he ? why is it that ye have left the man ? call him , that he may eat bread .

translation.kha: U Aaron u la kohnguh , u la shim ïa la u khiew buh ding bad marwei sha phangpdeng ki briew ba la ïalumlang . Haba u ïohi ba ka khlam ka la lah sdang , u buh ïa ka jingiwbih ha uta u jngi ding malu u pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta uta u paidbah .
translation.en: And Aaron took as Moses commanded , and ran into the midst of the congregation  ; and , behold , the plague was begun among the people : and he put on incense , and made an atonement for the people .
Also in Horeb ye provoked the  Lord  to wrath , so that the  Lord  was angry with you to have destroyed you .
translation.kha: Wat ha Lum Sinai ruh phi la pynbitar shla ïa U  Trai  kat haduh ban pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: And they that have believing masters , let them not despise them , because they are brethren ; but rather do them service , because they are faithful and beloved , partakers of the benefit . These things teach and exhort .
translation.kha: Ki mraw kiba long ki jong ki kynrad kiba ngeit kim dei ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ki , naba ki long ki parabangeit jong ki . Pynban , ki dei ban shakri ïa ki kham bha shuh shuh , namar kito kiba ïoh myntoi na ka jingtrei jong ki , ki long ki parabangeit ïa kiba ki ieit . Me dei ban hikai bad ïalap ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: For who maketh thee to differ from another ? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive ? now if thou didst receive it , why dost thou glory , as if thou hadst not received it ?
translation.kha: Uei uba pynlong ïa phi ban sngew kham halor ïa kiwei pat ? Hato ym dei U Blei uba la ai ha phi baroh kaba phi don ? Kumta , te , kumno phi lah ban sngewsarong , kumba kaei kaba phi don , kam dei ka jingai sngewbha ?
u la tei ïa ka pyrthei halor ki um jingjylliew ; ka jingieit jongngi u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Na don ka jinglynñiar kaba jam ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt , ka bym pat ju don mynno mynno naba kum kata lane ka ban ym don shuh lano lano .
translation.en: And there shall be a great cry throughout all the land of Egypt , such as there was none like it , nor shall be like it any more .
For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided , three against two , and two against three .
translation.kha: Naduh mynta ïa ka longïing kaba don san ngut yn phiah , ki lai ngut pyrshah ïa ki ar ngut bad ki ar ngut pyrshah ïa ki lai ngut .
U Joab u ong ha u Amasa , Phi longïing kumno , ko paralok jong nga ? bad u bat ïa u Ahas na u ñiuhtmoh jong u da la ka kti kamon ban doh ïa u .
translation.en: And Joab said to Amasa , Art thou in health , my brother ? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him .

translation.kha: Lada ka pyrthei ka shun ïa phi , to kynmaw ba ka la shun ïa nga nyngkong .
translation.en: If the world hate you , ye know that it hated me before it hated you .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngem kaba bud hadien ka thma , ki Philistia ki longing bad lute ïa ki metïap , bad ki lap ïa ki sien jongu u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ba ki ni halor u Leummim Gilboa .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa .

translation.kha: Me hir kum u dieng Kedar ka Lebanon , lem bad ki tnat kiba itynnat bad ba kah syrngiew , u dieng suba jrong katta Katta uba kot Haduh ki lyoh .
translation.en: Behold , the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches , and with a shadowing shroud , and of an high stature  ; and his top was among the thick boughs .

translation.kha: U Trai un pyndonkam ïa ka ba bakhuid jong u ; un pynim ïa la ki biria , mala ka pyrthei baroh kan ïohi ïa kata .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations  ; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God .

translation.kha: Ngam shah ïa ki kynthei ba ngin hikai lane leh dabor halor ki shynrang ; ki dei ban long kiba jar jar .
translation.en: But I suffer not a woman to teach , nor to usurp authority over the man , but to be in silence .

translation.kha: U Paul u la buh ïa la ki kti phalor jong ki , mala U Mynsiem Bakyntang u la wan ha ki ; ki la krenbeiñ ha ki thylliej kiba pher bad ki la pynbna hati ïa ka khubor jong U Blei .
translation.en: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them , the Holy Ghost came on them  ; and they spake with tongues , and prophesied .

translation.kha: Te u Sennakherib u katsha ka Assyria u hynne bad leit phai sha Ninebeh .
translation.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , and went and returned , and dwelt at Nineveh .

translation.kha: La leit lamler ïa u ha u Moses , u Aaron , bad ka kynhun baroh kawei ,
translation.en: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron , and unto all the congregation .

translation.kha: Wallam shuh Shua ki dieng ! Pynngam ïa ka thiang ! Shet ïa ka doh ! Phon ïa ka sirka ! Tangba noh ïa ki shyieng !
translation.en: Heap on wood , kindle the fire , consume the flesh , and spice it well , and let the bones be burned .

translation.kha: Mynta ki Dei ban sangeh noh na kob mane ïa kiwei pat ki balieh bad weng ïa ki metïap jongno ki syiem jong ki . Lada ki leh kumta , nur shong pangnud jong ki junom .
translation.en: Now let them put away their whoredom , and the carcases of their kings , far from me , and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever .

translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa phi shat Seïon , shata u lbong bakynjang jong nga , kun ai ha pa’ ka jingkmen ha ka ïohnang jingduwai jong ar ; bad pdeng ïa ki jingkñia ibha phi ai ha ka duwan jong nga . Ïa ka ïing jong nga yn khot ka ïing jingduwai na ka bynta ki briew jong ki ri baroh .
translation.en: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain , and make them joyful in my house of prayer : their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar  ; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people .

translation.kha: Rwai ka jingïaroh ïa U Trai ; ïathuh ïa ki jingkhylliap Kiba u la leh .
translation.en: Sing unto him , sing psalms unto him , talk ye of all his wondrous works .

translation.kha: Pynbna u syiem Hesekaïah bad baroh ki Shiphew jong u ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , ki la pyrshang don kjit na ka nongbat ha ka por mynmiet . Ki la phet na ka lynti jong ka kper syiem , ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka khyrdop kaba pynïasoh ïa ki ar tylli ki kynroh , bad phet na ka liang jong ka Them kyrdan .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them , and all the men of war , then they fled , and went forth out of the city by night , by the way of the king s garden , by the gate betwixt the two walls : and he went out the way of the plain .
O inhabitant of Lebanon , that makest thy nest in the cedars , how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee , the pain as of a woman in travail !
translation.kha: Phi shong sngewskhem hapdeng ki dieng Kedar ba wanrah na Lebanon ; hynrei katno kaba sngewsynei ynda wan ka jingshitom ha phi , bad phin ud haba ka jingsuh kan lap ïa phi , ki jingshitom kum kito ki jong ka kynthei kaba suh kha .

translation.en: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh , Thus saith the  Lord  , Israel is my son , even my firstborn :
translation.kha: Te me dei ban ong ha u ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong , ‘ U Israel u long u khun nyngkong jong nga .

translation.en: These are the sons of Ishmael , and these are their names , by their towns , and by their castles  ; twelve princes according to their nations .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki kpa tymmen jong ki khat-ar jait , bad da ki kyrteng jong ki la jer ïa ki shnong bad ïa ki jaka sher dara jong ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall be king over all the earth : in that day shall there be one  Lord  , and his name one .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  un long u syiem jong ka pyrthei baroh ; uwei pa uwei baroh un mane ïa u kum U Blei bad tip ïa u da kajuh ka kyrteng .
Ngan Wan lang bad phi .
translation.en: I shall come with you .

translation.kha: bad ki ïohi ïa U Blang ki Jeriel . hapoh ki sla jat jong u , la don kai kaba i kumno ka jingsiang da u mardor Sapphir , kaba jngum kum ka seiñïong .
translation.en: And they saw the God of Israel : and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone , and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Ka jingshai kan kein hapdeng jong phi sa katto katne por . To nang ïaid katba ka jingshai ka dang don , ba ka jingdum ka ym wan lap ïa phi ; naba uta uba ïaid ha ka jingdum um tip shano ba u leit .
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Yet a little while is the light with you . Walk while ye have the light , lest darkness come upon you : for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth .
She said moreover unto him , We have both straw and provender enough , and room to lodge in .
translation.kha: Don shibun u phlangïap bad ka jingbam ïa ki jingri ha ïing jong ngi , bad don ruh ka jaka na ka bynta jong phi ban sah .
bad u la hukum ïa u Nathan , u nongshetkylla ban jer kyrteng ïa u khynnah , u Jedidaïah , Naamah ba U Trai u la ieit ïa u .
translation.en: And he sent by the hand of Nathan the prophet  ; and he called his name Jedidiah , because of the  Lord .
And he said unto Jesus , Lord , remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha U Jisu ,  To kynmaw ïa nga , ko Jisu , haba me wan kum u Syiem !
U Trai u la bitar ïa ki Jerusalem bad u pyndam ïa ki na khnam jong u , da kaba iehnoh tyngkan ïa ka hima Judith .
translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  was very angry with Israel , and removed them out of his sight : there was none left but the tribe of Judah only .

translation.kha: Baroh ki briew kiba shon ha ka pyrthei ngin mane ïa u , lait ino ïa kito kiba ïa ki kyrteng jong ki la thoh ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei ha ka babha jong kiba im kiba dei ki jong uta U Khunlangbrot ïa uba la shah pynïap .
translation.en: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him , whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world .

But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col–hozeh , the ruler of part of Mizpah  ; he built it , and covered it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof , and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king s garden , and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David .
translation.kha: U Shallum , u khun jong u Kolhoseh , u nongsynshar ïa ka Mispah distrik , u tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Umpohliew . U siang ïa ka lynti kaba poi sha ka khyrdop , u pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ïa ki jingkhang ka khyrdop . Ha ka Pungsum Shelah , u tei ïa ka khyrdop markhap ïa ka kper syiem , haduh ki mawjam kiba hiar sha ka Nongbah u Dabid .

Hadien ki nongpyntrei ki wan biang sha u Ahab bad kawei pat ka jingdawa na u Benhadad ; Nga la phah ktien sha me ba men aiti noh ha nga ïa ka rupa malade ka ksiar jong me , bad ïa ki kynthei bad ki khun jong me .
translation.en: And the messengers came again , and said , Thus speaketh Ben–hadad , saying , Although I have sent unto thee , saying , Thou shalt deliver me thy silver , and thy gold , and thy wives , and thy children  ;
The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning  ; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even :
translation.kha: Kñia uwei u khunlangbrot mynstep bad uwei pat ynda janmiet .

translation.en: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now ;
translation.kha: namar ka rukom kaba phi la ïarap ïa nga ha ka kam jong ka gospel sha kiwei pat naduh ka sngi kaba sdang haduh mynta .
Hadien kata , katto katne thut na ki tymmen ki san ki la ïeng joit malade ki ong ha ki paidbah kiba la ïalumlang ,
translation.en: Then rose up certain of the elders of the land , and spake to all the assembly of the people , saying ,

translation.kha: Bad U Trai jrong ngi u la theh noh buk ïa ka jingaiei ba-dap kyrhai ha to bad u la ai ha nga ïa ka jingngeit bad ïa ka jingieit naba longkmie ki jongngi ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: Kynmaw ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton bad Sumar kyntang ïa ka .
translation.en: Remember the sabbath day , to keep it holy .

translation.kha: Hapdeng lai bad hynriew baje mynstep U Jisu u la wan sha ki synran , da kaba ïadei Halor ka um .
translation.en: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them , walking on the sea .

translation.kha: Shisien la don hynñiew ngut shi para ki shynrang ; uba nyngkong duh u la shongkurim bad u la ïap khlem don khun .
translation.en: There were therefore seven brethren : and the first took a wife , and died without children .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi ki briew ! Phi long kiba eh ryndang bad kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ; phi la phai noh sharud bad iehnoh ïa nga .
translation.en: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart  ; they are revolted and gone .

translation.kha: U la iehnoh ïa ki , u la kiew pat halor ka lieng bad u la sdang ban leit sha shiliang jong ka duriaw .
translation.en: And he left them , and entering into the ship again departed to the other side .

translation.kha: Bun sngi ngim shym lah ban ïuh ïa ka sngi lin ïa ki khlur , bun ka lyer ka la nang beh jur . Ha kaba khatduh ngi la duh jingmane ïa ka ba lait im .
translation.en: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared , and no small tempest lay on us , all hope that we should be saved was then taken away .

translation.kha: Kana ka longïng ka khubor ba u ïashoh ha ki ban ai ha u Isshaïah ; Mynta ka long ka sngi jong ka jingjynjar ; ngi la shah pynmih bad ngi lama ha ka jinglehrain . Ngi longkmie khem ka kynthei kaba la suh kha , hynrei kaba tlot katta katta ba kam ia ban ha .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Thus saith Hezekiah , This day is a day of trouble , and of rebuke , and of blasphemy : for the children are come to the birth , and there is not strength to bring forth .

translation.kha: Ka nongpang kam donkam ïa ka sngem lane ïa u banbeiñ ban tyngshaiñ halor jong ka , ñiar ba ka burom jong U Trai ka tyngshaiñ halor jong ka , bad U Khunlangbrot u long ka shrah Jong ka .
translation.en: And the city had no need of the sun , neither of the moon , to shine in it : for the glory of God did lighten it , and the Lamb is the light thereof .

translation.kha: Ka Jingbymman Bamaïan ka la da Trei , hynriew , kaei ka don wia , kan ym jia poi ynda ïa uta uba bat ïa ka la weng noh na ka lynti .
translation.en: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work : only he who now letteth will let , until he be taken out of the way .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sian , borabor ki pyrkhat ha shuwa ban leh ïa Kanah kano , hynrei ki briew kiba mawpud ki thala ïa la ka jingbieit .
translation.en: Every prudent man dealeth with knowledge : but a fool layeth open his folly .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngaid kaba bud , u la sieh ar tylli ki sbai rupa bad u la ai ïa ki ha u rai ïing . ‘ To sar ïa u ,’ u la ong ïa u trai ïing , ‘ bad jingda to wan phai na kane ka lynti , tun siew ïa me ïa kano kano kaba me pynlut halor jong u .’
translation.en: And on the morrow when he departed , he took out two pence , and gave them to the host , and said unto him , Take care of him  ; and whatsoever thou spendest more , when I come again , I will repay thee .

translation.kha: Haba ka shem ïa ka , ka khot Ngan ïa ki paralok mala ïa ki paramarjan jyllang ka , bad ka ong ha ki , ‘ Nga kmen haduh katta katta ba nga la shem ïa ka pisa kaba nga la jah . To ngin ïalehkmen !’
translation.en: And when she hath found it , she calleth her friends and her neighbours together , saying , Rejoice with me  ; for I have found the piece which I had lost .

translation.kha: Naba da ka jingtep ba la kñia jong U Khrist la pyllaitluid ïa ngi , kata ka long , ïa ki pop jongnga ngi la map ei .
translation.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood , the forgiveness of sins , according to the riches of his grace ;

translation.kha: Uba uba khat ïa u diengpynïeng u daym ba-bang da sait ïa la ki jaiñ , hynrei u ïailong u bymkhuid khah janmiet . Kane ka rukom pynïadait rynsied ka long kaba dei ha ki nga ki ïa-ban wan baroh na ka bynta ki Israel bad ki nongwei kiba shnong basah hapdeng jong ki .
translation.en: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the even : and it shall be unto the children of Israel , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them , for a statute for ever .
And David s men said unto him , Behold , we be afraid here in Judah : how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki ong ha u ,  Ngi don bun bah ban sheptieng hangne ha Judah ; kan long kaba kham sniew lada ngi leit sha Keilah bad tur ïaleh ïa ki kynhun ïapom jong ki Philistia !
Hadien kata , ka thma ka khih baklang bad ki Philistia ha Geser . Kane ka jia haba u Sibbekai na Hushim u pynïap ïa u rahah uba kyrteng u Silpah , bad ïa ki Philistia la iap .
translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines  ; at which time Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Sippai , that was of the children of the giant : and they were subdued .

translation.kha: Ka trai duriaw ka pat tyngkreiñ bad ïa ki nongrim jongnga ka pyrthei ruh la pynpaw , hajuh U Trai u kynteit ïa ki nongshun jyllang u , bad u kyrhuh ïa ki ha ka jingtur .
translation.en: And the channels of the sea appeared , the foundations of the world were discovered , at the rebuking of the  Lord  , at the blast of the breath of his nostrils .
And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast :
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Grik hapdeng jong kito kiba la leit sha Jerusalem ban mane ha ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam .
Un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong ka bad un pynpyut ïa ka ha ka phang kaba shatei jong ka duwan , ha ka jaka ba ki ju pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia baje thang .
translation.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering , and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ko Syiem Kynrad , to bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga . Sangeh ngab leh ngop , to leh ïa kaba dei , Bad to sngewsynei ïa kiba duk . Te phira ïailong ibha pynbha .
translation.en: Wherefore , O king , let my counsel be acceptable unto thee , and break off thy sins by righteousness , and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor  ; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity .

translation.kha: Kumta kita baroh ar ngut ki shong bad ki ïabam ïadih lang . Nangta u kpa kata ka kynthei u ong ha u , Sngewbha sahmiet napoh hangne badno pynsngewbha ïa lade .
translation.en: And they sat down , and did eat and drink both of them together : for the damsel s father had said unto the man , Be content , I pray thee , and tarry all night , and let thine heart be merry .

translation.kha: Nangta , ïa U Jisu la ïalam sha ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh , ha kaba la ïalumlang ki Rangbah lyngkdong , ki rangbah nongïalam bad ki nonghikai jong ka Law .
translation.en: And they led Jesus away to the high priest : and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes .

translation.kha: Uta uba rnong tat ïa u briew da kaba mut ban die mraw ne ban ri mraw ïa u , u dei ban shah pynïap .
translation.en: And he that stealeth a man , and selleth him , or if he be found in his hand , he shall surely be put to death .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki jubab , Nangne ym shah ban leh ïa ka sa jong ngi kum ka nud .
translation.en: And they said , Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ka sner ka la poi haba len pynrkhiang pat ïa ka hima-patsha u Dabid kaba hir kum ka iing kaweh la khyllem ha ki jingjot . Ngan shna pynbna ïa ki kynroh jngai ka bad ngan pynïeng pat ïa ka . Ngam tei pat ïa ka bad ngan Pynlong ïa ka kum ka la ju long Mynshuwa .
translation.en: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen , and close up the breaches thereof  ; and I will raise up his ruins , and I will build it as in the days of old :

translation.kha: Haba phi pang ñiangthohlieh , phi dei ban leh thik kumba ki Lyngdoh Lebi ki ong ïa phi , bad buhnud ïa ki jingjai ïa kiba nga la ai ha ki .
translation.en: Take heed in the plague of leprosy , that thou observe diligently , and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you : as I commanded them , so ye shall observe to do .
For mine Angel shall go before thee , and bring thee in unto the Amorites , and the Hittites , and the Perizzites , and the Canaanites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites : and I will cut them off .
translation.kha: U angel jong nga un leit ha shuwa jong phi bad un ïalam ïa phi sha ka ri jong ki Amor , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Kanaan , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus ; bad ngan pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day : and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus , thou knowest very well .
translation.kha: To U Trai un ai ïa ka jinglehisynei ha u ha kata ka Sngi ! Bad phi tip shai kdar katno ba u la leh na ka bynta jong nga ha Ephesos .

Shihajar ngut na phi kin ïaphet krad haba phoi ioh ïa uwei u shipai nongshun , bad san ngut ki shipai ki la beiñ ban pynlong ïa phi baroh ban shet krad . Yn ym ni shuh ka kynhun shipai jongki phi ka ban dang sah , lait nep sa tang u dieng lama ba sah marwei ha kliar jong u lut !
translation.en: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one  ; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee : till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain , and as an ensign on an hill .

translation.kha: Sa shiliang pat u la bat ïa na , bad nga la khim sngaid ïohbor .
translation.en: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man , and he strengthened me ,
The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high  ; and thou shalt come down very low .
translation.kha: Ki nongwei kiba shong hapdeng jong phi kin nang kham ïohbor katba ma phi pat phin nang duh ïa la ka bor .
Ngan ai ha ki ïa kaweh ka jingthmu ha ka jingim : don donburom ïa nga ha ki por baroh , na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki hi bad ka jingbha jong ki khup ki ksiew jong ki .
translation.en: And I will give them one heart , and one way , that they may fear me for ever , for the good of them , and of their children after them :
He maketh my feet like hinds  feet : and setteth me upon my high places .
translation.kha: U pynstet ïa ki kjat jong nga kum ka skei ; u sumar ïa nga ha ki lumbah .
Ïa kane la lai ban pynurlong shisha ïa kaei kaba u Isaïah u Nongïathuhlypa u la lah ong :
translation.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying ,

translation.kha: Ïa ka khyndew dei ban buh dor katne kum ka jingdon jong ki snem ha kba tala ka khyndew ka lah ba pynjam soh shuwa ban poh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pud .
translation.en: According to the number of years after the jubilee thou shalt buy of thy neighbour , and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee :
I have fought a good fight , I have finished my course , I have kept the faith :
translation.kha: Nga la ïaleh tyngeh ïa ka jingïamareh , nga la pyndep ïa ka jingïaphet , nga la ri ïa ka jingngeit .

translation.en: Ye shall seek me , and shall not find me : and where I am , thither ye cannot come .
translation.kha: Phin ïawad ïa nga , hynrei phin ym shem ïa nga , namar phim lah ban leit sha kaba ngan don .
Ki la jubab , I pa jong ngi , u shakri barit jong phi , i dang im bad i shait i khlam . Badno ki la den-um ksew Bad nguh Eder ha khmat jongngi u .
translation.en: And they answered , Thy servant our father is in good health , he is yet alive . And they bowed down their heads , and made obeisance .

translation.kha: Ki ngab jong phi ki thaba napoh ka jaitniam jong pa’ .
translation.en: This thy stature is like to a palm tree , and thy breasts to clusters of grapes .

translation.kha: Hynriew mem shym iehnoh ïa ki Haneng ha ka ri shyiap , namar ka jingisynei jong me ka long kaba khraw . Mem shym la shim noh ïa u lyoh lane ïa ka thiang uba pyn-i ha ki ïa ka lynti mynsngi bad mynmiet .
translation.en: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness : the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day , to lead them in the way  ; neither the pillar of fire by night , to shew them light , and the way wherein they should go .

translation.kha: Da u , la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh ; ym ni kawei ruh na ka jingpynlong baroh kaba la thaw khlem ma u .
translation.en: All things were made by him  ; and without him was not any thing made that was made .
But Peter put them all forth , and kneeled down , and prayed  ; and turning him to the body said , Tabitha , arise . And she opened her eyes : and when she saw Peter , she sat up .
translation.kha: U Petros u la pynmih ïa ki baroh shabar ka kamra , bad u la dem khohsiew bad duwai ; nangta u la phai sha ka met bad u la ong ,  Ko Tabitha , khie joit !  Ka la plied ïa la ki khmat , bad haba ka la ïohi ïa u Petros , ka la khie shong .
Kim lah ap ban leh ïa kai kaei kaba sniew . Ki long badonbor kiba kloi ban pynïap .
translation.en: For their feet run to evil , and make haste to shed blood .

translation.kha: U thri u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Hadien nala u syier u ong ha u Hobab , Nga la riat ba-bang leh ïa kata kaba me kwah . Khie leit sad wad ïa u samla Absalom malade wiang ïalam pat ïa u hangne .
translation.en: And the king said unto Joab , Behold now , I have done this thing : go therefore , bring the young man Absalom again .
Then did they spit in his face , and buffeted him  ; and others smote him with the palms of their hands ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki la bynthiew ha ka khmat jong u bad ki la shoh ïa u ; bad kito kiba la thab ïa u
Baalis me khot uba bha ïa per ? U Jisu u la kylli ïa u . Ym ba-don uno uno umbiah bha lait thiang U Blei .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? none is good , save one , that is , God .

translation.kha: U Trai u kyrhuh ïa ki hukum sha ka kynhun shipai jong u . Ki ba-shiphew kiba khunlung ïa u ki long shibun nabar kiba khlaiñbor . Haduh katno ka longïing kaba shyrkhei ka sngi jong U Trai ! Uei u ban lait im na ka ?
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall utter his voice before his army : for his camp is very great : for he is strong that executeth his word : for the day of the  Lord  is great and very terrible  ; and who can abide it ?

translation.kha: Ha kata ka kynta hi , ka la wan poi bad ka la ainguh ïa U Blei bad ka la krenbeiñ shaphang u khunlung ha baroh kiba ap ïa U blem ban pyllaitluid ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord , and spake of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Sumar bha ! Wat pyntbit por shaba palat ha ka jingkhawai bad ka jingïadon malu ha ki jingkhuslai jong kane ka jingim , Ïoh ba kata Ka Sngi kan kem kynsan ïa phi kum ka jingriam .
translation.en: And take heed to yourselves , lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with surfeiting , and drunkenness , and cares of this life , and so that day come upon you unawares .

translation.kha: Ka por sa wanrah haba baroh na phi phin bret noh ïa ki leilieh bapop kiba phi la thaw na ka rupa sad ka ksiar .
translation.en: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver , and his idols of gold , which your own hands have made unto you for a sin .
All things were made by him  ; and without him was not any thing made that was made .
translation.kha: Da u , la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh ; ym don kawei ruh na ka jingpynlong baroh kaba la thaw khlem ma u .
To thawsha ka pansngiat na ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba ki la ai , bad buh ïa ka halor ka khlieh jong u Joshua , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u khun jong u Jehosadak .
translation.en: Then take silver and gold , and make crowns , and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest  ;

And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Be not afraid because of them : for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel : thou shalt hough their horses , and burn their chariots with fire .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Wat sheptieng ïa ki . Ha kane ka por lashai ka sngi ngan pynïap ïa ki baroh na ka bynta ki Israel . Phi dei ban pyndkoh ïa ki kulai jong ki bad thang ïa ki kali ïapom jong ki .

Ha kane hi ka sngi U Trai un aiti ïa me hapoh ka bol jong nga ; ngan pynkyllon ïa me pynlang ngan sharai ïa ka khlieh jong me . Bad ngan ai ïa ki metïap jong ki ba-shiphew Philistia ha ki sim bad ha ki mrad ba kin bam .
translation.en: This day will the  Lord  deliver thee into mine hand  ; and I will smite thee , and take thine head from thee  ; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air , and to the wild beasts of the earth  ; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un ïaknieh ïa kajuh ka kupar — ki lyngdoh bad ki briew , ki mraw bad ki kynrad , kiba thied bad katba thaw , kiba ai kylliang bad kiba shim kylliang , ibha riewspah bad kiba duk .
translation.en: And it shall be , as with the people , so with the priest  ; as with the servant , so with his master  ; as with the maid , so with her mistress  ; as with the buyer , so with the seller  ; as with the lender , so with the borrower  ; as with the taker of usury , so with the giver of usury to him .

translation.kha: kumta u phah khot ïa u Jehoïada , u nongïalam jongki ki , bad u malade , Balei ba phim peit ïa kane ba ki Lebi ki lum na Judah Bad Jerusalem ïa ka khñiang kaweh u Moses , u shakri jong U Troas , u la pan na ki briew ban siew ïa ka ban kyrshan ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai ?
translation.en: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief , and said unto him , Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection , according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the  Lord  , and of the congregation of Israel , for the tabernacle of witness ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la peit shlip sha ki bad u la jyllop , Kane ka long ka bym ia ha u briew , hynrei ha U Blei kiei kiei baroh ki longïing ka haw .
translation.en: But Jesus beheld them , and said unto them ,  With men this is impossible  ; but with God all things are possible .

translation.kha: Ka khuri kabu sem pyndem ha ka Jingkhawai U Trai bad ïa kaba sem ieit ïa U blei : ibha Ngi dih na ka , Ngi ïoh bynta lakam ha ka snam U Kynther . Bad u kpu uba i kdiah : Haba sem bam ïa u , ngi ïoh bynta lem ha ka met U Khrist .
translation.en: The cup of blessing which we bless , is it not the communion of the blood of Christ ? The bread which we break , is it not the communion of the body of Christ ?

translation.kha: Kane , pynban , kaba la dei ban jia , khnang ba ïa kaei kaba la thok ha ka Hukum jong ki kan urlong shisha : ‘ Ki la thret ïa nga khlem daw ei ei .’
translation.en: But this cometh to pass , that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law , They hated me without a cause .
Beloved , if our heart condemn us not , then have we confidence toward God .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , lada ka jingïatiplem kam pynrem ïa ngi , ngi don ka jingshlur ha khmat U Blei .
nongïam tharai ba nga long uba khampoh kynhied ban ïa kito ki riewkhlaw ïa kiba la khot ki apostol jong phi!
translation.en: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles .

translation.kha: U Daniel u la don ha ka ïingbishar sahmiet haduh ba u Syros u patsha jong ka Peresh u la jop ïa ka babniah .
translation.en: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus .
And ye my flock , the flock of my pasture , are men , and I am your God , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ma phi , ki langbrot jong nga , ka kynhun kaba nga bsa , phi long ki briew jong nga , bad nga long U Blei jong phi ,  ong U  Trai  Nongsynshar .
Namar ba U Blei u la pynkhynñiuh lypa ïa kai kaei kaban kham bha na ka bynta jongnga i . Ka jingthmu jong u ka la long ba tang ha ka jingïadon shlip bad Ngi ba yn pynïoh ïa ki .
translation.en: God having provided some better thing for us , that they without us should not be made perfect .

translation.kha: U syiem Dabid u buh pynskhem ïa u Asaph bad ïa ki para Lehbha ha ka kam kaba ïadei bun ka jingmane ba pynbang ha ka jaka ba la bsuh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang . La buh ïa ki ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jrong ki hangto man ka snoh .
translation.en: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  Asaph and his brethren , to minister before the ark continually , as every day s work required :

translation.kha: U Shim Jeroboam u ong ha u nongpynkhiah , Sngewbha Duwai na ka bynta jongngi nga ha U Trai U Blei jong phi , bad kyrpad ba un pynkhiah ïa ka kti jong nga ! U nongïathuhlypa u la duwai ha U Trai , bun la pynkhiah ïa ka kti jong u syiem .
translation.en: And the king answered and said unto the man of God , Entreat now the face of the  Lord  thy God , and pray for me , that my hand may be restored me again . And the man of God besought the  Lord  , and the king s hand was restored him again , and became as it was before .

translation.kha: ka Humtah , ka Hebron , mala ka Seir : khyndai tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: And Humtah , and Kirjath–arba , which is Hebron , and Zior  ; nine cities with their villages :

And he said , It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob , and to restore the preserved of Israel : I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles , that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Nga don ka kam kaba kham khraw ïa me , ko shakri jong nga . Ym tang ba men rah pat sha ka jingkhraw ïa ki paid Israel kiba la lait im , hynrei ngan pynlong ruh ïa me ka jingshai sha ki jaitbynriew — khnang ba ka pyrthei baroh kan ïohlait im .

translation.en: Reuben , thou art my firstborn , my might , and the beginning of my strength , the excellency of dignity , and the excellency of power :
translation.kha: Reuben , khun phrangsngi jong nga , Me long ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , U soh nyngkong ka jinglong rangbah jong nga , Uba sarong tam bad uba khlaiñ tam Na ki khun jong nga baroh .

translation.en: It was said unto her , The elder shall serve the younger .
translation.kha: Hynrei khnang ba ka jingjied ïa uwei u khun shynrang kan long nadong shadong ka jingmih jong ka jingthmu U Blei hi , U Blei u la ong ïa ka ,  U hynmen un shakri ïa u para .  U la ong ïa kane shuwa ba yn kha ïa ki , shuwa ba ki la leh ïa kano kano kaba bha ne kaba sniew ; kumta ïa ka jingjied U Blei la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingkhot jong u , bad ym ha kano kano kaba ki la lah leh .
U briew’ uba mutlop u long uba sner bad u kun ïa ki kam kiba sniew ; u ïasylla ban pynsmieij ïa kiba duk da ki jingshukor bad ban khanglad ïa ki ban ïoh ïa ki khot jong ki .
translation.en: The instruments also of the churl are evil : he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words , even when the needy speaketh right .

translation.kha: U Jehosadak u la ïarep bad la tep ha ka jingïap ki syiem ha Samaria , bad u khun jong u , u Jeroboam Uba Ar u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Joash slept with his fathers  ; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne : and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel .

translation.kha: Blei ki briew ki long kaba donkam ha me ? balei me da peit bniah ïa kaei ba ki leh ?
translation.en: What is man , that thou shouldest magnify him ? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him ?
And Ophir , and Havilah , and Jobab : all these were the sons of Joktan .
translation.kha: ka Ophir , ka Habilah , bad ka Jobab . Kine baroh ki dei kiba hiarpateng na u Joktan .
bad ha shuwa ba yn pynpaw ïa ka jingsniew kaba pha la bor ? Mynta phai long kum ma ka — ka jingjemnud ïa ki nong Edom , ki Philistia bad Kiwei pat ki paramarjan jong pha kiba isih ïa pha .
translation.en: Before thy wickedness was discovered , as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria , and all that are round about her , the daughters of the Philistines , which despise thee round about .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la lah jop bad Kam kynti ïa ka ri kaba shwa mihngi jong ka Jordan , Naduh ka Them Araunah haduh ka The Jordan bad shaduh u Lum Hermon ha ka phang bashatei . Ki la jop ïa ki ar ngut ki syiem .
translation.en: Now these are the kings of the land , which the children of Israel smote , and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun , from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon , and all the plain on the east :
And he marvelled because of their unbelief . And he went round about the villages , teaching .
translation.kha: U la sngewlyngngoh shikatdei , namar ki briew kim shym don jingngeit . Nangta U Jisu u la leit sha ki nongrit kiba don sawdong ha kata ka thain , u da hikai ïa ki briew .
Kumta u Mosah u la mihnoh bad ïathuh ha uta u paidbah ïa kaba U Trai u la ong . U la lamwir jingïohipaw ngut ki nongïalam bad u la buh ïa ki sawdong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And Moses went out , and told the people the words of the  Lord  , and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people , and set them round about the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad ki Israel ki rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ha U Trai : Neng rwai ha U Trai namar ka jingjop kaban khlaw jong u ; sha duriaw u la Bret ïa ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai .
translation.en: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the  Lord  , and spake , saying , I will sing unto the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously : the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .

translation.kha: Phim kwah pynsangeh ia u Tom ?
translation.en: Don't you want to stop Tom ?

translation.kha: Kumta u Pharaoh u pynkhreh ïa la ka kali thma bad ïa ka kynhun ïasam jong u hima .
translation.en: And he made ready his chariot , and took his people with him :

translation.kha: Ki pyrta ïa u Lot bad kylli ïa u , Hangno kito ki rangbah naba wan sah bad me ha kane ka miet ? Pynmih ïa ki shabar ! Ki Shaneng jong ka Sodom ki kwah ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki .
translation.en: And they called unto Lot , and said unto him , Where are the men which came in to thee this night ? bring them out unto us , that we may know them .

Then said he unto them ,  Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder , which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old .
translation.kha: Kumta u la jubab ,  Kane ka mut , te , ba uwei pa uwei u nonghikai Aiñ uba long u synran hapoh ka Hima ki bneng u long kum u trai jong ka ïing uba la sei shabar ïa kiei kiei kiba thymmai bad kiba rim napoh ka kamra kynshew jong u .
U Petros u la kren bad ong ïa U Ujuh , Ko nongshniah , katno ka longkmie naba bha ba ngi ïadon hangne ! Ngin thaw noh lai tylli ki ïingjaiñ , kawei ïa me , khawai ïa u Moses , bad kawei ïa u Elijah .
translation.en: And Peter answered and said to Jesus , Master , it is good for us to be here : and let us make three tabernacles  ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias .
Now his elder son was in the field : and as he came and drew nigh to the house , he heard musick and dancing .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por u khun ba kham heh u la don ha lyngkha . Ha ka lynti ba u wan phai , haba u la poi sha jan ka ïing , u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingput jingtem bad ka jingïashad .
Ngan pynïap ïa u nongsynshar ka Moab mala ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ka ri .
translation.en: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof , and will slay all the princes thereof with him , saith the  Lord .

Forasmuch as an excellent spirit , and knowledge , and understanding , interpreting of dreams , and shewing of hard sentences , and dissolving of doubts , were found in the same Daniel , whom the king named Belteshazzar : now let Daniel be called , and he will shew the interpretation .
translation.kha: U la don ka jinglah kaba kham pher bad u long uba stad bad uba tbit ha kaba batai ïa ki jingphohsniew , uba ai jubab ïa ki jingkyntip , bad batai ïa ki jingmaïan ; kumta to phah khot ïa une u briew , u Daniel , ïa uba u syiem u la ai kyrteng u Belteshassar , bad un ïathuh ïa phi aïu kane baroh ka kit jingmut .
Haba ki poi hangta , u Jehu u pynïap lut ïa baroh ki kur ki jait jong u Ahab khlem pynshoh wat uwei ruh . Kñia ka long kaei kaba U Trai u la ïathuh ha u Elijah ba kan jia .
translation.en: And when he came to Samaria , he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria , till he had destroyed him , according to the saying of the  Lord  , which he spake to Elijah .

translation.kha: U Trai nongsharai u ainong , Ko ki paid Jerusalem’ , khie sien sha ka jaka bakhuid ka Bethel malu leh pop , lada phi hap ban bor kumta ! Khie leit sha Gilgal bad to sa ngop da ka jingkhlaiñbor jong phi baroh ! Ïing shaphrang nabar wallam ïa ki mrad pun kynïan na ka stait sha ka pathaw , bad Wallam ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew Jong phi man la ka sngap ka lai .
translation.en: Come to Beth–el , and transgress  ; at Gilgal multiply transgression  ; and bring your sacrifices every morning , and your tithes after three years :

translation.kha: Nga la shuh baroh ka jingkyrmen , te yn lei lada U balui u pynïap noh ïa na ? Ngan leit pun ïasaid ïa ka kada jong nga ha u .
translation.en: Though he slay me , yet will I trust in him : but I will maintain mine own ways before him .

translation.kha: Katto katne nguid ki parabangeit ïa naba la pynsakma da ka jingshat pynshitom beiñ kaba la jia mynleh haba la pynïap ïa u Shaphan , ka la pura! shaduh sha Phoenisia , Sypros , dara Antiokh , da kaba ïathuh ïa ka khubor tang ha ki Jiw .
translation.en: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phoenicia , and Cyprus , and Antioch , preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only .
And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum , there came unto him a centurion , beseeching him ,
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la rung shapoh Kapernam , u rangbah pynïaidkam ka Hima Rom u la wan ïakynduh ïa u bad u la kyrpad jingïarap :

translation.en: And it was the preparation of the passover , and about the sixth hour : and he saith unto the Jews , Behold your King !
translation.kha: Ka la long la jan shiteng sngi shuwa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . U Pilat u la ong ha ki briew ,  Une u syiem jong phi !
Hadien katto katne sngi U Jisu u la leit phai pud sha Kapernam , bad ka khublei ka la phriang ba u la don ha ïong .
translation.en: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days  ; and it was noised that he was in the house .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ki thied mala ki dohksah , bad ngan sting ïa phi da ka sniehdoh . Ngan pyllait mynsiem ha phi , sad wallam pat ïa phi shwa ka jingim . Te phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And I will lay sinews upon you , and will bring up flesh upon you , and cover you with skin , and put breath in you , and ye shall live  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Me la ai ha la ïa ka jingim bad ka jingieit baïaineh , malade ka jingsumar sukher jong me ka ri pynim ïa nga .
translation.en: Thou hast granted me life and favour , and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit .

translation.kha: Man ka por ba ki Israel ki thung jingthung , ki Midian , ki wan bad ki Amalek , sad ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap ïa-ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .
translation.en: And so it was , when Israel had sown , that the Midianites came up , and the Amalekites , and the children of the east , even they came up against them  ;

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat jong ka jingsyier u Jeroham u syiem ka Jeruel , u Abijah u la long u syiem ka Jehud , bad u synshar lai snem ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah .

translation.kha: Ka jingthmu jong ki ka long ban pynshaniah ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka long Kaba sngur . woh ïa ka khiar , ïa kaba lah ban pynpoh , la phrang da ka ding ; bad Kumta ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , katba kham kordor shuh shiah ban ïa ka ksiar , dadien ruh ba-bang phrang , khnang ba kan lah baneh shah . Te phin sa ïohpdiang ïa ka jingsarong bad ka bhor bun ka jingpyndonburom ha ka Sngi haba ïa U Jisu Khrist yn pynpaw .
translation.en: That the trial of your faith , being much more precious than of gold that perisheth , though it be tried with fire , might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ :
Thus saith the king , Let not Hezekiah deceive you : for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand :
translation.kha: U maham ïa phi ba phin ym shah ïa u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi . U Hesekaïah um lah ban pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising , a scab , or bright spot , and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy  ; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest , or unto one of his sons the priests :
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u briew u mih prum , lane u mih tohjaw , lane u tyrha ka sniehdoh , bad kata ka lah ban kylla sha ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , dei ban leit ïalam ïa u ha lyngdoh uba na ka longïing jong u Aaron .
NGA la pynlong ka jutang ïa ka sngi bad ka miat , khnang ba kin wan mih ha la ki por kiba biang ; bad ïa ka jutang yn ym lah ban pynkhiah .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; If ye can break my covenant of the day , and my covenant of the night , and that there should not be day and night in their season  ;

translation.kha: Ha ki jinglait lad por kiba babe nga la anna ha ka jingma na ki jingshlei um bad na ki nongkurup , ha ka jingma na ki par Jiw bad na ki Jentil ; ki la don ki jingbam ha ki nongbah , ki jingma ha ki ri khlaw , ki jingjam ha ki duriaw-bah , bad ki jingmad na ki paralok Ibbah shahshkor .
translation.en: In journeyings often , in perils of waters , in perils of robbers , in perils by mine own countrymen , in perils by the heathen , in perils in the city , in perils in the wilderness , in perils in the sea , in perils among false brethren ;

translation.kha: Ai ha nga ïa ki tnga jong nga bad ïa ki khwan jong nga kiba nga la ïoh da kob trei na ka bynta jong phoi , bad ngan leit noh . Phi tip hapoh katno nga la Shakri hok ïa phi .
translation.en: Give me my wives and my children , for whom I have served thee , and let me go : for thou knowest my service which I have done thee .

translation.kha: Ka Ashteroth ka ong , U nongshun Jong ngi , u nongpynshitom jong ngi , u dei une u briew Uba snep , u Haman ! U Haman u khmih sha u syiem pynlang ka mahadei da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: And Esther said , The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman . Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen .

translation.kha: Ka kyrteng jrong me kane ym long shuh u Abram , hynñiew u Aram , naba nga pynlong ïa me u kper tymmen jongu ki jingbhabriew Ibbah badno .
translation.en: Neither shall thy name any more be called Abram , but thy name shall be Abraham  ; for a father of many nations have I made thee .
The  Lord  knoweth the thoughts of man , that they are vanity .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat ; u tip katno ki long ki bymshemphang ha kaba pynshong nongrim .
U la ong ha nga , Rung shapoh , bad peit ïa kaba sniew , ïa kiei kiei kiba ijli ba ki ïaleit hangta .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Go in , and behold the wicked abominations that they do here .
And he declared unto you his covenant , which he commanded you to perform , even ten commandments  ; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone .
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha phi kaei kaba phi dei ban leh ha kaba bat ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad phi , kata , ïa ki Shiphew Hukum ba u la thoh ha ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap .
A , phi ki bhabriew kiba bieit ! Slem katno keiñ phi dang kwah ban tama bieit ? Sa katno ken phin dang kmen ha kaweh rkhiebeiñ ïa ka jingtip ? Hato phim kwah ban ïoh jinghikai ?
translation.en: How long , ye simple ones , will ye love simplicity ? and the scorners delight in their scorning , and fools hate knowledge ?

translation.kha: Sangeh pynsmieij jongnga .
translation.en: Stop tickling me !

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei ha Israel : Ki briew jong nga ki la pyntngit ïa lade da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translation.en: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel : there is the whoredom of Ephraim , Israel is defiled .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta phi sngewlyngngoh bad phi kyr-eit ; baroh Katai kaba phi kyr-eit ka lama ka bakla .
translation.en: But now ye rejoice in your boastings : all such rejoicing is evil .

translation.kha: Ngi don ïa ka khak kum ka atiar jong ngi , ïa ka ban ïaleit bad ban ïada ïa lade ruh .
translation.en: By the word of truth , by the power of God , by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left ,

translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki synran , Ka por kan poi ha kaba phin kwah ban ïohi ïa kawei na ki snoh jrong U Khun U Briew , hynrei phin ym ïohi ïa ka .
translation.en: And he said unto the disciples ,  The days will come , when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man , and ye shall not see it .
For with what judgment ye judge , ye shall be judged : and with what measure ye mete , it shall be measured to you again .
translation.kha: naba U Blei un bishar ïa phi ha kajuh ka rukom kumba phi bishar ïa kiwei pat , bad un pyndei ha phi ïa kijuh ki jingthew kiba phi pyndei ïa kiwei pat .

A kat phi long kiba eh ryndang ! u Tahpenes u bthah ban kren . A katai ki dohnud jong phi ki long kum kiba mane blei thala , katno phi leh kyllut ïa ka khubor jong U Blei ! Phi long khim ki kpu tymmen jong phi : Phi ruh phi la ïai ïalaw ïa-pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid !
translation.en: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears , ye do always resist the Holy Ghost : as your fathers did , so do ye .

translation.kha: Ka Athalaïah ka kumwei jong u syiem Ahasaïah ka tang shu mar ïatip ïa ka jingshah pynpaw u khun jyllang ka , ka ai hukum ba yn pynïap ïa baher ki dkhot jongngi ka longïing syiem .
translation.en: And when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead , she arose and destroyed all the seed royal .

And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west , from Baal–gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak , that goeth up to Seir  ; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions  ;
translation.kha: U Joshua bad ki paid Israel ki la jop ïa ki syiem baroh kiba ha ka ri kaba sha sepngi jong ka Jordan , naduh Baalgad ha Them Lebanon haduh u Lum Halak ha ka phang shathie hajan Edom . U Joshua u pynïabynta ïa kane ka ri hapdeng ki jait Israel bad u ai ïa ka ha ki kum ka jingïohkynti baneh junom .
U Jisu u la jubor , Hato phim patar pule ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong ba ha kaba mynnyngkong U Nongthaw u la thaw ïa ki briew , shynrang bad kynthei ?
translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  Have ye not read , that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female ,

translation.kha: Kumta sa la leit hangta bad na la ïohi ïa u nongtem khie ba u trei ha ka shalyntem jong u .
translation.en: Then I went down to the potter s house , and , behold , he wrought a work on the wheels .

translation.kha: Me daym ruh ban dih khyndiat ka um , ar khuri shuh sngi .
translation.en: Thou shalt drink also water by measure , the sixth part of an hin : from time to time shalt thou drink .

translation.kha: Ki erlangthari ki Wan na sanphew shathie , bad ka lyer khait na shaphang shatei .
translation.en: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind : and cold out of the north .
Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan , that ye shall set up these stones , which I command you this day , in mount Ebal , and thou shalt plaster them with plaster .
translation.kha: bad ynda phi la poi sha shiliang ka Jordan , pynïeng ïa kita ki maw ha u lum Ebal , kumba nga la hukum ïa phi mynta ka sngi , bad ñiad astor ïa ki .
Nga la khmih ïa kiwei patar ki jubab hynrei ngam shem ei ei . Nga la shem uwei u briew na ki shihajar ngut uba nga lah shun burom , hyndai ym don kawei ruh ka kynthei .
translation.en: Which yet my soul seeketh , but I find not : one man among a thousand have I found  ; but a woman among all those have I not found .
Among which was Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James and Joses , and the mother of Zebedee s children .
translation.kha: Napdeng jong ki , ki long ka Mari ka nong Magdala , ka Mari ka kmie u Jakob bad u Josis bad ka tnga u Sebedi .

Kumta u Ïoannis u la ong ha ki baroh , Nga pynbaptis ïa phi da ka um , hynriewphew don uwei pat uba wang umbah khah khraw ban ïa nga . Ngam long uba mala kdew ban loit ïa ki sotti jong u . Un pynbaptis ïa phoi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid dara da ka ding .
translation.en: John answered , saying unto them all , I indeed baptize you with water  ; but one mightier than I cometh , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose : he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire :
This only would I learn of you , Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha nga ïa kane kawei : Hato phi pdiang ïa U Mynsiem U Blei da kaba leh ïa kaei ba ka Hukum ka dawa ne da kaba ïohsngew ïa ka Gospel bad ngeit ïa ka ?

translation.en: Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests , the word of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness .
translation.kha: bad u Annas bad u Kaïaphas ki la long ki rangbah lyngdoh . Ha kata ka por , ka ktien jong U Blei ka la wan ha u Ïoannis u khun jong u Sekharaïah , ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: Even so ye , forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts , seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church .
translation.kha: Namar ba phi kwah hir hir ïa ki jingai jong U Mynsiem , phi dei ban pyrshang nalor kiei kiei baroh ban kham pyndonkam ïa kito kiba long jingïarap ban tei ïa ka balang .
Nobah U blang u la ieit katta katta ïa ka pyrthei kat haduh ba u la aiti noh ïa U Khun ba tyngka mawthew jongnga u , ba uno isangsot uba ngeit ha u un ym ïap noh hynrei un ïoh ïa ka jingim bymkhuid .
translation.en: For God so loved the world , that he gave his only begotten Son , that whosoever believeth in him should not perish , but have everlasting life .

translation.kha: Kata ka khñium shakri ka la ïohi ïa u hangta bad ka la sdang ban ong biang kumjuh ha kiba ïa-ïeng hangta , U long uwei na ki !
translation.en: And a maid saw him again , and began to say to them that stood by , This is one of them .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Saul ki wait ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa kaba u Saul u la ong , bad u Dabid u sngewbha ïa ka jingpyrkhat ba un sa long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem . Ha ka sngi shuwa ka jingkyntiew kurim ,
translation.en: And when his servants told David these words , it pleased David well to be the king s son in law : and the days were not expired .
But , behold , the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table .
translation.kha: Hynrei , ha khmih ! Uta uba shetkylla ïa nga u don hangne ha ka miej lem bad nga !

translation.en: How can it be quiet , seeing the  Lord  hath given it a charge against Ashkelon , and against the sea shore ? there hath he appointed it .
translation.kha: Kumno ka lah ban shongthait , haba nga la ai kam ïa ka ban leh ? Nga la hukum ïa ka ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ashkelon bad ïa ki briew kiba sah ha ki rud duriaw .
Kawei phi ai jingmut ïa nga ban leh ? u kylli . Kaei ba lang ong ha ki briew kiba ong ïa nga ba ngan pynsting ïa ki jingkit jong ki ?
translation.en: And he said unto them , What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people , which have spoken to me , saying , Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us ?

translation.kha: Kumta haba ki nong Samaria ki la wan ha u , ki la kyrpad ïa u ban Hukum bad ki , bad U Jisu u la sah hangta ar sngaid .
translation.en: So when the Samaritans were come unto him , they besought him that he would tarry with them : and he abode there two days .
When thou goest forth to war against thine enemies , and the  Lord  thy God hath delivered them into thine hands , and thou hast taken them captive ,
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u pynjop thma ïa phi bad phi ïohkem koidi ,
Lada ka long kumta , to ainong ha la ka burom bad ka jingsarong ; kup ïa lai da ka jingitynnat bad ka burom ,
translation.en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency  ; and array thyself with glory and beauty .

translation.kha: Bad katto katne ki symboh ki la hap ha ka khynñiat babha ; ki jingthung ki la sai bad ki la pynmih syiemsad , da ki spah Sibmah uei uwei . Bad U Jisu u la pynkut , Shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !
translation.en: And other fell on good ground , and sprang up , and bare fruit an hundredfold .  And when he had said these things , he cried ,  He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
He slept the whole night .
translation.kha: U Thiah Baroh Shimiet .
Ko khun u briew , to ud kumba ka dohnud jong me ka la pait ha ka jingjynjar . To ud da ka jingsngewsih ha kaba baroh kin khmih ïa me .
translation.en: Sigh therefore , thou son of man , with the breaking of thy loins  ; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes .
For ye have the poor with you always , and whensoever ye will ye may do them good : but me ye have not always .
translation.kha: Phin don borabor ïa ki briew kiba duk bad phi , bad ha kano kano ka por ba phi kwah , phi lah ban ïarap ïa ki . Hynrei phin ym ïoh borabor ïa nga .
Hynrei phin la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka hukum U Trai U Blei jong phi , bad phim treh ban sien rung sha kata ka ri .
translation.en: Notwithstanding ye would not go up , but rebelled against the commandment of the  Lord  your God :
