translation.kha: U Moses u ithuh , bad U Trai u ong ha u , Khie leit ïahiar Bad maham ïa ki briew ban ym jam ïa u pud shun wanpaw khmih ïa nga ; lada ki leh kumta , bun na ki kin ïap .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go down , charge the people , lest they break through unto the  Lord  to gaze , and many of them perish .
This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon , and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David . And Hezekiah prospered in all his works .
translation.kha: U dei u syiem Hesekaïah uba set ïa ka jingmih ka um na ka Umpohliew Gihon bad ban pun ïa ka um ba kan tuid lyngba ka nur-um sha ka tduh hapoh ki kynroh jong ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: And Elijah took twelve stones , according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob , unto whom the word of the  Lord  came , saying , Israel shall be thy name :
translation.kha: U shim khat-ar tylli ki maw , uwei uwei na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait ba la shim kyrteng na ki khun u Jakob , u briew ïa uba U  Trai  u la ai ka kyrteng u Israel .
Ma nga , U Trai , nga ong ba ka por kan wan haba ngan pyndap ïa ka ri Israhaïah bad Judah da ki briew badno ki mrad .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man , and with the seed of beast .

translation.kha: U Manasseh u wanrah ïa ka kam jong ki ha khmat U Trai ,
translation.en: And Moses brought their cause before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka long kumne . Ka kynthei ka shim Khyndiat u thiat bad ka khleh ïa u bad sawphew kilo u purew poi haduh ba ka lyngngun kpu baroh kawei ka sieb .
translation.en: It is like leaven , which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal , till the whole was leavened .
Who was delivered for our offences , and was raised again for our justification .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ki pop jong ngi , la aiti ïa u ban ïap , bad ïa u la pynmihpat khnang ban pynlong ka hok ïa ngi bad U Blei .

translation.en: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not , nor rejected ; but received me as an angel of God , even as Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat la ka jinglong ka met jong nga ka la long ka jingtynjuh bakhraw ïa phi , phim shym la ibeiñ ne kyntait ïa nga . Pynban phi la pdiang ïa nga kumba phi pdiang ïa u angel na bneng ; phi la pdiang ïa nga kumba phi pdiang ïa U Khrist Jisu hi .

translation.en: So when they had gone through all the land , they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days .
translation.kha: Kumta hadien khyndai bnai bad arphew sngi ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem , da kaba ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: Paul , and Silvanus , and Timothy , unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Na u Paul , u Silas bad u Timothi — Ha ki parabangeit jong ka balang ha Thessaloni , kiba long ki jong U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad ki jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai :

translation.en: And the Hivite , and the Arkite , and the Sinite ,
translation.kha: ki Hib , ki Ark , ki Sin ,

Nga la jied ruh ïa u Oholiab u khun jong u Ahisamakh , na ka jait Dan , ban ïatrei lem bad u . Nga la ai ruh ïa ka jinglah kaba bakhraw ha Kiwei pat ki mynjur kiba tbit , khnang ba ki la ban shna ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ba dih ban shen :
translation.en: And I , behold , I have given with him Aholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan : and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom , that they may make all that I have commanded thee  ;

Wherefore , when I came , was there no man ? when I called , was there none to answer ? Is my hand shortened at all , that it cannot redeem ? or have I no power to deliver ? behold , at my rebuke I dry up the sea , I make the rivers a wilderness : their fish stinketh , because there is no water , and dieth for thirst .
translation.kha: Balei ba ki briew jong nga kim jubab haba nga la leit sha ki ban pynim ïa ki ? Balei ba kim phai ktien haba nga la khot ïa ki ? Hato nga tlot eh ban pynim ïa ki ? Nga lah ban pynrngad noh ïa ka duriaw da kaba shu hukum bad pynkylla ïa ki wah sha ka ri shyiap , ba ki dohkha kiba don ha ki kin ïap na ka jingduna um .
Ki la ïeng khim pajih bad ki la pyntha , Ko Jisu ! Ko Kynrad ! To isynei ïa ngi !
translation.en: And they lifted up their voices , and said , Jesus , Master , have mercy on us .

translation.kha: Ym dei ban leh ei ei ïa kata ka briew , namar kam shyiap la leh ïa ka pop ba ka dat ban ïap , ibha kane ka kam ka ïasyriem kum ïa kato kaba u briew u shoh malu pynap ïa uwei patiaw u briew .
translation.en: But unto the damsel thou shalt do nothing  ; there is in the damsel no sin worthy of death : for as when a man riseth against his neighbour , and slayeth him , even so is this matter :

translation.kha: Mynsngi badno mynsngi ngi kyrpad ïa u da ka dohnud jong i baroh ban shahïap ïa ngi Ban ïohi ïa phi markhmat bad pun pyndap ïa kaei ka donkam ha ka jingngeit Jong phi .
translation.en: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face , and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith ?

translation.kha: Hato me ha ban pyndap ïa ka snieh jong u da ki synrum pynjop dohkha ? ne dung ïa ka khlieh da u proh dung dohkha ?
translation.en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons ? or his head with fish spears ?

translation.kha: U Blei um khim jied ïa ngi ban shah ïa ka jingbitar jong u , hynrei ban ïoh ïa ka jingpynim Lyngba U Jisu Khrist kiba U Trai jong ngi ,
translation.en: For God hath not appointed us to wrath , but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ ,

translation.kha: Naba u Ïoannis u long uta ïa uba ka jingthoh bakhuid ka ainong . ‘ U Blei u la Ong , ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien jong nga ha shuwa jong me ban pyllew ka lynti na ka pyntwa jong me .’
translation.en: For this is he , of whom it is written , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingpule ka Baibl lehse lah ban pynbiang ïa ka nga bad ka jaka ka ban suk ïa phi .
translation.en: A Bible study can usually be arranged at a time and place convenient to you .

translation.kha: Ka Rebekka ka ba-don u hynmen uba kyrteng u Laban ; dara u Laban u la Mareshah bran bran shabar ban leit sha kata ka pukri ha kaba u shrak jong u Abraham u don .
translation.en: And Rebekah had a brother , and his name was Laban : and Laban ran out unto the man , unto the well .

translation.kha: Kumne ka jingainguh bam , wanrah u purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kila u purew Lem bad nawei u masi lyngraw ; ar kilo u purim slem bad u langbrot ;
translation.en: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one bullock  ; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one ram  ;
And the  Lord  took me as I followed the flock , and the  Lord  said unto me , Go , prophesy unto my people Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la shim ïa nga na ka kam kum u nongaplangbrot bad u la hukum ïa nga ban wan bad ïathuhlypa ha ki briew jong u ki Israel .

Ïa kaei kiei baroh la lai kat Kum ka jinglum bad ka jingrai U Blei ; badno U Blei u la jied ïa ngi ban long ki briew jong u hi ha U Khrist namar ka jingthmu jong u hi , ba la pynshong nongrim ha kaei kaba u la rai naduh kabu mynnyngkong .
translation.en: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance , being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will :

translation.kha: Nangta u Pharaoh u phah khot kyrkieh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong , “Nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi , sad ïa phiah ruh .
translation.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste  ; and he said , I have sinned against the  Lord  your God , and against you .
But all the cattle , and the spoil of the cities , we took for a prey to ourselves .
translation.kha: Ngi rah noh ïa ki jingri , bad ki jinglute na ki shnong jong ki .

translation.en: Yea , ye overwhelm the fatherless , and ye dig a pit for your friend .
translation.kha: Phi te phi nud ban kynting sbai ïa ki khunswet mraw bad pynlong riewspah ïa lade na ki paralok bajan tam eh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will send upon them the sword , the famine , and the pestilence , and will make them like vile figs , that cannot be eaten , they are so evil .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong , ‘ Nga wallam ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang ha ki , bad ngan pynlong ïa ki kum ki soh Dumbur kiba la pyut eh ïa ka ban bam .

translation.en: Peace be to the brethren , and love with faith , from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba U Kpa bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha ki parabangeit baroh ïa ka jingsuk bad ka jingieit da ka jingngeit .

translation.en: All nations before him are as nothing  ; and they are counted to him less than nothing , and vanity .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew kim long ei ei satia ha u .

Namar U Blei um shyiap la ong ha uno isangsot na ki angel jong u , Me long u khun jong nga ; mynta ka sngi nga la long U Kpa jong me . Lymne U Bel um shym la ong shaphang uno uno u angel , Ngan long U kpu u jong u sad un long u khun jong nga .
translation.en: For unto which of the angels said he at any time , Thou art my Son , this day have I begotten thee ? And again , I will be to him a Father , and he shall be to me a Son ?

translation.kha: Kordit ïa u Briew uba ong , len tei ïa lade ka ïing paki spel bad ki Hall kiba khyllied shajrong ki bit . Kumta u buh ki jingkhangïit ha ka ïing jongno u , bad u shnong biar da ki dien Kedar , bun u airong ïa ka da ka rong saw .
translation.en: That saith , I will build me a wide house and large chambers , and cutteth him out windows  ; and it is ceiled with cedar , and painted with vermilion .

translation.kha: Ka riewkynthei kaba long tang mareh , ka me don mano myn ban sumar ïa ka , ka la shuh ïa la ka jingkmen ha U Blei bad ka ïai duwai bad pan na u ïa ka jingïarap mynmiet bad mynsngi .
translation.en: Now she that is a widow indeed , and desolate , trusteth in God , and continueth in supplications and prayers night and day .
And the second time the cock crew . And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him ,  Before the cock crow twice , thou shalt deny me thrice .  And when he thought thereon , he wept .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u syiar u kyn-ih ha ka sien kaba ar , bad u Petros u la kynmaw kumno ba U Jisu u la lah ong ïa u ,  Shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih ar sien , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .  Bad u la pait ka dohnud bad u la lynñiar kthang .
Ki la don ha byndi la kham skhem , bad u bapar u la buh ïa u Joseph ban peit ïa ki .
translation.en: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them , and he served them : and they continued a season in ward .

translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa pha ïa ka ksiar ha ka jaka ka rnong , ka rupa malu ka tama ha ka jaka u nar bad ka dieng , bad u narud ha ka jaka u maïan . Ki nongsynshar jongngi phah ken ym barben shuh ïa pha ; lang! pynpang ïa ki ban synshar da ka hok bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: For brass I will bring gold , and for iron I will bring silver , and for wood brass , and for stones iron : I will also make thy officers peace , and thine exactors righteousness .
Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet . For in that he put all in subjection under him , he left nothing that is not put under him . But now we see not yet all things put under him .
translation.kha: La ong ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa u briew  u nongsynshar halor kiei kiei baroh ;  kane ka paw shai ba ka kynthup ïa kiei kiei baroh . Pynban , ngim pat ïohi ba u briew un synshar halor kiei kiei baroh mynta .
U buh ïa kata ka jingbam baroh’ ha ki ktem u Aaron bad ki khur shynrang jong u , sad ki ai ïa kine kum ka jingai kaba kyr-ang sha U Trai .
translation.en: And he put all upon Aaron s hands , and upon his sons  hands , and waved them for a wave offering before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Naba kito kiba leh kum ïa kita kai kiei Ki shakri ïa U Khrist uba U Trai jong ine , hynrei ïa ki jingkwah jong ki hi . Da ki ktien jali bam-im bad ka jingïakren pynhapoh , ki shukor ïa ki briew uba lui lui .
translation.en: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ , but their own belly ; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple .

translation.kha: U blei sha iwei pat u rangïapom bad u kylli ïa u ïa kajuh ka jinglehkai , bun Man ba u kylli , u ïohi ïa kiaw ka jubab .
translation.en: And he turned from him toward another , and spake after the same manner : and the people answered him again after the former manner .

translation.kha: Hato phi la ïohi ïa uno uno u brai kum u Job ? Um ju pyn-i jingburom ïa U Blei .
translation.en: What man is like Job , who drinketh up scorning like water ?
Luke , the beloved physician , and Demas , greet you .
translation.kha: U Loukas , u doktor ba-ieit jong ngi , bad u Demas ki phah ki jingai khublei ïa phi .

translation.en: Servants , be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh , with fear and trembling , in singleness of your heart , as unto Christ ;
translation.kha: Ki mraw , to kohnguh ïa la ki kynrad da ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingkhynñiuh ; bad leh ïa ka da ka dohnud basngur , kumba phi shakri ïa U Khrist .
Haba kumta , phi daym ne phim dei u syiem ? Ka Jesebel ka Jubab , To khie joit na jingthiah , lymne sad to bam . ngam pynïoh ha phi ïa ka bri shaïong u Naboth !
translation.en: And Jezebel his wife said unto him , Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel ? arise , and eat bread , and let thine heart be merry : I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite .

This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly , that said in her heart , I am , and there is none beside me : how is she become a desolation , a place for beasts to lie down in ! every one that passeth by her shall hiss , and wag his hand .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kaei ka ban jia ïa ka nongbah kaba sarong katta katta ïa la ka bor bad kaba pyrkhat ba ka don ha ka jingshngain . Ki briew jong ka ki pyrkhat ba ka nongbah jong ki ka long kaba khraw tam ha ka pyrthei . Katno kan long ka jaka kaba kynjah , ka jaka ha kaba ki mradkhlaw kin pynjahthait ! Uwei uwei baroh uba ïaid lyngba jong ka un kynran dien ha ka jingsheptieng .

Kumta ki la pyndih buaid ïa la u kpa ha Katai ka miet ruh , sad kata ka khun kaba ar ka leit ïathiah shongkha bad u . Ha Kanah ka kynti shiah u la buaid ibha palat kat haduh ba um tip) ei ei shaphang kata .
translation.en: And they made their father drink wine that night also : and the younger arose , and lay with him  ; and he perceived not when she lay down , nor when she arose .
And , lo , the angel of the Lord came upon them , and the glory of the Lord shone round about them : and they were sore afraid .
translation.kha: U angel jong U Trai u la mihpaw ha ki , bad ka burom jong U Trai ka la tyngshaiñ halor jong ki . Ki la sngewsheptieng shikatdei eh ,

translation.en: Then he took unto him the twelve , and said unto them ,  Behold , we go up to Jerusalem , and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïalam sharud ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad u la ong ha ki ,  Ha sngap ! Ngi ïaleit sha Jerusalem ha kaba ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la thoh shaphang U Khun U Briew kan urlong shisha .

translation.en: And the man of thine , whom I shall not cut off from mine altar , shall be to consume thine eyes , and to grieve thine heart : and all the increase of thine house shall die in the flower of their age .
translation.kha: Pynban ngan pynsah ïa uwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong me bad un shakri ïa nga kum u lyngdoh . Hynrei uta ruh un sa matlah bad duh jingkyrmen , bad baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong me kin ïap shyrkhei .
Kin ki long ki khun ki ksiew na u Shemaïah , u Ham , bad u Japheth , ki khun shynrang Jong u Noah . Kinah lai jngut ki la ïoh khun shyieng hadien kata ka jingshlei um .
translation.en: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah , Shem , Ham , and Japheth : and unto them were sons born after the flood .

translation.kha: Nga la wan ba ki khun shynriah ktien ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki kop jong ki , ki khun kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kmie lad ki , ki pyrsa kurim kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kiaw kurim jong ki ;
translation.en: For I am come to set a man at variance against his father , and the daughter against her mother , and the daughter in law against her mother in law .

U Moses u la jop ïa u , bad ruh ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Midian : u Ebi , u Rekem , u Sur , u Hur , bad u Reba . Kine baroh ki la synshar na ka bynta u Sihon .

U Akhish u Khot ïa u Dabid , bad u ong ha u , Nga sma ha U Blei suba im jong ki Eliel ba phi long Uba hok ïa nga ; sad nga hi nga sngewdei ba phin leit ryngkat bad na shai ka thma ; naba ngam shym la shem kano kano ka jingbakla ha phi naduh ka sngi ba phi wan sha nga haduh kane ka sngi . Hynrei Kawei pat ki syiem kim pdeng ïa phi .
translation.en: Then Achish called David , and said unto him , Surely , as the  Lord  liveth , thou hast been upright , and thy going out and thy coming in with me in the host is good in my sight : for I have not found evil in thee since the day of thy coming unto me unto this day : nevertheless the lords favour thee not .

translation.kha: nangta katai katne nguid na ki Pharisi napdeng u paidbah ki la kruiñ ïa U Jisu! . Ko nongïoh , ki la ong , hukum ïa ki synran jongnga me ban sngap wad !
translation.en: And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him , Master , rebuke thy disciples .

translation.kha: Ki la pynkhih ïa ka jingbat U Trai da ki jingleh jong ki , bad ka jingpang bashyrkhei ka la miaw hap jong ki .
translation.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions : and the plague brake in upon them .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki kynriah jaka tang lada uta u lyoh u kiew shajrong na kata ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle , the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys :
The  Lord  hath made all things for himself : yea , even the wicked for the day of evil .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  u la thaw ki don la ki jingkut ; bad ka jingkut jong u bymman ka long ka jingjot .

Ïa baroh kiei kaei babha khraw bad kiba phylla kiba u la leh , kumjuh pajut ïa baroh ka jingïathuhkhana kumno ba u la pynkiew ïa u Merodakh shata ka kyrdan treikam kaba halor , la buh jingkynnoh ha ki jingthoh ba dei ïa ki syiem ka Persia bad Media .
translation.en: And all the acts of his power and of his might , and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai , whereunto the king advanced him , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia ?

translation.kha: Pynïaid ïa ka rai jong ki bad leh thik kumba ki bthah ïa phi .
translation.en: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee , and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee , thou shalt do : thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee , to the right hand , nor to the left .

translation.kha: Lada ka kun baroh kawei ka long tang ka khmat , da kumno yn ïohsngew ? Bad lada ka long tang ka shkor , da kumno yn iw ?
translation.en: If the whole body were an eye , where were the hearing ? If the whole were hearing , where were the smelling ?

translation.kha: U syiem u la leit sping shapoh ngab khmih ïa kiba shah khot sngewbha bad u la ïohi ïa u bhabriew babha khlem phong ki jaiñ shongkurim .
translation.en: And when the king came in to see the guests , he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment :

translation.kha: bad ong ha u Samuel , To ïaw duwai ha U Tharai U Blei jong i'u ban ïapyllait im ïa ngi na ki Philistia .
translation.en: And the children of Israel said to Samuel , Cease not to cry unto the  Lord  our God for us , that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines .

translation.kha: Halor kane borbah , kadei kaba ngi lah ban ong ? “lada U Blei u long na ka bynta jong ngi , mano ba lah ban ïalaw pyrshah ïa me ?
translation.en: What shall we then say to these things ? If God be for us , who can be against us ?
And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven , having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth , and to every nation , and kindred , and tongue , and people ,
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa uwei pat u angel uba her shajrong eh ha suiñ , lem bad ka khubor bymjukut jong ka Khubor Babha ban pynbna ha ki briew ka pyrthei , ha kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew , ka jait , ka ktien bad ka kynja bynriew .
Ong ha ki Israel , uno uno na phi lano u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong phi , uba ai ïa uwei na ki khun jyllang u ha u blei Molekh , u dei ban shah lynthem maw ha u paidbah haduh ba un da ïap .
translation.en: Again , thou shalt say to the children of Israel , Whosoever he be of the children of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel , that giveth any of his seed unto Molech  ; he shall surely be put to death : the people of the land shall stone him with stones .

translation.kha: Kin ai ka jingkhlaiñ ïa ki kti kiba la thait bad ïa ki khohsiew bakyiuh da ka jingtlot .
translation.en: Strengthen ye the weak hands , and confirm the feeble knees .
Who are Israelites ; to whom pertaineth the adoption , and the glory , and the covenants , and the giving of the law , and the service of God , and the promises ;
translation.kha: Ki long ki briew jong U Blei ; u la pynlong ki khun jong u ïa ki bad u la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong u ha ki ; u la pynlong ki jutang bad ki bad u la ai ïa ki ka Hukum ; ki don ka jingmane bashisha ; ki la ïoh ïa ki jingkular U Blei ;
Haba U Trai u hukum ïa uta u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen ban shim ïa ka ding ngap ki shalyntem kiba ni hapoh ki khohruh , uta u briew u rung shapoh mala u ïeng hajan kawei na ki shalyntem .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen , saying , Take fire from between the wheels , from between the cherubims  ; then he went in , and stood beside the wheels .

translation.kha: Ki ksuid ki la kyrpang ïa U Jisu ban ym phah ïa ki sha ka liewlong khlem trai .
translation.en: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep .

translation.kha: thaba U Tlai u hukum ïa uta u briew uba Phong da ki jaiñ lin ïa-ban shim ïa ka dong napdeng ki shalyntem kiba don hapoh ki kherub , uta u bri u rung shapoh bad u ïeng hajan kawei na ki lynthem .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen , saying , Take fire from between the wheels , from between the cherubims  ; then he went in , and stood beside the wheels .

translation.kha: u sangot u la pynbna ha ka sur bajam , Ko ki briew jong ki ri bhor , ki jaitbynriew bad ki khait ktien !
translation.en: Then an herald cried aloud , To you it is commanded , O people , nations , and languages ,

translation.kha: Naba nga ong ïa phira ba ka jingim jong ka jingrkhie U Khrist ka la long na ka bynta ki Jiw , ban pyn-i ba U Blei u long uba ïaineh , ban pynlong ïa ki kular jrong u ha ki kpa tymmen jongki ki don eriong Shishak ,
translation.en: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God , to confirm the promises made unto the fathers :

translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Moses , NGA LONG UBA NGA LONG . Kane ka long Kiei kambah me dei ban ong ha ki : ‘ Uta ïa uba la khot ïa-bta Ang LONG u pha ïa nga sha phi .’
translation.en: And God said unto Moses , I AM THAT I AM : and he said , Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel , I AM hath sent me unto you .

translation.kha: Baroh kaba ki kynthah ka long ba ngin kynmaw ïa kiba kyrdoh ha ka kynruh jong ki , kaban nga hi ruh nga da kwah eh ba-bang leh .
translation.en: Only they would that we should remember the poor ; the same which I also was forward to do .

translation.kha: Ki nongbah synshar ki buh ïa ka kot Kloi ha ka kamra u Elmadam , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , badno ki leit sha ka phyllaw ka ïingsyiem , bad ki la ïathuh ïa baroh kiei keiñ ha u syiem .
translation.en: And they went in to the king into the court , but they laid up the roll in the chamber of Elishama the scribe , and told all the words in the ears of the king .

translation.kha: tong ïa ki nongbishar bad kiwei patan ki ngab synshar ha man la ka shnong ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi . kine kin shrah hok ïa ki briew .
translation.en: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , throughout thy tribes : and they shall judge the people with just judgment .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei kai kaba U Trai’ u ong shaphang ka Damaskos : Ki brisoh ha ki nongbah jong ka Hamath bad ka Arpad ki khublei bad ki sngew jinglur namar ki la ïohsngew ïa ki khlur basniew . Ka jinglyng-a ka tyllun hajir jong ki kum ka duriaw , bad kim ïoh khiat .
translation.en: Concerning Damascus . Hamath is confounded , and Arpad : for they have heard evil tidings : they are fainthearted  ; there is sorrow on the sea  ; it cannot be quiet .

translation.kha: Kumta nga leit sha u Bad nga pynïap ïa u , namar nga tip ba un sa ïap hi la kumno Kamon un tang shu kyllon . Nangta ang rim ïa ka pansngiat na ka khlieh jong u bad ïa ka jingdeng na ka ksang ti jong u , bad nga la wallam ïa ki sha phi , ko kynrad .
translation.en: So I stood upon him , and slew him , because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen : and I took the crown that was upon his head , and the bracelet that was on his arm , and have brought them hither unto my lord .
And the golden altar , and the anointing oil , and the sweet incense , and the hanging for the tabernacle door ,
translation.kha: ïa ka duwan ksiar , ïa ka umphniang pynsleh , ïa ka jingiwbih , ïa ka pyrda ïa ka jaka rung sha ka Ïingjaiñ ;

translation.en: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and wash them with water .
translation.kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u sha ka khyrdop jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad ong ïa ki ban sum kat kum ka jinglehniam .

Wat la nga long u syiem uba la jied da U Blei , nga sngewtlot mynsiem ka sngi . Kine ki kynhun shynrang jong ka Seruïah ki long ka jingma ïa nga . To U Trei un pynshitom ïa kine ki nongkamsniew kumba ki dadien ban ïoh !
translation.en: And I am this day weak , though anointed king  ; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me : the  Lord  shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness .

translation.kha: U Trei u ino , Ko bamaïan , pha long u tyrnem jong nga , ka atiar jong ar ha ka thma . Nga la pyndonkam ïa pha ban ïuhroit ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ïa ki shem ,
translation.en: Thou art my battle axe and weapons of war : for with thee will I break in pieces the nations , and with thee will I destroy kingdoms  ;

translation.kha: Nangta to la duwai , A Trai nongbanbor Baroh , me long u nongbishar ba bishar hok ; me tynjuh ïa ki jingkhangïit malu ki jingsngew jngai ki briew . Nga la buh ïa ka kam jong nga ha ki ktem jong me ; kumta shah ïa nga ban khmih ïa me ba me pynhiarkput halor kine ki briew .
translation.en: But , O  Lord  of hosts , that judgest righteously , that triest the reins and the heart , let me see thy vengeance on them : for unto thee have I revealed my cause .
And the disciples were astonished at his words . But Jesus answereth again , and saith unto them ,  Children , how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God !
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la sngewkyndit halor kine ki ktien , hynrei U Jisu u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ko khun jong nga , katno ka long kaba eh ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei !

translation.en: For they are the spirits of devils , working miracles , which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world , to gather them to the battle of that great day of God Almighty .
translation.kha: Ki long ki mynsiem jong ki ksuid kiba leh ïa ki kambah . Kine lai tylli ki mynsiem ki leit noh sha ki syiem baroh jong ka pyrthei , ban lumlang ïa ki na ka bynta ka thma ha ka Sngi kaba khraw jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
Ïa kaei phi la leit ban peit ? Hato ïa u briew uba phong ki jaiñsem kiba itynnat ? Ïa ki briew kiba rai kumta bad kiba shong ha ka jingput kyrhai la shem ha ki ïingsyiem !
translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? Behold , they which are gorgeously apparelled , and live delicately , are in kings  courts .
And when he had opened the second seal , I heard the second beast say , Come and see .
translation.kha: Nangta U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait noh ïa ka jingpyndait kaba ar ; bad nga la ïohsngew ïa u jingthaw ba-im uba ar uba ong ,  To wan !
pynïap lut khoit ïa ki briew baroh’ ha kata ka shngain bad ïa ki jingri jong ki Baroh umdih . Pynjot de thiaw ïa kata ka shnong .
translation.en: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword , destroying it utterly , and all that is therein , and the cattle thereof , with the edge of the sword .

translation.kha: Me la pynlong ka jingkhaïi bastad bad me ïai pynïohnong . kat uba sarong me long ïa ka shab jong me !
translation.en: By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches , and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches :
The king of Jericho , one  ; the king of Ai , which is beside Beth–el , one  ;
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la jop ïa ki syiem jong kine ki nongbah : ka Jerikho , ka Ai ( hajan Bethel ) ,

translation.en: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet , and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin , which was by the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: u la hukum ba yn tied ïa nga bad ban pyndait kynjri hajan ka Khyrdop Benjamin bashaneng hapoh ka Templ .

Ha kane ka sngi kaba nyngkong , ai ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U Trai , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : khatlai tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki langbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , baroh ki dei ban hir ki bym Don kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; thirteen young bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year  ; they shall be without blemish :

translation.kha: Hynrei phin ong , Ho-oid , ïa ki tnat la pynkhlaiñ ei ban ai jaka na ka bynta jong na .
translation.en: Thou wilt say then , The branches were broken off , that I might be grafted in .
And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi Sabbaton , U Jisu u dang hikai ha ka synagog .

translation.en: But when thou doest alms , let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth :
translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi ïarap ïa u briew uba kyrduh , leh ïa ka ha kata ka rukom ba wat u paralok bajan tam jong phi un ym tip shaphang kata .
Ka long kaba shisha ba Ngi im ha ka pyrthei , hynrei ngiah ïaleh na ki jingthmu ba kynja pyrem .
translation.en: For though we walk in the flesh , we do not war after the flesh :

And they said , The  Lord  commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel : and my lord was commanded by the  Lord  to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi ban ïasam ïa ka ri ha ki paid Israel da kaba kynting sbai . U la hukum ruh ïa phi ban ai ïa ka bri ka khyndew jong u para kur jong ngi u Selophehad ha ki khun kynthei jong u .
To long naba laitluid na ka jingshah teh na ine uno — ka jingteh kaban phi dei ïa-ban shad , ka lama thrang don ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei . Uno une babha leh ïa Kanneh , u la kohnguh ïa ka suda .
translation.en: Owe no man any thing , but to love one another : for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law .
I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the end , the first and the last .
translation.kha: Nga long uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh , uba sdang bad uba kut .
Hynrei Un uno uba im ha ka pyrthei kiba im u don katto Katno ka jingkyrmen ; u kseh uba im u kham beh ban ïa u jingjot ba la ïap .
translation.en: For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope : for a living dog is better than a dead lion .
Seeing then that we have a great high priest , that is passed into the heavens , Jesus the Son of God , let us hold fast our profession .
translation.kha: Te , to ngin batskhem ïa ka jingngeit ïa kaba ngi phla . Naba ngi don U Rangbah Lyngdoh uba khraw uba la leit haduh ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei — U Jisu , U Khun U Blei .

A Trai , ai ba ki jingtim jong ki baroh kin arliang shispah lada ngam shym la shakri ba ïa me , lada ngam shym la ïasaid bad me na ka bynshet ki nongshun jong por mynba ki don ha ka jingjynjar malade jingeh bajur .
translation.en: The  Lord  said , Verily it shall be well with thy remnant  ; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction .

And Moses turned , and went down from the mount , and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand : the tables were written on both their sides  ; on the one side and on the other were they written .
translation.kha: U Moses u la leit hiar na uta u lum , u da rah ïa kita ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ki hukum ha baroh arliang .

U Jisu u la jubab , Hato phi khmih lynti ba Kiba Shah khot sngewbha shad ka jingkhawai shongkurim kin sngewsih katba u nongleitkurim u sdang dat lam bad ki ? Em kam hir kumta ! Hynrei ka sngi kan poi haba ïa u nongleitkurim yn shim noh na ki , bad kumta kew kin sa shahjingit .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Can the children of the bridechamber mourn , as long as the bridegroom is with them ? but the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken from them , and then shall they fast .

translation.kha: Kum ïa ki Anakim , la ju khot ruh ïa ki , ki Rephaim ; hynrei ki nong Moab ki khot ïa ki , ki Emim .
translation.en: Which also were accounted giants , as the Anakims  ; but the Moabites call them Emims .

The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it : for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon  ; and , behold , a greater than Solomon is here .
translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , ka syiem jong ka Sheba kan ïeng joit bad mudui ïa phi , namar ka la wan na la ka ri bajngai ban shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai bastad jong U Syiem Solomon ; bad nga pynthikna ïa phi ba don hangne uba kham khraw ban ïa u Solomon !

translation.en: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams , wherewith his spirit was troubled , and his sleep brake from him .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar ba u Nebukhadnessar u long syiem , u la ïoh ka jingphohsniew . Ka la pynkhuslai shibun eh ïa u kat haduh ba um shym ïohthiah ,
U Shuppim bad u Hosah ki ïoh ïa ka kyrdoh Kaba shaphang syngkai bad ka khyrdop Shallekheth ha ka surok kaba na neng . Ïa ka jingap phira la pynbynta ha ki nga ba la buh , kawei haduh kawei pat .
translation.en: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward , with the gate Shallecheth , by the causeway of the going up , ward against ward .
Now Barzillai was a very aged man , even fourscore years old : and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim  ; for he was a very great man .
translation.kha: U Barsillai u long uba la tymmen bha , u la phraphew snem ka rta . U long uba riewspah bha , bad u la pynbiang jingbam ïa u syiem mynba u dang sah ha Mahanaim .
bad un pynbunkam ïa Kawei pa kawei ka jingshukor bymman ha kito ki ba sa jot nala . Kin jot noh namar ba kdor pdiang sngewbha bad ieit ïa ka jingsuki khnang ba kin ïoh im .
translation.en: And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish ; because they received not the love of the truth , that they might be saved .
For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened , and have tasted of the heavenly gift , and were made partakers of the Holy Ghost ,
translation.kha: Naba da kumno lah ban ïalam pat ïa kito kiba la iehnoh ïa la ka jingngeit ba kin kylla-kaba-mut biang ? Ki la don shisien ha ka jingshai U Blei ; ki la ïohmad ïa ka jingai ba kynja bneng , bad ïohpdiang ïa la ka bynta na U Mynsiem Bakhuid ;
Te baroh ki synran ki la iehnoh ïa u pynlang ki la ïaphet noh .
translation.en: And they all forsook him , and fled .

translation.kha: ka Meon , bad ka Rakkon , kumwei hati ka jaka Syndong ka Joah .
translation.en: And Me–jarkon , and Rakkon , with the border before Japho .

translation.kha: Ka kham ba ban bam ïa u kpu ba la tyrkhong lem bad ka jingsuk mynhynnin ban ïa kiba Bam khawai ha ka ïing ka dap da ki jingjynjar .
translation.en: Better is a dry morsel , and quietness therewith , than an house full of sacrifices with strife .

translation.kha: ( Kito kiba la ïaleit pyrshah ïa u ki dadien u Sabad , u khun jong ka nong Ammon kaba kyrteng ka Siphmoth , bad u Jehosabad , u khun jong ka nong Moab kaba kyrteng ka Shimrith ) .
translation.en: And these are they that conspired against him  ; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess , and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess .

translation.kha: U syep ka Babilonia u lumrit ïa ka Templ , ïa ka ïing jingkynnoh ka Templ , bad ka spah jong u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , mala u kit baroh shai Babilon .
translation.en: And all the vessels of the house of God , great and small , and the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king , and of his princes  ; all these he brought to Babylon .

translation.kha: lang khmih ïa ka bad ïai ai um ïa ka . Ngan ap phira ïa ka mynmiet bad mynsngi khnang ba yn ym don mano mano u ban pynsniew ïa ka .
translation.en: I the  Lord  do keep it  ; I will water it every moment : lest any hurt it , I will keep it night and day .

translation.kha: Hato me la pan na U Blei ban pyn-i ha me ïa ki jingduna jong me , Bad hato me la kohnguh ban ym leh nongpop shuh ?
translation.en: That which I see not teach thou me : if I have done iniquity , I will do no more .
He that despised Moses  law died without mercy under two or three witnesses :
translation.kha: Uno uno u bymkohnguh ïa ka Hukum u Moses u shah pynïap khlem jingisynei haba la bishar pynrem halor ka sakhi jong ki ar ngut ne bun ki nongsakhi .

translation.en: The pure candlestick , with the lamps thereof , even with the lamps to be set in order , and all the vessels thereof , and the oil for light ,
translation.kha: ïa u diengpynïeng sharak ksiar , ïa ki sharak jong u , ïa ki tiar jong u baroh , bad ïa ka umphniang ïa ki sharak jong u ;

translation.en: And when Moses  father in law saw all that he did to the people , he said , What is this thing that thou doest to the people ? why sittest thou thyself alone , and all the people stand by thee from morning unto even ?
translation.kha: Haba u Jethro u la ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u Moses u dei ban leh , u la kylli ,  Kaei keiñ kane kaba phi leh na ka bynta u paidbah ? Balei phi shu leh hi marwei ïa kane baroh katba ki briew ki shu ïa-ïeng hangne naduh dang step haduh ban da miet ban ïasyllok bad me .

translation.en: And ye became followers of us , and of the Lord , having received the word in much affliction , with joy of the Holy Ghost :
translation.kha: Phi la pyrthuh bud ïa ngi bad ïa U Trai ; wat la phi la shahshitom shikatdei eh , phi la pdiang ïa ka khubor da ka jingkmen kaba wan na U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
Nangta u syiem Ahab u hukum ïa uwei na ki rangbah nongpynïaidkam , Kem ïa u Mikaïah bad ithuh lam ïa u sha u Amon , u lat ka nongbah , bad sha u khun Syiem Joash .
translation.en: Then the king of Israel said , Take ye Micaiah , and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city , and to Joash the king s son  ;

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ong ha u pyrta , Wat ym theh , ‘ U Syiem ki Jiw ,’ hynrei pynban , ‘ un u briew u la ong , nga long u Syiem ki Jiw .’
translation.en: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate , Write not , The King of the Jews  ; but that he said , I am King of the Jews .

translation.kha: Um don hangne ; la pynmihpat ïa u , kumba u la ong . Ale hangne bad peit ïa ka jaka ha kaba u la thiah .

translation.en: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them , they determined that Paul and Barnabas , and certain other of them , should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question .
translation.kha: U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la poi sha ka jingïasaid nia kaba jur bad ki shaphang kane , kumta la ïakut ba u Paul bad u Barnabas bad katto katne ngut kiwei pat ha Antiokh ki dei ban leit sha Jerusalem bad ïakynduh ïa ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang shaphang kane ka kam .

U Hanun bad ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah Sanoah , ki theh pat ïa ka Khyrdop Them . Ki pynkdang ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ïa ki jingkhang ka khyrdop , bad ki sha pynbuh ïa ka kynroh kaba sawspah sawphew milimitar , haduh ka syrdoh Synrum .
translation.en: The valley gate repaired Hanun , and the inhabitants of Zanoah  ; they built it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof , and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate .

translation.kha: Kumta nga kyrmen ba U Trai un map ïa nga haba nga synran ïa la u syiem sha ka templ u Rimmon , u blei Syria , bad mane ïa u . Da shisha U Trai un map ïa nga !
translation.en: In this thing the  Lord  pardon thy servant , that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there , and he leaneth on my hand , and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon : when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon , the  Lord  pardon thy servant in this thing .

translation.kha: shihajar laispah hynriewphew san shekel ka rupa ,
translation.en: Even those that were numbered of them , were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore .
When his candle shined upon my head , and when by his light I walked through darkness  ;
translation.kha: U Blei u long borabor bad nga ha kata ka por bad u ai jingshai ïa nga katba nga ïaid lyngba ïa ka jingdum .
Ha kata ka sngi U Trai u la hukum ïa ki paid Israel ban ai ïa kane ka bynta jong ka jingainguh . Ka dei ka aiñ ba ki paid Israel ki dei ban kohnguh pateng la pateng .
translation.en: Which the  Lord  commanded to be given them of the children of Israel , in the day that he anointed them , by a statute for ever throughout their generations .
If so be they will hearken , and turn every man from his evil way , that I may repent me of the evil , which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings .
translation.kha: Lehse ki briew kin shahshkor bad iehnoh ïa la ki lynti basniew . Lada ki leh kumta , te ngan kylla ïa la ka jingmut shaphang ka jingpynjot kaba nga la thmu ban wallam halor jong ki na ka bynta ki kam bymman jong ki .

translation.en: And there came a messenger unto Job , and said , The oxen were plowing , and the asses feeding beside them :
translation.kha: Katba ngi dang pynlur ïa ki lyngkha da ki masi lur ,  u la ong ,  bad ki kada ki dang ïabam phlang marjan .
Nangta U Trai u bitar lep ïa ki Israel , bad u ong , Kane ka jaitbynriew ka la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang Kaba nga la hukum ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki baneh sumar . namar ba kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga ,
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel  ; and he said , Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers , and have not hearkened unto my voice  ;
And he departed , and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him : and all men did marvel .
translation.kha: Kumta uta u briew u la leit bad u la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Dekapolis , da kaba ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la lah leh ïa u . Bad baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa kata , ki la sngewlyngngoh .

translation.en: The  Lord  thy God , he will go over before thee , and he will destroy these nations from before thee , and thou shalt possess them : and Joshua , he shall go over before thee , as the  Lord  hath said .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi hi un leit ha shuwa jong phi bad un pynjot ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba shong hangta , khnang ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jong ki ; bad u Joshua un long u nongïalam jong phi , kumba U  Trai  u la ong .
haba la ïashoh ha u Abda ba u Ahithophel u la ïadoh ngan bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong u Absalom , u la duwai , Ko Trai , Sngewbha pynpulom ïa ka jingbuaid u Iphtahel .
translation.en: And one told David , saying , Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom . And David said , O  Lord  , I pray thee , turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness .

Speak unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will profane my sanctuary , the excellency of your strength , the desire of your eyes , and that which your soul pitieth  ; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword .
translation.kha: ba ngan ai ha ki Israel ïa kane ka khubor : Pha sarong ha ka jingkhraw jong ka Templ . Pha sngewbha ban khmih ïa ka bad ban leit jngoh ïa ka , hynrei U  Trai  un pyntngit ïa ka . Bad ki dkhot ba kham samla ha ki longïing jong pha kiba la shah iehnoh ha Jerusalem kin shah pynïap ha ka thma .
Thung u briew wahbah stai u tip aïu kiei kiei ki kit jingmut shisha . Ka jingstad ka pynlong ïa u ban phuh samrkhie bad ka pynjah ïa ka jingnoh sngewsih ka durkhmat jong u .
translation.en: Who is as the wise man ? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing ? a man s wisdom maketh his face to shine , and the boldness of his face shall be changed .

translation.kha: Ka nongbah kaba la ïakhih bad ki paid Ishmael ka dei ka Gibeon , ha kaba katto katne ki Abib ki shongsah . Baroh kiwei pat ki la shahjop ha ka thma .
translation.en: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel , save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon : all other they took in battle .

translation.kha: Uta uba pyndap ïa uno uno u jingroi u dei ban buria ïa u , hynrei uta uba pynap ïa la u parabriew u dei ïa-ban shah pynïap .
translation.en: And he that killeth a beast , he shall restore it : and he that killeth a man , he shall be put to death .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai . . . ha ka snem kaweh khatwei jong ka jingshah ringmraw , U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the first day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
For as I passed by , and beheld your devotions , I found an altar with this inscription , TO THE UNKNOWN GOD . Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship , him declare I unto you .
translation.kha: Naba katba nga dang ïaid lyngba ka nongbah jong phi bad khmih ïa ki jaka ha kiba phi mane , nga la lap ïa ka duwan ha kaba la thoh , ‘ Ha U Blei uba ngim tip .’ Te ïa uta ïa uba phi mane , wat haba phim tip ïa u , ïa une keiñ nga pynbna mynta ha phi .

translation.en: And if ye walk contrary unto me , and will not hearken unto me  ; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins .
translation.kha: Lada phi dang ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad phim treh ban kohnguh ïa nga , ngan pynshitom shuh shuh ïa phi sa hynñiew shah .

translation.en: Yea , truth faileth  ; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey : and the  Lord  saw it , and it displeased him that there was no judgment .
translation.kha: Ka jinglonghok ka la nang duna katta katta ba uno uno uba kiar na kaba leh bymman u shem ïa lade ba u long u lanot jong ka kam runar .  U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa kane , bad ka la pynsngewsih ïa u ba ym don shuh ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: Not slothful in business ; fervent in spirit ; serving the Lord ;
translation.kha: To trei shitom bad wat long kiba alhia . To shakri ïa U Trai da ka dohnud kaba aiti lut .
U la hikai ha ki synagog malu uwei pa imat u la ïarieh ïa u .
translation.en: And he taught in their synagogues , being glorified of all .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Tlai Badonbor Baroh , nga la thung ïa ka Israel bad ka Judah ; hynrei mynta nga byrngem ïa ki da ka jingpynjot . Ki la wallam ïa kane halor jongki ki hi nalor ba ki la bor bakla ; ki la pynbitar ïa nga da kaba ai ki jingkñia ha u Baal .
translation.en: For the  Lord  of hosts , that planted thee , hath pronounced evil against thee , for the evil of the house of Israel and of the house of Judah , which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal .

translation.kha: Jamynrei U Trai u ong ha nga , ‘ wat tieng ïa u . Ngan aiti ïa u , ïa ki briew jongki u , bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh ha phi . Leh ïa u kumba phi la leh ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor Uba synshar ha Heshbon .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Fear him not : for I will deliver him , and all his people , and his land , into thy hand  ; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .
So Baasha slept with his fathers , and was buried in Tirzah : and Elah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Baasha u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Tirsah , bad u khun jong u , u Elah u la long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: That say , Let him make speed , and hasten his work , that we may see it : and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come , that we may know it !
translation.kha: Phi ong ,  Ai ba U  Trai  un pynstet bad leh ïa kaei kaba u ong ba un leh , ba kumta ngi lah ban ïohi ïa ka . Ai ba U Blei bakhuid ka Israel un pyndep ïa ki jingthmu jong u , to ngin khmih kaei u don ha ka jingmut jong u .

translation.en: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches , which hath devoured her fruit , so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule . This is a lamentation , and shall be for a lamentation .
translation.kha: Ka met jong u dieng sohwaiñ ka la kem ding ; ka ding ka la bam duh ïa ki tnat bad ïa u soh jong u . Ki tnat kin ym long shuh da lei lei kiba khlaiñ , kin ym long shuh da lei lei ki diengsynshar ba kynja syiem . Kane ka dei ka jingrwai jong ka jingsngewsih ; la ju rwai bad ïai rwai ïa ka .
Ym don mano mano baïar ka kynhun kiba la nud ban ïasoh mala ki , wat la ki paidbah ki la kren ïaroh ïa ki .
translation.en: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them : but the people magnified them .

translation.kha: Ngam ym leit pah bad phi , u Samuel u jubab . Phi la kyndit ïa ka hukum U Trai , pynlang u la kyntait ïa phi kumno u syiem ki Israel .
translation.en: And Samuel said unto Saul , I will not return with thee : for thou hast rejected the word of the  Lord  , and the  Lord  hath rejected thee from being king over Israel .
That ye may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets , and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour :
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ban kynmaw ïa ki ktien ïa kiba la kren lah slem bah da ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid , bad ïa ka hukum na U Trai bad U Nongpynim ïa kaba la ai ha phi da ki apostol .

translation.en: Who maketh his angels spirits  ; his ministers a flaming fire :
translation.kha: Me pyndonkam ïa ki lyer kum ki nonglamktien jong me bad ki jingthaba leilieh kum ki shakri jong me .

translation.en: And when they had received it , they murmured against the goodman of the house ,
translation.kha: Ki la shim la ka bainong bad ki la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa u nongaikam .
Ha u bitar , uei uba lah ban lait im ? Uei uba lah ban lait na ka jingbitar shna bashyrkhei jong u ? U theh napoh ïa ka jingbitar bameh ding jong u ; ki mawsiang ki lum pum ha khmat jong u .
translation.en: Who can stand before his indignation ? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger ? his fury is poured out like fire , and the rocks are thrown down by him .
And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite , and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite :
translation.kha: Haba u Iso u la dap sawphew snem ka rta , u shongkurim ïa ar ngut ki kynthei Hit , ka Judith ka khun jong u Beeri bad ka Basemath ka khun jong u Elon .

translation.en: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat , Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me , but evil ?
translation.kha: U Ahab u ong ïa u Jehoshaphat ,  Nga la ong ïa phi ba um juh ïathuhlypa ïa kano kano kaba bha ïa nga ; ka long borabor kaei kaei kaba sniew !
Ki long kiba mutlop bad kim burom ïa per , kumta nga phah ïa me sha ki bad men ong ha ki , ïa kaei kaba ma nga U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki .
translation.en: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted . I do send thee unto them  ; and thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God .
He hath dispersed , he hath given to the poor  ; his righteousness endureth for ever  ; his horn shall be exalted with honour .
translation.kha: U ai kylluid ïa kiba kyrduh , bad ka jingbhasbun jong u kam ju duh ; un long uba donbor bad uba ïoh burom .
Baroh kiei ktien kiba u Simri u la leh , kaba kynthih ïa ka jingïathuh Shaphang ka jingïasylla jong u , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri , and his treason that he wrought , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David : but David waxed stronger and stronger , and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh hapdeng ki kynhun ïaleh kiba ïashah ïa ka longïing jong u Saul bad kito kiba ïashah ïa u Dabid ka la neh slem bha . Katba u Dabid u nang khlaiñ nang khlaiñ , ki nongïaleh pyrshah jong u ki la nang tlot nang tlot .

translation.en: Leave there thy gift before the altar , and go thy way  ; first be reconciled to thy brother , and then come and offer thy gift .
translation.kha: to ieh ïa ka jingai jong phi hangta ha khmat jong ka duwan , khie leit shisyndon bad ïasuk bad la u para , bad nangta sa wan pat bad ai ïa ka jingai jong phi sha U Blei .
Nga don hangne hapdeng ki briew ïa uba me la jied kum la ki jong , ki briew kiba bhor paid jaka katta ba ym lah ñiew Shu ïa ki .
translation.en: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen , a great people , that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude .

translation.kha: dara u la ïa-ong , Ko Kynrad , to isynei ïa u khun jong nga ! U long umbiah pang rang mala u la ne ka jingkhie ring kaba shyrkhei eh ba bunsien u hap ha ka tyngkan lane ha ka um .
translation.en: Lord , have mercy on my son : for he is lunatic , and sore vexed : for ofttimes he falleth into the fire , and oft into the water .

translation.kha: Katba u dang kren , u lyoh uba tyngshaiñ u la wan halor jong ki , bad ka sur na u lyoh ka la ong , Une u long U Khun uba ieit jong nga , ha uba nga sngewbha eh — to shahshkor ïa u !
translation.en: While he yet spake , behold , a bright cloud overshadowed them : and behold a voice out of the cloud , which said , This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased  ; hear ye him .

translation.kha: Buh ïa ki mawlyngkniap hapoh ka pynkit , bad ïa ka jingtap halor Jong ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark  ; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee .

translation.kha: U ong ha u paidbah baroh , Une u maw un longïng u sorki ïa ngi . U la ïohsngew ïa ki ktem baroh ba U Trai u la kren ha ngi . Kumta un long u hikai pyrshah ïa phi , ban da ïa ph na kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto all the people , Behold , this stone shall be a witness unto us  ; for it hath heard all the words of the  Lord  which he spake unto us : it shall be therefore a witness unto you , lest ye deny your God .
And the people answered him after this manner , saying , So shall it be done to the man that killeth him .
translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ïa kaei ba yn leh ïa uta u briew uba pynïap ïa u Goliath .

Ma nga , bad ki hynñiew thut ki nongri jingmut , ngi phah ïa phi ban wad jingmihpat ïa ki jingrung jingman ha Jerusalem bad Judah khnang ban ïohi kumno ïa ka Law U Blei jong me , ïa naba la bynshet ha me , la kohnguh .
translation.en: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king , and of his seven counsellors , to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem , according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand  ;

translation.kha: To sngap ïa kane , pha kaba ieit ïa ka jinglehsngewbha , pha kob pyrkhat ba Phah shongshngain bad sngewskhem . Pha kam ba pha long kaba khraw khim U blang — ba ym don mano mano pat kum ma phah . Pha pyrkhat ba da lwa lei phan ym un-long ka riewkynthei lane mad ïa ka jingduh noh ïa la ki khun .
translation.en: Therefore hear now this , thou that art given to pleasures , that dwellest carelessly , that sayest in thine heart , I am , and none else beside me  ; I shall not sit as a widow , neither shall I know the loss of children :

translation.kha: U Jeroboam u tei ruh ïa ki tare mane ha kliar ki lum , bad u jied ïa ki lyngkhuh napdeng ki longïing ki bym dei na ka jait Lebi .
translation.en: And he made an house of high places , and made priests of the lowest of the people , which were not of the sons of Levi .

translation.kha: ka kharai kaban jylliew ha ka nongbeh Ahasaïah ; bad lang! pynshitom ïa phi baroh .
translation.en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter , though I have been a rebuker of them all .

translation.kha: Hynrei kito kiba shaniah ha U Trai Ban ieh jingïarap kin shem ba la pynthymmai ïa ka jingkhlaiñ lad ki . Kin ïong joit ha ki thngan kum ki pukni ; kin mareh bad kin ym sngewlwait ; kin ïadait bad kin ym sngewthait .
translation.en: But they that wait upon the  Lord  shall renew their strength  ; they shall mount up with wings as eagles  ; they shall run , and not be weary  ; and they shall walk , and not faint .

translation.kha: Suit na kita ki nongap jngai u , u ong , U Jesse , suba na ka shnong Bethlehem , u don u khun uba long u nongtem nongput naba tbit . U long ruh uba shlur bad naba bhabriew , u shipai uba bha bad Uba pnah thylliej . U Trai u don ryngkat bad u .
translation.en: Then answered one of the servants , and said , Behold , I have seen a son of Jesse the Beth–lehemite , that is cunning in playing , and a mighty valiant man , and a man of war , and prudent in matters , and a comely person , and the  Lord  is with him .
Therefore was the wrath of the  Lord  kindled against his people , insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki briew jong u ; u la sngewngiah ïa ki .
Ha kata kajuh ka miet ïa u Belshassar , u syiem ka Babilonia , la pynïap ;
translation.en: In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain .
After that he is sold he may be redeemed again  ; one of his brethren may redeem him :
translation.kha: Hadien ba la die ïa u , pynban u dang don hi ka hok ban shah thied biang .

Uei uba pynjrong ïa phi ngab sngew kham halor ïa kiwei pat ? Hattush ym dei U Bela uba la ai ha phoi baroh kaba phi ne ? Kumta , te , kumno phiah da ban sngewkynjah , kumba kaei kaba phi don , kim dei ka jingai Sngewbha ?
translation.en: For who maketh thee to differ from another ? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive ? now if thou didst receive it , why dost thou glory , as if thou hadst not received it ?
Also he built altars in the house of the  Lord  , whereof the  Lord  had said , In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever .
translation.kha: U tei ki duwan ki blei thala ha ka Templ , ka jaka ha kaba U  Trai  u la ong ba yn mane ïa u junom .
U Jisu u la jubab , ino uno uba dih na kane ka um un sliang pat , hynrei uno uno uba dkoh na ka um kaba ngan ai ha u un ym sliang shuh .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto her ,  Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again :

translation.kha: Tang hadien jingkyndit por , ki lyoh dum ki la tap ïa ka suiñbneng , ka lem ka sdang ban beh bad u slap bajur u tdong ban hap . U Ahab u shong ha ka kali ïapom bad u sdang ban leit phad sha Jehasiel .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the mean while , that the heaven was black with clouds and wind , and there was a great rain . And Ahab rode , and went to Jezreel .

translation.kha: Ki nuti bun ki kynthei lyngkar ki longsem ka jingriam kaba shyrkhei .
translation.en: For a whore is a deep ditch  ; and a strange woman is a narrow pit .

translation.kha: Kumta ki ïaid lait ïa ka Jebus bad ki ïai bteng ha ka lynter jong ki . Ka la Sephon sngi haba ki ïan poi ha Hephsibah kaweh ha ka ri ki Benjamin .
translation.en: And they passed on and went their way  ; and the sun went down upon them when they were by Gibeah , which belongeth to Benjamin .
Upon this I awaked , and beheld  ; and my sleep was sweet unto me .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ki briew kin ong , ‘ Nga la leit thiah bad nga la kyndit ha ka jingthymmai bor .’
Nga pahuh ha khmat jong u Joshua ïa uwei u maw uba don hynriew tyllai ki dong . Ngan shniah ka jingthoh halor jong u bad ha ka shi sngi nur-um shim noh ïa ka pep jong kane ka ri .
translation.en: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua  ; upon one stone shall be seven eyes : behold , I will engrave the graving thereof , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day .

translation.kha: Mynba te , lada kaei kaba phi kuna mynta ka sngi ïa u Hadien bad ïa ka longïing jong u ka long da kaba khuid mynsiem sad kaba hok , te to kumne bad u Amraphel bad ai ba un kumne bad phi .
translation.en: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day , then rejoice ye in Abimelech , and let him also rejoice in you :
And what concord hath Christ with Belial ? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel ?
translation.kha: Kumno U Khrist bad u Ksuid kin ïahap jingmut ? Kumno uba ngeit u don bynta bad u bymngeit ?
U Abraham u la kynriah noh na Mamre sha ki bynta bashathie jong ka Kanaan bad u la shong la sah pynpdang ka Kadesh bad ka shuh .
translation.en: And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country , and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur , and sojourned in Gerar .

translation.kha: Hynrei uta suba pynïasoh ïa lade sha U Trai u long kawei bad u ha kaba kynja mynsiem .
translation.en: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki la pyrshah da u nongleh myntor uba kyrteng u Elumas ( kata ka lama ka kyrteng jong u ha ka ktien Grik ) , uba la pyrshang ban pynphai noh ïa u lyngskor na ka jingngeit .
translation.en: But Elymas the sorcerer ( for so is his name by interpretation ) withstood them , seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith .

translation.kha: Ki riewsniew kim nang ïohthiah lymda ki ïoh ban leh ïa ka kam sniew ; ki peitmat sah lymda ki la ïoh pynmynsaw ïano ïano .
translation.en: For they sleep not , except they have done mischief  ; and their sleep is taken away , unless they cause some to fall .
And thou shalt put the mercy seat above upon the ark  ; and in the ark thou shalt put the testimony that I shall give thee .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ki mawlyngkniap hapoh ka synduk , bad ïa ka jingtap halor jong ka .
Kumta u Dabid u ong , Te sah hangne ha kane ka sngi , bad Lashai ngan phan pat ïa phi . Kumta u Uriah u la kamar-tama ha Jerusalem ha kata ka sngi bad ha ka sngi kaba bud .
translation.en: And David said to Uriah , Tarry here to day also , and to morrow I will let thee depart . So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day , and the morrow .
Then she said , I desire one small petition of thee  ; I pray thee , say me not nay . And the king said unto her , Ask on , my mother : for I will not say thee nay .
translation.kha: Ka ong ,  Nga don kawei ka jingkyrpad barit ban pan na me ; sngewbha wat kyrngah ïa nga .   Kaei kata , mei ?  u kylli .  Ngan ym kyrngah ïa phi .
