And the  Lord  said unto me , Fear him not : for I will deliver him , and all his people , and his land , into thy hand  ; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Wat tieng ïa u . Ngan aiti ïa u , ïa ki briew jong u , bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh ha phi . Leh ïa u kumba phi la leh ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor uba synshar ha Heshbon .’

kata ka long , ym ka jingïatiplem jong Phi , hynrei ka jingïatiplem jong uta uwei pat u briew . Kumjuh , te , don u ban kyllut , balei ba ïa ka jinglaitluid jongnga nga ba-bang leh ïa kaei Kiei la buh pud da ka jingïatiplem jong uwei pat ?
translation.en: Conscience , I say , not thine own , but of the other : for why is my liberty judged of another man s conscience ?

translation.kha: Ar tylli ki thapniang jong uwei uwei u jingthaw ki pyiar bad nam ki jingthaw ki pynlong ïa ka dur basawdong da ki khmut thapniang kiba ïakynduh . Haba ki khih , ki khih kum ka kynhun khlem da pynphai ïa ki met jong ki .
translation.en: Their wings were joined one to another  ; they turned not when they went  ; they went every one straight forward .
And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall lay my vengeance upon them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom jur ïa ki bad pynhiarkput pura halor jong ki . Kin mad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga . Te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
Ki bymman ki ïohi ïa kane bad ki bitar ; u peit bitar ha ka jingisih bad ki jah noh ; ka jingkyrmen jong ki ka duh noh junom .
translation.en: The wicked shall see it , and be grieved  ; he shall gnash with his teeth , and melt away : the desire of the wicked shall perish .

translation.kha: Baroh ki jingleh bymdei ki long ka pop , hynrei ka don ka pop ka bymlah ïalam shuh ka jingïap .
translation.en: All unrighteousness is sin : and there is a sin not unto death .
But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight , a perfect and just measure shalt thou have : that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
translation.kha: Pyndonkam hok ïa ki mawthew bad ki diengthew kiba beit , khnang ba phin im slem ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .

U pynpaw ïa ka jingtyngshaiñ ka burom U Blei bad u ïasynran thik malade ka dik U Blei hi , uba kyrshan ïa ka pyrthei da ka ktien badonbor jongnga u . Hadien ba u la ïohpdiang ka jingmap ïa ki thup u khunbynriew , u la shong ha bneng ha ka jar kamon jong U Blei , U Bakhrawbor Tam .
translation.en: Who being the brightness of his glory , and the express image of his person , and upholding all things by the word of his power , when he had by himself purged our sins , sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high  ;

translation.kha: Ha ka por ba la leit , wat hato u Saul u dang longsyiem u syiem jongno ngi , phi la ïalam ïa ki rangbah Israel ha ka thma bad U Tlai u la kular ïa phi ba phin ïalaw ïa ki briew Jong u bad ban lama u nongsynran jong ki .
translation.en: Also in time past , when Saul was king over us , thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel : and the  Lord  said to thee , Thou shalt feed my people Israel , and thou shalt be a captain over Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei lah ban wang noh ïa ka , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka Ong shaphang u Moses : Ïa ka jingkah jong u la weng noh mynba u la phai shuh U Trai .
translation.en: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord , the veil shall be taken away .

translation.kha: Ka jingpyrsad ka la kham dam , bad katto katne nongput na ki nonghikai ka praw kiba dei ki jong ka kynhun ki Pharisi ki la Ïeng bad ki la pyrshah umjer : Ngim shem kano kano kaba bakla bad Une u briew ! Lehse u mynsiem lin u gospel u la kren Shisha ha u !
translation.en: And there arose a great cry : and the scribes that were of the Pharisees  part arose , and strove , saying , We find no evil in this man : but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him , let us not fight against God .

translation.kha: U la wan sha nga , u la ïeng hajan jong nga , bad u la ong , ‘ Ko Saul , to men ïoh imat patar !’ Ha kata hi ka khyllipmat nga la lah ban peit pat , bad at la khmih ïa u .
translation.en: Came unto me , and stood , and said unto me , Brother Saul , receive thy sight . And the same hour I looked up upon him .
I shall come with you .
translation.kha: Ngan Wan lang bad phi .

U tharai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Ishmael , u la hukum ïa ph ban shim ïa kine ki dulir thied iaka baroh ar tylli , ka dulir tlot jaka ba la shon muhor bad ka kopi ba khlem shon Moreh , bad ban buh ïa ki ha u khra khyndew , khring ba kin neh ha ki sner ki ban wanlam .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Take these evidences , this evidence of the purchase , both which is sealed , and this evidence which is open  ; and put them in an earthen vessel , that they may continue many days .

translation.kha: sa shi bynshet kin ap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem , bad ïa kiba sah yn buh ha ka Khyrdop Nongïalam . Ki briew baroh kine ïalumlang ha ki phyllaw ka Templ .
translation.en: And a third part shall be at the king s house  ; and a third part at the gate of the foundation : and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of the  Lord .
He trusted in God  ; let him deliver him now , if he will have him : for he said , I am the Son of God .
translation.kha: U shaniah ha U Blei bad u kam ba u long U Khun U Blei . Kumta , te , to ngin peit lada U Blei u kwah ban pynim ïa u mynta !

translation.en: And he said unto her , Give me thy son . And he took him out of her bosom , and carried him up into a loft , where he abode , and laid him upon his own bed .
translation.kha: Ai ïa u khynnah ha nga ,  u Elijah u la ong . U shim ïa uta u khynnah na ki kti jong ka , u rah ïa u shalor sha ka kamra kaba u sah , bad u pynthiah ïa u ha ka jingthiah .
Ïada haba nga pynïap ïa kine ki briew kum ki jingkñia , ki sim bad ki mrad ki daym ban bam lut ïa ka khleiñ haduh ba kyang da ngiah bad dkoh ïa ka snam khih ba keiñ da buaid .
translation.en: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full , and drink blood till ye be drunken , of my sacrifice which I have sacrificed for you .

translation.kha: Te u Pilat u la aiti nong ïa U Jisu sha ki ïa ka ban sabakhthani . Kumta ki la shimti noh ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified . And they took Jesus , and led him away .

translation.kha: U kñi jong u Saul u ïohi ïa u bad ïa uta u shakri , bad u kylli ïa ki , Phi ïajah shano ? Ngi ïaleit wan ïa ki kam , u Saul u jubab . Ynda ngim lap ïa ki , ngi leit shat u Samuel .
translation.en: And Saul s uncle said unto him and to his servant , Whither went ye ? And he said , To seek the asses : and when we saw that they were no where , we came to Samuel .
And Abimelech fought against the city all that day  ; and he took the city , and slew the people that was therein , and beat down the city , and sowed it with salt .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh ka la neh baroh shi sngi . U Abimelekh u kurup ïa ka nongbah , u pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka , u pynkhyllem ïa ka , bad u tap ïa ka madan da ka mluh .
Kumta U Jisu u la ong baïong , Nga ïashoh ha phiah ïa ka jingshisha : Na long ka jingkhang jong ki long-briew .
translation.en: Then said Jesus unto them again ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , I am the door of the sheep .

translation.kha: Bad wat sngewsynei hab phoi ïohsngew ki jingsawa ki thma hajan jong phi bad ïa ki khubor jong ki thma jngai na phi . Ka dei ïa ktien kiei kiei pun jia , hynrei kam mut ba ka jingkut ka la long .
translation.en: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars , be ye not troubled : for such things must needs be  ; but the end shall not be yet .
And , behold , men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy : and they sought means to bring him in , and to lay him before him .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki la wan da kaba bah ha ka jingthiah ïa u briew uba ïapshiliang , bad ki la pyrshang ban rah ïa u shapoh ïing bad ban buh ha khmat jong U Jisu .
iaineh ïa ka kynhun ki briew kiba ba-bieit , bad men ïoh im . Ïaid ruh ha ka lynti ka jingtip .
translation.en: Forsake the foolish , and live  ; and go in the way of understanding .

translation.kha: kumne keiñ I lah ban rue ïa ka jingrwai ha U Trai ha ka ri nongwei ?
translation.en: How shall we sing the  Lord s  song in a strange land ?

translation.kha: Phim ïaryngkat bor wat tang bad uba don ha kyrdan ba hapoh eh jong ki rangbah synshar jong ki Asher , badno pynban phi khmih lynti ba ki nong Ijipt kin phah kali ïasam bad ki shipai shong kulai !
translation.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master s servants , and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?

translation.kha: Ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang bad ki sien tylli ki khup ki la dem khrup bad ki la mane ïa U Blei , uba la shong ha ka khet . Ki la ong , Amen ! To ïaroh ïa U Balei !
translation.en: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped God that sat on the throne , saying , Amen  ; Alleluia .
All flesh shall perish together , and man shall turn again unto dust .
translation.kha: te uwei pa uwei uba im un ïap bad un kylla long dewmet sa shisien .

translation.en: Thy throne is established of old : thou art from everlasting .
translation.kha: Ka khet jong me , A  Trai  , ka la long kaba skhem naduh mynnyngkong , bad me la long shuwa ka jingsdang ka por .
Pynduh ïa ki ban shna jingiwbih , khlem ïa ki kum ka jingpyniwbih . Ber khyndiat ka mluh ba pynlong ïa ka kaba kyrduh bad kaba kyntang .
translation.en: And thou shalt make it a perfume , a confection after the art of the apothecary , tempered together , pure and holy :
And when he came to himself , he said , How many hired servants of my father s have bread enough and to spare , and I perish with hunger !
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh u la kyndit bynriew bad u la ong , ‘ Baroh ki nongtrei wai jong i pa jong nga ki don kyrhai ban ïa kaba ki lah ban bam , bad nga pat hangne ngan sa ïapthngan !
Anab ki sngi ki wan ha kaba ki bynriew kin ong , ‘ katto kiba donbok longkmie ki kynthei ki bym ju don khun , ki bym ju kha khunlung , ki bym ju bsa ïa ki !’
translation.en: For , behold , the days are coming , in the which they shall say , Blessed are the barren , and the wombs that never bare , and the paps which never gave suck .

translation.kha: U Blei , uta uba hok , u tip ïa kaei kaba jia ha ki longïing ki riewbymman , bad un wallam ïa ki bymman sha ka jingjot jingpra .
translation.en: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked : but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness .
This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders , which is become the head of the corner .
translation.kha: U Jisu u long uta ïa uba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,   ‘ U maw uba ma phi ki nongtei phi la kyntait u la kylla long uba donkam tam na baroh .’
Phi lah ban jong ïa iwei na Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ban ïarap ïa phin ba-bang sngewthuh ïa ki jingmut Jong ki dkhot Baibl .—Pule Loukas 24 :32 , 45 .
translation.en: Any one of Jehovah’s Witnesses will be pleased to help you to reason on the meaning of the Scriptures . —Read Luke 24 :32 , 45 .

translation.kha: kum kita ki briew ken shait pyndeng ha ka shikhyllipmat . Hato phi sngewthuh ba ka jingjot kaba kum kan ia ban jia na U blem ne na u syiem ?
translation.en: For their calamity shall rise suddenly  ; and who knoweth the ruin of them both ?

translation.kha: Ym don nangne kaba lah shun shet ïa ki pop jong nga .
translation.en: If I wash myself with snow water , and make my hands never so clean  ;

translation.kha: Phi la wan shai ka jingialang kaba kmen jong ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong jong U Blei , kiba ïa ki kyrteng Jong ki la thoh ha ïeng . Pi la wan sha U blei uba long u nongbishar ki bynriew baroh , bad shat ki mynsiem jong ki briew kiba ba ïa kiba la pynjanai .
translation.en: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn , which are written in heaven , and to God the Judge of all , and to the spirits of just men made perfect ,

translation.kha: Ha khmut ka khet ruh la don kaei kaba i kum ka ïit bakhraw , kaba shai sngur bha . La ker ha baroh sawdong ka khat da sien tyllai ki jingthaw ïa-im Kiba don ki khmat sha khmat malade sdien .
translation.en: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal : and in the midst of the throne , and round about the throne , were four beasts full of eyes before and behind .

translation.kha: Don ki nongwei kiba ïaleit lang badno ki Israel . Kine ki don ka jingkwah pait banbeiñ bam doh , bad wat ki Jeriel hi ki la sdang ban ud : A , ba ma ngi ruh ngin da ïoh khyndiat ka doh !
translation.en: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting : and the children of Israel also wept again , and said , Who shall give us flesh to eat ?

translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kumjuh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh . U la kwah shun pynpaw ïa ka jingbitar jong u bad ba pynpaw ïa ka bor jongu u . Hynrei u la long uba ïaishah haduh mawria katta ïa kito kiba long ka daw jong ka jingbitar jong u , kiba la don ha ka lynti sha ka jingshah pynjot .
translation.en: What if God , willing to shew his wrath , and to make his power known , endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction :

translation.kha: Hynrei nga ïakhot ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Ka kham bha ïa phi ba la leit neh , namar ïada ngam leit noh , U Nongïarap un ym wan sha phi . Hynrei lada nga leit noh , te ngan phah ïa u sha phi .
translation.en: Nevertheless I tell you the truth  ; It is expedient for you that I go away : for if I go not away , the Comforter will not come unto you  ; but if I depart , I will send him unto you .

translation.kha: Kin pynjot ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah jong phan nabar kin pynrit ïa ki ktung jong pha . Nangta ngan sar lut khoit ïa ki pui pait bad ngan ieh sa tyngkan ïa u mawlong .
translation.en: And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre , and break down her towers : I will also scrape her dust from her , and make her like the top of a rock .

translation.kha: Ladan ang dei u briew jong U Blei , u Elijah u jubab , ai ba ka ding Kan wiang hiar na bneng bad pynap ïa me badno ïa ki nongbah jong me ! Hangta hi ka ding ka la wan khah bad ka la pynkup ïa u rangbah pynïaid bad ïa ki rangbah jong u .
translation.en: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty , If I be a man of God , then let fire come down from heaven , and consume thee and thy fifty . And there came down fire from heaven , and consumed him and his fifty .

translation.kha: Nangta ki pynïabynta hapdeng ki briew , kat khem ki kynhun longïing , ïa ki jingri na ka bynshet ki jingtah thang , khnang ba kin lah Ban ai ïa ki kat kum ki jingbthah ha ka Hukum u Moses .
translation.en: And they removed the burnt offerings , that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people , to offer unto the  Lord  , as it is written in the book of Moses . And so did they with the oxen .

translation.kha: Ngan pynpang ïa me Uba skhem kum u mawshun , uba eh Kum u diamond ; wat sheptieng ïa wer Kiba ïaheh pyrshah .
translation.en: As an adamant harder than flint have I made thy forehead : fear them not , neither be dismayed at their looks , though they be a rebellious house .

translation.kha: Katba ki rangbah jongno u Gideon ki tang put ïa la ki turoi , U Trai u la pynlong ïa ki kynhun shipa jong ki nongshun ban tur ïabah per ma ki da la ki waitlam . Ki la mareh sha Sarethan haduh Beth Shittah , ïaheh ka nongrit jong ka Abel Meholah hajan ka Tebeth .
translation.en: And the three hundred blew the trumpets , and the  Lord  set every man s sword against his fellow , even throughout all the host : and the host fled to Beth–shittah in Zererath , and to the border of Abel–meholah , unto Tabbath .
I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi da ka iktiar jong U Trai ban pule ïa kane ka shithi ha ki parabangeit baroh .
U Jisu u la jyllop ïa ki , A katno phi long kiba bakla ! Ka long namar ba kine thop ïa ki jingthoh bakynja lane ïa ka bor U Blei .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Ye do err , not knowing the scriptures , nor the power of God .
And thou shalt beat some of it very small , and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation , where I will meet with thee : it shall be unto you most holy .
translation.kha: Tylliat khyndiat ïa ka haduh ba kan da lwet ni bha , rah ïa ka shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad ber ïa ka ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang . Kheiñ ïa kane ka jingiwbih kum kaba da kyntang janai .
Hynrei wat lada phi hap banbeiñ shahshitom haba phi leh ïa kaei kaba dei , katno kiba kmen phi long ! Wat bthing ïano ïano , sad wat khuid .
translation.en: But and if ye suffer for righteousness  sake , happy are ye : and be not afraid of their terror , neither be troubled  ;

translation.kha: Pynngam shemphang kaei kaba nga bor ; Naamah ngam leh ïa kaei kaba nga kwah ban ar , hynrei pynban nga leh ïa kaei kaba nga isih .
translation.en: For that which I do I allow not : for what I would , that do I not ; but what I hate , that do I .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Samuel u phuh biang ïa ki ba kin da leit peiñ da lade ïa u Dabid . U hukum ïa ki , Rah lang ïa u hangne ha ka jingthiah jong u bad ngan pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David , saying , Bring him up to me in the bed , that I may slay him .

translation.kha: Haba ki per nongshong shnong na kino kino ki nongbah ki wallam ha khmat jong phi ïa ka kam pynïap briew ne Kana kano ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ ne ka hukum , phi dei banbeiñ bthah bha ïa ki kumno ba ki de ban leh donakor ïa lade ha ka nga jngai ka jingbishar , khnang ba kin ym leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai . Lada phim leh kumta , ma phi dara ki para nongsaiñ shnong jyllang phi , kin sngew ïa ka kuna Jong ka jingbitar U Trai . Hynrei lada phi leh ïa la ka kamram , phin erlangthari kiba la ksan .
translation.en: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities , between blood and blood , between law and commandment , statutes and judgments , ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the  Lord  , and so wrath come upon you , and upon your brethren : this do , and ye shall not trespass .

translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki sheng shrak ha uwei u lum bad ki Israel ha uwei pat u lym , hapdeng jong ki don kawei ka them .
translation.en: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side , and Israel stood on a mountain on the other side : and there was a valley between them .

translation.kha: Kum u apil kaba shim ïa ka theisotti kum ka nongpynim jong u , uta uba pynlong ïa pha un shongkurim ïa pha , kumba u nongleitkurim u shem sngewkwah malade ka nongsiatkhnam jong u , kumta U Blei jrong pha un shem sngewbang ïa pha .
translation.en: For as a young man marrieth a virgin , so shall thy sons marry thee : and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride , so shall thy God rejoice over thee .

translation.kha: Ka Baibl ka ong “Te u suri un shong lem bad u khun ‘ Langbrot , u labasa ruh un dem bad u kynhun blang ; u khun masi bad u sing samla bad u masi sngaid lang bad u khynnah rit un ïalam ïa ki .” —Isaïah 11 :12-14 ; Hosea 2 :23 .
translation.en: The Bible says : “The wolf will actually reside for a while with the male lamb , and with the kid the leopard itself will lie down , and the calf and the maned young lion and the well-fed animal all together  ; and a mere little boy will be leader over them .”—Isaiah 11 :6-9  ; Hosea 2 :18 .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit bad u . Kumta bun ki briew ki la ïaleit lang bad U Jisu , ki da ïa-thngian sha u na baroh ki Hul .
translation.en: And Jesus went with him  ; and much people followed him , and thronged him .

translation.kha: Ïa ki nongai jingmut mala ki nongleh myntri la salm shapoh ban pule ïa kane ka jingthoh bad pun ïathuh ha per aïu ka kit jingmut , hynrei kim shym Lah ban shem ïa ka jingmut .
translation.en: And now the wise men , the astrologers , have been brought in before me , that they should read this writing , and make known unto me the interpretation thereof : but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing :
Thou shalt prepare thee a way , and divide the coasts of thy land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to inherit , into three parts , that every slayer may flee thither .
translation.kha: phiah ïa kata ka ri ha ki lai bynta . Kawei ka bynta kan don kawei ka shnong ha kaba yn don ruh ka lynti ka syngkien . Te u briew uba pynïap ïano ïano u lah ban phet rieh sha kawei na ki .

translation.en: And they went out at noon . But Ben–hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions , he and the kings , the thirty and two kings that helped him .
translation.kha: Ka jingtur ïaleh ka la sdang ha ka por shiteng sngi katba u Benhadad bad ki laiphew ar ngut kiba ïateh lok bad u ki dang ïadih buaid ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki .
Haba u Iso u la thap sawphew snem ka rta , u shongkurim ïa ar nguid ki kynthei tap , ka Judith ka khun jong u Beeri sad ka Basemath ka khun jong u Elon .
translation.en: And Esau was forty years old when he took to wife Judith the daughter of Beeri the Hittite , and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite :

translation.kha: Ki bniat jngai phira ki longkmie kiba lieh kum ka kynhun jong ki langbrot ba dang shu dep pynsum . Ym don kawei ruh na ki kaba jah ; baroh ki erlangthari uba ïaryntih bha .
translation.en: How fair and how pleasant art thou , O love , for delights !

translation.kha: ‘ Me la leh ïa kaba bha tam , me u shakri uba bha bad uba lah ban shaniah !’ la ong u kynrad jong u . ‘ Me la long uba lah ban shane ha kaba pynïaid ïa kaba khyndiat , kumta ngan buh ïa me ban ïakhmih ïa kaba kham bun . To wanlam rung shapoh bad ïoh bynta lem na ka jingkmen jong nga !’
translation.en: His lord said unto him , Well done , good and faithful servant  ; thou hast been faithful over a few things , I will make thee ruler over many things : enter thou into the joy of thy lord .

translation.kha: Nangno nga lah ban pynbiang doh ïa kine ki paidbah ? Ki ud sa ud bad ki pita doh ban bam .
translation.en: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people ? for they weep unto me , saying , Give us flesh , that we may eat .

translation.kha: ibha u Herod u la sngewkyiuh ïa kata , u la ong , U dei u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ! Nga la phah khrew ïa ka khlieh jong u , hynmen u la im pat !
translation.en: But when Herod heard thereof , he said , It is John , whom I beheaded : he is risen from the dead .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei bakha u Baasha u la leh bad ki kam shlur jongno u baroh la nguh jingthoh ha ka Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha , and what he did , and his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: bad ki ïa-ong , ‘ U Trai U Blei jong i u la pynpaw ha ine ïa ka jingkraw bad ka burom jong u haba ngi jingsngewsih ïa u ba u kren nongpdiang ka ding ! Mynta ka sngi ngi la ioh ba u briew u tang haka hi banbeiñ im , wat la U Blei u la kren ha u .
translation.en: And ye said , Behold , the  Lord  our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness , and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire : we have seen this day that God doth talk with man , and he liveth .

translation.kha: Ym don uwei pang u blei kum ma me , A Trai ; me map ïa ki pop jong ki brai jongki me Kiba la lait im . Mem neh junom ha ka jingbitar , hynrei me sngewbha haba me pynpaw ïa ka jingieit baïaineh jong me .
translation.en: Who is a God like unto thee , that pardoneth iniquity , and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage ? he retaineth not his anger for ever , because he delighteth in mercy .

translation.kha: U shtah jong ka Assyria un ïalum lyngkhuit ïa ki koidi kiba u la kem na iar ki ar tukri ki ri . kiba samla bad ibha thymmai , kin ïaid da ka kjat suda bad lyngkhuit , bad ki rain jong ki ba khlieh tap , kaba wanrah ka jinglehrain halor ka jingïap .
translation.en: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners , and the Ethiopians captives , young and old , naked and barefoot , even with their buttocks uncovered , to the shame of Egypt .

translation.kha: Ha tala ka por ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan phah ïa u slap ba un hap ha ka khyndew
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , I will hear , saith the  Lord  , I will hear the heavens , and they shall hear the earth  ;
After sin and death entered the world , God revealed that it was his purpose that the dead be restored to life by means of a resurrection .
translation.kha: Hadien ka pop bad ka jingiap ka la wan sha ka pyrthei , U Blei u la pynpaw ba ka long ka jingthmu jong u , ba kiba iap kin ioh biang ia ka jingim da ka jingmihpat .
Hadien ka jingïap u Abimelekh , u thala u khun jong u Puah bad u ksiew jyllang u Dodo , u la wan ban pyllait ïa ki Israel . U dei na ka jait shahshkor bad u shong ha Shamir ha ka ri lum Ephraim .
translation.en: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah , the son of Dodo , a man of Issachar  ; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim .
Therefore we were comforted in your comfort : yea , and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus , because his spirit was refreshed by you all .
translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw balei ba la pynshlur ïa ngi . Ym tang ba la pynshlur ïa ngi ; haduh katno u Titos u la pynkmen ïa ngi da ka jingkmen jong u halor ka rukom kaba phi baroh phi la ïarap ban pynkmen ïa u !
Man la ka Ïing Ahimaas jong ki Nongsakhi U Jehubbah ki pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng bakynjah jongngi U Blei .
translation.en: Every Kingdom Hall of Jehovah’s Witnesses bears God’s holy name .

translation.kha: U ijuh u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad katba u dang ïaid , u la ïohi ïa u nonglum khajna , uba kyrteng u Mathaios , ibha shang ha ka jaka thrang jong u . U la jong ha u , To bud ïa nga . U Matthaïos u la ïeng jrut bad u la bud ïa u .
translation.en: And as Jesus passed forth from thence , he saw a man , named Matthew , sitting at the receipt of custom : and he saith unto him ,  Follow me .  And he arose , and followed him .

translation.kha: U Abimelekh u shong ha Arumah , bad u Sebul u beh krad ïa u Gaal bad ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u na Shekhem , ba kumta kiei lah shiah baneh shong ban sah hangta .
translation.en: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah : and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren , that they should not dwell in Shechem .

translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka miet , u Pharaoh u la phah khot mar mar ïa u Moses bad u Arnon , sad u Ong , Kaei mihnoh na ka ri jongngi nga , ma Phin nabar ki Jerusalem’ ! Khie leit bad mane ïa U Trai kumba phi la peiñ .
translation.en: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night , and said , Rise up , and get you forth from among my people , both ye and the children of Israel  ; and go , serve the  Lord  , as ye have said .

translation.kha: Kine ki long kiba na ka longïing longsem jong u Aaron bad u Mysia ha ka por ba U Trai u kren ha u Moses ha u Lum Sinai .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,

translation.kha: Ki la longsyiem sniew khlem jingkyrmen ha kaei kaei kaba ki imat , kumba ki la long ha Gibeah . U Blei un kynmaw ïa ka pop jyllang ki , bad un pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kata .
translation.en: They have deeply corrupted themselves , as in the days of Gibeah : therefore he will remember their iniquity , he will visit their sins .

translation.kha: U Meshakh um shym la hiarpateng na u Lebi , hynrei u la lum ïa shatei-lam-mihngi na u Abraham bad u la kyrkhu ïa u , u briew uba la ïohpdiang ïa ki jingkular jong U Blei .
translation.en: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham , and blessed him that had the promises .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kyntait ïa ki Eliel baroh , u pynshitom ïa ki bad u aiti noh ïa ki sha ki nongshun barunar haduh ha kaba khatduh ban pyndam ïa ki na khmat jongu u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  rejected all the seed of Israel , and afflicted them , and delivered them into the hand of spoilers , until he had cast them out of his sight .

translation.kha: Ki longïing jong ka jait Judith ki la ïohpdiang shi bynta ka jaka kumba la batip harum : Ka ri ka kynoi shaei sha ka tduh eh kaba shathie jongnga ka ri khlaw Sin , ha ka pud jong ka Edom .
translation.en: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families  ; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast .

translation.kha: U syiem Joash u la ïasnohkti ha ka jingsylla pyrshah ïa u Sekharaïah , bad ha ka suda jong u syiem , ki paidbah ki la lyntait maw ïa u Sekharaïah ha ka phyllaw ka Templ .
translation.en: And they conspired against him , and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Sumar Khuid ïa ka jaka shon dara jong phiah , namar U Trai U Blei jong phi u don ryngkat bad phi Haneng ban ïada ïa phi bad ai ha phi ka jingjop ïa ki nongshna jong phi . Wat leh ïa kano kano kabu khulom akor kaba lah ban pynlong ïa U Trai’ ba-bang phai noh na phi .
translation.en: For the  Lord  thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp , to deliver thee , and to give up thine enemies before thee  ; therefore shall thy camp be holy : that he see no unclean thing in thee , and turn away from thee .

translation.kha: Nangta uta naba shong ha ka khet u la ong , Jaban mynta nga thaw thymmai ïa kiei kiei baroh ! U la ong hati ïa nga , Thoh ïa kane , nalor kine ki ktien ki long kiba shisha Bad kiba lah don shaniah .
translation.en: And he that sat upon the throne said , Behold , I make all things new . And he said unto me , Write : for these words are true and faithful .

translation.kha: Eshan ïa ki briew ka Moab ! Ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u Khemosh la pynjot , bad ïa ki khun shynrang pynlang ki khun kynthei la ïalam noh kum ki koidi .
translation.en: Woe be unto thee , O Moab ! the people of Chemosh perisheth : for thy sons are taken captives , and thy daughters captives .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , phi tip , u la kwah ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu u kjap jong u , hynrei u la shah kyntait ; namar um ïohlad shuh ban pynkylla ïa kaei kaba u la ar , la u la wad ïa ka da ki jingjaw ummat .
translation.en: For ye know how that afterward , when he would have inherited the blessing , he was rejected : for he found no place of repentance , though he sought it carefully with tears .
Love not the world , neither the things that are in the world . If any man love the world , the love of the Father is not in him .
translation.kha: To wat ieit ïa ka pyrthei , lymne ïa kaei kaei kaba dei jong ka pyrthei . Lada phi ieit ïa ka pyrthei , kata ka long ba phim ieit ïa U Kpa .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath , I commanded that the gates should be shut , and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath : and some of my servants set I at the gates , that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la ai hukum ban khang ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah ha kaba sdang jong kawei pa kawei ka sngi Sabbaton , tang shu sdang ka por janmiet , bad ban ym plie biang haduh ba ka sngi Sabbaton ka la kut . Nga la pynap katto katne ki rangbah jong nga ha ki khyrdop ban pynthikna ban ym don jingwanrah ei ei shapoh ka nongbah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

phi ki bynriew ka Shaphir , leit shah ringmraw , ha ka jinglyngkhuit badno jinglehrain . Kito kiba shongsuk ha Aswan kim nud pun mih shalor na ka nongbah jong ki . Haba phi ïohsngew ïa ki briew jong ka Bethesel ki ïambriew , phin tip ba ym don jakarieh hangta .
translation.en: Pass ye away , thou inhabitant of Saphir , having thy shame naked : the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth–ezel  ; he shall receive of you his standing .
And the seven years of dearth began to come , according as Joseph had said : and the dearth was in all lands  ; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread .
translation.kha: Ka la don ka  nemsniew ha kiwei ruh ki ri ; hynrei ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei , don kyrhai ka bam .

U Tiglath Pileser , haba ïajubab ïa ka jingkyrpad u Ahas , u tur sha khmat dara la ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ka Damaskos , u kurup ïa ka , u pynpaw ïa u syiem Resin , bad u ïalam kyrdoh ïa ki briew sha Kir .
translation.en: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him : for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus , and took it , and carried the people of it captive to Kir , and slew Rezin .
Which all are to perish with the using ; ) after the commandments and doctrines of men ?
translation.kha: Kine baroh ki kdew ïa kiei kiei kiba long ki bymmyntoi shisien ba la dep pyndonkam ; ki long tang ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai u briew .
Ki la leh ïa ki kam kiba donbok jong U Blei bad leh ïa ki kambah ha ibieit .
translation.en: They shewed his signs among them , and wonders in the land of Ham .

translation.kha: Baroh kaba U Blei u la thaw ka longïng kaba bha ; ym dei ban kyntait ei ei , Hynrei ïa kiei ki baroh dei ban pynpdang laiñ bad ka jingduwai sngewnguh , namar ïa ka la pynkyntang da ka ktien U Blei bad ka jingduwai , kiba pynong ïa ki ba la pdiang da U Blei .
translation.en: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer .

translation.kha: hynrei ka sngi kaba hynriewphew ka dei ka sner shongthait ba la pynngeit sha nga . Ha said ka snieh phim bit ban kun ïa kano Kanaan ka kam — ma phi , ne ki khun jong phi , ne ki mraw jongu phi , ne ki jingri jong phi , ne ki nongwei katba shong basah ha ka ri jong phi .
translation.en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the  Lord  thy God : in it thou shalt not do any work , thou , nor thy son , nor thy daughter , thy manservant , nor thy maidservant , nor thy cattle , nor thy stranger that is within thy gates :

translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko parabangeit , phim long ha ka jingdum , bad ba ka Sning kan lap kyndit ïa phi kum u nongap .
translation.en: But ye , brethren , are not in darkness , that that day should overtake you as a thief .

translation.kha: U kew te um syiem jingjulor , namar ba u ih kham hadien .
translation.en: But the wheat and the rie were not smitten : for they were not grown up .
They did eat , they drank , they married wives , they were given in marriage , until the day that Noah entered into the ark , and the flood came , and destroyed them all .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh u ïai ïabam bad ïadih , bad ki shynrang bad ki kynthei ki ïashongkurim , haduh ka sngi kaba u Noah u la leit rung shapoh ka lieng bad ka jingshlei um ka la wan bad ka la pynïap ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar , his sons , Uncover not your heads , neither rend your clothes  ; lest ye die , and lest wrath come upon all the people : but let your brethren , the whole house of Israel , bewail the burning which the  Lord  hath kindled .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ong ha u Aaron bad ha u Eleasar bad u Ithamar , ki khun shynrang jong u ,  Wat ieh ra-ngiep ïa la u shñiuh lane kad ïa la ki jaiñ ban pyn-i ba phi ïam sngewsih , lada phi leh kumta phin ïap , bad U  Trai  un bitar ïa u paidlang baroh . Hynrei ïa baroh ki para jait Israel jong phi la shah ba kin ïa-ïam briew na ka bynta kane ka jingïap ba la wallam da ka ding kaba U  Trai  u la phah .
Hynrei “lada ngi kyrmen ïa kaei kiba ngim ïohi , ngi ap ïa kata da ka jingïaishah .
translation.en: But if we hope for that we see not , then do we with patience wait for it .
And Moses did so : as the  Lord  commanded him , so did he .
translation.kha: U Moses u leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
Hato U Blei um shong ha ki bneng kiba hajrong tam bad jngoh shabi ïa ki khlur , wat la ki don hajrong ?
translation.en: Is not God in the height of heaven ? and behold the height of the stars , how high they are !
When thou art come into the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations .
translation.kha: Ynda phi poi ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , wat pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh kiba ijli jong ki jaitbynriew kiba shong hangta .
Dang step bha ha ka step ka buid , katba ki tdong ïaid ha sier ka lynti , ki la ïohi ïa uta u diengïap Dumbur . U la ïap barabor shi rynïeng hajuh ki thied .
translation.en: And in the morning , as they passed by , they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat kin shang ioh ka jingïada jong nga . Kynton thung ïa u kew bad Siddim kum ka bri shawei . Kin pham kum ka waiñ jong ka lawbah .
translation.en: They that dwell under his shadow shall return  ; they shall revive as the corn , and grow as the vine : the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon .
And Solomon did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and went not fully after the  Lord  , as did David his father .
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad um shym la bud hok ïa U  Trai  , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong u , u la long .
Ka Judah bad ka Israel ki la siew na ka bynta ki mar jong pha da u kaei , ka ngap , ka umphniang Olib , nabar ki musli musla .
translation.en: Judah , and the land of Israel , they were thy merchants : they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith , and Pannag , and honey , and oil , and balm .

translation.kha: To rwai ha u ïa ka jingrwai bameh , to tem da ka jingtbit ïa ka dala , bad to risa jam da ka jingkmen !
translation.en: Sing unto him a new song  ; play skilfully with a loud noise .

translation.kha: Te phin long kiba lait na baroh ki jingbymkhuid bad khlem shah kynnoh pop ha ka Sngi U Khrist .
translation.en: That ye may approve things that are excellent ; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ ;
When he giveth quietness , who then can make trouble ? and when he hideth his face , who then can behold him ? whether it be done against a nation , or against a man only :
translation.kha: Lada U Blei u rai ban nym leh ei ei ruh , ym don uno uno uba lah ban wad daw ïa u . Lada u buhrieh ïa ka khmat jong u , ki briew kin long kiba khlem ïoh jingïarap .
Haba kata ka kynthei ka ïohi ïa u Samuel , ka lynñiar kliar , bad ka ong ha u saraw , Balei phi sahit shrak ïa nga ? Phibi dei u syiem Saul du !
translation.en: And when the woman saw Samuel , she cried with a loud voice : and the woman spake to Saul , saying , Why hast thou deceived me ? for thou art Saul .

This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons , which they shall offer unto the  Lord  in the day when he is anointed  ; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual , half of it in the morning , and half thereof at night .
translation.kha: na ka bynta ka jingpynsleh lyngdoh ïa kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron . Ha ka sngi ba yn pynkyntang ïa u , un ai kum ka jingainguh sha U  Trai  shi kilo u  purew ( kaba ïaryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam ba man ka sngi ) , shiteng ha ka por mynstep bad shiteng ha ka por janmiet .
Kane ka dei kaei ba ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki pyrshang katba lah ban sa .
translation.en: This is what Jehovah’s Witnesses are endeavoring to do .

translation.kha: Haba ngi peit ïa ka lawei , ka Baibl ka ïathuh shemphang “Ki ïeng kiba tyrsim bad ka khyndew kiba thymmai , katba kum kata ka jinglorni jongu u ( Blei ) im ïakhmih lynti , ha kiba ka hok ka shong sah” . —2 Petros 3 :13 ; Isaia 65 :17 .
translation.en: Looking to the future , the Bible tells of a “new heavens and a new earth that we are awaiting according to [God’s] promise , and in these righteousness is to dwell .”—2 Peter 3 :13  ; Isaiah 65 :17 .
Backbiters , haters of God , despiteful , proud , boasters , inventors of evil things , disobedient to parents ,
translation.kha: Ki ïa-lorni bad kren sniew uwei ïa uwei pat ; ki long kiba shun ïa U Blei , kiba pynbitar , kiba sarong bad kiba sngewmeng ; ki pyrkhat ïa kiba bun ki lynti ban leh ïa kaba sniew ; kim kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa ;

translation.en: Now therefore deliver us the men , the children of Belial , which are in Gibeah , that we may put them to death , and put away evil from Israel . But the children of Benjamin would not hearken to the voice of their brethren the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Mynta aiti noh ïa kito ki riewbymman ha Gibeah , ba ngin ïoh pynïap ïa ki bad ban weng noh ïa kane ka jingbymman na Israel .  Hynrei ki briew ka Benjamin kim salia ïa kiwei pat ki jait Israel .

translation.en: For they have not served thee in their kingdom , and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them , and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them , neither turned they from their wicked works .
translation.kha: Da ki jingkyrkhu jong me , ki syiem ki la synshar ïa ki briew jong me haba ki shong ki sah ha ka ri kaba ïar bad kaba seisoh ba me la ai ïa ki ; hynrei kim shym la phai noh na ka pop ban shakri ïa me .
Kumta nga , U Trai U blang ki Israel ngan wallam ka jingjot ha Jerusalem bad Judah ba uwei pa nawei uba ïohsngew shaphang kata un lyngngoh .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Behold , I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah , that whosoever heareth of it , both his ears shall tingle .

translation.kha: Nalor jong ka , u syiem u la lehbha ïa u Ibsam malade u la ai ha u ki kynhun langbrot bad ki blang , ki masi , ki kada , ki mraw bad ki ut .
translation.en: And he entreated Abram well for her sake : and he had sheep , and oxen , and he asses , and menservants , and maidservants , and she asses , and camels .

translation.kha: ym ha baroh , hynriew tang ha ki sohkhia kiba U Blei u la lah jat , kata , ha sem kiba la ïabam malu ïadih bad u hadien ba u la mihpat na ka jingïap .
translation.en: Not to all the people , but unto witnesses chosen before of God , even to us , who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead .
Tom pulled out his key and opened the door .
translation.kha: U Tom u sei ia u shabi bad u plie ia ka jingkhang .

translation.en: World conditions confirm that God’s Kingdom will soon come .
translation.kha: Ki jinglong jong ka pyrthei ki pynshisha ba ka Hima jong U Blei ka la jan .

translation.en: Yea , he had power over the angel , and prevailed : he wept , and made supplication unto him : he found him in Beth–el , and there he spake with us  ;
translation.kha: U ïaleh bad u angel bad u la jop . U la ïam bad pan ïa ka jingkyrkhu . Bad ha Bethel U Blei u la wan sha u kpa tymmen jong ngi u Jakob bad u la ïakren bad u .
Ki briew kiba bha kin don ka spah ban ieh pateng ha ki kseh jong ki , hynrei ka spah jong ki nongpop kan leit sha kiba hok .
translation.en: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children s children : and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just .

translation.kha: To ngin ïawan ha khmat jong u da ka jingainguh Bad rwai kmen da ki jingsngew ïaroh !
translation.en: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving , and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms .

translation.kha: Ïa ki shipai bakynsai tam jong u yn pynïap ha ka thma malade ïa kiba lait im yn pynsakma ha ki phang baroh . Te phan tip ba ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And all his fugitives with all his bands shall fall by the sword , and they that remain shall be scattered toward all winds : and ye shall know that I the  Lord  have spoken it .

translation.kha: Ka iing jong u briew uba bhah kan dang ïeng hi hadien ba la pynjot ïa ka ïing jong u nongleh ïa kaba sngewieit .
translation.en: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown : but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish .
I know his wrath , saith the  Lord   ; but it shall not be so  ; his lies shall not so effect it .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga tip ïa ka jinglehmeng jong ki . Ki jingkob jong ki kim long ei ei ruh , bad kiei kiei kiba ki leh kin ym neh .

Ki pynrangbah synshar jong u ki buh ïa ka met jong u ha ka kali ïapom sad kit ïa ka sha Jerusalem , ha kaba la tep ïa u ha ka jingïap ki syiemsad . Ki briew ka Judah ki la lngaid ïa u Joahas u khun jyllang u Josaïah , pynlang pynsleh syiem ïa u .
translation.en: And his servants carried him in a chariot dead from Megiddo , and brought him to Jerusalem , and buried him in his own sepulchre . And the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and anointed him , and made him king in his father s stead .
But I would strengthen you with my mouth , and the moving of my lips should assuage your grief .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban pynkhlaiñ ïa phi da ki jingai jingmut bad ngan ïai kren ban pyntngen ïa phi .

translation.en: And what man is he that hath planted a vineyard , and hath not yet eaten of it ? let him also go and return unto his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man eat of it .
translation.kha: Don mo hangne uba dang shu dep rep bri sohwaiñ , hynrei u bym pat ïohlad ban kheit ïa ki soh jong ka ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , ïoh ba u ïap ha madan thma , bad ba uwei pat un ïoh bam ïa ki soh jong ka .
Shano ki don mynta , ki blei jongki ka Hamath sad ka Atad ? Shano ki blei jong ka Sepharbaim , ka Hena , bad ka Ibbah ? ithuh don na ki kiba la pyllait im ïa ka Samaria ?
translation.en: Where are the gods of Hamath , and of Arpad ? where are the gods of Sepharvaim , Hena , and Ivah ? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand ?

And hearken thou to the supplication of thy servant , and of thy people Israel , when they shall pray toward this place : and hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place : and when thou hearest , forgive .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga bad ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong me haba ki phai khmat sha kane ka jaka bad ki duwai . Na ka ïing jong me ha bneng to shahshkor ïa ngi bad to map ruh ïa ngi .
Pynban uno uno uba don U Minnith , u lah ban bishar ïa ka dor jongnga ktieh kiei baroh , hynrei ym don uba lah ban bishar ïa u .
translation.en: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things , yet he himself is judged of no man .

translation.kha: Ki peit ïa nga da ka jingisih ; ki pyrkhat ki kham bha phlait ma ki ban ïa nga , bun ki wan wat Ban bynthiew ha ka khmat jong nga .
translation.en: They abhor me , they flee far from me , and spare not to spit in my face .

But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate , which shall come with an army , and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north , and shall deal against them , and shall prevail :
translation.kha: Shen hadien kata , uwei na ki ba-ha-ïing jong ka un long syiem . Un tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem Syria , un rung shapoh ki kut jong ki , bad jop ïa ki .

Ki khun ki kiaw Jong u kthaw kurim u Moses , na ka jait kane , ki la leit ryngkat bad u bani Judah na Jerikho , ka nongbah ki dieng Tlai , shai ka ri shrah ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Arad ha Judah . Ki shongksuid hangta hapdeng ki Amalek .
translation.en: And the children of the Kenite , Moses  father in law , went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah , which lieth in the south of Arad  ; and they went and dwelt among the people .

translation.kha: Ïalam , Deborah , ïalam ! Ïalam ! Rwai ka jingiw ! Elim ! Tur sha khmied , ko Barak , u khun jong u Abinoam , Ïalam noh ïa ki mraw jong me !
translation.en: Awake , awake , Deborah : awake , awake , utter a song : arise , Barak , and lead thy captivity captive , thou son of Abinoam .

translation.kha: Ha shu lynter ka jingtem , ngi don ha tmier jyllang ka jingïap na ka bynta U Jisu , khnang ba yn ïohi ïa ka jingim jong u ha kane ka met baïapher jongki ngi .
translation.en: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus  sake , that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh .

translation.kha: Lada u nongïeng ibha shong basah nabar phi u kwah ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ban pyndonburom ïa U Trai , nyngkong eh Phi dei baneh umsoh shuwa ïa ki shynrang baroh na ka ïing jong u . Hadien kata , haka Ban kheiñ ïa u kumto u traishnong , bad nongap u lah ban ïashim bynta ha ka Jingkhawai Amam .
translation.en: And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee , and will keep the passover to the  Lord  , let all his males be circumcised , and then let him come near and keep it  ; and he shall be as one that is born in the land : for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei kai kaba U Trai Nongsharai u ong : Ngi phah ïa ki saw tylli ki jingpynshitom basniew tam jong nga ha ka Jerusalem — ka tdam , ka nadien , ki mradkhlaw , bad ka jingpang — ban pynjot ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem , the sword , and the famine , and the noisome beast , and the pestilence , to cut off from it man and beast ?

translation.kha: U Abraham u kren biah , To map , ko Trai ïa ka jingshlur bieit jong nga ban kren ha me . Ngin long tang u briew bun ngam don hok ban ong ei ei .
translation.en: And Abraham answered and said , Behold now , I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord , which am but dust and ashes :

translation.kha: Haba ka waiñ ka la lut noh , ka kmie U Jisu ka la ong ïa u , Kim kein waiñ Shuah .
translation.en: And when they wanted wine , the mother of Jesus saith unto him , They have no wine .

translation.kha: U Jesse nangta u wan ïalumlang ïa u Shammah . Em , U Trai um shym la jingdih ïa i'u ruh u Samuel u ong .
translation.en: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by . And he said , Neither hath the  Lord  chosen this .

translation.kha: U Jephthah u ïa-ong ha ki , Lada phi ïalam biang ïa nga shuh ïing ban ïaleh ïa ki Amen , bad U Trai u ai jingjop ïa de , nga dei ban longsyiem u nongsynshar jong ph .
translation.en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead , If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon , and the  Lord  deliver them before me , shall I be your head ?

translation.kha: Nangta ki leit shaw khmat . U Mikah u ïohi ïa kata ba ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa u , kumto u leit phai noh sha la ïing .
translation.en: And the children of Dan went their way : and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him , he turned and went back unto his house .
For one believeth that he may eat all things : another , who is weak , eateth herbs .
translation.kha: ïa u briew u ba jingngeit u ban bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam : U wei pat u briew uba tlot ,  u bam da ki jhur .

translation.en: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah , saying , The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon , saying , Give thy daughter to my son to wife : and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon , and trode down the thistle .
translation.kha: U Jehoash u la phah ïa kane ka jubab sha u Amasaïah :  Shisien u dieng shiah ha ki Lum Lebanon u phah khubor sha u dieng Kedar : ‘ To ai ïa ka khun jong me ban shongkurim ïa u khun jong nga .’ U mradkhlaw u ïaid lynti nangta bad u ïuhroit ïa u dieng shiah .
Bun snem hadien kane , u syiem Ijipt u ïap ne , hynrei ki Israel ki ding ïai ud namar kata ka jinglongmraw jong ki bad ki pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: And it came to pass in process of time , that the king of Egypt died : and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage , and they cried , and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage .

translation.kha: Bun na ki briew kiba la wan jngoh ïa ka Mari ki la ïohi ïa kai ka U Jisu u la leh , bad ki la ngeit ha u .
translation.en: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary , and had seen the things which Jesus did , believed on him .
And die in the mount whither thou goest up , and be gathered unto thy people  ; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor , and was gathered unto his people :
translation.kha: Men sa ïap halor uta u lum kumba u Aaron u hynmen jong me u la ïap ha u Lum Hor ,
To ïaroi ïa U Trai ! To rwai ka jingrwai bathymmai ïa U Trai ; to ïaroh ïa u ha ka jingïaseng lang Jong ki briew bajanai jongki u !
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Sing unto the  Lord  a new song , and his praise in the congregation of saints .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la mynjur ban shong ban sah noh hangta , bad u Jehu ruh u pynshong ïa u bad ka Sipporah ka khun jong u kob la kha khun shynrang ïa u Mesha .
translation.en: And Moses was content to dwell with the man : and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter .

translation.kha: Te mynta , ko ka kynjoh jong nga ; ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga ïathuh ha phi ba ngan bashabar ïa kaei pa khawai na phi bad ngan pynkhlad ïa kiba bakha na Ibbah snieh , ïa ki langbrot na ki blang .
translation.en: And as for you , O my flock , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I judge between cattle and cattle , between the rams and the he goats .

translation.kha: Ko Kynhun jong nga , to sngap bad shahshkor ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingshongshngain jong nga .
translation.en: My son , attend unto my wisdom , and bow thine ear to my understanding :

translation.kha: Uno uno uba leh biria ïa la u kpa lane uba ñiewbeiñ ïa la ka kmie ha ka jinglong tmier jong ka u dei ban shah bam ha ki pukni ne shah khlaw ki khmat ha ki tyngab khlaw .
translation.en: The eye that mocketh at his father , and despiseth to obey his mother , the ravens of the valley shall pick it out , and the young eagles shall eat it .

translation.kha: Ka don kamai ka par kaba kyrteng ka Mari , katba la shong hajan ki kjat jong U Trai bad ka la pynshahshkor ïa ka jinghikai jongngi u .
translation.en: And she had a sister called Mary , which also sat at Jesus  feet , and heard his word .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew Hynrei jong ka jingkyrshan u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Baanah u syiem ka Eliel u thma ïa ka Judah bad sdang ban tei ktung ïa ka ramhah khnang ban khang noh ïa ka jingïaid lyntang shapoh bad shabar ka Judah .
translation.en: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah , and built Ramah , to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .

translation.kha: Mei kumta hi , u Taanakh , u lat ka Ïuphratis Sippai , u Shethar bishni bad ki para rangbah synshar , ki wan sha Jerusalem bad ki ïada bad noh : Mano ba ai hukum ïa phoi Ban thet ïa kane ka Templ bad pynban ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka ?
translation.en: At the same time came to them Tatnai , governor on this side the river , and Shethar–bozenai , and their companions , and said thus unto them , Who hath commanded you to build this house , and to make up this wall ?

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingong kaba Shishak , ïa kaba dei ban pdiang pura mala ban ngeit : U Khrist Jisu u la wanpaw sha ka pyrthei ïa ka ban pynim ïa ki nongsngap , nga hir uba sniew hano na ki ,
translation.en: This is a faithful saying , and worthy of all acceptation , that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners ; of whom I am chief .
Judah was his sanctuary , and Israel his dominion .
translation.kha: ka Judah ka la kylla long ka jaitbynriew kaba khuid jong U  Trai  , bad ka Israel ka kylla long ka jingïohkynti jong u hi .

Hynrei ha film ki sngem kiba khatduh u la krai ha ngi Lyngba U Khun jong u . U la long uta da uba U Blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , uta ïa suba U blei u la jied ban longsem u nongïaleh kyntu ïa kiei kiei baroh ha ka kut .
translation.en: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son , whom he hath appointed heir of all things , by whom also he made the worlds  ;
But was rebuked for his iniquity : the dumb ass speaking with man s voice forbad the madness of the prophet .
translation.kha: bad la sneng ïa u na ka bynta ka pop . U kada jong u , u la kren ha ka sur briew bad u la khang ïa ka kam leh bieit jong u nongïathuhlypa .
Ki rmiang shijur ka rnga jong uwei pat u briew ki lah ban thiang kum ka ngap , bad ki jingdoh jong ka ki long jlih khim ka nongpynim Olib ;
translation.en: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb , and her mouth is smoother than oil :

translation.kha: Kin ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Khunlangbrot ; hynrei U Khunlangbrot , blem bad ki nongbud jong u ïa kiba u la khot , u la Jedidah , bad kiba ïaineh skhem , un jop ïa ki , namar ba u dem U Trai jong ki trai bad U Syiem jong ki symboh .
translation.en: These shall make war with the Lamb , and the Lamb shall overcome them : for he is Lord of lords , and King of kings : and they that are with him are called , and chosen , and faithful .
So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten : for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites , because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah .
translation.kha: te ki Benjamin ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop . Ki Israel kiba ha khmat eh ki la kynran dien na ki Benjamin namar ba ki shaniah ha kita ki rangbah ba la buh ban apthap baroh sawdong ïa ka Gibeah .

Ki la jubab , Bah , ngi la leh ïa ka namar ngi la tip shiah ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa u Mosah u shakri jong u ban ai ha phi ïa ka ri baroh katai , bad ban pynïap ïa ki brup baroh kiba shang ha ka katba phi nang ïadat sha khat . ngi la bor ïa ka namar ba ngi la sngewsheptieng ïa phi ; ngi don ha ka jingpynjynjar ïa la ka jingim .
translation.en: And they answered Joshua , and said , Because it was certainly told thy servants , how that the  Lord  thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land , and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you , therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you , and have done this thing .

translation.kha: Ngam patar ju mane ïa ka sngi ha ka jingthaba jong ka ne ïa u bnai ha ka itynnat jong u baroh .
translation.en: If I beheld the sun when it shined , or the moon walking in brightness  ;

translation.kha: U Blei u sneng ïa u briew da kaba phah ïa ka jingpang bad pyndap ïa ka met jong u da ka jingshitom .
translation.en: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed , and the multitude of his bones with strong pain :

translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong phi kiba kohnguh ïa nga , ka ba jong nga kaba pynim kan kiwei halor jong phi kamon ka sngi bad kan wallam jingkhiah kum ki kjat sngi . Phi long kiba loit mala bakmen kumno ki khun masi ba la pyllait na ka sem .
translation.en: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings  ; and ye shall go forth , and grow up as calves of the stall .

translation.kha: Bad ki briew lad U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh kin ïohpdiang ïa ka bor ba kynja shem malade ba-bang beit ïa ka jongu la junom .
translation.en: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom , and possess the kingdom for ever , even for ever and ever .

translation.kha: ibha u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u phah ïa u Jehoba ryngkat pynlang ka kynran swai baroh kawei .
translation.en: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab , and all the host of the mighty men .

translation.kha: Katba dang don ka jingpynpaw , ki briew jong U Blei kin ïoh khyndiat ka jingïarap , wat la kiba bun kiba ïasoh bad ki kin bor kumta na ka bynta ki daw shimet .
translation.en: Now when they shall fall , they shall be holpen with a little help : but many shall cleave to them with flatteries .
And he was casting out a devil , and it was dumb . And it came to pass , when the devil was gone out , the dumb spake  ; and the people wondered .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang beh noh ïa u ksuid u bym lah ban kren ; bad haba u ksuid u la mihnoh , uta u briew u la sdang ban kren . Ki paidbah ki la sngewlyngngoh ,

translation.en: Then Jesus answered and said unto her ,  O woman , great is thy faith : be it unto thee even as thou wilt .  And her daughter was made whole from that very hour .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la jubab ïa ka ,  Pha long ka briew kaba khraw ka jingngeit ! Ïa kaei kaba pha kwah yn leh na ka bynta jong pha .  Bad ha kata ka khyllipmat la pynkhiah ïa ka khun jong ka .
Ki la mane ïa kiaw ki blei , ki bud ïa ki rukom jong ki briew kiba U Terah u la beh noh katba ki briew jong u ki dang tam shaphrang , sad ki pdiang ïa ki rukom ba la pdang da ki syiem ka Israel .
translation.en: And walked in the statutes of the heathen , whom the  Lord  cast out from before the children of Israel , and of the kings of Israel , which they had made .

translation.kha: Nga phan shaw phi u nongshna jingshna uba kata bad uba tbit bha , uba kyrteng u Huram .
translation.en: And now I have sent a cunning man , endued with understanding , of Huram my father s ,

translation.kha: Ngan ym tyngkai ïa pha lane pyn-i kano kano ka jongisynei ïa pha . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kai ijli katba pha la leh , kumta phan sa tip ba nga erlangthari U Tharai , bad daym ma nga wahbah pynshitom ïa pha .
translation.en: And mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity : I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  that smiteth .

translation.kha: Haba ngi pyndap ïa kine ki peiñ snieh waiñ , ki daiñ tikmie , hynñiew ha khmih ! Ki la jot . Ki jaiñ bad ki umdih jong ngi ki la jot namar ka jingieid lynti kaba jngai .
translation.en: And these bottles of wine , which we filled , were new  ; and , behold , they be rent : and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey .

translation.kha: Ha Kajuh ka rukom ruh , kine ki briew ki ïoh ïa ki jingïohipaw kiba pynhieng ïa ki ban leh pop pyrshah ïa la ki jong ki met ; ki ñiewbeiñ ïa ka jingsynshar jong U Blei bad ki ïakren beiñ ïa ki jingwoh badonburom ha Bneng .
translation.en: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh , despise dominion , and speak evil of dignities .

But above all things , my brethren , swear not , neither by heaven , neither by the earth , neither by any other oath : but let your yea be yea  ; and your nay , nay  ; lest ye fall into condemnation .
translation.kha: Nalor kine baroh , ko parabangeit jong nga , wat pyndonkam da ka jingsmai haba phi pynlong ka jingkular . Wat smai da ka bneng ne da ka khyndew ne da kaei kaei pat . Shu ong  Ho-oid  haba phi mut ho-oid , bad  Em  haba phi mut em , bad phin ym hap hapoh ka jingbishar U Blei .
Pynban , ngai ban ïa kaei kaei baroh , ngi kwah ban pynsngewbha ïa u , la Ngi don ha Kanneh ka ïing hangne lane hangtei .
translation.en: Wherefore we labour , that , whether present or absent , we may be accepted of him .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Sihon um shym shah ïa ki Israel ba kin leh kumta . U lum ïa u paidïapom jong u baroh , u sher dara ha Jahas , bad u tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast : but Sihon gathered all his people together , and pitched in Jahzah , and fought against Israel .

translation.kha: Katba ka sur-thma ka ïangat jur bha , u syiem Ahab u la shu kyrshan ha ka kali ïapom jong u , u da peiñ pyrshah ïa ki Syria . Ka snam na ka jingmong jongnga u ka tuid bad ka tap shaduh trai jong ka kali ïapom , malade haba la janmiet u la ïaw .
translation.en: And the battle increased that day : and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians , and died at even : and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot .
And if thou wilt walk in my ways , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as thy father David did walk , then I will lengthen thy days .
translation.kha: Bad lada me kohnguh ïa nga bad sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong me u la leh , ngan ai ha me ka jingim kaba jlan .

translation.en: Give unto the  Lord  the glory due unto his name : bring an offering , and come into his courts .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom jong U  Trai  ; to wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bad wan sha ka Templ jong u .
Suk uta u briew Uba sbun ha ka jingairam jong u , uba pynïaid hok ïa ka kam ïakhaïi jong u .
translation.en: A good man sheweth favour , and lendeth : he will guide his affairs with discretion .
And , behold , a certain lawyer stood up , and tempted him , saying , Master , what shall I do to inherit eternal life ?
translation.kha: U nonghikai ka Hukum u la wan bad u la pyrshang ban riam ïa U Jisu .  Ko Nonghikai ,  u la kylli ,  kaei nga dei ban leh ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?

Katto katne ngut ki Philistia Bad ki Arab ki shong ki sah hajuh ka jaka ha kaba katto katto-katne ñiut ki nong Sudan ki la shongshit harud ka duriaw . U Trai u la pynkhih ïa ki ban leit ïaleh thma pyrda ïa u Jehoram .
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines , and of the Arabians , that were near the Ethiopians :

And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward , they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben , and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad , and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh .
translation.kha: Ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan , ha ka padun ri shyiap sha mihngi jong ka Jerikho , ki jied ïa ka Beser kaba ha ka jaka ki jait Reuben , ïa ka Ramoth ha Gilead ha ka jaka ki jait Gad ; bad ïa ka Golan ha Bashan ha ka jaka ki jait Manasseh .
Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa U Joseph , ha shuwa ba un ïap , ban kren shaphang ka jingmihnoh ki khun Jeriel na Ijipt , bad ai ka jingbthah shaphang kaei ba ki dei ban leh ïa ka met jong u .
translation.en: By faith Joseph , when he died , made mention of the departing of the children of Israel  ; and gave commandment concerning his bones .

translation.kha: Na pyrshah ïa kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba sping keiñ uwei na uwei bad pynbna ïa ki kamon ka khubor Jong nga .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , I am against the prophets , saith the  Lord  , that steal my words every one from his neighbour .

translation.kha: U Petros u la mihnoh malu u la ïam sngewsih eh .
translation.en: And Peter went out , and wept bitterly .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngi phla ïa ki pop jong ngi ha U Blei , un bat ïa la ka kular bad un leh ïa kaei kaba dei : Un ïohmap ïa ngi ïa ki Pop Jong ngi sad un pynduh ïa ngi na ki Kam batymmen baroh .
translation.en: If we confess our sins , he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins , and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness .

translation.kha: Ym to kaei kaei ïa kaba kah ban buhrieh na U Bel ; ïa kiei kiei kiba don ha ki jingthaw baroh la pynpaw bad pynim shynna ha ki khmat jong u . badno ka dei sha u ba ngi dei ban ai jingkheiñ ïa lade .
translation.en: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight : but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do .
And Cabbon , and Lahmam , and Kithlish ,
translation.kha: ka Kabbon , ka Lahmam , ka Shitlish ,

translation.en: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom : but a man of understanding walketh uprightly .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba mutlop ki kmen ha la ka jingbieit , hynrei kiba stad kin leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
lane ha Kanaan kano ka lyngkhot jaiñ linen ne jaiñ saiwul , lane ha ka snieh , lane ha kaei kaei kiba la shna da ka snieh ,
translation.en: Whether it be in the warp , or woof  ; of linen , or of woollen  ; whether in a skin , or in any thing made of skin  ;
Who , when they were come down , prayed for them , that they might receive the Holy Ghost :
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi , ki la duwai na ka bynta ki riewngeit ba kin ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
u Simeon u la skhem ïa u khunlung ha ki ksang ti jong u bad u la baje ïa U Blei’ :
translation.en: Then took he him up in his arms , and blessed God , and said ,

translation.kha: U Trai u pynlong ïa ki wah ban rngad lut bad pynsangeh ïa ki ñiuhlieh ban mih .
translation.en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness , and the watersprings into dry ground  ;

translation.kha: La ïan ïaroh ïa u namar kiei kaba u leh ; phi ruh phi daiñ ban ïajah ïa u .
translation.en: Remember that thou magnify his work , which men behold .
And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen , in which my people dwell , that no swarms of flies shall be there  ; to the end thou mayest know that I am the  Lord  in the midst of the earth .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pyllait ïa ka ri Goshen , ha kaba ki briew jong nga ki shong , ba kumta yn ym don skain hangta . Ngan leh ïa kane ba men tip ba nga U  Trai  nga trei ha kane ka ri .

translation.en: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating . And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet , he said , Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar ?
translation.kha: Katba u Adonijah bad baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha ki dang shu lah bam , ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa . Bad haba u Joab u la ïohsngew ïa ka turoi , u la kylli ,  Kaei ka jingmut jong kata ka jingsawa baroh hapoh ka nongbah ?
Phi la pynïap ïa ithuh uba ïalumlang sha ka jingim , hyndai U blei u la pynmihpatlada ïa u na ka jingtep — bad ngi long ki shithi ïa kane .
translation.en: And killed the Prince of life , whom God hath raised from the dead  ; whereof we are witnesses .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ma ka bad ki dkhoi jong ka ïing jong ka ki la shah pynbaptis , ka la khot sngewbha ïa ngi , To wan Bad sah hapoh ka ïing jong ar lada phira la pyndeng ba nga long ka parabangeit bashisha ha U Trai . Bad ka la pynkohnguh ïa ngi ban leit .
translation.en: And when she was baptized , and her household , she besought us , saying , If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord , come into my house , and abide there . And she constrained us .

translation.kha: U Blei u pynlong ïa ki hynmen ki para jong nga ban iaineh ïa nga ; nga kylla long u nongwei ha iar kiba ithuh ïa nga ;
translation.en: He hath put my brethren far from me , and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me .
And they said , An Egyptian delivered us out of the hand of the shepherds , and also drew water enough for us , and watered the flock .

And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars , be ye not troubled : for such things must needs be  ; but the end shall not be yet .
