Ka Delilah nangta ka kynoi shiah ïa u , ka shim ïa kita ki kynting shñiuh jong u , bad ka thain hynriew tyllep ïa ki . Ka pynskhem ïa ki da ki snar ïingjaiñ bad ka pyrta , Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan ! Hynrei u kiei joit bad u lawlynnong pynsynjor ïa la u shñiuh na kata ka jingthain .
translation.en: And she fastened it with the pin , and said unto him , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he awaked out of his sleep , and went away with the pin of the beam , and with the web .
And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod , and Abiezer , and Mahalah .
translation.kha: Ka Hammolekheth , ka para u Gilead , ka ïoh lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Ishod , u Abieser , bad u Mahlah .

translation.en: And the man said unto me , Son of man , behold with thine eyes , and hear with thine ears , and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee  ; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither : declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel .
translation.kha: U ong ha nga ,  To khmih , ko khun u briew , shahshkor kyndiang bad pynleit jingmut bha ïa kata baroh kaba nga pyn-i ha me ; namar ba na ka bynta kane la ïalam ïa me hangne . Me dei ban ïathuh ïa kata baroh ba me ïohi sha ki briew ka Israel .
Ki ijuh ha u slap umbah khap halor ki lumbah , bad ki ïa-thngian harud ki mawsiang ban rieh .
translation.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains , and embrace the rock for want of a shelter .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba shah iehnoh ha Jerusalem , uba U Blei u la jia baneh ïohlait im , yn khot uba khuid .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that he that is left in Zion , and he that remaineth in Jerusalem , shall be called holy , even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem :

translation.kha: Kumba ka Baibyl ka ong , phin Nahum sngew sih kumne kito “ki bymdon jingkyrmen .”
translation.en: As the Bible says , you will “not sorrow just as the rest also do who have no hope .”

translation.kha: U phar ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha shuwa jong u bad u la sahmiet ha kata ka miet ha ka jaka sher dara .
translation.en: So went the present over before him : and himself lodged that night in the company .

translation.kha: (Nga bangeit ïa la ka kliar na ka bynta ki bun hajar ki pateng bynriew bad nga Kartah ïa ka jingbymman , bad ïa ka pop ; hynriewphew , kan pynshitom ïa ki khun ki ksiew rahah ka pateng bynriew kaba lai bad kaba saw namar ki pop jong ki kmie ki kpa jong ki .
translation.en: Keeping mercy for thousands , forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin , and that will by no means clear the guilty  ; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children , and upon the children s children , unto the third and to the fourth generation .
Their land also is full of idols  ; they worship the work of their own hands , that which their own fingers have made :
translation.kha: Ka ri jong ki ka dap da ki bleithaw , bad ki mane ïa kita kiba ki la shna da ki kti jong ki hi .

translation.en: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign : according to all that he hath done shall ye do : and when this cometh , ye shall know that I am the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Te ngan long ka dak ïa pha ; phan leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la leh . U  Trai  u ong ba haba kane kan jia , phan ïoh tip ba u long U  Trai  Nongsynshar .

translation.en: But the  Lord  is with me as a mighty terrible one : therefore my persecutors shall stumble , and they shall not prevail : they shall be greatly ashamed  ; for they shall not prosper : their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  , me long ha ka liang jong nga , uba khlaiñ bad bakhrawbor , bad kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga kin ym jop , kin shah pynlehrain junom , namar kim lah ban jop . Ïa ka jingjahburom jong ki yn ym klet noh da lei lei .

translation.en: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards  ; two sockets under one board for his two tenons , and two sockets under another board for his two tenons .
translation.kha: bad sawphew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa hapoh jong ki , ar ar tylli ki thliew tnaw hapoh kawei ka jingker ban bat ïa kita ki tnaw jong ka ar tylli .

translation.en: We grope for the wall like the blind , and we grope as if we had no eyes : we stumble at noonday as in the night  ; we are in desolate places as dead men .
translation.kha: bad ngi tare ruma kum ki briew kiba matlah . Ngi jynthut ha ka por shiteng sngi , la kumba long mynmiet , la kumba ngi don ha ka pyrthei kaba dum jong kiba ïap .

kumto u Pynphai pat ïa ki sha la ka kmie . Ka shim arsap tylli ki sbai shoh bad ka ai ïa ki ha u bniah , uba la thaw ïa ka bleithaw , da kaba shniah ïa ka na ka dieng bad suit da ka dabi . La buh ïa ka ha ïing u Mikhmash .
translation.en: Yet he restored the money unto his mother  ; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver , and gave them to the founder , who made thereof a graven image and a molten image : and they were in the house of Micah .

translation.kha: U buh ïa ka dabor Hapdeng ka Ïingjaiñ nabar kata ka duwan , bad u pynpyut ïa ka da ka um .
translation.en: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar , and put water there , to wash withal .
Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread , neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la klet ban wallam kpu kat ban dap , bad ki la don tang uwei u kpu bad ki .

U Lebi u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang , u Gershon , u Kohath , badno u Merari , kiba long ki khap thnum jong kita ki kur kiba ei ïa ki kyrteng jong ki . U Gershon u kein ar nguid ki khwan shynrang : U Libni bad u Shimei ; u Kohath u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Amram , u Ishar , u Kherub , bad u Ussiel ; bad u Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : u Mahli bad u Mushi . Kainan ki longkmie ki kpa tymmen jong kito ki ïing kiba don ïa ki kyrteng jong ki .
translation.en: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites :
And all the earth sought to Solomon , to hear his wisdom , which God had put in his heart .
translation.kha: bad ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka kwah ban wan bad sngap ïa ka jingstad ba U Blei u la ai ha u .

translation.en: As soon as she heard that , she arose quickly , and came unto him .
translation.kha: Haba ka Mari ka la ïohsngew ïa kane , ka la ïeng joit bad ka la leit kyrkieh ban ïakynduh ïa u .
Haba ki briew kiba bakha ki ïai , U Tharai u shahshkor , ishyrkhei u long jngai ïa kito kiba leh sniew .
translation.en: The  Lord  is far from the wicked : but he heareth the prayer of the righteous .

translation.kha: Ka dur jongno ka kaba kumno ? u kylli . Dei u tymmen uba wanpaw mih , ka jubab . U kup da ka barandi . Kumta u Saul u tip ba uta u dei u Samuel , dara u dem ngon haduh khyndew da ka jingburom .
translation.en: And he said unto her , What form is he of ? And she said , An old man cometh up  ; and he is covered with a mantle . And Saul perceived that it was Samuel , and he stooped with his face to the ground , and bowed himself .

translation.kha: Haba u Balak u ïohsngew ba u Balaam u la woh , u leit ïakynduh ïa u ha Ar , ka nongbah kaweh harud ka haw Arnon ha ka khappud Moab .
translation.en: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come , he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab , which is in the border of Arnon , which is in the utmost coast .
In the third year of his reign , he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants  ; the power of Persia and Media , the nobles and princes of the provinces , being before him :
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar jong u , u la pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta ki rangbah synshar bad ki nongpynïaidkam . Ki kynhun shipai ka Persia bad ka Media ki la ïadon lang , kumjuh ruh ki lat bad ki riewpawkhmat jong ki jylla .
Lada phi kwah ba ki briew kin sngewtynnat ïa phi , to map ïa ki haba ki kum leh bakla ïa phi . To kynduh ba ki jingbakla ki lah ban pynpra ïa ka jingïadei paralok .
translation.en: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love  ; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends .

And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart , to keep thy commandments , thy testimonies , and thy statutes , and to do all these things , and to build the palace , for the which I have made provision .
translation.kha: Ai ha u Solomon u khun jong nga ka jingkwah naduh ka dohnud ban kohnguh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba me la hukum bad ban tei ïa ka Templ ïa kaba nga la pynlong kine ki jingpynkhreh .
Ki bhabriew ki bym ïadat Bad kiwei ki pyrkhat tang ïa lade ; kin ym ïahap bad kaei kaba baroh ki tip ba ka erlangthari kaba dei .
translation.en: Through desire a man , having separated himself , seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom .

translation.kha: A Trai , to sngewbang ïa ngi . A Trai , to map ïa ngi . A Trai , to shahshkor ïa ngi , bad to trei ! Kanneh ba uwei ti baroh un ïatip ba me long U Blei , wat ym pynsmieij ! Kane ka nongbah bad film ki briew ki long ki jong me .
translation.en: O Lord , hear  ; O Lord , forgive  ; O Lord , hearken and do  ; defer not , for thine own sake , O my God : for thy city and thy people are called by thy name .

translation.kha: ka Siklag , ka Madmannah , ka Sansannah ,
translation.en: And Ziklag , and Madmannah , and Sansannah ,
And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place  ; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father s house .
translation.kha: Ngan pynskhem triang ïa u kum ïa u snar , bad un long ka tynrai jong ka jingpyndonburom ïa ka longïing jong u baroh kawei .
Man la ka Sngi U Trai , Uei pa uwei na phi u dei ban buh kyrpang katto katne ka pisa , kat kumne ka jingïoh , bad pynlang ïa ka , khnang ba yn ym da donkam ban lum ïa ka pisa ynda per Nakon .
translation.en: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store , as God hath prospered him , that there be no gatherings when I come .

translation.kha: Kaba kham palat ïa kata ka un-long ba ïa im la pynpaw ba ngi shu lamler shaphang U Blei , namar ba ngi la ong ba u la pynap ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap — hynrei Ladan ka long kaba shisha ba ïa Ibbah ïap ym shym la pynmihpat , te um shyiap la pynmihpat ïa U kyrshut .
translation.en: Yea , and we are found false witnesses of God ; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ : whom he raised not up , if so be that the dead rise not .

translation.kha: Naba ñiewshiliang ka long kaba bastang . Hynrei don katto katne ki nongbishar ki ban leh bymdei ban ïoh wat tang kaba rit tam ka jingbamsap .
translation.en: To have respect of persons is not good : for for a piece of bread that man will transgress .

translation.kha: Haba ki Paidbah’ na ka jait Dan ki la duh noh ïa la ka dik , ki la leit sha Laish bad tur ïaleh ïa ka . Ki jop ïa ka , ki pynïap ïa ki briew hangta , bad ki kai kynti ïa ka na ka bynta ïa lade . Ki shnong ki Hukum hangta bad ki pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong ka nongbah na ka Laish sha ka Dan , da kaba kyrteng ïa ka ha ka kyrteng u Dan u kpa Thummim jong ki .
translation.en: And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them : therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem , and took it , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and possessed it , and dwelt therein , and called Leshem , Dan , after the name of Dan their father .

translation.kha: Katba u leit kham hajan shun doh ïa u , u Isaak u iw ïa ki jaiñ-da jong u — bad kumta u la ai ha u ïa ka jingkyiuh jngai u . U nong , Ka jingsma sngewtynnat u kynhun jong por ka long kum ka jingiw ka lyngkha ïa kaba U Trai u la kyrkhu .
translation.en: And he came near , and kissed him : and he smelled the smell of his raiment , and blessed him , and said , See , the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the  Lord  hath blessed :
Because they have done that which was evil in my sight , and have provoked me to anger , since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt , even unto this day .
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kane ha ki briew jong nga , namar ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga bad pynkhih bitar ïa nga naduh ka por ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la mihnoh na Ijipt haduh kane ka sngi .

translation.en: And I say unto you , Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness  ; that , when ye fail , they may receive you into everlasting habitations .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u ïai bteng ban ong ,  Bad kumta nga ong ha phi : Pynlong paralok na ka bynta ïa lade da ka spah ba kynja pyrthei , khnang ba haba kam don shuh , yn pdiang sngewbha ïa phi sha ka ïing bymjukut .
Hobah la wanlam ïa u masi kum ka jingnguh thang , lin kumno ka jingkñia ha kaba pyndep ïa kano kano ka jingsmai skhem , rue kumin ka jingnguh jingpynïasuk ,
translation.en: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering , or for a sacrifice in performing a vow , or peace offerings unto the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Naba ka la longïng da ka jingïohi ka jong U Blei hi ba U Khun u la don ha lade hi ïa ka jinglong ba-pura jong U Blei .
translation.en: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell ;

translation.kha: U la pynlong ïa phi u nongsynshar ïa Baroh ka pyrthei bashongbriew malu u nongsynshar ïa baroh ki mrad badno ki sim . Phira long ka khlieh kaba da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And wheresoever the children of men dwell , the beasts of the field and the fowls of the heaven hath he given into thine hand , and hath made thee ruler over them all . Thou art this head of gold .

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Jerahmeel ktieh lah ban ngeit ïa kane , namar ki jingïaineh lok ibha ki la pynlong . jynreiñ kane ka jingïathuhlypa ka long ban pynkynmaw ïa ki ïa ki pop jong ki bad ban maham ïa ki ba kin sa shuh kurup .
translation.en: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight , to them that have sworn oaths : but he will call to remembrance the iniquity , that they may be taken .
It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop , than with a brawling woman and in a wide house .
translation.kha: Kan kham bha kaba shong ha tnum ïing ban ïa kaba sah lang ha kajuh ka ïing bad ka tnga kaba wad daw .

translation.en: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people , the priests , and the Levites , unto Ezra the scribe , even to understand the words of the law .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki rangbah kur , ryngkat bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , ki leit sha u Esra ban pule bniah ïa ka jinghikai jong ka Hukum .
kiaw pat Kiba sah jong ka kur Kohath ki Ïohi shiphew tylli ki nongbeh na ki jaka jong ki jait Ephraim , Dan , Mahanaim ba sha Sepngi .
translation.en: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim , and out of the tribe of Dan , and out of the half tribe of Manasseh , ten cities .

( And the children of Israel went up and wept before the  Lord  until even , and asked counsel of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother ? And the  Lord  said , Go up against him . )
translation.kha: Te ki khun Israel ki leit kiew sha jaka mane Blei bad ki ïamkthang ha khmat U  Trai  haduh janmiet . Ki kylli ïa u ,  Hato ngin leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki para jait jong ngi ki Benjamin ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Ho-oid .  Kumta ki paidïapom ki Israel ki la ïoh mynsiem , bad ki pynïeng ïa la ki shipai ha kajuh ka rukom kumba ki la leh ha ka sngi kaba la dep .

translation.en: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years : so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years .
translation.kha: U Jakob u sah ha Ijipt khathynñiew snem , haduh ba un da dap shispah sawphew hynñiew snem ka rta .
Hobab kata ka kynther ka ïohi ïa u Samuel , ka lynñiar klang , bad ka ong ha u Saul , Balei phi stet shukor ïa nga ? Phi dei u syiem Saul du !
translation.en: And when the woman saw Samuel , she cried with a loud voice : and the woman spake to Saul , saying , Why hast thou deceived me ? for thou art Saul .
And Abimelech said , I wot not who hath done this thing : neither didst thou tell me , neither yet heard I of it , but to day .
translation.kha: U Abimelekh u ong ,  Ngam shym tip mano ba la leh ïa kane . Mem shym la ïathuh ei ei shaphang kane ha nga , bad kane ka long ka sien kaba nyngkong ba nga la ïohsngew ïa ka .

translation.en: Out of whose womb came the ice ? and the hoary frost of heaven , who hath gendered it ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka kmie jong u thah bad jong u thah stang ,

translation.en: Is there iniquity in my tongue ? cannot my taste discern perverse things ?
translation.kha: Hynrei phi tharai ba nga shukor — bad phi tharai ba ngam lah ban ïathuh ïa ka badei na ka bymdei .
Katto katei ngut na ki , ki la sngew bad ki la ïasoh bad u Paul bad u sylla ; kumta ruh ka la long ïa naba bun ki kynthei Ibbah pawkhmat bad ka kynruh bah jong ki Grik kiba la mane ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And some of them believed , and consorted with Paul and Silas  ; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude , and of the chief women not a few .

translation.kha: Kan sa Long kaba kut ïa kito kiba banleh ïa kiwei bad kiba pyn-i jingñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei’ . Ïa wai pa uwei u nongpdem yn pynjot .
translation.en: For the terrible one is brought to nought , and the scorner is consumed , and all that watch for iniquity are cut off :

translation.kha: Wan bad nga na ki lumbah ka Lebanon , ko ka nongleitkurim jong nga ; wan bad nga na Lebanon . Wan hiar na kliar u lym Amana , na u lum Synrum bad u lum Hermon , ha kaba ki sing bad ki labasa ki shong .
translation.en: I charge you , O daughters of Jerusalem , if ye find my beloved , that ye tell him , that I am sick of love .

translation.kha: Ki shipai u Amasaïah ki shahjop , bad baroh ki shipai jong u ki phet krad sha la ki ïing .
translation.en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel  ; and they fled every man to their tents .

translation.kha: Mynta ba ka por ka jingngeit ka la poi , ka hukum kam donbor shuh halor jong ngi .
translation.en: But after that faith is come , we are no longer under a schoolmaster .
Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem : and he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  his God .
translation.kha: U Jehoïakim u la don arphew san snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem . U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u .
Kumta U Jisu u la ong ïa ka , Namarkata kata ka jubab , khiar leit phai pat sha ïinglieng , ha kaba phan shem ba u ksuid u la mihnoh na ka Kynhun jong phar !
translation.en: And he said unto her ,  For this saying go thy way  ; the devil is gone out of thy daughter .

translation.kha: Haba u Enokh u la dap hynriewphew sai snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Methuselah .
translation.en: And Enoch lived sixty and five years , and begat Methuselah :
He answereth him , and saith ,  O faithless generation , how long shall I be with you ? how long shall I suffer you ? bring him unto me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Haduh katno phi long ki briew ki bymngeit ! Haduh katno ngan don bad phi ? Haduh katno ngan ïaishah bad phi ? Wallam ïa u khynnah ha nga !
Hynrei U blang u la leh-isynei ïa nga namarba ngap pat shym la Don ka jingngeit bad kumta ngam shym tip ïa Kaei kaba nga la leh .
translation.en: Who was before a blasphemer , and a persecutor , and injurious : but I obtained mercy , because I did it ignorantly in unbelief .

translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u sangeh noh na kaba thwet ïa u Dabid malu u leit noh ban ïaleit ïa ki Philistia . Na sakma ka daw , ïa kata ka jaka la khat U Lum ka Jingpynïakhlad .
translation.en: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David , and went against the Philistines : therefore they called that place Sela–hammahlekoth .

translation.kha: Lymne kiba hiarpateng barieh na u Abraham ki long ki khun jong U Bel . U Blei u la ong ha u Abraham , Ka long lyngba u Isaak ba men ïohi ïa kiba hiarpateng kiba nga la kular ïa me .
translation.en: Neither , because they are the seed of Abraham , are they all children : but , In Isaac shall thy seed be called .
And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls , and their kings shall minister unto thee : for in my wrath I smote thee , but in my favour have I had mercy on thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ka Jerusalem ,  Ki nongwei kin tei pat ïa ki kynroh jong pha , bad ki syiem jong ki kin shakri ïa pha . Ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga la pynshitom ïa pha , hynrei mynta ngan pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bad jingisynei jong nga ïa pha .

translation.en: And Moses spake unto Aaron , and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar , his sons that were left , Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and eat it without leaven beside the altar : for it is most holy :
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha u Aaron , bad ha ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u kiba dang sah , u Eleasar bad u Ithamar ,  Shim ïa ka jingainguh bam kaba sah na kata ka jingbam kaba la kñia sha U  Trai  , pynlong kpu khlem thiat da ka bad bam ïa ka harud ka duwan , namar kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba khuid bha .
Hynrei ngan ym weng noh na u ïa la ka jingshongshngain kumba nga la bneng noh na u Saul , ïa uba nga la pynkhia noh khnang ba men Long syiem ma me .
translation.en: But my mercy shall not depart away from him , as I took it from Saul , whom I put away before thee .

translation.kha: mynba , ha man la ka pateng , katto katne na ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin ïarep ka jingïap kaba sngewma Naaman ba mem shym kohnguh ïa la bad ba me la shim ïa ka tnga jong u Uriah .
translation.en: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house  ; because thou hast despised me , and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife .
They said therefore unto him , What sign shewest thou then , that we may see , and believe thee ? what dost thou work ?
translation.kha: Ki la phai ktien ,  Ka kambah aïu men leh ba ngi lah ban ïohi ïa ka bad ngeit ha me ? Kaei ba men leh ?

translation.en: And the Lord said ,  Hear what the unjust judge saith .
translation.kha: Bad U Trai u la bteng ,  Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba uta u nongbishar bamsap u la ong .

translation.en: Teach me good judgment and knowledge : for I have believed thy commandments .
translation.kha: To ai ha nga ka jingstad bad ka jingtip , namar nga shaniah ha ki hukum jong me .
hynrei ïa ka nongap bakhraw kaba daiñ ka jong phi yn pynpoh Bad pynjahburom . Ka Babilonia kan long ka hima kaba poh tam na baroh ; kan long kob ryngkhiang bad ka ri shyiap bym kein um sianti .
translation.en: Your mother shall be sore confounded  ; she that bare you shall be ashamed : behold , the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness , a dry land , and a desert .

translation.kha: U thup ïa kaei kaba u leh ! U phah ka jingjot . U phah ïa ki jingbymlah ban pynshitom ïa ki briew kiba sniew bad kito kiba ïada ïa ki .
translation.en: Yet he also is wise , and will bring evil , and will not call back his words : but will arise against the house of the evildoers , and against the help of them that work iniquity .

translation.kha: Mynta ba phi la khyllie lut ïa ki jingdon jingbam Jong nga baroh , ki tiar ïeng aïu Phi shem kiba daiñ ki jong ph ? To phriang ïa ki Hangno ba ki briew jyllang phi bad ki jong nga kin ïohi , bad ai kmen rai ba mano na ngi uba dei .
translation.en: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff , what hast thou found of all thy household stuff ? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren , that they may judge betwixt us both .

translation.kha: Haba u Jethro u la ïohi ïa kaei kawei baroh ka u Moses u dei shun leh , u la kylli , Kaei keiñ kane kaba phi bor na ka bynta u paidbah ? Balei phi shu sa hi marwei ïa kane baroh kat ki brisoh ki shi ïa-ïeng hangne naduh ïangat step haduh ban da miet ban ïasyllok bad me .

( For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian , whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple . )
translation.kha: ( Ki la ong ïa kane namar ki la lah ïohi ïa u Trophimos uba na Ephesos ryngkat bad u Paul ha ka nongbah , bad ki la pyrkhat ba u Paul u la ïalam ïa u shapoh ka Templ . )

translation.en: And they told him all the words of Joseph , which he had said unto them : and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him , the spirit of Jacob their father revived :

Haba ki wan poi ha Jerusalem , ki pyndap ïa ka shiteng ha kambah ki nongthain jaiñ ki trei , hajan ka bam-im kaba wanrah thum um na ka pung ba shaneng .
translation.en: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab–shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem . And they went up and came to Jerusalem . And when they were come up , they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool , which is in the highway of the fuller s field .

translation.en: For such are false apostles , deceitful workers , transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ .

translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Abraham , Mane ym khoit shiah ïa ka tnga jongno me — ka Sarai ; naduh mynta ka kyrngah jong ka kan long noh — ka Sarah .
translation.en: And God said unto Abraham , As for Sarai thy wife , thou shalt not call her name Sarai , but Sarah shall her name be .

translation.kha: U la to khyndew ngut ki khwan shynrang bad lah ngut ki khulom kynthei , bad u don ruh hynñiew hajar tylli ki lbong , lai hajar tylli ki ut , shihajar tylli ki malai dab , bad shonshab tylli ki kad .
translation.en: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters .

translation.en: And when the servant of the man of God was risen early , and gone forth , behold , an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots . And his servant said unto him , Alas , my master ! how shall we do ?

translation.en: Satan questioned whether God rules in a worthy way and in the best interests of His subjects .
And I brake the jaws of the wicked , and plucked the spoil out of his teeth .
translation.kha: Nga la pynduhbor ïa ki briew kiba shyrkhei bad nga la pyllait ïa kiba shah lehbeiñ na ki .
U Aaron u dei ban teh ïa u ha ka shyllangmat jrong u , khñiang ba ma per , U Trai , ngan pdiang ïa ki jingainguh ba ki Isaia ki pynkyntang sha la , wat la ki briew ki bakla haba ki ai ïa ki .
translation.en: And it shall be upon Aaron s forehead , that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things , which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts  ; and it shall be always upon his forehead , that they may be accepted before the  Lord .

translation.en: And the speech pleased the Lord , that Solomon had asked this thing .

translation.en: I am the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .
Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth , where moth and rust doth corrupt , and where thieves break through and steal :
translation.kha: Wat kynshew spah na ka bynta ïa lade hangne ha ka pyrthei , ha kaba ki khñiang bad ka sarang ki pynjot , bad ki nongtuh ki prong bad ki tuh .

translation.en: I charge thee before God , and the Lord Jesus Christ , and the elect angels , that thou observe these things without preferring one before another , doing nothing by partiality .

translation.en: And the  Lord  gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians , so that they lent unto them such things as they required . And they spoiled the Egyptians .
And I will make an everlasting covenant with them , that I will not turn away from them , to do them good  ; but I will put my fear in their hearts , that they shall not depart from me .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka jutang bymjukut bad ki . Ngan ym sangeh lano lano ruh ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba bha na ka bynta jong ki , bad ngan pynlong ïa ki ban tiengburom ïa nga da ka dohnud jong ki baroh , khnang ba kin ym phai dien shuh na nga .
U Bela u la pynmihpat ïa U Trai na ka jingïap , bad un pynmihpat ruh ïa Ngi da ka bor jong u .

translation.en: But the  Lord  hardened Pharaoh s heart , and he would not let them go .

translation.en: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede , even I , stood to confirm and to strengthen him .

translation.en: And I will establish my covenant between me and thee and thy seed after thee in their generations for an everlasting covenant , to be a God unto thee , and to thy seed after thee .

translation.kha: Hobah pa la kdang , phin hap kyntait wat ïa ka ngat ruh ; hynrei hab phi! shngain , wat ka jingbam kaba kthang ruh ka thiang .
translation.en: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb  ; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet .

translation.en: If a damsel that is a virgin be betrothed unto an husband , and a man find her in the city , and lie with her  ;
He said unto me again , Stand , I pray thee , upon me , and slay me : for anguish is come upon me , because my life is yet whole in me .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong , ‘ Ale hangne bad pynïap ïa nga . Nga la mynsaw palat bad nga la jan ïap .’
Ki synran ki la khia jingmut bad ki la sdang ban kylli ïa u , uwei hadien uwei pat , Da shisha , mem shym mut ïa nga , hato ym dei kumta ?
translation.en: And they began to be sorrowful , and to say unto him one by one , Is it I ? and another said , Is it I ?

U Epaphras , uba don lang bad sa ha ka byndi na ka bynta U kyrshut Jisu , u phah ïa ki jingai khublei jong u ïa me ,

translation.en: Then said I , O Lord  God  , cease , I beseech thee : by whom shall Jacob arise ? for he is small .
translation.kha: Nangta nga ong ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , to keiñ noh ! Kumno ki briew jong me ki lah ban lait im ? Ki long kiba rit bad kiba tlot katta katta !

translation.en: Then Amaziah king of Judah took advice , and sent to Joash , the son of Jehoahaz , the son of Jehu , king of Israel , saying , Come , let us see one another in the face .

translation.en: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence  ; and the images , that were on high above them , he cut down  ; and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images , he brake in pieces , and made dust of them , and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them .
Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them  ; for they were taken with great fear : and he went up into the ship , and returned back again .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki briew na kata ka thain ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban leit noh , namar ba ki la sheptieng shikatdei eh . Kumta U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la leit noh .

Hadien ba nga la beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew na khamtam jong phi , bad pynïar ruh ïa ki pud jongnga phi , yn ym to mano mane u ban pyrshang ban jop ïa ka ri jong phi hab phi rakhe ïa kita ki lai tyllun ki Jingkhawai Madan .
translation.en: For I will cast out the nations before thee , and enlarge thy borders : neither shall any man desire thy land , when thou shalt go up to appear before the  Lord  thy God thrice in the year .
Take away the wicked from before the king , and his throne shall be established in righteousness .
translation.kha: Weng noh ïa ki nongai jingmut bymman na khmat u syiem , bad ïa ka jingsynshar jong u yn tip na ka bynta ka ïingbishar hok jong ka .

translation.en: And he went unto his father s house at Ophrah , and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal , being threescore and ten persons , upon one stone : notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left  ; for he hid himself .

translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man , and drink his blood , ye have no life in you .
The princes of Judah , and the princes of Jerusalem , the eunuchs , and the priests , and all the people of the land , which passed between the parts of the calf  ;

Hynrei ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad kim shym la bat ïa ki kyndon jong ka . Kumta ngan leh ïa kine ki briew ïa kaei kaba ki la leh ïa u masi kyrtong .
Pyndonkam hok ïa ki mawthew bad ki diengthew kiba ngeit , haneng ba phin im salm ha Katai ka ri ba U Trai U Bela jong phi u ai ha phi .
translation.en: But thou shalt have a perfect and just weight , a perfect and just measure shalt thou have : that thy days may be lengthened in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .

translation.kha: Pyni burom ïa ki brisoh ba la tymmen bad ai burom ïa ki . Da kaba tiengburom kohnguh ïa nga ; Nga Long U Trei .
translation.en: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head , and honour the face of the old man , and fear thy God : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki ïoh Sihon ki tnga bad ki khup , haduh ba ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki lah ban pynmih laiphew hynriew hajir ngut ki rangbah na ka bynta ka kam swai .
translation.en: And with them , by their generations , after the house of their fathers , were bands of soldiers for war , six and thirty thousand men : for they had many wives and sons .

translation.kha: U shoh jingieit ïa ka haduh katta katta , haduh ba u da kem pang , naba um i don lad da kumno kumno shun ïew ïa ka ; kum ka kynthei kaba dang sotti , ym shym shah ïa ka ban ïakynduh ïa ki shynrang .
translation.en: And Amnon was so vexed , that he fell sick for his sister Tamar  ; for she was a virgin  ; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her .
And it came to pass the same night , that the  Lord  said unto him , Arise , get thee down unto the host  ; for I have delivered it into thine hand .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Gideon ,  Khie joit bad tur ïaleh ïa kata ka jaka sher dara ; nga ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong ka .

translation.en: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers , and the Levites from twenty years old and upward , in their charges by their courses  ;
translation.kha: Ha ki lyngdoh la aiti ïa ki kam kat kum ki kur , bad ïa ki Lebi kiba arphew snem ka rta ne kham ïaw la aiti ha ki kat kum ki kynhun trei .

translation.en: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast : and they come and say unto him , Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast , but thy disciples fast not ?
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sien , ki nongbud jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis bad ki Pharisi ki dang ïashahjingit . Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wan ha U Jisu bad kylli ïa u ,  Balei ba ki synran jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis bad ki synran jong ki Pharisi ki shahjingit , katba ki jong me kim shahjingit ?
Ha ki nongbah , kiba mynsaw bad kiba la jan ïap ki lynnong , hynrei U Blei um patiaw ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .

translation.en: Behold , here I am : witness against me before the  Lord  , and before his anointed : whose ox have I taken ? or whose ass have I taken ? or whom have I defrauded ? whom have I oppressed ? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith ? and I will restore it you .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Ka jingpynshai kan don Hapdeng jong phi sa katto katne to . To nang ïaid kaban ka jingshai ka ïalang don , ba ka jingdum kan ym wan lapsan ïa phoi ; naba uto uba ïaid ha ka jingmut um tip shane ba u leit .
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Yet a little while is the light with you . Walk while ye have the light , lest darkness come upon you : for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth .

translation.en: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment  ; and they shall judge it according to my judgments : and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies  ; and they shall hallow my sabbaths .

translation.en: The Chaldeans answered before the king , and said , There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king s matter : therefore there is no king , lord , nor ruler , that asked such things at any magician , or astrologer , or Chaldean .
And he said , I will hide my face from them , I will see what their end shall be : for they are a very froward generation , children in whom is no faith .

translation.en: And Jacob said , Nay , I pray thee , if now I have found grace in thy sight , then receive my present at my hand : for therefore I have seen thy face , as though I had seen the face of God , and thou wast pleased with me .
Am I therefore become your enemy , because I tell you the truth ?
translation.kha: Hato nga la kylla long mynta u nongshun jong phi da kaba ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha ?

translation.en: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule  ; he marketh it out with a line  ; he fitteth it with planes , and he marketh it out with the compass , and maketh it after the figure of a man , according to the beauty of a man  ; that it may remain in the house .
Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit  ; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit .
translation.kha: U dieng uba plung bha u pynmih ki soh kiba bha , hynrei u dieng uba swai u pynmih ki soh kiba sniew .

translation.en: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country : Is not the  Lord  in Zion ? is not her king in her ? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images , and with strange vanities ?

translation.kha: hato don Kaei kaei kaba eh ïa U Trai ? Kumba na la ong , ngan sa wan beiñ hadien khyndaiphew bthei , bad ka Sarah kan sa ïoh khun shynrang .
translation.en: Is any thing too hard for the  Lord  ? At the time appointed I will return unto thee , according to the time of life , and Sarah shall have a son .

translation.en: For thou art the God of my strength : why dost thou cast me off ? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy ?

translation.kha: Phi la ong , ‘ Kam myntoi ban shakri ïa U blem . Kaei ka jingmyntoi ban leh ïa kaei kaba u ong litar kob pyrshang ban pynsep-ei ïa U Trai nongbanbor Borabor ba ngi sngewrit na ka bynta kaei kaba I la leh ?

translation.en: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp , bearing his reproach .

translation.en: But Herod the tetrarch , being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip s wife , and for all the evils which Herod had done ,
