And there was given me a reed like unto a rod : and the angel stood , saying , Rise , and measure the temple of God , and the altar , and them that worship therein .
translation.kha: La ai ha nga ïa u dieng uba syriem ïa u diengthew , bad la ong ïa nga ,  Khie leit bad thew ïa ka Templ U Blei bad ïa ka duwan , bad ñiew ïa kito kiba mane ha ka templ .
Bad phi ruh phi ïasngewdei ïa kata kaba bha ban ni .
translation.en: And ye answered me , and said , The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do .

translation.kha: Haba phi ai kylliang ei ei ïa un uno u briew’ , wat leit rung shuh ïit jong u ban shngiam ïa ka kjap ban bah bynda ha phi ;
translation.en: When thou dost lend thy brother any thing , thou shalt not go into his house to fetch his pledge .
But as for you , your carcases , they shall fall in this wilderness .
translation.kha: Phi , phin ïap ha kane ka ri khlaw .

translation.en: And he prayed unto the  Lord  , and said , I pray thee , O  Lord  , was not this my saying , when I was yet in my country ? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish : for I knew that thou art a gracious God , and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and repentest thee of the evil .
translation.kha: Kumta u la duwai ,  A Trai , hato ngam la ong shuwa ba ngan mih na ïing ba kane ka dei kaei kaba men leh ? Dei na kata ka daw ba nga la pyrshang tyngeh ban phet noh sha Spain ! Nga la tip ba me long U Blei ka jingieit bad ka jingisynei , uba ïaishah slem , uba sbun borabor , bad uba kloi borabor ban kylla ïa la ka jingmut ban ym pynshitom .
U nongrep uba bajaipdeh palat ban lur ïa ki lyngkha jong u ha ka jer kaba biang un ym ïoh ei ei ïa ka ban ot .
translation.en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold  ; therefore shall he beg in harvest , and have nothing .
And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of the  Lord  , and an house for his kingdom .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u la rai ban tei ïa ka Templ ha kaba yn mane ïa U  Trai  , bad ruh ban tei ka ïingsyiem na ka bynta ïa lade .

U la ong ruh ïa ine banbeiñ ym tei ki ïing ne rep ki lyngkha , bad ban ym shuh ki bri sohwaiñ lane thied ïa ki . U la hukum ïa ngi ba ngin shong ngin sah borabor ha ki jingïohnong , khñiang ba ngin kein ha kano ka ri ha kaba ngi im kum ki nongwei .
translation.en: Neither shall ye build house , nor sow seed , nor plant vineyard , nor have any : but all your days ye shall dwell in tents  ; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers .

translation.kha: I ñiew ïa ngi Kum ki nongwei . I la sla ïa ngi , pynlang mynta i la pynlut ïa ka pisa baroh kaba long ka dor jong ngi .
translation.en: Are we not counted of him strangers ? for he hath sold us , and hath quite devoured also our money .

translation.kha: wai lada phira synsar ïa u bieit haduh ba u la marjan ïap , pynban phin ym da satia ban weng ïa ka jingbieit na u .
translation.en: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle , yet will not his foolishness depart from him .

translation.kha: pulom ïa ka ktien jongngi U man la ka sngi .
translation.en: Study his Word each day .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew ki kohnguh , te ngan rat lut khoit bad pynjot ïa ka . Ma ar , U Trai , la la kren .
translation.en: But if they will not obey , I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u jingphohsniew ïa ka khubor jong nga bad um kohnguh ïa ka , ngan ym bishar ïa u . Nga la wan , ym ban bishar ïa ka pyrthei , hynrei ba pynsum ïa ka .
translation.en: And if any man hear my words , and believe not , I judge him not : for I came not to judge the world , but to save the world .
And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men .
translation.kha: Ka jingdon ki rangbah ïa kiba la bsa ka la long san hajar ngut .

translation.en: And he said , Thou shalt not go through . And Edom came out against him with much people , and with a strong hand .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Edom ki ban ktien biang ,  Ngim shah !  Bad ki la wan mih bad ka kynhun ïapom kaba khlaiñ ban tur ïaleh ïa ki paid Israel .
Nongthaw u Jehohanan u ïong ha u , Naba lashai ka dei ka jingïakhih mut banbeiñ thymmai , ka jingbymngeit jong phi! kan paw shatai lada phim don ha jingïabam .
translation.en: Then Jonathan said to David , To morrow is the new moon : and thou shalt be missed , because thy seat will be empty .

translation.kha: tala ka long haba ka jingshai jong ka sngi , u bnai , bad ki khlur kun sdang lip ïa phi , bad ki lyoh slap kin ym leit noh da lei lei .
translation.en: While the sun , or the light , or the moon , or the stars , be not darkened , nor the clouds return after the rain :

translation.kha: Hynrei uwei na kita kiba ïa-ïeng hangta u la sei ïa ka waitlam bad u la pom ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad ïoh mait ïa ka shkor jong u .
translation.en: And one of them that stood by drew a sword , and smote a servant of the high priest , and cut off his ear .
And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea : who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews .
translation.kha: Mar ïapoi ka miet , ki parabangeit ki la phah ïa u Paul bad u Silas sha Beria . Haba ki la poi hangta , ki la leit sha ka synagog .

Ki la shim ïa la ki ryntieh bad ki waitlam ; ki erlangthari kiba runar bad ki bym ba-don jingisynei . Ki sawa kamon ka duriaw bakyrhuh , katba ki Shong ha ki kulai jong ki . Ki la pynkhih ïa ka thlim pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: They shall lay hold on bow and spear  ; they are cruel , and have no mercy  ; their voice roareth like the sea  ; and they ride upon horses , set in array as men for war against thee , O daughter of Zion .
But lift thou up thy rod , and stretch out thine hand over the sea , and divide it : and the children of Israel shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea .
translation.kha: Rah ïa la u diengduh bad bat ïa u halor ka duriaw . Ka um kan sa kad arliang , bad ki Israel kin lah ban ïaid lyngba ïa kata ka duriaw halor ka khyndew kaba rkhiang .
Ong ha ki Israel ba ktang wallam ha nga ïa ki jingainguh . Pdeng ïa kino kino ki jingainguh kat kiba uno uno u manna ban ai .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , that they bring me an offering : of every man that giveth it willingly with his heart ye shall take my offering .
But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build , who also laid the beams thereof , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof .
translation.kha: Ka kur Hassenaah ka tei ïa ka Khyrdop Dohkha . Ki buh ïa ki bim bad pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ki jingkhang ïa ka khyrdop .
Ha kajuh ka Por , U Blei jin u la ai shuh ïa la ki sakhi ha ki , da kaba imat bun ki kambah bad ki kamphylla bad da kaba ïamih ïa ki jingai U Mynsiem bakynjah kat kum ka mon jongngi u .
translation.en: God also bearing them witness , both with signs and wonders , and with divers miracles , and gifts of the Holy Ghost , according to his own will ?
One shall say , I am the  Lord s   ; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob  ; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the  Lord  , and surname himself by the name of Israel .
translation.kha: Uwei hadien uwei , ki briew kin ong , ‘ nga long u jong U TRAI’ . Kin ïawan ban ïasnoh bad u paid Israel . Uwei pa uwei un shon ha ka ksang ti jong u ïa ka kyrteng jong U  Trai bad un khot ïa lade uwei na ki briew U Blei .
Em , me lah ban shah tang ïa ka jingshit haba ka lyer na shaphang shathie ka lynshop ïa ka ri .
translation.en: How thy garments are warm , when he quieteth the earth by the south wind ?

translation.kha: Katba u dang Sakhi ïa ki , u la ong , Sumar bha na ki nongñiah ka Hukum , kiba sngewtynnat ban leit kylleng ha ki jaiñkup jynsur bad ba yn jingkhublei ïa ki da ka jinglehburom ha ka jaka ïew ,
translation.en: And he said unto them in his doctrine ,  Beware of the scribes , which love to go in long clothing , and love salutations in the marketplaces ,

translation.kha: Bad ha ka shi kynta ka la duh lut ïa kane ka spah ! Baroh ki kapten jong ki liengbah bad ki nongshong lynti , ki maji bad borbah kiwei pat kiba la ïoh kamai na ka duriaw , ki la ïeng na sha Jngai bah ,
translation.en: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought . And every shipmaster , and all the company in ships , and sailors , and as many as trade by sea , stood afar off ,
The king said also unto Zadok the priest , Art not thou a seer ? return into the city in peace , and your two sons with you , Ahimaaz thy son , and Jonathan the son of Abiathar .
translation.kha: Bad u la bteng da kaba ong shuh shuh ha u Sadok ,  Peit shane , khie ïalam noh ïa u Ahimaas , u khun jong me bad ïa u Jonathan u khun jong u Abiathar sha ka nongbah ha ka jingsuk .
hateng kata u la im sa shispah khatkhyndai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khup .
translation.en: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years , and begat sons and daughters .

translation.kha: U Joshua u la leh kumta ,
translation.en: Joshua therefore commanded the priests , saying , Come ye up out of Jordan .

Then the mariners were afraid , and cried every man unto his god , and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea , to lighten it of them . But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship  ; and he lay , and was fast asleep .
translation.kha: Ki maji ki la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap , uwei pa uwei sha la u jong u blei . Nangta , khnang ban pynduna ïa ka jingma , ki bret noh ïa ka jingkit nalor lieng . Ha kata ka por , u Jonah u la hiar sha ka bynta bashapoh , u thiah ha trai ka lieng , u ïohthiah lyngngai .
Ha kadei pa kawei ka balang ki la thung ïa ki nongshoh-nar balang , bad da ki jingaiei bad ka jingshah jingit ki la aiti ïa ki sha U Trai , ha uba ki la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah .
translation.en: And when they had ordained them elders in every church , and had prayed with fasting , they commended them to the Lord , on whom they believed .

translation.kha: Ki don ki jingïadei paralok ki bymneh , hynrei ki don ki paralok kiba lah ban shaniah palat pun ïa ki bymman ki prie .
translation.en: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly : and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother .
And it came to pass , that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem , because they had transgressed against the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba san jong ka jingsynshar jong u ïa ka jingbymïaineh jong ki ha U  Trai  la pynshitom .
Wat pylleng ban kren tipbriew ha uba bieit ; um lah ban ïarah ïa ka .
translation.en: Speak not in the ears of a fool : for he will despise the wisdom of thy words .
That this is a rebellious people , lying children , children that will not hear the law of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Ki long borabor kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei , kiba ïai shukor , kiba ïai kyntait ban shahshkor ïa ki jinghikai U  Trai .
Hynriew mynta te ka bor met ruh ngim don shuh . Ym don ei ei ban bam — thylli loit sa tang kane ka manna na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat !
translation.en: But now our soul is dried away : there is nothing at all , beside this manna , before our eyes .

translation.kha: Haba u duh U Trai u la jan pynim ïa ka Jerushah , U Trai u la kylla ka jingmut ïa-ban pynshitom ïa ki briew bad u ong ha u angel uba pynap ïa ki , Sangeh ! Ka la biang katto ! U jin u la don khatsan ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah , u nongïam Jebus .
translation.en: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it , the  Lord  repented him of the evil , and said to the angel that destroyed the people , It is enough : stay now thine hand . And the angel of the  Lord  was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite .
Then the soldiers , as it was commanded them , took Paul , and brought him by night to Antipatris .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la leh ïa kaba la hukum ïa ki . Ki la shim ïa u Paul bad ki la ïalam ïa u ha kata ka miet haduh Antipatris .

translation.en: The captain of fifty , and the honourable man , and the counsellor , and the cunning artificer , and the eloquent orator .
translation.kha: ïa ki nongïalam shipai bad ki nongïalam paidbah jong ki , ïa ki nongmihkhmat paidbah jong ki bad ïa baroh kiba pyndonkam ïa ka myntor ban bat ïa kino kino ki jingjia .
U la pynjot ïa ki kut , u la pynpyiar ïa ki shnong . Ki briew jongki ka ri ki la sngewshyrkhei man ka por ba u kyrjaw .
translation.en: And he knew their desolate palaces , and he laid waste their cities  ; and the land was desolate , and the fulness thereof , by the noise of his roaring .

translation.kha: Ki la ïamareh ïa ki sha ki rangbah synshar ka Hima Rom bad ki la ong , Kine ki briew ki dei ki Jiw , malade ki la thawsha jingkulmar ha ka nongbah jong ngi .
translation.en: And brought them to the magistrates , saying , These men , being Jews , do exceedingly trouble our city ,
If thou count me therefore a partner , receive him as myself .
translation.kha: Namarkata , lada me pyrkhat ïa nga kum u para ba-ïatrei lem jong me , to pdiang sngewbha pat ïa u kumba men pdiang sngewbha ïa nga .
Nangta u Nathan u leit phai noh shaei ïing . U Trai u la pyntngit ka jingtem bajur ha u khunblang ba ka rnga u Uriah ka la ïoh na u Dabid .
translation.en: And Nathan departed unto his house . And the  Lord  struck the child that Uriah s wife bare unto David , and it was very sick .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka jingkam u Lebi ruh u la wan ïadei , u la ïaid nalor bad u la khmih ïa uta u briew , bad nongap u la ïaid lait , na kawei ka liang .
translation.en: And likewise a Levite , when he was at the place , came and looked on him , and passed by on the other side .
So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel , and found Abishag a Shunammite , and brought her to the king .
translation.kha: Kumta la wad ïa ka samla bhabriew ha kylleng ka ri Israel , bad ki lap ha Shunem ïa kaba kum kata ka kynthei kaba kyrteng ka Abishag , bad ki la wallam ïa ka sha u syiem .
u tyrkhong , u Agate , bad u Agate ha ka kyrdon kaban lai ;
translation.en: And the third row a ligure , an agate , and an amethyst .

translation.kha: Babha kata ka por ka wan , kan don ka duwan ïa U Trai ha ka ri Ijipt bad u rishot maw ba la pynkyntang sha U ha ka pud Ijipt .
translation.en: In that day shall there be an altar to the  Lord  in the midst of the land of Egypt , and a pillar at the border thereof to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei katba nga mut , ko pynrangbah Jong nga . Haba phi ïashem lang ïa ka ban mane ïa U Blei , uwei u don ka jingrwai , uwei pat ïa ka jinghikai , uwei pateng ïa ka jingpynpaw na U blem , sa uwei pat ha ki thylliej baïar , bad sa utai pat ïa ka jingbatai ïa kaei kaba la kren . Baroh ki dei ban long ki ban ïarap ïa ka bajlan .
translation.en: How is it then , brethren ? when ye come together , every one of you hath a psalm , hath a doctrine , hath a tongue , hath a revelation , hath an interpretation . Let all things be done unto edifying .
The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul : but the belly of the wicked shall want .
translation.kha: Kiba hok ki don kyrhai ban bam , hynrei ki bymman ki shahthngan borabor .
Ki briew bakha shong ha ki kali kulai bad ha ki kulai ruh ki ïaleit synran ïa u ; kumta ka kynruh ka long kaba bun .
translation.en: And there went up with him both chariots and horsemen : and it was a very great company .

translation.kha: Na uta u masi un shym noh ïa ka khleiñ baroh , ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki sngur ,
translation.en: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering  ; the fat that covereth the inwards , and all the fat that is upon the inwards ,

translation.kha: ( Ïa u lumlang Hermon la khot Sirion da ki nongthain Sidon , bad Senir da ki sympat )
translation.en: ( Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion  ; and the Amorites call it Senir  ; )

translation.kha: Ki dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad ban long kiba la khreh la shi sngi . Ha kata ka sngi ngan wan hiar ha u Lur Synñia ; ha kaba ki brisoh baroh kin ïohi ïa nga .
translation.en: And be ready against the third day : for the third day the  Lord  will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai .

translation.kha: To shangkhawiah ha U Trai , phi baroh kiba mane ïa u . U ïarap ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi .
translation.en: Ye that fear the  Lord  , trust in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .

translation.kha: Te uta imat pat u synran , uba la poi nyngkong ha ka jingtep , u ruh u la rung shapoh ; u la ïohi bad u la ngeit .
translation.en: Then went in also that other disciple , which came first to the sepulchre , and he saw , and believed .

After this shall he turn his face unto the isles , and shall take many : but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease  ; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him .
translation.kha: Hadien kata un tur ïaleh ïa ki hima kiba harud duriaw bad u jop ïa kiba bun na ki . Hynrei u nongïalam nongwei un jop ïa u bad un pynkut ïa ka jinglehmeng jong u ; da shisha un pynphai pat ïa ka jinglehmeng jong u syiem ka Syria sha u .
Ang pyrsad ïa kane ba ka long kaba dat ïa nga ban pynkhie ïa ka jingkynmaw jong phi ïa kino kiei kiei katba ang dang im .
translation.en: Yea , I think it meet , as long as I am in this tabernacle , to stir you up by putting you in remembrance  ;

translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah shiphew sngi .
translation.en: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years : and he died .
For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure , wherewith the  Lord  was wroth against you to destroy you . But the  Lord  hearkened unto me at that time also .
translation.kha: Nga la sheptieng ïa ka jingbitar shla U  Trai  , naba u la bitar lep kat haduh ba u la kloi wat ban pynjot ïa phi ; hynrei sa shisien U  Trai  u la shahshkor ïa nga .

translation.en: He teareth me in his wrath , who hateth me : he gnasheth upon me with his teeth  ; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingbitar U Blei u la pyndkut ïa ki kti ki kjat jong nga ; u peit ïa nga da ka jingisih .

Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai u Ong ha ki briew jong u ki Eliel : Wat la ki nong Assyria ki khlaiñ malu ki khah bun paid , ïa ki yn pynjot thiaw bad kin jah noh . Ko ki briew jong na , per la pynlong ïa phi ban shahshitom , hynrei ngan ym kuna shuh ïa ka .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Though they be quiet , and likewise many , yet thus shall they be cut down , when he shall pass through . Though I have afflicted thee , I will afflict thee no more .

translation.kha: Ha ka kyrteng U Trai , te , nga maham ïa phi ; wat ïai im Kum kaba mane blei thala , uba ki jingpyrkhat jong ki kim donbor , bad Ibbah ki jingmut jong ki , ki long ha ka jingdum .
translation.en: This I say therefore , and testify in the Lord , that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk , in the vanity of their mind ,

Then Zedekiah the king sent , and took him out : and the king asked him secretly in his house , and said , Is there any word from the  Lord  ? And Jeremiah said , There is : for , said he , thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: Hadien kata u syiem Sedekaïah u la phah khot ïa nga , bad hangta ha ka ïingsyiem u la kylli ïa nga ha kaba jar jar ,  Hato don khubor ei ei na U  Trai  ?   Ka don ,  nga la jubab , bad nga ong shuh shuh ,  Ïa phi yn sa aiti noh ha u syiem ka Babilonia .

Un pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , hapdeng ki bor bakhraw hajan bad hajngai . kin shoh tyrnem ïa la ki waitlam ban pynong ki lyngkor bad ïa ki sum sha ki wait ngor tnum dieng . Ki jaitbynriew kin ym ïaleh thom shuh , kin ym pynheh shuh ban ïaleh thma .
translation.en: And he shall judge among many people , and rebuke strong nations afar off  ; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruninghooks : nation shall not lift up a sword against nation , neither shall they learn war any more .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ai ha ang ïa ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba u la thok da la ka kti ïa kata kaba u la kren ha pa nadong ka ding ha kato ka sngi ba phi ïalumlang ha uta u lym .
translation.en: And the  Lord  delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God  ; and on them was written according to all the words , which the  Lord  spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly .

translation.kha: Ki la pynlong ïa u ban phai dien noh na U Blei , bad katai haduh ba un da tymmen ki la ïalumlang noh ïa u ban mane ïa ki phai nongwei . Um shym la jingkit thok shuh ïa U Trai’ U Blei jong u , kumba u Dabid u kpa jongki u , u la long .
translation.en: For it came to pass , when Solomon was old , that his wives turned away his heart after other gods : and his heart was not perfect with the  Lord  his God , as was the heart of David his father .

translation.kha: Lah ban sympat ïa u haduh sawphew thri , hynrei ym palat ïa kata ; lada phlait ïa Kata , kan pyniphuh dor ïa u ha khmut ki briew .
translation.en: Forty stripes he may give him , and not exceed : lest , if he should exceed , and beat him above these with many stripes , then thy brother should seem vile unto thee .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kiew shwa u lbong bad Hangta u la shong badno la ki synran .
translation.en: And Jesus went up into a mountain , and there he sat with his disciples .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka Die , U blem u mihpaw ha u ha ka jingphohsniew , bad u nguh ha u , Men sa ïaw , namar me la shim ïa kane ka briew ; ka la dep shongkurim .
translation.en: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night , and said to him , Behold , thou art but a dead man , for the woman which thou hast taken  ; for she is a man s wife .
Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  unto them  ; Behold , I , even I , will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ïathuh ha phi ba ngan bishar hapdeng jong phi ïa ki langbrot kiba khlaiñ bad ki langbrot kiba tlot .

translation.en: And they came to Ophir , and fetched from thence gold , four hundred and twenty talents , and brought it to king Solomon .
translation.kha: Ki la leit sha ka ri Ophir bad ki wan kit nangta haduh khatsaw hajar kilo ka ksiar .
Gera kumta la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingkhem , bad ki kyntien jong nga ki dap da ka jingkmen . Bad ma nga , la por long tang u biria , ngan ym khuslai ha ka jingkynrum ,
translation.en: Therefore did my heart rejoice , and my tongue was glad  ; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope :

translation.kha: Ma me A Trai , me la pynlong ïa ngi don lynñiar , kum ka briew kaba lynñiar ha ka jingsuh kha .
translation.en: Like as a woman with child , that draweth near the time of her delivery , is in pain , and crieth out in her pangs  ; so have we been in thy sight , O  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong ha im’ baroh , ‘ Ki khun ki kti jong phi , kiba dang pajih palat ïa-ban tip ïa katba bha na kaba sniew , kin rung sha kata ka ri — ki khun ki kad kiba phi ainong kin shah kurup ha ki nongshun jong pa’ . Ngan ai ïa ka ri ha ki , ban kin ïohkynti ïa ka .
translation.en: Moreover your little ones , which ye said should be a prey , and your children , which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil , they shall go in thither , and unto them will I give it , and they shall possess it .

translation.kha: Namar ba u Job u sngewskhem ïa ka jinglong balaitluid lui jong u hi , i'u ki lai ngut ki rangbah ki iehnoh ïa ka ban pyrshang ban jubab ïa u .
translation.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job , because he was righteous in his own eyes .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba sawphew phra jong ka jingsynshar u Isshaïah u syiem ka Jedaïah , u Sherebaïah u khwan jong u Jeroboam umbah ar u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar hynriew bthei ha Samaria .
translation.en: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months .

translation.kha: Wat lada ki khot ïa nga U Blang jngai ki bad ki kam ba ki dei ki briew jongu nga sad ba ki tap ïa nga ,
translation.en: Israel shall cry unto me , My God , we know thee .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ai hukum , bad ki shipai jong u ki la pynïap ïa u Rekhab bad ïa u Baanah bad ki la ot ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jngai ki , ïa kiba ki la saiñdur hajuh ka pung ha Hebron . Ki la skhem ïa ka khlieh jong u Ishbosheth bad ki la tep ïa ka ha ka jingtep jongngi u Abner hangtei ha Hebron .
translation.en: And David commanded his young men , and they slew them , and cut off their hands and their feet , and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron . But they took the head of Ish–bosheth , and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron .
And it came to pass at the end of forty days , that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made :
translation.kha: Hadien sawphew sngi u Noah u plie ïa ka jingkhangïit , bad u pyllait ïa ka tyngab .

translation.en: And the scribes and chief priests heard it , and sought how they might destroy him : for they feared him , because all the people was astonished at his doctrine .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , kumta ki la sdang ban ïawad da kano ka lad ban pynïap noh ïa U Jisu . Ki la sheptieng ïa u , namar uta u paidbah baroh u la sngewphylla ïa ka jinghikai jong u .

Ha kata ka janmiet ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u bad ki la jong , Ka la da dier eh , badno kane ka dei ka jaka bakynjah . To phah noh ïa ki paidbah badno shah ïa ki ban leit shai ki shnong baneh thad jingbam na ka pyntha ïa lade .
translation.en: And when it was evening , his disciples came to him , saying , This is a desert place , and the time is now past  ; send the multitude away , that they may go into the villages , and buy themselves victuals .
And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years .
translation.kha: U Samson u ïalam ïa ki Israel arphew snem katba ki Philistia ki synshar ïa ka ri .

translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria , and I will deliver thee two thousand horses , if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jingïapan dor bad phi ha ka kyrteng jong u patsha . Ngan ai ha phi ar hajar ki kulai lada phi lah ban pynïoh katta ngut ki briew ban shong ha ki !
to ieh ïa ka jingai jrong phi hangta ha khmat jong ka duwan , khie leit shadien bad ïasuk bad la u para , malu nangta sa wan pat pynlang ai ïa ka jingai jong phi! sha U Blei .
translation.en: Leave there thy gift before the altar , and go thy way  ; first be reconciled to thy brother , and then come and offer thy gift .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ka sngi ka la mih , U Blei u la phah ïa ka lyer mihngi kaba satang , malu u Jona u la jan ïapler na ka jingshat jong ka sngi kaba shoh halor ka khlei jong u . kamut u la kwah pun ïap noh . Ka khah bha ïa nga ban ïap noh ban ïa kaba im , u la ong .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the sun did arise , that God prepared a vehement east wind  ; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah , that he fainted , and wished in himself to die , and said , It is better for me to die than to live .

translation.kha: Ym lah ban thied da ka rupa lane ka ksiar .
translation.en: It cannot be gotten for gold , neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof .
Now will I rise , saith the  Lord   ; now will I be exalted  ; now will I lift up myself .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki jaitbynriew ,  Mynta ngan leh ïa la ka kam . Ngan pyn-i katno nga long uba donbor .

U Sakhaïos u la ïeng jot bad u la ïa-ong ha U Trai , To shahshkor , kynrad ! ngan ai sheng na ki jingjrong jingtim jong ang ha kiba duk , bad lada nga la sukher ïano ïasnoh , ngan siew patar ïa u sa saw shah .
translation.en: And Zacchaeus stood , and said unto the Lord  ; Behold , Lord , the half of my goods I give to the poor  ; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation , I restore him fourfold .
He is not the God of the dead , but the God of the living : ye therefore do greatly err .
translation.kha: U long U Blei jong kiba im , ym jong kiba ïap . Phi la bakla shikatdei eh !
Katba ki dang ïakren , ki ïunukh ka ïingjah ki wang poi ha ka jingkyrkieh ban ïalam ïa u Haman sha ka jingkhiah ka Shethar .
translation.en: And while they were yet talking with him , came the king s chamberlains , and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared .

Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch , whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon : he went and said thus unto him  ; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon : bring me in before the king , and I will shew unto the king the interpretation .
translation.kha: Kumta u Daniel u la leit sha u Ariokh , ïa uba u syiem u la lah hukum ban pynïap ïa ki nongai jingmut ïa u syiem . U la ong ha u ,  Wat pynïap ïa ki . Ïalam ïa nga sha u syiem , bad ngan ïathuh ha u aïu ka jingphohsniew jong u ka kit jingmut .
hynrei u syiem Nongsynshar u la hukum ïa u Nebusaradan , u rangbah shipai , ban ai ïa kane ka hukum harum :
translation.en: Now Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon gave charge concerning Jeremiah to Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard , saying ,

translation.kha: kumin u ong , Balei ba me imat sngewbang ? Mem shym pang , ka lah baneh long ba me ne jingsngewsih .
translation.en: Wherefore the king said unto me , Why is thy countenance sad , seeing thou art not sick ? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart . Then I was very sore afraid ,

translation.kha: Ki shim pa sawphew sngi ban pyndep ïa ka , namar ka bam por katta ban kyllan jingiwbih ïa ka metïap . Ki nong Ijipt ki pynlong ka jingïambriew ïa u hynñiewphew sngi .
translation.en: And forty days were fulfilled for him  ; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed : and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days .

translation.kha: Kumba ka leilieh ka thaba na ïinglieng sha arliang jong ka sahit bneng sad ka pynswai ïa ka na kawei ka liang sha kawei pat , kumta un long U Khun U Briew ha ka sngi jong u .
translation.en: For as the lightning , that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven , shineth unto the other part under heaven  ; so shall also the Son of man be in his day .

translation.kha: nongthaw pat u lyngdoh un pynphong sa ïa ka jingbna namar ka pop , bad un pyndep ïa ka jingsngem kambah ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid . Hadien kata , un pynjop ïa uta u jingri namar ka jingweng thang ,
translation.en: And the priest shall offer the sin offering , and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness  ; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering :
The anger of the  Lord  hath divided them  ; he will no more regard them : they respected not the persons of the priests , they favoured not the elders .
translation.kha: U  Trai  um shym la don shuh ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta jong ki ; u la pynsakma ïa ki da lade hi . Um shym pyn-i jingñiewkor ei ei ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam jong ngi .

Haba me khang ïa u slap don hap namar ba ki briew ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , bad nangta haba ki kylla-kaba-mut bad phai khmat sha kñia ka Templ , ki da kparad da kaba sngewrit ha me , to shahshkor ïa ki na bneng .
translation.en: When heaven is shut up , and there is no rain , because they have sinned against thee  ; if they pray toward this place , and confess thy name , and turn from their sin , when thou afflictest them :
And on the fourth day ten bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba saw , ai shiphew tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
U Blei Badonburom Baroh u la long bad nga ha kata ka por , mala ïa sa la ker sawdong da baroh ki khun jong nga .
translation.en: When the Almighty was yet with me , when my children were about me  ;

translation.kha: Hato nga la kylla long mynta u nongshun jong phi da kaba ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha ?
translation.en: Am I therefore become your enemy , because I tell you the truth ?
The tree that thou sawest , which grew , and was strong , whose height reached unto the heaven , and the sight thereof to all the earth  ;
translation.kha: U dieng , uba jrong katta katta uba la kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng , uba lah ban ïohi da baroh kiba don ha ka pyrthei .
Mynta to khie leit sha ki surok bah badno khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai ïa ki briew katba phi lah ban ïashad .’
translation.en: Go ye therefore into the highways , and as many as ye shall find , bid to the marriage .

translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ïa kaei naba u patsha ka Assir u ni ïa kano kano ka ri kaba u rai ban pynjot . Hato pa’ pyrkhat ba phin ïuhkjat im ?
translation.en: Behold , thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands , by destroying them utterly : and shalt thou be delivered ?

translation.kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki reng ki long ki shipa ngut ki shym ki ban nongsynshar ïa kata ka hima . Nangta sa uwei pat u skhem un mihpaw ; un longïing uba pher bak lbak ïa kiba mynshuwa bad un pynkhyllem ïa ki lai ngut ki syiem .
translation.en: And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise : and another shall rise after them  ; and he shall be diverse from the first , and he shall subdue three kings .

translation.kha: Une ki nong Ijipt ki la kyrpad jur ïa ki Israel ban pynpyut bad mihnoh na kata ka ri . Ngin sa ïap lut lada phim leit noh , ki ong .
translation.en: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people , that they might send them out of the land in haste  ; for they said , We be all dead men .

translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u hukum ïa u Joab bad ïa ki rangbah jong u ban kad ïa la ki jaiñ , ban phong ka jreiñ khain , bad ban ïambriew na ka bynta u Abner . bad ha ka jingleit ontep , u syiem Dedan da lade hi u ïaid hadien ka jingduk metïap .
translation.en: And David said to Joab , and to all the people that were with him , Rend your clothes , and gird you with sackcloth , and mourn before Abner . And king David himself followed the bier .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah ki ithuh shaduh Jordan , malade Baroh shi lynter lyndet ki ïohi ïa ki jabieng bun ki thong ki tar ba ki Syria ki la bret Kaba ki dang phet ïap . Nangta ki wan phai badno ki longing ïathuh ha u syiem .
translation.en: And they went after them unto Jordan : and , lo , all the way was full of garments and vessels , which the Syrians had cast away in their haste . And the messengers returned , and told the king .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki briew kiba thmu ban pynjynjar bad ban leh ïa kaba sniew ; ki dohnud jong ki , ki dap borabor da ka jingshet ïashukor .
translation.en: They conceive mischief , and bring forth vanity , and their belly prepareth deceit .

translation.kha: ki ban sa rkhie ïa u , kin bynthiew halor jong u , kin sympat ïa u , sad pynïap ïa u ; hynrei hadien lai sngi un sa mihpat .
translation.en: And they shall mock him , and shall scourge him , and shall spit upon him , and shall kill him : and the third day he shall rise again .

translation.kha: Lyngba ka durbriew me pynlong ka lynti ïaid na ka bynta ki briew jong me bad me ïalam ïa ki lyngngai ka khyndew ba-rkhiang . Ïa kito kiba bah ïa ki , me pynïap jyllop ha ka um jingjylliew , kum u maw uba ngam ha ka duriaw ba-atphyllung .
translation.en: And thou didst divide the sea before them , so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land  ; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps , as a stone into the mighty waters .

translation.kha: kawei kaba la ha wallam ka la biang ban trei pyndep ïa ka mana baroh .
translation.en: For the stuff they had was sufficient for all the work to make it , and too much .

translation.kha: Haba phi ai kliang ei ei ïano ïano , phim dei ba shim bynda da u Methushael kiaw jong u , Namar kata ka long kumba phi shim bynda ïa ka tiar khreh bam kaba kirteng ïa ka jingjam jngai u .
translation.en: No man shall take the nether or the upper millstone to pledge : for he taketh a man s life to pledge .
And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water :
translation.kha: Un pynïap ïa kawei na kita ki sim halor u khiew khyndew ha uba don ka um kaba sngur na ka umpohliew .

bad u la pynpait ïa ki briew jong ka ha ki kurat , ki mohkhiew , malade ki sdien nong , bad u la pynbor ïa ki ban trei ha kaba shna maw-it . U la leh kumjuh ïa ki briew jongki kiwei pat ki nongrit jong ka Almon baroh . Nangta ma u lem bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And he brought forth the people that were therein , and put them under saws , and under harrows of iron , and under axes of iron , and made them pass through the brickkiln : and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon . So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem .
And he made boards for the tabernacle  ; twenty boards for the south side southward :
translation.kha: Ki shna arphew tylli ki jingker ïa ka liang kaba shaphang shathie ,

translation.en: In the morning thou shalt say , Would God it were even ! and at even thou shalt say , Would God it were morning ! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear , and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see .
translation.kha: Ka shadem jong phi kan kyndeh da ka jingsheptieng kat ïa kaba phi ïohi . Man ka step phin kwah ba kan wan noh ka janmiet ; man ka janmiet pat phin kwah ba kan wan noh ka step .
U Trai u la hukum ïa nga ban ym bam lane diaw ei ei , malade ban ym leit phai na kajuh ka lynti kaba nga la Wan .
translation.en: For so was it charged me by the word of the  Lord  , saying , Eat no bread , nor drink water , nor turn again by the same way that thou camest .

translation.kha: Kumta u ïing ha ka khyrdop jong ka jaka sher dara , bad u la pyrta , Kat uba don ha ka liang jong U Trai , wan sheng ! Kumta baroh kiba na ka jwat Lebi ki ïalumlang ha u ,
translation.en: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp , and said , Who is on the  Lord s  side ? let him come unto me . And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him .
And it came to pass , when Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who was in Egypt , whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king , heard it , that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Haba u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la leit sha Ijipt ban lait im na u syiem Solomon , u la ïohsngew ïa kane ka khubor , u wan phai noh sha ïing .

Ynda u la poi , u rung shapoh ïing badno u shym kawei ka tari . U shim ïa ka met ka tnga kliar jong u , u ot ïa ka khat-ar lyngkhot , badno u phah ïa kawei ka lyngkhot sha kawei pa kawei na ki khat-ar jait ki Eliel .
translation.en: And when he was come into his house , he took a knife , and laid hold on his concubine , and divided her , together with her bones , into twelve pieces , and sent her into all the coasts of Israel .

My heart shall cry out for Moab  ; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar , an heifer of three years old : for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up  ; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction .
translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka kyang jam namar ka Moab ! Ki briew ki la phet sha ki shnong jong ka Soar , bad sha ka Eglath Shelishiyah . Katto katne ki kiew ïa ka surok sha Luhith , ki da ïam haba ki leit ; katto katne ki lait phet sha Horanaim , ki da ïam sngewsih jam .
U Paul u la kut jingmut ban ïadie lait ïa ka Ephesos , ba kumta yn ym pynsep-ei ïa ka por ha ka kuman jngai ka Asia . U la kyrkieh ban poi ha Jerusalem ha ka sngi Peninnah , lada ka long kaba lah .
translation.en: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus , because he would not spend the time in Asia : for he hasted , if it were possible for him , to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong me ki leh pop pyrshah ïa me — bad ba ym don utai ruh u briew uba khlem leh pop — nabar ha la ka jingbitar me shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jop ïa ki bad don ring koidi ïa ki sha kadei pat ka ri , kam la kata ka ri ka long kaba jngai , to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jyllang me .
translation.en: If they sin against thee , ( for there is no man that sinneth not , ) and thou be angry with them , and deliver them to the enemy , so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy , far or near  ;

translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki synran , Ïa ngi ïaleit phai noh Sha Judia .
translation.en: Then after that saith he to his disciples ,  Let us go into Judaea again .

translation.kha: Hato me tip kumno U blem u ai hukum malade u pynlong ïa ka leilieh banbeiñ ibha na ki lyoh ?
translation.en: Dost thou know when God disposed them , and caused the light of his cloud to shine ?

translation.kha: Sumar ïa ki aiñ mala ki hukum jong nga baroh , ba kumta phin ym shiah kyntait ha ka ri Kanaan sha kaba ngan ïalam ïa phi .
translation.en: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes , and all my judgments , and do them : that the land , whither I bring you to dwell therein , spue you not out .

translation.kha: Bad ngi la phah ïa u Timothi , u pansngiat jong ngi uba ïarieh lak bad ngi na ka bynta U Blei ha kaba ïap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Kynther . Ngi la phah ïa u ban pynkhlaiñ ïa phi badno ïarap ïa ka jingngeit jong phiah ,
translation.en: And sent Timothy , our brother , and minister of God , and our fellowlabourer in the gospel of Christ , to establish you , and to comfort you concerning your faith :

translation.kha: Ym u Briew Baroh uba khot ïa nga , ‘ A Trai , A Trai’ u pun ïohrung shapoh Ka Hima ki bneng , hynrei tang iba babha bor ïa kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bnai u kwah ïa ki ban leh .
translation.en: Not every one that saith unto me , Lord , Lord , shall enter into the kingdom of heaven  ; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven .
Yea , all the people of the land shall bury them  ; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei ha ka ri un ïarap lang ha kaba tep ïa ki , bad ïa ki yn ai burom na ka bynta kane , ha ka sngi jong ka jingjop thiaw jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

Baroh ka long kaba khuid ha kito kiba erlangthari kiba khuid ha laiñ ; hynrei ym don kaba khuid ha kito kiba la tngit bad ki bymngeit , namar ba ki jingmut sad ki jingïatiplem jong ki , ki long ba la pyntngit .
translation.en: Unto the pure all things are pure : but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure ; but even their mind and conscience is defiled .

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kin bam ïa kaba sah baroh . Yn pynlong ïa u kpu ba la shet khlem thiat bad ban bam ha ka jaka bakhuid , ka phla jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai . U Trai’ u la ai ha ki lyngdoh kum ka bynta jong ki na kata ka jingainguh ba-im . Ka long naba khuid , kumba long ki jingweng namar ka pop bad ki jingtah namar ki jingkit ngai .
translation.en: It shall not be baken with leaven . I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire  ; it is most holy , as is the sin offering , and as the trespass offering .
And ye murmured in your tents , and said , Because the  Lord  hated us , he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt , to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites , to destroy us .
translation.kha: Phi la ïakren khñium para ma phi : ‘ U  Trai  u isih ïa ngi . U la wan ïalam ïa ngi na Ijipt tang ban aiti ïa ngi ha kine ki Amor , ba kin ïoh pynïap ïa ngi .
Ko ki parabangeit jong nga , katno nga kwah da ka dohnud jong nga barben ba ki briew jong nga hi kin longkmie ïa kiba la pynim ! Katno nga duli ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong ki !
translation.en: Brethren , my heart s desire and prayer to God for Israel is , that they might be saved .
And she said unto him , There is no cause : this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me . But he would not hearken unto her .
translation.kha: Em ,  ka la jubab .  Ban phah noh ïa nga kumne ka long ka kam sniew kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaei kaba phi dang shu dep leh !  Hynrei u Amnon um sngap ïa ka ;

Wat haba phi don shiphew hajar ngut ki nongriam ha ka jingim jong phiah kum ki bangeit , phi don tang iwei u kpa . Naba ha ka jingriam jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu nga la long u Kpa jongu phi da kiba wallam ïa ka khohruh ibha ha phiah .
translation.en: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ , yet have ye not many fathers : for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel .

translation.kha: Ussi pa uwei u dei ban ai , namarkata , kumba phi la kut jingdum , ym da Kaba bynñiaw ne da kaba sngew kum ka kamram ; naba U Blei u Ieit ïa uta suba ai da kaba kmienah .
translation.en: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart , so let him give ; not grudgingly , or of necessity : for God loveth a cheerful giver .

translation.kha: Ïa ki nongwei jingmut badno ki nongleh myntor la wallam Shabeh ban pule ïa kane ka jingthiah bad don ïathuh ha nga aiwai ka kit jingot , hynrei kim shym lah ban shem ïa ka jingmut .
translation.en: And now the wise men , the astrologers , have been brought in before me , that they should read this writing , and make known unto me the interpretation thereof : but they could not shew the interpretation of the thing :

translation.kha: Hadien ba u Paul u la oh ïa khnai ka jingïohipaw , ngi la khreh ban leit sha Medan , Namarba ngi la rai ba U Blei u la khot ïa ngi ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shuh ki brisoh hangta .
translation.en: And after he had seen the vision , immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia , assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them .

And they brought the head of Ish–bosheth unto David to Hebron , and said to the king , Behold the head of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul thine enemy , which sought thy life  ; and the  Lord  hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul , and of his seed .
translation.kha: Ki ai ïa kata ka khlieh ha u Syiem Dabid ha Hebron , bad ki ong ha u ,  Kane hangne ka dei ka khlieh u Ishbosheth , u khun jong u Saul , u nongshun jong phi , uba la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa phi . Ha kane ka sngi U  Trai  u la shah ïa u Syiem Kynrad ban pynhiarkput ïa u Saul bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
Phi lah ruh ban thied ïa ki khun jong ki nongai kiba shong napdeng jong phi . Kum kita ïa kiba la kha ha ka ri jong pa’ ki lah ban long ka jingïohkynti jongngi phi ,
translation.en: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you , of them shall ye buy , and of their families that are with you , which they begat in your land : and they shall be your possession .
Pass ye over to Tarshish  ; howl , ye inhabitants of the isle .
translation.kha: To lynñiar da ka jingsngewsih , phi ki briew ka Phoenisia ! Pyrshang ban phet ïap sha Spain !

Khim hikai ïa ka jingïapher khappud babha khuid bad kiba jakhlia , bad kim sohwaiñ ïa ka Sabbaton . Kaba mih ka long ba ki paid Israel kim ñiewkordor ïa nga .
translation.en: Her priests have violated my law , and have profaned mine holy things : they have put no difference between the holy and profane , neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean , and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths , and I am profaned among them .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ban tyngkreiñ ïa ki Israel , ban lap la kin kohnguh ne em ïa ki hukum ba U Trai u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki da u Moses .
translation.en: And they were to prove Israel by them , to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the  Lord  , which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: Ka jingrisa ba phi ïadon ki jingïakajia hapoh ka aiñ hapdeng jong phi hi , ka pyn-i phi la rem nadong shadong . Heth nang kham bha ïa phi ban shah bymdei ? Hato nang kham bha ba phin shiah lwait noh ?
translation.en: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you , because ye go to law one with another . Why do ye not rather take wrong ? why do ye not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded ?

translation.kha: U Ahas u phah ïa ki rangbah sha u Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , ryngkat bad khie ka khubor : Nga long u shakri baïaineh jong phin . To wan bad pyllait im ïa nga na ki syiem ka Syria bad Israel , kiba wan tur ïaleh ïa nga .
translation.en: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria , saying , I am thy servant and thy son : come up , and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria , and out of the hand of the king of Israel , which rise up against me .
And God remembered Noah , and every living thing , and all the cattle that was with him in the ark : and God made a wind to pass over the earth , and the waters assuaged  ;
translation.kha: U Blei um shym la klet ïa u Noah , bad ïa ki mrad baroh kiba ïadon lem bad u ha ka lieng ; u la pynlong ïa ka lyer ban beh , bad ka um ka la sdang hiar .
Ka jingjynjar ka wan . Phin ïada ïa ka jingsuk , hynrei phin ym shem ïa ka .
translation.en: Destruction cometh  ; and they shall seek peace , and there shall be none .
When the wicked are multiplied , transgression increaseth : but the righteous shall see their fall .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew basniew ki don ha ka bor synshar , ka kam sniew ka nang roi . Hynrei kiba hok kin im ban ïohi ïa ka jingkyllon jong kiba kum kita ki briew .
Ngi la kwah ban wan pah pat shata phi . Nga hi nga la pyrshang ban leit phai pat palat ïa ka shisien , hynrei u Soitan um ailad ïa im’ .
translation.en: Wherefore we would have come unto you , even I Paul , once and again ; but Satan hindered us .
And he said , Nay , father Abraham : but if one went unto them from the dead , they will repent .
translation.kha: U riewspah u la jubab , ‘ Kata kam pat biang , ko kpa Abraham ! Hynrei lada uno uno u mihpat na ka jingïap bad leit sha ki , te kin phai noh na ki pop jong ki .’

translation.en: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day , and having done all , to stand .
translation.kha: Kumta to kieng mynta ïa ka jingkieng atiar U Blei! Nangta haba ka sngi basniew ka wan , phin lah ban ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki bor ïaleh u nongshun ; bad hadien ba ka jingïaleh ka la kut , phin dang ïeng skhem ha ka nongrim jong phi .
Kuth , hadien ba ngi la sah skhem ha Kadesh ,
translation.en: So ye abode in Kadesh many days , according unto the days that ye abode there .

translation.kha: U Blei’ Badonbor Baroh u la siaw da ki khnam ïa nga , bad ka i jong ki ka par baroh kawei ka met jong por . Da ki jingshyrkhei U Blei u la pynhap jingïashem pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me , the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit : the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngin ïa-ot te , ba u Abraham u kpa , jong ka jingïapthngan jong ngi , Kaei ka jingshem jong u ?
translation.en: What shall we say then that Abraham our father , as pertaining to the flesh , hath found ?
From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them  ; all that enter in to perform the service , to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ , ïa ka jingsop kaba shapoh bad kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ka pyrda jong ka jingkhang ,

translation.en: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel , preaching peace by Jesus Christ : ( he is Lord of all : )
translation.kha: Phi tip ïa ka khubor kaba u la phah sha ki paid Israel , da kaba pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha jong ka jingsuk lyngba U Jisu Khrist , uba long U Trai jong baroh .

translation.en: Now gather thyself in troops , O daughter of troops : he hath laid siege against us : they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , lumlang ïa la u paid ! Ngi lah shah kerkut ! Ki ïatur ïaleh ïa u nongïalam ki Israel !
Ki briew na barabor ki jaka , ba kynthup ruh ïa ka Antarctica ki ïoh jingmyntoi .
translation.en: People from every continent , including Antarctica , are benefiting .
And they come to Jesus , and see him that was possessed with the devil , and had the legion , sitting , and clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .
translation.kha: bad haba ki la wan ha U Jisu , ki la ïohi ïa uta u briew uba ju don shibun ki ksuid hapoh jong u . U la shong hangta , u la phong jaiñ bad ba u la tipbriew , bad baroh ki la sheptieng .

translation.en: And he came thither unto a cave , and lodged there  ; and , behold , the word of the  Lord  came to him , and he said unto him , What doest thou here , Elijah ?
translation.kha: Hangta u la rung shapoh krem bad sahmiet hangta . Kynsan kynsan U  Trai  u kren ha u ,  Elijah me leh aïu hangne ?
U Terah u ïohi kaei kaba jia ha ki jaka baher ; u khmih halor jongki ngi , la ngi leh ïa kiba bha ne kaba sniew .
translation.en: The eyes of the  Lord  are in every place , beholding the evil and the good .

translation.kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te , ba U Khun U Briew u kein ka iktiar ha ka khyndew ban map ïa ki pop . Kumta u la ong ha u briew ibha ïapshiliang , To ïeng joit , to rah ïa la ka jingteh , Bad leit sha ïing !
translation.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins ,  ( then saith he to the sick of the palsy , )  Arise , take up thy bed , and go unto thine house .

translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ko balui ki Israel , to kan long shisha kumta kumba me la kular ha la u shakor , u Dedan u kpa jong nga .
translation.en: And now , O God of Israel , let thy word , I pray thee , be verified , which thou spakest unto thy servant David my father .

translation.kha: Ka la long la jan shiteng sngi shaw ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait . U Pilat u la ino ha ki briew , A u syiem jong phi !
translation.en: And it was the preparation of the passover , and about the sixth hour : and he saith unto the Jews , Behold your King !
But Zion said , The  Lord  hath forsaken me , and my Lord hath forgotten me .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ki la ong ,  U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa ngi ! U la klet ïa ngi .
U Elijah u jubab , Da u Trai uba im , ïa uba nga shakri , ang kutlad ba ngan ïong ha khmat u syiem mandriek ka sngi .
translation.en: And Elijah said , As the  Lord  of hosts liveth , before whom I stand , I will surely shew myself unto him to day .

translation.kha: Kam sheptieng ïa ki ; hynrei to ïai kynmaw aïu U Trai U Blei jong phi u la leh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki briew Jong u Baroh .
translation.en: Thou shalt not be afraid of them : but shalt well remember what the  Lord  thy God did unto Pharaoh , and unto all Egypt  ;
That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us , who walk not after the flesh , but after the Spirit .
translation.kha: U Blei u la leh ïa kane khnang ba ïa ki jingdawa bahok jong ka Hukum yn pyndep nadong shadong ha ngi kiba im kat kum U Mynsiem , bad ym kat kum ka jinglong ba kynja doh .

Nangta la don ruh sa kawei pat ka tmoh ha Gath ha kaba la dat uwei u ramhah uba sngewtynnat ban ïaleh . U don hynriew tylli ki shynriah ti ha kawei kawei ka kti , bad hynriew tylli ki shynriah jat ha kawei kawei ka kjat .
translation.en: And there was yet a battle in Gath , where was a man of great stature , that had on every hand six fingers , and on every foot six toes , four and twenty in number  ; and he also was born to the giant .

translation.kha: Ngan pyllait im ïa me bad ïa kane ka nongbah Jerusalem na u patsha Assyria , bad ngan ïai bteng ban ïada ïa ka nongbah .
translation.en: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria : and I will defend this city .
And afterward he read all the words of the law , the blessings and cursings , according to all that is written in the book of the law .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u pule jam ïa ka Hukum baroh kawei , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingkyrkhu bad ïa ki jingtim , kumba la thoh ha ka kitab ka Hukum .
namar um shym la pynïap ïa nga ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa nga . Te ka kpoh jongu i mei jongnga nga kan jin da la long ka jingtep jong nga .
translation.en: Because he slew me not from the womb  ; or that my mother might have been my grave , and her womb to be always great with me .
And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , Return to thy mistress , and submit thyself under her hands .
translation.kha: U ong ha ka ,  Khie leit phai pat sha la ka kynrad , bad long ka mraw jong ka .
To pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh , A thri ;
translation.en: Render unto them a recompence , O  Lord  , according to the work of their hands .
Children , obey your parents in the Lord : for this is right .
translation.kha: Phi ki khun , ka long ka kamram kum kiba ngeit ban kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , namar kane ka long kaba phi dei ban leh .

translation.en: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them , they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies , and precious jewels , which they stripped off for themselves , more than they could carry away : and they were three days in gathering of the spoil , it was so much .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat bad ki shipai jong u ki leit bad lute , bad ki shem bun ki jingri , ki mar ki mata , ki jaiñ ki nep bad kiwei ki mar baremdor . Ki pynlut lai sngi ban lum ïa ka jinglute , hynrei la don bun palat haduh ba kim lah shuh ban rah lut .

U Nongsakhi balang u dei ban long u bym don jingshah kynnoh pop ; u dei ban don tang kawei ka tnga , bad ki khun jong u ki dei don long ki bangeit bad ki bym anna jingbudnam ba ki un-long kiba leh thurmur lane ki bymkohnguh .
translation.en: If any be blameless , the husband of one wife , having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly .

translation.kha: Ki la khñium ha u Moses , bad ki la noh , Ai um ïa ngi ban dih . U Moses u ong ha ki , balieh keiñ phi ïakhñium ïa nga ? Baalah phi tynjuh ïa U Trai ?
translation.en: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses , and said , Give us water that we may drink . And Moses said unto them , Why chide ye with me ? wherefore do ye tempt the  Lord  ?
He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him , and saying unto him , Cornelius .
translation.kha: Ka la long ha kawei ka sngi kumba lai baje nohphai sngi mynba u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw , ha kaba u la ïohi da kaba shai kdar ïa u angel jong U Blei uba wan shapoh bad ong ha u ,  Kornelios !
Ki la wan phai pat da kaba ainong ba ki la ioh ka jingïohipaw ïa ki angel kiba la ïatyngkhuh ha ki ba u im .
translation.en: And when they found not his body , they came , saying , that they had also seen a vision of angels , which said that he was alive .

translation.kha: U Trai u long u syiem junom la jongu . Kito kiba mane ïa kiaw patan ki plie kin jah noh na ka ri jong u .
translation.en: The  Lord  is King for ever and ever : the heathen are perished out of his land .
Wherefore be ye not unwise , but understanding what the will of the Lord is .
translation.kha: Wat long kiba bieit , hynrei , pyrshang ban wad ïa kaei kaba U Trai u kwah ïa phi ban leh .
Ngan sa Plie
translation.en: Will open

translation.kha: To kiar noh! na ki jingkwah brai ka jinglong samla , bad ïaleh tyngeh na ka bna ka hok , ka jingngeit , ka jingieit , Bad ka jingsuk , lem sad kito kiba da ka dohnud basma ki khot kyrpad ïa U Trai na ka bna ka jingïarap .
translation.en: Flee also youthful lusts : but follow righteousness , faith , charity , peace , with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart .

translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa nga : Ka long kaba shisha ba ki don shibun ki riewkynthei ha Eliel ha ka por jong u Elijah , hajuh ym shym la don slap haduh lai snem shiteng dara ba ka nemsniew bajur ka la saphriang kylleng ka ri baroh kawei .
translation.en: But I tell you of a truth , many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias , when the heaven was shut up three years and six months , when great famine was throughout all the land  ;
And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur , that is before Egypt , as thou goest toward Assyria : and he died in the presence of all his brethren .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ishmael ki la shong la sah ha ka jaka kaba hapdeng ka Habilah bad ka Shur , sha ka phang mihngi jong ka ri Ijipt ha ka lynti sha Assyria . Kine ki la shong kyrpang na kiwei pat ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham .
Ka jingïaleh ka pur kylleng ki rudnong , bad kham Bun ki rangbah ki la ïap ha khlaw ban ïa kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translation.en: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country : and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured .

translation.kha: Nangta U Ujuh u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka phah : pyrthuh ïa u diengsoh Dumbur bad ïa kiwei pat ki jait dieng .
translation.en: And he spake to them a parable  ;  Behold the fig tree , and all the trees  ;

translation.kha: Hato don a uno uba pat ? U dei ban phah khot ïa ki nongsharai balang , ki ban duwai na ka bynta jong u bad pynsleh ha u da ka umphniang Oholibah ha ka kyrngah Jong U Trai .
translation.en: Is any sick among you ? let him call for the elders of the church  ; and let them pray over him , anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord :

translation.kha: Ha ken hi ka sngi U Trai un aiti ïa me hapoh ka bor jong de ; ngan pynkyllon ïa me bad ngan khar ïa ka khlieh jong me . Sin ngan ai ïa ki metïap jongki ki shipai Philistia ha ki sim bad ha ki mutdur ba kin bam .
translation.en: This day will the  Lord  deliver thee into mine hand  ; and I will smite thee , and take thine head from thee  ; and I will give the carcases of the host of the Philistines this day unto the fowls of the air , and to the wild beasts of the earth  ; that all the earth may know that there is a God in Israel .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa u sa shisien , pynlang lada kata ka prum ka la pur , un pynbna ba u long u bymkhuid ; ka dei ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh .
translation.en: And if the priest see that , behold , the scab spreadeth in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a leprosy .

translation.kha: manbha ki dang samla , ki shong ki sah ha Ijipt , ki la mad noh ka jinglong sotti bad ki kylla long ki nuti .
translation.en: And they committed whoredoms in Egypt  ; they committed whoredoms in their youth : there were their breasts pressed , and there they bruised the teats of their virginity .

translation.kha: U ong , Namar kine ki biria ki la kyntait ïa ki um bajai jai jong ka wahduid Shiloah bad khynñiuh ha Khmut jong u syiem Resin badno u syiem Pekah ,
translation.en: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly , and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah s son  ;

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynïap hynñiewphew nongput ki rangbah kiba na Bthah Shemesh namar ba ki khmih shispah ka Synduk ka Jutang . Bad u paidbah u ïam pangnud namar ba U Trei u la pynjia kat kata ka jingpynnang Hapdeng jong ki .
translation.en: And he smote the men of Beth–shemesh , because they had looked into the ark of the  Lord  , even he smote of the people fifty thousand and threescore and ten men : and the people lamented , because the  Lord  had smitten many of the people with a great slaughter .

translation.kha: banyngkong , per jingaiti ïa U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrist na ka bynta jong phi baroh , namar ka pyiar Baroh kawei ka ïohsngew shaphang ka jingngeit jong phi .
translation.en: First , I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all , that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world .

translation.kha: Bad U blei u la pyn-ap ïa ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi da kaba phah ïa la U Khun ba marwei sha ka pyrthei , khnang ba ngin ïoh ïa ka jingim da u .
translation.en: In this was manifested the love of God toward us , because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world , that we might live through him .
Lord  , thou hast heard the desire of the humble : thou wilt prepare their heart , thou wilt cause thine ear to hear :
translation.kha: A  Trai  , men shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong kiba rit kyrdan ; me ai ha ki ka jingshlur .
‘ Bad na kane ka haka , u briew un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ka kmang bad ïaid Bad la ka tnga ,
translation.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother , and cleave to his wife  ;

translation.kha: Me long u nongïada jong nga ; balei ba me la iehnoh ïa nga ? Balei ba ngan ïasah shitom na ka jingshyrkhei ki nongshun jong nga ?
translation.en: For thou art the God of my strength : why dost thou cast me off ? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy ?

translation.kha: Ka tnum jong u ka dien ka khun jong u Ahab , bad ruma long kiba na ka ïing u Ahab , u ruh u bud ïa ki lynti bymman jong ki syiem ka Israel . U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel , as did the house of Ahab : for the daughter of Ahab was his wife : and he did evil in the sight of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ladan hapoh phin ai ha u da u bseiñ haba u pait ïa ka dohkha ?
translation.en: Or if he ask a fish , will he give him a serpent ?
Multitudes , multitudes in the valley of decision : for the day of the  Lord  is near in the valley of decision .
translation.kha: Da ki hajar hajar ki don ha ka Them jong ka Jingbishar . Dei hangta ba ka Sngi jong U  Trai  shen kan wan .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time ,
translation.kha: U angel jong U  Trai  u khot ïa u Abraham ha kaba ar sien na bneng ,

translation.en: Thou sayest , Lo , thou hast smitten the Edomites  ; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast : abide now at home  ; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt , that thou shouldest fall , even thou , and Judah with thee ?
translation.kha: Mynta ko Amasaïah , me kob ba me la jop ïa ki Edom , hynrei nga ai jingmut ïa me ba men shong ha ïing . Balei me pynkhih jingkulmar ka ban shu wanrah tang ka jingjot ha me bad ki briew jong me ?
Man ka por ba u Moses u lytar shata , ki baïap ki ainong ha ki jingkhang jong ki ïongreiñ jong ki bad ki ïa-pynïap ïa u Moses haduh ba un da rung Shobab .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses went out unto the tabernacle , that all the people rose up , and stood every man at his tent door , and looked after Moses , until he was gone into the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Da la ka shynriah ti un synreit khyndiat na kata ka snam ha kata ka duwan bahynñiew sien . Ha kane ka rukom u dei ban pynkhuid ïa ka na ki pop jongngi ki paid Jeruel , bad un pynlong khum ïa ka .
translation.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times , and cleanse it , and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Un leit ha Shuah jngai U TRAI’ , uba khlaiñ bad uba khapbrip kum u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa . Un pynïasuk pait ïa ki kpa bad ki khur ; un pynwai pat ïa ki briew ki bymjukut shat ka rukom pyrkhat jrong katba hok ; un pynrieh ïa ki briew jong U Trai na ka bynta jong U .
translation.en: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias , to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children , and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just  ; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord .

translation.kha: Haba u Jehosheba um sngewlyngngoh kun haw ïa la ka jingsniew ha khmat ki shakri jong u , kumta u la hukum ïa ki baroh ba kin mihnoh na ka kamra . Ym smam don me mano lem bad u haba u Joseph u pynithuh ïa lade ha ki imon shynrang jong u .
translation.en: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him  ; and he cried , Cause every man to go out from me . And there stood no man with him , while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren .

translation.kha: Katto katei ki rangbah na Jerikho ki la kitei sha u Elisha , sad ki ong , Kumba phi tip , ko kynrad , kane ka dei ka nongbah kaba itynnat , hynrei ka um ka sniew bad ka wanrah ki jinghap khun .
translation.en: And the men of the city said unto Elisha , Behold , I pray thee , the situation of this city is pleasant , as my lord seeth : but the water is naught , and the ground barren .

translation.kha: Lada ka kada ne ka masi u para Israel ka kyllon , wat shu ieh ïa ka kumta ; ïarap ïa u ban pynïeng pat ïa ka .
translation.en: Thou shalt not see thy brother s ass or his ox fall down by the way , and hide thyself from them : thou shalt surely help him to lift them up again .

translation.kha: To pynbna ha kito kiba shong ha ki ïingjaiñ ha Ijipt bad Ashdod : Ïalumlang ha ki lum sawdong ka Samaria , bad peit ïa ka jingkhynwin kaba khraw malu ka jingbymman ba la leh hangta .
translation.en: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod , and in the palaces in the land of Egypt , and say , Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria , and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof , and the oppressed in the midst thereof .

translation.kha: Shisyndon ïa ki khuri ksiar bad ayu la wallam Shabeh , nabar ma ki baroh ki la ïadih waiñ na ki
translation.en: Then they brought the golden vessels that were taken out of the temple of the house of God which was at Jerusalem  ; and the king , and his princes , his wives , and his concubines , drank in them .

translation.kha: Ïa u Lum Sinai baroh uwei la tap da ka thma , Namarba U Trai u la wan hiar ha u ha ka dong . Ka tdem ka kiew kum kaba mih na ka lawar ding , bad ki briew barben ki la kyiuh sian eh .
translation.en: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke , because the  Lord  descended upon it in fire : and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace , and the whole mount quaked greatly .

translation.kha: Haba u Syiem Dabid u la wan poi ha Bahurim , uwei na ki ba-ha-ïing jong u Saul , u Shimham , u khun jong u Gera , u la wan ïakynduh ïa u , u da tmain ïa u katba u sdang wan .
translation.en: And when king David came to Bahurim , behold , thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul , whose name was Shimei , the son of Gera : he came forth , and cursed still as he came .

Gather the people , sanctify the congregation , assemble the elders , gather the children , and those that suck the breasts : let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber , and the bride out of her closet .
translation.kha: To ïalumlang ïa ki paidbah ; to pynkhreh ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingïalang bakyntang ; to wallam ki briew ba la tymmen ; to ïalumlang ïa ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ruh . Wat kito kiba dang shu dep shongkurim ki dei ban mihnoh na la ka kamra bad ban wan .

translation.en: And his daughter in law , Phinehas  wife , was with child , near to be delivered : and when she heard the tidings that the ark of God was taken , and that her father in law and her husband were dead , she bowed herself and travailed  ; for her pains came upon her .
translation.kha: Ka pyrsa kurim u Eli , ka tnga u Phinehas , ka la armet , bad ka la jan dei ka por ba kan kha khun . Haba ka ïohsngew ba la knieh noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , bad ba u kthaw kurim bad u tnga jong ka ki la ïap , kynsan ka la suh kha bad ka la kha .
Baroh ktang isih ïa phi Namarba jong nga . Hynrei uno uno uba ïingjaiñ skhem shuh kaba kut un lait im .
translation.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name s sake : but he that endureth to the end shall be saved .
And Israel saw that great work which the  Lord  did upon the Egyptians : and the people feared the  Lord  , and believed the  Lord  , and his servant Moses .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ka borbah da kaba U  Trai  u jop ïa ki Ijipt , ki la ïeng da kaba tiengburom ïa U  Trai  ; bad kumta ki la shaniah ha U  Trai  bad ha u Moses u shakri jong u .

translation.en: And he that taketh not his cross , and followeth after me , is not worthy of me .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym shim ïa la ka diengphna bad bud ha dien jat jong nga um long uba bit ban long u synran jong nga .

translation.en: Only the  Lord  had a delight in thy fathers to love them , and he chose their seed after them , even you above all people , as it is this day .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingieit U  Trai  ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ka long kaba khraw katta katta ba u la jied ïa phi napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh , bad phi dang long haduh mynta ka jaitbynriew ba la jied jong u .
Kita ki jingthaw hi ki phet shane bad shatai bad ki stet la kum ka jingtah ka leilieh .
translation.en: And the living creatures ran and returned as the appearance of a flash of lightning .

translation.kha: Buh ïa ki panpoh ha ki jingsuki jong ki , bad teh ïa ki tupia ha ki khlieh jong ki . Ha kane ka manna men pynkieng ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khunlung shynrang jong u . Ma ki bun ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin shakri ïa nga junom kumto ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: And thou shalt gird them with girdles , Aaron and his sons , and put the bonnets on them : and the priest s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute : and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons .

translation.kha: U long kum ka banep ha ka ri shyiap , kaba mih ha ka ri khlaw baryngkhiang , halor ka khyndew mluh ha kaba ym don kaei kaei kaba maw . Ym don kano ïano kaba bha kaba la ju jia ha u .
translation.en: For he shall be like the heath in the desert , and shall not see when good cometh  ; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness , in a salt land and not inhabited .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba im u dei ban long uba stad ; ka long kaba bha khem ka jingïohpdiang ïa ka jingïohpateng
translation.en: Wisdom is good with an inheritance : and by it there is profit to them that see the sun .
And he slew the burnt offering  ; and Aaron s sons presented unto him the blood , which he sprinkled round about upon the altar .
translation.kha: U pynïap ïa u mrad ïa uba la wanlam na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang jong u hi . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wanrah ïa ka snam , bad u theh ïa ka sawdong ka duwan .

translation.en: And Joseph made haste  ; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother : and he sought where to weep  ; and he entered into his chamber , and wept there .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u mihnoh kynsan namar ka dohnud jong u ka shlei da ka jingsngewieit ïa la u para . Namar ba um lah kun shuh , u leit sha la ka kamra , bad u la ïam .
To kynmaw ïa kane , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga ! Uwei pa uwei u dei ban long uba kloi ban shahshkor , hynrei uba suki ba-bang kren-ïa bad uba suki ïa-ban bitar .
translation.en: Wherefore , my beloved brethren , let every man be swift to hear , slow to speak , slow to wrath :
Then came one and told them , saying , Behold , the men whom ye put in prison are standing in the temple , and teaching the people .
translation.kha: Nangta uwei u briew u la wan rung shapoh bad u la ong ha ki ,  To shahshkor ! Ki briew kiba phi la buh ha byndi ki don ha ka Templ , ki da hikai ïa ki paidbah !
Katno tylli u kpu phi don ? U Jisu u la kylluid . Hynñiew tylli ki kpu , ki la jubab .
translation.en: And he asked them ,  How many loaves have ye ?  And they said , Seven .

translation.kha: U Ishbosheth u la sheptieng eh ïa u Abner kat haduh ba um nang ang wat thiang Shisien ruh .
translation.en: And he could not answer Abner a word again , because he feared him .

translation.kha: La khong u brisoh uba ktung u Elkanah , uba na ka jait Ephraim , babha shong ha ka shnong Ramah kaba ha ri lem Abraham . U dei u khun jong u Jeroham bad u khulom ksiew jong u Elihu , bad u dei na ka longïing jong u Nod kaba ïahap ioh ka jait Sophah .
translation.en: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim–zophim , of mount Ephraim , and his name was Elkanah , the son of Jeroham , the son of Elihu , the son of Tohu , the son of Zuph , an Ephrathite :

translation.kha: ban longïng kiba synran ïa lade bad kiba sngi mynsiem , bad ki nongsumar ïing babha kiba pyndem ha la ki tnga , ba yn ym don mano mynno ba lah ban kren sniew ïa ka khubor kaban wan na U Blei .
translation.en: To be discreet , chaste , keepers at home , good , obedient to their own husbands , that the word of God be not blasphemed .
Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word .
translation.kha: Kita ki riewngeit ïa kiba la pynsakma ki la leit kylleng , ki da ïalap ïa ka khubor .
Ïa ka shithi kaba phi la phah , la pynkylla ktien bad pule ha nga .
translation.en: The letter which ye sent unto us hath been plainly read before me .
I thank my God , I speak with tongues more than ye all :
translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei ba nga kren ha ki thylliej bapher kham bun ban ïa uno uno na phi .

translation.en: Build you cities for your little ones , and folds for your sheep  ; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth .
translation.kha: Kumta tei ïa ki shnong jong phi bad ki jingker ïa ki langbrot jong phi , hynrei leh ïa kaei kaba phi la kular .

translation.en: Else , if thou refuse to let my people go , behold , to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast :
translation.kha: Lada me dang ïai kyntait , te ngan wallam ïa ki puit ha ka ri jong me .
bad nga wanlam phai sha Jerusalem . Hangta at la kyndit ban Shim ba u Abiasaph u shah ïa u Tobiah ba-bang pyndonkam ïa ka kamra ha ka Templ .
translation.en: And I came to Jerusalem , and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah , in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God .

And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts , men of valour , from Zorah , and from Eshtaol , to spy out the land , and to search it  ; and they said unto them , Go , search the land : who when they came to mount Ephraim , to the house of Micah , they lodged there .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Dan ki jied san ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit na baroh ki longïing ha ka jait bad ki phah ïa ki na ki shnong Sorah bad Eshtaol ryngkat bad ki jingbthah ba kin leit syntiat ïa ka ri . Ynda ki poi ha ri lum Ephraim , ki sah ha ïing u Mikah .
Wat thok .
translation.en: Don't tell a lie .

translation.kha: hynne la dat shiphew ngut ki rangbah ha ka kynhun kba la ong ha u Ishmael , Sngewbha wat pynïap ïa ngi ! Ngi don u kew , u barli , ka umphniang Olib , bad ka ngat ba la buhrieh ha ki lyngki . Kumta u la ïapyllait ïa ki .
translation.en: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael , Slay us not : for we have treasures in the field , of wheat , and of barley , and of oil , and of honey . So he forbare , and slew them not among their brethren .
And Dannah , and Kirjath–sannah , which is Debir ,
translation.kha: ka Dannah , ka Kiriath Sepher ( lane ka Debir ) ,

translation.en: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold , silver , precious stones , wood , hay , stubble ;
translation.kha: Don ki ban pyndonkam da ka ksiar ne da ka rupa ne da ki mawkordor ha kaba tei halor ka nongrim ; kiwei pat kin pyndonkam da ka dieng ne da u phlang ne da u jyntang .

Shu ap , U Trai u ong . Ap ïa ka Sngi haba ngan ïong ban pynrem ïa ki jaitbynriew . Ang la pynbit ïa la ka jingmut ban lumlang ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ki ha-sem Haneng ban shah ïa ki ngab sngem ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong de . Ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei yn pynjot da ka ding ka jingbitar shla jong na .
translation.en: Therefore wait ye upon me , saith the  Lord  , until the day that I rise up to the prey : for my determination is to gather the nations , that I may assemble the kingdoms , to pour upon them mine indignation , even all my fierce anger : for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy .

translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la mihpaw ha kamai pat ka rukom ha ki ar ngut na ki katba ki dang ïa-ïaid lynti sha la shnong .
translation.en: After that he appeared in another form unto two of them , as they walked , and went into the country .
