translation.kha: Nga la lawbah ban wallam sha nga ïa baroh ki nongai jingmut jong u syiem ha Babilon khnang ba ki lah ban ïathuh ha nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka jingphohsniew .
translation.en: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me , that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream .
Princes also did sit and speak against me : but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes .
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar ki ïakynduh lang bad ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga , hynrei ngan pule bniah ïa ki jinghikai jong me .
Haba ki bymman ki ïap , ka jingmynjur jong ki ruh ka ïap bad ki . Ka jingsngewskhem halor ka spah kam ïalam shano shano ruh .
translation.en: When a wicked man dieth , his expectation shall perish : and the hope of unjust men perisheth .
Now therefore , Tatnai , governor beyond the river , Shethar–bozenai , and your companions the Apharsachites , which are beyond the river , be ye far from thence :
translation.kha: Nangta u Darius u phah ïa kane ka jubab :  Ha u Tattenai , u lat jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi , u Shethar Bosenai , bad ki para rangbah synshar ha Ïuphratis Sepngi .

Bad mynta , ko parabangeit jong nga , khublei! To ïabeh shiah ka jingjanai ; to shahshkor ïa ki jingkyrpad jongngi nga , to don kajuh ka jingmut para ma phi , to ïa-ieit ha ka jingsuk . badno U Blei ka jingieit mala ka jingsuk un long ryngkat bad phi .
translation.en: Finally , brethren , farewell . Be perfect , be of good comfort , be of one mind , live in peace ; and the God of love and peace shall be with you .

translation.kha: Ha ka jaka ban bam , nga ïam sngewsih , bad ngam Shimham sangeh ban ud .
translation.en: For my sighing cometh before I eat , and my roarings are poured out like the waters .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la ïohi ïa u angel uba u pynnep ïa ki brai , bad u ong ha U Trai , Dei ma ar umbiah la leh pop . Nga dei iathuh uba la leh bakla . Kine ki briew bapli ki la leh aïu ? Me dei ïa-ban pynshitom ïa nga bad ïa ka longïing jong nga .
translation.en: And David spake unto the  Lord  when he saw the angel that smote the people , and said , Lo , I have sinned , and I have done wickedly : but these sheep , what have they done ? let thine hand , I pray thee , be against me , and against my father s house .

translation.kha: Lada ïa ka ïing ha kawei na kine ki shngain la die da kiba na ka jait Lebi bad ym shym thied pat ïa ka , dei ban pynphai pat ïa ka ha ka snem ka Jingpynphai pat , namar ki ïing jong kito kiba na ka jait Lebi kiba don ha kita ki shnong jongnga ki , ki dei ki jingïohkynti jong ki hapdeng ki paid Jeruel .
translation.en: And if a man purchase of the Levites , then the house that was sold , and the city of his possession , shall go out in the year of jubilee : for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel .

translation.kha: U Joseph u long uba thep shyieng bad uba bhabriew lymphuin , bad hadien khyndiat por , ka tnga jong u kynrad jong u ka la pdang pun ikwah ïa u Joseph , bad ka la ong ïa u ban leit thiah bad ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that his master s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph  ; and she said , Lie with me .

translation.kha: U Jakob u ong , wahbah ka sngi ka dang jlan kumto bad ka por ruh kam paw dei ban leit set ïa ki langbrot , te balei phim nang ai um ïa ki bad ïalam biang ïa ki sha ka kajuh bam phlang ?
translation.en: And he said , Lo , it is yet high day , neither is it time that the cattle should be gathered together : water ye the sheep , and go and feed them .

translation.kha: Ka jingïaiban ïa ka jingphohsniew jong phi ka mutlop ba ïa kane la pynskhem da U Blei bad ba un pynurlong shen ïa ka .
translation.en: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice  ; it is because the thing is established by God , and God will shortly bring it to pass .
For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance .
translation.kha: Naba U Blei um shym la pynkylla ïa ka jingmut jong u shaphang jongno ba u jied bad u kyrkhu .

translation.en: For those who wish to make a donation , there is a contribution box .—2 Corinthians 9 :7 .
translation.kha: Kito kiba kwah ban ai sngewbha ki lah thep ha i synduk ba la buh lypa .—2 Korinth 9 :7 .
Haba u Saul u ïohi ïa ka kynhun shaei ki Philistia , u la sngewsheptieng ,
translation.en: And when Saul saw the host of the Philistines , he was afraid , and his heart greatly trembled .

translation.kha: Kine ki maw kine pynkohnguh ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la leh . Hadien khadu , haba ki khun ki kti jong phi ki kylli aïu kine ki maw ki mut ,
translation.en: That this may be a sign among you , that when your children ask their fathers in time to come , saying , What mean ye by these stones ?

translation.kha: U longsem U Blei uba pynkup ïa u phlang khlaw — u phlang uba don hangtai mynta bad uba jah noh la shawei , ïa uba la thang nep ha ka lawar ding . Hato Un ym jin da la thikna banbeiñ pynkup jaiñ ïa phi ? A katno kaba rit ka jingbeit phi don !
translation.en: If then God so clothe the grass , which is to day in the field , and to morrow is cast into the oven  ; how much more will he clothe you , O ye of little faith ?

translation.kha: haduh katno phin pynslem , ko ki briew bym ba-don jingngeit ? Nga la thaw kaei kaei kaba thymmai bad kabu pher , kaba pher kum ka briew kaba ïada ïa u briew .
translation.en: How long wilt thou go about , O thou backsliding daughter ? for the  Lord  hath created a new thing in the earth , A woman shall compass a man .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la law ïa kine ki sahmiet ban khet ïa ki dieng bad ban shna ki kynton khring ban kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem . U la ïai-ong , Ngan pynïapmat ïa kñia ka nongpang Namarba ka la dup da ka jingbabe .
translation.en: For thus hath the  Lord  of hosts said , Hew ye down trees , and cast a mount against Jerusalem : this is the city to be visited  ; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her .

translation.kha: Ka long kumne . U briew’ u shim ïa u symbai thir , u symbai bariew tam ha ka pyrthei , bad u thung ïa u ha ka khyndew .
translation.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed , which , when it is sown in the earth , is less than all the seeds that be in the earth :

translation.kha: mynta , haba baroh Ibbah la ïap , Kin sa mihpat ha dat ka sngi ka jingmihpat , ka tnen iohnong kan Long ? Baroh kita ki hynriew ñiut ki la lah shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: In the resurrection therefore , when they shall rise , whose wife shall she be of them ? for the seven had her to wife .

translation.kha: U Blei Bakhuid jong ki Jesreel , U Trai umbiah pynim ïa phi , u ong : Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi , uta uba kwah ban hikai ïa phi na ka bynta ka jingkha jongnga phi hi sad uba kdup ïa phi ïa ka lynti ba phi dei ban wait .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , thy Redeemer , the Holy One of Israel  ; I am the  Lord  thy God which teacheth thee to profit , which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go .

translation.kha: Wat ainguh ha nga da u kpu ba la khleh thiah hato phi ktien ïa ka mrad ha na . Ym bit ban ieh haduh mynsngi ïa ka khleiñ jongki ki mrad ba la kñia ha nga ha kine ki Jingkhawai Niam .
translation.en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread  ; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning .
And he left them , and entering into the ship again departed to the other side .
translation.kha: U la iehnoh ïa ki , u la kiew pat halor ka lieng bad u la sdang ban leit sha shiliang jong ka duriaw .

translation.en: And she brought it before Saul , and before his servants  ; and they did eat . Then they rose up , and went away that night .
translation.kha: Ka buh ïa kata ka jingbam ha khmat u Saul bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ki ïabam . Nangta ki ïeng bad leit noh ha kata hi ka miet .

translation.en: For the day of the  Lord  is near upon all the heathen : as thou hast done , it shall be done unto thee : thy reward shall return upon thine own head .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka la jan ha kaba ma nga , U  Trai  ,  ngan bishar ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh . Ko Edom , ïa kaei kaba pha la leh yn sa leh ha pha . Phan sa ïoh pat ïa kaei kaba pha la ai .

translation.en: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies : for they are ever with me .
translation.kha: Ka hukum jong me ka don bad nga ha ka por baroh bad ka pynlong ïa nga uba kham stad ban ïa ki nongshun jong nga .
Nga tap ba ki jingbishar jong me ki long kiba hok , A Troas , bad ba me la pynshitom ïa nga namar me long uba ïaineh .
translation.en: I know , O  Lord  , that thy judgments are right , and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me .

translation.kha: Kumta phin synrum bad leh ïa ki hukum jong nga : nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments , and do them : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba u bitar , uei uba lah ban lait im ? Uei uba lah ban laitluid na ka jingbitar shla bashyrkhei jong u ? U theh noh ïa ka jingbitar bameh ding jong u ; ki mawsiang ki lko thum ha khmat jong u .
translation.en: Who can stand before his indignation ? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger ? his fury is poured out like fire , and the rocks are thrown down by him .

translation.kha: To pan , bad ngan ai ha me ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ; ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan long ka jong me .
translation.en: Ask of me , and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance , and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession .
For precept must be upon precept , precept upon precept  ; line upon line , line upon line  ; here a little , and there a little :
translation.kha: U pyrshang ban hikai ha ngi ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien , kawei pa kawei ka laiñ , kawei pa kawei ka jinghikai .

Haduh phi la klet noh ïa ki ktien pynshlur ïa kiba U Blei u la kren ha phi khem ïa la ki khun ? Ko khulom jong nga , to pynleit jingput haba U Trai u Sning pynbeit ïa phi , mala wat sngewhun noh mynsiem haba u sneng ïa phi .
translation.en: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children , My son , despise not thou the chastening of the Lord , nor faint when thou art rebuked of him :
And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets , and said unto him , Gird up thy loins , and take this box of oil in thine hand , and go to Ramoth–gilead :
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Elisha u nongïathuhlypa u la khot ïa uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa samla , bad u ong ha u ,  Khreh bad leit sha Ramoth ha Gilead . Rah ïa une u khiew umphniang Olib bad me ,

translation.en: Jesus answered them and said ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Ye seek me , not because ye saw the miracles , but because ye did eat of the loaves , and were filled .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Phi ïawad ïa nga namar ba phi la bam ïa u kpu bad phi la ïoh baroh kaba phi kwah , ym namar ba phi la sngewthuh shai ïa ki kambah jong nga .

translation.en: Son of man , say unto her , Thou art the land that is not cleansed , nor rained upon in the day of indignation .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  ïathuh ïa ki Israel ba ka ri jong ki kam long kaba khuid , bad kumta ngan pynshitom ïa ka ha ka jingbitar jong nga .

U Hasiel u ïa-ong , Ko syiem bad baroh ma phi u bani Judah bad Jerusalem , U Trai u nong ba phim dei ban ryntih mynsiem ne sheptieng shun ïeng pyrshah ïa khnai ka kynoi swai ba bun paid . Ka thma ka shong ha U Bel , ym ha phi .
translation.en: And he said , Hearken ye , all Judah , and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem , and thou king Jehoshaphat , Thus saith the  Lord  unto you , Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude  ; for the battle is not yours , but God s .
But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching , which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour ;
translation.kha: bad ha ka por kaba biang u la pynpaw ïa ka ha ka khubor jong u . Ïa kane la pynkhamti ha nga , bad nga pynbna ïa ka da ka hukum U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi .

Bad kumta ïa Kaei kaba U Tiras u la ïathuh mynshuwa lyngba u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa la pyndep : Ka ri kan sa sah kynjah haduh hynñiewphew sneng , ban pyngkiang ïa ka jingshongthait Sabbaton , ïa kiba ym pateng shym la rakhe .
translation.en: To fulfil the word of the  Lord  by the mouth of Jeremiah , until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths : for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath , to fulfil threescore and ten years .
And he saith unto them ,  Why are ye fearful , O ye of little faith ?  Then he arose , and rebuked the winds and the sea  ; and there was a great calm .
translation.kha: Balei ba phi sheptieng haduh katne ?  U Jisu u la jubab .  Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !  Nangta u la khie joit bad u la hukum ïa ki lyer bad ïa ki jingat phyllung ban sangeh , bad ka la don ka jingjai jai kaba khraw .
U par shakri jong u , u la dem khrup bad u la kyrpad ïa u , ‘ to ïaishah malu to , bad ngan siew patiaw ïa phi !’
translation.en: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet , and besought him , saying , Have patience with me , and I will pay thee all .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u la pyndap ïa nga da U Mynmiet jong u . U la jied ïa nga bad phan ïa la ban wallam ïa ka khublei babha sha kiba duk , ban pynkhiah ïa kiba la pait dohnud , baneh pynbna ka jingpyllait ïa ki mraw bad ka jinglaitluid ïa kito kiba ha ka byndi .
translation.en: The Spirit of the Lord  God  is upon me  ; because the  Lord  hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek  ; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted , to proclaim liberty to the captives , and the opening of the prison to them that are bound  ;
What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth ?
translation.kha: Aïu ngi ïohnong na ka kam jong ngi baroh ?
Kumta u la khot ïa uwei na ki shakor bad u la kylli ïa u , ‘ Ka jia aïu ?’
translation.en: And he called one of the servants , and asked what these things meant .
But as for us , the  Lord  is our God , and we have not forsaken him  ; and the priests , which minister unto the  Lord  , are the sons of Aaron , and the Levites wait upon their business :
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi pat ngi dang ïai shakri ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi bad ngim shym pat iehnoh ïa u . Ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ki pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki , bad ki Lebi ki ïarap lem ïa ki .
Kito kiba dawa ba ki long uba hok ki la kyndit , bad baroh ki la pynrem ïa nga ba ngam khong Blei .
translation.en: Upright men shall be astonished at this , and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite .

translation.kha: U la ong , Kine ki saw thylliej ki mradkhlaw kiba khraw eh ki long ki saw thlia ki hima ki ban sa mih ha ka pyrem .
translation.en: These great beasts , which are four , are four kings , which shall arise out of the earth .

translation.kha: Ha ka jaka sahmiet ha lynti , U tharai u ïashem bad u Moses , bad u mih ban pynïap noh ïa u .
translation.en: And it came to pass by the way in the inn , that the  Lord  met him , and sought to kill him .

translation.kha: Wat ai ki jingkynnoh kiba lamler , bad kam pynïap ïa kiba ang lui , namar lang pynkmen ïa uno un Uba leh kum kata ka kam bymman .
translation.en: Keep thee far from a false matter  ; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not : for I will not justify the wicked .

translation.kha: Don u ban kylli , Kumba lah ban pynmihpat ïa kiba ïap ? Ka met kaba kumto kin don ?
translation.en: But some man will say , How are the dead raised up ? and with what body do they come ?
Judah , and the land of Israel , they were thy merchants : they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith , and Pannag , and honey , and oil , and balm .
translation.kha: Ka Judah bad ka Israel ki la siew na ka bynta ki mar jong pha da u kew , ka ngap , ka umphniang Olib , bad ki musli musla .
Hobab u la tip ba U Jeshua u la dei na ka thain ba la synshar da u Herod , u la phiah ïa u sha u Herod , uba la don ruh ha Jeremaïah ha kata ka por .
translation.en: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod s jurisdiction , he sent him to Herod , who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time .

translation.kha: ka Madan , ka Hasor ,
translation.en: The king of Madon , one  ; the king of Hazor , one  ;

translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jongnga nga , mynta ngi long ki khunlung U Blei , hyndai kam pat da shai aïu ngin sa long . Hynrei ngi tip ba ynda U Khrist un lap , Ngin ïoh long kum ma u , namar ngin ïor ïa u kumba u long da shisha .
translation.en: Beloved , now are we the sons of God , and it doth not yet appear what we shall be : but we know that , when he shall appear , we shall be like him  ; for we shall see him as he is .

translation.kha: U Mushi u la sngewkynduh ïa Kaei kaba u la Ïohi , bad u la leit hajan ka lawlynnong ban ioh kham bha . Hynrei u la ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong U Trai :
translation.en: When Moses saw it , he wondered at the sight : and as he drew near to behold it , the voice of the Lord came unto him ,

translation.kha: Lada me leh kumne ïa per , to sngewsynei ïa nga bad pynïap noh ïa nga , khnang ba ngan ym hapdeng shah shuh ïa Kanneh ka jingleh bymdondor jong me .
translation.en: And if thou deal thus with me , kill me , I pray thee , out of hand , if I have found favour in thy sight  ; and let me not see my wretchedness .
Thine heart shall meditate terror . Where is the scribe ? where is the receiver ? where is he that counted the towers ?
translation.kha: Ki jingsheptieng jong phi kiba mynshuwa ïa ki nonglum khajna nongwei bad ki nongsyntiat kin shu long sa tang ka jingkynmaw .

translation.en: If thou seekest her as silver , and searchest for her as for hid treasures  ;
translation.kha: Wad ïa ka kumba phi wad ïa ka rupa lane ïa kano kano ka spah ba la buhrieh .

Nangne nga ong ha u Jehosheba , ‘ Me la ïohi ïa kata baïar kaba U Trai U Bela jongu me u la leh ïa kito ki ar lwet ki syiem , u Sihon bad u Og ; un leh khmut ïa kita baroh ïa kiba nam dang hiarthma ha ka ri jong ki .
translation.en: And I commanded Joshua at that time , saying , Thine eyes have seen all that the  Lord  your God hath done unto these two kings : so shall the  Lord  do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ka jingïapyndait ka ban wan hap ha ka Edom kuna longsem kaba da ishyrkhei hajuh ba kiba ïaid nangta kin kyndit sad sheptieng .
translation.en: Also Edom shall be a desolation : every one that goeth by it shall be astonished , and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof .
Strength and honour are her clothing  ; and she shall rejoice in time to come .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba khlaiñ bad ïoh burom , bad kam sheptieng ïa ka lawei .
Hadien ka jingtep jong u Gideon , ki paid Israel Kim shym ïaid shuh bad U Blei bad ki la mane ïa ki Baal . Ki la pynlong ïa u Baal-jong-ka-Jutang banbeiñ long u blei jong ki ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as Gideon was dead , that the children of Israel turned again , and went a whoring after Baalim , and made Baal–berith their god .

translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Wat shah ba ki jingbrai jong phi kin ïapoi kha bad ki bym dei na kajuh ka jait . Wat thung ha kajuh ka lyngkha ar khait u symbai . Wat phong ïa ka jaiñ kaba la tiduh da ki ar jait ki ksai .
translation.en: Ye shall keep my statutes . Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind : thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed : neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee .

translation.kha: Bahok ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïaineh jong phi ha ka gospel , bun na ka bynta kane , nga sngewrem shibun shaphang jong phira . NGA kwah ïa phi ban lama kaba stad shaphang kaei kaba Bha , hynrei ban long la lui ha kaei kaba sniew .
translation.en: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men . I am glad therefore on your behalf : but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good , and simple concerning evil .
Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words ? there is more hope of a fool than of him .
translation.kha: Don katto katne ka jingkyrmen ïa u bieit uba mutlop ban ïa uno uno uba kren khlem pyrkhat .
Katto katne snem hawei , ha ka aïom ot , u khana u la mih shabar ha kawei ka step ban wait sha la u kpa jong u , uba don ha lyngkha lem bad ki nongot khiew .
translation.en: And when the child was grown , it fell on a day , that he went out to his father to the reapers .
But thou , son of man , hear what I say unto thee  ; Be not thou rebellious like that rebellious house : open thy mouth , and eat that I give thee .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , sngap ïa kaei ba nga ong ha me . Wat ïaleh pyrshah kum ma ki . Ang ïa la ka shyntur bad bam ïa kaei kaba ngan ai ha me .

translation.en: We give thanks to God always for you all , making mention of you in our prayers ;
translation.kha: Ngi ainguh borabor ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong phi baroh bad ngi ïai kynmaw ïa phi borabor ha ki jingduwai jong ngi .
Nangta u Shemuel u leit sha Ramah , bad u syiem Saul u leit sha la ïohnang ha Gibeah .
translation.en: Then Samuel went to Ramah  ; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul .

translation.kha: U Moses u la ong ha ki , Uno uno ruh um dei ban pynsah ïa ka kdew tang khyndiat pajut na ka bynta kaba la shai .
translation.en: And Moses said , Let no man leave of it till the morning .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba U Messaïah un wan , ym don ba tip na-ei ba u waiñ . Bad baroh im’ tip nangno une u briew u wan .
translation.en: Howbeit we know this man whence he is : but when Christ cometh , no man knoweth whence he is .
And it came to pass , because the midwives feared God , that he made them houses .
translation.kha: Namar ba kita ki nongpynkha khun ki sheptieng ïa U Blei , u ruh u pynmanbha ïa ki , bad u ai ha ki ba kin don la ki khun ki kti . Ki Israel ruh ki nang roi bad ki nang khlaiñ .

translation.en: And I will take thee , and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth , and shalt be king over Israel .
translation.kha: Jeroboam , ngan pynlong ïa me u syiem ki Israel , bad men synshar ïa ka jaka baroh kat kaba me kwah .
sharud jong kawei pa kawei ka surok pha la Tei ki jaka ban mane ïa ki bleithaw pynlang ban ïalaw nongkit .
translation.en: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place , and hast made thee an high place in every street .

translation.kha: U pynrangbah uba duk u dei ban kmen haba U Blei u kyntiew ïa u , Bad u parabangeit uba pynriewspah u dei ban kmen haba U Blei u pynhiar ïa u .
translation.en: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted :

translation.kha: ïa ki pyrda jongnga ka phyllaw kaba long baroh sawdong ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa ka duwan , bad ïa ka phira ïa ka jingkhang jong ka phiah . Kynton kitkhlieh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad kine ki tiar ki tar .
translation.en: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites , to serve , and for burdens :

translation.kha: Hynñiew U Jisu u la ong , Keiñ noh kane ! U la ktah ïa ka shkor lad uta u bhabriew bad u la pynkhiah ïa u .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said ,  Suffer ye thus far .  And he touched his ear , and healed him .

And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel  ; and one king shall be king to them all : and they shall be no more two nations , neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all :
translation.kha: Ngan pyntylli ïa ki kum kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ka ri , halor ki lumbah ka Israel ; kin don tang uwei u syiem u ban synshar halor jong ki , bad kin ym long shuh ka jingïaphiah ha ki ar ki jaitbynriew lane ïabynta ha ki ar tylli ki hima .
Kan long kum haba u briew u phet ïap na u sing bad u ïakynduh ïa ka dngiem ! lane kum haba u briew u Wan sha la ïing bad buh ïa la ka kti ha ka kynrei — tang shun shah buh ha u bseiñ !
translation.en: As if a man did flee from a lion , and a bear met him  ; or went into the house , and leaned his hand on the wall , and a serpent bit him .

The  Lord  hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion : he hath stretched out a line , he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying : therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament  ; they languished together .
translation.kha: Ka burom jong ka , ka la leit noh ; ka la lyngkhuit bad ka la don ha ka jingshah ñiewbeiñ . Ka ud bad ka buhrieh ïa la ka durkhmat ha ka jinglehrain . Ka Jerusalem ka la pynjakhlia ïa lade da ka pop kaba shyrkhei .

bad kane ka dei ka khana shaphang ka longïing longsem jongno u Jakob . U Joseph , u samla uba la khathynñiew snem ka rta , u ap sumar ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang lem bad la ki hynmen shynrang jongngi u , ki khun shaneng jong ka Bilhah pynlang ka Silpah , ki tngit kylla jong u kpa jong u . U Joseph u Wanlam ki jingïathuh bymsngewtynnat ha la u kop shaphang kaei ba ki hynmen jong u ki leh .
translation.en: These are the generations of Jacob . Joseph , being seventeen years old , was feeding the flock with his brethren  ; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah , and with the sons of Zilpah , his father s wives : and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report .

translation.kha: Ka shtah borbah ka wan na me ; me synshar halor kiei kiei baroh da ka jingkhlaiñ bad ka bol jong me , Bad me lah ban pynlong ïano ïano uba khraw sad uba khlaiñ .
translation.en: Both riches and honour come of thee , and thou reignest over all  ; and in thine hand is power and might  ; and in thine hand it is to make great , and to give strength unto all .

translation.kha: Suk uta u bariew uba to U Bel jong u Jakob ba-bang ïarap ïa u bad uba shaniah ha U Trai U Bela jong u ,
translation.en: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help , whose hope is in the  Lord  his God :

translation.kha: Bel phi thiah ?
translation.en: Why did you sleep ?

translation.kha: Kumta phiah dei ban kohnguh bad leh ïa kiei kiei baïar kiba ki ong ïa phi Ban leh ; pynban , wat Pyrthei bud ïa ki jingleh jong ki ; namar ba kim leh ïa kaei kaba ki ïalap .
translation.en: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe , that observe and do  ; but do not ye after their works : for they say , and do not .

translation.kha: Balei tun ïarap ïa phi ? u Elisha u ong ïa u syiem ka Israel . Khie rupa bad kylli na kito ki nongïathuhlypa kaba u kpa badno ka kmie jong me ki la kylli . Em ! u Joram u jaboh . U dei U Trai uba la buh ïa ngi lai ngut ha ka jingisynei jong u syiem ka Moab .
translation.en: And Elisha said unto the king of Israel , What have I to do with thee ? get thee to the prophets of thy father , and to the prophets of thy mother . And the king of Israel said unto him , Nay : for the  Lord  hath called these three kings together , to deliver them into the hand of Moab .

translation.kha: U mane ïa ka Astarte ka blei ki Sidon , nabar ïa u Malkhijah u balieh ba-ijli jong ki Ammon .
translation.en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites .
And in the same house remain , eating and drinking such things as they give : for the labourer is worthy of his hire . Go not from house to house .
translation.kha: Sah ha kata kajuh ka ïing , bam bad dih ïa kano kano kaba ki ai ïa phi , naba u nongtrei u dei ban ïoh ïa ka bainong jong u . Wat leit sawdong na kawei ka ïing sha kawei pat .

U Nadab bad u Abihu , ki khun shynrang jongu u Aaron , ki shim ïa la ki khie thang jingiwbih , ki buh rnga dieng ha ki , ki ryngkat ïa ka jingiwbih klang , sad ki kñia ainguh ïa ka ha U Trai . Hynrei kane ka ding ka long ka bymdonkam , namar U Trai um shym la hukum ïa ki ban leh kumta .
translation.en: And Nadab and Abihu , the sons of Aaron , took either of them his censer , and put fire therein , and put incense thereon , and offered strange fire before the  Lord  , which he commanded them not .
And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people , and the veil that is spread over all nations .
translation.kha: Hangne un sa weng kynsan ïa u lyoh jong ka jingsngewsih uba ju tap halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .
U pyrthat u pynbna ïa ka jingnang ka airong bad ki jingbrai ki tip ba kan wan .
translation.en: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it , the cattle also concerning the vapour .
And another said , I have married a wife , and therefore I cannot come .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u la ong , ‘ Nga dang shu shongkurim , bad na kata ka daw ngam lah ban wan .’

translation.en: Therefore , O Aholibah , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will raise up thy lovers against thee , from whom thy mind is alienated , and I will bring them against thee on every side  ;
translation.kha: Mynta te , ko Oholibah , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha pha . Pha la thait ïa kito ki nongleh-ieit , hynrei ngan pynlong ïa ki ban bitar ïa pha bad ngan wallam ïa ki ban ker sawdong ïa pha .

translation.en: But she was plucked up in fury , she was cast down to the ground , and the east wind dried up her fruit : her strong rods were broken and withered  ; the fire consumed them .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki kti ba bitar ki la rat ïa u naduh tynrai bad bret ïa u sha madan . Ka lyer mihngi ka la pyntyrkhong ïa u soh jong u . Ki tnat jong u ki la kheiñ ; ki la tyrkhong bad la thang noh .

translation.en: These things speak , and exhort , and rebuke with all authority . Let no man despise thee .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa kine kiei kiei bad pyndonkam pura ïa la ka iktiar haba me ai mynsiem bad haba sneng ïa ki nongsngap jong me . Wat ai ïano ïano na ki ban ibeiñ ïa me .
Lada u nongïathuhlypa u shah Shur ban ai ki ïajubab kiba bakla , ka den namar ma nga , U Troas Nongsynshar , de la shukor ïa u . Ngan weng ïa u na ki paidbhur Israel .
translation.en: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing , I the  Lord  have deceived that prophet , and I will stretch out my hand upon him , and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel .

translation.kha: Anab uno uno uba kwah ban pyntam ïa la ka jong ka jingim un heh nep ïa ka ; hyndai uno uno u ban duh noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Gospel un pynim ïa ka .
translation.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it  ; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel s , the same shall save it .

translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei ka kynther ha ka hima kan sdang ban peitbeiñ ïa u tnen jong ka tang shu ïasngew ïa kamai kaba ka mahadei ka la leh . kin ong , ‘ U syiem Serksis u hukum ïa ka Bashti , ka Mahadei , ban wan sha u bad ka kyntait .’
translation.en: For this deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women , so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes , when it shall be reported , The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him , but she came not .

translation.kha: Ym don Uba khuid kum U Trai’ ; ym don uba kamon ma u , ym don nongïada uba kum U Blei Jong ngi .
translation.en: There is none holy as the  Lord  : for there is none beside thee : neither is there any rock like our God .

translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong sa , to wat sngewphylla ïa ka jingtynjuh ba-eh katba pa shahshitom , kumba kiei kiei kiba khyllah ki wanlam jylla ha phi .
translation.en: Beloved , think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you , as though some strange thing happened unto you :
And the speech pleased the Lord , that Solomon had asked this thing .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la sngewbha ba u Solomon u la pan ïa kane ,

translation.en: And when he heard of Jesus , he sent unto him the elders of the Jews , beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant .
translation.kha: Haba u rangbah pynïaidkam u la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu , u la phah katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san jong ki Jiw ban kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban wan bad pynkhiah ïa u shakri jong u .
U Demas u la khnam noh ha ki kam pyrem bad u la ieh ïa nga , bun u la leit noh shad Thessaloni . U Kreskens u la rupa shwa Galatia ; u Titos sha Dalmatia .
translation.en: For Demas hath forsaken me , having loved this present world , and is departed unto Thessalonica ; Crescens to Galatia , Titus unto Dalmatia .

If a soul commit a trespass , and sin through ignorance , in the holy things of the  Lord   ; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the  Lord  a ram without blemish out of the flocks , with thy estimation by shekels of silver , after the shekel of the sanctuary , for a trespass offering :
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u leh pop khlem tip da kaba kum klet ban wan ai ïa ka jingsiew ba long kyntang sha U  Trai  , un wallam ïa ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat sha U  Trai  da u langbrot ne u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna . Ka jingpynshong dor ïa u kan long kumba la buh .

Mynta pat , ngi la lait na ka Hukum , namar ngi la ïap noh ïa kata kaba shisien ka la khum ïa ngi kum ki koidi . Ngim shatri shuh ha ka rukom barim jong ka hukum ba la thoh , hynrei ha ka rukom bathymmai jongki U Mynhynnin .
translation.en: But now we are delivered from the law , that being dead wherein we were held ; that we should serve in newness of spirit , and not in the oldness of the letter .
Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !
translation.kha: Ki dei ban sngewnguh ïa U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingieit baneh jong u , na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh ïa ki .

translation.en: Thou shalt stand abroad , and the man to whom thou dost lend shall bring out the pledge abroad unto thee .
translation.kha: ap habar bad ieh un da wallam hi ïa ka ha phi .
Hynrei ngan pynkhamti ïa ka jaitbynriew kaba te mraw ïa ki , bad hato kmen ïashongduh na kata ka ri nongtei , kan da kit ruh shibun ka spah .
translation.en: And also that nation , whom they shall serve , will I judge : and afterward shall they come out with great substance .

translation.kha: U la ïakhot ha u kumno ba u Saul u la pynïap ïa ki lyngkhuh jongno U Tiras .
translation.en: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the  Lord s  priests .

translation.kha: Ki la sngewsarong bad mutlop bad leh ïa keiñ kiei kiba nga isih , kumta ang la pynïong ïa ki , kumba pha tip) bha .
translation.en: And they were haughty , and committed abomination before me : therefore I took them away as I saw good .

Get thee unto Pharaoh in the morning  ; lo , he goeth out unto the water  ; and thou shalt stand by the river s brink against he come  ; and the rod which was turned to a serpent shalt thou take in thine hand .
translation.kha: Kumta khie leit bad ïakynduh ïa u mynstep ha ka por ba u leit hiar sha ka wah Nile . Rah bad me ïa u diengduh ïa uba la pynkylla bseiñ , bad ap ïa u harud wah .
Ki pop jong ki , ki la pynkhih bitar ïa nga , bad kamut ngan pyndam noh ïa me bad ïa ka longïing jongno me , kumba nga la sa ïa u Jeroboam .
translation.en: Behold , I will take away the posterity of Baasha , and the posterity of his house  ; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Khie leit khah , malade wan ïalam patiaw bad me ïa u Horon . hynriew ki lyngdoh bad ki briew kim bit ban jam ïa u pud ban wan shata to , ïew sa pynsamthiah ïa ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Away , get thee down , and thou shalt come up , thou , and Aaron with thee : but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the  Lord  , lest he break forth upon them .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki Israel ki la jyllop ïa ki mawpud , bad ka jingsuk ka la khong ha ka ri hapoh phraphew snem .
translation.en: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel . And the land had rest fourscore years .

Tell ye , and bring them near  ; yea , let them take counsel together : who hath declared this from ancient time ? who hath told it from that time ? have not I the  Lord  ? and there is no God else beside me  ; a just God and a Saviour  ; there is none beside me .
translation.kha: Ale bad ai ïa ka kam jong phi ha ka ïingbishar ; ai ba ki nongïasaid kin ïasyllok uwei ïa uwei pat . Mano ba la ïathuhlypa slem mynshuwa kaei ban jia ? Hato ym dei ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei uba pynim ïa la ki briew ? Ym don uwei pat U Blei .

translation.en: And now I ask one petition of thee , deny me not . And she said unto him , Say on .
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga don kawei ka jingkyrpad ; sngewbha wat kyrngah ïa nga .   Kaei kata ?  ka Bathsheba ka kylli .

translation.en: And it was so , that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto the  Lord  , he arose from before the altar of the  Lord  , from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Solomon u la pynkut ïa kane ka jingduwai ha U  Trai  , u ïeng noh na khmat kata ka duwan , na ka jaka ba u la dem khohsiew da kaba rah ïa la ki kti .

translation.en: “Satan” means an enemy or an opposer .
translation.kha: “Soitan” ka mut u nongshun ne u nongïaleh pyrshah .
Phi hi phi ïapstai ba nga la trei da kine ki ktien jong nga ban pynbiang ïa kaei kaei kaba ki parad jong nga bad ma por ngi jingdonkam .
translation.en: Yea , ye yourselves know , that these hands have ministered unto my necessities , and to them that were with me .
And the  Lord  said , Even thus shall the children of Israel eat their defiled bread among the Gentiles , whither I will drive them .
translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ,  Kane ka long kum ka dak ba ki Israel ki hap ban bam ïa ka jingbam ba ka Aiñ ka khang , haba ngan pynsakma ïa ki sha ki ri nongwei .
To sneng ha khmat kiba bun ïa kito baroh kiba har ïa ki pah , khnang ba kita kiei ruh kin bymsheptieng .
translation.en: Them that sin rebuke before all , that others also may fear .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet U Trai u nong ha u Nathan ,
translation.en: And it came to pass that night , that the word of the  Lord  came unto Nathan , saying ,

translation.kha: bad hangta nga la ïohi ba wan na shaphang mihngi ka jingshai ba-thaba jong ka jingdon U Blei ki Israel . Ka sur jong U Blei ka sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh ka duriaw , bad ka pyrthei ka phria da ka jingshai babha .
translation.en: And , behold , the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east : and his voice was like a noise of many waters : and the earth shined with his glory .
And Jehoshaphat said , The word of the  Lord  is with him . So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him .
translation.kha: U dei u nongïathuhlypa bashisha ,  u syiem Jehoshaphat u ong . Kumta ki lai ngut ki syiem ki la leit sha u Elisha .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Take heed , and beware of covetousness : for a man s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth .
translation.kha: Bad u la ïai kren ha ki baroh ,  To khmih bha bad sumar ïa lade na kano kano ka jait jinglalot ; namar ba ïa ka jingim bashisha jong u briew ym shym la pynlong da kiei kiei kiba u don , kam pher haduh katno u lah ban long uba riewspah .

U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka Templ bad u la beh ei ïa barieh Kito kiba ïadie bad kiba ïathied hangta . U la pynkylla nongkhap ïa ki miej jong ki nongïapeiñ sbai bad ïa ki khang shong jong kito kiba die parad ,
translation.en: And Jesus went into the temple of God , and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple , and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers , and the seats of them that sold doves ,

translation.kha: Hynrei u Uriah um shym leit sha ïing ; pynban u la thiat ha ka khyrdop ïingsyiem lem bad ki nongjop phira jong u syiem .
translation.en: But Uriah slept at the door of the king s house with all the servants of his lord , and went not down to his house .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki sa kawei pat ka Persia . Ka Hima ki baneh ka un-long kumne . Ka briew ka shim khyndiat u thiat bad ka khleh ïa u malu sawphew kilo u puriskam tad haduh ba u purew ba la khleh u sieb .
translation.en: Another parable spake he unto them  ;  The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven , which a woman took , and hid in three measures of meal , till the whole was leavened .

translation.kha: Nga la ïaleh tyngeh ïa ka jingïamareh , nga la pynjop ïa ka jingïaphet , nga la ri ïa ka jingngeit .
translation.en: I have fought a good fight , I have finished my course , I have kept the faith :
Then said his wife unto him , Dost thou still retain thine integrity ? curse God , and die .
translation.kha: Ka tnga jong u ka ong ha u ,  Me dang long hi uba ïaishah kumba ju long , hato kam dei kumta ? Balei mem tim ïa U Blei bad ïap noh artat ?
ngan ym eh shuh ïa kano kano na ki jaitbynriew kiba dang ne ha ka ri haba u Jeshua u la ïap .
translation.en: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died :

translation.kha: Ai ba u dieng Dumbur un ai ka jinghikai ïa phi . Habor ki tnat jong u ki la jyrngam bad kai lung sad u la sdang banbeiñ sei ki sla , phi kop ba ka lyiur ka la jan .
translation.en: Now learn a parable of the fig tree  ; When her branch is yet tender , and putteth forth leaves , ye know that summer is near :

translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym la sngewthuh aïu kane ka jinghikai ka kit jingmut , bad ki la sngewsheptieng ban kyrmen ïa u .
translation.en: But they understood not that saying , and were afraid to ask him .
And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria , and the plummet of the house of Ahab : and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish , wiping it , and turning it upside down .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem kumba nga la leh ïa ka Samaria , kumba nga la leh ïa u Ahab u syiem ka Israel bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u . Ngan pynkhuid phar ïa ka Jerusalem na ki briew jong ka kumba khuid ka pliang ba la ñiad bad pyndem pyllup ïa ka .
u la Pha sha katto katne ngut ki rangbah blem dara kane ka khubor : To U TRAI’ un kyrkhu ïa phi nabar ka jingpynshoi ïa ka jingngeit ïa la u syier da kaba tep ïa u .
translation.en: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh–gilead , and said unto them , Blessed be ye of the  Lord  , that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord , even unto Saul , and have buried him .

translation.kha: NGA duwai na ka bynta jong ki . Ngam duwai na ka bynta ka pyrthei hynrei na ka bynta pli ïa kiba me la ai ha to , namar ki long ki jong me .
translation.en: I pray for them : I pray not for the world , but for them which thou hast given me  ; for they are thine .

translation.kha: Kumta ki ma ïa U Trai , hynrei ki mane ruh ïa la ki blei kat kum ki rukom jong ki hima na kiba ki waiñ .
translation.en: They feared the  Lord  , and served their own gods , after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence .

translation.kha: ïa ka duwan ïohnong sad ka khraw rnong jong ka , ïa ki jinghap jngai ka bad ïa ki tiar ki tar jongu ka ; ïa ka dabor bad ïa ka jingpynshong jong ka ;
translation.en: The brasen altar , and his grate of brass , his staves , and all his vessels , the laver and his foot ,

And it came to pass , that when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them , and all the men of war , then they fled , and went forth out of the city by night , by the way of the king s garden , by the gate betwixt the two walls : and he went out the way of the plain .
translation.kha: Mynba u syiem Sedekaïah bad baroh ki shipai jong u ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , ki la pyrshang ban phet na ka nongbah ha ka por mynmiet . Ki la phet na ka lynti jong ka kper syiem , ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka khyrdop kaba pynïasoh ïa ki ar tylli ki kynroh , bad phet na ka liang jong ka Them Jordan .

translation.en: Wherefore , sirs , be of good cheer : for I believe God , that it shall be even as it was told me .
translation.kha: Kumta , ko ki rangbah , to sngew shlur ! Naba nga shaniah ha U Blei ba kan long thik kumba la ïathuh ha nga .

translation.en: Because they turned back from him , and would not consider any of his ways :
translation.kha: namar ki la sangeh na kaba bud ïa u bad leh bymsalia ïa ki hukum jong u .

translation.en: He loveth righteousness and judgment : the earth is full of the goodness of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ieit ïa ka hok bad ka jingbishar hok ; ka jingieit baneh jong u ka pyndap ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria , and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan , and in the cities of the Medes :
translation.kha: U patsha ka Assyria u ïalam ïa ki Israel sha Assyria kum ki koidi bad u pynshong pynsah ïa ki katto katne na ki ha ka nongbah Halah , katto katne hajan ka wah Habor ha ka distrik Gosan , bad katto katne ha ki nongbah ka Media .

U Moses u la rah bad u ïa ka saw u Joseph , kumba u Joseph u la pynjar ïa ki Israel . U Joseph u la lah ong , Haba U Blei u Wan pyllait ïa pa , phin dei ban pita nala ïa ka met jongu nga na kane ka khang .
translation.en: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him : for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel , saying , God will surely visit you  ; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you .
And ye answered me , and said , The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do .
translation.kha: Bad phi ruh phi ïasngewdei ïa kata kaba bha ban leh .

translation.en: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice  ; with the voice together shall they sing : for they shall see eye to eye , when the  Lord  shall bring again Zion .
translation.kha: Kito kiba ap phira ïa ka nongbah ki pyrta , ki pyrta lang da ka jingkmen ! Ki lah ban ïohi da la ki jong ki khmat ïa ka jingwan jong U  Trai  sha Seïon !
U la rung shapoh malu u la ïa-ong ïa ki , Balei katne katne ka jingkhynwin ? Areli ba phin ïa-ïoh ? Ka khynnah kam shym ïap — ka Shuh ïohthiah !
translation.en: And when he was come in , he saith unto them ,  Why make ye this ado , and weep ? the damsel is not dead , but sleepeth .

translation.kha: U Kpa u ieit ïa nga namar ba na kloi ban aiti ïa la ka jingim , khring ba to lah baneh ïohpdiang pat ïa ka .
translation.en: Therefore doth my Father love me , because I lay down my life , that I might take it again .

translation.kha: U briew uba pang na ka jingpangnud ñiuhtmoh u la wan ha U Jisu , u la dem khohsiew bad u la jingkyrpad ïa u ba-bang ïarap . Lada me mon , u la ong , me lah ban pynkhuid ïa nga .
translation.en: And there came a leper to him , beseeching him , and kneeling down to him , and saying unto him , If thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ka khlur sha ki jaitbynriew ! Pyndep ïa ka ! Ai ka dak bad pynbna ïa ka khubor ! Waw buhrieh ïa ka ! Ka Babilon ka la kyllon ! U Marduk u blei jong ka u la khynñiuh ! Ïa ki bleithaw jong Babilon la buh ha ka jinglehrain , ïa ki dur ba-ijli jong ka la pynlwet !
translation.en: Declare ye among the nations , and publish , and set up a standard  ; publish , and conceal not : say , Babylon is taken , Bel is confounded , Merodach is broken in pieces  ; her idols are confounded , her images are broken in pieces .

translation.kha: Pa’ sngewshngain ïa lap ha la ki kam Sniew ; pha pyrkhat ba ym dat mano mano ba ïohi ïa pha . Ka jingdeng bad ka jingtip jong pha ki ïalam kynroh ïa pha , bad phah ong ha lade , ‘ Ngi long U Blei — ym don une Une paw Kum ma nga .’
translation.en: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness : thou hast said , None seeth me . Thy wisdom and thy knowledge , it hath perverted thee  ; and thou hast said in thine heart , I am , and none else beside me .

translation.kha: Eliada u bri u ïathiah shongnia bad la ka pyrsa kurim , baroh ar ngut kyang shiah pynïap . Ki la ai ïa ka kam kaba sang , malade ki la mat khah hi ïa ka jingïap .
translation.en: And if a man lie with his daughter in law , both of them shall surely be put to death : they have wrought confusion  ; their blood shall be upon them .

translation.kha: kane ka dei ka khubor shapoh ka Moab . Ïa ki Nongbah jong ka Ar bad ka Kir la pynring tang ha kawei ka miet , bad ka jingkynjah ka thup ïa ka ri mawbah .
translation.en: The burden of Moab . Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste , and brought to silence  ; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste , and brought to silence  ;
Tom is a friend of a friend of mine .
translation.kha: U Tom u dei u paralok jong u paralok jong nga .

translation.en: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans , and they that are thrust through in her streets .
translation.kha: Kin mynsaw bad kin ïap ha ki lynti bah jong ki nongbah jong ki .
‘ Iehnoh ïa la ka longïing bad ïa ka ri badno leit sha ka jaka kaba ngan pyn-i ïa me .’
translation.en: And said unto him , Get thee out of thy country , and from thy kindred , and come into the land which I shall shew thee .

translation.kha: U la phah ïa ka ding nalor , ka ding naba thang hapoh jong nga . U la buh ka jingriam na ka bynta jong la bad u la wanrah ïa de sha khyndew . Nangta u la iehnoh ïa nga sad ioh ïa nga ha ka jingpang baïaineh .
translation.en: What thing shall I take to witness for thee ? what thing shall I liken to thee , O daughter of Jerusalem ? what shall I equal to thee , that I may comfort thee , O virgin daughter of Zion ? for thy breach is great like the sea : who can heal thee ?

translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la leh pep pyrshah ïa U Trai bad ki ni palat ban pynkhih bitar ïa U pyrshah ïa ki ban ïa kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ki baroh ki la leh .
translation.en: And Judah did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed , above all that their fathers had done .

translation.kha: Lada phi ap haduh ba ka reng bad ka jinglong ka suiñbneng kin bit kin biang , da lat lei phin ym sting ei ei bad phin ym ïoh ot ei ei .
translation.en: He that observeth the wind shall not sow  ; and he that regardeth the clouds shall not reap .

translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan bad khleh poi pyrkhat U Trei Badonbor Baroh un pyllait im ïa pha da ki pynïong bajur bad ki jingkhih jumai . Un phah ïa ki erlangthari dara ka ding baklang ;
translation.en: Thou shalt be visited of the  Lord  of hosts with thunder , and with earthquake , and great noise , with storm and tempest , and the flame of devouring fire .
And they came unto John , and said unto him , Rabbi , he that was with thee beyond Jordan , to whom thou barest witness , behold , the same baptizeth , and all men come to him .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit sha u Ïoannis bad ki la ong ,  Ko Nonghikai , phi kynmaw ïa u briew uba la don lem bad phi ha ka liang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan , ïa uba phi la kren shaphang jong u ? Ha khmih , u la pynbaptis mynta , bad baroh ki la leit sha u !

translation.en: In measure , when it shooteth forth , thou wilt debate with it : he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa ki briew jong u da kaba phah ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw . U la shim ïa ki da ka lyer bashyrkhei na shaphang mihngi .

translation.en: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law , the priest of Midian : and he led the flock to the backside of the desert , and came to the mountain of God , even to Horeb .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba u Moses u dang ap ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong u Jethro , u kthaw kurim jong u , u lyngdoh ka Midian , u ïalam ïa kata ka kynhun lyngba ka ri shyiap , bad u wan poi ha Sinai , u lum uba khuid .

translation.en: And make one cherub on the one end , and the other cherub on the other end : even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof .
translation.kha: uwei ha kawei ka tduh bad uwei ha kawei pat ka tduh jong ka jingtap , bad pynlong ïa ki ba kin i kumba ki ïadait lang bad kata ka jingtap .
U Blei u pyn-ap ha ki ïa ki ngop jong ki bad ïa ka jingsarong jong ki .
translation.en: Then he sheweth them their work , and their transgressions that they have exceeded .

translation.kha: Haba la krenbeiñ ïa u , um shym pynphai ktieh kylliang da kaba krenbeiñ ; haba u shahshitom , um shym la byrngem , hynrei u la buh ïa la ki jingkmen ha U Balei , u Nongbishar bahok .
translation.en: Who , when he was reviled , reviled not again  ; when he suffered , he threatened not  ; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously :

translation.kha: Baroh bakha don hangta ki la ïasam bad ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka khynnah . U Jisu u la ong , Wat ïasam ; ka khynnah kada skhem ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !
translation.en: And all wept , and bewailed her : but he said ,  Weep not  ; she is not dead , but sleepeth .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi men ïoh pat ïa ka bor ban krai ïa kaba me la duh noh , bad trai ïakren bad u . Ha kane ka man men long ka ki ïa ki biria , sad ngin ïoh tip ba nga long U tharai .
translation.en: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped , and thou shalt speak , and be no more dumb : and thou shalt be a sign unto them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions , be not terrified : for these things must first come to pass  ; but the end is not by and by .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng haba phi ïohsngew ïa ki thma bad ki jingïakhih pyrshah bor synshar ; kiba kum kine ki dei ban jia nyngkong , hynrei kim mut ba kaba kut ka la jan .

translation.en: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment , that , if any man knew where he were , he should shew it , that they might take him .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ai ïa ka hukum ba lada uno uno u tip hangno ba U Jisu u don , u dei ban wanrah khubor , khnang ba kin ïohkem ïa u .

U Trai u ong ïa nga ban leit sha ka ïing u syiem Judah , u khun jong u ksiew jongngi u ïaiban , pynlang kren hangta ïa u syiem , ïa ki rangbah synshar bad ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la Ong :
translation.en: And say , Hear the word of the  Lord  , O king of Judah , that sittest upon the throne of David , thou , and thy servants , and thy people that enter in by these gates :

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u la shadong biang ha ka jingïaid lynti jong u , uwei u brai u la wanlam Mareshah , u la den khohsiew ha khmat jongu u , bad u la ong ïa u , Ko nongshniah Babha , kiei kob nga dei ban leh ban ïoh ïa ka jingim bymtip ?
translation.en: And when he was gone forth into the way , there came one running , and kneeled to him , and asked him , Good Master , what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life ?

translation.kha: Ka jingsngewmeng ki paid Israel ka khñiang pyrshah ïa ki hi . Wat hajuh khie baroh ka la jia , kim shym la wan peiñ sha nga , U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face : and they do not return to the  Lord  their God , nor seek him for all this .

translation.kha: U gospel u la kylli , Balei me da sympat kumne ïa la ka kada ha ktien lai mata ? Na la Wan ban khang lynti ïa me namar mem shym la dei shun ithuh sha kano ka jingleit .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto him , Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times ? behold , I went out to withstand thee , because thy way is perverse before me :

translation.kha: U dab u shim ïa ka khlieh u Goliath bad u rah ïa ka sha Jerusalem , hynrei u buh ïa ki atiar u Gaal ha la ka dara .
translation.en: And David took the head of the Philistine , and brought it to Jerusalem  ; but he put his armour in his tent .

translation.kha: U Tobadonijah uba ïohnang hangta hajan jongki u , u ong shuh shuh , Naba kumne kano ka kynroh ki lah ban tei ? Wai u ryngkhiang u ha ban pynpra ïa ka !
translation.en: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him , and he said , Even that which they build , if a fox go up , he shall even break down their stone wall .
And the word of the  Lord  came unto him , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Elijah ,
Haba u symboh Jeroboam u ïohsngew ïa kane , u kdew ïa u bad u hukum , Kem ïa uto u briew ! Mar kumta hi ka kti u syiem ka erlangthari kumba ïapom haduh ba um lah pynkhun shuh ïa ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God , which had cried against the altar in Beth–el , that he put forth his hand from the altar , saying , Lay hold on him . And his hand , which he put forth against him , dried up , so that he could not pull it in again to him .

translation.kha: Nangta ki kyang sha U Trai ban ïoh jingïalap , sad ki ong , ‘ Ngi la lai pop , namar ngi la phai noh na me , ko Trai , malu ngi la mane ïa ki bleithaw jong u Baalath bad ki Astarte . To pyllait ïa ngi na ki nongsuhjaiñ jong ngi , Bad ngin mane ïa me !’
translation.en: And they cried unto the  Lord  , and said , We have sinned , because we have forsaken the  Lord  , and have served Baalim and Ashtoreth : but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies , and we will serve thee .

translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Nga la jied ïa u maw uba kordor ïa uba nga bsuh khem u mawdong ha Shion ; bad uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym noh mynsiem da lei lei .
translation.en: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture , Behold , I lay in Sion a chief corner stone , elect , precious : and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded .

translation.kha: Baroh Ibbah ïohi ïa nga lane ïohsngew shaphang jong nga ki don ban ong ïa kiei kiei kiba beh kiba nga la leh .
translation.en: When the ear heard me , then it blessed me  ; and when the eye saw me , it gave witness to me :

translation.kha: Ngan pynthymmai ïa ka million ba nga la pynlong bad ki khop tymmen jongu ki mynba at la pynpaw ïa la ka bor ha ki jaitbynriew baroh da kaba ïalam noh ïa la ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , khnang ba ma nga , U Trai , nga lah ban long U Blei jong ki . Nga longïng U Trai .
translation.en: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors , whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen , that I might be their God : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Pha ïeng sharud ha kata ka sngaid haba ki nongshong ki pynpra ïa ki khyrdop jong ki . Pha la long kaba sniew kum kito ki nongwei babha rah noh ïa ka spah jong ka Jerusalem Bad pynbynta ïa ka hapdeng jong ki hi .
translation.en: In the day that thou stoodest on the other side , in the day that the strangers carried away captive his forces , and foreigners entered into his gates , and cast lots upon Jerusalem , even thou wast as one of them .

translation.kha: Na la ki kynhun jingriam u pyndap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang man la ka step bad man la ka janmiet , nabar na ka bynta kito ïa uba plied ha ka sngi Sabbaton , ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ha kiwei ki jinglehkmen ïa kiba donkam da ka hukum Jong U Trai’ .
translation.en: He appointed also the king s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings , to wit , for the morning and evening burnt offerings , and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths , and for the new moons , and for the set feasts , as it is written in the law of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ïap ïa ki paid Judah , bad ki la shim kynti ïa ka ri lum . Hynrei kim shym la kurup ïa ka Gasa , ka Ashkelon , lane ka Ekron lak Bad ki kajuh sdang jong ki . Kainan ki briew kaba shong basah harud duriaw ki don ïa ki kali ïapom da ka nar , sad kumta ki paid Jehoïada kim shym la lah ban beh krad ïa ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Judah  ; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain  ; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley , because they had chariots of iron .

translation.kha: Kumta u Judia u la leit shad kata ka kper , u da ïalam bad u ïa ka kynoi ki shipai Rom , bad katto kattne ki nongap phira jong ka Templ ïa kiba la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ; ki la long kiba la kieng tait Bad ki la rah ïa ki sharak bad ki dongmusa .
translation.en: Judas then , having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees , cometh thither with lanterns and torches and weapons .

translation.kha: Ki nongot babniah baroh ki kyrhuh kum ki sing sad jlew kum ki khun sopti .
translation.en: They shall roar together like lions : they shall yell as lions  whelps .
And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them , and fled by the way of the wilderness .
translation.kha: U Joshua bad ki rangbah jong u ki leh mynleh kumba phai dien , bad ki phet sha ka jaka bashrah .

translation.en: And she said unto her mistress , Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria ! for he would recover him of his leprosy .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ka ong ïa la ka kynrad ,  Nga kwah ba u kynrad jong nga un lah ban leit sha u nongïathuhlypa uba shong ha Samaria ! Un pynkhiah ïa u na ka jingpang jong u .

translation.en: The instruments also of the churl are evil : he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words , even when the needy speaketh right .
translation.kha: U briew uba mutlop u long uba sniew bad u leh ïa ki kam kiba sniew ; u ïasylla ban pynsniew ïa kiba duk da ki jingshukor bad ban khanglad ïa ki ban ïoh ïa ki hok jong ki .

translation.en: Every vow , and every binding oath to afflict the soul , her husband may establish it , or her husband may make it void .
translation.kha: U tnga jong ka u don hok ban pynskhem ne ban pyndam ïa kano kano ka jingkular ba ka la pynlong .

translation.en: Now , O  Lord  God , let thy promise unto David my father be established : for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude .
translation.kha: A  Trai  U Blei , to pyndep ïa ka kular kaba me la ong ha u kpa jong nga . Me la pynlong syiem ïa nga halor u paidlang uba bun katta katta kat haduh ba ym lah ban ñiew , kumta to ai ha nga ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingtip kaba nga donkam ban synshar ïa ki .
Na u patsha Artemas ha u Esra , u lyngdoh , riewstad ka Hukum jong U Blei ka Bneng .
translation.en: Artaxerxes , king of kings , unto Ezra the priest , a scribe of the law of the God of heaven , perfect peace , and at such a time .

translation.kha: badno U Jisu u la ïathaw ha ki ïa Kanneh ka phria : U brup uba matlah um lah ban ïalam ïa uwei pat ; lada u leh kumta , baroh ar ngut kin hap hapoh kharai .
translation.en: And he spake a parable unto them , Can the blind lead the blind ? shall they not both fall into the ditch ?

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , u Paul u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ha kaba u la ïohi ïa u nong Makedonia uba ïeng bad kyrpad ïa u , Abel shane Sha Makedonia bad ïarap ïa ngi !
translation.en: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night  ; There stood a man of Macedonia , and prayed him , saying , Come over into Macedonia , and help us .

translation.kha: U Joseph u ong , O , em ! da lei lei ngan ym leh kumta ! Tang uta keiñ ha uba la shem ïa ka khuri un long u mraw jngai per . Kawei pat na phi ki lah ban leit phai suk sha la u kpa .
translation.en: And he said , God forbid that I should do so : but the man in whose hand the cup is found , he shall be my servant  ; and as for you , get you up in peace unto your father .
For thou hast said , My doctrine is pure , and I am clean in thine eyes .
translation.kha: Me kam ba kaei kaba me ong ka long kaba shisha ; me kam ba me long uba sngur ha ki khmat U Blei .
Ki khnam jong me ki sam lyngba ïa u nongïalam ka kynhun shipai jong u haba u la wan kum ka iohnong ban pynsakma ïa ngi , da ka jingsarong kumno kito Ibbah nongbanbeiñ ïa Ibbah duk ha naba rieh .
translation.en: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages : they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me : their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly .

translation.kha: U Josis u la jubab ïa ki , Ki briew kiba khiah kim donkam ïa u nongpynkhiah , hynrei tang kito kiba pang .
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  They that are whole need not a physician  ; but they that are sick .

translation.kha: Ngi don ka jingshlur ha khmat U Blei , namar ngi sngewskhem ba u jingphohsniew ïa ngi lada ngi kyrpad ïa u na ka bynta Kane kano kaba long kat kum ka mon jong u .
translation.en: And this is the confidence that we have in him , that , if we ask any thing according to his will , he heareth us :

translation.kha: U Blei! u ong ha u Jakob , Khlieh leit sha Bethel badno shongsah hangta . Tei ïa ka duwan hangta ïa de , U Blei umbah la mihpaw ha me mynba me dang phet ïap na u Iso u hynmen jong me .
translation.en: And God said unto Jacob , Arise , go up to Beth–el , and dwell there : and make there an altar unto God , that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka jingmong bymjukut bad ki . Ngan ym sangeh lano lano ruh ban leh ïa kiei ktieh kiba bha na ka bynta jong ki , bad tun pynlong ïa ki ban tiengburom ïa nga da ka dohnud jong ki baher , khnang ba ngin ym phai dien shuh na nga .
translation.en: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them , that I will not turn away from them , to do them good  ; but I will put my fear in their hearts , that they shall not depart from me .

translation.kha: Katba katne ngut ki Pharisi badno ki nonghikai ka Hukum kaba la lah wan na Jerusalem ki la ïalum sawdong ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: Then came together unto him the Pharisees , and certain of the scribes , which came from Jerusalem .
And to him they agreed : and when they had called the apostles , and beaten them , they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus , and let them go .
translation.kha: Ki la khot shapoh ïa ki apostol , ki la phah sympat ïa ki , bad hukum ïa ki ban ym kren shuh da lei lei ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu ; bad nangta ki la pyllait noh ïa ki .

translation.en: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof .
translation.kha: Te ïa ka hukum kaba mynshuwa la buh sharud , namar ba ka long kaba tlot bad ka bymmyntoi .
U la ainong ha u Jehosheba , nong ïa ki hynmen jong phi ban pyndap da ki jingkit ïa ki ñiad jong ki bad ban leit phai sha ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , Say unto thy brethren , This do ye  ; lade your beasts , and go , get you unto the land of Canaan  ;

translation.kha: U Paul u la nang sah khlam babe sngi Bad ki parabangeit ha Korinth , nangta u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit da ka lieng lem bad ka Priskila bad u Akwila sha Syria . Ha shuwa ba un leit da ka lieng na Jingrakhe u la phan khi ïa la ka khlieh namsop ka jingsmai kaba u la pynlong .
translation.en: And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while , and then took his leave of the brethren , and sailed thence into Syria , and with him Priscilla and Aquila  ; having shorn his head in Cenchrea : for he had a vow .

translation.kha: U Mikaïah u ong shuh shuh : Mynta sngap ïa kaei ba U Trai u ainong ! Nga ïohi ïa U Trai ba u shong ha ka khet jong u ha bneng , lymne bad ki angel jong u bakha ïeng hajan Jong u .
translation.en: And he said , Hear thou therefore the word of the  Lord  : I saw the  Lord  sitting on his throne , and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left .

translation.kha: bad un sdang baneh shoh ïa la ki para shakri bad ban ïabam ïadih bad ki nongbeh .
translation.en: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants , and to eat and drink with the drunken  ;

translation.kha: U Bel u la ong , Ko khun u briew , bam ïa Kanah ka kot kli , ngat saw nabar kren ha ki paid Jerusalem’ .
translation.en: Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , eat that thou findest  ; eat this roll , and go speak unto the house of Israel .
And he said , Oh let not the Lord be angry , and I will speak yet but this once : Peradventure ten shall be found there . And he said , I will not destroy it for ten s sake .
translation.kha: U Abraham u ong ,  Sngewbha wat bitar , A Trai , bad ngan kren biang sa tang shisien . Kumno lada don tang shiphew ngut hangta ?  U jubab ,  Ngan ym pynjot ïa ka lada don shiphew ngut .
U kpa jong kata ka briew un ong ha ki , ‘ Nga la ai ïa la ka khun ha une u Briew ngab long ka tnga jong u , bun mynta um mon Shuah ïa ka .
translation.en: And the damsel s father shall say unto the elders , I gave my daughter unto this man to wife , and he hateth her  ;
And again he sent another servant : and they beat him also , and entreated him shamefully , and sent him away empty .
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah sa uwei pat u mraw ; hynrei , ki nongshimwai ki shoh ïa une ruh , ki da leh pynjahburom ïa u , bad ki la phah noh thylli ïa u .
Uta u briew u ong , Pyllait noh ïa nga ; ka la Sdang kynjat shai . Em , ngan ym pyllait , lymda me kyrkhu ïa nga , Ong u Jakob .
translation.en: And he said , Let me go , for the day breaketh . And he said , I will not let thee go , except thou bless me .
And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u la im sa sanspah snem bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
U shipai radbah uba ïeng hangta ha khmat ka diengphna u la ïohi kumno U Jisu u la ïatip . Une u briew u long shisha U Khun U Blei ! u la ong .
translation.en: And when the centurion , which stood over against him , saw that he so cried out , and gave up the ghost , he said , Truly this man was the Son of God .
I bring near my righteousness  ; it shall not be far off , and my salvation shall not tarry : and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory .
translation.kha: Nga wallam ïa ka sngi ka jingjop sha jan — kam long satia kaba dang sha jngai . Ïa ka jingjop jong nga yn ym pynslem . Ngan pyllait im ïa ka Jerusalem bad ngan wallam ïa ka burom ka Israel hangta .

translation.en: And said unto them ,  It is written , My house shall be called the house of prayer  ; but ye have made it a den of thieves .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  La thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ba U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ïa ka Templ jong nga yn khot ka ïing ka jingduwai .’ Hynrei phi pynlong ïa ka , ka jakarieh ïa ki nongtuh !

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Manoah , Though thou detain me , I will not eat of thy bread : and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering , thou must offer it unto the  Lord . For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Manoah um shym tip ba u dei u angel jong U  Trai  , kumta u ong ha u ,  Sngewbha wat nym pat leit . Ai ba ngin ïoh shet uwei u khunblang na ka bynta jong phi .  Hynrei u angel u ong ,  Lada nga dei ban ap , ngan nym bam ïa ka jingbam jong phi . Hynrei lada phi kwah ban pynkhreh ïa ka , thang ïa ka kum ka jingainguh sha U  Trai .

U Bela u don satang ngut ki khun shynrang : u Esbon , u Ussi , u Ussiel , u Jerimoth , bad u Iri . Ki dien ki khlieh jong ki longïing ha ka kur bad ki daym baroh ki shipai bapawnam . Ki khun ki khiew jong ki , ki kynthup ïa ki synreit ar hiar laispah mata ngut ki rangbah kiba bit na ka pyntha ka kam shipai .
translation.en: And the sons of Bela  ; Ezbon , and Uzzi , and Uzziel , and Jerimoth , and Iri , five  ; heads of the house of their fathers , mighty men of valour  ; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four .

translation.kha: Ladan hato me la kyntait ïa sem junom ? Hammoth ym don jingkut ïa ka jingbitar jong me ?
translation.en: But thou hast utterly rejected us  ; thou art very wroth against us .

translation.kha: U Akhan u dat ar ngut ki tngen , ka Hannah bad ka Peninnah . Ka Peninnah ka don ki khun ki kad , isynei ka Hannah kam shym la don khun .
translation.en: And he had two wives  ; the name of the one was Hannah , and the name of the other Peninnah : and Peninnah had children , but Hannah had no children .
Behold , I am according to thy wish in God s stead : I also am formed out of the clay .
translation.kha: Ma phi bad ma nga ngi long kumjuh ha khmat U Blei , ïa baroh ar ngut na ngi la thaw na ka dewmet .
Phin ym donkam ban khuslai ïa ka jingpynduh ka wan kynsan , kum naba wan ha ki riewbymman kum ka erïong .
translation.en: Be not afraid of sudden fear , neither of the desolation of the wicked , when it cometh .

translation.kha: Naba ka lyngraw kaba ngan ai ha phi ka long kaba jem , bad ka jingkit ba ngan buh shalor jong phi ka long kaba slap .
translation.en: For my yoke is easy , and my burden is light .

translation.kha: Kumta u Laban u pynlong ka jingkhiah shongkurim bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki briew baroh .
translation.en: And Laban gathered together all the men of the place , and made a feast .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , to pynkhreh ïa ka kamra na ka bynta jngai nga , namsop nga kyrmen ba U Blei! un Jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong phiah baroh nabar ban ai pat ïa nga ha me .
translation.en: But withal prepare me also a lodging : for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you .

translation.kha: Kam da donkam ïa nga ban pynrem ïa me ; la pynrem ïa me da kawei pa kawei ka kyntoit ba me kren .
translation.en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee , and not I : yea , thine own lips testify against thee .

translation.kha: Bad kumta u iohnong ïa nga namar ba nga ai ïa kaba dei , namsop u tip ba nga long uba pynmeng .
translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  hath recompensed me according to my righteousness  ; according to my cleanness in his eye sight .
And he lifted up his eyes , and saw the women and the children  ; and said , Who are those with thee ? And he said , The children which God hath graciously given thy servant .
translation.kha: Haba u Iso u phai sawdong , bad u ïohi ïa ki kynthei bad ïa ki khynnah , u ong ,  Kiei kine ki briew kiba bad phi ?  U Jakob u jubab ,  Kine , kynrad , ki dei ki khun kiba U Blei u la sngewbha eh ban ai ïa nga .
Slem haduh katno ki riewrunar kin leh sarong bad kob shaphang ki kam dulir jong ki ?
translation.en: How long shall they utter and speak hard things ? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves ?
Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers : for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness ? and what communion hath light with darkness ?
translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban ïatreilang ryngkat bad ki bymngeit , naba kam lah ban long . Kumno kaba dei bad kaba bakla kin ïadon bynta lang ? Kumno ka jingshai bad ka jingdum kin ïasah lang ?
Naba ngi pynleit jingmut , ym ha kiei kaei kiba lah ban ïohi , hynrei ha kai ktieh ki bym lah ban ïohi . Katba ka lah ban ïohi ka neh tang shipa , hynrei kata ka bym lah shun ïohi ka neh junom .
translation.en: While we look not at the things which are seen , but at the things which are not seen : for the things which are seen are temporal ; but the things which are not seen are eternal .
And seek not ye what ye shall eat , or what ye shall drink , neither be ye of doubtful mind .
translation.kha: Kumta baroh wat sngewdiaw , da kaba pyrkhat ïa kaei phin bam bad dih .
U pud jong ka , u suh na Heleph sha u diengsoh Sning ha Saanannim , nangta beit beit sha Adaminekeb bad sha Jamnia , haduh Lakkum , bad u khot ha ka Jordan .
translation.en: And their coast was from Heleph , from Allon to Zaanannim , and Adami Nekeb , and Jabneel , unto Lakum  ; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan :

translation.kha: Ïa kane ka khubor ka bapra na U Blei ym da ban ïanujor bad kaei kaei umdih .
translation.en: Few things are as fascinating as the good news from God .

translation.kha: Ha tala ka por ki Philistia ki ïalumlang ba-bang otsher ïaleh thma pyrsa ïa ki Israel , kumta ki Israel ki mih ban ïaleh ïa ki . Ki Israel ki sher dara ha Ebeneser bun ki phria patar ha Apphia .
translation.en: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel . Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle , and pitched beside Eben–ezer : and the Philistines pitched in Aphek .

translation.kha: Balei te ba phi wan ïalam ïa ngi sha kane ka ri khlaw ? Katto ba ngin ïap haneng bad la ki jingijli ?
translation.en: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the  Lord  into this wilderness , that we and our cattle should die there ?
But neither Titus , who was with me , being a Greek , was compelled to be circumcised :
translation.kha: Ïa u Titos u paralok jong nga , wat la u dei u Grik , ym shym la pynbor ïa u ban otsher ,
Nobah lada kaei kaban U Blei u kular ban ai ha kito kiba kohnguh ïa ka suda , te ka jingngeit u briew kam don jingmut bad ka jingkular U Blei kam dondor ei ei .
translation.en: For if they which are of the law be heirs , faith is made void , and the promise made of none effect :
Simon , ( whom he also named Peter , ) and Andrew his brother , James and John , Philip and Bartholomew ,
translation.kha: U Simon ( ïa uba u la ai kyrteng , u Petros ) bad u Andriw u para jong u , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , u Philip bad u Bartholomai ,
Ki mane kdew ïa ki jar thiang dohkha jong ki bad ai jingkñia ha ki , ñiar ki jar jong ki , ki pyndap ïa ki da kiei kiei baroh kaba bha tam .
translation.en: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net , and burn incense unto their drag  ; because by them their portion is fat , and their meat plenteous .

translation.kha: Balei me don jngai palat , A Trai ? Balei me babuhrieh ïa lade haba ngi don ha ka jynjar ?
translation.en: Why standest thou afar off , O  Lord  ? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble ?

translation.kha: kiaw ka la jia ha baroh hynñiew jngut — ki la ïap khlem don khun .
translation.en: And the third took her  ; and in like manner the seven also : and they left no children , and died .

translation.kha: U ong ha la ki briew ban lum katto katne ki mawbah bad ban kynton khlur jong ki . Nangta ki ïashong bam hajan kata ka kynton maw .
translation.en: And Jacob said unto his brethren , Gather stones  ; and they took stones , and made an heap : and they did eat there upon the heap .

translation.kha: Nga la jong , To sngap ïa U Trai , phi ki kynthei , bad to pynshahshkor ïa ki ktien jong u . To hikai ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi kumno ban ïarieh , bad ïa ki paralok jong phi kumno ban rwai ka jingrwai ïapbriew .
translation.en: Yet hear the word of the  Lord  , O ye women , and let your ear receive the word of his mouth , and teach your daughters wailing , and every one her neighbour lamentation .

translation.kha: To wat kynthup ïa kano kano ka riewkynthei ha ka thup ki riewkynthei Lym ka la dap hynriewphew snem ka rta .
translation.en: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old , having been the wife of one man ,
Therefore it shall come to pass , when the Egyptians shall see thee , that they shall say , This is his wife : and they will kill me , but they will save thee alive .
translation.kha: Haba ki nong Ijipt kin ïohi ïa pha , kin tharai ba pha dei ka tnga jong nga , bad kumta kin pynïap ïa nga bad shah ïa pha , ban im .

translation.en: Lord , they have killed thy prophets , and digged down thine altars ; and I am left alone , and they seek my life .
translation.kha: Ko Trai , ki la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me bad pynkhyllem ïa ki duwan jong me ; nga long sa tang ma nga marwei uba sah , bad ki pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga .
U la kylli shang ka jingkoit jingïakhih jong ki bad u ong , Phi la ïathuh ha nga shngain i pa jong phi , iba la tymmen — i long Kamon ? I dang im , bad i shait i khlem bha ?
translation.en: And he asked them of their welfare , and said , Is your father well , the old man of whom ye spake ? Is he yet alive ?
His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself , and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins .
translation.kha: Ki pop u riewbymman ki long ka jingriam . U ngat ha ka jingriam jong ki pop jong u hi .

translation.en: So are the paths of all that forget God  ; and the hypocrite s hope shall perish :
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba khlem Blei ki long kum kito ki khah ; ka jingkyrmen jong ki ka duh noh , shisien ba la klet ïa U Blei .

translation.en: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers : all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise .
translation.kha: Ki misteri liengbah na Biblos ki long ki rangbah ba la ïoh jinghikai bha . Ki maji na baroh ki liengbah duriaw ki la ïakhaïi pateng ha ki dukan jong pha .
