Da shisha u la pang bad u la ïajan ïap . Hynrei U Blei u la iaineh ïa u , bad ym tang ïa u Hynrei ïa nga ruh , bad u la pyllait ïa nga wat na ka jingsngewsih kaba khlam khrup .
translation.en: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death : but God had mercy on him ; and not on him only , but on me also , lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow .
Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him ? saith the  Lord . Do not I fill heaven and earth ? saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ym don uba lah ban rieh ha kaba ngam lah ban ïohi ïa u . Hato phim tip ba nga don ha ki jaka baroh ha bneng bad ha khyndew ?

translation.en: That hath taken off his hand from the poor , that hath not received usury nor increase , hath executed my judgments , hath walked in my statutes  ; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father , he shall surely live .
translation.kha: U kyntait ban leh ïa kaba sniew bad um ju ai pisa kylliang ban ïohnong . U sumar ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Un ym ïap na ka bynta ki pop jong u kpa jong u , hynrei un im da shisha .
bad katno ka ksiar Nile ha kaba shna ïa ka duwan ha kambah yn tdong jingiwbih , bad ha kaba shna ïa ka kali ïam na ka bynta ki Kherub katba pyiar la ki thapniang halor Ka Synduk Ka Jutang U Trai .
translation.en: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight  ; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims , that spread out their wings , and covered the ark of the covenant of the  Lord .
Remove from me reproach and contempt  ; for I have kept thy testimonies .
translation.kha: To pyllaitluid ïa nga na ki jingibeiñ bad jingkrenbeiñ jong ki , namar nga la sumar ïa ki aiñ jong me ;

Wat u Mikhmash , u angel rangbah um shym la leh ïa kane . Ha ka jingïakajia jong u bun u Soitan , mynba ki la ïania shaphang uei u ban ïoh ïa ka met u Moses , u Mikhael um shym nud shun pynrem ïa u Soitan da ki ktien ban krenbeiñ , hynrei u la ong , U Trai un da sneng ïa me !
translation.en: Yet Michael the archangel , when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses , durst not bring against him a railing accusation , but said , The Lord rebuke thee .

translation.kha: Pha la long ka nuti ïa ki jaitbynriew bad pynjakhlia ïa lade bad ki bleithaw .
translation.en: I will do these things unto thee , because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen , and because thou art polluted with their idols .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba na ki ba-eh jong me uba ïap hapoh ka nongbah un shah bah ha ki ksew , bad uno uno uba ïap ha rudnong un shah bam ha ki pukni .
translation.en: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat  ; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat .

translation.kha: Nga la ai ki jingiaseng mynta , bad nga don ki thoh kñia .
translation.en: I have peace offerings with me  ; this day have I payed my vows .

There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers : and , behold , this vine did bend her roots toward him , and shot forth her branches toward him , that he might water it by the furrows of her plantation .
translation.kha: La don sa uwei u pukni radbah uba don ki thapniang kiba khraw bad ki sner kiba rben . Bad mynta u dieng sohwaiñ u pyiar ïa la ki thied sha u bad u la pynphai ïa la ki sla sha u , ha ka jingkyrmen ba un ai ïa u kham bun ka um ban ïa kaba ka don ha ka kper ha kaba u san .

Nangta u ong ha u Onan , Khie leit sha ka duwan bad kñia ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pum bad ïa ka jingainguh thang ba yn ïohmap ïa ki pop jong phi sad ïa ki pop jong ki paidbah . Lehbha ïa Kanneh ba yn ïohmap noh ïa ki pop jong ki paidbah , kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Go unto the altar , and offer thy sin offering , and thy burnt offering , and make an atonement for thyself , and for the people : and offer the offering of the people , and make an atonement for them  ; as the  Lord  commanded .

translation.kha: U Elisha u nongïathuhlypa u la kem pdang na ka jait jingpang kob shyrkhei , bad katba u dang thiah sa ba un ïap u Jehoash u syiem Israel u loit jingthoh ïa u . Ko pa jongki nga , pa jong nga ! u pyrta da kaba ïam . Phi la long u nongïada bakhlaiñbor jong ka Eliel !
translation.en: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died . And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him , and wept over his face , and said , O my father , my father , the chariot of Israel , and the horsemen thereof .

translation.kha: Nga long , U Jisu u la jingbabe , bad phin ïohi ïa U Toi U Briew uba shong ha ka kular kamon jong U barabor Baroh bad ba u wei ha ki lyoh jongu ka bneng !
translation.en: And Jesus said ,  I am : and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power , and coming in the clouds of heaven .

translation.kha: Don sanspah sanphew ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba peit ïa ki briew kiba tei ïa ki jingtei u Siloam .
translation.en: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon s work , five hundred and fifty , which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work .

translation.en: And they said , Thou hast saved our lives : let us find grace in the sight of my lord , and we will be Pharaoh s servants .

translation.kha: Ki bri kiba kloi baneh bitar ki pynlong shibun ki jingïakajia bad ki jingkulmar .
translation.en: An angry man stirreth up strife , and a furious man aboundeth in transgression .
In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath , in the days of Jael , the highways were unoccupied , and the travellers walked through byways .
translation.kha: Ha ki sngi u Shamgar u khun jong u Anath , Ha ki sngi jong ka Jael , Ki kynhun nongkhaïi kim shym leit shuh lyngba ka ri , Bad ki nongleit jingleit ki pyndonkam ïa ki lynti na shadien .
U la thaw ïa ka sngi bad ïa u bthei ; ka jingneit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translation.en: To him that made great lights : for his mercy endureth for ever :

translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ka ri shyiap ban long ka ïingjaiñ jong ki , bad nga shah ba kin shong ha ki pynthiah mluh .
translation.en: Whose house I have made the wilderness , and the barren land his dwellings .

translation.kha: ka Gederoth , ka Bethdagon , ka Naamah , bad ka Makkedah : khathynriew tukri ki nongbah Lem ruh bad ki nongrit kiba don sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: And Gederoth , Beth–dagon , and Naamah , and Makkedah  ; sixteen cities with their villages :
And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood  ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,
translation.kha: Thaw ruh ïa ki diengkhap da ka dieng akasia , san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei ka liang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,
Te ka jingpynmihpat ka batai ïa ngi shaphang ka jingieit badno jingïamai jong U Jehobah .
translation.en: So the resurrection tells us about Jehovah’s love and undeserved kindness .

translation.kha: Ka shispah jong ki mar khaïi jyllang pha baroh , ki maji jong pha baroh , ki misteri lieng pynlang ki nongkhaïi jong pha baroh , uwei pa uwei u shipai halor ka liengbah — baroh , baroh ki la ngam jyllop ha ka duriaw mynba ka liengbah jong pha ka la shahskhor pynjot .
translation.en: Thy riches , and thy fairs , thy merchandise , thy mariners , and thy pilots , thy calkers , and the occupiers of thy merchandise , and all thy men of war , that are in thee , and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee , shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin .

translation.kha: Ha ka phang bashatei u pud jong ki u sdang na Jordan bad u kiew artet ïa ka sharing lwa kaba shatei na Jeberekhaïah bad u suh sha sepngi lyngba ka ri lum haduh ka ri shyiap Bethaben .
translation.en: And their border on the north side was from Jordan  ; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side , and went up through the mountains westward  ; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth–aven .
They that forsake the law praise the wicked : but such as keep the law contend with them .
translation.kha: Kito kiba lyndet ïa ka hukum ki ïaroh ïa ki bymman ; hynrei kito kiba bat ïa ka ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: I will also gather all nations , and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat , and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel , whom they have scattered among the nations , and parted my land .
translation.kha: Ngan lumlang ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew bad wallam ïa ki sha ka Them jong ka Jingbishar . Hangta ngan bishar ïa ki na ka bynta baroh kaba ki la leh ïa ki briew jong nga . Ki la pynsakma ïa ki Israel sha ki ri nongwei bad ki la phiah ïa ka Israel , ka ri jong nga .

translation.en: And the Word was made flesh , and dwelt among us , ( and we beheld his glory , the glory as of the only begotten of the Father , ) full of grace and truth .
translation.kha: U Ktien la kylla long u briew bad , uba dap da ka jingaiei bad ka jingshisha , u la im hapdeng jong ngi . Ngi la ïohi ïa ka burom jong u , ka burom kaba u la ïohpdiang kum U Khun marwei jong U Kpa .
U Shallum u khun jong u Jabesh u ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Asaraïah , u pynïap ïa u ha Ibleam , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him , and smote him before the people , and slew him , and reigned in his stead .
And it shall come to pass , while my glory passeth by , that I will put thee in a clift of the rock , and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by :
translation.kha: Haba ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon jong nga ka ïaid najan nangta , ngan buh ïa me ha khmat ka krem jong uta u mawsiang bad ngan tap ïa me da la ka kti haduh ba ngan da ïaid lait nangta .

translation.en: And I will walk at liberty : for I seek thy precepts .
translation.kha: ngan im ha ka jinglaitluid bajanai , namar nga pyrshang ban kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong me .
Wat pyntud ban sneng pynpeit ïa u khynnah . Ka jingsympat kaba dei kan ym pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: Withhold not correction from the child : for if thou beatest him with the rod , he shall not die .

translation.kha: U Amasa um shym don jingïada na ka waitlam kaba u Joab u bang ha kawei pat ka ktem jong u , bad u Joab u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh , dara ki snier jong u ki mih syiad ha madan . U ïap ha shen , bun u Joppa um donnam ban dung biang sa shisien . Nangta u Jubab bad u Abishai , u para jong u ki la leit thwet ïa u Sheba .
translation.en: But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab s hand : so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib , and shed out his bowels to the ground , and struck him not again  ; and he died . So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri .
But Esaias is very bold , and saith , I was found of them that sought me not ; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me .
translation.kha: Bad u Isaïah u la long uba kham shlur haba u ong ,  Ïa nga la shem da kito ki bym shym la wad ïa nga ; nga la paw ha kito ki bym shym la kylli ïa nga .
Te U Blei u kren ha u ha ka jingïohipaw mynmiet , bad u ong , Jakob , Jakob ! U ruh u jubab , Oi , nga hangne .
translation.en: And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night , and said , Jacob , Jacob . And he said , Here am I .
So Azariah slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David : and Jotham his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Jotham u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: He shall suck the poison of asps : the viper s tongue shall slay him .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba u briew uba sniew u nguid ka long kum ka bih ; ka pynïap ïa u kum ka jingpuh jong u bseiñ bashyrkhei .

Lada uno une u ïalum ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa phi bad rah ïa phiah shuh ka ïabishar , to leh ïa kaba bha tam ban ïapynbeit ïa ka jingïakajia mala u ha shuwa ba phin poi sha ka jingpynhiar . Lada phim leh kumta , un tian ïa phi ha khmat u nongsynran , u ban aiti ïa phi ha ki nongjapan phira , sad ïa phi yn buh ha ka byrni .
translation.en: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate , as thou art in the way , give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him  ; lest he hale thee to the judge , and the judge deliver thee to the officer , and the officer cast thee into prison .

translation.kha: Ki la kyrwep ïa ka ha khiew ka Sngi bad ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa imat hangta , kumba ki la lai ha Lakhish .
translation.en: And they took it on that day , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day , according to all that he had done to Lachish .

translation.kha: U Paul u la ïeng joit , u la ai tam da la ka kti , bad u la Sdang ba-bang kren : Ko ki para Israel bad ko ki Jentil baroh hangne kiba mane ïa U Blei : To shahskhor ïa la !
translation.en: Then Paul stood up , and beckoning with his hand said , Men of Israel , and ye that fear God , give audience .

translation.kha: U la pynjot ïa ki koit , u la pynpra ïa ki shnongrit . Ki briew jong ka ri ki la sngewshyrkhei man ka por ba u kyrhuh .
translation.en: And he knew their desolate palaces , and he laid waste their cities  ; and the land was desolate , and the fulness thereof , by the noise of his roaring .

Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye multiplied more than the nations that are round about you , and have not walked in my statutes , neither have kept my judgments , neither have done according to the judgments of the nations that are round about you  ;
translation.kha: Mynta to sngew , ko Jerusalem , ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , Nga ong . Da kaba pham kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga ne sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga , pha la pynmih kham bun ki jingeh ban ïa kito ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong pha , pha la shu bud tynneng ïa ki rukom leh jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
U lyngdoh un ïalam ïa tur u briew lem bad ïa kita ki jingainguh jongngi u ha khmat ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai .
translation.en: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean , and those things , before the  Lord  , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation :

translation.kha: Hato kino tip ba u syiem Balah jong ki Ammon u la phah ïa u Ishmael ban pynïap ïa phi ? Hynrei u Gedalaïah um smam ngeit ïa kata .
translation.en: And said unto him , Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee ? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not .

translation.kha: Ki la jubab , Lydda phi pynphai ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blang ki Israel , phoi dei da pahara ban phah mala ka ïa ka jingai sngewbha sha u ban siew noh na ka bynta ka pop jong phi . Ka Synduk ka jrong kam dei ba-bang leit noh khlem ka jingai sngewbha . Da kumne , yn pynkoit ïa phi bad phira sa sngewthuh balei ba u ïan pyndem ïa phi .
translation.en: And they said , If ye send away the ark of the God of Israel , send it not empty  ; but in any wise return him a trespass offering : then ye shall be healed , and it shall be known to you why his hand is not removed from you .
And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace ;
translation.kha: bad da ka jinglong la kloi ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha ka jingsuk , kum ki juti jong phi .
Hynrei hajan me ai pang ha ki ïa ka jingpyrsad jong me , la thaw ïa ki ; me ai ka jingim bathymmai ïa ka pyrem .
translation.en: Thou sendest forth thy spirit , they are created : and thou renewest the face of the earth .

translation.kha: Mynba u Pharaoh u shah ïa uta u paidbah ba-bang leit noh , U Blei um shym ïalam ïa ki na ka lynti kambah poi shatei sha ka phang Philistia , wat la ka longsyiem kaba jan kad . U Blei u noh , Ngam kwah ba kine ki briew kine kylla dien malade kin leit phai pat sha Ijipt lehbha ki ïohi ba ki hap ban ïaleh thma .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Pharaoh had let the people go , that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines , although that was near  ; for God said , Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war , and they return to Egypt :

translation.kha: U Ussaïah u kurup biang bad tei pat ïa ka Elath hadien ka jingïap u kpa jong u .
translation.en: He built Elath , and restored it to Judah , after that the king slept with his fathers .

translation.kha: Uta u ïabah synshar u la kylli ïa u iphylla , To ïathuh ïa por , shaphang jongno u nongïathuhlypa u kren ïa kane ? Shaphang ïa biar ne shaphang uwei pateng ?
translation.en: And the eunuch answered Philip , and said , I pray thee , of whom speaketh the prophet this ? of himself , or of some other man ?

translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko Trai , to pyndep na ka bynta ka por Baroh ïa ka kylluid jong me ïa nga bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , bad to leh ïa kaei kaba me thmu ban leh .
translation.en: Therefore now ,  Lord  , let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever , and do as thou hast said .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , U Jisu u la ong ïa ki , bad nga ong ïa phi ba uno uno uba iehnoh ïa ka ïing ne ki hynmen ki prie shynrang ne kynthei lane ka kmie lane u kpa lynti ki khun lane ki lyngkhuh na ka bynta jrong nga bad na ka bna ka gospel , un ïohpang kham Palat ha kane ka pateng ba myntan .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said ,  Verily I say unto you , There is no man that hath left house , or brethren , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my sake , and the gospel s ,

translation.kha: La don ruh ka Ain , ka tymmen , ka Ether , bad ka Ashan : saw tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: Ain , Rimmon , and Ether , and Ashan  ; four cities and their villages :

translation.kha: Ngan pynthikna ba ki bhabriew jong per ki Israel kin tip ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong por , bad ngan ym shah shuh ba ïa ka kyrteng jong to yn pynjahburom . Te ki jaitbynriew kin tip ba ma per , U Trai , nga long U Blei U Bakhuid jrong ki Israel .
translation.en: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel  ; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more : and the heathen shall know that I am the  Lord  , the Holy One in Israel .

translation.kha: Wat rah ïa kano kano ka ksiar , ka shoh , lane ka pisa tama ha ki pla jong phi ;
translation.en: Provide neither gold , nor silver , nor brass in your purses ,

translation.kha: U la pyndonkam ïa ka bor synshar baïar jong u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong ha ka jingdon jingkad jong u . U la pynbor ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa borbah kiba shong ha ka ban mane ïa u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong , uba ka jingmynsaw jong u ka la ïohkhiah .
translation.en: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him , and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast , whose deadly wound was healed .

translation.kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah nongsynshar ki la ieh ïa ka Bad ki la ïathuh ha u syiem haduh katno ka la long kaba bhabriew ; kumta te ki la ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïing u shym .
translation.en: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her , and commended her before Pharaoh : and the woman was taken into Pharaoh s house .
They shall have like portions to eat , beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony .
translation.kha: U dei ban ïoh bynta mar katjuh ka jingbam kumba long kiwei pat ki lyngdoh , bad u lah ban buh ïa kano kano kaba ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u ki phah sha u .

translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he shewed them his hands and his feet .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa kane bad u la pyn-i ha ki ïa ki kti jong u bad ïa ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: And the Philistine said , I defy the armies of Israel this day  ; give me a man , that we may fight together .
translation.kha: Hangne mynta nga kob ïa ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel . Nga kob ïa phi ba phin phah da uno uno ban ïaleh bad nga !
Ngi la nang leit da ka lieng na Tyros sha Ptolemais , ha kaba la khublei ïa moi da ki parabangeit bad ngi la sai bad ki shi sngem .
translation.en: And when we had finished our course from Tyre , we came to Ptolemais , and saluted the brethren , and abode with them one day .

translation.kha: U Timon Petros u la jubab ïa u , Ko Trai , sha uno pat ngim leit ? Me don ki ktien kiba ai ïa ka jingtem bymjukut .
translation.en: Then Simon Peter answered him , Lord , to whom shall we go ? thou hast the words of eternal life .

translation.kha: U Aaron u shongkurim ïa ka Elishaphat , ka kynhun jong u Amminadab bad ka para jongno u Nahshon . Ka la kha ïa u Nadab , u Ibbah , u Eleasar , bad u Ithamar .
translation.en: And Aaron took him Elisheba , daughter of Amminadab , sister of Nahshon , to wife  ; and she bare him Nadab , and Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar .

translation.kha: Nangta , pynsleh ïa ki kumba me leh ïa u kpa jong ki , ba ki lah ban shakri ïa nga kumin ki lyngdoh . Da kan ka jingpynsleh , kin ïailong ki lyngdoh shi ther .
translation.en: And thou shalt anoint them , as thou didst anoint their father , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office : for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations .

translation.kha: Nga iohsngew ba u da ban pynjakhlia ktien na ka hebrew hyndai .
translation.en: I heard that he could even translate from Ancient Hebrew .

translation.kha: da ka kti bakhlaiñ jong u , ka ksah ti badonbor jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: With a strong hand , and with a stretched out arm : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Absalom u ïaw ban haduh ba u Dabid ha kaba khatduh u la shah ïa u Amnon bad ïa kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u baroh ban leit bad u Absalom . U Absalom u la pynkhreh ka jingkhawai kaba ïabiang ïa u syiem
translation.en: But Absalom pressed him , that he let Amnon and all the king s sons go with him .
I have waited for thy salvation , O  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , nga ap ïa ka jingpyllait im jong me .

translation.en: For I know the forwardness of your mind , for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia , that Achaia was ready a year ago ; and your zeal hath provoked very many .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba phi mon sngewbha ban ïarap , bad nga la kob sarong ïa phi ha ki briew ha Makedonia .  Ki parabangeit ha Akhaïa  nga la ong ,  ki la kloi ban ïarap naduh ka snem kaba la dep .  Ka jinglong ba la kloi jong phi ka la pynkhih ïa kiba bun na ki .

Katto katne ngut na ki paidbah ki la pyrta ïa kawei khie kadei , kiwei ïa kawei pat . Ka la dat ka jingkulmar kaba haduh kor ba u jingbabe ai hukum um lah ban tip thngan ïa kaei kaba la lah jat , kumta u la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u ban ïalam ïa u Paul sha ka kut shipai .
translation.en: And some cried one thing , some another , among the multitude : and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult , he commanded him to be carried into the castle .

translation.kha: U paidbah u dei ban ñiew ba u lyngdoh u long uba khwai , namar u wallam ïa ki jingainguh bam sha nga . Nga long U Trai ; nga long uba khuid , bun nga pynkyntang khuid ïa ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore  ; for he offereth the bread of thy God : he shall be holy unto thee : for I the  Lord  , which sanctify you , am holy .
Or for a ram , thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil .
translation.kha: Haba la wanrah ïa u langbrot , ar kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad shi litar shiteng ka umphniang Olib dei ban ai kum ka jingainguh bam , lem bad shi litar shiteng ka waiñ .
Haba khap ïa uno uno u khun masi , dawai ïa u Langbrot , lane ïa u khunblang , ioh ïa u bad la ka kmie haduh hynñiew sngi , Hynrei haduh kata haw ban pdiang ïa u kum ka jingainguh bam .
translation.en: When a bullock , or a sheep , or a goat , is brought forth , then it shall be seven days under the dam  ; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
And as for the king of Judah , who sent you to enquire of the  Lord  , so shall ye say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard  ;
translation.kha: Na ka bynta u syiem ïa lade hi , kane ka dei kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga ong : To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab ,
Khenani namar ba ka long ka jingïatainia shaphang ki ktien bad ki kyrteng bad shngain ka law jong phi , phi hi ph de ban ïapynbeit ïa ka . Ngan ym long u nongbishar ïa Kinah kiei ktieh !
translation.en: But if it be a question of words and names , and of your law , look ye to it  ; for I will be no judge of such matters .

translation.kha: Ki kali ïalap ki jingkhuid kynshoit ha ki lyndang bah , da kaba mareh shane shatai lyngba ki jaka paidbah ka nongbah . Ki thaba Kum ki dongmusa bad ki sti koum ka leilieh .
translation.en: The chariots shall rage in the streets , they shall justle one against another in the broad ways : they shall seem like torches , they shall run like the lightnings .

translation.kha: ki la ïapom ïa baroh ki jingthung ha ka ri ; bad ki la ïabam ïa barabor ki jingthang ba longïng jingbam .
translation.en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land , and devoured the fruit of their ground .

translation.kha: Khmih sha ki bneng ; peit ha ka pyrthei ! Ki bneng kin jah noh kum ka tdem ; ka pyrthei kan jot nong kum ki jaiñ ba la rim , bad ki briew jong ka baroh kin ïap kum ki skain . Hynrei ka jingpyllait kaba nga wallam kan neh junom ; ka jingjop jongnga nga kad long kaba kut .
translation.en: Lift up your eyes to the heavens , and look upon the earth beneath : for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke , and the earth shall wax old like a garment , and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner : but my salvation shall be for ever , and my righteousness shall not be abolished .

translation.kha: Kane ka bor kiba trei ha ngi ka long kajuh kum ka jingkhlaiñbor ba u pyndonkam hajuh u la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na uba ïan , bad u la pynïashong ïa u sha ka kti kamon jongki u ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng .
translation.en: Which he wrought in Christ , when he raised him from the dead , and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places ,

And the seventh angel sounded  ; and there were great voices in heaven , saying , The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord , and of his Christ  ; and he shall reign for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynñiew u la put ïa la ka turoi , bad la don ki sur kiba jam ha bneng , kiba ong ,  Ka bor ban synshar halor ka pyrthei ka long mynta ka jong U Trai jong ngi bad jong U Messaïah jong u , bad un synshar junom la junom !
Haba u Jephthah u wan phai shai la ïing ha Mispah , ka khun jong u ka wan ban ïakynduh ïa u , ka da shad bad tem ïa ka ksing . Ka dei ka khulom marwei jong u .
translation.en: And Jephthah came to Mizpah unto his house , and , behold , his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances : and she was his only child  ; beside her he had neither son nor daughter .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Kino longïing shuh kba kham nep jingmut ban ïa kiwei pat .
translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Are ye also yet without understanding ?

translation.kha: Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha kito ïa kiba me la ai ha nga na ka pyrthei . Ki la long ki Jong me , bad me la ai ïa ki ha na .
translation.en: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world : thine they were , and thou gavest them me  ; and they have kept thy word .

translation.kha: Wat lytar ban pang jingmut na ki briew kiba wad jingtip na ki mynsaw jongngi ki briew kiba la ïarap . Lada pa’ leh kumta , yn ñiew ïa phi ki bymkhuid . ?(Nga longsem U Terah U Blei jongu phi .
translation.en: Regard not them that have familiar spirits , neither seek after wizards , to be defiled by them : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Bad shano shano ba U Jisu u loit , sha ki nongrit , ki shnong , ki lyngkha , ki paidbah ki rah ïa kito Kiba pang sha ki jaka ïew bad kyrpad ïa u ban shah ïa ki la kumno kumno ban ktah ïa ka rmiang jaiñkup jong u ; bad baroh kiba ktah ïa ka , ki ïohthiah .
translation.en: And whithersoever he entered , into villages , or cities , or country , they laid the sick in the streets , and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment : and as many as touched him were made whole .
But God , who is rich in mercy , for his great love wherewith he loved us ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingisynei U Blei ka shlei katta katta , bad ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi ka long kaba khraw katta katta ,
Ka bhor U balui ka la phet na Israel , ka ong , namar ba la knieh noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei .
translation.en: And she said , The glory is departed from Israel : for the ark of God is taken .
And I stayed in the mount , according to the first time , forty days and forty nights  ; and the  Lord  hearkened unto me at that time also , and the  Lord  would not destroy thee .
translation.kha: Nga la sah ha uta u lum sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , kumba nga la leh ha ka sien kaba nyngkong . U  Trai  u la shahshkor ïa nga sa shisien bad um mon ban pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof , he said , It is the man of God , who was disobedient unto the word of the  Lord  : therefore the  Lord  hath delivered him unto the lion , which hath torn him , and slain him , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake unto him .
translation.kha: Haba uta u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u ïohsngew ïa kata , u ong ,  Utai u dei u nongïathuhlypa uba la lyndet ïa ka hukum U  Trai . Bad kumta U  Trai  u phah ïa u sing uba la patar bad pynïap ïa u , kumba U  Trai  u la kren ha u .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto Moses , Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh : for with a strong hand shall he let them go , and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Mynta men sa ïohi aïu ngan leh ïa u Pharaoh . Ngan pynbor ïa u ban shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban leit . Ha ka jingshisha , ngan pynbor ïa u ban beh noh ïa ki na ka ri jong u .

Phi long kiba la tim . Phi thied bun tylli ki ïing dara ki lynghoh ban bynrap Shuh shuh ïa kito kiba phi la ba-don lypa . Shen yn ym don jaka ïaineh ïano pat ban shong baneh sah bad tang ma phi hi phin shong ha ka ri .
translation.en: Woe unto them that join house to house , that lay field to field , till there be no place , that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth !

translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nonglamktien bun u pynjam ha ki ïa ka spah ka phew jong u — ka reng bad ka ksiar jngai u , ki musli Musri bad ki jingiwbih jong u , bad baroh’ ki tiar thma ki jong u . Ym ne shuh kano ïano kaba don ha ki jaka buh tiar jongki u lane hangno hangno ha ka hima jong u kaba um shym la pyni ha ki .
translation.en: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them , and shewed them all the house of his precious things , the silver , and the gold , and the spices , and the precious ointment , and all the house of his armour , and all that was found in his treasures : there was nothing in his house , nor in all his dominion , that Hezekiah shewed them not .

Then shalt thou delight thyself in the  Lord   ; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth , and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father : for the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: te phin shem ka jingkmen kaba wan na kaba shakri ïa nga . Ngan pynlong ïa phi ban ïoh burom ha kylleng ka pyrthei . Bad phin lehkmen ha ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha u kpa tymmen jong phi , u Jakob . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Uba nyngkong u long uba saw doh , bad ka sniehdoh jong u ka long khem ka jaiñkup shñiuh ; kumta la khot ktang ïa u , u Iso .
translation.en: And the first came out red , all over like an hairy garment  ; and they called his name Esau .

And from Jesus Christ , who is the faithful witness , and the first begotten of the dead , and the prince of the kings of the earth . Unto him that loved us , and washed us from our sins in his own blood ,
translation.kha: bad na U Jisu Khrist , u sakhi baïaineh , uba nyngkong ïa uba la pynmih na ka jingïap bad uba long ruh u nongsynshar jong ki syiem jong ka pyrthei . U ieit ïa ngi , bad da ka jingïap ba aiti lut jong u , u la pyllait ïa ngi na ki pop
Kumta sumar ban kohnguh bad leh ïa Kiei kamai baroh kaba la thoh ha ka kitab ka Aiñ u Moses .
translation.en: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses , that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left  ;
And when ye did eat , and when ye did drink , did not ye eat for yourselves , and drink for yourselves ?
translation.kha: Bad haba ki la bam bad dih , ka long na ka bynta ka jingpynhun ïa ki hi .
Ha kata ka por ki synran ki la ïan sha U Jisu , da kaba kylli , Ïai wahbah khraw tam ha ka Hima ki bneng ?
translation.en: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus , saying , Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven ?
Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter , and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood : so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife .
translation.kha: Lada phi king kynruh ïa ka dud , ka pynmih makhon . Lada phi tied ïa ka khmut jongno jongno , ka pynmih snam . Lada phi pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar , phi ngat ha ka jingjynjar .
Ka jingshai kaba mynsngi ka pynphong ïa ki lum bad ki tai ïa-ban ïeng kum ki jingkhylliap jongnga ka jaiñ , kaba shai kum ka dak jong ka shab ha ka riewbieit .
translation.en: It is turned as clay to the seal  ; and they stand as a garment .

translation.kha: Thaw arphew tylli ki jingker ïa ka Hul kaba shaphang shathie ,
translation.en: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle , twenty boards on the south side southward .

translation.kha: Shibun u symbai phin beit ha lyngkha , hynrei tangba jingkyndit patan phna ïoh ot , namar ki puit kin bam ïa ki jingthung jongno phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field , and shalt gather but little in  ; for the locust shall consume it .

translation.kha: Ngan thung ïa ki nongsynshar ki ban samla ïa ki . Ki briew jong ang kin ym sheptieng ne sngewshyrkhei , bad ngan ym pynshitom shuh ïa ki . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la krai .
translation.en: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them : and they shall fear no more , nor be dismayed , neither shall they be lacking , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi ; nga pynphaloh ïa ka duriaw bad nga pyntong ïa ki jingat phyllung ban kyrhuh . Ka kyrteng jong nga ka long U Trai Badonbor Baroh !
translation.en: But I am the  Lord  thy God , that divided the sea , whose waves roared : The  Lord  of hosts is his name .

translation.kha: Kumta ka jubab jong ki ïa U Jisu ka la longsyiem , Ngim tip . U Jisu u la ong ïa ki , Nga shwa Ngan ym ïathuh ïa phi te , da kaei ka hok ba nga leh ïa Kinah kiei kiei .
translation.en: And they answered and said unto Jesus , We cannot tell . And Jesus answering saith unto them ,  Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things .

translation.kha: Yn ym don ki maw na ki jingjot jngai pha ba yn pyndem patan na ka boitha ki jingtei . Phan long kum ka ri shyiap jrong . Ma nga , U Trai , ang la kren .
translation.en: And they shall not take of thee a stone for a corner , nor a stone for foundations  ; but thou shalt be desolate for ever , saith the  Lord .
Thus saith the Lord  God   ; An evil , an only evil , behold , is come .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Kawei ka jingjynjar hadien kawei pat kan wan ha pha .

translation.en: And the king took off his ring , which he had taken from Haman , and gave it unto Mordecai . And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman .
translation.kha: U syiem u la loit noh ïa ka sati ba don muhor ha ka ( kaba u la shim noh na u Haman ) bad u ai ha u Mordekai . Ka Esther ka buh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u Haman ha ka jingpeit u Mordekai .
Bad mynta , balei me pyntud ? To ïeng jwat bad shah ba yn pynbaptis ïa me sad sait napoh ïa ki pop jrong me da kaba duwai sha u .’
translation.en: And now why tarriest thou ? arise , and be baptized , and wash away thy sins , calling on the name of the Lord .

translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew , pynlang ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng ; ïa ki Philistia la kynrup da ka jingsngewtriem .
translation.en: The people shall hear , and be afraid : sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Philistia .
Yea , they despised the pleasant land , they believed not his word :
translation.kha: Nangta ki la kyntait ïa ka ri kaba itynnat , namar ba kim ngeit ïa ka jingkular U Blei .
U Blei u pynlong ka khor bad ki briew lyndang ka jingngeit jong ki ha U Jisu Khrist . U Blei u kuna ïa kane ïa baroh kiba ngeit ha U Khrist , namar ym don saitlah kano kano ka jingïapher :
translation.en: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe : for there is no difference :

translation.kha: U la ai ïa ki ri jong ki ha ki briew jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymkhuid ;
translation.en: And gave their land for an heritage : for his mercy endureth for ever :
For he will not lay upon man more than right  ; that he should enter into judgment with God .
translation.kha: Ym da donkam ba U Blei un buh por ïa ki briew ban leit bad ba yn bishar ïa ki da u .

translation.en: They shall lie down alike in the dust , and the worms shall cover them .
translation.kha: Hynrei baroh kumjuh ki ïap bad la tep ïa ki ; ïa ki baroh la tap da ki kruiñ .
Me don u ksuid hapoh jong me ! u paidbah u la jubab . Mano ba pyrshang shun pynïap ïa me ?
translation.en: The people answered and said , Thou hast a devil : who goeth about to kill thee ?
And I will camp against thee round about , and will lay siege against thee with a mount , and I will raise forts against thee .
translation.kha: U Blei un tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , un don sawdong jong ka bad un kerkut ïa ka .

Ho-oid na la ïohi ïa ki riewbymman ba la tep bad hapoh ki jingtep Jong ki , hynrei ha ka lynti leit phai na lum jingtep ki briew ki ïaroh ïa ki ha kata ka nongbah ha Kaba ki la leh ïa ki kam sniew Jong ki . Ka long ka me ne jingmut .
translation.en: And so I saw the wicked buried , who had come and gone from the place of the holy , and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done : this is also vanity .
I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance : but he that cometh after me is mightier than I , whose shoes I am not worthy to bear : he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost , and with fire :
translation.kha: Nga pynbaptis ïa phi da ka um ban pyn-i ba phi la kylla-kaba-mut , hynrei uta uba wan hadien jong nga un pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka ding . U long uba kham khraw ban ïa nga ; bad ngam long uba bit wat tang ban rah ïa ki juti jong u .
Nangta ka Ruth ka ong , Kaba kor tam na baroh , u ong ba tun ïaid Tam kew bad ki nongtrei jong u haduh ba kin da pyndep ïa ka jingot .
translation.en: And Ruth the Moabitess said , He said unto me also , Thou shalt keep fast by my young men , until they have ended all my harvest .
And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine , and cups , and I said unto them , Drink ye wine .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la buh ïa ki khuri bad ki pliang ba la dap waiñ ha khmat ki Rekhab , bad nga ong ïa ki ,  To dih waiñ khyndiat .
Ka jingphla ka Long kane : U Blei u la ai ha ngi ïa ka jingim bymjukut , bad kane ka jingim ka don ka tyllong jong ka ha U Khun jong u .
translation.en: And this is the record , that God hath given to us eternal life , and this life is in his Son .

From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh , and even unto Jahaz , have they uttered their voice , from Zoar even unto Horonaim , as an heifer of three years old : for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Heshbon bad ka Elealeh ki kyang , bad ïa ka jingkyang jong ki lah ban ïohsngew shaduh sha Jahas ; lah ban ïohsngew da ki briew ha Soar , bad la ïohsngew shaduh sha Horonaim bad sha Eglath Shelishiyah . Wat ka wahduid Nimrim ka la rngad noh .
Phin long kum u briew ba la thoh ha ka proberb , uba pyrshang ban taïew ha ka jingthiah kaba lyngkot palat bym lah ban jyrtieng , bad ka napoh kaba raïot pait ka bym lah ban tap ïa u .
translation.en: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it : and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it .
He will surely reprove you , if ye do secretly accept persons .
translation.kha: Wat la ïa ka jingnoh shiliang la buhrieh , un pynrem ïa me ,

translation.en: Because ye have burned incense , and because ye have sinned against the  Lord  , and have not obeyed the voice of the  Lord  , nor walked in his law , nor in his statutes , nor in his testimonies  ; therefore this evil is happened unto you , as at this day .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingjot mynta ka la wan ha phi namar ba phi ai jingkñia sha kiwei ki blei bad leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da ka jingbymkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh .
ïa ka duwan ksiar , ïa ka umphniang pynsleh , ïa ka jingiwbih , ïa ka pyrem ïa ka jaka rung sha ka jingïaineh ;
translation.en: And the golden altar , and the anointing oil , and the sweet incense , and the hanging for the tabernacle door ,

translation.kha: U Phestos u la jubab , Ïa u Paul la set kum u koidi ha Kaisaria , bad nga hi ngan sa ithuh pat sheng shata .
translation.en: But Festus answered , that Paul should be kept at Caesarea , and that he himself would depart shortly thither .

translation.kha: (Nga longsyiem U Trai ; ym don uwei pat U Blang , ngan ai ïa me ka jingkhyllong ba me donkam , wat la mem shym la tiduh ïa nga .
translation.en: I am the  Lord  , and there is none else , there is no God beside me : I girded thee , though thou hast not known me :

And I will sow her unto me in the earth  ; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy  ; and I will say to them which were not my people , Thou art my people  ; and they shall say , Thou art my God .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong skhem ïa ki briew jong nga ha ka ri bad ngan pynmanbha ïa ki . Ngan pyn-i jingieit ïa kito kiba la ju khot  Lo-Ruhamah ,  bad ïa kito kiba la ju khot  Lo-ammi  ngan sa ong ,  Phi long ki briew jong nga ,  bad kin jubab ,  Me long U Blei jong ngi .

Sngewbha map ïa nga , ko kynrad , na ka bynta kano kano ka jingbakla kaba nga la leh . U Trai un pynong ïa phi u syiem , malade ïa ki khun ki ksuid jong phi mad , nia phi ïaleh ïa ki thnam jong u ; bad phin ym leh kano kano kaba sniew katba phi dang im .
translation.en: I pray thee , forgive the trespass of thine handmaid : for the  Lord  will certainly make my lord a sure house  ; because my lord fighteth the battles of the  Lord  , and evil hath not been found in thee all thy days .
When Jesus therefore saw his mother , and the disciple standing by , whom he loved , he saith unto his mother ,  Woman , behold thy son !
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa la ka kmie bad ïa u synran ïa uba u ieit ba ki ïa-ïeng hangta ; te u la ong ha la ka kmie ,  Une u long u khun jong phi .
U shwa ïa kita ki jingbah da ka dieng akasia mala u suit ïa ki da ka ksiew .
translation.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold , to bear the table .

translation.kha: Ai ngan jop . Hynrei lada mem lah jop , ai ngan long shlur ha ka jingpyrshang .
translation.en: Let me win . But if I cannot win , let me be brave in the attempt .
I will shew thee , hear me  ; and that which I have seen I will declare  ;
translation.kha: Mynta to shahshkor , ko Job , ïa kaei kaba nga tip ngan ïathuh .
U mane ïa ka Astarte ka blei ki syndon , bad ïa u Molekh u blei ba-ijli jong ki Ammon .
translation.en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites .

translation.kha: Haneng hangno ha kaba don ka metïap , ki pukni kin ïalumlang .
translation.en: For wheresoever the carcase is , there will the eagles be gathered together .

But the man that shall be unclean , and shall not purify himself , that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation , because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the  Lord  : the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him  ; he is unclean .
translation.kha: Kito kiba long bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam bad ki bym pynkhuid ïa lade ki ïailong ki bymkhuid , namar ba ym shym la synreit ïa ka um ka jingpynkhuid halor jong ki . Ki pyntngit ïa ka Ïingjaiñ U  Trai  bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa ki kum ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead , how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead ?
translation.kha: Mynta , namar ka khubor jong ngi ka long ba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , kumno ba katto katne ngut na phi ki ong ba yn ym don ka jingmihpat na ka jingïap ?
Ha ka sngi ba nga pynshitom ïa ki Edom , ngan pynduh noh ïa ki rangbah basian buit jongnga ki Bad pynjah noh ïa ka jingstad jong ki baroh .
translation.en: Shall I not in that day , saith the  Lord  , even destroy the wise men out of Edom , and understanding out of the mount of Esau ?

translation.kha: uno du uba ïalap , u dei baneh ïalap ïa ki khubor jrong U Balei ; uno uno uba shakri , u dei ban shakuriaw da ka bor kaba U balui u ai ïa u , khnang ba ha kiei kiei borbah yn ai ïa ka jingïaroh sha U blem da U Jisu Kiriath , ha uba ka burom bad ka bor ki long ki lad u junom la junom , Amen .
translation.en: If any man speak , let him speak as the oracles of God  ; if any man minister , let him do it as of the ability which God giveth : that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ , to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .

translation.kha: Neng ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Haba me dang samla , me ju long uba la pynkhreh dara me leit kat shaba me mon ; hynrei haba me la tymmen , men kner la ki jong ki kti bad wai pat un teh un khum ïa me nabar un ïalang ïa me sha kaba mem kwah ban leit .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto thee , When thou wast young , thou girdedst thyself , and walkedst whither thou wouldest : but when thou shalt be old , thou shalt stretch forth thy hands , and another shall gird thee , and carry thee whither thou wouldest not .

translation.kha: U lyngngoh un khmih biang ïa u ha ka sngi kiba hynñiew , bad lada ha ka jingshem jong u ba sakma ka prum ka lama kumjuh bad kam shym pur , un pynkyrpang ïa u sa hynñiew sngap .
translation.en: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day : and , behold , if the plague in his sight be at a stay , and the plague spread not in the skin  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more :

translation.kha: Ka jaka shong u Dabid ka thylli , hynrei u Saul um shym ong ei ei ha kata ka sngi , namar u pyrkhat , Kaei re kamai ka la khia ïa u , bad um shym long uba bit kat kum ka jingshim .
translation.en: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day : for he thought , Something hath befallen him , he is not clean  ; surely he is not clean .

translation.kha: U la khoit lang ïa ki synran jong u baroh bad u la ong ïa ki , ?(Nga ong ïa phi ba kane ka riewkynthei kaba duk , ka la pynnoh kham bun ha ka synduk jingainguh ban ïa baroh kiwei pat .
translation.en: And he called unto him his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That this poor widow hath cast more in , than all they which have cast into the treasury :

translation.kha: ba U Trai badonburom Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la lah ong : Nga la pynkheiñ ïa ka ba jong u syiem ka Babilonia .
translation.en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saying , I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon .
David said furthermore , As the  Lord  liveth , the  Lord  shall smite him  ; or his day shall come to die  ; or he shall descend into battle , and perish .
translation.kha: Da U  Trai  uba im ,  u Dabid u bteng biang ,  nga tip ba U  Trai  hi un shoh ïap ïa u , lane un ïap hi ynda poi ka por ba un ïap , lane haba un ïap ha ka thma .

translation.en: Ephraim shall say , What have I to do any more with idols ? I have heard him , and observed him : I am like a green fir tree . From me is thy fruit found .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel kim don bynta ei ei shuh bad ki bleithaw ; ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki bad sumar ïa ki ; kum u dieng ba ïai jyrngam ngan kah tngen ïa ki ; nga long u tynrai jong ki jingkyrkhu jong ki baroh .
Khynñiuh u la pynim ïa ki , kumba u la kular , khnang ban pyn-i ïa ka bor bakhraw jong u .
translation.en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name s sake , that he might make his mighty power to be known .

translation.kha: U shim ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar baroh ibha u lah don ïoh , ki tiar ka templ baroh bad ki jingkynmaw baroh jong ka ïingsyiem , bad u rah biang ïa ki shai Samaria . U rai ruh ïa ki koidi bad u .
translation.en: And he took all the gold and silver , and all the vessels that were found in the house of the  Lord  , and in the treasures of the king s house , and hostages , and returned to Samaria .

translation.kha: U kyntiew ïa kiba duk na ka dewmet , bad u rah ïa kiba khyrdong na ka jingjngem jong ki . U pynlong ïa ki , ki paralok jong ki khun syiem , bun buh ïa ki , ha ki jaka badonburom . Ki nongrim jongno ka khyndew ki dei ki jong U Trai’ ; bad ha ki u la pynshongduh ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust , and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill , to set them among princes , and to make them inherit the throne of glory : for the pillars of the earth are the  Lord s  , and he hath set the world upon them .

translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynriew u la put ïa la ka turoi . Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka ar kaba wan na ki saw tylli ki deng jong ka duwan ksiar kob ïeng ha khmat U Blei .
translation.en: And the sixth angel sounded , and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God ,
And if thy right eye offend thee , pluck it out , and cast it from thee : for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish , and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell .
translation.kha: Kumta lada ka khmat kamon jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban leh pop , khlaw noh ïa ka bad bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban duh noh shi bynta na ka met jong phi ban ïa kaba ka met jong phi baroh kawei yn shah bret sha ka dujok .
Hynrei nga la jong , ‘ Da lei lei shwa em , ko Trei ! Ym don kano nangno ka jingbam ka bymkhuid kat Kum ka jingleh lane kaba sing kaba la ju rung ha ka shyntur jong nga .’
translation.en: But I said , Not so , Lord : for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth .
And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family , which remain in all the places whither I have driven them , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Bad ki briew jong kane ka jaitbynriew basniew kiba dang im , kiba shong ha ki jaka kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , kin jied ban ïap ban ïa kaba ki ïai im . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Their bull gendereth , and faileth not  ; their cow calveth , and casteth not her calf .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , baroh ki jingri jong ki , ki pun bad ki kha khlem don ka jingeh .
Lada ka i long kaba myntoi ïa ang ban leit , te ki lah ban ïaleit ryngkat bad nga .
translation.en: And if it be meet that I go also , they shall go with me .
He had also seven sons and three daughters .
translation.kha: U la long u kpa jong ki hynñiew ngut ki khun shynrang bad ki lai ngut ki khun kynthei .
Kumta Uno uno ïa uba la pynïasoh ha U Khrist u long u jingthaw kiba thymmai ; kaban rim ka la leit noh , kaba thma ka la wan .
translation.en: Therefore if any man be in Christ , he is a new creature : old things are passed away ; behold , all things are become new .

translation.en: Saying ,  The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses  seat :
To him who alone doeth great wonders : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Tang ma u hi u leh ïa ki kambah bakhraw ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
Wat ka kmie jong u kam kynmaw shu ïa u mynta ; la bam ïa u da ki ksaiñ bad la pynpait kumta ïa u dieng ba la khyllem .
translation.en: The womb shall forget him  ; the worm shall feed sweetly on him  ; he shall be no more remembered  ; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree .
For they served idols , whereof the  Lord  had said unto them , Ye shall not do this thing .
translation.kha: bad kim kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  ban ym mane ïa ki bleithaw .

translation.en: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate , and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly .
translation.kha: Phi ki briew phi isih ïa uta uba pyrshah ïa ka jingbymhok bad kren ïa ka jingshisha baroh ha ka ïingbishar .

translation.en: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel , and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats .
translation.kha: U Saul u ïalam lai hajar ngut ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel bad u la leit wad ïa u Dabid bad ïa ki rangbah jong u ha ka phang mihngi jong ki Mawsiang ki Blang Khlaw .

translation.en: And when the sabbath day was come , he began to teach in the synagogue : and many hearing him were astonished , saying , From whence hath this man these things ? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him , that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton u la sdang ban hikai ha ka synagog . Bun ki briew ki la don hangta ; bad haba ki la ïohsngew ïa u , baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh .  Nangno u la ïoh ïa kane baroh ?  ki la kylli .  Ka jingstad aïu kane ba la ai ha u ? Kumno u leh ïa ki kambah ?

translation.en: They did cry there , Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise  ; he hath passed the time appointed .
translation.kha: To ai da ka kyrteng bathymmai ïa u syiem ka Ijipt — ‘ U riew kob-pia uba la duh ei ïa la ka kabu’ .

translation.en: And Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the eventide : and he lifted up his eyes , and saw , and , behold , the camels were coming .
translation.kha: U la mih shabar ha ka por janmiet ban ïaid kai pyngngad ha ki pyntha bad u ïohi ïa ki ut ba ki dang wan .
Slem bah ki Israel ki la im khlem U Blei umbah shisha , khlup ki lyngdoh ban hikai ïa ki , bad Khlem ka hukum .
translation.en: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God , and without a teaching priest , and without law .

translation.kha: Hynriew ïa ka doh jong uta u masi lyngraw , ïa ka snieh jong u , bad ïa ki nierlang jong u , dei ban thang ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara . Kane ka long ka jingainguh ban siat ïa ki pop jongnga ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: But the flesh of the bullock , and his skin , and his dung , shalt thou burn with fire without the camp : it is a sin offering .

translation.kha: Ïa u Adam kiba sneng , la tiduh na ka dewmet , ba la wei na ka khyndew ; u Amon uba ar u la wiang na bneng .
translation.en: The first man is of the earth , earthy : the second man is the Lord from heaven .
It is of the  Lord s  mercies that we are not consumed , because his compassions fail not .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit baneh bad ka jingisynei jong U  Trai  ka ïaineh ,
Ko Ninebeh , hato pha kham bhah shun ïa ka Thebes , ka nongbah jong ka Ijipt ? Ma ka ruh ka la to ka wah ban ïada ïa ka kum ka kynroh — Ka woh Nile ka la long kum ka jingker jong ka .
translation.en: Art thou better than populous No , that was situate among the rivers , that had the waters round about it , whose rampart was the sea , and her wall was from the sea ?

translation.kha: Ki saw tukri ki jingshah ja-um ki la jubab , Amen ! Bad ki nongsharai balang ki la dem khrup bad ki la mane .
translation.en: And the four beasts said , Amen . And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever .

And the bullock for the sin offering , and the goat for the sin offering , whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place , shall one carry forth without the camp  ; and they shall burn in the fire their skins , and their flesh , and their dung .
translation.kha: Ïa uta u masi lyngraw bad ïa uta  langsohmoh ïa kiba la kñia kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ïa kiba ka snam jong ki la leit rah sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam ban weng noh ïa ka pop , dei ban leit rah shabar ka jaka shong dara bad thang ïa ki hangta . Ïa ka snieh , ka doh , bad ki snier jong ki ruh dei ban thang lang hangta .

translation.en: And when he came to Samaria , he slew all that remained unto Ahab in Samaria , till he had destroyed him , according to the saying of the  Lord  , which he spake to Elijah .
translation.kha: Haba ki poi hangta , u Jehu u pynïap lut ïa baroh ki kur ki jait jong u Ahab khlem pynsah wat uwei ruh . Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha u Elijah ba kan jia .
Kam pher sha kano ka liang u dieng u khyllem , un don ha ka jaka kaba u la kyllon . Habor ki lyoh ki thap , ka slap .
translation.en: If the clouds be full of rain , they empty themselves upon the earth : and if the tree fall toward the south , or toward the north , in the place where the tree falleth , there it shall be .

translation.kha: U Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : U Mahli bad u Mushi . Kine ki long ki jait jong ki Lebi Lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .
translation.en: And the sons of Merari  ; Mahli and Mushi : these are the families of Levi according to their generations .
While he was yet speaking , there came also another , and said , Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un kut ka jingkren , sa uwei pat u shakri u la wan bad u ong ,  Ki khun jong phi ki dang ïakhawai ha ïing u khun shynrang baheh duh jong phi , haba ka  erïong na ri shyiap ka wan beh shapoh .
Nangta nga la shuh ïa ki khuri bad ki pliang ba la dap wiang ha khmat ki Rekhab , bad to ong ïa ki , To dih wei kyndiang .
translation.en: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine , and cups , and I said unto them , Drink ye wine .
And in this place again , If they shall enter into my rest .
translation.kha: Ïa kane kajuh ka bynta la kren biang ,  Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei sha kata ka ri ha kaba ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingjahthait .
U mynsiem bymman u tur ïabeh ïa u da ka jingpynjynjar kynsan bad bret ïa u ha ka jingkhie ring , ba kumta u sei tyrso ha ka shyntur ; u ïatei pynshitom ïa u malu da kaba eh un pyllait ïa u !
translation.en: And , lo , a spirit taketh him , and he suddenly crieth out  ; and it teareth him that he foameth again , and bruising him hardly departeth from him .
And after that they durst not ask him any question at all .
translation.kha: Naba kim nud shuh ban kylli ïa u kano kano ka jingkylli .

translation.en: And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls : for Joseph was in Egypt already .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew kiba hiarpateng beit na u Jakob ki long baroh hynñiewphew ngut .    U khun jong u , u Joseph u la don lypa ha Ijipt .

translation.en: Then shall ye know that I am the  Lord  , when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars , upon every high hill , in all the tops of the mountains , and under every green tree , and under every thick oak , the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols .
translation.kha: Ïa ki metïap yn pynsaphriang hapdeng ki bleithaw bad sawdong ki duwan , yn pynsaphriang halor uwei pa uwei u lum uba jrong , ha kliar uwei pa uwei u lumbah , ha trai uwei pa uwei u dieng jyrngam bad uwei pa uwei u dieng Sning uba heh , ha ki jaka baroh ba ki thang ïa ki jingkñia ïa ki bleithaw jong ki .
Lada phi thmu sniew borabor , phin sa ïoh nam kumin u nongthaw kulmar .
translation.en: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person .

translation.kha: Kumta ym u Jehoïakhin lymne uno uno na ki rangbah shipai lymne kino kino na ki paidbah kin kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Trai ban ïaisah ha ka ri Judah .
translation.en: So Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces , and all the people , obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  , to dwell in the land of Judah .
Cursed be their anger , for it was fierce  ; and their wrath , for it was cruel : I will divide them in Jacob , and scatter them in Israel .
translation.kha: Long ba la tim ïa ka jingbitar jong ki , Naba ka long kaba ishyrkhei ; Bad long ba la tim ïa ka jingbitar shla jong ki , Naba ka long kaba shyrkhei katta katta . Kylleng ka ri Israel ngan pynsakma ïa ki , Bad hapdeng ki briew jong ka ngan pynsakma ïa ki .

translation.en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth : the strength of the hills is his also .
translation.kha: U synshar halor ka pyrthei baroh , na ki krem kiba jylliew tam sha kliar ki lum bajrong tam .

translation.en: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance : the  Lord  God of Israel was their inheritance , as he said unto them .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses um shym la ai kano kano ka jaka ha ka jait Lebi . U ong ïa ki ba ka jingïohkynti jong ki ka dei ka bhah jong ki jingainguh sha U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  What wilt thou that I should do unto thee ?  The blind man said unto him , Lord , that I might receive my sight .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba me kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong me ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa u .  Ko Nonghikai ,  uta u briew uba matlah u la jubab ,  Nga kwah ban ïoh imat biang .

Ki briew ka Judah pynlang ki briew ka Israel kin ïasoh lang kawei sa saihon . Kin sa jied tang uwei u nongïalam na ka bynta jong ki , bad sa shisien pat kyang sa Manla bad roi kyrhai ha la ka ri . Ho-oid , ka sngur jong ka Jesreel kan long ka sngi kaba khraw !
translation.en: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together , and appoint themselves one head , and they shall come up out of the land : for great shall be the day of Jezreel .
Moab is spoiled , and gone up out of her cities , and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab bad ïa ki nongbah jong ka la pynjot , ïa ki samla shynrang bakynsai tam la pynïap . Nga long u syiem , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , bad nga la kren .
U ong ha ka , Khie saw phai pat sha la ka kynrad , bad erlangthari ka mraw jong ka .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , Return to thy mistress , and submit thyself under her hands .

And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Lo , I come unto thee in a thick cloud , that the people may hear when I speak with thee , and believe thee for ever . And Moses told the words of the people unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan wan ha me ha u lyoh uba rben , khnang ba u paidbah un ïohsngew ïa nga ba nga ïakren bad me , bad un sa ngeit ïa me naduh mynta .  U Moses u la ïathuh ha U  Trai  ïa ka jubab jong uta u paidbah ,
Ka kynhun shipawa jong u Dabid ka la leit shwa rudnong bad ïaleh ïa ki Israel ha ka khlaw Ephraim .
translation.en: So the people went out into the field against Israel : and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim  ;
And the  Lord  our God delivered him before us  ; and we smote him , and his sons , and all his people .
translation.kha: hynrei U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la aiti ïa u ha ngi , bad ngi la pynïap ïa u , ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ïa ki briew jong u baroh .

Me dei ban shim kat katne na ka snam jong u bad ban buh ïa ka ha ki reng ha ki synsar thylli ki dong kiba halor ha ka duwan , bad ha ki dong jrong ka bynta ba hap jong ka iba , bad ha baïar sawdong jong ki tduh . Ha kano ka rukom men pynpyngngad ïa ka duwan bad pynkieng ïa ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof , and put it on the four horns of it , and on the four corners of the settle , and upon the border round about : thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it .

translation.kha: Ki khrai ïa ka khlieh u Sarah , ki lalot noh ïa ki atiar jong u , malade ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien kadlieng ka ri Phrygia ban pynbna ïa kata ka khubor babha shuh ki blei jong ki bad ha ki briew jong ki .
translation.en: And they cut off his head , and stripped off his armour , and sent into the land of the Philistines round about , to publish it in the house of their idols , and among the people .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Judas u nong Galilaïa u la mih ha ka por jong ka jingkheiñbriew ; u la khring ïa u paidbah ban bud ïa u , hynrei ïa u shiah la pynkup , bad ïa baroh ki nongbud jong u la pynsngewrem .
translation.en: After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing , and drew away much people after him : he also perished  ; and all , even as many as obeyed him , were dispersed .
Or when saw we thee sick , or in prison , and came unto thee ?
translation.kha: Mynno ngi la ju ïohi ïa me ba me pang lane ba me don ha ka ïingbyndi , bad ba ngi wan jngoh ïa me ?’

translation.en: And saith unto him ,  See thou say nothing to any man : but go thy way , shew thyself to the priest , and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .
translation.kha: hadien u la ong ïa u ,  Sngap , wat ïathuh hano hano ruh shaphang kane . Hynrei leit beit sha u lyngdoh bad ai ba un khmih ïa me ; te khnang ban pynshisha ha baroh ba me la ïohkhiah , sa ai ka jingkñia kaba u Moses u la hukum .

Namar ba ki kyntait ïa ka Khubor Babbai , ki Jiw ki longsyiem ki nongshun jongnga U Blei na ka bynta Jong phi ki Jentil . Hynrei namar ka jingjied U blem , ki long ki paro jong u namar ki kpa thom jong ki .
translation.en: As concerning the gospel , they are enemies for your sakes : but as touching the election , they are beloved for the fathers  sakes .

translation.kha: U TRAI’ Nongsynshar u ino , Bad mynta , ma phi ki Israel baroh , to pynsngewbha ïa lade ! To kai sad to shakri ïa ki bleithaw jong phi ! Hynrei nga maham ïa phi ba hadien kane , phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga bad sangeh ban pynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong na da kaba ai ki jingai sngewkwah ha ki bleithaw jong pa’ .
translation.en: As for you , O house of Israel , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Go ye , serve ye every one his idols , and hereafter also , if ye will not hearken unto me : but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts , and with your idols .

translation.kha: shemphang ka jait Arah u ong , U Nasareth u long uba la ïoh kyrhai ki jingkyrkhu da ka jingsngewbha U Trai ; Ka ri jongu ki shaphang shathie ka kot haduh duriaw Galilaïa .
translation.en: And of Naphtali he said , O Naphtali , satisfied with favour , and full with the blessing of the  Lord  : possess thou the west and the south .

translation.kha: Lada u kynran jong u , u pynïoh ïa u ka tnat , bad ka ïoh khum shynrang ne kynthei na u , kata ka briew bad ki khup jong ka kin long ki lad u kyndeh jong ka , bad uta u brai un mihnoh tieng marwei .
translation.en: If his master have given him a wife , and she have born him sons or daughters  ; the wife and her children shall be her master s , and he shall go out by himself .
And he arose , and departed to his house .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïeng joit bad u la leit sha ïing .
Hangta ka pyrta , Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan ! U khie joit bad u pyrkhat , Ngan pynsynjor nabar pyllait jingsawa , kamar mawshun . Um shym tip ba U Trai u la iehnoh ïa u .
translation.en: And she said , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he awoke out of his sleep , and said , I will go out as at other times before , and shake myself . And he wist not that the  Lord  was departed from him .

translation.kha: Hynrei , da kaba kylla longïing ka jingtim na ka byndi jong ngi , U Khrist u la siewspah ïa ngi na ka jingtim kaba ka Hukum ka wanrah ; naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Uno du uba la shah sdien ha u dieng un ba-don hapoh ka jingtim U Bel .
translation.en: Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law , being made a curse for us : for it is written , Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree :
And the children of Dan went their way : and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him , he turned and went back unto his house .
translation.kha: Nangta ki leit sha khmat . U Mikah u ïohi ïa kata ba ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa u , kumta u leit phai noh sha la ïing .

Nga la ong , Ym don na film ki Nongïathuhlypa uba tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat barieh jongno U Trai . Ym don na ki uba la ju jingsngewsih ne sngewthuh ïa ka khubor jongno U ne uba la ju shah ne pynleit jingtem ïa Kaei kaba U noh .
translation.en: For who hath stood in the counsel of the  Lord  , and hath perceived and heard his word ? who hath marked his word , and heard it ?

translation.kha: Haba ki mei khaïi jong pha ki leit shabar ri , pha pyndap ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki hima baroh . la pynriewspah ïa ki syiem da ka spah jong ki mar jong pha .
translation.en: When thy wares went forth out of the seas , thou filledst many people  ; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise .

translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh pyrshah ïa u ka long kaba sniew hi kumne ka jingsuh byrthen , bad ka jingmeng ka long hi ka thup khim ka jingmane bleithaw) . Namar ba me la kyntait ïa ka hukum U TRAI’ , u la kyntait ïa me kum u syep .
translation.en: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft , and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry . Because thou hast rejected the word of the  Lord  , he hath also rejected thee from being king .

translation.kha: U Blei u la pynbna naduh mynshuwa lyngraw ki nongïathuhlypa baroh ba U Messaïah jong u , u dei ïa-ban shahshitom ; nabar u la pynlong ïa ka , ban jia Shishak ha kane ka rukom .
translation.en: But those things , which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets , that Christ should suffer , he hath so fulfilled .

translation.kha: U Nadab u thung katto katne ki Lem ban ïalam ïa ka jingmane ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Ishmael , ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , da ki jingrwai bad ki jingïaroh ïa u .
translation.en: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the  Lord  , and to record , and to thank and praise the  Lord  God of Israel :

translation.kha: Haba nga shem ïa uno uno uba khuid , uba duk pait ban ïoh thied jaiñ tlot nep ,
translation.en: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing , or any poor without covering  ;

translation.kha: U Saul u ïohi ïa ka jingjop u Dabid bad u dum sheptieng shiah hajuh ïa u .
translation.en: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely , he was afraid of him .
And , behold , seven other kine came up after them , poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed , such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness :
translation.kha: Nangta , sa hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei ki la wan mih kiba raikhoh bad kiba sah sa ka shyieng suda . Ki long ki masi kynthei kiba isangsot eh kiba ngam pat ju ïohi hangno hangno ha ka ri Ijipt .

Nangta u Nadab u kylli ïa u Anammelekh u nong slap bad ïa u Abishai u para u Joab , ( ka kmie jong ki ka dei ka Seruïah ) , Mano napdeng jong phi ar nguh ban leit bad nga sha ka jaka shong dara u Saul ? Ma nga , u Abishai u jubab .
translation.en: Then answered David and said to Ahimelech the Hittite , and to Abishai the son of Zeruiah , brother to Joab , saying , Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp ? And Abishai said , I will go down with thee .

translation.kha: Wat khuslai .
translation.en: Don't worry .

translation.kha: Bad ar ngut ki rangbah bamatlah kiba shong harud lynti ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u ïaid nangta , kumta ki la sdang ban pyrta , Ko Khun u Dabid ! To sngewsynei ïa ngi , ko Kynrad !
translation.en: And , behold , two blind men sitting by the way side , when they heard that Jesus passed by , cried out , saying , Have mercy on us , O Lord , thou Son of David .
Now when they shall fall , they shall be holpen with a little help : but many shall cleave to them with flatteries .
translation.kha: Katba dang don ka jingpynïap , ki briew jong U Blei kin ïoh khyndiat ka jingïarap , wat la kiba bun kiba ïasoh bad ki kin leh kumta na ka bynta ki daw shimet .

translation.en: Insomuch that we desired Titus , that as he had begun , so he would also finish in you the same grace also .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi la kyntu ïa u Titos , uba la sdang ïa kane ka kam , ban bteng ïa ka bad ban ïarap ïa phi ban pyndep ïa kane ka jingshakri bakyrpang jong ka jingieit .

translation.en: So Saul took the kingdom over Israel , and fought against all his enemies on every side , against Moab , and against the children of Ammon , and against Edom , and against the kings of Zobah , and against the Philistines : and whithersoever he turned himself , he vexed them .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Saul u la long u syiem ki Israel , u la ïaleh ïa baroh ki nongshun jong u kylleng : ki paid Moab , Ammon , Edom , ki syiem ka Sobah , bad ki Philistia . Man kaba u ïaleh u jop .
Kata ka sur ka la ong ha uta u ruh kiba hynriew , To pyllait noh ïa ki saw nguid ki angel kiba la shah khum ha ka wahbah Ïuphratis !
translation.en: Saying to the sixth angel which had the trumpet , Loose the four angels which are bound in the great river Euphrates .
They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward , saying , Come , and let us join ourselves to the  Lord  in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten .
translation.kha: Kin kylli ïa ka lynti sha Seïon bad nangta kin leit ha kata ka phang . Kin pynlong ka jutang baïaineh bad nga bad da lei lei kin ym pynkheiñ ïa ka .
Haba per la ïohi ïa u , nga la dem khrup ha ki kjit lad u kum u biria ba la ïap . U la buh ïa ka kti kamon jong u halor jong de bad u la ong , Wat sheptieng ! Nga long uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh .
translation.en: And when I saw him , I fell at his feet as dead . And he laid his right hand upon me , saying unto me ,  Fear not  ; I am the first and the last :
But these speak evil of those things which they know not : but what they know naturally , as brute beasts , in those things they corrupt themselves .
translation.kha: Hynrei , kine ki briew , ki tur ïaleh da kaba krenbeiñ da kiei kiei kiba kim sngewthuh ; bad kito kiei kiei kiba ki tip da ka bor tipthuh kum ki mradkhlaw , ki long kita hi kiei kiei kiba pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished , O daughter of Zion  ; he will no more carry thee away into captivity : he will visit thine iniquity , O daughter of Edom  ; he will discover thy sins .
translation.kha: Ka Seïon ka la siew na ka bynta ka pop jong ka ; U  Trai  un ym buh shuh ïa ngi ha ka jingshah ringmraw . Hynrei ko Edom , U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa pha ; un pynpaw ïa ki kam bymman jong pha .
Men ym shemphang na ki jingman myn ne na ki jingot ïaleh ha ka por mynsngi ,
translation.en: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night  ; nor for the arrow that flieth by day  ;

translation.kha: hynrei namar ba u ni ka jingduna ha ka met , um bit ban wan hajan ka jingap pyrda kaba kyntang ne don leit sha jan ka duwan . Um dei ban pynbit tngit ïa kine ki jaka kyntang jong nga ; namar per long U Trai bad na pynkyntang ïa ki .
translation.en: Only he shall not go in unto the veil , nor come nigh unto the altar , because he hath a blemish  ; that he profane not my sanctuaries : for I the  Lord  do sanctify them .

translation.kha: Neng da lade nur-um hikai ïa ki brup jong pha , bad ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingmanbha bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: And all thy children shall be taught of the  Lord   ; and great shall be the peace of thy children .

translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi , te , kaei kiba me pyrkhat ? Hangto ka long pyrshah ïa ka Aiñ jong ngi ïa-ban sawphew khajna sha u Patsha ka shiah Rom , ne kdew long ?
translation.en: Tell us therefore , What thinkest thou ? Is it lawful to give tribute unto Caesar , or not ?

translation.kha: Ki lyngkdong ktang ïoh ïa kaba bah tam na ki soh nyngkong jong ka jingot bad na baroh kiei Kiei kiwei ïa kiba la ainguh ha nga . Man ka por ba ki briew ki shet kpu , kin ai shata ki lyngdoh ïa u kpu banyngkong kumno ka jingainguh , badno ki jingkyrkhu jongngi nga kin neh ha ki ïing ki sem jong ki .
translation.en: And the first of all the firstfruits of all things , and every oblation of all , of every sort of your oblations , shall be the priest s : ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough , that he may cause the blessing to rest in thine house .

translation.kha: Ngan sa wan sha phi hadien ba nga la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Makedonia — ngab nga dei ban leit lyngba ka Makedonia .
translation.en: Now I will come unto you , when I shall pass through Macedonia : for I do pass through Macedonia .
And when they had brought their ships to land , they forsook all , and followed him .
translation.kha: Ki la tan ïa ki lieng sharud duriaw , ki la iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh bad ki la bud ïa U Jisu .

Ki shipai ki la ïalam noh ïa U Jisu , bun katba ki tang leit , ki la ïashem ïa u briew ibha ka Kynsan Uba kyrteng u Simon uba la wan rung sha ka nongbah . Ki la kumta ïa u , ki buh ïa ka diengphna halor jongki u , bad ki la pynphong ïa u ngab bah ïa ka shadien U Jisu .
translation.en: And as they led him away , they laid hold upon one Simon , a Cyrenian , coming out of the country , and on him they laid the cross , that he might bear it after Jesus .
And said unto them , What will ye give me , and I will deliver him unto you ? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver .
translation.kha: bad u la kylli ,  Phin ai aïu ïa nga lada nga shetkylla ïa U Jisu ha phi ?  Ki la ñiew laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa bad ki la ai ïa kita ha u .
Nangta ki la shim ïa u bad bret ïa u sha ka tukri , kaba la tyrkhong .
translation.en: And they took him , and cast him into a pit : and the pit was empty , there was no water in it .

translation.kha: U ju u la don ha Bethania ha ka ïing Jong u Simon , u briew kaba la pien ñiuhkhlieh .
translation.en: Now when Jesus was in Bethany , in the house of Simon the leper ,

translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki la lum thup ïa ki shi jaka jaka haduh ba la iwtung lut ka ri baroh kawei .
translation.en: And they gathered them together upon heaps : and the land stank .

translation.kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , ka jingieit jong Ngi kam dei ban long tang da ki ktien bun ka jingrung ; ka dei ban long ka jingieit ka shisha , kaba pynpaw ïa lade da ka Kam .
translation.en: My little children , let us not love in word , neither in tongue  ; but in deed and in truth .
Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace , but of debt .
translation.kha: Ïa u briew uba trei , la siew bainong ïa u , hynrei ym shym la ñiew ïa ka kum ka jingai sngewbha ; ka long kaei kaei kaba u la kamai .
Ka long ha ka pa die ba ki briew ki thiah ; ka dei ha ka por miet ba ki pynbuaid .
translation.en: For they that sleep sleep in the night ; and they that be drunken are drunken in the night .

translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Uno uno uba kwah ban lehkmen ha ka jingim bad uba kwah ban ïohi ïa ki para kiba bakha , u dem ban kiar na kaba kren sniew badno ban nym kren lamler .
translation.en: For he that will love life , and see good days , let him refrain his tongue from evil , and his lips that they speak no guile :

translation.kha: Kum ka um na ka kajuh den um ba la pra ki briew ki mareh napoh ka Ninebeh ! Sangeh ! Sangeh ! ka jingpyrta ka sawa — hynrei ym don mano mano ba pait dien .
translation.en: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water : yet they shall flee away . Stand , stand , shall they cry  ; but none shall look back .

translation.kha: U la jubab , Katba phi dang leit shapoh ka nongbah , u briew ibha samla shi khra ka um un ïashem ïa phi . Bud ïa u shapoh ka ïing ba u rung , bad ong ha u trai jong ka ïing :
