translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Behold , when ye are entered into the city , there shall a man meet you , bearing a pitcher of water  ; follow him into the house where he entereth in .

translation.kha: Ngan kiew ïa ka jaka ap phira jong nga bad ap ban khmih ïa kaei kaba U Trai un ïathuh ha nga ban ong bad kaei ka jubab ba un ai halor ka jingmudui jong nga .
translation.en: I will stand upon my watch , and set me upon the tower , and will watch to see what he will say unto me , and what I shall answer when I am reproved .
Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the  Lord  in Jerusalem , but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren .
translation.kha: Ïa kito ki lyngdoh ym shym la shah ban shakri ha ka Templ , hynrei ki lah ban bam ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat ba la ju ai ïa ki para lyngdoh jong ki .
kumta nga la leit , bad haba nga la shem ïa ka jaka ha kaba nga la buhrieh ïa ki , nga la ïohi ba ki la sniew bad kim long shuh ban pynbunkam .
translation.en: Then I went to Euphrates , and digged , and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it : and , behold , the girdle was marred , it was profitable for nothing .

translation.kha: To ai ba yn ïar ïa ka kylleng jong u mynta Bad sha bymjukut !
translation.en: Blessed be the name of the  Lord  from this time forth and for evermore .

translation.kha: bad sa shi kilo u pruid lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .
translation.en: And one tenth deal for one lamb , throughout the seven lambs :

translation.kha: U Trai da lade hi u ïalam ïa la ki brup , ym don u blei nongwei uba ïarap ïa u .
translation.en: So the  Lord  alone did lead him , and there was no strange god with him .

translation.kha: Bun na ki lynghoh ba la kham tymmen , ki Lem , bad ki rangbah kur , ki la ïohthiah ïa ka Templ bakohnguh , bad ki peiñ ïa ka nongrep jong kane ka Templ katba dang tei , ki ïam pangnud . Hynrei kiwei pat babha don hangta ki pyrta da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers , who were ancient men , that had seen the first house , when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes , wept with a loud voice  ; and many shouted aloud for joy :

translation.kha: Te kumjuh , ngi daym borabor ngab thuh ban leh ïa kita kiei ki kiba wallam ka jingsuk bad kiba ïarap Ban pynkhlaiñ iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace , and things wherewith one may edify another .

translation.kha: khnam ba ngi ha ban longsem kiba khuid bad kiba hok ha khmat jong u baher ki sngi ka jingim jong ngi .
translation.en: In holiness and righteousness before him , all the days of our life .

translation.kha: kumta kdew sheptieng ïa kita ki briew . U Trai U blang lad phi u don ryngkat bad phi ; u hir U Blei uba donbor bad umbah itieng .
translation.en: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them : for the  Lord  thy God is among you , a mighty God and terrible .
Then answered Peter , and said unto Jesus , Lord , it is good for us to be here : if thou wilt , let us make here three tabernacles  ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias .
translation.kha: Kumta u Petros u la kren bad u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ko Trai , katno ka long kaba bha ba ngi ïadon hangne ! Lada me mon , ngan shna lai tylli ki ïingjaiñ hangne , kawei na ka bynta jong me , kawei na ka bynta u Moses , bad kawei na ka bynta u Elijah .

U Trai u ong , Ngi bitar ïa tun ki nongwei kiba synshar ïa ki briew jong nga , bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki . Ki paid Judah ki long ki jong nga , bad ma nga , U thri Badonbor Baroh , nur-um sumar ïa ki . Kin long ki kulai thma badonbor jong nga .
translation.en: Mine anger was kindled against the shepherds , and I punished the goats : for the  Lord  of hosts hath visited his flock the house of Judah , and hath made them as his goodly horse in the battle .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ka dohthang kaba thymmai bad ïa ka jingput kaba thymmai . Ngan khlur noh na phi ïa ka dohnud maw ba-eh rang jong phi , bad ngan ai ha phi ka dohnud kaba kohnguh .
translation.en: A new heart also will I give you , and a new spirit will I put within you : and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh , and I will give you an heart of flesh .
Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord  God  : for the day of the  Lord  is at hand : for the  Lord  hath prepared a sacrifice , he hath bid his guests .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka la jan haba U  Trai  un shong ha ka jingbishar ; kumta to sngap jar ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u . U  Trai  u pynkhreh ban kñia ïa ki briew jong u bad u la khot sngewbha ïa ki nongshun ban lute ïa ka Judah .

translation.en: And Pharaoh sent , and called for Moses and Aaron , and said unto them , I have sinned this time : the  Lord  is righteous , and I and my people are wicked .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong ha ki ,  Ha kane ka sien nga la leh pop ; U  Trai  u leh ïa kaba dei ; ma nga bad ki briew jong nga ngi la leh bakla .
Uba hok u isih ïa u bymman , malade u bymman u isih ïa uba hok .
translation.en: An unjust man is an abomination to the just : and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked .

translation.kha: Don kano kano kaba ngam shym la leh ïa ka ? Te balei ka pynmih ki sohwaiñ kiba jew bad ym kiba bha kamar nga la khmih lynti ?
translation.en: What could have been done more to my vineyard , that I have not done in it ? wherefore , when I looked that it should bring forth grapes , brought it forth wild grapes ?

translation.kha: U long u Nongsynshar uba ïakhleh tam na ki syiem baïar ha ka thain naduh ka wah Ïuphratis haduh ka ri Philistia bad haduh khapbrip ka Ijipt .
translation.en: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines , and to the border of Egypt .
And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words .
translation.kha: Haba nga ïohsngew ïa ki jingujor jong ki , nga la bitar bad kut jingmut ban leh ei ei .
Kane kadei ka kot ?
translation.en: Is it a book ?

translation.kha: Ba ka jingaiei ka shuki ïa me ban iehnoh ïa ka rukom im bymriewblei bad ïa ki jingkwah brai ba kynja pyrthuh , bad ïa-ban im da ka synshar ïa biar , ban im hok , bad ban im riewblei ha kane ka pyrthei ,
translation.en: Teaching us that , denying ungodliness and worldly lusts , we should live soberly , righteously , and godly , in this present world ;
So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken : and he was there when Jerusalem was taken .
translation.kha: Bad ïa nga la buh ha ka phyllaw jong ka ïingsyiem haduh ka sngi ba la kurup ïa ka Jerusalem .
Nangne u Solomon u ong , “Wat pynap ïa u khunlung ! Ai ïa u ha ka kynthei kaba nyngkong — ka dei ka kamai bashisha jong u .
translation.en: Then the king answered and said , Give her the living child , and in no wise slay it : she is the mother thereof .

translation.kha: Me buh ïa u pud ba ktem lah ban kum king , pun pynlong ïa ki ba kin ym tap biang ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over  ; that they turn not again to cover the earth .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa kine ki briew’ ba ki dei ban Kohnguh ïa barieh ki hukum jong nga . Kim dei ban kup kano kano ka jingkit shapoh lyngngoh ki kyrdoh jrong kane ka nongbah ha ka Sabbaton . Ki dei ba-bang radbah ïa ka Sabbaton Kum ka sngi bakyntang bad kdor dei ban leh ïa ïano kano ka kam .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if ye diligently hearken unto me , saith the  Lord  , to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day , but hallow the sabbath day , to do no work therein  ;

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u ong , kyndat ïa ka Jeroboam . Kyntait ïa ki jaka ha kiba ki briew ki mane . Maham ïa ka ri Israel .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face toward Jerusalem , and drop thy word toward the holy places , and prophesy against the land of Israel ,

translation.kha: Ïa ki um la kad pylleng , nabar ki Israel ki ïadie lyndang ïa kata ka duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang , katba me ki um ki long kum ki kynroh ha baroh arliang .
translation.en: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground : and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand , and on their left .

translation.kha: Hynriew haba ki shakri ki la ïathuh ïa ka hukum u syiem ha ka Bashti , ka mahadei ; ka la kyntait ban wanpaw . Kane ka la pynbitar ïa u syiem .
translation.en: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king s commandment by his chamberlains : therefore was the king very wroth , and his anger burned in him .
And they gave him audience unto this word , and then lifted up their voices , and said , Away with such a fellow from the earth : for it is not fit that he should live .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la pynshahshkor ïa u Paul haduh ba un da dep kren ; hynrei pynban ki la sdang ban kyang jam eh ,  Pynduh ïa u ! Pynïap ïa u ! Um long uba bit ban im !

U Moses u leit kiew na ri them Moab shaw u Lum Nebo haduh khlur jong u Lum Pisgah shaphang mihngi na Jerikho , mala nangta U Trai u pynjam ha u ïa kata ka ri barabor kawei : ka ri Gilead shaduh Dan kob shaphang shatei ;
translation.en: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo , to the top of Pisgah , that is over against Jericho . And the  Lord  shewed him all the land of Gilead , unto Dan ,
The priests the Levites , and all the tribe of Levi , shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel : they shall eat the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and his inheritance .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kiba na ka jait Lebi baroh kim dei ban ïohpateng ei ei na ka khyndew kumba long ki para Israel ; ha ka jaka kata , kin ïoh ka bam tang na ki jingainguh bad kiwei pat ki jingkñia ainguh sha U  Trai .

translation.en: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me , and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel , unto Abner the son of Ner , and unto Amasa the son of Jether , whom he slew , and shed the blood of war in peace , and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins , and in his shoes that were on his feet .
translation.kha: Ka dang don shuh sa kawei pat . Me kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Joab u la leh ïa nga da kaba pynïap ïa ki ar ngut ki rangbah ai hukum jong ki shipai Israel — u Abner , u khun jong u Ner bad u Amasa , u khun jong u Jether . Me kynmaw kumno u la pynïap ïa ki ha ka por suk pyrthei kum ka jingpynhiarkput ïa ka jingpynïap kaba ki la leh ha ka por thma . U la pynïap ïa ki rangbah balui lui , bad mynta nga bah ka jingkitkhlieh ïa kaei kaba u la leh , bad nga la shah jynjar na ka bynta kata .

translation.en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you , and ye shall fall by the sword : because ye are turned away from the  Lord  , therefore the  Lord  will not be with you .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïakhun ïa ki Amalek bad ki Kanaan , phin ïap ha ka thma ; U  Trai  un ym don lem bad phi , namar phi la kyntait ban bud ïa u .

translation.en: And came to the strong hold of Tyre , and to all the cities of the Hivites , and of the Canaanites : and they went out to the south of Judah , even to Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: Nangta ki leit shaphang shathie sha Tyros ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh , nangta sha baroh ki nongbah jong ki Hib bad ki Kanaan , bad khatduh eh sha Beersheba , ha ka bynta bashathie jong ka Judah .
Uno uno umbiah bam ïa ka dohnud jong nga bad dih ïa ka snam jongno per u khong ka jingim bymjukut , bad ngan sa pynmihpat ïa u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .
translation.en: Whoso eateth my flesh , and drinketh my blood , hath eternal life  ; and I will raise him up at the last day .

And it came to pass , as they fled from before Israel , and were in the going down to Beth–horon , that the  Lord  cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah , and they died : they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword .
translation.kha: Katba ki Amor ki dang phet arsut na ka khim lum na ki shipai Israel , U  Trai  u pynhap halor jong ki ïa u phria uba heh baroh shi lynter lynti haduh Asekah . Kham bun ki la ïap na u phria ban na kaba ki shah pynïap ha ki Israel .
U Jotbathah u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiad ha ka Nongbah lad u Dabid bad u Horem u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka Jong u .
translation.en: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David . And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Ka jingrung jaipdeh kan pynlong ïa phi ban kyrduh , hynrei ka jingtrei shitom kan pynpluh ïa phi .
translation.en: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand : but the hand of the diligent maketh rich .
And he came and touched the bier : and they that bare him stood still . And he said ,  Young man , I say unto thee , Arise .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ïaid sha khmat bad u la ktah ïa ka krong , bad ki briew kiba bah ïa ka ki la sangeh . U Jisu u la ong ,  Ko samla ! To khie joit , nga ong ïa me !

translation.en: O ye seed of Israel his servant , ye children of Jacob , his chosen ones .
translation.kha: Ma phi kiba hiarpateng na u Jakob , u shakri jong U Blei , kiba hiarpateng na u Israel , ïa uba U Blei u la jied , kynmaw ïa ki kambah kiba U Blei u la leh bad ki jingbishar kiba u la ai .
Hynrei ka khubor kam ngam jylliew hapoh jongki ki , mala kim neh slem . Kumjuh haba ka jingeh lane ka jingpynshitom beiñ ka woh namar ka khubor , tang kumta hi ki phai dien noh .
translation.en: And have no root in themselves , and so endure but for a time : afterward , when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word s sake , immediately they are offended .

translation.kha: A Trai , nga lah ban ieh ïa ki khun jongngi ki ba ki shah beh kthong bun shah pynïap .
translation.en: Ephraim , as I saw Tyre , is planted in a pleasant place : but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer .
Not giving heed to Jewish fables , and commandments of men , that turn from the truth .
translation.kha: bad ban nym pynshahshkor shuh ha ki khanatang jong ki Jiw bad ha ki hukum briew kiba wan na ki briew kiba la kyntait ïa ka jingshisha .

Ki la sangeh ba mane ïa U Trai , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jongno ki , U Blei uba la wallam ïa ki na Ijipt , bad ki la sdang ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blang , ki blei jong ki jaitbynriew kiba don sarong jongngi ki . Ki Mano im ïa ki , bad ki la pynpang ïa U Trai ban setkut .
translation.en: And they forsook the  Lord  God of their fathers , which brought them out of the land of Egypt , and followed other gods , of the gods of the people that were round about them , and bowed themselves unto them , and provoked the  Lord  to anger .
He causeth it to come , whether for correction , or for his land , or for mercy .
translation.kha: U Blei u phah ïa u slap ban ai um ïa ka khyndew ; u lah ban phah ïa u ban pynshitom ïa ngi , lane ban pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewbha jong u .

Um ju mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki Eliel lane bam ïa ki jingkylla ba la jingaiti ha ki jaka Mane ba la mana . Um ju khroh pynbieit ïa ka tnen jong uwei pat u biria lane ïathiah jingkha bad ka kynthei ha ka prie poi bnai jongki ka .
translation.en: And hath not eaten upon the mountains , neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel , neither hath defiled his neighbour s wife , neither hath come near to a menstruous woman ,

translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Balaam , Wat leit dara ki , bad wat buh ka jingtim halor ki paid Israel , namar ki don ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong nga .
translation.en: And God said unto Balaam , Thou shalt not go with them  ; thou shalt not curse the people : for they are blessed .
Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil , to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives ?
translation.kha: Hato ka dei ïa ngi ban bud ïa ka nuksa jong phi bad ban ym kohnguh ïa U Blei jong ngi da kaba shongkurim ïa ki kynthei nongwei ?

translation.en: And the sons of Uzziel  ; Mishael , and Elzaphan , and Zithri .
translation.kha: U Ussiel ruh u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Mishael , u Elsaphan , bad u Sithri .
U briew babha jaipdeh u long uba sniew kum uno uno Uba pynring .
translation.en: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster .

translation.kha: Ki bynriew kin ïaid sakma na ka Duriaw Baïap sha ka Mid bad nangta shuh shuh na shatei shaduh mihngi . Kin ïakhleh Kylleng kylleng ïa ka khubor na U Trai , hynrei kin ym shem ïa ka .
translation.en: And they shall wander from sea to sea , and from the north even to the east , they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the  Lord  , and shall not find it .

translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u la sngewthuh ba dei u angel jong U Trai ba u la ïohi , bad u ong ha ka jingsheptieng , A Trai Bakhrawbor ! (Nga la ïohi ïa u apostol jong me mareh !
translation.en: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the  Lord  , Gideon said , Alas , O Lord  God  ! for because I have seen an angel of the  Lord  face to face .

translation.kha: Bad kumno u la ioh ïa la ka ri bad u la leit ban shon ban kamar-tama ha hajan . hadien ba u kop jong u Amraphel u la ïap , U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Ban kynriah sha kaei ka jaka ha kaba phi mynta phi shong phin sah .
translation.en: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldeans , and dwelt in Charran : and from thence , when his father was dead , he removed him into this land , wherein ye now dwell .

translation.kha: Um shym la lah ban leh kino kino ki khap hangta , lehse noh tang kaba buh ïa ki kti jong u ha ki khyndiat ngut ki bariew kiba pang bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki .
translation.en: And he could there do no mighty work , save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk , and healed them .

translation.kha: Ha ka lawlynnong jongngi u ki um halor ka suiñbneng ki kyrhuh ; u wallam ïa ki lyoh na kiba Kut ka khñiot . U pynlong ïa ka leilieh pun thala ha u slap bad u phah ïa ka lyer na ka kamra jingkynshew jong u .
translation.en: When he uttereth his voice , there is a multitude of waters in the heavens  ; and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth : he maketh lightnings with rain , and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .
For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer , and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ ,
translation.kha: Bad ngan ïailong uba kmen , namar nga tip ba da ki jingduwai jong phi bad da ka jingïarap kaba wan na U Mynsiem jong U Jisu Khrist , ïa nga yn sa pyllaitluid .
?(Nga pynthikna ïa ph ba uno uno Uba pynbna ha kaba paw ba u long u jngai nga , U Toi U Briew un leh kumjuh ïa u ha khmat ki bishar jongngi U Blei .
translation.en: Also I say unto you , Whosoever shall confess me before men , him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God :

translation.kha: Nga la wan da ka iktiar U Kpa jong nga ; hynrei phim shym la pdiang ïa nga ; pynban , haba don uno une uba wan ha la ka jong ka iktiar , Phon pdiang ïa u .
translation.en: I am come in my Father s name , and ye receive me not : if another shall come in his own name , him ye will receive .

translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ïa kaei ba yn leh ïa uta u briew uba pynïap ïa u Goliath .
translation.en: And the people answered him after this manner , saying , So shall it be done to the man that killeth him .

But I say unto you , That whosoever shall put away his wife , saving for the cause of fornication , causeth her to commit adultery : and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : lada uno uno u briew u pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga , na ka bynta kano kano ka daw lait noh na ka jingbymïaineh jong ka , te u long uba la shah rem ha kaba pynlong ïa ka ban klim lada ka shongkurim biang ; bad u briew uba shongkurim ïa ka , u ruh u klim .
Ha man kawei pa katai ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ha man kawei pa kawei ka Sabbaton , ki jaitbynriew na ki hima baroh kin wan ban Mane ïa nga hangne ha Israel , ong U Trai .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that from one new moon to another , and from one sabbath to another , shall all flesh come to worship before me , saith the  Lord .
Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace , and things wherewith one may edify another .
translation.kha: Te kumta , ngi dei borabor ban thmu ban leh ïa kita kiei kiei kiba wallam ka jingsuk bad kiba ïarap ban pynkhlaiñ iwei ïa iwei pat .
Kumta ki la noh ïa U Jisu ban mynhynne na ka thait jong ki .
translation.en: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts .

translation.kha: Kumta ong ha u shakri jongno sa u Dabid ba de , U Trai borabor barieh , nga noh ha u , ‘ ang la shim ïa me na kaba sumar ïa ki langbrot ha ki jaka phlang bad pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar jong ki Briew jong de ki Israel .
translation.en: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I took thee from the sheepcote , even from following the sheep , that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel :

translation.kha: Ki wallam ïa ka jingiwtung bad jingpyntrei , bad ha ka jingsarong jyllang ki , ki shim ïa ka Aiñ ha lade .
translation.en: They are terrible and dreadful : their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves .

translation.kha: nur phah ïa pham sha trai jong ka pyrthei kiba ïalap ban pynïasoh bad ki briew Kiba shong ha ki por mynbarim . Ngan pynurlong ïa pha ba phan shong ha sakma ka pyrthei kaba shapoh ka khyndew hapdeng ki jingjot bymsuidñiew , ban ïadon lang bad bakha ïapom . Namarkata phan ym lah shuh ban shong ban sah ha ka ri jong ki briew kiba im .
translation.en: When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit , with the people of old time , and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth , in places desolate of old , with them that go down to the pit , that thou be not inhabited  ; and I shall set glory in the land of the living  ;
Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul .
translation.kha: Ngam pat ju leh pop da kaba duwai ba kin ïap .
Hobab ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la lyngngoh ; bad ki la iehnoh ïa u bad ki la rupa noh .
translation.en: When they had heard these words , they marvelled , and left him , and went their way .

translation.kha: Don uwei u briew uba u kpa jong u , u dei u nong Ijipt bad ka kmie jong u pat ka dei ka Israel kaba kyrteng ka Shelomith , ka khun u Dibri Uba na ka jait Dan . Une u briew’ u ïasakma bad uwei u Israel thah ka Jaka shongneh dara . Katba ki dang ïakhawai kumta , une u briew u krenbeiñ ïa ka kyrteng U Tlai : kumta ki wan ïalam ïa u ha u Moses .
translation.en: And the Israelite woman s son blasphemed the name of the  Lord  , and cursed . And they brought him unto Moses : ( and his mother s name was Shelomith , the daughter of Dibri , of the tribe of Dan : )

translation.kha: Kim pat lah hi ban jait , ki la shla da ka jingkmen bad ka jingphylla ; kumta u la kylli ïa ki , Phi don ei ei hangno ban ïam ?
translation.en: And while they yet believed not for joy , and wondered , he said unto them ,  Have ye here any meat ?
And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u kham riewspah bad kham stad ban ïa uno uno u syiem ha ka pyrthei .
Ki briew kiba shit khlieh ki leh ïa ki kam beiñ ; ki briew kiba kata ki long jai jai .
translation.en: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly : and a man of wicked devices is hated .

translation.kha: Wat ka kmie jyllang u kam kynmaw Shu ïa u Myntan ; la bam ïa u da ki ksaiñ bad la pynjot kum ïa u dieng ba la khyllem .
translation.en: The womb shall forget him  ; the worm shall feed sweetly on him  ; he shall be no more remembered  ; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree .

translation.kha: U Jokshan u dei u kpa jong u Sheba bad u Dedan , bad ki khun ki ktieh jong u Dedan ki long ki Asshurim , Ki Letushim , bad ki lym .
translation.en: And Jokshan begat Sheba , and Dedan . And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim , and Letushim , and Leummim .

translation.kha: Hynrei to phyrnai nang roi ha ka jingaiei bad ka jingtip ïa U ijuh Khrist uba U Trai bad U Nongpynim jong im . Ha u , to long ka burom , mynta bad shaduh bymjukut ! Amen .
translation.en: But grow in grace , and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ . To him be glory both now and for ever . Amen .
God thundereth marvellously with his voice  ; great things doeth he , which we cannot comprehend .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum jong U Blei kiei kiei kiba khraw ki jia , kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba ngim lah ban sngewthuh .

Ki para bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong u baroh ki wan shim bad rah noh ïa ka met jong u . Ki Shim pat ïa u bad ki tat ïa u ha ka jingtep u Manoah u kpa jong u , kaba hapdeng ka Sorah bad ka Eshtaol . U la long u nongïalam ïa ki Israel arphew snem .
translation.en: Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down , and took him , and brought him up , and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father . And he judged Israel twenty years .

translation.kha: U Kpa u ieit ïa nga namar ba nga kloi ban niam ïa la ka jingim , ktang ba nga lah ban ïohpdiang pateng ïa ka .
translation.en: Therefore doth my Father love me , because I lay down my life , that I might take it again .

translation.kha: Khie leit lumlang ïa ki thnum ki san Jong ki Israel mala ïathuh ha ki ba nga U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpa thymmai jong ki , U Blei jngai u Abraham , U Isaak , bad u Jakob , nga la mihpaw ha me . ïathiah ruh ha ki ba nga la wan jngoh ïa ki , bad de la ïohi aïu ki nong Ijipt ki la leh ïa ki .
translation.en: Go , and gather the elders of Israel together , and say unto them , The  Lord  God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , of Isaac , and of Jacob , appeared unto me , saying , I have surely visited you , and seen that which is done to you in Egypt :

translation.kha: Hynrei na ka pyntha u Dabid , U Trai U Blei jong u , u la ai ïa u Abijah u khun ban synshar hadien jong u ha Jerusalem bad ban sumar ïa ka Jerusalem ba kan shem .
translation.en: Nevertheless for David s sake did the  Lord  his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem , to set up his son after him , and to establish Jerusalem :

translation.kha: Ki nongri Gibeah ki wan ban ïaleh pyrsa ïa la bad mynmiet ki kerkut ïa ka ïing . Ki thmu ban pynïap ïa na ; pynban ki leh pynjahburom ïa ka tnga kliar jong nga , bad ka da ïap noh .
translation.en: And the men of Gibeah rose against me , and beset the house round about upon me by night , and thought to have slain me : and my concubine have they forced , that she is dead .

translation.kha: “Nga shim ïa ka met jongngi ka , nga ot lyngkot ïa ka , bad nga phah ïa kawei ka lyngkhot sha kawei pa kawei ka jait Israel . Kine ki briew ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba bymman bad ba-ijli hapdeng jong ngi .
translation.en: And I took my concubine , and cut her in pieces , and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel : for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel .
None is so fierce that dare stir him up : who then is able to stand before me ?
translation.kha: Haba la pynkhih ïa u , u long uba shyrkhei ; ym don mano mano ba nud bad ïeng ha khmat jong u .

Hynrei u la shah ïa ka jingshitom kaba la dadien hok ïa I , ka jingpang kaweh ngi la dei ban shah . Baroh shi katta ngi la pyrkhat ba ki jingshitom jrong u ki la long ki jingpynmihpat ba la phah da U Balei .
translation.en: Surely he hath borne our griefs , and carried our sorrows : yet we did esteem him stricken , smitten of God , and afflicted .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Moses ha u Lum Sinai nabar u hukum ïa u , Ban ai ïa kine ngon ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ha u paid Israel .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses in mount Sinai , saying ,

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ka Hima ki ïeng kan long kumne . Shisien la don u briew u ban sa leit jingleit ; u la khot ïa ki shakri jong u bad u la Buh ïa ki ban khmied ïa ka jingainong jingem jyllang u .
translation.en: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country , who called his own servants , and delivered unto them his goods .
He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches , and he that giveth to the rich , shall surely come to want .
translation.kha: Lada phi ai sngewbha sha ki briew kiba riewspah lane banbeiñ ïa kiba duk ban ïoh riewspah , phin long uba duk ïa lade .

Ynda mynsaw u la sngewkhuslai ; kumta u phah khot ïa ki nongleh Mynta bad ïa ki riewstad baroh jong ka ri Ijipt . U ïathuh ha ki ïa la ki jingphohsniew , hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba lah ban batai ïa ki ha u .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled  ; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt , and all the wise men thereof : and Pharaoh told them his dream  ; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh .

translation.kha: Kumta ka khynraw ka la leit noh bad ka la kylli ïa ka kmie jong ka , Kawei ngan pan ? Ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis , ka la jubab .
translation.en: And she went forth , and said unto her mother , What shall I ask ? And she said , The head of John the Baptist .
And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship , and to go before him unto the other side , while he sent the multitudes away .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la pynlong ïa ki synran ban kiew ha ka lieng bad ban nang leit sha shiliang ka duriaw , katba u la nang phah noh ïa u paidbah .
Ki la ïamynjur ïa kane ka bynta jong ka ri uwei uwei un leit wad , malu ki ïapyllait shad la ka jong ka jongngi ka lad .
translation.en: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it : Ahab went one way by himself , and Obadiah went another way by himself .
Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely , and thy foot shall not stumble .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban ïaid da kaba suk ha ki lynti jong phi bad phin ym jynthut .

translation.en: The sons of Asher  ; Imnah , and Ishuah , and Ishvi , and Beriah , and Serah their sister .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Asher . U don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Imnah , u Ishbah , u Ishbi , bad u Beraïah , bad kawei ka khun , ka Serah .
Ho-oid , Syiem Kynrad , ki la jubab . Ngi la kloi ba lai kat ïa kaban phi ong .
translation.en: And the king s servants said unto the king , Behold , thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint .

translation.kha: Nangta u Balak u la phah kham bun ki nongïalam kiba kham pawkhmat baneh ïa kito kiba mynshuwa .
translation.en: And Balak sent yet again princes , more , and more honourable than they .

translation.kha: Ha ki jaka mane blei thala hajar ki lum , bun hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng wahbah ktah syrngiew , u Ahas u ai jingïania sad u thang jingiwbih .
translation.en: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places , and on the hills , and under every green tree .

translation.kha: Hato me la pan na U Blei ban pyn-i ha me ïa ki jingduna jong me , bad shano me la kohnguh banbeiñ ym leh pop shuh ?
translation.en: That which I see not teach thou me : if I have done iniquity , I will do no more .

translation.kha: Ki pyrshang ban syiem Lano ka nga sa long bad kumno kan wan . Kane ka la long ka to sha kaba U Mynsiem U Khrist uba kein ha ki u kdew , ha katba ïathuhlypa ïa ki jingshah shitom kiba U Khereth un tap ban shah bad ïa ka burom ka ïa-ban sa bud .
translation.en: Searching what , or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify , when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ , and the glory that should follow .

translation.kha: U paidbah baroh u la jubab , Ai ba ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u kun hapdeng halor jong ngi bad halor ki khun jong ngi !
translation.en: Then answered all the people , and said , His blood be on us , and on our children .
The wicked , through the pride of his countenance , will not seek after God : God is not in all his thoughts .
translation.kha: U riewbymman um salia shaphang U  Trai  ; ha ka jingsarong jong u , u pyrkhat ba U Blei um da donkam .
Ki nongai jingmut jong u syiem ki la ïawan shai khmat , Hynrei ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah don pyllup ïa ka jingbthuh lane ïathuh ha u syiem aïu ka kit jingmut .
translation.en: Then came in all the king s wise men : but they could not read the writing , nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof .

translation.kha: U ka U Briew u la wan , malu u la bam bad u la dih , bad phiah la ong , ‘ Khmih ïa Une u briew ! U long u lalot bad u nongbanbeiñ , u paralok jong ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat naba la shah kyntait !’
translation.en: The Son of man is come eating and drinking  ; and ye say , Behold a gluttonous man , and a winebibber , a friend of publicans and sinners !

translation.kha: Ki kparad thnum jong ngi kim shym shem jingbam ei ei , bad haba u Jakob u la ïohsngew ba don kew ha Ijipt , u la phar ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ha ka jingleit banyngkong jong ki shata .
translation.en: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt , he sent out our fathers first .

translation.kha: shen ngan pynkdiah ïa ka bneng bad ka pyrthei , ïa ka khyndew bad ka duriaw .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Yet once , it is a little while , and I will shake the heavens , and the earth , and the sea , and the dry land  ;
While Peter thought on the vision , the Spirit said unto him , Behold , three men seek thee .
translation.kha: U Petros u dang ïai pyrshang ban shemphang aïu ka jingïohipaw ka kit jingmut , haba U Mynsiem u la ong ,  Ha sngap ! Lai ngut ki rangbah ki ïawad ïa me .
Mano ba pynhap ïa u slap ha ka jaka bym don bashong basah ?
translation.en: To cause it to rain on the earth , where no man is  ; on the wilderness , wherein there is no man  ;

translation.kha: U Amos u jubab , Ngam daym koum uta u jait nongïathuhlypa , uba ïathuhlypa na ka bynta ban ïoh jingsiew . Nga dei u nongri jingri , bad nga sumar ïa ki diengkhap Dumbur .
translation.en: Then answered Amos , and said to Amaziah , I was no prophet , neither was I a prophet s son  ; but I was an herdman , and a gatherer of sycomore fruit :

translation.kha: Te ki nongri ibieit kin tip ba de long U Trai , haba nga rah ïa la ka kti pyrshah ïa ki bad ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na ka ri jong ki .
translation.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt , and bring out the children of Israel from among them .
And the servants of Amon conspired against him , and slew the king in his own house .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Amon ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa u , bad ki la pynïap ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem .
Kumta nga leit poi sha Tel Abib hajan ka wahbah Khebar , ha kaba shong kiba la shah ringmraw bad nga Hukum hangta hynñiew sngi bad ka jingsngew shaïong shaphang kaei kaba nga la ïuh bad ïohsngew .
translation.en: Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel–abib , that dwelt by the river of Chebar , and I sat where they sat , and remained there astonished among them seven days .
Length of days is in her right hand  ; and in her left hand riches and honour .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka pynjlan ïa ka rta jong phi kumjuh ruh ka pynïoh ïa ka spah bad ka burom .

Kine ki Lebi harum ki ai ïa ka jingthok sha ka jingmane : u Isaiah , u Kadmiel , u Bani , u Hashabneïah , u Sherebaïah , u Hodabaïah , u Shebanaïah , bad u Pethahaïah . Ki ong : ngin bad ïaroh ïa U Trai’ U Blei jrong phi ; ïaroh ïa u junom la junom ! Ai ba baroh kin ïajah ïa ka kyrteng badonburom jong u , wat la ym anna ka jingïaroh ba kynja brisoh kaba khrawburom patlun .
translation.en: Then the Levites , Jeshua , and Kadmiel , Bani , Hashabniah , Sherebiah , Hodijah , Shebaniah , and Pethahiah , said , Stand up and bless the  Lord  your God for ever and ever : and blessed be thy glorious name , which is exalted above all blessing and praise .

translation.kha: haba u Daniel u la tip ba ïa ka hukum la lah soi , u la leit sha ïing . Ha ka ruma kaba haneng jong ka ïing jong u la Don ki jingkhangïit kiba phai shad Jerusalem . Hangta , kumba u la ju ïai leh , u la dem khohsiew ha ki jingkhangïit ba la plie bad u duwai sha U Blei lai sien shi sngi .
translation.en: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed , he went into his house  ; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem , he kneeled upon his knees three times a day , and prayed , and gave thanks before his God , as he did aforetime .

translation.kha: Hangne , te , ka long ka jingïohpdiang jong nga ïa kiei kiei barieh ba phin la ai ha nga — bad ka la long Palal ban ïa kaba nga donkam! Nga don ïa baroh kaba nga donkam mynta ha kambah u Ïuphratis u la wanrah sha nga ïa ki jingjai sngewbha bhor jong phi . Ki erlangthari kum ka jingainguh ba-iwbih sha U Blei , ka jingkñia kaba pdiang hun bad kaba pynsngewbha ïa u .
translation.en: But I have all , and abound : I am full , having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you , an odour of a sweet smell , a sacrifice acceptable , wellpleasing to God .
Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that were in the fields , came to Gedaliah to Mizpah ,
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Johanan bad ki nongïalam jong ki shipai ki bym shym la pyndem ki la wan ha u Gedalaïah ha Mispah bad ki la ong ha u ,

translation.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel  ; for he hath visited and redeemed his people ,
translation.kha: To ngin ïaroh ïa U Trai , U Blei jong ki Israel ! U la wan ïa ka ban ïarap ïa ki briew jong u bad ban pyllaitluid ïa ki .
Kumne ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Ki ïaidwir ka um kaba ai jingim kin tait noh na ka dohnud jong u .’
translation.en: He that believeth on me , as the scripture hath said , out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water .
Shall mortal man be more just than God ? shall a man be more pure than his maker ?
translation.kha: Hato don uno uno uba hok ha ka jingkhmih U Blei ne uba sngur ha khmat u Nongthaw jong u ?

U khur ïa kata ka ngap ha la ka kti bad u da bam ïa ka katba u ding ïaid ha la ka lynti . Nangta u leit sha la u kpa bad sha la ka kmie bad u ai ïa ki mar khyndiat . Ki bam ïa ka , hynrei u Samson um shyiap ïathuh ha ki ba u la shim ïa kata ka ngap na ka batip u sing .
translation.en: And he took thereof in his hands , and went on eating , and came to his father and mother , and he gave them , and they did eat : but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion .

translation.kha: U Jakob u tam kham sha jan u kpa jong u , uba la kthaw ïa u bad u ong , Ka sur te kum ka sur jong u Jakob , hynrei ki ktah jongno me pat ki long kum ki kti jong u Iso .
translation.en: And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father  ; and he felt him , and said , The voice is Jacob s voice , but the hands are the hands of Esau .

translation.kha: U Salm u sngewieit ïa ka jingkyrpad jong ki ban ïoh syiem ; kumta u duwai ha U Trai ,
translation.en: But the thing displeased Samuel , when they said , Give us a king to judge us . And Samuel prayed unto the  Lord .
And Saul said , Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son . And Jonathan was taken .
translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u ong ,  To rai hapdeng jong nga bad u Jonathan u khun jong nga .  La kdew ïa u Jonathan .

translation.en: Dan shall be a serpent by the way , an adder in the path , that biteth the horse heels , so that his rider shall fall backward .
translation.kha: U Dan un long kum u bseiñ harud lynti bah , Bad kum u  seiñpuh harud lynti , Uba puh na ka khongdong jat jong u kulai Khnang ba u nongshong un shah bret shadien .
To sumar bha , te , ba kaei kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ong kad ym jia ha phi :
translation.en: Beware therefore , lest that come upon you , which is spoken of in the prophets  ;

translation.kha: U la leit sha u Palat nabar u la pan ïa ka met U Jisu . U Pyllait u la hukum Ban ai ïa ka met ha u Joseph .
translation.en: He went to Pilate , and begged the body of Jesus . Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered .

And he said unto them , This is that which the  Lord  hath said , To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto the  Lord  : bake that which ye will bake to day , and seethe that ye will seethe  ; and that which remaineth over lay up for you to be kept until the morning .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  u la hukum ba lashai ka dei ka sngi shongthait ïa kaba la pynkyrpang sha u . Shet mynta kat ïa kaba phi dei ban shet , bad pynthnam kat ïa kaba phi dei ban pynthnam . Sa buh kyrpang kat ïa kaba tam bad tyngkai ïa ka na ka bynta lashai .
Kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long ka lynti kaba dei ka lah ban ïalam sha ka jinghap .
translation.en: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man , but the end thereof are the ways of death .

translation.kha: Wat klet ïa kaei kaba len ïathuh ha phi ! Yn sa atiar noh ïa U Khun U Briew ha ka har jong ki brup .
translation.en: Let these sayings sink down into your ears : for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ka khyndew kan khynñiuh , bad uei pa uwei ha ka ri un longkmie ha ka jinglut . Ka ri baroh kawei kan khynñiuh ; kan kiew bad kan hiar kumin ka wah Ngin .
translation.en: Shall not the land tremble for this , and every one mourn that dwelleth therein ? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood  ; and it shall be cast out and drowned , as by the flood of Egypt .

The first was like a lion , and had eagle s wings : I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked , and it was lifted up from the earth , and made stand upon the feet as a man , and a man s heart was given to it .
translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u syriem kum u sing , hynrei u don ki thapniang kum u pukni . Katba nga dang khmih la pynkdiah ïa ki thapniang . Ïa u mradkhlaw la rah shajrong bad la pynlong ïa u ban ïeng kum u briew . Bad nangta la ai ha u ka jingmut jingpyrkhat kum u briew .
Balei me leit leh ïa ka ?
translation.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham , What sawest thou , that thou hast done this thing ?
And said , O  Lord  God of Israel , why is this come to pass in Israel , that there should be to day one tribe lacking in Israel ?
translation.kha: A  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , balei kane ka la jia ? Balei ba ka jait Benjamin kan sa jah noh na Israel ?
Haba ki nongshniah jong u Daniel ki la khmih ïa u ba u duwai shiah U Blei ,
translation.en: Then these men assembled , and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God .

translation.kha: Kenan ka long Kumne kad jia haba ïa kiba ïap la pynmihpat . Haba ïa ka saw la tep , ka long kambah ïap ; haba la pynmihpat , ka long ka bymïap shuh .
translation.en: So also is the resurrection of the dead . It is sown in corruption ; it is raised in incorruption :

translation.kha: Haba u Ahithophel u la ïohthiah ba ïa ka jingai jingmut jong u ym shym la pdiang , u la teh jin ïa la ka kada bad u leit phai noh sha la shnong . Ynda u la dien pynbeit ïa la ki kam ïohnang kam sem , u la sdien phasi ïa lade . La Thep ïa u ha ka jingtep ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed , he saddled his ass , and arose , and gat him home to his house , to his city , and put his household in order , and hanged himself , and died , and was buried in the sepulchre of his father .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Hynñiew sngi lynter phiah ym bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat — bam tang ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat . Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong phi dei ban kren noh ïa u thiat baroh na ïing jong phi , namar lada uno uno u bam ïa u kpu ba la khlieh thir ha Us ki hynñiew sngi , yn ym khie hajuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread  ; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses : for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day , that soul shall be cut off from Israel .

translation.kha: Ki la dem ngon ha khmat jong u , bad u Joseph u ong , Kaei kane kaba phi la leh ? Phim tip ba u briew uba ha ka kyrdan jong nga u haw ban lap ïa phi da ka kheiñ ka bishar ?
translation.en: And Joseph said unto them , What deed is this that ye have done ? wot ye not that such a man as I can certainly divine ?

translation.kha: bad kam shym lehniam siaw . Ka la pyntngit ïa ka ri , bad ka la leh awria da kaba miej ïa ki maw bad ki tieng .
translation.en: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom , that she defiled the land , and committed adultery with stones and with stocks .

translation.kha: lymne ka pyrthei shalor lymne ka pyrthei sha tbian — ym don kano kano ha ki jingthaw baroh ki ban lah lano lano hati ban pynïakhlad ïa im’ na ka jingieit U Blei kaba ha ngi lyngba U Kiriath Jisu uba U Troas jong ngi .
translation.en: Nor height , nor depth , nor any other creature , shall be able to separate us from the love of God , which is in Christ Jesus our Lord .

translation.kha: manna pynlong ïa sa uba kham khraw ban ïa kaba ju un-long ; bad men pynkyrteng ibiang ïa de .
translation.en: Thou shalt increase my greatness , and comfort me on every side .

Would ye tarry for them till they were grown ? would ye stay for them from having husbands ? nay , my daughters  ; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the  Lord  is gone out against me .
translation.kha: hato phi lah hi ban ap haduh ba kin da san ? Hato kane kan khanglad ïa phi na kaba shongkurim ïano ïano ? Em , ko khun kynthei jong nga , phi tip ba kata kam lah ban long . U  Trai  u la phai pyrshah ïa nga , bad nga sngewsih shikatdei eh ïa phi .
Kabbon U Jehu u dang hikai ha ka Tabor , u la kylli ka jingkyllon , Kumba ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum ki ong ba U Messaïah un long uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ?
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said , while he taught in the temple ,  How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David ?

translation.kha: Ki riewsniew kim nang ïohthiah lymda ki ïoh ban leh ïa ka kam sniew ; ki peitmat tama lyndum ki la ïoh pynmynsaw ïano ïano .
translation.en: For they sleep not , except they have done mischief  ; and their sleep is taken away , unless they cause some to fall .

translation.kha: Ki Bethmeon ki wan peiñ pat , bad kiwei ki Israel ki ai ha ki ïa kita ki theisotti na Jashub ïa kiba kim shyiap la pynïap . Hynrei kita kim pat biang ïa ki .
translation.en: And Benjamin came again at that time  ; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh–gilead : and yet so they sufficed them not .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga la ai ha phi ïa ki syier , bad ha ka jingbitar sleh jong nga , la la shim noh ïa ki .
translation.en: I gave thee a king in mine anger , and took him away in my wrath .

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong , Te kumta , siew sha u patsha ïa kaei kaba lama ka jong u patsha , bad sieb shiah U Blei ïa kaei kaba long ka jong U Blei . Bad ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar s , and to God the things that are God s .  And they marvelled at him .
And said , Behold , I see the heavens opened , and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God .
translation.kha: Ha khmih !  u la ong .  Nga ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad ïa U Khun U Briew ba u ïeng ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei !

translation.en: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the  Lord  , until he hath driven out his enemies from before him ,
translation.kha: Baroh ki rangïapom jong phi kin jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad hapoh ka jingïalam jong U  Trai  ki dei ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong ngi haduh ba U  Trai  un da jop thiaw ïa ki

translation.en: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey , or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards : wilt thou put out the eyes of these men ? we will not come up .
translation.kha: Da shisha , phim shym la ïalam ïa ngi sha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap lane ai ha ngi ïa ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi , bad mynta phi pyrshang ban shukor ïa ngi . Ngim wan !

Ki la rah ïa la ki ryntieh bad ki tiensyiem ; ki long uba runar mala ki bymsngewsynei . Ki sawa kum ka duriaw bakyrhuh , katba ki ïangat ïaid khlur ki kulai . Ki long kiba la pynkhreh ïa ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia .
translation.en: They shall hold the bow and the lance : they are cruel , and will not shew mercy : their voice shall roar like the sea , and they shall ride upon horses , every one put in array , like a man to the battle , against thee , O daughter of Babylon .

translation.kha: Dei ban don hynriew tylli ki tnat kiba maw na baroh kylliang jongnga u , lai tylli na kawei kawei ka liang .
translation.en: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it  ; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side , and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side :

translation.kha: Ha kwah ka per , u Eber u jait Ken u pynïeng la ka dara mariang ïa ka Kedesh hajuh u dieng Sning ha Saanannim . U la kynriah nala na kiwei pat ki jait Ken , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hobab , u kynum jong u Moses .
translation.en: Now Heber the Kenite , which was of the children of Hobab the father in law of Moses , had severed himself from the Kenites , and pitched his tent unto the plain of Zaanannim , which is by Kedesh .
And we have sent with him the brother , whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches ;
translation.kha: Lem bad u ngi phah ïa u parabangeit ïa uba la ñiewburom bha ha baroh ki balang na ka bynta ka jingtrei jong u ha kaba ïalap ïa ka gospel .

translation.en: Therefore judge nothing before the time , until the Lord come , who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness , and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts : and then shall every man have praise of God .
translation.kha: Kumta phim dei ban bishar ïano ïano shuwa ba ka por kaba dei kan poi . Ka jingbishar bakhatduh ka dei ban ap tad ynda U Trai un wan ; un wallam ha ka jingshai ïa ki jingbuhrieh ba-dum bad pynpaw ïa ki jingthmu barieh jong ki jingmut ki briew . Bad nangta uwei pa uwei un ïohpdiang na U Blei ïa ka jingïaroh kaba u dei hok ban ïoh .
Ha ka sngi kaba phra , ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad kdew trei kano kano ka kam .
translation.en: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly : ye shall do no servile work therein :

translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u tei ha u Lum Abel’ ïa ka duwan ha U Trai , U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: Then Joshua built an altar unto the  Lord  God of Israel in mount Ebal ,
Wealth and riches shall be in his house : and his righteousness endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Ka longïing jong u kan long kaba don ba em bad kaba riewspah ; bad un roi kyrhai junom .
Ngan leit sad pynkheiñ ïa u , U Jisu u la ong .
translation.en: And Jesus saith unto him ,  I will come and heal him .

translation.kha: Bad nangta ki Israel ki duwai ïa kano ka jingduwai : Ma me , Ko Trai , tang ma me hi marwei me long U Trai ; me thaw ïa ki banyngkong bad ki khulom jyllang ka sahit bneng . Me thaw ïa ka ryngkew bad ïa ka duriaw-bah bad baroh kiba don ha ki ; me ai jingkem ïa baroh . Ki hab ha bneng ki dem bad ki mian ïa me .
translation.en: Thou , even thou , art  Lord  alone  ; thou hast made heaven , the heaven of heavens , with all their host , the earth , and all things that are therein , the seas , and all that is therein , and thou preservest them all  ; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee .

And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel : and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury  ; and they shall know my vengeance , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki Israel kin pynhiarkput ïa ka Edom namar jong nga , bad kin pynlong ïa ka Edom ban mad ïa ka jingbitar lep jong nga . Ki Edom kin tip ka mut aïu ban shah ha ka jingpynhiarkput jong nga .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
Hynrei , haba ki nongshimwai ki la ïor ïa u , ki la kren para ma ki , ‘ Une u dei u khum jong u trai . To ing ïa-pynïap ïa u , bad ka jingsdang jingem jong u kan long ka jong ngi !’
translation.en: But when the husbandmen saw him , they reasoned among themselves , saying , This is the heir : come , let us kill him , that the inheritance may be ours .

translation.kha: Hadlai kata , un pynïap ïa uta u nongthoh kamon ka jingkñia namar ka nongpop na ka bynta u Paidbah , un rahah ïa ka snam jong u shad ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , bad un synreit ïa ka halor ka jingtap bad ha khmat jong ka Synduk ka Jutang , kumba u la leh da ka Snam jong uta u basa lyngraw .
translation.en: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering , that is for the people , and bring his blood within the veil , and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock , and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat , and before the mercy seat :

Then I said , I will not make mention of him , nor speak any more in his name . But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones , and I was weary with forbearing , and I could not stay .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba nga ong ,  Ngan klet noh ïa U  Trai bad ngan ym kren shuh ha ka kyrteng jong u ,  te ka khubor jong me ka long kum ka ding kaba klang jylliew hapoh jong nga . Nga la pyrshang kat kaba nga lah ban kun ïa ka , hynrei ngam lah ban bat ïa ka .

translation.en: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim , and the horse from Jerusalem , and the battle bow shall be cut off : and he shall speak peace unto the heathen : and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea , and from the river even to the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan weng noh ïa ki kali thma na Israel bad shim ïa ki kulai na Jerusalem ; ïa ki ryntieh ba la pyndonkam ha ka thma yn pynjot . U syiem jong phi un pynlong jingïasuk hapdeng ki jaitbynriew ; un synshar na ka duriaw sha ka duriaw , na ka wah Ïuphratis sha kiba kut jong ka pyrthei .
Nangta u sei ïa ki jaiñ bad ki jingnang mata bad ksiar , sad u ai ïa ki ha ka Rebekka . U ai ruh ïa ki jingai kiba kor ïa u hynmen bad ïa ka kmie jngai ka .
translation.en: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment , and gave them to Rebekah : he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga nguh ha phi : lapbah uno uno u briew u pyllait noh ïa la ka rnga , na ka bynta kano kano ka daw lait nong na ka jingbymngeit jongki ka , te u long uba la shah riam ha kaba pynlong ïa ka banbeiñ klim lada ka shongdor baïong ; mala u briew uba shongkurim ïa ka , u ruh u kyllum .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That whosoever shall put away his wife , saving for the cause of fornication , causeth her to commit adultery : and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery .
And God looked upon the earth , and , behold , it was corrupt  ; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth .
translation.kha: U Blei u la khmih ïa ka pyrthei bad u la ïohi ba ka la sniew , namar ki briew baroh ki la im ka jingim kaba sniew .

translation.en: And here is the mind which hath wisdom . The seven heads are seven mountains , on which the woman sitteth .
translation.kha: Kane ka khot ïa ka jingstad bad jingshemphang . Ki hynñiew tylli ki khlieh ki long hynñiew tylli ki lum , ha kiba kata ka briew ka shong . Ki long ruh ki hynñiew ngut ki syiem :
NGA ong ha pa , ki paralok jong sa , wat sheptieng ïa kito kiba pynïap ïa ka met hynne ki bym lah Hadien ban leh ïa kano kano kaba kham sniew .
translation.en: And I say unto you my friends , Be not afraid of them that kill the body , and after that have no more that they can do .

translation.kha: hynne haduh kane ka sngi um pat shym la ai ha pa’ ban shemphang ïa kaei kaba phi la mad .
translation.en: Yet the  Lord  hath not given you an heart to perceive , and eyes to see , and ears to hear , unto this day .

When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate , and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full , when I shall smite all them that dwell therein , then shall they know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ynda nga la pynlong kynjah ïa ka Ijipt bad pynjot noh ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka , kin sa tip ba nga long U Trai .
Hynñiew ngan sa pynkhih ïa kane ka nongbah bad ki brup jong ka bad kan pynïoh pat ha ki ïa ka jingkoit jingkhiah . Ngan pyndum ha ki ïa ka jingsuk karai pynlang ka jingshahthngan .
translation.en: Behold , I will bring it health and cure , and I will cure them , and will reveal unto them the abundance of peace and truth .

translation.kha: ki San ngut ki syntiat ki rung beit shapoh ïing bad ki shim ïa kata ka blei ba la suit da ka rupa , kiwei pat ruh ki bleithaw , bad ïa ka ephod , katba u lyngdoh u dang ïeng ha ka khrud bad ki hynriewspah thut ki rangbah kaba la kieng atiar .
translation.en: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up , and came in thither , and took the graven image , and the ephod , and the teraphim , and the molten image : and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war .

And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me , Write , Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth : Yea , saith the Spirit , that they may rest from their labours  ; and their works do follow them .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na bneng kaba ong ,  To thoh ïa kane : Suk kito kiba naduh mynta ki ïap ha kaba shakri ïa U Trai !   Ho-oid shisha !  U Mynsiem u jubab .  Kin ïoh shongthait na ki jingtrei shitom jong ki , namar ki soh ka jingshakri jong ki , ki leit lem bad ki .
U Jonathan u ong , Ngan har ïa kano Kane kaba phi khiew .
translation.en: Then said Jonathan unto David , Whatsoever thy soul desireth , I will even do it for thee .

translation.kha: Ki joit Manasseh kim skhem la beh noh ïa ki briew kiba shong lehrain ha Beth Shan , Taanakh , Dor , Ibleam , Megiddo bad ha ki nongrit kiba hajan ; ki Kanah ki dang shong hangta .
translation.en: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Beth–shean and her towns , nor Taanach and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns : but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .
For thus saith the  Lord   ; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people , so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them .
translation.kha: Kumba nga la wallam ïa kane ka jingjot ha kine ki briew , kumta ruh ngan ai ïa ki baroh kiei kiei kiba bha kiba nga la kular .

translation.en: And the whole valley of the dead bodies , and of the ashes , and all the fields unto the brook of Kidron , unto the corner of the horse gate toward the east , shall be holy unto the  Lord   ; it shall not be plucked up , nor thrown down any more for ever .
translation.kha: Ka them baroh kawei , ha kaba la tep ïa kiba ïap bad ha kaba la bret ïa ki jakhlia , bad baroh ki pyntha shaneng ka wah Kidron haduh ka Khyrdop Kulai shaphang mihngi , kin long kiba kyntang ha nga . Ka nongbah kan ym shah pynpra shuh lane shah pynjot .
( Hebru 11 :4–12 :1 ) Kumba u briew u sakhi na ka bynta jong uwei pat u balieh ha ka ïingbishar , ngi ruh ngi la rah skhem ban ïashoh ïa ka jingrisa shaphang U Blei jong ngi .
translation.en: ( Hebrews 11 :4–12 :1 ) Just as an individual may bear witness in court in behalf of an innocent person , we are determined to make known the truth about our God .

translation.kha: Ki nongwan jong me kim tip sahit ba lad pynthnam ïa ki . A Trai , buh ïa ki ha ka jingjahburom bad ai ba kin jynjar ; ai ba kin jynjar da ka jingpynriam kaba me la pynkhreh . To pyn-i ïa ki haduh katno me i-ieit ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: Lord  , when thy hand is lifted up , they will not see : but they shall see , and be ashamed for their envy at the people  ; yea , the fire of thine enemies shall devour them .
That all men should honour the Son , even as they honour the Father . He that honoureth not the Son honoureth not the Father which hath sent him .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym burom ïa U Khun um burom ïa U Kpa uba la phah ïa u .
Kane ka long ka jingong kaba shisha , ïa kaba dei ban ïa-pdiang pura bad ban ngeit .
translation.en: This is a faithful saying and worthy of all acceptation .

translation.kha: Haba ki Ammon ki ïohi ba ki Syria ki la her ïap , ki ruh ki la phet krad na u Abishai bad ki leit rung noh shapoh ka nongbah . Nangta u Jubab u wan phai noh na ka jingïaleh ïa ki Ammon , badno u otsher noh shad Jeruel .
translation.en: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled , then fled they also before Abishai , and entered into the city . So Joab returned from the children of Ammon , and came to Jerusalem .
The enemy said , I will pursue , I will overtake , I will divide the spoil  ; my lust shall be satisfied upon them  ; I will draw my sword , my hand shall destroy them .
translation.kha: U nongshun u ong , ‘ Ngan beh kthong bad kem ïa ki , ngan ïabynta ïa ka spah jong ki , bad ngan shim kat ïa kaba nga mon ; ngan sei ïa la ka waitlam , bad ngan shim ïa baroh kaba ki don .’
U Thomas ( ïa uba la khot uba khah Synrap ) u la nong ha la ki para synran , Ïa ngin ïaleit baroh bad u Nonghikai , ba ngin ïa-ïap ïaryngkat bad u !
translation.en: Then said Thomas , which is called Didymus , unto his fellowdisciples , Let us also go , that we may die with him .

translation.kha: Ym don kaba khuid kaba lah ban woh na ïano kano ka bymkhuid kat ki khunbynriew .
translation.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean ? not one .

translation.kha: Lada phi pynmong ïa la u parabangeit namar kai kaba pa’ baibam , te phim leh shu na ka jingieit . To Wat ai ba ka jingbam kaba pa’ bam kan pynsniew ïa u briew ïa kaba U Khrist u la ïap na ka boitha jong u!
translation.en: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat , now walkest thou not charitably . Destroy not him with thy meat , for whom Christ died .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kabu me dei ban leh ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ban pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh ki ban sharai ïa nga . Shim nawei u smai lyngraw bun ar tylli ki nongaplangbrot shynrang ki bym don jingduna .
translation.en: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them , to minister unto me in the priest s office : Take one young bullock , and two rams without blemish ,

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiwei kiba u Joshua u la leh — ka jingaiti lut jong u sha U Trai , ka jingkohnguh jongno u ïa ka suda , bad ïa ka histori jongnga u naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut — la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Ngim Ka Jeruel Bad Ka Judah .
translation.en: And his deeds , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor jong U Trai : U la riej pynshitom ïa ka ri Hadrakh bad ïa ka nongbah Demetrios . Ym tang ki jait Israel hyndai ka nongbah Syria ruh ka long ka jong U Trai .
translation.en: The burden of the word of the  Lord  in the land of Hadrach , and Damascus shall be the rest thereof : when the eyes of man , as of all the tribes of Israel , shall be toward the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong , Ngan ym shuh ïa ki briew ngab im jingmut , ki long kaba dei banbeiñ ïap . Nangne sha khmat kin im ym palat ïa ka shispah arphew snem .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , My spirit shall not always strive with man , for that he also is flesh : yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years .

translation.kha: shakor ! Na ka bynta kato ka kynhun kaba dem ka jong u Soitan , kito kiba lamler bakha kam ba ki dih ki Siew hynrei kim dei , ngan pynlong ïa ki ban wan bad dem khrup ha ki kjat jong pha . Berakah kin tip ba nga ieit ïa pha .
translation.en: Behold , I will make them of the synagogue of Satan , which say they are Jews , and are not , but do lie  ; behold , I will make them to come and worship before thy feet , and to know that I have loved thee .
And if men strive together , and one smite another with a stone , or with his fist , and he die not , but keepeth his bed :
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki ïakajia , bad uwei u shoh da u maw ne u kura da ka kti ïa uwei pat khlem da pynïap ïa u , yn ym pynshitom ïa u ,
Ko pansngiat , ngi kwah ïa phi ban tip ïa ka jingbishar shaphang tun kiba la ïan , khnang ba phin ym sngewsih , kumba lama kito ki bym don ka jingkyrmen .
translation.en: But I would not have you to be ignorant , brethren , concerning them which are asleep , that ye sorrow not , even as others which have no hope .
If I beheld the sun when it shined , or the moon walking in brightness  ;
translation.kha: Ngam pat ju mane ïa ka sngi ha ka jingthaba jong ka ne ïa u bnai ha ka itynnat jong u baroh .
Kine keiñ ki long ki khun ki ksiew lad u Ham kiba shong ha ki ri kiba pher bapher , bad ha la ka jaitniam ka jait kaba kren ïa la ka jongno ka jong ka ktien .
translation.en: These are the sons of Ham , after their families , after their tongues , in their countries , and in their nations .

translation.kha: Ki pung khait jong ki , ki long kiba beit , bad ki don ki khnap kum ki jong u masi dab , bad ki thaba kumin ka rnong ba la shut pynphyrnai .
translation.en: And their feet were straight feet  ; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf s foot : and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass .

translation.kha: Bad ïa uwei pa uwei umbah kuna bakla yn siew na ka beit kiei kiei kiba bakla kiba u leh , namar U Blei u bishar ïa uei pa uwei da kajuh ka jingthew .
translation.en: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done : and there is no respect of persons .

translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la longïing kum ka sharak , kaba mei Bad kaba tyngshaiñ , bad phi la mon shipor ban lehkmen ha ka jingshai jongngi u .
translation.en: He was a burning and a shining light : and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh hadien lai sngaid . U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u bad u la pynlong ïa u ban ñiew ,
translation.en: Him God raised up the third day , and shewed him openly  ;

translation.kha: bad u shong ha ka jaka ba u ju shong hajan kynroh . U Abner u shong hajan jong u , bad u Jonathan ha pyrshah Jong u .
translation.en: And the king sat upon his seat , as at other times , even upon a seat by the wall : and Jonathan arose , and Abner sat by Saul s side , and David s place was empty .

translation.kha: Me la kem ïa ang ; me dei u nongshun jong nga . Nga la sah sa tang ka snep bad ki jingshaïong , bad ki briew ki shim ïa kata kum ka jingpyrshah ïa ka jingkitpop jngai nga .
translation.en: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles , which is a witness against me : and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face .

translation.kha: Kane ka kitab ka long ka jingbuh jingïathoh ïa ki jingjia kiba U Jisu Kherith u la pynsep . U Blei u la ai ha u ïa kane ka jingpynpaw khnang ban pyn-i ha ki shakri jong u ïa kaei kaba dei ban jied shen . U Khrist u la pynlong ïa kine kiei kiei ba tip da u sharati jong u , u Ïoannis da kaba phah ïa la u duh sha u ,
translation.en: The Revelation of Jesus Christ , which God gave unto him , to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass  ; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John :

translation.kha: Ïa ki jaiñ jongno U Ïoannis la shna da u shñiuh jong ka ut ; u la panpoh da u pnah snieh ha ka syngkai jong u , bad ka jingbam jong u ka la long da ki puit malu ka ngap khlaw .
translation.en: And the same John had his raiment of camel s hair , and a leathern girdle about his loins  ; and his meat was locusts and wild honey .

translation.kha: U Eliada u la long u briew kum ma ngi . U la duli shitrhem ba kan ym hap slap , malu ym shym la hapdeng slap halor ka khñiot haduh kad sngi shiteng .
translation.en: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are , and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain : and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months .

translation.kha: Ho-oid shisha , u Petros u la jubab . Haba u Petros u la rung Shobab ïing , U Jisu u la krung nyngkong , Ko Simon , kaei ka jingpyrkhat jong me ? Mano ba siew ïa ki bai khrong lane ki khajna sha ki symboh jong kane ka pyrta ? Ki traishnong jong ka ri ne ki nongwei ?
translation.en: He saith , Yes . And when he was come into the house , Jesus prevented him , saying ,  What thinkest thou , Simon ? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute ? of their own children , or of strangers ?

translation.kha: dara ki shad katba kad tem ïa ki dulir malu put ïa ki tangmuri .
translation.en: They take the timbrel and harp , and rejoice at the sound of the organ .

translation.kha: Ki la long kiba thuh haduh katta! katta bad uba thngan haduh ba ki bam ïa ki thied tyrkhong — mynmiet , ha khlaw , ha ki jaka kynjah .
translation.en: For want and famine they were solitary  ; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste .
For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor , it is time to thresh her : yet a little while , and the time of her harvest shall come .
translation.kha: Shen u nongshun un ot ïa ki bad un ïuhroit ïa ki kum u kew ha ka jaka tylliat kew . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ki Israel , nga la kren .
bad u Abimelekh u kylli ïa u , phin leh lei kamon ?
translation.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham , What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves ?

translation.kha: dara u la buh ïa ka ha ka jingtep jong u hi , ïa kaba u tdong phan tih shen na u mawsiang . Nangta u la pyntyllun ïa u maw kaba heh na khmat ka kajuh rung sha ka jingtep bad u la leit noh .
translation.en: And laid it in his own new tomb , which he had hewn out in the rock : and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre , and departed .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ba ïa u Ïoannis la thep ha ka ïingjaiñ , u la leit noh sha Galilaïa .
translation.en: Now when Jesus had heard that John was cast into prison , he departed into Galilee  ;

translation.kha: Haba u samla u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la leit noh da kaba sngewsih , namar u la long uba riewspah bha .
translation.en: But when the young man heard that saying , he went away sorrowful : for he had great possessions .

translation.kha: Nga , U Tharai , nga long uba nyngkong ban ïakhot ïa ka Seïon ïa ka khubor ; nga phah ïa u nonglamktien sha Jerusalem pun ong , ‘ Ki briew jongnga phi ki wan ! Ki wan sha ïing !’
translation.en: The first shall say to Zion , Behold , behold them : and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings .

translation.kha: U briew uba nyngkong ban kren ha ka ïingbishar borabor u sngewdei tam haduh ba uba ïaleh pyrshah u sdang ban buh jingkylli ïa u .
translation.en: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just  ; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him .

translation.kha: U Solomon u shna arspah tylli ki stieh kiba ha bad hynñiew kilo ka kiar la pyndonkam ha kawei kawei ka stieh .
translation.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold : six hundred shekels of gold went to one target .

translation.kha: Nga long u paralok jong kito Baroh kiba shatri ïa me , jong baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translation.en: I am a companion of all them that fear thee , and of them that keep thy precepts .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar ba u Nebukhadnessar u long syiem , u la eh ka jingphohsniew . Ka la pynkhuslai shibun eh ïa u kat haduh ba um shym ïohthiah ,
translation.en: And in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams , wherewith his spirit was troubled , and his sleep brake from him .

translation.kha: da kaba ong ha lade , Lada nga Tang shu ïohktah ïa ki jaiñkup jong u , ngan ïoh .
translation.en: For she said , If I may touch but his clothes , I shall be whole .

translation.kha: U la long uba khraw katta katta ba ki briew jong ki hima baroh , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki tyllep ki la sheptieng ïa u bad khynñiuh . lada u la kwah ban pynnep ïano ïano u ni kumta ; lada u kwah ïa-ban ri pynim ïasnoh ïano , u leh kumta . U pyndonburom lane pynjahburom ïa du eit , uba u kwah .
translation.en: And for the majesty that he gave him , all people , nations , and languages , trembled and feared before him : whom he would he slew  ; and whom he would he kept alive  ; and whom he would he set up  ; and whom he would he put down .

translation.kha: Kumta ngi , Wat la ngi long shibun , ngi long kawei ka met ha U Khreh , bad la pynïasoh iwei bad iwei pat kum ki dkhot bapra jong kawei ka met .
translation.en: So we , being many , are one body in Christ , and every one members one of another .

translation.kha: Haba u la wan pat ha ka sien kaba lah , u la ong ïa ki , Hato Phin dang ïohbat bad dang shongduh ? Ka la biang ! Ka kyntiap ka la poi ! Khmih , ïa U ka U Briew yn ai ei myntan ha ka bor jong ki bri kiba pop .
translation.en: And he cometh the third time , and saith unto them ,  Sleep on now , and take your rest : it is enough , the hour is come  ; behold , the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .

Whensoever I take my journey into Spain , I will come to you : for I trust to see you in my journey , and to be brought on my way thitherward by you , if first I be somewhat filled with your company .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban ïakynduh ïa phi ha ka jingleit lynti artat jong nga sha Spain , bad ba phin ïarap ïa nga ha ka jingleit jong nga shata , hadien ba nga la sngewhun ban sah shipor ha ka jingwan khmih ïa phi .

Haba u Saul bad u shakri jong u ki iar ha Gibeah , shi kynum ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïakynduh ïa u . kyrshan kynsan U Mynsiem lad U Blei u wan da ka bor ha u , bad u ïasoh lang bad ki ha ka jingïashad bashemphang bad ha ka jingïarisa .
translation.en: And when they came thither to the hill , behold , a company of prophets met him  ; and the Spirit of God came upon him , and he prophesied among them .

translation.kha: Ki tymmen kim shongsah shuh ha ka khyrdop nongbah , mala ki samla kiei tem jingshim shuh .
translation.en: The elders have ceased from the gate , the young men from their musick .
And he said unto them ,  I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also : for therefore am I sent .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la ong ha ki ,  Nga dei ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima U Blei ha kiwei pat ki shnong ruh , namar kata ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la phah ïa nga ban leh .
Ka nongbah ka khraw haba kiba hok ki kyrkhu ïa ka ; hawei ka nongbah ka jot noh da ki ktien jong ki bymman .
translation.en: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted : but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked .

translation.kha: Ïa u syiem jong ka yn kit noh , kumne ka thah dieng halor um .
translation.en: As for Samaria , her king is cut off as the foam upon the water .
That in every thing ye are enriched by him , in all utterance , and in all knowledge ;
translation.kha: Naba ha U Khrist la pynlong ïa phi kiba man kyrhai ha kiei kiei baroh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingkren bad ka jingtip baroh .
Ki la duh ka jingshlur jong ki bad ki wan da kaba kyiuh na la ki jong ki kut .
translation.en: Strangers shall fade away , and they shall be afraid out of their close places .
Now that the dead are raised , even Moses shewed at the bush , when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob .
translation.kha: Bad u Moses u pynshisha da kaba shai ba ïa kiba ïap la pynmihpat . Ha ka bynta shaphang ka  lawlynnong kaba ing u kren shaphang U Trai kum ‘ U Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei jong u Isaak , bad U Blei jong u Jakob .’

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Depart , and go up hence , thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt , unto the land which I sware unto Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , saying , Unto thy seed will I give it :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Khie ïamihnoh nangne , ma me bad ki paidbah kiba me la ïalam na ka ri Ijipt , bad leit sha kata ka ri ïa kaba nga la kular ban ai ha u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .

translation.en: He shall not depart out of darkness  ; the flame shall dry up his branches , and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away .
translation.kha: Wat ka syrngiew jong u kan jah noh , bad un ym lait na ka jingdum . Un long kum u dieng ïa kiba ki tnat la thang da ka ding , uba ki shylluit la rong noh da ka lyer .

translation.en: But we will bless the  Lord  from this time forth and for evermore . Praise the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma ngi , kiba im , ngin ainguh ïa u mynta bad sha bymjukut . A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed , or my mouth hath kissed my hand :
translation.kha: Ym pat la ïalam bakla ïa nga ban burom ïa ki da kaba doh ïa la ki kti kum ka jingnguh ïa ki .

translation.en: And Isaiah said , Take a lump of figs . And they took and laid it on the boil , and he recovered .
translation.kha: Nangta u Isaïah u ong ha kiba synran ïa u syiem ban tah ha u tohjaw da i symboh ba la shna na ki soh Dumbur , bad un ïohkhiah .

translation.en: Therefore thou shalt love the  Lord  thy God , and keep his charge , and his statutes , and his judgments , and his commandments , alway .
translation.kha: Ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad ïai kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh .

Pynban ym don uno uno uba kah shisha ban tei ka Templ na ka boitha U Bel , namar wat ka jingïar jongngi ka bneng kam ha ban ngiam ïa u . Kumno te nga lah ban teh ka Templ ka ban long kaba kumno kumno kaba khnam heh ban ïa ka jaka ïa-ban thang jingiwbih ïa U Blei ?
translation.en: But who is able to build him an house , seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him ? who am I then , that I should build him an house , save only to burn sacrifice before him ?

translation.kha: U dei ban shong bun phi kum u nongtrei bad shakri ïa phi haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .
translation.en: But as an hired servant , and as a sojourner , he shall be with thee , and shall serve thee unto the year of jubilee :
But be shod with sandals  ; and not put on two coats .
translation.kha: Phong ïa ki juti , hynrei wat rah sopti nalor kaba phi la phong .

translation.en: And when he putteth forth his own sheep , he goeth before them , and the sheep follow him : for they know his voice .
translation.kha: Haba u la pynmih ïa ki shabar , u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki , bad ki langbrot ki bud ïa u , namar ba ki sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u .
Ki pyrkhat ba ka niam ka longkmie ka lynti ban riewspah .
translation.en: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds , and destitute of the truth , supposing that gain is godliness : from such withdraw thyself .
As I live , saith the  Lord  , though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand , yet would I pluck thee thence  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u syiem Jehoïakhin , u khun jong u Jehoïakim u syiem ka Judah ,  Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei Uba im . Wat la me long kum ka sati muhor ha ka kti kamon jong nga , ngan weng noh ïa me ,
Hobab u Saul u wan phai na kaba ïaleh ïa ki Philistia , la ïathuh ha u ba u Dabid u don ha ka ri khlaw hajan Edrei .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Saul was returned from following the Philistines , that it was told him , saying , Behold , David is in the wilderness of En–gedi .

translation.kha: Ym don mynshem mane ba bahryntieh ïa kaei kaba u ai lada u kwah ba kiwei ngin tip . Naba me leh ïa kine kiei kiei , to ai ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan tip shngain jong me !
translation.en: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret , and he himself seeketh to be known openly . If thou do these things , shew thyself to the world .
