translation.kha: Kynmaw ba kumba u kpa u sneng pynbeit ïa la u Kynhun , kumta ruh U Trai U Blei jong phi u sneng pynbeit ïa phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart , that , as a man chasteneth his son , so the  Lord  thy God chasteneth thee .

translation.kha: Ha ki hynriew snoh to thung to tep ha la ka lyngkha , bad lum ïa ki jingmih jong ka .
translation.en: And six years thou shalt sow thy land , and shalt gather in the fruits thereof :
And Onan knew that the seed should not be his  ; and it came to pass , when he went in unto his brother s wife , that he spilled it on the ground , lest that he should give seed to his brother .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Onan u la tip ba ki khun kin ym long ki jong u , kumta haba u ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga u hynmen jong u , u pynhap noh ïa la u symbai sharud , khnang ban yn ym pynïoh khun ïa u hynmen jong u .
Baroh kin tip ba nga ïada ïa ki Jerusalem’ bad ba ki long ki briew jong nga . Ma ar , U thri Nongsynshar , de la kren .
translation.en: Thus shall they know that I the  Lord  their God am with them , and that they , even the house of Israel , are my people , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ka por ka iar ha kaba ïa ka Tyros yn klet noh hynñiewphew snem , kat ka rta u syiem . Haba nia ki snep ki la kut noh , ka Tyros kan long kumta ka nuti ha ka jingrwai :
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years , according to the days of one king : after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot .
But if thou fear to go down , go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada me sheptieng ban tur ïaleh , leit hiar sha ka jaka sher dara lem bad u Purah u shakri jong me .

Suk uta uba pule ïa kane ka kitab , bad suki kito kiba shahshkor ïa ki ktien jong kane ka khubor jong ka jingïathuhlypa bad kiba kohnguh ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha kan ka kitab ! Naba ka por ka la jan haba baroh kine kiei kiei kin sa jia .
translation.en: Blessed is he that readeth , and they that hear the words of this prophecy , and keep those things which are written therein : for the time is at hand .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ïaid hok ki sohshnong bad sngewskhem , hynne uta u lai lehhok un shah kumta .
translation.en: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely : but he that perverteth his ways shall be known .

Therefore the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the Lord , saith thus  ; Wailing shall be in all streets  ; and they shall say in all the highways , Alas ! alas ! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning , and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing .
translation.kha: Bad kumta U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh , u ong ,  Kan don ka jinglynñiar bad ki jingïam sngewsih ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah . Wat ïa ki nongrep yn khot ban ïam na ka bynta kiba ïap lem bad kito ïa kiba lah da siew ban ïambriew .
U Jisu u la wait pei biang sha shiliang ka wah Johanan sha ka jaka ha kaba u —Ïoannis u la ju pynbaptis , bad u la sah hangta .
translation.en: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized  ; and there he abode .

translation.kha: Kanaan ka lama kaei kambah u ong , ‘ U Jeroboam un ïap ha ka thma , bad ki briew ka Israel kin shah ringmraw na la ka ri .’
translation.en: For thus Amos saith , Jeroboam shall die by the sword , and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la kun pop ibiang pyrshah ïa U Trai . Namar khnai keiñ U Trei u la pynkitkhlieh ïa u Eglon u syiem ka Moab ban ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord  : and the  Lord  strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel , because they had done evil in the sight of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Abraham u la ong , ‘ Lada kim shahshkor ïa u Moses bad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , yn ym lah ban pynngeit ïa ki wat lada uno Uno un mihpat na ka jingïap .’
translation.en: And he said unto him , If they hear not Moses and the prophets , neither will they be persuaded , though one rose from the dead .

translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la leit nep bad ki la pynlong ka jingthmu ban riam ïa U Jisu da ki jingïatylli .
translation.en: Then went the Pharisees , and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk .

Cut off the sower from Babylon , and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest : for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people , and they shall flee every one to his own land .
translation.kha: Wat ai ba yn bet ïa ki symbai ha kata ka ri lane ai ba yn lum ïa ka jingmih . Man uwei pa uwei u nongwei uba shong hangta un sheptieng ïa ka kynhun shipai ba tur ïaleh bad ban leit phai ïing .

translation.en: So Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces , and all the people , obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  , to dwell in the land of Judah .
translation.kha: Kumta ym u Johanan lymne uno uno na ki rangbah shipai lymne kino kino na ki paidbah kin kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  ban ïaisah ha ka ri Judah .

translation.en: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron , and said , Go ye , sacrifice to your God in the land .
translation.kha: Te u Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u la ong ,  Khie leit bad ai jingkñia ha U Blei jong phi hangne ha kane ka ri .

bad ki ong ha u , Peit , phi te mynta phi la tymmen , bad ki khun jong Phi kim shym bud ïa ka nuksa jong phi . Kumta , thung noh da u syiem ban synshar halor jong ngi , ba Kumta ngin don noh la u Syiem kumba kiwei pat ki ri ki dat .
translation.en: And said unto him , Behold , thou art old , and thy sons walk not in thy ways : now make us a king to judge us like all the nations .

translation.kha: To sumar ba phin ym ibeiñ ïasnoh ïano na ktien kiba ryñiot . Ki Angel jong ki ha Bteng , at ong ha phi , ki ïai don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .
translation.en: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones  ; for I say unto you , That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven .

translation.kha: ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem bad ki paralok jong nga kim don shuh .
translation.en: My kinsfolk have failed , and my familiar friends have forgotten me .

translation.kha: Bad U Isaïah u la pyrta shaphang ki Israel : Wat lada ki paid Israel ki bun kat u shyiap harud duriaw , pynban tang khyndiat na ki yn pynim ;
translation.en: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel , Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea , a remnant shall be saved :

According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee , and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee , thou shalt do : thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee , to the right hand , nor to the left .
translation.kha: Pdiang ïa ka rai jong ki bad leh thik kumba ki bthah ïa phi .
Hato me lai ba teh nur-um ïa ki Pleïades , ne pynsynjor ïa ki jingkhum kiba Tei ïa u Orion ?
translation.en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades , or loose the bands of Orion ?

translation.kha: U pynïeng ruh ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah . U leh shibun ban pynkhih bitar ïa U Trai , U blang ki Israel , kham palat ban ïa ki syiem Israel barabor ha shu jong u .
translation.en: And Ahab made a grove  ; and Ahab did more to provoke the  Lord  God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him .

translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ïa at bad ki la ai jingkñia ha kiwei ki blei , bad kumta ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jingbitar jong per da baroh kaba ki la leh . Ka jingbitar jong nga ka la khie buk , bad sam ym pynjah kumto .
translation.en: Because they have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands  ; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place , and shall not be quenched .

translation.kha: Ki Lebi kin kren ïa kine ki ktien ha ka sur kaba ïam :
translation.en: And the Levites shall speak , and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice ,

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Pynsawa ïa ka jingmaham ! Ki nongshun ki hiar kynsan shapoh ha ka ri jong nga kum ki pukni ! Ki briew jong to ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jrong kaba nga la ïateh bad ki , bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jinghikai jong nga .
translation.en: Set the trumpet to thy mouth . He shall come as an eagle against the house of the  Lord  , because they have transgressed my covenant , and trespassed against my law .
He hath bent his bow , and set me as a mark for the arrow .
translation.kha: U la sei ïa ka ryntieh jong u bad u pynlong ïa nga ka sohpdung ïa ki khnam jong u .

translation.en: And upon a set day Herod , arrayed in royal apparel , sat upon his throne , and made an oration unto them .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba la ïakut , u Herod u la phong ki jaiñkup syiem , u la shong halor ka khet jong u , bad u la kren ha u paidbah .

U la tei ïa ka kat koum ki jingtah ba u Moses , u shakri jong U Trai’ u la ai ha ki Israel , kumba la thoh ha ka Politics u Moses : Ka duwan ba la twa da ki maw ki bymlah khim la shtah da ki tiar nar . Habor jong ka ki la step ïa ki jingkñia ha U Trai , bad ki la ainguh ruh ïa ki jingainguh jingïasyllok .
translation.en: As Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded the children of Israel , as it is written in the book of the law of Moses , an altar of whole stones , over which no man hath lift up any iron : and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the  Lord  , and sacrificed peace offerings .

translation.kha: U shuh ha ka Templ ïa baroh ki tiar kiba u Abijah u kper jong u , u la pynkyntang sha U Blei , kamut ruh ïa ki tiar ba la sha da ka ksiar bad ka rupa kob u hi u la pynkyntang .
translation.en: And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated , and that he himself had dedicated , silver , and gold , and vessels .
It came to pass after this also , that the children of Moab , and the children of Ammon , and with them other beside the Ammonites , came against Jehoshaphat to battle .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , ki kynhun shipai jong ka Moab bad ka Ammon , ryngkat bad kiba ïateh lok bad ki , ki Meun , ki hiarthma ïa ka Judah .
Kumjuh jin , ka rukom riam jongnga ngi ha ki jingïaleh ka pynjai ba ngi bur ïa “U Nongbishar ka pyrthei baher kiwei ,” U Blei Jehobah , nabar ïa ka jaka kaba ngi mane ïa u . —Jenesis 18 :21 .
translation.en: Likewise , the way we appear at meetings shows our esteem for “the Judge of all the earth ,” Jehovah God , and for the place where we worship him . —Genesis 18 :25 .
If I do not the works of my Father , believe me not .
translation.kha: Wat ngeit ïa nga , namarkata , lada ngam leh ïa kiei kiei kiba U Kpa jong nga u kwah ïa nga ban leh .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar , and will set it  ; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one , and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent :
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan shim ïa ka kliar jong u dieng Kedar bajrong bad kdiah ïa i shylluit balung ; ngan thung ïa i halor u lum bakynjang ,

translation.en: Behold the day , behold , it is come : the morning is gone forth  ; the rod hath blossomed , pride hath budded .
translation.kha: Ka sngi jong ka jingjot ka la wan ïa ka Israel . Ka jingleh jubor ka nang roi . Ka jingsarong ka ïeng rasong .

translation.en: These are the words of the covenant , which the  Lord  commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab , beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki ktien jong kata ka jutang ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses ban pynlong bad ki Israel ha ka ri ki Moab ; kane baroh ka la long ka jingbynrap shuh shuh halor kata ka jutang kaba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad ki ha u Lum Sinai .
Ngi khot sngewbha ïa phi ban wan sha ka jingïalang jongnga ngi , phin sa mad hi dalade ïa kine kiei kiei .
translation.en: Why not accept this invitation to attend our congregation’s next meeting and experience these things for yourself ?

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingpynpaw jong u yn wallam da U Blei ha ka ïa ka bneng , uba la kyrkhu bad tang ma u hi , U Nongsynshar , U Syiem jyllang ki syiem bad U Trai jong ki trai .
translation.en: Which in his times he shall shew , who is the blessed and only Potentate , the King of kings , and Lord of lords ;
And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar : but the breast shall be Aaron s and his sons .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un thang ïa kata ka khleiñ ha ka duwan , hynrei kata ka shadem kan dei jong ki lyngdoh .
Shu bret ïa u ha kane ka pukri hangne ha ka ri khlaw , hynrei wat pynsyier ïa u . U ong kamet namar ba u mut ban pyllew im ïa u na ki , bad pun phar pat ïa u shuh la u kpa .
translation.en: And Reuben said unto them , Shed no blood , but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness , and lay no hand upon him  ; that he might rid him out of their hands , to deliver him to his father again .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet u Eli , uba la kham byrni ki khmat , u thiah ha la ka kamra ;
translation.en: And it came to pass at that time , when Eli was laid down in his place , and his eyes began to wax dim , that he could not see  ;

translation.kha: Ka la long ha kaba kum kane ka Por ba ka la don ka jingeh kaba jur ha Ephesos namar ka ryntih jong U Trai .
translation.en: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way .

translation.kha: Mynta to kynroh aïu phi la long , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , mynba U Blei u la khot ïa phi . Na ka pipa kaba kynja briew tieng khyndiat na phi , phi la long kiba stad ne kaba khlaiñbor ne kiba don kyrdoh katba Halor ha ka imlang shang .
translation.en: For ye see your calling , brethren , how that not many wise men after the flesh , not many mighty , not many noble , are called :

translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt ktien dei ki blei — ki long tang ki briew . Ki kulai jong ki kim dei kita babha don ka bol bapalat liam . Haba U Trai u twa , ka hima bakhlaiñbor kan khyllipmat , bad ka hima batlot bor kaba ka ïapra ka kyrdon . Baroh ar na ki kin shah pynjot .
translation.en: Now the Egyptians are men , and not God  ; and their horses flesh , and not spirit . When the  Lord  shall stretch out his hand , both he that helpeth shall fall , and he that is holpen shall fall down , and they all shall fail together .

translation.kha: Don kadei ka shata syntiew harum ki lai jur ki tnat bakha mih na u diengpynïeng shrak .
translation.en: And a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , according to the six branches going out of it .

translation.kha: Nangta ki leit rah ïa ka sha ka templ u phai jongu ki , u Dagon , badno ki buh ïa ka ha synduk u mot jongnga u .
translation.en: When the Philistines took the ark of God , they brought it into the house of Dagon , and set it by Dagon .

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , ka jait Ephraim bad ka jait Manasseh ba shuh Sepngi , ki la ïa-ïohpdiang ïa kane ka ri kum ka jingkynrei jongu ki .
translation.en: So the children of Joseph , Manasseh and Ephraim , took their inheritance .

translation.kha: Nangta uwei na ki uba kirteng u Harbonah , u ong , U Hammath u la dep ïada shaphrang ha kaba u la shna ïa ka diengphasi ha ka ïing jong u khnang ba un phasi ïa u Mordekai , uba pyllut ïa ka jingim jong phi , ko syiad . Bun ka long kaba rnong arphew ar mitar ! Sdien phasi ïa u Haman ha ka ! u syiem u hukum .
translation.en: And Harbona , one of the chamberlains , said before the king , Behold also , the gallows fifty cubits high , which Haman had made for Mordecai , who had spoken good for the king , standeth in the house of Haman . Then the king said , Hang him thereon .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duk ki long ki mraw jong u briew bariewspah , pan kylliang pisa bad phin long u mraw jong u nongai ram .
translation.en: The rich ruleth over the poor , and the borrower is servant to the lender .
For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day  ; that I should remove it from before my face ,
translation.kha: Ki briew jong kane ka nongbah ki la pynbitar bad pynbitar shla ïa nga naduh ka sngi ba la thaw ïa ka .

translation.en: If his master have given him a wife , and she have born him sons or daughters  ; the wife and her children shall be her master s , and he shall go out by himself .
translation.kha: Lada u kynrad jong u , u pynïoh ïa u ka tnga , bad ka ïoh khun shynrang ne kynthei na u , kata ka briew bad ki khun jong ka kin long ki jong u kynrad jong ka , bad uta u briew un mihnoh tang marwei .

translation.en: Wherefore ( as the Holy Ghost saith , To day if ye will hear his voice ,
translation.kha: Kumta te , kumba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ong ;  Lada phi ïohsngew ïa ka sur ka jong U Blei ha kane ka sngi ,

Ngi baroh ngi la long kum ki lumlang ba la sakma , uwei pa wai na ine u leit ha la ka jong ka lynti . Hynrei U Trai u la pynlong ba ka jingpynshitom kan khap halor jong u , ka jingpynshitom kaban baroh ngi dei hok ban ïoh .
translation.en: All we like sheep have gone astray  ; we have turned every one to his own way  ; and the  Lord  hath laid on him the iniquity of us all .
Then came the first , saying , Lord , thy pound hath gained ten pounds .
translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u la wan bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga la kamai shiphew tylli ki sbai ksiar da kawei kaba me la ai ha nga .’
ngam pynstet ïa ki bleithaw nabar ki rishot maw bakyntang jong phi ; phin ym manna Shua ïa keiñ kiei kiba phi hi phi la thaw .
translation.en: Thy graven images also will I cut off , and thy standing images out of the midst of thee  ; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands .

translation.kha: Lada phi long uba jaipdeh , phin ym ïoh da lei lei ïa kaei kaba phi kwah banbeiñ long hadien , hynrei lada phi trei minot , phin ïoh spah .
translation.en: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting : but the substance of a diligent man is precious .
She looketh well to the ways of her household , and eateth not the bread of idleness .
translation.kha: Ka long borabor kaba smat kaba sting bad ka khmih ïa ki jingdonkam ha ka longïing jong ka .
nangta ka phah teh jin ïa ka kali , bad ka hukum ïa u shrak , Pynïaid stet ïa ka kada katba ka lah , pynlang waiñ pynsuk , lymda nga ïa-ong ïa me ban leh kumta .
translation.en: Then she saddled an ass , and said to her servant , Drive , and go forward  ; slack not thy riding for me , except I bid thee .
And take every man his censer , and put incense in them , and bring ye before the  Lord  every man his censer , two hundred and fifty censers  ; thou also , and Aaron , each of you his censer .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi un rah ïa la u khiew buh ding , un buh hangta ïa ka jingiwbih , bad nangta un wanrah ïa ka sha ka duwan .
A Trai , to pynshitom ïa kito ki riewkhñium ! To kynmaw ïa kito kiba shahshitom !
translation.en: Arise , O  Lord   ; O God , lift up thine hand : forget not the humble .

And by the borders of the children of Manasseh , Beth–shean and her towns , Taanach and her towns , Megiddo and her towns , Dor and her towns . In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew u Manasseh ki pynïaid ïa ki nongbah jong ka Beth Shan , ka Taanakh , ka Megiddo , bad ka Dor , bad ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ki . Kine baroh ki dei ki jaka ha kiba ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph , u khun jong u Jakob , ki shong ki sah .
Ka jingkhuid ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat : Lada ine pyndap ïa ki jingmut jingpynkhiah jong ngi da kiei ktien kiba khuid , ka jinglong jong ngi ruh kan longsyiem kaba khuid .
translation.en: Mental Cleanness : If we fill our minds with clean , pure thoughts , our conduct will also be clean .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kaba U Troas Nongsynshar u ong : Kawei ka jingjynjar hadien kawei pat kan wan ha pha .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; An evil , an only evil , behold , is come .

translation.kha: Ym don kaei pah ka jyrthiaw ha ka pyrthiew kum ki Israel , ïa kaba me la pyllait im na ka jinglongmraw ban pynurlong ïa ki ka jaitbynriew jong me . Kiei kiei ki bakhraw bad baphylla kiba me la leh na ka boitha jong ki , ki pynphriang ïa ka kita jong me kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei . Me la pyllait im ïa ki briew lad me na Ijipt bad pynher kparad ïa kiwei ki jingpyniwbih katba ki briew jong me ki nang tuh shaphrang .
translation.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel , whom God went to redeem to be his own people , to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness , by driving out nations from before thy people , whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt ?

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la ong , lada ka ri ka leh pop bad kam ïaheh ha de , len kner ïa ka kti jong nga bad pyndkoh ïa ka jingpyndap jingbam jong ka . Ngan phah ïa ka nemsniew bad pynïap ïa ki briew’ bad ki mrad kumjuh .
translation.en: Son of man , when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously , then will I stretch out mine hand upon it , and will break the staff of the bread thereof , and will send famine upon it , and will cut off man and beast from it :

translation.kha: Kainan ka long kata ka sah na ka bynda uta u briew uba ïoh ïa ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh hynrei u bym kotbor ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh kumba ju long ka rukom ïa kiba yn pyndonkam ha ka jingpynkhuid ïa u .
translation.en: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy , whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing .

translation.kha: Kane ka jingriam ka long ka jingkynmaw , kum kaei kaei kaba la tah ha ka kti jong ngi ne ha ka shyllangmat jong ngi ; kan pynkieng ïa ngi ba U Trai u la ïalam noh ïa I na ka ri Joppa da ka borbah lad u .’
translation.en: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand , and for frontlets between thine eyes : for by strength of hand the  Lord  brought us forth out of Egypt .
Wherefore ye must needs be subject , not only for wrath , but also for conscience sake .
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw phi dei ban kohnguh ïa ki bor synshar — ym tang namar ka jingpynshitom U Blei , hynrei na ka bynta ka jingïatiplem ruh .
To kynmaw ïa film ki hukum bad ñiewburom ïa ki . Teh ïa ki ha ki ksang ti jong phi bad deng ïa ki ha ki shyllangmat jong Phin khim ka jingpynkynmaw .
translation.en: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul , and bind them for a sign upon your hand , that they may be as frontlets between your eyes .

translation.kha: Kam lei lei , hikai ïa nga ; ïathuh ha nga ïa ki jingbakla jong nga . Ngan sngapjar jar bad shahshkor ïa phi .
translation.en: Teach me , and I will hold my tongue : and cause me to understand wherein I have erred .

translation.kha: Pynkylla ïa kata ka sngi shaei ka jingdum , A Blei . Wat kynmaw shuh ïa kata ka sngi ; Wat ai ba ka jingshai kad tyngshaiñ pat halor jngai ka .
translation.en: Let that day be darkness  ; let not God regard it from above , neither let the light shine upon it .

translation.kha: U Blei u longïing umbah donbor ; baroh ki dem ïa-ban ïeng ha ka jingsheptieng ïa u ; U pynïeng ïa ka hima ba kyntur bneng ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Dominion and fear are with him , he maketh peace in his high places .
Take heed therefore that the light which is in thee be not darkness .
translation.kha: Pynthikna , te , ba ka jingshai hapoh jong phi kam dei ka jingdum .

U Meremoth , u khun jong u Uriah Bad u ksiew jong u Hakkos u tei ïa ka bynta kabu bud . U Meshullam , u khun jong u Berekhaïah bad u ksiew jong u Meshesabel u tei ïa ka byndi kaba bud . U Sadok , u khun jongno u Baanah u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bujli .
translation.en: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah , the son of Koz . And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah , the son of Meshezabeel . And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baanah .
For first of all , when ye come together in the church , I hear that there be divisions among you ; and I partly believe it .
translation.kha: Ha kaba nyngkong eh , la ïathuh ïa nga ba ha ki jingïaseng jong phi , ki don ki kynhun kiba ïa-pyrshah ; bad kane nga ngeit ka don katto katne ka jingshisha .

translation.en: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper : and one is hungry , and another is drunken .
translation.kha: Naba katba phi dang ïabam , phi ïabam shuwa ïa la ka jong ka jingbam miet , te don kiba la thngan katba kiwei ki lah da buaid .

translation.en: And these bottles of wine , which we filled , were new  ; and , behold , they be rent : and these our garments and our shoes are become old by reason of the very long journey .
translation.kha: Haba ngi pyndap ïa kine ki pla snieh waiñ , ki dang thymmai , hynrei ha khmih ! Ki la jot . Ki jaiñ bad ki juti jong ngi ki la jot namar ka jingïaid lynti kaba jngai .
Wat ngeit ïa nga , namarkata , lade ngam leh ïa kiei ki kiba U Kpa jong per u kwah ïa nga ban imat .
translation.en: If I do not the works of my Father , believe me not .

translation.kha: La iehnoh ïa nga Moraïah hangta , da kaba khmih ïa kane ka jingïohmap kaba phylla . Ngam donbor thuh , bad ka durkhmat jongngi nga ka la kylluid dur haduh katta katta ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban ithuh ïa to .
translation.en: Therefore I was left alone , and saw this great vision , and there remained no strength in me : for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption , and I retained no strength .

translation.kha: Wat sngewlyngngoh ha Kanah ; ba ka por kan wiang haba baroh kiba ïap kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u bun kin mihnoh na ki jingtep jong ki : Kito kiba la leh ïa kaba bha kin mihpat bad kin im , bad kito kiba la leh ïa kaba sniew kin mihpat bad yn pynrem ïa ki .
translation.en: And shall come forth  ; they that have done good , unto the resurrection of life  ; and they that have done evil , unto the resurrection of damnation .
And I said unto them , If ye think good , give me my price  ; and if not , forbear . So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ha ki ,  Lada phi mon , to ai ïa ka bainong jong nga . Hynrei lada kam long kumta , to bat noh ïa ka .  Kumta ki la siew ïa nga laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa kum ka bainong jong nga .

translation.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel , like as did the house of Ahab : for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife : and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U bud ïa ka jingleh bymman jong u Syiem Ahab bad kiwei pat ki syiem Israel , namar u la shongkurim ïa kawei na ki khun kynthei jong u Ahab , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ,
Ïa ka doh kñia dei ban bam ha kajuh ka sngi ba la pynïap ïa uta u mrad lane ha ka sngi kaba bud . Ïa kano kano ka doh kaba dang sah haduh ka sngem kaba lai daym ban thang noh ,
translation.en: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it , and on the morrow : and if ought remain until the third day , it shall be burnt in the fire .

translation.kha: U Moses u la leit kiew ïa u Lum synñia , bad u lyiur u tapmoh ïa uta u lwa .
translation.en: And Moses went up into the mount , and a cloud covered the mount .

translation.kha: Mynta , ma phi , ki nongaplangbrot jong nga , phi long ki khun U Blei na ka jingkular jong u , kitab ka la long bad u Isaak .
translation.en: Now we , brethren , as Isaac was , are the children of promise .

With the work of an engraver in stone , like the engravings of a signet , shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel : thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold .
translation.kha: Wad ïa u bania uba tbit ba un ohdur ha kita ki ar tylli ki mawkordor ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob bad pynshong ïa ki ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar .
Ynda u Long syiem , u dei ban don kopi ïa ka babha jyllang ki aiñ U Blei! bad ki jingjai kaba la shla na ka kat aiñ kaba ki lyngdoh Lebi ki bat .
translation.en: And it shall be , when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom , that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of that which is before the priests the Levites :

translation.kha: Baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ki la klun shaphang jong u , da kaba ong ba un uno uba ngeit ha u un ïoh ka jingmap ïa ki pop lyngngai ka bor jrong ka kyrteng jong u .
translation.en: To him give all the prophets witness , that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , To ïeng joit , to rai ïa la ka jingïathoh , bad to ïaid .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Rise , take up thy bed , and walk .
And laid their hands on the apostles , and put them in the common prison .
translation.kha: Ki la kem ïa ki apostol bad ki la set ha ka phatok .

translation.en: As the  Lord  hath been with my lord the king , even so be he with Solomon , and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la don ryngkat bad u Syiem Kynrad , kumta ruh ai un don ryngkat bad u Solomon , bad pynlong ïa ka jingsynshar jong u kaba kham roi ban ïa ka jong phi .
Hynrei U Jisu u la ong , jhieh ïa ka marwei ! Balah ba phi pynwit ïa ka ? Ka la sa ïa kaei kaei kabu bha bad ba-itynnat na ka bynta jong nga .
translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Let her alone  ; why trouble ye her ? she hath wrought a good work on me .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki la ong ha ki Israhaïah baroh , Ha kane ka janmiet , phin tip ba dei U Trai uba la wallam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel , At even , then ye shall know that the  Lord  hath brought you out from the land of Egypt :

And I have heard of thee , that thou canst make interpretations , and dissolve doubts : now if thou canst read the writing , and make known to me the interpretation thereof , thou shalt be clothed with scarlet , and have a chain of gold about thy neck , and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom .
translation.kha: Mynta nga la ïohsngew ba me lah ban shem ïa ki jingmut barieh bad batai ïa ki jingmaïan . Lada me lah ban pule ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ïathuh ïa nga aïu ka kit jingmut , yn pynkup ïa me ha ki jaiñkup syiem ba sawbthuh , yn pyndeng ha me ïa u kynjri ksiar jong ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jong me , bad men long uba lai ha ka bor hapoh ka hima .
U Jisu u la pynlut ïa kita ki sngi da kaba hikai ha ka Templ , bad haba ka janmiet ka la poi , u ju mihnoh shabar bad pynlut ïa ka miej ha u lum ki Seeb .
translation.en: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple  ; and at night he went out , and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives .

translation.kha: ngan pynlong ïa ki briew Ibbah ïeng pyrshah ïa phi ban sheptieng ïa nga ; ngan pynkulmar thlim ïa kito kiba phi ïaleh pyrshah , bad ngan pynthor krad ïa ki nongshun jongki phi .
translation.en: I will send my fear before thee , and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come , and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee .

translation.kha: Bad ka long katba bha’ tam ban nang ïa kane ka jingïaishah ha ka jinglong samla jong ngi .
translation.en: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ïasheptieng haduh katta! katta bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki , Uei une u briew ? Wat ka lyer bad ki jingbet phyllung ki kohnguh ïa u !
translation.en: And they feared exceedingly , and said one to another , What manner of man is this , that even the wind and the sea obey him ?

translation.kha: Nga la sngwthuh sa kawei paw , ba ha kane ka pyrthei ki nongmareh kiba stet ktieh ju ïai jop sah ïa ki jingïamareh thong , bad kiba shlur kim ju ïai jop sah ïa ka tdem . Ki brisoh kiba bajar ktien ju ïaw kamai sah pun im , ki biria kiba proh jingmut kim ju ïa ïoh spah , malu ki bariew kiba lah ban sa ei ei kim ju ïai kiew sha ki kyrdan bashalor . Ka kupar basniew ka jia ha uwei pa uwei .
translation.en: I returned , and saw under the sun , that the race is not to the swift , nor the battle to the strong , neither yet bread to the wise , nor yet riches to men of understanding , nor yet favour to men of skill  ; but time and chance happeneth to them all .

translation.kha: Ka jingïap ka ïoh na ka pop ïa ka bor ïa-ban pynthnam , bad ka pop ka ïoh ïa ka bor jong ka na ka Hukum .
translation.en: The sting of death is sin ; and the strength of sin is the law .

translation.kha: Nga la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u ban mane ïa u , hynrei u la ino ha per , Wat lai kumne ! Nga long u para shakri nabar me bad nia ki pynrangbah jong me , wer baroh kiba bang ïa ka jingshisha kabu U Jisu u la pynpaw . To mane ïa U Blei ! Naba ka jingshisha kaweh U Jisu u la pynpaw ka longïng kata kaba pyrsad mynsiem ïa ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And I fell at his feet to worship him . And he said unto me , See thou do it not : I am thy fellowservant , and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus : worship God : for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy .

translation.kha: U khrawbor u la pynbun ïa ki briew baroh , kiba rit bad kiba khraw , kiba riewspah bad kiba duk , ki mradkhlaw bad kiba laitluid , pun don ka shab ïa kaba la nguh ha ki kti kamon jong ki lane ha ki lamkhmat jong ki .
translation.en: And he causeth all , both small and great , rich and poor , free and bond , to receive a mark in their right hand , or in their foreheads :
And Jonathan called David , and Jonathan shewed him all those things . And Jonathan brought David to Saul , and he was in his presence , as in times past .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jonathan u khot ïa u Dabid bad u ïathuh ha u ïa kita baroh ; nangta u ïalam ïa u sha u Saul , bad u Dabid u shakri ïa u syiem kumba u ju leh mynshuwa .
Ïa ki jingïoh shiliang jong ki yn bat pyrshah ïa ki . Ki leh pop! khlem rieh kumba ki briew ka Sodom ki la leh . Ki longsem kiba la tim , badno ki la khlam ïa ka halor jong ki hi .
translation.en: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them  ; and they declare their sin as Sodom , they hide it not . Woe unto their soul ! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves .

translation.kha: Ki bymman ki ïam ha lade ka jingjynjar ïa kaba ki pyrshang ban pynjia ha ki briew kiba bha .
translation.en: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous , and the transgressor for the upright .
And the king was exceeding sorry  ; yet for his oath s sake , and for their sakes which sat with him , he would not reject her .
translation.kha: Kane ka pynlong ïa u syiem ban sngewsih haduh katta katta , hynrei um lah ban kyrngah ïa ka namar ki jingsmai ba u la pynlong ha khmat jong baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha .

Katba ki dang ne hangno , uwei u tymmen uba dang wan phalang na lyngkien Bad ïaid nala ynda la janmiet . U dei uba na ri lum Ephraim , hynrei ha dat ka por u shong u tama ha Gibeah . ( Kiwei kiba shong hangta ki de na ka jait Benjamin . )
translation.en: And , behold , there came an old man from his work out of the field at even , which was also of mount Ephraim  ; and he sojourned in Gibeah : but the men of the place were Benjamites .

But Jesus called them to him , and saith unto them ,  Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them  ; and their great ones exercise authority upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la khot lang ïa ki baroh sha u bad u la ong ,  Phi tip ba ki briew ïa kiba la ñiew kum ki nongsynshar jong kita kiba mane blei thala , ki leh donbor halor jong ki , bad ki nongïalam ki don ïa ka bor nadong shadong .
Ki khun ki peitbeiñ ïa nga bad ki rkhie haba ki ïohi ïa de .
translation.en: Yea , young children despised me  ; I arose , and they spake against me .

translation.kha: La dat Kawei ka nongïathuhlypa kaba la tymmen bha , ka riewkhraw kaba kyrteng ka Anna , ka khun jongno u Phanuel na ka jait Asher . Ka la shongkurim tang hynñiew snem nabar mynnin ka la dap phraphew saw snem ka rta . Kam ju mih shuh na ka Templ ; mynnin bad Mynmiet ka la mane ïa U Blei , da kambah shahjingit bad duwai .
translation.en: And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years , which departed not from the temple , but served God with fastings and prayers night and day .
And when they were gone over , they came into the land of Gennesaret .
translation.kha: Ki la ïaleit sha shiliang ka duriaw bad ki la wan poi ha Gennesaret , ha kaba ki briew ki la ithuh ïa U Jisu .
Shuh shuh u la thung ïa u Jediael dara ar nongput kiwei pat ban kham ïa ki lat bad ban khmih halor ki jingkwah jong u syiem .
translation.en: And over these three presidents  ; of whom Daniel was first : that the princes might give accounts unto them , and the king should have no damage .

translation.kha: Ngan long u kpa jong u bad un long u khum jong ang , ngan ym weng noh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong ar na u wohnia sa la har ïa u Saul , ïa uba nga la weng khnai ba me lah ban long syiem .
translation.en: I will be his father , and he shall be my son : and I will not take my mercy away from him , as I took it from him that was before thee :

translation.kha: Nga dei ban sngewkynjah , wat la kam nongrah jingbha ei ei . Hynrei ngan kren mynta shaphang ki jingïohipaw bad ki jingpynpaw ba la ai ha nga da U Trai .
translation.en: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory . I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord .

translation.kha: Kut jingmut triang bad long skhem , namar men long u nongïalam jong kine ki briew katba ki shim kyndit ïa kane ka ri ïa kaban nga la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: Be strong and of a good courage : for unto this people shalt thou divide for an inheritance the land , which I sware unto their fathers to give them .

translation.kha: U TRAI’ u kren biang ha u Moses , Bsuh ïa la ka kti shapoh ka jaiñkup jong me . U Moses u la kohnguh ; bad ynda u sei patan ïa la ka kti , ka la ïew jingpang kaba la tap da ki jingthohlieh , kum ka ïor .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said furthermore unto him , Put now thine hand into thy bosom . And he put his hand into his bosom : and when he took it out , behold , his hand was leprous as snow .
And the sons of Joseph , which were born him in Egypt , were two souls : all the souls of the house of Jacob , which came into Egypt , were threescore and ten .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang u Joseph ïa kiba la kha ha Ijipt ki long ar ngut ; kumta ki briew baroh kiba na ka ïing u Jakob kiba la wan sha Ijipt ki long hynñiewphew ngut .

translation.en: Lord , now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace , according to thy word :
translation.kha: Mynta , A Trai , me la bat ïa la ka kular , bad men shah ïa u shakri jong me ban leit noh ha kaba suk .
Phi baroh kiba burom ïa U TRAI’ bad kiba kohnguh ïa ki keiñ u shakri jong u , ka lynti kaba phi ïaid ka lah ban long kaba dum da shisha , hynrei shaniah ha U Trai , aiti ha U blang jong pa .
translation.en: Who is among you that feareth the  Lord  , that obeyeth the voice of his servant , that walketh in darkness , and hath no light ? let him trust in the name of the  Lord  , and stay upon his God .
While the earth remaineth , seedtime and harvest , and cold and heat , and summer and winter , and day and night shall not cease .
translation.kha: Katba ka pyrthei ka dang sah , kan don ka aïom bet bad ka aïom ot . Kan don ka jingkhriat bad ka jingshit , ka lyiur bad ka tlang , ka sngi bad ka miet .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Lord , I am ready to go with thee , both into prison , and to death .
translation.kha: U Petros u la jubab ,  Ko Kynrad , nga kloi ban leit sha ka ïingbyndi bad me bad ban ïap lem bad me !

translation.en: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word  ; Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Every bottle shall be filled with wine : and they shall say unto thee , Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , ïathuh ïa ki paid Israel ba ïa uwei pa uwei u khra buh waiñ dei ban pyndap da ka waiñ . Kin jubab ba ki tip ba ïa uwei pa uwei u khra buh waiñ dei ban pyndap da ka waiñ .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the fortieth year , in the eleventh month , on the first day of the month , that Moses spake unto the children of Israel , according unto all that the  Lord  had given him in commandment unto them  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba khatwei , ha ka snem kaba sawphew hadien ba ki la mih na Ijipt , u Moses u ïathuh ha u paidbah ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u ban ong ha ki ,
Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa kan , ki la jubab , U la beh noh ïa ki ksew tong Namarba ba u rangbah jong ki , u Beelsebul u ai bor ïa u ban leh kumto .
translation.en: But when the Pharisees heard it , they said , This fellow doth not cast out devils , but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils .

translation.kha: Ki dieng ki la dap da ka ngap , hynrei ym khong uwei hajuh umbah la bam ei ei na ka Namar baroh ki sheptieng ïa ka jingtim ka jongki u Saul .
translation.en: And when the people were come into the wood , behold , the honey dropped  ; but no man put his hand to his mouth : for the people feared the oath .

translation.kha: Khmut , te , balei mem thuh ïa ka pisa jyllang nga ha ka khang kynsha pisa ? Hangta te ngan jin da la ïa-ïohpdiang pateng ïa ka lem bad ka sut haba nga la wanpaw pait .’
translation.en: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank , that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury ?

translation.kha: Eliada u briew um kotbor don wallam da ka langbrot ne da ka blang , un ïarah sha U Trai ar tylli ki paro ne ar tylli ki lyngdkhur kumto ka jingpli ïa la ka bapop , kawei na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad kawei paw na ka pyntwa ka jingkñia ainguh thang .
translation.en: And if he be not able to bring a lamb , then he shall bring for his trespass , which he hath committed , two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , unto the  Lord   ; one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering .

translation.kha: Hynrei to long ka jingnguh ïa U Blei , uba ai ha ngi ïa ka jingjop thiaw lyngba U ijuh Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi !
translation.en: But thanks be to God , which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: U Baasha u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Tirsah , malu u khun jongngi u , u Elasah u la long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: So Baasha slept with his fathers , and was buried in Tirzah : and Elah his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: U la waiñ sha u langbrot , uba na la ïew ba u sheng harud jong ka oh , bad u la mareh shata u da ka bor jong u baroh .
translation.en: And he came to the ram that had two horns , which I had seen standing before the river , and ran unto him in the fury of his power .
So she wrote letters in Ahab s name , and sealed them with his seal , and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city , dwelling with Naboth .
translation.kha: Nangta ka thoh katto katne ki shithi , bad ka soi ïa ki ha ka kyrteng u Ahab , ka shonshab ïa ki da ka muhor jong u , bad ka phah ïa ki sha ki rangbah synshar bad ki riewpawkhmat ka Jesreel .
Ko Kynrad , ki la jubab , ngi kwah ïa me ban ai ha ngi ka jinglah ïa-ban Iohi !
translation.en: They say unto him , Lord , that our eyes may be opened .

translation.kha: haba nga la poi ha Troas ban ïalap ïa ka Khroh Babha shaphang U Khrist , nga la shem ba U Trai u la lah plie ïa ka lynti na ka bynta ka kam hangto .
translation.en: Furthermore , when I came to Troas to preach Christ s gospel , and a door was opened unto me of the Lord ,
The king of Taanach , one  ; the king of Megiddo , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Taanakh , ka Megiddo ,

translation.en: The eyes of the  Lord  are in every place , beholding the evil and the good .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïohi kaei kaba jia ha ki jaka baroh ; u khmih halor jong ngi , la ngi leh ïa kaba bha ne kaba sniew .

translation.en: Saying ,  What wilt thou that I shall do unto thee ?  And he said , Lord , that I may receive my sight .
translation.kha: Kaei me kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong me ?   Ko Kynrad ,  u la jubab ,  nga kwah ban imat pat .

Lada ki la tip ïa ki jingmut bahryntieh jong nga , te kin jin da la pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga sha ki briew jong nga , bad kin jin da la pynlong ïa ki ba iehnoh ïa ki jingim basniew ba ki im bad na ki kim bymman ba ki leh .
translation.en: But if they had stood in my counsel , and had caused my people to hear my words , then they should have turned them from their evil way , and from the evil of their doings .

translation.kha: Bad u mradkhlaw uba la ju im shisien , hynrei u bym shym im shuh , u daym hi u syier uba phra uba long eiei na ki hynñiew ngut bad u mihnoh ban shuh pynjot .
translation.en: And the beast that was , and is not , even he is the eighth , and is of the seven , and goeth into perdition .

translation.kha: Ka jingïap kan wei kum u nonglamktien barunar ïa ki riewbymman bakha pynkhih jingkulmar borabor .
translation.en: An evil man seeketh only rebellion : therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingkhah jongngi ka Ïingjaiñ ka jingdeng Ryngkat jong nga ki dei ban bam ïa ka lem nabar u kpu uba dang sah ha kata ka shaneng .
translation.en: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram , and the bread that is in the basket , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: U syiem u ïa-ong ha u Joseph , U Blei u la pynpaw ha me ïa kane baroh , kumin ka long kaba shai ba me don ka jingstad bad jingshemphang kaba kham khraw ban ïano ïaduna .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this , there is none so discreet and wise as thou art :
They shall eat the meat offering , and the sin offering , and the trespass offering  ; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs .
translation.kha: Ki jingkñia ainguh , ki jingkñia pop bad ki jingkñia na ka bynta ban siew pat , kin long ki jingbam jong ki lyngdoh , bad ki kin ïoh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha Israel ïa kiba la pynkyrpang na ka bynta jong nga .
Baroh ki la bam bad ki la kdang . Nangta ki synran ki la lum hynñiew tylli pura jong ki lyngkhot kiba sah dak .
translation.en: And they did all eat , and were filled : and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full .

translation.kha: Nga sngewthikna , kato nga dang thoh ïa kane , ba nam leh ïa kaei kaweh nga kyrpang — ha ka jingshisha nga tip ba men leh wat khlam patar ïa kane .
translation.en: Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee , knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ïajubab , Kane ka la jia namar ki briew jong por ki la iehnoh ïa ka jinghikai jong to Kaba nga la ai ha ki . Kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga lane leh ïa Kiei kaba nga la bthah ïa ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  saith , Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them , and have not obeyed my voice , neither walked therein  ;
Not every one that saith unto me , Lord , Lord , shall enter into the kingdom of heaven  ; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Ym u briew baroh uba khot ïa nga , ‘ A Trai , A Trai’ u ban ïohrung shapoh Ka Hima ki bneng , hynrei tang kito kiba leh ïa kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng u kwah ïa ki ban leh .
Ko ki kynrad , to long kiba beit bad kiba hok ha ka rukom kaba phi imat ïa ki miaw jong phi . jingkynmaw ba ma phi ruh phi don U Kynrad ha bnoh .
translation.en: Masters , give unto your servants that which is just and equal ; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven .

translation.kha: Kat kum ka rukom ba la dud da ki lyngdoh , la jied ïa u da Kaba kyntur sbai ban thang jingiwbih halor ka duwan . Kumta u la leit shapoh ka Templ jong U Trai ,
translation.en: According to the custom of the priest s office , his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord .

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ktieh jong u Sophah ki long u Suah , u Sennakherib , u Shual , u Beri , u Imrah ,
translation.en: The sons of Zophah  ; Suah , and Harnepher , and Shual , and Beri , and Imrah ,

translation.kha: Bad kaei kata ka jingshisha ? u Pilat u la kylla . Nangta u Pilat u la mihpat shabar sha ki paidbah bad u la ïong ha ki , Ngam lap kano kano ka daw ban pynrem ïa u .
translation.en: Pilate saith unto him , What is truth ? And when he had said this , he went out again unto the Jews , and saith unto them , I find in him no fault at all .

translation.kha: U nongap phira u pyrta , Ko kynrad , nga la ïeng ap phira ha ka kam jngai to mynhyndai bad mynmiet .
translation.en: And he cried , A lion : My lord , I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime , and I am set in my ward whole nights :

translation.kha: Nangta shibun ki nongïathuhlypa lamler kin maw Bad kin Shur ïa ki briew kiba bun .
translation.en: And many false prophets shall rise , and shall deceive many .
The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron , and with the point of a diamond : it is graven upon the table of their heart , and upon the horns of your altars  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki briew jong ka Judah , ïa ka pop jong phi la thoh da u khulom nar ; la pruid jylliew halor ki dohnud jong phi da u diamond banep bad la ohdur halor ki dong jong ki duwan jong phi .
Hadien ba ki Philistia ki la ïohknieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ki kit ïa ka na Ebeneser sha ka nongbah jrong ki ha Ahussath ,
translation.en: And the Philistines took the ark of God , and brought it from Eben–ezer unto Ashdod .

For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir , utterly to slay and destroy them : and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir , every one helped to destroy another .
translation.kha: Ki Amon bad ki Moab ki tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Edom bad pynjot thiaw ïa ka , bad hadien kata , ki ïaphai pyrshah para ma ki ha ka jingïaleh bashyrkhei .
nangta U Trai u ong , Bsuh biang ïa kato ka kti jong me shab ka jaiñkup jong me . U ruh u leh kumta , bad hir u sep-ei ïa ka , u ïohi ba ka la koit pat , kumba ka long mynshuwa .
translation.en: And he said , Put thine hand into thy bosom again . And he put his hand into his bosom again  ; and plucked it out of his bosom , and , behold , it was turned again as his other flesh .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïaid shaneng bad sharum jong ka ri , man ba ki lap ïa ka shynrang briew , kin buh dak Hajan kata , ba kumin ki nongtih jingtep kan wan bad tep ïa ka ha ka dem ka Kynhun Shipai u Gog .
translation.en: And the passengers that pass through the land , when any seeth a man s bone , then shall he set up a sign by it , till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon–gog .

translation.kha: Ki shnat ïa ka jingdeng shadem da kijuh ki tiak da kiba la suh ïa ka ephod , mala ki pynpur itynnat ïa ka ruh ha kajuh ka rukom .
translation.en: And he made the breastplate of cunning work , like the work of the ephod  ; of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .

translation.kha: Ka jingsarong jong phar ka la shukor ïa pha . Ka nongbet jong pha ka long ka khun mawsiang baskhem ; ka ïing jong pha ka don ha krai ki lympat , bad katkum phi ïong ha lade , ‘ Uei uba lah ïa-ban pynhiar ïa to sha tbian ?’
translation.en: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee , thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock , whose habitation is high  ; that saith in his heart , Who shall bring me down to the ground ?

translation.kha: Hynriew phi , phi de ki brai kba u la pyllait im na Ijipt , ka pajwa kaba khunlung da ka ding . U la wan ïalam ïa phin ban pyntong ïa phi ki briew jong u hi , kumne kumba phi long Myntan .
translation.en: But the  Lord  hath taken you , and brought you forth out of the iron furnace , even out of Egypt , to be unto him a people of inheritance , as ye are this day .

translation.kha: Ngan Pynbna ïa ki Hukum jong me ha ki syiem , bad nur-um ym shah pynlehrain .
translation.en: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings , and will not be ashamed .

translation.kha: Haba ki kylli lada don ka kynhun na ki khait Israel ka bym shym la leit shiah ka jingïalumlang ha Mispah , ki shem ba ym don uwei ruh na Dabbesheth ha Gilead kiba la don hangta ;
translation.en: And they said , What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpah to the  Lord  ? And , behold , there came none to the camp from Jabesh–gilead to the assembly .

translation.kha: lane bad la ka hynmen kynsi ne ka lai kynsi .
translation.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother s wife : it is thy brother s nakedness .

translation.kha: Ïa uno uno u bymïaineh ha nga yn bret noh ïa u kum ka tnat bad u ïap tyngkreiñ ; kum ïa kita ki tnat , la mluh badno la bret noh ha ka ding , ha kaba la thang ïa ki .
translation.en: If a man abide not in me , he is cast forth as a branch , and is withered  ; and men gather them , and cast them into the fire , and they are burned .

translation.kha: U Trai un wallam ïa phi sha ka ri ki Kanaan ïa kaba u la kular skhem ha phi bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translation.en: And it shall be when the  Lord  shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites , as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers , and shall give it thee ,
But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness , and despise government . Presumptuous are they , selfwilled , they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities .
translation.kha: Kine ki nonghikai balamler ki long kiba shlur bad kiba kyr-eit , bad kim pyn-i jingñiewburom ïa ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng ; pynban ki krenbeiñ ïa ki .

translation.en: In the thirty and eighth year of Azariah king of Judah did Zachariah the son of Jeroboam reign over Israel in Samaria six months .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew phra jong ka jingsynshar u Ussaïah u syiem ka Judah , u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Jeroboam uba ar u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar hynriew bnai ha Samaria .

Kine keiñ ki longïing kita ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh thang , ki jingainguh bam , ki jinganna namar ka pop , ki jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat , ki jingkñia pynkyntang , bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok .
translation.en: This is the law of the burnt offering , of the meat offering , and of the sin offering , and of the trespass offering , and of the consecrations , and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings  ;
My son , hear the instruction of thy father , and forsake not the law of thy mother :
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , to pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba u kpa bad ka kmie jong phi ki ong ïa phi .
U jop hati ïa ki Joab kiba kylli long ki raïot jong u mala siew khajna sha u .
translation.en: And he smote Moab  ; and the Moabites became David s servants , and brought gifts .

translation.kha: Te u Sarah u ong ha ki nongïalap jong u paidbah , Ale jingeh bad wad ka pop aïu la leh ha kane ka sngem .
translation.en: And Saul said , Draw ye near hither , all the chief of the people : and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day .

translation.kha: U la kam ba u long uba khraw , bad uwei uwei baroh ha ka nongbah , na ki kyrdan baroh ha ka imlang ka sahlang , ki pynshahshkor kmang ïa u . Une u briew u long sier ka bor jong U Blei ïa kaba la kut ‘ Ka Borbah’ , ki la ong .
translation.en: To whom they all gave heed , from the least to the greatest , saying , This man is the great power of God .

And it shall be Aaron s and his sons  by a statute for ever from the children of Israel : for it is an heave offering : and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Israel of the sacrifice of their peace offerings , even their heave offering unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka rai jong nga ka ban ym kylla ba haba ki briew jong nga ki pynlong ïa ka jingkñia ïasyllok , ka shadem bad ka lbong jong u mrad ki long ka bynta jong ki lyngdoh . Kane ka long ka jingai sngewbha jong ki briew sha nga , U  Trai .
ban ïalamwir ïa ka jingïar ha baroh , ban pynum ïa ki baroh na ka bynta ki kada bymriewblei ba ki la leh bad na ka bynta ki ktien ba sngewtriem kiba ki nongpop ba khlem blei ki la kren pyrshah ïa u !
translation.en: To execute judgment upon all , and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed , and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him .

translation.kha: Hadad kane , U Jisu u la otsher sha Jerusalem’ na ka bniat ka Jingïohipaw Anam .
translation.en: After this there was a feast of the Jews  ; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem .
After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece , from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest .
translation.kha: U Barukh , u khun jong u Sabbai u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh ka jaka rung sha ka ïing jong u Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh .

translation.en: Reuben , Simeon , Levi , and Judah ,
translation.kha: U Reuben , U Simeon , U Lebi , U Judah ,
thab ïa ka miej da ka dieng akasia , kaba phraphew phra sentimitar ka lynter , sawphew saw sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .
translation.en: Thou shalt also make a table of shittim wood : two cubits shall be the length thereof , and a cubit the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ka por ka wan haba ngan pynshitom ïa ki bynriew ka Ijipt , ka Judah , ka Edom , ka Ammon , ka Moab , bad ki briew ka ri shyiap , kaba la ot lyngkot ïa ki shñiuh jong ki . Kine ki briew baroh ki erlangthari kiba la otsher , hynrei ki bym shym la bat ïa ka jutang kaba ka thmu . Ym don mano mano na ktien ki briew bad ym ei mano mano na ki paid Israel uba la bat ïa kane ka jutang jong nga .
translation.en: Egypt , and Judah , and Edom , and the children of Ammon , and Moab , and all that are in the utmost corners , that dwell in the wilderness : for all these nations are uncircumcised , and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart .

translation.kha: Nga la dep ïathuh ïa phi , u la jubab , bad Phim shym la shahshkor . Balei ba phi kwah ban ïohsngew biang ïa ka ? Lehse ma phi , duh , phi kwah ban long ki synrap jong u ?
translation.en: He answered them , I have told you already , and ye did not hear : wherefore would ye hear it again ? will ye also be his disciples ?
For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you , and for them at Laodicea , and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh ;
translation.kha: To shah ngan ïathuh ïa phi haduh katno nga la trei shitom na ka bynta jong phi , bad na ka bynta ki briew ha Laodikaïa bad na ka bynta kiwei pat baroh ki bym ithuh ïa nga markhmat .

Ki nongap langbrot jong ka Gerar ki la ïakhawai bad ki nongap khunlangbrot jong u Isaak , mala ki ïai-ong , Kane ka um ka dih ka jong ngi . Kumta u Isaak u khot kirteng ïa dat ka pukri Ka jingsngewkhia .
translation.en: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac s herdmen , saying , The water is ours : and he called the name of the well Esek  ; because they strove with him .
Teaching us that , denying ungodliness and worldly lusts , we should live soberly , righteously , and godly , in this present world ;
translation.kha: Ba ka jingaiei ka hikai ïa ngi ban iehnoh ïa ka rukom im bymriewblei bad ïa ki jingkwah brai ba kynja pyrthei , bad ban im da kaba synshar ïa lade , ban im hok , bad ban im riewblei ha kane ka pyrthei ,
Hato mem pat ju ïohsngew ba nga la thmu ïa kane baroh slem mynshuwa ? Bad mynta nga pynurlong ïa ka . Nga ai ha me ka bor don pynkylla ïa ki nongbah ba la per kynroh sha ki kynton theh ñiut .
translation.en: Hast thou not heard long ago , how I have done it  ; and of ancient times , that I have formed it ? now have I brought it to pass , that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps .
Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt , Jacob said unto his sons , Why do ye look one upon another ?
translation.kha: Haba u Jakob u la tip ba don kew ha Ijipt , u ong ha la ki khun shynrang ,  Balei phim ïaleh ei ei ?
Bad u la nong ïa ki , To satia bad to duwai ba phan ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi . Ka mynsiem ka khah Hynrei ka soh ka tlot .
translation.en: Watch ye and pray , lest ye enter into temptation . The spirit truly is ready , but the flesh is weak .

These are the feasts of the  Lord  , which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations , to offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  , a burnt offering , and a meat offering , a sacrifice , and drink offerings , every thing upon his day :
translation.kha: Kine ki long kita ki Jingkhawai Niam ha kiba phi ai burom ïa U  Trai  da kaba ïalumlang ban mane Blei bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang , ïa ki jingainguh bam , ïa ki jingkñia , bad ïa ki jingainguh dih , man la ka sngi kumba la buh .
Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ki jingjubab bastad jong u .
translation.en: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers .
He thanked me with his eyes .
translation.kha: U khublei ianga da ki khmat jongu .

U tharai u la pynkhih ïa ki syiem jong ka Media , namar u thmu ban pynjot ïa ka Babilonia . Dei da kumta un siew kylliang namar ka jingpynjot ïa ka Templ lad u . Ki rangbah ai hukum ban tur ïaleh , ki hukum , Pynnep ïa ki khnam jrong phi ! Pynkhreh ïa ki stieh jong phi !
translation.en: Make bright the arrows  ; gather the shields : the  Lord  hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes : for his device is against Babylon , to destroy it  ; because it is the vengeance of the  Lord  , the vengeance of his temple .

translation.kha: bad nangta u Bynrap , Nga don ei ei ban kylli na phi . Kaei kata ? ka kylliang .
translation.en: He said moreover , I have somewhat to say unto thee . And she said , Say on .

translation.kha: Kane baroh ka la shim por kumba sawspah sahkynmaw snem . Hadien kane u la ai ha ki ïa ki nongbishar haduh ka por jong u Samuel u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years , until Samuel the prophet .
And when the day of Pentecost was fully come , they were all with one accord in one place .
translation.kha: Haba ka sngi Pentekost ka la poi , baroh ki riewngeit ki la ïalumlang ha kawei ka jaka .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name , and I sent them not , yet they say , Sword and famine shall not be in this land  ; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ïathuh ïa phi ïa kaei ba ngan leh ïa kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ngam shym phah hynrei kiba kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad ong ba ka thma bad ka jingïapthngan kin ym lynshop ïa kane ka ri — ngan pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma bad da ka jingïapthngan .

translation.en: Six days may work be done  ; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest , holy to the  Lord  : whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day , he shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban trei , hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ka long ka sngi shongthait ïa kaba la pynkyntang sha nga . Uno uno uba trei ïa kano kano ka kam ha kata ka sngi un shah pynïap .
U la long uba jop , namar baroh kaba u la leh na ka bynta ka Templ lane ha kaba sorkar ïa ka Hukum , u la ar ha ka mynmiet kaba ïaineh tyllep bad aiti lut ha U Blei jong u .
translation.en: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God , and in the law , and in the commandments , to seek his God , he did it with all his heart , and prospered .
Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may be before thee for ever : for thou blessest , O  Lord  , and it shall be blessed for ever .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me ban kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga khnang ba kin ïai lehkmen ha ka jinglehbha jong me . Ma me , A  Trai  , me la kyrkhu ïa ki , bad ka jingkyrkhu jong me kan neh bad ki junom .

translation.en: Wherefore I take you to record this day , that I am pure from the blood of all men .
translation.kha: Kumta nga pynbna skhem ha phi ha kane hi ka sngi : Lada uno uno na phi u dei ban jot noh , ngam don ka jingkitkhlieh .

A TRAI’ Nongsynshar , U Blei ki Jerusalem’ ! nga sngem shlur ban duwai kane ka jingduwai ha me , namar me la pynpaw ïa kane baroh ha nga , u shakri jongngi me , bad ba me la ong ha na ba Leit pynlong syier ïa ki ïakhun ki ksiew jong nga .
translation.en: For thou , O  Lord  of hosts , God of Israel , hast revealed to thy servant , saying , I will build thee an house : therefore hath thy servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto thee .

translation.kha: U Judah u ong , Ko kynrad , ngin ong aïu pat ha phi ? Kumno keiñ ngin ïasaid ? Kamon keiñ ngi lah ban sait khun ïa lade ? U Blei u la paw ïa kane ka kam bymman jong ngi . Mynta te , baroh ngi long ki mraw jong pa , bad ym tang uta na uba la shen ïa ka khuid .
translation.en: And Judah said , What shall we say unto my lord ? what shall we speak ? or how shall we clear ourselves ? God hath found out the iniquity of thy servants : behold , we are my lord s servants , both we , and he also with whom the cup is found .

In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel , whose name was called Belteshazzar  ; and the thing was true , but the time appointed was long : and he understood the thing , and had understanding of the vision .
translation.kha: ( Ha ka snem kaba lai kaba u Syros u long u patsha jong ka Persia , ïa ka khubor la pynpaw ha u Daniel , ïa uba la khot ruh u Belteshassar . Ka khubor ka long kaba shisha hynrei kaba jwat eh ban sngewthuh . La batai ïa ka ha u ha ka jingïohipaw . )

Don Une uno uba lah ban thew ïa ka duriaw-bah da ki lynghoh Ki lane baneh thew ïa ka sahit bneng da ki kti jong u ? Don uno uno uba lah ban bat ïa ka khyndew jong ka pyllait ha ka khuri lane thew ïa ki lumbah bad lumrit ha ki tarajur ?
translation.en: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand , and meted out heaven with the span , and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure , and weighed the mountains in scales , and the hills in a balance ?

translation.kha: Haba wanrah kham bun ki jingri , ïa ki jingsuh bynrap dei ban pynbun kat ban ïabiang .
translation.en: According to the number that ye shall prepare , so shall ye do to every one according to their number .

translation.kha: U rangbah synshar u la jubab , Kumno ngan lah ban sngewthuh lymda don mano moi ba batai ïa ka ha nga ? Bad u la khot sngewbha ïa u Philip ban wan kyiuh malu shong ha ka kali kulai ryngkat bad u .
translation.en: And he said , How can I , except some man should guide me ? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him .

translation.kha: Ki nongshun jongnga ki briew ka Judah bad Bneng ki la ïohsngew ba nam kiba la wan phai pat na ka jingshah ringmraw ki dang ïatei pat ïa ka Templ U Trai , U Blei ki Jeruel .
translation.en: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the  Lord  God of Israel  ;

But , The  Lord  liveth , that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north , and from all the lands whither he had driven them : and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers .
translation.kha: Pynban , kin smai da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri bashatei bad na baroh kiwei pat ki ri ha kaba nga la pynsakma ïa ki . Ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri ka jong ki hi , sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Kin jin da la dei ban kwah ïa ka jingman ba u ai ; kine jin da la dei ïa-ban duwai borabor ïa u .
translation.en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty ? will he always call upon God ?

translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai Ijipt ka don ha ka lynter ban ïarap ïa me , hynriew kan leit phai noh sha la ka ri .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah , that sent you unto me to enquire of me  ; Behold , Pharaoh s army , which is come forth to help you , shall return to Egypt into their own land .

translation.kha: U Tom u la jingjubab ïa u , U Trai jong nga bad U Blei jong nga !
translation.en: And Thomas answered and said unto him , My Lord and my God .

translation.kha: Hangno , namarkata , ka don ka thymmei jong ka jingstad ? Hangno ngi lah ban ïoh jinghikai ban jingshemphang ?
translation.en: Whence then cometh wisdom ? and where is the place of understanding ?

translation.kha: Ki la wan sha Kapernam , bad hadien ba u la rung shapoh ïing U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki synreit jong u , Shaphang kaei phi la ïatainia hapdeng jongnga phi ha lynti ?
translation.en: And he came to Capernaum : and being in the house he asked them ,  What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way ?

translation.kha: Wat sheptieng haba phi ïohsngew ïa ki thma malu ki jingïakhih pyrshah bor synshar ; katba kum kine ki dei ban jia nyngkong , hynrei kim mut ba kaba kut ka la jan .
translation.en: But when ye shall hear of wars and commotions , be not terrified : for these things must first come to pass  ; but the end is not by and by .

translation.kha: Ki Jiw ki khwai ïa ki kambah kum ka sakhi , bad ki Grik ki wad ïa ka jingshad .
translation.en: For the Jews require a sign , and the Greeks seek after wisdom :

translation.kha: Te kumta , lada uno Un u wan ha phi khlup da wallam ïa kane ka jinghikai , to wiat ïa-pdiang sngewbha ïa u ha ki ïing jong phi ; to wat da Ong , To ka jingsuh kan long bad phi .
translation.en: If there come any unto you , and bring not this doctrine , receive him not into your house , neither bid him God speed :

translation.kha: Nob dat sian ki daw baher balui ba ki briew kim ha ban shongkurim : katto katto , namar ba la kha ïa ki kumta ; kiwei pat , namar ba ki brai ki pynlong ïa ki kumta ; bad Kawei pat kim shongkurim na ka bynta ka Hima ki bneng . Ai ba uta uba lah banbeiñ pdiang ïa kane ka jinghikai un leh kamet .
translation.en: For there are some eunuchs , which were so born from their mother s womb : and there are some eunuchs , which were made eunuchs of men : and there be eunuchs , which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven s sake . He that is able to receive it , let him receive it .

translation.kha: Nangta u Shammah u ter ïaleh ïa ka Israel bad u kerkut ïa ka Samaria . Ha ka snem kaba lai jngai ka jingshah kerkut ,
translation.en: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land , and went up to Samaria , and besieged it three years .

translation.kha: Ka jingkhihwin ka la par ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei . Ki paidbhur ki la kem ïa u Gaïos bad ïa u Aristarkhos , ki ar ngut ki nongmih Makedonia kiba ïaleit shrong bad u Paul , bad ki la paring Mareh bad ki shaw ka rynsan kun tamasa .
translation.en: And the whole city was filled with confusion : and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus , men of Macedonia , Paul s companions in travel , they rushed with one accord into the theatre .

translation.kha: Ban phang ïa ka jingbymkhuid , shem khyndiat u dpei na katai ka masi roi saw ïa kaba la lane banbeiñ weng noh ïa ka pop Bad buh ïa ka ha u khiew , malu theh hangthie ïa ka um ba dang shwa wan tong .
translation.en: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin , and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel :

translation.kha: Kumta uta u briew u la leit bad u la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Hierapolis , da kaba ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la lah leh ïa u . Bad baroh kiba la sngewkyiuh ïa kata , ki la sngewlyngngoh .
translation.en: And he departed , and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him : and all men did marvel .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la klun ïa kane bad nangta u la nang leit sha Jerusalem ha suk jongki ki .
translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he went before , ascending up to Jerusalem .
Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain , and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second  ; that the loops may take hold one of another .
translation.kha: Buh sanphew tylli ki kyrwoh ha ka jingkah kaba nyngkong , bad sa sanphew tylli pat ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba khatduh ba la suh lang ha ka jingkah kaba ar . Pynphai marpyrshah ïa ki .

translation.en: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh–gilead , and said unto them , Blessed be ye of the  Lord  , that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord , even unto Saul , and have buried him .
translation.kha: u la phah shata katto katne ngut ki rangbah lem bad kane ka khubor :  To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi namar ka jingpyn-i ïa ka jingieit ïa la u syiem da kaba tep ïa u .
Ki rangbah synshar jong ki Assyria ki la ong ïa kiei kaei kiba kham sniew shaphang U Trai U Blei’ bad ïa u Hesekaïah , u shakri U Trai .
translation.en: And his servants spake yet more against the  Lord  God , and against his servant Hezekiah .

translation.kha: Hangne halor u Lum Seïon , U Trai borabor Baroh un pynkhreh ka jingïakhaïi bthah na ka bynta ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei — ka jingïarwai bah da ki jingbam bakyrhuh eh dara ka wiang bakynsai tam .
translation.en: And in this mountain shall the  Lord  of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things , a feast of wines on the lees , of fat things full of marrow , of wines on the lees well refined .
And the fenced cities are Ziddim , Zer , and Hammath , Rakkath , and Chinnereth ,
translation.kha: Ki nongbah ba la ker da ki kynroh ki long ka Siddim , ka Ser , ka Hammath , ka Rakkath , ka Khinnereth ,

Nangta u ïathuh ïa nga ba U Troas , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong , Barukh , me ong , ‘ Nga la ngiah ! U Trai u la ban ïa ka jingsngewsih halor ki jingjynjar jong nga . Nga la thait na kaba shu ud , bad ngam shem ïano kano ka jingjahthait !’
translation.en: Thou didst say , Woe is me now ! for the  Lord  hath added grief to my sorrow  ; I fainted in my sighing , and I find no rest .

translation.kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jongngi u shaei ka khyrdop jngai ka Ïingjaiñ , bad ong ïa ki ban sumar kat kum ka jingshitom .
translation.en: And thou shalt bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and wash them with water .

translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki wan shuh ka lok u Usai na Ephraim , Manasseh , malade Simeon , bad ki shang ki sah ha ka hangamei jong u , namar ki la ïohi ba U Trai u long lema bad u . U Asa u Pha khot ïa ki baroh badno ïa ki antad Judah bad Bamaïan .
translation.en: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin , and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh , and out of Simeon : for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance , when they saw that the  Lord  his God was with him .

translation.kha: kadei “Phi Leh ?
translation.en: What did you do ?

translation.kha: Hynrei lada said ka jingkynnoh ka long katba shisha bad ym don shata baneh pyndei ba Katai ka briew ka long kaban dang siat ,
translation.en: But if this thing be true , and the tokens of virginity be not found for the damsel :

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Dabid u khie dang paw phyrngab , u ieh ïa ki langbrot ha uwei pat u nongsharai , u rah ïa tala ka jingbam , bad u otsher main u Jeush u la bthah ïa u . U poi ha ka jaka sher dara hamar ba ki Eliel ki dang leit sha ka madan thma , ki da ïarisa ha ka tdam .
translation.en: And David rose up early in the morning , and left the sheep with a keeper , and took , and went , as Jesse had commanded him  ; and he came to the trench , as the host was going forth to the fight , and shouted for the battle .

translation.kha: Ka jingieit jong phi ka pynkmen ïa nga , ko ba-beit thep mynsiem dara ko nongleitkurim jngai nga . Ka jingieit jong phi ka kham bha’ ban ïa ka waiñ ; ka jingsleh jong phi ka kham iwbih ban ïa uno uno u musla .
translation.en: My beloved is white and ruddy , the chiefest among ten thousand .
Till I come , give attendance to reading , to exhortation , to doctrine .
translation.kha: Tad ynda nga wan , to ai ïa ka por jong me bad ka jingpyrshang ban pule paidbah ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid bad ban ïalap bad hikai .
U ia ban buhrieh arsap ïa la ka jingidiaw , hynrei baroh kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba bymman ba u leh .
translation.en: Whose hatred is covered by deceit , his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation .
We have sent therefore Judas and Silas , who shall also tell you the same things by mouth .
translation.kha: Ngi phah ha phi , te , ïa u Judas bad u Silas , ki ban ïathuh ïa phi markhmat ïa kijuh kiei kiei kiba ngi thoh .

ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bun ki ïing kiba bit bthuh . ( Kine kin treikam haduh ba ki Israel ki la rung sha ri Kanaan , ha kaba U Trai un ai ha ki kum ka jingïohkynti . ) Lada uno uno u shem ba U TRAI’ u phah ïa ka jingpang buh ha ka ïing jong u , te u dei ban leit ïathuh ha u lyngkhuh shaphang Katai .
translation.en: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest , saying , It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house :

translation.kha: Ki ïeng jngai bah na ka , namar ba ki shaphang ban ïoh bniat ha ki jingshitom jong ka . Ki ong , Katno kiba ishyrkhei ! Katno kaba itriem ! Kane ka nongbah Babilon kaba khriat bad kaweh khlaiñbor ! tong hapoh shi kyntait phasi la shah pynshitom !
translation.en: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment , saying , Alas , alas , that great city Babylon , that mighty city ! for in one hour is thy judgment come .

translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u la rim ïa ka , u la spaiñ da ka jaiñjot lymne naba thymmai ,
translation.en: And when Joseph had taken the body , he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth ,

translation.kha: Khmut haba nga la wan sha phi , nga la long uba tlot bad uba kyiuh baroh shi rynïeng da ka jingsheptieng , mala ïa ka jinghikai bad ka khohruh jong nga ym shym la pynïoh da ki ktien batbit jong ka jingstad briew , hynrei da ka jingpynshisha baskhem jrong ka bor U Mynsiem U Blei .
translation.en: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man s wisdom , but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power :
Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by . And he said , Neither hath the  Lord  chosen this .
translation.kha: U Jesse nangta u wan ïalam ïa u Shammah .  Em , U  Trai  um shym la jied ïa une ruh  u Samuel u ong .
Ki bakla Shaphan ka pop , namar ba kim shym la ngeit ha nga ;
translation.en: Of sin , because they believe not on me  ;

translation.kha: dei na “kata ka daw balei ba ïa ka Khubor babud la ïalap ruh ha kiba ïahap , ha kito ïa kiba la bishar katne kum ka jingim ha ka doh wohnia ïa uwei pa uwei la bishar ; la ïalap ha ki khnang ba ha jingim ba kynja mynsiem kin ïoh im kumba U Blei u im .
translation.en: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead , that they might be judged according to men in the flesh , but live according to God in the spirit .
Shew me a penny . Whose image and superscription hath it ?  They answered and said , Caesar s .
translation.kha: To pyn-i hangne ïa ka sbai rupa . Ka durkhmat bad ka kyrteng jongno long kine kiba don ha ka ?   Jong u Patsha ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews , devout men , out of every nation under heaven .
translation.kha: La don ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem , ki riew niam kiba la wan na kawei pa kawei ka ri ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Now concerning the collection for the saints , as I have given order to the churches of Galatia , even so do ye .
