translation.kha: Mynta , ha kaba ïadei bad kaei kaba phi la thoh shaphang ka pisa ka ban kynshew na ka bynta ban ïarap ïa ki briew U Blei ha Judia . Phi dei ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ïa ki balang ha Galatia ban leh .

translation.en: For all flesh is as grass , and all the glory of man as the flower of grass . The grass withereth , and the flower thereof falleth away :
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Ki briew baroh ki long kum u phlang , bad ka burom jong ki baroh kum ki  tiewkhlaw . U phlang u ïapstai noh , bad ki syntiew ki tlor noh ,
Ïa ka dang sah na sakma ka umphniang un kyllaiñ ha ka khlieh lad uta u briew , bad da kumta un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam Kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid .
translation.en: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed , to make an atonement for him before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Bad lada ha Kanaan kano ka por ki nongwei ki wan ban shongduh ban sah malade phiah , la ka longsyiem Teng ujor lane baroh sei rta , bad ki ai ka jingainguh bam , ka jingkiew kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai , ki dei ban bud ïa kijuh ki jingaibuit ryntieh .
translation.en: And if a stranger sojourn with you , or whosoever be among you in your generations , and will offer an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; as ye do , so he shall do .

translation.kha: Ki briew ha ki shnong ha kaba U Jisu u la leh kham bun ki kambah jong u , Ki syiem la phai noh na ki pop jong ki , kumta u la pynkmen jur ïa iar ki Shong .
translation.en: Then began he to upbraid the cities wherein most of his mighty works were done , because they repented not :
Because ye have said , The  Lord  hath raised us up prophets in Babylon  ;
translation.kha: Phi ong ba U  Trai  u la ai ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ha phi ha Babilonia .
Kum mynta , ma nga , U Trai nongsharai , nga ïathuh ha phi ba ngan gospel hapdeng jong phi ïa ki langbrot kiba khlaiñ malu ki langbrot kba sliew .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  unto them  ; Behold , I , even I , will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle .

translation.kha: Nahum mynnyngkong nga la tip lypa ïa kaei ka ban mih ; la skhem bah nga la ïathuh lypa ïa kaei ka ban jia . Nga la ong ba ki jingthmu jong nga kin ym duh da lei lei , ngan leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga thmu ban leh .
translation.en: Declaring the end from the beginning , and from ancient times the things that are not yet done , saying , My counsel shall stand , and I will do all my pleasure :

translation.kha: Wat kñia ïa la ki khun da kaba ryngkat ïa ki ha ka duwan jong Phin ; wat shah ïa la ki bariew shun king , lane ban shat ban keiñ , lane ban ai myntor ,
translation.en: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire , or that useth divination , or an observer of times , or an enchanter , or a witch ,
And the Amorites , which dwelt in that mountain , came out against you , and chased you , as bees do , and destroyed you in Seir , even unto Hormah .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Amor kiba shong ha kita ki lum ki la wan tur pyrshah ïa phi kumba beh u ngap . Ki la beh ïa phi shaduh Hormah , bad ki la jop ïa phi hangta ha ri lum Edom .

U Hirah u la kmen shaba Palat hato u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor na u Solomon , bad u ong , Aroer ïa U Trai ha kane ka snieh ba u la ai ha u Dabid ïa u khun kaba stad Kum une ban long u syiem hadien jong u ïa Kata ka jaitbynriew bakhraw !
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Hiram heard the words of Solomon , that he rejoiced greatly , and said , Blessed be the  Lord  this day , which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people .

translation.kha: bad na U ju Khrist , u sakhi bajynjar , uba nyngkong ïa uba la pynmih na ka jingap bad umbah long ruh u nongshukor jong ki shym jong ka pyiar . U ieit ïa ngi , Bad da ka jingïap ba aiti lwet jong u , u la pyllait ïa ngi na ki pop
translation.en: And from Jesus Christ , who is the faithful witness , and the first begotten of the dead , and the prince of the kings of the earth . Unto him that loved us , and washed us from our sins in his own blood ,

translation.kha: kat babha sner nabar bym kein blei ki long ki briew jong kane ka por ! U Jisu u la pynbna . Phi pan na nga ïa ka kambah ? Em ! Ka kambah kaba yn ai ha phi ka long tong ka khapnap jong u Jonah u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But he answered and said unto them ,  An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign  ; and there shall no sign be given to it , but the sign of the prophet Jonas :

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba saw jong ka snem kaba laiphew , ma nga , u Esekiel u lyndang , u khup jong u bus , to tang ïashong ïajah ryngkat bad ki Jiw ba la shah ringmraw harud ka wieh Khebar ha Bethania . Ka bneng ka la plie wang , bad nga la ïohi ïa U Blei ha ka jingïohipaw .
translation.en: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year , in the fourth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar , that the heavens were opened , and I saw visions of God .

translation.kha: Sngewbha , ko Syiem Kynrad , shat ïa nga ïa-ban ong sa tang kamai , ka briew ka ong . To ong u jubab .
translation.en: Then the woman said , Let thine handmaid , I pray thee , speak one word unto my lord the king . And he said , Say on .

translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi! ba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u long uba kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u briew uba la ju im . Hynrei uta uba rit tam ha ka Hima ki Bneng u long uba kham khraw ban ïa u Ïoannis .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist : notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he .

translation.kha: Nga la ai ha pha ïa ka sati khmut nabar ki sohkhram bad ka pansngiat ba-itynnat don phong .
translation.en: And I put a jewel on thy forehead , and earrings in thine ears , and a beautiful crown upon thine head .
May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth , and length , and depth , and height ;
translation.kha: khnang ba ma phi lem bad ki briew jong U Blei baroh , phin lah ban ïoh ka bor ban sngewthuh katno ka jingïar bad ka lynter , katno ka jingjrong bad ka jingjylliew , ka long ka jingieit U Khrist .
Kane ka dei ka por ha kaweh U Trai un pyllait im ïa ka Seïon bad pynhiarkput halor ki nongshun jong ka .
translation.en: For it is the day of the  Lord s  vengeance , and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion .

translation.kha: Reuben , khun phrangsngi jong nga , Me longsem ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , U soh nyngkong ka jinglong rangbah jong nga , Uba sahnar tam bad uba khlaiñ Tam Na ki khup jong na bhor .
translation.en: Reuben , thou art my firstborn , my might , and the beginning of my strength , the excellency of dignity , and the excellency of power :

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u long uba ïaineh , nabar un pynkhlaiñbor ïa phoi bad ri sumar ïa phi na Uta u Basniew .
translation.en: But the Lord is faithful , who shall stablish you , and keep you from evil .

translation.kha: Pyndeng ïa ka kaba khlem seisoh , ka miet khlem ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Lo , let that night be solitary , let no joyful voice come therein .
And they brought the young man alive , and were not a little comforted .
translation.kha: Ki la ïalam sha ïing ïa uta u samla uba dang im , bad la pyntngen ïa ki shikatdei eh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will raise up against Babylon , and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me , a destroying wind  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga wallam ïa ka lyer ka jingjot pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia bad ïa ki briew jong ka .

( U Absalom u la buh ïa u Amasa ban ai hukum ïa ka kynran shipai ha ka jaka jong u Joab . U Amasa u dat u khun jong u Jether u nong Ishmael ; ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abigail , ka khup jongki u Nahash mala ka la jong ka Seruïah , ka kmiesan jong u Joppa . )
translation.en: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab : which Amasa was a man s son , whose name was Ithra an Israelite , that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash , sister to Zeruiah Joab s mother .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u la batai pei , Ka kam sngew aïu ba nga la leh ? u kyllaiñ da ka jingbitar . Ka aiñ aïu ba ar la pynkheiñ kaba shong hok ha phi ban twad ïa ar hajuh katne ?
translation.en: And Jacob was wroth , and chode with Laban : and Jacob answered and said to Laban , What is my trespass ? what is my sin , that thou hast so hotly pursued after me ?

translation.kha: Kito ki nonghiarpateng balamler , ki kren shaphang khie kiei ki jong ka pyrthei , bad ka pyrthei ka shahshkor ïa ki , namar ki longkmie ki jong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: They are of the world : therefore speak they of the world , and the world heareth them .
And while he yet spake with them , Rachel came with her father s sheep : for she kept them .
translation.kha: Katba u Jakob u dang ïakren bad ki , ka Rakhel ka la poi bad la ka kynhun langbrot .

Hangta ka dak U Khun U Briew kan paw ha ka sahmiet banyngkong , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew lad ka pyrthei kin ïam haba ki ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew ba u wan ha ki lyoh Bteng ha ka bol pynlang ka burom bakhraw .
translation.en: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven : and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn , and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory .

translation.kha: Katno ka Long kaba phylla pun ïohi ïa u nonglamktien ba u wan na ki lumbah , u wanrah ïa ka khublei baïap , ka khubor jongu ka jingsuk ! U pynbna ïa ka jingjop mala u nong ïa ka Seïon , U Blei jong phi u hir u syiem !
translation.en: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings , that publisheth peace  ; that bringeth good tidings of good , that publisheth salvation  ; that saith unto Zion , Thy God reigneth !

translation.kha: U Makhir u la ïa-ong ïa ki ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u la ïohsngew ba u Barukh u la pule ha ki paidbah .
translation.en: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard , when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people .
For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God : but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had .
translation.kha: Naba kiwei ki la ai ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong ki na kaei kaba ki don , ban ym ktah ïa ka spah jong ki ; hynrei ma ka , ha ka jingduk jong ka , ka la ai ïa baroh kaba ka donkam ïa lade .
Ha ka sngi kyntiew kurim , u Othniel u kyntu ïa ka , ban pan lyngkha na u kpa jong ka . Ka la hiar na ka kada jong ka , bad u Kaleb u kylli ïa ka aïu ka kwah .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when she came to him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field : and she lighted from off her ass  ; and Caleb said unto her , What wilt thou ?

translation.kha: Wat la ki thied jong u ki man thlim noh , bad u dyngkhong jong u , u ïap ha ka khyndew ,
translation.en: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth , and the stock thereof die in the ground  ;

Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father , through sanctification of the Spirit , unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ : Grace unto you , and peace , be multiplied .
translation.kha: Ïa phi la jied kat kum ka jingthmu U Blei uba U Kpa bad la pynlong ïa phi ki briew kiba khuid da U Mynsiem jong u , ban kohnguh ïa U Jisu Khrist bad ban ïoh pynkhuid da ka snam jong u . To ai ba ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk kin long kiba dap pura ïa phi .
Ka jingïap ka la waiñ shapoh lyngba ki jingkynthoh jngai ngi bad ka la rung sha ki ïingsyiem jongki ngi ; ka la ot ïa ki khana ha ki synduk bad ïa ki samla shynrang ha ki jaka ïew .
translation.en: For death is come up into our windows , and is entered into our palaces , to cut off the children from without , and the young men from the streets .
After this I beheld , and lo another , like a leopard , which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl  ; the beast had also four heads  ; and dominion was given to it .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang ap khmih , sa uwei pat u mradkhlaw u la mihpaw . U syriem kum u  labasa , hynrei ha ka met jong u la don saw tylli ki thapniang , kum ki thapniang jong ka sim , bad u don saw tylli ki khlieh . U don ka dur kum uba don ka bor .

U briew u pyndonkam shi bynta jong u dieng ban thang ding bad shi bynta jong u shun pynlong bleithaw . Da shi boitha u pynmeh ding ban pynsyaid ïa lade bad shet kpu ; da kadei pat ka shai bynta u shna blei bad mane ïa ka .
translation.en: Then shall it be for a man to burn : for he will take thereof , and warm himself  ; yea , he kindleth it , and baketh bread  ; yea , he maketh a god , and worshippeth it  ; he maketh it a graven image , and falleth down thereto .

translation.kha: Nangta u Isaïah u ong ïa u sahmiet Hesekaïah , Kane ka un-long ka dak ïa kaei ka ban sa jia . Mynta ka snem bad ha ka snem ka ngab wan , nam ïoh tang ïa ki kew khlaw ban bam , ishyrkhei ha ka snem kaba bud men lah ban bet ïa u kew bad ot ïa u , bad ban thung ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad bam ïa ki shoiñ .
translation.en: And this shall be a sign unto thee , Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves , and in the second year that which springeth of the same  ; and in the third year sow ye , and reap , and plant vineyards , and eat the fruits thereof .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sian ki sngi jar ïa kaei kaba ki tip , hynrei kiba lup ki thad ïa la ka jingaibor .
translation.en: A prudent man concealeth knowledge : but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness .

translation.kha: To wan shad U Trai , u maw uba im uba la kyndat da u bri kumno u bymmyntoi hynñiew uba la jied da U Blei ba u longkmie uba kordor .
translation.en: To whom coming , as unto a living stone , disallowed indeed of men , but chosen of God , and precious ,

translation.kha: Kane ka jingjot myntan ka la wan ha phi namar ba phi ai jingkñia shad kiwei ki blei bad sa bapop pyrshah ïa U Trai da ka jingïohknieh ïa ki hukum jong u barieh .
translation.en: Because ye have burned incense , and because ye have sinned against the  Lord  , and have not obeyed the voice of the  Lord  , nor walked in his law , nor in his statutes , nor in his testimonies  ; therefore this evil is happened unto you , as at this day .

translation.kha: Leh snam ka jingkyrduh bam ? jlan , lai bnai kaba phet krad na ki nongshun jong me ? Lane lai sngi ha kambah U Trai u tur ïaleh ïa me da ka waitlam bad phah ka jingïapthem halor ka ri jong me , da kaba pyndonkam ïa u angel jong u ban wallam ka jingïap ha kylleng ka Israel ? Kawei ka jubab ba ngan ai ha U Trai ?
translation.en: Either three years  famine  ; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes , while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee  ; or else three days the sword of the  Lord  , even the pestilence , in the land , and the angel of the  Lord  destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel . Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me .
When I went out to the gate through the city , when I prepared my seat in the street !
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah jong ka nongbah ki ïakynduh lang nga long uwei napdeng jong ki ,

U nonglamktien uba la Wan sha nga ha Siklag bad ïathuh ha sa ïa ka jingïap u Saul , u la pyllait ba u la ïalum ka khubor babha . ?(Nga la kem ïa u , mala phah pynïap ïa u . tala ka dat ka bainong ba nga la ai ha u na ka bynta sakma ka khubor babha jong u !
translation.en: When one told me , saying , Behold , Saul is dead , thinking to have brought good tidings , I took hold of him , and slew him in Ziklag , who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings :
But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered . Fear not therefore : ye are of more value than many sparrows .
translation.kha: Wat ïa ki shñiuh jong ka khlieh jong phi la dep ñiew baroh . Kumta to wat sheptieng ; phi kham kor bun shah ban ïa shibun ki sim ïing !
Ki briew ki leit sha shiliang jong ka Them ki dieng Jamynrei , da kaba pyrshang ban lait pait lem bad la ki jingdon jingem jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore the abundance they have gotten , and that which they have laid up , shall they carry away to the brook of the willows .
And spake unto him , saying , Tell us , by what authority doest thou these things ? or who is he that gave thee this authority ?
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi , me donhok aïu ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa kane ka hok ?

translation.en: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity : he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword . Here is the patience and the faith of the saints .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba dei ban shah kem un shah kem da shisha ; uno uno uba dei ban shah pynïap da ka waitlam un shah pynïap shisha da ka waitlam . Kane ka dawa ïa ka jingïaishah bad ïa ka jingngeit na ka liang jong ki briew jong U Blei .
Naba u Dabid u la ong shaphang jongno u , ‘ Nga la ieh ïa U TRAI’ ha khmat jrong ang ha ki por baroh ; u don hajan jong nga , bad lang! ym don ha ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: For David speaketh concerning him , I foresaw the Lord always before my face , for he is on my right hand , that I should not be moved :

translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong u , nga la bret noh ïa kiei ki baroh ; nga ñiew ïa ka baroh tang kum ka synrum , khnang ba ngan oh ïa U Khrist , bad ba yn pynshai pura bad u . Ngam long shuh uba don ka hok ka jrong ar hi , ka beit kob nga Ïoh da kaba kohnguh ïa ka hukum . “Nga mynta , nga ïoh ïa ka hok kaba la ai da ka jingngeit ha U Kiriath , ka hok kaba wan na U Blei bad kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingngeit .
translation.en: And be found in him , not having mine own righteousness , which is of the law , but that which is through the faith of Christ , the righteousness which is of God by faith :
And when Joseph s brethren saw that their father was dead , they said , Joseph will peradventure hate us , and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u kpa jong ki , ki hynmen u Joseph ki ïa-ong ,  Tip kan jia aïu keiñ lada u Joseph u dang buhnud bad thmu ban pynhiarkput ïa ngi namar ka kam sniew ba ngi la leh ïa u ?

translation.en: Through his Kingdom , Jehovah will soon end the suffering of each individual .
translation.kha: Lyngba ka Hima jong u , U Jehobah shen un sa pynkut noh ïa ki jingjynjar jong iwei pa iwei i briew .

Ka pukri ha kaba u Ammiel u la bret ïa ki mawtylliat jong wir ki pynbah uba u la pynkup ka long kaban heh bha kaba u syiem Asa u la tih mynba u la shah tur ïaleh ha u Baasha , u syiem ka Jerusalem’ . U Ishmael u la pyndap ïa kata ka pukri da ki batip .
translation.en: Now the pit wherein Ishmael had cast all the dead bodies of the men , whom he had slain because of Gedaliah , was it which Asa the king had made for fear of Baasha king of Israel : and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah filled it with them that were slain .

translation.kha: Kane kan long ka jingpynshitom ka ban hap halor ka Ijipt bad ha baroh kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew Lada Ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
translation.en: This shall be the punishment of Egypt , and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles .

And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel shall possess that of the Canaanites , even unto Zarephath  ; and the captivity of Jerusalem , which is in Sepharad , shall possess the cities of the south .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun kiba shah ringmraw na ka Israel bashatei kan wan phai bad jop ïa ka Phoenisia jngai bah shaphang shatei haduh ka Sarephath . Kiba shah ringmraw na Jerusalem kiba don ha Sardis kin kurup ïa ki shnong jong ka Judah bashathie .
Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ki thapniang jong ki jingthaw ba-im kiba ïatyngkhuh lang ha suiñ , bad ka jingkhynñiuh ki shalyntem , kiba da skum kum u jumai .
translation.en: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another , and the noise of the wheels over against them , and a noise of a great rushing .
And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , even a ram for a trespass offering .
translation.kha: Uta u briew un wallam uwei u langbrot ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga kum ka jingkñia namar ka jingpalat jong u ,

translation.en: Open ye the gates , that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in .
translation.kha: To plie ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah bad to ai ba ka jaitbynriew baïaineh kan rung , ka jaitbynriew kaba ki briew jong ka , ki leh ïa kaba dei .

Kan ym long kum ka jutang barim kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jngai ki mynba nga la sping ïa ki da la ka kti bad ïalaw ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Wat la nga la long kum u tnga ïa ki , kim shym la bat ïa Katai ka jutang .
translation.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt  ; which my covenant they brake , although I was an husband unto them , saith the  Lord  :
For John came neither eating nor drinking , and they say , He hath a devil .
translation.kha: Haba u Ïoannis u la wan , u la shahjingit bad um shym dih waiñ , bad uwei uwei baroh u la ong , ‘ Une uba shongksuid !’
A Trai , to shahshkor na bneng malu hajar ïa ki shakri jong me . Pynshitom ïa uta u nongleh palat kumba ka dem hok ïa u ban ïoh , malu pynksan ïa uta uba lui lui .
translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven , and do , and judge thy servants , condemning the wicked , to bring his way upon his head  ; and justifying the righteous , to give him according to his righteousness .

translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei ka jingriewblei ka mane bad kohnguh ha ïa la u jong u blei , hynrei ngi ngin mane bad nongshong ïa U Terah U Blei jong im junom la junom .
translation.en: For all people will walk every one in the name of his god , and we will walk in the name of the  Lord  our God for ever and ever .
As the cold of snow in the time of harvest , so is a faithful messenger to them that send him : for he refresheth the soul of his masters .
translation.kha: U nonglamktien uba lah ban shaniah u ai jinghun mynsiem ïa uta uba phah ïa u , kum ka umkhriat ha ka jingshit tyrha ha ka aïom ot .
Ka jaka sawdong jong ka Tappuah ka dei jong ka jait Manasseh , hynrei ka shnong Tappuah , ha khappud , ka dadien ka jong ki khun ki ksiew u Abram .
translation.en: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah : but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim  ;

translation.kha: Teng teng ka donkam pun lud ïa ka jingshem kaba kthang ha ka jingim ngab pynlong ïa ngi ban kylla ïa ki lynti jong ngi .
translation.en: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil : so do stripes the inward parts of the belly .

translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa Isaïah , u khunlung jong u Amos , u buh jingkhih ïa baroh Kawei pat ki kam ba u syiem Ussaïah u la leh ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah , first and last , did Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , write .

translation.kha: Te ngan sa pah shaw pat ïa me . Balei tun shu duh ei ïa ki khur shynrang jong nga baroh ar ngut ha hajuh ka sngi ?
translation.en: Until thy brother s anger turn away from thee , and he forget that which thou hast done to him : then I will send , and fetch thee from thence : why should I be deprived also of you both in one day ?

translation.kha: Hato Kanah ka i kumba nga pyrshang ban ïoh jingpynshisha na u briew ? Em , ym kumta! Kaei kabu nga kwah ka long ban pynshisha na U Blei! Hato at pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa ki briew ? Lada nga dang long naba pyrshang ban leh kamut , ngam pat long u shakri U Khrist .
translation.en: For do I now persuade men , or God ? or do I seek to please men ? for if I yet pleased men , I should not be the servant of Christ .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Gideon , Ngan pyllait im ïa me mala ngan ai ha me ka jingpar halor ki Midian da ki laispah nongput ki rangbah kiba shu jliah ïa ka um . Ong ïa kyiuh pat kin leit noh sha ïing .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Gideon , By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you , and deliver the Midianites into thine hand : and let all the other people go every man unto his place .

translation.kha: Ki briew baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh ba ki la sdang Ban ïa-ong para ma ki , Kaei kane ? Hato ka dei ka jait jingkhie thymmai ? Une u brup u don ka bor pun ai praw ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid , bad ki kohnguh ïa u !
translation.en: And they were all amazed , insomuch that they questioned among themselves , saying , What thing is this ? what new doctrine is this ? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits , and they do obey him .

translation.kha: Ka jingim jong imat pa uwei u jingshah uba im ka don ha ka snam , bad dei ñiar kata ba U Trai u la ong ha ki paid Israel ba kim dadien ba-bang bam ïa kano Kanah ka dohksah kob dang don snur ha ka , bun ba ïa uno ine uba leh kumno yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jongngi U Blei .
translation.en: For it is the life of all flesh  ; the blood of it is for the life thereof : therefore I said unto the children of Israel , Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh : for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof : whosoever eateth it shall be cut off .

translation.kha: Hobah la pynlong janai ïa u , u la jia long ka tynrai jong ka jingriam bymjukut na ka bynta kito baroh ibha kohnguh ïa u ,
translation.en: And being made perfect , he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him  ;

translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba lai u la put ïa la ka tyrso . U khlur uba heh , uba meh kum ka dongmusa , u la hap na sahit bneng bad u la hap halor ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki wah malade halor ki pukri um .
translation.en: And the third angel sounded , and there fell a great star from heaven , burning as it were a lamp , and it fell upon the third part of the rivers , and upon the fountains of waters  ;

translation.kha: Uno uno ïa uba U Kpa jong nga u ai ha nga un ïan sha nga . Ngan ym kyntait ïa uno uno suba wan sha nga , namar nga la wanrah hiar na bneng don leh ym ïa ka mon ka jongno nga hynrei ïa ka mon jong uta uba la phar ïa ar .
translation.en: For I came down from heaven , not to do mine own will , but the will of him that sent me .

translation.kha: U Darius u nongri rta , uba long u khun jyllang u Serksis , u la synshar ïa ka hima Babilonia .
translation.en: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus , of the seed of the Medes , which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans  ;

translation.kha: Ha-ei , phi dei wer kiba la ïohi ïa kine ki kambah baroh katba U Trei u la ar .
translation.en: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the  Lord  which he did .

translation.kha: Haba u Absalom u hynmen jong ka u la ïohi ïa ka , u la kylli , Hato u Amnon u la ktah kti ïa phi ? Sngewbha , ko har , wat shah ba kata kan pynsngewsih shibun ïa phi . U dei u ba ïailong shi na bad phi na ijuh i pa , kumno te wat ïathuh hano hano shaphang kata . kumto ka Tam ka la sah ha ka ïing jong u Absalom , ka da sngew bad sngewhun ïarwai .
translation.en: And Absalom her brother said unto her , Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee ? but hold now thy peace , my sister : he is thy brother  ; regard not this thing . So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom s house .

Therefore hear now , I pray thee , O my lord the king : let my supplication , I pray thee , be accepted before thee  ; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe , lest I die there .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , Ko Syiem Kynrad , nga kyrpad ïa phi ban shahshkor ïa nga bad ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Sngewbha wat phah pat ïa nga sha ka byndi ha ka ïing u Jonathan . Lada phi leh kumta , da shisha ngan sa ïap hangta .

translation.en: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years , O house of Israel ?
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , ngam shym la dawa ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh ha kito ki sawphew snem ha kaba nga la ïalam ïa phi lyngba ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: Thou hast built thy high place at every head of the way , and hast made thy beauty to be abhorred , and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by , and multiplied thy whoredoms .
translation.kha: Pha pynbyrsieh ïa la ka jingbhabriew ha ka ktieh , pha ai ïa lade ha uwei pa uwei uba wan najan , bad pha la kham long kum ka nuti man la ka sngi .
Nob men long u sakhrai na ka bynta jong u ban ïathuh ha utai pa uwei ïa kaei kambah me la ïew bad ïohsngew .
translation.en: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard .

translation.kha: Sah hangne barieh shi miet , bad ha ka par mynshem ngin sa wad la un shim jingïohknieh ne em na ka bynta jong phira . Lada ka long kumjuh , ka la bha ; lada kam long kumta , te nga smai ha U thri Uba im ba ngan shim ïa ka jingkitkhlieh . Mynta to thiah bad sah hangne ïathuh mynstep .
translation.en: Tarry this night , and it shall be in the morning , that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman , well  ; let him do the kinsman s part : but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee , then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee , as the  Lord  liveth : lie down until the morning .

translation.kha: Nga leh ïa kane khnang ba phna tip ïa ka jingshisha ba-pura shaneng kiei kiei baroh’ ïa kiba la hikai ïa phi .
translation.en: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things , wherein thou hast been instructed .
Let us go up against Judah , and vex it , and let us make a breach therein for us , and set a king in the midst of it , even the son of Tabeal :
translation.kha: Ki la thmu ban hiarthma ïa ka Judah , ban pyntieng ïa ki briew ban ïasoh ha ka liang jong ki , bad nangta ban buh ïa u khun jong u Tabeel halor ka khet .
U briew ha kaba la ni ïa kane ka kambah ka jingpynkhiah u la palat sawphew snem ka rta .
translation.en: For the man was above forty years old , on whom this miracle of healing was shewed .

translation.kha: U Dabid u sah ha ka jakarieh ha ri lum kaba ha ka ri khlaw khatsan ka Siph . U Suah u ïadie pyrshang ban shem ïa u , hynrei U Bela um shym la aiti ïa u Dabid ha u .
translation.en: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds , and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph . And Saul sought him every day , but God delivered him not into his hand .

translation.kha: Ngam la mihpat ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob , kumin U Bela Badonbor Baroh , hynrei ngam shym la pynithuh ïa lade ha ki da ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , U Trai .
translation.en: And I appeared unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob , by the name of God Almighty , but by my name  Jehovah  was I not known to them .

translation.kha: Haba U Trai U Blei jongngi phi u pynjop thom ïa phin sad phi ïohkem koidi ,
translation.en: When thou goest forth to war against thine enemies , and the  Lord  thy God hath delivered them into thine hands , and thou hast taken them captive ,

translation.kha: U Mordekai u kop shngain kane bun u ïathuh ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei ; kaba la ïathuh pat ïa u syep ïa Kiei kiba u Mordekai u la shem .
translation.en: And the thing was known to Mordecai , who told it unto Esther the queen  ; and Esther certified the king thereof in Mordecai s name .

translation.kha: U Moses bad u Onan ki kynriah nong na uta u paidbah bad ki la ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ . Ki dat khop ha khyndew , bad ka jingpynshai kaba tyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai ka la paw ha ki .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and they fell upon their faces : and the glory of the  Lord  appeared unto them .

translation.kha: hynrei ka sngi kiba hynriewphew ka dei ka sngi shongthait ba la pynkyntang sha nga . Ha kata ka sngi phim bit ban ar ïa kano kano ka kam — ma phi , ne ki khup jongno phiah , ne ki mraw jong phi , ne ki jingri jong phi , ne ki nongwei kba shong dew ha ka ri jong phi .
translation.en: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the  Lord  thy God : in it thou shalt not do any work , thou , nor thy son , nor thy daughter , thy manservant , nor thy maidservant , nor thy cattle , nor thy stranger that is within thy gates :

translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki la wan shat ka jaka khlaw bad ki la shem ïa ka ngap kat shaba phai .
translation.en: And all they of the land came to a wood  ; and there was honey upon the ground .
And the  Lord  said unto him , Who hath made man s mouth ? or who maketh the dumb , or deaf , or the seeing , or the blind ? have not I the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u ,  Uei uba ai ha u briew ïa ka shyntur ? Uei uba pynlong ïa u uba kyllut ne u bymnang kren ? Uei uba ai ha u ïa ka jingïohi ne pynlong ïa u , uba matlah ? Dei ma nga , U  Trai .
Hynrei kiba la shah khot sngewbha kim shitaiew bad ki la leit shaei la ki kai ki jam : Uwei sha ka lyngba jong u , uwei pat sha ka dukan jong u ,
translation.en: But they made light of it , and went their ways , one to his farm , another to his merchandise :
Then the steward said within himself , What shall I do ? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship : I cannot dig  ; to beg I am ashamed .
translation.kha: U shakri u la ong ha lade , ‘ U Kynrad jong nga un sa beh ïa nga na ka kam jong nga . Kaei ba ngan leh ? Ngam long uba khlaiñ ban tih kharai , bad nga sngewlehrain ban khrong .
Wat khang ïa U mynhynne Bakhuid ;
translation.en: Quench not the Spirit .

translation.kha: Te Naamah kane hi ka daw phi dei ban lai ïa kaweh bha tam jong pa’ ban pynlang ïa ka jingbha ha ka jingngeit jong phi ; ha ka jingbha jong phi pynlang ïa ka jingtip ;
translation.en: And beside this , giving all diligence , add to your faith virtue  ; and to virtue knowledge  ;

translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u waiñ sha u Eli sad ka khubor na U Trai : Hobab u Kpa tymmen jong me u Aaron bad ka longïing jong u ki dang long ki mraw jong u Pharaoh ka Ijipt . Nga la pynpaw ïa lade ha u Aaron .
translation.en: And there came a man of God unto Eli , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father , when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh s house ?
Surely , shall one say , in the  Lord  have I righteousness and strength : even to him shall men come  ; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed .
translation.kha: Kin ong ba dei tang lyngba jong nga yn shem ïa ka jingjop bad ka jingkhlaiñ ; hynrei baroh kiba shun ïa nga kin shah pynjahburom .

U Joseph um sngewkyndit hato u ieh ïa u kpa jong u ba u buh ïa la ka kti kamon ha ka khlieh u Ephraim ; kumta u bakut ïa ka kti u kpa jong u ban pynkyiuh ïa ka na ka khlieh u Ephraim sha ka khlieh u Manasseh .
translation.en: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim , it displeased him : and he held up his father s hand , to remove it from Ephraim s head unto Manasseh s head .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ba phi ai ïa kata ka song kew , kñia ruh kum ka jingainguh stong uwei u jinglongbriew u bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the  Lord .
Then those men , when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did , said , This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa kane ka kambah kaba U Jisu u la leh , ki la ong ,  Da shisha une u long u nongïathuhlypa , uba la dei ban wan sha ka pyrthei !

Pha la dei ban ym risa beiñ halor ka jingshem jynjar jrong ki Heshmon ki para jyllang pha ha Judah . Pha la daym ban ym lehkmen ha ka sngur ka jingpynkoit ïa ki . phad la dei ban ym rakhe ïa ki ha ka jingjynjar jong ki .
translation.en: But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger  ; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction  ; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , un khi biang ïa la u ñiuhkhlieh , u ñiuhtmoh , u ñiuhmat , bad u shñiuh baroh na ka kun jong u ; un sait ruh ïa la ki jaiñ , nabar un sum un sleh de , bad nangta un sa long uba khuid .
translation.en: But it shall be on the seventh day , that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows , even all his hair he shall shave off : and he shall wash his clothes , also he shall wash his flesh in water , and he shall be clean .
I have made the earth , and created man upon it : I , even my hands , have stretched out the heavens , and all their host have I commanded .
translation.kha: Nga long uta uba thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad pynlong ïa ki briew ban shong hangta . Da ka bor jong nga , nga pynpyiar ïa ki bneng ; nga pynïaid ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khlur .
Naba lada la don ka burom ha kata kaba la neh tang shipor , kaba haduh katno keiñ ka Burom ka don ha kata kaban kein jrong !
translation.en: For if that which is done away was glorious , much more that which remaineth is glorious .

translation.kha: Ki hynñiewphew snem kiba pahuh kiba ka ri Ijipt ka la ïoh lehkmen ki la kut , bad ki hynñiew snem jong ka nemsniew ki la sdang , kumba u Joseph u la lah ïong .
translation.en: And the seven years of plenteousness , that was in the land of Egypt , were ended .

translation.kha: To khiew otsher bad bta ïa ka khmat jong me ha ka Pung Siloam . ( Kane ka kyrteng ka meng Ba la phuh . ) Kumta uta u briew u la leit , u la bta ïa la ka khmat , bad u la wan phai uba imat pat .
translation.en: And said unto him ,  Go , wash in the pool of Siloam ,  ( which is by interpretation , Sent . ) He went his way therefore , and washed , and came seeing .
Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah , and his goodness , behold , they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Hesekaïah u la leh bad ka jingaiti lut jong u sha U  Trai  la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Jingïohipaw jong u Nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jong u Amos  bad ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel .
Hynrei u Barsillai u ïajubab , ngim don bun snem shuh ban im ; balei ngan leit Bad U Syiem Kynrad sha Jerusalem ?
translation.en: And Barzillai said unto the king , How long have I to live , that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem ?

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Heshbon , ki kyang ! Ïa ka Ai la pynstet ! Ki kynteit ka Rabbah , ki leit ïam sngewtieng ! Ki pha ïa ki jaiñ khain bad ïalum pangnud . Ki mareh lamkhmat . Ïa u Molekh u blei jong phi yn ïalam saraw , lem malade ki lyngdoh bad ki khun syiem .
translation.en: Howl , O Heshbon , for Ai is spoiled : cry , ye daughters of Rabbah , gird you with sackcloth  ; lament , and run to and fro by the hedges  ; for their king shall go into captivity , and his priests and his princes together .

translation.kha: Nga shu pynthikna .
translation.en: I was just making sure .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem naba san jong ka jingsynshar jong u ïa ka jingbymïaineh jong ki ha U Trai la pynshitom .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem , because they had transgressed against the  Lord  ,
Iron sharpeneth iron  ; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïoh jinghikai uwei na uwei pat , kumba u nar u pynnep ïa u nar .
Ka Dei da ka jingngeit jong ki , ba ki briew ha ki por mynbarim ki ïohpdiang ïa ka jingsngewbha lad U blei .
translation.en: For by it the elders obtained a good report .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trei U Blei jong phi un ym sngap ïa u balamler ; u pynlur pynban ïa kata ka jingtim sha ka jingkyrkhu , nongmareh ba u ieid ïa phi .
translation.en: Nevertheless the  Lord  thy God would not hearken unto Balaam  ; but the  Lord  thy God turned the curse into a blessing unto thee , because the  Lord  thy God loved thee .

translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingsngewsynei na ka bynta jongngi ki , namar ki la khuslai badno kim lah don leh ei ei , khim ki langbrot khlem u nongsharai .
translation.en: But when he saw the multitudes , he was moved with compassion on them , because they fainted , and were scattered abroad , as sheep having no shepherd .
At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn  ; and his disciples were an hungred , and began to pluck the ears of corn , and to eat .
translation.kha: Ym slem hadien U Jisu u la ïaid lyngba ki katto katne ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Ki synran jong u ki la thngan , ba kumta ki la sdang ban ïakheit ïa ki rynjup kew bad bam ïa ki symboh kew .
Sa shisien u Dabid u kylli na U Trai , uba jubab , Wat tur ïaleh ïa ki nangne , hynrei leit sawdong bad pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ki na khwai ka liang , najan ki diengduh Balsam .
translation.en: And when David enquired of the  Lord  , he said , Thou shalt not go up  ; but fetch a compass behind them , and come upon them over against the mulberry trees .

translation.kha: Na kiba khem kita ki jingma bashyrkhei jong ka jingpynïap u la pyni ïa ngi , bad un pynni ïa ngi ; bun ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha u ba un pynum biang ïa ngi , kumba phi ïarap ïa ngi lyngba ki jinglui lem jong phi na ka bynta jong ngi .
translation.en: Who delivered us from so great a death , and doth deliver : in whom we trust that he will yet deliver us ;

translation.kha: Ko Ainias , u Petros u la ong ha u , U Jisu Khreh u pynkhiah ïa me . To ïeng joit bad pynbeit ïa la ka jingthiah . mar kumta hi u Ainias u la ïingjaiñ joit .
translation.en: And Peter said unto him , Aeneas , Jesus Christ maketh thee whole : arise , and make thy bed . And he arose immediately .
Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki Israel ki sdang wanrah biang sha ki kamra buh tiar ïa kiba shiphew na u kew jong ki , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib .
U la dem bad u la ïohi ïa ki jaiñsop linen , hynrei um khim la rung shapoh .
translation.en: And he stooping down , and looking in , saw the linen clothes lying  ; yet went he not in .
Now the brother shall betray the brother to death , and the father the son  ; and children shall rise up against their parents , and shall cause them to be put to death .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin aiti noh ïa la ki hynmen ki para ban pynïap ïa ki , bad ki kpa kin leh kumjuh ïa la ki khun , ki khun ki ïeng pyrshah ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad kin aiti ïa ki ban shah pynïap .
Nga shakri kum u lyngdoh ha kaba ïarap ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei! , khring ba ki Jentil ki lai ban long ka jingkynha ba la pdiang shata U Blei , ba la pynkyntang sha u da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles , ministering the gospel of God , that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable , being sanctified by the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: Baroh ki jaitbynriew kin shakri ïa u , pynlang kin sakhrai ïa u khum bad u khun ksiew jong u tad haduh ba ka por kan wan ïa ka hima jong u hi ban jingkyllon . Te ka jyrthiaw jong u kuna sharati ïa ki jingpyniwbih badonbor bad ïa ki syiem bakhraw .
translation.en: And all nations shall serve him , and his son , and his son s son , until the very time of his land come : and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him .
Saying ,  Father , if thou be willing , remove this cup from me : nevertheless not my will , but thine , be done .
translation.kha: Ko Pa ,  u la ong ,  lada me mon , shim noh na nga ïa kane ka khuri ka jingshah shitom . Ym ïa ka mon jong nga , pynban , ïa ka mon jong me yn pyndep .

translation.en: Naked , and ye clothed me : I was sick , and ye visited me : I was in prison , and ye came unto me .
translation.kha: nga la lyngkhuit bad phi la pynkup jaiñ ïa nga ; nga la pang bad phi la shim ban sumar ïa nga , nga la don ha ïingbyndi bad phi la wan jngoh ïa nga .’
“lada u bhabriew u ïathiah shongkha malu ka tnga Jong u kñi jong u , u pynkheiñ burom ïa la u Kñia , kumta ma u bad kata ka biria keiñ kit hi ïa la ka pop ; baroh ar ngut kin ïap khlem khun .
translation.en: And if a man shall lie with his uncle s wife , he hath uncovered his uncle s nakedness : they shall bear their sin  ; they shall die childless .

translation.kha: wat la don katto katne ngut kiba khih ban pyndep ïa ka . Da kaba leh mynleh kum ki parabangeit , kine ki rangbah ki la ïohrung shapoh ka kynha jong im kum ki nongsyntiat , khnang ban lap shemphang ka jingtied kaba ngi la mad da ka jingpynïasoh jong im’ ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in , who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus , that they might bring us into bondage :
That they teach you not to do after all their abominations , which they have done unto their gods  ; so should ye sin against the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa ki , ba kin ym ïoh hikai shuh ïa phi ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba isaitmet ba ki ju leh haba ki mane ïa ki blei jong ki , kumta ba phin ym leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

Mynta , la kumno kumno ngan phah ïa ki rangbah synshar jong nga ïa-ban ïit ha ka ïingsyiem jongki me bad ha ki iing jongngi ki rangbah synshar jong me , bad ban shim ïa kaei kaei baroh kiba ki kheiñ kordor . Kin poi hangto lashai kumba katai por .
translation.en: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time , and they shall search thine house , and the houses of thy servants  ; and it shall be , that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes , they shall put it in their hand , and take it away .
And Moses spake unto the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: U Moses u duwai ,

Hynrei mynta phi phai pyrsa ïa ka longïing jong i pa jong nga . Phin la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong i — hynñiewphew ngut ki rangbah halor uwei u maw — bad Naamah ba u Abimelekh , u khun ba i ïohi na ka shakri jongngi i , u dien uba ha ïinglieng jong phi , phi la pynlong ïa u , u syiem ka Shekhem .
translation.en: And ye are risen up against my father s house this day , and have slain his sons , threescore and ten persons , upon one stone , and have made Abimelech , the son of his maidservant , king over the men of Shechem , because he is your brother  ; )

translation.kha: Balah ki nongshong shnong jong kata ka nongbah ki la ïamynjur ïa kaei katba u Horem mala u Shekhem ki ai jingmut , bad baroh ki shynrong ki la shah otsher .
translation.en: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city  ; and every male was circumcised , all that went out of the gate of his city .
So they , being sent forth by the Holy Ghost , departed unto Seleucia  ; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus .
translation.kha: Haba la phah da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u Barnabas bad u Saul ki la leit sha Seleukia bad ki la leit da ka lieng nangta sha ka dewlynnong Sypros .
U Goliath u ïeng bad u byrthen ïa ki Israel , Pha ïajah aïu hangto , pynkhreh ban ïaleh thma ? Nga , nga dei u Philistia , phi ki mraw u Saul ! Jied uwei na ki rangbah jong phi ban ïateh bad de .
translation.en: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Israel , and said unto them , Why are ye come out to set your battle in array ? am not I a Philistine , and ye servants to Saul ? choose you a man for you , and let him come down to me .

translation.kha: Lada ka jingïatiplem jong ngi ka pynrem ïa ngi , moi tip ba U Blei u khap khraw ba ïa ka jingïatiplem jong ngi bad ba u tip ïa kiei kiei baroh .
translation.en: For if our heart condemn us , God is greater than our heart , and knoweth all things .

translation.kha: phi pyrshah ïa kito kiba ieit ïa phi bad kyrshan ïa pli kiba isih ïa phoi ! phiah la pynpei shai ba ki nongpynïaidkam bad ki lapbah jong phi kim long ei ei ïa phi . Nga lah ban ïohi ba phin jin da la sngewhun Ladan u Abiram u tang im mynta bad ba ngi baroh ngin ïap .
translation.en: In that thou lovest thine enemies , and hatest thy friends . For thou hast declared this day , that thou regardest neither princes nor servants : for this day I perceive , that if Absalom had lived , and all we had died this day , then it had pleased thee well .

And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah , Therefore we turn again to thee now , that thou mayest go with us , and fight against the children of Ammon , and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead .
translation.kha: Ki ong ïa u Jephthah ,  Ngi phai sha me mynta namar ngi kwah ïa me ban leit lang bad ngi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Ammon , bad ban long u nongïalam ïa ki Gilead baroh .
bad sa ar thyllah ki jingker ïa ki khongdong jong ka .
translation.en: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides .

translation.kha: Me kyntu ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong ngi , ban maham ïa kiba jaipdeh , ban pynkulmar ïa kiba khawpud , ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot , don ïashad ïa baroh .
translation.en: Now we exhort you , brethren , warn them that are unruly , comfort the feebleminded , support the weak , be patient toward all men .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah kiba la ïohnong hangta ki la iohsngew ïa kata ka sur , bad don na ki babha la ong ba ka dei ka jingtied pyrthat , katba kiwei pat ki la ong , U angel u la kren ha u !
translation.en: The people therefore , that stood by , and heard it , said that it thundered : others said , An angel spake to him .

translation.kha: U phong ka jingkup kaba la shna na ki snieh mrad , ïa kaba la teh da u panpoh snep , ki jubab . U dei u Elijah ! u shem u la ïa-ong jam .
translation.en: And they answered him , He was an hairy man , and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins . And he said , It is Elijah the Tishbite .

translation.kha: ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem bad ki paralok jong nga kim don shuh .
translation.en: My kinsfolk have failed , and my familiar friends have forgotten me .

translation.kha: U lah ban phet ïap sha kawei na kine ki nongbam , un leit sha ka jaka bishar ha ka khyrdop sha ka nongbah , bad batai ha ki nongïalam ïa kaba la jia . Nangta kan shah ba un rung shapoh ka nongbah bad ktien ai jaka sah ïa u , ba kumta u lah ban shong ban kamar-tama hangta .
translation.en: And when he that doth flee unto one of those cities shall stand at the entering of the gate of the city , and shall declare his cause in the ears of the elders of that city , they shall take him into the city unto them , and give him a place , that he may dwell among them .
Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught , that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers .
translation.kha: U dei ban long uba batskhem ïa ka khubor kaba lah ban shaniah bad kaba ïadei bad ka jinghikai shongtynrai . Ha kane ka rukom un lah ban ai mynsiem ïa kiwei da ka jinghikai bashisha bad ban pyn-i ruh ïa ka jingbakla jong kito kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa ka .

Nangta ki briew ki la jong , To ngin ar ei ei sanphew u Jeremaïah ! Yn to borabor ki lyngdoh ki ban hikai ïa ngi , ki rangbah bastad ban ai jingsyllok ïa ngi , bad ki nongïathuhlypa ban pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Blei . To ïong wallam ki jinghukum pyrshah ïa u , bad sangeh ban pynshahshkor ïa kaei kabu u ainong .
translation.en: Then said they , Come , and let us devise devices against Jeremiah  ; for the law shall not perish from the priest , nor counsel from the wise , nor the word from the prophet . Come , and let us smite him with the tongue , and let us not give heed to any of his words .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada u pyndam ïa kata hadien , un hap ban shah ïa ki jingpynshitom na ka jinglehbha ban pyndep ïa ka kular .
translation.en: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them  ; then he shall bear her iniquity .

translation.kha: Yn ym ne shuh kano kano ka miet , bad kin ym donkam ïa ki sharak lane ïa ka jingshai ka sngi , namar U Trai uba U Blei un long ka jingshai jong ki mala kin synshar kum ki syiem junom la junom .
translation.en: And there shall be no night there  ; and they need no candle , neither light of the sun  ; for the Lord God giveth them light : and they shall reign for ever and ever .

translation.kha: U riewbymman u sngewsarong ha la ki jong ki jingkwah basniew ; u riewlalot u tmain bad kyntait ïa U Tharai .
translation.en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart s desire , and blesseth the covetous , whom the  Lord  abhorreth .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei katba la thoh : ‘ Ka dak jingkheiñ , ka dak jingkheiñ , ka jingthew , ki jingbynta .’
translation.en: And this is the writing that was written , MENE , MENE , TEKEL , UPHARSIN .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u angel u rupa sha khmat ; u ïeng ha ka jaka kaba khim ha kaba ym ni jaka ban ïadoh na baroh rkhiang .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  went further , and stood in a narrow place , where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left .
And in the synagogue there was a man , which had a spirit of an unclean devil , and cried out with a loud voice ,
translation.kha: Ha ka synagog , la don u briew uba don u mynsiem bymkhuid ha u , bad u la kyang da ka sur kaba jam ,
Naba uno uno uba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingjahthait ïa kaba U Blei u la kular , un shongthait na ka kam jong u hi , kumba U balui u la shongthait na ka kam jong u .
translation.en: For he that is entered into his rest , he also hath ceased from his own works , as God did from his .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la phah ïa la ki synrai ban wad ïa ki briew kiba sngewrit nabar ban hikai ïa ki kumno ban long ki paralok jongki U Blei .
translation.en: Jesus sent his followers to search for meek people and to teach them how to become acceptable to God .
For better it is that it be said unto thee , Come up hither  ; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban shah khot sha ka jaka kaba kham shajrong ban ïa kaba shah ong ban ai noh ïa ka jaka jong phi ha uwei uba kham pawkhmat .
Bad khyllem da pynpaw ïa kiwei pud kiew kai , man ka sngi la ngab ïa na da ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta ki balang baroh .
translation.en: Beside those things that are without , that which cometh upon me daily , the care of all the churches .
Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge : but he that hateth reproof is brutish .
translation.kha: Kino kino kiba ieit ïa ka jingtip ki kwah ban don ba pynong haba ki bakla . Ka long ka jingbieit ban isih haba don ba pynbeit .
Nangta ki apostol ki la kitei phai pat sha Jerusalem na u lum ki Olib , umbiah jingai kumba shi kilomitar na ka nongbat .
translation.en: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet , which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day s journey .

translation.kha: Man la u khun ba la kha nyngkong , pynlang man la Uba la kha nyngkong na ki jingrem , ki Dei ki jong nga . Hynrei phi dei pun sleit biang ïa u kada ,
translation.en: All that openeth the matrix is mine  ; and every firstling among thy cattle , whether ox or sheep , that is male .

translation.kha: To kynmaw , ko Trai , ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ngi . To khmih ïa ngi , malu peit ïa ka jingbyrngem jong ngi .
translation.en: Remember , O  Lord  , what is come upon us : consider , and behold our reproach .

translation.kha: U Trai u kyrhai na u lum Seïon ; ka sur jong u ka byr-ïe na Jerusalem ; ka khyndew mala ka suiñbneng ki khñiot . hynñiew un ïada ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: The  Lord  also shall roar out of Zion , and utter his voice from Jerusalem  ; and the heavens and the earth shall shake : but the  Lord  will be the hope of his people , and the strength of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Te Men sa tip ba ma nga , U Trai , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ jong me ba ïa ki lumbah ka Israel ba ki la sah kynjah nabar ba ki long ki jong me ba men baibam duh .
translation.en: And thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  , and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel , saying , They are laid desolate , they are given us to consume .
Therefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will prepare thee unto blood , and blood shall pursue thee : sith thou hast not hated blood , even blood shall pursue thee .
translation.kha: Kumta te — da shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im — ka jingïap ka long ka kupar jong pha , bad men ym lah lait na ka . Me long uba la rem na ka jingpynïap briew , bad ka jingpynïap briew kan buddien ïa me .
Ha u bniap bahynriew jong ka jingpynshong jongnga ka Elisabeth , U Blei u la pah ïa u jin Gabriel sha ka shong ha Galilaïa kaba kyrteng ka Nasareth .
translation.en: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee , named Nazareth ,

translation.kha: haba phi tei ïing thymmai , kynmaw baneh da ker ïa ka tduh jong ka tnum ïing , ioh phi haduh kit pop lada uno uno u bri u hap nongkit mala u ïap .
translation.en: When thou buildest a new house , then thou shalt make a battlement for thy roof , that thou bring not blood upon thine house , if any man fall from thence .

translation.kha: Katto katne ki nonglamktien ki wan nabar ki ïathuh ha u syiem Jehoshaphat : Ka kynhun shipai babun pangnud na Edom ka la wan na sha shiliang ka Duriaw Baibyl ban tam ïaleh ïa phi . Ki la dep knieh ïa ka Hasason tamasa . ( Kane ka dei kawei pat ka kyrteng jongu ka Engedi . )
translation.en: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat , saying , There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria  ; and , behold , they be in Hazazon–tamar , which is En–gedi .
And it came to pass , when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes , and covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Mar ïa ïohsngew ïa kane ka khubor , u syiem Hesekaïah u la tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , u la phong ki jaiñ khain , bad u la leit sha ka Templ jong U  Trai .
Nga burom bad nga ieit ïa ki hukum jong me ; lang poh ïa ki jingbah jong me .
translation.en: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments , which I have loved  ; and I will meditate in thy statutes .

translation.kha: Bad pynïap , nabar ka jingkhraw ka jingisynei jong me , im skhem iehnoh ne pynjot ïa ki . Me long U blei ka jingtei bad ka jingisynei !
translation.en: Nevertheless for thy great mercies  sake thou didst not utterly consume them , nor forsake them  ; for thou art a gracious and merciful God .

translation.kha: ki thrang ha ka jingdum bad ïaid sheng sheng kum ki nongbuaid .
translation.en: They grope in the dark without light , and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man .

translation.kha: Kumta u la ïalap ha ki synagog ha kylleng ka ri .
translation.en: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee .

translation.kha: Kata ka jia namar u la lehbeiñ ïa ki riewkynthei bad um ju pyn-i jingsbun ïa ki kynthei ki bym don khun .
translation.en: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not : and doeth not good to the widow .

translation.kha: ma u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki rai ba ot khong ïa ka jingpanpoh um shabi ka nongbah khnang ban khlad ïa ki nong Assyria ban ïoh um ianga kin poi ha Jerushah . Ki rangbah synshar ki ïalam ïa u paidbah babun ban ïamih bad ban set noh ïa Baroh ki umpohliew , khnang ba yn ym don um ka ban thad shabar na ki .
translation.en: So there was gathered much people together , who stopped all the fountains , and the brook that ran through the midst of the land , saying , Why should the kings of Assyria come , and find much water ?

translation.kha: Ha ka por jan sngaid , u poi shaw ka tare bakhuid bad u la sher dara hangta . U dem ban theh , u da pynshaniah ïa la ka khlieh halor u maw-it .
translation.en: And he lighted upon a certain place , and tarried there all night , because the sun was set  ; and he took of the stones of that place , and put them for his pillows , and lay down in that place to sleep .

translation.kha: Mynta , ki para ri jong u ki la isih ïa u , sad kumta ki la phah ïa ki nonglamktien hawei jong u banbeiñ ong , ‘ Ngi kwah ïa une u briew ban long u syiem jong ngi .’
translation.en: But his citizens hated him , and sent a message after him , saying , We will not have this man to reign over us .

And when they had finished it , they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada , whereof were made vessels for the house of the  Lord  , even vessels to minister , and to offer withal , and spoons , and vessels of gold and silver . And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the  Lord  continually all the days of Jehoiada .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la pyndep ïa ka jingpynbha , ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa kaba tam la ai sha u syiem bad sha u Jehoïada , kiba la pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba phah shna ïa ki pliang bad kiwei ki pat ki khiew ki pliang na ka bynta ka Templ . Katba u Jehoïada u dang im , ïa ki jingkñia la ai tista ha ka Templ .
U la ong , Ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka ri bad ïa ki lyngdoh ba haba ki jingshahthngan bad ïambriew ha u bnai basan bad bahynñiew ha kine ki hynñiewphew snep , kam shym dat ha ka jingñiewburom ïa na .
translation.en: Speak unto all the people of the land , and to the priests , saying , When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month , even those seventy years , did ye at all fast unto me , even to me ?

translation.kha: U Samuel u leh ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la ong ha u ïa-ban leh nabar u leit sha Bethlehem , ha kaba ki nongïalam jong kata ka nongbah ki wan da kaba kyiuh ban ïakynton ïa u bad ki kulai , Hattush kane ka long ka jingwan jngoh ha ka jingsuk , ko nongïohipaw ?
translation.en: And Samuel did that which the  Lord  spake , and came to Beth–lehem . And the elders of the town trembled at his coming , and said , Comest thou peaceably ?

translation.kha: U Dabid u la kular ba un leh kumta . Nangta u Saul u leit phai sha ïing , bad u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la longing phai biang sha la ka jakarieh .
translation.en: And David sware unto Saul . And Saul went home  ; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold .

translation.kha: Uwei patiaw u briew u la jong , Ngan bud ïa me , ko kynrad ; hynrei nyngkong shahshkor ïa nga ban longing bad bahkhlieh ïa ka longïing jong por .
translation.en: And another also said , Lord , I will follow thee  ; but let me first go bid them farewell , which are at home at my house .

translation.kha: Ym don mano ma ha Israel uba pawnam ha ka jingbhabriew kat u Absalom ; um don kano kano ka jingduna naduh khlieh haduh sleit jat .
translation.en: But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty : from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him .

And he removed from thence unto a mountain on the east of Beth–el , and pitched his tent , having Beth–el on the west , and Ai on the east : and there he builded an altar unto the  Lord  , and called upon the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u la leit shaphang shathie sha ka ri lum ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Bethel bad u la pynïeng ïa ka dara hapdeng ka Bethel shaphang sepngi bad ka Ai shaphang mihngi . Hangta ruh u la tei ïa ka duwan bad u la mane ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Who appeared in glory , and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: kiba la paw ha ka burom ba kynja bneng bad ki la ïakren bad U Jisu shaphang ka rukom ha kaba shen un sa pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong U Blei da kaba ïap ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist : notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u long uba kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u briew uba la ju im . Hynrei uta uba rit tam ha ka Hima ki bneng u long uba kham khraw ban ïa u Ïoannis .

Ïa phi la jied kat kum ka jingthmu U Blei kaba U Kpa bad la pynlong ïa phi ki briew Kiba khuid da U Mynsiem jongno u , ban kohnguh ïa U Jisu Khrist bad ban ïuh pynkhuid da ka snam jongngi u . To ai ba ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk kin long bakha dap pura ïa phi .
translation.en: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father , through sanctification of the Spirit , unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ : Grace unto you , and peace , be multiplied .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Hasor yn pyntylli ri syep junom , ka jaka ha kaba tang ki myrsiang kin im . Yn ym don myn mano shuh ban shong ban sah biang hangta . Ma ang , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons , and a desolation for ever : there shall no man abide there , nor any son of man dwell in it .

translation.kha: U la pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ban ïathuh ïa ki shibun kiei kiei . Shisien la ne u bhabriew uba la mihnoh ban peiñ symbai .
translation.en: And he spake many things unto them in parables , saying ,  Behold , a sower went forth to sow  ;

translation.kha: Ka la ïalam shaphang kata ha baroh kita ki hynñiew sngi jong ka jingkhawai . Hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u ïathuh ha ka , ka mut aïu kata ka jingkyntip , naba ka ïai thlia ïa u katta dik . Nangta ka ïathuh patan ha i'u ki Philistia .
translation.en: And she wept before him the seven days , while their feast lasted : and it came to pass on the seventh day , that he told her , because she lay sore upon him : and she told the riddle to the children of her people .
And Joseph s master took him , and put him into the prison , a place where the king s prisoners were bound : and he was there in the prison .
translation.kha: bad u la phah kem ïa u Joseph bad u set ïa u ha ka byndi ha ka jaka ba la set ïa ki koidi jong u syiem , bad hangta la pynsah ïa u .

Kumta ki la shim ïa nga bun ki la pynhiar ïa nga da ki tyllai shapoh ka pung u khun syiem Hakhlieh , kaba don hapoh ka phyllaw jingmih . Ym don um ha kata ka pung , tang ka ktieh , bad nga la ngap shaphang ha ka .
translation.en: Then took they Jeremiah , and cast him into the dungeon of Malchiah the son of Hammelech , that was in the court of the prison : and they let down Jeremiah with cords . And in the dungeon there was no water , but mire : so Jeremiah sunk in the mire .
Then saith he unto his disciples ,  The harvest truly is plenteous , but the labourers are few  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  Ka jingot ka khraw eh , hynrei don khyndiat ki nongtrei ban lumlang ïa ka shapoh .

Susah to pynkyntang khuid ïa ka snieh kaba sanphew nabar pynbna ïa ka jinglaitluid ha ki traishnong baroh jong kata ka ri . Ha kane ka snem , ïa ki jingdon jingem baroh ba la dep die dei ban pynphieng pud sha u trai jong ka , Lane sha ki khun ki ksiew jong u , bad du uno u brai uba la shah die mraw un leit pei pat shwa la ïohnang .
translation.en: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year , and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof : it shall be a jubilee unto you  ; and ye shall return every man unto his possession , and ye shall return every man unto his family .
And the people said unto me , Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us , that thou doest so ?
translation.kha: Ki briew ki kylli ïa nga ,  Balei ba me leh kumne ?

translation.en: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good , and doeth it not , to him it is sin .
translation.kha: Kumta te , u briew u bym leh ïa kaba bha kaba u tip ba u dei ban leh u long uba shah pynrem namar ka pop .
U pynbiang jingbam ïa Kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u ; um ju kheit ïa ka jutang jong u .
translation.en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him : he will ever be mindful of his covenant .

translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa kaei ba la hikai ïa phi , long uba distrik ; ki kyntait ïa ka .
translation.en: Hear instruction , and be wise , and refuse it not .

translation.kha: Hato uno ine na phi u lah ban im khnam slem da kaba u khuslai shaphang jong ka ?
translation.en: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature ?

translation.kha: Kumno nga lah ban map ïa kito kiba pyndonburom da ki tarajur bad jingwoh bashukor ?
translation.en: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances , and with the bag of deceitful weights ?

translation.kha: Ïa ka spah lad u baroh yn pynïong ha ka jingshlei jong ka jingbitar U Blang .
translation.en: The increase of his house shall depart , and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath .

And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon , he , and his mother , and his servants , and his princes , and his officers : and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign .
translation.kha: bad u syiem Jehoïakhin lem bad ka kmie jong u , ki khun shynrang jong u , ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , bad ki rangbah synshar ha ka ïingsyiem , ki la pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia . Ha ka snem kaba phra jong ka jingsynshar u Nebukhadnessar u la shim koidi ïa u Jehoïakhin
Hato une u dei u briew kaba la pynjot ïa ki nongbah bad pynkylla ïa ka pyrthei sha ka ri shyiap ? hato i'u u dei u briew u bym ju pyllaitluid ïa ki koidi jong u lane shah ïa ki don saw shuh ïing ?’
translation.en: That made the world as a wilderness , and destroyed the cities thereof  ; that opened not the house of his prisoners ?

translation.kha: Kumta u buh pur ïa ki ha byndi haduh lai sngi .
translation.en: And he put them all together into ward three days .

translation.kha: Hynrei la don shiphew ngut ki rangbah ha ka kynjoh kiba la ong ha u Ishmael , Sngewbha wat pyndap ïa ngi ! Ngi don u kew , u barli , ka umphniang Olib , bad ka ngap ba la buhrieh ha ki lyngkha . Kumta u la pyllait ïa ki .
translation.en: But ten men were found among them that said unto Ishmael , Slay us not : for we have treasures in the field , of wheat , and of barley , and of oil , and of honey . So he forbare , and slew them not among their brethren .

translation.kha: Dei U Trai uba ai ïa ka jingstad ; na u ka wan ka jingtep bad ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: For the  Lord  giveth wisdom : out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding .

translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U Trai , namar u long babha bha ; ka jingieit jong u ka Neah bymjukut .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: te ngan weng noh ïa phi na kane ka ri ïa naba nga la ai ha phi , bad ngan iehnoh ïa kane ka Templ ba nga la pynshngain kumta ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga . Ki briew kylleng kin krenbeiñ bad ñiewbeiñ ïa ka .
translation.en: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them  ; and this house , which I have sanctified for my name , will I cast out of my sight , and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations .

translation.kha: Kin kyllaiñ ïa ka lynti shuh Sihon malu nangta kin leit ha —kata ka phang . Keiñ pynlong ka jutang baïaineh bad nga Bad da lei lei kin ym pynkheiñ ïa ka .
translation.en: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward , saying , Come , and let us join ourselves to the  Lord  in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la lah rain ha ka lyngba kaba seisoh bad kaba biang bha ka um ba kumin u lah ban sei ki sla bad pynmih ki shaïong bad long u dieng sohwaiñ uba itynnad eh .
translation.en: It was planted in a good soil by great waters , that it might bring forth branches , and that it might bear fruit , that it might be a goodly vine .
No man can come to me , except the Father which hath sent me draw him : and I will raise him up at the last day .
translation.kha: Ym don uba lah ban wan sha nga lymda U Kpa uba la phah ïa nga u pynwan ïa u sha nga ; bad ngan pynmihpat ïa u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .

Kumta u Naaman u ong , Lada phim pyngkiang ïa ka jingai jong de , te shah ïa nga ban rah sha ïing ar kit khashor ka khyndew , namar naduh mynta nur ym ai jingkñia lieng jingainguh thang ha uno une u blei lait khong tang U Trai .
translation.en: And Naaman said , Shall there not then , I pray thee , be given to thy servant two mules  burden of earth ? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods , but unto the  Lord .
And Moses wrote all the words of the  Lord  , and rose up early in the morning , and builded an altar under the hill , and twelve pillars , according to the twelve tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: U Moses u thoh ïa ki hukum baroh jong U  Trai . Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , u tei ïa ka duwan ha trai jong u lum , bad u pynïeng ruh khat-ar tylli ki maw , uwei u maw na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel .
U Amasaïah u kulai ïa u nongïathuhlypa , Hynrei kumno pat shaphang ka rupa baroh kaba nga la dep siew ïa ki ? U nongïohipaw u jubab , U Trai u lah ïa-ban ai pat shiah me kham bun ban ïa kata !
translation.en: And Amaziah said to the man of God , But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel ? And the man of God answered , The  Lord  is able to give thee much more than this .

Then spake Azariah the son of Hoshaiah , and Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the proud men , saying unto Jeremiah , Thou speakest falsely : the  Lord  our God hath not sent thee to say , Go not into Egypt to sojourn there :
translation.kha: Nangta u Asaraïah u khun jong u Hoshaïah bad u Johanan u khun jong u Kareah bad baroh kiwei ki rangbah ba leh meng ki la ong ïa nga ,  Phi shukor . U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi um shym la phah ïa phi ban ong ha ngi ba ngin ym leit bad shong ha Ijipt .
ka Judah ka la kylla long ka jaitbynriew kaba Khuid jngai U Trai , bad ka Israel ka kylla long ka jingïohkynti jong u hi .
translation.en: Judah was his sanctuary , and Israel his dominion .

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kin hikai ïa ki bariew jong nga ïa ka jingpynïap hapdeng katei kaba khuid bad ka bymkohnguh , dara hapdeng kaei kaba khuid katne kum ka jinglehniam bad kaei ka bym un-long kamet .
translation.en: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane , and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean .

translation.kha: Phi long u khun ba-ieit jrong nga , ka jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong nga . Kaei ngan ïathuh ïa phi ?
translation.en: What , my son ? and what , the son of my womb ? and what , the son of my vows ?

translation.kha: Nangta u shakri uba la ïohpdiang shihajar tylli ki sbai u la wan rung bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga tip ba me long u briew babha eh ; me ot ïa ki jingtah na kaba mem shym la bet , bad me lum ïa ki jingthung na kaba mem shym la set symbai .
translation.en: Then he which had received the one talent came and said , Lord , I knew thee that thou art an hard man , reaping where thou hast not sown , and gathering where thou hast not strawed :

translation.kha: Ym slem hadien , U Jisu u la wanrah na Nasareth kaba ha ka pun jong ka Galilaïa , bad la pynbaptis da u Ïoannis ha ka wah Jordan .
translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee , and was baptized of John in Jordan .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa U Trai ba u ïeng harud ka duwan . U la ai ka lawbah : Tied tyngeh ïa ki khlieh rishot jong ka Tabor haduh ba ka shyngkub barieh kawei kan da khiar . Pynpait ïa ki bun ai ba kin hap halor ki khlieh jong ki briew . Ngan pynïap ha ka thma ïa ki briew kiba dang sah . Yn ym don u ban ïohphet ; wat uwei ruh un ym lait im .
translation.en: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar : and he said , Smite the lintel of the door , that the posts may shake : and cut them in the head , all of them  ; and I will slay the last of them with the sword : he that fleeth of them shall not flee away , and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered .
In that night was Belshazzar the king of the Chaldeans slain .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka miet ïa u Belshassar , u syiem ka Babilonia , la pynïap ;
Ka durkhmat Jong u ka la lama kum ka leilieh , bad ki jreiñ jong u ki lieh kum ka ïor .
translation.en: His countenance was like lightning , and his raiment white as snow :

translation.kha: Man la ka snem wallam ïa ki soh ba phi la lum nongking na ka jingot shaei ka ïing U Trai U Blei jrong phi . Wat ju shet ïa u khunlangbrot ne khunblang ha ka dud ka kmie jrong u .
translation.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the  Lord  thy God . Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother s milk .

translation.kha: Nga peit ïa khnai , nga la pyrkhat shemphang jong ka , bad nga ïoh ka jinghikai na ka :
translation.en: Then I saw , and considered it well : I looked upon it , and received instruction .

translation.kha: Pha long kaba khlieh bor wat la pha ïoh ïa ka jingai jingmut . To ai ba ki nongbatai kupar kin wan shaw khmat ban pyut im ïa pha — kito ki briew kiba dam jingtip shaphang ki khlur , kiba pruid dak ïa ki bynta jong ki ïeng bad ïathuh ïa pha na uwei u banbeiñ sha uwei pat kaei ka baneh jia ïa pha .
translation.en: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels . Let now the astrologers , the stargazers , the monthly prognosticators , stand up , and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee .

translation.kha: U Esra u ong , Ïaroh ïa U Trai , U Blei babha khraw ! Baroh u Paidbah u rah la ki ktem shajrong bad ainong , Amen ! Amon ! Ki dem khohsiew ha ka jingshakri , ki phai ki khmat jyllang ki sha khyndew .
translation.en: And Ezra blessed the  Lord  , the great God . And all the people answered , Amen , Amen , with lifting up their hands : and they bowed their heads , and worshipped the  Lord  with their faces to the ground .

translation.kha: Ai un bam kat kaba u khoh ! U Blei un pynshitom ïa u ha ka jingbitar shna .
translation.en: When he is about to fill his belly , God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him , and shall rain it upon him while he is eating .

translation.kha: Uno uno naba kynjat ïa nga bad u bym pdiang ïa ka khubor jrong nga , u don uwei u ban bishar ïa u . Ki ktien kiba nga la kren kin longïng u nongbishar jong u ha ka sngew kaba khatduh !
translation.en: He that rejecteth me , and receiveth not my words , hath one that judgeth him : the word that I have spoken , the same shall judge him in the last day .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Trai U Blei jong ngi ; to mane ha khmat ka khet jong u ! Kumba Khuid lama ma u !
translation.en: Exalt ye the  Lord  our God , and worship at his footstool  ; for he is holy .

translation.kha: Ïa kata ka lyngkha bad ka krem kaba don hangta la thied na ki Hit . Tep ïa nga hangta .
translation.en: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth .
And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land  ; I will bereave them of children , I will destroy my people , since they return not from their ways .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka shnong ha ka ri nga la kynting ïa phi sha ka lyer kum ïa u phlangïap . Nga la pynjot ïa phi , ki briew jong nga , nga la pynïap ïa ki khun jong phi namar phim shym sangeh ïa ki rukom basniew jong phi .
Ki la pynpang ïa lade ki bymkhuid da ki jingleh lad ki bad ki la long bymïaineh ha U Blei .
translation.en: Thus were they defiled with their own works , and went a whoring with their own inventions .

translation.kha: Phai hikai ruh , ‘ Lada Une uno u smai da ka duwan , ïa u ym shym la teh da ka jingsmai jong u ; hynrei dalade u smai da ka jingtieng sngewbha halor ka jingset , u long uba la shah teh .’
translation.en: And , Whosoever shall swear by the altar , it is nothing  ; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it , he is guilty .
