translation.kha: U buh hynñiewphew hajar ngut ki pynrangbah Ban trei ha kaba pyngkiang ïa ki tiar ki tar , dara phraphew hajar ngut ban trei ha kaba tih maw . La don lai hajar hynriewspah ngut kiwei pat kiba bahkhlieh na ka pyntwa ban pynïaid ïa ka kim .
translation.en: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens , and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain , and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them .

translation.kha: bad u law ba yn hikai ïa ka ha ki bynriew ka Judith . ( La buh jingsngewma ha Ka Kitab U Jashar . )
translation.en: ( Also he bade them teach the children of Judah the use of the bow : behold , it is written in the book of Jasher . )
And hath taken of the king s seed , and made a covenant with him , and hath taken an oath of him : he hath also taken the mighty of the land :
translation.kha: U la shim ïa uwei na ka longïing jong u syiem , u la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u , bad u la pynlong ïa u ban smai ban long uba ïaineh skhem . U la rah koidi ïa ki rangbah badonkam

U Trai umbiah synshar bad uba ïada ïa ki Israel , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , u don ïa kane ban ong : Nga long uba nyngkong , uba khatduh , tang ma nga hi U Blang ; ym ne iwei pat U Blei! hynrei tang ma nga .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  the King of Israel , and his redeemer the  Lord  of hosts  ; I am the first , and I am the last  ; and beside me there is no God .
And Amaziah strengthened himself , and led forth his people , and went to the valley of salt , and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand .
translation.kha: U Amasaïah u la long shlur bad u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u sha ka Them Mluh . Hangta ki la ïaleh bad ki pynïap shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Edom ,

translation.en: And the world passeth away , and the lust thereof : but he that doeth the will of God abideth for ever .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei bad kaei kaei baroh kaba don ha ka , kaba ki briew ki kwah kan sa jah noh ; hynrei kito kiba leh ïa ka mon U Blei kin im junom .
U Terah u ong , Wat ai ba uno Uno un kynnoh ïa ki briew lane pynmeh ïa ki — ka jingmudui jong nga ka long pyrsad ïa phi ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: Yet let no man strive , nor reprove another : for thy people are as they that strive with the priest .

translation.kha: U la ong ha nga , ‘ Ngan ai ha me bun ki kynhun ki ksiew ba kumta ki nongmih pateng jngai me ngin sa long ki jaitbynriew kiba bun . Ngan ai ïa kane ka ri ha ki khun ki kseh jong me ba kan long ka ri kynti jong ki junom .’
translation.en: And said unto me , Behold , I will make thee fruitful , and multiply thee , and I will make of thee a multitude of people  ; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa ka rukom ba U Blei u buh ba ki briew kin long ka hok bad u hi , la pynpaw . Kam don jingïadei ei ei bad ka Hukum , wat la ka Hukum u Moses bad ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ai ka jingsakhi ïa ka .
translation.en: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested , being witnessed by the law and the prophets ;

translation.kha: Ka por ka poi ! Ngi pynshitom ïa ki nongbanbeiñ jong pha ; ngan pyllew im ïa baroh kiba dkoh bad ngan wallam sha ïing ïa kiba shah jingthrew . Ngan pynphai ïa ka jinglehrain jong ki sha ka jingpynjahburom , bad bhor ka pyrthei kun ïajah ïa ki .
translation.en: Behold , at that time I will undo all that afflict thee : and I will save her that halteth , and gather her that was driven out  ; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame .

translation.kha: Baroh syang sngi la ïaroh ïa me malu pynbna ïa ka barim jong me .
translation.en: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day .

translation.kha: Hynrei me lah Ban ïohi tang ïa la ki jingmyntoi shimet ; me pynïap ïa kiba lui yn , bad me banbeiñ tyngeh ïa la ki brisoh . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness , and for to shed innocent blood , and for oppression , and for violence , to do it .
So David stayed his servants with these words , and suffered them not to rise against Saul . But Saul rose up out of the cave , and went on his way .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u pynkohnguh ïa la ki rangbah ba kim dei ban ktah kti ïa u Saul . U Saul u ïeng joit , u mihnoh na ka krem , bad u leit noh .
Haba ka sngi ka la sep , bad ba ka la dum , u khiew uba mih tdem badno ka dongmusa kaba pyndeng ki paw kynsan mala ïaid napdeng nia ki lyngkhot doh .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when the sun went down , and it was dark , behold a smoking furnace , and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces .

translation.kha: Kumba hadien khatkhyndai bnai bad arphew sngi ki la leit peiñ sha Jerusalem , da kaba ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri baroh kawei .
translation.en: So when they had gone through all the land , they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days .

translation.kha: Mynta por la ïohsngew ba me lah ban shem ïa ki jingmut Beraïah bad batai ïa ki jingmaïan . Lada me lah ban pluh ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ïathuh ïa sa aïu ka put jingmad , yn pynkup ïa me ha ki jaiñkup syiem ba sawbthuh , yn pyndeng ha me ïa u kynjri ksiar jong ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jong me , bad “Men long uba lai ha ka bor thah ka hima .
translation.en: And I have heard of thee , that thou canst make interpretations , and dissolve doubts : now if thou canst read the writing , and make known to me the interpretation thereof , thou shalt be clothed with scarlet , and have a chain of gold about thy neck , and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom .

translation.kha: Balei ? Namar ba ka Simri Kam long ka kham khleh ban ïa ka Damaskos , ka nongbah jong ka , bad ka Damaskos kam hir kiba Kham khlaiñ ban ïa u Shimham Resin . Katba ïa ka Israel , ioh ki hynriewphew sai snem yn sa pynkhynñiuh ïa ka ruh ban lieh im kumto ka jaitbynriew .
translation.en: For the head of Syria is Damascus , and the head of Damascus is Rezin  ; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken , that it be not a people .
And he was with them hid in the house of God six years : and Athaliah reigned over the land .
translation.kha: Hynriew snem u la don hangta ha kaba rieh , katba ka Athalaïah ka synshar kum ka syiem .

Ka jai Reuben bad ka jait Gad , sad kawei bapaw ka shiteng na ka jait Manasseh ki la ïohpang lypa ïa ka ri kaba u Moses , u shakri U Trai , u la ai ha ki ; ka don ha ka balang mihngi jong ka kwah Jordan .
translation.en: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance , which Moses gave them , beyond Jordan eastward , even as Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave them  ;

translation.kha: Lada U Mynsiem jong U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa U Jisu na ka jingïap , u im hapoh jong phi , te Uta uba la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap , un ai jingim shiah ïa ki met ba kynja doh jongu phi da ka jingdon U mynhynne jongnga u hapoh jongno pa .
translation.en: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you , he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you .

translation.kha: Wat ai ïa kamai kaba khuid ha ki ksew — kin shu phai pynban bad tur Ban dait ïa phi . Kam thret ïa ki mawlynnai ha khmat ki snep — kin shu ijuh pynïap ïa ki hapoh ka kjat .
translation.en: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs , neither cast ye your pearls before swine , lest they trample them under their feet , and turn again and rend you .

translation.kha: Ka la Jia ba katba u dang long syiem ba U Trai u phah jingsuh ïa u Resin u syiem ka Syros bad u Pekah u syiad ka Israel ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Joïada .
translation.en: In those days the  Lord  began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria , and Pekah the son of Remaliah .
And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall , and were set down together , Peter sat down among them .
translation.kha: La pynmeh ïa ka ding hapdeng jong ka phyllaw , bad u Petros u la ïasoh lem bad kito kiba ïashong sawdong jong ka .

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit , he cannot enter into the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ym don uba lah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei khlem da kha na ka um bad na U Mynsiem .

translation.en: He keepeth back his soul from the pit , and his life from perishing by the sword .
translation.kha: Un ym shah ba yn pynjot ïa ki ; u pyllait im ïa ki na ka jingïap hi .
Mano ba ïathuh ïa ka ibis lano ka wah Nile kan shlei um , lane mano ba ïathuh ïa u syiar ba u slap un sa hap ?
translation.en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts ? or who hath given understanding to the heart ?
Behold , there came fire down from heaven , and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties : therefore let my life now be precious in thy sight .
translation.kha: Ïa ki ar ngut ki rangbah pynïaidkam bad ki rangbah jong ki la pynïap da ka ding na bneng ; hynrei sngewbha isynei ïa nga !
Ka jingsneng bad ka jingpynbeit ki un-long kiba bha’ ïa ki khynnah . Lydia u khynnah u ïoh leh katba u mon , u pynkhlemrain ïa la ka kmie .
translation.en: The rod and reproof give wisdom : but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame .

translation.kha: U Paul bad u Silas ki la leit lyngba ka Amphipolis malade ka Apollonia , bad ki la wan poi sha Thessaloni , ha kaba la don ka synagog .
translation.en: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia , they came to Thessalonica , where was a synagogue of the Jews :
And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead , she mourned for her husband .
translation.kha: Haba ka Bathsheba ka la ïohsngew ba u tnga jong ka u la shah pynïap , ka ïambriew na ka bynta jong u .
Husiar ïoh phi ong ha lade , ‘ Ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga hi ki la pynriewspah katjuh ïa nga .’
translation.en: And thou say in thine heart , My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth .
Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the  Lord  , and Satan came also among them .
translation.kha: Haba la poi ka sngi ha kaba ki jingthaw ha bneng ki wanpaw ha khmat U  Trai  , u Soitan u la don lang hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath–pileser king of Assyria , saying , I am thy servant and thy son : come up , and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria , and out of the hand of the king of Israel , which rise up against me .
translation.kha: U Ahas u phah ïa ki rangbah sha u Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , ryngkat bad kane ka khubor :  Nga long u shakri baïaineh jong phi . To wan bad pyllait im ïa nga na ki syiem ka Syria bad Israel , kiba wan tur ïaleh ïa nga .

Haba phi lum ïa u kiew bad phi kum klet shuh Sing ha lyngka , wat leit tam shuh ïa u ; ïohi ïa u hangta na ka bynta ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , khnang ba U Trai U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa phi! ha ka kam jong Phin baroh .
translation.en: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field , and hast forgot a sheaf in the field , thou shalt not go again to fetch it : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow : that the  Lord  thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands .

translation.kha: Haba u Sanballat , u Tobiah , bad u nong Arab wahbah kyrteng u Geshem ki la iohsngew ïa kaei ka ngi la thmu ban leh , ki rkhie ïa ngi bad ïai-ong , kaei kaba phi taïew phin leh ? Hato phin ïaleh ïa-pyrshah ïa u patsha ?
translation.en: But when Sanballat the Horonite , and Tobiah the servant , the Ammonite , and Geshem the Arabian , heard it , they laughed us to scorn , and despised us , and said , What is this thing that ye do ? will ye rebel against the king ?

translation.kha: Ma u bad kiwei pat ki la sheptieng katta katta hapoh ba um tip ïa kaei ban ong .
translation.en: For he wist not what to say  ; for they were sore afraid .

translation.kha: La don sa kawei pat ka thma bad ki phylliew ha Gob , bad u Elhanan , u khuid jong u Jair uba na Bethlehem u la pynpei ïa u Goliath na Gob , babha u sum jong u , u don u dieng thung sum uba rben kat u khung jong u nongthain jaiñ .
translation.en: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines , where Elhanan the son of Jaare–oregim , a Beth–lehemite , slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite , the staff of whose spear was like a weaver s beam .

translation.kha: Kan satang kin plung kum u phlangïap ba la ai um bha , kum ki dieng Jamynrei harud ki wahduid jong ka um batuid .
translation.en: And they shall spring up as among the grass , as willows by the water courses .

translation.kha: hynriew nga la ong , ‘ Da lei lei ruh em , ko Trai ! Ym don Kana kano ka jingbang ka bymsuidñiew kat kum ka jingshim lane kambah sang kaba la ju rung ha ka shyntur jongu nga .’
translation.en: But I said , Not so , Lord : for nothing common or unclean hath at any time entered into my mouth .
But if any man hate his neighbour , and lie in wait for him , and rise up against him , and smite him mortally that he die , and fleeth into one of these cities :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u briew u shun ïa la u paramarjan bad u apthap ïa u , bad u shoh bad pynmynsaw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap , bad nangta u phet sha kawei na kita ki shnong ban ïoh jingïada ,
U Sekharaïah u la pan ïa ka kynja sleit bad u la thoh , Ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Ïoannis . A katno baroh ki la ïasngewsih kyndit !
translation.en: And he asked for a writing table , and wrote , saying , His name is John . And they marvelled all .

translation.kha: Naba U Trai u wan hiar ha u lyoh bad u la kren ïa u . U la shim khyndai ka bor mynjur kaba u la ai ha u Maaseïah bad u ai ïa ka ha me ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam . Haba kata ka bor mynsiem ka la wei shong ha ki , ki sdang ban pyrsa jam kamon ki Nongïathuhlypa , hynrei tang shipor .
translation.en: And the  Lord  came down in a cloud , and spake unto him , and took of the spirit that was upon him , and gave it unto the seventy elders : and it came to pass , that , when the spirit rested upon them , they prophesied , and did not cease .

translation.en: Yea , they are greedy dogs which can never have enough , and they are shepherds that cannot understand : they all look to their own way , every one for his gain , from his quarter .

translation.kha: Ngim haka ban shem u bynriew ibha khnam mala ban ïa u Joseph , u briew uba don U Mynmiet U balui .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto his servants , Can we find such a one as this is , a man in whom the Spirit of God is ?

translation.kha: Mynta ba phi la khyllie lut ïa ki jingdon jingem jong nga baroh , ki tiak ïing aïu phi shem kiba dei ki jongnga Phi ? To phriang ïa ki hangne ba ki briew jong phi bad ki jong nga kin ïohi , bad ai kin rwai ba mano na ngi uba dei .
translation.en: Whereas thou hast searched all my stuff , what hast thou found of all thy household stuff ? set it here before my brethren and thy brethren , that they may judge betwixt us both .

translation.kha: Ka um ka khrew ïa ki mawsiang , malade u slap uba jreiñ un rong noh ïa ka khyndew ; kumta me pynduh ïa ka jingkyrmen junom .
translation.en: The waters wear the stones : thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth  ; and thou destroyest the hope of man .

translation.kha: Hadien kata u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha Aijalon kaba ha ri Sebulun .
translation.en: And Elon the Zebulunite died , and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , woh ha ki sharai jong nga , baroh shynrang bad kynthei , len theh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha kita ki sngi , bad kin pynbha ïa ka kherub jong nga .
translation.en: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit  ; and they shall prophesy :
Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign , and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem , and did not that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  his God , like David his father .
translation.kha: Um shym bud ïa ki nuksa babha jong u syiem Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u ; pynban , u leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewsih ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u bad u bud ïa ki jingleh jong ki syiem Israel .

translation.en: And Peter said , Man , I know not what thou sayest . And immediately , while he yet spake , the cock crew .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la jubab ,  Ko rangbah , ngam sngewthuh shaphang kaei phi ïakren !  Kumta hi , katba u dang kren , u syiar u la kyn-ih .
U Jisu u la ïeng bad u la suda ïa ka lyer , Long jai jai ! bad u la ong ïa ki jingbat phyllung , Long jai jai ! Ka lyer ka la kynjah jar bad ka la don ka jingai jai kabu khraw .
translation.en: And he arose , and rebuked the wind , and said unto the sea ,  Peace , be still .  And the wind ceased , and there was a great calm .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba ieit khlam bun shah ïa la u kpa rue ka kmie ban ïa nga um long uba bit ban long u synran jyllang nga ; uno un uba ieit kham bun shah ïa la u khun lane ka khun ban ïa nga , um long uba bieit ngab long u synran jong nga .
translation.en: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me : and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me .

translation.kha: moi ki nongpynkha khun ki jubab , Ki kynthei Hebru kim long kum ki kynthah ibit ; ki kha suk ïa ki khun , bad katba ngin da pa ma sem , ki la lah kha .
translation.en: And the midwives said unto Pharaoh , Because the Hebrew women are not as the Egyptian women  ; for they are lively , and are delivered ere the midwives come in unto them .

translation.kha: Thaw ka rmiang kaba hynñiewphew san milimitar baïar Syndong mala pynpur da ka ksiar sawdong kata ka rmiang .
translation.en: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about , and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about .
For , behold , in those days , and in that time , when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha kata ka por ngan pynïoh pat ïa ka jingroi kyrhai jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: Therefore snares are round about thee , and sudden fear troubleth thee  ;
translation.kha: Kumta mynta ki don ki jingriam baroh sawdong jong phi , bad kynsan kynsan phi dap da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children , and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house , and when thou walkest by the way , and when thou liest down , and when thou risest up .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa ki ha ki khun ki kti jong phi . Ïai pynkynmaw ïa ki haba phi don ha ïing bad haba phi ïaid ha lynti , haba phi shongthait bad haba phi trei phi ktah .
Te U Trai u la ai ïa kaei ka khubor sha ki Briew lyngba u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa :
translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  by Haggai the prophet , saying ,

translation.kha: Kumba lai kynta , ïa ka Hukum jong U Troas U Blei jong ki , la pyllun ha ki , malu ha ki lai kynti kiba buhnud , ki phla ïa la ki pop bad mane ïa U Trai U Blei Jong ki .
translation.en: And they stood up in their place , and read in the book of the law of the  Lord  their God one fourth part of the day  ; and another fourth part they confessed , and worshipped the  Lord  their God .
Now if I do that I would not , it is no more I that do it , but sin that dwelleth in me .
translation.kha: Lada nga leh ïa kaei kaba ngam kwah ban leh , kane ka mut ba ngam long shuh uta uba leh ïa kata ; pynban , ka dei ka pop kaba im hapoh jong nga .
Ha ki por ba-mynshuwa ïa u khunbynriew ym shym la ïathuh ïa kane ka jingmaïan , hynrei , U Blei u la pynpaw ïa ka mynta da U Mynsiem ha ki apostol bad ki nongpynkhiah bakhuid jong u .
translation.en: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men , as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit ;

translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la ong , Nga shimti ba nga kruiñ ïa ka jingshem ! Ai ba U Blei un pynshitom ïa nga lada ngam long kumta ! Ngam tip shemphang uta u bri uba phi kren !
translation.en: But he began to curse and to swear , saying , I know not this man of whom ye speak .
And I set my face unto the Lord God , to seek by prayer and supplications , with fasting , and sackcloth , and ashes :
translation.kha: Bad nga la duwai jur ha U Trai U Blei , da kaba ïasaid bad u , da kaba shahjingit , da kaba phong ki jaiñ khain , bad da kaba shong ha u dpei .

Kin long ka dak jong ka jingong rijied jong U Trai Badonbor Baroh ha Ijipt . Haba ïa ki briew hangta la banbeiñ bad ki la kyang jam sha U Trai’ ban ïoh jingïarap , un phah ïa uno uno Ban pyllait ïa ki .
translation.en: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the  Lord  of hosts in the land of Egypt : for they shall cry unto the  Lord  because of the oppressors , and he shall send them a saviour , and a great one , and he shall deliver them .
If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things , thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ , nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine , whereunto thou hast attained .
translation.kha: Lada me ai ïa kine ki jinghikai ha ki parabangeit , men long u shakri babha jong U Khrist Jisu , kumba me bsa ïa lade ha ka mynsiem da ki ktien jong ka jingngeit bad jong ki jinghikai bashisha ïa kiba me la bud .

translation.en: And from Betah , and from Berothai , cities of Hadadezer , king David took exceeding much brass .
translation.kha: U la shim ruh shibun ka rnong na Betah bad na Berothai , ki nongbah kiba la synshar da u Hadadeser .
U syiem Sedekaïah u la jubab , To leh te ïa kaei kaweh phi kwah ban leh ïa u ; ngam lah ban khang ïa phi .
translation.en: Then Zedekiah the king said , Behold , he is in your hand : for the king is not he that can do any thing against you .

translation.kha: kamut u Petros u la ai ha ki ka jingïathuh bniah ïa kaei kaba la wia naduh kaba sdang hi .
translation.en: But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning , and expounded it by order unto them , saying ,

translation.kha: Kaei kaba me kwah ïa de ba kun na ka bynta jong me ? U Jisu u la kylli ïa u . Ko Nonghikai , uto u brisoh umbiah matlah u la jubab , Nga kwah ban ïoh imat biang .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  What wilt thou that I should do unto thee ?  The blind man said unto him , Lord , that I might receive my sight .
Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity , and sin as it were with a cart rope :
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phim shym lah ban pyllaitluid na la ki jong ki pop .
Ha ka step kambah bujli phin sngew kumba phi la shah puh da u seiñïong .
translation.en: At the last it biteth like a serpent , and stingeth like an adder .

translation.kha: U lah ban wallam ka jingsniew ha ngi , hynrei ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi ka long kaba thikna bad kaba khlain .
translation.en: But though he cause grief , yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies .

translation.kha: Wat pynduh ïa ki khah jong ki nongwei lane ki khunswet , bad wat shim ïa ka jaiñkup lad ka riewkai kum ka bynda ïa kan kano ka ram .
translation.en: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger , nor of the fatherless  ; nor take a widow s raiment to pledge :

translation.kha: Um dei hati ban pyntngit ïa ka iaki kyntur da kaba mih shabar jong ka ; naba la pynkyntang ïa u shaw nga da kaba pynsleh umphniang . Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary , nor profane the sanctuary of his God  ; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ngi la leh pop bad ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , bad ma me A Trai , sam pat shym lap ïa ngi .
translation.en: We have transgressed and have rebelled : thou hast not pardoned .

translation.kha: Ki metïap ki la saphriang ha kylleng , kum ki kynton sboh halor ki lyngkhuit , kamon u riewhadem ba la ot bad iehnoh da ki nongot , u riewhadem u bym ba-don mano mano ba lum . Kane ka longïing kaei kaba U Trai u la bthah ïa nga ban ong .
translation.en: Speak , Thus saith the  Lord  , Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field , and as the handful after the harvestman , and none shall gather them .

translation.kha: U Heber u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Japhlet , u Shomer , bad u Hotham , bad kawei ka khun , ka Shua .
translation.en: And Heber begat Japhlet , and Shomer , and Hotham , and Shua their sister .

translation.kha: Kita ki la ïaleit sha kata ka ri lum khah Them Shahshkor nabar ki la synlar ïa ka .
translation.en: And they turned and went up into the mountain , and came unto the valley of Eshcol , and searched it out .

translation.kha: bad tei ïa ka ïing jong me halor ki um hajrong . Me pyndonkam ïa ki lyoh kum ki kali ïapom bad me shnong halor ki thapniang jong ka lyer .
translation.en: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters : who maketh the clouds his chariot : who walketh upon the wings of the wind :

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u ong , kun buh ïa me kum u nongap phira na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew Israel . Men pynsngew ha ki ïa ki jingmaham kiba nga ai ïa me .
translation.en: Son of man , I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel : therefore hear the word at my mouth , and give them warning from me .

translation.kha: U syiem Ahab u ïathaw ha ka Jesebel ka tnga jong u ïa baroh kob u Elijah u la kun bad kumno ba u la pynïap lut ïa ki nongïathuhlypa u Baal .
translation.en: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done , and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword .
For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ ,
translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw , nga dem khohsiew ha khmat U Kpa ,
Ka jingïateh kular kaba phi la pynlong bad ka jingïap yn pynbuh , mala ïa ka jingïakut jong phiah bun ka pyrthei kiba ïapom yn pyndam noh . Haba ka jingjot ka sar , phin shispah ne .
translation.en: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled , and your agreement with hell shall not stand  ; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through , then ye shall be trodden down by it .

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew lad u Kush ki long ki briew jong ka Seba , ka Hakhilah , ka Sabtah , ka Raamah , bad ka Sabteka . Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Raamah ki long ki briew jong ka Sheba , bad ka Dedan .
translation.en: And the sons of Cush  ; Seba , and Havilah , and Sabtah , and Raamah , and Sabtecha : and the sons of Raamah  ; Sheba , and Dedan .

translation.kha: Ka shang ka la don ka jingtap ba la shna da ka siar . Katba nga dang khmih , la lup ïa ka jingtap , bad hangta hapoh ka sheng la shong ka kyntur !
translation.en: And , behold , there was lifted up a talent of lead : and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah .

Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren , that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God , to make reconciliation for the sins of the people .
translation.kha: Kane ka mut , ba u dei ban long uba syriem kum ki para jong u ha kiei kiei baroh , ba un ïoh long u rangbah lyngdoh uba lah ban shaniah bad uba sngewsynei ha ka jingshakri ïa U Blei , kumta ba yn ïohmap noh ïa ki pop ki briew .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .
U shim kaei kob u kwah , bad ym don ba lah ban khang ïa u . Ym ni uba nud ban kylli ïa u , Me har aïu ?
translation.en: Behold , he taketh away , who can hinder him ? who will say unto him , What doest thou ?

translation.kha: U Trai u nguh , Hato phim ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia ha phi ? Ha shuwa ba phin sawdong ban thet pat ïa ka Templ ,
translation.en: And now , I pray you , consider from this day and upward , from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Nalorkata , une um dat u Dabid , uta uba ki kynthei ki ïaphawar katba ki dang ïashad , ‘ U Shaul u la pynïap da ki khashor , hynrei u Dabid u la pynïap da ki phew hajar ?’
translation.en: Is not this David , of whom they sang one to another in dances , saying , Saul slew his thousands , and David his ten thousands ?

translation.kha: Bad U Trai’ u phah ïa u Gideon , u Barak , u Jephthah , bad khatduh ïa nga . Uwei pa uwei na ngi , ngi la pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phoi , bad phi la ïoh shongkhet shongshngain .
translation.en: And the  Lord  sent Jerubbaal , and Bedan , and Jephthah , and Samuel , and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side , and ye dwelled safe .

Men shall buy fields for money , and subscribe evidences , and seal them , and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin , and in the places about Jerusalem , and in the cities of Judah , and in the cities of the mountains , and in the cities of the valley , and in the cities of the south : for I will cause their captivity to return , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin thied ïa ki , bad ïa ki dulir thied jaka yn soi , shon muhor bad yn sakhi . Kane kan jia ha ka ri Benjamin , ha ki shnong sawdong ka Jerusalem , ha ki shnong ka Judah , bad ha ki shnong ka ri lum , ha ki kjat lum , bad ha ka Judah bashaphang shathie . Ngan pynïoh pat ha ki briew ïa ka ri jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

Ha uwei pa uei na ki la ai ïa ka jaiñspong balieh , bad la noh ïa ki ba kin shongthait sa shipor , tad ynda la thep kheiñduh lur ïa ki sa shakri pynlang parabangeit Kiba la shah pynpyut , kumba la leh ïa ki .
translation.en: And white robes were given unto every one of them  ; and it was said unto them , that they should rest yet for a little season , until their fellowservants also and their brethren , that should be killed as they were , should be fulfilled .

translation.kha: Nangta u angel babha lai u la put ïa la ka turoi . U khlur uba hajuh , ibha meh kum ka dumok , u la hap na shat bneng bad u la hap Halor ka shi pyntwa na ka lai bna jong ki Wah mala halor ki shok um .
translation.en: And the third angel sounded , and there fell a great star from heaven , burning as it were a lamp , and it fell upon the third part of the rivers , and upon the fountains of waters  ;

translation.kha: Bad Kumta ba yn ym don ka jingïapait ïapra ha sakma ka met , hynrei baroh ki dkhot met kiba ïapher kin ïahap iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: That there should be no schism in the body ; but that the members should have the same care one for another .
Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , and upon the inhabitants thereof , even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read :
translation.kha: Ngan sa pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jong ka baroh , kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab ba u syiem u la pule .
Kaei kaba Thoh ha ka Shithi ?
translation.en: What is written in the letter ?
And unto this people thou shalt say , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I set before you the way of life , and the way of death .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha nga ban ong ha u paidbah ,  To shahshkor ! Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ai ha phi ka jingjied hapdeng ka lynti ka ban lam sha ka jingim bad ka lynti ka ban lam sha ka jingïap .

da kabu ai ha ngi ïa barieh ki jingpynshitom kiba la batai ha ka Aiñ jong u Moserah . Hynrei kam mynta , A Trai U Blei jong ngi , ngim shym la pyrshang pun pynsngewbha ïa me da kaba phai noh na ki pop jong ngi lane da kaba bud ïa ka jingshisha jong me .
translation.en: As it is written in the law of Moses , all this evil is come upon us : yet made we not our prayer before the  Lord  our God , that we might turn from our iniquities , and understand thy truth .

translation.kha: Hangne ha Susa la don u Jia uba kyrteng u Mordekai , u khun jong u Joram ; uba na ka jait Bethmeon bad u longsem uba hiarpateng na u Kish bad u Shimei .
translation.en: Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew , whose name was Mordecai , the son of Jair , the son of Shimei , the son of Kish , a Benjamite  ;

translation.kha: Ho-oid , ngan lumlang ïa ki ha Jerusha , bthuh ïa ka ding hapoh jong ki , malu pynum ïa ki da ka jingbitar jongnga nga .
translation.en: Yea , I will gather you , and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath , and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof .
But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles , and made their minds evil affected against the brethren .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Jiw ki bym shym la ngeit ki la pynkhih ïa ki Jentil bad ki la pynlong ïa ki ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa riewngeit .
Te ïa ka burom jong U Trai yn sa pynïap , bad baroh’ ki briew kin ïohi ïa ka . U Terah da lade u la kular ïa Kanah .
translation.en: And the glory of the  Lord  shall be revealed , and all flesh shall see it together : for the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken it .

translation.kha: Te U Trai , U blem ki Jerusalem’ , u la ong ha la ban ong ha ki paidbah : Nga la pynlong ka jutang bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi mynhynnin nga la pyllait ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt bad pynïatylli ïa ki na ka jinglongmraw .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondmen , saying ,
But Christ as a son over his own house  ; whose house are we , if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end .
translation.kha: Hynrei , U Khrist u long uba lah ban shaniah kum U Khun uba dei peit ïa ka ïing U Blei . Ngi long ka ïing jong u lada ngi ïaineh ha ka jingshlur bad ngi long skhem ha kaei kaba ngi kyrmen .

Bad ki symbai kiba la put ha ka khyndew katba ba ki ïeng na ka byndi re kiba sngewkyiuh ïa ka kherub bad shemphang ïa ka : ki pynmih soh , katto katne shispah tylli , kiwei pait hynriewphew tylli , malade kiwei pat laiphew tylli .
translation.en: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word , and understandeth it  ; which also beareth fruit , and bringeth forth , some an hundredfold , some sixty , some thirty .
And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon  ; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father : for Hiram was ever a lover of David .
translation.kha: U Hiram , u syiem Tyros u la ju long u paralok jong u Dabid , bad haba u la ïohsngew ba u Solomon u la long syiem hadien jong u Dabid , u kpa jong u , u la phah ki nongkit  tiensyiem sha u .
Ka long kaba ma ban sngewkhia ïa kaei kaba kiwei ki pyrkhat shaphang jong phi , hynrei lada phi! shaniah ha U Trai , phi long shngain .
translation.en: The fear of man bringeth a snare : but whoso putteth his trust in the  Lord  shall be safe .

translation.kha: Ka jubab , Ñiuma , ngan leit ryngkat bad phi , hynrei phin ym oh burom ei ei ïa ka jingjop , nongmareh U Trai un aiti ïa u Sisera ha ka kynthei . Kumta ka Deborah ka sien bad u Barukh sha Kedesh .
translation.en: And she said , I will surely go with thee : notwithstanding the journey that thou takest shall not be for thine honour  ; for the  Lord  shall sell Sisera into the hand of a woman . And Deborah arose , and went with Barak to Kedesh .

translation.kha: U syiem u la phah sa iwei pat u rangbah pynïaidkam lem bun sanphew ngut ki rangbah , kiba la leit khiew bad ong ha u Elijah , Ko briew jong U Blei , u syiem u hukum ïa phi ïa-ban wan Hirah shadien !
translation.en: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty . And he answered and said unto him , O man of God , thus hath the king said , Come down quickly .
The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him  ; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him .
translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ba u paidbah u ïa-pasiaw ïa kine kiei kiei shaphang U Jisu , kumta ma ki bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la phah katto katne ngut ki nongap phira ban kem ïa u .
U ïa-ban pynkylla ïa ki met batlot jongki ngi bad pynlong ïa ki kum ka met! ba-dap da ka Burom jongnga u hi , da kata ka bor da kaba u lah ban wallam ïa kiei kiei borbah hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u .
translation.en: Who shall change our vile body , that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body , according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself .
Oh that my words were now written ! oh that they were printed in a book !
translation.kha: Katno nga da kwah ban don ki ban kynmaw ïa ki ktien jong nga bad ban buh jingthoh ïa ki ha ka kitab !

U Trai U Blei’ jong pha u long bad phan ; ka bor jong u ka ai ha phar ka jingjop . U Trai un shem jingsngewbha ha pha , bad ha ka jingieit jong u un ai ha pha ka jingtem bathymmai . Un rwai bad un khem halor jong pha ,
translation.en: The  Lord  thy God in the midst of thee is mighty  ; he will save , he will rejoice over thee with joy  ; he will rest in his love , he will joy over thee with singing .
Then the king commanded to call the magicians , and the astrologers , and the sorcerers , and the Chaldeans , for to shew the king his dreams . So they came and stood before the king .
translation.kha: kumta u la phah khot ïa ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor , ki nongkheiñ ksuid bad ki nongleh byrtong ban ïawan bad batai ïa ka jingphohsniew ha u . Haba ki la ïawan bad ïeng ha khmat u syiem ,
Bad kumta une u briew uba tlot , u parabangeit ïa uba U Khereth u la ïap , un jot noh namar kata ka jingtip jong phi !
translation.en: And through thy knowledge shall the weak brother perish , for whom Christ died ?
Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition , which ye have delivered : and many such like things do ye .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom ka jinghikai ba phi ai pateng sha kiwei pat ka pynduh noh ïa ka ktien jong U Blei . Bad don bun kiwei kiei kiei kum kane kaba phi leh .
Nga la sheptieng , kumta nga la kitei bad bahkhlieh ïa ka peiñ jongnga me ha ka khyndew . Ha khmih ! Kane hangne ka long ka dei ka jong me .’
