translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong na kim shym pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi uba kynjai kuna ba ki la ïoh khrup ; pynban , ki la wallam ïa ki hangne ha Gilgal ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ha U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: But the people took of the spoil , sheep and oxen , the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed , to sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God in Gilgal .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïakynting sbai ban ïatip ïa ka mian U blei , hynrei U Blei da lade hi u ai ïa ka jyllop .
translation.en: The lot is cast into the lap  ; but the whole disposing thereof is of the  Lord .
Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbour .
translation.kha: Wat sakhi lamler ïano ïano .
Phim lah ban dih na ka khuri U Trai bad ruh na ka khuri ki “ksuid” ; phim lah ban ïabam na ka miej U Trai mala ruh na ka mei ki ksaiñ .
translation.en: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord , and the cup of devils : ye cannot be partakers of the Lord s table , and of the table of devils .
And when he hath found it , he layeth it on his shoulders , rejoicing .
translation.kha: Haba u la shem ïa ka , u kmen haduh katta katta ba u buh ïa ka halor ki tyrpeng jong u bad bah pat ïa ka sha ïing .
Phim dei u briew uba nga mut ba phi dei .
translation.en: You're just not the person I thought you were .

translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad Kane kano ka mrad , ma u mala kata ka mrad ki dei ban shah pynïap .
translation.en: And if a man lie with a beast , he shall surely be put to death : and ye shall slay the beast .
And when the tempter came to him , he said , If thou be the Son of God , command that these stones be made bread .
translation.kha: Te u Soitan u la wan ha U bad u la ong ,  Lada me long U Khun U Blei , hukum ïa kine ki maw ban kylla kpu .

translation.en: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs .
translation.kha: bad U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Ashkenas ban pyrkhat sngewlem ïa u Daniel .
Nangta u Sedekaïah nongïathuhlypa u leit sha u Mikaïah , u tar ïa u bad kyrhai , Naduh mynno u mynsiem U Trai u la mih na nga bad kren ha phi ?
translation.en: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near , and smote Micaiah upon the cheek , and said , Which way went the Spirit of the  Lord  from me to speak unto thee ?

translation.kha: ho-oid , kyrpad ban ïoh ïa ka jingtip , bun kyrpad jur ban ïew ïa ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: Yea , if thou criest after knowledge , and liftest up thy voice for understanding  ;

translation.kha: “Wat lapbah ki paid Israel ki roi kum ki ñiut , ngan phah ïa ka lyer khluit na mihngi katba na ri shyiap , bad kan pyntyrkhong ïa ki umpohliew bad ki pung-um jong ki . Kan rnong noh ïa Kanaan kano kaba kordor .
translation.en: Though he be fruitful among his brethren , an east wind shall come , the wind of the  Lord  shall come up from the wilderness , and his spring shall become dry , and his fountain shall be dried up : he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels .
And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul , and never eateth with pleasure .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat kim don jingkmen satia ; ki im bad ki ïap ryngkat bad ka jingkthang ha ki dohnud .
Namar said , kohnguh ïa kaei kaba la lah hikai ïa phi , sumar ban leh ïa ki hukum bad ki ai baroh ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
translation.en: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments , and the statutes , and the judgments , which I command thee this day , to do them .

translation.kha: Bad u la ïai kren ha ki baroh , To khmih bhah bad sumar ïa lai na Kanah kano ka jait jinglalot ; namar ba ïa ka jingim bashisha jong u briew ym shym la pynlong da kiei kiei kiba u anna , kam phler haduh Katto u ha ïa-ban long uba riewspah .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Take heed , and beware of covetousness : for a man s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth .

translation.kha: Kumta mynta , kitab u shem Kiba bad u phlang tyrkhong ki ran bad ing ha ka ding , ki thied lad phira kin pyut bad ki synreit jong phi kin tyrpeng bad shah rong noh ha ka lyer , nabar ba phi la kyntait ïa kaei kaba U Trai Benabinadab Baroh , U Blang bakhuid ka Israel u la hikai ïa ngi .
translation.en: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble , and the flame consumeth the chaff , so their root shall be as rottenness , and their blossom shall go up as dust : because they have cast away the law of the  Lord  of hosts , and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel .
Yea , my reins shall rejoice , when thy lips speak right things .
translation.kha: Ngan sngewsarong haba ngan ïohsngew ba phi kren ïa ki ktien ka jingstad .

translation.en: Let the heavens rejoice , and let the earth be glad  ; let the sea roar , and the fulness thereof .
translation.kha: To lehkmen , ko ka khyndew bad ka sahit bneng ! To kyrhuh , ko ka duriaw bad baroh ki jingthaw ba don ha pha ;

Lada phim sumar ïa ka jutang kaba U Trai U blang jongu phi u la hukum ïa phi ban sumar bad lada phi shakri bad mane ïa kyiuh patiaw ki blei , katkum te ha ka jingtur jong u , un pynshitom ïa phi , bad shen ym don uei ruh na phi u ban lait im ha kane ka ri babniah kaba u la ai ha phi .
translation.en: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the  Lord  your God , which he commanded you , and have gone and served other gods , and bowed yourselves to them  ; then shall the anger of the  Lord  be kindled against you , and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you .

translation.kha: Pynjot ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew kat ïa kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u aiti ha phi , bad woh sngewsynei ïa ki . Wat mane ïa ki blei jongngi ki , namar kata ka long ka jingma ïa me .
translation.en: And thou shalt consume all the people which the  Lord  thy God shall deliver thee  ; thine eye shall have no pity upon them : neither shalt thou serve their gods  ; for that will be a snare unto thee .

translation.kha: pynlang u la ïap noh ha ka ter kaba khyndaispah sanphew snem .
translation.en: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years : and he died .

translation.kha: Ïa ki jaiñ jong U Ïoannis la shna da u shñiuh jong ka ut ; u la panpoh da u pynhapoh sneng ha ka jingkam jong u , bad ka jingbam jong u ka la longïng da ki puit bad ka ngat khlaw .
translation.en: And the same John had his raiment of camel s hair , and a leathern girdle about his loins  ; and his meat was locusts and wild honey .
And the  Lord  hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt , and he pursued after the children of Israel : and the children of Israel went out with an high hand .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad une u la beh kthong ïa ki Israel , kiba la mihnoh da ka jingjop .

translation.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong : yea , he reproved kings for their sakes  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei um shym la shah ïano ïano ban lehbeiñ ïa ki ; ban ïada ïa ki , u maham ïa ki syiem :
U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Ong ïa u Aaron ban shoh ïa ka khyndew da u diengduh , ba u pui pui ha ka ri Ijipt baroh’ kamai un kylla niam .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Stretch out thy rod , and smite the dust of the land , that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U Joab , u khwan jong ka Seruïah , bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong u Dabid ki la ïakynduh ïa ki ha ka pung , ha kaba barabor ki la ïashong , kawei ka kynhun ha kawei ka liang jong ka pung Bad kawei paw ka kynhun ha kawei ka liang .
translation.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah , and the servants of David , went out , and met together by the pool of Gibeon : and they sat down , the one on the one side of the pool , and the other on the other side of the pool .

translation.kha: Kumta , katto kum ka hukum U Trai , ki paid Jerusalem ki ai ha ki Lebi katto katne tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang na ki bakwah jong ki .
translation.en: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance , at the commandment of the  Lord  , these cities and their suburbs .

translation.kha: un shimti ïa u khiew thang jingiwbih ba la pyndap da u rnga ding barhem na ka duwan bad ar khah ka jingbuaid , bad un wanrah ïa ki shaei ka Katta Kaba Khuid Tam .
translation.en: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the  Lord  , and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small , and bring it within the veil :

translation.kha: lad map ïa ki bad men weng nep sharud ïa ki ; man ñiad noh ïa ki jingbakla baroh ba la la leh .
translation.en: My transgression is sealed up in a bag , and thou sewest up mine iniquity .
And all the prophets prophesied so , saying , Go up to Ramoth–gilead , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the hand of the king .
translation.kha: Baroh kiwei pat ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ïa kajuh .  Tur pyrshah ïa ka Ramoth bad phin sa jop ,  ki ong ,  U  Trai  un ai ïa phi ka jingjop .

Ha khmat ki paralok jong u bad ki shiphew Samaria u ong , Kaei , kine ki Jiw shem-lanot , ki tharai ba ki leh ? Hato ki pyrkhat ba da ka jingjia jingainguh ki lah ban pyndep ïa ka kam ha ka shi sngew ? Hammoth ki lah ban pynlong ïa ki maw jingtei na ki kynton jong ki synrum ba la ing ?
translation.en: And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria , and said , What do these feeble Jews ? will they fortify themselves ? will they sacrifice ? will they make an end in a day ? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned ?

translation.kha: Uno uno uba khleh ïa kaba kumno kane , ne uba pyndonkam ïa ka wat tyngka khyndiat ruh ha uno uno u briew u bym dih u lyngdoh , yn ym kheiñ shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong per !’
translation.en: Whosoever compoundeth any like it , or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger , shall even be cut off from his people .

translation.kha: U rangbah synshar ki Asaraïah u ïathuh ha ki ba u Patsha u kwah tip kiei kaba pynlong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ban sngewskhem .
translation.en: And Rabshakeh said unto them , Say ye now to Hezekiah , Thus saith the great king , the king of Assyria , What confidence is this wherein thou trustest ?

translation.kha: Ha ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad nga ai ïa dat ka ri kaba haduh Gilead haduh ka haw Arnon . U pud uba shaphang shathie u long napdeng jong kata ka wah , badno u pud uba Shaphan shai pat u longsem ka wah Jakob ; kaba shi bynta na kata ka pynlong duh ïa u phuh ki Ammon .
translation.en: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley , and the border even unto the river Jabbok , which is the border of the children of Ammon  ;

translation.kha: Ha khim ! u la nong . Nga ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie badno ïa U Te U Beeri ba u ïeng ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei !
translation.en: And said , Behold , I see the heavens opened , and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God .

translation.kha: Shisha kumba u symbai u khie lung bad u san , U Trai Nongsynshar un ïadoh ïa ki briew jong u , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin ïaroh ïa u .
translation.en: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud , and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth  ; so the Lord  God  will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations .

translation.kha: Kata ka long haba ka jingshai jong ka sngi , u bna , sad ki khulom kan sawdong lip ïa phi , bad ki lyoh klop kin ym leit noh da lei lei .
translation.en: While the sun , or the light , or the moon , or the stars , be not darkened , nor the clouds return after the rain :

translation.kha: hynrei lada ka wei na U Blei , phim lah ban iap ïa ki . Phi lah ban shem ïa lade kiba ïaleh marpyrshah ïa U balui ! Ka Dorbar ka la kohnguh ïa ka jingai jingmut Jong u Gamaliel .
translation.en: But if it be of God , ye cannot overthrow it  ; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God .

translation.kha: Uno uno u briew um dei ban pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa da kaba u ïaishah shongkha bad kawei na ki tnga u kper jong u .
translation.en: A man shall not take his father s wife , nor discover his father s skirt .

translation.kha: Bad pynpang , nga long U Blei ibha map ïa ki pop jong phi , bad nga leh ïa kane nalor uei ba per long . Ngin ym bat ïa ki pop jongki phi pyrshah ïa phi .
translation.en: I , even I , am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake , and will not remember thy sins .

translation.kha: Pynban , u Jiw bashisha u dei u briew uba dei u Jiw ha kaba shapoh , Katai , uba ïa ka dohnud jong u la otsher , bad kane ka dei ka jingtrei jong U Mynsiem jong U Blei , ym jong ka Hukum ba la thoh . Kum uta u briew u Ïohi ïa la ka jingïar na U Blei , ym na u briew .
translation.en: But he is a Jew , which is one inwardly ; and circumcision is that of the heart , in the spirit , and not in the letter ; whose praise is not of men , but of God .

translation.kha: bad beit beit sha Gilead bad shuh Hadad ha ka ri ki Hit . Nangta ki leit sha dien , Bad na Dan ki leit shaphang sepngi shai Sidon .
translation.en: Then they came to Gilead , and to the land of Tahtim–hodshi  ; and they came to Dan–jaan , and about to Zidon ,
Take that thine is , and go thy way : I will give unto this last , even as unto thee .
translation.kha: Mynta to shim ïa ka bainong jong phi bad khie leit sha ïing . Nga kwah ban ai ha une u briew uba la shah khot khatduh katjuh kumba nga la ai ha phi .

Kane ka dei kaei kaba u ong shemphang ki kynhun shipai u Neko , u syiem ka Ijipt , ïa uba u Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia u la jop ha Karkhemish Hajan ka wah Ïuphratis ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Jehoïakim u long u syiem ka Judah :
translation.en: Against Egypt , against the army of Pharaoh–neco king of Egypt , which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish , which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah .

And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother , And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah ? ask for him the kingdom also  ; for he is mine elder brother  ; even for him , and for Abiathar the priest , and for Joab the son of Zeruiah .
translation.kha: Balei ba phi pan na nga ban ai ïa ka Abishag ha u ?  u syiem u kylli .  Phi lah ban sa pan ruh na nga ban ai ha u ïa ka khet ruh . Nalor kata , u dei u hynmen ba kham heh jong nga , bad ba u Abiathar u lyngdoh bad u Joab ki don ha ka liang jong u !

translation.en: And when Jacob saw them , he said , This is God s host : and he called the name of that place Mahanaim .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa ki , u ong ,  Kane ka dei ka jaka sher dara jong U Blei  ; kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Mahanaim .

translation.en: Then Daniel went in , and desired of the king that he would give him time , and that he would shew the king the interpretation .
translation.kha: U Daniel shisyndon u la leit bad u la ïoh por da ka jingai jingbit jong u syiem , khnang ba u lah ban ïathuh ïa u syiem aïu ka jingphohsniew ka kit jingmut .

Kumta u Ahab u jubab ha ki nongsyntiat jong u Benhadad , Ïathuh ha u shym u kynrad jong nga , ba por mynleh ïa ka jingdawa kaba nyngkong jong u , hynrei mem lah ban mynsiem ïa kambah ar . Ki nongpynïaid ki longing noh bad nangto ki wan biang da kawei pat ka khubor na u Benhadad ;
translation.en: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben–hadad , Tell my lord the king , All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do : but this thing I may not do . And the messengers departed , and brought him word again .

translation.kha: kiaw pait ki jait Jesreel ki ïalumlang saw lakh ngut ki shipai katba tbit babha .
translation.en: And the men of Israel , beside Benjamin , were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword : all these were men of war .

translation.kha: Ngam shym la woh Ban khot ïa ki riewdonburom ban kylla-kaba-mut , hynne ïa kiba la shah kyntait .
translation.en: I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .

translation.kha: U Gaal u la phew ïap bad u Abimael u la beh kyrtong ïa u . Bun ngut ki la mynsaw , wat ïathuh khyrdop shnong .
translation.en: And Abimelech chased him , and he fled before him , and many were overthrown and wounded , even unto the entering of the gate .

translation.kha: U syiem bad ki pynbah synshar jong u ki la pdiang ïa kane ka jingai jingmut , bun u ong ha ki ,
translation.en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of all his servants .

translation.kha: Leh ïa kaei kaba U Trai u ong ba ka long kaba dei bad kaba bha , te phin manbha . Phin sa ïohlait ïa kata ka ri kaba seisoh ïa kaba U Trai u la kutlad ha ki kpa tmain jrong phi ,
translation.en: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the  Lord  : that it may be well with thee , and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers ,

translation.kha: Khie leit sha kli u Lum pynshah , malu peitmat barhem sawdong , shatei , shathie , sha mihngi , dara sha synñiang . Peit bha ïa kaei kaba me ïohi , namar shano lane ruh men ym ïoh leit sha shiliang ka Jordan .
translation.en: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah , and lift up thine eyes westward , and northward , and southward , and eastward , and behold it with thine eyes : for thou shalt not go over this Jordan .

translation.kha: Ngan pyllait ïa me na ki paid Israel bad na ki Jeiel Sha kiba ngan phah ïa me .
translation.en: Delivering thee from the people , and from the Gentiles , unto whom now I send thee ,
And his name shall be called in Israel , The house of him that hath his shoe loosed .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ïing jong u yn tip ha Israel kum ‘ Ka ïing jong uta u briew uba la shah loit juti .’
U la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka pukri Ka Jingsmai . Dei kumta ba ka shnong Beersheba ka la ïoh ïa la ka kyrteng .
translation.en: And he called it Shebah : therefore the name of the city is Beer–sheba unto this day .
Simon Peter , a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ , to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Na u Simon Petros , u shakri bad u Apostol jong U Jisu Khrist — Sha kito ha kiba da ka hok jong U Blei jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim la ai ïa ka jingngeit kaba kordor kum ka jong ngi :

translation.en: I will go and return to my place , till they acknowledge their offence , and seek my face : in their affliction they will seek me early .
translation.kha: Ngan lyndet noh ïa ki briew jong nga haduh ba kin shahshitom ha ban da biang na ka bynta ki pop jong ki bad wan ban wad ïa nga . Lehse ha ki jingshah shitom jong ki , kin pyrshang ban wad ïa nga .
Uno ine uba ngeit ha U Khun un ym shah bishar ; hynrei ïa uno uno u bymngeit la lah bishar lypa ïa u , ñiar ba um shym la ngeit ha U Khun ba tang marwei jong U Blei .
translation.en: He that believeth on him is not condemned : but he that believeth not is condemned already , because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God .

translation.kha: To pynshlur ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem . To ïathuh ha ki ba ki la jynjar slem bha bad ïa ki thup jong ki la map mynsiem . Nga la pynshitom ïa ki la biang bol na ka bynta ki pop jongnga ki baroh’ .
translation.en: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem , and cry unto her , that her warfare is accomplished , that her iniquity is pardoned : for she hath received of the  Lord s  hand double for all her sins .
Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar , or no ?
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi , hato ka long pyrshah ïa ka Aiñ jong ngi ba ngi dei ban siew khajna sha u Patsha ka Hima Rom , ne kumno ?

translation.en: For so was it charged me by the word of the  Lord  , saying , Eat no bread , nor drink water , nor turn again by the same way that thou camest .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban ym bam lane dih ei ei , bad ban ym leit phai na kajuh ka lynti kaba nga la wan .
Ka lute ka jubab , Ngan leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi ong .
translation.en: And she said unto her , All that thou sayest unto me I will do .
A bell and a pomegranate , a bell and a pomegranate , round about the hem of the robe to minister in  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Ki buh ïa ki shakuriaw ksiar hapdeng jong kita ki dur soh baroh sawdong , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: And when they heard that , they lifted up their voice to God with one accord , and said , Lord , thou art God , which hast made heaven , and earth , and the sea , and all that in them is :
translation.kha: Haba ki riewngeit ki la ïohsngew ïa kata , baroh ki la ïasoh lang ha ka jingduwai sha U Blei :  Ko Kynrad bad ko Nongthaw ïa ka bneng , ka pyrthei , bad ka duriaw , bad ïa baroh kaba don ha ki !

translation.en: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the  Lord  , and do all his commandments which I command thee this day .
translation.kha: bad phin kohnguh biang ïa u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
Hynrei lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew kam kohnguh , te ngan rat lut khoit bad pyndait ïa ka . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: But if they will not obey , I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U jingïathuhlypa u tar ïa ka jaiñ na ka khmat jong u , bad kumta hi u Syiem u ithuh ïa u bad u long uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And he hasted , and took the ashes away from his face  ; and the king of Israel discerned him that he was of the prophets .

translation.kha: Lai shen shisnem , ki shynrang jong phi baroh ki dei ban wanpaw ha khmih U Trai U Blei lad phi ha kata ka jaka mane blang : ha ka Niam Ka Jinglait , ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot , bad ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep . Kim den ban wan thylli ha khmat U Trai ;
translation.en: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the  Lord  thy God in the place which he shall choose  ; in the feast of unleavened bread , and in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of tabernacles : and they shall not appear before the  Lord  empty :
Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter : Fear God , and keep his commandments : for this is the whole duty of man .
translation.kha: Hadien kane baroh , don tang kawei ban ong : To tiengburom ïa U Blei , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , namar dei ïa kane keiñ ba la thaw ïa u briew .

translation.en: ( Genesis 1 :31 ) If they had obeyed God , they would have produced perfect children , and the earth would have become a global paradise , where people would live forever in peace and happiness .
translation.kha: ( Jenesis 1 :31 ) Lada kila kohnguh ia U Blei , kin jin da la kha ia ki khun ki bajanai , bad ka pyrthei baroh kan jin da la long ka paradais , ha kaba ki briew kin ioh im haka jingkmen bad jingsuk junom .

Nga khot ïa ka ïeng bad ïa ka khyndew ban sakhi pyrshah ïa phi ba , lada tv kohnguh ïa nga , phin sa jah noh shem na kata ka ri ; phi ym im Slem ha kata ka ri shaw shiliang ka Jordan ïa kaba phin sa seiñïong . Yn sa pynjot taiew ïa phi .
translation.en: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day , that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it  ; ye shall not prolong your days upon it , but shall utterly be destroyed .
Then saith Pilate unto him , Speakest thou not unto me ? knowest thou not that I have power to crucify thee , and have power to release thee ?
translation.kha: U Pilat u la ong ha u ,  Mem kren ei ei ha nga ? To kynmaw , nga don ka bor ban pyllait ïa me bad ruh ban phah sahnarphna ïa me .

Kine ki shithi ki batai ba u syiem u shah ïa ki Jiw ha kaei pa kawei ka nongbet ban ïalumlang la ma ki ban ïada ïa lade . Lada ki rangbah ba la kieng Ataroth jrong kano kano ka jaitbynriew ha kano kano ka jingbhasbun ki tad ïateh ïa ki rangbah Jiw , ïa ki khun jong ki ne ïa ki kynthei jong ki , ki Siew ki lah ban ïakhleh pyrshah bad pynngat ïa kiba wan ïabeh pyrshah ; ki lah ban pynïap ïa baroh na ki bad shim ïa ki jingdon jingem jngai ki .
translation.en: Wherein the king granted the Jews which were in every city to gather themselves together , and to stand for their life , to destroy , to slay , and to cause to perish , all the power of the people and province that would assault them , both little ones and women , and to take the spoil of them for a prey ,

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingthaw bakylluid ka ïathmu ba ka pyrthei hi baroh kawei ka don hapoh ka bor jong ka pop ; bad kumta ïa ka jingai ïa kaba la kular halor ka nongrim jong ka jingngeit ha U Jisu khriat la ai ïa kito kiba ngeit .
translation.en: But the scripture hath concluded all under sin , that the promise by faith of Jesus Christ might be given to them that believe .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la Mihnoh na ka nongbah bad u la leit , kumba u la ju leh , sha u lum ki Olib ; bad ki synran ki la leit slem bad u .
translation.en: And he came out , and went , as he was wont , to the mount of Olives  ; and his disciples also followed him .

translation.kha: U Moses u Jobab , Lada kumjuh , phin ïahap pynbiang ïa ine da ki mrad na ka beit ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh thang ban ai ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi .
translation.en: And Moses said , Thou must give us also sacrifices and burnt offerings , that we may sacrifice unto the  Lord  our God .
It is for the prince  ; the prince , he shall sit in it to eat bread before the  Lord   ; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate , and shall go out by the way of the same .
translation.kha: Hynrei u khun syiem uba synshar , u lah ban rung hangta ban bam ïa ka jingbam bakhuid ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga . Un rung bad mih ïa ka khyrdop lyngba ka kamra ban rung ban mih ha ka bynta kaba kham shapoh .

Kajuh kaei kaei kan jliah ïa ka Baibl kumba ka la jia ïa ka Edom bad Gomorrah , ibha at la pynjot ïa ki bad ïa ki shaneng kiba marjan . Yn ym don ba sheng shuh hangta . Ma nga , U Trai , por la kren .
translation.en: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof , saith the  Lord   ; so shall no man abide there , neither shall any son of man dwell therein .

translation.kha: wat ai phlangïap shuh ïa kine ki briew ba-bang shna maw-it . Ieh ngin sien ïawad phlangïap hi da lade” .
translation.en: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick , as heretofore : let them go and gather straw for themselves .

translation.kha: U jongu u la ong ha u , Mynno ka jingpyntieng ka la wan ha kane ka ïing , naba une u briew , ruh , u den wahbah hiarpateng jongno u Ahab .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  This day is salvation come to this house , forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong , Hato ym don khat-ar kynta ha ka shi sngi ? Kumjuh uno uno uba ïaid haba dang shai ka sngi un ym jynthut , babha u ïohi ïa ka jingshaïong jong kano ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Are there not twelve hours in the day ? If any man walk in the day , he stumbleth not , because he seeth the light of this world .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Maroth ki ap da ka lyng-a ïa ka jingïalap , namar ba U Trai u la wallam ïa ka jingjot sha jan ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good : but evil came down from the  Lord  unto the gate of Jerusalem .
They kept also the feast of tabernacles , as it is written , and offered the daily burnt offerings by number , according to the custom , as the duty of every day required  ;
translation.kha: Ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ; ha kawei pa kawei ka sngi ki ai ki jingkñia kiba donkam ha kata ka sngi ;
Pynban , ph la wan sha u lum Seïon bad sha ka nongpang jong U Balei uba im , ka Jerusalem kaban kynja banyngkong , ha Kaba la don bun hajar ki duh .
translation.en: But ye are come unto mount Sion , and unto the city of the living God , the heavenly Jerusalem , and to an innumerable company of angels ,
Don't look at me .
translation.kha: Wat peit ianga .

translation.en: He was not that Light , but was sent to bear witness of that Light .
translation.kha: U hi da lade um dei ka jingshai ; u la wan ban ïathuh shaphang ka jingshai .

translation.en: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke , I will add to your yoke : my father hath chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki , ‘ I pa jong nga i la buh ha phi ïa ka jingkit kaba khia ; nga ngan kham pynkhia shuh shuh ïa kita , i pa i la shoh ïa phi da u riphin ; nga ngan sympat ïa phi da u shabuk !’
mynhynne bad mynmiet ki la ap ha ki khyrdop shnong khnang ban pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: But their laying await was known of Saul . And they watched the gates day and night to kill him .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Nga la khleiñ ba-bang Jubab ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong nga , hynrei kim syiem la ïamudui . Nga la ap ïa ki ban shem ïa nga , hynrei kim shym la pyrshang . Ka jingïambriew kam shym la khot kyrpad ïa nga , wat lada nga longïing la kloi ban jubab , ‘ Hangne la don ; ngan ïarap ïa phi .’
translation.en: I am sought of them that asked not for me  ; I am found of them that sought me not : I said , Behold me , behold me , unto a nation that was not called by my name .
Arise , shine  ; for thy light is come , and the glory of the  Lord  is risen upon thee .
translation.kha: To khie joit , ko Jerusalem bad tyngshaiñ kum ka sngi ; ka burom ka jong U  Trai  ka tyngshaiñ ha phi !

Ha ka sngap kaba san jong u bniah uba saw jong ka sniew naba laiphew , ma nga , u Esekiel u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Busi , nga dang ïashong ïasan ryngkat bad ki Jiw ba la shuh ringmraw harud ka wah Khebar ha Babilonia . Ka bneng ka la plie phang , bad nga la ïohi ïa U Blei ha ka jingpynkhiah .
translation.en: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year , in the fourth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar , that the heavens were opened , and I saw visions of God .
And it be told thee , and thou hast heard of it , and enquired diligently , and , behold , it be true , and the thing certain , that such abomination is wrought in Israel :
translation.kha: phi dei ban tohkit bniah ïa kata .

translation.en: Now it came to pass on the third day , that Esther put on her royal apparel , and stood in the inner court of the king s house , over against the king s house : and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house , over against the gate of the house .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai jong ka jingshah jingit , ka Esther ka phong ïa ki jingriam syiem jong ka bad ka leit bad ïeng ha ka phyllaw ba kham shapoh ka ïingsyiem , kaba phai khmat sha ka kamra ba don ka khet syiem . U syiem u don hapoh , u shong halor ka khet syiem , da kaba phai khmat sha ka khyrdop .

Haba kin pynshitom beiñ ïa phi ha kawei ka shnong , to phret sha kawei pat . Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba phna ym pat lah ban pyndep ïa ka kam jrong phi ha barben ki shnong jong ka Israel ha shuwa ba U Toi U Briew un wanrah .
translation.en: But when they persecute you in this city , flee ye into another : for verily I say unto you , Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel , till the Son of man be come .
And I will set my face against you , and ye shall be slain before your enemies : they that hate you shall reign over you  ; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you .
translation.kha: Ngan phai pyrshah ïa phi , te phin shahjop ha ki nongshun jong phi , bad kito kiba phi isih kin synshar halor jong phi ; phin sngewsheptieng haduh katta katta ba phin phet ïap haba ym don ba beh ïa phi .

translation.en: And when they had crucified him , they parted his garments , casting lots upon them , what every man should take .
translation.kha: Nangta , ki la sahnarphna ïa u bad ki la ïabynta ïa ki jaiñ jong u hapdeng jong ki , da kaba ïakynting sbai ban khmih mano ban ïoh ïa kano ka bynta jong ka jaiñ .
U Iso u la isih ïa u Jubab , namsop ba u kpa jong u , u la ai ha u Joab ïa ka jingkynnoh . U la pyrthat , Ka por ban ïamareh na ka bynta i pa jong la ka la jan ; te kumto ngan sa pynïap ïa u Jakob .
translation.en: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him : and Esau said in his heart , The days of mourning for my father are at hand  ; then will I slay my brother Jacob .

translation.kha: Mynba ka ïng ka ing , ka jingsngewma ka wan ha nga .
translation.en: When the house caught fire , an awful feeling came over me .

translation.kha: U Trai u khot biang ïa u Samuel . U khynnah um shym tip satia ba dei U Trai , namar U Trai um pat ju la kren nabar u mynshuwa . Kumta u khih joit bad u wait sha u Eli , bad u ainong , Pha khot ïa nga , bad nga hangne . Hynrei u Eli u jubab , Khun jong nga , ngam shym khot ïa phi ; khie leit thiah bajngum .
translation.en: Now Samuel did not yet know the  Lord  , neither was the word of the  Lord  yet revealed unto him .

translation.kha: Naba don shisien ki sier baïapher balei ba ki briew kim lah ban shongkurim : katto katne , namar ba la khia ïa ki kumta ; kiwei pat , namar ba ki briew ki pynlong ïa ki kumta ; Bad kiwei pat kim shongman na ka byndi ka Hima ki weng . Ai ba uta uba lah ban pdiang ïa ken ka jingkhie un leh kumta .
translation.en: For there are some eunuchs , which were so born from their mother s womb : and there are some eunuchs , which were made eunuchs of men : and there be eunuchs , which have made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven s sake . He that is able to receive it , let him receive it .

translation.kha: U kurup ruh ngon bah ka rnong na Tibhath bad Kush , ki nongbah ba synshar u Hadadeser . ( U Solomon hadien u pynbam ïa kane ka rnong ha kaba thaw ïa ka pynngam , ki rishot , bad ki khiew prong na ka pyntha ka Templ . )
translation.en: Likewise from Tibhath , and from Chun , cities of Hadarezer , brought David very much brass , wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea , and the pillars , and the vessels of brass .

translation.kha: Wat pyrshing , U Jisu u la ong ha ki . Khie lytar bad ïathuh ïa ki para jong nga ban saw shiah Galilaïa bad hangta keiñ ïohi ïa nga .
translation.en: Then said Jesus unto them ,  Be not afraid : go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee , and there shall they see me .
Yet hear the word of the  Lord  , O Zedekiah king of Judah  ; Thus saith the  Lord  of thee , Thou shalt not die by the sword :
translation.kha: Ko Sedekaïah , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong shaphang jong me . Men ym shah pynïap ha ka thma .
Ïa ki nongap phira jong ka Templ la pynïabynta ha ki kynhun kynhun kat kum ki erlangthari , bad la pynkhamti ïa ki kam ha ka Templ kumba long lem kiwei pat ki Lebi .
translation.en: Among these were the divisions of the porters , even among the chief men , having wards one against another , to minister in the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki kynhun shipa ka bneng ki la bud ïa u , ki da shong halor ki kulai balieh pynlang ki la riam da ki jaiñ lin banleh bad bakhuid .
translation.en: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses , clothed in fine linen , white and clean .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , U Jisu u la sien kiew sha u kum ban duwai bad ban pynlut baroh shi miet hangta da kaba duwai ha U Blei .
translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that he went out into a mountain to pray , and continued all night in prayer to God .
For , behold , the  Lord  will come with fire , and with his chariots like a whirlwind , to render his anger with fury , and his rebuke with flames of fire .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un wan bad ka ding . Un shong ha ki thapniang jong ka  erïong , ban pynshitom ïa kito kiba u la bitar .
Baroh ki la ïawan hadien jong u bad ki la pyrta , Pynphai ïa u !
translation.en: For the multitude of the people followed after , crying , Away with him .

translation.kha: Da la ki jong ki khmat ar la Ïohi ïa ka jingpyndonkam jong me ,
translation.en: For mine eyes have seen thy salvation ,

translation.kha: Haba ken ïap , kin leit phai pah sha ka khyndew ; ha kata ka sngi borbah ki jingthmu jong ki kine sa kut noh .
translation.en: His breath goeth forth , he returneth to his earth  ; in that very day his thoughts perish .

translation.kha: u Mahlon bad u kyllon ruh ki la ïap , Bad ka Naomi ka la shah iehnoh sa tang mudui , khlem u tnga ne ki khun shynraiñ .
translation.en: And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them  ; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband .

translation.kha: U Elishah u ïaid baroh shi sngi ha ka ri khlei . U la syngkhlieh bad shong ha ka jingkah syrngiew u dieng bad u kwah tang ban ïap noh . Ka la long palat , ko Trai , u la ïadie . Syiem noh ïa ka jingim jong nga ; ka bha ïa nga ban ïap noh .
translation.en: But he himself went a day s journey into the wilderness , and came and sat down under a juniper tree : and he requested for himself that he might die  ; and said , It is enough  ; now , O  Lord  , take away my life  ; for I am not better than my fathers .

translation.kha: I bah ine-ine i eh iap . Balei ngan leit sha jingontep jongno i haba nga lah thikna , in nym wan sha jingontep jongnga ?
translation.en: Mr So-and-So is dead . Why would I bother going to his funeral since , I am certain , he won't come to mine ?
And now , though thou wouldest needs be gone , because thou sore longedst after thy father s house , yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods ?
translation.kha: Nga tip ba me mihnoh namar ba me kynmaw ïing eh , hynrei balei pat me tuh ïa ki blei ïing jong nga ?
Ko khun u briew , u la ong , kumno yn nujor ïa u dieng shaiñ bad u dieng ? Ka bha aïu ka tnat u dieng shongsaiñ haba nujor bad ki dieng ha khlaw ?
translation.en: Son of man , What is the vine tree more than any tree , or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest ?

translation.kha: Mynta nga la ïohsngew ba me lah ba syiem ïa ki jingman baher bad pyut ïa ki jingmaïan . Lada me lah ban pule ïa ken ka jingthoh sad ïathuh ïa ang aïu ka kit jingmut , yn pynkup ïa me ha ki jaiñkup syiemsad ba sboh , yn pyndeng ha me ïa u kynjri ksiar jong ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jrong me , bad men long umbiah lai ha ka ber haduh ka hima .
translation.en: And I have heard of thee , that thou canst make interpretations , and dissolve doubts : now if thou canst read the writing , and make known to me the interpretation thereof , thou shalt be clothed with scarlet , and have a chain of gold about thy neck , and shalt be the third ruler in the kingdom .

translation.kha: Lada to la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum dara leh ïa kawei khie kaba ka de ïa ang ban shah pynrem da ka jingtep , mem kyrpad baneh lait na ka . Hynrei lada ym don ka jingshisha ha ki jingmudui ïa ibha ki wallam pyrshah ïa nga , ym don uno Une uba lah ban aiti ïa nga shad ki . Nga apil sha u Pashhur .
translation.en: For if I be an offender , or have committed any thing worthy of death , I refuse not to die : but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me , no man may deliver me unto them . I appeal unto Caesar .

translation.kha: ka snieh langsohmoh ba la wieh dong saw , ka snem kabu bha , bad ka dieng akasia ;
translation.en: And rams  skins dyed red , and badgers  skins , and shittim wood ,

translation.kha: Ki bynriew kiba kloi ban bitar ki pynlong shibun ki jingïakajia bad ki jingkulmar .
translation.en: An angry man stirreth up strife , and a furious man aboundeth in transgression .
Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Judah , and took them .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatsaw jong ka jingsynshar u syiem Hesekaïah , u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria , u tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh jong ka Judah bad ki jop ïa ki .

translation.en: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp , bearing his reproach .
translation.kha: Te , to ngin leit sha u shabar ka jaka shong dara ban ïoh bynta lang ha ka jingshah lehrain jong u .

translation.en: And the Jews marvelled , saying , How knoweth this man letters , having never learned ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la lyngngoh haduh katta katta bad ki la ong ,  Kumno une u briew u tip katne katne haba um pat ju ïoh jinghikai ei ei ?
Ho-oid , hadien kita ki sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , U Trai u la ai ha nga ïa kita ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba u la tah ïa kata ka jutang .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights , that the  Lord  gave me the two tables of stone , even the tables of the covenant .
He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth : but he that hath mercy on the poor , happy is he .
translation.kha: Lada phi kwah ban long kiba kmen , to lehsbun ïa kiba duk ; ka long ka pop ban ñiewbeiñ ïano ïano .

translation.en: But when the husbandmen saw him , they reasoned among themselves , saying , This is the heir : come , let us kill him , that the inheritance may be ours .
translation.kha: Hynrei , haba ki nongshimwai ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la kren para ma ki , ‘ Une u dei u khun jong u trai . To ngin ïa-pynïap ïa u , bad ka jingdon jingem jong u kan long ka jong ngi !’

Lada ba-don Teng kamai ka shnong , ka lyngki shata ka lah ban jngai than , bun uto uba wad kpu u lah ban lap ïa u bad ha la ka jingbitar u lah ïa-ban pynïap ïa u briew u bim dei hok ban ïapom , namar um shngiam don ka jingïashun pynlang la u paramarjan mynlyiur .
translation.en: Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer , while his heart is hot , and overtake him , because the way is long , and slay him  ; whereas he was not worthy of death , inasmuch as he hated him not in time past .
But Herod the tetrarch , being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip s wife , and for all the evils which Herod had done ,
translation.kha: Hynrei u Ïoannis u la pynrem jur ïa u Herod , uba long u lyngskor , namar u la shongkurim ïa ka Herodias , ka tnga jong u para jong u , bad u la leh bun kiei kiei kiba sniew .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto the children of Israel , Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians , and from the Amorites , from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha ki ïa kane ka jubab ,  Ki Ijipt , ki Amor , ki Ammon , ki Philistia

translation.en: I will also praise thee with the psaltery , even thy truth , O my God : unto thee will I sing with the harp , O thou Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Da shisha ngan ïaroh ïa me da ka duitara ; ngan ïaroh ïa ka jingïaineh jong me , A Blei jong nga . Ha ka duitara jong nga ngan tem ïa ki jingrwai sha me , Uta Uba Khuid ki Israel .

translation.en: Woe to thee that spoilest , and thou wast not spoiled  ; and dealest treacherously , and they dealt not treacherously with thee ! when thou shalt cease to spoil , thou shalt be spoiled  ; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously , they shall deal treacherously with thee .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki la shahjop ! Ki la lute bad shetkylla , wat la ym shym don kiba la lute ne shetkylla ïa ki . Hynrei ka por ban lute bad shetkylla kan kut , bad ma ki hi kin sa long kiba shah lute bad kiba shah shetkylla .

Ka mluh ka long kaba bha ; hynrei lada ka duh noh ïa ka jingbang jong ka , kum phi lah ban pynpdang pat ïa ka ? To don ïa ka mluh jong ka jingïalong paralok hapdeng jong phi , bad para ma phi , to im hapdeng ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Salt is good : but if the salt have lost his saltness , wherewith will ye season it ? Have salt in yourselves , and have peace one with another .

And there came a man of God , and spake unto the king of Israel , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , Because the Syrians have said , The  Lord  is God of the hills , but he is not God of the valleys , therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand , and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Ahab bad ong ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong : ‘ Namar ba ki Syria ki ong ba nga long u blei jong ki lum bad ym jong ki jaka madan , ngan sa ai jingjop ïa phi halor ka kynhun shipai bakhraw jong ki , bad ma phi bad ki briew jong phi kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .’
Ka la long na snem shadien ba nga la leit sha Jerusalem banbeiñ ïoh jingtip na u Petros , nabar nga la sah bad u ar taïew .
translation.en: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter , and abode with him fifteen days .

translation.kha: U Samuel u ïathuh ha u Jonathan u khun jong u mala ha ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ba u thmu ban pynïap ïa u Dabid . hynriew u Jonathan u sngew jan eh ïa u Dabid ,
translation.en: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son , and to all his servants , that they should kill David .

Arise , cry out in the night : in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord : lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children , that faint for hunger in the top of every street .
translation.kha: Nga la khot ïa kiba ïateh lok bad nga , hynrei ki la kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga . Ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam ki la ïap ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah , ki da wad ïa ka jingbam ban ri pynim ïa lade .
Te ngan eh ba jubab ïa kito bakha ibiang ïa na namar nga shynriah ha ka ktien jong me .
translation.en: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me : for I trust in thy word .

translation.kha: Kumta , katno kum ka hukum U Trai , ki paid Israel ki ai ha ki Lebi katto katne tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang na ki jaka Jong ki .
translation.en: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance , at the commandment of the  Lord  , these cities and their suburbs .

translation.kha: Ban tip ïa ka mon jong U Blei , aïu dei baneh ar man la ka sngem ?
translation.en: What daily practice is good for anyone wanting to learn God’s will ?

translation.kha: Lada ka pang ba ka kham jylla ban ïa ka sniehdoh Sidon jong ka , bad u shngiam hangta u lam thor bad stang , kata ka dei ka jingdap ñiangthohlieh , bad un pynbna ba uta u bynriew u long u bymjukut .
translation.en: Then the priest shall see the plague : and , behold , if it be in sight deeper than the skin  ; and there be in it a yellow thin hair  ; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a dry scall , even a leprosy upon the head or beard .

translation.kha: Shah ngin ïaid na ka ri jong phi . Ma ngi lem bad ki jingri ngin ym leit saitlah na ka lynti dawai leit sha ki lyngkhuit ne ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi ; bad ngaiñ ym dih um na ki pukri jongnga phi ; ngin ïaid babit na lynti bah khih ba ngin da laitim na ka ri jong phi .
translation.en: Let me pass through thy land : we will not turn into the fields , or into the vineyards  ; we will not drink of the waters of the well : but we will go along by the king s high way , until we be past thy borders .
