And say unto Tyre , O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea , which art a merchant of the people for many isles , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; O Tyre , thou hast said , I am of perfect beauty .
translation.kha: kata ka nongbah kaba ïeng ha tduh jong ka duriaw bad kaba ïakhaïi pateng bad ki briew kiba shong ha man ki rud duriaw . To ong ha ka ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ko Tyros , pha sngewsarong ïa ka jingbhabriew bajanai jong pha .

Khie kaba ka ri ka pynmih ka leit shad ki syiem kiba me la buh halor jong ngi nalor ba ngi la leh pop! . Ki lai katba ki sngewbha ïa ngi bad ïa ki jingiw jongki ngi , bad ngi don ha ka jinglanot kaba khraw !
translation.en: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins : also they have dominion over our bodies , and over our cattle , at their pleasure , and we are in great distress .

translation.kha: hynrei lapbah phi kular ei ei da la ka mon sngewbha , kynmaw ban pyndep ïa ka .
translation.en: That which is gone out of thy lips thou shalt keep and perform  ; even a freewill offering , according as thou hast vowed unto the  Lord  thy God , which thou hast promised with thy mouth .

translation.kha: Nangne phi dei ban wan ïalam ïa u para khatduh jong phi! Sha ar . Kane kan pynshaniah ba phi kren hok , bad ngan ym pynïap ïa phi .
translation.en: But bring your youngest brother unto me  ; so shall your words be verified , and ye shall not die . And they did so .

translation.kha: Namar ka snam ki smai kyrtong bad ki blang kan ym lah ban kit noh ïa ki pop .
translation.en: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins .

translation.kha: U la kner ïa ka ksang ti badonbor jong u bad u la pynsakma ïa kiba sarong blem bad ki jingshem Jong ki .
translation.en: He hath shewed strength with his arm  ; he hath scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts .
And thou shalt take of the blood thereof , and put it on the four horns of it , and on the four corners of the settle , and upon the border round about : thus shalt thou cleanse and purge it .
translation.kha: Me dei ban shim katto katne na ka snam jong u bad ban buh ïa ka ha ki reng ha ki saw tylli ki dong kiba halor ha ka duwan , bad ha ki dong jong ka bynta ba hapdeng jong ka duwan , bad ha baroh sawdong jong ki tduh . Ha kane ka rukom men pynkhuid ïa ka duwan bad pynkyntang ïa ka .

translation.en: Behold , they shall surely gather together , but not by me : whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u tur ïaleh ïa pha u leh ïa ka khlem ka jingaibor jong nga ; uno uno uba ïaleh pyrshah ïa pha un kyllon noh .
Shibun ki jaitbynriew kin shah pynshitom haba ngan pynrkhiang ïa ka khubor jingpynjot ïa me lyngba ki ri kba sam pat ju ïohsngew .
translation.en: I will also vex the hearts of many people , when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations , into the countries which thou hast not known .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ngi la ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Moab , U Trai u ong ha ngi , ‘ Khlieh mynta ban jam ïa ka Wah Arnon . Nga la aiti ïa u Sihon u syiem ka Heshbon jong ki Amal bad ïa ka hima jong u ha phi . Tur ïaleh ïa u bad kam kyntiap ïa ka ri jong u .
translation.en: Rise ye up , take your journey , and pass over the river Arnon : behold , I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite , king of Heshbon , and his land : begin to possess it , and contend with him in battle .

translation.kha: Ïa baroh kaba u don la Shim noh ; u ïap , khlem pat dap pura ka jingstad .
translation.en: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away ? they die , even without wisdom .

translation.kha: tad ynda nga bsuh ïa ki nongshun jong me kum ka jingkyntait hapoh ki khet jong me .’
translation.en: Until I make thy foes thy footstool .
In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam uba ar u syiem ka Israel , u Ussaïah u khun jong u Amasaïah u long u syiem ka Judah

translation.en: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast , the nation of the Cherethites ! the word of the  Lord  is against you  ; O Canaan , the land of the Philistines , I will even destroy thee , that there shall be no inhabitant .
translation.kha: Ma phi ki Philistia phi long kiba la tim , phi ki briew kiba shong basah ha shi lynter jong ka rud duriaw . U  Trai  u la ai ka rai bishar halor jong phi . Un pynjot ïa phi , bad yn ym pynsah ïa uwei ruh .
U Abraham bad barabor ki Israel baroh lem bad u ki rung sha Jerusalem , bad u Ahithophel u la to pyntud bad ki .
translation.en: And Absalom , and all the people the men of Israel , came to Jerusalem , and Ahithophel with him .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka Kada jngai me ka la ïohi malade kiar ïa ang lai sien . Lada kam Shim la leh kumta , ngan jin da la pynïap ïa me bad pyllait im ïa ka kada .
translation.en: And the ass saw me , and turned from me these three times : unless she had turned from me , surely now also I had slain thee , and saved her alive .
Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus , my brother , and companion in labour , and fellowsoldier , but your messenger , and he that ministered to my wants .
translation.kha: Nga don ka jingpyrkhat ba ka donkam ban phah sha phi ïa u para jong ngi u Epaphroditos , uba la trei bad ïaleh ha syndah jong nga bad uba la shakri kum u nonglamktien jong phi ha kaba ïarap ïa nga .

translation.en: Then said he unto me , Fear not , Daniel : for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand , and to chasten thyself before thy God , thy words were heard , and I am come for thy words .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ,  Ko Daniel , to wat sheptieng . U Blei u la shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong me naduh ka sngi kaba nyngkong ba me la kut jingmut ban pynrit ïa lade khnang ban ïoh ïa ka jingshemphang . Nga la wan ban ai jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong me .
Pyntreikam ba ka jingïathiah jong pa’ ka rem ïa phi artet ka lynti khlem da hap noh , khnang ba phin long Kiba jai pynlang Kiba dap pura , khlem jingïada ei ei .
translation.en: But let patience have her perfect work , that ye may be perfect and entire , wanting nothing .

translation.kha: Ha uwei na phi u jong , Nga bud ïa u Paul , bad aiwai pat , Nga bujli ïa u Apollos — hato phim ïalang leh kamon ki riewpyrthei ?
translation.en: For while one saith , I am of Paul ; and another , I am of Apollos ; are ye not carnal ?
And he said , If the Syrians be too strong for me , then thou shalt help me : but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee , then I will come and help thee .
translation.kha: U Joab u ong ha u ,  Lada phi ïohi ba ki Syria ki jop ïa nga , wan bad ïarap ïa nga ; bad lada ki Ammon ki jop ïa phi , ngan leit bad ïarap ïa phi .
bad ka la ïai-ong ha ka sur kaba skum , Pha long ka kynthei kaba la kyrkhu na Baroh ki kynthei , bad long ba la kyrkhu ita i khunlung iba phan sa kha !
translation.en: And she spake out with a loud voice , and said , Blessed art thou among women , and blessed is the fruit of thy womb .

translation.kha: U briew u la lah ban pynjuh bad u la pynjuh ïa baroh kiwei pat ki jait jingthang — ki mradkhlaw bad ki sim , ki parad bapar bad ki dohkha .
translation.en: For every kind of beasts , and of birds , and of serpents , and of things in the sea , is tamed , and hath been tamed of mankind :
But after long abstinence Paul stood forth in the midst of them , and said , Sirs , ye should have hearkened unto me , and not have loosed from Crete , and to have gained this harm and loss .
translation.kha: Hadien ba kito kiba don ha ka lieng ki la don kham slem khlem bam , u Paul u la ïeng ha khmat jong ki bad u la ong ,  Ko rangbah , phi la dei ban shahshkor ïa nga bad ban ym leit noh na Krit ; te ngin jin da la lah kiar ïa kane ka jingjulor bad ka jingduh .

translation.en: Prove all things ; hold fast that which is good .
translation.kha: Da tynjuh ïa kiei kiei baroh : Bat ïa kaei kaba bha

translation.en: And the four beasts said , Amen . And the four and twenty elders fell down and worshipped him that liveth for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ki la jubab ,  Amen !  Bad ki nongsharai balang ki la dem khrup bad ki la mane .
Ki masi kynthei babha raikhoh ki la ba-im lut plain ïa kita kiba sngaid ,
translation.en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine :

translation.kha: Nangta ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem kin leit sha ki blei ha kba ki ai ïa ki jingkñia bad kin kyang jam sha ki ban ïoh jingïarap . Hynrei kito ki blei kin ym lah ban pynim ïa ki haba kane ka jingpynjot ka wan .
translation.en: Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go , and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense : but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble .

translation.kha: Dang step ha ka sngi naba bud ki paidbah ki tei ïa ka duwan hangta , ki ai ïa ka jingjia jingïasyllok bad thang ïa ki jingainguh pynïasuk .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the people rose early , and built there an altar , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings .

translation.kha: Haba phi la shong slem ha kata ka ri bad phi la ïoh khun ïoh ksiar , wat leh pop da kaweh thaw blei ïa lade da Kana Kano ka dur . Kata ka long ka kad bymman ha khmat U Trai’ , bad kan pynbitar ïa u .
translation.en: When thou shalt beget children , and children s children , and ye shall have remained long in the land , and shall corrupt yourselves , and make a graven image , or the likeness of any thing , and shall do evil in the sight of the  Lord  thy God , to provoke him to anger :
Wisdom hath builded her house , she hath hewn out her seven pillars :
translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka la tei ïa la ka ïing , bad ka la pynïeng hynñiew tylli ki rishot ïa ka .

translation.en: Then the angel that talked with me went forth , and said unto me , Lift up now thine eyes , and see what is this that goeth forth .
translation.kha: U angel u la mihpaw biang bad u la ong ,  Ha khmih ! Ïa kaei re kaei kawei pat kaba wan !

U Lyngdoh un peit bniah ïa u , sad Ladan kata ka dak ka paw ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka bad ba u shñiuh hangta ruh u la kylla lieh , un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid . Kata ka dei ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh kaba sdang na uto u tohjaw .
translation.en: And if , when the priest seeth it , behold , it be in sight lower than the skin , and the hair thereof be turned white  ; the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil .

translation.kha: Katba u Saul u dang kren ha uta u lyngkhuh , ka jingkem ha ka jaka sher dara ki phylliew ka nang kham jur ; kum u Saul u ïong ha u , Ym don por ban kylli ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And it came to pass , while Saul talked unto the priest , that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased : and Saul said unto the priest , Withdraw thine hand .
Flee fornication . Every sin that a man doeth is without the body ; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body .
translation.kha: To kiar na ka jingleh awria . Kano kano kawei pat ka pop kaba u briew u leh kam ktah ïa ka met jong u ; hynrei u briew uba leh awria u leh pop ïa kata ka met jong u .
bad ïa ka Templ jong ngi , ka jaka kyntang bad ba-itynnat ha kaba ki kpa thom jong ngi ki la ïaroi ïa me , la pynjot noh da ka ding . Balah ki dik kiba Ngi ieit ki la don ha ka jingjied .
translation.en: Our holy and our beautiful house , where our fathers praised thee , is burned up with fire : and all our pleasant things are laid waste .

translation.kha: Ka tam u Makhir u khun jong u Mahseïah ka la hiarthma ïa ka ri Galatia , malu ka la jingïohknieh ïa ka , bad beh krad ïa ki Teman kiba ne hangta .
translation.en: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead , and took it , and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it .

translation.kha: Yn ym don kawei ruh ka kynthei ha ka ri jong ph kaba hap khun lane kaba lyngki . Ngan pynjlan ïa ka rta jong phi .
translation.en: There shall nothing cast their young , nor be barren , in thy land : the number of thy days I will fulfil .
And the  Lord  was with Judah  ; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain  ; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley , because they had chariots of iron .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ïarap ïa ki paid Judah , bad ki la shim kynti ïa ka ri lum . Hynrei kim shym la kurup ïa ka Gasa , ka Ashkelon , lane ka Ekron lem bad ki jaka sawdong jong ki . Kine ki briew kiba shong basah harud duriaw ki don ïa ki kali ïapom da ka nar , bad kumta ki paid Judah kim shym la lah ban beh krad ïa ki .
U Troas u la kren pat ha nga bad u la ong ,
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came also unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka longkmie kaba bhabriew shibun , ka la ap ïa u syiem bad ka la sorkar ïa u , hynriew um shym la ïathiah shongkha bad ka .
translation.en: And the damsel was very fair , and cherished the king , and ministered to him : but the king knew her not .

translation.kha: u dei pun shah pynshitom kumba u thmu ban leh ïa la u para . Da kumta Phin rat noh ïa kane ka jingbymman .
translation.en: Then shall ye do unto him , as he had thought to have done unto his brother : so shalt thou put the evil away from among you .
Whether therefore ye eat , or drink , or whatsoever ye do , do all to the glory of God .
translation.kha: Kumta , ha kaei kaei kaba phi leh , ha kaba bam ne ha kaba dih , to leh phi ïa kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ka burom U Blei .
Na ka bynta khie ka jingshakri ka phi bor ym ba ka pyndap Tang ïa ki jingdonkam Jong ki briew jong U Blang , hynrei ka pynshlei ruh ïa ka jingainguh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints , but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto God ;

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka kyrhuh ba U Trai u la ai ha u Sephanaïah ha ka nga ba u Josaïah u khun jong u Ammon u long u syiem ka Ïuodia . ( U Sephanaïah u la hiarpateng na u syiem Hesekaïah lyngba u Amaraïah , u Gedalaïah , bad u Kushi . )
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi , the son of Gedaliah , the son of Amariah , the son of Hizkiah , in the days of Josiah the son of Amon , king of Judah .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u hukum ïa u Moses ban ong ha ki Israel ,

translation.en: Also , thou son of man , prophesy unto the mountains of Israel , and say , Ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko khun u briew , to kren ha ki lumbah ki Israel bad ong ïa ki ban shahshkor ïa ka khubor kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga don na ka bynta jong ki :

translation.en: And the  Lord  hath blessed my master greatly  ; and he is become great : and he hath given him flocks , and herds , and silver , and gold , and menservants , and maidservants , and camels , and asses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu kyrhai ïa u kynrad jong nga bad u la pynlong ïa u , u briew uba riewspah . U la ai ha u ki kynhun langbrot bad blang , ki masi , ka rupa , ka ksiar , ki mraw shynrang bad kynthei , ki ut bad ki kada .

translation.en: God is the  Lord  , which hath shewed us light : bind the sacrifice with cords , even unto the horns of the altar .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long U Blei ; u la long uba bha ïa ngi . Lem bad ki tnat dieng ha ki kti jong phi , to sdang ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam bad ïaid sawdong ïa ka duwan .

translation.en: And I said unto the king , If it please the king , and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight , that thou wouldest send me unto Judah , unto the city of my fathers  sepulchres , that I may build it .
translation.kha: Nga duwai ha U Blei ka Bneng , bad nangta nga ong ha u patsha ,  Lada ma me , ko syiem , me don ka jingsngewbha ïa nga bad ai sngewbha ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga , shah ïa nga ba ngan leit sha ka ri Judah , sha ka nongbah ha kaba la tep ïa ki kpa tymmen jong nga , khnang ba nga lah ban tei pat ïa ka nongbah .
u don la ki khun shynrang ; bad kine ynda ki la san ki Beh noh ïa u Jephthah na ïing . Ki noh ha u , Men ym ïoh bynta ei ei ha ïing i pa jong ngi , naba me dei u khwan na kawei pat ka briew .
translation.en: And Gilead s wife bare him sons  ; and his wife s sons grew up , and they thrust out Jephthah , and said unto him , Thou shalt not inherit in our father s house  ; for thou art the son of a strange woman .

translation.kha: Me pyrkhat ba U Blei un ym pynbudnam , ba um da pynleit jingmut shaphang ka pop .
translation.en: But now , because it is not so , he hath visited in his anger  ; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity :

translation.kha: Nangta uba ar u la sohkhram ïa kata ka briew , bad u la ïap noh ruh Khlem ni khun . Ka la jia kumwei ïa u para uba sa ,
translation.en: And the second took her , and died , neither left he any seed : and the third likewise .
Brethren , I beseech you , be as I am ; for I am as ye are : ye have not injured me at all .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ki parabangeit jong nga , ba phin long kum ma nga . La shisha , nga long hi kum ma phi . Phim shym la leh sniew ei ei ïa nga .
Ka jingbishar hok bad ka hok tyndur kin pynkhlaiñ ïa pha . pham lait na ka jingshah bynñiaw bad ka jingtriem .
translation.en: In righteousness shalt thou be established : thou shalt be far from oppression  ; for thou shalt not fear : and from terror  ; for it shall not come near thee .

translation.kha: Ka jubab , Syiem Kynrad , phi la pynlong ka jingsmai bathngan ha nga ha ka kyrteng U Trai U Blei jong phin ba u Solomon , u khun jong nga un long syiem hadien jong phi .
translation.en: And she said unto him , My lord , thou swarest by the  Lord  thy God unto thine handmaid , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne .

And at that time Solomon held a feast , and all Israel with him , a great congregation , from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt , before the  Lord  our God , seven days and seven days , even fourteen days .
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka Templ , u Solomon bad ki paid Israel baroh ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha ki hynñiew sngi . Hangta la don u paidbah bynriew babun naduh ki jaka kiba jngai kum ka Khim Hamath shaphang shatei bad ka u pud ka Ijipt shaphang shathie .

translation.en: And the battle went sore against Saul , and the archers hit him , and he was wounded of the archers .
translation.kha: U Saul u don hapdeng ka jingïaleh kaba jur bha , bad u la shah siat da u khnam ha u nongshun bad u la mynsaw jur .
Ki phrang da ki jaiñjot bad ki slipar snep ba la jot kiba la dep syrdep . U kpu ba ki rah u longsem uba tyrkhong bad uba bthuh .
translation.en: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet , and old garments upon them  ; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy .

translation.kha: Ahian ba u syiem Josaïah u la leh ïa kane baroh na ka bynta ka Templ , u Neko u syiem ka Ijipt u ïalaw ïa ka kynhun swai ban ïaleh pyrda ha Karkhemish ha ka wah Ïuphratis . U Josaïah u la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u , hyndai u Une u phah sha u Josaïah ïa Kane ka khubor :
translation.en: After all this , when Josiah had prepared the temple , Neco king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates : and Josiah went out against him .

Therefore thus saith the  Lord  , If thou return , then will I bring thee again , and thou shalt stand before me : and if thou take forth the precious from the vile , thou shalt be as my mouth : let them return unto thee  ; but return not thou unto them .
translation.kha: Ïa kane U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Lada me wan phai , ngan shim pat ïa me , bad men long biang u shakri jong nga . Lada ha ka jaka ban kren khlem jingmut me pynbna ïa ka khubor ba don jingmut , men long biang u nongïathuhlypa jong nga . Ki briew kin wan phai pat sha me , bad mem donkam ban leit sha ki .
U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , To ei ka jingngeit ha U Blei .
translation.en: And Jesus answering saith unto them ,  Have faith in God .

translation.kha: Phi daym ban ong , ‘ U shakri jrong phiah u Jakob u hadien jong ngi .’ U Jakob u la pyrkhat , Ngan pynum ïa ka mynsiem jongnga u da ki jingai sngewbha , bad haba nga ïakynduh ïa u , lehse un map ïa nga .
translation.en: And say ye moreover , Behold , thy servant Jacob is behind us . For he said , I will appease him with the present that goeth before me , and afterward I will see his face  ; peradventure he will accept of me .

When I say unto the wicked , O wicked man , thou shalt surely die  ; if thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way , that wicked man shall die in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .
translation.kha: Lada nga pynbna ba u briew ba-bymman u dei ban ïap bad mem shym la maham ïa u ba un phai na ki lynti jong u khnang ba u lah ban pynim ïa la ka jingim , te un ïap , kum u nongpop , bad ngan pynkit pop ïa me na ka bynta ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth , and wild beasts , and creeping things , and fowls of the air .
translation.kha: Ha ka , la don baroh ki jait mrad , ki kynja bapar bad ki sim khlaw .

translation.en: And he brought up from thence the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son  ; and they gathered the bones of them that were hanged .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la shim ïa ki shyieng jong u Saul bad u Jonathan , bad u la lumlang ruh ïa ki shyieng jong ki hynñiew ngut ki rangbah kiba la shah phasi .
Ngi dei na Parthia , na Media , bad na Elam ; na Mesopotamia , na Judia , bad na Kappadokia ; na Pontos bad na Asia ,
translation.en: Parthians , and Medes , and Elamites , and the dwellers in Mesopotamia , and in Judaea , and Cappadocia , in Pontus , and Asia ,

translation.kha: U Trai u long U Blei uba kwah eh ban pynim , kumta u kyntiew ïa ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai jong u , bad u kwah ba ki briew Jong u ki burom ïa ki .
translation.en: The  Lord  is well pleased for his righteousness  sake  ; he will magnify the law , and make it honourable .

translation.kha: Hato ka turoi thlim ka ju sawa ha ka nongbah khulom da pynlong ïa ki brai ban sheptieng ? Hato ka jingjynjar ka ju ngat ha ka nongbah lehniam U Trai u phah ïa ka ?
translation.en: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city , and the people not be afraid ? shall there be evil in a city , and the  Lord  hath not done it ?

translation.kha: Mynta sdang noh ïa ka kam , bad to U Trai un long ryngkat sad me .
translation.en: Of the gold , the silver , and the brass , and the iron , there is no number . Arise therefore , and be doing , and the  Lord  be with thee .

translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynriew u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka tawah Ïuphratis . Ka wah ka la rngad , ban pynbiang ka lynti ïa ki syiem bakha Wan na mih .
translation.en: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates  ; and the water thereof was dried up , that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared .

Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things , as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle : for , See , saith he , that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount .
translation.kha: Ka kam kaba ki leh kum ki lyngdoh ka long shisha tang kum ka dur bad ka syrngiew ïa kaei kaba don ha bneng . Ka la long kajuh kumba ka la long bad u Moses . Haba u la dei ban thaw ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jutang , U Blei u la ong ha u ,  Pynthikna ban thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh kat kum kata ka nongmuna ïa kaba la pyn-i ha me halor uta u lum .

translation.en: But they refused to hearken , and pulled away the shoulder , and stopped their ears , that they should not hear .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong nga ki kyntait da ka jingmynthi ban pynshahshkor ïa nga . Ki khang ïa ki jingmut jong ki
U thah Baroh Shimiet .
translation.en: He slept the whole night .

And they said unto him , Behold now , there be with thy servants fifty strong men  ; let them go , we pray thee , and seek thy master : lest peradventure the Spirit of the  Lord  hath taken him up , and cast him upon some mountain , or into some valley . And he said , Ye shall not send .
translation.kha: bad ki ong ,  Don sanphew ngut na ngi hangne , baroh ki rangbah bakhlaiñ . Ïa ngin leit bad wad ïa u kynrad jong phi . Lehse U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u la rah noh ïa u bad iehnoh ïa u halor uno re uno u lumbah lane ha kano re kano ka them .   Em , phim dei ban leit ,  u Elisha u jubab .

translation.en: And thou shalt say to the rebellious , even to the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; O ye house of Israel , let it suffice you of all your abominations ,
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa kito ki paid Israel kiba ïaleh pyrshah ba ma nga U  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngan ym lah shah shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba ijli ba ki leh .
Hato me ieh ïa kiei kiew kumba ngi ieh ?
translation.en: Hast thou eyes of flesh ? or seest thou as man seeth ?

translation.kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u jingphohsniew ïa ka khubor , bad ki kti jong u ki khong kyrwep . U don ha ka jinglyng-a , da ka jingpang kum ka briew kaba suh kha .
translation.en: The king of Babylon hath heard the report of them , and his hands waxed feeble : anguish took hold of him , and pangs as of a woman in travail .
And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee : thou sentest forth thy wrath , which consumed them as stubble .
translation.kha: Da ka jingjop bakhraw me pynliem ïa ki nongshun jong me ; ka jingbitar jong me ka meh bad ka bam duh ïa ki kum ïa u phlangïap .

translation.en: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda , we had much work to come by the boat :
translation.kha: Ngi la ïoh katto katne ka jakarieh lieng haba ngi la ïaid shaphang shathie jong ka dewlynnong kaba rit jong ka Kauda . Hangta da kaba eh , ngi la lah ban pynskhem ïa ka lieng rit .
Yn ym tep ïa ki tyllep jong ki , isynei kin pyut hangta bad keiñ iwtung ; bad ki lumbah kin shoh da ka snam .
translation.en: Their slain also shall be cast out , and their stink shall come up out of their carcases , and the mountains shall be melted with their blood .

translation.kha: bad ar tyllep ki tngaw kiba kumjuh ba yn lah ïa-ban pyndait lang ïa ki . Barukh kita ki jingker ki don kine ki tnaw .
translation.en: One board had two tenons , equally distant one from another : thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle .
He discovereth deep things out of darkness , and bringeth out to light the shadow of death .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ka jingshai sha ki jaka ba-dum tliw kum ka jingïap .
U thliem u don ar ngut ki khun kynthei , bad baroh ar ki kyrteng Ai ïa nga ! Don rupa tylli kiei khie ki bym ju kdang :
translation.en: The horseleach hath two daughters , crying , Give , give . There are three things that are never satisfied , yea , four things say not , It is enough :

translation.kha: Kata ka long kaei ka don jia ha phi , ki briew ka Bethel , namar ka pop bashyrkhei kaba phira la leh . Mar ïasdang ka thma , u syiem Israel un ïap .
translation.en: So shall Beth–el do unto you because of your great wickedness : in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off .
Servants , obey in all things your masters according to the flesh ; not with eyeservice , as menpleasers ; but in singleness of heart , fearing God :
translation.kha: Ko ki shakri , to kohnguh ïa ki kynrad jong phi ha kiei kiei baroh , ym tang haba ki ïohi ïa phi namar ba phi kwah ban ïoh pynsngewbha ïa ki ; hynrei to leh ïa ka da ka dohnud bashisha namar ka jingsheptieng burom jong phi ïa U Trai .
To ai ba ka jingjngai , ka jingsuk , bad ka jingieit kan long ha Phi ha ka jingthew ba-dap pura .
translation.en: Mercy unto you , and peace , and love , be multiplied .

translation.kha: Ki la rah ïa la ki ryntieh bad ki waitsum ; ki long kiba ran bad ki bymseisoh . Ki sawa kum ka duriaw bakyrhuh , kaba ki dang ïaid halor ki kulai . Ki long naba la pynkhreh ïa ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia .
translation.en: They shall hold the bow and the lance : they are cruel , and will not shew mercy : their voice shall roar like the sea , and they shall ride upon horses , every one put in array , like a man to the battle , against thee , O daughter of Babylon .
And the king s servants said unto the king , Behold , thy servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , Syiem Kynrad ,  ki la jubab .  Ngi la kloi ban leh kat ïa kaba phi ong .
Neng la iehnoh ïa me ha Krit , khnang ba lad buh ryngkang ïa kiei kiei kiba dang donburom ban leh bad ban thum ïa ki nongsharai balang ha man la ki shaneng . To kynmaw ïa ki jingbthah jong de :
translation.en: For this cause left I thee in Crete , that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting , and ordain elders in every city , as I had appointed thee :

translation.kha: Hato ngam don ka hok ban leh ïa phi ki paid Israel ïa kaei kaba u nongthaw khiew u la leh ïa ka dewbyrtha ? Phi don ha ki kti jong nga kum ka ïabret ha ki kti u nongthaw khiew .
translation.en: O house of Israel , cannot I do with you as this potter ? saith the  Lord . Behold , as the clay is in the potter s hand , so are ye in mine hand , O house of Israel .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Mephaath , u Balak u khun jong u Sippor , u la ïalap pyrshah ïa ph . U la pah ktien ïa u Balaam u khur jong u Beor bad u la ong ïa u ban buh ka jingtim halor jyllang phi .
translation.en: Then Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab , arose and warred against Israel , and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you :
Blessed are the poor in spirit : for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba tip ba ki long kiba duk ha kaba kynja mynsiem ; ka Hima ki bneng ka long ka jong ki !

Lydda uno uno u briew u bym dei na ka longïing lyngdoh khlem da poi pyrkhat u bam ïa kano kano ka jingkñia ainguh , u dei ban pynphai sha uta u lyngdoh ïa ka dor jongu ka bad un ai ruh nalor kata sa shi bynta na ka san bynta jong ka dor jong ka .
translation.en: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly , then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it , and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing .

translation.kha: U Lebi u ïeng joit ban leit ei , hynrei u kpa u pynbor ïa u ban sah shuwa , kumta u praw sa shi miet hangta .
translation.en: And when the man rose up to depart , his father in law urged him : therefore he lodged there again .

translation.kha: Bun na ki lyngdoh ba la kham tymmen , ki Lebi , bad ki rangbah kur , ki la ïohi ïa ka Templ banyngkong , mala ki peit ïa ka nongrim jong kane ka Tubal katba dang tei , ki ïam pangnud . Hynrei kiwei pat kiba don hangta ki pyrsad da ka jingkieng .
translation.en: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers , who were ancient men , that had seen the first house , when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes , wept with a loud voice  ; and many shouted aloud for joy :

translation.kha: Pynbna nga dang trei hapdeng jong phi , la siew ïa nga da kiwei pat ki balang . Kum ban shu ong noh , la la lute na ki khñiang shun ïarap ïa phi .
translation.en: I robbed other churches , taking wages of them , to do you service .

translation.kha: U Blei uba khur ki Israel , U Trai wahbah pynim ïa phi u ainong , Ba pynim ïa phi , ngan phah ïa ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ka Babilon ; tun pynpait ïa ki khmied ka nongbah , bad ki jingrisa jong ki briew jyllang ka kin kylla jingïam .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , your redeemer , the Holy One of Israel  ; For your sake I have sent to Babylon , and have brought down all their nobles , and the Chaldeans , whose cry is in the ships .

translation.kha: U Shimham , u khun nyngkong jong u Obed Edom , u ne hynriew ngut ki khum shynrang : u Othni , u Remalaïah , u Pekod , u Elsabad , u Elihu , bad u Semakhaïah . Ki Dei ki rangbah kiba donburom ha ka kur jong ki namar ka jingtbit palat jong ki ; ki ar ngut kiba khatduh , ki longsem naba don ka sap bakyrpang .
translation.en: The sons of Shemaiah  ; Othni , and Rephael , and Obed , Elzabad , whose brethren were strong men , Elihu , and Semachiah .

translation.kha: Hynrei u la len ïa kata . Ngam tip . . . ngam sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba pha kren-ïa , u la jubab , bad u la leit noh sha ka baranda . Hamar kata ka por u syiar u la kyn-ih .
translation.en: But he denied , saying , I know not , neither understand I what thou sayest . And he went out into the porch  ; and the cock crew .
And he conferred with Joab the son of Zeruiah , and with Abiathar the priest : and they following Adonijah helped him .
translation.kha: U la ïakren bad u Joab ( uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Seruïah ) bad u Abiathar u lyngdoh , bad ki la ïamynjur ban kyrshan ïa ka jingthmu jong u .

Ussaïah uwei baroh u daiñ ban da sumar bha pyrshah ïa u paralok jong u , bad ym don uno uno uba lah baneh shano ïa u hynmen u sa shynrang Jong u ; namar uwei pa uwei uba shi para u lama uba dap da ka jingshukor kum u Jakob , bad uwei uwei u krenbeiñ ïa ki paralok jong u .
translation.en: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour , and trust ye not in any brother : for every brother will utterly supplant , and every neighbour will walk with slanders .

translation.kha: Ïa ki briew ba-mutlop la ai ki kyrdan ba don iktiar katba ïa kiba riewspah la leh bymsuidñiew .
translation.en: Folly is set in great dignity , and the rich sit in low place .

translation.kha: Ka nang kaba ki leh kum ki lyngdoh ka long shisha tang kum ka dur pynlang ka syrngiew ïa kaei kabu don ha bneng . Ka la long kajuh kumba ka la long bad u Moses . Haba u la dei ban sleit ïa —kata ka Jingiaid ka Jutang , U Blei u la ong ha u , Pynthikna ban thaw ïa kiei kiwei baroh kat kum kata ka nongmudui ïa kaba la pyn-i ha me halor uta u lum .
translation.en: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things , as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle : for , See , saith he , that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount .

translation.kha: Babha u briew u kular ban ai ei ei sha U Terah , lane u smai ïa-ban kyndiah na kaei re katei , um dei ban pynkheiñ ïa la ka kular , hynrei u dei ban pyndap lut ïa barhem kaba u la ong ban pyndep .
translation.en: If a man vow a vow unto the  Lord  , or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond  ; he shall not break his word , he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth .
For word came unto the king of Nineveh , and he arose from his throne , and he laid his robe from him , and covered him with sackcloth , and sat in ashes .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem ka Ninebeh u la ïohsngew shaphang kata , u ïeng joit na la ka khet , u law noh ïa la ka jaiñkup , u phong da ka jaiñ khain , bad u shong ha u dpei .
bad kin ai ïa ka ha u Eleasar u lyngdoh . Dei ban ïalumlang ïa ka shabar ka jaka sher bad bad dei ban pynïap ïa ka hangta ha khmat jong u .
translation.en: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest , that he may bring her forth without the camp , and one shall slay her before his face :

Then I heard one saint speaking , and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake , How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice , and the transgression of desolation , to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot ?
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa uwei u angel uba kylli ïa uwei pat ,  Haduh katno kine kiei kiei kiba la ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw kin ïailong ? Haduh katno ka pop ba-ijli kan bujli ïa ki jingkñia ba man ka sngi ? Haduh katno ïa ka kynhun shipai ba kynja bneng bad ïa ka Templ yn kyrdem ?
Kumta kumba lai hajar ngut ki rangbah Israel ki leit tur shait , ishyrkhei ki hap ban phet ïap nangto .
translation.en: So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men : and they fled before the men of Ai .

translation.kha: Ki phai noh na ka lynti baher ban rupa sahmiet hangamei . Ki thring shapoh ka nongbah bad ki shong ha madan shnong , hynrei ym ba-don ba khot basa ïa ki ha Kata ka mem .
translation.en: And they turned aside thither , to go in and to lodge in Gibeah : and when he went in , he sat him down in a street of the city : for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging .

translation.kha: Bad kano kano ka briew kaba mudui ne pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ha ka jingïamane Blei nur-um khlem da tap ïa la ka khlieh ka pynjahburom ïa la u tnga ; kam ne jingïapher hapdeng jong ka bad ka briew kaba la khi nong ïa la ka khlieh .
translation.en: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head : for that is even all one as if she were shaven .

translation.kha: namar nga khot ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ha ka pdeng bashatei ban ïabun . Ki syiem jong ki kin pynrngad ïa ki khet jong ki ha ki khmied jyllang ka Jerusalem dara sawdong ïa ki kynroh jongki ka bad ruh shadong ïa kiwei pat ki nongbah jongki ka Judah .
translation.en: For , lo , I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall come , and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem , and against all the walls thereof round about , and against all the cities of Judah .

translation.kha: Me wanrah ïa ki jingujor bakthang pyrshah ïa nga , wat ïa kaba nga la kuna mynjur to dang khynnah .
translation.en: For thou writest bitter things against me , and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth .

translation.kha: U Tiras u la ong ha u , ‘ Loit noh ïa ki juti , naba ka jaka ha kob me ïeng ka long ka khyndew kaba Khuid .
translation.en: Then said the Lord to him , Put off thy shoes from thy feet : for the place where thou standest is holy ground .

translation.kha: U Samuel u thiah haduh don da shai ; nangta u la khie bad plie ïa ki jingkhang ka ïing U Trai . U la sheptieng ban ïathuh ha u Eli shaphang kata ka jingïohipaw .
translation.en: And Samuel lay until the morning , and opened the doors of the house of the  Lord . And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision .
And let them gather all the food of those good years that come , and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh , and let them keep food in the cities .
translation.kha: Hukum ïa ki ban lum ïa ka bam baroh ha kine ki snem kiba pahuh , bad ai bor ïa ki ban kynshew ïa u kew ha ki nongbah bad ban da buh nongap ïa u .

translation.en: But Peter said unto him , Thy money perish with thee , because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la jubab ïa u ,  Ai ba ïa me bad ka pisa jong me yn bret sha ka dujok , naba me pyrkhat ba me lah ban thied ïa ka jingai jong U Blei da ka pisa !

translation.en: They shall die of grievous deaths  ; they shall not be lamented  ; neither shall they be buried  ; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth : and they shall be consumed by the sword , and by famine  ; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven , and for the beasts of the earth .
translation.kha: Kin ïap na ki jingpang bashyrkhei , bad ym don mano mano ba ïambriew na ka bynta jong ki lane tep ïa ki . Ki met jong ki kin long kum ki kynton sboh halor ka khyndew . Kin shah pynïap ha ka thma lane ïap na ka jingïapthngan , bad ki met jong ki kin long ki jingbam ïa ki sim bad ïa ki mradkhlaw .

translation.en: And she went , and sat her down over against him a good way off , as it were a bowshot : for she said , Let me not see the death of the child . And she sat over against him , and lift up her voice , and wept .
translation.kha: bad ïa lade ka leit shong kumba shispah mitar na kata ka jaka . Ka ong ha lade ,  Ngam lah shah ban ïohi ïa la u khun ba u ïap .  Katba ka dang shong hangta , ka la sdang ban ïam .
U la ïam ïa nga sha ka jaka rung sha ka phyllaw kiba shabar bad pyn-i ïa at ïa ka thliew ha ka kynroh .
translation.en: And he brought me to the door of the court  ; and when I looked , behold a hole in the wall .
Do not err , my beloved brethren .
translation.kha: To wat shah shukor , phi ki parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga !

Haba me la dep ïa kata , phai pyrshing pat sha ka kyrkhu kamon jong me bad shahshitom sawphew sngi namar ki kam bymshemphang ka ïingjaiñ Judah — kawei ka sngi namar kawei kawei ka snam jong ka jingshah pynïapmat jong ki .
translation.en: And when thou hast accomplished them , lie again on thy right side , and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days : I have appointed thee each day for a year .

translation.kha: Haba u la poi hangta , u la khiat jam da ka jingkhmih lyngki , Ko Daniel , u shakri jong U Blei uba im ! Hato U Blei uba me shakri khih kor katta u la lah mo ban pyllait im ïa me na ki sing ?
translation.en: And when he came to the den , he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel : and the king spake and said to Daniel , O Daniel , servant of the living God , is thy God , whom thou servest continually , able to deliver thee from the lions ?
And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea , they were troubled , saying , It is a spirit  ; and they cried out for fear .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohi ba u ïaid halor ka um , ki la sngewshyrkhei .  Ka dei ka rngai !  ki la ong , bad ki la lynñiar da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: Now I will come unto you , when I shall pass through Macedonia : for I do pass through Macedonia .
translation.kha: Ngan sa wan sha phi hadien ba nga la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Makedonia — naba nga dei ban leit lyngba ka Makedonia .

translation.en: And Ben–hadad said unto him , The cities , which my father took from thy father , I will restore  ; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus , as my father made in Samaria . Then said Ahab , I will send thee away with this covenant . So he made a covenant with him , and sent him away .
translation.kha: U Benhadad u ong ïa u ,  Ngan ai pat ha phi ïa ki shnong ba u kpa jong nga u la shim na u kpa jong phi , bad phi lah ban tei ka jaka khaïi na ka bynta ïa lade ha Damaskos , kumba u kpa jong nga u leh ha Samaria .  U Ahab u jubab ,  Halor kine ki kyndon , te ngan pyllait ïa phi .  U ïateh kular bad u bad u pyllait noh ïa u ban leit .

Hynrei u ïabuaid u jubab , I pa jong pa’ i tip bha katno ba phi sngewieit ïa nga , bad i la rai ba phin ym tip ïa kaei ba i thmu ban leh , namar ba phna sa sngewkthang eh . Nga smam ha phi da U Trai naba im ba nga don sa tang shisien jam na ka jingïap !
translation.en: And David sware moreover , and said , Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes  ; and he saith , Let not Jonathan know this , lest he be grieved : but truly as the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , there is but a step between me and death .
Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye are as graves which appear not , and the men that walk over them are not aware of them .
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ! Phi long kum ki lum jingtep ki bym don dien shuh ha kaba ki briew ki ïaid nalor khlem tip ïa ka .

Kumta u Joab u la leit sha u Syiem Dabid bad u ïathmu ha u ïa kaei kaba u Amraphel u la ong . U syiem u la phah khot ïa u Abimael ; uba la leit sha u bad u dem ngon ha khyndew ha khmat jong u . U syiem u la pdiang sngewbha ïa u da ka jingdoh .
translation.en: So Joab came to the king , and told him : and when he had called for Absalom , he came to the king , and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king : and the king kissed Absalom .

translation.kha: Bad lada ïa U Khrist ym shym la pynmihpat , te ka jingkyntait jong phira kam long kaba shispah sad phi dang don hi ha ki pop jong phi .
translation.en: And if Christ be not raised , your faith is vain ; ye are yet in your sins .
I sent Moses also and Aaron , and I plagued Egypt , according to that which I did among them : and afterward I brought you out .
translation.kha: Kham hadien , nga la phah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad nga la wallam ka jingjynjar bakhraw halor ka Ijipt .

translation.en: And when he was come into the ship , he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kiew halor ka lieng , uta u briew uba shongksuid u la kyrpad ïa u ,  Shah ïa nga ban leit bad me !
Ko ki paralok ba-ieit , ïada kane ka long kumno U Blei u la ieit ïa im , te ma ngi , ngi dei ban ïa-ieit iwei ïa uwei pat .
translation.en: Beloved , if God so loved us , we ought also to love one another .

translation.kha: haduh ar snem ngan wallam pat sha kñia ka khak ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ka Templ ka u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la rah sha Babilon .
translation.en: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the  Lord s  house , that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place , and carried them to Babylon :

translation.kha: ka kynthei kiba jylliew kaba ïew banbeiñ shongkurim , bad ka sakhrai haba ka ïoh ban shim ïa ka jaka ka kynrad jong ka .
translation.en: For an odious woman when she is married  ; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress .
Because I will publish the name of the  Lord  : ascribe ye greatness unto our God .
translation.kha: Ngan ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai  , bad ki briew jong u kin pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .
Ka la leit Sha ïing bad ka la shem ïa ka khun jong ka ba ka thiah ha ka jingïathoh ; u ksiew u la lah mihnoh shisha na ka .
translation.en: And when she was come to her house , she found the devil gone out , and her daughter laid upon the bed .

translation.kha: Katba u Petros u dang sngewlyngngoh shaphang ka jingmut jyllang ken ka jingïohipaw , ki rangbah Kiba u Kornelios u la phah ki la thup hangtei ka ïing jong u Simon ka don , bad mynta ki la ainong ha khmat ka khyrdop .
translation.en: Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean , behold , the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon s house , and stood before the gate ,

translation.kha: Lada u sdie jong phi u luin bad phim shym shut pynnep ïa u , phi hap ban Trei kham tyngeh ïa-ban pyndonkam ïa u . Ka long kiba kham don jingmut don pynkhreh lypa .
translation.en: If the iron be blunt , and he do not whet the edge , then must he put to more strength : but wisdom is profitable to direct .
Incline thine ear , O  Lord  , and hear  ; open thine eyes , O  Lord  , and see : and hear all the words of Sennacherib , which hath sent to reproach the living God .
translation.kha: Mynta , A  Trai  , to sngap ïa ngi bad to peit ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ngi . To shahshkor ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba u Sennakherib u la ong ban ñiewbeiñ ïa me , U Blei ba-im .
Ki hima kiba khlieh ki don ha ka jingkhynwin ha ka jingsawa kumta ka jingkyrhuh jongngi ka duriaw , kum ka jingphaloh jong ki jingsat phriang bakha khrawburom .
translation.en: Woe to the multitude of many people , which make a noise like the noise of the seas  ; and to the rushing of nations , that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters !
And he took away the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house  ; he even took away all : and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made .
translation.kha: U shim lut ïa baroh ki jingkynshew spah kiba don ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem , kiba kynthup ïa ki stieh ksiar kiba u Solomon u la thaw .

U Blei kaba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap ïa U Jisu umbah U Trai jong ngi , naba long u Nongaplangbrot uba khraw jong ki langbrot da kata ka jingïap ha kaba la kñia ïa u , da kaba la pynskhem ïa ka jutang bymjukut . To ai ba U Blei ka jingsuk un pyndap ïa phi da kaei kaei kaba bha baroh kaba phi donkam khnam ban leh ïa ka mon jong u , bad ai ba ma u , da U Jisu khriat , un bor ha ngi ïa kaei kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa u . Bad ha U Khrist to long ka burom junom la junom , Adummim .
translation.en: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will , working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight , through Jesus Christ  ; to whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
Harden not your heart , as in the provocation , and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness :
translation.kha: Wat long uba mutlop , kumba ki kpa tymmen ki la long ha Meribah , kumba ki la long ha kato ka sngi ha ka ri shyiap ha Massah .

translation.en: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams  horns before the ark of the  Lord  went on continually , and blew with the trumpets : and the armed men went before them  ; but the rearward came after the ark of the  Lord  , the priests going on , and blowing with the trumpets .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la khie dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , bad ha ka sien kaba ar ki lyngdoh bad ki shipai ki la ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah ha kajuh ka rukom kumba ki la leh ha ka sngi kaba la dep : nyngkong , ka kynhun shipai na sha khmat ; hadien kata , ki hynñiew ngut ki lyngdoh kiba put ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki turoi ; nangta , ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ; bad khatduh , ka kynhun shipai na shadien . Ha ki por baroh la put ïa ki turoi .

translation.en: And there was a young man out of Beth–lehem–judah of the family of Judah , who was a Levite , and he sojourned there .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka por la don uwei u samla Lebi uba ju sah ha nongrit Bethlehem kaba ha Judah .

translation.en: And every one that was in distress , and every one that was in debt , and every one that was discontented , gathered themselves unto him  ; and he became a captain over them : and there were with him about four hundred men .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la shah banbeiñ lane kiba dap ram lane kiba kthang mynsiem ki la leit sha u , baroh ki don kumba sawspah ngut ki rangbah , bad u kylla long u nongïalam jong ki .
u la ong , Ha khmih’ katno khraw ka Babilon ka long ! Nga la tei ïa ka kum ka nongbah jong nga ban pyn-i ïa ka kuna bad ka jingkhlaiñ Jong nga , ka burom jong nga bad ka jingong syiem Jong nga .
translation.en: The king spake , and said , Is not this great Babylon , that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power , and for the honour of my majesty ?

translation.kha: Kine ki san ngut ki syiem ki la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad ki la ïasoh lang kum kawei ka kynhun shipai ha ka Them Siddim , kaba long Myntan ka Duriaw Baïap .
translation.en: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim , which is the salt sea .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U Trai un ong shaphang ka bri shaïong ba-itynnat jong u ,
translation.en: In that day sing ye unto her , A vineyard of red wine .

translation.kha: Slem katno u la long kumne ? U Jisu u la kylli ïa u kpa jong u . Nahath ba u ïalang rit , u la Joab .
translation.en: And he asked his father ,  How long is it ago since this came unto him ?  And he said , Of a child .

translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ka ri ki Amor baroh naduh Arnon shaphang shathie haduh Jabbok shang shat , bad naduh ri shyiap Shaphan mihngi haduh Jordan shaphang sepngi .
translation.en: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites , from Arnon even unto Jabbok , and from the wilderness even unto Jordan .

translation.kha: Ïa ka histori jong u syiem Dabid naduh kaba sdang haduh ka kut la buh jingkhot ha ki kot buh jingkynmaw jong ki per ngut ki nongïathuhlypa , u Samuel , u Nathan , bad u Gad .
translation.en: Now the acts of David the king , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of Samuel the seer , and in the book of Nathan the prophet , and in the book of Gad the seer ,

translation.kha: Mynta ha kaba ïathuh , ha ka snem kabu khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Josaïah , la rakhe ïa ka Jingïohipaw Niam Ka jinglait ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah , wherein this passover was holden to the  Lord  in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Nangta u la jaw ha Palat sanspah ngut ki nongbud jongngi u ha kajuh ka por , kiba Kham bun na ki , ki dang im , wiat la katto katne ngut ki la ïap .
translation.en: After that , he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once ; of whom the greater part remain unto this present , but some are fallen asleep .

translation.kha: U Abraham u la ïapom ha ka rta ba la ih bha haba u la dap shispah hynñiewphew sian snem ka rta .
translation.en: Then Abraham gave up the ghost , and died in a good old age , an old man , and full of years  ; and was gathered to his people .

translation.kha: Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la jop , U la biah noh ïa ki ksuid tang namar ba u radbah Jong ki , u Beelsebul u ai bor ïa u Ban leh kumjuh .
translation.en: But when the Pharisees heard it , they said , This fellow doth not cast out devils , but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils .
Wherefore Hanun took David s servants , and shaved them , and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks , and sent them away .
translation.kha: U Hanun u kem ïa ki nonglamktien jong u Dabid bad u khi ïa ki  ñiuhtmoh jong ki , bad ot ïa ki jaiñphong jong ki ha ki syngkai , bad phah noh ïa ki .
Kumta u Hephsibah u phad shim ei ïa ka na u thngan jong ka , u Paltiel u khun jong u lehse .
translation.en: And Ish–bosheth sent , and took her from her husband , even from Phaltiel the son of Laish .
I say unto thee , Arise , and take up thy bed , and go thy way into thine house .
translation.kha: Nga ong ïa me , to ïeng , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad to leit noh sha ïing !

translation.en: Behold , my terror shall not make thee afraid , neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee .
translation.kha: Te phim don daw ban sheptieng ïa nga ; ngan ym leh jubor ïa phi .

translation.en: That they do good , that they be rich in good works , ready to distribute , willing to communicate ;
translation.kha: To hukum ïa ki ba kin leh ïa kaba bha , ban man kyrhai ha ki kam babha , ban long kiba sbun bad kiba kloi ban ïasam bad kiwei .
Haba u bieit u rkhie , ka long kum ka jingsawa ki dieng shiah ha ka ngin . Kam don jingmut ei ei .
translation.en: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot , so is the laughter of the fool : this also is vanity .

translation.kha: myntri to iehnoh ïa nga marwei ban ïakhmih halor kito na ki briew jong nga kiba la ïap . Wat pyrshang ban pyntngen ïa nga .
translation.en: Therefore said I , Look away from me  ; I will weep bitterly , labour not to comfort me , because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people .
But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins ,  ( he saith to the sick of the palsy , )
translation.kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te ba U Khun U Briew u don ka bor ha ka pyrthei ban map ïa ki pop .  Kumta u la ong ha uta u briew ba la ïapshiliang ,

U briew uba la ïor ïa ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh u dei ban phong da ki jingtim , un ieh Khlem sad ïa la u shñiuh , un tip ïa la ka khmat naduh ki jingmong shyntur sharum , bad un pyrta , U bymkhuid , u bymkhuid !
translation.en: And the leper in whom the plague is , his clothes shall be rent , and his head bare , and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip , and shall cry , Unclean , unclean .

translation.kha: Nga la pisa bad nga la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang : ‘ Kin ym ïohrung da lili lei sha ka ri ha naba lang ai ha ki ïa ka jingjahthait !’
translation.en: So I sware in my wrath , They shall not enter into my rest . )

Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites , and of the priests , and of the chief of the fathers of Israel , for the judgment of the  Lord  , and for controversies , when they returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha Jerusalem , u Jehoshaphat u thung ïa ki Lebi , ki lyngdoh bad katto katne ki riewkhmat ka shnong kum ki nongbishar ha ki kam ba ïadei bad ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum U  Trai  lane ki jingïakajia ba dei ïa ka aiñ hapdeng ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah .
U Jonathan u ong , Ngan leh ïa kano kano kambah phi kwah .
translation.en: Then said Jonathan unto David , Whatsoever thy soul desireth , I will even do it for thee .
And he said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , There is no man that hath left house , or parents , or brethren , or wife , or children , for the kingdom of God s sake ,
translation.kha: Ho-oid ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  bad nga pynthikna ïa phi ba uno uno uba iehnoh ïa ka ïing lane ïa ka tnga lane ïa ki hynmen ki para lane ïa ki kmie ki kpa lane ïa ki khun na ka bynta ka Hima U Blei
Ar ngut ki kynthei kin ne ha ka jaka tylliat kput : Ïa kadei yn skhem noh , ïa kawei pat yn hynne sdien .
translation.en: Two women shall be grinding at the mill  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .

Also , thou son of man , the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses , and speak one to another , every one to his brother , saying , Come , I pray you , and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko khun u briew , ki briew jong me ki ïakren shaphang jong me haba ki ïakynduh hajan ki kynroh ka nongbah ne ha ki lynti hajan jingkhang ki ïing jong ki . Ki ïa-ong para ma ki , ‘ Ïa ngin ïaleit bad sngap ka ktien aïu kaba wan na U Trai mynta .’
Lada phi leh ïa kane , phin pynsngewbha ïa U Blei bad ïa u briew .
translation.en: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man .
I saw a dream which made me afraid , and the thoughts upon my bed and the visions of my head troubled me .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ïoh ka jingphohsniew kaba pynsheptieng bad nga la ïohi ki jingïohipaw kiba shyrkhei mynba nga dang ïohthiah .
Hynrei U Trai u la pynduna ïa ka jingjlan jong kita ki sngaid ; Lada um shym la leh kumta , yn ym don u ban lait im . Hynrei , na ka bynta ki briew ba la jied jong u , u la pynduna ïa kita ki sngi .
translation.en: And except that the Lord had shortened those days , no flesh should be saved : but for the elect s sake , whom he hath chosen , he hath shortened the days .
Jesus answered and said unto them ,  This is the work of God , that ye believe on him whom he hath sent .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban leh ka long ban ngeit ha uta ïa uba u la phah .

translation.en: And Tyre did build herself a strong hold , and heaped up silver as the dust , and fine gold as the mire of the streets .
translation.kha: Ka Tyros ka la tei ki kut na ka bynta ïa lade bad ka la kynton shibun eh ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba ka la kynrei kum ka tngit .
Haba ki la dep ïadei , ka jaka ha kiba ki la ïakynduh ka la khyndew . La pyndap ïa ki baroh da U Mynhyndai Bakhuid bad ki la sdang ba Pynbna ïa ka khohruh U Blei da ka jingshlur .
translation.en: And when they had prayed , the place was shaken where they were assembled together  ; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost , and they spake the word of God with boldness .

translation.kha: Te ki rangbah mana , ki rangbah synshar jong ki jait , ki nongïoh hukum jong ka kynran shipai , bad ki nongpynïaid ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u syep da la ka myn sngewbha ki ai
translation.en: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel , and the captains of thousands and of hundreds , with the rulers of the king s work , offered willingly ,

translation.kha: Pateng la pateng , ïa kane ka jingai kaba kyrpang dei baneh ai shat U Trai na u kpu ba phi shet .
translation.en: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the  Lord  an heave offering in your generations .

translation.kha: Nangta khie leit bad shim ïa u ïakhun masi uba la pynsngaid bha dara pynïap ïa u , bad to ngin ïalehkmen da ka jingkhawai !
translation.en: And bring hither the fatted calf , and kill it  ; and let us eat , and be merry :

translation.kha: Ko Moab , to kynjoh kum phai rkhiebeiñ ïa ki pyllut Israel ? phan la leh ïa ki Rumah ki la nangto ha ka kynhun ki nongput .
translation.en: For was not Israel a derision unto thee ? was he found among thieves ? for since thou spakest of him , thou skippedst for joy .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la ïathuh ïa kine ki ktien ha ki rangbah synshar ka Khmih Rom ; bad hajuh ki la iohnong ba u Apostol bad u Silas ki dei ki traishnong ka Hoham Ram , ki la sheptieng .
translation.en: And the serjeants told these words unto the magistrates : and they feared , when they heard that they were Romans .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih biang ïa tala ka prum ha ka snieh kaba hynñiew , bad lada kam pat plain lane ym don u sngewnguh uba lam stem ha ka , bad kam paw ruh ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka ,
translation.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague : and , behold , if the scall spread not , and there be in it no yellow hair , and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin  ;

translation.kha: Ki sakhi ki dei ban lynthem maw nyngkong , bad nangta khiew pat ki brup kin pynbud ïa ki , da kumta phin pynkhuid nep ïa kane ka jingbam napdeng jong phiah .
translation.en: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death , and afterward the hands of all the people . So thou shalt put the evil away from among you .
For though I be free from all men , yet have I made myself servant unto all , that I might gain the more .
translation.kha: Nga long u briew uba laitluid , ym u mraw jongno jongno ; hynrei nga pynlong ïa lade u mraw jong baroh khnang ba ngan jop katba lah ïa ki briew kiba bun .
Ha Kane ka rukom ngan pyn-i ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ba nga long uba khraw bad uba khiah . Kin sa tip , te , ba de long U Trai .
translation.en: Thus will I magnify myself , and sanctify myself  ; and I will be known in the eyes of many nations , and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba u rangbah shipai pynlang ki shipai kiba bad u , bakha la ïa-ap ïa U Jisu ki la ïoh ïa u jumai bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia , ki la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la ong , Da shisha u la long U Khun U Blei !
translation.en: Now when the centurion , and they that were with him , watching Jesus , saw the earthquake , and those things that were done , they feared greatly , saying , Truly this was the Son of God .

translation.kha: Ki Kmen ki kpa Jong u ki la jong ïa kane namar ba ki la pyrshing ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki ïew , kiba la lah mynjur lypa ba uno uno uba ong ba u kjit ba U Jisu u long U Messaïah un shad beh noh na ka synñiang .
translation.en: These words spake his parents , because they feared the Jews : for the Jews had agreed already , that if any man did confess that he was Christ , he should be put out of the synagogue .

translation.kha: U kyang , Ai ba U Blei un shoh ïalap ïa to lada u Elisha um shah khra khlei shuwa ba ka sngi kan khun !
translation.en: Then he said , God do so and more also to me , if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day .

translation.kha: Ki radbah lyngdoh ki la mudui ïa U Jisu shibun kiei kaei , kumta u Peleth u la kulai biang ïa u , Hato men ym jubab ? Sngap ïa ki jingmudui jong ki barabor !
translation.en: And Pilate asked him again , saying , Answerest thou nothing ? behold how many things they witness against thee .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ka dohnud bathymmai bad ka jingmut bathymmai . Ngi shim noh ïa ka nadong maw ba-mutlop bad nur ai ha ki ka dohnud bakohnguh .
translation.en: And I will give them one heart , and I will put a new spirit within you  ; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh , and will give them an heart of flesh :

translation.kha: hynriew kliar ka kassia , ( ïa kba la thew kat kum ka jingteh jong ka jaka kyntang ) . Bynrap sa saw litar ka umphniang Olib ,
translation.en: And of cassia five hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary , and of oil olive an hin :

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ba u Jonah u la pynlut lai sngi badno prie marwei hapoh u dohkha uba heh , kumta U u U Briew un pynlut lai sngi bad lai miet ha kiba jylliew jong ka khyndew .
translation.en: For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale s belly  ; so shall the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth .
When thou sittest to eat with a ruler , consider diligently what is before thee :
translation.kha: Haba phi shong bam bad u briew uba donburom , da buh jingmut ba u long uei .

translation.en: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child  ; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him .
translation.kha: Ki khynnah na la ka tynrai ki leh kiei kiei kiba ibieit , khlem sumar , hynrei ka jingsneng sympat kaba bha ka hikai ïa ki kumno ban long .

translation.en: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works : in doctrine shewing uncorruptness , gravity , sincerity ,
translation.kha: Ha kiei kiei baroh phi dei ban long ka nuksa jong ka jinglong babha . To long kiba minot bad kiba kitkhia ha ka jinghikai jong me .
Uta u briew u jubab , ‘ Da kumne ngan tip ba phim dei ki riewshukor , uwei na phi un sah bad nga ; ieh khawai pat kin leit put keiñ shuh la ki ba-ha-ïing kiba shngain , bad kin leit noh .
translation.en: And the man , the lord of the country , said unto us , Hereby shall I know that ye are true men  ; leave one of your brethren here with me , and take food for the famine of your households , and be gone :

translation.kha: Haba kita ki briew ki ïohi ba u syiem um shakor ïa ki , ki pyrta jam , Keiñ noh ïa u Dabid bad ka longïing jong u ! Ki la leh aïu na ka bynta jong sem ? Ko ki rangbah Israel , ïa ing ïalute noh sha la ïing ! Ai ba u Rehoboam un ïitkhmih hi na ka bynta ïa lat . Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïaleh pyrsad ,
translation.en: And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them , the people answered the king , saying , What portion have we in David ? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse : every man to your tents , O Israel : and now , David , see to thine own house . So all Israel went to their tents .
While as yet he had not made the earth , nor the fields , nor the highest part of the dust of the world .
translation.kha: shuwa ba U Blei un thaw ïa ka khyndew bad ïa ki pyntha jong ka , ne wat shi kham ka khyndew kaba nyngkong .

translation.en: And the cares of this world , and the deceitfulness of riches , and the lusts of other things entering in , choke the word , and it becometh unfruitful .
translation.kha: hynrei ki jingpynkhuslai jong kane ka jingim , ka jingieit ïa ka spah , bad baroh kiwei ki jait jingkwah ki tap bad kjap noh ïa ka khubor , bad kim seisoh satia .
U Jehoash u ïalam pat ïa ki shipai sha Jerusalem ha ka jingjop , namar U TRAI’ u la jop ïa ki nongshun jong ki .
translation.en: Then they returned , every man of Judah and Jerusalem , and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them , to go again to Jerusalem with joy  ; for the  Lord  had made them to rejoice over their enemies .
Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Jehoram u la long syiem haba u don laiphew ar snem ka rta , bad u synshar phra snem ha Jerusalem .

Lumlang ïa ki jingsdang jingem jong ki briew baroh kiba shong hangta bad kynton ïa ki ha ka madan shnong . Nangta thang ïa kata ka shnong malu ïa kata ka spah ka phew baroh kum ka jingsuh thang sha U Trai U Blang jong phoi . Ka dei ban sah jingdum ha ka jingjot bad ym dei ban Tei pat .
translation.en: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof , and shalt burn with fire the city , and all the spoil thereof every whit , for the  Lord  thy God : and it shall be an heap for ever  ; it shall not be built again .
Let your light so shine before men , that they may see your good works , and glorify your Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ka jingshai jong phi ka dei ban shai ha khmat ki briew , khnang ba kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba bha kiba phi leh bad ïaroh ïa u Kpa jong phi uba ha bneng .

translation.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils , by whom do your sons cast them out ? therefore shall they be your judges .
translation.kha: Lada kane ka long kumno ba nga beh noh ïa ki , da kumno ki nongbud jong phi ki beh noh ïa ki ? Ki nongbud jong phi hi ki pynshisha ba phi bakla !
Kine kiew kiei baroh ki long kum ki jingpang banyngkong jong ka jingsuh kha .
translation.en: All these are the beginning of sorrows .

translation.kha: U Saul u leit mareh mar shrong mala sa hajar ngut ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel sha ka ri khlaw Siph ban wad ïa u Dabid ,
translation.en: Then Saul arose , and went down to the wilderness of Ziph , having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him , to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph .

translation.kha: To ïadei ha U Bela ba phin ym hap ban phet noh ha ka por mong lane ha ka sngi Sabbaton !
translation.en: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter , neither on the sabbath day :
But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors , whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen , that I might be their God : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynthymmai ïa ka jutang ba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki mynba nga la pynpaw ïa la ka bor ha ki jaitbynriew baroh da kaba ïalam noh ïa la ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , khnang ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga lah ban long U Blei jong ki . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout , with the voice of the archangel , and with the trump of God : and the dead in Christ shall rise first :
translation.kha: Kan don ka jingpyrta da ka hukum , ka sur jong u angel rangbah , ka jingriew ka turoi jong U Blei , bad U Trai hi da lade un sa wan hiar na bneng . Kito kiba la ïap da kaba ngeit ha U Khrist kin ïamih pat shuwa ;
Nga la thngan , hynrei phim shym bsa ïa nga , nga la sliang , hyndai phim shyiap ai jingdih ïa sa ;
translation.en: For I was an hungred , and ye gave me no meat : I was thirsty , and ye gave me no drink :

Turn you , and take your journey , and go to the mount of the Amorites , and unto all the places nigh thereunto , in the plain , in the hills , and in the vale , and in the south , and by the sea side , to the land of the Canaanites , and unto Lebanon , unto the great river , the river Euphrates .
translation.kha: Lied noh ïa la ka dara bad ïaid shaphrang . Leit sha ri lum Amor bad sha ki jaka kiba markhap bad ka — sha ka Them Jordan , sha ki ri lum bad ri them , sha ka jaka kaba shathie bad sha ka rud duriaw Mediterranian . Leit sha ka ri Kanaan bad nangta sha lyndet ki lum Lebanon haduh ka wahbah Ïuphratis .

translation.en: And he wrought evil in the sight of the  Lord   ; but not like his father , and like his mother : for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made .
translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , hynrei um da sniew eh kat u kpa jong u , lane kat ka Jesebel , ka kmie jong u ; u la pynkhyllem ïa ka dur kaba u kpa jong u , u la thaw na ka bynta ban mane ïa u Baal .
