translation.kha: Nangta u Adonijah , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Haggith , u la leit sha ka Bathsheba , kaba dei ka kmie jong u Solomon .  Hato kane ka dei ka jingwan jngoh kaba sngewtynnat ?  Ka dei ,  u jubab ,

translation.en: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Judah  ; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba la tip bha ba ïa u la kha kum u dkhot jong ka jait Judah ; bad u Moses um shym kdew ïa kane ka jait haba u la kren shaphang ki lyngdoh .

translation.en: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses , they will faint by the way : for divers of them came from far .
translation.kha: Lada nga phah ïa ki sha ïing khlem bsa ïa ki , kin ïapler katba ki dang ïaid , namar katto katne ngut na ki , ki la wan na ka lynti bajngai .
U Omri u la ïan badno la thap ïa u ha Samaria , bad u Ahab u khun jngai u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jongno u .
translation.en: So Omri slept with his fathers , and was buried in Samaria : and Ahab his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: ka Khuid , ka Beneberak , ka Gathrimmon ,
translation.en: And Jehud , and Bene–berak , and Gath–rimmon ,
They have wandered as blind men in the streets , they have polluted themselves with blood , so that men could not touch their garments .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka ki la sakma lyngba ki lynti bah kum ki rangbah kiba matlah , kiba la bit da ka snam haduh katta katta ba ym don mano mano ban ktah ïa ki .

Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingtied u pyrthat sad ïa ka jingsait ka tari , bad ïohi ïa ka leilieh bad ïa uta u lum babha mih tnum , ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng bad ki la ïeng noh sha jngai .
translation.en: And all the people saw the thunderings , and the lightnings , and the noise of the trumpet , and the mountain smoking : and when the people saw it , they removed , and stood afar off .

translation.kha: Ki kyntien jong u Dabid ki la pynïoh ïa ka jingshaniah tylli jong baroh ki rangbah ka Judah , bad ki la phuh ktien sha u ïa-ban wan pei bad ki ngab synshar jong u baroh .
translation.en: And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah , even as the heart of one man  ; so that they sent this word unto the king , Return thou , and all thy servants .
When he was set down on the judgment seat , his wife sent unto him , saying , Have thou nothing to do with that just man : for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him .
translation.kha: Katba u Pilat u dang shong ha ka kamra ïingbishar , ka tnga jong u ka la phah khubor sha u :  Wat leh ei ei ïa uta u briew uba lui lui , namar ba ha ka jingphohsniew hynne mynmiet nga la shahshitom shikatdei eh na ka bynta jong u .

Ka la long ka ïingjaiñ jong u blei Molekh naba phi la biah , bad ka dur jong u Rephan , u blei khlur jong phi ; ki la Long ki bleithaw kiba phi la thaw ïa ka ban mane . Bad kumta ngan phah ïa phi sha ka jinglongmraw sha pyllait ka Baal .’
translation.en: Yea , ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch , and the star of your god Remphan , figures which ye made to worship them : and I will carry you away beyond Babylon .

translation.kha: kata ka kynthei ka saw sha u , malade haba ka ïohi ba u la sheptieng , kumta ka ainong ha u , Sngewbha kynrad , nga la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim da kaba leh ïa kaei ba phi ong .
translation.en: And the woman came unto Saul , and saw that he was sore troubled , and said unto him , Behold , thine handmaid hath obeyed thy voice , and I have put my life in my hand , and have hearkened unto thy words which thou spakest unto me .
I have given them thy word  ; and the world hath hated them , because they are not of the world , even as I am not of the world .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor jong me , bad ka pyrthei ka la shun ïa ki , namar ba kim dei jong kane ka pyrthei , kumba nga ruh ngam dei na kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: They answering said , John the Baptist  ; but some say , Elias  ; and others say , that one of the old prophets is risen again .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki ong ba me dei u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ,  ki la jubab .  Kiwei pat ki ong ba me dei u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ong ba me dei uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa na mynbarim uba la mihpat .
Ngan jied ïa u lyngdoh u pun kohnguh ïa nga mala leh ïa sakma baroh kaba nga kwah ïa u . Ngan ai ha u ki khun ki ksiew ki Ban ïai shakri ha khmat u syier uba la jied jongu nga .
translation.en: And I will raise me up a faithful priest , that shall do according to that which is in mine heart and in my mind : and I will build him a sure house  ; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever .

translation.kha: Ki ïa-pynïap uwei ïa uwei pat : Bakhuid , Bakhuid , Bakhuid ! U Trai borabor Bahok u long uba khuid ! Ka burom jong u ka pyndap ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And one cried unto another , and said , Holy , holy , holy , is the  Lord  of hosts : the whole earth is full of his glory .

translation.kha: Um pynsting noh ïa u kew da katba peh palat ïa u , bad u tip kumno ban ïuh ïa u da kaba pynïaid ïa ka kali diengïap shalor jong u khlem pynshlur ino ïa ki symbai .
translation.en: Bread corn is bruised  ; because he will not ever be threshing it , nor break it with the wheel of his cart , nor bruise it with his horsemen .

translation.kha: Haba nga lyng-a bad khuslai , me pyntngen bad pynbunkam ïa nga .
translation.en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul .
And I will walk among you , and will be your God , and ye shall be my people .
translation.kha: Ngan long ryngkat bad phi ; ngan long U Blei jong phi , bad phin long ki briew jong nga .
Ha kane ka rukom , phin ïoh ïa ka jingñiewkor jrong kito ki bym pat ngeit , malade phim donkam ba shynriah hano hano na ka bynta kaei kaba phi donkam .
translation.en: That ye may walk honestly toward them that are without , and that ye may have lack of nothing .
And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish : and they made the ships in Ezion–geber .
translation.kha: Ha ka kadlieng Esiongeber ki thaw ïa ki liengbah ïaid duriaw .

Hynrei phim im kumba ka jingsliang ba kynja doh jong phi ka ong ïa phi ban leh ; pynban , phi im kumba U Mynsiem u ong ïa phi ban leh — lada , shisha , U Mynsiem U Blei u don ioh jong phi! . Uno uno u bih don ïa U Mynsiem jong U Khrist , um long u jong u .
translation.en: But ye are not in the flesh , but in the Spirit , if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you . Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ , he is none of his .
Thou hast granted me life and favour , and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit .
translation.kha: Me la ai ha nga ïa ka jingim bad ka jingieit baïaineh , bad ka jingsumar sukher jong me ka ri pynim ïa nga .

translation.en: Before him went the pestilence , and burning coals went forth at his feet .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ka jingpang ha shuwa jong u bad hukum ba ka jingïap kan bud ïa u .

translation.en: But the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them , and then shall they fast in those days .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka sngi kan poi haba ïa u nongleitkurim yn shim noh na ki , bad kumta kin sa shahjingit .

translation.en: So Manasseh slept with his fathers , and they buried him in his own house : and Amon his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Manasseh u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem , bad u Amon u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
U briew u bym ia ïoh rupa ne ksiar u jied da ka dieng ka ban ym pyut . U shem ïa u nongtrei Dieng batbit ban shna ïa ka dur ka Ban ym kyllon .
translation.en: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot  ; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image , that shall not be moved .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingkhlaiñ Jong ka Moab la kheit noh ; ïa ka bor jong ka la pynjot . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: The horn of Moab is cut off , and his arm is broken , saith the  Lord .
And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle s son , that was in Anathoth , and weighed him the money , even seventeen shekels of silver .
translation.kha: Nga la thied ïa ka lyngkha na u Hanamel bad nga thew ïa ka pisa na ka bynta jong u ; ka shongdor khathynñiew lyngkhot ki sbai rupa .

Nga kwah don ïakynduh ïa phi ha ka jingsait lynti artat jong nga sha Spain , bad ba phin ïarap ïa nga ha ka jingleit jong nga shata , shadien ba nga la sngewhun ban kamar-tama shipor ha ka jingainong khmih ïa phi .
translation.en: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain , I will come to you : for I trust to see you in my journey , and to be brought on my way thitherward by you , if first I be somewhat filled with your company .
Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age  ; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women .
translation.kha: U Abraham bad ka Sarah ki la tymmen bha , bad ka Sarah ruh ka la palat ïa ka por ban dang ïoh khun .
Ka thain ki jaiñspong bad ki jingpanpoh bad ka die ïa ki ha ki nongkhaïi .
translation.en: She maketh fine linen , and selleth it  ; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant .

translation.kha: Mynta ngan wallam pat ïa ki na ki jaka na kiba ki la shah die . Ngan leh ïa phi ïa kaei naba phi la leh ïa ki .
translation.en: Behold , I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them , and will return your recompence upon your own head :
Hearing of thy love and faith , which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus , and toward all saints  ;
translation.kha: Naba nga ïohsngew shaphang ka jingieit jong me ïa ki briew U Blei baroh bad ïa ka jingngeit kaba me don ha U Trai Jisu .
Ngan pynjot ïa kito bakha la phai lyndet sad ki bym stem sha ïa nga , kito ki bym shym wan sha nga , lane kylli na to ban kiaw lynti ïa ki .
translation.en: And them that are turned back from the  Lord   ; and those that have not sought the  Lord  , nor enquired for him .

translation.kha: To ïaphai iwei ïa iwei da ka jingïadoh parabangeit . Baroh ki balang jong U Khrist ki phah ki jingkhublei jong ki ïa phi .
translation.en: Salute one another with an holy kiss . The churches of Christ salute you .
The son of Amariah , the son of Azariah , the son of Meraioth ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Amaraïah , u khun jong u Asaraïah , u khun jong u Meraïoth ,

translation.en: Him would Paul have to go forth with him  ; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters : for they knew all that his father was a Greek .
translation.kha: U Paul u la kwah ban ïalam bad u ïa u Timothi , kumta u la otsher ïa u . U la leh kumta namar baroh ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha kita ki jaka ki tip ba u kpa jong u Timothi u long u Grik .
‘ Nga longsyiem U Blei jongngi ki kpa tymmen jong me , U Blei jong u Amraphel , u Asekah bad u Jakob .’ U Moses u la khñiot da ka jingsheptieng bad um shyiap la nud shun peit .
translation.en: Saying , I am the God of thy fathers , the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . Then Moses trembled , and durst not behold .

translation.kha: Ka Lehse ka jubab , Hato pham pat sngew ba phasi la knieh noh ïa u tnga jong nga ? myntri pat pha pyrshang ban shim sa ïa ki mandriek jong u khun jong nga . Ka Rakhel ka ong , Lada phan ai ïa nga ïa ki mandriek jrong u khun Jong pha , pha lah ban thiaw bad u Joab mynta ka miet .
translation.en: And she said unto her , Is it a small matter that thou hast taken my husband ? and wouldest thou take away my son s mandrakes also ? And Rachel said , Therefore he shall lie with thee to night for thy son s mandrakes .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïai-ong , Sumar ; wat shuh shukor . Ibbah bun ki rangbah , kiba kam ba ki kren na ka bynta jong nga , keiñ wan bad ong , ‘ Nga long ma u !’ bad , ‘ Ka por ka la poi !’ Hynrei wat stem ïa ki .
translation.en: And he said ,  Take heed that ye be not deceived : for many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and the time draweth near : go ye not therefore after them .
Wherefore , brethren , look ye out among you seven men of honest report , full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom , whom we may appoint over this business .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko hynmen ko para , to jied hynñiew ngut ki rangbah napdeng jong phi ïa kiba la ithuh ba ki long kiba dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ka jingstad , bad ngin buh ïa ki ban khmih ïa kane ka kam .

phin ong ha U Trai U balui jong phi , ‘ Ngam shym pynsah ei ei shuh ha ïing na kata kaba nga la lbong kyrpang ; la la ai ïa ka ha ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , kumba me la hukum ïa nga . Ngam shym la leh palat jlan leh klet ïa ki hukum jngai me ibha ïadei bun kawei na ki shiphew .
translation.en: Then thou shalt say before the  Lord  thy God , I have brought away the hallowed things out of mine house , and also have given them unto the Levite , and unto the stranger , to the fatherless , and to the widow , according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me : I have not transgressed thy commandments , neither have I forgotten them :
Now there were with us seven brethren : and the first , when he had married a wife , deceased , and , having no issue , left his wife unto his brother :
translation.kha: Mynta , la don hynñiew ngut ki shynrang ba shi para kiba la ju shong ju sah hangne . Uba heh duh u la shongkurim bad u la ïap khlem don khun , kumta u la iehnoh ïa ka tnga jong u ha la u jong u para .
Ki nongsynshar jngai ki Jiw , pynban , Ki mon shun ngeit ba une u briew u la erlangthari uba matlah bad mynta u la lah ban imat pat , kad ynda ki la khot ïa ki kmie ki kpa jong u sad kylli na ki ,
translation.en: But the Jews did not believe concerning him , that he had been blind , and received his sight , until they called the parents of him that had received his sight .

translation.kha: ka sa long ka sngi kaba dum bad kaba pynlong jingkhuslai , ka sngi kaba ïong malu ba-dum lyoh . Ka kynhun bakhraw jrong ki puit ka tur kum ka jingdum kaba pyiar halor ki lumbah . Ym ju ba-don mynno mynshem ruh kum kan , bad yn ym don shuh Lano laiñ ruh .
translation.en: A day of darkness and of gloominess , a day of clouds and of thick darkness , as the morning spread upon the mountains : a great people and a strong  ; there hath not been ever the like , neither shall be any more after it , even to the years of many generations .

And they sent out unto him their disciples with the Herodians , saying , Master , we know that thou art true , and teachest the way of God in truth , neither carest thou for any man : for thou regardest not the person of men .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la phah sha u katto katne ngut na ki synran jong ki bad katto katne ngut ki dkhot jong ka kynhun u Herod .  Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  ngi tip ba me ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha . Me hikai ïa ka jingshisha shaphang ka mon U Blei na ka bynta u briew , khlem da khuslai shaphang kaei kaba ki briew ki pyrkhat , namar ba mem pyrkhat ïa ka kyrdan jongno jongno .
Hato me la kloi ban ai ïa ka jingrai hajir jong ki , ko khup u briew ? Te to leh kumta . Pynkynmaw ïa ki shaphang kaei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki kpa jong ki , ki la leh .
translation.en: Wilt thou judge them , son of man , wilt thou judge them ? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers :

translation.kha: ki Arad , ki Shemeber , bad ki Hamath . Ki jait baphylla bapher jong ki jait Kanaan ki la saphriang kylleng kylleng ,
translation.en: And the Arvadite , and the Zemarite , and the Hamathite : and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad .

translation.kha: Ki lumbah bad ki lumrit ki lah baneh twa , hynrei ka jingieit jongno nga ïa phad kan ym kut noh ; sam pynneh junom ïa la ka kular jong ka jinglah . Kumta te ong U Trai umbah ainguh ïa pha .
translation.en: For the mountains shall depart , and the hills be removed  ; but my kindness shall not depart from thee , neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed , saith the  Lord  that hath mercy on thee .

translation.kha: ka kynthei kaba ijli kaba ïoh ban shongkurim , bad ka shakri haba ka ïoh ban shim ïa ka jaka ka kynrad jong ka .
translation.en: For an odious woman when she is married  ; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress .

translation.kha: Ieh ïa ka kumba ka longkmie , u Josaïah u hukum . Ïa ki shyieng jong u ym Dei ngab pynkhih . Kumta ïa ki shyieng jngai u , ym shym la pynkhih , lymne jong tun ki jongnga u nongïathuhlypa ibha la wan na Samaria .
translation.en: And he said , Let him alone  ; let no man move his bones . So they let his bones alone , with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaban lai jong ka jingshah jingit , ka Esther ka rupa ïa ki jingriam syiem jngai ka bad ka leit bad ïing ha ka phyllaw ba kham shapoh ka ïingsyiem , kaban phai khmat sha ka sharum ba don ka khiat syiem . U syiem u don hapoh , u shong halor ka khet syiem , da kaba phai khmat sha ka khyrdop .
translation.en: Now it came to pass on the third day , that Esther put on her royal apparel , and stood in the inner court of the king s house , over against the king s house : and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house , over against the gate of the house .

translation.kha: Ki wad jingïarap , hynrei ym don kiba pyllun im ïa ki ; ki khot kyrpad ïa U Trai , hynrei um jubab .
translation.en: They looked , but there was none to save  ; even unto the  Lord  , but he answered them not .

translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u la pyndonnam da ka jingpyntrei jubor ban tei ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , ban pyndap khihwin ïa ka jaka ha ka phang mihngi jong ka nongbah , bad ban shna ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah . U la pyndonkam ruh ïa ka , na ka bynda ban tei patan ïa ki nongbah Hasor , Megiddo bad Geser .
translation.en: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised  ; for to build the house of the  Lord  , and his own house , and Millo , and the wall of Jerusalem , and Hazor , and Megiddo , and Gezer .

translation.kha: Um khuslai lane pyrshing ; u thikna ban ïohi ba ki nongshun jong u ki jaboh .
translation.en: His heart is established , he shall not be afraid , until he see his desire upon his enemies .

translation.kha: Na u Paul , u nongshniah byndi na ka bynta U Khrist Jisu , bad na u TIMOTHI u para jong Ngi — Ha u Philemon , u paw jong ngi bad u para ba-ïatrei len ,
translation.en: Paul , a prisoner of Jesus Christ , and Timothy our brother , unto Philemon our dearly beloved , and fellowlabourer ,
And makest men as the fishes of the sea , as the creeping things , that have no ruler over them ?
translation.kha: Kumno me lah ban pynlong ïa ki briew kum ka dohkha lane kum ka kynhun ki khñiang ki bym don nongsynshar ban ïalam ïa ki ?
Nga la soi bad shon muhor ïa ka dulir , bad la sakhi ïa ka , bad la thew ïa ka pud ha ka tarajur .
translation.en: And I subscribed the evidence , and sealed it , and took witnesses , and weighed him the money in the balances .

translation.kha: ka Kinah , ka Dimonah , ka Adadah ,
translation.en: And Kinah , and Dimonah , and Adadah ,

translation.kha: Neng jingsakhi borabor ïa U Blei Jong nga na ka bynta Jong phi namar kata ka jingaiei ïa kaba u la ai ha Phi da U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: I thank my God always on your behalf , for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ ;

translation.kha: Ïa ki jingleh tiengburom yn ym ïohsngew shuh , ka jingot kan ym don shuh hapoh ki pud jongu pha ; ngan ïaduna bad kyrshan ïa Phah Kum ka kynriah : Phan ïaroh ïa nga namar nga la pyllait ïa pha .
translation.en: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land , wasting nor destruction within thy borders  ; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation , and thy gates Praise .

translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u la lumlang ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh , u pynpeit ïa ki ha ki kynum kiba sawar ngut bad kiba shispah ngut , bad u buh ki rangbah pyndum ban ai praw ïa ki .
translation.en: And David numbered the people that were with him , and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them .

translation.kha: Baroh kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im , ki don mar hynriew tylli ki thapniang , bad ïa ki la tap da ki khmih , shapoh sad shabar . Mynmiet bad mynmiet kim ju sangeh noh na kaba rwai : Bakhuid , bakmen , bakhuid , long U tharai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , Uba la long , uba un-long bad u ban sa wan .
translation.en: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him  ; and they were full of eyes within : and they rest not day and night , saying , Holy , holy , holy , Lord God Almighty , which was , and is , and is to come .

translation.kha: Ha ka Por ba u Jehoram u synshar , ka Edom ka ainong ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Judah , bad ka la kylla lama ka ha-sem kaba laitluid .
translation.en: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah , and made a king over themselves .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka Judah bad Israel kiba roi kyrhai , bad ngan pynlong pateng ïa ki Rumah mynshuwa .
translation.en: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return , and will build them , as at the first .

translation.kha: Kane ka longsyiem ka jingpynïasoh kaba na la ïoh , ong u syep Nebukhadnessar . Mynta , ko Belteshassar , ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka . Ym don man mane na ki nongai jingmut na ka ïinglieng jong nga kiba lah ïa-ban ïathuh ha nga , hynrei me lah , namar ba u mynsiem jongno ki beit bakhuid u don hapoh jong me .
translation.en: This dream I king Nebuchadnezzar have seen . Now thou , O Belteshazzar , declare the interpretation thereof , forasmuch as all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known unto me the interpretation : but thou art able  ; for the spirit of the holy gods is in thee .

translation.kha: bad u la buh ïa ka ha ka jingtep jong u hi , ïa kaweh u dang phah tih shen na u mawsiang . Nangta u la pyntyllun ïa u Maw uba heh na khmat ka jaka rung sha ka jingtep bad u la leit noh .
translation.en: And laid it in his own new tomb , which he had hewn out in the rock : and he rolled a great stone to the door of the sepulchre , and departed .
And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau  ; and the kingdom shall be the  Lord s .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah nongjop jong ka Jerusalem kin tur ïaleh ïa ka Edom bad kin synshar halor jong ka . Bad U  Trai  da lade hi un long u Syiem .
Ka pynkyndit ia nga .
translation.en: It took me by surprise .

Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth , but hast fretted me in all these things  ; behold , therefore I also will recompense thy way upon thine head , saith the Lord  God  : and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations .
translation.kha: Pha la klet kumno nga la leh ïa pha mynba pha dang samla , bad pha la pynbitar ïa nga da kiei kiei baroh kiba pha la leh . Dei kata keiñ balei ba nga la pynlong ïa pha ban shah na ka bynta jong ki baroh . Balei pha bynrap ïa ka jingawria jakhlia ha baroh kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba pha la leh ?  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: And they laid their hands on him , and took him .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kem ïa U Jisu bad ki la batskhem ïa u .

translation.en: And ye shall take a bunch of hyssop , and dip it in the blood that is in the basin , and strike the lintel and the two side posts with the blood that is in the basin  ; and none of you shall go out at the door of his house until the morning .

translation.kha: bad nga la pyndap ïa u da ka bor jong nga . Nga la ai ha u ka jingshemphang , ka jingtbit bad ka jingnang ban trei ïa ki jait kam baroh —

U Hanun bad ki nongshong shang jong ka nongbah Sanoah , ki tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Them . Ki pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pynïadait ïa ki nar-khang bad ïa ki jingkhang ka khyrdop , bad ki shna pynbha ïa ka kynroh kaba seraph sawphew lytar , haduh ka Khyrdop Synrum .
translation.en: The valley gate repaired Hanun , and the inhabitants of Zanoah  ; they built it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof , and a thousand cubits on the wall unto the dung gate .

translation.kha: Bad U Blei , uba lama ka tyllong Jong ka jingsuk jong ngi , shen un pynlwet ïa u Soitan hapoh ki kjat jngai pa’ . To ka jingaiei jong U Jehu uba U Tiras jongu moi kan long lem bad phi .
translation.en: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly . The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you . Amen .

translation.kha: Hadien la wan nang kita kyiuh pat ki theisotti . ‘ Ko kynrad , ko Kynrad ! to plie ïa ngi !’ ki la pyrta jam .
translation.en: Afterward came also the other virgins , saying , Lord , Lord , open to us .
And his mother answered and said , Not so  ; but he shall be called John .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka kmie ka la ong ,  Em ! Ka kyrteng jong u ka dei ban long u Ïoannis .
Ki briew’ ibha mutlop kin sdang ban long kiba stad haba kha ïa ki kada khlaw don long kum kiba la pynjuh .
translation.en: For vain man would be wise , though man be born like a wild ass s colt .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Ïoannis u la pyrshang ban pynkylla ïa ka jingmut jong u . Nga dei ban shah pynbuaid ha me , u Ïoanna u la ong , bad me la wei pynbah sha nga !
translation.en: But John forbad him , saying , I have need to be baptized of thee , and comest thou to me ?

translation.kha: Lymne ba ki lah shun ai ki jingpynshisha jong ki jingkynnoh jong ki kaba ki wallam mynta pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka mirr , la pynkyndeh ïa u Pharaoh , ïa ki rangbah pynsynjor jong u , nabar ïa baïar ki nong Joppa . Ka jinglynñiar kaba jar ka la don ha kliang ka ri Ijipt , namar ym shym don kawei ruh ka ïing kaba ym don u khun uba khyllem ïap .
translation.en: And Pharaoh rose up in the night , he , and all his servants , and all the Egyptians  ; and there was a great cry in Egypt  ; for there was not a house where there was not one dead .
And Shaaraim , and Adithaim , and Gederah , and Gederothaim  ; fourteen cities with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Shaaraim , ka Adithaim , ka Gederah , bad ka Gederothaim : khatsaw tylli ki nongbah lem ruh bad ki nongrit kiba don sawdong jong ki .
U Lot u mih shabar , u da haneng tdam ïa ka jingkhang .
translation.en: And Lot went out at the door unto them , and shut the door after him ,
And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thine hand  ; and thou shalt have no more soothsayers :
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki jingleh myntor kiba phi pyndonkam bad ngan iehnoh ïa phi khlem ki nongkren byrtong .

translation.en: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island , and the satyr shall cry to his fellow  ; the screech owl also shall rest there , and find for herself a place of rest .
translation.kha: Ki mradkhlaw kin ïaid kai hangta , bad ki ksuid kin ïakhot para ma ki . U mrad kynsha ba shang mynmiet un wan hangta bad un wad jaka shongthait .
Naba u Ïoannis u long ita uba ka jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong : ‘ U Blei u la ong , ngan phad ïa u nongpynim ha shuwa jong me ban plie ka lynti na ka bynta jong me .’
translation.en: This is he , of whom it is written , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .

translation.kha: Kumta u leit shiah u Ishmael u khun jong u Abraham , bad u shongkurim ïa ka khun kynthei jong u , ka Mahalath , kambah long ka para jong u Nebaïoth .
translation.en: Then went Esau unto Ishmael , and took unto the wives which he had Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael Abraham s son , the sister of Nebaioth , to be his wife .
Then said Micah , Now know I that the  Lord  will do me good , seeing I have a Levite to my priest .
translation.kha: U Mikah u ong ,  Mynta ba nga la don u Lebi kum u lyngdoh jong nga , nga tip ba U  Trai  un sa pynmanbha ïa nga .
ha ka jingkhot kyrteng ïa ki shipai ym shym la don Uei shwa na Jabesh uba jubab .
translation.en: For the people were numbered , and , behold , there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead there .

translation.kha: Ki la saphriang kyllan ka pyrthei bad ki la kerkut ïa ka jaka shrah Gera jong ki briew jong U Blei bad ïa ka nongbam kaba u ieit . Hynrei ka ding ka la wan hiar na weng bad ka la pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: And they went up on the breadth of the earth , and compassed the camp of the saints about , and the beloved city : and fire came down from God out of heaven , and devoured them .

translation.kha: Haba u briew uba proh jingtem u wanrah ïa ka matsohlah pyrthuh ïa uba bieit , uba ngeit u shuh rkhie bad u hylla bad u tim .
translation.en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man , whether he rage or laugh , there is no rest .

translation.kha: u la pynïap ïa ki syiem kiba pynthnam ; ka jingieit jong u ka Neah bymngeit ;
translation.en: And slew famous kings : for his mercy endureth for ever :

translation.kha: Nangno u Elijah u Ong ha u Elisha , Mynta ap hangne ; U Trai u la hukum ïa nga ban leit sha ka wah Jordan . Hynrei u Elisha u jubab , Nga smai da ka jingshaniah skhem jong nga ha U Trai bad ha phi ba ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi . Kumta ki la leit ,
translation.en: And Elijah said unto him , Tarry , I pray thee , here  ; for the  Lord  hath sent me to Jordan . And he said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . And they two went on .

translation.kha: Mynta to rupa kiaw sha ki lumrit , pynïoh ïa ki dieng shna ïing , bad ti pat ïa ka Templ ; te ngan sngewbha ha ka malu ïa nga yn mane kumba ka dei .
translation.en: Go up to the mountain , and bring wood , and build the house  ; and I will take pleasure in it , and I will be glorified , saith the  Lord .
My kinsfolk have failed , and my familiar friends have forgotten me .
translation.kha: ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem bad ki paralok jong nga kim don shuh .
Kum ka erïong , U Blei u pynjot ïa ki ha ka jingbitar .
translation.en: By the blast of God they perish , and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed .

translation.kha: Kumba U Khun U Briew u long U Kyrpad jong ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath .

translation.kha: U Moses u la ai ha phi ïa ka Hukum , hato ym dei kumta ? Hynrei ym don utai na phi uba kohnguh ïa ka lawbah . Balei ba phi pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ?
translation.en: Did not Moses give you the law , and yet none of you keepeth the law ? Why go ye about to kill me ?

My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea : and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me , and will cause them to be discharged there , and thou shalt receive them : and thou shalt accomplish my desire , in giving food for my household .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong nga kin pynpoi ïa ki dieng tylli na Lebanon shathie sha ka duriaw bad kin teh lang ïa ki ha ki bur ban pynkie ïa ki sharum jong ka rud duriaw sha ka jaka kaba me jied . Hangta ki rangbah jong nga kin law ïa ki jingteh , bad ki rangbah jong me kin shimti ïa ki . Na ka liang jong me , nga kwah ïa me ban pynbiang jingbam ïa ki rangbah jong nga .

translation.en: I clothed thee also with broidered work , and shod thee with badgers  skin , and I girded thee about with fine linen , and I covered thee with silk .
translation.kha: Nga la pynphong jaiñ ïa pha ha ki jaiñ jynsur kiba la suh syntiew bad nga la ai ha pha ki juti na ki snieh kiba bha tam , ka jingteh khlieh linen bad ka tapmoh rusom .
Hynrei u Mysia u ong , Te balei Phi dang ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai mynta ? Phin ym jop !
translation.en: And Moses said , Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the  Lord  ? but it shall not prosper .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïong ïa kane bad nangta u pynbud , U paralok jong ngi u Lasaros u la ïohthiah , hynrei ngan kitei bad ngan kyrsiew noh ïa u .
translation.en: These things said he : and after that he saith unto them ,  Our friend Lazarus sleepeth  ; but I go , that I may awake him out of sleep .

translation.kha: To , ka jubab . len kren ha u syiem na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: And Bath–sheba said , Well  ; I will speak for thee unto the king .

translation.kha: Kumta ki Pharisi bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la lum ïa ka dorbar dara ki la ong , Ngin ïaleh kumno ? Peit ïa ki ïabam baroh kiba une u briew u la leh !
translation.en: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council , and said , What do we ? for this man doeth many miracles .

And there are also many other things which Jesus did , the which , if they should be written every one , I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written . Amen .
translation.kha: Mynta , don bun kiwei pat kiei kiei kiba U Jisu u la leh . Lada la thoh ïa ki baroh kawei pa kawei , nga tharai ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan ym ngiam jaka ïa ki kitab ha kiba yn thoh .
Ki leh kumba ki jingmong jong ki briew jong nga ki long tyngkan ki jingtrud . ‘ Baroh ka bit ka biang ,’ ki ong , haba barhem kam bit kam biang .
translation.en: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly , saying , Peace , peace  ; when there is no peace .

translation.kha: Ka la jan Dei artat ka na na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , kumta U Jisu u la leit shiah Jerusalem .
translation.en: And the Jews  passover was at hand , and Jesus went up to Jerusalem ,

translation.kha: Dagon uwei u khynnah hangne uba don syn tylli ki kpu barli bad ar tylli ki Dohkha . Hynrei kine kin ym pat biang na ka boitha film ki briew Baroh .
translation.en: There is a lad here , which hath five barley loaves , and two small fishes : but what are they among so many ?

translation.kha: Kumta ka Mei ka nong Magdala ka la leit sad ïathuh ïa ki synran ba ka la Ïohi ïa U Trai pynlang pynshai ha ki ïa kaei kaba u la ïatih ïa ka .
translation.en: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord , and that he had spoken these things unto her .

translation.kha: U Blei u buhrieh ïa ka lawei na ki bad ker ïa ki na ki liang baroh .
translation.en: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid , and whom God hath hedged in ?

translation.kha: La ei bun ki bhabriew naba la wan bad leit , haduh ba U Jisu bad ki synran jong u kim don por shiah wat ïa-ban bam jingbam . Kumta u la ong ïa ki , To ngin ïatrei neh tang ma ngi sha ka iaka ba ïong ïalong thiang para ma ngi bad phi lah ban pynjahthait shipor .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place , and rest a while :  for there were many coming and going , and they had no leisure so much as to eat .

translation.kha: ka Hit Shual , ka Balah , ka Esem ,
translation.en: And Hazar–shual , and Balah , and Ezem ,

translation.kha: Ha ki pateng ki ba wan , ki khun ki ksiew jongki phi bad ki nongwei na ki ri kiba jngai keiñ ïohi ïa ki Jingpynjot malade ki jingshah shitrhem ba U Trai’ u la pynngat ha ka ri jongnga phin .
translation.en: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you , and the stranger that shall come from a far land , shall say , when they see the plagues of that land , and the sicknesses which the  Lord  hath laid upon it  ;
Then the king promoted Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , in the province of Babylon .
translation.kha: Bad u syiem u la pynkiew kyrdan ïa u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego sha ki kyrdan ba kham halor ha ka probins jong ka Babilon .
U Trai u phah ïa ka ding najrong , bad ka thang duh ïa ka jingkñia , ïa ki diengthang bad ïa ki maw ; ka pyningkhong ïa ka khyndew bad pynrngad lut ïa ka um ha ka kharai .
translation.en: Then the fire of the  Lord  fell , and consumed the burnt sacrifice , and the wood , and the stones , and the dust , and licked up the water that was in the trench .

translation.kha: Nangta ki Ïeng ha la ki jaka , bad kine ki Lebi ki batai ïa ka Politics ha ki : u Jeshua , u Bani , u Serahaïah , u Jamin , u Akkub , u Shabbethai , u Hodaïah , u Maaseïah , u Kelita , u Sakharaïah , u Jehosabad , u Hanan , bad u Pelaïah .
translation.en: Also Jeshua , and Bani , and Sherebiah , Jamin , Akkub , Shabbethai , Hodijah , Maaseiah , Kelita , Azariah , Jozabad , Hanan , Pelaiah , and the Levites , caused the people to understand the law : and the people stood in their place .

translation.kha: Wat pyndeng kita kiei kiew kiba la jia , u Job um shym la leh pop da kaba kynnoh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: In all this Job sinned not , nor charged God foolishly .

translation.kha: U blei u la kren , sad kine ki dei ki ktien jong u :
translation.en: And God spake all these words , saying ,

translation.kha: Ko Israel , pha long kum ka tnum ba dang kham jingruma , ba la iehnoh da u tnga jong ka bad ba sngi jynjar sahit . hynne U Trai u khot pat ïa pha nabar u ong :
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit , and a wife of youth , when thou wast refused , saith thy God .
And the rulers knew not whither I went , or what I did  ; neither had I as yet told it to the Jews , nor to the priests , nor to the nobles , nor to the rulers , nor to the rest that did the work .
translation.kha: Ym don na kino kino ki rangbah synshar kiba na kata ka jaka kiba la tip shano ba nga la leit bad kaei kaba nga la leh . Haduh kata ka por , ngam pat shym la ong ei ei ïano ïano ruh na ka para Jiw jong nga — ki lyngdoh , ki nongïalam , ki rangbah synshar , lane mano mano ruh u ban ïashim bynta ha ka kam .

translation.en: That we henceforth be no more children , tossed to and fro , and carried about with every wind of doctrine , by the sleight of men , and cunning craftiness , whereby they lie in wait to deceive ;
translation.kha: Te ngin ym long shuh kum ki khynnah , ba la pynshad kynting da ki jingat phyllung bad ka jingbeh ka  erïong man ba ka kylla da ka jinghikai jong ki riewshukor , kiba ïalam ïa kiwei pat sha ka jingbakla da ki buit sianti ba ki pynmih .
Ha shuwa ba U Jisu un sdang ïa ka kam jong u , u Ïoannis u la ïalap ha ki bastad Israel barben ba ki dien ban phai noh na ki pop jong ki bad ban shah pynbaptis .
translation.en: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel .
Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city , saying that bonds and afflictions abide me .
translation.kha: Kaba nga tip ka long ba ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la maham ïa nga ba ka byndi bad ki jingjynjar ki ap ïa nga .
Nga la ïohi ïa ka kti ba la kynran sha nga bad ka bat ïa ka kot kli .
translation.en: And when I looked , behold , an hand was sent unto me  ; and , lo , a roll of a book was therein  ;

translation.kha: Shu Iathuh ianga jia aïu .
translation.en: Just tell me what's going on .
That they may fear thee all the days that they live in the land which thou gavest unto our fathers .
translation.kha: Ainong ïa uwei pa uwei baroh katba kum ki kam jong u , khnang ba ki briew jong me kin kohnguh ïa me ha ki por baroh katba ki dang im ha kane ka ri ïa kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
Hadien ka jingïap u kpa jong ki , ki hynmen u Joseph ki ïa-ai , Tip kane jia aïu keiñ ïada u Joseph u dang buhnud bad thmu ban pynhiarkput ïa i Naamah ka kam sngew ba i la leh ïa u ?
translation.en: And when Joseph s brethren saw that their father was dead , they said , Joseph will peradventure hate us , and will certainly requite us all the evil which we did unto him .
That every man should let his manservant , and every man his maidservant , being an Hebrew or an Hebrewess , go free  ; that none should serve himself of them , to wit , of a Jew his brother .
translation.kha: U syiem Sedekaïah bad ki briew ka Jerusalem ki la pynlong ka jingïakut ban pyllaitluid noh ïa ki mraw Hebru , ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , khnang ba uno uno ruh un ym don u para jait Israel kum u mraw .

U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Ong ïa u Aaron ban shim ïa la u diengduh badno ban rah ïa u hajar ki wah , ki nur-um , bad ki pukri um borbah ha ka ri Ijipt . Ka um kan hylla snam , bad ha ka ri baroh kawei kan don ka snam , kad ha ki khiew dieng bad ki khiew maw-it mad .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Take thy rod , and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt , upon their streams , upon their rivers , and upon their ponds , and upon all their pools of water , that they may become blood  ; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt , both in vessels of wood , and in vessels of stone .
Go ye , get you straw where ye can find it : yet not ought of your work shall be diminished .
translation.kha: Phi hap ban leit ïawad hi kat naba phi lap , hynrei phi dei ban shna katjuh ki maw-it .
Akaba ki dang leit ha la ka lynti , uwei u briew u la ong ha U Jisu , Ngan bud ïa me kot shaba me leit .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as they went in the way , a certain man said unto him , Lord , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .

translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u , U Jisu u la ino ïa ki , namar ym don uba leh ïa ka kambah ha ka kyrteng jong at , ba shen dadien un ong khie kiei kiba sniew shaphang jong nga .
translation.en: But Jesus said ,  Forbid him not : for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name , that can lightly speak evil of me .

translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki wan bad shekel dara ha Judah , bad ki hiarthma ïa ka shnong Likhi .
translation.en: Then the Philistines went up , and pitched in Judah , and spread themselves in Lehi .

translation.kha: Bad nga da Kyrpad jur ïa phi ban duwai ba U Bel un phah pat ïa nga Sha phoi kham kloi .
translation.en: But I beseech you the rather to do this , that I may be restored to you the sooner .
And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah  ; even Issachar , and also Barak : he was sent on foot into the valley . For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ka jait Issakhar ki wan bad ka Deborah ; Ho-oid , ki Issakhar ki wan bad u Barak ruh , Bad ki la bud ïa u sha ka them . Hynrei ki jait Reuben kim ïabeit jingmut , Kim shym lah rai ban ïawan .
U Mynsiem u la ïa-ong shai ba yn don ki briew ki banbeiñ iehnoh ïa ka jingngeit ha ki Ïa kiba khatduh : Kin kohnguh ïa ki mynjur bashukor bad kin bud ïa ki jinghikai jongki ki ksuid .
translation.en: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly , that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith , giving heed to seducing spirits , and doctrines of devils ;

translation.kha: Me la shah ïa ki ngab jop ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ki hima , ïa ki ri uba markhap bad ki . Ki jop ïa ka ri ki Heshbon , ha kaba u Sihon u synshar , mala ïa ka ri ki Bashan , ha kaba u Og u long shym .
translation.en: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations , and didst divide them into corners : so they possessed the land of Sihon , and the land of the king of Heshbon , and the land of Og king of Bashan .

translation.kha: Haba u Jisu u la ïohi ïa u paidbah sawdong jongnga u , u la hukum ïa ki synran jyllang u ban leit sha sliang jong ka duriaw .
translation.en: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him , he gave commandment to depart unto the other side .
I beheld , and , lo , there was no man , and all the birds of the heavens were fled .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ba ym don briew ; wat ki sim ki la lah her noh .

translation.en: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just , and desired a murderer to be granted unto you  ;
translation.kha: U la long uba khuid bad uba bha , hynrei phi la kyntait ïa u , bad pynban phi la kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban leh na ka bynta jong phi ban pyllait ïa u nongpynïap briew .

Katba nga dang trei bad ki Jiw , nga im kum u Jiw khnang ban ioh ïa ki ; bad wat la ma nga hi ngam long khoh ka Hukum u Moses , nga im kumba nga la un-long Mynba nga dang trei bad kito kiba hapoh ka hukum , khnang ba ngan jop ïa ki .
translation.en: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew , that I might gain the Jews ; to them that are under the law , as under the law , that I might gain them that are under the law ;

translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha uta u paidbah baroh , Kane ka long kaei kiba U Trai , U Blei ki Jeriel , u kein pun ïong : ‘ Mynhyndai , ki kpa tymmen jong phoi ki shong ki sah sha arliang jong ka wah Epaphroditos , bad ki la mane ïa khiew paw ki blei . Uwei na kito ki kpa tymmen u dei u Terah , u kpa jong u Abraham bad u Nahor .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto all the people , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time , even Terah , the father of Abraham , and the father of Nahor : and they served other gods .
It is joy to the just to do judgment : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .
translation.kha: Haba la pyndep ïa ka jingbishar hok , ki briew kiba bha ki kmen , hynrei ki briew kiba sniew ki sngewsih .

U la shim ïa wir ki sohshkor , u thap pynjam ïa ki , u theh ïa ka ksiar ha ka tiar sahit , bad u thaw ïa ka dur u khun masi . Ki paidbah ki ïa-ong , Ko Jeruel , une u long u blei jong ngi , uba la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt !
translation.en: And he received them at their hand , and fashioned it with a graving tool , after he had made it a molten calf : and they said , These be thy gods , O Israel , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki la shadong ban hynñiew neh ïa u Saul , kumta u ong ha ki , Wallam ha nga ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok .
translation.en: And Saul said , Bring hither a burnt offering to me , and peace offerings . And he offered the burnt offering .
I have heard many such things : miserable comforters are ye all .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew kum kita ki ktien mynshuwa ; ka jingpyntngen kaba phi ai ka long tang ka jingpynshitom .
Hynrei ki khun ki ksiew jong pa’ keiñ phla ïa la ki pop jong ki bad ki thup jong ki kpa bymman jongngi ki , kba pyneh ïa nga bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ,
translation.en: If they shall confess their iniquity , and the iniquity of their fathers , with their trespass which they trespassed against me , and that also they have walked contrary unto me  ;
Blessed be God , even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Father of mercies , and the God of all comfort ;
translation.kha: To ngin ai ka jingnguh sha U Blei bad U Kpa jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , U Kpa ba-dap da jingisynei , U Blei na uba ka jingïarap baroh ka wan !

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground : and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the  Lord  , worshipping the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Jehoshaphat u dem ngon , ka khmat jong u kaba dei ha ka khyndew , bad baroh u paidbah u dem ryngkat bad u bad mane ïa U  Trai .
Ha kamai pat ka jingpynïasoh nga la ïohi saw tylli ki reng masi dab .
translation.en: Then lifted I up mine eyes , and saw , and behold four horns .

Now when every maid s turn was come to go in to king Ahasuerus , after that she had been twelve months , according to the manner of the women , ( for so were the days of their purifications accomplished , to wit , six months with oil of myrrh , and six months with sweet odours , and with other things for the purifying of the women  ; )

translation.en: And thou didst divide the sea before them , so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land  ; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps , as a stone into the mighty waters .

translation.kha: Ym ba-don mano mano ba sumar ïa phi! , ym don jingïarap na ka boitha ki pruh jong phi , ym don jingkyrmen ban koit na ka bynshet jong phi .
translation.en: There is none to plead thy cause , that thou mayest be bound up : thou hast no healing medicines .

translation.kha: U angel na bneng u la pang ha u badno u la pynshaitbor ïa u .
translation.en: And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven , strengthening him .

translation.kha: Suk ma phi haba Phi shah krenbeiñ namar ba phi! long ki nongbud jong U Khrist ; kane ka mut ba U Mynsiem ka donburom , U Mynsiem jong U Blei , u khong ha pa .
translation.en: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ , happy are ye  ; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you : on their part he is evil spoken of , but on your part he is glorified .
And he that stealeth a man , and selleth him , or if he be found in his hand , he shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: Uta uba rong tuh ïa u briew da kaba mut ban die mraw ne ban ri mraw ïa u , u dei ban shah pynïap .

translation.en: And when Abram was ninety years old and nine , the  Lord  appeared to Abram , and said unto him , I am the Almighty God  ; walk before me , and be thou perfect .
translation.kha: Haba u Abram u la dap khyndaiphew khyndai snem ka rta , U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u bad u ong ,  Nga long U Blei Badonbor Baroh . Kohnguh ïa nga bad ïai leh ïa kaba dei .
Kynrad ngi la wanpaw shane shisien ban thied jingman .
translation.en: And said , O sir , we came indeed down at the first time to buy food :

translation.kha: Ka doh na ki , kum ka shadem bad ka kjat-dien kamon naba long ki jingainguh bakyrpang , ki long ka pyntwa jongno me .
translation.en: And the flesh of them shall be thine , as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Jonadab , u khun jong u Shammah , u Ahiman jong u Dabid , u ong , Syiem Kynrad , kim khim la pynïap ïa ki khulom shynrang jong phi baroh . Tang u Amnon uba la ïap . Phi eh ban ong da kaba peit ïa u Absalom ba u la kut jingot shem ban har ïa kane naduh ka por ba u Amnon u la batbor ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u .
translation.en: And Jonadab , the son of Shimeah David s brother , answered and said , Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king s sons  ; for Amnon only is dead : for by the appointment of Absalom this hath been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar .

translation.kha: Hynrei nur kyrkhu ïa u briew umbiah buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong u ha de .
translation.en: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the  Lord  , and whose hope the  Lord  is .

translation.kha: U Tharai u ïaid na khmat jong u , bad u pynbna , Ma per , U Trai , nga long U Blei uba dap da ka jinglehsbun bad jingïabujli , umbiah suki ban bitar bad uba pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad ïa ka jingïaineh skhem .
translation.en: And the  Lord  passed by before him , and proclaimed , The  Lord  , The  Lord  God , merciful and gracious , longsuffering , and abundant in goodness and truth ,

translation.kha: tang ma u hi u leh ïa ki kambah bakhraw ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: To him who alone doeth great wonders : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Nga la shah ïa ki briew ban sping pisa kylliang bad u kew na nga , bad kumjuh ruh ki paidlang jong nga bad ki briew kiba trei na ka bynta jongngi por . To mynta ngin ym ïa-pynïap shuh ïa ka jingpynphai biang ïa ka pisa .
translation.en: I likewise , and my brethren , and my servants , might exact of them money and corn : I pray you , let us leave off this usury .

translation.kha: Uno na phi uba la ïathuhlypa ba kane kan jai , khnang ba ngin lah baneh ong ba phi long uba dei ? Ym Don na phi uba la ong wat shikyntien shaphang jong ka ; ym don ibha la ïohsngew ïa phi ba phi ong ïa kata .
translation.en: Who hath declared from the beginning , that we may know ? and beforetime , that we may say , He is righteous ? yea , there is none that sheweth , yea , there is none that declareth , yea , there is none that heareth your words .
These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab , on the other side Jordan , by Jericho , eastward .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ba u Moses u la pynbynta ïa ka ri shaphang mihngi jong ka Jerikho bad ka Jordan mynba u don ha ki pyntha ka Moab .

translation.en: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch , a knop and a flower  ; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch , a knop and a flower : so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick .
translation.kha: Kawei pa kawei na kita ki hynriew tylli ki tnat ka don lai tylli ki khuri kiba kum ki syntiew soh almond lem bad ki shata bad ki syntiew ba la oh-shrong itynnat .
Ka jingiw jong kine ki jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine , for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki Lebi kan ym don ka jingdiang jingem baneh ha Jerusalem’ , namar nga la ai ha ki kum ka bynta Jong ki ïa ka ka shiphew ba ki Jeriel ki wanrah sha nga kum ka jingïoh kaba pynpang . Dei namar katai ba nga la ïathuh ïa ki ba keiñ ym don ka jingdon jingkmen baheh ha Israel .
translation.en: But the tithes of the children of Israel , which they offer as an heave offering unto the  Lord  , I have given to the Levites to inherit : therefore I have said unto them , Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance .

And when he had taken the book , the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb , having every one of them harps , and golden vials full of odours , which are the prayers of saints .
translation.kha: Katba u dang leh kumta , kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im bad ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang    ki la dem khrup ha khmat U Khunlangbrot . Uwei pa uwei u la don ka duitara bad ki pliang ksiar ba la pyndap da ka jingiwbih , kiba long ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong U Blei .
Me la jingïashoh kaei ba u patsha Asia u leh ïa kano kano ka ri kaba u rai banbeiñ pynjot . Hato me pyrkhat ba men laiñ im ?
translation.en: Behold , thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly  ; and shalt thou be delivered ?

translation.kha: Kumta u ïalam ïa ki sha la ïing bun u ai bam ïa ki kada jong ki . Ki ruh ki ïasait ïa la ki phet bad ki ïabam jingbam miet .
translation.en: So he brought him into his house , and gave provender unto the asses : and they washed their feet , and did eat and drink .
And I will bring you in unto the land , concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob  ; and I will give it you for an heritage : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa phi sha ka ri kaba nga la kular skhem ban ai ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob ; bad ngan ai ïa ka ha phi kum ka nongkynti jong phi hi . Nga long U  Trai .’

translation.en: So Esther s maids and her chamberlains came and told it her . Then was the queen exceedingly grieved  ; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai , and to take away his sackcloth from him : but he received it not .
translation.kha: Haba ki shakri kynthei jong ka Esther bad ki ïunukh ki ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaba u Mordekai u leh , ka la shitom jingmut haduh katta katta . Ka phah sha u Mordekai katto katne ki jaiñ ban phong ha ka jaka ki jaiñ khain , hynrei um shym pdiang ïa ki .

translation.en: And Joshua said unto Achan , My son , give , I pray thee , glory to the  Lord  God of Israel , and make confession unto him  ; and tell me now what thou hast done  ; hide it not from me .
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha u ,  Ko khun shynrang jong nga , ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha hangne ha khmat U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , bad phla . Ïathuh ha nga mynta ïa kaei kaba me la leh . Wat pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa ka na nga .
Kane ka dei kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong : Ngam shim ïa ka kliar jong u diengïap Kedar bajrong bad kdiah ïa i shylluit balung ; ngan thung ïa i halor u lum bakynjang ,
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar , and will set it  ; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one , and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent :

translation.kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un shahshkor ïa put hi . Lada uno uno napdeng jrong phi u pyrkhat ba u lama kaba sngewstad da ka jingthew jong kane ka pyrthei , u dei ban long uba babit khnang ba un long babha stad da shispah .
translation.en: Let no man deceive himself . If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world , let him become a fool , that he may be wise .

translation.kha: hynne ai ïa kaei kaba hapoh ki khuri dara ki pliang jyllang phoi ha kiba duk , bad kiei kiei baroh kin long kiba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: But rather give alms of such things as ye have  ; and , behold , all things are clean unto you .
He shall dwell on high : his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks : bread shall be given him  ; his waters shall be sure .
translation.kha: Te phin long shngain ; phin long skhem kum ka kut bakhlaiñ . Phin don ka jingbam ban bam bad ka um ban dih .
Ym don kano Kane ha ka pyrthei kaba lah ban ïanujor bad u , u dei u jingthaw u bym don jingsheptieng .
translation.en: Upon earth there is not his like , who is made without fear .

translation.kha: Bad kano kano kambah phi dong donkam shuh ha ka baphylla , phi ia ban ïoh na ka ïing jingkynshew syiem .
translation.en: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God , which thou shalt have occasion to bestow , bestow it out of the king s treasure house .
Know ye not that ye are the temple of God , and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you ?
translation.kha: Da shisha phi tip ba phi long ka templ jong U Blei bad ba U Mynsiem U Blei u shong hapoh jong phi !
u khun jong u Joshua , u khun jong u Elieser , u khun jong u Jorim , u khun jngai u Mahath , u khun jongno u Lebi ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Jose , which was the son of Eliezer , which was the son of Jorim , which was the son of Matthat , which was the son of Levi ,

translation.kha: Naba ki jaitbynriew baroh ki la dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka — ka ïew baïar jong ka jingkwah byrni awria jongngi ka . Ki shym jong ka pyrthei ki la ïaleh awria bad ka , mala ki nongkhaïi jong ka pyrthei ki la kiew spah babha na ka jingkwah brai bymïap Lah thah lakam jongu ka .
translation.en: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication , and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her , and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies .

translation.kha: Lymne ba uno uno un thew ïa ka waiñ Bathymmai ha ki lwa snieh ba la pyndonkam , namar ka waiñ bathymmai kan pynpdang ïa ki snieh , ka waiñ kad tuid sawar , bad ïa ki snieh yn pynjot .
translation.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles  ; else the new wine will burst the bottles , and be spilled , and the bottles shall perish .
Again , he sent other servants more than the first : and they did unto them likewise .
translation.kha: Sa shisien uta u briew u la phah biang ïa kiwei pat ki mraw , kham bun ïa kaba nyngkong , bad ki nongshimwai ki la leh ïa ki ha kajuh ka rukom .

translation.en: Then began he to curse and to swear , saying , I know not the man . And immediately the cock crew .
translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la ong ,  Nga smai ba nga ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ! Ai ba U Blei un pynshitom ïa nga lada ngam long kumta ! Ngam ithuh ïa uta u briew !  Kumta hi u syiar u la kyn-ih ,
U sharak u ngeit ïa ka jingshim jong ka Baibl badno ïa ka hukum ban ïalap ïa ka khubor babha , bad u long uba distrik ha kaban sumar ïa kiei kiew ki jong u Khrist ha pyrthei .
translation.en: The slave is faithful to Bible truths and to its commission to preach the good news , and it is discreet about how it wisely cares for Christ’s interests on earth .

translation.kha: U Trai u isih ïa ki briew naba pyndonkam da ki tlor bad jingthew bymhok .
translation.en: Divers weights are an abomination unto the  Lord   ; and a false balance is not good .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah na Dan ki pynïeng ïa ka bleithaw ïa ka ban mian , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Geshem bad u khun ksiew jong u Moses , ki shakri kum ki lyngngeit ïa ka jait Dan , bad ki shakri kiba hiarpateng kumno ki lyngdoh haduh ka jingshah ringmraw ki brisoh na kata ka ri .
translation.en: And the children of Dan set up the graven image : and Jonathan , the son of Gershom , the son of Manasseh , he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land .

translation.kha: Ka Naomi ka kylli ïa ka , Hangno phi ïohlum ïa kine baroh ? Ha ka lyngkien jongno phi ïoh trei ? To U Bel un kyrkhu ïa u briew uba shem jingsngewbha ha phiah ! Kumta ka lwet ka ïathuh ha ka Naei ba ka la ter ha ka lyngkha kaba dei jong u bri uba ktung u Boas .

translation.kha: ki kynthei bad ki khynnah jong phi , ki nongwei kiba shong bad phi , bad kito kiba lama ki nongthoh dieng bad ki nongtong um ïa phi ,
translation.en: Your little ones , your wives , and thy stranger that is in thy camp , from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water :

To shahshkor ïa ka jingdum U Trai pyrshah ïa ki Israel . To khie , A Trai , bad Wanlam ïa ka jingmudui jongki me ; to ai ba ki lumbah bad ki lumrit kin ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba me ïong .
translation.en: Hear ye now what the  Lord  saith  ; Arise , contend thou before the mountains , and let the hills hear thy voice .

translation.kha: Ym ni nongwei ha ka ri jong ki ; ym dat u ban ïalam jngai ïa ki na U Blei .
translation.en: Unto whom alone the earth was given , and no stranger passed among them .

translation.kha: te ngan weng noh ïa phi na kane ka ri ïa kob nga la ai ha phi , sad ngan iehnoh ïa kane ka Templ ba nga la pynkyntang kum ka khak ha katba yn mane ïa nga . Ki briew kylleng kin krenbeiñ bad ñiew ïa ka .
translation.en: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them  ; and this house , which I have sanctified for my name , will I cast out of my sight , and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations .

translation.kha: Wat lehbeiñ ïa u nongwei ; phi tip kumno phi sngewdiaw ban long u nongwei , nia phi la ju long ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger : for ye know the heart of a stranger , seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt .
For I am the  Lord  thy God , the Holy One of Israel , thy Saviour : I gave Egypt for thy ransom , Ethiopia and Seba for thee .
translation.kha: Naba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel , uba pynim ïa phi . Ngan kyntait ïa ka Ijipt ban pyllaitluid ïa phi ; ngan kyntait ïa ka Sudan bad ka Seba .

translation.en: And I will make thee swear by the  Lord  , the God of heaven , and the God of the earth , that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites , among whom I dwell :
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa me ban pynlong ka jingsmai ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , U Blei jong ka bneng bad ka khyndew , ba men ym jied ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga na ki briew hangne ha ri Kanaan .
Bad kumta ki paid Judah ki la long nongjop hiar ki Israel , namar ki la shaniah ha U Trai , U Blei jongu ki kper tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time , and the children of Judah prevailed , because they relied upon the  Lord  God of their fathers .
And Eli said unto her , How long wilt thou be drunken ? put away thy wine from thee .
translation.kha: bad u ong ha ka ,  Keiñ noh kane ka jingleh buaid jong pha ! Wat dih shuh bad pynpyngngad noh !

translation.en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare : but the righteous doth sing and rejoice .
translation.kha: Ki briew basniew ki ngat ha la ki jong ki pop , katba ki briew bahok ki kmen bad ki laitluid .
sad pli ïa la ki jaiñ . Ka dei ban sah ha ïeng jong phiah , bad ïam sngewsih shi bnai ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmang . Hadien kata , phi haka ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: And she shall put the raiment of her captivity from off her , and shall remain in thine house , and bewail her father and her mother a full month : and after that thou shalt go in unto her , and be her husband , and she shall be thy wife .

translation.kha: Ka jinghikai jong nga kan ai ïa phi ka jingim kaba jyllang bad kaban manbha .
translation.en: For length of days , and long life , and peace , shall they add to thee .
Remove not the old landmark  ; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless :
translation.kha: Wat pynkynriah ïa u mawpud uba rim lane knieh ïa ka khyndew ba long trai da ki khunswet .
Uwei pa uwei ha ka ri un ïarap Ngan ha kaba tep ïa ki , bad ïa ki yn ai burom na ka bynta kane , ha ka sngi jrong ka jingjot thiaw jong nga . Ma nga , U Trai Nongshun , nga la kren .
translation.en: Yea , all the people of the land shall bury them  ; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: La thup ïa u ha ka ri kynti jong u hi ha Timnath seraph ha ka ri lum Ephraim kaba shaphang shatei jong u Lum Gaash .
translation.en: And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath–heres , in the mount of Ephraim , on the north side of the hill Gaash .

translation.kha: naba ka dei ka jingshai kaba pynmih ïa ka jingat kaba kyrhai ha baroh ki jinglong babha , bahok , bad bashisha .
translation.en: For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth .
For though thou wash thee with nitre , and take thee much soap , yet thine iniquity is marked before me , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Wat lada me la sait da ka sabon kaba khlaiñ , ngan dang ïai ïohi ïa ka jingkhah jaboh jong ka jingpalat jong me .

wat lada u Noah , u Daniel , bad u Joppa ki shong ki sah hangtai — kumba shisha ma ang , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im — kin ym lah ban pynim wat ïa la ki jong ki khun . Ka jingtah jong ki sa pyllait im tang ïa ka jingïam jong ki .
translation.en: Though Noah , Daniel , and Job , were in it , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , they shall deliver neither son nor daughter  ; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness .

translation.kha: Mynta , halor ka jingai jingmad u Mordekai , ka astor ka bat tang ha lade Khlem ïathuh hano hano ba ka long ka Jiw .
translation.en: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred : for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it .
Nevertheless the  Lord  raised up judges , which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ïa ki nongïalam kiba la pyllait im ïa ki na ki nonglute .

Ka jingrwai jong nga ka long ba ka jingïasyllok jong ngi bad me kum ki bangeit kan wallam ïa ka jingsngewthuh ba kham jylliew ïa ki jingkyrkhu baroh ïa kiba ngi ïoh ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist .
translation.en: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus .
The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the  Lord  : but the prayer of the upright is his delight .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u sngewbha haba ki briew kiba bha ki duwai , hynrei u isih ïa ki jingkñia kiba ki bymman ki wallam ha u .

Ngan leh ïa kane namar ki briew ki la ino ïa nga bad ki la pyntngit ïa kane ka jaka da kaba ai jingkñia hangne shuh kiwei pat ki blei — ki blei kiba ym ma ki lin ki kpa tymmen jong ki lymne ki syiem jong ka Ïuodia ki la tip ei ei .
