translation.en: Because they have forsaken me , and have estranged this place , and have burned incense in it unto other gods , whom neither they nor their fathers have known , nor the kings of Judah , and have filled this place with the blood of innocents  ;

translation.kha: ‘ U para jong me u la wang phai pat sha ïing ,’ u shakri u la jubab , ‘ bad u kpa jong me u la phah pynap ïa u khun masi uba la pynsngaid ba , namar u la ïoh pat ïa u ha ka jingsuk pynlang ha ka jingkoit jingthiah .’
translation.en: And he said unto him , Thy brother is come  ; and thy father hath killed the fatted calf , because he hath received him safe and sound .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la ino , to kruiñ pyrshah ïa ki nongsynshar ka Israel . Iphtahel ha ki , bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga ong ha ki : Phi erlangthari ki bymïap don jingkyrmen shuh , a phi ki nongsharai ka Isaia ! Phi sumar ibha tang ïa biar , ishyrkhei phim ju bsa bha ïa ki Langbrot .
translation.en: Son of man , prophesy against the shepherds of Israel , prophesy , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God  unto the shepherds  ; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves ! should not the shepherds feed the flocks ?

translation.kha: Uei suba lah ban pynjrong ïa u ban plie ïa ki tieng jong u , kiba la ker da kito ki bniat kiba itriem ?
translation.en: Who can open the doors of his face ? his teeth are terrible round about .

translation.kha: Nangta un shim shi kham u purew bad ka umphniang , bad ïa ka jingiwbih halor jong ka , bad un thrang ha ka duwan kum ka dak ba ïa kata baroh la kñia ainguh ha U Trai . Ka jingiw na kane ka jingainguh ka lama kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And he shall take of it his handful , of the flour of the meat offering , and of the oil thereof , and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering , and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour , even the memorial of it , unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por shibun ki jaitbynriew kin wan sha U Trai sad long ki briew jong u . Un shong un sah hapdeng jong phi , bad phin thop ba u la lah phah ïa nga sha phi .
translation.en: And many nations shall be joined to the  Lord  in that day , and shall be my people : and I will dwell in the midst of thee , and thou shalt know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto thee .
If we believe not , yet he abideth faithful : he cannot deny himself .
translation.kha: Lada ngim long kiba ïaineh , u ïaisah hi uba ïaineh , namar um lah ban shukor ïa lade .

translation.en: For what man knoweth the things of a man , save the spirit of man which is in him ? even so the things of God knoweth no man , but the Spirit of God .
translation.kha: Ka dei tang ka mynsiem kaba hapoh u briew hi , kaba tip ïa baroh shaphang jong u ; ha kajuh ka rukom , tang U Mynsiem U Blei , uba tip ïa baroh shaphang U Blei .

Namar ba u Judas u lama uba bat ïa ka pla pisa , don na ki synran ki la pyrkhat ba U Jisu u la ong ïa u ban leit bad thied ïa kaei kaba ki bunkam na ka bynta ka jingrwai Niam , rue ban ai ei ei ïa kiba duk .
translation.en: For some of them thought , because Judas had the bag , that Jesus had said unto him , Buy those things that we have need of against the feast  ; or , that he should give something to the poor .
And he said unto me , This chamber , whose prospect is toward the south , is for the priests , the keepers of the charge of the house .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïathuh ïa nga ba ka kamra kaba phai shaphang shathie ka la long na ka bynta ki lyngdoh kiba lehniam ha ka templ ,

translation.en: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die : yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die .
translation.kha: Ka long kaei kaei kaba eh ïa uno uno ban ïap na ka bynta u briew uba hok . Ka lah ban long ba don uno uno uba nud ban ïap na ka bynta u briew uba bha .
Kumba ka ïor ka jah napoh ha ka jingshit sad ka jingryngkhiang , kum ruh u nongpdiang u da noh na ka ri jong kiba im .
translation.en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters : so doth the grave those which have sinned .

translation.kha: U nongshun u ong , ‘ Ngan beh khongdong bad kem ïa ki , lang ïabynta ïa ka spah jong ki , bad ngan shim kat ïa kaba nga manna ; ngan shi ïa la ka waitlam , bad ngan Shim ïa baroh kabu ki don .’
translation.en: The enemy said , I will pursue , I will overtake , I will divide the spoil  ; my lust shall be satisfied upon them  ; I will draw my sword , my hand shall destroy them .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Stretch out thy rod , and smite the dust of the land , that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Ong ïa u Aaron ban shoh ïa ka khyndew da u diengduh , ba u pui pui ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei un kylla mait .
Naba don Tang nawei U Blei , bad don uwei uba pynwan sam ïa U Bela bad ïa u jingpynkhihwin , U Khrist Jisu uba long ruh u briew , uba la aiti ïa lade ban siewspah ïa ki briew baroh .
translation.en: For there is one God , and one mediator between God and men , the man Christ Jesus ;

translation.kha: kumne ki shakri kiba ap khmih ïa u kynrad Jong ki ban wan phai pat na ka jingkhiah shongkurim . Babha u wan bad u Tied jingkhang , mar kumta hi , kin pyllew ïa ka jingkha na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord , when he will return from the wedding  ; that when he cometh and knocketh , they may open unto him immediately .

translation.kha: ïa ki nongïaleh shipai sad ki nongïalam Paidbah’ jong ki , ïa ki nongmihkhmat paidbah jong ki bad ïa baroh kiba pyndonkam ïa ka myntor baneh bat ïa Phim kino ki jingïada .
translation.en: The captain of fifty , and the honourable man , and the counsellor , and the cunning artificer , and the eloquent orator .
And she was in bitterness of soul , and prayed unto the  Lord  , and wept sore .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ynda ki la dep bam dep dih ha ka ïing U  Trai  ha Shiloh , ka Hannah ka ïeng joit , ka la sngew jynjar sat bad ka la ïamkthang katba ka dang duwai ha khmat U  Trai . Ha kata ka por , u lyngdoh Eli u shong ha ka jaka jong u ha syndah jingkhang .

Ha ka Law u sahmiet ïa ka law la pyntip Paidbah’ ha Susa , ka nongbah jong ka hima , bad ki nongbanbor ki rah ïa ka khubor sha ki jylla . U syiem malu u Haman ki shong mala ïadih sngewbha katba ka nongbah Susa ka la don hapdeng ka jingkulmar .
translation.en: The posts went out , being hastened by the king s commandment , and the decree was given in Shushan the palace . And the king and Haman sat down to drink  ; but the city Shushan was perplexed .
His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle , and it shall bring him to the king of terrors .
translation.kha: La weng ïa u na ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba u la ju im ha ka jingshngain , bad la tan ïa u ban ïeng markhmat bad u Syiem ka Jingïap .
hynne haba ka ïa kambah baïong ka la poi , U Blei u la phah ïa la U Khun .
translation.en: But when the fulness of the time was come , God sent forth his Son , made of a woman , made under the law ,
I have heard what the prophets said , that prophesy lies in my name , saying , I have dreamed , I have dreamed .
translation.kha: Nga tip aïu kito ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ong , ki da kren lamler ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad kam ba nga la ai ha ki ïa ki khubor jong nga ha ki jingphohsniew jong ki .
Ngi thoh ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkieng jyllang ngi kan long kaba dap pura .
translation.en: And these things write we unto you , that your joy may be full .
And you , being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh , hath he quickened together with him , having forgiven you all trespasses ;
translation.kha: Phi la long ha kawei ka por kiba la ïap ha kaba kynja mynsiem namar ki pop jong phi bad namar ba phi la long ki Jentil kiba khlem ka Hukum . Hynrei U Blei mynta u la wallam ïa phi sha ka jingim bad U Khrist .

Ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , u briew uba khuid katba kum ka jinglehniam un synreit ïa ka um ha kita ki briew ki bymïap . Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u dei ban pynkhuid ïa kito , babha , hadien ba ki la sait ïa la ki jaiñ pynlang sum ïa lade , ki kylla longsyiem kiba khuid ha ka por sep sngi katai kum ka jinglehniam .
translation.en: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day , and on the seventh day : and on the seventh day he shall purify himself , and wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and shall be clean at even .
And I will cast thee out , and thy mother that bare thee , into another country , where ye were not born  ; and there shall ye die .
translation.kha: Ngan sa bret ïa me bad ïa ka kmie jong me sha ka jinglongmraw . Men leit sha ka ri ha kaba ym shym la kha ïa me , bad hangta phin ïap baroh ar ngut .
Ka khun kaweh ar ruh ka la kha khun shynraiñ ïa uba ka jer kyrteng u Ben-ammi . U la long u kpa tymmen jong ki Ammon shuh kane ka sneng .
translation.en: And the younger , she also bare a son , and called his name Ben–ammi : the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day .
For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily , eateth and drinketh damnation to himself , not discerning the Lord s body .
translation.kha: Naba , lada um tip ïa ka jingmut jong ka met jong U Trai haba u bam ïa u kpu bad dih na ka khuri , u wallam ïa ka jingbishar ha lade hi katba u dang bam bad dih .
Ïa kiei phi la leit ba-bang peit ? Hato ïa u briew umbah phong ki jaiñ babha itynnat ? Ïa ki briew kiba riam kumta bad babha shong ha ka jingdap kyrhai la shem ha ki ïingsyiem !
translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? Behold , they which are gorgeously apparelled , and live delicately , are in kings  courts .
He spread a cloud for a covering  ; and fire to give light in the night .
translation.kha: U Blei u buh ïa u lyoh halor ki briew jong u bad ïa ka ding mynmiet ban ai jingshai ïa ki .

translation.en: I am that bread of life .
translation.kha: Nga long u kpu ka jingim .

Lada eit uno u wallam ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa phi badno ïalam ïa phi sha ka ïingbishar , to ïapynbeit khong ïa ka jingïakajia bad u katba dang don ka por ha shwa ba phin pei sha ka ïingbishar . Shisien ba phi la don hangthie , un aiti ïa phi sha u nongbishar , u ban aiti ïa phi sha u pulit , bad un set ïa pa’ ha ka ïingbyndi .
translation.en: Agree with thine adversary quickly , whiles thou art in the way with him  ; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge , and the judge deliver thee to the officer , and thou be cast into prison .

translation.kha: Bad nalor Kine ki jinglong baroh , to bynrap ïa ka jingieit , kaba tehsong lang ïa kiwei kiei baroh lang ha ka jingïatylli kaba janai .
translation.en: And above all these things put on charity , which is the bond of perfectness .

translation.kha: ( Ïa kane ka ri la ju tip kum ka ri ki Rephaim , ka kyrteng jyllang kita ki briew kiba ju shongsuk hangta . Ki Ammon ki khot ïa ki , ki Samsummim .
translation.en: ( That also was accounted a land of giants : giants dwelt therein in old time  ; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims  ;

translation.kha: Hammoth ki Para kynthei jong u baroh kim shong kim sah hangne ? Nangno u ïoh ïa kane baroh ?
translation.en: And his sisters , are they not all with us ? Whence then hath this man all these things ?

translation.kha: Lyngba u Elieser u para jong u Gershom u don ka jingïadei bad u Shelomith . U Elieser u dei u kpa jong u Rehabaïah , uba dei u kput jong u Jeshaïah , u kpa jongki u Joram , u kpa jong u shakri , u kpa jong u Shelomith .
translation.en: And his brethren by Eliezer  ; Rehabiah his son , and Jeshaiah his son , and Joram his son , and Zichri his son , and Shelomith his son .
And Joash did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  all the days of Jehoiada the priest .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  katba u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u dang im .
U Issakhar , U Sebulun , U Benjamin ,
translation.en: Issachar , Zebulun , and Benjamin ,

translation.kha: Nongbah ka khubor shaphang ka jingïap U Khrist halor ka diengphna ka longkmie ka jingbeit ha kito kiba jot noh ; hynrei ïa ngi kiba la pynim , ka long ka bor U Bel .
translation.en: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness ; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God .

translation.kha: Pynban phi dang iehnoh ïa nga bad mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ; kumta ngan ym pyllait ïa phi sa shisien pat .
translation.en: Yet ye have forsaken me , and served other gods : wherefore I will deliver you no more .

And now , behold , the  Lord  hath kept me alive , as he said , these forty and five years , even since the  Lord  spake this word unto Moses , while the children of Israel wandered in the wilderness : and now , lo , I am this day fourscore and five years old .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ha khmih , ka la long sawphew san snem naduh ba U  Trai  u la ong ïa kata ha u Moses . Kata ka la long mynba ki Israel ki dang ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap , bad U  Trai  , kumba u la kular , u la ri pynim ïa nga .

Haba ki Philistia ki ïohsngew ba ki Israel ki la ïailong ha Mispah , kita ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki leit kiew bad la ki briew ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , bad ki Israel ki la ïohsngew ïa kata bad ki la sheptieng ,
translation.en: And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together to Mizpah , the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel . And when the children of Israel heard it , they were afraid of the Philistines .
And the book is delivered to him that is not learned , saying , Read this , I pray thee : and he saith , I am not learned .
translation.kha: Lada phi ai ïa ka ha uno uno u bym lah ban pule bad ong ïa u ban pule ïa ka ha phi , un jubab ba um tip kumno ban pule .

translation.en: That thou mightest know the certainty of those things , wherein thou hast been instructed .
translation.kha: Nga leh ïa kane khnang ba phin tip ïa ka jingshisha ba-pura shaphang kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba la hikai ïa phi .
U ïada ïa kito kiba lehhok ïa kiwei pat , badno u ïada ïa kito kiba aiti ha u .
translation.en: He keepeth the paths of judgment , and preserveth the way of his saints .

translation.kha: Men ym sheptieng ïa ki nongwan jong me ; kiba bun ki briew kin kyrpad jingïarap na me .
translation.en: Also thou shalt lie down , and none shall make thee afraid  ; yea , many shall make suit unto thee .

translation.kha: U Trai u longsem u syiem junom . U balui jong phalang , ko Seïon , un synshar baroh shi rta . To ïaroh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: The  Lord  shall reign for ever , even thy God , O Zion , unto all generations . Praise ye the  Lord .
Heaven and earth shall pass away : but my words shall not pass away .
translation.kha: Ka bneng bad ka pyrthei kin leit noh , hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym leit noh satia .

U patsha u phah ïa kane ka jubab : Ha u Rieh , u lam , ha u Shimshai , u sekretari jong ka probins , bad ha ki paralok jrong ki kiba shongsuk ha Samaria bad ha kiba sah jyllang ka ïapyllait Sepngi , ki jingïabujli .
translation.en: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor , and to Shimshai the scribe , and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria , and unto the rest beyond the river , Peace , and at such a time .

translation.kha: Baroh ka spah kaba me la duh , kam longsem ei ei ban ïapyrshang bad kaei kiba U Blei un sa ai pait ha me .
translation.en: Though thy beginning was small , yet thy latter end should greatly increase .
And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness in them that perish ; because they received not the love of the truth , that they might be saved .
translation.kha: bad un pyndonkam ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingshukor bymman ha kito ki ban sa jot noh . Kin jot noh namar ba kim pdiang sngewbha bad ieit ïa ka jingshisha khnang ba kin ïoh im .
Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun jong nga , namarba ïa ki pep jong phi la map na ka bynta U Khrist .
translation.en: I write unto you , little children , because your sins are forgiven you for his name s sake .
And Abigail hasted , and arose , and rode upon an ass , with five damsels of hers that went after her  ; and she went after the messengers of David , and became his wife .
translation.kha: Ka la ïeng kloi kloi bad ka shong halor ka kada jong ka . La synran ïa ka da ki shakri kynthei jong ka san ngut ; ka la leit ryngkat bad ki shakri jong u Dabid bad ka la long ka tnga jong u .

translation.en: For he is the minister of God to thee for good . But if thou do that which is evil , be afraid ; for he beareth not the sword in vain : for he is the minister of God , a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil .
translation.kha: namar u long u shakri jong U Blei uba trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi . Hynrei lada phi leh ïa kaba sniew , te to sheptieng ïa u , namar ka bor jong u ban pynshitom ka long kaba dei . U long u shakri jong U Blei bad u pyntreikam ïa ka jingpynshitom U Blei halor kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew .

Lada u briew u wanlam ïa ka jingainguh jingsyllok ban pyndep ïa la ka jingkular lane kum ka jingainguh mon sngewbha jong u hi , ym da donkam ban bam lut ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi ba la ktien ; hynrei ïa kambah sah lah ban bam ha ka sngi kaba bud .
translation.en: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow , or a voluntary offering , it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice : and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten :

translation.kha: Kane , te , ka long kumno ngin tap ba i'u long ki jong ka jingshisha ; kane ka long kumno ngin sngewskhem ha khmat U Blei .
translation.en: And hereby we know that we are of the truth , and shall assure our hearts before him .

translation.kha: Bneng ki bri na ka probins jong ka Judia bad ka nongbah Jerusalem ki la leit ban ïohsngew ïa u Ïoannis . Ki la phla ïa la ki pop , bad u la pynbyrngia ïa ki ha ka wah Joïada .
translation.en: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea , and they of Jerusalem , and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan , confessing their sins .
And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple : and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him .
translation.kha: bad haba ki la ithuh ïa u kum u nongkhrong uba la ju shong ha ka Khyrdop Ba-itynnat , baroh ki la kyndit bad lyngngoh ïa kaei kaba la lah jia ha u .

Nangta ainong ha u Pharaoh , ‘ U Trai , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u la phah ïa nga ban ong ha phi ba phin shah ïa ki briew jong u ba-bang wait , khnang ba kin ïoh ban mane ïa u ha ri shyiap . Khenani haw mynta phim shym shahshkor .
translation.en: And thou shalt say unto him , The  Lord  God of the Hebrews hath sent me unto thee , saying , Let my people go , that they may serve me in the wilderness : and , behold , hitherto thou wouldest not hear .

translation.kha: Namar ïa kaei kaba phi la lai , ngan aiti noh ïa phi sha ki kiwei ki jingtipbriew ki shun lut ïa phi bad pynjot ïa phi . Ngan pynjot lumrit ïa pa ba phi ym long shuh ka jaitbynriew lano ban don ka ri la ka jong . Te phin tip ba na long U Trai .
translation.en: Behold , therefore I will stretch out mine hand upon thee , and will deliver thee for a spoil to the heathen  ; and I will cut thee off from the people , and I will cause thee to perish out of the countries : I will destroy thee  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ngi ngeit myntor , ym namar kaei kob pha la ïathuh , hynrei namar ma ngi hi da put ngi la ïohsngew ïa u , bad ngi tip ba une da shisha u long u Nongpynim jong ka pynrieh .
translation.en: And said unto the woman , Now we believe , not because of thy saying : for we have heard him ourselves , and know that this is indeed the Christ , the Saviour of the world .

translation.kha: U kynrad jong u Joseph u la bitar lep
translation.en: And it came to pass , when his master heard the words of his wife , which she spake unto him , saying , After this manner did thy servant to me  ; that his wrath was kindled .

translation.kha: Da shisha ktem shym leh kumta , u Dabid u jubab . Ki rangbah jong nga ki ju sumar khuid ïa lade kat kum ka jinglehniam wat haba ngi kein ha ka jingïaleh kaweh mala mala ; katno tam lei lei ha kane ka por ha kaba ngi don ha ka jingïaleh kaba khah kyrpang !
translation.en: And David answered the priest , and said unto him , Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days , since I came out , and the vessels of the young men are holy , and the bread is in a manner common , yea , though it were sanctified this day in the vessel .
And Adah bare Jabal : he was the father of such as dwell in tents , and of such as have cattle .
translation.kha: Ka Adah ka la kha ïa u Jabal , uba dei u kpa tymmen jong kito kiba ri jingri bad kiba shong ha ki ïingjaiñ .
Kam da jngai nangta la don ka kynhun bah ki snieh kaba dang ïam jingbam .
translation.en: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding .

translation.kha: U la synshar ha Hebron hynñiew snem ha Jerusalem laiphew lai snem .
translation.en: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years  ; seven years reigned he in Hebron , and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Peit ïa une u Briew ki ïakren para ma ki . Sngap ïa ki jingkob jong u . U syiem Saul un ai ka nong kaba khrong ïa u briew u ban pynnep ïa u ; u syiem un ai ruh Ban shongkurim ïa ka khun kynthei jong u bad ka ïing u kpa jong u kam donkam ban siew khajna .
translation.en: And the men of Israel said , Have ye seen this man that is come up ? surely to defy Israel is he come up : and it shall be , that the man who killeth him , the king will enrich him with great riches , and will give him his daughter , and make his father s house free in Israel .

translation.kha: U Manasseh u shim ïa ka jingman pynsleh bad khyndiat ka snam kaba don ha ka duwan bad u synrai ïa ki ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u bad ha ki jaiñkup jong ki . Ha kane ka rukom u jingpynkyntang ïa ki bad ïa ki jreiñ jong ki shata U Trai .
translation.en: And Moses took of the anointing oil , and of the blood which was upon the altar , and sprinkled it upon Aaron , and upon his garments , and upon his sons , and upon his sons  garments with him  ; and sanctified Aaron , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons  garments with him .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , A katno kaba shyrkhei ruh ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum ! Phi buh ki jingkit halor ki met jngai ki briew , kiba eh ïa ka ban kit , hynrei Phi hi phim kner wat kawei ka shyiap kti ban ïarap ïa ki ban set ïa kita ki jingkit .
translation.en: And he said ,  Woe unto you also , ye lawyers ! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne , and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers .

translation.kha: U Judas u la mynjur ïa kata bad u la sdang ban khmih ïa ka kabu kaba biang ban aiti ïa U ju ha ki khlei ka jingtip jong u paidbah shaphang kata .
translation.en: And he promised , and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude .

translation.kha: Ki la ïalamwir ïa ki sha ki rangbah synshar ka Hima Rom bad ki la ong , Kine ki briew ki dei ki Jiw , bad ki la thaw jingkulmar ha ka nongbah jongno ngi .
translation.en: And brought them to the magistrates , saying , These men , being Jews , do exceedingly trouble our city ,
For was not Israel a derision unto thee ? was he found among thieves ? for since thou spakest of him , thou skippedst for joy .
translation.kha: Ko Moab , to kynmaw kumno pha rkhiebeiñ ïa ki paid Israel ? Pha la leh ïa ki kumba ki la ngat ha ka kynhun ki nonglute .

translation.en: And they buried Abner in Hebron : and the king lifted up his voice , and wept at the grave of Abner  ; and all the people wept .
translation.kha: La tep ïa u Abner ha Hebron , bad u syiem u ïam da kaba kyang jam ha ka jaka tep , bad ki briew baroh ki leh kumjuh .
Ym don kano nangno ha ka pyrthei Kaba lah ban ïanujor mala u , u dei u jingthaw u bym don jingsheptieng .
translation.en: Upon earth there is not his like , who is made without fear .
Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: And when ye shall come into the land , and shall have planted all manner of trees for food , then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised : three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you : it shall not be eaten of .
translation.kha: Ynda phi poi ha ri Kanaan bad thung ïa uno uno u jait diengsoh , ñiew ba u soh jong u , u long u bymkhuid haduh lai snem . Hapoh kane ka por phim dei ban bam ïa u .
Uwei pa uwei , babha khrong dara uba rit , u pyrshang ban shna pisa da ka jingbieit ; wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki thok ïa ki briew .
translation.en: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness  ; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely .

translation.kha: Lada phi pynlut ïa ka por ha kaba thiah , phin long uba duk . Ïai trei shitom bad phin ïoh kyrhai ka bam .
translation.en: Love not sleep , lest thou come to poverty  ; open thine eyes , and thou shalt be satisfied with bread .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kiaw ka por u la pynlong mraw ïa ki ban thoh tieng bad paki um ïa ki paid Israhaïah bad ïa ka duwan U TRAI’ . Haduh khnai ka sngi ki la ïai bteng ïa kane ka kam ha ka iaka kambah u Trai u la jied ban mane ïa u .
translation.en: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation , and for the altar of the  Lord  , even unto this day , in the place which he should choose .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka ki ud katai ki wad ei ei ban bam-im ; ki ïa-bujli ïa la ki jingkynshew na ka byndi ka jingbam ban pynsah im ïa lap . To khmih sha nga , A Trai , ka nongbah ka kyang ; to peitmat ïa nga ha ka jinglong rangli jong de .
translation.en: Mine eyes do fail with tears , my bowels are troubled , my liver is poured upon the earth , for the destruction of the daughter of my people  ; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city .

translation.kha: U Jeshua , u Lebi , lem bad ki khun shynrang bad ki ba-ha-ïing ja-um jong u bad u Kadmiel bad ki khun shynrang jong u ( na ka kur Hodabaïah ) , ki la ïashongsuk nur-um ha kaba khmih ïa ka jingtei biang ïa ka Templ . ( Ïa ki la ïarap da ki Lebi jong ka kur Henadad . )
translation.en: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren , Kadmiel and his sons , the sons of Judah , together , to set forward the workmen in the house of God : the sons of Henadad , with their sons and their brethren the Levites .

translation.kha: U na ba-ieit jong ngi u Tukhikos , u nongtrei uba lah ban shaniah bad u na shakri ha ka kam jyllang U Troas , un sa ai ïa phoi ka khubor baroh Shaphan jong nga .
translation.en: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you , who is a beloved brother , and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord :

translation.kha: Ka ju shon hapoh uwei u Dieng Tlai hapdeng ka Ramah bad ka Bethel ha ka ri lum Ephraim , bad ki paid Israhaïah ki ju leit hangta na ka bynta ki jingbishar jong ka .
translation.en: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth–el in mount Ephraim : and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment .
And he cometh , and findeth them sleeping , and saith unto Peter ,  Simon , sleepest thou ? couldest not thou watch one hour ?
translation.kha: Nangta u la wan phai pat bad u la shem ïa ki lai ngut ki synran ba ki ïohthiah . U la ong ha u Petros ,  Ko Simon , me ïohthiah ? Hato mem lah ban ïaishah bad nga wat tang shi kynta ?

translation.en: Simon answered and said , I suppose that he , to whom he forgave most . And he said unto him ,  Thou hast rightly judged .
translation.kha: Nga tharai ,  u Simon u la jubab ,  un long uta uba la ïohmap kham bun .   Me ong kaba dei ,  U Jisu u la ong .
Ki proberb u Solomon , u khun jrong u Dabid bad u syiem ki Ishmael .
translation.en: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David , king of Israel  ;

translation.kha: u la die ïa ka lyngkha ba u long trai , u la ïalam ïa ka peiñ , bad u la ai ha ki apostol .
translation.en: Having land , sold it , and brought the money , and laid it at the apostles  feet .

translation.kha: Khatduh eh u la paw hajuh ha nga — wat la nga long kum uta umbah la kha khlem biang por .
translation.en: And last of all he was seen of me also , as of one born out of due time .

translation.kha: U Simon u ong ha ki , Shah ngan buh ha phi kawei ka jingkyntip . Ngan tyngam ïa phi uwei pa uwei sei lyngdoh ka jaiñ linen bad laiphew riam ki jai baremdor lada phi lah ban batai ha na ïa ka jingmut jong ka ha shuwa ban kut Kine ki hynñiew sngi jong ka jingkhawai shongkurim . Ïathuh ha ngi ïa kata ka jingkyntip jong phiah , ki ong . To ai ba ngim ïohsngew ïa kata .
translation.en: But if ye cannot declare it me , then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments . And they said unto him , Put forth thy riddle , that we may hear it .

translation.kha: La pynïap ïa ki da ka jingbitar shla bad ki la sawdong ban ïaphylliew jingmut para ma ki ïa kaei ba ki lah ban leh ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And they were filled with madness  ; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus .
And I know that his commandment is life everlasting : whatsoever I speak therefore , even as the Father said unto me , so I speak .
translation.kha: Bad nga tip ba ka hukum jong u ka wallam ïa ka jingim bymjukut . Kaei kaba nga ong , namarkata , ka long kaei kaba U Kpa u la ïathuh ïa nga ban ong .

translation.en: And he coupled five curtains by themselves , and six curtains by themselves .
translation.kha: Ki bteng lang san tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba kin long tang kawei shi sut jingtap , bad ki leh kumjuh ïa ki hynriew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah .

translation.en: And Esau ran to meet him , and embraced him , and fell on his neck , and kissed him : and they wept .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Iso u mareh ban ïakynduh ïa u , u kdup ïa u , bad u doh ïa u . Ki ïa-ïam baroh ar ngut .
wai buaid da ka waiñ , ha kaba kan pyndeng ïa ph ; pynban , to long kiba la pyndap da U mynhynne .
translation.en: And be not drunk with wine , wherein is excess ; but be filled with the Spirit ;
And he took and sent messes unto them from before him : but Benjamin s mess was five times so much as any of theirs . And they drank , and were merry with him .
translation.kha: La sam jingbam ïa ki na ka miej u Joseph , bad ïa u Benjamin la sam san shah ban ïa uno uno na ki . Kumta keiñ ki la ïabam ïadih bad leh sngewbha bad u Joseph .

Phi la ïohsngew ïa por ba nga ong ha phi , ‘ Ngin sa leit noh , hynrei ngan sa wan pat sha phoi .’ Lada phi la ieit ïa nga , phin kmen namar ba ngan sa leit sha U kpa ; naba u long kham khraw ban ïa sa .
translation.en: Ye have heard how I said unto you , I go away , and come again unto you . If ye loved me , ye would rejoice , because I said , I go unto the Father : for my Father is greater than I .
Praising God , and having favour with all the people . And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved .

‘ Na kane ka pateng pyrman , yn ym ba-don uwei duh u ban ïuh leit rung ha Katai ka ri kaba seisoh ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki kjap tmier jong phi ,
translation.en: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land , which I sware to give unto your fathers ,

translation.kha: Ha ki sngi u Shamgar u khun jongno u Anath , Ha ki sngi jong ka Jael , Ki kynhun nongkhaïi kdor shym leit shuh lyngba ka ri , Bad ki nongleit jingleit ki pyndonkam ïa ki lynti na shadien .
translation.en: In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath , in the days of Jael , the highways were unoccupied , and the travellers walked through byways .

translation.kha: U Abraham u la tmain bha , bad U Troas u la krung ïa u ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u leh .
translation.en: And Abraham was old , and well stricken in age : and the  Lord  had blessed Abraham in all things .

translation.kha: To shongsah , ki la ong , mala to pule na ka kot kli ha me . Te u Barukh u la leh kumta .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Sit down now , and read it in our ears . So Baruch read it in their ears .
Jesus was a perfect human just like Adam .
translation.kha: U Jisu u long u briew u bajanai kum u Adam .

Phibi ïohi aïu U Blei u la kuna lyngba kane ka jingsngewsih jong phin : Katno ka la pynlong smat ïa phi . Katno phi kwah ban pynshisha ïa ka jinglong balui lui jong phi ! Kaba haduh katno ka jingsngew bitar , ka jingpait pyrman halor kaba la jia , nabar phi la sngur ka jingsngew , ka jingaiti , ka jingurlong ba la kloi ban pynshitom ïa ka jingleit bakla ! phi la pynpaw ïa lade kiba khlem bakla ha kane ka kad baroh .
translation.en: For behold this selfsame thing , that ye sorrowed after a godly sort , what carefulness it wrought in you , yea , what clearing of yourselves , yea , what indignation , yea , what fear , yea , what vehement desire , yea , what zeal , yea , what revenge ! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter .

translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane ban pynurlong shisha ïa kamai kaba u Asaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la lai nong , Ma u da lade hi u la shim ïa ki jingmihsnam jong ngi bad u la bah noh! ïa ki jingpang jong me .
translation.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying , Himself took our infirmities , and bare our sicknesses .
It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth .
translation.kha: Bad ka long kaba bha tam ban nang ïa kane ka jingïaishah ha ka jinglong samla jong ngi .
U Rehum ruh , u lat , bad u Shimshai , u sekretari jngai ka probins , ki thoh ïa kane ka shithi sha u Artakserksis na Jerusalem :
translation.en: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort :

translation.kha: Hato u briew u lah pun shla ïa ki blei jong u ? Em , lada u lai kumta , kin ym long shisha ki blei .
translation.en: Shall a man make gods unto himself , and they are no gods ?
But ye have borne the tabernacle of your Moloch and Chiun your images , the star of your god , which ye made to yourselves .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , namar ba phi la mane ïa ki durblei jong u Sakkuth , u blei syiem jong phi , bad ïa u Kaiwan , u blei khlur jong phi , phin hap ban kit ïa kito ki durblei

Ha ka por ka jingsynran u Akhaikos , u patsha ka Persia , u Bishlam , u Mithredath , u Betharbel nabar ki paralok jong ki , ki theh shithi sha u patsha . Ïa ka shithi la thoh ha ka ktien Aramaik bad ban pynkylla ktung ha ka por ba pule ïa ka .
translation.en: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam , Mithredath , Tabeel , and the rest of their companions , unto Artaxerxes king of Persia  ; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue , and interpreted in the Syrian tongue .

translation.kha: hynñiew ym don kano kano ka bymkhuid ka ban ïong sha ka nongbah , lymne uno uno wahbah leh ïa kino kino kiba sngewlehrain lane uba ïathuh lamler . Tang kito ïa kaba ki kyrteng jongngi ki la thoh ha ka kitab kaba im jong U Khunlangbrot kin ïohrung shuh kata ka nongbah .
translation.en: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth , neither whatsoever worketh abomination , or maketh a lie : but they which are written in the Lamb s book of life .
The sun shall be turned into darkness , and the moon into blood , before that great and notable day of the Lord come :
translation.kha: ïa ka sngi yn pyndum , bad u bnai un kylla saw kum ka snam , ha shuwa Ka Sngi kaba khraw bad kaba donburom jong U Trai ka wan .
Ngin sngewhun ha ki jingtlot , ki jingkrenbeiñ , ki jingjynjar , ki jingshoh pynshitom , bad ki jingeh na ka bynta U Khrist . Naba haba nga tlor , dei hangta ba nga khlei .
translation.en: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities , in reproaches , in necessities , in persecutions , in distresses for Christ s sake : for when I am weak , then am I strong .

translation.kha: Phim don jinglehburom ïa ki jaka bakhuid , bad phim sumar ïa ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: Thou hast despised mine holy things , and hast profaned my sabbaths .

translation.kha: hangtei hajuh , la don ka kynhied bah ki sniang , kiba ïamih jingbam ha ki sharing lum . Kumta ki ksuid ki la kyrthep ïa U Jisu don shah ïa ki ban rung shapoh ki sniang , bad u la shah ïa ki .
translation.en: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain : and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them . And he suffered them .

translation.kha: U Edom u shna da lade hi kawei ka waitlam erïong syrti kaba shi phut rynghang ka jingjrong . U teh ïa ka ha ka liang kamet jong u hapoh la ki jaiñkup .
translation.en: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges , of a cubit length  ; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh .
Therefore , my beloved brethren , be ye stedfast , unmoveable , always abounding in the work of the Lord , forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord .

U Moses u ong ha ki Israel , U Trai u la jied ïa u Beelsebul , u khwan jong u Iri pynlang u khun kseh jongngi u Hur , na ka jaiñjot Jehudi .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the children of Israel , See , the  Lord  hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah  ;
And Barnabas determined to take with them John , whose surname was Mark .
translation.kha: U Barnabas u la kwah ban ïalam ïa u Ïoannis Markos lem bad ki ,

translation.en: And God hearkened unto Leah , and she conceived , and bare Jacob the fifth son .
And he said , O  Lord  God of my master Abraham , I pray thee , send me good speed this day , and shew kindness unto my master Abraham .
translation.kha: U la duwai ,  A  Trai  , U Blei jong u kynrad jong nga u Abraham , to ai ka jingjop ïa nga mynta ka sngi bad to bat ïa la ka kular ïa u kynrad jong nga .
Ïa u syiem jong ka yn kit noh , kum ka thalab dieng halor um .
translation.en: As for Samaria , her king is cut off as the foam upon the water .

translation.en: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace , but of debt .
But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves , being not baptized of him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la kyntait ïa ka jingthmu jong U Blei na ka bynta jong ki hi bad ki la kyntait ban shah pynbaptis ha u Ïoannis .
Nangno ramhah ïa ki shabi ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad buh ïa ki ha khmat ka syntied ka Jutang , ha kaba nga ïashem bad me .
translation.en: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony , where I will meet with you .
And they shall not teach every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the Lord : for all shall know me , from the least to the greatest .
translation.kha: Yn ym don na ki u ban hikai ïa la u para shnong lane ong ïa la u para ri , ‘ To tip ïa U Trai .’ Namar baroh kin tip ïa nga , naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw tam .
U Trai u jong ha u Moses , Ngan pynlong ïa me kum U Blei ha u phar , bad u Aaron u hynmen jong me un kruiñ ha u kum u nongïathuhlypa jong me .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , See , I have made thee a god to Pharaoh : and Aaron thy brother shall be thy prophet .
Six of their names on one stone , and the other six names of the rest on the other stone , according to their birth .
translation.kha: katba kum ka jinglong hynmen para jong ki , hynriew na ki kyrteng jong ki ha uwei u mawkordor bad hynriew ha uwei pat u mawkordor .

Da ki ktien ka hukum nga pyntyllun ïa ka duriaw-bah .
translation.en: That saith to the deep , Be dry , and I will dry up thy rivers :

translation.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel : and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain in mount Gilboa .

translation.kha: U kynrad un ot ïa u lyngkhuh lyngkhai bad un pynjrong ïa u ban ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar jong ki riewspah’ . hangto un lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .
translation.en: And shall cut him asunder , and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .

translation.kha: U Moraïah u mih na ka ïingsyiem , ha ki jingphong syiem kiba jngum rong Bad balieh , ka barandi linen ba sawbthuh dara ka pansngiat ksiar ba-itynnat . nongthaw ki lynti bah ka Suah ki sawa da ki jingpyrta ïarieh jong ka jingkem .
translation.en: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white , and with a great crown of gold , and with a garment of fine linen and purple : and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u ong , Wat snep ha ki jingïada jong ka mynnor ne shongsah ha kaei kaba la jia slem mynshuwa .
translation.en: Remember ye not the former things , neither consider the things of old .

translation.kha: Lada ka kynthei ka bym bapaw shongkurim ka pynlong ka soskular , da kaba mut khñiang ne khlem da pyrkhat ban kyndon na kan kano bad nangta ka shongkurim ,
translation.en: And if she had at all an husband , when she vowed , or uttered ought out of her lips , wherewith she bound her soul  ;

translation.kha: Naba U Blang un ym pynim jinglehisynei ibha u bishar ïa u briew u bym shym la leh-isynei ; hynrei ka jinglehisynei ka jop nep halor ka jingbishar .
translation.en: For he shall have judgment without mercy , that hath shewed no mercy  ; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment .

These all died in faith , not having received the promises , but having seen them afar off , and were persuaded of them , and embraced them , and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth .
translation.kha: Dei ha ka jingngeit ba kine ki briew baroh ki la ïap . Kim shym la ïohpdiang ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba U Blei u la kular , hynrei na sha jngai ki ïohi ïa ki bad ki pdiang sngewbha ïa ki , bad ki la pynbna paidbah ba ki la long ki nongwei bad ki sohshnong ha kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Thy first father hath sinned , and thy teachers have transgressed against me .

translation.en: Ammiel the sixth , Issachar the seventh , Peulthai the eighth : for God blessed him .

translation.kha: Nga kyang jam ban ïor jingïarap , hynrei U Blei u kyntait ngab shahshkor ;
translation.en: Also when I cry and shout , he shutteth out my prayer .

translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u phah noh ïa u bad u thung ïa u kum u nongïalam ïa ki shihajar ki rangbah .
translation.en: Therefore Saul removed him from him , and made him his captain over a thousand  ; and he went out and came in before the people .

translation.kha: Ïa U tharai yn ym ïaroh da kiba ïahap , da kino kino kiba leit khar sha ka ri ka jingsngap jar .
translation.en: The dead praise not the  Lord  , neither any that go down into silence .

translation.kha: thaba ki rangbah ki la sdang ban tei ïa ka nongrim jongngi ka Templ , ki lyndang ha ki jingriam jong ki , ki ïeng ha la ki jaka bad ki turoi ha ki kti jongno ki , bad ki Lebi jong ka kur Asaph ki ïeng hangta ryngkat bad ki shakuriaw . Ki ïaroh ïa U Trai kat kum ki jingbthah ba la ai pateng naduh ka por u syiem Dabid .
translation.en: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the  Lord  , they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets , and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals , to praise the  Lord  , after the ordinance of David king of Israel .
Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour , and he was the son of an harlot : and Gilead begat Jephthah .
translation.kha: U Jephthah , u shipai bashlur na Gilead u dei u khun jong ka nuti . U kpa jong u , u Gilead
kawei ka leit shaphang Beth Horon , bad kawei pat ka lytar shaphang ka khappud na kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Seboim bun ïa ka ri khlaw .
translation.en: And another company turned the way to Beth–horon : and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la nang kham panpoh shuh shuh lehbha u la wang phai na kaba pynïap khatphra hajar ngut ki nongai Edom ha ka Them Mluh .
translation.en: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt , being eighteen thousand men .

Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken , and her high gates shall be burned with fire  ; and the people shall labour in vain , and the folk in the fire , and they shall be weary .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kynroh bakhlaiñ jong ka Babilon yn pyntwa haduh khyndew , bad ïa ki khyrdop bajrong jong ka yn thang noh . Ka jingtrei jong ki jaitbynriew baroh kam long ei ei ; ki jingpyrshang jong ki , ki kut ha ka ding . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh nga la kren .
To put ïa ka turoi halor u lum Seïon ; to ai ki hukum na ka bynta ka jingshah jinglah bad khot ïa ka jingïasoh bah !
translation.en: Blow the trumpet in Zion , sanctify a fast , call a solemn assembly :

translation.en: And if he have betrothed her unto his son , he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters .

translation.kha: u la ong , Ha khmih kato khrup ka Babilon ka long ! Nga la tei ïa ka kum ka nongbah jong per ban pyn-i ïa ka bor bad ka jingkhyllong jongngi nga , ka burom jong ang bad ka jinglong syiem jong nga .
translation.en: The king spake , and said , Is not this great Babylon , that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power , and for the honour of my majesty ?

translation.kha: U Trai , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki , u ïapoi phah ïa ki Nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki briew jong u , namar ba u kwah ban da ïa ki bad ïa ka templ .
translation.en: And the  Lord  God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers , rising up betimes , and sending  ; because he had compassion on his people , and on his dwelling place :

translation.kha: Te u Jakob u ong ha u Laban , Ka por ka la ktung noh ; to shahïap ba ngan shongkurim noh ïa ka khur jong phi .
translation.en: And Jacob said unto Laban , Give me my wife , for my days are fulfilled , that I may go in unto her .

translation.kha: Shi pynbha na ka lai bynta jong ki briew jyllang pha ktang ïap na ka jingpang bad jingthngan ha ka nongbah ; sei bynta pat kin ïap da ka tiensyiem shabar ka nongbah ; bad ïa ka shi bynta kaba dang sah ngan pynsakma sha ki sawlyer , bad ngan beh ïa ki kein da ka waitlam .
translation.en: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence , and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee : and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee  ; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds , and I will draw out a sword after them .

translation.kha: Hynrei kito kiba kaweh ba-bang riewspah ki hap ha ka jingpynshoi bad ki ngat ha ka jingri jong ki jingkhiah ba-bieit bad ki jingkhwan ïa-pyndap , kiba tian ïa ki sha ka jingjot bad ka jingpynjot .
translation.en: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare , and into many foolish and hurtful lusts , which drown men in destruction and perdition .

translation.kha: U Paul bad u manbha ki la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha Derbe bad ki la ïoh bun ki synran . Nongthaw ki la leit phai pat sha lytar , sha Ikoniom , bad nangta sha Akhaikos kaba ha Pisidia .
translation.en: And when they had preached the gospel to that city , and had taught many , they returned again to Lystra , and to Iconium , and Antioch ,
