Te ngan long uba iing ban ïaroh ïa me bad jingpdiang ba me la ïoh ka jingit da biar hi .
translation.en: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee .

translation.kha: Lada U Blei jong ki kpa jong na , U Blei jong u Abraham bad u Asaïah um shym la don ryngkat bad per , phin jin da la phah thylli ïa nga . Hynrei U Bela u la ïohi ïa ka jingjied jong nga bad ïa ka jingtrei ba la la pyndep , bad iehnoh mynmiet u la ai ïa ka jingbishar jong u .
translation.en: Except the God of my father , the God of Abraham , and the fear of Isaac , had been with me , surely thou hadst sent me away now empty . God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands , and rebuked thee yesternight .
But if ye cannot declare it me , then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments . And they said unto him , Put forth thy riddle , that we may hear it .
translation.kha: U Samson u ong ha ki ,  Shah ngan buh ha phi kawei ka jingkyntip . Ngan thong ïa phi uwei pa uwei shi lyngkhot ka jaiñ linen bad laiphew riam ki jaiñ baremdor lada phi lah ban batai ha nga ïa ka jingmut jong ka ha shuwa ban kut kine ki hynñiew sngi jong ka jingkhawai shongkurim .  Ïathuh ha ngi ïa kata ka jingkyntip jong phi ,  ki ong .  To ai ba ngin ïohsngew ïa kata .
sngewbit , khiew nang ïaid sha khmat , ngan nang bud suki suki , ban ïaid katba nga lah lem bad kine ki jingri dara ki khynnah hapoh ba ngi sa ïashem pat bad phi ha Edom .
translation.en: Let my lord , I pray thee , pass over before his servant : and I will lead on softly , according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure , until I come unto my lord unto Seir .

translation.kha: ka Siklag , ka Madmannah , ka Sanoah ,
translation.en: And Ziklag , and Madmannah , and Sansannah ,

translation.kha: Ko khwan , jingñiewburom ïa U Trai pynlang burom ïa u syiem . Wat leh ei ei dara ki briew kiba ïingjaiñ ïaleh pyrthuh ïa ki ;
translation.en: My son , fear thou the  Lord  and the king : and meddle not with them that are given to change :

translation.kha: katno katne lwet ki Arab ki la leit lute bad pynïap ïa baroh ki khun shynrang jong u Jehoram wai noh u Ahasaïah , uba khatduh . Te mynta ki bynriew ka Jerusalem ki thum ïa u Ahasaïah Kum u syiem ba mih bujli ïa u kpa jong u .
translation.en: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead : for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest . So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned .

translation.kha: Kito ki nongïathuhlypa balei , ki kren shaphang kiei kiei ki jongnga ka pyrthei , bad ka pyrthei ka shahshkor ïa ki , namar ki long ki jong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: They are of the world : therefore speak they of the world , and the world heareth them .
Wherefore if Demetrius , and the craftsmen which are with him , have a matter against any man , the law is open , and there are deputies : let them implead one another .
translation.kha: Lada u Demetrios bad ki nongtrei jong u ki don ka jingmudui pyrshah ïano ïano , ngi don ki bor synshar bad ki sngi kiba thikna ïa ka ïingbishar ; ïa ki jingmudui lah ban leh hangta .
U Jonathan u jubab , U Bela un ym shah ba phan Shi ïap ! I pa i da ïathuh shuwa ha nga ïa kaei kaei ba i leh , kaba dumok ne ka bymdonkam , bad im ju buhrieh ïa kane na nga : Kam long kaba shisha !
translation.en: And he said unto him , God forbid  ; thou shalt not die : behold , my father will do nothing either great or small , but that he will shew it me : and why should my father hide this thing from me ? it is not so .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyrpad jong me na ka bynta u Ishmael , kumin sam kyrkhu ïa u bad ngan ai ha u shibun ki khun ki ksiew . Un long u kparad lad ki khat-ar ngut ki khun syiem , bad ngan pynbang ka jingïohipaw kabu khlaw na ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translation.en: And as for Ishmael , I have heard thee : Behold , I have blessed him , and will make him fruitful , and will multiply him exceedingly  ; twelve princes shall he beget , and I will make him a great nation .
Go and tell Hananiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood  ; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron .
translation.kha: ban leit bad ong ha u Hananaïah :  U  Trai  u la ong ba me lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor dieng , hynrei un bujli ïa ka da ka lyngkor nar .

translation.en: In a dream , in a vision of the night , when deep sleep falleth upon men , in slumberings upon the bed  ;
translation.kha: Mynmiet haba ki briew ki dang ïohthiah , U Blei u kren ha ki jingphohsniew bad jingïohipaw .
uwei ha katai ka tduh Bad uwei ha kawei paw ka tduh jong ka jingtap , bad pynlong ïa ki ba kin i kumba ki ïadait lang malade kata ka jingtap .
translation.en: And make one cherub on the one end , and the other cherub on the other end : even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof .

translation.kha: Bohan na ki , ki la ngeit , bad bun ki kynthei Grik Ibbah ha ka kyrni ba-halor ha ka imlang ka shngain bad bun ki rangbah Grik ruh ki la beit .
translation.en: Therefore many of them believed  ; also of honourable women which were Greeks , and of men , not a few .
And all nations shall call you blessed : for ye shall be a delightsome land , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Te ki briew jong ki hima baroh kin khot ïa phi kiba suk , namar ka ri jong phi kan long ka jaka kaba bha ban shong ban sah .

Naba u Ïoanna u Nongpynbaptis u la wan ha phi da kaba pyn-i ha phira ïa ka lynti ïaid kaba dei , bad tv shym la ngeit ïa u ; hynne ki nonglum khajna bad ki nuti ki la ngeit ïa u . Wat haba phi la ïohi ïa kane , phim shym la kylla ïa la ki jingat dadien bad jingieit ïa u .
translation.en: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness , and ye believed him not : but the publicans and the harlots believed him : and ye , when ye had seen it , repented not afterward , that ye might believe him .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong biang ha u Moses , Mynta ba me leit phai sha Ijipt , da kynmaw shun ar ha khmat u Pharaoh ïa ki kambah baroh babha nga la ai ha me ïa ka hab ban leh . Hynrei sam pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad un ym shah ïa u paidbah shun longing .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , When thou goest to return into Egypt , see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh , which I have put in thine hand : but I will harden his heart , that he shall not let the people go .

translation.kha: “lada mem thir , ngan pynthnam ïa me da kiba phah ïa ki saiñ sha me , shwa ki rangbah synshar jong me , bad sha ki briew jyllang me . Ki ïing jong ki nong ibieit bad ka madan madiah baroh’ kmen dap da ki shaiñ ïadat .
translation.en: Else , if thou wilt not let my people go , behold , I will send swarms of flies upon thee , and upon thy servants , and upon thy people , and into thy houses : and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies , and also the ground whereon they are .

translation.kha: Minnith buh ïa u khiew ïong ba suda halor ki rnga bad ai ba un nongïalap . Te u khiew un long ba la pynkhuid ha ka jinglehniam sa shisien hadien ba ka sarang ka la ing lut ,
translation.en: Then set it empty upon the coals thereof , that the brass of it may be hot , and may burn , and that the filthiness of it may be molten in it , that the scum of it may be consumed .

translation.kha: Ko hynñiew ko para jngai nga , u la ong , ka Jingkhot Bakhuid ka dei ban urlong shisha ha kabu U Mynsiem Bakhuid u kren lyngba u Dabid , u la pynlong ka jingïathuh lypa shaphang u Judas , uba la un-long u nongaikam ïa kito ibha la kem ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: Men and brethren , this scripture must needs have been fulfilled , which the Holy Ghost by the mouth of David spake before concerning Judas , which was guide to them that took Jesus .

translation.kha: Pyntreikam ïa kaei kaba phin la nang bad ïohpdiang na nga , na ki ktien jong ang bad ki kam jong nga . Bad U Blei uba ai ha ngi ka jingsuk , un long lem bad phi .
translation.en: Those things , which ye have both learned , and received , and heard , and seen in me , do : and the God of peace shall be with you .
And hereby we know that we are of the truth , and shall assure our hearts before him .
translation.kha: Kane , te , ka long kumno ngin tip ba ngi long ki jong ka jingshisha ; kane ka long kumno ngin sngewskhem ha khmat U Blei .
U Trai u long uba khraw bad wahbah eh de shun ïaroi ; ïa u dei ïa-ban ai ka barim palat ban ïa kiwei! ki bleithaw baroh .
translation.en: For great is the  Lord  , and greatly to be praised : he also is to be feared above all gods .

translation.kha: Phin ïew jingjop ha baroh kiei khie bakha phi leh , bad ka jingshai kan shai ha ka lynti ïaid jong phira .
translation.en: Thou shalt also decree a thing , and it shall be established unto thee : and the light shall shine upon thy ways .

translation.kha: Ynda U Blei u la thep ïakren bad u Abraham , u iehnoh ïa u .
translation.en: And he left off talking with him , and God went up from Abraham .

translation.kha: Lada u leh pah pyrshah ïa Phin hynñiew sien ha ka shi snoh , bad man ka por u wan sha phiah da katba ong , ‘ nga kylla-kaba-mut ,’ phi dei ban Kartah ïa u .
translation.en: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day , and seven times in a day turn again to thee , saying , I repent  ; thou shalt forgive him .

translation.kha: Naba nga nang peit ïa kita ki saw thylli ki jingthaw , nga la ïohi saw tylli ki shalyntem ba ki hiar ha ka khyndew , kawei kaweh marsyndah bad ki .
translation.en: Now as I beheld the living creatures , behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures , with his four faces .

translation.kha: Naba ka Hukum u Moses kada lah ban pynlong janai ïa kano kano . Bad mynta la ai ïa ka jingkyrmen kaba khem beh da kaba ngi lah ban wan sha jan U Blei .
translation.en: For the law made nothing perfect , but the bringing in of a better hope did  ; by the which we draw nigh unto God .

translation.kha: Ha ka por mynmiet ki leit sha ki kram bad sha ki tare tep ban ïasyllok bad ki mynsiem jong kiba ïap . Ki bam doh sniang Bad ki dih ïa ka syrti ba la shet da ka doh ba la ai jingkñia sha ki Blei thalab .
translation.en: Which remain among the graves , and lodge in the monuments , which eat swine s flesh , and broth of abominable things is in their vessels  ;

translation.kha: U Trai u pynïaid ïa ka jingmut jong u syiem kham suk dom u pynïoh ïa ka lynti ka wahduid .
translation.en: The king s heart is in the hand of the  Lord  , as the rivers of water : he turneth it whithersoever he will .

translation.kha: Shu ïai-ong ‘ Nonghikai’ lin ‘ Em’ — kano kano kawei pateng kambah ph ong ka wei na Uta uba Sniew .
translation.en: But let your communication be , Yea , yea  ; Nay , nay : for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil .

translation.kha: len sa pynlong ïa ka ri ka jaka kynjah , bad ka bor kob ki ju sngewsarong katta thar kan sa kut noh . Ki lumbah ka Israel kin long khlaw kynha ba ym don uba nud ban leit jinglanot lyngba jong ki .
translation.en: For I will lay the land most desolate , and the pomp of her strength shall cease  ; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate , that none shall pass through .
And Abraham took sheep and oxen , and gave them unto Abimelech  ; and both of them made a covenant .
translation.kha: Nangta u Abraham u la ai katto katne tylli ki langbrot bad ki masi ha u Abimelekh , bad kine baroh ar ngut ki ïateh kular .
U Jisu u la jubab ïa u , Mem sngewthuh satia mynta ïa kamai kaba nga leh , hynmen Leit sa sngewthuh hadien .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  What I do thou knowest not now  ; but thou shalt know hereafter .
Hath a nation changed their gods , which are yet no gods ? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit .
translation.kha: Ym don kano kano kawei pat ka jaitbynriew kaba kylla ïa la ki blei , wat la kim dei kiba shisha . Hynrei ki briew jong nga ki la bujli ïa nga , U Blei uba la wanrah ha ki ka jingpyndonburom , da ki blei ki bym lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki .
U Moses u la jubab , Wat pynsheptieng ! Ïeng skhem , bad phyrnai sa ïohi une U Trai un leh mynba ka sngaid ban pyllait im ïa phi ; lano lano ruh phira ym ïohthiah shuh ïa kine ki nong Ijipt .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the people , Fear ye not , stand still , and see the salvation of the  Lord  , which he will shew to you to day : for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day , ye shall see them again no more for ever .

And the  Lord  said unto Samuel , Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee : for they have not rejected thee , but they have rejected me , that I should not reign over them .
translation.kha: bad U  Trai  u ong ,  Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba u paidbah u ong ha me ; mem long ma me uba ki kyntait , Nga long ma nga ïa uba ki la kyntait kum u syiem jong ki .
Kaei kaba me ïoh na nga ka kham bha ban ïa ka ksar banylla , ka khem beh don ïa ka rupa kaba kynsai .
translation.en: My fruit is better than gold , yea , than fine gold  ; and my revenue than choice silver .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la ïathuhlypa kumba u la bthah ïa nga . Ka jingpynhiar mynsiem ka la rung ha kita ki met , bad ki la khie im bad ki la ainong jwat . Ki la ïabun bah na ki kat ban pynlong ka kynhun shipai .
translation.en: So I prophesied as he commanded me , and the breath came into them , and they lived , and stood up upon their feet , an exceeding great army .

translation.kha: Ka la long bania khat-ar baje haba ka sngi ka la sangeh ban tyngkreiñ bad ka jingdum ka la tap ïa ka ri baroh kiwei haw to baje ;
translation.en: And it was about the sixth hour , and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour .

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , ngi hukum ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist ibha U Trai jong ngi ban kiar noh na ki bangeit baroh kiba im ka jingim bajaipdeh bad ki bym bud ïa ki jingïathuh kiba ngi ai ha ki .
translation.en: Now we command you , brethren , in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly , and not after the tradition which he received of us .

translation.kha: Kumta u Abram u kynjri noh ïa la ka dara , bad u ïan shong wan sah hajan ki dieng kyntang jong u Mamre ha Hebron , bad hangta u tei ka duwan ha U Trai .
translation.en: Then Abram removed his tent , and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre , which is in Hebron , and built there an altar unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la dem ïa lade ha ka jaka shon shaniah jong ka Esther ban kyrpad na ka bynta ka jingisynei . Haba u syiem u wan phai pat shapoh kamra na ki kpa , haba u ïohi ïa kane , u syiem u pyrta jam , Hato une u briew un leh be-ijot ïa ka mahadei hangne hi ha khmat jong nga , ha ka ïingsyiem jong nga ? U syiem um pateng kut bha ka jingkren , ba ki ïunukh ki tap ïa ka khlieh u Haman .
translation.en: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine  ; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was . Then said the king , Will he force the queen also before me in the house ? As the word went out of the king s mouth , they covered Haman s face .
But he denied , saying , I know not , neither understand I what thou sayest . And he went out into the porch  ; and the cock crew .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la len ïa kata .  Ngam tip . . . ngam sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba pha kren ,  u la jubab , bad u la leit noh sha ka baranda . Hamar kata ka por u syiar u la kyn-ih .

translation.en: And they asked him , saying , Master , but when shall these things be ? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass ?
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la kylli ,  lano kane kan jia ? Bad kaei ka ban jia khnang ban pyn-i ba ka por ka la poi ïa ka ba kan jia ?
U thri u kruiñ ha u Jeush u Nongïathuhlypa , u khun jong u Hanani bad ai ha u ïa kane ka khubor na ka bynta u Baasha :
translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha , saying ,

translation.kha: Te U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Ngan leh thik kumta kumba me la kyrpad , namar por tip ba ïa me , bad la sngewlah ïa me .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken : for thou hast found grace in my sight , and I know thee by name .

translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah hynriewphew ar sner .
translation.en: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years : and he died .
Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons : and the rest of Manasseh s sons had the land of Gilead .
translation.kha: namar ba ki khun ki ksiew kynthei jong u bad ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u ki la ïoh jaka . Ïa ka ri Gilead la ai ha kiba sah jong ki khun ki ksiew u Manasseh .
ibha ki paidbah ki la ïoh ïa kane ka kambah naba U Jisu u la leh , ki la ong , Da shisha une u long u nongïathuhlypa , kiba la dei ban wan shai ka pyrthei !
translation.en: Then those men , when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did , said , This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world .

translation.kha: Te ki syiem jong ka pyrthei , ki nongsynshar bad ki lapbah shipai , kiba Rispah bad uba donbor , bad kiwei pat ki briew baroh , ki mradkhlaw ne katba laitluid , ki la buhrieh ïa lade ha ki krem bad ha ki synrang maw ba-don ha ki lum .
translation.en: And the kings of the earth , and the great men , and the rich men , and the chief captains , and the mighty men , and every bondman , and every free man , hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains  ;

translation.kha: Ngi nongtuh borabor ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong phi baroh bad ngi ïai kynmaw ïa pa borabor ha ki jingïohi jong ngi .
translation.en: We give thanks to God always for you all , making mention of you in our prayers ;

translation.kha: Lada phi tyngkhuh ïa U Trai U Bel jong Phi bad leh kato ïa kaba u hukum , un pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong u hi , bania u la kular .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall establish thee an holy people unto himself , as he hath sworn unto thee , if thou shalt keep the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , and walk in his ways .

translation.kha: Nga la longïng kum u dieng babha ki thied ki ïoh um borabor bad uba ki tnat ki jhieh da ki thurmur .
translation.en: My root was spread out by the waters , and the dew lay all night upon my branch .
Children : “Children , be obedient to your parents in union with the Lord .”—Ephesians 6 :1 .
translation.kha: Ki khun : “Phi ki khun to kohnguh ia la ki kmie ki kpa ha U Trai .” —Ephesos 6 :1 .
Ha ka sngi kaba lai , u Joseph u ong ha ki , Nga long u briew umbah sheptieng Blei , kumta ngan pyllait im ïa pa’ ha kane ka kyntien :
translation.en: And Joseph said unto them the third day , This do , and live  ; for I fear God :

translation.kha: Ki ïoh shibun ki tnga bad ki khun , ïaheh ba ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki lah ban pynmih Laiphew hynriew ïahiar nongput ki rangïapom na ka bynta ka kam shipai .
translation.en: And with them , by their generations , after the house of their fathers , were bands of soldiers for war , six and thirty thousand men : for they had many wives and sons .

translation.kha: Ka bymmyntoi , ka bymmyntoi , ong u stad saiñpyrkhat . Baroh ka long ka bymmyntoi .
translation.en: Vanity of vanities , saith the preacher  ; all is vanity .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Khubor Baalah la kular la slem bah da U Blei lyngkha ki nongïathuhlypa jong u , kumba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh bakhyndai .
translation.en: ( Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures , )

translation.kha: Nga la phah ïa ka lynter khluit ban pyntyrkhong ïa ki jingthung jong phi . Ki puit ki la bam duh ïa baroh ki kdup bad bri sohwaiñ jong phi , ki dieng dumok bad ki dieng Olib jongki phi . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai patar sha nga .
translation.en: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew : when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased , the palmerworm devoured them : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
And now , O Lord our God , that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand , and hast gotten thee renown , as at this day  ; we have sinned , we have done wickedly .
translation.kha: A Trai U Blei jong ngi , me la pyn-i ïa ka bor jong me da kaba wallam noh ïa ki briew jong me na ri Ijipt , bad ïa ka bor jong me la ïai kynmaw . Ngi la leh pop ; ngi la leh bakla .

translation.en: Have ye not known ? have ye not heard ? hath it not been told you from the beginning ? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ? Hato ym shym la ïathuh slem mynshuwa ? Hato phim shym ïohsngew kumno ka pyrthei ka sdang ?
Kiar na kaba sniew bad ïadih beit sha kham . Wat jam palat na ka lynti naba dei .
translation.en: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left : remove thy foot from evil .

translation.kha: Ka kynhun Jeraïah baroh ka la mihnoh na ka ri shyiap Sin , da kabu ïasaid na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat ka jaka kat kum ka Hukum U Tlai . Ki la sher dara ha Rehum , hynrei ym ne umdih hangta .
translation.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin , after their journeys , according to the commandment of the  Lord  , and pitched in Rephidim : and there was no water for the people to drink .
In those days , and at that time , will I cause the Branch of righteousness to grow up unto David  ; and he shall execute judgment and righteousness in the land .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan jied kum u syiem ïa u nonghiarpateng uba hok na u Dabid . Uta u syiem un leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba hok ha ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said , Thou shalt love thy neighbour , and hate thine enemy .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Ieit ïa ki paralok jong phi bad isih ïa ki nongshun jong phi .’

translation.en: And it came to pass , when she was in hard labour , that the midwife said unto her , Fear not  ; thou shalt have this son also .
translation.kha: Haba ki jingsuh kha ki la thar eh , ka nongpynkha khun ka ong ïa ka ,  Wat sheptieng , ko Rakhel ; u dei sa uwei pat u shynrang .
Un bat ïa ka jingïakut ba u la pynlong bad u Abiram bad ïa ka kular bad u Iskah .
translation.en: Which covenant he made with Abraham , and his oath unto Isaac  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei shitom katto katne ni , ka jingjia kaba phylla tud sa wan jia .
translation.en: Soon , though , an amazing event will take place .

translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ka , ka kynthup ïa ka Helkath , ka Hali , ka Beten , ka Akhshaph ,
translation.en: And their border was Helkath , and Hali , and Beten , and Achshaph ,
Wherefore if they shall say unto you , Behold , he is in the desert  ; go not forth : behold , he is in the secret chambers  ; believe it not .
translation.kha: Lane , lada ki briew kin ïathuh ïa phi , ‘ Ha khmih , u don ha ka ri shyiap !’ — wat leit shata , lane lada ki ong , ‘ Ha khmih , u rieh hangne !’ — wat ngeit ïa kata .

translation.en: Therefore , brethren , we are debtors , not to the flesh , to live after the flesh .
translation.kha: Te kumta , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ngi don ka kamram kaba ngi dei ban leh , hynrei kam dei ïa ngi ban im kat kum ka jingkwah jong ka jinglong ba kynja doh jong ngi .

translation.en: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth : and there is none that holdeth with me in these things , but Michael your prince .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Hato me tip balei ba nga la wan sha me ? Ka long ban pynpaw ha me ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha ka Kitab ka Jingshisha . Mynta nga dei ban leit noh pat bad ban ïaleh ïa u angel ïada jong ka Persia . Hadien kata , u angel ïada jong ka Gris un mihpaw . Ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa nga lait noh u Mikhael , u angel ïada jong ka Israel .

translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Khie leit phai bad ïathuh ïa u Ïoannis ïa kaei kaba phi ïohsngew bad ïohi :
Ki snep ha ka kpoh jngai u ki long kum ki syrwiang khiew kiba nep ; ki tyrha ïa ka madan ktieh kumba long ka lyngngoh shoh kew .
translation.en: Sharp stones are under him : he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka por ki Israel ki la tlot palat na ka jingthngan , bad kumta ki la kynrup ïa kata kaba ki la ïohknieh na ki nongshun , ki la shimti ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri , ki la pynpyut ïa ki hangta , bad ki la baibam ïa ka doh naba dang don snam hapoh jyllang ka .
translation.en: And the people flew upon the spoil , and took sheep , and oxen , and calves , and slew them on the ground : and the people did eat them with the blood .
Honour thy father and thy mother , as the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee  ; that thy days may be prolonged , and that it may go well with thee , in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
translation.kha: ‘ Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie , kumba nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , nga hukum ïa phi , khnang ba phin manbha bad im slem ha kata ka ri ba nga ai ha phi .

translation.en: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly unto you , that I also may be of good comfort , when I know your state .
translation.kha: Lada ka long ka mon U Trai , nga kyrmen ba nga lah ban phah shen sha phi ïa u Timothi , khnang ba nga lah ban ïoh ka jingpynshlur da ka khubor shaphang jong phi .
U Joab u la Hukum ban put ïa ka tyrwa ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingïaleh , bad ki shipai jong u , ki wan phai na kaba beh khongpong ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And Joab blew the trumpet , and the people returned from pursuing after Israel : for Joab held back the people .

translation.kha: dara ïa ki jaiñphong kiba jinghun ba ki lyngdoh ki dei ban kup ha ka Katta Kyntang — ki jabieng babha kynthah na ka bynta u Aaron u lyngdoh bad ïa ki khun shynriah jong u .
translation.en: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and his sons  garments , to minister in the priest s office .

translation.kha: Ka ktien U Blei ka long kaba im bad kaba donbor , kaba khap nep-syiad ban ïa kano kano ka waitlam ïinglieng syier . Ka pei lyngba shawkad kaba ka jingim bad ka mynsiem ki ïakynduh , shaduh kaba ki mut bad ki khleiñ shyieng ki ïakynduh lang . Ka bishar ïa ki jingkwah bad ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ka dohnud u briew .
translation.en: For the word of God is quick , and powerful , and sharper than any twoedged sword , piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit , and of the joints and marrow , and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart .

translation.kha: Kan long kiba pawnam pangnud ki jyrthiaw , uwei pa uwei uba iohi ïa ki un tip ba ki Long ki briew ïa kiba nga la kyrhai .
translation.en: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles , and their offspring among the people : all that see them shall acknowledge them , that they are the seed which the  Lord  hath blessed .
Then Jesse called Abinadab , and made him pass before Samuel . And he said , Neither hath the  Lord  chosen this .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jesse u khot ïa u Abinadab u khun jong u bad u wan ïalam ïa u sha u Samuel . Hynrei u Samuel u ong ,  Em , U  Trai  um shym la jied ïa une ruh .
Yn ym to jingjop hangta , ym don ki ñiad bashyrkhei ki ban ïaid na kata ka lynti . Kynton ïa kiba U Trai u la phlait im ngin ïaid sha ïing na sier ka lynti .
translation.en: No lion shall be there , nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon , it shall not be found there  ; but the redeemed shall walk there :

translation.kha: bad u Asaraïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , uba jingkahtngen na u Sadok , u ong ha u , Nahum ba ki briew ki sdang ba wanrah ïa ki jingai jong ki shiah ka Templ , kaba la don , ka la biang ban bam bad kaba sai tad ka long kaba bun . Ngi to ïa kane baïar namar U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa ki brisoh jong u .
translation.en: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him , and said , Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the  Lord  , we have had enough to eat , and have left plenty : for the  Lord  hath blessed his people  ; and that which is left is this great store .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai , u la Iohi ïa ki ba ki bud ïa u , bad u la kyllan , Phi ïawad aiñ ? Ki la jingbabe ïa u , Hangno me sah , ko Rabbi ? ( Kane ka kyntien ka mut U Nonghikai . )
translation.en: Then Jesus turned , and saw them following , and saith unto them ,  What seek ye ?  They said unto him , Rabbi , ( which is to say , being interpreted , Master , ) where dwellest thou ?
Fear not , little flock  ; for it is your Father s good pleasure to give you the kingdom .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng , ko kynhun barit , naba U Kpa jong phi u la sngewbha ban ai ha phi ïa ka Hima .
U Trai u la ong ha at ,
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab , every one shall howl : for the foundations of Kir–hareseth shall ye mourn  ; surely they are stricken .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Moab kin lynñiar namar ki jingjynjar ba ki shah . Baroh kin ïam haba ki kynmaw ïa ka jingbam babha kaba ki ju bam ha ka nongbah jong ka Kir Heres . Yn beh ïa ki baroh sha ka jingduh jingkyrmen .

Nabynta kaei nga shiah nga jynjar kumne baroh , Hynrei nga ba-dap da ka jingsngem , namar nga thup hano nga la shaniah , bad nga sngewthikna ba u lah ban Sumar skhem haduh kata ka sngur ïa Kiei kabu u la aiti ha nga .
translation.en: For the which cause I also suffer these things : nevertheless I am not ashamed : for I know whom I have believed , and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day .
But now is Christ risen from the dead , and become the firstfruits of them that slept .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingshisha ka long ba ïa U Khrist la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , kum ka jingbahkhlieh ba ïa kito kiba la ïap yn sa pynmihpat ruh ïa ki .
To ai ki jingkhublei jongu I sha baroh ki nongïalam jong phi bad sha ki bhabriew jong U Blei baroh . Ki phyrngab jong ngi na Italy ki phah ki jingkhublei jong ki ïa Phin .
translation.en: Salute all them that have the rule over you , and all the saints . They of Italy salute you .
And in his name shall the Gentiles trust .
translation.kha: bad ha u ki briew baroh kin buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ki .

U kyrwep ruh bun bah ka rnong na Taphath bun Kun , ki nongbah ba synshar u Hadadeser . ( U Simon hadien u pyndonkam ïa kane ka rnong ha kaba thaw ïa ka pung-um , ki rishot , bad ki khiew rong na ka bynta ka Tubal . )
translation.en: Likewise from Tibhath , and from Chun , cities of Hadarezer , brought David very much brass , wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea , and the pillars , and the vessels of brass .

translation.kha: Hato ngi shym la ong lypa ha pa’ shuwa ba ngin mih ba kane kan sa jia ? Ngi la ong ïa phi ban ym pynsaja ïa ngi bad ban shahshkor ïa i'u ban ïailong ki mraw jong ki nong Ijipt . Kan jin da la kham bha ban long ki mraw hangta ban ïa kaba ïap hangne ha ri shyiap .
translation.en: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt , saying , Let us alone , that we may serve the Egyptians ? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians , than that we should die in the wilderness .

translation.kha: len ïaw buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ar ha me , ngan ïaroh ïa me shuh shuh .
translation.en: But I will hope continually , and will yet praise thee more and more .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ka ktien U Blei ka la nang phriang bad nang roi .
translation.en: But the word of God grew and multiplied .

translation.kha: Nga la plie ïa ka jaka ha kaba la buh ïa ki atiar jong nga , bad ha ka jingbitar nga la shim neh ïa ki , namar ma nga , U Tlai nongsynran Badonbor Bakhraw , ar to ka kam ban leh ha Babilonia .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath opened his armoury , and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation : for this is the work of the Lord  God  of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans .

translation.kha: Ki nongthain Samaria ki mih shaba bad ki leit lute ïa ka jaka shong dara ki Syria . Bad kumba U Trai u la lah kriah , lai kilo u kew naba bha Tam lane hynriew kylla u barli la die ha ka dor shi sbiar rupa .
translation.en: And the people went out , and spoiled the tents of the Syrians . So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel , and two measures of barley for a shekel , according to the word of the  Lord .

And when ye reap the harvest of your land , thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest , neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest : thou shalt leave them unto the poor , and to the stranger : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Haba phi lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi , wat ot ïa u kew uba ha tduh jong ki lyngkha , bad wat leit kylla dien ban khar ïa ki sohkew kiba sah ; ieh ïa ki na ka bynta kiba duk bad ki nongwei ; Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done , shew them the form of the house , and the fashion thereof , and the goings out thereof , and the comings in thereof , and all the forms thereof , and all the ordinances thereof , and all the forms thereof , and all the laws thereof : and write it in their sight , that they may keep the whole form thereof , and all the ordinances thereof , and do them .
translation.kha: Te lada ki sngewlehrain ïa kaei kaba ki la leh , sa batai ïa ka jingthmu jong ka Templ ha ki : Ïa ka jingpynwandur jong ka , ïa ki khyrdop jingrung bad jingmih jong ka , ïa ka dur jong ka , ïa ka jingbuhbeit ryntih ïa kiei kiei baroh bad ïa baroh ki aiñ . To thoh ïa kane baroh na ka bynta jong ki khnang ba ki lah ban ïohi kumno ïa kiei kiei baroh la buh ryntih bad ba lah ban pyndep ïa baroh ki aiñ .
Don ki briew babha la phai dien noh na kine bad ki la jah lynti ha ki jingïatainia ba-bieit .
translation.en: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling ;

translation.kha: daiñ paw phyrngab manna ka mynstep baroh ki bynriew ki la saw Sha ka Templ ban sngap ïa u .
translation.en: And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple , for to hear him .
So , as much as in me is , I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also .
translation.kha: Kumta te , nga kwah hir hir ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi ruh kiba shong ha Rom .
Wat lada ki tait ïa ka lynti jong ki Shabeh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ngan kem ïa ki . Wat ïada ki kiew sha bneng , ngan patan ïa ki shapoh .
translation.en: Though they dig into hell , thence shall mine hand take them  ; though they climb up to heaven , thence will I bring them down :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u , Lada nga mon ïa u ba un im tad ynda de wan , ka phler aïu ïa me ? To bud ïa nga !
translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  If I will that he tarry till I come , what is that to thee ? follow thou me .
And when Paul would have entered in unto the people , the disciples suffered him not .
translation.kha: U Paul hi u la kwah ban leit ha khmat u paidbah , hynrei ki parabangeit kim shah ïa u .
Ki shynrang ki dei ban ieit ïa ki tnat jong ki kamar ki ieit ïa la ki jong ki kun . U shynrang kaba ieit ïa la ka tnga u ieit ïa laiñ hi .
translation.en: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies . He that loveth his wife loveth himself .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba dei eh ba U blem , uba thaw bad pynrieh ïa kiei kiei baroh , un pynlong ïa U Josis ibha janai lyntang ka jingshah shitom , khnang ban pynwan ïa kiba bun ki ïakhun ban ïoh bynta ha ka burom jong u . Namar U Jisu u long uta uba ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingpynim .
translation.en: For it became him , for whom are all things , and by whom are all things , in bringing many sons unto glory , to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings .

translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u wan ïalam ïa u Jobab u kpa jong u malu u pynithuh ïa u ha u syiem . U Jakob u kylla kyrdoh ïa u syiem ,
translation.en: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father , and set him before Pharaoh : and Jacob blessed Pharaoh .
He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner , whose house is by the sea side : he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do .
translation.kha: Une u sah shipor ha ka ïing u nongpdem snieh uba kyrteng u Simon , uba shong basah harud duriaw .

translation.en: Feed the flock of God which is among you , taking the oversight thereof , not by constraint , but willingly  ; not for filthy lucre , but of a ready mind  ;
translation.kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi ban long ki nongsharai ïa ka kynhun ïa kaba U Blei u la ai ha phi bad ban sumar ïa ka da ka mon sngewbha , kumba U Blei u kwah ïa phi , bad ym da kaba shu pynbor . Trei ïa la ka kam , ym tang na ka bynta ka bainong , hynrei na ka jingthrang ban shakri .

translation.en: And ye shall sow the eighth year , and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year  ; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store .
translation.kha: Haba phi bet ha ki lyngkha ha ka snem kaba phra , phin nang bam ïa kaei kaba la ot ha ka snem kaba hynriew , bad phin dang don kyrhai ban bam haduh ba phin da ot ïa u jingthung ha kata ka snem .

Lane to pyrkhat ïa ka lieng kaba heh : La ka haw Katto katno bad la pynïaid ïa ka da ki reng bakynja , la ñiad ïa ka da u boitha uba rit eh , Bad ka ïaid kat shaba u nongking lieng u mon ba kan leit .
translation.en: Behold also the ships , which though they be so great , and are driven of fierce winds , yet are they turned about with a very small helm , whithersoever the governor listeth .

translation.kha: Nga don ha ka liang jong phi , bad ngan pynthikna ba yn lur biang ïa ka khñiot jong phi bad ïa ki symbai yn rung hangthie .
translation.en: For , behold , I am for you , and I will turn unto you , and ye shall be tilled and sown :
Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury  ; and I , even I , will chastise you seven times for your sins .
translation.kha: te ha ka jingbitar ngan phai pyrshah ïa phi , bad sa shisien ngan pynshitom jur shuh shuh ïa phi sa hynñiew shah ban ïa kaba la long mynshuwa .
Ki nongbah khyrdop ki pynbna ïa kata ka khubor , badno la leit rah ïa ka sha ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And he called the porters  ; and they told it to the king s house within .

translation.kha: Kawei kaba nongkam ïa kum uta u shakri ka long ba un long uba ïaineh ha u kynrad jong u .
translation.en: Moreover it is required in stewards , that a man be found faithful .

And Israel stretched out his right hand , and laid it upon Ephraim s head , who was the younger , and his left hand upon Manasseh s head , guiding his hands wittingly  ; for Manasseh was the firstborn .
translation.kha: U Jakob u phna ïa la ki kti bad u buh ïa ka kti kamon ha ka khlieh u Ephraim , wat la u long uba kham rit , bad ïa ka kti kadiang ha ka khlieh u Manasseh , uba kham san .

translation.en: And Abraham said unto his young men , Abide ye here with the ass  ; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship , and come again to you .
translation.kha: Te u ong ha kita ki shakri ,  To shong hangne bad ka kada . Ma nga bad u khun ngin leit hangtai ban mane Blei , bad hadien kata ngin sa wan pat sha phi .
Ïa kane ka jingainguh thang dadien ban nongkit mano la ka Sabbaton nalor ka jingainguh kabu man ka sngi lym bad ka jingainguh da ka waiñ .
translation.en: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath , beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .

translation.kha: Hynñiew ka khun u lyndang kaba la long riewkynthei lane kaba la ïapyllait tnga , ka bym don khun , malade kiba la ïan phai ban shong ban sah nabar la u kpa kumba ka la kun mynba ka Dang samla , ka lah ban bam ïa kata ka jingbam ba u kpa jong ka u ïohpdiang kum u lyngdoh . Dei tieng uta uba na ka longïing lyngdoh uba lah ban bam ïa ka .
translation.en: But if the priest s daughter be a widow , or divorced , and have no child , and is returned unto her father s house , as in her youth , she shall eat of her father s meat : but there shall no stranger eat thereof .

translation.kha: phah la die ïa ki tiar jong pha na ka bynta ki kulai thoin , ki kulai thma , bad ki kada na Beth Togarmah .
translation.en: They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules .

translation.kha: Hynrei ym ne kano nangno kambah ki lah ban noh , namar ba ki la Ïohi ïa u briew uba la ïohkhiah naba ïohnong hangta lem dara u Petros bad u Ïoannis .
translation.en: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them , they could say nothing against it .
And he looked this way and that way , and when he saw that there was no man , he slew the Egyptian , and hid him in the sand .
translation.kha: U Moses u peit shane shatai , bad haba u ïohi ba ym don mano mano ba peit sha u , u pynïap ïa u , bad u tep ïa u hapoh u shyiap .
U Blei u la leh ïa kan kat kum ka jingthmu bymsuidñiew kaba u la pyndep lyngba U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .
translation.en: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord :

translation.kha: Ngim dei ban leh ïa kane ha ka jer Ka Jingkhawai Mem , ki la Ong , lymda kumta ki paidbah ki la ba khih kulmar .
translation.en: But they said , Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar of the people .

translation.kha: Haba u Saul u la wanrah poi hadien ka nongbah Damaskos , kynsan ka jingshai na ka sahit bneng ka la thaba lep sawdong ïa u .
translation.en: And as he journeyed , he came near Damascus : and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven :
But he said unto them ,  I have meat to eat that ye know not of .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la jubab ,  Nga don ka jingbam ban bam ïa kaba phi phim tip ei ei .

translation.en: At my first answer no man stood with me , but all men forsook me : I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge .
translation.kha: Ym don ba kyrshan ïa nga haba nga ïasaid da ïa lade nyngkong eh ha khmat ki bor synshar ; baroh ki la iehnoh ïa nga . Nga duwai ba U Blei un ym thew pyrshah ïa ki !
To pynshahshkor katba nga rwai ha phi ïa Kane ka jingjaw , ka jingrkhie u paidlang jong nga bad ka bri sohwaiñ jong u : U phalang jong nga u don ka bri sohwaiñ ha u lumrit uba seisoh bakha .
translation.en: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard . My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill :

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga la nguh ha phi : ‘ U mraw um long hasem khraw ban ïa la u Kynrad .’ Lada ki pynshitom ïa nga , ken pyndem ïa phi hajuh ; lada ki la khlong ïa ka jingsuki jong nga , kin kthong ïa ka jrong Phi ruh .
translation.en: Remember the word that I said unto you , The servant is not greater than his lord . If they have persecuted me , they will also persecute you  ; if they have kept my saying , they will keep yours also .

translation.kha: Haba ka snieh Pentekost ka la poi , baroh ki riewngeit ki la ïalang ha kawei ka jaka .
translation.en: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come , they were all with one accord in one place .

translation.kha: To kohnguh ïa U Blei , bad wat shad ba ïa ka jingshem jong pa’ yn pynwandur da tun ki jingkwah brai kaba phi la ju don mynba phi ïan don ha ka jingbymtip .
translation.en: As obedient children , not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance :

translation.kha: Te U Trai u ong ïa u Kain , Balei me bitar , bad batylli ka durkhmat jong me ka kylla dur ?
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Cain , Why art thou wroth ? and why is thy countenance fallen ?

translation.kha: Ki dkhoh bad ki tyngab kin shimti ïa ka ri . U Trai un ym pynsmieij shuh ïa ka , kumba ka la longkmie ha shuwa ka jingurlong ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it  ; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it : and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion , and the stones of emptiness .

translation.kha: U la pynlut ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u don . Nangta ka nemsniew kaba umjer ka la saphriang kylleng jong sakma ka ri , bad um don ei ei Shua .
translation.en: And when he had spent all , there arose a mighty famine in that land  ; and he began to be in want .
For if I by grace be a partaker , why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks ?
translation.kha: Lada nga ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingbam jong nga , balei ba uno uno un wohnia ïa nga na ka bynta ka jingbam ïa kaba nga da ainguh ?
Ka nong Samaria ka la waiñ ban thiang um , bad U Jisu u la ïai-ong ha ka , To ai um ba ngan dih .
translation.en: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water : Jesus saith unto her ,  Give me to drink .
Then assembled together the chief priests , and the scribes , and the elders of the people , unto the palace of the high priest , who was called Caiaphas ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ïakynduh lang ha ka ïing paki dulan jong u Kaïaphas , u Rangbah Lyngdoh ,

Uno uno uba ieit kham bun Shah ïa la u kjap lane ka kmie banbeiñ ïa nga um long umbiah bit ban long u synrap jong nga ; uno uno suba ieit kham bun shah ïa la u khun lynti ka khun ban ïa nga , um erlangthari umbiah bit ban long u synran jong nga .
translation.en: He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me : and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me .
And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate .
translation.kha: Ki teh ïa kita ki kynjri ksiar ha kita ki kyrwoh ,

translation.en: Yet now be strong , O Zerubbabel , saith the  Lord   ; and be strong , O Joshua , son of Jehozadak , the high priest  ; and be strong , all ye people of the land , saith the  Lord  , and work : for I am with you , saith the  Lord  of hosts :
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta to wat duh jingkyrmen , mano mano ruh na phi . Leh la ka kam , naba nga long ryngkat bad phi .

translation.en: The appearance of the wheels and their work was like unto the colour of a beryl : and they four had one likeness : and their appearance and their work was as it were a wheel in the middle of a wheel .
translation.kha: Ki shalyntem baroh saw tylli ki ïasyriem kumjuh , kawei pa kawei ka phyrnai la kum u mawkordor , bad kawei kawei ka don kawei pat ka shalyntem halor jong ka ha ka liang ka mon ,
U Jisu u la phai sha ki bad u la ong , Ko kynthei Jerusalem ! Wah ïam na ka bynta jong nga , hynrei na ka bynta ïa lade bad ki khun jong Phi .
translation.en: But Jesus turning unto them said ,  Daughters of Jerusalem , weep not for me , but weep for yourselves , and for your children .

translation.kha: U la ai ïa Phin bad ïa kiwei pat ki Lebi ban ïoh ïa kaei ka burom — bad mynta pat phi pyrshang ba-bang ïoh sa ïa ka kdew lyngdoh ruh !
translation.en: And he hath brought thee near to him , and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee : and seek ye the priesthood also ?

translation.kha: Hynñiew kim shym bud ïa ka nuksa u kput jong ki ; ki im sngi tang ha kob kamai spah , kumne ki bamsap bad kim bishar hok ïa ki jingïakajia .
translation.en: And his sons walked not in his ways , but turned aside after lucre , and took bribes , and perverted judgment .

translation.kha: Kata ka ia namar u la lehkmen ïa ki riewkynthei Bad um ju pynkhaw-eit jingsbun ïa ki kynther ki bym don khun .
translation.en: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not : and doeth not good to the widow .
As for Ephraim , their glory shall fly away like a bird , from the birth , and from the womb , and from the conception .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhraw ki Israel kan her noh kum ka sim , bad yn ym don shuh ki khun ban kha na ki , yn ym don shuh ki kynthei ki ban armet , yn ym don jingpunkhun shuh .
U Jisu! u la shem ïa u kada bad u la shong halor jong u , dom ka jingthiah Bakhuid ka ong ,
translation.en: And Jesus , when he had found a young ass , sat thereon  ; as it is written ,

translation.kha: bun ai ïa ka ha ki apostol ; nabar ïa ka pisa la ïasam ha uwei pa uwei kot kum ka jingdonkam jong u .
translation.en: And laid them down at the apostles  feet : and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need .
But I have prayed for thee , that thy faith fail not : and when thou art converted , strengthen thy brethren .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la duwai na ka bynta jong me , ko Simon , ba ka jingngeit jong me kan ym duh noh . Bad haba me la wan phai pat sha nga , me dei ban pynkhlaiñ ïa ki hynmen ki para jong me .

translation.en: Then I returned , and I saw vanity under the sun .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kawei pat kaei kaei ha ka jingim kaba long ka bymmyntoi .
U Trai u ong ha ngi ,
translation.en: That the  Lord  spake unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ha kata ka prie ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem ka bajakhlia ka sdang puta ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem , bad ïa nga la set ha ka phlait ba la kerkut jong ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: For then the king of Babylon s army besieged Jerusalem : and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison , which was in the king of Judah s house .

translation.kha: bad u Dabid u ong ha uta u nong Adrammelekh , Me la wallam ïa kane halor lade . Me la pynrem ïa lade haba me phla ba me la pynïap ïa uta uba U Trai u la jat ban long syiem .
translation.en: And David said unto him , Thy blood be upon thy head  ; for thy mouth hath testified against thee , saying , I have slain the  Lord s  anointed .

translation.kha: U Joshua u la phah ïa ki paid Jeriel ha la ka lynñiar , bad uwei pa nawei u briew u la otsher ban shim kynti ïa la ka bhah jong ka ri .
translation.en: And when Joshua had let the people go , the children of Israel went every man unto his inheritance to possess the land .

translation.kha: Wat sheptieng , U Jisu u la ong ha ki . Khie leit bad ïathuh ïa ki para jong nga pun leit sha Galilaïa bad hangta kin ïohi ïa nga .
translation.en: Then said Jesus unto them ,  Be not afraid : go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee , and there shall they see me .
Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch , and a King shall reign and prosper , and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por kan wan haba ngan jied kum u syiem ïa uba hiarpateng na u Dabid uba hok . Uta syiem u ban synshar da ka jingstad , bad u ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba hok ha kylleng ka ri .

translation.en: For now we live , if ye stand fast in the Lord .
translation.kha: Namar mynta ngi im shisha , lada phi ïeng skhem ha ka ha U Trai .
Ka Halah ka la punkhun biang , bad ka la kham khun shynrang uba ar ïa u Jakob .
translation.en: And Bilhah Rachel s maid conceived again , and bare Jacob a second son .
And all the men of Israel rose up out of their place , and put themselves in array at Baal–tamar : and the liers in wait of Israel came forth out of their places , even out of the meadows of Gibeah .
translation.kha: Kumta haba ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel ka kynran dien bad ban ïakynduh lang biang ha Baaltamar , ki rangbah kiba khangkdong ïa ka Gibeah ki mih kynsan na la ki jakarieh ba don ha ki jaka maw jong ka nongbah .
U Paul sa ba un sdang kren , long u Gallio u la ong ha kita ki Jiw , Lada kane ka long ka kam runar lane ka kam sniew ba la leh , kan long kaba sngewkhia ïa nga ban ïaishah bad ki Jiw .
translation.en: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth , Gallio said unto the Jews , If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness , O ye Jews , reason would that I should bear with you :

translation.kha: lada phi nongshong ïa ki suda jong u barben kiba to la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , bad phi leh ruh ïa kata kaba u kwah .
translation.en: When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day , to do that which is right in the eyes of the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Ki la tip tang ïa kaei ba kiwei pat ki ong : U briew uba la ju pynshitom beiñ ïa ngi mynta pat u ïarap ïa ka jingngeit ïa kaba shisien u la pyrshang pun pynduh !
translation.en: But they had heard only , That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed .
Wherefore the king said unto me , Why is thy countenance sad , seeing thou art not sick ? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart . Then I was very sore afraid ,
translation.kha: kumta u ong ,  Balei ba me imat sngewsih ? Mem shym pang , ka lah ban long ba me don jingsngewsih .
Ki suit ksiar ruh ïa kita ki jingker , bad ki pyndait ha ki ïa ki kyrwoh ksiar ban baskhem ïa kita ki diengkhap . Ïa kita ki diengkhap ruh la suit da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And he overlaid the boards with gold , and made their rings of gold to be places for the bars , and overlaid the bars with gold .

translation.kha: To kyrpad ïa U Blei ban kyrkhu ïa kito bakha pynshitom ïa phi — ho-oid , to kyrthep ïa u ïa-ban pyrkhat , ym ban tim .
translation.en: Bless them which persecute you : bless , and curse not .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Heshmon bad ka Elealeh ki kyang jam , bad ïa ka jingsliang Jong ki lah ban ïohsngew kat shaduh Jahas . Wat ki shipai ki khyndew ; ka jingshlur jong ki ka duh noh .
translation.en: And Heshbon shall cry , and Elealeh : their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz : therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out  ; his life shall be grievous unto him .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta te ka bor met ruh ngim don shiah . Ym don ei ei ban bam — thliew lait sa tang kane ka manna na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pateng !
translation.en: But now our soul is dried away : there is nothing at all , beside this manna , before our eyes .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jop , U briew uba la bet ïa u symboh babha u long U ti U briew’ ;
translation.en: He answered and said unto them ,  He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man  ;

translation.kha: Wat klim .
translation.en: Thou shalt not commit adultery .

translation.kha: Kanneh ka hukum ka teh ïa phi baroh , ïa ki Israel bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong hateng jong phoi , naba nga longïng U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Ye shall have one manner of law , as well for the stranger , as for one of your own country : for I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Haba u la kren , ïa ka pyrthei la pynlong ; ha ka hukum jong u baroh ka la jaw .
translation.en: For he spake , and it was done  ; he commanded , and it stood fast .

translation.kha: Nangta shah ba ngan leit phai pat shuh ïing bad ban ïap hajan ka jingtep jong i mei bad i pa jong nga . Une hangne u Shimham , u khun jong nga , u ban shakri ïa phi ; shim ïa u bad phi , ko Syiem Kynrad ; bad leh na ka bynta jong u katba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam .
translation.en: Let thy servant , I pray thee , turn back again , that I may die in mine own city , and be buried by the grave of my father and of my mother . But behold thy servant Chimham  ; let him go over with my lord the king  ; and do to him what shall seem good unto thee .

translation.kha: Bad haba ki la ïawanlang , u la ai ha ki ïa kan ka hukum : Wat leit ei na Jerusalem , hynrei ap ïa ka jingkular kaba la la ïathuh , ka jingai kaba U Kpa jong nga u la kyllum .
translation.en: And , being assembled together with them , commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem , but wait for the promise of the Father ,  which ,  saith he ,  ye have heard of me .

translation.kha: U iaka u la wan sha ka ri khlam jong Ka Pukri jong ithuh Uba Im Uba Ïohi Ïa Nga nabar ba u sah ha ka bynta bashaphang shathie jong ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai–roi  ; for he dwelt in the south country .

translation.kha: Haba ki la wan phai pat sha u paidbah , uwei u briew u la wan sha U Jisu , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u ,
translation.en: And when they were come to the multitude , there came to him a certain man , kneeling down to him , and saying ,

translation.kha: Hynrei lada kata ka dak ka sawa Khmut , bad kam shym pur satia , hynrei ka stang ha ka rong , kata kam dei ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh . U lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long uba khur , namar ka dei tang ka sohkhliang na kata ka dak ing ding .
translation.en: And if the bright spot stay in his place , and spread not in the skin , but it be somewhat dark  ; it is a rising of the burning , and the priest shall pronounce him clean : for it is an inflammation of the burning .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ieh ïa ka Topheth , ha kaweh U Trai u la phah ïa nga ban pynbna ïa ka nongrah-khubor jong u . Nga la leit Bad ïeng haduh ka phyllaw jong ka Templ bad ïathuh ha ki briew barben
translation.en: Then came Jeremiah from Topheth , whither the  Lord  had sent him to prophesy  ; and he stood in the court of the  Lord s  house  ; and said to all the people ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Isshaïah u hukum ïa u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , ïa ki lyndum ba ïar ïa u , dara ïa ki ngap kiba treikam ha ka khak rung sha ka Templ ba ïarah shabar ka Templ ïa baroh ki tiar kiba pyndonkam ha ka jingmlien ïa u Baal , ïa ka blei Asherah , Bad ïa ki khlur . U syiem u la ïaryngkat ïa kine ki tarajur baroh’ shabar ka Nongbah ba-hajan ka Them Jingdon , Bad nangta ïa u dpei la rah shat Bethel .
translation.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest , and the priests of the second order , and the keepers of the door , to bring forth out of the temple of the  Lord  all the vessels that were made for Baal , and for the grove , and for all the host of heaven : and he burned them without Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron , and carried the ashes of them unto Beth–el .

translation.kha: To rwai ka jingïaroh ïa U Trei ; ïathuh ïa kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la leh .
translation.en: Sing unto him , sing psalms unto him : talk ye of all his wondrous works .
Or let him take hold of my strength , that he may make peace with me  ; and he shall make peace with me .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ki nongshun jong ki briew jong nga ki kwah ïa ka jingïada jong nga , ai ba kin ïasuk bad nga . Ho-oid , ai kin ïasuk bad nga .
Kumne mynta , ma nga , U Trai nongshoh-nar , nga ïathuh ha phi ba ngan bishar hapdeng jong pa’ ïa ki langbrot kiba khlaiñ bad ki langbrot kba tlot .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  unto them  ; Behold , I , even I , will judge between the fat cattle and between the lean cattle .

translation.kha: U la pynlut ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u don . Nangta ka nongshimti kaba jrut ka la saphriang kylleng jong kata ka ri , bad um don ei ei shuh .
translation.en: And when he had spent all , there arose a mighty famine in that land  ; and he began to be in want .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ka jingïohipaw jong ki jingjia ba-ishyrkhei , ka jingïohipaw ïa ka jingshetkylla bad ka jingpynjot . Ko kynhun shipai jong ka Elam , to uta ïaleh ! Ko kynhun shipai jong ka Media , to kerkut ïa ki nongbah ! U Blei un pynkut ïa ka jingshitom kaba la wanrah da ka bapyllun .
translation.en: A grievous vision is declared unto me  ; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously , and the spoiler spoileth . Go up , O Elam : besiege , O Media  ; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease .

translation.kha: Mynta , haba u trai ka bri sohwaiñ u wanrah , kaei kiba un leh ïa kito ki nongshimwai ? U Jisu u la kylli .
translation.en: When the lord therefore of the vineyard cometh , what will he do unto those husbandmen ?

translation.kha: Haba U Jehu u la ïohi ïa kane , u la sngewbitar bad u la ong ïa ki synran lad u , Shah ïa ki khynnah ban wanlam ha nga , bad wat khang ïa ki , namar ka Hima U Blei! ka long na ka bynta kum kine .
translation.en: But when Jesus saw it , he was much displeased , and said unto them ,  Suffer the little children to come unto me , and forbid them not : for of such is the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: hadien ba U Trai u la jop ïa u Shibun u syiem Amor uba shon ha Heshbon , bad ïa u Og u syiem Bashan , Uba synshar ha ki sneng Ashtaroth nabar Ehud .
translation.en: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites , which dwelt in Heshbon , and Og the king of Bashan , which dwelt at Ashtaroth in Edrei :

translation.kha: U thri U Blei’ jong phi u la bajngum ïa ken ka ri da ka jingit , bad mynta u la leh ïa kaei kaban u la ong ba un leh . Baroh kaei ka la jia namarba ki briew jong phi ki la ai pop pyrshah ïa U tharai bad kim shym la kohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: Now the  Lord  hath brought it , and done according as he hath said : because ye have sinned against the  Lord  , and have not obeyed his voice , therefore this thing is come upon you .

translation.kha: Nga la long ryngkat bad me shano shano ba me leit , bad nga la jrop ïa baroh ki nongshun jong me katba me ïaid shaphrang . ngan pynlong ïa me uba pawnam kumta ki nongïalam bakhraw tam ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked , and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee , and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth .
When the house caught fire , an awful feeling came over me .
translation.kha: Mynba ka ïng ka ing , ka jingsngewma ka wan ha nga .
da kaba shah ïa uno uno u bri u bym dei hok ban bam ïa ki ; kata kan pynïap ïa uto u briew ha ka pop! , bad un Shah pynshitom . Nga long U Trai umbiah pynkyntang ïa ki jingainguh .
translation.en: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass , when they eat their holy things : for I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
I the  Lord  have called thee in righteousness , and will hold thine hand , and will keep thee , and give thee for a covenant of the people , for a light of the Gentiles  ;
translation.kha: Nga , U  Trai  , nga la khot bad ai bor ïa phi , ban khmih ba ka jingbishar hok la pyndep ha pyrthei . Lyngba jong phi ngan pynlong ïa ka jutang bad ki briew baroh ; lyngba jong phi ngan wanrah ka jingshai sha ki jaitbynriew .
Me long U Blei jong nga , malu nga jingsakhi ïa me ; ngan pynbna ïa ka jingkren jong me .
translation.en: Thou art my God , and I will praise thee : thou art my God , I will exalt thee .
And having an high priest over the house of God  ;
translation.kha: Ngi don u lyngdoh uba khraw uba peit ïa ka ïing U Blei .
Hynrei katno kaba shympriah ïa pa kiba hynriewspah mynta ; phi la lah ïoh ïa ka jingim suk !
translation.en: But woe unto you that are rich ! for ye have received your consolation .

translation.kha: Ki shyieng jong u ki khlaiñ kum ka rngad , bad ki khohsiew jngai u ki long kumto ki shalyngka namar .
translation.en: His bones are as strong pieces of brass  ; his bones are like bars of iron .

translation.kha: Ki la klet ïa U Bel uba la pyllait im ïa ki da ki kam badonbor jong u ha Ijipt .
translation.en: They forgat God their saviour , which had done great things in Egypt  ;

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u ong , shim ïa u lyngkhot dieng bad thoh ha u ïa ki ktien ‘ Ka Hima Judah .’ Nangta shim sa nawei pat u lyngkhot diengduh bad theh ha u ïa kine ki ktien : ‘ Ka Hima Israel .’
translation.en: Moreover , thou son of man , take thee one stick , and write upon it , For Judah , and for the children of Israel his companions : then take another stick , and write upon it , For Joseph , the stick of Ephraim , and for all the house of Israel his companions :
But their laying await was known of Saul . And they watched the gates day and night to kill him .
translation.kha: Mynsngi bad mynmiet ki la ap ha ki khyrdop shnong khnang ban pynïap ïa u .
ha kaba u Saddusi malu u Nathan ki dei ban pynsleh ïa u kum u syiem Israel . Nangta put ïa ka turoi bad pyrta , ‘ Im slem Syiem Solomon !’
translation.en: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel : and blow ye with the trumpet , and say , God save king Solomon .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U tharai , nga la kut jingmut ba saw tylli kiei kiei kiba sngewshyrkhei ktien jia ha ki : kin shah pynïap ha ka thnum ; ïa ki set jong ki yn patan nong da ki ksew ; ki sim kin bam ïa ki , bad ki mradkhlaw kin bam ïa kaei kaba sah .
translation.en: And I will appoint over them four kinds , saith the  Lord  : the sword to slay , and the dogs to tear , and the fowls of the heaven , and the beasts of the earth , to devour and destroy .
And , behold , a man of the company cried out , saying , Master , I beseech thee , look upon my son : for he is mine only child .
translation.kha: Uwei u briew u la pyrta na u paidbah ,  Ko Nonghikai ! Nga kyrpad ïa me , ban khmih ïa u khun jong nga — u khun marwei jong nga !
Ngan pynni kyrhai ïa ka jingmih na ki diengsoh bad na ki lyngkha jong phi , ba kuna ym don shuh ka nemsniew ka ban pynjahburom ïa pa khappud ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree , and the increase of the field , that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen .

translation.kha: U saraw u sheptieng ïa u Dedan namar ba U Trai u don ryngkat bad u Dabid hynrei U la kynriah noh na u Saul .
translation.en: And Saul was afraid of David , because the  Lord  was with him , and was departed from Saul .

translation.kha: ki la wallam ïa ka Kada bad ïa u khwan kada , ki la siang ïa la ki jaiñ halor jong ki , bad U Jisu u la kiew ban shong .
translation.en: And brought the ass , and the colt , and put on them their clothes , and they set him thereon .

translation.kha: Hato phi don ka tnga ? Te wat pyrshang ban iehnoh ïa ka . Hato phim pat shongkurim ? Te wat ym wad tnum .
translation.en: Art thou bound unto a wife ? seek not to be loosed . Art thou loosed from a wife ? seek not a wife .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jehud u la mihnoh , U Jisu u la ïong , Mynta ïa ka burom U Khun U Briew la pynpaw ; mynta ïa ka burom U Balei la pynpaw lyngba u .
translation.en: Therefore , when he was gone out , Jesus said ,  Now is the Son of man glorified , and God is glorified in him .
The sons of Laadan  ; the chief was Jehiel , and Zetham , and Joel , three .
translation.kha: U Ladan u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jehiel , u Setham , bad u Joel ,
hynriew kilo ka kassia , ( ïa kiba la thew kat kum ka jingthew jong ka jaka kyntang ) . pynrangbah sa saw litar ka umphniang Olib ,
translation.en: And of cassia five hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary , and of oil olive an hin :
If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land , and they spoil it , so that it be desolate , that no man may pass through because of the beasts :
translation.kha: Lane nga lah ban phah ïa ki mradkhlaw ban pynïap ïa ki briew , da kaba pynlong ïa ka ri kaba ma katta katta ba ym don uno uno uba lah ban leit lyngba ïa ka ,

Mynta ong ïa ki bajaipdeh , ‘ Pynkhuid ïa ailad na ka bniat lashai ; bad phi sa ïoh ka doh ban bam . U Trai u la ïohsngew ba phi ïakhun khynnah bad ong ba phi mutdur ba phi don khyndiat ka deng , bad ba phi kham ïoh bam bha ha Ijipt . Te mynta U Trai un ai ka doh ba phin ïam , bad ph dei ban bah ïa ka .
translation.en: And say thou unto the people , Sanctify yourselves against to morrow , and ye shall eat flesh : for ye have wept in the ears of the  Lord  , saying , Who shall give us flesh to eat ? for it was well with us in Egypt : therefore the  Lord  will give you flesh , and ye shall eat .

translation.kha: Kaba u syep u dang ïaid , u nongïathuhlypa u khiat ïa u pynlang ong , Syiem kyndon , katba nga tdong ïaleh thma , u Shipai u wallam shuh nga ïa u nongshun ba shah Kem bad u ong , ‘ Ap bha ïa une u briew ; “lada u lait phet , phan hap ban siew da la ka jong ka jingim lane phin hap siew har lai hajar ki sbai rupa .’
translation.en: And as the king passed by , he cried unto the king : and he said , Thy servant went out into the midst of the battle  ; and , behold , a man turned aside , and brought a man unto me , and said , Keep this man : if by any means he be missing , then shall thy life be for his life , or else thou shalt pay a talent of silver .

translation.kha: Lada phoi ïa pule Baibl bad ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah , lehse phi ju pule lypa shuwa baneh sdang ka jingïasyllok .
translation.en: If you are studying the Bible with one of Jehovah’s Witnesses , you likely try to review the material in advance of each study .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , la maham ïa phi ban ym shah ïa lade ban shah shukor ha ki nongïathuhlypa kiba im hapdeng jong phi lane da film kino khiew pat kiba mana ba ki lah ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka lawei . Wat ym pynleit jingmut siat ïa ki jingphohsniew jong ki .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Let not your prophets and your diviners , that be in the midst of you , deceive you , neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed .

And David was greatly distressed  ; for the people spake of stoning him , because the soul of all the people was grieved , every man for his sons and for his daughters : but David encouraged himself in the  Lord  his God .
translation.kha: U Dabid u don mynta ha ka jingma kaba khraw , namar ki briew jong u kiba la sngewkthang haba ki la duh ïa la ki khun ki kti bad ki byrngem ban lynthem maw ïa u ; hynrei U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u ai ha u ka jingshlur .
Kumno kñi ngi lah ban rai ïa ka jingrwai ha U Trai ha ka ri nongwankai ?
translation.en: How shall we sing the  Lord s  song in a strange land ?
And the altar shall be twelve cubits long , twelve broad , square in the four squares thereof .
translation.kha: Ka bynta kaba halor jong ka duwan ka long sawdong , hynriew mitar ha kawei pa kawei ka liang .
Kan kham bha kaba shong ha tnum ïing ban ïa kaba sah lang ha kajuh ka ïing sad ka tnga kaba wad daw .
translation.en: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop , than with a brawling woman and in a wide house .

translation.kha: U Troas Nongsynshar u ong , Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , ngan pynshitom ïa u na ka bynta ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka jingïateh lok kaba u la smai ha ka kyrteng jngai nga ban bat .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; As I live , surely mine oath that he hath despised , and my covenant that he hath broken , even it will I recompense upon his own head .
If they say thus unto us , Tarry until we come to you  ; then we will stand still in our place , and will not go up unto them .
translation.kha: Lada ki ong ïa ngi ban ap haduh ba kin da wan sha ngi , ngin ïeng thik ha la ka jaka .

translation.en: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering : they shall also prepare a young bullock , and a ram out of the flock , without blemish .
And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no servile work .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad wat treikam ei ei .
Katba ki rangbah ki dang ïamih , katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wanlam sha U Jisu ïa u briew u bymnang krung namar ba u shongksuid .
translation.en: As they went out , behold , they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil .
He that justifieth the wicked , and he that condemneth the just , even they both are abomination to the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kaba pynrem ïa kiba lui lui lane kaba pynksan ïa ki bymman — baroh ar ki long ka jingijli ha U  Trai .
To U Blei umbiah U Kpa mala U Jisu Khrist , U Khun jong U Kpa , un ai ha ngi ka jingjai , ka jingsiew bad ka jingsuk ; to ai ba kin long ki jyllang ngi ha ka jingshisha bad ka jingieit .
translation.en: Grace be with you , mercy , and peace , from God the Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ , the Son of the Father , in truth and love .

translation.kha: To long kiba ïaishah , namarkata , ko parabangeit jong nga , haduh ba U Trai un wiang . Khmih katno u nongrep u long uba ïaisah hajuh u ap ïa la ka khynwin ba-bang pynmih ïa ki jingthung kiba kordor . U ïaishah shun ap ïa u sting synñia bad ïa u slap pyrem .
translation.en: Be patient therefore , brethren , unto the coming of the Lord . Behold , the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth , and hath long patience for it , until he receive the early and latter rain .
And after eight days again his disciples were within , and Thomas with them : then came Jesus , the doors being shut , and stood in the midst , and said ,  Peace be unto you .
translation.kha: Shi taïew hadien ki synran ki la ïadon lang biang hapoh ïing , bad u Thomas u la don lem bad ki . Ïa ki jingkhang la khang skhem , hynrei U Jisu u la wan bad u la ïeng hapdeng jong ki bad u la ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad phi .
U Bel u ong ha u Joseph , Khie leit sha Bethel mala shongsah hangtai . Tei ïa ka duwan hangta ïa nga , U blang uba la mihpaw ha me mynba me Dang phet ïap na u Iso u tymmen jong me .
translation.en: And God said unto Jacob , Arise , go up to Beth–el , and dwell there : and make there an altar unto God , that appeared unto thee when thou fleddest from the face of Esau thy brother .
And all Israel shall hear , and fear , and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you .
translation.kha: Te ki Israel baroh kin sa ïohsngew aïu ka la jia , bad kin sheptieng ; bad yn ym don shuh mano mano u ban leh kum ïa kata ka kam bymman .

translation.en: But it shall be , when evening cometh on , he shall wash himself with water : and when the sun is down , he shall come into the camp again .
translation.kha: Ynda janmiet u dei ban sait ban sum ïa lade , bad ha ka por sep sngi u lah ban wan pat sha ka jaka shong dara .
Saw tylli ki mradkhlaw bakhraw eh ki la mih saphriang na ka duriaw-bah , uwei uwei u ïapher na kiei pat .
translation.en: And four great beasts came up from the sea , diverse one from another .

translation.kha: Baroh ki bynriew ki la ïohsngew ïa u ; ma ki bad khamtam ki nonglum khajna ki long kita kiba la kohnguh ïa ka jingdawa bahok jong U Blei bad kiba la shah pynbaptis ha u Ïoannis .
translation.en: And all the people that heard him , and the publicans , justified God , being baptized with the baptism of John .

translation.kha: Ngam pat ju kyrngah ban ïarap ïa kba duk ; ma pat ju shah ïa ki riewkai ban im jynjar
translation.en: If I have withheld the poor from their desire , or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail  ;

translation.kha: ym dei ban jhieh ïa ka metïap hangta baroh shi miet . tep ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi , namar ka metïap kaba sdien ha u dieng ka long ka jingjngem U Blei , khnang ba phin ym pyntngit ïa kata ka ri ba U Trai U blei jong phira u ai ha phi .
translation.en: His body shall not remain all night upon the tree , but thou shalt in any wise bury him that day  ; ( for he that is hanged is accursed of God  ; ) that thy land be not defiled , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance .
Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work ? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon ?
translation.kha: Hato phi lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba shna ei ei ? Hato phi lah ban shna u snar na ka , ban wah ïa kiei kiei ha u ?
U matlah ïa pa’ ban ym shah ba u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi . U Hesekaïah um ia ban pyllaitluid ïa phi .
translation.en: Thus saith the king , Let not Hezekiah deceive you : for he shall not be able to deliver you .

translation.kha: Ki bymman ki lah ban don shibun bha ka rupa ban ñiew bad shibun ki jingriam ban ïa kaba ki donkam ;
translation.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust , and prepare raiment as the clay  ;

translation.kha: mynta te , to ïashoh ïa ki bariew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem’ ba nga thaw ki jingthmu bathymmai pyrshah ïa ki dara nga Khreh ban pynshitom ïa ki . Ïathuh ïa ki ban sangeh banbeiñ im ka jingim ba-dap da ka ngop — ban pynkyllon ïa ki rukom im jong ki bad ïa kiei ktieh kiba ki leh .
translation.en: Now therefore go to , speak to the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I frame evil against you , and devise a device against you : return ye now every one from his evil way , and make your ways and your doings good .

translation.kha: Hynrei mar syn beh noh ïa u kshaid , u briew u la sdang ba-bang kren , nabar uwei uei baroh u la lyngngai , Ngim pat ju ïohi mynno mynno hima kum kñia ha Israel ! ki la ong .
translation.en: And when the devil was cast out , the dumb spake : and the multitudes marvelled , saying , It was never so seen in Israel .

translation.kha: Ki bniat jong phi ki longkmie kiba lied kamon ka kynhun jong ki langbrot ba dang shu dep pynsuk . Ym don kawei ruh na ki kaba jah ; baroh ki long kiba ïatim bha .
translation.en: How fair and how pleasant art thou , O love , for delights !

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Asa u la phah ïa ka hukum kylleng ka ri Jehudi kaba dawa ïa uwei pa uwei , khlem lait ïano ïano , ban ïarap kit noh na Ramah ïa ki maw sad ki dieng ïa kiba u Baasha u pyndonkam ban pynskhem ïa ka . Da kine ki tiar ki tar u Asa u tei pynduk ïa ka Mispah bad ïa ka Geba , ka nongbam kaba don ha ka ri Benjamin .
translation.en: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah  ; none was exempted : and they took away the stones of Ramah , and the timber thereof , wherewith Baasha had builded  ; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin , and Mizpah .

translation.kha: Haduh ngi baroh ing wan ha ka jingtylli jong ka jingneit bad ha ka jingtip jongngi ngi ïa U Khun U Blei ; ngin long ki briew kiba rangbah bha , kiba kot shadong ka rynïeng ka jinglong rangbah pura U Khrist .
translation.en: Till we all come in the unity of the faith , and of the knowledge of the Son of God , unto a perfect man , unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Christ :

translation.kha: Kanneh , mynta , ka dei kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ïong : Ngan buh ha Seïon ka nongrim kambah skhem bad bakhlaiñbor . Ha ka ngan buh ïa u mawdong baskhem ha uba yn thoh ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingngeit kaban skhem ka long ruh kaba ïaishah .’
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone , a tried stone , a precious corner stone , a sure foundation : he that believeth shall not make haste .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kad syang ha ka met bad ha ka jingstad , da kaba ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha bad U Blei lem bad ki briew .
translation.en: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature , and in favour with God and man .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki sngap jar , kumba u syiem Hesekaïah u la ong ïa ki Ban leh kumta ; kim shyiap kren shikyntien ruh .
translation.en: But the people held their peace , and answered him not a word : for the king s commandment was , saying , Answer him not .
And they understood none of these things : and this saying was hid from them , neither knew they the things which were spoken .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki synran kim shemphang ïa kano kano na kine kiei kiei ; ïa ka jingmut jong ki kyntien la buhrieh na ki , bad kim tip shaphang kaei U Jisu u kren .

U Dabid u leit neh na Kata ka jaka shaei shispah ha Moab bad u ong ha u syep Moab , sngewlah shah ïa i pa bad i mei jong la ban wan bad sah bad phi haduh ba ngan da tipthuh aïu U Blei un leh na ka byndi jong nga .
translation.en: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab : and he said unto the king of Moab , Let my father and my mother , I pray thee , come forth , and be with you , till I know what God will do for me .

translation.kha: Babha u la pei hajan Bethpeor bad Bethania ha u lum ki Olib , u la phah ar ngut ki synran sha shuwa lem bad kine ki jingbthah :
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount called the mount of Olives , he sent two of his disciples ,
Or else how can one enter into a strong man s house , and spoil his goods , except he first bind the strong man ? and then he will spoil his house .
translation.kha: Ym don uba lah ban phrung jubor shapoh ka ïing jong u briew uba khlaiñ bad kit noh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u lymda nyngkong eh u teh u khum shuwa ïa u briew uba khlaiñ , nangta u sa lah ban lute ïa ka ïing jong u .
Ka khiah dang step pyrshang bad ka pynkhynñiuh jingbam ïa bakha ha ka ïing jongki ka , bad ban ong ïa la ki sharati kynthei ïa kaei kaba ki dei baneh leh .
