translation.en: She riseth also while it is yet night , and giveth meat to her household , and a portion to her maidens .
Yet if thou warn the wicked , and he turn not from his wickedness , nor from his wicked way , he shall die in his iniquity  ; but thou hast delivered thy soul .
translation.kha: Lada me maham ïa u briew basniew , bad um shym sangeh na kaba leh pop , un ïap hi kum u nongpop , hynrei ïa ka jingim jong me yn pyllait .

translation.en: And the morrow after they entered into Caesarea . And Cornelius waited for them , and had called together his kinsmen and near friends .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u la poi ha Kaisaria , ha kaba u Kornelios u dang ap ïa u , lem bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem bad ki paralok bajan jong u kiba u la khot sngewbha .
Ngim dei ban long kiba shah kynnoh ba leh awria , kumba don na ki , kiba la leh kumta — bad ha ka shi sngi , syn lai hajar thut na ki , ki la kyllon ïalap .
translation.en: Neither let us commit fornication , as some of them committed , and fell in one day three and twenty thousand .
And them that are turned back from the  Lord   ; and those that have not sought the  Lord  , nor enquired for him .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa kito kiba la phai lyndet bad ki bym bud shuh ïa nga , kito ki bym shym wan sha nga , lane kylli na nga ban kdew lynti ïa ki .

translation.en: For great is the  Lord  , and greatly to be praised : he also is to be feared above all gods .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba khraw bad uba eh dei ban ïaroh ; ïa u dei ban ai ka burom palat ban ïa kiwei ki blei baroh .

nongthaw u nongïathuhlypa u ong ha u syiem , Kane ka dadien ka ktien U Trai : ‘ Namar ba me la shah ïa u brup ban lait phet ïa ibha nga la hukum ban pynïap , men hap ban siew da la ka jingim , badno ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me yn pynjot namar ba la pyllaitluid ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ban lait phet .’
translation.en: And he said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction , therefore thy life shall go for his life , and thy people for his people .

translation.kha: U Hamul u ong ha u , U khun jong nga u Hakkherem u la ïapmat ïa ka khun Jong phi ; sngewbha shait ïa u ngab shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: And Hamor communed with them , saying , The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter : I pray you give her him to wife .

translation.kha: Ka shnong jong ngi ka dei ka nongbah kaba khraw , kawei na ki shnong Kiba shongsuk shongsaiñ tam bad kohnguh syiem kuna ha Israel . Balei phi pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka ? Balei phi! kwah ban pynstet noh ïa khie kaba dei ka jong U Tiras ?
translation.en: I am one of them that are peaceable and faithful in Israel : thou seekest to destroy a city and a mother in Israel : why wilt thou swallow up the inheritance of the  Lord  ?

translation.kha: Kumne u Abimelekh u phad khot ïa u Isaak , malade u ong , Blang , ka dei ka tnum jong me ! Bel pat me ong ba ka dei ka para jong me ? U jubab , Namar nga pyrkhat ïoh ba nga shah pynïap lada nga ong ba ka dei ka tnga jngai nga .
translation.en: And Abimelech called Isaac , and said , Behold , of a surety she is thy wife : and how saidst thou , She is my sister ? And Isaac said unto him , Because I said , Lest I die for her .
And it came to pass in those days , that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee , and was baptized of John in Jordan .
translation.kha: Ym slem hadien , U Jisu u la wan na Nasareth kaba ha ka probins jong ka Galilaïa , bad la pynbaptis da u Ïoannis ha ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: And the damsel was very fair to look upon , a virgin , neither had any man known her : and she went down to the well , and filled her pitcher , and came up .
translation.kha: Ka long ka samla kaba bhabriew eh bad kaba dang sotti . Ka leit hiar sha ka pukri , ka pyndap um ha la u khiew bad ka wan kiew biang .
Wat ju klet kumno ph la pynbitar lep ïa U Trai ha ka ri shyiap . Naduh ka sngi ba Phin miat na Ijipt haduh ba pa’ poi hangne , phi la ïalap pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: Remember , and forget not , how thou provokedst the  Lord  thy God to wrath in the wilderness : from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt , until ye came unto this place , ye have been rebellious against the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta u la ïeng na ka miej bam , u la law noh ïa la ka jaiñkup , bad u la teh ïa ka jaiñ ñiad ha la ka tyngkai .
translation.en: He riseth from supper , and laid aside his garments  ; and took a towel , and girded himself .

translation.kha: Ka la don ka nemsniew ha kiew ruh ki ri ; hynrei ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei , don kyrhai ka bim .
translation.en: And the seven years of dearth began to come , according as Joseph had said : and the dearth was in all lands  ; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread .
After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah , and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph , another piece . After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber .
translation.kha: U Hananaïah , u khun jong u Shelemaïah bad u Hanun , u khun bahynriew jong u Salaph , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , ka jingtrei kaba ar jong ki . U Meshullam , u khun jong u Berekhaïah u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba long ha khmat ka ïing jong u .
Hynñiew U Jisu u la shim ïa uta u khynnah na ka kti malade u la ïarap pynïeng ïa u , malade u la ngin joit .
translation.en: But Jesus took him by the hand , and lifted him up  ; and he arose .
Can you write the exam ?
translation.kha: Phi lah ban thoh ia ka exam ?
U Dabid u wan sha u Saul bad u rung kam napoh bad u . U Saul u sngewbha eh ïa u Bad u jied ïa u kum u nongrah atiar lad u .
translation.en: And David came to Saul , and stood before him : and he loved him greatly  ; and he became his armourbearer .

translation.kha: Ki la khot shapoh ïa ki apostol , ki la phah sympat ïa ki , bad hukum ïa ki ban ym krensih shuh da lei lei ha ka kyrteng jongno U Jisu ; bad nongtih ki la pyllait noh ïa ki .
translation.en: And to him they agreed : and when they had called the apostles , and beaten them , they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus , and let them go .

translation.kha: Ka jingkulmar ka la pura ha ka nongbah bhor kawei , Bad ki briew’ ki la ïamareh lang , ki la skum ïa u Paul , bad ki la patan ïa u shabar jong ka Templ . Shisyndon hi la khang ïa ki jingkhang jong ka Tabeel .
translation.en: And all the city was moved , and the people ran together : and they took Paul , and drew him out of the temple : and forthwith the doors were shut .

translation.kha: Nga long kum u mluh kiba ïeng ha khamtam u kynroh jong u . Kum nga lah ban ïaring bad phi ? Ngam donbor lane jingpynhiar mynsiem kaban dang hukum ha nga .
translation.en: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord ? for as for me , straightway there remained no strength in me , neither is there breath left in me .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u , Ki myrsiang ki don ki krem , bad ki sem ki don ki skum , hynrei U Khun U Briew um don jaka hangno hangno ban de bad ban pynjahthait .
translation.en: And Jesus saith unto him ,  The foxes have holes , and the birds of the air have nests  ; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head .

translation.kha: Shah ïa at , A Trai , ban jam ïa ka wah Jordan nabar ïohi ïa tala ka ri kaba seisoh shaei sha shiliang , ka ri lum kaba itynnat , bad ki lum Lebanon .’
translation.en: I pray thee , let me go over , and see the good land that is beyond Jordan , that goodly mountain , and Lebanon .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka pyut kan long ba la thap da ka jingtip ïa ka burom U Trai kumba ki duriaw ki dap da ka um .
translation.en: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the  Lord  , as the waters cover the sea .

translation.kha: U la tei biang ïa ki nongbah baroh ha Hamath uba long ki jaka buh jingbam .
translation.en: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness , and all the store cities , which he built in Hamath .

translation.kha: Sumar ban ym shah pynshoi kat haduh ban da mano bad shakri ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi ha sahit bneng — la ka long ka sngi , u bnai , lane ki khlur , ïa kiba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha kiwei pat ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei ba kin ïoh mane .
translation.en: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven , and when thou seest the sun , and the moon , and the stars , even all the host of heaven , shouldest be driven to worship them , and serve them , which the  Lord  thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven .

translation.kha: Kum ki wah Ibbah la sangeh noh pun tuid , bad ki pung-um kaba la sdang noh ,
translation.en: As the waters fail from the sea , and the flood decayeth and drieth up :

translation.kha: To pynkloi ban wan shuwa ka tlang . U Ïubulos bad u Pudens bad u Linos bun ka Klaudia bad kumjuh ruh kiwei pat ki parabangeit barabor ki pah ïa ki jingiw Khublei jong ki .
translation.en: Do thy diligence to come before winter . Eubulus greeteth thee , and Pudens , and Linus , and Claudia , and all the brethren .

translation.kha: Tang shu hiar na ka lynnong , U Jisu u la ïakynduh ïa u bariew uba wan mih na ki krem jingtep Kiba don klang . Une u briew u don ïa u mynsiem bymkohnguh hapoh jong u bad u shong u sah ha ki jaka tep briew .
translation.en: And when he was come out of the ship , immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit ,

translation.kha: Hato ym dei ba ïa ki san tylli ki sim ïing la die tang ar pipa ? Pynnep ym don kawei hati ka bai ïong ïa kaba la klet noh da U Blei .
translation.en: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings , and not one of them is forgotten before God ?

translation.kha: ‘Phim ithuh ïa u ; hynrei , nga thoh ïa u , namar ang wiang na u bad u la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: But I know him : for I am from him , and he hath sent me .
And when he had brought them into his house , he set meat before them , and rejoiced , believing in God with all his house .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ïalam ïa u Paul bad u Silas sha ka ïing jong u bad u la ai ha ki katto katne ka jingbam ban bam . Ïa u bad ka longïing jong u la pyndap da ka jingkmen , namar mynta ki la ngeit ha U Blei .

translation.en: Jesus said unto them ,  If ye were blind , ye should have no sin : but now ye say , We see  ; therefore your sin remaineth .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Lada phi la long kiba matlah , te phin ym long kiba la shah pynrem ; hynrei naba phi kam ba phi ïohi , kane ka mut ba phi dang don ha ka jingpynrem .

translation.en: Lord  , bow down thine ear , and hear : open ,  Lord  , thine eyes , and see : and hear the words of Sennacherib , which hath sent him to reproach the living God .
translation.kha: Mynta , A  Trai  , khmih ïa kaei kaba jia ha ngi . Shahshkor ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba u Sennakherib u ong ban ibeiñ ïa me , U Blei uba im .

translation.en: And very early in the morning the first day of the week , they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun .
translation.kha: Dang step eh ha ka Sngi U Trai , hamar ba dang shu mih ka sngi , ki la leit sha ka jingtep .

translation.en: And I looked , and , behold , a whirlwind came out of the north , a great cloud , and a fire infolding itself , and a brightness was about it , and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber , out of the midst of the fire .
translation.kha: Nga la khmied , bad nga la ïohi ïa ka  erïong ba ka wan na shaphang shatei . Ka leilieh ka thaba na u lyoh uba rben , bad ka sahit bneng sawdong jong u , ka phyrnai . Ha ka jaka ba ka leilieh ka thaba , don kaei kaei kaba phyrnai kum ka rnong .

U dei U Terah uba la khang ïa phi don pynhiarkput bun pynïap ïa ki nongshun jong phi . Bad mynba nga smai ha phi da U Trai uba im ba ki nongshun jong phi bad baroh kiba kwah baneh pynmynsaw ïa phi kin shah pynshitom kumno u Namarba .
translation.en: Now therefore , my lord , as the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , seeing the  Lord  hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood , and from avenging thyself with thine own hand , now let thine enemies , and they that seek evil to my lord , be as Nabal .
Fear them not therefore : for there is nothing covered , that shall not be revealed  ; and hid , that shall not be known .
translation.kha: Kumta wat sheptieng ïa ki briew . Ïa kaei kaba la kah mynta yn weng noh , bad ïa kaei kaba la buhrieh yn pynpaw .
Ha kata ka por ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu , da kambah kylli , Uei kiba khraw tad ha ka Hima ki bneng ?
translation.en: At the same time came the disciples unto Jesus , saying , Who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven ?
And David said to Uriah , Tarry here to day also , and to morrow I will let thee depart . So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day , and the morrow .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u ong ,  Te sah hangne ha kane ka sngi , bad lashai ngan phah pat ïa phi .  Kumta u Uriah u la sah ha Jerusalem ha kata ka sngi bad ha ka sngi kaba bud .
Bad U Jisu u la pynkut , Shibun la khot sngewlah , hynrei khyndiat la jied .
translation.en: For many are called , but few are chosen .

translation.kha: U la ïai-ong ha ki , Ko Shadrakh , Meshakh , bad Abednego , hato ka long kaba Shispah ba phi kynti ban mane ïa u plie jong ang bad ïa-ban dem ngon sha ka durbriew kaba nga la phah pynïeng ?
translation.en: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them , Is it true , O Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , do not ye serve my gods , nor worship the golden image which I have set up ?
And with them Heman and Jeduthun , and the rest that were chosen , who were expressed by name , to give thanks to the  Lord  , because his mercy endureth for ever  ;
translation.kha: Hangta bad ki la don u Heman bad u Jeduthun bad kiwei ïa kiba la jied kyrpang ban rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh ha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingieit bymjukut jong u .

Ha man ba i ong , ‘ Ki blang kiba tyrwa kin long ka bainong jong me ,’ ka kynjoh jingri baroh ka kha da kiba thohbria suda . Haba i ong , ‘ Me kiba thohshuid Kin long ka bainong jrong me ,’ kata ka kynhun jingri baroh ka kha da Kiba thohshuid suda .
translation.en: If he said thus , The speckled shall be thy wages  ; then all the cattle bare speckled : and if he said thus , The ringstraked shall be thy hire  ; then bare all the cattle ringstraked .

translation.kha: Ngam ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha , U Jisu u la ong , kaei kaba u Moses u la ai ha phi! kam dei u kpu na Bteng ; dem U kpa jongnga ang uba ai ha phin ïa u kpu bashisha na bneng .
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Moses gave you not that bread from heaven  ; but my Father giveth you the true bread from heaven .
But foolish and unlearned questions avoid , knowing that they do gender strifes .
translation.kha: Hynrei to kiar noh na ki jingïatainia ba-bieit bad ba khlem jingmut ; me tip ba ki kut ha ka jingïakajia .

translation.en: But hast done evil above all that were before thee : for thou hast gone and made thee other gods , and molten images , to provoke me to anger , and hast cast me behind thy back :
translation.kha: Me la leh ïa ki pop kiba khraw palat liam ban ïa kito kiba la synshar ha shuwa jong me . Me la kyntait ïa nga bad me la pynbitar lep ïa nga da kaba me thaw ïa ki bleithaw bad ki dur ba la shu saiñ ban mane .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass at that time , that I will search Jerusalem with candles , and punish the men that are settled on their lees : that say in their heart , The  Lord  will not do good , neither will he do evil .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan shim ïa ka sharak bad wad ïa ka Jerusalem . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew kiba sngewhun ha lade bad kiba sngewskhem , kiba ong ha lade , ‘ U  Trai  um ju leh ei ei , kumne lane katai .’
Ha baroh kambah u leh u long uba ïaineh bad ibha hok ; ki hukum jong u baïar ki long kiba lah ban shaniah .
translation.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment  ; all his commandments are sure .
Who hath also sealed us , and given the earnest of the Spirit in our hearts .
translation.kha: uba la shon ïa ka shab jong ka jinglong trai halor jong ngi , bad uba la ai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki dohnud jong ngi kum ka jingbahkhlieh ïa kata baroh kaba u la buh tyngkai na ka bynta jong ngi .

translation.en: For the  Lord  hath redeemed Jacob , and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he .
translation.kha: Nga la pyllaitluid ïa ki paid Israel bad pynim ïa ki na ka hima bakhrawbor .
Ha tala kajuh ka por la don uwei u samla Lebi uba ju tama ha nongriam Bethlehem kaba ha Judah .
translation.en: And there was a young man out of Beth–lehem–judah of the family of Judah , who was a Levite , and he sojourned there .

They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude : her graves are round about him : all of them uncircumcised , slain by the sword : though their terror was caused in the land of the living , yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit : he is put in the midst of them that be slain .
translation.kha: Ka Elam ka don hapdeng kito kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , bad ki jingtep jong ki shipai jong ka ki don ha baroh sawdong jong ka . Ki long baroh kiba khlem otsher , baroh ki la shah pynïap ha ka thma . Ha ka jingim ki pynphriang ïa ka jingpyntriem , hynrei mynta ki thiah ïap bad ki jahburom , ki ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar ryngkat bad kito kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma .
Bad kumta to kyrpad ïa phi ngab shah ïa u ban tip ba phi i-ieit ïa u da shisha .
translation.en: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him .

translation.kha: To pyndonkam bha ïa ki kabu baroh ba phi ïor , namar kine ki long ki sngem kiba sniew .
translation.en: Redeeming the time , because the days are evil .
And Noah builded an altar unto the  Lord   ; and took of every clean beast , and of every clean fowl , and offered burnt offerings on the altar .
translation.kha: Te u Noah u tei ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  ; u shim na kawei kawei ka jait ki mrad bad ki sim ïa kiba la ñiew ba ki long kiba khuid , bad u thang tylli ïa ki kum ka jingkñia ainguh halor kata ka duwan .
Ïa u jingthang baroh ïa uba U kba jong nga kaba ha bneng um shym la thung , yn rat ne , la jubab U Jisu .
translation.en: But he answered and said ,  Every plant , which my heavenly Father hath not planted , shall be rooted up .
And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace : none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki rangbah jong u Joshua ki la wan phai suk sha u ha ka jaka sher dara ha Makkedah . Ym don uwei ruh u briew ha kata ka ri uba nud ban kren pyrshah ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men , that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived , and said , How do ye advise that I may answer this people ?
translation.kha: U syiem Rehoboam u ïasyllok bad ki riewrangbah kiba la shakri kum ki nongaibuit jong u Solomon u kpa jong u ,  Ka jubab aïu phi ai jingmut ban ai ïa kine ki briew ?  U kylli .
Wat pynriam ïa nga , A Blei , Ïathuh ïa nga ! Kaei ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa nga ?
translation.en: I will say unto God , Do not condemn me  ; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me .
And these are the golden emerods which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering unto the  Lord   ; for Ashdod one , for Gaza one , for Ashkelon one , for Gath one , for Ekron one  ;
translation.kha: Kine ki dur u thung kiba da ka ksiar ba ki Philistia ki phah pat kum ka jingainguh namar ka jingpalat sha U  Trai  ki long na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka shnong : Ka Ashdod , ka Gasa , ka Ashkelon , ka Gath , bad ka Ekron .

translation.en: Now there was leaning on Jesus  bosom one of his disciples , whom Jesus loved .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki synran , uta ïa uba U Jisu u ieit , u da shong shaniah ha U Jisu .
Haba khah ïa uno une u kynhun masi , lane ïa u Langbrot , lane ïa u kohnguh , ieh ïa u bad la ka kmie haduh hynñiew sngi , hynriew hadien kata lah ban pdiang ïa u kum ka jingainguh bam .
translation.en: When a bullock , or a sheep , or a goat , is brought forth , then it shall be seven days under the dam  ; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kham pynheh ïa ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba pha shong ; pynjrong ïa ki tyllai malu pynskhem ïa ki snar !
translation.en: Enlarge the place of thy tent , and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations : spare not , lengthen thy cords , and strengthen thy stakes  ;

translation.kha: Haba la kut shi taïew , ki lyngdoh kin sdang ki jingainguh lane halor ka duwan bad ki jingainguh Thang jingïasyllok ki paidbah . Te ngan Sngewbha na bynta jong phi baroh . Ma nga , U Trai’ Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translation.en: And when these days are expired , it shall be , that upon the eighth day , and so forward , the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar , and your peace offerings  ; and I will accept you , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Kum u Iso u leit phai pat ha kata ka sngi sha ephod .
translation.en: So Esau returned that day on his way unto Seir .

translation.kha: Ko ki rangbah Israel ! ki la pyrta . To ïarap ! Dei une u biria uba kitei kylleng ïakylliang da kaba hikai ïa uwei pa Uei pyrshah ïa ki paid Jerusalem’ , ïa ka Hukum u Mesha , bad ïa kane ka Templ . badno mynnin u la Wan ïalam wat katne katne ngut ki Jentil shapoh ka Templ bad pynsngaid ïa kñia ka jaka bakhuid !
translation.en: Crying out , Men of Israel , help : This is the man , that teacheth all men every where against the people , and the law , and this place : and further brought Greeks also into the temple , and hath polluted this holy place .

translation.kha: Na u Paul , ïa uba la khot ban lama u apostol U Khrist Jisu da ka mano U Blei , bad na u Sosthenes u parabangeit jong ngi —
translation.en: Paul , called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God , and Sosthenes our brother ,

translation.kha: Te kumta , lada uno uno u waiñ ha phira khlem da wallam ïa kane ka jinghikai , to ki pdiang sngewbiang ïa u ha ki ïing jong phira ; to wat da ong , To ka jingsuk kan longkmie bad phi .
translation.en: If there come any unto you , and bring not this doctrine , receive him not into your house , neither bid him God speed :

translation.kha: Berakah kito kba trei bad nga ki pyntip ba nga la ju pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nongwei .
translation.en: If the men of my tabernacle said not , Oh that we had of his flesh ! we cannot be satisfied .

translation.kha: A Trai , nga la ïohsngew ïa kaei ba me la leh , bad nga la dap da ka jingtiengburom . Mynta to leh biang ha ki por jong ngi ïa ki kam bakhraw babha me la ju leh . To leh-isynei , wat haba me bitar .
translation.en: O  Lord  , I have heard thy speech , and was afraid : O  Lord  , revive thy work in the midst of the years , in the midst of the years make known  ; in wrath remember mercy .

translation.kha: U Milkah u kylli ïa u , Nangta phi wan ? U jubab , Nga dei u Likhi na Bethesel kaba ha Judah . Nga dang khmih hangno ba ngan shong ngan sah .
translation.en: And Micah said unto him , Whence comest thou ? And he said unto him , I am a Levite of Beth–lehem–judah , and I go to sojourn where I may find a place .
Your words have been stout against me , saith the  Lord . Yet ye say , What have we spoken so much against thee ?
translation.kha: Phi la ong ïa kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei shaphang jong nga ,  ong U  Trai .  Hynrei phi kylli , ‘ Kaei ba ngi la ong shaphang jong me ?’

translation.en: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day , nor the pillar of fire by night , from before the people .
translation.kha: Uta u rishot lyoh u don borabor ha shuwa uta u paidbah ha ka por mynsngi , bad u rishot ding pat , mynmiet .

U Trai u la shah ïa u ban Kem ïa u Syiem Jekolaïah bad kurup katto katne ki jingkynshew jrong ka Templ . U la shim pat katno katne ngut ki koidi lem bad u Sha ka templ jong ki blei jongu u ha Babilon , bad u la buh ïa ka jingkynshew ba la ïoh kurup ha ki jaka kynshew ka templ .
translation.en: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand , with part of the vessels of the house of God : which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god  ; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god .

translation.kha: U Jehu u la hukum ïa la ki briew , Kem im ïa ki . Ki la kem ïa ki , mala u pynïap ïa ki hajan kawei ka thliew hangta . barieh ki ïadon sawphew ar ngut , nabar ym shym la pyllait im ïa uwei hati na ki .
translation.en: And he said , Take them alive . And they took them alive , and slew them at the pit of the shearing house , even two and forty men  ; neither left he any of them .

translation.kha: Phi pynjahburom ïa nga ha khmat ki briew jong sa khnang ban ïoh katto katne kham u barli pynlang khyndiat tyllep ki lyngngoh kpu . Phi pyndap ïa ki briew’ ki bym dei hok ban ïap , bad phi pynsah im ïa ki briew ki me dei hok ban im . Kumta phi ïathiah ki jinglamler ha ki briew jongki nga , bad ki jingkit ïa phi .
translation.en: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread , to slay the souls that should not die , and to save the souls alive that should not live , by your lying to my people that hear your lies ?

translation.kha: Ki Lebi mynsiem ki longkmie ki jongno nga . Mynba nga la pynpaw ïa u khwan nyngkong baroh jongnga ki nong ibit , ar la pynkyntang koum la u jong ïa u khum nyngkong na kadei pa kawei ka ïing Israel bad ïa uba la kha nyngkong na iwei pa aiwai u mrad . Mynmiet , nga ïoh noh da ki Lebi kum la ki jong ha ka jaka ki khur shynrang ba la kha jingsuh jong ki Israel ; ki kine long ki jong nga . NGA long U Trai .
translation.en: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar , and spread a purple cloth thereon :

translation.kha: Nalor kata , ym dei don wanrah ïa ka kamai sleit , la ka dei ka jong u shynrang ne ka kynthei , sha ka ïohnang U Trai U Blei jong phi khem ka jingpyndep ïa kane kano ka jingsmai , namar U Trai u isih ïa ki nuti ha ka jakarieh mane blei .
translation.en: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore , or the price of a dog , into the house of the  Lord  thy God for any vow : for even both these are abomination unto the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Nangta , ki la ai dat ïa u kpa jong u , da naba kyrpad ïa u kaei ka kyrteng u mon ba u khynnah un don .
translation.en: And they made signs to his father , how he would have him called .

translation.kha: Ki la pyrta ha ki lumbah bad ha ki mawsiang , To tap halor jong im’ bad to buhrieh noh ïa I na ki khmat jong uta uba shnong halor ka khet bad na ka jingbitar U Khunlangbrot !
translation.en: And said to the mountains and rocks , Fall on us , and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne , and from the wrath of the Lamb :
He had eaten .
translation.kha: U la bam .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  to the men of Judah and Jerusalem , Break up your fallow ground , and sow not among thorns .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem ,  To lur ïa ki lyngkha jong phi ki bym pat ju lur ; wat bet ïa ki symbai jong phi hapdeng ki shiah .
nabar haba ki ïa-ïeng ja-um jong u Jakob ki la ïabam lut ïa u kew ba la sleit na Ijipt , u Jakob u la ong ha la ki khun , Khie leit biang bad thied jingbam baïong ïa moi khyndiat .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when they had eaten up the corn which they had brought out of Egypt , their father said unto them , Go again , buy us a little food .

translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha ka , Nga kular ïa pha da U Trai uba im , uba la pyllait im ïa nga na ki jingjynjar baroh ,
translation.en: And the king sware , and said , As the  Lord  liveth , that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress ,
I called upon thy name , O  Lord  , out of the low dungeon .
translation.kha: Na trai jong ka thliew , Ko  Trai  , nga la kyang jam sha me ,
U Hukum ïa ka jaiñkup ba u phong bad u ai ïa ka ha u dabi , ryngkat bad ka jingkyang atiar jong u bad ruh ïa ka waitlam , ka rynïeng , bad u pynbang jong u .
translation.en: And Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was upon him , and gave it to David , and his garments , even to his sword , and to his bow , and to his girdle .

translation.kha: Nangta , sa hynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei ki la wan mih kiba raikhoh bad kiba sah sa ka shyiap suda . Ki erlangthari ki masi kynther kiba isangsot eh kiba ngam pat ju ïohi hangno hangno ha ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And , behold , seven other kine came up after them , poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed , such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness :

translation.kha: Te to rah ïa ki kti ba la thait jong phira , bad pynkhih ïa ki khohsiew kiba la kyiuh jong phi !
translation.en: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down , and the feeble knees  ;

translation.kha: Kine ki briew ki kwah ïa u jwat nongïathuhlypa uba ïaid kylleng uba dap da ka lamler bad jingshukor bad u ong , ‘ Nga nongïathuhlypa ba ka waiñ bad ka kyiad kin tuid na ka bynta jongno phi .’
translation.en: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie , saying , I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink  ; he shall even be the prophet of this people .

translation.kha: pynban ha i'u don tang uwei U Blei , U Kpa , uba long u Nongthaw ïa kiei kiei baroh bad uba na ka bniat jong u me im ; bad don tang uwei U Terah , U Jisu Khrist , da u ba kiei kiei baroh la pynlong bad ha u ba ngi im .
translation.en: But to us there is but one God , the Father , of whom are all things , and we in him ; and one Lord Jesus Christ , by whom are all things , and we by him .

translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , kad klet ïa katai kiba nga hikai ïa phi , kynmaw borabor ïa kaei katba nga ïathuh ïa phi banbeiñ leh .
translation.en: My son , forget not my law  ; but let thine heart keep my commandments :

translation.kha: Ïa ki brai jong nga bad ïa nga , la die sha ka jingpynïap . Lada kam da lama kaba hasem sniew ban ïa kiba die sha ka jinglongmraw , ngan jingem da la shu sngewbishni jar pynlang sam ym pynshitom ïa phi ; hynrei im’ la jan shah pynjot — shah pynduh pyndam !
translation.en: For we are sold , I and my people , to be destroyed , to be slain , and to perish . But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen , I had held my tongue , although the enemy could not countervail the king s damage .

translation.kha: Khie leit wad ïa u Jeremaïah bad sumar bol ïa u . Wat pynmynsaw ïa u , hynrei leh ïa kaei kaei baher kaweh u kwah .
translation.en: Take him , and look well to him , and do him no harm  ; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee .

translation.kha: Ka ïa-ong , Nga don kawei ka jingkyrpad barit ban pan na me ; sngewngiah wat jingkhwan ïa nga . Kawei kata , mei ? u kylli . Ngan ym kyrngah ïa phi .
translation.en: Then she said , I desire one small petition of thee  ; I pray thee , say me not nay . And the king said unto her , Ask on , my mother : for I will not say thee nay .

translation.kha: Ïa kaba kamar-tama jongngi ka yn pynsaphriang hangtei kum ka jakhlia , khnang ba yn ym don mano mano naba lah iathuh ïa ki .’
translation.en: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel  ; so that they shall not say , This is Jezebel .

translation.kha: kamut u la peit sha ki , da ka jingmihsnam lynti ban ïew ei ei na ki .
translation.en: And he gave heed unto them , expecting to receive something of them .

translation.kha: Kin trei ïa ka kam kat kambah donkam ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Khidon Ryngkat jong nga bad kin pyndep ïa ki kamram na ka bynta ki lyngdoh bad na ka bynta ka kynhun baroh kawei .
translation.en: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue , and put thereon the dishes , and the spoons , and the bowls , and covers to cover withal : and the continual bread shall be thereon :
Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee , and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt : so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them , nor remember Egypt any more .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsangeh noh ïa ka jingkwah brai jong pha bad ïa ki jingijli kiba pha la leh naduh ba pha dang don ha Ijipt . Phan ym khmih shuh ïa ki bleithaw ne pyrkhat shuh shaphang ka Ijipt .
hynrei kim da ban skhem ei ei , kam la shisha bun ki briew ki la wan sha khmat bad kren ki jinglamler shaphang jong u .
translation.en: But found none : yea , though many false witnesses came , yet found they none . At the last came two false witnesses ,

translation.kha: Bad shano shano ba U Jisu u leit , sha ki nongrit , ki shnong , ki lynghoh , ki paidbah ki rah ïa kito kiba pang sha ki jaka ïew bad kyrpad ïa u ïa-ban shah ïa ki la kumno kumno Ban ktah ïa ka rnong jaiñkup jong u ; bad baroh kiba ktah ïa ka , ki ïohkhiah .
translation.en: And whithersoever he entered , into villages , or cities , or country , they laid the sick in the streets , and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment : and as many as touched him were made whole .
And they shall build houses , and inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , and eat the fruit of them .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin tei ïa ki ïing ki sem bad kin shong hi ha ki — yn ym pyndonkam ïa ki da kiwei pat . Kin thung ki dieng sohwaiñ bad leh sngewbha ha ka waiñ — yn ym dih ïa ka da kiwei pat .
Bad kumno nur-um wan shai phin da ka jingkmen kabu dap , lada ka long ka mon jong U Blei , Bad ngan dap da ka jinghun ba pynpyngngad hir ngan wan khmih ïa phin .
translation.en: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God , and may with you be refreshed .
And they returned , and came to En–mishpat , which is Kadesh , and smote all the country of the Amalekites , and also the Amorites , that dwelt in Hazazon–tamar .
translation.kha: Nangta ki phai dien bad ki wan poi biang sha Kadesh ( kaba la tip mynshuwa kum ka Enmishpat ) . Ki la jop ïa ka ri baroh jong ki Amalek , bad ki la jop ïa ki Amor ruh kiba shong basah ha Hasason Tamar .
Ïa uno uno uba krensih ka kynta pyrshah ïa U Khun U Briew lah ban map ; hynrei ïa Une uno uba kren kiei kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem bakhatduh yn ym map .
translation.en: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him : but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven .
Saying , Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven , and whose sins are covered .
translation.kha: Suk kita ïa kiba la map noh ïa ki jingleh bymdei , kiba ïa ki pop la map noh!

translation.en: Saying , Blessed be the King that cometh in the name of the Lord : peace in heaven , and glory in the highest .
translation.kha: U Blei u kyrkhu ïa u syiem uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ! Ka jingsuk ha ki bneng bad ka burom ïa U Blei !
Nangta u Paulos u la jubab . Ko Trai , lada dei shisha ma me , lei ïa nga ban wan sha me shalor ka um .
translation.en: And Peter answered him and said , Lord , if it be thou , bid me come unto thee on the water .

translation.kha: Kumno phi kah ban kubur ba phi la shem ïa ka jingstad ? U Blang u dei u ban jubab ïa u Job , naba film smam lah leh ei ei .
translation.en: Lest ye should say , We have found out wisdom : God thrusteth him down , not man .
And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon : for they heard that they should eat bread there .
translation.kha: Ki pynkhreh ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha ban ai ha u Joseph ynda u wan ha ka por shiteng sngi , namar la ïathuh ha ki ba ki dei ban ïabam ryngkat bad u .
Hynrei ym don mano mynno ba la lah ban pynjuh ïa u thylliej . U long uba sner bad bym Lah ban synlar , uba dap da ka bih ba pynïap .
translation.en: But the tongue can no man tame  ; it is an unruly evil , full of deadly poison .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ko Syiem Kynrad , to bud ïa ka jngai jingmut jong sa . Sangeh ban leh pop , to leh ïa kaba de , bad to sngewsynei ïa kiba duk . Te phin ïailong uba manbha .
translation.en: Wherefore , O king , let my counsel be acceptable unto thee , and break off thy sins by righteousness , and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor  ; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity .

translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kan orpait malade ka kad .
translation.en: The earth is utterly broken down , the earth is clean dissolved , the earth is moved exceedingly .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , ha ka sngi katba lai jong ka jingrang ryngkhiang , U Trai u ong ha u Elijah , khie leit pyn-i ïa lade ha u shym Ahab , bad ngan sa phah slap .
translation.en: And it came to pass after many days , that the word of the  Lord  came to Elijah in the third year , saying , Go , shew thyself unto Ahab  ; and I will send rain upon the earth .

translation.kha: Kan don ka sneng ha kob yn don u syiem u ban synshar ha ka jinglong ba-beit , bad ki nongïalam ka ri ki ïa-ban synshar ha ka jinglehhok .
translation.en: Behold , a king shall reign in righteousness , and princes shall rule in judgment .

translation.kha: Te ha khwai ka miet ka la kum ban ïa la i khun bun i la ïap .
translation.en: And this woman s child died in the night  ; because she overlaid it .

translation.kha: Haba ki kylli balei ba nga la bor ïa kine kiei kiei , ïathuh ïa ki , ko Jeremaïah , ba kumba ki la phai ne na nga sad shakri ïa ki beit nongwei ha ka ri jong ki hi , kumta kin shakri ïa ki nongwei ha ka ri ka bym dei ka jong ki .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when ye shall say , Wherefore doeth the  Lord  our God all these things unto us ? then shalt thou answer them , Like as ye have forsaken me , and served strange gods in your land , so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours .

Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which ought not to be done , and shall do against any of them :
translation.kha: ban ïathuh ha ki Israel ba uno uno u briew uba leh pop khlem tip bad u pynkheiñ ïa kano kano ka hukum U  Trai  , u dei ban bud ïa kine ki aiñ harum .

translation.en: And he carried away all his cattle , and all his goods which he had gotten , the cattle of his getting , which he had gotten in Paddan–aram , for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u khreh ban leit phai pat sha la u kpa ha ka ri Kanaan . U pynshong ïa ki khun bad ki tnga jong u halor ki ut , bad u ïalam ïa la ki kynhun jingri jong u baroh ha shuwa jong u , lem bad baroh kiba u la ïohlum ha Mesopotamia .

translation.en: And , behold , there talked with him two men , which were Moses and Elias :
translation.kha: Kynsan ar ngut ki rangbah ki la ïakren bad u . Ki la long u Moses bad u Elijah ,
Hynrei u Amasaïah u kynjai ban shahshkor , kumta u syier Jehoash u tur shaphrang lem nabar ki rangbah jong u malade u ïateh pyrshah ïa u ha Beth Shemesh ha Judah .
translation.en: But Amaziah would not hear . Therefore Jehoash king of Israel went up  ; and he and Amaziah king of Judah looked one another in the face at Beth–shemesh , which belongeth to Judah .

translation.kha: Hato at la kyllum long mynta u nongïeng jong phi! da kaba ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha ?
translation.en: Am I therefore become your enemy , because I tell you the truth ?
And from Heshbon unto Ramath–mizpeh , and Betonim  ; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir  ;
translation.kha: ka jaka jong ki ka ïar naduh Heshbon haduh Ramath Mispeh bad Betonim , naduh Mahanaim haduh ka khappud jong ka Lodebar .

U Mynsiem u long ka jingbahkhlieh ba ngin sa ïohpdiang ïa Kiei kiba U Blei u la kular ha ki bynriew jong u , badno kane ka pynthikna ïa ngi ba U Bel un ai ka jinglaitluid kaba pura ha kito kiba long ki jong u . To ngin ïaroh ïa ka burom jong u!
translation.en: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession , unto the praise of his glory .

translation.kha: Mano ba la ai ïa ki Israel ha ki nonglute ? Ka un-long na U Trai hi , pyrshah ïa u ba ngi la leh pop ! ngiam shym im kumba u khwai ïa ngi ngab im , rue kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai kiba u ai ha ngi .
translation.en: Who gave Jacob for a spoil , and Israel to the robbers ? did not the  Lord  , he against whom we have sinned ? for they would not walk in his ways , neither were they obedient unto his law .
She layeth her hands to the spindle , and her hands hold the distaff .
translation.kha: Ka thir hi ïa la u ksai , bad ka thain hi ïa la ka jaiñ .
Hangta Ngi la shem katto katne ngut ki pynphalang pynlang ngi la sah bad ki shi taïew . Da ka tam jong U Mynsiem ki la ïathaw ïa u Paul ban ym leit sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And finding disciples , we tarried there seven days : who said to Paul through the Spirit , that he should not go up to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Nob U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses ban Ong ha ki , Phi long u paidlang uba mutlop . dalade ngan leit ryngkat badno phi wat tang shikhyllipmat ruh , ngan jin da la pynjot Thiah ïa phi . Law noh mynta ïa iar ki jingdeng jong phi , bad ngan sa rai ngan leh kumno ïa phi .
translation.en: For the  Lord  had said unto Moses , Say unto the children of Israel , Ye are a stiffnecked people : I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment , and consume thee : therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee , that I may know what to do unto thee .

translation.kha: Hato me lah ban pyn-i ïa ki haduh katno dei ban leit , lane ban phah noh biang ïa ki ?
translation.en: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof , and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof ?
Last of all the woman died also .
translation.kha: Khatduh na ki baroh , kata ka briew ka la ïap .
Ha ka por lai bajai U Jisu u la pyrta da ka op kaba jam , Eloi , Eloi , lema sabakhthani ? kaba mut , A Blei jong nga , A Blei jong nga , baluilui ba me Iehnoh ïa nga ?
translation.en: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice , saying ,  Eloi , Eloi , lama sabachthani ?  which is , being interpreted ,  My God , my God , why hast thou forsaken me ?
God forbid : for then how shall God judge the world ?
translation.kha: Ym kumta keiñ! Lada U Blei um long uba hok , kumno un bishar ïa ka pyrthei ?
U Jakob u la Bneng ïa ka jingleit jong u bad u la leit sha ka ri kaba shaphang mihngi .
translation.en: Then Jacob went on his journey , and came into the land of the people of the east .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga , Na don ka kam kaba kham khraw ïa me , ko shakri jong nga . Ym tang ba men rah pat sha ka jingkhraw ïa ki paid Jeraïah kiba la mait im , ishyrkhei ngan pynlong jin ïa me ka jingshai sha ki jaitbynriew — khnang ba ka pyrthei baroh kan ïohlait im .
translation.en: And he said , It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob , and to restore the preserved of Israel : I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles , that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth .

translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka Gilead , ki thain jongngi ka Geshur bad ka Maakah , u Lum Heshmon baroh , bad ka Bashan baroh haduh Helek .
translation.en: And Gilead , and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites , and all mount Hermon , and all Bashan unto Salecah  ;

translation.kha: U lyngkhuh un pyndap ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ha ka duwan ba-bang pynkhuid ïa phi na ka jop jong phi ; bad yn sa map ïa phi .
translation.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly , when he sinneth by ignorance before the  Lord  , to make an atonement for him  ; and it shall be forgiven him .
The king s heart is in the hand of the  Lord  , as the rivers of water : he turneth it whithersoever he will .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynïaid ïa ka jingmut jong u syiem kham suk kumba u pynïaid ïa ka lynti ka wahduid .

Haba phi shet kpu , ïa uta uba phiah shet nyngkong na u kew thymmai dei ban ïawer kum ka jingai kaba keirang sha U Trei . Ïa une dei ban wanpaw kumjuh kumba phi wanpaw jingainguh kyr-ang na u kew ba phin shoh .
translation.en: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering : as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor , so shall ye heave it .

translation.kha: Ki la wan sha Jeraïah , bad katba U Jisu u sdang ban mihnoh ryngkat malade ki synrap jong u bad u paidbah babun , u nongkhrong uba matlah uba kyrteng u Bartimaïos , u khun jongu u Timaïos , u dang shong haduh lynti .
translation.en: And they came to Jericho : and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people , blind Bartimaeus , the son of Timaeus , sat by the highway side begging .

translation.kha: Wat ïathuh mynta phi ai ïa kynsi ki jingai sngewbha bad pynjngut ïa lade da kijuh ki bleithaw da naba kñia ïa la ki khun sha ki ha ka ding . Bad nangta ma Phin ki Israhaïah phi dang ïadie wan baneh kylli kaei ka long ka mon jong nga ! Kumba da shisha ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga longïng U blei umbah im , ngan ym shah ïa phi ban Kylli ei ei na nga .
translation.en: For when ye offer your gifts , when ye make your sons to pass through the fire , ye pollute yourselves with all your idols , even unto this day : and shall I be enquired of by you , O house of Israel ? As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will not be enquired of by you .

translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Abraham , Me ruh me dei ban mynjur ban bat ïa ka jutang bad nga , ma me nabar ki khun ki ksiew jong me ha ki pateng ban wan .
translation.en: And God said unto Abraham , Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore , thou , and thy seed after thee in their generations .

translation.kha: Lada ki jingthmu jong phoi ki long kiba bakha , yn ñiewkor ïa phin , hynrei Ladan Phi Wad ïa ka jingjot , kata ka long kaei kaba phin ïoh .
translation.en: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour : but he that seeketh mischief , it shall come unto him .

translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh bakhia ka la ong lypa ba U Blei un pynkieng ïa ki Jentil ha lade hi da ka jingngeit . Bad kumto ka Jingot Bakhuid ka pynbna ïa ka khur babha ha u Abram : Lyngba Jong me , U Blei un ring ïa ka jyrthiaw baroh .
translation.en: And the scripture , foreseeing that God would justify the heathen through faith , preached before the gospel unto Abraham , saying , In thee shall all nations be blessed .
And the Pharisees also , who were covetous , heard all these things : and they derided him .
translation.kha: Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , ki la rkhiebeiñ ïa U Jisu , namar ba ki ieit ïa ka pisa .

translation.en: And now , behold , I know well that thou shalt surely be king , and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand .
translation.kha: Mynta nga da sngewthikna ba phin sa long u syiem ki Israel bad ba ka hima Israel kan ïaineh ha ka jingsynshar jong phi .

Ka jingimat jong ki ka long ban pynshisha ba ka jingtah jong phoi ka long kaba sngur . Wat ïa ka ksiar , ïa kaba lah ban pynduh , la phrangsngi da ka ding ; bad kumta ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , kaba kham kordor shuh shuh ban ïa ka ksiar , dei ruh ban phrang , khnang ba kan lah ngab shah . Te phin sa ïohpdiang ïa ka jingïaroh bad ka prum bad ka jingpyndonburom ha ka sngur haba ïa U Jisu Khrist yn pynpaw .
translation.en: That the trial of your faith , being much more precious than of gold that perisheth , though it be tried with fire , might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ :

translation.kha: Ka Jael ka mih shabar ban ïashongduh ïa u Sisera bad ka ong ha u , Ale shispah , kynrad ; wan sha ka dara jong nga . Wat sheptieng . kumta u leit shapoh , bad ka pynrieh ïa u shadien ka pyrda .
translation.en: And Jael went out to meet Sisera , and said unto him , Turn in , my lord , turn in to me  ; fear not . And when he had turned in unto her into the tent , she covered him with a mantle .
And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils  ; for the boil was upon the magicians , and upon all the Egyptians .
translation.kha: Ki nongleh myntor kim lah ïeng shuh ha khmat u Moses namar ki la ïa-ïoh tohjaw lut kumba long lem kiwei pat ki nong Ijipt .
( Ioannis 17 :3 ) Hooid , “kata ka pyrthei kan iaid jah noh . . . , hynrei Utai uba ni ka manna jong u Bela u iaisah bymjukut .” —1 Ioannis 2 :17 .
translation.en: ( John 17 :3 ) Yes , “the world is passing away . . .  , but he that does the will of God remains forever .” —1 John 2 :17 .
To the praise of the glory of his grace , wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved .
translation.kha: To ngin ïaroh ïa U Blei namar ka jingaiei ba-dap da ka burom jong u , ïa ka jingai ei u la ai ha ngi ha U Khun uba ieit jong u!
U nongbah Lyngdoh u la kyllaiñ ïa u Stephan , Haduh khie ka dei kaba shisha ?
translation.en: Then said the high priest , Are these things so ?

translation.kha: lane ngam shym la leit sha Jerusalem ban ïakynduh ïa eit kiba long ki apostol shuwa jong nga . Pynban shisyndon nga la wait sha Arabia , nangta nga la wan phai pat sha Damaskos .
translation.en: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me ; but I went into Arabia , and returned again unto Damascus .
For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead , that they might be judged according to men in the flesh , but live according to God in the spirit .
translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw balei ba ïa ka Khubor Babha la ïalap ruh ha kiba ïap , ha kito ïa kiba la bishar katba kum ka jingim ha ka doh kumba ïa uwei pa uwei la bishar ; la ïalap ha ki khnang ba ha jingim ba kynja mynsiem kin ïoh im kumba U Blei u im .
Ka kynhun Israel baroh ka la mihnoh na ka ri shyiap Sin , da kaba ïaid na kiwei ka jaka shata khwai pat ka jaka kat kum ka hukum U Terah . Ki la sher dara ha Rephidim , hynrei ym khong umdih hangta .
translation.en: And all the congregation of the children of Israel journeyed from the wilderness of Sin , after their journeys , according to the commandment of the  Lord  , and pitched in Rephidim : and there was no water for the people to drink .
And these things write we unto you , that your joy may be full .
translation.kha: Ngi thoh ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkmen jong ngi kan long kaba dap pura .

translation.en: Keep silence before me , O islands  ; and let the people renew their strength : let them come near  ; then let them speak : let us come near together to judgment .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ,  To sngap jar bad to shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki ri sha jngai bah ! To pynkhreh ban wanrah ïa ka jingmudui jong phi ha ka ïingbishar ; phin ïoh ïa ka lad jong phi ban kren . To ngin ïawanlang ban rai mano ba dei .
U Jotham u la ïap badno la tep ha ka jingtip ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid , sad u Ahas u khun jong u , u erlangthari syiad ha ka iaki jong u .
translation.en: And Jotham slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father : and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: U nongshetkylla u la lah ai den ïa u paidbah : U briew uba ngan dohksah u long uta ibha phi kwah . To kem ïa u !
translation.en: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign , saying , Whomsoever I shall kiss , that same is he : hold him fast .

translation.kha: U Messaïah u thoh lumrit ïa ka Aiñ U Blei ha ka kitab , khlaw da ieh kamai ruh ka ktah .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book , until they were finished ,

translation.kha: Ki phan ïa nga ïa kajuh ka kyrhuh met sien , bad ha man la ki sien , nga phah ïa kijuh ki jubab .
translation.en: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort  ; and I answered them after the same manner .

translation.kha: kumto u Abda u mihnoh , u da phet krad na u Saul , bad u la leit sha u Ahishar u syiem ka Gath .
translation.en: And David arose , and fled that day for fear of Saul , and went to Achish the king of Gath .

translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ki kyrpang ïa ka . Ki pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka bad ki wiang ding ïa ka nongbah .
translation.en: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem , and had taken it , and smitten it with the edge of the sword , and set the city on fire .

translation.kha: Ka jingsakhi lamler ka long kaba ma kum ka waitlam , u dieng tangon ne u khnam banep .
translation.en: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul , and a sword , and a sharp arrow .

translation.kha: Haba u Enosh u la dap khyndaiphew sneng ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Kenan ,
translation.en: And Enos lived ninety years , and begat Cainan :

translation.kha: Ïa ka sngi yn pyndum , bad u bnai un hylla saw kum ka snar shuwa kata ka sngi bakhraw bad bashyrkhei jong U Trai kan wan .
translation.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness , and the moon into blood , before the great and the terrible day of the  Lord  come .

translation.kha: Hynrei un ong biah , ‘ Ngam ithuh nangno phi ïawan . Khie leit noh na nga , phi baroh ki briew kiba bymman !’
translation.en: But he shall say , I tell you , I know you not whence ye are  ; depart from me , all ye workers of iniquity .
Mine enemies chased me sore , like a bird , without cause .
translation.kha: Nga la shah riam kum ka sim ha ki nongshun ki bym don daw ban isih ïa nga .
hangta ruh kñia bad bam ïa ki jingtieng ïasyllok , bad lehkmen ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And thou shalt offer peace offerings , and shalt eat there , and rejoice before the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Nangno u Jehoïada u ïalum ïa u Joash shabar , u buh ïa ka pansngiat ha ka khlieh jong u , bad u ai ha u ïa ka kopi jong ki aiñ ba pynïaid ïa ka jingsliang syiem . Nangta ïa u Joash la pynsleh syiem nabar la pynbna kum u syiem . Ki paidbah ki thab ïa la ki kti badno ki ïarisa , Im slem ko syiem !
translation.en: And he brought forth the king s son , and put the crown upon him , and gave him the testimony  ; and they made him king , and anointed him  ; and they clapped their hands , and said , God save the king .

translation.kha: Ïa u yn sa aiti neh ha ki Jentil , ki banbeiñ ibeiñ ïa u , krenbeiñ ïa u malade bynthiew ïa u .
translation.en: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles , and shall be mocked , and spitefully entreated , and spitted on :

translation.kha: Me kob sarong ba me la tih pukri bad dih ïa ki um ha ki ri nongwei bad ba ki kjat jong ki shipai jong me ki la ïoh ïuh pyntyrkhong ïa ka wah Nile .
translation.en: I have digged and drunk strange waters , and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places .

Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah , and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah  ; they laid the beams thereof , and set up the doors thereof , and the locks thereof , and the bars thereof .
translation.kha: U Joïada , u khun jong u Paseah , bad u Meshullam , u khun jong u Besodeïah , ki tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Jeshanah . Ki buh ïa ki bim bad pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ki jingkhang ka khyrdop .
Kumta sa shem ba kan ka hukum ka trei ; hab nga khiah ban leh ïa kaei kaba bha , kaei kabu sniew ka long tang ma ka , ka jingdih kaba nga dat .
translation.en: I find then a law , that , when I would do good , evil is present with me .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki kawei pat ka pharshi . Ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew u shim ïa u symbai tyrso mala u tohtit ïa u hapoh ka lyngkha jong u .
translation.en: Another parable put he forth unto them , saying ,  The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed , which a man took , and sowed in his field :

translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba bha ki duwai , U Trai u shakor , hynrei u long jngai ïa kito kiba leh Sniew .
translation.en: The  Lord  is far from the wicked : but he heareth the prayer of the righteous .
An Invitation to Learn
translation.kha: Ka Jingkhot Sngewbha Ban Hikai
Da kumta u Jehu u la pyndeng pyndeng ïa ka jingmane ïa u Baal ha Ishmael .
translation.en: Thus Jehu destroyed Baal out of Israel .

translation.kha: lada U Blei u shim noh ïa ka jingpynkhiah mynsiem na ka jingim ,
translation.en: If he set his heart upon man , if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath  ;

translation.kha: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Kumta u la ïaphylliew jingmut ha ka synagog bad ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kiba mane ïa U Blei , bad hajuh ha ki iaki paidbah manna ka sngi bad ki brai kiba jia ryngkoh ki ïaid nangto .
translation.en: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews , and with the devout persons , and in the market daily with them that met with him .
And in that day did the Lord  God  of hosts call to weeping , and to mourning , and to baldness , and to girding with sackcloth :
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u la khot ïa phi ha kato ka por ban ïam bad ïam pangnud , ban khi ïa ki khlieh jong phi bad ban phong ki jaiñ khain .
Ki nongaplangbrot ki la otsher phai pat , ki da rwai ki jingsarong ïa U Blei na ka boitha barieh kaba ki la jingphohsniew bad ïohi ; ka la long thik kumba u angel u la ïathiah ha ki .
translation.en: And the shepherds returned , glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen , as it was told unto them .

translation.kha: A katno suk ka long ïa kito ki bymlah Don jingartatien shaphang jong nga !
translation.en: And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ki shynrang , ki la iehnoh ïa ka jingshongkurim bad ki kynthei kat kum ba dei ka lap bad ki la ïa ïng da ka jingkwah bran para ma ki hi . Ki shynrang ki leh ktien kiei kiba khlemrain para ma ki , bad ka jingmih ka long ba ki Wanlam halor lade hi ïa ka jingpyntreikam katba ki dat khih ban ïoh na ka pyntha ka jingleh bym dei jong ki .
translation.en: And likewise also the men , leaving the natural use of the woman , burned in their lust one toward another ; men with men working that which is unseemly , and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet .

translation.kha: Wat thmu sniew ei ei ban pynmong ïa la u Pharpar , uba kamar-tama hajan lad phi , uba shaniah ïa phira .
translation.en: Devise not evil against thy neighbour , seeing he dwelleth securely by thee .

translation.kha: Khreh la sha daiñ step , bad wan kiew ïa u Lem Sinai ban ïashem dara nga hangta ha kliar lum .
translation.en: And be ready in the morning , and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai , and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses

translation.en: Now when Jesus was in Bethany , in the house of Simon the leper ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la don ha Bethania ha ka ïing jong u Simon , u briew uba la pang  ñiangthohlieh .
bad u la kylli ïa ki , Kato phi la ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid haba phi! la long kiba thwet ? Ngim pat ju ïohsngew ba don U Mynsiem Bakhuid , ki la Jubab .
translation.en: He said unto them , Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed ? And they said unto him , We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: Buh ïa ki ha ki tylli tawah tyrpeng jong ka ephod ba kin ïeng na ka bynta ki khaw-eit jaitniam Israel . Ha ken ka rukom u Aaron un kit ïa ki kyrteng jong ki ha la ka tyrpeng khring ba ma nga , U Trai , nur ïai kyntiew ïa ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel : and Aaron shall bear their names before the  Lord  upon his two shoulders for a memorial .
When Will Paradise Come ?
translation.kha: Lano ka Paradais Kan Wan ?

translation.en: Behold , I come quickly : hold that fast which thou hast , that no man take thy crown .
translation.kha: Ngan wan kloi . Sumar kyndong ïa kaei kaba pha don , khnang ba yn ym don uno uno u ban lute na pha ïa ka bainong jong ka jingjop .
U briew baduk bad u nongbanbeiñ jong u ki ïadon ïa kane kumjuh — U Trai u ai ïa ki khmat ha baroh ar ngut .
translation.en: The poor and the deceitful man meet together : the  Lord  lighteneth both their eyes .
Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us , who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ  ; what was I , that I could withstand God ?
translation.kha: Ka long kaba shai ba U Blei u la ai ïa kito ki Jentil ïa kajuh ka jingai kaba u la ai ha ngi myn haba ngi la ngeit ha U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai ; nga long uei , te , ban pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa U Blei !

translation.en: What work do the ministerial servants perform for our benefit ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka kamram jong ki nongïarap ?
Phim ïaryngkat bun wat uwei u rangbah synshar uba rit kuna jongnga ki Assyria nabar pynban phin khmih lyngkot ba ki Ijipt ba kin phah ha phi ïa ki kada ïapom bad ki shipai shong khwai .
translation.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master s servants , and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?

Now , behold , thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed , even upon Egypt , on which if a man lean , it will go into his hand , and pierce it : so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him .
translation.kha: Phi khmih lynti ba ka Ijipt kan ïarap ïa phi , hynrei kata kan long kumba pyndonkam ïa u khah kum u diengduh — un kdiah bad un dung ïa ka kti jong phi . Kata ka dei kaei kaba u syiem ka Ijipt u long haba mano mano ki shaniah tylli ha u .
Ko Israel , katba kut ka la wan . Phan sa sngewdiaw ïa ka jingbitar jongu nga ; naba Ngan habar ïa phah ïa kaei kaba phai la leh . Ngam pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kam ijli jongno pha baroh .
translation.en: Now is the end come upon thee , and I will send mine anger upon thee , and will judge thee according to thy ways , and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations .

translation.kha: Khnang ba U Blang un sngap ïa ki jingïadei jong phi , Phi dei ban ïajah ban im ïakem ki law jngai u .
translation.en: For your prayers to be heard by God , you must be trying your best to live by his laws .

translation.kha: Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ kun erlangthari khat-ar mitar ka lynter dara ar lytar ka kynjah . Ïaroh kita ki lyngkot jaiñ ki dei banbeiñ long katjuh ka jingdih .
translation.en: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : and every one of the curtains shall have one measure .
Lift up thine eyes round about , and see : all they gather themselves together , they come to thee : thy sons shall come from far , and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side .
translation.kha: Khmih sawdong jong pha bad peit kaei kaba jia : Ki briew jong pha kin ïalumlang ban wan phai sha ïing ; ki khun shynrang jong pha kin wan na sha jngai bah , bad ïa ki khun kynthei jong pha yn shu rah kum ïa ki khunlung .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh  ; lo , he cometh forth to the water  ; and say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Let my people go , that they may serve me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Lashai dang step phyrngab , khie leit ap ïa u Pharaoh katba u dang leit sha ka wah , bad ïathuh ha u ba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga ba kin ïoh mane ïa nga .
U Jisu u la ïa-ong ha u , Khie leit , u khun jong me un im ! Uta u briew u la bieit ïa ki ktien U Jiw bad u la leit napoh .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Go thy way  ; thy son liveth .  And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him , and he went his way .

And he said unto me , Son of man , I send thee to the children of Israel , to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me : they and their fathers have transgressed against me , even unto this very day .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , ngan phah ïa me sha ki paid Israel . Ki la ïaleh pyrshah bad ki phai lyndet ïa nga bad ki dang ïai pyrshah hi , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la long .

Te nga la peit , nabar la don U Khunlangbrot uba ïeng halor u lum Seïon ; lem bad u la don shi lakh sawphew saw ïahiar ngut ki bynriew kiba la ne ïa ka kyrteng jong u , bad ïa ka kyrteng jong U Kpa jong u ïa kaba la thoh ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .
translation.en: And I looked , and , lo , a Lamb stood on the mount Sion , and with him an hundred forty and four thousand , having his Father s name written in their foreheads .
He hath said , which heard the words of God , and knew the knowledge of the most High , which saw the vision of the Almighty , falling into a trance , but having his eyes open :
translation.kha: Uba lah ban ïohsngew aïu U Blei u ong , Bad uba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingtip kaba wan na U Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Da ki khmat kiba peit nga ïohi ha ka jingïohi rngai Ka jingïohipaw na U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
Ki dei shwa ban shna ka Ïingjaiñ kaba kynthih na ka bynta jong nga , khñiang ba ngan ïoh shong hapdeng jong ki .
translation.en: And let them make me a sanctuary  ; that I may dwell among them .

translation.kha: bad ha Hades , ha kaba u la don ha ka jingshitom bakhraw , u la Khmih shajrong bad u la ïohi ïa u Abraham , sha Jngai bah , bad ïa u Lasaros ha syndah jongnga u .
translation.en: And in hell he lift up his eyes , being in torments , and seeth Abraham afar off , and Lazarus in his bosom .
Nicodemus saith unto him , How can a man be born when he is old ? can he enter the second time into his mother s womb , and be born ?
translation.kha: Kumno lah ban kha pat ïa u briew uba la rangbah ?  U Nikodemos u la kylli .  Kam lah ban long ba un rung shapoh ka kpoh jong ka kmie jong u bad ban kha sa shisien !

translation.en: And Moses lifted up his hand , and with his rod he smote the rock twice : and the water came out abundantly , and the congregation drank , and their beasts also .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u rah shajrong ïa u diengduh bad u la tied ar sien ïa uta u mawsiang ; te ka um kaba heh ka la mih , bad baroh ki briew lem bad ki jingri ki la ïadih .
Shimham ïa ki kti jong nga bad ki phet jong sa , bad peit ba dei ma nga hi . Tba ïa nga , bad phin tip , ngab ka rai kam don ka doh bad ki shyieng , ruma phi ïoh ba sa don .
translation.en: Behold my hands and my feet , that it is I myself : handle me , and see  ; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones , as ye see me have .
And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together , the floods stood upright as an heap , and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea .
translation.kha: Me la pyrsad ïa ka duriaw bad ka um ka kynton shajrong eh ; ka ïeng beit thik kum ka kynroh ; ka bynta bajylliew tam jong ka duriaw ka kylla eh .
Kiwei pat ki Israel ktieh dei Shu ban wan sha jan ka Ïingjaiñ ïoh ki wallam ha lade ïa ka jingshah pyndem da ka jingïap .
translation.en: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation , lest they bear sin , and die .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la pynjrong ka jinglorni ha ka ri shyiap ba kun ym rah ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki , ka ri kaba tiduh da ka dud bad ka ngap , ka ri bakynsai tam na baroh .
translation.en: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness , that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them , flowing with milk and honey , which is the glory of all lands  ;

translation.kha: Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , U Trai Nongsynshar u la ong , une u syiem un ïap ha Babilonia namar u la pynkheiñ ïa la ka jingsmai bad ka jingïateh lok bad u symboh ka Babilonia , uba la bsuh ïa u halor ka khet .
translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king , whose oath he despised , and whose covenant he brake , even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die .

translation.kha: A Trai , ngan im na ka bynta Jong me , bad tyngka ïa me hi ; to pynkhiah ïa nga bad ai ngan im .
translation.en: O Lord , by these things men live , and in all these things is the life of my spirit : so wilt thou recover me , and make me to live .

translation.kha: Balei ba phi khot ïa nga , ‘ A Trai , A Trai ,’ bad pynban phim leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ha phi ?
translation.en: And why call ye me , Lord , Lord , and do not the things which I say ?

translation.kha: Yn ym don ki ban hiarpateng ïa ki briew kiba khlem blei , pynlang ka ding kan bam duh ïa ki ïing ba la tei da ka jingbamsap .
translation.en: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate , and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery .

translation.kha: Haba phi! bam ïa kane ka jingbam , wat bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh tait . Hynñiew sngaid phin bam ïa u kpu khlem thiat , kumba phi la ïam mynba phi la dei ban mihnoh kyrkieh na Ijipt . Bam ïa une u kdup — yn khot ïa u , u kpu ka jingshah khim — ba katba Phi dang im phin ïai kynmaw ïa kata ka sngi mynsngi phi mihnoh na Ijipt , kata ka khang ka jingshah shitom .
translation.en: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it  ; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith , even the bread of affliction  ; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste : that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life .

translation.kha: U ioh thiaw da kaba pynïap ïa ki nud Aroer Haduh ka thapniang Minnith , baroh ki long arphew tylli ki nongbah , bad haduh Ethbaal Keramim . Ka la don ka jingpynïap briew kaba jur , mala ki Ammon ki shoh-ïap ha ki Israel .
translation.en: And he smote them from Aroer , even till thou come to Minnith , even twenty cities , and unto the plain of the vineyards , with a very great slaughter . Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel .
Thou hast increased the nation , O  Lord  , thou hast increased the nation : thou art glorified : thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me la pynlong ïa ka hima jong ngi ban roi , da kaba pynïar ïa ka ri ha baroh sawdong , bad kane ka la wallam ïa me ka burom .
Te U Abraham u la thung uwei u dieng Tamarisk ha Beersheba bad u la mane ïa U thri , U Blei bymkut .
translation.en: And Abraham planted a grove in Beer–sheba , and called there on the name of the  Lord  , the everlasting God .
And Moses said , Hereby ye shall know that the  Lord  hath sent me to do all these works  ; for I have not done them of mine own mind .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Da kane phin tip ba dei U  Trai  uba la phah ïa nga ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh , bad ba ym dei da ka mon jong nga ba nga la leh ïa ki .

translation.en: I the  Lord  do keep it  ; I will water it every moment : lest any hurt it , I will keep it night and day .
translation.kha: Ngan khmih ïa ka bad ïai ai um ïa ka . Ngan ap phira ïa ka mynmiet bad mynsngi khnang ba yn ym don mano mano u ban pynsniew ïa ka .

translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; call upon his name : make known his deeds among the people .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u ; ïathuh ïa ki jaitbynriew ïa kaei kaba u la leh .
Nangta u lyngdoh , kiba kup ïa ka jaiñkup linen bad uba phong ïa ka patlun lymne kaba lyngkot , un weng noh ïa u dpei khleiñ ba tama ha ka duwan bad un buh ïa u harud jong ka duwan .
translation.en: And the priest shall put on his linen garment , and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh , and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar , and he shall put them beside the altar .

translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa pha ïa ka ksiar ha ka jaka ka rnong , ka spoiñ malade ka kamar-tama ha ka jakarieh u nar bad ka dieng , bun u nar ha ka jaka u maw . Ki Nongsynshar jong phad kin ym banbeiñ shuh ïa phasi ; tun pynlong ïa ki ngab pynsynjor da ka hok badno ka jingsuk .
translation.en: For brass I will bring gold , and for iron I will bring silver , and for wood brass , and for stones iron : I will also make thy officers peace , and thine exactors righteousness .

Wherefore they came again , and told him . And he said , This is the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite , saying , In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel :
translation.kha: Haba ki leit ïathuh ïa kane ha u Jehu , u la ong ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ba kan jia , mynba u la kren lyngba u shakri jong u , u Elijah : ‘ Ki ksew kin bam ïa ka met jong ka Jesebel ha ka thain Jesreel .
Naba U Trai u long U Balei bakyrhai , u syiem uba khrawbor halor ki blei baroh .
translation.en: For the  Lord  is a great God , and a great King above all gods .

translation.kha: Te u jingkdew jyllang uta u briew ïa uba nga la jied un khiar lung . Da kumta ngan pynsngap jar ïa ki jingïaiban khñium jong kine ki Israel pyrshah ïa me .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that the man s rod , whom I shall choose , shall blossom : and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel , whereby they murmur against you .

translation.kha: Man la ka sngi ha ki por ban wan , kñia ha kata ka duwan ar thyllah ki langbrot kiba shisnem .
translation.en: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar  ; two lambs of the first year day by day continually .
And if Satan rise up against himself , and be divided , he cannot stand , but hath an end .
translation.kha: Kumta lada ka hima u Soitan ka phiah ha ki kynhun , kan ym lah ban neh , hynrei kan kyllon noh bad poi sha ka jingkut .
baroh kiei kiei uba u syiem Josaïah u la leh la pahuh jingkhih ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

translation.kha: Un pynmih da ka jingshlur ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhraw ban tur ïaleh ïa u syier ka jingtep , u ban pynkhreh ban ïaleh pyrshah da ka kynhun shipai babun bad bakyrhuh . Hynrei ïa u sahmiet ka Ijipt yn shukor bad un ym jop .
translation.en: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army  ; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army  ; but he shall not stand : for they shall forecast devices against him .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba u lalot u mih na Simon , ka ding bad u kyndok ki la hap na bneng bad la pynïap ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven , and destroyed them all .

translation.kha: Khmut u Ïoannis u la ong ha ki barieh , NGA pynbaptis ïa phi da ka um , hyndai ne ti pat uba wan uba kham khlaw ban ïa nga . Ngam long Uba bit kad ban lyoh ïa ki juti jong u . Un pynbaptis ïa phiah da U Mynsngi Bakhuid bad da ka ding .
translation.en: John answered , saying unto them all , I indeed baptize you with water  ; but one mightier than I cometh , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose : he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire :

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la kren biang ha de u la ong ,
translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Naba ngi ieid da ka jingtieng , ym da ka jingïohi .
translation.en: For we walk by faith , not by sight .

translation.kha: Ka la long ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba san jong ka snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jingringmraw jong ngi . Katto katne ngut na ki nongïamareh jong ka kynhun ki Jeruel , ki la ïawan ban kylli ïa nga shaphang ka mon jong U Trai , bad ki la shong ha khmat Jong nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the seventh year , in the fifth month , the tenth day of the month , that certain of the elders of Israel came to enquire of the  Lord  , and sat before me .

translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban pynbeit ïano ïano ha kaba paw ban ïa kaba pynlong ïa u don pyrthuh ba phim suidñiew satia ïa u .
translation.en: Open rebuke is better than secret love .
Now therefore give pledges , I pray thee , to my master the king of Assyria , and I will give thee two thousand horses , if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jingïathong bad phi ha ka kyrteng u patsha . Ngan ai ïa phi ar hajar tylli ki kulai lada phi lah ban shem katta ngut ki rangbah ki ban shong ha ki .
Ha ka jaka shok jongngi ka Ïaineh , ïakit ïa ka pyrshah kaba da ka linen katba ni , ba la thain da u sarew uba jngum , Uba sawbthuh , bad kaba rong saw , bad ba la suh pynpur itynnat bha .
translation.en: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , wrought with needlework .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta u syiem ïa put hi , kane ka dei kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai U balui ki Israel , nga ong : To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab ,
translation.en: And as for the king of Judah , who sent you to enquire of the  Lord  , so shall ye say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard  ;

translation.kha: ba un pynim ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong moi , na ka leh jong kito baroh kiba isih ïa i .
translation.en: That we should be saved from our enemies , and from the hand of all that hate us  ;

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong , Hadien sawphew snem ngan wallam pat ïa ki nong Ijipt na ki ri sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki ,
translation.en: Yet thus saith the Lord  God   ; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered :

translation.kha: Kat kaba nga kren ka dei ka jingshisha , ha nga ki Ktien lamler ki long kiba jylla .
translation.en: For my mouth shall speak truth  ; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips .

translation.kha: U shitaiew kaba shit phyrnai un long ka pung , dara ka khyndew kob thrang um kane long ki umpohliew . —Isaïah 35 :1 , 6 , 7 .
translation.en: And the heat-parched ground will have become as a reedy pool , and the thirsty ground as springs of water .”—Isaiah 35 :1 , 6 , 7 .
And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth , even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs , when she is shaken of a mighty wind .
translation.kha: Ki khlur ki la hap ha pyrthei , kum ki soh Dumbur bym pat ih na u dieng haba kynther ka lyer kaba jur .

Ka kynhun barben kawei ka la sngewdap jar katba ki dang sngap ïa ka jingtynjuh jongu u Barnabas bad u Philip ïa ki kambah nabar ki khung barabor kiba U Blei u la leh liengbah jong ki hapdeng ki Jentil .
translation.en: Then all the multitude kept silence , and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul , declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them .

translation.kha: Kumta baroh woh sngewtieng , da kaba pyrkhat ïa kaei phin bam bun dih .
translation.en: And seek not ye what ye shall eat , or what ye shall drink , neither be ye of doubtful mind .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba ka ïa kaba biang ka la poi , U Blei u la phar ïa la U Khun .
translation.en: But when the fulness of the time was come , God sent forth his Son , made of a woman , made under the law ,

translation.kha: Kynmaw borabor ïa kaei kaba phi la nang . Ka jingainong jingkit jong phi ka dei ka jingim jrong phi — ri kyndong ïa ka .
translation.en: Take fast hold of instruction  ; let her not go : keep her  ; for she is thy life .

translation.kha: To ngin khroh ïa U Trai , U Blei jngai ki Israel ! U la wanrah ïa ka ban ïarap ïa ki briew jong u bad ban pynthylli ïa ki .
translation.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel  ; for he hath visited and redeemed his people ,
Woe to the crown of pride , to the drunkards of Ephraim , whose glorious beauty is a fading flower , which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine !
translation.kha: Ka hima Israel ka la kut ! Ka burom jong ka , ka la jah kum ki pansngiat syntiew ha ki khlieh jong ki nongïalam buaid . Ïa ki khlieh basarong jong ki la pyniwbih bha , hynrei hangta ki ïathiah , ki buaid bhor .
