translation.en: Seek ye the  Lord  , all ye meek of the earth , which have wrought his judgment  ; seek righteousness , seek meekness : it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the  Lord s  anger .
translation.kha: To phai noh sha U  Trai  , phi baroh ki briew kiba sngewrit , kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u . To leh ïa kaei kaba dei , bad to pynrit ïa lade ha khmat U  Trai . Lehse phin lait na ka jingpynshitom ha ka sngi haba U  Trai  u pyn-i ïa ka jingbitar jong u .

lada ka long ban pynshlur ïa kiaw , ngi dei ban imat kumjuh . Uno uno uba ïamareh badno kiwei u dei ban sa ïa kata da ka jingkylluid mynhyndai ; Un uno uba to ka iktiar u dadien don trei shitom ; a uno uba pyn-i ka jingsbun ïa kiwei u dei ba leh da kaba kmen .
translation.en: Or he that exhorteth , on exhortation : he that giveth , let him do it with simplicity ; he that ruleth , with diligence ; he that sheweth mercy , with cheerfulness .

translation.kha: Naba u mih bad khlam ïa ki hynñiew nguid kiwei pat ki mynsiem Ibbah kham sniew ban ïa u hi , bad ki wan bad shongsah hangta . Kumta haba ka la dat baroh , uta u bri un don ha ka jinglong ba kham sniew ban ïa kaba u la longkmie ha kaba sdang .
translation.en: Then goeth he , and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself  ; and they enter in , and dwell there : and the last state of that man is worse than the first .

translation.kha: badno u buh halor jong ka ïa u kpu ba la pynngeit sha U Trai , kumba U Trai u la lawbah ïa u .
translation.en: And he set the bread in order upon it before the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  had commanded Moses .
But whereunto shall I liken this generation ? It is like unto children sitting in the markets , and calling unto their fellows ,
translation.kha: Mynta , bad kaei nga lah ban nujor ïa ki briew jong kane ka por ? Ki long kum ki khynnah kiba ïashong ha ki jaka ïew . Kawei ka kynhun ka pyrta ïa kawei pat ,

translation.en: And brought them out , and said , Sirs , what must I do to be saved ?
translation.kha: Nangta u la ïalam noh ïa ki shabar bad u la kylli ,  Ko rangbah , kaei nga dei ban leh ba yn pynim ïa nga ?
Ïa ka jaka rung jongu ka Ïingjaiñ , ki shna ka pyrda kiba da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u sohwaiñ uba jyrngam , uba sawbthuh , Bad kiba rong saw , bad ha kaba la suh pynpur itynnat ba .
translation.en: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , of needlework  ;

translation.kha: bad uta u sumar ruh um shym la pynshlei ban leh ïa kata kaba la ai jingmut , namar ba u la ibha eh ïa ka khun jong u Jakob . U long ruh uba donburom tam na ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u baroh .
translation.en: And the young man deferred not to do the thing , because he had delight in Jacob s daughter : and he was more honourable than all the house of his father .

translation.kha: U Trai u Isih ïa ki briew kiba pynbunkam da ki tarajur bad mawthew bymneh .
translation.en: Divers weights , and divers measures , both of them are alike abomination to the  Lord .
But that the world may know that I love the Father  ; and as the Father gave me commandment , even so I do . Arise , let us go hence .
translation.kha: Ngam lah ban kren bad phi kham slem , namar u nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei un wan . Um donbor halor jong nga , hynrei , ka pyrthei ka dei ban tip ba nga ieit ïa U Kpa ; na kata ka daw balei ba nga leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba u hukum ïa nga .  Ale , ïa ngin ïaleit noh na kane ka jaka .

U Trai u ong , Phira tharai ba at la Pha noh ïa la ki briew kum u briew uba pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga ? Hangno te , ki don ki kotbor pyllait tnga ? Phi tharai nga la die ïa phi sha ka jingshahtehmraw kum u bynriew uba die ïa la ki khun kum ki mraw ? Em , phi la leit shahtehmraw ei namar ki pop lad phi ; la phah noh ïa phi namarba ki ki bymman jong phi .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Where is the bill of your mother s divorcement , whom I have put away ? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you ? Behold , for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves , and for your transgressions is your mother put away .
How much more shall the blood of Christ , who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to God , purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living God ?
translation.kha: Namar ba kane ka long kaba shisha , kaba katno tam lah ban pyndep da ka snam U Khrist ! Lyngba U Mynsiem bymjukut u la aiti ïa lade kum ka jingkñia kaba janai ha U Blei . Ka snam jong u kan pynkhuid ïa ka jingïatiplem jong ngi na ki niam ki rukom ki bymmyntoi , khnang ba ngi lah ban shakri ïa U Blei uba im .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Joshua , Choose us out men , and go out , fight with Amalek : to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of God in mine hand .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Joshua ,  Jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki ban leit ïaleh ïa ki Amalek lashai ka sngi . Ngan ïeng ha kliar u lum da kaba bat ïa u diengduh ba U Blei u la ong ïa nga ban rah .

translation.en: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him : for some said , He is a good man : others said , Nay  ; but he deceiveth the people .
translation.kha: Ka la don ka jingïa-pasiaw kaba jur shaphang jong u hapdeng u paidbah .  U long u briew uba bha ,  don kiba la ong .  Em ,  kiwei ki la ong ,  u ïalam bakla ïa ki briew .
mana mut ba nga dei ban da ïoh ïa ka jingphla jong u briew ; nga ong ïa kane ba khnang ba phin ïohlait im .
translation.en: But I receive not testimony from man : but these things I say , that ye might be saved .

translation.kha: Nangta u la rim ïa ka khuri , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , bad u la ai ïa ka ha ki . To dkoh ïa ka , phi baroh , u la ïong ;
translation.en: And he took the cup , and gave thanks , and gave it to them , saying ,  Drink ye all of it  ;
Consider now from this day and upward , from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month , even from the day that the foundation of the  Lord s  temple was laid , consider it .
translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi ka dei ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba khyndai , ka sngi ha kaba la pyndep ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ . Ha khmih kaei ka ban sa jia naduh mynta .

translation.en: When I lie down , I say , When shall I arise , and the night be gone ? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day .
translation.kha: Haba nga dem ban thiah , ki kynta ki ïaid suki nga khih pisa baroh shi miet bad ka slem ban kynjat shai .

I nonghikai Baibl jong phi in kmen banbeiñ wad lang ïa ki jaboh pynlang phi khnang ba mangi laiñ sad ka ïing ka sem jong Phi phin lah ba ‘ ri noh ia lade ha ka jingieit U Blei , da kaba ap khmih hir hir ia . . . ka jingim bymjukut .’ Jehoïada 21 .
translation.en: Your Bible teacher will be pleased to explore the answers with you so that you and your family can “keep yourselves in God’s love , . . . with everlasting life in view .” —Jude 21 .

translation.kha: To ong ba Kane ka Long kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ïakhot ïa u syiad ka Ijipt : Nga long u nongshong jong me , ma me u kuratia bakynsha , uba dem ha ka wah . Me ong ba ka wah Nile ka long ka jong me bad ba me la pynlong ïa ka .
translation.en: Speak , and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , Pharaoh king of Egypt , the great dragon that lieth in the midst of his rivers , which hath said , My river is mine own , and I have made it for myself .

translation.kha: Katto kiba buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha ka Sudan bad kiba la kabu sarong shaphang ka Ijipt kin shaïong jingmut ; la pynkhih ïa ki jingkyrmen jong ki .
translation.en: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation , and of Egypt their glory .

translation.kha: Kynton ai ïa la ka jingijli jong ki , bad phi dei ba leh Rumah ki ong ïa phi .
translation.en: And thou shalt do according to the sentence , which they of that place which the  Lord  shall choose shall shew thee  ; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee :
And the  Lord  thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed , and thou shalt possess it  ; and he will do thee good , and multiply thee above thy fathers .
translation.kha: khnang ba phin ïoh kam kynti biang ïa kata ka ri ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la shong shisien . Un pynmanbha bad un pynroi ïa phi kham bun shah ban ïa kaba u la leh ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi .

translation.en: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh , they constrain you to be circumcised ; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pyrshang ban pynbor ïa phi ban otsher ki dei kito kiba kwah ban pynpaw bad kob ïa ki kam kiba paw shabar . Ki leh ïa ka , la kumno kumno , tang ban lait na ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ na ka bynta ka diengphna U Khrist .
Phi lah ban tharai ba baroh kat kabu phi ai ka long kaba dei , hynrei kynruh ba U Trai u bishar ïa ki jingthmu jong phi .
translation.en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes : but the  Lord  pondereth the hearts .

translation.kha: U la pyrshang ngab ïohi ïa U Jehu ba u long uba kumno , hynrei u erlangthari u briew uba rit bad um lah pun ïew ïa U ijuh Naamah ki paidbah .
translation.en: And he sought to see Jesus who he was  ; and could not for the press , because he was little of stature .

translation.kha: Bad uno uno uba la iehnoh ïa ki ïing ki sem lane ïa ki hynmen ki la dawai ïa u kpa lane ïa ka kmie lane ïa ki khwan ki ktha lane ïa ki lyngkha na ka bynta jong nga , un ïohpdiang shispah shuh tam ïa kata , bad yn ai ha u ïa ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: And every one that hath forsaken houses , or brethren , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my name s sake , shall receive an hundredfold , and shall inherit everlasting life .

translation.kha: Uba lah Ban ïohsngew aïu U Blei u ong , Bad wahbah ïohpdiang ïa ka jingtip kaba wan na U Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Da ki khmat kba peit to ïohi ha ka jingïohi rngai Ka jingïohipaw na U blem Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: He hath said , which heard the words of God , and knew the knowledge of the most High , which saw the vision of the Almighty , falling into a trance , but having his eyes open :

translation.kha: Ïa ki mar khaïi jong pha la pynkit ha ki kynhun liengbah kit ma baheh tam . Pha long kum ka liengbah ha duriaw ba la pynkit da ki jingkit bakhia .
translation.en: The ships of Tarshish did sing of thee in thy market : and thou wast replenished , and made very glorious in the midst of the seas .

translation.kha: ( Ym ju don ine uno uba isih ïa la ka jong ka met . Pynban , u bsa bad sumar ïa ka , kumba U Khrist ruh u leh ïa ka balang ;
translation.en: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh ; but nourisheth and cherisheth it , even as the Lord the church :

translation.kha: Phi ïamihnoh na ka ri Ijipt ha kane ka sngi jong u bnai uba nyngkong , u bnai Abib .
translation.en: This day came ye out in the month Abib .

And they came in , and possessed it  ; but they obeyed not thy voice , neither walked in thy law  ; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do : therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them :
translation.kha: Hynrei ynda ki la wan sha kane ka ri bad shimti ïa ka , kim shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me lane im kat kum ka jinghikai jong me ; kim shym la leh ïa kaba me la hukum ïa ki ban leh . Bad kumta me la wallam ïa kane ka jingpynjot baroh ha ki .

Kumta u Gideon u phah noh ïa ine ki Israel baroh sha ïing , lait napoh ki bashispah ngut , kiba la sumar ïa Baroh ki jingbam bad ki turoi . Ka jaka sher dara jong ki Medan ka don shrah jong ki ha ka them .
translation.en: So the people took victuals in their hand , and their trumpets : and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent , and retained those three hundred men : and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley .

translation.kha: U ju um shym la pashait ïa kamai kaba ki la ong , ishyrkhei u la jong ha u Jairos , Wat sheptieng , shu ngeit .
translation.en: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken , he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue ,  Be not afraid , only believe .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , yn sa khum sa teh ïa me da ki tyllai , bad manna ym haka Ban leit sha tare paidlang .
translation.en: But thou , O son of man , behold , they shall put bands upon thee , and shall bind thee with them , and thou shalt not go out among them :

translation.kha: Ngan pynthnam jur ïa ki bad pynhiarkput pyrsa halor Jong ki . Kin mad ïa ka jingbitar jong ar . Te kine sa tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall lay my vengeance upon them .

translation.kha: U Trai u kein bad nga , kun ym ïasheptieng ; u biria un lah leh aïu ïa nga ?
translation.en: The  Lord  is on my side  ; I will not fear : what can man do unto me ?

translation.kha: Nangta u shim ïa Uei u kpu na ka shang ba la bthuh ïa ki kpoh bakhlem thiat ba la pynkyntang sha U Trai , uwei u kpu ba la khleh umphniang , eiei u kpu uba stang , bad u pahuh ïa ki halor tala ka khleiñ bad ka kjat-dien kamon .
translation.en: And out of the basket of unleavened bread , that was before the  Lord  , he took one unleavened cake , and a cake of oiled bread , and one wafer , and put them on the fat , and upon the right shoulder :

translation.kha: Kam pher la hangno hangno ki Israel ki shong ki sah” , kim dei da lei lei ban pyndonkam ïa ka snam jong ki sim ne ki kparad kum ka jingbam .
translation.en: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood , whether it be of fowl or of beast , in any of your dwellings .

translation.kha: Kumta te , u briew u bym kuna ïa kaba ba kaba u tip ba u dih ban leh u long uba shah pynjam namar ka pop .
translation.en: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good , and doeth it not , to him it is sin .
The rich man is wise in his own conceit  ; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba riewspah ki ju pyrkhat borabor ba ki long kiba stad , hynrei u briew uba duk , uba don ka jingsngewthuh shaphang ka jinglongbriew u tip kham bha .

Ha ka snoh banyngkong jong ka jingsynshar jong u patsha Syros , u la hukum ba ïa ka Thep ha Jerusalem yn thet pat ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh yn thang . Ka Templ ka Dei ngab long arphew hynriewphew mitar ka jingjrong bad arphew hynñiew mitar ka pyngkiang .
translation.en: In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem , Let the house be builded , the place where they offered sacrifices , and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid  ; the height thereof threescore cubits , and the breadth thereof threescore cubits  ;

translation.kha: U Saul , u Jonathan u khun jong u , bad ki rangbah jong ki , ki sher dara ha Geba ha ka thoiñ Benjamin ; ka iaki sher dara ki Philistia ka dei ha Mikhmash .
translation.en: And Saul , and Jonathan his son , and the people that were present with them , abode in Gibeah of Benjamin : but the Philistines encamped in Michmash .

translation.kha: Ka longïing jongki me kan long kum ka longsyiem u syiem Joram u khun jongu u Nebat , bad kamon ka longïing u syiem Baasha u khunlung jong u Ahijah , namar ba me la pynkhih bitar ïa nga da kaba ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .’
translation.en: And will make thine house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah , for the provocation wherewith thou hast provoked me to anger , and made Israel to sin .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan rit da ka jar bad kem ïa ki kum ki sim katba ki dang ïaid . Ngan pynmih ïa ki namar ki kam bymman ba ki la leh .
translation.en: When they shall go , I will spread my net upon them  ; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven  ; I will chastise them , as their congregation hath heard .
And he said unto them , What have I done now in comparison of you ? Is not the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abi–ezer ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u ong ha ki ,  Kaei kaba nga lah ban leh kam long ei ei haba nujor bad kaei kaba phi la leh . Wat kata kaba rit eh kaba ma phi ki paid Ephraim phi la leh ka long kaba kham kor shikatdei eh ban ïa kaei kaba ka kur jong nga baroh ka la leh .

Minnith to ïathuh ïa ki por ba shuh ringmraw ïa kadei kaba na ong . Nga long uta uba la phah ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha ki ri kiba jngai bad pynsakma ïa ki ha kiwei de ki ri . Pynnep , ïa mynta shipor ngan kein bad ki ha ki jaka sha ka ki la leit .
translation.en: Therefore say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen , and although I have scattered them among the countries , yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come .
Speak unto all the people of the land , and to the priests , saying , When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month , even those seventy years , did ye at all fast unto me , even to me ?
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka ri bad ïa ki lyngdoh ba haba ki shahjingit bad ïambriew ha u bnai basan bad bahynñiew ha kine ki hynñiewphew snem , kam shym dei ha ka jingñiewburom ïa nga .
Haba ngi shahshitom , sem dei ban shongsuk marwei ha ka jingïaishah bymstad Jar ;
translation.en: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence , because he hath borne it upon him .

translation.kha: Ki Rangbah pynïaidkam jong pha ki lama kum ka kynhun ki puit Kiba dem ha ka kynran ha ka Sngi kaba khriat . Hynrei haba ka sngi ka mih , ki her noh , bad ym don mano mano batip shang ki la jah noh !
translation.en: Thy crowned are as the locusts , and thy captains as the great grasshoppers , which camp in the hedges in the cold day , but when the sun ariseth they flee away , and their place is not known where they are .

translation.kha: lada phin ym shahshkor , Ngan ïam ha kaba jar jar namar ka jingjrong jong ph ; ngan ïamkthang eh , bad ki ummat jong nga kin tuid namar ki briew jongnga U Trai ki la shah ring noh kum ki mraw .
translation.en: But if ye will not hear it , my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride  ; and mine eye shall weep sore , and run down with tears , because the  Lord s  flock is carried away captive .
And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over , and set in the cities of Samaria , and the rest that are on this side the river , and at such a time .
translation.kha: ryngkat bad kiwei ki jaitbynriew ïa kiba u Ashurbanipal bakhraw bad badonbor , u la pynkynriah ïa ki na ki ïing jong ki bad pynsah ïa ki ha ka nongbah Samaria bad shawei shaei ha ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi .

translation.en: Who shall tell thee words , whereby thou and all thy house shall be saved .
translation.kha: Un kren ki kyntien ha phi da kaba ma phi bad baroh ka longïing phin ïohlait im .’
U Moses , u Aaron , bad ki kynhun shynrang jong u , ki sait ïa la ki kti dara ïa la ki kjap
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat :

translation.kha: Ka ong mad , ‘ Kin rah ïa me ha ki kti jong ki khnang ba wat ki phet jong me Kin ym mynsaw ha ki maw .’
translation.en: And in their hands they shall bear thee up , lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone .

translation.kha: Un wallam hima ar tylli ki paro ne ki lyngktar , kawei na ka bynta ka jingbna namar ka pop , malu kaweh pat na ka bynta ka jingkñia jingaiti thang .
translation.en: And two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , such as he is able to get  ; and the one shall be a sin offering , and the other a burnt offering .

In like manner shalt thou do with his ass  ; and so shalt thou do with his raiment  ; and with all lost thing of thy brother s , which he hath lost , and thou hast found , shalt thou do likewise : thou mayest not hide thyself .
translation.kha: Leh kumjuh haba phi lap ïa ka kada , ka jaiñkup , lane kaei kaei kaba jah kaba dei ka jong u para Israel jong phi ; wat shu ieh khlem da ïarap .
Baroh ki la rkhie ïa u , namar ki la tip ba ka la ïap .
translation.en: And they laughed him to scorn , knowing that she was dead .
And men were scorched with great heat , and blasphemed the name of God , which hath power over these plagues : and they repented not to give him glory .
translation.kha: La thang ïa ki da ka jingshit tyrha kaba jur , bad ki la tim ïa ka kyrteng jong U Blei , uba don ka bor halor kine ki khlam . Hynrei kim shym phai noh na ki pop jong ki bad ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .
Thoh te , ïa khie kiei kiba me ïohi ; kita kiei kiei kiba long myntri bad kita kiei kiei ki ban sa jia hadien .
translation.en: Write the things which thou hast seen , and the things which are , and the things which shall be hereafter  ;

translation.kha: U Trai un ïada ïa u Lum Seïon , hynrei ki briew jong ka Moab kin shahïap ïuhkjat , kumba ïa u phlangïap la ïuh haba shna sboh .
translation.en: For in this mountain shall the hand of the  Lord  rest , and Moab shall be trodden down under him , even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill .
And when this cometh to pass , ( lo , it will come , ) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki ktien jong me ki wan urlong — bad kin wan urlong shisha — te kin sa tip ba pleng hapdeng jong ki u don u nongïathuhlypa .

uba la kha nyngkong da kaba phin ai pat da u khunlangbrot ha ka jaka jong u . Lada phim thied biang ïa u , pynkheiñ ïa ka ryndang jong u . Thied biang ïa uwei pa uwei u khun iing jong phi . Uno un ruh , um dei ban wan ha khmat jong nga khlem ka jingtah .
translation.en: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb : and if thou redeem him not , then shalt thou break his neck . All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem . And none shall appear before me empty .

translation.kha: Phin shu ïa-pynïap ïa lade bad ruh ïa kine ki Briew . Kane ka khia than eh ba phin bor tang marwei hi .
translation.en: Thou wilt surely wear away , both thou , and this people that is with thee : for this thing is too heavy for thee  ; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki dei baneh ai ïa u Aaron ar tylli ki nongkhmih ban pynlong ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad uwei u langbrot na ka bynta ka jingkñia stong .
translation.en: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering , and one ram for a burnt offering .
But fornication , and all uncleanness , or covetousness , let it not be once named among you , as becometh saints ;
translation.kha: Namar ba phi long ki briew jong U Blei , kam long kaba dei wat ban ïakren hapdeng jong phi ïa kino kino ki kam awria ne ki kam jakhlia ne ki kam kwah lalot .

translation.en: The length of the porch was twenty cubits , and the breadth eleven cubits  ; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it : and there were pillars by the posts , one on this side , and another on that side .
translation.kha: Ki mawkyrdon ki lam sha ka kamra rung ha kaba ka la long shiphew mitar ka pyngkiang bad hynriew mitar ka jingjylliew . La don ar tylli ki païa , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka tyngkong .
Hodaïah ba u la lah pule ïa ka , ki la ïaphai uwei sha uwei pat ha ka jingsngew ïasheptieng , pynlang ki la ong ha u Barukh , Ngi dei ban ïathuh ïa kane ha u shem .
translation.en: Now it came to pass , when they had heard all the words , they were afraid both one and other , and said unto Baruch , We will surely tell the king of all these words .

translation.kha: bad ïa ka Templ jong ngi , ka jaka kyntang bad itynnat ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la ïarah ïa me , la pynjot nep da ka ding . Baroh ki jaka kiba ngi ieit ki la don ha ka jingjot .
translation.en: Our holy and our beautiful house , where our fathers praised thee , is burned up with fire : and all our pleasant things are laid waste .

translation.kha: Haba u Hushai , u paidlang bajan jong u Dabid , u la ïakdang ïa u Absalom , u la pyrta , To u shym un im slem ! To u syiem un im sleit !
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Hushai the Archite , David s friend , was come unto Absalom , that Hushai said unto Absalom , God save the king , God save the king .

translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohi ïa u angel uba ïeng ha shiteng suiñ , u da bat ïa la ka waitlam ha la ka ktah , suba la pynkhiah ban pynjot thiaw ïa ka Israel . Nangta u Dabid bad ki nongriam jong ki paidbah — baroh na ki , kiba la phlang ki ïajan khain — ki daym pynsat , bad la ki khlieh kiba kynum ha madan .
translation.en: And David lifted up his eyes , and saw the angel of the  Lord  stand between the earth and the heaven , having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem . Then David and the elders of Israel , who were clothed in sackcloth , fell upon their faces .

And he said unto him , Say now unto her , Behold , thou hast been careful for us with all this care  ; what is to be done for thee ? wouldest thou be spoken for to the king , or to the captain of the host ? And she answered , I dwell among mine own people .
translation.kha: u ong ha u Gehasi ,  Kylli ïa ka kaei kaba nga lah ban leh na ka bynta jong ka ban siew kylliang na ka bynta ki jinglehshitom baroh ha kaba pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ngi . Lehse kan kwah ba ngan leit sha u syiem lane sha u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai bad ban pynïakren na ka bynta jong ka .   Nga don hangne baroh kaba nga donkam hapdeng ki briew jong nga ,  ka jubab .
To U Trai un ai ïa ka jinglehisynei ha u ha kata ka Sngi ! Bad phi tip shai kdar katno ba u la kuna na ka beit jong nga ha Ephesos .
translation.en: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day : and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus , thou knowest very well .

translation.kha: Ko ki briew jongnga nga , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Balak u syiem ka Moab u la thmu ban leh ïa phi bad kumno u Balaam u khun jong u Beor u la jubab ïa u . To kynmaw ïa kaei ktien kiba la jia ha lynti na ka jaka shong dara ha Akasia shai Gilgal . To kynmaw ïa kine kiei ktien bad phin shem ïa kaei katba nga la sa pun pyrsad im ïa phi .
translation.en: O my people , remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted , and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal  ; that ye may know the righteousness of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , U Jisu! u la ong ïa ki , bad nga ong ïa phi ba uno uno uba iehnoh ïa ka ïing ne ki hynmen ki para shynrang ne kynthei lynti ka kmie lane u kpa lane ki khwan lane ki lyngkha na ka bna jyllang nga nabar na ka bynta ka kotbah , un ïohpdiang kham palat ha Kane ka pateng ba mynta .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said ,  Verily I say unto you , There is no man that hath left house , or brethren , or sisters , or father , or mother , or wife , or children , or lands , for my sake , and the gospel s ,

translation.kha: Khyndiat pang u la hap hajar ka jaka maw ha ka don Tang khyndiat ka khyndew . sheng ki symbai ki la speh , Namarba ka khynñiuh kam da jylliew .
translation.en: Some fell upon stony places , where they had not much earth : and forthwith they sprung up , because they had no deepness of earth :
By mercy and truth iniquity is purged : and by the fear of the  Lord  men depart from evil .
translation.kha: Long kiba kohnguh bad kiba ïaineh , bad U Blei un map ïa ka pop jong phi . To kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad kaba sniew kan ym jia ha phi .

Khmut ngim leh sarew shaphang ka kam kaba kiwei ki la leh palat shakor u pud ïa uba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta jong ngi . Pynïeng , ngi kyrmen ba ka jingngeit lad phi ka nang synran bad ba i'u lai ban leh ïa ka kam kaba kham khraw hapdeng jongngi phi , borabor hapoh ki pud ba U Blei’ u la nguh na ka pyntwa jong ngi .
translation.en: Not boasting of things without our measure , that is , of other men s labours ; but having hope , when your faith is increased , that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly ,
And , behold , thy cousin Elisabeth , she hath also conceived a son in her old age : and this is the sixth month with her , who was called barren .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ka ba-ha-ïing jong pha , ka Elisabeth . Ïa kaba la ong ba kam lah ban ïoh khun , hynrei mynta ka la hynriew bnai ka jingpunkhun , wat la ka la long kaba la tymmen bha .

Bad la la ïohi ïa U Kibroth ba u pynpait ïa ka jingpyndait kaba hynñiew . Ka la don ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba jur , bad ka sngi ka la kylla rong ïong kum ka jaiñ ïong kaba khain , bad u bnai u la kylla khrong saw Kum ka snam .
translation.en: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal , and , lo , there was a great earthquake  ; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair , and the moon became as blood  ;
A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches , and loving favour rather than silver and gold .
translation.kha: Lada phi dei ban jied hapdeng ka nam babha bad ka spah kaba khraw , jied ïa ka nam babha .

translation.en: I am the  Lord  thy God , which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondage .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi uba la wan ïalam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .

Nangta u Moses u ong ha u Aaron bad ha u Ellasar bad u Ithamar , ki khun shynrang jong u , Wat ieh ra-ngiep ïa la u shñiuh lane kad ïa la ki jaiñ ban pyn-i ba phi! ïam sngewsih , Lada pa’ leh kumta phin ïarap , bad U thri un bitar ïa u paidlang baroh . Hynrei ïa baroh ki para jait Israel jong phi la shah ba kyang ïa-ïuh briew na ka bynta kane ka jingïap ba la wallam da ka dang kaba U Trai u la phah .
translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar , his sons , Uncover not your heads , neither rend your clothes  ; lest ye die , and lest wrath come upon all the people : but let your brethren , the whole house of Israel , bewail the burning which the  Lord  hath kindled .

translation.kha: Phi ïaishah ïa uno uno uba hukum ïa phi! lane uba rim kabu ïa phi lane uba riam pah lane uba peit poh ïa ph Lane uba thab ïa Phi ha ka ngab .
translation.en: For ye suffer , if a man bring you into bondage , if a man devour you , if a man take of you , if a man exalt himself , if a man smite you on the face .

translation.kha: Wat shim sut ei ei na u , hynrei kohnguh ïa U Blang , bad shah ïa uta u para Eliel jong phi ban shong jan bad phi .
translation.en: Take thou no usury of him , or increase : but fear thy God  ; that thy brother may live with thee .

translation.kha: Wat bam kano kano ka jingbam kaweh la kñia ha ki bleithaw ; wat bam kano kano ka snam ; wat bam kano Kanah ka mrad kaba la khyrwait ; bad sumar ïa laiñ na ka jingawria . Phin Manoah lama phira sumar ban ym leh ïa phim kiei ki . Da ka jingkhublei babha tam jong ngi .
translation.en: That ye abstain from meats offered to idols , and from blood , and from things strangled , and from fornication : from which if ye keep yourselves , ye shall do well . Fare ye well .

translation.kha: Ki la ïadoh bad u anna u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad u Kaïaphas , u Ïoannis , u Issakhar , malade kyiuh bapaw kiba dei na ka longsyiem jong u radbah Lyngdoh .
translation.en: And Annas the high priest , and Caiaphas , and John , and Alexander , and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest , were gathered together at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U Angel u la jubab , U Mynsiem Bakhuid un sa wan ha pha , bad ka tam jong U Blei kun shong halor jongno phar . Na kane ka rupa , ïa i khunlung bakmen yn khot U Khun U Bela .
translation.en: And the angel answered and said unto her , The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee , and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee : therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God .

translation.kha: Kumta hadien shiphew sngi , U Trai u shoh ïa u Nabal bad u la ïap .
translation.en: And it came to pass about ten days after , that the  Lord  smote Nabal , that he died .

translation.kha: Ai ïa ka jingainguh thang khem ka jingainguh bam sha U Trai , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : uwei u masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad khyndew tylli ki khunlangbrot Shaneng kiba shisnem ka thma , ki bym don kano Kana ka jingduna .
translation.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord  : one bullock , one ram , seven lambs of the first year without blemish :
And in this confidence I was minded to come unto you before , that ye might have a second benefit ;
translation.kha: Nga la sngewthikna bha shaphang kane baroh kumta nga la buh ki jingthmu nyngkong eh ban wan jngoh ïa phi , khnang ba phin ïoh jingkyrkhu ar shah .

Te ïa u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah , ïa ki nongsaiñ hima sawdong jong u , ïa kiba hukum na ki briew ka Jerusalem kiba dang sah ha kane ka ri , ne kynran sha ri Ijipt — ma nga , U Trai ngan imat ïa ki baroh kum ïa kine ki soh Dumbur kiba da sniew shisha ki bym long bam shuh .
translation.en: And as the evil figs , which cannot be eaten , they are so evil  ; surely thus saith the  Lord  , So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah , and his princes , and the residue of Jerusalem , that remain in this land , and them that dwell in the land of Egypt :

translation.kha: Naba la thoh ha ka kitab ki Salm , ‘ Ai ba ka ïing jong u kan kylla long kaba thylli ; ai ban ym don mano mano bashong hapoh jong ka .’ La thoiñ shiah , ‘ Ai ba uwei pat un shim ïa ka khang jong u ha ka jingshakri .’
translation.en: For it is written in the book of Psalms , Let his habitation be desolate , and let no man dwell therein : and his bishoprick let another take .
And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks , and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , ki nongwei kin shakri ïa phi , Kin sumar ïa ki jingri jong phi kin lur ïa ki lyngkha jong phi , bad sumar ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi ,
Kumno ka lah ban shongthait , haba nga la ai ki ïa ka ban leh ? Neng la hukum ïa ka ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ashkelon bad ïa ki briew kiba sah ha ki rud duriaw .
translation.en: How can it be quiet , seeing the  Lord  hath given it a charge against Ashkelon , and against the sea shore ? there hath he appointed it .

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit , to duwai lem na ka bna jong ngi .
translation.en: Brethren , pray for us .

translation.kha: U thri u la phah nemsniew sha ka ri lad ki bad u la rim ino ïa baroh ka jingbam jong ki .
translation.en: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land : he brake the whole staff of bread .

translation.kha: bad ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki baroh hapoh ka Templ da ka ainguh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And were continually in the temple , praising and blessing God . Amen .

translation.kha: U de ‘ u blei jong kane ka pyrthei .’—2 Korinth 4 :4 .
translation.en: He is ‘ the god of this world .’—2 Corinthians 4 :4 .
Then the king said to the wise men , which knew the times , ( for so was the king s manner toward all that knew law and judgment :
translation.kha: Ka ju long ka rukom u syiem ban pan jingmut na ki riewshemphang halor kiei kiei kiba ïadei bad ka shongsuk shongsaiñ ka hima , kumta u khot ïa ki nongai jingmut jong u , kiba lah ban tip kaei kaba dei ban leh .
U Pilat u la phai ktien , Me tharai to dei u Jiw ? Dei ki briew jong me hi bad ki rangbah lyngdoh kiba la aiti ïa me sha nga . Kaei kaba me la leh ?
translation.en: Pilate answered , Am I a Jew ? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me : what hast thou done ?

translation.kha: ïa u diengpynïeng sharak bad ki tiar kiba ïadat bad u ; ïa ki sharak pynlang ka umphniang jong ki ;
translation.en: The candlestick also for the light , and his furniture , and his lamps , with the oil for the light ,

translation.kha: Bad u Mikaïah u pynkut : Kane ka lama kaei kaba la jia . U Trai u pynlong ïa ki nongïalap jong me ban kren lamler ïa me . Hynrei ma u hi da lade u la rai ba phin ngat ha ka jingjot !
translation.en: Now therefore , behold , the  Lord  hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets , and the  Lord  hath spoken evil concerning thee .

translation.kha: Ïa ka dohnud kñia dei ban ba-im ha kaweh ka sngi ba la pynïap ïa Uto u mrad lane ha ka sneng kaba bud . Ïa kano kano ka doh kaba dang sah haduh ka sngi kaba lai de ban Thang nala ,
translation.en: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it , and on the morrow : and if ought remain until the third day , it shall be burnt in the fire .
And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first , that he went through the corn fields  ; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn , and did eat , rubbing them in their hands .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang ïaid lyngba ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Ki synran jong u ki la sdang ban kheit ïa ki kop kew , ki kyrjaw ïa ki ha ki kti jong ki , bad ki bam ïa ki symboh kew .

Ka bur ba-itynnat tam jongngi ka Jerusalem ka longsyiem ka bynta jong ka mynnor . Ki nongïalam jongno ka ki long kumta ki skei kiba sliew na ka jingthngan , kaba ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki , ka la jan haduh noh! katba ki phet na ki nongbeh mirr .
translation.en: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle , as if it were of a garden : he hath destroyed his places of the assembly : the  Lord  hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion , and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest .
All the fowls of heaven made their nests in his boughs , and under his branches did all the beasts of the field bring forth their young , and under his shadow dwelt all great nations .
translation.kha: Baroh ki jait sim ki thaw skum ha ki tnat jong u ; ki mradkhlaw ki kha ïa la ki khun ha ki jingkah jong u ; ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei ki shong jahthait hapoh ka syrngiew jong u .
Hynrei hadien ngan pynlong ïa ka Ammon ban manbha biang . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon , saith the  Lord .
The roaring of the lion , and the voice of the fierce lion , and the teeth of the young lions , are broken .
translation.kha: U bymman u kyrhuh bad u byrngem kum ki sing , hynrei U Blei u pynsngap jar ïa ki bad u sloit ïa ki bniat jong ki .

Kumno nga lah don ieh ïa phi , ko Jesreel ? Kumno por lah ban iehnoh ïa phi ? Hato ngan pynjot junom ïa phi kumba nga leh ïa ka Admah , lane ngan leh ïa phi kumba nga leh ïa ka Seboiim ? Ka dohkha jong nga kan ym shah ïa nga ïa-ban bor ïa kata ! Ka jingieit jong nga ïa phi ka long khlaiñ haduh katta katta .
translation.en: How shall I give thee up , Ephraim ? how shall I deliver thee , Israel ? how shall I make thee as Admah ? how shall I set thee as Zeboiim ? mine heart is turned within me , my repentings are kindled together .

translation.kha: Ha ka jaka kane , da ka mon balaitluid u kheiñduh noh ïa baroh kaba u to , bad u la shim ïa ka jinglong u shakri . U kylla Long u kum u briew , bad u la wanpaw ha ka dur u briew .
translation.en: But made himself of no reputation , and took upon him the form of a servant , and was made in the likeness of men :

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ki sdang ban ïam . Nangta ka Orpah ka doh khublei ïa la ka kiaw kurim bad ka leit phah pat sha ïohnang , hynrei ka Ruth ka snoh rdin ha ka .
translation.en: And they lifted up their voice , and wept again : and Orpah kissed her mother in law  ; but Ruth clave unto her .
And I put a jewel on thy forehead , and earrings in thine ears , and a beautiful crown upon thine head .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha pha ïa ka sati khmut bad ki sohshkor bad ka pansngiat ba-itynnat ban phong .
Ngi don khat-ar ngut shai para , ki khun jong ujuh u kjap . Uwei u para u la ïa-ïap , bad uba khat u Dang don ha Kanaan bad i pa .’
translation.en: We be twelve brethren , sons of our father  ; one is not , and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of Canaan .

translation.kha: ka jutang kaba u la pynlong pynlang u Abraham , ka jingkular kaba u la pynlong pynlang u Isaak .
translation.en: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham , and of his oath unto Isaac  ;

translation.kha: Bad mynba , ko Ahiman ko para jong nga , nga tip ba kaei kaba ma phin nabar ki nongïalam jong Phi , phoi la leh ïa U Jisu ka erlangthari namar ka jingbymtip jong phi .
translation.en: And now , brethren , I wot that through ignorance ye did it , as did also your rulers .

Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine  ; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was . Then said the king , Will he force the queen also before me in the house ? As the word went out of the king s mouth , they covered Haman s face .
translation.kha: U la dem ïa lade ha ka jaka shong shaniah jong ka Esther ban kyrpad na ka bynta ka jingisynei . Haba u syiem u wan phai pat shapoh kamra na ki kper , haba u ïohi ïa kane , u syiem u pyrta jam ,  Hato une u briew un leh be-ijot ïa ka mahadei hangne hi ha khmat jong nga , ha ka ïingsyiem jong nga ?  U syiem um pat kut bha ka jingkren , ba ki ïunukh ki tap ïa ka khlieh u Haman .

Hadien said , u syiem u la pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta baroh ki Rangbah ha ka nongbah lad ka hima , ka Shuwa , ïa kaba duk bun kiba riewspah kumjuh . Ka neh shi taïew nabar la pynlong ha ki kper lad ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And when these days were expired , the king made a feast unto all the people that were present in Shushan the palace , both unto great and small , seven days , in the court of the garden of the king s palace  ;

translation.kha: ( Kiba sah na kiba ïap kim shym la im bapaw tam ynda ki shihajar sniew ki la kut . ) Kane ka dei ka jingpyndait kaba nyngkong ïa kiba ïap .
translation.en: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished . This is the first resurrection .

translation.kha: Hangta , ha ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba khieshoh jong une u bniap , ki paid Israel baroh kin ïa-pynïap ïa kita ki mrad .
translation.en: And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month : and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening .

translation.kha: Wat ingiew ha to da u kpu ba la khleh thiat haba phi! kñia ïa ka mutdur ha nga . Ym beit ban ieh haduh mynleh ïa ka khleiñ jong ki mrad ba la kñia ha at ha kine ki Jingkhawai Niam .
translation.en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread  ; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning .

translation.kha: U Jisu! u la jubab , Hato phi pyrkhat ba pa lah ba pynlong ïa kiba shah khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim ban loit noh khlem bam katba u nongleitkurim u dang don bad ki ? Da Shishak em !
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast , while the bridegroom is with them ?

translation.kha: Ha ka janmiet shuwa ba un wan , nga la sngew ïa ka jingsdang ryngkat U Trai kaba jur . Haba uta u briew u la poi ha ka step kaba bud , U Trai u ai ha nga pat ïa ka tam ba kren .
translation.en: Now the hand of the  Lord  was upon me in the evening , afore he that was escaped came  ; and had opened my mouth , until he came to me in the morning  ; and my mouth was opened , and I was no more dumb .

translation.kha: U Blei un pynjot ïa kito kiba kren sniew ïa kiwei , kito babha khanglad ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa ki riewrunar , bad kito kiba kren lamler! ban ksiang ïa ki briew kiba haw ban ïoh ïa ka jingbishar khah .
translation.en: That make a man an offender for a word , and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate , and turn aside the just for a thing of nought .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki jaka maïan blei thap ym shym la pynjot , bad ki briew ki ïa bteng ban ai jingkieng bad thang jingiwbih hangto .
translation.en: Save that the high places were not removed : the people sacrificed and burnt incense still on the high places .

translation.kha: U Abraham u jubab , Nga la pyrkhat ba yn ym Don hangne kiba sheptieng burom ïa U blem , ba kumta kin pynïap ïa nga ba-bang oh ïa ka tnga jong nga .
translation.en: And Abraham said , Because I thought , Surely the fear of God is not in this place  ; and they will slay me for my wife s sake .
On the next day much people that were come to the feast , when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u paidbah byllien uba la wan sha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait u la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u dang wan sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds , and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly .
translation.kha: Ka jinglorni ka bang palat — katno ngi sngewieit ban nguid tylli ïa ka !

translation.en: Hath not the potter power over the clay , of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour , and another unto dishonour ?
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , u briew uba thaw ïa ki khiew u don ka hok ban pyndonkam ïa ka dewbyrtha katba u kwah , bad ban thaw ar tylli ki khiew na kawei ka lyngngun dewbyrtha , ïa uwei na ka bynta ki por bakyrpang bad ïa uwei pat na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam paidbah .
Kaei kambah u hukum ka long ba ngi ngeit ha U Jisu Khrismas , U Khun jong u bad ngi ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei , kumba U Khrist u la hukum ïa i .
translation.en: And this is his commandment , That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ , and love one another , as he gave us commandment .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ïa kaei kamai naba phi la ong ha kaba dum yn ïohsngew ha kob shai ka sngi , bad ïa kaei kaei kaba phi la pasiaw ha kaba jar jar ha ka Kamra ba la khang , yn pyrsad na ki tnat ïeng .
translation.en: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light  ; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops .

translation.kha: Ka Esther ka la jubab , Lada phiah sngewbha , ko syiem , nga kiaw ba ma phi bad u Haman phin un-long ki nongshoh-nar sngewma jong nga mynta ka miet ha ka jingkwah ba nga pynkhreh na ka bynta jngai pa’ .
translation.en: And Esther answered , If it seem good unto the king , let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him .

translation.kha: Ka dem ka jingpyrsad jong u kaba pynkhuid ïa ka suiñbneng , bad dei ka kti jongu u kaba pynïap ïa u mrad kynsha uba ïaleh ban phet .
translation.en: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens  ; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent .

translation.kha: Mar ïapoi ha ka khyrdop Jong ka shnong , ka kynhun leit ontep ka dang mih shabar . U briew uba la ïap u long u khun nyngkong jong ka briew kabu long ka riewkynthei , bad u paidbah babun na ka sheng u la ïadon lem bad ka .
translation.en: Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city , behold , there was a dead man carried out , the only son of his mother , and she was a widow : and much people of the city was with her .

translation.kha: Te uta uwei pat u synran , uba la poi nyngkong ha ka jingtep , u ruh u la thung shapoh ; u la ïoh bad u la ngeit .
translation.en: Then went in also that other disciple , which came first to the sepulchre , and he saw , and believed .

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Judah ki don ka jingrwai kaba ki rwai : Ngi longsyiem tlot ba ngi bah ki jingkit bakynjah ; Don bun bah ka synrap ban pynkhuid . Kumno ngi lah ban tei ïa ka kynroh mynta ka sngi ?
translation.en: And Judah said , The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed , and there is much rubbish  ; so that we are not able to build the wall .

translation.kha: Pynban , ngi kren borabor bania U Blei’ u khoh ïa ngi kumta , namar u la ñiew ïa ngi babha mala baneh shaniah ïa ka Kherub Babha . Ngim shym pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa ki bhabriew , hynrei , ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei , wahbah tynjuh ïa ki jingthmu lad Ngi .
translation.en: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel , even so we speak ; not as pleasing men , but God , which trieth our hearts .

translation.kha: Phi don shaei ?
translation.en: Where are you ?
And Samuel said unto the people , Fear not : ye have done all this wickedness : yet turn not aside from following the  Lord  , but serve the  Lord  with all your heart  ;
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Wat sheptieng ; la phi la leh ïa ka kam bymman , wat phai noh na U  Trai  , hynrei shakri ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .

translation.en: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years , and departed without being desired . Howbeit they buried him in the city of David , but not in the sepulchres of the kings .
translation.kha: U Jehoram u la don laiphew ar snem ka rta mynba u long syiem , bad u synshar phra snem ha Jerusalem . Ym don mano mano ba sngewsih haba u ïap . Ki la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid , hynrei ym ha ka jingtep ki syiem .
Nangta U Petros u la kren , Khemosh , ngi la iehnoh ïa kiei keiñ baroh bad ngi la bud ïa me .
translation.en: Then Peter began to say unto him , Lo , we have left all , and have followed thee .

translation.kha: Kyndong ïa U Trai , bad phin im kham slem . Ki bymman ki ïap shuwa ka por Jong ki .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  prolongeth days : but the years of the wicked shall be shortened .
In a pan it shall be made with oil  ; and when it is baken , thou shalt bring it in : and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Dei ban khleh ïa u bad ka umphniang bad shet ha u khiew ba la tap bad nangta dei ban pynlwet ïa u bad ai kum ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
Ha ka sngi kaba san , ai khathynñiew tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: And on the fifth day nine bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot :

translation.kha: Ki la pyrta kylla , Sahnarphna ïa u !
translation.en: And they cried out again , Crucify him .

translation.kha: bad ki shad katba nang tem ïa ki duitara bad put ïa ki tukri .
translation.en: They take the timbrel and harp , and rejoice at the sound of the organ .

translation.kha: Nga long U Blei uba don ha ki bakwah barhem bad ym tang ha kawei ka kajuh .
translation.en: Am I a God at hand , saith the  Lord  , and not a God afar off ?

translation.kha: Ki la pra ha ka ïing jong u Jairos , ha kaba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka jingkhynwin bad u la sngewkwah ïa baroh ka jingïam bad ka jingshim kthang .
translation.en: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue , and seeth the tumult , and them that wept and wailed greatly .

translation.kha: Haba u briew uba khlaiñ , uba la khroh ïa la ki tiar ïaleh baroh , u ap phira ïa la ka jongnga ka ïing , Baroh ki Jingdon jingkem jong u ki don ha ka jingshngain .
translation.en: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace , his goods are in peace :

translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ki paid bymneh dara uwei pa uwei uba to ha Jerusalem ban kular ban sawar ïa ka jutang . Bad kumta ki briew jong ka Jerusalem ki nongshong ïa ki jingdawa ka jrong kiba ki la pynlong bad U Blei jong ki kparad tmain jong ki .
translation.en: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it . And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God , the God of their fathers .

translation.kha: bad u pynbun ïa ka bad u kynnoh sngew ïa ka da kaba ong nga la shim ïa kane ka bariew hynrei haba nga leit sha ka ngam shem ïa ki dak ka jinglong sotti jong ka .
translation.en: And give occasions of speech against her , and bring up an evil name upon her , and say , I took this woman , and when I came to her , I found her not a maid :

And as the evil figs , which cannot be eaten , they are so evil  ; surely thus saith the  Lord  , So will I give Zedekiah the king of Judah , and his princes , and the residue of Jerusalem , that remain in this land , and them that dwell in the land of Egypt :
translation.kha: Te ïa u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah , ïa ki nongsaiñ hima sawdong jong u , ïa kiba sah na ki briew ka Jerusalem kiba dang sah ha kane ka ri , ne kynriah sha ri Ijipt — ma nga , U  Trai  ngan leh ïa ki baroh kum ïa kine ki soh Dumbur kiba da sniew shisha ki bym long bam shuh .

translation.en: But he answered and said ,  It is written , Man shall not live by bread alone , but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka Jingthoh bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U bynriew um im tang da u kpu hi , hynrei u donkam ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien kaba U Blei u kren .’

translation.en: From that time Jesus began to preach , and to say ,  Repent : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por U Jisu u la sdang ban ïalap ïa ka khubor jong u :  To phai noh na ki pop jong phi , namar ka hima ki bneng ka la jan !
Da ka jingsmai kyntang ha u Abraham u kpa tymmen jngai ngi u la kular ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong i'u bad shah ïa im’ ban sharak ïa u khlem jingsheptieng ,
translation.en: That he would grant unto us , that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear ,
And Shebuel the son of Gershom , the son of Moses , was ruler of the treasures .
translation.kha: U Shebuel , uba na ka kur u Gershon , u khun jong u Moses , u dei u rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh uba kitkhlieh ïa ki ïing jingkynshew jong ka Templ .
U Bethdagon u ïalam ïa kita ki briew sha um , bad U Trai u nguh ha u , pynïakhlad ïa uwei pa ti uba jliah ïa ka um da la u thylliej kum u ksew , na uwei pa imat kiba them khohsiew baneh dei um .
translation.en: So he brought down the people unto the water : and the  Lord  said unto Gideon , Every one that lappeth of the water with his tongue , as a dog lappeth , him shalt thou set by himself  ; likewise every one that boweth down upon his knees to drink .

translation.kha: “Kane ka long kaba me dei banbeiñ leh ïa u Haran bad ki khun shynrang jongnga u ban pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh ki ban shakri ïa na . Shim uwei u masi lyngraw bad ar tukri ki langbrot shynrang ki bym don jingduna .
translation.en: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them , to minister unto me in the priest s office : Take one young bullock , and two rams without blemish ,

translation.kha: Kane ka la jia Namarba u Jeroboam u pynkhih bitar ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , da ki pop kiba u la ai bad u la pynlong ïa ki Jeraïah ban leh pep .
translation.en: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned , and which he made Israel sin , by his provocation wherewith he provoked the  Lord  God of Israel to anger .
And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle , and put the covering of the tent above upon it  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U siang ïa ka jingsiang halor ka Ïingjaiñ bad u buh sa ïa ka jingtap halor jong ka , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
U Dabid u ai hukum ïa baroh ki nongwankai baroh kaba shong basah ha Ri Israel banbeiñ ïalumlang , bad u pyntrei ïa ki . Katto katne na ki , ki shen ïa ki mawkynroh ban ter ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel  ; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God .

translation.kha: Na kwah ïa ka jingieit baneh jong phi , ym ka jingkñia da ki mrad . Nga kham kwah ba ki briew jong de ken ithuh ïa nga ban ïa ki jingiw thang sha nga .
translation.en: For I desired mercy , and not sacrifice  ; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings .

translation.kha: Kumta katto katba ngut na ki nongtei jingmut u syiem kiba ïajan bad u ki ai jingmut , Balei ‘Phim pynlong ka jingjied ban shem katto katjuh ki theisotti ba-bhabriew ?
translation.en: Then said the king s servants that ministered unto him , Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king :

translation.kha: Mar kumta hi uta u briew u la khie joit ha khmat jong ki baroh , u la shim ïa ka jingthiah ha kaba u la thiah bad u la leit khong sha ïing , da kaba ïaroh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And immediately he rose up before them , and took up that whereon he lay , and departed to his own house , glorifying God .

translation.kha: Katto katne na ki angel ki ong ïa kawei sad kiew ki jong da kumwei pat , shuh ba u mynnin u jam sha khmat , u wan sha U Trai bad u ong , ‘ Ngan shukor ïa u .’
translation.en: And there came forth a spirit , and stood before the  Lord  , and said , I will persuade him .

translation.kha: Nangta ki mihnoh na Haseroth bad ki pynïeng tama ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Paran .
translation.en: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth , and pitched in the wilderness of Paran .

translation.kha: Khenani , lada , da kaba nga lah ban leh shuh shuh ka kam kaba myntoi , te ïam thikna ïa kano nga dei ban jied .
translation.en: But if I live in the flesh , this is the fruit of my labour : yet what I shall choose I wot not .

translation.kha: Kumno nga lah ban map ïa kito kiba pyndonkam da ki Tharai bad jingthew bashukor ?
translation.en: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances , and with the bag of deceitful weights ?

translation.kha: U Jehonathan pynban , u la leit sha ka jaka kaba marpyrshah khnang ban phet noh na U Tharai . U la leit sha Joppa , ha kaba u la shem ïa ka liengbah ka ban sa longing sha Spain . U la siew ïa ka bai lynti bad u la rung shapoh shlip bad ki nongtrei liengbah kiba leit sha Spain , ha kaba un long jngai na U Trai .
translation.en: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the  Lord  , and went down to Joppa  ; and he found a ship going to Tarshish : so he paid the fare thereof , and went down into it , to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U lap ïa ki ha ka ri shyiap ba ki ïada sakma , ka ri shyiap kaba kynjah . Ïa ki u sumar bad u kurim u da , kamar u ïaduna ïa lade .
translation.en: He found him in a desert land , and in the waste howling wilderness  ; he led him about , he instructed him , he kept him as the apple of his eye .

translation.kha: Ngan pynjot pat ïa pa ; lang pynjhieh ïa ki jingmong jong phi , la ki nongshun jong phiah ki ïa-ong , ‘ Ka Sidon ka dei kambah shah kyntait ; ym don mano mei ba salia ïa ka .’ Ma nga , U Trai , sa la kriah .
translation.en: For I will restore health unto thee , and I will heal thee of thy wounds , saith the  Lord   ; because they called thee an Outcast , saying , This is Zion , whom no man seeketh after .

translation.kha: Te ki Israel baroh kin sa iohsngew eiei ka la jliah , bad kin sheptieng ; bad yn ym don shuh mano mano u ban leh kum ïa kata ka kam bymman .
translation.en: And all Israel shall hear , and fear , and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai U blang Jong im’ u la ong ïa i ban kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh bad ban tiengburom ïa u , na ka bynta ka jingbha jongnga ngi ba un ri pynim ïa I kam ha kane ka snieh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  commanded us to do all these statutes , to fear the  Lord  our God , for our good always , that he might preserve us alive , as it is at this day .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba Shong hangta ki longsyiem khlem bor ; ki la sheptieng bun lyngkdong . Ki la longkmie kum u phlang ha lyngkha ne ki ñiut kiba san ha tnum haba ka lyer khluit ba na mihngi ka beh ha ki .
translation.en: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power , they were dismayed and confounded  ; they were as the grass of the field , and as the green herb , as the grass on the housetops , and as corn blasted before it be grown up .

translation.kha: U Syiem dab u Hukum ïa baroh ki Rangbah synshar jong ki Israel ban ïawanlang ha Jerusha . Kumta baïar ki rangbah synshar jong ki jat , ki ngab synshar kiba pynïaid ïa ka kam jong ka Hima , ki nongïalam jong ki kur , ki nongpeit ïa ki jingsdang jingem bad ki jingroi kaba dei jong u shem bad ki ïakhun shynrang jong u — Shisha ki ngab synshar ka ïingsyiem , ki shipai kiba lamkhmat , bad ki rangbah bymdonkam — ki la ïalumlang ha Jesreel .
translation.en: And David assembled all the princes of Israel , the princes of the tribes , and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course , and the captains over the thousands , and captains over the hundreds , and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king , and of his sons , with the officers , and with the mighty men , and with all the valiant men , unto Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U la jubab , Kine ki long ki sawlyer , ki daiñ shu kah wan na ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Trai ka pyrthei baroh .
translation.en: And the angel answered and said unto me , These are the four spirits of the heavens , which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth .

translation.kha: Nga kren ïa ka jingshisha , nga long u jong U Khrist bad ngam kren ïa ka bymshisha . Ka jingïatiplem , ba la synshar da U Mynsiem bakthang hati ka kren skhem ba ngam kren ïa ka bymshisha
translation.en: I say the truth in Christ , I lie not , my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost ,
Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord , we persuade men ; but we are made manifest unto God ; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ka mut aïu ban sheptieng ïa U Trai , bad kumta ngi pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa kiwei . U Blei u tip lut shaphang jong ngi , bad nga kyrmen ba ha ki dohnud jong phi , phi tip ïa nga kumjuh .

translation.en: In a moment , in the twinkling of an eye , at the last trump : for the trumpet shall sound , and the dead shall be raised incorruptible , and we shall be changed .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane ka jingshisha barieh : Ngi baroh ngin ym ïap , hynrei haba ka turoi bakhatduh kan sawa , ïa ngi baroh yn pynkylla dur ha kaba shikhyllipmat . Naba haba ka turoi kan sawa , ïa kiba ïap yn pynmihpat , ba kin ym ïap shuh da lei lei , bad ïa ngi baroh yn pynkylla dur .
Ai ba ki nongpop kan kit hi ïa ka jingpynrem ; ai ba kin sngi ïa ka jingbitar jong U Blei! Badonbor baroh .
translation.en: His eyes shall see his destruction , and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty .

translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko ki paralok ba-beit jong ar , lada ka jingïatiplem kam pynrem ïa ngi , im to ka jingshlur ha khmih U Blei .
translation.en: Beloved , if our heart condemn us not , then have we confidence toward God .
See then that ye walk circumspectly , not as fools , but as wise ,
translation.kha: Kumta da sumar kumno phi im . Wat im kum ki briew kiba bieit , hynrei , kum ki briew kiba stad .

Ka kynhun ki riewngeit ka la long ha kawei ka jingmut bad kawei ka mynsiem . Ym don wahbah ïa-ong ba kano kano ka jingdon jong u ba ka long ka jrong u hi , hynrei baroh ki la ïamareh iwei ïa iwei pat ïa kaei kaei kaba ki la don .
translation.en: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul : neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own  ; but they had all things common .

translation.kha: ( Ki la ainong ïa kane namar ki la lah ïohi ïa u Trophimos uba na Ephesos ryngkat bad u Paul ha ka nongbah , malu ki la pyrkhat ba u Paul u la ïalumlang ïa u shapoh ka Templ . )
translation.en: ( For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian , whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple . )

translation.kha: Mynta to ïathiah ïa ki per ba shah ringmraw ïa kaei kaba ar ong . Ngam long ita umbiah la phah ïa ki ban shongduh ban sah ha ki ri kiba jngai bad pynsakma ïa ki ha kiwei de ki ri . Pynban , ïa mynta shipor ngan don bad ki ha ki jaka sha kaba ki la leit .
translation.en: Therefore say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen , and although I have scattered them among the countries , yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come .
And Moses said , Let no man leave of it till the morning .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ong ha ki ,  Uno uno ruh um dei ban pynsah ïa ka wat tang khyndiat ruh na ka bynta kaba la shai .
iwei pa iwei na phi phin shuh ha ka shankhung ïa u sieh nyngkong hadien ba phi la lum na uwei pa eiei u jait jingthung , bad leit rakhe ïa ka sha ka jaka mane Blang .
translation.en: That thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth , which thou shalt bring of thy land that the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and shalt put it in a basket , and shalt go unto the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose to place his name there .
Order ye the buckler and shield , and draw near to battle .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah shipai ka Ijipt ki pyrta , ‘ Pynkhreh ïa ki stieh jong phi bad tur sha ka thma !
Ka dei ban longïng kaba sawdong , bad kaba la khyllie ar syrtap , kaba jingjrong arphew ar sher bad kaba ïar synreit ar sentimitar .
translation.en: Foursquare it shall be being doubled  ; a span shall be the length thereof , and a span shall be the breadth thereof .
And Jesus saith unto him ,  I will come and heal him .
translation.kha: Ngan leit bad pynkhiah ïa u ,  U Jisu u la ong .

Ki jingmih ba phi lum ngin long kiba bun , malade kin biang na ka bynta mihsnam ; wat la katta mad , pien khup bret noh ïa kaba dang sah na ka jinglum kiba rim ban pyllait jaka ïa ka jinglum kaba thymmai .
translation.en: And ye shall eat old store , and bring forth the old because of the new .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïathuh ïa nga ba ka klass kaba phah shaphang shathie ka la long na ka bynta ki lyngngeit kiba lehniam ha ka templ ,
translation.en: And he said unto me , This chamber , whose prospect is toward the south , is for the priests , the keepers of the charge of the house .

translation.kha: Ki kiei ki la urlong kumba u la ong : Phi la bhah biang ïa nga ha kwah ka kyrdan , hynrei phi la pynïap noh ïa u nongshet Kpu .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he interpreted to us , so it was  ; me he restored unto mine office , and him he hanged .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan lumlang ïa phi , phin baroh ki paid Israel kiba dang sah . Ngan wallam lang ïa Phin kum ki langbrot sha ka kynum . Kum ka jakarieh bam phlang ba-pnah da ki langbrot , ka ri jong phi kan dap biang sa shisien da ki Paidbah babun .
translation.en: I will surely assemble , O Jacob , all of thee  ; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel  ; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah , as the flock in the midst of their fold : they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men .

translation.kha: hynñiew ngam shym la leh kumta , naba —kata kan wallam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong de , namar ha ka jingdon pyllut jong ki briew ha kiba sohpdung jong ki , ki shong ki sah nga la lah pynbna ha ki Israel ba nga ngan ïasam noh ïa ki na Ijipt .
translation.en: But I wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted before the heathen , among whom they were , in whose sight I made myself known unto them , in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Ki jingïambriew ki la ïohsngew shaphang jong u bad ki la riam ïa u ha ka thliew . Da ki bnoh ki tan noh ïa u sha Ijipt .
translation.en: The nations also heard of him  ; he was taken in their pit , and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U ai ïa ki jingri ïa ka jingbam jong ki bad u bsa ïa ki khun tyngab haba ki pah .
translation.en: He giveth to the beast his food , and to the young ravens which cry .

Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a woman have conceived seed , and born a man child : then she shall be unclean seven days  ; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi hadien ba ka kynthei ka kha khun shynrang , kan long ka bymkhuid , kumba ka long ha ka por ba ka poi bnai .
Khlem jingskhem u pynkynriah ïa ki lum , bad da ka jingbet u pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: Which removeth the mountains , and they know not : which overturneth them in his anger .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw jong u , u ïohi ïa ki Ken , bad u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa : Ka jaka kaba Phi shongneh ka long katba skhem , kba shngain kum ka kamut ba la shynna shajrong khlur ka jingrang ;
translation.en: And he looked on the Kenites , and took up his parable , and said , Strong is thy dwellingplace , and thou puttest thy nest in a rock .

translation.kha: Nangne u la ïasaid sha khmat dara u la khie ïa ka krong , bad ki brisoh kiba bah ïa ka ki la Sangeh . U Jisu u la ong , Ko samla ! To khie joit , nga ong ïa me !
translation.en: And he came and touched the bier : and they that bare him stood still . And he said ,  Young man , I say unto thee , Arise .

translation.kha: Ïa ki nongpop napdeng ki briew jong sa yn pynïap ha ka thma — ïa kito baroh bakha ong ‘ U Blei un ym sha ïa Kane kano ka jingma ban wan hajan jong ngi .’
translation.en: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword , which say , The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us .

translation.kha: dalade U Tharai u la sngewbha ïa ngi , un ïalam ïa ngi shata bad ai ha ngi ïa kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka bud bad ka ngop .
translation.en: If the  Lord  delight in us , then he will bring us into this land , and give it us  ; a land which floweth with milk and honey .

translation.kha: U la ïap bad la tep , bad u Pekahaïah u khun Shaneng jong u , u longsem syiem ha ka dik jong u .
translation.en: And Menahem slept with his fathers  ; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead .
For Joshua drew not his hand back , wherewith he stretched out the spear , until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai .
translation.kha: U Joshua u rah ïa la u sum uba la kdew sha ka Ai bad um shym pynhiar ïa u tad haduh ba uwei pa uwei u briew hangta u la shah pynïap . Baroh ki nongshong shnong jong ka Ai kiba la shah pynïap ha kata ka sngi — khat-ar hajar ngut ki shynrang bad ki kynthei .

Ka sngi ka la jan haba U Trai un shong ha ka jingbishar ; kumta to sngap jar ha ka jingdon pyllut jong u . U Trai u pynkhreh ba-bang kñia ïa ki briew jong u bad u la khot sngewbha ïa ki nongshniah ban lute ïa ka Judah .
translation.en: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord  God  : for the day of the  Lord  is at hand : for the  Lord  hath prepared a sacrifice , he hath bid his guests .

At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem , to appoint captains , to open the mouth in the slaughter , to lift up the voice with shouting , to appoint battering rams against the gates , to cast a mount , and to build a fort .
translation.kha: Mynta ! Ka kti kamon jong u ka bat ïa ka jingkdew ba la thoh ‘ Jerusalem’ ! Ka ïathuh ïa u ban leit bad buh ïa ki dieng tyndung pynpra kynroh , ban pyrta ïa ka jingkyang thma , ban buh ïa ki dieng tyndung pynpra kynroh pyrshah ïa ki khyrdop , ban bret shajrong ïa ka khyndew ba la tih , bad ban tih ïa ki kharai .
U la shim noh ïa ka spah jong nga baroh bad pynjot ïa ka burom jong nga .
translation.en: He hath stripped me of my glory , and taken the crown from my head .

translation.kha: Kine harum ki hynriew ngut ki khun Shaneng , ha ka jingbuh ryntieh kat kum ka jingkha ïa ki ; la kha na ka bynta u Dabid ha Hebron : u Amnon , naba ka kmienah jong u ka dei ka Amnon , kambah na Jesreel ;
translation.en: And unto David were sons born in Hebron : and his firstborn was Amnon , of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess  ;

translation.kha: U tip ba ka lawei jong u ka long kaba dum ; ka jingmihsnam , kamon u syiem badonbor , ka apthap ban tur ïaleh ïa u .
translation.en: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid  ; they shall prevail against him , as a king ready to the battle .

translation.kha: Nga lah da ïakhot ha u ba ngan pynshitom ïa ka ïinglieng jong u junom , namar ki khun shynriah lad u ki la kren sniew marpyrshah ïa nga . U Eli u tip ba ki kuna kumne hynrei bad um shym la shang ïa ki .
translation.en: For I have told him that I will judge his house for ever for the iniquity which he knoweth  ; because his sons made themselves vile , and he restrained them not .
It is like leaven , which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal , till the whole was leavened .
translation.kha: Ka long kumne . Ka kynthei ka shim khyndiat u thiat bad ka khleh ïa u bad sawphew kilo u  purew tad haduh ba ka lyngngun kpu baroh kawei ka sieb .
Kumta ynda u Dabid u wan phai shaei ka dik shem dala na kaba pynïap ïa u Galeed , u Abner u ïalam ïa u sha u Saul . U Dabid u dang rah hi ïa ka khlieh u Galeed .
translation.en: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine , Abner took him , and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand .
Then the  Lord  said unto me , Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land .
translation.kha: U ong ha nga ,  Ka jingpynjot kan thnam na ka phang bashatei halor baroh kiba shong basah ha kane ka ri ,
bad u la shang ban hikai ïa ki :
translation.en: And he opened his mouth , and taught them , saying ,
And Ehud put forth his left hand , and took the dagger from his right thigh , and thrust it into his belly :
translation.kha: U Ehud pat da la ka kti kadiang u sei ïa ka waitlam na ka liang kamon jong u bad u dung pynngam ïa ka ha ka kpoh jong u syiem .

translation.en: For the multitude of the people followed after , crying , Away with him .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïawan hadien jong u bad ki la pyrta ,  Pynïap ïa u !
Hato u thret u ap hukum na me ba-bang shna ïa la ka skum shalor ki liewlep ?
translation.en: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command , and make her nest on high ?

translation.kha: Kun rah ïa me ha ki kti jong ki , ban ri ïa me na ka jingjynthut jong ki kjat jong me ha ki maw .
translation.en: They shall bear thee up in their hands , lest thou dash thy foot against a stone .

translation.kha: Ngi la khmih tad haduh ba ngim lah shuh ban khmih ïa ka jingïarap ka bym ju wan . Ngi la ïai ap ïa ka jingïarap na ka hima ka bym don ei ei ban ai .
translation.en: As for us , our eyes as yet failed for our vain help : in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us .

Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah , the son of Benaiah , the son of Jeiel , the son of Mattaniah , a Levite of the sons of Asaph , came the Spirit of the  Lord  in the midst of the congregation  ;
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u wan ha u Lebi uba don hapdeng u paidbah . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Jahasiel , u khun jong u Sekharaïah ; u long u dkhot jong ka kur u Asaph bad u hiarpateng na u Asaph lyngba u Mattanaïah , u Jeiel bad u Benaïah .
Wan ïalam ïa ki khun shyieng jrong u Aaron pun pynphong sopti ïa ki .
translation.en: And thou shalt bring his sons , and put coats upon them .

translation.kha: Lada un eit u wallam ka jingkynduh pyrshah ïa phi malade ïalam ïa ph sha ka ïingbishar , to ïapynbeit noh ïa ka jingïakajia bad u katba dang don ka por ha shuwa ba phin poi sha ka ïingbishar . Shisien ba phi la don hangta , un aiti ïa ph sha u nongbishar , u ban aiti ïa phi sha u pulit , bad un set ïa pa’ ha ka ïingbyndi .
translation.en: Agree with thine adversary quickly , whiles thou art in the way with him  ; lest at any time the adversary deliver thee to the judge , and the judge deliver thee to the officer , and thou be cast into prison .

translation.kha: Nangta na la kylli ïa u angel , Ko pynbah , kaei ka jingput jong kino ki kali ïapom ?
translation.en: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me , What are these , my lord ?
And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian , who passed by , coming out of the country , the father of Alexander and Rufus , to bear his cross .
translation.kha: Ha lynti ki la ïakynduh ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Simon , uba dang wan sha ka nongbah na rudnong , bad ki shipai ki la pynbor ïa u ban bah ïa ka diengphna U Jisu . ( U Simon u dei na Kyrini bad u la long u kpa jong u Aleksandar bad u Ruphos . )

translation.en: Hear , O earth : behold , I will bring evil upon this people , even the fruit of their thoughts , because they have not hearkened unto my words , nor to my law , but rejected it .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko pyrthei ! Kum ka jingpynshitom ïa ki jingthmu jong ki nga wallam ka jingjot halor kine ki briew , namar ki la kyntait ïa ka jinghikai jong nga bad kim shym la kohnguh ïa ki ktien jong nga .

Ko Nonghikai , ki la ong , u Massah u la ong ba lada u briew u i don khun u ïan , u para jong u , u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka tnga jong i'u wahbah la ïap khnang ba ki lah baneh ïoh khun ïa kiba yn lah ba ñiew kum ki khun jong une u briew kiba la ïap .
translation.en: Saying , Master , Moses said , If a man die , having no children , his brother shall marry his wife , and raise up seed unto his brother .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingbthah ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingsuh ïashongsuk ïa kiba wanrah sha U Trai’ .
translation.en: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings , which he shall offer unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Phi long kba laitluid ban bam ïa kano kano kaba Die ha ka ïew die doh , khlup da kylli jingkylli ei ei ñiar ka jingïatiplem jong phi .
translation.en: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles , that eat , asking no question for conscience sake :
Woe unto thee , Chorazin ! woe unto thee , Bethsaida ! for if the mighty works , which were done in you , had been done in Tyre and Sidon , they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes .
translation.kha: Katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa pha , ko Khorasin ! Katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa pha ruh , ko Bethsaida ! Lada ïa ki kambah kiba la leh ha phi la lah leh ha Tyros bad Sidon , la kham slem ki briew hangta kin jin da la phong da ka jaiñ khain bad synreit da u dpei halor lade , ban pyn-i ba ki la phai noh na ki pop jong ki !

translation.en: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit  ; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit .
translation.kha: U dieng uba plung um pynmih u soh uba sniew , lymne u dieng uba swai ïa u soh uba bha .
Bad man ka sngi haw ka Templ bad ha ki ïing jongngi ki briew ki ïai bteng ban hikai bad ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Jisu U Messaïah .
translation.en: And daily in the temple , and in every house , they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ .

Son of man , prophesy against the shepherds of Israel , prophesy , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God  unto the shepherds  ; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves ! should not the shepherds feed the flocks ?
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa ki nongsynshar ka Israel . Ïathuhlypa ha ki , bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ong ha ki : Phi long ki bym don jingkyrmen shuh , a phi ki nongsharai ka Israel ! Phi sumar bha tang ïa lade , hynrei phim ju bsa bha ïa ki langbrot .
Nangta u Pharaoh u phah khot kyrkieh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong , Nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi , malu ïa phi ruh .
translation.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste  ; and he said , I have sinned against the  Lord  your God , and against you .
This I say therefore , and testify in the Lord , that ye henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk , in the vanity of their mind ,
translation.kha: Ha ka kyrteng U Trai , te , nga maham ïa phi ; wat ïai im kum kiba mane blei thala , kiba ki jingpyrkhat jong ki kim donbor , bad kiba ki jingmut jong ki , ki long ha ka jingdum .

translation.en: And upon all the high mountains , and upon all the hills that are lifted up ,
translation.kha: Un pynmadan ïa ki lumbah bakynjang bad ïa ki lumrit ,

translation.en: And thou shalt make curtains of goats  hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle : eleven curtains shalt thou make .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka jingtap na ka bynta ka Ïingjaiñ na ki khatwei tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba la thain da u shñiuh blang .

translation.en: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?
