translation.kha: Hato ki blei jong kino kino ki hima ki la pyllait im ïa ki ri jong ki na u patsha ka Assyria ?
shaphang sepngi , ka ri jong ki ka poi haduh kah Jordan , naduh ka Pung Galatia shaphang shatei , arsut haduh ka Duriaw Baïap shaphang shathie , bad nangta shaduh ka kjat lum pjiah shaphang mynsngi .
translation.en: The plain also , and Jordan , and the coast thereof , from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain , even the salt sea , under Ashdoth–pisgah eastward .

translation.kha: Bad kumta to pynshahthngan iwei ïa iwei pat dara to ïap iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba pa’ leh myntri .
translation.en: Wherefore comfort yourselves together , and edify one another , even as also ye do .

translation.kha: Katba ki apostol ki mihnoh na ka Dorbar , ki la ken , namar U Blei u la ñiew ïa ki , kiba bit ban shah ïa ka jahburom na ka bynta U Jehu .
translation.en: And they departed from the presence of the council , rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name .
Let us therefore fear , lest , a promise being left us of entering into his rest , any of you should seem to come short of it .
translation.kha: Mynta , U Blei u la tyrwa ha ngi ïa ka jingkular ba ngi lah ban pdiang ïa ka jingjahthait ïa kaba u la kren . Te , to ngin da sumar , ba yn ym shem ïa uno uno na phi u bym kot ban ïohpdiang ïa kata ka jingjahthait ba la kular .
Ki ktien ba-thylli , ko Joab ! Ki ktien ba-thylli !
translation.en: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge , and fill his belly with the east wind ?

translation.kha: U Trai un wanpaw bad ka ding . Un shong ha ki thapniang jong ka pynïong , ban pynshitom ïa kito kiba u la bitar .
translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  will come with fire , and with his chariots like a whirlwind , to render his anger with fury , and his rebuke with flames of fire .
But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head : for that is even all one as if she were shaven .
translation.kha: Bad kano kano ka briew kaba duwai ne pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ha ka jingïamane Blei lang khlem da tap ïa la ka khlieh ka pynjahburom ïa la u tnga ; kam don jingïapher hapdeng jong ka bad ka briew kaba la khi noh ïa la ka khlieh .
U Moses u la jubab , Wat sheptieng ! Ïeng syiem , pynlang phin sa ïohi aïu U Terah un leh mynta ka sngi pun pyllait im ïa phi ; lano shano ruh phin ym ïohi shuh ïa kine ki nong Ijipt .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the people , Fear ye not , stand still , and see the salvation of the  Lord  , which he will shew to you to day : for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day , ye shall see them again no more for ever .

translation.kha: Kaei ka jingkhlaiñ kambah nga don ba ngan ïai im ? Balei ngan dang im haba ngam ba-don ka jingkyrmen ?
translation.en: What is my strength , that I should hope ? and what is mine end , that I should prolong my life ?

Then Jesus went with them . And when he was now not far from the house , the centurion sent friends to him , saying unto him , Lord , trouble not thyself : for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof :
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la leit bad ki . Um shym da jngai na ka ïing mynba u rangbah pynïaidkam u la phah ïa ki paralok ban ong ha U ,  Kynrad , wat pynshitom ïa lade . Ngam dei hok ban pdiang ïa me ha ka ïing jong nga ,

translation.en: Now when he had left speaking , he said unto Simon ,  Launch out into the deep , and let down your nets for a draught .
translation.kha: Haba u la dep kren , u la ong ha u Simon ,  To ñiat ïa ka lieng kham jngai sha ka um bajylliew , bad ma me lem bad ki paralok jong me to pynhap ïa ki jar ban tong dohkha .
Bad kumta haba phi la phah khot ïa nga , nga la wan khlem katno kano ka jingpyrshah . Nga kyllan ïa phi , te , balei ba phi phah khot ïa per ?
translation.en: Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying , as soon as I was sent for : I ask therefore for what intent ye have sent for me ?

translation.kha: Ka pynrieh jong kiba ïap ka pynkhreh pun pdiang sngewbha ïa u syier jong ka Babilonia . Ki sna-ïap jong kita katba kotbor ha ka pyrthei ki ïakhih ksar . Ki sna-ïap jongnga ki syiem ki ïohnong na ki klet jongngi ki .
translation.en: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming : it stirreth up the dead for thee , even all the chief ones of the earth  ; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations .
And from the face of the gate of the entrance unto the face of the porch of the inner gate were fifty cubits .
translation.kha: Kata ka lynti ïaid baroh shi lynter naduh ka khyrdop kaba shabar shaduh ka liang ba kut jong ka kamra bakhatduh ka la long arphew san mitar .

translation.en: O ye seed of Abraham his servant , ye children of Jacob his chosen .
translation.kha: Ma phi ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham , u shakri jong u ; ma phi ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , u briew uba u la jied : Kynmaw ïa ki kambah ba U Blei u la leh bad ki jingbishar kiba u la ai .
men la ka janmiet , u Aaron un thang ïa ki bad un ieh ba kin meh haduh mynstep ha kham U Trai shabar ka jingkah kaba ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ïa kane ka hukum dei ban leh phang la pateng .
translation.en: Without the veil of the testimony , in the tabernacle of the congregation , shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the  Lord  continually : it shall be a statute for ever in your generations .
In that day the  Lord  with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent , even leviathan that crooked serpent  ; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  un pyndonkam ïa ka waitlam badonbor bad bashyrkhei jong u ban pynshitom ïa u Lebiathan , uta u Ïakjakor uba khih bad uba khyrwait , bad ban pynïap ïa uta u mrad kynsha uba im ha ka duriaw .
Kenan baïar ka pynshisha ba ka jingbishar ka jong U Blei ka Long kaba hok , bad kumjuh phin long kiba kismis na ka bynta ka Hima jong u , kaba na ka bynta jong ka phi jingshahshitom .
translation.en: Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God , that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God , for which ye also suffer :
So David s young men turned their way , and went again , and came and told him all those sayings .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki leit phai noh bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei ba u Nabal u la lah ong .

To ai ha ka , mawria ka jingshitom bad ka jingsngewsih kat ka barim bad ka jingpahuh kaba ka la ai ïa lade . Naba ka ïai-ong ïa lade : ‘ Hangne nga shong , ka syiem ! Ngam long ka riewkynthei , len ym tip ïa ka jingsngewsih !’
translation.en: How much she hath glorified herself , and lived deliciously , so much torment and sorrow give her : for she saith in her heart , I sit a queen , and am no widow , and shall see no sorrow .

translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba la jhieh bad u la phah noh ïa ki sha Joppa .
translation.en: And when he had declared all these things unto them , he sent them to Joppa .

translation.kha: te ki Benjamin ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop . Ki Israel kiba ha khmat eh ki la kynroh dien na ki Benjamin namar ba ki shaniah ha kita ki rangbah ba la buh ban apthap baroh sawdong ïa ka Gibeah .
translation.en: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were smitten : for the men of Israel gave place to the Benjamites , because they trusted unto the liers in wait which they had set beside Gibeah .

translation.kha: Nangta u lap kawei ka jingshaïong tyngam jong ka kada kaweh ding shu ïap shen . U dem malu u tam ïa ka , bad da kata u pynïap shihajar ngut ki rangbah .
translation.en: And he found a new jawbone of an ass , and put forth his hand , and took it , and slew a thousand men therewith .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta kita katba stem ïa kane ka rukom ha ka jingim jong ki , to ai ba ka jingkem bad ka jingisynei kad long lem bad ki — ïa ki lem bad baroh ki bhabriew jong U Blei !
translation.en: And as many as walk according to this rule , peace be on them , and mercy , and upon the Israel of God .

Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel  ; Behold , I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands , wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon , and against the Chaldeans , which besiege you without the walls , and I will assemble them into the midst of this city .
translation.kha: Ko Sedekaïah , ngan jop ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Babilonia bad ki shipai jong u . Ngan kynton ïa ki tiar ïapom jong ki shipai jong me hamar pdeng jong ka nongbah .
Ki nongbah jong ki , ki bun shaba palat ban ñiew ; ki shipai jong ki , ki kham badno ban ïa ki puit .
translation.en: They shall cut down her forest , saith the  Lord  , though it cannot be searched  ; because they are more than the grasshoppers , and are innumerable .

translation.kha: Kumno u nud ban kren kumne ? Ken ka dei ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei! ! Dei Teng U Blei hi maw uba lah ban karta ïa ki pop !
translation.en: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies ? who can forgive sins but God only ?

translation.kha: U la ai ka jingshongthait bad ka jingjahthait ïa phiah barabor , hynriew phi kyntait ban shahshkor ïa u .
translation.en: To whom he said , This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest  ; and this is the refreshing : yet they would not hear .
And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also , neither would he let the people go .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat ha kane ka kynti ruh , u Pharaoh u la kylla long mutlop , bad um shym shah ïa u paidbah ban leit .
Ki khun shynraiñ u Jakob kaba la leit pyntud bad u shad Ijipt , lem dara la ki ba-ima ha-sem , ki long
translation.en: Now these are the names of the children of Israel , which came into Egypt  ; every man and his household came with Jacob .
And the people went out , and spoiled the tents of the Syrians . So a measure of fine flour was sold for a shekel , and two measures of barley for a shekel , according to the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki nong Samaria ki mih shabar bad ki leit lute ïa ka jaka shong dara ki Syria . Bad kumba U  Trai  u la lah kren , lai kilo u kew uba bha tam lane hynriew kilo u barli la die ha ka dor shi sbai rupa .
Hato phim tip ? Phim pat ïohsngew ? U Trai u long U Blei bymjukut ; u jingaiti ïa ka pyrthei baroh . Um ju sngewthait ne sngewlwait . Ym don uba sngewthuh ïa ki jingpyrkhat lad u
translation.en: Hast thou not known ? hast thou not heard , that the everlasting God , the  Lord  , the Creator of the ends of the earth , fainteth not , neither is weary ? there is no searching of his understanding .
And , behold , your eyes see , and the eyes of my brother Benjamin , that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you .
translation.kha: U Joseph u bteng ,  Mynta , phi baroh , bad phi ruh , Benjamin , phi ïohi ba nga dei shisha u Joseph uba kren ha phi .

translation.en: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot , and she returned unto him into the ark , for the waters were on the face of the whole earth : then he put forth his hand , and took her , and pulled her in unto him into the ark .
translation.kha: Ka wan phai pat sha ka lieng , bad u Noah u kner ïa la ka kti , bad u rah ïa ka shapoh .
U la ai ïa por shibun ki khun shynrang bad napdeng jngai ki baroh u la jied ïa u Solomon ban synshar halor ka Israel , ka Hima ka Jong U Trai .
translation.en: And of all my sons , ( for the  Lord  hath given me many sons , ) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the  Lord  over Israel .
And God said unto Abraham , As for Sarai thy wife , thou shalt not call her name Sarai , but Sarah shall her name be .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Abraham ,  Men ym khot shuh ïa ka tnga jong me — ka Sarai ; naduh mynta ka kyrteng jong ka kan long noh — ka Sarah .
Ki Lem kin kruiñ ïa kino ki ktien ha ka sur ka jam :
translation.en: And the Levites shall speak , and say unto all the men of Israel with a loud voice ,
And it came to pass , when he was come , that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim , and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount , and he before them .
translation.kha: Haba u poi hangta ha ka ri lum ki Ephraim , u la put ïa ka turoi ban khot ïa ki paid Israel sha ka thma ; nangta u la ïalam ïa ki arsut na ki lumrit .
Kito ki pynlwet baroh ki la pynphai noh ïa ki Israhaïah na nga , hynrei da ka jubab jong nga , nga kyrmen ban ïoh pat ïa ka jingshaniah jyllang ki .
translation.en: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart , because they are all estranged from me through their idols .

translation.kha: Un wallam ïa ki sha u lyngdoh ha ka jingkhang ka jingïoh ha ka sngi kaba pharia jong ka jingpynkhuid ïa u .
translation.en: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei Phin lah ngab shim sha ailad ïa ki kynthei , ki khun rit , ki jingriew jingdup , bad ïa kiew kiei baroh kba ha kata ka shnong . Phi haw ngab rah ïa said baher kaba dei ka jong ki nongshun jong phi . U Trai u la ai ïa ka ha phi .
translation.en: But the women , and the little ones , and the cattle , and all that is in the city , even all the spoil thereof , shalt thou take unto thyself  ; and thou shalt eat the spoil of thine enemies , which the  Lord  thy God hath given thee .
Depart not hence , I pray thee , until I come unto thee , and bring forth my present , and set it before thee . And he said , I will tarry until thou come again .
translation.kha: Wat pat leit tat ynda nga wanrah ha me ka jingainguh bam .  U jubab ,  Ngan ap haduh ba men da wan phai pat .
Kata ka dei tang ka jinglamler —Jenesis 3 :1-5 .
translation.en: Of course , that was a lie . —Genesis 3 :1-5 .
Therefore , when they were come hither , without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat , and commanded the man to be brought forth .
translation.kha: Haba ki la wan hangne , te , ngam shym la pyntud ei ei , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba bud nga la shong ha ka ïingbishar bad nga la hukum ban wallam shapoh ïa uta u briew .

translation.en: And he had prepared for him a great chamber , where aforetime they laid the meat offerings , the frankincense , and the vessels , and the tithes of the corn , the new wine , and the oil , which was commanded to be given to the Levites , and the singers , and the porters  ; and the offerings of the priests .
translation.kha: U shah ïa u Tobiah ban pyndonkam ïa ka kamra kaba heh ïa kaba la thmu tang ban buh ïa u kew jingkñia bad ka jingiwbih , ki tiar ki tar ba pyndonkam ha ka Templ , ki jingainguh na ka bynta ki lyngdoh , bad kiba shiphew na u kew , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ba ai sha ki Lebi , ki nongtem nongput ka Templ , bad ki nongap phira ka Templ .

translation.en: Jehovah is so great and powerful , yet he listens to our prayers !
translation.kha: U Jehobah u long uba khraw bad badonbor tam , hynrei u sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong ngi !

translation.en: This man was taken of the Jews , and should have been killed of them : then came I with an army , and rescued him , having understood that he was a Roman .
translation.kha: Ki Jiw ki la kem ïa une u briew bad sa ba kin pynïap ïa u . Nga la ïoh jingtip ba u long u traishnong ka Hima Rom , kumta nga la leit bad ki shipai jong nga bad nga la pyllait im ïa u .
Ka kyiad ka long ïa ki biria uba la jan ïap , ïa kito Ibbah shem jynjar sat .
translation.en: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish , and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts .

translation.kha: Te kumta , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Uno uno uba kwah baneh sngewsarong , u dei Ban sngewsarong ha kiei kaba U Trai u la leh .
translation.en: That , according as it is written , He that glorieth , let him glory in the Lord .

translation.kha: Ki ktien jong ki , ki la shon jur ha u Dedan , mala u sheptieng shikatdei eh ïa u syiem Akhish .
translation.en: And David laid up these words in his heart , and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath .

translation.kha: Naba ngi tip ba ïathuh ka per ba mynta , ki jingthaw baroh ki ud da ka jingpang , kum ka jingpangnud jong ka jingsuh kha .
translation.en: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now .
If they shall confess their iniquity , and the iniquity of their fathers , with their trespass which they trespassed against me , and that also they have walked contrary unto me  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin phla ïa la ki pop jong ki bad ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , kiba pyneh ïa nga bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ,

U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u ong , Phi hi da lade phi la ïohi ïa ka jingpynjot kaba nga la wanrah ha Jerusalem malu ha baroh kiwei ki nongbeh ka Judah . Wat mynta ki dang sah ha ki jingjot , sad ym don ba sah ha ki namar ki briew jong ki , ki la leh ïa kaba sniew bad ki la pynlong ïa de don bitar . Ki ai jingkñia ha kiwei patar ki blei bad shakri ïa ki blei kiba ma ki ne ma phi ne ki kput tymmen jong phi kim ju manla .
translation.en: Because of their wickedness which they have committed to provoke me to anger , in that they went to burn incense , and to serve other gods , whom they knew not , neither they , ye , nor your fathers .

translation.kha: Tang u Lukios u to badno at . Leit wad ïa u Markos bad wan ïalam ïa u ryngkat bad me , namar u lah Ban ïahap ïa ar .
translation.en: Only Luke is with me . Take Mark , and bring him with thee : for he is profitable to me for the ministry .

translation.kha: Phong ïa ki juti , hynrei wat rah sopti nalor kaba phi la phong .
translation.en: But be shod with sandals  ; and not put on two coats .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bujli , u paidbah byllien kaba la wan shad ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait u la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u dang wan sha Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Hobah me la dep ïa kata , phai pyrshing pud sha ka prong kamon jong me bad ïashitom siaw sner namar ki kad bymdonkam ka ïing Judah — kaweh ka sngi namar kadei kawei ka snem jong ka jingshna pynshitom jong ki .
translation.en: And when thou hast accomplished them , lie again on thy right side , and thou shalt bear the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days : I have appointed thee each day for a year .

translation.kha: Pynban , lada u bymngeit u kwah ban iehnoh ïa tnga ka jingit , ai ba kan long Kumta . Ha kiba khem kita ki khep u tnga ne ka tnga jingit , ki la laitluid ban jied . U Blei u la khot ïa phi ïa ka ban im ha ka jingsuki .
translation.en: But if the unbelieving depart , let him depart . A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases : but God hath called us to peace .
Behold , he put no trust in his servants  ; and his angels he charged with folly :
translation.kha: U Blei um shaniah ïa ki shakri jong u ha bneng ; u shem ka jingduna wat bad ki angel jong u .
namar baroh ar ngut phi la leh patlun ïa nga ha khmat ki Israel . Mynba phi ïadait ha ki um Ibbah , hajan ka shnong Kadesh , ha ka ri khlaw Sin , phi la pynjahburom ïa la ha khmat u paidbah .
translation.en: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah–kadesh , in the wilderness of Zin  ; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la leit sha ka thain hajan ki nongbam Tyros bad Seïon .
translation.en: Then Jesus went thence , and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon .

translation.kha: Nalorkata u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha u Pharaoh , Bad ki la ong , U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , u ong , ‘ Shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban leit , khnang ba kin ïuh pynlong ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam ha ka ri shitaiew ban pyndonburom ïa nga .’
translation.en: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in , and told Pharaoh , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Let my people go , that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness .

translation.kha: (Nga la pynpaw ïa ka burom jong me ha ka pyrthei ; nga la pyndih ïa ka kam kaba me la ai ha nga don lai .
translation.en: I have glorified thee on the earth : I have finished the work which thou gavest me to do .
When the Almighty was yet with me , when my children were about me  ;
translation.kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la long bad nga ha kata ka por , bad ïa nga la ker sawdong da baroh ki khun jong nga .
Syiem Kynrad , ka ong , ïa kano katno kaba phi kuna , ma nga malade la ka longïing ïong shim ïa ka jingshah kynnoh ; ma phi bad la ka longïing syiem phin lait .
translation.en: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king , My lord , O king , the iniquity be on me , and on my father s house : and the king and his throne be guiltless .
Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name : ask , and ye shall receive , that your joy may be full .
translation.kha: Haduh mynta phim ju pan ei ei ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; to pan bad phin ïohpdiang , khnang ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan ïoh long kaba dap pura .
U Abijah u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Sabad , bad u Asa u khun jong u , u hir syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Abijam slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him in the city of David : and Asa his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: U ong ïa ki , Paralok , nga kyrpad ïa phi , wat leh ïa kaba koum kane ka kam kaba sniew !
translation.en: And said , I pray you , brethren , do not so wickedly .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , u bret noh ïa dat ka shyieng tyngam . Ka dik ha kaba kane ka la jia la ai kyrteng ka Ramath Lehi .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he had made an end of speaking , that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand , and called that place Ramath–lehi .

translation.kha: U Moses u ai ïa phim ki jingbthah ha ki Nongïalam na ki jait Israel .
translation.en: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel , saying , This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded .

translation.kha: babha la pynïap ïa U Trai Jisu bad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ki la pynshitom beiñ ïa ngi . A kumno ki la longsem ki bym pynsngewbha ïa U bieit! A kumno ki la long kiba shun uei ïa iwei!
translation.en: Who both killed the Lord Jesus , and their own prophets , and have persecuted us ; and they please not God , and are contrary to all men :

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingstad ym lah ban shem hapdeng ki briew ; ym don batip ïa ka dor bashisha jong ka .
translation.en: Man knoweth not the price thereof  ; neither is it found in the land of the living .

And the other issued out of the city against them  ; so they were in the midst of Israel , some on this side , and some on that side : and they smote them , so that they let none of them remain or escape .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kiba hapoh ka nongbah mynta ki wan hiar ban ïasoh lem ha ka thma . Kumta ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki shem ïa lade ba ki la shah kerkut ha ki Israel , bad ba ki la shah pynïap lut . Ym don uwei ruh uba lait im , bad ym don uwei ruh uba lait na kata lait tang u syiem jong ka Ai .
Baroh kiwei pat ki nongïohipaw ki ong ïa hajuh . tur pyrshah ïa ka Ramoth bad phin sa jop , ki ong , U Tlai un ai ïa phi ka jingjop .
translation.en: And all the prophets prophesied so , saying , Go up to Ramoth–gilead , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the hand of the king .

translation.kha: Ki wad jingïar , hynrei ym don kiba phlait im ïa ki ; ki ïakhot kyrpad ïa U Trai , hynrei um jubab .
translation.en: They looked , but there was none to save  ; even unto the  Lord  , but he answered them not .

translation.kha: Mynta , ai ha ki ïa khie ka jubab : ‘ Neng smai ba kumba nga long uba im , ngan leh kumba phi la patan . (Nga U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Say unto them , As truly as I live , saith the  Lord  , as ye have spoken in mine ears , so will I do to you :

translation.kha: U kular ba katba ka jingbuh ryntih ïa ka mariang ka ïalang napoh , kumta ruh ki Israel kin long ka jingbhabriew .
translation.en: If those ordinances depart from before me , saith the  Lord  , then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever .
And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever  ; and of his kingdom there shall be no end .
translation.kha: bad un long u syiem jong ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob junom ; ka hima jong u kan ym kut shuh da lei lei !
Shim ïa une u diengduh bad me , namar da u men sa lai ïa ki kambah .
translation.en: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand , wherewith thou shalt do signs .
Then the high priest rent his clothes , and saith , What need we any further witnesses ?
translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la tar ïa la ki jaiñkup bad u la ong ,  Ngim donkam shuh kino kino ki sakhi !
Ki shakri jong u ki ino ha u , Ngi tip ba u mynsiem bymman ba la phah U Blei u pyniapher ïa phi .
translation.en: And Saul s servants said unto him , Behold now , an evil spirit from God troubleth thee .

translation.kha: Kum ki la Mihnoh ha ka jingkyrkieh na ka jingtep , da ka jinghiarpateng bad pynap Ibbah la pyndap da ka jingkmen , bad ki la mareh ban ïathuh ha ki synran jong u .
translation.en: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy  ; and did run to bring his disciples word .

Know therefore and understand , that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks , and threescore and two weeks : the street shall be built again , and the wall , even in troublous times .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa kane bad to shemphang ïa ka : Naduh ka por ba la ai ïa ka hukum ban tei pat ïa ka Jerusalem , tad haduh ba wan u nongïalam ba la jied da U Blei , ki hynñiew sien ki hynñiew snem kin leit noh . Ïa ka Jerusalem yn tei pat lem bad ki lynti bah bad ki jingïada bakhlaiñ , bad kan ïeng haduh hynñiew sien ki hynriewphew ar snem , hynrei kane kan long ka por ki jingjynjar .

kumta u la leit kiew sha u Lus Salmon bad la ki rangbah . Hangta u shim uwei u sdie , u pom kawei ka tnat na u dieng , bad u beh ïa ka ha la ka tyrpeng . U ïai-ong ïa la ki radbah ba pynkloi badno ban leh kumjuh .
translation.en: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon , he and all the people that were with him  ; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand , and cut down a bough from the trees , and took it , and laid it on his shoulder , and said unto the people that were with him , What ye have seen me do , make haste , and do as I have done .

translation.kha: Ki dieng Kedar lad ka Lebanon ki ïoh shibun u slap — ki diengïap jong U TRAI’ hi , katba u la thung .
translation.en: The trees of the  Lord  are full of sap  ; the cedars of Lebanon , which he hath planted  ;
This Jesus hath God raised up , whereof we all are witnesses .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa une hi U Jisu na ka jingïap , bad ngi baroh ngi long ki sakhi ïa kane ka jingshisha .
Kum ki Israel ki mih ha ka step kaba bud bad ki shrah dara hajan ka nongbah Gibeah .
translation.en: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning , and encamped against Gibeah .

translation.kha: u u longïng u jingthaw batymmen uba U Blei , u Nongthaw jngai u , u ïai pynthymmai ha ka dur lad u hi , khring ban wallam ïa phi shad ka jingtip ba-pura shaphang jongno u .
translation.en: And have put on the new man , which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him :

translation.kha: Ka un-long kaei kaei kaba eh ïa uno uno banbeiñ ïap na ka bynta u briew uba hok . Ka lah ïa-ban Long ba ba-don uno uno umbiah nud ban ïap na ka bynta u briew uba bha .
translation.en: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die : yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die .

translation.kha: To pynnep ïa ka jinglong jemnud shaw uwei pa uwei baroh . U Trai u la jan wan .
translation.en: Let your moderation be known unto all men . The Lord is at hand .

For it is a fact : This “world is passing away and so is its desire , but he that does the will of God remains forever ,” to enjoy eternally the blessings to be showered down by our loving Creator .—1 John 2 :17 .
translation.kha: Namar ka long ka bashisha “Kane ka pyrthei ka ïaid jah noh bad kata ka jingkwah brai jong ka , hynrei uta uba leh ïa ka mon u Blei u ïaisah bymjukut ,” ban lehkmen junom ïa ki jingkyrkhu ban thehsei da u Trai Nongbuh Nongthaw . —Ïoannis 2 :17 .

translation.en: Wherefore I say unto thee , Her sins , which are many , are forgiven  ; for she loved much : but to whom little is forgiven , the same loveth little .
translation.kha: Te nga ong ha me , ka jingieit bakhraw kaba ka la pyn-i ka pynshisha ba ïa ki pop jong ka kiba bun la map . Hynrei uno uno uba la ïohmap khyndiat u pyn-i tang khyndiat ka jingieit .
Ha u bnai uba nyngkong , u paid Israel baroh u wan poi ha ka ri khlaw Sin Bad u Shong dara ha Kadesh . Hangta ka Miriam ka la ïahap bad la tep ïa ka .
translation.en: Then came the children of Israel , even the whole congregation , into the desert of Zin in the first month : and the people abode in Kadesh  ; and Miriam died there , and was buried there .

translation.kha: Hobah U Jisu bad la ki synran ki la wan sha Kapernam , ki nonglum ïa ka khajna Templ ki la wan ha u Petros bad ki la kylli , Haseroth u Nonghikai jong phi u siew ïa ka khajna Templ ?
translation.en: And when they were come to Capernaum , they that received tribute money came to Peter , and said , Doth not your master pay tribute ?

translation.kha: Pha long kaba khlem bor wat la pha ïoh ïa ka jingai jingmut . To ai ba ki nongbatai kupar kin wan sha kham ban pyllait im ïa pha — kito ki briew kiba wad jingtip shaphang ki khlei , kiba pruid dak ïa ki bynta jong ki bneng bad ïathuh ïa pha na uwei u bnai sha uwei pat kaei ka ban jat ïa phad .
translation.en: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels . Let now the astrologers , the stargazers , the monthly prognosticators , stand up , and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee .
Tom gave his seat to an elderly lady .
translation.kha: U Tom u ai ia ka jakashong jong u ha I tymmen kynthei .

translation.en: Take heed now  ; for the  Lord  hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary : be strong , and do it .
translation.kha: Me dei ban sngewthuh ba U  Trai  u la jied ïa me ban tei ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong u . Mynta leh ïa kata — bad leh ïa kata da ka jingkut jingmut baskhem .
Nongthaw u wait ïarep bad kata ka kynthei , bad u la itynnat ïa ka .
translation.en: And he went down , and talked with the woman  ; and she pleased Samson well .

translation.kha: U Blei u long uba stad bad uba donbor ! to ïaroh ïa u junom la junom .
translation.en: Daniel answered and said , Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever : for wisdom and might are his :

translation.kha: U la mynhynnin ban sieb ïa ki ka bainong sngi , shi sbai rupa shi sngi , bad u la phah ïa ki ban thir ha ka bri shawei jong u .
translation.en: And when he had agreed with the labourers for a penny a day , he sent them into his vineyard .
And Jacob said unto his father , I am Esau thy firstborn  ; I have done according as thou badest me : arise , I pray thee , sit and eat of my venison , that thy soul may bless me .
translation.kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Nga dei u Iso u khun rangbah jong phi ; nga la leh kumba phi la bthah ïa nga . Sngewbha khie shong , bad bam khyndiat na kane ka doh kaba nga la wallam ïa phi , ba phin ïoh ai ha nga ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong phi .

Ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi la pynbynta kim ba kan leh ha ka Templ . Ki nongtrei kiba don jingtbit ha ki jahthait kim baroh ki thrang ïa-ban ïaroh ïa me , Bad baroh ki briew bad ki nongïalap jong ki , ki don hapoh ka hukum jong me .
translation.en: And , behold , the courses of the priests and the Levites , even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God : and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man , for any manner of service : also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment .
Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial  ; they knew not the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang u Eli ki dei ki riewbymman . Kim ju shahshkor ïa U  Trai

translation.en: And the men took of their victuals , and asked not counsel at the mouth of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la pdiang katto katne ka jingbam na ki , hynrei kim shym kynjoh ktien na U  Trai  shaphang kata .
Hangta halor u lum , U Trai u la kren ha phi markhmat napdeng ka ding .
translation.en: The  Lord  talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire ,

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong ïa ka , Namar kata ka jubab , khie leit phai pat sha ïing , ha kaba phan shem ba u ksuid u la mihnoh na ka khun jong pha !
translation.en: And he said unto her ,  For this saying go thy way  ; the devil is gone out of thy daughter .
Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day , neither do ye any work , but hallow ye the sabbath day , as I commanded your fathers .
translation.kha: lane rah ïa kano kano shabar ki ïing jong ki ha ka Sabbaton . Kim dei ban trei ha ka Sabbaton ; ki dei ban rakhe ïa ka kum ka sngi bakyntang , kumba nga la hukum ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: I therefore , the prisoner of the Lord , beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called ,
translation.kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi , te — nga uba long u nongsah byndi namar ba nga shakri ïa U Trai ; to im ka jingim kaba la thew kat kum ka rukom kaba U Blei u la buh haba u la khot ïa phi .

U paralok jongki u , u phai ktien , Ka dei ka waitsum jongu u nong Israel , u Gideon u khun jong u Joash ! Kam mut da kumwei pat ! U blem u la ai ha u ka jingjot halor ki Midian bad ïa ka kynhun shiphang jong sem baroh .
translation.en: And his fellow answered and said , This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash , a man of Israel : for into his hand hath God delivered Midian , and all the host .

translation.kha: Lada ngi ïai Bteng ban ïaishah , ngin sa synshar ruh lem nabar u . Lada ngin len ïa u , u hati un lem ïa i .
translation.en: If we suffer , we shall also reign with him : if we deny him , he also will deny us :

And thou shalt put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Israel : and Aaron shall bear their names before the  Lord  upon his two shoulders for a memorial .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ki ha ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng jong ka ephod ba kin ïeng na ka bynta ki khat-ar jait Israel . Ha kane ka rukom u Aaron un kit ïa ki kyrteng jong ki ha la ka tyrpeng khnang ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan ïai kynmaw ïa ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: And certain women , which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities , Mary called Magdalene , out of whom went seven devils ,
translation.kha: bad kumta ruh katto katne ngut ki kynthei kiba la ïohkhiah na ki mynsiem bymman bad ki jingpang : Ka Mari ( kaba la khot , ka nong Magdala ) , na ka ba la beh noh ïa ki hynñiew ki ksuid ;

translation.en: For he that will love life , and see good days , let him refrain his tongue from evil , and his lips that they speak no guile :
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba kwah ban lehkmen ha ka jingim bad uba kwah ban ïohi ïa ki por kiba bha , u dei ban kiar na kaba kren sniew bad ban nym kren lamler .

te phi dei pun jied sa lai tylli ki shnongrit . ( Un ai ha phi ïa Kane ka ri lada Phin kuna ïa baroh kaba at hukum ïa phi ha kane ka sngi bad lada phi imat ïa U tharai U Blei jong Phin bad im kat kumno ki jingjai jong U . )
translation.en: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them , which I command thee this day , to love the  Lord  thy God , and to walk ever in his ways  ; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee , beside these three :

translation.kha: Ngi kynjat ban shahshkor ïa Kiei kaba phi la iathuh ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai .
translation.en: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the  Lord  , we will not hearken unto thee .

translation.kha: u khun jong u Janoah , u khun jong u Rhesa , u Kynhun jongnga u Serubbabel , u khum jong u Shealtiel , u khun jongnga u Neri ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Joanna , which was the son of Rhesa , which was the son of Zorobabel , which was the son of Salathiel , which was the son of Neri ,
And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead , If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon , and the  Lord  deliver them before me , shall I be your head ?
translation.kha: U Jephthah u ong ha ki ,  Lada phi ïalam biang ïa nga sha ïing ban ïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad U  Trai  u ai jingjop ïa nga , nga dei ban long u nongsynshar jong phi .
ibha U Trai U Bel jong phi u pynjop thma ïa phira bad phoi ïoh koidi ,
translation.en: When thou goest forth to war against thine enemies , and the  Lord  thy God hath delivered them into thine hands , and thou hast taken them captive ,

translation.kha: Ïa kane kajuh ka bynta la kren biang , Kan ym ïohrung da lem lei shwa —kata ka ri ha kaba ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingjahthait .
translation.en: And in this place again , If they shall enter into my rest .
And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise : and another shall rise after them  ; and he shall be diverse from the first , and he shall subdue three kings .
translation.kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki reng ki long ki shiphew ngut ki syiem ki ban synshar ïa kata ka hima . Nangta sa uwei pat u syiem un mihpaw ; un long uba pher bak lbak ïa kiba mynshuwa bad un pynkhyllem ïa ki lai ngut ki syiem .

Ym dat u shatri uba lah ban long u mraw jong ki ar ngut ki kynrad ; un isih ïa uwei bad un ieit ïa uwei pateng ; un kohnguh ïa uwei bad un ñiewbeiñ ïa eiei pat . Phim lah shun shakri ïa U Blei bad ïa ka spah .
translation.en: No servant can serve two masters : for either he will hate the one , and love the other  ; or else he will hold to the one , and despise the other . Ye cannot serve God and mammon .

translation.kha: U buh ïa uwei u khun masi ksiar ha Bethel bad ïa iwei pat ha Dan .
translation.en: And he set the one in Beth–el , and the other put he in Dan .

translation.kha: Ym don ba ïarap ïa U Blei ban pynïar ïa ki bneng lane ïuh phalor ka met ki mrad kynsha ka duriaw .
translation.en: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens , and treadeth upon the waves of the sea .
And they shall be gathered together , as prisoners are gathered in the pit , and shall be shut up in the prison , and after many days shall they be visited .
translation.kha: U Blei un buh khapngiah ïa ki syiem kum ki koidi ha ka thliew . Un set ïa ki ha ka ïingbyndi haduh ka por jong ka jingpynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself , and took the captains of hundreds , Azariah the son of Jeroham , and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan , and Azariah the son of Obed , and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah , and Elishaphat the son of Zichri , into covenant with him .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingap kaba hynriew snem , u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u la rai ba ka la dei ka por ban leh ei ei . U ïateh kular bad san ngut ki rangbah shipai : u Asaraïah u khun jong u Jeroham , u Ishmael u khun jong u Jehohanan , u Asaraïah u khun jong u Obed , u Maaseïah u khun jong u Adaïah , bad u Elishaphat u khun jong u Sikhri .

translation.en: Moses and Aaron among his priests , and Samuel among them that call upon his name  ; they called upon the  Lord  , and he answered them .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la long ki lyngdoh jong u , bad u Samuel u la long uwei uba la duwai ha u ; kiba la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u la jubab ïa ki .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king had heard the words of the book of the law , that he rent his clothes .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u ïohsngew ba la pule ïa ka Kitab , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsheptieng ,
Ki kulai thma kim lai ban ai jingjop ; ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki kam lah ban pyllait im .
translation.en: An horse is a vain thing for safety : neither shall he deliver any by his great strength .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Josaïah u ktung jingmut don ïaleh . U kyntait ban shakor ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la ong lyndang u sahmiet Neko , kumta u riam pher ïa lade” sad u leit sha ka tmoh ha ka them jong ka Megiddo .
translation.en: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him , but disguised himself , that he might fight with him , and hearkened not unto the words of Neco from the mouth of God , and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo .
And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth , and pitched in the wilderness of Paran .
translation.kha: Nangta ki mihnoh na Haseroth bad ki pynïeng dara ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Paran .

translation.en: But if any provide not for his own , and specially for those of his own house , he hath denied the faith , and is worse than an infidel .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno um sumar ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , khamtam ïa ki dkhot ka longïing jong u hi , u la len ïa ka jingngeit bad u kham sniew ban ïa u bymngeit .
Kiei kiei borbah ki neh Haduh kaei ka sngi namar ka hukum jong me , namar baroh ki long ki sakhrai jong me .
translation.en: They continue this day according to thine ordinances : for all are thy servants .

translation.kha: Balei une u nongkhaïi u long thiang ma u uba la wan pah pat ban ainguh ïa U Blei ?
translation.en: There are not found that returned to give glory to God , save this stranger .
And arms shall stand on his part , and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength , and shall take away the daily sacrifice , and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate .
translation.kha: Katto katne na ki shipai jong u kin pyntngit ïa ka Templ . Kin pynsangeh ïa ki jingkñia ba man ka sngi bad kin pynïeng ïa ka Jingshyrkhei Ba-ijli .
Bad u la hukum ïa ki briew kiba khlaiñ tam ha ka kynhun shipai jong u pun khoh ïa ki lai nguid ki rangbah bad ban bret ïa ki ha ka lawar ding baklang .
translation.en: And he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace .

translation.kha: bad pynkylla ïa ki hima mala pynkut ïa ka bor jong ki . Ngin pynkylla khongpong ïa ki kali ïapom bad ïa ki nongïam jong ki ; ki kulai kin ïap , bad ki nongshong kulai keiñ ïa-pynïap para ma ki .
translation.en: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms , and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen  ; and I will overthrow the chariots , and those that ride in them  ; and the horses and their riders shall come down , every one by the sword of his brother .

translation.kha: Me tip baïong biang ïa ka jinglong bakla baroh kaba me la har ïa u Dabid u kpa jong nga . U Trai un pynshitom ïa me namar kata .
translation.en: The king said moreover to Shimei , Thou knowest all the wickedness which thine heart is privy to , that thou didst to David my father : therefore the  Lord  shall return thy wickedness upon thine own head  ;
But if it be a question of words and names , and of your law , look ye to it  ; for I will be no judge of such matters .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba ka long ka jingïatainia shaphang ki ktien bad ki kyrteng bad shaphang ka hukum jong phi , phi hi phi dei ban ïapynbeit ïa ka . Ngan ym long u nongbishar ïa kine kiei kiei !
‘ Ka jingtim U Blei sa hap ha uta u Briew uba ïashah shongkha bad la ka kiaw kurup .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law . And all the people shall say , Amen .
And he touched her hand , and the fever left her : and she arose , and ministered unto them .
translation.kha: U la ktah ïa ka kti jong ka , ka jingshit ka la iehnoh ïa ka , bad ka la khie joit bad ka la sdang ban shakri ïa u .
Kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ai jingpynïoh ïa ka Jerusalem ba kaei kaei bhor ka bieit ka biang , hajuh barabor kam bit kam biang ! U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren-ïa .
translation.en: To wit , the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem , and which see visions of peace for her , and there is no peace , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Shekhem ki buh bariew ba iap ïa u Abimelekh ha ki kliar lum , bad ki la lute ïa utai pa uwei uba ïaid lynti nangta . La ïathiah ïa kane ha u Abimelekh .
translation.en: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains , and they robbed all that came along that way by them : and it was told Abimelech .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah kba ïadat bad nga ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai , hynrei kim shym ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong Utai uba kren ha nga .
translation.en: And they that were with me saw indeed the light , and were afraid  ; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me .
For when they shall rise from the dead , they neither marry , nor are given in marriage  ; but are as the angels which are in heaven .
translation.kha: Naba haba kiba la ïap kin mihpat , kin long kum ki angel ha bneng ba kin ym shongkurim shuh .
Hato ngan ym pynshitom ïa ki na ka pynbha kine kiei kiei ? bad pynkulmar ïa ka jaitbynriew kaba kamon kane ?
translation.en: Shall I not visit for these things ? saith the  Lord  : and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this ?

translation.kha: Ka thma kun khie ha ki nongbah jong ki , bun kan pynkheiñ ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbet . Kan pyndait ïa ki briew jong nga namar ki ni ïa kawei kaba ma ki hi ki kyrkhoit ba ka long kaba bha tam .
translation.en: And the sword shall abide on his cities , and shall consume his branches , and devour them , because of their own counsels .

translation.kha: Ki shna hima sawphew thylli ki jingker na ka pyntha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei ka ïingjah ,
translation.en: And for the other side of the tabernacle , which is toward the north corner , he made twenty boards ,

translation.kha: kawei nga lah ban ong ? U Trai u la leh ïa kane . Ka dohnud jong nga ka kthang , malu ngam shym haka ïohthiah .
translation.en: What shall I say ? he hath both spoken unto me , and himself hath done it : I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul .

translation.kha: Ki leh kumta , bad halor jong ka u la hiar arsut ha ka lyntang nadien u nongïathuhlypa kaba na Judah bad u lap ïa u ba u shong ha trai uwei u dieng snep . Hato phi dei uta u nongïathuhlypa kaba na Judah ? u kylli . Nga dei , uta u briew u jubab .
translation.en: And went after the man of God , and found him sitting under an oak : and he said unto him , Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah ? And he said , I am .

translation.kha: Haba ka jingiaseng batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon lad nga ka ïaid pun nangta , ngan buh ïa me ha khmat ka krem jong uta u mawdong bad Ngan tap ïa me da la ka kti haduh ba ngan da ïaid mlien nongtuh .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , while my glory passeth by , that I will put thee in a clift of the rock , and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by :
Thus they made a covenant at Beer–sheba : then Abimelech rose up , and Phichol the chief captain of his host , and they returned into the land of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la pynlong ïa kane ka jingïateh kular ha Beersheba , u Abimelekh bad u Phikol ki leit phai pat sha Philistia .
ba ka jaitbynriew kaba la wan na ibit ka la saphriang ha ka ri baroh kawei . U khah ïa nga ban tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong u , khnang ba u lah ban ïaleh pyrthuh bad beh noh ïa ki .
translation.en: Behold , there is a people come out of Egypt , which covereth the face of the earth : come now , curse me them  ; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them , and drive them out .
And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives , of which the name of the one was Shiphrah , and the name of the other Puah :
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem ka Ijipt u ong ha ki nongpynkha khun kiba na ki kynthei Hebru , kawei kaba kyrteng ka Shiphrah bad kawei pat ka Puah ,

translation.en: And they have turned unto me the back , and not the face : though I taught them , rising up early and teaching them , yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction .
translation.kha: Ki la phai dien na nga ; bad wat la nga la ïai hikai ïa ki , kim shahshkor bad ïoh jinghikai .

translation.en: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me .
translation.kha: Bad uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa uwei uba kum une u khynnah , u pdiang ïa nga .
Naba kumba ki bri baroh ki ïap nalor ka jingïadei jong ki ha u Adam , kumjuh ruh ïa baïar yn pynmihpat namar ka jingïadei jyllang ki ha U Khrist .
translation.en: For as in Adam all die , even so in Christ shall all be made alive .
Howbeit the high places were not taken away : for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers .
translation.kha: hynrei ïa ki jaka mane ba-thala ym shym la pynjot . Ki briew kim pat shym la phai da ka dohnud baroh ban shakri ïa U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
U Korah u la don sa nud ki khun shynrang : u Assir , u Elnathan , bad u Abiasaph ; Kinah ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong ka jait Korah .
translation.en: And the sons of Korah  ; Assir , and Elkanah , and Abiasaph : these are the families of the Korhites .

translation.kha: U Trei u Ong ha u Moses , Ngan wanlam ha me ha u lyoh uba rben , khnang ba u paidbah un ïohsngew ïa nga ba nga ïakren malu me , bad un sa ngeit ïa me naduh mynta . U Manasseh u la ïathuh ha U Trai’ ïa ka jubab jong uta u paidbah ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Lo , I come unto thee in a thick cloud , that the people may hear when I speak with thee , and believe thee for ever . And Moses told the words of the people unto the  Lord .
Tom was even busier than I was .
translation.kha: U Tom u kham bunkam ban ia nga .
Haba u Nahor u la thep arphew khyndai snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shngain , u Terah ;
translation.en: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years , and begat Terah :

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u long uba hok , namar Ngam shym la kohnguh ïa u . To shahshkor ïa nga , ko ki briew hangno hangno ; to khmih ïa nga ha ka jingong jong nga . Ki samla shngain bad kynthei jong nga ki la shah ringmraw noh .
translation.en: Their heart cried unto the Lord , O wall of the daughter of Zion , let tears run down like a river day and night : give thyself no rest  ; let not the apple of thine eye cease .
He gave them hail for rain , and flaming fire in their land .
translation.kha: U la phah ïa u phria bad ka leilieh ha ka ri jong ki ha ka jaka jong u slap ;

U syiem u jong , Kaei otsher sha u syiem Israel bad rhah ïa kane ka shitom sha u . Kumta u Naaman u leit , u da rah laiphew hajar tylli ki lyngkhot rupa , hynriew hajar tylli ki lyngkhot kseh , bad Shipai riat ki jaiñ ba-itynnat .
translation.en: And the king of Syria said , Go to , go , and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel . And he departed , and took with him ten talents of silver , and six thousand pieces of gold , and ten changes of raiment .
I , even I , am he that comforteth you : who art thou , that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die , and of the son of man which shall be made as grass  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga long uta uba pynkhlaiñ ïa phi . Balei phin sheptieng ïa u briew u bym im junom , u bym kham neh ban ïa u phlang ?

translation.en: And Joktan begat Almodad , and Sheleph , and Hazarmaveth , and Jerah ,
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joktan ki dei ki briew jong ka Almodad , ka Sheleph , ka Hasarmabeth , ka Jerah ,
( 1 Samuel 1 :12 , 13 ) Kan kham ba lada ngi duwai ha ki jaka ba kynjah ha kaba ym don ba pynwit ïa ngi .—Markos 1 :35 .
translation.en: ( 1 Samuel 1 :12 , 13 ) It is good to find a quiet place away from other people to say our personal prayers .—Mark 1 :35 .

translation.kha: Wat long kiba bieit , hynrei , pyrshang ban wad ïa khie kaba U Trai u kwah ïa phi ban har .
translation.en: Wherefore be ye not unwise , but understanding what the will of the Lord is .

translation.kha: Nga la ong , To sngi ïa U Trai , phi ki kynthei , bad to pynshahshkor ïa ki ktien Jong u . To hikai ïa ki khwan kynthei jong phi kumno ban ïambriew , bad ïa ki paralok jong phi Kamon ban rwai ka jingrwai ïapbriew .
translation.en: Yet hear the word of the  Lord  , O ye women , and let your ear receive the word of his mouth , and teach your daughters wailing , and every one her neighbour lamentation .
Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites , and for all the work of the service of the house of the  Lord  , and for all the vessels of service in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la ai ruh ïa ki dur pynkhreh kiba ïadei bad ki jingpynbeit ryntih ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , bad pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki , ban trei ïa ki kam jong ka Templ bad ban sumar ïa baroh ki khiew ki pliang jong ka Templ .
Nga long U Tiras U Blei jong phi uba la wanrah ïalamwir ïa phi na ka ri Joppa , ka ri ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
translation.en: I am the  Lord  thy God , which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt , out of the house of bondage .

translation.kha: Ngin sa kumno ban pynïoh tnga ïa ki rangbah Benjamin kiba dang sah ? Ngi la ai ïa ka jingkular kaba kyntang sha U Trai ba ïeng ym ai ha ki ïa la ki khun kynthei .
translation.en: How shall we do for wives for them that remain , seeing we have sworn by the  Lord  that we will not give them of our daughters to wives ?

translation.kha: Don kiba lap ïa ki , bad la ïathuh ha u Joshua ha-ei ba ki ïarieh .
translation.en: And it was told Joshua , saying , The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah .
For that ye ought to say , If the Lord will , we shall live , and do this , or that .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi dei ban ong ka long kane :  Lada U Trai u mon , ngin im bad ngin leh ïa kane lane ïa katai .
Ki Pharaoh ki la ïakren para ma ki , phin ïohi , ngi shyiap la leh ei ei ruh em ! Khmih , ka pyrthuh baroh kawei ka ïabud ïa u !
translation.en: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves , Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing ? behold , the world is gone after him .

translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïalumlang ha ka Templ bad hangta ki la pynurlong ka Jutang pynlang u Joash , u khun jong u syiemsad . U Jehoïada u ong ha ki , Un hangne u Dei u khwan jongngi u syiem ba la khlad noh ! Mynta u dei ban long syiem , kumba U Trai u la kular ba ki khun ki ksew u Dabid ktien long .
translation.en: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of God . And he said unto them , Behold , the king s son shall reign , as the  Lord  hath said of the sons of David .

translation.kha: ka hamsaïa batylli kur na barabor , bad kin ym ïoh synshar pateng halor kiwei ki hima . Ngan pynlong ïa ki , ki bymlarkam haduh ba kin ym lah ban pynlong ïa kano kano ka shem ban pyndem ha ka mon jong ki .
translation.en: It shall be the basest of the kingdoms  ; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations : for I will diminish them , that they shall no more rule over the nations .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong to ki Israel kin pynhiarkput ïa ka Edom namar jong nga , bad kin pynlong ïa ka Edom ban mad ïa ka jingbitar lep jong nga . Ki Edom kin kop ka mut aïu baneh shahïap ha ka jingpynhiarkput jong nga . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel : and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury  ; and they shall know my vengeance , saith the Lord  God .
And it came to pass , as she spake to Joseph day by day , that he hearkened not unto her , to lie by her , or to be with her .
translation.kha: Wat la ka kyrpad ïa u Joseph man la ka sngi , um treh ban leit thiah bad ka .

Haba ki nongtuh ki wan mynmiet , ki rah tang ïa kaei kaba ki kwah . Ha ki briew ki lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , borabor ki pynsah khyrdong khyndiat . Hynrei ki nongshun jong pha ki la pyndam noh khoit ïa pha .
translation.en: If thieves came to thee , if robbers by night , ( how art thou cut off ! ) would they not have stolen till they had enough ? if the grapegatherers came to thee , would they not leave some grapes ?

translation.kha: Ki Jeraïah ki la pdiang katto katne ka jingbam na ki , hynrei kim shngiam kynjoh ktien na U Trai shaphang kata .
translation.en: And the men took of their victuals , and asked not counsel at the mouth of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kan shoh bad kan ïai shoh ïa pa’ , na kawei ka step sha kawei pat . Phin hap ban shah ïa ka bad sngi bad miet . Kawei pa kawei ka khubor tikmie na U Blang kan wanrah ïa ka jingshyrkhei bathymmai !
translation.en: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you : for morning by morning shall it pass over , by day and by night : and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report .
And unto David were sons born in Hebron : and his firstborn was Amnon , of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess  ;
translation.kha: Kine harum ki hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang , ha ka jingbuh ryntih kat kum ka jingkha ïa ki ; la kha na ka bynta u Dabid ha Hebron : u Amnon , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Ahinoam , kaba na Jesreel ;

translation.en: By lot was their inheritance , as the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses , for the nine tribes , and for the half tribe .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses , ïa ki jaka jong ki khyndai jait bad kawei ka shiteng jait ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan la rai da kaba kynting sbai .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , cause thy belly to eat , and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee . Then did I eat it  ; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Ko khun u briew , bam ïa kane ka kot kli ba nga ai ha me , pyndap ïa ka kpoh jong me da ka .  Te nga bam ïa ka , bad ka thiang kum ka ngap .
U tharai Nongsynshar u la ong , Pha long kaba la tim ! Kaba la tim ! Pha la leh ïa “kata kaban sniew baroh , dara nangta
translation.en: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness , ( woe , woe unto thee ! saith the Lord  God   ; )
Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels , intruding into those things which he hath not seen , vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind ,
translation.kha: Wat shah ïa lade ban shah pynrem da uno uno uba kam ba u long uba kham hakhlieh namar ki jingïohipaw kiba kyrpang bad uba ïai ban ha ka jingsngewrit bymdei bad ha kaba mane ïa ki angel . Naba khlem kano kano ka daw , ïa kiba kum kine ki briew la pynmeng shikatdei da ka rukom pyrkhat briew bad ki la sangeh ban batskhem ha U Khrist , uba long u khlieh jong ka met .

Hynrei man u briew uba hok u sangeh ban lehbha bad sdang ba leh ïa kaba sniew baroh , ïa kiwei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki briew kiba sniew ki leh , hato un ïai im ? Em , yn ym kynmaw ïa kano kano kob bha kaban u la leh . Un ïap ñiar ka jingpynïoh jong u bad ki bapop jong u .
translation.en: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth , shall he live ? All his righteousness that he hath done shall not be mentioned : in his trespass that he hath trespassed , and in his sin that he hath sinned , in them shall he die .
Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service , and a worldly sanctuary .
translation.kha: Ka jutang kaba nyngkong ka la don ki rukom pynïaid ïa ka jingmane Blei bad kumjuh ruh ka jaka ba la shna da u briew ban mane .

translation.en: Ask Jehovah to help you do what is good .
translation.kha: To pan na U Jehobah ban ïarap ïa phi ban leh ïa kaba dei .
Khmih ïa ki tyngab : Kim shym bet symbai lane lum ïa ka jingduh ; kim to ki jaka kynshew lane ki thiar ; U Blei u bseiñ ïa ki ! Phi long Ibbah kor kham bun shah ban ïa ki sim !
translation.en: Consider the ravens : for they neither sow nor reap  ; which neither have storehouse nor barn  ; and God feedeth them : how much more are ye better than the fowls ?

And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing , I the  Lord  have deceived that prophet , and I will stretch out my hand upon him , and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel .
translation.kha: Lada u nongïathuhlypa u shah shukor ban ai ki jubab kiba bakla , ka dei namar ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la shukor ïa u . Ngan weng ïa u na ki paid Israel .

U Trai u wallam sha ka jingbishar ïa ki tymmen ki sian bad ïa ki nongriam . U pynpang ïa kane ka jingkynnoh : phiah la lute ïa ki bri sohwaiñ pynlang ki ïing lad pa ki dup da kiei kiei kiba phi la shim na kiba duk .
translation.en: The  Lord  will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people , and the princes thereof : for ye have eaten up the vineyard  ; the spoil of the poor is in your houses .

translation.kha: Ka jingïaroh ïa kaba bieit kam long kaba dem , kum ka ieh ha ka por lyiur lane u slap ha ka aïom ot .
translation.en: As snow in summer , and as rain in harvest , so honour is not seemly for a fool .
In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord :
translation.kha: U long ma u , uta uba bat ïa ka jingtei baroh kawei , bad uba pynlong ïa ka ba kan san ha ka Templ kaba kyntang ïa kaba la pynkyntang sha U Trai .
Ko Kynhun u briew , u la ong , to ainong ha u shym jyllang ka Ijipt mala ha ki briew lad u baroh : Katno ka jingkhrawbor jong me ! Bad kaei ngan ïaineh ïa me ?
translation.en: Son of man , speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , and to his multitude  ; Whom art thou like in thy greatness ?

translation.kha: U Tiras u jubab , Phi tur ïaleh ïa ki bhabriew jong nga kum ki nongshun . Ki rangbah ki wan phai na ka thma , da kaba pyrkhing ba kin shyieng ha ïeng , hynrei hangta ki shem , ïa Kiba ap ban tuh noh ïa ki jaiñphong na ka set jngai ki .
translation.en: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy : ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war .

translation.kha: ban pynkohnguh ïa ki kulai bad ïa ki nongshong kulai , Ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ki kila ïapom bad ïa ki nongïoh jong ki ,
translation.en: And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider  ; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider  ;

translation.kha: Kan don ka jingpyrta da ka hukum , ka sur Jong u jin rangbah , ka jingriew ka turoi jong U Blei , bad U Trai hi da lade un sa wan thir na bneng . Kito kiba la ïap da kaba ngeit ha U Khrist kin ïamih pah shuwa ;
translation.en: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout , with the voice of the archangel , and with the trump of God : and the dead in Christ shall rise first :

translation.kha: Ym patar ju don ba ïor lap ïohsngew ïa U Blei uba kum ma me , uba imat ïa kiba kumin kita ki kam na ka bynta kito naba ap kyrmen ha u .
translation.en: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard , nor perceived by the ear , neither hath the eye seen , O God , beside thee , what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him .

translation.kha: ka Taanakh , ka Megiddo ,
translation.en: The king of Taanach , one  ; the king of Megiddo , one  ;

translation.kha: Ho-oid , ka to kan wan haba ki nongap kin Khot ha ki lum ka Ephraim , ‘ Ïa ngin ïaleit haduh Seïon , sha U Trai U Bela jongki ngi .’
translation.en: For there shall be a day , that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry , Arise ye , and let us go up to Zion unto the  Lord  our God .

And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine , he said unto Abner , the captain of the host , Abner , whose son is this youth ? And Abner said , As thy soul liveth , O king , I cannot tell .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u ïohi ïa u Dabid ba u leit ban ïaleh bad u Goliath , u kylli ïa u Abner , u rangbah shipai jong u ,  Abner , u dei u khun jongno mo ?   Ngam don jingtip , syiem Kynrad ,  u Abner u jubab .

translation.en: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth , and built him an house , and made booths for his cattle : therefore the name of the place is called Succoth .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jakob u la leit sha Sukkoth , ha kaba u la shna ka ïing ïa lade bad ki sem na ka bynta ki jingri jong u . Dei namar kata ba la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka , Ka Sukkoth .

translation.en: Then said God , Call his name Lo–ammi : for ye are not my people , and I will not be your God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Hosia ,  Pynkyrteng ïa u , ‘ u Lo-ammi ,’ namar ki briew ka Israel kim dei ki briew jong nga , bad ngam long U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: To whom I answered , It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die , before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face , and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ïathuh ïa ki ba ma ngi ki nong Rom ngim ju mlien ban aiti ïa uno uno uba la shah kynnoh ha ka kam runar ha shuwa ba un ïakynduh ïa ki nongmudui jong u markhmat bad ba u la ïoh ka lad ban ïasaid da ïa lade pyrshah ïa ka jingkynnoh .

translation.en: O Israel , trust thou in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .
translation.kha: To shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi ki paid Israel . U ïarap ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi .

translation.en: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near , and smote Micaiah on the cheek , and said , Which way went the Spirit of the  Lord  from me to speak unto thee ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Sedekaïah u nongïathuhlypa u leit kiew sha u Mikaïah , u thab ïa u na ka ngab jong u , bad kylli ,  Naduh mynno u mynsiem jong U  Trai  u iehnoh ïa nga bad u kren ha me ?

Bad haba la kem ïa pa bun ïalam shai ka ïingbishar , wat khuslai lehbha ïa kaei kaba phin kren ; haba ka por kan poi , to kren ïa kaei kaei kaba yn sa ai ha phi ha kata ka por . Namar ki ktien Ibbah Phon sa kren , kin ym long ki jong pa’ ; kin Wan na U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: But when they shall lead you , and deliver you up , take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak , neither do ye premeditate : but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour , that speak ye : for it is not ye that speak , but the Holy Ghost .
When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon , and into the cabins , and Jeremiah had remained there many days  ;
translation.kha: Ïa nga la set ha ka kamra kaba shapoh khyndew bad la set slem ïa nga hangta .
Ka la ïing kloi kloi bad ka shong halor ka kada jong ka . La synran ïa ka da ki shakri kynthei jong ka san ngut ; ka la leit ryngkat bad ki shakri jyllang u Dabid bad ka la long ka tnga jong u .
translation.en: And Abigail hasted , and arose , and rode upon an ass , with five damsels of hers that went after her  ; and she went after the messengers of David , and became his wife .

translation.kha: Nga ai ïa ka jingnguh sha U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi , uba la ai ha nga ïa ka jingkhlaiñ na ka bynta ka kam jong nga . Nga ainguh ïa u ba la ñiew ïa nga uba bit bad la thung ïa nga ban shakri ïa u , wat la ha ka por ba la leit noh nga la kren sniew ïa u bad pynshitom beiñ bad krenbeiñ ïa u .
translation.en: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord , who hath enabled me , for that he counted me faithful , putting me into the ministry ;

translation.kha: bad u ai ïa ki ha u Amon bun ki khun shynrang jong u .
translation.en: According to the commandment of the  Lord  they were numbered by the hand of Moses , every one according to his service , and according to his burden : thus were they numbered of him , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Babilon la pynshitom namar ïa ka snam jngai ki nongïathuhlypa bad jong ki briew jong U Blei la shem hapoh ka nongbah ; ho-oid , ka snem jong kito baroh kiba la shah pynïap ha ka pyut .
translation.en: And in her was found the blood of prophets , and of saints , and of all that were slain upon the earth .

Seemeth it but a small thing unto you , that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel , to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the  Lord  , and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them ?
translation.kha: Phi tharai ba ka long kaei kaei kaba rit ba U Blei ki Israel u la pynkyrpang ïa phi na ka kynhun , ba phi lah ban leit sha u , ban leh ïa ka kamram jong phi ha ka Ïingjaiñ U  Trai  , bad ban ai jingshakri ïa ka kynhun bad ban shakri ïa ki ?

translation.en: Every man may see it  ; man may behold it afar off .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba u la leh ; hynrei ngi lah tang ban shu khmih na jngai .
Katno ka long kaba kordit ïa pa’ ki Moab ! Pi Ibbah Mane ïa u Khemosh , Phi la bit ! U blei jong phi u pynphetwir ïa ki shynrang , Bad ïa ki kynthei u pynlong ki mraw jong u syiem Leah .
translation.en: Woe to thee , Moab ! thou art undone , O people of Chemosh : he hath given his sons that escaped , and his daughters , into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites .

For thus saith the  Lord  concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place , and concerning their mothers that bare them , and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land  ;
translation.kha: Ngan ïathuh ïa me kaei ka ban jia ïa ki khynnah kiba la kha hangne bad ïa ki kmie ki kpa jong ki .
Hangta khah kata ka tnum nia ki jingthaw ki ïeng , uwei aiwai u pyiar ar tylli ki thapniang sha kiwei pat kiba hajan bad u bad tap pat ïa lade da ki ar tylli ki thapniang .
translation.en: And under the firmament were their wings straight , the one toward the other : every one had two , which covered on this side , and every one had two , which covered on that side , their bodies .

translation.kha: U pynïap ïa u jingri , ïa uba u ai kumto ka jingkñia halor uta u lum , bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki briew jong u ban ïabam . Ynda ki la lah bam , ki sahmiet halor uta u lat .
translation.en: Then Jacob offered sacrifice upon the mount , and called his brethren to eat bread : and they did eat bread , and tarried all night in the mount .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la nong , ïashoh ka pharshi ha ki Israel
translation.en: Son of man , put forth a riddle , and speak a parable unto the house of Israel  ;

translation.kha: Haba ki poi ha Sukkoth , u ong ha ki rangbah jong kata ka nongriam , Sngewbha ai ïa ki rangbah jong nga katto katne ki kper . Ki la thait ïan , bad nga dang baheh ïa u Sebah badno u Salmunna , ki syiem Midian .
translation.en: And he said unto the men of Succoth , Give , I pray you , loaves of bread unto the people that follow me  ; for they be faint , and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna , kings of Midian .

translation.kha: Neng ailad ïa ki nongwei ban lute ïa ki , ong U Trai , bad ki nongpynkheiñ aiñ kin shim noh ïa ka spah jong ki dara pyntngit ïa ka .
translation.en: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey , and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil  ; and they shall pollute it .

translation.kha: Ki jubab , Uba u briew u ïai kylli bniah shaphang jong ngi bad shaphang ki bahaïing ha-sem jong ngi , u da ong , ‘ I pa Jong phi i dang im ne em ? Phi dang khong Para shynrang shuh ?’ Ngi khep ban jubab ïa kita ki jingkylli . Kumno ngi lah ban tip ba un ong ïa ngi ïa-ban wan ïalam ïa u para Jong im ?
translation.en: And they said , The man asked us straitly of our state , and of our kindred , saying , Is your father yet alive ? have ye another brother ? and we told him according to the tenor of these words : could we certainly know that he would say , Bring your brother down ?

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei ki Israel , u la jied ïa nga mala ïa ki khun ki ksiew jongu nga ban synshar junom ïa ki Israel ; u la jied ïa ka jait Judah ban pynmih nongñiah , mala na ka jait Judah u la jied ïa ka ïing u kpa jong nga . Na borbah kata ka longïing ka long ka jingsngewbha jong u ban shim ïa nga malade ban pynlong ïa nga u shym hajir ki Israel baroh .
translation.en: Howbeit the  Lord  God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever : for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler  ; and of the house of Judah , the house of my father  ; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel :

translation.kha: kham hadien , na la phah ïa u Moses bad u Horon , bad nga la wallam ka jingjynjar bakhraw phalor ka Ieit .
translation.en: I sent Moses also and Aaron , and I plagued Egypt , according to that which I did among them : and afterward I brought you out .

translation.kha: Da kumne u Jesse u wan ïalam hynñiew ngut ki khur shynrang jong u sha u Samuel . bad u Samuel u ong ha u , Em , U Trai um shym la Jedidah ïadon ïano na kine .
translation.en: Again , Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel . And Samuel said unto Jesse , The  Lord  hath not chosen these .

translation.kha: Katai ka dei ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh Kaba la shong salm . U lyngdoh un pynbynta ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid . Ym da donkam ban pynkyrpang ïa u , naba u la long lypa u bymkhuid .
translation.en: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh , and the priest shall pronounce him unclean , and shall not shut him up : for he is unclean .

translation.kha: Ïa ki nongbah kiba mynta ki dap da ki briew yn pynjot , bad ïa ka ri yn pynkylla ri khlaw . Nangno te kin tip ba de long U Trei .
translation.en: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste , and the land shall be desolate  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Phi tip shaphang U Jisu suba na Nasareth bad kumno U blei u la theh halor jong u ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ïa ka bor . U la leit kylleng , u da leh ki kam babha bad u da pynkhiah ïa baroh kiba la longsyiem haduh ka bor jong u Ksuid , naba U Blei u la to lymne bad u .
translation.en: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power : who went about doing good , and healing all that were oppressed of the devil  ; for God was with him .

translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , ka sahmiet jong ka Sheba kan ïeng joit bad mudui ïa pa’ , namar ka la wang na la ka ri bajngai ban shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai bastad jong U Syiem Samson ; bad at pynthikna ïa phi ba don hangne uba khap khraw ban ïa u Solomon !
translation.en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it : for she came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon  ; and , behold , a greater than Solomon is here .

translation.kha: hynñiew u Joab u jubab ïa u syiem , Syiem Kynrad , to U Terah U Blei jong phi un pyniar ïa ki Israel shispah shah ban ïa kaba ki don mynta , bad to phin dang im ban ïuh ïa u ba u leh ïa kata . Hynrei balei keiñ u Shimham Kynrad u kwah ban leh ïa kane ?
translation.en: And Joab said unto the king , Now the  Lord  thy God add unto the people , how many soever they be , an hundredfold , and that the eyes of my lord the king may see it : but why doth my lord the king delight in this thing ?

translation.kha: Te u Samson u rwai , Da ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada , shihajar ngut nga pynpoh ; Da ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada , nga kynton ïa ki ha ki kynton .
translation.en: And Samson said , With the jawbone of an ass , heaps upon heaps , with the jaw of an ass have I slain a thousand men .
And they went up out of Egypt , and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father ,
translation.kha: Kumta ki ïamihnoh na Ijipt bad ki wan phai sha la u kpa ha Kanaan .
Ka don ka por kaba dei bad ka lynti kaba dei ba leh ïa kiei kiei , ishyrkhei ngi tip tang khyndiat eh !
translation.en: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment , therefore the misery of man is great upon him .

translation.kha: u la phan khot ïa u badno u ong , Nga la pynlong ïa me ban smam ha ka ktung jongki U Trai shun ym mihnoh na Jerusalem . Bad la la maham ïa me ba lada me leh kumno , Man ïap da shisha . Heth mem shym la mynjur ïa ka sad ong ba men kohnguh ïa nga ?
translation.en: And the king sent and called for Shimei , and said unto him , Did I not make thee to swear by the  Lord  , and protested unto thee , saying , Know for a certain , on the day thou goest out , and walkest abroad any whither , that thou shalt surely die ? and thou saidst unto me , The word that I have heard is good .

translation.kha: Hangta U Trai u la ong ha nga , To pynïoh ïa ki mawbah badno tep ïa ki ha ka sorki jong ka jingbynta ha khmat ka khyrdop sha ka ïing sorkar kaba don ha ka nongbah , bad to ai ba Katto katne ngut ki Israel kyang ïuh ïa me ba me leh ïa “kata .
translation.en: Take great stones in thine hand , and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln , which is at the entry of Pharaoh s house in Tahpanhes , in the sight of the men of Judah  ;
Behold , I have longed after thy precepts : quicken me in thy righteousness .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me ; to ai ha nga ka jingim bathymmai , namar me long uba hok .

translation.en: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free , and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage .
translation.kha: Ka jinglaitluid ka long kaei kaba ngi don — dei U Khrist u la pyllait ïa ngi ! Ïeng te , kum ki briew kiba laitluid , bad wat shah ïa lade ban long pat ki mraw .
To ïathuh ïa ngi , me donhok aïu Ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa ken ka hok ?
translation.en: And spake unto him , saying , Tell us , by what authority doest thou these things ? or who is he that gave thee this authority ?

translation.kha: U nongïalam uba bud u dei u Shamgar , u khun jongki u Anath . uno jin u la pyllait ïa ki Israel , bad u la leh kumta da kaba pynpyut hynriewspah ngut ki Philistia da u dieng ñiah masi .
translation.en: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath , which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad : and he also delivered Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei hajan u briew da kaba bitar u pynïap khnang ïa uwei bapaw , dei ban pynïap ïa u , wat la u wan ban rieh ha ka duwan jong de .
translation.en: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour , to slay him with guile  ; thou shalt take him from mine altar , that he may die .

translation.kha: Nalorkata u ong ha u Jether , u khun nyngkong jong u , Khie , pynïap ïa ki ! hynñiew uta u khynnah um shym seiñ ïa la ka waitlam . Um sngew nud , namar ba u dang long tang u khynnah .
translation.en: And he said unto Jether his firstborn , Up , and slay them . But the youth drew not his sword : for he feared , because he was yet a youth .
Ah Lord  God  ! behold , thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm , and there is nothing too hard for thee :
translation.kha: A  Trai  Nongsynshar , me la thaw ïa ka khyndew bad ka suiñbneng da ka bor bad ka borbah bakhraw ; ym don kaba eh than ïa me .

translation.en: Finally , my brethren , be strong in the Lord , and in the power of his might .
translation.kha: Ha kaba pynkut noh , to long kiba khlaiñ ha U Trai bad ha ka bor ka jingkhlaiñ jong u .
ïa ka miej bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka , ïa u diengpynïeng sharak ksiar malade ki tait ki tar jrong u baroh , ïa ka duwan ban thang jingbei ,
translation.en: And the table and his furniture , and the pure candlestick with all his furniture , and the altar of incense ,
And Jesus answered and said ,  Suffer ye thus far .  And he touched his ear , and healed him .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Keiñ noh kane !  U la ktah ïa ka shkor jong uta u briew bad u la pynkhiah ïa u .
Ki la ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong u pynlang ïa ka ri u Og u syiem Bashan , uwei pat u syier Amor suba shong sha mihngi na ka wah Jehohanan .
translation.en: And they possessed his land , and the land of Og king of Bashan , two kings of the Amorites , which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising  ;

translation.kha: Pynlong ïa ka Sabbaton ka sngi kaba khuid , ba kumta kan longïing ka dak jong ka jutang ba ngi la thaw , bad kan pynkynmaw ïa Phin ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong ph .
translation.en: And hallow my sabbaths  ; and they shall be a sign between me and you , that ye may know that I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka sngi jong ka jingap jong U Trai ; to ngin ïakyndit , to ing ïalehkmen !
translation.en: This is the day which the  Lord  hath made  ; we will rejoice and be glad in it .
