This is the water of Meribah  ; because the children of Israel strove with the  Lord  , and he was sanctified in them .
translation.kha: Kane ka jia ha Meribah , ha kaba ki Israel ki la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , bad ha kaba u la pynpaw ïa lade ba u long uba khuid .

translation.en: Joshua therefore commanded the priests , saying , Come ye up out of Jordan .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la leh kumta ,
Ki briew kiba sniew kin hap ban pyndem ha kiba hok bad kyrpad ryntih ïa ka jinglehisynei na ki .
translation.en: The evil bow before the good  ; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Joash u ong ha kito baroh kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa u , Hato phi ïingjaiñ na ka bynta u Baal ? Hato phi ïasaid da ïa u ? Uno Une uba ïadih na ka bynta jong u un shah pynïap ha shu ka step . Lada u Bah u dei u plie , ieh un ïadat hi ïa lade . Ka de ka duwan jong u ïa Kaba la pynkhyllem .
translation.en: And Joash said unto all that stood against him , Will ye plead for Baal ? will ye save him ? he that will plead for him , let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning : if he be a god , let him plead for himself , because one hath cast down his altar .

translation.kha: Dor ruh u Shimei , u khum jong u Gera , na ka shnong Bahurim kaweh ha Benjamin . U la tim tyngeh ïa nga ha ka sngi naba la leit sha Mahanaim , hynrei haba u la ïakynduh ïa nga ha ka wah Jordan , nga la ai ha u ka jingkular bakyntang ha ka kirteng jong U Trai ba ngan ym shah ban pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And , behold , thou hast with thee Shimei the son of Gera , a Benjamite of Bahurim , which cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim : but he came down to meet me at Jordan , and I sware to him by the  Lord  , saying , I will not put thee to death with the sword .

translation.kha: Lada Ngim shym la pyntud katne katjuh , ngim jingem da la wan phai kylla ar sien .
translation.en: For except we had lingered , surely now we had returned this second time .

translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ki la ïadoh hynriew jam , u Dabid u la phah ïa ki ban sangeh katba u dang ai ka jingkñia ïa U Trai da u malai bad u khun masi ba la pynsngaid .
translation.en: And it was so , that when they that bare the ark of the  Lord  had gone six paces , he sacrificed oxen and fatlings .

translation.kha: Ngan pynhiarkput na ka bynta kito kiba la shahskhor pynkup ; ngan ym map ïa kiba leh kam sniew . Hynrei ha Judah bad Jerusalem yn don ki nongshong shnong junom , bad ma por U Trai , ngan shongsah ha u lat Seïon .
translation.en: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed : for the  Lord  dwelleth in Zion .
They have gaped upon me with their mouth  ; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully  ; they have gathered themselves together against me .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ñiewbeiñ ïa nga ; ki ïalum sawdong ïa nga bad ki thap ïa nga .
Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongpynkhiah ka Hukum ki la sheptieng ïa u paidbah , bad kumta ki la pyrshang ban wad lad ban pynïap ïa U Jisu ha kabu jar jar .
translation.en: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him  ; for they feared the people .

translation.kha: La kha ïa nga shuwa ki lwa , ha shuwa ban pynïabynta ïa ki lute ,
translation.en: Before the mountains were settled , before the hills was I brought forth :
He was oppressed , and he was afflicted , yet he opened not his mouth : he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter , and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb , so he openeth not his mouth .
translation.kha: U la shah lehbeiñ sat , hynrei u la shah da kaba sngewrit ; um shym la kren shikyntien ruh . Kum i khunlangbrot ban sa shah pynïap , kum ka langbrot ka ban sa shah khih ïa la u shñiuh , um shym kren shikyntien ruh .

translation.en: There is a generation , O how lofty are their eyes ! and their eyelids are lifted up .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba pyrkhat ba ki long kiba bha palat — oh , katno ka jingbha ki pyrkhat ba ki long !
Haba ka la poi ha ïohnang , ka kiaw jong ka , ka kylli ïa ka , Ka long kumno , ko khun kynthei jong nga ? Ka Luhith ka ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u Boas u la leh na ka bynta jong ka .
translation.en: And when she came to her mother in law , she said , Who art thou , my daughter ? And she told her all that the man had done to her .
And the heat-parched ground will have become as a reedy pool , and the thirsty ground as springs of water .”—Isaiah 35 :1 , 6 , 7 .
translation.kha: U shyiap uba shit phyrnai un long ka pung , bad ka khyndew kaba thrang um kan long ki umpohliew . —Isaïah 35 :1 , 6 , 7 .
U Jonathan u la leit sha u hangta bad u la pynseisoh ïa u da ka jingpynthikna ïa ka jingïada jong U Blei ,
translation.en: And Jonathan Saul s son arose , and went to David into the wood , and strengthened his hand in God .

translation.kha: dawai pynlang la ka hynmen kynsai ne ka para kynsi .
translation.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother s wife : it is thy brother s nakedness .

translation.kha: A to ïaroh ïa U Trai ! Da ka dohnud jongngi nga baroh nur ainguh ïa U Trai ha ka jingïalang ki briew jong u .
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . I will praise the  Lord  with my whole heart , in the assembly of the upright , and in the congregation .

translation.kha: Hangne ni Uei uba shong basah marwei . Um don khun shynrang lymne u para , pynban u ïai ter , um ju sngewhun ïa ka spah kaba u don . Na ka bynta jongno ba u trei snoh haduh katta katta bad ba u khang ïa lade hi na kano kano ka jingsngewbiang ? Kane hima ka long ka bymmyntoi — bad ka lynti isangsot ban im .
translation.en: There is one alone , and there is not a second  ; yea , he hath neither child nor brother : yet is there no end of all his labour  ; neither is his eye satisfied with riches  ; neither saith he , For whom do I labour , and bereave my soul of good ? This is also vanity , yea , it is a sore travail .

translation.kha: Ki sngi jong ar ki matlah stet , ym don kawei na ki naba bha .
translation.en: Now my days are swifter than a post : they flee away , they see no good .

translation.kha: Haba nga wallam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki na Ijipt , nga la maham kyntang ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa nga , bad nga la ïaphai maham ïa ki briew tad haduh kaei ka sngi .
translation.en: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt , even unto this day , rising early and protesting , saying , Obey my voice .
For this cause the people also met him , for that they heard that he had done this miracle .
translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw balei ba u paidbah u la ïakynduh ïa U — namar ba ki la ïohsngew ba U la leh ïa kane ka kambah .
U Trai u Wan hiar ha u lynghoh bad u la ïeng bad u hangta , bad u la pynbna ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong u , U Trai .
translation.en: And the  Lord  descended in the cloud , and stood with him there , and proclaimed the name of the  Lord .

Baana the son of Ahilud  ; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo , and all Beth–shean , which is by Zarethan beneath Jezreel , from Beth–shean to Abel–meholah , even unto the place that is beyond Jokmeam :
translation.kha: U Baana , u khun jong u Ahilud : ki nongbah Taanakh , Megiddo , bad baroh ka thain hajan ka Beth Shan , hajan ka nongrit Sarethan , kaba shaphang shathie jong ka Jesreel , haduh ka nongbah Abel Meholah bad ka nongbah Jokmeam
U Trai u ong , Ka bneng ka long ka khoit jongnga nga bad ka khynwin ka longïng ka jingïuhkjat jong nga . Kaba kumno keiñ ka ïing men te ïa nga , bad kaba kumno ka jaka ba ngan shong ?
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The heaven is my throne , and the earth is my footstool : where is the house that ye build unto me ? and where is the place of my rest ?

translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la ong , Wat ïateh hano hano ba me la ïathuh ïa kane ha nga . Bad u la phah noh! ïa uta u samla .
translation.en: So the chief captain then let the young man depart , and charged him , See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me .

translation.kha: U la long uba khuid bad ibha bha , hynriewphew Phin la kyntait ïa u , bad pynban phi la kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban leh na ka bynta jong phi ban pyllait ïa u nongïapeiñ briew .
translation.en: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just , and desired a murderer to be granted unto you  ;

translation.kha: Ki la sngewlehrain shikynta ban leit phai sha ïing . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u phah Ktien sha ki ba ken sah ha Jerikho pynlang ban ym wan phai dat haduh ba ki ñiuhtmoh jong ki , ki da san biang .
translation.en: Then there went certain , and told David how the men were served . And he sent to meet them : for the men were greatly ashamed . And the king said , Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown , and then return .
Yet they say , The  Lord  shall not see , neither shall the God of Jacob regard it .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  U  Trai  um ym ïohi ïa ngi ; U Blei ki Israel um ithuh ei ei .

Bad u la ong ha nga , Wat leh kumne ! Na longkmie u Shakri ryngkat bad me lem bad ki nongïathuhlypa ki para lad me bad jong kito baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki ktung hapoh jong kane ka kitab . To mane ïa U Blang !
translation.en: Then saith he unto me , See thou do it not : for I am thy fellowservant , and of thy brethren the prophets , and of them which keep the sayings of this book : worship God .

translation.kha: Nga khiah ïa me don pynlong ka jingbymïaid ha ka kyrteng U Trai’ , U Blei jong ka Bneng bad ka khyndew , ba men ym lngaid ka tnga ïa u khun lad at na ki briew hangne ha ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And I will make thee swear by the  Lord  , the God of heaven , and the God of the earth , that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites , among whom I dwell :
And when he cometh home , he calleth together his friends and neighbours , saying unto them , Rejoice with me  ; for I have found my sheep which was lost .
translation.kha: Nangta u khot lang ïa ki paralok bad ïa ki paramarjan jong u bad u ong ha ki , ‘ Nga kmen haduh katta katta ba nga la shem ïa ka langbrot jong nga kaba la jah . To ngin ïalehkmen !’
Te ha ka jingjot jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U Trai , bad u pyllait ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .
translation.en: Then they cry unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he saveth them out of their distresses .

translation.kha: ( Kane ka la longsyiem ha shuwa banbeiñ set byndi ïa u Ïoannis . )
translation.en: For John was not yet cast into prison .
For he taught them as one having authority , and not as the scribes .
translation.kha: Um shym la long kum ki nonghikai Aiñ ; pynban , u la hikai da ka iktiar .

translation.en: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest :
translation.kha: Nalor katei , ka don ruh ka jingsmai ka jong U Blei . Ym shym la don ka jingsmai kaba kum kata haba la pynlong lyngdoh ïa kita kiwei pat .

translation.en: And Joseph nourished his father , and his brethren , and all his father s household , with bread , according to their families .
translation.kha: U Joseph u pyndap pynbiang jingbam ïa la u kpa , ïa la ki hynmen ki para , bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing u kpa jong u baroh katba ki ïadon , haduh kiba khynnah tam .
Kita ki rangbah synshar bad ki riewpawkhmat ka Jesreel ki la leh ïa kaei kob ka Jesebel ka la hukum .
translation.en: And the men of his city , even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city , did as Jezebel had sent unto them , and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them .

translation.kha: Ka jingim jong phi kan ba-don borabor ha ka jingmane . Synñia sngi phin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng , bad phiah sngew kum ban ïap ha kano ïano ka khyllipmat .
translation.en: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee  ; and thou shalt fear day and night , and shalt have none assurance of thy life :
And Joshua smote them from Kadesh–barnea even unto Gaza , and all the country of Goshen , even unto Gibeon .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh u Joshua ka ïalam ïa u naduh Kadesh Barnea ha ka phang shathie haduh Gasa hajan ka rud duriaw , kaba kynthup ïa baroh ki jaka ka ri Goshen haduh Gibeon ha ka phang bashatei .

translation.en: And she say to me , Both drink thou , and I will also draw for thy camels : let the same be the woman whom the  Lord  hath appointed out for my master s son .
translation.kha: Lada ka mynjur bad tyrwa ruh ban wanrah um ïa ki ut jong nga , to ai ba kata kan long kaba me la jied kum ka tnga ïa u khun jong u kynrad jong nga .’
Haba u Reuben u la ïohsngew ïa ki , u la pyrkhing banbeiñ pyllait im ïa u Joseph . To ngin ym pynïap ïa u , u ong .
translation.en: And Reuben heard it , and he delivered him out of their hands  ; and said , Let us not kill him .
And it came to pass , that the beggar died , and was carried by the angels into Abraham s bosom : the rich man also died , and was buried  ;
translation.kha: U briew uba duk u la ïap bad la bah da ki angel ban shong hajan u Abraham ha ka jingkhawai ha bneng . U riewspah u la ïap bad la tep ,
U Mikaïah u ïa-ong shuh : myntan sngap ïa kaei kaba U Trai u ong ! Nga ieh ïa U Trai ba u shong halor ka khet jong u ha bneng , jingkad bad baroh ki angel jong u kiba ïeng harud jong u .
translation.en: Again he said , Therefore hear the word of the  Lord   ; I saw the  Lord  sitting upon his throne , and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left .

translation.kha: U don Badonbor ïa ka jingsliang U Blei ; hynrei um shym pyrkhat ïa —kata da ka bor ba u dei ban ïapyrshang ban pynlong mar thang bad U Blei .
translation.en: Who , being in the form of God , thought it not robbery to be equal with God :
As they ministered to the Lord , and fasted , the Holy Ghost said , Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïashakri ïa U Trai bad shahjingit , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la ong ha ki ,  Pynkyrpang na ka bynta jong nga ïa u Barnabas bad u Saul , ban trei ïa ka kam sha kaba nga la khot ïa ki .

len pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem’ kamar nga la leh ïa ka Samaria , kumba nga la leh ïa u Ahab u syiem ka Israel bad ïa ki khwan ki ksiew jongngi u . Ngan pynpyngngad phasi ïa ka Jerusalem na ki briew jong ka kumba khuid ka pliang ba la ñiut bad pyndem pyllup ïa ka .
translation.en: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria , and the plummet of the house of Ahab : and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish , wiping it , and turning it upside down .
That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying ,
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane khnang ban pynurlong shisha ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kren lyngba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa :
U Jehu u khot lang ïa ki briew jong ka Samaria , mala u ong , U syiem Ahab u la shakri ïa u blei Babel khyndiat , hynrei nga ngan shakri ïa u kham bun .
translation.en: And Jehu gathered all the people together , and said unto them , Ahab served Baal a little  ; but Jehu shall serve him much .

translation.kha: U Loukas , u dohkha ba-ieit jong ngi , bad u Demas ki phah ki jingai khublei ïa phin .
translation.en: Luke , the beloved physician , and Demas , greet you .
And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed–edom in his house three months . And the  Lord  blessed the house of Obed–edom , and all that he had .
translation.kha: Ka don hangta haduh lai bnai , bad U  Trai  u kyrkhu ïa ka longïing u Obed Edom bad baroh kiei kiei kiba dei ki jong u .

Katba baroh ki dang ïa-peit , uto u briew u la ïeng joit , u la rah ïa la ka jingtynjuh , bad ma katkum hi u la leit noh . Baroh ki la sngewkynjah haduh katta katta bad ki la ïarep ïa U Blei , ki da ong , Ngim pat ju ïohi kum kane katei kaei !
translation.en: And immediately he arose , took up the bed , and went forth before them all  ; insomuch that they were all amazed , and glorified God , saying , We never saw it on this fashion .

translation.kha: bad kin phla , ‘ Ym dei ma ngi kiba pynïap ïa uto u briew , bad jingtem shngiam ïor ruh mano ba la kun ïa kata ka kam .
translation.en: And they shall answer and say , Our hands have not shed this blood , neither have our eyes seen it .

translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ka pyrda da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u saiwul kaba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rnong saw , bun la suh pynpur itynnat bha ha ka da ki trud ki Kherub .
translation.en: And he made a veil of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen : with cherubims made he it of cunning work .

translation.kha: La kyntiew ïa u sha ka liang khambun jong U Blei , U Kpa jong u , bad u la ïohpdiang na u ïa U Mynsiem bakhatduh , kumba u la lah kulai . Kaei kaba phi ïohi bad ïohsngew mynta ka longïing ka jingai sngewbha kaba u la ieh noh ha ngi .
translation.en: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted , and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost , he hath shed forth this , which ye now see and hear .

translation.kha: bad haba ki la tah ïa u khem u nongkhrong uba la ju shong ha ka Khyrdop Ba-itynnat , baroh ki la kyndit bad lyngngoh ïa kaei kaweh la lah jia ha u .
translation.en: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple : and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ïatyngkhuh ïa ki ba ma ngi ki nong Rom ngim ju mlien ban aiti ïa uno ine uba la shah kynnoh ha ka kam runar ha shuwa ba un ïakynduh ïa ki nongmudui jong u Markaboth mala ba u la ïoh ka lad Ban ïasaid da ïa lade pyrshah ïa ka jingkynnoh .
translation.en: To whom I answered , It is not the manner of the Romans to deliver any man to die , before that he which is accused have the accusers face to face , and have licence to answer for himself concerning the crime laid against him .

translation.kha: Lada u sdie jong phi u luin bad ‘Phim shym thaw pynpaw ïa u , phi hap ban trei kham tyngeh baneh pyndonkam ïa u . Ka long kaba kham don jingmut ban pynkhreh lypa .
translation.en: If the iron be blunt , and he do not whet the edge , then must he put to more strength : but wisdom is profitable to direct .

translation.kha: Nangta kita ki tnga kliar ki la wan lem Bad ki khun jong ki , bad ki shuh ;
translation.en: Then the handmaidens came near , they and their children , and they bowed themselves .

translation.kha: Baroh ki paid ka Judah ki la kmen namsop ki la pynbang ïa kane ka jutang da ka pangnud baroh . Ki shem sngewbha ha ka jingmane ïa U Trai’ , bad u pdiang ïa ki bad u ai ha ki ka jingsuk na ki liang baroh .
translation.en: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath : for they had sworn with all their heart , and sought him with their whole desire  ; and he was found of them : and the  Lord  gave them rest round about .
And Isaac came from the way of the well Lahai–roi  ; for he dwelt in the south country .
translation.kha: U Isaak u la wan sha ka ri khlaw jong  Ka Pukri jong uta Uba Im Uba Ïohi Ïa Nga  bad ba u sah ha ka bynta bashaphang shathie jong ka ri Kanaan .
Katto katne ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba la wang na Jerusalem ki ïa-ïoh , U don ïa u Beryl ha u ! U daym u ksuid rangbah umbiah ai ïa u ka bor ban beh nep ïa ki .
translation.en: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said , He hath Beelzebub , and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils .
And he found a new jawbone of an ass , and put forth his hand , and took it , and slew a thousand men therewith .
translation.kha: Nangta u lap kawei ka shyieng tyngam jong ka kada kaba dang shu ïap shen . U dem bad u tam ïa ka , bad da kata u pynïap shihajar ngut ki rangbah .

translation.en: And her father hear her vow , and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul , and her father shall hold his peace at her : then all her vows shall stand , and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand .
translation.kha: ka dei ban leh lut kumba ka la kular lymda u kpa jong ka u pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrshah haba u ïohsngew ïa kata .

translation.en: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast , and ye be disposed to go ; whatsoever is set before you , eat , asking no question for conscience sake .
translation.kha: Lada u bymngeit u khot bam sngewbha ïa phi bad phi mon ban leit , bam ïa kaei kaba la buh ha khmat jong phi , khlem kylli jingkylli ei ei namar ka jingïatiplem jong phi .

kyang sa ïathuh ïa kata ha ki briew kiba shong ha kane ka ri . Kino ki briew ki la lah ïohsngew ba me , A Trai , me don lem sad ngi , bad ba me paw ha kaba ïoh shai haba u lyoh jong me u Seneh halor jong ngi bad ba me leit ha shuwa jong ngi ha u riat lehhok mynsngi bad u rishot ding mynmiet .
translation.en: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land : for they have heard that thou  Lord  art among this people , that thou  Lord  art seen face to face , and that thy cloud standeth over them , and that thou goest before them , by day time in a pillar of a cloud , and in a pillar of fire by night .
And many nations shall be joined to the  Lord  in that day , and shall be my people : and I will dwell in the midst of thee , and thou shalt know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto thee .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por shibun ki jaitbynriew kin wan sha U  Trai  bad long ki briew jong u . Un shong un sah hapdeng jong phi , bad phin tip ba u la lah phah ïa nga sha phi .
Ym don mano mano ba lah ban ong ïa U Blei aïu un leh lane kynnoh ïa u ba u leh bymman .
translation.en: Who hath enjoined him his way ? or who can say , Thou hast wrought iniquity ?

translation.kha: U ba-ima ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ainguh ha ki jaka mane ba la neng bad u khroh pynbieit ïa ki tnat jong kiwei pat ki rangbah .
translation.en: And that doeth not any of those duties , but even hath eaten upon the mountains , and defiled his neighbour s wife ,

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Judas u la mih , U Jisu u la ong , mynta ïa ka burom U u U Briew la pynpoh ; mynta ïa ka burom U Blei la pynpaw lyngba u .
translation.en: Therefore , when he was gone out , Jesus said ,  Now is the Son of man glorified , and God is glorified in him .

translation.kha: Une uno kiba ïalap , u dei ban ïapli ïa ki khubor jong U Blei ; uno une uba shakri , u dei ban shakri da ka bor kaba U Blei u ai ïa u , khnang ba ha kai kiei baroh yn ai ïa ka jingïaroh sha U Blei da U Jisu Khrismas , ha umbiah ka burom bad ka bor ki long ki Jong u junom la junom , Amen .
translation.en: If any man speak , let him speak as the oracles of God  ; if any man minister , let him do it as of the ability which God giveth : that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ , to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .
And Nob , the city of the priests , smote he with the edge of the sword , both men and women , children and sucklings , and oxen , and asses , and sheep , with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: U Saul u la phah pynïap ïa baroh kiwei pat ki nongshong shnong ha Nob , ka nongbah jong ki lyngdoh : ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung , ki masi , ki kada , bad ki langbrot — ki la shah pynïap lut khoit .
Ngan tbeh ding ïa ka Ijipt , Bad ka Pelusium kan don ha ka jingbat . Ki kynroh jong ka Thebes kin pra , sad ka nongbah kan shlur da ka um .
translation.en: And I will set fire in Egypt : Sin shall have great pain , and No shall be rent asunder , and Memphis shall have distresses daily .

translation.kha: Haba kumta , phi dei ne phim de u syiem ? Ka Jesebel ka jubab , To khie joit na jingthiah , lehkmen bad to bam . Ngan pynïoh ha phi ïa ka bnai sohwaiñ u Naboth !
translation.en: And Jezebel his wife said unto him , Dost thou now govern the kingdom of Israel ? arise , and eat bread , and let thine heart be merry : I will give thee the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite .

translation.kha: Wat siew ïinglieng ïa kaba sniew da kaba sniew lane ïa ka jingtim da ka jingtim ; pynnep , to siew kylliang da ka jingkyrkhu , Naaman ka jingkynjah ka long katei kaba U Blei u la kular ban ai ïa phi mynba u la khot ïa phi .
translation.en: Not rendering evil for evil , or railing for railing : but contrariwise blessing  ; knowing that ye are thereunto called , that ye should inherit a blessing .

translation.kha: Khmut u kynrad u la ong ha u sharai , ‘ Kaei sien sha ki lyntait bah ha nadong bad sha ki lyngkot khim mala ïawer ïa ki briew don wan shapoh khnang ba ka ïing jong per kan dap .
translation.en: And the lord said unto the servant , Go out into the highways and hedges , and compel them to come in , that my house may be filled .
And they clothed him with purple , and platted a crown of thorns , and put it about his head ,
translation.kha: Ki la pynkup ïa ka jaiñkup basawbthuh ha U Jisu , ki la thaw ïa ka pansngiat na ki tnat ba don shiah , bad pynphong ïa ka ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: He moveth his tail like a cedar : the sinews of his stones are wrapped together .
translation.kha: U tdong jong u , u ïeng kum u dieng Kedar ; ki ksah ha ki khohwah jong u ki long kiba khlaiñ .
Ïa kata baher kaba ki bymman ki don la pynjot , bad ka ding ka thang duh ïa kano kano kaba dang sah .
translation.en: Whereas our substance is not cut down , but the remnant of them the fire consumeth .
For though I made you sorry with a letter , I do not repent , though I did repent : for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry , though it were but for a season .
translation.kha: Naba wat lada kata ka shithi jong nga ka la pynsngewsih ïa phi , nga te ngam sngewsih ba nga la thoh ïa ka . Ngan jin da la sngewsih haba nga la ïohi ba ka la pynsngewsih ïa phi shipor .
Kiwei patan ki mradkhlaw ki la shah knieh noh ka bor jong ki , hynñiew la shah ïa ki ban im shiphang .
translation.en: As concerning the rest of the beasts , they had their dominion taken away : yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time .

translation.kha: Ban im slem ka long ka bainong jongngi kiba hok ; u ñiuhlieh u long ka pyntong badonburom .
translation.en: The hoary head is a crown of glory , if it be found in the way of righteousness .
Then said I unto them , Cast ye away every man the abominations of his eyes , and defile not yourselves with the idols of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Nga la bthah ïa ki ban bret noh ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli kiba ki la ieit bad ban ym pynlong ïa lade ki bymkhuid da ki blei ba-thala jong ka Ijipt , namar ba nga , nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

U Elisha u phai dien , u la khmih da ka jingbitar ïa ki , bad u la tim ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U thri . Nangta ar tylli ki dngiem kynthei ki la wan mih na khlaw bad ki la patar lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki sawphew ar ngut ki khynnah shynrang .
translation.en: And he turned back , and looked on them , and cursed them in the name of the  Lord . And there came forth two she bears out of the wood , and tare forty and two children of them .
And he went from thence to mount Carmel , and from thence he returned to Samaria .
translation.kha: U Elisha u la nang leit sha u Lum Karmel , bad hadien u la leit phai sha Samaria .
Shen u Nongshun un ot ïa ki badno un ïuhroit ïa ki kum u kew ha ka jaka tylliat kew . Ma nga , U Trai bymdonbor Baroh , U Bel jong ki Israel , per la kren .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor , it is time to thresh her : yet a little while , and the time of her harvest shall come .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , Namar ba ïa iar ki nong Galilaïa la pynjop ha kata ka rukom , ithuh phi pyrkhat ba ka pynshisha ba ki la long ki nongpop kiba kham sniew ban ïa baroh kiwei pat ki nadong Galilaïa ?
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans , because they suffered such things ?
He that gathereth in summer is a wise son : but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame .
translation.kha: U briew uba sngewthuh u lum ïa ki soh ha ka aïom kaba biang ; ka long kaba jahburom ban thiah thai ha ka por ka aïom ot .
U dei U Trai u ban ïasam ïa ka ri hapdeng jong ki bad ai hapdeng jong ki ïa-ban ïa-ïoh bynta sam . Kin ja-um ha ka ri na kawei ka rta sha kaei pat , bad kan long ka jong ki jymphong .
translation.en: And he hath cast the lot for them , and his hand hath divided it unto them by line : they shall possess it for ever , from generation to generation shall they dwell therein .

translation.kha: U la long u nongïalam jong ki Israel shuh arphew lai sngi . Nangta u la ïap malade la tep ïa u ha Shamir .
translation.en: And he judged Israel twenty and three years , and died , and was buried in Shamir .

translation.kha: Ai ha kiwei , bad U Blei un ai ha phi . Da shisha , phin ïohpdiang ka jingithuh kaba dap biang , ka jingai babun , Kaba la thew ha ki kti jong phi — baroh kata kaba phi lai ban bat . Ka jingthew kob phi pyndonkam na ka bynta kiwei ka long kata kaba U Bela un pyndonkam ïa phi .
translation.en: Give , and it shall be given unto you  ; good measure , pressed down , and shaken together , and running over , shall men give into your bosom . For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again .
And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren , strong men , eighteen .
translation.kha: Ka longïing jong u Meshelemaïah ka pynmih khatphra ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit .
Long kiba pynbit bad phi pyn-i ba ph don ka jingtiengburom ïa U Trai ; long katba kynriang mala phi pyn-i ba phim ni ïa kata .
translation.en: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the  Lord  : but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u ïathuhlypa u saw sha u syier Ahab , bad u la jong , U Trai’ u ong , ‘ Wat sheptieng ïa katai ka kynhun swai kaba heh ! Ngan ai jingjop ïa me halor jong ka mynta ka sngaid , bad men ïoh tip ba nga dei U Trai .’
translation.en: And , behold , there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Hast thou seen all this great multitude ? behold , I will deliver it into thine hand this day  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .

And mine eye shall not spare , neither will I have pity : I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations that are in the midst of thee  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  that smiteth .
translation.kha: Ngan ym tyngkai ïa pha lane pyn-i kano kano ka jingisynei ïa pha . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kam ijli kiba pha la leh , kumta phan sa tip ba nga long U  Trai  , bad dei ma nga uba pynshitom ïa pha .
Ko khun u briew , u la ong , kyang ki briew ki la ai ïa ki dohnud jong ki ha ki thliew sad ki la shah ba ki bleithaw kin ïalam ïa ki sha ka pop . Hato ki pynkut ba ngan ai ha ki ka jubab ?
translation.en: Son of man , these men have set up their idols in their heart , and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face : should I be enquired of at all by them ?
Even so , Father : for so it seemed good in thy sight .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , Ko Kpa , kane ka la long kumno me la kwah ïa ka ba kan jia .

translation.en: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites , that dwelt in the mountain , and in the south , and in the valley .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , ki leit ban ïaleh ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong ha ka ri lum , ha ki trai ki lum , bad ha ka ri ryngkhiang kaba shaphang shathie .

translation.en: And now thou sayest , Go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here .
translation.kha: Bad mynta phi kwah ba ngan leit ïathuh ïa u ba phi don hangne ?
Bad shim kine ki ktung dud shiphew tylli sha u nongïalam rangbah . Wad jingtip kumno ki ingmane jong phi ki long bad wanrah ki ei ei ban pynjam ba phi la ïohi ïa ki bad ba ki koit ki khiah .
translation.en: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand , and look how thy brethren fare , and take their pledge .

translation.kha: Lada don uno uno uba skei shen , to ai ba un skhem ïa ki soh ba mih na kata . Lada phi pynkoit ïa u na ka jingjynjar shisien , phin sa hap kun biang .
translation.en: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment : for if thou deliver him , yet thou must do it again .
But now are they many members , yet but one body .
translation.kha: Kumba ka long , don shibun ki dkhot hynrei tang kawei ka met .
Bahok ki mrad , ki sim , bad ki dohkha kin im ha ka jingsheptieng ïa phi . La buh ïa ki hapoh ka bor jong phi .
translation.en: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth , and upon every fowl of the air , upon all that moveth upon the earth , and upon all the fishes of the sea  ; into your hand are they delivered .

translation.kha: hynne mynta ïa ka rukom ba U Blei u nguh ba ki briew ken long ka hok bad u hi , la pynap . kim ne jingïadei ei ei bad ka Hukum , wat la ka Hukum u Moses bad ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ai ka jingsakhi ïa ka .
translation.en: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested , being witnessed by the law and the prophets ;
Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples : and they are written for our admonition , upon whom the ends of the world are come .
translation.kha: Kine kiei kiei baroh ki la jia ha ki kum ki nuksa ïa kiwei pat , bad la thoh ïa kine kum ka jingmaham ïa ngi . Naba ngi im ha ka por ba kaba kut ka la jan poi .

Napdeng Jong ki la don ka kynïan kaba la shitom na ka jingpang mihsnam kaba jur la khat-ar snem ; ka la pynlut ïa baroh kaba ka don ha ki nongsumar , ishyrkhei ym don mano mano ba lai Ban pynkhiah ïa ka .
translation.en: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years , which had spent all her living upon physicians , neither could be healed of any ,

And the  Lord  said unto Moses , If her father had but spit in her face , should she not be ashamed seven days ? let her be shut out from the camp seven days , and after that let her be received in again .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Lada u kpa jong ka u bynthiew halor ka khmat jong ka , ka dei ban shah ïa ka jingjahburom hynñiew sngi . Kumta ieh kan shah khang shabar ka jaka sher dara shi taïew , bad hadien kata lah ban pynrung pat ïa ka .
jynreiñ ha shuwa ka sngi kaba khraw bad kob shyrkhei lad U Trai kan wan , ngan phah ha phi ïa u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: Behold , I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the  Lord  :

Say now to the rebellious house , Know ye not what these things mean ? tell them , Behold , the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem , and hath taken the king thereof , and the princes thereof , and led them with him to Babylon  ;
translation.kha: Kylli ïa kine kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah lada ki tip aïu ka pharshi ka mut . Ïathuh ïa ki ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan sha Jerusalem bad rah ïa u syiem bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u lem bad u sha Babilonia .

translation.en: And Moses did look upon all the work , and , behold , they had done it as the  Lord  had commanded , even so had they done it : and Moses blessed them .
translation.kha: U Moses u bishar bniah ïa ka kam baroh bad u ïohi ba ki la leh ïa ka kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Kumta u Moses u kyrkhu ïa ki .
bad ïa ki Hor ha ki lumbah jong ka Edom , bad ki thwet ïa ki ïaheh Elparan kaba harud ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: And the Horites in their mount Seir , unto El–paran , which is by the wilderness .

translation.kha: bad u la kup sha bapyllun ïa baroh ki jingtynjuh ha ka Thymmai bad ïingsyiem . Kumba U tharai u la pynthaba , u Nebukhadnessar u la pynpait ïa baher ki khiew ki pliang ksiar Kiba u syiem Solomon u la thaw na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ .
translation.en: And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house , and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the  Lord  , as the  Lord  had said .

translation.kha: Sngap batai ianga ka jingmad ba iahap tam jong ka kyndat .
translation.en: Will you please explain to me the exact meaning of the word ?

translation.kha: Ki sanphew ngut ki syiem Philistia ki leit sha ka bad ki ino , Khroh ïa u Samson ban ïakhot ha pha balui ba u long uba khlaiñbor bad kumno Ngin Lah ban jop ïa u , khum ïa u nabar pynlong ba un ym lah leh ei ei shuh . Uwei pa uwei na ngi un ai ïa pha mar shihajar shispah tylli ki sbai ayu .
translation.en: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her , and said unto her , Entice him , and see wherein his great strength lieth , and by what means we may prevail against him , that we may bind him to afflict him : and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver .

translation.kha: U leit sha ïing u kpa jong u ha Ophrah , bad hangta ha khleiñ jongnga uwei u maw u la pynnep ïa ki hynñiew ngut ki imon ki para shynrang jong u , ki khun shynrang jong u Gideon . Hynrei u Jehoram , u khun khat jongno u Eden , u la rieh bad um shym la shah pynïap .
translation.en: And he went unto his father s house at Ophrah , and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal , being threescore and ten persons , upon one stone : notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left  ; for he hid himself .
Sanctify the  Lord  of hosts himself  ; and let him be your fear , and let him be your dread .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga long uba khuid , nga long uta uba phi dei ban sheptieng .
ki bat ïa kaba paw bashabar jong ka Anam jong ki , hynrei kin kyntait ïa ka bor bashisha jong ka . To khiar noh na kiba kum kita ki briew .
translation.en: Having a form of godliness , but denying the power thereof : from such turn away .

translation.kha: ki brisoh jong ka Judah kin Anak ba ki la shaniah ha kata ka hima ka bym lah ban shaneng , ka ha-sem ka bym lah ba leh ei ei ïa ki haba ki Khmih lynti ban ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them , nor be an help nor profit , but a shame , and also a reproach .

translation.kha: Hobah ki la rung pat shahïap ïing , ki synran ki la kylli ïa U Jisu shaphang kane .
translation.en: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter .
Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt , and brought them into the wilderness .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga la ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt sha ka ri shyiap .

Ki rangbah kiba sah sha jngai bah kin wan bad ïahap ban tei pat ïa ka Templ jong U Trai . Bad hir la tei patiaw ïa ka , phin tip ba U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la phar ïa nga sha pa . Kane baroh kan jia lada ph Kohnguh lumrit ïa ki hukum jong U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the  Lord  , and ye shall know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto you . And this shall come to pass , if ye will diligently obey the voice of the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Pyndonkam jylliew ïa ki nongrim jong phi ha u , to tei ïa ka jingim jong phi halor jong u , bad to nang kham khlaiñ ha ka jingngeit jong phi , kumba la hikai ïa phiah . Bad to long kiba la pyndap da ka jingainguh .
translation.en: Rooted and built up in him , and stablished in the faith , as ye have been taught , abounding therein with thanksgiving .

translation.kha: Ki nongsiatkhnam kin ym lah ïeng ha la ki jaka ïeng , ki nongïam kiba stet kin ym lah lait , bad ki nongshong kulai kin ym lah ban pyllait ïa la ka jong ka jingrem .
translation.en: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow  ; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself : neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself .
And the children of Israel said to Samuel , Cease not to cry unto the  Lord  our God for us , that he will save us out of the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: bad ong ha u Samuel ,  To ïai duwai ha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Philistia .

translation.en: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian , Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us , as the ox licketh up the grass of the field . And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time .
translation.kha: Ki nong Moab ki ong ha ki nongïalam jong ki Midian ,  Kane ka kynhun shen kan sa pynjot ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba don sawdong jong ngi , kum u masi uba bam phlang ha ka pyntha phlang .
U Hanun u jam ïa ki nonglamktien jong u Sabad dara u khi ïa ki ñiuhtmoh jong ki , bad ot ïa ki jaiñphong jongno ki ha ki syngkai , bad phah neh ïa ki .
translation.en: Wherefore Hanun took David s servants , and shaved them , and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks , and sent them away .

translation.kha: Dei u Kaïaphas uba la ai jingjam ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba ka kham bha ba iwei u briew un ïa-ïap na ka bynta ka briew baroh .
translation.en: Now Caiaphas was he , which gave counsel to the Jews , that it was expedient that one man should die for the people .
Are not Abana and Pharpar , rivers of Damascus , better than all the waters of Israel ? may I not wash in them , and be clean ? So he turned and went away in a rage .
translation.kha: Nalor kata , hato ki wah Abana bad Pharpar kiba ha Damaskos kim kham bha ban ïa kano kano ka wah ha Israel ? nga lah ban sum ha ki bad ban ïohkhiah !

U Trai un wallam lang ïa barhem ki jingkheiñbriew ban ïalap tmoh ïa ka Jerusalem . Ïa ka nongbah yn sa shim noh , ïa ki ïing la lute , pynlang ïa ki kynthei la basboh . shongkhet na ki briew kin leit shaei ka jingshah jingsngew , hynñiew ïa kiba sah na ki yn ym shim noh na ka nongbet .
translation.en: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle  ; and the city shall be taken , and the houses rifled , and the women ravished  ; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity , and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city .
But ye should say , Why persecute we him , seeing the root of the matter is found in me ?
translation.kha: Kumno ngin pynshitom ïa u ?  Phi ap khmih ïa ka kabu ban tur ïaleh ïa nga ,
namsop u la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim , bad u la jan ïap na ka pyntha ka Kam U Khrist , khnang ba un ai ïa ang ka jingïapan , kiba ma phi da lade phim lai shun ai .
translation.en: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death , not regarding his life , to supply your lack of service toward me .

translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki pliang , ki khiew bad ki khuri ban pynbunkam ha ka jingkohnguh dih . Ïa kine baroh dei ban thaw da ka ksiar nylla .
translation.en: And thou shalt make the dishes thereof , and spoons thereof , and covers thereof , and bowls thereof , to cover withal : of pure gold shalt thou make them .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Absalom u ïatei ban khih ba u Dabid ha kob khatduh u la shah ïa u Amnon bad ïa kiwei pat ki khun shynrong jong u baroh ban leit bad u Absalom . U Apollos u la pynrieh ka jingkhawai kambah ïabiang ïa u syiem
translation.en: But Absalom pressed him , that he let Amnon and all the king s sons go with him .

translation.kha: ki Harod , ki Semar , pynlang ki Hamath . Ki jait bapher bapher jong ki jaitniam Kanaan ki la saphred kylleng kyllaiñ ,
translation.en: And the Arvadite , and the Zemarite , and the Hamathite : and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad .

translation.kha: Nga don shibun eh shun ïakhot ha pa’ , hynrei ngan ym leh ïa kata ha ka kot bad ka siasia ; pynban , nga kylli ban da wan jngoh ïa phi bad ïakren markhmat bad pa’ , ba ka jingkmen jong ngi kan ïoh long kaba dap pura .
translation.en: Having many things to write unto you , I would not write with paper and ink : but I trust to come unto you , and speak face to face , that our joy may be full .

translation.kha: Kynton kiba long ki mraw ki dei ban ñiew ba ki kynrad jong ki , ki long kiba dei hok ban ïoh ïa ka burom barabor , khnang ba yn ym don mano mano ki ba-bang krai sniew ïa ka kyrteng U Blei bad ïa ka jinghikai jong ngi .
translation.en: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour , that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed .

translation.kha: Ki Jeriel ki la shahjop ha ki rangbah jongu u Dabid ; ka long ka jingshahjop kaba sngewshyrkhei , ha kaweh la pynïap synreit hajar ngut ki rangbah ha Katai ka sngi .
translation.en: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David , and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men .
And the angel came in unto her , and said , Hail , thou that art highly favoured , the Lord is with thee : blessed art thou among women .
translation.kha: U angel u la wan sha ka bad u la ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad pha ! U Trai u long ryngkat bad pha bad u la kyrkhu eh ïa pha !

translation.en: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign  ; and there shall no sign be given unto it , but the sign of the prophet Jonas .  And he left them , and departed .
translation.kha: Katno kiba sniew bad ki bym don blei ki long ki briew jong kane ka juk ! Phi kyrpad na nga ïa ka kambah ? Em ! Ka kambah kaba yn ai ha phi ka long tang ka kambah jong u Jonah .  Kumta u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit noh .
jynreiñ wat u ksew ruh un ym wiar ïa ki Israel lane ïa ki jingri jingdih jong ki . Te men Tip ba la U Trai nga pynïapher khappud ki nongthain Ijipt bad ki Jerusalem .’
translation.en: But against any of the children of Israel shall not a dog move his tongue , against man or beast : that ye may know how that the  Lord  doth put a difference between the Egyptians and Israel .

translation.kha: Baroh kaba u bor ki dap da ka jingpyndonburom bad kaba iphieng ; ka khih jong u ka neh junom .
translation.en: His work is honourable and glorious : and his righteousness endureth for ever .

The father shall be divided against the son , and the son against the father  ; the mother against the daughter , and the daughter against the mother  ; the mother in law against her daughter in law , and the daughter in law against her mother in law .
translation.kha: Ki kpa ki long pyrshah ïa ki khun shynrang jong ki , bad ki khun shynrang pyrshah ïa ki kpa jong ki ; ki kmie kin long pyrshah ïa ki khun kynthei jong ki , bad ki khun kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kmie jong ki ; ki kiaw kurim kin long pyrshah ïa ki pyrsa kurim kynthei jong ki bad ki pyrsa kurim kynthei pyrshah ïa ki kiaw jong ki .

Ha katai ka sner u Eden bad ki rangbah jongno u baroh ki la khie dang step phlangïap bad ki la sher ayu harud ka Umpohliew Harod . Ki Midian patar ki sher dara shaïong shatei na ki , ha ka them kaba harud u Lum Moreh .
translation.en: Then Jerubbaal , who is Gideon , and all the people that were with him , rose up early , and pitched beside the well of Harod : so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them , by the hill of Moreh , in the valley .
And I will drive thee from thy station , and from thy state shall he pull thee down .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un weng noh ïa me na ka jaka treikam bad pynhiar ïa me na ka kyrdan kaba halor .
Pynmih dei don ong ïa to ïa kaei ba ngan leh , U jongu u la jubab . Ka per jongngi nga kam pat poi .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , what have I to do with thee ? mine hour is not yet come .

translation.kha: U Jehoash u la ïohkem ïa u Amasaïah bad u ïalum ïa u sha Jerusalem . Haneng u la pynkhyllem ïa ka kynroh nongbah naduh ka Khyrdop Ephraim haduh ka Khyrdop Dong , ka jingai kumba arspah mitar .
translation.en: And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah , the son of Joash , the son of Jehoahaz , at Beth–shemesh , and brought him to Jerusalem , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate , four hundred cubits .

translation.kha: Haba nga ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , nga shong bad na ïam . Bun sngew nga la sngewbang malu ngim shym bam .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when I heard these words , that I sat down and wept , and mourned certain days , and fasted , and prayed before the God of heaven ,

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , kaba dei ka sngi Sabteka , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ïakynduh ïa U Pilat
translation.en: Now the next day , that followed the day of the preparation , the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate ,
The prophet which prophesieth of peace , when the word of the prophet shall come to pass , then shall the prophet be known , that the  Lord  hath truly sent him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba ïathuh lypa ïa ka jingsuk lah ban ithuh ïa u kum u nongïathuhlypa uba U  Trai  u la phah shisha haba ki jingïathuhlypa jong uta u nongïathuhlypa kin urlong shisha .

translation.en: What is it then ? I will pray with the spirit , and I will pray with the understanding also : I will sing with the spirit , and I will sing with the understanding also .
translation.kha: Kaei ken kane ? Ngan duwai da ka mynsiem jong nga , hynrei ngan rwai ruh da ka jingmut jong nga ; ngan rwai da la ka mynsiem , hynrei ngan rwai ruh da ka jingmut jong nga .
Um shym la lah ïa-ban leh kino Phim ki ïabam hangta , lait noh tang kaba bah ïa ki kad jong u ha ki khyndiat ngut ki briew kiba pang bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki .
translation.en: And he could there do no mighty work , save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk , and healed them .

translation.kha: Ki jingkular jong U Blei lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki erlangthari na ka bynta jong phi , bad phin ïew bynta ha ka jyntang katba U Blei u la pynlong sad ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Kumba u la ong ha u Abraham , ‘ lyngngoh ki khun ki ksiew Jong me ngan kyrkhu ïa ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei .’
translation.en: Ye are the children of the prophets , and of the covenant which God made with our fathers , saying unto Abraham , And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed .

translation.kha: Ki nongïamareh kin wan da ki lieng na Sypros ; Kin jop ïa u Assyria bad u Eber , Hynrei ma ki shiah kin jah noh Jar .
translation.en: And ships shall come from the coast of Kittim , and shall afflict Asshur , and shall afflict Eber , and he also shall perish for ever .
Neither shalt thou go up by steps unto mine altar , that thy nakedness be not discovered thereon .
translation.kha: Wat shna ïa ka duwan kaba don ki kyrdon kiba kiew sha ka ; lada phi leh kumta , phi pynpaw khlem akor ïa lade haba phi kiew ïa ki .

myntor phin phah ïakhot ïa ki hima ri nongwei ; mynshuwa kim shym la tip ïa phi , hynmen mynta kin wan mareh ban ïashah bad phi ! Nga , U Trai U Bel jong phi , U Bel bakhlaiñ jong ki Jeruel , ngan pynjia ïa kane baroh ; ngan ai ha phi ïa ka burom malu jingdonburom .
translation.en: Behold , thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not , and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the  Lord  thy God , and for the Holy One of Israel  ; for he hath glorified thee .
But there came a man of God to him , saying , O king , let not the army of Israel go with thee  ; for the  Lord  is not with Israel , to wit , with all the children of Ephraim .
translation.kha: Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem bad u ong ha u ,  Wat shim ïa kine ki shipai Israel bad me . U  Trai  um don bad kine ki kynhun shipai kiba na ka Hima bashatei .
Ka pyrem kan ïam sngewsih ; ka sahit bneng kan sdang dum . U Trai u la krong bad un ym kylla ïa ka jingmut jongu u . U la pyningkhong ïa ka jingrai jyllang u bad un ym kylla dien .
translation.en: For this shall the earth mourn , and the heavens above be black : because I have spoken it , I have purposed it , and will not repent , neither will I turn back from it .
And when he looked behind him , he saw me , and called unto me . And I answered , Here am I .
translation.kha: Nangta u phai sawdong , u la ïohi ïa nga , bad u la khot ïa nga . Nga jubab , ‘ Ho-oid , Kynrad !’
Wat pat leit tat ynda nga wanrah ha me ka jingainguh bam . U jubab , Ngan ap haduh ba men da wan phan pat .
translation.en: Depart not hence , I pray thee , until I come unto thee , and bring forth my present , and set it before thee . And he said , I will tarry until thou come again .

translation.kha: Mar ïaskhem ha ka bor , u la pynïap ïa ki rangbah synshar kiba la pynïap ïa u kpa jong u .
translation.en: Now it came to pass , when the kingdom was established to him , that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father .
When I brake the five loaves among five thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ?  They say unto him , Twelve .
translation.kha: Hato phim kynmaw mynba nga la kdiah ïa ki san tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki san hajar ngut ki briew ? Katno tukri kiba da ki lyngkhot kpu kiba sah tam kiba phi la ïalum ?   Khat-ar ,  ki la jubab .

La pynngat ïa ki ïingjaiñ jong im’ ; ïa ki tyllun ba pynskhem ïa ki la pyndkut . Ki khun jong ngi ki la leit noh bhor ; ym don shuh mano mei ba dang sah ban pynïeng pud ïa ki ïingjaiñ jong ngi ; ym don shuh mano mano ban wah ïa ki pyrda jong ki .
translation.en: My tabernacle is spoiled , and all my cords are broken : my children are gone forth of me , and they are not : there is none to stretch forth my tent any more , and to set up my curtains .

translation.kha: Ka la shah ba kin pynïap ïa ki jingïar jong ka na ka bynta ka jingkwah , ka la khlem jingbeit ha ka waiñ , bad ka la pynkhreh ïa ka miej .
translation.en: She hath killed her beasts  ; she hath mingled her wine  ; she hath also furnished her table .

translation.kha: Katto katne nongput ki briew ki la wallam ha u ïa u briew uba khyllad bad u bymnang kren , bad ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban nguh ïa ki kti jong U phalor Jong u .
translation.en: And they bring unto him one that was deaf , and had an impediment in his speech  ; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him .

translation.kha: U Laban u leit rung shapoh ka ïingjaiñ jong u Jakob , nangta u sien sha ïingjaiñ jong ka Lehse , bad sha ka ïohnang jongnga kita ki ar jrut ki khraw kynthei , hynrei um shym lap ïa ki phai jong u . Nangta u saw rung sa ha ka ïingjaiñ jong ka Rakhel .
translation.en: And Laban went into Jacob s tent , and into Leah s tent , and into the two maidservants  tents  ; but he found them not . Then went he out of Leah s tent , and entered into Rachel s tent .

translation.kha: Ki nongsuhjaiñ batbit ki dei ban pyndonnam da u saiwul babha jngi , babha sawbthuh , nabar uba rong saw , u sei ksiar , bad da ka jaiñ linen bani .
translation.en: And they shall take gold , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen .

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ïateh ha ki ïa kan ka pharshi :
translation.en: And he spake this parable unto them , saying ,

They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them : they have made them a molten calf , and have worshipped it , and have sacrificed thereunto , and said , These be thy gods , O Israel , which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ki la da ïaid sakma noh na kata ka lynti ha kaba nga la hukum ïa ki ban ïaid ; ki la thaw ïa lade u khun masi ba la saiñ da ka ksiar bad ki la ïamane ïa u , bad ki la ai jingkñia ha u . Ki ïa-ong ba une u long u blei jong ki , uba la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt !

translation.en: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled , that thus it must be ?
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka long kumta , da kumno ki Jingthoh Bakhuid kiba ong ba kane ka long kaei kaba dei ban jia , kin jia long shisha ?

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ïa kiba nga hikai ïa phi , te phin ïoh im bad phin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba U  Trai  U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u ai ha phi .

translation.en: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about : all ye that bend the bow , shoot at her , spare no arrows : for she hath sinned against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko nongsiatkhnam , to ïeng ryntih na ka bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilon bad kerkut ïa ka . To siat ïa ki khnam jong phi baroh ïa ka Babilon , namar ka la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , U  Trai .

Leh kumba u Joab u ong , u Solomon u jubab . Pynïap ïa u mala ter ïa u . Nangta ym ma nga ne Mano mano na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid ki ban shah kynnoh shuh na ka bniat kaei kaba u Joab u la leh haba u la pynïap ïa ki rangbah kiba lui lui .
translation.en: And the king said unto him , Do as he hath said , and fall upon him , and bury him  ; that thou mayest take away the innocent blood , which Joab shed , from me , and from the house of my father .

translation.kha: Ka Gilead ka long ka nongbah ka dap da ki riewbymman bad ki nongpynïap briew .
translation.en: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity , and is polluted with blood .
And so terrible was the sight , that Moses said , I exceedingly fear and quake : )
translation.kha: Kaei kaba la ïohi ka long kaba sngewtriem katta katta ba u Moses u la ong ,  Nga la khynñiuh bad nga la sheptieng !

Kito kiba dei napdeng ki briew jong ngi kiba la ïap kin im biang ! Ki tat jong ki kin wan blei biang sha ka jingim . Baroh kito kiba ïohthiah ha ki jingtep jong ki kin kyndit Thiah malade kin rwai namar ka jingkmen . Kumba ka umjer baphyrnai ka pynthymmai bor ïa ka khyndew , kumta ruh U Trai un pynkhie im pat ïa kito kba la ïap la slem .
translation.en: Thy dead men shall live , together with my dead body shall they arise . Awake and sing , ye that dwell in dust : for thy dew is as the dew of herbs , and the earth shall cast out the dead .

translation.kha: Baroh shi miet nga kyang bad ka jingong , la kumba u sing u pynkheiñ ïa ki jingkieng jong sa . Ang pyrkhat ba U Blei u la pynkut ïa ka jingkem jong nga .
translation.en: I reckoned till morning , that , as a lion , so will he break all my bones : from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kabu ki dang ïasynran , kamet u la kylli ïa ki , Balei pa’ iakren shaphang ka jingbymdon kpu ? Hato phim pat tip lane sngewthuh ? Hato ki jingmut jong phi ki dang dum ?
translation.en: And when Jesus knew it , he saith unto them ,  Why reason ye , because ye have no bread ? perceive ye not yet , neither understand ? have ye your heart yet hardened ?
And he led them forth by the right way , that they might go to a city of habitation .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa ki na ka lynti kaba beit sha ka nongbah ha kaba ki lah ban shong ban sah .
Habor uno une u pan ei ei na phi , to ai ïa sier ha u ; haba uno uno u kwah ban pan kylliang ei ei na phi , to ai kylliang ïa u .
translation.en: Give to him that asketh thee , and from him that would borrow of thee turn not thou away .

translation.kha: Kaba khmih ïa ki khmat jong phi , ko ba-ieit thep mynsaw bad ko nongrim jong nga , bad u jingdeng ryndang ba phi deng ka la tuh ïa ka dohnud lad at .
translation.en: What is thy beloved more than another beloved , O thou fairest among women ? what is thy beloved more than another beloved , that thou dost so charge us ?
How do ye say , We are wise , and the law of the  Lord  is with us ? Lo , certainly in vain made he it  ; the pen of the scribes is in vain .
translation.kha: Kumno phi lah ban ong ba phi long kiba stad , bad ba phi tip ïa ki aiñ jong nga ? Ha khmih , ïa ki aiñ la pynkylla da ki nongthoh bymhok .

translation.en: And their father said unto them , What way went he ? For his sons had seen what way the man of God went , which came from Judah .
translation.kha: Na kano ka lynti u leit phai ?  u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u kylli ïa ki .

U Syiem Ahas u pynkynriah ïa ka Makkedah ka kmierad jong u na ka kyrdan kum ka syiemsad , namar ka la thaw ka bleithaw kynsha jong ka Asherah ka blei jingseisoh . U Asa u pynpaw ïa ka bleithaw , u pyndkut ïa ka , bad u thang ïa ki lyngkhot ha ka dem Kidron .
translation.en: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king , he removed her from being queen , because she had made an idol in a grove : and Asa cut down her idol , and stamped it , and burnt it at the brook Kidron .
And he arose from thence , and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan : and the people resort unto him again  ; and , as he was wont , he taught them again .
translation.kha: Nangta , U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , u la leit sha ka probins    jong ka Judia , bad u la jam sha shiliang ka wah Jordan . Ki paidbah ki la ïalum biang ha u , bad u la hikai ïa ki , kumba u ju leh .
Ka jingkhaïi ba-thaba ka la ïaid lyngngai ïa ka khyrdop bashaphang mihngi bad rung bashapoh ka Templ .
translation.en: And the glory of the  Lord  came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ba ka don kaei kaei hangne kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka Tabor .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That in this place is one greater than the temple .

translation.kha: Hato dei u Joab uba la ai pur ïa pha ha kane bhor ? u la kylli ïa ka . Ka Jubab , Nga smai da kata baroh kob kyntang , ko Syiem Kynrad , ba ym don kano kano ka lad ban kiar na kaba jingbabe ïa ka jingkylli jong ph . Ka dei kaba shisha ba u Jehubbah , u lapbah pynïaidkam jong phi uba la bthah ïa at ïa Kiei ngan leh bad ïa kiei ngan kren-ïa .
translation.en: And the king said , Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this ? And the woman answered and said , As thy soul liveth , my lord the king , none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken : for thy servant Joab , he bade me , and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid :
My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh , and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth .
translation.kha: Ka sniehdoh jong nga kam ïadait bha shuh bad ki shyieng ; nga la shu lait im da ka said .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity , in the tenth month , in the fifth day of the month , that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me , saying , The city is smitten .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba shiphew jong ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jinglongmraw jong ngi , uwei u briew uba la lait im na Jerusalem , u la wan sha nga bad u la ïathuh ha nga ba ka nongbah ka la kyllon .
La u Abraham u la ïap shisha , na une uwei u briew , la mih bun kiba hiarpateng kat ki khlur ha ka shata bneng , katne u shyiap bymlah ñiut shuh harud duriaw .
translation.en: Therefore sprang there even of one , and him as good as dead , so many as the stars of the sky in multitude , and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki rangbah jyllang u Dabid u la ïohi ïa u bad u la ïathuh ha u Hobab , Kyntait , nga la ïohi ïa u Absalom ba u siaw ha u dieng Sning !
translation.en: And a certain man saw it , and told Joab , and said , Behold , I saw Absalom hanged in an oak .

translation.kha: U la kynnoh pynban ïa ka da kaba ong ba kam long shuh kaba sotti haba u sngewjahburom ïa ka . Hynrei kine ki long ki dak jong ka jinglong sotti ka khun jong nga ; khmih ïa ki jingtamsneng ha ka jingïathuhkhana jingjahburom !’
translation.en: And , lo , he hath given occasions of speech against her , saying , I found not thy daughter a maid  ; and yet these are the tokens of my daughter s virginity . And they shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city .

translation.kha: Uno Une uba bam ïa ka un ngat ha ka jingpynrem ba u kheiñ dew thala ïa kaba la pynkyntang sha nga , bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jongno nga .
translation.en: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity , because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the  Lord  : and that soul shall be cut off from among his people .
Hilkiah the second , Tebaliah the third , Zechariah the fourth : all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen .
translation.kha: U Hilkaïah , u Tebalaïah , bad u Sekharaïah . Ha baroh ki ïadon khatlai ngut ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong u Hosah kiba dei ki nongap phira ïa ka Templ .
lane banbeiñ ïano ïano lane lute ïano ïawan . U pynphai ïa kaei kaba u nongshim ram u ai ha u kum ka bynda . U bsa ïa kiba thngan bad u ai jaiñ ïa kiba lyngkhuit .
translation.en: Neither hath oppressed any , hath not withholden the pledge , neither hath spoiled by violence , but hath given his bread to the hungry , and hath covered the naked with a garment ,

translation.kha: U la ïoh ïa ka jingsngewma jong U Blei , bad u la kyrpad ïa U Blei ban shah ïa u ban pynkhreh ka ïing na ka bynta U Blei jong u Jakob .
translation.en: Who found favour before God , and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob .
And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice  ; it is because the thing is established by God , and God will shortly bring it to pass .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaiban ïa ka jingphohsniew jong phi ka mut ba ïa kane la pynskhem da U Blei bad ba un pynurlong shen ïa ka .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came unto me again , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga
Mynta , ko Job , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; long jar jar bad shah ba ngan kren .
translation.en: Mark well , O Job , hearken unto me : hold thy peace , and I will speak .

translation.kha: Ai ba baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong U Trai ! U shu hukum , bad ïa ki la pynlong ;
translation.en: Let them praise the name of the  Lord  : for he commanded , and they were created .

translation.kha: Shimei ïa ki ha ki khun ki kti jong phiah . Ïalap shaphang jong ki haba phi don ha ïing bad haba phi ïaid ha lynti , haba phi shongthait bad haba phi triang phi khie .
translation.en: And ye shall teach them your children , speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house , and when thou walkest by the way , when thou liest down , and when thou risest up .
And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim , even unto Gaza , the Caphtorims , which came forth out of Caphtor , destroyed them , and dwelt in their stead . )
translation.kha: Ka jaka harud ka Duriaw Mediterranian ka long kaba shong da ki Kaphtorim kiba wan na ka dewlynnong Krit . Kine ki la pynjot ïa ki Abbim kiba dei ki trai jaka , bad ki knieh lut ïa ka ri jong ki haduh ka shnong Gasa kaba shaphang shathie . )

translation.en: Great is our Lord , and of great power : his understanding is infinite .
translation.kha: Uba khraw bad uba donbor long U  Trai  jong ngi ; ïa ka jingstad jong u ym lah ban thew .
Haba u briew uba duk u kren , u hap kyrpad donakor , hynrei haba u briew uba riewspah u jubab , u kren khor .
translation.en: The poor useth entreaties  ; but the rich answereth roughly .

translation.kha: Ki ïalehkmen para ma ki , kumta ki ong Khot ïa u Samson , bad ngin phah ïa u shun pynïabiang ïa ine ! Haba ki la wallam ïa u Samson na ka byndi , ki phah ba un pynbyrngia ïa ki pynlang ki pynïeng ïa u hapdeng ki rishot . Haba ki briew ki la ïohi ïa u , ki rwai ïaroh sha u blei jong ki : U blei jongngi ngi u la ai ha i'u ka jingjop halor u nongshun jong i , uba la pynjot ïa ka ri jrong ngi bad uba la pynïap shibun na ngi !
translation.en: And it came to pass , when their hearts were merry , that they said , Call for Samson , that he may make us sport . And they called for Samson out of the prison house  ; and he made them sport : and they set him between the pillars .
Son of man , thou dwellest in the midst of a rebellious house , which have eyes to see , and see not  ; they have ears to hear , and hear not : for they are a rebellious house .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  me im hapdeng ki briew kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah . Ki don ki khmat , hynrei kim ïohi ei ei ; ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim ïohsngew ei ei , namar ki long kiba ïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: 20 When Will Paradise Come ?
translation.kha: 20 Lano ka Paradais Kan Wan ?

Wat nym duh noh ïa ka jingsuhsieng ne sheptieng namar ki khubor lamler ba phi ïohsngew . Man ka snem ki khubor lamler bapher ki phriang — ki khubor Lamekh shang ka jinglehbor ha ka ri bad ba uwei u syiem u ïabah ïa uwei pud .
translation.en: And lest your heart faint , and ye fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land  ; a rumour shall both come one year , and after that in another year shall come a rumour , and violence in the land , ruler against ruler .
Give them sorrow of heart , thy curse unto them .
translation.kha: to tim ïa ki bad pyndap ïa ki da ka jingduh jingkyrmen !
Kiba hok ki ïohi ïa kane bad ki kilomitar , hynñiew ïa baroh kiba bymman la pynsngap jar .
translation.en: The righteous shall see it , and rejoice : and all iniquity shall stop her mouth .
Women received their dead raised to life again : and others were tortured , not accepting deliverance  ; that they might obtain a better resurrection :
translation.kha: Da ka jingngeit , ki kynthei ki la ïohpdiang ïa ki ba-ha-ïing kiba la ïap ïa kiba la pynim pat . Kiwei pat , kiba kyntait ban pdiang ïa ka jinglaitluid , ki la ïap ha ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ khnang ba yn pynmihpat sha ka jingim kaba kham bha .

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I also will ask you one thing , which if ye tell me , I in like wise will tell you by what authority I do these things .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ngan kylli ïa phi tang kawei ka jingkylli , bad lada phi ai ha nga ka jubab , ngan ïathuh ha phi da ka bor aïu nga don ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei .
U Dabid u khun jong u Jesse u synshar sawphew snem halor ki Israel baroh .
translation.en: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel .
The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep . Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread , as I commanded thee , in the time of the month Abib : for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Kumba nga la hukum ïa phi , bam ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat hynñiew sngi lynter ha u bnai Abib , namar dei ha uta u bnai ba phi la mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt .

Kumta u Ahab u khot ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kumba sawspah jrut na ki , bad u kylli ïa ki , Hato ngan leit ne em Ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ? Tur ïaleh ïa ka , ki jyllop , U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingtip .
translation.en: Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together , about four hundred men , and said unto them , Shall I go against Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And they said , Go up  ; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king .

translation.kha: Ka Rebekka ka ong ha u Isaak , Nga la sngewsynei bad sngewlwait ïa ki tngaw nongwei jngai u Iso . Lada u Jakob ruh u shongkurim ïa kawei na kyang ki nong Hit , nga lah ban sa shu ïap noh ruh .
translation.en: And Rebekah said to Isaac , I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth : if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth , such as these which are of the daughters of the land , what good shall my life do me ?

translation.kha: hynrei haba ka la wan ha u Isaiah ka la nguh badno ha khmat jong u bad ka la bat ïa ki khiat jong u . U Gasa u la mluh sa ban khynñiat ïa ka sharud , hynrei u Elisha u ong , Wat pynwit ïa ka . Mem ïohi ba ka khuslai jur ? Susah U Trai um shitrhem ïathuh ei ei shaphang kata .
translation.en: And when she came to the man of God to the hill , she caught him by the feet : but Gehazi came near to thrust her away . And the man of God said , Let her alone  ; for her soul is vexed within her : and the  Lord  hath hid it from me , and hath not told me .

translation.kha: Nangta nga ong , kadei kaba phoi ar ka long kaba bakla ! Phi dei banbeiñ kohnguh ïa U Blei bad leh ïa kaei kaba daiñ , khnang ba Phon ym pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong ngi , ki jingïatylli , ïa kano kano ka daw ba kin krenbeiñ ïa ngi .
translation.en: Also I said , It is not good that ye do : ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies ?

translation.kha: Ki rkhiang shynrang jong nga kin nym ong lano lano ïa kaba Sniew , u tyllai jong ang un ym kren ïa kaba shukor lano lano mad .
translation.en: My lips shall not speak wickedness , nor my tongue utter deceit .
This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families , these cities with their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Dan ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

Haba U Troas u ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri jingpeit ba-bang pynap ïa ki nong Ijipt , un ïohi ïa ka sner ha u bymneh nabar ha ki shawkad bad un ym shah ïa u Angel jong ka Jingïap ban rang shapoh ki ïing jong phi bad pynïap ïa phi .
translation.en: For the  Lord  will pass through to smite the Egyptians  ; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel , and on the two side posts , the  Lord  will pass over the door , and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you .

translation.kha: Ki ar ngut ki syiem maïan , u Sebah bad u Salmunna , ki jaijai ïalap , hynrei u beh khongdong ïa ki malu u ïohkem ïa ki , bad u pynkulmar thnum ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ki baroh kaweh .
translation.en: And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled , he pursued after them , and took the two kings of Midian , Zebah and Zalmunna , and discomfited all the host .

translation.kha: bad ka khyndew kan pynmih ïa u kew , pynlang ki shoiñ , bad ki soh Olib .
translation.en: And the earth shall hear the corn , and the wine , and the oil  ; and they shall hear Jezreel .

translation.kha: Me ai ha u ïa ka jingjahthait na ki sngaid ka jingjynjar haduh pun da tih ïa ka thliew ban nangto u bymman .
translation.en: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity , until the pit be digged for the wicked .
And the passover , a feast of the Jews , was nigh .
translation.kha: Ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ka la jan .

Ïa kiba na ka jaiñ Reuben , ka don ka shnong Beser ha kawei ka madan kaba ba-halor lum ha ka ri shyiap ; ïa kiba na ka jait Gad , ka ei ka Ramoth ha ri Gilead ; bad ïa kiba na ka jaiñjot Manasseh , ka dat ka Golan ha ri Bashan .
translation.en: Namely , Bezer in the wilderness , in the plain country , of the Reubenites  ; and Ramoth in Gilead , of the Gadites  ; and Golan in Bashan , of the Manassites .
And when he rose up from prayer , and was come to his disciples , he found them sleeping for sorrow ,
translation.kha: Haba u la ïeng joit na ka jingduwai jong u , u la leit pat sha ki synran bad u la shem ïa ki ba ki ïohthiah , kiba la shoh lwait da ka jingsngewsih jong ki .

translation.en: And he put the wood in order , and cut the bullock in pieces , and laid him on the wood , and said , Fill four barrels with water , and pour it on the burnt sacrifice , and on the wood .
translation.kha: Nangta u buh ïa ki diengthang halor ka duwan , u ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa u masi dab bad buh halor ki diengthang . U ong ,  Pyndap saw tylli ki khiew da ka um bad theh ïa ka um halor ka jingkñia bad ki dieng ,
bad ki nongsynshar jong phi ki la pyntngit ïa ka jingpynkyntang jong nga . Kut na la ïalamwir ka jingpynjot ha Israel ; nga shahïap ïa ki briew jong nga ban shah rkhiebeiñ .
translation.en: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary , and have given Jacob to the curse , and Israel to reproaches .
And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead . As for Saul , he was yet in Gilgal , and all the people followed him trembling .
translation.kha: kiwei pat ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan sha ki ri Gad bad Gilead . U Saul u dang don ha Gilgal , bad ki briew kiba bad u ki la khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

Kane ka dei kaei kaba U Trai u ong shaphang ka Ammon : Shano ki rangbah ka Israel ? Hattush ym don mano mano baneh ïada ïa la ka ri ? Balei ba ki shah ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u Molekh kin shim ïa ki jaka jong ka jait Gad bad shongduh hangta ?
translation.en: Concerning the Ammonites , thus saith the  Lord   ; Hath Israel no sons ? hath he no heir ? why then doth their king inherit Gad , and his people dwell in his cities ?

translation.kha: Na ka bakwah jongno ka jait Naphtali ki la ïohpdiang lai tukri ki nongbah : ka Kedesh ha Galilaïa , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ka ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , ka Hammoth Dor , bad ka Kartan , lem Bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali , Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Hammoth–dor with her suburbs , and Kartan with her suburbs  ; three cities .
A new commandment I give unto you , That ye love one another  ; as I have loved you , that ye also love one another .
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga ai ha phi ka hukum kaba thymmai ; to ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei .

Ko parabangeit jngai ngi , kyntur kiei kiei kiba la Jia ha phi ki la jia ha ki balang jongu U Blei ha Judia , ha ki briew hangta kiba long ki jong U Khrist Jisu . Phi la shah ïa kijuh ki jingpynshitom beiñ na ki briew ki per ri jong phiah hi kiba ki la shahshitom na ki Jiw ,
translation.en: For ye , brethren , became followers of the churches of God which in Judaea are in Christ Jesus : for ye also have suffered like things of your own countrymen , even as they have of the Jews :

translation.kha: Kut ki Dan ki jied San ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit na baroh’ ki longïing ha ka jait Bad ki phah ïa ki na ki Shong Sorah pynlang Isshaïah ryngkat Bad ki jingïathuh ba kin loit syntiat ïa ka ri . Ynda ki pa ha ri lum Ephraim , ki sah ha ïing u Mikah .
translation.en: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts , men of valour , from Zorah , and from Eshtaol , to spy out the land , and to search it  ; and they said unto them , Go , search the land : who when they came to mount Ephraim , to the house of Micah , they lodged there .

translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa kito kiba kyrkhoit ïa me , Hynrei ngan tim ïa kito katba tim ïa me . Bun da me tun kyrkhu ïa ki jingïapthngan baroh .
translation.en: And I will bless them that bless thee , and curse him that curseth thee : and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed .

translation.kha: dien bhor ki jinglah ban shakri kiba ïapher , hynrei ujuh U Blei uba pynlah ïa baroh na ka bynta ka jingshakri bakyrpang jong ki .
translation.en: And there are diversities of operations , but it is the same God which worketh all in all .

translation.kha: Lada wat hajan kat kane phim ba-thurmur satia don shahshkor ïa nga , len pynshitom jur ïa phi sa hynñiew shah .
translation.en: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me , then I will punish you seven times more for your sins .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ïa u angel ban buh noh sharud ïa ka waitlam jong u , bad u angel u kohnguh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  commanded the angel  ; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof .

translation.kha: Ïa du ine u nongbah lyngkhot la thung ban ai ki jingainguh malu ki jingkñia da ki mrad sha U Blei , bad kamet U Rangbah lyngkhuh jong ngi u dei shiah ban khong ei ei ban ainguh .
translation.en: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices : wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer .

translation.kha: Lada kata ka dak ka pur , u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid ; u la bit jingtap .
translation.en: And if it spread much abroad in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a plague .

translation.kha: Ki khatwei ngut ki syndon ki la leit sha u lumrit ha Galilaïa ha kaba U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ban leit .
translation.en: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee , into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them .
And Jonathan said unto David , Come , and let us go out into the field . And they went out both of them into the field .
translation.kha: Ïa ngin ïaleit sha ki bri ,  u Jonathan u jubab . Kumta ki ïaleit lang .

Mar kumta , u khot kyrkieh ïa u meeting uba bah ïa ki atiar ïaleh jong u , bad u lawbah ïa u , Sei ïa la ka waitlam bad pynïap ïa nga . Ngam kwah ba yn ong ba ka kynoi ka la pynïap ïa nga . Kumta u jingkup u dung lyngba ïa u , bad u la ïap .
translation.en: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer , and said unto him , Draw thy sword , and slay me , that men say not of me , A woman slew him . And his young man thrust him through , and he died .

translation.kha: Ha Taanakh , harud ka wahduid jong ka Middin , Ki Syiem ki la wan bad ïaleh ; Ki syiem Kanaan ki la ïaleh , Hynrei kim shyiap ïoh rah ïa kano Kane ka saw .
