translation.en: The kings came and fought , then fought the kings of Canaan in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo  ; they took no gain of money .

translation.kha: kumno u thang jingkñia da ki nard bad ki jingainguh bam , bad u theh ïa ka jingainguh wai bad ka snam lad ka jingainguh ïasyllok ha ka .
translation.en: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering , and poured his drink offering , and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings , upon the altar .

translation.kha: Na pha , ko nongbeh , la wan u briew’ uba dap da ki jingpyrkhat bymman , uba la ïasylla pyrda ïa U Tiras .
translation.en: There is one come out of thee , that imagineth evil against the  Lord  , a wicked counsellor .

translation.kha: Ki masi bad ki blang jongno nga ki la ai shibun ka bud , Bad ki diengkhap Olib ki la sa ha ki khyndew lad ki jaka mut .
translation.en: When I washed my steps with butter , and the rock poured me out rivers of oil  ;
And he went down , and talked with the woman  ; and she pleased Samson well .
translation.kha: Nangta u leit ïakren bad kata ka kynthei , bad u la itynnat ïa ka .

translation.en: And the king said unto him , Where is he ? And Ziba said unto the king , Behold , he is in the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , in Lo–debar .
translation.kha: Ha-ei u don ?  u syiem u kylli .  Ha ïing u Makhir , u khun jong u Ammiel , ha Lodebar ,  u Siba u jubab .
Namar ba Pha lute bad pynïap ïa la ki bymneh ki para shynrang , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , ïa phar yn pynjot Bad pynjahburom junom .
translation.en: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee , and thou shalt be cut off for ever .

translation.kha: U Troas u ong , Ko Babilon , to hiar noh na ka khet jongnga pham , bad sheng ha u pui pui halor ka khyndew . Shisien phar la long kum katba sotti , ka nongbah bym pat shahjop , hynrei Pham hir shuh kaba jem bad ba long jait jai ! Mynta pha long ka mraw !
translation.en: Come down , and sit in the dust , O virgin daughter of Babylon , sit on the ground : there is no throne , O daughter of the Chaldeans : for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate .

translation.kha: Kito kaba Dang sah napdeng ki jaitbynriew Kin longsem kum u sing kaba ïawad jingbang ha ka khlieh ne ha ka jaka ïam phyllung : U bang hapdeng ki langbrot , u kynhun ïa ki , sad tat lyngkhot ïa ki — bad hangto ym don jingkyrmen ban lehse im .
translation.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest , as a young lion among the flocks of sheep : who , if he go through , both treadeth down , and teareth in pieces , and none can deliver .
But Jesus called them unto him , and said ,  Suffer little children to come unto me , and forbid them not : for of such is the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: hynrei , U Jisu u la khot ïa ki khynnah sha u bad u la ong ,  Shah ïa ki khynnah ban wan sha nga bad wat khang ïa ki , namar ka Hima U Blei ka long ïa kiba kum kine .

Ngim shym la shahshkor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jongngi me , kiba la kruiñ ha ka kyrteng jongnga me sha ki syiem lad ngi , ki nongsynshar jong ngi , ki kpa thnum jongngi ngi , bad ka jyrthiaw jong ngi baroh kawei .
translation.en: Neither have we hearkened unto thy servants the prophets , which spake in thy name to our kings , our princes , and our fathers , and to all the people of the land .

And in every province , and in every city , whithersoever the king s commandment and his decree came , the Jews had joy and gladness , a feast and a good day . And many of the people of the land became Jews  ; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah bad probins , hangno hangno ba la pule ïa ka jingpynbna u syiem , ki Jiw ki pynlong ki shuti lehkmen ryngkat bad ki jingkhawai sngewbha bad jingkmen . Ha ka jingshisha , bun kiwei ki briew ki la kylla Jiw , namar mynta ki la sheptieng ïa ki .
Ki Amor ki dang sah ha Aijalon , Shaalbim , bad ha u Lum Heres , hynrei ki jait Ephraim bad Manasseh ki bsuh hapoh ka jingsynshar jong ki bad ki pynbor ïa ki ban trei na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon , and in Shaalbim : yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed , so that they became tributaries .

translation.kha: Bad kamut nga nong ha phi ba ngan phiah ha phi ïa ki nongïathuhlypa malu ïa ki briew kiba stad bad ïa ki nonghikai ; phin pynïap katto katne ngut na ki , phin Sahnarphna ïa kiwei pat , bad phin sympat ïa kiwei pat ha ki synagog bad beh ïa ki na kawei ka shongneh sha kawei pat .
translation.en: Wherefore , behold , I send unto you prophets , and wise men , and scribes : and some of them ye shall kill and crucify  ; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues , and persecute them from city to city :
But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink  ; and commanded the prophets , saying , Prophesy not .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi la pynlong ïa ki Nasir ban dih waiñ , bad phi la hukum ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban ym kren ïa ka khubor jong nga .
Hangto I la shem ïa ka lieng kaba thmu ban leit sha Phoenisia , kumta i la ïakiew ha ka bad moi la leit noh .
translation.en: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phoenicia , we went aboard , and set forth .

translation.kha: U Eliab , u hynmen rangbah u Dabid , u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u ïakren bad kita ki rangbah . U la bitar ïa u Dabid bad u ong , Me leh aïu hangne ? Mano ba sumar ïa tun ki langbrot ki jong me kiba don ha ka ri khlaw ? Ma me , me Uba sngewstad ! Me wan tang ban peitbeiñ kai ïa ka jingïaleh thma !
translation.en: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men  ; and Eliab s anger was kindled against David , and he said , Why camest thou down hither ? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness ? I know thy pride , and the naughtiness of thine heart  ; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra u Solomon u phah noh sha ïong ïa u paidlang . barieh ki la ïaroh ïa u bad ki leit suk sha ïohnang namar ki jingkyrkhu baroh ba U Trai u la ai ha u Dabid u shakri jong u bad ha ki briew jong u ki Israel .
translation.en: On the eighth day he sent the people away : and they blessed the king , and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the  Lord  had done for David his servant , and for Israel his people .
They have cut off my life in the dungeon , and cast a stone upon me .
translation.kha: Ki la bret im ïa nga shapoh ka thliew bad ki la khang ïa ka da u maw .
Nga kular ba ngan pynlong ïa kane ka nongbah bad ïa kiba shong ha ka kum ka Topheth .
translation.en: Thus will I do unto this place , saith the  Lord  , and to the inhabitants thereof , and even make this city as Topheth :
And he took them up in his arms , put his hands upon them , and blessed them .
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa ki khynnah ha la ki ksang ti , u la buh ïa ki kti jong u halor jong ki , bad u la kyrkhu ïa ki .
Pynban U blang u thop ïa ka jingjam barieh kabu nga shim ; lada u tyngeh ïa nga , un shem ba nga long khuid .
translation.en: But he knoweth the way that I take : when he hath tried me , I shall come forth as gold .

translation.kha: Kita ki ar ngut ki riewrunar ki kynnoh pyrsad ïa u ha khmat u paidbah ba u la tei ïa U Blei bad ïa u syiem . Jaban kumne la Sei ïa u Shabar ka nongbah nabar lynthem maw ha ba-bang da ïap .
translation.en: And there came in two men , children of Belial , and sat before him : and the men of Belial witnessed against him , even against Naboth , in the presence of the people , saying , Naboth did blaspheme God and the king . Then they carried him forth out of the city , and stoned him with stones , that he died .
Then I went on to the gate of the fountain , and to the king s pool : but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass .
translation.kha: Nangta ha ka bynta kaba shaphang mihngi jong ka nongbah , nga leit shaphang shatei sha ka Khyrdop Umpohliew bad ka Pungsum u Syiem . U kada u ba nga shong um lah ban shem kano kano ka lynti lyngba ki synrum ,
Ki rangbah Kiba peit halor ka kam ki long kiba da khwai thok , te kim donnam ban hap ai jingkheiñ ïa ka jingmih .
translation.en: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand , because they dealt faithfully .

translation.kha: Mynta ha kaba khatduh ka pyut baroh khwai ka ïoh ïa ka jingjahthait bad ka jingsuk , bad imat pa uwei u rwai da kaba kmen .
translation.en: The whole earth is at rest , and is quiet : they break forth into singing .
And Cain talked with Abel his brother : and it came to pass , when they were in the field , that Cain rose up against Abel his brother , and slew him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Kain u ong ïa u Abel u para jong u ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit sha lyngkha .  Haba ki la don ha lyngkha , u Kain u la shoh ïa la u para bad u la pynïap ïa u .
Kaei ? Lane ka da mo ban erlangthari ba ka ktien U Blei ka la wan na phi ? Lane hato dei tang ha phi ba ka la wan ?
translation.en: What ? came the word of God out from you ? or came it unto you only ?

translation.kha: Ki briew kin kyllon kum ki masi kyrteng khlaw bad ki mar lyngkhot , sad ka khynñiat sa leit da ka snam nabar yn Tap da ka khleiñ .
translation.en: And the unicorns shall come down with them , and the bullocks with the bulls  ; and their land shall be soaked with blood , and their dust made fat with fatness .

translation.kha: Kuth u Mishael u khun jong u Nethanaïah , u Johanan u khwan jong u Kareah , u Seruïah u khun jong u Tanhumeth , ki khun shynrang jong u Ephai na Nophah , bun u Jesanaïah na Maakah ki la leit bad la ki rangbah sha u Gedalaïah ha Mispah .
translation.en: Then they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah , even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah , and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth , and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite , and Jezaniah the son of a Maachathite , they and their men .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit sha ka ïing jong u Petros nabar hangta u la ïohi ïa ka kyiad kurim u Petros ba ka thiah pang lem bad ka jingshit .
translation.en: And when Jesus was come into Peter s house , he saw his wife s mother laid , and sick of a fever .

translation.kha: Phim ju kwah ïa ka jingshai jingot lem jong nga lane shahshkor haba nga pynbeit ïa phi .
translation.en: They would none of my counsel : they despised all my reproof .

translation.kha: Kumjuh ruh hikai ïa ki kynthei kiba la kham san ba kin im donhok kumne ki kynthei kiba dei shun leh , kiba im ka jingkem Bakhuid . Kim dien banbeiñ long kiba kren siar lane kiba kyrni ha ka dih waiñ .
translation.en: The aged women likewise , that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness , not false accusers , not given to much wine , teachers of good things ;

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta sa nong ha phi : lada uno uno u briew u pyllut noh ïa la ka tnga , na ka bynta kano kano ka deng lait noh na ka jingbymïaineh jong ka , te u Long kaba la shah rem ha kaba pynlong ïa ka baneh klim lada ka ïashongkurim biang ; Bad u briew kiba sngewjahburom ïa ka , u ruh u klim .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That whosoever shall put away his wife , saving for the cause of fornication , causeth her to commit adultery : and whosoever shall marry her that is divorced committeth adultery .

translation.kha: Da shispah un pynïap ïa kito ki briew kiba sniew , ki la jubab , bad un aiwai ïa ka brai sohkew ha kiwei patan ki nongshimwai , ki ban ai ha u ïa ka bhah jong u na ka jingkheit ha ka pa kaba beiñ .
translation.en: They say unto him , He will miserably destroy those wicked men , and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen , which shall render him the fruits in their seasons .

translation.kha: Ka la dei ban ïoh khun synrap , bad ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa ki , ki ïakheiñ ïaksaid para ma ki ha ka kpoh jong ka . Ka ong , Balei kaba kum kane ka wan jliah ha ang ? Kumta ka la leit kylli na U Trai ban ïoh jubab .
translation.en: And the children struggled together within her  ; and she said , If it be so , why am I thus ? And she went to enquire of the  Lord .

translation.kha: bad sawphew thlia ki thliew tnum rupa hapoh jong ki , ar ar tyllai ki thliew tnaw hapoh kawei ka jingker pun bat ïa moi ki tnaw jyllang ka ar tylli .
translation.en: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards  ; two sockets under one board for his two tenons , and two sockets under another board for his two tenons .

translation.kha: Khie leit bad kylli na U Trai na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ki briew baroh jong ka Judah shaphang ka jinghikai jong kane ka Kitab . U Trai u la bitar ïa i Naaman ba ki kput tymmen jong ngi Ki shym la leh ïa kaei ba kane ka Biblos ka ong ba dei ban leh .
translation.en: Go ye , enquire of the  Lord  for me , and for the people , and for all Judah , concerning the words of this book that is found : for great is the wrath of the  Lord  that is kindled against us , because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book , to do according unto all that which is written concerning us .
Without counsel purposes are disappointed : but in the multitude of counsellors they are established .
translation.kha: Lum ïa ki jingai jingmut baroh katba phi lah , bad phin jop ; khlem kata phin shahjop .

Lada u dang mudui mynba u wan long u mraw jong phoi , um dem ban ïalam ïa ka tnga jong u long u mihnoh ; hynrei lada u la shongkurim mynba u wan long u saraw jongnga phi , u lah pun ïalumlang ïa la ka rnga lem bad u .
translation.en: If he came in by himself , he shall go out by himself : if he were married , then his wife shall go out with him .
For the bodies of those beasts , whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin , are burned without the camp .
translation.kha: U rangbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw u wanrah ïa ka snam ki mrad ha ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam ïa ka ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia namar ki pop ; hynrei ïa ki met jong ki mrad la thang shabar ka jaka shong dara .
Kumta u Ahab u khot shapoh ïa ki ïathuhlypa , kumba shispah na ki , bad u kylli ïa ki , Hato ngan rupa dara tur ïaleit ïa ka Ramoth , ne em ? Tur ïaleh ïa ka , ki Jubab . U Blei un ai jingjop ïa ph .
translation.en: Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men , and said unto them , Shall we go to Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And they said , Go up  ; for God will deliver it into the king s hand .

translation.kha: U Bosrah u khur jong u Ahijah , uba na ka jait Issakhar , u la ïasuhbuit pyrshah ïa u Nadab bad u la pynïap ïa u katba u Nadab bad ka kynoi shipai jong u ki ïangat kerkut ïa ka nongbah Gibbethon ha Philistia .
translation.en: And Baasha the son of Ahijah , of the house of Issachar , conspired against him  ; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon , which belonged to the Philistines  ; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon .

Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest , and the other priests , and said unto them , Why repair ye not the breaches of the house ? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance , but deliver it for the breaches of the house .
translation.kha: Kumta u phah khot ïa u Jehoïada bad ïa kiwei pat ki lyngdoh bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Balei ba phim shym shna pynbha ïa ka Templ ? Naduh mynta phim dei shuh ban bat ïa ka pisa kaba phi ïohpdiang ; phi dei ban aiti noh , khnang ban ïoh shna pynbha .

translation.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time , when the priests blew with the trumpets , Joshua said unto the people , Shout  ; for the  Lord  hath given you the city .
translation.kha: Ha ka sien ïaid tawiar kaba hynñiew , hamar ba ki lyngdoh kin put ïa ki turoi , u Joshua u hukum ïa u paidbah ban risa , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u la ai ha phi ïa ka nongbah !

translation.en: But David pursued , he and four hundred men : for two hundred abode behind , which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor .
translation.kha: U Dabid u nang ïai bteng la ka lynti jong u lem bad sawspah ngut ki rangbah ; kita arspah ngut kiwei pat , namar ba ki la thait eh , kim lah shuh ban jam sha shiliang ka wahduid , bad ki sah noh shadien .
Na ka jingtip jong ka jingjanai jongngi u , u la kyrkhu ïa ngi baroh , da kaba ai ha ngi ïa ka jingkynduh Kawei hadien kawei patan .
translation.en: And of his fulness have all we received , and grace for grace .

translation.kha: U pajwa ka Assyria u la phar ïa u ïabah synshar ba-halor den ban ibeiñ ïa U Blei uba im . To ai ba U tharai U Blei jong phi un ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingibeiñ bad un pynbudnam ïa kito naba kren ha ki . Kumta Duwai ha U blang na ka bynta eit ki briew kiba lait im .
translation.en: It may be the  Lord  thy God will hear all the words of Rab–shakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God  ; and will reprove the words which the  Lord  thy God hath heard : wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that are left .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la blei sawdong bad u la ïuh ïa ka , bad u la ainong , To long shlur , ko ka khun jong nga ! Ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynkoit ïa pha . Ha “kata ka khyllipmat ka kynthei ka la koit .
translation.en: But Jesus turned him about , and when he saw her , he said ,  Daughter , be of good comfort  ; thy faith hath made thee whole .  And the woman was made whole from that hour .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki ñiewbeiñ ïa nga ; ki ïalum sawdong ïa nga bad ki thap ïa nga .
translation.en: They have gaped upon me with their mouth  ; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully  ; they have gathered themselves together against me .

translation.kha: ïada ki briew ki la lait im na ki hab ba pynjngut jong ka pyrthei da ka jingtep jong ki ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Tlai bad U Nongrim jong ngi , bad nala ki ngat wiang bad shahjop ha ki , koum kita ki bhabriew ki don ha ka jinglong ka kham sniew ha kiba kut ban ïa kaba ki la longïing ha kaba nyngkong .
translation.en: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ , they are again entangled therein , and overcome , the latter end is worse with them than the beginning .
And  God  saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth , and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u la ïohi haduh katno ka jingsniew jong uwei pa uwei u briew ha ka pyrthei bad katno ki jingmut jingpyrkhat bymman jong ki ha ki por baroh ,
Ïa ka jingpule ka Baibl lehse lah ban pynbiang ïa ka por bad ka jaka ka ban suk ïa phin .
translation.en: A Bible study can usually be arranged at a time and place convenient to you .

translation.kha: Nga ai ha me ïa ki soh sneng kiba kynsai tam baroh na ka umphniang Olib , ka waiñ bad u kew ba ki Jeraïah ki ai ïa nga man la ka snoh .
translation.en: All the best of the oil , and all the best of the wine , and of the wheat , the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the  Lord  , them have I given thee .
Why is light given to a man whose way is hid , and whom God hath hedged in ?
translation.kha: U Blei u buhrieh ïa ka lawei na ki bad ker ïa ki na ki liang baroh .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said , I will let you go , that ye may sacrifice to the  Lord  your God in the wilderness  ; only ye shall not go very far away : entreat for me .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u ong ,  Ngan shah ba phin ïaleit ban ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ha ka ri shyiap ; lada phim leit jngai than . Duwai na ka bynta jong nga .
A Trai , ki kam runar jong ngi pyrshah ïa me ki long kiba bun . Ki pop jong ngi hi ki pynrem ïa ngi . Ngi tip bha ïa kine kiei Kiei baroh .
translation.en: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee , and our sins testify against us : for our transgressions are with us  ; and as for our iniquities , we know them  ;
Mine eyes fail for thy word , saying , When wilt thou comfort me ?
translation.kha: Ki khmat jong nga ki thait ïan ha kaba ap ïa ka jingkular jong me ; katba nga kylli ,  Lano keiñ men ïarap ïa nga ?

translation.en: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land : for they have heard that thou  Lord  art among this people , that thou  Lord  art seen face to face , and that thy cloud standeth over them , and that thou goest before them , by day time in a pillar of a cloud , and in a pillar of fire by night .
translation.kha: kin sa ïathuh ïa kata ha ki briew kiba shong ha kane ka ri . Kine ki briew ki la lah ïohsngew ba me , A  Trai  , me don lem bad ngi , bad ba me paw ha kaba ïohi shai haba u lyoh jong me u sangeh halor jong ngi bad ba me leit ha shuwa jong ngi ha u rishot lyoh mynsngi bad u rishot ding mynmiet .

translation.en: And they sat down in ranks , by hundreds , and by fifties .
translation.kha: Kumta ki briew ki la shong ha ki laiñ , ha ki kynhun bashispah ngut bad ki kynhun basanphew ngut .
Ma nga , U Trai nga la buh ïa ka sngi kaba la shai kumne ka to ha kaba ngan leh ïa kane .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  appointed a set time , saying , To morrow the  Lord  shall do this thing in the land .

translation.kha: Kum , hangta ha Khmut jong ph nga bret ïa kita ki mawlynnai bad nga pynpait pharia ïa ki .
translation.en: And I took the two tables , and cast them out of my two hands , and brake them before your eyes .
I have surely built thee an house to dwell in , a settled place for thee to abide in for ever .
translation.kha: Mynta nga la tei ïa ka Templ kaba khraw na ka bynta jong me , ka jaka na ka bynta jong me ba men shong junom la junom .

Uno une uba wan shiah nga um ha ban longïing u synran jong nga lymda u iktiar ïa at kham phlait ban ïa kaba u ieit ïa u kpa bad ka kmie Jong u , ïa ka tnga dara ki khun jong u , ïa ki hynmen ki Para Shynrang bad kynhied jong u , bad ïa lade kumjuh .
translation.en: If any man come to me , and hate not his father , and mother , and wife , and children , and brethren , and sisters , yea , and his own life also , he cannot be my disciple .
For indeed he was sick nigh unto death : but God had mercy on him ; and not on him only , but on me also , lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow .
translation.kha: Da shisha u la pang bad u la jan ïap . Hynrei U Blei u la isynei ïa u , bad ym tang ïa u hynrei ïa nga ruh , bad u la pyllait ïa nga wat na ka jingsngewsih kaba kham khraw .

translation.en: But as a wife that committeth adultery , which taketh strangers instead of her husband !
translation.kha: Pha long kum ka kynthei kaba ïaleh awria bad ki nongwei ha ka jaka ban ieit ïa la u tnga .
Ka sngi ka la ju , ka sngi haba U tharai un leh , ka sngur jong ki lyoh bad jingjyrsieh ïa ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: For the day is near , even the day of the  Lord  is near , a cloudy day  ; it shall be the time of the heathen .

translation.kha: U ïaiban u jubab , Nga dei uei keiñ bad kaei ka longïing jong nga ba ngan ïoh long u pyrsa kurim jyllang u symboh ?
translation.en: And David said unto Saul , Who am I ? and what is my life , or my father s family in Israel , that I should be son in law to the king ?
Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age , so that he could not see . And he brought them near unto him  ; and he kissed them , and embraced them .
translation.kha: U Jakob , namar ba u la tymmen , u la byr-ïe ki khmat , bad um imat bha shuh . U Joseph u ïalam ïa ki hajan jong u ; u ruh u piam u kdup ïa ki bad u doh de ïa ki .
Kata ka bariew ka leit shiah u syiem , ka dem mynshem haduh khyndew ha ka jingïaburom dara ka ong , Ïarap ïa nga , ko Ngim Kynrad !
translation.en: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king , she fell on her face to the ground , and did obeisance , and said , Help , O king .

translation.kha: U Trai u hukum ïa u Moses banbeiñ kren ha ki lyngdoh , ki khur u Aaron , bad ong ha ki ba uno uno na ki um dei ban pyntngit ïa put ha ka por ba lehniam haba don uba ïap naphang ki briew lad u ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron , and say unto them , There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people :

But it shall be on the seventh day , that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows , even all his hair he shall shave off : and he shall wash his clothes , also he shall wash his flesh in water , and he shall be clean .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , un khi biang ïa la u  ñiuhkhlieh , u  ñiuhtmoh , u  ñiuhmat , bad u shñiuh baroh na ka met jong u ; un sait ruh ïa la ki jaiñ , bad un sum un sleh de , bad nangta un sa long uba khuid .
U Samuel u ong , Blei keiñ ba me da khot ïa nga haba U Trai u la iehnoh ïa me Bad u la kylla longïng u nongshun jong me ?
translation.en: Then said Samuel , Wherefore then dost thou ask of me , seeing the  Lord  is departed from thee , and is become thine enemy ?
And I will take away mine hand , and thou shalt see my back parts : but my face shall not be seen .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan sa weng noh ïa ka kti jong nga , bad men sa ïohi ïa ka ingdong jong nga ym ïa ka khmat jong nga .

La khoit ïa ki Israel pynlang la pynkieng ailad ïa ki ; ki la ïaleit bad sher dara ha ki ar kynhun ban ïaheh ïa ki Seraïah . La ïohi ïa ki Israel ba ki long kum ar thyllah ki kynha blang barit long ïanujor bad ki nong Syria , kiba la pyndap ïa ki rudnong .
translation.en: And the children of Israel were numbered , and were all present , and went against them : and the children of Israel pitched before them like two little flocks of kids  ; but the Syrians filled the country .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingleit pait jong u , ki rangbah ka Judah kiba la wan sha Gilgal ban synran ïa u sha shiliang ka wah , ki la ïakynduh ïa u ha ka wah Jordan .
translation.en: So the king returned , and came to Jordan . And Judah came to Gilgal , to go to meet the king , to conduct the king over Jordan .
And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age , and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father , in Ophrah of the Abi–ezrites .
translation.kha: U Gideon u khun jong u Joash u la ïap haba u la tymmen bha , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep u Joash u kpa jong u , kaba ha Ophrah , ka nongrit jong ka kur Abieser .
katba u ong ha ki Kane ka bniat jyllang ka jingthoh Bakhuid ka la wan urlong shispah mynta ka snoh , haba phi ïohsngew ba la pule ïa ka .
translation.en: And he began to say unto them ,  This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa sier , la ong U Ïoannis , bad por ong ha phi ba une u dei U Khun U Balei .
translation.en: And I saw , and bare record that this is the Son of God .
Verily , verily , I say unto you , That ye shall weep and lament , but the world shall rejoice : and ye shall be sorrowful , but your sorrow shall be turned into joy .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Phin ïam bad phin ïamkthang , hynrei , ka pyrthei kan shadkmen ; phin ïasngewsih , hynrei ka jingsngewsih jong phi kan kylla sha ka jingkmen .
Ka jingïalang jong me ka ïaisah shad ki pateng bynriew baroh ; me la buh pynskhem ïa ka pyrthei , bad ka neh .
translation.en: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations : thou hast established the earth , and it abideth .

translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph , Mynta nga la kloi lada ïap noh! hajuh , namar ba nga la ïohi ïa me sad tip ba me ïan im .
translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , Now let me die , since I have seen thy face , because thou art yet alive .
Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther . So Esther arose , and stood before the king ,
translation.kha: U syiem u la pyn-i ïa u diengsynshar ksiar ha ka , kumta ka ïeng bad ka ong ,
Katba phi nang bunktien , katta phi nang leh pop . Lada phi longsem uba stad phin sngap jar .
translation.en: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin : but he that refraineth his lips is wise .

translation.kha: Katno kan long kaba shyngkub ïa pha , ko Hesron ! Katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ïa pha ruh , ko Bethsaida ! Lada ïa ki kambah kiba la leh ha Phin la lah leh ha Troas bad Sidon , la kham snem ki briew hangtai kin jin da la phrang da ka jaiñ khihwin bad synreit da u pdem khlur biar , ban pyn-i ba ki la phai noh na ki pop jong ki !
translation.en: Woe unto thee , Chorazin ! woe unto thee , Bethsaida ! for if the mighty works , which were done in you , had been done in Tyre and Sidon , they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes .

translation.kha: Bad ha ka sngi kambah arphew hynñiew jongngi u bnai uba ar , ka khyndew ka la rkhiang nongdih shadong .
translation.en: And in the second month , on the seven and twentieth day of the month , was the earth dried .
And he stood over her , and rebuked the fever  ; and it left her : and immediately she arose and ministered unto them .
translation.kha: U la leit bad ïeng harud ka jingthiah jong ka bad u la hukum ïa ka jingpang shit ban mihnoh na ka . Ka jingpang shit ka la iehnoh ïa ka , bad ka la khie joit shisyndon bad ka la sdang ban shakri ïa ki .
Ki tamsneng jong ka ki la phet sha Gidom , ha kaba ki la shong la sah naduh kata ka por . )
translation.en: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim , and were sojourners there until this day . )

translation.kha: Nangne don jingduk , jingkhangïit , bad ki jingjynjar jong nga kim don jingkad .
translation.en: I was not in safety , neither had I rest , neither was I quiet  ; yet trouble came .

translation.kha: Bun u Kane u ong ha U Trai , Kainan ka jingpynshitom ka long palat ïa kaba nga lah ban shah .
translation.en: And Cain said unto the  Lord  , My punishment is greater than I can bear .

translation.kha: Kñia khathynriew ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew ba u Jakob u ïoh na ka Silpah ïa kaba u Laban u ai ha ka Leah ka khun jong u ban long ka mraw jong ka .
translation.en: These are the sons of Zilpah , whom Laban gave to Leah his daughter , and these she bare unto Jacob , even sixteen souls .

And this shall be a sign unto thee , Ye shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves , and in the second year that which springeth of the same  ; and in the third year sow ye , and reap , and plant vineyards , and eat the fruits thereof .
translation.kha: Nangta u Isaïah u ong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ,  Kane ka long ka dak ïa kaei ka ban sa jia . Mynta ka snem bad ha ka snem ka ban wan , men ïoh tang ïa ki kew khlaw ban bam , hynrei ha ka snem kaba bud men lah ban bet ïa u kew bad ot ïa u , bad ban thung ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad bam ïa ki sohwaiñ .

translation.en: For mine own sake , even for mine own sake , will I do it : for how should my name be polluted ? and I will not give my glory unto another .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga la leh na ka bynta jong nga hi — Ngan ym shah ba ïa ka kyrteng jong nga yn pynjahburom lane mano mano ban ïadon bynta lang ïa ka burom kaba dei ka jong nga bad ka jong nga hi .
Ki jingjam kim lah ban pynmynsaw ïa phoi lait tang Haba phi dei haw ban ïoh ïa ki . Ki longsyiem kum ki sim katba lui bad ki bym ju shongneh .
translation.en: As the bird by wandering , as the swallow by flying , so the curse causeless shall not come .

translation.kha: Ki khluit , ki tnat , bad u diengpynïeng sharak ki dei ban long kiba ïawad lang kawei malu kiba la shuh shoh da ka ksiar nylla .
translation.en: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same : all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa nga , A Trai , Haba me ïarap ïa ki briew jong me ; kynhun ïa nga ruh haba me pynim ïa ki .
translation.en: Remember me , O  Lord  , with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people : O visit me with thy salvation  ;

translation.kha: Ym don uwei na kita kiba la shongduh bim kiba la sngewthuh bapli U ijuh u la ong ïa kane ha u .
translation.en: Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him .

Among the Hebronites was Jeriah the chief , even among the Hebronites , according to the generations of his fathers . In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for , and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead .
translation.kha: U Jeraïah u dei u nongïalam jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hebron . Ha ka snem kaba sawphew ba u Dabid u la long syiem , la don ka jingtohkit shaphang ka pateng longïing jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hebron , bad la shem ba ki shipai bapawkhmat kiba na kane ka longïing la lap ba ki shong ki sah ha Jaser ha ka ri Gilead .
U Trai u ai ha u Moses ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: U Jediael u la jubab , Ko Syiem Kynrad , ym don uno uno u nongpang byrtong , u nongleh mynjur , u nongbatai pan , lane u nongkhmih khlong uba lah ban ïathuh ha phi ïa kata .
translation.en: Daniel answered in the presence of the king , and said , The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise men , the astrologers , the magicians , the soothsayers , shew unto the king  ;
So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u kham riewspah bad kham stad ban ïa uno uno u syiem ,
Ka kur Hassenaah ka tei ïa ka Khyrdop Dohkha . Ki buh ïa ki bim bad pynïeng ïa ka khyrdep , bad pyndait ïa ki nar-khang bad ki jingkhang ïa ka khyrdop .
translation.en: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build , who also laid the beams thereof , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof .

And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised  ; for to build the house of the  Lord  , and his own house , and Millo , and the wall of Jerusalem , and Hazor , and Megiddo , and Gezer .
translation.kha: U Syiem Solomon u la pyndonkam da ka jingpyntrei jubor ban tei ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , ban pyndap khyndew ïa ka jaka ha ka phang mihngi jong ka nongbah , bad ban shna ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah . U la pyndonkam ruh ïa ka , na ka bynta ban tei pat ïa ki nongbah Hasor , Megiddo bad Geser .
To shim bynta lem ha ka jingshah shitom , kum u shipai baïaineh jong U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: Thou therefore endure hardness , as a good soldier of Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: La don u briew uba kyrteng u Job , uba shong ba sah ha ka ri Us , uba mane ïa U Blei bad uba ïaineh ha u . U lama u briew uba bha , kaba kiar ban ym leh ïa kano kano kaba snep .
translation.en: There was a man in the land of Uz , whose name was Job  ; and that man was perfect and upright , and one that feared God , and eschewed evil .

translation.kha: kumta ang hiar noh sharum shad ka them Kidron bad ïaid shaphrang , da kaba peit ïa ka kynroh . Nangta nga wanlam phai pat na kajuh ka lynti ba nga wiang bad wait phai sha ka nongbah lyngba ka Khyrdop Them .
translation.en: Then went I up in the night by the brook , and viewed the wall , and turned back , and entered by the gate of the valley , and so returned .
And , Whosoever shall swear by the altar , it is nothing  ; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it , he is guilty .
translation.kha: Phi hikai ruh , ‘ Lada uno uno u smai da ka duwan , ïa u ym shym la teh da ka jingsmai jong u ; hynrei lada u smai da ka jingai sngewbha halor ka duwan , u long uba la shah teh .’
bad un long u syiem jong ki khum ki ksiew u Jakob julam ; ka hima jong u kan ym kput shuh da lei lei !
translation.en: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever  ; and of his kingdom there shall be no end .
He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot  ; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image , that shall not be moved .
translation.kha: U briew u bym lah ïoh rupa ne ksiar u jied da ka dieng ka ban ym pyut . U shem ïa u nongtrei dieng batbit ban shna ïa ka dur ka ban ym kyllon .
Te u Abimael u nong ha u Asekah , To mihnoh na ka ri jyllang ngi . Me la kylla long babha kham khroh ban ïa kaba ngi long .
translation.en: And Abimelech said unto Isaac , Go from us  ; for thou art much mightier than we .

translation.kha: Wat la ang longsem u syiem uba la jied da U Blei , nga sngewtlot myntri ka sngi . Kine ki khun shngain jong ka Seruïah ki long ka jingma ïa nga . To U Trai un pynshitom ïa kine ki nongkamsniew kumba ki dei ban ïoh !
translation.en: And I am this day weak , though anointed king  ; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me : the  Lord  shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness .

translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u wan sha u Eli bad ka khubor na U Terah : Haba u Kpa tymmen jongno me u Aaron bad ka longïing jong u ki ïalang longïng ki khra-maw jong u Pharaoh ka Ijipt . Nga la pynpaw ïa biar ha u Yiron .
translation.en: And there came a man of God unto Eli , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father , when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh s house ?

translation.kha: Ka jingim jong na ka long ka bym don jingmut , hynrei ha ka por la ïor ïa kaei kaei borbah . Katto katne ki briew kiba bha ki da ban ïapom katba kiwei pat ki ïalang im waiñ haba ki long kiba sniew .
translation.en: All things have I seen in the days of my vanity : there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness , and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness .

translation.kha: U patsha u phah ïa kane ka jubab : Ha u Rehum , u lat , ha u Shimiet , u sentimitar jong ka probins , pynlang ha ki paralok jong ki kiba shong ha Jeremaïah bad ha kiba sah Jong ka Ijipt Sepngi , ki jingkhublei .
translation.en: Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor , and to Shimshai the scribe , and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria , and unto the rest beyond the river , Peace , and at such a time .
Therefore I will give thanks unto thee , O  Lord  , among the heathen , and I will sing praises unto thy name .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ïaroh ïa me , ko  Trai  , hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , nga rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me .

translation.en: For bodily exercise profiteth little : but godliness is profitable unto all things , having promise of the life that now is , and of that which is to come .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynmlien ïa ka met ka ai katto katne ka jingbha , hynrei ka jingpynmlien ba kynja mynsiem ka pynmyntoi ha ki liang baroh , namar ka kular ïa ka jingim ha ka mynta bad ha ka lawei .

translation.en: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation , which shall devour the adversaries .
translation.kha: Pynban , kaei kaba dang sah ka long ban ap da ka jingsheptieng ïa ka Jingbishar ka ban sa wan bad ïa ka ding kaba klang ka ban sa bam duh ïa kita kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei !

translation.en: And they immediately left the ship and their father , and followed him .
translation.kha: bad shisyndon ki la iehnoh ïa ka lieng bad ïa la u kpa bad ki la ïaleit bad u .
La pynïadait skhem haw main katta ïa ki barben ba ym don kano kano kob lah ban pynïakhlad ïa ki .
translation.en: They are joined one to another , they stick together , that they cannot be sundered .
And , behold , the acts of Asa , first and last , lo , they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh ki jingjia ha ka jingsynshar u Asa naduh kaba nyngkong haduh kaba kut la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel .
Hynrei lada u ïada ha ka por mynmiet u jynthut , namar um ba-don ka jingiaseng .
translation.en: But if a man walk in the night , he stumbleth , because there is no light in him .
But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare , and into many foolish and hurtful lusts , which drown men in destruction and perdition .
translation.kha: Hynrei kito kiba kwah ban riewspah ki hap ha ka jingpynshoi bad ki ngat ha ka jingriam jong ki jingkwah ba-bieit bad ki jingkwah ba-pynmynsaw , kiba tan ïa ki sha ka jingjot bad ka jingpynjot .

translation.en: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality .
translation.kha: Ki la shah tynjuh palat da ki jingjynjar kiba ki la ïaid lyngba ; hynrei ka jingkmen jong ki ka la long kaba khraw haduh katta katta ba ki la long kiba sbun shikatdei eh ha ka jingai jong ki , wat la ki long kiba duk shisha .
Kumta ki la khum ïa ki , ki da rupa jaiñ pura — ki sopti-poh , ka jaiñkup jynsur , ki tupia , bad baïar — bad ki la bret ïa ki ha ka lawar ding baklang .
translation.en: Then these men were bound in their coats , their hosen , and their hats , and their other garments , and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace .

translation.kha: Kumta u Hosea u phah noh ïa ki , bun ki la leit sha la ka jakarieh badno ap hangta , ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Ai , Hapdeng ka Ai bad ka Bethel . U Joshua pait u sahmiet ha ka jaka sher dara .
translation.en: Joshua therefore sent them forth : and they went to lie in ambush , and abode between Beth–el and Ai , on the west side of Ai : but Joshua lodged that night among the people .

translation.kha: Shim uwei na kita ki khunlangbrot shynrang , bad Ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .
translation.en: Thou shalt also take one ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .

translation.kha: Nangta ki her noh kum ka lyer bad ki jah syndon , kine ki briew kiba ka bor ka long u blei jong ki .
translation.en: Then shall his mind change , and he shall pass over , and offend , imputing this his power unto his god .

For we are sold , I and my people , to be destroyed , to be slain , and to perish . But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen , I had held my tongue , although the enemy could not countervail the king s damage .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew jong nga bad ïa nga , la die sha ka jingpynïap . Lada kam da long kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba die sha ka jinglongmraw , ngan jin da la shu sngap jar bad ngan ym pynshitom ïa phi ; hynrei ngi la jan shah pynjot — shah pynduh pyndam !
Haba nga ïohi ïa ki bymman ba ki pynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ jong me , nga la dap da ka jingbitar .
translation.en: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law .
I have compassion on the multitude , because they have now been with me three days , and have nothing to eat :
translation.kha: Nga sngewsynei ïa kine ki briew , namar ki la don bad nga la lai sngi bad mynta kim don ei ei shuh ban bam .
Ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka jingleh ha kaba pyndonburom ïa U Trai dei ban pynlong ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bthei uba nyngkong .
translation.en: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the  Lord .

translation.kha: bad la buh hapoh ka jingkhmih ki nongap , namar ym pat don ka jingpynshong yn leh kumno ïa u .
translation.en: And they put him in ward , because it was not declared what should be done to him .
Neither , because they are the seed of Abraham , are they all children : but , In Isaac shall thy seed be called .
translation.kha: Lymne kiba hiarpateng baroh na u Abraham ki long ki khun jong U Blei . U Blei u la ong ha u Abraham ,  Ka long lyngba u Isaak ba men ïoh ïa kiba hiarpateng kiba nga la kular ïa me .

Ngan ai aïu ïa phi kum ka dak ka jingkular ? u phai ktien . Ka jubab , Ka muhor jong phi bad u ksah jong ka , bad uto u diengduh ba phi rah . U la ai ïa ki ha ka . Nangta ki la ïathiah shongkha , badno ka la punkhun .
translation.en: And he said , What pledge shall I give thee ? And she said , Thy signet , and thy bracelets , and thy staff that is in thine hand . And he gave it her , and came in unto her , and she conceived by him .

And unto Abiathar the priest said the king , Get thee to Anathoth , unto thine own fields  ; for thou art worthy of death : but I will not at this time put thee to death , because thou barest the ark of the Lord  God  before David my father , and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted .
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u ong ha u Abiathar u lyngdoh ,  Khie leit sha la ka jong ka ri ha Anathoth . Me dei hok ban ïap , hynrei ngan ym phah pynïap ïa me mynta , namar ba me la khmih sumar ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U  Trai  mynba me dang don bad u Dabid , u kpa jong nga , bad me la ïoh bynta lem ha ki jingjynjar jong u baroh .

translation.en: For there shall be a day , that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry , Arise ye , and let us go up to Zion unto the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ka por kan wan haba ki nongap kin khot ha ki lum ka Ephraim , ‘ Ïa ngin ïaleit haduh Seïon , sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi .’

Hynrei ngi da ioh ïa U Ujuh , ïa uba la pynlong shipor kham hapoh ban ïa ki angel , kumto ba lyngba ka jingaiei ka jong U blei , u dei ban shahïap na ka bynta uwei pa aiwai baroh . Myntan ngi ïohi ïa u , ba la pynphong pansngiat da ka burom bad da ka jingpyntreikam Naamah ka jingïap kaba u la shah .
translation.en: But we see Jesus , who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death , crowned with glory and honour  ; that he by the grace of God should taste death for every man .

Then the priest shall command that they empty the house , before the priest go into it to see the plague , that all that is in the house be not made unclean : and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un hukum ba dei ban pynmih lut napoh ïing ïa ki tiar ki tar baroh shuwa ba un leit khmih ïa kata ka jingbthuh ; lym kumta , yn pynbna ba baroh kaba don ha kata ka ïing ka long ka bymkhuid . Nangta un sa leit rung shapoh ïing bad un khmih bha ïa kata ka jingbthuh .

translation.en: But thou must eat them before the  Lord  thy God in the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose , thou , and thy son , and thy daughter , and thy manservant , and thy maidservant , and the Levite that is within thy gates : and thou shalt rejoice before the  Lord  thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto .
translation.kha: Ma phi bad ki khun ki kti jong phi , lem bad ki shakri shakor jong phi , bad ki Lebi ruh kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi , phi dei ban bam ïa kine ki jingainguh tang ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ha kawei ka jaka mane Blei kaba u la jied . Bad hangta phi dei ban sngewkmen na ka bynta kaei kaei baroh kaba phi la leh .
U shñiuh jong ki u long kamon u shñiuh kynthah , ki bniat jongu ki , ki long kum ki bniat Song .
translation.en: And they had hair as the hair of women , and their teeth were as the teeth of lions .
And Jael went out to meet Sisera , and said unto him , Turn in , my lord , turn in to me  ; fear not . And when he had turned in unto her into the tent , she covered him with a mantle .
translation.kha: Ka Jael ka mih shabar ban ïakynduh ïa u Sisera bad ka ong ha u ,  Ale shapoh , kynrad ; wan sha ka dara jong nga . Wat sheptieng .  Kumta u leit shapoh , bad ka pynrieh ïa u hadien ka pyrda .

Lada ki rangbah na ka jai Gad bad ka jait Reuben ki ngim sha arliang ka Jordan kiba la kloi ban ïabah thma ha ka hukum jong U Trai bad lade da ka jingïarap jong ki phi lah ban jop ïa ka ri , te ai ha ki ïa ka ri Gilead kum ka jingkynthih jong ki .
translation.en: And Moses said unto them , If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan , every man armed to battle , before the  Lord  , and the land shall be subdued before you  ; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession :

translation.kha: U Jogbehah u ïohi ba ki shipai nongshniah kin tur ïaleh ïa u na shad khmat bad na shajan , kumto u jied ki shipai Israel bakynsai tam bad pynap da kaba pynphai khat ïa ki shang ki Samaria .
translation.en: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind , he chose out of all the choice of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians .

translation.kha: U Arpakhshad u dat u kpa jong u Shelah , uba dei u kpa jong u Eber .
translation.en: And Arphaxad begat Salah  ; and Salah begat Eber .

translation.kha: U Trai u kylli , ‘ Mano ban shukor ïa u Ahab khnang ba un wait bad shah pynïap ha Ramoth ?’ Katto katne ki angel ki ong ïa kiwei , bad kiwei patiaw ki ong ïa kawei pat ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel , that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead ? And one spake saying after this manner , and another saying after that manner .

translation.kha: Kumta u la hukum ba yn pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jongu U Jisu Khrist . Te ki la khappud ïa u ban sai bad ki sa khyndiat sngi .
translation.en: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord . Then prayed they him to tarry certain days .
Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un tim ïa u kew jong phi bad ïa ki jingbam ba phi khreh da u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , while they communed together and reasoned , Jesus himself drew near , and went with them .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïakren bad ïasaidnia , U Jisu hi u la leit hajan bad u la ïaid lem bad ki ;

translation.en: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds , the officers of the host , and said unto them , Have her forth without the ranges : and him that followeth her kill with the sword . For the priest had said , Let her not be slain in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada um kwah ba ka Athalaïah kan shah pynïap ha ka phyllaw ka Templ , te u hukum ïa ki rangbah shipai :  Rah ïa ka shabar napdeng ki ar laiñ ba ïeng ki nongap phira , bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa ka .

translation.en: And the sons of Bela  ; Ezbon , and Uzzi , and Uzziel , and Jerimoth , and Iri , five  ; heads of the house of their fathers , mighty men of valour  ; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four .
translation.kha: U Bela u don san ngut ki khun shynrang : u Esbon , u Ussi , u Ussiel , u Jerimoth , bad u Iri . Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing ha ka kur bad ki dei baroh ki shipai bapawnam . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki kynthup ïa ki arphew ar hajar laiphew saw ngut ki rangbah kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .

Ki shipai Israel bad Judah ki risa shaid bad ki Mareshah nemsniew jong ki , ki beh kthong haduh Gath badno shaduh ki khyrdop ka Ekron . Ki Philistia ki la kylluid mynsaw baher Sei lynter lyngkot Naduh Shaaraim , haduh Gath bad Aaron .
translation.en: And the men of Israel and of Judah arose , and shouted , and pursued the Philistines , until thou come to the valley , and to the gates of Ekron . And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim , even unto Gath , and unto Ekron .

translation.kha: U la khmih halor ki briew jong ka pyrthei kum bym long ei ei ; ki angel ha bneng bad ki briew ha ka pyrthei ki don khah ka jingsynshar jong u . Ym don mano mynno ba lah ban pyrshah ïa ka mon jong u lane kylli jingkylli ïa kaei kaba u leh .
translation.en: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing : and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven , and among the inhabitants of the earth : and none can stay his hand , or say unto him , What doest thou ?

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jehoash , ka jaiñ-da Ephron bad ka jaiñ Manasseh ba Sha Sepngi , ki la ïohpdiang ïa kane ka ri kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: So the children of Joseph , Manasseh and Ephraim , took their inheritance .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban kynjat shai , u Philip u la kyrpad ïa ki baroh ban bam khyndiat ka jingbam : Phi la ïa-ap la khatsaw sngi Mynta , bad ha kane ka por baroh tv shym la bam ei ei .
translation.en: And while the day was coming on , Paul besought them all to take meat , saying , This day is the fourteenth day that ye have tarried and continued fasting , having taken nothing .

translation.kha: bad phi lah ban ai pateng ïa ki ha ki khun shynrang jong phi , ïa kiba ki dei ban shakri kabu ki dang im . Hynrei phim lah ban lehbeiñ ïa kino kino na ki para Israel jong phi .
translation.en: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you , to inherit them for a possession  ; they shall be your bondmen for ever : but over your brethren the children of Israel , ye shall not rule one over another with rigour .

translation.kha: Bad U Tharai un ïapyllait im ïa nga na ka jingmynsaw baroh bad un ri pynim bad ïalam ïa na sha ka hangta jong u ha bneng .
translation.en: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work , and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom : to whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine , for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingiw jong kine ki jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
u don la ki ïakhun shynrang ; Bad Kino ynda ki la san ki beh nong ïa u Jephthah na ïng . Ki ong ha u , manna ym ïoh bynta ei ei ha ïing i pa jongu i'u , naba me dei u khun na kawei pat ka briew .
translation.en: And Gilead s wife bare him sons  ; and his wife s sons grew up , and they thrust out Jephthah , and said unto him , Thou shalt not inherit in our father s house  ; for thou art the son of a strange woman .

translation.kha: Ka jingieid ki julam jingsniew ia ki marjan , namarkata , ka jinieid ka jingpyndap pynkmen jong ka kyndon .
translation.en: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour : therefore love is the fulfilling of the law .

translation.kha: Kawei ka jaitbynriew ka banbeiñ ïa kawei pang ka jaitbynriew , bad kawei ka nongbud ka banbeiñ ïa kawei pat ka nongbah , Naamah U Blei u wanrah ka jingjynjar bad jingshitom ha ki .
translation.en: And nation was destroyed of nation , and city of city : for God did vex them with all adversity .

translation.kha: Namarba ne thiang uwei U Blei , bad don iwei uba pynwan lang ïa U Blei bad ïa u khunbynriew , U Khreh Jisu uba long ruh u briew , suba la aiti ïa lade ban siewspah ïa ki briew baher .
translation.en: For there is one God , and one mediator between God and men , the man Christ Jesus ;

translation.kha: U Dabid u la kurup ïa ki stieh ksiar ba la rah da ki rangbah syiar jrong u Hadadeser bad u la rah ïa ki sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer , and brought them to Jerusalem .
And they took them wives of the women of Moab  ; the name of the one was Orpah , and the name of the other Ruth : and they dwelled there about ten years .
translation.kha: kiba la shongkurim ïa ki kynthei Moab , ka Orpah bad ka Ruth . Kumba shiphew snem hadien ,

Hynrei ngan pyn-i jingieit ïa ki briew ka Judah . Ma nga U Trai U Blei jong ki ngan Pyllait im ïa ki ; hynrei ngan ym leh ïa kata da ka thma — da ki waitlam lin ki ryntieh , bad ki khnam lane ki kulai nabar ki shiphang shongsuk kulai .
translation.en: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah , and will save them by the  Lord  their God , and will not save them by bow , nor by sword , nor by battle , by horses , nor by horsemen .

translation.kha: U paidbah u jubab , Da lei lei ngin ym iehnoh ïa U Trai ban shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei !
translation.en: And the people answered and said , God forbid that we should forsake the  Lord  , to serve other gods  ;

translation.kha: u Sheba u Dei u sekretari ka ïingbishar ; u Sadok bun u Abiathar ki dei ki lyngdoh ,
translation.en: And Sheva was scribe : and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests :
Moreover the brasen altar , that Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , had made , he put before the tabernacle of the  Lord  : and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it .
translation.kha: Ka duwan rnong kaba la thaw da u Besalel , u khun jong u Uri bad u ksiew jong u Hur , ka don ruh ha Gibeon ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . U syiem Solomon bad ki briew baroh ki la mane ïa U  Trai  hangta .
Ko khun , lada phi longsyiem babha stad , lang! sngewtriem shikatdei eh .
translation.en: My son , if thine heart be wise , my heart shall rejoice , even mine .
And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold , of beaten work shalt thou make them , in the two ends of the mercy seat .
translation.kha: Thaw ar tylli ki kherub da ka ksiar kaba la shoh tylli ,
Lym sa katno nga dei ban ap ? Lano men pyndem ïa kito kiba pynshitom ibeiñ ïa nga ?
translation.en: How many are the days of thy servant ? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me ?

translation.kha: ( Jingpynpaw 17 :6-9 ) Ka niam ba bakla ka shong khuslai halor i u parad synshar pyrthei ban pynkohnguh ia la ka rai bad ban pyniaid ia la ka jingialam .
translation.en: * ( Revelation 17 :10-13 ) False religion straddles the back of this political beast , attempting to influence its decisions and to control its direction .

translation.kha: Nga la ong , Ym don jingkyrmen ïa nga ! Nga erlangthari ba la tim namar Kawei pa kawei ka kyntait kaba mih na ki rmiang shyntur Jong nga ka long kaba pop , bad nga shong nga Hukum hapdeng ki briew kiba kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ka long kaba pah . Bad pynïap , da la ki jong ki lamkhmat nga la ïohi ïa U Shimei , U TRAI’ Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Then said I , Woe is me ! for I am undone  ; because I am a man of unclean lips , and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips : for mine eyes have seen the King , the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: ( U Laban u ai ïa ka mraw jong u ka Sippor ha ka Leah ka khun jong u ban shakri ïa ka . )
translation.en: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid .
Know ye not , brethren , (for I speak to them that know the law ) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth ?
translation.kha: Da shisha phin sa sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba ngan sa ong , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , namar phi baroh phi tip ïa ka hukum . Ka hukum ka synshar halor ki briew tang haba ki dang im .

translation.en: O my soul , come not thou into their secret  ; unto their assembly , mine honour , be not thou united : for in their anger they slew a man , and in their selfwill they digged down a wall .
translation.kha: Da lei lei ngan ym ïadon bad ki ha ki jingïaphylliew jingmut barieh jong ki . Da lei lei ngan ym ïasyllok lang bad ki ha ki jingïakynduh jong ki , naba haba ki khie bitar ki pynïap ïa ki briew , bad ki pyndkoh ïa ki masi shynrang kum ka jinglehkai sngewbha .
U la buh ka por kaba dei ïa kaei kaei baroh . U la ai ha ngi ka jingkwah ban tip ïa ka lawei , hynrei um ju ai ha moi ka jinghun ban sngewthuh lur ïa kaei kaba u leh .
translation.en: He hath made every thing beautiful in his time : also he hath set the world in their heart , so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end .
And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God , who liveth for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Nangta uwei na ki saw tylli ki kherub u la ai ha ki hynñiew ngut ki angel ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang ksiar ba la pyndap da ka jingbitar jong U Blei , uba im junom la junom .
kumin ki Rangbah Balang ki Shakri ïa ka Balang ?
translation.en: How Do the Elders Serve the Congregation ?

translation.kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , kaba kut ka la jan ! La ïathuh ha phi ba u Nongshun jong U Kherith un sa wan ; bad mynta ki nongshun babun jong U Khrist ki la lah paw , bad kumta ngi tip ba kaba kut ka la jan .
translation.en: Little children , it is the last time : and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come , even now are there many antichrists  ; whereby we know that it is the last time .

translation.kha: bad seiñpuh ngut na ki nongïathuhlypa ki la bud ïa ki shai ka Jordan . U Elijah badno u Elisha ki la syngkhlieh harud heh , bad ki sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïong khah pajih .
translation.en: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went , and stood to view afar off : and they two stood by Jordan .

translation.kha: Lada me tang shu mih bad leit sha shiliang ka wahduid Yiron , men ïap da shisha — bad me hi men shiah kynnoh .
translation.en: For it shall be , that on the day thou goest out , and passest over the brook Kidron , thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die : thy blood shall be upon thine own head .

translation.kha: Nangta ka jingïohi batyngshaiñ ka iehnoh ïa ka nongbah bad ka la leit sha u lumbah ha ka phang mynhyndai jong ka .
translation.en: And the glory of the  Lord  went up from the midst of the city , and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city .

translation.kha: Kane pat , kam dien ka rukom kaba long hapdeng jong phi . Lada uno uno napdeng jongnga phi u khiah ngab long kiba khraw , u daym ban longkmie u shakri ïa kiwei ;
translation.en: But so shall it not be among you : but whosoever will be great among you , shall be your minister :

translation.kha: Ang la sngewdei ïa kata ka jingai jingmut ; kumta nga la jied khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , uwei na kaei kawei ka jait .
translation.en: And the saying pleased me well : and I took twelve men of you , one of a tribe :

translation.kha: Mano ba lah ban shemphang ïa ka dohnud brup ? Ym don kano Kano kawei pat kaba Shur katta katta ; ka pang jur eh don ïa kaweh ïoh jingkoit .
translation.en: The heart is deceitful above all things , and desperately wicked : who can know it ?

translation.kha: bad u la kren biang ha u haba u Jehoïakim u khun Jong u Josaïah u long u syiem . Hadien kata , U Trai u la kren ha u bun basniew , tad haduh ka snem kabu khatwei jong ka jingsynshar u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Josaïah . Ha u bnai wahbah san jong kata ka snem , ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem la ringmraw ei .
translation.en: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month .

And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven : and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn , and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory .
translation.kha: Nangta ka dak U Khun U Briew kan paw ha ka sahit bneng , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin ïam haba ki ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew ba u wan ha ki lyoh bneng ha ka bor bad ka burom bakhraw .
U Trai u la phah nemsniew shuh ka ri jong ki pynlang u la shim noh ïa baroh ka jingbam jong ki .
translation.en: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land : he brake the whole staff of bread .

translation.kha: Hadien katai , phi tip , u la kwah ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu u kpa jong u , hynrei u la shah kyntait ; namar um ïohlad shuh ban pynkylla ïa kaei kaba u la sa , la u la wad ïa ka da ki jingjaw ummat .
translation.en: For ye know how that afterward , when he would have inherited the blessing , he was rejected : for he found no place of repentance , though he sought it carefully with tears .

translation.kha: u Benaïah , u khun jong u Jehoïada u long uba khmih ïa ki nongïasaid jong u Dabid ; bad ki khun shyieng jong u Dabid ki la long ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites  ; and David s sons were chief rulers .
And he took butter , and milk , and the calf which he had dressed , and set it before them  ; and he stood by them under the tree , and they did eat .
translation.kha: U shim katto katne ka malai , ka dud , bad ka doh , bad u buh ïa kita ki jingbam ha khmat jong kita ki rangbah . Hangta ha trai u dieng u la pynbiang ïa ki da lade hi , bad ki la ïabam .
Ha u Syiem bymjukut , u bymïap shuh bad u bym lah ban ïohi , uba tang ma u hi U Blei — ha u to long ka jingpyndonburom bad ka burom junom la junom ! Enaim .
translation.en: Now unto the King eternal , immortal , invisible , the only wise God , be honour and glory for ever and ever . Amen .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki biria ka Tyros ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la ring ïa u paidbah baroh sha ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki Edom , bad kim shym bat ïa ka jutang ka jingïalong paralok ba ki la ïateh .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Tyre , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom , and remembered not the brotherly covenant :

translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Asher u ong , U Asher u khnam ïor jingkyrkhu ban ïa la ki la jait . To ki imon ki na jong u kin burom eh ïa u , Bad to ka ri jrong u kan ba-dap da ki diengsoh Olib .
translation.en: And of Asher he said , Let Asher be blessed with children  ; let him be acceptable to his brethren , and let him dip his foot in oil .

translation.kha: Hangno , namarkata , ka don ka thymmei jong ka jingstad ? Hangno i'u lah ban ïoh jingaiei ban shemphang ?
translation.en: Whence then cometh wisdom ? and where is the place of understanding ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ïa ka Jerusalem , Ki nongwei kin thew pat ïa ki kynroh jong pha , bad ki syiem jong ki kin shakri ïa pha . Ha ka jingbet jong nga , nga la pynshitom ïa pha , hynrei mynta ngan pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bad jingisynei jong nga ïa Phah .
translation.en: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls , and their kings shall minister unto thee : for in my wrath I smote thee , but in my favour have I had mercy on thee .

translation.kha: bad kumba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha la ka bor ba synshar , kumta ngan ai ha phi ïa kajuh ka bor .
translation.en: And I appoint unto you a kingdom , as my Father hath appointed unto me  ;

translation.kha: Ka aiñ kaba me la ai ka kham kordor ïa nga ban ïa ka pisa baroh ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver .
The words of Agur the son of Jakeh , even the prophecy : the man spake unto Ithiel , even unto Ithiel and Ucal ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki ktien bashongkhia jong u Agur u khun jong u Jakeh :  U Blei um long bad nga , U Blei um long bad nga , bad nga long khlem jingïarap .
da kaba siewdor ïa uwei uwei san shekel ka rupa kat kum ka jingthew kaba buh ryntih ,
translation.en: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari , whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .
And when David s young men came , they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David , and ceased .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Nabal ha ka kyrteng u Dabid .
Bad kumta U Trai hi u ong ba un lieng noh ïa me . Ha shuwa ban kut kane ka snem manna ïap namar me la ong ïa ki briew ban ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U TRAI’ .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will cast thee from off the face of the earth : this year thou shalt die , because thou hast taught rebellion against the  Lord .
And repayeth them that hate him to their face , to destroy them : he will not be slack to him that hateth him , he will repay him to his face .
translation.kha: hynrei un ym pynslem ban pynshitom ïa kito kiba isih ïa u .
Neng pyn-i ha phi ïano ban sheptieng : To shaphang ïa U Blei , uba , hadien ka jingpynïap , u don ka kun ban prut sha ka dujok . To ngeit ïa nga , u long ma u uta uba phi dih ban sheptieng !
translation.en: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear : Fear him , which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell  ; yea , I say unto you , Fear him .

translation.kha: To ïeng ïaroh ïa U Blei ñiar ka jingaiei ba-dap da ka burom jong u , ïa ka jingai ei u la ai ha ngi ha U Khun uba ieit jong u!
translation.en: To the praise of the glory of his grace , wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved .
And he went after the man of Israel into the tent , and thrust both of them through , the man of Israel , and the woman through her belly . So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U la shim ïa u sum , u la bud ïa uta u shynrang bad kata ka kynthei shapoh ïingjaiñ , bad u dung ïap da u sum ïa ki baroh ar ngut . Da kumne la pynsangeh ïa ka jingïapthem kaba la pynjot ïa ki Israel ,

translation.en: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious ?
translation.kha: Lada kata ka Hukum , kaba wallam ïa ka jingïap haba la pyntreikam ïa ka , ka la wan ha kat kata ka burom , kaba katno tam ka burom kaba kham khraw ka long kata ka jingtrei jong U Mynsiem!
La don kawei ka kynthei kaba stad hapoh ka nongkhap naba la pyrta na ka kynroh , Ha sngap ! Ha sngap ! Ong ïa u Joab ba un wiang hangne ; la kwah ban ïakren bad u .
translation.en: Then cried a wise woman out of the city , Hear , hear  ; say , I pray you , unto Joab , Come near hither , that I may speak with thee .

And she said , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he awoke out of his sleep , and said , I will go out as at other times before , and shake myself . And he wist not that the  Lord  was departed from him .
translation.kha: Nangta ka pyrta ,  Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wan !  U khie joit bad u pyrkhat ,  Ngan pynsynjor bad pyllait war , kumba mynshuwa .  Um shym tip ba U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa u .
Ha kaba ïadei bad ki lyngdoh ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew la lum da ki briew kiba dei ban ïap ; hynrei ïa u Meshekh ïa kylla-kaba-mut la lum da uta babha im , kumba ka jingkynthoh Bakhuid ka ong .
translation.en: And here men that die receive tithes  ; but there he receiveth them , of whom it is witnessed that he liveth .
And Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of the  Lord  , died , being an hundred and ten years old .
translation.kha: U Joshua u shakri U  Trai  , u khun jong u Nun , u la ïap ha ka rta kaba shispah shiphew snem .

La lynthem maw ïa ki , la ot arliang ïa ki , la pynïap ïa ki da ka waitlam . Ki la ïaid kylleng , ki da phrang da ki jaiñ snieh langbrot Lane snieh blang — ha ka jingduk , ha ka jingshah pynshitom , bad ha ka jingshah lehbeiñ .
translation.en: They were stoned , they were sawn asunder , were tempted , were slain with the sword : they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins  ; being destitute , afflicted , tormented  ;

translation.kha: To kyrpad ïa U Blei ba-bang kyrkhu ïa kito kiba pynshitom ïa phi — ho-oid , to jingkyrpad ïa u don kyrkhu , ym ban tim .
translation.en: Bless them which persecute you : bless , and curse not .

translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei ba ngam shym la pynbaptis ïano ïano na phi lait noh ïa u Krispos sad u Gaïos .
translation.en: I thank God that I baptized none of you , but Crispus and Gaius ;
And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot , Jonathan cried after the lad , and said , Is not the arrow beyond thee ?
translation.kha: Haba uta u khynnah u poi ha ka jaka ba uta u khnam u la hap , u Jonathan u pyrta ïa u ,  U khnam u don kham sha jngai na phi !

translation.en: And when the people were come into the wood , behold , the honey dropped  ; but no man put his hand to his mouth : for the people feared the oath .
translation.kha: Ki dieng ki la dap da ka ngap , hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba la bam ei ei na ka namar baroh ki sheptieng ïa ka jingtim ka jong u Saul .

translation.en: The word which came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,
Hadien kane , U Jisu bad ka kmierad jong u , ki para shynrang jong u , bad ki synran ki la leit sha Kapernam bad ki la sawa hangta katto kattne sngi .
translation.en: After this he went down to Capernaum , he , and his mother , and his brethren , and his disciples : and they continued there not many days .
He that heareth you heareth me  ; and he that despiseth you despiseth me  ; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  Uno uno uba shahshkor ïa phi u shahshkor ïa nga ; uno uno uba kyntait ïa phi u kyntait ïa nga ; bad uno uno uba kyntait ïa nga u kyntait ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga .

Ki briew U Tiras ki la riewspah , hynriewphew kiba ïaleh pyrshah ; ki la sngaid bad ki la dap bha da ka jingbam . Te ki la iehnoh ïa U Blei uba la thaw ïa ki , bad ki la kyntait ïa u nongpynim bakhrawbor jong ki .
translation.en: But Jeshurun waxed fat , and kicked : thou art waxen fat , thou art grown thick , thou art covered with fatness  ; then he forsook God which made him , and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation .

translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki long ki khang phlang ha kaba la bsa ïa ki , ha kaba ki wad ïa Kanaan kan kaba jingrem ban bam .
translation.en: The range of the mountains is his pasture , and he searcheth after every green thing .
Woe unto them that call evil good , and good evil  ; that put darkness for light , and light for darkness  ; that put bitter for sweet , and sweet for bitter !
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi khot kaba bha ïa kaba sniew bad kaba sniew ïa kaba bha . Phi pynphai ïa ka jingdum sha ka jingshai bad ïa ka jingshai sha ka jingdum . Phi pynlong kaba thiang ïa kaba kthang bad kaba kthang ïa kaba thiang .
U shna ïa Us ki jingbah da ka dieng akasia bad u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold .

translation.kha: U pynbiang shibun ka nar ban shna preg bad ki nar ban pyndait ïa ki khyrdop dieng , bad saihon ka rnong haduh ba ym don ba lah ban thew ïa ka .
translation.en: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates , and for the joinings  ; and brass in abundance without weight  ;

translation.kha: U la kylli ïa nga , Amos , me ïew aïu ? U Sawar , nga la jubab . Nangta u ong , Nga pyndonkam ïa u ban pyn-i ba ki briew jongno nga ki long kum ka kynroh ka bym biang sawar . Ngan ym kylla shuh la ka jingmut shaphang ka pynbudnam ïa ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Amos , what seest thou ? And I said , A plumbline . Then said the Lord , Behold , I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel : I will not again pass by them any more :

translation.kha: Ka tam Hassenaah ka tei ïa ka Kyrpad Dohkha . Ki shuh ïa ki bim nabar pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pynsat ïa ki nar-khang bad ki jingkhan ïa ka khrup .
translation.en: But the fish gate did the sons of Hassenaah build , who also laid the beams thereof , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof .

translation.kha: bad to ka long ka jingïaroh ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh uba ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop shalor ki nongshun jong phi ! Bun u Abram u ai ha u Melkhisedek ïa kaba shiphew na ka jinglute kaba u la lah pynïoh pat .
translation.en: And blessed be the most high God , which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand . And he gave him tithes of all .
Afterward he brought me to the gate , even the gate that looketh toward the east :
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop kaba phai shaphang mihngi ,
namar jong ki kiei kiba khraw kiba U Blei’ Badonburom barieh u la leh na ka bynta jongu nga . Ka kyrteng jong u ka longïng kaba khuid ;
translation.en: For he that is mighty hath done to me great things  ; and holy is his name .
Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked , and the scant measure that is abominable ?
translation.kha: Ha ki ïing jong ki briew kiba sniew don ki jingkynshew kiba ki la lum da kaba leh bymhok . Ki pyndonkam da ki jingthew bashukor , kaei kaei kaba nga isih .
Na ka jait u Merari ki mih ki longïing jong u Mahli bad u Mushi .
translation.en: And this is the charge of their burden , according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation  ; the boards of the tabernacle , and the bars thereof , and the pillars thereof , and sockets thereof ,

translation.kha: Hynrei u Pharaoh u la ïai-ong ha u Mushi malade u Aaron , Phi mut kumno da kambah pynlong ïa ki briew ban leh kli ïa la ki kam ? Ong ïa ki ban otsher sha la ki kdew ki kam !
translation.en: And the king of Egypt said unto them , Wherefore do ye , Moses and Aaron , let the people from their works ? get you unto your burdens .

translation.kha: Lane hato phin ai ha u da u bseiñ haba u pan ïa ka dohthang ?
translation.en: Or if he ask a fish , will he give him a serpent ?

translation.kha: Ngi don ki phasi , ki kada , ki langbrot , ki blang , bad ki mraw . Nga pham ktem sha phi ko kynrad da ka jingkyrmen ba ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong phi .
translation.en: And I have oxen , and asses , flocks , and menservants , and womenservants : and I have sent to tell my lord , that I may find grace in thy sight .
For sin , taking occasion by the commandment , deceived me , and by it slew me .
translation.kha: Ka pop ka la ïoh ïa ka lad , bad da ka lad jong ka hukum , ka la shukor ïa nga bad ka la pynïap ïa nga .

u thang jingiwbih ha ka Them Hinnom , malu u kñia wat ïa la ki jong ki khun shynrang kumno ki jingangnud thang ïa ki thliew , da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh ïa-bujli jongnga ki jaitbynriew ïa kiba U Trai u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki Jeruel ki nang tur shaphrang .
translation.en: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom , and burnt his children in the fire , after the abominations of the heathen whom the  Lord  had cast out before the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por , namar jongnga u Joseph , U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa ka longïing longsem jong u nong Ijipt , malade ïa keiñ kiei baroh kiba u don ha ïohnong ka sem jong u lane ha lyngkha jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house , and over all that he had , that the  Lord  blessed the Egyptian s house for Joseph s sake  ; and the blessing of the  Lord  was upon all that he had in the house , and in the field .
And Saul said unto his uncle , He told us plainly that the asses were found . But of the matter of the kingdom , whereof Samuel spake , he told him not .
translation.kha: U ïathuh ïa ngi ba la lap ïa ki kada ,  u Saul u jubab — hynrei um shym ïathuh ha u kñi jong u ïa kaei kaba u Samuel u la kren shaphang ka jingpynlong Syiem ïa u .

translation.en: For as the rain cometh down , and the snow from heaven , and returneth not thither , but watereth the earth , and maketh it bring forth and bud , that it may give seed to the sower , and bread to the eater :
translation.kha: Ka ktien jong nga ka long kum ka ïor bad u slap kiba wan hap na suiñbneng ban ai um ïa ka pyrthei . Ki pynlong ïa ki jingthung ban san bad pynmih ïa u symbai ban ïoh bet bad ka jingbam ban bam .
Baroh kiei kai Kaba u Jehoïakim u la leh la buh jingkhih ha Ka Histori ïohnang Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha u buid jngai ka Mysia , ki la pyrshang ban leit shat ka Probins jong ka Bithynia , hynrei U Mynhyndai jongu U ijuh um shym shah ïa ki .
translation.en: After they were come to Mysia , they assayed to go into Bithynia : but the Spirit suffered them not .

translation.kha: Hadien sawphew sngi u Noah u plie ïa ka jinglyngkhuit , bad u pyllait ïa ka tyngam .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of forty days , that Noah opened the window of the ark which he had made :

translation.kha: Haba U Jiw u la dap khat-ar snem ka rta , ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Maim kumba ju long .
translation.en: And when he was twelve years old , they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast .

And he that blasphemeth the name of the  Lord  , he shall surely be put to death , and all the congregation shall certainly stone him : as well the stranger , as he that is born in the land , when he blasphemeth the name of the  Lord  , shall be put to death .
translation.kha: Uno uno u Israel lane u nongwei uba shong ha Israel uba krenbeiñ ïa U  Trai  un shah lynthem maw ha u paidbah haduh ba un da ïap .
shahïap ïa nga , A Trai , ban jam ïa ka wah Jordan malu ïohi ïa kata ka ri kaba sat shatai shai shiliang , ka ri lum kaba jingitynnat , bad ki Lum Lebanon .’
translation.en: I pray thee , let me go over , and see the good land that is beyond Jordan , that goodly mountain , and Lebanon .

translation.kha: U ai ha nawei pa uwei u shynrong bad ha kawei pa katai ka kynthei ha Israel ïa u kpu bad ka dohthang bad katto katne ki soh khadar .
