translation.en: And he dealt to every one of Israel , both man and woman , to every one a loaf of bread , and a good piece of flesh , and a flagon of wine .
And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought , and the rock is removed out of his place .
translation.kha: Ka por ka poi haba ki lumbah ki twa bad ki mawsiang baskhem ki kynriah noh .

Ïa ka set jong u Joseph , kaba ki bastad Israel ki la wanrah na jingïaphet , la thet ha Shekhem , ha kata ka jaka ba u Jakob u la thied ha ka dor shispah thyllah ki sbai rupa na ki khun jong u Hamor , u Kpa Jong u Shekhem . Ïa kaei ka jaka la ïohpateng da ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph .
translation.en: And the bones of Joseph , which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt , buried they in Shechem , in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver : and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph .
And he said , He that shewed mercy on him . Then said Jesus unto him ,  Go , and do thou likewise .
translation.kha: U Nonghikai ka Hukum u la jubab ,  Uta uba la lehbha ïa u .  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Te , ma me khie leit bad leh kumjuh .
hynñiew ngim shym la shah ïa u Balaam , kumta u la kyrkhu ïa phi , bad da kumta nga la pyllait ïa phi na u Balak .
translation.en: But I would not hearken unto Balaam  ; therefore he blessed you still : so I delivered you out of his hand .

translation.kha: U briew uba Kum uta , um da baneh kut jingmut bad Ban rai ha kiei kiei baroh’ ba u leh , um dei ban pyrkhat ba un sa ïohpdiang ei ei na U Trai .
translation.en: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways .

translation.kha: Kumno phna sngew lapbah phi tip ba phin sa ia kynduh biang bad kiba imat ki jongphi- ha kane ka pyrthei , hapdeng ka jingsliang jingman ba bha tam .
translation.en: How would you feel if you knew that a reunion with your loved ones was possible right here on earth under the best of conditions ?

translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka iaki kaba ki longïing na ka jat Sebulun ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jongu ki .
translation.en: This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families , these cities with their villages .

And Ben–hadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together : and there were thirty and two kings with him , and horses , and chariots : and he went up and besieged Samaria , and warred against it .
translation.kha: U Benhadad u syiem ka Syria u la ïalumlang ïa ki shipai jong u baroh , bad ba la kyrshan da ki laiphew ar ngut kiwei pat ki nongsynshar lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom jong ki , u la tur bad kerkut ïa ka Samaria bad hiarthma ïa ka .
Phin tap prie noh ïa kaba phi la bam , bun baroh ki ktien pynduhbor jong pa ken sep-ei .
translation.en: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up , and lose thy sweet words .

translation.kha: Kumta keiñ , baroh ar ngut ki khun kynthei jong u Lot ki la punkhun na u kpa la jong .
translation.en: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father .
Praise him , ye heavens of heavens , and ye waters that be above the heavens .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki bneng bajrong tam , bad ki um halor ka sahit bneng .

translation.en: Have all the gifts of healing ? do all speak with tongues ? do all interpret ?
translation.kha: Baroh kim long ki Apostol ne ki nongïathuhlypa ne ki nonghikai . Ym baroh ki don ïa ka bor ban leh ïa ki kambah lane ban pynkhiah ïa ki jingpang lane ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher lane ban batai ïa kaei kaba la kren .

translation.en: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand , with part of the vessels of the house of God : which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god  ; and he brought the vessels into the treasure house of his god .
translation.kha: U Trai u la shah ïa u ban kem ïa u Syiem Jehoïakim bad kurup katto katne ki jingkynshew jong ka Templ . U la shim pat katto katne ngut ki koidi lem bad u sha ka templ jong ki blei jong u ha Babilon , bad u la buh ïa ka jingkynshew ba la ïoh kurup ha ki jaka kynshew ka templ .
Nga hi nga la pyrthat ba nga daiñ Ban leh ïa kaei kai baroh kaba nga lah pyrshah ïa ka jingshitom U Jeshua uba na Anaharath .
translation.en: I verily thought with myself , that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem katba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jehosheba , u syiem Joïada , u Joram u khun jrong u Ahab u la long u syiem ka Israel ; bad u la synshar khat-ar snem ha Samaria .
translation.en: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and reigned twelve years .

translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la riam ha ki jaiñ ba sawbthuh bad basaw hain hain , bad ba la tap da ki jingsdang ksing , ki mawkordor , bad ki paila . Ha ka kti jong ka , ka la bat ïa ka khuid ksiar kaba dap da kiei ki kiba isaitmet bad ijakhlia , kiba mih na ka jingawria jong ka .
translation.en: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour , and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls , having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication :

translation.kha: Jied ïa ka jingbthah jong nga , ban ïa ka rupa ; jied ïa ka jingtip , ban ïa ka ksiew nala .
translation.en: Receive my instruction , and not silver  ; and knowledge rather than choice gold .
Now therefore , I pray thee , if I have found grace in thy sight , shew me now thy way , that I may know thee , that I may find grace in thy sight : and consider that this nation is thy people .
translation.kha: Lada ka long kumta , nga kyrpad ïa me ba men ïathuh ha nga ïa ki jingthmu jong me , khnang ba nga lah ban ïai shakri bad pynsngewbha ïa me . To da kynmaw ruh ba me la jied ïa kane ka jaitbynriew ba kan long u paidlang jong me .
La pyndap ïa ki da baroh ki jait jingbymman , ka jingsniew , ka jingkwah lalot bad ka jingthala ; ki dap da ka jingbishni , ka jingpynïap briew , ka jingïaleh , ka jingshukor , ka jingshun .
translation.en: Being filled with all unrighteousness , fornication , wickedness , covetousness , maliciousness ; full of envy , murder , debate , deceit , malignity ; whisperers ,

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , to pynphai noh ïa kato ka briew ha u tnaw jong ka . U dei u nongïathuhlypa , bad un sa duwai na ka bynta jong me , ba kumta men ym ïap . Hynrei lada mem pynphai pat ïa ka , nga maham ïa me ba nam ïap , ma me nabar ki briew jong me baroh .
translation.en: Now therefore restore the man his wife  ; for he is a prophet , and he shall pray for thee , and thou shalt live : and if thou restore her not , know thou that thou shalt surely die , thou , and all that are thine .

translation.kha: Hynriew U Jisu u la ong , Keiñ noh kane ! U la ktah ïa ka shkor lad uta u briew bad u la pynkhiah ïa u .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said ,  Suffer ye thus far .  And he touched his ear , and healed him .
And if the avenger of blood pursue after him , then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand  ; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly , and hated him not beforetime .
translation.kha: Lada uta uba wad kput u bud ïa u shata , ki briew jong ka nongbah kim dei ban aiti ïa u ha uta . Ki dei ban ïada ïa u namar ba u la pynïap ïa u briew da ka jingjia ryngkhat bad ym na ka jingbitar .

translation.en: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God  ; and all these things shall be added unto you .
translation.kha: Pynban , to pyrkhat ïa ka Hima jong u , bad un pyndap ïa phi da kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: In that day shall messengers go forth from me in ships to make the careless Ethiopians afraid , and great pain shall come upon them , as in the day of Egypt : for , lo , it cometh .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka wan bad ïa ka Ijipt la pynjot , ngan phah ïa ki nonglamktien ha ki liengbah ban pynkhih ïa ki briew ki bym poi pyrkhat jong ka Sudan , bad kin sngewtriem . Kata ka sngi ka la jan wan !

translation.en: And he set the one in Beth–el , and the other put he in Dan .
translation.kha: U buh ïa uwei u khun masi ksiar ha Bethel bad ïa uwei pat ha Dan .
hadien kata u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Pirathon ha ka ri ki Ephraim ha ka ri lum Jong ki Amalek .
translation.en: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died , and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim , in the mount of the Amalekites .

translation.kha: Ki shnong ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad ki buh ïa ki na shapoh jong ka jingdiang shadem ha ki tduh kiba sha trai jong ka , hajan ka ephod .
translation.en: And they made two rings of gold , and put them on the two ends of the breastplate , upon the border of it , which was on the side of the ephod inward .

translation.kha: Bad hir nga la kyrpad ïa me don shahshkor ïa ka jingkyang jong nga , me la ïohsngew .
translation.en: Thou hast heard my voice : hide not thine ear at my breathing , at my cry .
Beside the chief of Solomon s officers which were over the work , three thousand and three hundred , which ruled over the people that wrought in the work .
translation.kha: bad u la buh lai hajar laispah ngut ki riewkhmat kiba peit ïa ki bad kiba pynïaid ïa ki jingtrei jong ki .

translation.en: When they took hold of thee by thy hand , thou didst break , and rend all their shoulder : and when they leaned upon thee , thou brakest , and madest all their loins to be at a stand .
translation.kha: Haba ki shaniah ha phi , phi kheiñ noh , u dung ïa ki tohtit jong ki , bad pynlong ïa ki ban pynkdor ïa la ki met .

U Dabid u ai ha u Shelomoth ïa ka dur pynkhreh jong ka jingïohi baroh jong ka Templ , badno ïa ki kamra buh tiar jong ka mala ïa kiwei pat ki kamra pynlang ïa ka jaka kaba kyntang tam , ha kaba la map ïa ki pop .
translation.en: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch , and of the houses thereof , and of the treasuries thereof , and of the upper chambers thereof , and of the inner parlours thereof , and of the place of the mercy seat ,

translation.kha: Wan kiew sha sa ha uta u lum , malu ngan thoh ha kita ki mawlynnai ïa kito ki kiei uba nga la thoh ha ki mawlyngkniap ïa kiba me la lynthaw , bad nangta men nguh ïa ki ha kata ka synduk .’
translation.en: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest , and thou shalt put them in the ark .
Behold , I will bring again the shadow of the degrees , which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz , ten degrees backward . So the sun returned ten degrees , by which degrees it was gone down .
translation.kha: Ha ka lynti mawkyrdon ba la tei da u syiem Ahas , U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew jam shadien .  Bad ka syrngiew ka kynriah shiphew jam shadien .

translation.en: But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors , and brought them forth , and said ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet u angel jong U Trai u la plie ïa ki khyrdop ka byndi , u la ïalam shabar ïa ki apostol , bad u la ong ha ki ,

U Sisera u la thait haduh katta katta ba u da ïathiah jar . Nangta ka Jael ka shim ïa u tyrnem bad u snar pynskhem dara , ka la rupa mian mian sha u , bad ka pynïap ïa u da kaba praw ïa u snar na ka Me moi jongno u ha ban da pahai phlait haduh khyndew .
translation.en: Then Jael Heber s wife took a nail of the tent , and took an hammer in her hand , and went softly unto him , and smote the nail into his temples , and fastened it into the ground : for he was fast asleep and weary . So he died .

translation.kha: ki ai ruh khynñiat ki soh Dumbur tyrkhong , bad ar rynjup ki soh kynjoh . Iddo u la dap bam , u la ïohbor biang ; nia um shym la bam la dih ei ei la lai sngap pura .
translation.en: And they gave him a piece of a cake of figs , and two clusters of raisins : and when he had eaten , his spirit came again to him : for he had eaten no bread , nor drunk any water , three days and three nights .

translation.kha: namar u long u Shakri jong U Blei uba trei na ka bynta ka jingbna jong phi hi . Hynrei lada phi leh ïa kaba sniew , te to bthing ïa u , namar ka bor jong u ban pynshitom ka longïng kaba dat . U long u shakri jong U Blei bad u pyntreikam ïa ka jingpynshitom U Blei halor kito kiba leh ïa kaba sngi .
translation.en: For he is the minister of God to thee for good . But if thou do that which is evil , be afraid ; for he beareth not the sword in vain : for he is the minister of God , a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil .
And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord , to the glory of God the Father .
translation.kha: bad baroh kin pynbna shynna ba U Jisu Khrist u long U Trai , ïa ka burom U Blei uba U Kpa .
Mynta u kitkhlieh ban ïarap sad ïada ïa nga .
translation.en: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede , even I , stood to confirm and to strengthen him .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga ,
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ngan kner ïa ka hima na u khum jong u Solomon bun ngan ai ha me shiphew jait ,
translation.en: But I will take the kingdom out of his son s hand , and will give it unto thee , even ten tribes .

translation.kha: ban hukum ïa ki Lyngdoh kiba Bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ban wan kiew nep na ka Joanan .
translation.en: Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony , that they come up out of Jordan .

translation.kha: Nga la kylli , Ko Trai , balei ka ri ka ha ka jingjot jingpra bad ka tyrkhong kum ka ri shyiap , ba ym don mano mian ba leit jingleit lyntang jong ka ? Uei uba stad eh ban shemphang ïa kane ? Hano me la batai ïa ka ba u lah ban ïathiah ha kiwei paw ?
translation.en: Who is the wise man , that may understand this ? and who is he to whom the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken , that he may declare it , for what the land perisheth and is burned up like a wilderness , that none passeth through ?

translation.kha: Ki jongngi u Patsha , ki la jubab . Kumta U Jisu u la Ong ha ki , Kumta , te , to siew sha u Pisgah ïa katei kaba dei ka jong u Patsha , bad sawphew shata U Blei ïa kaei kaba dei ka jyllang U Blei .
translation.en: They say unto him , Caesar s . Then saith he unto them ,  Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar s  ; and unto God the things that are God s .

And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant , wherein your fathers have dwelt  ; and they shall dwell therein , even they , and their children , and their children s children for ever : and my servant David shall be their prince for ever .
translation.kha: Kin shong ha ka ri ba nga la ai ha u shakri jong nga u Jakob , ka ri ha kaba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki shong ki sah . Kin shong junom hangta , bad kumta ruh ki khun jong ki bad baroh kiba hiarpateng na ki . U syiem uba kum u shakri jong nga , u Dabid un synshar halor jong ki junom .
Kumba la don ha thoh , U blang u la pynluin ïa ki jingmut bad ki dohnud jong ki , haduh kane hi ka sngi Ki Lah ban ïohi ne ïohsngew .
translation.en: (According as it is written , God hath given them the spirit of slumber , eyes that they should not see , and ears that they should not hear ;) unto this day .

translation.kha: Ïa ki kulai na ka bynta u Simeon la Wan kit na Musri malade na kiwei pat ki ri .
translation.en: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt , and out of all lands .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ainong ïa ki , U Mosah u la thoh ïa kane ka hukum na ka bynta jong phi , namar ba ka long kaba eh ban Hikai ïa phi .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept .

And this is the manner of the release : Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it  ; he shall not exact it of his neighbour , or of his brother  ; because it is called the  Lord s  release .
translation.kha: Haba map , dei ban leh kumne . Uwei pa uwei uba ai ram ha la u para Israel u dei ban map ïa kata ka ram ; um dei ban dawa shuh ïa ka , namar ba U  Trai  hi u la map ïa ka .

translation.en: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him , he touched the hollow of his thigh  ; and the hollow of Jacob s thigh was out of joint , as he wrestled with him .
translation.kha: Haba uta u briew u ïohi ba um lah jop ïa u Jakob , u kura ïa u na ka skhep ; bad kata ka skhep jong u ka la lait .

translation.en: Unto the pure all things are pure : but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure ; but even their mind and conscience is defiled .
translation.kha: Baroh ka long kaba khuid ha kito kiba long kiba khuid ha lade ; hynrei ym don kaba khuid ha kito kiba la tngit bad ki bymngeit , namar ba ki jingmut bad ki jingïatiplem jong ki , ki long ba la pyntngit .

translation.en: And Moses alone shall come near the  Lord  : but they shall not come nigh  ; neither shall the people go up with him .
translation.kha: Tang ma me marwei men wan sha jan jong nga ; kita kiwei pat kim bit ban wan sha jan . U paidbah lei lei um bit ban wan kiew sha uta u lum .
Kat katto ngut ki ong ba me long u Ïoannis u nongpynkheiñ , ki la jubab ; kiwei pud ki ong ba me long u Elisha , katba Kiwei pat ki ong ba me long uwei na ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And they answered , John the Baptist : but some say , Elias  ; and others , One of the prophets .
For he shall not much remember the days of his life  ; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart .
translation.kha: Namar U Blei u la shah ïa ngi ban kmen , ngin ym khuslai shibun shaphang katno ka jingim ka long kaba lyngkot .
U shakri um shym kein shibun ban siew ïa ka ram jong u , kumta u symboh u la Law ba ïa uta dei ngab die mraw noh , ïa ka tnga bad ki khwan jongki u bad baroh uba u la don khnang ban siew ïa ka ram .
translation.en: But forasmuch as he had not to pay , his lord commanded him to be sold , and his wife , and children , and all that he had , and payment to be made .

translation.kha: Ka por kan poi , ong U Tiras , haba ngan lumlang ïa ki biria kiba nga la pynbudnam , kito kiba la Shahasumah ha ka jingshah ringmraw .
translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  , will I assemble her that halteth , and I will gather her that is driven out , and her that I have afflicted  ;

translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha u Aaron , bad ha ki ar ngut ki khun shynraiñ jong u kiba ding sah , u Eleasar bad u Ithamar , Shim ïa ka jingainguh bam kob sah na kata ka jingbam kaba la kynsha sha U Trai , pynlong kpu khlem thiat da ka bad bam ïa ka harud ka duwan , namar khnai ka jingkñia ka long kaba khuid bha .
translation.en: And Moses spake unto Aaron , and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar , his sons that were left , Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and eat it without leaven beside the altar : for it is most holy :

translation.kha: Phi bad baroh kabu phi lai kim long ei ei ; kito kiba Mano ïa phi ki longsem kiba isaitmet !
translation.en: Behold , ye are of nothing , and your work of nought : an abomination is he that chooseth you .

translation.kha: Uwei pat u la ong , ‘ Nga la thied san jrong ki masi dab bad nga kein ha ka lynti ban tynjuh ïa ki ; sngewbha pdiang ïa ka jingbymlah wan jongnga la .’
translation.en: And another said , I have bought five yoke of oxen , and I go to prove them : I pray thee have me excused .

translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ki ka kynduh ïa ka Jaser bad ki nongbah baroh jong ka Gilead , shiteng na ka ri ki Amnon haduh Aroer , kaba ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Rabbah ;
translation.en: And their coast was Jazer , and all the cities of Gilead , and half the land of the children of Ammon , unto Aroer that is before Rabbah  ;
And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them , that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes  ; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban sumar ïa kane ka jingpynbeit ryntih ha ki por ki ban wan baroh . Uta u briew uba synreit ïa ka um ka jingpynkhuid u dei ruh ban sait ïa la ki jaiñ ; uno uno uba ktah ïa kata ka um u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
Ïa kine baroh la buh jingthoh naba ki la jop da ka jingngeit ! hynrei kim shym la ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaweh U Blei u la kular .
translation.en: And these all , having obtained a good report through faith , received not the promise :

translation.kha: Shaneng na kaba beh kthong ïa ar ! ong u Abiram . Kiei leit beh ïa uwei na ki shipai bad shim kat ïa kaba u don . Khenani u Asahel u ïai beh kthong hi sia ïa u .
translation.en: And Abner said to him , Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left , and lay thee hold on one of the young men , and take thee his armour . But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him .

translation.kha: Ki ar ngut ki sakhi ki long ki ar tylli ki dieng Ahitub bad ki ar tylli ki diengpynïeng sharak kiba ïing ha khmat U Trai jongu ka pyrthei .
translation.en: These are the two olive trees , and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth .
For I , saith the  Lord  , will be unto her a wall of fire round about , and will be the glory in the midst of her .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la lah kular ba ma u hi un long ka kynroh ding sawdong ïa ka nongbah ban ïada ïa ka bad ba un shong un sah hangta ha ka burom jong u baroh .
U Jisu u la hukum ïa u mynsiem , sngew jar bad mihnoh na une u briew ! U mynsiem bymkhuid u la bret ïa uta u briew sha madan ha khmut jong ki , bad u la Mynno na u , khlem pynkynroi ei ei ïa u .
translation.en: And Jesus rebuked him , saying ,  Hold thy peace , and come out of him .  And when the devil had thrown him in the midst , he came out of him , and hurt him not .
The man answered and said unto them , Why herein is a marvellous thing , that ye know not from whence he is , and yet he hath opened mine eyes .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la jubab ,  Kata te kaba da phylla ! Phim tip nangno u wan , hynrei u la pynkoit ïa nga na ka jingmatlah jong nga !

U Syiem Salmunna u la pyndonkam da ka jingpyntrei jubor ban theh ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , ban pyndap khyndew ïa ka jaka ha ka phang mihngi jong ka nongbah , bad ban shna ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah . U la pyndonkam ruh ïa ka , na ka bynta ban tei pat ïa ki nongbah Hasor , Megiddo bad Geser .
translation.en: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised  ; for to build the house of the  Lord  , and his own house , and Millo , and the wall of Jerusalem , and Hazor , and Megiddo , and Gezer .

translation.kha: Pynban , ngi kren borabor kumba U Blei’ u kwah ïa ngi kumne , nalor u la ñiew ïa im ibha bit ba-bang shaniah ïa ka khohruh Babha . Ngam Shim pylleng ban pynsngewbha ïa ki briew , hynriewphew , pun pynsngewbha ïa U Blei , uba tynjuh ïa ki jingthmu jong ngi .
translation.en: But as we were allowed of God to be put in trust with the gospel , even so we speak ; not as pleasing men , but God , which trieth our hearts .

translation.kha: Hynriew lada bhor kin woh bad ïng ha khmat jngai nga , ngan ym shem kad tong uwei ruh na ki ba u long suba stad .
translation.en: But as for you all , do ye return , and come now : for I cannot find one wise man among you .
And Moses  father in law said unto him , The thing that thou doest is not good .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jethro u ong ,  Phim shym leh satia ïa kane ha ka rukom kaba dei .
Lada hynñiew ngut ki myn yn pynïap ban sieb na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa u Kain , Jingïohipaw hynñiew ngut ki mynsiem yn pynïap lada uno uno u pynïap ïa ang .
translation.en: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold , truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold .
And the  Lord  said unto Satan , From whence comest thou ? And Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , From going to and fro in the earth , and from walking up and down in it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylli ïa u ,  Na-ei me wan ?  U Soitan u jubab ,  Nga la leit ïaid shane bad shatai , da kaba shang kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei .

Ka long ka jingidiaw jingkyrmen ! Nga erlangthari kum u bri uba thngan uba shem ba ym don soh ba ïan sah ha ki dieng bad ym don sohwaiñ ha ki dieng sohwaiñ . Ïa baroh ki sohwaiñ bad baroh ki sohkew thombor ba-bang la kheit lut .
translation.en: Woe is me ! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits , as the grapegleanings of the vintage : there is no cluster to eat : my soul desired the firstripe fruit .

translation.kha: Ngi la phai sawdong ban peit uei uba la krong ïa nga , sad nga la ïohi ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki diengpynïeng sharak ksiar ,
translation.en: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me . And being turned , I saw seven golden candlesticks  ;
And when Jehu was come to Jezreel , Jezebel heard of it  ; and she painted her face , and tired her head , and looked out at a window .
translation.kha: U Jehu u la wan poi ha Jesreel . Ka Jesebel , haba ka la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia , ka kyllan rong ïa la ki khmat , ka pynbeit ïa u shñiuh jong ka , bad ka ïeng ban khmih shapoh ka surok na ka jingkhangïit ha ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And they found Adoni–bezek in Bezek : and they fought against him , and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites .
translation.kha: Ki la lap ïa u Adonibesek hangta bad ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
Hynrei phim bitar ïa-ban baibam ïa ka snam jong ki ; phi dei ban theh ïa ka ha ka khyndew wohnia theh ïa ka um .
translation.en: Only ye shall not eat the blood  ; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water .
Think not that I am come to destroy the law , or the prophets : I am not come to destroy , but to fulfil .
translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba nga la wan ban pyndam noh ïa ka Hukum u Moses bad ïa ki jinghikai jong ki nongïathuhlypa . Ngam shym la wan ban pyndam noh ïa ki , hynrei ban pynurlong shisha ïa ki jinghikai jong ki .
Ko nongkheiñ , la jubab u Hananel , me long U Khun U Blei ! Me long u Syiem ki Israhaïah !
translation.en: Nathanael answered and saith unto him , Rabbi , thou art the Son of God  ; thou art the King of Israel .

translation.kha: Kumba ka khyndew bathymmai bad ki bneng kiba thymmai , kin ïajah da ka har Jong nga , kumne ruh ki khun ki ksiew jong phi bad ka kyrteng jong phi kan ïaisah .
translation.en: For as the new heavens and the new earth , which I will make , shall remain before me , saith the  Lord  , so shall your seed and your name remain .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingshongkurim dei ban ri burom da baroh , bad ibha long shiah tngen ki dien ba shaniah iwei ïa iwei pait . U Blei un sa bishar ïa kito kiba awria bad ïa kita kiba klim .
translation.en: Marriage is honourable in all , and the bed undefiled : but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge .
And they brought him upon horses , and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah .
translation.kha: Ïa ka met jong u la wan kit sha Jerusalem halor u kulai , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid .

translation.en: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat , and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel , and all their transgressions in all their sins , putting them upon the head of the goat , and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness :
translation.kha: Un buh ïa la ki kti baroh ar ha ka khlieh jong uta u  langsohmoh , bad halor jong u un phla ïa ki jingbymman , ïa ki pop , bad ïa ki jingïaleh pyrshah baroh jong ki Israel , bad da kumta un pynkit ïa ki ha ka khlieh jong uta u  langsohmoh . Nangta dei ban ñiah noh ïa uta u  langsohmoh sha ka ri shyiap da u briew uba la jied kyrpang na ka bynta kata .

Hadien ba u la ïakren bad u paidbah , u syiem u hukum ïa katto katne ki nongtem nongot ban phrung ïa ki jingroi kiba ki ju phong ha ki por bakyntang bad ban ïaid na khmat ka kynhun swai , da kaba rwai : Ïaroh ïa U Trai ! Ka jingieit jongu u ka long bymjukut !
translation.en: And when he had consulted with the people , he appointed singers unto the  Lord  , and that should praise the beauty of holiness , as they went out before the army , and to say , Praise the  Lord   ; for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Sur bha , U Ujuh u la maham ïa ki , bun sumar ïa lade na u khait jong ki Pharisi bad u thiat jong u Hahiroth .
translation.en: And he charged them , saying ,  Take heed , beware of the leaven of the Pharisees , and of the leaven of Herod .
And when they were come up out of the water , the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip , that the eunuch saw him no more : and he went on his way rejoicing .
translation.kha: Haba ki la wan kiew na kata ka um , U Mynsiem jong U Trai u la rah noh ïa u Philip . U rangbah synshar um shym la ïohi shuh ïa u , hynrei u la bteng ïa la ka jingleit , uba dap da ka jingkmen .

Kiei kiei baher babha u Manasseh u la ai , ka jingduwai ba u pynlong sha U Blei , bad ki khubor jong ki nongïalap kiba la kren ha u ha ka kyrteng jong U Tlai , U Blei ki Jerusalem’ , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh , and his prayer unto his God , and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the  Lord  God of Israel , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel .

Also , thou son of man , shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength , the joy of their glory , the desire of their eyes , and that whereupon they set their minds , their sons and their daughters ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Mynta , ko khun u briew , ngan shim noh na ki ïa ka Templ bakhraw kaba la long ka jingsarong bad ka jingkmen jong ki , kaba ki sngewtynnat ban khmih bad ban leit jngoh . Bad ngan shim noh ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ki .
u la praw ba yn tied ïa nga bad ban pynthait kynjri hajan ka Khyrdop Benjamin bashaneng haduh ka Templ .
translation.en: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet , and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin , which was by the house of the  Lord .
Ye shall observe to do therefore as the  Lord  your God hath commanded you : ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left .
translation.kha: Ko phi ki Israel , wat pep ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa phi . Wat pynkheiñ ïa kawei ruh na ki aiñ jong u .

translation.en: One God and Father of all , who is above all , and through all , and in you all .
translation.kha: don tang uwei U Blei uba long U Kpa jong u bynriew baroh , uba long U Trai halor baroh , uba trei lyngba kiei kiei baroh , bad u long ha baroh .

Shaphang ka khait Judah u ong , Ko TRAI’ , to shahshkor haba ki kyrpad ba-bang ïoh jingïarap ; jingshong ïa ki kawei bad la ki para jait . Ïaleh na ka bynta jong ki , ko Trai , Bad ïarap ïa ki pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong ki .
translation.en: And this is the blessing of Judah : and he said , Hear ,  Lord  , the voice of Judah , and bring him unto his people : let his hands be sufficient for him  ; and be thou an help to him from his enemies .
Now therefore , behold , the  Lord  hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets , and the  Lord  hath spoken evil concerning thee .
translation.kha: Bad u Mikaïah u pynkut :  Kane ka long kaei kaba la jia . U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me ban kren lamler ïa me . Hynrei ma u hi da lade u la rai ba phin ngat ha ka jingjot !
U Saul bad u Dabid ki la dep ka jingïakren phangpdeng jong ki . Ahian kata , u Jehohanan u khun jong u Saul u la sngew ju eh ïa u dab bad u sngewlwait ïa u wohnia u ieit ïa lade hi .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul , that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David , and Jonathan loved him as his own soul .

translation.kha: U Pynlong ïa ka hima jong u kaba khlaiñ , ba kumta baroh ki briew jong u ki ïaroh ïa u — ki dala Israel , kiba u ieit eh . To ïaroh ïa U Troas !
translation.en: He also exalteth the horn of his people , the praise of all his saints  ; even of the children of Israel , a people near unto him . Praise ye the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta , u Soitan u la ïalam ïa u shajrong nabar u la pynkhaw-eit ha u ha ka pynkhyllem ïa barhem ki song jong ka pyrta .
translation.en: And the devil , taking him up into an high mountain , shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time .

translation.kha: U la Pha ïa ki shakuriaw jong u ban ïathaw ha ki nongshahkhot jingsngewbha banbeiñ waiñ shat ka jingkhawai , hynrei kim kwah Ban wan .
translation.en: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding : and they would not come .

translation.kha: U Philip u la smam ïa u Nathanael bad u la ong ïa u , Ngi la shem ïa uta ïa uba u Moses u la thok ha ka kitab jong ka Hukum bad ïa uba ki nongïohipaw ruh ki la thoh shaphang jong u . U un-long U Jisu , u khun jong u Jakob , uba na Nehushtan .
translation.en: Philip findeth Nathanael , and saith unto him , We have found him , of whom Moses in the law , and the prophets , did write , Jesus of Nazareth , the son of Joseph .

translation.kha: Kane ka long baroh Kaba de la tip : U Bel u la thawsha ïa ngi kiba synlar , hynrei ngi la pynjyrsieh shibun eh ïa lap .
translation.en: Lo , this only have I found , that God hath made man upright  ; but they have sought out many inventions .

translation.kha: Khie ïaid lyngba ïa ka nongbah Jerusalem dara buh dak ha ka shyllangmat jong uwei pa uwei ibha shem jingïar bad khuslai namar ki Kiei kiei baroh kiba jingijli ibha la har ha ka nongbeh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Go through the midst of the city , through the midst of Jerusalem , and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof .

translation.kha: U Wallam jingbieit ha kiba khlaiñ bad ïa ki Kut baskhem jongu ki .
translation.en: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong , so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress .

translation.kha: lane ïatyngkhuh Para ma ki . Ki ïa-ïaid kynhun lyngba ïa ki jingker-ïada , bad ym don kano Kanah kaba lah ba-bang pynsangeh ïa ki .
translation.en: Neither shall one thrust another  ; they shall walk every one in his path : and when they fall upon the sword , they shall not be wounded .

translation.kha: U Moses u noh ha ki Eliel , U Trai u la jied ïa u Besalel , u khun jong u Uri bad u khun kyrsiew jong u Hur , na ka jait Judah .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the children of Israel , See , the  Lord  hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah  ;
The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat .
translation.kha: Kum ïa kata ka jait jingbam ngam sngewkwah bam , bad baroh kaba nga bam ka pynshitom ïa nga .
Ka la long ha kane ka nga ba la kha ïa u Moses , u khunlung uba bhabriew haduh katta katta .
translation.en: In which time Moses was born , and was exceeding fair , and nourished up in his father s house three months :

translation.kha: Tang namar ba im don khun shynrang , balei keiñ ba ka kyrteng jong i kan jah na Israel ? Ai bynta kum ka jingïohkynti jong me hapdeng ki kur ki jaiñ jong i pa .
translation.en: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family , because he hath no son ? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father .

translation.kha: La kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah kan shahshkor ïa me ne ktien shahshkor , kin tip ba don u nongïathuhlypa hapdeng jong ki .
translation.en: And they , whether they will hear , or whether they will forbear , ( for they are a rebellious house , ) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them .

translation.kha: Nangta ki synran lad u ki la ong ha u , Mynta te me kren shai kdar , khlem pyndonkam ïa ki rukom kren bapher .
translation.en: His disciples said unto him , Lo , now speakest thou plainly , and speakest no proverb .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Saul bad ki pynbah jong u ki pynsah im ïa u Agag , nabar kim shym pynïap ïa ki langbrot pynlang ki masi kiba kynsai tam , ïa ki khun maw Bad ki khunlangbrot kiba kynsai tam , bad ïa kano kano ka kordor ; ki la pynjot tang ïa kata ka bymlarkam ne bymdonkam ei ei shuh .
translation.en: But Saul and the people spared Agag , and the best of the sheep , and of the oxen , and of the fatlings , and the lambs , and all that was good , and would not utterly destroy them : but every thing that was vile and refuse , that they destroyed utterly .

translation.kha: Kut u la ong ha u nongsumar kper jong u , ‘ Ha khmih , la lai snem nga la wan shane da kaba wad soh dud ha une u diengsoh thurmur , bad ngam shym shem ei ei . Khet noh ïa u ! Bel un shu pynsep-ei ïa ka khyndew ?’
translation.en: Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard , Behold , these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree , and find none : cut it down  ; why cumbereth it the ground ?

translation.kha: Ka met jong u kan khie kular kumba dang samla bad ïa-ban khlaiñ pat ;
translation.en: His flesh shall be fresher than a child s : he shall return to the days of his youth :

translation.kha: Bunsien u mynsaw bymkhuid u la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa u da ka kren ïa u ha ka ding bad ha ka um . To isynei ïa ngi bad ïarap ïa ngi , lada me lah !
translation.en: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire , and into the waters , to destroy him : but if thou canst do any thing , have compassion on us , and help us .

translation.kha: Baroh ki long kiba shetkylla bad ki bym lah shaniah . Ka jingsah jong ki , ka ing suki kum ka ding ha ka tyndur , ka bym skhem la pynkhie da u nongbet kpu haduh ba u purew u lah longïing ban shet .
translation.en: They are all adulterers , as an oven heated by the baker , who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough , until it be leavened .

translation.kha: U Trai u la mihpaw ha u Abram bad u ino ha u , Kane ka dei ka ri kaba ngan ai ha ki khun ki ksiew ong me . nangta u Abram u la tei hangta ïa ka duwan ha U Trai , uba haw mihpaw ha u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared unto Abram , and said , Unto thy seed will I give this land : and there builded he an altar unto the  Lord  , who appeared unto him .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Moses ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
For God , who commanded the light to shine out of darkness , hath shined in our hearts , to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: U Blei uba la ong ,  Na ka jingdum ka jingshai kan tyngshaiñ!  u long ujuh U Blei uba la pynlong ïa ka jingshai jong u ban tyngshaiñ ha ki dohnud jong ngi , ban wanrah ha ngi ïa ka jingtip shaphang ka burom U Blei kaba tyngshaiñ ha U Khrist .
U Naaman u la ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa baroh kat kaba U Blei u la pynpaw ha u .
translation.en: According to all these words , and according to all this vision , so did Nathan speak unto David .

translation.kha: Nga phah pat sha me ïa u mynta , blem bad u ka long lem ka dohnud jongno nga .
translation.en: Whom I have sent again : thou therefore receive him , that is , mine own bowels :

translation.kha: Wat ïateh kano nangno ka jutang bad ki briew jong kata ka ri , namar haba ki mane ïa ki blei thala jong ki , bad kñia ha ki , kin sa khot sngewngiah ïa Phin ban ïasoh bad ki , bad phin shah pynshoi ban bam-im ïa ka jingbam ba ki ai ïa ki blei jong ki .
translation.en: Lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land , and they go a whoring after their gods , and do sacrifice unto their gods , and one call thee , and thou eat of his sacrifice  ;
He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye , and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pyrkhat tang ïa lade ki kyrkieh ban ïoh spah ha kaba kim tip lano ka jingduk kan lap .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Go .  And when they were come out , they went into the herd of swine : and , behold , the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea , and perished in the waters .
translation.kha: Khie leit ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ; kumta ki la mihnoh bad ki la leit shapoh ki sniang . Ka kynhun ki sniang baroh kawei ka la mareh arsut ïa ka riat jong ka synrang shapoh ka duriaw bad ka la ïap jyllop .
U ong ha u Shaphan , Nga la shem ïa ka kitab jongu ka Hukum hangne ha ka Templ .
translation.en: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe , I have found the book of the law in the house of the  Lord . And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan .

And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet , and wept as he went up , and had his head covered , and he went barefoot : and all the people that was with him covered every man his head , and they went up , weeping as they went up .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u leit shalor u Lum ki Olib da kaba ïam ; u ïaid da ka kjat suda bad u tap ïa la ka khlieh kum ka dak ka jingsngewsih . Baroh kiba bud ïa u ki la tap ïa la ki khlieh bad ki la ïam ruh .

translation.en: And greetings in the markets , and to be called of men , Rabbi , Rabbi .
translation.kha: ki ieit ban shah khublei da ka jingburom ha ki jaka ïew bad ban shah khot ha ki briew ‘ ko Nonghikai .’
Ka pangnud jong nga ka la shah pynlwet namar ki briew jong nga ki la shah pynliat ; nga ïam sngewsih ; ar la shaïong jur .
translation.en: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt  ; I am black  ; astonishment hath taken hold on me .

translation.kha: Ngam shym ong ïa kane ïa ka ban pynrem ïa phi ; naba kumba nga la ong mynshuwa , phi long kiba ngi ieit eh ba ngi ïalong lang borabor , lada ngi im lane i'u ïap .
translation.en: I speak not this to condemn you : for I have said before , that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you .

translation.kha: Long kiba sngewshngain kumba U Kpa jong phi u lama uba sngewsynei .
translation.en: Be ye therefore merciful , as your Father also is merciful .
And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God .
translation.kha: Ki Apostol bad kiwei pat ki riewngeit ha kylleng ka Judia ki la ïohsngew ba ki Jentil ruh ki la pdiang ïa ka ktien U Blei .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  answered Job out of the whirlwind , and said ,
translation.kha: Nangta napdeng ka  erïong U  Trai  u la kren ha u Job .

Pynïap ïa u , Shim khyndiat ka snam jong u , bad tah ïa ka ha ki shkor kamon jong u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , ha ki tikmie kamon jong ki , bad ha ki jatkmie kamon jngai ki . syntiew ïa ka snam kaba sah , sawdong kata ka reng .
translation.en: Then shalt thou kill the ram , and take of his blood , and put it upon the tip of the right ear of Aaron , and upon the tip of the right ear of his sons , and upon the thumb of their right hand , and upon the great toe of their right foot , and sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about .

And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar , and of the anointing oil , and sprinkle it upon Aaron , and upon his garments , and upon his sons , and upon the garments of his sons with him : and he shall be hallowed , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons  garments with him .
translation.kha: Shim khyndiat ka snam kaba don ha kata ka duwan bad khyndiat ka umphniang pynsleh , bad synreit ha u Aaron bad ha ki jaiñkup jong u , bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u bad ha ki jaiñkup jong ki . Ma ki bad ki jaiñkup jong ki kin long kiba la pynkyntang khuid sha nga .

Mynta , ïa katei kaba phi la thoh shaphang ki briew ki bym pat shongkurim : Ngam don ka lawlynnong na U Trai , hynñiew nga ai ïa la ka jingmut kumta wai uba da ka jingisynei U Trai nga longsem uba lah ban shaniah .
translation.en: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord : yet I give my judgment , as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful .
Therefore his height was exalted above all the trees of the field , and his boughs were multiplied , and his branches became long because of the multitude of waters , when he shot forth .
translation.kha: Namar ba la ai um pahuh , u san kham shajrong ban ïa kiwei pat ki dieng ki tnat jong u ki rben bad ki jrong .

Haba ki la ïohpdiang ïa ka shitom jongngi u Jehu , ki nongïalam jong ka Samaria ki la pynïap ïa baroh ki hynriewspah ngut ki khun ki ktieh jong u Ahas , ki buh ïa ki khleh jong ki ha ki shang , bad ki la phah ïa ki sha u Jehu ha Jesreel .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the letter came to them , that they took the king s sons , and slew seventy persons , and put their heads in baskets , and sent him them to Jezreel .

translation.kha: Nga kynmaw ïa ka jingngeit bashong Kaba me don , ka jingngeit kaba kum ka jong ka kmierad jong me ka Lois mala ka ka kmie jong me ka Ïuniki ruh ka don . Nga sngewthikna ba me ruh me Don ïa ka .
translation.en: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee , which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois , and thy mother Eunice ; and I am persuaded that in thee also .
And his brethren said to him , Shalt thou indeed reign over us ? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us ? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams , and for his words .
translation.kha: Hato me pyrkhat ba men sa long u syiem bad synshar ïa ngi ?  Ki hynmen shynrang jong u ki ong . Kumta ki la nang kham isih shuh shuh ïa u namar ki jingphohsniew jong u bad namar kaei kaba ba u la kren shaphang jong ki .
( O ho-oid , nga la pynbaptis ruh ïa u Stephanas bad ïa ka longïing jong u ; hynrei ngam kynmaw la por la pynbaptis sa ïano ïano pat . )
translation.en: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas : besides , I know not whether I baptized any other .

translation.kha: Kane ka jingtem , ïa kaba U Blei un sa pyndep ha ka ïa naba biang , ka long ban lumlang ïa ka jingpynlong bhor , ha bneng bad ha khyndew , lem bad U Khrist kum u khlieh .
translation.en: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ , both which are in heaven , and which are on earth ; even in him :

translation.kha: Kumba ki la leit kliar pynlang ki la shem ïa ka Mari bad u Joseph bad ki la ïohi ïa u khunlung uba thah ha ka shyngoid .
translation.en: And they came with haste , and found Mary , and Joseph , and the babe lying in a manger .

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw bad kaba donbor , bad da u ngan kyrkhu ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translation.en: Seeing that Abraham shall surely become a great and mighty nation , and all the nations of the earth shall be blessed in him ?

translation.kha: Ngan phah ka jingïatiplem bad pynim tliw ïa ki , hynrei ïa me ngan pynlong u kparad ka jaitbynriew kiba kham khraw bad hasem khlaiñ ban ïa ki !
translation.en: I will smite them with the pestilence , and disinherit them , and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they .

translation.kha: Ki ai ïa u hynñiewphew tylli ki Sabbai rupa na ka templ jyllang u Baal-jong-ka-Jutang , bun da kata ka pisa u la wai shi kynhun ki riewdakaid ban ïasoh bad u .
translation.en: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal–berith , wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons , which followed him .

translation.kha: Hadlai ka bapop bad ka jingiap ka la wan sha ka pyrthei , U Blei u la pynpaw ba ka hir ka jingthmu jong u , ba kiba ialap kin ioh biang ia ka jingtim da ka jingmihpat .
translation.en: After sin and death entered the world , God revealed that it was his purpose that the dead be restored to life by means of a resurrection .
And it came to pass on the morrow , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud hadien ka thma , ki Philistia ki leit bad lute ïa ki metïap , bad ki lap ïa ki met jong u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ba ki don halor u Lum Gilboa .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Know ye not this parable ? and how then will ye know all parables ?
translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki ,  Hato phim sngewthuh ïa kane ka pharshi ? Kumno , te phi lah ban sngewthuh ïa kiwei pat ki pharshi ?
ngin ïuh ban im ka jingim jong Ngi ha ka jingdum bad ka jingsngewsih kthang , ngi khuslai , bitar bad ïohpang .
translation.en: All his days also he eateth in darkness , and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness .
I have set the point of the sword against all their gates , that their heart may faint , and their ruins be multiplied : ah ! it is made bright , it is wrapped up for the slaughter .
translation.kha: Ka pynlong ïa ki briew jong nga ban duh ka jingshlur bad ban kyllon . Nga byrngem ïa ka nongbah jong ki da ka waitlam kaba thaba kum ka leilieh bad ka pynkhreh ban pynïap .
U kñia ïa ka jingainguh ba-im bad u shim shi hasem u purew bad u thrang ïa u halor ka duwan . ( Kane ka hir nongrah ka jingainguh thang kaba Leit ka sneng . )
translation.en: And he brought the meat offering , and took an handful thereof , and burnt it upon the altar , beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning .

translation.kha: Bad ïa pha patan ko Kapernam ! Hato pha kiaw ban kyntiew ïa lade sha Bneng ? Ïa pha yn bret sha tbian sha dujok ! Lada ïa ki kambah ïa kiba la leh ha pha , la lah leh ha Sodom , kan jin da la sah haduh mynta !
translation.en: And thou , Capernaum , which art exalted unto heaven , shalt be brought down to hell : for if the mighty works , which have been done in thee , had been done in Sodom , it would have remained until this day .

translation.kha: Na ka nongbah jongki ka Silla ha ka ri shyiap , ki brup jong ka Moab ki phah u Nongaplangbrot kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa uta uba synshar ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness , unto the mount of the daughter of Zion .

translation.kha: Ka jingtip jong na ka long kaba ïawer ; nur-um pyndonkam ïa kiba nga tip ban pyn-i ba U Blei , u Nongthaw jong nga , u long uba hok .
translation.en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar , and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker .

translation.kha: U Moserah u la dap Shispah arphew snam ka sma mynba u ïap ; ki khmat jongki u kim pat ba-ïaitrei , bad ka bor met jong u ruh kam pat duna .
translation.en: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died : his eye was not dim , nor his natural force abated .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ïa nga ,
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u phai ban leit noh , hynrei u Saul u ïohbat ïa ka jingkup jong u , bad ka la kur .
translation.en: And as Samuel turned about to go away , he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle , and it rent .
For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon , and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem , according to the good hand of his God upon him .
translation.kha: Ki mih na Babilonia ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai banyngkong , bad da ka jingïarap U Blei , ki poi ha Jerusalem ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai uba san .

translation.en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of all his servants .
translation.kha: U syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki la pdiang ïa kane ka jingai jingmut , bad u ong ha ki ,

translation.en: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself , ye do well :
translation.kha: Phi leh ïa kaei kaba dei lada phi kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong ka hima , ïa kaba la shem ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ,  To ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba ieit ïa lade .

A Blei , U Blei jongki ngi , kato me long uba khraw ! Katno me long uba shyrkhei bad uba donbor ! Me badonkam ïa ki kular ka jingïateh jutang . Naduh ka por ba ki syiad Israhaïah ki banbeiñ ïa ngi , wat haduh kane ka por , haduh katno ngi shahshitom ! Ki syier jong ngi , ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki lyngdoh jongngi ngi bad ki nongïathuhlypa , ki kpa thlim jong ngi , malu baroh ki briew jongno ngi ki shitom . To kynmaw haduh Katto moi la shahshitom !
translation.en: Now therefore , our God , the great , the mighty , and the terrible God , who keepest covenant and mercy , let not all the trouble seem little before thee , that hath come upon us , on our kings , on our princes , and on our priests , and on our prophets , and on our fathers , and on all thy people , since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day .

translation.kha: U Korah u khun jong u Ishar na ka jait Lebi jong u Kohath , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jingïalam jong u Moses . La wan ïasoh lem bad u da kad ngut ki dkhot na ka jaiñ-da Reuben — u Dathan bad u Abbim , ki khun shynrang jngai u Eliab , bad u On u khur jong u Palat — pynlang da ki arspah sanphew ngat kiwei pat ki rangbah Jeruel , ki nongïalam kiba jaiñtapkhmat ba la jied da ka kynhun .
translation.en: And they rose up before Moses , with certain of the children of Israel , two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly , famous in the congregation , men of renown :

translation.kha: Ki la da ïaid sakma noh na kata ka lynti ha kaba ang la hukum ïa ki ban ïasaid ; ki la thaw ïa lade u khun masi ba la saiñ da ka ksing bad ki la ïamane ïa u , bad ki la ai jingkñia ha u . Ki ïa-ong ba a u long u plie jong ki , uba la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt !
translation.en: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them : they have made them a molten calf , and have worshipped it , and have sacrificed thereunto , and said , These be thy gods , O Israel , which have brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Ma at , U Trai U Balei Badonbor Baroh , ngam pat shngiam la iehnoh ïa ka Israel mala ka Judah , wat la ki la har pop pyrshah ïa to , U bakthang jong ki Jeriel .
translation.en: For Israel hath not been forsaken , nor Judah of his God , of the  Lord  of hosts  ; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: Shaei u Mephibosheth u kiaw jong u Saul , u kynrad jong me ? u syiem u kylli ïa u . U sah ha Jerusalem , u Siba u la jubab , namar ba u la sngewthikna ba ki Israel mynta kin pynïoh pat ha u ïa ka hima jong u Saul , u kparad jong u .
translation.en: And the king said , And where is thy master s son ? And Ziba said unto the king , Behold , he abideth at Jerusalem : for he said , To day shall the house of Israel restore me the kingdom of my father .

translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki jied ïa u Joahas u khulom jong u Jehoash sad ki pynsleh syiem ïa u ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah , and made him king in his father s stead in Jerusalem .
Take an harp , go about the city , thou harlot that hast been forgotten  ; make sweet melody , sing many songs , that thou mayest be remembered .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ka duitara , khie leit sawdong ïa ka shnong , Pha ka bapli ka nuti ba la klet noh ! To tem bad rwai biang ïa ki jingrwai jong pha To wallam ïa ki rangbah sa shisien pat .

U Hadadeser u shem ka Sirion u la ïalumlang ïa ki shipai jong u barben , bad ba la kyrshut da ki laiphew ar ngut kiwei pat ki nongsynshar lem sad ki kulai bad ki kali ïap jong ki , u la tur bad kerkut ïa ka Samaria malu hiarthma ïa ka .
translation.en: And Ben–hadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together : and there were thirty and two kings with him , and horses , and chariots : and he went up and besieged Samaria , and warred against it .

translation.kha: Ha u Lum Sinai , U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la pynlong ka jutang ,
translation.en: The  Lord  our God made a covenant with us in Horeb .
And Nabal answered David s servants , and said , Who is David ? and who is the son of Jesse ? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la ap hangta , bad u Nabal ha kaba khatduh u la jubab ,  U Dabid ? Uei uta ? Ngam pat ju ïohsngew ïa u ! Ha kine ki sngi ka ri ka dap da ki mraw kiba phet na la ki kynrad !
Haba kumta , uei wahbah dei u Jiw bashisha , ba la nujor shisha ? Ym dei uta u briew uba dei u Jiw ha naba shabar , uba ka jingotsher ka long ha ka thop .
translation.en: For he is not a Jew , which is one outwardly ; neither is that circumcision , which is outward in the flesh :

translation.kha: Kumta u Pekod , u Jonathan , u Benaïah , bad ki nongïada syiem ki pynshong ïa u Solomon halor u khashor jong u Susim Dabid bad ki la synran ïa u sha ka Umpohliew Gihon .
translation.en: So Zadok the priest , and Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and the Cherethites , and the Pelethites , went down , and caused Solomon to ride upon king David s mule , and brought him to Gihon .
They compassed me about  ; yea , they compassed me about : but in the name of the  Lord  I will destroy them .
translation.kha: Ki la don sawdong jong nga ha ki liang baroh ; hynrei nga la pynjot ïa ki da ka bor jong U  Trai  !
Kumta ka jingpynkhiah jongnga u Isaïah ka la treikam ha ki : ‘ Kine ki brisoh kin ïashukor malu ïai shahshkor , hynrei kim shemphang ; kin khmih bad ïai khmih , hyndai ktien ïuh ,
translation.en: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias , which saith , By hearing ye shall hear , and shall not understand  ; and seeing ye shall see , and shall not perceive :

translation.kha: Un ym im baneh ïohi ïa ki wah ka umphniang Elul lane ïa ki wahduid kiba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .
translation.en: He shall not see the rivers , the floods , the brooks of honey and butter .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga , U Trai’ U Bel jongu ph , nabar ngan pyllait im ïa phin na ki nongshniah jong phi .
translation.en: But the  Lord  your God ye shall fear  ; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies .

translation.kha: Lada u briew uba ieit ïa ka jingsuk u shong hangta , ai ba ka jingkhublei jingsuk jong phi kan neh ha u ; lymda kumno , shim noh ïa ka jingkhublei jingsngur .
translation.en: And if the son of peace be there , your peace shall rest upon it : if not , it shall turn to you again .
Lacking appreciation for God’s kindness , Adam and Eve did disobey and were made to pay the prescribed penalty .
translation.kha: Namar ki khlem la niewkor ia ki jinglehsbun jong U Blei , u Adam bad ka Im ki la saitlah .

translation.en: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary , and had seen the things which Jesus did , believed on him .
translation.kha: Bun na ki briew kiba la wan jngoh ïa ka Mari ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh , bad ki la ngeit ha u .
Hynrei ma me , A Trai , me long u syiem junom , bad man synshar sha kaba koit ka por .
translation.en: Thou , O  Lord  , remainest for ever  ; thy throne from generation to generation .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet U Bela u ong ha u Nethanaïah ,
translation.en: And it came to pass the same night , that the word of God came to Nathan , saying ,
Judge me , O God , and plead my cause against an ungodly nation : O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man .
translation.kha: A Blei , to pynbna ba nga long uba lui lui , bad ïasaid da ïa nga na ki bymriewblei ; pyllait ïa nga na ki briew kiba shukor bad kiba sniew !
Haba kiba duk ki lynñiar , ang ïarap ïa ki ; na ai jingïarap ïa ki khunswet ki me to lad shuh .
translation.en: Because I delivered the poor that cried , and the fatherless , and him that had none to help him .

translation.kha: Katai ka brup ka kha ïa u khun shynrang bad ka ai kyrteng ïa u , u Samson . Uta u kylliang u la nang syn bad U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa u .
translation.en: And the woman bare a son , and called his name Samson : and the child grew , and the  Lord  blessed him .
And thinkest thou this , O man , that judgest them which do such things , and doest the same , that thou shalt escape the judgment of God ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko paralok jong nga , leh ïa kita kiei kiei hi kiba phi bishar ïa kiwei! Hato phi pyrkhat phin lait na ka jingbishar U Blei ?
U Paul u la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki , nabar U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan ha ki ; ki la kren ha ki thylliej kiba pher bad ki la pynbna duh ïa ka khubor jngai U blang .
translation.en: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them , the Holy Ghost came on them  ; and they spake with tongues , and prophesied .
And no man in heaven , nor in earth , neither under the earth , was able to open the book , neither to look thereon .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym shym la don ha bneng lane ha khyndew lane ha ka pyrthei kaba shapoh , uba lah ban plied ïa ka kot kli bad ban khmih shapoh jong ka .
Kumta U Blei u la pynbna ïa ka jingriam ha ka pynrieh . Ki briew jongno ka ki hap ban siew ïa kamai kaba ki la lai . Kiba im ki la nang duna bad on duna .
translation.en: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth , and they that dwell therein are desolate : therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned , and few men left .

translation.kha: Balei nga dat ban ïaishah shitom ? Areli ba ki jingmynsaw jong sa ym lah ban pynkoit ? Balei ba kim koit ? Hato me thmu ban pyneh mynsiem ïa nga kumno ka wahduid kiba ryngkhiang ha ka por lyiur ?
translation.en: Why is my pain perpetual , and my wound incurable , which refuseth to be healed ? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar , and as waters that fail ?

translation.kha: Nahath ki mynsiem ki la wallam lang ïa ki syiem ha ka khak kaba ha ka ktien Hebru la khot Ka Armoni .
translation.en: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la bret ïa u shabar jong ka bri sohwaiñ bad ki la pynïap ïa u . Kaei , te , ba u tei Jong ka bri sohwaiñ un leh ïa ki nongshimwai ? U Jisu u la kylli .
translation.en: So they cast him out of the vineyard , and killed him . What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them ?

translation.kha: Nangta ki synrap ki la kylli ïa U Jisu , Balah ba ki nonghikai Aiñ ki ong ba u Elijah u la dei ban wan shuwa ?
translation.en: And his disciples asked him , saying , Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come ?

translation.kha: ïa ka Synduk ka jyntang ha kaba don ki jingpynkynmaw , ïa ki jingbah bad ïa ka jingtah jngai ka ;
translation.en: The ark of the testimony , and the staves thereof , and the mercy seat ,

translation.kha: haba u wan ha kata ka Snem ban ïohpdiang ïa ka burom na ki briew jong u baroh bad ka jingpyndonburom na borbah uba ieit . Phi ruh phin long napdeng jong ki , namar ba phi la ngeit ïa ka khubor kaba ngi la ïathuh ha phin .
translation.en: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints , and to be admired in all them that believe (because our testimony among you was believed) in that day .

And he will appoint him captains over thousands , and captains over fifties  ; and will set them to ear his ground , and to reap his harvest , and to make his instruments of war , and instruments of his chariots .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki un thung kum ki rangbah synshar ki ban peit ïa ki shihajar ngut ki rangbah bad katto katne ngut ki ban peit ïa ki sanphew ngut ki rangbah : ki khun shynrang jong phi kin hap ban lur ïa ki lyngkha jong u , ban lum ïa ki jingmih jong u na ka khyndew , bad ban shna ïa ki tiar thma bad ki tiar kali ïapom jong u .

translation.en: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul : neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own  ; but they had all things common .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun ki riewngeit ka la long ha kawei ka jingmut bad kawei ka mynsiem . Ym don uba ong ba kano kano ka jingdon jong u ba ka long ka jong u hi , hynrei baroh ki la ïasam iwei ïa iwei pat ïa kaei kaei kaba ki la don .

translation.en: Then the Spirit said unto Philip , Go near , and join thyself to this chariot .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la ong ha u Philip ,  Khie leit sha jan ka kali kulai bad bud mar jan ïa ka .

translation.en: The table , and his staves , and all his vessels , and the shewbread ,
translation.kha: ïa ka miej , ki jingbah ïa ka , bad baroh ki tiar ki tar jong ka ; ïa u kpu ba la ainguh sha U Blei ;
U angel u hukum ïa u , Bsuh ïa ka doh sad u ksew halor une u mawsiang , malade theh ïa ka syrwa halor jong ki . U Bethdagon u bor kumta .
translation.en: And the angel of God said unto him , Take the flesh and the unleavened cakes , and lay them upon this rock , and pour out the broth . And he did so .

translation.kha: Me pyndonkam ïa u ban ainguh ïa U Trai bad U Kpa jong I bad pun tim ruh ïa la u parabriew , ïa Uba la thaw ha ka dur U Blei .
translation.en: Therewith bless we God , even the Father  ; and therewith curse we men , which are made after the similitude of God .
Then thou shalt say unto them , I presented my supplication before the king , that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan s house , to die there .
translation.kha: Shu ong ïa ki ba me kyrpad ïa nga ban ym phah pat ïa me sha byndi ban ïap hangta .
Ïa ki briew la thaw ha ka dur jong U Blei hi , kumta eit uno uba pynïap ïa uwei na ki , u ruh un shah pynjop ha uwei pat .
translation.en: Whoso sheddeth man s blood , by man shall his blood be shed : for in the image of God made he man .

translation.kha: Ha sngap , ka por kan poi ha kaweh ngan pynpei lut ïa ki samla shynrang baroh kiba na ka longïing jong me bad na ka kur jong me , kumta ba yn ym don uwei ruh u briew u pun im thymmai ha ka ïohnong jong me .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , that I will cut off thine arm , and the arm of thy father s house , that there shall not be an old man in thine house .

Then Nebuchadnezzar spake , and said , Blessed be the God of Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , who hath sent his angel , and delivered his servants that trusted in him , and have changed the king s word , and yielded their bodies , that they might not serve nor worship any god , except their own God .
translation.kha: U syiem u la ong ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei jong u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego ! U la phah ïa u angel jong u bad pyllait im ïa kine ki rangbah kiba la shakri bad shaniah ha u . Kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga bad ki la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ban ïa kaba dem ngon bad mane ïa uno uno u blei lait tang u jong ki hi .

translation.en: “Better to eat a dry crust of bread with peace of mind than have a banquet in a house full of trouble .”
translation.kha: “Lah kaba shikyntien ka ja suda ha ba bad ka jingsuk , ban ia ka ing kaba dap da ka jingkhawai lem bad ka jingialeh .”

translation.en: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom , and which is in the valley of the giants on the north , and descended to the valley of Hinnom , to the side of Jebusi on the south , and descended to En–rogel ,
translation.kha: Nangta u hiar arsut shaduh trai jong u lum na uba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Hinnom , ha ka tduh kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Them Rephaim . Nangta u suh arsut lyngba ka Them Hinnom , shathie na ka sharing lum jong ka Jebus , sha ka Enrogel .

Ka jutang bathymmai kob sam pynlong bad ki paid Israel kan lama kane : Ngan buh ïa ka aiñ jong nga hapoh jong ki bad thoh ïa ka ha ki pangnud jong ki . nur long U Blei jongu ki , bad kin hir ki briew jongngi nga .
translation.en: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel  ; After those days , saith the  Lord  , I will put my law in their inward parts , and write it in their hearts  ; and will be their God , and they shall be my people .

translation.kha: Wat la ki briew kim pait smam la sdang ban tei biang ïa ka Templ , ki la sdang ha ka snoh banyngkong jong u bnai bahynñiew ban thrang ki jingkñia sha U Trai .
translation.en: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord . But the foundation of the temple of the  Lord  was not yet laid .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , nga ong ba ki ïing ha Jerusalem mala ka ïingsyiem Judah kin sa shah pynkitkhlieh na ka daw jong ka jingshah kerkut bad ka jingtur ïaleh .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , concerning the houses of this city , and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah , which are thrown down by the mounts , and by the sword  ;

translation.kha: kawei phi ai jingmut ïa per pun leh ? u kylli . Kaei ba ngan ong ha ki briew kiba ong ïa nga ba ngan pynring ïa ki jingduk jong ki ?
translation.en: And he said unto them , What advice give ye that we may return answer to this people , which have spoken to me , saying , Ease somewhat the yoke that thy father did put upon us ?
Then went in also that other disciple , which came first to the sepulchre , and he saw , and believed .
translation.kha: Te uta uwei pat u synran , uba la poi nyngkong ha ka jingtep , u ruh u la rung shapoh ; u la ïohi bad u la ngeit .
ngin lah ban don ki jingthmu , hynrei khatduh ka riej ka dei jong U Bel .
translation.en: The preparations of the heart in man , and the answer of the tongue , is from the  Lord .

translation.kha: wat la ka sarang baroh tista ym jah ha ki tylli ding .
translation.en: She hath wearied herself with lies , and her great scum went not forth out of her : her scum shall be in the fire .

translation.kha: Me kob sarong ba me la tih pukri bad dih ïa ki um ha ki ri nongwei bad ba ki khait jongnga ki shipai jongu me ki la ïoh ïuh pyntyrkhong ïa ka wah Nile .
translation.en: I have digged and drunk strange waters , and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places .

translation.kha: Nga la ïan phah shaei phi ïa baroh ki shakri jyllang nga , ki Nongïathuhlypa , bad ki la ong ïa phi ban iehnoh ïa ki lyntait bymman jong phi bad ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei . Ki la maham ïa Phi ban ym mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei , khnang ba phi lah ban ïashang ha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha phi bad ki kput tymmen jong phi . Hynrei phim shym la shahshkor ïa nga lane sngap ïa nga .
translation.en: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets , rising up early and sending them , saying , Return ye now every man from his evil way , and amend your doings , and go not after other gods to serve them , and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers : but ye have not inclined your ear , nor hearkened unto me .

translation.kha: Haba phi ai ha kiba duk , ka long kumba phi ai kylliang sha U Trai , bad U Trai un sa sleit pang ïa phira .
translation.en: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the  Lord   ; and that which he hath given will he pay him again .

translation.kha: U ai ha u Hathakh ïa ka kopi jngai ka jingpynbna kaba u la pynjam ha Susa , kaban hukum ïa ka jingpynjot ïa ki Jiw . U Mordekai u ong ïa u ban rieh ïa ka shai ka Esther , ban batai ha ka ïa kaei ka long , bad ban ong ïa ka ban ïasaid bad u syiem bad kyrpad ïa u Ban don jingisynei ïa ki briew jong ka .
translation.en: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them , to shew it unto Esther , and to declare it unto her , and to charge her that she should go in unto the king , to make supplication unto him , and to make request before him for her people .

translation.kha: Ym bit ïa Un uno u briew uba don jingduna ha ka tat ban ai ïa kata ka jinganna : kum uba matlah , uba dkoh , uba la sniew ka durkhmat , lane umbah la thawsha ka met ;
translation.en: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish , he shall not approach : a blind man , or a lame , or he that hath a flat nose , or any thing superfluous ,
And the  Lord  said , Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel , that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead ? And one spake saying after this manner , and another saying after that manner .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylli , ‘ Mano ban shukor ïa u Ahab khnang ba un leit bad shah pynïap ha Ramoth ?’ Katto katne ki angel ki ong ïa kawei , bad kiwei pat ki ong ïa kawei pat ,

translation.en: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: u la tei ïa ka pyrthei halor ki um bajylliew ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
Wat pynjahburom ïa la u kjap da kaba ïathiah shongkha sad kano kano na ki tnga jong u .
translation.en: The nakedness of thy father s wife shalt thou not uncover : it is thy father s nakedness .

translation.kha: Wat ki shipai ba shu wai lad ka ki long khulom bor kum ki khun masi . Kim shym ïeng ban ïaleh ; baroh na ki , ki phai bad phret noh . Ka sneng jong ka jingpanpoh ka la poi , ka por Jong ka jingpynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks  ; for they also are turned back , and are fled away together : they did not stand , because the day of their calamity was come upon them , and the time of their visitation .
There is that maketh himself rich , yet hath nothing : there is that maketh himself poor , yet hath great riches .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba leh riewspah , hynrei kim don ei ei . Kiwei ki leh duk , hynrei ki don ka spah bah .

translation.en: My little children , of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you ,
translation.kha: Ko ki khun ba-ieit jong nga ! Sa shisien , kum ka kmie kaba suh kha , nga sngew ïa kajuh ka jait jingsuh na ka bynta jong phi tad haduh ka jinglong U Khrist kan da thawdur ha phi .
To ïashukor ! Na woh kum u nongtuh ! Suk uta uba peitmat Bad uba sumar ïa la ki jabieng , khnang ba un ym ïaid lyngkhuit kylleng bad shah pynlehrain ha khmat ki briew !
translation.en: Behold , I come as a thief . Blessed is he that watcheth , and keepeth his garments , lest he walk naked , and they see his shame .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïahap u Jehoïada u la ïap , ki nongïalam jong ka Judah ki khroh ïa u syiem Joash don shahshkor ino ïa ki .
translation.en: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah , and made obeisance to the king . Then the king hearkened unto them .
That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof , and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban pyn-i ïa ki haduh katno dei ban leit , lane ban phah noh biang ïa ki ?
Nga treng ban don ka jaka ban sah ha ka ri shitaiew ha kaba na ia ban lehse na ki briew jong nga . Ma ki baroh ki hir ki bymïaineh , ki paidbhur ki nongshetkylla .
translation.en: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men  ; that I might leave my people , and go from them ! for they be all adulterers , an assembly of treacherous men .

translation.kha: Ki biria ka Dedan ki ïakynting ïa ki jaiñ-jin na ka bynta ki mei jongnga pha .
translation.en: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots .

translation.kha: bad wat lada kito ki lai ngut ki rangbah ki shong ki sah hangta — kumba shaid ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , at long U Blei uba im — kin ym lah ban pynim Wat ïa la ki jngai ki khun . Kin lah ban pynrem tang ïa la ka jong ka jingim , bad ka ri kun kylla long ka ri khlaw .
translation.en: Though these three men were in it , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters  ; they only shall be delivered , but the land shall be desolate .

translation.en: And Uriah said unto David , The ark , and Israel , and Judah , abide in tents  ; and my lord Joab , and the servants of my lord , are encamped in the open fields  ; shall I then go into mine house , to eat and to drink , and to lie with my wife ? as thou livest , and as thy soul liveth , I will not do this thing .
translation.kha: U Uriah u jubab ,  Ki rangbah Israel bad Judah ki don jngai ha ka thma , bad ka Synduk ka Jutang ka don bad ki ; u Joab u rangbah nongai hukum ïa nga bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ki ïasah ha madan . Kumno nga lah ban shu leit sha ïing , ban bam ban dih , bad ban thiah bad la ka tnga ? Ka long kaba kyntang ïa nga , nga smai ba ngan ym leh ïa kaba kum kata ka kam !

translation.en: This is the disciple which testifieth of these things , and wrote these things : and we know that his testimony is true .
translation.kha: U long u synran uba la kren kine kiei kiei , uta uba la thoh ruh ïa kine ; bad ngi tip ba kaei kaba u ong ka long kaba shisha .

translation.en: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief .
translation.kha: Namar ba kim don ka jingngeit , um shym la leh shibun ki kambah hangta .
Katba u Ahab u dang leit ban bam , u Elijah u kiew shad u lum Karmel , u dem khrup ha khyndew , u da buh ïa la ka khlieh hapdeng ki khohsiew jong u .
translation.en: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink . And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel  ; and he cast himself down upon the earth , and put his face between his knees ,

translation.kha: “Nga ne ki jingrem bad nga pyntreikam ïa ki ; nga ei ka jingpyntieng , bad por khong ka bor .
translation.en: Counsel is mine , and sound wisdom : I am understanding  ; I have strength .
