translation.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad , even unto the children of Gad according to their families .

translation.kha: Phin pynlong ïa u ba la thang da ka jingthrang bad U Trai un ïong ïa phi .
translation.en: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head , and the  Lord  shall reward thee .

And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David . And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword : and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword .
translation.kha: U la ai jingkheiñ ha u Dabid ïa ka jingdon baroh lang jong ki rangbah kiba bit ïa ka kam shipai : Khatwei lakh ngut ha Israel , bad saw lakh hynñiewphew hajar ngut ha Judah .
ki khlur ktang hap na bneng , badno ïa ki bor ha ka haw haw yn pynkynriah nong na ki lynti ïaid jong ki .
translation.en: And the stars of heaven shall fall , and the powers that are in heaven shall be shaken .

translation.kha: Haba u Phinehas , u khun jong u Eleasar bad u ksiew jong u Sharon uba long lyngdoh , u la ïohi ïa kane , u ïeng joit bad u maw na kata ka kynhun .
translation.en: And when Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , saw it , he rose up from among the congregation , and took a javelin in his hand  ;

translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bud u leit ïawad ïa u Saul . U ïohsngew ba u Saul u la leit sha ka nongrit Ammiel , ha kaba u la tei mot ïa lade , bad nangta u la leit sha Jahlil .
translation.en: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning , it was told Samuel , saying , Saul came to Carmel , and , behold , he set him up a place , and is gone about , and passed on , and gone down to Gilgal .

translation.kha: Ngi la ñiewbeiñ ïa u bad ngi la kyntait ïa u ; u la shah ïa ka jingshitom bad jingpang . Ym don mano mano wat ban peit ïa u — ngi la leh bymsalia ïa u kum u i Long ei ei .
translation.en: He is despised and rejected of men  ; a man of sorrows , and acquainted with grief : and we hid as it were our faces from him  ; he was despised , and we esteemed him not .

translation.kha: ‘ Kine briew , ong U Blei , ki pyndonburom ïa nga da ki kyntien jong ki , isynei ka dohnud jong ki , da shisha ka long jngai eh na nga .
translation.en: This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth , and honoureth me with their lips  ; but their heart is far from me .

translation.kha: Ka duwan rnong kaba la thaw da u Beelsebul , u khun jong u Uri mala u ksiew jongno u Hur , ka ba-don ruh ha Gibeon ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon long U Trai . U sahmiet Solomon bad ki biria baroh ki la mane ïa U thri hangta .
translation.en: Moreover the brasen altar , that Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , had made , he put before the tabernacle of the  Lord  : and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it .

translation.kha: U Simon u la ïohi ba la ai ïa U Mynsiem ha ki bangeit hab ki apostol ki la buh ïa la ki kti hiar jong ki . Kumta u la tyrwa pisa ha u Pontios bad u Ïoannis ,
translation.en: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles  hands the Holy Ghost was given , he offered them money ,

translation.kha: Haba nga la ïor ïa u , nga la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u kum u briew ba la ïap . U la buh ïa ka Ki kamon jong u halor jong nga bad u la ong , Wat sheptieng ! Nga longsem uba jingsuh bad uba khatduh .
translation.en: And when I saw him , I fell at his feet as dead . And he laid his right hand upon me , saying unto me ,  Fear not  ; I am the first and the last :
But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz .
translation.kha: U Hasael u syiem ka Syria u thom beiñ ïa ki Israel baroh shi lynter ka jingsynshar u Jehoahas ,

translation.en: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me , and increasest thine indignation upon me  ; changes and war are against me .
translation.kha: Me don borabor katto katne ngut ki nongsakhi pyrshah ïa nga ; ka jingbitar jong me ïa nga ka nang jur nang jur ; me thaw ki lad thymmai ban ïaleh ïa nga .

translation.en: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store , as God hath prospered him , that there be no gatherings when I come .
translation.kha: Man la ka Sngi U Trai , uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban buh kyrpang katto katne ka pisa , kat kum ka jingïoh , bad pynlang ïa ka , khnang ba yn ym da donkam ban lum ïa ka pisa ynda nga poi .
Bad U Trai u ong ha lap , Ngan nongmih buhrieh na u Amram ïa kaei kaba ngan sa leh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do  ;

translation.kha: Phi barieh ar ngut phi tip ba nga la trei na ka bynta i pa jong phi katba kot la ka bor .
translation.en: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father .

translation.kha: Mynta , la don ka jingong kaba thikna ba ka don ka jingïaleh awria hapdeng jong phiah kaba shyrkhei haduh katta katta ba wat ki bymngeit kin sngewsarong ïa kata . La ïathiah ïa nga ba uwei u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka keiñ!
translation.en: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you , and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles , that one should have his father s wife .

translation.kha: Haba ngan wan sha phi , nga thup ba ngan woh ryngkat bad ka jingkyiuh ba-dap jong U Khrist .
translation.en: And I am sure that , when I come unto you , I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ .

translation.kha: Kumba nga la wallam ïa kane ka jingjot ha kine ki briew , kumta ruh ngan ai ïa ki baroh kiwei kiei kiba bha kiba nga la pynkulmar .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people , so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them .
But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the  Lord  God of Israel with all his heart : for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam , which made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jehu um shym la kohnguh da ka dohnud baroh ïa ka aiñ jong U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel ; pynban u la bud ïa ka jingleh jong u Jeroboam , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .

translation.en: And he said , Lord , I believe . And he worshipped him .

translation.kha: ngat ki shym bad ki khun syiem shynraiñ jong ki kin rung ïa ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem malu keiñ ei kajuh ka bor ba kynjai syiem kaba u dabi u la don . Ryngkat lem bad ki Briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , kin shongsuk ha ki kali ïapom bad halor ki kulai , bad ka nongbet Jeremaïah kan ïai dap borabor da ki briew .
translation.en: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David , riding in chariots and on horses , they , and their princes , the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem : and this city shall remain for ever .

When one told me , saying , Behold , Saul is dead , thinking to have brought good tidings , I took hold of him , and slew him in Ziklag , who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings :
translation.kha: U nonglamktien uba la wan sha nga ha Siklag bad ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingïap u Saul , u la pyrkhat ba u la wallam ka khubor babha . Nga la kem ïa u , bad phah pynïap ïa u . Kata ka dei ka bainong ba nga la ai ha u na ka bynta kata ka khubor babha jong u !
U la thikna bha ba U Blei un leh ïa kaei naba u la kular .
translation.en: And being fully persuaded that , what he had promised , he was able also to perform .
Therefore prophesy against them , prophesy , O son of man .
translation.kha: Mynta te , to kren pyrshah ïa ki , ko khun u briew .

Ki la dam sha shiliang jong ka wah ban synran ïa ka kynhun ba kynja syiem bun ban leh ïa kano kano kaba u syiem u kiaw . Katba u shym u khreh ban jam sha shiliang , u Shimei u rynsied ïa lade ha khmied jong u ,
translation.en: And there went over a ferry boat to carry over the king s household , and to do what he thought good . And Shimei the son of Gera fell down before the king , as he was come over Jordan  ;
And the angel took the censer , and filled it with fire of the altar , and cast it into the earth : and there were voices , and thunderings , and lightnings , and an earthquake .
translation.kha: Nangta uta u angel u la shim ïa kata ka pliang thang jingiwbih , u la pyndap ïa ka da ki rnga ding barhem na ka duwan , bad u la bret ïa ka halor ka khyndew . La don ki jingkyrhuh bad ki jingsawa u pyrthat , ki jingthaba leilieh , bad u jumai .
Ktien ki long kiba na ka longïing longsem jong u Aaron bad u Mesha ha ka por ba U Trai u kren ha u Moses ha u Lym Sinai .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
But of that day and that hour knoweth no man , no , not the angels which are in heaven , neither the Son , but the Father .
translation.kha: Ym don pat batip , lano kata ka sngi lane ka kynta kin wan — lymne wat ki angel ha bneng , lymne U Khun ; tang U Kpa u tip .
La phi don ne phim Don ïa ka Jingpynkyllaktien Pyrthei Bathymmai ha ka ktien jong phin , ngi pynshlur ïa phi banbeiñ pule ïa ka ktien jong U Jehobah man la ka snoh . —Joshua 1 :8 ; Salm 1 :2 , 3 .
translation.en: Whether you have the New World Translation in your language or not , we encourage you to get into a good routine of reading Jehovah’s Word every day . —Joshua 1 :8  ; Psalm 1 :2 , 3 .

translation.kha: Kito kiba kwah Ban ai sngewbha ki lah thep ha i snur ba la buh lymda .—2 Korinth 9 :7 .
translation.en: For those who wish to make a donation , there is a contribution box .—2 Corinthians 9 :7 .
John answered them , saying , I baptize with water : but there standeth one among you , whom ye know not  ;
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la jubab ,  Nga pynbaptis da ka um , hynrei hapdeng jong phi don uwei uba ïeng uba phim ithuh .

translation.en: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely : but he that perverteth his ways shall be known .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ïaid hok ki shongshngain bad sngewskhem , hynrei uta u bym lehhok un shah kem .
To shahshkor ïa la u kpa ; Khlem ma u phin ym ïoh jingim . Haba ka kmie ka la tymmen , pynkhaw-eit ha ka ïa ka jingïaroh jong phi .
translation.en: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee , and despise not thy mother when she is old .

translation.kha: Phi hajuh phoi dei ban longïng kiba ïashoh . To batskhem ïa ki jingkyrmen jong phin , naba ka sngi ka jingwan U Trai ka la jan .
translation.en: Be ye also patient  ; stablish your hearts : for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh .

But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch , and as the raiment of those that are slain , thrust through with a sword , that go down to the stones of the pit  ; as a carcase trodden under feet .
translation.kha: hynrei mem don kano kano ka jingtep , bad ïa ka metïap jong me la bret shabar ba kan pyut . La tap ïa ka da ki met jong ki shipai ba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , la kynting ïa ka lem bad ki ha ka thliew mawsiang , bad la ïuh ïa ka .
Ka ri shyiap lai shadkmen , bad ki syntiew kin phuh ha ka ri khleiñ .
translation.en: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them  ; and the desert shall rejoice , and blossom as the rose .
There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel : only in Gaza , in Gath , and in Ashdod , there remained .
translation.kha: Ym don napdeng ki Anakim kiba dang sah ha ka ri Israel ; pynban , tang katto katne , la iehnoh ha Gasa , Gath bad Ashdod .
Toi ki pynbah pynsynjor kin ong ruh ha uta u paidïapom , ‘ Don mo hangne wahbah sheptieng pynlang uba rit myn ? “lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , Ïohi ba u pynsyier mynsiem ïa kiwei pat .’
translation.en: And the officers shall speak further unto the people , and they shall say , What man is there that is fearful and fainthearted ? let him go and return unto his house , lest his brethren s heart faint as well as his heart .

translation.kha: Kito kiba la thied bad die ïa ki langbrot ki la wai ïa nga , badno nga la Long u nongaplangbrot jong ki langbrot kiba la dei Ban shah shohdoh . Nga la shem ar tylli ki dieng : Ïa uwei nga la khot U Jingsngewbha bad ïa uwei pat U Jingtylli . Bad nga la synrum ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: And I will feed the flock of slaughter , even you , O poor of the flock . And I took unto me two staves  ; the one I called Beauty , and the other I called Bands  ; and I fed the flock .

translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa U Balei na ka jingpynkheiñ spah ka burom jongnga u ban ai ha phira ïa ka bor da U mynhynne jong u ba phin long kiba khlaiñbor ha ki jinglong bashapoh jong phi , bad nga duwai ba U Khrist un pynlong ka ïingshong jong u ha ki dohnud jongnga phi da ka jingngeit .
translation.en: That he would grant you , according to the riches of his glory , to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man ;

translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki kem ïa u badno ki khlaw ïa ki khmat jong u . Ki ïalam ïa u shaw Gasa , ki teh ïa u da ki kynjri rnong , bad ki pyntrei ïa u ha ka akor tylliat hapoh byndi .
translation.en: But the Philistines took him , and put out his eyes , and brought him down to Gaza , and bound him with fetters of brass  ; and he did grind in the prison house .
And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king , saying , Hilkiah the priest hath delivered me a book . And Shaphan read it before the king .
translation.kha: Bad nangta u ong ,  Nga don hangne ka Kitab kaba u Hilkaïah u ai ha nga .  Bad u pule jam ïa ka ha u syiem .
U la synshar ha Hebron hynñiew snem ha Jerusalem laiphew lai Snem .
translation.en: And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years  ; seven years reigned he in Hebron , and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem .
And they came to Jericho : and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people , blind Bartimaeus , the son of Timaeus , sat by the highway side begging .
translation.kha: Ki la wan sha Jerikho , bad katba U Jisu u sdang ban mihnoh ryngkat bad ki synran jong u bad u paidbah babun , u nongkhrong uba matlah uba kyrteng u Bartimaïos , u khun jong u Timaïos , u dang shong harud lynti .
Ngi la khmih’ biang , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ki Angel , da ki hajar bad ki million na ki ! Ki la ïeng sawdong ka khet , ki saw tylli ki jingthaw bam-im , bad ki nongsharai balang ,
translation.en: And I beheld , and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders : and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand , and thousands of thousands  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei yn ym don ka tiar thma ka ban eh ban pynsyier ïa pham ; phan don ka jubab ïa kito baroh kiba mudui ïa pha . Ngan kyrngah ïa ki shakri jong nga bad ngan ai jingjop ïa ki . U Trai u la Kren .
translation.en: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper  ; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn . This is the heritage of the servants of the  Lord  , and their righteousness is of me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Un ai ïa ka jingshemphang jong ka jingbishar hok ïa kito babha Tertios kum ki nongbishar , bad ka jingshlur ïa tun kiba ïada ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah na ka jingshah hiarthma .
translation.en: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment , and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate .

translation.kha: To shahjop , te , lada phi don ki shkor !
translation.en: If any man have an ear , let him hear .

translation.kha: U la iehnoh ïa ki , u la kiew pat halor ka lieng bad u la sdang ban leit sha shiliang jong ka duriaw .
translation.en: And he left them , and entering into the ship again departed to the other side .
They shall take up serpents  ; and if they drink any deadly thing , it shall not hurt them  ; they shall lay hands on the sick , and they shall recover .
translation.kha: lada ki shim ïa ki bseiñ lane dih kano kano ka bih , kin ym mynsaw ; kin buh ïa la ki kti ha kiba pang , ki ban ïoh ka jingkhiah .
U Jephthah u phet na la ki hynmen bad u leit shon ha ri Tob . Hangta sia kynhun ki nongkamsniew ki ïapynlong Paralok bad u , bad ki leit nur kylleng lam bad u .
translation.en: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren , and dwelt in the land of Tob : and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah , and went out with him .
I have fed you with milk , and not with meat : for hitherto ye were not able to bear it , neither yet now are ye able .
translation.kha: Nga hap ban bsa ïa phi da ka dud , ym da ka jingbam kaba eh , namar phim pat shym kotbor ïa ka . Bad wat haduh mynta phim pat long kiba kotbor ïa ka , namar phi dang im kumba im ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei .
U Philip u la leit shwa ka nongbah ha Samaria Bad u la ïalang ïa U Messaïah ha ki briew hangta .
translation.en: Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria , and preached Christ unto them .

translation.kha: U Asaph u ïong ïa u Jehoshaphat , Hobab ngi sien Sha ka thma , ngan riej pher ïa lade , hynrei ma phi , phong ïa ki jaiñ symboh jong phi . Kumta u syiem Israel u leit sha sma ha ka jingriam pher .
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , I will disguise myself , and will go to the battle  ; but put thou on thy robes . So the king of Israel disguised himself  ; and they went to the battle .

translation.kha: Nalor kane ruh , u syiem u la ong ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh kiba long ki bynta bakha daiñ jongno ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , khnang ba ki lah ban ai ïa ka pa jong ki baroh sha ki jingdawa jong ka Hukum jong U Trei .
translation.en: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites , that they might be encouraged in the law of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba u Sabad u ïohpdiang ïa kata , u lumlang ïa ki shipai Israel , u jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad u buh ïa ki ha ka dik ba phai khmat ïa ki Syria .
translation.en: And it was told David  ; and he gathered all Israel , and passed over Jordan , and came upon them , and set the battle in array against them . So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians , they fought with him .

And the cherubims lifted up their wings , and mounted up from the earth in my sight : when they went out , the wheels also were beside them , and every one stood at the door of the east gate of the  Lord s  house  ; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above .
translation.kha: Ki pynpyiar la ki thapniang bad kiew shajrong na ka khyndew katba nga dang peit ïa ki , bad ki shalyntem ki bud lang ïa ki . Ki sangeh shiphang ha ka phalor kaba shaphang mihngi ka Templ , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ ka shong halor jong ki .
Ngam la pyllaitluid ïa ki paid Jeruel bad pynim ïa ki na ka hima bakhrawbor .
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath redeemed Jacob , and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he .

translation.kha: To un kyrshut ïa me bad ïa ki khulom ki ksiew jong me kumba u la kyrkhu ïa u Abraham , bad ai ba men shim kyntiap ïa kane ka ri ha naba me la shong la sah bad ïa kaba U Blei! u la ai ha u Abraham !
translation.en: And give thee the blessing of Abraham , to thee , and to thy seed with thee  ; that thou mayest inherit the land wherein thou art a stranger , which God gave unto Abraham .

translation.kha: Wat tmain ïa u briew uba kyllut lane wat buh ei ei ha khmat uba matlah ban pynlong ba un jingjynthut halor uta . Tiengburom ïa nga ; nga longsem U tharai U blem jongngi phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt not curse the deaf , nor put a stumblingblock before the blind , but shalt fear thy God : I am the  Lord .
So those servants went out into the highways , and gathered together all as many as they found , both bad and good : and the wedding was furnished with guests .
translation.kha: Kumta ki shakri ki la ïaleit sha ki lynti bah bad ki la ïalumlang ïa ki briew baroh kiba ki lah ban ïashem , kiba bha bad kiba sniew kumjuh , bad ïa ka kamra khawai shongkurim la pyndap da ki briew .
Lada kano kane ka jaitbynriew ka kyntait ban leit bad ma ïa U Trai Badonbor Baroh kum u syiem , te u plung un ym hap ha ka ri jong ki .
translation.en: And it shall be , that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King , the  Lord  of hosts , even upon them shall be no rain .
There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire , or that useth divination , or an observer of times , or an enchanter , or a witch ,
translation.kha: Wat kñia ïa la ki khun da kaba thang ïa ki ha ka duwan jong phi ; wat shah ïa la ki briew ban khan , lane ban shat ban kheiñ , lane ban ai myntor ,

translation.en: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him , and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast , whose deadly wound was healed .
translation.kha: U la pyndonkam ïa ka bor synshar baïar jong u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u . U la pynbor ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka ban mane ïa u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong , uba ka jingmynsaw jong u ka la ïohkhiah .

translation.en: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh , and Ephraim , and Simeon , even unto Naphtali , with their mattocks round about .
translation.kha: U leh kumjuh ha ki nongbah bad ki jaka ba la ieh kynjah jong ki Manasseh , Ephraim , bad Simeon , bad jngai shaduh shatei haduh Naphtali .

translation.en: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry , and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house ? when thou seest the naked , that thou cover him  ; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh ?
translation.kha: Ïasam lang ïa ki jingbam jong phi bad kiba thngan , bad ai jaka sah ïa kiba duk ki bym don ïing . Ai jaiñphong ïa kito ki bym don jaiñ ban phong , bad wat kyntait ban ïarap ïa la ki jong ki ba-ha-ïing .

Kumta u Joab u la leit shat u Shim Dabid bad u ïathuh ha u ïa Kiei kaba u Absalom u la ong . U syiem u la phah khot ïa u Absalom ; ibha la leit sha u bad u dem ngon ha khyndew ha khmat jong u . U syiem u la pdiang sngewbha ïa u da ka jingdoh .
translation.en: So Joab came to the king , and told him : and when he had called for Absalom , he came to the king , and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king : and the king kissed Absalom .

translation.kha: Man ka snem , ma phira bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong pa , phi dei ban ïabam ïa ki ha khmat U Terah ha kata ka jaka mane Blei ba U Trai un jied .
translation.en: Thou shalt eat it before the  Lord  thy God year by year in the place which the  Lord  shall choose , thou and thy household .

translation.kha: Kiba bun na kiba ngeit ki la ïaw , ki da phla ha ka paw bad ki da pynpaw ïa kamai kaba ki la leh .
translation.en: And many that believed came , and confessed , and shewed their deeds .

In the five and twentieth year of our captivity , in the beginning of the year , in the tenth day of the month , in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten , in the selfsame day the hand of the  Lord  was upon me , and brought me thither .
translation.kha: Ka la long ka sngi kaba shiphew jong ka snem thymmai , kaba long ka snem kaba arphew san hadien ba la ringmraw ïa ngi bad khatsaw snem hadien ba la jop ïa ka Jerusalem . Ha kata ka sngi nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat badonbor jong U  Trai  , bad u la rah noh ïa nga .
Ki jaiñ-da Reuben bad ki jait Gad ki la don shibun ki jingri . Haba ki la ïohi ba ka ri Jaser bad ka ri Gilead ka long kaba bit eh na ka bynta ki jingri ,
translation.en: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle : and when they saw the land of Jazer , and the land of Gilead , that , behold , the place was a place for cattle  ;

So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the  Lord  , even against the word of the  Lord  , which he kept not , and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit , to enquire of it  ;
translation.kha: U Saul u la ïap namar ka jingbymïaineh jong u ha U  Trai . Um shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  ; u pyrshang ban wad jingshai da kaba kylli na ki mynsiem jong kiba la ïap , ha ka jaka ba un kylli na U  Trai .
Na u Paul bad u Timothi , ki shakri U Khereth Jisu — Kha baroh ki bri jong U Bel ha Philippi ibha ha U Khrist Jisu , kiba ki kynthih ïa ki nongïalam balang nabar ki Nongïarap .
translation.en: Paul and Timothy , the servants of Jesus Christ , to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi , with the bishops and deacons :

translation.en: Then said we unto them after this manner , What are the names of the men that make this building ?
And when Jesus came to the place , he looked up , and saw him , and said unto him ,  Zacchaeus , make haste , and come down  ; for to day I must abide at thy house .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la poi ha kata ka jaka , u la khmied shajrong bad u la ong ha u Sakhaïos ,  Hiar kloi , ko Sakhaïos , namar nga dei ban sah ha ka ïing jong me ha kane ka sngi .

Ha ka jingsam jong ki shipai shong khwai bad jong ki nongsiatkhnam , uwei uwei baroh u phet krad . katno katne kin phet sha khleh , kiwei ktang ïakiew shajrong pangnud ki Mawsiang . Ïa kawei pa kawei ka shnong yn iehnoh thylli , bad yn ym don uno uno u ban shong ngab sahit pat ha ki .
translation.en: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen  ; they shall go into thickets , and climb up upon the rocks : every city shall be forsaken , and not a man dwell therein .

translation.kha: U Jakob , namar ba u la tmain , u la byr-ïe ki lamkhmat , bad um imat ibha shuh . U Joseph u ïamareh ïa ki hajan jong u ; u ruh u piam u khup ïa ki bad u doh de ïa ki .
translation.en: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age , so that he could not see . And he brought them near unto him  ; and he kissed them , and embraced them .

translation.kha: U Hoham bad u Shekhem u khun jyllang u ki la leit sha ka dik long dorbar ha ka khyrdop shnong bad ki kren ha la ki para shnong ;
translation.en: And Hamor and Shechem his son came unto the gate of their city , and communed with the men of their city , saying ,
And they buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath–heres , in the mount of Ephraim , on the north side of the hill Gaash .
translation.kha: La tep ïa u ha ka ri kynti jong u hi ha Timnath Serah ha ka ri lum Ephraim kaba shaphang shatei jong u Lum Gaash .

translation.en: Ephraim , as I saw Tyre , is planted in a pleasant place : but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , nga lah ban ïohi ïa ki khun jong ki ba ki shah beh kthong bad shah pynïap .

translation.en: In this was manifested the love of God toward us , because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world , that we might live through him .
translation.kha: Bad U Blei u la pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi da kaba phah ïa la U Khun ba marwei sha ka pyrthei , khnang ba ngin ïoh ïa ka jingim da u .
Kumta nga pynkieng atiar ïa ki briew da ki waitlam , ki sum , bad ki riewngeit , bad nga pynpyut ïa ki da ki kur hadien ki kynroh , ha ki kajuh bym pat dep tei .
translation.en: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall , and on the higher places , I even set the people after their families with their swords , their spears , and their bows .

translation.kha: Nangta u buh ïa sier ka synduk hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ dara u wah ïa ka pyrda . Da kumne u kah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , bania U tharai u la hukum ïa u .
translation.en: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle , and set up the veil of the covering , and covered the ark of the testimony  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Dei ha me , ym ha ki hynmen jong me , ba nga ai ïa ka Shekhem , kata ka jaka kaba stai ba at la ïohknieh na ki Amor da ka waitlam bad ka ryntieh jongki nga .
translation.en: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren , which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow .
And when he was come into his own country , he taught them in their synagogue , insomuch that they were astonished , and said , Whence hath this man this wisdom , and these mighty works ?
translation.kha: bad u la leit phai pat sha la ka shnong . U la hikai ha ka synagog , bad kito kiba ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh .  Nangno u la ïoh kat kane ka jingstad ?  ki la kylli .  Bad kumno shaphang ki kambah jong u ?
