translation.en: And as the ark of the  Lord  came into the city of David , Michal Saul s daughter looked through a window , and saw king David leaping and dancing before the  Lord   ; and she despised him in her heart .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Ngan sa pynjot ïa kiei khie baroh ha ka pyrthei ,
translation.en: I will utterly consume all things from off the land , saith the  Lord .
And Hannah answered and said , No , my lord , I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit : I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink , but have poured out my soul before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Em kynrad , ngam shym buaid  ka la jubab .  Ngam shym dih ! Nga jynjar sat bad nga dang duwai bad khlei lut ïa ki jingjynjar baroh ha U  Trai .
Haba shah jingkhot ka jingkyrmen , ka dohnud ruh ka shah khñiot , hynrei ka jingurlong jong ka jingkhmih lynti ka pyndap ïa phi da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick : but when the desire cometh , it is a tree of life .
And they cried with a loud voice , saying , How long , O Lord , holy and true , dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth ?
translation.kha: Ki la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam ,  Ko Trai Badonbor Baroh , u bakhuid bad uba shisha ! Sa katno kan long haduh ba men da bishar ïa ki briew ha ka pyrthei bad pynshitom ïa ki namar ba ki pynïap ïa ngi ?
Phin eh leh sngewbha ha ka jingdap khiar jong ka , koum i khunlung ha ka shadem ka kmie jong i .
translation.en: That ye may suck , and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations  ; that ye may milk out , and be delighted with the abundance of her glory .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa kawei ka jingthmu ha ka jingim : ban burom ïa por ha ki por baroh , na ka boitha ka jingbha jong ki hi bad ka jingbha jong ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .
translation.en: And I will give them one heart , and one way , that they may fear me for ever , for the good of them , and of their children after them :

translation.kha: U Eliphas u la maïan sha u bad u la ïohsngew ba u dang pule na ka Kitab u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa . U la kylli ïa u , Hato me sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba me pule ?
translation.en: And Philip ran thither to him , and heard him read the prophet Esaias , and said , Understandest thou what thou readest ?

translation.kha: mala nangta ma u , ki rangbah pyndum , ki jingïada ïa u syiem , bad ki nongap phira ha ïingsyiem ki synran ïa u syiem na ka Templ shiah ïingjah , bad buhnud sa u paidbah baroh . U Jahas u rung lyngba ka khyrdep Phira bad u shong ha la ka jaka ha ka khet .
translation.en: And he took the rulers over hundreds , and the captains , and the guard , and all the people of the land  ; and they brought down the king from the house of the  Lord  , and came by the way of the gate of the guard to the king s house . And he sat on the throne of the kings .

translation.kha: Wat la phi Don jingsngur ha ka jingsngem pat “U Abraham u jingkit ba ka tnga jongnga kan im biang , wat la katta ngi pule “Ka u Abraham u sngur sih bad iam namar jongka .”
translation.en: Abraham had faith his wife would live again , yet we read that “Abraham came in to bewail Sarah and to weep over her .”

translation.kha: La ni arspah ngut ki rangbah kiba ha ka jingkhot sngewbha u Absalom ki la leit na Jerusalem bad u ; kim tip ei ei shaphang ka jingthmu barieh bad ki la leit da kaba sngur mynsiem .
translation.en: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem , that were called  ; and they went in their simplicity , and they knew not any thing .

translation.kha: Man la ka snem wallam ïa ki soh ba phin la lut nyngkong na ka jingot sha ka ïohnang U Trai U Blei jong phi . Wat ju shet ïa u khunlangbrot ne khunblang ha ka dud ka kmie Jong u .
translation.en: The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring unto the house of the  Lord  thy God . Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother s milk .

translation.kha: Ki brisoh jong pha kin leh baroh ïa kaei naba dei , bad kin ïohkynti ïa ka ri junom . Ngin la bang ïa ki , nga la thaw ïa ki , ngab pynpaw ïa ka jingkhraw jong la sa baroh .
translation.en: Thy people also shall be all righteous : they shall inherit the land for ever , the branch of my planting , the work of my hands , that I may be glorified .

translation.kha: U Josaïah u la kurup ïa “kata ka ri baroh kadei , kumba U Troas u la hukum ïa u Moses . U Joshua u la ai ïa ka ha ki Israel kumin ka jong ki hi bad u la pynbat ïa ka ha ki lyngkhot , kawei kawei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait . kumto ki paidbah ki la shongthait na ka thma .
translation.en: So Joshua took the whole land , according to all that the  Lord  said unto Moses  ; and Joshua gave it for an inheritance unto Israel according to their divisions by their tribes . And the land rested from war .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Abiathar , u lyngdoh , u kynhun jong u Ahimelekh , Wanrah ha nga ka ephod , bad u Abiathar u wanrah ïa ka ha u .
translation.en: And David said to Abiathar the priest , Ahimelech s son , I pray thee , bring me hither the ephod . And Abiathar brought thither the ephod to David .
And when they heard it , they glorified the Lord , and said unto him , Thou seest , brother , how many thousands of Jews there are which believe  ; and they are all zealous of the law :
translation.kha: Hadien ba la ïohsngew ïa u , ki baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei . Nangta ki la ong ,  Ko Paul , phi lah ban ïohi katno hajar ngut ki Jiw ki la kylla long ki parabangeit , bad katno ma ki baroh ki bat pyrkhing ïa ka Hukum .
Bsuh ïa kane ka duwan shab ka pyrda kaba la wah ha khmat jong ka Synduk Ka Jutang . Kata ka dei ka jaka ha kaba ngan ïashem Bad me .
translation.en: And thou shalt put it before the veil that is by the ark of the testimony , before the mercy seat that is over the testimony , where I will meet with thee .

translation.kha: Naduh mynbarim , me la sa ïa ki kambah pynlang ki jingphylla ha Jingtep , bad me ïai leh ïa ki haduh kaei ka sngi , ha Israel nabar hapdeng kiwei ki hima baroh , ba kumta ïa me mynta la tip kylleng sawdong .
translation.en: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt , even unto this day , and in Israel , and among other men  ; and hast made thee a name , as at this day  ;
And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness , who have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , and worshipped the works of their own hands .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew jong nga namar ki la leh pop ; ki la phai dien noh na nga , ki la ai jingkñia sha kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki la shna ïa ki bleithaw bad mane ïa ki .
Kane ka la jia ha ka hukum jong U Trai , khnang ban beh nala ïa ki briew ka Judah na khmat jong u namar ki pop baroh kiba u syiem Manasseh u la leh ,
translation.en: Surely at the commandment of the  Lord  came this upon Judah , to remove them out of his sight , for the sins of Manasseh , according to all that he did  ;
Are there not mockers with me ? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation ?
translation.kha: Nga khmih kumno baroh ki krenbeiñ ïa nga da ka jingkthang .

translation.en: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee : and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh , that he send the children of Israel out of his land .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha u Aaron ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga hukum ïa me , bad un ïathuh ha u Pharaoh ba un shah ïa ki Israel ban mihnoh na ka ri jong u .
Ïa ka doh jong ithuh u mrad dem ban bam noh ha kata hi ka sngi ba la kñia ïa u ; ym dei don pynsah ki tang khyndiat ruh haduh ka step kaba bud .
translation.en: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered  ; he shall not leave any of it until the morning .

translation.kha: Wat nym pyrkhat ïa kaba kum kata ? u Jonathan u jubab . lada nga la tip shai ba i pa i la koit jingmut ban pynsniew ïa phi , hato nur ym ïathuh ïa phi ?
translation.en: And Jonathan said , Far be it from thee : for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee , then would not I tell it thee ?
And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb , and shall compass about to Goath .
translation.kha: Bad u pud un bteng nangta na sepngi shaduh u lum Gareb bad nangta sawdong sha Goah .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath opened his armoury , and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation : for this is the work of the Lord  God  of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans .
translation.kha: Nga la plie ïa ka jaka ha kaba la buh ïa ki atiar jong nga , bad ha ka jingbitar nga la shim noh ïa ki , namar ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh , nga don ka kam ban leh ha Babilonia .
U Joseph u la pynlong mraw ïa ki briew na tduh shiah tduh ka Ijipt .
translation.en: And as for the people , he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof .

And that lord answered the man of God , and said , Now , behold , if the  Lord  should make windows in heaven , might such a thing be ? And he said , Behold , thou shalt see it with thine eyes , but shalt not eat thereof .
translation.kha: ha kaba u rangbah pynïaidkam u la jubab ,  Kata kam lah ban jia — em wat lada U  Trai  da lade hi un phah shisien phah ïa u kew !  Bad u Elisha u la jubab ,  Men sa ïohi ïa kata ba ka jia , hynrei men ym ïoh bam na kata ka jingbam .

U Blei u sloit ïa ki bneng bad u pynpyiar ïa ki ; u pynwandur ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka ; u ai jingtim nabar u pyrsad mynsiem ïa la ki briew baroh . Bad mynta U Trai U Blei u ong ha la u shakri ,
translation.en: Thus saith God the  Lord  , he that created the heavens , and stretched them out  ; he that spread forth the earth , and that which cometh out of it  ; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it , and spirit to them that walk therein :

translation.kha: Mynshuwa phi la long kiba ïarap ha ka jinglong mynsaw namar ka jingbymkohnguh bad ki pop jong phi .
translation.en: And you hath he quickened , who were dead in trespasses and sins ;

translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew baroh kin sa kyrpad ïa at ban kyrkhoit ïa ki kamar nga la kyrhai ïa ki khun ki ksiew jngai me — baroh namar ba me la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jyllang nga .
translation.en: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed  ; because thou hast obeyed my voice .
These wait all upon thee  ; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season .
translation.kha: Baroh na ki , ki shaniah ha me ban ai ïa ki ka jingbam haba ki donkam ïa ka .

translation.en: His body shall not remain all night upon the tree , but thou shalt in any wise bury him that day  ; ( for he that is hanged is accursed of God  ; ) that thy land be not defiled , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance .
translation.kha: ym dei ban ieh ïa ka metïap hangta baroh shi miet . Tep ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi , namar ka metïap kaba sdien ha u dieng ka long ka jingtim U Blei , khnang ba phin ym pyntngit ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .

translation.en: And satest upon a stately bed , and a table prepared before it , whereupon thou hast set mine incense and mine oil .
translation.kha: Ki da shong ha ki jingthiah ba-itynnat , bad ha khmat jong ki kin buh ïa ka miej ba la dap da kiei kiei kiba bha , ba kynthup ïa ki jingiwbih bad ka umphniang Olib kaba nga la ai ha ki .

translation.en: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard , nor perceived by the ear , neither hath the eye seen , O God , beside thee , what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him .
translation.kha: Ym pat ju don ba ïohi lane ïohsngew ïa U Blei uba kum ma me , uba leh ïa kiba kum kita ki kam na ka bynta kito kiba ap kyrmen ha u .

translation.en: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it  ; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them : and they were judged every man according to their works .
translation.kha: Nangta ka duriaw ka la aiti ïa kiba ïap jong ka . Ka jingïap bad kumjuh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ki la aiti ïa kiba ïap kiba ki la bat . Bad ïa baroh la bishar kat kum kaei kaba ki la leh .

translation.en: And Michal took an image , and laid it in the bed , and put a pillow of goats  hair for his bolster , and covered it with a cloth .
translation.kha: Nangta ka shim ïa ka bleithaw na ïing , ka pyndem ïa ka ha jingthiah , ka buh ka syngkhlieh kaba da u shñiuh blang ha khlieh jong kata , bad ka buh jingtap halor jong ka .
Kumba , ym don jingotsher hapdeng ki Jiw bad ki Jentil , hapdeng ki mraw bad kiba ïalade , hapdeng ki shynrang bad ki kynthei ; phi baroh phi ïalong kawei ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: There is neither Jew nor Greek , there is neither bond nor free , there is neither male nor female : for ye are all one in Christ Jesus .
And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her  ; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more :
translation.kha: Ki nongkhaïi jong ka pyrthei ruh kin ïam bad ïambriew na ka bynta jong ka , namar ba ym don shuh mano mano ban thied ïa ki mar jong ki ;

Ka Hannah ka pynlong ka jingsmai kyntang , A Tharai Badonbor Baroh , to khmih ïa nga ka shakri jong me ! To peit ïa ka jingkordit jrong nga bad kynjoh ïa nga ! To wat kjat ïa na ! Lada man ai khun shynrang ïa at , nga kular ba ngan katai ïa u sha me baroh shi rta ka jingim jong u , bad da lei laiñ yn ym khampoh ïa u shñiuh jong u .
translation.en: And she vowed a vow , and said , O  Lord  of hosts , if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid , and remember me , and not forget thine handmaid , but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child , then I will give him unto the  Lord  all the days of his life , and there shall no razor come upon his head .
Give me my wives and my children , for whom I have served thee , and let me go : for thou knowest my service which I have done thee .
translation.kha: Ai ha nga ïa ki tnga jong nga bad ïa ki khun jong nga kiba nga la ïoh da kaba trei na ka bynta jong phi , bad ngan leit noh . Phi tip haduh katno nga la shakri hok ïa phi .
U Jisu u la leit lyngba ki nongbah bad ki nongrep , u da haei ïa ki bhabriew bad u da thew ïa la ka lynti sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And he went through the cities and villages , teaching , and journeying toward Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Shisien , katba ki Israel ki dang Don ha ka ri khleh , la lap ïa uwei u Briew uba dang lum diengphasi ha ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness , they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day .

translation.kha: Nga ai ha ki ïa ka jingim bymjukut , malade kin ym ïap da lei lwa ruh . Ym don uno uno uba kah ban knieh noh ïa ki na nga .
translation.en: And I give unto them eternal life  ; and they shall never perish , neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand .
And the king said unto her , What aileth thee ? And she answered , This woman said unto me , Give thy son , that we may eat him to day , and we will eat my son to morrow .
translation.kha: Kaei ka jynjar jong pha ?  Ka jubab ,  Ha kato ka sngi , kane ka briew hangne ka ai jingmut ba ngin ïabam ïa u khun jong nga , bad ban bam ïa u khun jong ka ha ka sngi kaba bud .

Ki phan bad ïai phan ïa ki nonglamktien ban longing khot sngewbha ïa ki rangbah don wang na sha jngai bah , bad ki rangbah ki la woh . Borabor ar ngut shi para ki sum bad tah ïa ki ñiuhmat nabar deng ïa ki jingdeng mawkordor .
translation.en: And furthermore , that ye have sent for men to come from far , unto whom a messenger was sent  ; and , lo , they came : for whom thou didst wash thyself , paintedst thy eyes , and deckedst thyself with ornaments ,
Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly , and went up from Gilgal all night .
translation.kha: Baroh shi miet , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la ïaid na Gilgal sha Gibeon bad ki la tur kyndit ban ïaleh ïa ki Amor .
Ka erïong ka la nang jur ha kata ka por , kumta ki maji ki la kylliang ïa u , Kaei kaba ngi dei ban ai ïa me ban pynsangeh ïa ka ehrang ?
translation.en: Then said they unto him , What shall we do unto thee , that the sea may be calm unto us ? for the sea wrought , and was tempestuous .

translation.kha: A Trai badonbok Baroh , me un-long u nongsynshar ha ka pyrthei baroh ; me kham khynraw palat ban ïa ki blei baroh .
translation.en: For thou ,  Lord  , art high above all the earth : thou art exalted far above all gods .

translation.kha: Ka lynnong kaba naba khak ki ïaid ka long kum ka jingmih ka sngi ; ka nang phyrnai nang pharia haduh ba kan da shai bha kum mynsngi .
translation.en: But the path of the just is as the shining light , that shineth more and more unto the perfect day .
And when they came nigh to Jerusalem , unto Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount of Olives , he sendeth forth two of his disciples ,
translation.kha: Haba ki la jan poi ha Jerusalem , hajan ki shnong Bethphage bad Bethania , ki la wan sha u lum ki Olib . U Jisu u la nang phah ar ngut na ki synran ha shuwa jong u bad kine ki jingbthah :
Tlai saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki ha ki saw tylli ki dong ha kiba khong ki kjat jong ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold , and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof .

translation.kha: U Ahab u jubab , Don sa wai , u Mikhmash u khur jongnga u Imlah . Hynrei nga isih ïa u , Naamah um ju ïathuhlypa ïa kaba bha shaphang jong nga , dorbar ka dei tang ïa kaba sniew suda . Phim dei ban ong kumta ! U Jehoshaphat u jubab .
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , There is yet one man , Micaiah the son of Imlah , by whom we may enquire of the  Lord  : but I hate him  ; for he doth not prophesy good concerning me , but evil . And Jehoshaphat said , Let not the king say so .

translation.kha: Haduh ïa ka jingshai jong u bymman la ju pynlip noh ? Hato uno eit na ki u ju ïadih ïa ka jingjot ? Hato U Blei u ju pyndem ïa u bymman ha ka jingbitar
translation.en: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out ! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them ! God distributeth sorrows in his anger .

And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks , two hundred rams , four hundred lambs  ; and for a sin offering for all Israel , twelve he goats , according to the number of the tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang , ki ai shispah tylli ki masi kyrtong , arspah ki langbrot , bad sawspah tylli ki khunlangbrot kum ki jingainguh thang , bad khat-ar tylli ki blang kum ki jingainguh ïa ka pop , uwei na ka bynta kawei ka jait ki Israel .
Nahath u shim ïa ka khuri , u la plied ha U Blei , sad u la ai ïa ka ha ki ; bad barabor ki la dih na ka .
translation.en: And he took the cup , and when he had given thanks , he gave it to them : and they all drank of it .
Be not deceived : evil communications corrupt good manners .
translation.kha: To wat shah ba yn shukor .  Ki paralok kiba sniew ki pynjot ïa ka jinglong babha .
To long kiba khleh bad kiba shlur ! To ngin ïaleh tyngeh na ka beit ki briew Jong ngi bad na ka bynta ki nongpang jong U Blei jong ngi . bad ai ba yn leh ïa ka mon U Trai !
translation.en: Be of good courage , and let us play the men for our people , and for the cities of our God : and the  Lord  do that which seemeth him good .

And it shall come to pass , when all these things are come upon thee , the blessing and the curse , which I have set before thee , and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations , whither the  Lord  thy God hath driven thee ,
translation.kha: Mynta nga la ai ba phin jied napdeng ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingtim . Ynda kine kiei kiei baroh ki la wan jia ha phi , bad phi shong hapdeng ki jaitbynriew sha kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynsakma ïa phi , phin sa kynmaw ïa ka jingjied ba nga la ai ha phi .

translation.en: At the last it biteth like a serpent , and stingeth like an adder .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud phin sngew kumba phi la shah puh da u  seiñïong .
Ha ka jingshitom jong u , u la pynher ïa lade , u phai sha U Troas U Blei jong u , bad u kyrpang ïa ka jingïarap jong u .
translation.en: And when he was in affliction , he besought the  Lord  his God , and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers ,
Having confidence in thy obedience I wrote unto thee , knowing that thou wilt also do more than I say .
translation.kha: Nga sngewthikna , katba nga dang thoh ïa kane , ba men leh ïa kaei kaba nga kyrpad — ha ka jingshisha nga tip ba men leh wat kham palat ïa kane .
Pynban , ym shym la pynim ïa ki jaka mane blei thawsha , badno ki bhabriew ki ïai Bneng ban ai jingkñia bad ryngkat jingiwbih hangta .
translation.en: But the high places were not taken away : the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places .

translation.kha: bad kumta nga la ïan ban pyllait ïa ki na ki nong Ijipt bad ban ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt sha kata ka ri katba ïar malade kaba seisoh , kaba tuid da ka dujok bad ka ngap , ha kaban ki Kanaan , ki bat , ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Hib nabar ki Jebus ki shong mynta .
translation.en: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians , and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large , unto a land flowing with milk and honey  ; unto the place of the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites .

translation.kha: U Trai u la don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad u la pynmanbha ïa u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Joseph , and he was a prosperous man  ; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba san jong ka jingsynshar u Rehoboam , u syiem Shishak jongngi ka Ijipt u la leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam , that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem :
But he answered and said ,  I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ïa nga la phah tang sha ki langbrot ba la jah noh jong ki paid Israel .
Lada de leh ïa kaei kaba ngam kwah ban leh , kane ka mut ba ngam long Shua uta uba leh ïa kata ; pynban , ka dei ka pum kaba im hapoh jong nga .
translation.en: Now if I do that I would not , it is no more I that do it , but sin that dwelleth in me .
And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down , lay low , and bring to the ground , even to the dust .
translation.kha: Un pynjot ïa ki kut jong ki Moab bad ïa ki kynroh bajrong jong ki bad pynhap ïa ki shapoh khyndew .

translation.en: But if any man be ignorant , let him be ignorant .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada um pynleit jingmut ïa kane , phi wat salia ïa u .
Te phin shaniah ha U Blei borabor bad shem ba u long ka thymmei jongno ka jingkmen jong phi .
translation.en: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty , and shalt lift up thy face unto God .
And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house , and the king s entry without , turned he from the house of the  Lord  for the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Bad khnang ban pynsngewbha ïa u patsha ki Assyria , u Ahas u weng ruh na ka Templ ïa ka rynsan na ka bynta ka khet syiem bad u set noh ïa ka jaka rung bakyrpang jong u syiem sha ka Templ .
Wat ailad ïa u Soitan .
translation.en: Neither give place to the devil .

translation.kha: Kñia ka long kaei kob U Trai Nongsynshar u ong : Wallam ïa u paidbhur Ban pynshyrkhei ïa ki bad shun lwet ïa ki .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will bring up a company upon them , and will give them to be removed and spoiled .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh “lada hapoh ka dohksah jong phoi , phi don ka jingpihuiñ , bad khwan myntoi , to wat imat pop pyrshah ïa ka jingshisha da kaba kren sarong ïa la ka jingmad .
translation.en: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts , glory not , and lie not against the truth .
And he gave them into the hand of the heathen  ; and they that hated them ruled over them .
translation.kha: U la iehnoh ïa ki ha ka bor jong ki nongmane bleithaw , bad ki nongshun jong ki , ki synshar halor jong ki .
Katba u ding Don ha lynti sha ïing , ki shakri jong u ki la wan shem ïa u bad ka khubor , U khun jong me un im !
translation.en: And as he was now going down , his servants met him , and told him , saying , Thy son liveth .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma ngi , kiba im , ngin ainguh ïa u mynta bad sha bymjukut . A to ïaroh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: But we will bless the  Lord  from this time forth and for evermore . Praise the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong me kim tip satia ba men pynshitom ïa ki . A Trai , buh ïa ki ha ka jingjahburom bad ai ba kin jynjar ; ai ba kan jingïar da ka nongpynshitom kaba me la pynkhreh . To pyn-i ïa ki haduh katno me ieit ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: Lord  , when thy hand is lifted up , they will not see : but they shall see , and be ashamed for their envy at the people  ; yea , the fire of thine enemies shall devour them .
And it came to pass afterward , that David s heart smote him , because he had cut off Saul s skirt .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingïatiplem jong u Dabid ka sdang ban pynjynjar ïa u ,

Ki khun ki ksiew jongki u Kush ki longsyiem ki briew jong ka Seba , ka Habilah , ka Sabtah , ka Raamah , bun ka Shobakh . Ki khun ki kyiuh jong u Raamah ki longsem ki bhabriew jngai ka Sheba , bad ka Dedan .
translation.en: And the sons of Cush  ; Seba , and Havilah , and Sabtah , and Raamah , and Sabtecha : and the sons of Raamah  ; Sheba , and Dedan .
And of the blue , and purple , and scarlet , they made cloths of service , to do service in the holy place , and made the holy garments for Aaron  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , ki suh ïa ki jaiñphong kiba ishongkun ba ki lyngdoh ki dei ban kup haba ki shakri ha ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang . Ki suh ïa kine ki jaiñphong lyngdoh na ka bynta u Aaron kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
‘ Nga ong ha phi ,’ u la jubab , ‘ ba ha uno eit u briew uba don ei ei , yn ai kham bun shuh shuh ; hynrei ha u briew u bym don ei ei , wiat ïa kaba rit kaba u don yn shim nong na u .
translation.en: For I say unto you , That unto every one which hath shall be given  ; and from him that hath not , even that he hath shall be taken away from him .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki , ‘ Ngi la long ki mraw u Pharaoh ha Ijipt , bad U TRAI’ u la pyrsad ïa ngi da ka barabor jong u .
translation.en: Then thou shalt say unto thy son , We were Pharaoh s bondmen in Egypt  ; and the  Lord  brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand :

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la shim ïa nga na ka Kam kum u nongaplangbrot bad u la hukum ïa sa ban wan malu ïathuhlypa ha ki briew jong u ki Israel .
translation.en: And the  Lord  took me as I followed the flock , and the  Lord  said unto me , Go , prophesy unto my people Israel .
But the king spared Mephibosheth , the son of Jonathan the son of Saul , because of the  Lord s  oath that was between them , between David and Jonathan the son of Saul .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ka kular kaba kyntang kaba ma u bad u Jonathan ki la pynlong uwei ïa uwei pat , u Dabid u la pyllait ïa u Mephibosheth , u khun jong u Jonathan bad u ksiew jong u Saul .
Kam dei kata kaba rung shapoh ka shimet jong u briew katba pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid katei kumto ka lehniam ; pynban , dei kaba mih shabar na ka , kaba pynlong ïa u , u bymhok .
translation.en: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man  ; but that which cometh out of the mouth , this defileth a man .

translation.kha: ban pynïap ïa ki shynriah bad ïa ki kynthei , ban pynïap ïa kiba la tymmen bad ïa kiba dang Gath , ban pynïap ïa ki khynnah shynrang bad ki khynnah kynthei ,
translation.en: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman  ; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young  ; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid  ;

The  Lord  hath done that which he had devised  ; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old : he hath thrown down , and hath not pitied : and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee , he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries .
translation.kha: Nga kner ïa la ki kti , hynrei ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa nga . U  Trai  u la khot ïa ki nongshun pyrshah ïa nga na ki liang baroh ; ki la leh ïa nga kum ïa kaei kaei kaba jakhlia .
Ki syiem jongki ki , ki ïeng pyrshah , ki nongsynshar jong ki , ki ïasylla lang! pyrshah ïa U Trai bad pyrshah ïa u sahmiet uba u la jied .
translation.en: The kings of the earth set themselves , and the rulers take counsel together , against the  Lord  , and against his anointed , saying ,

translation.kha: Nangta u ong , ‘ Ale hangne dara pynïap ïa sa . Nga la mynsaw palat pynlang nga la jan ïap .’
translation.en: He said unto me again , Stand , I pray thee , upon me , and slay me : for anguish is come upon me , because my life is yet whole in me .

translation.kha: Da shisha un pynïap ïa kito ki briew kiba snem , ki la jubab , Bad un eiei ïa ka byr-ïe sohwaiñ ha kiwei pat ki nongshimwai , ki ban ai ha u ïa ka bhah jong u na ka jingkheit ha ka por kiba biang .
translation.en: They say unto him , He will miserably destroy those wicked men , and will let out his vineyard unto other husbandmen , which shall render him the fruits in their seasons .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha to , ‘ Dei u Salmone u khun jong me u ban te ïa ka Templ jongu nga . Nga la jied ïa u ba longïing u khun jong nga , bad nga ngan longsyiem u kpa jongki u .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Solomon thy son , he shall build my house and my courts : for I have chosen him to be my son , and I will be his father .
When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard , thou shalt not glean it afterward : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow .
translation.kha: Haba phi la lum ïa ki sohwaiñ shisien , wat leit biang sha ki dieng sohwaiñ sa shisien ; ki sohwaiñ kiba dang sah hangta ki dei ka bynta ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei .
U khynwin baroh u dei ban ïohi ïa ka jingpynim ka jong U Blei !’
translation.en: And all flesh shall see the salvation of God .

translation.kha: U patsha jong ki un phet ha ka jingsngew shyrkhei , bad ki rangbah shipai keiñ sheptieng haduh katta katta haduh ba kin ioh ïa ki lama thma jong ki . U Trai u la kren — U Trai ïa uba la mane ha Jerusalem badno uba ka ding jong u ka thang hangta ïa ki jingkñia .
translation.en: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear , and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign , saith the  Lord  , whose fire is in Zion , and his furnace in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: bad pynlong ïa im ka hima lad ki lyngdoh ban shakri ïa U Blei bad U Kpa jong u . Ha U Jisu Khrist , to long ka burom malade ka bor junom la junom ! Adummim .
translation.en: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father  ; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .
When they shall go , I will spread my net upon them  ; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven  ; I will chastise them , as their congregation hath heard .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan riam da ka jar bad kem ïa ki kum ki sim katba ki dang ïaid . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki namar ki kam bymman ba ki la leh .
U Ïalam u ïap haba u la dap shispah laiphew hynñiew Snem ka rta .
translation.en: And these are the years of the life of Ishmael , an hundred and thirty and seven years : and he gave up the ghost and died  ; and was gathered unto his people .

translation.kha: hynriew ki Philistia ki la kem ïa ki bad pynsep ïa ki lai ngut ki khunlung shynrang jongu u Saul : u Jonathan , u Adadah , bad u Malkhishua .
translation.en: And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons  ; and the Philistines slew Jonathan , and Abinadab , and Malchi–shua , Saul s sons .

translation.kha: Kane baroh ka la jia ha Bethania kaba don ha ka pynong mihngi jong ka wah Jordan , ha kabu u Ïoannis u la pynbaptis .
translation.en: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan , where John was baptizing .

translation.kha: Ïa kano kano ka jingai jingjam ba u Ahithophel u la ai ha Kito ki sngi , la pdiang kumba ka long hi ka ktien jong U Blei ; u Dabid sad u Absalom baroh ar ngut ki bud ïa ka .
translation.en: And the counsel of Ahithophel , which he counselled in those days , was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God : so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom .

translation.kha: U shipai rangbah suba ïohnang hangta ha khmat ka diengpynïeng u la ïohi kumno U Jisu u la ïap . Ang u briew u long shisha U Khun U Blei ! u la noh .
translation.en: And when the centurion , which stood over against him , saw that he so cried out , and gave up the ghost , he said , Truly this man was the Son of God .

translation.kha: Nangta ha ka por khat-ar baje badno ruh ha ka por para baje u la leh Khmut .
translation.en: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour , and did likewise .

translation.kha: Kumba u la ïalap ha ki synagog ha kylleng ka ri .
translation.en: And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee .

translation.kha: Namar ka jingieit jong ngi ïa phi , ngi la long kiba la kloi ba ïabynta bad phi ym Teng ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei hynrei wat ïa ka jingim jong i'u shwa . Phi la long kiba ieid thep mynsiem eh jong ngi!
translation.en: So being affectionately desirous of you , we were willing to have imparted unto you , not the gospel of God only , but also our own souls , because ye were dear unto us .

translation.kha: Ïa ki brai lad nga bad ïa nga , la die sha ka jingpynïap . Lada kam da long kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba die sha ka jinglongmraw , ngan jin da la shu sngap jar bad ngan ym pynshitom ïa Phin ; hynrei ngi la jan shah pynngat — shah pynduh pyndam !
translation.en: For we are sold , I and my people , to be destroyed , to be slain , and to perish . But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen , I had held my tongue , although the enemy could not countervail the king s damage .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katto katne ki briew na ka jait Judith ki la wan ha u Joshua ha jingsleh . Usal na ki , u Kaleb u khun Jong u Jephunneh u nong Kenis , u ong ha u , Phi tip kaei kiba U Trai u ong ha Kedesh Bani shaphang jong phi bad per ha u Moses , u biria jong U Blei .
translation.en: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal : and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him , Thou knowest the thing that the  Lord  said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh–barnea .

And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau , which dwelt in Seir , through the way of the plain from Elath , and from Ezion–geber , we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi la nang ïaid , bad ngi kiar ïa ka lynti kaba leit na ki shnong Elath bad Esiongeber sha ka Duriaw Baïap , bad ngi phai shaphang shatei-lam-mihngi sha ka ri Moab .
Ki shongkhia ha u kseh — ka snur thapbawa .
translation.en: Whose hope shall be cut off , and whose trust shall be a spider s web .

translation.kha: Em , ka to hangtai bad phi . Pi tip ïa ka bad phi lah ban sot ïa ka ; kumta mynta , kohnguh ïa ka .
translation.en: But the word is very nigh unto thee , in thy mouth , and in thy heart , that thou mayest do it .

translation.kha: Ka jingiw jongnga ka jinganna ainguh ka la pynsngewbha ïa U Trai , bad U la ong ha latai , Lano lano ruh tun ym bsuh ïa ka pyiar hapoh ka jingtim namar kaei kaba ki briew ki ai ; nga tip ba naduh ba ki dang samla , ki jingpyrkhat jong ki , ki long kiba sniew . Lano lano ruh tun ym pynjot Shua ïa ki jingthaw ba-im baroh , kumba ar la leh ha kano ka sien .
translation.en: And the  Lord  smelled a sweet savour  ; and the  Lord  said in his heart , I will not again curse the ground any more for man s sake  ; for the imagination of man s heart is evil from his youth  ; neither will I again smite any more every thing living , as I have done .

translation.kha: Nobah ym daiñ ïa lade” ba ngi ïalap ; ngi ïalap ïa U Josis Khreh kum U Trai , bad ma ngi kum ki shakri jong phi na ka bynta U Ujuh .
translation.en: For we preach not ourselves , but Christ Jesus the Lord ; and ourselves your servants for Jesus  sake .

translation.kha: Ki khamtam jong ki , ki syriem thik kum ki khmat ba nga la ïohi harud ka wah Khebar . Uwei pa aiwai u kherub u ïaid babit sha iitkhmat .
translation.en: And the likeness of their faces was the same faces which I saw by the river of Chebar , their appearances and themselves : they went every one straight forward .
And if he do not these three unto her , then shall she go out free without money .
translation.kha: Lada um pyndep ïa kine ki kamram ha ka , u dei ban pyllaitluid noh ïa ka khlem da siew ei ei .
Pynngam ïa ka jingpynïap ha ka khleh jong u bad teh hajar jong ka ïa ka ki bakyntang jong ka jingpynkyntang ba la thoh ‘ La Pynkyntang sha U Trai .’
translation.en: And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head , and put the holy crown upon the mitre .
But did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , like unto the abominations of the heathen , whom the  Lord  had cast out before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki jingleh ba-ijli jong ki hima kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki dang tur shaphrang , u Manasseh u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart , and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah : and Uzza and Ahio , the sons of Abinadab , drave the new cart .
translation.kha: Ki la shim ïa ka na ka ïing jong u Abinadab kaba don halor lum , bad ki buh ïa ka ha ka kali thymmai . U Ussah bad u Ahio , ki khun shynrang jong u Abinadab , ki lam lynti ïa ka kali ,

translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  spake again unto Ahaz , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah sa kawei pat ka khubor sha u Ahas :

Bad ïa kito kiba hiarpateng na u Lem kiba long ki lyngdoh la ai ïa ki da ka Hukum ba kmen lbong kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na ki paid Israel , Katai ka long , na la ki briew , wat haba ki briew jong ki ruh ki hiarpateng na u Abarim .
translation.en: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi , who receive the office of the priesthood , have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law , that is , of their brethren , though they come out of the loins of Abraham :

translation.kha: Hynrei tang namar ka jingïoh pyrsa bymdei Phi shah ïa kiba Shah pynrem ban lait bad pa’ khang ïa kiba hun ih na kaba ïohi ïa ka jingbishar thok .
translation.en: Which justify the wicked for reward , and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him !

translation.kha: Naba nga jingsngewsih shaphang ka jingieit jongki me ïa ki briew U Blei baroh bad ïa ka jingngeit kaba me don ha U Trai Jisu .
translation.en: Hearing of thy love and faith , which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus , and toward all saints  ;
And said , Hail , King of the Jews ! and they smote him with their hands .
translation.kha: Im slem ko Syiem ki Jiw !  Bad ki la leit bad thab ïa u .

translation.en: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all , but one receiveth the prize ? So run , that ye may obtain .
translation.kha: Da shisha phi tip ba don shibun ki nongïamareh kiba ïashim bynta ha ka jingmareh thong , hynrei tang uwei na ki u ïoh ïa ka prais . Kumta to mareh ha kata ka rukom ban ïoh ïa ka prais .

translation.en: Therefore are my loins filled with pain : pangs have taken hold upon me , as the pangs of a woman that travaileth : I was bowed down at the hearing of it  ; I was dismayed at the seeing of it .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga la ïohi bad ïohsngew ha ka jingïohipaw ka la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingsngewtriem bad sngewpang , ka jingpang kum ka jong ka kynthei ha ka por suh kha .

translation.en: But if I live in the flesh , this is the fruit of my labour : yet what I shall choose I wot not .
translation.kha: Hynrei , lada , da kaba nga lah ban leh shuh shuh ka kam kaba myntoi , te ngam thikna ïa kano nga dei ban jied .

translation.en: Now Rachel had taken the images , and put them in the camel s furniture , and sat upon them . And Laban searched all the tent , but found them not .
translation.kha: Ka Rakhel ka la shim ïa kita ki blei ïing bad ka la lah thep ïa ki hapoh ka jin    ut bad ka shong halor jong ki . U Laban la u wad kylleng hapoh kata ka ïingjaiñ , hynrei um lap ïa ki .
Hynrei ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la lah thung ha ka lyngkha kaba seisoh bad kaba biang bhah ka um ba kumta u lah ban sei ki sla bad pynmih ki sohshnong badno long u dieng shitaiew uba itynnat eh .
translation.en: It was planted in a good soil by great waters , that it might bring forth branches , and that it might bear fruit , that it might be a goodly vine .
Yea , also I continued in the work of this wall , neither bought we any land : and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work .
translation.kha: Nga sei ïa ka bor jong nga baroh na ka bynta ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh bad ngam shym wad ban ïoh kano kano ka jingdon jingem . Baroh kiba trei na ka bynta jong nga , ki ïasnoh ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh .

translation.en: And he said , Swear unto me . And he sware unto him . And Israel bowed himself upon the bed s head .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u ong ,  Pynlong ka jingsmai ba phin leh kumta .  U Joseph u la pynlong ka jingsmai , bad u Jakob ruh u ainguh hangta ha jingthiah .

translation.en: Then all the children of Israel , and all the people , went up , and came unto the house of God , and wept , and sat there before the  Lord  , and fasted that day until even , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki briew ka Israel ki leit kiew sha Bethel bad ki ïamkthang . Ki shong hangta ha khmat U  Trai  bad kim shym bam ei ei haduh janmiet . Ki kñia ki jingainguh ïasyllok bad ki thang ïa ki jingainguh pynïasuk — baroh ha jingdon ryngkat U  Trai .

Dei na sier ka deng balei ba la pynshlur ïa ngi . Ym tang ba la pynshlur ïa ngi ; haduh katno u Titos u la pynkmen ïa ngi da ka jingkem jong u halor ka kynsi kaba phi baroh phi la ïarap ban pynstang ïa u !
translation.en: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort : yea , and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus , because his spirit was refreshed by you all .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat ki Simran jong u Jisu ki la wan peiñ , bad ki la lyngkot shikatdei eh ba-bang jingkam ïa u ba u ïakren bad kata ka briew . Hynñiew ym don na ki uba la ong ïa ka , Phai khih aïu ? lane uba la kylla ïa u , Balei ba me ïakren bad ka ?
translation.en: And upon this came his disciples , and marvelled that he talked with the woman : yet no man said , What seekest thou ? or , Why talkest thou with her ?

translation.kha: Ïa i'u , pynban , ka long kaba dei hok , nongmareh ba ngi ïoh ïa kaei kaba ngi dei ban Ïohi na ka bynta kawei kiba ngi la leh ; hynrei , um shym la leh kano kano ka me dei .
translation.en: And we indeed justly  ; for we receive the due reward of our deeds : but this man hath done nothing amiss .

translation.kha: Kumta ki bret noh ïa la ki blei nongwei bad ki la mane ïa U Trai ; bad u la pisa halor ka jingjied jrong ki Israel .
translation.en: And they put away the strange gods from among them , and served the  Lord  : and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel .
No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new : for he saith , The old is better .
translation.kha: Bad ym don uno uno uba kwah ïa ka waiñ bathymmai hadien ba u la dih ïa ka waiñ barim . ‘ Kaba rim ka kham bha ,’ u ong .

translation.en: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah , in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite , which is before Mamre  ;
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u , u Isaak bad u Ishmael , ki la tep ïa u ha ka krem Makhpelah , kaba ha ka lyngkha kaba don shaphang mihngi na Mamre , kaba dei ka jong u Ephron u khun jong u Sohar u nong Hit .
Ka jingmutlop ka long kum ka kynteit kaba kaw kaw , kaba bieit bad kaba khlemrain .
translation.en: A foolish woman is clamorous : she is simple , and knoweth nothing .

translation.kha: Don kiba lap ïa ki , bad la ïathuh ha u Joshua ha-ei ba ki ïarieh .
translation.en: And it was told Joshua , saying , The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah .
And take the helmet of salvation , and the sword of the Spirit , which is the word of God :
translation.kha: Bad to pdiang ïa ka jingpynim kum ka jingïada khlieh , bad ka ktien U Blei kum ka waitlam kaba U Mynsiem u ai ha phi .
Lada nga la thoh ïa ka khak kaba nga rep pynlang knieh ïa ka na ki trai kiba dei hok —
translation.en: If my land cry against me , or that the furrows likewise thereof complain  ;

translation.kha: lait noh kiba ïadei jan eh , kum ka kmie , u kpa , u khwan , ka khun , u hynmen u para ,
translation.en: But for his kin , that is near unto him , that is , for his mother , and for his father , and for his son , and for his daughter , and for his brother ,

translation.kha: Namarba ki Israel ki la shongduh dara ha ka Them Akasia , ki rangbah ki la sdang ban ïathiah shongkai bad ki kynoi Moab naba don hangta .
translation.en: And Israel abode in Shittim , and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab .

translation.kha: Kaba mut nangto kan longkmie ba ki kmie ki kba ha Jerusalem kin bim ïa la ki khun , bad ki khun paw kin bim ïa la ki kmie ki kpa . Ngam pynshitom ïa pha bad ngan pynsakma kylleng ïa kitab kino kiba sdang im .
translation.en: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee , and the sons shall eat their fathers  ; and I will execute judgments in thee , and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds .

translation.kha: Da shisha ym U Blei , u bym shym la tyngkai wat ïa la u jong U Khun hi , hynrei uba la ai sngewbha ïa u na ka bynta jong ngi baroh ! U la ai ha ngi ïa la U Khun — hato un ym ai sngewma ïa kiei kiei baroh ?
translation.en: He that spared not his own Son , but delivered him up for us all , how shall he not with him also freely give us all things ?

translation.kha: Bad ki briew jong me ki ong ba kaei kaba nga leh kada long ka badei ! Em , ka dei ka lyngkot jong ki ka bymdei .
translation.en: Yet the children of thy people say , The way of the Lord is not equal : but as for them , their way is not equal .

That he told her all his heart , and said unto her , There hath not come a razor upon mine head  ; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother s womb : if I be shaven , then my strength will go from me , and I shall become weak , and be like any other man .
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh u ïathuh ha ka ïa ka jingshisha .  Ïa u shñiuh jong nga ym pat ju khap ,  u ong ,  Ïa nga la pynkyntang sha U Blei kum u Nasir naduh ka por ba kha ïa nga . Lada la khi ïa u shñiuh jong nga , ngan duh noh ïa ka bor bad ngan long uba tlot kumba long lem kiwei .
Ha shuwa ba u khynnah un eh un san ban ong ‘ Mei’ bad ‘ Pa’ , ïa ka spah baroh jong ka Dorkas bad ïa ka mar lute baroh jong ka Samaria yn setkut noh da u pashat ka Assyria .
translation.en: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry , My father , and my mother , the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria .

translation.kha: A Blei jong nga , to pyllait im ïa ang na ki bymman , na ka ba jong kito kiba runar bad kiba sniew .
translation.en: Deliver me , O my God , out of the hand of the wicked , out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man .

translation.kha: Ka ksiar bad ka ayu jongno phi ka la bam sarang , bad kane ka siew kan long ka suki byrsha ïa phi bad kan sa bam duh ïa ka doh jong phi kum ka ding . Phi la kynsi spah ha kine ki sngi kiba khaweh .
translation.en: Your gold and silver is cankered  ; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you , and shall eat your flesh as it were fire . Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la dep ong ïa kane , u la khmied shai bna bad u la ong , Ko Pa , ka kynta ka la poi . To ai ka burom ïa la U Khun , ba U Khun un ïoh ban ai ka burom ïa me .
translation.en: These words spake Jesus , and lifted up his eyes to heaven , and said ,  Father , the hour is come  ; glorify thy Son , that thy Son also may glorify thee :

An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me , and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings , and thy peace offerings , thy sheep , and thine oxen : in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee , and I will bless thee .
translation.kha: Tei ïa nga kawei ka duwan da ka khyndew , bad kñia ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi jong phi halor jong ka kum ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ha man la ka jaka ba nga pynkyrpang ba phin mane ïa nga , ngan wan bad kyrkhu ïa phi .

Ka don sa kawei ka thma badno ki Philistia , sad u Joram u khun jong u Elkanah u pynïap ïa u Lahmi , uba shi to bad u Goliath na Gath , Uba u kop jong u , u kein u dieng thung sum uba ka jingrben jong u ka long kat u kattne jong u nongthain jaiñ .
translation.en: And there was war again with the Philistines  ; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite , whose spear staff was like a weaver s beam .
Looking for that blessed hope , and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: katba ngi dang ap ïa ka jingwan jong kata ka Sngi ba la kyrkhu kaba ngi ap kyrmen , haba ka burom U Blei bakhraw bad U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim jong ngi kan paw .

Lada phi manna ïa kiwei pat ki blei , ka jingtur U Tlai kuna wan bad thang ïa phi kum ka ding bad kan pynjot thiaw ïa phi , namar U Trai U blei jong phi , babha khong jingset bad phi , um lah shahïap ba phin shakuriaw ïa kiei pat ki blei .
translation.en: ( For the  Lord  thy God is a jealous God among you ) lest the anger of the  Lord  thy God be kindled against thee , and destroy thee from off the face of the earth .

Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah : I will water thee with my tears , O Heshbon , and Elealeh : for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen .
translation.kha: Mynta nga ïam ïa ki sohwaiñ jong ka Sibmah kumba nga ïam namar ka Jaser . Ki ummat jong nga ki hap na ka bynta ka Heshbon bad ka Elealeh , namar ym don kano kano ka jingkheit soh kaba pynkmen ïa ki briew .

translation.en: Though it be given him to be in safety , whereon he resteth  ; yet his eyes are upon their ways .
translation.kha: U Blei u lah ban shah ïa u ban im khlem jingpynthut , hynrei u peit-thuh pat ïa u man la ka por .
Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew , bad ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng ; ïa ki phylla la kynthup da ka jingsngewtynnat .
translation.en: The people shall hear , and be afraid : sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Philistia .

translation.kha: Bad ma phi pajut , kiba la kylluid long ki briew jrong U Blei mynba phi la jingphohsniew ïa ka khubor kaba shisha , ka khubor babha kaba ïalamwir ïa phi ka jingpynhun . Phi la kheit ha U Kynther , bad U Balei u la Buh ïa ka jingshonshab ka jinglong trai ha phi da kaba ai ha phi ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid uba u la kular .
translation.en: In whom ye also trusted , after that ye heard the word of truth , the gospel of your salvation : in whom also after that ye believed , ye were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise ,
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Take all the heads of the people , and hang them up before the  Lord  against the sun , that the fierce anger of the  Lord  may be turned away from Israel .
translation.kha: bad u ong ha u Moses ,  Shim ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel baroh bad da kaba kohnguh ïa nga , pynïap ïa ki haba shai ka sngi te ngan ym bitar shuh ïa ki briew .
Haba u Saul u la synriah ar snem ha Israel ,
translation.en: Saul reigned one year  ; and when he had reigned two years over Israel ,

translation.kha: U Judas Teng mar ïapoi , u la leit sha U Jisu bad u la ong , Ko Nonghikai ! bad u la doh ïa u .
translation.en: And as soon as he was come , he goeth straightway to him , and saith , Master , master  ; and kissed him .
And the  Lord  visited Sarah as he had said , and the  Lord  did unto Sarah as he had spoken .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ka Sarah kumba u la kular , bad ka la punkhun bad kha khun shynrang ïa u Abraham haba u la tymmen .
Ki la pyrta ha ki lawbah bad ha ki mawsiang , To tap halor jong ngi bad to buhrieh khong ïa ngi na ki khmat jongno uta uba shongsuk halor ka khet pynlang na ka jingbitar U Khunlangbrot !
translation.en: And said to the mountains and rocks , Fall on us , and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne , and from the wrath of the Lamb :

Now when I passed by thee , and looked upon thee , behold , thy time was the time of love  ; and I spread my skirt over thee , and covered thy nakedness : yea , I sware unto thee , and entered into a covenant with thee , saith the Lord  God  , and thou becamest mine .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang ïaid lyngba biang , nga la ïohi ba ka por ka la poi ïa pha ban shoh jingieit . Nga la tap ïa ka jinglyngkhuit jong pha da ka jaiñ jynsur jong nga bad nga la kular ban ieit ïa pha . Ho-oid nga la pynlong ka jutang shongkurim bad pha , bad pha long ka jong nga .  Kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong .

translation.en: He found him in a desert land , and in the waste howling wilderness  ; he led him about , he instructed him , he kept him as the apple of his eye .
translation.kha: U lap ïa ki ha ka ri shyiap ba ki ïaid sakma , ka ri shyiap kaba kynjah . Ïa ki u sumar bad u ker u da , kumba u ïada ïa lade .

U Trai u ong ha u , Mih shabar bad ïeng ha khmied jong nga halor u lat . Hadien kata , U Trai u la ïaid nangta bad u la phah ïa ka lem bajur kaba la kad arliang ïa ki lum Bad pynkhynñiuh ïa ki mawlong — hynrei U Trai um shym ba-don ha ka lyer . Ka lyer ka sangeh ba beh , bad nangta la kaei u jumai — hynrei U Trai um shym ba-don ha u Jahmai .
translation.en: And he said , Go forth , and stand upon the mount before the  Lord . And , behold , the  Lord  passed by , and a great and strong wind rent the mountains , and brake in pieces the rocks before the  Lord   ; but the  Lord  was not in the wind : and after the wind an earthquake  ; but the  Lord  was not in the earthquake :
And he trembling and astonished said , Lord , what wilt thou have me to do ? And the Lord said unto him ,  Arise , and go into the city , and it shall be told thee what thou must do .
translation.kha: Hynrei , ïeng joit bad leit rung shapoh ka nongbah , ha kaba yn ïathuh ïa me ïa kaei kaba me dei ban leh .

translation.en: As they went out , behold , they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil .
translation.kha: Katba ki rangbah ki dang ïamih , katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wanlam sha U Jisu ïa u briew u bymnang kren namar ba u shongksuid .
Haba phi Tei ïa ka duwan U Trai U Blei jong phi , wat pynïeng hajan Jong ka ïa uno uno u dieng uba don ka dur jong ka bleithaw Asherah .
translation.en: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the  Lord  thy God , which thou shalt make thee .
And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet  ; and none of them was cleansed , saving Naaman the Syrian .
translation.kha: Bad la don bun ki briew kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh kiba la im ha Israel ha ka por jong u Elisha u nongïathuhlypa ; pynban ym shym la pynkhiah ïa uno uno na ki , hynrei , tang ïa u Naaman u nong Syria .

translation.en: Nevertheless mine eye spared them from destroying them , neither did I make an end of them in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Hynrei pynban nga la pyrkhat isynei ïa ki . Nga la rai ban ym pynïap ïa ki ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: The night is far spent , the day is at hand : let us therefore cast off the works of darkness , and let us put on the armour of light .
translation.kha: Ka miet ka la jan kut , ka sngi ka la jan sdang . To ngin ïasangeh noh na kaba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba long jong ka jingdum , bad to ngin kieng ïa ki atiar ka jingïaleh ha ka jingshai .
Haba ka la dep ai um , uta u briew u shim ïa ka sati kseh kaba remdor bad u pyndait ha ka khrud jong ka , dara u pyndeng ruh ar tylli ki khadu ksai kiba heh ha ki jingkyntip jngai ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as the camels had done drinking , that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight , and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold  ;

translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ha u syiem Ahab , Mynta , khie wait bad bam-im . Nga jingphohsniew ïa ka jingsawa ba u slap u wan .
translation.en: And Elijah said unto Ahab , Get thee up , eat and drink  ; for there is a sound of abundance of rain .
Then stood there up one in the council , a Pharisee , named Gamaliel , a doctor of the law , had in reputation among all the people , and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei uwei na ki , u Pharisi uba kyrteng u Gamaliel , uba long u nonghikai ka Hukum bad ïa uba la burom shikatdei da ki briew baroh , u la ïeng ha ka Dorbar . U la hukum ban ïalam ïa ki apostol shipor shabar ,

translation.en: Then Pharaoh said unto him , But what hast thou lacked with me , that , behold , thou seekest to go to thine own country ? And he answered , Nothing : howbeit let me go in any wise .
translation.kha: Balei ?  u syiem u kylli .  Hato ngam shym lah ban ai ei ei ïa me ? Hato dei kata balei ba me da kwah ban leit phai sha ïing ?   Shu shah ïa nga ban leit ,  u Hadad u jubab ïa u syiem . Bad u leit phai sha la ka ri . Kum u syiem Edom , u Hadad u long uba bymman , u nongshun uba pynkthang ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof : but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged .
translation.kha: Haba ka jaitbynriew ka leh pop , kan ïoh u nongsynshar uwei hadien uwei pat . Hynrei ka jaitbynriew kan long kaba khlaiñ bad kaba ïaineh haba ka don ki nongsynshar kiba stad bad bashemphang .
Ha sakma hi ka sngi , u Herod bad u Pilat ki la ïalong paw ; ha shuwa jrong kane , ki la ïalong ki nongshoh-nar .
translation.en: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together : for before they were at enmity between themselves .

translation.kha: bad u lah ban shakri hangta kum u lyngkhot jngai U Trai U balui jongki u , kum kiwei pat ki Likhi kiba ïakhih hangta .
translation.en: Then he shall minister in the name of the  Lord  his God , as all his brethren the Levites do , which stand there before the  Lord .
Zion heard , and was glad  ; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments , O  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Seïon ki lehkmen , bad ki nongbah ka Judah ki shadkmen namar ki jingbishar jong me , A  Trai .

translation.en: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him , and in an hour that he is not aware of ,
translation.kha: Nangta u kynrad jong uta u shakri un wan pat ha kawei ka sngi haba u shakri um shym khmih lynti ïa u bad ha ka por kaba um tip .
ñiar ba ki khun ki ksiew kynthah lad u badno ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u ki la ïoh jaka . Ïa ka ri Gedalaïah la ai ha kiba sah jong ki khun ki ksiew u Mareshah .
translation.en: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons : and the rest of Manasseh s sons had the land of Gilead .

translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ka sngi Sabtah , ka sngi shongthait jong ar namar ka long ka nang hapdeng jongngi at bad phi pateng la pateng , ba phin ioh tip ba nga U Trai nga la pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong nga hi .
translation.en: Speak thou also unto the children of Israel , saying , Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep : for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations  ; that ye may know that I am the  Lord  that doth sanctify you .

translation.kha: Hadad kane , U jongu u la paw sa shisien pang ha la ki synran hajan ka duriaw Tiberias . Kanneh ka long kumno ka la jliah .
translation.en: After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias  ; and on this wise shewed he himself .
And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe , I have found the book of the law in the house of the  Lord . And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan .
translation.kha: U ong ha u Shaphan ,  Nga la shem ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum hangne ha ka Templ .

translation.en: Then Abram removed his tent , and came and dwelt in the plain of Mamre , which is in Hebron , and built there an altar unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u Abram u kynriah noh ïa la ka dara , bad u wan shong wan sah hajan ki dieng kyntang jong u Mamre ha Hebron , bad hangta u tei ka duwan ha U  Trai .
Haba ka Martha ka la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u dang wan , ka la otsher don ïakdang ïa u , hynrei ka Mari ka la sah ha ïing .
translation.en: Then Martha , as soon as she heard that Jesus was coming , went and met him : but Mary sat still in the house .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingshitom jong u , u la pynrit ïa lade , u phai sha U Trai U Bel jong u , bad u kyrpad ïa ka jingïarap jong u .
translation.en: And when he was in affliction , he besought the  Lord  his God , and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers ,
And say unto them , Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , ye kings of Judah , and all Judah , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , that enter in by these gates :
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki syiem bad ïa baroh ki briew jong ka Judah bad ïa uwei pa uwei uba shong ba sah ha Jerusalem bad rung sha kine ki khyrdop , ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
To thaw ka pansngiat na ka rupa sad ka ksiar kaba ki la ai , bad buh ïa ka halor ka Khlieh jong u Joshua , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u khun jong u Jehosadak .
translation.en: Then take silver and gold , and make crowns , and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest  ;
And so it fell out unto him : for the people trode upon him in the gate , and he died .
translation.kha: Te ka la jia kumta ïa u ; u la ïap , da kaba shah ïuh ha ban da ïap ha u paidbah ha kata ka khyrdop shnong .

Nga la khang ïa u slap haba ki jingthung ki dang dakmong eh ïa u . Nga la pynhap sting ha kawei ka nongbah , hynrei ym ha kawei pat . U slap u la hap ha kawei ka lyngka hynrei kawei pat ka lyngkha ka la ba-tyrkhong .
translation.en: And also I have withholden the rain from you , when there were yet three months to the harvest : and I caused it to rain upon one city , and caused it not to rain upon another city : one piece was rained upon , and the piece whereupon it rained not withered .
Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me , and sat before me .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la wan ban kylli na nga shaphang ka mon U  Trai .

translation.en: And many that believed came , and confessed , and shewed their deeds .
translation.kha: Kiba bun na kiba ngeit ki la ïawan , ki da phla ha kaba paw bad ki da pynpaw ïa kaei kaba ki la leh .

translation.en: For before that certain came from James , he did eat with the Gentiles : but when they were come , he withdrew and separated himself , fearing them which were of the circumcision .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba katto katne ngut ki rangbah ba la phah da u Jakob kin poi hangta , u Petros u la ïabam lang bad ki parabangeit Jentil . Hynrei hadien ba kine ki rangbah ki la poi , u la kynriah noh bad um shym ïabam lang shuh bad ki Jentil , namar u la sheptieng ïa kito kiba ha ka liang kiba otsher ïa ki .
Te kumta , kumba ka Jingthoh bakhiah ka ong , Uno uno uba kwah ban sngewsarong , u dei ngab sngewsarong ha kaei kaba U Trai u la ar .
translation.en: That , according as it is written , He that glorieth , let him glory in the Lord .
And afterward Joshua smote them , and slew them , and hanged them on five trees : and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u pynïap ïa ki syiem bad u sdien ïa ki ha ki san tylli ki dieng , ha kaba ki met jong ki , ki la sah haduh janmiet .

Baroh kin ong kumto kano ka ri , kaba shisien ka la long ka jaka khlaw , ka la kylla long kum ka Kper Dedan , bad kumno ba ki nongbah kiba la shah pynstet , shah lute bad shah iehnoh ha ki jingjot , ki long mynta ki jaka shong briew bad ki jaka ba la ker kynroh .
translation.en: And they shall say , This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden  ; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are become fenced , and are inhabited .
He was a burning and a shining light : and ye were willing for a season to rejoice in his light .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la long kum ka sharak , kaba meh bad kaba tyngshaiñ , bad phi la mon shipor ban lehkmen ha ka jingshai jong u .

translation.en: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home .
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la leit phai sha ïing .
Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uta uba ieit u don ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me hath everlasting life .
Behold , we go up to Jerusalem  ; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes , and they shall condemn him to death ,
translation.kha: Shahshkor ,  u la ong ïa ki ,  ngi ïaleit kiew sha Jerusalem , ha kaba yn aiti ïa U Khun U Briew ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum .
Saw ngut ki rangbah kiba pang pynkhynñiuh ki don shabar ki khylliap jong ka Samaria , bad ki ïa-ong para ma ki , Balei ngin shu ap hangne haduh ba ngin da ïap ?
translation.en: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate : and they said one to another , Why sit we here until we die ?
And Saul said , Hear now , thou son of Ahitub . And he answered , Here I am , my lord .
translation.kha: U Saul u ong ha u Ahimelekh ,  Shahshkor , Ahimelekh !   Nga hangne , ko kynrad ,  u jubab .
Hynrei ïa ki khun shynrang jngai u Moses , u briew jong U Blei , la kynthah lang hapdeng ki Lebi . )
translation.en: Now concerning Moses the man of God , his sons were named of the tribe of Levi .

translation.kha: Ki saw thylli ki miej ha ka kamra ba la pynïasoh ba la pynkhreh ban ai kum ki jingkñia batylli , ki la long da u maw ba shu phiah . Ki jrong sanphew sentimitar bad ha ki khlieh jong ki ka long hynñiewphew san sentimitar Sidon . Ïa ki tiar baroh ba pynbam ban pynïap ïa ki mrad ïa-ban kñia la bsuh halor kine ki mian .
translation.en: And the four tables were of hewn stone for the burnt offering , of a cubit and an half long , and a cubit and an half broad , and one cubit high : whereupon also they laid the instruments wherewith they slew the burnt offering and the sacrifice .
And Pilate asked him , Art thou the King of the Jews ? And he answering said unto him ,  Thou sayest it .
translation.kha: U Pilat u la kylli jingkylli ïa u ,  Me long u syiem jong ki Jiw ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kumba me ong hi .

translation.en: For that which I do I allow not : for what I would , that do I not ; but what I hate , that do I .
translation.kha: Ngam shemphang kaei kaba nga leh ; namar ngam leh ïa kaei kaba nga kwah ban leh , hynrei pynban nga leh ïa kaei kaba nga isih .

translation.en: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah , who was sixteen years old , and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Judah baroh ki jied ïa u Ussaïah , u khun jong u Amasaïah , uba dang khathynriew snem ka rta , ban long syiem ha ka jaka u kpa jong u .
Ka la long thik kumta . Haba u Gideon u la khie dang step phrangsngi ha ka step kob bud , u la khem ïa u shñiuh nongaplangbrot bad u la khyrwait ïa ka peit na u ban pyndeng ïa ka pliang da ka um .
translation.en: And it was so : for he rose up early on the morrow , and thrust the fleece together , and wringed the dew out of the fleece , a bowl full of water .

Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor , and their hosts with them , about fifteen thousand men , all that were left of all the hosts of the children of the east : for there fell an hundred and twenty thousand men that drew sword .
translation.kha: U Sebah bad u Salmunna ki don ha Karkor lem bad ka kynhun shipai jong ki . Na ka kynhun shipai baroh jong ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap , tang kumba khatsan hajar ngut ki dang sah ; shi lakh arphew hajar ngut ki shipai ki la shah pynïap .

translation.en: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste , and the high places shall be desolate  ; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate , and your idols may be broken and cease , and your images may be cut down , and your works may be abolished .
translation.kha: Ïa baroh ki nongbah ka Israel yn pynjot noh , kumta ba ïa ki duwan jong ki bad ki bleithaw jong ki yn pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai , ïa ki duwan jingiwbih jong ki yn pynpra lyngkhot lyngkhai , bad ïa ki jingtei jong ki baroh yn sa pynjot noh .
Naba u jop ïa ki mawbah . U la phah thiah ïa ki kaei ha madiah bad pynïap ar ngut na man ki lai lwet . Kumta ki Moab ki kylla longsem noh ki raïot jong u , bad ki sleit khajna sha u .
translation.en: And he smote Moab , and measured them with a line , casting them down to the ground  ; even with two lines measured he to put to death , and with one full line to keep alive . And so the Moabites became David s servants , and brought gifts .

translation.kha: U Asa u duwai ha U Trai U Blei jong u , A Trai , me lah ban ïarap ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba tlot da kaba suiñ kum kaba khlaiñ . Ïarap ïa ngi mandriek , Ko Troas U Blei jong ngi , Namarba ba me shylliah ha me , bad ha ka kyrteng jong me ngi la mian ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa Kanah ka kynhun shipai kaba bun . A Trai , me long U Blei jong ngi ; ym don u ban kyrmen ban jop ïa me .
translation.en: And Asa cried unto the  Lord  his God , and said ,  Lord  , it is nothing with thee to help , whether with many , or with them that have no power : help us , O  Lord  our God  ; for we rest on thee , and in thy name we go against this multitude . O  Lord  , thou art our God  ; let not man prevail against thee .

translation.kha: U phah ïa u phria kum u mawria ; ym dat uba lah ban shah ïa ka jingkhriat ba u phah !
translation.en: He casteth forth his ice like morsels : who can stand before his cold ?

translation.kha: Baroh kaba U kba jong nga u don ka long ka jong nga ; na kata ka daw nga la ïa-ong ba U Mynsiem un shim ïa kaei kaba nga ai ha u bad ïaheh ïa ka ha phi .
translation.en: All things that the Father hath are mine : therefore said I , that he shall take of mine , and shall shew it unto you .

translation.kha: Ha Kawei ka sneng , U Adonijah u ai ka jingkñia da ki langbrot , ki masi dab , bad ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid ha u Mawsiang Bseiñ , hajan ka umpohliew Eglon . U la khot sngewbha ïa kiwei pat ki khun shynrang lad U Shim Dabid bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem kiba dei na Joïada ban wan sha kane ka jingkhiah ai jingkynjah ,
translation.en: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth , which is by En–rogel , and called all his brethren the king s sons , and all the men of Judah the king s servants :

translation.kha: Ki la pait dien na nga ; bad wat la nga la ïai shuki ïa ki , kim shahshkor bad ïoh jinghikai .
translation.en: And they have turned unto me the back , and not the face : though I taught them , rising up early and teaching them , yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction .

translation.en: A sword is upon the liars  ; and they shall dote : a sword is upon her mighty men  ; and they shall be dismayed .
