translation.en: As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace , so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof  ; and ye shall know that I the  Lord  have poured out my fury upon you .

translation.kha: U buh ka por ban ieid bad ka por ban isih , ka por ïa ka thma malu ka por ïa ka jingsuk .
translation.en: A time to love , and a time to hate  ; a time of war , and a time of peace .

translation.kha: Kiei leit sad da pynthikna bha sa shisien pat ; ïaw biang biang ha-ei u ni , bad uei umbiah la ioh ïa u Haneng . Nga tip ba u hir umbah sianti beh .
translation.en: Go , I pray you , prepare yet , and know and see his place where his haunt is , and who hath seen him there : for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ïing ha khmat jong ki , bad u ong , Ko ki para ri jong nga , to shahshkor ïa nga . Nga la kwah ban tei ka ïingshong neh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ka jingïuhkjat jong U Trai U Blei jong ngi . Nga la pynkhih ba tei ïa ka Templ ban ai burom ïa u ,
translation.en: Then David the king stood up upon his feet , and said , Hear me , my brethren , and my people : As for me , I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and for the footstool of our God , and had made ready for the building :
Again Esther spake unto Hatach , and gave him commandment unto Mordecai  ;
translation.kha: bad ka Esther ka ai ïa kane ka khubor ban leit rah pat sha u Mordekai :

translation.en: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet , and besought him , saying , Have patience with me , and I will pay thee all .
translation.kha: U para shakri jong u , u la dem khrup bad u la kyrpad ïa u , ‘ to ïaishah bad nga , bad ngan siew pat ïa phi !’

translation.en: Son of man , set thy face toward Jerusalem , and drop thy word toward the holy places , and prophesy against the land of Israel ,
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  kyntait ïa ka Jerusalem . Kyntait ïa ki jaka ha kiba ki briew ki mane . Maham ïa ka ri Israel .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Jesus had finished these sayings , he departed from Galilee , and came into the coasts of Judaea beyond Jordan  ;
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep kren ïa kine kiei kiei , u la mihnoh na Galilaïa bad u la leit sha ka thain Judia sha shiliang jong ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: With a strong hand , and with a stretched out arm : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: da ka kti bakhlaiñ jong u , ka ksang ti badonbor jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
ki la ïohi ïa u , Hynrei kumno re kumno kim shym thah ïa u .
translation.en: But their eyes were holden that they should not know him .

translation.kha: Uta wahbah thap ïa kata ka masi ruh u dei pun sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad theh um ïa lade , hynñiew u ruh u ïailong u bymkhuid ïaheh janmiet .
translation.en: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water , and bathe his flesh in water , and shall be unclean until the even .

translation.kha: Baroh na ki , ki shaniah ha me ban ai ïa ki ka jingbam haba ki donkam ïa ka .
translation.en: These wait all upon thee  ; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season .
And his fellow answered and said , This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash , a man of Israel : for into his hand hath God delivered Midian , and all the host .
translation.kha: U paralok jong u , u phai ktien ,  Ka dei ka waitlam jong u nong Israel , u Gideon u khun jong u Joash ! Kam mut da kumwei pat ! U Blei u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor ki Midian bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ngi baroh .

translation.en: And she dwelt under the palm tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth–el in mount Ephraim : and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment .
translation.kha: Ka ju shong hapoh uwei u Dieng Tlai hapdeng ka Ramah bad ka Bethel ha ka ri lum Ephraim , bad ki paid Israel ki ju leit hangta na ka bynta ki jingbishar jong ka .
Kumta u nongïathuhlypa ibha na Judah u leit sha ka ïing jong u nongïathuhlypa tymmen bad u ba-ima u dih bad u .
translation.en: So he went back with him , and did eat bread in his house , and drank water .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ka la pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u , ka rupa ïalam ïa u sha Shiloh ryngkat malu uwei u masi wahbah dang lai snem , shiphew kilo u purew , nabar shi blang snier ka aiñ . Ka ïalam ïa u Samuel , dak la u dang khynnah eh , sha ka ïing U Trai ha Shiloh .
translation.en: And when she had weaned him , she took him up with her , with three bullocks , and one ephah of flour , and a bottle of wine , and brought him unto the house of the  Lord  in Shiloh : and the child was young .

And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits , and the breadth one cubit  ; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits , and the breadth one cubit .
translation.kha: Ka bynta kaba sha trai eh jong ka duwan , na ka bynta ba-halor jong ka trai , ka long shi mitar ka jingjrong . Ka bynta kaba bud na ka tduh ka long sanphew sentimitar baroh sawdong , bad ka long ar mitar ka jingjrong . Ka bynta hadien kata na ka tduh ruh ka long sanphew sentimitar baroh sawdong .
Naba haba kiba la ïap kin mihpat , kin long kum ki angel ha bneng ba kin ym shongsuk shuh .
translation.en: For when they shall rise from the dead , they neither marry , nor are given in marriage  ; but are as the angels which are in heaven .

translation.kha: Na u Petros , u Apostol U Jisu Khrist — Sha ki bariew ba la jia jong U Blei kiba im kum ki nongphetwir Kiba la pynsakma kylleng ki probins jong ka Pontos , ka Galatia , ka khawpud , ka Asia bad ka Beria .
translation.en: Peter , an apostle of Jesus Christ , to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus , Galatia , Cappadocia , Asia , and Bithynia ,

translation.kha: Khie joit lashai mynstep ha ka por ba mih ka sngi bad pynlong ka jingtur ïateh kaba kynsan phalor ka nongbah . Nangta haba u Gaal bad la ki rangbah ki mih shabar pyrshah ïa phi , Tied tyndong ïa ki kat kaba phi Lah !
translation.en: And it shall be , that in the morning , as soon as the sun is up , thou shalt rise early , and set upon the city : and , behold , when he and the people that is with him come out against thee , then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion .
Now therefore let me alone , that my wrath may wax hot against them , and that I may consume them : and I will make of thee a great nation .
translation.kha: Mynta , wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa nga . Nga bitar ïa ki , bad ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki . Nangta ngan pynlong ïa me bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw .

translation.en: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people , that thou mayest know and try their way .
translation.kha: Ko Jeremaïah , tynjuh ïa ki briew jong nga , kumba men tynjuh ïa ka nar , bad to ïit ki long kiba kumno .
“mon ka mut u nongshun ne u nongïaleh pyrshah .
translation.en: “Satan” means an enemy or an opposer .
O send out thy light and thy truth : let them lead me  ; let them bring me unto thy holy hill , and to thy tabernacles .
translation.kha: Phah ïa ka jingshai jong me bad ka jingshisha jong me ; to ai ba kin ïalam ïa nga bad wallam pat ïa nga sha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong me , bad sha ka Templ jong me , ha kaba me shong .
Nangta U Trai u la phah da ki bnai ba-dap da ka bih hapdeng kita ki briew , sad bun ki Israel ki la shah puh badno ïapom .
translation.en: And the  Lord  sent fiery serpents among the people , and they bit the people  ; and much people of Israel died .
But if thine eye be evil , thy whole body shall be full of darkness . If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness , how great is that darkness !
translation.kha: hynrei lada ki khmat jong phi kim long kiba bha , ka met jong phi kan don ha ka jingdum . Kumta lada ka jingshai hapoh jong phi ka long ka jingdum , katno kan long ka jingdum kaba shyrkhei eh !

translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that entereth into the service , for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation :
translation.kha: Kin kitkhlieh ruh ïa ki rijied , ïa ki thliew tnaw , ïa ki snar , bad ïa ki tyllai jong ka phyllaw .
Uwei pa uwei u la bam bad u la kdang . Nahath ki synran ki la lbong khat-ar tukri pura jong kaei kaba la sai tam .
translation.en: And they did all eat , and were filled : and they took up of the fragments that remained twelve baskets full .

translation.kha: Hynrei phi , ko paralok jong nga , phi sukher ïa nga kumne ki shawkad kba ju rngad noh ha bym don slap .
translation.en: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook , and as the stream of brooks they pass away  ;

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sah hangta kin rhah ïaroh ; ken pyrta jam da ka jingkmen . Da ka jingkyrkhu Jong nga kin king ha ka jingbun paid ; ka jingkyrhuh jong nga kan wallam ha ki ka baburom .
translation.en: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry : and I will multiply them , and they shall not be few  ; I will also glorify them , and they shall not be small .

translation.kha: U Moses u kohnguh bad u pahuh jingthoh ïa ki khun shynrang baroh kiba la kha nyngkong ha Israel kumba U Trai u la hukum ,
translation.en: Even those that were numbered of them , throughout their families , by the house of their fathers , were two thousand and six hundred and thirty .

translation.kha: Suk kito kiba dud ïa ki lei jong u , kiba kohnguh ïa u da la ka dohnud Baroh .
translation.en: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies , and that seek him with the whole heart .

translation.kha: Ïa kane U Tharai u la jubab , Lada me wang phan , ngan shim pat ïa me , bad man long biang u shakri jongngi nga . Lada ha ka jaka ba-bang kren khlaw jingmut me pynbna ïa ka khubor ba don jingmut , men long biang u nongïathuhlypa jong nga . Ki brup kin wan phai pait sha me , bad mem jingdonkam ïa-ban leit sha ki .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  , If thou return , then will I bring thee again , and thou shalt stand before me : and if thou take forth the precious from the vile , thou shalt be as my mouth : let them return unto thee  ; but return not thou unto them .

translation.kha: U thri u ino , Ha khmih haduh Katno ki kynthei ka Jerusalem ki un-long kiba stong ! Ki ïasaid da kabu pynhieng ïa la ki khmut . Ki ju long borabor kiba kynshleiñ . Ki shim ki mata jam Ibbah rit itynnat bad ki jingdeng ha ki matsohlah ki sawa .
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  saith , Because the daughters of Zion are haughty , and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes , walking and mincing as they go , and making a tinkling with their feet :

translation.kha: Um krensih ha ki khulom pynbam da ki pharshi , hyndai haba u don tang badno ki synran , u batai ïa kiei ki baroh ha ki .
translation.en: But without a parable spake he not unto them : and when they were alone , he expounded all things to his disciples .
And some of the Pharisees which were with him heard these words , and said unto him , Are we blind also ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki Pharisi kiba ïadon hangta lem bad u ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ïa kane bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Da shisha mem mut ba ngi ruh ngi matlah ?
Ha ka sngi kob nyngkong jyllang ka Jingkhawai Niam , Phin dei banbeiñ ïalumlang ban maïan Blei , bad phim dei ba-bang tyngam ei ei ha dat ka sngi .
translation.en: In the first day shall be an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein :

translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba nga la ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong u Akhish u khun jongngi u Shaphan , ym shym la aiti ïa nga ha ki briew sad shuh pynïap .
translation.en: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah , that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death .
And the field , and the cave that is therein , were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth .
translation.kha: Kumta kata ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong ki Hit , ryngkat bad ka krem kaba don hangta , ka la kylla long ka jingïohkynti jong u Abraham kum ka jaka tep briew .
Bad nga da kyrpad jreiñ ïa phi ban ïaboi ba U Bela un phah pat ïa nga shaw phi kham kloi .
translation.en: But I beseech you the rather to do this , that I may be restored to you the sooner .

translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ïa-ong ba U Messaïah un long uba jingkahtngen na u Syiem Dabid bad yn kha ïa u ha Bethlehem , ka shang ha kaba u ïabuaid u la im .
translation.en: Hath not the scripture said , That Christ cometh of the seed of David , and out of the town of Bethlehem , where David was ?

He hath bent his bow like an enemy : he stood with his right hand as an adversary , and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion : he poured out his fury like fire .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba wan sha ka Templ mynta ban mane ha ki sngi bakhuid . Ki kynthei samla kiba rwai hangta ki shahshitom , bad ki lyngdoh ki lah tang ban shu ud . Ki khyrdop ka nongbah ki ïeng thylli , bad ka Seïon ka don ha ka jingkordit .

translation.en: The lion s whelps have not trodden it , nor the fierce lion passed by it .
translation.kha: Ym don sing lane uno uno u mrad bashyrkhei uba ïaid ïa kita ki lynti bakynjah .
U Moses u ainong ha U Trai , Ki brup kim lah ban wan kiew jingkhroh , naba me la hukum ïa ngi ban kheiñ kyntang ïa u lym malu ban buh dak sawdong jrong u .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , The people cannot come up to mount Sinai : for thou chargedst us , saying , Set bounds about the mount , and sanctify it .

translation.kha: bad kumta u jong ha u , Namar ba me la mat ïa ka jingstad ban synshar khor , ha ka jaka ka jingim bajlan na ka bynta ïa lade rue ka sawspah lane ka jingïap ki nongshun jong me , ngan leh ïa Kaba me la pait .
translation.en: And God said unto him , Because thou hast asked this thing , and hast not asked for thyself long life  ; neither hast asked riches for thyself , nor hast asked the life of thine enemies  ; but hast asked for thyself understanding to discern judgment  ;

translation.kha: Hato kitab thop ba ngin sa bishar ïa ki duh ? Katno tam , te , ïa kiei keiñ ki jong kane ka jingim !
translation.en: Know ye not that we shall judge angels ? how much more things that pertain to this life ?

translation.kha: Ngam pynsngewrem ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki diengsoh Dumbur jong ka , ibha ka ju ong ba babha ieit jong ka ki ai ïa ka namar ba ka la shakri ïa ki . Ngi pynkylla ri khlieh ïa ki bri shaiñ bad ki basboh jong ka ; ki mradkhlaw kin pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees , whereof she hath said , These are my rewards that my lovers have given me : and I will make them a forest , and the beasts of the field shall eat them .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei katei kaba U Trai u ong shang ka Ammon : Shano ki rangbah ka Jerusalem ? Hato ym don mano mano ban ïadei ïa la ka ri ? Balei ba ki shah ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u Molekh kin shngiam ïa ki jaka jong ka jait Gad pynlang shongduh klang ?
translation.en: Concerning the Ammonites , thus saith the  Lord   ; Hath Israel no sons ? hath he no heir ? why then doth their king inherit Gad , and his people dwell in his cities ?

translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la ai ha u Abraham ïa ka jingkhyllem ka jingotsher kum ka dak jyllang ka jutang . Kumta u Abraham u la otsher ïa u Isaak hadien shi thiat naduh ba la kha ïa u ; u Isaak u la otsher ïa u .—Jakob u khun jong u bad u Jakob u la otsher ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u , ki kpa tymmen kiba pawnam jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi .
translation.en: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision : and so Abraham begat Isaac , and circumcised him the eighth day  ; and Isaac begat Jacob  ; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs .

translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ïa u Gad , Nga dat ha ka khim khait ! Hynrei ngam kwah ba yn pynshitom ïa la da ki briew . Ai ba U Trai da lade hi un long uta u ban pynshitom ïa nga , namar u un-long uba dap da ka jingtei .
translation.en: And David said unto Gad , I am in a great strait : let me fall now into the hand of the  Lord   ; for very great are his mercies : but let me not fall into the hand of man .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la sahnarphna ruh ïa ki ar ngut ki nonglute lem bad U Jisu , uwei sha ka liang kamon jong u bad uwei pat sha ka liang kadiang jong u .
translation.en: Then were there two thieves crucified with him , one on the right hand , and another on the left .

translation.kha: U sngewtynnat ha ka kynhun paralok bad ki briew uba bymman malu u ïaid sawdong bad ki nongpop .
translation.en: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity , and walketh with wicked men .
And Benjamin went forth against them out of Gibeah the second day , and destroyed down to the ground of the children of Israel again eighteen thousand men  ; all these drew the sword .
translation.kha: Bad ha ka sien kaba ar ki Benjamin ki wan mih na Gibeah , bad ha kane ka sien ki pynïap khatphra hajar ngut ki shipai batbit ka Israel .

translation.en: Now concerning his sons , and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him , and the repairing of the house of God , behold , they are written in the story of the book of the kings . And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Ka Komentari halor ka Kitab ki Syiem  ka don ki jingïathuhkhana shaphang ki khun shynrang jong u Joash , ki jingïathuhlypa kiba la kren pyrshah ïa u , bad ka jingbuh jingthoh kumno ba u la tei pat ïa ka Templ . U Amasaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
Hato kam pat biang tyngka ba phi la ïalap noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt kaba seisoh ban pynïap ïa ngi hangne ha ri khlaw ? Phi kwah sa ban da long kynrad halor jong ngi ?
translation.en: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey , to kill us in the wilderness , except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us ?
And I will give them one heart , and I will put a new spirit within you  ; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh , and will give them an heart of flesh :
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ka dohnud bathymmai bad ka jingmut bathymmai . Ngan shim noh ïa ka dohnud maw ba-mutlop bad ngan ai ha ki ka dohnud bakohnguh .
Kan khah sahkut pynban , lada ka shong marwei . Kata ka long ka jingai jingmut jong de bad por pyrkhat ba ïa nga hajuh la ïalam da U Minnith U blei .
translation.en: But she is happier if she so abide , after my judgment : and I think also that I have the Spirit of God .
The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity , nor speak lies  ; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth : for they shall feed and lie down , and none shall make them afraid .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel kiba lait im kin ym leh kano kano ka bym dei ïano ïano , kin ym ïathuh lamler , lymne pyrshang ban shukor . Kin manbha bad shongshngain , kin ym sheptieng ïano ïano .
Kine ki long ki aiñ baroh ïa kiba U Trai U Bela jong phi u la hukum ïa nga ban sakhi ïa phi . Sumar bad leh ïa ki ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit bad ïohkynti .
translation.en: Now these are the commandments , the statutes , and the judgments , which the  Lord  your God commanded to teach you , that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it :
For if a man find his enemy , will he let him go well away ? wherefore the  Lord  reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day .
translation.kha: Haduh katno sien ba u briew un kem ïa u nongshun jong u bad nangta un pyllait ïa u ban leit noh khlem mynsaw ? U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi ïa kaei kaba phi la leh ïa nga ha kane ka sngi !

translation.en: But other of the apostles saw I none , save James the Lord s brother .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la ïakynduh ïa kiwei pat ki Apostol lait noh tang ïa u Jakob , u para jong U Trai .

translation.en: That they sent and called him . And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came , and spake unto Rehoboam , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki paidbah na ki jait ba na shatei ki phah khot ïa u , bad nangta ma ki baroh ki ïaleit lang sha u Rehoboam bad ki ong ha u ,

translation.en: They were as fed horses in the morning : every one neighed after his neighbour s wife .
translation.kha: Ki la long kum ki kulai ba la bsa bha , ki bym lah synshar ha ki jingkwah , uwei pa uwei u da kwah brai ïa ka tnga jong u paramarjan jong u .
U buh ïa baroh ki rangbah ha ka nongbah hapoh ka jingai hukum ki rangbah shipai bad u Hukum ïa ki ban ïalumlang ha ka tare kaba kylluid ha ka khyrdong ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he set captains of war over the people , and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city , and spake comfortably to them , saying ,

translation.kha: Hato me tip ïa ki aiñ kiba syiar ïa ki suiñbneng , bad hato me lah ban pyndei ïa ki ha ka pyrthei ?
translation.en: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven ? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth ?
And Micaiah said , If thou return at all in peace , the  Lord  hath not spoken by me . And he said , Hearken , O people , every one of you .
translation.kha: Lada me wan phai da kaba suk ,  u Mikaïah u pyrta ,  te U  Trai  um shym la kren keiñ da nga !  bad u la bynrap ,  Shahshkor , uwei pa uwei ïa kaei kaba nga la kren !
Ym don uba shah hikai uba kham khraw ban ïa u nongkhaïi jong u ; ym don u saraw wahbah kham khraw ban ïa u kynhied jong u .
translation.en: The disciple is not above his master , nor the servant above his lord .

translation.kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Phestos , Ngam kwah baneh ïohsngew ïa une u briew da lade hi . Phin ïohsngew ïa u lashai ka sngi , u Blastos u la jubab .
translation.en: Then Agrippa said unto Festus , I would also hear the man myself . To morrow , said he , thou shalt hear him .
And Jotham ran away , and fled , and went to Beer , and dwelt there , for fear of Abimelech his brother .
translation.kha: Te namar ba u sheptieng ïa u Abimelekh , u hynmen jong u , u Jotham u la phet ïap bad u leit shong ha Beer .
Wat sheng shuki pyrshah ïano ïano khlaw ka daw kaba dei , ne wat ong ïa kaei kaei ka ban ïalaw bakla shaphang jongki u .
translation.en: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause  ; and deceive not with thy lips .

translation.kha: U synshar halor ka duriaw , kaba u la thaw ; ka khynñiat shwa , kaba u hi u la pynlong .
translation.en: The sea is his , and he made it : and his hands formed the dry land .

translation.kha: U Trai un pyllait im ïa la ki bhabriew long u ïohi ba kim donhok Shu . Un iwei ïa kito kiba shakri ïa u hato u ïohi ba kim lah leh ei ei shuh .
translation.en: For the  Lord  shall judge his people , and repent himself for his servants , when he seeth that their power is gone , and there is none shut up , or left .

translation.kha: Namarba u Abiathar u khun jong u Ahimelekh u la lait phet bad leit ïashong bad u Dabid ha Keilah , u la rah ïa ka ephod lem bad u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah , that he came down with an ephod in his hand .

translation.kha: Namar kñia , uwei pa aiwai ha ka pyrthei un Tip hajuh katno ka bor jong U Trai ka long kabu khraw , bad ba phin Burom ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi jongno .
translation.en: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the  Lord  , that it is mighty : that ye might fear the  Lord  your God for ever .

For the children of Joseph were two tribes , Manasseh and Ephraim : therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land , save cities to dwell in , with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance .
translation.kha: U Moses u la dep ai ïa ka ri ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan ha kiwei pat ki ar jait bad shiteng jong kawei jait . translation.en: And he took up his parable , and said , Alas , who shall live when God doeth this !

translation.kha: Nga ai ha me , ha ki khun shajrong bad kynthei jong me , ha ki por ki ban wan baroh ïa ki jingai pynrangbah barieh ba ki Israel ki ai ha nga . Keiñ ka long ka ïong bym lah pynkheiñ kaba nga la pynlong nabar me lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me .
translation.en: All the heave offerings of the holy things , which the children of Israel offer unto the  Lord  , have I given thee , and thy sons and thy daughters with thee , by a statute for ever : it is a covenant of salt for ever before the  Lord  unto thee and to thy seed with thee .
Son of man , What is the vine tree more than any tree , or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest ?
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  kumno yn nujor ïa u dieng sohwaiñ bad u dieng ? Ka bha aïu ka tnat u dieng sohwaiñ haba nujor bad ki dieng ha khlaw ?

translation.en: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them , and came unto Iconium .
translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong ki ha ka jingpyrshah ïa ki bad ki la leit noh sha Ikoniom .

translation.en: Oh that one would hear me ! behold , my desire is , that the Almighty would answer me , and that mine adversary had written a book .
translation.kha: Hato ym don ba shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ? Nga smai ba kawei pa kawei ka ktien ka long kaba shisha . To ai ba U Blei Badonbor Baroh un jubab ïa nga . Lada kiba pyrshah ïa nga ki wanrah ïa ki jingmudui da kaba thoh ïa ki ngan lah ban ïohi ,
U ai ha nga ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga , U pyndem ïa ki jaitbynriew hapoh jong nga ,
translation.en: It is God that avengeth me , and that bringeth down the people under me ,
And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the streets thereof .
translation.kha: Bad ki lynti bah kin dap pat da ki khynnah shynrang bad kynthei kiba ïalehkai .

translation.en: And I brought them into the house of the  Lord  , into the chamber of the sons of Hanan , the son of Igdaliah , a man of God , which was by the chamber of the princes , which was above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum , the keeper of the door :
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka kamra jong ki synran jong u Hanan u nongïathuhlypa u khun jong u Igdalaïah . Kane ka kamra ka long halor ka kamra u Maaseïah u khun jong u Shallum , u rangbah synshar bapawkhmat jong ka Templ , bad hajan ki kamra jong kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar .

translation.en: Then Joseph said unto the people , Behold , I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh : lo , here is seed for you , and ye shall sow the land .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ha kita ki briew ,  Phi ïohi mynta ba nga la thied ïa phi bad ïa ki khyndew jong phi na ka bynta u syiem . Shim une u symbai ba phin ïabet ha ka khyndew .

Namar ba ki leh ïa kane , U Blei’ u la ai noh ïa ki shat ki jingkwah bret bakmen . Wat ki kynthei ki la pynbakla noh ïa ka jingpyndonkam kaba dei kat kum ka rukom ha ka jingshongkurim da ki jingleh ki bym dei kat kum ka rukom .
translation.en: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections : for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature :

Thy crowned are as the locusts , and thy captains as the great grasshoppers , which camp in the hedges in the cold day , but when the sun ariseth they flee away , and their place is not known where they are .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong pha ki long kum ka kynhun ki puit kiba dem ha ka kynroh ha ka sngi kaba khriat . Hynrei haba ka sngi ka mih , ki her noh , bad ym don mano mano batip shano ki la jah noh !
Ha kawei na ki jinglalot thombor marpyrshah ïa ki Israel , ki Assyria ki la ringmraw ïa kawei ka khynnah rit Israel , kaba la Long ka shakri jong ka tnga jong u Naaman .
translation.en: And the Syrians had gone out by companies , and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid  ; and she waited on Naaman s wife .
And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph , saying , Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee :
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u Joseph ,  I pa jong phi bad ki hynmen ki para jong phi ki la wan sha phi , ka ri Ijipt ka long ka jong ki .
Ha ka aïom pakor nga la phohsniew , dara nga la ïohi ba ki nongshong kiba ïa-peit ki longïing kiba tipthuh , kiba thohbria bad kaba thohbroin .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived , that I lifted up mine eyes , and saw in a dream , and , behold , the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked , speckled , and grisled .
And when he was come near unto her , the woman said , Art thou Joab ? And he answered , I am he . Then she said unto him , Hear the words of thine handmaid . And he answered , I do hear .
translation.kha: U Joab u la leit , bad ka kylli ,  Phi dei u Joab ?   Ho-oid , nga dei ,  u jubab .  Kynrad , sngap ïa nga ,  ka ong .  Nga sngap keiñ ,  u jubab .

translation.en: And their possessions and habitations were , Beth–el and the towns thereof , and eastward Naaran , and westward Gezer , with the towns thereof  ; Shechem also and the towns thereof , unto Gaza and the towns thereof :
translation.kha: Ka ri ha kaba ki shim bad shongduh ka kynthup ïa ka Bethel bad ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ka naduh shaphang mihngi ka Naaran bad haduh shaphang sepngi ka Geser bad ki shnong sawdong jong ka . Ka kynthup ruh ïa ki nongbah ka Shekhem bad ka Ayyah bad ki shnong sawdong jong ka .

translation.en: And he charged him to tell no man :  but go , and shew thyself to the priest , and offer for thy cleansing , according as Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano , hynrei khie leit beit sha u lyngdoh bad ai un peit bniah ïa me ; nangta un pynshisha ha uwei uwei baroh ba me la koit . To ai ïa ka jingkñia kumba U Moses u la hukum .

translation.en: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler , and shall come forth and fight with him , even with the king of the north : and he shall set forth a great multitude  ; but the multitude shall be given into his hand .
translation.kha: U syiem Ijipt ha la ka jingbitar un leit sha ka thma pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Syria bad kem ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhraw jong u .
Ha kata ka por U Trai un pynlong ïa ki ba kin shaïong jingmad bad sheptieng haduh main ba ti uwei baroh un kem ïa u briew hajan jong u malu tur ïalap ïa u .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that a great tumult from the  Lord  shall be among them  ; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour , and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour .

translation.kha: Phi tip thoin kumno ba ïabeh nadien ki nongïatrei . Wat ki kynthei kiba sniew eh ki lah ban ïoh jinghikai na phi .
translation.en: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love ? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways .

translation.kha: Mynta hangne u don u syiem babha phi la jied ; Phin la panpoh ïa u , bad mynta U Trai u la ai ïa u ha phi .
translation.en: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen , and whom ye have desired ! and , behold , the  Lord  hath set a king over you .

translation.kha: Nangta ngan bat ïa ka kular kaba por la pynbang ha ki kpa thymmai jong ki ba ngan ai ha ki ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ïap kaba ki ne mynta . Nga la ong , Ho-oid , ko Trai .
translation.en: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers , to give them a land flowing with milk and honey , as it is this day . Then answered I , and said , So be it , O  Lord .

translation.kha: nangta khatsaw sner nga la rupa patan sha Jerusalem jingkad bad u Barnabas , nga da ïalumlang nur ruh ïa u Titos .
translation.en: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas , and took Titus with me also .
The floods have lifted up , O  Lord  , the floods have lifted up their voice  ; the floods lift up their waves .
translation.kha: Ki jingjylliew ka duriaw ki sawa jam , A  Trai  ; ki sawa jam bad ki kyrhuh .

translation.en: And he took the fat , and the rump , and all the fat that was upon the inwards , and the caul above the liver , and the two kidneys , and their fat , and the right shoulder :
translation.kha: U shim ïa ka khleiñ , ïa ka dongnai , ïa ka khleiñ baroh kaba sop ïa ki doh jem , ïa ka bynta kaba kynsai tam jong u dohnud , ïa ki khyllai ba sop khleiñ , bad ïa ka kjat-dien kamon .
Me ma ïa U Blei , badno ka jingrem jong me ka long ka bymïap shah kynnoh pop ; bad kumta me daym ba ne ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingkyrmen .
translation.en: Is not this thy fear , thy confidence , thy hope , and the uprightness of thy ways ?

translation.kha: Nga pynbaptis ïa Phi da ka um ban pyn-i ba phi la kylla-kaba-mut , hynriew uta uba wan hadien jong nga un pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid malade da ka ryndang . U long uba kham khraw ban ïa nga ; Bad ngiam long uba bit kdew tang ban rah ïa ki nuti jong u .
translation.en: I indeed baptize you with water unto repentance : but he that cometh after me is mightier than I , whose shoes I am not worthy to bear : he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost , and with fire :

translation.kha: Ha ka baklang , U Blei u la buh ïa barhem ha la ka bynta : Ha ka bynta banyngkong u buh ïa ki Apostol , ha ka bynta kaba ar ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kaba lai ïa ki nonghikai ; nongbat ïa kito kiba leh ïa ki kabu , bud sa kito ha uba la ai ïa ka bor ban pynkhiah lane ban ïarep ïa Kawei lane ban pyn-i lym lane ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher .
translation.en: And God hath set some in the church , first apostles , secondarily prophets , thirdly teachers , after that miracles , then gifts of healings , helps , governments , diversities of tongues .

translation.kha: Kin wan bad ïai da ka jingkmen ha u lum Seïon bad kin kmen ha ki jingai Sngewbha jyllang por — ki jingai sngewbha da u kew sad ka waiñ bad ka jingbymman Olib , ki jngai sngewbit da ki langbrot bad ki masi . Kin long kum ka kper bad la ai um bha ; kin don baroh kat kaba ki donkam .
translation.en: Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion , and shall flow together to the goodness of the  Lord  , for wheat , and for wine , and for oil , and for the young of the flock and of the herd : and their soul shall be as a watered garden  ; and they shall not sorrow any more at all .

translation.kha: Phi lah ban jot noh da ka jingkren ki briew kiba khlam blei , hynrei ka jingstad jongngi kiba khah ka lah ban pyllait im ïa phi .
translation.en: An hypocrite with his mouth destroyeth his neighbour : but through knowledge shall the just be delivered .

And when money failed in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , all the Egyptians came unto Joseph , and said , Give us bread : for why should we die in thy presence ? for the money faileth .
translation.kha: Haba ym don pisa shuh ha Ijipt bad ha Kanaan , baroh ki nong Ijipt ki ïawan sha u Joseph , bad ki ong ,  Ai jingbam ba ngin bam ! Wat ai ba ngin shu ïapthngan ! Ngim don pisa shuh .
Wat sngewbiang ïa ki briew kiba kuna pop , ai ba ka jingñiewburom ïa U Tharai kan erlangthari ha khmied ka jingim jong phi .
translation.en: Let not thine heart envy sinners : but be thou in the fear of the  Lord  all the day long .

translation.kha: U Nongthaw u la ap khmih ïa ngi ; ngim lah wat ban ïaid ha ki lynti bah . Ki sngi jongu ngi ki la ktung ; kaba kut ka la wang .
translation.en: They hunt our steps , that we cannot go in our streets : our end is near , our days are fulfilled  ; for our end is come .
And when the men of that place had knowledge of him , they sent out into all that country round about , and brought unto him all that were diseased  ;
translation.kha: Kumta ki la phah khot ïa ki briew kiba pang ha baroh ki jaka sawdong jong ka ri bad ki la wallam ïa ki sha U Jisu .
Pynban , kumba ka long , ka dang ïaisah hi ka jingthiah ïa ki briew jrong U Blei kumba U balui u shongthait ha ka sngi kaba ingiew .
translation.en: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God .

translation.kha: U Shakri u la dem khrup ha ki khohsiew ha khmat u Syiem . ‘ To ïaishah mala nga ,’ u la kyrpad , ‘ bad sam siew ïa phi ïa kaei kaei baroh !’
translation.en: The servant therefore fell down , and worshipped him , saying , Lord , have patience with me , and I will pay thee all .
Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians , and how I bare you on eagles  wings , and brought you unto myself .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi aïu ma nga , U  Trai  nga la leh ïa ki nong Ijipt bad kumno ba nga la kit ïa phi kum ka pukni kaba kit ïa la ki khun ha ki thapniang jong ka , bad nga la wan ïalam ïa phi sha nga ha kane ka jaka .
Ngan pyn-i ha phi ïaduna ban bymsheptieng : To sheptieng ïa U Blei , uba , hadien ka jingpynïap , u don ka bor ban bret sha ka dujok . To ngeit ïa nga , u long ma u tur uba pa dei ban sheptieng !
translation.en: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear : Fear him , which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell  ; yea , I say unto you , Fear him .

translation.kha: ban pynbna ïa kane ka kyrhuh ha uwei pa uwei ha Jerusalem , Nga kynmaw kumno phi la long kiba ïaineh Mynba pa dang khynnah , kumno phira la ieit ïa nga mynnin ine dang shongkurim nyngkong ; phi la stem ïa nga lyngba ka ri shyiap , lyngba ka ri ka bym pat shym la thret jingthung .
translation.en: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; I remember thee , the kindness of thy youth , the love of thine espousals , when thou wentest after me in the wilderness , in a land that was not sown .
Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven , let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven : for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons ?
translation.kha: Phi dei ban peit bha ban pynbiang ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei jong ka Bneng u donkam na ka bynta ka Templ jong u , bad ban pynthikna un ym bitar ïa nga lane ïa kito ki ban synshar hadien jong nga .
Haba u syiem u khot ïa phi bad u kylli phi ïatrei ïaktah aïu ,
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when Pharaoh shall call you , and shall say , What is your occupation ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa ki bad u la Joab , Ki briew kiba kajuh kim donkam ïa u nongpynkhiah , hynrei tang kito kiba pang . Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki briew’ uba donburom , hynrei ïa kiba la shahshkor kyntait .
translation.en: When Jesus heard it , he saith unto them ,  They that are whole have no need of the physician , but they that are sick : I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
When they had heard these words , they marvelled , and left him , and went their way .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la lyngngoh ; bad ki la iehnoh ïa u bad ki la leit noh .
Ka jingbei ïa u Ruphos , ba u la jia ia U Trai , bad ïa ka kmie jong u , bad jinganna .
translation.en: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord , and his mother and mine .

translation.kha: Kito kiba la ringmraw ïa ngi ki ong ba ngin rwai ; ki ong ïa ngi ba ngin pynsngewbha ïa ki : To rwai ha ngi ïa ka jingrwai shaphang ka Seïon .
translation.en: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song  ; and they that wasted us required of us mirth , saying , Sing us one of the songs of Zion .

translation.kha: Kumta wat ngeit ïa ka khubor ba ki khun shngain jongki me baroh ki la ïap ; tong u Amnon uba la sha pynkup .
translation.en: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart , to think that all the king s sons are dead : for Amnon only is dead .

translation.kha: Hato ngan ym pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynda phim kiei kaei ? bad pynhiarkput ïa ka jaitbynriew kaba Kum kaei ?
translation.en: Shall I not visit for these things ? saith the  Lord  : and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this ?

translation.kha: Naba U briew u long u ba khwan myntoi , kiba lalot , kiba ai sawar , bad kiba kyr-eit ; kin krenbeiñ , kin ym kohnguh ïa la ki kamai ki kpa , ki bymsngewnguh , bad ki bymriewblei ;
translation.en: For men shall be lovers of their own selves , covetous , boasters , proud , blasphemers , disobedient to parents , unthankful , unholy ,

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki briew ka Amam ban sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong ki , kiba khah ban pynjop ïa ki . Ha ka jingat bakhraw jong nga ngan pynjot ïa ki briew ka Elam bad nur-um phah ki shipai pyrshah ïa ki haduh ba sam da pynduh koit ïa ki .
translation.en: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies , and before them that seek their life : and I will bring evil upon them , even my fierce anger , saith the  Lord   ; and I will send the sword after them , till I have consumed them :
And looking round about upon them all , he said unto the man ,  Stretch forth thy hand .  And he did so : and his hand was restored whole as the other .
translation.kha: U la khmih sawdong jong ki baroh ; nangta U la ong ha uta u briew ,  To kner ïa ka kti jong me .  U la leh kumta , bad ka kti jong u ka la bha pat .

translation.en: And all thy children shall be taught of the  Lord   ; and great shall be the peace of thy children .
translation.kha: Nga da lade ngan hikai ïa ki briew jong pha , bad ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingmanbha bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And when he came to him , behold , he stood by his burnt offering , and the princes of Moab with him . And Balak said unto him , What hath the  Lord  spoken ?
translation.kha: Kumta u la leit phai pat bad u la lap ïa u Balak ba u dang ïeng harud ka jingainguh thang jong u lem bad ki nongïalam ka Moab . U Balak u la kylli aïu U  Trai  u la ong ,
U la nguh ba kane kan dei ka kupar jongno pha . Kane ka dei kaei kaba u la kut jingmut ban bor ïa phah , namar pha la kheit ïa u bad pha la shaniah ha ki blei thala .
translation.en: This is thy lot , the portion of thy measures from me , saith the  Lord   ; because thou hast forgotten me , and trusted in falsehood .
And they spake against the God of Jerusalem , as against the gods of the people of the earth , which were the work of the hands of man .
translation.kha: Ki ïakren shaphang U Blei ka Jerusalem kumba ki ïakren shaphang ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew , ki bleithaw ba la shna da ki kti ki briew .

Te kumin , to ngin sangeh noh na kaba ïabishar wai ïa eiei pat . Hynrei phi dei ban kut jingot ban ym ai ïa kaei kiei lano lano hati ka ban pynlong ïa u bangeit jong phi! ban jynthut lane hap ha ka pop .
translation.en: Let us not therefore judge one another any more : but judge this rather , that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother s way .
Jesus saith unto him ,  Go thy way  ; thy son liveth .  And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him , and he went his way .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Khie leit , u khun jong me un im !  Uta u briew u la ngeit ïa ki ktien U Jisu bad u la leit noh .
Kohnguh ïa ki hukum babha nga ai ha phiah mynsiem ka sngi . Ngan beh noh ïa ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Peres , ki Hib , bad ki Jehu , katba phi dum tur shai khmat .
translation.en: Observe thou that which I command thee this day : behold , I drive out before thee the Amorite , and the Canaanite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , and the Hivite , and the Jebusite .

translation.kha: U sleit u la hap , ki wah ki la shlei , mala ka lyer ka la beh jur pyrshah ïa kata ka ïing . Jamynrei kam shym la khyllem , namar la tei ïa ka halor u mawsiang .
translation.en: And the rain descended , and the floods came , and the winds blew , and beat upon that house  ; and it fell not : for it was founded upon a rock .
These discovered her nakedness : they took her sons and her daughters , and slew her with the sword : and she became famous among women  ; for they had executed judgment upon her .
translation.kha: Ki law lyngkhuit ïa ka , ki kem ïa ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei jong ka , bad nangta ki pynïap ïa ka da ka waitlam . Ki kynthei kylleng ki ïathuh lorni shaphang ka kupar jong ka .

translation.en: Every beast , every creeping thing , and every fowl , and whatsoever creepeth upon the earth , after their kinds , went forth out of the ark .
translation.kha: Baroh ki mrad bad ki sim ki la ïamihnoh shabar na ka lieng ha la ka kynhun kynhun ka jait jong ki .

translation.en: Set ye up a standard in the land , blow the trumpet among the nations , prepare the nations against her , call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat , Minni , and Ashchenaz  ; appoint a captain against her  ; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers .
translation.kha: To ai ïa ka dak ban tur ïaleh ! Put ïa ka turoi khnang ba ki jaitbynriew kin ïohsngew ! Pynkhreh ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia ! Ong ïa ki hima Ararat , Minni , bad Ashkenas ban tur ïaleh . Thung ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam ban ïalam ïa ka jingtur ïaleh . Wallam ïa ki kulai kum ka kynhun ki puit .

A Trai U Blei , to pynspong ïa ka kular kaba me la ong ha u kper jong nga . Me la pyningkhong syiem ïa nga halor u phalang uba bun katta katta kat haduh ba ym lah ngab ñiew , kumta to ai ha nga ïa ka jingstad bad ka jingtip kaba at donkam ban synshar ïa ki .
translation.en: Now , O  Lord  God , let thy promise unto David my father be established : for thou hast made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude .

translation.kha: Uei u ïa-ban ym pynbun ïa me , u syiem jong ki jaitbynriew baroh ? Me den hok ban ïoh ka pyndonburom . Ym don mano mano uba kum ma me hapdeng ki riewstad baroh lad ki jaitbynriew lane nongpdiang uno uno u syiem jong ki .
translation.en: Who would not fear thee , O King of nations ? for to thee doth it appertain : forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations , and in all their kingdoms , there is none like unto thee .

translation.kha: U Dabid u kylli na U tharai , Ngan leit beh ne em ïa kine ki nonglute ? Ngan lap ne em ïa ki ? U jubab , Khim leit ba-eh ïa ki ; manna lap ïa ki , bad men pyllait ïa kiba la shah ringswai .
translation.en: And David enquired at the  Lord  , saying , Shall I pursue after this troop ? shall I overtake them ? And he answered him , Pursue : for thou shalt surely overtake them , and without fail recover all .

translation.kha: kine pat ju ïohsngew ïa ka Sur jong u lane phim pait ju ïohi ïa ka khmat jong u , bad phim ju sumar ïa ka shukor jong u ha ki dohnud jong pa , naba phim jingieit ha Utai ïa uba u la phan .
translation.en: And ye have not his word abiding in you : for whom he hath sent , him ye believe not .

translation.kha: Ki pynbah synshar jong u syiem Benhadad ki ong ha u , Ki blei jong ki Israel ki dei ki beit lum , bad den na kata ka daw ba ki Israel ki jop ïa ine . Hynrei ngin sa jop khlem pep ïa ki lade ngi ïaleh ïa ki ha ki jaka Madon .
translation.en: And the servants of the king of Syria said unto him , Their gods are gods of the hills  ; therefore they were stronger than we  ; but let us fight against them in the plain , and surely we shall be stronger than they .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Syiem u jaboh , Em , Ngan siew ha me ïa ka sad ba-pura . len ym ai kum ka jingainguh ha U Trai’ ïa kaei kaba daym ka jong me , da kaei katba shu ïoh ei .
translation.en: And king David said to Ornan , Nay  ; but I will verily buy it for the full price : for I will not take that which is thine for the  Lord  , nor offer burnt offerings without cost .

And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place , and put on his garments , and come forth , and offer his burnt offering , and the burnt offering of the people , and make an atonement for himself , and for the people .
translation.kha: U dei ban sum ha ka jaka kaba khuid bad phong da la ki jong ki jaiñ . Hadien kata , un mih shabar bad un kñia ïa ka jingainguh thang ban weng noh ïa ki pop jong u bad ïa ki pop jong u paidbah de .
U Jisu u la Kylli biang ïa ki , Ono phi ïawad ? U ijuh uba na Nasareth , ki la ong .

translation.en: And he said unto him , Go in peace . So he departed from him a little way .

translation.en: Seeing that many glory after the flesh , I will glory also .

translation.en: Sit thou silent , and get thee into darkness , O daughter of the Chaldeans : for thou shalt no more be called , The lady of kingdoms .
That ye be not slothful , but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises .
translation.kha: Ngim kwah ïa phi ba phin long kiba alhia , hynrei ban long kum kita kiba ngeit bad ban long kiba ïaishah , bad kumta ban ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .

translation.en: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle , note that man , and have no company with him , that he may be ashamed .

translation.en: And when he came to himself , he said , How many hired servants of my father s have bread enough and to spare , and I perish with hunger !
And they commanded the people , saying , When ye see the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  your God , and the priests the Levites bearing it , then ye shall remove from your place , and go after it .
translation.kha: bad ong ha ki paidbah ,  Haba phi ïohi ïa ki lyngdoh ba ki bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , loit noh ïa ka jaka shong dara bad bud ïa ki .

translation.en: It does not belong to man who is walking even to direct his step .
translation.kha: Kam long ha u briew uba iaid ban pynbeit ia la ki jingjam .

translation.en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life .
translation.kha: Ka thma kaba la sdang hapdeng u Rehoboam bad u Jeroboam ka neh katba u Abijah u dang im .

Dei ha ka jingngeit ba film ki biria baroh ki la ïap . Kim shym la ïohpdiang ïa kiei kiei ïa naba U Blei u la kular , hynrei na sha jngai ki ïew ïa ki bad ki pdiang sngewbha ïa ki , bad ki la pynbna paidbah ba ki la long ki nongwei bad ki sohshnong ha kane ka pyrthei .
translation.en: These all died in faith , not having received the promises , but having seen them afar off , and were persuaded of them , and embraced them , and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth .

translation.kha: Ki kyntien ki wan rnong shisha mar kumta hi . Ïa u Nebukhadnessar la bah noh na ka pliang ka sahlang u bynriew bad u la bam phlang kum u smai dab . Ka umjer ka la khap halor ka met jong u , bad u shñiuh jong u , u la san jrop kamon ki snem jong ki pukni bad ki tyrsim jong u ki Jong Kum ki tnaw jong ki sim .
translation.en: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar : and he was driven from men , and did eat grass as oxen , and his body was wet with the dew of heaven , till his hairs were grown like eagles  feathers , and his nails like birds  claws .

translation.kha: Jin haduh sawspah snem nga la ijli ïa iba ki briew . Nga la ong , ‘ Haduh katno ki long kiba shetkylla ! Ki kynta Ban kumjuh ïa ki hukum jong nga .’
translation.en: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation , and said , It is a people that do err in their heart , and they have not known my ways :

translation.kha: ‘ Kine ki brisoh kiba la shah khot phylla khatduh ki la thri tang shai kynta ,’ ki la nguh , ‘ katba ïa ngi la buh ha ka kam baroh shi sngi ha ka jingshitom ka sngi — pynban me siew ïa ki kumjuh kamar me la sleit ïa sem !’
translation.en: Saying , These last have wrought but one hour , and thou hast made them equal unto us , which have borne the burden and heat of the day .
For thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will bring up a company upon them , and will give them to be removed and spoiled .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Wallam ïa u paidbhur ban pynshyrkhei ïa ki bad ban lute ïa ki .

translation.en: For they are a nation void of counsel , neither is there any understanding in them .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki long ka jaitbynriew ka bym don ka bor sngewthuh ; kim don satia ka jingstad .
Nongbah u Moses u la hukum , ‘ Bud ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmiesan ,’ bad , ‘ du uno umbiah tim ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie yn pynïap .’
translation.en: For Moses said , Honour thy father and thy mother  ; and , Whoso curseth father or mother , let him die the death :

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ong ha ki paid Israel ,
translation.en: And Moses charged the people the same day , saying ,
Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things : for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you :
translation.kha: Wat pynbyrsieh ïa lade da kano kano na kine ki kam , namar dei da kine ba ki briew ki bymngeit Blei ki la pyntngit ïa lade , kito ki jaitbynriew kiba im ha kata ka ri ha shuwa jong phi bad ïa kiba ngan beh noh , ba phin ïoh leit rung hangta .
U la ong umdih , Me , A Trai , ha kaba mynnyngkong me la thaw ïa ka pyrthat , bad da la ki kiei hi me la thaw ïa ki bneng .
translation.en: And , Thou , Lord , in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth  ; and the heavens are the works of thine hands :
What hath my beloved to do in mine house , seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many , and the holy flesh is passed from thee ? when thou doest evil , then thou rejoicest .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew kiba nga ieit ki la leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew . Ki don hok aïu ban don hapoh ka Templ jong nga ? Hato ki pyrkhat ba ki lah ban ïada na ka jingpynjot da kaba pynlong ki jingkular bad da kaba ai ki jingkñia da ki mrad ? Hato kata kan pynkmen ïa ki ?

translation.en: And their king shall go into captivity , he and his princes together , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem jong ki bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , kin shah ringmraw .
Kane ka jingpynbna kan treikam ha baroh ka hima Paseah ha ka sngi ba la bhah na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa ki Jiw , ka sngi kaba khatlai jongnga u Ararat , u bnai uba khat-ar .
translation.en: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus , namely , upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar .

translation.kha: Wat pyrthuh ba ngan wallam ïa ki briew jngai ar sha ka jingsuh kha bad khlem lah ban kha ïa ki . U Troas u la kren .
translation.en: Shall I bring to the birth , and not cause to bring forth ? saith the  Lord  : shall I cause to bring forth , and shut the womb ? saith thy God .
And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering , mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil .
translation.kha: lem bad ka jingainguh bam kaba shi kilo u  purew ba la khleh lang bad shi litar ka umphniang Olib kaba bha tam .
U Trai u ong , Ki briew jong ka Damaskos ki ïai leh pop , bad na ka bna Kane ngan pynthnam da Shisha ïa ki ; ki la shohbeiñ ïa ki briew ka Gilead da ka kur shyntur ba khleh ba-beit .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Damascus , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron :

translation.kha: Haba ki pynrangbah jong ka nongbah ki ïakhun Ngan nga long uwei napdeng jong ki ,
translation.en: When I went out to the gate through the city , when I prepared my seat in the street !
Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye devour widows  houses , and for a pretence make long prayer : therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad phi knieh noh ïa ki ïing jong ki , bad nangta phi pyn-i ïa ka jingduwai bajlan ! Namar kane , ka jingpynshitom ïa phi kan long kaba kham sniew !

Kumta u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka phiah kaba kham shapoh ka Templ . Haneng hajan ka jaka rung sha ka jaka kynjoh , hapdeng ka duwan bad ka lynti rung , la don arphew san ngut ki rangbah . Ki peiñ dadien ïa ka jaka kyntang , dara ki pyndem ïa lade shaphang mihngi , ki da ma ïa ka sngi kaba dang mih .
translation.en: And he brought me into the inner court of the  Lord s  house , and , behold , at the door of the temple of the  Lord  , between the porch and the altar , were about five and twenty men , with their backs toward the temple of the  Lord  , and their faces toward the east  ; and they worshipped the sun toward the east .
The candlestick also for the light , and his furniture , and his lamps , with the oil for the light ,
translation.kha: ïa u diengpynïeng sharak bad ki tiar kiba ïadei bad u ; ïa ki sharak bad ka umphniang jong ki ;

Ha ka jingphohsniew jrong nga , nga la ïohi ïa ki puit ba ki bameh duh ïa baroh kaei katei naba jingsngem ha ka ri , bad nangta nga la ong , A Trai Nongsynshar , to ïohmap ïa ki briew jong me ! Kumno ki lah ba-bang lait im ? Ki long kiba rieh bad kiba sliew katta kor !
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land , then I said , O Lord  God  , forgive , I beseech thee : by whom shall Jacob arise ? for he is small .

translation.kha: U la phah ïa ki nongsyntiat sha ka nongbah shuh u Ahab u syiem ka Israel bad ong ,
translation.en: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Israel into the city , and said unto him , Thus saith Ben–hadad ,

translation.kha: Ho-oid’ , ko ki khur jong nga , to ïashoh ha u , khnang ba ynda u wanpaw , ïeng long kiba dap da ka jingshlur bad ngim donkam ban rieh ha ka jinglehrain na u ha ka Sngi kaban u wan .
translation.en: And now , little children , abide in him  ; that , when he shall appear , we may have confidence , and not be ashamed before him at his coming .
And the  Lord  have removed men far away , and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land .
translation.kha: Ngan phah sha jngai bah ïa ki briew bad ngan pynlong kynjah ïa ka ri .
Nangta u Abraham u la ai katto katne tylli ki langbrot mala ki mar ha u Abimael , bad ktien borbah ar ñiut ki ïateh kli .
translation.en: And Abraham took sheep and oxen , and gave them unto Abimelech  ; and both of them made a covenant .

translation.kha: Ma phi to nang ïaleit shiah ka Jingkhawai Niam . Nga ngam leit shaw khnai ka Jingïohipaw Niam , namarba ba ka por kaba biang kam pat poi na ka bynta Jong nga .
translation.en: Go ye up unto this feast : I go not up yet unto this feast  ; for my time is not yet full come .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ba la tei pat ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah . U Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad ki para lyngdoh jong u ki la tei paw ïa ka Khyrdop Langbrot , ki pyngkiang ïa ka , bad pynïeng ïa ki khyrdop . Ki la pynkyntang ïa ka kynroh haduh u Mot ki bashispah dara u Mot Hananel .
translation.en: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests , and they builded the sheep gate  ; they sanctified it , and set up the doors of it  ; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it , unto the tower of Hananeel .

translation.kha: Uei u baneh ym ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa me , A Trai ? Uei u pun kyntait ban pynbna ïa ka jingkraw jong me ? Tang ma me hi umbiah khuid . Baroh ki jaitbynriew kin wan malu mane ïa me , namar ïa ki jingleh bahok lad me la ïohi da baher .
translation.en: Who shall not fear thee , O Lord , and glorify thy name ? for thou only art holy : for all nations shall come and worship before thee  ; for thy judgments are made manifest .

translation.kha: U briew u dei ban pyndep hok ïa la ka kamram kum u tnga , pynlang ka briew ka dei ban pyndep hok ïa la ka kamram kum ka tngit , bad pun pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence : and likewise also the wife unto the husband .

translation.kha: Hangne ka dat Kaei kawei kaba jingshyrkhei kaba nga la ïohi ha ka pyrthei : Ki bariew ki lah shun beit tang shipor ïa la ka pita haba ki lah ba donkam ïa ka ,
translation.en: There is a sore evil which I have seen under the sun , namely , riches kept for the owners thereof to their hurt .
And Judah and Israel dwelt safely , every man under his vine and under his fig tree , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , all the days of Solomon .
translation.kha: Katba u dang im , ki briew ha kylleng ka Judah bad Israel , ki im ha ka jingshngain , kawei kawei ka longïing ka don la ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Dumbur .
Ka jingthoh jong ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u ka long : U Syiem jngai ki Jiw .
translation.en: And the superscription of his accusation was written over , THE KING OF THE JEWS .

translation.kha: Wai klet lano lano ïa kine ki hukum ïa kiba at ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
translation.en: And these words , which I command thee this day , shall be in thine heart :

translation.kha: Ki briew Kiba shyieng ki kwah ïa-ban ïoh hikai , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop ki sngewhun ha ka jingbieit .
translation.en: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge : but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness .

translation.kha: Ki leit tylli ki lem kiba la woh mih shalor haba la pynkheiñ noh ïa ka reng kaba nyngkong ki ïeng na ka bna ki saw thylliej ki hima sha naba kata ka Hima yn pynïabynta bad kin ym long kiba khlain kum ka hima kaba nyngkong .
translation.en: Now that being broken , whereas four stood up for it , four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation , but not in his power .

translation.kha: U pynhiar shapoh ïa ki nongsynshar badonbor um pynlong ei ei shuh ïa ki .
translation.en: That bringeth the princes to nothing  ; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity .

translation.kha: Haduh Myntan u Balaam u la tip ba U Trai u kwah ïa u ba un kyrkhu ïa ki paid Eliel , kumta um shym leit wad shuh ïa ki dak ki shin kumba u la leh mynshuwa . U la phai la ki khmat shaphang ka ri shyiap ,
translation.en: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the  Lord  to bless Israel , he went not , as at other times , to seek for enchantments , but he set his face toward the wilderness .

translation.kha: Haseroth u briew u lah ban hikai ïa U Blei Ibbah bishar wat ïa kito kiba heh kyrdan ?
translation.en: Shall any teach God knowledge ? seeing he judgeth those that are high .
Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa u kew jong phi , bad ïa ka jingbam ba phi khreh da u .

Ki ïa-lorni bad kren Sniew uwei ïa ti pat ; ki long kiba shun ïa U balui , uba pynbitar , kiba sarong bad kiba sngewmeng ; ki pyrkhat ïa kiba bun ki lynti ban leh ïa kaba sngur ; kim kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa ;
translation.en: Backbiters , haters of God , despiteful , proud , boasters , inventors of evil things , disobedient to parents ,

translation.kha: Ki lyngkhot baroh , namar dat , ki de ban sum ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba nga la ai . Lym kumto kin kit hi ïa la ka pop bad Kin ïap , nongmareh ba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba kyntang . Nga long U Trai uba pynkyntang ïa ki .
translation.en: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance , lest they bear sin for it , and die therefore , if they profane it : I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
Saul reigned one year  ; and when he had reigned two years over Israel ,
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u la synshar ar snem ha Israel ,

translation.en: For they said unto me , Make us gods , which shall go before us : for as for this Moses , the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .
translation.kha: Ki ong ïa nga , ‘ Ngim tip ka la jia aïu ïa une u Moses , u briew uba la ïalam ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt ; kumta , thaw noh ïa ngi u blei u ban ïalam ïa ngi .’

U Trai Nongsynshar un pynkut noh ïa ka jingïap junom ! Un ñiad noh ïa ki ummat na ki khmat jongki baroh bad un weng neh ïa ka jingjahburom kaba ki briew jong u ki la shah ha pylleng ka pyrthei . U Terah hi da lade u la kren !
translation.en: He will swallow up death in victory  ; and the Lord  God  will wipe away tears from off all faces  ; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ruh ïa u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah malu ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u shai kito kiba kwah don pynïap ïa ki . Ngan aiti ïa ki shiah ka kynhun shipai Babilonia , kaba la sangeh ïa-ban tur ïaleh ïa phi .
translation.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah and his princes will I give into the hand of their enemies , and into the hand of them that seek their life , and into the hand of the king of Babylon s army , which are gone up from you .

translation.kha: Hynrei ym don kano kano kaba ki haw ban Ong , namar ba ki la ïohi ïa u briew uba la ïohkhiah kaba ïeng hangta lem bad u Petros bad u Ïoannis .
translation.en: And beholding the man which was healed standing with them , they could say nothing against it .

translation.kha: lang kyiuh ïa ka jaka ap phira jong nga badno ap ba-bang khih ïa kaei kambah U Trai un ïathuh ha na ban ong bad kaei ka jubab ba un ai halor ka jingmudui jong nga .
translation.en: I will stand upon my watch , and set me upon the tower , and will watch to see what he will say unto me , and what I shall answer when I am reproved .

translation.kha: Baroh ki kyntur naba dum baneh thir ki wallam ïa u ksai linen uba ni , nabar ïa u saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw .
translation.en: And all the women that were wise hearted did spin with their hands , and brought that which they had spun , both of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine linen .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , un sait ïa la ki jaiñ pynlang theh um ïa lade , bad nangta u lah ban rung sha ka jaka shong sawa ; hynrei u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
translation.en: Then the priest shall wash his clothes , and he shall bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp , and the priest shall be unclean until the even .

translation.kha: Ym kumta keiñ! Lada U Blei um long uba khih , kumno un bishar ïa ka pyrthei ?
translation.en: God forbid : for then how shall God judge the world ?

And Saul was consenting unto his death . And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem  ; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria , except the apostles .
translation.kha: Bad u Saul u la mynjur ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u Stephan . Ha kata hi ka sngi , ka balang ha Jerusalem ka la sdang ban mad ïa ka jingpynshitom beiñ kaba shyrkhei . Baroh ki riewngeit , lait noh ki apostol , ki la sakma sha kylleng jong ki thain ka Judia bad ka Samaria .
Kumta ki Pharisi bad ki ïabah lyngdoh ki la lum ïa ka dorbar bad ki la ong , Ngin ïaleh kumno ? Peit ïa ki kambah baroh kiba une u brup u la leh !
translation.en: Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council , and said , What do we ? for this man doeth many miracles .

translation.kha: U la ai ïa phi bad ïa kiwei pat ki Lebi ba ïoh ïa kane ka burom — bad mynta pat phi pyrshah ban ïoh sa ïa ka kam lyngdoh ruh !
translation.en: And he hath brought thee near to him , and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee : and seek ye the priesthood also ?

translation.kha: Haba U Trai u wan ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka pyrthei , ki briew kin rieh ha ki thliew bad ki krem ha ki mawsiang lum ban pyrshang ban lait na ka jingbitar jong u Bad ban rieh na ka bor bad ka burom jong u .
translation.en: To go into the clefts of the rocks , and into the tops of the ragged rocks , for fear of the  Lord  , and for the glory of his majesty , when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth .
And Nahash the Ammonite answered them , On this condition will I make a covenant with you , that I may thrust out all your right eyes , and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel .
translation.kha: U Nahash u jubab ,  Ngan ïateh jutang bad phi halor kawei ka kyndon : Ngan khlaw ïa ka khmat kamon jong phi baroh , bad da kumta ngan pynjahburom halor ki Israel baroh .

translation.en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun , as an error which proceedeth from the ruler :
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingbymlehhok kaba jia ha ka pyrthei — ka jingbymlehhok kaba la pynlong da ki nongsynshar .

translation.en: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard , and his feet were as the feet of a bear , and his mouth as the mouth of a lion : and the dragon gave him his power , and his seat , and great authority .
translation.kha: Uta u mradkhlaw u ïasyriem ïa u  labasa , bad ki kjat kum ki kjat dngiem bad ka shyntur u kum ka shyntur sing . U Ïakjakor u la ai ha u mradkhlaw ïa ka bor jong u hi , ïa ka khet jong u , bad ïa ka bor synshar baïar jong u .

translation.en: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed : and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ka umphniang kaba dang sah ha ka sla ti un kyllan ha ka khlieh jong uta u briew . Kumne keiñ u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid .

malade ki la Pha ïa kane ka shithi harum lyngba jong ki : Ma moi , ki apostol bad ki nongsharai buid , ki hynmen ki para jongki phi , ngi Pha ki jingkhublei ïa ki hynmen ki para jong ngi kiba la kha na ki Jentil kiba sheng basah ha Antiokh , ha Syria bad ha Kilikia .
translation.en: And they wrote letters by them after this manner  ; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia :
And Zacchaeus stood , and said unto the Lord  ; Behold , Lord , the half of my goods I give to the poor  ; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation , I restore him fourfold .
translation.kha: U Sakhaïos u la ïeng joit bad u la ong ha U Trai ,  To shahshkor , kynrad ! ngan ai shiteng na ki jingdon jingem jong nga ha kiba duk , bad lada nga la shukor ïano ïano , ngan siew pat ïa u sa saw shah .
U Abraham u wan hajan U TRAI’ , bad u kylli , Hato men shu pynjot nep ïa kiba hok ruh ryngkat dara ki bymman ?
translation.en: And Abraham drew near , and said , Wilt thou also destroy the righteous with the wicked ?

translation.kha: U Asa u syiem Jehoïada bad u Baasha u syiem Jeruel ki don baburom ha ka jingialeh thma hapdeng jong ki katba ki dang don ha ka bor .
translation.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days .

translation.kha: Eliada eit uno uba ïohsngew ïa ka hynrei um shitaiew , bad u nongshun u wan malade pynap ïa u , te un kit pop hi ïa la ka jong ka jingïap .
translation.en: Then whosoever heareth the sound of the trumpet , and taketh not warning  ; if the sword come , and take him away , his blood shall be upon his own head .

translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw bapli ba la pynshlur ïa ngi . Ym tang ba la pynshlur ïa ngi ; ïaheh katno u tyrtho u la pynkmen ïa ngi da ka jingkmen jong u halor ka lap kaba phi baroh phi la ïarap ban pynkmen ïa u !
translation.en: Therefore we were comforted in your comfort : yea , and exceedingly the more joyed we for the joy of Titus , because his spirit was refreshed by you all .

translation.kha: Kito kiba la thied dara die ïa ki langbrot ki la wai ïa to , Bad nga la long u nongaplangbrot jong ki langbrot kiba la dei ban shah shohdoh . Nga la shim ar tylli ki dieng : Ïa uwei nga la khat U Jingsngewbha bad ïa aiwai pang U Jingtylli . Bad nga la jrem ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: And I will feed the flock of slaughter , even you , O poor of the flock . And I took unto me two staves  ; the one I called Beauty , and the other I called Bands  ; and I fed the flock .
And he answered and said unto them ,  My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God , and do it .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki baroh ,  Ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong nga ki long kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka ktien U Blei bad kiba kohnguh ïa ka .
U Jonathan u ïaheh jutang jingïadei paralok pynlang u Dabid namar ka jingieit bajylliew ïa u .
translation.en: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant , because he loved him as his own soul .

translation.kha: Nangta ha ka bynta kaba shaphang mihngi jong ka nongbah , nga leit shaphang shatei sha ka Khyrdop Umpohliew bad ka pung-um u Simri . U khi u ba nga shong um lah ban shem kano kano ka lynti lyngba ki synrum ,
translation.en: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain , and to the king s pool : but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass .
Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop : but a good word maketh it glad .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïathied harud ka duriaw Galilaïa , u la ïohi ïa ki ar ngut sha para kiba long ki nongtong dohkha , u Simon ( ïa uba la khop u Petros ) bad u para jong u , u Andriw , ba ki dang tong dkhoh ha ka duriaw da ka jar .
translation.en: And Jesus , walking by the sea of Galilee , saw two brethren , Simon called Peter , and Andrew his brother , casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .

translation.kha: U Rangbah lyngkhuit ha uba ïa ka umphniang pynsleh la theh ha ka khlieh jong u , bad ïa uba la pynkyntang ban phong ïa ki jingap lyngkhuh , um Dei Ban iehnoh ra-ngiep ïa la u shñiuh lane kad ïa la ki jaiñkup .
translation.en: And he that is the high priest among his brethren , upon whose head the anointing oil was poured , and that is consecrated to put on the garments , shall not uncover his head , nor rend his clothes  ;

translation.kha: To phai noh na ki pop Jong phi , u la ong , naba ka Hima ki bneng ka la jan !
translation.en: And saying , Repent ye : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand .

translation.kha: Ki don bad ki ïa ki khun shynrang jong ki , u Ahimaas bad u Jonathan , bad phiah lah ba phuh ïa ki sha nga lem bad ki jingmihpat baroh kiba phi la ïohbor .
translation.en: Behold , they have there with them their two sons , Ahimaaz Zadok s son , and Jonathan Abiathar s son  ; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear .

translation.kha: Ïa kaei phi ïaleit ban peit ? Ïa u briew naba la kup da ki jaiñ ba-itynnat ? Ki briew kiba riam kumta ki shong ki sah ha ki ïingshong !
translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? behold , they that wear soft clothing are in kings  houses .
In vain have I smitten your children  ; they received no correction : your own sword hath devoured your prophets , like a destroying lion .
translation.kha: Nga la pynshitom ïa pha , hynrei kam shym wanrah kano kano ka jingbha ; phan ym da la shah ïa nga ban pynbeit ïa pha . Kum u sing uba shyrkhei , pha la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong nga .

Men leit kurup , bad lute ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah kiba shisien ki don ha ka jingot . Ki long kiba la lumlang na ki jaitbynriew , bad Myntan ki don la ki jingri dara ki jingdon jingem , bad ki shong ha ki lad bthah ka pyrthei .
translation.en: To take a spoil , and to take a prey  ; to turn thine hand upon the desolate places that are now inhabited , and upon the people that are gathered out of the nations , which have gotten cattle and goods , that dwell in the midst of the land .

translation.kha: To sumar ba phin ym ibeiñ ïano ïano na kine kiba rit . Ki angel jong ki ha bneng , nga ong ha phi , ki ïai don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Kpa jong nga suba ha bneng .
translation.en: Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones  ; for I say unto you , That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven .

Now therefore , my lord , as the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , seeing the  Lord  hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood , and from avenging thyself with thine own hand , now let thine enemies , and they that seek evil to my lord , be as Nabal .
translation.kha: U dei U  Trai  uba la khang ïa phi ban pynhiarkput bad pynïap ïa ki nongshun jong phi . Bad mynta nga smai ha phi da U  Trai  uba im ba ki nongshun jong phi bad baroh kiba kwah ban pynmynsaw ïa phi kin shah pynshitom kum u Nabal .
Ka Baibl ka ong : “U blei u la iohi ia Kiei Kiei barben ba u la thaw , ha khmih ruh , ka la bha eh .”
translation.en: The Bible states : “God saw everything he had made and , look ! it was very good .”

translation.kha: Nangta u Jehudi u ïai-ong ha ka Tamar ka pyrsa kyrsum jongnga u , Khie leit phai noh sha ka ïing u khap jong Pha bad to ïaheh riewkhraw tad haduh ba u Shelah u khun jong nga un da rangbah . U ong kumta naba u sheptieng ïoh ba u Salekah un shah pynïap kum ki hynmen jong u . Kumta ka Tamar ka la leit phai noh shad la ïing .
translation.en: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law , Remain a widow at thy father s house , till Shelah my son be grown : for he said , Lest peradventure he die also , as his brethren did . And Tamar went and dwelt in her father s house .
Which leaveth her eggs in the earth , and warmeth them in dust ,
translation.kha: Ka Ostrit ka iehnoh ïa la ki pylleng ha madan ba ka jingshit hapoh ka khyndew kan pynsyaid ïa ki .
To kieng noh ïa ka jingkieng atiar U Blei baroh , khring ba phi lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki buit thop basniew jong u Soitan .
translation.en: Put on the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba brup , ka sngi hadien ka jingkwah mih bnai tyrsim , ka jaka shong bam u Dabid ka dang thylli hi , bad u Saul u kylli ïa u Jonathan , Balei u Dabid um shem wan sha ka jingkhawai mynhynnin bad mynta ka sngi ruh ?
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , which was the second day of the month , that David s place was empty : and Saul said unto Jonathan his son , Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat , neither yesterday , nor to day ?
Wherefore , my brethren , when ye come together to eat , tarry one for another .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , haba phi ïawanlang ban bam ïa ka Jingkhawai U Trai , to da ïa-ap paralok hi .
Ha ka step kaba bud , u Dabid u thoh sahit sha u Joab bad u phah rah ïa ka ha u Uriah .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , that David wrote a letter to Joab , and sent it by the hand of Uriah .

translation.kha: Haba u la tip ba U Jisu u la dei na ka thoin ba la synshar da u Herod , u la phah ïa u sha u Herod , uba la don ruh ha Jerahmeel ha kata ka nga .
translation.en: And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod s jurisdiction , he sent him to Herod , who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time .

translation.kha: Namar ba ka Rebekka kam ïoh khun , u Isaak u la duwai ha U Tlai na ka bynta jong ka . U Trai u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , malade ka Rakhe ka la punkhun .
translation.en: And Isaac entreated the  Lord  for his wife , because she was barren : and the  Lord  was entreated of him , and Rebekah his wife conceived .

translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kob ki longïing na ka jait Asher ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jongu ki .
translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families , these cities with their villages .
He that believeth on me , as the scripture hath said , out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Ki wahduid ka um kaba ai jingim kin tuid noh na ka dohnud jong u .’

translation.en: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone , which Moses put there at Horeb , when the  Lord  made a covenant with the children of Israel , when they came out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ym don ei ei ruh hapoh ka Synduk ka Jutang lait tang ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ïa kiba u Moses u la buh hangta ha u Lum Sinai , mynba U  Trai  u pynlong ka jutang bad ki paid Israel katba ki dang wan mihnoh na ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And it shall be with him , and he shall read therein all the days of his life : that he may learn to fear the  Lord  his God , to keep all the words of this law and these statutes , to do them :
translation.kha: Un buh bad u ïa kata ka kitab bad un pule na ka synñia sngi , ba un tip ban tiengburom ïa U  Trai  bad kohnguh hok ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh ïa kiba la thoh hangta .

translation.en: Then the beasts go into dens , and remain in their places .
translation.kha: Ki mradkhlaw ki leit sha la ki krem .

Hynrei haba kim shym lap ïa ki , ki la paring ïa u Jason bad ïa ki katto katne ngut kiwei pat ki parabangeit ha khat ki bor synshar jong ka nongkhap mala ki la pyrta , Kine ki briew ki la tiduh jingkulmar kylleng kylleng ! Mynta ki la wan sha ka nongbah jong ngi , bad u Jason u la pynsah ïa ki ha ka ïohnang jong u .
