translation.en: And when they found them not , they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city , crying , These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also  ;
Families everywhere are coming apart at the seams .
translation.kha: Ha kylleng sawdong ka longïng longsem ka pait ka pra na ba sdang .
Mynba u Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ijipt , U Trai U la kren ha nga . U ong ,
translation.en: The word that the  Lord  spake to Jeremiah the prophet , how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Ka jingbitar u briew kam lah ban jop ïa ka jingthmu bahok jong U blang .
translation.en: For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God .

translation.kha: Kumno ma phi pat ? U la kylliang ïa ki . Phi ong nga long uei ?
translation.en: He saith unto them ,  But whom say ye that I am ?

translation.kha: Lada u briew ne ka briew ki mih prum ha ka khlieh ne ha ka tmoh , u lyngdoh un peit bniap ïa ka .
translation.en: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard  ;

translation.kha: Ha baroh ki lumrit bad ha syrngiew jong uwei pa uwei u dieng ki pynïeng ïa ki pait maw bad ki dur jong ka blei Asherah ,
translation.en: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill , and under every green tree :
But there shall not an hair of your head perish .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat iwei ruh i shñiuh na ki khlieh jong phi in ym jah noh .

Kumta u Dabid u lumlang ïa ki paid Israel na baroh kawei ka ri , naduh khappud ibieit ha ka phang shat sha Khim Haman ha ka phang shatei , khnai ban wallam ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang na kyr-iat Jearim sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: So David gathered all Israel together , from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hamath , to bring the ark of God from Kirjath–jearim .
And these are they that conspired against him  ; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess , and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess .
translation.kha: ( Kito kiba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u ki dei u Sabad , u khun jong ka nong Ammon kaba kyrteng ka Shimeath , bad u Jehosabad , u khun jong ka nong Moab kaba kyrteng ka Shimrith ) .
Ha kata ka Por , U Jisu u la leit kiew sha u kum ban ïarwai bad ban pynlut baroh sei suri hangta da kaba duwai ha U Bela .
translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that he went out into a mountain to pray , and continued all night in prayer to God .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga Hikai ïa Phin ka longïng kaba bha , kumta wat klet ïa ka .
translation.en: For I give you good doctrine , forsake ye not my law .

translation.kha: Phi la ïoh shiah ba ki kjap bad ki shynrang khet ki longsem shi beit da ka dewbyrtha dara shi bynta da ka nong . Kane ka mut ba kan long ka hima kaba la pynïakhlad . Kan don kaei kaei kaba eh kumto ka nalor , namar la don ka nar naba la khleh bad ka riewbieit .
translation.en: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes , part of potters  clay , and part of iron , the kingdom shall be divided  ; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron , forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay .
These are murmurers , complainers , walking after their own lusts  ; and their mouth speaketh great swelling words , having men s persons in admiration because of advantage .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew kiba khñium bad borabor ki kynnoh ïa kiwei ; ki ïaid kat kum ki jingkwah brai jong ki ; ki kren sarong shaphang ïa lade bad ïaroh arsap ïa kiwei khnang ban ïoh leh ïa kaba ki kwah hi .
‘ To sngap , ko Israel ! mynta ka sngi phna leit ban ïaleh thma . Wat sheptieng ïa ki nongsuhjaiñ jngai phi , wat noh mynsiem , lane woh sngi syier .
translation.en: And shall say unto them , Hear , O Israel , ye approach this day unto battle against your enemies : let not your hearts faint , fear not , and do not tremble , neither be ye terrified because of them  ;
( Acts 24 :15 ) That is why Jesus Christ could tell a repentant evildoer who expressed faith in him : “You will be with me in Paradise .” —Luke 23 :43 .
translation.kha: ( Kam ki Apostol 24 :15 ) Na kata ka daw u Jisu Khrist u la ong ha u nongpop ba la kylla bamut uba la pynpaw ia ka jingngeit ha u : “Men long lem bad nga ha ka paradais .” —Loukas 23 :43 .

translation.en: And I Daniel fainted , and was sick certain days  ; afterward I rose up , and did the king s business  ; and I was astonished at the vision , but none understood it .
translation.kha: Nga la noh mynsiem bad shitom bun bun sngi . Hadien kata nga la khie bad leit pat sha ka kam kaba u syiem u la ai ha nga , hynrei nga la shaïong da ka jingïohipaw bad ngam lah ban shemphang ïa ka .

Haba nga pham ïa u shapoh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ka jingsawa jong ka jingkyllon jong u , kan pynkhynñiuh ïa ki jingñiewbeiñ . Baroh ki dieng ha Eden bad ki dieng baroh kiba kynsai , kba la ïoh um bha jong ka Lebanon kiba la leit sha ka pyrthat shapoh kin sa sngewkmen ha ka jingkyllon jrong u .
translation.en: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall , when I cast him down to hell with them that descend into the pit : and all the trees of Eden , the choice and best of Lebanon , all that drink water , shall be comforted in the nether parts of the earth .

translation.kha: Wat lyndet ïa nga bad mane ïa ki bleithaw ; wat thaw ïa ki blei ba Shuah saiñ na ka sisa bad ban Mano ïa ki . Nga long U Troas U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Turn ye not unto idols , nor make to yourselves molten gods : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: U ding uba plung bha um lah ban pynmong ki soh katba sniew , bad u dieng umbah swai um lah ban Pynmih ki soi kiba bha .
translation.en: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit , neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit .

Then he said , I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains , as sheep that have no shepherd : and the  Lord  said , These have no master  ; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace .
translation.kha: U Mikaïah u jubab ,  Nga ïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel ba la pynsakma halor ki lum kum ïa ki langbrot bym don nongsharai . Bad U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Kine ki rangbah kim don nongïalam ; ai ba kin leit phai noh sha la ïing ha ka jingsuk .’
Te dalade pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ïa ki balang !
translation.en: He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .
And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not : for a fire is kindled in mine anger , which shall burn upon you .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban shakri ïa ki nongshun jong ki ha ka ri kaba kim don jingtip ei ei , namar ka jingbitar jong nga ka long kum ka ding , ban kan pluh junom .
Ka jingwoh jong kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine , for an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Phi kylla riewspah na ki pop ki briew jong nga , bad kumta phi kwah ïa ki ban nang leh pop shuh shuh .
translation.en: They eat up the sin of my people , and they set their heart on their iniquity .

translation.kha: Haduh ka por jong u Ïoannis baroh ki nongïathuhlypa bad ka Hukum u Moses ki la krenbeiñ shaïong ka Hima ;
translation.en: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John .

translation.kha: To lute ïa ka rupa ! To lwa ïa ka ksiew ! Ka nongbah ka dap da ki jingkynshew !
translation.en: Take ye the spoil of silver , take the spoil of gold : for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture .
As for the wheels , it was cried unto them in my hearing , O wheel .
translation.kha: Kine ki shalyntem ki long kumjuh kum kito kiba nga la ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw kaba nyngkong jong nga .

Kumta u syiem Balak u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban ïakynduh ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , uba to ha Peleth hajan ka wah Ïuphratis ha ka ri jongnga ki Amaw . Ki wallam sha u ïa kane ka khohruh na u Balak , Nga kwah ïa phi ban tip ba khawai ka jingtipbriew baroh kawei ka la wan na Ieit ; kita ki briew ki la saphriang kylleng bad ki thmu ban knieh ïa ka ri jong ngi .
translation.en: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor , which is by the river of the land of the children of his people , to call him , saying , Behold , there is a people come out from Egypt : behold , they cover the face of the earth , and they abide over against me :

translation.kha: Kan long dom ka la longïing ha ka por jongngi u Lot . Uwei uwei baroh u ïai ïam bad ïawad , da kaba ïathied bad ïadie , da kabu thung pynlang tei .
translation.en: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot  ; they did eat , they drank , they bought , they sold , they planted , they builded  ;
My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long : for they are confounded , for they are brought unto shame , that seek my hurt .
translation.kha: Ngan kren shaphang ka hok jong me baroh shi sngi , namar kito kiba pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa nga ki la shahjop bad shah pynlehrain .
Ym dei ban bam ïa ka khleiñ jong ki masi , ki langbrot , ne ki blang .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , Ye shall eat no manner of fat , of ox , or of sheep , or of goat .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la shim ïa u Jonah bad bret ïa u sha ka dur , bad ka la long jat jai ha ka shikhyllipmat .
translation.en: So they took up Jonah , and cast him forth into the sea : and the sea ceased from her raging .
And God said unto Noah , The end of all flesh is come before me  ; for the earth is filled with violence through them  ; and , behold , I will destroy them with the earth .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Noah ,  Nga la kut jingmut ban pynduh noh ïa ki briew baroh . Ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki namar ka pyrthei ka la jyllei da ki kam leh jubor jong ki .
Ha ka sngi kaba khaïi jong u bnai bajew jong ka snem kaba khatwei ka jinglong syiem u Sedekaïah , ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah la pynpra lut .
translation.en: And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah , in the fourth month , the ninth day of the month , the city was broken up .

translation.kha: Kata ka long kumno kan jia ha ka sngi ba yn pynpaw ïa U Khun U Briew .
translation.en: Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ïa u , Men ïam ïa to sha kito ki nonglute ? U jubab , Ngan longing lada phi kular ïa nga ha ka kylleng U Blei ba phin ym pynnep ïa nga lane aiti ïa nga ha u kyndiang Jong nga .
translation.en: And David said to him , Canst thou bring me down to this company ? And he said , Swear unto me by God , that thou wilt neither kill me , nor deliver me into the hands of my master , and I will bring thee down to this company .
Against whom when the accusers stood up , they brought none accusation of such things as I supposed :
translation.kha: Ki nongïaleh pyrshah ïa u ki la ïeng , hynrei kim shym mudui ïa u ïa kano kano na ki kam runar kiba nga la pyrkhat ba kin leh .

translation.en: He hath put my brethren far from me , and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me .
translation.kha: U Blei u pynlong ïa ki hynmen ki para jong nga ban iehnoh ïa nga ; nga kylla long u nongwei ha kito kiba ithuh ïa nga ;

nalor kane ruh , u syiem u la ong ïa ki briew ka Israel ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh kiba long ki bynta Ibbah dei jrong ki lyngdoh malu ki Lebi , khnang ba ki lah ban ai ïa ka por jong ki baroh sha ki jingdawa jong ka hukum jong U Trai .
translation.en: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites , that they might be encouraged in the law of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Ngan wan ha me ha u lyoh uba Reuben , khring ba u paidbhur un ïohsngew ïa nga ba nga ïakren bad me , sad un sa ngeit ïa me naduh mynta . U Moses u la ïashoh ha U Trai ïa ka jubab jong uta u paidbah ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Lo , I come unto thee in a thick cloud , that the people may hear when I speak with thee , and believe thee for ever . And Moses told the words of the people unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ngam pat skhem la tip hi ba u dadien ma u , hynrei U Blei , uba la phah ïa nga ban pynbat da ka um , u la ong ha nga , ‘ Men sa ïoh ïa U Mynsiem ba u hiar badno u shongsah ha u briew ; u dei Uto , umbah pynbaptis da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .’
translation.en: And I knew him not : but he that sent me to baptize with water , the same said unto me , Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending , and remaining on him , the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ong kiei kiei kiba sner pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem bakynjah yn ym map lano lano ruh , namar u la leh ïa ka Pop bymjukut .
translation.en: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness , but is in danger of eternal damnation :
From thence she seeketh the prey , and her eyes behold afar off .
translation.kha: Na kata ka jaka u peit shane bad shatai ban ïoh ei ei ban pynïap bad ban bam .
Wat lada ka jingïadei ingiew jngai phi ka biang bha , kur ïarep ei ei ïa uwei pat u briew .
translation.en: For thou verily givest thanks well , but the other is not edified .
Nebuchadnezzar the king , unto all people , nations , and languages , that dwell in all the earth  ; Peace be multiplied unto you .
translation.kha: U syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah ïa ka khubor harum sha ki briew jong baroh ki jaitbynriew , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki thylliej ha ka pyrthei :  Khublei !
U angel jong U Trai u la mihpaw ha ki , bad ka burom jngai U Trai ka la tyngshaiñ hajar jngai ki . Ki la sngewsheptieng shikatdei eh ,
translation.en: And , lo , the angel of the Lord came upon them , and the glory of the Lord shone round about them : and they were sore afraid .
And after that they had mocked him , they took the robe off from him , and put his own raiment on him , and led him away to crucify him .
translation.kha: Ynda ki la dep pyrthuh beiñ ïa u , ki la weng noh ïa ka jaiñkup bad ki la pynphong biang ïa u da ki jaiñ jong u . Nangta ki la ïalam ïa u shabar ban sahnarphna ïa u .
Ha kawei ka sngi mynba U Jisu u dang duwai marwei , ki synran ki la wan ha u . Ki paidbah ki ong ba nga long uei ? U la kylli ïa ki .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he was alone praying , his disciples were with him : and he asked them , saying ,  Whom say the people that I am ?

translation.kha: Kumta u Syiem Shelomoth u la ai hukum ha u Benaïah , uba la ithuh bad pynpyut ïa u Adnah .
translation.en: And king Solomon sent by the hand of Benaiah the son of Jehoiada  ; and he fell upon him that he died .

translation.kha: U Samuel u leh ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la ong ha u ngab leh malade u leit sha Bethlehem , ha kaba ki nongïalam jong kata ka nongap ki wan da katba kyiuh ban ïatyngkhuh ïa u bad ki kylli , Hato kane ka long ka jingwan jngoh ha ka jingsuk , ko nongïohipaw ?
translation.en: And Samuel did that which the  Lord  spake , and came to Beth–lehem . And the elders of the town trembled at his coming , and said , Comest thou peaceably ?
Remember ye not , that , when I was yet with you , I told you these things ?
translation.kha: Hato phim kynmaw ? Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane baroh mynba nga dang don lem bad phi .

Katba U ju u dang hikai ha ka Templ , u la kren ha ka sur ka jar , Hattush phi ithuh da shisha ïa na malade ïatip nangno de wan ? Nahum shem la wan da ka kun jong nga hi . Uta uba la phah ïa nga , pynïap , u long uba shisha .
translation.en: Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught , saying ,  Ye both know me , and ye know whence I am : and I am not come of myself , but he that sent me is true , whom ye know not .

translation.kha: ba u la paw ha u Petros bad nangta ha baroh ki khat-ar nguh ki Apostol .
translation.en: And that he was seen of Cephas , then of the twelve :

translation.kha: kumta u Ïoanna u la wan sha ka ri shyiap , da kaba pynbaptis bad ïalap . To phan noh na ki pep jong phi bad to shait pynbaptis , u la ong ïa ki briew , bad U Blei un map noh ïa ki pop jong phi .
translation.en: John did baptize in the wilderness , and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins .
And he said unto his lad , Run , find out now the arrows which I shoot . And as the lad ran , he shot an arrow beyond him .
translation.kha: bad u ong ha u ,  Khie mareh , bad tam ïa ki khnam kiba ngan sa siat .  Uta u mareh , bad u Jonathan u siat ïa u khnam sha shuwa jong u .
Hato ka kham suk ban noh , ‘ La map ïa ki pop jong me ,’ lane ban ong , ‘ To ïingjaiñ joit bad to ïaid ?’
translation.en: For whether is easier , to say , Thy sins be forgiven thee  ; or to say , Arise , and walk ?

translation.kha: La ai ha u ka iktiar , ka jingpyndonburom , bad ka bor ba kynja syiem , khnang ba ki biria jong ki jaitbynriew baroh , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktah ki thylliej kin shakri ïa u . Ka iktiar jrong u kan neh junom , bad ka hima Jong u kan ym kut sha .
translation.en: And there was given him dominion , and glory , and a kingdom , that all people , nations , and languages , should serve him : his dominion is an everlasting dominion , which shall not pass away , and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed .

translation.kha: bad u Beryl , u Karnelian , bad u Jasper ha ka ïadon kaba saw . Pyndait ïa ki baroh ha ki jingoh-shrong katba da ka ksing .
translation.en: And the fourth row a beryl , and an onyx , and a jasper : they shall be set in gold in their inclosings .

translation.kha: Hynrei ym don nangno kano ka bymkhuid ka don ïing sha ka nongbah , lymne uno uno uba leh ïa kino kino kiba sngewlehrain lane uba ïathmu lakam . Tang kito ïa kiba ki kyrteng Jong ki la thoh ha ka kitab kiba im jong U Khunlangbrot kin ïohrung sha kata ka nongbah .
translation.en: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth , neither whatsoever worketh abomination , or maketh a lie : but they which are written in the Lamb s book of life .

translation.kha: U Ktien u la don ha ka pyrthei , bad dak la U blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei da u , pynban , ka pyrthei kam shym la ithuh ïa u .
translation.en: He was in the world , and the world was made by him , and the world knew him not .

translation.kha: U Nathan u la ïathuh ha u dabi ïa baroh katne kaba U Blei u la pynpaw ha u .
translation.en: According to all these words , and according to all this vision , so did Nathan speak unto David .

translation.kha: Bad U Bela u la ong , ‘ Namar kane ka daw u briew un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie bad un ïashong ïasah bad la ka tnga , bad ma ki baroh ar ngut kin ïapynlong kawei .’
translation.en: And said , For this cause shall a man leave father and mother , and shall cleave to his wife : and they twain shall be one flesh ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kin ong ïa me ban kylli ïa ki khubor na ki nongbatai kyrpang bad ki nongkren byrtong kiba kren jam bad kiba Kren mian mian . Kin ong , Nalor bhor , ki briew ki dei pun kylli ïa ki khubor na ki mynsiem bad kylli na kiba ïaw na ka bynta kiba im .
translation.en: And when they shall say unto you , Seek unto them that have familiar spirits , and unto wizards that peep , and that mutter : should not a people seek unto their God ? for the living to the dead ?
Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom , seeing he hath no heart to it ?
translation.kha: Kam wanrah ei ei kaba bha lada pynlut pisa ha ka jingpynnang pynstad ïa uba bieit , namar um don jingshemphang satia .
Ka bha bha kane .
translation.en: This is very good .

translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa phi sha ka ri kaba nga la kylluid skhem ban ai ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob ; bad ngan ai ïa ka ha pa’ kum ka nongkynti jong phiah hi . Nga long U Trai .’
translation.en: And I will bring you in unto the land , concerning the which I did swear to give it to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob  ; and I will give it you for an heritage : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Bad ha ka jingïohipaw jong nga , nga la ïohi ïa ki khuslai bad ïa ki nongshong kulai jong ki : Ki don ki jingïada shadem kiba saw kum ka ting , kiba jngum khim u seraph , bad kiba stem kum u kyndok . Ki khlieh jong ki kulai ki la long kumno ki khlup sing , bun na ki shyntur jngai ki la mih ka ding , ka thom bad u kyndok .
translation.en: And thus I saw the horses in the vision , and them that sat on them , having breastplates of fire , and of jacinth , and brimstone : and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions  ; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone .

translation.kha: Hynñiew u Asahel um skhem sangeh ; kumta u Aben , da ka jingtynrah shadien ïa la u sum , u la dung ïa u na ka khop ba kumta u sum u da pei bla ha ka ingdong jong u . U Asahel u kyllon ïap ha madan , bad uwei pa uwei uba wanlam poi ha ka khang ha ka u kyllon u la sangeh nabar ïeng hangamei .
translation.en: Howbeit he refused to turn aside : wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib , that the spear came out behind him  ; and he fell down there , and died in the same place : and it came to pass , that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still .

translation.kha: Shim ïa u khun jongno me , U Blei u ong , u iaisah , u khulom ba Tang marwei jong me , ïa uba me ieid thep mynsiem , bad leit sha ka ri Moraïah . hangtei halor u lum ïa uba ngan sa pyn-i ha me , kñia ïa u kumne ka jingiaseng ha nga .
translation.en: And he said , Take now thy son , thine only son Isaac , whom thou lovest , and get thee into the land of Moriah  ; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of .
For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world : and this is the victory that overcometh the world , even our faith .
translation.kha: namar man u khun U Blei u lah ban jop noh thiaw ïa ka pyrthei . Bad ngi ïoh ïa ka jingjop halor ka pyrthei lyngba ka jingngeit jong ngi .
Ka kmie bad u kpa jong ka ki la lyngngoh shikatdei , isynei U Jisu u la law ïa ki ban ym ïaheh haei hano ïa kaei kaba la jia .
translation.en: And her parents were astonished : but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done .

translation.kha: Wai ki maw ha ki kynrup ki Kieng pyrsa ïa phi , bad ki shankhung ki pynsaja ïa ka jingkyang .
translation.en: For the stone shall cry out of the wall , and the beam out of the timber shall answer it .
Yet the children of thy people say , The way of the Lord is not equal : but as for them , their way is not equal .
translation.kha: Bad ki briew jong me ki ong ba kaei kaba nga leh kam long ka badei ! Em , ka dei ka lynti jong ki ka bymdei .
Nangta na la pyrkhat , Keiñ ki long Tang bakha duk bun ki bym sngewkwah . Ki la leh bieit ; kim tip ïa kaei kaba U Blang jong ki u dawa , ïa kaei U Trai u kwah ïa ki ban leh .
translation.en: Therefore I said , Surely these are poor  ; they are foolish : for they know not the way of the  Lord  , nor the judgment of their God .

translation.kha: Me ai ïa ka ha ki , bad ki bam ïa ka , me pynbiang jingbam , bad ki sngewhun .
translation.en: That thou givest them they gather : thou openest thine hand , they are filled with good .

translation.kha: thaba u Abram u la ïohsngew ba la kem koidi ïa u pyrta jongu u , u khot lang ïa ki nongïapom kiba don hapoh ka dara jong u , baroh ki long laispah khatphra ngut , dara u la thet ïa ki leit thut ki syiem haduh Dan .
translation.en: And when Abram heard that his brother was taken captive , he armed his trained servants , born in his own house , three hundred and eighteen , and pursued them unto Dan .

translation.kha: Hadien Katai , un phah khrud ïa ki kynruh baïar hapoh ïohnong , bad bret ïa kata ka khyndew shabar shong ha ka jaka theh ñiut .
translation.en: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about , and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place :
He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife : but he that putteth his trust in the  Lord  shall be made fat .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhapnap ka pynmih tang ka jingjynjar . Phi long kham bha ban shaniah ha U  Trai .
Ki Jentil kim don ka Law u Moses ; ki leh pop bad bakla lynti khlem ka law . Ki Jiw ki ei ka Hukum ; ki leh pop bad shah bishar da ka Hukum .
translation.en: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law : and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law ;
I'm just asking .
translation.kha: Nga shu kylli .

U syiem Jehosabad u kylli , Hato Don nongïathuhlypa hangne da wahbah ngi eh ban kylli na U Trai ? U rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki kynhun u syiem Joram u jop , U Elisha u khun jongki u Shaphat u khong hangtei . U dei u nongïarap jongu u Elijah .
translation.en: But Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  , that we may enquire of the  Lord  by him ? And one of the king of Israel s servants answered and said , Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat , which poured water on the hands of Elijah .

He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom , and upright ones with him  ; thus shall he do : and he shall give him the daughter of women , corrupting her : but she shall not stand on his side , neither be for him .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Syria un pynkhreh ka jinghiarthma , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh kawei . Nangta , khnang ban pynjot ïa ka hima jong u nongshun , un pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u bad tyrwa ha u ban shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u ; hynrei ka jingthmu jong u kan ym jop .
kamut , man ka sngi , naduh tang step phyrngab haduh ka por ba la ñiah ki khlem mynmiet , shithi na Ngi , i'u trei ha ka kynroh , Kaba shiteng kiwei pat , ki ïeng ap pharia bad ki sum .
translation.en: So we laboured in the work : and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared .
But I would have you know , that the head of every man is Christ ; and the head of the woman is the man ; and the head of Christ is God .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga kwah ïa phi ba phin sngewthuh ba U Khrist u long halor tam ïa uwei pa uwei briew , u tnga u long halor la ka tnga , bad U Blei u long halor tam ïa U Khrist .

translation.en: Thou , O king , art a king of kings : for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom , power , and strength , and glory .
translation.kha: Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi long uba khraw tam na ki syiem baroh . U Blei ka bneng u la pynlong ïa phi u patsha bad u la ai ha phi ka bor , ka jingkhlaiñ , bad ka burom .
Nga ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew baroh da ka jingtim ba la thoh ha ka kitab ïa kaba la pule ha khmat u syiem .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , and upon the inhabitants thereof , even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah :

translation.kha: Ki khun : “Ka ki khun to kohnguh ia la ki kmie ki kpa ha U Trai .” —Ephesos 6 :1 .
translation.en: Children : “Children , be obedient to your parents in union with the Lord .”—Ephesians 6 :1 .
Neither will I hide my face any more from them : for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan theh buk ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha ki paid Israel , bad ngan ym phai dien shuh na ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
Kumta u Ahikam u ong ha ki lapbah synshar jong u , Ha khmih ! u u briew u lamwir ! Balei phin wan ïalam ïa u shwa nga ?
translation.en: Then said Achish unto his servants , Lo , ye see the man is mad : wherefore then have ye brought him to me ?

translation.kha: Balei me kylli na to shaphang kaei kaba bha ? la jyllop U Jisu . Don tong suit uba bha . To jrem ïa ki praw lada me kwah ban rung sha ka jingim .
translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? there is none good but one , that is , God : but if thou wilt enter into life , keep the commandments .
And he searched , and began at the eldest , and left at the youngest : and the cup was found in Benjamin s sack .
translation.kha: U shakri jong u Joseph u la wad bniah da kaba sdang na uba nyngkong ter ter haduh uba khatduh , bad ïa ka khuri la shem ha ka byrni jong u Benjamin .

translation.en: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven ,
translation.kha: Te u angel ïa uba nga la ïohi ba u ïeng halor ka duriaw bad halor ka khyndew u la rah ïa la ka kti kamon sha bneng
ho-oid , u phlang u ïapstai malu ki syntiew ki jlop , hynrei ka ktien jong U Blei jong ngi ka neng bymjukut .
translation.en: The grass withereth , the flower fadeth : but the word of our God shall stand for ever .
But the children of Belial said , How shall this man save us ? And they despised him , and brought him no presents . But he held his peace .
translation.kha: Hynrei don ki riewkai kiba ong ,  Kumno da kum une u briew u lah ban lehbha ïa ngi ?  Ki ibeiñ ïa u Saul bad kim shym wanrah ïa u kano kano ka jingai sngewbha .
U Trai u la skei ïa ki ; bad kumta katba u ïalang leit noh ,
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against them  ; and he departed .

And thus I saw the horses in the vision , and them that sat on them , having breastplates of fire , and of jacinth , and brimstone : and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions  ; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone .
translation.kha: Bad ha ka jingïohipaw jong nga , nga la ïohi ïa ki kulai bad ïa ki nongshong kulai jong ki : Ki don ki jingïada shadem kiba saw kum ka ding , kiba jngum kum u Sapphir , bad kiba stem kum u kyndok . Ki khlieh jong ki kulai ki la long kum ki khlieh sing , bad na ki shyntur jong ki la mih ka ding , ka tdem bad u kyndok .
Ka theisotti Jeriel ka la Khilion ; kan ym khie patiaw lano lano ! Ka shah iehnoh ha ka khyndew Bad ym don uwei ruh u ban khyllie ïa ka .
translation.en: The virgin of Israel is fallen  ; she shall no more rise : she is forsaken upon her land  ; there is none to raise her up .

translation.kha: Ka pud kabu shaphang mihngi ka dadien ka ïarieh baïapher , artet ïathuh ka jaka ha kaweh ka Jordan ka tuid sha ka . Ka buid kabu shaphang shatei ka sdang nangta ,
translation.en: And the east border was the salt sea , even unto the end of Jordan . And their border in the north quarter was from the bay of the sea at the uttermost part of Jordan :

translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi ki rakhe da ka jingkmen ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Ki la ba-dap da ka jingkmen ñiar U Terah u la pynlong ïa u patsha jong ka Assyria ba-bang lehsbun ïa ki , ba u kyrshan ïa ki ha ka jingtrei Jong ki ha ka jingtei pah ïa ka Thymmai jongno U Blang ki Jerusalem .
translation.en: And kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with joy : for the  Lord  had made them joyful , and turned the heart of the king of Assyria unto them , to strengthen their hands in the work of the house of God , the God of Israel .
And he sent forth a raven , which went forth to and fro , until the waters were dried up from off the earth .
translation.kha: Kam shym la wan phai , hynrei ka shu her kylleng kylleng haduh ba ka um kan da rngad .

Lehse ki briew kin shahjop bad iehnoh ïa la ki lynti banbeiñ . Lada ki leh kumta , te ngan kylla ïa la ka jingmut shaphang ka jingpynithuh kaweh at la thmu ban wallam halor jong ki na ka bynta ki kam bymman jong ki .
translation.en: If so be they will hearken , and turn every man from his evil way , that I may repent me of the evil , which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings .

translation.kha: Nga ngam lah ban leh ei ei da la ka jong ka har ; nga bishar Teng kat kaba U Blei u ong ïa de , kumta ka jingbishar jongngi nga ka lama kaba hok , namar ba ngiam pyrshing ban kun ïa kaei kaba nga mon , hynrei ïa kaei kaba uta uba la Pha ïa nga u mon .
translation.en: I can of mine own self do nothing : as I hear , I judge : and my judgment is just  ; because I seek not mine own will , but the will of the Father which hath sent me .

translation.kha: U lat jong ka ri Ijipt u la kren khop ïa ngi , bad u la kynnoh ba ngi syntiat ïa kata ka ri .
translation.en: The man , who is the lord of the land , spake roughly to us , and took us for spies of the country .

translation.kha: Mynta ngan pynpang ka jutang malu phi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jrong phi ,
translation.en: And I , behold , I establish my covenant with you , and with your seed after you  ;
Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ;
Nangta u mraw na Sudan u wan poi bad u ong ha u syiem , Nga don ka khubor babha ïa u Syiem Kynrad ! Ha kane ka sneng U Trai u la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor kito barhem kiba la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi !
translation.en: And , behold , Cushi came  ; and Cushi said , Tidings , my lord the king : for the  Lord  hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee .

translation.kha: hynrei U Blei um shym la shah ïan ïaduna ban lehbeiñ ïa ki ; ban ïadih ïa ki , u pham ïa ki syiem :
translation.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong : yea , he reproved kings for their sakes  ;
Open thou mine eyes , that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law .
translation.kha: To pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong nga , khnang ba ngan ïohi ïa ki jingshisha baphylla hapoh ka aiñ jong me .
Dannah ba la sdang ïa ka Gilead ha u sniew 1943 , palat 8 ,000 ngut ki la wiang sha kane ka snur bad la phah ïa ki kumne ki mishoneri ban sakhi “shaduh kaba kut ka pyrem .”
translation.en: Since Gilead’s founding in 1943 , more than 8 ,000 graduates of this school have been sent out as missionaries to give a witness “to the ends of the earth” with great success .
Also thou shalt lie down , and none shall make thee afraid  ; yea , many shall make suit unto thee .
translation.kha: Men ym sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong me ; kiba bun ki briew kin kyrpad jingïarap na me .

translation.en: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city  ; and every male was circumcised , all that went out of the gate of his city .
translation.kha: Baroh ki nongshong shnong jong kata ka nongbah ki la ïamynjur ïa kaei kaba u Hamor bad u Shekhem ki ai jingmut , bad baroh ki shynrang ki la shah otsher .
U la pynlut la ka jingim ha kaba ïasyllok malade U Blei , malade hadien kata u la ja-um noh , namar U Blei u la Shim nep ïa u .
translation.en: And Enoch walked with God : and he was not  ; for God took him .

translation.kha: U Shomer u para jong u , u don lai ngut ki khwan shynriah : u Rohgah , u Jehubbah , bad u Aram .
translation.en: And the sons of Shamer  ; Ahi , and Rohgah , Jehubbah , and Aram .

translation.kha: Haba phi la lum ïa ki sohwaiñ shisien , wat leit biang sha ki dieng sohwaiñ sa Sihon ; ki shaïong kiba dang sah hangta ki dei ka bynta ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewngeit .
translation.en: When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard , thou shalt not glean it afterward : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow .

translation.kha: Ki phong da ki jaiñjot bad ki slipar snieh ba la jot kiba la dep syrdep . U kpu ba ki rahah u long uba tyrkhong bad babha bthuh .
translation.en: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet , and old garments upon them  ; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy .

translation.kha: U la mih lem bad ki kila ïapom jong u baroh , kynthup ïa ki hynriewspah tylli ki kali ïapom jrong u kiba bha kuna , ïa ibha la ai hukum da ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki .
translation.en: And he took six hundred chosen chariots , and all the chariots of Egypt , and captains over every one of them .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah katba u Moses u la phah swar ïa ka ri , ki la wanrah ïa ka kaiphod balamler kaba la pynlong ïa u baïap ban khñium pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And the men , which Moses sent to search the land , who returned , and made all the congregation to murmur against him , by bringing up a slander upon the land ,

translation.kha: Te ka jingshai bapyrkhing jngai ka jingainong U Terah ka la kiew noh na ki kherub sha ka jaka rung jong ka Templ . Te u lehkai u la tap ïa ka baphylla , bad kata ka phyllaw ka phyrnai da ka jingshai .
translation.en: Then the glory of the  Lord  went up from the cherub , and stood over the threshold of the house  ; and the house was filled with the cloud , and the court was full of the brightness of the  Lord s  glory .
Ten fat oxen , and twenty oxen out of the pastures , and an hundred sheep , beside harts , and roebucks , and fallowdeer , and fatted fowl .
translation.kha: shiphew tylli ki masi ba la bsa pynsngaid ha sem , arphew tylli ki masi bam phlang ha lum , bad shispah tylli ki langbrot , nalor ki skei , ki khiat , ki  keirang , bad ki syiar .
Ngan sngewbha ha kaba leh kiei kiei kiba bha na ka bynta jongki ki , bad ngan buh pynskhem jyrngam ïa ki ha kane ka ri .
translation.en: Yea , I will rejoice over them to do them good , and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul .
But shun profane and vain babblings : for they will increase unto more ungodliness .
translation.kha: To kiar noh na ki jingïakren ba-thala bad ba-bieit , tang ban ïalam ïa ki briew kham jngai na U Blei .
Wat la kumta ruh , ktieh shym la lah ban pynlong ïa ki jingïathuh jong ki kiba ïahap .
translation.en: But neither so did their witness agree together .

translation.kha: Ka na kan wan , ong U Trai , haba ki briew kin ym syiem shuh da nga koum U blei uba im uba la ïalam ïa u paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that they shall no more say , The  Lord  liveth , which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt  ;
For if the inheritance be of the law , it is no more of promise : but God gave it to Abraham by promise .
translation.kha: Naba lada ka jingai U Blei ka shong ha ka Hukum , te ka jingaiei kam shong shuh ha ka jingkular jong u . Pynban ka long namar ka jingkular jong u ba U Blei u la ai ïa kata ka jingai sngewbha ha u Abraham .
U Kynrad u donkam ïa u , ki la jubab , bad ki la ïalam ïa u khun kada sha U Jisu! .
translation.en: And they said , The Lord hath need of him .

translation.kha: U Tola u ni hynriew ngut ki khwan Shaneng : u Ussi , u Rephaïah , u Jeriel , u Jahmai , u Ibsam , bad u Shemuel . Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing kiba na ka kura Tola , bad ki dei ruh ki shipai bapawnam . Ha ka por u syiem Dabid , ki khulom ki khiew jong ki , ki don arphew ar hajar hynriewspah ngut .
translation.en: And the sons of Tola  ; Uzzi , and Rephaiah , and Jeriel , and Jahmai , and Jibsam , and Shemuel , heads of their father s house , to wit , of Tola : they were valiant men of might in their generations  ; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred .

translation.kha: U Elisha u peiñ dien , u la kham da ka jingbitar ïa ki , bad u la tim ïa ki ha ka kyr-ang jong U Trai . Nangta ar tylli ki dngiem kynthei ki la wan mih na khlaw bad ki la phar lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki sawphew ar ngut ki khynnah shynrang .
translation.en: And he turned back , and looked on them , and cursed them in the name of the  Lord . And there came forth two she bears out of the wood , and tare forty and two children of them .
I taught Ephraim also to go , taking them by their arms  ; but they knew not that I healed them .
translation.kha: Pynban dei ma nga uba hikai ïa ki Israel ban ïaid . Nga la rah ïa ki briew jong nga ha la ki ksang ti , hynrei kim shym la pdiang ba nga la sumar ïa ki .

translation.en: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles , which is a witness against me : and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face .
translation.kha: Me la kem ïa nga ; me dei u nongshun jong nga . Nga la sah sa tang ka snep bad ki shyieng , bad ki briew ki shim ïa kata kum ka jingpynshisha ïa ka jingkitpop jong nga .
U Jisu u la kli pat ïa ka kot kli , u la ai pat ïa ka ha u shakri , bad u la shong . Balah ki briew ha ka synagog ki la peit shlip sha u ,
translation.en: And he closed the book , and he gave it again to the minister , and sat down . And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la kyang shad U Trai , A Trai , ngi duwai , to wat pynshitom ïa ngi da ka jingïap ban shim ïa ka jingim jong une u briew ! Ma me , ko Trai , me kitkhlieh na ka bynta kane baroh ; ka long ka jingleh jong me .
translation.en: Wherefore they cried unto the  Lord  , and said , We beseech thee , O  Lord  , we beseech thee , let us not perish for this man s life , and lay not upon us innocent blood : for thou , O  Lord  , hast done as it pleased thee .
And the Arvadite , and the Zemarite , and the Hamathite : and afterward were the families of the Canaanites spread abroad .
translation.kha: ki Arbad , ki Semar , bad ki Hamath . Ki jait bapher bapher jong ki jait Kanaan ki la saphriang kylleng kylleng ,
Nangta ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki leit shwa u Pharaoh bad ki la ujor , Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi leh ïa kane ha i ?
translation.en: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh , saying , Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants ?
And he said unto them ,  What man shall there be among you , that shall have one sheep , and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day , will he not lay hold on it , and lift it out ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kumno lada uwei na phi u don kawei ka langbrot bad ka hap hapoh ka thliew bajylliew ha ka sngi Sabbaton ? Hato phin ym bat ïa ka bad kyntiew ïa ka shabar ?
Hukum ïa ki Israel ban wanrah ïa ka umphniang Olib kaweh khuid bol na ka bynta kita ki sharak , ba kin ai jingshai man la ka por .
translation.en: Command the children of Israel , that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light , to cause the lamps to burn continually .
Praise ye the  Lord . Praise ye the name of the  Lord   ; praise him , O ye servants of the  Lord .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u , phi ki shakri jong U  Trai  ,

translation.en: And the sons of Uzzi  ; Izrahiah : and the sons of Izrahiah  ; Michael , and Obadiah , and Joel , Ishiah , five : all of them chief men .
translation.kha: U Ussi u don uwei u khun , u Israhaïah . U Israhaïah bad ki khun shynrang jong u saw ngut , u Mikhael , u Obadaïah , u Joel , bad u Isshaïah , ki dei baroh ki khlieh jong ki longïing .
Man ka snem , ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong phi , pa’ dih ban ïabam ïa ki ha Khmut U Trai ha kata ka khak mane Blei ba U Trei un ieid .
translation.en: Thou shalt eat it before the  Lord  thy God year by year in the place which the  Lord  shall choose , thou and thy household .

So it came to pass , when the king s commandment and his decree was heard , and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace , to the custody of Hegai , that Esther was brought also unto the king s house , to the custody of Hegai , keeper of the women .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u la pynmih ïa ka jingpynbna bathymmai bad shibun ki samla kynthei la wallam sha Susa , ka Esther ka la long kawei na ki . Ïa ka ruh la buh ha ka ïingsyiem hapoh ka jingsumar u Hegai , uba peit ïa ka ïing ki kynthei .
Ngin shen ïa u Dabid hangno hangno ha kaba u don , bad ngin tur ïaleit ïa u ha shuwa ba un tip kaei kaba jia . Ma u lane uno une na ki rangïapom jong u kin ym laitluid im .
translation.en: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found , and we will light upon him as the dew falleth on the ground : and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one .

translation.kha: Ki Long kum ki dieng kiba mih harud ka wahduid , kiba seisoh ha ka por kaba Dei , bad kiba ki sla jong ki kim tyrkhong . Ki jop ha ktieh kiei baroh kiba ki leh .
translation.en: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water , that bringeth forth his fruit in his season  ; his leaf also shall not wither  ; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper .

translation.kha: Men ïai don ki khun ki kiaw , malade ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong me ban neh junom . Ka longrynïeng syep jong me tud ym kut .’
translation.en: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee : thy throne shall be established for ever .

translation.kha: Kumba ka sleit ka hikai her ïa la ki khun , bad ka pyiar la ki thapniang ban kyrshan ïa ki , kumta duh U Trai u kyrshan ïa ki Israel ba kin ym hap .
translation.en: As an eagle stirreth up her nest , fluttereth over her young , spreadeth abroad her wings , taketh them , beareth them on her wings :
But I wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted before the heathen , in whose sight I brought them out .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la leh kumta , naba kata kan jin da la wallam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba la lah ïohi ïa nga ba nga ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na Ijipt .

translation.en: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers , and read it : and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the  Lord  , and spread it before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u shim ïa ka shithi na ki nongrah-khubor bad pule ïa ka .
Kabbon ki dang wan hiar na u lumbah , U Jeshua u la hukum ïa ki , wah ïathuh hano hano duh ïa kane ka jingïohipaw kaba phi la ïohi tad haduh ba ïa U Khun U Briew la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
translation.en: And as they came down from the mountain , Jesus charged them , saying ,  Tell the vision to no man , until the Son of man be risen again from the dead .

Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses , let us lay aside every weight , and the sin which doth so easily beset us , and let us run with patience the race that is set before us ,
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong ngi , ngi don katne u paid sakhi babun byllien sawdong jong ngi . Kumta te , to ngin ïabret noh na lade ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba wan pynwit ha lynti , bad ïa kata ka pop kaba shait snoh skhem ha ngi , bad to ngin ïaphet da ka jingkut jingmut ïa ka jingïaphet thong kaba don ha khmat jong ngi .
Ka jingpynmlien ïa ka met ka ai katto katba ka jingbha , hynrei ka jingpynmlien ba kynja mynsiem ka pynjulor ha ki liang baroh , namar ka kyllum ïa ka jingim ha ka mynta mala ha ka lawei .
translation.en: For bodily exercise profiteth little : but godliness is profitable unto all things , having promise of the life that now is , and of that which is to come .
Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes .
translation.kha: U briew uba don ha ka lyngkha um dei ban phai dien ban leit shim ïa ka jaiñkup jong u .
U la batai , Ko Daniel , nga la wan Hangne shun ïarap ïa me ban shemphang ïa ka jingïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And he informed me , and talked with me , and said , O Daniel , I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding .

translation.kha: bad lada uno uno napdeng jong phi u kwah ban long nyngkong , u dei ban long u mraw jong baroh .
translation.en: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest , shall be servant of all .
And when they had set them in the midst , they asked , By what power , or by what name , have ye done this ?
translation.kha: Ki la pynlong ïa ki apostol ban ïeng ha khmat jong ki bad kylli ïa ki ,  Kumno phi la leh ïa kane ? Ka bor aïu phi la ïoh lane ïa ka kyrteng jongno phi pyndonkam ?
Lada U Blei u ïakhmih bha ïa me , hato un shem kano kano kaba bha ? Haduh me pyrkhat ba me lah ban shukor ïa U Blei kumba me shukor ïa ki briew ?
translation.en: Is it good that he should search you out ? or as one man mocketh another , do ye so mock him ?

translation.kha: Kumta seiñ la pynspong ïa ka jingtrei baroh ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U tharai . Ki Israel ki la thaw ïa kata baroh kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished : and the children of Israel did according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses , so did they .

translation.kha: Ko Job , me la kob ïa U Blei Badonbor Baroh ; ithuh men sangeh noh mynsiem , ne men jubor ?
translation.en: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him ? he that reproveth God , let him answer it .

translation.kha: Pynban phi dang iehnoh ïa nga bad mano ïa kiwei pat ki blei ; kumta ngan ym pyllait ïa phi sa shisyndon pat .
translation.en: Yet ye have forsaken me , and served other gods : wherefore I will deliver you no more .

translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u la phah nong ïa u paidbah , bad uwei pa ti u leit phai pat sha la ka jongu ka Jong ka bakwah .
translation.en: So Joshua let the people depart , every man unto his inheritance .

translation.kha: Mynta , A Tlai , khmih ïa kamai kaba jia ha ngi . Shahshkor ïa barhem kiei kiew babha u Sennakherib u ong ngab ibeiñ ïa me , U balui umbah im .
translation.en: Lord  , bow down thine ear , and hear : open ,  Lord  , thine eyes , and see : and hear the words of Sennacherib , which hath sent him to reproach the living God .

translation.kha: U nonghiarthma u la lah ai ha u paidbah ïa ka dak : U briew ïa babha ngan doh u dei uta ïa uba phi kaweh . Kem ïa u bad ïalam ïa u da kaba ap phira bha .
translation.en: And he that betrayed him had given them a token , saying , Whomsoever I shall kiss , that same is he  ; take him , and lead him away safely .
All the days of the afflicted are evil : but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong kiba duk ka don ha ka jingïaleh borabor , hynrei ki briew kiba kmen ki suk mynsiem ha ka jingim borabor .
bad ki la pyndonkam ïa ka pisa ban thied ïa ka lyngkha u nongthaw khiew , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa nga .
translation.en: And gave them for the potter s field , as the Lord appointed me .
Jesus saith unto her ,  Thy brother shall rise again .
translation.kha: U para jong pha un sa im pat ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ka .

Namar kane , ha ka shi snoh yn sa shoh ïa ka da ki khlam — ka jingpang , ka jingsngewsih bad ka nemsniew . Bad yn thrang ïa ka da ka ding , namar ba U Trai uba U Blei , babha bishar ïa ka , u long uba khlaiñbor .
translation.en: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day , death , and mourning , and famine  ; and she shall be utterly burned with fire : for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her .
When the wicked cometh , then cometh also contempt , and with ignominy reproach .
translation.kha: Ka pop bad ka jinglehrain ki ïaid lang . Pynjah noh ïa ka burom jong phi , bad phin ïoh ïa ka jingshah krenbeiñ ha ka jaka jong ka .
U long ma u , uta uba bat ïa ka jingtei barieh kawei , dara uba pynlong ïa ka ba kan san ha ka Templ kaba kyntang ïa kaba la pynkyntang sha U Trai .
translation.en: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord :

translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Ki shawkad ka um naba ai jingim kin tuid ino na ka dohnud jong u .’
translation.en: He that believeth on me , as the scripture hath said , out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ki jingmaham shaïong sakma ka snieh ha ka suiñbneng bad ha ka khyndew ; kun dat ka jingumsnam , ka ryndang bad ki lyoh tdem .
translation.en: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth , blood , and fire , and pillars of smoke .

translation.kha: kham Palal baneh ïa u briew u bym ïoh lehkmen ha ka jingim , la u lah ban im ar hajar snieh . Nalorkata , baroh ar ki leit sha kajuh ka jaka .
translation.en: Yea , though he live a thousand years twice told , yet hath he seen no good : do not all go to one place ?
And he settled his countenance stedfastly , until he was ashamed : and the man of God wept .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elisha u peit shlip ïa u da ka jingpeit kaba ishyrkhei ïa ka khmat jong u haduh ba u Hasael u la kem pang . Kynsan u Elisha u jaw ki ummat brup .
Shan ha U Trai da ka dohnud jong phi baher . Wat shaniah ha kaei ba phi pyrkhat ba phi tip .
translation.en: Trust in the  Lord  with all thine heart  ; and lean not unto thine own understanding .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba ngeit ba U Jisu u un-long U Messaïah , u long u khun U blang ; bad uno uno uba ainguh ïa u kpa , u ieit ïa u khunlung jyllang u ruh .
translation.en: Whosoever believeth that Jesus is the Christ is born of God : and every one that loveth him that begat loveth him also that is begotten of him .
And they told him , that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by .
translation.kha: U Jisu uba na Nasareth u dang ïaid nangne ,  ki la ïathuh ïa u .
Khatwei na ki lad ka longkmie da kaba peit bniah ïa ki jingthaw kiba u la thaw bad ban pyrkhat jylliew ïa kaei kabu ki , ki ïathuh ïa ngi .
translation.en: One way is by observing the things he has created and thinking deeply about what they tell us .

translation.kha: Nga la wan na U KA , bad nga la wan shwa ka pyrthat ; bad mynta ngan sa iehnoh ïa ka pyrthei bad ngan leit sha U Kpa .
translation.en: I came forth from the Father , and am come into the world : again , I leave the world , and go to the Father .
And it shall be , that the city which is next unto the slain man , even the elders of that city shall take an heifer , which hath not been wrought with , and which hath not drawn in the yoke  ;
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongïalam jong ka shnong kaba jan tam na kata ka jaka ha kaba la shem ïa ka metïap kin jied kawei ka masi lud ka bym pat ju ring lyngkor .
( U la ong ïa kane namar U Jisu u la ong , Me u mynsiem bymkhuid , mihnoh na une u briew ! )
translation.en: For he said unto him ,  Come out of the man , thou unclean spirit .

translation.kha: Bad kumta sa ong ha phi ba ki bynriew ki ha ban ïohmap ïa Kanah Kanah ka pop bad ïa kano kano kiba snieh kaba ki ong ; hynrei uno uno wahbah kren kiei kiei kiba sniew pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid un ym Ïoh jingmap .
translation.en: Wherefore I say unto you , All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men : but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men .

translation.kha: une uno kaba ong ba u ïaisah ha U Blei u dei ban im kumba U Jisu Khrist u la im .
translation.en: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk , even as he walked .

translation.kha: Sumar bha , U Jisu! u la maham ïa ki , bad sumar ïa lade na u thiat jong ki Pharisi bad u thiat jong u Herod .
translation.en: And he charged them , saying ,  Take heed , beware of the leaven of the Pharisees , and of the leaven of Herod .
And when Jesus saw her , he called her to him , and said unto her ,  Woman , thou art loosed from thine infirmity .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka , u la pyrta ïa ka ,  Ko ka briew , pha la lait phar na ka jingpang jong pha !

Nangta u la ong ha ki , Kine ki longsyiem kita kiei kiei kiba nga la ïakhot ha phi mynba nga dong khong lem bad phi : Kaei kaei barabor kaba la thoiñ shaphang jong nga ha ka Hukum u Moses , ha ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ha Ki Salm ka dei ban urlong shiah .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  These are the words which I spake unto you , while I was yet with you , that all things must be fulfilled , which were written in the law of Moses , and in the prophets , and in the psalms , concerning me .

translation.kha: Un shim ïa kaba shiphew na ki kynhun langbrot jrong phi , bad phi phin long ki mraw jong u .
translation.en: He will take the tenth of your sheep : and ye shall be his servants .

translation.kha: Khie leit blei noh sha ïing bad sah bad la ki kmie . Ai ba U Trai un lehbha ïa phi kumba phi la leh ïa la bad ïa kito kiba la ïap .
translation.en: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law , Go , return each to her mother s house : the  Lord  deal kindly with you , as ye have dealt with the dead , and with me .
And he killed James the brother of John with the sword .
translation.kha: U la phah pynïap ïa u Jakob , u para jong u Ïoannis , da ka waitlam .

translation.en: And when they were come into the ship , the wind ceased .
translation.kha: Baroh ar ngut ki la kiew halor ka lieng , bad ka lyer ka la sangeh .
Kane ka long kumno ka jingisih ka 3 : Ka jingshai ka la wan sha ka Pyrthei , hynrei ki briew ki ibit ïa ka jingdum ban ïa ka jingshai , nongmareh ba ki kam jong ki , ki lama katba snieh .
translation.en: And this is the condemnation , that light is come into the world , and men loved darkness rather than light , because their deeds were evil .

translation.kha: U Abram u la shongkurim ïa ka Sarai , bad u Nahor u la sngewjahburom ïa ka Milkah , ka khun jong u Haran , uba long ruh u kpa jong ka Iskah .
translation.en: And Abram and Nahor took them wives : the name of Abram s wife was Sarai  ; and the name of Nahor s wife , Milcah , the daughter of Haran , the father of Milcah , and the father of Iscah .

translation.kha: Hamar ba ki la kren , nga la sdang ban thok . Hynrei nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba kren na bneng , To buhrieh ïa kadei kaba ki hynñiew tylli ki pyrthat ki la ong ; woh thoh ïa ka !
translation.en: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices , I was about to write : and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me , Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered , and write them not .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ruh ba ki kynthei keiñ long kiba biang sad kiba sngewthuh ïa ki jaiñ ba ki riam bad ban riam da kaba dadien ; ym da ki jingkhyllong shñiuh bakhyllah ne da ki jingkieng ksiar ne ki paila ne da ki jaiñkup riam kiba remdor , hynrei da ki kam babha , kumba ka dei ïa ki kynthei Ibbah kam ba ki long kiba riewblei .
translation.en: But ( which becometh women professing godliness ) with good works .
He that covereth his sins shall not prosper : but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy .
translation.kha: Phin ym long uba jop ha ka jingim lada phi pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa la ki pop . Phla ïa ki bad iehnoh ïa ki ; te U Blei un pyn-i ka jingisynei ïa phi .
Ki nongthain daiñ bad ki nongtrei kiba tbit kyang diaw mala kin nala mynsiem .
translation.en: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof , all that make sluices and ponds for fish .

translation.kha: bad ban leit lyngngai ka Khyrdop Khra-pait shabar sha ka Them Pyndem . Hangta nga dei ban pynbna ïa ka khublei kaba un ai ha ang .
translation.en: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom , which is by the entry of the east gate , and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee ,

translation.kha: Ka Hannah ka la ïai : U Trai u la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jrong nga da ka jingkmen ; katno nga sngewtynnat nabar kaei kaba u la leh ! Nga rkhie ïa ki nongshun lad nga ; kano nga Shadkmen namar ba U Blei u la ïarap ïa nga .
translation.en: And Hannah prayed , and said , My heart rejoiceth in the  Lord  , mine horn is exalted in the  Lord  : my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies  ; because I rejoice in thy salvation .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka law ki la dam sha khmat bad ki la pynlong ki jingmudui kiba khlaiñ pyrshah ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him .

And Gideon went in , and made ready a kid , and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour : the flesh he put in a basket , and he put the broth in a pot , and brought it out unto him under the oak , and presented it .
translation.kha: Kumta u Gideon u la leit sha la ïing bad u shet uwei u khunblang bad u la pyndonkam shiphew kilo u  purew ban shet ïa u kpu khlem thiat . U buh ïa ka doh ha ka shang bad ïa ka syrwa hapoh u khiew , u la wallam ïa ki sha u angel jong U  Trai  ha trai u dieng Sning , bad u ai ïa ki ha u .
Ki la pynïap ïa kito ki khun balui lui , bad ïa ka ri la pynjyrsieh da kita ki jingpynïap briew .
translation.en: And shed innocent blood , even the blood of their sons and of their daughters , whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan : and the land was polluted with blood .

translation.kha: U Epaphras , kiba don lang bad nga ha ka byndi na ka bynta U Kynther Jisu , u phah ïa ki jingaiei khublei jong u ïa me ,
translation.en: There salute thee Epaphras , my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus  ;
And it may be that I will abide , yea , and winter with you , that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban sah katto katne por bad phi , lehse baroh shi tlang , bad nangta phi lah ban ïarap ïa nga ha ka ban bteng ïa ka jingleit jong nga , kat shano sha ba ngan leit .

translation.en: I will be his father , and he shall be my son . If he commit iniquity , I will chasten him with the rod of men , and with the stripes of the children of men :
translation.kha: Ngan long u kpa jong u , bad u , un long u khun jong nga . Haba u leh bakla , ngan sneng sympat ïa u kumba u kpa u sneng sympat ïa la u khun .

translation.en: Therefore hath the  Lord  watched upon the evil , and brought it upon us : for the  Lord  our God is righteous in all his works which he doeth : for we obeyed not his voice .
translation.kha: Ma me , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , me la pynkhreh ban pynshitom ïa ngi , bad me la leh kumta , namar borabor me ju ïai leh ïa kaei kaba dei , bad ngim shym la pynshahshkor ïa me .

translation.en: And saying , Alas , alas , that great city , that was clothed in fine linen , and purple , and scarlet , and decked with gold , and precious stones , and pearls !
translation.kha: Katno kaba ishyrkhei ! Katno kaba itriem ïa ka nongbah kaba khraw ! Ka la ju riam ïa lade da ki jaiñ linen , kiba sawbthuh , bad kiba saw hain hain , bad ka kup ïa lade da ki jingdeng ksiar , ki mawkordor , bad ki paila !
Ussaïah pa utai un shongsuk hapdeng ki bri sohwaiñ Bad ki dieng Dumbur la ki jong hi , bad yn ym don mano mano ban pynsheptieng ïa u . U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la kular ïa kane .
translation.en: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree  ; and none shall make them afraid : for the mouth of the  Lord  of hosts hath spoken it .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi ïoh da jingkem phi lai baneh lehbeiñ kum ka jingbam ibha Tam , hynrei shen kan long kum u shyiap ba-dap ha ka shyntur .
translation.en: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man  ; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel .

translation.kha: Kito bakha lyndet ïa ka hukum ki ïaroh ïa ki bymman ; hynrei kito Kiba bat ïa ka ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: They that forsake the law praise the wicked : but such as keep the law contend with them .

translation.kha: U Trai U nongbishar Badonbor Beor u la ong ïa nga ban leit sha u Shebna , u nongpynïaidkam ha ka longïing syiem , bad ong ha u ,
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  of hosts , Go , get thee unto this treasurer , even unto Shebna , which is over the house , and say ,

translation.kha: Haba uta u rangbah u ïathuh shaphang ka Synduk ka jyntang , u Eli u kyllon da lyndang na la ka jaka shong kaba harud khyrdop . U la tymmen palat bad sngaid bad kata ka jinghap ka la pynkheiñ ïa u rynïeng jrong u , malade u la ïap . U la long u nongïalam ha Israel sawphew snem .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he made mention of the ark of God , that he fell from off the seat backward by the side of the gate , and his neck brake , and he died : for he was an old man , and heavy . And he had judged Israel forty years .
For there stood by me this night the angel of God , whose I am , and whom I serve ,
translation.kha: Namar mynhynne ka miet u angel jong U Blei ha uba nga long bad ïa uba nga mane u la wan sha nga bad u la ong ,
Haba me khreh ka jingkhawai , khot sngewbha ïa bakha duk , kiba khrew , kiba dkoh , bad kiba mareh ;
translation.en: But when thou makest a feast , call the poor , the maimed , the lame , the blind :
Ye have feared the sword  ; and I will bring a sword upon you , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Hato phi sheptieng ïa ki waitlam ? Ngan wallam ïa ki briew ryngkat bad ki waitlam ban tur ïaleh ïa phi .

Khatwei ka kupar ka wan kumjuh ha baroh , bad kane ka long kaba bakla kum Kanaan kano kaba jia ha kane ka pyrthei . Katba ki briew ki dang im , ki jingtim jingpyrkhat jongu ki , ki dap da ka jingsniew bad ka jinglamwir , bad kynsan kynshuit ki ïaphah .
translation.en: This is an evil among all things that are done under the sun , that there is one event unto all : yea , also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil , and madness is in their heart while they live , and after that they go to the dead .

translation.kha: Lada ka i long kaba myntoi ïa nga ban lytar , te ki eh ban ïaleit ryngkat bad nga .
translation.en: And if it be meet that I go also , they shall go with me .
And in process of time the daughter of Shua Judah s wife died  ; and Judah was comforted , and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnah , he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , ka tnga jong u Judah ka la ïap . Hadien ba u la pyndep ïa ka por ka jingïam sngewsih , ma u lem bad u paralok jong u , u Hirah uba na Adullam ki la ïaleit sha Timnah , ha kaba la khap shñiuh ïa ki langbrot jong u .

Lada u mai kyrtong jong uwei u briew u pynïap ïa u masi kyrtong jong uwei pat , kita ki lad kin die ïa u maw kyrtong uba ding im bad kin ïam ïa ka pisa ; kin ïalam mad ïa ka doh jong uta u mrad uba shah pynïap .
translation.en: And if one man s ox hurt another s , that he die  ; then they shall sell the live ox , and divide the money of it  ; and the dead ox also they shall divide .

translation.kha: Ka jingstad mala ka jingtbit lad me ka la pynriewspah ïa me da ki jingkynshew ksiar bad saw .
translation.en: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches , and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures :
Then said Jeremiah , It is false  ; I fall not away to the Chaldeans . But he hearkened not to him : so Irijah took Jeremiah , and brought him to the princes .
translation.kha: Nga la jubab ,  Kam long kumta ! Ngam phet noh .  Hynrei u Irijah um sngap ïa nga . Pynban , u la kem ïa nga bad ïalam ïa nga sha ki rangbah synshar .

translation.en: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured  ; and all thine adversaries , every one of them , shall go into captivity  ; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil , and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , baroh kiba klun ïa phi kin shah klun , bad ïa baroh ki nongshun jong phi yn rah noh kum ki koidi . Ïa baroh kiba banbeiñ ïa phi yn banbeiñ , bad ïa baroh kiba lute ïa phi yn lute .

translation.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard .
translation.kha: Nangta u Isaïah u phah ïa ka khubor kaba ong ha u syiem Hesekaïah kum ka jubab ïa ka jingduwai u syiem

translation.en: Also they were over the bearers of burdens , and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service : and of the Levites there were scribes , and officers , and porters .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki Lebi ki peit halor ka jingpynkit jingkit bad halor ki nongtrei ha ki kam bapher bapher , bad kiwei ki buh jingkheiñ lane ki shakri kum ki nongap phira .
Habor u Abimelekh u wiang shun tam ïaleh ïa uta u mot , u la sien sha ka jingkhang bad thang ïa Uto u mot .
translation.en: And Abimelech came unto the tower , and fought against it , and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , To rwai da ka jingmeng na ka bynta ki Israel , kiba khraw tam na ki jaitbynriew . To rwai ïa ka jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh jong phi , ‘ U Trai u la pynim ïa la ki bariew ; u la pyrsad im ïa baroh kiba dang sah .’
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Sing with gladness for Jacob , and shout among the chief of the nations : publish ye , praise ye , and say , O  Lord  , save thy people , the remnant of Israel .
Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , and Timothy our brother , unto the church of God which is at Corinth , with all the saints which are in all Achaia :
translation.kha: Na u Paul , u apostol U Khrist Jisu da ka mon U Blei , bad na u Timothi u para jong ngi — Sha ka balang U Blei kaba ha Korinth , bad sha ki briew jong U Blei baroh kiba ha Akhaïa :

translation.en: And the glory of the  Lord  came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ba-thaba ka la ïaid lyngba ïa ka khyrdop bashaphang mihngi bad rung shapoh ka Templ .

translation.en: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the  Lord  : though hand join in hand , he shall not be unpunished .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa baroh kiba leh meng ; da lei lei un ym shah ba kin lait na ka jingpynshitom .
bad u ino ha u Moses , Shim ïa ki nongïalam jong ki Israel baroh bad da kaba kohnguh ïa nga , pynïap ïa ki haba shai ka sngi te ngan ym bitar shuh ïa ki briew .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Take all the heads of the people , and hang them up before the  Lord  against the sun , that the fierce anger of the  Lord  may be turned away from Israel .

translation.kha: Ïa , ngin ïaleit hiar bad pynkhleh ïa ka keiñ jong ki , ba kumta kin ym ïashongduh Shua iwei ïa iwei paw .
translation.en: Go to , let us go down , and there confound their language , that they may not understand one another s speech .

translation.kha: Mar kumta hi ka la khie badno ka la tdong ban ïadie shane shatai . ( Ka la don khat-ar snem ka rta . ) Haba Kane ka la khia , ki la lyngngoh shikatdei eh .
translation.en: And straightway the damsel arose , and walked  ; for she was of the age of twelve years . And they were astonished with a great astonishment .

translation.kha: Haba u Maaseïah u la ïaheh ha ki Jeruel ïa kaba U Trai u la krai , ki ïamkthang .
translation.en: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel : and the people mourned greatly .
And there was no day like that before it or after it , that the  Lord  hearkened unto the voice of a man : for the  Lord  fought for Israel .
translation.kha: Ym pat ju don mynno mynno , bad yn ym don lano lano , ba la don kum kata ka sngi , mynba U  Trai  u la shahshkor ïa u bynriew . U  Trai  u ïaleh ha ka liang ki Israel !
To sharai , te , bad to kynmaw bad da ki ummat kiba bun , mynsngi bad mynmiet , nga la haei ïa iohi pa iwei na phi haw lai snem .
translation.en: Therefore watch , and remember , that by the space of three years I ceased not to warn every one night and day with tears .

translation.kha: U mynsiem jong U Trai u bat synshar ïa u Gideon ; bad u put ïa ka turoi ban khot ïa ki rangbah na ka kur Abieser ban bud ïa u .
translation.en: But the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon Gideon , and he blew a trumpet  ; and Abi–ezer was gathered after him .

translation.kha: hynrei ym don mane mano batip shaphang kata , namsop ki i kumjuh kumba ki longsem mynshuwa . Nangta nga la kyndit thiah .
translation.en: And when they had eaten them up , it could not be known that they had eaten them  ; but they were still ill favoured , as at the beginning . So I awoke .

translation.kha: u Hadad , u Tema , u Jetur , u pynsah , bad u Kedemah .
translation.en: Hadar , and Tema , Jetur , Naphish , and Kedemah :
( For as yet he was fallen upon none of them : only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus . )
translation.kha: Naba U Mynsiem Bakhuid um pat shym la wan hiar hano hano ruh na ki ; la pynbaptis ïa ki tang ha ka kyrteng U Trai Jisu .
Nangta ki buh ïa ki tiar ïapom jong u ha ka ïing mane lad ka blei Astarte , sad ki sahnarphna ïa ka met jongno u ha ka kynroh jong ka nongbah Beth Shan .
translation.en: And they put his armour in the house of Ashtoreth : and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth–shan .
And Mahlon and Chilion died also both of them  ; and the woman was left of her two sons and her husband .
translation.kha: u Mahlon bad u Khilion ruh ki la ïap , bad ka Naomi ka la shah iehnoh sa tang marwei , khlem u tnga ne ki khun shynrang .
U Trai u wan mian na ka kajuh bakhuid jong u ; un wanlam hiar bad ïadoh ha kliar jong ki lamwir .
translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  cometh forth out of his place , and will come down , and tread upon the high places of the earth .

translation.kha: kaba long ka jingïamai kaba u la buhrieh lyngba ki mar baroh kiba mynshuwa na ki jaitbynriew baroh hynrei mynta la pynpaw ha ki briew jong u .
translation.en: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations , but now is made manifest to his saints :

And the sons of Tola  ; Uzzi , and Rephaiah , and Jeriel , and Jahmai , and Jibsam , and Shemuel , heads of their father s house , to wit , of Tola : they were valiant men of might in their generations  ; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred .
translation.kha: U Tola u don hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Ussi , u Rephaïah , u Jeriel , u Jahmai , u Ibsam , bad u Shemuel . Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing kiba na ka kur Tola , bad ki dei ruh ki shipai bapawnam . Ha ka por u syiem Dabid , ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki don arphew ar hajar hynriewspah ngut .
Uta u shakri u ni kumba la hukum ïa u , bad u leit ïalam ïa kita shi para sha ka ïing u Joseph .
translation.en: And the man did as Joseph bade  ; and the man brought the men into Joseph s house .
And he made the candlestick of pure gold : of beaten work made he the candlestick  ; his shaft , and his branch , his bowls , his knops , and his flowers , were of the same :
translation.kha: U shna ïa u diengpynïeng sharak uba da ka ksiar nylla . U shna ïa ka trai bad ïa ka ktang    jong u diengpynïeng sharak da ka ksiar ba la shu shoh . Ki syntiew ba la oh-shrong jong u , kiba kynthup ïa ki shata bad ki sla jong ki , ki ïasoh lang kawei bad u .
Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la pynkhiah ïa kiba bun ki briew na ki jingshitom jong ki , ki jingpang jong ki , bad na ki mynsiem bymkhuid , bad u la ai ka jingïohi pat ha kiba bun ki briew kiba bamatlah .
translation.en: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues , and of evil spirits  ; and unto many that were blind he gave sight .

translation.kha: Ka khun u lyngdoh kaba shongdor bad u bym dei na ka longïing lyngdoh kdew lah ïa-ban bam ïa kita ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang .
translation.en: If the priest s daughter also be married unto a stranger , she may not eat of an offering of the holy things .

translation.kha: U Pharaoh un sa tharai ba ki Jerusalem’ ki la kjat sakma malu ba ki la shah khan kut ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel , They are entangled in the land , the wilderness hath shut them in .
And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali , and out of Asher , and out of all Manasseh , and pursued after the Midianites .
translation.kha: Nangta la khot ïa ki rangbah na ki jait Naphtali , Asher , bad na ka jait Manasseh baroh ar bynta , ki beh kthong ïa ki Midian .

Gera ngan ym shim na u ïa ka hima baroh kawei , pynbna ngan ai ha u ïa kawei ka jait na ka beit u Dabid u shakri jong sa mala na ka pyntwa ka Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kambah na la pynlong ka jong nga .
translation.en: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom  ; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant s sake , and for Jerusalem s sake which I have chosen .

translation.kha: Hynrei ba phim ngeit ïa kaei kaba u la thoh , kumno phiah lah ban ngeit ïa kaei kaba por ong ?
translation.en: But if ye believe not his writings , how shall ye believe my words ?

translation.kha: Ka jingieit jong nga kan long lem bad phi baroh ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus . Amen .

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei jong phi un leit ryngkat bad phira bad un ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop .’
translation.en: For the  Lord  your God is he that goeth with you , to fight for you against your enemies , to save you .

translation.kha: Kaba bud ka lama , lada uno uno uba bam ïa u kpu lane dih na ka khuri jong U Trai ha ka rukom kaba pyndonburom ïa U , ma u ne ma ka ki long kiba la pynrem ha ka pah pyrshah ïa ka met bad ïa ka snam jong U Trai .
translation.en: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread , and drink this cup of the Lord , unworthily , shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord .

translation.kha: bad ki la kylli ïa u , Me don hok aïu ba me leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa kane ka hok ?
translation.en: And say unto him , By what authority doest thou these things ? and who gave thee this authority to do these things ?

translation.kha: Ko kyntur , batylli pha ïam ? ki la ïakylli ïa ka . Ka la jubab , Ki la rah noh ïa U Trai jong nga , malu ngam tip shano ki la thuh ïa u !
translation.en: And they say unto her , Woman , why weepest thou ? She saith unto them , Because they have taken away my Lord , and I know not where they have laid him .

And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle , as if it were of a garden : he hath destroyed his places of the assembly : the  Lord  hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion , and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest .
translation.kha: Ka burom ba-itynnat tam jong ka Jerusalem ka long ka bynta jong ka mynnor . Ki nongïalam jong ka ki long kum ki skei kiba tlot na ka jingthngan , kaba ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki , ka la jan duh noh katba ki phet na ki nongbeh mrad .
Bad baneh ïaroh bad pyndonnam ïa U Trai men ka step bad man ka jingïateh ,
translation.en: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the  Lord  , and likewise at even  ;

translation.kha: Ki riat kiba I pynbudnam ha ka jingïaleh jong Ngi kam long ki atiar jong ka pyrthei hynrei ki atiar kiba donbor jong U Blei , ïa babha ngi pyndonkam ban pynpaw ïa ki kut baskhem .
translation.en: For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal , but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki la pyrta biang , Sahnarphna ïa u ! Sahnarphna ïa u !
translation.en: But they cried , saying , Crucify him , crucify him .

And it came to pass , when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness , ( for the mountain did burn with fire , ) that ye came near unto me , even all the heads of your tribes , and your elders  ;
translation.kha: Katba uta u lum baroh uwei u dang mehding bad phi ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba wan napdeng ka jingdum , ki nongïalam bad ki tymmen ki san na ki jait jong phi ki ïawan sha nga
Nangta phi borbah phna jubab , ‘ ngi la ïabam bad ïadih bad me ; me la hikai ha ka shnong jong ngi !’
translation.en: Then shall ye begin to say , We have eaten and drunk in thy presence , and thou hast taught in our streets .

translation.kha: Ki la shah tynjuh palat da ki jingjynjar kiba ki la ïada lyngba ; hynrei ka jingkmen jong ki ka la un-long kaba khraw haduh katta katta ba ki la un-long kiba sbun shait eh ha ka jingai jrong ki , wat la ki long kiba duk shisha .
translation.en: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality .

translation.kha: Kine baher ki long ki khun ki kyrsiew jong u Asher . Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïng , ki riewïaleh babniah , ki nongïalam kiba pawnam . Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Asher ki kynthup ïa ki arphew hynriew hajar nongput ki rangbah kiba bit na ka bna ka kam shiphang .
translation.en: All these were the children of Asher , heads of their father s house , choice and mighty men of valour , chief of the princes . And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men .
Therefore will he give them up , until the time that she which travaileth hath brought forth : then the remnant of his brethren shall return unto the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta , U  Trai  un sa aiti noh ïa la ki briew sha ki nongshun jong ki haduh ba ka briew ka ban sa kha kan ïoh ïa u khun jong ka . Nangta kito ki paid Israel kiba dang don ha ka jingshah ringmraw kin wan ïasoh lang bad ki briew la jong .
