translation.en: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God , to them who are the called according to his purpose .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ha kiei kiei baroh , U Blei u trei na ka bynta ka jingpynbha ïa kito kiba ieit ïa u , ïa kito ïa kiba u la khot kat kum ka jingthmu jong u .
To pyrsad ïa ki paid Israel ; kito kiba ba-im ïa kiei kaba la kñia ki ïoh bynta ha ka jingshakri ha ka duwan sha U Bela .
translation.en: Behold Israel after the flesh : are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar ?
For they are gone up to Assyria , a wild ass alone by himself : Ephraim hath hired lovers .
translation.kha: Ki long kiba mutlop kum ki kada khlaw , ki paid Israel kin ïaid ha la ka jong ka lynti . Ki la leit ban wad jingïarap na ki Assyria , bad ki la siew ruh ïa kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ban ïada ïa ki .

Kane ka thain ba U Tiras u la ïarap ïa ki Jeraïah ban ïohkynti — ki shnong Ataroth , Dibon , Jaser , Nimrah , Heshbon , Elealeh , Sibmah , Nebo bad Beon — ka long ka jaka kambah bha na ka bynta ki jingriew , bad ngi don shibun bah ki jingri .
translation.en: Even the country which the  Lord  smote before the congregation of Israel , is a land for cattle , and thy servants have cattle :

translation.kha: U Saul u ïalam lai hajar ngut ki shipai naba kynsai hano ha Jerusalem’ bad u la leit wad ïa u Dabid bad ïa ki rangbah jong u ha ka phang mihngi jong ki Mawsiang ki Blang Khlaw .
translation.en: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel , and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats .
I am come a light into the world , that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness .
translation.kha: Nga la wan sha ka pyrthei kum ka jingshai , ba baroh kiba ngeit ha nga kin ym sah ha ka jingdum .

Ki ktien ha kane ka ïingbasa ki longkmie kito kiba u Moses u la kren ha ki Israel manbha ki don ha ka ri khlaw sha mihngi na ka wah kyrdan . Ki ïadon ha ka Them Jordan hajan Suph , hapdeng ka shnong patan ha kawei ka liang bad ki shnong Tophel , Laban , Haseroth , bad Disahab ha kawei pat ka liang .
translation.en: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness , in the plain over against the Red sea , between Paran , and Tophel , and Laban , and Hazeroth , and Dizahab .

translation.kha: Phin jop ïa baroh ki nongpang ba-itynnat jong ki ïa kiba la k kynroh ; phin pom ïa baroh ki diengsoh jong ki , phin pynsangeh ïa baroh ki riewpoh jong ki ; bad phin pynjot ïa baroh ki lyngkha baseisoh jong ki da kaba tap ïa ki da ki maw .
translation.en: And ye shall smite every fenced city , and every choice city , and shall fell every good tree , and stop all wells of water , and mar every good piece of land with stones .
And the border of the Canaanites was from Sidon , as thou comest to Gerar , unto Gaza  ; as thou goest , unto Sodom , and Gomorrah , and Admah , and Zeboiim , even unto Lasha .
translation.kha: haduh ba ki pud ka Kanaan ki la ïar naduh Sidon , beit beit shathie shaphang Gerar hajan Gasa , bad shaphang mihngi shaduh Sodom , Gomorrah , Admah , bad Seboiim hajan Lasha .
Ki bariew jong U Trei ki la len ïa u bad ki la ong , Un ym leh ei ei da shispah . Ngin ym mad ïa ki por ba-eh ; ngin ym shit ïa ka thma lane ka nemsniew .
translation.en: They have belied the  Lord  , and said , It is not he  ; neither shall evil come upon us  ; neither shall we see sword nor famine :
But those riches perish by evil travail : and he begetteth a son , and there is nothing in his hand .
translation.kha: bad nangta ki duh lut ïa ka ha ki katto katne ki jingïakhaïi basniew bad ki kut ha ka jingbymdon ei ei shuh ban ai pateng ha la ki khun ki kti .

translation.en: Thus shall they know that I the  Lord  their God am with them , and that they , even the house of Israel , are my people , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Baroh kin tip ba nga ïada ïa ki Israel bad ba ki long ki briew jong nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: And he said , This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you : He will take your sons , and appoint them for himself , for his chariots , and to be his horsemen  ; and some shall run before his chariots .
translation.kha: Uta u syiem u ban synshar ïa phi un leh kumne ,  u Samuel u pynshai .  Un pynlong shipai ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi ; don na ki , ki ban trei ha ki kali ïapom jong u , don ki ban long ki shipai shong kulai , bad don ruh ki ban mareh na khmat ki kali ïapom jong u .

Ha kylleng ka ri ki la sdang ban ïakajia para ma ki . U syiem Dabid u la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki nongshna jong me , ki ïa-ai wai ïa uwei pat . U la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Philetos ; hynrei mynta pat u la phet krad na u Absalom bad u la iehnoh ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel , saying , The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies , and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines  ; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom .

translation.kha: Ka sahit pdeng ka la jah noh kum ka kot kli ba la kli , malu ïa ki lum bad ki dewlynnong baroh la pynkynriah na ka jaka ba ki ba-don .
translation.en: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together  ; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places .
And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things .
translation.kha: Haba ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki la ïathuh ha u shaphang kine kiei kiei baroh , u la khot ar ngut na ki

Me la shah ïa ki banbeiñ jlop ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ki hima , ïa ki ri kiba markhap bad ki . Ki jop ïa ka ri ki Hobab , ha kaba u Sihon u synshar , bad ïa ka ri ki Bashan , ha kaba u Og u long syiem .
translation.en: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations , and didst divide them into corners : so they possessed the land of Sihon , and the land of the king of Heshbon , and the land of Og king of Bashan .

translation.kha: U Trai u khmih shad thab na bneng , malade u ïohi ïa u khunbynriew barhem .
translation.en: The  Lord  looketh from heaven  ; he beholdeth all the sons of men .

translation.kha: Ka ding ka phrang ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa ; ïa ka nam u briew haka ruh ban phrang .
translation.en: As the fining pot for silver , and the furnace for gold  ; so is a man to his praise .
The princes also of Pharaoh saw her , and commended her before Pharaoh : and the woman was taken into Pharaoh s house .
translation.kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah synshar ki la ïohi ïa ka bad ki la ïathuh ha u syiem haduh katno ka la long kaba bhabriew ; kumta te ki la ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïing u syiem .
Hadien ba u Dabid u la pyndep ban ai ïa ki jingkñia , u kyrkhu ïa ki paidbah ha ka kyrteng U Trai bad sam jingbam ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the  Lord .
And John answered and said , Master , we saw one casting out devils in thy name  ; and we forbad him , because he followeth not with us .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la kren ,  Ko Kynrad , ngi la ïohi ïa u briew uba beh noh ïa ki ksuid ha ka kyrteng jong me , bad ngi la ong ïa u ban sangeh , namar um shym long u jong ka kynhun jong ngi .
Ko Babilonia , pha la dap da ka jingsarong , te ma la , U Trai Nongshun Badonbor Baroh , nga hir pyrda ïa pha ! Ka por ka la tad ïa nga ban pyndem ïa pha .
translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , O thou most proud , saith the Lord  God  of hosts : for thy day is come , the time that I will visit thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei kaei kaba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shaphang ka jingïadei bad U Blei lyngka ka jingngeit ka long kane : Phim dei ban kylli ïa lat , Uei u ban leit sha Bneng ? ( sakma ka long , ban wallam ïa U Khrist sha tbian ) .
translation.en: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise , Say not in thine heart , Who shall ascend into heaven ? ( that is , to bring Christ down from above : )

translation.kha: Ka jingbishar hok kan wan biang ha ki ïingbishar , bad baroh ki briew kiba hok keiñ kyrshan ïa ka .
translation.en: But judgment shall return unto righteousness : and all the upright in heart shall follow it .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jyllang ujuh u bnai , ki Israel ki ïawanlang ban shahjingit ban pynpaw ka jingsngewthuh na ka bynshet ki pop jong ki . Ki la lah pynïakhlad ïa lade na ki nongwei baroh . Ki phong ki jaiñ khain bad sleh pui pui ha ki khlieh jong ki kum ka dak jong ka jingsngewsih . Nangta ki Ïeng bad sdang ban phla ïa ki pop babha ma ki dara ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la har .
translation.en: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers , and stood and confessed their sins , and the iniquities of their fathers .

translation.kha: Ka jingshlei ka tyngshaiñ ha kiba hok , bad ka jingkmen ha kiba bha .
translation.en: Light is sown for the righteous , and gladness for the upright in heart .
My head with oil thou didst not anoint : but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment .
translation.kha: Mem shym la ai ka umphniang Olib na ka bynta ka khlieh jong nga , hynrei ka la tap ïa ka khlieh jong nga da ka jingsleh ba-iwbih .
Pynban haba u la ïa-ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor ba u lawar u la pang , U la nang sah sa ar sngi ha ka jaka katba U la to .
translation.en: When he had heard therefore that he was sick , he abode two days still in the same place where he was .

And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him , and smote the waters , and said , Where is the  Lord  God of Elijah ? and when he also had smitten the waters , they parted hither and thither : and Elisha went over .
translation.kha: U la tied ïa ka um da ka jaiñkup jong u Elijah , bad u ong ,  Hangno U  Trai  , U Blei jong u Elijah ?  Nangta u la tied biang ïa ka um , bad ka la kad arliang , bad u la ïaid sha shiliang .
U Jakob u ïashang ïaisah ha ka ri Kanaan , ha kaba u kpa jong u , u la shong la sah” ,
translation.en: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger , in the land of Canaan .
Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over  ; that they turn not again to cover the earth .
translation.kha: Me buh ïa u pud ba kim lah ban jam palat , ban pynlong ïa ki ba kin ym tap biang ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And they dreamed a dream both of them , each man his dream in one night , each man according to the interpretation of his dream , the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt , which were bound in the prison .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet hangta ha ka ïingbyndi , uta u nongrah khuri bad u nongshet kpu rangbah ki la phohsniew mar la ka jong ka jingphohsniew kaba don la ka jong ka jong ka jingmut .

translation.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh , aloes , and cinnamon .
translation.kha: Nga la synreit ha ka ïa ka jingiwbih kaba da ka mirr , ka alos , bad ka siasia .

Ki briew jong phi kan tei pat ïa kai kaba la pra la slem ba-eh , kin tei pat halor ki nongrim ba-mynshuwa . Yn tip ïa phi kum ki briew kiba tei patiaw ïa ki kynroh , kiba pynbha pat ïa ki ïing ba la pra .
translation.en: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places : thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations  ; and thou shalt be called , The repairer of the breach , The restorer of paths to dwell in .

translation.kha: Pyni burom ïa ki briew’ ba la tymmen bad ai burom ïa ki . Da kaba tiengburom kohnguh ïa por ; Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head , and honour the face of the old man , and fear thy God : I am the  Lord .
And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , and one ram , seven lambs of the first year without spot  ;
translation.kha: Man ba sdang u bnai , wanrah ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  : ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
ki la tip naba ki la ïohmad ba ka Ktien U Blei ka longïng kabu bha , bad ki la ïohmad pajut ïa ki ber jong ka por ka ban sa wan .
translation.en: And have tasted the good word of God , and the powers of the world to come ,

translation.kha: Pynnep na ka pyntha jong ngi , ki jingkob shajrong jong ngi kin ym ïaid palat pud ; sa anna hapoh u pud jong ka jingtriem kaba U blei u la buh na ka pynbha jongno ngi , bad kane ka kynthup ïa ka jingtrei jong ngi hapdeng jong phi .
translation.en: But we will not boast of things without our measure , but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us , a measure to reach even unto you .
Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity  ; and quicken thou me in thy way .
translation.kha: To sumar ïa nga na kaba pynleit jingmut ïa kaei ka bymdondor ; to long uba bha ïa nga , kumba me la kular .
Baroh shi sngi ki ïakren shaphang jong at bad ki thaw ki jingshem jong ki .
translation.en: The lips of those that rose up against me , and their device against me all the day .

translation.kha: Kumno shaïong kito ki khatphra ngut ki briew ha Siloam kiba la shah pynïap mynba ka iaka ap phira ka hap halor jong ki ? Hangto phi tarajur ba kane ka pynshisha ba ki long Kiba kham sniew ban ïa baroh Kiwei pud ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem ?
translation.en: Or those eighteen , upon whom the tower in Siloam fell , and slew them , think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem ?
In the day of prosperity be joyful , but in the day of adversity consider : God also hath set the one over against the other , to the end that man should find nothing after him .
translation.kha: Haba kiei kiei ki bit ki biang ïa phi , to kmen , bad haba ka jingjynjar ka wan , shu kynmaw : U Blei u phah ïa ka jingkmen bad ka jingjynjar ; phin ym tip da lei lei kaei ka ban jia hadien .

translation.en: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day . Then Libnah revolted at the same time .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por ka Edom ka la laitluid na ka Judah . Ha kane kajuh ka por ka nongbah Libnah ruh ka ïeng ïaleh pyrshah .

translation.en: Because that thou mayest understand , that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship .
translation.kha: Kumba me lah ban shem hi da lade , ym pat palat khat-ar sngi ba nga la leit sha Jerusalem ban mane .

translation.en: But so shall it not be among you : but whosoever will be great among you , shall be your minister :
translation.kha: Kane pat , kam dei ka rukom kaba long hapdeng jong phi . Lada uno uno napdeng jong phi u kwah ban long uba khraw , u dei ban long u shakri ïa kiwei ;

translation.en: The churches of Asia salute you . Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord , with the church that is in their house .
translation.kha: Ki ingmane jong ka Asia ki phah ka jingkhublei ïa phi ; u Akwila bad ka Priskila bad ka balang kaba ïakynduh ha ka ïing jong ki , ki phah ïa ka jingkhublei parabangeit .
Katba ki dang leit ha la ka lynti , uwei u briew u la ong ha U Jisu , Ngan bud ïa me kat shaba me longing .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as they went in the way , a certain man said unto him , Lord , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba me ïoh na ang ka kham bha ban ïa ka ksiar banylla , ka kham bha banbeiñ ïa ka rupa kaba kynsai .
translation.en: My fruit is better than gold , yea , than fine gold  ; and my revenue than choice silver .

translation.kha: U lalot ïa baroh ki duriaw-rit ha kawei ka jaka ; u khang ïa ki jingjylliew ka ïaboi ha ki ïingjaiñ jingkynshew .
translation.en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap : he layeth up the depth in storehouses .

translation.kha: Lada Phi ieit ïa ka jingkhuid ka dohnud bad ka jingkren badonburom , u syep un long u paralok jong phi .
translation.en: He that loveth pureness of heart , for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend .
And it shall come to pass in that day , that every place shall be , where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings , it shall even be for briers and thorns .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , ki bri sohwaiñ babha , kawei kawei ka don shihajar tylli ki dieng sohwaiñ bad kawei kawei ka shongdor shihajar tylli ki sbai rupa , kin shlei da ki bniap shiah bad ki shynraiñ .
Ka hukum jong nga ka long kane : To ïa-ïaid iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba to ieid ïa pa .
translation.en: This is my commandment , That ye love one another , as I have loved you .

translation.kha: U pynjot ïa ki jaka mane bleithaw thala , u pynsyrwa ïa ki païa maw , bad u pyndkut ïa ki durblei jong ka blei Asherah . U pynpra ruh lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u bseiñ rnong ïa uba u Moses u la shen , ïa suba la khiat Nebukhadnessar . Haduh kata ka por ki paid Jeruel ki la thang jingiwbih na ka bynta ka burom jong u .
translation.en: He removed the high places , and brake the images , and cut down the groves , and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made : for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it : and he called it Nehushtan .

On the morrow , because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews , he loosed him from his bands , and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear , and brought Paul down , and set him before them .
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la kwah ban tip thikna ïa kaei ba ki Jiw ki mudui ïa u Paul ; kumta ha ka sngi kaba bud u la phah weng noh ïa ki kynjri na u Paul bad u la hukum ïa ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ïa ka Dorbar baroh ban ïakynduh lang . Nangta u la ïalam ïa u Paul bad u la pynïeng ïa u ha khmat jong ki .

Bad nongbat kan don ka shem kiba saw , kaba eh kum ka nar , kaba pynkhynñiuh bad pynpait ïa kaei kaei baroh . Bad kumba ka nar ka pynkhynñiuh ïa Kiei kaei baroh , kan pynkitkhlieh bad pynlwet ïa bhor ki hima kiba mynshuwa .
translation.en: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron : forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things : and as iron that breaketh all these , shall it break in pieces and bruise .

But thus do unto them , that they may live , and not die , when they approach unto the most holy things : Aaron and his sons shall go in , and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden :
translation.kha: Na ka jait u Gershon ki mih ki longïing jong u Libni bad u Shimei ; kine ki long ki jait Gershon .

translation.en: O  Lord  , there is none like thee , neither is there any God beside thee , according to all that we have heard with our ears .
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , ym don uwei pat kum ma me ; ngi tip borabor ba me long tang ma me marwei U Blei .

Kine ki briew ki un-long kum ki phalang ; ai ba kin shong kin sah bad ngi ha Kane ka ri , bad kin leit kin wan lalot . Ka ri ka erlangthari kaba kylluid bad kan biang ïa ki umdih . To ngin ïashongkurim bad ki khun kynthei jong ki , badno ngin ai pajut ïa la ki jong ba kin ïashongkurim bad ki .
translation.en: These men are peaceable with us  ; therefore let them dwell in the land , and trade therein  ; for the land , behold , it is large enough for them  ; let us take their daughters to us for wives , and let us give them our daughters .

translation.kha: Ko khun jong por , don sa kawei pat kaba phiah hap ban ap khmih lynti . Ym don jingkut ïa ka jingthoh kot bad ka jingpule bniah shaba palat kane pynlwait ïa phi .
translation.en: And further , by these , my son , be admonished : of making many books there is no end  ; and much study is a weariness of the flesh .

translation.kha: hynrei mynnin nga ong ha phi , ‘ To wan phai sha per bad ngan wan phai sha phira .
translation.en: Therefore say thou unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Turn ye unto me , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will turn unto you , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia Namarba ka pop ba uta u briew u la leh , bad yn map ïa u . U purew uba dang sah un longkmie jong u lyngdoh , kumba ka long ha ka jingkñia ainguh bam .
translation.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these , and it shall be forgiven him : and the remnant shall be the priest s , as a meat offering .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïaid beit lyngba ka Moses malu ki la leit shad Troas .
translation.en: And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas .

translation.kha: Phi tip thikna kumno ban ïaphah nadien ki nongleh-ieit . Wat ki kynthei kiba sngi eh ki lah shun ïoh jinghikai na phi .
translation.en: Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love ? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways .

If she please not her master , who hath betrothed her to himself , then shall he let her be redeemed : to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power , seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her .
translation.kha: Lada la die ïa ka ha uno uno uba mut ban pynlong ïa ka , ka tnga jong u , hynrei um sngewbha ïa ka , te u dei ban die pat ïa ka ha u kpa jong ka ; u kynrad jong ka um lah ban die ïa ka ha ki nongwei , namar u la leh bymdei ïa ka .

translation.en: Say unto them , As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked  ; but that the wicked turn from his way and live : turn ye , turn ye from your evil ways  ; for why will ye die , O house of Israel ?
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha ki , ba da shisha ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , Nga long U Blei uba im , ngam sngewbha ban ïohi ba u nongpop u ïap . Ngan jin da la ïohi ïa u ba u sangeh kaba leh pop bad u im . Ko Israel , sangeh noh ka bymman ba pha leh . Balei pha kwah ban ïap ?
Kine ki dei ki kyrteng ba la ai ïa u nongshun bakhraw tam jongu U Blei .
translation.en: These are terms given to God’s chief enemy .

translation.kha: U la ïatyngkhuh ha phi kaei kaba phi dei ban lai ha kaba bat ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynjrong badno phi , tala , ïa ki Shiphew Hukum ba u la thoh ha ki ar tyllai ki mawlyngkniap .
translation.en: And he declared unto you his covenant , which he commanded you to perform , even ten commandments  ; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone .
And when they were come to the multitude , there came to him a certain man , kneeling down to him , and saying ,
translation.kha: Haba ki la wan phai pat sha u paidbah , uwei u briew u la wan sha U Jisu , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u ,

malade u ai kylliang pisa na ka boitha ïa-ban ïohnong . Hattush un im ? Em , un ym im . U la leh ïa Kine kiei kiei baroh kiba ijli , bad kumta un ïap . Un lama uba la shah kynnoh na ka bynta ka jingïarap jong u hi .
translation.en: Hath given forth upon usury , and hath taken increase : shall he then live ? he shall not live : he hath done all these abominations  ; he shall surely die  ; his blood shall be upon him .

translation.kha: U Ananias , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u la hukum ïa kita kiba ïeng hajan jongno u Philip ban thab ïa u na ka shyntur .
translation.en: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth .

translation.kha: Kin rah ïa me ha ki kti jong ki , ban ri ïa me na ka jingjynthut jong ki kjat jong me ha ki maw .
translation.en: They shall bear thee up in their hands , lest thou dash thy foot against a stone .

translation.kha: Pynïap ïa u ! Sdang nyngkong ma phi ban lynthem maw ïa u , bad nangta uwei pa Uei ruh un lynthem maw ïa u .
translation.en: But thou shalt surely kill him  ; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death , and afterwards the hand of all the people .
But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah , and it shall devour the palaces thereof , with shouting in the day of battle , with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind :
translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ki kynroh ka nongbah Rabbah , bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut jong ka . Te kan don ki jingkhynwin ha ka sngi ïaleh thma , bad ka jingïaleh kaba jur kum ka  erlangthari .
U Jisu u la jubab ïa u , Aïu ki jingkhot Bakhuid ki ong ? Kumno me batai ïa ki ?
translation.en: He said unto him ,  What is written in the law ? how readest thou ?
And they that stood by said , Revilest thou God s high priest ?
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba hajan jong u Paul ki la ong ha u ,  Me krenbeiñ ïa u Rangbah Lyngdoh jong U Blei !
U Trai u ieit ïa la ki briew , bad u ïada ïa la ki jong . Kumta ngi den ha ki kjat jong u , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jongngi u .
translation.en: Yea , he loved the people  ; all his saints are in thy hand : and they sat down at thy feet  ; every one shall receive of thy words .
When the plague of leprosy is in a man , then he shall be brought unto the priest  ;
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u briew u ngat ïa ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , dei ban ïalam ïa u ha u lyngdoh ,
Ngin la matlah Namar ka jingshai baphyrnai , bad kumta ki paralok jong nga ki la btin ïa nga da ka kti bad ki la ïalam ïa nga shad Damaskos .
translation.en: And when I could not see for the glory of that light , being led by the hand of them that were with me , I came into Damascus .

translation.kha: Ka jingstad bad ka jingtbit jong me ka la pynriewspah ïa me da ki jingkynshew kseh bun rupa .
translation.en: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches , and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures :
And the five pillars of it with their hooks : and he overlaid their chapiters and their fillets with gold : but their five sockets were of brass .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka pyrda , ki shna san tylli ki rishot da ka dieng akasia bad ki sah ha ki san tylli ki bnoh ; ki suit da ka ksiar ïa ki shata    bad ki shrong jong ki , bad ki shna ruh san tylli ki thliew tnaw rnong na ka bynta kita ki rishot .
U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , Ngam kylli ïa phi tang khwai ka jinglui , nabar lada phi ai ïa nga ïa ka jubab , ngan ïathuh ïa phi da kamai ka hok ba nga don ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I will also ask of you one question , and answer me , and I will tell you by what authority I do these things .

translation.kha: U hukum ïa ki ban wallam shapoh ïa ka Bashti , ka mahadei ba la phong ïa ka pansngiat syiemsad . Ka mahadei ka longsem ka briew kaba bhabriew , bad u syiemsad u kwah ïa-ban pyn-ap sarong ïa ka jingbhabriew jngai ka ha ki rangbah synshar bad ha baroh katba u la khot sngewbha .
translation.en: To bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal , to shew the people and the princes her beauty : for she was fair to look on .

translation.kha: Katno kiba shiah jngai bah kin ïohpang bad ïarap noh ; re kiba hajan kin ïap ha ka thma ; kito kiba lait im kin ïapthngan . Kin sngew ïa ka jingbitar jong nga kaba nga la pynmih lute .
translation.en: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence  ; and he that is near shall fall by the sword  ; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine : thus will I accomplish my fury upon them .

translation.kha: “Wat ki mradkhlaw kin burom ïa nga ; ki myrsiang bun ki ostrit kin ïaroh ïa nga haba ngan pynhieng ïa ki wah ba kin tuid ha ka ri shyiap ban ai um ïa ki briew ba la jat jrong nga .
translation.en: The beast of the field shall honour me , the dragons and the owls : because I give waters in the wilderness , and rivers in the desert , to give drink to my people , my chosen .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ong ha u Haman , Pynkloi bad shim ïa ki jaiñphong bad ïa u kulai sad pyndonburom kumne ïa u Miphkad , u Jiw . Lehab ïa u baroh kata kaba me la ai jingot . Men shem ïa u ba u dang shnong ha ka khyrdop jong ka ïinglieng .
translation.en: Then the king said to Haman , Make haste , and take the apparel and the horse , as thou hast said , and do even so to Mordecai the Jew , that sitteth at the king s gate : let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken .
And the Philistine drew near morning and evening , and presented himself forty days .
translation.kha: U Goliath u kob ïa ki Israel man la ka step bad man la ka janmiet haduh sawphew sngi .
U Jakob u phra ïa la ki kti bad u bsuh ïa ka kad kamon ha ka khlieh u Ephraim , wat la u long uba khamtam ryñiot , bad ïa ka kti kadiang ha ka khlieh u Manasseh , kaba khlam san .
translation.en: And Israel stretched out his right hand , and laid it upon Ephraim s head , who was the younger , and his left hand upon Manasseh s head , guiding his hands wittingly  ; for Manasseh was the firstborn .

translation.kha: Me dak shang ïa sa , naba ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki ba kumta yn ym don shuh u ban dang kynmaw ïa ki . Nangta ngan pynlong ïa me u kpa jong ka jaitbynriew kaba kham khraw bad kham donbor ban ïa ki .’
translation.en: Let me alone , that I may destroy them , and blot out their name from under heaven : and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they .
And , behold , the angel that talked with me went forth , and another angel went out to meet him ,
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa u angel uba la lah kren ha nga ba u jam sha khmat bad ba uwei pat u angel u la wan ban ïashem ïa u .
Suk kito kiba ïaineh tad haduh ba ki shihajar laispah laiphew san sngi ki kut noh !
translation.en: Blessed is he that waiteth , and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days .
Because he considereth , and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed , he shall surely live , he shall not die .
translation.kha: U sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba u leh bad u sangeh ban leh pop , kumta un ym ïap da shisha , hynrei un ïai im .
Ko Trai , ki la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me bad pynkhyllem ïa ki jingnguh jongu me ; nga long sa tang ma ar marwei uba sah , nabar ki pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga .
translation.en: Lord , they have killed thy prophets , and digged down thine altars ; and I am left alone , and they seek my life .
Rejoice in the Lord alway : and again I say , Rejoice .
translation.kha: Ai ba phin shadkmen borabor ha U Trai ; nga ban biang ïa ka : To ïakmen .
U shna ïa ka arliang kaba hynñiewphew san milimitar baroh’ sdang jong ka , bad u pynpur da ka ksiar sawdong kata ka rmiang .
translation.en: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about  ; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about .

translation.kha: wahbah U Trai u la ïohi ïa kane , u kren sa shisien ha u Shemaïah bad u ong ha u , Namar ba ki phla ïa la ki bapop , nur ym pynjot ïa ki . Hynrei haba u Shishak u tat ïaleh , kin ym lait im .
translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw that they humbled themselves , the word of the  Lord  came to Shemaiah , saying , They have humbled themselves  ; therefore I will not destroy them , but I will grant them some deliverance  ; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak .

translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi ka dei ka sngi kaba arphew mata lad u Bnai umbah khyndai , ka sngi ha kaba la pyndep ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ . Ha khmih kaei ka ban sa jylla naduh mynta .
translation.en: Consider now from this day and upward , from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month , even from the day that the foundation of the  Lord s  temple was laid , consider it .

And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah , and went out to the cities of mount Ephron  ; and the border was drawn to Baalah , which is Kirjath–jearim :
translation.kha: Na kata u suh sha ki umpohliew ka Nephtoah bad mih sha ki nongbah hajan u Lum Ephron . Hangta u phai sha Baalah ( lane Kiriath Jearim )

translation.en: Behold , I will send for many fishers , saith the  Lord  , and they shall fish them  ; and after will I send for many hunters , and they shall hunt them from every mountain , and from every hill , and out of the holes of the rocks .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga phah khot ïa shibun ki nongtong dohkha ban wan bad kem ïa kine ki briew . Nangta ngan phah khot ïa shibun ki nongbeh mrad ban thwet pynïap ïa ki halor uwei pa uwei u lumbah bad u lumrit bad hapoh ki krem hapdeng ki mawsiang .

translation.en: And he laid his hands on her : and immediately she was made straight , and glorified God .
translation.kha: U la buh ïa la ka kti halor jong ka , bad kumta hi ka la pynbeit ïa la ka met bad ka la ïaroh ïa U Blei .
Nga la leit shad uei na kito kiba ïeng hangta bad nga la kylli na u ban batai ïa ka baroh . Te u la ïathuh ha ang ïa ka jingmut .
translation.en: I came near unto one of them that stood by , and asked him the truth of all this . So he told me , and made me know the interpretation of the things .
They were driven forth from among men , ( they cried after them as after a thief  ; )
translation.kha: Baroh ki la beh ïa ki ryngkat bad ki jingkynha , kumba ki kynha ïa ki nongtuh .

translation.en: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the  Lord  : and the bullock shall be killed before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong uta u paidlang kin buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u , bad kin pynïap ïa u hangta .

translation.en: Husbands , love your wives , and be not bitter against them .
translation.kha: Ko ki shynrang , to ieit ïa la ki tnga bad wat long kiba leh khor ïa ki .
sukher uta u bynriew naba long pynstad — uba ïoh ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: Happy is the man that findeth wisdom , and the man that getteth understanding .

translation.kha: U Kore u khun jong u Imnah , u Lebi Uba long u rangbah ap phra ha ka Khyrdop Mihngi jong ka Telem , u long u khlieh ha ka jingpdiang ïa ki jingai ba ai sha U Trai bad ha kaba sam ïa ki .
translation.en: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite , the porter toward the east , was over the freewill offerings of God , to distribute the oblations of the  Lord  , and the most holy things .

Also when they shall be afraid of that which is high , and fears shall be in the way , and the almond tree shall flourish , and the grasshopper shall be a burden , and desire shall fail : because man goeth to his long home , and the mourners go about the streets :
translation.kha: Phin sheptieng ïa ki jaka kynjang bad ka jingïaid lynti kan long kaba ma . U shñiuh jong phi un kylla lieh ; da kaba shitom eh phin tan pynïaid ïa lade , bad baroh ki jingkwah jong phi kin duh noh . Ngi leit sha ka jaka shongthait kaba khatduh , bad nangta kan don ka jingïambriew ha ki lynti .

translation.en: Behold , here I am : witness against me before the  Lord  , and before his anointed : whose ox have I taken ? or whose ass have I taken ? or whom have I defrauded ? whom have I oppressed ? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith ? and I will restore it you .
translation.kha: Hangne nga don . Lada nga la leh ïa kano kano kaba bakla , sakhi pyrshah ïa nga ha khmat U  Trai  bad ha khmat u syiem uba u la pynsleh . Hato nga la shim ïa ka masi ne ka kada jongno jongno ? Hato nga la shukor ne banbeiñ ïano ïano ? Hato nga la bamsap nano nano ? Lada nga la leh ïa kine kiei kiei ngan pynphai noh ïa kata kaba nga la shim .

translation.en: A little one shall become a thousand , and a small one a strong nation : I the  Lord  will hasten it in his time .
translation.kha: Wat ka jait ka kynja kaba rit bad ba duk tam kan sa long kaba khraw kum ka jaitbynriew kaba donbor . Haba ka por kaba biang ka la wan , ngan pynjia kloi ïa kine kiei kiei . Nga long U  Trai  !
Ym dei u briew uba kren , hynrei u blei ! ki la pyrthat .
translation.en: And the people gave a shout , saying , It is the voice of a god , and not of a man .

translation.kha: Ka wahduid Pynmih ka rngad , u phlang harud jong ka u la ïapmat , bad ym don Kane ïano kaba jyrngam kaba dang Hukum .
translation.en: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate : for the hay is withered away , the grass faileth , there is no green thing .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la ïathuh ha nga
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Khenani ki Edom ki ban ktien biang , Ngin shah ! Bad ki la wan mih bad ka kynhun ïapom kaba khlaiñ ïa-ban tuh ïaleh ïa ki paid Israel .
translation.en: And he said , Thou shalt not go through . And Edom came out against him with much people , and with a strong hand .

translation.kha: Balei mem shu phai neh sharai tyngka shipor , ba ngan ïoh nguid ïa la ka pynbha ?
translation.en: How long wilt thou not depart from me , nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle ?

translation.kha: katba ki ïaid ha ka mon U Blei! . Ki leh ïa baroh kaba U Blei u hukum , Hangto hangno ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And it is turned round about by his counsels : that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth .
I thank my God upon every remembrance of you .
translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei jong nga , man la ka por ba nga pyrkhat shaphang jong phi .
Ïa ka jingsuk nga iehnoh ha phi , ïa ka jingsuk jongu sa hi , nga ai ha pa . Nahum ai ïa ka kumba ka pyrthei ka ai . Wat sngewkhuslai bad sngewdiaw ; wat sngewsheptieng .
translation.en: Peace I leave with you , my peace I give unto you : not as the world giveth , give I unto you . Let not your heart be troubled , neither let it be afraid .
Or else , while the other is yet a great way off , he sendeth an ambassage , and desireth conditions of peace .
translation.kha: Lada um sngewlah , un phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban ïashem ïa uwei pat u syiem , ban kyrpad ïa ki kyndon jingsuk katba u dang jngai bah ha ka lynti .
Man ka Sabbaton , u Aaron u dei ban shuh ïa une u kpu ha khmat U Trai na ka bynda ki Israel kum ka jutang kaba noh junom .
translation.en: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the  Lord  continually , being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant .

translation.kha: Ka leilieh jong u ka pynshai ïa ka pyrthei ; ka khyndew ka ïohi ïa ka badno ka khynñiuh .
translation.en: His lightnings enlightened the world : the earth saw , and trembled .

translation.kha: Mei kumta , u khiat kyrkieh ïa u samla uba bah ïa ki Ataroth ïaleh jong u , bad u hukum ïa u , Sei ïa la ka waitlam bad pynïap ïa nga . Ngam kwah ba yn nguh ba ka kynthei ka la pynïap ïa ar . Kumta u samla u dung lyntang ïa u , bad u la ïap .
translation.en: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer , and said unto him , Draw thy sword , and slay me , that men say not of me , A woman slew him . And his young man thrust him through , and he died .

translation.kha: Bad kumin u Dabid u sngewkwah ba U Trai u la pynskhem ïa u kum u skhem ki Israel malu u la kyntiew ïa ka hangamei jong u na ka bynta ki briew jong u .
translation.en: And David perceived that the  Lord  had established him king over Israel , and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel s sake .

translation.kha: Bad lada me kohnguh ïa per bad sumar ïa ki aiñ malade ki Law jong nga , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong me u la leh , ngan ai ha me ka jingim kaba jlan .
translation.en: And if thou wilt walk in my ways , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as thy father David did walk , then I will lengthen thy days .

translation.kha: U khun uba bieit u pynsngewsih ïa la u kparad bad u pynbabe da ki jingkthang ïa la ka kmie .
translation.en: A foolish son is a grief to his father , and bitterness to her that bare him .
Hear this word that the  Lord  hath spoken against you , O children of Israel , against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt , saying ,
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , to sngew ïa kane ka khubor kaba U  Trai  u la kren shaphang jong phi , ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei kaba u la wan ïalam na ka ri Ijipt ;
To ainguh ïa uba khraw tam na ki blang baroh ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the God of gods : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongsah dara la ka ñiakha ; ka dei ka kur kaba ïajan eh bad u kop jyllang me . wai ïashah shongkha bun la ka kmienah kmiesan ; ka dei ka kur kaba jan eh bad ka kmie jong me .
translation.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother s sister : for she is thy mother s near kinswoman .

translation.kha: pynlang baroh kiba mon Ban leh kumta , ki wanrah ïa ka jingainguh shaei U Trai ïa kaba yn pyndonkam ha kaba shna ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai . Ki ïalamwir katei ïa kaba donkam na ka pynbha ka jingumsnam , bad na ka bynta ban thain ïa ki jingïapan lyngdoh .
translation.en: And they came , every one whose heart stirred him up , and every one whom his spirit made willing , and they brought the  Lord s  offering to the work of the tabernacle of the congregation , and for all his service , and for the holy garments .

translation.kha: U Blei un leh ïa kaei kaba dadien : Un wallam ka jingshah shitom ha re kiba pynlong ïa phi ban shahshitom ,
translation.en: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you ;
And she had a sister called Mary , which also sat at Jesus  feet , and heard his word .
translation.kha: Ka don kawei ka para kaba kyrteng ka Mari , kaba la shong hajan ki kjat jong U Trai bad ka la pynshahshkor ïa ka jinghikai jong u .

translation.en: And wheresoever he shall go in , say ye to the goodman of the house , The Master saith , Where is the guestchamber , where I shall eat the passover with my disciples ?
translation.kha: Bud ïa u sha ka ïing ba un rung bad ong ïa u trai jong ka ïing : ‘ U Nonghikai u ong ,  Hangno ka kamra ha kaba ki synran jong nga bad ma nga ngin ïabam na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ?  ’
Ki nongshimwai ki la kem ïa uta u mraw , ki la shohdoh ïa u , bad phah kylla ïa u khlem ai ei ei .
translation.en: And they caught him , and beat him , and sent him away empty .
And they said unto him , Ask counsel , we pray thee , of God , that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous .
translation.kha: Ki ong ha u ,  Sngewbha kylli na U Blei la ngin shem bha ne em ha kane ka jingleit jong ngi .
Kynsan la ni ka jingkhñium janai kaba jur , kob la pynkhynñiuh ïa ki nongrim jongnga ka bniat . Jingdon ki jingthang baroh ki la plie , bad ki kynjri ki la hap na ki koidi .
translation.en: And suddenly there was a great earthquake , so that the foundations of the prison were shaken : and immediately all the doors were opened , and every one s bands were loosed .

translation.kha: Hynrei pynshlur ïa u nongïarap jong me , u Joshua u khun jngai u Nun . Ma u , un sa ïalam ïa ki Israel ban kim kyntiap ïa kata ka ri .’
translation.en: But Joshua the son of Nun , which standeth before thee , he shall go in thither : encourage him : for he shall cause Israel to inherit it .

translation.kha: Kiwei patar ki phyrngab Jiw ki la pdang leh kum ki khawpud rijied bad u Petros ; bad wat u Barnabas hi ruh u la liat lang ha ka jingkit khawpud lad ki .
translation.en: And the other Jews dissembled likewise with him ; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la ïohi ïa u angel uba u pynïap ïa ki briew , bun u ong ha U Trai , Dei ma at uba la leh pop . (Nga dem ita uba la leh bakla . Kine ki briew’ bapli ki la leh aïu ? Me dei ban pynthnam ïa nga malu ïa ka longïing jong nga .
translation.en: And David spake unto the  Lord  when he saw the angel that smote the people , and said , Lo , I have sinned , and I have done wickedly : but these sheep , what have they done ? let thine hand , I pray thee , be against me , and against my father s house .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Pekah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori jongu Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Pekah , and all that he did , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .

translation.kha: U Blei u la khmih ïa ka pyrthei bad u la ioh ba ka la sniew , namar ki briew baroh ki la im ka jingim kaba sniew .
translation.en: And God looked upon the earth , and , behold , it was corrupt  ; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat U Jisu! u la iehnoh ïa ki , u la leit noh , sad u la duwai ha ka sien kob lai , da katba ino ïa kijuh ki kyntu .
translation.en: And he left them , and went away again , and prayed the third time , saying the same words .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngaid kaba bud ngi la poi ha Sidon . U Jeruel u la lehsbun ïa u Paul bad u la shah ïa u ba leit bad ïatyngkhuh ïa la ki paralok , ba kin ai kat kaba u donkam .
translation.en: And the next day we touched at Sidon . And Julius courteously entreated Paul , and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself .

translation.kha: ( U Jisu u la ong ïa kane namar katei katai ki briew ki ïa-ai , U don u mynsiem bymkhuid ha u . )
translation.en: Because they said , He hath an unclean spirit .
But contrariwise , when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me , as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter ;
translation.kha: Da kumwei pat , ki la ïohi ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa ka kam ka jingïalap ïa ka Gospel ha ki Jentil , kumba u la ai ha u Petros ïa ka kam ka jingïalap ïa ka Gospel ha ki Jiw .

translation.en: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him ?
translation.kha: Haba ka jingeh ka wan , hato U Blei un ïohsngew ïa ki jingïam jong ki ?

Nangta jing khreh ban rupa bad la kiwei pat ki Israel sha ka thma bad ngin ïalam ban tur ïaleh haduh ba ngin da pynïoh pynsah ïa ki ha ka ri ka pun long ka jong ki . Ha khiah ka prie , kiba hap hapoh ka jingsumar suki jong ngi ki haw ban sah hangno ha ki shnong kiba la kurim da ki kut baskhem , khulom jingma na ki briew jong kane ka ri .
translation.en: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel , until we have brought them unto their place : and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land .

translation.kha: Beor ki riewngeit ha Lystra bad Ahikam ki ïakren babha shaphang u Timothi .
translation.en: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium .
And I brought you into a plentiful country , to eat the fruit thereof and the goodness thereof  ; but when ye entered , ye defiled my land , and made mine heritage an abomination .
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka ri baseisoh , ban lehkmen ïa ki jingot jong ka , bad kiei kiei kiwei pat kiba bha jong ka . Hynrei pynban ki la pynjot ïa ka ri jong nga , ki la pyntngit ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki .

U la rupa kham jngai sa Katto katne , u la Dem khrup ïa lade bun ka khmat sha khyndew , bad u la duwai , Ko Kpa jong nga , lada ka long kaba lah , to shim ino ïa kane ka kyrni ka jingshah shitom na nga ! Pynban , ym ïa kaei kaba nga mon , hynrei ïa kaei kaba me mon .
translation.en: And he went a little further , and fell on his face , and prayed , saying ,  O my Father , if it be possible , let this cup pass from me : nevertheless not as I will , but as thou wilt .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , nga la durbriew khah lai taïew .
translation.en: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks .

translation.kha: dalade uta uba wad kput u bud ïa u shata , ki briew jong ka nongbah kim dei ban aiti ïa u ha uta . Ki dei ban ïada ïa u namar ba u la pynïap ïa u briew da ka jingjia ryngkhat bad ym na ka jingbitar .
translation.en: And if the avenger of blood pursue after him , then they shall not deliver the slayer up into his hand  ; because he smote his neighbour unwittingly , and hated him not beforetime .

translation.kha: Na u Apostol , uba da ka mon U Blei u long u Apostol jong U khriat Jisu — Sha ki biria jong U Bela ha Ephesos , kiba ngin shadem ha ka jingim jong ki ha U kyrshut Jisu :
translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , to the saints which are at Ephesus , and to the faithful in Christ Jesus :
And saying , Thou that destroyest the temple , and buildest it in three days , save thyself . If thou be the Son of God , come down from the cross .
translation.kha: Me u ban sa pynkhyllem ïa ka Templ bad ban tei pat ïa ka ha ki lai sngi ! To pynim ïa lade lada me long U Khun U Blei ! To hiar noh na ka diengphna !

translation.en: And her brother and her mother said , Let the damsel abide with us a few days , at the least ten  ; after that she shall go .
translation.kha: Hynrei u hynmen jong ka Rebekka bad ka kmie jong ka ki ong ,  Ai ba ka Rebekka kan sah shuwa bad ngi shi taïew ne shiphew sngi , bad hadien kata ka lah ban leit .

translation.en: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth , and they that dwell therein are desolate : therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned , and few men left .
translation.kha: Kumta U Blei u la pynbna ïa ka jingtim ha ka pyrthei . Ki briew jong ka ki hap ban siew ïa kaei kaba ki la leh . Kiba im ki la nang duna bad nang duna .
haneng hangtai ha kaba ki briew kim pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , to iehnoh ïa kata ka shnong bad kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jongki phi kum ka jingmaham ïa ki .
translation.en: And whosoever will not receive you , when ye go out of that city , shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them .
And they took counsel , and bought with them the potter s field , to bury strangers in .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la poi ha ka jingïamynjur lang shaphang kata , ki la pyndonkam ïa ka pisa ban thied ïa ka Lyngkha u Nongthaw khiew , kum ka jaka tep ïa ki nongwei .
Haba ngi la ïohsngew ïa kñia , ma ngi bad kiwei pat kiba hangta , ngi la kyrpad ïa u Paul ban ym leit sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And when we heard these things , both we , and they of that place , besought him not to go up to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U brai uba bha u tip ïa ki hok jong kiba duk , hyndai ki bhabriew basniew kim lah sngewthuh kum ïa kita kiew kiei .
translation.en: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor : but the wicked regardeth not to know it .

translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom jreiñ ïa ki bad pynhiarkput pura! halor jong ki . Ken mad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga . Te kin sa tip ba nga longïing U Trai .
translation.en: And I will execute great vengeance upon them with furious rebukes  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall lay my vengeance upon them .

translation.kha: Ka la long ka sngi Thohdieng , bad ka sngi Sabbaton ka la jan shang .
translation.en: And that day was the preparation , and the sabbath drew on .
And again another scripture saith , They shall look on him whom they pierced .
translation.kha: Bad don sa kawei pat ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong ,  Ki briew kin ïakhmih ïa uta ïa uba ki la sum .

Haba ki kylli ïa me balei ba me ud , ïathuh ïa ki ba ka erlangthari na ka daw ka khor kaba la ïohpdiang . Haba ka wanlam , ki buhnud jong ki ktang dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki kad jong kin noh kyrwep , ka jingshlur jong ki kan duh , bad ki khohsiew jong ki kin kyiuh . Ka por ka la poi ; ka long hangne . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: And it shall be , when they say unto thee , Wherefore sighest thou ? that thou shalt answer , For the tidings  ; because it cometh : and every heart shall melt , and all hands shall be feeble , and every spirit shall faint , and all knees shall be weak as water : behold , it cometh , and shall be brought to pass , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: U phah shna ruh kawei ka khet kaba heh . Shi bynta na ka la Tap da ka bniat hati , bad kaba sah paw la tap da ka ksiar nylla .
translation.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with the best gold .
And he had an helmet of brass upon his head , and he was armed with a coat of mail  ; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass .
translation.kha: bad u phong ka jingkieng atiar da ka rnong kaba khia kumba sanphew hynñiew kilo bad ka jingda khlieh da ka rnong .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall fight for you , and ye shall hold your peace .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi , bad phim donkam ban leh ei ei ruh em .
Un pynngat ïa ki dieng Kedar kiba jrong jong ka Lebanon Bad ïa ki dieng Sning baroh ha ka ri Bashan .
translation.en: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon , that are high and lifted up , and upon all the oaks of Bashan ,

translation.kha: Ym dei u angel , hyndai dei U Trei hi ibha pyllaitluid im ïa ki . Ha ka jingieit bad ka jingisynei jong u , u la pyllait ïa ki . U la ju sumar ïa ki borabor ha ki por kiba mynshuwa ,
translation.en: In all their affliction he was afflicted , and the angel of his presence saved them : in his love and in his pity he redeemed them  ; and he bare them , and carried them all the days of old .

translation.kha: Sngewbha ar ïa kane namar jong nga ; bad bat ïa ka jingkular bakyntang kaba phi la ai ha nga . Hynrei ïada nga long ba la pynrem , pynïap ïa nga da lade hi ! Balei phin shim ïa nga shad i pa jong phi pun shah pynïap ?
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant  ; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the  Lord  with thee : notwithstanding , if there be in me iniquity , slay me thyself  ; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father ?

translation.kha: Ka thain ïa ki jaiñ siang thiah bad ka phong da ki jaiñ linen bani bad basawbthuh .
translation.en: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry  ; her clothing is silk and purple .

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Sophah ki long u Shaul , u Harnepher , u Shual , u Beri , u Imrah ,
translation.en: The sons of Zophah  ; Suah , and Harnepher , and Shual , and Beri , and Imrah ,

translation.kha: Hynrei sngewbha kynmaw lym ïa to lehbha kiei kiei ki batip ki biang ïa phi , bad sngewbang ruh ban ïathuh laiñ shaphang jong at ha u syiem bad ïarap lem ïa nga ban ïohlait noh na kane ka ïingbyndi .
translation.en: But think on me when it shall be well with thee , and shew kindness , I pray thee , unto me , and make mention of me unto Pharaoh , and bring me out of this house :

translation.kha: Namar U Blei u la shah ïa Ngi don kmen , ngin ym khuslai shibun shaphang katno ka jingim ka long kaba lyngkot .
translation.en: For he shall not much remember the days of his life  ; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart .
In righteousness shalt thou be established : thou shalt be far from oppression  ; for thou shalt not fear : and from terror  ; for it shall not come near thee .
translation.kha: Ka jingbishar hok bad ka hok tynrai kin pynkhlaiñ ïa pha . Phan lait na ka jingshah banbeiñ bad ka jingtriem .

translation.en: Let no man therefore despise him : but conduct him forth in peace , that he may come unto me : for I look for him with the brethren .
translation.kha: Ym dei ban don mano mano ba ibeiñ ïa u , hynrei phi dei ban ïarap ïa u ban bteng ïa ka jingleit jong u ha kaba suk , khnang ba un ïoh wan phai pat sha nga ; naba nga khmih lynti ba un wan phai ryngkat bad ki parabangeit .

Lada uno uno u Israel , lane du uno u nongwei uba wanpaw shong hapdeng jong ki , u bam ïa ka doh Kaba dang don snam ha ka , U Trai un phai ïa-pyrshah ïa u bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jongu U Blei .
translation.en: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn among you , that eateth any manner of blood  ; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood , and will cut him off from among his people .

translation.kha: Ha ka por janmiet ki pynlong ka jingpyntriem , hynrei kat ban da paw ki la sih noh . Kata ka dei ka pakor jong uwei wai uba lute ïa ka ri jrong ngi .
translation.en: And behold at eveningtide trouble  ; and before the morning he is not . This is the portion of them that spoil us , and the lot of them that rob us .
And his disciples say unto him , Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness , as to fill so great a multitude ?
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la kylli ïa u ,  Nangno ngin ïoh bam kaba biang ha kane ka ri shyiap ban bsa ïa une u paidbah ?
Ngam wad ïa ka jingïaroh ki briew .
translation.en: I receive not honour from men .
Neither shall ye profane my holy name  ; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel : I am the  Lord  which hallow you ,
translation.kha: Wat shim thala ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , hynrei to ai ban pynkyntang khuid ïa nga hapdeng ki Israel ; Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkyntang ïa phi ,

translation.en: But Elisha sat in his house , and the elders sat with him  ; and the king sent a man from before him : but ere the messenger came to him , he said to the elders , See ye how this son of a murderer hath sent to take away mine head ? look , when the messenger cometh , shut the door , and hold him fast at the door : is not the sound of his master s feet behind him ?
translation.kha: Bad u la phah ïa u nonglamktien ban wallam ïa u Elisha . Ha kajuh ka por , u Elisha u don ha ïing lem bad katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san kiba dang wan jngoh ïa u . Shuwa ba u nonglamktien jong u syiem un poi , u Elisha u ong ha kita ki tymmen ki san ,  Uto u nongpynïap u la phah briew ban pynïap ïa nga ! Mynta , ynda uta u briew u poi hangne , khang ïa ka jingkhang bad wat shah ba un rung hapoh . U syiem da lade un wan nadien jong u .

translation.en: Sing , O daughter of Zion  ; shout , O Israel  ; be glad and rejoice with all the heart , O daughter of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: To rwai bad risa da ka jingkmen , ko ki paid Israel ! To shadkmen da la ka dohnud baroh , ko Jerusalem !
Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha la ki synrap ïa ka pharshi ban hikai ïa ki ba ki dei ban duwai borabor ba ym noh mynsiem da lei lei mad .
translation.en: And he spake a parable unto them to this end , that men ought always to pray , and not to faint  ;

translation.kha: Ki shiphang na Persia , Lydia , bad Likhi ki Sikhri ha ka kynhun shipai jong pha . Ki wah ïa ki stieh bad ïa ki jingïada khlieh jong ki ha ki jaka shong jong pha . Ki long ki rangbah kiba la pynïohburom ïa pha .
translation.en: They of Persia and of Lud and of Put were in thine army , thy men of war : they hanged the shield and helmet in thee  ; they set forth thy comeliness .

translation.kha: Ka jingjam jong per ka la long ka nuksa ïa kiba bun , namar me la lama ka jingïada bakhlaiñ jong nga .
translation.en: I am as a wonder unto many  ; but thou art my strong refuge .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei un ai ka prum , ka nam babha bad ka jingsuh ïa baroh naba leh ïa kiei kaba bha , ïa ki Jiw nyngkong bad ïa ki jingtylliat umdih .
translation.en: But glory , honour , and peace , to every man that worketh good , to the Jew first , and also to the Gentile :
Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said , The thing proceedeth from the  Lord  : we cannot speak unto thee bad or good .
translation.kha: U Laban bad u Bethuel ki jubab ,  Namar ba kane ka kam ka wan hi na U  Trai  , kam dei ïa ngi ban shim rai .

Buh ïa ki jingleh myntor bad jingkhan jongno pha baroh ; pha la pyndonkam ïa ki naduh ba pha dang samla . Lehse ki haka ban long jingïarap Katto katne ïa pha ; Lehse pha lah ban pyntieng ïa ki nongshun jong pha .
translation.en: Stand now with thine enchantments , and with the multitude of thy sorceries , wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth  ; if so be thou shalt be able to profit , if so be thou mayest prevail .
Neither shall they shave their heads , nor suffer their locks to grow long  ; they shall only poll their heads .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban khi ïa la ki khlieh ne ban ieh jrong ïa u shñiuh jong ki . Kin ieh ïa u shñiuh ha ka jingjrong kat ban biang .
Phin Kyrteng Ai ?
translation.en: What is your name ?
And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Shechem , unto the plain of Moreh . And the Canaanite was then in the land .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha ka ri Kanaan , u Abram u ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri haduh ba un da poi ha u dieng kyntang jong u Moreh , ka jaka bakhuid ha Shekhem . ( Ha kata ka por , ki Kanaan ki dang don ha ka ri . )
Ka jingshad ïa ka jingïakajia ka longsem kum ka jingkhie banyngkong jong ka de ; pynsngew ïa ka ha shuwa ba kan ïaid sha khmat .
translation.en: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water : therefore leave off contention , before it be meddled with .

translation.kha: Ha jingpyrkhat jongnga , ka meeting ka long kaba stet .
translation.en: In my opinion , the meeting was a success .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kambah bud , ki ïawan sha u , bad ki ïa-ïaid , Kyrpad , ngin ym buhrieh ïa ka jingsuki na Phi ba ki pisa jong i'u baroh’ ki la lut , bad ba ki jingri jingdup jong me ki la dei ki Jong phi . Ngim don ei ei shuh ban ai ïa Phin lieh noh sa tang ki met jngai ngi bad ki lyngkien jong ngi .
translation.en: When that year was ended , they came unto him the second year , and said unto him , We will not hide it from my lord , how that our money is spent  ; my lord also hath our herds of cattle  ; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord , but our bodies , and our lands :

translation.kha: Bad kumta ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , ar la ïathuh ïa Phah ba nga long u nongshun jong pha , nga ai ka jingbishar ïa pha ha kaba baroh ki jingtipbriew kin ïohi ïa kata .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I , even I , am against thee , and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations .

translation.kha: A Trai U Nongsynshar , nga bhah ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha me ; nga la shaniah ha me naduh ba de sdang samla .
translation.en: For thou art my hope , O Lord  God  : thou art my trust from my youth .
Yea , I will gather you , and blow upon you in the fire of my wrath , and ye shall be melted in the midst thereof .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ngan lumlang ïa ki ha Jerusalem , buh ïa ka ding hapoh jong ki , bad pynum ïa ki da ka jingbitar jong nga .
U pyndait kynjri ha ki kjat jyllang nga ; u peit-thuh ïa ka jingïaid jong nga .
translation.en: He putteth my feet in the stocks , he marketh all my paths .

translation.kha: Haba Phi kyang ban oh jingïarap , ai ba kito ki leilieh jong pa’ kin pyllait ïa Phi ! Tang saihon pyrsad ka lyer kan rong noh ïa ki ! Jamynrei kito babha shaniah ha nga ktien ïoh im ha ka ri bad kin mane ïa ang ha ka Templ jong nga .
translation.en: When thou criest , let thy companies deliver thee  ; but the wind shall carry them all away  ; vanity shall take them : but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land , and shall inherit my holy mountain  ;

translation.kha: Nangta thiah pyrshing ha ka krung kadiang , bad ngan pynkit ha me ïa ki kai bymman ka jaitbynriew Israel . Kumba laispah khyndaiphew sngi men sawa hangta bad shahshitom namar ki kur bymman jong ki . Nga la pynshitom ïa me shi sngi na ka byndi kawei kawei ka snem haduh ba ka jingpynshitom jong ki kan ngut noh .
translation.en: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity , according to the number of the days , three hundred and ninety days : so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel .
And Israel said , Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me , as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother ?
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ,  Balei keiñ phi pynjynjar sat ïa nga katne katne ba phi da ïathuh ha uta u briew ba phi don sa uwei u para ?
Ainguh ïa U Blei namar ka jingtipbriew jong phi , bad namar kaei kaba phi la leh ha Kanneh ka sngi ha kaba khang ïa nga na ka jingpalat ka jingpynim briew bad na kaba pynhiarkput da lade hi .
translation.en: And blessed be thy advice , and blessed be thou , which hast kept me this day from coming to shed blood , and from avenging myself with mine own hand .

translation.kha: U Trai u wanrah na ka jaka shong jong u na bnai ban pynshitom ïa ki bhabriew jrong ka pyrthei namar ki pop jong ki . Ki jingpynïap bhabriew ha ka pyrthei ïa kiba la leh ha kaba rieh , yn pynpaw , bad ka khyndew kad ym lah shuh ban buhrieh ïa kito ïa kiba la pynap .
translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity : the earth also shall disclose her blood , and shall no more cover her slain .

translation.kha: hynrei haba phi ïew ba u Nahash u syiem Ammon u wan tur pyrshah ïa phi , phi la kyntait ïa U Trai kum u Syiem jong phi bad phi ïai-ong ha de , ‘ Ngi kwah shym ba-bang synshar ïa ngi .’
translation.en: And when ye saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you , ye said unto me , Nay  ; but a king shall reign over us : when the  Lord  your God was your king .

translation.kha: Ussaïah pa uwei u sngewkhia tang ïa la ki lad ki kam , ym ïa kiew kiei ki jrong U Jisu Krit .
translation.en: For all seek their own , not the things which are Jesus Christs .

translation.kha: Ki la ai jingdap ha u syiem ïa ka jingdon baïar jong ki rangbah kiba bit don long shipai : phra lakh ha Jerusalem bad san lakh ha Judah .
translation.en: And Joab gave up the sum of the number of the people unto the king : and there were in Israel eight hundred thousand valiant men that drew the sword  ; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men .
And when she is departed out of his house , she may go and be another man s wife .
translation.kha: bad lada ka ïapoi shongkurim bad uwei pat u briew ,
Nangta baroh ki jingjynjar jong me ngin shu ja noh na ki jingkynmaw jong me , kum ki jingkhuslai um kiba la ïaid maji noh mala ym anna jingkiew shuh .
translation.en: Because thou shalt forget thy misery , and remember it as waters that pass away :

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingrem jong nga la ot noh bad ka la kut , kum ka ïingjaiñ ba la pynshitom , Kum ka jaiñ ba la khapngiah na ka kor thoin ïajan . Nga pyrkhat ba U Blei u la pynkut ïa ka jingim jong ang .
translation.en: Mine age is departed , and is removed from me as a shepherd s tent : I have cut off like a weaver my life : he will cut me off with pining sickness : from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me .
And their border went up toward the sea , and Maralah , and reached to Dabbasheth , and reached to the river that is before Jokneam  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u pud jong ka u suh beit shaphang sepngi shaduh Mareal , da kaba ktah ïa ka Dabbesheth bad ïa ka wahduid kaba sha mihngi jong ka Jokneam .
Hynrei da ka jingaiei U Blei , ïa baroh la pynlong ka khor bad u lyngba U Khrist Jisu , naba pyllaitluid ïa ki .
translation.en: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus :

translation.kha: Katno katne ki briew ki ïai leh ïa katba bah , bad thad burom , ka nam babha , bad ka jingkem bymjukut Shuah ; ïa ki U Blei un ai ka jingim bymkut .
translation.en: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality , eternal life :

translation.kha: U la poi kham jan shwa ka nongbah , bad haba u la ïohi ïa ka , u la ïam na ka bynta jong ka , u da nong ,
translation.en: And when he was come near , he beheld the city , and wept over it ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Amasaïah u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Jehoash u symboh ka Israel , u kob ïa u ban ïaleh .
translation.en: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash , the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu , king of Israel , saying , Come , let us look one another in the face .
I am the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la pyllait im ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
Uta uba rong tuh ïa u briew da kaba mut ban die mraw ne ba-bang ri khraw ïa u , u dei ban shah pynïap .
translation.en: And he that stealeth a man , and selleth him , or if he be found in his hand , he shall surely be put to death .

translation.kha: Bad U Trai un pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingmynsaw barhem bad un ri pynim bad ïalap ïa nga shat ka hima jyllang u ha bneng .
translation.en: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work , and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom : to whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
Saying , Let us alone  ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art , the Holy One of God .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba me kwah na ngi , ko Jisu na Nasareth ? Hato me la wan hangne ban pynjot ïa ngi ? Nga tip me long uei — me long u nonglamktien bakhuid jong U Blei !
Kumta mynta nga la wan ban ïakynduh ïa phi . Nga la khiew eh ba wan wad ïa phi , bad nga la lap ïa phi !
translation.en: Therefore came I forth to meet thee , diligently to seek thy face , and I have found thee .

translation.kha: Hynriew ki jubab , Ngin ym shah ban leh ïa ka para jong ngi kum ka nuti .
translation.en: And they said , Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot ?
And if thy foot offend thee , cut it off : it is better for thee to enter halt into life , than having two feet to be cast into hell , into the fire that never shall be quenched :
translation.kha: Bad lada ka kjat jong me ka pynlong ïa me ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit , ot noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa me ban rung sha ka jingim khlem ka kjat , ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki kjat bad ban shah bret sha dujok .
U Trai’ u la pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad une u la bah kthong ïa ki Israel , kiba la mihnoh da ka jingjop .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt , and he pursued after the children of Israel : and the children of Israel went out with an high hand .

translation.kha: La don katto katne ngut ki Jiw ïa kiba phi la buh baneh khmih ïa ka probins jrong ka bamaïan — u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego — ki i shym kohnguh ïa ki hukum u Syiem Kynrad . Kim shym mane ïa u blei jrong phiah lane dem ngon sha ka durbriew kaba phi la phah pynïeng .
translation.en: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego  ; these men , O king , have not regarded thee : they serve not thy gods , nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up .
And Bath–sheba went in unto the king into the chamber : and the king was very old  ; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Bathsheba ka leit jngoh ïa u syiem ha ka kamra thiah jong u . U la tymmen bha , bad ka Abishag , ka samla kynthei na Shunem , ka sumar ïa u .
Ngan ainong ïa ki da kaba pynslem ïa ka rta jong ki , nur-um pynim ïa ki .
translation.en: With long life will I satisfy him , and shew him my salvation .

translation.kha: U Blei’ um shym la shah i-ieit ïa ki angel kiba la lai pop , hynrei u la bret ïa ki sha dujok , ha kaban la khum kynthih ïa ki ha ka jingdum , da kaba ap ïa ka Sngi ka Jingbishar .
translation.en: For if God spared not the angels that sinned , but cast them down to hell , and delivered them into chains of darkness , to be reserved unto judgment  ;

translation.kha: Sngewbha , ko kynrad , pdiang ïa Kanneh ka jingai sngewbha naba nga la wallam ïa phi , bad ai ïa ka ha ki briew Jong phoi .
translation.en: And now this blessing which thine handmaid hath brought unto my lord , let it even be given unto the young men that follow my lord .

translation.kha: Hammoth pa la sawdong pule ïa ka Baibl bad ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ?
translation.en: Have you started studying the Bible with Jehovah’s Witnesses ?

translation.kha: U hukum ïa ki paid ka Judah ban bor ïa ka mon jong U Trai , U Blei jongki ki kop tymmen jong ki , bad ban kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai bad hukum jong u .
translation.en: And commanded Judah to seek the  Lord  God of their fathers , and to do the law and the commandment .

translation.kha: Nangta u Mosah u ïathuh ïa ki ktien jong kane ka jingrwai baroh kaei katba ki paid Israel baïar ki shahshkor .
translation.en: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song , until they were ended .

translation.kha: Da pynthikna bha ha-ei u thiah , bad hadien ba u la ïohthiah , saw bad khyllied ïa ki jaiñ sting bad thiah ha ki kjat jongki u . Un sa ïathuh ïa phi kaei ba phin dei ban leh .
translation.en: And it shall be , when he lieth down , that thou shalt mark the place where he shall lie , and thou shalt go in , and uncover his feet , and lay thee down  ; and he will tell thee what thou shalt do .
In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge .
translation.kha: U long u shabi uba plie ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ba la buhrieh jong ka jingstad bad ka jingtip U Blei .

translation.en: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father .
translation.kha: Kumta keiñ , baroh ar ngut ki khun kynthei jong u Lot ki la punkhun na u kpa la jong .
Kumba ka long , namarkata , ki jingkñia ainguh ki don na kawei ka snem shuh kawei patar ka snem ban pynkynmaw ïa ki briew Shaphang ki pop jongu ki .
translation.en: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year .

translation.kha: Thiophilos badonburom : Bud ki briew ki la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban thoh ka jingïathuh ïa kiei kiei kiba la lah jia hapdeng jong ngi .
translation.en: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us ,

And keep the charge of the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , to keep his statutes , and his commandments , and his judgments , and his testimonies , as it is written in the law of Moses , that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest , and whithersoever thou turnest thyself :
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong u baroh , kumba la thoh ha ka Aiñ u Moses , khnang ba haba me leit shano shano me lah ban manbha ha kaei kaei kaba me leh .

translation.en: We are imitating Jesus .
translation.kha: Ngi bud ïa ka nuksa jong u Jisu .

translation.en: Who hath woe ? who hath sorrow ? who hath contentions ? who hath babbling ? who hath wounds without cause ? who hath redness of eyes ?
translation.kha: To pyn-i ha nga ïa uno uno uba dih kyrni , uba pyrshang katto katne ka jingdih bathymmai , bad nga pyn-i ïa phi ïa uwei uba kordit bad sngewsih na ka bynta ïa lade , uba pynmih jingeh borabor , bad uba khñium borabor .
Hynrei katai ka kynthei ka pynhap najrong da u mawtylliat halor ka Khlieh jong u , bad ka shynrong khlieh jong u ka la pait .
translation.en: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech s head , and all to brake his skull .

translation.kha: U la sdang ban krensih shlur ha ka synagog . Haba ka Priskila bad u Keilah ki la ïohsngew ïa u , ki la ïalam ïa u sha la ïng bad ki la batai ha u kham bniah ïa ka Lynti jong U Blei .
translation.en: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue : whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard , they took him unto them , and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly .

translation.kha: U Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki kamar-tama ha Gath ryngkat mala ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki . U Dabid u don ar ngut ki tnga lem bad u , ka Ahinoam na Jesreel , bad ka Abigail , ka tnga u Namarba uba la ïap , kaba na Karmel .
translation.en: And David dwelt with Achish at Gath , he and his men , every man with his household , even David with his two wives , Ahinoam the Jezreelitess , and Abigail the Carmelitess , Nabal s wife .
The way of life is above to the wise , that he may depart from hell beneath .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba stad ki ïaid ha ka lynti kaba ïalam artet sha ka jingim , ym ïa ka lynti kaba ïalam arsut sha ka jingïap .
Kane ka jingjot mynta ka la wan ha phi namar ba phi ai jingkñia sha kiwei ki blei malade leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai da ka jingbymkohnguh ïa ki hukum jngai u baroh .
translation.en: Because ye have burned incense , and because ye have sinned against the  Lord  , and have not obeyed the voice of the  Lord  , nor walked in his law , nor in his statutes , nor in his testimonies  ; therefore this evil is happened unto you , as at this day .

translation.kha: Naba nga la thmu ban wan jngum ïa phi ha ka lynti jong ar sha Makedonia bad khmut ynda nga wan phai , khnang ban ïoh jingïarap lem na phi na ka bynta ka jingleit jong nga sha Judia .
translation.en: And to pass by you into Macedonia , and to come again out of Macedonia unto you , and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea .

translation.kha: ïa ki riewshlur bad ki shipai jong ki , ïa ki nongbishar bad ki nongïathuhlypa jong ki , ïa ki nongbatai kup bad ki nongsaiñ hima Jong ki ,
translation.en: The mighty man , and the man of war , the judge , and the prophet , and the prudent , and the ancient ,

translation.kha: Wat u briew uba jem tam ka dohnud kiba wan na ka ïing kaba donburom , un Nakon ha ka kutlad ha ka por ba u shah kerkut , kat ban da Bam ïa la ki khur namar ba um don kadei pat ka jait jingbam . Un ym ai ei ei wat ïa la u na ne ka tnga kaba u ieit ne ïa la ki khun Ibbah Dang ba-don bad u .
translation.en: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat : because he hath nothing left him in the siege , and in the straitness , wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates .

translation.kha: U Sadok u lyngdoh bad ki para lyngdoh jong u pateng , ki peit ïa ka jingbymman ïa U Trai ha ka jaka mane kabu ha Gibeon .
translation.en: And Zadok the priest , and his brethren the priests , before the tabernacle of the  Lord  in the high place that was at Gibeon ,

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la mian shabar , da kaba phong ïa ka pyntieng shiah bad kup da ka jaiñkup kaban sawbthuh . U Pilat u la ong ha ki , Shimham ! hangtai uta u briew !
translation.en: Then came Jesus forth , wearing the crown of thorns , and the purple robe . And Pilate saith unto them , Behold the man !
And Enos lived ninety years , and begat Cainan :
translation.kha: Haba u Enosh u la dap khyndaiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Kenan ,
Nangta phan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la bor . Phan ym tap ïa la ki lamkhmat lane bam ïa ka jingbam kaba ki nongmih pangnud ki bim .
translation.en: And ye shall do as I have done : ye shall not cover your lips , nor eat the bread of men .

translation.kha: La don u nongïalam jong ki Jiw uba kyrteng u Nikodemos , uba dei na ka kynhun ki pharshi .
translation.en: There was a man of the Pharisees , named Nicodemus , a ruler of the Jews :

translation.kha: Lehse nga erlangthari u bym da nang Ban kren , hynrei da kabu sngewthikna ym ha ka jingtip ; ngi la pynshai ïa kane ha phi man la ka por bad ha ki jingjngem baroh .
translation.en: But though I be rude in speech , yet not in knowledge ; but we have been thoroughly made manifest among you in all things .

translation.kha: Nga beh kthong ïa ki nongshun jyllang por , bad nga jop ïa ki ; ngam shym sangeh tad haduh ba ngan da pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: I have pursued mine enemies , and destroyed them  ; and turned not again until I had consumed them .

translation.kha: Kine baroh ki long ki aiñ bad ki hukum ba U Trai’ u la ai ha u Moses , ha u Lum synñia na ka bynta ki paidbhur Israel .
translation.en: These are the statutes and judgments and laws , which the  Lord  made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses .
Is any among you afflicted ? let him pray . Is any merry ? let him sing psalms .
translation.kha: Hato don napdeng jong phi ba shem jynjar ? U dei ban duwai . Hato don uba kmen ? U dei ban rwai ïaroh .

translation.en: And his miracles , and his acts , which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt , and unto all his land  ;
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi kumno u la leh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei .

translation.en: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly , nor standeth in the way of sinners , nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut ki briew basniew ki bym bud ïa ka jingleh ki nongpop lane ïasoh bad kito ki bymdonkam ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba ïa ka kyrteng jong u ym shym la thoh ha ka kitab kiba im la bret sha ka pung ka ding .
Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uta uba beit u Don ka jingïam bymjukut .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me hath everlasting life .
To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles ; which is Christ in you , the hope of glory :
