translation.kha: Ka jingthmu jong U Blei ka long ban pyntip ïa ka jingmaïan jong u ha ki briew jong u , ïa kane ka jingmaïan basngewtynnat bad badonburom kaba u don na ka bynta ki briew baroh . Bad ka jingmaïan ka long , ba U Khrist u don hapoh jong phi , kaba mut , ba phin ïoh bynta ha ka burom jong U Blei .
Ka pyrthei ka khiah katba ki neng tur ; ka sahit bneng ka khynñiuh . Ka sngi bad u bnai ki kylla dum , bad ki khulom kim shai shuh .
translation.en: The earth shall quake before them  ; the heavens shall tremble : the sun and the moon shall be dark , and the stars shall withdraw their shining :
Woe unto the world because of offences ! for it must needs be that offences come  ; but woe to that man by whom the offence cometh !
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei kan long ïa ka pyrthei ha kaba don kiei kiei kiba pynlong ïa ki briew ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong ki ! Kiba kum kine kiei kiei kin ïai jia — hynrei katno kaba shyrkhei ïa uta u briew uba pynjia ïa ki !
Kumjuh u Potiphar u aiti ïa kiei kiew baroh kat kiba u don ha ka jingpeit u Joseph , bad um shym pynkhuslai ei ei shuh ïa lade lait tang ka bam ba u ju bam .
translation.en: And he left all that he had in Joseph s hand  ; and he knew not ought he had , save the bread which he did eat . And Joseph was a goodly person , and well favoured .

translation.kha: Nangne u ong ha ka , Ïalam ïa kito ki kput hangne ha ka jingthiah lad ar bad pyntian ïa de da ma phi hi . Ka la shim ïa ki kpu bad ka la leit sha u .
translation.en: And Amnon said unto Tamar , Bring the meat into the chamber , that I may eat of thine hand . And Tamar took the cakes which she had made , and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother .

translation.kha: ki sei shabar ïa u rishot bakmen uba don hangta bad ki thang ïa u .
translation.en: And they brought forth the images out of the house of Baal , and burned them .

translation.kha: Uta u brai u dang ïai khmih tong jar ïa ka , ban dabor la ka long ba U Troas u la ai jingjop ïa u .
translation.en: And the man wondering at her held his peace , to wit whether the  Lord  had made his journey prosperous or not .

translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la khuslai shikatdei eh mala ki la ïa-ong ha u Petros Bad ha kiwei! pat ki apostol , Kaei kaba ngin leh , ko para ?
translation.en: Now when they heard this , they were pricked in their heart , and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles , Men and brethren , what shall we do ?

translation.kha: Naba ym don kano kano kaba U Blei um haka ban leh .
translation.en: For with God nothing shall be impossible .

translation.kha: Na la pynsakma da ki rukom kren bapher ban ïathuh ïa phi ïa Kin kiei kiei . Hynrei ka por ka poi haba ngan ym pyndonnam ïa ki rukom kren bapyut , hynmen ngan kren ha phin da kambah shawei kdar shaphang U Kpa .
translation.en: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs : but the time cometh , when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs , but I shall shew you plainly of the Father .

translation.kha: Kito kiba na kiwei ka nongbah kin jong ha kito kiba na kawei pat , ‘ Ngi leit ban mane ïa U Trai Badonbor Baroh bad ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu Jong u . To wan bad ngi !’
translation.en: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another , saying , Let us go speedily to pray before the  Lord  , and to seek the  Lord  of hosts : I will go also .

translation.kha: Ynda pra kata ka por , phin sa lynñiar kthang namar u Syiem jong phi , ibha phi hi da lade phi la jakoid , hynrei U Trai un ym sngap ïa ki jingud jong phira .
translation.en: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king which ye shall have chosen you  ; and the  Lord  will not hear you in that day .

translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jong nga , U thri u pyndap ïa nga da U Mynsiem bad ka ber , bad u ai ha nga ka jingsngewthuh ïa ka jingisih hok sad ka jingshlur ba-bang ïathuh ha ki paid Israel kiew ki longsem ki ngop jong ki .
translation.en: But truly I am full of power by the spirit of the  Lord  , and of judgment , and of might , to declare unto Jacob his transgression , and to Israel his sin .

translation.kha: Ong phi kaweh aïu len ai , bad pynshongdor katba phi sngewieit ïa ka nongleitkurim , ngan ai ha phi katne ka phi pan , tang lada ph shah ïa nga ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: Ask me never so much dowry and gift , and I will give according as ye shall say unto me : but give me the damsel to wife .
Then shall the cities of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go , and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense : but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble .
translation.kha: Nangta ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem kin leit sha ki blei ha kiba ki ai ïa ki jingkñia bad kin kyang jam sha ki ban ïoh jingïarap . Hynrei kito ki blei kin ym lah ban pynim ïa ki haba kane ka jingpynjot ka wan .

Ngan pynlong ïa ka Ijipt ka ri ba sah kynjah tam ha ka pyiar . Na ka bynta sawphew snem ki nongbud ka Ijipt kin sah ha ka jingjot , ki jingbieit bakha kham sniew baneh ïa kito ha kiwei pat ki nongbah . Ngan pynlong ïa ki nong Ijipt ki nongphetwir . Ki phet shaei mano ki ri bad don im hapdeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate , and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years : and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and will disperse them through the countries .

translation.kha: Baroh ki briew ki la ïohsngew ïa u ; ma ki bad khamtam ki nonglur khajna ki long kita kiba la kohnguh ïa ka jingailad bakhlaiñ jong U Blei malade kiba la shah pynïapmat ha u Ïoannis .
translation.en: And all the people that heard him , and the publicans , justified God , being baptized with the baptism of John .
And they shall take away the ashes from the altar , and spread a purple cloth thereon :
translation.kha: Ki Lebi mynta ki long ki jong nga . Mynba nga la pynïap ïa u khun nyngkong baroh jong ki nong Ijipt , nga la pynkyntang kum la u jong ïa u khun nyngkong na kawei pa kawei ka ïing Israel bad ïa uba la kha nyngkong na uwei pa uwei u mrad . Mynta , nga ïoh noh da ki Lebi kum la ki jong ha ka jaka ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong jong ki Israel ; ki kin long ki jong nga . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples , he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ai ïa kine ki jinghikai ha ki khat-ar ngut ki synran jong u , u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la leit noh ban hikai bad ïalap ha ki shnong kiba hajan hangta .

translation.en: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki dei ban shong dara ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ shaphang mihngi . Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam niam baroh kiba dei ban pyndep ha ka Jaka Kyntang na ka bynta ki Israel . Uno uno uwei pat uba pyrshang ban leh kumta un shah pynïap .
Hynrei u Petros u la jubab , Ko rangbah , ngam sngewthuh shaphang kaei phi ïakhreh ! Kumta hi , katba u dang krung , u syiar u la kyn-ih .
translation.en: And Peter said , Man , I know not what thou sayest . And immediately , while he yet spake , the cock crew .

translation.kha: Nangta u Pilat u la pyllew ïa u Barabbas na ka bynta jong ki ; bad hadien kata , u la phah sympat ïa U Jisu , u la aiti ïa u ban sahnarphna .
translation.en: Then released he Barabbas unto them : and when he had scourged Jesus , he delivered him to be crucified .

translation.kha: Kata ka long kaba shisha , ko Kner , ka la jubab ; hynrei wat ki ksew ki ïabam ïa kiba sah tam Kiba hap na ka mei u kynrad jong ki .
translation.en: And she said , Truth , Lord : yet the dogs eat of the crumbs which fall from their masters  table .

translation.kha: Me long Uba dap da ka jingisynei bad ibha map , wat la moi la ïohnang ïaleh pyrshah ïa me .
translation.en: To the Lord our God belong mercies and forgivenesses , though we have rebelled against him  ;

translation.kha: Ngi bud ïa ka nuksa jong u Jehu .
translation.en: We are imitating Jesus .
And lo a voice from heaven , saying , This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased .
translation.kha: Nangta ka sur ktien ka la ong na bneng ,  Une u long U Khun uba ieit eh jong nga , ha uba nga sngewbha eh .
Ngan ai ha u ïa ka Ijipt kum ka jingsiew na ka bynta ki jingtrei jong u , namar ka kynhun shipai jong u ka trei na ka bynta jong nga . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , la la kren .
translation.en: I have given him the land of Egypt for his labour wherewith he served against it , because they wrought for me , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: KA ym long kumto ka jutang ïa kaban nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki ha kata ka sngi ha kaweh na la btin ïa ki bad la ïalamwir nong ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Kim shym ïaineh ha kata ka ïong kaba nga la pynlong bad ki , nabar kumta ngam shym shahshkor shuh ïa ki .
translation.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt  ; because they continued not in my covenant , and I regarded them not , saith the Lord .
For example , employers often prefer workers who live by the Bible principles of honesty and diligence .
translation.kha: Kum ka nuksa , ki nongaikam ki kham jied ïa ki nongtrei kiba trei hok , kiba minot bad kiba bud ïa ki aiñ jong ka Baibl .

Te pa la jubor , ‘ Moses , ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai . Hynrei mynta ngin leit tur , kumba U TRAI’ U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ïa im .’ Nangta uwei pa uwei na phi u khreh ïa-ban ïaleh tmoh , u da tharai ba ka long kaba jem ïa-ban leit iitkhmat ïa kata ka ri .
translation.en: Then ye answered and said unto me , We have sinned against the  Lord  , we will go up and fight , according to all that the  Lord  our God commanded us . And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war , ye were ready to go up into the hill .

translation.kha: Phi la long ha kawei ka por kiba la ïap ha kaba kynja mynhynne namar ki pop jong phi bad namar ba phi la longïng ki Jentil kiba khlei ka Hukum . Hynrei U Blei mynnin u la ïam ïa phin sha ka jingim bad U Khrist .
translation.en: And you , being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh , hath he quickened together with him , having forgiven you all trespasses ;

translation.kha: Kumta u Elijah u la leit shai Sarephath . Ynda u poi ha khyrdop shnongrit , u la ïohi ïa kawei ka riewkynthei kaba tam diengïap . U khot ïa ka , bad u ong , Sngewbha ai ha nga ka um ban dih .
translation.en: So he arose and went to Zarephath . And when he came to the gate of the city , behold , the widow woman was there gathering of sticks : and he called to her , and said , Fetch me , I pray thee , a little water in a vessel , that I may drink .
And Judah said , The strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed , and there is much rubbish  ; so that we are not able to build the wall .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Judah ki don ka jingrwai kaba ki rwai :  Ngi long tlot ba ngi bah ki jingkit bakhia ; Don bun bah ka synrum ban pynkhuid . Kumno ngi lah ban tei ïa ka kynroh mynta ka sngi ?
Nangta pynkyntang ïa ka Ïingjaiñ nabar ïa ki tiar jong ka baroh da kaba synreit da ka jingbymman pynsleh ; te kan sa long kaba kyntang nadong sdang .
translation.en: And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering , and all his vessels , and sanctify the altar : and it shall be an altar most holy .

translation.kha: Ki la pyrshing ban kem ïa u , hynrei u la phet lyngkhuit , da kaba iehnoh ïa ka jaiñ shadien jrong u .
translation.en: And he left the linen cloth , and fled from them naked .
He is gone up to Bajith , and to Dibon , the high places , to weep : Moab shall howl over Nebo , and over Medeba : on all their heads shall be baldness , and every beard cut off .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Dibon ki kiew ïa u lum ban ïam ha ka jaka mane blei . Ki briew jong ka Moab ki la ïam ha ka jingsngewsih ïa ki nongbah jong ka Nebo bad Medeba ; ki la khi ïa la ki khlieh bad ïa u  ñiuhtmoh ha ka jingsngewsih .
Haba u leit sa ha kadei pat ka sngi , u ïohi ar ngut ki Hebru kaba ïashoh . U ong ha uta uba leh bymdei , Balei me da shoh ïa la u to Hebru ?
translation.en: And when he went out the second day , behold , two men of the Hebrews strove together : and he said to him that did the wrong , Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow ?

translation.kha: ba ka por ka poh haba ïa kiei kiei kiba ha ka ïingsyiem , kiei kiei kiba ki kba tymmen ki la kynshew haduh kan ka sngi , yn rong noh shai Babilonia . Yn ym khong ei ei ka ban sah .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , that all that is in thine house , and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day , shall be carried into Babylon : nothing shall be left , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: To ngin rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam , te , ym da u kpu suba don u thiat uba rim jong ka pop bad ka jingbymman , hynriew da u kpu u bym ne thir , u kpu jong ka jingduh bad ka jingshisha .
translation.en: Therefore let us keep the feast , not with old leaven , neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness ; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth .

translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la leit phai sha ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home .

translation.kha: Taralah uwei na phi u anna u shakri uba dang lur lyngkha lieng dang sharai ïa ki langbrot . Haba u wan shapoh ïing na lyngkha hato phi ong ïa u ban pynkloi bad bam ïa la ka jingbam ?
translation.en: But which of you , having a servant plowing or feeding cattle , will say unto him by and by , when he is come from the field , Go and sit down to meat ?

translation.kha: baroh kaba nga kwah ka long ba ngan ithuh ïa U Khrist bad ban mad ïa ka bor ka jingpahuh jong u , ban ïoh bynta ha ki jingshahshitom jongki u , bad ban long kum ma u ha ka jingïap jong u ,
translation.en: That I may know him , and the power of his resurrection , and the fellowship of his sufferings , being made conformable unto his death ;

translation.kha: Pynshong ar ngut ki riewrunar ban mudui pyrshah ïa u , ba u la tim ïa U Blei bad ïa u syiem jong u . Nangta sei ïa u shabar ka nongbah bad Lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap .
translation.en: And set two men , sons of Belial , before him , to bear witness against him , saying , Thou didst blaspheme God and the king . And then carry him out , and stone him , that he may die .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïai-ong , Ngan pynkhih ka thma poh-ïing ha Joppa bad ngan pynphai ïa u para pyrshah ïa u para bad u paramarjan pyrshah ïa u paramarjan . Ki nongbah ba-ïashun kin ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat , bad ki syiem ba-ïashun keiñ ïaksaid ban ïoh ïa ka bor .
translation.en: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians : and they shall fight every one against his brother , and every one against his neighbour  ; city against city , and kingdom against kingdom .
As for thee also , by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Namar ka jutang jong nga bad phi kaba la shonshab da ka snam jong ki jingkñia , ngan pyllaitluid ïa ki briew jong phi — kaba laitluid na ki thliew bym don um jong ka jingshah ringmraw .

Un aiti noh ïa me badno ïa ki Israel ha ki Philistia . Lashai ka sngi ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me kin sa ïadon ryngkat bad nga , bad U Trai un aiti noh ruh ïa ka kynhun ïapom ki Israel ha ki Philistia .
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  will also deliver Israel with thee into the hand of the Philistines : and to morrow shalt thou and thy sons be with me : the  Lord  also shall deliver the host of Israel into the hand of the Philistines .
And his disciples asked him , saying , What might this parable be ?
translation.kha: Ki synran jong u ki la kylli ïa U Jisu aïu kane ka pharshi ka kit jingmut ,
U Petros u la bud na jingai , haduh ka phyllaw jong ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh . U la leit shahjop ka phyllaw bad u la shong lem bad ki nongbat byndi ban khmih kumno kan jia baroh .
translation.en: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest s palace , and went in , and sat with the servants , to see the end .

translation.kha: U Blei u ïarap ïa u ban jop ïa ki Philistia , ïa ki Arab kiba shong ha Khublei , bad ïa ki Meun .
translation.en: And God helped him against the Philistines , and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur–baal , and the Mehunims .

translation.kha: Katba nga dang anna hi ha ka ïingbyndi ha ka phlait , ka khubor U Trai ka la wan biang ha nga .
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah the second time , while he was yet shut up in the court of the prison , saying ,

translation.kha: Bad mynta ka jingshai ha ka sahit bneng ka phyrnai eh , ka phyrnai haduh katta Katta ïa ngi ban khmih’ ïa ka ; bad ïa ka sahkut bnai la sar pynduh da ka lyer .
translation.en: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds : but the wind passeth , and cleanseth them .

translation.kha: Hangta u sei ïa ki jaiñ bad ki jingdeng rupa bad ksiar , bad u ai ïa ki ha ka Rebekka . U ai ruh ïa ki jingai kiba kordor ïa u hynmen bad ïa ka kmie jong ka .
translation.en: And the servant brought forth jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment , and gave them to Rebekah : he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things .
But , beloved , remember ye the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei to kynmaw , ko ki paralok jong nga , ïa kaei ba la ïathuh ha phi mynshuwa da ki apostol jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .
U nongpdiang u lah ban leh shispah tylli ki kam runar bad u dang im . O ! ho-oid , nga tip ïa kaei ba ki ong : Lydda phi kohnguh ïa U Blei , kiei kiei baher ken bit kin baïong ,
translation.en: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times , and his days be prolonged , yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God , which fear before him :

translation.kha: Ko Israel , ym don u blei uba kum U Blei jong phi , Uba ïadat ha ka burom ha sahit bnoh , Uba ïaid ha ki lyoh ban wan ïarap ïa Phin .
translation.en: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun , who rideth upon the heaven in thy help , and in his excellency on the sky .

translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia , bad suit ïa ki ruh da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And thou shalt make staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold .

translation.kha: Ki leh kumba ki jingmong jongno ki briew jong de ki long tang ki jingtrud . ‘ Baroh ka bit ka biang ,’ ki nguh , haba barhem kam bit kam biang .
translation.en: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly , saying , Peace , peace  ; when there is no peace .

translation.kha: Te u rangbah synshar u ïeng joit dara u pyrta ha ka ktien Hebru , To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba u patsha ka Assyria u ïatih ha phi .
translation.en: Then Rabshakeh stood , and cried with a loud voice in the Jews  language , and said , Hear ye the words of the great king , the king of Assyria .
But also thou shalt not cut off thy kindness from my house for ever : no , not when the  Lord  hath cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth .
translation.kha: pynpaw ïa kajuh ka jingïaineh skhem ïa ka ïing ka sem jong nga shi junom . Bad haba U  Trai  u la pynjot thiaw ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh ,
Kane baroh ka long na ka bynta jong phi ; bad katba ka jingaiei U Blei ka dang kner noh sha Kiba bun ki briew , kine ai shaei ka burom U Blei kham bun ki jingduwai ainguh .
translation.en: For all things are for your sakes , that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God .
Therefore shall ye keep my commandments , and do them : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta phin sumar bad leh ïa ki hukum jong nga : nga long U  Trai .
Hynrei haba phi ïarap ïa u briew ibha kyrdon , leh ïa ka ha kata ka rukom ba wat u paralok bajan tam jong phi un ym tip shaphang kata .
translation.en: But when thou doest alms , let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth :

translation.kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba ma ki lymne ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la ïohsngew , bad ngan phah ki kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ki tad haduh ba nur da pynjot khoit ïa ki .
translation.en: I will scatter them also among the heathen , whom neither they nor their fathers have known : and I will send a sword after them , till I have consumed them .
A foolish son is a grief to his father , and bitterness to her that bare him .
translation.kha: U khun uba bieit u pynsngewsih ïa la u kpa bad u pynbabe da ki jingkthang ïa la ka kmie .

translation.en: And when they came to Jesus , they besought him instantly , saying , That he was worthy for whom he should do this :
translation.kha: Ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kyrpad jur ïa u ,  Une u briew u dei hok shisha ban ïoh ïa ka jingïarap jong me .
Ki la iehnoh ïa ka lyndum ka jingshisha bad pynkylla kohnguh ïa ka jingngeit jong ki katto katne ki bangeit da kaba ong ba ka jingpynmihpat ïa ngi ka la dep jia .
translation.en: Who concerning the truth have erred , saying that the resurrection is past already ; and overthrow the faith of some .

translation.kha: Ki la jubor ïa u da kaba pyrta khim , Em , ym dei ïa u ! Ngi kwah ïa u Barabbas ! ( u Babbai u la long u nongkyrshan . )
translation.en: Then cried they all again , saying , Not this man , but Barabbas . Now Barabbas was a robber .

translation.kha: Nangta u paidbah u ong ha u Joshua , Ngin shakri ïa U Trai U Blei jong ngi . Ngin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
translation.en: And the people said unto Joshua , The  Lord  our God will we serve , and his voice will we obey .

translation.kha: Naba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la wan ha phin da kaba pyn-i ha phi ïa ka lyntang ïadat kaba dei , bad kitab shitrhem la ngeit ïa u ; hynrei ki nonglum khajna bad ki nuti ki la ngeit ïa u . Wat haba phi la ïohi ïa kane , drama shym la kylla ïa la ki jingot hadien bad ngeit ïa u .
translation.en: For John came unto you in the way of righteousness , and ye believed him not : but the publicans and the harlots believed him : and ye , when ye had seen it , repented not afterward , that ye might believe him .
That the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying , I am the  Lord  : speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha u Pharaoh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga la ong ha me .

translation.en: All nations compassed me about : but in the name of the  Lord  will I destroy them .
translation.kha: Shibun ki nongshun ki la don sawdong jong nga ; hynrei nga la pynjot ïa ki da ka bor jong U  Trai  !

translation.en: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country : and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh ka pur kylleng ki rudnong , bad kham bun ki rangbah ki la ïap ha khlaw ban ïa kiba shah pynïap ha ka thma .
U la beiñ ïa ki Israel , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Shahasumah , u hynmen jong u Dabid , u la pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And when he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him .

translation.kha: Ngan shahskhor ïa ki um jong me ban un-long jai jai bad kun pynlong sngur bad lang shah ïa ki wah jong me ba kin tuid jai jai . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , to la kren .
translation.en: Then will I make their waters deep , and cause their rivers to run like oil , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka Templ , da ki jingpyrshang jong to , nga la lum palat ïa na hajar sawspah ton ka kseh bad king ïa laiphew saw hajar tin ka rupa ban pyndonkam ha kaba tei ïa ka . Nalor kata , la don bun bah ka rnong bad ka nar-khang . Nga la pynkhreh mad ïa ka dieng bad u maw , hynrei me dei ban pynïoh shuh shuh .
translation.en: Now , behold , in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the  Lord  an hundred thousand talents of gold , and a thousand thousand talents of silver  ; and of brass and iron without weight  ; for it is in abundance : timber also and stone have I prepared  ; and thou mayest add thereto .

translation.kha: Kane ka la pynsangeh ïa ka khulom bad u la sha ïeng hapdeng kiba im bad kiba ïap .
translation.en: And he stood between the dead and the living  ; and the plague was stayed .

translation.kha: Une uno kiba ngeit ha U Khun un ym shah bishar ; hynrei ïa uno Une u bymngeit la lah bishar lyngba ïa u , namar ba um shym la jingieit ha U Khun ba tang marwei jong U Blei .
translation.en: He that believeth on him is not condemned : but he that believeth not is condemned already , because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God .

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Samson u kiba ïa kawei ka bhabriew kambah kyrteng ka Taralah , kaba shong basah ha ka Them Sorek .
translation.en: And it came to pass afterward , that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek , whose name was Delilah .
The servant therefore fell down , and worshipped him , saying , Lord , have patience with me , and I will pay thee all .
translation.kha: U shakri u la dem khrup ha ki khohsiew ha khmat u Syiem . ‘ To ïaishah bad nga ,’ u la kyrpad , ‘ bad ngan siew ïa phi ïa kaei kaei baroh !’

translation.en: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day s uproar , there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse .
translation.kha: Naba hadien kaei kaba la jia mynta ka sngi , ka don ka jingma ba yn mudui ïa ngi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin . Ym don kano kano ka jingmap na ka bynta kane ka jingkhihwin , bad ngim lah ban ai kano kano ka daw kaba dei na ka bynta kata .

A Trei , me long ka jingkyrmen jongu ka Israel ; baroh kiba la rynsied ïa me yn buh ha ka jinglehrain . Kin sim noh kum ki kyrthat ba la thoh ha ka khyndew , namar ki la lyndet ïa me , U Tlai , uba un-long ka umpohliew ki um bastang .
translation.en: O  Lord  , the hope of Israel , all that forsake thee shall be ashamed , and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth , because they have forsaken the  Lord  , the fountain of living waters .

translation.kha: Marah ïadep pynskhem ïa la ka bor kum u syiemsad , u Bethrehob bad ki briew jong u Baroh ki iehnoh ïa ka sah jong U Trai .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Rehoboam had established the kingdom , and had strengthened himself , he forsook the law of the  Lord  , and all Israel with him .

translation.kha: Ki paid nongkhaïi ki jah lynti ha ka wad um ; ki ïaid ruma badno ki ïap ha ka ri shispah .
translation.en: The paths of their way are turned aside  ; they go to nothing , and perish .

translation.kha: Uno uno u bynriew uba leit rung ha kata ka ïong kaban dang khang un long u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
translation.en: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even .

translation.kha: U la ïap bad la tep , bad u Berakhaïah u khun shynrang jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Menahem slept with his fathers  ; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Ngi la kohnguh ïa baroh ki jingbthah ba u Jonadab u la ai ha i'u . Ma I hi ngim ju dih waiñ , lymne ki tnga jongngi ngi , ki khun shynrang jong ngi , lane ki khun kynther jong ngi .
translation.en: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jehonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us , to drink no wine all our days , we , our wives , our sons , nor our daughters  ;

translation.kha: Kanneh ka long ka hukum jong U Tiras U Bel jong phi , uba la ïalam ïa phiah na ka ri jingtep don ai ha phi! ïa ka ri Kanaan bad ban long U Blei jong phoi .
translation.en: I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt , to give you the land of Canaan , and to be your God .
And it came to pass , that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner .
translation.kha: U Petros u la ïaisah bun sngi ha Joppa lem bad u nongpdem snieh uba kyrteng u Simon .
U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la ïeng bad u la ong ha U Jisu , Mem don jubab banbeiñ ai ïa kane ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa me ?
translation.en: And the high priest arose , and said unto him , Answerest thou nothing ? what is it which these witness against thee ?
These words spake Jesus , and lifted up his eyes to heaven , and said ,  Father , the hour is come  ; glorify thy Son , that thy Son also may glorify thee :
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la dep ong ïa kane , u la khmied sha bneng bad u la ong ,  Ko Pa , ka kynta ka la poi . To ai ka burom ïa la U Khun , ba U Khun un ïoh ban ai ka burom ïa me .
Da pyrkhat bha hajan phi ai jingrai ; phim pyndep ïa ka kad ha ka bor bri , hynrei ha ka bor U Trai , bad u hir bad phi haba phi ai ïa ka jingrai .
translation.en: And said to the judges , Take heed what ye do : for ye judge not for man , but for the  Lord  , who is with you in the judgment .
Saying unto them ,  Go into the village over against you , and straightway ye shall find an ass tied , and a colt with her : loose them , and bring them unto me .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ka nongrit kaba hangta ha khmat jong phi , bad shisyndon phin shem ïa ka kada kaba la teh lem bad u khun kada hajan jong ka . Loit noh ïa ki bad wallam ïa ki sha nga .
Lada phiah ai ïa ka ha uno uno u bym lah ban pule bad nguh ïa u ban pule ïa ka ha Phin , un jubab ba um tip kumno ban pluh .
translation.en: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned , saying , Read this , I pray thee : and he saith , I am not learned .

translation.kha: Mynta kren ha ki antad Israel bad ong ïa ki baroh ban pat na la ki paramarjan ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad ki jingtieng mata .
translation.en: Speak now in the ears of the people , and let every man borrow of his neighbour , and every woman of her neighbour , jewels of silver , and jewels of gold .
He that is not with me is against me  ; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym long na ka bynta jong nga , u ïaleh pyrshah shisha ïa nga ; uno uno u bym ïarap ïa nga ban lum ban lang u long shisha uba pynsaphred .

translation.en: And when he had looked round about on them with anger , being grieved for the hardness of their hearts , he saith unto the man ,  Stretch forth thine hand .  And he stretched it out : and his hand was restored whole as the other .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la bitar katba u la peit sawdong ïa ki , hynrei ha ka kajuh ka por u la sngewsih na ka bynta jong ki , namar ba ki eh mynsiem bad leh bymdei . Te u la ong ha uta u briew ,  Rah ïa la ka kti .  U la rah ïa ka , bad ka la khiah bha pat .
Bad to khmih ïa ki jingdonkam jong iwei ïa iwei pat , ym tyngka ïa la ka jong .
translation.en: Look not every man on his own things , but every man also on the things of others .

For , lo , he that formeth the mountains , and createth the wind , and declareth unto man what is his thought , that maketh the morning darkness , and treadeth upon the high places of the earth , The  Lord  , The God of hosts , is his name .
translation.kha: U Blei u long uta uba la thaw ïa ki lumbah bad uba pynlong ïa ki lyer . U pynpaw ïa la ki jingmut ha u briew ; u pynkylla ïa ka sngi sha ka miet . U ïaid ha kiba kynjang jong ka pyrthei . Kane ka long ka kyrteng jong u : U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh !
U Japheth u ong ha ki , Lada pa’ ïalam biang ïa nga sha ïingjaiñ ban ïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad U Trai u ai jingjop ïa nga , nga dei shun longïing u nongsynshar jong phiah .
translation.en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead , If ye bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon , and the  Lord  deliver them before me , shall I be your head ?
For as often as ye eat this bread , and drink this cup , ye do shew the Lord s death till he come .
translation.kha: Kane ka mut ba man ba phi bam ïa une u kpu bad phi dih na kane ka khuri phi pynbna ïa ka jingïap U Trai tad ynda un wan .
Kumta ïa u Haman la syllen ha ka diengphasi kaba u la shna na ka beit u Mordekai . Nangta ka jingbitar u syiem ka la lama jai jai .
translation.en: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai . Then was the king s wrath pacified .

translation.kha: Ka la long ka suri ka khatsaw , bad ngi la shah ïalam kylleng ha ka duriaw Mediterranian da ka erïong . Kumba shiteng synñia ki maji ki la antad ba ngi la jan poi Ashan ka ryngkew .
translation.en: But when the fourteenth night was come , as we were driven up and down in Adria , about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country  ;

translation.kha: Ïa ka ri yn pynbat mar katjuh ha ki hynñiew bynta ; ka jait Judah kan sah ha la ka jaka shaphang shathie , bad ka jait Joseph ha la ka jaka shaphang shithi .
translation.en: And they shall divide it into seven parts : Judah shall abide in their coast on the south , and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north .

translation.kha: U sakhi uba lah ban shaniah , borabor u ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , hynrei u ngi lah ban shaniah , u ïathuh tang ïa kaba lam .
translation.en: A faithful witness will not lie : but a false witness will utter lies .

translation.kha: Haba u Kenan u la dap hynñiew snem ka rta , u la ïor khun shynrang , u Mahalalel ,
translation.en: And Cainan lived seventy years , and begat Mahalaleel :
When a child dies , it is particularly hard for the mother .
translation.kha: Haba u khyllung u iap , ka long ka ba eh da shisha ia ka kmie .
Ym donakor ban thoh ha phi , ko parabangeit , shaphang ki par bad ki khep hajan kine kiei kiei kin jia .
translation.en: But of the times and the seasons , brethren , ye have no need that I write unto you .
And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea , very much , until he left numbering  ; for it was without number .
translation.kha: La don kyrhai eh u kew kat haduh ba u Joseph um donkam shuh ban da thew ïa u — u la long kum u shyiap ka duriaw .
nong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ba ka kynroh jong ki kan khyllem . Ngan phah ïa u slap bajur . U phria un hap halor jongu ka , bad ka lyer bashabar tud beh pyrshah ïa ka .
translation.en: Say unto them which daub it with untempered mortar , that it shall fall : there shall be an overflowing shower  ; and ye , O great hailstones , shall fall  ; and a stormy wind shall rend it .

translation.kha: Kumta , haba phi ïadie ïathied khyndew para Israel , wat shukor paralok hi .
translation.en: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour , or buyest ought of thy neighbour s hand , ye shall not oppress one another :

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sien , ki nongbud jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis malade ki Pharisi ki Dang ïashahjingit . Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wan ha U Jisu bad kylli ïa u , Balei ba ki synran jong u Ïashong u Nongpynbaptis bad ki synran jong ki Pharisi ki shahjingit , katba ki Jong me kim shahjingit ?
translation.en: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast : and they come and say unto him , Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast , but thy disciples fast not ?
Thus I was  ; in the day the drought consumed me , and the frost by night  ; and my sleep departed from mine eyes .
translation.kha: Bunsien nga shahshitom na ka jingshit mynsngi bad na ka jingkhriat mynmiet . Ngam ju ïohthiah satia .
Man ka Sabbaton , u Aaron u dei ban buh ïa une u kpoh ha kham U Trai na ka bynta ki Israel kum ka jutang kaba neh junom .
translation.en: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the  Lord  continually , being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant .

translation.kha: To bishar hi da lade la ka long kaba dei ïa ka brai ban mudui ha U Blei ha ka jingïamane lang khlem da tap ïa la ka khlieh .
translation.en: Judge in yourselves : is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Une u long u shakri jong nga , uba sa pynshahthngan — Uta uba nga la jied , ha u nga smam sngewbit . Nga la pynïap ïa u da U Mynsiem jong nga , bad un wallam jingbishar hok ha man la ka jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Behold my servant , whom I uphold  ; mine elect , in whom my soul delighteth  ; I have put my spirit upon him : he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles .
O my threshing , and the corn of my floor : that which I have heard of the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , have I declared unto you .
translation.kha: Ko paid Israel jong nga , phi la shah shoh kumba shoh kew , hynrei mynta nga la pynbna ha phi ïa ka khubor babha ba nga la ïohsngew na U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei jong ki Israel .

Hobah ki tnum jongno ki rangbah synshar ka ïingsyiem jong ka Peresh bad Media kin jingsngewsih shaphang ka jinglwet jong ka hadien kin ong ïa la ki tnga jong ki shaphang kata shata ba ka sngi kan kut . Ki kynthei ha kyllan sawdong kin ym burom Shua ïa la ki tngaw , bad ki shynrang kin dap da ka jingbitar ïa la ki tnga .
translation.en: Likewise shall the ladies of Persia and Media say this day unto all the king s princes , which have heard of the deed of the queen . Thus shall there arise too much contempt and wrath .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynïohburom ïa ka jutang katba nga la pynjrong bad pha mynba pha dang set , bad ngan pynlong ka jutang bad pha ka shun neh junom .
translation.en: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with thee in the days of thy youth , and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant .

translation.kha: U la ïohknieh shwa ïa ki kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun masi borbah ; ki briew jong u ki ñiah ïa i'u ki jingri ha shuwa jong ki bad ki ong , “Kane ka dei ka jong u Dabid !
translation.en: And David took all the flocks and the herds , which they drave before those other cattle , and said , This is David s spoil .

translation.kha: Bad mynta , Ko Syiem Kynrad , nga kyrpad ïa phi ban shahshkor ïa nga bad ban leh ïa kawei kaba nga ong . Sngewbha wat phiah pat ïa de shiah ka byndi ha ka ïing u Jonathan . Lada phi ni kumta , da shisha ngan sa ïap hangta .
translation.en: Therefore hear now , I pray thee , O my lord the king : let my supplication , I pray thee , be accepted before thee  ; that thou cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe , lest I die there .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ïathuh ha phi! ïa kane , ba haba ka por ka poi ïa ki ban leh ïa kine khie kiei , phyrnai sa kynmaw ba nga la ïathuh ïa phi . Ngam shngiam la ïatih ha phi ïa kine ktieh kiei ha kaba mynnyngkong , naba por la ba-don lem bad pa’ .
translation.en: But these things have I told you , that when the time shall come , ye may remember that I told you of them . And these things I said not unto you at the beginning , because I was with you .

translation.kha: Ka dei ha ka lynti ha ka por satang sngur , ko Syiem Knidos , ba nga la ïohi ïa ka jingïakhaïi kaweh kham phyrnai ban ïa ka sngi , kaba wan na sahit bneng bad kaba tyngshaiñ baroh Sawdong ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah kiba la ïaleit lai bad nga .
translation.en: At midday , O king , I saw in the way a light from heaven , above the brightness of the sun , shining round about me and them which journeyed with me .
Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spake this unto him .
translation.kha: Ym don uwei na kita kiba la shong bam kiba la sngewthuh balei U Jisu u la ong ïa kane ha u .
Ym ni mano mano ban bam lane dih badno bun ban pynshahthngan ïa u mynba iba ieit babniah i ïan . Ym don mano mano ban pyn-i jingsngewlem , wat ïa uto uba la duh noh ïa la u kpa lane ïa ka kmie .
translation.en: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning , to comfort them for the dead  ; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother .
And the  Lord  said unto him , Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain , vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold . And the  Lord  set a mark upon Cain , lest any finding him should kill him .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u jubab ,  Em . Lada uno uno ruh u pynïap ïa me , yn sa pynïap hynñiew ki mynsiem ha ka jingpynhiarkput .  Kumta U  Trai  u buh ka dak ha u Kain ban maham ïano ïano ba ïashem ïa u ban ym pynïap ïa u .
Haseroth mem tip ? U la kulai ïa nga . Em , ngam tip , ko rangbah , la la jubab .
translation.en: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me , Knowest thou not what these be ? And I said , No , my lord .

translation.kha: Ki la ïajubab , Haba men shong halor ka khet jong me ha ka Hima kaba dap da ka burom jong me , sem kwah ba men shah ïa ngi ban shong bad me , uwei sha kamon jong me bad uwei sha kadiang jong me .
translation.en: They said unto him , Grant unto us that we may sit , one on thy right hand , and the other on thy left hand , in thy glory .

translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ko ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , shaniah ha U Blei jong phi bad wan phai pang sha u . Long kiba ïaineh bad kiba lehhok , Bad ap da kaba ïaishah ïa U Blei jong phira ban ai .
translation.en: Therefore turn thou to thy God : keep mercy and judgment , and wait on thy God continually .
Likewise , I say unto you , there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , nga ong ha phi , ki angel jong U Blei ki risa halor uwei u nongpop uba kylla-kaba-mut .

Bad kumta , ko ki paralok jongnga nga , katba phi daiñ ap ïa said ka Sngi , to leh ïa kaba bha den ka jong phi ban long kiba khleh thombor bad kiba khlem sha kynnoh pum ha khmied U Blei bad ban don ka jingïasuk bad u .
translation.en: Wherefore , beloved , seeing that ye look for such things , be diligent that ye may be found of him in peace , without spot , and blameless .

Then said the  Lord  unto me  ; This gate shall be shut , it shall not be opened , and no man shall enter in by it  ; because the  Lord  , the God of Israel , hath entered in by it , therefore it shall be shut .
translation.kha: Ka khyrdop ka khang , bad U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Kane ka khyrdop kan long ba la khang bad yn ym plie lano lano ruh . Yn ym don u briew ïa uba yn shah ban plie ïa ka , namar ma nga U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel , nga la rung lyngba jong ka . Kan sah ba la khang ïa ka .
Ngan ailad ïa ki Katto katne ban ïohlad na ka waitlam bad kin sakma hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , bad kin im kum kiba shiah ringmraw .
translation.en: Yet will I leave a remnant , that ye may have some that shall escape the sword among the nations , when ye shall be scattered through the countries .

translation.kha: ngan pynnoh junom ïa ka khet syiad jong me ha Israel , kumba nga la kular ha u Dabid u kpa jong me , da kaba nguh , ‘ Men ym kyrduh u briew u ban shong ha ka khet Israel .’
translation.en: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever , as I promised to David thy father , saying , There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel .
Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul , and told the tidings in the ears of the people : and all the people lifted up their voices , and wept .
translation.kha: Kita ki nonglamktien ki poi ha Gibeah ha kaba u Saul u shong , bad haba ki la ïathuh ha ki briew ïa kata ka khubor , baroh ki ïalynñiar da ka jingsngewsih .
Bad u Agabos u la ong ha u Phestos , Ïa une u briew la dei ban pyllait noh lymda u la ha apil sha u Patsha .
translation.en: Then said Agrippa unto Festus , This man might have been set at liberty , if he had not appealed unto Caesar .

translation.kha: Namar haba ka jinglong lyngdoh ka la kylla , ka dei ban don ruh ka jingkylla ha ka hukum .
translation.en: For the priesthood being changed , there is made of necessity a change also of the law .

translation.kha: bad u la ong ha U Trai , Balei keiñ ba me la pynjynjar sat ïa nga katne katne ? Balei ba ngam sngewbha ïa de ? Balei ba me la ai ha nga ka jingkitkhlieh ïa Kin ki paidlang baroh ?
translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant ? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight , that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Joshua , Kaei kaba nga leh mynta ka sngi kan pynlong ïa ki paid Israel baroh ban tdong shun burom ïa me kum u riewkhmat , bad Kin ïoh tip ba nga long lem ryngkat bad me Rumah nga la long bad u Moses .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , This day will I begin to magnify thee in the sight of all Israel , that they may know that , as I was with Moses , so I will be with thee .

And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin , and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh , and out of Simeon : for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance , when they saw that the  Lord  his God was with him .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki wan sha ka liang u Asa na Ephraim , Manasseh , bad Simeon , bad ki shong ki sah ha ka hima jong u , namar ki la ïohi ba U  Trai  u long lem bad u . U Asa u phah khot ïa ki baroh bad ïa ki paid Judah bad Benjamin .
Hynrei la don ka nongpynim ha ka ri Kanaan , bad ka la long kaba umjer shikatdei eh kat haduh ba u Abram u la leit jingjia shaphang shathie sha ka ri Ijipt ban shong ban hukum hangto shipor .
translation.en: And there was a famine in the land : and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there  ; for the famine was grievous in the land .

translation.kha: Bad ym dei u Amam uba la shah shukor ; dei ka kynthei kaba la shiah shukor bad pynheh ïa ka hukum U Blei .
translation.en: And Adam was not deceived , but the woman being deceived was in the transgression .

translation.kha: U Blei u la pynjop ha kine ki nongïathuhlypa ba ka jingtrei jyllang ki kam shym la long na ka bna ka jingpynkoit jong ki hi , hynrei na ka bynta jong phi , katba ki dang lah kren shaphang kito kiei kiei ïa ibha phi la ïohsngew mynta na ki nonglamktien kiba la pynmanbha ïa ka Khubor Babha da ka bor U Mynsiem! bakhuid ba la phah na bneng . Kinah ki long kiei kiei kiba wat ki angel ki thrang ban shemphang .
translation.en: Unto whom it was revealed , that not unto themselves , but unto us they did minister the things , which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven  ; which things the angels desire to look into .
Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant , when , lo , he had given his hand , and hath done all these things , he shall not escape .
translation.kha: U la pynkheiñ ïa la ka jingsmai bad ïa ka jingïateh lok kaba u la lah pynlong . U la leh ïa kine kiei kiei , bad mynta un ym ïohlait ban phet .
U balui u ai ïa ka pyrthuh ha ki bymman . U pynlong ïa baroh’ ki nongbishar Kiba matlah . Bad lada ym dei U Blei uba leh ïa kata , uei kaba leh ?
translation.en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked : he covereth the faces of the judges thereof  ; if not , where , and who is he ?
Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law , but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds .
translation.kha: Nga la shem ba um shym la leh kaei kaei kaba u dei ban ïap lane ban shah set byndi ; ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u ka dei bad ki jingkylli shaphang ka hukum jong ki hi .

translation.en: Ye have said , It is vain to serve God : and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance , and that we have walked mournfully before the  Lord  of hosts ?
translation.kha: Phi la ong , ‘ Kam myntoi ban shakri ïa U Blei . Kaei ka jingmyntoi ban leh ïa kaei kaba u ong lane kaba pyrshang ban pyn-i ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ba ngi sngewsih na ka bynta kaei kaba ngi la leh ?

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Sa kawei pat ka khubor ka la wan ha nga na U  Trai .
To kynmaw , A Balei jong per , ïa baroh’ kine ktien ktien kiba nga la lai na ka bynta ka Templ jong me bad ka jingmane jong ka .
translation.en: Remember me , O my God , concerning this , and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God , and for the offices thereof .
And God spake unto Israel in the visions of the night , and said , Jacob , Jacob . And he said , Here am I .
translation.kha: Te U Blei u kren ha u ha ka jingïohipaw mynmiet , bad u ong ,  Jakob , Jakob !  U ruh u jubab ,  Oi , nga hangne .
Hynriew sngi phiah ïalum jingbat , Hynrei ha ka sngi kob hynñiew , ka sngi shongshit , yn ym don ei ei .
translation.en: Six days ye shall gather it  ; but on the seventh day , which is the sabbath , in it there shall be none .

translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane ktang ban pynluin shisha ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kren lyngka u Isaïah u Nongïathuhlypa :
translation.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by Esaias the prophet , saying ,

translation.kha: Hynrei Kim shym la shahshkor lane kohnguh . Pynban , uwei imat baroh u ïai bteng ban long uba mutlop sad uba sniew kumba u ju long . Nga la hukum ïa ki ban bat ïa ka million , hynrei ki la kyntait . Kumta nga la wallam khashor jong ki baroh ïa ki jingpynim naba la batai ha ka .
translation.en: Yet they obeyed not , nor inclined their ear , but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart : therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant , which I commanded them to do  ; but they did them not .

translation.kha: Bun ynda u la kput jingmut ban pynpaw ïa la U Khun ha nga , khnang ba nga lah ban ïalap ïa ka khubor babha Shaphan jngai u ha ki Jentil , ngam shym la leit wad buit nano nano ,
translation.en: To reveal his Son in me , that I might preach him among the heathen ; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood :
And Moses called unto them  ; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him : and Moses talked with them .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u khot ïa ki , bad u Aaron lem bad ki nongïalam jong uta u paidlang ki ïaleit sha u , bad u Moses u ïakren bad ki .

translation.en: Surely he shall not be moved for ever : the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance .
translation.kha: U briew uba bha un ym bakla da lei lei ; yn ïai kynmaw borabor ïa u .
Phi ong ba U Trai u la ai ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ha phi ha Babilonia .
translation.en: Because ye have said , The  Lord  hath raised us up prophets in Babylon  ;

translation.kha: ha ka jingkhot kyrteng ïa ki shipai ym shym la don iwei ruh na Jabesh suba jubab .
translation.en: For the people were numbered , and , behold , there were none of the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead there .

translation.kha: U Tlai u la kren ha sa
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came unto me again , saying ,

translation.kha: Ki pawnam mala ki ba-ha-ïing jong ka , ki la ïasngew haduh katno U Trai u la long ka jingbha kaba phylla ïa ka , bun baroh ki la shadkmen lem bad ka .
translation.en: And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had shewed great mercy upon her  ; and they rejoiced with her .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , bhor ki paidbah Jerusalem’ kiba don ha Moab , Ammon , Edom dara ha kiei ki ri , ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la shuh katto katne ki nong Israel ban ïaisah ha Judah bad ba u la pynphong ïa u Delaïah u lat jong ki .
translation.en: Likewise when all the Jews that were in Moab , and among the Ammonites , and in Edom , and that were in all the countries , heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah , and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan  ;

translation.kha: To erlangthari uba bha ïa nga , u shakri jong me , khnang ba ngan ïoh im , bad kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong me .
translation.en: Deal bountifully with thy servant , that I may live , and keep thy word .
Because it is a trial , and what if the sword contemn even the rod ? it shall be no more , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Nga tynjuh ïa la ki briew , bad lada ki kyntait ban kylla-kaba-mut , kine kiei kiei baroh kin wan jia ha ki .

translation.en: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness , but unto holiness .
translation.kha: U Blei um shym la khot ïa ngi ban im ha ka jingthala , hynrei ha ka jinglongkhuid .

Ngin tei ka Templ ban ai burom ïa U Tlai U Blei jong nga . Kan long ka jaka bakhuid ha kaba ki bariew jong nga bad ma nga ngin mane ïa u da kaba thang ki jingiwbih da ki musla iwbih , bad ha kaba ngin ïai ai ki jingainguh ha u da u kpu kynthih , bad ha katba ngin ai ki jingtieng thrang man ka step bad janmiet , kumjuh pajut ha ki sngi Sabbaton , ki Jingrakhe Bnai Thymmai , bad kiwei pat ki sngi khuid ban ai burom ïa U Trai U Blei jong ngi . U la hukum ïa ki Jesreel ban ar ïa kane junom la jingmut .
translation.en: Behold , I build an house to the name of the  Lord  my God , to dedicate it to him , and to burn before him sweet incense , and for the continual shewbread , and for the burnt offerings morning and evening , on the sabbaths , and on the new moons , and on the solemn feasts of the  Lord  our God . This is an ordinance for ever to Israel .

translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki bri don pyndeng ïa ka . Ki baroh kin wanrah ïa la ki sdie , kin pyngngad ïa ki dieng Kedar kiba itynnat bad kin bret ïa ki ha ka ding .
translation.en: And I will prepare destroyers against thee , every one with his weapons : and they shall cut down thy choice cedars , and cast them into the fire .
And Moses took the blood , and sprinkled it on the people , and said , Behold the blood of the covenant , which the  Lord  hath made with you concerning all these words .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u shim ïa kata ka snam na ki dabor bad u synreit ïa ka ha uta u paidbah . U ong ,  Kane ka long ka snam kaba pynskhem ïa ka jutang kaba U  Trai  u la pynlong bad phi , mynba u ai ïa kine ki hukum baroh .
Ki nongbishar kiba pynshitom ïa umbiah shah pynrem , ken manbha bad kin ïoh ka nam babha .
translation.en: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight , and a good blessing shall come upon them .
When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it , he said unto them ,  Doth this offend you ?
translation.kha: Khlem da don ba ïathuh , U Jisu u la tip ba ki ïakhñium shaphang kane , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Hato kane ka pynlong ïa phi ba phin kwah iehnoh ?
Ki dei ki nongjapan ?
translation.en: Are they Japanese ?

translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa khiah ka burom kiba me la ai ha ar , kthang ba kan long kawei , wohnia ma me bad nga ngi longïing kadei .
translation.en: And the glory which thou gavest me I have given them  ; that they may be one , even as we are one :
And it came to pass at the end of two months , that she returned unto her father , who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed : and she knew no man . And it was a custom in Israel ,
translation.kha: Hadien ar bnai ka wan phai sha la u kpa . U leh kumba u la kular ha U  Trai  , bad ka la ïap haba ka dang sotti . Kane ka la long ka thymmei ïa ka ban bud kum ka rukom ha Israel

Haba nga la ïohi ba Kino shym wan ïarap ïa nga , na la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingkem malade nga khim ïa u pud ban ïaleh marpyrshah ïa ki ; bad U Trai u la ai ha nga ka jingjop halor jong ki . Te balei patan phi wan ba-bang ïaleh ïa nga mynsiem ?
translation.en: And when I saw that ye delivered me not , I put my life in my hands , and passed over against the children of Ammon , and the  Lord  delivered them into my hand : wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day , to fight against me ?
And it came to pass , that , as Jesus sat at meat in his house , many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples : for there were many , and they followed him .
translation.kha: Hadien kata U Jisu u leit bam ha ka ïing u Lebi . Don bun ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei kiba la shah kyntait na ka imlang ka sahlang kiba ïabud ïa U Jisu , bad bun na ki , ki la ïadon bynta bad u lem bad ki synran jong u ha ka miej bam .

Hynrei u la jubab ïa la u kpa , ‘ Ha khmied , baroh kine ki snem nga la ter kum u mraw na ka bynta jong phi , bad ngam pat ju saitlah ïa ki hukum jrong pa . Phi la ai aïu ïa nga ? Ym don wat tang kawei ka blang na ka bynta jong nga banbeiñ ïakhawai bad ki pakor lad nga !
translation.en: And he answering said to his father , Lo , these many years do I serve thee , neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment : and yet thou never gavest me a kid , that I might make merry with my friends :

translation.kha: Ki sha ïa ki kynjri kiba da ka ksiar nylla ba la jyrthiaw Kum u tyllai na ka bynta kata ka jingdeng shym .
translation.en: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends , of wreathen work of pure gold .

translation.kha: To ïeng joit bad khie leit shim ïa u , bad khroh ïa u . Ngan pynlong ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw na ki khun ki ksiew jongngi u .
translation.en: Arise , lift up the lad , and hold him in thine hand  ; for I will make him a great nation .

translation.kha: ban ai ka khubor ha u Lo-Ruhamah bad ha ki briew baroh jong ki jait Judah bad Benjamin :
translation.en: Speak unto Rehoboam , the son of Solomon , king of Judah , and unto all the house of Judah and Benjamin , and to the remnant of the people , saying ,

translation.kha: Hynrei u dieng sohwaiñ u jubab , ‘ Na ka bynta ban shihajar ïa phi , ngan hap sangeh ngab pynmih ïa ka waiñ jong nga , kaba pynkmen ïa ki blei bad ïa ki jingpyniwbih .’
translation.en: And the vine said unto them , Should I leave my wine , which cheereth God and man , and go to be promoted over the trees ?

translation.kha: Shisha , ka niam kam pynrieh palat ïa u briew , lada u sngewhun bad kaei kaba u don .
translation.en: But godliness with contentment is great gain .

translation.kha: U Tharai nongshukor u ong , Kumba da shisha nga longkmie U Blei uba im , ngan pynshitom ïa u na ka bynta ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka jingïaphet lakam kaba u la smai ha ka kyrteng jongngi nga ban bat .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; As I live , surely mine oath that he hath despised , and my covenant that he hath broken , even it will I recompense upon his own head .

translation.kha: bad ki nongsynshar jong phi ki la pyntngen ïa ka ïingkyntang jong nga . Kumta nga la Wallam ka jingpynjot ha Isaia ; nga shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban shad rkhiebeiñ .
translation.en: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary , and have given Jacob to the curse , and Israel to reproaches .
And the  Lord  said , My spirit shall not always strive with man , for that he also is flesh : yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan ym shah ïa ki briew ban im junom , ki long kiba dei ban ïap . Nangne sha khmat kin im ym palat ïa ka shispah arphew snem .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as they went in the way , a certain man said unto him , Lord , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang leit ha la ka lynti , uwei u briew u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ngan bud ïa me kat shaba me leit .

translation.en: But if a man walk in the night , he stumbleth , because there is no light in him .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u ïaid ha ka por mynmiet u jynthut , namar um don ka jingshai .
U Jeshua u la jubab , Hato phi ïitkhmih lynti ba ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha ka jingshongsuk ban leit khlem jingbam ? Ym kumta ! katsha u nongleitkurim u ei ryngkat bad ki , kmen ym shahthngan .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Can the children of the bridechamber fast , while the bridegroom is with them ? as long as they have the bridegroom with them , they cannot fast .
Ye worship ye know not what : we know what we worship : for salvation is of the Jews .
translation.kha: Phi ki nong Samaria phim da tip shai ïano phi mane ; hynrei ma ngi ki Jiw ngi tip ïano ngi mane , namar ka long na ki Jiw ba ka jingpynim ka wan .
Phan dih bad phan pynrngad ba-tyrkhong ïa ka , bad da ki lyngkhot ba la pait jong ka phan tar ïa ka shadem jong pha . Ma sa , U Trai Nongsynshar , to la kren .
translation.en: Thou shalt even drink it and suck it out , and thou shalt break the sherds thereof , and pluck off thine own breasts : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba la shah rah noh kum ki koidi na Jerusalem sha Babilonia ki kwah ban wallam ka jingtim hano hano , kin ino , ‘ To U Trai un ñiar ïa phi kum u Sedekaïah bad u Ahab , Kiba u syiem ka Babilonia u la syang im !’
translation.en: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon , saying , The  Lord  make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab , whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire  ;

translation.kha: U ïai-ong ïa ki , Paralok , nga kyrpad ïa pa’ , wat leh ïa kaba kum kane ka kam kaba sniew !
translation.en: And said , I pray you , brethren , do not so wickedly .

And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded , and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan , as the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel , and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged , and laid them down there .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ki bud ïa ki hukum jong u Joshua . Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Joshua , ki la shim khat-ar tylli ki maw napdeng jong ka Jordan , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel , ki la bah ïa ki sha ka jaka shong dara , bad ki buh ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: Behold , as wild asses in the desert , go they forth to their work  ; rising betimes for a prey : the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children .
translation.kha: Kumta kiba duk , kum ki kada khlaw , ki wad jingbam ha ka ri khlaw ba-tyrkhong ; ym don jaka hangno hangno ban shem jingbam na ka bynta ki khun jong ki .
U El u la ïohsngew ïa kata ka jingsawa dara u kylli , Ka jingsawa aïu kata ? Uta u rangbah u leit kloi kloi sha u Eliel don ïathaw ha u ïa kaban la jia baroh .
translation.en: And when Eli heard the noise of the crying , he said , What meaneth the noise of this tumult ? And the man came in hastily , and told Eli .

translation.kha: Hynrei khyndiat na phi phiah lait na ka jingtep nabar leit phai na Joppa sha Judah . Nangta kiba lait im kin tip ki Ktien jongno ki la wan jia shisha , ki jong ar ne ki jong ki .
translation.en: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Judah , and all the remnant of Judah , that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , shall know whose words shall stand , mine , or theirs .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Dibon ki kiaw ïa u lum ban ïam ha ka jaka mane bleithaw . Ki briew’ jong ka Jobab ki la ïam ha ka jingsngewsih ïa ki nongbeh jong ka Nebo bad Abida ; ki la khi ïa la ki khlieh bad ïa u ñiuhtmoh ha ka jingsngewsih .
translation.en: He is gone up to Bajith , and to Dibon , the high places , to weep : Moab shall howl over Nebo , and over Medeba : on all their heads shall be baldness , and every beard cut off .

translation.kha: U la ai ruh ha u ïa ki dur pynkhreh jong kita baroh kiba u don ha ka jingmut ïa ki phyllaw malu ïa ki kamra sawdong jong ki malu ïa ki kamra buh ïa ki tiar jngai ka Templ , bad ïa ki jingai jingsngewbha ba la jingpynkyntang sha U Trai .
translation.en: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit , of the courts of the house of the  Lord  , and of all the chambers round about , of the treasuries of the house of God , and of the treasuries of the dedicated things :
For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast , and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward  ;
translation.kha: Kata ka khubor ïa kaba la pynbna da ki angel ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ka long kaba shisha , bad uno uno u bym shym bud ïa ka lane u bym shym kohnguh ïa ka u shah pynshitom kumba ka dei hok ïa u .

Nga kynmaw ïa phi ha ki jingduwai jong nga ; malade nga kyrpang na U Blei’ jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , u KA uba dap da ka burom , ba un ai ha phi! ïa U Mynsiem! , u shun pynlong ïa phi kiba kata bad un pynpaw ha phin ïa U blem , khnang ba phin ïoh tip ïa u .
translation.en: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Father of glory , may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him :

translation.kha: Nga duwai ha U Blei ka Bneng , bad nangta nga ong ha u patsha , Lada ma me , ko syiem , me ei ka jingsngewbha ïa nga bad ai sngewbha ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga , shah ïa nga ba ngan rupa sha ka ri Judah , sha ka nongbah ha kaba la tep ïa ki kpa tymmen jong to , khnang ba nga haw ban tei pat ïa ka nongbah .
translation.en: And I said unto the king , If it please the king , and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight , that thou wouldest send me unto Judah , unto the city of my fathers  sepulchres , that I may build it .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , un khi biang ïa la u ñiuhkhlieh , u ñiuhtmoh , u ñiuhmat , malade u shñiuh baroh na ka met jong u ; un sait ruh ïa la ki jaiñ , bad un sum un sleh de , pynlang nangta un sa longïng uba khuid .
translation.en: But it shall be on the seventh day , that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows , even all his hair he shall shave off : and he shall wash his clothes , also he shall wash his flesh in water , and he shall be clean .

And the  Lord  said unto Aaron , Thou and thy sons and thy father s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary : and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Aaron ,  Ma me , ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ki Lebi ruh , phin hap shah ïa kiei kiei kiba mih na kano kano ka jingleh palat ha ka jingshakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga , hynrei tang ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me kin shah ïa kiei kiba mih ha ka jingshakri ha ka jinglong lyngdoh .

translation.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound , and with musical instruments of God . And the sons of Jeduthun were porters .
translation.kha: Ïa u Heman bad u Jeduthun ruh la buh ban peit ïa ki turoi bad ki shakuriaw bad kiwei ki jingtem ba pyndonkam ha ka por ba rwai ïa ki jingrwai ïaroh . Ïa ki dkhot jong ka kur u Jeduthun , la buh ban ap phira ïa ki khyrdop .

Phi dei ban kynthih , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba buhnud nga la thnam ban wan jingjaw ïa phi , hynrei don kaei kai kob la ju khangkdong ïa nga borabor na kaba leh Kumta . Nga kwah ban jop ïa ki myn napdeng jong phi ruh , kitab nga la ju kun hapdeng kiwei ki Jentil .
translation.en: Now I would not have you ignorant , brethren , that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you , (but was let hitherto ,) that I might have some fruit among you also , even as among other Gentiles .

translation.kha: U nonglamktien u la ïathuh ha u Dabid , Ki Israel ki la ïakular ban ai jingsuhsieng noh ïa u Absalom .
translation.en: And there came a messenger to David , saying , The hearts of the men of Israel are after Absalom .

translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , to phet lyngba ki surok bah jong phi ! To khmih sawdong ! Peit hi da lade ! To wad ïa ki jaka ïit ! ithuh phi lah ban shem utai u briew uba leh ïa kaba dei malu uba Pyrshang ban ïadih ha U Blei ? Ladan phi lah , U Trai un karta ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem , and see now , and know , and seek in the broad places thereof , if ye can find a man , if there be any that executeth judgment , that seeketh the truth  ; and I will pardon it .

translation.kha: Lai ñiut ki nong Judia ki wan ban ïakynduh ïa u ; u rangbah synshar uba dih peit ïa ka ïingsyiem , u Eliakim u khun jong u khyllah ; u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u Shebna ; bad u rangbah synshar ba dat peit ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh , u Joah u khunlung jngai u Asaph .
translation.en: Then came forth unto him Eliakim , Hilkiah s son , which was over the house , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , Asaph s son , the recorder .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u mihpaw , u da phet krad na u Saul , mala u la leit sha u Akhish u sahmiet ka Hangta .
translation.en: And David arose , and fled that day for fear of Saul , and went to Achish the king of Gath .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong ïa u Joshua
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , saying ,
Now these are the nations which the  Lord  left , to prove Israel by them , even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan  ;
translation.kha: Kumta te , U  Trai  u iehnoh katto katne ki jaitbynriew ha ka ri ban tynjuh ïa ki Israel ki bym pat mad ïa ki thma ha ri Kanaan .

translation.en: Knowing this , that our old man is crucified with him , that the body of sin might be destroyed , that henceforth we should not serve sin .
translation.kha: Bad ngi tip ba ïa ka jinglong barim jong ngi la pynïap noh bad U Khrist halor ka diengphna , khnang ba ïa ka bor jong ka jinglong pop jong ngi , yn pynjot noh , khnang ba ngin ym long shuh ki mraw jong ka pop .
Bad U Jisu u la ong ha u , To khie joit bad leit ; ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .
translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Arise , go thy way : thy faith hath made thee whole .
They are of the world : therefore speak they of the world , and the world heareth them .
translation.kha: Kito ki nongïathuhlypa balamler , ki kren shaphang kiei kiei ki jong ka pyrthei , bad ka pyrthei ka shahshkor ïa ki , namar ki long ki jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt , which the head or tail , branch or rush , may do .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ha Ijipt , uba riewspah ne uba duk , uba donnam ne u bym donnam , uba lah ban tyrwa ban ïarap .

Phi khem lynti ba ka Ijipt kuna ïarap ïa phi , hynrei kata kan lama kumba pyndonkam ïa u khah kum u diengduh — un kdiah Bad un dung ïa ka kti jong phi . Kata ka dei kaei kaba u syiem ka Ijipt u long haba myn mano ki shaniah tylliat ha u .
translation.en: Now , behold , thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed , even upon Egypt , on which if a man lean , it will go into his hand , and pierce it : so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him .

translation.kha: Bad kaei ka dei ka jingmut jong ka : Ka dak jingkheiñ , U Blei u la kheiñ ïa ki sngi jong ka hima jong phi bad u la wallam ïa ka sha ka jingkut ;
translation.en: This is the interpretation of the thing : MENE  ; God hath numbered thy kingdom , and finished it .
And he said unto him , My lord knoweth that the children are tender , and the flocks and herds with young are with me : and if men should overdrive them one day , all the flock will die .
translation.kha: U Jakob u phai ktien ,  Phi tip ba ki khynnah ki tlot , bad nga dei ruh ban pyrkhat shaphang ki langbrot bad ki jingri kiba dang ai buiñ . Lada yn ñiah jubor ïa ki wat tang shi sngi ruh , baroh ki jingri kin ïap lut .
Ïa ka jingsngewmeng dei ban pynshitom , khnang ba ki briew ki bym da sngewthuh bha kin ïoh jingkhie . Lada phi! long uba pynstad , phin ïoh jinghikai haba pynbeit ïa phi .
translation.en: Smite a scorner , and the simple will beware : and reprove one that hath understanding , and he will understand knowledge .
From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you : for morning by morning shall it pass over , by day and by night : and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report .
translation.kha: Kan shoh bad kan ïai shoh ïa phi , na kawei ka step sha kawei pat . Phin hap ban shah ïa ka bad sngi bad miet . Kawei pa kawei ka khubor thymmai na U Blei kan wanrah ïa ka jingshyrkhei bathymmai !
nangta ka durblei ka la aiti ïa kiba ïap jyllang ka . Ka jingïap bad kumjuh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ki la afi ïa kiba ïap bakha ki la bat . Bad ïa barhem la kotbah kat kum kadei kaba ki la leh .
translation.en: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it  ; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them : and they were judged every man according to their works .

translation.kha: Ngin ïathuh ïa ka shatei ban shahshkor ïa ki ban leit bad ïa ka sharati ban ym batbor noh ïa ki . Ai ba ki briew jong nga ki wan phai na ki ri bajhieh , na man la ki bynta baroh jong ka pyrthuh .
translation.en: I will say to the north , Give up  ; and to the south , Keep not back : bring my sons from far , and my daughters from the ends of the earth  ;

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , baroh ki paid Israel kiba don ha Moab , Ahiman , Edom bad ha kiwei ki ri , ki la jingsngewsih ba u syep ka Babilonia u la shah katto katne ki nong Israel ban ïaisah ha Jehud bad ba u la pynlong ïa u Gedalaïah u lalot jong ki .
translation.en: Likewise when all the Jews that were in Moab , and among the Ammonites , and in Edom , and that were in all the countries , heard that the king of Babylon had left a remnant of Judah , and that he had set over them Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan  ;

translation.kha: ka Kedemoth , bad ka Mephaath , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: Kedemoth with her suburbs , and Mephaath with her suburbs  ; four cities .

And speak unto him , saying , Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , saying , Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH  ; and he shall grow up out of his place , and he shall build the temple of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa u ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong , ‘ U briew ïa uba la khot U Tnat un manbha ha kaba u don bad un tei ïa ka Templ jong U  Trai .
Wat mane ïa uwei pang u blei hynrei tyngkan ïa nga .
translation.en: Thou shalt have no other gods before me .

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Japheth — u Gomer , u Magog , u Madai , u Jaban , u Tabeel , u Meshek , pynlang u Tyros — ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na ki .
translation.en: The sons of Japheth  ; Gomer , and Magog , and Madai , and Javan , and Tubal , and Meshech , and Tiras .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong ka Rishathaim bad jong ka Pekod . Pynphai bad pynim ïa ki . lieh ïa Kiei kiei bhor ïa kiba nga hukum ïa phi . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Go up against the land of Merathaim , even against it , and against the inhabitants of Pekod : waste and utterly destroy after them , saith the  Lord  , and do according to all that I have commanded thee .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan hiar na u lum , ki paidbah babun ki la bud ïa u .
translation.en: When he was come down from the mountain , great multitudes followed him .

Speak not evil one of another , brethren . He that speaketh evil of his brother , and judgeth his brother , speaketh evil of the law , and judgeth the law : but if thou judge the law , thou art not a doer of the law , but a judge .
translation.kha: Wat ïa-wohnia para ma phi , ko parabangeit jong nga . Uno uno uba wohnia ïa u parabangeit ne bishar ïa u , u wohnia ïa ka Hukum bad u bishar ïa ka . Lada phi bishar ïa ka Hukum , te phim long shuh uba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , hynrei uwei uba bishar ïa ka .

translation.en: Wherefore thou art great , O  Lord  God : for there is none like thee , neither is there any God beside thee , according to all that we have heard with our ears .
translation.kha: Katno me long uba khraw ; A  Trai  Nongsynshar ! Ym don uwei pat uba kum ma me , ngi la ju tip ba dei tang ma me hi uba long U Blei .
Ki mih na bakhia ha ka sngi bajngum jongu u bnai jingainong , mala da ka jingïarap U Blei , ki poi ha Jerusalem ha ka sngi banyngkong jong u bnai uba syang .
translation.en: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon , and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem , according to the good hand of his God upon him .
But the eyes of the wicked shall fail , and they shall not escape , and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki bymman kin peit sawdong ha ka jinglyng-a bad kin shem ba ym don lynti ban phet ïap . Tang kawei ka jingkyrmen ïa ki ka long ba ka jingïap kan wan .
U Asa u leh ïa kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai , kumba u Dabid u kpa thnum jong u , u la sa .
translation.en: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  , as did David his father .

translation.kha: Kumba U Trai’ u la hukum ïa u Jeshua , la ai shi bynta na ka jaka jong ka —Judah ha u Kalah u khun jyllang u Jephunneh , na ka jait Judith . U la ïohpdiang ïa ka Hebron , ka nongbah kaba dei jongngi u Arba , u kpa jong u Anak .
translation.en: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah , according to the commandment of the  Lord  to Joshua , even the city of Arba the father of Anak , which city is Hebron .

translation.kha: ksan la don ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba ju , kaba la pynkheiñ ïa ki nongrim jongu ka byndi . Shisyndon ki jingkhang barhem ki la peiñ , sad ki kynthih ki la hap na ki koidi .
translation.en: And suddenly there was a great earthquake , so that the foundations of the prison were shaken : and immediately all the doors were opened , and every one s bands were loosed .

translation.kha: Naba kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai , U blei ki Israel , u ong : ‘ katai ka pliang kan ym thylli purew lap uta u klong un nym erlangthari khlem umphniang shuwa kata ka sngi ba nga , U Trai kan pha slap .’
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , The barrel of meal shall not waste , neither shall the cruse of oil fail , until the day that the  Lord  sendeth rain upon the earth .

translation.kha: ianga ki la poi , u Samuel u ïoh ïa u Eliab u ïakhun jngai u Jesse bun u ong ha laiñ , Une uba ainong hangne ha khmat U Trai da shaid u dei uba U la jied .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when they were come , that he looked on Eliab , and said , Surely the  Lord s  anointed is before him .

translation.kha: ( Uta uba la ïohi ïa kane ba ka jia u la krai shaphang jong ka , khnang ba ma Phin mad phin ïoh ngat . Kaei kaba u la ong ka long kaba shisha , bad u tip ba u kren ïa ka jingshisha . )
translation.en: And he that saw it bare record , and his record is true : and he knoweth that he saith true , that ye might believe .

translation.kha: Ki la jubab , Bah , ngi la imat ïa ka namar ngi la tip) shisha ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa u Moses u shakri jong u ban ai ha phi ïa ka ri baroh kawei , bad ban pynïap ïa ki bariew baroh’ kiba shongduh ha ka katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat . Ngi la leh ïa ka namar ba ngi la sngewsheptieng ïa phi ; ngi kein ha ka jingsyier ïa la ka jingim .
translation.en: And they answered Joshua , and said , Because it was certainly told thy servants , how that the  Lord  thy God commanded his servant Moses to give you all the land , and to destroy all the inhabitants of the land from before you , therefore we were sore afraid of our lives because of you , and have done this thing .

translation.kha: Me la shong ha Eden , ka kper jong U Blei , bun me dong ïa ki mawlynnai ba bun jait : ki Rubi pynlang ki Diamond ; u Tahpenes , u Beryl , u Karnelian bad u Jasper ; ki Sapphir , ki Emerald , bad ki Ginath . Me kein ki jingdeng da ka ksiew . Ïa ki la shna na ka bynshet jong me ha ka sngi ba la thaw ïa me .
translation.en: Thou hast been in Eden the garden of God  ; every precious stone was thy covering , the sardius , topaz , and the diamond , the beryl , the onyx , and the jasper , the sapphire , the emerald , and the carbuncle , and gold : the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created .

translation.kha: nga pynriewspah ïa kito kiba ieit ïa nga , da kaba pyndap ïa ki ïing jngai ki da ki jingkynshew .
translation.en: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance  ; and I will fill their treasures .

translation.kha: Buh sanspah tylli ki kyrsiew ha ka jingkup katba nyngkong , bad sa sanphew tylli pat ha ka rmiang lad ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba khatduh ba la suh lai ha ka jingkit kaba ar . Pynphai marpyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain , and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second  ; that the loops may take hold one of another .

translation.kha: Ai ba un long kum kito ki nongbah uba U Trai u la pynjot khlem jingisynei . Ai un ïohsngew ïa ka jingud pang ha ka por mynstep bad ka jingmaham thma ha ka jer shiteng sngur ,
