translation.en: And let that man be as the cities which the  Lord  overthrew , and repented not : and let him hear the cry in the morning , and the shouting at noontide  ;

translation.kha: Lada jied ba phi lap ïa ka skum sim ha u dieng ne ha khyndew lem bad ïa ka sim kmie kabu pdem ïa ki pylleng lieng kaba kdup ïa la ki khun , phim dei shun kem ïa ka sim kmie .
translation.en: If a bird s nest chance to be before thee in the way in any tree , or on the ground , whether they be young ones , or eggs , and the dam sitting upon the young , or upon the eggs , thou shalt not take the dam with the young :

And when I was present with you , and wanted , I was chargeable to no man : for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied : and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you , and so will I keep myself .
translation.kha: Bad ha ka por ba nga la don bad phi , ngam shym la pynkhuslai ïa phi ban ïarap haba nga la donkam pisa ; ki parabangeit kiba la wan na Makedonia ki la wanrah sha nga ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la donkam . Kum ha kaba mynshuwa , kumta ruh ha ka lawei : Da lei lei ngan ym bankhia ïa phi !
U symboh u nguh ha u , Nga la phohsniew ïa ka jingphohsniew , malade ym Don mano Mano ba lah Ban batai ïa ka . La ïaheh ha nga ba me lah ba-bang batai ïa ki jingphohsniew .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I have dreamed a dream , and there is none that can interpret it : and I have heard say of thee , that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it .

translation.kha: Ki aiñ jong me ki neh bymjukut , A Trai , bad ka Templ jongno me ka long kaba khuid da bashisha , jongno la junom .
translation.en: Thy testimonies are very sure : holiness becometh thine house , O  Lord  , for ever .

translation.kha: Ki Libni ki rah ïa ka Synduk ka jyntang U Trei bad ïa Katai ka synduk ha kaba don kita ki dulir kiba da ka ksiar bad ki buh ïa ki halor uta u mawbah . Nahath ki nong Beth Shemesh ki keiñ ïa ki jingiaseng stong bad ïa kiwei! bapaw ki jingkñia ha U Trai .
translation.en: And the Levites took down the ark of the  Lord  , and the coffer that was with it , wherein the jewels of gold were , and put them on the great stone : and the men of Beth–shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Khidon u tei hangta ka duwan ïa U Trai bad u khot kyrteng ïa ka , U Trai u long ka Jingsuk . ( Ka dang ïohnong ha Ophrah , kaba dei jong ki kur jyllang u Abieser . )
translation.en: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the  Lord  , and called it Jehovah–shalom : unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abi–ezrites .

translation.kha: Kin pynrem ïa u sha ka jingïap bad kin Aiti ïa u ha ki Jentil , ki ban krenbeiñ ïa u , kin sliew ïa u , bad kin sahnarphna ïa u ; hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynïapmat ïa u .
translation.en: And shall deliver him to the Gentiles to mock , and to scourge , and to crucify him : and the third day he shall rise again .
These be they who separate themselves , sensual , having not the Spirit .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki briew kiba pynlong ki jingïapait , kiba shah ïalam ha ki jingkwah ba kynja doh jong ki , ki bym don U Mynsiem .
Ngam la shah riam Kum ka sim ha ki nongshun ki bym don rupa ban isih ïa nga .
translation.en: Mine enemies chased me sore , like a bird , without cause .
Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places , yet unto the  Lord  their God only .
translation.kha: Wat la ki paidbah ki ïai bteng ban ai jingainguh thang ha kiwei ki jaka mane , ki ainguh ïa ki tang sha U  Trai .
U Trai un pynïong ïa ki longïing jongno ki briew kiba sarong , hynrei un ïada ïa ki jingjrong jingem jong ka riewkynthei .
translation.en: The  Lord  will destroy the house of the proud : but he will establish the border of the widow .
Behold , the people shall rise up as a great lion , and lift up himself as a young lion : he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey , and drink the blood of the slain .
translation.kha: Ka jaitbynriew Israel ka long kum u sing uba khrawbor ; U bym shongthait tad haduh ba u la lah patar bad bam lut khoit , Haduh ba un da dep dih ïa ka snam jong kito kiba u la pynïap .
Nga pah sha phin u nongshna jingshalan Uba stad malade uba tnat bha , suba kyrteng u Huram .
translation.en: And now I have sent a cunning man , endued with understanding , of Huram my father s ,

translation.kha: Shisien , katba ki Israel ki dang don ha ka ri khlaw , la lap ïa uwei u briew uba dang lut diengïap ha ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness , they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day .

translation.kha: Haba uno a u khot Sngewbha ïa phi sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim , wat shang ha ki jaka bakyrpang . Ka lah ban jliah ba uno uno uba kham donkam ban ïa phi u la shah ïakhot sngewbha ,
translation.en: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding , sit not down in the highest room  ; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him  ;

translation.kha: Kajuh kaei kaei kan jia ïa ka bapyllun kumba ka la jia ïa ka Sodom bad Gomorrah , haba nga la pynjot ïa ki bad ïa ki shnong kiba marjan . Yn ym don ba shong shuh hangta . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof , saith the  Lord   ; so shall no man abide there , neither shall any son of man dwell therein .

translation.kha: Ki Jentil kim don ïa ka Hukum ; hynrei haba ki imat da ka jingtynjuh ha lade ïa kaei kaba ka lawbah ka ïa-dawa , ki long ka hukum ïa lade , wat la kim don ka Hukum .
translation.en: For when the Gentiles , which have not the law , do by nature the things contained in the law , these , having not the law , are a law unto themselves :

translation.kha: Ki shipai Philistia ki ïalam bad ki wan sher dara ha Shunem ; u Saul pat u lumlang ïa ki Israel baroh bad ki sieh dara ha u Lum Gilboa .
translation.en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together , and came and pitched in Shunem : and Saul gathered all Israel together , and they pitched in Gilboa .

translation.kha: Kaei kabu ai jingim dem U Mynsiem jong U Blei ; ka bor briew kam myntoi ei ei ruh em . Ki ktien kiba nga la kren ha phi ki wallam ïa U mynhynne ba ai jingrem jong U Blei .
translation.en: It is the spirit that quickeneth  ; the flesh profiteth nothing : the words that I speak unto you , they are spirit , and they are life .

translation.kha: Nalorkata u nongïathuhlypa Josaïah u sien Sha u syiem Hesekaïah bad u kylli , Nangno kine ki rangbah ki la wan bad ki la ong aïu ïa me ? U Hesekaïah u jingbabe , Ki la wanpaw na ka ri kaba jngai , na Babilonia .
translation.en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah , and said unto him , What said these men ? and from whence came they unto thee ? And Hezekiah said , They are come from a far country , even from Babylon .
Wherefore come out from among them , and be ye separate , saith the Lord , and touch not the unclean thing ; and I will receive you ,
translation.kha: Bad kumta U Trai u ong ,  Phi dei ban iehnoh ïa ki bad pynïakhlad ïa lade na ki . Wat ïadon bynta bad kaei kaei ka bymkhuid , bad ngan pdiang ïa phi .
Bad nangne u la ïan haba u la tymmen bha .
translation.en: So Job died , being old and full of days .

translation.kha: U Trai um shah ïa ki briew kiba bha baneh shahthngan , hynrei u khñiang ïa ki bymman baneh ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah .
translation.en: The  Lord  will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish : but he casteth away the substance of the wicked .

translation.kha: Me Kam ba kaei kaba me ong ka long kaba shisha ; me kam ba me long naba sngur ha ki khmat U Blei .
translation.en: For thou hast said , My doctrine is pure , and I am clean in thine eyes .
And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: Da kumta keiñ u Joshua u jop thiaw ïa ki Amalek .
U Blei u kwah ïa phira ban lama kiba Khuid bad kiba loit phar na ka jingjakhlia ka jingawria .
translation.en: For this is the will of God , even your sanctification , that ye should abstain from fornication :

translation.kha: Ha u to ai ba kan long ka bor junom ! Amen .
translation.en: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .

translation.kha: Ka ding ka daiñ ban ïa-ai meh lynter halor ka duwan bad ym dien ban shah ba Kan lip noh .
translation.en: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar  ; it shall never go out .
Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the  Lord  continually , being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant .
translation.kha: Man ka Sabbaton , u Aaron u dei ban buh ïa une u kpu ha khmat U  Trai  na ka bynta ki Israel kum ka jutang kaba neh junom .
bad pynlong ïa ngi ka hima jong ki lyngdoh ban shakri ïa U Blei bad U Kpa jong u . Ha U Jisu Khrist , to un-long ka bur bad ka bor junom la junom ! Amon .
translation.en: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father  ; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .
And hope maketh not ashamed ; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingkyrmen ka ai ha ngi ka jingkmen , namar U Blei u la theh noh ïa ka jingieit jong u ha ki dohnud jong ngi lyngba U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba long ka jingai sngewbha jong U Blei ïa ngi .

translation.en: And Laban said , This heap is a witness between me and thee this day . Therefore was the name of it called Galeed  ;
translation.kha: U Laban u ong ha u Jakob ,  Kane ka kynton maw kan long ka jingpynkynmaw ïa ngi baroh ar ngut .  Namar kata , la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Galeed .

translation.en: He cropped off the top of his young twigs , and carried it into a land of traffick  ; he set it in a city of merchants .
translation.kha: kaba u la rah sha ka ri jingkhaïi bad u la buh ha ka nongbah ki nongkhaïi .

translation.en: And the king went forth , and all his household after him . And the king left ten women , which were concubines , to keep the house .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u phet noh , da ka jingsynran lem ka longïing jong u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh , lait noh ki shiphew ngut ki tnga kliar , ïa kiba u la iehnoh shadien ban sumar ïa ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place , because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel , and because of their transgressions in all their sins : and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation , that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom un pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam ban pynkhuid ïa ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam namar ka jingbymkhuid jong ki Israel bad namar ki pop jong ki baroh . U dei ban leh kumne ha ka Ïingjaiñ namar ka ïeng hapdeng ka jaka shong dara , ïa kaba la ñiew ba ka long ka bymkhuid .
Naba phi hi da lade Phi tip bha ba ka Sngi jngai U Trai kan wan kum u nongtuh mynmiet .
translation.en: For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night .
And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens , and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain , and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work .
translation.kha: U la pynbeit hynñiewphew hajar ngut na ki ban kit ïa ki tiar ki tar bad phraphew hajar ngut ban shtah maw ha ki jaka lum , bad u la thung lai hajar hynriewspah ngut ki nongpynïaidkam ki ban pynthikna ba yn pyndep ïa ka kam .
Hato phim kynmaw ? Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane baroh mynba to dang don lem malade phi .
translation.en: Remember ye not , that , when I was yet with you , I told you these things ?
I called upon the  Lord  in distress : the  Lord  answered me , and set me in a large place .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingkordit jong nga , nga la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ; u la jubab ïa nga bad u la pyllait ïa nga .
Sa shisien pat nga maham ba uno uno u briew suba shah ïa lade ban nujor u pynbor ban Kohnguh ïa ka sah” baroh kawei .
translation.en: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised , that he is a debtor to do the whole law .

translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la poi , ngan sa ai ïa ki shithi jingpynithuh shiah kito kiba phin la mynhynnin , bad ban phah ïa ki ban leit rah ïa ka jingai jong phi sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And when I come , whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters , them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem .

translation.kha: bad ar tylli ki tnga kiba ïabiang ktang ba yn lah ban pyndait lang ïa kita ki jingker . Baroh kita ki jingker ki dei ban don ïa kine ki tnaw .
translation.en: Two tenons shall there be in one board , set in order one against another : thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Ka jingbitar jong nga kan meh lep kum ka ding , bad kad thang duh katne don ha sla pyrthei . Kan purim de shaduh ñiamra , bad kan ïaryngkat ïa ki tynrai Jong ki lumbah .
translation.en: For a fire is kindled in mine anger , and shall burn unto the lowest hell , and shall consume the earth with her increase , and set on fire the foundations of the mountains .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ong ha u , ‘ Ko kyndiang , u la ni lypa shiphew tylli ki sbai ksiar !’
translation.en: ( And they said unto him , Lord , he hath ten pounds . )
And say to Archippus , Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord , that thou fulfil it .
translation.kha: Bad ong ïa u Arkhippos ,  Pynthikna ban pyndep ïa ka kam kaba la ai ha me ha ka jingshakri ïa U Trai .
Kane ka dem kaei ba ngin leh : ngim ïakynting sbai bad ngin jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Gibeah .
translation.en: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah  ; we will go up by lot against it  ;

translation.kha: Ki wait rung shapoh bad ki shem ïa kata ka bleithaw na ïing ha ka jingthiah bad ïa ka syngkhlieh kaba da u shñiuh blang ha khlem jong kata .
translation.en: And when the messengers were come in , behold , there was an image in the bed , with a pillow of goats  hair for his bolster .

And the  Lord  said unto me , Son of man , mark well , and behold with thine eyes , and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the  Lord  , and all the laws thereof  ; and mark well the entering in of the house , with every going forth of the sanctuary .
translation.kha: Nga la dem pyllup ha ka khyndew , bad U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ,  Ko khun u briew , shahshkor ïa kaei kaei baroh ba me ïohi bad ïohsngew . Ngan ïathuh ïa me ïa ki aiñ bad ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ka Templ . Khmih bha ïa kiba kumno ki briew la shah ban leit shapoh bad mih shabar ka Templ bad ïa kiba kumno ki briew ym shah .
ka umphniang na ka boitha ki sharak , ki musla na ka bynta ka umphniang pynsleh bad na ka bynta ka jingibeiñ ;
translation.en: And oil for the light , and spices for anointing oil , and for the sweet incense ,

translation.kha: Hynñiew ki tang mar ïarung ïa ka ri ha Adam , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jingot kaweh nga la ïateh bad ki .
translation.en: But they like men have transgressed the covenant : there have they dealt treacherously against me .
Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth ; fornication , uncleanness , inordinate affection , evil concupiscence , and covetousness , which is idolatry :
translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynïap troiñ , te , ïa ki jingkwah brai ba kynja pyrthei kiba trei hapoh jong phi , kum ka jingawria , ka jingkhlem-akor , ka jingkwah brai , ki jingkwah basniew , bad ka jinglalot (naba ka jinglalot ka long kawei pat ka dur jong ka jingmane bleithaw) .
Ïa ka jingbymman ki Israel bad ki pop jong ki la buh jingthoh , bad ïa ki jingthoh la buh bha khep .
translation.en: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up  ; his sin is hid .
And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter : now his sons were with his cattle in the field : and Jacob held his peace until they were come .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la tip ba la pynkheiñ burom ïa ka khun jong u ; hynrei namar ba ki khun shynrang jong u ki dang don sha ki pyntha bad la ki jingri , um shym leh ei ei tad haduh ba kin da wan phai .
namar ka shispah kam neh junom . Ym don wat ki hima ruh ki ba neh junom .
translation.en: For riches are not for ever : and doth the crown endure to every generation ?

translation.kha: Hynrei kane baroh ka la lah jia khnang ban pynlong ïa kaei kaban ki nongïathuhlypa ki la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ban jia shisha . Nangta baroh ki synran ki la ieh ïa u bad ki la ïaphet ei .
translation.en: But all this was done , that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled .  Then all the disciples forsook him , and fled .

translation.kha: Nangta ki mynhynne na Haseroth bad ki pynïeng dara ha ka ri khlaw jong ka phan .
translation.en: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth , and pitched in the wilderness of Paran .
And if thou say in thine heart , Wherefore come these things upon me ? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered , and thy heels made bare .
translation.kha: Lada pha kylli balei kane baroh ka la jia ha pha — balei ba ki jaiñ jong pha ki la kad noh bad pha la shah batbor — ka dei namar ba ka pop jong pha ka long kaba shyrkhei .
ka Dorbar ( harud duriaw ) , Goiim ( ha Galilaïa ) ,
translation.en: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor , one  ; the king of the nations of Gilgal , one  ;
But he shall say , I am no prophet , I am an husbandman  ; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth .
translation.kha: Pynban , un ong , ‘ Ngam dei u nongïathuhlypa . Nga long u nongrep — nga la rep ha ka khyndew baroh shi rta ka jingim jong nga .’
kumto te , ngim kren ha ki ktien ba la hikai da ka jingstad briew , hynrei ha ki ktien ba la hikai da U Mynsiem , main ngi batai ïa ki jingshisha ba kynja mynsiem ha kito kiba don U Mynsiem! .
translation.en: Which things also we speak , not in the words which man s wisdom teacheth , but which the Holy Ghost teacheth ; comparing spiritual things with spiritual .

translation.kha: U Solomon u la synshar ïa ka jaka baïar kaba sha sepngi jong ka wah Ïuphratis , naduh Tiphsah kaba ha Ïuphratis haduh shaphang Sepngi ka nongbah Gasa . Baroh ki syiem babha sha synñiang jrong ka Ïutikhos ki la hap hapoh jong u , bad u la don ha ka jingïasuk bad ki ri ba-bang baroh .
translation.en: For he had dominion over all the region on this side the river , from Tiphsah even to Gaza , over all the kings on this side the river : and he had peace on all sides round about him .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la wallam ïa phi ha U Khereth Jisu , bad U Blei u la pynlong ïa U Khreh ngab erlangthari ka jingsyiad jong ngi . Da u , la pynskuiñ ïa ngi bad U Blei ; ngi long ki briew bakhuid jong U Blei sad la pyllaitluid ïa ngi .
translation.en: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus , who of God is made unto us wisdom , and righteousness , and sanctification , and redemption :

translation.kha: U Trai u la bthat ïa por Ban ong , Ko ki syiem jong ka Judah bad ki bariew jong ka Jeremaïah , to shahshkor ïa kamai kaba ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Borabor , U Blei jong ka Israel , nga don ban ong . nur wallam kaba kum kane ka jingpynjot ha kane ka dik ba uwei pa uwei baroh suba ïohsngew shaphang jong ka un kyndit .
translation.en: And say , Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , O kings of Judah , and inhabitants of Jerusalem  ; Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , the which whosoever heareth , his ears shall tingle .

translation.kha: bad ka da pyni da ka burom jong U Blei . Ka nongbah ka la phyrnai kum u mawkordor , kum u maw Jasper , kaba shai sngur bha’ .
translation.en: Having the glory of God : and her light was like unto a stone most precious , even like a jasper stone , clear as crystal  ;

translation.kha: Ki nongput dohkha kin pynsaphriang ïa la ki jar halor jong u , hangta ha kaba u ïeng ha ka duriaw . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la kren . Ki jaitbynriew kin pynjot ïa ka Tyros .
translation.en: It shall be a place for the spreading of nets in the midst of the sea : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God  : and it shall become a spoil to the nations .
And thou shalt speak unto him , and put words in his mouth : and I will be with thy mouth , and with his mouth , and will teach you what ye shall do .
translation.kha: Me lah ban ïakren bad u , bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba un ong . Ngan ïarap ïa phi baroh ar ngut ban kren , bad ngan ïathuh ha phi aïu phin leh .
kaba miaw nangta ka longsem ba nga khyllipmat kum ka dieng pyut , kamon ka jaiñphong ba la bam khñiang .
translation.en: And he , as a rotten thing , consumeth , as a garment that is moth eaten .

translation.kha: Hynrei u la shu tyngkan ïa lade bad u saw sha ïong . Nangta u khot sngewma ïa ki paralok jong u sha ka ïing jong u bad ong ïa ka tnga jong u ka Seresh ban wan baneh ïadon thang bad ki .
translation.en: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself : and when he came home , he sent and called for his friends , and Zeresh his wife .

translation.kha: U angel u la bret ïa u shat ka liewlong khlem trai , u la khang tala ïa ka , bad u la pynskhem ïa ka , ktang ba un ym lah ban shukor shuh ïa ki jaitbynriew tad haduh ba ki shihajar snem ki la kut . Hadien dat ïa u dei ba pyllait shiphew .
translation.en: And cast him into the bottomless pit , and shut him up , and set a seal upon him , that he should deceive the nations no more , till the thousand years should be fulfilled : and after that he must be loosed a little season .

translation.kha: Uto u briew u la jubab , Naduh ba nga dang samla nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki sah baroh .
translation.en: And he said , All these have I kept from my youth up .

translation.kha: Wat kwah lalot ïa ki jingbam bang ba u pynkhreh ; u lah ban pyrshang ban riam ïa phi .
translation.en: Be not desirous of his dainties : for they are deceitful meat .

translation.kha: Uei keiñ uba lah pun pyllait ïa ngi na kine ki blang kiba khlur ? Kynsan ki dei i'u ki Blei kiba la shoh ïap ïa ki Ijipt ha ka ri shyieng !
translation.en: Woe unto us ! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods ? these are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Haba ka Rakhel ka la ïap , la tep ïa ka harud ka lynti kaba ithuh shwa Ephrath , ïa kaba la tip mynta kum ka Bethlehem .
translation.en: And Rachel died , and was buried in the way to Ephrath , which is Beth–lehem .
Then Samuel took a vial of oil , and poured it upon his head , and kissed him , and said , Is it not because the  Lord  hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u shim shi klong ka umphniang Olib bad u theh ïa ka ha ka khlieh u Saul , u doh ïa u , bad u ong ,  U  Trai  u la pynsleh ïa me kum u nongsynshar ki briew jong u , ki Israel . Men synshar ïa ki briew jong u bad men ïada ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki . Bad kane kan long ka jingpynshisha ïa me ba U  Trai  u la pynsleh ïa me ban long u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong u :

translation.en: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night  ; There stood a man of Macedonia , and prayed him , saying , Come over into Macedonia , and help us .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , u Paul u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ha kaba u la ïohi ïa u nong Makedonia uba ïeng bad kyrpad ïa u ,  Ale shane sha Makedonia bad ïarap ïa ngi !

Kumta baïar ki ïalumlang ha Mispah . Ki tun ïa ka um bad ki theh ïa ka koum ka jingtieng ha U Terah bad ki shahjingit baroh shuh sngi . Ki ong , Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai . Dei ha Mispah ba u Samuel u pynbud ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng ki Jerusalem .
translation.en: And they gathered together to Mizpah , and drew water , and poured it out before the  Lord  , and fasted on that day , and said there , We have sinned against the  Lord . And Samuel judged the children of Israel in Mizpah .

translation.kha: Nga ïaroh ïa me malu pyndonburom ïa me , A U Blei ki kpa thnam jong nga . Me la ai ha nga ka jingstad bad ka jingkhlaiñ ; me la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad me la pyn-i ha ngi kadei ba ïong ïathuh ha u syiem .
translation.en: I thank thee , and praise thee , O thou God of my fathers , who hast given me wisdom and might , and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee : for thou hast now made known unto us the king s matter .

And Jesus said unto them ,  Because of your unbelief : for verily I say unto you , If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed , ye shall say unto this mountain , Remove hence to yonder place  ; and it shall remove  ; and nothing shall be impossible unto you .
translation.kha: Ka la long namar phim don ka jingngeit kaba biang ,  la jubab U Jisu .  Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba lada phi don ka jingngeit kaba heh kat u symbai tyrso , phi lah ban ong ïa une u lumrit , ‘ Khie leit noh nangne shatai !’ bad un leit . Phi lah ban leh ïa kano kano !

translation.en: Behold now , thy servant hath found grace in thy sight , and thou hast magnified thy mercy , which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life  ; and I cannot escape to the mountain , lest some evil take me , and I die :
translation.kha: Phi la lehsbun shikatdei eh bad phi la pyllait im ïa nga . Hynrei ki lum ki jngai palat ïa nga ; ka jingjynjar kan lap ïa nga , bad nga lah ban ïap noh shuwa ban poi shata .
Bad kumta , kiwei ki jaitbynriew kin ym burom ïa pha , hynrei phan tip ba ar long U Trai .
translation.en: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen , and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nga la ai ha pha ïa ka sati Khmut bad ki sohshkor malade ka pynjngut ba-itynnat ban phong .
translation.en: And I put a jewel on thy forehead , and earrings in thine ears , and a beautiful crown upon thine head .

translation.kha: Haba u Peleg u la dap laiphew snem ka rta , u la Ïoh khun shynraiñ , u Reu ;
translation.en: And Peleg lived thirty years , and begat Reu :

translation.kha: Hukum ïa ki Israel ban wanrah ïa ka umphniang Olib kaba khuid bha na ka beit kita ki sharak , ba kin ai jingshai man la ka por .
translation.en: Command the children of Israel , that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light , to cause the lamps to burn continually .
And I said unto the nobles , and to the rulers , and to the rest of the people , The work is great and large , and we are separated upon the wall , one far from another .
translation.kha: Nga ong ïa ki briew bad ïa ki rangbah synshar bad ki nongïalam ,  Ka jingtreikam ka la ïar bad la pynïakhlad ïa ngi da ka jingjngai uwei na uwei pat ha ka kynroh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Where is the bill of your mother s divorcement , whom I have put away ? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you ? Behold , for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves , and for your transgressions is your mother put away .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Phi tharai ba nga la phah noh ïa la ki briew kum u briew uba pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga ? Hangno te , ki don ki kot pyllait tnga ? Phi tharai nga la die ïa phi sha ka jingshahtehmraw kum u briew uba die ïa la ki khun kum ki mraw ? Em , phi la leit shahtehmraw noh namar ki pop jong phi ; la phah noh ïa phi namar ki kam bymman jong phi .

translation.en: For he is gone down this day , and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance , and hath called all the king s sons , and the captains of the host , and Abiathar the priest  ; and , behold , they eat and drink before him , and say , God save king Adonijah .
translation.kha: Ha kane hi ka sngi u la leit ai jingkñia da shibun ki masi , ki langbrot , bad ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid . U la khot sngewbha ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi baroh , ïa u Joab u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong phi , bad ïa u Abiathar u lyngdoh , bad mynta hi ki dang ïabam ïadih bad u bad ki pyrta , ‘ Im slem Syiem Adonijah !’

U Trai da lade hi u la ong , ‘ Ngan pynlong ïa me ka jingkyrkhu ïa me hi bad ïa ki lop jong me , bad trai ïohi ïa ki baher ba ki shah pynpyut da ki waitlam jong ki nongsynran jong ki . Ngan buh ïa baroh ki briew jong ka Judah hapoh ka bor jongnga u syiem ka Babilonia ; un shim katto katne ngut kum ki koidi sha ka ri jngai u bad pynïap ïa kiwei pat .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will make thee a terror to thyself , and to all thy friends : and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies , and thine eyes shall behold it : and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall carry them captive into Babylon , and shall slay them with the sword .
As the waters fail from the sea , and the flood decayeth and drieth up :
translation.kha: Kum ki wah kiba la sangeh noh ban tuid , bad ki pung-um kiba la rngad noh ,

translation.en: Is not thy wickedness great ? and thine iniquities infinite ?
translation.kha: Em , ka dei namar ba phi la leh pop haduh katta katta ; ka long namar ka jingsniew baroh kaba phi leh .

translation.en: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him , and said unto her , Go up in peace to thine house  ; see , I have hearkened to thy voice , and have accepted thy person .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u la pdiang ïa kaei kaba ka la wallam ïa u bad u ong ha ka ,  Khie leit phai noh sha ïing bad wat khuslai . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba phi kwah .

translation.en: O house of Israel , cannot I do with you as this potter ? saith the  Lord . Behold , as the clay is in the potter s hand , so are ye in mine hand , O house of Israel .
translation.kha: Hato ngam don ka hok ban leh ïa phi ki paid Israel ïa kaei kaba u nongthaw khiew u la leh ïa ka dewbyrtha ? Phi don ha ki kti jong nga kum ka dewbyrtha ha ki kti u nongthaw khiew .
U Moses u jubab , Phi ïakwah ban shong pun sah hangne katsha kiwei pat ki Israel kin leit sha ka thma ?
translation.en: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben , Shall your brethren go to war , and shall ye sit here ?

translation.kha: ki briew kiba iehnoh ïa ka jingshim hok ban im ha ka jingdum ka pop ,
translation.en: Who leave the paths of uprightness , to walk in the ways of darkness  ;

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Edom . Don Uei wahbah pyrta ïa nga na Edom , Ko nongap phira , shen sa katno ba ka miet kan kut ? Ïathuh ïa nga sa katno shen kan kut noh .
translation.en: The burden of Dumah . He calleth to me out of Seir , Watchman , what of the night ? Watchman , what of the night ?
Zedekiah was twenty and one years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hamutal , the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .
translation.kha: U Sedekaïah u la don arphew wei snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hamutal , ka khun jong u Jeremaïah na ka nongbah Libnah .

translation.en: Saying ,  There was in a city a judge , which feared not God , neither regarded man :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka shnong la don u nongbishar u bymsheptieng ïa U Blei lymne burom ïa u briew .
U Trai nongsumar u ong , Ngan leh ïa pha ha ka rukom kaba pha dei hok Ban ïoh , namar phai la leh bymsalia ïa ki jingkular jong phah bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done , which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant .
And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah , and came to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U knieh ïa ki nongbah ba la kerkut jong ka Judah bad u tur shaphrang shaduh Jerusalem .

U rangbah ai hukum u la kwah baneh tip Tyngka ïa kaei ba ki Jiw ki mudui ïa u Petros ; kumin ha ka sngi kaba bud u la phah weng noh ïa ki kynriah na u Paul bad u la law ïa ki Rangbah lyngdoh bad ïa ka dorbar baroh ban ïadih lang . Nalorkata u la ïalam ïa u Apostol bad u la pynïeng ïa u ha khmat jrong ki .
translation.en: On the morrow , because he would have known the certainty wherefore he was accused of the Jews , he loosed him from his bands , and commanded the chief priests and all their council to appear , and brought Paul down , and set him before them .

translation.kha: Hynrei ai jing jingsyllok sha bad U Trai .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Israel , Enquire , I pray thee , at the word of the  Lord  to day .
Fair weather cometh out of the north : with God is terrible majesty .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingphyrnai ksiar la ïohi ha ka phang bashatei , bad ka burom jong U Blei ka pyndap ïa ngi da ka jingtiengburom .

translation.en: As at the report concerning Egypt , so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre .
translation.kha: Wat ki nong Ijipt kin kyndit bad khuslai haba ki tip ba ïa ka Tyros la pynjot .

Wat shim shiah latai ïa kaei kaei kaba la mang ban pynjot , te U thri un phai na ka jingtur shla jong u bad un isynei ïa phi . Un leh-isynei ïa phi sad un pynrit ïa phi , kumba u la kular ïa ki kparad tymmen jong phi ,
translation.en: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand : that the  Lord  may turn from the fierceness of his anger , and shew thee mercy , and have compassion upon thee , and multiply thee , as he hath sworn unto thy fathers  ;

translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang ban nym khmih da ka jingkwah brai ïa ka kynthei .
translation.en: I made a covenant with mine eyes  ; why then should I think upon a maid ?
And the priest shall see the raw flesh , and pronounce him to be unclean : for the raw flesh is unclean : it is a leprosy .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa u , bad lada u ïohi ïa ka prum , un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid . Ka prum ka pyn-i ba ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad uta u briew u long u bymkhuid .
Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Kleopas , u la kylli ïa u , Hato me long tang ma me uba wan sha Jerusalem u bymtip ïa kiei kiei kiba la lah jia hangta ha kine ki khyndiat sngi ba la loit ?
translation.en: And the one of them , whose name was Cleopas , answering said unto him , Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem , and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days ?

translation.kha: Ynda Phin la kurup ïa ka nongbah , thang ïa ka , kumba U Trai u la hukum . Kine ki long ki hukum ïa phi .
translation.en: And it shall be , when ye have taken the city , that ye shall set the city on fire : according to the commandment of the  Lord  shall ye do . See , I have commanded you .

translation.kha: Ki pynkylla kyrteng ïa ka Laish shiah ka Dem , kum ka kyrteng u Kpa tymmen u de , u khun Jong u Jakob .
translation.en: And they called the name of the city Dan , after the name of Dan their father , who was born unto Israel : howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first .

translation.kha: Lada don kaba tam na ka doh ne na u kpu bakha ym syiem la lah bam lut haduh myn , dei baneh step napoh ïa ki . Ym dien ban bam ïa ka , naba ka long kaba kyntiap .
translation.en: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations , or of the bread , remain unto the morning , then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire : it shall not be eaten , because it is holy .

translation.kha: ka jingaiei kan don ha phi , bad jingsuk , na U Blei jong ngi U Kpa bad U Trai ijuh Khrist .
translation.en: Grace unto you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: U Trai u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur bun jingtynjuh bymneh .
translation.en: Divers weights are an abomination unto the  Lord   ; and a false balance is not good .

But not as the offence , so also is the free gift . For if through the offence of one many be dead , much more the grace of God , and the gift by grace , which is by one man , Jesus Christ , hath abounded unto many .
translation.kha: Hynrei kine ar kim long kumjuh , namar ka jingai sngewbha jong U Blei kam long kum ka pop u Adam . Ka long kaba shisha ba bun ki briew ki la ïap namar ka pop jong uta uwei u briew . Hynrei ka jingaiei U Blei ka long kham khraw , bad kumta ruh ka jingai sngewbha ïa kiba bun ki briew lyngba ka jingaiei jong uta uwei u briew , U Jisu Khrist .
Khot ïa ki nongsuhjaiñ borbah bakha nga la ai ha ki ka sap bad ong ïa ki ba kin suh ïa ki jaiñkup u Haron khnang ba yn ïoh pynkyntang ïa u kum u lyngdoh ban shakri ïa sa .
translation.en: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted , whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom , that they may make Aaron s garments to consecrate him , that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga la leh na ka bynta jong de hi — Ngan ym shah ba ïa ka kyrteng jong nga yn jingpynjahburom lane mano mano ban ïadon bynta len ïa ka burom kaba dei ka jong por bad ka lad ar hi .
translation.en: For mine own sake , even for mine own sake , will I do it : for how should my name be polluted ? and I will not give my glory unto another .

translation.kha: Naba ka jingieit ïa ka spah ka longsem ka thymmei jong ki jait jingsniew barieh . Don bakha da kwah eh shun ïoh ïa ka haduh ba ki la ïaid sakma na ka jingngeit bad ki pait dohnud na ki jingsngewdiaw babun .
translation.en: For the love of money is the root of all evil : which while some coveted after , they have erred from the faith , and pierced themselves through with many sorrows .
For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself , lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds .
translation.kha: To da pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba u la ïaid lyngba , kumno u la buh ïa lade ban shah isih ha ki nongpop ! Kumta wat ai ba phin noh mynsiem bad kynran dien .

translation.en: And David enquired at the  Lord  , saying , Shall I pursue after this troop ? shall I overtake them ? And he answered him , Pursue : for thou shalt surely overtake them , and without fail recover all .
translation.kha: U Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  ,  Ngan leit beh ne em ïa kine ki nonglute ? Ngan lap ne em ïa ki ?  U jubab ,  Khie leit beh ïa ki ; men lap ïa ki , bad men pyllait ïa kiba la shah ringmraw .

Ki nongai jingmut ki la jubab , Ym don mano mano ha sla pynrieh Ibbah lah don ïathuh ïa u Syiem Kyrpad ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban thop . Ym don u syiem , ym ni wat uba khrud tam bad uba donbor tam , uba la pynlong kum kane ka jingdawa na ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh mandriek bad ki nongleh byrtong .
translation.en: The Chaldeans answered before the king , and said , There is not a man upon the earth that can shew the king s matter : therefore there is no king , lord , nor ruler , that asked such things at any magician , or astrologer , or Chaldean .

translation.kha: Kane ka de ka kupar jong ki briew kiba Sniew , ka kupar ba U Blei u la buh bynta ïa ki .
translation.en: This is the portion of a wicked man from God , and the heritage appointed unto him by God .

translation.kha: Yn Don ka jingjynjar bad ka jingpang na ka bynta kito baroh kiba leh ïa kaei kaba sngur , na ka bynta ki Jiw nyngkong bad na ka bynta ki Jahlil ruh .
translation.en: Tribulation and anguish , upon every soul of man that doeth evil , of the Jew first , and also of the Gentile ;

translation.kha: Ngam tynjuh ïa la ki briew , bad lada ki kyndit ban kylla-kaba-mut , kine kiei kiei barben kin wan jia ha ki .
translation.en: Because it is a trial , and what if the sword contemn even the rod ? it shall be no more , saith the Lord  God .
And many nations shall pass by this city , and they shall say every man to his neighbour , Wherefore hath the  Lord  done thus unto this great city ?
translation.kha: Hadien nangta , bun ki jaitbynriew nongwei kin ïaid lynti bad kin ïakylli uwei ïa uwei pat balei ba nga , U  Trai  nga la leh katne katne ïa kane ka nongbah kaba khraw .

translation.en: Thy way and thy doings have procured these things unto thee  ; this is thy wickedness , because it is bitter , because it reacheth unto thine heart .
translation.kha: Ko Judah , pha la wallam ïa kane halor lade da ka rukom kaba pha la im bad da kiei kiei kiba pha la leh . Ka pop jong pha ka la pynjia ïa kane ka jingjynjar ; ka la dung ïa pha lyngba ka dohnud .

translation.en: I tell you , Nay : but , except ye repent , ye shall all likewise perish .
translation.kha: Em , ym kumta ! Bad nga ong ha phi ba lada phim phai noh na ki pop jong phi , phi baroh phin ïap kum ma ki .

Kumta u Absalom u ong ha la ki shakri , Ha khmih , ka lyngkha u Joab ka don markhap bad ka jong nga , Bad ka don u barli uba miaw ha ka . Khie leit bad weng ding ïa ka . Khmut ki la leit bad wiang ding ïa ka Lyngkha .
translation.en: Therefore he said unto his servants , See , Joab s field is near mine , and he hath barley there  ; go and set it on fire . And Absalom s servants set the field on fire .

translation.kha: Namar U Trai u sneng ïa baroh katba u olib , bad u sympat ïa uno uno ïa Uba u pdiang kum la u khuid .
translation.en: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth , and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth .

And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick .
translation.kha: Dei ban don uwei u shylluit syntiew hapoh , ha trai jong ki lai jur ki tnat .

Nga la leh katba nga lah ban pynbiang ki tiar ki tar na ka bynta ka Templ — Ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , ki diengsoh , ki mawkordor , bad ki mawleiñ , ki maw na ka bynta ki jingthaw dur , sad shibun u maw marbl .
translation.en: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for things to be made of gold , and the silver for things of silver , and the brass for things of brass , the iron for things of iron , and wood for things of wood  ; onyx stones , and stones to be set , glistering stones , and of divers colours , and all manner of precious stones , and marble stones in abundance .
And Absalom said to Hushai , Is this thy kindness to thy friend ? why wentest thou not with thy friend ?
translation.kha: La jia aïu ïa ka jingkyrshan jong me ïa u Dabid , u paralok jong me ?  u Absalom u la kylli ïa u .  Balei mem leit ryngkat bad u ?

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die , it abideth alone : but if it die , it bringeth forth much fruit .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ïa phi ïa ka jingshisha : U symboh kew u ïaisah hi tang shi symboh lymda la pynhap ïa u ha ka khyndew bad u ïap . Lada u da ïap , te u sei shibun ki sohkew .

translation.en: Children and parents worship together and learn how to benefit from the good news . —Read Micah 4 :1-4 .
translation.kha: Ki khun bad ki kmie ki kpa ki ïa mane lang bad ki ïoh jinghikai kumno ban myntoi na ka khubor babha .—Pule Mikah 4 :1-4 .
Kiei kiwei kiba la leh ha ka tnad treikam ka wanrah ïa ka jingryntih ha ka kam ïalap . —1 Korinth 14 :33 , 40 .
translation.en: Everything done at a branch contributes to the orderly accomplishment of the preaching work . —1 Corinthians 14 :33 , 40 .

translation.kha: hynne U Jisu um shym ong jingkynthih hima ha ka . Ki synran jongu u ki la wan ha u bad ki la kyrpad ïa u , To phah nala ïa ka ! Ka wan bud ïa ngi bad ka pynurlong ïa kane ka jingkhynwin bhor !
translation.en: But he answered her not a word . And his disciples came and besought him , saying , Send her away  ; for she crieth after us .
And the king commanded Hilkiah , and Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Abdon the son of Micah , and Shaphan the scribe , and Asaiah a servant of the king s , saying ,
translation.kha: bad u ai ïa kane ka hukum harum ha u Hilkaïah , u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , u Abdon u khun jong u Mikaïah , u Shaphan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad u Asaïah , u nongbud jong u syiem :

translation.en: Render therefore to all their dues : tribute to whom tribute is due ; custom to whom custom ; fear to whom fear ; honour to whom honour .
translation.kha: To siew te , kaei kaba phi dei ban siew ïa ki ; to siew sha ki ïa ki khajna shimet bad kiba dei ïa ki jingdon jingem jong phi , bad to pyn-i ka jingburom bad to ai ka burom ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: Behold , I come as a thief . Blessed is he that watcheth , and keepeth his garments , lest he walk naked , and they see his shame .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ! Nga wan kum u nongtuh ! Suk uta uba peitmat bad uba sumar ïa la ki jaiñkup , khnang ba un ym ïaid lyngkhuit kylleng bad shah pynlehrain ha khmat ki briew !
Na u Nongsharai Balang — Shata ka Kynthei badonburom bad shaw ki khun jong ka , ïa kiba ar ieit da shisha . badno ym dat tieng ma nga hi , hawei baroh bakha tip ïa ka jinglah ki ieit ïa phi ,
translation.en: The elder unto the elect lady and her children , whom I love in the truth  ; and not I only , but also all they that have known the truth  ;
For a small moment have I forsaken thee  ; but with great mercies will I gather thee .
translation.kha: Tang shipor nga la iehnoh ïa pha ; da ka jingieit kaba jylliew ngan shim pat ïa pha .

translation.en: And David said , What have I now done ? Is there not a cause ?
translation.kha: Mynta nga la leh aïu keiñ ?  u Dabid u kylli .  Hato ngam lah seh ban kylli jingkylli ?

Pynban , main ka Jingthoh bakylluid ka ïa-ong : ïada u nongshun jong phi u thngan , to ai bam ïa u ; lada u sahlang , to ai ïa u ban dih ; uba da kiba kuna ïa khnai pien pynlong ïa u ba ing da ka jingpynmynsaw .
translation.en: Therefore if thine enemy hunger , feed him ; if he thirst , give him drink : for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head .

translation.kha: U shyiap uba shitom phyrnai un long ka pung-um , bad ka khyndew kaba thrang um kan long ki umpohliew . Isaiah 35 :1 , 6 , 7 .
translation.en: And the heat-parched ground will have become as a reedy pool , and the thirsty ground as springs of water .”—Isaiah 35 :1 , 6 , 7 .
And when they found not his body , they came , saying , that they had also seen a vision of angels , which said that he was alive .
translation.kha: Ki la wan phai pat da kaba ong ba ki la ïohi ka jingïohipaw ïa ki angel kiba la ïathuh ha ki ba u im .

Ong ïa ki ba kin shukor ïa kaei naba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , na ïai-ong : phi la ïatehktien ban ïew ba ïa ka Templ jong de la pyntngit , baneh ïohi ïa ka ri Israel la pynjot taïew , don ïohi ïa ki paid ka Judah ba ki shah ringmraw .
translation.en: And say unto the Ammonites , Hear the word of the Lord  God   ; Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou saidst , Aha , against my sanctuary , when it was profaned  ; and against the land of Israel , when it was desolate  ; and against the house of Judah , when they went into captivity  ;

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet , hir baroh ki la ïohthiah , u nongshoh-nar u la wanlam bad u la beit ïa ki ñiut napdeng u kew , bad u la leit noh .
translation.en: But while men slept , his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat , and went his way .

translation.kha: Hato kane ka pynpaw bania i pynsarong biang shaphang ïa laiñ ? Hato ka lah shun long ba , kumba long lema kiwei ki briew ruh , ngi donakor ïa ki shuki pynphuh shuh phi lane na phi ?
translation.en: Do we begin again to commend ourselves ? or need we , as some others , epistles of commendation to you , or letters of commendation from you ?
And he sent Judah before him unto Joseph , to direct his face unto Goshen  ; and they came into the land of Goshen .
translation.kha: U Jakob u phah ïa u Judah ban nang leit sha khmat ban ong ïa u Joseph ban wan ïakynduh bad u ha Goshen .

translation.en: The sons of Shimei  ; Shelomith , and Haziel , and Haran , three . These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan .
translation.kha: kiba long ki khlieh jong ki kur kiba hiarpateng na u Ladan . ( U Shimei u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Shelomoth , u Hasiel , bad u Haran . )

translation.en: And they could not take hold of his words before the people : and they marvelled at his answer , and held their peace .
translation.kha: Hangta ha khmat jong ki paidbah , kim shym la lah ban kem daw ïa u ha kano kano , kumta ki la sngap jar , ki da lyngngoh ha ka jingjubab jong u .
Lymne kiba nonghiarpateng baroh na u Abraham ki long ki khun jongno U Blei . U Blei u la ong ha u Amram , Ka long lyngba u Isaak ba trai ïoh ïa kiba hiarpateng kiba nga la kular ïa me .
translation.en: Neither , because they are the seed of Abraham , are they all children : but , In Isaac shall thy seed be called .

translation.kha: La tur ïaleh jur ïa to bad ang la shahjop , hynrei U Trai u la ïarap ïa per ,
translation.en: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall : but the  Lord  helped me .

translation.kha: Ki khun jongu u bhabriew kaba bha’ kin long kiba donbor ha ka ri ; ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin longsem Ibbah la kyrkhu .
translation.en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth : the generation of the upright shall be blessed .

translation.kha: Ki bhabriew kiba sah hangthie kin rwai ïaroh ; kin pyrta jam da ka jingmeng . Da ka jingkyrkhu jong nga kan roi ha ka jingbun paid ; ka jingkyrkhu jong nga kan wallam ha ki ka burom .
translation.en: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry : and I will multiply them , and they shall not be few  ; I will also glorify them , and they shall not be small .

translation.kha: Ngan sa pynngat ha ki ka jinglanot ha kaba ki jingïapthngan ka pyrthei baroh kin da sngewshyrkhei , ki bynriew kin riewkhñium ïa ki ; kin ïakren kai ïa ki , kin ïakynshi ïa ki , bad kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ki kumin ka jingtim kylleng kat ibha ar pynsakma ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt , to be a reproach and a proverb , a taunt and a curse , in all places whither I shall drive them .
Are they Hebrews ? so am I . Are they Israelites ? so am I . Are they the seed of Abraham ? so am I .
translation.kha: Hato ki long ki Hebru ? Nga ruh nga long . Hato ki long ki Israel ? Nga ruh nga long . Hato ki long kiba hiarpateng na u Abraham ? Nga ruh nga long .
La ïathuh ïa ki ba kin ym pynsyier ïa u phlang lane ïa ki dieng lane ïa kiwei pat ki jingthung ; ki lah ban pynsngewrem tong ïa ki briew ki bym don ka shab jong U Blei ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .
translation.en: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth , neither any green thing , neither any tree  ; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads .

translation.kha: Pynban , ngi tip ba ïa u briew la pynksan ha khmat U Blei tang da ka jingngeit ha U Jisu Khrist , ym da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa . Nga ruh , ngi la ngeit ha U Khrist Jisu khnai ban pynksan ha U Bel da ka jingngeit jong ngi ha U Khrismas sad ym da kaba bor ïa kaei kaba ka Law ka dawa . Namar ym don uno uno ruh ïa uba la pynksan ha U Blei da kaweh ni ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka ïadep .
translation.en: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law , but by the faith of Jesus Christ , even we have believed in Jesus Christ , that we might be justified by the faith of Christ , and not by the works of the law : for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified .

translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u shem Ahab malade ïa-ong , Kane ka long kaei kaba U Tlai u ong : ‘ Nimrim ba ki Syria ki ong ba nga long u plie jong ki lumlang bad ym jongnga ki dik madan , ngan sa ai jingjop ïa phi halor ka kynoi shipawa bakhraw jong ki , bad ma phi bad ki briew jong phi kmen tip ba nga long U Trai .’
translation.en: And there came a man of God , and spake unto the king of Israel , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , Because the Syrians have said , The  Lord  is God of the hills , but he is not God of the valleys , therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand , and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven , and all that is dressed in the fryingpan , and in the pan , shall be the priest s that offereth it .
translation.kha: Ka jingainguh bam baroh ïa kaba la syang ha dpei , lane ïa kaba la sdieh ha ka karai lane ha u khiew ba la tap ka dei ka jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia ainguh sha U Blei .
Hynrei ïa u ksiang ym donhok haba treikam tang uwei u briew’ ; bad U Blei u long uwei .
translation.en: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one , but God is one .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kumto ngi tip kaei ka jingieit : U Khrist u la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ngi . Ngi ruh , jingaiti , ngi dei ban ai ïa la ki jingim na ka bynta ki parabriew !
translation.en: Hereby perceive we the love of God , because he laid down his life for us : and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren .

translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem kumba nga la leh ïa ka Jeremaïah , kumba nga la leh ïa u Ahab u syiem ka Israel bun ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u . Ngan pynkhuid phar ïa ka Jerusalem na ki briew jongki ka kumba khuid ka pliang ba la ñiad dara pyndem pyllup ïa ka .
translation.en: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria , and the plummet of the house of Ahab : and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish , wiping it , and turning it upside down .
Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead , and the people made him head and captain over them : and Jephthah uttered all his words before the  Lord  in Mizpah .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jephthah u leit bad ki nongïalam ka Gilead , bad u paidbah u thung ïa u kum u nongsynshar bad u nongïalam jong ki . U Jephthah u pynpaw ïa ki kyndon na ka liang jong u ha Mispah ha khmat U  Trai .
To shahshkor mynta , Bad maham ïa ki khun ki ksuid u Jakob , ong U Trai Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh ,
translation.en: Hear ye , and testify in the house of Jacob , saith the Lord  God  , the God of hosts ,

translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la ong shaphang kaba pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , ym ban pyut noh ha ka jingtep : ‘ Ngan ai ha me ïa kita ki jingkyrkhu bakyntang bad naba thikna kiba nga la kular ha u Abda .’
translation.en: And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead , now no more to return to corruption , he said on this wise , I will give you the sure mercies of David .

translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ïa ki , naba ngan don lem sad me ban ïaid ïa me . Ma nga , U Trai nga la krenbeiñ !
translation.en: Be not afraid of their faces : for I am with thee to deliver thee , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: A Jerusalem , Jerusalem ! Pha pyndap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa malade lynthem maw ïa ki nonglamktien kiba U Blei u la phah ha pha ! Kato rupa nga la kiaw ban kdup ha ki ksang ti jong to ïa ki briew jong pha baroh , kumba ka shihajar ka lumlang ïa la ki khun hapoh ki thapniang jong ka , isynei pham shym la shahskhor ïa nga .
translation.en: O Jerusalem , Jerusalem , thou that killest the prophets , and stonest them which are sent unto thee , how often would I have gathered thy children together , even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings , and ye would not !
Behold , I am the  Lord  , the God of all flesh : is there any thing too hard for me ?
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  , U Blei ki jaitbynriew baroh . Ym don kaei kaei kaba eh than ïa nga ban leh .

translation.en: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God ,
translation.kha: khnang ba ha ka por ba mynta lyngba ka Balang , ki angel nongsynshar bad ki bor ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng ki lah ban tip ïa ka jingstad jong u ha baroh ki rukom ba-ïapher jong ki .
Ynda phin poi ha ri Kanaan nabar thung ïa uno uno u jait diengïap , ñiew ba u soh jrong u , u Long u bymkhuid haduh lai snem . Halah kane ka por kino daiñ ban bam ïa u .
translation.en: And when ye shall come into the land , and shall have planted all manner of trees for food , then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised : three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you : it shall not be eaten of .

translation.kha: U Trei un pynlong ïa ki nongshun jongu phi ba ktang shahjop haba ki wan ïaleh pyrshah ïa phiah . Kin wan tur na kawei ka dong , hynrei kin sa her ïap na baroh’ ki dong .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face : they shall come out against thee one way , and flee before thee seven ways .

translation.kha: Ki syiem lad ki , ki ïeng ïa-pyrshah , ki nongsynshar jong ki , ki ïasylla lang pynshah ïa U Trai bad ïa-pyrshah ïa u syiem uba u la jied .
translation.en: The kings of the earth set themselves , and the rulers take counsel together , against the  Lord  , and against his anointed , saying ,
Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders ? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread .
translation.kha: Balei ba ki synran jong me kim kohnguh ïa ka jinghikai ba la ai pateng da ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ? Kim ju thet ïa la ki kti ha ka rukom kaba dei ha shuwa ba kin bam !
Nangta i ong ban leit thied jingbam shuh sa khyndiat .
translation.en: And our father said , Go again , and buy us a little food .

translation.kha: Ïa u Er , u khun tyngkong jong u , u Judah u la pynïoh ka tngaw kaba kyrteng ka Tamar .
translation.en: And Judah took a wife for Er his firstborn , whose name was Tamar .

translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka shispah laiphew ut mitar ka lynter , arphew ar mitar ka pyngkiang bad khatlai mitar ka jingjrong .
translation.en: And this is the fashion which thou shalt make it of : The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits , the breadth of it fifty cubits , and the height of it thirty cubits .
And it came to pass in those days , that he went out into a mountain to pray , and continued all night in prayer to God .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , U Jisu u la leit kiew sha u kum ban duwai bad ban pynlut baroh shi miet hangta da kaba duwai ha U Blei .
Ko Nongbah , pha don ha ka jingshah tur ïaleh ! Ka bor ka ban kyntur ïa pha ka la wan . To buh briew ha ki jingïada ! To phira ïa ka lynti bah ! To pynkhiah ïa ka thnam !
translation.en: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face : keep the munition , watch the way , make thy loins strong , fortify thy power mightily .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingbitar jongnga nga , nga la ai ha phoi ïa ki syiem , bad ha ka jingbitar shla jong nga , nga la Shim noh ïa ki .
translation.en: I gave thee a king in mine anger , and took him away in my wrath .

translation.kha: kumta u la leit kiew sha u Lem Salmon bad la ki rangbah . Nangta u shim uei u sdie , u pom kawei ka tnat na u dieng , bad u bah ïa ka ha la ka tyrpeng . U ong ïa la ki rangbah banbeiñ pynkloi bad pun leh kumjuh .
translation.en: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon , he and all the people that were with him  ; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand , and cut down a bough from the trees , and took it , and laid it on his shoulder , and said unto the people that were with him , What ye have seen me do , make haste , and do as I have done .

translation.kha: Haba ka por jingshakri jong u ha ka Templ ka la kut , u Sekharaïah u la leit phai sha ïing .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished , he departed to his own house .

translation.kha: Un long uba khlaiñ — hynrei ym da ka hab jong u hi . Un pynlong ka jingpynjot bashyrkhei bad un jop ha kiei kaei baroh kiba u leh . Un wallam ka jingjot halor ki rangbah kiba donbor bad khashor ki briew jrong U blang hi .
translation.en: And his power shall be mighty , but not by his own power : and he shall destroy wonderfully , and shall prosper , and practise , and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people .
And found a certain Jew named Aquila , born in Pontus , lately come from Italy , with his wife Priscilla  ; ( because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome : ) and came unto them .
translation.kha: Hangta u la ïakynduh ïa u Jiw uba kyrteng u Akwila , ïa uba la kha ha Pontos , uba dang shu wan shen na Italy lem bad ka Priskila ka tnga jong u , naba u Patsha Klaudius u la lah hukum ïa ki Jiw baroh ban mihnoh na Rom .

translation.en: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things .
translation.kha: Katno nga kmen ba nga lah ban shaniah ha phi nadong shadong !

translation.en: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land : and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver , that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand .
translation.kha: U Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , u tur ïaleh ïa ka Israel , bad u Menahem u ai ïa u laiphew saw ton ka rupa ban ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong u ban nang pynkhlaiñbor ïa u Menahem halor ka ri .
Nga kular ha U Trai uba im , uba ai ha ki Israel ka jingjngem , ba uta uba la leh un shah pynpoh , wat la u de u Jonathan u khun jongno nga . Hynrei ym don uwei ruh suba ainong ei ei .
translation.en: For , as the  Lord  liveth , which saveth Israel , though it be in Jonathan my son , he shall surely die . But there was not a man among all the people that answered him .

translation.kha: U angel u la wan shaei ka bad u la ong , To ka jingsuk kan long lakam bad pha ! U Trei u long ryngkat bad phasi bad u la kyrkhu eh ïa pha !
translation.en: And the angel came in unto her , and said , Hail , thou that art highly favoured , the Lord is with thee : blessed art thou among women .
And Moses said unto the people , Fear not : for God is come to prove you , and that his fear may be before your faces , that ye sin not .
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Wat sheptieng , U Blei u la wan tang ban tynjuh ïa phi bad pynlong ïa phi ban ïai kohnguh ïa u , khnang ba phin ym leh pop .
U Joseph u jubab , Kine ki dien ki khun jong nga kiba U Blei u la ai ïa nga hangne ha Ijipt . U jaboh u ong , Wan ïalam ïa ki sha na ba ngan ïoh kyrkhu ïa ki .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto his father , They are my sons , whom God hath given me in this place . And he said , Bring them , I pray thee , unto me , and I will bless them .

translation.kha: Nangta sa ïathuh ïa ki ba ma por , U Trai badonburom Baroh , U Blei ki Jeruel , ngan wallam ïa u shakri jongki nga u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia sha kane ka dik , bad un bthuh ïa ka khet jong u halor kine ki maw kba me la tep , bad un pyrem ïa ka ïingjaiñ syiem halor jongno ki .
translation.en: And say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will send and take Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon , my servant , and will set his throne upon these stones that I have hid  ; and he shall spread his royal pavilion over them .

And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria , and was sick : and he sent messengers , and said unto them , Go , enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease .
translation.kha: U Ahasaïah , u syiem Israel u la hap na ka jaka jngoh kai halor ka tnum jong ka ïingsyiem jong u ha Samaria , bad u la mynsaw jur . Kumta u phah katto katne ki nonglamktien ban kylli ïa u Baalsebub , u blei jong ka Ekron , ka nongbah Philistia , khnang ban tip la un ïohkhiah ne em .
Ha u bnai uba phra jong ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha ka Persia , U thri u la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Sekharaïah u nonghiarthma , u khun jong u bahkhlieh bad u ksiew lad u Iddo .
translation.en: In the eighth month , in the second year of Darius , came the word of the  Lord  unto Zechariah , the son of Berechiah , the son of Iddo the prophet , saying ,

translation.kha: Hynrei sngap phin ïalum jingbam , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ka Sngi shongkhet , yn ym ba-don ei ei .
translation.en: Six days ye shall gather it  ; but on the seventh day , which is the sabbath , in it there shall be none .
For our conversation is in heaven ; from whence also we look for the Saviour , the Lord Jesus Christ :
translation.kha: Ma ngi pynban , ngi long ki traishnong jong ka bneng , bad ngi ïa-ap hir hir ïa U Nongpynim , U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai ban wan na bneng .

Ki Pheliks ki ïakhleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel shalor u lum Gilboa . Shibun na ki Israel ki la shah pynïap hangta nabar kiba sah na ki , kynthup ïa u syiem Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u , ki la phet ïa-ïap .
translation.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel  ; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain in mount Gilboa .

translation.kha: Kana ka long kaei kaba u ong ha ki shuki Jong u barieh hajan u thoh halor kane ka phang . Dang katto kat kiei kiei kiba eh ha ki shithi jong u ha kaba ki bym da shemphang bad ki bariew ki bymneh jingmut ki batai khrew , Rumah ki leh ïa kiwei pat ki bynta ha ki jingthiah Bakhuid . Kumta ki wanrah hi ïa la ka jingjop .
translation.en: As also in all his epistles , speaking in them of these things  ; in which are some things hard to be understood , which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest , as they do also the other scriptures , unto their own destruction .

translation.kha: Lada phi ieit ïa ka pisa da lei lei pajut phin ym ïoh jinghun , lada phi angnud ban riewspah , phin ym ïoh ïa baroh kaba pa’ kwah . Ka long ka bymmyntoi .
translation.en: He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver  ; nor he that loveth abundance with increase : this is also vanity .

translation.kha: Ai sha nga u khlam .
translation.en: Pass me the pen .

translation.kha: U biria uba khoh , pat , u lah ban ai , bad ba-bang ai kylluid .
translation.en: He coveteth greedily all the day long : but the righteous giveth and spareth not .

translation.kha: don uwei uba la ong ha U Jisu , Ka kumwei bad ki para shynrang jyllang me ki ïeng shabar bad ki kwah ban Iohi ïa me .
translation.en: And it was told him by certain which said , Thy mother and thy brethren stand without , desiring to see thee .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u tur ïaleh ïa Pha u lai ïa ka khlem ka jingaibor jong nga ; uno uno uba ïaleh pyrda ïa phah un kyllon ne .
translation.en: Behold , they shall surely gather together , but not by me : whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake .
For the man is not of the woman ; but the woman of the man .
translation.kha: U briew um donkam ban tap ïa la ka khlieh , namar u pynphalang ïa ka dur bad ka burom U Blei . Hynrei ka briew ka pynphalang ïa ka burom jong u briew ; naba ïa u briew ym shym la thaw ïa na ka briew , hynrei ïa ka briew na u briew .

translation.en: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us .
translation.kha: Da ka bor jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba im hapoh jong ngi , to sumar ïa kiei kiei kiba bha ïa kiba la pynkhamti ha me .
U la kyrshut ïa ka durkhmat jong nga ha kheiñduh bun la pynkheiñ ïa ki bniat jong nga ha ki mawria .
translation.en: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones , he hath covered me with ashes .
And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold : six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u shna arspah tylli ki stieh kiba heh , ïa kawei pa kawei la sop da ka ksiar ba la shoh kaba khia kumba hynriew kilo ,
‘ Wat pynïap .
translation.en: Thou shalt not kill .

translation.kha: Sa shiliang pat ki sdang ban ïam . Nangta ka arspah ka doh jingkhublei ïa la ka kiaw kyrsum Bad ka leit phai patiaw sha Ïing , hynriew ka Ruth ka sneng rdin ha ka .
translation.en: And they lifted up their voice , and wept again : and Orpah kissed her mother in law  ; but Ruth clave unto her .
And she said , Drink , my lord : and she hasted , and let down her pitcher upon her hand , and gave him drink .
translation.kha: Ka ong ,  Ko rangbah , to dih  bad ka pynhiar kloi kloi ïa uta u khiew um na ka tyrpeng jong ka , bad ka pynbat katba u dang dih .
Ki la kem ïa ka , ki ïalumlang ïa ka sha ka ïingsyiem , bad hangta ha ka khrud Kulai ki pynïap ïa ka .
translation.en: So they laid hands on her  ; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king s house , they slew her there .

And when the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , saw the mourning in the floor of Atad , they said , This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians : wherefore the name of it was called Abel–mizraim , which is beyond Jordan .
translation.kha: Haba ki Kanaan kiba shong ha kata ka ri ki ïohi ïa kita ki briew kiba ïambriew ha Atad , ki ïa-ong ,  Kane ka rukom ïambriew ki nong Ijipt kaba da sngew lung mynsiem shisha !  Dei namar kata ba la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka Abel Misraim .

translation.en: Or if I bring a sword upon that land , and say , Sword , go through the land  ; so that I cut off man and beast from it :
translation.kha: Lane nga lah ban wallam ka thma ha ka ri bad phah ki tiar pynjot ban pynduh lut ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh ,
Ha ka synagog , la don u briew uba ba-don u mynhyndai bymkhuid ha u , dara u la kyang da ka na kaba jam ,
translation.en: And in the synagogue there was a man , which had a spirit of an unclean devil , and cried out with a loud voice ,

translation.kha: Ynda haba la dep pynbaptis ïa ki briew baroh , la pynbaptis ruh ïa u jongu . Katba U dang duwai , la plie ïa ka bneng ,
translation.en: Now when all the people were baptized , it came to pass , that Jesus also being baptized , and praying , the heaven was opened ,

translation.kha: Kumta ngi la nang ïaid , bad im kiar ïa ka lynti kaba leit na ki shnong Elath bad pioneer sha ka Duriaw Baïap , bad ngi phai shaphang jingïaleh-sngewbha sha ka ri Moab .
translation.en: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau , which dwelt in Seir , through the way of the plain from Elath , and from Ezion–geber , we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab .

translation.kha: hynriew u Moses u ino ha U Blei , Ngam long ei ei . Kumno nga lah ngab leit shwa u Pharaoh sad ban ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na Jephthah ?
translation.en: And Moses said unto God , Who am I , that I should go unto Pharaoh , and that I should bring forth the children of Israel out of Egypt ?

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la rung shapoh Harnepher , u radbah pynïar ka Hima rem u la wan ïakynduh ïa u dara u la kyrpad jingïarap :
translation.en: And when Jesus was entered into Capernaum , there came unto him a centurion , beseeching him ,

translation.kha: Ha Katai hi ka kyntait jyllang ka mirr , u nongot phatok u la ïalam ïa ki malu u la saisaw ïa ki jingmong jong ki ; bad shisyndon la pynbaptis ïa u lema bad ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: And he took them the same hour of the night , and washed their stripes  ; and was baptized , he and all his , straightway .
For the law was given by Moses , but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ai ïa ka hukum lyngba u Moses , hynrei ka jingaiei bad ka jingshisha ki la wan lyngba U Jisu Khrist .

translation.en: Who died for us , that , whether we wake or sleep , we should live together with him .
translation.kha: uba la ïap na ka bynta jong ngi khnang ba ngi lah ban ïa-im lem bad u , la ngi im lane ngi ïap haba u wan .

Katba U Jeshua u dang ïathied harud ka Darius Gallio , u la ïohi ïa ki ar ngut shi para kiba longsyiem ki nongtong dohkha , u Solomon ( ïa uba la khot u Petros ) bad u para jong u , u Andriw , ba ki dang tong dohkha ha ka duriaw da ka jar .
translation.en: And Jesus , walking by the sea of Galilee , saw two brethren , Simon called Peter , and Andrew his brother , casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , nga ïohi ba ki briew ha Judah ki khñiot umsoh na ki sohwaiñ ha ka sngi Sabbaton . kiwei pat ki daiñ kyntiew halor ki kada jrong ki ïa u kew , ka waiñ , sohwaiñ , soh Khajur , bad kiwei kiei kiei bad leit rah ïa ki shaw Jerusalem ; nga la maham ïa ki shun ym die ei ei ha ka sngew Sabbaton .
translation.en: In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath , and bringing in sheaves , and lading asses  ; as also wine , grapes , and figs , and all manner of burdens , which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day : and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals .
And he overlaid it with pure gold , both the top of it , and the sides thereof round about , and the horns of it : also he made unto it a crown of gold round about .
translation.kha: U suit ïa kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ki krung jong ka baroh sawdong , bad ïa ki reng jong ka , da ka ksiar nylla , bad u shna ruh ïa ka jingpynpur ksiar baroh sawdong jong ka .

Nangta u Shem bad u Japheth ki la shim khawai ka jaiñkup bad ki tawah ïa ka hadien jong ki ha la ka tyrpeng . Ki ïaid dadien shab ka ïingjaiñ bun ki tap ïa la u kpa , ki da phai dei khnang ba kin ym ïohi ïa u , ba u lyngkhuit .
translation.en: And Shem and Japheth took a garment , and laid it upon both their shoulders , and went backward , and covered the nakedness of their father  ; and their faces were backward , and they saw not their father s nakedness .
As keepers of a field , are they against her round about  ; because she hath been rebellious against me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad yn kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem kumba ki rangbah ki ap phira ïa ka lyngkha , namar ki briew jong ka ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai . U  Trai  u la kren .

Te ngin ym long shuh kum ki khynnah , ba la pynshad kyntur da ki jingat phyllung bad ka jingbei ka erïong man ba ka kylla da ka jinghikai jong ki riewshukor , kiba ïalam ïa kiwei pat sha ka jingbakla da ki buit shithi ba ki pynmih .
translation.en: That we henceforth be no more children , tossed to and fro , and carried about with every wind of doctrine , by the sleight of men , and cunning craftiness , whereby they lie in wait to deceive ;
Now the name of his firstborn was Joel  ; and the name of his second , Abiah : they were judges in Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: U khun uba kham heh u kyrteng u Joel bad uba kham rit , u Abijah ; kine ki long ki nongbishar ha Beersheba .
Bad nangta u la ïap haba u la tymmen bakha .
translation.en: So Job died , being old and full of days .
And Uriah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus : so Uriah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus .
translation.kha: Kumta u Uriah u thaw ïa ka duwan thik kum kata , bad u pyndep ïa ka shuwa ba u Ahas un wan phai .
Ngan shong hapdeng jongki phi ha ka ïingjaiñ bakyntang jong nga , bad ngan ym phai noh! na phi da lei lili .
translation.en: And I will set my tabernacle among you : and my soul shall not abhor you .

translation.kha: khadu na ki baroh , kata ka briew’ ka la ïatip .
translation.en: Last of all the woman died also .

And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon , distress them not , nor meddle with them : for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession  ; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession .
translation.kha: Te phin sa poi hajan ka ri ki Ammon , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lot . Wat pynjynjar ïa ki lane ïaleh thma bad ki , namar ngan ym ai ei ei ïa phi na kata ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha ki .’

translation.en: And when the devil had ended all the temptation , he departed from him for a season .
translation.kha: Haba u Soitan u la dep ban pynshoi ïa U Jisu ha ki rukom bapher bapher , u la iehnoh ïa u shipor .

translation.en: For though we walk in the flesh , we do not war after the flesh :
translation.kha: Ka long kaba shisha ba ngi im ha ka pyrthei , hynrei ngim ïaleh na ki jingthmu ba kynja pyrthei .
Buh ïa ka dabor hap ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad pyndap ïa ka da ka um .
translation.en: And thou shalt set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar , and shalt put water therein .
And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding .
translation.kha: Kam da jngai nangta la don ka kynhun bah ki sniang kiba dang ïabam jingbam .

translation.en: And as they did eat , Jesus took bread , and blessed , and brake it , and gave to them , and said ,  Take , eat : this is my body .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , U Jisu u la shim ïa u kpu , u la duwai ainguh bad u la kdiah ïa u , bad u la ai ïa u ha ki synran jong u ,  Shim ïa u , une u long ka met jong nga  u la ong .

translation.en: For thou verily givest thanks well , but the other is not edified .
translation.kha: Wat lada ka jingduwai ainguh jong phi ka biang bha , kam ïarap ei ei ïa uwei pat u briew .
U Joseph u jubab , Syiem Kynrad , ïam lah ; hynrei U Blei un ai ka jingbat kaba ai jinghun .
translation.en: And Joseph answered Pharaoh , saying , It is not in me : God shall give Pharaoh an answer of peace .
Reprobate silver shall men call them , because the  Lord  hath rejected them .
translation.kha: Yn khot ïa ki , ka eitnar bymdondor , namar ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kyntait ïa ki .
Ngan ai ha phira ïa ka dohnud kaba thymmai bad ïa ka jingat kaba thymmai . Ngan khlaw noh na phi ïa ka dohnud maw ha-ei call jong phi , bad ngan ai ha phi ka ïaduna kaba kohnguh .
translation.en: A new heart also will I give you , and a new spirit will I put within you : and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh , and I will give you an heart of flesh .
Then said Jesus to them again ,  Peace be unto you : as my Father hath sent me , even so send I you .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong pat ha ki ,  To ka jingsuk kan long lem bad phi . Kumba U Kpa u la phah ïa nga , kumta ruh nga phah ïa phi .
U Dabid u kurup ïa ki lyntait ksiar ba la rah da ki rangbah synshar jongno u Hadadeser bad u rah ïa ki sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer , and brought them to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Kumta ki rangbah na Beth Geshem ki ïa-ong , Uei uba lah ngab ïeng ha khmat U Trai , eit U blang uba khuid ? Shano ngi haka ban phah ïa u ba un laitluid nong na ngi ?
translation.en: And the men of Beth–shemesh said , Who is able to stand before this holy  Lord  God ? and to whom shall he go up from us ?
But they mocked the messengers of God , and despised his words , and misused his prophets , until the wrath of the  Lord  arose against his people , till there was no remedy .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nonglamktien jong U Blei , kim suidñiew ïa ki ktien jong u bad ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , ha kaba kut ka jingbitar U  Trai  pyrshah ïa la ki briew ka long kaba jur katta katta kat ban ym don lad shuh ban lait na ka .
Ki wahduid kiba la khleh lang bad ka ïor lem bad u tah ,
translation.en: Which are blackish by reason of the ice , and wherein the snow is hid :

And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate , and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years : and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and will disperse them through the countries .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka Ijipt ka ri ba sah kynjah tam ha ka pyrthei . Na ka bynta sawphew snem ki nongbah ka Ijipt kin sah ha ka jingjot , ki jingjot kiba kham sniew ban ïa kito ha kiwei pat ki nongbah . Ngan pynlong ïa ki nong Ijipt ki nongphetwir . Kin phet sha man ki ri bad ban im hapdeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .

Hadien habud phin sa shem da kaba suk lada nga lah lehhok . Haba phin wan ban khmih ïa ka bainong jong nga , lada nga kein ki blang ki ngi thohbria nabar ki bym thohbroin , lane kino kino ki khunlangbrot ki i ïohnang , phyrnai ïatip ba nga la tah ïa ki .
translation.en: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come , when it shall come for my hire before thy face : every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats , and brown among the sheep , that shall be counted stolen with me .
For an odious woman when she is married  ; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress .
translation.kha: ka kynthei kaba ijli kaba ïoh ban shongkurim , bad ka shakri haba ka ïoh ban shim ïa ka jaka ka kynrad jong ka .
Ki jingbabe lyngdoh bad ki Pharoah ki la ïohsngew ïa ki phar jong U Jisu bad ki la tip ba u la kren shaphang jongno ki ,
translation.en: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables , they perceived that he spake of them .
