translation.kha: Kumta u Nahum u ong , Lada phim pdiang ïa ka jingai jong to , te shah ïa na ban ramhah shad ïing ar paki khashor ka khyndew , namar napoh mynta ngan ym ai jingkñia lynti jingainguh thang ha ine uno u blei lait noh thrang U Trai .
translation.en: And Naaman said , Shall there not then , I pray thee , be given to thy servant two mules  burden of earth ? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods , but unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ko ki khun ki kyiuh u Uto , ïa ki jingkynshew bakordor jong Phin la lute .
translation.en: How are the things of Esau searched out ! how are his hidden things sought up !

translation.kha: Katba ka por ka nang jan haba ïa U Jisu yn shim noh sha bneng , u la pynbeit ïa ka jingat malu u la leit ha la ka lyngki Sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the time was come that he should be received up , he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem ,
Whose house I have made the wilderness , and the barren land his dwellings .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ka ri shyiap ban long ka ïing jong ki , bad nga shah ba kin shong ha ki pyntha mluh .

U Trai u la ïathuh ha to ban ai ïa khnai ka khubor ha ka ïingsyiem Judah , ki khun ki ksiew u Dabid : To shahshkor ïa kiei kaba ma nga , U Trai , nga ong . To khmih ba yn don ka jingbishar khak man la ka sngi . Ïada ïa u briew uba shah thok na uta uba thok ïa u . Lada phim leh kumta , ka jingbymman kaba phi kuna kan pynjrong ïa ka jingbitar jong nga ban meh khim ka ding kaba ym lah ban pynpeit .
translation.en: O house of David , thus saith the  Lord   ; Execute judgment in the morning , and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor , lest my fury go out like fire , and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings .
Then Solomon sat on the throne of the  Lord  as king instead of David his father , and prospered  ; and all Israel obeyed him .
translation.kha: Kumta u Solomon u kiew ïa ka khet u Dabid u kpa jong u ïa kaba U Blei U  Trai  u la seng . U la long u syiem uba jop , bad ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh ka la kohnguh ïa u .
( Ha kata ka por u Eli u la dap khyndaiphew phra snem bad u la jan matlah ) .
translation.en: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old  ; and his eyes were dim , that he could not see .

translation.kha: Nga la ainong ïa ki ba Man ki hynñiew snem ki dem Ban pynïatylli ïa eit uno u mraw Hebru kiba la shakri ïa ki hynriew snem . Hynrei ki kpa tymmen lad phi kim shym la suidñiew ïa nga lane shahshkor ïa kaei kambah nga la ong .
translation.en: At the end of seven years let ye go every man his brother an Hebrew , which hath been sold unto thee  ; and when he hath served thee six years , thou shalt let him go free from thee : but your fathers hearkened not unto me , neither inclined their ear .

translation.kha: U ong ha u Simon , Nga nang pyrkhat ba me isih ïa ka , te kumta nga la ai noh ïa ka ha u paralok jong me . Hynrei kam pher , ka lai jong ka , ka kham bhabriew Ban ïa ka . Me lah ban shem khong da ka .
translation.en: And her father said , I verily thought that thou hadst utterly hated her  ; therefore I gave her to thy companion : is not her younger sister fairer than she ? take her , I pray thee , instead of her .

translation.kha: hynne “lada me sheptieng ban tur ïaleh , leit hiar sha ka jaka sheng Gera lem bad u Purah u shakri jong me .
translation.en: But if thou fear to go down , go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host :

translation.kha: U Trai u ainong ha u Moses ,
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa ph bad kun ai ha phi sian ki khun ; ngan pynseisoh ïa ka pynbha ka jingmong jong ar kaba nga la pynlong bad phi .
translation.en: For I will have respect unto you , and make you fruitful , and multiply you , and establish my covenant with you .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngur U Blei u ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor u Jabin , u syiem Kanaan .
translation.en: So God subdued on that day Jabin the king of Canaan before the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Namarkata , lama me pyrkhat ïa nga kum u par ba-ïatrei lymne jong me , to pdiang sngewbha pat ïa u kumba men pdiang sngewkhia ïa nga .
translation.en: If thou count me therefore a partner , receive him as myself .

translation.kha: Ki Nonghikai jong ka pyrthei mad ktang ïamih bad ïambriew na ka bynta jong ka , Naamah ba ym don shuh mano mano ban thied ïa ki mar jong ki ;
translation.en: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her  ; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more :

translation.kha: Hato ki kynjang mawsiang jong ka Lebanon ki ju un-long khyllem ka ïor ? Hato ki wahduid ba dait-thah na ki lumbah ki ju rngad ?
translation.en: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which cometh from the rock of the field ? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken ?
And Laban gathered together all the men of the place , and made a feast .
translation.kha: Kumta u Laban u pynlong ka jingkhawai shongkurim bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki briew baroh .
U Moses u ïohsngew ba ki Briew baroh ki ïakhñium katba ki dang ïa-ïeng lymbung kynhun kynhun ha lamkhmat jingkhang jong ki ïingjaiñ jong ki . U la sngewkhuslai namar ba U Trai u la bitar ïa ki ,
translation.en: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families , every man in the door of his tent : and the anger of the  Lord  was kindled greatly  ; Moses also was displeased .
But ye say , If a man shall say to his father or mother , It is Corban , that is to say , a gift , by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me  ; he shall be free .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi hikai ba lada u briew u don ei ei , kaba u lah ban pyndonkam ha kaba ïarap ïa u kpa lane ka kmie , hynrei u ong , ‘ Kane ka long ka Korban’ ( kaba mut , ka long sha U Blei ) ,
Babha u Reuben u la ïohsngew ïa ki , u la Pyrshang ïa-ban Pyllait im ïa u Joseph . To ngin ym pynpyut ïa u , u ong .
translation.en: And Reuben heard it , and he delivered him out of their hands  ; and said , Let us not kill him .

translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u phah khat ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong ki jait bad ki kur jong ki Israel ban wan sha u sha Jeremaïah khnang ban leit shim noh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai na ka Sephon , ka Nongbah u ïaiban , sha ka Tubal .
translation.en: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel , and all the heads of the tribes , the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel , unto king Solomon in Jerusalem , that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  out of the city of David , which is Zion .

translation.kha: U Blei un buh ïa ki angel ban khmih halor jongnga me ban ïalade ïa me shano sheng ba me leit .
translation.en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee , to keep thee in all thy ways .

translation.kha: U Trai un tim ïa ph da kaba pynduna ïa ki khun ki Ki jongnga phi , da kaba pynduna ïa ka jingseisoh ki jingthung jong phi , Bad da kaba pynduna ïa ki masi bad ki nongaplangbrot jong Phin .
translation.en: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body , and the fruit of thy land , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep .

translation.kha: Un synreit ruh hynñiew Saw ïa kata ka snam ha ka set ithuh u briew’ ïa ibha yn dang pynkhuid na ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh , bad hadien kata un sa pynbna ba u long ibha khuid . Un pyllait noh ïa kata ka sim kob ïalang im ba kan Ela kat seng ka mon .
translation.en: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times , and shall pronounce him clean , and shall let the living bird loose into the open field .

translation.kha: bad U Trai u ong ha u ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: Ar sngi hadien , la don ka jingkyntiew kurim ha ka shnong Kana kaba ha Galilaïa .
translation.en: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee  ; and the mother of Jesus was there :
But they shall proceed no further : for their folly shall be manifest unto all men , as theirs also was .
translation.kha: Hynrei kin ym lah ban leit kham jngai , namar baroh kin ïohi ba katno ki long kiba mutlop . Kata ka long kaei kaba dang dep jia ïa u Jannes bad u Jambres .

translation.en: Our soul waiteth for the  Lord  : he is our help and our shield .
translation.kha: Ngi buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha U  Trai  ; u long ka jingïada bad ka jingïarap jong ngi .
Ha kaweh ka don ka jingpihuiñ malu ka jingkhwan myntoi , hangta ka don ruh ka jingbymïaid ryntih bad ki jait jingsniew baroh .
translation.en: For where envying and strife is , there is confusion and every evil work .

translation.kha: Nga ïatip ba me Mynno namar ba me kynmaw ïing eh , hynñiew barli pat me tuh ïa ki blei ïing jong nga ?
translation.en: And now , though thou wouldest needs be gone , because thou sore longedst after thy father s house , yet wherefore hast thou stolen my gods ?

And Samuel said unto Jesse , Are here all thy children ? And he said , There remaineth yet the youngest , and , behold , he keepeth the sheep . And Samuel said unto Jesse , Send and fetch him : for we will not sit down till he come hither .
translation.kha: Nangta u kylli ïa u ,  Phi dang don shuh ki khun shynrang ?  U Jesse u jubab ,  Don sa tang uba khatduh , hynrei u dang leit sharai ïa ki langbrot .   Bthah ïa u ban wan shane ,  u Samuel u ong .  Ngin ym ai jingkñia katba um pat wan .

Kumta ka tnga jong u bad ki paralok jong u baroh ki ai jingmut , Balei ba phim shna da ka diengphasi kob arphew ar myntri ka jingurlong ? La sha mynstep phi lah ban ong ïa u skhem ban sdien ïa u Moladah hajir jong ka , bad nangta sa leit sha ka jingkhawai da kaba kmen . U Hamath u la pyrkhat ba kane ka long kaba dei , kumta u la phah thaw ïa ka diengphasi .
translation.en: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him , Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high , and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon : then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet . And the thing pleased Haman  ; and he caused the gallows to be made .

translation.kha: U Mikah u kylli ïa u , Nangno phi wan ? U jubab , Nga dei u Lebi na Bethlehem kaba ha Judah . Nga dang khmih haneng ba ngan shong ngan sah .
translation.en: And Micah said unto him , Whence comest thou ? And he said unto him , I am a Levite of Beth–lehem–judah , and I go to sojourn where I may find a place .

translation.kha: Nga dei ban jaiñjot ïa U Blei ha ki na baroh na ka beit Jong phi , ko parabangeit , phi kiba U tharai u ieit . Naba U Blei u la jied ïa phi kum kiba nongtong don pynim da ka bor U Mynsiem baneh pynlong ïa phi ki riewkhñium jong u sad da ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka jingshisha .
translation.en: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you , brethren beloved of the Lord , because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth :

Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following the  Lord  they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem  ; and he fled to Lachish : but they sent to Lachish after him , and slew him there .
translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por mynba u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , ka la don ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u ha Jerusalem . Ha kaba khatduh u la phet sha ka nongbah Lakhish , hynrei ki nongshun jong u ki la buddien ïa u shata bad ki la pynïap ïa u .

U patsha jong ki un phet ha ka jingsngew ishyrkhei , bun ki pynrangbah Shipai ken sheptieng haduh katta katta haduh ba kin iehnoh ïa ki lama thma jyllang ki . U Trai u la klun — U Trai ïa uba la ma ha Jerusalem bad uba ka ding jong u ka thang hangta ïa ki jingkñia .
translation.en: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear , and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign , saith the  Lord  , whose fire is in Zion , and his furnace in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: len wan ha phi bad pyllaitluid im ïa ph . Ngan pynjot ïa ki hima baroh sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , hynrei ngan ym pynjot ïa Phi . ngan nym shah ba phin laiñ khlem shah pynshitom ; hynrei haba to pynsum ïa phi , ngan lehhok . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Fear thou not , O Jacob my servant , saith the  Lord  : for I am with thee  ; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven thee : but I will not make a full end of thee , but correct thee in measure  ; yet will I not leave thee wholly unpunished .

translation.kha: U TRAI’ u la leh ha me kamra u la kren da ar : u la knieh kynthet ïa ka hangta na me , bad pynban u la ai ïa ka ha u Abda .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath done to him , as he spake by me : for the  Lord  hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand , and given it to thy neighbour , even to David :

translation.kha: To ïaid pyrthuh bud ïa nga , ko ki parabangeit jong nga . To pynleit jingmut ïa kito kiba bud ïa ka naba kaba dei kaban ngi la buh na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: Brethren , be followers together of me , and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an example .
And many of them said , He hath a devil , and is mad  ; why hear ye him ?
translation.kha: Bun na ki , ki la ïa-ong ,  U shongksuid ! U la lamwir ! Balei phi ïa-shahskhor ïa u ?

Kawei pa kawei ka kynthei ha ka hima kan sdang ban pynbieit ïa u tngit jong ka tang shu ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ka mahadei ka la leh . Kan Ong , ‘ U syiem Sypros u law ïa ka Bashti , ka mahadei , ban wan sha u bad ka kyntait .’
translation.en: For this deed of the queen shall come abroad unto all women , so that they shall despise their husbands in their eyes , when it shall be reported , The king Ahasuerus commanded Vashti the queen to be brought in before him , but she came not .

translation.kha: Me ieit ïa kaei kaba dei nabar me isih ïa ka bymdei . Namarkata U Blei , U Blei jong me , u la jied ïa me bad u la ai ha me ïa ka jingkmen ka jingpyndonburom kaba khampoh khriat ban ïa kaba u ai ïa ki paro jong me .
translation.en: Thou hast loved righteousness , and hated iniquity  ; therefore God , even thy God , hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows .
For as yet they knew not the scripture , that he must rise again from the dead .
translation.kha: ( Kim pat sngewthuh hi ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba la ong ba u dei ban mihpat na ka jingïap . )
Ka jingairam kaba hynriew la ai ha ki longïing na ka jait Naphtuh .
translation.en: The sixth lot came out to the children of Naphtali , even for the children of Naphtali according to their families .

translation.kha: Bad namarba ma u hi u long uba tlot , u dei ïa-ban ai ïa ki jingkñia ym tang na ka bynta ki pop jong ki briew hynrei namar ki pop jong u ruh .
translation.en: And by reason hereof he ought , as for the people , so also for himself , to offer for sins .
And it came to pass , while they were in the way , that tidings came to David , saying , Absalom hath slain all the king s sons , and there is not one of them left .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang don ha lynti sha ïing , la ïathuh ha u Dabid ,  U Absalom u la pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi baroh — ym don uwei ruh uba lait !
Wat ibeiñ ïa ki Edom ; ki longkmie hi ki para jong phiah . Bad wat jingibeiñ ïa ki Ijipt ; pa’ la shong shipor ha ka ri jong ki .
translation.en: Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite  ; for he is thy brother : thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian  ; because thou wast a stranger in his land .
Remove from me the way of lying : and grant me thy law graciously .
translation.kha: Sumar ïa nga na kaba leit ha ka lynti kaba bakla , bad ha ka jingbha jong me to hikai ïa nga ïa ka aiñ jong me .

Balei ba phi pynsheptieng haduh katne ? U Jisu u la jyllop . Katno kambah rit ka jingngeit phi don ! Nangta u la khie tohtit badno u la hukum ïa ki lyer bad ïa ki jingat phylla ban sangeh , bad ka la don ka jingjai jaiñ kaba khraw .
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Why are ye fearful , O ye of little faith ?  Then he arose , and rebuked the winds and the sea  ; and there was a great calm .
And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea  ; and it became as the blood of a dead man : and every living soul died in the sea .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba ar u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka duriaw . Ka um ka la kylla long kum ka snam jong u briew uba ïap , bad uwei pa uwei u jingthaw ba-im hapoh duriaw u la ïap .
Ki pung kjat jrong ki , ki long kiba bieit , Bad ki don ki khapnoh kum ki jongnga u masi dab , bad ki thaba khem ka rngad ba la shut pynphyrnai .
translation.en: And their feet were straight feet  ; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf s foot : and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass .

translation.kha: Ka jingïamai jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai , ka jingieit jong U Balei bad ka jingïohknieh jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid kin long lem bad phi baroh .
translation.en: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ , and the love of God , and the communion of the Holy Ghost , be with you all . Amen .
The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness , Prepare ye the way of the  Lord  , make straight in the desert a highway for our God .
translation.kha: Ka sur ka pyrta jam ,  To pynkhreh ha ka ri khlaw ïa ka lynti na ka bynta U  Trai  ! To pynkhuid ïa ka lynti ha ka ri shyiap na ka bynta U Blei jong ngi !
U la pah ïa u phria bad ka leilieh ha ka ri jong ki ha ka jaka jongki u shok ;
translation.en: He gave them hail for rain , and flaming fire in their land .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei ktien Kiba u Omri u la leh bad barabor ki jingjop jong u la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did , and his might that he shewed , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
And they cried out all at once , saying , Away with this man , and release unto us Barabbas :
translation.kha: Ki paidbah baroh ki la pyrta ,  Pynïap ïa u ! Pyllait ïa u Barabbas ha ngi !
Ka Leah ka la punkhun bad ka kha khun shynraiñ . Ka ïa-ong , U Trai u la ïohi ïa ka jingjynjar jong la , bad mynta u tnga jongu nga un ieit ïa nga ; kumta ka la khot kyrtong ïa u , u Reuben .
translation.en: And Leah conceived , and bare a son , and she called his name Reuben : for she said , Surely the  Lord  hath looked upon my affliction  ; now therefore my husband will love me .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha nga ïa kane kawei : Hato ph pdeng ïa U Mynhynnin U Blei da kaba leh ïa kadei ba ka Hukum ka dawa ne da Kaba ïohsngew ïa ka Gospel malade ngeit ïa ka ?
translation.en: This only would I learn of you , Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law , or by the hearing of faith ?

translation.kha: Kane kan longkmie ka kop jong ki namar ki la shah rem na ki pop bashyrkhei — ki la leh awria bad ki la ïathuh ki jinglamler ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai . Kñia ka long pynshisha ïa ka mon ka jong U Trai ; u tip ïa kaei kaba ki la leh , bad u longsem u sakhi pyrshah ïa ki . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: Because they have committed villany in Israel , and have committed adultery with their neighbours  wives , and have spoken lying words in my name , which I have not commanded them  ; even I know , and am a witness , saith the  Lord .
Now the rest of the acts of Baasha , and what he did , and his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Baasha u la leh bad ki kam shlur jong u baroh la buh jingthoh ha ka  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
Neng pynphong ïa phi ki briew jong nga , bad nga tun long U Blei jong pa . Phin sa tip ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi haba por pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka jingsngewnguh ha ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And I will take you to me for a people , and I will be to you a God : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  your God , which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians .

translation.kha: khnang ba phi eh ban long ki khun jong U Kpa jong Phin uba ha bneng . Namar u pynlong ïa ka Sngi kaweh u la thaw ban tyngshaiñ ha ki briew kiba sniew bad kiba bha kumjuh , bad u ai lup ha re uba leh ïa kaba bha bad ha kita kiba leh ïa kaba sngewieit .
translation.en: That ye may be the children of your Father which is in heaven : for he maketh his sun to rise on the evil and on the good , and sendeth rain on the just and on the unjust .
And he said unto them , Hear , I pray you , this dream which I have dreamed :
translation.kha: U ong ,  Shahshkor ïa ka jingphohsniew jong nga .
Kaba mih ka long , ba ïa kito baroh ki me skhem la ngeit ïa ka jingshem hynrei kiba la sngewma ha ka pop , yn pynrem .
translation.en: That they all might be damned who believed not the truth , but had pleasure in unrighteousness .
And the ambush arose quickly out of their place , and they ran as soon as he had stretched out his hand : and they entered into the city , and took it , and hasted and set the city on fire .
translation.kha: bad u tang shu rah ïa la ka kti , ki rangbah kiba la rieh ki ïeng joit , ki mareh sha ka nongbah bad kurup ïa ka . Mar mar ruh ki thang ïa ka nongbah .

Ki briew ki kylli ïa ki bleithaw bad ïa ki nongbatai kupar , hynrei ki jubab kiba ki ïoh ki lama ki jinglamler sad ki bym don jingjam . Katto katne ki pynryngkang ban batynrai ïa ki jingphohsniew , hynrei tang ban shu ïalam barew ïa phi ; ka jingpyntngen ba ki ai ka long ka bymmyntoi . Kumta ki briew ki sakma kylleng kum ka langbrot ba la bai . Ki don ha ka jingjynjar namar ba kim kein u nongïamareh .
translation.en: For the idols have spoken vanity , and the diviners have seen a lie , and have told false dreams  ; they comfort in vain : therefore they went their way as a flock , they were troubled , because there was no shepherd .
And early in the morning Laban rose up , and kissed his sons and his daughters , and blessed them : and Laban departed , and returned unto his place .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud u Laban u la doh khublei ïa la ki khun ksiew bad ïa la ki khun kynthei , bad u la leit phai pat sha la ïing .

Haba ka kynta kaba Khatduh jong u syiem ka Seraïah ka la jan wan arsut , u syiad ka Ijipt un tur ïaheh ïa u , bad u syiem ka Seruïah un ïaleh pyrshah da la ka bor baroh , da kaba pynbam ïa ki kali ïapom , ki kular , bad ki liengbah kiba bun . Un hiarthma ïa kiba bun ki ri , kum ka jingshlei ki um .
translation.en: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him : and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind , with chariots , and with horsemen , and with many ships  ; and he shall enter into the countries , and shall overflow and pass over .

translation.kha: Ngi baroh ngi tip , A Trai , ba ki patsha ka Assyria ki la pynjot ïa kiba dara ki jaitbynriew , bad pynlong ïa ki ri jong ki , ki bym khong briew ,
translation.en: Of a truth ,  Lord  , the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations , and their countries ,
But Mary kept all these things , and pondered them in her heart .
translation.kha: Ka Mari ka la kynmaw ïa kine kiei kiei baroh bad ka la pyrkhat jylliew shaphang kita .
Te lada uno uno u pynjot ïa ka templ jong U Blei , U blang un pynim ïa u . Naba ka templ jong U Blei ka long kabu khiah , sad phi hi ph long ka templ jong u .
translation.en: If any man defile the temple of God , him shall God destroy ; for the temple of God is holy , which temple ye are .

translation.kha: Te Lada pha Don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U mynsiem u ong ïa ki balang !
translation.en: He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .

translation.kha: Ka la long jingimat haba u Jehoash na Arimathaïa u la wan poi . U la erlangthari u pyndonburom jongnga ka Habor , uba ap ïa ka jingwan jong ka Hima U blang . Ka la hir ka sngi Pynkhreh ( Katai , ka sngi shuwa ka sngi Sabbaton ) , kumin u Joseph u la leit da ka jingshlur sha u Pilat Bad pan na u ïa ka met U Jisu .
translation.en: Joseph of Arimathaea , an honourable counsellor , which also waited for the kingdom of God , came , and went in boldly unto Pilate , and craved the body of Jesus .
So the spirit lifted me up , and took me away , and I went in bitterness , in the heat of my spirit  ; but the hand of the  Lord  was strong upon me .
translation.kha: Ka bor jong U  Trai  ka la wan ha nga da ka borbah , bad katba U Mynsiem jong u , u rah noh ïa nga , nga la sngewkthang bad sngewbitar .

translation.en: And Jonathan Saul s son arose , and went to David into the wood , and strengthened his hand in God .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u la leit sha u hangta bad u la pynshlur ïa u da ka jingpynthikna ïa ka jingïada jong U Blei ,

translation.en: I pray not that thou shouldest take them out of the world , but that thou shouldest keep them from the evil .
translation.kha: Ngam kyrpad ba men shim noh ïa ki na ka pyrthei , hynrei nga da kyrpad ba men ri kyndong ïa ki na uta u bymman .
U Trai u ong , Ha kata ka por ngan pynïaid pah ïa ka jingroi kyrhai jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: For , behold , in those days , and in that time , when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem ,

translation.kha: Kumta ki briew ki la shong ha ki laiñ , ha ki kynhun bashispah ngut bad ki kynhun basanphew ngut .
translation.en: And they sat down in ranks , by hundreds , and by fifties .

translation.kha: Wat ka jingïapan nabar ka jingpynjot ki ong ba ki la ïohsngew tang ki Hosia .
translation.en: Destruction and death say , We have heard the fame thereof with our ears .

translation.kha: U lah ban pom ïa ki dieng Kedar ngab pyndem , lap u jied da u dieng sneng lane u diengthang Kseh-Sypress na ka khlad . Lane u lah shun thung u dieng ba ïai jyrngam bad u ap ïa u plung ban pynmih ïa u .
translation.en: He heweth him down cedars , and taketh the cypress and the oak , which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest : he planteth an ash , and the rain doth nourish it .

translation.kha: Kumta u kylli na U Trai , Hammoth nur-um leit Bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ? Ho-oid U Trai u jingbabe . Tur ïaleh ïa ki bad pyllait im ïa ka Jeiel .
translation.en: Therefore David enquired of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go and smite these Philistines ? And the  Lord  said unto David , Go , and smite the Philistines , and save Keilah .

translation.kha: U wanlam ruh ïa u mrad na ka bynta ka jinganna ainguh thang , malade u kñia ïa u katba kumne ka jingbuhbeit ryntih .
translation.en: And he brought the burnt offering , and offered it according to the manner .
And the king said , What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this ? Then said the king s servants that ministered unto him , There is nothing done for him .
translation.kha: U syiem u kylli ,  Kumno ngi la pyndonburom bad ai bainong ïa u Mordekai na ka bynta kane ?  Ki shakri jong u ki jubab ,  Ym shym la leh ei ei na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: So shall ye say unto Joseph , Forgive , I pray thee now , the trespass of thy brethren , and their sin  ; for they did unto thee evil : and now , we pray thee , forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father . And Joseph wept when they spake unto him .
translation.kha: Kumta ngi kyrpad ïa phi ba phin map ïa ka kam sniew kaba ngi , ki shakri jong U Blei u kpa jong phi , ngi la leh .  U Joseph u ïam haba u ïohsngew ïa kane .

Ïalap lem ïa la ki para Israel haduh ba kin da ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U Trai u ai ha ki sha sepngi na Jordan bad haduh ba U Tiras un shah ba kin im suk im saiñ Hangne , kumba u la ai ïa phi haneng . Hadad kata , phi lah ban wan pei sha kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Until the  Lord  have given rest unto your brethren , as well as unto you , and until they also possess the land which the  Lord  your God hath given them beyond Jordan : and then shall ye return every man unto his possession , which I have given you .

translation.kha: U Abraham u jubab , Nga la pyrkhat ba yn ym ei hangne kiba sheptieng burom ïa U Blei , ba kumta kin pynkup ïa nga ban ïoh ïa ka tnga jong na .
translation.en: And Abraham said , Because I thought , Surely the fear of God is not in this place  ; and they will slay me for my wife s sake .

translation.kha: ktem shym tip ba u Joseph u sngewthuh aiñ ki ong , namar ki ïakren bad u da ka jingïarap u nongbatai ktien .
translation.en: And they knew not that Joseph understood them  ; for he spake unto them by an interpreter .

translation.kha: A Katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka suda bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi leit lyngba ki duli badno phi ïasaid sha kylleng ki ri baroh ban pynkylla ïano ïano ; badno haba Phin lah , phi pynlong ïa u ar shait Uba dei ban sien sha dujok kam phi hi , phi long !
translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye compass sea and land to make one proselyte , and when he is made , ye make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves .

translation.kha: U wan poi ha ka krem hajan ki katto katne ki jaka sor blang kiba harud lynti , Bad u rung shispah ban leit shabar . Ka jia ryngkhat ba ka dei kajuh ka krem ha katba u Dabid bad ki rangbah jongu u ki rieh khamtam Shabeh jong sakma ka krem .
translation.en: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way , where was a cave  ; and Saul went in to cover his feet : and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave .
And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones , and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale , for abundance .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u ka rupa ka don kynrei ha Jerusalem kumba don u maw , bad ïa u dieng Kedar kumba pahuh u dieng Dumbur ha ki kjat lum ka Judah .

translation.en: Confirming the souls of the disciples , and exhorting them to continue in the faith , and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Ki la pynkhlaiñ ïa ki riewngeit bad pynshlur ïa ki ban ïaineh skhem ha ka jingngeit .  Ngi dei ban ïaid lyngba bun ki jingjynjar ban ïohrung sha ka Hima U Blei ,  ki la hikai .
I pa jong ngi i la ïap ha ka ri khlaw khlem khun shynrang . Im shym ïadon ngan malade ki nongbeh jong u Korah kiba la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai ; i la ïap namar ka pah la jong .
translation.en: Our father died in the wilderness , and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the  Lord  in the company of Korah  ; but died in his own sin , and had no sons .

translation.kha: U Syiem u la loit noh ïa ka sati ba Don muhor ha ka ( naba u la shim noh na u Haman ) bad u ai ha u Marduk . Ka Esther ka nguh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u Haman ha ka jingtep u Mordekai .
translation.en: And the king took off his ring , which he had taken from Haman , and gave it unto Mordecai . And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman .

translation.kha: U Adam bad ka tnga jong u ki ka ïoh sa uwei pat u khun . Ka la ong , U Blei u la ai khun shynrang ïa to ha ka jaka u Abimael , ïa kiba u Kain u la pynnep . Kumta ka la kyrteng ïa u , u Seth .
translation.en: And Adam knew his wife again  ; and she bare a son , and called his name Seth : For God , said she , hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel , whom Cain slew .

translation.kha: Kyrpad na U Trai ba-bang kyrkhu ïa ki jingthmu jong phi , bad phan ïor jingjop ha kaba pyntreikam ïa ki .
translation.en: Commit thy works unto the  Lord  , and thy thoughts shall be established .
Give to every man that asketh of thee  ; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again .
translation.kha: Ai ha uno uno uba pan na phi ïa kano kano , bad haba uno uno u shim ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong phi , wat pan shuh ïa ka .
U syiem u ong , Ahimelekh , ma me bad ki ba-ïaishah ha-sem jong me baroh phi dei ban ïap .
translation.en: And the king said , Thou shalt surely die , Ahimelech , thou , and all thy father s house .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , NGA isih ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi ; ngam lah shah ïa ki !
translation.en: I hate , I despise your feast days , and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies .
And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Da kumta u Moses u ai ha ki Israel ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingrakhe ïa ka jinglehniam ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai .
Kumta u la pyn-i ïa ki , bad ki paid Ephraim bad Manasseh ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei hapoh ka nongbeh , lait tyngkan une u briew bad ka longïing jongnga u .
translation.en: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city , they smote the city with the edge of the sword  ; but they let go the man and all his family .

translation.kha: Ka Mikhal ka khun u Saul pynban ka ïapmat ïa u Dabid , bad hajan u Saul u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la sngewbha .
translation.en: And Michal Saul s daughter loved David : and they told Saul , and the thing pleased him .

translation.kha: Te ka jinglehbeiñ jngai nga kan tyngshaiñ ha phiah kum ka sngi mynstep , dara ki jingmong jong phi kin sa koit kloi . Ngan don jingset bad phi borabor ban pyllait ïa phi ; ka jingong ryngkat jong na kan ïada ïa phi ha ki liang baroh .
translation.en: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning , and thine health shall spring forth speedily : and thy righteousness shall go before thee  ; the glory of the  Lord  shall be thy rearward .

translation.kha: Haba u Ham , u kpa jong u Kanaan , u la ïohi ba u kpa jong u , u la lyngkhuit , u la mih shabar bad ïathuh ha la ki hynmen shynrang baïar ar ngut .
translation.en: And Ham , the father of Canaan , saw the nakedness of his father , and told his two brethren without .
Hell is naked before him , and destruction hath no covering .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kiba ïap ka plie rynghang ha U Blei ; ym don ka jingtap kaba kah ïa ka na ka jingïohi jong u .

translation.en: He wrote also letters to rail on the  Lord  God of Israel , and to speak against him , saying , As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand , so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand .
translation.kha: Ka shithi kaba u patsha u la thoh ka kren pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel . Ka ong ,  Ki blei jong ki hima kim shym lah ban pyllait ïa ki briew jong ki na ka bor jong nga , bad da lei lei U Blei jong u Hesekaïah un ym lah ban pyllait im ïa la ki briew na nga .

translation.en: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done , and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword .
translation.kha: U syiem Ahab u ïathuh ha ka Jesebel ka tnga jong u ïa baroh kaba u Elijah u la leh bad kumno ba u la pynïap lut ïa ki nongïathuhlypa u Baal .
Hikai ïa kiba la kham Rangbah ba kin long kiba adkar , kiba tipbriew bad kiba synran ïa lade ; kiba skhem ha ka jingngeit , ka jingieit bad ka jingïaishah jong ki .
translation.en: That the aged men be sober , grave , temperate , sound in faith , in charity , in patience .

translation.kha: Ym dei ma ngi bakha la khang khop ïa la ki dohnud shata phi ; dei ma phi kiba khang khot ïa la ki dohnud sha ngi .
translation.en: Ye are not straitened in us , but ye are straitened in your own bowels .

translation.kha: Lada nga ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingbam jongno nga , balei ba une uno un wohnia ïa nga na ka pyntwa ka jingbam ïa kaba nga da ainguh ?
translation.en: For if I by grace be a partaker , why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks ?
And the Jews also assented , saying that these things were so .
translation.kha: Ki Jiw ki la kyrshan ïa kane ka jingmudui bad ki la ong ba kane baroh ka long kaba shisha .

translation.en: Peter therefore went forth , and that other disciple , and came to the sepulchre .
translation.kha: Te u Petros bad uta uwei pat u synran ki la leit sha ka jingtep .
U Trai u la ong ha nga , Ngan pynshitom ïa Kito ki Lebi , ryngkat bad ïa kito kiba na ki paid Israel , kiba la iehnoh ïa nga bad mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translation.en: And the Levites that are gone away far from me , when Israel went astray , which went astray away from me after their idols  ; they shall even bear their iniquity .

translation.kha: Kum u la ong ha ki synran jong u , Ka jingot ka khraw eh , hynrei don khyndiat ki nongtrei ban lumlang ïa ka shapoh .
translation.en: Then saith he unto his disciples ,  The harvest truly is plenteous , but the labourers are few  ;

translation.kha: Kin bam haw ïa ki jingthung bad ïa ki jingbam jong phi ; kin pynïap ïa ki ïakhun shynraiñ sad ki khun kynthei jong phi . Kin pynïap ïa ki kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun masi jong phi nabar pynjot ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad diengsoh Dumbur jongu phi . Ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynrup ha kiba ph shaniah yn pynjot da ka kynhun shipai jong ki .
translation.en: And they shall eat up thine harvest , and thy bread , which thy sons and thy daughters should eat : they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds : they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees : they shall impoverish thy fenced cities , wherein thou trustedst , with the sword .

translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa tymmen u shim ïa kata ka metïap bad u kyntiap ïa ka halor ka nang , bad u kitei kit pat ïa ka sha Bethel pun ïam sngewsih bad ban tep ïa ka .
translation.en: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God , and laid it upon the ass , and brought it back : and the old prophet came to the city , to mourn and to bury him .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka jingthmu nga phah ha phi ïa u Timothi , uba long u Kynhun ba-ïaitrei bad baïaineh jongngi nga ha ka jingim kum uba ngeit . Un pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa ki nongrim kiba nga burom ha ka jingrem ka thymmai ha U Khrist Jisu bun kaba nga hikai ha ki bajlan barhem uba khong kylleng .
translation.en: For this cause have I sent unto you Timothy , who is my beloved son , and faithful in the Lord , who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ , as I teach every where in every church .
Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria :
translation.kha: Te u Isaïah u la phah ka khubor ban ïathuh ha u syiem Hesekaïah kaba jubab ïa ka jingduwai u syiem .

translation.en: And they went about in Judah , and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Judah , and the chief of the fathers of Israel , and they came to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ki la ïaleit sha baroh ki nongbah jong ka Judah bad ki wallam pat bad ki sha Jerusalem ïa ki Lebi bad ïa baroh ki rangbah kur .
Kane ka jia ha Meribah , ha kaba ki Jesreel ki la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa U Trai , bad ha kaba u la pynpaw ïa lade ba u long uba khuid .
translation.en: This is the water of Meribah  ; because the children of Israel strove with the  Lord  , and he was sanctified in them .

I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom , nor your spouses when they commit adultery : for themselves are separated with whores , and they sacrifice with harlots : therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall .
translation.kha: Wat la katta ruh ngan ym pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kane , namar ma phi hi phi ïa-ïaid lang bad ki nuti kiba ha ka templ , bad ryngkat bad ki , phi ai ki jingkñia ba-thala . Kumba ka proberb ka ong , ‘ Ki briew kiba khlem pyrkhat kin sa jot noh .’
Ki la wei phai bad ki la ïathuh ha kiew pat , hynriewphew kim shym la ngeit ïa dat .
translation.en: And they went and told it unto the residue : neither believed they them .

Therefore is the anger of the  Lord  kindled against his people , and he hath stretched forth his hand against them , and hath smitten them : and the hills did tremble , and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets . For all this his anger is not turned away , but his hand is stretched out still .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ïa la ki briew bad u la kner ïa la ka kti ban pynshitom ïa ki . Ki lumbah kin khynñiuh bad ïa ki met jong kito kiba la ïap yn ieh ha ki lynti kum ka synrum . Pynban wat la katta ruh ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  ym shym la pynkut , hynrei ka kti jong u kan ïai kner ban pynshitom .

translation.en: And the space in which we came from Kadesh–barnea , until we were come over the brook Zered , was thirty and eight years  ; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host , as the  Lord  sware unto them .
translation.kha: Kane ka long laiphew phra snem hadien ba ngi la mih na Kadesh Barnea . Ki rangïapom baroh jong kata ka pateng ki la ïap lut , kumba U  Trai  u la kren lypa .
Ma ngi kiba long kiba khlaiñ ha ka jingngeit , ngi dei ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot ba kin bah ïa ki jingtip jong ki . Ngi dei ban pynsngewbha ïa lade .
translation.en: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak , and not to please ourselves .

translation.kha: Baroh Kiba nga la ïathuh lyngka , mynta ki la urlong ; phi hap ban ïa-pdiang ba ki jingïathuh lypa jong nga ki long kiba dei . Mynta ngan ong ïa phi ïa kiei kiei kiba thymmai ki ban wan , ki jingjia kiba im shym la pynpaw mynshuwa .
translation.en: Thou hast heard , see all this  ; and will not ye declare it ? I have shewed thee new things from this time , even hidden things , and thou didst not know them .

translation.kha: Kita ki khynñiat shynrang ki la na san nang rangbah , bad u Iso u kyllaiñ long u nongbeh mrad uba tbit , u bariew uba ieid ban shang lum shaneng wah , katba u Jakob pat u long u briew uba jar buid , uba shong tang ha ïing .
translation.en: And the boys grew : and Esau was a cunning hunter , a man of the field  ; and Jacob was a plain man , dwelling in tents .

translation.kha: Ki nonglamktien na ka nongbah Dan malade na ki lam Ephraim ki pynbna ïa ka khubor basniew .
translation.en: For a voice declareth from Dan , and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim .

translation.kha: Wat ju ailad ïa u brisoh ibha jaipdeh ban leh ei ei na ka bynta jrong phi ; un long kumto ka sirka kaba pynshyrkhei ïa ki bniat , dawai kam pynsat ka tdem ïa ki khmih .
translation.en: As vinegar to the teeth , and as smoke to the eyes , so is the sluggard to them that send him .

translation.kha: Te ngan kynjat ban ïarap ïa ki Naamah ba ki la sa Jingbymman Bad mane ïa kiwei pat ki blang .
translation.en: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought , in that they are turned unto other gods .

translation.kha: U angel jongno nga un leit ha shuwa jong phi! badno un ïalam ïa phi sha ka ri jong ki Amor , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Kanaan , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus ; malu ngan pynïoh ïa ki .
translation.en: For mine Angel shall go before thee , and bring thee in unto the Amorites , and the Hittites , and the Perizzites , and the Canaanites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites : and I will cut them off .

translation.kha: Ïa u Daniel la wallam shisyndon shapoh shaw ka jakarieh ba khong u syiem , bad u syiem u la ong ha u , Hato me dei u Daniel , uto u Jisu uba shah ringmraw ïa umbah u kper jong nga u syiem u la wallam hangne na Judah ?
translation.en: Then was Daniel brought in before the king . And the king spake and said unto Daniel , Art thou that Daniel , which art of the children of the captivity of Judah , whom the king my father brought out of Jewry ?
For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate : for the hay is withered away , the grass faileth , there is no green thing .
translation.kha: Ka wahduid Nimrim ka rngad , u phlang harud jong ka u la ïapstai , bad ym don kano kano kaba jyrngam kaba dang sah .
U syiem Serksis u la pynong ka jingpyntrei jubor ïa ki briew kiba ha ki wat duriaw jong ka Hima jong u Kumjuh umdih ïa kito ki briew kiba sheng shapoh .
translation.en: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land , and upon the isles of the sea .

translation.kha: Ïa phi! ruh , la tei ha ka nongrim ba la buh da ki apostol nabar ki nongïathuhlypa , u mawdong uba long U Khrist Jisu hi .
translation.en: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets , Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone ;

Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor , and ye take from him burdens of wheat : ye have built houses of hewn stone , but ye shall not dwell in them  ; ye have planted pleasant vineyards , but ye shall not drink wine of them .
translation.kha: Phi la banbeiñ ïa kiba duk bad la shim jubor na ki ïa u kew jong ki . Bad kumta phin ym ïoh sah ha ki ïing maw ba-itynnat ba phi la tei lane dih waiñ na ki bri sohwaiñ kiba itynnat ba phi la thung .
long hynñiew tylli ki basa kyntiew kiba sngaid bad kiba plung ki la wan mih na ka wah bad ki tdong ban ïabam phlang .
translation.en: And , behold , there came up out of the river seven kine , fatfleshed and well favoured  ; and they fed in a meadow :
Yea , and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after , as many as have spoken , have likewise foretold of these days .
translation.kha: Bad baroh ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la don ka khubor , kynthup ïa u Samuel bad kito kiba mih hadien jong u , ki la pynbna ruh ïa kaei kaba la jia ha kine ki sngi .

Kumba u kyrkhu ïa ki ha tala ka sngi , u da ong , Ki Israel kin sa shim ïa ki ktung jong phi haba ki kyrkhu kyrdoh ïano ïano . Kin ïa-ong , ‘ To U Blei un pynlong ïa phoi kum u Ephraim bad kum u Manasseh .’ Da kumta u la buh ïa u Ephraim ha shuwa u Manasseh .
translation.en: And he blessed them that day , saying , In thee shall Israel bless , saying , God make thee as Ephraim and as Manasseh : and he set Ephraim before Manasseh .

translation.kha: U ba-beit u haw banbeiñ pyndonkam ïa ka proberb tang kumba u briew suba dkoh u lah ban pyndonkam ïa ki kjat jong u .
translation.en: The legs of the lame are not equal : so is a parable in the mouth of fools .
And Noah awoke from his wine , and knew what his younger son had done unto him .
translation.kha: Ynda u Noah u la pyngngad , bad u la tip aïu u khun khatduh jong u , u la leh ïa u ,

translation.en: And Saul said , I will give him her , that she may be a snare to him , and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him . Wherefore Saul said to David , Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain .
translation.kha: U ong ha lade ,  Ngan ai ïa ka Mikhal ha u Dabid : ngan pyndonkam ïa ka ban riam ïa u , bad un sa shah pynïap ha ki Philistia .  Kumta ha ka sien kaba ar u Saul u ong ha u Dabid ,  Men sa long u pyrsa kurim jong nga .
Khenani kim shym ong ei ei . U Jisu u la shim ïa uba u briew , U la pynkhiah ïa u , bad U la phah noh ïa u .
translation.en: And they held their peace . And he took him , and healed him , and let him go  ;

translation.kha: To ïa-pdiang iwei ïa iwei te , na ka bynta ka bur jong U Bela , kumba U Khrist u la pdiang ïa phi .
translation.en: Wherefore receive ye one another , as Christ also received us to the glory of God .
So the people of Nineveh believed God , and proclaimed a fast , and put on sackcloth , from the greatest of them even to the least of them .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Ninebeh ki la ngeit ïa ka khubor U Blei . Kumta ki la ïa-rai ba baroh ki dei ban shahjingit , bad ba baroh ki briew , naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw tam , ban phong jaiñ khain ban pynpaw ba ki la kylla-kaba-mut .

Ki ar ngut ki syiad , kiba riam da ki jaiñphong syiem jongno ki , ki Dang ïasdang ha la ki khep ha ka jaka Saw kew kaba habar ka khyrdop Semaraim nabar baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïalang ïaphla ha khmat jong ki .
translation.en: And the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah sat each on his throne , having put on their robes , in a void place in the entrance of the gate of Samaria  ; and all the prophets prophesied before them .

translation.kha: uta u briew u dei ban siew ïa u kjap jong kata ka briew sanphew tylli ki sbai rupa , bad kata ka briew kan long ka tnga jong u , namar u la pynbor ïa ka ban ïathiah shongkha bad u . Katba u ding im um ia shuh ban pyllait ïa ka .
translation.en: Then the man that lay with her shall give unto the damsel s father fifty shekels of silver , and she shall be his wife  ; because he hath humbled her , he may not put her away all his days .

translation.kha: baroh phim ktieh kiei ki wan napoh u briew bad pynlong bymkhuid ïa u .
translation.en: All these evil things come from within , and defile the man .

translation.kha: U Joab u jubab , To U Trai un pynroi bun ïa ki paid Jesreel shispah shah ban ïa kaba ki long mynta ! Shimei Kynrad , ki baïar ki dei ki sakhrai jong pa . Balei phi kaweh ban leh ïa kane bad pynkit pop ïa ka jaitbynriew barieh kawei ?
translation.en: And Joab answered , The  Lord  make his people an hundred times so many more as they be : but , my lord the king , are they not all my lord s servants ? why then doth my lord require this thing ? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel ?

translation.kha: To leh ïa kito kiei kiei ki ban pyn-i ba phi la peiñ nong na ki pop jong phi .
translation.en: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance :

translation.kha: Ïa de ruh yn pyndap da ka jingmeng namar ka Jerusalem bad ki briew jong ka . Hangta yn ym don sha ka jingïamai , yn ym don shuh ki ban khot kyrpad ban ioh jingïarap .
translation.en: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem , and joy in my people : and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her , nor the voice of crying .
And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs :
translation.kha: bad shi kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot , lem ryngkat bad ïa ki jingainguh waiñ kiba donkam .
Ka jingshem jong me kan kham pynni ban ïa ka jingshai ka sngi ha ka por shiteng sngi , bad ki kynta ba-dum tam jong ka jingim kin pyni kum ka step phyrngab .
translation.en: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday  ; thou shalt shine forth , thou shalt be as the morning .

translation.kha: Hynrei u ainong shuh shuh , Shah ngan pan dang kawei na ph . Uwei pa uwei na pa’ un ai noh ha nga ïa ki sohshkor ba phi la shim . ( Ki Madan kumta kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap , ki deng ki sohshkor ksiar . )
translation.en: And Gideon said unto them , I would desire a request of you , that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey . ( For they had golden earrings , because they were Ishmaelites . )
But one of the young men told Abigail , Nabal s wife , saying , Behold , David sent messengers out of the wilderness to salute our master  ; and he railed on them .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki shakri jong u Nabal u ong ha ka Abigail ka tnga jong u Nabal ,  Hato phi ïohsngew ? U Dabid u la phah katto katne ngut ki nonglamktien na ka ri khlaw lem bad ka jingai khublei ïa u kynrad jong ngi , hynrei u la ñiewbeiñ ïa ki .
ïa ka duwan rmiang bad ka kriah rnong jong ka , ïa ki jingbah jong ka bad ïa ki tyrwa ki tar jong ka ; ïa ka dabor nabar ïa ka jingpynshong jong ka ;
translation.en: The brasen altar , and his grate of brass , his staves , and all his vessels , the laver and his foot ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u la pdiang ïa kaei Kaba ka la wallam ïa u bad u ong ha ka , Khie leit pah neh sha ïing Bad kam khuslai . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba phin kwah .
translation.en: So David received of her hand that which she had brought him , and said unto her , Go up in peace to thine house  ; see , I have hearkened to thy voice , and have accepted thy person .

translation.kha: Te tista long ka nang kaba rieh . Bad U Kpa jong phi , wahbah ïohi ïa Kiei kaba phi leh ha kaba rakhe , un ainong ïa phi .
translation.en: That thine alms may be in secret : and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly .
And it came to pass at the seven years  end , that the woman returned out of the land of the Philistines : and she went forth to cry unto the king for her house and for her land .
translation.kha: Ynda la kut kita ki hynñiew snem , ka la wan phai sha Israel bad ka la leit sha u syiem ban kyrpad ïa u ban pynphai biang sha ka ïa ka ïing bad ka khyndew jong ka .

translation.en: Write the things which thou hast seen , and the things which are , and the things which shall be hereafter  ;
translation.kha: Thoh te , ïa kiei kiei kiba me ïohi ; kita kiei kiei kiba long mynta bad kita kiei kiei ki ban sa jia hadien .

Khie jat Lashai mynstep ha ka por ba miej ka sngi bad Pynlong ka jingtur ïabah kaba kynsan hajar ka nongbah . Nangta hajan u Gaal malade la ki rangbah ki mih shabar pyrshah ïa pa’ , tied tyngeh ïa ki kat kaba phira lai !
translation.en: And it shall be , that in the morning , as soon as the sun is up , thou shalt rise early , and set upon the city : and , behold , when he and the people that is with him come out against thee , then mayest thou do to them as thou shalt find occasion .

translation.kha: Pynbna , a uno uba bah ïa ki swai kiba jew Kan pynlong ba ki bniat jong u hi kin shyrkhei ; bad uwei uwei baroh un ïap namarba ki pop jong u hi .
translation.en: But every one shall die for his own iniquity : every man that eateth the sour grape , his teeth shall be set on edge .

translation.kha: Ka kynhun Israel baroh ka la mihnoh na Elim , bad ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba ar naduh ba ki mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt , ki la wan poi ha ka ri shyiap Sin , kaba don phangpdeng ka Elihu mala ka synrai .
translation.en: And they took their journey from Elim , and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin , which is between Elim and Sinai , on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U Moses u leh kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: And Moses did so : as the  Lord  commanded him , so did he .

translation.kha: Ym pat ju don mynno mynno , bad yn ym ne lano lynnong , ba la dat kum kata ka sngap , mynba U Trai u la shahshkor ïa u bahynriew . U Trai u ïaleh ha ka liang ki Israel !
translation.en: And there was no day like that before it or after it , that the  Lord  hearkened unto the voice of a man : for the  Lord  fought for Israel .

translation.kha: Balei yn ym ong te , To ngin leh ïa ka sniew khnang ba kambah ibha kan mih ? Katto katne ñiut ki bynriew , shispah , ki pynjahburom ïa ang da kaba pharep ïa nga da kaba ong ïa kane katei kaei hi ! Kim shahïap pynrem , kumba ki dei ban shah .
translation.en: And not rather , (as we be slanderously reported , and as some affirm that we say) Let us do evil , that good may come ? whose damnation is just .

translation.kha: Katba phi nang bunktien , katta phi nang leh pop . Lada phi long uba riewstad phin sngap jar .
translation.en: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin : but he that refraineth his lips is wise .
And I will set my face against them  ; they shall go out from one fire , and another fire shall devour them  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I set my face against them .
translation.kha: bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki . Ki lah lait na kawei ka ding , hynrei mynta ka ding kan thang khoit ïa ki . Haba nga pynshitom ïa ki , phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
Kumta u Dabid u ong , Kane ka dei ka jaka ha kaba ka Templ jongno U thri U Blei kan don . Hangne ka don ka duwan ha kaba ki paid Israel ki dei ban ai ki jingainguh Thang .
translation.en: Then David said , This is the house of the  Lord  God , and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel .

translation.kha: U Trai u phah ïa ki nongpynïaidkam bad ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki Jeruel bad Judah : Iehnoh khong ïa ki lynti kynriang bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , ïa kiba la don ha ka Aiñ kaba nga la ai ïa ki kjap tymmen jong phi bad kaba nga la aiti pateng ha phi lyngba ki shakri jong nga bad ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: Yet the  Lord  testified against Israel , and against Judah , by all the prophets , and by all the seers , saying , Turn ye from your evil ways , and keep my commandments and my statutes , according to all the law which I commanded your fathers , and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets .

translation.kha: Kine ki dur u thung kiba da ka ksiar ba ki Philistia ki phah pat kum ka jingainguh namar ka jingpalat shai U Trai ki long na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka shnong : Ka ïashad , ka Gasa , ka Ashkelon , ka Gath , bad ka Ekron .
translation.en: And these are the golden emerods which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering unto the  Lord   ; for Ashdod one , for Gaza one , for Ashkelon one , for Gath one , for Ekron one  ;

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la shem ïa uta u bri bad u la kylli ïa u , Hato me ngeit ha U ka U Briew ?
translation.en: Jesus heard that they had cast him out  ; and when he had found him , he said unto him ,  Dost thou believe on the Son of God ?
And he began to teach them , that the Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders , and of the chief priests , and scribes , and be killed , and after three days rise again .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la sdang ban hikai ïa ki synran jong u :  U Khun U Briew u dei ban shahshitom shibun bad ban shah kyntait da ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad da ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Un sa shah pynïap , hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .

translation.en: For he hath broken the gates of brass , and cut the bars of iron in sunder .
translation.kha: U la pynpait ïa ki jingkhang rnong bad pynpra ïa ki nar kiba ker .
Hangta u ap mynta tad ynda U Blei u la pyndem ïa ki nongshun jong u kum ka jingïuhkjat shiah ki kjat lad u .
translation.en: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool .

translation.kha: Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba har ïa kaba bha ha ki por baroh bad u bym ju leh bakla .
translation.en: For there is not a just man upon earth , that doeth good , and sinneth not .

Shall not all these take up a parable against him , and a taunting proverb against him , and say , Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his ! how long ? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay !
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la shahjop ki beiñ pyrshah ïa kiba jop ïa ki bad ki pyn-i jingisih ïa ki . Kin ong ,  Phi shim ïa kaei ka bym dei ka jong phi , hynrei phi long ba la tim ! Katno slem phin ïailong kiba riewspah da kaba pynbor ïa ki nongshim ram jong phi ban siew noh ?

translation.en: And Aaron said , Let not the anger of my lord wax hot : thou knowest the people , that they are set on mischief .
translation.kha: U Aaron u jubab ,  Wat bitar ïa nga . Phi tip ba kine ki briew ki long kiba im sngi tang ban leh ïa kaba sniew .

translation.en: A man shall not take his father s wife , nor discover his father s skirt .
translation.kha: Uno uno u briew um dei ban pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kpa da kaba u ïathiah shongkha bad kawei na ki tnga u kpa jong u .
ïa ka Synduk ka Jingot ha kaba don ki mawlyngkniap , ïa ki jingbah bad ïa ka jingtap jngai ka ;
translation.en: The ark of the testimony , and the staves thereof , and the mercy seat ,
These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon s work , five hundred and fifty , which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work .
translation.kha: Don sanspah sanphew ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba peit ïa ki briew kiba tei ïa ki jingtei u Solomon .
Nga la pynlong ïa u , u nongïalam bad u nongai law ïa ki jaitbynriew ; bad lyngba jong u por la pyn-i ha ki ïa ka bor jong nga .
translation.en: Behold , I have given him for a witness to the people , a leader and commander to the people .
But he saith unto them ,  It is I  ; be not afraid .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  dei ma nga !
Ko Kynrad , ki la Ong ïa u , to ai ha ngi ïa une u kpa borabor .
translation.en: Then said they unto him , Lord , evermore give us this bread .

And thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  , and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel , saying , They are laid desolate , they are given us to consume .
translation.kha: Te men sa tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ jong me ba ïa ki lumbah ka Israel ba ki la sah kynjah bad ba ki long ki jong me ba men bam duh .

Kane ka dei kaei kaba U Trai u ong shaphang ka Damaskos : Ki briew ha ki nongbet jong ka Hamath bad ka Arpad ki khublei bad ki sngew jynjar namar ki la ïohsngew ïa ki khubor basniew . Ka jinglyng-a ka tyllun khashor jong ki kum ka duriaw , bad kim ïoh jahthait .
translation.en: Concerning Damascus . Hamath is confounded , and Arpad : for they have heard evil tidings : they are fainthearted  ; there is sorrow on the sea  ; it cannot be quiet .
And Joseph said unto his father , Not so , my father : for this is the firstborn  ; put thy right hand upon his head .
translation.kha: U ong ha la u kpa ,  Pa , ym dei kumto . Une uba nyngkong ; buh ïa ka kti kamon jong phi ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: Well ; because of unbelief they were broken off , and thou standest by faith . Be not highminded , but fear :
translation.kha: Kata ka long kaba shisha . Ïa ki la pynkheiñ noh namar kim shym la ngeit , katba phi sah ha la ka jaka namar ba phi ngeit . Hynrei wat sngewsarong na ka bynta kata ; pynban , to sheptieng .
ha kaba u la shym ba ki rangbah shipai ki dang ïashong pyrkhat kam . U ong , Kynrad , nga don ka khubor ïa pa’ . U Jehu u kylli , Phi kren ïano na Ngi ? Ïa phi keiñ , ko rangbah , u jubab .
translation.en: And when he came , behold , the captains of the host were sitting  ; and he said , I have an errand to thee , O captain . And Jehu said , Unto which of all us ? And he said , To thee , O captain .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Pharaoh u ïor ba Kita ki jakoid ki la ïap , u la kylla mutlop biang , bad kumba U Trai u la lah ong , u Pharaoh um shym la shakor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
translation.en: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite , he hardened his heart , and hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ! nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa khnai ha shuwa ba ka pa kan poi .
translation.en: Behold , I have told you before .
If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant , when they contended with me  ;
translation.kha: Haba uno uno na ki shakri jong nga u mudui pyrshah ïa nga , ngan shahshkor bad leh da kaba hok ïa u .

Nangta u la ong ha nga , Horon jong ka la thoh ïa ka jingtim kiba dih ban leit sha ka ri baroh kamai . Ha kawei ka liang jong ka kot kli ka ong ba ïa uwei pa uwei u nongtuh yn bneng noh na ka ri ; bad ha kawei pat ka liang ka ong ba ïa ine uno uba ïathuh lamler hapoh ka jingsmai yn shim noh ïa u ruh .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth : for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it  ; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it .
And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me .
translation.kha: A katno suk ka long ïa kito ki bym don jingartatien shaphang jong nga !
U Hamor u kpa jong u Shekhem u la leit ban ïakren bad u Jakob , hamar ba ki khwan shynrang jong u Jakob ki la wan phai na ki pyntha .
translation.en: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him .
And Abimelech took sheep , and oxen , and menservants , and womenservants , and gave them unto Abraham , and restored him Sarah his wife .
translation.kha: Te u Abimelekh u pynphai pat ïa ka Sarah ha u Abraham , bad ha kajuh ka por u la ai ha u ïa ki langbrot , ki masi , bad ki mraw .

Nangta pat u shim ïa ka kitab ka jutang ha kambah la thoh ïa ki hukum U Troas bun u pule jam ïa ka ha uta u paidbah ; ki ruh ki ïa-ong , Ïa kita baroh kiba U TRAI’ u la hukum , ngin lai , bad ngin kohnguh .
translation.en: And he took the book of the covenant , and read in the audience of the people : and they said , All that the  Lord  hath said will we do , and be obedient .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ba ki khun shynrang bad ki Kynhun kynthei jong phi yn die sha ki briew ka Judah ; ma ki ktien sa die ïa ki shaei jngai sha ki Shebanaïah . Ma nga , U Trai , sa la kren .
translation.en: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah , and they shall sell them to the Sabeans , to a people far off : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .

translation.kha: Baroh Kaba la shna da ka rupa , ka ksiar , ka rnong lane ka nar , la buh bakyrpang na ka bynta U Terah . Dei ban bsuh ïa kata ha ka ïing jingkynshew U Trai .
translation.en: But all the silver , and gold , and vessels of brass and iron , are consecrated unto the  Lord  : they shall come into the treasury of the  Lord .

Then they came near , and spake before the king concerning the king s decree  ; Hast thou not signed a decree , that every man that shall ask a petition of any God or man within thirty days , save of thee , O king , shall be cast into the den of lions ? The king answered and said , The thing is true , according to the law of the Medes and Persians , which altereth not .
translation.kha: baroh na ki , ki la ïaleit lang sha u syiem ban mudui ïa u Daniel . Ki la ong ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi la soi ïa ka hukum ba na ka bynta ki laiphew sngi kiba bud ïa uno uno uba kyrpad ïa kano kano na uno uno u blei lane na uno uno u briew lait tang na phi , yn bret ïa u hapoh ka thliew ba-dap da ki sing .  U syiem u la jubab ,  Ho-oid , ka hukum kaba pyrkhing , ka aiñ jong ki Mid bad ki Persia , ka bym lah ban pynkylla .

Nangta u angel u la ong ha nga , Kainan ki ktien ki long kiba shisha bad naba ha ban shaniah . Doeg U Trai uba U blang , uba ai ïa U Mynhynnin jong u ha ki nongïathuhlypa , u la phad ïa u angel jong u ban pyn-i ha ki shakri jong u ïa kaei kaba dei ban jia shen .
translation.en: And he said unto me , These sayings are faithful and true : and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done .

translation.kha: U la leit sha u Pilat dara u la pan ïa ka met U Ujuh . U pyllait u la hukum ban ai ïa ka met ha u Joseph .
translation.en: He went to Pilate , and begged the body of Jesus . Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered .
And now I beseech thee , lady , not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee , but that which we had from the beginning , that we love one another .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko Kynthei badonburom : To ai ba baroh ngin ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat . Kane kam long ka hukum kaba thymmai kaba nga thoh sha phi ; ka long ka hukum kaba ngi la don naduh mynnyngkong .

Kum u Hasar u pynkit ïa baroh ki jait jingmih kiba kynsai tam jongu ka Damaskos ha ki sawphew tylliat ki ut mala u leit sha u Elihu . Haba u Hasael u la ïakynduh ïa u , u ong , U shrak Jong phi u syiem Benhadad u la phah ïa nga ban kylli na phin la un dang koit ne em na ka jingpang jong u .
translation.en: So Hazael went to meet him , and took a present with him , even of every good thing of Damascus , forty camels  burden , and came and stood before him , and said , Thy son Ben–hadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee , saying , Shall I recover of this disease ?

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u thoh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa kijuh ki Ktien ba u la thoh ha ka sien kabu nyngkong , ïa ki Shiphew Hukum keiñ ba u la ai ha ph manbha u la klun napdeng ka ding ha kata ka sngi ba phi ïalumlang ha iathuh u lumlang . U Trai u ai ha nga ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap , bad nga phai bad leit hiar na uta u Lum .
translation.en: And he wrote on the tables , according to the first writing , the ten commandments , which the  Lord  spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly : and the  Lord  gave them unto me .

translation.kha: U la lytar ban thoh Kyrteng lem bad ka Mari , kaba la ïatehktien pynlang u .
translation.en: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife , being great with child .

translation.kha: Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka jingsngewmeng jong phi ; yn ym don slap , bad ka khynwin jong phi kan tyrkhong bad eh kum u nar .
translation.en: And I will break the pride of your power  ; and I will make your heaven as iron , and your earth as brass :
And her adversary also provoked her sore , for to make her fret , because the  Lord  had shut up her womb .
translation.kha: Ka Peninnah , kaba ju pyrshah ïa ka , ka pynshitom bad ñiewbeiñ ïa ka , namar ba U  Trai  u la pynlyngki ïa ka .
Syiem Kren , ka ong , ïa kano kano kaba phi leh , ma nga mala la ka longïing ïong shimti ïa ka jingshah kynnoh ; ma phi bad la ka longïing syiem phi lait .
translation.en: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king , My lord , O king , the iniquity be on me , and on my father s house : and the king and his throne be guiltless .
Now a mediator is not a mediator of one , but God is one .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa u ksiang ym donkam haba treikam tang uwei u briew ; bad U Blei u long uwei .

translation.en: And ye shall eat it in every place , ye and your households : for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi , phi lah ban bam ïa kata kaba dang sah ha kano kano ka jaka , namar ka long ka bainong ïa ka jingshakri jong phi ha ka Ïingjaiñ .
Kumta u la wan ha u Moses , u da ïalam ruh ïa ka Sipporah , ka tnga jong u Messaïah , kaba u khlem ïalam sam ,
translation.en: Then Jethro , Moses  father in law , took Zipporah , Moses  wife , after he had sent her back ,

translation.kha: Ngam la thngan bad phi la bsa ïa nga , nga la sliang bad phi la ai jingdih ïa por ; nga la long u nongkhaïi pynlang phi la jingpdiang sngewbha ïa ar ha ki ïing jong Phin ,
translation.en: For I was an hungred , and ye gave me meat : I was thirsty , and ye gave me drink : I was a stranger , and ye took me in :

translation.kha: Ki la leh kumta , bad u ong , Leh biang kumta — bad ki la ar biang kumta . U la ong , lehhok biang sa Sihon , bad ki la leh kumta .
translation.en: And he said , Do it the second time . And they did it the second time . And he said , Do it the third time . And they did it the third time .
And the men of the city went out , and fought with Joab : and there fell some of the people of the servants of David  ; and Uriah the Hittite died also .
