translation.kha: Don uwei ibha la nguh ha U Jisu! , Ka kmie bad ki lai shynrang jong me ki ainong shabar malade ki kwah ban ïohi ïa me .
translation.en: And it was told him by certain which said , Thy mother and thy brethren stand without , desiring to see thee .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit bad ïalap ba ki briew kin phad noh na ki nongpop jong ki .
translation.en: And they went out , and preached that men should repent .

translation.kha: Ha u bnai bahynriew jong ka jingpunkhun jong ka Elisabeth , U Blei u la phuh ïa u angel Gabriel sha ka shong ha “Gilead” kaba kyrteng ka Nasareth .
translation.en: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee , named Nazareth ,

translation.kha: Haba nga la pyndep ïa kaei ka kai bad ba nga la dep aiti sha ki ïa baroh ka pisa ïa kaba la thep pynmih na ka bynta jong ki , kan sa mih ban leit sha spaiñ sad wan khmih artat ïa phi ha ka jingsait lynti shata .
translation.en: When therefore I have performed this , and have sealed to them this fruit , I will come by you into Spain .
Then the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah the prophet , after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien kane , U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga

U la leit phai pait sha u Elisha lem bad baroh ki rangbah jong u bad u nong , Mynta per tip ba ym ne uno uno u blei hynrei tang U Blei ki Jerusalem ; Kumta sngewbha , ko kynduh , pdiang ïa ka jingjai sngewbha na nga .
translation.en: And he returned to the man of God , he and all his company , and came , and stood before him : and he said , Behold , now I know that there is no God in all the earth , but in Israel : now therefore , I pray thee , take a blessing of thy servant .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki kylli ïa ki bleithaw bad ïa ki nongïatrei kupar , ishyrkhei ki jubab kiba ki ïew ki long ki jinglamler bad ki bym don jingat . Katto katne ki pyrshang shun batai ïa ki jingphohsniew , hynrei tang ban Shuh ïalam kynroh ïa phi ; ka jingpyntngen ba ki ai ka long ka bymneh . Kumta ki briew ki salm Kylleng kum ka langbrot ba la jah . Ki don ha ka jingjied namar ba kdor don u nongïalam .
translation.en: For the idols have spoken vanity , and the diviners have seen a lie , and have told false dreams  ; they comfort in vain : therefore they went their way as a flock , they were troubled , because there was no shepherd .
For if a man think himself to be something , when he is nothing , he deceiveth himself .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u mut ba u long ei ei haba da shisha um long ei ei , u long tang u nongshukor ïa lade .

translation.en: Thou art my God , and I will praise thee : thou art my God , I will exalt thee .
translation.kha: Me long U Blei jong nga , bad nga ainguh ïa me ; ngan pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong me .
Ki im ka jingim ha ka jingsuk sad ki ïap suk khlem ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: They spend their days in wealth , and in a moment go down to the grave .

translation.kha: Phin sa kynruh ïa ki jingleh bymman jong phi bad ïa ki jingbakla ba phi la leh , pynlang phin sa isih ïa lat namar ki nongpop jong phi sad ki jingleh palat jong phi .
translation.en: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways , and your doings that were not good , and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations .

translation.kha: Me u ban sa pynkhyllem ïa ka Templ bad ban tei pat ïa ka ha ki lai sngi ! To pynim ïa lade lama me long U Khun U Blei ! To hiar napoh na ka diengphna !
translation.en: And saying , Thou that destroyest the temple , and buildest it in three days , save thyself . If thou be the Son of God , come down from the cross .
And ye also shall bear witness , because ye have been with me from the beginning .
translation.kha: Bad ma phi , ruh , phin kren shaphang jong nga , namar ba phi la don lem bad nga naduh kaba sdang .
Phi donkam ban sympat ïa u kulai , ph dei ban ter lem ïa u kada , bad phi de ban sympat ïa uba bieit .
translation.en: A whip for the horse , a bridle for the ass , and a rod for the fool s back .

translation.kha: To sohshkor ! nga la ïathuh ha phin ïa kane ha shuwa ba ka por kan poi .
translation.en: Behold , I have told you before .

translation.kha: Nga long khor , A blem . Pdiang ïa ka ktien jong to . Ym don moi mano u ban kyrshan ïa kaba nga Ong .
translation.en: Lay down now , put me in a surety with thee  ; who is he that will strike hands with me ?

translation.kha: Nga ieit ïa phi dom U Kpa u iktiar ïa nga ; to ïadih ha ka jingieit jong nga .
translation.en: As the Father hath loved me , so have I loved you : continue ye in my love .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim treh pun phah ïa u , ngin ym leit , namar uta u briew u la ong ha ngi ba ngin ym Lah sha ban ïakynduh ïa u lymda u para jong ngi u don pyntud lem bad ngi .
translation.en: But if thou wilt not send him , we will not go down : for the man said unto us , Ye shall not see my face , except your brother be with you .

translation.kha: U paidbah u la phad ktien , Ngi don ka lei Kaba ino ba u de ban ïarep , namar u la kam ba u long U Khun U Blei .
translation.en: The Jews answered him , We have a law , and by our law he ought to die , because he made himself the Son of God .

translation.kha: U la pynjot bun ki jaitbynriew bad u la pynïap ïa ki syiem kiba khraw :
translation.en: Who smote great nations , and slew mighty kings  ;

Moreover Amaziah gathered Judah together , and made them captains over thousands , and captains over hundreds , according to the houses of their fathers , throughout all Judah and Benjamin : and he numbered them from twenty years old and above , and found them three hundred thousand choice men , able to go forth to war , that could handle spear and shield .
translation.kha: U Syiem Amasaïah u pynbeit ïa baroh ki rangbah jong ki jait Judah bad Benjamin ha ki kynhun shipai , kat kum ki kur jong ki , bad u la buh ki rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka jingai hukum ïa ki kynhun kiba shihajar ngut bad ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut . Kane ka kynthup ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba arphew snem ne kham ïaw , baroh ki long lai lakh ngut . Ki long ki shipai ba la jied , kiba la kloi ban ïaleh thma , kiba tbit ban pyndonkam ïa ki sum bad ki stieh .

translation.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment  ; all his commandments are sure .
translation.kha: Ha baroh kaba u leh u long uba ïaineh bad uba hok ; ki hukum jong u baroh ki long kiba lah ban shaniah .

translation.en: Giving no offence in any thing , that the ministry be not blamed :
translation.kha: Ngim kwah ïano ïano ban wad daw ïa ka jingtrei jong ngi , kumta ngi pyrshang ban ym buh ïa ki jingjynthut ha ka lynti jongno jongno .
U Ussiel ruh u don sa ngut ki Kynhun shynrang : u Mishael , u Elsaphan , sad u Sithri .
translation.en: And the sons of Uzziel  ; Mishael , and Elzaphan , and Zithri .

translation.kha: U suit ïa ka da ka ksiar kaba nala , bad u buh u jingpynbor kseh baroh sawdong ka rmiang jong ka .
translation.en: And he overlaid it with pure gold , and made thereunto a crown of gold round about .
The city of confusion is broken down : every house is shut up , that no man may come in .
translation.kha: Ha ka nongbah , baroh kiei kiei ki long ha ka jingkulmar , bad ki briew ki la setkut ïa lade ha ki ïing jong ki ban shngain .
Bad U Troas u phah ïa u Jehoaddin , u Barak , u Jephthah , bad khatduh ïa nga . Uwei pa uwei na me , ngi la pyllaitluid im ïa pa’ na ki nongshun jong pa , bad phi la ïor shongsuk shongshngain .
translation.en: And the  Lord  sent Jerubbaal , and Bedan , and Jephthah , and Samuel , and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side , and ye dwelled safe .

translation.kha: Ka jingsam kaba ar ka un-long na ka bynta ki longïing na ka jait Simeon . Ka jaka jong ki ka ïar shaduh ka ri kaba la ai ha ka jait Judia .
translation.en: And the second lot came forth to Simeon , even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families : and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah .

translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u phet ei , da ka jingsynran lakam ka longrynïeng jong u bad ki rangbah nongsynshar Jong u baroh , lait noh ki shiphew ngut ki tnum kliar , ïa kiba u la iehnoh shaid ban sumar ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And the king went forth , and all his household after him . And the king left ten women , which were concubines , to keep the house .

translation.kha: san jrut na phi phin khup ïa ki shispah ngut , pynlang shyiap ngut na phiah phan jop ïa ki shiphew hajar nguid .
translation.en: And five of you shall chase an hundred , and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight : and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword .

translation.kha: Bad U Jingsuk u la ong ha la ki synran , Tharai uwei na phi un leit sha ka ïing u paralok jong pa ha ka por shiteng synñia bad ong ha u , ‘ Ko paralok , ai kylliang ïa nga lai tylli ki lyngkhot kpu .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Which of you shall have a friend , and shall go unto him at midnight , and say unto him , Friend , lend me three loaves  ;
And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues , that if he found any of this way , whether they were men or women , he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U la leit sha u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad u la pan ïa ki shithi pynithuh sha ki synagog kiba ha Damaskos , khnang ba lada un lap ïano ïano hangta kiba bud ïa ka Lynti jong U Trai , un lah ban kem ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei bad wallam pat ïa ki sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Did not your fathers thus , and did not our God bring all this evil upon us , and upon this city ? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka daw balei ba U Blei u la pynshitom ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi mynba u wanrah ka jingjot halor kane ka nongbah . Bad pynban , phi pan kwah ba U Blei un phah shuh shuh ka jingbitar halor ka Israel da kaba pyntngit ïa ka sngi Sabbaton .
U Joseph u ong , Kane ka mut kumne : kita ki tnat lai tylli ki un-long lai tylli ki sngi .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto him , This is the interpretation of it : The three branches are three days :
And they shall be my people , and I will be their God :
translation.kha: Te kin long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .
U Moses u la leh kamar U Trai u la hukum . Ki la ïaleit kiew ïa u Lum Hor haba ïohi Utai u paidlang baroh ,
translation.en: And Moses did as the  Lord  commanded : and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation .

translation.kha: shaphang ka jinglong Blei bakhuid jong u , la pyn-i shynna da ka bor bakhraw ban longsem U Khun jong U balui da kaba pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
translation.en: And declared to be the Son of God with power , according to the spirit of holiness , by the resurrection from the dead :

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un hukum ba dei ban pynmih lut Noah ïing ïa ki tyrha ki tar baroh shuwa ba un leit khmih ïa kata ka jingbthuh ; lym kumta , yn pynnep ba baroh kaba don ha kata ka ïing ka long ka bymkhuid . Nangta un sa leit rung shapoh ïing bad un khmih bha ïa kata ka jingbthuh .
translation.en: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house , before the priest go into it to see the plague , that all that is in the house be not made unclean : and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house :

translation.kha: Ale wan bad ïarap ïa nga ba tur ïaleh ïa ka Gibeon , namar ba ki briew jong ka ki la ïasuk bad u Joshua bad ki Israel .
translation.en: Come up unto me , and help me , that we may smite Gibeon : for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Ka lynñiar ban long uba stad ka long ban pyndonburom ïa U Trai ; u ai ka jingbishar kaba beit ïa baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u . U long uba dei ban ïaroh jngum .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of wisdom : a good understanding have all they that do his commandments : his praise endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u la mane ïa u Ïakjakor ñiar ba u la ai ïa la ka bor synshar ha uta u mradkhlaw . Ki la mane ruh ïa uta u ïalaw , bad ki la ong , Ïai uba kum u mradkhlaw ? Uei uba lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u ?
translation.en: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast : and they worshipped the beast , saying , Who is like unto the beast ? who is able to make war with him ?
And Jacob said unto his brethren , Gather stones  ; and they took stones , and made an heap : and they did eat there upon the heap .
translation.kha: U ong ha la ki briew ban lum katto katne ki mawbah bad ban kynton halor jong ki . Nangta ki ïashong bam hajan kata ka kynton maw .

Mynta , lada phi mutdur ban pyndep ïa ka jingïohthiah kaba phi don ïa u kynrad jong nga bad ban lehkmen ïa u , to Sngewbha ïathuh ïa de ; te lada kam long , to ong kumta , bad ngan sa rai aïu ngan har .
translation.en: And now if ye will deal kindly and truly with my master , tell me : and if not , tell me  ; that I may turn to the right hand , or to the left .

translation.kha: Phin sien thiah ïew ?
translation.en: What are you buying ?
Men do therefore fear him : he respecteth not any that are wise of heart .
translation.kha: Kam long kaba phylla , te , ba uwei pa uwei u ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa u , bad ba um ñiew ïa kito kiba kam ba ki long kiba stad .
U Joshua u la ïohsngew ïa ki paidbah ba ki ïarisa bad u la ong ha u Moses , Nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kumba ïaleh thma ha ka jaka sher dara .
translation.en: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted , he said unto Moses , There is a noise of war in the camp .

translation.kha: Mihngi bad mynmiet u ju shang ha ki khang tep bhabriew bad ki iaka lut , da naba lynñiar bad ot ïa lade da ki mraw .
translation.en: And always , night and day , he was in the mountains , and in the tombs , crying , and cutting himself with stones .
If not , hearken unto me : hold thy peace , and I shall teach thee wisdom .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kam long kumta , to long jar jar bad shahshkor ïa nga , bad ngan hikai ïa phi kumno ba phi long uba stad .
Ki briew kan aiti noh ïa la ki bymman ki para ban pynïap ïa ki , bad ki kpa kin sa kumjuh ïa la ki khun , ki khun ki sheng pynshah ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad kin ai ïa ki ban shait pynïap .
translation.en: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death , and the father the son  ; and children shall rise up against their parents , and shall cause them to be put to death .

translation.kha: Suh ïa ka pajut u Aaron da ka linen bani , bad ïa ka jaiñsop hajuh da ka linen bani ; dara ïa u panpoh ruh uba la suh pynpur ba-itynnat .
translation.en: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen , and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen , and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework .

translation.kha: Balei U Blei un ainong ïa phi lada phi ieit tong ïa ki briew kiba ieit ïa phira ? Waw ki nonglum khajna ki leh ïa kata !
translation.en: For if ye love them which love you , what reward have ye ? do not even the publicans the same ?

translation.kha: ka da pyrta jam ha ki khyrdop nongbah bad kat haba ki briew ki ïalumlang :
translation.en: She crieth in the chief place of concourse , in the openings of the gates : in the city she uttereth her words , saying ,
In thoughts from the visions of the night , when deep sleep falleth on men ,
translation.kha: Kum ka jingruma ka pynwit ïa ka jingïohthiah jong nga .
U angel u la ong , Kane ka kynthei ka ïeng na ka bynta ka jingbymman . Nangne u ñiup ïa ka sha tbian shahjop jong ka shang Bad u sting pat shapoh ïa ka jingtah .
translation.en: And he said , This is wickedness . And he cast it into the midst of the ephah  ; and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof .

translation.kha: Ha kata hajuh ka sngi u pynkieng ruh ïa ka bynta kaba sohpdung ka phyllaw , kata ka jaka kaba ha khmat ka Templ , bad u kñia hangta ïa ki jingainguh thang , ïa ki jingiw bam , bad ïa ka khleiñ jong ki mrad na ka bynta ka jingainguh jinglakloi . U ar ïa kane namar ba kata ka duwan rnong ka ryntieh than eh na ka bynta baroh kine ki jingainguh .
translation.en: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the  Lord  : for there he offered burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings : because the brasen altar that was before the  Lord  was too little to receive the burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings .

translation.kha: Ïa ka syiem la ring jakoid ; ki shakri jong ka ki ud kum ki lyngdkhur bad ki tied ïa la ka shadem ha ka jingsngew .
translation.en: And Huzzab shall be led away captive , she shall be brought up , and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves , tabering upon their breasts .

translation.kha: Naba u syep u la ai ki praw ban kem ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba la lah mudui ïa u Daniel , bad la bret ïa ki , slem bad ki tnga jyllang ki badno ki khun jong ki , shapoh ka thwet kaba dap da ki sing . Ha shuwa ïa-ban kin tad sha tbian jong ka thliew , ki song ki la kynrup ïa ki bad pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jongnga ki baroh .
translation.en: And the king commanded , and they brought those men which had accused Daniel , and they cast them into the den of lions , them , their children , and their wives  ; and the lions had the mastery of them , and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den .
( For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat . )
translation.kha: ( Ki synran jong u ki la lah leit sha shnong ban thied jingbam . )
U lyngdoh un ïalum ïa uta u briew lem bad ïa kita ki jingainguh jong u ha khmat ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ ka ingdong Ryngkat U Trai .
translation.en: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean , and those things , before the  Lord  , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation :
And I came to Jerusalem , and understood of the evil that Eliashib did for Tobiah , in preparing him a chamber in the courts of the house of God .
translation.kha: bad nga wan phai sha Jerusalem . Hangta nga la kyndit ban shem ba u Eliashib u shah ïa u Tobiah ban pyndonkam ïa ka kamra ha ka Templ .
Ki briew ki i ñiewkor ïa kiwei pat , ki lah pun pynkhih kulmar ïa ki nongbah baroh . Kito kiba tari ki pynni jat ïa kiei kiei .
translation.en: Scornful men bring a city into a snare : but wise men turn away wrath .

translation.kha: U ai ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah : Phi dei baneh pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ph ha ka jingtyngshaiñ burom ïa U Trai , da kaba kohnguh hok ïa u ha kiei ki ba phi leh .
translation.en: And he charged them , saying , Thus shall ye do in the fear of the  Lord  , faithfully , and with a perfect heart .

And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it , by the two corners thereof , upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it  ; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal .
translation.kha: Thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki harum kata ka jingpynpur ha ki ar tylli ki krung kiba marpyrshah , ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah da kiba yn bah ïa ka .

Kumta U Jisu u la otsher bad ki . Um khim da jngai na ka ïing mynba u rangbah pynïaidkam u la phah ïa ki paralok ban ong ha U , Kynrad , wat pynshitom ïa lade . nongïam dei hok ban pdiang ïa me ha ka ïing jong nga ,
translation.en: Then Jesus went with them . And when he was now not far from the house , the centurion sent friends to him , saying unto him , Lord , trouble not thyself : for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof :

translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban don ki briew kiba stad kiba sneng ïa phin ban ïa kaba don ki bariew kiba tasngeng Ibbah rwai ki jingïaroh ïa phi .
translation.en: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise , than for a man to hear the song of fools .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha ki nongïathuhlypa ka Jerusalem de la ïohi ba ki leh kaba kham sniew : ki klim dara ki krenbeiñ lamler ; ki pynshlur ïa ki briew ban leh ïa ka diengtied , kumta ba ym don ba sangeh noh ïa kaei katba sniew . Ha na , ki long baroh kiba sniew kamon ki brisoh ka Sodom , bad ka Gomorrah .
translation.en: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing : they commit adultery , and walk in lies : they strengthen also the hands of evildoers , that none doth return from his wickedness : they are all of them unto me as Sodom , and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah .

translation.kha: Lydia bahynñiew ngut ki mynhyndai yn pynïap ba-bang siew na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa u Kain , Hynñiewphew hynñiew ngut ki mynnin yn pynïap lada Un eit u pynïap ïa per .
translation.en: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold , truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold .

translation.kha: Kumta ki phah nonglamktien sha Shiloh bad ki wanrah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Tlai Badonbor Baroh , umbah shongkhet halor ki Khebar . Bad ki ar ngut ki khuid shynrang u Eli , u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki wan ryngkat hangtai badno ka synduk ka Jutang .
translation.en: So the people sent to Shiloh , that they might bring from thence the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  of hosts , which dwelleth between the cherubims : and the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , were there with the ark of the covenant of God .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi kiba ïuhroit ïa kiba kyrduh bad Ibbah pyrshang ban pynjot ïa kiba duk ha ka ri .
translation.en: Hear this , O ye that swallow up the needy , even to make the poor of the land to fail ,
And Hadoram , and Uzal , and Diklah ,
translation.kha: ka Hadoram , ka Usal , ka Diklah ,
Hadien ka jingong ïa kan , la shngiam noh ïa u sha bnoh katba ki dang khmih ïa u , malu u lyoh u la bakyrhuh ïa u na ka jingïohi jong ki .
translation.en: And when he had spoken these things , while they beheld , he was taken up  ; and a cloud received him out of their sight .

translation.kha: Wat ju klet kumno phi la pynhiarkput lep ïa U Trai ha ka ri shyiap . Naduh ka sngi ba phi mih na Ijipt haduh ba phi pa Hangne , phi la ïaleh byrsha ïa u .
translation.en: Remember , and forget not , how thou provokedst the  Lord  thy God to wrath in the wilderness : from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt , until ye came unto this place , ye have been rebellious against the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Elijah u la kohnguh ïa ka lawbah U Trai bad u la leit malu shong harud ka Wahduid Kherith .
translation.en: So he went and did according unto the word of the  Lord  : for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith , that is before Jordan .

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba U Trai un ai ha phi kamon ka bainong ïa kaei kaba u la buh na ka bynta ki briew jong u . Naba U Khrist u dei U Kynrad bashisha uba phi shakri .
translation.en: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance : for ye serve the Lord Christ .

translation.kha: A Trei , me la pynkhiah ïa nga . Ngin tem ki duitara bad rwai ka jingïaroh ïa me , ngin rwai ïarep ha ka Templ jong me katba ngi daiñ im .
translation.en: The  Lord  was ready to save me : therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Teh ïa ka ha khmat ka jaiñspong da u kshaid bymnang .
translation.en: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace , that it may be upon the mitre  ; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be .
But I fear , lest by any means , as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty , so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ .
translation.kha: Nga sheptieng ïoh ïa ki jingmut jong phi yn pynjngut noh bad ba phin iehnoh noh ïa ka jingaiti basngur pura jong phi ha U Khrist — kumba ïa ka Im la shukor da ki buit sianti uta u bseiñ .

translation.en: And shall say unto them , Hear , O Israel , ye approach this day unto battle against your enemies : let not your hearts faint , fear not , and do not tremble , neither be ye terrified because of them  ;

translation.en: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him , and comfort him , lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow .
And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre , unto the city of Arbah , which is Hebron , where Abraham and Isaac sojourned .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la leit sha u Isaak u kpa jong u ha Mamre , hajan Hebron , ha kaba u Abraham bad u Isaak ki la ju shong ju sah .

translation.en: Then he said , Go , borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours , even empty vessels  ; borrow not a few .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ki paramarjan jong phi bad pan kylliang bun tylli ki khra thylli kat kiba phi lah ban ïoh ,  u Elisha u la ong ha ka .

Nalor kata baroh , ka don ka khar kaba jylliew hapdeng jong moi , khnang ba kito ibha kwah ban jam sha shiliang nongthain shaw me Kam lah banbeiñ har kumta , lymne uno uno un lah ban jam sha shiliang shwa ngi na ka jaka kaba me don .’
translation.en: And beside all this , between us and you there is a great gulf fixed : so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot  ; neither can they pass to us , that would come from thence .

translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingkyrkieh U Trai kaba pynriewspah ïa phi . Ka jingtrei shit kan ym lah ba kham pynriewspah ïa phi .
translation.en: The blessing of the  Lord  , it maketh rich , and he addeth no sorrow with it .

translation.kha: U la pyrta ïan ïano ban wallam shapoh ïa ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrngia , sad ki nongbet kti . haba ki la ïatan shapoh , u syiem u la ong ha ki , Ïa uno uno uba lah ban pule ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingtem jong ka yn pynphong ha ki jaiñjot syiem kiba sawbthuh , un deng u kynjri ksiar ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jong u , bad un long uba lai ha ka bor hapoh ka hima .
translation.en: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers , the Chaldeans , and the soothsayers . And the king spake , and said to the wise men of Babylon , Whosoever shall read this writing , and shew me the interpretation thereof , shall be clothed with scarlet , and have a chain of gold about his neck , and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom .

translation.kha: Baroh kaba kum kita ki longïing tang ka syrngiew jongu kiei kaei ha ka khawai ; ka jingshisha ka long U Khrist .
translation.en: Which are a shadow of things to come ; but the body is of Christ .

translation.kha: Nga pynbna ha ka jingbitar bameh ding jong nga ba ha kata ka sngi kan don ka jingkhih bymdei kaba jur ha ka ri Israel .
translation.en: For in my jealousy and in the fire of my wrath have I spoken , Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel  ;

translation.kha: Ki la kylli ïa u , Aiu uta u briew uba la ong ïa me ban leh kumne ?
translation.en: Then asked they him , What man is that which said unto thee ,  Take up thy bed , and walk ?
Let those that fear thee turn unto me , and those that have known thy testimonies .
translation.kha: Ai ba kito kiba pyndonburom ïa me kin wan sha nga — kito baroh kiba tip ïa ki hukum jong me .
Bad baroh ki Israel yn pynim . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka noh , U Nongpynim un wan na Seïon bad un weng noh ïa baroh ka jingbymman na ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob .
translation.en: And so all Israel shall be saved : as it is written , There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer , and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob :

translation.kha: Namar dat ngi Lah ban sngew thikna ba baroh ar ngut u Jehobah bad u Jisu ki kwah ban ïarap ïa ngi ban ïohi ïa ka lawei kaba suk ba kilomitar .—Salm 72 :12-14 ; 43 :16 ; 2 Petros 3 :9 .
translation.en: So we can be sure that both Jehovah and Jesus want to help us to enjoy a happy future ! —Psalm 72 :12-14  ; 145 :16  ; 2 Peter 3 :9 .

translation.kha: Kumta u Gideon u phah noh ïa kita ki Israel baroh sha Ïing , laitluid noh ki laispah ngut , kiba la jrem ïa baroh ki jingbam bad ki turoi . Ka jaka sher dara jong ki Midian ka ei sharum jong ki ha ka them .
translation.en: So the people took victuals in their hand , and their trumpets : and he sent all the rest of Israel every man unto his tent , and retained those three hundred men : and the host of Midian was beneath him in the valley .

translation.kha: nongthaw nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaba i kumto ka ïit bakhraw kaba la khleh lang bad ka jing . Na la ïohi ruh ïa kito kiba la khup ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ka dur jong u malade ïa uta uba ka kyrteng jong u la mihkhmat da u dak jingkhynñiuh . Ki la ïeng hajan ka ïit bakhraw , ki da bang ïa ki duitara kiba U Blang u la ai ha ki
translation.en: And I saw as it were a sea of glass mingled with fire : and them that had gotten the victory over the beast , and over his image , and over his mark , and over the number of his name , stand on the sea of glass , having the harps of God .

translation.kha: Khie leit , U Jisu u la ong ha ki ; kumto ki la mihnoh bad ki la leit shapoh ki sniang . Ka kynhun ki sniang bhor kawei ka la mareh artat ïa ka riat jong ka synrang shapoh ka duriaw bad ka la ïap jrop .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Go .  And when they were come out , they went into the herd of swine : and , behold , the whole herd of swine ran violently down a steep place into the sea , and perished in the waters .
And the rest of the acts of Pekah , and all that he did , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Pekah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ki bad u la ong ha ki , Khie leit bad ai ba ki lyngdoh kin da Khmih bniah ïa phi . Ha lynti la pynkhuid ïa ki .
translation.en: And when he saw them , he said unto them ,  Go shew yourselves unto the priests .  And it came to pass , that , as they went , they were cleansed .

And they sung as it were a new song before the throne , and before the four beasts , and the elders : and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand , which were redeemed from the earth .
translation.kha: Ki shi lakh sawphew saw hajar ngut ki briew ki la ïeng ha khmat ka khet , ha khmat ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im , bad ha khmat ki nongsharai balang ; ki la ïarwai ïa ka jingrwai kaba thymmai , kaba tang ma ki hi ki lah ban nang . Na ki bynriew baroh , ki long tang ma ki , kiba la siewspah .

translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that came to do the service of the ministry , and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation ,
translation.kha: U Moses u la kohnguh bad u la shim

translation.en: And the king commanded all the people , saying , Keep the passover unto the  Lord  your God , as it is written in the book of this covenant .
translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u hukum ïa ki briew ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait kum ka jinglehburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab ka Jutang .

Kum ka nuksa , hir ar jngut ki briew ki leit thop dieng lang shiah khlaw bad , katba uwei na ki u dang khet ïa uwei u dieng , u sdie u lait na u sping bad u leit dei ha uta uwei pat , bad kumta u ïap , u lah ban kjat sha kawei na Kita ki na tylli ki shnong , bad un leit riej bad ïohlait im hangta .
translation.en: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood , and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree , and the head slippeth from the helve , and lighteth upon his neighbour , that he die  ; he shall flee unto one of those cities , and live :

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u da ki turoi . To ïaroh ïa u da ki duitara bad ki jingimat ksai .
translation.en: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet : praise him with the psaltery and harp .
Grace unto you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: ka jingaiei kan don ha phi , bad jingsuk , na U Blei jong ngi U Kpa bad U Trai Jisu Khrist .

translation.en: Knowest thou it , because thou wast then born ? or because the number of thy days is great ?
translation.kha: Nga thikna ba me lah , namar me la tymmen bha bad me la don hangta mynba la thaw ïa ka pyrthei !

translation.en: Arise , and let us go by night , and let us destroy her palaces .
translation.kha: Ngin tur ïaleh mynmiet ; ngin pynjot ïa ki kut jong ka nongbah .
Ha shuwa ïa-ban poi ki snieh ka nemsniew , u Joseph u la ïoh ar ngut ki khun shynrang na ka Asenath .
translation.en: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came , which Asenath the daughter of Poti–phera priest of On bare unto him .

translation.kha: Ki briew jongngi u syiem ki pynïaid ïa ka jingshalan shabar ïa ki kulai na Musri bun Kilikia , bad ïa ka jingshalan shabar ïa ki kali ïapom na Ijipt .
translation.en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt , and linen yarn : the king s merchants received the linen yarn at a price .
For Christ also hath once suffered for sins , the just for the unjust , that he might bring us to God , being put to death in the flesh , but quickened by the Spirit :
translation.kha: Naba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta ki pop tang shisien bad na ka bynta ki por baroh , u briew uba bha na ka bynta ki nongpop , ba un ïoh ïalam ïa phi sha U Blei . La pynïap ïa u ha ka doh , hynrei la pynim pat ïa u ha ka mynsiem ,

Baroh ka long kaba khuid ha kito kaba long kiba khuid ha lap ; hynrei ym don kaba khuid ha kito kiba la tyngeh bad ki bymngeit , namar ba ki jingmut bad ki jingïatiplem Jong ki , ki long ba la pyntngit .
translation.en: Unto the pure all things are pure : but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure ; but even their mind and conscience is defiled .

translation.kha: Suit ïa kaba shalor jong ka , ïa ki kruiñ jong ka baroh sawdong , bad ïa ki reng jong ka , da ka ksiar nylla , bad shna ruh ïa ka jingpynhiar ksiar baroh sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , the top thereof , and the sides thereof round about , and the horns thereof  ; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about .

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim syiem kylli , ‘ Hangno U Trai’ u don ?’ Ki lyngdoh jong nga hi ktien tiduh ïa nga . Ki nongsynshar ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ; ki nongïathuhlypa ki la krenbeiñ ha ka kthang jong u Baal bad ki la ïamane ïa ki bleithaw bymngeit .
translation.en: The priests said not , Where is the  Lord  ? and they that handle the law knew me not : the pastors also transgressed against me , and the prophets prophesied by Baal , and walked after things that do not profit .
And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house , which stood and said unto him , Send men to Joppa , and call for Simon , whose surname is Peter  ;
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ïa ngi kumno ba u la ïohi ïa u angel uba ïeng ha ka ïing jong u , bad uba la ong ha u , ‘ Phah ïano ïano sha Joppa bad leit shem ïa u briew uba ka kyrteng pura ka long u Simon Petros .

bad ngan aiti ha kito kiba kwah ba-bang pynïap ïa ki , ha u nongkyrshan , u syiem ka Babilonia bad ka kynhun shipai jong u . Hynrei shen hadien , ki briew ktien shong kin sah biang ha Ijipt , kumba ki la lai ha ki por ba la leit . Ma at , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives , and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of his servants : and afterward it shall be inhabited , as in the days of old , saith the  Lord .
Then let him count the years of the sale thereof , and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it  ; that he may return unto his possession .
translation.kha: Lada kumta , u dei ban siew sha uta u briew uba la thied ïa ka ha ka dor ka ban ïahap bad ki snem kiba dang sah haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat kaba bud , hadien kata un ïoh pat ïa la ka khyndew .
Namar ba ka dohnud jong phi tud ïai don ha ka jaka kaba don ka spaiñ jong phi .
translation.en: For where your treasure is , there will your heart be also .
The  Lord  reigneth  ; let the people tremble : he sitteth between the cherubims  ; let the earth be moved .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem , bad ki briew kin khynñiuh . U shong ha ka khet halor ki kherub , bad ka pyrthei kan khynñiuh .
Nangta un shim ïa ka khleiñ jong u baroh Bad thang halor ka duwan .
translation.en: And he shall take all his fat from him , and burn it upon the altar .

translation.kha: Ïa ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jrong uta u shñiuh Leit thang hapoh ka nongbah , ynda la dep ka jingkyrkhu . Shim ïa ka bynta kaba ar bad shaiñ ïa ka da ka waitlam jong me haba me ïadie baroh’ sawdong ka nongbah . Ïa ka bynta katba dang sah trai pynhiar ha ka lyer , nabar ngan sa pynbud da ka waitlam jong nga nadien jong ki .
translation.en: Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city , when the days of the siege are fulfilled : and thou shalt take a third part , and smite about it with a knife : and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind  ; and I will draw out a sword after them .

translation.kha: Myntan te , ko Syiem Kynrad , U Trai u ïai-ong ba phin sa tip u long uei da kaei kaba un sa sa . Ha khmih , ngan tied ïa ka sla um da une u diengduh , bad ka um kan kylla snur .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , In this thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  : behold , I will smite with the rod that is in mine hand upon the waters which are in the river , and they shall be turned to blood .

translation.kha: Ngin la shahshkor riam kum ka sem ha ki nongshun ki bym don daw ban kito ïa nga .
translation.en: Mine enemies chased me sore , like a bird , without cause .

translation.kha: Ka trei smat ïa lade ban thir saiwul bad thain jaiñ linen .
translation.en: She seeketh wool , and flax , and worketh willingly with her hands .

Then spake Joshua to the  Lord  in the day when the  Lord  delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel , and he said in the sight of Israel , Sun , stand thou still upon Gibeon  ; and thou , Moon , in the valley of Aijalon .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba U  Trai  u ai jingjop ïa ki Israel halor ki Amor , u Joshua u kren ha U  Trai . Ha khmat ki Israel u ong ,  Ko Sngi , to ïeng thik halor ka Gibeon , Ko Bnai , to sangeh ha ka Them Aijalon .

translation.en: Philip answered him , Two hundred pennyworth of bread is not sufficient for them , that every one of them may take a little .
translation.kha: U Philip u la jubab ,  Lada uwei uwei un ïoh tang mar khyndiat , kan donkam palat ïa ka arspah tylli ki sbai rupa ban thied kpu kat ban biang .

translation.en: And here men that die receive tithes  ; but there he receiveth them , of whom it is witnessed that he liveth .
translation.kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ki lyngdoh ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew la lum da ki briew kiba dei ban ïap ; hynrei ïa u Melkhisedek ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew la lum da uta uba im , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong .
Ngam don hok ban kob tang namar ba at ïalap ïa ka Gospel . La katta ruh , nga don thah ki hukum ban leh kumta . Bad kat kane longkmie naba shyrkhei ïa nga Ladan ïam shym la ïalap ïa ka gospel!
translation.en: For though I preach the gospel , I have nothing to glory of : for necessity is laid upon me ; yea , woe is unto me , if I preach not the gospel!

translation.kha: Ki jingbun jingwoh ïa baroh ki longïing jongngi ka jait Issakhar ki don phraphew hynñiew hajar ngut ki jingbabe kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .
translation.en: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might , reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand .

translation.kha: U Doeg u dang ïeng hangta bad ki rangbah pynkdor jong u Saul , bad u ong , Nga la ïohi ïa u Dabid mynba u leit sha u Ahimelekh u khun jong u Ahitub ha Nob .
translation.en: Then answered Doeg the Edomite , which was set over the servants of Saul , and said , I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob , to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub .

translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u pynnep ïa ki syiem bad u suiñ ïa ki ha ki san tylli ki dien , ha kaweh ki met jong ki , ki la sah hajuh janmiet .
translation.en: And afterward Joshua smote them , and slew them , and hanged them on five trees : and they were hanging upon the trees until the evening .

translation.kha: Namarba u Ahas u syiem Judah u la pynkyllaiñ ïa ki khih ki brai jyllang u bad u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai , U Tharai u la wallam ki jingjynjar ha ka Judah .
translation.en: For the  Lord  brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel  ; for he made Judah naked , and transgressed sore against the  Lord .

translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u kham riewspah bad kham stad ban ïa uno uno u syiem ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom .

translation.kha: Bad mynta um erlangthari hajuh tang kum u mraw , hynmen kham palat ba-bang ïa u mraw : u erlangthari u para ba-ieit ha U khriat . Katno u long uba kordor ïa nga ! Bad katno khraw un long uba kordor ïa me , kum u mraw sad kum u para ha u Trai !
translation.en: Not now as a servant , but above a servant , a brother beloved , specially to me , but how much more unto thee , both in the flesh , and in the Lord ?

translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynkylla ïa ka rukom kaba phi im bad ïa kiei keiñ baroh kiba phi leh , bad pa’ dadien ban kohnguh ïa U Trai U Blei jongnga phi . Lada phi leh kumta , un kylla ïa la ka jingmut na ka jingpynjot kaba u la ong ba un wallam halor jong phi .
translation.en: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings , and obey the voice of the  Lord  your God  ; and the  Lord  will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you .

translation.kha: U knieh ïa ki nongbah ba la kerkut jong ka Judah bad u tur shaphrang shaduh Jeroboam .
translation.en: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Judah , and came to Jerusalem .
Therefore the he goat waxed very great : and when he was strong , the great horn was broken  ; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven .
translation.kha: U  langsohmoh u la nang sngewmeng , hynrei ha ka jingdap rynïeng ka bor jong u , ka reng jong u ka la kheiñ . Ha ka jaka jong ka la wan mih saw tylli ki reng , kawei kawei ka phai sha ki liang baïapher .

translation.en: Be ye not as your fathers , unto whom the former prophets have cried , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Turn ye now from your evil ways , and from your evil doings : but they did not hear , nor hearken unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat long kum ki kpa tymmen jong phi . La slem bah ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor jong nga , da kaba ïathuh ha ki ban ym im bymman , ban ym im shuh ka jingim bapop . Hynrei kim shym la shahshkor ïa nga lane kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: Moreover this they have done unto me : they have defiled my sanctuary in the same day , and have profaned my sabbaths .
translation.kha: Bad kata kam dei kaba ki la leh baroh . Ki pyntngit ïa ka Templ jong nga bad ki pynkheiñ ïa ka Sabbaton , kaba nga la pynskhem .
U blem u ai ïa ka pyrthei ha ki bymdon . U pynlong ïa baroh ki nongbishar kiba matlah . Bad lada ym dei U Blei uba leh ïa dat , uei uba leh ?
translation.en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked : he covereth the faces of the judges thereof  ; if not , where , and who is he ?

translation.kha: ka Helkath , bad ka Rehob , lem bad ki pynbynta phlang Jong ki .
translation.en: Helkath with her suburbs , and Rehob with her suburbs  ; four cities .
Because they rebelled against the words of God , and contemned the counsel of the most High :
translation.kha: namar ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki hukum jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh bad ki la kyntait ïa ki jingbthah jong u .

Ki briew ki kylli , Balei ngin shahjingit , lada U Trai um patiaw ? Balei ngi dat ban leit khlem bam lada um shahshkor ? U Trai u ong ïa ki , Ka jingshisha ka long ba ha kajuh ka por ba phi shahjingit , phi ïaphah ïa la ki jong ki jingïohkynti bad banleh ïa la ki nongtrei .
translation.en: Wherefore have we fasted , say they , and thou seest not ? wherefore have we afflicted our soul , and thou takest no knowledge ? Behold , in the day of your fast ye find pleasure , and exact all your labours .
Fear not , thou worm Jacob , and ye men of Israel  ; I will help thee , saith the  Lord  , and thy redeemer , the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Uba rit bad uba tlot kumba me long , ko Israel , wat sheptieng ; ngan ïarap ïa me . Nga , U Blei uba khuid ki Israel , nga long uta uba pynim ïa me .
Dei ïa-ban pynthymmai naduh shadong ïa ki buhnud bad ïa ki jingmut jong phi ,
translation.en: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind ;
But if it be of God , ye cannot overthrow it  ; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God .
translation.kha: hynrei lada ka wan na U Blei , phim lah ban jop ïa ki . Phi lah ban shem ïa lade kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei !  Ka Dorbar ka la kohnguh ïa ka jingai jingmut jong u Gamaliel .

translation.en: Jesus heard that they had cast him out  ; and when he had found him , he said unto him ,  Dost thou believe on the Son of God ?
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la shem ïa uta u briew bad u la kylli ïa u ,  Hato me ngeit ha U Khun U Briew ?
Kan long Rumah ka la erlangthari ha ka nga jong u Lum . Uwei uwei baroh u ïai ïajubab bad ïadih , da kaba ïathied bad ïadie , da kaba thung bad tei .
translation.en: Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot  ; they did eat , they drank , they bought , they sold , they planted , they builded  ;

translation.kha: Te to rah ïa ki ktem ba la thait jong phi , bun pynkhlaiñ ïa ki khohsiew kiba la kyiuh jong phi !
translation.en: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down , and the feeble knees  ;
Then we turned , and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea , as the  Lord  spake unto me : and we compassed mount Seir many days .
translation.kha: ngi leit phai sha ka ri shyiap shaphang ka Duriaw Basaw , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , bad ngi la pynlut por slem ha kaba ïaid sakma ha ri lum Edom .

U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong : Lada me kohnguh ïa ki Aiñ jong nga bad leh ïa ki kamram kiba ang la shaniah ha me , te men ïailong uba khmih ïa ka Templ jong nga bad ïa ki phyllaw jong ka , bad sam shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong me , ruma nga shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki angel kiba don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jongki nga .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; If thou wilt walk in my ways , and if thou wilt keep my charge , then thou shalt also judge my house , and shalt also keep my courts , and I will give thee places to walk among these that stand by .

translation.kha: Uno uno naba ïai leh ïa ka pop , u longïing jong u telephone , namar u Soitan u la leh pop narud kaba mynnyngkong eh . U Khun U blei u la paw na ka pyntwa kane hi ka dak , ngab pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba la leh da u Soitan .
translation.en: He that committeth sin is of the devil  ; for the devil sinneth from the beginning . For this purpose the Son of God was manifested , that he might destroy the works of the devil .
The merciful man doeth good to his own soul : but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh .
translation.kha: Phi myntoi ïa lade haba phi bha sbun . Haba phi leh ki kam runar , phi pynmynsaw hi ïa lade .

translation.en: The  Lord  possessed me in the beginning of his way , before his works of old .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la thaw nyngkong eh ïa nga , kaba nyngkong eh na ki kam jong u , la slem bah .

translation.en: He that hath the Son hath life  ; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba don U Khun , u don ïa kane ka jingim ; uno uno u bym don U Khun U Blei , um don ka jingim .
Ngan khmih halor jong ki nabar kun ïalam bneng ïa ki sha kane ka ri . Ngan tei bha ïa ki bad ngan ym thab lyngngeit ïa ki ; ngan thung ïa ki bad ngan ym thor ïa ki .
translation.en: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good , and I will bring them again to this land : and I will build them , and not pull them down  ; and I will plant them , and not pluck them up .

translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ban ïalam ïa pha , ym don uno un napdeng ki briew jongnga pha ban btin ïa pha da ka kti .
translation.en: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth  ; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up .

translation.kha: Uta u dpei un sa her khim u pui pui uba ni ha ka ri Ijipt baroh , bad kat haba u khap un pynmih ki tohjaw kiba kylla prum ha u brisoh bad ha u mrad .
translation.en: And it shall become small dust in all the land of Egypt , and shall be a boil breaking forth with blains upon man , and upon beast , throughout all the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U Ono u Ong , Ka biang hi ! Nga sngew kum ban sa ïap nala ; kita ki hok jong nga kin mynnin aiñ pang ïa nga ?
translation.en: And Esau said , Behold , I am at the point to die : and what profit shall this birthright do to me ?
And of thy sons that shall issue from thee , which thou shalt beget , shall they take away  ; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: Khyndiat na ki khun ki ksiew jong me hi yn sa ïalam noh bad ban pynlong ki ïunukh ban shakri ha ka ïingsyiem jong u syiem ka Babilonia .
Nangta , hadien ba u Job u la duwai na ka bynta ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u , U Trai u la pynbyrsieh beiñ ïa u bad u la ai ha u ar shah ban ïa kabu u la don mynshuwa .
translation.en: And the  Lord  turned the captivity of Job , when he prayed for his friends : also the  Lord  gave Job twice as much as he had before .

translation.kha: Mynba nga dang trei hapdeng jong phi , la thor ïa ar da kiwei pat ki balang . Kum ban shu ong noh , nga la lwa na ki khnang ban ïabeh ïa phi .
translation.en: I robbed other churches , taking wages of them , to do you service .

translation.kha: Haba u la poi hajan ka Jerusalem , ha ka jaka ha kabu ka lyngkot kaba hiar sha u lum ki Olib , ki paid synrum jong u kiba bun bah ki la sdang ban ainguh ïa U Blei bad ïaroh ïa u ha ki thar bajam na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba khraw baroh ibha ki la lah ïohi :
translation.en: And when he was come nigh , even now at the descent of the mount of Olives , the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen  ;
Then spake Solomon , The  Lord  said that he would dwell in the thick darkness .
translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u duwai :  Me , A  Trai  , me la buh ïa ka sngi ha ka sahit bneng , pynban me la jied ban shong ha ki lyoh bad ka jingdum .
Phi kynmaw kumno ngi la im ha Ijipt bad kamon ka la jia badno ngi haba ngi ïaid lynti na ka ri jongno kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: ( For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt  ; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by  ;

translation.kha: ( Ka kynhun lieng jong u Hiram , kaban la wan suit ksah na Ophir , ka la wan kit ruh nangta shibun ki dieng Kseh-Juniper malade ki mawlynnai .
translation.en: And the navy also of Hiram , that brought gold from Ophir , brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees , and precious stones .

translation.kha: U Jephthah u ïalam ïa ki Jeruel bynriew snem . shadien Kata u la ïap bun la tep ïa u ha shnong jong u kaba ha Gaddah .
translation.en: And Jephthah judged Israel six years . Then died Jephthah the Gileadite , and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead .

translation.kha: Ko Shimiet Kynrad , ha ka jingïohipaw jong phi , phi la ïohi ba la ïeng ha khmat jong phi ka durbriew bakhraw , kaba phyrnai bad thaba , Bad kaba ishyrkhei Ban khmih .
translation.en: Thou , O king , sawest , and behold a great image . This great image , whose brightness was excellent , stood before thee  ; and the form thereof was terrible .

translation.kha: Sha shiliang ka khyrdop bashatei la don ka khyrdop kaba ïalaw sha ka pyllew bashapoh , kjit kam la don ha ka liang mihnoh . Ulla u briew u la thew ïa ka jingjngai hapdeng kine ki ar tylli ki khyrdop , bad ka long sanphew mitar .
translation.en: And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north , and toward the east  ; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits .

translation.kha: myntan khreh kloi ban ithuh sha i pa , malade ong ha i ba u Joseph u khun jongu i u Ong kumno , ‘ U Blei u la pynphong ïa nga u nongsynshar ïa ka ri Ijipt baroh ; wan noh sha de , bun wat pynslem .
translation.en: Haste ye , and go up to my father , and say unto him , Thus saith thy son Joseph , God hath made me lord of all Egypt : come down unto me , tarry not :
Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead , nor print any marks upon you : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: lane pruid dak ha la ka met lane pynmong ïa la ka doh ban ïambriew ïa kiba ïap . Nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: ( Proverbs 1 :8 ) Jehovah requires a wife to care for her family lovingly .
Which is come unto you , as it is in all the world ; and bringeth forth fruit , as it doth also in you , since the day ye heard of it , and knew the grace of God in truth :

Bad kumin nga la ïalam ne ïa ki na Ijipt sha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: Wherefore I caused them to go forth out of the land of Egypt , and brought them into the wilderness .

translation.kha: Hadien kine ki jingïohi , ha kiba u syiem Hakhlieh u la ïaineh ha ka jingshakri ïa U Trai , u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria , u Tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah . U kerkut ïa ki nongbah ba la tei kynroh bad u ai ki hukum ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ban pynpra ïa ka lynti lyngba ki kynroh .
translation.en: After these things , and the establishment thereof , Sennacherib king of Assyria came , and entered into Judah , and encamped against the fenced cities , and thought to win them for himself .

translation.kha: Ngan iehnoh ïa ki brai kiba lait im bad aiti ïa ki ha ki nongshun jyllang ki , ki ban jop ïa ki bad lwa ïa ka ri jong ki .
translation.en: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance , and deliver them into the hand of their enemies  ; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies  ;

Even he shall build the temple of the  Lord   ; and he shall bear the glory , and shall sit and rule upon his throne  ; and he shall be a priest upon his throne : and the counsel of peace shall be between them both .
translation.kha: U long ma u , u ban tei ïa ka bad ïohpdiang ïa ka burom kaba dei ïa u syiem bad un synshar ïa ki briew jong u . U lyngdoh un ïeng hajan ka khet jong u , bad kin ïatreilang ha ka jingsuk bad ha ka jingïasngewtynnat .’
U buh ha khmat eh ïa ki tnga kliar pynlang ki khun jong ki , nangta sa ka Leah bad ki khun jong ka , bad khatsaw ïa ka Rakhel bad u Joseph hadien duh .
translation.en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost , and Leah and her children after , and Rachel and Joseph hindermost .
Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world .
translation.kha: Kumta ong U Trai , uba la pyntip ïa kane slem bah mynshuwa .’

Ki Lebi ki syang ïa ki jingkñia ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha ka ding , kat kum ki jingbuhbeit rit , bad ki sirka ïa ki jingainguh bthing ha ki khiew , ki khiew heh , ki khiew rit , bad kloi na ki sam ïa ka doh ha ki briew .
translation.en: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance : but the other holy offerings sod they in pots , and in caldrons , and in pans , and divided them speedily among all the people .
The burden of Nineveh . The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor shaphang ka Ninebeh , ka jingïathuh shaphang ka jingïohipaw kaba la ïohi da u Nahum , uba dei na Elkosh .
Un pynngat ruh ïa ki ïingjaiñ syiem kaba heh pynpdang ki duriaw bad ki lumbah ha kaweh ka Templ ka ïeng . hynrei un ïap , khlem don mano mano hangtai ban ïarap ïa u .
translation.en: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain  ; yet he shall come to his end , and none shall help him .
The  Lord  liveth  ; and blessed be my rock  ; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u im ! To ïaroh ïa u nongïada jong nga ! To pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong U Blei uba khlaiñ uba pynim ïa nga !

Ka kynhun ki riewngeit ka la long ha kawei ka jingmut bad kawei ka mynsiem . Ym don uba ong ba kano kano ka jingdon jong u ba ka longïng ka jongu u hi , hynrei baroh ki la ïasam iwei ïa iwei pat ïa kaei kaei kaba ki la don .
translation.en: And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul : neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own  ; but they had all things common .

translation.kha: La synshar ïa ngi da ka jingieit U kyrshut , mynsiem ba ngi tip ba uwei u briew u la ïap na ka bynta jong Uei pa uwei , Kaba smat ba baroh ki ïoh bynta lang ha ka jingïap jong u .
translation.en: For the love of Christ constraineth us ; because we thus judge , that if one died for all , then were all dead :

translation.kha: U Joseph u bteng , Mynta , phi barieh , bad phi ruh , bymïaineh , phi ïohi ba por dei Shishak u Jehoshaphat uba kren ha phi .
translation.en: And , behold , your eyes see , and the eyes of my brother Benjamin , that it is my mouth that speaketh unto you .

translation.kha: ( Loukas 21 :4 ) Te mano mano jin ki haw ban “buh noh ha lade” batbor ban ai “katba u thlim ha la ka angnud .” —1 Korinth 16 :2 ; 2 Korinth 9 :7 .
translation.en: ( Luke 21 :1-4 ) Thus anyone can regularly “set something aside” to give “just as he has resolved in his heart .” —1 Corinthians 16 :2  ; 2 Corinthians 9 :7 .

translation.kha: Pynban haba to la kren haw katta ruh , phim Shim shaniah ha U Trai ,
translation.en: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the  Lord  your God ,

translation.kha: Bad ngan leh ïa Kanaan kano kaba phi pan ha ka kyrteng jong per , khnang ba ïa ka burom U Kpa yn ieh pynpaw lyngba U Khun .
translation.en: And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name , that will I do , that the Father may be glorified in the Son .

translation.kha: Me pynlong ïa ki umpohliew ban tiduh sha ki them , bun ïa ki heh ba kin tuid hapdeng ki lum .
translation.en: He sendeth the springs into the valleys , which run among the hills .
And the  Lord  said , Judah shall go up : behold , I have delivered the land into his hand .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Ka jait Judah kan leit nyngkong . Nga ai ha ki ban bat synshar ïa ka ri .

translation.en: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria  ; and Hoshea became his servant , and gave him presents .
translation.kha: U Shalmaneser u patsha ka Assyria u ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u ; u Hoshea u pyndem wait ha u Shalmaneser bad u siew jingnguh syiem man la ka snem .

NGA lah ban kren ha ki ktien jongngi ki briew bad wat ha ka jong ki angel ruh , Hynrei lada ngam ne ka jingieit , ka jingkren jong nga ka long kum ka wiang rnong ba sawa ne kumno ka sharak bariew shaw shad .
translation.en: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels , and have not charity , I am become as sounding brass , or a tinkling cymbal .

translation.kha: Buh ïa kane ka duwan shabar ka pyrda kaba la wah ha khmat jong ka Synduk Ka Jutang . Kata ka dei ka jaka ha kaba ngan ïashem bad me .
translation.en: And thou shalt put it before the veil that is by the ark of the testimony , before the mercy seat that is over the testimony , where I will meet with thee .

translation.kha: U kyndiang jong ka ïing un khie pynlang un khang ïa ka jingkthang ; nongkit haba phi ïeng shabar bad sdang ban tied ha ka jingryngkhiang bad ong , ‘ To plie ïa ka jingkhang na ka bynta jong ngi , ko kyndiang !’ Un jubab ïa pa , ‘ Ngam ithuh ïa phi ïano phi ïalang !’
translation.en: When once the master of the house is risen up , and hath shut to the door , and ye begin to stand without , and to knock at the door , saying , Lord , Lord , open unto us  ; and he shall answer and say unto you , I know you not whence ye are :

translation.kha: Ki brisoh kiba pyrshang ban pynbor ïa phin ban otsher ki dei kito kiba kwah ban pynpaw bad kob ïa ki kam kiba paw shabar . Ki bor ïa ka , la kumno kumno , tang don lait na ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ na ka boitha ka diengphna U Khrist .
translation.en: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh , they constrain you to be circumcised ; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ .

translation.kha: Te ïathuh ïa im me dei uei , ki la ong . Ngin hap ban rah ïa ka jubab shai kito kiba la phah ïa ngi . Kumno me ong shaphang ïa lade ?
translation.en: Then said they unto him , Who art thou ? that we may give an answer to them that sent us . What sayest thou of thyself ?

translation.kha: Ha khie ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet , ar la ïohi ïa kaei kaba i kum u briew . U la wan shiah nga , ba la por sawdong da u lyoh , bad u la leit sha uta umbah la im jymphong bad la ai sngewbha ha u .
translation.en: I saw in the night visions , and , behold , one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven , and came to the Ancient of days , and they brought him near before him .

translation.kha: Kumta U thri u la kila noh ïa la ka jingmut bad um shngiam wallam ha ki briew jongnga u ïa ka jingpynjot kaba u la byrngem .
translation.en: And the  Lord  repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people .

translation.kha: Henadad ba u la pyrkhat bha , u shna ar tylli ki khun mar kiba da ka ksiar bad u Ong ha ki briew jong u , Phi la hap ïaleit mane jngai paila shaduh Jerusalem . Ko ki pyntud Israel , khmih kine ki blei kiba la wanlam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt !
translation.en: Whereupon the king took counsel , and made two calves of gold , and said unto them , It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem : behold thy gods , O Israel , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u ong , Ngan pynlong ïa ka Samaria ka kynton ñiut ha rudnong , ka jaka ban thung ïa ki ding sohwaiñ . Ngan heh noh ïa ka jakhlia jongu ka nongbah Sha ka jaka them , bad ngan pynpaw shabar tang ïa ki maw nongrim lad ka nongbah .
translation.en: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field , and as plantings of a vineyard : and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley , and I will discover the foundations thereof .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan weng noh ïa ki kylleng jong ki bleithaw na ka ri , bad ym anna mano mano ban kynmaw shuh ïa ki . Ngan weng noh ïa uno uno uba kam ba u long u nongpynkhiah bad ngan shim noh ïa ka jingkwah ban mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land , and they shall no more be remembered : and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land .

translation.kha: Nangno u shim ïa uwei u kpa na ka shang ba la buh ïa ki kpu bakhlem thiat ba la pynkyntang sha U Trai’ , uwei u kpu ba la khleh umphniang , uwei u kput uba stang , bad u nguh ïa ki hajar kata ka khleiñ bad ka kjat-dien kamon .
translation.en: And out of the basket of unleavened bread , that was before the  Lord  , he took one unleavened cake , and a cake of oiled bread , and one wafer , and put them on the fat , and upon the right shoulder :

translation.kha: ‘ Ha khmih’ u la bteng , ‘ Baroh ki langsohmoh kiba ïa-pakor ki long kiba thohshuid , kiba thohbria , bad kiba thohbroin . Nga pynlong ïa kane ban jia namar nga la ïohi ïa barieh kaba u Laban u la leh ïa me .
translation.en: And he said , Lift up now thine eyes , and see , all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked , speckled , and grisled : for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee .
And he called unto him two centurions , saying , Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea , and horsemen threescore and ten , and spearmen two hundred , at the third hour of the night  ;
translation.kha: Te u rangbah ai hukum u la khot ar ngut na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u bad u la ong ,  Pynkhreh arspah ngut ki shipai ban leit sha Kaisaria , lem bad hynñiewphew ngut ki shipai shong kulai bad arspah ngut ki nongbat sum , bad pynkhreh ban mih ha ka por khyndai baje mynta ka miet .

translation.en: And he said , God forbid that I should do so : but the man in whose hand the cup is found , he shall be my servant  ; and as for you , get you up in peace unto your father .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ,  O , em ! da lei lei ngan ym leh kumta ! Tang uta keiñ ha uba la shem ïa ka khuri un long u mraw jong nga . Kiwei pat na phi ki lah ban leit phai suk sha la u kpa .
Ym don bapaw beit , lano kata ka sngew lane ka kynti kin wan — lymne wat ki angel ha bneng , lymne U Khun ; tang U Kpa u tip .
translation.en: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man , no , not the angels which are in heaven , neither the Son , but the Father .
And when he was twelve years old , they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast .

kaba u la rah sha ka ri jingkhangïit bad u la pahuh ha ka nongbah ki nongkhaïi .
translation.en: He cropped off the top of his young twigs , and carried it into a land of traffick  ; he set it in a city of merchants .
And Judas Iscariot , which also betrayed him : and they went into an house .

translation.en: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth , neither any green thing , neither any tree  ; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ïa ki ba kin ym pynmynsaw ïa u phlang lane ïa ki dieng lane ïa kiwei pat ki jingthung ; ki lah ban pynmynsaw tang ïa ki briew ki bym don ka shab jong U Blei ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .

ianga la dap shiteng sngi u alhia u la sdang ba-bang krong biria ïa ki : Duwai kham jam ! U dei u blei ! Lehse u dang pynsngewsih lane u dang leit shabar lane lehse u dang leit jinglait ! Lane lehse u dang ïohthiah , phin khep ban kyrjaw ïa u !
translation.en: And it came to pass at noon , that Elijah mocked them , and said , Cry aloud : for he is a god  ; either he is talking , or he is pursuing , or he is in a journey , or peradventure he sleepeth , and must be awaked .

translation.kha: Ka Martha ka la khuslai halor ki kam baroh naba ka la daym Ban leh , kumta ka la wan bad ka la ino , Ko TRAI’ , hato mem pynkut lem ba ka para jong sa ka la ieh ïa to ban leh ïa ka Kam baher da ailad hi ? To ong ïa ka ban wan bad ïarap ïa to !
translation.en: But Martha was cumbered about much serving , and came to him , and said , Lord , dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone ? bid her therefore that she help me .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong ki ang kwah ba ngan jin da la don hapoh ka jingtim U Bel ba la pynïakhlad na U Khrist .
translation.en: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren , my kinsmen according to the flesh :
Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears , and in the ears of all the people  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ha phi bad ha ki paidbah .
Kumta U Trai nongsynshar u la phah ïa nga ban ïatih ha u Gog ïa kaei kaba u ong ïa u : Mynta kaban ki Israel , ki briew jong nga ki dang shong ha ka jingsngewskhem ,
translation.en: Therefore , son of man , prophesy and say unto Gog , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely , shalt thou not know it ?

translation.kha: To kynmaw , A Trai , ba nga la shrak ïa me ha ka hok bad jingïoh skhem , badno nga la pyrshang batbor ban leh ïa kaei kabu me kwah ïa nga ban leh . Bad u sdang shun ïamkthang .
translation.en: I beseech thee , O  Lord  , remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart , and have done that which is good in thy sight . And Hezekiah wept sore .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ïa ka Babilon , To shongduh ha ka jingjar jar bad ha ka jingdum ; kin ym khot shuh ïa pha ka syiem jong ki jingïambriew !
translation.en: Sit thou silent , and get thee into darkness , O daughter of the Chaldeans : for thou shalt no more be called , The lady of kingdoms .

translation.kha: Ïano uno uba ong ba u ïaisah ha U Blei u dei shun im kumba U Jisu Khrist u la im .
translation.en: He that saith he abideth in him ought himself also so to walk , even as he walked .

translation.kha: Haba nga leh ban da ïa la ka burom , ma phi ki Israel phan tap ba ar long U Trai’ , namar ngam smam leh ïa phi kat kumto ki jingbymman jong phi , ki jingleh basniew kiba phi dei hok ban ïoh . U Trai Nongsynshar u la Kren .
translation.en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have wrought with you for my name s sake , not according to your wicked ways , nor according to your corrupt doings , O ye house of Israel , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa shispah khatkhyndai snem , bad u la ïor ruh sa kiwei pat ki khuid .
translation.en: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years , and begat sons and daughters .

translation.en: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies  lands  ; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them .

translation.kha: Katba u dang duwai , ka durkhmat jong u ka la kylla dur , pynlang ki jaiñ jong u ki la kylla lieh phyrnai .
translation.en: And as he prayed , the fashion of his countenance was altered , and his raiment was white and glistering .
Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee , in making thee desolate because of thy sins .
translation.kha: Te nga la dep sdang ïa ka jingpynjot bad jingpynpra ïa phi namar ki pop jong phi .

Kine ki nongtem nongput harum na ka kur u Sophah jong ki Lebi ki don ha la ki jaka ba la aiti ha ki da ki jingbthah u Syiem dab : u Asaph , u Heman , bad u Jeduthun , u nongïathuhlypa jong u syier .
