translation.en: We are fools for Christ s sake , but ye are wise in Christ ; we are weak , but ye are strong ; ye are honourable , but we are despised .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta U Khrist ngi long kiba bieit ; hynrei , phi long kiba stad ha U Khrist ! Ngi long kiba tlot , hynrei phi long kiba khlaiñ ! Ngi long kiba la ibeiñ , hynrei phi long kiba la pyndonburom !

Ka jingstad kaba nga pynbna ka long ka jingtied babuhrieh jong U Blang , ïa kaba la ibhabriew na u bynriew , hynrei , ïa kaba u la jied lypa na ka bynta ka burom jong ngi wat ha shuwa ba yn pyningkhong ïa ka pyiar .
translation.en: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery , even the hidden wisdom , which God ordained before the world unto our glory :

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u mynsiem bymman na U balui kynsan kynsan u ïoh tyrnem ïa u Saul , bad u pynkulmar ha ïing la kumin uba lamwir . U Dabid u dang tem ïa ka duitara , kumba u ju leh man ka sngi , bad u Sillah u bat ïa la u sum .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul , and he prophesied in the midst of the house : and David played with his hand , as at other times : and there was a javelin in Saul s hand .

translation.kha: Ki la iehnoh ïa ka lynti kaweh beit Bad ki la jah lynti ; ki la bud ïa ka lynti jong u Baalath , u khun jong u Beor , uba ieit ïa ka pisa kaba u ïoh da ka kam bymhok
translation.en: Which have forsaken the right way , and are gone astray , following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor , who loved the wages of unrighteousness  ;
Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing , and I have heard the voice of thy words , saying ,
translation.kha: Mynta kane ka dei kaei kaba nga ïohsngew ïa kaba phi la ong :

translation.en: Now it came to pass , as they went , that he entered into a certain village : and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki dang leit ha ka jingleit jong ki , u la wan sha ka shnong ha kaba ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Martha ka la pdiang sngewbha ïa u sha ka ïing jong ka .

translation.en: And Moses took the breast , and waved it for a wave offering before the  Lord  : for of the ram of consecration it was Moses  part  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u shim ïa ka shadem bad u ai ïa ka kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang ha U  Trai . Kata ka long ka bynta jong u Moses na u langbrot ka jingpynkyntang . U Moses u la leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .
shon hadien ba u Sedekaïah u la long u syiemsad ka Judah , U Trai Badonbor barieh u la kren ha nga shaphang ka ri Amram .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah , saying ,

He said unto him , I am a prophet also as thou art  ; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the  Lord  , saying , Bring him back with thee into thine house , that he may eat bread and drink water . But he lied unto him .
translation.kha: Te u nongïathuhlypa tymmen uba na Bethel u ong ha u ,  Nga ruh nga dei u nongïathuhlypa kum ma phi , bad ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  , u angel u la ong ïa nga ban ïalam ïa phi sha ïing bad ban ai ïa ka jingpdiang sngewbha ïa phi .  Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u lamler .

translation.en: These see the works of the  Lord  , and his wonders in the deep .
translation.kha: Ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u lah ban leh , ki kam baphylla jong u ha ki duriaw-rit .
Ka jingsawa ka utai ruh ka nang ngim nang jam . U Moses u la Kren , bad U Blei u jubab ïa u ha ka sur u pyrthat .
translation.en: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long , and waxed louder and louder , Moses spake , and God answered him by a voice .
Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past , and his owner hath not kept him in  ; he shall surely pay ox for ox  ; and the dead shall be his own .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada la tip ba uta u masi kyrtong mynshuwa ruh u dei uba la tynrah teng , bad u trai jong u um shym set ïa u , u dei ban buria da kaba ai ïa uta uwei pat da u masi kyrtong uba im , bad un ïoh ma u ïa uta uba ïap .
Hynrei U Jisu u la ong , Ko Joïada , hato dei da ka jingdoh ba me la shetkylla ïa U Toi U Briew ?
translation.en: But Jesus said unto him ,  Judas , betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss ?

translation.kha: un pynshlur ïa phi bad pynsaphriang ïa phi ban ïai leh bad kren ïa kaei kob bha .
translation.en: Comfort your hearts , and stablish you in every good word and work .

translation.kha: Hangno hangno ba phi ïap , hangta ngan ïarep , bad dei hangta ba yn tep ïa to . Ai ba ka jingpynshitom bashyrkhei eh jong U Trai kan wan khap halor jong nga lada nga shah ïa kaei kaei lait nala ka jingïap hi ka ban pynïakhlad ïa nga na phi !
translation.en: Where thou diest , will I die , and there will I be buried : the  Lord  do so to me , and more also , if ought but death part thee and me .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingriew ki thapniang haba ki her ; ka sawa kumne ka jingkyrhuh ka dur , kumba khynwin ka kynjah shipai kaba Heh ; kum ka sur jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh . Haba ki sangeh na kaweh her , ki khylliap ïa la ki thapniang ,
translation.en: And when they went , I heard the noise of their wings , like the noise of great waters , as the voice of the Almighty , the voice of speech , as the noise of an host : when they stood , they let down their wings .

translation.kha: Ynda u la dep , u ong ha ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba khmih ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai ,
translation.en: That Moses commanded the Levites , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: Ha ka sien kaba lai U Jiw u la ong , Ko Simon , u khun jong u Jona , me ieit ïa to ? U Petros u la sngewsih namar ba U Jisu u la kylluid ïa u ha ka sien katba lai , Me ieit ïa nga ? kumta u la ong ha u , Ko Trai , me tip ïa kiei kiei baroh ; me kop ba nga ieit ïa me ! U Jisu u la ong ha u , To sumar ïa ki langbrot jong nga .
translation.en: He saith unto him the third time ,  Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me ?  Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time , Lovest thou me ? And he said unto him , Lord , thou knowest all things  ; thou knowest that I love thee . Jesus saith unto him ,  Feed my sheep .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la ong ïa U Jisu , Ki synran jong U Onan ki shongshit man ka por bad ki duwai , bad ki synñiang jongnga ki Pharisi ki leh Kumjuh , hynrei ki synran jngai me ki ïabah bad ïadih .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Why do the disciples of John fast often , and make prayers , and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees  ; but thine eat and drink ?
Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee , go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone : if he shall hear thee , thou hast gained thy brother .
translation.kha: Lada u para jong me u leh pop pyrshah ïa me , khie leit sha u bad pyn-i ha u ïa ka jingbakla jong u . Hynrei leh ïa ka ha kaba jar jar , kumba tang hapdeng para ma phi . Lada u shahshkor ïa me , me la ïoh pat ïa la u para .
Khatphra hajuh ngut ki shipai Ben-ammi kiba shlur ki la sha pynïap .
translation.en: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men  ; all these were men of valour .

translation.kha: Ki erlangthari ki wan na shaphang shiah , bad ka lyer kriah na shang shat .
translation.en: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind : and cold out of the north .
So they feared the  Lord  , and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places , which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew ki mane ruh ïa U  Trai  bad ki jied napdeng jong ki baroh ki jait briew bapher ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh ha ki jaka mane blei thala bad ban ai jingkñia ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day , that Pharaoh should have the fifth part  ; except the land of the priests only , which became not Pharaoh s .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u shna ïa ka aiñ kaba ïadei bad ka khyndew ha ri Ijipt ba kaba shi bynta na ka san bynta na ka jinglum ha ka aïom ot kan long ka jong u syiem . Kane ka aiñ ka dang neh haduh kane ka sngi . Tang ka khyndew jong ki lyngdoh te kam shym kylla long ka jong u syiem .
Kynsan kynsan , U Mynsiem jong U Trai un wan da ka bor ha me , bad me ruh men ïashad bad ïarisa lang bad ki , bad men sylla long da uwei pat u bhabriew .
translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  will come upon thee , and thou shalt prophesy with them , and shalt be turned into another man .

translation.kha: Nga la ong , Ka dei na ka dak ki kynthei nongtei ba u shym Samson u la leh pop . U la long u briew uba kham khraw ban ïa uno uno na ki syiem jong kiwei ki jaitbynriew . U Blei u la iau ïa u bad pyningkhong syiem ïa u halor ki Jesreel , bad pynban u hap ha kane ka pop .
translation.en: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things ? yet among many nations was there no king like him , who was beloved of his God , and God made him king over all Israel : nevertheless even him did outlandish women cause to sin .

translation.kha: Ki lyoh bad ka jingduk ki ker sawdong ïa u ; u synshar da ka hok malade ka jingbishar hok .
translation.en: Clouds and darkness are round about him : righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne .

translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jongu ki Jiw ha Jeroham ki la phah katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi shwa u Ïoannis , ban kylli ïa u , Me daym uei ?
translation.en: And this is the record of John , when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him , Who art thou ?

translation.kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ba une U Jiw uba na Nasareth un sa pynkyllon ïa ka Templ bad pynkylla ïa ki paw katba la wan sha ngi lyngba u Moses !
translation.en: For we have heard him say , that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place , and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us .
Woe to the land shadowing with wings , which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia :
translation.kha: Sha lyndet ki wah jong ka Sudan don ka ri ha kaba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa jong ki thapniang .

translation.en: And he called unto him the twelve , and began to send them forth by two and two  ; and gave them power over unclean spirits  ;
translation.kha: U la khot lang ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad u la phah ïa ki ar ngut ar ngut . U la ai ïa ki ka bor halor ki mynsiem bymkhuid
Dei namsop kata , nga mareh beit sha ka thong ; dei ñiar sakma balei ba nga long kum nongïakura u bym ïa-pihuin ïa ka jingrai lad u .
translation.en: I therefore so run , not as uncertainly ; so fight I , not as one that beateth the air :

translation.kha: Ki skain kiba ïa-ïap ki lah ban pyniwtung ïa baroh ka jingiwbih shapoh ka dabi , bad tang khyndiat ka jingmutlop ka Lah ban pynduh ïa ka jingngeit kaba khraw kur .
translation.en: Dead flies cause the ointment of the apothecary to send forth a stinking savour : so doth a little folly him that is in reputation for wisdom and honour .

translation.kha: Te ki nong Ijipt ki la sdang ban sheptieng ïa ki Israel , bad kumta ki pynsaja sat ïa ki da kaba pynlong mraw jubor ïa ki ban trei ha ki nang dewbyrtha bad shna maw-it , bad ha ki lyngkha jong ki , bad kim don jinghikai ïa ki .
translation.en: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage , in mortar , and in brick , and in all manner of service in the field : all their service , wherein they made them serve , was with rigour .

translation.kha: Shuh ap , U Trai u nguh . Ap ïa ka sngew haba ngan ïeng ban pynrem ïa ki jingñiewbeiñ . Nga la pynbeit ïa la ka jingmut ban lumlang ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ki hima ktang ban shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ka jingaibor jong nga . Ïa ka pyrthuh baroh kawei yn pynjot da ka ding ka jingbitar shla Jong nga .
translation.en: Therefore wait ye upon me , saith the  Lord  , until the day that I rise up to the prey : for my determination is to gather the nations , that I may assemble the kingdoms , to pour upon them mine indignation , even all my fierce anger : for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka phyrnai : Ym don uno uno uba tar ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ batymmen ban syrdep ïa ka jaiñkup ka rim . Lada u leh kumta , un thab ïa ka jaiñ bathymmai , bad dat ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai kan ym ïadait ïa kiba rim .
translation.en: And he spake also a parable unto them  ;  No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old  ; if otherwise , then both the new maketh a rent , and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old .

translation.kha: Kumno ki iitkhmat jongki ki shuh kliang ? Maki hati kim sngewthuh iakata .
translation.en: How did their glasses get swapped ? Even they themselves didn't understand it !

translation.kha: Ngan tap ïa ki lumbah da ki metïap , bad ki kun jong tun kiba shahïap pynïap ha ka thma kin tap ïa ki lumrit bad ki them .
translation.en: And I will fill his mountains with his slain men : in thy hills , and in thy valleys , and in all thy rivers , shall they fall that are slain with the sword .

translation.kha: Bad ngan tynjuh ïa ka bynta kaba na kaba tang laiñ im bad ngan pynkhuid ïa ki kumba phrang ïa ka rupa da ka ding . Ngan tynjuh ïa ki kumba la ju tyngab ïa ka ksiar . Nangta kin duwai ha nga , bad len jubab ïa ki . Ngam ïathuh ïa ki ba ki long ki briew jong nga , bad kan Phla ba nga long U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And I will bring the third part through the fire , and will refine them as silver is refined , and will try them as gold is tried : they shall call on my name , and I will hear them : I will say , It is my people : and they shall say , The  Lord  is my God .

translation.kha: Ka bymmyntoi , ka bymmyntoi , ong u bymstad saiñpyrkhat . Baroh ka long ka bymmyntoi .
translation.en: Vanity of vanities , saith the preacher  ; all is vanity .

translation.kha: malu ka khot ïa ki briew kiba ïadei nangta , kiba dang leit sha la ka kam :
translation.en: To call passengers who go right on their ways :

translation.kha: Haba u la kriah ïa ken , nga la shut sha khyndew , khlem lait kren .
translation.en: And when he had spoken such words unto me , I set my face toward the ground , and I became dumb .

translation.kha: U tharai u wan hiar ha u lyoh bad u la ïong bad u hangta , bad u la pynthaba ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong u , U Trai .
translation.en: And the  Lord  descended in the cloud , and stood with him there , and proclaimed the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Phi lah ban leit rieh ïa ka sha i pa lad phi ba in bam bad in sa ai ïa phi ka jingkyrkhu jongngi i shuwa ba in ïap .
translation.en: And thou shalt bring it to thy father , that he may eat , and that he may bless thee before his death .
( Psalm 122 :1 ) This also creates a favorable impression in the community . —2 Corinthians 6 :3 .
translation.kha: ( Salm 122 :1 ) Ka shnong ka thaw ka ïaroh ïa kane . —2 Korinth 6 :3 .
Nangta u lyoh u la paw bad u la tap ïa ki da ka syrngiew jong u , bad ka sur ka la wan na u lynghoh , Une u long U Khun ba-ieit eh jong ang — to ïashukor ïa u !
translation.en: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them : and a voice came out of the cloud , saying , This is my beloved Son : hear him .

translation.kha: Naba tang mar ïa iohnong ïa ka jingkhublei jongu pha , i khunlung hapoh jong nga i la kynthih da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: For , lo , as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears , the babe leaped in my womb for joy .

translation.kha: Ngim shym la ïoh jingpyiar ei ei da ka jingmane jong ngi ka bym dei ïa me halor ki krai lum . Ka jingïarap ïa ki Israhaïah ka wan tieng na U Trai U Blei jong me .
translation.en: Truly in vain is salvation hoped for from the hills , and from the multitude of mountains : truly in the  Lord  our God is the salvation of Israel .

translation.kha: Lada lap hapoh shnong ïa uno uno u briew ba u ïathiah shongneh bad ka briew kaba la ïatehktien sad uwei pat u bariew ,
translation.en: If a damsel that is a virgin be betrothed unto an husband , and a man find her in the city , and lie with her  ;

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha kiwei shemphang U Jehobah bad ki lynti jong u Isaïah 43 :10 .
translation.en: Tell others about Jehovah and his ways . —Isaiah 43 :10 .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Ïoannis Nongpynbaptis u la wan sha ka ri shyiap jrong ka Judia bad u la sheng ban ïalaw .
translation.en: In those days came John the Baptist , preaching in the wilderness of Judaea ,

translation.kha: Ha ba ia nujor malu pyrkhat kumno pyllaitluid na ki kitab jong ka .—Proberb ka arspah ia ngi , kaei naba bunkam ha ka jingsuk jingsaiñ .
translation.en: In contrast , consider how just two Bible proverbs help us to see what is important to happiness .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba kamut ki kmen ha la ka jingbieit , hynrei kiba stad kin leh ïa kaei kaba dei .
translation.en: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom : but a man of understanding walketh uprightly .

translation.kha: ‘ Wat ïa u pajih pui na ka shnong jong phi uba dambit ha ki khait jong ngi , ngi ñiat noh pyrshah ïa pa’ . Hynrei kynmaw ba ka Hima U Blei ka la wan hajan Jong phi !’
translation.en: Even the very dust of your city , which cleaveth on us , we do wipe off against you : notwithstanding be ye sure of this , that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you .
Remember them , O my God , because they have defiled the priesthood , and the covenant of the priesthood , and of the Levites .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , A Blei , kumno kito ki briew ki la pyntngit ïa baroh ar , ka jinglong lyngdoh bad ka jutang kaba me la pynlong bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .
Ngi la ïoh katto katne ka jakarieh lieng hab ngi la ïaid shaphang shathie jongnga ka lawlynnong Kaba rai jong ka Kauda . Hangta da kaba eh , ngi la lah ba-bang pynskhem ïa ka lieng rit .
translation.en: And running under a certain island which is called Clauda , we had much work to come by the boat :
And Jesus looked round about , and saith unto his disciples ,  How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !
translation.kha: U Jisu u la peit sawdong ha ki synran jong u bad u la ong ïa ki ,  A katno ka long kaba eh ïa kiba riewspah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei !

translation.en: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate  ; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses , which the  Lord  had commanded to Israel .
translation.kha: Haba la poi u bnai uba hynñiew , ki briew ka Israel ki la ïashong ïasah ha ki shnong . Ha ka sngi banyngkong jong uta u bnai , ki la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem , ha ka jaka basawdong hapoh ka Khyrdop Um . Ki ong ïa u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad ka Hukum ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel lyngba u Moses , ban wanrah ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum .
Kane ka dei kumno U Blei Badonbor Baroh u pynshitom ïa ki bymman , ki briew kiba lehhok .
translation.en: This is the portion of a wicked man with God , and the heritage of oppressors , which they shall receive of the Almighty .
And there came a man of God unto Eli , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Did I plainly appear unto the house of thy father , when they were in Egypt in Pharaoh s house ?
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u wan sha u Eli bad ka khubor na U  Trai  :  Haba u Kpa tymmen jong me u Aaron bad ka longïing jong u ki dang long ki mraw jong u Pharaoh ka Ijipt . Nga la pynpaw ïa lade ha u Aaron .
Lada ine kohnguh hok ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la hukum ïa ngi , u ruh un sngewbha ïa ngi .’
translation.en: And it shall be our righteousness , if we observe to do all these commandments before the  Lord  our God , as he hath commanded us .
Blessed are the meek : for they shall inherit the earth .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba sngewrit ; kin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular !

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will extend peace to her like a river , and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream : then shall ye suck , ye shall be borne upon her sides , and be dandled upon her knees .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan wallam ha phi ïa ka jingdap kyrhai baneh ; ka spah jong ki jaitbynriew kan tuid sha phi kum ka wah , ka bym ju rngad . Phin long kum i khunlung iba la sumar da la ka kmie , ba la rah ha ki ksang ti jong ka , bad sumar da ka jingieit .
Ha ka nongbah , baroh’ kiei ktien ki long ha ka jingkulmar , bad ki briew ki la setkut ïa lap ha ki ïing jong ki ba shngain .
translation.en: The city of confusion is broken down : every house is shut up , that no man may come in .

translation.kha: Yn ym don shuh kano kano ka miet , bad kin ym donkam ïa ki sharak lane ïa ka jingshai ka sngi , nalor U Trai naba U Blei un long ka jingshai jong ki bad kmen synshar khem ki syiem junom la junom .
translation.en: And there shall be no night there  ; and they need no candle , neither light of the sun  ; for the Lord God giveth them light : and they shall reign for ever and ever .

translation.kha: To hukum ïa nam kiba riewspah ha Kiei kiei jongnga kano ka jingrem ba kin ym sngewsarong , hynrei ban buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jongu ki , ym ha kata kaei kawei ka bym thikna kum ka spah , hynrei ha U Blei , uba ai kyrhai ïa kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ka jingsngewbha jong ngi .
translation.en: Charge them that are rich in this world , that they be not highminded , nor trust in uncertain riches , but in the living God , who giveth us richly all things to enjoy ;
And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father Uzziah did : howbeit he entered not into the temple of the  Lord . And the people did yet corruptly .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , kumba u kpa jong u , u la leh ; hynrei , ym kum u kpa jong u , um shym la leh pop da kaba thang jingiwbih ha ka Templ . Ki briew pynban , ki dang ïai leh pop .
Hato la pynmynsaw ïa phi da ka pop Jong la , ko phi u nongap byndi ? Balei me pyndonkam ïa nga na ka bynta ka sohpdung-jinghikai jong me ? Haduh sa long ka jingkit kaba khia eh ïa me ?
translation.en: I have sinned  ; what shall I do unto thee , O thou preserver of men ? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee , so that I am a burden to myself ?

So Gideon , and the hundred men that were with him , came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch  ; and they had but newly set the watch : and they blew the trumpets , and brake the pitchers that were in their hands .
translation.kha: U Gideon bad ki shispah ngut ki rangbah ki la poi ha tduh kata ka jaka sher dara shuwa ka por shiteng synñia , hamar ba dang dep ïa-bujli ïa ki nongap phira . Nangta ki put ïa ki turoi bad ki pynpait ïa ki khra ba ki bat , bad kita ki ar kynhun ruh ki leh kumjuh .

translation.en: Then ye shall come up after him , that he may come and sit upon my throne  ; for he shall be king in my stead : and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah .
translation.kha: Bud biang ïa u shane haba u wan ban shong ha ka khet jong nga . Un long syiem hadien jong nga , namar u dei ma u , uta uba nga la jied ban long u nongsynshar jong ka Israel bad ka Judah .

translation.en: Neither shall one thrust another  ; they shall walk every one in his path : and when they fall upon the sword , they shall not be wounded .

translation.en: I have shewed you all things , how that so labouring ye ought to support the weak , and to remember the words of the Lord Jesus , how he said ,  It is more blessed to give than to receive .

Un ym ïalang slem uba riewspah ; ym kein kaba dei ka jong u ka ban neh .
translation.en: He shall not be rich , neither shall his substance continue , neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth .
Two men shall be in the field  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
translation.kha: Ar ngut ki rangbah kin ïatrei ha ka lyngkha : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn iehnoh shadien .

translation.kha: Ka jingkren bymshisha kaba buhrieh ïa kaei ba phi pyrkhat shisha ka long kum ka jingsop ïit ha u khiew khyndew uba tat-dor .
Uwei na ki u la iehnoh ïa na . Khlem pep u la shah patar lyngdoh lyngkhai ha ki mradkhlaw , namar ngam shym la ïohi shuh ïa u naduh ba u mih .
translation.en: And the one went out from me , and I said , Surely he is torn in pieces  ; and I saw him not since :
And the first day of unleavened bread , when they killed the passover , his disciples said unto him , Where wilt thou that we go and prepare that thou mayest eat the passover ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ka sngi ha kaba la pynïap ïa ki khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , ki synran U Jisu ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hangno me kwah ïa ngi ban leit bad ban pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ?
U Moses u klet shane shatai , bad haba u ïohi ba ym don mano mano ba pynlut sha u , u pynpei ïa u , bad u tep ïa u shapoh u shyiap .
translation.en: And he looked this way and that way , and when he saw that there was no man , he slew the Egyptian , and hid him in the sand .
For , behold , the  Lord  cometh forth out of his place , and will come down , and tread upon the high places of the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wan mih na ka jaka bakhuid jong u ; un wan hiar bad ïaid ha kliar jong ki lumbah .
Te ki briew jong u ki la ngeit ïa ki kular jongki u bad ki rwai ki jingïaroh ïa u .
translation.en: Then believed they his words  ; they sang his praise .
Seeing that many glory after the flesh , I will glory also .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar don shibun kiba kob sarong na ki daw ba kynja briew , nga ruh ngan leh kumjuh .
U Jisu! u la jingjubab , Hato phim paw pule ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong ba ha kaba mynnyngkong U Nongthaw u la thaw ïa ki briew , shynrang bad kynthih ?
translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  Have ye not read , that he which made them at the beginning made them male and female ,

translation.kha: Kine ki nongkhap bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Dan ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingkhaïi jong ki .
translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families , these cities with their villages .
I just want to forget about it .
translation.kha: Nga kwah klet noh shaphang kato .
ïohthiah ïa ki ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Mynba la la jied ïa ka Israel , nga la pynlong ka jingkular ha ki . Neng la pynpaw ïa lade ha ki ha ibieit dara ong ïa ki : Nga long U Trai U Blei jongno phi .
translation.en: And say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day when I chose Israel , and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob , and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt , when I lifted up mine hand unto them , saying , I am the  Lord  your God  ;

translation.kha: To shong to sah hangne , bad ngan long lem mala me , malu ngan kyrkhu ïa me . Ngan sa ai ïa kano ka ri borbah ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me . Ngan bat ïa la ka kular kaweh nga la pynlong ha u Abraham u kput jong me .
translation.en: Sojourn in this land , and I will be with thee , and will bless thee  ; for unto thee , and unto thy seed , I will give all these countries , and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father  ;

translation.kha: U lehbha u la ïeng jot , u la iehnoh ïa kaei kiei bhor bad u la bud ïa u .
translation.en: And he left all , rose up , and followed him .
And Jesus , when he came out , saw much people , and was moved with compassion toward them , because they were as sheep not having a shepherd : and he began to teach them many things .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu la hiar na ka lieng , u la ïohi ïa une u paidbah babun , bad ïa ka mynsiem jong u la pyndap da ka jingsngewsynei ïa ki , namar ki la long kum ki langbrot khlem u nongsharai . Kumta u la sdang ban hikai bun kiei kiei ïa ki .
Kin jali kat haduh ba kin tap lin ïa ka khyndew baroh . Kin ïam lut khoit ïa kata baroh kaba u phria um shym la pynjot , dara wat ïa ki dieng kiba dang tama .
translation.en: And they shall cover the face of the earth , that one cannot be able to see the earth : and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped , which remaineth unto you from the hail , and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field :

translation.kha: Wat ai ba yn bet ïa ki symbai ha kata ka ri lane ai ba yn lum ïa ka jingmih . Man uwei pa uwei u nongwei uba shong hangtei un sheptieng ïa ka kynhun shipa ba tur ïaleh bad ban leit phai iing .
translation.en: Cut off the sower from Babylon , and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest : for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people , and they shall flee every one to his own land .

translation.kha: Lada ka pynsngewbha ïa phi , ko syiem , bad lada phi sngewsynei ïa nga bad ka long kaweh daym ha phi , sngewbha pynmih ka jingpynbna shun khang ïa ki hukum u Haman na kaba pyntreikam ïa ki — iba ki hukum ibha u khun jyllang u Hammedatha uba hiarpateng na u Agag u la ai na ka bynta ka jingpynjot ïa ki Jiw baroh ha ka hima .
translation.en: And said , If it please the king , and if I have found favour in his sight , and the thing seem right before the king , and I be pleasing in his eyes , let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king s provinces :

And the priest shall put on his linen garment , and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh , and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar , and he shall put them beside the altar .
translation.kha: Nangta u lyngdoh , uba kup ïa ka jaiñkup linen bad uba phong ïa ka patlun linen kaba lyngkot , un weng noh ïa u dpei khleiñ ba sah ha ka duwan bad un buh ïa u harud jong ka duwan .
Kine ki dei ki kthang ba la ai ïa u nongshun bakhrawbor tad jong U Blei .
translation.en: These are terms given to God’s chief enemy .

translation.en: Thou shalt also decree a thing , and it shall be established unto thee : and the light shall shine upon thy ways .

translation.en: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram , the rump , and that which covereth the inwards , and the kidneys , and the caul above the liver :
And the people believed : and when they heard that the  Lord  had visited the children of Israel , and that he had looked upon their affliction , then they bowed their heads and worshipped .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la ngeit , bad haba ki ïohsngew ba U  Trai  u la wan sha ki bad ba u la ïohi kumno ki la shah lehbeiñ tyngeh , ki la nguh la dem bad ki la ïamane ruh .

translation.en: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit , or that is a wizard , shall surely be put to death : they shall stone them with stones : their blood shall be upon them .
translation.kha: Uno uno u briew lane ka briew kiba leh byrtong kin shah lynthem maw haduh ba kin da ïap ; uno uno u briew uba leh ïa kane u pan kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .
Lada kumta , u dei ban siew sha uta u briew uba la thied ïa ka ha ka dor ka ban ïahap bad ki snem kiba dang sah haduh ka snem ka Jingpynïap pat katba bud , hadien kata un ïoh pat ïa la ka khyndew .
translation.en: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof , and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it  ; that he may return unto his possession .

translation.kha: U la jubab , Uta uba don ar tylli ki sopti , u dei ban ai kamai ha u briew u bym don , dara uno un uba don jingbam u dih pun ïashem ïa ka .
translation.en: He answereth and saith unto them , He that hath two coats , let him impart to him that hath none  ; and he that hath meat , let him do likewise .
Come to Beth–el , and transgress  ; at Gilgal multiply transgression  ; and bring your sacrifices every morning , and your tithes after three years :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ko ki paid Israel , khie leit sha ka jaka bakhuid ka Bethel bad leh pop , lada phi hap ban leh kumta ! Khie leit sha Gilgal bad to leh pop da ka jingkhlaiñbor jong phi baroh ! Ïaid shaphrang bad wallam ïa ki mrad ban kñia na ka step sha ka step , bad wallam ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jong phi man la ka sngi kaba lai .

U Trai u la ai ruh ha ki Israel ka jingjop ïa kane ka nongbah malade ïa u shem jong ka . kam Shimham la iehnoh wat uwei ruh , hynrei ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa iwei u briew kiba don ha ka . Ki la leh ïa u syiem jong ka kumba ki la leh ïa u syiemsad ka Jerikho .
translation.en: And the  Lord  delivered it also , and the king thereof , into the hand of Israel  ; and he smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein  ; he let none remain in it  ; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho .

translation.kha: Kito kiba leit sha Ijipt ban ïoh jingïarap kin jot ! Ki shaniah ha ka bor shipai bakhraw jong ka Ijipt — ki kulai , ki kali ïapom , bad ki ba-shiphew . Hynrei kim tip ban shaniah ha U Trai , U blem Bakhuid ki Israel , jlan pan na u ïa ka jingïarap .
translation.en: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help  ; and stay on horses , and trust in chariots , because they are many  ; and in horsemen , because they are very strong  ; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel , neither seek the  Lord  !

translation.kha: U Trai un kyrshan ïa la ki briew ; un sngewsynei ïa la ki shakri .
translation.en: For the  Lord  will judge his people , and he will repent himself concerning his servants .

translation.kha: Dang kiba im kiba ïarep ïa me , dom nga ïaroh ïa me mynta . Ki kpa ki ïathuh ïa la ki khulom katno me long umbiah ïaineh .
translation.en: The living , the living , he shall praise thee , as I do this day : the father to the children shall make known thy truth .

And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David , the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth–rehob , and the Syrians of Zobah , twenty thousand footmen , and of king Maacah a thousand men , and of Ish–tob twelve thousand men .
translation.kha: Ki Ammon ki la sngewthuh ba ki la pynlong nongshun ïa u Dabid , kumta ki la phah wai arphew hajar ngut ki shipai Syria na Bethrehob bad na Sobah , khat-ar hajar ngut ki rangbah na Tob , bad ïa u syiem Maakah lem bad shihajar ngut ki rangbah .

As righteousness tendeth to life : so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death .

translation.en: And the bramble said unto the trees , If in truth ye anoint me king over you , then come and put your trust in my shadow : and if not , let fire come out of the bramble , and devour the cedars of Lebanon .

translation.kha: U Trai u la nguh ha u Gad , u nongïathuhlypa jong u Dabid , Khie leit mala ong ha u Dabid ba sa ai ha u lai tylliat ki jingjied . Ngan leh ïa Kanah Kanaan kiba u jied . Ha ka pha kambah bud , hadien ba u Dabid u la khie thiaw ,
translation.en: Go and say unto David , Thus saith the  Lord  , I offer thee three things  ; choose thee one of them , that I may do it unto thee .

translation.en: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family , which remain in all the places whither I have driven them , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.en: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard , they have trodden my portion under foot , they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness .

translation.en: And when ye came unto this place , Sihon the king of Heshbon , and Og the king of Bashan , came out against us unto battle , and we smote them :

translation.en: Then said the woman , Whom shall I bring up unto thee ? And he said , Bring me up Samuel .

translation.en: But many that are first shall be last  ; and the last shall be first .

translation.en: Also every sickness , and every plague , which is not written in the book of this law , them will the  Lord  bring upon thee , until thou be destroyed .
And there was an hole in the midst of the robe , as the hole of an habergeon , with a band round about the hole , that it should not rend .

translation.en: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers  skins , and shall put it upon a bar .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the Lord  God  , that I will cause the sun to go down at noon , and I will darken the earth in the clear day :

translation.kha: U  Trai  u la lah ong ha u Moses ,  U Pharaoh un ïai kyntait ban shahshkor ïa phi khnang ba nga lah ban leh kham bun ki kambah jong nga ha Ijipt .

translation.en: Terrors are turned upon me : they pursue my soul as the wind : and my welfare passeth away as a cloud .

translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u , Nga la phohsniew ïa ka jingphohsniew , nabar ym don mano mano ba lah ngab paw ïa ka . La ïathuh ha nga ba me ia ban batai ïa ki jingphohsniew .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I have dreamed a dream , and there is none that can interpret it : and I have heard say of thee , that thou canst understand a dream to interpret it .

translation.en: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job : and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren .

translation.kha: Lada u briew u leh ïa kano kano ka kam shyntur bad na ka bynta “kata u shah phasi ha u dieng ,

translation.en: And he called unto him the twelve , and began to send them forth by two and two  ; and gave them power over unclean spirits  ;

translation.en: And he must needs go through Samaria .

translation.en: And it came to pass , after he had eaten bread , and after he had drunk , that he saddled for him the ass , to wit , for the prophet whom he had brought back .

translation.en: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years , and begat sons and daughters .
And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven , having great power  ; and the earth was lightened with his glory .
translation.kha: Hadien kane nga la ïohi ïa uwei pat u angel uba wan hiar na bneng . U la don ka bor bakhraw , bad ka jingphyrnai jong u ka la pynthaba ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

U Khrist da lade hi u la bah noh ïa ki pop jong ngi ha ka met jong u sha ka diengphna , khnang ba ngin ïap ïa ka pop bad ïoh im na ka bynta ka hok . Ka dei da ki jingjngem snam jongu u ba la pynkhiah ïa pa .
translation.en: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree , that we , being dead to sins , should live unto righteousness : by whose stripes ye were healed .

translation.kha: Nangta u Ahimaas , u khun jong u Saddusi u ong ha u Joppa , Shah ngan leit sha u syiem bad ka khubor Babha ba U TRAI’ u la pyllait im ïa u na ki nongshun Jong u .
translation.en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok , Let me now run , and bear the king tidings , how that the  Lord  hath avenged him of his enemies .
For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins : they afflict the just , they take a bribe , and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right .
translation.kha: Nga tip haduh katno ki pop jong phi ki long kiba sngewshyrkhei bad katno kiba bun ki kam runar phi la leh . Phi pynshitom beiñ ïa ki briew kiba bha , phi bamsap , phi khang noh ïa kiba duk ban ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok ha ki ïingbishar .

translation.en: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans , and of the Stoicks , encountered him . And some said , What will this babbler say ? other some , He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods : because he preached unto them Jesus , and the resurrection .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki nonghikai na ka skul jong ki Epikuri bad ki Stoik ki la ïatainia ruh bad u . Katto katne ngut na ki , ki la kylli ,  Aïu une u sarong bieit u pyrshang ban kren ?  Kiwei pat ki jubab ,  U i kumba u kren shaphang ki blei nongwei .  Ki la ong ïa kane namar ba u Paul u la ïalap shaphang U Jisu bad ka jingmihpat .
Nangta u la kdew sha la ki synran bad u la ong , Ha khmih ! Hangne ki lama ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jongngi nga !
translation.en: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples , and said ,  Behold my mother and my brethren !

translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip luin shaphang jong me , kaei ba me imat bad shano me leit , badno nga tip kumno ba me bato shla pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: But I know thy abode , and thy going out , and thy coming in , and thy rage against me .
Then the priest shall consider : and , behold , if the leprosy have covered all his flesh , he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague : it is all turned white : he is clean .
translation.kha: u lyngdoh un khmih bniah biang ïa uta u briew . Lada u shem ba kata ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ka la sop shisha ïa ka met jong u baroh shi rynïeng , un pynbna ba uta u briew u long uba khuid . Lada ka sniehdoh jong u baroh ka la kylla lieh un long uba khuid .

Te mynta , ma nga U Trai , por ong ha me , ko syiem Jehoïakim , ba yn ym don u ban hiarpateng na me u ban synshar shuh halor ka hima u Dabid . Ïa ka metïap jongki me yn bret shabar ha ka jingshit kyr-ang ka sngi ha ka por mynnor bad ha u thah mynmiet .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of Jehoiakim king of Judah  ; He shall have none to sit upon the throne of David : and his dead body shall be cast out in the day to the heat , and in the night to the frost .

translation.kha: U Jonathan u jubab , U la kyrpad ïa sa ba ngan shah ïa u ban ithuh sha Bethlehem .
translation.en: And Jonathan answered Saul , David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth–lehem :

translation.kha: Tad ynda nga wan , to ai ïa ka por jong me bad ka jingpyrshang Ban pule paidbah ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid bad ban ïalap bad hikai .
translation.en: Till I come , give attendance to reading , to exhortation , to doctrine .
And six branches shall come out of the sides of it  ; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side , and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side :
translation.kha: Dei ban don hynriew tylli ki tnat kiba mih na baroh arliang jong u , lai tylli na kawei kawei ka liang .
Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha para shynrang , ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba sang ; dei ban pynïap ïa ki baroh ar ngut .
translation.en: If a man also lie with mankind , as he lieth with a woman , both of them have committed an abomination : they shall surely be put to death  ; their blood shall be upon them .

translation.kha: Wat bishni ïa ki riewsniew , pynlang wat pylleng ban ïalang paralok Bad ki .
translation.en: Be not thou envious against evil men , neither desire to be with them .
Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine : turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ha nga ,  Ïa ka Israel yn sloit pynkhuid kum ka bri sohwaiñ na kaba la kheit ïa uwei pa uwei u sohwaiñ . Kumta pha dei ban pyllait im ïano ïano katba pha lah katba dang don ka por .
To ïar ïa U Trai , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyllait ; ïarah ïa ka burom badno ka jingkhlaiñbor jong u .
translation.en: Give unto the  Lord  , O ye kindreds of the people , give unto the  Lord  glory and strength .
For if ye love them which love you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also love those that love them .
translation.kha: Lada phi ieit tang ïa ki briew kiba ieit ïa phi , balei phi dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongpop ki ieit ïa kito kiba ieit ïa ki !

Dei ha ka nongrim jong ka jinglong lyngdoh ki Lebi ba la ai ïa ka Hukum ha ki paid Israel . myntri , lada ka kam lyngdoh jongno ki lehbha ka la longïing kabu jingai , yn ym donkam shuh ïa uwei pateng u lyngdoh ban mihngi , uwei uba na ka jinglong lyngdoh u Melkhi , ym jong u Yiron .
translation.en: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood , ( for under it the people received the law , ) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec , and not be called after the order of Aaron ?
So the king died , and was brought to Samaria  ; and they buried the king in Samaria .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Ahab u la ïap . Ïa ka met jong u la kit bad la tep ha Samaria .
Habor u Akhbor u ïohi ïa u , u ong , Me la wan — u nongthoh jingkulmar basniew tam ha Jeriel !
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Ahab saw Elijah , that Ahab said unto him , Art thou he that troubleth Israel ?

translation.kha: Te U Trai’ u la ong ha nga ,
translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto Jeremiah , saying ,

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jingïathong Bad phi ha ka kthang u patsha . Ngan ai ïa phi ar hajir tylli ki kulai lada phi lah ban Shem katta ngut ki rangbah ki ban shong ha ki .
translation.en: Now therefore give pledges , I pray thee , to my master the king of Assyria , and I will give thee two thousand horses , if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them .
For , behold , we were binding sheaves in the field , and , lo , my sheaf arose , and also stood upright  ; and , behold , your sheaves stood round about , and made obeisance to my sheaf .
translation.kha: Baroh ngi ïadon lang ha lyngkha ba ngi ïateh song ïa u kew , ha kaba ka song jong nga ka khie joit bad ka ïeng beit . Ki song jong phi pat ki tawiar sawdong ïa ka song jong nga , bad ki ïanguh ïa ka .
Em , ym tang hynñiew sien , la jubab U Jisu , hynrei haduh hynñiewphew sien hynñiew ,
translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  I say not unto thee , Until seven times : but , Until seventy times seven .

translation.kha: Wat theh ïa ka ha ka met jong uno uno u riewpaidbah malade wat pynbudnam ïa khih ka rukom khlieh ban shna ïa kawei pait ka jait umphniang kaba kum kane . Kane ka long kaba kyntang , bad phi dei ïa-ban kheiñ kyntang ïa ka .
translation.en: Upon man s flesh shall it not be poured , neither shall ye make any other like it , after the composition of it : it is holy , and it shall be holy unto you .
But I suffer not a woman to teach , nor to usurp authority over the man , but to be in silence .
translation.kha: Ngam shah ïa ki kynthei ba kin hikai lane leh donbor halor ki shynrang ; ki dei ban long kiba jar jar .

translation.en: O house of David , thus saith the  Lord   ; Execute judgment in the morning , and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor , lest my fury go out like fire , and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha nga ban ai ïa kane ka khubor ha ka ïingsyiem Judah , ki khun ki ksiew u Dabid :  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong . To khmih ba yn don ka jingbishar hok man la ka sngi . Ïada ïa u briew uba shah thok na uta uba thok ïa u . Lada phim leh kumta , ka jingbymman kaba phi leh kan pynlong ïa ka jingbitar jong nga ban meh kum ka ding kaba ym lah ban pynlip .

translation.en: Son of man , set thy face toward the south , and drop thy word toward the south , and prophesy against the forest of the south field  ;
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  khmih shaphang shathie . To kren pyrshah ïa kaba shathie bad ïathuhlypa pyrshah ïa ka khlaw jong kaba shathie .

translation.en: But the Levites have no part among you  ; for the priesthood of the  Lord  is their inheritance : and Gad , and Reuben , and half the tribe of Manasseh , have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east , which Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave them .
translation.kha: Pynban , ki Lebi kin ym ïoh kano kano ka bynta jong ka ri lem bad phi , namar ka bynta jong ki ka long ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai . Bad da shisha , ki jait Gad , Reuben , Manasseh ba sha Mihngi te ki la lah ïohpdiang ïa la ka jaka ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan , ïa kaba u Moses u shakri jong U  Trai  u la ai ha ki .

translation.en: 1 What Is the Good News ?
translation.kha: 1 Kaei ka Khubor Babha ?
hynrei lada ka leh kumta , ka dei ba shong khynraw noh lane ka dei ban ïasuk pah bad la u tnga Bad u tnga um dei ban pyllait noh ïa la ka thngan .
translation.en: But and if she depart , let her remain unmarried , or be reconciled to her husband : and let not the husband put away his wife .
He reigned three years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah . And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam .
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Mikaïah ka khun u Uriel , na ka nongbah Gibeah . Ka thma ka la khie hapdeng u Abijah bad u Jeroboam .

U Salmunna u pynkyntang ïa ka khak pdeng jong ka phyllaw , ka jaka kaweh ha khmat ka Templ , bad u ai ki jingkñia hangta ba la trep tyrnem , ki jingainguh bam , bad ïa ka khleiñ na ki jingweng ïasyllok . U kuna ïa kane namar ba ka duwan rnong ba u la thaw ka rit than ïa Kino ki jingainguh baroh .
translation.en: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the  Lord  : for there he offered burnt offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings , because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings , and the meat offerings , and the fat .

translation.kha: Ngi la ai ha ki ïa ki hukum jong nga bad na la shithi ha ki ïa ki aiñ jong la , kiba wallam ka jingim ïa uno Un uba jongu ïa ki .
translation.en: And I gave them my statutes , and shewed them my judgments , which if a man do , he shall even live in them .
And there was one named Barabbas , which lay bound with them that had made insurrection with him , who had committed murder in the insurrection .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u briew uba kyrteng u Barabbas u don ha ka byndi bad ki nongïaleh pyrshah kiba la pynïap briew ha ki por jingïakhih paidbah .

hynrei u Paul um shym pyrkhat ba ka long kaba dei ban ïamareh ïa u , namarba um shyiap la sah bad ki haduh kaba ngut ka kam lad ki , isynei u la longing phai bapaw nabar u la Iehnoh ïa ki ha Pamphylia .
translation.en: But Paul thought not good to take him with them , who departed from them from Pamphylia , and went not with them to the work .

translation.kha: Yn sa rah ïa ki sha Babilonia bad kin sah hangthie tad haduh ba ngan da phai ka jingmut jong nga shat ki . Nangta ngan wallam pat ïa ki bad bthuh biang ïa ki ha kaei ka khak . Ma sa , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: They shall be carried to Babylon , and there shall they be until the day that I visit them , saith the  Lord   ; then will I bring them up , and restore them to this place .

translation.kha: Bad u Mikaïah u pynkut : Kane ka dei Kaei kaba la jia . U TRAI’ u pynhieng ïa kine ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi ban lamler ïa phi . Hynrei u hi da latai u la dep ïa-rai ba phin ïakynduh ïa ka jingshyrkhei !
translation.en: Now therefore , behold , the  Lord  hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets , and the  Lord  hath spoken evil against thee .
Woe to them that devise iniquity , and work evil upon their beds ! when the morning is light , they practise it , because it is in the power of their hand .
translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewtriem kan long ïa kito kiba peitmat bad thmu ïa kaba sniew ! Haba poi ka step , mar ïa-ïoh ïa ka kabu , ki leh ïa kaba sniew kaba ki la thmu .

translation.en: Then said he unto me , This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole earth : for every one that stealeth shall be cut off as on this side according to it  ; and every one that sweareth shall be cut off as on that side according to it .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha nga ,  Halor jong ka la thoh ïa ka jingtim kaba dei ban leit sha ka ri baroh kawei . Ha kawei ka liang jong ka kot kli ka ong ba ïa uwei pa uwei u nongtuh yn weng noh na ka ri ; bad ha kawei pat ka liang ka ong ba ïa uno uno uba ïathuh lamler hapoh ka jingsmai yn shim noh ïa u ruh .
Uwei u banbeiñ uba kyrteng u Demetrios uba la thaw ïa ki Susah templ jongki ka bleithaw Artemas da ka rupa , bad ka kam jong u ka la pynïohnong shibun eh ïa ki nongtrei .
translation.en: For a certain man named Demetrius , a silversmith , which made silver shrines for Diana , brought no small gain unto the craftsmen  ;

translation.kha: Lada kata ka Hukum , kaba wallam ïa ka jingïap haba la pyntreikam ïa ka , ka la wanrah ha kat kata ka burom , kaba katno dak ka burom kaba kham khraw ka longïng kata ka jingieit jong U Mynsiem!
translation.en: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather glorious ?

translation.kha: Hynrei u khun jong pha un im Kum ka kad khlaw , un ïaleh pyrshah ïa uwei pa uwei u briew , bad nawei pa uwei u briew un ïaleh pyrshah ïa u . Un shong khlad na la ki kur ki jaiñjot baroh .
translation.en: And he will be a wild man  ; his hand will be against every man , and every man s hand against him  ; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren .

translation.kha: Ïeng hangto , u syiem u ong ha u ; bad u la wait shajrong bad ïeng hangta .
translation.en: And the king said unto him , Turn aside , and stand here . And he turned aside , and stood still .
By long forbearing is a prince persuaded , and a soft tongue breaketh the bone .
translation.kha: Ka jingïaishah ba pynkohnguh ka lah ban pynpra ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah bakhlaiñ tam bad ka lah ban pynngeit wat ïa ki nongsynshar .

translation.en: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood : but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them .
translation.kha: Ki ktien jong ki bymman ki long kum ban pynïap , hynrei ki ktien jong kiba hok ki pyllait im ïa kito kiba shah byrngem .
Lada lap ïa u bhabriew ba u batbor ïa ka briew ka bym pat shym ïatehktien badno badno ,
translation.en: If a man find a damsel that is a virgin , which is not betrothed , and lay hold on her , and lie with her , and they be found  ;
For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name : I have not sent them , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ki jinglamler ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong nga . Ngam shym phah ïa ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .’

translation.en: Then Abner called to Joab , and said , Shall the sword devour for ever ? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end ? how long shall it be then , ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren ?
translation.kha: U Abner u pyrta ïa u Joab ,  Hato ngin hap ban ïaleh shi junom ? Hato mem ïohi ba ha kaba kut ym don ei ei hynrei tang ka jingkthang ? Ngi long ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi . Slem sa katno ha shuwa ba men hukum ïa ki rangbah jong me ban sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa ngi ?

translation.en: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding , that the king enquired of them , he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm .
translation.kha: Kam pher kaei ka jingkylli ba u syiem u la kylli , lane kano ka jingeh kaba u pynpaw , kine ki saw ngut ki la kham tip shiphew shah ban ïa uno uno u nongbatai kupar lane u nongleh myntor ha ka hima jong u baroh kawei .
Bad phim dei Ban khot ïadon ïatan ha kane ka pyrthei ‘ u Kpa ,’ namar ba phi don tang uwei u Kpa ha bneng .
translation.en: And call no man your father upon the earth : for one is your Father , which is in heaven .

translation.kha: Kata ka pateng bynthiew baroh ka la ïap , bad ka pateng bynriew kaba bud ka la klet ïa U Trai’ bad ïa kaei kaba u la leh na ka bynta ki Israel .
translation.en: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers : and there arose another generation after them , which knew not the  Lord  , nor yet the works which he had done for Israel .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la bato ïa ki briew jong u ; u la sngewkynjah ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore was the wrath of the  Lord  kindled against his people , insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance .

translation.kha: U la ai ha u ïa ka kali syiem kaba ar ba un shong ; bad ki nongap ïa ka ïongjngum ki ïadoh ha khamtam jong u pynlang ki pyrta , Kynriah ! kynriah ! Bad kumno la thung lat ïa u Joseph halor ka ri Ijipt barabor .
translation.en: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had  ; and they cried before him , Bow the knee : and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt .
This was the Lord s doing , and it is marvellous in our eyes ?
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaba la leh da U Trai ; A haduh katno ka long kaei kaei kaba iphylla !’

Ki khi pajut ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa la ka por ha kabu kyntang na kawei ka ïing sha katai pang ; Hynrei kaba khamtam sngur , ki nang ban ïa-lorni malade pynsyrwa ei ïa ka por , da kaba ki kren ïa kiei kiei naba kim dei ban krai .
translation.en: And withal they learn to be idle , wandering about from house to house ; and not only idle , but tattlers also and busybodies , speaking things which they ought not .
He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab : for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly .
translation.kha: U Ahasaïah u la long syiem haba u la don arphew ar snem ka rta , bad u la synshar shisnem ha Jerusalem . U Ahasaïah ruh u la bud ïa ka jingleh jong ka longïing jong u Syiem Ahab , naduh ba ka Athalaïah , ka kmie jong u — ka khun jong u syiem Ahab bad ka ksiew jong u Omri , u syiem ka Israel — ka la ai jingmut ïa u , kaba la ïalam sha ka jingsniew .

Nangta u Moses u la ong , Dei U Trai u ban ai ïa phi ka doh ban bam ha ka por janmiet bad kyrhai u kpu ha ka por mynstep , ñiar ba u la ïohsngew haduh katno phi la ïakhñium marpyrshah ïa u . Haba phi khñium pyrshah ïa moi , phi ïakhñium shisha keiñ pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And Moses said , This shall be , when the  Lord  shall give you in the evening flesh to eat , and in the morning bread to the full  ; for that the  Lord  heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him : and what are we ? your murmurings are not against us , but against the  Lord .
This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing : He shall be brought unto the priest :
translation.kha: ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid ïa u briew uba la koit na ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh . Ha kata ka sngi ha kaba yn pynkhuid ïa u , yn wallam ïa u ha khmat u lyngdoh ,
U Jehoïakim u la don arphew san snem ka rta manbha u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar khatwei snieh ha Jerusalem . U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai U Blei jong u .
translation.en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem : and he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  his God .

translation.kha: Ki la pyndap shoiñ ïa ki , bad nangta u la noh ha ki , Mynmiet to tong khyndiat ka um sad ithuh rah ïa ka sha u nongpynïaid jong ka jingkhawai .
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Draw out now , and bear unto the governor of the feast .  And they bare it .

translation.kha: Hadien katei katne por , kata ka wahduid ka rngad noh namar ba ym shym la don slap .
translation.en: And it came to pass after a while , that the brook dried up , because there had been no rain in the land .

translation.kha: U Solomon u pynkyntang ïa ka khang pdeng jong ka phlait , ka iaki kaba ha khmat ka thalab , bad u ai ki jingkñia hangthie ba la thang tylli , ki jingainguh bam , bad ïa ka kheiñ na ki jingainguh ïasyllok . U leh ïa kane namar ba ka duwan rnong ba u la thaw ka rit than ïa kine ki jingkohnguh baroh .
translation.en: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of the  Lord  : for there he offered burnt offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings , because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings , and the meat offerings , and the fat .

translation.kha: Ka jingbam jong nga , U Jisu u la nong ha ki , ka long ban kohnguh ïa ka mon jong uta uba la phar ïa nga malade ban pyndep ïa ka kada kob u la ai ha to ban leh .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto them ,  My meat is to do the will of him that sent me , and to finish his work .

translation.kha: Uno uno suba dang lait im na ka jingshah pynïap ha u Hasael , un shah pynïap ha u Jehu , bad une uno uba lieh im na ka jingshah pyndap ha u Jehu un shah pynnep ha u Elisha .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay : and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay .
Which was the son of Jose , which was the son of Eliezer , which was the son of Jorim , which was the son of Matthat , which was the son of Levi ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Joshua , u khun jong u Elieser , u khun jong u Jorim , u khun jong u Matthat , u khun jong u Lebi ,
U TRAI’ un pynlong ïa pha ban kai tlot , bad yn ym don baburom ïa pha .
translation.en: For , lo , I will make thee small among the heathen , and despised among men .

translation.kha: Ynda u Dabid u la wan phai shai Sikhri , u phah ai bynta na kata ka mar lute sha ki paralok jong u , ki nongïalam ka Judah , malade ka khubor , Kainan ka jingai sngewbha ïa phira na ka jinglute ba ngi la rim na ki nongshun U tharai .
translation.en: And when David came to Ziklag , he sent of the spoil unto the elders of Judah , even to his friends , saying , Behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of the  Lord   ;

translation.kha: bad ka Leah ka ong , Katno de Long kaba khem ! Mynta ki kyntiew keiñ khop ïa nga kaba Kmen ; kumta ka la Khot kyrteng ïa u , u Ashan .
translation.en: And Leah said , Happy am I , for the daughters will call me blessed : and she called his name Asher .

translation.kha: bad ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u Ong ïa ki : Ma phi ki kynther pa’ long kiba la tim ! Phi suh ki jingteh ki myntor na ka bniat uwei uwei barieh bad phi shrong ki jaiñ teh khlieh myntor na ka bynta uwei uwei ban phong ha ki khlieh jongu ki , khnang ba ki lah ban to ka bor halor ka jingim jong kiwei patar ki biria . phi khah ban don ka har jong ka jingim bad jingïap halor ki brup jong nga bad ban pyndonkam ïa ka na ka bynta ka jingpynkoit ïa lade hi .
translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes , and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls ! Will ye hunt the souls of my people , and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you ?

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Asaph u hukum ïa uwei na ki rangbah pynkdor jong u , khem ïa u Mikah bad ïalam ïa u sha u Amon , u lat jong kane ka nongbah , bad sha u Jashar u khun syiad .
translation.en: And the king of Israel said , Take Micaiah , and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city , and to Joash the king s son  ;

translation.kha: U la ong ha ki , Nga pynthikna ba phin soi ïa kane ka proberb ha nga , ‘ Ko nongpynkhiah , to pynkhiah ïa lade .’ Phin noh duh ïa nga ban leh hangne ha la ka sheng ïa kijuh khie Kiei kiba phi la ïohsngew ïa kiba la imat ha Kapernam .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Ye will surely say unto me this proverb , Physician , heal thyself : whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum , do also here in thy country .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u phai ktien , Haba nga leit sha ki Israel mala ngan nong ha ki , ‘ U Balei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi u la phah ïa nga sha phi ,’ kin sa kylli ïa nga , ‘ Kaei ka kyrteng jong u ?’ Ngan ong kumin ïa ki ?
translation.en: And Moses said unto God , Behold , when I come unto the children of Israel , and shall say unto them , The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you  ; and they shall say to me , What is his name ? what shall I say unto them ?

translation.kha: Ma nga , u Sennakherib , u Patsha ka Assyria , nga kylli uei uba ai ha phi ba phin don ïa ka jingsngewskhem katba ka Jerusalem ka dang don ha ka jingshah kerkut .
Eliada u briew u weng ïa ka jingtap na ka thliew , ne lada u tih thliew bad um tap ïa ka , bad u masi ne u kada u hap hangta ,
translation.en: And if a man shall open a pit , or if a man shall dig a pit , and not cover it , and an ox or an ass fall therein  ;

translation.kha: Shaphang ka jaiñjot Gad u ong , Ïaroh ïa U Blei uba pynïar ïa ka ri jong ki . U Gad u ap ktem kamon u sing ban patar ïa ka kti ne ïa ka snieh khlieh .
translation.en: And of Gad he said , Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad : he dwelleth as a lion , and teareth the arm with the crown of the head .

translation.kha: Ha khah ka lap ki shynrang , ki la mihnoh ïa ka jingshongkurim bad ki kynthei kat kum ba dadien ka rukom bad ki la ïa ing da ka jingkwah brai para ma ki hi . translation.en: And likewise also the men , leaving the natural use of the woman , burned in their lust one toward another ; men with men working that which is unseemly , and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet .
And he said , Call her . And when he had called her , she stood in the door .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ka ban wan hangne ,  u Elisha u hukum . Ka la wan bad ïeng ha ka jingkhang ,

translation.en: Circumcision is nothing , and uncircumcision is nothing , but the keeping of the commandments of God .
translation.kha: Naba kaba otsher ne kaba khlem otsher ïa u briew kam don jingmut ei ei ; kaei kaba donkam ka long ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Blei .

translation.en: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son , and of thy son s son , what things I have wrought in Egypt , and my signs which I have done among them  ; that ye may know how that I am the  Lord .

translation.en: Which was with the deputy of the country , Sergius Paulus , a prudent man  ; who called for Barnabas and Saul , and desired to hear the word of God .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u Israel u pynïap ïa u masi lane u langbrot lane  langsohmoh kum ka jingainguh ïa U  Trai  hangno hangno lait noh ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  u la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum . translation.en: And they said , There must be an inheritance for them that be escaped of Benjamin , that a tribe be not destroyed out of Israel .
They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods , with abominations provoked they him to anger .
translation.kha: Ka jingmane bleithaw jong ki ka pynlong ïa U  Trai  ban ym lah shah , ki kam bymman jong ki , ki la pynlong ïa u ban bitar .

translation.en: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night , and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both man and beast  ; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment : I am the  Lord .

Kam sheptieng , u la ong . Nga tip ba phi ïawad ïa U Jisu ibha na Nasareth , ïa uba la sahnarphna . Um don hangne — u la mihkhmat ! Ha khmih , hangne ka dik ha kaba ki la buh ïa u .
translation.en: And he saith unto them , Be not affrighted : Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth , which was crucified : he is risen  ; he is not here : behold the place where they laid him .

These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites , all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation , which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Ki shynrang baroh na ka jait Lebi kiba la dap shi bnai bad kham heh ïa kiba u Moses bad u Aaron ki la ñiew shi kur shi kur da ka hukum U  Trai  ki long arphew ar hajar ngut .
u Jakob bad u para jong u , u Ïoannis , ki khun jong u Sebedi ( U Jisu u la ai kyrteng ïa ki , Boas , kaba mut ki U u Pyrthat ) ;
translation.en: And James the son of Zebedee , and John the brother of James  ; and he surnamed them Boanerges , which is , The sons of thunder :

translation.kha: Ki shakor ksiar ba u Gideon u ïohpdiang ki khia la jan arphew kilo , malu kane kam shym kynthup ïa ki jingdeng , ki kpieng bad ki jaiñ sawbthuh ba ki syiem Midian ki kup , lymne ki jingdeng kiba don sdang ki ryndang jong ki ut jongngi ki .
translation.en: And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold  ; beside ornaments , and collars , and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian , and beside the chains that were about their camels  necks .

translation.kha: Nangta u la wiang phai pat sha ki Simran bad u la ong , Phi dang ïohbat malu pynjahthait ? Ha khmih ! Ka para ka poi ïa U Khun U briew ba yn ai noh ha ka bor ki briew kiba bapop .
translation.en: Then cometh he to his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Sleep on now , and take your rest : behold , the hour is at hand , and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki lyngdoh ! To pynslem jingmut , phi ki paid Israel ! To khashor , phi kiba na ka un-long u syiem ! La kham lynti ïa phi ban baher da ka hok — Kumta ka jingbishar Kan wanpaw hapdeng ha ph ! Phi la long ka jingriam ha Mispah , ka jar ba la pynap ha u lum Tabor ,
translation.en: Hear ye this , O priests  ; and hearken , ye house of Israel  ; and give ye ear , O house of the king  ; for judgment is toward you , because ye have been a snare on Mizpah , and a net spread upon Tabor .

translation.kha: ha-ei ken kata ka jingkyiuh ka ba phi la ong ? Nga hi nga lah Ban ong ba Phon da la khlieh noh ïa la ki jong ki khmat , lada phi lah , bad ban ai noh ïa ki ha nga .
translation.en: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of ? for I bear you record , that , if it had been possible , ye would have plucked out your own eyes , and have given them to me .

translation.kha: Ko ki khun ba-ieit jong nga ! Sa shisien , khim ka kmie kaba basah kha , nga sngew ïa kajuh ka jait jingsuh na ka bynta jong phi tad haduh ka jinglong U Khrist kan da thawdur ha phira .
translation.en: My little children , of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you ,

translation.kha: Kham hadien , u jaboh mala ki kawei pah ki rangbah synshar jyllang u Dabid ki la wan phai na kaba leit lute , ki da wanrah shikatdei ka mar lute bad ki . hynñiew u Abner um don sha bad u Nadab hangta ha Hebron , namar u Dabid u la lah phah noh ïa u lam bad ka jingkular jingshngain .
translation.en: And , behold , the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop , and brought in a great spoil with them : but Abner was not with David in Hebron  ; for he had sent him away , and he was gone in peace .
Namely , five lords of the Philistines , and all the Canaanites , and the Sidonians , and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon , from mount Baal–hermon unto the entering in of Hamath .
translation.kha: Kito kiba dang sah ha kata ka ri ki long ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia , ki Kanaan baroh , ki Sidon , bad ki Hib kiba shong ha ki Lum Lebanon naduh u Lum Baal Hermon haduh ka Khim Hamath .
Shahshkor ïa kaei ba la hikai ïa phi , long uba stad ; wat kyndit ïa ka .
translation.en: Hear instruction , and be wise , and refuse it not .

translation.kha: Wat kjat ïa ka jutang U Blei , kaba u la pynlong ba-bang neh junom ,
translation.en: Be ye mindful always of his covenant  ; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations  ;

On this side Jordan , in the valley over against Beth–peor , in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites , who dwelt at Heshbon , whom Moses and the children of Israel smote , after they were come forth out of Egypt :
translation.kha: Dei hadien ba ki la wan mih na Ijipt bad mynba ki don ha kata ka them kaba sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan , marpyrshah ïa ka shnong Bethpeor , ba u ai ha ki ïa kine ki hukum . Kane ka long ha ka hima u Sihon u syiem Amor , uba synshar ha ka shnong Heshbon . Mynba U Moses bad ki Israel ki la jop ïa u ynda ki la mih na Ijipt .

Ym don myn mano ba wan shuh ka Templ mynta ban mane ha ki sngi bakhuid . Ki kynthei samla kiba rwai hangta ki shahshitom , bad ki lyngdoh ki lah tang ban Shuh ud . Ki khyrdop ka nongbah ki ïeng thylli , bad ka Seïon ka don ha ka jingkordit .
translation.en: He hath bent his bow like an enemy : he stood with his right hand as an adversary , and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion : he poured out his fury like fire .

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi , ki la duwai na ka pyntha ki riewngeit ba kin pdiang ïa U Mynmiet Bakhuid .
translation.en: Who , when they were come down , prayed for them , that they might receive the Holy Ghost :
And this know , that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come , he would have watched , and not have suffered his house to be broken through .
translation.kha: Bad phi lah ban sngewthikna ba lada u trai ïing u la tip ïa ka por haba u nongtuh un wan , un ym shah ïa u nongtuh ban prong shapoh ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: And he shall judge among the nations , and shall rebuke many people : and they shall beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruninghooks : nation shall not lift up sword against nation , neither shall they learn war any more .
translation.kha: Un bishar ïa ki jingkajia hapdeng ki jaitbynriew . Kin tied tyrnem ïa ki waitlam jong ki sha ki jinglur lyngkha bad ïa ki sum jong ki sha ki waitbnoh khyllad tnat . Ki jaitbynriew kin ym ïaleh thma shuh , kin ym pynkhreh thma shuh .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam , and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel , and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam , as a man taketh away dung , till it be all gone .
translation.kha: Namar kane , ngan pynhap ïa ka jingjynjar ha ka longïing syiem jong me bad ngan pynïap ïa ki khun ki ksiew shynrang baroh , ïa u samla bad u tymmen kumjuh . Ngan pynduh khoit ïa ka longïing jong me ; kumba sar lut ïa ka jakhlia .

translation.en: And their father gave them great gifts of silver , and of gold , and of precious things , with fenced cities in Judah : but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram  ; because he was the firstborn .
translation.kha: U kpa jong ki u la ai ha ki shibun ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad kiwei kiwei ki markordor , bad u la buh ïa uwei pa uwei na ki ban peit ïa kawei kawei ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh jong ka Judah ; hynrei namar u Jehoram u dei uba nyngkong eh , u Jehoshaphat u la pynlong ïa u , u nongmih bujli jong u .
Hynrei U Jisu u la phai , u la khmih ïa ki synrai jong u , bad u la sneng ïa u Petros . Kheiñ noh na nga , me u Soitan , u la ong . Ki jingpyrkhat jong me kim shym wan na U Blei Hynrei na u briew !
translation.en: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples , he rebuked Peter , saying ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : for thou savourest not the things that be of God , but the things that be of men .

translation.kha: Ki da kwah ban pynlong mradkhlaw ïa ngi , hynmen khnang ban pynneh ïa ka jingshisha ka Gospel na ka bynta jong phi , ngim shym la ailad ïa ki wat tang shi minit ruh .
translation.en: To whom we gave place by subjection , no , not for an hour ; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
And six years thou shalt sow thy land , and shalt gather in the fruits thereof :
translation.kha: Ha ki hynriew snem to thung to tep ha la ka lyngkha , bad lumlang ïa ki jingmih jong ka .

translation.en: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove , and would have set them at one again , saying , Sirs , ye are brethren  ; why do ye wrong one to another ?

translation.en: That then the  Lord  thy God will turn thy captivity , and have compassion upon thee , and will return and gather thee from all the nations , whither the  Lord  thy God hath scattered thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un leh-isynei ïa phi . Un wan ïalam pat ïa phi napdeng kita ki jaitbynriew sha kiba u la pynsakma ïa phi , bad un pynbha pat ïa phi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Behold , I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee : begin to possess , that thou mayest inherit his land .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Khmih shane , nga la aiti ïa u syiem Sihon bad ïa ka ri jong u ha phi ; knieh ïa ka ri jong u bad kam kynti ïa ka .’
Ha kaweh kut jong ki lai snem kiba la buh da u syiem , u Ashpenas u la ïalam ïa baroh ki sumar shynrang sha u Nebukhadnessar .
translation.en: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in , then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar .

translation.kha: ba ngan thaw pynban ïa ka waitlam kaba ïalang jong to , bad ai ïa ka jingbit bahok , ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki nongshun jong at bad pynbudnam ïa kito kiba isih ïa nga .
translation.en: If I whet my glittering sword , and mine hand take hold on judgment  ; I will render vengeance to mine enemies , and will reward them that hate me .

translation.kha: Kum u khlieh jrong ka ïing u dei ban long u banyngkong ha ka ban ïarap ban hikai ïa ki shaphang U Blei bad ki jingthmu jong U .
translation.en: He takes the lead in helping his family to learn about God and His purposes .
And he said to Gehazi his servant , Call this Shunammite . And when he had called her , she stood before him .
