Hynrei lada kata ka prum ka erlangthari kaba lieh , bad kam shym lip ba ka kham jylla ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jongnga ka , bad u sngewnguh ha kata ka prum ruh um pat mluh , u lyngkdong un pynkyrpang ïa uta u briew hynñiewphew sngi .
translation.en: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh , and in sight be not deeper than the skin , and the hair thereof be not turned white  ; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days :

translation.kha: Naba ka bor jong ki kulai ka don ha ki shyntur jong ki bun ruh ha ki tdong lad ki . Ki thiang jong ki , ki long kum ki bseiñ ba don ki khlieh , bad ki pyndonkam ïa ki ban pynmynsaw ïa ki briew .
translation.en: For their power is in their mouth , and in their tails : for their tails were like unto serpents , and had heads , and with them they do hurt .

translation.kha: Kumta , hadien ba ngi la sah slem ha kadei ,
translation.en: So ye abode in Kadesh many days , according unto the days that ye abode there .

translation.kha: Khie leit sha ka nongrit kaba hangtai ha khmat jong phi , bad shisyndon phin shem ïa ka kada kaba la te lakam bad u khun kada hajan jong ka . Loit noh ïa ki bad wallam ïa ki shwa nga .
translation.en: Saying unto them ,  Go into the village over against you , and straightway ye shall find an ass tied , and a colt with her : loose them , and bring them unto me .

translation.kha: U Trai u long u nongïada jong nga , u long ka kut baskhem jong nga .
translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  is my rock , and my fortress , and my deliverer  ;
And these signs shall follow them that believe  ; In my name shall they cast out devils  ; they shall speak with new tongues  ;
translation.kha: Ïa kiba ngeit yn ai ka bor ban leh ïa ki kambah : Kin beh noh ïa ki ksuid ha ka kyrteng jong nga ; kin kren ha ki thylliej kiba pher ;

translation.en: At that time Merodach–baladan , the son of Baladan , king of Babylon , sent letters and a present to Hezekiah : for he had heard that he had been sick , and was recovered .
translation.kha: Hamar kaba kum kane ka por , u syiem ka Babilonia , u Merodakh Baladan , u khun jong u Baladan , u la ïohsngew ba u syiem Hesekaïah u pang , kumta u la phah sha u ïa ka shithi bad ka jingai sngewbha .

translation.en: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains , and to the beasts of the earth : and the fowls shall summer upon them , and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them .
translation.kha: Ïa ki metïap jong ki shipai jong ki yn iehnoh ha ki sim bad ki mradkhlaw . Ha ka lyiur ki sim kin bam ïa ki , bad ha ka tlang ki mrad .

translation.en: For the  Lord  will pass through to smite the Egyptians  ; and when he seeth the blood upon the lintel , and on the two side posts , the  Lord  will pass over the door , and will not suffer the destroyer to come in unto your houses to smite you .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Ijipt ban pynïap ïa ki nong Ijipt , un ïohi ïa ka snam ha u bim bad ha ki shawkad bad un ym shah ïa u Angel jong ka Jingïap ban rung shapoh ki ïing jong phi bad pynïap ïa phi .

U wallam sha Jerusalem ïa ki lyngdoh kiba ju don ha ki nongbah ka Jedaïah , bad ha kylleng jong ka ri u la ñiewsang ïa ki duwan ha kiba ki ju ai jingkñia . U la pynthiah ruh ïa ki jingnguh ba la pynkyntang sha ki ksuid-durblang hajan ka khyrdop ba la tei da u Joshua , u lat ka nongbah , kiba don shaw kadiang jong ka khyrdop bah kaba ki ju sping sha ka nongbeh .
translation.en: And he brought all the priests out of the cities of Judah , and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense , from Geba to Beer–sheba , and brake down the high places of the gates that were in the entering in of the gate of Joshua the governor of the city , which were on a man s left hand at the gate of the city .

translation.kha: Ong ha u Aaron , ym mala ïa uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong me pateng la pateng umbah don jingda ha ka met ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam sha sa .
translation.en: Speak unto Aaron , saying , Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish , let him not approach to offer the bread of his God .

translation.kha: Kumba ka jingkynthoh Bakhuid ka ong , uto umbah la Lum shibun um Shimham la don tam keiñ , badno uta uba la lum khyndiat um shym ïoh duna palat .
translation.en: As it is written , He that had gathered much had nothing over ; and he that had gathered little had no lack .

translation.kha: Lymda phi wan phai khlem shah pynïap , u Mikaïah u pyrta , te U Tlai um shym la kren liengbah jngai de ! Bad u ong shuh , Sngap ïa nga phi Baroh , ïa Kiei kaba nga la nguh !
translation.en: And Micaiah said , If thou certainly return in peace , then hath not the  Lord  spoken by me . And he said , Hearken , all ye people .

translation.kha: Haoid , u balui un sa khot ia ka niam ba bakla ban ai jingkhein halor ki nang niewbein kiba ka la leh ha ka kyrteng lad u .
translation.en: Yes , God will call false religion to account for all the despicable acts she has committed in his name .

translation.kha: Kumta ki paidbah baroh ki ïalaw noh ïa la ki sohshnong ksiar bad ki wallam ïa ki ha u Amon .
translation.en: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears , and brought them unto Aaron .

translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki kynriah noh na Uto u paidlang bad ki la ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ . Ki dem khrup ha khyndew , bad ka jingiaseng kaba tyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai ka la paw ha ki .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and they fell upon their faces : and the glory of the  Lord  appeared unto them .
He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not : and doeth not good to the widow .
translation.kha: Kata ka jia namar u la lehbeiñ ïa ki riewkynthei bad um ju pyn-i jingsbun ïa ki kynthei ki bym don khun .

translation.en: And they took him , and cast him into a pit : and the pit was empty , there was no water in it .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la shim ïa u bad bret ïa u sha ka pukri , kaba la tyrkhong .

translation.en: He made many to fall , yea , one fell upon another : and they said , Arise , and let us go again to our own people , and to the land of our nativity , from the oppressing sword .
translation.kha: Ki shipai jong phi ki jynthut bad ki kyllon ; uwei u ong ïa uwei pat , ‘ Pynkloi ! Ïa ngin ïaleit sha ïing sha ki briew jong ngi bad ban ïohlait im na ka waitlam u nongshun !’
Naba lada la buhrieh ïa ka gospel kaba ngi ïalap , la buhrieh ïa ka tang na Kito kiba la jah noh .
translation.en: But if our gospel be hid , it is hid to them that are lost :
Whom should I contact ?
translation.kha: Haei nga hap ban pyntip ?

Hynrei uwei na ki Rangbah u jong ha u , Ngi baroh ngi la tlot na ka jingïapthngan , hynrei i pa jong phiah i la byrngem ïa sem nabar Ong , ‘ Ka jingtim kan long ha uno Une uba bam ei ei mynta ka sngi .’
translation.en: Then answered one of the people , and said , Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath , saying , Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day . And the people were faint .
He saith unto them ,  But whom say ye that I am ?
translation.kha: Kumno ma phi pat ?  U la kylli ïa ki .  Phi ong nga long uei ?
Kumta u Moses u la kren ha ki paid Ishmael ïa kaei kaei baroh’ ba U Trai u la hukum ïa u .
translation.en: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Baroh ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren sanphew jong u , da kaba ong ba uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ïoh ka jingmap ïa ki pop lyngba ka bor jong ka kyrteng jong u .
translation.en: To him give all the prophets witness , that through his name whosoever believeth in him shall receive remission of sins .

translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ïa ken nabar kin sngewkhuslai ki hapdeng ka jingkhlaiñ jongngi ki baroh . Ha ka jinglyngngoh kin suit ïa la ki shyntur bad tap ïa la ki shkor .
translation.en: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might : they shall lay their hand upon their mouth , their ears shall be deaf .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba bieit ban sngewtynnat haba leh bymdei . Ki briew kiba stad ki sngewbha ha ka jingsdang .
translation.en: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief : but a man of understanding hath wisdom .
Howbeit in vain do they worship me , teaching for doctrines the commandments of men .
translation.kha: Ka long ka bymmyntoi ïa ki ban mane ïa nga , namar ki hikai ïa ki aiñ ba la thaw da ki briew kumba ki dei ki aiñ U Blei !’
Ko Tiras , shano Leit leit ? u Paul u la kylli ïa u . Mem lah ban bud ïa nga mynta shano shai ba ngan sa leit , U Jisu u la jaboh ; isynei hadien men sa bud ïa nga .
translation.en: Simon Peter said unto him , Lord , whither goest thou ? Jesus answered him ,  Whither I go , thou canst not follow me now  ; but thou shalt follow me afterwards .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka long tong kob shu jai ryngkhat , bad um shym da mut shisha ban pynïap ïa u , u lah don phet sha ka jaka kaba ngan jied na ka bniat jong phi , mala Hangne un shngain .
translation.en: And if a man lie not in wait , but God deliver him into his hand  ; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee .

translation.kha: U Isaak u la tei ka duwan hangta nabar mane ïa U Trai . Nangta u sher ïa la ka dara hangto , bad ki shakri jong u ki ïatih sa kamai pat ka pukri .
translation.en: And he builded an altar there , and called upon the name of the  Lord  , and pitched his tent there : and there Isaac s servants digged a well .

translation.kha: Ngan synreit ïa phi da ka um khuid , bad ngan pynkhuid ïa phi na ki bleithaw jong phi bad na baroh kiei kiei kiba la pynkyrteng ïa phi .
translation.en: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you , and ye shall be clean : from all your filthiness , and from all your idols , will I cleanse you .

translation.kha: Don ki briew uba ki pop jong ki , ki long kiba pait tyngkreiñ , bad ki pop jong ki , ki leit ha suk jong ki sha ka jingbishar ; hynrei ki pop jong kiwei pat ki paw kham hateng .
translation.en: Some men s sins are open beforehand , going before to judgment ; and some men they follow after .

translation.kha: Ban ïoh ïa ka jingtip , nyngkong phi dei ban don ka jingtiengburom ïa U Trai . Ki briew kiba mutlop kim don ka jingïaroh ïa ka jingstad bad ki kyntait ban shahïap hikai .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of knowledge : but fools despise wisdom and instruction .
But she is happier if she so abide , after my judgment : and I think also that I have the Spirit of God .
translation.kha: Kan kham suk pynban , lada ka shong marwei . Kata ka long ka jingai jingmut jong nga bad nga pyrkhat ba ïa nga ruh la ïalam da U Mynsiem U Blei .
bad baroh ki nongbah badno ki nongrit kiba hasem ka Ashdod , naduh Ekron haduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian .
translation.en: From Ekron even unto the sea , all that lay near Ashdod , with their villages :
Let thy fountain be blessed : and rejoice with the wife of thy youth .
translation.kha: Kumta shongsuk bad ka tnga jong phi bad shem ïa ka jingkmen bad ka kynthei kaba phi shongkurim —

U Trai u la kyrkhu kyrhai ïa u kyndiang jong nga sad u la pynlong ïa u , u briew uba hynriewspah . U la ai ha u ki kynhun langbrot bad blang , ki masi , ka rupa , ka ksiang , ki mraw shynrang bad kynthei , ki ut bad ki kali .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath blessed my master greatly  ; and he is become great : and he hath given him flocks , and herds , and silver , and gold , and menservants , and maidservants , and camels , and asses .

Because they have forsaken me , and have estranged this place , and have burned incense in it unto other gods , whom neither they nor their fathers have known , nor the kings of Judah , and have filled this place with the blood of innocents  ;
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kane namar ki briew ki la iehnoh ïa nga bad ki la pyntngit ïa kane ka jaka da kaba ai jingkñia hangne sha kiwei pat ki blei — ki blei kiba ym ma ki lymne ki kpa tymmen jong ki lymne ki syiem jong ka Judah ki la tip ei ei . Ki la pyndap ïa kane ka jaka da ka snam jong ki briew kiba lui lui ,
Ka sahkut bneng ka la jah noh kum ka kot klun ba la kli , bad ïa ki lum bad ki dewlynnong baroh’ la pynkynriah na ka jaka ba ki don .
translation.en: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together  ; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places .

translation.kha: bad ban ap ïa U Khun jong u ban wan na bneng — U Jisu , U Khun lad u , ïa umbiah u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap bad uba pyllait im ïa me na ka jingbat jong U Blei ka ban sa ïan .
translation.en: And to wait for his Son from heaven , whom he raised from the dead , even Jesus , which delivered us from the wrath to come .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ki Ong ba ngin leit sha ki , te ngin loit , namar kata kun long ka dak ba U Trai u la ai ha sem ka jingjop halor jong ki .
translation.en: But if they say thus , Come up unto us  ; then we will go up : for the  Lord  hath delivered them into our hand : and this shall be a sign unto us .

translation.kha: Ka rah ïa ka ïing bad pynap ïa ki baroh . Tang ma nga babha la lait im ban wei ïathaw ïa phi .
translation.en: And , behold , there came a great wind from the wilderness , and smote the four corners of the house , and it fell upon the young men , and they are dead  ; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee .

translation.kha: La hikai ïa u ha ka Lynti jong U Tlai , bad da ka jingshitrhem bakhraw u la Pynbna bad hikai khlem bakla ïa ki jinglah shaphang U Jisu . Pynkup u la tip thrang ïa ka jingpynshohbieit jong u Ïoannis .
translation.en: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord  ; and being fervent in the spirit , he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord , knowing only the baptism of John .
Afterward shall the children of Israel return , and seek the  Lord  their God , and David their king  ; and shall fear the  Lord  and his goodness in the latter days .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka por kan poi haba ki paid Israel sa shisien pat kin phai sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ; bad sha uba hiarpateng na u Dabid u syiem jong ki . Nangta kin sheptieng ïa U  Trai  bad kin sa ïohpdiang ïa ki jingai babha ki jong u .

translation.en: The same came for a witness , to bear witness of the Light , that all men through him might believe .
translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa u nonglamktien jong u , u briew uba kyrteng u Ïoannis , uba la wan ban ïathuh ïa ki briew shaphang ka jingshai , ba baroh ki dei ban shahshkor ïa ka khubor bad ban ngeit .

U Jeshua u la khot ïa ki khriat ngut ki synran jong u bad u la ai ha ki ka iitkhmat ban beh noh ïa ki mynsiem bymman bad ban pynkdiah ïa kawei pa Kawei ka Jingpang bad ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingshitom .
translation.en: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples , he gave them power against unclean spirits , to cast them out , and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease .

translation.kha: Mynta , lada ne mano mano ba la pynsngewsih ïabna ïaineh , um shym la leh ïa katai ha nga hynrei ha phi baroh — la kumno kumno shi bynta . (Nga ong ïa kane namar ngam kwah ban da sa tyngeh halor jong u .)
translation.en: But if any have caused grief , he hath not grieved me , but in part : that I may not overcharge you all .

translation.kha: Baroh kaei kiei kiba u Sekharaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Zachariah , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
For whosoever will save his life shall lose it : and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba kwah ban pyllait la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; hynrei uno uno uba duh noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un shem ïa ka .

translation.en: Remember me , O  Lord  , with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people : O visit me with thy salvation  ;
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa nga , A  Trai  , haba me ïarap ïa ki briew jong me ; kynthup ïa nga ruh haba me pynim ïa ki .
Ki rangbah ka Tekoa ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , hynmen ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ka shnong ki kyntait ban leh ïa ki Kam trei kti ba la aiti ha ki da ki nongpynïaidkam .
translation.en: And next unto them the Tekoites repaired  ; but their nobles put not their necks to the work of their Lord .

translation.kha: Nga jubab , Ngam dei u bri uba shait phet bad riewhok . Hato phi pyrkhat ba nur-um Pyrshang ban pynim ïa la ka jingim da kaba rieh ha ka Templ ? Ngan ym leh kumta .
translation.en: And I said , Should such a man as I flee ? and who is there , that , being as I am , would go into the temple to save his life ? I will not go in .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom un pynbud ïa ka rukom lehkmen ban pynkhlad ïa ka Jaka Kabbon Khuid Tam namar ka jingbymkhuid jong ki Eliel bad namar ki pum jrong ki baroh . U dei ban lai kumne ha ka Ïingjaiñ namar ka ïeng hapdeng ka jaka shong dara , ïa kaba la ñiew ba ka long ka jingbymkhuid .
translation.en: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place , because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel , and because of their transgressions in all their sins : and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation , that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness .

translation.kha: Ki don ki shyntur , hynrei kim lah banbeiñ kren , bad ki Khmut , hynrei kim lah ban ïohi .
translation.en: They have mouths , but they speak not  ; eyes have they , but they see not  ;

translation.kha: Nangta u Jethro u la wanrah ïa ka jingiaseng ban thang thlia bad ïa kiwei kiwei de ki jingainguh ban ai jingkñia sha U Blei ; bad u Aaron lem bad nongïalam jong ki Israel baroh ki la ïaleh bad u ban bam ïa ka jingbam ka kyntang kumto ka dak ka jingmane ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And Jethro , Moses  father in law , took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God : and Aaron came , and all the elders of Israel , to eat bread with Moses  father in law before God .

translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u ong ha u Abiathar u lyngdoh , Khie leit sha la ka jong ka ri ha Anathoth . Me dei hok ban ïap , hynrei nur-um ym phah pynïap ïa me mynta , namar ba me la khmih sumar ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Trai mynba me dang ba-don bad u Dabid , u kpa jong nga , bad me la ïoh bynta lem ha ki jingjynjar jong u baroh .
translation.en: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king , Get thee to Anathoth , unto thine own fields  ; for thou art worthy of death : but I will not at this time put thee to death , because thou barest the ark of the Lord  God  before David my father , and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted .

translation.kha: U Saul u lumlang ïa ki kynhun shipai jong u bun u peit bniah ïa ki ha Telem : la ne ar lakh ngut ki shipai na Israel bad shiphew hajar ngut na Judah .
translation.en: And Saul gathered the people together , and numbered them in Telaim , two hundred thousand footmen , and ten thousand men of Judah .

translation.kha: To ai ba U Blei un thew ïa sa ha ki tarajur bahok , bad un ïohi katno umbiah lui lui nga long .
translation.en: Let me be weighed in an even balance , that God may know mine integrity .

translation.kha: Wat ka pyiar kiba ïap kam lah ban buhrieh na U Trai’ ba un ym tip kiei kaba don hangta ; kumno te ngi lah banbeiñ buhrieh ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ngi na U Blei! ?
translation.en: Hell and destruction are before the  Lord  : how much more then the hearts of the children of men ?

translation.kha: Ngim kwah ïano ïano ban wad daw ïa ka jingtrei jongu ngi , kumta ngi pyrshang ban ym pahuh ïa ki jingjynthut ha ka lynñiar jongno Jong .
translation.en: Giving no offence in any thing , that the ministry be not blamed :

translation.kha: ka Kain , ka Gibeah , bad ka Ithnan : shiphew tylli ki nongbet lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: Cain , Gibeah , and Timnah  ; ten cities with their villages :

And he said unto them , Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company , or come unto one of another nation  ; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean .
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Phi hi phi tip bha ba la khang ïa u Jiw da ka niam jong u ban leit jngoh lane ïajan bad ki Jentil . Hynrei U Blei u la pyn-i ha nga ba ngam dei ban ñiew bymkhuid ne basang kat kum ka jinglehniam ïa uno uno u briew .
Kumta u Ïoannis u la wan sha ka ri shyiap , da kaba pynbaptis bad ïalap . To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad to shah pynbaptis , u la ainong ïa ki briew , bad U Blang un map noh ïa ki pop jong phi .
translation.en: John did baptize in the wilderness , and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins .

translation.kha: ?(Nga la pynlong ïa u , kaba itynnat , da ka jingpyiar ki tnat . U la long ka jingpihuiñ jong ki dieng baroh ha Eden , ka kper U Blei’ .
translation.en: I have made him fair by the multitude of his branches : so that all the trees of Eden , that were in the garden of God , envied him .
And he said unto them ,  Behold , when ye are entered into the city , there shall a man meet you , bearing a pitcher of water  ; follow him into the house where he entereth in .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  Katba phi dang leit shapoh ka nongbah , u briew uba kit shi khra ka um un ïashem ïa phi . Bud ïa u shapoh ka ïing ba u rung , bad ong ha u trai jong ka ïing :
ka Lebaoth , ka Shilhim , ka Ain bad ka Rimmon : baroh lang ki long arphew khyndai tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit kiba don sawdong jongno ki .
translation.en: And Lebaoth , and Shilhim , and Ain , and Rimmon : all the cities are twenty and nine , with their villages :

translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka snem kaba lai , u Jehoash u syiem Judah u leit ïakynduh ïa u Ahab u syiem Jeruel .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the third year , that Jehoshaphat the king of Judah came down to the king of Israel .
So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering , and offered it upon a rock unto the  Lord  : and the angel did wondrously  ; and Manoah and his wife looked on .
translation.kha: Kumta u Manoah u shim uwei u khunblang bad khyndiat u kew , bad u ainguh ïa ki halor ka duwan maw sha U  Trai  uba leh kamphylla .

translation.en: But Jesus said unto them ,  They need not depart  ; give ye them to eat .
translation.kha: Kim donkam ban leit ,  la jubab U Jisu .  Ma phi hi to ai ei ei ha ki ban bam !

U Saul u jubor , Ki briew jong per ki la rim ïa ki na ki Abimelekh . Ki la buh ïa ki langbrot badno ki masi kiba kynsai tam ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ha U Trai U Blei’ Jong phi , bad ïa kiba sah i'u la pynduh lwet khoit .
translation.en: And Saul said , They have brought them from the Amalekites : for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen , to sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God  ; and the rest we have utterly destroyed .

translation.kha: U la ainong ïa nga ban ai ha phi ïa kine ki jinghikai : ‘ Mynta phin ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri lbong Edom , ka ri ki mana ki jait jong phi , ki ïakhun ki kiaw u Ishod .
translation.en: And command thou the people , saying , Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau , which dwell in Seir  ; and they shall be afraid of you : take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore :

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingpynbna ba la dpei pynmihpat ha ka kyrteng u syep bad ba la shon da ka muhor syiem , ym lah ban pynkylla . Phi lah paw ban thoh sha ki Jiw ïa kaei kaei kaba phi kwah ; bad phi eh ban thoh ïa ka ha ka kirteng jyllang nga bad shon ïa ka da ka mut syep .
translation.en: Write ye also for the Jews , as it liketh you , in the king s name , and seal it with the king s ring : for the writing which is written in the king s name , and sealed with the king s ring , may no man reverse .
Father , glorify thy name .  Then came there a voice from heaven , saying , I have both glorified it , and will glorify it again .
translation.kha: Ko Pa , to pyndonburom ïa la ka kyrteng !  Te ka sur ka la kren na bneng ,  Nga la wallam ka burom ïa ka , bad ngan leh biang kumta .
Ka Bethania ka jngai kumba lai kilomitar duna na Jerusalem , bad Shibun ki nong Judia ki la wan ban peit ïa ka Martha bad ka Mari ban pyntngen ïa ki ha ka jingïap noh u para Jong ki .
translation.en: And many of the Jews came to Martha and Mary , to comfort them concerning their brother .

translation.kha: Ki Pharisi , te , ki la kylli biang ïa uta u briew kumno u la ïoh imat pat . U la ïathuh ïa ki , U la tah khyndiat ka ktieh ha ki khmat jong nga ; nga la bta khmat , bad mynta nga la imat .
translation.en: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight . He said unto them , He put clay upon mine eyes , and I washed , and do see .

translation.kha: Ka sngi ka jingpynshitom ka la wan , bad ki Israel kin sa shah pynjot . Ko ki paid Israel , kane tista jia da shisha !
translation.en: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke : among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be .

translation.kha: Nga la kwah ban lumlang ïa ki briew jong nga , dom u briew u lumlang ïa ka jingot Jong u ; hynriewphew ki long kum u dieng sohwaiñ khleiñ ki sohwaiñ , kumta u diengsoh Dumbur khleh ki soh-ot Dumah ; wat ki sla ki la jlop . Nahum dat , nga la shah ïa kiba nabar ban shim noh ïa ka ri .
translation.en: I will surely consume them , saith the  Lord  : there shall be no grapes on the vine , nor figs on the fig tree , and the leaf shall fade  ; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them .

And the Levites shall compass the king round about , every man with his weapons in his hand  ; and whosoever else cometh into the house , he shall be put to death : but be ye with the king when he cometh in , and when he goeth out .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi ki dei ban ïeng ïada sawdong ïa u syiem , lem bad ki waitlam jong ki , kiba ki la sei , bad ki dei ban don ryngkat bad u syiem kat shaba u leit . Uno uno uba pyrshang ban rung shapoh ka Templ u dei ban shah pynïap .

Nga la noh mynsiem bad shitom bun babe sngaid . Hadien kata nga la khie bad leit pat sha ka kam kaba u syiem u la ai ha nga , hynrei nga la shaïong da ka jingïohipaw bad ngam lah ba-bang shemphang ïa ka .
translation.en: And I Daniel fainted , and was sick certain days  ; afterward I rose up , and did the king s business  ; and I was astonished at the vision , but none understood it .

translation.kha: Kim Shim lama katba Kmen haduh ka jingïap bad la tep ïa ki ;
translation.en: Which rejoice exceedingly , and are glad , when they can find the grave ?
( For my father fought for you , and adventured his life far , and delivered you out of the hand of Midian :
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba i pa jong nga i la ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi . I la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ban pyllait im ïa phi na ki Midian .

Kumta nga la ai lei ban khang ïa ki khrup ka nongbah ha kaba sdang jong kawei pa kawei ka sngi Sabbaton , tong Shuh sdang ka por janmiet , bad ban ym plie biang haduh ba ka sngur Sabtah ka la kut . Nga la pynsep katto katne ki rangbah jong nga ha ki khyrdop ban pynthikna ban ym don jingwanrah ei ei shapoh ka nongbah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when the gates of Jerusalem began to be dark before the sabbath , I commanded that the gates should be shut , and charged that they should not be opened till after the sabbath : and some of my servants set I at the gates , that there should no burden be brought in on the sabbath day .

Therefore , thou son of man , prepare thee stuff for removing , and remove by day in their sight  ; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight : it may be they will consider , though they be a rebellious house .
translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , to teh ïa ka song kumba u nongphetwir u leh bad mihnoh ha shuwa ban wan ka miet . Ai ba uwei uwei baroh un ïohi ba me mihnoh bad leit sha kawei pat ka jaka . Lehse kito kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah kin ïohi ïa me .

translation.en: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness : and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast , full of names of blasphemy , having seven heads and ten horns .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u la bat synshar ïa nga , bad u angel u la rah ïa nga sha ka ri shyiap . Hangta nga la ïohi ïa ka briew kaba shong halor u mradkhlaw rong saw uba la don ki kyrteng kiba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei ba la thoh baroh shi rynïeng jong u ; u mradkhlaw u la don hynñiew tylli ki khlieh bad shiphew tylli ki reng .
To pynkhreh ban shah kumta koidi , phi ki briew ka Ijipt ! Ïa ka Memphis yn sa pynlong ka ri shyiap , ka jingjot ha kaba yn ym don ban shong don sah .
translation.en: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt , furnish thyself to go into captivity : for Memphis shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant .

translation.kha: U la thoh lai Jashar thyllah ki proberb bad patar hajar tylli ki jingrwai .
translation.en: And he spake three thousand proverbs : and his songs were a thousand and five .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba nud ban ïalap pyrshah ïa u nongbishar lane ïa u lyngdoh suba shakri ha kata ka por ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong phi ; u dei ban shah pynïap . Da kumta phin pynkhuid ïa kata ka jingbymman na Israel .
translation.en: And the man that will do presumptuously , and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the  Lord  thy God , or unto the judge , even that man shall die : and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel .

translation.kha: U Saul u sngewthuh shai ba U Trai u khong ryngkat bad u Dabid bad ba ka Mikhal ka khun jong u ka ieit ïa u .
translation.en: And Saul saw and knew that the  Lord  was with David , and that Michal Saul s daughter loved him .
And Jacob their father said unto them , Me have ye bereaved of my children : Joseph is not , and Simeon is not , and ye will take Benjamin away : all these things are against me .
translation.kha: U kpa jong ki u ong ha ki ,  Phi kwah ba ngan duh lut ïa la ki jong ki khun ? U Joseph um don shuh , u Simeon ruh um don , bad mynta pat phi kwah ban shim noh sa ïa u Benjamin . Dei ma nga keiñ uba shah jynjar !

translation.en: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season , that thou shouldest receive him for ever  ;
translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba u Onesimos u la don jngai na me katto katne por khnang ba men ïoh pat ïa u ha ki por baroh .

translation.en: And if one prevail against him , two shall withstand him  ; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken .
translation.kha: Ar ngut ki briew ki lah ban ïada na ka jingtur ïaleh kaba lah ban jop ïa u briew ba tang marwei . U tyllai uba la jyrthiaw da ki lai tylli ki tyllai u long uba jwat ban dkut .

translation.en: Say not unto thy neighbour , Go , and come again , and to morrow I will give  ; when thou hast it by thee .

translation.en: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment : the waters stood above the mountains .

translation.en: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Surely I will be with thee , and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man .

translation.en: By faith Abraham , when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance , obeyed  ; and he went out , not knowing whither he went .

translation.en: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without , an hundred cubits eastward and northward .

translation.en: For he loveth our nation , and he hath built us a synagogue .

translation.kha: Ki nongsuhjaiñ jong ka ki la jop ; ki la bat ïa ka ha ka bor jong ki . U Trai u la pynurlong ïa ka Ban shahshitom na ka bynta ki pop kiba bun jong ka baroh . Ïa ki khun jong ka la Kem bad la shahskhor rah noh .
translation.en: The Lord was as an enemy : he hath swallowed up Israel , he hath swallowed up all her palaces : he hath destroyed his strong holds , and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation .

translation.kha: Ko Pa pahuh ! Ka pyrthuh kam thuh ïa me , hynrei nga ithuh ïa me , bad kine ki tip ba me la Phah ïa sa .
translation.en: O righteous Father , the world hath not known thee : but I have known thee , and these have known that thou hast sent me .

translation.en: I speak as to wise men ; judge ye what I say .

translation.en: Wherefore we would have come unto you , even I Paul , once and again ; but Satan hindered us .

translation.en: Lift up thine eyes round about , and see : all they gather themselves together , they come to thee : thy sons shall come from far , and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side .

translation.en: And as they came down from the mountain , Jesus charged them , saying ,  Tell the vision to no man , until the Son of man be risen again from the dead .

translation.en: Therefore prophesy and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , O my people , I will open your graves , and cause you to come up out of your graves , and bring you into the land of Israel .

translation.en: And Abraham said unto his young men , Abide ye here with the ass  ; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship , and come again to you .

Un long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba mad noh ïa ki soh ki bym pat ih ; kumin u dieng Olib suba hap noh ki shylluit .
translation.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine , and shall cast off his flower as the olive .

translation.en: And the whole city was filled with confusion : and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus , men of Macedonia , Paul s companions in travel , they rushed with one accord into the theatre .

translation.en: And Moses took half of the blood , and put it in basins  ; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar .

translation.en: For as touching the ministering to the saints , it is superfluous for me to write to you :

translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts hath sworn by himself , saying , Surely I will fill thee with men , as with caterpillers  ; and they shall lift up a shout against thee .
The rich man s wealth is his strong city , and as an high wall in his own conceit .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba riewspah , pynban , ki mutdur ba ka spah jong ki ka ïada ïa ki kum ki kynroh bajrong bakhlaiñ sawdong ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested , being witnessed by the law and the prophets ;
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa ka rukom ba U Blei u buh ba ki briew kin long ka hok bad u hi , la pynpaw . Kam don jingïadei ei ei bad ka Hukum , wat la ka Hukum u Moses bad ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ai ka jingsakhi ïa ka .

translation.en: But , O  Lord  of hosts , that judgest righteously , that triest the reins and the heart , let me see thy vengeance on them : for unto thee have I revealed my cause .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la duwai ,  A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , me long u nongbishar ba bishar hok ; me tynjuh ïa ki jingpyrkhat bad ki jingsngew jong ki briew . Nga la buh ïa ka kam jong nga ha ki kti jong me ; kumta shah ïa nga ban khmih ïa me ba me pynhiarkput halor kine ki briew .

U Blei , Mynta , um shym la ai ha u Abraham ïa kano kano ka bynta Jong ka kum ka jong u hi , ym wat shi mitar sawdong jong ka khyndew , hynñiew U Blei u la kular baneh ai ïa ka ha u , bad ba kan long ka jong u malade ka jngai ki khun ki kseh jong u . translation.en: And he gave him none inheritance in it , no , not so much as to set his foot on : yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession , and to his seed after him , when as yet he had no child .

translation.en: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother  ;

translation.en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness , and the watersprings into dry ground  ;

translation.en: And the Levites , of the children of the Kohathites , and of the children of the Korhites , stood up to praise the  Lord  God of Israel with a loud voice on high .

translation.en: And he called unto him two centurions , saying , Make ready two hundred soldiers to go to Caesarea , and horsemen threescore and ten , and spearmen two hundred , at the third hour of the night  ;

translation.en: And the king of Israel answered and said , Tell him , Let not him that girdeth on his harness boast himself as he that putteth it off .

translation.en: Which had the golden censer , and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold , wherein was the golden pot that had manna , and Aaron s rod that budded , and the tables of the covenant  ;

translation.kha: Ki im ka jingim ha ka jingsuk bad ki ïap suk khleiñ ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: They spend their days in wealth , and in a moment go down to the grave .

translation.en: Malchijah the son of Harim , and Hashub the son of Pahath–moab , repaired the other piece , and the tower of the furnaces .

translation.en: Naphtali is a hind let loose : he giveth goodly words .

translation.en: If there be among you any man , that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night , then shall he go abroad out of the camp , he shall not come within the camp :

translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Come ye after me , and I will make you to become fishers of men .

translation.en: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria , and the head of Samaria is Remaliah s son . If ye will not believe , surely ye shall not be established .

translation.en: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine , and pour out their blood by the force of the sword  ; and let their wives be bereaved of their children , and be widows  ; and let their men be put to death  ; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle .
He made him ride on the high places of the earth , that he might eat the increase of the fields  ; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock , and oil out of the flinty rock  ;

translation.en: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness , but rather reprove them .
translation.kha: Phim dei ban ïadon bynta ei ei bad ki kam bym don jingmyntoi kiba ki briew ki leh , kiba long ki kam ka jingdum . Pynban wallam ïa ki sha ka jingshai .

translation.en: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die , from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne , even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill  ; and all the firstborn of beasts .

translation.en: Let our lord now command thy servants , which are before thee , to seek out a man , who is a cunning player on an harp : and it shall come to pass , when the evil spirit from God is upon thee , that he shall play with his hand , and thou shalt be well .

translation.en: But there came a messenger unto Saul , saying , Haste thee , and come  ; for the Philistines have invaded the land .

translation.en: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation , which murmur against me ? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel , which they murmur against me .

translation.kha: Ko Trai , kine ki dei ki shakri jong me , ki biria jong me hi . Me la pyllait ïa ki da ka bor bakhraw bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong me .
translation.en: Now these are thy servants and thy people , whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power , and by thy strong hand .

translation.en: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour , to slay him with guile  ; thou shalt take him from mine altar , that he may die .

translation.en: Behold , I am the  Lord  , the God of all flesh : is there any thing too hard for me ?

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen , and against all Edom , which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart , with despiteful minds , to cast it out for a prey .

ba ki samla kynthei kin leit rupa sngi man la ka snem ban ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka khun u Jephthah u nong Gilead .
translation.en: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year .

translation.kha: Bha long ba la pynrem Namarba kito ki jingpynkheiñ briew baroh bad ba la pyntngit da ki bleithaw ba pha la thret , bad te ka sngi jong pha ka la wan , ka por ka la kut ! Dei na kata ka daw nga la pyntong ïa ki jaitbynriew ban ibeiñ ïa pha bad ki ri baroh ki ñiewbeiñ ïa pha .
translation.en: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed  ; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made  ; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near , and art come even unto thy years : therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen , and a mocking to all countries .

translation.en: And when he was alone , they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable .

translation.en: Now therefore be ye not mockers , lest your bands be made strong : for I have heard from the Lord  God  of hosts a consumption , even determined upon the whole earth .

translation.en: Or if a soul swear , pronouncing with his lips to do evil , or to do good , whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath , and it be hid from him  ; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty in one of these .

translation.en: The  Lord  knoweth the thoughts of man , that they are vanity .

translation.en: Let thy mercies come also unto me , O  Lord  , even thy salvation , according to thy word .
