translation.en: And they watched him , and sent forth spies , which should feign themselves just men , that they might take hold of his words , that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor .
Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance , and joined affinity with Ahab .
translation.kha: Haba u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah u la riewspah bad pawnam , u la pynbeit ïa ka jingshongkurim hapdeng u dkhot ka longïing jong u bad ka longïing u Ahab u syiem ka Israel .

Ka syiem jong ka Sheba ka bna shaphang ka nam u Solomon , bad ka leit sha Jerusalem ban tynjuh ïa u da ki jingkylli kiba eh . Ka wan ïalam shibun ki nongbud lym nabar ki ut bakha kit ki mawshun , ki mawkordor , bad shibun ka ksiar . Haba ka la ïakynduh ïa u Salmone , ka kylli lut ïa baroh ki jingkylli kat babha kein ha ka jingat jong ka .
translation.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon , she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem , with a very great company , and camels that bare spices , and gold in abundance , and precious stones : and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .

translation.kha: Kumta u Ebedmelekh u la leit bad ki rangbah sha ka kamra buh jingbam ha ka ïingsyiem Bad la ioh katto katne ki jaiñphong ba la rim kiba u la pynhiar sha nga da ki tyllai .
translation.en: So Ebed–melech took the men with him , and went into the house of the king under the treasury , and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags , and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah .

For this cause have I sent unto you Timothy , who is my beloved son , and faithful in the Lord , who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Christ , as I teach every where in every church .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka jingthmu nga phah ha phi ïa u Timothi , uba long u khun ba-ieit bad baïaineh jong nga ha ka jingim kum uba ngeit . Un pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa ki nongrim kiba nga bud ha ka jingim kaba thymmai ha U Khrist Jisu bad kaba nga hikai ha ki balang baroh kiba don kylleng .
U la leit shai u syiem Daberath bad u ong , syiem Kynrad , nga la ai pynphuh shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot . ithuh ma phi bad ki jingbabe synshar jong phi phin wan bad shim bna ha ka jingïaleh-sngewbha ?
translation.en: And Absalom came to the king , and said , Behold now , thy servant hath sheepshearers  ; let the king , I beseech thee , and his servants go with thy servant .

translation.kha: U kham khlaiñ don ianga .
translation.en: He's stronger than me .

translation.kha: Wah pynpait ei ei nabar kaba sa hukum ïa phi , lane pynduna ei ei na ka . Kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Trai U blang jongki phi ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you , neither shall ye diminish ought from it , that ye may keep the commandments of the  Lord  your God which I command you .

translation.kha: U jubab , Nga don ka jingïakut bun u Mikah , u da siewdor ïa ang ba ngan shrak kum u lyngkhuh jong u .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Thus and thus dealeth Micah with me , and hath hired me , and I am his priest .

translation.kha: Ka ong ha u , Balei ba phi la leh kum kaei ka jingbha ha ki briew jong U Blei ? Phim shym la shat ïa la u jong u khun ban Wan peiñ noh na ka jingphet wir , malu kumta phi la pynrem ïa lade da kawei kaba phin dang Shu dep ong .
translation.en: And the woman said , Wherefore then hast thou thought such a thing against the people of God ? for the king doth speak this thing as one which is faulty , in that the king doth not fetch home again his banished .

translation.kha: Kaiwan pa kawei ka Long , la ka theh ne ka rit , ka kyntur shabi ban tip ïa kano ka kyrdoh ka kitkhlieh .
translation.en: And they cast lots , as well the small as the great , according to the house of their fathers , for every gate .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom , phin ïoh ïa ka khor ba-pura Ban rung sha ka Hima bymjukut jong U Jehu Khrist uba U Trai badno U Nongpynim Jong ngi .
translation.en: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: U Trai u la lah nguh ha u Moses , U Pharaoh un ïai kyntait don shahshkor ïa phira khnang ba nga la ban ni kham badno ki kambah jong nga ha Ijipt .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Pharaoh shall not hearken unto you  ; that my wonders may be multiplied in the land of Egypt .
Then said we unto them after this manner , What are the names of the men that make this building ?
translation.kha: Ki pan ruh ïa ki kyrteng jong baroh ki rangbah kiba ïarap ha kaba tei ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: And that day was the preparation , and the sabbath drew on .
translation.kha: Ka la long ka sngi Thohdieng , bad ka sngi Sabbaton ka la jan sdang .

translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,
Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha para shynrang , ki la ni ïa ka kam kaba sang ; dei ban pynïap ïa ki baroh ar ngut .
translation.en: If a man also lie with mankind , as he lieth with a woman , both of them have committed an abomination : they shall surely be put to death  ; their blood shall be upon them .
For what shall it profit a man , if he shall gain the whole world , and lose his own soul ?
translation.kha: Hato u briew u ïoh jingmyntoi ei ei lada u ïoh ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hynrei u duh noh ïa la ka jingim ? Em , un ym ïoh jingmyntoi ei ei !
Ktien ki long ki ktien bashongkhia jyllang u Agur u khun jong u Jakeh : U Blei um long bad ar , U Blei um long bad nga , bad nga long khlem jingïarap .
translation.en: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh , even the prophecy : the man spake unto Ithiel , even unto Ithiel and Ucal ,

translation.kha: Nga khah jin ba ki kynthei kin long kiba biang bad kiba sngewthuh ïa ki jaiñ ba ki riam bad ban riam da kaba dei ; ym da ki jingpynlong shñiuh bakhyllah ne da ki jingdeng ksiar ne ki palat ne da ki kjap riam kiba remdor , hynrei da ki kam babha , dom ka dei ïa ki kynthei kiba mana ba ki long kiba riewblei .
translation.en: But ( which becometh women professing godliness ) with good works .

translation.kha: Kita ki mar kynthei ki leit biah beit sanphew beh Shemesh , bad khlei da phai na ka lyngki ba ki leit , ki da ïap artat kabu ki dang leit . Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki bud nadien jong ki haduh u pduh jongu ka Beth Shemesh .
translation.en: And the kine took the straight way to the way of Beth–shemesh , and went along the highway , lowing as they went , and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left  ; and the lords of the Philistines went after them unto the border of Beth–shemesh .

translation.kha: La pynlong ka jingleit pud bniah ïa u Ahasaïah , bad la shem ïa u ba u rieh ha Samaria . Ki la leit lem ïa u sha u Jehu bad pynïap ïa u . Hynrei ki la tep ïa ka met Jong u naba ki burom ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat u kparad jong u , ibha la leh katai kaba u Lah ban shakri ïa U Trai . Ym don uno a u dkhot jong ka longïing jong u Ahasaïah uba dang hukum uba lah ban syiar ïa ka hima .
translation.en: And he sought Ahaziah : and they caught him , ( for he was hid in Samaria , ) and brought him to Jehu : and when they had slain him , they buried him : Because , said they , he is the son of Jehoshaphat , who sought the  Lord  with all his heart . So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom .
But the fat , and the kidneys , and the caul above the liver of the sin offering , he burnt upon the altar  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Nangta u thang ha ka duwan ïa ka khleiñ , ïa ki khyllai , bad ïa ka bynta bakynsai tam jong u dohnud , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

translation.en: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that ye might be exalted , because I have preached to you the gospel of God freely ?
translation.kha: Ngam shym la buh dor ei ei ïa phi haba nga la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha jong U Blei ha phi ; nga la pynrit ïa lade khnang ban kyntiew ïa phi . Hato nga la leh bakla ?

Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei kiba la ïashah bynta ha ka jingwanrah bad ka jingkwah bri jyllang ka kin lynñiar bad ïam na ka bynta ka nongpang haba ki ïohi ïa ka thmu na ki thylliej ting kiba bam umdih ïa ka .
translation.en: And the kings of the earth , who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her , shall bewail her , and lament for her , when they shall see the smoke of her burning ,

translation.kha: Ki synrap jong u ki la kylli ïa U Jisu aiwai kane ka pharshi ka kit jingmut ,
translation.en: And his disciples asked him , saying , What might this parable be ?
And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me : forasmuch as when the  Lord  had delivered me into thine hand , thou killedst me not .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi phi la pyn-i haduh katno phi long uba bha ïa nga , naba phim shym la pynïap ïa nga , wat la U  Trai  u la buh ïa nga ha ka bor jong phi .

Haba ki kun kamet , i'u ki arphew saw ngut ki nongai balang ki la em khep ha khat uta suba shong halor ka khet , bad Mane ïa u , uba im junom la junom . Ki bret ïa ki pansngiat jong ki ha khmat jong ka khet bad ki ïai-ong ,
translation.en: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne , and worship him that liveth for ever and ever , and cast their crowns before the throne , saying ,

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim shym kylli , ‘ Hangno U thri u don ?’ Ki lyngdoh jong na hi kim ithuh ïa nga . Ki nongsynshar ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ; ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren ha ka kyrteng jong u Baal bad ki la ïamane ïa ki thliew bymmyntoi .
translation.en: The priests said not , Where is the  Lord  ? and they that handle the law knew me not : the pastors also transgressed against me , and the prophets prophesied by Baal , and walked after things that do not profit .

translation.kha: ma u blem bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la shemphang .
translation.en: And Moab was sore afraid of the people , because they were many : and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel .
And Enoch walked with God : and he was not  ; for God took him .
translation.kha: U la pynlut la ka jingim ha kaba ïasyllok bad U Blei , bad hadien kata u la jah noh , namar U Blei u la shim noh ïa u .

Nangta u Moses u Wallam ïa ki Kynhun shynrang u Aaron khim sha khmat bad u pynphong sopti ïa ki , u buh ïa ki panpoh sawdong ka syngkai jong ki , dara u pynteh tupia ha ki khlieh jong ki , kumba U Trai u la sah” .
translation.en: And Moses brought Aaron s sons , and put coats upon them , and girded them with girdles , and put bonnets upon them  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: U don ka kynhun ki liengbah kiba ïaid sha dulir ryngkat sad ki liengbah jong u syiemsad Hiram . Shisien lai snem ki lyngba jong u ki wan phai , ki da kit ïa ka ksiar , ka phong , ki bniat hati , ki tngaw , bad ki shrieh .
translation.en: For the king s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram : every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold , and silver , ivory , and apes , and peacocks .

translation.kha: Ka jingleh bymman kam wanrah ïa ka jingtyngshaiñ , Hynrei ki briew kiba hok ki ïeng shadem .
translation.en: A man shall not be established by wickedness : but the root of the righteous shall not be moved .
But he that is spiritual judgeth all things , yet he himself is judged of no man .
translation.kha: Pynban uno uno uba don U Mynsiem , u lah ban bishar ïa ka dor jong kiei kiei baroh , hynrei ym don uba lah ban bishar ïa u .
U Paul u la kwah ban ïalam dara u ïa u TIMOTHI , kumta u la otsher ïa u . U la leh kumta Namar Baroh ki Siew kiba shong basah ha kita ki iaka ki tip ba u kpa jong u Timothi u long u Grik .
translation.en: Him would Paul have to go forth with him  ; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters : for they knew all that his father was a Greek .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba shah iohnong ha Jerusalem , uba U Blei u la jied Ban ïohlait im , yn khot uba khuid .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that he that is left in Zion , and he that remaineth in Jerusalem , shall be called holy , even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem :

translation.kha: U Josaïah u la khong phra snem ka rta mynsaw u long u syiem ka Jehoïada , badno u synshar phraphew wei snem ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years .

translation.kha: Ka pyrthei hi kan khiar kum u nongbuaid bad khoh shane bad shaei kumin ka ïingtrep ha ka erïong . Ïa ka pyrthei la pynkhie da ki pop jong ka ; kan khyllem bad kan ym lah kaei khlieh shuh .
translation.en: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard , and shall be removed like a cottage  ; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it  ; and it shall fall , and not rise again .

translation.kha: mynta nga la tat ïa ka Templ naba khraw na ka bynta jong me , ka jaka na ka bniat jong me ba men shong junom la junom .
translation.en: I have surely built thee an house to dwell in , a settled place for thee to abide in for ever .

translation.kha: Da u lyoh me ïalam ïa ki ha ka por mynsngi , bad mynmiet me pynshisha ïa ka lynti jong ki da ka dieng .
translation.en: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar  ; and in the night by a pillar of fire , to give them light in the way wherein they should go .

For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law , he took the blood of calves and of goats , with water , and scarlet wool , and hyssop , and sprinkled both the book , and all the people ,
translation.kha: Nyngkong , u Moses u la pynbna ha u paidlang ïa ki hukum baroh kat kum ba la buh ha ka hukum . Nangta u la shim ïa ka snam ki masi kyrtong bad ki blang , u la khleh ïa ka bad ka um , bad u la synreit ïa ka halor kata ka kitab ka hukum bad halor u paidbah baroh , da kaba pyndonkam ïa u tnat Hissop bad katto katne u  saiwul uba saw .
Nga pynkhuid ïa ki briew na kiei kiei kiba long nongwei : nga pynkhreh ki jingbymngeit ryntih na ka bynta ki lyngkhot bad ki Lebi khnang ba uwei pa uwei un tip ïa la ka kamram ;
translation.en: Thus cleansed I them from all strangers , and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites , every one in his business  ;
And it came to pass afterward , that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek , whose name was Delilah .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Samson u ibha ïa kawei ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Delilah , kaba shong basah ha ka Them Sorek .

translation.en: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah khyndai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la bitar haba ki la ïoh ïa ki kiei kiba phria kiba u la leh bad ba ki khynnah ki ïa-pyrta ha ka baphylla , To ïaroh ïa U Khun u Dabid !
translation.en: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did , and the children crying in the temple , and saying , Hosanna to the Son of David  ; they were sore displeased ,

translation.kha: U Trai u long u nongïada jongnga nga , u longsem ka kut ïaskhem jong nga .
translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  is my rock , and my fortress , and my deliverer  ;

translation.kha: Kane ka long said ka hukum na ka bynta ithuh u briew’ kiba ïoh ïa ka jingpang pynkitkhlieh hynrei u bym kotbor ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh kumba ju long ka rukom ïa kiba yn pyndonkam ha ka jingpynkhuid ïa u .
translation.en: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy , whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing .

translation.kha: bad u ong ha u Jeroboam , Shim shiphew lyngkhot ha lade , namar U Tlai , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ïa me , ‘ Ngan knieh noh ïa ka hima na u Samson , dara ngan ai ha me shipai jait .
translation.en: And he said to Jeroboam , Take thee ten pieces : for thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , Behold , I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon , and will give ten tribes to thee :

And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering , in the holy place : for as the sin offering is the priest s , so is the trespass offering : it is most holy :
translation.kha: Un pynïap ïa uta u khunlangbrot ha ka jaka kaba kyntang ha kaba la ju pynïap ïa ki jingri na ka bynta ki jingkñia namar ka pop bad ïa ki jingkñia ainguh thang . U dei ban leh ïa kane namar ba ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka jingpalat , kumba long ka jingkñia namar ka pop , ka dei ka jong u lyngdoh , bad ka long kaba khuid bha .
Ha ka jakarieh ba ki ïasah miet , uwei na ki u plied ïa la ka byrni ban ai bam ïa ka kada jong u , bad u lap ïa ka pisa jong u ha khlieh eh ka byrni .
translation.en: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn , he espied his money  ; for , behold , it was in his sack s mouth .

translation.kha: ngam pyllait ïa phi na kata baroh kaba pyntngit ïa Phi . Ngan sah ïa u kew ba un Bun kyrhai , khnang ba phin ym mad shuh ïa ki jingïapthngan .
translation.en: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses : and I will call for the corn , and will increase it , and lay no famine upon you .
And they continued stedfastly in the apostles  doctrine and fellowship , and in breaking of bread , and in prayers .
translation.kha: Ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki ha kaba ïoh jinghikai na ki apostol , ha kaba ïashim bynta ha ka jingïasyllok , bad ha kaba ïa-ai lem ha ka jingïabam lang bad ha ki jingduwai .
Nga long ka shakri jong U Trai’ , ka Mari ka la ong , ai kan longsem ha ang kumba me la ong . Bad u angel u la leit noh na ka .
translation.en: And Mary said , Behold the handmaid of the Lord  ; be it unto me according to thy word . And the angel departed from her .

translation.kha: U syiem jong ki sad ki radbah pynïaidkam jong u , kin shah riewrangbah .
translation.en: And their king shall go into captivity , he and his princes together , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hobab ki ikwah ïa ki lyngkha , ki shi tyngeh ïa ki ; haba ki ikwah ïa ki ïing , ki shu shim ïa ki . Ym don ka longïing ne ka jingdon jingem iohnong jongno kaba shongshngain .
translation.en: And they covet fields , and take them by violence  ; and houses , and take them away : so they oppress a man and his house , even a man and his heritage .

translation.kha: U pynshngain ïa u Aaron da kaba theh khyndiat ïa ka umphniang pynsleh ha ka khlem jong u .
translation.en: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron s head , and anointed him , to sanctify him .

translation.kha: Nangta to ïathaw ha ki ba ma nga , U Trai Nongsharai , ngan shim noh ïa ki briew jong de baroh na ki jingñiewbeiñ sha kiba ki la leit , nur-um lumlang ïa ki na ki , bad wanrah pat ïa ki sha la ka jong ka ri .
translation.en: And say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen , whither they be gone , and will gather them on every side , and bring them into their own land :
Can the Ethiopian change his skin , or the leopard his spots ? then may ye also do good , that are accustomed to do evil .
translation.kha: U briew uba ïong u lah mo ban pynkylla ïa ka rong jong ka sniehdoh jong u , lane u  labasa u lah mo ban weng ïa ki jingthoh ïong jong u ? Lada ki lah , te ma pha ka bym leh ïa kano kano hynrei ka jingsniew pha lah ban tip ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei .

, u Paul u batai ruh ïa ka jingthmu jong ka Hukum U Blei bad ka bor jong U mynsngi U Blei’ ha ka jingrem jongno uba ngeit . Nangta u ebanjelist u ïaleh shitom ban pynshai ïa ka jingkylli kumno ki Jiw bad ki jingtylli ki don ka jingïadei bad ka jingthmu U Blei ïa ki jaitbynriew . U pynkut ba ka jingkyntait jong ki Jiw ïa U Jisu ka long ka bynta jrong ka jingthmu U blang ban wallam ïa baroh ki jingriewblei hapoh ka jylli jong ka jingaiei jong U Blei da U Jisu Khrist , bad u ngeit ba ki Jia kine ym kyntait sah ïa U ijuh . Khatduh u Paul u thoh shaphang kumno ban im ka jingim Khristan , khamtam shaphang ka lynti jong ka jingieit ha ka jingïadei bad Kiwei pait . U thoh kiwei pat ki phangpdeng kum ka jingshakri ïa U Blang , ka khem ki Khristan ha ka jingïadei bad ka hima sima bad ka imlang sahlang , bad ki jingkylli shaphang ka jingïatiplem . U pynjot ïa ka shithi da ki khubor bashimet bad ki ktien ïaroh ïa U Blei . Ki Jingkdew Ka jinglyngngoh bad ka phangpdeng
translation.en: And he shook off the beast into the fire , and felt no harm .

translation.kha: Da pyrkhat shuwa ba phin kren , bad wat Pynlong kino kino ki jingïalang rkhie ha U Blei . U don ha bneng bad ma phiah ha khyndew , kumta Wat ong ei ei palat ban ïa kaba Phin dei ban ong .
translation.en: Be not rash with thy mouth , and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God : for God is in heaven , and thou upon earth : therefore let thy words be few .
And said to his servant , Go up now , look toward the sea . And he went up , and looked , and said , There is nothing . And he said , Go again seven times .
translation.kha: U ong ïa la u shakri ,  Khie leit peit shaphang ka duriaw .  U shakri u leit bad u wan phai bad u ong ,  Ngam ïohi ei ei .  Hynñiew sien u Elijah u ong ïa u ban leit bad ban peit .

translation.en: And I will make your cities waste , and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation , and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingijli bakhraw , ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki shnong jong phi , ngan pynpra ïa ki jaka mane blei jong phi , bad ngan kyntait ïa ki jingkñia ainguh jong phi .

translation.en: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion–geber , which is beside Eloth , on the shore of the Red sea , in the land of Edom .
translation.kha: U Syiem Solomon u shna shi kynhun ki lieng ha Esiongeber , kaba hajan Elath , harud jong ka Khmut duriaw Akaba , ha ka ri Edom .

translation.en: Not because I desire a gift : but I desire fruit that may abound to your account .
translation.kha: Ym namar ba nga kwah ban ïohpdiang ïa ki jingai sngewbha ; pynban , nga kwah ban ïohi ba la pynlang ïa ka jingïohnong ha ka jingbuh jingkheiñ jong phi .
Kumta kata ka lyngkhai katba dei ka jong ki Tap , ryngkat bad ka krem kaba to hangta , ka la kylla lama ka jingïohkynti jong u Abraham kum ka jaka tep briew .
translation.en: And the field , and the cave that is therein , were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth .

translation.kha: A Blei , to pynbna ba nga long uba lui ih , bad ïasaid da ïa at na ki bymriewblei ; pyllait ïa nga na ki briew kiba shukor bad kiba sniew !
translation.en: Judge me , O God , and plead my cause against an ungodly nation : O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man .

translation.kha: Ïa ki mar jong pa’ yn pynïap ha khmat jyllang phi hi , hynrei phin ym ïoh bam ïa ka doh jong ki . Ïa ki kada jyllang phi yn rong jubor ha khmat jongki phi hi , badno yn ym pynphai pat ïa ki sha phi . Ïa ki langbrot jong phi yn ai noh ha ki nongshun jong phi , bad yn ym don ba ïarap ïa phin .
translation.en: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes , and thou shalt not eat thereof : thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face , and shall not be restored to thee : thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies , and thou shalt have none to rescue them .

And yet for all that , when they be in the land of their enemies , I will not cast them away , neither will I abhor them , to destroy them utterly , and to break my covenant with them : for I am the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: Hynrei la katta ruh , katba ki dang don ha ka ri ki nongshun jong ki , ngan ym iehnoh syndon lane pynjot ïa ki . Da kumta ngan ym pyndkut noh ïa ka jutang jong nga bad ki , naba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: I have written unto you , fathers , because ye have known him that is from the beginning . I have written unto you , young men , because ye are strong , and the word of God abideth in you , and ye have overcome the wicked one .
translation.kha: Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun jong nga , namar phi ithuh ïa U Kpa . Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki kpa , namar phi ithuh ïa u , uba la don naduh kaba mynnyngkong . Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun samla , namar phi long kiba khlaiñ ; ka ktien U Blei ka ïaisah ha phi , bad phi la jop noh thiaw ïa Uta u Basniew .

translation.en: And she said to her father , Let it not displease my lord that I cannot rise up before thee  ; for the custom of women is upon me . And he searched , but found not the images .
translation.kha: Ka Rakhel ka ong ha la u kpa ,  Wat bitar ïa nga , ko kynrad , hynrei ngam lah ban ïeng ha khmat jong phi , nga dang poi bnai .  U Laban u la wad , hynrei um shym la shem satia ïa kita ki blei ïing jong u .
Ka jinglaitluid ka long kaei kaba ngi ba-don — dei U Khrist u la pyllait ïa ngi ! Pdeng te , kum ki bynriew kiba laitluid , Bad wat shah ïa latai ban longsyiem pat ki mradkhlaw .
translation.en: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free , and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage .

translation.kha: U Meraïoth na Gibeon , u Jadon na Meronoth , bad ki rangbah ka Gibeon malade Mispah , ki ti ïa ka bynta kaba bud , haduh ka tare sah jongu u lat ka Ïuphratis kambah shaphang sepngi .
translation.en: And next unto them repaired Melatiah the Gibeonite , and Jadon the Meronothite , the men of Gibeon , and of Mizpah , unto the throne of the governor on this side the river .

translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi Bishar ki briew jong ka Ninebeh kin ïeng joit sad mudui ïa phi , namar ki la phai noh na ki nongpop jong ki haba ki la ïohsngew ba u Jonah u ïalap ; bad nga pynneh ïa phi ba don uei re iwei hangne naba kham khraw ban ïa u Jonah !
translation.en: The men of Nineve shall rise up in the judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it : for they repented at the preaching of Jonas  ; and , behold , a greater than Jonas is here .
And Elishama , and Eliada , and Eliphelet .
translation.kha: u Elishama , u Eliada , bad u Eliphelet .

Nangta u angel suba saw u la ut ïa la ka turoi . Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka sngi la shohbeiñ , bad shi bynta na ka kad bynta jong u bajanai , bad shi bynta na ka la bynta jong ki khlur , ba ka jingshai jong ki ka la jah noh shi beit na ka lai boitha ka jingtyngshaiñ ; ym shyiap la ba-don jingshai ha ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka sngi bun ïa ka shi bynta na ka lai boitha jong ka miet .
translation.en: And the fourth angel sounded , and the third part of the sun was smitten , and the third part of the moon , and the third part of the stars  ; so as the third part of them was darkened , and the day shone not for a third part of it , and the night likewise .

translation.kha: Phi kupar ïa u syiem bad ki nongïalam , hynrei Myntan kumno ki lah ban pyllait im ïa ka ri ?
translation.en: I will be thy king : where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities ? and thy judges of whom thou saidst , Give me a king and princes ?

translation.kha: Kumta u Daniel u la leit sha u Ariokh , ïa uba u syiem u la lah hukum ban pynïap ïa ki nongai jingot ïa u syiem . U la ong ha u , Wat pynïap ïa ki . Ïalam ïa la sha u syiem , bad ngan ïathuh ha u aïu ka jingphohsniew jong u ka kit jingmut .
translation.en: Therefore Daniel went in unto Arioch , whom the king had ordained to destroy the wise men of Babylon : he went and said thus unto him  ; Destroy not the wise men of Babylon : bring me in before the king , and I will shew unto the king the interpretation .
Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned , and which he made Israel sin , by his provocation wherewith he provoked the  Lord  God of Israel to anger .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia namar u Jeroboam u pynkhih bitar ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , da ki pop kiba u la leh bad u la pynlong ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
ïa ka umphniang pynsleh , bad ïa ka jingiwbih basma sngewtynnat na ka bynta Ka Jaka Kyntang . Ha kaba shna ïa kine baroh , ki dei ban leh thik kat kumba ang la hukum ïa me .
translation.en: And the anointing oil , and sweet incense for the holy place : according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do .
And he from within shall answer and say , Trouble me not : the door is now shut , and my children are with me in bed  ; I cannot rise and give thee .
translation.kha: Bad tharai u paralok jong phi un jubab napoh ïing , ‘ Wat pynwit ïa nga ! Ïa ka jingkhang la lah khang , bad ma nga lem bad ki khun jong nga ngi la thiah . Ngam lah ban khie bad ai ei ei ha phi .’

translation.en: The kings of the earth set themselves , and the rulers take counsel together , against the  Lord  , and against his anointed , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ki , ki ïeng pyrshah , ki nongsynshar jong ki , ki ïasylla lang pyrshah ïa U  Trai bad pyrshah ïa u syiem uba u la jied .
Ka ïong , Nga khong khwai ka jingpangnud barit ban pan na me ; sngewbha wat kyrngah ïa to . Kaei Katai , mei ? u kylli . Ngan ym kyrngah ïa phi .
translation.en: Then she said , I desire one small petition of thee  ; I pray thee , say me not nay . And the king said unto her , Ask on , my mother : for I will not say thee nay .

translation.kha: Ngin la pyntong ruh ka jutang sad ki , da kaba kular ban ai ha ki ïa ka ri Kanaan , ka ri ha kaweh ki la sheng la tama kumto ki sohshnong .
translation.en: And I have also established my covenant with them , to give them the land of Canaan , the land of their pilgrimage , wherein they were strangers .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ïa kine ki lei ha u Eleasar , u Joshua , bad ha kiwei pat ki nongïalam jongu ki Israhaïah :
translation.en: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel :

translation.kha: Ki la ïai-ong Para ma ki , Hato kam shym la long kum ka dong kaba klang hapoh jong Ngi mynba u la krai ha ngi ha ka lynti bad batai ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ha ngi ?
translation.en: And they said one to another , Did not our heart burn within us , while he talked with us by the way , and while he opened to us the scriptures ?

translation.kha: Ym da donkam mano mano ban ïathuh ha u shaphang jong ki , namar u hi u la Tip kaei kaba don ha ka dohnud jong ki .
translation.en: And needed not that any should testify of man : for he knew what was in man .

translation.kha: Ka la long hangta ba ki la thaw ïa ka blei ha ka dur jong u masi , ki la ai jingïania ha ka , bad ki la ïakhawai ha kaba ai burom ïa kaei kaba ma ki hi ki la lah thaw .
translation.en: And they made a calf in those days , and offered sacrifice unto the idol , and rejoiced in the works of their own hands .

For the mountains shall depart , and the hills be removed  ; but my kindness shall not depart from thee , neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed , saith the  Lord  that hath mercy on thee .
translation.kha: Ki lumbah bad ki lumrit ki lah ban twa , hynrei ka jingieit jong nga ïa pha kan ym kut noh ; ngan pynneh junom ïa la ka kular jong ka jingsuk .  Kumta te ong U  Trai  uba ieit ïa pha .
Lada yn kylli ïa ngi mynba shaphang ka kada Babha ïa kaba la leh ha u briew wahbah dkoh pynlang kumno la pynkhiah ïa u ,
translation.en: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man , by what means he is made whole  ;

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , Mynta ka jingpynim ka la wan ha kane ka ïing , naba une u briew , ruh , u dadien uba hiarpateng jong u Abraham .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  This day is salvation come to this house , forsomuch as he also is a son of Abraham .
And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars , and burned men s bones upon them , and returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U pynïap lut ïa ki lyngdoh nongmane blei thala halor ki duwan ba ki shakri , bad u thang ïa ki shyieng briew ha kawei pa kawei ka duwan . Nangta u leit phai pat sha Jerusalem .
Ki jyrthiaw kin ïohthiah ïa Kane bad kin sngewkhuslai wat hapdeng ka jingkitkhlieh jong ki baroh’ . Ha ka jinglyngngoh ngin samla ïa la ki shyntur bad tap ïa la ki shkor .
translation.en: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might : they shall lay their hand upon their mouth , their ears shall be deaf .

translation.kha: U Bela u don syn ngut ki ïakhun shynrang : u Esbon , u Ussi , u Ussiel , u Jerimoth , bad u Iri . Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing ha ka kur bad ki dei baïar ki shipai bapawnam . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki kynthup ïa ki Nepheg ar khashor arphew saw ngut ki rangbah kiba kismis na ka bynta ka kam shipai .
translation.en: And the sons of Bela  ; Ezbon , and Uzzi , and Uzziel , and Jerimoth , and Iri , five  ; heads of the house of their fathers , mighty men of valour  ; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four .

translation.kha: Ka jingsawa ka sur jyllang ki ka pynlong ïa ki nongrim jong ka Templ ban khñiot , bad ka Templ hi ka kylla dap da ka tdem .
translation.en: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried , and the house was filled with smoke .

translation.kha: Haba u syiem u la lah jam sha shiliang , ïa kaba la synran da barhem ki rangbah ka Judah bad shiteng na ki paid Jesreel , u la leit beit sha Gilgal , bad u Shimham u la kitei malu u .
translation.en: Then the king went on to Gilgal , and Chimham went on with him : and all the people of Judah conducted the king , and also half the people of Israel .

translation.kha: Wat ai ba uno uno un long uba im thala lane u bym kynja mynsiem , kum u Iso , uba tang namar shisien ka jingbam u la die noh ïa ki hok jong u kumin u hynmen .
translation.en: Lest there be any fornicator , or profane person , as Esau , who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright .
But seek not Beth–el , nor enter into Gilgal , and pass not to Beer–sheba : for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity , and Beth–el shall come to nought .
translation.kha: Wat leit sha Beersheba ban mane Blei . Wat pyrshang ban wad ïa nga ha Bethel — ka Bethel kan ym long ei ei . Wat leit sha Gilgal — ïa ki briew jong ka la tim ba kin shah ringmraw .

translation.en: They eat up the sin of my people , and they set their heart on their iniquity .
translation.kha: Phi kylla riewspah na ki pop ki briew jong nga , bad kumta phi kwah ïa ki ban nang leh pop shuh shuh .
Ko khun u briew , u la ong , ïathuh ha ki briew jong me ïa kaei kambah jai haba nga wanrah ïa ka sur-thma ha ka ri . Ki briew ha said ka ri ki jied ïa uwei napdeng jyllang ki ban long u nongbah .
translation.en: Son of man , speak to the children of thy people , and say unto them , When I bring the sword upon a land , if the people of the land take a man of their coasts , and set him for their watchman :
In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up , and Jehoiakim became his servant three years : then he turned and rebelled against him .
translation.kha: Mynba u Jehoïakim u long u syiem , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem Babilonia u la hiarthma ïa ka Judah , bad lai snem la pynbor ïa u Jehoïakim ban pyndem ha ka jingsynshar jong u ; nangta u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah .
Ka jingmut kaba ph dei ban kein ka lama kata kaba U Khrist Jisu u la don :
translation.en: Let this mind be in you , which was also in Christ Jesus :

translation.kha: Ko Trai , shano lad leit ? u Petros u la kylli ïa u . Mem lah banbeiñ bud ïa nga mynta shadong shwa ba ngan sa lytar , U Jisu u la jubab ; hynrei hadien men sa bud ïa na .
translation.en: Simon Peter said unto him , Lord , whither goest thou ? Jesus answered him ,  Whither I go , thou canst not follow me now  ; but thou shalt follow me afterwards .
I will make thee a terror , and thou shalt be no more : though thou be sought for , yet shalt thou never be found again , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa pha ka nuksa ba-itriem , bad kata kan long kaba kut jong pha . Ki briew ki lah ban wad ïa pha , hynrei kin ym lap ïa pha .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

translation.en: And six branches going out of the sides thereof  ; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof , and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof :
translation.kha: Hynriew tylli ki tnat ki mih na baroh arliang jong u , lai tylli na kawei kawei ka liang .

translation.en: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock  ; he overturneth the mountains by the roots .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki tih ïa ki mawsiang ba-eh tam , ki tih ha trai jong ki lumbah .

Wat buhnud ïa ki rukom im jong ki brai kiba shongneh Haneng ; ngan beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew ki bymngeit Blei ba phin ïohrung ha kata ka ri . Nga isih eh ïa ki namar ki kam bymman jong ki baroh .
translation.en: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation , which I cast out before you : for they committed all these things , and therefore I abhorred them .

translation.kha: Kumjuh katto katne ngut na ki nongai jingmut u syiem kiba ïajan bad u ki ai jingmut , Baalah phim pynlong ka jingwad ban shen katei katne ki theisotti ba-bhabriew ?
translation.en: Then said the king s servants that ministered unto him , Let there be fair young virgins sought for the king :

translation.kha: U Syiem u jubab , ïada uno uno u bymnang ïa pha , ïan ïalam ïa u sha ar , bad un ym pynwit shuh ïa pha lano lano .
translation.en: And the king said , Whosoever saith ought unto thee , bring him to me , and he shall not touch thee any more .

translation.kha: U la pynthaba ha ka sur bajam , ‘ Pom ïa u dieng bad khet noh ïa ki tnat jong u ; sloit ïa ki sla jong u bad pynsaphriang ïa ki soh jong u . Beh noh ïa ki mrad napoh jong u bad ïa ki ha-sem na ki tnat jong u .
translation.en: He cried aloud , and said thus , Hew down the tree , and cut off his branches , shake off his leaves , and scatter his fruit : let the beasts get away from under it , and the fowls from his branches :
If thy children have sinned against him , and he have cast them away for their transgression  ;
translation.kha: Ki khun jong me ïoh ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Blei , bad kumta u pynshitom ïa ki kumba ka dei ïa ki .
Ki shim ïa ka jaka ka bha tam na ka beit ïa lade , Ïa ka bynta u jingïalam , la ai ha ki . Ki la kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki praw U Tharai Haba ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki ïalum shi jaka .
translation.en: And he provided the first part for himself , because there , in a portion of the lawgiver , was he seated  ; and he came with the heads of the people , he executed the justice of the  Lord  , and his judgments with Israel .

translation.kha: Wat haba phi don shiphew khadar ngut ki nongsumar ha ka jingim jongno Phi kum ki bangeit , pa don dang uwei u kpa . Naba ha ka jingtem jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu nga la longkmie u kpa jong phi da kaba wallam ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi .
translation.en: For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ , yet have ye not many fathers : for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel .
And the scripture was fulfilled which saith , Abraham believed God , and it was imputed unto him for righteousness : and he was called the Friend of God .
translation.kha: Bad ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid la pynshisha haba ka la ong ,  U Abraham u la ngeit ha U Blei ; bad namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok .  Bad kumta ïa u Abraham la khot u paralok jong U Blei .
Pyndonkam ïa ki tarajur kiba biang , ki mawthew kiba biang , bad ïa ki tiar thew kiba biang . Nga Long U Trai U Blei jong phi bad nga wallam ïa phi na ka ri ibieit .
translation.en: Just balances , just weights , a just ephah , and a just hin , shall ye have : I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Shuwa ba shim ïa ka jingpynbaptis tista kham bha lama pule sa kaweh de ka kjat ba la pynmih da ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah .
translation.en: A study of What Does the Bible Really Teach ? or a similar book published by Jehovah’s Witnesses is recommended in preparation for baptism .
And that ye may prolong your days in the land , which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed , a land that floweth with milk and honey .
translation.kha: Phin ïoh shong slem ruh ha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kaba U  Trai  u la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .
Kumta u Jehoshaphat u synshar ha ka jingsuk , bad U Bel u ai ha u ka jingshngain ha ki liang baroh .
translation.en: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet : for his God gave him rest round about .
And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong katto katne na ki , ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .
Mar shu dep pule da u Jehudi ïa ki lai ne saw bynta , u syiem u la ot ïa ki da ka tari barieh Bad bret ïa ki ha ka ding . U ïai leh ïa kane haduh ba la thang lut ïa ka kjit kli baïar khawai .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves , he cut it with the penknife , and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth , until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew ha ka synagog ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , la pyndap ïa ki da ka jingat .
translation.en: And all they in the synagogue , when they heard these things , were filled with wrath ,

translation.kha: Un jop ïa ki nongshun jongu u ha Edom , Bad un pynlong ïa ka ri jong ki ka jingïohthiah jong u , Kabbon ki Israel kmen ïatei jop .
translation.en: And Edom shall be a possession , Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies  ; and Israel shall do valiantly .
And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man , I sent straightway to thee , and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him . Farewell .
translation.kha: Bad haba la pyntip ha nga ba ka la don ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u , shisyndon nga la rai ban phah ïa u sha phi . Nga la ong ïa ki nongmudui jong u ban ai ki jingmudui jong ki pyrshah ïa u ha khmat jong phi .
Ka la long ka miet kaba khatsaw , bad ngi la shah ïalam kylleng ha ka duriaw Mediterranian da ka erïong . Kumba shithi synñia ki maji ki la antad ba i la jan poi hajan ka jingkraw .
translation.en: But when the fourteenth night was come , as we were driven up and down in Adria , about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country  ;

translation.kha: Hobah ki kherub ki sangeh , ki shalyntem ruh ki sangeh ; bad haba ki kherub ki hun , ki shalyntem jin ki leit lang bad ki , namar ki kherub ki pynïaid ïa ki .
translation.en: When they stood , these stood  ; and when they were lifted up , these lifted up themselves also : for the spirit of the living creature was in them .

And the man that will do presumptuously , and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the  Lord  thy God , or unto the judge , even that man shall die : and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba nud ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u nongbishar lane ïa u lyngdoh uba shakri ha kata ka por ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; u dei ban shah pynïap . Da kumta phin pynkhuid ïa kata ka jingbymman na Israel .
To kynjoh ïa kane , ph ki nongpop ; pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba nga la leh .
translation.en: Remember this , and shew yourselves men : bring it again to mind , O ye transgressors .

translation.kha: U Jakob , u Petros , bad u Ïoannis , kiba i ba ki long ki nongïalam , ki la tip ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kam bakyrpang ; kumne ki la ïakhublei kti ïa u Bathsheba lem bad ïa nga de , kum ka dak ba ngi ïalong baroh ki nongïatrei nur . Ngi la ïamynjur ba u Barnabas bad nga , ngin ïaroi hapdeng ki Jentil , malu ki pat hapdeng ki Jiw .
translation.en: And when James , Cephas , and John , who seemed to be pillars , perceived the grace that was given unto me , they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship ; that we should go unto the heathen , and they unto the circumcision .
And if any man ask you , Why do ye loose him ? thus shall ye say unto him , Because the Lord hath need of him .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u kylli ïa phi balei ba phi loit ïa u , ong ha u ba u Kynrad u donkam ïa u .
Ki la kynja ban ai jingbymman bun ai um ïa phiah mynba phi don ha lynti na Ijipt , bad ki la khiat wai ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , suba na ka shnong Pethor ha Mesopotamia , ban tim ïa phin .
translation.en: Because they met you not with bread and with water in the way , when ye came forth out of Egypt  ; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia , to curse thee .

translation.kha: Ale , bam na ka jingbam jong nga , bad dih na ka waiñ ba ar la khleh .
translation.en: Come , eat of my bread , and drink of the wine which I have mingled .

translation.kha: Ki la ïada ïa ngi mynsngi bad mynmiet ha ka por barhem ba ngi don bad ki ibha im sharai ïa la ki nongaplangbrot .
translation.en: They were a wall unto us both by night and day , all the while we were with them keeping the sheep .

And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines , and from the desert unto the river : for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand  ; and thou shalt drive them out before thee .
translation.kha: Ngan pynïar ïa ki pud jong ka ri jong phi naduh ka khmut duriaw Akaba haduh ka duriaw Mediterranian bad naduh ka ri shyiap haduh ka wah Ïuphratis . Ngan ai ha phi ka bor halor ki nongshong shnong jong kata ka ri , bad phin beh noh ïa ki katba phi nang tur sha khmat .
‘ Ko Kynrad ,’ nga la jubab , ‘ ki ïapstai bha ba nga la otsher sha ki synrum bad ang la kem bad saw ïa kito kiba ngeit ha me .
translation.en: And I said , Lord , they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee :
This is the portion of a wicked man with God , and the heritage of oppressors , which they shall receive of the Almighty .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kumno U Blei Badonbor Baroh u pynshitom ïa ki bymman , ki briew kiba lehbor .
Hangta nangno hangno phin ym thngan , bad phyrnai ym kyrduh ei ei . Ha ki mawsiang jong ka don u nar , bad ha ki lym jong ka lah ban tih tama .
translation.en: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness , thou shalt not lack any thing in it  ; a land whose stones are iron , and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass .

translation.kha: Wat tur ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki hynmen ki para jong phi hi , ki paid Jerusalem . Khie ïalap noh shat ïing phi barben . Kaei kabu wia ka long ka nga mon . Baroh ki la ïanguh ïa ka hukum U Trai bad ki leit phai sha la ïing .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Ye shall not go up , nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel : return every man to his house  ; for this thing is from me . They hearkened therefore to the word of the  Lord  , and returned to depart , according to the word of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kajuh ka to u la pynlong mraw ïa ki banbeiñ thah dieng bad kit um ïa ki paid Israel bad ïa ka duwan U thri . Haduh kane ka sngi ki la ïa-ai bteng ïa Kanneh ka kim ha ka jaka kaba u Terah u la jat ban mian ïa u .
translation.en: And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation , and for the altar of the  Lord  , even unto this day , in the place which he should choose .

translation.kha: To ngin ai ki jingnguh sha U Blei bad U kba U Jehu Khrist suba U Tlai jong ngi! Naba ha U Khreh , u la kyrkhu ïa ngi da kaba ai ha i'u ïa ka jingkyrkhu ba kynja mynnin baroh ha ka pyrthei kaba kynja bneng .
translation.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ :

translation.kha: Ban long kiba stad , nyngkong phi dadien ban tiengburom ïa U Trai . Lada phi tip ïa uta Uba Khuid , phoi don ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of wisdom : and the knowledge of the holy is understanding .

translation.kha: A phi ki nong Galatia kiba bieit! Uei uba la pynthame ïa pa’ ? Ha iitkhmat ki khmat jong phi hi la batai shai kdar ïa ka jingïap U Jisu Khrist khlur ka diengphna!
translation.en: O foolish Galatians , who hath bewitched you , that ye should not obey the truth , before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth , crucified among you ?

translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka ksiew ; kata kan long ka jingjahburom ïa me .
translation.en: The nakedness of thy son s daughter , or of thy daughter s daughter , even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover : for theirs is thine own nakedness .

translation.kha: Ki jubab , Ngin mynsiem ïa kata . U Trai un long u sakhi hapdeng jong ngi .
translation.en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah , The  Lord  be witness between us , if we do not so according to thy words .

translation.kha: Ïa ki Them kiba sahit jongngi ka Judah la pyndap da ki kali ïapom ; ki shipai halor ki kulai ki da ïong ha khmat ki khyrdop jong ka Jerushah .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots , and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la len babiang ïa kata . Katto katne por hateng , kiba ïa-ïeng hangta ki la mudui biang ïa u Petros , Mem lah ban len ba me long imat na ki , namar ma me ruh , me long na Igdalaïah .
translation.en: And he denied it again . And a little after , they that stood by said again to Peter , Surely thou art one of them : for thou art a Galilaean , and thy speech agreeth thereto .

translation.kha: Sin kumta U Trai nongsynran Badonbor Baroh , u ong , Kan don ka jingïalumlang bad ki jingïam sngewsih ha ki lynnong bah jong ka nongbah . Wat ïa ki nongrep yn khot ban ïadem na ka bynta uba ïapom lem bad pli ïa kiba lah da siew ban ïambriew .
translation.en: Therefore the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the Lord , saith thus  ; Wailing shall be in all streets  ; and they shall say in all the highways , Alas ! alas ! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning , and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing .

translation.kha: Ïa ka syiem la ringmraw kadei ; ki shakri jong ka ki ud kum ki lyngkhuh bad ki tied ïa la ka shadem ha ka jingsngewsih .
translation.en: And Huzzab shall be led away captive , she shall be brought up , and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves , tabering upon their breasts .

translation.kha: Nga la khmied , bad nga la ïohi ïa ka erïong ba ka waiñ na shaphang shatei . Ka leilieh ka thaba na u lyoh suba rben , bad ka sahit bneng sawdong jong u , ka phriang . Ha ka jakarieh ba ka leilieh ka thaba , don kaei kamai kaba phyrnai kum ka rnong .
translation.en: And I looked , and , behold , a whirlwind came out of the north , a great cloud , and a fire infolding itself , and a brightness was about it , and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber , out of the midst of the fire .
Rejoice not thou , whole Philistia , because the rod of him that smote thee is broken : for out of the serpent s root shall come forth a cockatrice , and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Philistia , u dieng uba la tied ïa phi u la kheiñ , hynrei phim don kano kano ka daw ban shadkmen . Haba uwei u bseiñ u ïap , uwei pat uba kham sniew u wan ha ka jaka jong u . Ka pylleng bseiñ ka pynmih ïa u Ïakjakor uba her .

translation.en: Every man is brutish in his knowledge : every founder is confounded by the graven image : for his molten image is falsehood , and there is no breath in them .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohi ïa kane , ki rangbah ki sngew mutlop bad kim sngewthuh ei ei ; kito kiba shna bleithaw ki shah pynthame , namar ki blei kiba ki shna ki long kiba bakla bad kim don jingim .

translation.en: And thou shalt anoint the laver and his foot , and sanctify it .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , pynkyntang ïa ka dabor bad ïa ka jingpynshong jong ka .

translation.en: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe : for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers .
translation.kha: Ka bri ka khyndew jong uwei pa uwei u Israel kan sah ha ka jait jong u .

Ym don uno un uba kah don pynong sad thung bashapoh ka ïing kaweh skhem jong u briew’ bad rah noh ïa ki tiar ki tar lymda u teh nyngkong ïa u briew uba khlaiñ ; te un sa lah ban lute ïa ka iing jongki u .
translation.en: No man can enter into a strong man s house , and spoil his goods , except he will first bind the strong man  ; and then he will spoil his house .
And these things will they do unto you , because they have not known the Father , nor me .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin leh ïa kine kiei kiei ïa phi namar ba kim pat ithuh ïa U Kpa lymne ïa nga .
U la ong ïa nga , Ko Israel , me long u shakri jong nga ; namar jong me , ki bariew kin ïaroh ïa nga .
translation.en: And said unto me , Thou art my servant , O Israel , in whom I will be glorified .

translation.kha: len pynpyngngad nala ïa ka jingkwah brai jong pha badno ïa ki jingrai kiba phalang la leh naduh ba pha tang don ha Ijipt . Phan ym khmih shuh ïa ki bleithaw ne pyrkhat shuh Shaphang ka jingïap .
translation.en: Thus will I make thy lewdness to cease from thee , and thy whoredom brought from the land of Egypt : so that thou shalt not lift up thine eyes unto them , nor remember Egypt any more .

translation.kha: Ki Israel kim dei shuh ban lyndet ïa U Trai da kaba pynïap ïa ki mirr jong ki ha lum ha wah la kum ba kñia ainguh ïa ki sha ki ksuid . Ki pangnud Israel ki de ïa-ban sumar ïa kane ka aiñ pateng la pateng .
translation.en: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils , after whom they have gone a whoring . This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations .

translation.kha: Tad haduh ba U Trai un da khmih sha tbian na pdeng bad ïew ïa ngi .
translation.en: Till the  Lord  look down , and behold from heaven .

translation.kha: La katta pajut , u la pynlong ka jingkular badno nga . U ong , ‘ Phin sa don u khun jyllang u pun synshar ha ka jingsuk , namar ba ngan ai ha u ka jingsuk na ki nongsuhjaiñ jong u baroh . Ka kyrthat jong u tista long u Solomon , namsop ha ka jingsynshar jngai u ngan ai ha ki Israel ka jingsuk bad ka jingshongshngain .
translation.en: Behold , a son shall be born to thee , who shall be a man of rest  ; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about : for his name shall be Solomon , and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days .

translation.kha: U Salm u khot lang ïa ki briew shwa ka jingïalang niam ha Mispah ,
translation.en: And Samuel called the people together unto the  Lord  to Mizpah  ;
The words of king Lemuel , the prophecy that his mother taught him .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki ktien shongkhia kiba ka kmie u syiem Lemuel ka kren ha u :

U Nebukhadnessar u la ring koidi ïa ki brai ka Jerusalem , ïa ki khun shym shajrong baroh , Bad baroh ki rangbah bapawkhmat , barieh lang! shiphew hajar jrut . U la pynryngkang par ruh ïa baroh ki nongtrei kiba tngit , kyntiap ïa ki bania , da kaba iehnoh shadien ha Jedaïah Teng ïa ki brisoh kiba duk tam eh .
translation.en: And he carried away all Jerusalem , and all the princes , and all the mighty men of valour , even ten thousand captives , and all the craftsmen and smiths : none remained , save the poorest sort of the people of the land .
And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves : for charity shall cover the multitude of sins .
translation.kha: Nalor kiei kiei baroh , to ïa-ieit shitrhem iwei ïa iwei pat , namar ka jingieit ka tap noh lin ïa ki pop babun .
To ap tad haduh ba ka taïew ka jinglehniam shongkurim kuna kut , bad ngan ai ha me ïa ka Rakkath , lada men trei na ka bynta jong nga sa hynñiew snem .
translation.en: Fulfil her week , and we will give thee this also for the service which thou shalt serve with me yet seven other years .

translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïa-ïam haba ki la kdew ïa u malu ki la doh khublei ïakhlad bad u .
translation.en: And they all wept sore , and fell on Paul s neck , and kissed him ,

And the  Lord  spake unto Moses face to face , as a man speaketh unto his friend . And he turned again into the camp : but his servant Joshua , the son of Nun , a young man , departed not out of the tabernacle .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïakren markhmat bad u Moses , kumba u briew u ïakren bad la u paralok . Nangta u Moses u leit phai sha ka jaka sher dara . Hynrei u samla , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , uba long u nongïarap jong u , u shongsah ha ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen , a great people , that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude .
translation.kha: Nga don hangne hapdeng ki briew ïa kiba me la jied kum la ki jong , ki briew kiba bun paid katta katta ba ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki .

Ki kyndiah ïa ka ha la ki tynneng bad rem ïa ka ; ki buh ïa ka ha ka jaka jongnga ka , bad hangta ka ïng , khlem lah ban khih na ka jaka ba ka don . Lada don Un uno ba duwai ha ka , kam lah ban jubab lane pynkoit ïa u na ka jingjot .
translation.en: They bear him upon the shoulder , they carry him , and set him in his place , and he standeth  ; from his place shall he not remove : yea , one shall cry unto him , yet can he not answer , nor save him out of his trouble .

translation.kha: U Bela u la thung ïa nga Kum u apostol bad u nonghikai pun pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha , bad dih na kane ka daw ba ar jingshahshitom ïa kine kiei kiei .
translation.en: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher , and an apostle , and a teacher of the Gentiles .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khathynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u Abijah u sdang ban synshar ha Israel ; nabar u synshar ar snem ha Samaria .
translation.en: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and reigned two years over Israel .

And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah , according to the commandment of the  Lord  to Joshua , even the city of Arba the father of Anak , which city is Hebron .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Joshua , la ai shi bynta na ka jaka jong ka Judah ha u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh , na ka jait Judah . U la ïohpdiang ïa ka Hebron , ka nongbah kaba dei jong u Arba , u kpa jong u Anak .

Ka Sarah ka la ïohi ïa ki , bad ka ong ha u Abraham , Beh noh ïa kane ka mrad bad ïa u khup jong ka . U khun jong kane ka briew um dei ban ïoh bynta ei ei ïa ka spah ka pah jong me , kaba u khun jrong nga , u Isaïah u dei ban ïohpateng .
translation.en: Wherefore she said unto Abraham , Cast out this bondwoman and her son : for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son , even with Isaac .

translation.kha: Ha —kata ka miet U blang u leh ïa kata . Ha ka step katba bud u shñiuh langbrot u jingkyang , hynrei ka khyndew ka la jhieh da ka peit .
translation.en: And God did so that night : for it was dry upon the fleece only , and there was dew on all the ground .

translation.kha: Mynta khatduh U Trai u la ïar ïa nga , ka la ong . U la shim noh ïa ka jahburom jong nga hapdeng ki briew !
translation.en: Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me , to take away my reproach among men .

And he brought out the grove from the house of the  Lord  , without Jerusalem , unto the brook Kidron , and burned it at the brook Kidron , and stamped it small to powder , and cast the powder thereof upon the graves of the children of the people .
translation.kha: U weng noh na ka Templ ïa ka dur jong ka blei Asherah , bad rah ïa ka shabar ka nongbah sha ka Them Kidron , u thang ïa ka , u pynlwet phum ïa u dpei jong ka , bad pynsaphred ïa ka ha jingtep paidbah .
Nangno u shim ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap ar tyllai bad u buh ïa ki hapoh ka syntied ka million . U bsuh ïa ki dieng jingtah ha ki kyrdoh jongu kata ka jingsuk bad u pahuh ïa ka jingtap hiar jong ka .
translation.en: And he took and put the testimony into the ark , and set the staves on the ark , and put the mercy seat above upon the ark :

translation.kha: Pynïap , nga la maham ïa ki samla hapdeng jongki ki : Wat sumar ïa ki aiñ kiba ki kparad tymmen jong pa ki thaw ; wat brup ïa ki rukom jong ki lane pyntngit ïa lade da ki bynthiew jong ki .
translation.en: But I said unto their children in the wilderness , Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers , neither observe their judgments , nor defile yourselves with their idols :
And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture , and the laver and his foot ,
translation.kha: ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh , ïa ka dabor bad ka jingpynshong jong ka ,

translation.en: What ? know ye not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body ? for two , saith he , shall be one flesh .
translation.kha: Lane lehse phim tip ba u briew uba pynïasoh ïa la ka met bad ka nuti u long kawei ka met bad ka ? Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shai kdar ,  Baroh ar kin ïalong kawei ka doh .

ki wan ïathuh ha u Joshua , Ym da donkam ba barabor kin leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Ai . Phah tang kumba ar ne kad hajar jrut ki rangbah . Wat phah ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei ban kitei ïaleh ; kam dei ka shnong kaba Heth .
translation.en: And they returned to Joshua , and said unto him , Let not all the people go up  ; but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai  ; and make not all the people to labour thither  ; for they are but few .
Say , I pray thee , thou art my sister : that it may be well with me for thy sake  ; and my soul shall live because of thee .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba pha dei ka para jong nga ; khnang ba na ka bynta jong pha kin shah ïa nga ban im bad lehbha ïa nga .
Ki la khynñiat , Balei phi wan ïalam ïa im’ na Ijipt ban ïap ha kane ka ri shahïap ha kaba ym don bam lane ka um ? Ngim sngewlah shuh ban bam kum ken ka jingbam !
translation.en: And the people spake against God , and against Moses , Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness ? for there is no bread , neither is there any water  ; and our soul loatheth this light bread .
Paul and Timothy , the servants of Jesus Christ , to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi , with the bishops and deacons :
translation.kha: Na u Paul bad u Timothi , ki shakri U Khrist Jisu — Sha baroh ki briew jong U Blei ha Philippi kiba ha U Khrist Jisu , kiba ki kynthup ïa ki nongïalam balang bad ki nongïarap .
U Blei u lah ban shah ïa u ban im khlem jingpynthut , hynrei u ïa-pihuin pat ïa u man la ka por .
translation.en: Though it be given him to be in safety , whereon he resteth  ; yet his eyes are upon their ways .

translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh un rah khñiot ka snam jong uta u masi shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translation.en: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock s blood to the tabernacle of the congregation :
And this is the writing that was written , MENE , MENE , TEKEL , UPHARSIN .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba la thoh : ‘ Ka dak jingkheiñ , ka dak jingkheiñ , ka jingthew , ki jingbynta .’

translation.en: Let these sayings sink down into your ears : for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men .
translation.kha: Wat klet ïa kaei kaba ngan ïathuh ha phi ! Yn sa aiti noh ïa U Khun U Briew ha ka bor jong ki briew .

U Jakob u jubab , Nga dei u Iso u khun rangbah jong phiah ; nga la leh kumba phi la bthah ïa la . Sngewbha khiah sheng , bad bam khyndiat na kñia ka doh kaba nga la wallam ïa phira , ba phin ïoh ai ha la ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong pa .
translation.en: And Jacob said unto his father , I am Esau thy firstborn  ; I have done according as thou badest me : arise , I pray thee , sit and eat of my venison , that thy soul may bless me .
So then because thou art lukewarm , and neither cold nor hot , I will spue thee out of my mouth .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba pha long kaba blem blem , ka bym shit lymne khriat , ngan prie noh ïa pha na ka shyntur jong nga !
Ynda ka khlam ka la sangeh , u Onan u leit phai sha u Moses ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation : and the plague was stayed .

translation.kha: te ai ba yn pynjot ïa ki jingthrang jingtep jyllang nga , lane to ai ba kiwei kin bam ïa ka jingbam ba nga pynmih .
translation.en: Then let me sow , and let another eat  ; yea , let my offspring be rooted out .
Thou shalt not lie with mankind , as with womankind : it is abomination .
translation.kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew ban ïathiah shongkha para shynrang . U Blei u isih eh ïa kata .
Ban bujli ïa ki , u Rehoboam u thaw ïa ki stieh da ka rnong bad aiti ïa ki ha ki pynbah pynïaidkam kiba kitkhlieh ban ïada ïa ki khyrdop ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass , and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard , that kept the entrance of the king s house .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Trai , phi ki jaitbynriew barieh ha ka pyrthei ; ïajah ïa ka burom sad ka jingkhrawbor jong u .
translation.en: Give unto the  Lord  , O ye kindreds of the people , give unto the  Lord  glory and strength .

translation.kha: U la kem ïa u Ïakjakor , ïa uta u seiñ hyndai — kata , u Ksuid lane u Soitan — bad u la thoh kynjri ïa u haduh shihajar snem .
translation.en: And he laid hold on the dragon , that old serpent , which is the Devil , and Satan , and bound him a thousand years ,

translation.kha: U phai sha uwei pat u rangbah bad u kylli ïa u ïa kajuh ka jingkylli , bad man ba u kylli , u ïoh ïa kajuh ka jubab .
translation.en: And he turned from him toward another , and spake after the same manner : and the people answered him again after the former manner .

translation.kha: Ngi la kiew da ka lieng na Atharim katba la khreh ban leit sha ki kylliang jongngi ka probins jong ka Asia , bad ngi la leit . U Aristarkhos , u nong Makedonia uba na Tarsos , u la don lem bad ngi .
translation.en: And entering into a ship of Adramyttium , we launched , meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia  ; one Aristarchus , a Macedonian of Thessalonica , being with us .

For the  Lord  had said unto Moses , Say unto the children of Israel , Ye are a stiffnecked people : I will come up into the midst of thee in a moment , and consume thee : therefore now put off thy ornaments from thee , that I may know what to do unto thee .
translation.kha: Naba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses ban ong ha ki ,  Phi long u paidlang uba mutlop . Lada ngan leit ryngkat bad phi wat tang shikhyllipmat ruh , ngan jin da la pynjot thiaw ïa phi . Law noh mynta ïa kito ki jingdeng jong phi , bad ngan sa rai ngan leh kumno ïa phi .

U Joseph u khlaw kat u masi kyrtong , kato ki reng u smai prut . Ki reng jong u kiba kat ki hajar jong u Mahseïah , Bad kat ki shiphew hajar jong u Jeremaïah . Da ki , u tur pyrshah ïa ki jaitbynriew , Doeg u shop ïa ki sha kabu kut jong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock , and his horns are like the horns of unicorns : with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth : and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim , and they are the thousands of Manasseh .
And Samuel came to Saul : and Saul said unto him , Blessed be thou of the  Lord  : I have performed the commandment of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Samuel u la leit sha u Saul , uba la khublei ïa u , da kaba ong ,  U  Trai  u kyrkhu ïa phi , Samuel ! Nga la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai .

translation.en: For every kind of beasts , and of birds , and of serpents , and of things in the sea , is tamed , and hath been tamed of mankind :
translation.kha: U briew u la lah ban pynjuh bad u la pynjuh ïa baroh kiwei pat ki jait jingthaw — ki mradkhlaw bad ki sim , ki mrad bapar bad ki dohkha .

translation.en: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery , dost thou commit adultery ? thou that abhorrest idols , dost thou commit sacrilege ?
translation.kha: Bad ba ong ba u briew um dei ban klim ,  — hynrei phi klim ? Phi isih ïa ki bleithaw — hynrei phi lute ha ki templ ?

U TRAI’ U Blei jong pa’ hi un saw ha shuwa jongnga phi bad un pynjot ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba shongneh Hangne , khnang ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jongngi ki ; bad u Joshua un long u nongïalam jong phi , kumba U Trai u la ong .
translation.en: The  Lord  thy God , he will go over before thee , and he will destroy these nations from before thee , and thou shalt possess them : and Joshua , he shall go over before thee , as the  Lord  hath said .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh la don u briew suba kyrteng u Ananias , uba , lem bad ka tnga jong u ka Sapphira , ki la die katto-katne katne na ka jaka kaban dih ka jong ki .
translation.en: But a certain man named Ananias , with Sapphira his wife , sold a possession ,
And the  Lord  thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies , and on them that hate thee , which persecuted thee .
translation.kha: Un pynngat kylla ïa kine ki jingtim baroh ha ki nongshun jong phi , kiba isih bad banbeiñ ïa phi ,

translation.en: And now , I pray you , consider from this day and upward , from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Hato phim ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia ha phi ? Ha shuwa ba phin sdang ban tei pat ïa ka Templ ,
Kumta wat bymsheptieng ïa ki briew . Ïa kaei kaba la kah mynta yn weng nep , bad ïa kaei Kaba la babuhrieh yn pynpaw .
translation.en: Fear them not therefore : for there is nothing covered , that shall not be revealed  ; and hid , that shall not be known .

translation.kha: Khatduh eh , uta u syier u hukum ïa ki briew jong u baroh , Shim ïa u khunlung hebrew baroh uba dang shu lah kham bad bret ïa u sha wah Nalor , hynrei ai ba ki khwan kynthei kan im .
translation.en: And Pharaoh charged all his people , saying , Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river , and every daughter ye shall save alive .

translation.kha: U Trai u la lah kular ba ma u hi un lama ka kynroh ding sawdong ïa ka nongbah ba ïada ïa ka bad ba un shong un sah hangta ha ka burom jong u baroh .
translation.en: For I , saith the  Lord  , will be unto her a wall of fire round about , and will be the glory in the midst of her .

Then the moon shall be confounded , and the sun ashamed , when the  Lord  of hosts shall reign in mount Zion , and in Jerusalem , and before his ancients gloriously .
translation.kha: U bnai un kylla dum , bad ka sngi kan ym tyngshaiñ shuh , namar U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un long u syiem . Un synshar ha Jerusalem halor u Lum Seïon , bad ki nongïalam jong ki briew kin ïohi ïa ka burom jong u .

translation.en: And in the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel , Jehoshaphat being then king of Judah , Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba san jong ka jingsynshar u Joram u khun jong u Ahab kum u syiem ka Israel , u Jehoram u khun jong u Jehoshaphat , u la long u syiem ka Judah
( Nga la thop khyndiat shaneng ken , bad lada phi peiñ ïa kaei kaba nga la thoh , Phi eh ban tip shaphang ka jingsngewthuh jongki nga ïa ka jingmaïan U Kiriath . )
translation.en: Whereby , when ye read , ye may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ )

translation.kha: bathoiñ ka snem , u Elkanah u mih na Ramah ban leit mane bad kñia ïa ki jingtieng ha U Trai Badonbor Baroh ha Shiloh ; ha kaba u Shophan bad u Peninnah , ki ar ngut ki khunlung shynrang u Eli , ki long ki Lyngdoh jong U Trai .
translation.en: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the  Lord  of hosts in Shiloh . And the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , the priests of the  Lord  , were there .
And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly , he said unto him ,  Thou art not far from the kingdom of God .  And no man after that durst ask him any question .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi katno u la long uba stad ha ka jingjubab jong u , bad kumta U la ong ïa u ,  Mem long jngai na ka Hima U Blei .  Hadien kane , ym don shuh mano mano ba nud ban kylli kino kino ki jingkylli ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband , so have ye dealt treacherously with me , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei kum ka tnga ka bymïaineh , pham shym la ïaineh ha nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites .
translation.kha: U mane ïa ka Astarte ka blei ki Sidon , bad ïa u Molekh u blei ba-ijli jong ki Ammon .
Pha sa punkhun bad phan kha ïa u khun , bad phan kyrteng ïa u , U Jisu! .
translation.en: And , behold , thou shalt conceive in thy womb , and bring forth a son , and shalt call his name JESUS .

So when they had dined , Jesus saith to Simon Peter ,  Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me more than these ?  He saith unto him , Yea , Lord  ; thou knowest that I love thee . He saith unto him ,  Feed my lambs .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la dep bam , U Jisu u la ong ïa u Simon Petros ,  Ko Simon , u khun jong u Jona , me kham ieit ma me ïa nga ban ïa kaba kine kiwei ki ieit ?   Ho-oid , ko Trai ,  u la jubab ,  me tip ba nga ieit ïa me .  U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To sumar ïa ki khunlangbrot jong nga .

Ka jingjynjar kan Bud kawei haduh kawei pateng , ka khubor basniew kan ïai tuid . Phin kyrpad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban ïathuh ïa kaei kaba ki ïohi lypa . Ki lyngdoh kin ym don ei ei shuh ban hikai ïa ki briew , bad ki tymmen ki San kin ym don jingsneng jingrung shuh ban ai .
translation.en: Mischief shall come upon mischief , and rumour shall be upon rumour  ; then shall they seek a vision of the prophet  ; but the law shall perish from the priest , and counsel from the ancients .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Is the  Lord s  hand waxed short ? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not .
translation.kha: Hato don u pud ïa ka bor jong nga ?  U  Trai  u jubab .  Men sa ïohi shen la kata kaba nga la ong kan urlong ne em !

translation.en: He taught me also , and said unto me , Let thine heart retain my words : keep my commandments , and live .
translation.kha: I ju ong ,  Kynmaw bha ïa kaba nga ong bad wat klet ïa ka lano lano ruh . Leh kumba nga ong ïa phi , bad phin im .

translation.en: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight , as stuff for removing : and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight , as they that go forth into captivity .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang shai , to teh ïa ka song jong me na ka bynta ka jingshah ringmraw , khnang ba kin lah ban ïohi ïa me , bad nangta shah ïa ki ban khmih ïa me ba me mihnoh ha ka premmiet kumba me leit sha ka jingshah ringmraw .

translation.en: The isles saw it , and feared  ; the ends of the earth were afraid , drew near , and came .
translation.kha: Ki briew na ki ri bajngai ki la ïohi kaei ba nga la leh ; ki da sheptieng bad khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Kumta ki la ïalumlang baroh bad ki ïawan .
U Tharai u pynbeit ïa kito kiba u ieit , kumba u kpa u pynbynta ïa u khun ïa uba u sngewsarong .
translation.en: For whom the  Lord  loveth he correcteth  ; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth .

translation.kha: Kane ka dih ka jingthmu jong nga ïa ka pyrthei , bad ka ïa ka kti jong nga la kner ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth : and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations .

translation.kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki reng kiba me la ïohi , bad u mradkhlaw , kmen isih ïa ka nuti ; ktien sa knieh noh ïa kaei kai Baroh kaba ka don bad kin iehnoh lyngkhot ïa ka ; kin bam ïa ka doh jong ka bad kin pynjot ïa ka da ka ding .
translation.en: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast , these shall hate the whore , and shall make her desolate and naked , and shall eat her flesh , and burn her with fire .

translation.kha: Phi tipthuh ïa ka jingbam kaba bang dei haba phi la mad ïa ka , hynrei kam long Kumta ïa ki kyntien kiba stad haba phi ïohsngew ïa ki .
translation.en: For the ear trieth words , as the mouth tasteth meat .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , la pynmatlah ïa ki khmat u Sedekaïah bad la teh ïa u da ki kynjri ban rah ïa u sha Babilonia .
translation.en: Moreover he put out Zedekiah s eyes , and bound him with chains , to carry him to Babylon .
These twelve Jesus sent forth , and commanded them , saying ,  Go not into the way of the Gentiles , and into any city of the Samaritans enter ye not :
translation.kha: Ïa kine ki khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , U Jisu u la phah noh lem bad kine ki jingbthah harum :  Wat leit sha kano kano ka thain jong ki Jentil lane sha kano kano ka shnong ki nong Samaria .

translation.en: And Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria . And Jehu wrote letters , and sent to Samaria , unto the rulers of Jezreel , to the elders , and to them that brought up Ahab s children , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki don hynñiewphew ngut ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem Ahab kiba shong basah ha ka nongbah Samaria . U Jehu u thoh ka shithi bad u la phah ïa ki kopi jong ka sha ki nongsynshar jong ka nongbah , sha ki riewpawkhmat , bad sha ki nongsumar ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahab .

translation.en: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted , and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost , he hath shed forth this , which ye now see and hear .
translation.kha: La kyntiew ïa u sha ka liang kamon jong U Blei , U Kpa jong u , bad u la ïohpdiang na u ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid , kumba u la lah kular . Kaei kaba phi ïohi bad ïohsngew mynta ka long ka jingai sngewbha kaba u la theh noh ha ngi .

Shaphang ka jwat Libni u ong , Ko Trai , to pynpaw ïa la ka mon da u Urim bad u Thummim Lyngba ki Lebi , ki shakor kiba ïaineh jong me . Me la tynjuh ïa ki ha Massah , Bad me la phrang ïa ki ha ki um ka Meribah .
translation.en: And of Levi he said , Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one , whom thou didst prove at Massah , and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah  ;

And at that time shall Michael stand up , the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people : and there shall be a time of trouble , such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time : and at that time thy people shall be delivered , every one that shall be found written in the book .
translation.kha: U angel uba kup ki jaiñ linen u la ong ,  Ha kata ka por , u Mikhael , u angel uba khraw , uba ïada ïa ki briew jong me , un mihpaw . Nangta kan don ka por ki jingjynjar , kaba kham sniew tam naduh ba ki jaitbynriew ki mih . Haba kata ka por ka wan , baroh ki briew jong ka jaitbynriew jong me kiba ïa ki kyrteng jong ki la thoh ha ka kitab ka jong U Blei yn pynim .
Ha wer kiba dei ban ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaweh u kular , U Blei u kwah ban pynkhaw-eit shai ba un ym pynkylla ïa ki jingthmu jong u ; kumta u wanrah de ïa ka jingsmai ha ka jingkular .
translation.en: Wherein God , willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel , confirmed it by an oath :

And it came to pass in the morning that his spirit was troubled  ; and he sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt , and all the wise men thereof : and Pharaoh told them his dream  ; but there was none that could interpret them unto Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Ynda mynstep u la sngewkhuslai ; kumta u phah khot ïa ki nongleh myntor bad ïa ki riewstad baroh jong ka ri Ijipt . U ïathuh ha ki ïa la ki jingphohsniew , hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba lah ban batai ïa ki ha u .
Haba ka nongai ka ïoh ba ka Ruth ka la kut jingmut skhem Ban leit bad ka , kai shym ong ei ei shuh .
