translation.en: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her , then she left speaking unto her .

translation.kha: U Trai u long baroh kaba nga ba-don , malu kumta nga buh ïa la ka jingkyrmen ha u .
translation.en: The  Lord  is my portion , saith my soul  ; therefore will I hope in him .

translation.kha: Shi sngi hadien ka thma ki Philistia ki leit ban lute na ki metïap , ki paw ïa ki metïap jong u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u lai ngut ba ki Thiah ïap ha Lem Gilboa .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , when the Philistines came to strip the slain , that they found Saul and his three sons fallen in mount Gilboa .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Sa katno kine ki briew’ keiñ kyntait ïa nga ? Sa katno ruh kin kyntait ngab shaniah ha nga , wat la nga la leh bun ki kambah Hapdeng jong ki ?
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , How long will this people provoke me ? and how long will it be ere they believe me , for all the signs which I have shewed among them ?

translation.kha: Hooid , ki anna ki jingdawa Kiba ngi tap ban pynbiang ïada im kwah ban im jongno la jymphong ha ka Paradais ban sa wanpaw ha ka Pyrthei .
translation.en: Of course , there are requirements to be met if we are to live forever in the coming Paradise on earth .
The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another  ; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another .
translation.kha: Bteng lang san tylli na ki ba kin long kawei ka jingkah , bad leh kumjuh ïa ki san tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah .
Haba u Iso u la sngewkwah ïa kano , u lynñiar khem bad ïakhmih ruh , bad u ong , Ko Pa ! to ai ha na ruh ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong me .
translation.en: And when Esau heard the words of his father , he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry , and said unto his father , Bless me , even me also , O my father .

Make the heart of this people fat , and make their ears heavy , and shut their eyes  ; lest they see with their eyes , and hear with their ears , and understand with their heart , and convert , and be healed .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ïa nga ,  Pynbthi ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong kine ki briew , pynkyllut ïa ki shkor jong ki , bad pynmatlah ïa ki khmat jong ki , ba kumta kin ym lah ban ïohi lane ïohsngew lane sngewthuh . Lada ki leh kumta , ki lah ban phai sha nga bad ïoh jingkhiah .

Nangta u angel uba san u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka khet jong u mradkhlaw . Ka jingdum ka la tap ïa ka hima jong u mradkhlaw , bad ki briew ki la dait ïa la ki thylliej namar ka jingpang jrong ki ,
translation.en: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast  ; and his kingdom was full of darkness  ; and they gnawed their tongues for pain ,

translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw phi dei ban kohnguh ïa ki bor synshar — ym tang namar ka jingpynshitom U Bel , hynne na ka bniat ka jingïatiplem ruh .
translation.en: Wherefore ye must needs be subject , not only for wrath , but also for conscience sake .

translation.kha: U Moses u shim ïa ka umphniang pynsleh bad pynïadait ka snam kaba don ha ka duwan bad u synrai ïa ki ha u Aaron sad ha ki khun shynrang jongno u bad ha ki jaiñkup jong ki . Ha kano ka man u pynkyntang ïa ki Bad ïa ki jaiñ jong ki shaw U Trai .
translation.en: And Moses took of the anointing oil , and of the blood which was upon the altar , and sprinkled it upon Aaron , and upon his garments , and upon his sons , and upon his sons  garments with him  ; and sanctified Aaron , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons  garments with him .

translation.kha: U ju u la pyrta ha ka sur bajam , Ko Pa ! Ha ki kti jongki me nga aiti ïa la ka mynmiet ! U la ong ïa kane bad u la ïap .
translation.en: And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice , he said ,  Father , into thy hands I commend my spirit :  and having said thus , he gave up the ghost .

translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba arphew san snieh , bad u synshar khathynriew snieh ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dadien ka Jerusha ka khun jong u Sadok .
translation.en: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jerusha , the daughter of Zadok .
And the second lot came forth to Simeon , even for the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families : and their inheritance was within the inheritance of the children of Judah .
translation.kha: Ka jingsam kaba ar ka long na ka bynta ki longïing na ka jait Simeon . Ka jaka jong ki ka ïar shaduh ka ri kaba la ai ha ka jait Judah .

translation.en: They shall be carried to Babylon , and there shall they be until the day that I visit them , saith the  Lord   ; then will I bring them up , and restore them to this place .
translation.kha: Yn sa rah ïa ki sha Babilonia bad kin sah hangta tad haduh ba ngan da phai ka jingmut jong nga sha ki . Nangta ngan wallam pat ïa ki bad buh biang ïa ki ha kane ka jaka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power , resisteth the ordinance of God : and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrshah ïa ka bor kaba synshar , u pyrshah ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la hukum ; bad uno uno uba leh kumta un wallam ka jingbishar pynrem halor lade hi .
hynñiew ngan ap khmih ïa U Trai ; ngan ap skhem ïa U Blei , u don pyllait im ïa nga . U Blei jong nga un sngur ïa nga .
translation.en: Therefore I will look unto the  Lord   ; I will wait for the God of my salvation : my God will hear me .
Neither pray I for these alone , but for them also which shall believe on me through their word  ;
translation.kha: Nga duwai ym tang na ka bynta jong ki , hynrei na ka bynta kito ruh kiba ngeit ha nga namar ka khubor jong ki .

translation.en: Yea , I attended unto you , and , behold , there was none of you that convinced Job , or that answered his words :
translation.kha: Nga la shahshkor bha bad shem ba phi la bakla ; phim shym lah ban pynduh nia ïa kaei kaba u Job u la ong .

U la leit sha u syiem Dabid bad u ong , Syiem kynrad , nga la ai pynkhap jingkhynñiuh ïa la ki langbrot . ithuh ma pa’ bad ki rangbah synshar jong phi phin wan bad sping bynta ha ka jingïaleh-sngewbha ?
translation.en: And Absalom came to the king , and said , Behold now , thy servant hath sheepshearers  ; let the king , I beseech thee , and his servants go with thy servant .

translation.kha: Da kaba ong ka jutang bathymmai , U Blei u la pynlong riam ïa kata kaba nyngkong ; bad kano kano kaba kylla rim bad kai tymmen kan sa jah noh shen .
translation.en: In that he saith , A new covenant , he hath made the first old . Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away .

translation.kha: Doeg ma Phin ! Phibi pyrshang ban pyntngen ïa nga ha ka jinglait ! baroh ka ïajubab ba phi ai ka long ka jingshukor !
translation.en: How then comfort ye me in vain , seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood ?

translation.kha: Haba u Man u la dap shispah laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun Shynrang uba Syria ïa u bad u la kyrteng ïa u , u Seth .
translation.en: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years , and begat a son in his own likeness , after his image  ; and called his name Seth :

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa kito kiba idei ban long ki nongïalam — nga ong ïa kane namar kam pher ei ei ïa nga la ki long kiba kumno kumno ruh ; U Blei um bishar na ki durkhmat bashabar — iar ki nongïalam , nga ong , kim don ei ei ki jingai jingmut bathymmai na ka bniat jong to .
translation.en: But of these who seemed to be somewhat , (whatsoever they were , it maketh no matter to me : God accepteth no man s person :) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me :

translation.kha: Ka kynrup kan khyllem , malu wai uwei baroh un kylli ïa phi kaba bha aïu ka la Long da ka jingpushara lieh .
translation.en: Lo , when the wall is fallen , shall it not be said unto you , Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it ?
And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king s meat .
translation.kha: Haba ka por ka la kut , ki la kham i khiah krat bad kham khlaiñ ban ïa kito baroh kiba la bam ïa ka jingbam syiem .

Nga la leh mynleh kum u beit — hynrei phi la pynlong ïa por pun leh kumta . Dang ma phi kiba la dei ngab pynnep ïa ka jingmynjur jong phi! ïa nga . Naba wat lada ngam long ei ei , ngam shym duna ei ei na kita ki apostol naba khim kyrpang jong phi .
translation.en: I am become a fool in glorying ; ye have compelled me : for I ought to have been commended of you : for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles , though I be nothing .

translation.kha: To ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi Bad U Jisu kyrshut suba U Trai’ jong sem un ai ha pa’ ka jingtei bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Ar ngut na moi ki hynñiewphew ngat ki nongïalam , u Eldad bad u Medad , ki sah ha ka khang shong dara malu kim shym la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ . Hangta ha ka khak shong dara , tala ka bor mynsiem ka wan ha ki , bad ki ruh ki sdang ban pyrta jam khem ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But there remained two of the men in the camp , the name of the one was Eldad , and the name of the other Medad : and the spirit rested upon them  ; and they were of them that were written , but went not out unto the tabernacle : and they prophesied in the camp .

translation.kha: u Emerald , u Sapphir , bad u Elmadam ha ka kyrdon kaba ar ;
translation.en: And the second row shall be an emerald , a sapphire , and a diamond .

translation.kha: Mynta to shahshkor , ko Job , ïa Kaei kaba nga tip ngan ïathuh .
translation.en: I will shew thee , hear me  ; and that which I have seen I will declare  ;

translation.kha: Katno kiba khraw ki long ki jingphylla jong U balui kiba u pyn-i ha ngi ! Katno kiba khrawbor ki long ki kambah kiba u leh ! U blang u long u syiem jingmut ; un syiar ha ki nga baroh .
translation.en: How great are his signs ! and how mighty are his wonders ! his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom , and his dominion is from generation to generation .

translation.kha: kiba shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad kiba knieh noh ïa ki ïing jong ki , bad nangta kiba pyn-i paidbah da naba duwai jrong ! Ka jingpynshitom ïa ki kan long kaba kham shyrkhei !
translation.en: Which devour widows  houses , and for a shew make long prayers : the same shall receive greater damnation .

translation.kha: bad Rakal ; sha ki kur u Jeremoth , sha ki Ken ,
translation.en: And to them which were in Rachal , and to them which were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites , and to them which were in the cities of the Kenites ,

translation.kha: hynrei U Blei un ym iehnoh ïa kiba shaniah ha u ne um ju ai jingïarap ïa ki riewbymman .
translation.en: Behold , God will not cast away a perfect man , neither will he help the evil doers :

translation.kha: Ki briew ka saihon ki lehkmen , bad ki nongbah ka Judah ki shadkmen namar ki jingbit Jong me , A Trai .
translation.en: Zion heard , and was glad  ; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments , O  Lord .

translation.kha: men la ka jingkynjah kaba Phi la mad ka long kata kaba ju wan ha ki briew . Hynrei U Blang u long uba bat ïa la ka kular , bad un ym shah ban tynjuh ïa phi sha Palat ka tam jong phi ba phin ïoh ïaineh skhem ; ha ka por ba ph shiah tynjuh , un ai ha phi ïa ka bor ba pa’ lah ban shah ïa ka , Bad kumta un thaw ïa ka syn ba phi lah ban mait na ka .
translation.en: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man : but God is faithful , who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able ; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape , that ye may be able to bear it .

translation.kha: U Ujuh u la jubab , Utai umbah wieh ïa u kpu ha ka pliang lem bad nga , un shetkylla ïa to .
translation.en: And he answered and said ,  He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish , the same shall betray me .
Persia , Ethiopia , and Libya with them  ; all of them with shield and helmet :
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na Persia , Sudan bad na Libya ki don bad u , bad baroh ki don ki stieh bad ki jingda khlieh .
Nangta u Solomon u leit sha Esiongeber malu sha Elath , ki kadlieng harud ka kumjuh Duriaw Akaba , ha ri ki Edom .
translation.en: Then went Solomon to Ezion–geber , and to Eloth , at the sea side in the land of Edom .

translation.kha: Kaei kambah ai jingim dei U Mynsiem jong U Blei ; ka ba briew Kam myntoi ei ei umdih em . Ki ktien Ibbah nga la kren ha phi ki Wallam ïa U Mynsiem ba ai jingim jyllang U Blei .
translation.en: It is the spirit that quickeneth  ; the flesh profiteth nothing : the words that I speak unto you , they are spirit , and they are life .

translation.kha: Katno sa da khih ban don ki ïa-ban kynruh ïa ki ktien jong nga bad ban buh jingthoh ïa ki ha ka kitab !
translation.en: Oh that my words were now written ! oh that they were printed in a book !

translation.kha: ym dei ban ieh ïa ka metïap hangta baroh shi miet . Tep ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi , namar ka metïap kaba sdien ha u ding ka longïng ka jingtim U Blei , khnang ba phin ym pynngat ïa “kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai ha phira .
translation.en: His body shall not remain all night upon the tree , but thou shalt in any wise bury him that day  ; ( for he that is hanged is accursed of God  ; ) that thy land be not defiled , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance .
And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth , blood , and fire , and pillars of smoke .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ki jingmaham shaphang kata ka sngi ha ka suiñbneng bad ha ka khyndew ; kan don ka jingumsnam , ka ding bad ki lyoh tdem .
U Jisu u la btin , Hangto ju don uno un uba wallam ïa ka sharak bad buh ïa ka hapoh ka shang lane ha khrum jingthiah ? hato um buh ïa ka ha u diengpynïeng sharak ?
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel , or under a bed ? and not to be set on a candlestick ?

translation.kha: U Iso u ïai kyrpad ha la u kpa . Ko Pa , hab phi don tang katai ka jingkynduh ? Pa , to kyrkhu ïa nga ruh ! U la sdang ban ïam .
translation.en: And Esau said unto his father , Hast thou but one blessing , my father ? bless me , even me also , O my father . And Esau lifted up his voice , and wept .

translation.kha: U TRAI’ u la ong , Kine ki briew ki ong ba ki mane ïa nga , hynrei ki ktien jong ki Ki don jingmut ei ei , nabar ki angnud jongnga ki , ki long shawei patar . Ka myn Jong ki kam long ei ei , hynrei ka long tang ki aiñ dara ki rukom briew , kiba ki shu spel lyndet .
translation.en: Wherefore the Lord said , Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth , and with their lips do honour me , but have removed their heart far from me , and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men :

translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua u ong ha ki bani Israel , Sa katno phin ap ha shwa ban phan shok sad shim kyntien ïa ka ri kaban U TRAI’ , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u la ai ha phi ?
translation.en: And Joshua said unto the children of Israel , How long are ye slack to go to possess the land , which the  Lord  God of your fathers hath given you ?

translation.kha: Hynrei u Onan u la tip ba ki khun kin ym long ki jong u , kumta hajan u ïathaw shongkha bad ka tnad u hynmen jong u , u pynhap ne ïa la u symbai sharud , Haneng ban yn ym pynïaid khun ïa u ingmane jong u .
translation.en: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his  ; and it came to pass , when he went in unto his brother s wife , that he spilled it on the ground , lest that he should give seed to his brother .

translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ki briew ka Judah bad Bamaïan ki la ïohsngew ba kita kba la wan phai pat na ka jingshah ringmraw ki dang ïatei patiaw ïa ka Templ U Trai , U Blang ki Israel .
translation.en: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the  Lord  God of Israel  ;
He that overcometh , the same shall be clothed in white raiment  ; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life , but I will confess his name before my Father , and before his angels .
translation.kha: Ïa kito kiba ïoh ka jingjop yn pynkup ïa ki kumne ha ki jaiñkup balieh , bad ngan ym weng noh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki na ka kitab jong kiba im . Ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Kpa jong nga bad ki angel jong u , ngan pynbna paidbah ba ki long ki jong nga .
Ngan pynthymmai ïa ka jutang jong por mala phar , bad phan tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And I will establish my covenant with thee  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Ma phi ki briew phi la kyntait ïa nga ; phoi la pynphai ïa la ki ingdong sha de . Kumta nga la kner ïa la ka katei bad pynlwet ïa pa’ namar nga la thait ban teh lakam ïa ka jingbitar jong por .
translation.en: Thou hast forsaken me , saith the  Lord  , thou art gone backward : therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee , and destroy thee  ; I am weary with repenting .

translation.kha: Ha ka por shithi synñia nga khie ban ïaroh ïa me namar ki jingsah hok jongno me .
translation.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments .
For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the  Lord  , in walking in the way of Jeroboam , and in his sin which he did , to make Israel to sin .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia namar ki pop jong u pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Kum u Jeroboam uba ha shuwa jong u , u la pynsngewsih ïa U  Trai  da ki pop jong u hi bad da kaba ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
baroh phim kiei kiew ki wang napoh u briew bun pynjrong bymkhuid ïa u .
translation.en: All these evil things come from within , and defile the man .

O  Lord  , my strength , and my fortress , and my refuge in the day of affliction , the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth , and shall say , Surely our fathers have inherited lies , vanity , and things wherein there is no profit .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me long uta uba ïada ïa nga bad uba ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ; me ïarap ïa nga ha ki por jingjynjar . Ki jaitbynriew kin wan sha me na kiba kut jong ka pyrthei bad ong ,  Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la don ei ei hynrei tang ki blei thala , ym don ei ei hynrei tang ki bleithaw bymmyntoi .
Katba nga nang peit ïa kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw , nga la ïohi saw tyrnem ki shalyntem ba ki Hiar ha ka khyndew , kawei kawei marsyndah bad ki .
translation.en: Now as I beheld the living creatures , behold one wheel upon the earth by the living creatures , with his four faces .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Nga la leh ïa kawei ka kambah , bad baroh phi ïa-sngewlyngngoh .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I have done one work , and ye all marvel .
For as many of you as have been baptized into Christ have put on Christ .
translation.kha: Naba ki ba bun na phi , ba la pynbaptis ha U Khrist , bad la pynkup ïa phi da U Khrist hi .
Nangta u la hukum ïa la ki briew ban sdang ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah , laiñ bad ka kynhun shipai kaba ïaid ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai .
translation.en: And he said unto the people , Pass on , and compass the city , and let him that is armed pass on before the ark of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la ïalam bad u ïa u Paul , u Jakob , bad u Ïing . Ka jingjynjar mynsiem bad ka jingsngewkhuslai ki la wan ha u ,
translation.en: And he taketh with him Peter and James and John , and began to be sore amazed , and to be very heavy  ;
When Jesus understood it , he said unto them ,  Why trouble ye the woman ? for she hath wrought a good work upon me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki ïakren , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Balei ba phi pynsalia ïa kane ka briew ? Ka long kaei kaei kaba biang bad kaba itynnat ba ka la leh na ka bynta jong nga .
Ki briew kiba shemphang ki long borabor kiba thrang bad ba kloi ban shah hikai .
translation.en: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge  ; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge .

translation.kha: La mawria ruh , kiba na ka jait Lebi ki don ka hok ban thied bapaw ha kano kano ka por ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki , kiba don ha ki shnong ba la ai ha ki .
translation.en: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites , and the houses of the cities of their possession , may the Levites redeem at any time .

translation.kha: Nangta ha ka jingainong jingset u paidbah , u Solomon u leit bad u ïeng ha khmat ka jingset , u rah ïa la ki kti ,
translation.en: And Solomon stood before the altar of the  Lord  in the presence of all the congregation of Israel , and spread forth his hands toward heaven :

That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks , rams , lambs , with their meat offerings and their drink offerings , and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynlut ha ka rukom kaba dei ïa kane ka pisa bad ban thied ki masi kyrtong , ki langbrot shynrang , ki khunblang , u kew bad ka waiñ bad ban ainguh ïa ki ha ka duwan jong ka Templ ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the officers shall speak further unto the people , and they shall say , What man is there that is fearful and fainthearted ? let him go and return unto his house , lest his brethren s heart faint as well as his heart .
translation.kha: Kita ki rangbah synshar kin ong ruh ha uta u paidïapom , ‘ Don mo hangne uba sheptieng bad uba rit mynsiem ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïing , ïoh ba u pynsyier mynsiem ïa kiwei pat .’

Haba ki rangbah ki la sdang ban tei ïa ka nongrim jngai ka Templ , ki lyngdoh ha ki jingriam lad ki , ki ïeng ha la ki jaka bad ki turoi ha ki kti jong ki , bad ki Lebi jong ka kur Salaph ki ïeng hangta ryngkat bad ki shakuriaw . Ki ïaroh ïa U Trai kat kum ki jingthiah ba la ai pateng naduh ka por u syiem Dabid .
translation.en: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the  Lord  , they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets , and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals , to praise the  Lord  , after the ordinance of David king of Israel .

translation.kha: Ïa ka khleiñ jong uno uno u jait mrad uba shu ïap hi ne uba la shah pyndap ha u mradkhlaw ym dei ban bam , hynrei lah ba pyndonkam na ka bynta kiwei pat ki jingthmu .
translation.en: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself , and the fat of that which is torn with beasts , may be used in any other use : but ye shall in no wise eat of it .
And he saith unto me , The waters which thou sawest , where the whore sitteth , are peoples , and multitudes , and nations , and tongues .
translation.kha: U angel u la ong ruh ha nga ,  Ki um ïa kiba me la ïohi , ha kaba kata ka nuti ka shong , ki long ki jaitbynriew , ki paidlang , ki kynja bynriew bad ki jait ktien .
Iddo phi poi ha kata ka ri ba U Trai U blei jong phi u ai ha phi , wat pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh ibha ijli jong ki jaitbynriew kiba shongduh hangtai .
translation.en: When thou art come into the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations .

translation.kha: U Moses u pynkdang da kaba ong , Ki rangbah synshar jong phi baroh kin sa wan sha nga bad dem khrup ha khmat jong nga , bad kin sa kyrpad ïa nga ïa-ban ïalam noh ïa ki brup jong nga borbah bad ba-bang iehnoh . Hadien Kata ngan sa leit . ngat u Maaseïah u mihnoh na u Pharaoh da ka jingbitar bakhraw .
translation.en: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me , and bow down themselves unto me , saying , Get thee out , and all the people that follow thee : and after that I will go out . And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger .

translation.kha: U dei u syiem Hesekaïah uba set ïa ka jingmeng ka um na ka Umpohliew Sihon Bad pun pun ïa ka um ba kad tuid lyngba ka ja-um shad ka tduh hapoh ki kynroh jong ka Jeroboam .
translation.en: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon , and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David . And Hezekiah prospered in all his works .

translation.kha: Hynrei hato kane ka mut ba kaei kaba bha ka pynlong ïa ka jingïap ïa nga ? Ym kumta! Ka dei ka pop! kaba pynlong ïa kata ; da kaba pyndonkam ïa kaei kaban bha , ka pop ka la wallam ka jingïap ïa at , khñiang ba ïa kata ka jinglyngngoh pynshisha lad ka pop yn pynpoi . Bad kum , lyngba ka hukum , ïa ka pop la pynpaw ba ka long kaba kham shyrkhei .
translation.en: Was then that which is good made death unto me ? God forbid . But sin , that it might appear sin , working death in me by that which is good ; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful .
And it was revealed in mine ears by the  Lord  of hosts , Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die , saith the Lord  God  of hosts .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh da lade hi u la kren ha nga bad ong ,  Ïa kane kaba sniew jong ki yn ym map da lei lei katba ki dang im . Ma nga , U  Trai  U Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh nga la kren .

Ngan ym shim ei ei na ka bna ïa lade ; ngan pdiang tang ïa kata kaba ki briew jrong nga ki la pyndonkam . Hynrei shah ba ki paidlang jong nga , u Aner , u Eshkol , bad u Mamre ba kin shim ïa la ka pyntwa .
translation.en: Save only that which the young men have eaten , and the portion of the men which went with me , Aner , Eshcol , and Mamre  ; let them take their portion .

translation.kha: Nangta u Eliakim , u Shebna , bad u Joash ki ïathuh ïa u rangbah synshar , Kren ha ka ktien Aramaik ïa im’ , ko kynrad . Neng sngewthuh ïa ka . Wat kren ha ka ktien Hebru ; baroh ki briew ha ka kynroh ki ïasngap .
translation.en: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , and Shebna , and Joah , unto Rab–shakeh , Speak , I pray thee , to thy servants in the Syrian language  ; for we understand it : and talk not with us in the Jews  language in the ears of the people that are on the wall .

translation.kha: Baroh na ngi , Ngi dei ban bam bad dih nabar lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei . Ka dei ka jingai jongki U Blei .
translation.en: And also that every man should eat and drink , and enjoy the good of all his labour , it is the gift of God .

translation.kha: Baroh kita ki saw thlia ki jingthang bam , ki ba-don mar hynriew tylli ki tasngeng , bad ïa ki la tap da ki kham , shapoh malade shabar . Mynsngi bad mynmiet kim ju sangeh noh na kaba rwai : Bakhuid , bakhuid , bakhuid , long U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , umbah la long , uba long pynlang u baneh sa wan .
translation.en: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him  ; and they were full of eyes within : and they rest not day and night , saying , Holy , holy , holy , Lord God Almighty , which was , and is , and is to come .

translation.kha: Hynrei kine ar kim longsyiem kumjuh , namar ka jingai sngewbha jong U Blei kam long kum ka pop u Man . Ka long kaba shisha ba bun ki briew ki la ïap namar ka pop jong uta wai u briew . Hynrei ka jingaiei U Blei ka long kham khraw , bad kumno ruh ka jingai sngewbha ïa kba bun ki briew lyngngai ka jinghikai jong uta uwei u briew , U Jingsuk Khrist .
translation.en: But not as the offence , so also is the free gift . For if through the offence of one many be dead , much more the grace of God , and the gift by grace , which is by one man , Jesus Christ , hath abounded unto many .
So Abraham returned unto his young men , and they rose up and went together to Beer–sheba  ; and Abraham dwelt at Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: U Abraham u leit phai pat sha la ki shakri , bad ki ïaleit lang sha Beersheba , ha kaba u Abraham u shongneh hangta .
Ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ka ki long kum ki sing bakyrhuh ; ki nongbishar jyllang ka ki long kumno ki suri bathngan , kiba laiñ eh kat ngab pynsah sa tang ka shyieng haduh mynstep .
translation.en: Her princes within her are roaring lions  ; her judges are evening wolves  ; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow .
But I speak this by permission , and not of commandment .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa kane ym kum ka hukum , hynrei tang kum ka jingpyn-i .

translation.en: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah , they were thy merchants : they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices , and with all precious stones , and gold .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ki mar jong pha ki nongkhaïi ka Sheba bad Raamah ki ai kylliang da ki mawkordor , ka ksiar , bad ki musli musla bakynsai tam .
Ïa uwei pa uwei dei ban otsher , bad kane tista long ka dak kaba paw shabar ba-bang pyn-i ba ka jutang jong de bad me ka long kambah ïaineh junom .
translation.en: He that is born in thy house , and he that is bought with thy money , must needs be circumcised : and my covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant .

translation.kha: Nangta u lyngdoh un hukum ban pynïap ïa kawei na kita ki sih halor u khiew khihwin ha uba ei ka um kaba sngur na ka umpohliew .
translation.en: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water :

translation.kha: Hodaïah ba u la Long khuid biang , u dei ban ap hynñiew sngi bad nangta un leit sha ka phyllaw kaba kham shapoh jong ka Templ Bad ai ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka jingpynkhuid ïa u , khnap ba un lah ba shakri biang ha ka Thymmai . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translation.en: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary , unto the inner court , to minister in the sanctuary , he shall offer his sin offering , saith the Lord  God .
Then David sent home to Tamar , saying , Go now to thy brother Amnon s house , and dress him meat .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u phah ktien sha ka Tamar ha ka ïingsyiem :  Khie leit sha ka ïing u Amnon bad khreh katto katne ka jingbam ïa u .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers , that I will raise up thy seed after thee , which shall be of thy sons  ; and I will establish his kingdom .
translation.kha: Ynda me ïap bad tep ïa me bad ki kpa tymmen jong me , ngan pynlong syiem ïa uwei na ki khun jong me bad ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong u kaba khlaiñ .
Ki la pyntyllun noh ïa uta u mawkhang . U Jisu u la khmut shajrong bad u la nguh , Nga jaiñjot ïa me , ko Kpa , ba me shahshkor ïa nga .
translation.en: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid . And Jesus lifted up his eyes , and said ,  Father , I thank thee that thou hast heard me .
Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword , destroying it utterly , and all that is therein , and the cattle thereof , with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: pynïap lut khoit ïa ki briew baroh ha kata ka shnong bad ïa ki jingri jong ki baroh ruh . Pynjot de thiaw ïa kata ka shnong .

Lai sien shisnem , u Solomon u kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh pynïasuk ha kata ka duwan ba u la tei ha U Trai . U tdong ruh ïa ka jingiwbih ha khnam U Trai . Bad kumta u pyndep kaba tei ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto the  Lord  , and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before the  Lord . So he finished the house .

translation.kha: Ngan shah ruh ba ki nongshun jngai ki kin lute ïa baroh ka spah jong kane ka nongbeh bad kurup ïa ka jingdon jingong baroh , wiat ïa ki jingkynshew jong ki syiem ka Judah , bad kit noh ïa kiei kiei borbah shaw Babilonia .
translation.en: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city , and all the labours thereof , and all the precious things thereof , and all the treasures of the kings of Judah will I give into the hand of their enemies , which shall spoil them , and take them , and carry them to Babylon .

Yea , all Israel have transgressed thy law , even by departing , that they might not obey thy voice  ; therefore the curse is poured upon us , and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God , because we have sinned against him .
translation.kha: Ki Israel baroh ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong me bad ki kyntait ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba me la ong . Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , bad kumta me la wallam ha ngi ïa ki jingtim kiba la thoh ha Ka Aiñ u Moses , u shakri jong me .
To ïeng pliang ïa la ki dohnud sha U Blei ha bneng bad duwai ,
translation.en: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens .

translation.kha: Babha u Serubbabel u khun jong u Shealtiel bad u Joshua u khun jongki u Jehiskaïah ki la ïohsngew ïa ki khor , ki kdang don tei biang ïa ka Templ ha Jerusalem , bad ki ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïarap ïa ki .
translation.en: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem : and with them were the prophets of God helping them .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka par u syiar u kyn-ih ha ka sien kaba ar , bad u Petros u la kynmaw kumno ba U Ujuh u la kah ong ïa u , Shu ba u syiad un kyn-ih ar sien , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga . Bad u la pait ka dohnud bad u la lynnong kthang .
translation.en: And the second time the cock crew . And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him ,  Before the cock crow twice , thou shalt deny me thrice .  And when he thought thereon , he wept .
Now therefore beware , I pray thee , and drink not wine nor strong drink , and eat not any unclean thing :
translation.kha: Sumar ban ym dih waiñ lane dih kyiad , lane bam ïa kano kano ka bymkhuid ;

Pyndait ïa la ki waitlam ! u la law , pynlang ki la leh kumta . U Dabid ruh u la pyndait ïa la ka thnam bad u la mih lem bad kumba sawspah nguid ki rangbah jong u , da kaban iehnoh shadien ïa ki spah ngut lam bad ki jingkit jingbah .
translation.en: And David said unto his men , Gird ye on every man his sword . And they girded on every man his sword  ; and David also girded on his sword : and there went up after David about four hundred men  ; and two hundred abode by the stuff .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ka jait Issakhar ki wan bad ka Debir ; Ho-oid , ki Issakhar ki ïan bad u Barak ruh , Bad ki la bud ïa u sha ka them . Hynrei ki jait Reuben kim ïabeit jingmut , Kim shym lah ria ïa-ban ïawan .
translation.en: And the princes of Issachar were with Deborah  ; even Issachar , and also Barak : he was sent on foot into the valley . For the divisions of Reuben there were great thoughts of heart .

translation.kha: bad ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki la bret noh katto katne ki pyntwa jong ki tiar ki tar jong ka lieng .
translation.en: And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship .

translation.kha: Ïeng sharud na kine ki briew , dara ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki hangto hi . Baroh ar ngut ki la de khlup ha khyndew ,
translation.en: Get you up from among this congregation , that I may consume them as in a moment . And they fell upon their faces .
Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him , that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros u la pyn-i dak ïa u bad u la ong ,  Kylli ïa u ba u kren shaphang jongno .

translation.en: And he said , Draw not nigh hither : put off thy shoes from off thy feet , for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground .
translation.kha: Wat wan sha jan ,  ong U Blei .  Loit noh ïa la ki juti , namar me ïeng ha ka jaka kaba khuid .

translation.en: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth , when thou wast naked and bare , and wast polluted in thy blood .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingim ba-ijli jong pha kum ka nuti pham ju kynmaw shisien ruh ïa la ka jinglong khynnah — mynba pha long kaba lyngkhuit , bad ïaksaid ha la ka jong ka snam .

translation.en: And the Horites in their mount Seir , unto El–paran , which is by the wilderness .
translation.kha: bad ïa ki Hor ha ki lumbah jong ka Edom , bad ki thwet ïa ki haduh Elparan kaba harud ka ri shyiap .
Nga la ai ha me ïa ka hima jong u malu ïa ki tnga jong u ; nga la pynlong ïa me u syiemsad Hamor ki Jeraïah bad ki Judah . Lada Kanneh kam pat baklang , ngan jin da la ai shuh sa ar shah ïa me .
translation.en: And I gave thee thy master s house , and thy master s wives into thy bosom , and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah  ; and if that had been too little , I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things .
And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples , and said ,  Behold my mother and my brethren !
translation.kha: Nangta u la kdew sha la ki synran bad u la ong ,  Ha khmih ! Hangne ki long ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong nga !

translation.en: And they went to bury her : but they found no more of her than the skull , and the feet , and the palms of her hands .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba mih ban leit tep ïa ka , kim shem ei ei shuh lait tang ka shynrong khlieh jong ka bad ki shyieng kti bad shyieng kjat jong ka .
Hato khnai ka mut ba da kane ka jingngeit ngi kyndit noh ïa ka Hukum ? Em , ym kumta ; pynbang , ngi pynskhem ïa ka Hukum .
translation.en: Do we then make void the law through faith ? God forbid : yea , we establish the law .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , How long will this people provoke me ? and how long will it be ere they believe me , for all the signs which I have shewed among them ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Sa katno kine ki briew kin kyntait ïa nga ? Sa katno ruh kin kyntait ban shaniah ha nga , wat la nga la leh bun ki kambah hapdeng jong ki ?

translation.en: And the men of the place asked him of his wife  ; and he said , She is my sister : for he feared to say , She is my wife  ; lest , said he , the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah  ; because she was fair to look upon .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew hangta ki kylli shaphang ka tnga jong u , u jubab ba ka dei ka para jong u . Um shym ïathuh ba ka dei ka tnga jong u , namar u sheptieng ïoh ba ki briew hangta kin pynïap ïa u ban ïoh ïa ka Rebekka , kaba long kaba bhabriew eh .

translation.en: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid .
translation.kha: ( U Laban u ai ïa ka mraw jong u ka Silpah ha ka Leah ka khun jong u ban shakri ïa ka . )
Ki Ammon ki siew khajna ha u Ussaïah , bad u kylla long uba khlieh haduh katta sier ba ka nam jong u ka phriang wat shaduh sha Ieit .
translation.en: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah : and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt  ; for he strengthened himself exceedingly .

translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba U Trai u tlot palat ngab pynim ïa phi lane ba u kyllut palat ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang jong phi ban ïoh jingïarap !
translation.en: Behold , the  Lord s  hand is not shortened , that it cannot save  ; neither his ear heavy , that it cannot hear :

translation.kha: Me pynbudnam ïa ki lyer kum ki nongpruid jong me malade ki jingthaba leilieh kum ki shakri jong me .
translation.en: Who maketh his angels spirits  ; his ministers a flaming fire :
And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer unto a rough valley , which is neither eared nor sown , and shall strike off the heifer s neck there in the valley :
translation.kha: Kin leit ïalam ïa ka sha ka jaka kaba harud kawei ka wahduid ka bym ju rngad um , ha kaba ym pat ju don ba lur ne thung jingthung , bad hangta kin pynkheiñ ïa u ryndang jong ka .

translation.en: Can you lift the box ?
translation.kha: Phi lah ban rah ka synduk ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people , as he hath promised thee , and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments  ;
translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi U  Trai  u la pdiang ïa phi kum la ki jong ki briew , kumba u la kular ïa phi ; bad u hukum ïa phi ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh .

translation.en: And the king turned his face about , and blessed all the congregation of Israel : ( and all the congregation of Israel stood  ; )
translation.kha: Katba u paidbah u dang ïeng hangta , u Syiem Solomon u phai khmat sha ki bad pan ka jingkyrkhu U Blei halor jong ki .
Hynrei don ki nongjapan langbrot kiba wan beh noh ïa ki . Te u Mosah u leit ban ïada ïa ki bad u ïarap ai um ruh ïa ki jingri jong ki .
translation.en: And the shepherds came and drove them away : but Moses stood up and helped them , and watered their flock .

translation.kha: Balei ba shihajar kin shahjop tang ha uwei , bad shiphew hajar pat tang ha ki ar ngut ? U Trai U Balei jongu ki u la iaineh ïa ki , malade U Blei badonbor jong ki u la kyndat noh ïa ki ?
translation.en: How should one chase a thousand , and two put ten thousand to flight , except their Rock had sold them , and the  Lord  had shut them up ?

translation.kha: Ngan sa wanrah ha ki ïa ka jinglehkmen bad ka jingjahburom junom ïa kiba yn ym klet shuh .
translation.en: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you , and a perpetual shame , which shall not be forgotten .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh la pyrshah ïa u da katto katto-katne ngut ki rangbah kiba long ki dkhot ka synagog jong ki briew kiba la laitluid ( kumba la khiat ïa ki ) , ka kynruh ïa ki Jiw na Kyrini bad na Assyria . Ma ki bad kiwei pat ki Jiw na ki thiang ka Milkah bad Asia ki la ïasan ban ïasaidnia bad u Stephan .
translation.en: Then there arose certain of the synagogue , which is called the synagogue of the Libertines , and Cyrenians , and Alexandrians , and of them of Cilicia and of Asia , disputing with Stephen .

translation.kha: U la im ha ka jingïasylla bad U Blei , hynriew baroh kiwei pat , ki la erlangthari kiba sniew ha khmat U Blei , bad ka jingleh jubor ka la saphriang kyllaiñ .
translation.en: The earth also was corrupt before God , and the earth was filled with violence .

translation.kha: U pynïap ïa u masi lyngraw bad ïa u byrngut kum ka jingkñia ainguh ïakylli na ka bynta ki Baïap . Ki khun shynrang jongngi u ki wanrah ha u ïa ka snep , bad u theh ïa ka sawdong ka duwan .
translation.en: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings , which was for the people : and Aaron s sons presented unto him the blood , which he sprinkled upon the altar round about ,

translation.kha: ‘ Me dei uei , A Trai ?’ nga la kylli . ‘ Nga long U Jisu uba na Nasareth , ïa umbah me pynshitom beiñ ,’ u la ong ha nga .
translation.en: And I answered , Who art thou , Lord ? And he said unto me ,  I am Jesus of Nazareth , whom thou persecutest .

translation.kha: U blang um shem jied ïa moi ba shah ïa ka jingbitar jrong u , hynrei ban ïoh ïa ka jingpynksan lyngba U Jeshua Khrist uba U Trai lad I ,
translation.en: For God hath not appointed us to wrath , but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ ,

translation.kha: Ki leh kumba ki jingmong jong ki briew jong nga ki longïng tang ki jingtrud . ‘ Baroh ka bit ka biang ,’ ki ïong , haba baroh kam bitar kam biang .
translation.en: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly , saying , Peace , peace  ; when there is no peace .
As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather , and as vinegar upon nitre , so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart .
translation.kha: Kaba rwai jingrwai ha u briew uba khuslai mynsiem ka long kumba loit noh ïa ki jaiñ jong u ha ka por khriat lane kum kaba kyllan mluh ha ka jingmong .

Kito kiba long ki mraw ki Dei ban ñiut ba ki kyndiah jong ki , ki long kiba dem hok ban ïoh ïa ka burom baroh , Haneng ba yn ym don mano moi ki ban klun sniew ïa ka kyrteng U Blei bad ïa ka jinghikai jong ngi .
translation.en: Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour , that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed .

translation.kha: Nalorkata shim biang katto katne na ki , bret ïa ki ha ka ding , bad ai ba yn thang ïa ki . Na ki ka ding kan klang sha ka jaitbynriew Israel baïar kawei .
translation.en: Then take of them again , and cast them into the midst of the fire , and burn them in the fire  ; for thereof shall a fire come forth into all the house of Israel .

translation.kha: U Jotham u long syiem Haba u la don phraphew san snep ka rta , dara u synshar khynñiat snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka Dei ka Jerushah , ka khun jong u Sadok .
translation.en: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Jerusha , the daughter of Zadok .

translation.kha: Mynba na la don lem sad ki , nga la ri kyndong ïa ki da ka bol ka kyr-ang jong me , ka kyrteng kaba me la ai ha nga . Nga la ïada ïa ki , bad ym don aiwai ruh na ki uba la jah noh , loit tang u Briew naba la dei ban jah — khnang ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kan urlong shisha .
translation.en: While I was with them in the world , I kept them in thy name : those that thou gavest me I have kept , and none of them is lost , but the son of perdition  ; that the scripture might be fulfilled .

translation.kha: To map ïa ki pop jongngi ki briew jongki me bad wan ïabam biang ïa ki sha sier ka ri ïa kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tmier jong ki .
translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy people Israel , and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers .
For which I am an ambassador in bonds : that therein I may speak boldly , as I ought to speak .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta kane ka gospel , nga long u nongkit  tiensyiem wat la mynta nga don ha ïingbyndi . To duwai ba nga lah ban long uba shlur ha ka jingkren shaphang ka gospel kumba nga dei .

translation.en: And I appeared unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob , by the name of God Almighty , but by my name  Jehovah  was I not known to them .
translation.kha: Nga la mihpaw ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob , kum U Blei Badonbor Baroh , hynrei ngam shym la pynithuh ïa lade ha ki da ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , U  Trai .
Nangta kata ka brup ka la iehnoh ïa la u khiew um , ka la leit pah sha shnong , bad ka la ong ïa ki briew hangtei ,
translation.en: The woman then left her waterpot , and went her way into the city , and saith to the men ,

translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba nga la pyllait ïa ki paidbhur Jeruel na Jephthah haduh mynsiem , ngam pat ju shong ha ka templ ; sa la leit kylleng kylleng da kaba shong ha ka ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Israel out of Egypt , even to this day , but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle .

translation.kha: Katba u Jakob u dang shong dang sah ha kata ka ri , u Reuben u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka Bilhah , kawei na ki tnga kli jong u kpa jong u . U Jakob u la tip ïa kata bad u pita shla . U Jakob u don khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Israel dwelt in that land , that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father s concubine : and Israel heard it . Now the sons of Jacob were twelve :

translation.kha: Ha ki umpohliew ka Meribah ki briew ki la pynbitar ïa U Trai sad u Moses u la shem jingeh namar jong ki .
translation.en: They angered him also at the waters of strife , so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes :
Now Hannah , she spake in her heart  ; only her lips moved , but her voice was not heard : therefore Eli thought she had been drunken .
translation.kha: Ka la duwai jar jar : tang ki rmiang shyntur jong ka ki khih , hynrei kam shym pynmih sur ei ei . Kumta u Eli la u pyrkhat ba ka la buaid ,
Bad lada eit uno u kylli ïa phi balei phi leh ïa “kata , noh ïa u ba U Kynrad u donkam ïa u bad pun pynphai meng mar pat ïa u .
translation.en: And if any man say unto you , Why do ye this ? say ye that the Lord hath need of him  ; and straightway he will send him hither .
Thou hast moreover multiplied thy fornication in the land of Canaan unto Chaldea  ; and yet thou wast not satisfied herewith .
translation.kha: Pha la long ruh ka nuti ïa ki nong Babilonia , kata ka jaitbynriew ki nongkhaïi , hynrei kita ruh kim shym la pynhun ïa pha .
Haba ki la pra kham ha pajih na ka ïing , u Mikah u khot ïa ki pawnam ban leit ïaleh thom ïa ki . Ki lap ïa ki rangbah na de
translation.en: And when they were a good way from the house of Micah , the men that were in the houses near to Micah s house were gathered together , and overtook the children of Dan .
Ye shall conceive chaff , ye shall bring forth stubble : your breath , as fire , shall devour you .
translation.kha: Phi pynlong ïa ki jingthmu bymlarkam bad kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh ki long ki bym don jingmyntoi . U Mynsiem jong nga u long kum ka ding ka ban pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: Judgments are prepared for scorners , and stripes for the back of fools .
translation.kha: U bieit uba sngewmeng u thikna ban ïoh ïa ka jingshah sympat .
Ka Judah ka don ha ka jingïambriew ; ki nongbah jong ka ki la jan ïap , ki briew jong ka ki thiah ha madan ha ka jingsngewsih , bad ka Jerusalem ka kyang jam ban ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: Judah mourneth , and the gates thereof languish  ; they are black unto the ground  ; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up .

translation.kha: Wat ïeng ha ka lynti jong ngi bad wat kah ïa ka lynti ïaid jong ngi . Ngim kaweh ban ïohsngew shaphang U Blei Bakhuid jong phi ki Israel .
translation.en: Get you out of the way , turn aside out of the path , cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us .
But wilt thou know , O vain man , that faith without works is dead ?
translation.kha: Phi kiba bieit ! Hato phi kwah ban da pyn-i ba ka jingngeit khlem ki kam ka long ka bymmyntoi ?

Hynrei me pat , Moses , men sah hangne bad de , mala kan ai ha me ïa ki aiñ bad ki lawlynnong jong nga baroh . Hikai ïa ki ha u paidbah ba kin sumar bad leh ïa ki ha kata ka ri ïa kaba tun ai ha ki .’
translation.en: But as for thee , stand thou here by me , and I will speak unto thee all the commandments , and the statutes , and the judgments , which thou shalt teach them , that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it .

translation.kha: U Maaseïah um shym la ai Kane kano ka jaka ha ka jait lehbha . Kaba U Trai u la bthah ha u Moses , ki dei baneh pdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki , ïa ka bhah jong ki jingainguh ba la tdong ha ka duwan sha U Tharai U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance  ; the sacrifices of the  Lord  God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance , as he said unto them .
Thou shalt not lend upon usury to thy brother  ; usury of money , usury of victuals , usury of any thing that is lent upon usury :
translation.kha: Wat shim sut na la u para Israel haba phi ai ram , lane phi ai jingbam , lane phi ai shah ïa kaei kaei ha u .

un leit sha kata ka Eri ka jingainguh thang bad un pynkhuid ïa ka . U dei ïa-ban shem khyndiat na ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw bad khyndiat na ka snam jong uta u langsohmoh malu un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong kata ka duwan .
translation.en: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the  Lord  , and make an atonement for it  ; and shall take of the blood of the bullock , and of the blood of the goat , and put it upon the horns of the altar round about .
All the best of the oil , and all the best of the wine , and of the wheat , the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the  Lord  , them have I given thee .
translation.kha: Nga ai ha me ïa ki soh nyngkong kiba kynsai tam baroh na ka umphniang Olib , ka waiñ bad u kew ba ki Israel ki ai ïa nga man la ka snem .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Wherewith ? And he said , I will go forth , and I will be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . And he said , Thou shalt persuade him , and prevail also : go forth , and do so .
translation.kha: ‘ Kumno ?’ U  Trai  u kylli . U mynsiem u jubab , ‘ Ngan leit bad pynlong ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa u Ahab ban kren lamler . U  Trai  u ong , leit bad shukor ïa u . Phin sa jop .’

translation.en: Hear , O Israel : The  Lord  our God is one  Lord  :
translation.kha: To sngap ko ki Israel ! U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u long tang ma u hi U  Trai .

translation.en: But Jehoiada waxed old , and was full of days when he died  ; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la kynjoh ka rta kaba la tymmen bha haba u la don shispah laiphew snem , u la ïap .
Wat la ki Judia ki dem ki para ri jongngi ki , ki shipai Israel ki ring koidi ïa ki ar milian jngut ki kynthei bad khynnah bad ki rah ïa ki shat Samaria , lem bad ka jinglute kaba dara .
translation.en: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand , women , sons , and daughters , and took also away much spoil from them , and brought the spoil to Samaria .
And ye are complete in him , which is the head of all principality and power :
translation.kha: U long uba hakhlieh tam halor kawei pa kawei ka jingsynshar ba kynja mynsiem bad ka bor synshar .

Lada u nongïathuhlypa u kren ha ka kyrtong U Trai bad kata kaba u krai kam Shimham urlong , Katai kam dei ka khubor U Trai . Uta u nongïathuhlypa u la kruiñ na lade hi , bad phim dei ban sheptieng ïa u .
translation.en: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the  Lord  , if the thing follow not , nor come to pass , that is the thing which the  Lord  hath not spoken , but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously : thou shalt not be afraid of him .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Nga don ei ei ba ong shaphang ki paramarjan jong ka Israel kiba la pynjot ïa ka ri kambah nga la ai ha ki briew jong na ki Jesreel . Ngan shim noh ïa kito ki briew bymman na ki ri jong ki kum ïa u jingthung ba la rat , bad ngan pynkoit im ïa ka Judah na ki .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  against all mine evil neighbours , that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit  ; Behold , I will pluck them out of their land , and pluck out the house of Judah from among them .

translation.kha: To shahshkor mynta , bad maham ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , ong U Trai Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh ,
translation.en: Hear ye , and testify in the house of Jacob , saith the Lord  God  , the God of hosts ,
And I beseech you , brethren , suffer the word of exhortation : for I have written a letter unto you in few words .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ban shahshkor bha ïa kane ka khubor ka jingpynshlur ; naba kane ka shithi kaba nga la thoh sha phi kam da long kaba jrong eh .
Pynjot ïa ki kulai bad ki kali ïalam jong ka ! Ka Jingïap ïa ki shiphang ba shu wai — Katno ki long kiba tlot ! Pynjot ïa ki jingkynshew jong ka ; lute bad rong noh .
translation.en: A sword is upon their horses , and upon their chariots , and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her  ; and they shall become as women : a sword is upon her treasures  ; and they shall be robbed .

translation.kha: Ki Lehab ki rah ïa ka Synduk ka Ijon U Trai bad ïa tala ka synduk ha kaba dat kita ki dur kiba da ka ksiar bad ki buh ïa ki khashor uta u mawbah . Nangta ki nong Beth Shemesh ki kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ïa kiwei pat ki jingkñia ha U Tlai .
translation.en: And the Levites took down the ark of the  Lord  , and the coffer that was with it , wherein the jewels of gold were , and put them on the great stone : and the men of Beth–shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba jubab ïa ka jinglehkai u syiem , ka pynthiah ïa ka jingïathuhkhana u Gehasi , bad kumta u syiem u la khor ïa u rangbah synran bad ino ha u ba un pynphai pat ha ka ïa baroh naba dei ka jong ka , kynthup ïa ka dor jongki ki jingmih na ki lyngka baroh ha kita ki hynñiew snem kiba ka ei shawei patiaw .
translation.en: And when the king asked the woman , she told him . So the king appointed unto her a certain officer , saying , Restore all that was hers , and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land , even until now .
And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour : and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious , he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u long u samla uba dap shynrang , bad haba u Solomon u ïohi katno ba u long uba trei shitom , u buh ïa u ban pynïaid ïa ki nongtrei ba shu pynbor ha ka thain jong ki jait Manasseh bad Ephraim .

Lada phi tiengburom ïa U Trai , phin sharati ïa u , phi shahshkor ïa u , bad phin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , bad lada ma phi bad u syiem uba synshar ïa phi , phi brup ïa U Trei U Blei jong phin , baroh kun manbha bad Phin .
translation.en: If ye will fear the  Lord  , and serve him , and obey his voice , and not rebel against the commandment of the  Lord  , then shall both ye and also the king that reigneth over you continue following the  Lord  your God :

translation.kha: namar phim pat rung ha kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jyllang phi u ai ha phi , ha kaba phin ïoh shongkhet shongduh .
translation.en: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance , which the  Lord  your God giveth you .
And the people stood beholding . And the rulers also with them derided him , saying , He saved others  ; let him save himself , if he be Christ , the chosen of God .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la ïeng hangta da kaba khmih katba ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki krenbeiñ ïa u :  U la pynim ïa kiwei ; ai un pynim ïa lade lada u dei U Messaïah ïa uba U Blei u la jied !

Ki briew kiba la shahjop ki bieit marpyrshah ïa kiba jop ïa ki bad ki pyn-i jingsah ïa ki . Kin ong , Phi shim ïa kaei ka bym dei ka jong phi , hynrei phoi long ba la tim ! Katno slem phin ïailong kaba pynriewspah da kaba pynroh ïa ki nongshim ram jong phi ban siew noh ?
translation.en: Shall not all these take up a parable against him , and a taunting proverb against him , and say , Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his ! how long ? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay !

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Paul u la mihnoh na Athens sad u la lytar sha Korinth .
translation.en: After these things Paul departed from Athens , and came to Corinth  ;

translation.kha: Eliada phi long kiba beit , la ïalam ïa phi da ka jinglonghok . Ïa ki briew kiba ym lah ban shaniah la pynjot da ka jingbymhok jong ki hi .
translation.en: The integrity of the upright shall guide them : but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them .

translation.kha: Lada u briew um thombor ban wanrah ar tylli ki paro ne ar tylli ki lyngdkhur , un salm sei kilo u purew kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop . Um dei ban thoh Kane kano ka nongpynim Olib ne kano kano ka jingiwbih halor jong u , namar ka dei ka jingkñia nalor ka pop , ym ka jingkylla bam .
translation.en: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering  ; he shall put no oil upon it , neither shall he put any frankincense thereon : for it is a sin offering .

translation.kha: La kem ïa u bad la ïalam ïa u sha u Joshua .
translation.en: And the king of Ai they took alive , and brought him to Joshua .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la mih bad saw noh shat ka jaka kaweh hajan ka nongpang Tyros . U la leit sha kawei ka ïing bad um shym la kwah mano mano ban tip ba u don Hangta , hynrei ba u lah ïa-ban shong ha kaba rieh .
translation.en: And from thence he arose , and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon , and entered into an house , and would have no man know it : but he could not be hid .
The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up  ; his sin is hid .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbymman ki Israel bad ki pop jong ki la buh jingthoh , bad ïa ki jingthoh la buh bha khop .
Shabar kata ka kamar la don ruh saw tylli ki miej kiba long kumjuh , ar tylli ha khawai kawei ka liang jongngi ka khyrdop bashatei .
translation.en: And at the side without , as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate , were two tables  ; and on the other side , which was at the porch of the gate , were two tables .

Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread  ; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses : for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day , that soul shall be cut off from Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Hynñiew sngi lynter phin ym bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat — bam tang ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat . Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong phi dei ban bret noh ïa u thiat baroh na ïing jong phi , namar lada uno uno u bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat ha kita ki hynñiew sngi , yn ym kheiñ shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .
Ka biang ! u Dabid u jubab . Ngan ïateh kular bad phiah tang ha kawei ka kyndon : Phin dei ban wallam ïa ka Mikhal ka khun jong u Saul sha ar haba phi wan ïakynduh ïa nga .
translation.en: And he said , Well  ; I will make a league with thee : but one thing I require of thee , that is , Thou shalt not see my face , except thou first bring Michal Saul s daughter , when thou comest to see my face .

translation.kha: Katba u Samuel u dang im , um shym ïohi Shua ïa u Syiem ; hynrei u khuslai sat na ka bynta jong u . U Trai’ u la sngewsih ba u la thung ïa u Saul kum u syiem ki Israel .
translation.en: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death : nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul : and the  Lord  repented that he had made Saul king over Israel .

translation.kha: Hynñiew sien ki hynñiewphew snem ki long ka jingjlan jong ka por ba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta don pyllait im ïa ki briew jongnga me bad ïa ka nongbah bakhlaiñ jyllang me na ka jop bad ka jingsniew . Ïa ka thup yn map bad yn seng ïa ka jingbishar hok bymjukut , khnang ba ka jingïohipaw bad ka jingkhylliap kin wan urlong shisha , sad ïa ka Templ bakhuid yn pynkyntang biah .
translation.en: Seventy weeks are determined upon thy people and upon thy holy city , to finish the transgression , and to make an end of sins , and to make reconciliation for iniquity , and to bring in everlasting righteousness , and to seal up the vision and prophecy , and to anoint the most Holy .
But the Egyptians pursued after them , all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh , and his horsemen , and his army , and overtook them encamping by the sea , beside Pi–hahiroth , before Baal–zephon .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai Ijipt , lem bad ki kulai baroh , ki kali ïapom , bad ki nongñiah , ki la beh kthong ïa ki bad ki la lap ïa ki ha ka jaka ha kaba ki la sher dara harud ka Duriaw Basaw , hajan ka Pi Hahiroth bad ka Baal Sephon .

translation.en: When once the master of the house is risen up , and hath shut to the door , and ye begin to stand without , and to knock at the door , saying , Lord , Lord , open unto us  ; and he shall answer and say unto you , I know you not whence ye are :
translation.kha: U kynrad jong ka ïing un khie bad un khang ïa ka jingkhang ; nangta haba phi ïeng shabar bad sdang ban tied ha ka jingkhang bad ong , ‘ To plie ïa ka jingkhang na ka bynta jong ngi , ko kynrad !’ Un jubab ïa phi , ‘ Ngam ithuh ïa phi nangno phi ïawan !’

Ka Israel kan ïasoh bad ka Joïada , bad ryngkat lang kin ïawan na ka jingshah riewrangbah ha ka ri naba shatei Bad kin wan phai sha ka ri kaba at la ai ha ki kpa thymmei jong phi khim ka jingainong jingem Kaba neh .
translation.en: In those days the house of Judah shall walk with the house of Israel , and they shall come together out of the land of the north to the land that I have given for an inheritance unto your fathers .
Because thou sayest , I am rich , and increased with goods , and have need of nothing  ; and knowest not that thou art wretched , and miserable , and poor , and blind , and naked :
translation.kha: Pha ong , ‘ Nga long kaba riewspah bad kaba dap babiang ; nga don baroh kaba nga donkam .’ Hynrei pham tip haduh katno pha long kaba lanot bad kaba isynei ban khmih ! Pha long kaba duk , kaba lyngkhuit , bad kaba matlah .

Haba phi lym ïa ki jingmeng na ki lyngkha jong phi , wat ot ïa u kew uba ha tduh jongnga ki lynghoh , bad kam leit kylla den ban khar ïa ki shapoh kiba sah ; ïuh ïa ki na ka bynta katba tun bad ki nongwei ; Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land , thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest , neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest : thou shalt leave them unto the poor , and to the stranger : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Ko Syiem , kaei Kaba kine ki briew ki la leh ka long ka bym de . Ki la thep ïa u Jeremaïah ha ka pung , ha kaba , da shisha , un sa ïap ha ka jingïapthngan , namar ym don jingbam shuh ha ka nongbah .
translation.en: My lord the king , these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet , whom they have cast into the dungeon  ; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is : for there is no more bread in the city .
Be not forgetful to entertain strangers : for thereby some have entertained angels unawares .
translation.kha: Da kynmaw ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nongwei ha ki ïing jong phi . Don kiba la leh kumta bad pdiang sngewbha ïa ki angel khlem da tip ïa kata .

translation.en: We have dealt very corruptly against thee , and have not kept the commandments , nor the statutes , nor the judgments , which thou commandedst thy servant Moses .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh bymman pyrshah ïa me bad ngim shym la leh ïa kaei kaba me la hukum . Ngim shym la sumar ïa ki hukum kiba me la ai ha ngi lyngba u Moses , u shakri jong me .
Hato ni u briew , wat la u longsyiem uba stad tam , uba la ju long uba larkam na ka bynta U Blei ?
translation.en: Can a man be profitable unto God , as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself ?
And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward , even unto the sea of the plain , under the springs of Pisgah .
translation.kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa kata ka thain baroh kaba sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan haduh ka Duriaw Baïap kaba shaphang shathie , bad nangta haduh ka kjat lum Pisgah shaphang mihngi .
Kumta ki synñiang ki la sdang ba-bang ïakylli para ma ki hi , Katto la don mano mano ba la wanrah jingbam ïa u ?
translation.en: Therefore said the disciples one to another , Hath any man brought him ought to eat ?

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ma phi kiba dang khap samla phi donkam ban kohnguh ïa kiba la kham rangbah . Bad ma phi baroh ph dei ban phong ïa ka jaiñkup ka jingkerkut , ban shakri iwei ïa iwei pat ; namarba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , U blei u ïaleh pyrshah ïa kiba sarong , hynriewphew u pyn-i ïa ka jinglehsngewbha ïa kiba sngewrit .
translation.en: Likewise , ye younger , submit yourselves unto the elder . Yea , all of you be subject one to another , and be clothed with humility : for God resisteth the proud , and giveth grace to the humble .
So Jonah arose , and went unto Nineveh , according to the word of the  Lord . Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city of three days  journey .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jonah u la kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad u la leit sha Ninebeh , ka nongbah kaba heh haduh katta katta ba ka la shim por lai sngi ban ïaid lyngba jong ka .
Hynrei hadien lai sngi . U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u bad u la pynlong ïa u ban mihpaw ,
translation.en: Him God raised up the third day , and shewed him openly  ;

translation.kha: Nga tip , ka la jubab , ba un sa mihpat ha ka sngem kaba khatduh .
translation.en: Martha saith unto him , I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day .

translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno suba ïohsngew ïa ki kti jong nga bad u bymkohnguh ïa ki u erlangthari kum u bhabriew umbah la tei ïa la ka ïing khlem da pynshong nongrep ; haba ka jingshlei um ka lynshop ïa kata ka ïing , ka khyllem shisyndon — sad katno ka jingkhem kaba shynriah “kata ka la long !
translation.en: But he that heareth , and doeth not , is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth  ; against which the stream did beat vehemently , and immediately it fell  ; and the ruin of that house was great .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Pekah u khun jong u Raamah kum u syiem ka Israel , u Jotham u khulom jong u Ussaïah u long u Syiem ka Judah
translation.en: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong ar bad ma nga ngin leit tur sha ka nongbah . Haba ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki wan mian pyrshah ïa ngi , ngin phai dien bad ngin pui , kumba im la leh ha ka sien kaba nyngkong .
translation.en: And I , and all the people that are with me , will approach unto the city : and it shall come to pass , when they come out against us , as at the first , that we will flee before them ,

translation.kha: U para jong pha un sa im patiaw , U Jisu u la ong ha ka .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Thy brother shall rise again .

And I gave thee thy master s house , and thy master s wives into thy bosom , and gave thee the house of Israel and of Judah  ; and if that had been too little , I would moreover have given unto thee such and such things .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha me ïa ka hima jong u bad ïa ki tnga jong u ; nga la pynlong ïa me u syiem halor ki Israel bad ki Judah . Lada kane kam pat biang , ngan jin da la ai shuh sa ar shah ïa me .
Nga la ïamkthang namar ym shym lah ban smam ïa uno uno uba daym hok ban plied ïa ka kot kliar lane ban Khmih shaphang jong ka .
translation.en: And I wept much , because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book , neither to look thereon .
Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes , the captains thereof , and all the rulers thereof , and all the land of his dominion .
translation.kha: Pynkhreh ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia . Phah ïa ki syiem ka Media , ïa ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki , bad ki kynhun shipai jong ki ri baroh kiba ki synshar .
Ki longïng kiba tbit baroh ha kaba leh ïa kabu sniew . Ki rangbah synshar bad ki nongbishar ki bamsap . U briew uba lah u ong ha ki ïa katei kaba u kwah , dara kumta ki ïasylla lang .
translation.en: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly , the prince asketh , and the judge asketh for a reward  ; and the great man , he uttereth his mischievous desire : so they wrap it up .

translation.kha: Ym dat sha Kanah kano kabu dang sah na baroh kaba ine la ju sngewsarong . Ngi la leh pop bad mynta ngi long kiba la tim .
translation.en: The crown is fallen from our head : woe unto us , that we have sinned !

translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi . Ka sngi ka la jan , ha kaba ka jingïada ïathied lai ym don jingmut shiah , namar ka jingpyndonkam U Blei kan hap ha baroh kumjuh .
translation.en: The time is come , the day draweth near : let not the buyer rejoice , nor the seller mourn : for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof .

translation.kha: Me la leh ïa ki pop kiba khraw palat liam ba ïa kito kiba la synshar ha shuwa jongno me . Me la kyntait ïa de bad me la pynbitar lep ïa nga da kaba me thawsha ïa ki bleithaw bad ki dur ba la sha saiñ Ban mane .
translation.en: But hast done evil above all that were before thee : for thou hast gone and made thee other gods , and molten images , to provoke me to anger , and hast cast me behind thy back :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la nguh , Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingbishar : U briew u bym rung sha ka im’ ki langbrot na ka jingkhang , hynrei uba shu kiew nawei pat , u long u nongtuh Bad u nonglute .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold , but climbeth up some other way , the same is a thief and a robber .

translation.kha: Kumno ka jingruma ka pynwit ïa ka jingïohthiah jong nga .
translation.en: In thoughts from the visions of the night , when deep sleep falleth on men ,

translation.kha: Pynban ki briew jong nga ki la khet noh ïa nga ; ki stong jingiwbih ïa ki bleithaw . Ki la jynthut ha ka lyntang ba ki dei ban leit , kim shym bud shuh ïa ki lynti ba-mynshuwa ; ki ïadait ha ki lynti ba khlem buh dak .
translation.en: Because my people hath forgotten me , they have burned incense to vanity , and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths , to walk in paths , in a way not cast up  ;

translation.kha: Te u Manoah u duwai ha U Tiras , A Trai , nga kyrpad ba lad shah ïa u briew jong U Blei ïa uba me la phah ban wan ibiang sha ngi bad ban ong ïa I kaei ba ngin leh ïa uta u khunlung ynda la Kha ïa u .
translation.en: Then Manoah entreated the  Lord  , and said , O my Lord , let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us , and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la hiar na ka lieng , bad hab u la ïohi ïa u pynbah babun , ïa ka dohnud jong u la pyndap da ka jingisynei ïa ki , bad u la pynkhiah ïa kito kiba la pangnud .
translation.en: And Jesus went forth , and saw a great multitude , and was moved with compassion toward them , and he healed their sick .

translation.kha: Ko Job , haw me pyrkhat ba ngim lah ban jubab ïa me ? Ba ki kyntien beiñ jong me kin ieh ïa ngi ba-bang nam at kren-ïa shiah ?
translation.en: Should thy lies make men hold their peace ? and when thou mockest , shall no man make thee ashamed ?

translation.kha: Nga la ïadat kylleng hapdeng jong pa baroh , da kaba ïalap ïa ka hima U Blei . Bad mynta ang tip ba ym don mano mynno na phi ki ïa-ban dang ïohi shuh ïa nga .
translation.en: And now , behold , I know that ye all , among whom I have gone preaching the kingdom of God , shall see my face no more .

translation.kha: ka Kinah , ka Dimonah , ka Adadah ,
translation.en: And Kinah , and Dimonah , and Adadah ,
Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked , and this is the place of him that knoweth not God .
translation.kha: Kata ka long ka kupar jong ki briew kiba sniew , ka kupar jong kito ki bymsalia ïa U Blei .

Ki Philistia ki ïalumlang ban ïaleh ïa ki Isaia ; ki don laiphew hajar tylli ki kali thnum , hynriew hajar nud ki shipa shong khwai , Bad ki shipawa kiba bad kat u shyiap harud duriaw . Ki leit sha Mikhmash , kambah Sha jongngi na Bethania badno ki Sher dara hangta .
translation.en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel , thirty thousand chariots , and six thousand horsemen , and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude : and they came up , and pitched in Michmash , eastward from Beth–aven .

translation.kha: kane kan long ka jingpynshitom ka ban hap halor ka Ijipt bad ha Baroh kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew lada kim rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki ïingtrep .
translation.en: This shall be the punishment of Egypt , and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles .

And two other rings of gold thou shalt make , and shalt put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart thereof , over against the other coupling thereof , above the curious girdle of the ephod .
translation.kha: Thaw shuh sa ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki ha ka bynta kaba sha trai jong ka bynta kaba ha khmat jong ki ar tylli ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng hajan ka jaka ba la suh pyndait bad haneng jong u panpoh ba la thain itynnat bha .

dien na ki Briew jong pha , ibha pynïap ïa ki briew da kaba ïoh jingsiew . Don kiba Shim sut halor ki ram ba ki ai ïa ki para jait Israel bad ki riewspah da kaba shim kabu’ ïa ki . Ki la klet ïa nga . U Troas Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood  ; thou hast taken usury and increase , and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion , and hast forgotten me , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki longïng jong nga ki hap ban bam ïa u phlang ba phiah la kyrdem bad dih ïa ka um kaba phiah pynjngut .
translation.en: And as for my flock , they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet  ; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet .

translation.kha: Lada ang la kum shrak ïa u khunswet , da katba tip ba ngan ksan ha khmat ka ïingbishar ,
translation.en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless , when I saw my help in the gate :
And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation , which I cast out before you : for they committed all these things , and therefore I abhorred them .
translation.kha: Wat bud ïa ki rukom im jong ki briew kiba shong hangta ; ngan beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew ki bymngeit Blei ba phin ïohrung ha kata ka ri . Nga isih eh ïa ki namar ki kam bymman jong ki baroh .

translation.en: Neither murmur ye , as some of them also murmured , and were destroyed of the destroyer .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban khñium , kumba don na ki , kiba la khñium — bad la pynjot ïa ki da u Angel ka Jingïap .
ïa u Emerald , u Sapphir , bad u Diamond ha ka kyrdon kaba ar ;
translation.en: And the second row , an emerald , a sapphire , and a diamond .
And the angel of the  Lord  went further , and stood in a narrow place , where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u angel u leit sha khmat ; u ïeng ha ka jaka kaba khim ha kaba ym don jaka ban ïaid na baroh arliang .

Kumta haba nga la wan sha phi , nga la long uba tlot bad uba kyiuh barhem shi rynïeng da ka jingsheptieng , bad ïa ka jinghikai bad ka khubor jong nga ym shym la pynïoh da ki ktieh borbah jongno ka jingstad briew , hynrei da ka jingpynshisha baskhem jong ka bor U Mynsiem U blei .
translation.en: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man s wisdom , but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power :

translation.kha: ( Kam 11 :27-30 ) Kumjuh hati haba ngi tip ba ki para bangeit jong ngi ha kano Kane ka bynta jong ka pyrthei ki shem jingeh , im’ phah ïa ki jingnoh synñiang lyngraw ka balang la jong ban ai jingïarap sha kito kiba donkam bha . —2 Korinth 8 :13-15 .
translation.en: ( Acts 11 :27-30 ) Similarly , when we learn that our brothers in some part of the world are facing hardship , we send donations through our local congregation to supply material aid to those in critical need . —2 Corinthians 8 :13-15 .

translation.kha: U Petros u la bud na jngai dara u la leit shapoh ka phyllaw jong ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh . U shong hangta bad ki nongap phikir , u pynsdien ïa lade harud ding .
translation.en: And Peter followed him afar off , even into the palace of the high priest : and he sat with the servants , and warmed himself at the fire .
And they remembered his words ,
translation.kha: Te kita ki kynthei ki la kynmaw ïa ki kyntien jong u ,
ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Girgash , bad ki Jebus .
translation.en: And the Amorites , and the Canaanites , and the Girgashites , and the Jebusites .

translation.kha: Nga thmu ban tei ka Templ kaba khrud , namar U Blei jong ngi u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno uwei pat u blei .
translation.en: And the house which I build is great : for great is our God above all gods .
Now I would not have you ignorant , brethren , that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you , (but was let hitherto ,) that I might have some fruit among you also , even as among other Gentiles .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban kynmaw , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba bunsien nga la thmu ban wan jngoh ïa phi , hynrei don kaei kaei kaba la ju khang ïa nga borabor na kaba leh kumta . Nga kwah ban jop ïa ki mynsiem napdeng jong phi ruh , kumba nga la ju leh hapdeng kiwei ki Jentil .
u la phah shata katto katjuh ngut ki rangbah lem bad kane ka khubor : To U Trai un kyrkhu ïa phi namar ka jingpyn-i ïa ka jingieit ïa la u syiem da kaba Thep ïa u .
translation.en: And David sent messengers unto the men of Jabesh–gilead , and said unto them , Blessed be ye of the  Lord  , that ye have shewed this kindness unto your lord , even unto Saul , and have buried him .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don nongïathuhlypa u ban sngewsarong ïa ki jingïohipaw jong u Lane leh kum u nongïathuhlypa lane khop ïa ka jaiñkup bakhain jong u nongïohipaw khnang ban shukor ïa ki bri .
