translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision , when he hath prophesied  ; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive :

translation.kha: Hynrei sngewbha to ïasah mut mynta ruh , ba ar lah ban ïoh tipbriew aïu pait U Trai un ong ha nga .
translation.en: Now therefore , I pray you , tarry ye also here this night , that I may know what the  Lord  will say unto me more .

translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki la wan sha ka jaka khlaw bad ki la shem ïa ka ngap kat shaba phai .
translation.en: And all they of the land came to a wood  ; and there was honey upon the ground .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalamwir ïa nga sha ka khyrdop kaba kham shabar ha ka bna bashngain mihngi jong ka Templ .
translation.en: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east  ; and it was shut .

translation.kha: Te u Asaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Hesekaïah bad u la kylli , Nain Kin ki briew ki wan bad khie kaba ki ïong ïa phi! ? U Hesekaïah u la jingbabe , Ki wan na ka ri kaba jngai bha , na Babilonia .
translation.en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah , and said unto him , What said these men ? and from whence came they unto thee ? And Hezekiah said , They are come from a far country unto me , even from Babylon .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Bad balei ba kine nongshong ïa ka hukum jong U Blei bad phi brup ïa la ka jong ka jinghikai ?
translation.en: But he answered and said unto them ,  Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition ?

translation.kha: ïa u Serubbabel , u lat ka Judah : Nga la jan shun pynkhreh ïa ka bneng bad ka khñiot
translation.en: Speak to Zerubbabel , governor of Judah , saying , I will shake the heavens and the earth  ;
And he said unto me , These sayings are faithful and true : and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel u la ong ha nga ,  Kine ki ktien ki long kiba shisha bad kiba lah ban shaniah . Bad U Trai uba U Blei , uba ai ïa U Mynsiem jong u ha ki nongïathuhlypa , u la phah ïa u angel jong u ban pyn-i ha ki shakri jong u ïa kaei kaba dei ban jia shen .

Ka la longkmie ha kato ka por ba nga la kular ban shim noh ïa ki na Ijipt bad ïalamwir ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la jied na ka bynta jong ki , ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ka ri kaba kynsai tam na baroh .
translation.en: In the day that I lifted up mine hand unto them , to bring them forth of the land of Egypt into a land that I had espied for them , flowing with milk and honey , which is the glory of all lands :

Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place , seeing it is most holy , and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation , to make atonement for them before the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Balei phim shym ïabam ïa kata ka jingkñia namar ka pop ha ka jaka kyntang ? Ka long kaba khuid bha , bad U  Trai  u la ai ïa ka ha phi na ka bynta ban kit noh ïa ka pop jong u paidlang .

Kin ïa ki jingainguh na ka bynta ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha kata ka jaka mane Blei ba U Trai un jied — ym hawei bapaw ha katai ka ri ba U tharai U Blei jong phi un ai ha phi . lieh ïa kata ha ka por sep sngi , kaba ïadei bad ka por ba phi mih na jingïap .
translation.en: But at the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose to place his name in , there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even , at the going down of the sun , at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt .

translation.kha: Kumne , haba ka la pdang nang , ki leit sha ka jaka shong dara ki Syria , hynrei ynda ki poh ha ka , ym don mane mano hangta .
translation.en: And they rose up in the twilight , to go unto the camp of the Syrians : and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria , behold , there was no man there .
So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight .
translation.kha: Bad u la siew ïa u Araunah hynriewspah ki sbai ksiar na ka bynta ka jaka shoh kew .
Ha ka sngi kha jong u Herod , ka ïakhun jong ka Herodias , ka la shab ha khmat jong ka kynhun bhor kawei .
translation.en: But when Herod s birthday was kept , the daughter of Herodias danced before them , and pleased Herod .

And an highway shall be there , and a way , and it shall be called The way of holiness  ; the unclean shall not pass over it  ; but it shall be for those : the wayfaring men , though fools , shall not err therein .
translation.kha: Kan long ka lynti bah hangta , ba la khot  Ka Lynti jong ka Jingkhuid .  Yn ym don nongpop u ban ïaid ha kata ka lynti ; ym don ki riewbieit ki ban ïalam bakla ïa kito kiba bud ïa ka .

translation.en: Remember the sabbath day , to keep it holy .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton bad sumar kyntang ïa ka .

Pynïap , ngi Tip ba ïa u briew la pynksan ha khmat U Blei tang da ka jingngeit ha U Jiw Khrist , ym da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa . Ngi ruh , ngi la jingkit ha U Khrist Jisu khnang ban pynshngain ha U Blei da ka jingngeit jong ngi ha U Khrist bad ym da kaba leh ïa katei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa . Namar ym don uno uno shiah ïa kaba la pynksan ha U Blei da kaba leh ïa khie kaba ka Hukum ka dawa .
translation.en: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law , but by the faith of Jesus Christ , even we have believed in Jesus Christ , that we might be justified by the faith of Christ , and not by the works of the law : for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified .
And the sons of Zilpah , Leah s handmaid  ; Gad , and Asher : these are the sons of Jacob , which were born to him in Paddan–aram .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Silpah , ka mraw ka Leah , ki long u Gad bad u Asher . Ïa kine ki khun shynrang la kha ha Mesopotamia .

Kumne hi u Ariokh u la ïalam ïa u Daniel sha u syiem Nongbishar bad u la ïathuh ha u syiem , ?(Nga la shem ti na ki Jiw kiba la shah ringmraw , uba lah ban ïathuh ha u Syiem kyrdan ïa ka jingot jong ka jingphohsniew jong Phin .
translation.en: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste , and said thus unto him , I have found a man of the captives of Judah , that will make known unto the king the interpretation .

translation.kha: To phikir bha ïa lade bad ïa ki jinghikai kiba me ai . To men ïadie leh ïa kine kiei kiei , namar lada me kun kumta , me pynim ïa latai bad ïa kita kiba shahshkor ïa me .
translation.en: Take heed unto thyself , and unto the doctrine ; continue in them : for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself , and them that hear thee .

translation.kha: Ka hima jong u ka kynthup ïa u Lym Hermon , ka Shelemaïah , bad ka Bashan baroh ïaheh ki phuh jong ka Hasor bad ka Maakah , bad shiteng jngai ka Gilead haduh ka ri jongno u Sihon u syiem ka Heshbon .
translation.en: And reigned in mount Hermon , and in Salecah , and in all Bashan , unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites , and half Gilead , the border of Sihon king of Heshbon .

translation.kha: Ko khun u biria , ki Ishmael kim long jingryntih ei ei ïa nga . Ki long kum ka mar bymmyntoi shuh — ka tama , ka tin , ka nar , Bad ka sisa — kiba la pynsah hadien ba la saiñ ïa ka rupa ha ka ding .
translation.en: Son of man , the house of Israel is to me become dross : all they are brass , and tin , and iron , and lead , in the midst of the furnace  ; they are even the dross of silver .
But Joshua the son of Nun , which standeth before thee , he shall go in thither : encourage him : for he shall cause Israel to inherit it .
translation.kha: Hynrei pynshlur ïa u nongïarap jong me , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun . Ma u , un sa ïalam ïa ki Israel ban kam kynti ïa kata ka ri .’

translation.en: I will surely assemble , O Jacob , all of thee  ; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel  ; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah , as the flock in the midst of their fold : they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan lumlang ïa phi , phi baroh ki paid Israel kiba dang sah . Ngan wallam lang ïa phi kum ki langbrot sha ka kynhun . Kum ka jaka bam phlang ba-dap da ki langbrot , ka ri jong phi kan dap biang sa shisien da ki paidbah babun .

translation.en: So that the  Lord  could no longer bear , because of the evil of your doings , and because of the abominations which ye have committed  ; therefore is your land a desolation , and an astonishment , and a curse , without an inhabitant , as at this day .
translation.kha: Ha kane hi ka sngi ka ri jong phi kan sah ha ki jingjot bad ym don mano mano ban shong ban sah ha ka . Ka la long ka jingïohi ba-itriem , bad ki briew ki pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ka kum ka jingtim , namar U  Trai  um lah shah shuh ïa ki kam bymman bad basniew jong phi .

U la ong ha nga , ‘ Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki kseh ba kumta ki nongmih pateng jong me kin sa long ki jaitbynriew kiba bun . Ngan ai ïa kane ka ri ha ki khun ki khiew jong me ba kan lama ka ri kyntiap jong ki jymphong .’
translation.en: And said unto me , Behold , I will make thee fruitful , and multiply thee , and I will make of thee a multitude of people  ; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession .

translation.kha: Shano phin loit ? nga la kylli . Ban thew ïa ka Jerusalem , u la jingjubab , ban ïohi katno ka jingjrong bad ka jingïar jong ka .
translation.en: Then said I , Whither goest thou ? And he said unto me , To measure Jerusalem , to see what is the breadth thereof , and what is the length thereof .

translation.kha: Kumba u nongaikam sim u pyndap ïa ka ruh jong u da ki sim , ki la pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ka jinglute . Dei kata keiñ balei ba ki longkmie kiba dabor bad Ibbah riewshlur ,
translation.en: As a cage is full of birds , so are their houses full of deceit : therefore they are become great , and waxen rich .

And it shall come to pass , when ye shall say , Wherefore doeth the  Lord  our God all these things unto us ? then shalt thou answer them , Like as ye have forsaken me , and served strange gods in your land , so shall ye serve strangers in a land that is not yours .
translation.kha: Haba ki kylli balei ba nga la leh ïa kine kiei kiei , ïathuh ïa ki , ko Jeremaïah , ba kumba ki la phai noh na nga bad shakri ïa ki blei nongwei ha ka ri jong ki hi , kumta kin shakri ïa ki nongwei ha ka ri ka bym dei ka jong ki .

‘ Me u shakri uba sniew pynlang naba jaipdeh !’ u kynrad jong u , u la ong . ‘ Me la tip , ym dei , ba nga ot ïa ki jingot na kaba ngam shyiap bet , bad lum ïa ki jingthung na kaba ngam shym bet symbai ?
translation.en: His lord answered and said unto him , Thou wicked and slothful servant , thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not , and gather where I have not strawed :

translation.kha: U pynap shipai ha ki nongbah ba la tei kut ka Jedaïah , ha ki rudnong Judah , bad ha ki nongbah kiba u ita u la jop ha ka ri ki Ephraim .
translation.en: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah , and set garrisons in the land of Judah , and in the cities of Ephraim , which Asa his father had taken .
O  Lord  , be gracious unto us  ; we have waited for thee : be thou their arm every morning , our salvation also in the time of trouble .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , to isynei ïa ngi . Ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen ha me . To ïada ïa ngi man la ka sngi bad to pynim ïa ngi ha ki por jong ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: But the  Lord  hardened Pharaoh s heart , so that he would not let the children of Israel go .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad kumta um shym pyllait ïa ki Israel ban leit .
Ngan ïa khongdong ïa ka aiñ jong me , junom la junom ;
translation.en: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever .
There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea , and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus , an old disciple , with whom we should lodge .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki parabangeit na Kaisaria ruh ki la ïaleit bad ngi bad ki la ïalam ïa ngi sha ka ïing jong u briew ha kaba ngin sah — u Mnason , uba na Sypros , uba la long u parabangeit naduh ki sngi kiba dang sdang .

Ïa u pud bashaphang shathie jong ka ri la ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph ; u sdang na ka Jordan hajan ka Jerikho , ha ka pyntha kaba sha mihngi jong ki umpohliew ka Jakeh , bad u suh sha ka ri shahïap . U suh na ka Jerikho artet sha ka ri lum hapoh ka Bethel .
translation.en: And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho , unto the water of Jericho on the east , to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Beth–el ,

translation.kha: Haba u la ïor ïa u Petros bad u Ïoannis ba ki rung shapoh , u la kyrpad ïa ki Ban ai ei ei ïa u .
translation.en: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms .

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , ngi hukum ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong U ju Khrist uba U Tharai jong ngi ban kiar nong na ki bangeit baroh Ibbah im ka jingriam bajaipdeh bad ki i bujli ïa ki jingbthah kiba ngi ai ha ki .
translation.en: Now we command you , brethren , in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly , and not after the tradition which he received of us .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingpyntrei ïa ka Templ la Lah pynsangeh nala bad ka la sahkut khlem pyntrei shuh haduh ka snem ba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Darius , u patsha ka Persia .
translation.en: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem . So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia .

translation.kha: Dong mano mano ba la pyn-i ha me ïa ki khyrdop babha ap phira ïa ka pyrthei ba-dait jong kiba ïap ?
translation.en: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee ? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death ?

translation.kha: Te u la ong ha u Thomas , Bthah ïa ka shynriah ti jong me hangne , bad peit ïa ki kti jong nga ; Nangta Kner ïa la ka kti bad nguh ïa ka ha ka krung jong nga . wai artatien shuh bad to ngeit !
translation.en: Then saith he to Thomas ,  Reach hither thy finger , and behold my hands  ; and reach hither thy hand , and thrust it into my side : and be not faithless , but believing .

translation.kha: Dei namar kata ba u Manasseh u ïoh shiphew bynta nalor ka Gilead bad ka Bashan ha ka pdang mihngi jongngi ka Jordan ,
translation.en: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh , beside the land of Gilead and Bashan , which were on the other side Jordan  ;

translation.kha: Naba ka dih Jong la ka long ka jingbat byrsha ; ka snam jong nga ka hir ka jingdih bashisha .
translation.en: For my flesh is meat indeed , and my blood is drink indeed .

translation.kha: Mynba u Syiem Kynrad u dang ïohthiah , phi la phohsniew shaphang ka lawei ; sad U Blei naba pynpaw ïa ki jingmaïan , u la pyn-i ha phi kaei ka ban sa jylla .
translation.en: As for thee , O king , thy thoughts came into thy mind upon thy bed , what should come to pass hereafter : and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass .
And who is he that will harm you , if ye be followers of that which is good ?
translation.kha: Uei u ban pynsniew ïa phi lada phi shitrhem ban leh ïa kaei kaba bha ?

translation.en: And when the Lord saw her , he had compassion on her , and said unto her ,  Weep not .
translation.kha: Haba U Trai u la ïohi ïa ka , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingisynei ïa ka , bad u la ong ha ka ,  Wat ïam .

Ha shuwa ba ngan Kut ka jingduwai bajar jar jong nga , ka Rekem ka la wei sad u khiew um ha ka tyrpeng jong ka bad ka la leit hiar sha dat ka pukri ba tong um . Nga la ong ha ka , ‘ To ai um ba Ngan dih .’
translation.en: And before I had done speaking in mine heart , behold , Rebekah came forth with her pitcher on her shoulder  ; and she went down unto the well , and drew water : and I said unto her , Let me drink , I pray thee .

translation.kha: ïa ki khohwah jong ka da ka nar ; bad ïa ki kjat jngai ka shi bynta da ka nar malade shi bna da ka dewbyrtha .
translation.en: His legs of iron , his feet part of iron and part of clay .
Then cometh Jesus from Galilee to Jordan unto John , to be baptized of him .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la wan poi na Galilaïa bad u la wan sha u Ïoannis ha ka wah Jordan ba yn shah pynbaptis ha u .

Ong ïa u , ba sa U Trai nga ong ïa u , ‘ Hadien ba me la pynïap ïa u briew hato men skhem ruh ïa ka khyndew jongngi u ?’ ïathuh jin ha u ïa kaei ba nga ong : ‘ Ha kata hi ka jaka ba ki ksew ki jliah ïa ka snam u Naboth , kin jlih ruh ïa ka snam jong me !’
translation.en: And thou shalt speak unto him , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Hast thou killed , and also taken possession ? And thou shalt speak unto him , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth shall dogs lick thy blood , even thine .

translation.kha: Ki biria jong u Jakob bad jong u Jehosadak kin long kum ka ding ; kin pynjot ïa ki brup u Ono kitab ka ding ka thang ïa u pynphalang . Yn ym anna uba hiarpateng na u Katta u ban lait im . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la krensih .
translation.en: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire , and the house of Joseph a flame , and the house of Esau for stubble , and they shall kindle in them , and devour them  ; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau  ; for the  Lord  hath spoken it .

translation.kha: ( U la ong ïa Kanneh ban tynjuh ïa u Philip ; ha ka jingshisha u la lah tip lypa ïa kaei ba un kuna . )
translation.en: And this he said to prove him : for he himself knew what he would do .

translation.kha: Phi lah ban ong ba kam dei ka kai jong phi , hynrei U Blei u tip bad u bashrah ïa ki jinglum jong phi . U ïadie ap khmih ïa phi ; u Tip . Un ainong ïa phi kat kum kaei ka Phin leh .
translation.en: If thou sayest , Behold , we knew it not  ; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it ? and he that keepeth thy soul , doth not he know it ? and shall not he render to every man according to his works ?
Apply thine heart unto instruction , and thine ears to the words of knowledge .
translation.kha: To shahshkor bha ïa u nonghikai jong phi bad pynleit jingmut ïa baroh katba phi lah .
Ka por tud poi haba ki nongwan jyllang pha kin ker sarong ïa pha da ki jingker , ki jingkhanglad ïa pha , bun ki nang tur jan sha pha na ki lok baroh .
translation.en: For the days shall come upon thee , that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee , and compass thee round , and keep thee in on every side ,

translation.kha: Tang ma me , me long ka jingkyrmen jong ka Israel ; me long uta uba la pyllait im ïa ngi na ka jingpynjot . Balei me long kum u nongai ha ka ri jong i'u , kum u nonglehbeiñ jingleit suba sah tang shi miet ?
translation.en: O the hope of Israel , the saviour thereof in time of trouble , why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land , and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night ?
As when the melting fire burneth , the fire causeth the waters to boil , to make thy name known to thine adversaries , that the nations may tremble at thy presence !
translation.kha: Kin khynñiuh kum ka um ba dang shet halor ka ding kaba khluit . Ale bad pynpaw ïa ka bor jong me ha ki nongshun jong me , bad pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew ban khynñiuh ha khmat jong me !
Haba me la de baneh leh ïa Katai , shim ïa u masi lynghoh bad ïa u langbrot lud , baroh ar na ki , ki bym ne kino kino ki jingduna , bad ïam ïa ki sha nga .
translation.en: When thou hast made an end of cleansing it , thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish , and a ram out of the flock without blemish .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ka lei , bad ktien wan ibiang sha kane ka nongbah . Kin tur ïajah ïa ka , kin kurup ïa ka , bad trep duh ïa ka . ngam pynlong ïa ki shnong ka Jehoïada ba kin long kum ka ri shyiap ha kaba yn ym don mano mano ban shong ïa-ban sah ha ka . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Behold , I will command , saith the  Lord  , and cause them to return to this city  ; and they shall fight against it , and take it , and burn it with fire : and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant .
And many resorted unto him , and said , John did no miracle : but all things that John spake of this man were true .
translation.kha: Shibun ki briew ki la wan sha u .  U Ïoannis um leh kambah ei ei ,  ki la ong ,  hynrei kiei kiei baroh kiba u la ong shaphang une u briew ka la long kaba shisha .

translation.en: Rejoiceth not in iniquity , but rejoiceth in the truth ;
translation.kha: ka jingieit kam kmen ha ka jingbymman , hynrei ka kmen ha ka jingshisha .

translation.en: Yet now hear , O Jacob my servant  ; and Israel , whom I have chosen :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To shahshkor mynta , ko Israel , u shakri jong nga , ki briew ba la jied jong nga , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob .
U Trai u ong , Ka Jingïap ïa ka bniah ! Ka Jingïap ïa ki briew jong ka , ïa ki nongsynshar jong ka , ïa ki rangbah bastad jong ka .
translation.en: A sword is upon the Chaldeans , saith the  Lord  , and upon the inhabitants of Babylon , and upon her princes , and upon her wise men .
These are the families of the sons of Noah , after their generations , in their nations : and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew baroh ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Noah , ha la ka jait ka jait , kat kum la ki jingkheiñ jait bapher bapher ha ka jinghiarpateng . Hadien ka jingshlei um , baroh ki jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ki hiarpateng na ki khun shynrang jong u Noah .
Hato me lah ban shaniah ha ka jingkhlaiñ bakhraw jong u bad ïakhmih lynti ïa u ban trei ïa ki kam bakhia jongno me ?
translation.en: Wilt thou trust him , because his strength is great ? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him ?
In the first day shall be an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai Niam , phi dei ban ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad phim dei ban treikam ei ei ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: And we beseech you , brethren , to know them which labour among you , and are over you in the Lord , and admonish you ;
translation.kha: Ngi kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong ngi , ban ai ka burom kaba dei biang ïa kito kiba la trei hapdeng jong phi , kiba la ïalam bad hikai ïa phi ha ka jingim kum kiba ngeit .
U ijuh u la mihnoh na ka nongbah bad u la wait , kumba u la ju leh , sha u lum ki Olib ; bad ki synran ki la saw lem bad u .
translation.en: And he came out , and went , as he was wont , to the mount of Olives  ; and his disciples also followed him .
For he wist not what to say  ; for they were sore afraid .
translation.kha: Ma u bad kiwei pat ki la sheptieng katta katta haduh ba um tip ïa kaei ban ong .

translation.en: And he was sad at that saying , and went away grieved : for he had great possessions .
translation.kha: Haba uta u briew u la ïohsngew ïa kane , ka jingidiaw ka la tap ïa ka khmat jong u baroh kawei , bad u la leit noh da ka jingsngewsih , namar u la long uba riewspah haduh katta katta .
Da ka mon sngewbha jong ki hi , ki la kyrpad ïa ngi bad ïasaid na ka bynta ka lad baneh ïadon bynta ha kaba ïarap ïa ki briew jong U Blei ha Judia .
translation.en: Praying us with much entreaty that we would receive the gift , and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints .

translation.kha: ‘ Wat kliar .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou commit adultery .

translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt ki lehbeiñ ïa i bad pyntrei jubor ïa ngi kum ki mradkhlaw .
translation.en: And the Egyptians evil entreated us , and afflicted us , and laid upon us hard bondage :

translation.kha: Kumta hajuh phi ai ei ei ha u briew uba kyrduh , wat pynsawa jam ïa ka , kumba ki riewarsap ki leh ha ki synagog bad ha ki lynti bah . Ki leh ïa ka khnang ba ki briew kyang ïaroh ïa ki . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ba ki la da oh ka jingsiew ba-pura .
translation.en: Therefore when thou doest thine alms , do not sound a trumpet before thee , as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets , that they may have glory of men . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
And the Egyptians pursued , and went in after them to the midst of the sea , even all Pharaoh s horses , his chariots , and his horsemen .
translation.kha: Ki nong Ijipt ruh ki la beh kthong ïa ki bad ki la leit nadien jong ki sha ka duriaw lem bad ki kulai , ki kali ïapom bad ki nongñiah .
Sumar bad lehhok ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi : ieid ïa U Trai U Blei jong pa’ , leh ïa sakma Baroh kaba u hukum , bad ïaishah ha u .
translation.en: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you , to do them , to love the  Lord  your God , to walk in all his ways , and to cleave unto him  ;

translation.kha: To kynthih , A Trai , ba nga la shakri ïa me ha ka hok bad jingïalang skhem , bad nga la pyrshang batbor banbeiñ leh ïa kaei kaweh me kwah ïa nga baneh imat . Bad u sdang Ban ïamkthang .
translation.en: I beseech thee , O  Lord  , remember now how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart , and have done that which is good in thy sight . And Hezekiah wept sore .
If one be found slain in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to possess it , lying in the field , and it be not known who hath slain him :
translation.kha: Lada ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , phi lap ha lum ha wah ïa u briew uba la shah pynïap , bad phim tip mano ba la pynïap ïa u .
Ïa ka jingkhraw nabar ïa ka spah jong ki jaitbynriew yn Wanlam shapoh ka nongbah .
translation.en: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it .
That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea ; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints ;
translation.kha: To duwai ba ngan lait na ka jingma na ki bymngeit kiba don ha Judia bad ba ka jingshakri jong nga ha Jerusalem kan long kaba la pdiang da ki briew jong U Blei hangta .

translation.en: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men , but to the will of God .
translation.kha: Naduh mynta , te , phi dei ban im ïa kaba sah jong ka jingim ha kane ka pyrthei , ka jingim ba la synshar da ka mon U Blei bad ym da ki jingkwah jong ka doh .
U Moses u Ong ha uta u paidbah , Da Kanah Phin tip ba dei U Tiras uba la phah ïa nga ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh , bad ba ym dei da ka mon jong na ba nga la leh ïa ki .
translation.en: And Moses said , Hereby ye shall know that the  Lord  hath sent me to do all these works  ; for I have not done them of mine own mind .
But if he wash them not , nor bathe his flesh  ; then he shall bear his iniquity .
translation.kha: Lada um leh kumta , un kit hi ïa la ka jingpynshitom .

translation.en: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead : for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest . So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Arab ki la leit lute bad pynïap ïa baroh ki khun shynrang jong u Jehoram lait noh u Ahasaïah , uba khatduh . Te mynta ki briew ka Jerusalem ki thung ïa u Ahasaïah kum u syiem ba mih bujli ïa u kpa jong u .
Ha kajuh ka per U thri u la ong ha u Aaron , Kheiñ leit shwa ka ri shyiap ban ïakynduh ïa u Moses . Kumta u leit ban ïakynduh ïa u ha uta u lum bakhlaiñ ; pynlang haba u ïashah dara u , u doh ïa u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said to Aaron , Go into the wilderness to meet Moses . And he went , and met him in the mount of God , and kissed him .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jethro u la wanrah ïa ka jingainguh ban thang tylli malu ïa kiwei! kiwei de ki jingainguh ngab ai jingkñia sha U Blei ; pynlang u Aaron lem bad nongïalam jongngi ki Jeraïah barben ki la ïaleit bad u banbeiñ bam ïa ka jingbam kaba kyntang kumto ka dak ka jingbymman ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And Jethro , Moses  father in law , took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God : and Aaron came , and all the elders of Israel , to eat bread with Moses  father in law before God .

translation.kha: Dem kata keiñ balieh ba la khot Ka Lyngkha Ka Snam haduh kane ka sngi .
translation.en: Wherefore that field was called , The field of blood , unto this day .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka por baroh ka ban sa wan ïa kane ka jingkñia jingaiti daym ban leh da wai pa uwei u Lyngkha uba hiarpateng na u Ïaroh u baneh shrak kumin u nongbah Lyngdoh . Dei ba yn thang lut khoit ïa ka kum ka jingkynha sha U Trai .
translation.en: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it : it is a statute for ever unto the  Lord   ; it shall be wholly burnt .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , to ïathuhlypa . Pynbna ïa kaei kaba ma at , U Trai nongbishar , de ainong ïa ki nong Ammon , kiba krenbeiñ ïa ki Israel . Ong ha ki : ‘ Ka waitlam ka la kloi ban pynstet ; ïa ka la pynphyrnai ban pynïap , ban thaba kum ka lehse .
translation.en: And thou , son of man , prophesy and say , Thus saith the Lord  God  concerning the Ammonites , and concerning their reproach  ; even say thou , The sword , the sword is drawn : for the slaughter it is furbished , to consume because of the glittering :

translation.kha: Wat shu ïeng hangto ! Lehi kyrkieh ! Uta u khynnah u hano ïa uta u khnam bad u wan phai sha la u kynrad ,
translation.en: And Jonathan cried after the lad , Make speed , haste , stay not . And Jonathan s lad gathered up the arrows , and came to his master .

translation.kha: Ki Arab pynlang ki nongsynshar ka ri Kedar ki la siew na ka bynta ki mar khaïi jong pha da ki khunlangbrot , ki langbrot , mala ki blang .
translation.en: Arabia , and all the princes of Kedar , they occupied with thee in lambs , and rams , and goats : in these were they thy merchants .

translation.kha: Bad pynban u dei U blang uba la pynriewspah ïa ki — meng lah ban sngewtlot ïa ki jingpyrkhat jyllang ki bymman .
translation.en: Yet he filled their houses with good things : but the counsel of the wicked is far from me .

translation.kha: U Tiras u ong ha u Joshua , Wat sheptieng ïa ki . Nga la ai lypa ha me ïa ka jingjngem . Yn ym don ti ruh na ki naba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa me .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Fear them not : for I have delivered them into thine hand  ; there shall not a man of them stand before thee .
Behold , in this thou art not just : I will answer thee , that God is greater than man .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi , ko Job , phi la bakla . U Blei u kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u briew .
Wat la u Asa um shym la pynjot lut ïa ki jaka mane blei thala baroh , u ïadih ha U Trai katba u dang im .
translation.en: But the high places were not removed : nevertheless Asa s heart was perfect with the  Lord  all his days .

translation.kha: Napdeng jong ki la don ka kynthei kaba la shitom na ka jingdap mihsnam kabu jur la khatphra snem ; ka la pynlut ïa baroh kaweh ka don ha ki nongsumar , hynrei ym ne mano mano ba lah ban pynkhiah ïa ka .
translation.en: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years , which had spent all her living upon physicians , neither could be healed of any ,

translation.kha: Kam longkmie kaba bha ïa ka khyndew lane ïa ka kynton sbai ; la bret noh ïa ka . Shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shakor !
translation.en: It is neither fit for the land , nor yet for the dunghill  ; but men cast it out . He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
Remove not the ancient landmark , which thy fathers have set .
translation.kha: Wat ju pynkynriah ïa u mawpud ba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la thung naduh mynbarim .
To rwai , ko ki bneng ! Pyrta da ka jingkmen , ko ka pyrthei ! To ai ba ki lumbah kin win ha ka jingrwai ! U Trai un pyntngen ïa la ki briew ; un don jingisynei ha ki briew jong u kiba jynrat .
translation.en: Sing , O heavens  ; and be joyful , O earth  ; and break forth into singing , O mountains : for the  Lord  hath comforted his people , and will have mercy upon his afflicted .

translation.kha: To wan phan , phi! barben kiba la phai rynsied na U Trai ; un pynkdiah ïa phi sad un pynlong ïa phi kiba ïaineh . Phi ong , ho-oid , ngi waiñ sha U Trai , namar u dat U Blei jong sem .
translation.en: Return , ye backsliding children , and I will heal your backslidings . Behold , we come unto thee  ; for thou art the  Lord  our God .

translation.kha: Ngi kwah ïa phi ban tip , ko ki por Israel jong nga , bad ka hir lyngba U Jisu ba ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingmap ïa ki pop la ïalap ha phi ; bad ba ïa uwei uwei baroh uba ngeit ha u la pyllait na ki pop baroh na kiba ka Hukum u Moses kam ha ban pyllait ïa phi .
translation.en: And by him all that believe are justified from all things , from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses .

translation.kha: Kumta , imat kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa phi : im kat kum ki sah jong u bad jongu ïa u .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , and to fear him .
And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation : and all the congregation drew near and stood before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki wanlam sha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u Moses u la hukum , bad ki paidbah baroh ki ïalumlang ban mane ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And when James , Cephas , and John , who seemed to be pillars , perceived the grace that was given unto me , they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship ; that we should go unto the heathen , and they unto the circumcision .
translation.kha: U Jakob , u Petros , bad u Ïoannis , kiba i ba ki long ki nongïalam , ki la tip ba U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kam bakyrpang ; kumta ki la ïakhublei kti ïa u Barnabas lem bad ïa nga de , kum ka dak ba ngi ïalong baroh ki nongïatrei lang . Ngi la ïamynjur ba u Barnabas bad nga , ngin ïatrei hapdeng ki Jentil , bad ki pat hapdeng ki Jiw .
U la ong ïa u Haggai don klun ha u Segub , u lat ka Judah , ha u Joshua , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad ha ki paidbah , bad ban ong ha ki ,
translation.en: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , and to the residue of the people , saying ,

translation.kha: La don u briew suba kyrteng u Jehoshaphat na Arimathaïa , ka shong kaba ha Judia . U la long u briew uba bha malu uba donburom , uba la apkhmih ïa ka jingwan jong ka Harim U Blei . Wat la u long u dkhot jong ka Dorbar , um shym la mynjur bad ka jingrai bad jingleh jong ki .
translation.en: ( The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them  ; ) he was of Arimathaea , a city of the Jews : who also himself waited for the kingdom of God .

All that found them have devoured them : and their adversaries said , We offend not , because they have sinned against the  Lord  , the habitation of justice , even the  Lord  , the hope of their fathers .
translation.kha: Ki la shah tur ïaleh da baroh kiba ïakynduh ïa ki . Ki nongshun jong ki , ki ong , ‘ Ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , bad kumta kaei kaba ngi la leh , kam long kaba bakla . Ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki la shaniah ha U  Trai  , bad ma ki hi kiba la dei ban ïailong kiba ïaineh ha u .’
Ki Philistia ki la ïaleh tyngeh bad ki la jrop ïa ki Jeruel , kiba phet ïap sha la ki ïeng . Ka la don ka jingshah pynïap kaba khrawburom : Laiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Jeraïah ki shah pynïap .
translation.en: And the Philistines fought , and Israel was smitten , and they fled every man into his tent : and there was a very great slaughter  ; for there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen .

translation.kha: Ko paid Israel , to sohshkor ïa kaei kaba nga nguh . Hato nga la long kum ka ri shitaiew ïa phi , kum ka ri kaba dum bad kaba ma ? Balei te ba phi ong ba phin leh kat kaba phi sngewbit , ba phin ym wan phai shuh sha nga ?
translation.en: O generation , see ye the word of the  Lord . Have I been a wilderness unto Israel ? a land of darkness ? wherefore say my people , We are lords  ; we will come no more unto thee ?

translation.kha: U rai ïa ka jingdon jong ki khlaw bad u khot ïa uwei pa uwei da ka kyrteng .
translation.en: He telleth the number of the stars  ; he calleth them all by their names .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u ong , ngan shuh ïa me kum u nongap phylla na ka bynta ka jaitbynriew Israel . Men pynsngew ha ki ïa ki jingkhem kiba de ai ïa me .
translation.en: Son of man , I have made thee a watchman unto the house of Israel : therefore hear the word at my mouth , and give them warning from me .

translation.kha: U kah ïa lade da ka jingdum ; ki lyoh baroh , kiba dap da ka um , ki ker shohdoh ïa u ;
translation.en: And he made darkness pavilions round about him , dark waters , and thick clouds of the skies .

translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngaid kaba bud , slem shuwa ban shai , U Jisu u la ïeng bad mihnoh na ka ïing . U la mihnoh na ka shnong shata ka iaka bakynjang , hangta u la duwai .
translation.en: And in the morning , rising up a great while before day , he went out , and departed into a solitary place , and there prayed .

translation.kha: Ki lumlang badno ki lumrit ki lah ban twa , hynrei ka jingieit jongu nga ïa pha kan ym kut noh ; ngan pyneh junom ïa la ka kulmar jong ka jingsuk . Kumta te ong U Trai uba ieid ïa pha .
translation.en: For the mountains shall depart , and the hills be removed  ; but my kindness shall not depart from thee , neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed , saith the  Lord  that hath mercy on thee .

translation.kha: Ka pynstet ban phylliew ïa ka um na u khiew jong ka ha ka jingïadon ai um ïa ki jingïar bad ka maw sha kata ka pukri ban leit tun um shuh , haw ba kan da dup shun ai um ïa ki ut jong u baroh .
translation.en: And she hasted , and emptied her pitcher into the trough , and ran again unto the well to draw water , and drew for all his camels .

translation.kha: Nangta ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U Terah , ngan pyndap ïa ki briew ha kane ka ri da ka wiang nang haduh ba kin buaid : ki syiem , kiba long kiba thapniang na u Dabid , ki lyngdoh , ki nongïathuh , bad baroh ki briew jrong ka Jeremaïah .
translation.en: Then shalt thou say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will fill all the inhabitants of this land , even the kings that sit upon David s throne , and the priests , and the prophets , and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem , with drunkenness .
Then thine heart be lifted up , and thou forget the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage  ;
translation.kha: kynmaw ban ym sngewsarong bad ban ym klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
Khot ïa ki nongïoh borbah kiba na la ai ha ki ka sap malade ong ïa ki ba Kin suh ïa ki jaiñkup u Aaron khnang ba yn ïoh pynkyntang ïa u kum u lyngdoh ban shakri ïa nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted , whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom , that they may make Aaron s garments to consecrate him , that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .

translation.kha: Ki dei ïa-ban sngewnguh ïa U Trai na ka boitha ka jingieit banbeiñ jongu u , na ka bynta kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba u la kuna ïa ki .
translation.en: Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !

translation.kha: Wat shukor ïa lade tang da Kaba sngap ïa ka ktien jngai u ; pynban , to pyntreikam ïa ka .
translation.en: But be ye doers of the word , and not hearers only , deceiving your own selves .
And he took a child , and set him in the midst of them : and when he had taken him in his arms , he said unto them ,
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa u khynnah rit bad pynïeng ïa u ha khmat jong ki . U la buh ïa la ki kti sawdong jong u bad u la ong ïa ki ,

translation.en: The depths have covered them : they sank into the bottom as a stone .
translation.kha: Ka duriaw kaba jylliew ka la tap ïa ki ; ki la ngam sha trai duriaw kum u maw .

translation.en: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake : I beheld even till the beast was slain , and his body destroyed , and given to the burning flame .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang khmih , nga dang lah ban ïohsngew ïa ka reng barit ba ka kren sarong eh bad kob . Katba nga dang ap khmih , la pynïap ïa u mradkhlaw uba saw , bad ïa ka met jong u la bret sha ki thylliej ding bad ka pynjot .
Yn sa pynjot noh thiaw ïa kiba sniew .—2 Petros 3 :7 .
translation.en: The wicked will be destroyed . —2 Peter 3 :7 .

translation.kha: Ka jingthngan ka la pynlong ïa ngi ban ing da ka jingshit , tad Haduh ba ka sniehdoh jong ngi ka long kaba khluit kum ka pajwa .
translation.en: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine .
For I came down from heaven , not to do mine own will , but the will of him that sent me .
translation.kha: Uno uno ïa uba U Kpa jong nga u ai ha nga un wan sha nga . Ngan ym kyntait ïa uno uno uba wan sha nga , namar nga la wan hiar na bneng ban leh ym ïa ka mon ka jong nga hynrei ïa ka mon jong uta uba la phah ïa nga .
Hynrei U Abram u ong , Ko Trai Nongsynshar , kumta keiñ nga lai ïa-ban tip ba kan long ka jong ar ?
translation.en: And he said , Lord  God  , whereby shall I know that I shall inherit it ?
And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah , and they shall sell them to the Sabeans , to a people far off : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ba ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi yn die sha ki briew ka Judah ; ma ki kin sa die ïa ki sha jngai sha ki Sabean . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: And Absalom said unto him , See , thy matters are good and right  ; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee .
translation.kha: u Absalom u ju ong ,  Khmih , ka aiñ ka ha ka liang jong me , hynrei ym don mano mano u ban mihkhmat ïa u syiem ban sngap ïa ka kam jong me .

translation.en: And it came to pass in process of time , that the king of Egypt died : and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage , and they cried , and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage .
translation.kha: Bun snem hadien kane , u syiem Ijipt u ïap noh , hynrei ki Israel ki dang ïai ud namar kata ka jinglongmraw jong ki bad ki pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap .

translation.en: And he said , Go and spy where he is , that I may send and fetch him . And it was told him , saying , Behold , he is in Dothan .
translation.kha: Khie leit wad ha-ei u don ,  u syiem u hukum ,  bad ngan sa phah kem ïa u .  Haba la ïathuh ba u Elisha u don ha Dothan ,

Nangta ka Deborah ka ong ïa u Barak , Khie leit ! U tharai u ïalam ïa me ! Ha kane ka sngi u la ai ha me ka jingjot halor u Sisera . Kumta u Bakhraw u la leit arspah na u Lum Tabor lak bad ki shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah jong u .
translation.en: And Deborah said unto Barak , Up  ; for this is the day in which the  Lord  hath delivered Sisera into thine hand : is not the  Lord  gone out before thee ? So Barak went down from mount Tabor , and ten thousand men after him .
Because the carnal mind is enmity against God : for it is not subject to the law of God , neither indeed can be .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u briew u long u nongshun jong U Blei haba u shah pynïaid ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh ; namar um kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Blei , bad ha ka jingshisha um lah ban kohnguh ïa ka .

translation.en: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her : for with such robes were the king s daughters that were virgins apparelled . Then his servant brought her out , and bolted the door after her .
translation.kha: U shakri u pynmih ïa ka shabar bad u khang ïa ka jingkhang . Ka Tamar ka kup ïa ka sopti jynsur kaba jrong kti , ka jait jaiñ ba ju phong da ki khun syiem kynthei ki bym pat shongkurim ha kito ki sngi .
Kishion U Jisu u la ïakynduh ïa ki dara u la ong , To ka jingsuk kan long bad phi . Ki la sien sha u , bun ki la bat ïa ki kjat jong u , bad ki la mane ïa u .
translation.en: And as they went to tell his disciples , behold , Jesus met them , saying ,  All hail .  And they came and held him by the feet , and worshipped him .

translation.kha: kaba long ka dak kaba kdew shai ka jingpynbaptis , kaba pyllait im ïa phi mynta . mana dei ka jingsait noh ïa ka jliah na ka met , hynrei ka jingjar ba la Pynlong shwa U Blei na ka jingialeh babha . Ka pynim ïa phi da ka jingphet jong U Jisu Khrist ,
translation.en: The like figure whereunto even baptism doth also now save us ( not the putting away of the filth of the flesh , but the answer of a good conscience toward God , ) by the resurrection of Jesus Christ :

translation.kha: U Pilat u la kylli jingkylli ïa u , Me longïing u syiem jong ki Jiw ? U jongu u la jubab , Kumba me ong hi .
translation.en: And Pilate asked him , Art thou the King of the Jews ? And he answering said unto him ,  Thou sayest it .

translation.kha: Ka jingkmen lad phi ka long ka jong phi hi ; ka jingkthang jongu phi ka long ka jong phi hi . Ym don uba lah ban ïasam ïa ki bad phiah .
translation.en: The heart knoweth his own bitterness  ; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy .

And it came to pass the same night , that the  Lord  said unto him , Take thy father s young bullock , even the second bullock of seven years old , and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath , and cut down the grove that is by it :
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , U  Trai  u ong ha u Gideon  Shim ïa u masi kyrtong jong u kpa jong me bad uwei pat u masi kyrtong uba hynñiew snem ka rta , pynpra noh ïa ka duwan ba u kpa jong me u la tei ha u Baal , bad pynkhyllem ïa ka dak jong ka blei Asherah kaba don ha syndah jong ka .
Kiwei pat ki Jerusalem kim dei shuh ban wan sha marjan ka Ïingjaiñ ïoh ki khulom ha lade ïa ka jingshah pynshitom da ka jingïap .
translation.en: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation , lest they bear sin , and die .

translation.kha: u mraw uba kylla long syiem , u bieit uba u ïoh shun ba-im ïa baroh kat kaba u kwah ,
translation.en: For a servant when he reigneth  ; and a fool when he is filled with meat  ;

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ishmael ki la shong la sah ha ka jaka kaba hapdeng ka Habilah bad ka Shur , sha ka phang mihngi jongngi ka ri Ijipt ha ka lynti sha Assyria . Kine ki la shnong kyrpang na kiwei paw ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abbim .
translation.en: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur , that is before Egypt , as thou goest toward Assyria : and he died in the presence of all his brethren .

translation.kha: Tang u Joash u khun jong u Ahasaïah u lait im . U la jan shah pynïap ryngkat nabar kiwei , hynrei la pyllait im ïa u da ka ñiakha jong u , ka Jehosheba , kambah long ka khun jong u syiem Hadoram bad ka bakha u Ahasaïah . Ka shimet ïa u lem bad ka nongsumar jong u sha ka klass thiah kaba don ha ka Templ dara ka la pynrieh ïa u na ka Athalaïah , kumta um skhem la shah pynïap .
translation.en: But Jehosheba , the daughter of king Joram , sister of Ahaziah , took Joash the son of Ahaziah , and stole him from among the king s sons which were slain  ; and they hid him , even him and his nurse , in the bedchamber from Athaliah , so that he was not slain .
He that loveth his brother abideth in the light , and there is none occasion of stumbling in him .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ieit ïa la u hynmen u para u ïaid ha ka jingshai , bad kumta ym don kaei kaei ha u ka ban pynlong ïano ïano pat ban leh pop .
U Tharai u la kren ha nga ,
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
Peace I leave with you , my peace I give unto you : not as the world giveth , give I unto you . Let not your heart be troubled , neither let it be afraid .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsuk nga iehnoh ha phi , ïa ka jingsuk jong nga hi , nga ai ha phi . Ngam ai ïa ka kumba ka pyrthei ka ai . Wat sngewkhuslai bad sngewdiaw ; wat sngewsheptieng .

translation.en: When they told it unto David , he sent to meet them , because the men were greatly ashamed : and the king said , Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown , and then return .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewlehrain shaba palat ban leit phai ïing . Haba u Dabid u la tip ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la phah ktien sha ki ban sah ha Jerikho bad ban ym wan phai tad ynda ki  ñiuhtmoh jong ki , ki la san biang .

Ha kajuh ka por ka jingïalang baroh kawei ka la don ha ka jingkhynwin : Katto katne ngut ki briew ki pyrta ïa kawei , kiwei ki pyrta ïa kawei pat , namar kiba bun na ki kim da tip balei ba ki la ïawan lymbung .
translation.en: Some therefore cried one thing , and some another : for the assembly was confused  ; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together .

translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi Bishar , ka syiem jong ka Shelah kan ïeng bad mudui ïa ki briew kiba mynta , namar ka la wan jingjia na la ka jong ka ri ban shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai bastad jong u syiem Solomon ; bad nga ong ha phi ba don uei re u hangne umbiah kham khraw ban ïa u Solomon .
translation.en: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation , and condemn them : for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon  ; and , behold , a greater than Solomon is here .
That I will not take from a thread even to a shoelatchet , and that I will not take any thing that is thine , lest thou shouldest say , I have made Abram rich :
translation.kha: Te men ym ïoh ong , ‘ Dei ma nga uba la pynriewspah ïa u Abram .’

translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel , and with the house of Judah :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por kan poi haba ngan sa pynlong ïa ka jutang bathymmai bad ki paid Israel bad ki paid Judah .

Ha ka shnong Dibon ka wah ka saw da ka snam , bad U Blei u ni kaei kaei kaba kham sniew ba la buh na ka bynta ki briew hangta . Ho-oid , yn don ka jingpynïap ba lyngkien snam ïa uwei uwei baroh ba la iehnoh ha Moab .
translation.en: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood : for I will bring more upon Dimon , lions upon him that escapeth of Moab , and upon the remnant of the land .

translation.kha: Hato uno une na phi un sngap ïa kane ? Naduh mynta hato phiah shahshkor bha ?
translation.en: Who among you will give ear to this ? who will hearken and hear for the time to come ?
And ye will not come to me , that ye might have life .
translation.kha: Pynban phim mon ban wan sha nga khnang ba phin ïoh ïa ka jingim .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  I say not unto thee , Until seven times : but , Until seventy times seven .
translation.kha: Em , ym tang hynñiew sien ,  la jubab U Jisu ,  hynrei haduh hynñiewphew sien hynñiew ,
Ngam la khmied sha tnum halor ki khlieh ki kherub bad halor jong ki ka Don kaei kaei kaban i kum ka khet ba la shna na u mawdong sapphir .
translation.en: Then I looked , and , behold , in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone , as the appearance of the likeness of a throne .

translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki nap bad ki pliang jongki u da ka ksiar nylla .
translation.en: And the tongs thereof , and the snuffdishes thereof , shall be of pure gold .

translation.kha: U mradkhlaw u la pynbor ïa ki briew baroh , kiba rai bad kiba khraw , kiba riewspah bad babha duk , ki mraw malu kiba laitluid , ban don ka shab ïa kaba la shuh ha ki katei kum Jong ki lane ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .
translation.en: And he causeth all , both small and great , rich and poor , free and bond , to receive a mark in their right hand , or in their foreheads :

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ïaid lynti nangta ki pynkhih ïa la ki khlieh bad ki da ther ki jingkrenbeiñ ïa U Jisu :
translation.en: And they that passed by reviled him , wagging their heads ,

translation.kha: mynta , ko Kynhun , leh kumba nga ong .
translation.en: Now therefore , my son , obey my voice  ; and arise , flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran  ;

translation.kha: U shna saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar malade u pyndait ïa ki ha ki saw tylli ki dong ha kiba don ki kjat jngai ka .
translation.en: And he cast for it four rings of gold , and put the rings upon the four corners that were in the four feet thereof .

translation.kha: Hadad ba U Jisu u la shah pynhiarkput , u la wan kiew noh na ka um . Nangta ïa ka bneng la plie ha u , bad u la ïohi ïa U Mynsiem jong U Blei umbah wan hiar kum ka paro bad ka da wanrah shong halor jong u .
translation.en: And Jesus , when he was baptized , went up straightway out of the water : and , lo , the heavens were opened unto him , and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove , and lighting upon him :

translation.kha: To U Trai un habar mano ba bakla napdeng jong ngi ! To un pynsum ïa phi namar ka jingsuh jong phi pyrshah ïa nga , ngab ngan ym pynshong ïa phi da lei lei ruh .
translation.en: The  Lord  judge between me and thee , and the  Lord  avenge me of thee : but mine hand shall not be upon thee .

translation.kha: Hangta u Dabid u leit noh sha shiliang jong ka them bad u ïong ha kliar uwei u lum suba kham ha pajih ,
translation.en: Then David went over to the other side , and stood on the top of an hill afar off  ; a great space being between them :

translation.kha: Ha ka jingthaba jong ki khñium bakhor stet sad ka jingïohknieh na u sum bahynriew , ka sngi bad u bnai ki sangeh hajuh .
translation.en: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation : at the light of thine arrows they went , and at the shining of thy glittering spear .

translation.kha: U la thaw ïa ka sneng bad ïa u bnai ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translation.en: To him that made great lights : for his mercy endureth for ever :

translation.kha: U Shem , u hynne jong u Japheth , u la long u kpa thlim jong ki Hebru baroh .
translation.en: Unto Shem also , the father of all the children of Eber , the brother of Japheth the elder , even to him were children born .

translation.kha: Ka jingthoh bakhatduh ka ong , Nga la kren namar nga la ngeit . Ha kajuh ka mynsiem jong ka jingngeit ngi ruh ngi kren namar ba ngi ngeit .
translation.en: We having the same spirit of faith , according as it is written , I believed , and therefore have I spoken ; we also believe , and therefore speak ;
Believe me that I am in the Father , and the Father in me : or else believe me for the very works  sake .
translation.kha: To ngeit ïa nga haba nga ong ba nga long ha U Kpa bad U Kpa u long ha nga . Lymda kumta , to ngeit namar kiei kiei kiba nga leh .
Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong : Ka long kob eh ïa ki briew ki babha ba kin ïohlait im ; aïu te , kan long ïa ki nongpop ba khlem Blei ?
translation.en: And if the righteous scarcely be saved , where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear ?

translation.kha: ( Ka jingthew ha kata ka por ka ïaryngkat dara syn kilo . )
translation.en: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah .
Wrath is cruel , and anger is outrageous  ; but who is able to stand before envy ?
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar ka long kaba shyrkhei bad kaba pynjot , hynrei kam long ei ei haba ïanujor bad ka jingpihuiñ .

translation.en: And Jonathan caused David to swear again , because he loved him : for he loved him as he loved his own soul .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u Jonathan u pynlong ïa u Dabid ban kular ban ieit ïa u , naba u Jonathan u ieit ïa u Dabid kumba u ieit ïa lade hi .

translation.en: For he that said , Do not commit adultery , said also , Do not kill . Now if thou commit no adultery , yet if thou kill , thou art become a transgressor of the law .
translation.kha: Naba ujuh uba la ong ,  Wat klim ,  u la ong ruh ,  Wat pynïap .  Wat lada phim shym klim , phi la long nongpynkheiñ hukum lada phi pynïap briew .

translation.en: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel , whom God went to redeem to be his own people , to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness , by driving out nations from before thy people , whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt ?
translation.kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei kum ki Israel , ïa kaba me la pyllait im na ka jinglongmraw ban pynlong ïa ki ka jaitbynriew jong me . Kiei kiei ki bakhraw bad baphylla kiba me la leh na ka bynta jong ki , ki pynphriang ïa ka nam jong me kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei . Me la pyllait im ïa ki briew jong me na Ijipt bad pynher krad ïa kiwei ki jaitbynriew katba ki briew jong me ki nang tur shaphrang .

translation.en: That he may give me the cave of Machpelah , which he hath , which is in the end of his field  ; for as much money as it is worth he shall give it me for a possession of a buryingplace amongst you .
translation.kha: Ong ïa u ban die ha nga katba ka shongdor haba phi dang ïadon ryngkat , ba ngan ïohkynti ïa ka kum ka jaka tep .

translation.en: And they led Jesus away to the high priest : and with him were assembled all the chief priests and the elders and the scribes .
translation.kha: Nangta , ïa U Jisu la ïalam sha ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh , ha kaba la ïalumlang ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki rangbah nongïalam bad ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum .
U Petros u la leit kylleng kylleng , Bad ha kawei ka sien u la leit ban jngoh ïa ki briew jong U Blei kiba shong basah ha Lydda .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as Peter passed throughout all quarters , he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda .
Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice , I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian , and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngam sngewthuh ïa ka ktien kaba la kren , u briew uba pyndonkam ïa ka un long u nongwei ha nga bad ngan long u nongwei ha u .

Ki lyngdoh kiba na ka jaitniam Lehbha baïar kim Dei ban ïohpateng ei ei na ka khñiot kumba lama ki para Israel ; ha ka jaka kata , kin ïoh ka bam tang na ki jingainguh bad kiwei pat ki jingkñia ainguh sha U Trai .
translation.en: The priests the Levites , and all the tribe of Levi , shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel : they shall eat the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and his inheritance .

translation.kha: naba ka waiñ na ki ka long kum ka bymmyntoi bseiñ .
translation.en: Their wine is the poison of dragons , and the cruel venom of asps .
I will not leave you comfortless : I will come to you .
translation.kha: Ynda nga leit , phin ym sah tang marwei ; ngan wan pat sha phi .
U Tlai u pyndiaw ïa ki jingthmu ki jaitbynriew ; um shahshkor ïa ki ban pyntreikam ïa ki jingthmu jong ki .
translation.en: The  Lord  bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought : he maketh the devices of the people of none effect .

translation.kha: Ki la phla ïa la ki pop , bad u la pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka wah Johanan .
translation.en: And were baptized of him in Jordan , confessing their sins .

translation.kha: Ngim shym ïohpdiang ïa u mynsiem jong kane ka pyrthei , pynban , ngi lah ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem ba la phuh da U Blei , khnang ba ngin lah ban tip ïa barhem katba U Blei u la ai ha ngi .
translation.en: Now we have received , not the spirit of the world , but the spirit which is of God ; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God .

These words the  Lord  spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire , of the cloud , and of the thick darkness , with a great voice : and he added no more . And he wrote them in two tables of stone , and delivered them unto me .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki hukum ïa kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi baroh mynba phi ïalumlang ha uta u lum . U la kren da ka sur kaba donbor napdeng kata ka ding bad u lyoh uba rben , mynba u ai ïa ki ha phi khlem da bynrap ïa kiwei pat . Nangta u thoh ïa ki ha ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap bad u ai ïa ki ha nga .
Kane ka long kaei kabu ngi kwah ïa me ban ar . Ki don saw ngut ki rangbah jingeh kiba la shim jingsmai .
translation.en: Do therefore this that we say to thee : We have four men which have a vow on them  ;

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la jop ïa ka ri , ka kynhun Israel baroh kamai ka la ïalumlang ha Shiloh bad pynïar ïa ka jingïaineh Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai .
translation.en: And the whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled together at Shiloh , and set up the tabernacle of the congregation there . And the land was subdued before them .

translation.kha: Ïa ki met jong ki la leit rah sha Shekhem , ha Kaba la tep ïa ki ha ka jingtip kaba u Abraham u la thied da ka pisa na ka jait Hamar .
translation.en: And were carried over into Sychem , and laid in the sepulchre that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem .

translation.kha: Katba ki ding ïamih shabar , ki la ïatyngkhuh ïa u briew na Kyrini suba kyrteng u Simon , bad ki shiphang ki la pynbor ïa u ban bah ïa ka diengphna jong U Jisu .
translation.en: And as they came out , they found a man of Cyrene , Simon by name : him they compelled to bear his cross .
She maketh fine linen , and selleth it  ; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant .
translation.kha: Ka thain ki jaiñkup bad ki jingpanpoh bad ka die ïa ki ha ki nongkhaïi .

translation.en: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth , and I am come to shew thee  ; for thou art greatly beloved : therefore understand the matter , and consider the vision .
translation.kha: Mynba me la sdang ban ïasaid bad U Blei , u la jubab ïa me . U ieit ïa me , bad kumta nga la wan ban ïathuh ïa ka jubab ha me . Mynta to pynshahshkor katba nga dang batai ïa ka jingïohipaw .
Kumne ki la leit noh bun mareh na ka jingtep , ki da sngewkhuslai pynlang sngewshyrkhei . Kim shym la ïathuh ei ei ha hano ruh , namar ki la sheptieng . [
translation.en: And they went out quickly , and fled from the sepulchre  ; for they trembled and were amazed : neither said they any thing to any man  ; for they were afraid .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta ki marbl jong phasi ki nongkhaïi ka Sebah bad Rabbah ki ai kylleng da ki mawkyrdon , ka ksiar , bad ki musli Musri bakynsai tam .
translation.en: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah , they were thy merchants : they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices , and with all precious stones , and gold .

Else , if thou wilt not let my people go , behold , I will send swarms of flies upon thee , and upon thy servants , and upon thy people , and into thy houses : and the houses of the Egyptians shall be full of swarms of flies , and also the ground whereon they are .
translation.kha: Lada mem treh , ngan pynshitom ïa me da kaba phah ïa ki skain sha me , sha ki rangbah synshar jong me , bad sha ki briew jong me . Ki ïing jong ki nong Ijipt bad ka madan madiah baroh kin dap da ki skain suda .

Kynmaw ïa kane bad to shemphang ïa ka : Naduh ka por ba la ai ïa ka hukum banbeiñ tei pat ïa ka Jerusalem , tad haduh ba wan u nongriam ba la jied da U Blei , ki hynñiew sien ki hynñiew snoh kin lytar noh . Ïa ka Jerusalem yn tei pat lem bad ki lynti bthah bad ki jingïada bakhlaiñ , bad kan ïeng haduh ingiew sien ki hynriewphew ar snem , hynrei kane kan long ka por ki jingjynjar .
translation.en: Know therefore and understand , that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks , and threescore and two weeks : the street shall be built again , and the wall , even in troublous times .
And Joshua rose early in the morning  ; and they removed from Shittim , and came to Jordan , he and all the children of Israel , and lodged there before they passed over .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , u Joshua bad ki paid Israel baroh ki khie dang step phyrngab , bad ki mihnoh na ka jaka shong dara ha Akasia , bad ki la leit sha Jordan , ha kaba ki la sher dara katba ki dang ap ban jam ïa ka .

Lada uta u briew u jubab , Ai ïeng leh ïa kaba de bad ieh kin da stong shuwa ïa ka khlem ; nangta sa shim katba phi kwah , uta u shakri u lyngdoh u ju ong , Em ! Ai neh mynta kumne ! Lym kumta , nur-um shim ïa ka da ka bor !
translation.en: And if any man said unto him , Let them not fail to burn the fat presently , and then take as much as thy soul desireth  ; then he would answer him , Nay  ; but thou shalt give it me now : and if not , I will take it by force .
When he is about to fill his belly , God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him , and shall rain it upon him while he is eating .
translation.kha: Ai un bam kat kaba u kwah ! U Blei un pynshitom ïa u ha ka jingbitar shla .
Me tip , A Trai , ba ngi ïaid lyngba ïa ka jingim kum ki khop tymmen jong ngi ki la leh . Ki sngi jong sem ki long kum ka syrngiew bad ngin ym lait na ka jingïap .
translation.en: For we are strangers before thee , and sojourners , as were all our fathers : our days on the earth are as a shadow , and there is none abiding .
But he knoweth the way that I take : when he hath tried me , I shall come forth as gold .
translation.kha: Pynban U Blei u tip ïa ka jingjam baroh kaba nga shim ; lada u tynjuh ïa nga , un shem ba nga long khuid .
Bad kumta la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingkmen , malu ki kyntien jong nga ki dap da ka jingkmen . Bad ma nga , la nga long tang u briew , ngan ym khuslai ha ka jingkyrmen ,
translation.en: Therefore did my heart rejoice , and my tongue was glad  ; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope :

translation.kha: U Jonathan u pynïap ïa u jingbabe ai suda jongngi ki Philistia ha Geba , bad ki Philistia baroh ki ïohsngew shaphang kata . Nangta u Saul u phar ïa ki nonglamktien ban Khot ïa ki Hebru sha ka thma da kaba put ïa ka turoi ha kylleng ka ri .
translation.en: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba , and the Philistines heard of it . And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land , saying , Let the Hebrews hear .
Though Babylon should mount up to heaven , and though she should fortify the height of her strength , yet from me shall spoilers come unto her , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat la ka Babilon ka lah ban kiew sha suiñbneng bad tei ka kut baskhem hangta , ngan dang ïai phah hi ïa ki briew ban pynjot ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .

translation.en: And the watchman said , Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok . And the king said , He is a good man , and cometh with good tidings .
translation.kha: Uta u nongap phira u ong ,  Nga ïohi ba u briew uba ha khmat u mareh kum u Ahimaas .   U dei u briew uba bha ,  u syiem u ong ,  bad u wanrah ka khubor kaba bha .

Ka kynoi baroh Kaei ka la sngewbang ïa ka jingtyrwa jongngi ki apostol , kumta ki la jied ïa u Stephan , u briew uba dap da ka jingngeit bad da U mynsaw Bakhuid , malu u Philip , u Prokhoros , u Nikanor , u Timon , u Parmenas , bad u Nikanor , u Jentil babha na Asnoth suba mynshuwa u la kylla sha ka myn Jiw .
translation.en: And the saying pleased the whole multitude : and they chose Stephen , a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost , and Philip , and Prochorus , and Nicanor , and Timon , and Parmenas , and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch :
For vain man would be wise , though man be born like a wild ass s colt .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba mutlop kin sdang ban long kiba stad haba kha ïa ki kada khlaw ban long kum kiba la pynjuh .

translation.en: There are many devices in a man s heart  ; nevertheless the counsel of the  Lord  , that shall stand .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki lah ban thmu shibun kiei kiei , hynrei ïa ka mon U  Trai  yn hap ban pyndep .

Dei namar Kanah ba ki Israel kim lah ban ïeng ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong ki . Ki kynran dien na ki namar ki hi ki la shah pynrem shai ka jingpyntieng ! Ngan ym don ryngkat shuh bad phi lymda ph pynjot thiaw ïa khie kiei kba la sah ïa phira ban ym shim !
translation.en: Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies , but turned their backs before their enemies , because they were accursed : neither will I be with you any more , except ye destroy the accursed from among you .

translation.kha: Kumta phi long kiba nyngkong ban leit shai ka jingsngewmeng . Ki jingkhawai bad ki jingïadih ïabun sngewbha jong ph kin kut nep .
translation.en: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive , and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed .

translation.kha: ha kaba nga la ïohi ïa U Trai , haba u la ino ha nga , ‘ Pynkloi bad mihnoh kyrkieh na Jerusha , namar ki bariew Hangno kin ym pdiang ïa ka jingsuh jong me shaphang jongu nga .’
translation.en: And saw him saying unto me ,  Make haste , and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem : for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me .

translation.kha: Uto uwei u don saw tyllun ki durkhmat , shoh tylli ki thngan , malade kaei kaei kaba syriem ïa ka kti bhabriew hapoh kaei kawei ka thapniang .
translation.en: Every one had four faces apiece , and every one four wings  ; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings .

And Harbona , one of the chamberlains , said before the king , Behold also , the gallows fifty cubits high , which Haman had made for Mordecai , who had spoken good for the king , standeth in the house of Haman . Then the king said , Hang him thereon .
translation.kha: Nangta uwei na ki uba kyrteng u Harbonah , u ong ,  U Haman u la dep ïaid shaphrang ha kaba u la shna ïa ka diengphasi ha ka ïing jong u khnang ba un phasi ïa u Mordekai , uba pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi , ko syiem . Bad ka long kaba jrong arphew ar mitar !   Sdien phasi ïa u Haman ha ka !  u syiem u hukum .
Te ha ka jingjynjar lad ki , ki khiat jingkyrpad ïa U Trai , bad u pynim ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .
translation.en: Then they cried unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he saved them out of their distresses .
And if there be any blemish therein , as if it be lame , or blind , or have any ill blemish , thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada don ei ei kaba duna ha kita ki jingri , lada ki dkoh lane ki matlah , lane lada palat eh kano kano ka jingduna , phim dei ban kñia ïa ki ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not . Thus the land was desolate after them , that no man passed through nor returned : for they laid the pleasant land desolate .
translation.kha: Kum ka  erïong nga la sar noh ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha ki ri nongwei . Ïa kane ka ri babha la iehnoh kynjah ïa ka , khlem don mano mano bashong ba sah hangta .
khem shipor sha ka jingstad mynbarim ; pyrkhat ïa ki jingshisha ba ki kpa jong ngi ki la nangto .
translation.en: For enquire , I pray thee , of the former age , and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers :

translation.kha: NGA sngewbha ban kyrpad ïa ka Ïuodia bad ka Suntukhi , ban pyrshang ban ïamynjur kum shuh para ha U Trai .
translation.en: I beseech Euodias , and beseech Syntyche , that they be of the same mind in the Lord .
Saying , These last have wrought but one hour , and thou hast made them equal unto us , which have borne the burden and heat of the day .
translation.kha: ‘ Kine ki briew kiba la shah khot bylla khatduh ki la trei tang shi kynta ,’ ki la ong , ‘ katba ïa ngi la buh ha ka kam baroh shi sngi ha ka jingshit ka sngi — pynban me siew ïa ki kumjuh kumba me la siew ïa ngi !’
Ha ka nongbah , baroh kiei kiei ki long ha ka jingkem , bad ki briew ki la satlak ïa lade ha ki ïohnang jong ki ban shngain .
translation.en: The city of confusion is broken down : every house is shut up , that no man may come in .

translation.kha: Ki wah ka Edom kin kylla um bsiang , bad ka khyndew kan kylla kyndok . Ka ri baroh kawei kan ïing kum ka bsiang .
translation.en: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch , and the dust thereof into brimstone , and the land thereof shall become burning pitch .

translation.kha: Lada phi! pynbudnam ïa ka ktien u Blei , phin long ki briew ba kmen dak .
translation.en: If you apply God’s Word , you will be a happier person .

translation.kha: Katba u Gehasi u dang ïathuh ïa u symboh kumno u Elisha u la pynim pat ïa u brai uba la ïapom , kata ka briew ka la pynlong ïa ka jingkyrpad na u syiem . U Gehasi u nong ha u , Ko syiem kynrad , khie keiñ kata ka briew , bad une keiñ u khun jong ka ïa uba u Elisha u la pynim pat .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life , that , behold , the woman , whose son he had restored to life , cried to the king for her house and for her land . And Gehazi said , My lord , O king , this is the woman , and this is her son , whom Elisha restored to life .

translation.kha: Khlem jingmaham u pynkynriah ïa ki lum , bad da ka jingbet u pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: Which removeth the mountains , and they know not : which overturneth them in his anger .
And Jonathan answered Saul , David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth–lehem :
translation.kha: U Jonathan u jubab ,  U la kyrpad ïa nga ba ngan shah ïa u ban leit sha Bethlehem .
Kum u Jeroboam ha shuwa jong u , u la pynkhih bitar ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , da ki bapop jong u bad da kaba ïalang ïa ki briew ban leh pop malu mane bleithaw .
translation.en: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin , to provoke the  Lord  God of Israel to anger with their vanities .

translation.kha: Ngi ïakhmih sha phi kum u nongïalam uba khraw ; tep ïa la ka tnga ha ka jaka tep kaba bha tam kaba ngi anna . Uno uno na ngi un da sngewkmen Ban ai jaka thop ha phi , ba phin ïoh banbeiñ tep ïa ka .
translation.en: Hear us , my lord : thou art a mighty prince among us : in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead  ; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre , but that thou mayest bury thy dead .

Wherefore David arose and went , he and his men , and slew of the Philistines two hundred men  ; and David brought their foreskins , and they gave them in full tale to the king , that he might be the king s son in law . And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife .
translation.kha: u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki leit bad pynïap arspah ngut ki Philistia . U wanrah ïa ki doh otsher jong ki baroh sha u syiem bad u da ñiew ïa ki ha u , khnang ba un lah ban long u pyrsa kurim jong u . Kumta u Saul u hap ban ai ïa ka Mikhal ka khun jong u ban shongkurim ïa u Dabid .
Phin Wad ïa nga , bad phin shem ïa nga namar ba phin wad ïa nga da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .
translation.en: And ye shall seek me , and find me , when ye shall search for me with all your heart .

translation.kha: ban hikai ïa ki Israel ban wanrah sha U Blei ha ki por ba la buh ïa ki jingainguh bam badonkam kiba pynsngewbha ïa u .
translation.en: Command the children of Israel , and say unto them , My offering , and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire , for a sweet savour unto me , shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season .

translation.kha: Nangta u kylli ïa u , Phi dang don shuh ki ïakhun shynrang ? U Jaser u jubab , Don sa thiang uba khatduh , hynrei u dang leit sharai ïa ki langbrot . Bthah ïa u ban wan shane , u Samuel u ong . Ngin ym ai jingkñia katba um patar woh .
translation.en: And Samuel said unto Jesse , Are here all thy children ? And he said , There remaineth yet the youngest , and , behold , he keepeth the sheep . And Samuel said unto Jesse , Send and fetch him : for we will not sit down till he come hither .

translation.kha: Haba ka ktien ka la poi ha u syiem ka Judah ba ki kynhun shipai ka Syria ki la da don hapoh ka ri Israel , ma u bad ki briew jyllang u baroh ki la sngewshyrkhei shikatdei ha kaba ki la khynñiuh kum ki dieng ba la pynkhih da ka lyer .
translation.en: And it was told the house of David , saying , Syria is confederate with Ephraim . And his heart was moved , and the heart of his people , as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind .

translation.kha: U Issakhar u don sawphew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Tola , u Puah , u Jashub , bad u Shimron .
translation.en: Now the sons of Issachar were , Tola , and Puah , Jashub , and Shimron , four .

translation.kha: U Ammon lynti u mawpud — lane uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong ki haduh katba shiphew pateng bynthiew — ym dei banbeiñ kynthup hapdeng ki briew U Trai .
translation.en: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord   ; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the  Lord  for ever :
I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin , and defiled my horn in the dust .
translation.kha: Nga sngewsih bad nga phong da ki jaiñ khain , bad nga shong hangne ha u pui pui , ba la shahjop .
Mynno te , ma nga U Trei Nongsynshar ngan ïathuh ha me ïa kaei ka ban jia ïa uta u diengsoh uba la san hajuh ba u la katto ïa ki lyoh . Katba u nang saiñ khah jrong u la nang sngewbiang ,
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast lifted up thyself in height , and he hath shot up his top among the thick boughs , and his heart is lifted up in his height  ;

translation.kha: U la ktah ïa ka kti jrong ka , ka jingshit ka la iehnoh ïa ka , nabar ka la kiei joit bad ka la sdang ban shakri ïa u .
translation.en: And he touched her hand , and the fever left her : and she arose , and ministered unto them .

translation.kha: ki la ïakylliang noh ïa ka burom jong U Blei bad ka dur jong u mirr uba bam phlang .
translation.en: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass .

translation.kha: khnang ba ngi eh ban longïng kiba khuid bad kiba hok ha khmat Jong u baroh ki sngap ka jingim jong ngi .
translation.en: In holiness and righteousness before him , all the days of our life .
And I say also unto thee , That thou art Peter , and upon this rock I will build my church  ; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha me , ko Petros : me long u mawsiang , bad halor kane ka nongrim mawsiang ngan tei ïa ka balang jong nga , bad wat ka jingïap hi kan ym lah ban jop ïa ka .

translation.en: We eat together every evening .
translation.kha: Ngi bam lang man ka janmiet .
To ainguh ïa U Trai , pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u ; ïathuh ïa ki jaitbynriew ïa kaei kaba u la kun .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; call upon his name : make known his deeds among the people .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki long ki mraw jong U Trai , Bad u wallam ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt ; ym dien Ban die mraw ïa ki .
translation.en: For they are my servants , which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt : they shall not be sold as bondmen .
The Jews then which were with her in the house , and comforted her , when they saw Mary , that she rose up hastily and went out , followed her , saying , She goeth unto the grave to weep there .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba don hapoh ïing bad ka Mari , ban pyntngen ïa ka , ki la ïabud ïa ka haba ki la ïohi ba ka la ïeng joit bad mih kyrkieh . Ki la pyrkhat ba ka leit sha ka jingtep ban ïam hangta .

translation.en: But he said unto them ,  Give ye them to eat .  And they said , We have no more but five loaves and two fishes  ; except we should go and buy meat for all this people .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ma phi hi to ai ei ei ha ki ba kin bam .  Ki la jubab ,  Baroh kaba ngi don ki long san tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha . Hato phi kwah ïa ngi ban leit bad thied jingbam na ka bynta une u paidbah ?
Buh ïa film baroh ha ki kti u Aaron bad ha ki kti ki khun Shynrang jong u , bad ong ba kin jingpynkyntang ïa ki kumin ka jingainguh kyrpang sha nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron , and in the hands of his sons  ; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord .
