translation.kha: Ki la jubab ïa u da kaba pyrta jam , Em , ym dei ïa u ! Ngi kwah ïa u Barabbas ! ( u Barabbas u la long u nongkamsniew . )
translation.en: Then cried they all again , saying , Not this man , but Barabbas . Now Barabbas was a robber .

translation.kha: U Benhesed : ki nongbah Arubboth bad Sokoh bad baroh ka ri Hepher
translation.en: The son of Hesed , in Aruboth  ; to him pertained Soco , and all the land of Hepher :

translation.kha: To rwai ha u ïa ka jingrwai bathymmai , to tem da ka jingtbit ïa ka duitara , bad to risa jam da ka jingkmen !
translation.en: Sing unto him a new song  ; play skilfully with a loud noise .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki Pharisi hangta u dei u Nikodemos , u briew uba la longing mynshuwa ban ïohi ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: Nicodemus saith unto them , ( he that came to Jesus by night , being one of them , )

translation.kha: Ngam shym la ïakynduh ïa kiwei pat ki Apostol lait noh tang ïa u Jakob , u para jongu U Trai .
translation.en: But other of the apostles saw I none , save James the Lord s brother .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la phah da ki bseiñ ba-dap da ka bymlah pyndeng kita ki briew , mala bun ki Israel ki la shah puh bad ïap .
translation.en: And the  Lord  sent fiery serpents among the people , and they bit the people  ; and much people of Israel died .

translation.kha: Nga shim ïa Katai kiei khie kaba long hi ka pop — kata ka trud khun masi keiñ kaba phi la thaw bad nga bret ïa ka ha ka ding . Nangta nga pynpait phar ïa ka , nga tylliat ni ïa ka Haduh ba kan da long kum u pui pui , mala nga bret ïa kata ha ka wah kaba tuid na uta u lum .
translation.en: And I took your sin , the calf which ye had made , and burnt it with fire , and stamped it , and ground it very small , even until it was as small as dust : and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount .

translation.kha: malade kin ai ïa ka ha u Eleasar u lyngdoh . Dei ban ïalam ïa ka shabar ka jaka shekel dara bad dei ban pynïap ïa ka hangta ha khmat jongno u .
translation.en: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest , that he may bring her forth without the camp , and one shall slay her before his face :

translation.kha: Naba ka Hima U Balei kam long ha kaba bam bad kaba dih , hawei ka longïing ka hok , ka jingsuk , bad ka jingkmen kiba U Mynsiem bakthang u ai .
translation.en: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink ; but righteousness , and peace , and joy in the Holy Ghost .

They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers , which refused to hear my words  ; and they went after other gods to serve them : the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers .
translation.kha: Ki la leit phai pat sha ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , kiba la kyntait ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Baroh ar , ka Israel bad ka Judah ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
hynrei un ym pynslem ban pynshitom ïa kito kiba isih ïa u .
translation.en: And repayeth them that hate him to their face , to destroy them : he will not be slack to him that hateth him , he will repay him to his face .
And he beat down the tower of Penuel , and slew the men of the city .
translation.kha: U la pyntwa ruh ïa u mot ha Penuel bad pynïap ïa ki rangbah jong kata ka nongbah .
Ki pynbah ki la ïeng hangtai da kaba khmih kabu ki nongïalam jong ki Jisu ki briew ïa u : U la pynim ïa kiwei ; ai un pyndam ïa lade salia u dei U Messaïah ïa babha U blang u la jied !
translation.en: And the people stood beholding . And the rulers also with them derided him , saying , He saved others  ; let him save himself , if he be Christ , the chosen of God .
Before destruction the heart of man is haughty , and before honour is humility .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba ïoh burom lymda u long uba sngewrit ; ki briew kiba meng ki don ha ka lynti sha ka jingjot .

translation.en: And Rebekah took goodly raiment of her eldest son Esau , which were with her in the house , and put them upon Jacob her younger son :
translation.kha: Nangta ka shim ïa ki jaiñ kiba bha tam jong u Iso , ïa kiba ka buh ha ïing , bad ka pynphong ïa ki ha u Jakob .
Uwei na ki u pynbor ïa u ban ïaleit len mala ki ; u la mynjur , bad u ïaleit ryngkat bad ki .
translation.en: And one said , Be content , I pray thee , and go with thy servants . And he answered , I will go .

translation.kha: Ïa ka sngi yn pyndum , bad u bnai un kylla saw kum ka Snam shata kata ka snoh bakhraw bad bashyrkhei jong U Tlai kan wan .
translation.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness , and the moon into blood , before the great and the terrible day of the  Lord  come .

translation.kha: U blang u ïasngew ïa ka jingïamane uta u khunlung , bad na bneng u angel jongnga U Balei u kren ha ka Hagar , Ko hajar , pha khuslai ïa-ei ? Wat sheptieng . U Blei u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingshim uta u khunlung .
translation.en: And God heard the voice of the lad  ; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven , and said unto her , What aileth thee , Hagar ? fear not  ; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is .

translation.kha: Kan ym thup ba dei ma nga uba la ai ïa ka u kaw , ka waiñ , ka nongpynim Olib , bad baroh ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba ka ju pyndonkam ha kaba Mano ïa u Baal .
translation.en: For she did not know that I gave her corn , and wine , and oil , and multiplied her silver and gold , which they prepared for Baal .
And I John saw the holy city , new Jerusalem , coming down from God out of heaven , prepared as a bride adorned for her husband .
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa ka Nongbah Bakhuid , ka Jerusalem bathymmai , kaba da wan hiar na bneng na U Blei , kaba la pynkhreh bad kaba la kloi , kum ka nongleitkurim kaba la riam ban ïashem ïa u tnga jong ka .
Ka sngi Jong ka jingjot ka la wan ïa ka Israel . Ka jingleh jahburom ka nang ngai . Ka jingsarong ka ïeng rasong .
translation.en: Behold the day , behold , it is come : the morning is gone forth  ; the rod hath blossomed , pride hath budded .

And it came to pass , as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians , and went and served Baal , and worshipped him .
translation.kha: Kam shym pat biang ïa u ban leh pop kum u syiem Jeroboam ; u leit kham jngai shuh shuh bad u shongkurim ïa ka Jesebel , ka khun jong u Ethbaal u syiem ka Sidon , bad u la mane ïa u Baal .
Kan dei ka kupar jong phi ngab ïap ka jingïaiban ishyrkhei , namar phim shym la jubab haba nga khot ïa phi lane shahshkor Haba nga kren . Phin jied ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad sa ïa kaba sniew .
translation.en: Therefore will I number you to the sword , and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter : because when I called , ye did not answer  ; when I spake , ye did not hear  ; but did evil before mine eyes , and did choose that wherein I delighted not .
And they departed thence , and passed through Galilee  ; and he would not that any man should know it .
translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad ki la ïaleit lyngba ka Galilaïa . U Jisu um shym la kwah mano mano ruh ban tip hangno u don , namar u dang hikai ïa ki synran jong u :

translation.en: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness : but a false witness deceit .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , ka don ka jingbishar hok , hynrei ki jingshukor ki ïalam sha ka jingshah bishar bymhok .

Ko khun u briew , u la ong , kren ha kine ki nongriam bad ïathuh ïa ki ba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong : phiah la ïawan ban kylli ïa ka mon jong nga , hapoh ym dei kumta ? Kumba da shisha nga long U blang uba im , kan ym shah ïa phi shun kylluid ei ei ïa at . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar de la kren .
translation.en: Son of man , speak unto the elders of Israel , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Are ye come to enquire of me ? As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will not be enquired of by you .

translation.kha: Hato me pyrkhat ba me dei u bri uba jingsuh ba la kha napdeng u khunbynriew ? Hato me Don hangta mynba U Blei u la ïakit ïa ki lumbah ?
translation.en: Art thou the first man that was born ? or wast thou made before the hills ?

translation.kha: Ngin buh ïa pha ha ka bor jong ki , bad kin pynkhyllem ïa ki jaka ha katba pha ïaleh jingrisa bad mane bleithaw . Kin shim noh ïa ki jaiñ badno ïa ki mawlynnai jong pha bad kin iehnoh lyngkhuit khoit ïa phasi .
translation.en: And I will also give thee into their hand , and they shall throw down thine eminent place , and shall break down thy high places : they shall strip thee also of thy clothes , and shall take thy fair jewels , and leave thee naked and bare .

translation.kha: U ijuh u la mynhynne na kata ka jaka bad u la leit sha ka synrang ,
translation.en: And when he was departed thence , he went into their synagogue :
Then the high priest rent his clothes , saying , He hath spoken blasphemy  ; what further need have we of witnesses ? behold , now ye have heard his blasphemy .
translation.kha: Ha kane , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la tar ïa la ki jaiñ bad u la ong ,  Ka jingkrenbeiñ blei ! Ngim donkam shuh bun ki sakhi ! Phi la dang shu ïohsngew ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ blei jong u !
Gera kumba nga la ïaleh shitom pun rat neh , ban pyntwa , Ban jop , ban pyndeng bad ban pynpra ïa ki , kumta pajut ngan ïaleh shitom ban thung ïa ki bun ban twa pang ïa ki .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that like as I have watched over them , to pluck up , and to break down , and to throw down , and to destroy , and to afflict  ; so will I watch over them , to build , and to plant , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: haba u briew u ïaphah hapoh ka ïingjaiñ , mano mano ba don haduh ka ïingjaiñ ha ka por ba ïap lane ba rung hapoh lad ka u long u bymkhuid haduh ingiew Sngi .
translation.en: This is the law , when a man dieth in a tent : all that come into the tent , and all that is in the tent , shall be unclean seven days .

translation.kha: Ko Israel , U Blei uba la thaw ïa phi u ong , Wai sheptieng — ngan pyllait im ïa phi , nga la khot ïa phi da ka kyrteng — phi long u jong nga .
translation.en: But now thus saith the  Lord  that created thee , O Jacob , and he that formed thee , O Israel , Fear not : for I have redeemed thee , I have called thee by thy name  ; thou art mine .

translation.kha: Ka tang Shuh kynjai shai ha Kawei pat ka sngi u Nadab u tur pyrshah bad u ïaleh ïa ki haduh janmiet . Ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lait im lait nep tang sawspah ngut ki samla shynrang kiba kiew ha ki ut bad kiba phet ïap .
translation.en: And David smote them from the twilight even unto the evening of the next day : and there escaped not a man of them , save four hundred young men , which rode upon camels , and fled .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei Uba Hakhlieh Tam Eh um shong ha ki ïing ba la tei da ki bariew , kumba u nongïathuhlypa u ong ,
translation.en: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands  ; as saith the prophet ,

translation.kha: To long kiba khlieh bad kiba khlur ! U Saul , u syiem jong phi u la ïap , bad ki paid Judah ki la pynsleh ïa to kumto u syiem jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore now let your hands be strengthened , and be ye valiant : for your master Saul is dead , and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them .
And Moses took half of the blood , and put it in basins  ; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar .
translation.kha: U Moses u shim shiteng na ka snam jong kita ki mrad bad u buh ïa ka ha ki dabor , bad shiteng pat na kata ka snam u synreit ha kata ka duwan .
U Trai u la Hukum ïa u Moses ban ong ha ki Israel : Phi la ïohi kumno ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren ha phi na Bteng .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel , Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven .

translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa kiba ïapom , bakha rit bad kiba khriat kumjuh , kiba ïeng ha kham jong ka khet . Ïa ki kitab la plied , bad nala la plied sa kawei pat ka kitab , ka kitab jong uba im . Ïa uba ïa-ïap la bishar katai kum kaei kaba ki la leh , kumba la buh jingthoh ha ki kitab .
translation.en: And I saw the dead , small and great , stand before God  ; and the books were opened : and another book was opened , which is the book of life : and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books , according to their works .

translation.kha: Une u Dei U Terah U Blei Badonbor Baroh — U Trai long ka kyrteng ha umbiah dei ban ma .
translation.en: Even the  Lord  God of hosts  ; the  Lord  is his memorial .

translation.kha: Hato phim kynmaw mynba nga la ktah ïa ki san tylli ki kpu na ka pyntha ki san hajar ngut ki briew ? Katno tukri babha da ki lyngkhot kpu kiba sah tad kiba phi la ïalum ? Khat-ar , ki la jubab .
translation.en: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ?  They say unto him , Twelve .
Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall , and on the higher places , I even set the people after their families with their swords , their spears , and their bows .
translation.kha: Kumta nga pynkieng atiar ïa ki briew da ki waitlam , ki sum , bad ki ryntieh , bad nga pynap ïa ki da ki kur hadien ki kynroh , ha ki jaka bym pat dep tei .
Ki khun shynrang u Joseph ïa naba la kha ha Ijipt ki longïng ar ngut ; kumta ki briew baroh kiba na ka ïing u Jakob kiba la wiang Sha Ijipt ki long hynñiewphew ngut .
translation.en: And the sons of Joseph , which were born him in Egypt , were two souls : all the souls of the house of Jacob , which came into Egypt , were threescore and ten .

And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down , What is sweeter than honey ? and what is stronger than a lion ? And he said unto them , If ye had not plowed with my heifer , ye had not found out my riddle .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ha shuwa ba u Samson un leit sha la kamra thiah , ki briew jong kata ka shnong ki ong ha u ,  Kaei kaba kham thiang ban ïa ka ngap ? Uei uba kham khlaiñ ban ïa u sing ?  U Samson u jubab ,  Lada phim shym la lur da ka masi jong nga , Phin ym tip ïa ka jubab mynta .

translation.en: And not holding the Head , from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered , and knit together , increaseth with the increase of God .
translation.kha: Hapoh ka jingsynshar jong U Khrist la bsa ïa ka met baroh kawei bad la pyndait lang da ki mat bad doh-satar jong ka , bad ka san kumba U Blei u kwah ïa ka ba kan san .

translation.en: But if there be no interpreter , let him keep silence in the church ; and let him speak to himself , and to God .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ym don mano mano ba lah ban batai , te uta uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher u dei ban sngap jar noh bad kren tang ha lade bad ha U Blei .

translation.en: Then Asa was wroth with the seer , and put him in a prison house  ; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing . And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynlong ïa u Asa ban bitar haduh katta katta ïa u nongïathuhlypa bad phah teh kynjri ïa u . Ka la long ha kane kajuh ka por ba u Asa u sdang ban lehbeiñ tyngeh ïa katto katne ngut ki briew .

translation.en: To him which divided the Red sea into parts : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: U la kad arliang ïa ka Duriaw basaw , ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
Um shym la longïng kumto ki nongshniah Aiñ ; pynban , u la hikai da ka ieit .
translation.en: For he taught them as one having authority , and not as the scribes .

translation.kha: U Adrammelekh u la wan na Gerar lem bad u Ahussath u nongbud jong u bad u Phikol u rangbah shipai jong u ba ïakynduh ïa u Isaak .
translation.en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar , and Ahuzzath one of his friends , and Phichol the chief captain of his army .
To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne , even as I also overcame , and am set down with my Father in his throne .
translation.kha: Ha kito kiba ïoh ïa ka jingjop ngan ai ïa ka hok ban shong ha syndah jong nga ha ka khet jong nga , kumba nga ruh nga la jop bad mynta nga shong ha syndah U Kpa jong nga ha ka khet jong u .
U Trai Nongsynshar u ai ha nga ka jingkheiñ . U pynlong ïa nga kiba skhem ki khait kum ka skei bad u sumar ïa nga halor ki lumbah .
translation.en: The  Lord  God is my strength , and he will make my feet like hinds  feet , and he will make me to walk upon mine high places . To the chief singer on my stringed instruments .

Now it came to pass upon a day , that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour , Come , and let us go over to the Philistines  garrison , that is on the other side . But he told not his father .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Jonathan u ong ha u samla uba bah ïa ki atiar jong u ,  Ïa ngin leit sha shiliang sha ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia .  Hynrei u Jonathan um shym ïathuh ha la u kpa , u Saul

translation.en: For through the voice of the  Lord  shall the Assyrian be beaten down , which smote with a rod .
translation.kha: Ki Assyria kin khynñiuh haba kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur U  Trai  bad sngew ïa ka bor jong ka jingpynshitom jong u .
nangta u syiem Ahas jong ki Israel bun u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah ki loit ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .
translation.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth–gilead .

translation.kha: Hodaïah kane , u Joseph , uba na ka shnong Arimathaïa , u la pan na u Pilat lada un Shah ba-bang rah ïa ka met U Jisu . ( U Joseph u la erlangthari u nongbud jong U Jisu , hynrei ym ha kaba paw , namar ba u la sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jyllang ki Jiw . ) U Pilat u la ong ïa u ba u lah ban rah ïa ka met , kumta u Joseph u la leit bad rahah noh ïa ka .
translation.en: And after this Joseph of Arimathaea , being a disciple of Jesus , but secretly for fear of the Jews , besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus : and Pilate gave him leave . He came therefore , and took the body of Jesus .

translation.kha: Namar baroh kata kaba la jylla , ma ngi , ki Jesreel , haneng ngi pynlong ka jingïakut bakyntang da ka jingthoh , bad ki nongïalam jong i'u , ki Libni jong i , bun ki lyngdoh jong ngi ki buh ïa ki jingshon mudui ha ka .
translation.en: And because of all this we make a sure covenant , and write it  ; and our princes , Levites , and priests , seal unto it .

translation.kha: Ïa ki shiphang la pynbeit na ka bynta ka tdem bad ka tare sher dara kaba shatei jongno ka nongbah , bad ïa kiba kamar-tama na ki radbah shata ka phang jingbei . U Joshua u sahmiet ha ka them .
translation.en: And when they had set the people , even all the host that was on the north of the city , and their liers in wait on the west of the city , Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley .

translation.kha: Hynrei wat lada ngi klun kumne , ko paralok ba-ieit , ine sngewshngain shemphang jongu phi . Ngi tip ba phi ïoh ïa ki jingkyrkhu kiba kham bha katba ïadei bad ka jingpynim lad phi! .
translation.en: But , beloved , we are persuaded better things of you , and things that accompany salvation , though we thus speak .

But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him , when he fought with Hazael king of Syria . ) And Jehu said , If it be your minds , then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehu u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Joram uba dang don ha Jesreel , ha kaba u la leit ban ïoh jingkoit na ki jingmong kiba u la ïoh ha ka thma ha Ramoth pyrshah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria . translation.en: And Joshua answered them , If thou be a great people , then get thee up to the wood country , and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants , if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee .

translation.kha: U Paulos u la tied ïa ka jingkhang kaba shabar , pynlang ka shakri kaba kyrteng ka Rhoda ka la wan ban peit uei uba tied .
translation.en: And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate , a damsel came to hearken , named Rhoda .

translation.kha: Nga la leit sha wai na kito kiba ïeng hangamei bad nga la kylli na u ban batai ïa ka baroh . Te u la ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingmut .
translation.en: I came near unto one of them that stood by , and asked him the truth of all this . So he told me , and made me know the interpretation of the things .
And his master saw that the  Lord  was with him , and that the  Lord  made all that he did to prosper in his hand .
translation.kha: U la shong la sah ha ka ïing jong u nong Ijipt uba long u kynrad jong u , uba la ïohi ba U  Trai  u don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad ba u la pynmanbha ïa u ha kaei kaei kaba u leh .
To shahshkor , ko khun jongki sa , long uba stad bad pynleit jingmut bha ha ka lynti ka ba phi im .
translation.en: Hear thou , my son , and be wise , and guide thine heart in the way .

translation.kha: U Trai un Shah ïa ki briew ban shah synshar ha ki khynnah shynrang ki bim pat ïaw .
translation.en: And I will give children to be their princes , and babes shall rule over them .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylli biang ïa ki , Ïano phi ïawad ? U Jisu uba na Nasareth , ki la ong .
translation.en: Then asked he them again ,  Whom seek ye ?  And they said , Jesus of Nazareth .

translation.kha: Kaei at lah ban ai ïa U Trai nalor ka jinglehsngewbha jong u baroh ïa nga ?
translation.en: What shall I render unto the  Lord  for all his benefits toward me ?

translation.kha: U Trai um ju bitar shen , hynne u long uba khrawbor bad um ju shahskhor ba bakha shah rai pynrem kin lait khlieh shah pynkhamti . Hanun ha kaba U TRAI’ u ïaid , ki erïong ki khie ; ki lehkai ki long ki pui pui ba la pynmong da ki phet jong u !
translation.en: The  Lord  is slow to anger , and great in power , and will not at all acquit the wicked : the  Lord  hath his way in the whirlwind and in the storm , and the clouds are the dust of his feet .

translation.kha: Ym don jingïapher hapdeng u Briew ibha bet bad u briew uba ai um ; U Blei un ai kyang ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum ka nang kaba u la leh .
translation.en: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one : and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour .

translation.kha: Ym slem hajan , u paidbah uba bun u la ïawanlang . Haba ki briew kim don ei ei shuh ban bam , U Jisu u la khoit ïa ki synran sha u bad u la ong ,
translation.en: In those days the multitude being very great , and having nothing to eat , Jesus called his disciples unto him , and saith unto them ,

translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri jongu ki ban ai kum ki jingkñia sha U Trai hynriew ken kan ym wanrah jingbha ei ei ïa ki . Kin ym shem ïa u namar u la iehnoh ïa ki .
translation.en: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the  Lord   ; but they shall not find him  ; he hath withdrawn himself from them .
And Moses said unto the  Lord  , O my Lord , I am not eloquent , neither heretofore , nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant : but I am slow of speech , and of a slow tongue .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong ,  Em , ko  Trai  , wat phah ïa nga . Ngam ju long u nongkren ba-pnah , bad ngam shym long kum uwei na kita naduh ba me la sdang ban kren ïa nga . Nga long u bym pnah ban kren , uba suki bad uba thlun .

Namarkata , nongmareh ba nga un-long U Blei uba im — kane ka long ka ktien U Trai Nongsynshar — namar pha la pynpyngngad ïa ka Templ jong nga da kiei kiei kiba basniew , ki kam jylliew kiba pha la leh , ngan kyntait ïa pha khlem isynei .
translation.en: Wherefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God   ; Surely , because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things , and with all thine abominations , therefore will I also diminish thee  ; neither shall mine eye spare , neither will I have any pity .

translation.kha: U Jonathan u jubab , Ka jingkynrei kaba khraw i pa jong nga i la leh ïa ki bynriew jong ngi ! Khmih haduh katno nga sngew ïohbor namar ba nga bam khyndiat ka ngap !
translation.en: Then said Jonathan , My father hath troubled the land : see , I pray you , how mine eyes have been enlightened , because I tasted a little of this honey .

translation.kha: Katba ki kynoi halor ki lumbah , ki riewhok Kum ki kali ïapom ; ki sawa kum u phyrngab ha ka ding . Ki ïeng lat kum ka kynhun shipai bakhraw ban ïaleh thma .
translation.en: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap , like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble , as a strong people set in battle array .

translation.kha: Wat leit shaei Beersheba ban mane Blei . Wat pyrshang ban wad ïa nga ha Bethel — ka Beth kan ym long ei ei . Wat leit sha Gilgal — ïa ki briew jngai ka la tim ba kine shah ringmraw .
translation.en: But seek not Beth–el , nor enter into Gilgal , and pass not to Beer–sheba : for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity , and Beth–el shall come to nought .
Now there arose up a new king over Egypt , which knew not Joseph .
translation.kha: Nangta , u syiem bathymmai u bymtip ei ei shaphang u Joseph , u la synshar ha Ijipt .
U Lyngskor u la pule ïa ka shitom bad u la kylli ïa u Paul na kano ka probins u la wan . Haba u la tip ba u dei na Kilikia ,
translation.en: And when the governor had read the letter , he asked of what province he was . And when he understood that he was of Cilicia  ;

translation.kha: Kumta te , kiew kiei baroh ki shong , ym ha kaei kaba u briew u kwah ne u leh , ishyrkhei tang ha ka jinglehisynei U Blei .
translation.en: So then it is not of him that willeth , nor of him that runneth , but of God that sheweth mercy .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingieit U Tlai ïa ki kba tymmen jong phi ka long ka khrawbor dik katta ba u la jakoid ïa phi napdeng ki jingñiewbeiñ barben , bad phi sdang long hapoh mynta ka jaitbynriew ba la jied jong u .
translation.en: Only the  Lord  had a delight in thy fathers to love them , and he chose their seed after them , even you above all people , as it is this day .

translation.kha: A katno me long suba bha — uba bha sbun ! To hikai ïa nga ïa ki hukum jong me .
translation.en: Thou art good , and doest good  ; teach me thy statutes .

translation.kha: Uta u shakri uba peit ba-halor ki jingdiang jingem jong u Abraham , u sping shiphew tylli ki ut jong u kynrad jong u bad u sien sha ka nongbah ha kaba u Nahor u shong u Hukum ha ka bynta bashong shatei ka ri Mesopotamia .
translation.en: And the servant took ten camels of the camels of his master , and departed  ; for all the goods of his master were in his hand : and he arose , and went to Mesopotamia , unto the city of Nahor .

translation.kha: La buh ïa u ha ka jingpeit lem dara ki ba-bymman , la Thep ïa u bad kiba riewpoh , wat la um shym la leh kano kano ka kam bymman lane um shym la shukor ïano ïano .
translation.en: And he made his grave with the wicked , and with the rich in his death  ; because he had done no violence , neither was any deceit in his mouth .

translation.kha: Nangno U Jisu u la shimet ïa ka khuri , u la ainguh ha U Blei , bad u la ong , Shim ïa kane bad sam ïa ka hapdeng jong pa’ .
translation.en: And he took the cup , and gave thanks , and said ,  Take this , and divide it among yourselves :
And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit , because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God .
translation.kha: Bad U Blei , uba ïohi ïa kaba shapoh ki dohnud jong ngi , u tip kaei ka long jingmut jong U Mynsiem ; namar U Mynsiem u ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta la ki briew bad kat kum ka mon jong u .

Mynta ka mynsiem jrong nga ka pait — bad aïu ngan ong ? Hato ngan ong , ‘ Ko Pa , wat ai ba kane ka kyntu kan waiñ ha ar ?’ Hynrei dei na ka bynta kata ar la wan — kthang ba ngan ïoh ïada lyngba kane ka kynta jong ka jingiashah shitom .
translation.en: Now is my soul troubled  ; and what shall I say ? Father , save me from this hour : but for this cause came I unto this hour .
I am my beloved s , and his desire is toward me .
translation.kha: Kaei kane kaba ka jingkhmih jong ka , ka long kum ka step ? Ka long kaba bhabriew bad kaba phyrnai , ka jingphyrnai kum ka sngi ne u bnai .
Nga la ïohthiah ïa kawei patar kaei kaei ha ka jingim kaba long ka bymmyntoi .
translation.en: Then I returned , and I saw vanity under the sun .
By little and little I will drive them out from before thee , until thou be increased , and inherit the land .
translation.kha: Pynban , ngan beh noh ïa ki khyndiat pa khyndiat , tad haduh ba phin da ïabun paid ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri .
To ïai pyrthuh bud ïa nga , ko ki parabangeit jong nga . To pynleit jingmut ïa kito kiba bud ïa ka nuksa katba dei kaba ngi la buh na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: Brethren , be followers together of me , and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an example .

translation.kha: ‘ jingsngewbha , shah ba kan leit ,’ u ong , ‘ namar ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ngi ki pyningkhong ka jingkhawai jingkñia ha shnong , dara u hynmen jong per u la hukum ba at dei ban don hangta . Te kumta , lada phi long u paralok jong nga , shah ba nur-um leit jngoh ïa la ki ki ki jait .’ Dei namar kata ba um shym la don ha la ka jaka ha ka mei bam jong phi .
translation.en: And he said , Let me go , I pray thee  ; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city  ; and my brother , he hath commanded me to be there : and now , if I have found favour in thine eyes , let me get away , I pray thee , and see my brethren . Therefore he cometh not unto the king s table .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki aiñ bad jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba U Trai u la ai ha ki Israel lyngba u Moses ha ki pyntha ka Moab sha sliang ka wah Jordan na Jerikho .
translation.en: These are the commandments and the judgments , which the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho .

translation.kha: U la wan sheng ban Shur ïa phi bad ban thup ïa kiei kaei baher kaba phi leh bad ïa ka leit ka wan jong phi . khyllem pep , phi tip ïa kata !
translation.en: Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner , that he came to deceive thee , and to know thy going out and thy coming in , and to know all that thou doest .

translation.kha: Ngin ym shah liang ha kane ka jingkñia ; ngan nym pynroh ïabun ïan .
translation.en: Let me not , I pray you , accept any man s person , neither let me give flattering titles unto man .
And he brought me into the inner court toward the east : and he measured the gate according to these measures .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop ba sha mihngi sha ka phyllaw bashapoh . U la thew ïa ka khyrdop bad ka la heh katjuh kum kiwei pat .
Akaba ki rangbah ki tdong ïamih , katto katne ngut ki briew ki la Wanlam sha U Jisu ïa u briew u bymnang kren namar ba u shongksuid .
translation.en: As they went out , behold , they brought to him a dumb man possessed with a devil .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la rung shapoh ka jingtep , ha kaba ki la ieh ïa u samla uba shong ha ka liang kamon uba phong da ka jaiñkup balieh — bad ki la sheptieng .
translation.en: And entering into the sepulchre , they saw a young man sitting on the right side , clothed in a long white garment  ; and they were affrighted .

translation.kha: Ki la saphriang kylleng ka pyrthei mala ki la khot ïa ka jaka sher dara jong ki briew jyllang U Blei bad ïa ka nongbah naba u ieit . Hynrei ka ding ka la wan hiar na bneng bad ka la pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: And they went up on the breadth of the earth , and compassed the camp of the saints about , and the beloved city : and fire came down from God out of heaven , and devoured them .

translation.kha: Hib phi ïarwai , wat pynkdang babe ki kyntu bym kit jingmut , kumba ki nongmane blei tala ki leh , kiba pyrkhat ba ki blei jong ki kan ïohsngew ïa ki namar ba ki jingduwai jong ki , ki long kiba jlan .
translation.en: But when ye pray , use not vain repetitions , as the heathen do : for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking .

Wherefore should the Egyptians speak , and say , For mischief did he bring them out , to slay them in the mountains , and to consume them from the face of the earth ? Turn from thy fierce wrath , and repent of this evil against thy people .
translation.kha: Balei ba ki nong Ijipt kin ïoh ong ba me la ïalam ïa la ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , da kaba me thmu ban pynïap ïa ki ha ki lum , bad ban pynjot thiaw ïa ki ? Sangeh ban bitar ; pynkylla noh ïa ka jingmut jong me , bad wat ai ba kane ka jingpynjot kan ngat ha ki briew jong me .
Phi la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei . Kaei ka jingrai jongu phi ? Baroh ki la ria pyrshah ïa u : U longsem ba la rem Bad dei ban pynïap ne ïa u .
translation.en: Ye have heard the blasphemy : what think ye ? And they all condemned him to be guilty of death .

translation.kha: Khlemlait lada u briew , daym pynbud ban leh kumta , u la kut jingmut skhem pun ym shongkurim , bad lada ïa la ka mon u lah ban synshar bad ba u la rai kut ha ka jingmut Jong u ïa kaei kaba un har — te u leh ïa kaba dei ban ym shongkurim katai ka thylliej .
translation.en: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart , having no necessity , but hath power over his own will , and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin , doeth well .

translation.kha: Nangta sa saihon pat nga dem kherub ha khmat U Trai sawphew sngi pynlang sawphew die , bad ngam shem la bam ne dih ei ei , namar ba phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai bad phi la pynbitar ïa u .
translation.en: And I fell down before the  Lord  , as at the first , forty days and forty nights : I did neither eat bread , nor drink water , because of all your sins which ye sinned , in doing wickedly in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
And all that believed were together , and had all things common  ;
translation.kha: Baroh ki riewngeit ki la ïadon lang ha ka jingïasyllok bajan bad ki la ïasam ïa la ki jingdon jingem iwei ïa iwei pat .
Ka leit rah ïa u kew sha shnong bad ka pyn-i ha la ka kiaw kurim haduh katno ka la lat . Ka la ai ruh ha ka ïa kata ka jingdam kaba sah tam .
translation.en: And she took it up , and went into the city : and her mother in law saw what she had gleaned : and she brought forth , and gave to her that she had reserved after she was sufficed .

translation.kha: Mynba nga dang ap khmih , sa uwei pat u mradkhlaw u la mihpaw . U syrti kum u labasa , hynrei ha ka met jong u la don saw tylli ki thapniang , kum ki thapniang jong ka sih , bad u ba-don saw tylli ki khlieh . U don ka dur kum uba don ka bor .
translation.en: After this I beheld , and lo another , like a leopard , which had upon the back of it four wings of a fowl  ; the beast had also four heads  ; and dominion was given to it .
Return unto thy rest , O my soul  ; for the  Lord  hath dealt bountifully with thee .
translation.kha: To sngewskhem , ko mynsiem jong nga , namar U  Trai  u la lehbha ïa nga .

Man ka kynthei kabu ïohpateng ïa ka bri ka khyndew ha kano kano ka jait Israel ka dei ban ïashongkurim bad u briew uba na kata ka jait . Ha kane ka rukom ki Ishmael baroh kin ïohnong ïa ka bri ka khyndew jong ki Kpa tymmen jong u ,
translation.en: And every daughter , that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel , shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father , that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers .

translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki da ka jingtah sleh mala ki la sdang ban ïaphylliew jingmut para ma ki ïa katei ba ki lah ban leh ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And they were filled with madness  ; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus .

translation.kha: Bad ki kynthei ki ong Shua haw , Haba ngi shet ïa ki kpu ha ka tare kum ka Syiem jongnga ka bteng , I ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ka , bad theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ ha ka , ki tnad jongu ngi ki mynjur ïa kaei kob ngi leh .
translation.en: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven , and poured out drink offerings unto her , did we make her cakes to worship her , and pour out drink offerings unto her , without our men ?

translation.kha: U Terah u la ong ïa la ,
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came to Jeremiah , saying ,

translation.kha: Haba ka jingriam u briew ka la kut , hato u pyrkhat sha ne em ba ki khun jongu u kin kmen ?
translation.en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him , when the number of his months is cut off in the midst ?
And they shall destroy the walls of Tyre , and break down her towers : I will also scrape her dust from her , and make her like the top of a rock .
translation.kha: Kin pynjot ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah jong pha bad kin pynpra ïa ki kut jong pha . Nangta ngan sar lut khoit ïa ki pui pui bad ngan ieh sa tang ïa u mawsiang .
Ki nongïalam kiba stad kin tyngshaiñ da ka jingpynhiar baroh jong ka suiñbneng . Bad kito kiba la hikai ïa kiba bun ki briew banbeiñ leh ïa Kiei kaba dei kin tyngshaiñ khim ki khlur junom .
translation.en: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament  ; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever .
Son of man , speak unto the elders of Israel , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Are ye come to enquire of me ? As I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will not be enquired of by you .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  kren ha kine ki nongïalam bad ïathuh ïa ki ba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong : Phi la ïawan ban kylli ïa ka mon jong nga , hato ym dei kumta ? Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , ngan ym shah ïa phi ban kylli ei ei ïa nga . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga la kren .
Da sumar bha te , ban ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jngai phi .
translation.en: Take good heed therefore unto yourselves , that ye love the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Hato ka dih ïa ngi ban buhnud ïa ka nuksa jong phiah nabar ban ym kohnguh ïa U Blei jongu ngi da kiba shongkurim ïa ki kynthei nongwei ?
translation.en: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil , to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives ?

translation.kha: To wiang phai , phira baroh ibha la phai lynter na U TRAI’ ; un pynkhiah ïa phi bad un pynlong ïa phi kiba ïadih . Phi nguh , ïa-ïoh , ngi wan sha U Trai , namar u dei U Blei jong ngi .
translation.en: Return , ye backsliding children , and I will heal your backslidings . Behold , we come unto thee  ; for thou art the  Lord  our God .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un pynkut ïa ka jingkren , u Jonathan , u khup jong u atiar u lyngdoh , u la wan poi . Ale thung , u Adonijah u ong . Me longïng u briew uba bha — me dei ban wanrah ka khubor kaban bha .
translation.en: And while he yet spake , behold , Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came : and Adonijah said unto him , Come in  ; for thou art a valiant man , and bringest good tidings .

translation.kha: U TRAI’ un wallam lang ïa barben ki jingtipbriew ban ïaleh thma ïa ka Jerusalem . Ïa ka nongbah yn sa shim noh , ïa ki ïing la lute , bad ïa ki kynthei la batbor . Shiteng na ki briew ktang leit sha ka jingshah rmiang , hynrei ïa kiba sah na ki yn ym shim ei na ka nongbah .
translation.en: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle  ; and the city shall be taken , and the houses rifled , and the women ravished  ; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity , and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city .

translation.kha: Un pynmadan ïa ki lumbah bakynjang bad ïa ki lumrit ,
translation.en: And upon all the high mountains , and upon all the hills that are lifted up ,

translation.kha: Bad baroh keiñ kiei kiba u Abijah u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Hanes Jong Ki Shilhim Ka Judah .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam .

translation.kha: bad u la ong ha ki , La thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ba U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ïa ka Templ jong to yn khot ka ïing ka jingduwai .’ Hynrei phi pynlong ïa ka , ka jakarieh ïa ki nongtuh !
translation.en: And said unto them ,  It is written , My house shall be called the house of prayer  ; but ye have made it a den of thieves .

translation.kha: U la peit ïa ki bri katba shong sawdong jong u bad u la ong , Khmih ! Hangne ki ei ka kmie jong nga bad ki para jong nga !
translation.en: And he looked round about on them which sat about him , and said ,  Behold my mother and my brethren !

translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u ïong ha ki , Phi baroh ïing hangamei , u Jonathan bad nga ngin ïeng hangto . Leh ïa kano kano kaba ph pyrkhing kaba bha tam , ki jingbabe .
translation.en: Then said he unto all Israel , Be ye on one side , and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side . And the people said unto Saul , Do what seemeth good unto thee .

translation.kha: Te kata ka briew ka leit ïathuh ha la u tnga , U briew’ jong U blei u la wan ha ar , bad ka durkhmat jong u ka jingpyntieng kum u angel U Blei . Ngam shem kylli ba u wan na-ei , bad u ruh um shym ïathuh ïa la ka kyrteng .
translation.en: Then the woman came and told her husband , saying , A man of God came unto me , and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God , very terrible : but I asked him not whence he was , neither told he me his name :

translation.kha: suit u brai u la pyrta na u pynbah , Ko Nonghikai’ ! Ngi kyrpad ïa me , shun khum ïa u khun jngai nga — u khun marwei jong nga !
translation.en: And , behold , a man of the company cried out , saying , Master , I beseech thee , look upon my son : for he is mine only child .

translation.kha: Ki la thngan bad sliang bad ki la duh baroh ka jingkyrmen .
translation.en: Hungry and thirsty , their soul fainted in them .

translation.kha: Balei phim shym ïabam ïa tala ka jingkñia namar ka pop ha ka jaka kyntiap ? Ka long kaba khuid beh , bad U Trai u la ai ïa ka ha phi na ka bynta ban kit noh ïa ka pop jong u paidlang .
translation.en: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place , seeing it is most holy , and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation , to make atonement for them before the  Lord  ?

translation.kha: Uta babha kren ha ki thylliej kiba peh um kren ha kiwei pat hynrei ha U Blei , namar ym don ba sngewthuh ïa u . U kren ïa ki jingshisha barieh da ka bor U Mynsiem .
translation.en: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men , but unto God : for no man understandeth him ; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries .

translation.kha: ha kaba u la shah pynshoi ha u Soitan haduh sawphew sngi . Ha baroh kata ka por u khlem bam ei ei , ba kumta u la thngan eh haba ka la khoit .
translation.en: Being forty days tempted of the devil . And in those days he did eat nothing : and when they were ended , he afterward hungered .

translation.kha: Kim dei kata kaba thung shapoh ka shyntur jongu u bariew kaba pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid kat kum ka lehniam ; pynïap , dei kaba ñiah shabar na ka , kambah pynhieng ïa u , u bymkhuid .
translation.en: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man  ; but that which cometh out of the mouth , this defileth a man .

translation.kha: Katba u syiem bad ki briew jngai u baroh ki la hynne ïa ka nongjop , ki la sangeh ha ka ïing kaba ïathuh .
translation.en: And the king went forth , and all the people after him , and tarried in a place that was far off .

translation.kha: U la kwah ban pyndeng ïa lade da ki jingbam ba bam ki sniang , hynrei ym don mano mano ba ai ei ei ïa u pun bam .
translation.en: And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat : and no man gave unto him .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la ong ha at , ‘ Mahalath ïa ki ban ym sien tur , ngab ngan ym long ryngkat bad ki , bad ki nongshun Jong ki kin sa kjap ïa ki .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Say unto them , Go not up , neither fight  ; for I am not among you  ; lest ye be smitten before your enemies .

translation.kha: katba tip) kumta banbeiñ pynshohbieit ïa u bseiñ ka long ka bymshemphang lada phi shah ïa u bseiñ ban puh nyngkong .
translation.en: Surely the serpent will bite without enchantment  ; and a babbler is no better .
And he gathered men unto him , and became captain over a band , when David slew them of Zobah : and they went to Damascus , and dwelt therein , and reigned in Damascus .
translation.kha: ( Kane ka jia hadien ba u Dabid u la jop ïa u Hadadeser bad u la pynïap ïa ki paralok jong u na Syria . ) U Reson bad ki rangbah jong u ki leit bad sah ha Damaskos , ha kaba ki rangbah jong u ki pynlong ïa u , u syiem ka Syria .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did , and his might , and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoash u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingshlur jong u ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
U Trai’ u la pynkut ïa ka nongpynshitom ïa phi ; u la bneng neh ïa ki nongshun jong phi barabor . U Trai , u syiem ka Israel , u long bad phi ; ym don daw mynta ngab sheptieng .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath taken away thy judgments , he hath cast out thine enemy : the king of Israel , even the  Lord  , is in the midst of thee : thou shalt not see evil any more .

translation.kha: Ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jongno U Jisu ki la wang sha u , hynrei ktieh lah ban ïadon bad u namar u paidbah .
translation.en: Then came to him his mother and his brethren , and could not come at him for the press .

translation.kha: U la tih ïa ka khyndew bad u la weng ïa ki maw na ka ; u la thung ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba kynsai . U la tei ka jaka ap phira ban khmih synrum ïa ki , u la tih ka tliw na ka bynta don nguh ïa ki sohwaiñ . U la ap ïa ki sohwaiñ ban ih , hynrei eiei pa nawei u sohwaiñ u long uba jew .
translation.en: And he fenced it , and gathered out the stones thereof , and planted it with the choicest vine , and built a tower in the midst of it , and also made a winepress therein : and he looked that it should bring forth grapes , and it brought forth wild grapes .

So David took the spear and the cruse of water from Saul s bolster  ; and they gat them away , and no man saw it , nor knew it , neither awaked : for they were all asleep  ; because a deep sleep from the  Lord  was fallen upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u shim ïa uta u sum bad ïa uta u khiew um najan ka khlieh u Saul , bad ma u bad u Abishai ki mihnoh . Ym don mano mano uba la ïohi lane tip ïa kata ; ym don ruh mano mano uba la kyndit — baroh ki dang ïohthiah lyngngai , namar ba U  Trai  u la phah ïa ka jingïohthiah kaba jur ha ki baroh .
ka Yiron , ka Migdalel , ka Horem , ka Bethanath , bad ka Beth Shemesh : khatkhyndai thylliej ki nongbah , lem nabar ki nongrit sawdong jongu ki .
translation.en: And Iron , and Migdal–el , Horem , and Beth–anath , and Beth–shemesh  ; nineteen cities with their villages .
Every man shall give as he is able , according to the blessing of the  Lord  thy God which he hath given thee .
translation.kha: baroh ki dei ban ai katba ki kotbor , kat kum ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kyrkhu ïa phi .
Hynrei U Trai u pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , malu kumta um shym pyllait ïa ki Israel ban leit .
translation.en: But the  Lord  hardened Pharaoh s heart , so that he would not let the children of Israel go .

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynshoh samthiah ïa phi , Bad phi sdang ban ngat ha ka jingïohthiah kaba jrut . Ki nongïathuhlypa ki den ban long ki khmat jong ki briew , hynriew U Blei u la pynsat ïa ki .
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep , and hath closed your eyes : the prophets and your rulers , the seers hath he covered .
And Jesus answering spake unto the lawyers and Pharisees , saying ,  Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day ?
translation.kha: bad U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ïa ki Pharisi ,  Hato ka Hukum jong ngi ka shah ne em ban pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?

translation.en: For had ye believed Moses , ye would have believed me : for he wrote of me .
translation.kha: Lada phi la ngeit da shisha ha u Moses , phin jin da la ngeit ha nga , namar u la thoh shaphang jong nga .
Nga la ai ki jingainguh myntan , bad nga don ki doh kñia .
translation.en: I have peace offerings with me  ; this day have I payed my vows .

And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives , which is before Jerusalem on the east , and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west , and there shall be a very great valley  ; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north , and half of it toward the south .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por un ïeng halor u lum Olib , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jerusalem . Te ïa u lum Olib yn sa kad arliang na mihngi sha sepngi da ka them kaba khraw . Shiteng jong u lumbah un kynriah shaphang shatei bad shiteng jong u shaphang shathie .

Balei ba phi peiñ na nga ba ai ïa ka Abishag ha u ? u syiem u kyrhai . Phi da ngab sa pan ruh na nga ban ai ha u ïa ka khet hati . Nalor dat , u dei u hynmen ba kham heh jong nga , bad ba u Abiathar u lyngdoh bad u Joab ki don ha ka buit jong u !
translation.en: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother , And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah ? ask for him the kingdom also  ; for he is mine elder brother  ; even for him , and for Abiathar the priest , and for Joab the son of Zeruiah .

translation.kha: Nga long u sharak jong me , ko Terah ; nga shrak ïa me , dom ka kmie jong nga ka la leh . Me la pyllut im ïa nga na ka jingïap .
translation.en: O  Lord  , truly I am thy servant  ; I am thy servant , and the son of thine handmaid : thou hast loosed my bonds .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , nga ong ha phi , yn don ar ngut ki briew babha thiah ha kajuh ka jingthiah : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn iehnoh shadien .
translation.en: I tell you , in that night there shall be two men in one bed  ; the one shall be taken , and the other shall be left .

translation.kha: Men nang leit sha khmat jong nga sha Gilgal ; ha kaba ngan ïasam bad me ban kynoi ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ap hangta hynñiew sngi haduh ba ngan da wan bad ïathuh ha me kaei ba man kun .
translation.en: And thou shalt go down before me to Gilgal  ; and , behold , I will come down unto thee , to offer burnt offerings , and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings : seven days shalt thou tarry , till I come to thee , and shew thee what thou shalt do .

translation.kha: Ka um ïa kaba ngan ai ha u Kan long ha u ka umpohliew ka pun pynïoh ïa u da ka um kaba ai jingim bad ai ha u ïa ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst  ; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life .

translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki ïaid shahthngan kumne ki jingat phyllung katba wan stet , hynne U Blei u sneng ïa ki bad ki kynran , la beh noh ïa ki kum u pui pui ha ki sharing lam , khem u phlangïap ha ka erlangthari .
translation.en: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters : but God shall rebuke them , and they shall flee far off , and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind , and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind .

translation.kha: ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh trep Bad ka kriah rnong jong ka , ki jingbah ïa ka , bad ki jingbun jingshat jong ka ; ïa ka dabor bad ka jingpynshong jong ka ;
translation.en: The altar of burnt offering , with his brasen grate , his staves , and all his vessels , the laver and his foot ,

translation.kha: Shaphat ka jingkular kaba ngi la pynlong hapdeng jong ngi , U Trei un pynthikna ba ngin bat ïa ka junom .
translation.en: And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of , behold , the  Lord  be between thee and me for ever .

translation.kha: U Jonadab u ong ha u Dabid , Kito kiba wan ki dei ki khun Shynrang jong phi , kumba nga la ïa-ong ba kin sa wan .
translation.en: And Jonadab said unto the king , Behold , the king s sons come : as thy servant said , so it is .

translation.kha: U Trai u la phah ïa u nongïathuhlypa ban pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na ka jinglongbriew ha Ijipt bad ban sumar ïa ki .
translation.en: And by a prophet the  Lord  brought Israel out of Egypt , and by a prophet was he preserved .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi ïohknieh ïa ki Shong kiba hapoh Katai ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jong phiah u ai ha phi ba long ka jingïohpateng , pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei .
translation.en: But of the cities of these people , which the  Lord  thy God doth give thee for an inheritance , thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth :
And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste , and the land shall be desolate  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongbah kiba mynta ki dap da ki briew yn pynjot , bad ïa ka ri yn pynkylla ri khlaw . Nangta te kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
Hynrei phi , phi un-long uei , ko paralok jong de , pun jubab kylla ïa U Blei ? U kyiuh khyndew um lah ban kylli ïa u briew uba la thaw ïa u , Balei ba me thaw ïa nga kumne ?
translation.en: Nay but , O man , who art thou that repliest against God ? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it , Why hast thou made me thus ?
A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast : but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha ki sumar ïa ki jingri jong ki , hynrei ki riew ba-bymman ki lehbeiñ ïa la ki jong .

translation.en: And I answered , Who art thou , Lord ? And he said unto me ,  I am Jesus of Nazareth , whom thou persecutest .
translation.kha: ‘ Me dei uei , A Trai ?’ nga la kylli . ‘ Nga long U Jisu uba na Nasareth , ïa uba me pynshitom beiñ ,’ u la ong ha nga .

U kpa jong ki u ainong ha ki , Phi kwah ba ngan shuh lut ïa la ki jong ki khun ? U Joseph um don shuh , u Simeon ruh um don , bad mynta pat phi kwah ban shim noh sa ïa u Bymman . dem ma de kiew kaba sha jynsur !
translation.en: And Jacob their father said unto them , Me have ye bereaved of my children : Joseph is not , and Simeon is not , and ye will take Benjamin away : all these things are against me .

And the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , get thee down quickly from hence  ; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves  ; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them  ; they have made them a molten image .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Khie leit hiar kloi na une u lum , namar kita ki briew jong me ïa kiba me la ïalam na Ijipt , ki la mut sniew bad ki la leh bymman . Ki lah da kynriah noh na kata ka lynti ïa kaba nga la hukum ïa ki , bad ki la thaw pynban ïa ka durblei na ka bynta ïa lade .’

translation.en: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel , who did very wickedly :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka por , u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah u la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u Ahasaïah u syiem ka Israel , uba la leh bun kiei kiei kiba sniew .
Ym don shuh u briew uba hok umbah dang don ha ka ri , ym don mano mano baïaineh malade U Blei . Ussaïah pa uwei u ap ïa ka kabu ban pynap briew . Ussi pa uwei u behmrad ïa la u para shong .
translation.en: The good man is perished out of the earth : and there is none upright among men : they all lie in wait for blood  ; they hunt every man his brother with a net .
Deal bountifully with thy servant , that I may live , and keep thy word .
translation.kha: To long uba bha ïa nga , u shakri jong me , khnang ba ngan ïoh im , bad kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong me .

translation.en: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year  ; lest the land become desolate , and the beast of the field multiply against thee .
translation.kha: Ngan ym beh noh ïa ki hapoh shisnem , lada nga leh kumta , ka ri kan long kaba kynjah , bad ki mradkhlaw kin bun palat ïa phi .

Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga pynban ba nga long u nongshun jongno phi . Ngan shim noh ïa ki langbrot jong nga na phi , bad lang ym shah shuh ba phin lama ki nongsharai jong ki ; ngan ym shah shiah ba phin sumar bha tang ïa laiñ . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki langbrot jong nga na phi bad ngan ym shah ba phin bam ïa ki .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against the shepherds  ; and I will require my flock at their hand , and cause them to cease from feeding the flock  ; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more  ; for I will deliver my flock from their mouth , that they may not be meat for them .

translation.kha: leit marjan mar sha u Shimei Dabid bad pan na u , ‘ Syiem Kynrad , hato phim shym la kular kyntang ïa nga ba u Solomon , u khun jong nga un long syiem hadien jong phi ? Kumno te ka lah ngab long ba u Hodaïah u la long syiem ?’
translation.en: Go and get thee in unto king David , and say unto him , Didst not thou , my lord , O king , swear unto thine handmaid , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne ? why then doth Adonijah reign ?

translation.kha: Balei , te , U Jisu u la kylli , ba U Mynsiem u pynshlur ïa Dabid ban khot ïa u , ‘ U Trai’ ? U Dabid u la ainong ,
translation.en: He saith unto them ,  How then doth David in spirit call him Lord , saying ,

translation.kha: U langsohmoh uba hap ha u Asalaïah yn wallam im ha khmat U Trai bad nangta yn pyllait ïa u sha ka ri shyiap sha u Asasel , khnang ba un kit noh ïa ki pop u paidbah .
translation.en: But the goat , on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat , shall be presented alive before the  Lord  , to make an atonement with him , and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness .
And when the sun is down , he shall be clean , and shall afterward eat of the holy things  ; because it is his food .
translation.kha: Un sa long uba khuid hadien ba ka sngi ka la sep , bad nangta u lah ban bam ïa kita ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang , kiba dei ka jingbam jong u .

translation.en: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief , that he might have mercy upon all .
translation.kha: Naba U Blei u la pynlong ïa baroh ki briew , ki koidi jong ka jingbymkohnguh , khnang ba un lah ban pyn-i ïa ka jingisynei ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it : but the instruction of fools is folly .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka long ka umpohliew jong ka jingim ha kiba stad , hynrei kaba pyrshang ban ai jinghikai ïa kiba mutlop ka long tang ka jingpynlut kai ïa ka por .

translation.en: And when she saw Peter warming himself , she looked upon him , and said , And thou also wast with Jesus of Nazareth .
translation.kha: Haba ka la ïohi ïa u Petros ba u dang syaid ding , ka la peit shaiñ ïa u bad ka la ong ,  Ma me ruh , me la long bad U Jisu uba na Nasareth .
Ka jingïohknieh ka long ym ia barabor ki jaitniam , hynmen tang ia kito ki niam kiba kyntiew ia ki kad Jingbymman .
translation.en: The fault lies , not with all religion , but with false religion .
And Joseph dwelt in Egypt , he , and his father s house : and Joseph lived an hundred and ten years .
translation.kha: U Joseph u shong u sah ha ka ri Ijipt bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u kpa jong u ; u la ïap noh haba u la dap shispah shiphew snem ka rta .

translation.en: And the next day we touched at Sidon . And Julius courteously entreated Paul , and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud ngi la poi ha Sidon . U Julius u la lehsbun ïa u Paul bad u la shah ïa u ban leit bad ïakynduh ïa la ki paralok , ba kin ai kat kaba u donkam .
U kyrkhu ïa ki bariew jong u , bad ki don pung ki khun ki kti ; u pynlong ba ki jingri jingdup jong ki kin ym daiñ .
translation.en: He blesseth them also , so that they are multiplied greatly  ; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease .

translation.kha: Ïa ki um la kad arliang , bad ki Israel ki ïaid liengbah ïa kata ka duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang , katba kita ki um ki long kum ki kynroh ha barabor arliang .
translation.en: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground : and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand , and on their left .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la leit sha ka Templ ha ka por lai baje nohphai sngi , kaba long ka kynta jingduwai .
translation.en: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer , being the ninth hour .

translation.kha: Ka jingshyrkhei bad ka jingkhublei ki wan hap halor jongnga ki . Ki ioh ïa ka bor jong me , ko Trai , ki ïeng khlem lait kren da ka jingtieng , tad haduh ba ki briew jong me ki la ïada lait sha shiliang — ki briew kiba me la pyllaitluid na ka jinglongmraw .
translation.en: Fear and dread shall fall upon them  ; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be as still as a stone  ; till thy people pass over , O  Lord  , till the people pass over , which thou hast purchased .

translation.kha: Long kiba kohnguh bad Kiba ïaineh , bad U Blei un map ïa ka pop jong phi . To kohnguh ïa U Trai bad kaba sniew kan ym jia ha phi .
translation.en: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged : and by the fear of the  Lord  men depart from evil .

translation.kha: Hib ki theisamla na Shiloh ki wan shad ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam , phi to wan mih na kita ki bri shitaiew . Uwei pa uwei na phi un shim da ka bor napdeng wir ki theisamla bad ïalam ngab long ka tnga jyllang phira shwa ka tare ki Benjamin .
translation.en: And see , and , behold , if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances , then come ye out of the vineyards , and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh , and go to the land of Benjamin .

translation.kha: Namarkata Phi dei ban pynmih ki lawbah ba wer ki ngab kin sangeh noh na ka jingtei pat ïa ka nongbah haduh ba ngan da ai hukum da kumwei pat .
translation.en: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease , and that this city be not builded , until another commandment shall be given from me .

translation.kha: Hynrei u ong , Wat pynjah Shu ïa ngi . U Troas u la ai jingjop ïa ka jingleit jong por ; to shah ngan kitei peiñ pat sha la u kynrad .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Hinder me not , seeing the  Lord  hath prospered my way  ; send me away that I may go to my master .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba jingsuk ba u Syros ka ri Persia u Long u patsha . U Trai u pynlong ïa kaei kaba u la ong lyngba u nongïalap Jeremaïah ban urlong shisha . U pynsngew ha u Syros ban pynmih ïa ka hukum umdih bad ban phah ha ka jingteh ïa ka ban pule jam ha kylleng ka hima jong u :
translation.en: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia , that the word of the  Lord  spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished , the  Lord  stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia , that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom , and put it also in writing , saying ,
All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt , which came out of his loins , besides Jacob s sons  wives , all the souls were threescore and six  ;
translation.kha: Baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob kiba la leit sha Ijipt , lait noh ki tnga jong ki khun shynrang jong u , ki long hynriewphew hynriew ngut .
U Jisu u la leit phai pat sha shiliang ka duriaw . Hangno harud ka duriaw , u paidbah babun u la ïalumlang sawdong jong u .
translation.en: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side , much people gathered unto him : and he was nigh unto the sea .

translation.kha: Naba u kpu ba U Blei u ai u erlangthari uta ibha wan hiar na bneng bad uba ai jingim ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven , and giveth life unto the world .
And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses said unto the people , Ye have sinned a great sin : and now I will go up unto the  Lord   ; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Moses u ong ha ki paidbah ,  Phi la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei eh . Mynta ngan leit kiew biang sha U  Trai  ; lehse nga lah ban pynïoh ïa ka jingmap ïa ka pop jong phi .
Kumta U Blei u la pynbna ïa ka jingtim ha ka Pyrthei . Ki briew jngai ka ki hap ban siew ïa kaei kaba ki la kuna . Kiba im ki la kada duna dara nang duna .
translation.en: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth , and they that dwell therein are desolate : therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned , and few men left .
And I fell unto the ground , and heard a voice saying unto me ,  Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ?
translation.kha: Nga la hap sha madan bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba ong ha nga , ‘ Saul , Saul ! Balei me pynshitom beiñ ïa nga ?’
Pynbna nga dang duwai , u Gabriel , suba nga la lah ïor ha ka jingïohipaw mynshuwa , u la wan her shai tbian shuh ka iaka ha kaba nga dat . Ka la longsyiem ha ka por ban ai ïa ka jingkñia jingïamai .
translation.en: Yea , whiles I was speaking in prayer , even the man Gabriel , whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning , being caused to fly swiftly , touched me about the time of the evening oblation .

translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewsynei kan long ïa ph kiba shongsuk ha Seïon , bad ïa phi kiba sngewshngain ha Shamir — phi ki briew kiba khrum jong kano ka jaitbynriew Eliel kaba khraw , phi sha kaba ki briew ki ju leit ban Ïoh jingïarap !
translation.en: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion , and trust in the mountain of Samaria , which are named chief of the nations , to whom the house of Israel came !
And thou shalt stone him with stones , that he die  ; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage .
translation.kha: Lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap ! U la pyrshang ban khring noh ïa phi na U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .

translation.en: Then went Solomon to Ezion–geber , and to Eloth , at the sea side in the land of Edom .
translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u leit sha Esiongeber bad sha Elath , ki kadlieng harud ka Khmut Duriaw Akaba , ha ri ki Edom .

translation.en: For as by one man s disobedience many were made sinners , so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous .
translation.kha: Bad kumba ïa baroh ki briew la pynlong ki nongpop na ka daw jong ka jingbymkohnguh jong uwei u briew , ha kajuh ka rukom yn pynïasuk ïa ki baroh bad U Blei na ka daw jong ka jingkohnguh jong uwei u briew .
Nangta ki nongmih Mahalab kin ym sngewkhia ïa u blei Khemosh jyllang ki , kumba ki Israel kim sngewbiang ïa u blei Bethgamul ha wahbah ki shane .
translation.en: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh , as the house of Israel was ashamed of Beth–el their confidence .

translation.kha: Ki la tat matsohlah ïa u bad ki la kylliang ïa u , Mane ba tied ïa me ? To antad !
