translation.kha: Ki la ïalumlang tista ban duwai kum ka kynhun , ryngkat lem bad ki kynthei bad ka Mari ka kmie jong U Jisu bad ki para shynrang jong u .
Ki jingsawa ba-ïaitrei kine pah ha ki shkor jong ki , malade ki nonglute kin wan kurup ïa ki haba ki dang pyrkhat ba ki shngain .
translation.en: A dreadful sound is in his ears : in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him .

translation.kha: Lum ïa kane ka jingainguh na ki Israel , mala pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga . Kane ka khajna ka long ka jingsiew na ka bynta la ka jingim , bad ngan kynmaw ban da ban Jer ïa ki .
translation.en: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel , and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation  ; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the  Lord  , to make an atonement for your souls .

translation.kha: Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki riewdonburom pun kylla-kaba-mut , Hynrei ïa uba la shait kyntait .
translation.en: I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .

translation.kha: hangtei halor u Lum Synñia ha ka ri shyiap , U Trai u la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha u Moses ha kata ka sngi ba u la noh ïa ki paid Israel ban ïalamwir ïa ki jingainguh jongnga ki .
translation.en: Which the  Lord  commanded Moses in mount Sinai , in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the  Lord  , in the wilderness of Sinai .

translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki jingker kiba pynïeng ïa ka Ïingjaiñ da ka dieng akasia .
translation.en: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up .

translation.kha: U la phah ïa ka khubor sha kawei pa kawei ka jylla jong u syiem ha ka ktien bad ka rukom thoh jong kata ka probins , kaba ong ba uwei pa uwei u tnga u longkmie u kynthih jong ka ïing jong u bad kaba u kren kan long ka bor kaba kut .
translation.en: For he sent letters into all the king s provinces , into every province according to the writing thereof , and to every people after their language , that every man should bear rule in his own house , and that it should be published according to the language of every people .

translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba khmih isynei ïa pha ban kun ïa kine kiei kiei na ka bynta jong pha . Mynba la kha ïa pha , ym don mano mane ba la ieit ïa pha . La bret ïa pha ha madan bym don jingkah .
translation.en: None eye pitied thee , to do any of these unto thee , to have compassion upon thee  ; but thou wast cast out in the open field , to the lothing of thy person , in the day that thou wast born .

translation.kha: ban buh jingtynjuh ïa ki lumbah katno ngut ki don shi kur shi kur nabar shi ïing shi ïing , da kaweh thoh kyrteng ïa uwei pa uwei u shajrong uba la dap shi bnai ne kham heh ,
translation.en: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary , and all the vessels of the sanctuary , as the camp is to set forward  ; after that , the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it : but they shall not touch any holy thing , lest they die . These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom keiñ kynshew ïa lade ka spah ka ban long ka nongrim kaba skhem na ka bynta ka lawei . Bad nangta kine lah ban jop ïa ka jingim kaba long ka jingkem kaba shisha .
translation.en: Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come , that they may lay hold on eternal life .

Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing , as the uncleanness of man , or any unclean beast , or any abominable unclean thing , and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings , which pertain unto the  Lord  , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .
translation.kha: Shuh shuh , lada uno uno u bam ïa ka doh jong kane ka jingainguh hadien ba u la ktah ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid , la ka dei kaba na u briew ne na u mrad , ïa u ruh yn ym ñiew shuh kum uwei na ki briew U Blei .
Haba ka por ka la poi ïa-ban lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa u mraw sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang ïa la ka bynta na ka jinglum soh .
translation.en: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant , that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard .

translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban lai jong khlieh hiar kito ha kiba la ai ïa phi baneh sumar , hynrei to longsem ka nongshna ïa ka kynhun .
translation.en: Neither as being lords over God s heritage , but being ensamples to the flock .
And one shall say unto him , What are these wounds in thine hands ? Then he shall answer , Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends .
translation.kha: Te lada uno uno u kylli ïa u , ‘ Kiei kito ki jingmong ha ka shadem jong phi ?’ Un jubab , ‘ Nga la ïoh ïa ki ha ka ïing u paralok .’
Naba ïa ki jingthaw hi ha kawei ka sngi yn pyllaitluid na ki jinglongmraw sha ka jingpyut bad ban ïadon bynta ha ka jinglaitluid Badonburom jong ki khun jong U Blei .
translation.en: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God .

translation.kha: U Trai u Kylli , Balei nur map ïa ki bapop jong ki Briew jong sa ? Ki la iehnoh ïa de , bad ki la mane ïa ki blei ki bymshisha . Nga la bsa ïa ki brisoh jong por shuh ba kin da kdang , hynne ki la leh awria , bad ki la pynlut ïa ka jer jong ki bad ki nuti .
translation.en: How shall I pardon thee for this ? thy children have forsaken me , and sworn by them that are no gods : when I had fed them to the full , they then committed adultery , and assembled themselves by troops in the harlots  houses .
And after a little while another saw him , and said , Thou art also of them . And Peter said , Man , I am not .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por uwei u briew u la ïohi ïa u Petros bad u la ong ,  Me ruh , me long uwei na ki !  Hynrei u Petros u la jubab ,  Ko rangbah , ngam dei !

translation.en: And they shall take gold , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine linen .
translation.kha: Ki nongsuhjaiñ batbit ki dei ban pyndonkam da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , u  sai ksiar , bad da ka jaiñ linen bani .
Ngan kham halor jong ki bad ngan wallam baklang ïa ki sha kane ka ri . Ngan tei bha ïa ki bad ngan ym tar lyngkhot ïa ki ; ngan thung ïa ki sad ngan ym rat ïa ki .
translation.en: For I will set mine eyes upon them for good , and I will bring them again to this land : and I will build them , and not pull them down  ; and I will plant them , and not pluck them up .

translation.kha: Hato u briew un ïohnong ei ei lada u ioh ïa ka pyrthei baïar kawei hynrei u hi u dih noh lane u shahjop ? Em da shisha !
translation.en: For what is a man advantaged , if he gain the whole world , and lose himself , or be cast away ?

translation.kha: Nahath ki kulai kin wan ïaid , Ki da kyrdem ïa ka khyndew da ki poh jat jong ki .
translation.en: Then were the horsehoofs broken by the means of the pransings , the pransings of their mighty ones .
And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem , in the house of the  Lord  , before the new court ,
translation.kha: bad ma ki bad ki briew ka Jerusalem ki ïalumlang ha ka phyllaw bathymmai jong ka Templ . U syiem Jehoshaphat u leit bad u ïeng ha khmat jong ki bad duwai jam ,

bad ha u Isaak nga la ai ïa u Jakob malu u Iso . Nga la ai ha u Iso ïa ka ri lum Edom kum ka jingïohkynti lad u , hynrei u Jakob , u kpa thnam jong phi , bad ki ïakhun ki kti jong u , ki leit hiar sha Ijipt .
translation.en: And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau : and I gave unto Esau mount Seir , to possess it  ; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt .

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong to , kan myntoi aïu ïa uba ainong ba u don ka jingngeit lada da ki nang jong u , um pynshisha ïa kata ? Hato Katai ka jingngeit kan pynim ïa u ?
translation.en: What doth it profit , my brethren , though a man say he hath faith , and have not works ? can faith save him ?

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïohsngew ïa kñia , kumta ki la sdang ban ïawad da kano ka jong don pynïap noh ïa U Jisu . Ki la sheptieng ïa u , namar Utai u Baïap baroh u la sngewphylla ïa ka jinghikai jong u .
translation.en: And the scribes and chief priests heard it , and sought how they might destroy him : for they feared him , because all the people was astonished at his doctrine .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ïajubab , Me don hok aïu ban bitar ?
translation.en: Then said the  Lord  , Doest thou well to be angry ?

translation.kha: Ki shipai na Parthia , Lydda , bad Libya ki shakri ha ka kynhun shipai jong pha . Ki wah ïa ki stieh bad ïa ki jingda khlieh jong ki ha ki jaka shong jong pha . Ki long ki rangbah kiba la pynïohburom ïa pha .
translation.en: They of Persia and of Lud and of Put were in thine army , thy men of war : they hanged the shield and helmet in thee  ; they set forth thy comeliness .
And again they said , Alleluia . And her smoke rose up for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Sa shisien ki la pyrta ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei ! Ka tdem na ki thylliej ding kiba la bam duh ïa ka nongbah bakhraw ka la kiew shajrong junom la junom !
Wat mane ïa U TRAI’ U Blei jong phi kumba leh kita ki briew .
translation.en: Ye shall not do so unto the  Lord  your God .

And I beheld , and , lo , in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts , and in the midst of the elders , stood a Lamb as it had been slain , having seven horns and seven eyes , which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa U Khunlangbrot uba ïeng hapdeng ka khet , ïa kaba la ker sawdong da ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im bad ki nongsharai balang . U Khunlangbrot u la paw ba u la shah pynïap . U don hynñiew tylli ki reng bad hynñiew tylli ki khmat , kiba long ki hynñiew ki mynsiem U Blei ïa kiba la phah sha kylleng ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Behold , I am against them that prophesy false dreams , saith the  Lord  , and do tell them , and cause my people to err by their lies , and by their lightness  ; yet I sent them not , nor commanded them : therefore they shall not profit this people at all , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: To sngew ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga ong ! Nga long pyrshah ïa kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ïathuh ïa la ki jingphohsniew kiba dap da ki jinglamler . Ki ïathuh ïa kine ki jingphohsniew bad ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong nga da ka jinglamler bad ka jingsngewmeng jong ki . Ngam shym la phah ne hukum ïa ki ban leit , bad kim shym la long satia ka jingïarap ïa ki briew . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

U Dabid u phet krad na ka nongbah kup bad u leit sha ka krem hajan ka nongrit Adummim . thaba ki hynmen shynrang jong u badno kiwei pat ki ba-ha-ïing ha jong u ki ïatip ba u don hangta , ki la ïadoh badno u .
translation.en: David therefore departed thence , and escaped to the cave Adullam : and when his brethren and all his father s house heard it , they went down thither to him .
Then said I , Wisdom is better than strength : nevertheless the poor man s wisdom is despised , and his words are not heard .
translation.kha: Nga la ïai-ong borabor ba ka jingstad ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingkhlaiñ , hynrei ym don mano mano ba pyrkhat ïa u briew uba duk ba u long uba stad lane pynshahshkor ei ei ïa kaei kaba u ong .
Uba hok u isih ïa u bymman , malade u ba-bymman u kito ïa uba hok .
translation.en: An unjust man is an abomination to the just : and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked .

translation.kha: Ka kynran ki nonglute kin sa wan ïabeh ïa u Gad , Hynrei un phah kylla ban beh ïa ki nadien .
translation.en: Gad , a troop shall overcome him : but he shall overcome at the last .

translation.kha: u ban khmih bniah ïa u . Lada ka don ka burom kaba lehse ha ka sniehdoh jong u kaba la pynlieh ïa u shñiuh bad kaba dap da ka ksuit ,
translation.en: And the priest shall see him : and , behold , if the rising be white in the skin , and it have turned the hair white , and there be quick raw flesh in the rising  ;

translation.kha: ngat u Hoshaïah u ïathuh ha u Sadok bad u Abiathar , ki lyngdoh , ïa ka jingai jingmut kaba u la ai ha u Abel mala ha ki nongïalam jong ki Israel , bad ïa ka jingai jingmut kambah u Ahithophel u la ai .
translation.en: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests , Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Israel  ; and thus and thus have I counselled .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa u paidbah bad u la leit rung shapoh ïing , ki synran jong u ki la wanlam shai u bad ki la ong , To ïathuh ïa ngi aïu ka pharshi shaphang ki ñiuhmat hapoh ka lyngkha ka kit jingmut .
translation.en: Then Jesus sent the multitude away , and went into the house : and his disciples came unto him , saying , Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field .

translation.kha: U Jisu u dang ïaid ha ka baranda u Solomon kaweh ha ka Templ , haba ki briew’ ki la ïalamwir sdang ïa u bad kylli , Sa katne men dong ïai pynap ïa ngi ha ka jinglyngngoh ? Ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka jingshisha naba shai kdar : Hato me longïing U Jeshaïah ?
translation.en: Then came the Jews round about him , and said unto him , How long dost thou make us to doubt ? If thou be the Christ , tell us plainly .
And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases , and removed the laver from off them  ; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it , and put it upon a pavement of stones .
translation.kha: U syiem Ahas u shim kyrpang ïa ki kali rnong ba pyndonkam ha ka Templ bad weng noh ïa ki khiew kiba don halor jong ki ; u shim ïa ka pipa rnong na ki bynta ba shadien jong ki khat-ar tylli ki masi dab rnong , bad u buh ha u maw nongrim .

Da shisha kiba kumin Kine ki kyndon ki i kumba la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingstad ha ka jingmane ba shu pynbor ïa ki angel , bad ka jingsngewrit bymïaineh , bad ka jingleh palat ïa ka met ; hynrei ki bymdondor ei ei ha kaba synshar ïa ki jingbrai ka doh .
translation.en: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship , and humility , and neglecting of the body ; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh .

translation.kha: U Janoah u la sngewsih haduh katta Iso shaphang kane bad u la bato .
translation.en: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly , and he was very angry .

translation.kha: kiba ka kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ha ka jinglehkai ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jyllang ngi .
translation.en: Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ .

And he gave him none inheritance in it , no , not so much as to set his foot on : yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession , and to his seed after him , when as yet he had no child .
translation.kha: U Blei , mynkata , um shym la ai ha u Abraham ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka kum ka jong u hi , ym wat shi mitar sawdong jong ka khyndew , hynrei U Blei u la kular ban ai ïa ka ha u , bad ba kan long ka jong u bad ka jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u . Ha ka por ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa kane ka jingkular , u Abraham um pat don khun .

translation.en: I went mourning without the sun : I stood up , and I cried in the congregation .
translation.kha: Nga ïaid shane shatai ha ka jingdum , khlem ka jingshai ka sngi ; nga ïeng ha khmat ki briew bad nga kyrpad jingïarap .

translation.en: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the  Lord  , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa uta u masi lyngraw hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga ha ka jaka rung jong ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And do this thing , Take the kings away , every man out of his place , and put captains in their rooms :
translation.kha: Mynta , weng noh ïa ki laiphew ar ngut ki nongsynshar na ka kyrdan ai hukum bad bujli noh ïa ki da ki rangbah ai hukum na madan thma .

translation.en: And the king of Syria said , Go to , go , and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel . And he departed , and took with him ten talents of silver , and six thousand pieces of gold , and ten changes of raiment .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ,  Khie leit sha u syiem Israel bad rah ïa kane ka shithi sha u .  Kumta u Naaman u leit , u da rah laiphew hajar tylli ki lyngkhot rupa , hynriew hajar tylli ki lyngkhot ksiar , bad shiphew riam ki jaiñ ba-itynnat .
Kine ki long ki jinglong kiba phi donkam , mala lada phi don kyrhai ïa ki , kin pynlong ïa phi kiba smat dara kiba seisoh ha ka jingdap ïa U Jisu Kynther U Trai jyllang ngi .
translation.en: For if these things be in you , and abound , they make you that ye shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ .
Do therefore according to thy wisdom , and let not his hoar head go down to the grave in peace .
translation.kha: Me tip kaei ban leh ; mem dei ban shah ïa u ban ïap da kaba suk .

translation.en: And the watchman cried , and told the king . And the king said , If he be alone , there is tidings in his mouth . And he came apace , and drew near .
translation.kha: U pyrta sha tbian bad u ïathuh ha u syiem bad U syiem u ong ,  Lada u don tang marwei , u wanrah ka khubor babha .  Uta uba mareh u nang jan nang jan .
Wat ñiew ïa nga kumto ka kynthei ka bymdondor ei ei . Ngi duwai Kumno namar ba nga sngew kyrduh sat ïa lade .
translation.en: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial : for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto .

translation.kha: Lada ki jong ïa ngi ban ap haduh ba kin da wang sha i'u , ngin ïeng thik ha la ka kajuh .
translation.en: If they say thus unto us , Tarry until we come to you  ; then we will stand still in our place , and will not go up unto them .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la duwai , A Trai , me tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong nawei pa uwei , kumta pyn-i ha ngi une na phim ar ngut uba me la jied
translation.en: And they prayed , and said , Thou , Lord , which knowest the hearts of all men , shew whether of these two thou hast chosen ,

translation.kha: To kam pynngat noh ïa kaei kaba U blem u la leh , na ka daw ka jingbam . Ki jingbam baroh ki long kiba Lah ban bam , ishyrkhei ka lama ka bym dih ban bam ïa kano kano ka ban pynhieng ïano ïano ban hap ha ka pop .
translation.en: For meat destroy not the work of God . All things indeed are pure ; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence .
And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof , and called them Havoth–jair .
translation.kha: U Jair uba na ka jait Manasseh u la tur ïaleh bad ïohknieh katto katne ki shnong bad u la khot kyrteng ïa ki  Ki shnong u Jair .
Ki lyngdoh , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad baroh ki briew ki la ïohsngew ba nga ong ïa Kinah kiei kiei ha ka Templ ,
translation.en: So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the  Lord .
And when he had spoken these things , while they beheld , he was taken up  ; and a cloud received him out of their sight .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingong ïa kane , la shim noh ïa u sha bneng katba ki dang khmih ïa u , bad u lyoh u la buhrieh ïa u na ka jingïohi jong ki .
Ïa kaei kaei ba la buhrieh yn sei shabar ha kaba shin , Bad ïa kaei kaei ba la tap yn sa law noh .
translation.en: For there is nothing hid , which shall not be manifested  ; neither was any thing kept secret , but that it should come abroad .
And it came to pass in the morning , that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David , and a little lad with him .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud u Jonathan u leit sha ki bri ban ïakynduh ïa U Dabid kumba u la ïakut . U ïalam ïa uwei u khynnah samla bad u ,
U bariew uba stad , uba rangbah jingmut u hir uba step ha ka jingshemphang jong u . Katba na sngewtynnat ki ktieh ba u kren , katta u na haka ban pynkohnguh .
translation.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent : and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning .

translation.kha: Lada U Trai um shym la ïarap ïa nga , ngan jin da la leit kloi sha ka ri kaban jar jar .
translation.en: Unless the  Lord  had been my help , my soul had almost dwelt in silence .
How long shall I see the standard , and hear the sound of the trumpet ?
translation.kha: Sa katno nga dei ban ïohi ïa ka thma kaba nang jur bad ïohsngew ïa ki jingsawa jong ki turoi ?

Ngan pynthikna ba ki briew jong to ki Israel kin kop ïa ka kylleng bakhuid jong nga , bad ngan ym shah shuh ba ïa ka kyrteng jong nga yn pynjahburom . Te ki jaitbynriew kin tip ba ma la , U Trai , por long U Blei U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .
translation.en: So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel  ; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more : and the heathen shall know that I am the  Lord  , the Holy One in Israel .
But the liberal deviseth liberal things  ; and by liberal things shall he stand .
translation.kha: Hynrei u briew uba donburom u lehhok bad u ïeng skhem na ka bynta kaei kaba dei .
bad u syiem u ong ha u Ittai , u nongïalam lad ki , Areli phi ïaleit bad ngi ? khie leit phai noh sad sah badno u syiem thymmai . Phi dei u nongwei , u nongphetwir na la ka jong ka ri .
translation.en: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite , Wherefore goest thou also with us ? return to thy place , and abide with the king : for thou art a stranger , and also an exile .

translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Mikaïah ka khun u Uriel , na ka nongbah Gibeah . Ka sma ka la ktieh phangpdeng u Abijah bad u Jeroboam .
translation.en: He reigned three years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah . And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam .

translation.kha: Ko Jeruel me la wallam ïa kane halor jong me ! Me la iehnoh ïa nga , U Tharai U Blei jong me , katba nga dang ïalap ïa me ha ka lyntang .
translation.en: Hast thou not procured this unto thyself , in that thou hast forsaken the  Lord  thy God , when he led thee by the way ?

translation.kha: Ki shaei Philistia ki ñiah ban leit ïaleh ha ki lai kynjoh na ka jaka sher dara jong ki : kawei ka kynhun ka leit shaphang Ophrah ha ka ri Shual ,
translation.en: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies : one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah , unto the land of Shual :

translation.kha: Uwei u briew hapdeng u babha u la jubab , Ko nonghikai , nga la wallam ïa u khun jong nga shaw me , namar u ei u mynsiem bymkhuid ha u bad um nang kren .
translation.en: And one of the multitude answered and said , Master , I have brought unto thee my son , which hath a dumb spirit  ;

translation.kha: Ki hap ban ot ha ki lyngkha ki bymlah dei la ki lad , sad lum ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ki biria sohwaiñ jong ki briew kiba sner .
translation.en: They reap every one his corn in the field : and they gather the vintage of the wicked .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki la pyrshah da u nongleh myntri uba kyrteng u Elishama ( kata ka long ka kyrteng Jong u ha ka ktien Grik ) , uba la pyrshang ban pynphai noh ïa u lyngngoh na ka jingngeit .
translation.en: But Elymas the sorcerer ( for so is his name by interpretation ) withstood them , seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith .
And these were the chief of king Solomon s officers , even two hundred and fifty , that bare rule over the people .
translation.kha: Don arspah sanphew ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba dei peit ïa ki nongtrei ba la pynbor ban trei ïa kiba bunkam tei jingtei .
Ngin la wan ïalam noh ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ; nga la pyllait ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ; nga la phah ïa u Moses , u Aaron , bad ka Misraim ban ïalam ïa phi .
translation.en: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt , and redeemed thee out of the house of servants  ; and I sent before thee Moses , Aaron , and Miriam .

translation.kha: Mei kumta hynriew ngut ki briew ki wan na ka khyrdop kaba shabar kaba don shaphang shatei jong ka thalab , iwei uwei u rah la ka tiar ïaleh . Ryngkat bad ki la don u briew uba samla da ki jaiñ linen , naba rah ki tiar ban thoh . Baroh ki wan bad ïong hajan ka duwan kaba da ka rnong .
translation.en: And , behold , six men came from the way of the higher gate , which lieth toward the north , and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand  ; and one man among them was clothed with linen , with a writer s inkhorn by his side : and they went in , and stood beside the brasen altar .

translation.kha: Uto isangsot u khñiot na ka longïing jong me naba ïap ha ka nongbah un shat baibam ha ki ksew , malu ine eit uba ïap ha rudnong un shah bam ha ki pukni . Nga , U thri , sa la kren .’
translation.en: Him that dieth of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat  ; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
Wherefore I give you to understand , that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed : and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord , but by the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ba phin tip ba ym don uno uno uba la ïalam da U Mynsiem U Blei u lah ban ong  Long ba la tim ïa U Jisu!  bad ym don uno uno uba lah ban phla  U Jisu u long U Trai ,  lymda la ïalam ïa u da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
U Trai Nongsynshar u ong , Ngan leh ïa pha ha ka rukom kaba pha dei hok ban ïoh , namar pha la sa bymsalia ïa ki jingkular jong pha bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jingong .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even deal with thee as thou hast done , which hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant .

translation.kha: Ki umphniang sleh bad ba-iwbih ki pynlong ïa phi ban sngewkmen , hynrei ka jingjynjar ka pynkulmar ïa ka jingsuk jingmut jong phi .
translation.en: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart : so doth the sweetness of a man s friend by hearty counsel .

translation.kha: Ki brisoh ki wan na ka ri bashatei , ka jingbhabriew bakhrawbor na jngai bah ; shibun ki shem ki pynkhreh ïa ka thma .
translation.en: Behold , a people shall come from the north , and a great nation , and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Dabid u rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai , u shong bad u duwai , Ngam hir babha dih hok ïa kaei kaba me la la leh na ka bynta jong nga , ko Trai U Blei , lane ka longïing jongnga nga .
translation.en: And David the king came and sat before the  Lord  , and said , Who am I , O  Lord  God , and what is mine house , that thou hast brought me hitherto ?

translation.kha: Hato u briew u ainong ei ei lada u jop ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hynmen u haduh noh ïa la ka jingim ? Em ym kumta ! Kam ei kano kano kaba u lah ban ai ban ïoh pat ïa la ka jingim .
translation.en: For what is a man profited , if he shall gain the whole world , and lose his own soul ? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul ?

translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi dang ïan leh pop , ïa phi bad ïa u syiem jong phi yn pynjot noh .
translation.en: But if ye shall still do wickedly , ye shall be consumed , both ye and your king .

translation.kha: Pha te phi nud ban kynting shaei ïa ki khunswet mraw bad pynlong riewspah ïa lade na ki paw babiang tam eh .
translation.en: Yea , ye overwhelm the fatherless , and ye dig a pit for your friend .
And Moses came and told the people all the words of the  Lord  , and all the judgments : and all the people answered with one voice , and said , All the words which the  Lord  hath said will we do .
translation.kha: U Moses u wan ïathuh ha u paidbah ïa ki hukum baroh bad ïa ki aiñ baroh jong U  Trai  , bad ki briew baroh ki ïajubab lang ,  Ïa kita baroh kiba U  Trai  u ong , ngin leh .
Ki briew ki bym don jingtip ki ïap nalor ba ki kyntait ïa ka jingstad . Ki briew kiba mutlop ki shah pynïoh namar ba ki kuna bymsuidñiew .
translation.en: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them , and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them .
The thieves also , which were crucified with him , cast the same in his teeth .
translation.kha: Wat ki nonglute kiba la shah sahnarphna bad u ki la ïakren beiñ ïa u ha kajuh ka rukom .

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came to Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ,
Ko rangbah , sngewbha wat ïaid lait na ka ïing jong nga khlem da wan bang ; nga don Hangne ïa-ban shakri ïa phi .
translation.en: And said , My Lord , if now I have found favour in thy sight , pass not away , I pray thee , from thy servant :
And the man wondering at her held his peace , to wit whether the  Lord  had made his journey prosperous or not .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u dang ïai khmih jar jar ïa ka , ban peit la ka long ba U  Trai  u la ai jingjop ïa u .
Lada u briew u khap shñiuh na shadien ne na sha khmat ka khlieh jong u , kata kam pynlong ïa u bymkhuid .
translation.en: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face , he is forehead bald : yet is he clean .

translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka long , ka Dang ïaisah hi ka jingjahthait ïa ki briew jong U Blei kumba U Blei u shongthait ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew .
translation.en: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of God .
Hear me now therefore , O ye children , and depart not from the words of my mouth .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ko ki khun jong nga , shahshkor ïa nga bad wat klet ïa ki ktien jong nga .
Long tun call ?
translation.en: Can I make a phone call ?

And he made in Jerusalem engines , invented by cunning men , to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks , to shoot arrows and great stones withal . And his name spread far abroad  ; for he was marvellously helped , till he was strong .
translation.kha: Ha Jerusalem , ki nongshna tiar jong u ki shna ïa ki tiar ki tar ban siat ïa ki khnam bad kawang ïa ki maw kiba heh na ki kut bad ki kyndong jong ka kynroh ka nongbah . Ka nam jong u ka la phriang kylleng sawdong , bad u la long uba khlaiñbor katta katta namar ka jingïarap ba u ïohpdiang na U Blei .
Bad wat la u ieit eh ïa ka Hannah , u ai ïa ka tang shi bynta namar ba U Trai u la pynlyngki ïa ka .
translation.en: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion  ; for he loved Hannah : but the  Lord  had shut up her womb .
And one of the company said unto him , Master , speak to my brother , that he divide the inheritance with me .
translation.kha: Uwei u briew na u paidbah u la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai , to ong ïa u hynmen jong nga ban ïabynta bad nga ïa ka jingdon jingem kaba u kpa jong ngi u la iehnoh ïa ngi .
Ki briew jong nga kin wan na jngai bah , na shatei bad na sepngi , bad na Aswan kaba don shait .
translation.en: Behold , these shall come from far : and , lo , these from the north and from the west  ; and these from the land of Sinim .

translation.kha: U Trai u tei pang ïa ka Jerusalem ; u wallam pat ïa kiba la shah ringmraw .
translation.en: The  Lord  doth build up Jerusalem : he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel .

translation.kha: Ki ong , U Trai u la hukum ïa phi ban ïasam ïa ka ri ha ki paid Israel da Kaba kynting shabi . U la hukum ruh ïa phi ba ai ïa ka bri ka khyndew jong u para kur jong ngi u Selophehad ha ki khun kynthei jong u .
translation.en: And they said , The  Lord  commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel : and my lord was commanded by the  Lord  to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la khoit ïa ka Rebekka bad ki la kylli , Hato pham kwah ba leit bad une u bariew ? Ho-oid’ , ka jubab .
translation.en: And they called Rebekah , and said unto her , Wilt thou go with this man ? And she said , I will go .

translation.kha: Un dei ma u , u ban tei ka templ ïa nga , bad ngan pynthikna ba ka longïing syiad Jong u kan ïaineh .
translation.en: He shall build an house for my name , and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever .

translation.kha: To kieng noh ïa ka jingkieng atiar U Blei baroh , khnang ba phi haka ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki pur thep basniew Jong u jingjot .
translation.en: Put on the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil .
And they called the name of the city Dan , after the name of Dan their father , who was born unto Israel : howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first .
translation.kha: Ki pynkylla kyrteng ïa ka Laish sha ka Dan , kum ka kyrteng u kpa tymmen u Dan , u khun jong u Jakob .

U Simri , uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam uba peit ïa shiteng ki kali ïapom jong u syiem , u ïasylla pyrshah ïa u . Ha kawei ka sngi ha Tirsah , u Elah u buaid ha ka ïing jong u Assyria , kiba peit ïa ka jingmihsnam .
translation.en: And his servant Zimri , captain of half his chariots , conspired against him , as he was in Tirzah , drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah .

translation.kha: Ka synrai jongu ka jingim ba riew Blei katba khong ha ka Gebal ka pyni ïa ngi kumno ban im ngab sah ha ka rukom ka ban wanrah ka jingmyntoi shimet .
translation.en: The godly principles in the Bible show us how to live in a way that brings physical benefits .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ïajubab , Me wei ïaleh ïa nga da ka waitlam , da u lyngka , bad da u sum , hynrei nga wan pyrshah ïa me ha ka kyrtong U Tlai Badonbor , U Blei jongno ki kynhun ïapom ki Israel , ïa babha me la ñiewbeiñ .
translation.en: Then said David to the Philistine , Thou comest to me with a sword , and with a spear , and with a shield : but I come to thee in the name of the  Lord  of hosts , the God of the armies of Israel , whom thou hast defied .

translation.kha: Pynban , mynta me la leh kham bun , A TRAI’ Nongbishar ; me la pynlong ki jingïalang shaphang ki khwan ki ksiew jong nga ha ki snem ki ban wan . Bad me shah ïa u briew ban ïohi ïa kane , A Trai Nongsynshar !
translation.en: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight , O Lord  God   ; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant s house for a great while to come . And is this the manner of man , O Lord  God  ?

translation.kha: ( Ïa u Barabbas la buh ha ka byndi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin kaba lah jia ha ka nongbah , bad namar ka jingpynïap briew . )
translation.en: ( Who for a certain sedition made in the city , and for murder , was cast into prison . )

translation.kha: Kumta , ha ka liang sepngi jongu ka Jordan ki bthuh kyrpang ïa ka Kedesh ha Galilaïa , ha ka ri lum Naphtali , ïa ka Shekhem ha ka ri lum Ephraim , bad ïa ka Hebron ha ka ri lum Judah .
translation.en: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali , and Shechem in mount Ephraim , and Kirjath–arba , which is Hebron , in the mountain of Judah .
Serve the  Lord  with fear , and rejoice with trembling .
translation.kha: Shakri ïa U  Trai  da ka jingsheptieng ;

translation.en: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language , whose words thou canst not understand . Surely , had I sent thee to them , they would have hearkened unto thee .
translation.kha: Lada nga la phah ïa me sha ki jaitbynriew bakhraw kiba kren ïa ki ktien kiba eh kiba mem sngewthuh , kin shahshkor ïa me .

U Jehoshaphat u khlaiñ kat u masi kyrdon , Kat ki reng u masi prut . Ki reng jong u naba katto ki hajar jong u Manasseh , Bad kat ki kawei-na-kaba-shiphew hajar jong u Ephraim . Da ki , u Tur pyrshah ïa ki jaitbynriew , Bad u shop ïa ki sha kaba kut jong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock , and his horns are like the horns of unicorns : with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth : and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim , and they are the thousands of Manasseh .
And , behold , there was lifted up a talent of lead : and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah .
translation.kha: Ka shang ka la don ka jingtap ba la shna da ka sisa . Katba nga dang khmih , la plied ïa ka jingtap , bad hangta hapoh ka shang la shong ka kynthei !

Lada u shñiuh ha ka ki khluit ding u la kyllan lieh badno kata ka ka ka khampoh jyllei ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , kata ka dei ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh kambah la sdang na kata kaba khluit ding , bad u lyngdoh un pynban ba uta u longïing u bymkhuid .
translation.en: Then the priest shall look upon it : and , behold , if the hair in the bright spot be turned white , and it be in sight deeper than the skin  ; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning : wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is the plague of leprosy .

translation.kha: U la shim noh ïa ka shispah jong nga baroh bad pynjot ïa ka bhor jong de .
translation.en: He hath stripped me of my glory , and taken the crown from my head .

translation.kha: Nangta u la phad ïa ki ban ïarap ïa ka Hima U Blei bad ban pynkhiah ïa kiba pang ,
translation.en: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God , and to heal the sick .

translation.kha: Balei phi wan ?
translation.en: Why did you come ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubor , Kaei ka lai eh ha u briew ka long kambah lah ha U Blei .
translation.en: And he said ,  The things which are impossible with men are possible with God .
So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights , and none spake a word unto him : for they saw that his grief was very great .
translation.kha: Nangta ki shong ha madan bad u haduh hynñiew sngi hynñiew miet khlem kren shikyntien ruh , namar ki la ïohi haduh katno u shah jynjar .
U la batai , Ko Daniel , ang la wan hangne ban ïarap ïa me ban shemphang ïa ka jingïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And he informed me , and talked with me , and said , O Daniel , I am now come forth to give thee skill and understanding .

translation.kha: Nangta ki synñiang hapoh ka lieng ki la mane ïa U Jisu . Da shisha me long U Khun U Blei ! ki la pynbna .
translation.en: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him , saying , Of a truth thou art the Son of God .
And when he came upon the stairs , so it was , that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people .
translation.kha: Ki la ïapoi haduh ki mawkyrdon lem bad u , bad nangta ki shipai ki la dei ban bah ïa u namar u paidbhur u la lamwir palat .

translation.en: These things said Esaias , when he saw his glory , and spake of him .
translation.kha: U Isaïah u la ong ïa kane namar u la ïohi ïa ka burom U Jisu bad u la kren shaphang jong u .
U syiem Joash u la ïasnohkti ha ka jingkylla pyrshah ïa u Sekharaïah , bad ha ka hukum jyllang u syiem , ki paidbah ki la lynthem maw ïa u Sekharaïah ha ka phylliew ka Templ .
translation.en: And they conspired against him , and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ba U Blei u pyrta , Wan hangne , phi ki briew kiba leit ban pynshitom ïa ka nongbah . ïalam ïa ki tiar ïaleh bad phi .
translation.en: He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice , saying , Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near , even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand .

translation.kha: lano ïa ki khunswet ban shahthngan katba ïa lade nga dang bam .
translation.en: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone , and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof  ;

translation.kha: U Moses , u Aaron , bad ki khun shynrang jong u , ki Siat ïa la ki kti bad ïa la ki kjat
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat :

translation.kha: U Solomon u la thut khat-ar ngut ki rangbah kum ki lat ka distrik ha Israel . Ki dei ban pynbiang bam na ki distrik jong ki ïa u syier bad ïa ka longïing jong u , iwei imat u Rangbah u kitkhlieh na ka bynta uwei u bnoh ha ka shisnem .
translation.en: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel , which provided victuals for the king and his household : each man his month in a year made provision .

translation.kha: haba Saw ngut ki rangbah ki la poi , ki da rieh ïa u briew uba pang ïapshiliang sha U Jisu .
translation.en: And they come unto him , bringing one sick of the palsy , which was borne of four .

translation.kha: Katba ki dkhot jyllang ka Dorbar ki pynshahshkor ïa u Stephan , ki la bitar shla bad ki la kyr-ang bniat ïa u ha ka jingbitar .
translation.en: When they heard these things , they were cut to the heart , and they gnashed on him with their teeth .

translation.kha: namar U Trai u isih ïa ki briew kiba leh bymman , hynrei ïa ki briew kiba khoh u ïalap ïa ki .
translation.en: For the froward is abomination to the  Lord  : but his secret is with the righteous .

translation.kha: U Bildad u la khat lang ïa ki rangbah lyngdoh , ïa ki nongïalam , bad ïa u paidbah , bad u la ong ha ki ,
translation.en: And Pilate , when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people ,
Bread of deceit is sweet to a man  ; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi ïoh da jingbymhok phi lah ban lehkmen kum ka jingbam babha tam , hynrei shen kan long kum u shyiap ba-dap ha ka shyntur .
Ka tnga jong nga kam ia ban shah ïa ka jingsma ka jingpynhiar mynsiem jong nga , ki hynmen ki para jong nga kim wan hajan jong nga .
translation.en: My breath is strange to my wife , though I entreated for the children s sake of mine own body .

translation.kha: U kñia ki jingainguh ha ki phai jong ki Syria , kiba la iap ïa u . U ino , Ki blei jongngi ki Syria ki la ïarap ïa ki syiem Syria , kumta lada nga ai jingkñia sha ki , ki lai ban ïarah ïa nga ruh . Kane ka la wanrah jingpynjot ïa u bun ha ka hima jong u .
translation.en: For he sacrificed unto the gods of Damascus , which smote him : and he said , Because the gods of the kings of Syria help them , therefore will I sacrifice to them , that they may help me . But they were the ruin of him , and of all Israel .
In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah , twenty and four years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Baasha u khun jong u Ahijah u la long u syiem ka Israel baroh kawei , bad u la synshar arphew saw snem ha Tirsah .

translation.en: And when they had called to the king , there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , which was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder .
translation.kha: Nangta ki phah wallam ïa u syiem Hesekaïah , bad ki lai ngut ki rangbah synshar ki leit ban ïakynduh ïa ki : u Eliakim u khun jong u Hilkaïah , uba dei peit ïa ka ïingsyiem ; u Shebna , u sekretari ka ïingbishar ; bad u Joah u khun jong u Asaph , uba dei peit ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh .
Ki nonglamktien , ïa kiba la phah da ki Pharisi , ki la kylli te ïa u Onan , Lada meng dei u Messaïah lane u Elijah lane u nongïathuhlypa , balei pat me pynsngap ?
translation.en: And they asked him , and said unto him , Why baptizest thou then , if thou be not that Christ , nor Elias , neither that prophet ?

translation.kha: Te ine lah ban shaniah skhem ba sieh ka Hima jong U Blei kan pynkut ïa kumta kita ki jingtap baroh .
translation.en: So we can be confident that God’s Kingdom will soon bring an end to all such problems .

translation.kha: U Trei u ong ha u Joshua , Ngi buh ha ki kti jong me ïa ka Jerikho , lem bad u syep jong ka bad ïa ki shipai bashlur jngai u baroh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , See , I have given into thine hand Jericho , and the king thereof , and the mighty men of valour .

translation.kha: Haba phi la kdang , phin hap kyntait wat ïa ka ngap ruh ; hynrei haba phi thngan , wat ka jingbamsap kaba kthang shiah ka thiang .
translation.en: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb  ; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet .

translation.kha: hynrei U Blei Uba Hakhlieh thom Eh um shong ha ki ïing ba la tei da ki briew , kumba u nongïathuhlypa u ïai-ong ,
translation.en: Howbeit the most High dwelleth not in temples made with hands  ; as saith the prophet ,
Thou hast made known to me the ways of life  ; thou shalt make me full of joy with thy countenance .
translation.kha: Me la pyn-i ha nga ïa ki lynti ïaid kiba ïalam sha ka jingim , bad ka jingdon ryngkat jong me kan pyndap ïa nga da ka jingkmen .’
U Hanun u la kumta ïa ki nonglamktien jong u Dabid , u la khi shiliang ïa u ñiuhtmoh jong ki , u khup ïa ki jaiñ-jin jong ki na mar skhep , bad u la phah napoh ïa ki .
translation.en: Wherefore Hanun took David s servants , and shaved off the one half of their beards , and cut off their garments in the middle , even to their buttocks , and sent them away .

translation.kha: U Jonathan u ïaroh ïa u Dabid ha u Saul bad u ong , Pa kynrad , kad leh bymdei ïa u shakuriaw jong phoi u Nadab . Um pat ju leh palat ïa phi ; ha khawai ka wad , kat kaba u la leh ka la long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa phi .
translation.en: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father , and said unto him , Let not the king sin against his servant , against David  ; because he hath not sinned against thee , and because his works have been to thee-ward very good :

translation.kha: U thiah mynmiet , u kaei bun ha ka per mynsngi , bad ha baroh kata ka por ki symbai ki speh malu ki at san . Pynban um tip kumno kane ka jia .
translation.en: And should sleep , and rise night and day , and the seed should spring and grow up , he knoweth not how .

Then the priest shall look upon it : and , behold , if the hair in the bright spot be turned white , and it be in sight deeper than the skin  ; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning : wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is the plague of leprosy .
translation.kha: Lada u shñiuh ha ka dak khluit ding u la kylla lieh bad kata ka dak ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh kaba la sdang na kata kaba khluit ding , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid .
khlem da peiphang ei ei ka maw aïu kane baroh ; Tang u Jonathan bad u Dabid ki tip .
translation.en: But the lad knew not any thing : only Jonathan and David knew the matter .

Now therefore , our God , the great , the mighty , and the terrible God , who keepest covenant and mercy , let not all the trouble seem little before thee , that hath come upon us , on our kings , on our princes , and on our priests , and on our prophets , and on our fathers , and on all thy people , since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day .
translation.kha: A Blei , U Blei jong ngi , katno me long uba khraw ! Katno me long uba shyrkhei bad uba donbor ! Me batskhem ïa ki kular ka jingïateh jutang . Naduh ka por ba ki syiem Assyria ki banbeiñ ïa ngi , wat haduh kane ka por , haduh katno ngi shahshitom ! Ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki lyngdoh jong ngi bad ki nongïathuhlypa , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , bad baroh ki briew jong ngi ki shitom . To kynmaw haduh katno ngi la shahshitom !

translation.en: There is no straw given unto thy servants , and they say to us , Make brick : and , behold , thy servants are beaten  ; but the fault is in thine own people .
translation.kha: Ym shym la ai phlangïap shuh ïa ngi , hynrei la ïai hukum ïa ngi ban shna maw-it ! Bad mynta pat ngi shah shoh . Dei ki briew jong phi keiñ kiba bakla .
Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai nongshoh-nar u nguh : Ngan Aiti ïa pha ha ki briew kiba pha pli bad phalang ijli .

Haba ka la ïohi ba u la iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup dara ba u la mareh shabi ïing ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand , and was fled forth ,

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Nga la bitar namar ba ki nongïalam ka Judah ki la hiarthma ïa ka Israel bad tuh khak na ka . Kumta ngan tbeh noh ka jingpynshitom halor jong ki kum ka jingshlei um .
translation.en: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound : therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water .

translation.kha: Uta u shakor u leit bran bran ban ïashem ïa ka bad u ong , To ai um ba Ngan dih na uto u khiew um jong phi .
translation.en: And the servant ran to meet her , and said , Let me , I pray thee , drink a little water of thy pitcher .

translation.kha: Phi shong sngewskhem hapdeng ki dieng Kedar ba wanrah na Lebanon ; hynrei katno kaba sngewsynei itynnad wan ka jingshitom ha phi , bad phna ud haba ka jinglah kan lap ïa phin , ki jingshitom kum Aner ki jong ka kynthei kaba suh kha .
translation.en: O inhabitant of Lebanon , that makest thy nest in the cedars , how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee , the pain as of a woman in travail !

translation.kha: Hynrei u Abram u ong , Ko Trai Nongsynshar , kan myntoi aïu ka bainong jong me ïa nga hajuh ngam ei khun ? U nongïoh pateng jong to u dei thrang u Eliesar uba na Damaskos .
translation.en: And Abram said , Lord  God  , what wilt thou give me , seeing I go childless , and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus ?

translation.kha: Naba wat ba pa’ la tip ïa kane barhem , nga kwah ban pynkynmaw biang ïa phoi ba kynum U Trai u la ïapyllait im shisien ïa ki paid Jeriel na ka ri Ijipt , hynrei hadien , u la pynjot ïa Kito ki bym shym la ngeit .
translation.en: I will therefore put you in remembrance , though ye once knew this , how that the Lord , having saved the people out of the land of Egypt , afterward destroyed them that believed not .
Why are our places of worship called Kingdom Halls ?
translation.kha: Balei la khot ïa ka jaka mane jong ngi ka Ïing Hima ?

translation.en: And there arose a great cry : and the scribes that were of the Pharisees  part arose , and strove , saying , We find no evil in this man : but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him , let us not fight against God .
translation.kha: Ka jingpyrta ka la kham jam , bad katto katne ngut na ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba dei ki jong ka kynhun ki Pharisi ki la ïeng bad ki la pyrshah jur :  Ngim shem kano kano kaba bakla bad une u briew ! Lehse u mynsiem lane u angel u la kren shisha ha u !

translation.en: For whoso findeth me findeth life , and shall obtain favour of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U briew uba shem ïa nga u shem ïa ka jingim , bad U  Trai  un sngewbha ïa u .
Hynrei u briew uba jingburom u lehbeiñ bad u ïeng skhem na ka bna kaei kaba dei .
translation.en: But the liberal deviseth liberal things  ; and by liberal things shall he stand .
I will arise and go to my father , and will say unto him , Father , I have sinned against heaven , and before thee ,
translation.kha: Ngan ïeng joit bad leit sha i pa jong nga bad ong ,  Ko pa , nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Blei bad pyrshah ïa phi .
Bun snem haei kane , u syiem Ijipt u ïapom noh , hynrei ki Israel ki dang ïai ud namar kata ka jinglongmraw jong ki bad ki pyrta ban ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: And it came to pass in process of time , that the king of Egypt died : and the children of Israel sighed by reason of the bondage , and they cried , and their cry came up unto God by reason of the bondage .

translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki baroh da ka jingsheptieng bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei . U nongïathuhlypa uba khraw u la ñiew hapdeng jong ngi ! ki la ong ; U Blei u la wanrah don pynim ïa ki briew jong u !
translation.en: And there came a fear on all : and they glorified God , saying , That a great prophet is risen up among us  ; and , That God hath visited his people .
Son of man , eat thy bread with quaking , and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness  ;
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kyiuh haba me bam , bad to khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng haba me dih .
Ka jingmutlop ka long kumta ka kynthei kaba kaw kaw , kaba bieit badno kaba khlemrain .
translation.en: A foolish woman is clamorous : she is simple , and knoweth nothing .

translation.kha: Ki ong ha u , Wan bad ïalang ïa ngi , ba ngin lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Ammon .
translation.en: And they said unto Jephthah , Come , and be our captain , that we may fight with the children of Ammon .
My righteousness is near  ; my salvation is gone forth , and mine arms shall judge the people  ; the isles shall wait upon me , and on mine arm shall they trust .
translation.kha: Ngan wan kloi bad ngan pynim ïa ki ; ka por jong ka jingjop ka la hajan . Nga da lade hi ngan synshar halor ki jaitbynriew . Ki ri ba hajngai bah ki ap ïa nga ba ngan wan ; ki ap da ka jingkyrmen ïa nga ban pynim ïa ki .
U Trai u ïai pynpaw ïa lade ha Shiloh , naba u la paw ha u Samuel , bad u la kren ruh ha u . Bad haba u Samuel u kren , ki Israel baroh’ ki shahshkor .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared again in Shiloh : for the  Lord  revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïohknieh ïa ki nongbah jong ki Amor baroh , lem pynlang ïa ka lehsbun sad ïa ki shnongrit baroh sawdong jong ka , bad ki la shong la sah” klang .
translation.en: And Israel took all these cities : and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites , in Heshbon , and in all the villages thereof .

translation.kha: Nangta ma u bad u Nongbah ki la leit shapoh ban ai ki jingkñia bad jingainguh thang sha u Baal . U la pyn-ap phraphew ngut ki rangbah shabar ka templ bad u la ai jingbeh ïa ki : “Phi dei ban pynïap ïa kine ki bariew baroh ; isangsot une na phi uba shah ïa uwei na ki ban lait im , un siewdor ïa ka da la ka jong ka jingtim !
translation.en: And when they went in to offer sacrifices and burnt offerings , Jehu appointed fourscore men without , and said , If any of the men whom I have brought into your hands escape , he that letteth him go , his life shall be for the life of him .

translation.kha: Hangta hi , u syiem u la bitar shla bad u la hukum ba-bang wallam ïa ki kad ngut ki rangbah shuh u .
translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego . Then they brought these men before the king .
And the same John had his raiment of camel s hair , and a leathern girdle about his loins  ; and his meat was locusts and wild honey .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jaiñ jong U Ïoannis la shna da u shñiuh jong ka ut ; u la panpoh da u panpoh snieh ha ka syngkai jong u , bad ka jingbam jong u ka la long da ki puit bad ka ngap khlaw .
Ïa u Jehosabad la ai ha kawei ka miej , bad ïa ki hynmen jong u ha kawei pat . Ki nong Ijipt bakha ïabam hangta ruh ki shong kyrpang , namar ki kheiñduh poh ban ïashong smam ryngkat bad ki Hebru .
translation.en: And they set on for him by himself , and for them by themselves , and for the Egyptians , which did eat with him , by themselves : because the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews  ; for that is an abomination unto the Egyptians .

translation.kha: U Saul u bitar lep ïa u Jonathan bad u ong ha u , Me u khun pongka ! Mynta nga tap ba me ïashoh liang bad u Dabid bad me pynïohburom ïa lade bad ïa kato ka kmie Jong me !
translation.en: Then Saul s anger was kindled against Jonathan , and he said unto him , Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman , do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion , and unto the confusion of thy mother s nakedness ?

translation.kha: Balei mem shu phai noh shawei tang shipa , ba ngan ïoh nguid ïa la ka babha ?
translation.en: How long wilt thou not depart from me , nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle ?
For thy Maker is thine husband  ; the  Lord  of hosts is his name  ; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel  ; The God of the whole earth shall he be called .
translation.kha: U Nongthaw jong pha un long kum u tnga ïa pha — U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh long ka kyrteng jong u . U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel un pynim ïa pha — u long u nongsynshar jong ka pyrthei baroh .
U Shaphan u ai ïa ka hukum syiem ha u Hilkaïah bad u Hilkaïah u ïaheh ïa u ba u la skhem ïa ka Kitab ka hukum ha ka Templ . U Hakhlieh u la ai ha u ïa ka Kitab , bad u Shaphan u pule ïa ka .
translation.en: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe , I have found the book of the law in the house of the  Lord . And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan , and he read it .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka snem u Hoshea u phah nonglamktien Sha u So , u syiem ka Ijipt , don pan ïa ka jingïarap jong u , bad u sangeh noh ka jingseisoh ïa ka jingnguh syiem ba man ka snem shiah ka Assyria . Haba u Shalmaneser u tip ïa kane , u phah kem ïa u Jeshaïah bad buh ïa u ha ka byndi .
translation.en: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea : for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt , and brought no present to the king of Assyria , as he had done year by year : therefore the king of Assyria shut him up , and bound him in prison .

translation.kha: Te kumta , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jongno ang , to longsem phi uba ïeng skhem bad kiba ïaineh . To long kiba ïa-ai 3 maïan ïa ka kam U Trai , namar phi tip ba nangno kano kob phi leh ha ka jinghikai ïa U Trai kam ju long kaba lehnoh-ei .
translation.en: Therefore , my beloved brethren , be ye stedfast , unmoveable , always abounding in the work of the Lord , forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord .
And he that curseth his father , or his mother , shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: Uta uba tim ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie u dei ban shah pynïap .
Ki briew jong U Blei ki long khyndiat , ki long ki nongwei ha ka ri Kane .
translation.en: When ye were but few , even a few , and strangers in it .
And Abraham was an hundred years old , when his son Isaac was born unto him .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la dap shispah snem ka rta mynba la kha ïa u Isaak .

translation.en: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem . So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingpyntrei ïa ka Templ la lah pynsangeh noh bad ka la sahkut khlem pyntrei shuh haduh ka snem ba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Darius , u patsha ka Persia .
Nangta U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait noh ïa ka jingpyndait kaba ar ; bad ar la ïohsngew ïa u jingthaw ba-im uba ar uba ong , To wan !
translation.en: And when he had opened the second seal , I heard the second beast say , Come and see .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la sdang ban leit da ka lieng tang ma ki hi sha ka jaka kynjah .
translation.en: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately .

translation.kha: Ki rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ; ha kawei pa kawei ka sngi ki ai ki jingkñia kiba donkam ha said ka sngi ;
translation.en: They kept also the feast of tabernacles , as it is written , and offered the daily burnt offerings by number , according to the custom , as the duty of every day required  ;

translation.kha: U Absalom bad ki Israel baroh ki ong , Ka jingai jingput jong u Hushai ka kham bha ban ïa ka jong u Ahithophel . U Trai u la rai don pynpulom ïa ka jngai jingput babha ka jong u Ahithophel , khnang ba ka jingjot tista wan ha u Absalom .
translation.en: And Absalom and all the men of Israel said , The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel . For the  Lord  had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel , to the intent that the  Lord  might bring evil upon Absalom .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , Ym don aiwai ruh na phi u ban ngeit lymda u ioh ïa ki kambah bad ki batbor .
translation.en: Then said Jesus unto him ,  Except ye see signs and wonders , ye will not believe .

translation.kha: ibha ki paid Israel ki la dep bynta ïa ka ri , ki la ai ha u Isaiah u khun jong u Nun shi bynta jong ka ri kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .
translation.en: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts , the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them :

And all that Samuel the seer , and Saul the son of Kish , and Abner the son of Ner , and Joab the son of Zeruiah , had dedicated  ; and whosoever had dedicated any thing , it was under the hand of Shelomith , and of his brethren .
translation.kha: U Shelomith bad ka longïing jong u , ki dei peit ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba la pynkyntang ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ , kynthup ruh ïa ki jingai sngewbha kiba la wanlam da u Samuel , u nongïathuhlypa , da u syiem Saul , da u Abner u khun jong u Ner , bad da u Joab u khun jong ka Seruïah .

translation.en: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite , of the kindred of Ram : against Job was his wrath kindled , because he justified himself rather than God .
translation.kha: Hynrei uba ïeng hajan hangta uba kyrteng u Elihu um lah kun shuh ïa la ka jingbitar , namar u Job u pynksan ïa lade bad u kynnoh ïa U Blei . ( U Elihu u dei u khun jong u Barakel , uba hiarpateng na u Bus , bad u dei na ka kur jong u Ram . )
Ha ka jingbitar U Blei u la pyndkut ïa ki ktieh ki kjat jong nga ; u peit ïa nga da ka jingisih .
translation.en: He teareth me in his wrath , who hateth me : he gnasheth upon me with his teeth  ; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingbymlehhok kaba jylla ha ka pyrthei — ka jingbymlehhok kaba la pynlong da ki nongsynshar .
translation.en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun , as an error which proceedeth from the ruler :

translation.kha: U la pyllait ïa ngi na Ijipt ba-bang wan ïalam ïa ngi shane bad ban ai ha ngi ïa ken ka ri , bania u la pynkulmar ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translation.en: And he brought us out from thence , that he might bring us in , to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers .
Then Jeremiah the prophet spake all these words unto Zedekiah king of Judah in Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: Te nga la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u syiem Sedekaïah ha Jerusalem katba ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem ka Babilonia ka dang tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah .
( 1 Thessaloni 2 :13 ) “lada phi pyndonkam kaei ka jinglehkai ka Baibl phin ioh shisien ka jingpynkoit .
translation.en: ( 1 Thessalonians 2 :13 ) If you apply what the Bible teaches , you will benefit greatly .

translation.kha: U la ai jingbthah ruh katno ka ksiar nylla kan leit ha kaba pyndonkam don shna ïa ki proh , ki pynbang , bad ki khiew , Bad katno ka rupa bad ka ksiar ha kaba shna ïa ki pliang ,
translation.en: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks , and the bowls , and the cups : and for the golden basins he gave gold by weight for every basin  ; and likewise silver by weight for every basin of silver :

translation.kha: Nangta ki ïakylli ïa u , Haei ka Sarah ka tnga jong me ? U Joab , Ka don hapoh ka ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Where is Sarah thy wife ? And he said , Behold , in the tent .
But be not ye called Rabbi : for one is your Master , even Christ  ; and all ye are brethren .
translation.kha: Ïa phi ym dei ban khot ‘ ko Nonghikai ,’ namar ba phi baroh phi ïalong mar ryngkat bad don tang uwei U Nonghikai .
Bad u la hukum ïa ki bhabriew kiba khlaiñ tam ha ka kynhun shipai jong u Ban khum ïa ki lai ngut ki jingbabe bad ban bret ïa ki ha ka laiñ ding baklang .
translation.en: And he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace .

translation.kha: Ha man ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait u Pyllait u la dei Ban pyllaitluid ïa uwei na ki koit na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: ( For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast . )

translation.kha: NGA pulom bania ïa ki jingbthah jongno me , nga bishar bniah ïa ki jinghikai jong me .
translation.en: I will meditate in thy precepts , and have respect unto thy ways .
But I had pity for mine holy name , which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen , whither they went .
translation.kha: Kata ka pynlong ïa nga ban khuslai shaphang ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , namar ki Israel ki pynjahburom ïa ka kat shaba ki leit .

translation.en: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims , and took thereof , and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen : who took it , and went out .
translation.kha: Uwei na kita ki kherub u buh ïa la ka kti ha ka ding kaba don hangta hapdeng jong ki , u la shim khyndiat ki rnga ding , bad u la buh ïa ki ha ki kti u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen . Uta u briew u la shim ïa kita ki rnga ding bad u la mihnoh .
don tang wai U Blei uba long U kpu jong u bynñiaw baroh , uba erlangthari U Trai halor baroh , uba trei lyngba kiei ki baroh , bad u long ha baroh .
translation.en: One God and Father of all , who is above all , and through all , and in you all .

translation.kha: Nga dang shu buh shuwa ba phin phah hi .
translation.en: I had just put it before you ask me to .

translation.kha: U blei u pynshitom ïa ki , namsop ïa kadei kiba lah ban tipthuh shaphang U Blei ka longïing kaba shaei ha ki , naba U Blei da lade hi u la pynshai ïa dat .
translation.en: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them ; for God hath shewed it unto them .

translation.kha: Nga la ud da ka jingsngewsih nalor ka Moab , da ka jingpangnud namar ka Kim Hano .
translation.en: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab , and mine inward parts for Kir–heres .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la iohnong ïa uwei u angel uba kyllan ïa uwei pat , Haduh katno kine kiei kiei uba la ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw kin ïawanlang ? Haduh katno ka pop ba-ijli kan bujli ïa ki jingkynjah ba man ka sngi ? Haduh katno ïa ka kynhun shipai ba kynja bneng bad ïa ka Templ yn kyrdem ?
translation.en: Then I heard one saint speaking , and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake , How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice , and the transgression of desolation , to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot ?
For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus , because he would not spend the time in Asia : for he hasted , if it were possible for him , to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost .
translation.kha: U Paul u la kut jingmut ban ïaid lait ïa ka Ephesos , ba kumta yn ym pynsep-ei ïa ka por ha ka probins jong ka Asia . U la kyrkieh ban poi ha Jerusalem ha ka sngi Pentekost , lada ka long kaba lah .
Kaei kaba nga hap ban leh ?
translation.en: What should I do ?

translation.kha: Ki la ïapoi haduh ki mawkyrdon lem bad u , bad nangta ki shipai ki la dei ba bah ïa u namar u bashipor u la lamwir palat .
translation.en: And when he came upon the stairs , so it was , that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi nam ïoh pat ïa ka bor ban kren ïa kaba me la hajuh ei , bad men ïakren bad u . Ha kane ka mano men long ka dak ïa ki briew , bad kmen ïoh tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: In that day shall thy mouth be opened to him which is escaped , and thou shalt speak , and be no more dumb : and thou shalt be a sign unto them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Uno du uba bam ei ei ha kata ka sngi yn ñiew uba la shah tait na ki briew U Blei .
translation.en: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day , he shall be cut off from among his people .

translation.kha: Ka set lad u dieng sohwaiñ ka la kem ding ; ka ding ka la bam duh ïa ki tnat bad ïa u soh jong u . Ki tnga kine ym long shuh da lem lat kiba khlaiñ , kin ym long shuh da lei lei ki diengsynshar ba kynja shym . Kane ka dei ka jingrwai jong ka jingsngewsih ; la ju ri bad ïai rwai ïa ka .
translation.en: And fire is gone out of a rod of her branches , which hath devoured her fruit , so that she hath no strong rod to be a sceptre to rule . This is a lamentation , and shall be for a lamentation .

translation.kha: ibha u Ïingjaiñ u Nongpynbaptis u la ïohsngew hapoh ïingbyndi shaphang kiei kiei kiba U Khrist u la leh , u la phah sha u katai kattne nguh na ki synran jong u .
translation.en: Now when John had heard in the prison the works of Christ , he sent two of his disciples ,

For the seed shall be prosperous  ; the vine shall give her fruit , and the ground shall give her increase , and the heavens shall give their dew  ; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things .
translation.kha: Kin thung ïa ki jingthung jong ki ha ka jingsuk . Ki bri sohwaiñ jong ki kin pynmih ki sohwaiñ , ka khyndew kan pynmih ïa ki jingthung , bad u slap un don kyrhai . Ngan ai ïa kine ki jingkyrkhu baroh ha ki briew jong ka hima jong nga kiba dang lait im .

Ka leit jingjia ryngkhat ba u syiem ka Israel u la nguh ha ka khyrdop nongbah hapoh ka jingpeit jong u jingbabe pynïaidkam uba dei u nongïarap ba-hajan jongno u . U rangbah pynïaidkam u la shah ïuh hangta ha ki paidbah malu u la ïap kumba u Elisha u la ïathuh lypa mynba u syiem u la leit ïatyngkhuh ïa u .
translation.en: And the king appointed the lord on whose hand he leaned to have the charge of the gate : and the people trode upon him in the gate , and he died , as the man of God had said , who spake when the king came down to him .
The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy , and in the night is as a thief .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab u nongpynïap briew u khie bad u mih ban leit pynïap ïa uba duk , bad mynmiet u tuh .
Kane ka la pyndiaw shibun eh ïa u Abraham , naba u Ishmael ruh u dei u khun jong u .
translation.en: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham s sight because of his son .

translation.kha: Da ka bor bakhraw bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthuh , ïa u khunbynriew , bad ïa baroh ki mrad Kiba im ha ka khyndew ; bad nga ai ïa ka ha uno uno uba la jingdih .
translation.en: I have made the earth , the man and the beast that are upon the ground , by my great power and by my outstretched arm , and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me .

translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba ïuh burom lypa u long kaba sngewkyndit ; ki briew kiba ut ki don ha ka lyntait shata ka jingjot .
translation.en: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty , and before honour is humility .

translation.kha: hynñiew lada Phin dang ïai leh pop , ïa phi bad ïa u syiem jong phiah yn pynjot noh .
translation.en: But if ye shall still do wickedly , ye shall be consumed , both ye and your king .
But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kaba nyngkong , ha ka por ka jingpynlong , ‘ U Blei u la thaw ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei ,’ kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong .
Naba haba ngi la im ka jingweng Kum ki briew , ki jingkwah bapop ba la pynkhreh da ka Hukum ki trei ha ki met jong i , bad baroh kaba ngi ni ka Kut ha ka jingïap .
translation.en: For when we were in the flesh , the motions of sins , which were by the law , did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death .

translation.kha: U Ahimelekh u nongsynshar ïa ki Ishmael haduh sa snoh .
translation.en: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel ,

Drop down , ye heavens , from above , and let the skies pour down righteousness : let the earth open , and let them bring forth salvation , and let righteousness spring up together  ; I the  Lord  have created it .

translation.en: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without , redeeming the time .
To have respect of persons is not good : for for a piece of bread that man will transgress .
