translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of two months , that she returned unto her father , who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed : and she knew no man . And it was a custom in Israel ,

translation.kha: U Iso u ïan kyrpad ha la u kpa . Ko Pa , hapoh phi don tang kawei ka jingkyrkhu ? Pa , to kyrkhu ïa nga ruh ! U la sdang shun ïam .
translation.en: And Esau said unto his father , Hast thou but one blessing , my father ? bless me , even me also , O my father . And Esau lifted up his voice , and wept .

translation.kha: Ka jingbhabriew Israel baroh ka dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , hynrei a uno u sem shym astor um lah ban bam ïa ka .
translation.en: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it .
And the women also , which came with him from Galilee , followed after , and beheld the sepulchre , and how his body was laid .
translation.kha: Ki kynthei kiba la bud ïa U Jisu na Galilaïa ki la leit bad u Joseph bad ki la ïohi ïa ka jingtep bad kumno ba la buh ïa ka met ka jong U Jisu hapoh jong ka .

translation.en: For what glory is it , if , when ye be buffeted for your faults , ye shall take it patiently ? but if , when ye do well , and suffer for it , ye take it patiently , this is acceptable with God .
translation.kha: Naba ka nong aïu ka don lada phi ïaishah ïa ki jingshah sympat ba phi dei hok haba phi la leh ïa kaba bakla ? Hynrei lada phi ïaishah ïa ka jingshahshitom wat haba phi la leh ïa kaba dei , U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phi na ka bynta kata .

Hynrei ma phi , ki briew jong U Blei! , Phin long kiba kmen bad phin ïai kumba phi leh ha ka miet jong ka Jingkhawai Niam bakyntang . Phin lama katba kmie kum kito kiba ïaid ryngkat bad ki sur jong ki tangmuri sha ka Templ U Trai , u nongkyrshan jong ki Israel .
translation.en: Ye shall have a song , as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept  ; and gladness of heart , as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the  Lord  , to the mighty One of Israel .

translation.kha: Kaba leit tuklar ha ka jingïania ka bym dei ka kam jong phi ka erlangthari kumba leit shai lynti bah bad kem ïa u ksew na ki shlur .
translation.en: He that passeth by , and meddleth with strife belonging not to him , is like one that taketh a dog by the ears .
And , behold , there was a man in Jerusalem , whose name was Simeon  ; and the same man was just and devout , waiting for the consolation of Israel : and the Holy Ghost was upon him .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don u briew uba shong basah ha Jerusalem uba kyrteng u Simeon . U la long u briew uba bha , uba sheptieng ïa U Blei bad uba ïai ap na ka bynta ki Israel ban ïoh jingpynim .
Katto katne lwet na ki , ki la sngewïahap bad ki la ïasoh bad u Peor bad u Silas ; kumta ruh ka la long ïa kiba bun ki kynthei ibha pawkhmat malade ka kynhun bah jong ki Grik kiba la mane ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And some of them believed , and consorted with Paul and Silas  ; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude , and of the chief women not a few .

translation.kha: Hynrei don pyllait ïa nga na kaba dap da ka jingsarong namar kiei kiei kiba bun kiba phylla ba nga la Ïohi , la buh ha nga ïa ka jingpang kaba jur ha ka met , kaba long kum u nongsyntiat jong u Soitan ban pynshitom ïa nga bad Ban pyllait ïa nga na ka jingsngewmeng sarong .
translation.en: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations , there was given to me a thorn in the flesh , the messenger of Satan to buffet me , lest I should be exalted above measure .
Thou therefore endure hardness , as a good soldier of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To shim bynta lem ha ka jingshah shitom , kum u shipai baïaineh jong U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness : for they shall be filled .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba ka jingangnud bakhraw tam jong ki ka long ban leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dawa ; U Blei un pynhun jrut ïa ki !

translation.en: A man s gift maketh room for him , and bringeth him before great men .
translation.kha: Hato phi kwah ban ïakynduh ïa u briew uba khraw ? Rah sha u ka jingai sngewbha bad kan pynsuk ïa phi .

translation.en: According to the commandment of the  Lord  they were numbered by the hand of Moses , every one according to his service , and according to his burden : thus were they numbered of him , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: bad u ai ïa ki ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u .

translation.en: Vanity of vanities , saith the preacher  ; all is vanity .
translation.kha: Ka bymmyntoi , ka bymmyntoi , ong u Stad saiñpyrkhat . Baroh ka long ka bymmyntoi .

Tharai eiei na phiah u ni shispah tylli ki langbrot pynlang u duh noh kadei na ki — kaei kaba un leh ? U ieh ïa kiwei ki khyndaiphew khyndai tylli ki Langbrot ha ka Jaka bam phlang dara u leit ban wad ïa kata kabu la sakma hapoh ba un da shem ïa ka .
translation.en: What man of you , having an hundred sheep , if he lose one of them , doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness , and go after that which is lost , until he find it ?
He setteth an end to darkness , and searcheth out all perfection : the stones of darkness , and the shadow of death .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ngam sha ki jaka bajylliew tam ka jingdum . Ki wad ïa ki jaka bajylliew ka pyrthei ; bad ki tih ïa ki mawsiang ha ka jingdum .
Kumta hadien ba ki la mihnoh na u Lum Sinai , ki Israel kim deng jingmeng shuh .
translation.en: And the children of Israel stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb .
The heaven , even the heavens , are the  Lord s  : but the earth hath he given to the children of men .
translation.kha: Ka bneng ka long ka jong U  Trai  hi , hynrei u ai ïa ka pyrthei ha u bynriew .

translation.en: And when it was evening , his disciples came to him , saying , This is a desert place , and the time is now past  ; send the multitude away , that they may go into the villages , and buy themselves victuals .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka janmiet ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  Ka la da dier eh , bad kane ka dei ka jaka bakynjah . To phah noh ïa ki paidbah bad shah ïa ki ban leit sha ki shnong ban thied jingbam na ka bynta ïa lade .

Haba la Sning sympat ïa ngi , ngi ju kyrkhoit ha kata ka por ïa kaei kai kaba pynsngewsih ïa ngi , bad ym kiba pynkmen ïa ngi . Pynban hadien , kito kiba shah pynbeit da kita ki armet sneng pynsabut ki ïoh ot ïa ka bainong kaba ai jingsuk jong ka jingim bahok .
translation.en: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous , but grievous : nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby .

translation.kha: U wan hadien jong nga , hynriewphew nga ngam long uba bit wat ban law ïa ki ksai juti jong u .
translation.en: He it is , who coming after me is preferred before me , whose shoe s latchet I am not worthy to unloose .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ka Jingïap ïa ka Babilonia ! Ka Jingpynpaw ïa ki briew jong ka , ïa ki nongsynshar jong ka , ïa ki rangbah bastad jong ka .
translation.en: A sword is upon the Chaldeans , saith the  Lord  , and upon the inhabitants of Babylon , and upon her princes , and upon her wise men .

Then it shall be , that whatsoever cometh forth of the doors of my house to meet me , when I return in peace from the children of Ammon , shall surely be the  Lord s  , and I will offer it up for a burnt offering .
translation.kha: ngan kñia ïa ka jingainguh da u briew ne ka briew ba mih nyngkong eh na ka ïing jong nga ban wan tan ïa nga , ynda nga wan phai na ka jingjop . Ngan ai ha me ïa uta ne kata ka briew kum ka jingainguh thang .
Ka um ka la tap bad ka set mynsiem ïa nga ; ka duriaw ka la tap lup ïa per , bad ki phlang duriaw ki la syep baroh sawdong ïa ka khlieh jong nga .
translation.en: The waters compassed me about , even to the soul : the depth closed me round about , the weeds were wrapped about my head .

translation.kha: ki Ebed , ki Moab , ki Ammon , ki Philetos , bad ki Adrammelekh — khmut shwa shu bynta na ka jinglute naba u la kurup na u Eldaah .
translation.en: Of Syria , and of Moab , and of the children of Ammon , and of the Philistines , and of Amalek , and of the spoil of Hadadezer , son of Rehob , king of Zobah .

translation.kha: U paidbah kaban u la bymdei ïa la ki jaiñkup ha lyntait katba kiwei pait ki la khyllad da ki tngit dieng bad ki la diengtied ïa ki ha lynnong .
translation.en: And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way  ; others cut down branches from the trees , and strawed them in the way .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , to ai ba ka dohnud jong phi kan khah hir Long ïa ka ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei , hynrei wat adong ïa ka jingkren ha ki thlia bapher .
translation.en: Wherefore , brethren , covet to prophesy , and forbid not to speak with tongues .

translation.kha: phiah haw ban ïaid da kaba suk ha ki lynti jong phi! bad phiah ym jynthut .
translation.en: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely , and thy foot shall not stumble .
I also will laugh at your calamity  ; I will mock when your fear cometh  ;
translation.kha: Kumta ynda phi shah jynjar , ngan sa ïoh rkhie ïa phi . Ngan sa rkhiebeiñ ïa phi ynda phi hap ha ka jingsheptieng —

translation.en: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days  ; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee , neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters .
translation.kha: Ha kita ki hynñiew sngi , phim dei ban bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat ; ym dei ban don u thiat ne u kpu ba la khleh thiat hangno hangno ha ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: Will a man rob God ? Yet ye have robbed me . But ye say , Wherein have we robbed thee ? In tithes and offerings .
translation.kha: Nga kylli ïa phi , hato ka long kaba dei ba u briew un shukor ïa U Blei ? Ha ka jingshisha ym dei , pynban phi shukor ïa nga . ‘ Da kumno ?’ phi kylli . Ha kaba ïadei shaphang kawei-na-kaba-shiphew bad ki jingainguh .
bad u ong ha u , Khie mareh , malu tam ïa ki khnam Kiba ngan sa syaid . Uta u Mareshah , nabar u Jonathan u siat ïa u khnam sha shuwa jong u .
translation.en: And he said unto his lad , Run , find out now the arrows which I shoot . And as the lad ran , he shot an arrow beyond him .
Trust in the  Lord  with all thine heart  ; and lean not unto thine own understanding .
translation.kha: Shaniah ha U  Trai  da ka dohnud jong phi baroh . Wat shaniah ha kaei ba phi pyrkhat ba phi tip .
Ki nongbah ka Haran , Kanneh , bad Edom , ki nongkhaïi ka Sheba , ki nongbah ka Pashhur bad Khilmad — baroh ki ïakhaïi pateng bad pha .
translation.en: Haran , and Canneh , and Eden , the merchants of Sheba , Asshur , and Chilmad , were thy merchants .
And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord , who hath enabled me , for that he counted me faithful , putting me into the ministry ;
translation.kha: Nga ai ïa ka jingnguh sha U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi , uba la ai ha nga ïa ka jingkhlaiñ na ka bynta ka kam jong nga . Nga ainguh ïa u ba la ñiew ïa nga uba bit bad la thung ïa nga ban shakri ïa u , wat la ha ka por ba la leit noh nga la kren sniew ïa u bad pynshitom beiñ bad krenbeiñ ïa u .
U sahmiet Hesekaïah u shim ïa ka shithi na ki nongrah-khubor mala pule ïa ka .
translation.en: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers , and read it : and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the  Lord  , and spread it before the  Lord .
The altar of burnt offering , with his brasen grate , his staves , and all his vessels , the laver and his foot ,
translation.kha: ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang bad ka kriah rnong jong ka , ki jingbah ïa ka , bad ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka ; ïa ka dabor bad ka jingpynshong jong ka ;

translation.en: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you , and the stranger that shall come from a far land , shall say , when they see the plagues of that land , and the sicknesses which the  Lord  hath laid upon it  ;
translation.kha: Ha ki pateng ki ban wan , ki khun ki ksiew jong phi bad ki nongwei na ki ri kiba jngai kin ïohi ïa ki jingpynjot bad ki jingshah shitom ba U  Trai  u la pynngat ha ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: Thus she committed her whoredoms with them , with all them that were the chosen men of Assyria , and with all on whom she doted : with all their idols she defiled herself .
translation.kha: Ka long ka nuti ïa baroh ki shipai Assyria , bad ka jingkwah brai jong ka , ka pynlong ïa ka ban pyntngit ïa lade da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki Assyria .

translation.en: They have belied the  Lord  , and said , It is not he  ; neither shall evil come upon us  ; neither shall we see sword nor famine :
translation.kha: Ki briew jong U  Trai  ki la len ïa u bad ki la ong ,  Un ym leh ei ei da shisha . Ngin ym mad ïa ki por ba-eh ; ngin ym mad ïa ka thma lane ka  nemsniew .

translation.en: My bones are pierced in me in the night season : and my sinews take no rest .
translation.kha: Mynmiet ki shyieng jong nga baroh ki pang ; ka jingpang kaba bam ïa nga kam kut shuh .

translation.en: Only rebel not ye against the  Lord  , neither fear ye the people of the land  ; for they are bread for us : their defence is departed from them , and the  Lord  is with us : fear them not .
translation.kha: Wat ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad wat sheptieng ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta . Ngin jop da kaba suk ïa ki . U  Trai  u don lem bad ngi bad u la jop ïa ki blei kiba ïada ïa ki ; kumta te wat sheptieng .

translation.en: For the days shall come upon thee , that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee , and compass thee round , and keep thee in on every side ,
translation.kha: Ka por kan poi haba ki nongshun jong pha kin ker sawdong ïa pha da ki jingker , ki jingkhanglad ïa pha , bad ki nang tur jan sha pha na ki liang baroh .
U Isaak u ino , Wanrah hangne ïa kata ka deng . Hadien ba nga la bam ïa ka , ngan sa kyrkhu ïa phi . U .—Jakob u wanrah ïa ka sha u , malu u la bam ; u wanrah katto katne ka Wai ruh ïa u Ban dih .
translation.en: And he said , Bring it near to me , and I will eat of my son s venison , that my soul may bless thee . And he brought it near to him , and he did eat : and he brought him wine , and he drank .
He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him , and went back , and stood by the bank of Jordan  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u tam ïa ka jaiñkup jong u Elijah kaba la hap na u , bad u leit phai bad ïeng harud ka Jordan .

Bad u Ahab u kyllan ïa u Jehoshaphat , Phin leit lang bad nga ïa-ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramah ? Nga la kloi , haba phi la Kloi , u Jehoshaphat u Joab bad kumin ruh ki bynriew bad ki shipai bad ki shipai shnong kulai jong nga ruh .
translation.en: And he said unto Jehoshaphat , Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth–gilead ? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel , I am as thou art , my people as thy people , my horses as thy horses .

translation.kha: Uno du uba pyrshang shun pyllait im ïa la ka jingkem un duh noh ïa ka ; uno Une uba duh noh ïa la ka jingtem un ïoh ïa ka .
translation.en: Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it  ; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it .

translation.kha: Nga la iphieng ïa kñia ka bri sohwaiñ na ki kpa tymmen jong ar . U Naboth u jingjubab . U TRAI’ u khang ba ngan ai ïa ka ha phi .
translation.en: And Naboth said to Ahab , The  Lord  forbid it me , that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha shaw ba phin tip ïa ka , phi kiba la jop ïa kiwei phin don ha ka Ram ïa lade bad shah pynbor ban siew ïa ka sut . Ki nongshna kin wan bad pynkyiuh ïa phi . Kane thombor ïa phoi !
translation.en: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite thee , and awake that shall vex thee , and thou shalt be for booties unto them ?
As concerning the rest of the beasts , they had their dominion taken away : yet their lives were prolonged for a season and time .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki mradkhlaw ki la shah knieh noh ka bor jong ki , hynrei la shah ïa ki ban im shipor .
Katba u Abib u dang leit ban bam , u Elijah u kiew sha u lum Karmel , u dem khrum ha khynñiuh , u da buh ïa la ka khleh khappud ki khohsiew jong u .
translation.en: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink . And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel  ; and he cast himself down upon the earth , and put his face between his knees ,

translation.kha: Suk uta u briew uba don U Blei jong u Jakeh ban ïarap ïa u bad uba shaniah ha U Trai U Blei jong u ,
translation.en: Happy is he that hath the God of Jacob for his help , whose hope is in the  Lord  his God :

translation.kha: Wat thaw bad mane ïa kano kano ka durblei ba la saiñ da kano kano ka jait nar .
translation.en: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods .

translation.kha: Haba phi duwai , wat long kum ki riewarsap ! Ki ieit don ïeng bad duwai ha ki synagog bad ha ki kyndong surok , khnang ba baroh ktang ïohi ïa ki . NGA pynthikna ïa Phi , ki la ïoh lwep ïa ka jingïasoh kaba pura! .
translation.en: And when thou prayest , thou shalt not be as the hypocrites are : for they love to pray standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets , that they may be seen of men . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .

translation.kha: Ym slem hawei U Jisu u la ïaid lyngba ki katto katne ki lyngkhuh kew ha ka sngi Sabteka . Ki synran jyllang u ki la thngan , ba kumta ki la sdang ban ïakheit ïa ki rynjup kew bad ïam ïa ki symboh kew .
translation.en: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn  ; and his disciples were an hungred , and began to pluck the ears of corn , and to eat .
And I , if I be lifted up from the earth , will draw all men unto me .
translation.kha: Ynda la kyntiew ïa nga na ka pyrthei , ngan khring ïa ki briew baroh sha nga .
Ha lynti , u la ïakynduh ïa u sing uba la pynïap ïa u . Ka metïap jongu u ka don ha ka lynti bah , bad ka kada bad u jingjngem ki ïeng ha syndah jong ka .
translation.en: And when he was gone , a lion met him by the way , and slew him : and his carcase was cast in the way , and the ass stood by it , the lion also stood by the carcase .

translation.kha: bad to pynbiang ïa lat khnang ba katto katne na Phin phin long kiba la kloi ban ïarap ïa kawei pa kawei ka long jongngi ki paid Israel .
translation.en: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people , and after the division of the families of the Levites .

translation.kha: U Troas u la bitar ïa ki ; bad kumto katba u dang leit noh ,
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against them  ; and he departed .
Because he covereth his face with his fatness , and maketh collops of fat on his flanks .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u long uba sarong bad uba ïaleh pyrshah ; u bat ïa la ka stieh ha ka jingmutlop bad u tur ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei .
U Trai u long babha bakha ïa uwei pa uwei uba shaniah ha u ,
translation.en: The  Lord  is good unto them that wait for him , to the soul that seeketh him .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki , To wan bad nga , badno ngan haei ïa phi ban tong briew .
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Follow me , and I will make you fishers of men .
Both thy bondmen , and thy bondmaids , which thou shalt have , shall be of the heathen that are round about you  ; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids .
translation.kha: Lada phi donkam ïa ki mraw , phi lah ban thied na ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong jong phi .

translation.en: The  Lord  openeth the eyes of the blind : the  Lord  raiseth them that are bowed down : the  Lord  loveth the righteous :
translation.kha: bad u pynpeit pat ïa kiba matlah . U khyllie ïa kito kiba la kyllon noh ; u ieit ïa ki briew kiba hok jong u .
Hynrei ka pyrthei kan longsyiem ba la dap da ka jingtip ïa ka Burom U thri kumba ki duriaw ki dap da ka um .
translation.en: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the  Lord  , as the waters cover the sea .

translation.kha: Ki ïaidwir na kawei ka ri sha kawei pateng , na khawai ka hima sha katai pat .
translation.en: And when they went from nation to nation , and from one kingdom to another people  ;
These are the sons of Shem , after their families , after their tongues , in their lands , after their nations .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew na u Shem , kiba shong ha ki ri kiba pher bapher , bad ha la ka jait ka jait kaba kren ïa la ka jong ka jong ka ktien .
U Syiem u la sngewsynei ïa u , kumto u la map ïa ka ram jong u bad u la pyllait noh ïa u .
translation.en: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion , and loosed him , and forgave him the debt .
And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord   ; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel sin : but he walked therein .
translation.kha: U ruh u leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad u bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u Syiem Jeroboam , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
nur pyllait im ïa me nabar ïa kan ka nongbah Jerusalem na u patsha Assyria , sad ngan ïan bteng ban ïada ïa ka nongbah .
translation.en: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria : and I will defend this city .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ka la mihnoh ban leit tam kew , u Boas u hukum ïa ki nongtrei , Shah ïa ka ban tam ki na ka jaka ha kaba ki song ki don , bad wat ong ei ei ban khang ïa ka . Nalor kata , sei hima katto katne ki kew na ki song bun ieh ïa ki ba kan Ïoh tam .
translation.en: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her , and leave them , that she may glean them , and rebuke her not .

translation.kha: ban ïatyngkhuh ha ki Eliel ba un uno u briew uba leh pop khlem tip bad u pynkheiñ ïa kano kano ka Hukum U Trai , u dei ban bud ïa kine ki aiu harum .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which ought not to be done , and shall do against any of them :

translation.kha: Lehse U Trai un ïohi ïa ka jinglanot jong nga bad un ai ha at katto katne ki jingkyrkhu ba-bang shim brup ïa ka jingtim jongki u .
translation.en: It may be that the  Lord  will look on mine affliction , and that the  Lord  will requite me good for his cursing this day .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u shym ka Israel , u Abijah u long u syiem ka Judah , sad u syiar to snem ha Jerusha .
translation.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah .
And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la iehnoh ïa kaei kaei kaba u don ha u Isaak ;

translation.en: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance : for ye serve the Lord Christ .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba U Trai un ai ha phi kum ka bainong ïa kaei kaba u la buh na ka bynta ki briew jong u . Naba U Khrist u dei U Kynrad bashisha uba phi shakri .
Ki ktien jong ki bymman ki long kum ngab pynïap , hynrei ki ktien jong kiba hok ki pyllait im ïa kito kiba shiah byrngem .
translation.en: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood : but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them .

translation.kha: Wat ki nong Ijipt kin kyndit bad khuslai haba ki tip ba ïa ka Tyros la pynjot .
translation.en: As at the report concerning Egypt , so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre .

translation.kha: Te nga la ong , ‘ Nga hangne , ban leh ïa ka mon jong me , A Blei! , kumba la thoh shapoh jyllang nga ha ka kitab ka Hukum .’
translation.en: Then said I , Lo , I come ( in the volume of the book it is written of me , ) to do thy will , O God .

translation.kha: Namar phi long kiba la pynkyntang khuid sha U Trai U Blei jongngi Phi . U la jied ïa phi napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei ba phin long ka jingpyniwbih kaba kyrpang jong u .
translation.en: For thou art an holy people unto the  Lord  thy God : the  Lord  thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself , above all people that are upon the face of the earth .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem u ai ha uwei ïa ka khubor ba-dap da ka jingsyiad , katba ha uwei pat , ujuh U Mynsiem u ai ïa ka khubor ba-pnah da ka jingtip .
translation.en: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom ; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit ;

translation.kha: Hobab kin wan ban pynkup ïa me , haei “Men dong kam hi ba me long U Blei ? Haba me ïakynduh ïa ki nongpynïap briew , men long uba kynja briew Bad ym satia uba kynja blei .
translation.en: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee , I am God ? but thou shalt be a man , and no God , in the hand of him that slayeth thee .

translation.kha: Kynhun ka kynhun bah jong ki ruh ka bneng , ka la mawbah lem bun u gospel , ki da rwai ki jingïarap ïa U Balei :
translation.en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God , and saying ,

translation.kha: bad kan jah noh na ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Thou shalt seek them , and shalt not find them , even them that contended with thee : they that war against thee shall be as nothing , and as a thing of nought .
But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb , The dog is turned to his own vomit again  ; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba la jia ha ki , ka pynpaw ba ki Proberb ki long kiba shisha :  U ksew u leit phai pat sha la ka prie  bad  u sniang ïa uba la pynsum pynsait u leit kyrsum pat ha ka ktieh .

translation.en: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment , or in the skin , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ; it is a plague of leprosy , and shall be shewed unto the priest :
translation.kha: lada ka dei kaba lam jyrngam lane kaba lam saw , ka dei ka jingbthuh kaba pur bad dei ban leit pyn-i ïa ka ha u lyngdoh .

translation.en: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season , the first rain and the latter rain , that thou mayest gather in thy corn , and thy wine , and thine oil .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , un sa pynhap slap ha ka khyndew jong phi ha ka aïom kaba biang , ha ka por synrai bad ha ka por pyrem , khnang ba phin ïohlum ïa u kew , ïa ka waiñ , bad ïa ka umphniang Olib na ka bynta jong phi hi , bad ïa u phlang na ka bynta ki jingri jong phi .
Un wallam ïa ki sha u lyngdoh ha ka jingshong ka Ïingjaiñ ha ka sngi kaba phra jongngi ka jingpyndep ïa u .
translation.en: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Shi bynta na ka lai bynta lad ka duriaw la pynkylla snam , shi bynta na ka para bynta jong ki jingwoh ba-im ha ka duriaw ki la ïap , nabar shu bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki lieng la shah pynjot .
translation.en: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea , and had life , died  ; and the third part of the ships were destroyed .

But when Sanballat the Horonite , and Tobiah the servant , the Ammonite , and Geshem the Arabian , heard it , they laughed us to scorn , and despised us , and said , What is this thing that ye do ? will ye rebel against the king ?
translation.kha: Haba u Sanballat , u Tobiah , bad u nong Arab uba kyrteng u Geshem ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ngi la thmu ban leh , ki rkhie ïa ngi bad ong ,  Kaei kaba phi tharai phin leh ? Hato phin ïaleh pyrshah ïa u patsha ?
jynreiñ , u ong ïa la ki synran ban iai-kynmaw , lane ïa-ban kynmaw ïa ka jingïap jong u .
translation.en: Rather , he told his disciples to memorialize , or remember , his death .

translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ki kynroh nongjop ka Tyros , bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut jong ka .
translation.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre , which shall devour the palaces thereof .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ba-beit kin nang ban sngewthuh , sad kito ibha khñium borabor kin kmen ban ïoh jingïakhaïi .
translation.en: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding , and they that murmured shall learn doctrine .

He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man  ; he that sacrificeth a lamb , as if he cut off a dog s neck  ; he that offereth an oblation , as if he offered swine s blood  ; he that burneth incense , as if he blessed an idol . Yea , they have chosen their own ways , and their soul delighteth in their abominations .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki leh katba ki sngewbha . Baroh ka long kajuh ïa ki , la ki pynïap ïa u masi kyrtong kum ka jingkñia lane jingkñia da u briew ; la ki kñia da u khunlangbrot lane ki pyndkut ïa ka ryndang u ksew ; la ki wanrah ka jingainguh kew ne ki ainguh da ka snam sniang ; la ki thang jingiwbih ne ki duwai ha ka bleithaw . Ki shem sngewbha ha ki rukom ba-ijli ha ka jingmane .

Ko khun u briew , u ong , pruid dak ar thylli ki lyntait na kiba u syiem ka Babilonia u lai ban wan lem bad la ka waitlam . Baroh ar tylli ki dei ban sdang na kajuh ka ri . Buh ïa ka dak jingkdew shano ba ki lynti ki ïakhlad .
translation.en: Also , thou son of man , appoint thee two ways , that the sword of the king of Babylon may come : both twain shall come forth out of one land : and choose thou a place , choose it at the head of the way to the city .

translation.kha: La katta ruh , kiba na ka jait Lebi ki don ka hok ban thied pat ha kano kano ka to ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki , kiba ei ha ki shnong ba la ai ha ki .
translation.en: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites , and the houses of the cities of their possession , may the Levites redeem at any time .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki bariew ki long kum ki symbai ba la bet hapdeng ki bna shiah . Kine ki longsyiem moi kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ,
translation.en: And these are they which are sown among thorns  ; such as hear the word ,

translation.kha: Mynta nga long kamon u ban sa ïarep noh ; ym don jinglait na ka jingjynjar jong per .
translation.en: And now my soul is poured out upon me  ; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me .

translation.kha: Ka jingbam ka mih na ka khyndew . Hynrei hapoh jong khiew ka khyndew , baroh ka long ba la pra bad ba la phret .
translation.en: As for the earth , out of it cometh bread : and under it is turned up as it were fire .
Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn , and to restore every man s money into his sack , and to give them provision for the way : and thus did he unto them .
translation.kha: U Joseph u la hukum ban pyndap ïa ki byrni jong ki hynmen shynrang jong u da u kew , bad ban thep biang ïa ki pisa jong uwei pa uwei ha ka byrni jong u , bad ban ai jingbam de ba kin ïoh bam ha lynti . Ïa kane la leh .

Hangne , te , ka long ka jingïohknieh jong nga ïa kiei kiei baroh ba phi la ai ha nga — dara ka la longkmie palat ban ïa kaba nga jingpynim! NGA don ïa baroh kaba nga donkam Mynta ha kaba u Epaphroditos u la wanrah shata nga ïa ki jingai sngewbha baroh jong phi . Ki long kum ka jingainguh ba-hajan sha U blei , ka jingkylla kob pdiang hun bad kiba pynsngewbha ïa u .
translation.en: But I have all , and abound : I am full , having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you , an odour of a sweet smell , a sacrifice acceptable , wellpleasing to God .

translation.kha: Nangta U Tlai u thoh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa kijuh ki ktien ba u la thoh ha ka sien kaba nyngkong , ïa ki shipawa sah” keiñ ba u la ai ha phi mynba u la kren nadong ka ding ha kata ka sngew ba phi ïalumlang ha uta u lum . U Trai u ai ha nga ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap , bad nga phai bad leit hiar na uta u lum .
translation.en: And he wrote on the tables , according to the first writing , the ten commandments , which the  Lord  spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly : and the  Lord  gave them unto me .

translation.kha: Nga la pynphong jaiñ ïa pha ha ki jaiñsem jynsur kiba la suh syntiew bad nga la ai ha pha ki juti na ki sniang kiba bha tam , ka jingïateh khlieh linen bad ka tapmoh rusom .
translation.en: I clothed thee also with broidered work , and shod thee with badgers  skin , and I girded thee about with fine linen , and I covered thee with silk .
And some of them of understanding shall fall , to try them , and to purge , and to make them white , even to the time of the end : because it is yet for a time appointed .
translation.kha: Katto katne na kito ki nongïalam bastad kin shah pynïap , hynrei kaba mih na kane ka long ba yn pynkhuid ïa ki briew . Kane kan ïailong tad haduh ba kaba kut kan wan , ka por kaba U Blei u la buh .
Nga shim ïa ka met jong ka , nga ot lyngkhot ïa ka , mala de phah ïa kawei ka lyngkhot sha kawei pa Kaei ka jait Israel . Kine ki briew ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba bymman bad ba-ijli hapdeng Jong I .
translation.en: And I took my concubine , and cut her in pieces , and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel : for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ka Hima ki bneng tista long kamut . Shisyndon la don shiphew ngut ki theisotti kiba la rah ïa la ki sharak bad ki la mih ban ïashem ïa u nongleitkurim .
translation.en: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins , which took their lamps , and went forth to meet the bridegroom .
Then Israel sang this song , Spring up , O well  ; sing ye unto it :
translation.kha: Te ki Israel ki rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai :  Ko ki pukri , pynkyrsoi ïa ka um jong phi , Da ka jingrwai ngin pdiang sngewbha ïa ka .

translation.en: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him , and said , Put now this woman out from me , and bolt the door after her .
translation.kha: u la khot ïa la u shakri , bad u ong ,  Beh noh ïa kane ka briew na khmat jong nga ! Pynmih ïa ka shabar bad khang ïa ka jingkhang !
Ki jin ki leh kumba la nguh ; ki shim ar tyrnem ki masi kynthei bad ki tah ïa ki ha kata ka kali , bad ki set ïa ki khun masi ha sem .
translation.en: And the men did so  ; and took two milch kine , and tied them to the cart , and shut up their calves at home :
And the  Lord  shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land , and shall choose Jerusalem again .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ka Judah kan long ka nongkynti bakyrpang jong U  Trai  ha ka ri bakyntang jong u , bad ka Jerusalem kan long ka nongbah kaba u ieit tam na baroh .

translation.en: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold , whose height was threescore cubits , and the breadth thereof six cubits : he set it up in the plain of Dura , in the province of Babylon .
translation.kha: U syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah thaw ka durbriew ksiar , arphew hynñiew mitar ka kynjang bad jan lai mitar ka pyngkiang , bad u la phah pynïeng ïa ka ha ka pyntha Dura ha ka probins    jong ka Babilon .

translation.en: Then said Paul , I wist not , brethren , that he was the high priest : for it is written , Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people .
translation.kha: U Paul u la jubab ,  Ko para nong Israel jong nga , ngam shym tip ba u dei u Rangbah Lyngdoh . Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Mem dei ban kren sniew ïa u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong me .’
Hynrei , haba u lyngdoh u la khmih bha pat ïa ka , lada kata ka jingbthuh ka la nang duma , u dadien ban tar noh ïa kata kaba la bit bthuh na tala ka jaiñ ne na kata ka snieh .
translation.en: And if the priest look , and , behold , the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it  ; then he shall rend it out of the garment , or out of the skin , or out of the warp , or out of the woof :

translation.kha: ïa u sahnarphna , u kalamus , ïa ka siasia , lane ka jingiwbih kaba bun jait . Ka mirr bad ka alos ki maw hangtei lem bad ki jingsleh kiba iwbih tam .
translation.en: His hands are as gold rings set with the beryl : his belly is as bright ivory overlaid with sapphires .

translation.kha: katba kita kiba stad ki la rah ïa la ki jingdiang ba la pyndap da ka umphniang na ka bynta ki sharak jong ki .
translation.en: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps .

translation.kha: Te u trai jong ka bri sohwaiñ u la ong , ‘ Kaei ngan leh ? ngan phah ïa u khun ba-ieit thep mynmiet jongngi de ; da kaba thikna kin burom ïa u !’
translation.en: Then said the lord of the vineyard , What shall I do ? I will send my beloved son : it may be they will reverence him when they see him .

translation.kha: Na ka jahthait u Gershon ki Mih ki longïing jong u Libni bad u Shemida ; ktien ki long ki jait Gershon .
translation.en: But thus do unto them , that they may live , and not die , when they approach unto the most holy things : Aaron and his sons shall go in , and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden :

translation.kha: U Mordekai u la thoh ïa ki shithi ha ka kyrteng u syiem Serksis , bun u shon ïa ki da ka muhor syiem . La leit ramhah da ki nongshong kulai kiba shong ha ki kulai basohsat na ki sem kulai syiem .
translation.en: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus  name , and sealed it with the king s ring , and sent letters by posts on horseback , and riders on mules , camels , and young dromedaries :

translation.kha: lane da kaba thok shang kano nangno ba ka la jah nep bad u smai ba um shym shem pat ïa ka .
translation.en: Or have found that which was lost , and lieth concerning it , and sweareth falsely  ; in any of all these that a man doeth , sinning therein :

translation.kha: Men ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang jongnga bakha shah banbeiñ bad jong ki khunswet ; men bishar da kaba sngewlem ïa ki ; ba kum ki briew kin ym pynjia jingkyrsiew shuh .
translation.en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed , that the man of the earth may no more oppress .

translation.kha: Naba nga long thoin ba ym don kabu ha pun pynïakhlad ïa moi na ka jingtied jong u : Ym ka jingïap lymne ka jingïam , lymne ki angel , lymne kiwei ki nongsynshar ba kynja bneng lane ki bor lymne jong kaba mynta lymne ka ban sa wan ,
translation.en: For I am persuaded , that neither death , nor life , nor angels , nor principalities , nor powers , nor things present , nor things to come ,
Then will I make this house like Shiloh , and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïai bteng ban ym kohnguh , te ngan leh ïa kane ka Templ ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ïa ka Shiloh , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong kane ka nongbah kum ka jingtim .
Nga la shem ba um shym la leh kaei kaei kaba u dei ban ïaphah lane ngab shah set bynda ; ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u ka dei bad ki jingkylli shaphang ka hukum jong ki hi .
translation.en: Whom I perceived to be accused of questions of their law , but to have nothing laid to his charge worthy of death or of bonds .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u syiem ka Jerusalem’ , u Asa u la long u syep ka Judah , bad u synshar sawphew wei snem ha Jeroboam .
translation.en: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah .
A wise man will hear , and will increase learning  ; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels :
translation.kha: Kine ki proberb ki lah ban nang pynkhraw ïa ka jingtip jong ki riewstad bad kdew lynti ïa kiba la nang la tip ,

translation.en: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds , or the noise of his tabernacle ?
translation.kha: Ym don batip kumno ki lyoh ki ïaid lane kumno u pyrthat u kyrhuh lyngba ka suiñbneng , ha kaba U Blei u shong .
Ha ka hukum jongno U Trai , u nongïathuhlypa na Jehud u leit sha Bethel bad u la tad hangta hamar ba u Jeroboam u ïeng ha ka duwan ban kñia jingainguh .
translation.en: And , behold , there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the  Lord  unto Beth–el : and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense .

translation.kha: U Hiram , u syiem Tyros u la ju longsem u paralok jong u Dabid , bad haba u la ïohsngew ba u Solomon u la longsem syiemsad hadien jong u Dabid , u kpa jong u , u la phah ki nongkit tiensyiem sha u .
translation.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon  ; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father : for Hiram was ever a lover of David .
Located there is the Governing Body , a central group of experienced elders who oversee the worldwide congregation .
translation.kha: Hangta la don ki dkhot ba la khot ka Governing Body , ka kynhun jong ki elders kiba tbit bha , ki ban peit ïa ki balang ha satlak ka pyrthei .
Kumta lada u ïabuaid u khot ïa u ‘ U Trai ,’ kumno ka lah ban long ba U Messaïah un dei uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ?
translation.en: If David then call him Lord , how is he his son ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh nangta bad u la leit narud ka tyrwa Galilaïa . U la kiaw ïa u lumrit bad u la shong .
translation.en: And Jesus departed from thence , and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee  ; and went up into a mountain , and sat down there .
Then said the  Lord  , Doest thou well to be angry ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Me don hok aïu ban bitar ?
Ïeng sharud na kino ki briew bad ngan pynjot thew ïa ki Kum kumno .
translation.en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation , that I may consume them in a moment .

translation.kha: Ko Trai , kine ki dei ki shakri jong me , ki briew jong me hi . Me la pyllait ïa ki da ka bor Bakhrawbor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong me .
translation.en: Now these are thy servants and thy people , whom thou hast redeemed by thy great power , and by thy strong hand .
Then said the  Lord  unto me , What seest thou , Jeremiah ? And I said , Figs  ; the good figs , very good  ; and the evil , very evil , that cannot be eaten , they are so evil .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , me ïohi aïu ?  Nga jubab ,  Ki soh Dumbur . Kiwei kiba bha ki da bha shisha , bad kiwei kiba sniew ki da sniew shisha , haduh ba ym long bam shuh .
ibha nga la wan sha ka tukri mynta ka sngi , nga la ïarwai , ‘ A Trai , U Blei jong u kynrad jong nga u Abraham , sngewbang ai ka jingjop ha nga ha kaei ba nga leh .
translation.en: And I came this day unto the well , and said , O  Lord  God of my master Abraham , if now thou do prosper my way which I go :

And it came to pass , after the year was expired , at the time when kings go forth to battle , that David sent Joab , and his servants with him , and all Israel  ; and they destroyed the children of Ammon , and besieged Rabbah . But David tarried still at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha ka pyrem kaba bud , ha ka por jong ka snem haba ki syiem ki ju leit sha ka thma , u Dabid u la phah ïa u Joab lem bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u bad ka kynhun shipai Israel ; ki la jop ïa ki Ammon bad ki la kerkut ïa ka nongbah Rabbah . Hynrei u Dabid hi u la sah ha Jerusalem .
Nga la mihpaw ha u Aram , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob , kum U Blei Badonbor Baroh , hawei ngam shym la pynithuh ïa lade ha ki da ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , U Trai .
translation.en: And I appeared unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob , by the name of God Almighty , but by my name  Jehovah  was I not known to them .
And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday  ; thou shalt shine forth , thou shalt be as the morning .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong me kan kham phyrnai ban ïa ka jingshai ka sngi ha ka por shiteng sngi , bad ki kynta ba-dum tam jong ka jingim kin phyrnai kum ka step phyrngab .

translation.en: All the valiant men arose , and went all night , and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth–shan , and came to Jabesh , and burnt them there .
translation.kha: baroh ki riewshlur ki leit bad ki ïaid baroh shi miet sha Beth Shan . Ki shim noh ïa ki met jong u Saul bad jong ki khun shynrang jong u na kata ka kynroh , ki wallam pat ïa ki sha Jabesh , bad ki thang ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us : for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul .
translation.kha: Nangta ngin leit bad shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , ïa kaba la leh bymsuidñiew mynba u Saul u long syiem .
‘ Ngan ym ïarap shuh ïa ki ,’ u ong ; ‘ bad sam peit kai kumno kan jia ïa ki . Kine ki dadien ki briew ibha mutlop , kiba ym don ka jingïaineh .
translation.en: And he said , I will hide my face from them , I will see what their end shall be : for they are a very froward generation , children in whom is no faith .
And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah , the son of Dodo , a man of Issachar  ; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Abimelekh , u Tola u khun jong u Puah bad u ksiew jong u Dodo , u la wan ban pyllait ïa ki Israel . U dei na ka jait Issakhar bad u shong ha Shamir ha ka ri lum Ephraim .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication , that thou hast made before me : I have hallowed this house , which thou hast built , to put my name there for ever  ; and mine eyes and mine heart shall be there perpetually .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Nga la shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai bad jingkyrpad rit jong me . Nga la pynkyntang ïa kane ka ïing kaba me la tei kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga junom . Ngan peit ïa ka bad ngan don hangta borabor .

translation.en: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew , that I might gain the Jews ; to them that are under the law , as under the law , that I might gain them that are under the law ;
translation.kha: Katba nga dang trei bad ki Jiw , nga im kum u Jiw khnang ban jop ïa ki ; bad wat la ma nga hi ngam long hapoh ka Hukum u Moses , nga im kumba nga la long mynba nga dang trei bad kito kiba hapoh ka hukum , khnang ba ngan jop ïa ki .
Nga la thoh ki jinghikai bym lah ñiew shiah na ka bynda ki Briew , hynñiew ki kynjai ïa ki Kum kaei kadei kaba khyllah bad long nongkhaïi .
translation.en: I have written to him the great things of my law , but they were counted as a strange thing .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingïap jong u , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: So Ahab slept with his fathers  ; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead .
For they have refreshed my spirit and yours : therefore acknowledge ye them that are such .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba kum kine ki dei hok ban ïoh ïa ka jingithuh .
Te pien long kiba lait na baroh ki jingbymkhuid bad khlem shah kynnoh pop! ha ka Sngi U Khrist .
translation.en: That ye may approve things that are excellent ; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ ;

translation.kha: Kumta u shym Ahab u khot shapoh ïa u rangbah ka ïingshong pynlang ong ïa u ngab leit bad wallam shisyndon ïa u Mikaïah .
translation.en: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers , and said , Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imlah .
In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Israel came up against Judah , and built Ramah , to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah , u Baasha u syiem ka Israel u hiarthma ïa ka Judah bad sdang ban tei kut ïa ka Ramah khnang ban khang noh ïa ka jingïaid lynti shapoh bad shabar ka Judah .
Lada u para Jeriel , shynrang dawai kynthei , ki die mraw ïa lade ha Phin , phi dei ban pyllew ïa ki hadien ba ki la shatri ïa phi hynriew snem . Ha ka snem kaba hynñiew phi dei ban pyllait ïa ki .
translation.en: And if thy brother , an Hebrew man , or an Hebrew woman , be sold unto thee , and serve thee six years  ; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee .
O daughter of Babylon , who art to be destroyed  ; happy shall he be , that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us .
translation.kha: Ko ka Babilon , yn sa pynjot ïa pha . Suk uta u briew uba siew kylliang ïa pha na ka bynta kaei kaba pha la leh ïa ngi —

translation.en: Speak unto the congregation , saying , Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah , Dathan , and Abiram .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki briew ban kynriah sha jngai na ki ïingjaiñ jong u Korah , u Dathan , bad u Abiram .

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah , and all his might , and how he made a pool , and a conduit , and brought water into the city , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Hesekaïah u la leh , ki kam shlur jong u , bad ki jingïathuh ba kumno u la tei ïa ka jaka pynlang um bad u tih ïa ka nur ban wallam um sha ka nongbah , la buh jingthoh baroh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
Sa shisien pat u Dabid u khot lang ïa ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel , kiba long baroh laiphew hajar ngut ,
translation.en: Again , David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel , thirty thousand .

translation.kha: Hangta ïa phira yn kem bad yn aiti ban shah pynshitom bad ban shah pynpaw . Ki jingtipbriew baroh kin isih ïa phi namar jong nga .
translation.en: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted , and shall kill you : and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name s sake .

All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee : they hiss and gnash the teeth : they say , We have swallowed her up : certainly this is the day that we looked for  ; we have found , we have seen it .
translation.kha: Kata ka long balei ba ki khmat jong nga ki shlei da ki ummat . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyntngen ïa nga ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban ai jingshlur ïa nga . U nongshun u la jop ïa nga ; ki briew jong nga kim don ei ei shuh kaba sah .

translation.en: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits : every hand of the wicked shall come upon him .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingkiew rasong ka jingjop jong u , pynban ka jingkhia jong ka jingjynjar kan ban halor jong u .

translation.en: As a cage is full of birds , so are their houses full of deceit : therefore they are become great , and waxen rich .
translation.kha: Kumba u nongriam sim u pyndap ïa ka ruh jong u da ki sim , ki la pyndap ïa ki ïing jong ki da ka jinglute . Dei kata keiñ balei ba ki long kiba donbor bad kiba riewspah ,

translation.en: And when I looked , behold , an hand was sent unto me  ; and , lo , a roll of a book was therein  ;
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ka kti ba la kner sha nga bad ka bat ïa ka kot kli .
U shipor u la Shem ïa u hangno bad u ong ïa u , Me leh aïu da kaba ïohthiah ? To Khie bad to mudui ha u blei jong me na ka bynta ka jingïaroh . Lehse un sngewlwait ïa i bad pyllait im ïa ngi .
translation.en: So the shipmaster came to him , and said unto him , What meanest thou , O sleeper ? arise , call upon thy God , if so be that God will think upon us , that we perish not .

translation.kha: U Mosah u la sah hangta bad U Trai sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , khlem ba-im khlam dih . U thoin ruh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa ki ktien jngai kata ka jutang — ki Shiphew sah” keiñ .
translation.en: And he was there with the  Lord  forty days and forty nights  ; he did neither eat bread , nor drink water . And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant , the ten commandments .

translation.kha: Hynrei u nongring khlur um shym la kyrkhoit ei ei Shaphan u Joshua — u la klet noh ïa kaei kaei baroh shaphang jong u .
translation.en: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph , but forgat him .
Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the  Lord  , and until it was finished . So the house of the  Lord  was perfected .
translation.kha: Ha kum kane ka por la pyndep ïa ki kam ki jam u Solomon baroh . Naduh kaba seng ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ U  Trai  haduh ka jingpyndep ïa ka , baroh ka kam ka la long kaba jop .
Kata ka sngi ka dei ngab long ka sngi kaba khuid bha , ka sngi ha kaba ki jingïakhih bad kim trei ïa kane kano ka kur . Kieng ki dei ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ban rakhe pateng la pateng .
translation.en: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you , and ye shall afflict your souls , by a statute for ever .
And the Philistines called for the priests and the diviners , saying , What shall we do to the ark of the  Lord  ? tell us wherewith we shall send it to his place .
translation.kha: ki briew ki khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki nongleh myntor bad ki kylli ,  Ngin leh kumno ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  ? Lada ngi phah biang ïa ka sha ka jaka jong ka da-ei ngin phah ryngkat bad ka ?
Wat klim .
translation.en: Thou shalt not commit adultery .

translation.kha: Hato me tip kumno U Blei u ai Law bad u pyningkhong ïa ka leilieh pun thaba na ki lehkai ?
translation.en: Dost thou know when God disposed them , and caused the light of his cloud to shine ?

translation.kha: Ki proberb u Solomon , u khun jong u Dabid bad u syiem ki Israel .
translation.en: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David , king of Israel  ;

translation.kha: borbah pylleng ki de ban kitei shaei kata ka jaka myn Blei ba yn bishar ïa ki da ki lyngdoh bad ki nongbishar kiba treikam ha kata ka por .
translation.en: Then both the men , between whom the controversy is , shall stand before the  Lord  , before the priests and the judges , which shall be in those days  ;

translation.kha: Kñia ka la long ka jingshai kabu shisha — ka jingshai kob wan sha ka pyrthei bad pynshai ha u bynriew baroh .
translation.en: That was the true Light , which lighteth every man that cometh into the world .
Will ye accept his person ? will ye contend for God ?
translation.kha: Hato me pyrshang ban ïada ïa u ? Hato men leit ban ïasaid ïa ka kam jong u ha ka ïingbishar ?

translation.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with the best gold .
translation.kha: U phah shna ruh kawei ka khet kaba heh . Shi bynta na ka la tap da ka bniat hati , bad kaba sah pat la tap da ka ksiar nylla .

Lai sien shisnem , ki shynrang Jong phi baroh ki dadien don wanpaw ha khmat U Trai U Blei! jong phi ha kata ka jaka mian Blei : ha ka Niam Ka Jinglait , ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot , sad ha ka jingrwai Maim Ki Ïingtrep . Kim dei ban wan thylli ha khmat U Trai ;
translation.en: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the  Lord  thy God in the place which he shall choose  ; in the feast of unleavened bread , and in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of tabernacles : and they shall not appear before the  Lord  empty :
And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people , that they might send them out of the land in haste  ; for they said , We be all dead men .
translation.kha: Kita ki nong Ijipt ki la kyrpad jur ïa ki Israel ban pynstet bad mihnoh na kata ka ri .  Ngin sa ïap lut lada phim leit noh ,  ki ong .
U Moses u jubab , Wat sheptieng , U Blei u la ïan tang ba tynjuh ïa phira bad pynlong ïa phi ban ïai kohnguh ïa u , khnang ba phin ym ni pum .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the people , Fear not : for God is come to prove you , and that his fear may be before your faces , that ye sin not .

translation.kha: Nabal baroh , dei ma phi — ma phiah keiñ , khlem ïania ïa kiwei pateng ! — kiba long ka jingkyrmen jong ngi , ka jingkmen jong ngi , bad ka daw jong im ban sngewsarong ïa ka jingjop jong ine ha khmat jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi haba u wan .
translation.en: For what is our hope , or joy , or crown of rejoicing ? Are not even ye in the presence of our Lord Jesus Christ at his coming ?

translation.kha: Nangta ki la ong ïa u , Ïathuh ha ngi , mynba , Kamon phoi la poi thoh ïa kane baroh ? Hato u Gemaraïah u la ong ïa ka ha phi ban thoh ?
translation.en: And they asked Baruch , saying , Tell us now , How didst thou write all these words at his mouth ?
And it came to pass , that , when Abram was come into Egypt , the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair .
translation.kha: Haba u la rung sha ka ri Ijipt , ki nong Ijipt ki la ïohi ba ka tnga jong u ka la long kaba bhabriew .
Bad U Blei , kaba ïohi ïa kaba shapoh ki jemnud jong ngi , u tip kaei ka long jingmut jong U mynsngi ; namar U Mynsiem u ïasaid bad U Blei na ka byndi la ki briew malu kat kum ka mon jong u .
translation.en: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit , because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God .

translation.kha: U Trai u la mihpat da shisha ! U la paw ha u Simon !
translation.en: Saying , The Lord is risen indeed , and hath appeared to Simon .

translation.kha: shadien kata , u ïohknieh u la im ha ka jingïasyllok nabar U Blei haduh lumbah snem pynlang u la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki kynhun .
translation.en: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years , and begat sons and daughters :

translation.kha: Te nga la ong , ‘ Nga hangne , ban leh ïa ka myn Jong me , A Blei , kumba la thoh shaphang jong nga ha ka kitab ka Law .’
translation.en: Then said I , Lo , I come ( in the volume of the book it is written of me , ) to do thy will , O God .

translation.kha: Ki tnga bad ki khun ki kti jong I , bad ki jingri lem sad ki langbrot jong I , kin sah hangtei ha ki shnong ka Gilgal .
translation.en: Our little ones , our wives , our flocks , and all our cattle , shall be there in the cities of Gilead :

translation.kha: Phin jubab , ‘ Ka long ka jingkñia jong ka Niam Ka Jinglait banbeiñ pynbun ïa U tharai , naba u la ïaid mlien ïa ki ïing jong ki Israel ha ka ri Ijipt . U la pynïap ïa ki nong Joppa , hynrei u la pyllait im ïa ngi .’ Ki Israel ki la dem khohwah bad ki la mane .
translation.en: That ye shall say , It is the sacrifice of the  Lord s  passover , who passed over the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt , when he smote the Egyptians , and delivered our houses . And the people bowed the head and worshipped .

translation.kha: Haba u nongshet kpu jingbabe u la ïohi ba said ka jingbatai ïa ka jingphohsniew jong u nongrah khuri ka long kaba ai jinghun , u ong ha u Jehosabad , Nga ruh nga la pynswai ; nga la kit lai tylli ki Shaneng kpu halor ka khlieh jong nga .
translation.en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good , he said unto Joseph , I also was in my dream , and , behold , I had three white baskets on my head :

translation.kha: Ang la long kum u kpa ïa Kiba duk bad nga la long ha ka liang ki nongwei haba ki shem jingeh .
translation.en: I was a father to the poor : and the cause which I knew not I searched out .

translation.kha: Lada U Blei uba ngi shakor u lah ïa-ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ka lawar ding baklang badno na ka bor jongu phi , te un ar .
translation.en: If it be so , our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace , and he will deliver us out of thine hand , O king .

translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka snieh u pynkyntang ruh ïa ka bynta naba hapdeng ka phyllaw , kata ka jaka kaba ha khmat ka Templ , bad u kñia hangamei ïa ki jingainguh thang , ïa ki jingainguh bam , bad ïa ka khlem jngai ki mraw na ka bynta ka jingainguh jingpynïasuk . U leh ïa kane namar ba kata ka duwan rnong ka rit than eh na ka bynta baroh kine ki jingainguh .
translation.en: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of the  Lord  : for there he offered burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings : because the brasen altar that was before the  Lord  was too little to receive the burnt offerings , and meat offerings , and the fat of the peace offerings .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar un pynkut nep ïa ka jingïap junom ! Un ñiad noh! ïa ki ummat na ki khmat jong barhem bad un weng noh ïa ka jingjahburom ka ki briew jrong u ki la shah ha kylleng ka pyrthei . U Trai hi da lade u la kren !
translation.en: He will swallow up death in victory  ; and the Lord  God  will wipe away tears from off all faces  ; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .

translation.kha: Syiem Kynrad , to shim ïa ka , u Araunah u ong , badno to keiñ ha U Trai ïa nangno kano kaba phi mon . Ktien hangne ki masi thad ban step kum ka jingainguh phalor ka duwan ; kine Hangno ki dei ki lyngkor jong ki malade ka lyntang shoh kew ban pyndonkam kum ka diengthang .
translation.en: And Araunah said unto David , Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him : behold , here be oxen for burnt sacrifice , and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood .

translation.kha: wat sarong shaphang kaba lashai . Phim tip aïu kan jhieh hapdeng mynta bad hain .
translation.en: Boast not thyself of to morrow  ; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth .
In a moment shall they die , and the people shall be troubled at midnight , and pass away : and the mighty shall be taken away without hand .
translation.kha: U briew u lah ban ïap kynsan mynmiet . U Blei u shoh-ïap ïa ki briew bad ki jot noh ; u pynïap ïa kiba khrawbor da kaba suk .
Wat leh-isynei ïa u . Rat noh na Israel kum ïa uta u nongpynïap briew , khnang ba phin manbha .
translation.en: Thine eye shall not pity him , but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel , that it may go well with thee .

translation.kha: Phira dei ruh ban thring ïa khiew ki rangïapom synriah bad skhem ïa kawei na kaba syn bynta na ki jingthung ha ki hynñiew snem kiba poh .
translation.en: Let Pharaoh do this , and let him appoint officers over the land , and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years .
To deliver thee from the way of the evil man , from the man that speaketh froward things  ;
translation.kha: bad khang ïa phi na kaba leh ïa ka bymdei . Kin sumar ïa phi na ki briew kiba pynkhih jingkulmar da kaei kaba ki kren —
Na u Paul , u sylla malu u Timothi — Ha ki parabangeit jong ka balang ha Thessaloni , kiba long ki jong U Blei uba U KA jyllang ngi Bad ki jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai :
translation.en: Paul , and Silvanus , and Timothy , unto the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ :

translation.kha: Lada uno uno um kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong U Blei jong me lane ki aiñ jong ka hima , ïa u dei ban pynshitom mardor : da ka jingïap lane da ka jingringmraw lane da kaba knieh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u lane da ka jingset byndi .
translation.en: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God , and the law of the king , let judgment be executed speedily upon him , whether it be unto death , or to banishment , or to confiscation of goods , or to imprisonment .
Hast thou not procured this unto thyself , in that thou hast forsaken the  Lord  thy God , when he led thee by the way ?
translation.kha: Ko Israel me la wallam ïa kane halor jong me ! Me la iehnoh ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong me , katba nga dang ïalam ïa me ha ka lynti .

translation.en: And I saw as the colour of amber , as the appearance of fire round about within it , from the appearance of his loins even upward , and from the appearance of his loins even downward , I saw as it were the appearance of fire , and it had brightness round about .
translation.kha: Ka dur ka i phyrnai la kum ka rnong hapdeng ka ding .
Nangta u Moses u ong ha ki paid Israel ,
translation.en: And Moses charged the people the same day , saying ,

translation.kha: kumta wat sheptieng , phi kham koit bun shah ban ïa shibun ki sim ïing .
translation.en: Fear ye not therefore , ye are of more value than many sparrows .

And it came to pass , that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness  ; and , behold , the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded , and brought forth buds , and bloomed blossoms , and yielded almonds .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , haba u Moses u leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , u la ïohi ba u diengduh jong u Aaron , uba ïeng na ka bynta ka jait Lebi , u la khie lung . U la shylluit , phuh syntiew , bad sei ki soh almond kiba ih !
nabar ki jingpanpoh da ka linen bani Bad da u saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad kiba rong sien , ba la pynpur itynnat bha , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: And a girdle of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet , of needlework  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Balei te ka kmie jong per ka thum ïa nga ha la pneh ? Balei ka ai buiñ ïa nga ha ka shadem jong ka ?
translation.en: Why did the knees prevent me ? or why the breasts that I should suck ?

translation.kha: U la Long u kpa jong ki hynñiew ngut ki khun shynrang bad ki per ngut ki khun kynthei .
translation.en: He had also seven sons and three daughters .

translation.kha: ïa ki pyrda jong ka phyllaw , ïa ki rishot jong ka , bad ïa ki thliew tnaw jong ka ; ïa ka Pyrta ïa ka khyrdop jong ka phyllaw bad ïa ki tyllai jong ka ; ïa ki snar jong ka Ïingjaiñ ; ïa ki tiar baroh ibha pyndonkam ha ka Ïingjaiñ ;
translation.en: The hangings of the court , his pillars , and his sockets , and the hanging for the court gate , his cords , and his pins , and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle , for the tent of the congregation ,

translation.kha: Katto katto ngut na ki briew ha ithuh u paidbah ki la jingsngewsih ïa u ba u noh ïa Kanneh bad ki la ong , Une u briew u dei da shisha u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: Many of the people therefore , when they heard this saying , said , Of a truth this is the Prophet .

And they said one to another , We are verily guilty concerning our brother , in that we saw the anguish of his soul , when he besought us , and we would not hear  ; therefore is this distress come upon us .
translation.kha: Ki te ki ïakohnguh ban leh kumta , bad ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ho-oid , mynta ngi shah jynjar namar kaei kaba ngi la leh ïa la u jong u para . Ngi la ïohi haduh katno u khuslai mynba u kyrpad ba ngin ïarap ïa u , bad ngim shym la shahshkor . Dei namar kata ba ngi shah jynjar kumne mynta .
ka Jahas , ka Kedemoth , ka Mephaath ,
translation.en: And Jahzah , and Kedemoth , and Mephaath ,

translation.kha: Da kumta , te , kaba kumno ka jingpynbaptis phira la ïa-ïohpdiang ? Ka jingpynbaptis u Ïoannis , ki la jubab .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Unto what then were ye baptized ? And they said , Unto John s baptism .

translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha me , ko Petros : me hir u maïan , bad hiar kane ka nongrim mawsiang ngan tei ïa ka balang jongki nga , bad wat ka jingïap hi kan ym la don jlop ïa ka .
translation.en: And I say also unto thee , That thou art Peter , and upon this rock I will build my church  ; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor ïa ka Tyros . To lynñiar da ka jingsngewsynei , Phin ki mata ha ki duriaw ! Ïa ka kadlieng ha ka shnong lad phi , ka Tiberios , la pynjot ; ki ïing bad ka kadlieng jong ka ki don ha ka jingud . Kumba ki lieng jong phi ki wan phai na Sypros , phi tip ïa ka khubor .
translation.en: The burden of Tyre . Howl , ye ships of Tarshish  ; for it is laid waste , so that there is no house , no entering in : from the land of Kittim it is revealed to them .

translation.kha: U Syiem Kynrad u la pynmih ka hukum ba tang meng ïasdang ka jingput jingtem , uwei pa aiwai u dei ban dem ngon bad manla ïa ka durbriew ksiar ,
translation.en: Thou , O king , hast made a decree , that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , shall fall down and worship the golden image :

translation.kha: U symboh u la ïeng joit , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewbiang , bad u lympat ïa lade ha khyndew . Ki shakri ruh kiba don hangta bad u ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ .
translation.en: Then the king arose , and tare his garments , and lay on the earth  ; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent .
He keepeth the paths of judgment , and preserveth the way of his saints .
translation.kha: U ïada ïa kito kiba lehhok ïa kiwei pat , bad u ïada ïa kito kiba aiti ha u .

translation.en: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer , and lay them up without the camp in a clean place , and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation : it is a purification for sin .
translation.kha: Nangta uno uno u briew u bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam un khat ïa u dpei jong kata ka masi bad buh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam shabar ka jaka sher dara , ha kaba dei ban buh kyrpang ïa ka hangta na ka bynta ka kynhun Israel ban pyndonkam ha kaba pynkhreh ïa ka um na ka bynta ka jingweng ïa ka jingbymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam . Ïa kane ka jinglehniam dei ban leh ban weng ïa ka pop .

translation.en: And I will make of thee a great nation , and I will bless thee , and make thy name great  ; and thou shalt be a blessing :
translation.kha: Ngan ai ïa me bun ki khun ki ksiew , bad kin sa long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw . Ngan kyrkhu ïa me bad ngan pyndonnam ïa ka kyrteng jong me , ba kumta men sa long ka jingkyrkhu .

Haneng ka Synduk la don ki khrum kiba un-long ka nang ka jingdon shlip jongno U Blei , bad ki thapniang jong ki , ki pyiar shalor ka jaka ha kaba la ju map ïa ki pop . Hynrei mynta kam dei ka por ban batai bniah nong shadong .
translation.en: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat  ; of which we cannot now speak particularly .

translation.kha: Ma phiah , ki nongbah pynïaidkam jong phi , bad ki briew jngai phi , phin sa lait na kine ki jakoid , sad kine ym don shuh hangno hangno lait sa tang ha ka wah Neah .
translation.en: And the frogs shall depart from thee , and from thy houses , and from thy servants , and from thy people  ; they shall remain in the river only .

translation.kha: Ngi pynlip ïa barabor ki jingshai Jong ka bneng , bad ngan pyndum ngaiñ ïa ka pyrthei jong me ha ka jingdum , ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga la kren-ïa .
translation.en: All the bright lights of heaven will I make dark over thee , and set darkness upon thy land , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Da ka dohnud jong nga baroh nga pyrshang ban shakri ïa me ; to sumar ïa at na ka jingbymkohnguh ïa ki lawbah jong me .
translation.en: With my whole heart have I sought thee : O let me not wander from thy commandments .

translation.kha: Namar wat U Khun U briew’ um shym la wan ba un shah shakri ; u la wanpaw ban shakri bad ban aiti ïa la ka jingim ban pynim ïa kiba bun ki briew .
translation.en: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto , but to minister , and to give his life a ransom for many .
Mr So-and-So is dead . Why would I bother going to his funeral since , I am certain , he won't come to mine ?
translation.kha: I bah ine-ine i lah iap . Balei ngan leit sha jingontep jong i haba nga lah thikna , in nym wan sha jingontep jongnga ?

translation.en: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us : for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul .

translation.kha: Hynrei to wat klet ïa kane kaweh , ko paralok ba-ieit jong nga ! Kam don ka jingïapher ha khmat U Trai hapdeng ka shi sngi bad ka shihajar snem ; ha u , baroh ar ki long Kumjuh .
translation.en: But , beloved , be not ignorant of this one thing , that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years , and a thousand years as one day .

translation.kha: Haba u la shem ïa u , u la ïalumlang ïa u sha Oniks , bad baroh shisnem kine ar ngut ki la ïaknieh ïa ki briew ka balang bun ki la hikai ïa ka kynha kaba heh . Ka la long ha Antiokh ba ïa ki parabangeit la khot nyngkong eh Ki Khristan .
translation.en: And when he had found him , he brought him unto Antioch . And it came to pass , that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church , and taught much people . And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch .

translation.kha: U Isaïah u jubab ïa kata , To shahshkor , mynta , ko ki khun ki ksiew jong u Syiem Dabid . Ka longïing kaban sniew eh ïa phi ban pynthait ïa ka jingiashah jong ki bynriew — hato phi donkam umdih banbeiñ pynthait ïa ka jingïaishah ka jong U Blei ?
translation.en: And he said , Hear ye now , O house of David  ; Is it a small thing for you to weary men , but will ye weary my God also ?

translation.kha: Naba U Blei u la buh ha ki dohkha jongno ki ïa ka mon ban pyndep ïa ka jingtem jong u da kaba ïatreilang bad da kaba ai ha u mradkhlaw ïa ka bor jong ki shun synshar tad ynda ki ktien jong U Balei ki wan urlong shispah .
translation.en: For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will , and to agree , and give their kingdom unto the beast , until the words of God shall be fulfilled .

translation.kha: Te kun long uba iing ban ïaroh ïa me bad pdiang ba me la ïoh ka jingjop da ailad hi .
translation.en: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee .

translation.kha: Haba ki nong Ijipt kin ïohi ïa pha , kin thah ba phah dei ka tnga jong nga , bad kumta kin pynïap ïa nga bad shah ïa phasi , don im .
translation.en: Therefore it shall come to pass , when the Egyptians shall see thee , that they shall say , This is his wife : and they will kill me , but they will save thee alive .

translation.kha: Ka lai ruh ban pynliat ïa phiah sha khawai patiaw ki jingpynshoi .—Proberb 23 :20 , 21 , 29-35 .
translation.en: It can also cause you to give in very quickly to other temptations .—Proverbs 23 :20 , 21 , 29-35 .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What things ?  And they said unto him , Concerning Jesus of Nazareth , which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people :

translation.kha: Hynrei u Sihon um shem shah ïa ki Israel ba kin leh kumta . U lumrit ïa u paidïapom jong u baroh , u sher dara ha Jehoahas , bad u tuh ïaleh ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast : but Sihon gathered all his people together , and pitched in Jahzah , and fought against Israel .
Therefore he said that he would destroy them , had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach , to turn away his wrath , lest he should destroy them .
translation.kha: Haba U Blei u la ong ban pynjot ïa ki briew jong u , u shakri ba la jied jong u , u Moses , u la ïeng pyrshah ïa U Blei bad khang ïa ka jingbitar jong u na kaba pynjot noh ïa ki .

Ka erlangthari kumta bad phira , ko ki nongpynïap jong na . Ha ka jingïadei bad ka hukum , ma phi ruh phi la ïap namarba phi! lama ka bynta jong ka met U Khrist ; bad mynta phi long ki jong u , uta ïa uba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap khnam ba ngi lah ban long kiba U Blei u Lah ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka kam jong u .
translation.en: Wherefore , my brethren , ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ ; that ye should be married to another , even to him who is raised from the dead , that we should bring forth fruit unto God .
Yea , before the day was I am he  ; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand : I will work , and who shall let it ?
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei bad ngan ïailong . Ym don u ban lait im na ka bor jong nga ; ym don uba lah ban pynkylla ïa kaei ba nga leh .

translation.kha: La don kham bun ki riewkynthei ha ka ri jong phi ban ïa ki symboh shyiap harud ka duriaw . Nga la pynïap ïa ki rangsamla jong phi ha ka rta kaba dang khie bha bad pynlong ïa ki kmie jong ki ban shahshitom . Nga lynshop kynsan ïa ki da ka jingkhuslai bad ka jingtriem .
Haba ki briew kiba babha ki wan ha ka bor , baroh ki lehkmen , hynrei haba ki briew kiba sniew ki synshar , ki brisoh ki buhrieh ïa latai .
translation.en: When righteous men do rejoice , there is great glory : but when the wicked rise , a man is hidden .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la klet ïa U Tlai U Blang jngai ki ; ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa u bad manla ïa ki bleithaw Balah bad Asherah .

translation.en: And there abode three months . And when the Jews laid wait for him , as he was about to sail into Syria , he purposed to return through Macedonia .

translation.en: And of thy garments thou didst take , and deckedst thy high places with divers colours , and playedst the harlot thereupon : the like things shall not come , neither shall it be so .

translation.kha: Bad kumta u Saul u la sah bad ki bad u la leit kylleng ka Jerusalem , da kaba ïalap da ka jingpynshlur ha ka kyrteng jong U TRAI’ .
translation.en: And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem .

translation.en: And Annas the high priest , and Caiaphas , and John , and Alexander , and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest , were gathered together at Jerusalem .

translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Except ye eat the flesh of the Son of man , and drink his blood , ye have no life in you .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Lada phim bam ïa ka doh jong U Khun U Briew bad dih ïa ka snam jong u , phin ym don ïa ka jingim ha lade .
U Blei u kwah ba ki bariew kin im ka jingim kaba khem ha pyrthei .
translation.en: God wants people to enjoy life on earth .
And he sent them to Lebanon , ten thousand a month by courses : a month they were in Lebanon , and two months at home : and Adoniram was over the levy .

translation.en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me , therefore will I call upon him as long as I live .
translation.kha: U shahshkor ïa nga , man ka por ba nga khot kyrpad ïa u .
U Pharaoh u phah kyrmen ïa kaei kabu la jied bad la iathuh ba na ki jingri jyllang ki Israel ym don siat kaba ïap . Hynrei u dang mutlop hi bad um shah ïa u paidbah baneh leit .
translation.en: And Pharaoh sent , and , behold , there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead . And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened , and he did not let the people go .

translation.kha: Kato ki blei jong kino Phim ki hima ki la pyllait im ïa ki ri jong ki na u patsha ka Assyria ?
translation.en: Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?

translation.en: And when he went in to his wife , she conceived , and bare a son , and he called his name Beriah , because it went evil with his house .

translation.en: And till Moses had done speaking with them , he put a veil on his face .
And thou shalt put them into one basket , and bring them in the basket , with the bullock and the two rams .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ki ha ka shang , bad wanrah ïa ki sha nga ha ka por ba me kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw bad ïa ki ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang .

translation.en: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people  ;
translation.kha: kaba me la pynkhreh ha khmat jong ki jaitbynriew baroh :

Uta u paidbah u ïawan sha u Mosah bad u ong , Ngi la leh pep haba sem la kren pyrshah ïa U Trai nabar ïa phi ruh . Mynta to duwai ha U Trai ba un shim noh ïa Kinah ki bseiñ . Kumjuh u Moses u la duwai na ka bynta uta u paidbah .
translation.en: Therefore the people came to Moses , and said , We have sinned , for we have spoken against the  Lord  , and against thee  ; pray unto the  Lord  , that he take away the serpents from us . And Moses prayed for the people .

translation.kha: Hynrei kita ki nongpynkha khun ki daiñ kiba sheptieng ïa U Blei! ; kumta kim shym kohnguh ïa u , hynrei ki shah ba ki khun shynrang kin im .
translation.en: But the midwives feared God , and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them , but saved the men children alive .
