translation.kha: jlan shano me la kynti ïa ngi junom ? Kato ym don jingkut ïa ka jingbitar jong me ?
translation.en: But thou hast utterly rejected us  ; thou art very wroth against us .

translation.kha: Don kiwei kiei kiba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u dang buhrieh na ka jingtip u briew ; hynrei u la pynpaw ïa ka Aiñ jongnga u , bad ma ngi lym bad ki khun ki khiew jong ngi , ngi dei ban kohnguh ïa ka junom .
translation.en: The secret things belong unto the  Lord  our God : but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever , that we may do all the words of this law .

translation.kha: Mar kumta hi U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki dang ïa-pakor , kumta u la jong ha ki . Balei ba phi ïa-pyrkhat kum ïa nam kiei keiñ ?
translation.en: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves , he said unto them ,  Why reason ye these things in your hearts ?
Since thou wast precious in my sight , thou hast been honourable , and I have loved thee : therefore will I give men for thee , and people for thy life .
translation.kha: Ngan kyntait ïa ki ri baroh ban pynim ïa ka jingim jong phi , namar phi long uba kordor ha nga bad namar ba nga ieit ïa phi bad ai ïa phi ka burom .

Pynban ki bri Jong nga ki la peit noh ïa sa ; ki thang jingiwbih ïa ki bleithaw . Ki la jynthut ha ka lynti ba ki dei Ban leit , kim shym bud shuh ïa ki lynti ba-mynshuwa ; ki ïasaid ha ki lyngki ba khlem buh dak .
translation.en: Because my people hath forgotten me , they have burned incense to vanity , and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths , to walk in paths , in a way not cast up  ;
But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body , as it hath pleased him .
translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka long , U Blei u la buh ïa ki dkhot kiba ïapher ha ka met kumba u kwah ïa ki ba kin long .
Bad kaei u ïathuh ïa phi ? u kñi u Saul u kylli .
translation.en: And Saul s uncle said , Tell me , I pray thee , what Samuel said unto you .

Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt  ; which my covenant they brake , although I was an husband unto them , saith the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Kan ym long kum ka jutang barim kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki mynba nga la shim ïa ki da la ka kti bad ïalam ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Wat la nga la long kum u tnga ïa ki , kim shym la bat ïa kata ka jutang .

translation.en: For rulers are not a terror to good works , but to the evil . Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power ? do that which is good , and thou shalt have praise of the same :
translation.kha: Naba ïa ki nongsynshar ym dei ban sheptieng da kito kiba leh ïa kaba bha , hynrei da kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew . Hato phi kwah ban long u bymsheptieng ïa u briew uba don ha ka bor ? Te to leh ïa kaei kaba bha , bad un ïaroh ïa phi ,

Me la ai ha ki ka jingkmen katba khraw , ko Trai ; me la pynlong ïa ki ban kmen . Ki shadkmen ha kaei kaba me la kuna kumba ki briew ki shadkmen ibha ki ot keiñ lane haba ki ïabynta ïa ka spah ba la ïoh brup .
translation.en: Thou hast multiplied the nation , and not increased the joy : they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest , and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil .

translation.kha: U angel u la ong jin ha sa , Ki um ïa kiba me la ïohi , ha kaba kata ka nuti ka shong , ki long ki jaitbynriew , ki paidlang , ki kyntur bynriew bad ki jait ktien .
translation.en: And he saith unto me , The waters which thou sawest , where the whore sitteth , are peoples , and multitudes , and nations , and tongues .
In all labour there is profit : but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury .
translation.kha: To trei minot bad phin pahuh ha ka jingim ; lada phi shu bunktien phin ïoh long kiba kyrduh .
Mynta kane ka dei kaei kaba de ïohsngew ïa kaba phira la ong :
translation.en: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing , and I have heard the voice of thy words , saying ,

translation.kha: U Abner u otsher shaei ki nongïalam jong ki Jeraïah , bad u ong ha ki , La slem bah ph la kwah ïa u Dabid ban long u syiem jyllang phi .
translation.en: And Abner had communication with the elders of Israel , saying , Ye sought for David in times past to be king over you :
And ye shall eat in plenty , and be satisfied , and praise the name of the  Lord  your God , that hath dealt wondrously with you : and my people shall never be ashamed .
translation.kha: Mynta phin don kyrhai ban bam , bad phin sngewhun . Phin ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la leh kiei kiei kiba phylla na ka bynta jong phi ki briew jong nga kin ym shah ñiewbeiñ shuh .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as her soul was in departing , ( for she died ) that she called his name Ben–oni : but his father called him Benjamin .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka la jan ïap , bad haba kan sa dkut mynsiem , ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Benoni , hynrei u kpa jong u , u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Benjamin .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will make thee a terror to thyself , and to all thy friends : and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies , and thine eyes shall behold it : and I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon , and he shall carry them captive into Babylon , and shall slay them with the sword .
translation.kha: U  Trai  da lade hi u la ong , ‘ Ngan pynlong ïa me ka jingshyrkhei ïa me hi bad ïa ki paralok jong me , bad men ïohi ïa ki baroh ba ki shah pynïap da ki waitlam jong ki nongshun jong ki . Ngan buh ïa baroh ki briew jong ka Judah hapoh ka bor jong u syiem ka Babilonia ; un shim katto katne ngut kum ki koidi sha ka ri jong u bad pynïap ïa kiwei pat .

translation.en: If thou return to the Almighty , thou shalt be built up , thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , phi dei ban phai sha U Blei da ka jingsngewrit bad iehnoh ïa baroh kaba sniew kaba don ha ka ïing jong phi .

translation.en: And he said unto him , I am the  Lord  that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldeans , to give thee this land to inherit it .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Nga long U  Trai  , uba la wan ïalam ïa me na ka shnong Ur kaba ha ka ri Babilonia , ban ai ha me ïa kane ka ri kum ka jong me hi .
Pule ïa ka ktien jong U lad la ka sngi .
translation.en: Study his Word each day .

To be a memorial unto the children of Israel , that no stranger , which is not of the seed of Aaron , come near to offer incense before the  Lord   ; that he be not as Korah , and as his company : as the  Lord  said to him by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Kane ka la long ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel ba uno uno u bym shym la hiarpateng na u Aaron um bit ban wan sha ka duwan ban thang jingiwbih ha khmat U  Trai  , lym kumta un shah pynjot thiaw kum u Korah bad ki nongbud jong u . Ïa kane baroh la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Eleasar da u Moses .

Lada la bam ïa ka ha ka sngi kaba lai , U Blei un ym pdiang ïa ka jingainguh lad uta u briew . Ïa kata ka jingainguh yn ym ñiew kum ka jingainguh jong u hynrei yn kheiñ ba ka erlangthari ka bymkhuid , badno ine uno uba bam ïa ka un pita hi ïa la ka pop .
translation.en: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day , it shall not be accepted , neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it : it shall be an abomination , and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity .
( Hebrews 11 :4–12 :1 ) Just as an individual may bear witness in court in behalf of an innocent person , we are determined to make known the truth about our God .
translation.kha: ( Hebru 11 :4–12 :1 ) Kumba u briew u sakhi na ka bynta jong uwei pat u baluilui ha ka ïingbishar , ngi ruh ngi la rai skhem ban ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei jong ngi .

translation.en: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the  Lord  , which was at the tabernacle of the congregation , and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it .
translation.kha: Ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ , u syiem u la mane ïa U  Trai  da kaba ai ki jingkñia ha ka duwan rnong ; u la phah pynïap shihajar tylli ki jingri bad thang tylli halor jong ka .

translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks . Then said Jeremiah unto him , The  Lord  hath not called thy name Pashur , but Magor–missabib .
translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , hadien ba u Pashhur u la pyllait ïa nga na ki kynjri , nga la ong ha u ,  U  Trai  um shym kyrteng ïa me u Pashhur . Ka kyrteng kaba u la lah ai ha me ka dei ‘ Ka Jingshyrkhei ha kylleng .’

translation.en: And Joshua said unto all the people , Behold , this stone shall be a witness unto us  ; for it hath heard all the words of the  Lord  which he spake unto us : it shall be therefore a witness unto you , lest ye deny your God .
translation.kha: U ong ha u paidbah baroh ,  Une u maw un long u sakhi ïa ngi . U la ïohsngew ïa ki ktien baroh ba U  Trai  u la kren ha ngi . Kumta un long u sakhi pyrshah ïa phi , ban da ïa phi na kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei jong phi .
U Trai , U Bela bakhuid ki Israel , uta uba saiñdur ïa ka lawei , u nguh : Phim don hok ban kylli ïa la shngain ki Kynhun jongno nga lane ngab ïathuh ïa nga kaei ba to dem ban leh !
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the Holy One of Israel , and his Maker , Ask me of things to come concerning my sons , and concerning the work of my hands command ye me .
From the south , all the land of the Canaanites , and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians , unto Aphek , to the borders of the Amorites :
translation.kha: Ka dang don ka ri ki Kanaan baroh kawei , bad ka Mearah ( kaba dei ka jong ki nong Sidon ) , haduh ka Aphek , kaba ha khappud ki Amor ;

Katba ki dang pynsngewbha ïa latai kumta , kynnoh kynsan la don ki riewlamwir na kata ka shnong ki kerkut ïa kata ka ïing , ki da tied tieng ïa ka jingkhang . Ki ong ha uta u tymmen , Shaei shabar ïa uto u briew uba rung ha ïing jong phi ! Ngin ïathiah shongkha malu u !
translation.en: Now as they were making their hearts merry , behold , the men of the city , certain sons of Belial , beset the house round about , and beat at the door , and spake to the master of the house , the old man , saying , Bring forth the man that came into thine house , that we may know him .

translation.kha: hynriew ym shym la don ha bneng lane ha khyndew lane ha ka pyrthei Kaba shapoh , uba lah ban plied ïa ka kot Kloi bad ban khmih shapoh jong ka .
translation.en: And no man in heaven , nor in earth , neither under the earth , was able to open the book , neither to look thereon .

translation.kha: thaba u Dabid u la tymmen bha , u thung ïa u Solomon u khun jong u kum u syiem halor ki Israel .
translation.en: So when David was old and full of days , he made Solomon his son king over Israel .

translation.kha: To Duwai , te , ba nga lah ban kren , kumba nga de , ha kata ka rukom ba kane long kaba shai .
translation.en: That I may make it manifest , as I ought to speak .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba saw ki ong ïa ka tnga jong u Samson , Khroh ïa u tnum jngai pha ban ïathuh ha ngi ka maw aïu kata ka jingkyntip . ïada pham haka , ngin wieh dieng ïa ka ïohnang u kpa jong pha bad ngin thang lang ïa pha hangta . Phai ruh pha la khot sngewbha ïa ngi khnang ban lutphut ïa ngi , hato kam long kumta ?
translation.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that they said unto Samson s wife , Entice thy husband , that he may declare unto us the riddle , lest we burn thee and thy father s house with fire : have ye called us to take that we have ? is it not so ?

translation.kha: kumta u leit phai pat sad u shem ïa ka ïing kaba khuid bad kaba la pynbeit ryntih .
translation.en: And when he cometh , he findeth it swept and garnished .
Whoso is wise , and will observe these things , even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the  Lord .
translation.kha: To ai ba kito kiba stad kin pyrkhat shaphang kine kiei kiei ; to kin pyrkhat shaphang ka jingieit baneh U  Trai .
Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai kiba thap ha ka khyndew ba long maw . Ki tang Shi ïohpdiang ïa ka khor , ki pdiang ïa ka da kaba kmen .
translation.en: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground  ; who , when they have heard the word , immediately receive it with gladness  ;

translation.kha: U Sakhaïos u la hiar pynteh bun u la pdang sngewbha ïa u da ka jingkyrmen kaba khraw .
translation.en: And he made haste , and came down , and received him joyfully .

translation.kha: Katba phi daiñ kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , phi don ha ka jingshongshngain , bad u briew uba stad u ïatip kumno Bad lano ban leh ïa ka .
translation.en: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing : and a wise man s heart discerneth both time and judgment .

translation.kha: Kumta ka tngaw u Samson ka leit ha khmat jong u rynsied bad ki umkhriat sad ka ong , Pdeng , phim olib satia ïa nga ! Phi isih ïa nga ! Phi buh jingkyntip ha ki paralok jong nga , hynrei phim shym ïathuh ha nga ka mudui ai ! U ong , Khmih , ngam shym paw la ïatih ha la i pa bad i mei . Baalis keiñ ngan ïathuh ha phi ?
translation.en: And Samson s wife wept before him , and said , Thou dost but hate me , and lovest me not : thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people , and hast not told it me . And he said unto her , Behold , I have not told it my father nor my mother , and shall I tell it thee ?

translation.kha: U Philip u shem ïa lap ha Ashteroth ; u la nang leit sha Kaisaria , bad ha lynti u la ïalang ïa ka Khubor Babha ha kiwei pa kawei ka shnong .
translation.en: But Philip was found at Azotus : and passing through he preached in all the cities , till he came to Caesarea .

translation.kha: Ki hukum jong me barhem ki long Ibbah lah ban shaniah ; ki briew ki pynkhamti beiñ ïa nga da ki jinglamler — A ïarap ïa nga !
translation.en: All thy commandments are faithful : they persecute me wrongfully  ; help thou me .

translation.kha: Haba ki mar khawai jong Phah ki leit bashabar ri , pha pyndap ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki hima barieh . la pynriewspah ïa ki syiem da ka spah jong ki ma jong pha .
translation.en: When thy wares went forth out of the seas , thou filledst many people  ; thou didst enrich the kings of the earth with the multitude of thy riches and of thy merchandise .

translation.kha: Kñia ki briew ki mane ruh ïa U Trai bad ki jingdih napdeng jong ki baroh ki jait briew bapher ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh ha ki jaka Mane Blei’ thala bad ban ai jingkñia ïa ki hangta .
translation.en: So they feared the  Lord  , and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places , which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places .

translation.kha: U la thaw nynkong ia ki shijur ki brisoh U Adam bad ka Im , bad u la buh ia ki sai kper Eden , bad u la hukum ia ki , ba kin Ieh khun ijuh kti , mala ban pynsyier ia ka pyrthei baroh khwai kum ka kper Jadon .
translation.en: He created the first human pair Adam and Eve , placed them in an earthly paradise called Eden , and instructed them to have children and extend their Paradise home earth wide .

translation.kha: U la thngan bad u ong ha u Jakob , Nga la thngan shaba palat , to ai kyndiah ba ngan dei ïa kato ka syrwa saw . ( Dei namar kata ba la khot ïa u , u Edom . )
translation.en: And Esau said to Jacob , Feed me , I pray thee , with that same red pottage  ; for I am faint : therefore was his name called Edom .

translation.kha: Shisyndon ki la iehnoh ïa la ki jar nabar ki la leit malu u .
translation.en: And straightway they forsook their nets , and followed him .

translation.kha: Ki khi noh ïa la ki khlieh na ka bynta jong pha bad ki kput ïa lade ha ki jaiñ khain . Ki angnud jrong ki , ki kthang sngewsyiad katsha ki dang ïam .
translation.en: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee , and gird them with sackcloth , and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing .

translation.kha: To rwai ha U Trai ïa ka jingrwai bymman ! To rwai ha U Trai , ko phin ka pyrta baroh !
translation.en: O sing unto the  Lord  a new song : sing unto the  Lord  , all the earth .
My flesh and my skin hath he made old  ; he hath broken my bones .
translation.kha: U la ieh ïa ka doh jong nga ha ka jing-lhieh bad u la pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong nga .
To kynmaw ba U Trai un ainong ïa uwei pa uwei , la u mraw ne uba laitluid , namar ka kam babha ba u trei .
translation.en: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man doeth , the same shall he receive of the Lord , whether he be bond or free .

translation.kha: Mynta phi dei ban jied ïa u briew uba stad Bad uba shemphang bad thung ïa u ba un peit ïa ka ri .
translation.en: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise , and set him over the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U Laban u ong shuh shuh , Lada phi lehbeiñ ïa ki khun kynthei jongnga sa lane lada phi shongkurim ïa kiwei pat ki kynthei , wat la ngap lah ban tip shapoh kata , to kynum ba U Blei u khmih’ ïa ngi .
translation.en: If thou shalt afflict my daughters , or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters , no man is with us  ; see , God is witness betwixt me and thee .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u ïing ha la ka jaka Syndong ka jaka shekel dara , bad ka kynhun shipai jong ki Nongshun baroh ki phet ïa-ïap da kaba lynñiar .
translation.en: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp : and all the host ran , and cried , and fled .

translation.kha: Naba ym don uno uno ruh uba hok ha khnam U Blei da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ; katei kaba ka Hukum ka leh ka long shun pynlong ïa u briew ban tip ba u la leh pah .
translation.en: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight : for by the law is the knowledge of sin .

translation.kha: Hadien tun sa theh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha uwei pa uwei : Ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi kin pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga ; ki tymmen shyieng kin don ki jingphohsniew , bad ki samla shynna jong phi kin ïohi ki jingïohipaw .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass afterward , that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh  ; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy , your old men shall dream dreams , your young men shall see visions :
And if it appear still in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ; it is a spreading plague : thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire .
translation.kha: Te , lada ka jingbthuh ka paw biang , ka mut ba ka la wan pur biang , bad u trai u dei ban thang noh ïa ka .

te phin shem ka jingkmen kiba wan na kaba shakri ïa at . Ngan Pynlong ïa phi banbeiñ ïoh burom ha kyllaiñ ka pyrthei . Bad phin lehkai ha ka ri ïa kabu nga la ai ha u kpa tymmen jong Phin , u Jakob . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la klun .
translation.en: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the  Lord   ; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth , and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father : for the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken it .

translation.kha: ka jaka jrong ki ka ïar naduh Heshbon haduh Ramath Mikhmash Bad Betonim , naduh Mahanaim haduh ka khappud Jong ka Lehab .
translation.en: And from Heshbon unto Ramath–mizpeh , and Betonim  ; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir  ;

translation.kha: dei u Jotham uba twa ïa ka kyrdoh kaba shaneng jong ka Templ , bad u la tei pynheh Shua shuh ïa ka kynjoh ka nongbah hapoh ka jaka jong ka Jerusalem ba la khot ka Oholiab .
translation.en: He built the high gate of the house of the  Lord  , and on the wall of Ophel he built much .

translation.kha: Bad baroh ki Nongïathuhlypa kiba la don ka khubor , kynrup ïa u Shelemaïah bun kito katba mih hateng jong u , ki la pynbna ruh ïa kaei kaba la jia ha Kino ki sngi .
translation.en: Yea , and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after , as many as have spoken , have likewise foretold of these days .

And they shall fill thy houses , and the houses of all thy servants , and the houses of all the Egyptians  ; which neither thy fathers , nor thy fathers  fathers have seen , since the day that they were upon the earth unto this day . And he turned himself , and went out from Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Kin dap ha ki ïingsyiem jong me , bad ha ki ïing jong ki rangbah synshar bad ki briew jong me baroh . Kin long kiba kham sniew ban ïa kano kano kaba ki kpa tymmen jong me ki la ju ïohi .’   Nangta u Moses u phai bad u mihnoh .

hynñiew U Trai u la sneng tyngeh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron . U ong Namar ba phim don ka jingngeit kaba skhem ban pynpaw ïa ka bor bakylluid jong nga ha Khmut ki paid Ishmael , phin ym ïoh ban ïalam ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ban ai ha ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron , Because ye believed me not , to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel , therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them .

translation.kha: Ngin leh ïa Kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba ngi la ong ban leh . Ngin ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ka bleithaw jong ngi , ka Syiem jongnga ka Bneng , bad ngin theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ shaw ka , wohnia ma ngi bad ki kpa tymmen jngai ngi , u syiem lad ngi bad ki nongriam Jong ngi , ki la ju leh ha ki shnong ka Judah malu ha ki surok bah ka Jerusalem . Nangta ngi don ka bam kyrhai , ngi manbha , bad ngim ju khong jingjynjar .
translation.en: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth , to burn incense unto the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , as we have done , we , and our fathers , our kings , and our princes , in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem : for then had we plenty of victuals , and were well , and saw no evil .

translation.kha: Ki Israel barabor ki la pynskuiñ ïa ki aiñ jong me bad ki kyntait baneh shahskhor ïa kaei kaba me la ong . Ngi la leh pep pyrsad ïa me , bad kumta me la wallam ha ngi ïa ki jingtim kiba la thoh ha Ka Aiñ u Moses , u shakuriaw jong me .
translation.en: Yea , all Israel have transgressed thy law , even by departing , that they might not obey thy voice  ; therefore the curse is poured upon us , and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God , because we have sinned against him .

translation.kha: ‘ Ym don mano ma ba khoit iphylla ïa ngi ,’ ki la jubab . ‘ Lada kumne , te , phiah hati khie leit sad trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ ,’ u la ong ha ki .
translation.en: They say unto him , Because no man hath hired us . He saith unto them , Go ye also into the vineyard  ; and whatsoever is right , that shall ye receive .
And the Philistines followed hard upon Saul and upon his sons  ; and the Philistines slew Jonathan , and Abinadab , and Malchi–shua , Saul s sons .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Philistia ki la kem ïa ki bad pynïap ïa ki lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Saul : u Jonathan , u Abinadab , bad u Malkhishua .

translation.en: And he said unto his disciples ,  Therefore I say unto you , Take no thought for your life , what ye shall eat  ; neither for the body , what ye shall put on .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran ,  Bad kumta nga ong ha phi ban ym khuslai shaphang ka jingbam kaba phi donkam ban im lane shaphang ki jaiñ kiba phi donkam na ka bynta ka met jong phi .
Ki Israel ha ka jingthmu U Blei
translation.en: For this cause therefore have I called for you , to see you , and to speak with you : because that for the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain .

translation.kha: U Kohath u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .
translation.en: The sons of Kohath  ; Amram , Izhar , Hebron , and Uzziel , four .
After this he went down to Capernaum , he , and his mother , and his brethren , and his disciples : and they continued there not many days .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu bad ka kmie jong u , ki para shynrang jong u , bad ki synran ki la leit sha Kapernam bad ki la sah hangta katto katne sngi .
La don shisien uwei u briew uba riewspah uba la riat ha ki jaiñ kiba remdor eh nabar uba im ha ka jingpahuh bakhraw Man la ka sngi .
translation.en: There was a certain rich man , which was clothed in purple and fine linen , and fared sumptuously every day :

translation.kha: Nga la khynñiuh ; phi la pynlong ïa nga ban throsh eh ïa ka jingieit kum u nongñiah kha ïapom u thrang ïa ka tdem .
translation.en: Let us get up early to the vineyards  ; let us see if the vine flourish , whether the tender grape appear , and the pomegranates bud forth : there will I give thee my loves .
If a man have two wives , one beloved , and another hated , and they have born him children , both the beloved and the hated  ; and if the firstborn son be hers that was hated :
translation.kha: Lada u briew u don ar ngut ki tnga bad baroh ar ki ïoh khun shynrang na u , hynrei u khun uba nyngkong um dei na ka tnga kaba u kham ieit ,
U Blei u tip ïa kiei kiei baroh ba nga leh ; u ïohi man ka sien jam ba nga jam .
translation.en: Doth not he see my ways , and count all my steps ?
And when he shewed them the entrance into the city , they smote the city with the edge of the sword  ; but they let go the man and all his family .
translation.kha: Kumta u la pyn-i ïa ki , bad ki paid Ephraim bad Manasseh ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei hapoh ka nongbah , lait tang une u briew bad ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous : but with kings are they on the throne  ; yea , he doth establish them for ever , and they are exalted .
translation.kha: U ïada ïa kito kiba hok ; u shah ïa ki ban synshar kum ki syiem bad u shah ïa ki ba kin ïoh ka jingpyndonburom junom .
U syiem Josaïah u la pynpait lyngkhot lyngkha ïa ki rishot maw , u ot lyngngeit ïa ki Dura jong ka blei Asherah , bad ïa ka bakwah ha naba ki ïeng u la tap da ki shyieng brup .
translation.en: And he brake in pieces the images , and cut down the groves , and filled their places with the bones of men .

translation.kha: Haba ka la long mynhynne , ki thlim ki sai , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïashem lang , Bad ïa U Josis la wallam ha Khmut ka dorbar .
translation.en: And as soon as it was day , the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together , and led him into their council , saying ,

translation.kha: Naba katba nga tdong ïadih lyngba ka nongbah jong phi bad khmih ïa ki jaka ha kiba phi mano , nga la lap ïa ka duwan ha kaba la thok , ‘ Ha U Blei uba ngim thop .’ Te ïa uta ïa uba phi mane , wat haba phim tip ïa u , ïa une keiñ nga pynbna mynta ha phi .
translation.en: For as I passed by , and beheld your devotions , I found an altar with this inscription , TO THE UNKNOWN GOD . Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship , him declare I unto you .

translation.kha: Uta U Nongïarap , U Mynsngi Bakhuid , ïa uba U Kpa un phah ha ka kyrteng jong nga , un hikai ïa phi ïa kiei kiei baroh bad un pynkynmaw ïa baroh kaba nga la ïathuh ha phi .
translation.en: But the Comforter , which is the Holy Ghost , whom the Father will send in my name , he shall teach you all things , and bring all things to your remembrance , whatsoever I have said unto you .

translation.kha: Ka la ïohpdiang shemphang U Jisu , kumta ka la wan ryngkat bad u paidbah nadien jong u ,
translation.en: When she had heard of Jesus , came in the press behind , and touched his garment .

translation.kha: U Judah u Long kum u sing , Haba u la pynïap ïa Uba u thmu u leit phai shat la krem ; Hangta u dem , bad u thiah . eiei naba nud Ban pynpait ïa u ?
translation.en: Judah is a lion s whelp : from the prey , my son , thou art gone up : he stooped down , he couched as a lion , and as an old lion  ; who shall rouse him up ?

translation.kha: Kumta ki la pynbam pisa ïa ki katto katne ki rangbah pun jong , Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u ba u da kriah pyrshah ïa u Moses malade marpyrshah ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Then they suborned men , which said , We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses , and against God .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u Joshua u maham tyngeh , u da ong , Ita uba ïapyrshang ban ti thymmai ïa ka nongbat Jerikho un long hapoh ka jingim jong U Trai ! uta uba seng ïa ka nongrim un ruh noh ïa la u khun nyngkong ; Uta uba tei ïa ki khyrdop un duh noh ïa la u khun khatduh !
translation.en: And Joshua adjured them at that time , saying , Cursed be the man before the  Lord  , that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho : he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn , and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it .

translation.kha: Ban pynduhbor ïa U Blei ka long ban isih ïa kaba sniew ; nga tun ïa ka jingsarong malade ka jingsngewmeng , ïa ki lynti bymman bad ki ktien lamler .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is to hate evil : pride , and arrogancy , and the evil way , and the froward mouth , do I hate .

And Joshua , and all Israel with him , took Achan the son of Zerah , and the silver , and the garment , and the wedge of gold , and his sons , and his daughters , and his oxen , and his asses , and his sheep , and his tent , and all that he had : and they brought them unto the valley of Achor .
translation.kha: U Joshua , lem bad ki paid Israel , ki shim ïa u Akhan , ka rupa , ka barandi , ka lyngkhot ksiar , lem bad ïa ki khun shynrang bad khun kynthei jong u Akhan , ki jingri jong u , ki kada jong u , bad ki langbrot jong u , ka ïingjaiñ jong u , bad kaei kaei baroh kaba u don , bad ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka Them Jingjynjar .
Ïai u ban mawpud ïa kiba la jied jngai U Blei’ ? U Blei hi da ailad u la pynbna ba ki long khlem pop!
translation.en: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God s elect ? It is God that justifieth .
And he taught daily in the temple . But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him ,
translation.kha: Man ka sngi , U Jisu u la hikai ha ka Templ . Ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki nonghikai ka Hukum , bad ki nongïalam jong ki paidbah ki la kwah ban pynïap ïa u ,

translation.en: And I was afraid , and went and hid thy talent in the earth : lo , there thou hast that is thine .
translation.kha: Nga la sheptieng , kumta nga la leit bad buhrieh ïa ka pisa jong me ha ka khyndew . Ha khmih ! Kane hangne ka long kaba dei ka jong me .’
Naba ngim lah ban leh ïa kaei kamai pyrshah ïa ka jingshisha , hynrei tang na ka bynta ka jinglah .
translation.en: For we can do nothing against the truth , but for the truth .

translation.kha: Da sumar ban ym peiñ shai ka jingbymman ; ïa ka jingshah shitom jong phi! la phiah ban pyut ïa Phin na ka .
translation.en: Take heed , regard not iniquity : for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction .
And thou shalt have joy and gladness  ; and many shall rejoice at his birth .
translation.kha: A katno men long uba shadkmen bad uba kmen , bad katno kiwei ruh kin kmen haba yn kha ïa u !

Phi la ngim ïa ka Jordan bad wan poi shai ka Jerikho . Ki rangïapom ka Jerikho ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi , kumba la kun ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Girgash , ki Hib bad ki Jebus . Hynrei nga la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor jongngi ki baroh .
translation.en: And ye went over Jordan , and came unto Jericho : and the men of Jericho fought against you , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Girgashites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites  ; and I delivered them into your hand .
I will answer thee , and thy companions with thee .
translation.kha: Ngan jubab ïa me bad ïa ki paralok jong me ruh .

translation.en: For the ships of Kittim shall come against him : therefore he shall be grieved , and return , and have indignation against the holy covenant : so shall he do  ; he shall even return , and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant .
translation.kha: Ki nong Rom kin wan ha ki liengbah bad kin pyrshah ïa u , bad un sa sheptieng .  Te un leit phai pat ha ka jingbitar shla bad un pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka niam jong ki briew jong U Blei . Un bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong kito kiba la iehnoh ïa kata ka niam .

translation.en: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him , and reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah . Bad kumta u Baasha u long u syiem ka Israel ha ka jaka u Nadab .
U Trai u ai ha u Manasseh bad u Aaron
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,

translation.kha: U Ebron u la ïoh ar ngut ki khun shynrang : ka kyr-ang jong uwei ka long u paidlang , namar daym ha ki sngi jongno u ba la pynïakhlad ïa ki briew ha ka pyrthei , bad ka kyrteng jong u para jong u bapaw ka long u Joktan .
translation.en: And unto Eber were born two sons : the name of one was Peleg  ; for in his days was the earth divided  ; and his brother s name was Joktan .
And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim , whose sister s name was Maachah  ; ) and the name of the second was Zelophehad : and Zelophehad had daughters .
translation.kha: U Makhir u pynïoh kawei ka tnga ïa u Huppim bad kawei pat ïa u Shuppim . Ka para jong u ka kyrteng ka Maakah . U khun uba ar jong u Makhir u dei u Selophehad , bad u don tang ki khun kynthei .

translation.en: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites , from Arnon even unto Jabbok , and from the wilderness even unto Jordan .
translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ka ri ki Amor baroh naduh Arnon shaphang shathie haduh Jabbok shaphang shatei , bad naduh ri shyiap shaphang mihngi haduh Jordan shaphang sepngi .

translation.en: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice , rising early in the morning , it shall be counted a curse to him .
translation.kha: Phi lah lehse ban tim ïa u paralok jong phi kat haduh ban da pynkhie ïa u dang step phyrngab da ka jingkhublei kaba jam .

translation.en: I verily thought with myself , that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth .
translation.kha: Nga hi nga la pyrkhat ba nga dei ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga lah pyrshah ïa ka jingthmu U Jisu uba na Nasareth .

translation.en: The blind receive their sight , and the lame walk , the lepers are cleansed , and the deaf hear , the dead are raised up , and the poor have the gospel preached to them .
translation.kha: kiba matlah ki lah ban ïohi , kiba dkoh ki lah ban ïaid , ïa kito kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh la pynkhuid , kiba kyllut ki ïohsngew , ïa kiba ïap la pynim pat , bad ïa ka Khubor Babha la ïalap ha kiba duk .
lane ïa ki khunswet ban shahthngan katba ïa lade nga dang bam .
translation.en: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone , and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof  ;

translation.kha: U briew uba kren ha la ka lad ka bor u pyrshang ban ïoh burom na ka bynshet ïa lade hi . Hynrei babha pud ïa ka burom jong uta Uba la phah ïa u , u longïng uba shida , bad ym don ka bymshisha ha u .
translation.en: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory : but he that seeketh his glory that sent him , the same is true , and no unrighteousness is in him .
And they , when they had testified and preached the word of the Lord , returned to Jerusalem , and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la ai ïa ka jingphla jong ki bad pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Trai , u Petros bad u Ïoannis ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem . Ha lynti ki la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha kiba bun ki shnong ha Samaria .
U Abraham bad ki rangbah synshar jong u Ishbosheth ki la leit na Mahanaim sha ka nongbud Gibeon .
translation.en: And Abner the son of Ner , and the servants of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul , went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon .

translation.kha: Haba ka la long mynsngi , ki thnum ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , nabar ki nongïoh ka Hukum ki la ïashem lang , bad ïa U Jisu la wallam ha khmat ka dorbar .
translation.en: And as soon as it was day , the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together , and led him into their council , saying ,
When I was a child , I spake as a child , I understood as a child , I thought as a child : but when I became a man , I put away childish things .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang khynnah , ka jingkren jong nga , ki jingsngew , bad ki jingpyrkhat ki long baroh kum ki jong u khynnah ; mynta ba nga la rangbah , nga iehnoh ïa ki rukom khynnah .

translation.en: ( Luke 1 :30-33 ) When Jesus was on earth , he proved that he would be a kind , just , and perfect Ruler .
translation.kha: ( Loukas 1 :30-33 ) Mynba u Jisu u don ha ka pyrthei , u la pynshisha ba un long u Nongsynshar uba sbun , uba hok bad uba janai .

Haba u Eliab u la dep kruiñ , u Ahab u la kad ïa la ki jait , u la law ïa ki bad u phong da ki jaiñ khain . Um treh bam , u thiah ha ka jaiñsem khain , bad u leit phai da kaba khuslai bad rit mynsiem .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Ahab heard those words , that he rent his clothes , and put sackcloth upon his flesh , and fasted , and lay in sackcloth , and went softly .

Also I have made a decree , that whosoever shall alter this word , let timber be pulled down from his house , and being set up , let him be hanged thereon  ; and let his house be made a dunghill for this .
translation.kha: Nga hukum ruh ba lada uno uno um kohnguh ïa kane ka hukum , dei ban sei ïa u bim dieng na ka ïing jong u , ban pynnep ha kawei ka liang , bad ban sam lyngba ïa ka met jong u . Bad ïa ka ïing jong u ban pynlong kum ka kynton ñiut .

Kumne u sing uba wan mih na ki khlur barben kiba don shi lyndum ka ohdur Jordan haduh ka jaka phlang bajyrngam , ma nga , U Tharai , ngan wan bad ngan pynlong ïa ki nong Babilonia ban phret throsh kynsan na ka nongjop jong ki . Te u nongaikam babha nga jakoid un synshar ïa ka hima . Mano ban ïanujor bad nga ? Uno uba naduh ban wan kaba ïa nga ? Uei u nongsynshar uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa nga ?
translation.en: Behold , he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong : but I will make them suddenly run away from her : and who is a chosen man , that I may appoint over her ? for who is like me ? and who will appoint me the time ? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me ?
Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people ? for they weep unto me , saying , Give us flesh , that we may eat .
translation.kha: Nangno nga lah ban pynbiang doh ïa kine ki paidbah ? Ki ud sa ud bad ki pan doh ban bam .

translation.en: And the king of Israel went out , and smote the horses and chariots , and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter .
translation.kha: U syiem Ahab , u la hiar sha madan , u la knieh ïa ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , bad u jop thiaw ïa ki nong Syria .
Balei , U Blei um shaniah wat ïa ki angel jrong u ; wat ma ki Kam long naba khuid ha khmat jngai u .
translation.en: Behold , he putteth no trust in his saints  ; yea , the heavens are not clean in his sight .

And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau  ; and they of the plain the Philistines : and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim , and the fields of Samaria : and Benjamin shall possess Gilead .
translation.kha: Ki briew na ka Judah bashathie kin ïoh ïa ka Edom ; kito kiba na ki kjat lum shaphang sepngi kin knieh ïa ka Philistia ; ki Israel kin ïoh ïa ka ri Ephraim bad Samaria ; ki briew jong ka Benjamin kin shim ïa ka Gilead .

translation.en: That your days may be multiplied , and the days of your children , in the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers to give them , as the days of heaven upon the earth .
translation.kha: Te ma phi bad ki khun ki kti jong phi phin sa ïoh shong slem ha kata ka ri katba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Phin ïaishong hangta katba ka suiñbneng ka dang neh halor ka pyrthei .
U nongrep uba jaipdeh palat ban lur ïa ki lyngkha jong u ha ka per kaba biang un ym ïoh ei ei ïa ka ban ot .
translation.en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold  ; therefore shall he beg in harvest , and have nothing .
For she hath cast down many wounded : yea , many strong men have been slain by her .
translation.kha: Naba ka la pynjot shibun ki rangbah bad ka la long ka daw jong ka jingïap kiba bun kiba ym lah ñiew shuh .

translation.en: And I said unto them , We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews , which were sold unto the heathen  ; and will ye even sell your brethren ? or shall they be sold unto us ? Then held they their peace , and found nothing to answer .
translation.kha: Katba ngi lah , ngi la ïathied pat ïa ki para Jiw ïa kiba la die sha ki nongwei . Mynta phi pynlong ïa la ki para ki hynmen jong phi ban die ïa lade ha phi , ki para Jiw jong ki !  Ki nongïalam ki la sngap jar bad kim don ei ei ban ong .
U la ïatip bad la Thep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Rehoboam u khwan jong u , u hir Syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David his father : and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: bad haba u tip ba u Mordekai u dei u Jiw , u la rai ban pynshitom ym tang ïa u Mordekai marwei . U la ei ka jingthmu ban pynïap ïa baher ki Jiw ha ka hima Persia baroh kawei .
translation.en: And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone  ; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai : wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus , even the people of Mordecai .
Saying ,  Go ye into the village over against you  ; in the which at your entering ye shall find a colt tied , whereon yet never man sat : loose him , and bring him hither .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ka shnong hangta kaba ha khmat jong phi ; haba phi rung shapoh , phin shem ïa u khun kada uba la teh ha uba ym pat ju don bashong halor jong u . To loit bad wallam ïa u shane .

translation.en: And ye have respect to him that weareth the gay clothing , and say unto him , Sit thou here in a good place  ; and say to the poor , Stand thou there , or sit here under my footstool :
translation.kha: Lada phi kham pyn-i burom ïa u briew uba riam bha bad phi ong ïa u ,  To shong ha kane ka jaka shong kaba bha tam ,  hynrei phi ong ïa u briew uba duk ,  To ïeng hangtai , lane to shong hangne ha madan hajan ki kjat jong nga ,

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his fathers had done .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh ki kpa tymmen jong u , u Jehoïakim u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
Bad mynta ine ngeit malade ngi tip ba me long uta U Bakhuid uba la wan na U Blei .
translation.en: And we believe and are sure that thou art that Christ , the Son of the living God .

translation.kha: Kaei naba U Trai u la leh ha sier ka sngi , ka la pynlong ïa ki bastad Israel ban ñiewkor ïa u Joshua u riewkhraw . Ki burom ïa u shi lynter ka jingim jong u , kumba ki la burom ïa u Moses .
translation.en: On that day the  Lord  magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel  ; and they feared him , as they feared Moses , all the days of his life .
He shall glorify me : for he shall receive of mine , and shall shew it unto you .
translation.kha: Un ai burom ïa nga , namar un shim ïa kaei ba nga ong bad ïathuh ïa ka ha phi .

translation.en: And the man , the lord of the country , said unto us , Hereby shall I know that ye are true men  ; leave one of your brethren here with me , and take food for the famine of your households , and be gone :
translation.kha: Uta u briew u jubab , ‘ Da kumne ngan tip ba phim dei ki riewshukor , uwei na phi un sah bad nga ; ieh kiwei pat kin leit kit kew sha la ki ba-ha-ïing kiba shahthngan , bad kin leit noh .
Hadien kano nga la ieh ïa uwei pat u angel uba waiñ hiar na bneng . U la don ka bor bakhraw , bad ka jingpynhiar jongu u ka la pynthaba ïa ka pyrthei baroh khawai .
translation.en: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven , having great power  ; and the earth was lightened with his glory .
For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure , as though we reached not unto you : for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Christ :
translation.kha: Bad namar ba phi don hapoh kita ki pud , ngim shym la jam palat ïa ki mynba ngi la wan sha phi , da kaba wanrah ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist .

translation.en: They are dead , they shall not live  ; they are deceased , they shall not rise : therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them , and made all their memory to perish .
translation.kha: Mynta ki la ïap noh bad kin ym im shuh ; ki sna-ïap jong ki kin ym mih , namar me la pynshitom bad pynjot ïa ki . Ym don uwei ruh u ban kynmaw shuh ïa ki .
Nangta baroh ki rangbah jyllang u Judas ki la wan phai suk sha u ha ka jaka Sher dara ha Makkedah . Ym don uwei ruh u briew ha Kata ka ri uba nongdih baneh kren pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And all the people returned to the camp to Joshua at Makkedah in peace : none moved his tongue against any of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: lane rah ïa kano kano shabar ki ïing jong ki ha ka Sabbaton . Kim dei ngab trei ha ka Sabbaton ; ki dei ban rkhie ïa ka kum ka sngi bakyntang , kumba per la hukum ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day , neither do ye any work , but hallow ye the sabbath day , as I commanded your fathers .
And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria  ; and the dogs licked up his blood  ; and they washed his armour  ; according unto the word of the  Lord  which he spake .
translation.kha: Ïa ka kali ïapom jong u la sait ha ka pung Samaria ; ha kaba ki ksew ki jliah ïa ka snam jong u , bad ki nuti ki sum ki sleh hangta , kumba U  Trai  u la ong ba kan jia .

translation.en: And the magicians of Egypt did so with their enchantments : and Pharaoh s heart was hardened , neither did he hearken unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongleh myntor jong u Pharaoh ki la leh kumjuh da ka myntor jong ki ; bad u Pharaoh u dang mutlop hi kumba u long . Kumba U  Trai  u la lah ong , u Pharaoh u la kyntait ban shahshkor ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
Ha sngap ! Ka Jingstad ka pyrta ha ki lyndet shnong bad ha ki jaka ïew ,
translation.en: Wisdom crieth without  ; she uttereth her voice in the streets :
And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father Amaziah had done  ;
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki nuksa u kpa jong u , u leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
Hadien ba ki la don klang bun sngur , u Phestos u la batai ïa ka jingsliang jingman jong u Baal ha u syiem . Dor u briew hangne ïa uba la ieh koidi da u Pheliks ;
translation.en: And when they had been there many days , Festus declared Paul s cause unto the king , saying , There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix :
Only the  Lord  give thee wisdom and understanding , and give thee charge concerning Israel , that thou mayest keep the law of the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Bad ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong me un ai ha me ka jingtip bad ka jingstad ba kumta me lah ban synshar ïa ka Israel kat kum ki Hukum jong u .
La don uwei u riewngeit ha Dorkas uba kyrteng u Adonijah . U la ïoh ka jingïohipaw , ha kaba U Trai u la ainong ha u , Ananaïah ! Hangne nga don , A Trai , u la jubab .
translation.en: And there was a certain disciple at Damascus , named Ananias  ; and to him said the Lord in a vision ,  Ananias .  And he said , Behold , I am here , Lord .
A false witness shall perish : but the man that heareth speaketh constantly .

translation.en: Remove from me the way of lying : and grant me thy law graciously .

But when the people were put forth , he went in , and took her by the hand , and the maid arose .

He that hath knowledge spareth his words : and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit .

translation.en: So they came into the land of Egypt : for they obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  : thus came they even to Tahpanhes .

translation.en: And in controversy they shall stand in judgment  ; and they shall judge it according to my judgments : and they shall keep my laws and my statutes in all mine assemblies  ; and they shall hallow my sabbaths .

translation.en: Saying , Master , Moses said , If a man die , having no children , his brother shall marry his wife , and raise up seed unto his brother .

translation.en: And Saul said , Hear now , thou son of Ahitub . And he answered , Here I am , my lord .
Only ye shall not eat the blood  ; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water .

That whosoever believeth in him should not perish , but have eternal life .
