translation.en: He said unto him ,  What is written in the law ? how readest thou ?
And the king said unto Cushi , Is the young man Absalom safe ? And Cushi answered , The enemies of my lord the king , and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt , be as that young man is .
translation.kha: Hato u samla Absalom u dang im ?  u syiem u kylli . U mraw u jubab ,  Ko Kynrad , nga sngew ba kaei kaba la jia ha u kan jin da la jia ha baroh ki nongshun jong ngi , bad ha baroh kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi .

translation.en: When thy sisters , Sodom and her daughters , shall return to their former estate , and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate , then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate .
translation.kha: Kin sa manbha pat , bad ïa pha bad ki nongrit jong pha ruh yn sa pynneh .
Ka jingshlei kaba mynsngi ka pynlong ïa ki lum malu ki them ban sheng kum ki jingkhylliap jong ka jaiñ , naba shai kum ka dak jongki ka shab ha ka ïabynta .
translation.en: It is turned as clay to the seal  ; and they stand as a garment .
And Aaron spake all the words which the  Lord  had spoken unto Moses , and did the signs in the sight of the people .
translation.kha: U Aaron u ïathuh ha ki ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba U  Trai  u la kren ha u Moses , bad nangta u Moses u leh ïa ki kambah baroh ha khmat ki paidbah .

translation.en: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah , the son of Habaziniah , and his brethren , and all his sons , and the whole house of the Rechabites  ;
translation.kha: Kumta nga la shim ïa ka kur Rekhab baroh kawei — u Jaasanaïah ( u khun jong uwei pat u Jeremaïah , uba dei u khun jong u Habassinaïah ) bad ïa baroh ki shynrang kiba shi para bad u bad ki khun shynrang jong u — bad wallam ïa ki sha ka Templ .

translation.en: Have ye not seen a vain vision , and have ye not spoken a lying divination , whereas ye say , The  Lord  saith it  ; albeit I have not spoken ?
translation.kha: Nga ong ïa ki : Kito ki jingïohipaw ba phi ïohi ki dei kiba bakla , bad ki jingïathuh lypa kiba phi thaw ki long kiba lamler . Phi ong ba ki dei ki ktien jong nga , hynrei ngam shym la kren ha phi !
U la ai kajuh ka hukum ïa uba ar , uba prie , nabar ïa kita Baroh uba khmih ïa nam ki kynhun jingri , Phin de ban ong kumne ha u Iso haba phoi ïakynduh ïa u .
translation.en: And so commanded he the second , and the third , and all that followed the droves , saying , On this manner shall ye speak unto Esau , when ye find him .
Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction : but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured .
translation.kha: Kino kino ki bym kwah ban shah hikai kin ïailong kiba kyrduh . Hynrei uno uno uba sngap ïa ka jingpynbeit u long ba la ñiewkor .
Ka tnga jong u ka ong ha u , Me sdang long hi uba ïaishah Rumah ju long , thah kam dei kumta ? Blei mem tim ïa U Bel bad ïap noh atiar ?
translation.en: Then said his wife unto him , Dost thou still retain thine integrity ? curse God , and die .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah na ka jait Benjamin ki la ïalong sa Shisien sawdong ïa u Abner sad ki la ïeng ha kliar uei u lum .
translation.en: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner , and became one troop , and stood on the top of an hill .
Whence then cometh wisdom ? and where is the place of understanding ?
translation.kha: Hangno , namarkata , ka don ka thymmei jong ka jingstad ? Hangno ngi lah ban ïoh jinghikai ban shemphang ?
Ka jingkylli kan lute ïa ka jingmane na phi , hynrei ki ktien sbun kin pynkmen ïa phoi .
translation.en: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop : but a good word maketh it glad .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u da ki ksing nabar ka jingshad . To ïaroh ïa u da ki duitara bad ki tangmuri .
translation.en: Praise him with the timbrel and dance : praise him with stringed instruments and organs .

translation.kha: haba u ïohsngew ba at lyntang , u la mareh shabar ïing , da kaba ieh ïa la ka jaiñkup hajan jong nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried , that he left his garment with me , and fled , and got him out .
Them that sin rebuke before all , that others also may fear .
translation.kha: To sneng ha khmat kiba bun ïa kito baroh kiba leh ïa ki pop , khnang ba kita kiwei ruh kin sheptieng .
Ka bleithaw u Mikah ka ïaisah hangta ha kaba ka Ïingjaiñ ba mane ïa U Blei ka dang sah ha Shiloh .
translation.en: And they set them up Micah s graven image , which he made , all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh .
And the statutes , and the ordinances , and the law , and the commandment , which he wrote for you , ye shall observe to do for evermore  ; and ye shall not fear other gods .
translation.kha: Phi dei borabor ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum kiba nga la thoh na ka bynta jong phi . Phim dei ban kohnguh ïa kiwei ki blei ,
U maw umbiah ki nongtei ki la kyndit kum u bymdondor u la ia long uba donkam eh na baroh .
translation.en: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner .

translation.kha: Wat ot ruh ïa u kew uba shu mih hi , bad wat ktieh soh na ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba phim shym la phyllad ; ka dem ka snem ba iehnoh shrah ïa ka khyndew .
translation.en: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap , neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed : for it is a year of rest unto the land .

translation.kha: Katto katne nongput ki briew na Siph ki la leit shaei u Saul ha Gibeah bad ki ainong , U Dabid u rieh ha ka ri lad ngi ha Horesh halor u Lum Hakhilah , ha ka phang Bashatei jongno ka ri khlam Judia .
translation.en: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah , saying , Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood , in the hill of Hachilah , which is on the south of Jeshimon ?

translation.kha: mala ka pyrthei baroh katai ka kwah ban wan mala sngi ïa ka jingstad ba U Blei’ u la ai ha u .
translation.en: And all the earth sought to Solomon , to hear his wisdom , which God had put in his heart .
Yea , they are greedy dogs which can never have enough , and they are shepherds that cannot understand : they all look to their own way , every one for his gain , from his quarter .
translation.kha: Ki long kum ki ksew kiba jlawnguid , ki bym ju ïoh bam kdang . Kine nongïalam ruh kim don ka jingshemphang . Uwei pa uwei na ki u leh katba u sngewbit , bad wad ïa la ka jong ka jingmyntoi .

Na kata ka ri , ki nongkit jingthymmai ki la wan arsut ïa ka Nile ha ki lieng ba la shna da ki khah . Khie noh sha ïing , ko nonglamktien basyiad ! Rah noh ïa ka khubor sha ka ri jongno phi kaba la pynïakhlad ïa ki kwah , shiah ka jaitbynriew jong phi kaba khlaiñ bad kaban dondor , shat ki bri jong phi kiba jrong bad kiba ijuh ka sniehdoh , ïa uba la sheptieng ha kylleng ka pyrthei bhor .
translation.en: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea , even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters , saying , Go , ye swift messengers , to a nation scattered and peeled , to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto  ; a nation meted out and trodden down , whose land the rivers have spoiled !

translation.kha: Lane lehse phim tip ba u briew uba pynïasoh ïa la ka met bad ka nuti u long khawai ka met bad ka ? Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shait kdar , Baroh ar kin ïalong katai ka doh .
translation.en: What ? know ye not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body ? for two , saith he , shall be one flesh .

translation.kha: Baroh kaba U blem u la thaw ka lama kaba bha ; ym dei ban kyntait ei ei , hynrei ïa kiei ktieh baroh dat ban pynong lem sad ka jingduwai sngewnguh , namar ïa ka la pynkyntang da ka ki U Blei badno ka jingduwai , kiba pynlong ïa ki ba la pdiang da U Blei .
translation.en: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka , Ko khun jong nga , ka jingngeit jyllang pha ka la pynkhiah ïa pha . Khie leit ha kaba juk .
translation.en: And he said unto her ,  Daughter , be of good comfort : thy faith hath made thee whole  ; go in peace .

translation.kha: Ka jingwan U Te U Briew kan long kum kaei kaba la jhieh ha ka por u Nob .
translation.en: But as the days of Noah were , so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .

And Moses said , This shall be , when the  Lord  shall give you in the evening flesh to eat , and in the morning bread to the full  ; for that the  Lord  heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him : and what are we ? your murmurings are not against us , but against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u la ong ,  Dei U  Trai  u ban ai ïa phi ka doh ban bam ha ka por janmiet bad kyrhai u kpu ha ka por mynstep , namar ba u la ïohsngew haduh katno phi la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa u . Haba phi khñium pyrshah ïa ngi , phi ïakhñium shisha keiñ pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
Hato u shait u khlaiñ ? u kylliang biang . U shait u khlaiñ , ki jubab . Kham , hangne ka Rakhel ka khun jong u ka wan lem bad ki kynhun langbrot jyllang u .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Is he well ? And they said , He is well : and , behold , Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep .

translation.kha: U Judas u la bret ïa ki sbai rupa ha maïan hapoh ka Tabeel malade u la mihnoh ; nangta u la leit bad u la sdien phasi ïa lade .
translation.en: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple , and departed , and went and hanged himself .

translation.kha: Uno une u bym don U Mynmiet , um ha pun ïohpdiang ïa ki jingtieng kiba wan na U Mynsiem U Blei . Kum uta u briew da shisha um sngewthuh ïa ki ; ki long ka jingbieit ha u , Namarba ïa ka dor jong ki lah ban bishar tyngka na ka nongrim kaba kynja mynsiem .
translation.en: But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God : for they are foolishness unto him : neither can he know them , because they are spiritually discerned .

translation.kha: Ki kynhun shipai ka bneng ki la bud ïa u , ki da shon halor ki kulai balieh bad ki la riam da ki jaiñ lynter balieh bad bakhuid .
translation.en: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses , clothed in fine linen , white and clean .
And this woman s child died in the night  ; because she overlaid it .
translation.kha: Te ha kawei ka miet ka la kum ban ïa la i khun bad i la ïap .

translation.en: To whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Ha U Blei long ka burom junom la junom! Amen .
Ka syiem jong ka Sheba ka la ioh ïa ka jingstad u Solomon , mala ka la ïohi ïa ka ïingsyiem ba u la tei .
translation.en: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon , and the house that he had built ,
And charged the messenger , saying , When thou hast made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king ,
translation.kha: bad u bthah ïa u nonglamktien ,  Hadien ba phi la ïathuh ha u syiem ïa baroh shaphang ka thma ,

translation.en: How much she hath glorified herself , and lived deliciously , so much torment and sorrow give her : for she saith in her heart , I sit a queen , and am no widow , and shall see no sorrow .
translation.kha: To ai ha ka , katta ka jingshitom bad ka jingsngewsih kat ka burom bad ka jingpahuh kaba ka la ai ïa lade . Naba ka ïai-ong ïa lade : ‘ Hangne nga shong , ka syiem ! Ngam long ka riewkynthei , ngan ym tip ïa ka jingsngewsih !’

translation.en: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat , saying , There cometh a great multitude against thee from beyond the sea on this side Syria  ; and , behold , they be in Hazazon–tamar , which is En–gedi .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki nonglamktien ki wan bad ki ïathuh ha u syiem Jehoshaphat :  Ka kynhun shipai babun paid na Edom ka la wan na sha shiliang ka Duriaw Baïap ban tur ïaleh ïa phi . Ki la dep knieh ïa ka Hasason Tamar .  ( Kane ka dei kawei pat ka kyrteng jong ka Engedi . )

translation.en: Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven , all whose works are truth , and his ways judgment : and those that walk in pride he is able to abase .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ma nga , u Nebukhadnessar , nga ïaroh , nga pyndon burom , bad nga ai burom ïa U Syiem jong ka Bneng . Kaei kaei baroh kaba u leh ka long kaba dei bad kaba hok , bad u lah ban pynhiar ïa uno uno uba leh sarong .
Kumta u angel u la pyndonkam ïa la ka rashi ha ka pyrthat , u la ot ïa ki swai na uta u dieng sohwaiñ , bad u la bret ïa ki sha ka jaka khñiot waiñ jong ka jingbitar shla jyllang U Blei .
translation.en: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth , and gathered the vine of the earth , and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God .
And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth , and gathered the vine of the earth , and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God .
translation.kha: Kumta u angel u la pyndonkam ïa la ka rashi ha ka pyrthei , u la ot ïa ki sohwaiñ na uta u dieng sohwaiñ , bad u la bret ïa ki sha ka jaka khñiot waiñ jong ka jingbitar shla jong U Blei .
Ki briew kiba sngewthait ki husiar ban khiar na ka sniew , hynne ki Briew kiba mutlop kim suidñiew dara ki tur ruma kat shaba lap .
translation.en: A wise man feareth , and departeth from evil : but the fool rageth , and is confident .

translation.kha: Dang step phrangsngi ha ka sngi kaba bud u Laban u la doh khublei ïa la ki khun kyiuh bad ïa la ki khun kynthei , bad u la leit phai pang shata la ïing .
translation.en: And early in the morning Laban rose up , and kissed his sons and his daughters , and blessed them : and Laban departed , and returned unto his place .

translation.kha: Ka pep ka la oh ïa ka trai , bad da ka lad jong ka hukum , ka la shukor ïa nga bad ka la pynnep ïa nga .
translation.en: For sin , taking occasion by the commandment , deceived me , and by it slew me .
And he sent Peter and John , saying ,  Go and prepare us the passover , that we may eat .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phah ïa u Petros bad ïa u Ïoannis lem bad kine ki jingbthah :  Khie leit bad pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta jong ngi ban ïabam .
im shym la ai khun ïa nga , bad nawei na ki mraw jong nga un iohpateng ïa ka shispah ka phew jong nga .
translation.en: And Abram said , Behold , to me thou hast given no seed : and , lo , one born in my house is mine heir .

translation.kha: Lada ki rangbah kiba ïashoh ki pynkynroi ïa ka kynïan kaba punkhun , mala kata ka briew ka hap khun , hynrei kam shym mong shym mynsaw da kumwei pat , uta uba pynïashong ïa ka un shah shaiñ kuna kat kumba u tnga jong kata ka briew u dawa , malu u dei baneh siew kumba la thuh pynlang ki nongbishar .
translation.en: If men strive , and hurt a woman with child , so that her fruit depart from her , and yet no mischief follow : he shall be surely punished , according as the woman s husband will lay upon him  ; and he shall pay as the judges determine .

translation.kha: hynne haba ki la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong u Philip shaneng ka khubor babha jong ka Hima U Blei bad shaphang U ijuh Khrist , la pynbaptis ïa ki , shynrang bad kynteit .
translation.en: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God , and the name of Jesus Christ , they were baptized , both men and women .

translation.kha: Lada ka long kumta , phin don ka lawei kaba phyrnai .
translation.en: For surely there is an end  ; and thine expectation shall not be cut off .

translation.kha: Wat tuh lane shukor lane lamler .
translation.en: Ye shall not steal , neither deal falsely , neither lie one to another .

translation.kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew ne ka briew ïa-ban ïathiah shongkha badno ki mrad ; kum kata ka kam khyllah ka pynlong ïa me u bymkhuid .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith : neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto : it is confusion .

translation.kha: U Abishai , uba ka kmie jong u , ka Seruïah , u ong ha u syiem , Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi shah ïa une u ksew ban tim ïa phi ? Shah ngan leit hangtai bad khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u !
translation.en: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king , Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king ? let me go over , I pray thee , and take off his head .
And Manoah said unto his wife , We shall surely die , because we have seen God .
translation.kha: U Manoah u ong ha la ka tnga ,  Ngin sa ïap shisha , namar ba ngi la ïohi ïa U Blei !
Um da donkam ïa ka jingwad bniah ban weng napoh ïa ki nongïalam bad don buaid ïa ki da kiwei pat .
translation.en: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number , and set others in their stead .
And all the people answered together , and said , All that the  Lord  hath spoken we will do . And Moses returned the words of the people unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u paidbah baroh u la jubab lang ,  Ngin leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la kren ,  bad u Moses u la leit ïathuh ïa kane ha U  Trai .

translation.en: This shall be thine of the most holy things , reserved from the fire : every oblation of theirs , every meat offering of theirs , and every sin offering of theirs , and every trespass offering of theirs , which they shall render unto me , shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons .
translation.kha: Kine harum ki long ki jong me na ki jingainguh kiba kyntang tam ïa ki bym shym la thang ha ka duwan : ki jingainguh bam , ki jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ki jingainguh namar ka jingpalat . Baroh kaba la wanrah ha nga kum ka jingainguh bakyntang ka long ka jong me bad jong ki khun shynrang jong me .
Hadien nangta , bun ki jaitbynriew nongwei kin ïaid lynti bad kin ïakylliang uwei ïa iwei pat bajai ba at , U Trai nga la leh katne kat ïa kane ka nongbah kaba khrup .
translation.en: And many nations shall pass by this city , and they shall say every man to his neighbour , Wherefore hath the  Lord  done thus unto this great city ?

translation.kha: Hangta u rangbah pynïaidkam u la shem ïa ka lieng na Laodikaïa kaba thom ban leit sha Attalia , kumta u la kyntiew ïa ngi ha ka .
translation.en: And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy  ; and he put us therein .
Jesus wept .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïam .
Mei kumta hi ka khynnah ka la leit phai khlaw kloi pud sha u syiem bad ka la dawa , Nga kwah ïa phi Ban ai mynta hangne ha ka pliang , ïa ka khlieh u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis !
translation.en: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king , and asked , saying , I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist .

translation.kha: Ïa ka khyndew dem ngab buh dor kat kum ka jingdiang jong ki snieh ha kiba kata ka khyndew ka lah ban pynmih soh suk ba-bang nang ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .
translation.en: According to the number of years after the jubilee thou shalt buy of thy neighbour , and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee :
And it came to pass , that on one of those days , as he taught the people in the temple , and preached the gospel , the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders ,
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi mynba U Jisu u don ha ka Templ , u da hikai ïa ki briew bad ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ; ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum , lem bad ki tymmen ki san , ki la wan bad ong ha u ,

translation.en: And Jesus knew their thoughts , and said unto them ,  Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation  ; and every city or house divided against itself shall not stand :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Kano kano ka ri kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan ym neh slem . Bad kano kano ka shnong lane ka longïing kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan khyllem ha ka jingpra .
Hib u Kanneh u la dap hynñiewphew snoh ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrong , u Gamaliel ,
translation.en: And Cainan lived seventy years , and begat Mahalaleel :

translation.kha: Ishmael ïa la ki byrngut , ki blem , malade ki masi , bad khie mihsnam . Duwai ruh na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu halor jong nga .
translation.en: Also take your flocks and your herds , as ye have said , and be gone  ; and bless me also .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki sa pop biang pyrshah ïa U Trai , bad u shah ba ki Philistia kin synshar ïa ki sawphew snem .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years .

translation.kha: U Trai u long uba khlaiñbor ha Seïon ; U long uba hakhlieh tam halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translation.en: The  Lord  is great in Zion  ; and he is high above all the people .
Thus cleansed I them from all strangers , and appointed the wards of the priests and the Levites , every one in his business  ;
translation.kha: Nga pynkhuid ïa ki briew na kiei kiei kiba long nongwei : nga pynkhreh ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi khnang ba uwei pa uwei un tip ïa la ka kamram ;

Ka duwan U Blei , kaba long ka Jeroham hi , kad lah khie khlieh haw ! Ka nongbet ha kaba u Dabid u la sher dala kam da khie khlieh shuh ! Ai ba sa kawei ne ar ki snam kin waiñ bad leit , shlip bad ki jingkhawai bad ki Jingkhawai mem ,
translation.en: Woe to Ariel , to Ariel , the city where David dwelt ! add ye year to year  ; let them kill sacrifices .

Ye have sown much , and bring in little  ; ye eat , but ye have not enough  ; ye drink , but ye are not filled with drink  ; ye clothe you , but there is none warm  ; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes .
translation.kha: Phi la bet shibun u kew , hynrei phi la ot tang khyndiat . Phi don ka bam ban bam , hynrei kam biang kat ban pynkdang ïa phi . Phi don ka waiñ ban dih , hynrei kam biang kat ban pynbuaid ïa phi ! Phi don ki jaiñkup , hynrei kam biang kat ban pynsyaid ïa phi . Bad u nongtrei um lah ban kamai kat ban biang ban im .

Lada uno uno u biria u bym dei na ka longsem lyngdoh khlem da poi pyrkhat u bam ïa kano kano ka jingkñia ainguh , u dei pun pynphai sha uta u lyngdoh ïa ka dor jong ka bad un ai ruh nalor kata sa shi bniat na ka sian bynta jong ka dor jong ka .
translation.en: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly , then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it , and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Ashan u la tip ba ki khun kin ym long ki jong u , kumta hajuh u ïathaw shongkha bad ka tnat u hynmen jong u , u pynhap noh ïa la u symbai sharud , khnang ba yn ym pynïoh khup ïa u Ahiman jong u .
translation.en: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his  ; and it came to pass , when he went in unto his brother s wife , that he spilled it on the ground , lest that he should give seed to his brother .
And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Moab , u Balak u khun jong u Sippor , u la ïohsngew ïa kaei ba ki Israel ki la leh ïa ki Amor , bad ïa ka jingbun paid ki Israel ,

Yn ym don uwei hajuh na ki u ban hap hikai ïa la u na ri ban tip ïa U Trai , namar baroh kin tip ïa nga , naduh uba rishot tam haduh uba khroh tam . Ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki bad Ngan ym kynroh shuh ïa ki jingbakla jong ki . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the  Lord  : for they shall all know me , from the least of them unto the greatest of them , saith the  Lord  : for I will forgive their iniquity , and I will remember their sin no more .
And I looked , and , behold , ye had sinned against the  Lord  your God , and had made you a molten calf : ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the  Lord  had commanded you .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ba phi la lyndet ïa ka hukum ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi , bad ba phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa u da kaba phi thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ka durblei ba la saiñ ha ka dur u khun masi .

Uwei u ba-shiphew Israel uba ktung u Sikhri , u la pynïap ïa u Maaseïah u khun jyllang u Syiem Ahas , ïa u Asrikam u nongpynïaidkam ha ka ïingsyiem , bad ïa u Elkanah , uba ha ka kyrdoh kaba ar ïa u syiem .
translation.en: And Zichri , a mighty man of Ephraim , slew Maaseiah the king s son , and Azrikam the governor of the house , and Elkanah that was next to the king .
Let the redeemed of the  Lord  say so , whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy  ;
translation.kha: To ïai-ong ïa kine ki ktien ha ka jingïaroh ïa U  Trai  , ma phi baroh ïa kiba u la pynim .
Shano ki don mynta , ki blei jong ka Hamath bad ka Arpakhshad ? Shaneng ki blang jong ka Sepharbaim , ka Hena , Bad ka Ibbah ? Hato don na ki kiba la pyllait im ïa ka Samaria ?
translation.en: Where are the gods of Hamath , and of Arpad ? where are the gods of Sepharvaim , Hena , and Ivah ? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand ?
And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted , he said unto Moses , There is a noise of war in the camp .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la ïohsngew ïa ki paidbah ba ki ïarisa bad u la ong ha u Moses ,  Nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kumba ïaleh thma ha ka jaka sher dara .

translation.en: Let me pass through thy land : we will not turn into the fields , or into the vineyards  ; we will not drink of the waters of the well : but we will go along by the king s high way , until we be past thy borders .
translation.kha: Shah ngin ïaid na ka ri jong phi . Ma ngi lem bad ki jingri ngin ym leit sakma na ka lynti lane leit sha ki lyngkha ne ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi ; bad ngin ym dih um na ki pukri jong phi ; ngin ïaid beit na lynti bah haduh ba ngin da lait na ka ri jong phi .
bad phna long kiba kmen lada phin kynmaw ïa ki bad Phi lah ban kren ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee  ; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips .

translation.kha: Nga noh ha phi , ki paralok jong nga , wat sheptieng ïa kito kiba pynïap ïa ka met hynrei ki bym kah hateng ban leh ïa kano kano kaba kham sniew .
translation.en: And I say unto you my friends , Be not afraid of them that kill the body , and after that have no more that they can do .

translation.kha: u haw ban ong ha u , Me long u nongkyrshan bad nongïada jong de , me long U Blei jong nga ; ha me por shniah .
translation.en: I will say of the  Lord  , He is my refuge and my fortress : my God  ; in him will I trust .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban bam ïa ka ym tang shi sngap ne ar Sngi , ne sai sngi , ne shiphew sngi , ne wat arphew sngi hati ,
translation.en: Ye shall not eat one day , nor two days , nor five days , neither ten days , nor twenty days  ;

translation.kha: Me ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ngab ïabah thma , bad ka jingap halor ki nongshun jong nga .
translation.en: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle : them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me .
And the word of the  Lord  came to Elijah the Tishbite , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa ,

translation.en: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year , in the fourth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar , that the heavens were opened , and I saw visions of God .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san jong u bnai uba saw jong ka snem kaba laiphew , ma nga , u Esekiel u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Busi , nga dang ïashong ïasah ryngkat bad ki Jiw ba la shah ringmraw harud ka wah Khebar ha Babilonia . Ka bneng ka la plie wang , bad nga la ïohi ïa U Blei ha ka jingïohipaw .
Mynta , to shim noh ïa ka pisa na u bad ai ïa ka ha uta uba la don shiphang hajar tylli ki sbai .
translation.en: Take therefore the talent from him , and give it unto him which hath ten talents .

translation.kha: Bad mynta , u lah ban ïar ïa me kiba shah pynshoi , namar ma u hi u la shah pynshoi bad shahtehmraw .
translation.en: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted , he is able to succour them that are tempted .

translation.kha: Wat ñiew ïa nga kumta ka kynther ka bymdondor ei ei . Nga duwai Kumno namar ba nga sngew kordit sat ïa lap .
translation.en: Count not thine handmaid for a daughter of Belial : for out of the abundance of my complaint and grief have I spoken hitherto .

translation.kha: U Pilat u la kruiñ biang ha u paidbah , Kaei te , phi kwah ïa nga ban leh ïa uta uba phi khot u syiem jong ki ijuh ?
translation.en: And Pilate answered and said again unto them , What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews ?

translation.kha: halor u lumbah bakynjang tam jongu ka Israel . Un sei ki tnat bad pynmong ki symbai bad kylla long u dieng khadar baïaineh eh . Ki sim kiba bun jait kin im hangta bad oh jingdiah ha ka syrngiew jong u .
translation.en: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it : and it shall bring forth boughs , and bear fruit , and be a goodly cedar : and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing  ; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell .

And this is the charge of their burden , according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation  ; the boards of the tabernacle , and the bars thereof , and the pillars thereof , and sockets thereof ,
translation.kha: Na ka jait u Merari ki mih ki longïing jong u Mahli bad u Mushi .
badno nangta u pynbang , Nga don ei ei ban kylli na phi . Kaei kata ? ka kylli .
translation.en: He said moreover , I have somewhat to say unto thee . And she said , Say on .
Art thou the first man that was born ? or wast thou made before the hills ?
translation.kha: Hato me pyrkhat ba me dei u briew uba nyngkong ba la kha napdeng u khunbynriew ? Hato me don hangta mynba U Blei u la thaw ïa ki lumbah ?

Un ieit bad kyrkhu ïa phi , ba phin nang roi kyrhai . Un kyrkhu ruh ba phin ïoh shibun ki khuid ki kti ; un kyrhuh ïa ki lyngkha jongki phi ba phin ïoh u kew , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ; bad un kyrkhu ruh ïa Phi da kaba ai ha phi sbun ki masi bad ki langbrot , ha kata ka ri ïa kaba u la kli ha ki kpa tymmen jong Phi ban ai ha phi .
translation.en: And he will love thee , and bless thee , and multiply thee : he will also bless the fruit of thy womb , and the fruit of thy land , thy corn , and thy wine , and thine oil , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep , in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee .
Woe be unto thee , O Moab ! the people of Chemosh perisheth : for thy sons are taken captives , and thy daughters captives .
translation.kha: Isynei ïa ki briew ka Moab ! Ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u Khemosh la pynjot , bad ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei la ïalam noh kum ki koidi .

Hib la sneng sympat ïa ngi , ngi ju pyrkhat ha kata ka por ïa kaei kaei kaba pynjngut ïa ngi , dara ym kaba pynkmen ïa ngi . Pynban hadien , kito kiba shah pynbeit da kita ki rukom sneng sympat ki Ïoh ot ïa ka bainong kabu ai jingsuk jong ka jingim bahok .
translation.en: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous , but grievous : nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby .
Thou answeredst them , O  Lord  our God : thou wast a God that forgavest them , though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , me la jubab ïa la ki briew ; me la pyn-i ïa ki ba me long U Blei uba map ei , wat la me pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: Then Paul took the men , and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple , to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification , until that an offering should be offered for every one of them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Paul u la ïalam ïa kita ki rangbah bad ha ka sngi kaba bud u la pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid lem bad ki . Nangta u la leit sha ka Templ bad u la pyntip katno sngi kan long haduh kaba kut ka por jong ka jingpynkhuid , haba yn ai ïa ka jingkñia na ka bynta jong ki baroh ar ngut .

translation.en: Have pity upon me , have pity upon me , O ye my friends  ; for the hand of God hath touched me .
translation.kha: Phi long ki paralok jong nga ! To isynei ïa nga ! Ka kti U Blei ka la ïaleh ïa nga .

translation.en: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former , saith the  Lord  of hosts : and in this place will I give peace , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ka Templ kaba bathymmai kan kham iphuh ban ïa kaba rim , bad hangta ngan ai ha ki briew jong nga ïa ka jingdap kyrhai bad ka jingsuk .  U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kren .

Me la bunkam ha katba thab bad kaba thaw , bad kane ka la ïalam ïa me sha ka jingleh julor bad ka pop . Te nga pynbor ïa me ban ieh ïa u lumbah bakhuid jong nga , bad u angel naba ap phira ïa me u la baher noh ïa me na ki mawlynnai batyngshaiñ .
translation.en: By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence , and thou hast sinned : therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God : and I will destroy thee , O covering cherub , from the midst of the stones of fire .

translation.kha: Dei namar kane lyngba U Jisu Khrist ba ngi ïa-ong Amen na ka bynta ka burom U Blei .
translation.en: For all the promises of God in him are yea , and in him Amen , unto the glory of God by us .

translation.kha: Baroh kiba ïohi ïa nga lane sngewkwah shaphang jong nga ki don ban ong ïa kiei kiei kiba bha kiba nga la kuna .
translation.en: When the ear heard me , then it blessed me  ; and when the eye saw me , it gave witness to me :

translation.kha: Bad to U blei , kaba longkmie ka tyllong jong ka jingïaishah bad ka jingpynshlur , un pynlah ïa Phin ban don kajuh ka jingmut hapdeng jong phoi da kambah bud ïa ka nuksa U Khrist Jisu! ,
translation.en: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus :

Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Edom , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because he did pursue his brother with the sword , and did cast off all pity , and his anger did tear perpetually , and he kept his wrath for ever :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ka Edom ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la beh krad ïa la ki hynmen ki para , ïa ki Israel bad khlem da pyn-i jingisynei ïa ki . Ka jingbitar jong ki kam don pud bad kim shah ba kin ïap .
Pyrkhat ïa ki sngi kiba mynbarim , ïa ka por ba la rupa ino , kylli na la ki kpa ban ïathuh ha ph aïu ka la jia , kylli na ki tymmen ban ïatyngkhuh ha phi ïa ka mynnor .
translation.en: Remember the days of old , consider the years of many generations : ask thy father , and he will shew thee  ; thy elders , and they will tell thee .

translation.kha: Baroh ki hynmen ki para jongngi u Job , kyntur bad shynrang , bad ki paralok barim jrong u , ki la wan jngoh ïa u bad ïabam sngewbha badno u ha ka ïing jong u . Ki la pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewsih jong ki bad ki pynshngain ïa u namar ki jingjynjar baroh ba U Trai u la wallam halor jong u . Uwei pa uwei na ki u la ai katto katne ka pisa bad ka sati ksiar .
translation.en: Then came there unto him all his brethren , and all his sisters , and all they that had been of his acquaintance before , and did eat bread with him in his house : and they bemoaned him , and comforted him over all the evil that the  Lord  had brought upon him : every man also gave him a piece of money , and every one an earring of gold .
And David did so , as the  Lord  had commanded him  ; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gezer .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , bad u la lah ban beh noh pat ïa ki Philistia naduh Geba shi lynter lynti haduh Geser .
Hynrei kin sa hap ban ai jingkheiñ ïa lade” ha U Blei , uba la kloi ba gospel ïa kba im bad ïa kiba ïapom .
translation.en: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead .
And many spread their garments in the way : and others cut down branches off the trees , and strawed them in the way .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki la siang ïa ki jaiñkup ha lynti . Katba kiwei pat ki dang ïa-ot ïa ki tnat dieng ha ki lyngkha bad ki la siang ïa ki ha ka lynti .
La ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa hajar ki kliar lum : ki Dei ki paid Israel kiba ïadem bad ïasaid , namar ba ki la im ka jingim ba-dap da ka pop bad ba ki la klet ïa U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: A voice was heard upon the high places , weeping and supplications of the children of Israel : for they have perverted their way , and they have forgotten the  Lord  their God .
Also the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: I said , I would scatter them into corners , I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men :
translation.kha: Ngan jin da la pynjot thiaw ïa ki , khnang ban ym don ba kynmaw shuh ïa ki .

translation.en: And Aaron took him Elisheba , daughter of Amminadab , sister of Nahshon , to wife  ; and she bare him Nadab , and Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar .
translation.kha: U Aaron u shongkurim ïa ka Elisheba , ka khun jong u Amminadab bad ka para jong u Nahshon . Ka la kha ïa u Nadab , u Abihu , u Eleasar , bad u Ithamar .

translation.en: The fining pot is for silver , and the furnace for gold : but the  Lord  trieth the hearts .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ksiar bad ïa ka rupa la phrang ha ka ding , bad ïa ka dohnud jong u briew la phrang da U  Trai .
Nangta u Dabid u kyrmen , myn ban pyntylli ïa nga Ladan i pa jong phi i kren-ïa dom ïa phira ?
translation.en: Then said David to Jonathan , Who shall tell me ? or what if thy father answer thee roughly ?
And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord  : and the  Lord  strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel , because they had done evil in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la leh pop biang pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Namar kane keiñ U  Trai  u la pynkhlaiñbor ïa u Eglon u syiem ka Moab ban ïa ki Israel .
Kumta ki la mihnoh ha ka jingkyrkieh na ka jingtep , da ka jingsheptieng bad pynban kiba la pyndap da ka jingman , bad ki la mareh ban ïathuh ha ki synran jong u .
translation.en: And they departed quickly from the sepulchre with fear and great joy  ; and did run to bring his disciples word .
My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook , and as the stream of brooks they pass away  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei phi , ko paralok jong nga , phi shukor ïa nga kum ki wahduid kiba ju rngad noh ha bym don slap .

translation.en: And further , by these , my son , be admonished : of making many books there is no end  ; and much study is a weariness of the flesh .
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , don sa kawei pat kaba phi hap ban ap khmih lynti . Ym don jingkut ïa ka jingthoh kot bad ka jingpule bniah shaba palat kan pynlwait ïa phi .

translation.en: But , behold , I will raise up against you a nation , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord  the God of hosts  ; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of the wilderness .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh da lade u ong ,  Ko ki paid Israel , ngan phah ïa ka kynhun shipai nongwei ban knieh ïa ka ri jong phi . Kan banbeiñ ïa phi naduh ka Khim Hamath bashaphang shatei haduh ka wahduid Arabah bashaphang shathie .

U Jakob u phai ktien , Phi tip ba ki khynnah ki sleit , nabar at dei ruh ban pynkut shemphang ki langbrot bad ki jingri kiba dang ai buiñ . Lada yn ñiah jubor ïa ki wat tang shi sngi shwa , baroh ki jingriam kin ïap lut .
translation.en: And he said unto him , My lord knoweth that the children are tender , and the flocks and herds with young are with me : and if men should overdrive them one day , all the flock will die .

translation.kha: hynrei U Trai um mon ban pynduh ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Dabid , namar u la lah pynlong ka jutang bad u dabi bad ba u la kular ba ki khuid ki kiaw jong u kin ïai bteng ban synshar .
translation.en: Howbeit the  Lord  would not destroy the house of David , because of the covenant that he had made with David , and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever .

translation.kha: len wallam ïa ka jingpyntieng kaba shyrkhei kum kan ha kano ka nongbah ha kaba uwei pa uwei uba ïawad lyngba un kyndit malu lyngngoh .
translation.en: And I will make this city desolate , and an hissing  ; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof .

translation.kha: Ko rangbah , nga ïohi ba ka jingleit jong ngi da ka lyntang nangne sha khmat tista long kaba ma ; kuna don ka jingjulor bakhraw ïa ka jingkit bad ïa ka lieng , bad ka jingduh hajuh ïa ka jingim .
translation.en: And said unto them , Sirs , I perceive that this voyage will be with hurt and much damage , not only of the lading and ship , but also of our lives .

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la pynlut katno katne por hangamei , u la mihnoh bad u la leit lyngba ka thain jong ka Galatia nabar Phrygia , da kaba pynkhlaiñ ïa ki nongpynïap baroh .
translation.en: And after he had spent some time there , he departed , and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order , strengthening all the disciples .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ïa u Moses ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynkhyllem ïa ki briew jong u da kabu phah ïa ki shiah ka jinglongmraw . U la shimet ïa ki da ka lyer bashyrkhei na shaphang mihngi .
translation.en: In measure , when it shooteth forth , thou wilt debate with it : he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind .

translation.kha: Nangta de la ong , Ko Trai Nongsynshar , nga tip ba ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ïa ki bariew ba yn ym don ka thma kane ka jingïapthngan , namar me la kulmar , ki ong , ba kan don tang ka jingsuk ha ka ri jong ngi .
translation.en: Then said I , Ah , Lord  God  ! behold , the prophets say unto them , Ye shall not see the sword , neither shall ye have famine  ; but I will give you assured peace in this place .

translation.kha: Ki dei ban sumar ïa baroh ki tiar ki tar ka Ïingjaiñ bad ban pyndep ïa ki kamram ibha ïadei bad ki Israel .
translation.en: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet , and cover the same with a covering of badgers  skins , and shall put in the staves thereof .

translation.kha: Shna ïa ka bad ïa ki jingbnoh jingsat jong ka baroh katjuh kum ka dik kaba ngan pyn-i ha me .
translation.en: According to all that I shew thee , after the pattern of the tabernacle , and the pattern of all the instruments thereof , even so shall ye make it .

translation.kha: namar kata , ko kynrad , u Judah u bteng , lada ngan leit phai sha i pa khlem u para , in tyngkan Shua ïoh ba u para um don bad at , in sa ïap . I ieit thep mynsiem ïa u , bad namar ba i la tymmen eh , ka jingleh jong ngi kan pynnep sngewsih ïa i .
translation.en: It shall come to pass , when he seeth that the lad is not with us , that he will die : and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave .

translation.kha: Balei U Blei um ai ha nga ïa kaba nga pan ? Bel um jubab ïa ka jingïabuaid jong nga ?
translation.en: Oh that I might have my request  ; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for !

translation.kha: Katba u Apollos u dang don ha Korinth , u Paul u la leit lyngba ïa ki phang kiba shapoh jong ka probins bad u la poi ha Ephesos . Hangta u la shem katto katne ngut kiba bieit ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , while Apollos was at Corinth , Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus : and finding certain disciples ,
But Martha was cumbered about much serving , and came to him , and said , Lord , dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone ? bid her therefore that she help me .
translation.kha: Ka Martha ka la khuslai halor ki kam baroh kiba ka la dei ban leh , kumta ka la wan bad ka la ong ,  Ko Trai , hato mem pyrkhat lem ba ka para jong nga ka la ieh ïa nga ban leh ïa ka kam baroh da lade hi ? To ong ïa ka ban wan bad ïarap ïa nga !

translation.en: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men  ; and Eliab s anger was kindled against David , and he said , Why camest thou down hither ? and with whom hast thou left those few sheep in the wilderness ? I know thy pride , and the naughtiness of thine heart  ; for thou art come down that thou mightest see the battle .
translation.kha: U Eliab , u hynmen rangbah u Dabid , u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u ïakren bad kita ki rangbah . U la bitar ïa u Dabid bad u ong ,  Me leh aïu hangne ? Mano ba sumar ïa kito ki langbrot ki jong me kiba don ha ka ri khlaw ? Ma me , me uba sngewstad ! Me wan tang ban peit kai ïa ka jingïaleh thma !
Nangta u Phestos , hadien ba u la ïakhun bad ki nongai jingtem jong u , u la jubab , Me la iahap sha u Patsha , kumta sha u Patsha men kitei .
translation.en: Then Festus , when he had conferred with the council , answered , Hast thou appealed unto Caesar ? unto Caesar shalt thou go .

translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingtah thang sha U Trai , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : uwei u masi lyngraw , nawei u langbrot bad hynñiew tyllep ki khunlangbrot shyieng kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano Kane ka jingduna .
translation.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the  Lord  for a sweet savour  ; one young bullock , one ram , and seven lambs of the first year  ; they shall be unto you without blemish :

translation.kha: U shem Jehosadak u pynjot ïa baroh ki bleithaw bajai kiba don ha ka ri kob dei jong ki bani Ishmael , bad katba u dang im , u dawa ba ki briew kyang shakri ïa U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jongki ki .
translation.en: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel , and made all that were present in Israel to serve , even to serve the  Lord  their God . And all his days they departed not from following the  Lord  , the God of their fathers .

translation.kha: Ha khmih ïa kaei u syiem Israel u pyrshang ban pynïap ? Ha khmih ïano u beh khongdong ! Ïa u ksew ïarap , ïa u thyllah !
translation.en: After whom is the king of Israel come out ? after whom dost thou pursue ? after a dead dog , after a flea .

translation.kha: Kane ka pynlong ïa u syiem ban sngewsih haduh katta katta , hynrei um ia baneh kyrngah ïa ka namar ki jingsmai ba u la pynlong ha khmat jong baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha .
translation.en: And the king was exceeding sorry  ; yet for his oath s sake , and for their sakes which sat with him , he would not reject her .

translation.kha: ( Ki ïabah jyllang u syiem Hiram bad ki jong u syiem Salmon kiba wan kit ksiar na Ophir , ki wan kit ruh u dieng Kseh-Juniper bad ki mawkordor .
translation.en: And the servants also of Huram , and the servants of Solomon , which brought gold from Ophir , brought algum trees and precious stones .

And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron , and said unto them , Ye take too much upon you , seeing all the congregation are holy , every one of them , and the  Lord  is among them : wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Ki la ïalumlang ha khmat u Moses bad u Aaron bad ki ong ha ki ,  Phi la leh shaba palat ! Baroh ki dkhot jong ka kynhun ki long ki jong U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u don lem bad ngi baroh . Balei te Moses me buh ïa lade uba halor jong ka kynhun jong U  Trai  ?

translation.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jedidah , the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath .
translation.kha: U Josaïah u la don phra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar laiphew wei snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jedidah , ka khun jong u Adaïah , na ka shnong na Boskath .
Ki khun nabar ki kmie ki kpa ki ïa mane lang bad ki ïoh jinghikai Kumne ban mynhyndai na ka khubor babha .—Pule Mikah 4 :1-4 .
translation.en: Children and parents worship together and learn how to benefit from the good news . —Read Micah 4 :1-4 .

translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ba u paidbah u ïa-pasiaw ïa kine kiei kiei shaphang U Ujuh , kumta ma ki bad ki ngab lyngdoh ki la phah katto katne jngut ki nongjop phira ban kem ïa u .
translation.en: The Pharisees heard that the people murmured such things concerning him  ; and the Pharisees and the chief priests sent officers to take him .
And he said unto another ,  Follow me .  But he said , Lord , suffer me first to go and bury my father .
translation.kha: U la ong ha uwei pat u briew ,  Bud ïa nga .  Hynrei uta u briew u la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , nyngkong to shah ïa nga ban leit phai pat bad ban tep ïa u kpa jong nga .
Shaphang ka jait Reuben , u Moses u ong , Ai ba ka jait Rubi kan im , wat la ka long kaba kyndiah briew .
translation.en: Let Reuben live , and not die  ; and let not his men be few .
The tabernacle , his tent , and his covering , his taches , and his boards , his bars , his pillars , and his sockets ,
translation.kha: ïa ka Ïingjaiñ , ka jingsop jong ka bad ka jingsop kaba shabar jong ka , ïa ki bnoh bad ïa ki jingker jong ka ; ïa ki diengkhap , ki rishot , bad ki thliew tnaw jong ka ;
hynriew hangno lah pun shem ïa ka jingstad ? Hangno ngi lah ban ïoh jinglehkai ba shemphang ?
translation.en: But where shall wisdom be found ? and where is the place of understanding ?

And Amaziah said to the man of God , But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel ? And the man of God answered , The  Lord  is able to give thee much more than this .
translation.kha: U Amasaïah u kylli ïa u nongïathuhlypa ,  Hynrei kumno pat shaphang ka rupa baroh kaba nga la dep siew ïa ki ?  U nongïathuhlypa u jubab ,  U  Trai  u lah ban ai pat sha me kham bun ban ïa kata !

U Aaron bad ki khun shynna jong u ki dih ban phong ïa ki man ka por ba ki leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga ne haba ki sien sha junom ka duwan ban Sikhri kum ki lynghoh ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang , khring ba kin ym shah pynpei ba ki thab bhor ïa lade . Kane ka longïng ka ngaiñ naba khong shi rta ïa u Ïaroh bad ki khun ki kyrsiew jong u .
translation.en: And they shall be upon Aaron , and upon his sons , when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation , or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place  ; that they bear not iniquity , and die : it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him .
And Elijah took the child , and brought him down out of the chamber into the house , and delivered him unto his mother : and Elijah said , See , thy son liveth .
translation.kha: U Elijah u rah biang ïa u khynnah shapoh sha ka kmie jong u bad u ong ha ka ,  Peit , u khun jong pha u la im !

translation.en: And he said ,  Therefore said I unto you , that no man can come unto me , except it were given unto him of my Father .
translation.kha: Bad u la pyndap ,  Kane hi ka dei ka daw kaba nga la ïathuh ïa phi ba ym don uba lah ban wan sha nga lymda U Kpa u pynlah ïa u ban leh kumta .

Hynrei u Samson u thiah tang haduh shiteng syndah . U khie nangta bad u bat khak ïa ka khyrdop shnong Bad u kynha syndon ïa ka — ki jingkhang , ki shawkad , u nongrah bad Baroh . U bah ïa ki ha la ka tyrpeng bad u rahah ïa ki barabor artet lynti sha kriah jong u lum uba marpyrshah ïa ka Hebron .
translation.en: And Samson lay till midnight , and arose at midnight , and took the doors of the gate of the city , and the two posts , and went away with them , bar and all , and put them upon his shoulders , and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron .

translation.kha: U Stad pynkhap u la ïapyrshang ban shem ïa ki kyndit pynsngaid , hynrei ki katei uba u thoh ki long kiba ia ban shaniah .
translation.en: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words : and that which was written was upright , even words of truth .

translation.kha: Phim shym la wallam ha nga ïa ki jingainguh thang ki khunlangbrot jong phi ; phim shym la burom ïa de da ki jingkñia jongu phi . nongbam skhem la bankhia ïa phi da kaba dawa ki jingainguh lane pynbtai ïa pa’ da kaba pan jingiwbih .
translation.en: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings  ; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices . I have not caused thee to serve with an offering , nor wearied thee with incense .

translation.kha: Ki khet plain arphew hynriew hajar ngut ki shiphang na ki nongbah jong ki ha kata ka sngi . Nalor kino , ki nongsaiñ shnong ka Gibeah ki lup hynñiewspah ngut ki rangdajied kiba la jied kyrpang kiba treikam da kadiang . Uta pa uwei na ki u tbit ngab kawang maw khlem da lait wat ha u ñiuhkhlieh .
translation.en: Among all this people there were seven hundred chosen men lefthanded  ; every one could sling stones at an hair breadth , and not miss .
For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men , who hold the truth in unrighteousness ;
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbitar U Blei la pynpaw na bneng pyrshah ïa baroh ka pop bad ka jingsniew jong ki briew kiba ki lynti basniew jong ki , ki la khang ïa ka jingtip ïa ka jingshisha .
Phi lah ban longïing uba stad , hynrei lada phi shrak ïano ïano , phi ai la kum u bieit . Lada phi shim klop , phi pynjop ïa la ka jingnang jingtem .
translation.en: Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad  ; and a gift destroyeth the heart .

translation.kha: Ha ki jait Rephan bad ki jait Gad nga ai ïa kata ka ri kaba naduh Gilead ïaheh ka wah Arnon . U pud uba shaphang shathie u longsyiem napdeng jong kata ka wah , bad u pud kaba shaphang shatei pat u long ka wah Jabbok ; kaba shi bna na tala ka pynlong ruh ïa u pud ki Armoni .
translation.en: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley , and the border even unto the river Jabbok , which is the border of the children of Ammon  ;
But I receive not testimony from man : but these things I say , that ye might be saved .
translation.kha: Kam mut ba nga dei ban da ïoh ïa ka jingphla jong u briew ; nga ong ïa kane ba khnang ba phin ïohlait im .

bad shibun ki jingjynjar kiba ishyrkhei kin wiang ngat ha ki . Hynrei ïa kane ka jingrwai yn dang ïai rwai , bad ka kan ïeng kumta ka sakhi byrsha ïa ki . Wat mynta hi , shuwa ba kun ïalam ïa ki sha kata ka ri ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki , nga ïatip aïu ki pyrkhat .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when many evils and troubles are befallen them , that this song shall testify against them as a witness  ; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed : for I know their imagination which they go about , even now , before I have brought them into the land which I sware .

translation.kha: U paralok jong nga uba don ha ka jingleit u la dang shu wan poh ha ka ïing jong nga , bad ngam shym don jingbam ei ei na ka bynta jong u !’
translation.en: For a friend of mine in his journey is come to me , and I have nothing to set before him ?
Having the glory of God : and her light was like unto a stone most precious , even like a jasper stone , clear as crystal  ;
translation.kha: bad ka da phyrnai da ka burom jong U Blei . Ka nongbah ka la phyrnai kum u mawkordor , kum u maw Jasper , kaba shai sngur bha .
Kynsan U Jisu u la ïakynduh ïa ki bad u la ong , To ka jingsuk kan long badno phi . Ki la leit sha u , bad ki la batbit ïa ki kjat jong u , bad ki la mane ïa u .
translation.en: And as they went to tell his disciples , behold , Jesus met them , saying ,  All hail .  And they came and held him by the feet , and worshipped him .
Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds , that abundance of waters may cover thee ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban pyrta hukum ïa ki lyoh bad pynlong ïa ki ban pynjhieh ïa me da u slap ?
Ko paid Ishmael , ki jingïathuhlypa jong Phin ki long ki bymmyntoi kum ki marynthing Kiba shong hapdeng ki jingjot jong ka nongbah .
translation.en: O Israel , thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts .

translation.kha: U Moses u la rahah mala u ïa ka met u Joseph , kumba u Joseph u la pynsakma ïa ki Israel . U Joseph u la haka ino , Haba U Blei u wan phlait ïa phi , phi dei ban kit noh ïa ka met jong nga na kane ka khang .
translation.en: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him : for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel , saying , God will surely visit you  ; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you .
For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning , that we should love one another .
translation.kha: Ka khubor kaba phi la ïohsngew naduh kaba mynnyngkong hi ka long kane : Ngi dei ban ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate , and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ka ri lum Edom ka ri khlaw ; bad ngan pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lynti na ka .

thaba said ka por ka poi , ong U Trai Badonbor Baroh , yn plie ïa ka umpohliew ban pynkhuid ïa ki khun ki kiaw jong u Dabid bad ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem na ka pep bad ka jingmane bleithaw jong ki .
translation.en: In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness .

translation.kha: Haba u la jingïashoh ba u baïap u ïathied najan , u la kylli , Kaei kane ?
translation.en: And hearing the multitude pass by , he asked what it meant .
And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together  ; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places .
translation.kha: Ka sahit bneng ka la jah noh kum ka kot kli ba la kli , bad ïa ki lum bad ki dewlynnong baroh la pynkynriah na ka jaka ba ki don .
U lah ban ïam ïa ka jingbang kaba la kñia ingiew ha nga , ïa ka jingbna ainguh bam kaba kyntang , bad kaba kyntang eh ;
translation.en: He shall eat the bread of his God , both of the most holy , and of the holy .

translation.kha: Ngan kren shaphang ka hok jong me baroh shi sngi , namar kito babha pyrshang ba-bang pynsmieij ïa nga ki la shahjop bad shad pynlehrain .
translation.en: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long : for they are confounded , for they are brought unto shame , that seek my hurt .

translation.kha: U syiad jong nga u thiah ha la ka jingthiah , bad ka jingsleh iwbih jong to ka la pyndap ïa ka slipar da ka jingiw ba-ieit .
translation.en: The flowers appear on the earth  ; the time of the singing of birds is come , and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land  ;
But the Comforter , which is the Holy Ghost , whom the Father will send in my name , he shall teach you all things , and bring all things to your remembrance , whatsoever I have said unto you .
translation.kha: Uta U Nongïarap , U Mynsiem Bakhuid , ïa uba U Kpa un phah ha ka kyrteng jong nga , un hikai ïa phi ïa kiei kiei baroh bad un pynkynmaw ïa baroh kaba nga la ïathuh ha phi .

Ha kawei ka snoh , la wan pa u nongwankai ha ïing jong uba riewspah . Uta u riewspah um kwah ban pynïap ïa uwei na ki jingri jong u ban khraw bam ïa uta u nongwan ; pynban , u la skhem ïa i khunlangbrot jongngi uba duk , bad u la khreh jingbam ïa u nongkhaïi .
translation.en: And there came a traveller unto the rich man , and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd , to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him  ; but took the poor man s lamb , and dressed it for the man that was come to him .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jongnga ka Edom ki la sngewshyrkhei ; ki rangbah bakhlaiñbor jong ka Moab ki sngewkyiuh ; ki briew ka Kanaan ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur jongki ki .
translation.en: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed  ; the mighty men of Moab , trembling shall take hold upon them  ; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away .
And there the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing into Italy  ; and he put us therein .
translation.kha: Hangta u rangbah pynïaidkam u la shem ïa ka lieng na Aleksandria kaba thmu ban leit sha Italy , kumta u la kyntiew ïa ngi ha ka .

translation.en: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand , Depart from me , ye cursed , into everlasting fire , prepared for the devil and his angels :
translation.kha: Nangta un ong ha kito kiba ha ka liang kadiang jong u , ‘ Khie leit noh na nga , phi kiba hapoh ka jingtim jong U Blei ! Khie leit noh sha ka ding bymjukut ïa kaba la pynkhreh na ka bynta u Ksuid bad ki angel jong u !

Akaba bun kita kba ju ai myntor ki la Wallam lang ïa ki kitab jong ki baroh bad thang ïa kita ha khmat u paidbah . Ki la kheiñlang ïa ka dor jongno ki kitab , bad ka jingkheiñ ka long kumba sanphew hajar tylli ki sbai rupa .
translation.en: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together , and burned them before all men : and they counted the price of them , and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver .
And upon her forehead was a name written , MYSTERY , BABYLON THE GREAT , THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH .
translation.kha: Ha ka shyllangmat jong ka , la thoh ïa ka kyrteng kaba don ka jingmut kaba rieh :  Ka Babilon Bakhraw , ka kmie jong ki nuti baroh bad kiba sakma baroh ha ka pyrthei .
U Jisu u la ong ha u , khih leit , u khun jongnga me un im ! Uta u briew u la ngeit ïa ki ktien U Jisu bad u la leit noh .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Go thy way  ; thy son liveth .  And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him , and he went his way .
And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath–beer , Ramath of the south . This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families .
translation.kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa baroh ki nongrit sawdong kine ki nongbah haduh ka Baalath Beer ( lane ka Ramah ) , ha ka phang bashathie . Kane ka dei ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Simeon ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year , and it shall bring forth fruit for three years .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa ka khyndew ha ka snem kaba hynriew khnang ba kan pynmih bam kyrhai na ka bynta ar snem .

wat la i'u don la u phlangïap bad ki jingbam ïa ki khi jngai im , kumjuh pajut u kpu bad ka waiñ na ka bynta ïa lade bad ïa kane ka tnga kliar jong nga bad ïa uno u shakri jong to . Ngi anna lut kat kaba ngi donkam .
translation.en: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses  ; and there is bread and wine also for me , and for thy handmaid , and for the young man which is with thy servants : there is no want of any thing .

translation.kha: U kwah ïa ailad da ka jingdum ; ki lynghoh barben , kiba dap da ka um , ki ker sawdong ïa u ;
translation.en: And he made darkness pavilions round about him , dark waters , and thick clouds of the skies .

translation.kha: Baroh uba la ïohsngew ïa sakma , ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa kaei kaba ki nongaplangbrot ki la ong .
translation.en: And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds .

translation.kha: Lada phi ïohi ba ka kada jong u ka kyllan namar ba ban ka jingkit , ïarap ban pynïeng pat ïa ka ; wat shi ïaid lait .
translation.en: If thou see the ass of him that hateth thee lying under his burden , and wouldest forbear to help him , thou shalt surely help with him .

translation.kha: Ynda ki la dep pynjyrthiaw bieit ïa u , ki la weng noh ïa ka jaiñkup bad ki la pynphong biang ïa u da ki jaiñ jong u . Nangta ki la ïalumlang ïa u shabar ban sahnarphna ïa u .
translation.en: And after that they had mocked him , they took the robe off from him , and put his own raiment on him , and led him away to crucify him .

translation.kha: Phi hap ban leit ïawad hi kat ngab phi lap , hynrei ph dei ban shna katjuh ki maw-it .
translation.en: Go ye , get you straw where ye can find it : yet not ought of your work shall be diminished .
And there were some that had indignation within themselves , and said , Why was this waste of the ointment made ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki briew kiba don hangta ki la bitar bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Kaei ka jingmyntoi ban pynlehnoh-ei ïa ka jingsleh iwbih ?

translation.en: For the pastors are become brutish , and have not sought the  Lord  : therefore they shall not prosper , and all their flocks shall be scattered .
translation.kha: Nga la jubab ,  Ki nongïalam jong ngi ki long kiba mutlop ; kim shym kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïalam . Dei kane keiñ balei ba ki shahjop , bad ki briew jong ngi ki la shah pynsakma .
Wat la phi! kam ba phi mane ïa U Trai , phim shym mut main phi ong .
translation.en: And though they say , The  Lord  liveth  ; surely they swear falsely .
And said unto me , Thou art my servant , O Israel , in whom I will be glorified .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa nga ,  Ko Israel , me long u shakri jong nga ; namar jong me , ki briew kin ïaroh ïa nga .

translation.en: And whither I go ye know , and the way ye know .
translation.kha: Phi tip ïa ka lynti kaba ïalam sha kata ka jaka shano sha ba nga leit .

Mynta saw noh sha la ïing bun bam malu dih sngewbha . Ïasam ïa ka jingbam bad ka wan bad kito ki bym thap bym biang . Mynta ka sneng ka long kaba khuid ha U Trai jong me , kumta dak sngewsih . Ka jingkmen kaba U Trai u la ai ha phi kan pynlong khlaiñ ïa phi .
translation.en: Then he said unto them , Go your way , eat the fat , and drink the sweet , and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared : for this day is holy unto our Lord : neither be ye sorry  ; for the joy of the  Lord  is your strength .

translation.kha: Ha man ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait u lyngskor ka hima Rom u la ju don ka rukom ban pyllait ïa uno uno u koidi ïa uba u paidbah u peiñ .
translation.en: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner , whom they would .

translation.kha: bad ki symbai kiba la bet ha ka khyndew Kaba bha ki ïeng na ka byndi kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka nongrah-khubor bad shemphang ïa ka : ki pynmih soh , katto katne shispah tylli , kiwei pat hynriewphew tylli , bad kiwei patan phraphew tylli .
translation.en: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word , and understandeth it  ; which also beareth fruit , and bringeth forth , some an hundredfold , some sixty , some thirty .
He will turn again , he will have compassion upon us  ; he will subdue our iniquities  ; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea .
translation.kha: Men long uba leh-isynei sa shisien pat . Men ïuh ha ki kjat ïa ki pop jong ngi bad ñiat ïa ki sha trai jong ka duriaw !

translation.en: Your riches are corrupted , and your garments are motheaten .
translation.kha: Ka spah jong phi ka la pyut noh , bad ki jaiñ jong phi ki la bam kruiñ .
Un tei ïa ka Templ na ka bynta jong at . Un long u Kynhun jong per bad ngan long u kpa jong u . Ka longïing shem jong u lai synriah ïa ka Israel junom .’
translation.en: He shall build an house for my name  ; and he shall be my son , and I will be his father  ; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever .

translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , u Naarah u syiem Ammon u la ïap , bad u Hanun , u khun jong u , u la long syiem .
translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that the king of the children of Ammon died , and Hanun his son reigned in his stead .
And I say unto you , Ask , and it shall be given you  ; seek , and ye shall find  ; knock , and it shall be opened unto you .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi : To pan , bad phin ïohpdiang ; to wad , bad phin shem ; to tied , bad ïa ka jingkhang yn plie na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And he said , Which way shall we go up ? And he answered , The way through the wilderness of Edom .
translation.kha: Na kano ka lynti ngin ïaid na ka bynta ka jingtur ïaleh ?   Ngin ïaid ïa ka lynti kaba jlan , lyngba ka ri khlaw Edom ,  u Joram u jubab .

translation.en: And the king went up into the house of the  Lord  , and all the men of Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him , and the priests , and the prophets , and all the people , both small and great : and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad baroh lang ki leit sha ka Templ , ba la synran da ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa bad baroh kiwei pat ki briew , kiba riewspah bad baduk kumjuh . Ha khmat jong ki baroh , u syiem u pule jam baroh kawei ïa ka Kitab ka Jutang kaba la shem ha ka Templ .

bad kiba la pyntong pajut ïa nga ban phai pyrshah ïa ki badno pynsakma ïa ki Sha ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki nongshun jong ki . Khatduh , ynda ki khun ki ksiew jong pa ki la pyndem rit ïa lade bad ki la shah pynshitom namarba ka pop bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong ki ,
translation.en: And that I also have walked contrary unto them , and have brought them into the land of their enemies  ; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled , and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity :

translation.kha: Lada phi banleh ïa ki brisoh kiba duk , phi ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei uba la thaw ïa ki ; hynrei ka jingpynshoi ïa ka jinglehsbun ïa kiba tuh ka long ka Kam jongki ka jingmane .
translation.en: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker : but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor .
And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses , that the skin of Moses  face shone : and Moses put the veil upon his face again , until he went in to speak with him .
translation.kha: bad ki ïohi ba ka khmat jong u ka tyngshaiñ . Kumta u buh biang ïa kata ka jaiñtapkhmat haduh ba un da leit ïakren pat bad U  Trai .
U Mahseïah u jubab , Ka suk ban pynlong ïa ka jingïohipaw ban otsher shiphew jam sha khmat ! Pynlong ïa ka ban leit shiphew jam shadien .
translation.en: And Hezekiah answered , It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees : nay , but let the shadow return backward ten degrees .
And the  Lord  said unto me , The backsliding Israel hath justified herself more than treacherous Judah .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ba wat la ka Israel ka la phai noh na u , ka la lah pynshisha ba ka long kaba kham bha ban ïa ka Judah ka bymïaineh .
Hangta phin shakri ïa ki blei dieng bad ki bleithaw mraw ïa kiba la jingaiti da ka ktieh briew , ki bym haka ïa-ban ïohi lane ban ïohsngew , ba bam lane ngab sma .
translation.en: And there ye shall serve gods , the work of men s hands , wood and stone , which neither see , nor hear , nor eat , nor smell .

translation.kha: Suk kito kba tip ba ki long kiba duk ha ka kynja mynsiem ; ka Hima ki Bneng ka long ka jong ki !
translation.en: Blessed are the poor in spirit : for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba phi dem ban khongdong ïa ki hukum baroh kiba u la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the  Lord  your God , and his testimonies , and his statutes , which he hath commanded thee .
Having abolished in his flesh the enmity , even the law of commandments contained in ordinances ; for to make in himself of twain one new man , so making peace ;
translation.kha: U la pynduh ïa ka hukum ki Jiw da la ki jong ki hukum bad ki kyndon , khnang ban ïoh pynlong ïa ki ar tylli ki jaitbynriew kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba thymmai ha u hi , ha kane ka rukom u wanrah jingsuk .

translation.en: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander ; whom I have delivered unto Satan , that they may learn not to blaspheme .
translation.kha: Napdeng kine ki long — u Hymenaïos bad u Aleksandar , ïa kiba nga la pynshitom da kaba aiti noh ïa ki sha ka bor u Soitan ; kane kan hikai ïa ki ban sangeh na kaba krenbeiñ Blei .
ha kaban ingiew tylli ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid bad kiba plung ki wan mih na —kata ka wah Bad ki sdang ban ïabam phlang .
translation.en: And , behold , there came up out of the river seven well favoured kine and fatfleshed  ; and they fed in a meadow .
