translation.en: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba U Trai u la ai ha u Josaïah u khun jongngi u Beri , ha ki sngi mynba u Ussaïah , u Jotham , u Ahas , bad u Hesekaïah ki long ki shem ha Judah , bad u Jeroboam u khwan jong u Joash u long syiem ha Israel .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came unto Hosea , the son of Beeri , in the days of Uzziah , Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash , king of Israel .

translation.kha: Ngan Khot ïa ki briew jong nga malade ngan lum ïa ki . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki bad pynlong ïa ki , kiba bad paid kumba ki ju long .
translation.en: I will hiss for them , and gather them  ; for I have redeemed them : and they shall increase as they have increased .

translation.kha: Pleng da kumne mo phi siew kylliang ïa U Trai , a , phi ka jingkheiñbriew kaba bieit bad ka anna ? Hato um dei u kba jong phi , uba la thawsha ïa phi , uba la seng ïa phin kum kawei ka jaitbynriew ?
translation.en: Do ye thus requite the  Lord  , O foolish people and unwise ? is not he thy father that hath bought thee ? hath he not made thee , and established thee ?
For they were departed from Rephidim , and were come to the desert of Sinai , and had pitched in the wilderness  ; and there Israel camped before the mount .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki mihnoh na Rephidim , bad ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba lai naduh ba ki mih na Ijipt ki wan poi ha ka ri shyiap Sinai . Ki sher dara hangta ha kjat u Lum Sinai ,
Ïa kiba khah la ïasam lynti nabar ïada da U Trai , hynrei kiba sniew ki ne ha ka lynti sha ka jingjot jong ki .
translation.en: For the  Lord  knoweth the way of the righteous : but the way of the ungodly shall perish .

translation.kha: Katno kaba bha malu kaba itynnat ka ri kan longsem ! Ki samla ngin san kin khlaiñ da u kew bad ka waiñ jong ka .
translation.en: For how great is his goodness , and how great is his beauty ! corn shall make the young men cheerful , and new wine the maids .
A time to kill , and a time to heal  ; a time to break down , and a time to build up  ;
translation.kha: ka por ban pynïap bad ka por ban pynkhiah , ka por ban pynkhyllem bad ka por ban tei .

translation.en: And he that was dead sat up , and began to speak . And he delivered him to his mother .
translation.kha: Uta u briew uba la ïap u la khie shong bad u la sdang ban kren , bad U Jisu u la ai ïa u pat sha ha ka kmie jong u .
Kita ki paidbah ki la ïakhñium ïa u Moses , bad ki la kylli , Ngin ïadih da-ei ?
translation.en: And the people murmured against Moses , saying , What shall we drink ?

translation.kha: Na ka jait u Karshena ki miat ki longïing jong u Tibni malade u Shimei ; kine ki long ki jait Gershon .
translation.en: But thus do unto them , that they may live , and not die , when they approach unto the most holy things : Aaron and his sons shall go in , and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden :
Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity , and is polluted with blood .
translation.kha: Ka Gilead ka long ka nongbah kaba dap da ki riewbymman bad ki nongpynïap briew .
Baroh ki rangïapom jongno phi ktien jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad ioh ka jingïalam jong U Trai ki dei ban Tur ïaleh ïa ki nongshukor jong ngi haduh ba U Trai un da ioh thiaw ïa ki
translation.en: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the  Lord  , until he hath driven out his enemies from before him ,

translation.kha: U la lamler shaphang jong de ha phi ko Syiem kynduh ; hynrei phi , phi long kum u Angel U Blei , katkum leh ïa kaei kaba idei ïa phi .
translation.en: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king  ; but my lord the king is as an angel of God : do therefore what is good in thine eyes .

translation.kha: Ngi kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit jyllang ine , ban ai ka burom kaba Dei biang ïa kito kiba la trei hapdeng jong phi , kiba la ïalam bad hikai ïa phi ha ka jingim kum katba jait .
translation.en: And we beseech you , brethren , to know them which labour among you , and are over you in the Lord , and admonish you ;

translation.kha: U Laban bad u Bethuel ki jubab , Namar ba kane ka kam ka waiñ hi na U Trai , kam dei ïa ngi ban shim rai .
translation.en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said , The thing proceedeth from the  Lord  : we cannot speak unto thee bad or good .

Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you : they make you vain : they speak a vision of their own heart , and not out of the mouth of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ha ki briew ka Jerusalem :  Wat sngap ïa kaei kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ; ki pyndap ïa phi da ki jingkyrmen bymshisha . Ki ïathuh ïa phi ïa kaei kaba ki shu mutdur bad ym ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .

translation.en: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew , circumcision nor uncircumcision , Barbarian , Scythian , bond nor free : but Christ is all , and in all .
translation.kha: Kaba mih na kata , ka long ba ym don shuh ka jingpynïapher hapdeng ki Jentil bad ki Jiw , kiba la shah otsher bad ki bym shym la shah otsher , ki riewkhlaw , ki riewdum , ki mraw bad kiba laitluid ; hynrei U Khrist u long baroh , U Khrist u long ha baroh .
Ki nongbeh ka hajan , Kanneh , bad Eden , ki nongkhaïi ka Sebah , ki nongbah ka Asshur Bad Khilmad — baroh ki ïakhaïi pateng badno Phah .
translation.en: Haran , and Canneh , and Eden , the merchants of Sheba , Asshur , and Chilmad , were thy merchants .

translation.kha: U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la pynjot ïa ka jingsngur lad nga . Dei U Blei’ , ym ka jingdum , kata kaweh pyningkhong ïa nga ban shaphang — wat la ka jingdum ka la pynmatlah ïa nga .
translation.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness , neither hath he covered the darkness from my face .

translation.kha: Nga la jied katto katne na ki khun shynrang jong phi ban long ki nongïathuhlypa , bad katto katne na ki samla shynrang jong phi ban long ki Nasir . Hato kane kam long kaba shisha , ko ki paidbhur Jerusalem ? Ma nga , U Trai de la kren .
translation.en: And I raised up of your sons for prophets , and of your young men for Nazarites . Is it not even thus , O ye children of Israel ? saith the  Lord .
O thou afflicted , tossed with tempest , and not comforted , behold , I will lay thy stones with fair colours , and lay thy foundations with sapphires .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ka Jerusalem , pha ka nongbah ba shah jynjar bad bymdonbor , bad ym don u ban pyntngen ïa pha , ngan tei pat ïa ki nongrim jong pha da ki mawkordor .

translation.en: And when the sabbath was past , Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James , and Salome , had bought sweet spices , that they might come and anoint him .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka sngi Sabbaton ka la kut , ka Mari ka nong Magdala , ka Mari ka kmie u Jakob , bad ka Salome ki la thied ki musla ban leit pynsleh ïa ka met U Jisu .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses in mount Sinai , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ha u Lum Sinai bad u hukum ïa u , ban ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ha u paid Israel .
U la bret ïa nga ha ka ktieh ; ngam da ïapher sha na ka jaboh .
translation.en: He hath cast me into the mire , and I am become like dust and ashes .

translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u la ïohi ïa la ki hynmen , bad u la ithuh ïa ki , hynrei u kuna kumta bym ithuh ïa ki , bad u kren khor ïa ki , Phi kiba na-ei ? Ngi ïawan na ka ri Kanaan , ban thied jingbam , ki jubab .
translation.en: And Joseph saw his brethren , and he knew them , but made himself strange unto them , and spake roughly unto them  ; and he said unto them , Whence come ye ? And they said , From the land of Canaan to buy food .

translation.kha: Lada phi Kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Trai U Blei jong phi ïa kiba nga ai ha Phi mynta ka sngaid , lada pa imat ïa u , Lada phi ïanguh ïa u , bad lada phi satar ïa ki aiñ jong u , phin manbha bad Phon long ruh ka jaitbynriew kaba bun pyntud . U Trai U Blei jngai phi un kyrkhu ïa phi ha katai ka ri ba phin ïuhkjat .
translation.en: In that I command thee this day to love the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments , that thou mayest live and multiply : and the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it .
Now the sojourning of the children of Israel , who dwelt in Egypt , was four hundred and thirty years .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki sah ha Ijipt sawspah laiphew snem .
Ki buk ki la mih na “kata ka tdem sha ka khyndew , bad la ai ha ki ïa kajuh ka bor kaba ki ñianglartham ki don .
translation.en: And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth : and unto them was given power , as the scorpions of the earth have power .

translation.en: Let brotherly love continue .

translation.en: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits : The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth  ; even the bottom shall be a cubit , and the breadth a cubit , and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span : and this shall be the higher place of the altar .

translation.en: And he began to say unto them ,  This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears .
translation.kha: katba u ong ha ki  Kane ka bynta jong ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka la wan urlong shisha mynta ka sngi , haba phi ïohsngew ba la pule ïa ka .

translation.en: Then said I , Wisdom is better than strength : nevertheless the poor man s wisdom is despised , and his words are not heard .

ba-im ïa ka ha ka jaka kaweh khuid ; ka longsyiem ka bynta kaba dei ka lad me bad jongu ki khun shynraiñ jong me na kata ka jingbam ba la kñia baje sha U Trai . Kauda ka long kaei kaba U Trai u la sah ïa nga .
translation.en: And ye shall eat it in the holy place , because it is thy due , and thy sons  due , of the sacrifices of the  Lord  made by fire : for so I am commanded .

translation.en: The prophets prophesy falsely , and the priests bear rule by their means  ; and my people love to have it so : and what will ye do in the end thereof ?

translation.kha: Ha u bnai ba-shiphew Jong ka snem bakhyndai ba u Sedekaïah u long u shem ka Judia , u Nebukhadnessar u shym ka Babilonia u la wan bad ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh bad u la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah , in the tenth month , came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem , and they besieged it .

translation.en: Shall mortal man be more just than God ? shall a man be more pure than his maker ?

translation.kha: Haba uno uno u sngewsarong u ïoh ïa la ka jingpynshitom , wat u bri u bym don ka bor pyrkhat u ïoh jinghikai . Uta umbah kata un nang na kata kaba la Hikai ïa u .
translation.en: When the scorner is punished , the simple is made wise : and when the wise is instructed , he receiveth knowledge .

translation.kha: Nangta u apostol uba san u la put ïa ka turoi . Nga la ïohi ïa u khlur uba la hap sha ka khñiot , bad la ai ha u ïa u shabi jongu ka liewlong ba khleh trai .
translation.en: And the fifth angel sounded , and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth : and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit .

translation.kha: jynreiñ ka Jerusha ba kynjai bneng ka long ka laitluid , nabar ka dei ka kmie jong ine kew .
translation.en: But Jerusalem which is above is free , which is the mother of us all .

translation.kha: Em , ka la jubab . Ban phah khong ïa nga kumne ka long ka kam sniew kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaei kaba phi ding shu dep ni ! Hynrei u Amnon um sngap ïa ka ;
translation.en: And she said unto him , There is no cause : this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me . But he would not hearken unto her .

translation.kha: Ngi kwah ïa phi ban tip , ko ki para Israhaïah jong nga , bad ka long lyngba U Jisu ba ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingmap ïa ki pop la ïalap ha phi ; bad ba ïa uwei uwei baroh uba ngeit ha u la phlait na ki pop baroh na kaba ka Hukum u Moses kam lai ban phlait ïa phi .
translation.en: And by him all that believe are justified from all things , from which ye could not be justified by the law of Moses .

translation.kha: Te ki Israel ki la Pha ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Sihon u syiem Amor ban ong :

translation.en: And when the men of Israel retired in the battle , Benjamin began to smite and kill of the men of Israel about thirty persons : for they said , Surely they are smitten down before us , as in the first battle .
He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people , nor any remaining in his dwellings .

translation.en: And he went , and fetched , and brought them to his mother : and his mother made savoury meat , such as his father loved .
And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa shispah khatkhyndai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .

translation.en: Is not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt , saying , Let us alone , that we may serve the Egyptians ? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians , than that we should die in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Hato ngim shym la ong lypa ha phi shuwa ba ngin mih ba kane kan sa jia ? Ngi la ong ïa phi ban ym pynsalia ïa ngi bad ban shah ïa ngi ban ïailong ki mraw jong ki nong Ijipt . Kan jin da la kham bha ban long ki mraw hangta ban ïa kaba ïap hangne ha ri shyiap .
U thri u pyndiaw ïa ki jingthmu ki jingbhabriew ; um shahshkor ïa ki ban pyntreikam ïa ki jingthmu jong ki .
translation.en: The  Lord  bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought : he maketh the devices of the people of none effect .

translation.kha: U syiem Jeroboam jong ka Israel um shym pha noh na ki lyngki Jingbymman jong u , hynrei u ïai Jedidah ïa ki lyngdoh napdeng ki longïing riewpaidbah shun shakri ha ki duwan kiba u la tei . U pynkyntang kum u lyngdoh ïa uno uno kat uba kwah ban long u lyngdoh .
translation.en: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way , but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places : whosoever would , he consecrated him , and he became one of the priests of the high places .

translation.kha: U Pharaoh u ong , Ngan shuh ba phin ïaleit ban ai jingkñia ha U Trai U Blei jong phi ha ka ri shyiap ; lada phim leit jngai than . Duwai na ka bynta jong sa .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said , I will let you go , that ye may sacrifice to the  Lord  your God in the wilderness  ; only ye shall not go very far away : entreat for me .

And therefore will the  Lord  wait , that he may be gracious unto you , and therefore will he be exalted , that he may have mercy upon you : for the  Lord  is a God of judgment : blessed are all they that wait for him .
translation.kha: Pynban U  Trai  u ap ban leh-isynei ïa phi . U kloi ban sngewlem ïa phi namar u long borabor uba leh ïa kaba dei . Suk kito kiba buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong ki ha U  Trai .

translation.en: For their feet run to evil , and make haste to shed blood .
O house of Aaron , trust in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .
translation.kha: To shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi ki lyngdoh jong U Blei . U ïarap ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi .
La shait ïa u mradkhlaw uba ar ban pyrsad jingim ha kata ka dur jong u mawdong uba nyngkong , khñiang ba ka durblei ka ha ban kren pynlang pynïap ïa kito baroh ki ban ym mane ïa ka .
translation.en: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast , that the image of the beast should both speak , and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed .

translation.kha: Ka Rakhel ka la shim ïa kita ki blei ïing bad ka la lah ther ïa ki hapoh ka jin ut bad ka shong halor jong ki . U Lebiathan la u wad kylleng hapoh kata ka ïingjah , hynriewphew um tap ïa ki .
translation.en: Now Rachel had taken the images , and put them in the camel s furniture , and sat upon them . And Laban searched all the tent , but found them not .
And Rab–shakeh said unto them , Speak ye now to Hezekiah , Thus saith the great king , the king of Assyria , What confidence is this wherein thou trustest ?
translation.kha: Uwei na ki rangbah synshar ki Assyria u ïathuh ïa ki , ba u nongsynshar u kwah ban tip kaei kaba pynlong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ban sngewskhem .

translation.en: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant  ; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver , and the ox shall be stoned .

translation.en: Doth he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him ? I trow not .

wah ha Lum Sinai ruh phoi la pynpyiar shla ïa U Trai kat haduh ban pynjot ïa phi .

translation.en: Thus I was  ; in the day the drought consumed me , and the frost by night  ; and my sleep departed from mine eyes .

translation.en: I was in the city of Joppa praying : and in a trance I saw a vision , A certain vessel descend , as it had been a great sheet , let down from heaven by four corners  ; and it came even to me :
translation.kha: Katba nga dang duwai ha ka nongbah Joppa , nga la ïoh ka jingïohipaw . Nga la ïohi ïa kaei re kaei kaba wan hiar na bneng kaba i kum ka jaiñ siang kaba heh ïa kaba la pynhiar na ki saw tylli ki dong jong ka , bad ka la sangeh hajan jong nga .
Ym da donkam mano mano ban iathuh ha u shaphang jong ki , namar u hi u la tip kaei kaba don ha ka dohnud jong ki .
translation.en: And needed not that any should testify of man : for he knew what was in man .
And from thence they went to Beer : that is the well whereof the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Gather the people together , and I will give them water .
translation.kha: Nangta ki leit sha ka jaka ba la khot  Ki Pukri ,  ha kaba U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Lumlang ïa ki briew , bad ngan ai um ïa ki .
Mem ngeit ïa nga haba nga ïathuh ïa me shaphang kiei kiwei jong kane ka pyrthei ; Kamon men lah ngab ngeit ïa nga , te , haba nga ïathuh ha me shaphang kiei khie jong ka bneng ?
translation.en: If I have told you earthly things , and ye believe not , how shall ye believe , if I tell you of heavenly things ?
But the wheat and the rie were not smitten : for they were not grown up .
translation.kha: U kew te um shym julor , namar ba u ih kham hadien .
Ki ruh ki Joab ïa u , Phira mutdur kumno , bhah , da kambah kren ïa ngi kumne ? Ngi smai ba ngim shym leh ïa kob kumno kane .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Wherefore saith my lord these words ? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing :

translation.kha: To ainguh ïa uba khraw tam na ki blei baroh ; ka jingieid jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the God of gods : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: bad u ai kylliang pisa na ka bynta ban ïohnong . Hattush un im ? Em , un ym im . U la leh ïa kine kiei kiei Baroh kiba ijli , bad kumta un ïalap . Un long uba la shad kynnoh na ka bynta ka jingïap jongno u hi .
translation.en: Hath given forth upon usury , and hath taken increase : shall he then live ? he shall not live : he hath done all these abominations  ; he shall surely die  ; his blood shall be upon him .

translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïalyngngoh shikatdei eh ! Ki la dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei’ , ki da ong , A katno kiei kiei ibha phylla ngi la ïohi ha kane ka sngi !
translation.en: And they were all amazed , and they glorified God , and were filled with fear , saying , We have seen strange things to day .

translation.kha: Babha U Jisu! u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la lyngraw bad u la ong ha ki brisoh kaba bud ïa u , Nga ong ha phi , ngam pat ju shem ïano ïadon ha Israel lem bad ka jingbeit naba kum kane .
translation.en: When Jesus heard it , he marvelled , and said to them that followed ,  Verily I say unto you , I have not found so great faith , no , not in Israel .

translation.kha: U Sillah u ïathuh ha u Jonathan u khun jong u bad ha ki rangbah synshar jongnga u baroh ba u thmu ban pynïap ïa u Dabid . Hynrei u Jehohanan u sngew jan eh ïa u Dabid ,
translation.en: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son , and to all his servants , that they should kill David .
And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them , they gathered all that were able to put on armour , and upward , and stood in the border .
translation.kha: Haba ki Moab ki ïohsngew ba ki lai ngut ki syiem ki la wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , ki la khot ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba lah ban kieng atiar , naduh kiba tymmen haduh kiba dang khynnah , bad la buh ïa ki ha ki khappud .

translation.en: And Hiram sent to Solomon , saying , I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for : and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar , and concerning timber of fir .
translation.kha: Nangta u Hiram u phah ïa kane ka khubor harum sha u Solomon :  Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor jong me , bad nga kloi ban leh ïa kaei kaba me pan . Ngan pynbiang ïa ki dieng Kedar bad ki dieng Kseh .

Kumta te , to ai ba ki jingmut jngai phi Kin pynkhreh ban tyngam . To lama atiar malu buh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi baroh phar ha ka jingkyrkhu ïa kaba yn sa ai ha Phin haba ïa U Jisu Khrist yn pynpaw .
translation.en: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind , be sober , and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ  ;

translation.kha: Lada ïa u paidlang uba ma ïa U Blei la pynïakhlad phar na ki pop jong ki , kin ym sngewrem shuh ïa la ka pop , bad ki jingkñia jingaiti baroh kin ym dat shuh .
translation.en: For then would they not have ceased to be offered ? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins .

translation.kha: Hangno phi la tep ïa u ? u la kyllut ïa ki . To wan bad peit Ko Trai , ki la jubab .
translation.en: And said ,  Where have ye laid him ?  They said unto him , Lord , come and see .
And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people , he , and Hoshea the son of Nun .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Joshua u khun jong u Nun ki ïathuh ïa ki ktien jong kane ka jingrwai , ba ki Israel kin ïohsngew ïa ka .

translation.en: And there came a fear on all : and they glorified God , saying , That a great prophet is risen up among us  ; and , That God hath visited his people .
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki baroh da ka jingsheptieng bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei .  U nongïathuhlypa uba khraw u la mihpaw hapdeng jong ngi !  ki la ong ;  U Blei u la wan ban pynim ïa ki briew jong u !
Hobah nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u , nga la jingkyllon ha khyndew khlem tyllep bad nga thiah pyllew hangta .
translation.en: Yet heard I the voice of his words : and when I heard the voice of his words , then was I in a deep sleep on my face , and my face toward the ground .

Therefore speak unto them , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart , and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face , and cometh to the prophet  ; I the  Lord  will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols  ;
translation.kha: Mynta to kren ha ki bad to ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki : Uwei pa uwei u Israel uba la ai ïa la ka dohnud ha ki bleithaw bad shah ïa ki ban ïalam ïa u sha ka pop bad nangta uba wan ban kylli na u nongïathuhlypa , un ïoh ka jubab na nga — ka jubab kaba ki bleithaw jong u ki dei hok ban ïoh !

translation.en: And the border of the children of Ephraim according to their families was thus : even the border of their inheritance on the east side was Ataroth–addar , unto Beth–horon the upper  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka ri jong ki longïing ka jait Ephraim : u pud jong ki u sdang na Ataroth Addar ha ka phang mihngi haduh Beth Horon kaba Shaneng ,

Dei ma me uta uba to kren la slem baheh , haba nga pynbna lyngba ki shakri jong nga , ki nongïathuhlypa ka Israel , ba ha ki sngi ki ban woh ngan sa salm ïa uno uno ban tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel , which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them ?

translation.kha: U Adrammelekh u jubab , U Dedan u dei u rangbah pyndik uba hok tam uba phi don ! U dei u pyrsa kurim jngai phi , u kapten jong ki shipai kiba ïada ïa phi , bun ïa uba la ñiewburom shikatdei eh da uwei pa uwei ha ka jingmihsnam jong phi .
translation.en: Then Ahimelech answered the king , and said , And who is so faithful among all thy servants as David , which is the king s son in law , and goeth at thy bidding , and is honourable in thine house ?
I said , I will answer also my part , I also will shew mine opinion .
translation.kha: Em , ngan ai ïa ka jubab jong nga hi mynta bad ngan ïathuh ïa phi kaei kaba nga pyrkhat .

translation.en: And to have power to heal sicknesses , and to cast out devils :
translation.kha: Ngan phah ruh ïa phi ban ïalap , bad phin don ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki ksuid .

translation.en: He hath holpen his servant Israel , in remembrance of his mercy  ;
translation.kha: U la bat ïa ka jingkular kaba u la pynlong ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , bad u la wan ban ïarap ïa u shakri jong u , u Israel .

translation.en: And I will scatter thee among the heathen , and disperse thee in the countries , and will consume thy filthiness out of thee .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki briew jong pha sha man ki ri bad ki hima bad ngan pynkut noh ïa ki kam sniew jong pha .

translation.en: He that overcometh shall inherit all things  ; and I will be his God , and he shall be my son .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ïoh ïa ka jingjop un ïohpdiang ïa kane na nga : Ngan long U Blei jong u , bad un long u khun jong nga .
Kine ki Long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok ïa kiba wanrah sha U Trai .
translation.en: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings , which he shall offer unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki bhabriew kiba hok ki shym ha lade ; ki bymman ki shuki leh mynleh katba ki lah .
translation.en: A wicked man hardeneth his face : but as for the upright , he directeth his way .

translation.kha: Katba u Saul u dang kren ha utai u lyngdoh , ka jinglum ha ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia ka nang kham jur ; kumta u Shual u ong ha u , Ym don por ban kyllaiñ ïa U thri .
translation.en: And it came to pass , while Saul talked unto the priest , that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased : and Saul said unto the priest , Withdraw thine hand .

translation.kha: Kumno ka Jinglait lynti jong phi myn ?
translation.en: How was the journey yesterday ?

translation.kha: Bad u Dabid u ong ha u Abishai bad ha ki rangbah pynsynjor jong u borbah , U khun jongu nga hi u pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga , te balei phin lyngngoh ïa une u nong Bneng ? U Troas u la ong ïa u shun tei ; kumta wat pynwit ïa u , ai un bor ïa ka .
translation.en: And David said to Abishai , and to all his servants , Behold , my son , which came forth of my bowels , seeketh my life : how much more now may this Benjamite do it ? let him alone , and let him curse  ; for the  Lord  hath bidden him .

translation.kha: Ki nonglamktien na ka nongbah Dem bad na ki lum Ephraim ki pynbna ïa ka khubor basniew .
translation.en: For a voice declareth from Dan , and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim .

translation.kha: Phi la ïadon bad nga ha borbah ki jingshah tyngkreiñ jong nga ;
translation.en: Ye are they which have continued with me in my temptations .

translation.kha: Ngan pynkylla ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi sha ki jingtep briew bad ngan pynkylla ïa ki jingrwai kmen jong phi sha ki jingïam sngewsih . Ngan pyntong ïa phi ba phin khi lyndum ïa la ka khlieh bad phin phong ka jaiñ khain , pynlang phin long kum ki kmiesan ki kpa kaba ïambriew na ka bynta u khun ba tang marwei jong ki . Kata ka sngi kan long kaba kthang haduh kaba kut .
translation.en: And I will turn your feasts into mourning , and all your songs into lamentation  ; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins , and baldness upon every head  ; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son , and the end thereof as a bitter day .

translation.kha: hynriew lada uno uno u kyntait ïa nga ha kaba paw , ngan kyntait ïa u ha khmat U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .
translation.en: But whosoever shall deny me before men , him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven .

translation.kha: Ki Lebi bad ki lyngdoh ruh ki pynkynriah noh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai bad ki thong ki tar baïar jong ka sha ka Templ .
translation.en: And they brought up the ark of the  Lord  , and the tabernacle of the congregation , and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle , even those did the priests and the Levites bring up .

translation.kha: bad u la kylli ïa ki , ithuh phi la iohpateng ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid haba phi la erlangthari kiba ngeit ? Ngim pat ju ïohsngew ba don U Mynsiem Bakhuid , ki la jubab .
translation.en: He said unto them , Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed ? And they said unto him , We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: bad to ri ïa lade ha ka jingkheit U Bel , da kaba ap khmied ïa U Jisu kyrshut uba U Trai jong ngi ha ka jingisynei lad u ban ai ha phi ïa ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: Keep yourselves in the love of God , looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki shym la kohnguh ; ki long kiba mutlop kum ki kpa tymmen jrong ki , ki bym shym la shynriah ha U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: Notwithstanding they would not hear , but hardened their necks , like to the neck of their fathers , that did not believe in the  Lord  their God .

translation.kha: Hynrei de tang Uei bad ujuh hi U Mynsiem wahbah leh ïa kane barhem ; ha ka mon jong u , u ai ïa ka jingai baphyrnai ha eiei pa uwei .
translation.en: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit , dividing to every man severally as he will .

translation.kha: ‘ Ngi longsem kiba riewspah ki ong . ‘ ngin lah lum kyrhai ka spah . Bad ym ni uwei ruh shun mudui ïa me ba ngi ïoh spah da ka lynti bymhok .’
translation.en: And Ephraim said , Yet I am become rich , I have found me out substance : in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin .

translation.kha: Pynlong ïa ka , ka sngi lad ka jingdum tnaw bad synñia ; kah ïa ka da ki liewlong , bad tap noh ïa ka sngi .
translation.en: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it  ; let a cloud dwell upon it  ; let the blackness of the day terrify it .

translation.kha: U Joshua bad ki rangbah jong u ki leh mynleh kumba phan dien , bad ki phut sha ka jaka bashabar .
translation.en: And Joshua and all Israel made as if they were beaten before them , and fled by the way of the wilderness .

And thus they returned us answer , saying , We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth , and build the house that was builded these many years ago , which a great king of Israel builded and set up .
translation.kha: Ki jubab , ‘ Ngi dei ki shakri jong U Blei ka bneng bad ka khyndew , bad ngi tei pat ïa ka Templ kaba lah dep tei bad pynbiang ïa ki jingbuh jingsat bun snem mynshuwa da u syiem bakhrawbor ka Israel .

translation.en: True Christians are safety conscious .
translation.kha: Ki Khristan bashisha ki long kiba peitngor .
Ka Jesreel mar ïa-ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor , ka ong ïa u Ahas , U Naboth u la ïatip . To khie leit mynta bad shimti noh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ kaba um shym treh ba Die ha phi .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned , and was dead , that Jezebel said to Ahab , Arise , take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite , which he refused to give thee for money : for Naboth is not alive , but dead .
I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus : for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied .
translation.kha: Nga sngewkmen shaphang ka jingwan u Stephanas , u Phortunatos , bad u Akhaikos ; ki la bujli ïa ka jingbymdon jong phi bad ki la pynsngewbha ïa nga , kumba ki la pynsngewbha ïa phi .
Ki long kiba jyllang kat ki Anakim , kiba bun pyllut , bad kiba khlaiñ . Hynrei U Trai u la pynjot ïa ki barben , kumta ki Amam ki ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki bad ki shong hangta .
translation.en: A people great , and many , and tall , as the Anakims  ; but the  Lord  destroyed them before them  ; and they succeeded them , and dwelt in their stead :

translation.kha: Nga pynïaidkam bad nga ai ki jingrai ; nga la ïalam ïa ki main u syiem u ïalam ïa la ki shipai , bad ar ai ha ki ïa ka jingshngain haba ki duh jingkyrmen .
translation.en: I chose out their way , and sat chief , and dwelt as a king in the army , as one that comforteth the mourners .

translation.kha: Shet ïa ka doh bad bam-im ïa ka ha kata ka iaki manla balui ; bad ha ka stait kaba bud , lytar phai neh sha la ïing .
translation.en: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose : and thou shalt turn in the morning , and go unto thy tents .

To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion , to give unto them beauty for ashes , the oil of joy for mourning , the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness  ; that they might be called trees of righteousness , the planting of the  Lord  , that he might be glorified .
translation.kha: ban ai ha kito kiba ïam sngewsih ha Seïon ïa ka jingkmen bad jingsngewbha ha ka jaka ka jingsngewsih , ka jingrwai jong ka jingïaroh ha ka jaka ki ummat kthang . Kin long kum ki dieng ba U  Trai  da lade hi u la thung . Baroh kin leh ïa kaei kaba dei . Bad ïa U Blei yn ai ka jingïaroh ïa kaei ba u la leh .

Ki ong , U Trai u la hukum ïa pa’ ban ïadem ïa ka ri ha ki paidbah Israel da kaba kynthah sboh . U la hukum ruh ïa phi ban ai ïa ka briew’ ka khyndew jong u to kdew jong sem u Sheleph ha ki khun kynthei jong u .
translation.en: And they said , The  Lord  commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel : and my lord was commanded by the  Lord  to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters .
Woe to thee , Moab ! thou art undone , O people of Chemosh : he hath given his sons that escaped , and his daughters , into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites .
translation.kha: Katno ka long kaba kordit ïa phi ki Moab ! Phi kiba mane ïa u Khemosh , phi la jot ! U blei jong phi u pynphetwir ïa ki shynrang , Bad ïa ki kynthei u pynlong ki mraw jong u syiem Amor .
U Hasael u leit phai sha u Benhadad , uba kylli ïa u , U Elihu u ong kumno ? U Hasael u jubab , U Ong ha nga ba phi sa koit sa kajuh bhah pat .
translation.en: So he departed from Elisha , and came to his master  ; who said to him , What said Elisha to thee ? And he answered , He told me that thou shouldest surely recover .

translation.kha: Ko ki rangbah ka Moab , balamler ba phi Kam ïa lade kum ki riewkhraw , ki shipai bashlur ba la tyngkreiñ ha ka thma ?
translation.en: How say ye , We are mighty and strong men for the war ?
He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law , even his prayer shall be abomination .
translation.kha: Lada phim kohnguh ïa ka hukum , U Blei un shem ïa ki jingduwai jong phi kiba ijli eh ban sngap .
Ngan phah ïa u angel ha shuwa jongngi phi ban ïada ïa phi haba phi leit jingleit bad ban ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka jaka kaba nga la pynkhreh .
translation.en: Behold , I send an Angel before thee , to keep thee in the way , and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared .
And Jesus said unto him ,  No man , having put his hand to the plough , and looking back , is fit for the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Uno uno uba sdang ban lur bad nangta uba ïai kyrtiang dien um long uba myntoi ïa ka Hima U Blei .
Ki briew kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ka kynsi ba u la hikai , Naamah um long kum ki nonghikai ka Hukum ; hynrei u la hikai da ka bor .
translation.en: And they were astonished at his doctrine : for he taught them as one that had authority , and not as the scribes .
Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Sedekaïah u la don arphew wei snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem .
Ki la ong ha ka , Hynrei pham don uwei ruh na ki ba-ha-ïing wahbah kylleng kumta !
translation.en: And they said unto her , There is none of thy kindred that is called by this name .

translation.kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa kane ka hukum , U Trai’ un sngewbha , badno ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin manbha .
translation.en: Thou shalt not eat it  ; that it may go well with thee , and with thy children after thee , when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ar sngi hadien , la anna ka jingkyntiew kurim ha ka shnongrit Kana kaba ha Galilaïa .
translation.en: And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee  ; and the mother of Jesus was there :

translation.kha: Ka jingim bashisha jong phi ka long U Khrist , bad haba u mihpaw , te ma phi ruh phin mihpaw lem sad u bad ïoh bniat ïa ka burom jong u!
translation.en: When Christ , who is our life , shall appear , then shall ye also appear with him in glory .

translation.kha: Haba ki nongshun jong u Daniel ki la khmih ïa u ba u Duwai sha U Blei ,
translation.en: Then these men assembled , and found Daniel praying and making supplication before his God .
And I will do in thee that which I have not done , and whereunto I will not do any more the like , because of all thine abominations .
translation.kha: Namar kiei kiei baroh kiba pha leh ki long kiba nga ijli , ngan pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem ïa kaba ngam pat ju leh mynno mynno , bad ïa kaba ngan ym leh shuh lano lano ruh .
Ha Kata ka miet U Trai u la mihpaw ha u ha ka jingïohipaw bad u kyrmen ïa u , Kaei me mon ïa nga ban ai ha me ?
translation.en: In Gibeon the  Lord  appeared to Solomon in a dream by night : and God said , Ask what I shall give thee .
The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit , that we are the children of God :
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U Blei u pynïasoh lang ïa lade bad ki mynsiem jong ngi ban pynbna ba ngi long ki khun jong U Blei .

translation.en: Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa u Petros bad u Ïoannis ba ki rung shapoh , u la kyrpad ïa ki ban ai ei ei ïa u .

translation.en: Behold , I have divided unto you by lot these nations that remain , to be an inheritance for your tribes , from Jordan , with all the nations that I have cut off , even unto the great sea westward .
translation.kha: Nga la ai kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki jait jong phi ïa ka ri jong kita ki jaitbynriew kiba dang sah , lem bad ka jong kito ki jaitbynriew kiba nga la dep jop , naduh ka wah Jordan ha ka phang mihngi haduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian ha ka phang sepngi .
Haba u duwai , U Blei un jubab ïa u ; un myn ïa U Blei da kaba kmen ; U Blei un buh ibieit sa shisien pat ïa keiñ kiei na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: He shall pray unto God , and he will be favourable unto him : and he shall see his face with joy : for he will render unto man his righteousness .

translation.kha: Teng wan hiar bad ïakren bad me hangta , bad ngan shimet khyndiat ka bor mynsiem ïa kaba nga la ai ha me bad ngan ai ïa ka ha ki . Te kin sa lah ban ïakit lem ïa ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta kine ki paidbah , bad “Men ym donburom haw ban kit tang marwei hi .
translation.en: And I will come down and talk with thee there : and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee , and will put it upon them  ; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee , that thou bear it not thyself alone .

translation.kha: U Trai u im ! To ïaroh ïa u nongïada jyllang nga ! To pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong U Blei! uba khlaiñ uba pynim ïa nga !
translation.en: The  Lord  liveth  ; and blessed be my rock  ; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation .
I would know the words which he would answer me , and understand what he would say unto me .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban tip kaei ba un ong bad kumno un jubab ïa nga .

translation.en: For the king had at sea a navy of Tarshish with the navy of Hiram : once in three years came the navy of Tarshish , bringing gold , and silver , ivory , and apes , and peacocks .
translation.kha: U don shi kynhun ki liengbah kiba ïaid ha duriaw ryngkat bad ka kynhun lieng u Hiram . Shisien lai snem ki kynhun lieng jong u ki ju wan phai , ki da wan kit ïa ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki bniat hati , ki tngaw , bad ki shrieh .
Haba u jingkup u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la leit noh da kaba sngewsih , nalor u la long uba siewspah bha .
translation.en: But when the young man heard that saying , he went away sorrowful : for he had great possessions .

That be far from thee to do after this manner , to slay the righteous with the wicked : and that the righteous should be as the wicked , that be far from thee : Shall not the Judge of all the earth do right ?
translation.kha: Da shisha men ym pynïap ïa kiba hok ryngkat bad ki bymman . Kata ka bym lah ban long . Mem lah ban leh kumta . Lada me leh kumta , kiba hok kin shah pynshitom ryngkat bad ki bymman . Kata ka bym lah ban long . U nongbishar jong ka pyrthei baroh u dei ban lehhok .
Ki khulom jong ka Para ba-beit jong phoi ki phah ïa ka jingai khubor ïa phi .
translation.en: The children of thy elect sister greet thee . Amen .

translation.kha: ka Baalath , ka Tamar ha ka ri khlaw Judah ,
translation.en: And Baalath , and Tamar in the wilderness , in the land ,

translation.kha: Kim tip ïa ka jingmut jong ka jingtyngshaiñ , nabar ym don thnam Kaba lah baneh pynïap dien ïa ki .
translation.en: He mocketh at fear , and is not affrighted  ; neither turneth he back from the sword .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha ka , Ar tylli ki jaitbynriew ki don hapoh jong pha ; Phan sa kha ar jai ki briew kiba ïaleh pyrshah para ma ki . Kawei kan kham khlaiñ ban ïa kawei pat , Kaba ha shuwa kan shakri ïa kaba hadien .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto her , Two nations are in thy womb , and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels  ; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people  ; and the elder shall serve the younger .

translation.kha: Bad lada U Trai U Blei jong phi u pynïar ïa ka ri jong phi , kumba u la ïaheh ha ki kpa tymmen jyllang phi , bad u ai ha phi ïa kata ka ri baroh ïa kaba u la kular ,
translation.en: And if the  Lord  thy God enlarge thy coast , as he hath sworn unto thy fathers , and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynshet jong phi , U Khrist u la theh noh ïa la U Mynsiem ha phi . Katba U Minnith jong u , u dang ïaisah ha phi , phim donkam ïano ïano ban hikai ïa phi . Nabal U Mynsiem jong u , un hikai ïa phi shaphang kiei kiei baroh , bad kaei kaba u hikai ka long kaba shisha , ym kaba lamler . namarkata , to kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai U Mynsiem bad ïaisah ha U Khrist .
translation.en: But the anointing which ye have received of him abideth in you , and ye need not that any man teach you : but as the same anointing teacheth you of all things , and is truth , and is no lie , and even as it hath taught you , ye shall abide in him .

translation.kha: U Blei u la long ryngkat bad Uto u khynnah katba u nang haw nang synran ; u la im ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Pha bad u kylla long u nongbeh mrad uba tbit .
translation.en: And God was with the lad  ; and he grew , and dwelt in the wilderness , and became an archer .

translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha nga , Wat bat kum kaba rieh ïa ki ktien ka jingïathuhlypa jngai kñia ka kitab , namar ka prie ka la jan haba kane barhem kan jia .
translation.en: And he saith unto me , Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book : for the time is at hand .

translation.kha: Namar de da ka jingisynei U Blei ba ïa phi la pynim da ka jingngeit . Kam dei na ka jingmih na ki kam jong phi hi , hynrei ka long ka jngai U Blei , khnang ba isangsot uno un ym lah ban kren sorkar shaphang Kata .
translation.en: Not of works , lest any man should boast .

translation.kha: Sumar bad kiar ïa la ka jingim na kaba i-ieit spah , bad sngwthuh pynlang kita kiei ktieh kiba phi kein . Namar U Blei u la ong , Ngan ym ino ïa phi , ngan ym kyntoit ïa pa .
translation.en: Let your conversation be without covetousness  ; and be content with such things as ye have : for he hath said , I will never leave thee , nor forsake thee .

translation.kha: Ka waitlam baher kawei lem mala ka jingpar ka la rung shapoh bad ka khleiñ ka la tap ïa ka . U Ehud um shym la sei ïa ka na ka kpoh jongu u syiem , bad ka la pei bla shadien , hapdeng ki kjat jong u .
translation.en: And the haft also went in after the blade  ; and the fat closed upon the blade , so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly  ; and the dirt came out .
I have sinned  ; what shall I do unto thee , O thou preserver of men ? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee , so that I am a burden to myself ?
translation.kha: Hato la pynmynsaw ïa phi da ka pop jong nga , ko phi u nongap byndi ? Balei me pyndonkam ïa nga na ka bynta ka sohpdung-jinghikai jong me ? Hato nga long ka jingkit kaba khia eh ïa me ?
U kpa bad ka kmie jong u khunlung ki la sngewlyngngoh ha kiew kiei katba u Simeon u la kren shaphang jong u .
translation.en: And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him .
And the sword shall abide on his cities , and shall consume his branches , and devour them , because of their own counsels .
translation.kha: Ka thma kan khie ha ki nongbah jong ki , bad kan pynkheiñ ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah . Kan pynjot ïa ki briew jong nga namar ki leh ïa kaei kaba ma ki hi ki pyrkhat ba ka long kaba bha tam .
Nga ieit ïa kito kiba ieit ïa nga ; kita uba buid ïa at kin shem ïa nga .
translation.en: I love them that love me  ; and those that seek me early shall find me .

And when he came unto Lehi , the Philistines shouted against him : and the Spirit of the  Lord  came mightily upon him , and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire , and his bands loosed from off his hands .
translation.kha: Ynda u poi ha Lehi , ki Philistia ki wan mareh sha u , ki da ïarisa ïa u . Hangta hi ka bor jong U  Trai  ka pynshaitbor ïa u , bad u bthat ïa ki tyllai kiba la khum ïa ki ksang ti bad ki kti jong u kum ki  saihon kiba la kem ding .

translation.en: Then brought he me into the outward court , and , lo , there were chambers , and a pavement made for the court round about : thirty chambers were upon the pavement .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop sha ka phyllaw bashabar . La don laiphew tylli ki kamra ba la tei ha syndah ka kynroh bashabar bad ha khmat jong ki , la don ka jaka ba la siang maw kaba poi sawdong ka phyllaw .
Kumta ki la ai ha u Jakob ïa i'u ki blei nongwei baroh kiba ki don , malu ruh ïa ki sohshkor ba ki deng . U Jakob u buhrieh ïa ki ha trai u dieng Sniew hajan Shem .
translation.en: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand , and all their earrings which were in their ears  ; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem .

translation.kha: ïa ki jaiñ bastang jong ki , ki lied linen jngai ki , bad ïa ki jreiñ tei ryndang malade ki jaiñtapkhmat kiba jrong kiba ki tap ha ki khlieh jong ki .
translation.en: The glasses , and the fine linen , and the hoods , and the veils .

translation.kha: Ha ki briew jong U Blei ha Kolossai kiba long ki phlangïap baïaineh ha U Khrist : Ai ba U Blang uba U kba jong i un ai ha phi ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse : Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
Then said Boaz unto Ruth , Hearest thou not , my daughter ? Go not to glean in another field , neither go from hence , but abide here fast by my maidens :
translation.kha: Nangta u Boas u ong ha ka Ruth ,  Shah ngan ai jingmut katto katne ïa phi . Wat leit tam kew shawei pat lait tang ha kane ka lyngkha . Trei para kynthei hangne ;
katba I dang ap ïa ka jingwan jong kata ka Sngi ba la kyrkhoit kaba ngi ap kyrmen , haba ka burom U Bel bakhraw Bad U Jisu! khriat U Nongpynim jong i'u kuna paw .
translation.en: Looking for that blessed hope , and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ .

Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods , and all the women that stood by , a great multitude , even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt , in Pathros , answered Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah baroh kiba tip ba ki tnga jong ki , ki ai jingkñia ha kiwei pat ki blei , bad ki kynthei baroh kiba ïeng hangta , kaba kynthup ïa ki Israel kiba shong ha ki bynta bashathie ka Ijipt — u paidbah babun baroh — ki ong ha nga ,
me tap ïa lade da ka jingshai . Me pyiar ïa ki bneng khim ka ïingjaiñ
translation.en: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment : who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain :

translation.kha: ka ri kaba pynmih ïa u kew bad u barli , u dieng sohwaiñ bun u diengsoh Dumbur , u diengsynshar Pomkranet bad u diengthew Olib , bad ka ngap .
translation.en: A land of wheat , and barley , and vines , and fig trees , and pomegranates  ; a land of oil olive , and honey  ;

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Asher . U don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Imnah , u Ishbah , u Ishbi , bad u Beraïah , bad kawei ka khun , ka Serah .
translation.en: The sons of Asher  ; Imnah , and Ishuah , and Ishvi , and Beriah , and Serah their sister .

translation.kha: To ïam bad to ud , ko dieng Kseh-Sypress — ki Kedar ki la kyllon ; ïa kito ki dieng bymdondor la pynngat ! To ïam bad to ud , ko ki dien sneng jong ka Bashan — ïa ka khlaiñ kaba rben la khet ei !
translation.en: Howl , fir tree  ; for the cedar is fallen  ; because the mighty are spoiled : howl , O ye oaks of Bashan  ; for the forest of the vintage is come down .

translation.kha: Halor u lum uba shata mih na Jerusalem’ u tei ka khak mane ïa u Khemosh , u bieit ïa-bujli jong ki Hobab , bad ka Jaka mane ïa u Malkhiel , u blei ba-ijli jong ki Ammon .
translation.en: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh , the abomination of Moab , in the hill that is before Jerusalem , and for Molech , the abomination of the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u Israel u kylla duk bad u hap ban die ïa la ka khyndew , u ba-ha-ïing bajanai eh jong u , un thied pat ïa ka .
translation.en: If thy brother be waxen poor , and hath sold away some of his possession , and if any of his kin come to redeem it , then shall he redeem that which his brother sold .
Wherefore he saith , When he ascended up on high , he led captivity captive , and gave gifts unto men .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Mynba u la kiew shajrong eh , u la ïalam bad u ïa shibun kiba shah ringmraw ; u la ai ki jingai sngewbha ha u bynriew .

translation.en: Therefore , thou son of man , prophesy against Gog , and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Gog , the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ko khun u briew , to kren pyrshah ïa u Gog , u nongsynshar rangbah jong ki jaitbynriew ka Meshekh bad ka Tubal bad ïathuh ïa u ba nga long u nongshun jong u .

Hib u Pharaoh u mluh bad u kyntien ba-bang shah ïa ngi ba-bang leit , U Troas u la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u khunlung nyngkong ha Ijipt , uba na u briew sad na u mrad ruh . Dei namar kata ba ngi kñia ainguh ha U Trai ïa uwei pa uwei uba la kha nyngkong na ki mrad , hynrei i pyllait pat ïa la ki khunlung shynrang Baroh kiba la kha nyngkong .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Pharaoh would hardly let us go , that the  Lord  slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both the firstborn of man , and the firstborn of beast : therefore I sacrifice to the  Lord  all that openeth the matrix , being males  ; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem .
And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead , they departed every man unto his place .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ba u Abimelekh u la ïap , baroh ki leit phai noh sha ïing .
Da sumar shaphang kaba leit sha ka Templ . Ka khlam bha ban kitei hangto Ban ïoh jinghikai ban ïa kaba ai jingkñia kumin ki briew ba-bieit ki bymtip ïa kaba dei na kaba bakla .
translation.en: Keep thy foot when thou goest to the house of God , and be more ready to hear , than to give the sacrifice of fools : for they consider not that they do evil .
Being defamed , we entreat : we are made as the filth of the world , and are the offscouring of all things unto this day .
translation.kha: La ñiew ïa ngi kum ka synrum jong ka pyrthei ; ngi long ki briew kiba la shah kyntait beiñ haduh kane ka khyllipmat !

translation.en: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine , and men of strength to mingle strong drink :
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Ki nongjop ïa ki klong waiñ ! Kiba shlur bad ki bym tieng ha kaba ïadei bad ki jingdih ba la khleh !
U Ananaïah u ong ha la ka tngaw , Ngin sa ïap shisha , namar ba ngi la ïohi ïa U Blei !
translation.en: And Manoah said unto his wife , We shall surely die , because we have seen God .
But I will take the kingdom out of his son s hand , and will give it unto thee , even ten tribes .
translation.kha: Ngan knieh ïa ka hima na u khun jong u Solomon bad ngan ai ha me shiphew jait ,

translation.en: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God .
translation.kha: Nangta ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong ka jingsynshar u syiem Syros kum u patsha ka Babilonia , u Syros u la pynmih ïa ki hukum na ka bynta ka jingtei biang ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread , to slay the souls that should not die , and to save the souls alive that should not live , by your lying to my people that hear your lies ?
translation.kha: Phi pynjahburom ïa nga ha khmat ki briew jong nga khnang ban ïoh katto katne kham u barli bad khyndiat tylli ki lyngkhot kpu . Phi pynïap ïa ki briew ki bym dei hok ban ïap , bad phi pynsah im ïa ki briew ki bym dei hok ban im . Kumta phi ïathuh ki jinglamler ha ki briew jong nga , bad ki ngeit ïa phi .
Nangta lynter ha ka sngi kaba lai ki leit puta byrsha ïa ki kynhun shipa Benjamin bad ki pynïeng ïa la ki shipai pyrshah ïa ka Gibeah , kumba ki la leh mynshuwa .
translation.en: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day , and put themselves in array against Gibeah , as at other times .

translation.kha: Ko para Isaia jong nga , ki khun ki ksiew Jong u Abraham , bad baroh ki Jentil haneng kiba mane ïa U Blei : Ka long ha ngi , ba la phah ïa ken ka khubor ka jingpynim !
translation.en: Men and brethren , children of the stock of Abraham , and whosoever among you feareth God , to you is the word of this salvation sent .

translation.kha: Bad U Jingsuk u la pynkut , Kane ka long kumto kan jia ha kito kiba kynton ka spah na ka bynta ïa laiñ hynriewphew ki bym riewsaid ha ka jingkhihwin jyllang U Blei .
translation.en: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself , and is not rich toward God .
Declare his glory among the heathen  ; his marvellous works among all nations .
translation.kha: Pynbna ïa ka burom jong u ha ki jaitbynriew , ïa ki kam bakhrawbor ha ki briew .
Naba ka la pynjot shibit ki ngab bad ka la longïing ka sier jong ka jingïap Kiba dara kiba ym haka ñiew shuh .
translation.en: For she hath cast down many wounded : yea , many strong men have been slain by her .
Behold , the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place : ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place , as I commanded .
translation.kha: Namar ba ïa ka snam jong u  langsohmoh ym shym la wanrah shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang , phi la dei ban bam ïa ka jingkñia hangta , kumba nga la hukum .

translation.en: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan , and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city : and set thy face against it , and it shall be besieged , and thou shalt lay siege against it . This shall be a sign to the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Shim uwei u khiew nar bad pynïeng ïa u kum ka kynroh hapdeng jong me bad ka nongbah . Phai khmat sha ka nongbah . Ka don ha ka jingshah kerkut , bad dei ma me uba kerkut ïa ka . Kane kan long ka dak ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel .

translation.en: Turn away my reproach which I fear : for thy judgments are good .
translation.kha: To pyllait ïa nga na ki jingibeiñ kiba nga sheptieng ; A katno kiba phylla long ki jingbishar jong me !

Hynrei mynta ïa-ban bthat biang — ïa u khun u don sa ïohpdiang ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u kpa jong u la ju ñiat thrang kum u mraw katba u dang khynñiuh , wat la shisha u long trai ha kiei kiei baroh .
translation.en: Now I say , That the heir , as long as he is a child , differeth nothing from a servant , though he be lord of all ;

translation.kha: Nangta kita ki ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam na bneng kaba ong ïa ki , To wan kiew shaiñ ! Katba ki nongshun jong ki , ki dang ïitkhmih , ki la kiew sha bneng ha u lyoh .
translation.en: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them , Come up hither . And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud  ; and their enemies beheld them .

translation.kha: Hynrei wat thew ïa ki phyllaw kiba shabar , nabar la ai noh ïa ki ha kiba mane bieit thala , ki ban sa ïew ïa ka Nongbah Bakhuid ïathuh sawphew ar bthei .
translation.en: But the court which is without the temple leave out , and measure it not  ; for it is given unto the Gentiles : and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga thoh ka long kaba Shishak . U Blei hi u tip ba ngam Shim lamler!
translation.en: Now the things which I write unto you , behold , before God , I lie not .

translation.kha: U Shephataïah u khun jong u Mattan , u Delaïah u khun jong u bashukor , u Jehukal u khun jong u Shelemaïah , bad u Asshur u khun jong u Malkhiel ki la ïohsngew ba nga la ong ïa ki paidbhur ba
translation.en: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan , and Gedaliah the son of Pashur , and Jucal the son of Shelemiah , and Pashur the son of Malchijah , heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people , saying ,

translation.kha: Haba u Daberath u la dep kren , u Saul u ong , Hato dei ma phi pahara , ko Dabid u khun jong ar ? Bad u la shang ban ïam .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul , that Saul said , Is this thy voice , my son David ? And Saul lifted up his voice , and wept .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan sa bishar ïa kata ka jaitbynriew ïa kaba kin shakri , bad hadien kata ki khun ki kseh jong me kin mihnoh na kata ka ri bad kin mane ïa nga ha khie ka jakarieh .’
translation.en: And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge , said God : and after that shall they come forth , and serve me in this place .
For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast , of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  , even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba bam ïa ka khleiñ jong u mrad ïa uba wanlam kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai  yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .

Ko Israel wat pynlwait ïa ki kjat jong me , lane shah ïa u pdot jong me ban tyrkhong na Kaba beh ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Hynrei me ong , ‘ Em ! Ngam lah ban phai dien . Nga la ieit ïa ki bieit nongwei bad ngan leit Hadien jong ki .’
translation.en: Withhold thy foot from being unshod , and thy throat from thirst : but thou saidst , There is no hope : no  ; for I have loved strangers , and after them will I go .

translation.kha: U Blei u la pynlong ruh ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem ban shitom namar ka jingbymman jong ki , kumba u Jotham , u khun jongngi u jingïadon , u ong ïa ki ba kin long kumta haba u la tim ïa ki .
translation.en: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads : and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal .

translation.kha: Ki la kurup ïa ka tynrai jngai ka jingim jong i , ïa u syiem uba U Trai u la jied , ita uba ngi la shaniah ban ïada ïa ngi na uno un u nonghiarthma .
translation.en: The breath of our nostrils , the anointed of the  Lord  , was taken in their pits , of whom we said , Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen .

translation.kha: haba u Soitan u la dep ban pynshoi ïa U Jisu ha ki man bapher bapher , u la ioh ïa u shipor .
translation.en: And when the devil had ended all the temptation , he departed from him for a season .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la khmih shaei ha u da ka jingieit bad u la ong , Me donkam tang kawei kaei kaei . Khie leit bad miet ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha Ibbah duk , bad men ïoh ïa ka spah ha Bneng ; nangne sa wan bad bud ïa nga .
translation.en: Then Jesus beholding him loved him , and said unto him ,  One thing thou lackest : go thy way , sell whatsoever thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come , take up the cross , and follow me .
Therefore thus saith the  Lord  , who redeemed Abraham , concerning the house of Jacob , Jacob shall not now be ashamed , neither shall his face now wax pale .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , uba la pyllait ïa u Abraham na ka jingjynjar , u ong ,  Ko ki briew jong nga , phin ym shah pynlehrain shuh , bad ki khmat jong phi kin ym i-blad shuh da ka jinglehrain .

translation.en: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom , that she defiled the land , and committed adultery with stones and with stocks .
translation.kha: bad kam shym lehrain satia . Ka la pyntngit ïa ka ri , bad ka la leh awria da kaba mane ïa ki maw bad ki dieng .

Ïa kane la pyn-i lyngba ka jingshisha ba U Blei u la buh ïa kiwei pat ka sngi , ïa kaba la khot Ha kñia ka sngi . Bun snem hadien u la kren lyngba u Abda ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ïa kaba la la kdew : Lada phyrnai ïohsngew ïa ka sur jngai U Blei ha kane ka sngi , wat pyneh ïa la ki dohnud .
translation.en: Again , he limiteth a certain day , saying in David , To day , after so long a time  ; as it is said , To day if ye will hear his voice , harden not your hearts .

translation.kha: U Josis malu ki synran jong u , kynthup ïa u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki la mih na ka synagog bad ki la leit pait sha ka ïingjaiñ u Simon bad u Andriw .
translation.en: And forthwith , when they were come out of the synagogue , they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew , with James and John .
And they took them out of the midst of the tent , and brought them unto Joshua , and unto all the children of Israel , and laid them out before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki wanrah ïa ki shabar ka ïingjaiñ , ki leit lam ïa ki sha u Joshua bad sha kita ki Israel baroh , bad ki buh ïa ki ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: Dost thou know when God disposed them , and caused the light of his cloud to shine ?
translation.kha: Hato me tip kumno U Blei u ai hukum bad u pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban thaba na ki lyoh ?

translation.en: But none saith , Where is God my maker , who giveth songs in the night  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei kim phai sha U Blei , u Nongthaw jong ki , uba ai jingkyrmen ïa ki ha ki kynta kiba dum .
Phin pynjrong ïa u ba la thang da ka jinglehrain bad U Trai un ainong ïa ph .
translation.en: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head , and the  Lord  shall reward thee .

translation.kha: U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la pynlut katto katne par ha Antiokh , bad ryngkat lem bad bun kiwei pat , ki la hikai dara ïalap ïa ka ktien jong U Trai .
translation.en: Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch , teaching and preaching the word of the Lord , with many others also .

translation.kha: U Trai’ u la pyndap ïa u da ka hab jong u , badno u la ai ruh ha u ïa ka jingot , ka jingnang , bad ka jingshemphang ban trei ïa ki jait kam otsher kiba har rukom ,
translation.en: And he hath filled him with the spirit of God , in wisdom , in understanding , and in knowledge , and in all manner of workmanship  ;

translation.kha: Ngan theh buk ïa U Mynsiem jong ar ha ki pyllut Eliel , malade ngan ym phai dien shuh na ki . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , por la kren .
translation.en: Neither will I hide my face any more from them : for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel , saith the Lord  God .
And Ehud escaped while they tarried , and passed beyond the quarries , and escaped unto Seirath .
translation.kha: U Ehud u la ïohphet katba ki dang ïa-ap . U la leit narud ki maw ba la ohdur bad u leit poi sha Seirah .

Nangta u la wan phai pat sha ki para ngut ki synran bad u la shem ïa ki ba ki ïohthiah ; pynlang u la ong ha u Petros , Kumno keiñ ma phi lai ngut Kino smam lah ban ïa-ap lakam bad na wat tangba shi kynta ?
translation.en: And he cometh unto the disciples , and findeth them asleep , and saith unto Peter ,  What , could ye not watch with me one hour ?

translation.kha: Suk kata ka jaitbynriew kaba U Blei jong ka U long U Trai ; suk kita ki briew Ibbah u la Jedidah ban long ka jingïohkynti jong u .
translation.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the  Lord   ; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance .

translation.kha: Ki longïing kaban lad ka kur Gershon ki la ïohpdiang baroh khatlai tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs .

translation.kha: Haba nga pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng kiei pat ki jaitbynriew bad ha ki ri nongai , kin tipthuh ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall scatter them among the nations , and disperse them in the countries .
He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life , righteousness , and honour .
translation.kha: Lehsbun bad lehhok bad phin im slem ; kiwei kin burom ïa phi bad kin lehbha ïa phi .

translation.en: Do they not err that devise evil ? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good .
translation.kha: Phin ïoh ïa ka jingshaniah bad jingñiewkor na kiwei lada phi trei na ka bynta kaba bha ; lada phi trei na ka bynta kaba sniew , phi leh ïa kaba bakla .
Katba u dang krung , u lyoh u la paw bad u la tap ïa ki da ka syrngiew jong u ; bad ki synran ki la sheptieng hajan u lyoh u la wei halor jong ki .
translation.en: While he thus spake , there came a cloud , and overshadowed them : and they feared as they entered into the cloud .

translation.kha: Em , ko khun jongngi nga , u syiem u jubab . Kan bankhia shibit eh ïa phi lada ngi baroh im’ ïarieh . U Shaalbim u la ïa-ai ban , hynrei u syiem um shym mynjur , bad u la ong ïa u Absalom ban mihnoh .
translation.en: And the king said to Absalom , Nay , my son , let us not all now go , lest we be chargeable unto thee . And he pressed him : howbeit he would not go , but blessed him .

translation.kha: Pa la long Kaba pawnam ha ki jaitbynriew baroh na ka pyntha ka jingbhabriew banbeiñ jong pha , namar nga long utai wahbah la pyntong ïa pha kaba ibhabriew . Kane ka longïng kaei ka U Trai Nongsynshar u ong .
translation.en: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty : for it was perfect through my comeliness , which I had put upon thee , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha kata ka jaka kabu U Blei u la ïathuh ha u , u Abraham u tei ïa ka iba malu u pynbeit ïa kita ki dieng halor jongnga ka . U la khum ïa la u khun bad pynthiah ïa u halor ka duwan , hajrong kita ki dieng .
translation.en: And they came to the place which God had told him of  ; and Abraham built an altar there , and laid the wood in order , and bound Isaac his son , and laid him on the altar upon the wood .

translation.kha: Ïarap lem ïa la ki para Israel haduh ba kin da ïohlait ïa kata ka ri ba U Trai u ai ha ki shata sepngi na Jordan bad haduh ba U Trai un shah ba kin im suk im saiñ hangta , kumba u la leh ïa phi haneng . Hadien kata , phi lah ban wan phai sha kan ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Until the  Lord  have given rest unto your brethren , as well as unto you , and until they also possess the land which the  Lord  your God hath given them beyond Jordan : and then shall ye return every man unto his possession , which I have given you .

translation.kha: Ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor U blang ka daiñ ban long kaban lah ban synriah da uba kren , namar U Blei um kajuh ïa ngi ban un-long ha ka jingkhñium kynrei hynrei ha ka jingieit bad ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: For God is not the author of confusion , but of peace , as in all churches of the saints .

translation.kha: Sawphew snoh U Trai u la ïalam ïa phi lyngba ka ri shitaiew , hynrei ki jaiñkup jong phi kim shym man rung , bad ki ujuh jong phi kim shym jot .
translation.en: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness : your clothes are not waxen old upon you , and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot .

translation.kha: Uwei uwei u kherub u don saw tylli ki durkhmat . Ka khmat kaba nyngkong ka dei ka jong u masi kyrtong , kaba ar ka jong u briew , kaba lai ka jong u jingjop , Bad kaba saw ka jong u pukni .
translation.en: And every one had four faces : the first face was the face of a cherub , and the second face was the face of a man , and the third the face of a lion , and the fourth the face of an eagle .

translation.kha: Ki nongpyntrei kam jong u Syiem ki pynïaid ïa ka jingshalan Kulai na Musri malade Kilikia bad ïa ka jingshalan kali ïapom na Ijipt .
translation.en: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt , and linen yarn : the king s merchants received the linen yarn at a price .
And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule , and her stature was exalted among the thick branches , and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches .
translation.kha: Ki tnat jong u ki long kiba khlaiñ bad ki san ban long u diengsynshar ba kynja syiem . U dieng sohwaiñ u la san jrong eh ban kot ïa ki lyoh ; uwei uwei baroh u la ïohi haduh katno u la long uba rben ki sla bad uba jrong .
Uno uno uba na ki ba-ha-ïing jongki me uba ïap khoh ka nongbah un shait ba-ima ha ki ksew , malu uno uno wahbah ïap ha rudnong un shah bam ha ki pukni .
translation.en: Him that dieth of Ahab in the city the dogs shall eat  ; and him that dieth in the field shall the fowls of the air eat .

translation.kha: pham sa pynher ïa ki pduh basawdong na baroh ki liang ; ki briew jong Pha kin Ïoh pat ïa la ka ri ïa kaba khawai pat ki jaitbynriew ki la shim . Ki nongbah kiba la ieh kynjah yn pynap pat da ki briew .
translation.en: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left  ; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles , and make the desolate cities to be inhabited .
This is my covenant , which ye shall keep , between me and you and thy seed after thee  ; Every man child among you shall be circumcised .
translation.kha: Ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ki dei ban mynjur ban otsher ïa uwei pa uwei u khunlung hapdeng jong phi .
Lada ki nong Ijipt ki kyntait ban rhah ïa ka Jingkhawai Madan Ki Ïingtrep , te yn sa shoh ïa ki da khwai ka jingpang kaba U Trai un phah ha ki jyrthiaw baroh kiba kyntait ban leit .
translation.en: And if the family of Egypt go not up , and come not , that have no rain  ; there shall be the plague , wherewith the  Lord  will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles .

translation.kha: Nangta ki syiem bad ki khun sahmiet shynrang jong ki kin bang ïa ki khyrdop jngai ka Jeroboam bad kin dat kaweh ka bor ba kynja syiem kaweh u Dabid u la don . Ryngkat lem bad ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jeroham , ktang Shong ha ki kad ïapom bad khashor ki kulai , bad ka nongbah Jerusalem kan ïai dap borabor da ki briew .
translation.en: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David , riding in chariots and on horses , they , and their princes , the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem : and this city shall remain for ever .

translation.kha: dara hadien ba la kha ïa u khun jong phai , woh pynbuaid syrti ha ka khliehduh jong u , namar na ka sngi ba la kha ïa u un long wahbah la pynkyntang sha U Blei kum u Nasir . Un sdang ïa ka kam ban pyllait ïa ki Israel na ki Philistia .
translation.en: For , lo , thou shalt conceive , and bear a son  ; and no razor shall come on his head : for the child shall be a Nazarite unto God from the womb : and he shall begin to deliver Israel out of the hand of the Philistines .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ka poi , phin ym pan ei ei na nga . Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingbishar : U Kpa un ai ha phi ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan na u ha ka kyrteng jong nga .
translation.en: And in that day ye shall ask me nothing . Verily , verily , I say unto you , Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name , he will give it you .

translation.kha: Phai la ïohi aïu ma nga , U Trai de la leh ïa ki nong Ijipt bad kumno ba nga la Suit ïa Phin kamon ka pukni kaba kit ïa la ki khulom ha ki thapniang jong ka , bad to la wan ïalam ïa phin sha nga ha kane ka jaka .
translation.en: Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians , and how I bare you on eagles  wings , and brought you unto myself .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai , nga la koit jingmut ba saw tylli kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kin jied ha ki : kin shah pynïap ha ka thma ; ïa ki met jong ki yn patan noh da ki kseh ; ki sim kin bam ïa ki , bad ki mradkhlaw kmen bam ïa kaei kaba sah .
translation.en: And I will appoint over them four kinds , saith the  Lord  : the sword to slay , and the dogs to tear , and the fowls of the heaven , and the beasts of the earth , to devour and destroy .
And he came to the ram that had two horns , which I had seen standing before the river , and ran unto him in the fury of his power .
translation.kha: U la wan sha u langbrot , uba nga la ïohi ba u ïeng harud jong ka wah , bad u la mareh sha u da ka bor jong u baroh .

Ki khat-ar nguid ki lat jong u , uwei uwei ha u bnai ba la Buh ïa u , ki pynphriang ka jingbabe ïa u Syiem Solomon kaba u donkam ïa ailad bad ïa baroh kiba bam ha ka ïingsyiem ; ki ju ïai pynbiang ïa kaei kaei baroh kabu donkam .
translation.en: And those officers provided victual for king Solomon , and for all that came unto king Solomon s table , every man in his month : they lacked nothing .

translation.kha: lymda katkum , u dat ban siew sha uta u briew uba la thied ïa ka ha ka dor ka ban ïahap bad ki snem kba dang sah haduh ka Snem ka jingpynbha pat kaba bud , hadien dat un ïoh pat ïa la ka khyndew .
translation.en: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof , and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it  ; that he may return unto his possession .
Thy bow was made quite naked , according to the oaths of the tribes , even thy word . Selah . Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers .
translation.kha: Me pynkhreh ban pyndonkam ïa la ka ryntieh , me khreh ban siat ïa la ki khnam . Ka leilieh jong me ka pynpait ïa ka khyndew .
wat la ka sarang baroh kan ym jah ha ki thylliej ding .
translation.en: She hath wearied herself with lies , and her great scum went not forth out of her : her scum shall be in the fire .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka na shibun ki jaitbynriew kin wan sha U Trai bad long ki briew jong u . Un shong un sah Hapdeng jong phi , bad phin tip ba u la kah phah ïa nga shwa phi .
translation.en: And many nations shall be joined to the  Lord  in that day , and shall be my people : and I will dwell in the midst of thee , and thou shalt know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me unto thee .

translation.kha: Lada nga leh ïa kaei kaba ngam kwah Ban imat , kane ka mut ba ngam long shuh uta uba leh ïa kata ; pynban , ka dei ka pop kaba im hapoh jong nga .
translation.en: Now if I do that I would not , it is no more I that do it , but sin that dwelleth in me .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga kin wan na jingïohi bah , na shatei bad na sheng , bad na Aswan katba don shathie .
translation.en: Behold , these shall come from far : and , lo , these from the north and from the west  ; and these from the land of Sinim .

translation.kha: U Trai , U Blei bakhuid ki Israel , uta uba saiñdur ïa ka lawei , u ong : Phim don hok don kylliang ïa nga shaphang ki Kynhun jong ang lane ban ïathuh ïa nga kadei ba nga dei ban ar !
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the Holy One of Israel , and his Maker , Ask me of things to come concerning my sons , and concerning the work of my hands command ye me .

translation.kha: Ki la leh ïa kita ki kam kiba ijli bad pyntngit ïa ka ri , hynrei phi kino dei ban leh ïa ki . Baroh na phi , la ki Israel ne ki nongwei kiba wan shong hapdeng jong phiah , phin den ban sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum U Trai ,
translation.en: ( For all these abominations have the men of the land done , which were before you , and the land is defiled  ; )

translation.kha: U Tharai u la beh noh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw bad badonbor katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , bad ym don mano mano ba la lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ph .
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath driven out from before you great nations and strong : but as for you , no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day .
I am sought of them that asked not for me  ; I am found of them that sought me not : I said , Behold me , behold me , unto a nation that was not called by my name .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la kloi ban jubab ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong nga , hynrei kim shym la duwai . Nga la ap ïa ki ban shem ïa nga , hynrei kim shym la pyrshang . Ka jaitbynriew kam shym la khot kyrpad ïa nga , wat lada nga long la kloi ban jubab , ‘ Hangne nga don ; ngan ïarap ïa phi .’
Kata ka briew ka la sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ka , kumto ka la wan , ka da kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng , ka la dem khohsiew ha ki kjat jong u , bad ka la ïathuh ha u ïa ka jingshisha baroh .
translation.en: But the woman fearing and trembling , knowing what was done in her , came and fell down before him , and told him all the truth .

translation.kha: Ynda u Joseph u la lah tep ïa la u kpa , u leit phai pat sha Ijipt ryngkat bad la ki hynmen ki per lem bad ine barben ibha leit ontep ïa u kpa jong u .
translation.en: And Joseph returned into Egypt , he , and his brethren , and all that went up with him to bury his father , after he had buried his father .
For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed : for the  Lord  dwelleth in Zion .
translation.kha: Ngan pynhiarkput na ka bynta kito kiba la shah pynïap ; ngan ym map ïa kiba leh kam sniew . Hynrei ha Judah bad Jerusalem yn don ki nongshong shnong junom , bad ma nga U  Trai  , ngan shong ha u lum Seïon .
Nga tip , A Trai , ba me long ibha khrawbor tam ; ba me lai ban leh ïa khie kawei Baroh kaba me kwah .
translation.en: I know that thou canst do every thing , and that no thought can be withholden from thee .

translation.kha: Nga shem sngewbha ha kaweh kohnguh ïa ki sah” jong me , nalor nga ieit ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will delight myself in thy commandments , which I have loved .

translation.kha: Lada ki mraw kiba shet na la u kynrad ki wan jar jingïada na phi , wat phah pat ïa ki sha u kynrad jong ki .
translation.en: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee :
Hast thou faith ? have it to thyself before God . Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth .
