translation.kha: To bat ïa kaei kaba phi ngeit shaphang kane ka kam , hapdeng jong phi bad U Blei . Suk uta u briew u bym sngew ïa ka jingpynrem haba u leh ïa kaei kaei kaba u bishar ba ka long kaba dei !

Ha ka step jong ka Sngi katba prie , la ba-don u pyrthat bad ka leilieh , u lyoh uba rben u la paw halor u lum , bad la ïohsngew ïa ka turoi kabu sawa jam . Baroh ki bri Kiba don ha ka jaka sher Dara ki la kyiuh da ka jingtyngshaiñ .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning , that there were thunders and lightnings , and a thick cloud upon the mount , and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud  ; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled .

translation.kha: Nga sngewthikna katta dik ïa phi ; nga sngewsarong na ka bynta jrong phi ! Ha ki jingjynjar jong ngi baroh nga dang dap hi da ka jingshlur ; sa shlei da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Great is my boldness of speech toward you , great is my glorying of you : I am filled with comfort , I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation .
( And they said unto him , Lord , he hath ten pounds . )
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ong ha u , ‘ Ko kynrad , u la don lypa shiphew tylli ki sbai ksiar !’

translation.en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host : a mighty man is not delivered by much strength .
translation.kha: U syiem um shym jop namar ka kynhun shipai badonbor jong u ; u shipai um shym jop namar ka jingkhlaiñ jong u .

translation.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin , Gibeon with her suburbs , Geba with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Benjamin la ai saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Gibeon , ka Geba ,
Kynmaw ba une u briew , u Boas , uba phi la ïatrei lem bad ki kynthei jong u , u dei u ba-ha-ïing jyllang ngi . Shahshkor mynta . Ha kane ka janmiet un leit dung ïa u barli .
translation.en: And now is not Boaz of our kindred , with whose maidens thou wast ? Behold , he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor .
For ye had compassion of me in my bonds , and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods , knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance .
translation.kha: Phi shahshitom lem bad ki koidi , bad haba ki jingdon jingem jong phi baroh ki la shah kurup , phi la shah ïa la ka jingduh da kaba kmen , namar phi la tip ba phi la ïoh kam kynti shibun kiei kiei kiba kham bha , kiba neh junom .
bad ha ka por kaweh biang u la pynpaw ïa ka ha ka kherub jong u . Ïa kane la pynshitom ha ar , bad nga pynmanbha ïa ka da ka hukum U Blei U nongpynkheiñ jong ngi .
translation.en: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching , which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour ;
And the people served the  Lord  all the days of Joshua , and all the days of the elders that outlived Joshua , who had seen all the great works of the  Lord  , that he did for Israel .
translation.kha: Katba u Joshua u dang im , ki paid Israel ki shakri ïa U  Trai  , bad wat hadien ka jingïap jong u ki ïai leh kumta katba dang im ki nongïalam kiba la ïohi da lade ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba U  Trai  u la leh na ka bynta ki Israel .
U siat ïa la ki khnam jylliew shapoh ka sien jongno to .
translation.en: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins .

translation.kha: Ki sakhi ki dei ban lynthem mawleiñ nyngkong , bad nangta kiwei pat ki briew’ kin pynbud ïa ki , da kumta phin pynkhuid noh ïa Kane ka jingbymman nongpang jong phi! .
translation.en: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death , and afterward the hands of all the people . So thou shalt put the evil away from among you .
Now is she without , now in the streets , and lieth in wait at every corner . )
translation.kha: lane ka ïeng apthap ha kyndong , teng teng ha ki surok bah , bad teng teng ha ka jaka ïew .

translation.en: And when he had gone over those parts , and had given them much exhortation , he came into Greece ,
translation.kha: U la leit lyngba kito ki thain bad u la pynshlur ïa ki briew da ki khubor kiba bun .

translation.en: Who among you will give ear to this ? who will hearken and hear for the time to come ?
translation.kha: Hato uno uno na phi un sngap ïa kane ? Naduh mynta hato phin shahshkor bha ?

translation.en: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night , and said , Rise up , and get you forth from among my people , both ye and the children of Israel  ; and go , serve the  Lord  , as ye have said .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka miet , u Pharaoh u la phah khot mar mar ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong ,  Khie mihnoh na ka ri jong nga , ma phi bad ki Israel ! Khie leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  kumba phi la pan .

translation.en: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity  ; and the earth shall rise up against him .
translation.kha: Ka bneng ka pynpaw ïa ka pop jong une u briew , bad ka pyrthei ka phla pyrshah ïa u .
da kaba shah ïa uno uno u briew u bym dem khot ban bam ïa ki ; kata kan pynhap ïa uto u briew ha ka pop , bad un shah pynum . Nga long U Trai uba pynkyntang ïa ki jingainguh .
translation.en: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass , when they eat their holy things : for I the  Lord  do sanctify them .

translation.kha: Ka riewkynthei lane ka kynthei kambah la pyllaitluid tnga ka dei ïa-ban pynspong ïa kawei pa kaei ka jingkular ba ka la ai ban kyndiang noh na Kanah kano .
translation.en: But every vow of a widow , and of her that is divorced , wherewith they have bound their souls , shall stand against her .

translation.kha: U nongïalam kiba bud u dei u Shamgar , u khun jong u Anath . Une shiah u la pyllait ïa ki Israel , bun u la ar kamet da kaba pynïap khyndaispah ngut ki Philistia da u dieng ñiah phasi .
translation.en: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath , which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad : and he also delivered Israel .

translation.kha: ‘ Wat ïa u pui pui na ka shnong jong phi uba dambit ha ki kjat jngai ngi , ngi ñiah noh pyrshah ïa Phi . Hynñiew kynmaw ba ka Hiram U Blei ka la wan hajan jong phi !’
translation.en: Even the very dust of your city , which cleaveth on us , we do wipe off against you : notwithstanding be ye sure of this , that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you .

translation.kha: Ngam buh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga hapoh jong phi bad ngan peit ba phi bud ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga kiba ar la ai ha phi! .
translation.en: And I will put my spirit within you , and cause you to walk in my statutes , and ye shall keep my judgments , and do them .

translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba phi la pyn-i ïa kum kane ka jingbeiñ ïa U Trai ha kaba leh ïa Kanah , u khun jong phi un ïap .
translation.en: Howbeit , because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the  Lord  to blaspheme , the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die .
Also regard not your stuff  ; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours .
translation.kha: Kim dei ban khuslai ei ei shaphang la ki jingdon jingem ba ki hap ieh , namar kiba bha tam ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei kin long ki jong ki .

Ynda phi la jam ïa ka wah Jordan , kine ki jait ki den ban ïing ha u lum Gerisim katba nang pynbang ïa ki jingkyrhuh : ka jait Simeon , ka jait Lebi , ka jait Judah , ka jait Issakhar , ka joit Joseph , bad ka jait Benjamin .
translation.en: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people , when ye are come over Jordan  ; Simeon , and Levi , and Judah , and Issachar , and Joseph , and Benjamin :

translation.kha: Wat ai ba ngin iohnong ïa ka jingmlien ban ïanguh lang , kumba don kiba leh . Pynban , to ngin pynshlur uwei ïa iwei pat , khem haba phi ïohi ba ka Sngi U Terah ka la dum jan .
translation.en: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together , as the manner of some is  ; but exhorting one another : and so much the more , as ye see the day approaching .

translation.kha: Ong ïa u ban da husiar , ban long jai jai , bun pun ym pynsheptieng lane khiah jingmut . Ka jingbitar u Syiem Resin bad ki Syria jongu u dara ka jong u Syiem Pekah kam long shuh kaba don jingma ban ïa ka tdem jong ki ar tylli ki shynraiñ ding kiba don ding .
translation.en: And say unto him , Take heed , and be quiet  ; fear not , neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands , for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria , and of the son of Remaliah .

translation.kha: ïa ka sngur yn pyndum , bad u bnai un kylla synsar kumin ka snar , ha shata Ka Sngi kaba khraw bad kaba jahburom jong U Trai ka wan .
translation.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness , and the moon into blood , before that great and notable day of the Lord come :

translation.kha: Keiñ ka mut ba ka jingïap ka ba-thurmur hapoh jongnga ngi , hynrei , ka jingim ka trei hapoh jong phi .
translation.en: So then death worketh in us , but life in you .
And the children of Israel said unto the  Lord  , We have sinned : do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee  ; deliver us only , we pray thee , this day .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki paid Israel ki ong ha U  Trai  ,  Ngi la leh pop . Leh ïa ngi katba me mon ; hynrei sngewbha , pyllait im ïa ngi ha kane ka sngi .

translation.en: Therefore say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Although I have cast them far off among the heathen , and although I have scattered them among the countries , yet will I be to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they shall come .
translation.kha: Mynta to ïathuh ïa ki para ba shah ringmraw ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Nga long uta uba la phah ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha ki ri kiba jngai bad pynsakma ïa ki ha kiwei de ki ri . Pynban , ïa mynta shipor ngan don bad ki ha ki jaka sha kaba ki la leit .

translation.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel , u Abijah u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai snem ha Jerusalem .
mynnyngkong bad mynmiet ki la ap ha ki khyrdop shnong khnang ban pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: But their laying await was known of Saul . And they watched the gates day and night to kill him .

translation.kha: Namar ba phi kwah hir hir ïa ki jingai jong U Mynsiem , phi dei ban pyrshang nalor kiei kiei baroh ban kham pyndonkam ïa kito kiba long jingïarap ban tei ïa ka basngur .
translation.en: Even so ye , forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts , seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church .

translation.kha: U Absalom u jubab , Namar ba phim wan haba nga la phah khot ïa phi . Nga la kwah ïa phi ban leit sha u syiem bad banbeiñ kylli na ka bynta jong nga : ‘ Balei nga dei ban iehnoh ïa ka Geshur pynlang wan hangne ? Kan jingai da la kham bha ïa nga ban kamar-tama hangthie .’ U Baalsebub u bteng , nga kwah ïa phi ban pynbit ïa nga shun ïew ïa u syiem , bad lada nga la set pop , te shah ïa u ban pynïap ïa nga .
translation.en: And Absalom answered Joab , Behold , I sent unto thee , saying , Come hither , that I may send thee to the king , to say , Wherefore am I come from Geshur ? it had been good for me to have been there still : now therefore let me see the king s face  ; and if there be any iniquity in me , let him kill me .

translation.kha: Ki don ki briew kaba kyntait ïa ka jingshai ; kim sngewkyiuh ïa ka rue ki leit sha kaba ka ïalam .
translation.en: They are of those that rebel against the light  ; they know not the ways thereof , nor abide in the paths thereof .
Seek ye the  Lord  while he may be found , call ye upon him while he is near :
translation.kha: To phai sha U  Trai  bad duwai ha u , mynta ba u don hajan .
(Nga la ïohi ïa ki khraw ba ki shongsuk da ki kulai katba ki riewdonburom ki ïadie da ka kjat kum ki mraw .
translation.en: I have seen servants upon horses , and princes walking as servants upon the earth .

translation.kha: Hadien ba u Syiem Solomon u la pyndep ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïongjngum , u da pynsep janai ïa kiei kaei baroh kumba u la buh jingmut don har ïa ki ,
translation.en: Thus Solomon finished the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house : and all that came into Solomon s heart to make in the house of the  Lord  , and in his own house , he prosperously effected .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Shisha , Pynkyrteng ïa u , u ‘ Jeiel ,’ namar kan ym slem shuh shuwa ba ngan pynïapmat ïa u syiem ki Israel namar ki kam pynïap bri ba u kpa tymmen jong u , u Heh u la har ha Jesreel . Ngan pynkut nala ïa ka jingsynshar na ka longïing syiem jrong u Jehu .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Call his name Jezreel  ; for yet a little while , and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu , and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel .
And a man s foes shall be they of his own household .
translation.kha: ki nongshun basniew tam jong u briew kin dei ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong u hi .

U Trai u la ong biang ha u Moses , Mynta ba me leit phai shwa Ijipt , da kynmaw ban leh ha khmat u Pharaoh ïa ki kambah baroh kiba to la ai ha me ïa ka bor ban leh . hynriew ngan pynmutlop ïa u Pharaoh , bad un ym shah ïa u paidïapom ban leit .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , When thou goest to return into Egypt , see that thou do all those wonders before Pharaoh , which I have put in thine hand : but I will harden his heart , that he shall not let the people go .
And a certain scribe came , and said unto him , Master , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .
translation.kha: U nonghikai Aiñ u la wan sha u .  Ko Nonghikai ,  u la ong ,  Nga la kloi ban leit bad me kat shaba me leit .

translation.en: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in , and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un tim ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba phi leh .

Ha ka por mynmiet ki loit sha ki krem bad sha ki jaka thap ban ïasyllok bad ki mynsiem Jong Ibbah ïap . Ki ba-ima dohthang sniang Bad ki dih ïa ka sirka ba la shet da ka doh ba la ai jingkha sha ki blei thala .
translation.en: Which remain among the graves , and lodge in the monuments , which eat swine s flesh , and broth of abominable things is in their vessels  ;
Which is the sweetest fruit ?
translation.kha: Uei u Soh u ba thiang bha ?

translation.en: When thou shalt vow a vow unto the  Lord  thy God , thou shalt not slack to pay it : for the  Lord  thy God will surely require it of thee  ; and it would be sin in thee .
translation.kha: Haba phi ai kano kano ka jingkular ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , wat pynslem ha kaba pyndep ïa ka , U  Trai  un bat ïa ka kular jong phi , bad ka long ka pop ban ym pyndep ïa ka .

translation.en: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes , and yet is not washed from their filthiness .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba tharai ba ki long kiba khuid hynrei kiba dap da ka tngit suda .

Phi lama kiba riewspah katta katta ha baroh uba phi dat : Ha ka jingngeit , ka jingkren , bad ka jingtip , ha ka jingangnud ba-bang ïarap bad ha ka jingieit jong phi ïa ngi . Bad kumta i'u kwah ïa phi ba long kiba sbun ruh ha kñia ka jingshakri jong ka jingieit .
translation.en: Therefore , as ye abound in every thing , in faith , and utterance , and knowledge , and in all diligence , and in your love to us , see that ye abound in this grace also .
So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel . And it came to pass , when the man of God saw her afar off , that he said to Gehazi his servant , Behold , yonder is that Shunammite :
translation.kha: Kumta ka la leit , bad ka leit sha u Lum Karmel , ha kaba u Elisha u don . U Elisha u la ïohi ïa ka , ba ka wan katba ka dang don kham ha pajih , bad u ong ha u Gehasi , u shakri jong u ,  Ha khmih — katai ka briew na Shunem ka wan !
Ki ïa-pyrta Uei ïa uwei pat : Bakhuid , Bakhuid , bakhuid ! U Trai Badonburom Baroh u long suba khup ! Ka burom jong u ka pyndap ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And one cried unto another , and said , Holy , holy , holy , is the  Lord  of hosts : the whole earth is full of his glory .

translation.kha: hynrei , Tang kawei kaba donkam . Ka mar ka la jied ïa kiei kaba dei , bad yn ym shimti noh ïa kata na ka .
translation.en: But one thing is needful : and Mary hath chosen that good part , which shall not be taken away from her .
Who , when he was reviled , reviled not again  ; when he suffered , he threatened not  ; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously :
translation.kha: Haba la krenbeiñ ïa u , um shym pynphai ktien kylliang da kaba krenbeiñ ; haba u shahshitom , um shym la byrngem , hynrei u la buh ïa la ki jingkyrmen ha U Blei , u Nongbishar bahok .

Hadien ngan sa theh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga ha uwei pa eiei : Ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi kin pynbna ïa ka khubor jongngi nga ; ki tymmen shynrang kin don ki jingphohsniew , bad ki samla shynrang jong phi kin ïohi ki jingïohipaw .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass afterward , that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh  ; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy , your old men shall dream dreams , your young men shall see visions :
Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee , and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king s meat : and as thou seest , deal with thy servants .
translation.kha: Te sa ïanujor ïa ngi bad ki samla shynrang kiba bam ïa ka jingbam jong ka ïingbishar syiem , bad pynshong nongrim ïa ka rai ka jong phi ha ka jingïohi kumno ngi long .
Na ki nongbah baroh jong ka bamaïan ki wan sha Ayyah ban ïabah pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: But the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together out of the cities unto Gibeah , to go out to battle against the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Em ! Ngam ha ban shu sngap jar ! Nga pita sad nga kthang mynsiem . Nga dei banbeiñ krensih .
translation.en: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth  ; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit  ; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul .

translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , ngan don ka daw ban sngewsarong ïa phi ha ka sngi jong U Khrist , namsop kan pyn-i ba baroh ka jingkyrpang bad ka jingtrei jongnga nga kam shym la long kaba lehnoh-ei .
translation.en: Holding forth the word of life ; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ , that I have not run in vain , neither laboured in vain .
A sword is upon the liars  ; and they shall dote : a sword is upon her mighty men  ; and they shall be dismayed .
translation.kha: Ka Jingïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bashukor jong ka — katno ki long kiba bieit ! Ka Jingïap ïa ki shipai jong ka — katno ki long kiba sheptieng !
U ju u la jubab ïa ki , U Ka jong nga u ïapoi trei , Bad ka dei ïa nga ruh ban Trei .
translation.en: But Jesus answered them ,  My Father worketh hitherto , and I work .

translation.kha: Ki la leit phai pat sha ki thup jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , kiba la kyntait ba leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; ki la mane ïa kiwei pateng ki blei . Baroh ar , ka Israel bad ka —Judah ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tmier jong ki .
translation.en: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers , which refused to hear my words  ; and they went after other gods to serve them : the house of Israel and the house of Judah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers .

translation.kha: Kumta , syiem kynrad , ai ka hukum ïa ngi bad ngin leit wad ïa u briew uba nang ban tem duitara . Te haba u mynsiem bymman u Wan ha phi , uta u briew un tem ïa la ka duitara , bad phin sa shait sa koit pat .
translation.en: Let our lord now command thy servants , which are before thee , to seek out a man , who is a cunning player on an harp : and it shall come to pass , when the evil spirit from God is upon thee , that he shall play with his hand , and thou shalt be well .

translation.kha: U Moses u thoh ïa ki hukum baroh jong U Trai . Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , u tei ïa ka kito ha trai jong u lum , bad u pynïeng duh Khat-ar tylli ki maw , uwei u maw na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait Israel .
translation.en: And Moses wrote all the words of the  Lord  , and rose up early in the morning , and builded an altar under the hill , and twelve pillars , according to the twelve tribes of Israel .

translation.kha: Ngi la kylli ïa u , Ko rangbah , Kine ki Kulai ki mut aïu ? U la Jubab Ngan pyn-i ïa phi ai ki kit jingmut .
translation.en: Then said I , O my lord , what are these ? And the angel that talked with me said unto me , I will shew thee what these be .
Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days , saith the  Lord . Thus far is the judgment of Moab .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ki sngi ki ban wan U  Trai  un pynlong ïa ka Moab kaba dap kyrhai sa shisien . Kane baroh ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong ba kan jia ïa ka Moab .

translation.en: How would you feel if you knew that a reunion with your loved ones was possible right here on earth under the best of conditions ?
translation.kha: Kumno phin sngew lada phi tip ba phin sa ia kynduh biang bad kiba ieit ki jongphi- ha kane ka pyrthei , hapdeng ka jinglong jingman ba bha tam .

Katba u Adonijah pynlang baroh kiba u la khot sngewbha ki dang shu lah bam , ki la jingsngewsih ïa ka jingsawa . Bad haba u Joab u la ïohsngew ïa ka turoi , u la kylli , kadei ka jingdam jong kata ka jingsawa barhem hapoh ka nongbah ?
translation.en: And Adonijah and all the guests that were with him heard it as they had made an end of eating . And when Joab heard the sound of the trumpet , he said , Wherefore is this noise of the city being in an uproar ?

translation.kha: Pynleit ïa ki briew’ jong me , A Trai ; isynei wat leh tyngeh halor jong ngi lane pynshitom ïa ngi haba me bitar ; kata ka la ban long ka mang jong ngi .
translation.en: O  Lord  , correct me , but with judgment  ; not in thine anger , lest thou bring me to nothing .

translation.kha: U Simon Petros , U Thomas ( ba la khot uba Kha Synrap ) , u Nathanael ( uto kiba na Kan ha Galilaïa ) , ki khun u Sebedi , bad ar ngut kiaw pat ki synran U Jisu ki la don Ngan .
translation.en: There were together Simon Peter , and Thomas called Didymus , and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee , and the sons of Zebedee , and two other of his disciples .

translation.kha: Ban ïada ïa la ki kut , un pyndonkam ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u blei nongwei . Un ai ka jingpyndonburom ka khraw ïa kito bakha pdiang ïa u kum u nongsynshar , un buh ïa ki ha ki jaka treikam ba-halor , bad un ai ka jaka ïa ki kum ka iphieng .
translation.en: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god , whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory : and he shall cause them to rule over many , and shall divide the land for gain .
That the kingdom might be base , that it might not lift itself up , but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand .
translation.kha: ban bat ïa ka ri na kaba ïeng biang bad ban pynthikna ba yn sumar ïa ka jingïateh lok .

Nangta nga la khmih biang ha baroh ki jinglehhok kaweh trei ha kane ka pyrthei . Kiba la shah banbeiñ ki lynñiar , badno ym don mano moi ban ïarap ïa ki . Ym ei mano mano banbeiñ ïarap ïa ki Naamah ki nongbanbeiñ jrong ki , ki anna ka bor ha ka liang jrong ki .
translation.en: So I returned , and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun : and behold the tears of such as were oppressed , and they had no comforter  ; and on the side of their oppressors there was power  ; but they had no comforter .

translation.kha: Ngi tip ka mut aïu ban sheptieng ïa U Trai , bad kumta ngi pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa kiwei . U Blei u thop lut shaneng jong ngi , nabar nga kyrmen ba ha ki ïaduna jong phoi , phi tip ïa nga kumjuh .
translation.en: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord , we persuade men ; but we are made manifest unto God ; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences .

translation.kha: Ki la sngewnguh ïoh mynsiem bad uwei aiwai na ki ruh , ki la bam kyndiah ka jingbam .
translation.en: Then were they all of good cheer , and they also took some meat .

translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohi ïa u angel uba ïeng ha shiteng suiñ , u da bat ïa la ka waitlam ha la ka ki , uba la pynkhynñiuh ban pynjot thiaw ïa ka Jeruel . Nangta u Dabid sad ki nongïalam jong ki paidbah — baroh na ki , uba la phong ki jaiñ khain — ki dem pynrit , sad la ki Khlieh kiba kynduh ha Madan .
translation.en: And David lifted up his eyes , and saw the angel of the  Lord  stand between the earth and the heaven , having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem . Then David and the elders of Israel , who were clothed in sackcloth , fell upon their faces .

translation.kha: Mynta , kane ka long ka jutang ïa kaba ngan pynlong bad ki pyntud Israel ha ki sngi ki ban wei , ong U Trai : Ngan buhai ïa ki suda jong nga ha ki jingat jong ki , bad len thoh ïa ki ha ki dohnud jong ki ; ngan long U Bela jong ki , bad ki kin long u paidlang jong la .
translation.en: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days , saith the Lord  ; I will put my laws into their mind , and write them in their hearts : and I will be to them a God , and they shall be to me a people :

translation.kha: U patsha ka Assyria u la phah ïa u rangbah synshar jong u , uba ha khlieh ban ïuhbeiñ ïa U Blei im . Ai ba U Trai U Blei jong phi un ïohsngew ïa kine ki jingbeiñ bad pynshitom ïa kito bakha klun ïa ki . Kumta to duwai ha U Blei na ka bynta kito ki brai jong ngi kiba lait im .
translation.en: It may be the  Lord  thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh , whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God , and will reprove the words which the  Lord  thy God hath heard : wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left .

translation.kha: Naduh kabu sdang u Ktien u la don bad U Blei .
translation.en: The same was in the beginning with God .

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingweng ïa kane , la rim noh ïa u shaei bneng kaban ki dang ïakhmih ïa u , mala u lyoh u la buhrieh ïa u na ka jingïohi jong ki .
translation.en: And when he had spoken these things , while they beheld , he was taken up  ; and a cloud received him out of their sight .

translation.kha: Ka um ka la tap Bad ka set myn ïa nga ; ka duriaw ka la thop lup ïa nga , bad ki phlang duriaw ki la sap baroh sawdong ïa ka khlieh jong nga .
translation.en: The waters compassed me about , even to the soul : the depth closed me round about , the weeds were wrapped about my head .

translation.kha: bad u la ong , Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba lymda phi! kylla bad long kum ki Khynnah , phin ym ïohrung da Lai lei shapoh ka Hima ki bneng .
translation.en: And said ,  Verily I say unto you , Except ye be converted , and become as little children , ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven .
And his father had not displeased him at any time in saying , Why hast thou done so ? and he also was a very goodly man  ; and his mother bare him after Absalom .
translation.kha: Mynta ba u Absalom u la ïap , u Adonijah , u khun jong u Dabid bad ka Haggith , u dei u khun heh uba dang im . U long u briew uba bhabriew . U Dabid um pat ju sneng tyngeh ïa u shaphang kano kano , bad u la kwah eh ban long syiem . U la pynkhreh ïa lade ki kali ïapom , ki kulai , bad ka kynhun synran kaba don sanphew ngut ki rangbah .

translation.en: At least once a year , a day is set aside to do a major cleaning .
translation.kha: Shisien shisnem , la buh ïa kawei ka sngi ban pynkhuid bha nadong shadong .
U Blei Badonbor Baroh un ym ni ïa kaba sniew ; um ju leh bymdei ïano ïano .
translation.en: Yea , surely God will not do wickedly , neither will the Almighty pervert judgment .
And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke , because the  Lord  descended upon it in fire : and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace , and the whole mount quaked greatly .
translation.kha: Ïa u Lum Sinai baroh uwei la tap da ka tdem , namar U  Trai  u la wan hiar ha u ha ka ding . Ka tdem ka kiew kum kaba mih na ka lawar ding , bad ki briew baroh ki la kyiuh shibun eh .
‘ Ka jingtim U balui sa hap ha uta u briew Uba pynkynriah ïa u mawpud jong u paramarjan .’ Bad u paidïapom baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour s landmark . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: Ki jingbam ba U Solomon u nongkam man ka sngi ki long san hajar kilo u pyrthiew bad shiphew hajar kilo ka jingbam ;
translation.en: And Solomon s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour , and threescore measures of meal ,

translation.kha: U lyngdoh jngai u phai Seus , uba ka templ jong u ka ïeng khim pynjuh shaba shnong , u la wallam ïa ki masi dab bad ki syntiew sha ka khyrdop , naba ma u nabar ki paidbah ki la kwah ban ai ka jingkieng shata ki apostol .
translation.en: Then the priest of Jupiter , which was before their city , brought oxen and garlands unto the gates , and would have done sacrifice with the people .

translation.kha: Ha ka shithi la thoh : Phi dei ki nongpeit ïa ki khuid ki ksiew Jong u syiem jong phoi bad phi don ruh bad phi ki kali ïalap , ki kulai , ki tiar ïapom bad ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh .
translation.en: Now as soon as this letter cometh to you , seeing your master s sons are with you , and there are with you chariots and horses , a fenced city also , and armour  ;
And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them , and said unto them , Ye are spies  ; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come .
translation.kha: U la kynmaw ïa ki jingphohsniew ba u la phohsniew shaphang jong ki , bad u ong ,  Phi dei ki nongsyntiat ; phi ïawan ban khmih ha-ei ka ri jong ngi ka shong tlot .

translation.en: And Leah conceived , and bare a son , and she called his name Reuben : for she said , Surely the  Lord  hath looked upon my affliction  ; now therefore my husband will love me .
translation.kha: Ka Leah ka la punkhun bad ka kha khun shynrang . Ka ong ,  U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa ka jingjynjar jong nga , bad mynta u tnga jong nga un ieit ïa nga  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Reuben .
Un pynïap ïa kawei na kita ki sim halor u khiew khyndew ha uba anna ka um kaba sngur na ka riewpoh .
translation.en: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water :

translation.kha: bakha shim ïa ki khyllung jong pha bad lynthaw ïa ki ha u mawsiang .
translation.en: Happy shall he be , that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones .

translation.kha: Bad kumta shisyndon nga la pha khoit ïa me , me ruh me la long kiba sbun eh ban wan . Mynmiet ngi baroh ngi don hangne ha ka jingdon ïaryngkat jong U Bel , da kaba ap ban ïohsngew ïa kano kano kaba U Trai u la bthei ïa me ban ong .
translation.en: Immediately therefore I sent to thee  ; and thou hast well done that thou art come . Now therefore are we all here present before God , to hear all things that are commanded thee of God .
And if there be in the bald head , or bald forehead , a white reddish sore  ; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head , or his bald forehead .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka prum kaba byrsaw-lieh ka mih ha ka jaka hap shñiuh , ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh .

translation.en: And that prophet , or that dreamer of dreams , shall be put to death  ; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt , and redeemed you out of the house of bondage , to thrust thee out of the way which the  Lord  thy God commanded thee to walk in . So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei pynïap ïa uno uno u nongïathuhlypa lane uno uno u nongbatai ïa ki jingphohsniew uba ong ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , uba la pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt , ha kaba phi la long ki mraw . Kum uta u briew u long uba bymman bad u pyrshang ban khring noh ïa phi na kata ka rukom im ba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi . Haba u briew u ïan shu dem shongkurim , ym dei ban phah ïa u sha ka thlim , ne pynkit ha u ïa kano kano ka kam bakhia hapoh shisnem , khnang ba un ïoh shong ha ïing bad lehkmen pynlang la ka tnga .
translation.en: When a man hath taken a new wife , he shall not go out to war , neither shall he be charged with any business : but he shall be free at home one year , and shall cheer up his wife which he hath taken .
My harp also is turned to mourning , and my organ into the voice of them that weep .

translation.en: Also take your flocks and your herds , as ye have said , and be gone  ; and bless me also .
For a whore is a deep ditch  ; and a strange woman is a narrow pit .
translation.kha: Ki nuti bad ki kynthei lyngkar ki long ka jingriam kaba shyrkhei .
bad kita ki masi kynthei katba raikhoh ki la bam-im lut plain ïa kita ki masi kyntur Ibbah sngaid . Nangta u syiem u la kyndit thiah .
translation.en: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine . So Pharaoh awoke .

translation.kha: Nga ong skhem ïa phi ba ïa ki briew ia Ban map ïa ki pop jong ki barieh , bad ïa borbah kiei kai ibha sniew kiba ki lah ban noh .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men , and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme :

translation.kha: Hato phiah rai pynrem ïa U blei uba hok ? Hattush phi pyrkhat ba U isih ïa ka jingbishar khop ?
translation.en: Shall even he that hateth right govern ? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just ?

translation.kha: Ïa ki biria Kiba la sohkhram , nga ne ka praw ym ka jong nga hynrei ka jong U Terah : Ka tnat kam dei ban iehnoh ïa la u tnga ;
translation.en: And unto the married I command , yet not I , but the Lord , Let not the wife depart from her husband :

translation.kha: U dieng uba plung bha um la ban pynmih ki soh kiba sniew , bad u dieng uba swai um ia ban pynmih ki soh kiba bha .
translation.en: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit , neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit .

translation.kha: Ki wanlam sha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ ïa kaei kai baroh kaba u Moses u la hukum , malu ki paidbah baroh ki ïalumlang ban mane ïa U Tharai .
translation.en: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation : and all the congregation drew near and stood before the  Lord .
Just as a wise and loving father instructs his children , so God teaches people everywhere the best way to live .
translation.kha: Kumba da jingstad bad jingieit u kpa u hikai ïa la ki khun , kumta ruh U Blei u hikai ïa ki briew katsha ba bha tam ka rukom ban im .

translation.en: Do ye thus requite the  Lord  , O foolish people and unwise ? is not he thy father that hath bought thee ? hath he not made thee , and established thee ?
translation.kha: Pleng da kumne mo phi siew kylliang ïa U  Trai  , a , phi ka jaitbynriew kaba bieit bad kaba anna ? Hato um dei u kpa jong phi , uba la thaw ïa phi , uba la seng ïa phi kum kawei ka jaitbynriew ?

Me la sngewsarong ba me long uba bhabriew , bad ka nam jong me ka la pynlong ïa me ban leh kum u bieit . Namar kane nga la bret ïa me shaw khyndew bad ih ïa me kum ka jingmaham ïa kiwei pat ki syiem .
translation.en: Thine heart was lifted up because of thy beauty , thou hast corrupted thy wisdom by reason of thy brightness : I will cast thee to the ground , I will lay thee before kings , that they may behold thee .

translation.kha: Ka Hebron ka dang dei ka jong ki khun ki ksiew jong u Kaleb , u khun jong u Jephunneh u nong Ken , namar ba u la kohnguh khak ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day , because that he wholly followed the  Lord  God of Israel .

translation.kha: Da kumta ki la khap shuh ka pyrem kba ïap pyntud bad ki jingdon jingem jong ki . Ka khyndew ka tap ïa ki , bad ki la bai jar .
translation.en: They , and all that appertained to them , went down alive into the pit , and the earth closed upon them : and they perished from among the congregation .

translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba u Stad saiñpyrkhat u long uba sngewstad , u ïai hikai ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba u tip . U la pule babniah ïa ki proberb dara da kaba sngur mynhynne u da tynjuh ïa ka jingjyrsieh jngai ki .
translation.en: And moreover , because the preacher was wise , he still taught the people knowledge  ; yea , he gave good heed , and sought out , and set in order many proverbs .
For I say unto you , that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me , And he was reckoned among the transgressors : for the things concerning me have an end .
translation.kha: Naba nga ong ha phi ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong , ‘ U la ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar jong kiba leh kam runar ,’ ka dei ban urlong shisha shaphang jong nga , namar kaei kaba la thoh shaphang jong nga ka wan jia shisha .

translation.en: And I will strengthen the house of Judah , and I will save the house of Joseph , and I will bring them again to place them  ; for I have mercy upon them : and they shall be as though I had not cast them off : for I am the  Lord  their God , and will hear them .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ki paid Judah ; ngan pyllait im ïa ki paid Israel . Ngan don ka jingsngewsynei ïa ki bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki baroh sha ïing . Kin long kum kiba ngam pat ju kyntait ïa ki . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ; ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .

translation.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign , and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hephzi–bah .
translation.kha: U Manasseh u la dap khat-ar snem ka rta mynba u long syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar sanphew san snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hephsibah .

translation.en: Then came his disciples , and said unto him , Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended , after they heard this saying ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong ,  Hato me tip ba la pynmong ïa ki jingsngew jong ki Pharisi da kaei kaba me la ong ?
bad shi kilo u pura lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .
translation.en: A several tenth deal unto one lamb , throughout the seven lambs  ;

translation.kha: Pynkhreh ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka bynta ka tdem pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia . Phah ïa ki syiem ka Media , ïa ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki , bad ki kynha shipai jong ki ri baroh kiba ki synshar .
translation.en: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes , the captains thereof , and all the rulers thereof , and all the land of his dominion .

translation.kha: Ki shong jngai bah na ki nongbet kiba khynwin ; bad ym don ba lah ban pynjuh bad pynthikna ïa ki .
translation.en: He scorneth the multitude of the city , neither regardeth he the crying of the driver .

translation.kha: Kaei Kaba khampoh ïa ka said , u Haman u ong Shuh shuh , ka Esther , ka mahadei , ka la pynlong ka jingkhawai ym na ka bynta jongno jongno , hynrei tang ïa u syiem bad ïa nga , bad la khot sngewbha biang ïa ngi na ka bynta la shai ka sngi .
translation.en: Haman said moreover , Yea , Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself  ; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king .

translation.kha: U briew baroh un khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka kyrteng jong phi .’
translation.en: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven , who shall hear report of thee , and shall tremble , and be in anguish because of thee .

translation.kha: Phi ïatip ba ngam shym la buhrieh ïa kano kano ka ban long ka jingïarap ïa phi haba la ïalap bad hikai ha ki paidbhur bun ha ki ïeng Jong phi .
translation.en: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you , but have shewed you , and have taught you publickly , and from house to house ,

translation.kha: Ka hima basarong jyllang pha kan jynthut bad kyllon , bad yn ym don ngab ïarap ban khyllie ïa pha . Ngan thang ïa ki nongbah da ka ding , bad kiei kiei baroh sawdong yn pynjot .
translation.en: And the most proud shall stumble and fall , and none shall raise him up : and I will kindle a fire in his cities , and it shall devour all round about him .

translation.kha: U Trai un pynsakma ïa phi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh , kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei , bad Hangta phin shakri ïa kiew pat ki blei Ibbah da ka dieng bad da u maïan , ki blei katba ma phira dara ki kpa tymmen lad phi phim paw ju mane mynshuwa .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall scatter thee among all people , from the one end of the earth even unto the other  ; and there thou shalt serve other gods , which neither thou nor thy fathers have known , even wood and stone .

translation.kha: Namar ba ngi don ïa kane ka jingkynrum , ngi long kiba shlur bha .
translation.en: Seeing then that we have such hope , we use great plainness of speech :
And she spake out with a loud voice , and said , Blessed art thou among women , and blessed is the fruit of thy womb .
translation.kha: bad ka la ong ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Pha long ka kynthei kaba la kyrkhu na baroh ki kynthei , bad long ba la kyrkhu ita i khunlung iba phan sa kha !
Nangta u pynkdang ki ïingjaiñ shipai ha ka ri jong ki , bad ki kylluid long ki raïot jong u bad ki sieh khajna Sha u . U Trai u ai jingjop ïa u Dabid ha kylleng .
translation.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria–damascus  ; and the Syrians became David s servants , and brought gifts . Thus the  Lord  preserved David whithersoever he went .
Then there came out a spirit , and stood before the  Lord  , and said , I will entice him . And the  Lord  said unto him , Wherewith ?
translation.kha: haduh ba u mynsiem u wan sha khmat , u wan ha U  Trai  , bad ong , ‘ Ngan shukor ma nga ïa u .’ ‘ Kumno ?’ U  Trai  u kylli .

Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki paidbah kiba la sah ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw ki la sngewkyiuh shaei ba la don tang kawei ka lieng hangta . Ki la tip ba U Jisu um shitrhem la kiew ha ka lymne bad ki synran jong u , hynrei ba ki la leit napoh khlem ma u .
translation.en: The day following , when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there , save that one whereinto his disciples were entered , and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat , but that his disciples were gone away alone  ;

translation.kha: Kumba ka Abihail ka ong , phin nym sngew sih kum kito “ki bymdon jingkyrmen .”
translation.en: As the Bible says , you will “not sorrow just as the rest also do who have no hope .”

translation.kha: Ka pyrda kaba wah ha ka Templ ka la kad arliang , naduh khlei haduh tbian .
translation.en: And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom .

translation.kha: To ki lum kiba naduh mynbarim kin dap kyrhai da u soh uba kynsit .
translation.en: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains , and for the precious things of the lasting hills ,

translation.kha: kumta U Trai u bitar ayu ïa ki Israel , pynlang u shah ïa ki phylliew bad ki Ammon ban iap ïa ki .
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines , and into the hands of the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: Haba ki Israel kiba shong Basaw ha ka Them Jesreel ki la jingsngewsih ba ka kynhun shipai ka la shet ïarap , bun ba u Salu dara ki khur shynrang jong u ki la ïap , ki iehnoh ïa la ki shnong bad ki phet ïap . Nangta ki Philistia ki waiñ bad ki shong ha ki .
translation.en: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled , and that Saul and his sons were dead , then they forsook their cities , and fled : and the Philistines came and dwelt in them .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ka khubor shaphang u Jisu ka la phriang stet kylliang ka probins jong ka Galilaïa .
translation.en: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee .

translation.kha: Dei ba-bang khleh ïa u bad ka umphniang malu shet ha u khihwin ba la slap bad nangta dei ban pynlwet ïa u mala ai kum ka jingainguh bam , ka jingwoh kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: In a pan it shall be made with oil  ; and when it is baken , thou shalt bring it in : and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka , Ka Bethel .
translation.en: And Jacob called the name of the place where God spake with him , Beth–el .

translation.kha: Ka dur ka i phyrnai la kum ka rnong hapdeng ka jing .
translation.en: And I saw as the colour of amber , as the appearance of fire round about within it , from the appearance of his loins even upward , and from the appearance of his loins even downward , I saw as it were the appearance of fire , and it had brightness round about .

translation.kha: Ngan pynphai pat ïa ki paid Isaia sha ka ri jong ki . Kin bam ïa ka jingbam kaba mih ha u lbong Karmel bad ha ki phang ka Bashan , bad kin bam ïa barieh kaba ki kwah na ki jingthung kiba mih ha ki kajuh jongnga ki Epaphras malu Gilead .
translation.en: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation , and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan , and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead .

translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa u Timothi bad u Erastos , ar ngut ki nongïarap jong u , sha Makedonia , katba u dang pyntbit sa katto katne Por ha ka probins jong ka Asia .
translation.en: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him , Timothy and Erastus  ; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season .
For every one shall be salted with fire , and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt .
translation.kha: Ïa baroh yn pynkhuid da ka ding kumba ïa ka jingkñia la pynkhuid da ka mluh .
U Jisu u la kiew halor ka Lieng bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleit malu u .
translation.en: And when he was entered into a ship , his disciples followed him .

translation.kha: to kyiuh ha khmat jong u , ko ka pyrthuh baroh ! Ïa ka pyrthei la pynskhem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah pynkhih shuh .
translation.en: Fear before him , all the earth : the world also shall be stable , that it be not moved .

translation.kha: Nga phla ïa baroh kaba nga la lai , bad me la jubab ïa at ; to hikai ïa nga ïa ki lyndang jong me .
translation.en: I have declared my ways , and thou heardest me : teach me thy statutes .
And the  Lord  said , Who shall persuade Ahab , that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead ? And one said on this manner , and another said on that manner .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylli , ‘ Uei u ban shukor ïa u Ahab khnang ba un leit bad shah pynïap ha Ramoth ?’

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  This kind can come forth by nothing , but by prayer and fasting .
translation.kha: Tang da ka jingduwai lah ban beh noh kum ïa une ,  u Jisu u la jubab ;  ym don kawei pat kaba lah .
Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u , ka dabi bad ka ksing ki kynrei ha Jerusalem kum ki maw , bad u dieng Kedar u jylliew kum u dieng Samgar .
translation.en: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones , and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance .

translation.kha: Kumba haba u paidbah u la ïalumlang , u iphylla u la kylli ïa ki , un na kine phi kwah ïa nga banbeiñ pyllait na ka bynta jrong phi ? Ïa u Jeshua Barabbas ne ïa U Jiw uba la khot U Messaïah ?
translation.en: Therefore when they were gathered together , Pilate said unto them , Whom will ye that I release unto you ? Barabbas , or Jesus which is called Christ ?
To whom hast thou uttered words ? and whose spirit came from thee ?
translation.kha: Mano , phi tharai u ban ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong phi baroh ? Mano ba la ai mynsiem ïa phi ban kren kumne ?
Slem katno u la long Kum ? U Jisu u la kylli ïa u kpa jong u . Naduh ba u dang rit , u la jubab .
translation.en: And he asked his father ,  How long is it ago since this came unto him ?  And he said , Of a child .

translation.kha: To sngem ha khmat kiba bun ïa iba baroh kiba leh ïa ki pop , khnang ba nam kiwei ruh kin sheptieng .
translation.en: Them that sin rebuke before all , that others also may fear .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la hiar na ka lieng , bad haba u la ïohi ïa u paidbah babun , ïa ka dohnud jongnga u la pyndap da ka jingisynei ïa ki , bad u la pynkhiah ïa kito kiba la pynbang .
translation.en: And Jesus went forth , and saw a great multitude , and was moved with compassion toward them , and he healed their sick .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trei , nga ong ba ka nga kan wan haba ngan pyndap ïa ka ri Israel bad Judah da ki briew bad ki mrad .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Judah with the seed of man , and with the seed of beast .
And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  : for ye have not walked in my statutes , neither executed my judgments , but have done after the manners of the heathen that are round about you .
translation.kha: Phin tip ba nga long U  Trai  bad ba katba phi dang bat ïa ki aiñ jong ki jaitbynriew ba-marjan , phi la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad khlem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga .

shawkad shaphang shathie sha ka shnong Aroer kaba harud ka wah Arnon — kane ka kynthup ïa ki thai jong ka Igdalaïah bad ka Baanah , ha kaba ki jait phad , Reuben , bad ki Manasseh kiba shaphang mangi ki shong ki sah .
translation.en: From Jordan eastward , all the land of Gilead , the Gadites , and the Reubenites , and the Manassites , from Aroer , which is by the river Arnon , even Gilead and Bashan .

translation.kha: Kan ïoh kyrhai u slap Bad kin thung ïa la u symbai ha ki lyngkha ba ïoh um bha . U syiem jongno ki un khim khraw ïa u Agag , badno ka har synshar jong u kan ïar kylleng shadong .
translation.en: He shall pour the water out of his buckets , and his seed shall be in many waters , and his king shall be higher than Agag , and his kingdom shall be exalted .

translation.kha: ka Bethpeor , ki sharing jong u Lum Pisgah , bad ka Bret Siphmoth .
translation.en: And Beth–peor , and Ashdoth–pisgah , and Beth–jeshimoth ,

translation.kha: Man ka jer , nga ai jingbam ha ka miej jong nga ïa shispah sanphew ngut ki Jiw malu ki nongïalam jong ki , nalor ki briew kiba wan sha de na ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong .
translation.en: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers , beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us .

translation.kha: Suit uwei baroh un ïakit ïa phi namar jong nga .
translation.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name s sake .

translation.kha: Ki lyngkha kin long shrah nabar kin ym seisoh shuh , naba kin dap da u kyndok bad ka nguh suda ; yn ym sting ei ei hangta , bad wiat u ñiup ruh , un ym mih hangta . Ka ri Jong phi kan long kum ki shnong Shemida bad Gomorrah , kum ka Admah bad ka Seboiim , ïa kiba U thri u la pynjot mynbarim u bitar shla .
translation.en: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone , and salt , and burning , that it is not sown , nor beareth , nor any grass groweth therein , like the overthrow of Sodom , and Gomorrah , Admah , and Zeboiim , which the  Lord  overthrew in his anger , and in his wrath :

translation.kha: U Paltiel u leit bud ïa ka haduh ka nongrit babuhrieh , u da ïam katai u dang leit . Hynrei u Abner u ong , Khie leit noh sha ïing , bad u leh kumta .
translation.en: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim . Then said Abner unto him , Go , return . And he returned .

translation.kha: U Trai u ieit ïa ka hok bad ka jingbishar hok ; ka jingieit baneh jong u ka pynjop ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: He loveth righteousness and judgment : the earth is full of the goodness of the  Lord .

translation.kha: To sumar , te , Namarba ba phim tip ha katno ka sngi ba U Tiras jong phi un wanrah .
translation.en: Watch therefore : for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come .

translation.kha: La hikai ïa u ha ka jingstad baroh jong ki nongot Ijipt bad u la long u biria uba khraw ha ki keiñ bad ki ki .
translation.en: And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians , and was mighty in words and in deeds .

translation.kha: Da kaba lyngngoh nabar shiliang , ki la ïai kylli uwei ïa uwei pait , Aïu kñia ka kit jingot ?
translation.en: And they were all amazed , and were in doubt , saying one to another , What meaneth this ?
Then answered Peter and said unto him , Declare unto us this parable .
translation.kha: U Petros u la kren ,  To batai ïa kane ka jingong ha ngi .
bad u ong , Mynta nga la dap shispah arphew snem bad ngam lah shuh ban long u nongïalam jong phi . Nalorkata , U Trai u la iathuh ha sa ba ngan ym ïoh ban jam ïa ka wah Jordan .
translation.en: And he said unto them , I am an hundred and twenty years old this day  ; I can no more go out and come in : also the  Lord  hath said unto me , Thou shalt not go over this Jordan .

translation.kha: To burom ïa ki riewkynthei kiba long tang marwei da shisha .
translation.en: Honour widows that are widows indeed .

translation.kha: Nga pynngat namar jong me , ko Jonathan u para jongki nga ; Katno me long uba na la sngewsih ! Katno phylla long ka jingieit jong me ïa nga , khim palat ban ïa ka jingieit ki kynteit .
translation.en: I am distressed for thee , my brother Jonathan : very pleasant hast thou been unto me : thy love to me was wonderful , passing the love of women .

And there was there with us a young man , an Hebrew , servant to the captain of the guard  ; and we told him , and he interpreted to us our dreams  ; to each man according to his dream he did interpret .
translation.kha: Uwei u samla Hebru u la don hangta lem bad ngi , uba dei u mraw jong u kapten jong ki nongap phira . Ngi la ïathuh ha u ïa la ki jingphohsniew , bad u la batai ïa ki ha ngi .
( Na ka bynta ki Pharisi , kumjuh ruh na ka bynta ki Jiw baroh , ki bud ïa ka jinghikai kaba ki la ïoh na ki kpa tymmen jong ki : Kim ju bam lymda ki siat ïa la ki katei ha ka mano kaba de ;
translation.en: For the Pharisees , and all the Jews , except they wash their hands oft , eat not , holding the tradition of the elders .
Speak now in the ears of the people , and let every man borrow of his neighbour , and every woman of her neighbour , jewels of silver , and jewels of gold .
translation.kha: Mynta kren ha ki paid Israel bad ong ïa ki baroh ban pan na la ki paramarjan ïa ki jingdeng ksiar bad ki jingdeng rupa .

translation.en: And when we were all fallen to the earth , I heard a voice speaking unto me , and saying in the Hebrew tongue ,  Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ? it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks .
translation.kha: Ngi baroh ngi la hap sha madan , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba kren ha nga ha ka ktien Hebru , ‘ Saul , Saul ! balei me pynshitom beiñ ïa nga ? Me pynmong ïa lade da kaba ïaleh pyrshah , kumba u masi dab u kynjat pyrshah ïa u dieng jong u kynrad jong u .’

translation.en: I am the  Lord  , your Holy One , the creator of Israel , your King .

translation.en: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities  ; but was in all points tempted like as we are , yet without sin .

translation.en: And said , O man greatly beloved , fear not : peace be unto thee , be strong , yea , be strong . And when he had spoken unto me , I was strengthened , and said , Let my lord speak  ; for thou hast strengthened me .
And it came to pass , when the angel of the  Lord  spake these words unto all the children of Israel , that the people lifted up their voice , and wept .

Khatduh u Paul u thoh shaphang kumno ban im ka jingim Khristan , khamtam shaphang ka lynti jong ka jingieit ha ka jingïadei bad kiwei pat . U thoh kiwei pat ki phangpdeng kum ka jingshakri ïa U Blei , ka kamram ki Khristan ha ka jingïadei bad ka hima sima bad ka imlang sahlang , bad ki jingkylli shaphang ka jingïatiplem . U lapbah ai hukum u la ong , Wat ïathuh hano hano ba me la ïathuh ïa kane ha nga . Susah u la phah noh ïa uba u samla .
translation.en: So the chief captain then let the young man depart , and charged him , See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me .
Nicodemus saith unto them , ( he that came to Jesus by night , being one of them , )
translation.kha: Uwei na ki Pharisi hangta u dei u Nikodemos , u briew uba la leit mynshuwa ban ïohi ïa U Jisu .

translation.en: And besought him greatly , saying , My little daughter lieth at the point of death : I pray thee , come and lay thy hands on her , that she may be healed  ; and she shall live .
translation.kha: bad u la kyrpad rit ïa u ,  Ka khun rit jong nga ka pang jur . To sngewbha ban wan bad buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ka , khnang ba kan khiah bad ïoh im .

translation.en: Ye are not straitened in us , but ye are straitened in your own bowels .
translation.kha: Ym dei ma ngi kiba la khang khop ïa la ki dohnud sha phi ; dei ma phi kiba khang khop ïa la ki dohnud sha ngi .
Ka kham bha kaba sah ha tnum ïing ban ïa kaba sah lang bad ka tnga kaba buiñ .
translation.en: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop , than with a brawling woman in a wide house .

translation.kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka hukum jong U Trai , khnang ban beh noh ïa ki briew ka Judah na khmat jong u namar ki pop baroh kiba u syiem Mahanaim u la leh ,
translation.en: Surely at the commandment of the  Lord  came this upon Judah , to remove them out of his sight , for the sins of Manasseh , according to all that he did  ;

translation.en: And there was a great famine in Samaria : and , behold , they besieged it , until an ass s head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver , and the fourth part of a cab of dove s dung for five pieces of silver .

translation.kha: Namar u Ahas u syiem Judah u la pynkheiñ ïa ki khak ki briew jong u bad u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai , U Trai u la wallam ki jingjynjar ha ka Judah .
translation.en: For the  Lord  brought Judah low because of Ahaz king of Israel  ; for he made Judah naked , and transgressed sore against the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba khak ki sumar ïa ka spah jong ki , hynrei ki bymman ki duh ei ïa la ka jong haba ki por kiba eh ki woh Nakon .
translation.en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure : but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ka jingsumar jong phi kan ym bteng . Namar ba phim shym kohnguh ïa u , U Trai un ïada ïa u briew uba u kiaw bad un thung ïa u ban longïng nongshoh-nar ïa ki briew jong u .
translation.en: But now thy kingdom shall not continue : the  Lord  hath sought him a man after his own heart , and the  Lord  hath commanded him to be captain over his people , because thou hast not kept that which the  Lord  commanded thee .
Meats for the belly , and the belly for meats : but God shall destroy both it and them . Now the body is not for fornication , but for the Lord ; and the Lord for the body .
translation.kha: Don uwei pat u ban ong ,  Ka jingbam ka dei na ka bynta ka kpoh , bad ka kpoh na ka bynta ka jingbam .  Ho-oid , hynrei U Blei un sa pynduh ïa baroh ar . Ïa ka met ym dei ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka kam awria , hynrei ïa ka ban shakri ïa U Trai ; bad U Trai u bsa ïa ka met .

translation.en: Then Manoah entreated the  Lord  , and said , O my Lord , let the man of God which thou didst send come again unto us , and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born .
translation.kha: Te u Manoah u duwai ha U  Trai  ,  A  Trai  , nga kyrpad ba men shah ïa u briew jong U Blei ïa uba me la phah ban wan biang sha ngi bad ban ong ïa ngi kaei ba ngin leh ïa uta u khunlung ynda la kha ïa u .

translation.en: So Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam , and Achbor , and Shaphan , and Asaiah , went unto Huldah the prophetess , the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah , the son of Harhas , keeper of the wardrobe  ; ( now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college  ; ) and they communed with her .
Thus shalt thou say to the prophet , What hath the  Lord  answered thee ? and , What hath the  Lord  spoken ?
translation.kha: Ko Jeremaïah , kylli ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , ‘ Kaei kaba U  Trai  u la jubab ïa phi ? Kaei kaba U  Trai  u la kren ?’

jynreiñ u Dabid u ong ïa u Abihu bad ïa u Jehubbah , u para jong u , Mano ba pan ïa ka jingmut na phi ? Hammoth phi thmu ban pynwit ïa nga ? mynba , nga de ma nga u Syiem jong ka Israel malade ha kane ka sngi yn ym pynpei ïa uno uno ruh u Israel .
translation.en: And David said , What have I to do with you , ye sons of Zeruiah , that ye should this day be adversaries unto me ? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel ? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel ?

translation.kha: Ki mawkyrdon ki lam sha ka kamra rung ha kaba ka la long shiphew mitar ka pyngkiang bad hynriew mitar ka jingjylliew . La don ar tylli ki païa , iwei ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka tynjuh .
translation.en: The length of the porch was twenty cubits , and the breadth eleven cubits  ; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it : and there were pillars by the posts , one on this side , and another on that side .
And Isaac his father answered and said unto him , Behold , thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth , and of the dew of heaven from above  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u Isaak u ong ha u ,  Ym don umjer na bneng na ka bynta jong me , Ym don lyngkha baseisoh na ka bynta jong me .
Ngi ïoh ban im ka jingrem jong ngi ha ka jingdum bad ka jingsngewsih kthang , i'u khuslai , bitar dara ïohpang .
translation.en: All his days also he eateth in darkness , and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness .

translation.kha: hynrei tang u rangbah lyngkdong uba rung sha ka bynta kaba shapoh jong ka Ïingjaiñ , bad u leh kumta tang shisien shisnem . U rah bad u ïa ka snam ïa kaba u ainguh ha U blem na ka bynta ïa lade bad na ka bynta ki pop ba ki briew ki leh khlem sngewtlot ba ki la ai nongpop .
translation.en: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year , not without blood , which he offered for himself , and for the errors of the people :

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingpyrta kaba jam , U jongu u la ïap .
translation.en: And Jesus cried with a loud voice , and gave up the ghost .

Ha kane ka prie ki la pyndep ka jingpyntieng ïa ka ri .
translation.en: These are the inheritances , which Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel , divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the  Lord  , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation . So they made an end of dividing the country .
Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land , a land of corn and wine , a land of bread and vineyards .

Uno uno ne uei uei uba ktieh ïa ka doh jong iathuh u jingkñia un mynsaw da ka bor jong ka jingkhuid jong ka . Ladan kano kano ka pyntha jong jaiñkup ka bit snam na uto u jingkñia , dei banbeiñ sait ïa ka ha ka jaka bakhuid .
translation.en: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy : and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment , thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place .
And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen , and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep : so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God .
translation.kha: U kñia arphew ar hajar tylli ki masi bad shi lakh arphew hajar tylli ki langbrot kum ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Bad kumta ma u bad uta u paidbah baroh ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
Lada nga peh samrkhie bad pyrshang ban klet ïa la ka jingpang , baroh ka jingshim jong nga ka wan biang ban pynkhuslai ïa nga . Nga tip ba U Blei u riat pynum ïa nga .
translation.en: I am afraid of all my sorrows , I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent .
For we are strangers before thee , and sojourners , as were all our fathers : our days on the earth are as a shadow , and there is none abiding .
translation.kha: Me tip , A Trai , ba ngi ïaid lyngba ïa ka jingim kum ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la leh . Ki sngi jong ngi ki long kum ka syrngiew bad ngin ym lait na ka jingïap .
U Blei u ong ha u Noah ,
translation.en: And God spake unto Noah , saying ,
Thou shalt not see thy brother s ox or his sheep go astray , and hide thyself from them : thou shalt in any case bring them again unto thy brother .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïohi ïa ka masi lane ïa ka langbrot u para Israel ba ka sakma , wat shu ieh ïa ka ; leit ïalam pat ïa ka sha u .
U kyndiah ïa kiba duk na ka khynñiuh ; u rah ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingsangsot jong ki ,
translation.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust , and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill  ;

translation.en: And the Chaldeans shall come again , and fight against this city , and take it , and burn it with fire .
But in the place which the  Lord  shall choose in one of thy tribes , there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings , and there thou shalt do all that I command thee .
translation.kha: hynrei leit rah ïa ki tang ha kawei ka jaka ha kaba U  Trai  un jied na ka ri jong kawei na ki jait jong phi , bad hangta phin leh ïa kita baroh kiba nga la hukum ïa phi .

translation.en: Fifty loops made he in one curtain , and fifty loops made he in the edge of the curtain which was in the coupling of the second : the loops held one curtain to another .
translation.kha: Ki buh sanphew tylli ki kyrwoh ha ka sut kaba nyngkong , bad sa sanphew tylli pat ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba khatduh , ba la suh lang ha ka sut kaba ar . Kita ki kyrwoh ki ïaphai marpyrshah .

Sngewbha shim hynriew hajar tylli ki lyngkhot rupa , u Naaman u jubab . U la ïai ban ïa kata , u la teh ïa ka rupa ha ki ar tylli ki pla , u la ai ïa ki bad ïa ki ar riam ki jaiñ ba-itynnat ha ki ar ngut ki shakri jong u , bad u la phah ïa ki ha shu jong u Geser .
translation.en: And Naaman said , Be content , take two talents . And he urged him , and bound two talents of silver in two bags , with two changes of garments , and laid them upon two of his servants  ; and they bare them before him .
But the word of God grew and multiplied .

translation.en: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit , after the tradition of men , after the rudiments of the world , and not after Christ .
translation.kha: Da khmih bha , te , ba uno uno un ym teh mraw ïa phi da ki buit shukor bymmyntoi jong ka jingstad ba kynja briew , kaba wan na ki jinghikai ba la ai pateng da ki briew bad na ki mynsiem kiba synshar ïa ka jingpynlong , bad ym na U Khrist .

translation.en: And a curse , if ye will not obey the commandments of the  Lord  your God , but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day , to go after other gods , which ye have not known .

translation.en: And ye shall be my people , and I will be your God .

translation.en: And some began to spit on him , and to cover his face , and to buffet him , and to say unto him , Prophesy : and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands .

translation.en: But Abraham said , Son , remember that thou in thy lifetime receivedst thy good things , and likewise Lazarus evil things : but now he is comforted , and thou art tormented .

translation.en: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet . For in that he put all in subjection under him , he left nothing that is not put under him . But now we see not yet all things put under him .

translation.en: But all their works they do for to be seen of men : they make broad their phylacteries , and enlarge the borders of their garments ,

translation.kha: Pynban , mynta me la leh khim badno , A Trai nongbishar ; me la pynlong ki jingkular shaphang ki khun ki ksiew jongngi nga ha ki snem ki ba-bang wan . Bun me shah ïa u brai ban ïohi ïa kane , A Tlai Nongsynshar !
translation.en: And this was yet a small thing in thy sight , O Lord  God   ; but thou hast spoken also of thy servant s house for a great while to come . And is this the manner of man , O Lord  God  ?

translation.kha: u Isaak u ong , Ko pa ! U jubab , Oi , khun ? U Isaak u kylli , Nga ïohi ïa ki rnga barhem bad ïa ki dieng , hynrei hangno pat u khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka jingkñia ?
translation.en: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father , and said , My father : and he said , Here am I , my son . And he said , Behold the fire and the wood : but where is the lamb for a burnt offering ?

translation.kha: Uei uba lah ban jop ïa ka pyrthei ? Tang u briew umbah ngeit ba U Jisu u long U Khun U blang .
translation.en: Who is he that overcometh the world , but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God ?

translation.kha: u pukni u her ha suiñ , u bseiñ u par halor u mawkyntang , ka liengbah kaba wad ïa la ka lynti ha ka tyrwa , bad u briew sad ka briew kiba ïashah jingieit .
translation.en: The way of an eagle in the air  ; the way of a serpent upon a rock  ; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea  ; and the way of a man with a maid .

translation.kha: Haba la dap hynñiew bnai , ki Israel ki la ïashongduh ha la ki shaneng jong ki . Nangno baroh ki ïalumlang ha Jerusalem ,
translation.en: And when the seventh month was come , and the children of Israel were in the cities , the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ka jingim jong kiba duk ka don ha ka jingïaleh batbor , hawei ki briew kiba ken ki Suki mynsngi ha ka jingim borabor .
translation.en: All the days of the afflicted are evil : but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast .

And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it , the  Lord  repented him of the evil , and said to the angel that destroyed the people , It is enough : stay now thine hand . And the angel of the  Lord  was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite .
translation.kha: Haba u angel U  Trai  u la jan pynjot ïa ka Jerusalem , U  Trai  u la kylla ka jingmut ban pynshitom ïa ki briew bad u ong ha u angel uba pynïap ïa ki ,  Sangeh ! Ka la biang katto !  U angel u la don hajan ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah , u nong Jebus .
Kam don jingbha ban thaw ïa ka dur nar ban mane kum u blei !
translation.en: Who hath formed a god , or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing ?

translation.kha: Yn ym don kawei ruh ka shngain ka ban lait na ka jingpynjot ; ki ri them pynlang ki ri thor kin shah pynjot . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And the spoiler shall come upon every city , and no city shall escape : the valley also shall perish , and the plain shall be destroyed , as the  Lord  hath spoken .
For this corruptible must put on incorruption , and this mortal must put on immortality .
translation.kha: Na kane u ba lalot rahah hab ban buh ha ka jing bymlalot , bad kaei kaba dei ban ïap ka dei ban kylla sha kaei ka bym dei ban ïap shuh .

translation.en: For now we see through a glass , darkly ; but then face to face : now I know in part ; but then shall I know even as also I am known .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngi ïohi mynta ka long kum ka dur kaba byrngut ha ka ïitkhmih ; nangta ngin sa ïohi markhmat . Kaei kaba nga tip mynta ka long tang katto katne ; nangta kan sa long kaba dap pura — kaba dap pura kum ka jingtip jong U Blei ïa nga .

translation.en: And they pitched one over against the other seven days . And so it was , that in the seventh day the battle was joined : and the children of Israel slew of the Syrians an hundred thousand footmen in one day .
translation.kha: Haduh hynñiew sngi ki Syria bad ki Israel ki shong ha la ki jaka sher dara marpyrshah kawei ïa kawei pat . Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ki sdang ïa ka jingïaleh , bad ki Israel ki pynïap da ki spah hajar ki Syria .
Ka lyer ka beh kat Sha kaba ka mon ; me ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ba ka pynmih , hynrei mem tip nangno ba ka waiñ lane shaei ba ka leit . Ka long kumta ïa uwei pa aiwai ïa uba la kha na U Mynsiem .
translation.en: The wind bloweth where it listeth , and thou hearest the sound thereof , but canst not tell whence it cometh , and whither it goeth : so is every one that is born of the Spirit .

translation.kha: To ka ri jong ki kad dap da u thoh uba ih kot kamon ka aïom , Bad kaba dap kyrhai da ki soh-ot kiba kynsai man la ka aïom .
translation.en: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun , and for the precious things put forth by the moon ,

translation.kha: Ha ka sngaid kaban bud , U Trai u la leh bania u la ong Bad ki jingri baroh Jong ki nong Ijipt ki la ïap , hynrei kawei duh na ki jingri jong ki Israel kam shym ïap .
translation.en: And the  Lord  did that thing on the morrow , and all the cattle of Egypt died : but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one .

translation.kha: Thaw sa ar tylli ki jingkah , kawei kaba da ka snieh jyllang ki langbrot shynna ba la wieh rong saw , bad kawei pat Kaba da ka snieh bha , ban long ka jingtap na shabar .
translation.en: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams  skins dyed red , and a covering above of badgers  skins .

translation.kha: Suit pa uwei na phi un rah ïa la u khiew buh ngin , un buhai hangta ïa ka jingiwbih , malu nangta un wanrah ïa ka sha ka duwan .
translation.en: And take every man his censer , and put incense in them , and bring ye before the  Lord  every man his censer , two hundred and fifty censers  ; thou also , and Aaron , each of you his censer .

translation.kha: u khun jong u sarew , u khun jongno u Reu , u khun jong u Peleg , u khun jong u Eber , u khun jong u Mahlah ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Saruch , which was the son of Ragau , which was the son of Phalec , which was the son of Heber , which was the son of Sala ,

translation.kha: Kaba naduh ba ngi la long kawei bad u ha ka jingïap kum ma u , ha kajuh ka manna ngin ïarung kawei sad u ha ka jingmihpat kumno ma u .
translation.en: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death , we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection :

translation.kha: U la ïoh hima kiwei pat ki ïakhun bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah laiphew sner .
translation.en: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years : and he died .
For there must be also heresies among you , that they which are approved may be made manifest among you .
translation.kha: (Khlem artatien ka don ka jingïapait hapdeng jong phi khnang ba yn ithuh shai ïa kita kiba leh ïa kaba dei .)

Hynrei hadien kata ki ïa-ong para ma ki , Ngin dat ban leh kumne ! Ngi don ka khubor baïap , bad ngim dei ban buh ïa ka tang ha lade hi . Lymda ngi ap rahah mynhynne ban ïathiah ïa ka , ngi thikna ba ngin Shah pynshitom . Ïa iing ïalute noh shisyndon ban ïathuh ha ki ngab pynïaidkam jong u syiem !
translation.en: Then they said one to another , We do not well : this day is a day of good tidings , and we hold our peace : if we tarry till the morning light , some mischief will come upon us : now therefore come , that we may go and tell the king s household .

translation.kha: Shim dara me shapoh kata ka lieng ïa u shngain bad ka kynthei na kawei pa kawei ka jait kparad bad jait sim baroh , na ka bna ba yn ri pyni ïa ki .
translation.en: Of fowls after their kind , and of cattle after their kind , of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind , two of every sort shall come unto thee , to keep them alive .

translation.kha: Ma phi naba hiarpateng na u Jakeh , u sharati jong U Blei , kiba hiarpateng na u Israel , ïa umbiah U Blei u la jied , kynmaw ïa ki kambah kaba U Blei u la leh bad ki jingbishar kiba u la ai .
translation.en: O ye seed of Israel his servant , ye children of Jacob , his chosen ones .

translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut , Kata ka long kumno ba U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng un leh ïa uwei pa uwei na phi lympat phi ïamap ïa la u Ahiman u para naduh ka dohnud .
translation.en: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you , if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses .

translation.kha: U ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa langbrot , bad u sait ïa ki donhok jem bad ki kjat-dien da ka um , bad u thang ïa ka khlain , ïa ka khleiñ bad ïa ki lyngkhuh doh baïar ha ka duwan , wohnia U tharai u la hukum . Kane ka jingainguh thang ka long ka jingkohnguh bam , bad ka jingjaw kaba pynbamphlang ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water  ; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar : it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour , and an offering made by fire unto the  Lord   ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Ym don jingbuh phud ïa ka jingdoh waiñ ; u syiad u la ai hukum ïa ki shatri ka ïingsyiem ba bhor ki lah ban dih katsha ki sngewkynduh .
translation.en: And the drinking was according to the law  ; none did compel : for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house , that they should do according to every man s pleasure .

translation.kha: Shim ruh uwei u kpu , uwei u kpu ba la khleh umphniang , bad iwei u kpu lyngkniap na kata ka sheng kpu ba la jingeh shad nga .
translation.en: And one loaf of bread , and one cake of oiled bread , and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before the  Lord  :

Beloved , when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation , it was needful for me to write unto you , and exhort you that ye should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints .
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , nga la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban thoh sha phi shaphang ka jingpynim kaba ngi ïoh lang , haba nga la shem ïa ka jingdonkam ban thoh shisyndon ban pynshlur ïa phi , ban ïaleh na ka bynta ka jingngeit kaba U Blei u la ai shisien ai ha ki briew jong u .

translation.en: Not that which goeth into the mouth defileth a man  ; but that which cometh out of the mouth , this defileth a man .
translation.kha: Kam dei kata kaba rung shapoh ka shyntur jong u briew kaba pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid kat kum ka lehniam ; pynban , dei kaba mih shabar na ka , kaba pynlong ïa u , u bymkhuid .
Sa shisien u Ebron u noh ha u , Haneng na kaba beh kthong ïa nga ! Balei nam pynpur ïa nga ba ngan pynïap ïa me ? Kumno shuh ngan dang nud ban peit ïa ka khmat u Joab u hynmen jongngi me ?
translation.en: And Abner said again to Asahel , Turn thee aside from following me : wherefore should I smite thee to the ground ? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother ?

And ye shall observe the feast of unleavened bread  ; for in this selfsame day have I brought your armies out of the land of Egypt : therefore shall ye observe this day in your generations by an ordinance for ever .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , namar dei ha kane ka sngi ba nga la ïalam noh ïa ki jait jong phi na ka ri Ijipt . Pateng la pateng phi dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka sngi kum ka Jingkhawai Niam .

translation.en: Give me understanding , and I shall keep thy law  ; yea , I shall observe it with my whole heart .
translation.kha: To batai ïa ka aiñ jong me ha nga , bad ngan kohnguh ïa ka ; ngan sumar ïa ka da ka dohnud jong nga baroh .

Ha ka hukum jong u ki um shalor jong ka suiñbneng ki kyrjaw ; u wallam ïa ki lyoh na naba kut jong ka pyrta . U pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ha u slap bad u phah ïa ka lyer na ka khem buh tiar jong u .
translation.en: When he uttereth his voice , there is a multitude of waters in the heavens , and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth  ; he maketh lightnings with rain , and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .

translation.kha: Bad ka bor U Trai ka la sdang ban pynkhlaiñ ïa u katba u dang don hapdeng Sorah dara Ethbaal ha ka jaka sher dara Jong ki Dem .
translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol .

Wherefore the  Lord  said unto Solomon , Forasmuch as this is done of thee , and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes , which I have commanded thee , I will surely rend the kingdom from thee , and will give it to thy servant .
