translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar ïa u Solomon , bad u la ong ha u ,  Namar ba me la leh khnang ban pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang ba me la ïateh bad nga bad ba mem kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , nga kular ban shim noh ïa ka hima na me bad ngan ai ha uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong me .

translation.en: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt , and that the  Lord  thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm : therefore the  Lord  thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban kynmaw ba phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt , bad ba nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , nga la pyllait im ïa phi da ka borbah jong nga . Dei namar kata ba nga hukum ïa phi ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton .
Ki la ïalumlang lai ban duwai kum ka kynhun , ryngkat lem bad ki kynthei bad ka marwei ka kmie jong U Jisu bad ki para shynrang jong u .
translation.en: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication , with the women , and Mary the mother of Jesus , and with his brethren .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel kin ym ïoh shongshit ha ka ri U thri ; hynriew ken hap leit phai sha Ijipt , bad ki hap ban ba-im ka jingmap ba la kheiñ sang ha Assyria .
translation.en: They shall not dwell in the  Lord s  land  ; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt , and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria .
Asshur shall not save us  ; we will not ride upon horses : neither will we say any more to the work of our hands , Ye are our gods : for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy .
translation.kha: Ka Assyria kan ym lah da lei lei ban pyllait im ïa ngi , bad ki kulai thma kim lah ban ïada ïa ngi . Ngin ym ong shuh ha ki bleithaw jong ngi ba ki long U Blei jong ngi . A  Trai  , me pyn-i jingisynei ha kito ki bym don uno uno sha uba ki lah ban phai .

translation.en: And Beth–peor , and Ashdoth–pisgah , and Beth–jeshimoth ,
translation.kha: ka Bethpeor , ki sharing jong u Lum Pisgah , bad ka Beth Jeshimoth .
U symboh u la sngew , hynrei namar ka soskular kaba u la lah pynlong ha khmat baroh ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong u , u la ai ki hukum ba ïa ka jingkwah jong ka yn ai .
translation.en: And the king was sorry : nevertheless for the oath s sake , and them which sat with him at meat , he commanded it to be given her .

translation.kha: Nangta ki shipai Rom lem bad u rangbah shipai jong ki bad ki nongjapan phira jong ki Jiw , ki la kem ïa U Jisu , ki la khum ïa u ,
translation.en: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus , and bound him ,
Yea , thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea , or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast .
translation.kha: Phin sngew kumba phi don halor ka duriaw-bah , phi ïohpang duriaw , shah pynshad kynting shajrong ha ka jingshah pynkhih ka liengbah .
Pynphai ïa ki khmat jong phi shawei pat na nga ; ki pynshohbieit ïa nga . U shñiuh jong phiah u shad kum ka kynhun ki blang kiba ïada sha trai jong ki lum ka Gilead .
translation.en: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel , and the hair of thine head like purple  ; the king is held in the galleries .

translation.kha: U Gad bad ki khun shynrang jong u : U Shebna , u Haggi , u Shuni , u Esbon , u Eri , u Arod , malade u Areli .
translation.en: And the sons of Gad  ; Ziphion , and Haggi , Shuni , and Ezbon , Eri , and Arodi , and Areli .

translation.kha: Nga la ïatyngkhuh ha phi ïa kane mynta ha Shua ba baroh kan jia , ba kumta haba kata kan jia , phin ïoh beit .
translation.en: And now I have told you before it come to pass , that , when it is come to pass , ye might believe .
And , behold , there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot , and subtil of heart .
translation.kha: Bad hangta ka la ïakynduh ïa u , ka da riam kum ka nuti bad ka da pyrkhat sniew .

translation.en: And he took them the same hour of the night , and washed their stripes  ; and was baptized , he and all his , straightway .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka kynta jong ka miet , u nongpeit phatok u la ïalam ïa ki bad u la sait ïa ki jingmong jong ki ; bad shisyndon la pynbaptis ïa u lem bad ka longïing jong u .
A Trai , U Blei lad ngi , ngi la khlam lang ïa kane ka spah baroh ban theh ïa ka templ ban pyndonburom ïa ka kyrtong bakhuid jong me , hynrei kane baroh ka la wan na me bad ka long ka jngai me .
translation.en: O  Lord  our God , all this store that we have prepared to build thee an house for thine holy name cometh of thine hand , and is all thine own .
And he shall bring them unto the priest , who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first , and wring off his head from his neck , but shall not divide it asunder :
translation.kha: Un wanrah ïa ki ha u lyngdoh , u ban kñia shuwa ïa ka sim na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka pop . Un khyrwait ïa ka ryndang jong ka khlem da pyndkut ïa ka khlieh na ka ,

translation.en: He said unto them ,  Give place : for the maid is not dead , but sleepeth .  And they laughed him to scorn .
translation.kha: u la ong ,  To ïamihnoh shabar baroh ! Ka khynnah rit kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !  Te ki baroh ki la ïa-rkhie ïa u .

translation.en: But as for the mighty man , he had the earth  ; and the honourable man dwelt in it .
translation.kha: Phi pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong phi bad ïa ka kyrdan jong phi ban shim noh ïa ka jaka baroh .
namar ba ki khun ki ksuid kynthei jong u bad ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u ki la ïoh jaka . Ïa ka ri Gilead la ai ha Kiba sah jong ki khup ki khiew u Mnason .
translation.en: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons : and the rest of Manasseh s sons had the land of Gilead .

translation.kha: Nalorkata u Pharaoh u phah khot ïa ki riewstad bad ïa ki nongleh myntor jong u , bad ki ruh ki leh kumjuh da ka myntor jong ki .
translation.en: Then Pharaoh also called the wise men and the sorcerers : now the magicians of Egypt , they also did in like manner with their enchantments .

translation.kha: Ki synran ki la khana kumba san ne hynriew kilomitar long ki la ïohi ïa U jongu ba u ïaid hajar ka um , u la nang wan sha jlan ka lieng , bad ki la sngewtriem .
translation.en: So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs , they see Jesus walking on the sea , and drawing nigh unto the ship : and they were afraid .

translation.kha: Baroh ki briew kiba la ïohi ïa Katai ki la sdang ban khñium , Une u briew u la lytar kum umbah shah khot sngewbha shai ka iing jongngi u nongjop !
translation.en: And when they saw it , they all murmured , saying , That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner .
And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar , as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings : and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin , and it shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: Nangta un thang ïa ka khleiñ jong u baroh halor ka duwan , kumba ju thang ïa ka khleiñ jong ki mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u nongsynshar , bad yn map ïa u .
Kumta u Asa u shim rupa mala ksiar na ka jingkynshew jongnga ka Templ bad ka ïingsyiem bad phah sha Damaskos , sha u Benhadad u syiem Sirion , ryngkat bad kane ka khubor :
translation.en: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the  Lord  and of the king s house , and sent to Ben–hadad king of Syria , that dwelt at Damascus , saying ,

translation.kha: To ai ba ka jingaiei U Trai Jisu Khrismas lai long lem bad phi baroh .
translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit . Amen .

translation.kha: haba wanrah kham bun ki jingri , ïa ki jingainguh bynrap dei ban pynbud kat ban ïabiang .
translation.en: According to the number that ye shall prepare , so shall ye do to every one according to their number .

translation.kha: Da U Mynmiet bakhuid me la kren lyngba u Nadab u kpa tmain jong ngi , u shatri jongngi me , haba u la ong , ‘ Balei ba ki Jentil ki bitar shla ; balei ki briew ki thaw ïa ki jingsylla bymmyntoi ?
translation.en: Who by the mouth of thy servant David hast said , Why did the heathen rage , and the people imagine vain things ?

translation.kha: Ha ka jingleit kaba ar u Jehosheba u la pyniwtung ïa lade ha la ki hynmen shynrang , bad u syiem ka Ijipt u la Ïohi jingtip shaphang ka longïing jong u Joseph .
translation.en: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren  ; and Joseph s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh .

translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , to khie ne ! Khie joit ïa lade malade ïing ! Pha la dih ïa ka khrai ka jingpynshitom kaba U thri ha ka jingbitar jong u , u la ai ba phlang dih ; phalang dih lut ïa ka , bad ka la pynlong ïa pha baneh ïaid sheng sheng .
translation.en: Awake , awake , stand up , O Jerusalem , which hast drunk at the hand of the  Lord  the cup of his fury  ; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling , and wrung them out .

translation.kha: Ki jubab , Lada phi lehsbun ïa kine ki bri bad phi pyrshang shun ïasngewbha ïa ki , da kaba ai ka jubab kaba im kine shakri hok ïa phi borabor .
translation.en: And they spake unto him , saying , If thou be kind to this people , and please them , and speak good words to them , they will be thy servants for ever .

So Haman came in . And the king said unto him , What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour ? Now Haman thought in his heart , To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Haman u wan shapoh , bad u syiem u ong ha u ,  Don uba nga kwah eh ban lehburom . Kaei kaba ngan leh na ka bynta une u briew ?  U Haman u la pyrkhat ha lade ,  Mynta ïano u syiem u kwah eh ban pyndonburom ? Dei ïa nga keiñ .

translation.en: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance , in the chambers of their kings .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ri jong ki la pyndap da ki jakoid , wat ïa ka ïingsyiem la pyndap da ki .
nga la lynghoh bad phoi la pynkup jaiñ ïa nga ; nga la pang bad phi la Shim ban sumar ïa nga , nga la don ha ïingbyndi bad phi la wan jngoh ïa nga .’
translation.en: Naked , and ye clothed me : I was sick , and ye visited me : I was in prison , and ye came unto me .

translation.kha: Lada u nongïathuhlypa u shah shukor ban ai ki jubab kiba barew , ka dei namar ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la sukher ïa u . Ngan weng ïa u na ki paid Israel .
translation.en: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing , I the  Lord  have deceived that prophet , and I will stretch out my hand upon him , and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel .

translation.kha: U Troas u la lei ïa u Moses banbeiñ ong ha ki Israel : Phi la ïohi kumno ma nga , U tharai , nga la kren ha phi na bneng .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel , Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven .
And it shall be , if thou do at all forget the  Lord  thy God , and walk after other gods , and serve them , and worship them , I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish .
translation.kha: Lada phi klet ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad phi phai sha kiwei pat ki blei ban mane bad ban shakri ïa ki , nga maham jur ïa phi ha kane ka sngi ba phin ïap da shisha .
Haba ki hynñiewphew snieh ki la kut , U Trai un sa shah ïa ka tlor ban leit phai pat shiah ka kam khaïi kambah mynshuwa , bun Kan aiwai ïa lade shad baroh ki hima jong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years , that the  Lord  will visit Tyre , and she shall turn to her hire , and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth .

translation.kha: dara barben kin pynmanbha shynna ba U Ujuh Krit u long U Trai , ïa ka burom U Blei uba U Kpa .
translation.en: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord , to the glory of God the Father .
If I have withheld the poor from their desire , or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail  ;
translation.kha: Ngam pat ju kyrngah ban ïarap ïa kiba duk ; ngam pat ju shah ïa ki riewkynthei ban im jynjar

U la jubab , Ka ithuh jia ryngkhat ba nga don ha u Lum Gilboa , bad nga la Ïohi ïa u Shaul ba u dang shaniah ha la u sum katba ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai jong ki nongshun ki la hajan jong u .
translation.en: And the young man that told him said , As I happened by chance upon mount Gilboa , behold , Saul leaned upon his spear  ; and , lo , the chariots and horsemen followed hard after him .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ki briew ka Israel kin ïohktah ïa kaei Kaba ïangat sah jong ka ri Edom bad ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba shisien ki long ki jong nga , ong U Tlai , u ban Pynlong ïa kane banbeiñ jia .
translation.en: That they may possess the remnant of Edom , and of all the heathen , which are called by my name , saith the  Lord  that doeth this .

translation.kha: Katba ki jingjynjar ki on jur , u Ahas u la ar pop sha shuh pyrshang ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the  Lord  : this is that king Ahaz .

translation.kha: Kumta te , haba u briew u smai da ka kharai , u shaei da ka sad da barieh ki jingai sngewbha halor jong ka ;
translation.en: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar , sweareth by it , and by all things thereon .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , to sheptieng ïa ka waitlam — ka waitlam kaba wanrah ïa ka jingat U Blei halor ka pop , khnang ba phiah tipthuh ba don uwei uba bishar .
translation.en: Be ye afraid of the sword : for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword , that ye may know there is a judgment .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ba un buh ka lyngkor nar halor Kin ki jaitbynriew baroh bad ba Kin shakri ïa u shym Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilonia . U Trai u la ong ba un pynlong wat ïa ki mradkhlaw ban sakhrai ïa u Nebukhadnessar .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations , that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon  ; and they shall serve him : and I have given him the beasts of the field also .

translation.kha: Ki la khang ïa ka lynti phut jong nga bad pyrshang ban pynjot ïa nga ; malu ym don mano mano ban pynsangeh ïa ki .
translation.en: They mar my path , they set forward my calamity , they have no helper .

translation.kha: Ki Isaia ki phew ïap na ki Judia , bad U Blei u shah ïa ki Judia ban thombor ïa ki .
translation.en: And the children of Israel fled before Judah : and God delivered them into their hand .

translation.kha: Ki briew kin shongsuk kin sah ha Judah bad ha baroh ki shnong jong ka , bad kin ne ki nongrit , bad ki nongjapan langbrot ryngkat bad ki kynhun langbrot jong ki .
translation.en: And there shall dwell in Judah itself , and in all the cities thereof together , husbandmen , and they that go forth with flocks .
A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land  ;
translation.kha: Kaba sngewshyrkhei bad kaba sngewkyndit ka la jia ha kane ka ri :

translation.en: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem , in the second month , began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites , and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem  ; and appointed the Levites , from twenty years old and upward , to set forward the work of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ha u bnai ba ar jong ka snem hadien ba ki la wan pat sha ka jaka jong ka Templ ha Jerusalem , ki sdang ban ïatrei . U Serubbabel , u Joshua bad kiwei pat ki para rangbah ka ri , ki lyngdoh , bad ki Lebi , ha ka jingshisha , baroh kiba shah ringmraw kiba la wan phai pat sha Jerusalem , ki la ïasnohkti lang ha ka jingtrei . Ïa baroh ki Lebi kiba la dap arphew snem ka rta lane tam , la buh ban khmih ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka Templ .

Nangta u la ong , Ko Daniel , to wat sheptieng . U Blei u la shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong me naduh ka sngur kaba nyngkong ba me la kut jingmut banbeiñ pynrit ïa lade khnang ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngem . Nga la wan ban ai jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong me .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , Fear not , Daniel : for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand , and to chasten thyself before thy God , thy words were heard , and I am come for thy words .
You are welcome .
translation.kha: Ym lei lei .

translation.en: And a stone of stumbling , and a rock of offence , even to them which stumble at the word , being disobedient : whereunto also they were appointed .
translation.kha: Bad kawei pat ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Une u long u maw u ban pynlong ïa ki briew ban jynthut , u mawsiang u ban pynlong ïa ki ba kin kyllon .  Ki la jynthut namar ba kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka ktien , katta ka la long ka mon U Blei ïa ki .

translation.en: And Mary said , My soul doth magnify the Lord ,
translation.kha: Ka Mari ka la ong ,  Ka dohnud jong nga ka ïaroh ïa U Trai ;

translation.en: And Moses called unto all Israel , and said unto them , Ye have seen all that the  Lord  did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh , and unto all his servants , and unto all his land  ;
translation.kha: U Moses u khot lang ïa ki Israel baroh , bad u ong ha ki ,  Phi la ïohi da lade hi aïu U  Trai  u la leh ïa u Pharaoh ha Ijipt , ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei .

translation.en: And he brought the burnt offering , and offered it according to the manner .
translation.kha: U wanlam ruh ïa u mrad na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang , bad u kñia ïa u katba kum ka jingbuhbeit ryntih .

translation.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga pynpaw ïa la ka jingieit ha ki hajar ki pateng kiba ieit ïa nga , bad kiba sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga .

U Blei um Shim la kyntait ïa la ki jongngi ki briew , ïa kba u la jied haduh kiba sdang . Phi tip ïa kaei kaba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ha ka jingïathiah shaphang u Elijah ba u ïasah bad U Blei pyrshah ïa ki Israel :
translation.en: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew . Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias ? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel , saying ,

translation.kha: Ki lwet ki bym ïoh jingïarap ki dem ha ka jinglwet ; ka jingkhlaiñ ba thombor ka la iap ïa ki .
translation.en: He croucheth , and humbleth himself , that the poor may fall by his strong ones .

translation.kha: Ki da ban shata ba khlaiñ haba moi jingkam ïa ki , hynrei kin ïahap haba sem ïoh leh dusmon ïa ki !
translation.en: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave  ; and whole , as those that go down into the pit :
Which remain among the graves , and lodge in the monuments , which eat swine s flesh , and broth of abominable things is in their vessels  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka por mynmiet ki leit sha ki krem bad sha ki jaka tep ban ïasyllok bad ki mynsiem jong kiba ïap . Ki bam doh sniang bad ki dih ïa ka syrwa ba la shet da ka doh ba la ai jingkñia sha ki blei thala .
Ki briew ki kyr-ang jam , Ka lyiur ka la leit , ka jingot ka la kut , hynrei ym shym la pynim ïa ngi .
translation.en: The harvest is past , the summer is ended , and we are not saved .
I will not conceal his parts , nor his power , nor his comely proportion .
translation.kha: Shah ngan ïathuh ïa me shaphang ki khohwah jong u Lebiathan bad batai haduh katno u long uba khraw bad uba khlaiñ .
Kumba ki paid Israel ki la sheng la sah ha ka ri ki sympat ,
translation.en: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites .

translation.kha: Kane ka dadien ka khubor kaba U blei u la ai ha u Isaïah u khun jong u Amnon shaphang ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem :
translation.en: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Namar kaei kaba la jia ha ka Sarah , ka tnga jong u Abraham , U Trai u la pynlyngki ïa ki kynthei baroh ha ka ïingsyiem jong u Abimelekh . Kumta u Abraham u duwai na ka bynta u Abimelekh , bad U Blei u la pynkhiah ïa u . U la pynkhiah shiah ïa ka tnga jong u , pynlang ïa ki mraw kynthei jong u , ba kumta ki ruh ki lah baneh ïoh khun .
translation.en: For the  Lord  had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech , because of Sarah Abraham s wife .

How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings , that publisheth peace  ; that bringeth good tidings of good , that publisheth salvation  ; that saith unto Zion , Thy God reigneth !
translation.kha: Katno ka long kaba phylla ban ïohi ïa u nonglamktien ba u wan na ki lumbah , u wanrah ïa ka khubor babha , ka khubor jong ka jingsuk ! U pynbna ïa ka jingjop bad u ong ïa ka Seïon ,  U Blei jong phi u long u syiem !
Mynta ka Deborah , ka tnga jongu u Lappidoth , ka longïng ka nongïathuhlypa , bad ka shakri kum ka nongbishar ïa ki Israel ha kata ka par .
translation.en: And Deborah , a prophetess , the wife of Lapidoth , she judged Israel at that time .

translation.kha: Phi longsem ba la tim ! Ki nongjop ïa ki klong waiñ ! Kiba shkor bad ki bym tieng ha kaba ïadei bad ki jingdih ba la khleh !
translation.en: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine , and men of strength to mingle strong drink :

translation.kha: ibha u la poi ha ïing , um shym shah ïano ïano ban rung shapoh bad u lait noh u Petros , u Ïoannis bad u Jakob , bad u kpa bad ka kmie jong ka khynwin .
translation.en: And when he came into the house , he suffered no man to go in , save Peter , and James , and John , and the father and the mother of the maiden .

translation.kha: Haba ym don pisa shuh ha Ijipt bad ha Kenan , barhem ki nong Ieit ki ïawan shwa u Jehoash , bad ki ong , Ai jingbymman ba ngin bah ! Wai ai ba ngin shuki ïapthngan ! Ngim don pisa shuh .
translation.en: And when money failed in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , all the Egyptians came unto Joseph , and said , Give us bread : for why should we die in thy presence ? for the money faileth .

translation.kha: Namar ka jingleit ïa kaba kum Kanneh ka jingleh barunar , u dei banbeiñ buria synsar shah ïa kaba u la shim .
translation.en: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold , because he did this thing , and because he had no pity .

translation.kha: Bun ki nongsakhi ki la shu sakhi lamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu , hynrei ki jingïathuh jong ki ktem ïahap sahit .
translation.en: For many bare false witness against him , but their witness agreed not together .

translation.kha: Ïa ka khlieh la wallam shapoh ha ka pliang bad la ai ha ka khynnah , kaba la rem ïa ka Sha la ka kmie .
translation.en: And his head was brought in a charger , and given to the damsel : and she brought it to her mother .
Behold , I Paul say unto you , that if ye be circumcised , Christ shall profit you nothing .
translation.kha: To shahshkor! Nga , u Paul , nga ïathuh ha phi ba lada phi shah ban otsher ïa lade , ka mut ba U Khrist un ym myntoi da lei lei ïa phi .
hynriew ka khubor shaphang U Ujuh ka la kham phriang khyllung , bad ki paidbah pyllun ki la wan pun sngur ïa u bad ban ïoh jingpynkhiah na ki jingong jongngi ki .
translation.en: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him : and great multitudes came together to hear , and to be healed by him of their infirmities .

translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki imat ïa kaei kaba U Trai’ u la law .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron did as the  Lord  commanded them , so did they .

translation.kha: Ka Rakhel ka la shim ïa kita ki blei ïing malade ka la lah thep ïa ki hapoh ka jin ut bad ka shong halor jong ki . U Laban la u jar kylliang hapoh kata ka ïingjaiñ , hynrei um lapsan ïa ki .
translation.en: Now Rachel had taken the images , and put them in the camel s furniture , and sat upon them . And Laban searched all the tent , but found them not .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingsawa Jong ki shipawa shong kulai bad jong ki nongsiatkhnam , iwei uwei baroh u phet krad . Katto katne kin phet sha khlaw , kiwei keiñ ïakiew shajrong hapdeng ki mawsiang . Ïa kawei pa kaweh ka shnong yn ioh thylli , bad yn ym don une uno u ban shong ban sah pat ha ki .
translation.en: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen  ; they shall go into thickets , and climb up upon the rocks : every city shall be forsaken , and not a man dwell therein .

translation.kha: Ha ka snoh kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingïashun u Jeroboam uba ar u syiem ka Israel , u Ussaïah u khun jong u Asalaïah u long u syiem ka Judah
translation.en: In the twenty and seventh year of Jeroboam king of Israel began Azariah son of Amaziah king of Judah to reign .

translation.kha: U shym u la phah khoh ïa u Joseph , bad mar kumto la wan sei ïa u na ka byndi . Ynda u la dep kada tmain bad bujli jaiñjot , u leit ha khmat u symboh .
translation.en: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph , and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon : and he shaved himself , and changed his raiment , and came in unto Pharaoh .
This is he , of whom it is written , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .
translation.kha: Naba u Ïoannis u long uta uba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong : ‘ U Blei u la ong , ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien ha shuwa jong me ban plie ka lynti na ka bynta jong me .’
Nangta u Moses bad u Aaron ki la em mynshem ha madiah ha khmat uta u paidbah baroh .
translation.en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel .
He that loveth silver shall not be satisfied with silver  ; nor he that loveth abundance with increase : this is also vanity .
translation.kha: Lada phi ieit ïa ka pisa da lei lei ruh phin ym ïoh jinghun , lada phi angnud ban riewspah , phin ym ïoh ïa baroh kaba phi kwah . Ka long ka bymmyntoi .

translation.en: And David said to Achish , Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do . And Achish said to David , Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever .
translation.kha: Da shisha  u Dabid u jubab ,  Nga long u shakri jong phi bad phin sa ïohi da lade kaei ba nga lah ban leh .  U Akhish u ong ,  Ka biang ! Ngan pynlong ïa phi u nongïada jong nga shi rta .
Nangne phan leh ïa kaei Kaba nga la leh . Phan ym tap ïa la ki khmat lane bam ïa ka jingbam kob ki nongïam pangnud ki bam .
translation.en: And ye shall do as I have done : ye shall not cover your lips , nor eat the bread of men .

translation.kha: U Adrammelekh u ong , Ngam shym tip mano ba la leh ïa kane . Mem shym la ïaheh ei ei shaphang kane ha nga , bad kane ka long ka sien kaba nyngkong ba nga la jingïohknieh ïa ka .
translation.en: And Abimelech said , I wot not who hath done this thing : neither didst thou tell me , neither yet heard I of it , but to day .

translation.kha: Nangta u la phah ïa u rangbah pyndum slem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah ban wanlam ïa u Elijah . U rangbah pynïaidkam u shem ïa u ba u shong phalor u lum badno u ong ha u , Ko briew jong U Blei , u syiem u hukum ïa phi ban ïan hiar shane .
translation.en: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty . And he went up to him : and , behold , he sat on the top of an hill . And he spake unto him , Thou man of God , the king hath said , Come down .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki leh katba ki sngewkhia . Baroh ka long kajuh ïa ki , la ki pynïap ïa u masi kyrtong kum ka jingkñia lane jingkñia da u briew ; la ki kynsha da u jinglongbriew lane ki pyndkut ïa ka rmiang u ksew ; la ki wanrah ka jingainguh kew ne ki ingiew da ka snam sngur ; la ki thang jingiwbih ne ki duwai ha ka bleithaw . Ki shem sngewbha ha ki rukom ba-ijli ha ka jingmane .
translation.en: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man  ; he that sacrificeth a lamb , as if he cut off a dog s neck  ; he that offereth an oblation , as if he offered swine s blood  ; he that burneth incense , as if he blessed an idol . Yea , they have chosen their own ways , and their soul delighteth in their abominations .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la shaei ka jingsmai : Kaei kaba nga la thmu kan jia . Kaei kaban nga la kut jingmut ban leh yn pyndep .
translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts hath sworn , saying , Surely as I have thought , so shall it come to pass  ; and as I have purposed , so shall it stand :

translation.kha: Nangta at la ïohi ïa ki khet bad ha kito kiba shongsah ha ki la ai ïa ka bor ban bishar . Nga la ïohi ruh ïa ki mynsiem jong kito katba la shah pynsep namar ba ki la pynbna ïa ka jingshisha ïa kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw bad ïa ka ktien U Blei . Kim shym la mane ïa u mradkhlaw lane ïa ka trud jongngi u , Lym ba ki la ïa-pdiang ïa ka spah jong u mradkhlaw ha ki shyllangmat jong ki lynti ha ki kti lad ki . Ki la im pat bad ki la synshar kum ki syiem malade U Khrist shihajar snem .
translation.en: And I saw thrones , and they sat upon them , and judgment was given unto them : and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus , and for the word of God , and which had not worshipped the beast , neither his image , neither had received his mark upon their foreheads , or in their hands  ; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years .

translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban kein khyndiat , kaba la kamon da ka hok , ban ïa kaba ïoh Shion , ba la lum da ka jingbymlehhok .
translation.en: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right .

translation.kha: Un ïap ha ka ri sha kaba ki la rah ïa u , bad un ym ieh Shuah ïa kane ka ri .
translation.en: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive , and shall see this land no more .

translation.kha: hynrei ma Shim la shah kynnoh pop ïa kano kano ka jingïaleh pynmynsaw , bad ka jingduwai jongngi nga sha U Blei ka long kaba beit .
translation.en: Not for any injustice in mine hands : also my prayer is pure .
And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled , then fled they also before Abishai , and entered into the city . So Joab returned from the children of Ammon , and came to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Haba ki Ammon ki ïohi ba ki Syria ki la her ïap , ki ruh ki la phet krad na u Abishai bad ki leit rung noh shapoh ka nongbah . Nangta u Joab u wan phai noh na ka jingïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad u leit noh sha Jerusalem .
U nongsuhjaiñ u ong , ‘ Ngan beh kthong bad kem ïa ki , nur-um ïaiban ïa ka spah jong ki , bad ngan shim kat ïa kaba nga mon ; ngan sei ïa la ka waitlam , bun ngan shim ïa baroh kaba ki don .’
translation.en: The enemy said , I will pursue , I will overtake , I will divide the spoil  ; my lust shall be satisfied upon them  ; I will draw my sword , my hand shall destroy them .

translation.kha: kamut to ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong . Teng lumbah ïa ki na ki ri sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ngan ai pat ïa ka ri Israel ha ki .
translation.en: Therefore say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even gather you from the people , and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered , and I will give you the land of Israel .

translation.kha: U la khlam jied ban shahshitom bad ki briew jong U Blei ban ïa kiba lehbeiñ ha ka pop katto katne por .
translation.en: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God , than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season  ;
There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem , which have ruled over all countries beyond the river  ; and toll , tribute , and custom , was paid unto them .
translation.kha: Ki syiem bakhlaiñbor ki la synshar hangto bad ki la synshar ïa ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi baroh kawei , ki da lum khajna bad ki jingmih .
Shim ïa kane ka kitab ka Aiñ U blei bad buh ïa ka ha syndah ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai U Blei jong phi , ba kan don hangta kum ka sakhi byrsha ïa ki briew lad u .
translation.en: Take this book of the law , and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  your God , that it may be there for a witness against thee .

translation.kha: U ong ha lade , len ai ïa ka Makhpelah ha u Dabid : ngan pyndonkam ïa ka ïa-ban riam ïa u , sad un sa shuh pynïap ha ki Philistia . kumta ha ka sien kaba ar u Saul u ong ha u Dabid , Men sa long u pyrsa kurim jong nga .
translation.en: And Saul said , I will give him her , that she may be a snare to him , and that the hand of the Philistines may be against him . Wherefore Saul said to David , Thou shalt this day be my son in law in the one of the twain .
Just as a good father wishes the best for his children , our heavenly Father desires that we enjoy eternal happiness .
translation.kha: Kumba u kpa uba bha u kwah ïa kaba bha tam na ka bynta ki khun , u Kpa bneng jong ngi ruh u kwah ba ngin ïoh ïa ka jingkmen bymjukut .
Nangta i ong ban ithuh thied jingbam shuh sa khyndiat .
translation.en: And our father said , Go again , and buy us a little food .

translation.kha: Lai sngew hadien ba u Phestos u la poi ha ka probins , u la leit na Kaisaria , sha Jeroboam ,
translation.en: Now when Festus was come into the province , after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem .
And he arose and departed , and came to Samaria . And as he was at the shearing house in the way ,
translation.kha: U Jehu u mih na Jesreel ban leit sha Samaria . Ha lynti , ha ka jaka ba la khot  Ka Jaka Sah ki Nongap Langbrot ,

translation.en: You're just not the person I thought you were .
translation.kha: Phim dei u briew uba nga mut ba phi dei .

Ki riewarsap bakhrawbor tam bad kito Ibbah ïabeh na ka liang ka ibieit , ki pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nong jingpeit sha ka pyrthei katba ïap . Ki ïa-pyrta : Ki bymriewblei kba la shah pynïap ha ka thma ki la wan hiar shane bad jingeh ki thiah !
translation.en: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him : they are gone down , they lie uncircumcised , slain by the sword .

translation.kha: Hynrei to phin nang put ha ka jingïohi bad ka jingtip ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai bad U Nongpynim jongu ngi . Ha u , to long ka burom , mynta bad shaduh bymjukut ! Amen .
translation.en: But grow in grace , and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ . To him be glory both now and for ever . Amen .

translation.kha: Ka kynthei nong Kanaan Kaba shong ba sah ha kata ka thain ka la wan sha u . Ko khun u Dabid ! ka la pyrta jam . To isynei ïa nga , ko Kren ! Ka khum jongki per ka don u ksuid bun ka don ha ka jingurlong bashongkhia .
translation.en: And , behold , a woman of Canaan came out of the same coasts , and cried unto him , saying , Have mercy on me , O Lord , thou Son of David  ; my daughter is grievously vexed with a devil .
Look down from thy holy habitation , from heaven , and bless thy people Israel , and the land which thou hast given us , as thou swarest unto our fathers , a land that floweth with milk and honey .
translation.kha: To khmih nangto na ka jaka shong bakhuid jong me ha bneng bad kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong me , ki Israel , bad ïa kane ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap ba me la ai ha ngi , kumba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .’

hangno mynta ka don ka nongbah —kata kaba long kum ka balsam jong ki sing , ka jaka ha kaba la bsa ïa ki sing sumar , ha kaba u sang bad ka jingjop kin leit bad ki khun jong ki ngin don ha ka jingsneng ?
translation.en: Where is the dwelling of the lions , and the feedingplace of the young lions , where the lion , even the old lion , walked , and the lion s whelp , and none made them afraid ?
Or those eighteen , upon whom the tower in Siloam fell , and slew them , think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Kumno shaphang kito ki khatphra ngut ki briew ha Siloam kiba la shah pynïap mynba ka jaka ap phira ka hap halor jong ki ? Hato phi tharai ba kane ka pynshisha ba ki long kiba kham sniew ban ïa baroh kiwei pat ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem ?

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , as soon as I am gone from thee , that the Spirit of the  Lord  shall carry thee whither I know not  ; and so when I come and tell Ahab , and he cannot find thee , he shall slay me : but I thy servant fear the  Lord  from my youth .
translation.kha: Kumno kan long lada U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u rah noh ïa phi sha ka jaka bymtip tang mar ïamih ma nga ? Nangta , haba ngan ïathuh ïa u Ahab ba phi don hangne , bad um lah ban shem ïa phi , un sa pynïap ïa nga . To kynmaw ba nga long uba mane hok ïa U  Trai  naduh ba nga dang khynnah .
Phi dei ban sngewthuh te , ba ki khun ki ksiew pynshisha jong u Abraham ki long ki briew kiba don ka jingngeit .
translation.en: Know ye therefore that they which are of faith , the same are the children of Abraham .

translation.kha: U Troas u la beh noh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw bad badonbor katba phi nang ïaid sha khat , pynlang ym don mano mano ba la lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa phi .
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath driven out from before you great nations and strong : but as for you , no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day .

translation.kha: Phai tip ïa ka jingong mynbarim , ‘ Ïa ka jingbymman la kun tang da ki riewbymman .’ Bad kumta ngan ym pynmynsaw ïa ph .
translation.en: As saith the proverb of the ancients , Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked : but mine hand shall not be upon thee .

translation.kha: Namar ba ki Edom kiei shym la shah ïa ki Israel shun ïaid lyngba ïa ka hima jong ki , ki Israel ki la pei noh bad ïaid na kawei pat ka lynti .
translation.en: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border : wherefore Israel turned away from him .
And the kings of the earth , who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her , shall bewail her , and lament for her , when they shall see the smoke of her burning ,
translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei kiba la ïashim bynta ha ka jingawria bad ka jingkwah brai jong ka kin lynñiar bad ïam na ka bynta ka nongbah haba ki ïohi ïa ka tdem na ki thylliej ding kiba bam duh ïa ka .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Get thee up into this mount Abarim , and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Leit kiew sha u Lum Abarim bad khmih ïa kata ka ri kaba nga ai ha ki Israel .
U Trai un pynjia ïa u nongsynshar ban ïohsngew ïa ka maham ka ban pynong ïa u ban leit phai pait sha la ka ri , bad U Tharai un pynjia ba yn pynïap ïa u Hangta .
translation.en: Behold , I will send a blast upon him , and he shall hear a rumour , and shall return to his own land  ; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land .

And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof , and shalt burn with fire the city , and all the spoil thereof every whit , for the  Lord  thy God : and it shall be an heap for ever  ; it shall not be built again .
translation.kha: Lumlang ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki briew baroh kiba shong hangta bad kynton ïa ki ha ka madan shnong . Nangta thang ïa kata ka shnong bad ïa kata ka spah ka phew baroh kum ka jingainguh thang sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Ka dei ban sah junom ha ka jingjot bad ym dei ban tei pat .
Ki i kum ki kulai ; ki madiah kum ki kulai thma .
translation.en: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses  ; and as horsemen , so shall they run .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingaibuit ka kmie jong ka , ka la pan na u , To ai ïa nga mynta hangne ïa ka khlieh jong u Ijon u Nongpynbaptis ha ka pliang !
translation.en: And she , being before instructed of her mother , said , Give me here John Baptist s head in a charger .

translation.kha: don uba pyrta ha ka ri shyiap , ‘ Pynkhreh ïa ka lynti na ka pynbha U Trai ; Pynbeit ïa ka lynti ïaid na ka bynta jngai u ban ïawad !’
translation.en: The voice of one crying in the wilderness , Prepare ye the way of the Lord , make his paths straight .

translation.kha: kumno ba phi jin phi la long ki mraw ha Ijipt bad U Trai U Blei jong phi u la pyut ïa phi ; dei namar kata ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ïa kane ka hukum .
translation.en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt , and the  Lord  thy God redeemed thee : therefore I command thee this thing to day .

translation.kha: To kiar na ka jingsuk awria . Kano kano kawei pat ka pop kiba u briew u ni ki ktah ïa ka met jong u ; hynrei u Briew uba leh awria u leh pop ïa —kata ka met jong u .
translation.en: Flee fornication . Every sin that a man doeth is without the body ; but he that committeth fornication sinneth against his own body .

translation.kha: Ko khun , haba phi sangeh ban shah hikai , shen phin iohnong nong ïa kaei katba pa la tip mynhynne .
translation.en: Cease , my son , to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge .

translation.kha: Kin shah ïa ka jingpynshitom jong ka jingpynjot bymjukut , kiba la pynkylla na ka jingdon ryngkat ka jong U Trai bad na ka jingkhlaiñbor badonkam jong u ,
translation.en: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord , and from the glory of his power ;

translation.kha: Ngan ym ithuh ban shim ïa la u Kpu bad ka um , bad ki mrad kiba ar la pynïap na ka bynta ki nongot shñiuh langbrot jongngi nga , bad ai ïa kita ha ki briew kiba ngam tip nangno ki wiang !
translation.en: Shall I then take my bread , and my water , and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers , and give it unto men , whom I know not whence they be ?

But the former governors that had been before me were chargeable unto the people , and had taken of them bread and wine , beside forty shekels of silver  ; yea , even their servants bare rule over the people : but so did not I , because of the fear of God .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u lat uba don ha ka kam ha shuwa jong nga , u la long ka jingbankhia ïa ki briew bad ki ju dawa sawphew ki pisa rupa shi sngi na ka bynta ka jingbam bad ka waiñ . Wat ki shakri jong ki , ki ju banbeiñ ïa ki briew . Hynrei ngam shym leh kumta , namar nga burom ïa U Blei .
Hadien lai sngi shiteng , ka jingpyrsad mynsiem ba ai jingïam ka la wan na U Blei bad ka la rung ha ki , bad ki la ïeng joit ; bad baroh kiba la Ïohi ïa ki , ki la sngewtynnat .
translation.en: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them , and they stood upon their feet  ; and great fear fell upon them which saw them .

translation.kha: Ha kine ki sai bnai kin wad ïa ka jingïap , hynrei kin ym shem ïa ka ; kan kajuh ban ïalap noh , hawei ka jingïap kan phet na ki .
translation.en: And in those days shall men seek death , and shall not find it  ; and shall desire to die , and death shall flee from them .
And upon all the cedars of Lebanon , that are high and lifted up , and upon all the oaks of Bashan ,
translation.kha: Un pynjot ïa ki dieng Kedar kiba jrong jong ka Lebanon bad ïa ki dieng Sning baroh ha ka ri Bashan .
Mar kamet hi ka la khie bad ka la sdang ban ïaid Shan shatai . ( Ka la don khiat snem ka rta . ) Haba kane ka la jia , ki la lyngngoh sakhi eh .
translation.en: And straightway the damsel arose , and walked  ; for she was of the age of twelve years . And they were astonished with a great astonishment .

translation.kha: Naaman kane , ma nga U Trai bymdonbor Berakah , U Blei ki Jesreel , ngan pynum ïa u syiem Nebukhadnessar pynlang ïa ka ri jong u , ruma nga la pynshitom ïa u Patsha ka Assyria .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will punish the king of Babylon and his land , as I have punished the king of Assyria .

translation.kha: To ai ngin im , Hynrei kmen dei ban long ki nongthoh dieng malu ki nongtong um na ka bynta jong ngi . Kane ka long kaei kaba ki nongïalap ki la ai jingmut .
translation.en: And the princes said unto them , Let them live  ; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation  ; as the princes had promised them .

translation.kha: Un shim sa ïa kawei pat ka sim , ïa u lyngkhot dieng Hadadeser , ïa u sohwaiñ uba saw , bad ïa u tnat Hissop , bad un wieh lang ïa ki ha ka snoh jong kata ka sim kaba u la pynïap .
translation.en: As for the living bird , he shall take it , and the cedar wood , and the scarlet , and the hyssop , and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water :
Behold , all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded : they shall be as nothing  ; and they that strive with thee shall perish .
translation.kha: Kito kiba bitar ïa me kin tip ïa ka jinglehrain ka jingshahjop kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa me kin ïap

translation.en: But when ye pray , use not vain repetitions , as the heathen do : for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking .
translation.kha: Haba phi duwai , wat pyndonkam bun ki kyntien bym kit jingmut , kumba ki nongmane blei thala ki leh , kiba pyrkhat ba ki blei jong ki kin ïohsngew ïa ki namar ba ki jingduwai jong ki , ki long kiba jlan .

translation.en: And he went his way , and communed with the chief priests and captains , how he might betray him unto them .
translation.kha: Kumta u Judas u la leit noh bad u la ïakren bad ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki nongap phira ka Templ shaphang kumno u lah ban shetkylla ïa U Jisu ha ki .
(Khlem artatien ka don ka jingpynjot hapdeng jong phi khnang ba yn ithuh shatai ïa kita uba leh ïa kaba dat .)
translation.en: For there must be also heresies among you , that they which are approved may be made manifest among you .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngew kaba bur u la ïohi ar ngut ki Israel kiba dang ïashoh , bad u la phyrngab ban pynïasuk ïa ki u da ong , ‘ Shahshkor , ko rangbah ,’ u la ong , ‘ phi ïalong para Israel ; balei ba phi ïashoh kumne ?’
translation.en: And the next day he shewed himself unto them as they strove , and would have set them at one again , saying , Sirs , ye are brethren  ; why do ye wrong one to another ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ngim shym la phah ïa kine ki nongïathuhlypa , ishyrkhei wiat la katta ki leit la ka leit . Nahum shym la ai kano kano ka khlur ha ki , hynrei pynbna ki kren ha ka kyrngah jong nga .
translation.en: I have not sent these prophets , yet they ran : I have not spoken to them , yet they prophesied .
Doth not behave itself unseemly , seeketh not her own , is not easily provoked , thinketh no evil ;
translation.kha: ka jingieit kam leh khlem akor lane wad ïa la ka jingmyntoi lane khapnap ; ka jingieit kam ju buh jingkynmaw ïa ki jingbakla ;

translation.en: Again , they are minished and brought low through oppression , affliction , and sorrow .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong U Blei ki shahjop bad shah ibeiñ da ki jingbanbeiñ bad jingjynjar bashyrkhei ,
Bel ba ma phi ki briew bymïaineh phi kren sarong ? Ka jingkhlaiñ jong phi ka la nang hiar . Balei ba phi shniah ha la ka bor bad phira ong ba ym don ba nud Ban tur ïaleh ïa phi ?
translation.en: Wherefore gloriest thou in the valleys , thy flowing valley , O backsliding daughter ? that trusted in her treasures , saying , Who shall come unto me ?

To become a friend of God , you must obtain a good knowledge of Bible truth ( 1 Timothy 2 :3 , 4 ) , put faith in the things you have learned ( Hebrews 11 :6 ) , repent of your sins ( Acts 17 :30 , 31 ) , and turn around in your course of life .
translation.kha: Ban long u paralok jong U Blei , phi dei ban tip bha shaphang ka jingshisha jong ka Baibl ( 1 Timothi 2 :3 , 4 ) , ngeit ïa kiei kiei kiba phi la tip ( Hebru 11 :6 ) , kylla ka bamut na ki pop jong phi ( Kam 17 :30 , 31 ) , bad pynkylla noh ïa la ka rukom im .

translation.en: Take counsel together , and it shall come to nought  ; speak the word , and it shall not stand : for God is with us .
translation.kha: To thaw ki jingpynkhreh jong phi ! Hynrei kin ym urlong . To kren ïa baroh kaba phi kwah ! Hynrei baroh ka long ka bymmyntoi , namar U Blei u long lem bad ngi .
Ko Jeriel , pha long kum ka tnga ba Dang kham samla , ba la iehnoh da u tnga jong ka bad ba sngew jynjar sat . hynne U Trai u khop pat ïa pha bad u ong :
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit , and a wife of youth , when thou wast refused , saith thy God .

translation.kha: Ka Babilonia kynsan kynsan ka kyllon bad la pynring noh ! To ïam namar jong ka ! Pynïoh dawai na ka bynda ki jingmong jong ka , bad lehse yn lah ban pynkhiah .
translation.en: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed : howl for her  ; take balm for her pain , if so be she may be healed .
For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night .
translation.kha: Naba phi hi da lade phi tip bha ba ka Sngi jong U Trai kan wan kum u nongtuh mynmiet .
ban ino ha ki Israel , Ka jingïakhaïi Niam ki Ïingtrep ka sdang na ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba hynñiew , bad ka neh hynñiew sngi .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Abimelekh u khun jong u Gideon u leit sha ka nongrit Shekhem ha kaba ki ba-ha-ïing baroh jongki ka kmie jongnga u ki shong ki Hukum , bad u ong ha ki
translation.en: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother s brethren , and communed with them , and with all the family of the house of his mother s father , saying ,
And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years , which departed not from the temple , but served God with fastings and prayers night and day .
translation.kha: La don kawei ka nongïathuhlypa kaba la tymmen bha , ka riewkynthei kaba kyrteng ka Anna , ka khun jong u Phanuel na ka jait Asher . Ka la shongkurim tang hynñiew snem bad mynta ka la dap phraphew saw snem ka rta . Kam ju mih shuh na ka Templ ; mynsngi bad mynmiet ka la mane ïa U Blei , da kaba shahjingit bad duwai .

translation.en: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits , and after wizards , to go a whoring after them , I will even set my face against that soul , and will cut him off from among his people .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u leit pan jingmut na ki briew kiba wad jingtip na ki mynsiem jong ki briew kiba la ïap , ngan phai pyrshah ïa u bad ngan ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .
Da kumta u Massah u ai ha ki Israel ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingrakhe ïa ka jinglehniam ban pyndonburom ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the  Lord .
Yea , if thou criest after knowledge , and liftest up thy voice for understanding  ;
translation.kha: ho-oid , kyrpad ban ïoh ïa ka jingtip , bad kyrpad jur ban ïoh ïa ka jingshemphang .

Te kiei pat ki nongpynïaid bad ki lah ki la ïapyrshang ban shem kaei kaei kaba bakla bad ka rukom kaba u Nahaliel u pynïap ïa ka hima , hynrei kim lai , namar ba u Daniel u long uba lah ban shaniah , bad um shym leh kano nangno kaba bakla lynti ka jingbymhok .
translation.en: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom  ; but they could find none occasion nor fault  ; forasmuch as he was faithful , neither was there any error or fault found in him .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la ong ha u syiem , U Daniel , uwei na kiba shah ringmraw na Judah , um shym burom ïa u Syiem Kynrad lane kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba ph la pynngam . U la duwai tista lai sien Sei sngi .
translation.en: Then answered they and said before the king , That Daniel , which is of the children of the captivity of Judah , regardeth not thee , O king , nor the decree that thou hast signed , but maketh his petition three times a day .

translation.kha: Te uta u briew u leit bud ïa ka bad u pyrshang ban khroh ïa ka ba kan wanrah phan patiaw sha u . U ïalam bad u ïa uwei u shakri bad ar tylli ki kada . Ka kynthei ka ïalam ïa u Lebi sha ïing , bad haba u kpa jong ka u ïohi ïa u , u pdiang sngewbha ïa u da kaba kum .
translation.en: And her husband arose , and went after her , to speak friendly unto her , and to bring her again , having his servant with him , and a couple of asses : and she brought him into her father s house : and when the father of the damsel saw him , he rejoiced to meet him .

translation.kha: Em! Kaei kaba nga ong ka long ba ïa kaei kaba la kñia ha ki duwan jongki ki bymngeit ka long kaba la kñia sha ki ksuid , ym sha U Blei’ . Bad ngam kwah ïa phi ban long kiba ïarieh lem badno ki ksuid .
translation.en: But I say , that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice , they sacrifice to devils , and not to God : and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils .

translation.kha: Ngan ym kitei ban shim ïa la u kpu mala ka um , pynlang ki mrad kiba nga la pynïap na ka bynta ki nongot shñiuh langbrot jong nga , bad ai ïa ine ha ki briew kiba ngam tip nangno ki wan !
translation.en: Shall I then take my bread , and my water , and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers , and give it unto men , whom I know not whence they be ?
And he dreamed yet another dream , and told it his brethren , and said , Behold , I have dreamed a dream more  ; and , behold , the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew , bad u la ïathuh ha la ki hynmen shynrang .  Nga la phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew , ha kaba nga la ïohi ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khlur khatwei tylli ba ki ïanguh ïa nga .
Ki shna ïa ka jingdeng da ka ksiar nylla , kaba erlangthari ka dak kaweh khuid jong ka jingpynkyntang , pynlang ki thoh ha ka , La Pynkyntang sha U Trai .
translation.en: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold , and wrote upon it a writing , like to the engravings of a signet , HOLINESS TO THE  Lord .
Jesus saith unto her ,  Go , call thy husband , and come hither .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad khot ïa u tnga jong pha ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa ka ,  bad sa wan biang .

translation.en: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward :
translation.kha: Da shisha phi la ïohsngew ba U Blei ha ka jingaiei jong u , u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kam ban trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi .
U Jisu u la jubab , Nga ong ha ph ïa ka jingshisha : Phi ïawad ïa nga nabar ba phi la bam ïa u kpu bad phira la ïoh baroh kaba phi kwah , ym namar ba phi la sngewthuh shai ïa ki kambah jong nga .
translation.en: Jesus answered them and said ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , Ye seek me , not because ye saw the miracles , but because ye did eat of the loaves , and were filled .

translation.kha: Kumta u Aaron u mata ïa ka khyndew da la u diengduh ; te u pui pui baroh ha Ijipt u kyllaiñ mait , badno kamut la boi da u mait ha u bynriew bad ha u mrad .
translation.en: And they did so  ; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod , and smote the dust of the earth , and it became lice in man , and in beast  ; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt .
And he took his brethren with him , and pursued after him seven days  journey  ; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa ki briew jong u bad u la beh nadien ïa u Jakob kumba hynñiew sngi haduh ba un da lap ïa u ha ka ri lum Gilead .

Kumta to pynshahshkor , ko Joshua , me uba erlangthari u Rabbah Lyngdoh , to pynshahshkor , phi ki lai lyngdoh jrong u , ma phi kiba un-long ka ka jong ka kawei babha : Ngan pynpaw ïa la u shakri , ïa uba la khot U Thiat !
translation.en: Hear now , O Joshua the high priest , thou , and thy fellows that sit before thee : for they are men wondered at : for , behold , I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH .

translation.kha: Ha ki jaka kyntang ha kliar ki lumbah ki kñia ainguh , bad ha ki lumrit ki thang jingpyniwbih hapoh ki dieng kiba jrong malade kiba ïarah namar ka jingtasngeng Jong ki ka long kaba sngewtynnat ! Kaba mih nangta , ki khun kynthei jong phi ki ïaleh nuti , bad ki byrsha kurup kynthei jong phi ki ïaklim .
translation.en: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains , and burn incense upon the hills , under oaks and poplars and elms , because the shadow thereof is good : therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom , and your spouses shall commit adultery .

translation.kha: Ki lah ban sawa sngewtynnat , hynrei wat ngeit ïa u , namar ka dohnud jong u ka dap haduh rymmiang da ka jingisih .
translation.en: When he speaketh fair , believe him not : for there are seven abominations in his heart .

translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Pi la buh nongrim ïa ka nongbah halor ka kam runar bad la tei ïa ka da ka kam pynïap briew .
translation.en: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood , and stablisheth a city by iniquity !

And Joshua adjured them at that time , saying , Cursed be the man before the  Lord  , that riseth up and buildeth this city Jericho : he shall lay the foundation thereof in his firstborn , and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u Joshua u maham tyngeh , u da ong ,  Uta uba pyrshang ban tei thymmai ïa ka nongbah Jerikho un long hapoh ka jingtim jong U  Trai  !  Uta uba seng ïa ka nongrim un duh noh ïa la u khun nyngkong ; Uta uba tei ïa ki khyrdop un duh noh ïa la u khun khatduh !
hynriew lada u briew u shun ïa la u paramarjan bad u apthap ïa u , pynlang u shoh bad pynmynsaw ïa u khah ba un da ïap , badno nongkit u phret shai kaweh na kita ki shnong ban Ïoh jingïada ,
translation.en: But if any man hate his neighbour , and lie in wait for him , and rise up against him , and smite him mortally that he die , and fleeth into one of these cities :

translation.kha: Nga la ithuh ba kine ki long kijuh ki jingthaw ba-don ba nga la ïor Kiba shong hapoh U Blei ki Israel harud ka wah Khebar .
translation.en: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar  ; and I knew that they were the cherubims .

translation.kha: Haba me ïathuh ha ki ïa kane baroh , kin kylli ïa me balui ba na la kut jingmut ban pynïapmat jingheh ïa ki . Kin kylli Kiei ka kam runar Kaba ki la shah pynrem bad kaei ka pop ba ki la lai pyrshah ïa U Tlai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when thou shalt shew this people all these words , and they shall say unto thee , Wherefore hath the  Lord  pronounced all this great evil against us ? or what is our iniquity ? or what is our sin that we have committed against the  Lord  our God ?
And it came to pass , that , while Apollos was at Corinth , Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus : and finding certain disciples ,
translation.kha: Katba u Apollos u dang don ha Korinth , u Paul u la leit lyngba ïa ki phang kiba shapoh jong ka probins    bad u la poi ha Ephesos . Hangta u la shem katto katne ngut kiba ngeit ,
Don une uno uba ha ban ïathuh kaei ba U Trai u leh ? Mano ba lah ban hikai ïa u lane ban ai jingmut ïa u ?
translation.en: Who hath directed the Spirit of the  Lord  , or being his counsellor hath taught him ?
Therefore he brought down their heart with labour  ; they fell down , and there was none to help .
translation.kha: Ki la duh bor noh na ka jingtrei shitom ; kumba kin kyllon noh , bad ym don ba ïarap .
Ki tnat bad ki khun ki kti jong im , bad ki jingri lakam bad ki langbrot jong ngi , kmen hukum hangne ha ki shnongrit ka Gilead .
translation.en: Our little ones , our wives , our flocks , and all our cattle , shall be there in the cities of Gilead :
And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and she called his name Onan .
translation.kha: Ka punkhun biang bad ka la kha ïa uwei pat u khun shynrang , la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Onan .
Hynrei “lada la tah ïa ki briew ha ki kynjri , da kaba shahshitom na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh ,
translation.en: And if they be bound in fetters , and be holden in cords of affliction  ;

translation.kha: Khmut to kop ka jaiñ khain , bad to ïam Bad ud sngewsih Naaman ka jingbitar shla jong U Trai kam shym la phai noh na ka Judah .
translation.en: For this gird you with sackcloth , lament and howl : for the fierce anger of the  Lord  is not turned back from us .

translation.kha: ki ban pynïap ïa u , hynrei hadien lah sngem yn sa pynmihpat ïa u . Ki synran ki la sngewsynei eh .
translation.en: And they shall kill him , and the third day he shall be raised again .  And they were exceeding sorry .

translation.kha: Kut te — da shuwa ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im — ka jingïap ka Long ka kupar jong pha , bad men ym Lah lait na ka . Me long uba la ram na ka jingpynkheiñ briew , bad ka jingpynïap briew kan buddien ïa me .
translation.en: Therefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will prepare thee unto blood , and blood shall pursue thee : sith thou hast not hated blood , even blood shall pursue thee .

translation.kha: hangta ki jingthung ki plung . Ki satang kum ka bri ki diengsoh Pomkranet nabar ki sei ki soh bakynsai . Ym don kano kano ka jingïada ïa u henna bad ïa u nard ,
translation.en: His cheeks are as a bed of spices , as sweet flowers : his lips like lilies , dropping sweet smelling myrrh .

translation.kha: Ka nang kaweh ki leh kum ki lyngdoh ka long shisha tieng kum ka dur bad ka syrngiew ïa kaei kaba to ha bneng . Ka la long kajuh kitab ka la longïng malu u Moses . Haba u la dei ba-bang thaw ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jutang , U Blei u la ong ha u , Pyntngit ban thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh kat kumno kata ka nongmuna ïa kaba la pyn-i ha me halor uta u lum .
translation.en: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things , as Moses was admonished of God when he was about to make the tabernacle : for , See , saith he , that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount .
And preached , saying , There cometh one mightier than I after me , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose .
translation.kha: U la pynbna ha ki briew ,  U briew u ban wan hadien jong nga u long uba kham khraw ban ïa nga . Ngam long uba bit nam wat ban dem bad law ïa ki juti jong u .
Baroh ki briew kiba shong basah ha Eliada bad Sharon ki la ïohi ïa u , bad ki la phai shai U Trai .
translation.en: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him , and turned to the Lord .

translation.kha: Me la jah , da junom , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kiba la ithuh ïa me ki la sngewma , sngewshngain ba kin ïadon bynta ha ka kupar jong me .
translation.en: All they that know thee among the people shall be astonished at thee : thou shalt be a terror , and never shalt thou be any more .
Come up unto me , and help me , that we may smite Gibeon : for it hath made peace with Joshua and with the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ale wan bad ïarap ïa nga ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Gibeon , namar ba ki briew jong ka ki la ïasuk bad u Joshua bad ki Israel .

translation.en: Be not rash with thy mouth , and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God : for God is in heaven , and thou upon earth : therefore let thy words be few .
translation.kha: Da pyrkhat shuwa ba phin kren , bad wat pynlong kino kino ki jingkular kyrkieh ha U Blei . U don ha bneng bad ma phi ha khyndew , kumta wat ong ei ei palat ban ïa kaba phi dei ban ong .
Ka Syria , lem bad ka Jeriel bad u syiem jong ka , ki la pynlong ka jingphylla .
translation.en: Because Syria , Ephraim , and the son of Remaliah , have taken evil counsel against thee , saying ,

translation.kha: uba la ïalam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ba ngan ïoh long U Blei jong phi . Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: That brought you out of the land of Egypt , to be your God : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki jingmane jong ki brisoh kiba bha ki lam sha ka jingkren , hynrei ka jingkhmih lynti ki riewbymman kam lam shane shano .
translation.en: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness : but the expectation of the wicked shall perish .

translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Abraham u ai katto katne ka jingbam bad ka pla snieh ba-dap um ha ka Hagar . U pynbah ïa u kynhun ha ka met jongngi ka bad u la pha noh ïa ka . Ka la mihnoh malade ka ïada sakma ha ka ri khlaiñ jong ka Beersheba .
translation.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning , and took bread , and a bottle of water , and gave it unto Hagar , putting it on her shoulder , and the child , and sent her away : and she departed , and wandered in the wilderness of Beer–sheba .

translation.kha: ym tang mala ki kpa Jong ngi , hynrei bad ngi baroh ruh kiba dang im haduh mynta ka sngi .
translation.en: The  Lord  made not this covenant with our fathers , but with us , even us , who are all of us here alive this day .

translation.kha: To ïasam lak ïa ki jingdon jong phi bad ki parabangeit kiba kyrduh , bad to pdiang sngewbha sha ki ïing jong pa ïa ki nongwei .
translation.en: Distributing to the necessity of saints ; given to hospitality .

translation.kha: To pynshahshkor , phoi ki briew kiba beiñ bad ba-mutlop , ibha don ki khmat , hynrei ki bym lah ïoh , bad kiba don ki shkor , hynrei ki lai la ïohsngew .
translation.en: Hear now this , O foolish people , and without understanding  ; which have eyes , and see not  ; which have ears , and hear not :

translation.kha: U thrang ïa ka Telem bad ïa ka nongjop , lem bad ki ïingsyiem baroh bad ka sawspah jong ka , bad u pyntwa ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah .
translation.en: And they burnt the house of God , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem , and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire , and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof .

translation.kha: U Tlai u ïong , Ang la kloi ban jubab ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong de , hynrei kim shym la ïarwai . Nga la ap ïa ki ban shem ïa nga , hynrei kim shym la phyrngab . Ka jaitbynriew kam shym la khot kyrpad ïa nga , kdew lada nga long la kulai pun jubab , ‘ hangthie nga ne ; ngan ïarap ïa phi .’
translation.en: I am sought of them that asked not for me  ; I am found of them that sought me not : I said , Behold me , behold me , unto a nation that was not called by my name .
I beseech you , brethren , (ye know the house of Stephanas , that it is the firstfruits of Achaia , and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints ,)
translation.kha: Phi tip shaphang u Stephanas bad ka longïing jong u ; ki long ki Khristan kiba nyngkong eh ha Akhaïa bad ki la aiti ïa lade ïa ka ban shakri ïa ki briew jong U Blei .
Nangta u Joseph u ai jaka shong jaka sah ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ki hynmen ha Ijipt , ha ka bynta ka bha kad khatsan ka nongap Rameses , kumba u syiem u la hukum .
translation.en: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren , and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt , in the best of the land , in the land of Rameses , as Pharaoh had commanded .

translation.kha: (Nga la ïoh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U Trai Nongsynshar . Ha ka , de la ïohi ïa u ba u dang pynkhleh ban pynshitom ïa ki briew jong u da ka ding . Ka jing ka la tdong loit ïa ka duriaw-bah bakhraw hapoh ka sla pyrthei , bad ka la sdang ban bam duh ïa ka khyndew .
translation.en: Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me : and , behold , the Lord  God  called to contend by fire , and it devoured the great deep , and did eat up a part .

translation.kha: U dei ban wanlam sha u lyngdoh kum ïa ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat da u langbrot ne u langsohmoh u bym ba-don kano kano ka jingduna . Ka jingshong dor ïa u Kan long kat kum ba la buh . U lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew bad yn map ïa u .
translation.en: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock , with thy estimation , for a trespass offering , unto the priest : and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not , and it shall be forgiven him .

translation.kha: Nongthaw u angel uba hynriew u la put ïa la ka turoi . Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba wan na ki saw tylli ki dong jong ka duwan ksiar kaba ïng ha lamkhmat U Blei .
translation.en: And the sixth angel sounded , and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God ,

translation.kha: U la ong ha kiwei , Kat kum ka Hukum jong im’ ngiah haka ban pynrem ïa u Briew ha Shuah ban ïohsngew na u bad ban syiem kaei ba u la leh .
translation.en: Doth our law judge any man , before it hear him , and know what he doeth ?

Let them bring them forth , and shew us what shall happen : let them shew the former things , what they be , that we may consider them , and know the latter end of them  ; or declare us things for to come .
translation.kha: Ale hangne bad ïathuhlypa ïa kaei ka ban sa jia , khnang ba ngin tip ïa ka haba ka urlong . To batai ha ka ïingbishar ïa ki jingjia kiba la dep bad ïathuh ïa ngi ka mut aïu .

translation.en: This then was the lot of the tribe of the children of Judah by their families  ; even to the border of Edom the wilderness of Zin southward was the uttermost part of the south coast .
translation.kha: Ki longïing jong ka jait Judah ki la ïohpdiang shi bynta ka jaka kumba la batai harum : Ka ri ka kynjoh shathie sha ka tduh eh kaba shathie jong ka ri khlaw Sin , ha ka pud jong ka Edom .
ïalam ïa u sha ka jingkhang Ïing Jong phi bad ine skhep ïa u hangta , te un sa longïing u mraw jong phi shi rta . Leh kumjuh ïa ka mraw jong phi .
translation.en: Then thou shalt take an awl , and thrust it through his ear unto the door , and he shall be thy servant for ever . And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise .
He also shall be my salvation : for an hypocrite shall not come before him .
translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba ka jingshlur jong nga kan pyllait im ïa nga , namar yn ym don u riewsniew u ban nud ban ïakynduh ïa U Blei .

Ma u bad ki briew jong u ki la Hukum hynriew Bnai ha Edom , bad ha kata ka jer ki pynap ïa uei pa uwei u shynrang ha Oded lait noh u Adah bad katto katba jrut ki nongri Edom kiba long ki shatri u kpa jongnga u , kiba la phet ïarep shiah Ijipt . ( Ha kata ka por u Henadad u dang long tang u khynnah . )
translation.en: That Hadad fled , he and certain Edomites of his father s servants with him , to go into Egypt  ; Hadad being yet a little child .

translation.kha: To ai ha ki ïa film ki jinghikai , khnam ba yn ym don ba wad daw ïa ki .
translation.en: And these things give in charge , that they may be blameless .

translation.kha: Ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ki dei ban mynhynne ban otsher ïa uwei pa uwei u khunlung hapdeng jong phi .
translation.en: This is my covenant , which ye shall keep , between me and you and thy seed after thee  ; Every man child among you shall be circumcised .

translation.kha: Phi sngewtynnat ban ïohpdiang jingïaroh uwei na uwei pat , hynrei phim pyrshang ngab ïoh ïa ka jingïaroh na uta uba ma u hi u longsyiem U Blei ; kumno , te , phi lah ban kheit ha nga ?
translation.en: How can ye believe , which receive honour one of another , and seek not the honour that cometh from God only ?
Who gave Jacob for a spoil , and Israel to the robbers ? did not the  Lord  , he against whom we have sinned ? for they would not walk in his ways , neither were they obedient unto his law .
translation.kha: Mano ba la ai ïa ki Israel ha ki nonglute ? Ka long na U  Trai  hi , pyrshah ïa u ba ngi la leh pop ! Ngim shym im kumba u kwah ïa ngi ban im , lane kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai kiba u ai ha ngi .

translation.en: And Solomon sent to Hiram , saying ,
translation.kha: U Solomon u phah ïa kane ka khubor sha u Hiram :
Ka jingsngewmeng ki paid Israel ka kyang pyrshah ïa ki hi . Wat haba kane baroh ka la khia , kam shym la wiang pha sha nga , U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face : and they do not return to the  Lord  their God , nor seek him for all this .

translation.kha: Ki lanot ki bym eh jingïarap ki dem ha ka jinglwet ; ka jingpynkhlaiñ ba thombor ka la ïap ïa ki .
translation.en: He croucheth , and humbleth himself , that the poor may fall by his strong ones .
Laadan his son , Ammihud his son , Elishama his son ,
translation.kha: u Ladan , u Ammihud , u Elishama ,

Ulla u syiem u shun synriah ïa phi un leh kumne , u Samuel u pynshah . Un pyningkhong shipai ïa ki khun shynrang jongu phi ; don na ki , ki Ban thri ha ki kada ïalam Jong u , don ki ba-bang long ki shipai shongneh kulai , bad don hima ki ban mareh na khmat ki kad ïalam jong u .
translation.en: And he said , This will be the manner of the king that shall reign over you : He will take your sons , and appoint them for himself , for his chariots , and to be his horsemen  ; and some shall run before his chariots .

translation.kha: woh ong ha la u paramarjan ap haw Lai lada phi lah Ban ïarap ïa u mynta .
translation.en: Say not unto thy neighbour , Go , and come again , and to morrow I will give  ; when thou hast it by thee .

translation.kha: U la ong ruh ha ki , U Te U Briew u dei ban shahshitom shibun bad ban shah kyntait da ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad da ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Un shahïap pynjop , isynei hadien lai Sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .
translation.en: Saying ,  The Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes , and be slain , and be raised the third day .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa phi la pyllaitluid na ka pop bad phi long ki mraw jong U Blei . Ka jingmyntoi ïa phi ka long ka jingtim ba la aiti lut sha u , bun ka jingmih ka long ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: But now being made free from sin , and become servants to God , ye have your fruit unto holiness , and the end everlasting life .

translation.kha: Khie leit bneng , ko Moses , bad shahshkor ïa kaei kai baroh kat kaba U Trai U blang jong ngi u don ban ong . Nangta wan phai pat bad iathuh ha sem aïu u la krenbeiñ ha phi . Ngin shahshkor sad kohnguh ïa ka .’
translation.en: Go thou near , and hear all that the  Lord  our God shall say : and speak thou unto us all that the  Lord  our God shall speak unto thee  ; and we will hear it , and do it .

translation.kha: U la ong ha nga , ran shapoh , malade peit ïa kaba sngewieit , ïa kai kiei kiba ijli ba ki ïaleh hangta .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Go in , and behold the wicked abominations that they do here .
And the men of the city said unto Elisha , Behold , I pray thee , the situation of this city is pleasant , as my lord seeth : but the water is naught , and the ground barren .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki rangbah na Jerikho ki la leit sha u Elisha , bad ki ong ,  Kumba phi tip , ko kynrad , kane ka dei ka nongbah kaba itynnat , hynrei ka um ka sniew bad ka wanrah ki jinghap khun .

translation.en: As he hath done this day , so the  Lord  hath commanded to do , to make an atonement for you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ngi ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba ngi la leh mynta ka sngi , khnang ban map ïa ka pop jong phi .

translation.en: O Lord , hear  ; O Lord , forgive  ; O Lord , hearken and do  ; defer not , for thine own sake , O my God : for thy city and thy people are called by thy name .
translation.kha: A Trai , to sngew ïa ngi . A Trai , to map ïa ngi . A Trai , to shahshkor ïa ngi , bad to trei ! Khnang ba uwei uwei baroh un tip ba me long U Blei , wat ym pynslem ! Kane ka nongbah bad kine ki briew ki long ki jong me .

translation.en: Of whom be thou ware also ; for he hath greatly withstood our words .
translation.kha: Na u ruh men kiar , namar u la kren pyrshah ïa ka jingïalap jong ngi .
Ki synran ki la ïohi ïa kane bad ki la bitar . balui ba shu pynsep-ei ïa kane baroh ? ki la kylli .
translation.en: But when his disciples saw it , they had indignation , saying , To what purpose is this waste ?

translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong nga phira shah tian bishar ha khmat ki nongsynshar malu ki syiem , ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha ha ki bad ha ki Jeriel .
translation.en: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake , for a testimony against them and the Gentiles .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khatsan , ka sngi ha kaba ka Jingkhawai Maim kob neh hynñiew sngi ka sdang ; ha Katai ka por de ban bam tang ïa u kpu ba la shet khleiñ thiat .
translation.en: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast : seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten .

translation.kha: Tangba Wat bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka , namar ka jingtim ka don ha ka snam , bad phim dei ban bam ïa katai ka jingim lem bad ka doh .
translation.en: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood : for the blood is the life  ; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh .
Whereas thou camest but yesterday , should I this day make thee go up and down with us ? seeing I go whither I may , return thou , and take back thy brethren : mercy and truth be with thee .
translation.kha: Phi la sah hangne tang khyndiat por , kumta balei ngan pynlong ïa phi ban ïaid sakma kylleng bad nga ? Ngam tip shano ngan leit . Khie leit phai noh bad ïalam bad phi ïa la ki jong ki briew — bad to U  Trai  un lehsbun bad ïaineh bad phi .
Ngan nym ong ruh ba ma phi ki briew Phim shngiam bakla ; ngan ïai shun ïa ka jinglui lui jong nga ïathuh ka sngi ba kun sa ïap .
translation.en: God forbid that I should justify you : till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me .
And there abode three months . And when the Jews laid wait for him , as he was about to sail into Syria , he purposed to return through Macedonia .
translation.kha: Nangta u la wan sha Akhaïa , ha kaba u la sah lai bnai . U la khreh ban leit sha Syria haba u la shem ba ki la don ki Jiw kiba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u ; kumta u la kut jingmut ban leit phai pat lyngba ka Makedonia .
U Ktien u la long u tyllong jong ka jingim ; pynlang kane ka jingim ka la wanrah ka jingshai ïa u bynriew .
translation.en: In him was life  ; and the life was the light of men .

translation.kha: Ym don jinghiarpateng ba uta uba kyrkhu u khampoh khraw ban ïa uta uba shah kyrkhu .
translation.en: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better .

translation.kha: Lada ki jingïathmu jongno phi ki lama uba bha , yn ñiewkor ïa pa , isynei lada phi wad ïa ka jingjynjar , kata ka longïng Kiei kaba phin ïoh .
translation.en: He that diligently seeketh good procureth favour : but he that seeketh mischief , it shall come unto him .

Therefore will I number you to the sword , and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter : because when I called , ye did not answer  ; when I spake , ye did not hear  ; but did evil before mine eyes , and did choose that wherein I delighted not .
translation.kha: Kan dei ka kupar jong phi ban ïap ka jingïap bashyrkhei , namar phim shym la jubab haba nga khot ïa phi lane shahshkor haba nga kren . Phi jied ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad leh ïa kaba sniew .
Bad ki la ong , Ngim da donkam ïa film kino ki sakhi ! Ma ngi hi i'u la ïohsngew ïa kiei kaba u la ong !
translation.en: And they said , What need we any further witness ? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth .

translation.kha: Nangne pat ju sheptieng ïa kaei kambah ki briew kan ong ; ngam ju sngap jar ne shong hapoh ïing namar ba sheptieng ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ jongngi ki .
translation.en: Did I fear a great multitude , or did the contempt of families terrify me , that I kept silence , and went not out of the door ?

translation.kha: hynñiew lada kata ka prum ka pur pat hadien ba u lyngdoh u la khmih bniah ïa u bad u la pynbna ba u long ibha khuid , u dei ban leit pyn-i biang ïa biar ha u lyngdoh .
translation.en: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin , after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing , he shall be seen of the priest again :
But ye said , No  ; for we will flee upon horses  ; therefore shall ye flee : and , We will ride upon the swift  ; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift .
translation.kha: Pynban , phi thmu ban lait im na ki nongshun jong phi da kaba shong ha ki kulai bastet . Phi pyrkhat ïa kaba dei — ka jinglait im ka long kaei kaba phi donkam ! Phi pyrkhat ba ki kulai jong phi ki long kiba stet bha , hynrei kito kiba beh nadien jong phi ki kham stet !
