Un bishar ïa ki jingkajia hapdeng ki jaitbynriew . Kin tied tynrah ïa ki waitlam jong ki sha ki jinglur lynghoh bad ïa ki sum jong ki sha ki waitbnoh khyllad tat . Ki jaitbynriew kin ym ïaleh sma hajuh , kin ym pynkhreh thma shuh .
translation.en: And he shall judge among the nations , and shall rebuke many people : and they shall beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruninghooks : nation shall not lift up sword against nation , neither shall they learn war any more .

translation.kha: Haba ki jingthaw ki ïadait , ki shalyntem ki ïatyllun lang bad ki , bad haba ki jingwoh ki kiew na ka khyndew ki shalyntem ruh ki leh kumjuh .
translation.en: And when the living creatures went , the wheels went by them : and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth , the wheels were lifted up .

translation.kha: Kane keiñ ka long kata kaba u Moses u la ong ha u Sharon , ha ki khun shynrang u Aaron , bad ha ki Israel baroh .
translation.en: And Moses told it unto Aaron , and to his sons , and unto all the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Ïa moi la shah ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh , kumta ki ong . Kata ka long kaba pahara , hynrei ym kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba bha . Ïa ngi la shah ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh — isynei ym baroh ka long kaba myntoi .
translation.en: All things are lawful for me , but all things are not expedient : all things are lawful for me , but all things edify not .

translation.kha: Bad u la ïai krung ha ki baher , To khmih bha bad sumar ïa lade na kano kano ka jait jinglur ; nabar ba ïa ka jingim bashisha jong u briew ym shym la pynlong da ki kiei kiba u don , kur peh Haduh katno u da ban long Uba riewspah .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Take heed , and beware of covetousness : for a man s life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth .

translation.kha: Namar kata , phi dei ban pynïapher ïa ki mrad bun ki sim ki bakyllut na kito ki bymïaineh . Wat bam ïa ki mirr bad ki sim ki bymïap . Nga la ñiew ïa ki , ki bymkhuid , bad kaba bam ïa ki ka pynurlong ïa phi ki bymkhuid .
translation.en: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean , and between unclean fowls and clean : and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast , or by fowl , or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground , which I have separated from you as unclean .
And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice , saying ,  Eli , Eli , lama sabachthani ?  that is to say ,  My God , my God , why hast thou forsaken me ?
translation.kha: Ha ka por lai baje U Jisu u la pyrta da ka jingpyrta bajam ,   Eli , Eli , lema Sabakhthani ?  kaba mut  U Blei jong nga , U Blei jong nga , balei ba me iehnoh ïa nga ?
Ka dei tang ka mynsiem kaba hapoh u briew hi , kaba tipbriew ïa Baroh shaphang lad u ; ha khah ka rukom , tangba U Mynsiem U Blei , suba tip ïa baroh shaphang U Blei .
translation.en: For what man knoweth the things of a man , save the spirit of man which is in him ? even so the things of God knoweth no man , but the Spirit of God .

translation.kha: Ngan ïadei khlong ïa ka aiñ jong me , junom la junom ;
translation.en: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever .

translation.kha: Ka por Kan poi , ong U Trai , haba ngan lumlang ïa ki briew kiba na la pynshitom , Aner kiba la shahshitom ha ka jingshah ringmraw .
translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  , will I assemble her that halteth , and I will gather her that is driven out , and her that I have afflicted  ;

translation.kha: Nga maham ïa ki , Kam myntoi ban ap hangto habar ki kynroh ka nongbah na ka bynta ka step ka ban wan . Lada phi pyrshang biang ïa kane , ngan pyndonkam da ka bor pyrshah ïa phi . Naduh kata , kim ju wan shuh ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: Then I testified against them , and said unto them , Why lodge ye about the wall ? if ye do so again , I will lay hands on you . From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath .

translation.kha: U Ktien u la don ha ka pyrthei , bad wat la U Bel u la tiduh ïa ka pyrthei da u , pynban , ka pyrthei kam shym la ithuh ïa u .
translation.en: He was in the world , and the world was made by him , and the world knew him not .

translation.kha: Hynrei klun ïa nga ha ka kyrtong U Trai ba phin ri pynim ïa ki khun ki kiew jong nga , ba kumta ka kyrteng jong nga bad ka kyrteng ka jait jong sa kan ym Da junom .
translation.en: Swear now therefore unto me by the  Lord  , that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me , and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father s house .

translation.kha: Ha ka phylliah kaba shabar ka la don kadei ka ruma rit ba pynïasoh bad ka khyrdop bashapoh kaba shaphang shatei . Kane ka lam shat ka kamra rung kaba pyrshah ïa ka phyllaw bad hangta ki sait ïa ki metïap jong ki kparad ba la thang tylli kum ki jinganna .
translation.en: And the chambers and the entries thereof were by the posts of the gates , where they washed the burnt offering .
Arise ye , and depart  ; for this is not your rest : because it is polluted , it shall destroy you , even with a sore destruction .
translation.kha: To ïeng joit bad mihnoh ; naba ym don shuh ka jingshngain hangne . Ki pop jong phi ki la long jingtim sha ka jingpynjot ïa kane ka jaka .

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , The servant is not greater than his lord  ; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : U mraw um long kham khraw ban ïa u kynrad jong u , bad u nonglamktien um long kham khraw ban ïa uta uba la phah ïa u .
Ko ki kmie ki kpa , to wat pynbitar ïa la ki khun , Ïoh ba Kin noh mynsiem .
translation.en: Fathers , provoke not your children to anger , lest they be discouraged .

translation.kha: U nongbylla snoh u pui noh namar ba u long tang u nongbylla sngi bad um salia ei ei ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: The hireling fleeth , because he is an hireling , and careth not for the sheep .

translation.kha: Ki neh slem ha ki por baroh ; la ai ïa ki ha ka jingshisha bad ha ka khoh .
translation.en: They stand fast for ever and ever , and are done in truth and uprightness .
And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver , and built on the hill , and called the name of the city which he built , after the name of Shemer , owner of the hill , Samaria .
translation.kha: bad nangta u thied ïa u lum ka Samaria da hynriew hajar ki sbai rupa na u briew uba kyrteng u Shemer . U Omri u la tei ka kut ïa u lum , u tei ka shnong hangta , bad u khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Samaria , da kaba pynbud ïa ka kyrteng u Shemer , u trai ba-mynshuwa jong uta u lum .

ino uno ïa kaba la kha nyngkong , la u dei u briew ne u jingijli , ba ki Israel ki wanrah shuh de u long u jong me . Hynrei me dei ban Pdiang ïa ka jingïohi ban thied pat ïa Uei pa uwei u khun ba la kha nyngkong , bad uwei pa iwei u jingri ba la kha nyngkong , ïa uba la ñiew ba u long u bymkhuid .
translation.en: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh , which they bring unto the  Lord  , whether it be of men or beasts , shall be thine : nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem , and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem .

translation.kha: U Hanokh u leh ïa kane ,
translation.en: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai .
And the  Lord  thy God will circumcise thine heart , and the heart of thy seed , to love the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul , that thou mayest live .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa phi kiba kohnguh hukum , khnang ba phin ieit ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh bad da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh , bad ba phin ïaishong ha kata ka ri .
Don ki briew kiba pynjot ïa lade da ki kad ba-mutlop jong ki hi bun nangta ki kynnoh ïa U Trai’ .
translation.en: The foolishness of man perverteth his way : and his heart fretteth against the  Lord .
And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel , u Asa u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar sawphew wei snem ha Jerusalem .

Ka Mahlah , ka Neah , ka Hoglah , ka Milkah , nabar ka Tirsah , ki longïng ki khun kynthei jongnga u Shephataïah u khun jong u Sher , u khun jong u Galilaïa , u khun jong u Makhir , u khun jong u Manasseh , u khur jong u Jehoshaphat .
translation.en: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph : and these are the names of his daughters  ; Mahlah , Noah , and Hoglah , and Milcah , and Tirzah .

translation.kha: nadong kata , shiteng na ki ïabah jong de ki trei bad shiteng ki sheng ban ap phira , da kaba khung ki jingpuh jong ka jingkhein atiar dara bat da ki sum , ki stieh bad ki ryntieh . Ki nongïalam jong ngi ki ai ka jingkyrshan batylli ïa ki briew kiba trei ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynthrong .
translation.en: And it came to pass from that time forth , that the half of my servants wrought in the work , and the other half of them held both the spears , the shields , and the bows , and the habergeons  ; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah .

translation.kha: Wat ino ei ei , bad dat ki ban pyrkhat ba me long kaba stad !
translation.en: O that ye would altogether hold your peace ! and it should be your wisdom .
And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand : and I heard the number of them .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingdon jong ki shipai shong kulai : Ki la long arphew lakh ngut .

translation.en: And after he had spent some time there , he departed , and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order , strengthening all the disciples .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la pynlut katto katne por hangta , u la mihnoh bad u la leit lyngba ka thain jong ka Galatia bad Phrygia , da kaba pynkhlaiñ ïa ki parabangeit baroh .
lane pruid dak ha la ka met lane pynmong ïa la ka doh ba-bang ïambriew ïa kiba ïap . Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead , nor print any marks upon you : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei khring ba ka jingjied ïa uwei u khum shynrang kan erlangthari nadong shadong ka jingmih jong ka jingthmu U Blei hi , U Bela u la jong ïa ka , U hynmen un shakri ïa u lai . U la ong ïa kane shuwa ba yn khap ïa ki , shuwa ba ki la leh ïa kano kano kaba bha’ ne kaba sniew ; kumin ïa ka jingjied U Blei la pynstang nongrim ha ka jingkhot jongngi u , bad ym ha kano kano kaba ki la lah bor .
translation.en: It was said unto her , The elder shall serve the younger .
Ye shall not make with me gods of silver , neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold .
translation.kha: Wat thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ki blei kiba da ka rupa ne da ka ksiar ban mane ïa ki nalor jong nga .

translation.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles  ; else the new wine will burst the bottles , and be spilled , and the bottles shall perish .
translation.kha: Lymne ba uno uno un theh ïa ka waiñ bathymmai ha ki lwa snieh ba la pyndonkam , namar ka waiñ bathymmai kan pynpdang ïa ki snieh , ka waiñ kan tuid shabar , bad ïa ki snieh yn pynjot .

translation.en: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them :
translation.kha: Kumta ki khun shynrang u Jakob ki leh kumba u la hukum ïa ki ;
Hato nga la pan na phi shun ai ïa nga ka jingai sngewbha lane ban tyrwa ei ei ïano ïano na ka bynda jong nga
translation.en: Did I say , Bring unto me ? or , Give a reward for me of your substance ?

And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria . And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance , and for the people that he had with him , and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth–gilead .
translation.kha: Bun snem hadien , u Jehoshaphat u leit sha ka nongbah Samaria ban leit khmih ïa u Ahab . Ban lehburom ïa u Jehoshaphat bad kito kiba bad u , u Ahab u phah pynïap shibun ki langbrot bad ki masi ban pynlong ka jingkhawai . U pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa u Jehoshaphat ban ïasnohkti lang bad u ha kaba tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .
Kumta u Ahab u phah khot ïa ki Israel baroh dara ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal ban ïakynduh lang ha u lut Karmel .
translation.en: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Israel , and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel .

translation.kha: U shakri kumne U Rangbah lyngkdong ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam , kata ka longkmie , ha ka ïingjaiñ kaba shisha ïa kaba U Trai u la pynjngut , ym da u briew .
translation.en: A minister of the sanctuary , and of the true tabernacle , which the Lord pitched , and not man .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingpynshai ïa ka Templ la lah pynsangeh noh nabar ka la sukher khlem pyntrei shuh haduh ka snem ba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Darius , u pynsawa ka Persia .
translation.en: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem . So it ceased unto the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia .

translation.kha: dalade phi shahshkor haba pa shah pyndait , phi lama kba stad .
translation.en: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise .
Behold , it is written before me : I will not keep silence , but will recompense , even recompense into their bosom ,
translation.kha: Nga la kut jingmut lypa ban pynshitom ïa ki , bad ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa ki la dep buh jingthoh . Ngan ym leh bym ïohi ïa kaei kaba ki la leh , hynrei ngan siew kylliang ïa ki
Ka miet ka la jan ktung , ka sngi ka la jan sdang . To ngin ïasangeh nala na kaba leh ïa kiei kiei bakha long lad ka jingdum , bad to ngin kieng ïa ki atiar ka jingïaleh ha ka jingiaseng .
translation.en: The night is far spent , the day is at hand : let us therefore cast off the works of darkness , and let us put on the armour of light .
For thus saith the  Lord  unto the king s house of Judah  ; Thou art Gilead unto me , and the head of Lebanon : yet surely I will make thee a wilderness , and cities which are not inhabited .
translation.kha: Ha nga , ka ïingsyiem Judah ka long kaba itynnat kum ka ri Gilead , bad kum ki lumbah Lebanon ; hynrei ngan pynlong ïa ka , ka jaka kynjah ha kaba yn ym don bashong basah .

translation.en: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord   ; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the  Lord  for ever :
translation.kha: U Ammon lane u Moab — lane uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong ki haduh kaba shiphew pateng bynriew — ym dei ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .

translation.en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked .
translation.kha: Men shu peit bad men ïohi kumno ki bymman ki shah pynshitom .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; This is Jerusalem : I have set it in the midst of the nations and countries that are round about her .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Khmih ïa ka Jerusalem . Nga buh ïa ka hapdeng ka pyrthei , bad kiwei pat ki ri sawdong jong ka .
naba ha u briew uba don ei ei yn nangto ai shuh shuh , Haneng ba un ïoh kham badno ; hynrei ha u brai u bym don ei ei yn shim noh na u wat ïa kaba rit kad kaba u don .
translation.en: For whosoever hath , to him shall be given , and he shall have more abundance : but whosoever hath not , from him shall be taken away even that he hath .

When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number , then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the  Lord  , when thou numberest them  ; that there be no plague among them , when thou numberest them .
translation.kha: Haba me shim jingkheiñ ïa ka jingdon ki paid Israel , uwei pa uwei u briew u dei ban siew ïa nga ïa ka dor na ka bynta la ka jingim , khnang ba kano kano kaba sniew kan ym wan ha u katba dang shim jingkheiñ .
Ki la khulom ïa ka Synduk nabar buh ïa ka ha ka jaka jong ka hapoh ka Ïaineh kaba u Dabid u la pynïeng na ka bynta jong ka . nongthaw u ainguh ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok ha U Terah .
translation.en: And they brought in the ark of the  Lord  , and set it in his place , in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it : and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Lai sngi hadien ba u Phestos u la poi ha ka probins , u la leit na Kaisaria , sha Jerushah ,
translation.en: Now when Festus was come into the province , after three days he ascended from Caesarea to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ma nga , U Trai Nongbishar , nga la ïathuh ïa pha ba nga longsyiem u nongshun jong pha , nga ai ka jingbynrap ïa pha ha kaba baroh ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ïa kata .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I , even I , am against thee , and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations .

translation.kha: Kumta te , uno uno u bymkohnguh wat ïa iba rit tam jong ki hukum bad uba hikai ïa kiwei pat ban har kumjuh , un un-long uba rit tam ha ka Hima ki Bteng . Ha kawei pat ka liang , uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ka Politics bad uba hikai ïa kiwei ban kuna kumjuh , un long uba khraw ha ka Shim ki Bneng .
translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments , and shall teach men so , he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven : but whosoever shall do and teach them , the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: Men ïap kum u ksew ha ka kti jong ki nongtei me don blei . Ma por , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la ai ïa ka hukum .
translation.en: Thou shalt die the deaths of the uncircumcised by the hand of strangers : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Keiñ ong ba daiñ tang lyngba jong nga yn shem ïa ka jingjop malade ka jingkhlaiñ ; hynrei Baroh kiba shun ïa nga kin shah pynjahburom .
translation.en: Surely , shall one say , in the  Lord  have I righteousness and strength : even to him shall men come  ; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed .

translation.kha: Hynrei u briew u shahskhor pynshoi haba u shah krong pah bad shahshkor riam ha ki jingkwah bran lad u hi .
translation.en: But every man is tempted , when he is drawn away of his own lust , and enticed .
For as the body without the spirit is dead , so faith without works is dead also .
translation.kha: Te kumta , kumba ka met khlem ka mynsiem ka long kaba ïap , kumta ruh ka jingngeit khlem ki kam ka long kaba ïap .

translation.en: For where envying and strife is , there is confusion and every evil work .
translation.kha: Ha kaba ka don ka jingpihuiñ bad ka jingkhwan myntoi , hangta ka don ruh ka jingbymïaid ryntih bad ki jait jingsniew baroh .
Ha ka snem naba khriat jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u syep ka Israel , u Ahab u long u syep ka Judah , mala u synshar per snem ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Judah .
He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !
malu kin jah noh na ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Thou shalt seek them , and shalt not find them , even them that contended with thee : they that war against thee shall be as nothing , and as a thing of nought .
And it came to pass after this , that Joash was minded to repair the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ynda u la long syiem katto katne por , u Joash u la kut jingmut ban shna pynbha pat ïa ka Templ .
Ong ïa ka ban wan hangne , u Elasah u hukum . Ka la woh bad ïeng ha ka jingkhang ,
translation.en: And he said , Call her . And when he had called her , she stood in the door .
And the multitude rebuked them , because they should hold their peace : but they cried the more , saying , Have mercy on us , O Lord , thou Son of David .
translation.kha: U paidbah u la kynhied ïa ki bad ong ïa ki ban sngap jar . Hynrei ki la nang pyrta kham jam ,  Ko Khun u Dabid ! To sngewsynei ïa ngi , ko Kynrad !
U Trai u ong , Ngan buh pat ïa ki brisoh jong nga ha ka ri jongki ki nabar ngan isynei ïa kawei pa kawei ka longïing ; ïa ka Jerusalem yn tei pat , bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong ka yn pynbha pat .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will bring again the captivity of Jacob s tents , and have mercy on his dwellingplaces  ; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap , and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof .

translation.kha: Namar ngi iohnong ba don katto katne ngut ki briew hapdeng jong phi ibha im ka jingim bajaipdeh bad ki bym thir ei ei mait tang ban lushia ha ka kam jong kiwei pat ki bri .
translation.en: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly , working not at all , but are busybodies .
And he took bread , and gave thanks , and brake it , and gave unto them , saying ,  This is my body which is given for you : this do in remembrance of me .
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim shi lyngkhot u kpu , bad U la ainguh ha U Blei , U la kdiah ïa u , bad U la ai ïa u ha ki , da kaba ong ,  Une u long ka met jong nga , ïa kaba la ai na ka bynta jong phi . To leh ïa kane ban kynmaw ïa nga .

Nga tip haduh katno ki nongpop jong phi ki long ibha sngewshyrkhei bad katno kiba bun ki kam shyntur phi la imat . Phi pynshitom beiñ ïa ki briew kaba bha , phi bamsap , phi! khang nong ïa kiba duk ban ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok ha ki ïingbishar .
translation.en: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins : they afflict the just , they take a bribe , and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right .
Come , my beloved , let us go forth into the field  ; let us lodge in the villages .
translation.kha: Nga la wan hiar napdeng ki dieng Almond ban ïohi ïa ki jingthung balung ha ka them , ban ïohi ïa ki sla bathymmai halor ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki syntiew halor ki diengsoh Pomkranet .

Ki mawkyrdon ki lym Sha ka sharum rung ha kaba ka la long shiphew mitar ka pynryngkang pynlang hynriew mitar ka jingjylliew . La don ar tylli ki pajwa , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka tyngkong .
translation.en: The length of the porch was twenty cubits , and the breadth eleven cubits  ; and he brought me by the steps whereby they went up to it : and there were pillars by the posts , one on this side , and another on that side .
And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent : for he is not a man , that he should repent .
translation.kha: U Blei bakhraw jong ki Israel um ju lamler lane kylla la ka jingmut . Um dei u briew — um ju kylla la ka jingmut .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest , the son of Buzi , in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar  ; and the hand of the  Lord  was there upon him .
translation.kha: Hangta ha Babilonia harud ka wah Khebar , nga la ïohsngew ïa U  Trai  ba u kren ha nga bad nga la sngew ïa ka bor jong u .
U Mikah u jaboh , Phi mut aïu , ‘ kaei kaba la jia ?’ Phi la shim ïa u lyngkdong bad ki bleithaw ba nga la thaw , bad phi shu phret ! kadei ka sah bad nga ?
translation.en: And he said , Ye have taken away my gods which I made , and the priest , and ye are gone away : and what have I more ? and what is this that ye say unto me , What aileth thee ?

translation.kha: Mynta te , pynbynta ïa kane ka ri phangpdeng kyiuh pat ki khatkhyndai jait bad ha ka shiteng na ka jaiñ-da Manasseh , na ka bynta jong ki ba kin ïohkynti kumto la ka jong .
translation.en: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes , and the half tribe of Manasseh ,

translation.kha: u Sadok , u khun jong u Hattaabah bad u Ahimelekh , u khun jngai u Abiathar ki long ki lyngkdong ; u Seraïah u long u sekretari ka ïingjaiñ ;
translation.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub , and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar , were the priests  ; and Seraiah was the scribe  ;
I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt , to give you the land of Canaan , and to be your God .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka hukum jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la ïalam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ban ai ha phi ïa ka ri Kanaan bad ban long U Blei jong phi .
Me pynkhreh ban pyndonkam ïa la ka ryntieh , me khreh ban siat ïa la ki khnam . Ka leilieh jong me ka pynpait ïa ka khyndew .
translation.en: Thy bow was made quite naked , according to the oaths of the tribes , even thy word . Selah . Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers .
And said unto him ,  Go , wash in the pool of Siloam ,  ( which is by interpretation , Sent . ) He went his way therefore , and washed , and came seeing .
translation.kha: To khie leit bad bta ïa ka khmat jong me ha ka Pung Siloam .  ( Kane ka kyrteng ka mut  Ba la phah .  ) Kumta uta u briew u la leit , u la bta ïa la ka khmat , bad u la wan phai uba imat pat .
Khatduh na ki baroh , kata ka briew ka la ïap .

translation.kha: Ïa ki blei jong ki la thaw da ka rupa bad ka kiar , ba la pynshong da ki kti jong ki brisoh .
translation.en: Their idols are silver and gold , the work of men s hands .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang don ha lynti sha ïing , la ïathuh ha u dab , U Absalom u la pynïap ïa ki khuid shynraiñ jongki phi Baroh — ym anna uwei ruh uba loit !
translation.en: And it came to pass , while they were in the way , that tidings came to David , saying , Absalom hath slain all the king s sons , and there is not one of them left .

translation.kha: Wat la ka khyndew ha sakma ka snem ka sah shrah , kun pynmih jingbam hi ïa phi , ïa ki mraw jong phi , ïa ki nongbanbor jong phi , ïa ki nongïeng kiba Shong bad phiah ,
translation.en: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you  ; for thee , and for thy servant , and for thy maid , and for thy hired servant , and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee ,

translation.kha: Ka jingkhraw jong U Balei ka kham ïar ban ïa ka pyrthei , ka kham ïar ban ïa ka duriaw .
translation.en: The measure thereof is longer than the earth , and broader than the sea .

translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkdang , U Khun U Briew u long U Trai jong ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath .

translation.kha: Kumba u Paul u la kamar-tama hangta shisnem shiteng , u da hikai ha ki ïa ka ktien jong U Blei .
translation.en: And he continued there a year and six months , teaching the word of God among them .

translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem un ong ha ki briew kiba ha ka pipa kamon jong u , ‘ To wan , phi kiba la kyrkhu da U Kpa Jong nga ! To wan bad to ïoh ïa ka hima kaba la pynkhreh na ka bynta jongno phi nud kambah pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand , Come , ye blessed of my Father , inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world :
We have heard the pride of Moab , ( he is exceeding proud ) his loftiness , and his arrogancy , and his pride , and the haughtiness of his heart .
translation.kha: Ka Moab ka sarong palat ! Nga la ïohsngew katno ka jingsarong , ka jingsngewbiang ki briew ki long , katno ki pyrkhat shaphang ïa lade .
Kumta ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa u Og , ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , badno ïa ki briew jong u baroh , khlem da pynshisha uei ruh , mala nangta ki kdew kynti ïa ka ri jong u .
translation.en: So they smote him , and his sons , and all his people , until there was none left him alive : and they possessed his land .

translation.kha: Bad ha ka jingïohipaw jrong nga , nga la ïohthiah ïa ki kulai bad ïa ki nongshong kulai jong ki : Ki don ki jingïada shadem kiba saw kum ka ding , kiba jngum kum u Sapphir , bad kiba stem kum u kyndok . Ki khlain jong ki kulai ki la long kumne ki khlieh sing , bad na ki shijur jong ki la mihngi ka ding , ka tnad bad u kyndok .
translation.en: And thus I saw the horses in the vision , and them that sat on them , having breastplates of fire , and of jacinth , and brimstone : and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions  ; and out of their mouths issued fire and smoke and brimstone .

translation.kha: U bang bha ngab leh ïa ka jingsniew dara u buh katto katne ha ka shyntur jong u ban sngewtynnat ïa ka jingbang jongngi ka .
translation.en: Though he spare it , and forsake it not  ; but keep it still within his mouth :
A lion which is strongest among beasts , and turneth not away for any  ;
translation.kha: Ki sing , kiba khlaiñ tam na ki mrad baroh bad ki bym tieng ïano ïano ;

U Ahab u ïa-ong ha u Besodeïah , Ïa ngin ïaleit ban khmih ïa baroh ki umpohliew bad ki wah ha ka ri , ba-bang syiem la ngi lah ban ïoh phlang don pyndap bam na ka beit ki kulai malade ki khadar ba keiñ ym ïapthngan . Lasha ngaiñ ym hap ban pynïap noh na ki mrad ba ngi ri .
translation.en: And Ahab said unto Obadiah , Go into the land , unto all fountains of water , and unto all brooks : peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive , that we lose not all the beasts .

translation.kha: U Serubbabel , u Joshua bad ki rangbah kur ki ong ïa ki , Ngim donkam ïa ka jingïarap jong phira ïa-ban tei ïa ka templ na ka byndi U Trai U Blei jrong ngi . Ngin ti hi ïa ka da biar , kumba u Syros , u patsha ka Persia , u la hukum ïa ngi .
translation.en: But Zerubbabel , and Jeshua , and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel , said unto them , Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God  ; but we ourselves together will build unto the  Lord  God of Israel , as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us .

translation.kha: Da ka jingïap ba aiti lut lad u , mynta la pynong ka jingïadei phangpdeng jong ngi bad U Blei ; katno tam te , ngin longïing kiba lait im da u na ka jingbitar U Blei!
translation.en: Much more then , being now justified by his blood , we shall be saved from wrath through him .
Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew , whose name was Mordecai , the son of Jair , the son of Shimei , the son of Kish , a Benjamite  ;
translation.kha: Hangta ha Susa la don u Jiw uba kyrteng u Mordekai , u khun jong u Jair ; uba na ka jait Benjamin bad u long uba hiarpateng na u Kish bad u Shimei .
Kumba mandriek ki jingpynïasoh ba bakla bad ki jingïathuhlypa ba ïalam bakla ki la kut . Nga pyllait im ïa ki briew jong nga na ka bor jong phiah , khnang ba phira tip ba ar long U Trai .
translation.en: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity , nor divine divinations : for I will deliver my people out of your hand : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta ki nongïathuhlypa ki la duwai khlam jam bad ki la ot ïa lade da ki tari bad ki leit , kat kum ki armet lehhok jong ki , haduh ba ka snar ka la tuid .
translation.en: And they cried aloud , and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets , till the blood gushed out upon them .

translation.kha: Ngan ym beh noh ïa ki hapoh shisnem , lada nga leh kumta , ka ri kan long kaba kynjah , bad ki mradkhlaw ktang bun palat ïa phi .
translation.en: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year  ; lest the land become desolate , and the beast of the field multiply against thee .
And having food and raiment let us be therewith content .
translation.kha: Te namarkata , lada ngi don ka bam bad ka kup ka sem , kata kan dei ka la biang ïa ngi .

translation.en: Behold , I will take away the posterity of Baasha , and the posterity of his house  ; and will make thy house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat .
translation.kha: Ki pop jong ki , ki la pynkhih bitar ïa nga , bad kumta ngan pyndam noh ïa me bad ïa ka longïing jong me , kumba nga la leh ïa u Jeroboam .

Te ki nong Ijipt kiba pyntrei mraw ki shoh ïa ki rangbah Israel kiba pynïaidkam , ha kaba ki la buh ban khmih ïa ka kam . Ki la dawa , Balei ba phim shym shna katjuh ki mawthoh kumba phi la ju shna mynshuwa ?
translation.en: And the officers of the children of Israel , which Pharaoh s taskmasters had set over them , were beaten , and demanded , Wherefore have ye not fulfilled your task in making brick both yesterday and to day , as heretofore ?

translation.kha: Kaba byrngia ha ki jingim bah , ka waiñ bad ka jingbam lute ktien ym pynlong ïa phi uba riewspah .
translation.en: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man : he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich .
Thy neck is as a tower of ivory  ; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon , by the gate of Bath–rabbim : thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus .
translation.kha: Ko ba-ieit jong nga , phi long kaba bhabriew kum ka Jerusalem , kaba i-ieit kum ka nongbah Tirsah , kaba pynkyndeh mynsiem kum kine ki nongbah bakhraw .

translation.en: I have not spoken in secret , in a dark place of the earth : I said not unto the seed of Jacob , Seek ye me in vain : I the  Lord  speak righteousness , I declare things that are right .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la kren ha kaba rieh lane buhrieh ïa ka jingthmu jong nga . Ngam shym la dawa na u paid Israel ban khmih ïa nga ha ka jaka ba la iehnoh suda . Nga long U  Trai  , bad nga kren ïa ka jingshisha ; nga pynlong ban tip ïa kaei kaba dei .
Me la long u nongshun baïaineh ka Israel bad me shah ba ki briew jong ka kin shah pynïap ha ka por ka jingjynjar jong ka , ka por jong ka jingshah pynkhamti bakhatduh namar ki pop lad ka .
translation.en: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred , and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity , in the time that their iniquity had an end :

translation.kha: Leit thwet babniah shaïong kata ; bad lada ka long ka shisha ba la leh kum ïa kata ka kam Jingbymman ,
translation.en: Then shalt thou enquire , and make search , and ask diligently  ; and , behold , if it be truth , and the thing certain , that such abomination is wrought among you  ;

translation.kha: Ki lyngkhuh kiba na ka jait Lebi baroh kim dei ban ïohpateng ei ei na ka khyndew kamra long ki para Israel ; ha ka jaka kata , kin ïoh ka smam tang na ki jingainguh Bad kiwei pat ki jingkñia ainguh sha U Trai .
translation.en: The priests the Levites , and all the tribe of Levi , shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel : they shall eat the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , and his inheritance .

translation.kha: Haba phi ïaleh ban knieh ïa Kanaan kano ka shngain , wat pom ïa ki diengsoh jong ka , kad lada phi kerkut slem ïa ka . bam-im ïa u shiah , hynrei ki pynjot ïa ki dieng , naba kim dadien ki nongshun jong phi .
translation.en: When thou shalt besiege a city a long time , in making war against it to take it , thou shalt not destroy the trees thereof by forcing an axe against them : for thou mayest eat of them , and thou shalt not cut them down ( for the tree of the field is man s life ) to employ them in the siege :

And kings shall be thy nursing fathers , and their queens thy nursing mothers : they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth , and lick up the dust of thy feet  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  : for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me .
translation.kha: Ki syiem kin long kum ki kpa ïa pha ; ki mahadei kum ki kmie . Kin dem khrup ha khmat jong pha bad kin burom ïa pha ; da kaba pynrit kin pyn-i burom ïa pha . Te phan tip ba nga long U  Trai  ; uba ap ïa ka jingïarap jong nga un ym duh jingkyrmen .

translation.en: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons , and consecrate them , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Nangta , pynsleh ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh ha ka jingshakri ïa nga .
Haba ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki la ïathmu ha u shaphang kine kiei kiei baroh , u la kut ar ngut na ki
translation.en: And the disciples of John shewed him of all these things .

translation.kha: Ki la lynti , ki da khiew ïa la ki jaiñ , sad ki da kynting ïa u pui pyut shiah suiñ .
translation.en: And as they cried out , and cast off their clothes , and threw dust into the air ,
For thus saith the  Lord  , Ye shall not see wind , neither shall ye see rain  ; yet that valley shall be filled with water , that ye may drink , both ye , and your cattle , and your beasts .
translation.kha: Wat la phim ïohi ïa uno uno u slap lane ïa ka lyer , yn sa pyndap ïa kane ka phud um da ka um , bad ma phi , ki jingri jong phi , bad ki kynhun mrad jong phi kin ïoh kyrhai ban dih .’
Ha kajuh ka por u Shimei u khun jong u Gera , na ka jait Benjamin kaba na Bahurim , u la pynshlur ban leit sha ka Johanan ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem Dabid .
translation.en: And Shimei the son of Gera , a Benjamite , which was of Bahurim , hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David .

translation.kha: Kumba u Jannes bad u Jambres ki la Ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Moses , kumta ruh kine ki briew ki ïaleh pyrshang ïa ka jingshisha — ki briew uba ki jingmut jong ki kim treikam bad katba la shahjop ha ka jingngeit .
translation.en: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses , so do these also resist the truth : men of corrupt minds , reprobate concerning the faith .

translation.kha: Nangta u Sedekaïah u nongïathuhlypa u leit kiew sha u Mikaïah , u tar ïa u na ka ngab jong u , bad kylli , Nahum mynno u Mynsiem jongngi U Trai u iehnoh ïa to bad u kren ha me ?
translation.en: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near , and smote Micaiah on the cheek , and said , Which way went the Spirit of the  Lord  from me to speak unto thee ?

translation.kha: U syiem Dabid mynta u Shong ha ka ïingsyiem jong u . Ha kawei ka sngi u Pha khot ïa u Nathan u nongïathuhlypa malade ïa-ong ha u , Hangne la shong ha ka ïing ba la thaw da ki dieng Kedar , hynrei ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai la buh ha ka ïingjaiñ !
translation.en: Now it came to pass , as David sat in his house , that David said to Nathan the prophet , Lo , I dwell in an house of cedars , but the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  remaineth under curtains .
Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God , they sent unto them Peter and John :
translation.kha: Ki apostol ha Jerusalem ki la ïohsngew ba ki nong Samaria ki la pdiang ïa ka ktien U Blei , kumta ki la phah ïa u Petros bad u Ïoannis sha ki .
U Dabid u kylli na U Trai , Ngan lytar beh ne em ïa kine ki nonglute ? Ngan lap ne em ïa ki ? U jubab , Kiwei leit beh ïa ki ; men lap ïa ki , bad men pyllait ïa kiba la shah ringmraw .
translation.en: And David enquired at the  Lord  , saying , Shall I pursue after this troop ? shall I overtake them ? And he answered him , Pursue : for thou shalt surely overtake them , and without fail recover all .

translation.kha: Te kumta ngin kohnguh ba kan don ka jingïashongkha khleh hapdeng jyllang I . Ngin shong ngin sah hapdeng jngai phi! , bad iing ïalang kawei ka jaitbynriew badno phi .
translation.en: Then will we give our daughters unto you , and we will take your daughters to us , and we will dwell with you , and we will become one people .

translation.kha: U Elijah u la bymsheptieng bad u la pui ban pyllait im ïa lade ; u shimti ïa u shakri jongu u bad leit noh sha Beersheba kaba ha Judith . Da kaba iehnoh ïa u sharai hangta ,
translation.en: And when he saw that , he arose , and went for his life , and came to Beer–sheba , which belongeth to Judah , and left his servant there .

translation.kha: Ieh ïa ka kitab ka long , u Josaïah u hukum . Ïa ki shyieng jong u ym dei ban pynkhih . Kumta ïa ki shyieng jongngi u , ym shym la pynkhih , lymne jong kito ki jong u nongïathuhlypa umbiah la wan na Sarai .
translation.en: And he said , Let him alone  ; let no man move his bones . So they let his bones alone , with the bones of the prophet that came out of Samaria .
For the creature was made subject to vanity , not willingly , but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope ,
translation.kha: Naba ïa ki jingthaw la pynrem ban duh noh ïa ka jingthmu jong ki , ym na ka mon la jong hi , hynrei namar ka mon U Blei uba la mon ïa kata . Pynban ka la don ka jingkyrmen

translation.en: He shall die without instruction  ; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray .
translation.kha: U ïap namar ba um lah synshar ïa lade ; ka jingïailong mutlop jong u kan ïalam ïa u sha ka jingtep jong u hi .

bad la shaniah ha ki ïa Kinah ki ki : ban ïarap ïa ki lyngdoh kiba jingartatiend na u Aaron bad ïa ka jingmane ha ka Templ , ban sumar ïa ki phyllaw bad ïa ki kamra jngai ka , bad ban sumar khuid ïa kata baroh kaba kyntang ;
translation.en: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the  Lord  , in the courts , and in the chambers , and in the purifying of all holy things , and the work of the service of the house of God  ;
I also could speak as ye do : if your soul were in my soul s stead , I could heap up words against you , and shake mine head at you .
translation.kha: Lada phi don ha ka jaka jong nga bad ma nga ha ka jaka jong phi , ngan lah ban ong ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba phi ong . Nga lah ban pynkhih ïa ka khlieh jong nga ha ka jingsian bad ngan pynïap jyllop ïa phi ha ka jingshlei jong ki ktien .
ïada um sngewlah , un phah ïa ki nonglamler ban ïashem ïa imat pat u syiem , ban kyrpad ïa ki kyndon jingsuk kaban u dang jngai bah ha ka lynti .
translation.en: Or else , while the other is yet a great way off , he sendeth an ambassage , and desireth conditions of peace .

translation.kha: Ki synrum ki la leit bad ïalap kylleng , mala U Trai u la ba-thurmur lema bad pynshisha ba ka jingïalang jong ki ka la long kaba shisha da ki kambah kiba ki la leh .]
translation.en: And they went forth , and preached every where , the Lord working with them , and confirming the word with signs following . Amen .

translation.kha: Ka kherub shaphang kane ka la poi ha ka Balang ha Jerusalem , kumta ki la phah ïa u Barnabas sha Antiokh .
translation.en: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem : and they sent forth Barnabas , that he should go as far as Antioch .

translation.kha: La pyllait noh ïa kita ki saw nguh ki satang ; na ka beit kane hi ka kyntu jyllang kane hi ka sngem jong une hi u bnai bad ka snem ïa ki la buh pynkhreh ban pynsep noh shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong u bynriew baroh .
translation.en: And the four angels were loosed , which were prepared for an hour , and a day , and a month , and a year , for to slay the third part of men .

translation.kha: Shisien la don hynñiew ngut Shi para ki shynrang ; uba iing eh u la shongkurim bad u la ïap khlup Don khun .
translation.en: Now there were seven brethren : and the first took a wife , and dying left no seed .
Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was , and her two daughters in law with her  ; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah .
translation.kha: Ki ïamih ban leit phai lang sha Judah , hynrei ha lynti ka ong ïa ki ,
U la ïai-ong , Ko khun u briew , pynpra ïa ka kynram hangne . Ngi la pynpra lyngba ïa ka bad nga la shem ïa ka jingkhang .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , dig now in the wall : and when I had digged in the wall , behold a door .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha u kynrad jong nga , u syiem Benhadad , ba nga mynjur ; u lah shun shim ïa to bad ïa kaei kaei baher kaba de don , u Ahab u jubab .
translation.en: And the king of Israel answered and said , My lord , O king , according to thy saying , I am thine , and all that I have .
Before the  Lord  : for he cometh , for he cometh to judge the earth : he shall judge the world with righteousness , and the people with his truth .
translation.kha: haba U  Trai  un wan ban synshar ïa ka pyrthei . Un synshar ïa ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei da ka hok bad ka jinglehhok .

translation.en: And Peleg lived thirty years , and begat Reu :
translation.kha: Haba u Peleg u la dap laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Reu ;
Ñiew ïa ka jingstad kum ka para jong phi , bad ïa ka jingshemphang kum ka lop ba-ieit thep mynsiem jongnga phi .
translation.en: Say unto wisdom , Thou art my sister  ; and call understanding thy kinswoman :

translation.kha: Ïa at kew la pynlong u shakri jong kata ka gospel da ka jingai bakyrpang U Blei , kiba u la ai ha nga lyngba ka jingtrei ka bor jong u .
translation.en: Whereof I was made a minister , according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power .

translation.kha: Kumno uno une u kah ban tip kaei kaba bha ïa I ha kane ka jingim jong ngi kaba lyngkhuit malade ka bymmyntoi — ka jingim kaba ïaid kum ka syrngiew ? Kamon ngi ia ïa-ban thop aïu kan jia ha ka pyut dadien ba ngi la ïap ?
translation.en: For who knoweth what is good for man in this life , all the days of his vain life which he spendeth as a shadow ? for who can tell a man what shall be after him under the sun ?

translation.kha: U Jisu uba na Nahath , ki la jubab . Dei ma nga u la ong . U Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la ïeng hangta ryngkat bad ki .
translation.en: They answered him , Jesus of Nazareth . Jesus saith unto them ,  I am he .  And Judas also , which betrayed him , stood with them .

translation.kha: bad Uto u samla ruh um shym la pynsakma ïa-ban leh ïa dat kaba la ai jingmut , namsop ba u la bha eh ïa ka khwan jong u Jehosabad . U long ruh uba donburom tam na ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jongki u baroh .
translation.en: And the young man deferred not to do the thing , because he had delight in Jacob s daughter : and he was more honourable than all the house of his father .
Then take silver and gold , and make crowns , and set them upon the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest  ;
translation.kha: To thaw ka pansngiat na ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba ki la ai , bad buh ïa ka halor ka khlieh jong u Joshua , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u khun jong u Jehosadak .
Kumta hato la map ïa kine , ym donkam thuh ka jingainguh ban kit noh ïa ki pop .
translation.en: Now where remission of these is , there is no more offering for sin .

translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ha ki , Em ! Phi la ïan ban khmih ha-ei kane ka ri ka shong sleh .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Nay , but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa la u kput ; khlem ma u phin ym ïoh jingim . ibha ka kmie ka la tymmen , pyn-i ha ka ïa ka jingïaroh jngai phiah .
translation.en: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee , and despise not thy mother when she is old .
Fear and a snare is come upon us , desolation and destruction .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïaid lyngba ka jingpynjot bad jingpra ; ngi im ha ka jingma bad ka jingsheptieng .

U Trai u ong , Ko Kynhun u briew , ki biria jong me ki ïakren shaphang jong me haba ki ïakynduh hajan ki kynriah ka nongpang ne ha ki lynti hajan jingkhang ki ïing jong ki . Ki ïa-ong para ma ki , ‘ Ïa ngim ïalute bad sngap ka ktien aïu kaba wan na U Trai mynta .’
translation.en: Also , thou son of man , the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses , and speak one to another , every one to his brother , saying , Come , I pray you , and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the  Lord .

And the  Lord  gave the people favour in the sight of the Egyptians . Moreover the man Moses was very great in the land of Egypt , in the sight of Pharaoh s servants , and in the sight of the people .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki nong Ijipt ba kin sngewburom ïa ki Israel . Shisha , ki rangbah synshar bad ki briew baroh ki ñiew ba u Moses u dei u briew uba khraw katta katta .
To sngewbishni ino na ka jingïam jong pa’ bad to ñiad noh ïa ki ummat jongno phi . Baroh kiba phi la ar na ka bynta ki khun jong phi kin ym longsyiem lehnoh-ei ; kin woh pah pat na ka ri u nongshun .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Refrain thy voice from weeping , and thine eyes from tears : for thy work shall be rewarded , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy .

translation.kha: ka bynta bashathie jong ka ri Joïada ; bad ka ri thor kaba ïawer ngat Soar haduh Jerikho , ka shnong ki ngin tyllai .
translation.en: And the south , and the plain of the valley of Jericho , the city of palm trees , unto Zoar .
And the Jebusite , and the Amorite , and the Girgashite ,
translation.kha: U Kanaan u long ruh u kpa tymmen jong ki Jebus , ki Amor , ki Girgash ,

translation.en: I made a covenant with mine eyes  ; why then should I think upon a maid ?
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang ban nym khmih da ka jingkwah brai ïa ka kynthei .
Ha ka jinglalot kaba ar u Joseph u la pynithuh ïa biar ha la ki hynmen shynrang , dara u syiem ka Ijipt u la oh jingtim shaïong ka longïng Jong u Joseph .
translation.en: And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren  ; and Joseph s kindred was made known unto Pharaoh .

translation.kha: Te me dei ban ong ha u ba ma nga , U Trai , nga nong , ‘ U Israel u long u khun nyngkong jngai nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh , Thus saith the  Lord  , Israel is my son , even my firstborn :
I thank my God always on your behalf , for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ ;
translation.kha: Nga ainguh borabor ïa U Blei jong nga na ka bynta jong phi namar kata ka jingaiei ïa kaba u la ai ha phi da U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: Gracious is the  Lord  , and righteous  ; yea , our God is merciful .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba dap da ka jingisynei bad uba bha ; U Blei jong ngi u long uba sngewlem .

translation.en: The strong among the mighty shall speak to him out of the midst of hell with them that help him : they are gone down , they lie uncircumcised , slain by the sword .
translation.kha: Ki riewshlur bakhraw tam bad kito kiba ïaleh na ka liang ka Ijipt , ki pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nong Ijipt sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Ki ïa-pyrta : Ki bymriewblei kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma ki la wan hiar shane bad hangne ki thiah !
Ngam pynkhlaiñ ïa ki brai jongu nga ; kin ïamane bad kohnguh ïa nga . U Trai u la kriah .
translation.en: And I will strengthen them in the  Lord   ; and they shall walk up and down in his name , saith the  Lord .
And not rather , (as we be slanderously reported , and as some affirm that we say) Let us do evil , that good may come ? whose damnation is just .
translation.kha: Balei yn ym ong te ,  To ngin leh ïa kaba sniew khnang ba kaba bha kan mih ?  Katto katne ngut ki briew , shisha , ki pynjahburom ïa nga da kaba pharep ïa nga da kaba ong ïa kane kaei kaei hi ! Kin shah pynrem , kumba ki dei ban shah .
Ki law lyngkhuit ïa ka , ki kem ïa ki khun shynrang bad Kynhun kynther jong ka , bad nangta ki pynïap ïa ka da ka waitlam . Ki kyntiap kylleng ki ïathuh lumrit shaphang ka kupar jong ka .
translation.en: These discovered her nakedness : they took her sons and her daughters , and slew her with the sword : and she became famous among women  ; for they had executed judgment upon her .
And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite , prince of the country , saw her , he took her , and lay with her , and defiled her .
translation.kha: Haba u Shekhem u khun jong u Hamor u jait Hib , uba long u khlieh jong kata ka thain , u la ïohi ïa ka , u la shim ïa ka , bad u la batbor ïa ka .

translation.en: And he shall go before him in the spirit and power of Elias , to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children , and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just  ; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord .
translation.kha: Un leit ha shuwa jong U Trai , uba khlaiñ bad uba khrawbor kum u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa . Un pynïasuk pat ïa ki kpa bad ki khun ; un pynphai pat ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh sha ka rukom pyrkhat jong kiba hok ; un pynkhreh ïa ki briew jong U Trai na ka bynta jong U .

U Gideon u ong ha u , Kren , lada long ban kylli , balei kane ka wan wia ha ngi lada U Trai u don ryngkat bad ngi ? Jia aïu ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba phylla Ibbah ki kpa jong Ngi ki ïathuh ïa ngi ba U Trai u ju leh — kumno u la ïalam nep ïa ki na jingtep ? U Trai u la iehnoh ïa ngi bad u la ïuh ïa ngi ha ka jingisynei jong ki Midian .
translation.en: And Gideon said unto him , Oh my Lord , if the  Lord  be with us , why then is all this befallen us ? and where be all his miracles which our fathers told us of , saying , Did not the  Lord  bring us up from Egypt ? but now the  Lord  hath forsaken us , and delivered us into the hands of the Midianites .
So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , and went and returned , and dwelt at Nineveh .
translation.kha: Te u Sennakherib u patsha ka Assyria u iehnoh bad leit phai sha Ninebeh .

Ngi khot ïa ki kiba suk namar ki la long kiba ïaishah . Phi la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïaishah u Job , bad phin tip kumno U Trai u la pyndap ïa u ha kiba kut . Nob U Tlai u long uba dap da ka jingsngewsynei bad jinglehsbun .
translation.en: Behold , we count them happy which endure . Ye have heard of the patience of Job , and have seen the end of the Lord  ; that the Lord is very pitiful , and of tender mercy .
And ye shall eat old store , and bring forth the old because of the new .
translation.kha: Ki jingmih ba phi lum kin long kiba bun , bad kin biang na ka bynta shisnem ; wat la katta ruh , phin hap bret noh ïa kaba dang sah na ka jinglum kaba rim ban pyllait jaka ïa ka jinglum kaba thymmai .
Khmut ai ba u Ngim Kynrad un pynmih ïa kane ka hukum bad soi ïa ka , badno kan treikam , ka aiñ jong ki Midian bad ki pharshi , ka bym eh ban pynkylla .
translation.en: Now , O king , establish the decree , and sign the writing , that it be not changed , according to the law of the Medes and Persians , which altereth not .

O Belteshazzar , master of the magicians , because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in thee , and no secret troubleth thee , tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen , and the interpretation thereof .
translation.kha: Ko Belteshassar , u rangbah jong ki nongbatai kupar , nga tip ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong me , bad ba me shemphang ïa ki jingmaïan baroh . Kane ka long ka jingphohsniew jong nga . To ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka .
Hynrei U ijuh u la jubab ïa u , Ai ba kun longsem kumta ïa mynta . Naba kumne keiñ ngin pyndep ïa tala baroh kaba U Balei u dawa . Kumta u Ïoannis u la mynjur .
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Suffer it to be so now : for thus it becometh us to fulfil all righteousness .  Then he suffered him .

translation.kha: ka kylla , ka Akhsib , bad ka Mareshah : khathynñiew tylli ki nongbah lym ruh bad ki nongrit kiba sawdong jongngi ki .
translation.en: And Keilah , and Achzib , and Mareshah  ; nine cities with their villages :

translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym la iehnoh ïa ki pop sha kiba u syiem Joab u la ïalam ïa ki Israel , hynrei ki ïai lai ïa ki ; bad ka durblei Asherah ka dang ïaisah ha Samaria .
translation.en: Nevertheless they departed not from the sins of the house of Jeroboam , who made Israel sin , but walked therein : and there remained the grove also in Samaria . )

translation.kha: Lada u briew u lah Ban long uba hok da kaba kohnguh ïa ki jingong ka suda , na long uba khulom jingrem .
translation.en: Concerning zeal , persecuting the church ; touching the righteousness which is in the law , blameless .

translation.kha: bad u duwai , A Trai U Blei ki Israel , ym don U Blei uba kamon ma me ha bneng shahthngan ne ha khyndew shapoh ! Me bat ïa ka jutang bad me pynpaw ïa la ka jingieit ha la ki jong ki briew kiba kohnguh ïa me naduh ka mynjur .
translation.en: And he said ,  Lord  God of Israel , there is no God like thee , in heaven above , or on earth beneath , who keepest covenant and mercy with thy servants that walk before thee with all their heart :
For he looketh to the ends of the earth , and seeth under the whole heaven  ;
translation.kha: Namar u ïohi ïa kiba kut jong ka pyrthei , u ïohi ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ka suiñbneng .

translation.en: And they watched him , and sent forth spies , which should feign themselves just men , that they might take hold of his words , that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la khmih ïa ka kabu . Ki la pynbam pisa ïa ki katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban leh mynleh kum kiba shida , bad ki la phah ïa ki ban riam ïa U Jisu da ki jingkylli , khnang ba kin lah ban aiti ïa u ha ki bor synshar bad sha ka bor jong u lyngskor ka Hima Rom .

translation.en: God chose the Israelites to be his witnesses .
translation.kha: U Blei u la jied ïa ki nong Israel ban long ki nongsakhi jong u .

Na ka bynta jong ngi , ngi don katne u paid sakhi basbun byllien sawdong jong ngi . Kumta te , to ngin ïabret noh na lade ïa Kiei kaei baroh kaba Wan pynwit ha lynti , bad ïa kata ka pop kaba shait snoh skhem ha ngi , bad to ngin ïaphet da ka jingkut jingot ïa ka jingïateh thong kaba don ha khmut jong im’ .
translation.en: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses , let us lay aside every weight , and the sin which doth so easily beset us , and let us run with patience the race that is set before us ,

translation.kha: U un long u nongpynkren blem jngai me badno un kren ha u paidbah na ka bynta jong me . Nangne me pat men longïing kum U Blei , da kaban ïaheh ha u aïu un ong .
translation.en: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people : and he shall be , even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth , and thou shalt be to him instead of God .

translation.kha: Ha kiwei nga ong ( ma nga da lade hi , ym de U Trai ) : lymda u parabangeit u don ka tnaw ka bymngeit bad ka mynjur ban ïaishah bad u , um dei ban pyllait noh ïa ka .
translation.en: But to the rest speak I , not the Lord : If any brother hath a wife that believeth not , and she be pleased to dwell with him , let him not put her away .

translation.kha: Hoham ar snem ngan wallam pat sha kane ka dik ïa baroh ki jingpynkynmaw ka Thep kaba u syiad Nebukhadnessar u la rah sha Babilonia .
translation.en: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the  Lord s  house , that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place , and carried them to Babylon :

translation.kha: Naba U Mynhyndai umbiah U Bel u la ai ha ngi um pynlong ïa ngi kiba khawpud ; pynban , U mynsngi jong u , u pyndap ïa ngi da ka bor , ka jingieit , bad ka kuna Hamor latai .
translation.en: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear ; but of power , and of love , and of a sound mind .

translation.kha: Ki ong ha u , Sngewbha kylli na U Blei la ngi shem bha ne em ha Kanneh ka jingleit jong ngi .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Ask counsel , we pray thee , of God , that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous .
And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me , it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck , and he were cast into the sea .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno un pynlong ïa uwei na kine kiba rit ban duh noh ka jingngeit jong u ha nga , kan kham bha ban teh ïa uta u briew da u mawtylliat baheh sawdong ïa ka ryndang jong u bad ban bret ïa u sha ka duriaw .

Lane leh-ieit phi ibeiñ ïa ka jingsbun bakhraw jong u , ka jingshah laitluid , bad ka jingïaishah . Da Shispah phi tip ba U Blei u longïng uba sbun , namar u pynjrong ban ïalam ïa phi ban kylla-kaba-mut .
translation.en: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering ; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance ?

translation.kha: U Blei u long borabor malade nga ha kata ka por bad u ai jingshai ïa nga kat nga ïadie lyngba ïa ka jingdum .
translation.en: When his candle shined upon my head , and when by his light I walked through darkness  ;

translation.kha: Ngi tip ba U Kun U Blei u la wan mala u la ai ha ngi ïa ka jingshongshngain , khnap ba ngin ithuh ïa U Blei uba bashisha . Ngi im ha U Blei uba shisha — ha U Ujuh Khrist U Toi jongnga u . Une u long U Blei uba shisha , Bad kane ka longkmie ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: And we know that the Son of God is come , and hath given us an understanding , that we may know him that is true , and we are in him that is true , even in his Son Jesus Christ . This is the true God , and eternal life .
And one kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , and the meat offering thereof , and their drink offerings .
translation.kha: Ai ïa ki lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh baroh kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong .
Balei ba ma phi shiah phi pynshitom ïa nga kumba U Blei u leh ? Hato kine shym la pynshitom la bajngum ïa nga ?
translation.en: Why do ye persecute me as God , and are not satisfied with my flesh ?

translation.kha: Nga la bitar ïa ki briew jong nga ; to la shim ïa ki kumba kim dei shuh ki jong nga : Nga buh ïa ki ha ka bor jong pha , badno pham pyn-i jinglehisynei ïa ki ; wat ïa kiba la tymmen pha leh da kaba tyngeh .
translation.en: I was wroth with my people , I have polluted mine inheritance , and given them into thine hand : thou didst shew them no mercy  ; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba ka Hukum kam lah ban leh , namar ka jinglong ba kynjai doh ka long naba sleh , U blei u la leh . U la pynmeh ïa ka pop ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh da kaba u la phuh ïa U Khun jong u hi , Uba la wan kum ka jinglong u briew uba pop , ban jop ïa ka pop .
translation.en: For what the law could not do , in that it was weak through the flesh , God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh , and for sin , condemned sin in the flesh :

translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , to khie noh ! Khie joit ïa biar bad ïeng ! Pha la diaw ïa ka khuri ka jingpyntreikam kaba U Trai ha ka jingbitar jong u , u la ai ba phan dih ; pha dih lut ïa ka , bad ka la pynlong ïa pha ban ïaid shaneng shang .
translation.en: Awake , awake , stand up , O Jerusalem , which hast drunk at the hand of the  Lord  the cup of his fury  ; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling , and wrung them out .

translation.kha: Ngi kylli te : Haba ki Jiw ki jynthut , hato ki iphuh shad ka jingjot jong ki ? Em , ym kumta ! Namar ki la leh pep , ka jingpynim ka la wan sha ki Jentil , ban pynlong ïa ki Jiw ban bishni ïa ki .
translation.en: I say then , Have they stumbled that they should fall ? God forbid : but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles , for to provoke them to jealousy .
That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee  ; I bare the loss of it  ; of my hand didst thou require it , whether stolen by day , or stolen by night .
translation.kha: Man ka por ba ka langbrot ka shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw , nga kitkhlieh hi ma nga . Ngam ju wanrah ïa kata ban pyn-i ha phi ba kam shym dei ka jingbakla jong nga . Phi dawa ba ma nga hi ngan hap buria ïa kaba lah shah tuh la ka long mynsngi lane mynmiet .
U Gideon u la leit sha Penuel bad u la kyrpad kumjuh ïa ki briew kiba hangta , hynriew ki bri jong ka Penuel ki la ai kajuh ka jubab kum ki pynbah jong ka Sukkoth .
translation.en: And he went up thence to Penuel , and spake unto them likewise : and the men of Penuel answered him as the men of Succoth had answered him .

translation.kha: Ïa U Trai yn ym ïaroh da kiba ïap , da kino kino kiba leit hiar shaei ka ri ka jingsngap jar .
translation.en: The dead praise not the  Lord  , neither any that go down into silence .
And he spake of trees , from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall : he spake also of beasts , and of fowl , and of creeping things , and of fishes .
translation.kha: U kren shaphang ki dieng bad ki jingthung , naduh ki dieng Kedar Lebanon haduh u Hissop uba mih halor kynroh ; u la kren shaphang ki mrad , ki sim , ki bseiñ , bad ki dohkha .

Phi dei ban kynmaw ba phi la long ki mraw ha jingpeit , bad ba nga , U Trai U Blei jong phi , la la pyllait im ïa phi da ka borbah jong nga . dei namar kata ba to hukum ïa phi ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt , and that the  Lord  thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm : therefore the  Lord  thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day .
And it came to pass , as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob , and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father , that Esau his brother came in from his hunting .
translation.kha: U Isaak u la pyndep ban ai ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u , bad shen hadien ba u Jakob u la leit , u Iso u hynmen jong u , u la wan phai na kaba behmrad .

Hynrei uta u shakri u Kylli , Kumno lada jat ba kata ka samla kai moi Ban iehnoh ïa la ka ïing ban wan ryngkat bad nga sha kane ka ri ? Hato ngan phah noh ïa u khun jong phi shaw kata ka ri na kaba phi wan ?
translation.en: And the servant said unto him , Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land : must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest ?
And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood , and led him throughout all the land of Canaan , and multiplied his seed , and gave him Isaac .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa u Abraham , u kpa tymmen jong phi , na ka ri kaba sha shiliang ka wah Ïuphratis bad nga ïalam ïa u lyngba ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei . Nga la ai ha u shibun ki khun ki ksiew . Nga la ai ha u ïa u Isaak ,
Don saw tylli kiei keiñ kiba phylla eh ïa nga ba ngan shemphang :
translation.en: There be three things which are too wonderful for me , yea , four which I know not :

translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki Aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga baroh . (Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes , and all my judgments , and do them : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Troas bymdonbor Baroh u ïong , To khie tohtit , ko waitlam , bad tur ïaleh ïa u nongaplangbrot uba triang na ka bynta jong nga ! Pynïaid ïa u , bad ïa ki langbrot yn pynsakma . Ngin tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong nga
translation.en: Awake , O sword , against my shepherd , and against the man that is my fellow , saith the  Lord  of hosts : smite the shepherd , and the sheep shall be scattered : and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u mut ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher , la kumno kumno ar ne lai ngut ki dih ban kren , uwei hadien uwei pat , bad uwei pang u dei ban batai ïa kaei kaba la kren .
translation.en: If any man speak in an unknown tongue , let it be by two , or at the most by three , and that by course ; and let one interpret .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , U Khrist ruh u la Kñia ainguh tang Kishion ban bah noh ïa ki pop jong kiba bun . Un sa jaw ha ka sien kaba ar , ym baneh weng noh ïa ka pop , hynñiew ban pynim ïa kita kiba ap khmih lynti ïa u .
translation.en: So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many  ; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation .

translation.kha: Da kine ki ktien , nga pynlong ka jingong bad phi : Nga kular ba lano lano ruh ngan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki jingthaw ba-im da ka jingshlei um , da lei lei mad ka jingsleh um kan ym pynjot shuh ïa ka pynrieh .
translation.en: And I will establish my covenant with you  ; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood  ; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth .

translation.kha: U Jakeh u ong , Em , kata kam da pher eh ; lada na la ïoh ka jingsngewbha jong phi , to pdiang ïa ka jingai sngewbha jong nga . Ban ïohi ïa ka kham jong phi ka long ïa nga hi kumba ïohi ïa ka khmat U Blei , mynta ba phoi la ar jan ïa nga katne .
translation.en: And Jacob said , Nay , I pray thee , if now I have found grace in thy sight , then receive my present at my hand : for therefore I have seen thy face , as though I had seen the face of God , and thou wast pleased with me .
He leadeth counsellors away spoiled , and maketh the judges fools .
translation.kha: U shim noh ïa ka jingstad jong ki nongsynshar bad u pynlong ïa ki nongïalam kum kiba bieit .
Ha kito kiba dei ban ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba u kular , U Blei u kwah ban pyndei shai ba un ym pynkylla ïa ki jingthmu jong u ; kumta u wanrah de ïa ka jingsmai ha ka jingkular .
translation.en: Wherein God , willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel , confirmed it by an oath :

translation.kha: Wallam ïa uta u masi lyngraw ha kham ka Ïingjaiñ ka jingdon Ryngkat jong na , bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khunlung shynrang jong u ba ktien buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlem jong u .
translation.en: And thou shalt cause a bullock to be brought before the tabernacle of the congregation : and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the bullock .

And out of the basket of unleavened bread , that was before the  Lord  , he took one unleavened cake , and a cake of oiled bread , and one wafer , and put them on the fat , and upon the right shoulder :
translation.kha: Nangta u shim ïa uwei u kpu na ka shang ba la buh ïa ki kpu bakhlem thiat ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  , uwei u kpu ba la khleh umphniang , uwei u kpu uba stang , bad u buh ïa ki halor kata ka khleiñ bad ka kjat-dien kamon .
Ka la long la jan shit sner shuwa ka Jingkhawai Maham Ka jinglehieit . U Pilat u la ong ha ki briew , Une u syiem jong phi !
translation.en: And it was the preparation of the passover , and about the sixth hour : and he saith unto the Jews , Behold your King !
His disciples say unto him , Master , the Jews of late sought to stone thee  ; and goest thou thither again ?
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  ki synran ki la jubab ,  dang shen ki briew hangta ki la kwah ban lynthem maw ïa me , bad hato me thmu ban leit phai shata ?

pep sha u lyngdoh uba dei peit kam ha kata ka por , badno ong ha u , ‘ Nga pynbna mynta ka sngi ha U Trai U Blei jong nga ba nga la wan rung ha Katai ka ri ba u la kliar ha ki kba tymmen jong ngi ba-bang ai ha ngi .’
translation.en: And thou shalt go unto the priest that shall be in those days , and say unto him , I profess this day unto the  Lord  thy God , that I am come unto the country which the  Lord  sware unto our fathers for to give us .

And many people shall go and say , Come ye , and let us go up to the mountain of the  Lord  , to the house of the God of Jacob  ; and he will teach us of his ways , and we will walk in his paths : for out of Zion shall go forth the law , and the word of the  Lord  from Jerusalem .
translation.kha: bad ki briew jong ki , kin ong ,  Ïa ngin kiew ïa u lum jong U  Trai  , sha ka Templ jong U Blei ka Israel . Un hikai ïa ngi kaei kaba u kwah ïa ngi ban leh ; ngin ïaid ha ki lynti kiba u la jied . Naba ka jinghikai jong U  Trai  ka wan na Jerusalem ; na Seïon u kren ha ki briew jong u .

Haba u nongwei uba shong jngai na ka ri u ïohsngew shaphang ka nam jong me mala ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba me la leh na ka bynta ki briew jong me , bad un wan ban mane ïa me bad duwai ha kane ka Templ , to shah ïa ka jingduwai jong u .
translation.en: ( For they shall hear of thy great name , and of thy strong hand , and of thy stretched out arm  ; ) when he shall come and pray toward this house  ;

translation.kha: Wat ha shuwa ba kin dep duwai ha nga , ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai lad ki .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that before they call , I will answer  ; and while they are yet speaking , I will hear .

translation.kha: U la shahshkor ïa ki kpa tymmen Jong ngi bad u la long uba shyrkhei ïa ki , da kaba pynbor ïa ki ban bret ïa ki khunlung jong ki na ki erlangthari jong ki , khnang ba kin ïaphah .
translation.en: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred , and evil entreated our fathers , so that they cast out their young children , to the end they might not live .

translation.kha: Mynta , ki para ri jong u ki la isih ïa u , bad kumta ki la phah ïa ki nongpynïaidkam hadien jong u Ban ong , ‘ Ngim kajuh ïa i'u u briew ban long u syiem jong ngi .’
translation.en: But his citizens hated him , and sent a message after him , saying , We will not have this man to reign over us .

translation.en: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation  ; and ye shall afflict your souls : ye shall not do any work therein :
translation.kha: Ïalumlang ban mane Blei ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew ; wat bam ei ei bad wat trei kano kano ka kam .

U Sisera u la thait haduh katta katta ba u da ïohthiah lade . Nangta ka Jael ka shim ïa u tyrnem bad u snar pynskhem dara , ka la leit mian mian sha u , bad ka pyndap ïa u da kaba sah ïa u snar na ka moi moi jong u ha ba da pei phlait haduh khyndew .
translation.en: Then Jael Heber s wife took a nail of the tent , and took an hammer in her hand , and went softly unto him , and smote the nail into his temples , and fastened it into the ground : for he was fast asleep and weary . So he died .

translation.kha: Gera ki briew jong me ki ong ba kaei kaba ar sa kam lama ka badei ! Em , ka dei ka lyngki jong ki ka bymdei .
translation.en: Yet the children of thy people say , The way of the Lord is not equal : but as for them , their way is not equal .
Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem :
translation.kha: U Manasseh u la don khat-ar snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar ha Jerusalem sanphew san snem .

U ijuh u la ong ha u , Lada me kwah ban long uba Jannai , to khie leit bad die nala ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha Kiba duk , Bad men don ka shapoh ha pdeng ; nangta to wan bad bud ïa nga .
translation.en: Jesus said unto him ,  If thou wilt be perfect , go and sell that thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come and follow me .
And he went up and down among the lions , he became a young lion , and learned to catch the prey , and devoured men .
translation.kha: Haba u la san dap rynïeng , u la ïaleit thap mrad bad kiwei pat ki sing . Ma u ruh u la nang ban behmrad bad u kylla long u nongbam briew .

translation.en: And Jonathan said to David , Go in peace , forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of the  Lord  , saying , The  Lord  be between me and thee , and between my seed and thy seed for ever . And he arose and departed : and Jonathan went into the city .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jonathan u ong ha u Dabid ,  U Blei un don ryngkat bad phi . U  Trai  un pynthikna ba ma nga bad ma phi , bad kiba hiarpateng na phi bad kiba hiarpateng na nga , kin bat ïa ka kular bakyntang kaba ngi la pynlong iwei ïa iwei .  Nangta u Dabid u leit noh , bad u Jonathan u leit phai pat sha shnong .

translation.en: And she went up , and laid him on the bed of the man of God , and shut the door upon him , and went out .
translation.kha: Ka bah ïa u shalor sha ka kamra u Elisha , ka buh ïa u ha ka jingthiah bad ka mihnoh , da kaba khang ïa ka jingkhang .

translation.en: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah shiphew snem .

Ki khat-ar tyllep ki khyrdop ki la long ki kharai tylli ki mawlynnai ; ïa kawei kawei ka khrawbor la shna na uwei u mynnin . Ka lynti baheh jngai ka nongbah ka la long da ka ksiar nylla , kaba lah ban ïohi lyngba kum ka ïit .
translation.en: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls  ; every several gate was of one pearl : and the street of the city was pure gold , as it were transparent glass .

translation.kha: “Lah kaba jingkyndit ka ja suda ha ba bad ka jingsuk , ban ia ka ing kaba dap da ka jingkhaïi lem bad ka jingialang .”
translation.en: “Better to eat a dry crust of bread with peace of mind than have a banquet in a house full of trouble .”

translation.kha: Kine keiñ ki long kita ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh stong , ki jingainguh bam , ki jingkñia namar ka pop , ki jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat , ki jingkñia pynkyntang , bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok .
translation.en: This is the law of the burnt offering , of the meat offering , and of the sin offering , and of the trespass offering , and of the consecrations , and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings  ;

translation.kha: ‘ Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie , kamra ang , U Trai U Blei’ jong phiah , nga sah ïa phi , khnang ba phin manbha bun im slem ha kata ka ri ba nga ai ha phi .
translation.en: Honour thy father and thy mother , as the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee  ; that thy days may be prolonged , and that it may go well with thee , in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .

translation.kha: La kumno kumno , lada kata ka lah baneh long , to ngin ïa-ïaid sha khmat katno Kum kijuh ki kyntien kiba i la bud haduh myntor .
translation.en: Nevertheless , whereto we have already attained , let us walk by the same rule , let us mind the same thing .

translation.kha: Hynrei uta u briew u jubab , Wat la phi ai ïa na shihajar tylli ki sbai rupa , ngan ym rahah wai i shynriah ti pyrshah ïa u khup jongu u syiem . Baroh ngi la ïohsngew ba u syiem u lei ïa phi , ïa u Abishai bad ïa u iaki , ‘ Na ka bynta jong nga wat pynmynsaw ïa u apil Absalom .’
translation.en: And the man said unto Joab , Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand , yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king s son : for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai , saying , Beware that none touch the young man Absalom .

translation.kha: Soh ki patlun lyngkot kiba da ka jaiñ linen , kiba kot naduh syngkai haduh lbong , khnang ba kin ym thad baburom ïa lade .
translation.en: And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness  ; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach :
These are the statutes and judgments , which ye shall observe to do in the land , which the  Lord  God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it , all the days that ye live upon the earth .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki hukum ba phi dei ban kohnguh katba phi dang shong ha kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u ai ha phi .

translation.en: And he took a yoke of oxen , and hewed them in pieces , and sent them throughout all the coasts of Israel by the hands of messengers , saying , Whosoever cometh not forth after Saul and after Samuel , so shall it be done unto his oxen . And the fear of the  Lord  fell on the people , and they came out with one consent .
translation.kha: U shim shi jur ki masi lur , u ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki bad u phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban leit rah ïa kita ki lyngkhot kylleng ka ri Israel ryngkat bad kane ka jingmaham :  Kat u bym bud ïa u Saul bad u Samuel sha ka thma , kumne yn leh ïa ki masi lur jong u .  Te ki paid Israel ki sheptieng her ïa kaei ba un leh U  Trai  , bad baroh khlem lait uwei ruh , ki ïawan mih ryntih lang baroh .

translation.en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land , and devoured the fruit of their ground .
translation.kha: ki la ïabam ïa baroh ki jingthung ha ka ri ; bad ki la ïabam ïa baroh ki jingthung ba long jingbam .
To ïathuh ïa baroh kiba rit myn , To longsyiem khlaiñ bun wat sheptieng ! U Blei un waiñ ban pyllait ïa phin , un wanrah ban pynshitom ïa ki nongshniah lad phi .
translation.en: Say to them that are of a fearful heart , Be strong , fear not : behold , your God will come with vengeance , even God with a recompence  ; he will come and save you .

Moreover the spirit lifted me up , and brought me unto the east gate of the  Lord s  house , which looketh eastward : and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men  ; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur , and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah , princes of the people .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah ïa nga shajrong bad u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop mihngi jong ka Templ . Hangta hajan jong ka khyrdop nga la ïohi arphew san ngut ki rangbah kynthup ïa u Jaasanaïah u khun jong u Assur bad u Pelataïah u khun jong u Benaïah , ki ar ngut ki nongïalam jong ka jaitbynriew .
