translation.en: Remember , I beseech thee , the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses , saying , If ye transgress , I will scatter you abroad among the nations :
translation.kha: To kynmaw mynta kaei kaba me la ong ha u Moses : ‘ Lada ma phi ki briew ka Israel phin ym ïaineh ha nga , ngan pynsakma ïa phi hapdeng kiwei ki jaitbynriew .
Haba u Methuselah u la dap shispah phraphew hynñiew sniew ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynna , u larkam ,
translation.en: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years , and begat Lamech :

translation.kha: Haba ki la ïasngew ïa u ba u klun ha ka ki Hebru , ki la kham sngap jar , bad u Paulos u la bteng :
translation.en: ( And when they heard that he spake in the Hebrew tongue to them , they kept the more silence : and he saith , )
For , behold , I am for you , and I will turn unto you , and ye shall be tilled and sown :
translation.kha: Nga don ha ka liang jong phi , bad ngan pynthikna ba yn lur biang ïa ka khyndew jong phi bad ïa ki symbai yn thung hangta .

translation.en: But the ship was now in the midst of the sea , tossed with waves : for the wind was contrary .
translation.kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , U Jisu u la don hangta marwei ; bad hamar kane ka por ka lieng ka la don jngai ha ka duriaw , ba la kynting shane shatai da ki jingat phyllung , namar ba ka lyer ka la beh pyrshah ïa ka .

U Mesha u la ïathmu ha u Jethro ïa kaei kaei borbah kaba U Trai u la leh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki nong Ijipt khnang ba un Ïohi pyllait im ïa ki Israel . U la ïathuh ruh ha u ïa ki jingeh ba ki Jerusalem ki la ïakynduh ha lyngki nabar kumno U Trai u la pyllait im ïa ki .
translation.en: And Moses told his father in law all that the  Lord  had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel s sake , and all the travail that had come upon them by the way , and how the  Lord  delivered them .
According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things .
translation.kha: To leh ïa ki kambah na ka bynta jong nga , A  Trai  , kumba me la leh ha ki sngi mynba me la wallam ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt .
Em ! Ngam lah Ban shu sngap jar ! Nga pisa bad nga kthang mynsiem . Nga dei ban kren .
translation.en: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth  ; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit  ; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul .

translation.kha: Ïa ki blei jyllang ki jingtipbriew la shna da ka rupa Bad ka ksiang ; la pynwandur da ki kti ki briew .
translation.en: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold , the work of men s hands .

translation.kha: Naba ka la hir da ka jingrai ka jong U Blei hi ba U Khun u la to ha lade hi ïa ka jinglong ba-pura jong U Blei .
translation.en: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell ;

translation.kha: Nangta na la ïohi ïa ka bneng ba plie , bad la don u kulai umbiah mluh . Ïa u nongshong ha u la ïakhot umbiah Ïoanna bad umbiah shniah ; ka erlangthari da ka jinglehhok ba u bishar bad u ïaleh ïa ki jingïaleh thma lad u .
translation.en: And I saw heaven opened , and behold a white horse  ; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True , and in righteousness he doth judge and make war .

translation.kha: Kumba ar sneng ka la nang jur tad haduh ba u syiem u la ïarep ha ka jingkordit . Ki raïot jong u kim shym thang ding shabar ha kaba ïalamwir ïa u kitab la ai ïa ki kpa Thummim jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that in process of time , after the end of two years , his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness : so he died of sore diseases . And his people made no burning for him , like the burning of his fathers .
With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman  ; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young  ; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid  ;
translation.kha: ban pynïap ïa ki shynrang bad ïa ki kynthei , ban pynïap ïa kiba la tymmen bad ïa kiba dang samla , ban pynïap ïa ki khynnah shynrang bad ki khynnah kynthei ,
Ka briew kaba me la ïohi ka long ka nongbah bakhraw kaba synshar hiar ki syiem jyllang ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And the woman which thou sawest is that great city , which reigneth over the kings of the earth .

translation.kha: U Jehoïada u buh ruh ki nongap phira ha ka kai ha ki khrud jong ka Templ ban khang ïa uno uno u bymkhuid kat kum ka niam .
translation.en: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the  Lord  , that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in .

translation.kha: U da ong , shibun ki kynoi ki longkmie ki tnga kiba babha , hynrei phi long kaba bha tam na ki baroh .
translation.en: Many daughters have done virtuously , but thou excellest them all .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada U Trai u leh ïa kaei kaei kaba ym pat ju ïohsngew , bad ba ka khyndew ka ang bad nguid ïa ki bad ïa baroh kat kaba ki dat , ba Kumta ki thap sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , te phin sa Tip ba keiñ ki briew ki la kyntoit ïa U Trai .
translation.en: But if the  Lord  make a new thing , and the earth open her mouth , and swallow them up , with all that appertain unto them , and they go down quick into the pit  ; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the  Lord .
And the sons of Israel came to buy corn among those that came : for the famine was in the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob lem bad kiwei pat ruh ki la ïawan ban thied kew , namar ba la don ka  nemsniew ha ri Kanaan .

translation.en: Then they said one to another , We do not well : this day is a day of good tidings , and we hold our peace : if we tarry till the morning light , some mischief will come upon us : now therefore come , that we may go and tell the king s household .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien kata ki ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ngim dei ban leh kumne ! Ngi don ka khubor babha , bad ngim dei ban buh ïa ka tang ha lade hi . Lada ngi ap haduh mynstep ban ïathuh ïa ka , ngi thikna ba ngin shah pynshitom . Ïa ngin ïaleit noh shisyndon ban ïathuh ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem !

Ha kaba waiñ noh , ko nongpynïap jong ngi , phi la ïohnang na I kumne phi dei ban im khnap ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei . Kane ka long da shisha , kumno phi la ju im . Sin mynta ngi kyrpad bad kyntu ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu ban leh kham bha’ shuh shuh .
translation.en: Furthermore then we beseech you , brethren , and exhort you by the Lord Jesus , that as ye have received of us how ye ought to walk and to please God , so ye would abound more and more .
And he spake to his sons , saying , Saddle me the ass . And they saddled him .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha la ki khun shynrang ,  Teh jin lem ïa ka kada jong nga .

translation.en: A husband should love his wife just as he loves himself .
translation.kha: U tnga u dei ban ieit ïa la ka tnga kumba u ieit ïalade .

translation.en: And the seven angels came out of the temple , having the seven plagues , clothed in pure and white linen , and having their breasts girded with golden girdles .
translation.kha: Ki hynñiew ki angel kiba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam ki la mihnoh na ka Templ , kiba la kup da ki jaiñ linen ba-thaba kiba khuid lem bad ki panpoh ksiar ba la teh sawdong ki shadem jong ki .

Ko Pa ! Me la ai ïa ki ha ang , bad sa kwah ïa ki ba kin don bad nga ha kabu nga khong , khnang ba ki lah ban ïohi ïa ka barim lad nga , ka burom ïa kaba me la ai ha nga ; naba me la ieit ïa nga ha shuwa ban pynong ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Father , I will that they also , whom thou hast given me , be with me where I am  ; that they may behold my glory , which thou hast given me : for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world .

translation.kha: Te , kitab u syiem Josaïah u la hukum , la leh ïa khie kiei baroh ha “kata ka Sngi ba-bang Mane ïa U Trai , ban sumar ïa ka Jingkhuid Niam Ka Jinglait , bad ïa ka jingai ïa ki jingainguh thang ha ka duwan .
translation.en: So all the service of the  Lord  was prepared the same day , to keep the passover , and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the  Lord  , according to the commandment of king Josiah .

translation.kha: Phi dei ruh ban thung ïa kiwei ki rangbah synsar bad shimti ïa kawei na kaba san bynta na ki jingthung ha ki hynriew snem kiba pahuh .
translation.en: Let Pharaoh do this , and let him appoint officers over the land , and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years .

translation.kha: Kñia ka dei kaei kaba U Trai u ong shang ka jait Hadad bad ïa ki bajar hapoh ka jingïaiban u Hasor , ïa kiba la jop thma da u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia : Tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong ka Kadesh bad pynjot ïa kata ka jait jongu ki briew na mihngi !
translation.en: Concerning Kedar , and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor , which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite , thus saith the  Lord   ; Arise ye , go up to Kedar , and spoil the men of the east .

translation.kha: Bad lada me Law ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ; Hato kan wan sha me bad ong , Nga kliar don leh ei ei ?
translation.en: Canst thou send lightnings , that they may go , and say unto thee , Here we are ?

translation.kha: Balei ba ngi ïashong khep ? Ki briew jong U Blei ki ïakhalai . Ale , ïeng ïaphet sha ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh , mala ïarap hangta . U Trai U Bel jong i u la pynrem ïa im’ ban ïap ; u la ai ha ngi ka bih ban dih , namar ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: Why do we sit still ? assemble yourselves , and let us enter into the defenced cities , and let us be silent there : for the  Lord  our God hath put us to silence , and given us water of gall to drink , because we have sinned against the  Lord .

And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed , he saddled his ass , and arose , and gat him home to his house , to his city , and put his household in order , and hanged himself , and died , and was buried in the sepulchre of his father .
translation.kha: Haba u Ahithophel u la ïohi ba ïa ka jingai jingmut jong u ym shym la pdiang , u la teh jin ïa la ka kada bad u leit phai noh sha la shnong . Ynda u la dep pynbeit ïa la ki kam ïing kam sem , u la sdien phasi ïa lade . La tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ka longïing jong u .
bad Tirsah — baroh ki long laiphew wei jngut ki syiem .
translation.en: The king of Tirzah , one : all the kings thirty and one .

translation.kha: Ka dang long mynmiet katba nga la mihnoh na ka nongbah lyngba ka Khyrdop Them shaphang sepngi bad leit shaphang shathie da kaba ïaid lait ïa ka Ïathuhlypa u Ïakjakor sha ka kyrdoh Synrum . Naba por dang leit , nga khmih ïa ki kynroh ba la pei jong ka nongbah bad ki khmied ïa kiba la pynjot da ka ding .
translation.en: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley , even before the dragon well , and to the dung port , and viewed the walls of Jerusalem , which were broken down , and the gates thereof were consumed with fire .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Terah ! To ïarieh ïa U Trai , ko mynsngi jong nga !
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise the  Lord  , O my soul .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïamareh ha baroh “kata ka thain ; bad shano shano ba ki la ïohsngew ba u don , ki la Wanlam ha u ïa ki briew kiba pang kiba thiah ha ki jingthiah jong ki .
translation.en: And ran through that whole region round about , and began to carry about in beds those that were sick , where they heard he was .

translation.kha: Haba phi la ai ïa kaba bha tam , phi lah banbeiñ bat ïa Kaba dang sah , ruma u nongrep u bat ïa kaba dang sah hadien ba u la wanrah ïa la ka jingainguh .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt say unto them , When ye have heaved the best thereof from it , then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor , and as the increase of the winepress .

translation.kha: Suk kito kiba ka jingim jong ki ka long ka bym don jingbabe , kiba im kat kum ka aïu jong U Trai .
translation.en: Blessed are the undefiled in the way , who walk in the law of the  Lord .
Then said he unto them ,  But now , he that hath a purse , let him take it , and likewise his scrip : and he that hath no sword , let him sell his garment , and buy one .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ,  U Jisu u la ong ,  uno uno uba don ka pla pisa lane ka pla u dei ban rah ïa ka ; bad uno uno u bym don ka waitlam u dei ban die noh ïa ka jaiñkup jong u bad thied kawei .
Nangta u la ïasam ïa ki shabar ka nongbah haduh ha Bethania , ha kaba u la rah ïa la ki kti badno u la kyrkhu ïa ki .
translation.en: And he led them out as far as to Bethany , and he lifted up his hands , and blessed them .
And they put him in ward in chains , and brought him to the king of Babylon : they brought him into holds , that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki buh ïa u hapoh ka ruh bad ki la rah ïa u sha u syiem ka Babilonia . Ki la buh ïa u hapoh ki nongap , ba kumta ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong u yn ym ïohsngew pat halor ki lum jong ka Israel .

translation.en: If then I do that which I would not , I consent unto the law that it is good .
translation.kha: Naba kaei kaba nga leh , ka dei kaei kaba ngam kwah ban leh , kane ka pyn-i ba nga ïamynjur ba ka Hukum ka long kaba dei .
Ko khun u bynriew , ngan phah ïa me Sha ki paid Eliel . Ki la ïaleh pyrshah bad ki phai lyngkot ïa nga bad ki dang ïai pynshisha hi , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la long .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , I send thee to the children of Israel , to a rebellious nation that hath rebelled against me : they and their fathers have transgressed against me , even unto this very day .

translation.kha: Keiñ ka long ka jingïapher kaba shai kdar hapdeng ki khun U blem bad ki khun u Soitan : Uno uno u bym leh ïa kaei kaban dei lynti u bim i-ieit ïa la u hynmen u la um long u khun U blem .
translation.en: In this the children of God are manifest , and the children of the devil : whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God , neither he that loveth not his brother .

translation.kha: Me la ïaid ïa ngi ha kiba mynsaw , kumno te to wat bitar shuh ïa ka Jerusalem . Ka long ka nongbah jong me , u lum bakynja jrong me . Baroh ki briew ha ki ri ba-marjan ki khmih beiñ ïa ka Jeroboam bad ïa ki briew jong me namsop ki pop jong i'u bad ka jingbymman ba ki kper tymmen jong ngi ki la leh .
translation.en: O Lord , according to all thy righteousness , I beseech thee , let thine anger and thy fury be turned away from thy city Jerusalem , thy holy mountain : because for our sins , and for the iniquities of our fathers , Jerusalem and thy people are become a reproach to all that are about us .
And they that use this world , as not abusing it : for the fashion of this world passeth away .
translation.kha: kito kiba pyndonkam ïa ki tiar ba ki ïoh , kumba kim shym lap miet ha kita . Naba kane ka pyrthei , kumba ka long mynta , kan ym neh slem .
Hato u kbeit u nang na me kumno ban her , haba u pyiar la ki thapniang shaphang shathie ?
translation.en: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom , and stretch her wings toward the south ?

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u don ïa kane ban ong ïa ka Nongbah Tyros : Hib la jop ïa pha , ki briew kiba shong basah ha ki rud duriaw kin sngewtriem ha ka jinglynñiar jong kito ibha shahskhor pynïap .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  to Tyre  ; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall , when the wounded cry , when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee ?

translation.kha: Ngi dei ban siew na ka bynta ka um kaba ngi dih ; ngi dei ban thied ïa ka dieng kaba ngi donkam ban thang .
translation.en: We have drunken our water for money  ; our wood is sold unto us .

translation.kha: Te u Paul u la khot ïa uwei na ki jingbabe pynïaidkam bad u la ong ha u , Imlah ïa une u samla sha u rangbah ai hukum , u don ei ei ban ïatih ha u .
translation.en: Then Paul called one of the centurions unto him , and said , Bring this young man unto the chief captain : for he hath a certain thing to tell him .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ba U kba u la ai ha u ïa ka bor baroh ; u la ïatip ba u la wan na U blei bad ba un sa leit shad U Blei .
translation.en: Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands , and that he was come from God , and went to God  ;
When I washed my steps with butter , and the rock poured me out rivers of oil  ;
translation.kha: Ki masi bad ki blang jong nga ki la ai shibun ka dud , bad ki dieng Olib ki la san ha ki khyndew jong ki jaka maw .

Te nga la ong shuh shuh , Ïa baroh ki kynthei bad ki Kynhun jong phi , yn rah nep shaw ki nong bajakhlia , bad ma phi! ruh ïa lade Phin ym mait na ki . Yn sa ïalam ïa phi kum u kyrdoh da u syiem ka bamaïan , bad ïa khnai ka nongjop yn sa thang lut khet .
translation.en: So they shall bring out all thy wives and thy children to the Chaldeans : and thou shalt not escape out of their hand , but shalt be taken by the hand of the king of Babylon : and thou shalt cause this city to be burned with fire .

translation.kha: U la mane bad shakri ïa u Baal , bad kumta u kpa jong u ha Shuah jyllang u , u la pynkhih skei ïa U Trai , U Blei jong ki Israel .
translation.en: For he served Baal , and worshipped him , and provoked to anger the  Lord  God of Israel , according to all that his father had done .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la ong , ïathuh ïa u nongsynshar ka Tyros katei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga noh ha u : Ba la pynhieng da ka jingsarong , me kam ba me dei U blem . Me ong ba kum U Blei me shongduh ha ka klet , ba la ker sawdong da ki duriaw-bah . Me lah shun leh mynleh khim U Blei , hynrei , em , me long uba kynja briew , ym uba kynja blei .
translation.en: Son of man , say unto the prince of Tyre , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thine heart is lifted up , and thou hast said , I am a God , I sit in the seat of God , in the midst of the seas  ; yet thou art a man , and not God , though thou set thine heart as the heart of God :

translation.kha: Ynda ki la pyndep ïa ka jingpynbha , ïa ka ksah bad ka rupa kambah tur la ai sha u syiem bad sha u Jehoïada , kiba la pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba phiah shwa ïa ki pliang bad kiwei ki pat ki khieshoh ki pliang na ka bynta ka Templ . Kat u Jehoïada u dang im , ïa ki jingkñia la ai tista ha ka Templ .
translation.en: And when they had finished it , they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada , whereof were made vessels for the house of the  Lord  , even vessels to minister , and to offer withal , and spoons , and vessels of gold and silver . And they offered burnt offerings in the house of the  Lord  continually all the days of Jehoiada .

translation.kha: Un ba-bang ïa ka million jong u junom , ki jingkular jong u na ka bniat ki hajar ki pateng .
translation.en: He hath remembered his covenant for ever , the word which he commanded to a thousand generations .

translation.kha: U Jehoïada um kwah ba ka Athalaïah kan shah pynïap ha ka phyllaw ka Templ , te u hukum ïa ki rangbah shipai : Rah ïa ka shabar napdeng ki ar laiñ ba ïeng ki nongap phria , bad pynïap ïa uwei pa uei uba pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa ka .
translation.en: But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds , the officers of the host , and said unto them , Have her forth without the ranges : and him that followeth her kill with the sword . For the priest had said , Let her not be slain in the house of the  Lord .
Thus saith the  Lord   ; A voice was heard in Ramah , lamentation , and bitter weeping  ; Rachel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children , because they were not .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  La ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ha Ramah , ka jingsawa jong ka jingïam kthang . Ka Rakhel ka ïam namar ki khun jong ka ; ki la ïap noh , bad kam treh ba yn pyntngen ïa ka .

translation.en: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence  ; and the images , that were on high above them , he cut down  ; and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images , he brake in pieces , and made dust of them , and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them .
translation.kha: Hapoh ka jingbthah jong u ïa ki duwan ha kaba la mane ïa u Baal la pynpra , bad ïa ki duwan jingiwbih hajan jong ki la pyntwa . Ki pynlwet kum ki pui pui ïa ki dur ka Asherah bad ïa kiwei ki bleithaw baroh bad nangta ki bret ïa u pui pui ha ki jingtep jong ki briew kiba la ai jingkñia ïa lade ha ki .

To u angel wahbah la pyllait ïa nga na ka jingsniew baher , un kyrkhu ïa ki ! To ka ktang jong nga , bad ka jong ki kparad jong nga , u Abraham bad u Isaak , Kan ïai im lyngba kine ki khun ! To kin don bun ki khun ki kti bad ki khun ki ksiew kiba ngon !
translation.en: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil , bless the lads  ; and let my name be named on them , and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac  ; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth .

translation.kha: To khmih ïa ka jingïaishah slem U Trai jong ngi kumin ka lad ba u ai ha phi ban Ïohi im , wohnia u Baal u para ba-ieit jongno ine u la Thoh ha phi , da kaba pynbunkam ïa ka jingdeng Kaba U Blei u la ai ha u .
translation.en: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation  ; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you  ;

translation.kha: Kane Sa Wan
translation.en: they will come

translation.kha: U thang ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka nongbah , lem bad ki ïingsyiem baher bad ka spah jong ka , mala u pyntwa ïa ka kynroh jngai ka nongbah .
translation.en: And they burnt the house of God , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem , and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire , and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka Templ , da ki jingpyrshang jong nga , nga la lum palat ïa lai hajar Shispah thom ka ksai bad palat ïa laiphew saw hajar tin ka rupa ban pyndonkam ha kaba tei ïa ka . Nalor katai , la don bun bah ka rnong bad ka nar . Nga la pynkhreh ruh ïa ka dieng bun u mawleiñ , hynriew me dei ban pynni shuh shuh .
translation.en: Now , behold , in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the  Lord  an hundred thousand talents of gold , and a thousand thousand talents of silver  ; and of brass and iron without weight  ; for it is in abundance : timber also and stone have I prepared  ; and thou mayest add thereto .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la wan ha u bad ki la pyrshah ban riam ïa u . Ïathuh ïa ngi , ki la kylli , haduh ka Hukum jong ngi ka shah ne em ïa u briew ban pyllait ïa ka tnga jong u ?
translation.en: And the Pharisees came to him , and asked him , Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife ? tempting him .
And they set the priests in their divisions , and the Levites in their courses , for the service of God , which is at Jerusalem  ; as it is written in the book of Moses .
translation.kha: Ki la buh ryntih ruh ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi na ka bynta ka jingshakri ha ka Templ ha Jerusalem , kat kum ki jingbthah bad don ha ka kitab u Moses .
Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U Trai u la sa kumba u la ïong bad ki jingriam baroh jong ki nongai Ijipt ki la ïap , hynrei khawai ruh na ki jingri jong ki Israel kam shym ïap .
translation.en: And the  Lord  did that thing on the morrow , and all the cattle of Egypt died : but of the cattle of the children of Israel died not one .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki shu jot ei namar ktem pdiang ïa nga . Phi ki lyngdoh kitab suidñiew ban pdiang ïa na bad phi la kyntait ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , bad kamut nga la kyntait noh ïa phi bad ngan ym Pdiang ïa ki khun jong ph kum ki lyngdoh jong nga .
translation.en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge : because thou hast rejected knowledge , I will also reject thee , that thou shalt be no priest to me : seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God , I will also forget thy children .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la bynta ïa ka ri kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: As the  Lord  commanded Moses , so the children of Israel did , and they divided the land .

translation.kha: Hynrei wat la ki ïoh pynheh pynsan ïa la ki khun , ngan shim noh ïa ki bad ngan ym pynsah im uei duh . Haba kan ingiew ino ïa film ki briew , kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kin wan jia ha ki .
translation.en: Though they bring up their children , yet will I bereave them , that there shall not be a man left : yea , woe also to them when I depart from them !

translation.kha: Bad ïa ki briew ka Judah kiba sah bad babha la khun jingmut ban saw bad shong ha Ijipt , ngan khmih ïa kane ba baroh na ki kin jot noh . barieh na ki , kiba rit malu ki bakhraw , kin ïap ha Ijipt , na ka thlim ne na ka jingïapthngan . Kin long ka jingïohi ba-ïatrei ; ki briew kin ñiewbeiñ ïa ki mala pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim .
translation.en: And I will take the remnant of Judah , that have set their faces to go into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , and they shall all be consumed , and fall in the land of Egypt  ; they shall even be consumed by the sword and by the famine : they shall die , from the least even unto the greatest , by the sword and by the famine : and they shall be an execration , and an astonishment , and a curse , and a reproach .

The burden of the beasts of the south : into the land of trouble and anguish , from whence come the young and old lion , the viper and fiery flying serpent , they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses , and their treasures upon the bunches of camels , to a people that shall not profit them .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor jong U Blei shaphang ki mrad jong ka ri shyiap bashathie :  Ki nongkit  tiensyiem ki ïaid lyngba ka ri bashyrkhei , ha kaba ki sing ki don bad ha kaba ki bseiñ kiba don bih bad ki Ïakjakor kiba her . Ki pynkit halor ki kada bad ki ut jong ki da ki jingai sngewbha baremdor na ka bynta ka hima ka bym lah ban ai ïa ki kano kano ka jingïarap .

Syiem Kynrad , to shim ïa ka , u Araunah u ong , mala to kñia ha U Trai ïa kano kano kaba phi mon . Kin stong ki masi dab don thang kum ka jingainguh halor ka duwan ; kine hangne ki dei ki lyngkor jong ki bun ka lyntang shoh kew ban pyndonkam kum ka diengthang .
translation.en: And Araunah said unto David , Let my lord the king take and offer up what seemeth good unto him : behold , here be oxen for burnt sacrifice , and threshing instruments and other instruments of the oxen for wood .

translation.kha: u Shimron u la skhem ïa u khunlung ha ki kthang ti jong u bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei :
translation.en: Then took he him up in his arms , and blessed God , and said ,
And would to God this people were under my hand ! then would I remove Abimelech . And he said to Abimelech , Increase thine army , and come out .
translation.kha: Nga pyrkhat ba ngan ïoh ïalam ïa kine ki briew ! ngan jin da la pynher krad ïa u Abimelekh ! Ngan ong ïa u , ‘ Pynbun shuh shuh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me , ale to mih ban ïaleh !’

translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against this land , to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book :
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa la ki briew bad u la pynngat ha ka ri jong ki ïa ki jingtim baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab .
Na ka bynta jong ngi U Josis u la rung hapoh hangta shuwa jong ngi , bad u la jia long U nongbah Lyngdoh jngum , ha ka rukom long lyngkhuh u Meshekh .
translation.en: Whither the forerunner is for us entered , even Jesus , made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec .

translation.kha: U Jisu badno ki synran jyllang u , kynthih ïa u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki la mihnoh na ka synagog bad ki la leit beit sha ka ïing u Sihon bad u Andriw .
translation.en: And forthwith , when they were come out of the synagogue , they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew , with James and John .

translation.kha: U la leit sha u , u la theh umphniang bad ka waiñ ha ki jingmong jngai u bad u la spaiñ ïa ki ; nangta u la buh ïa iathuh u briew halor u jingri jong u bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ka bymshisha , ha kaba u la sumar ïa u .
translation.en: And went to him , and bound up his wounds , pouring in oil and wine , and set him on his own beast , and brought him to an inn , and took care of him .

translation.kha: Nongbah uno uno u bym long byrsha ïa ngi u long ha ka liang jong i .
translation.en: For he that is not against us is on our part .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la dep bam , U Jisu u la ong ïa u Simon Petros , Ko Solomon , u khun jong u Jona , me kham ieit ma me ïa nga ban ïa kaba kine kiwei ki ieit ? ïa-ïohi , ko Trai’ , u la jubab , me Tip ba nga imat ïa me . U Jisu u la ong ha u , To samla ïa ki khunlangbrot jong nga .
translation.en: So when they had dined , Jesus saith to Simon Peter ,  Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me more than these ?  He saith unto him , Yea , Lord  ; thou knowest that I love thee . He saith unto him ,  Feed my lambs .
Then said Samuel , Wherefore then dost thou ask of me , seeing the  Lord  is departed from thee , and is become thine enemy ?
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ,  Balei keiñ ba me da khot ïa nga haba U  Trai  u la iehnoh ïa me bad u la kylla long u nongshun jong me ?

translation.en: Who found favour before God , and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob .
translation.kha: U la ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong U Blei , bad u la kyrpad ïa U Blei ban shah ïa u ban pynkhreh ka ïing na ka bynta U Blei jong u Jakob .

translation.en: Which justify the wicked for reward , and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him !
translation.kha: Hynrei tang namar ka jingïoh pisa bymdei phi shah ïa kiba shah pynrem ban lait bad phi khang ïa kiba lui lui na kaba ïoh ïa ka jingbishar hok .
ka Hormah , ka Arad ,
translation.en: The king of Hormah , one  ; the king of Arad , one  ;

translation.kha: Bad ba ong ba u briew um dei ban kli , — hynrei phi kyllum ? Phi isih ïa ki bleithaw — hynrei phi lute ha ki templ ?
translation.en: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery , dost thou commit adultery ? thou that abhorrest idols , dost thou commit sacrilege ?
Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world , or with the covetous , or extortioners , or with idolaters ; for then must ye needs go out of the world .
translation.kha: Mynta ngam mut ïa ki bymngeit kiba awria ne kiba lalot ne kiba long ki nongtuh ne kiba mane ïa ki bleithaw . Ban lait na kine phi dei ban mihnoh shisyndon na ka pyrthei .
Ha kano ka rukom la pynshong nongrim ïa ki jingïalang jongu ngi ?
translation.en: On what pattern are our congregation meetings based ?

translation.kha: Shaphat ka jait Joseph u ong , To U Trai un kyrkhu ïa ka ri jong ki da u slap Bad da ka um napoh khyndew .
translation.en: And of Joseph he said , Blessed of the  Lord  be his land , for the precious things of heaven , for the dew , and for the deep that coucheth beneath ,
Then the king said unto me , For what dost thou make request ? So I prayed to the God of heaven .
translation.kha: U patsha u kylli ,  Kaei kaba me kwah ?

translation.en: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen , and they shall possess their houses : I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease  ; and their holy places shall be defiled .
translation.kha: Ngan wanrah ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba sniew tam hangne bad ailad ïa ki ban shimti ïa ki ïing jong phi . Ki briew kiba khlaiñ tam jong phi kin duh noh ïa la ka jingsngewskhem ynda nga shah ïa ki jaitbynriew ba kin pynjakhlia ïa ki jaka ha kaba phi mane .
Hodaïah , u phlang u ïapli bad ki syntiew ki jlop , hynrei ka katei jongnga U Blei jong ngi ka ne bymjukut .
translation.en: The grass withereth , the flower fadeth : but the word of our God shall stand for ever .

translation.kha: Isih ïa kaei kaba snieh , ieit ïa kaei kaba bha , bad peit ba ka jingbishar khor ka ïeng ha ki ïingbishar . Lehse U Trai , un isynei ïa ki briew jong kane ka hima ibha dang pynsah ïa-ban im .
translation.en: Hate the evil , and love the good , and establish judgment in the gate : it may be that the  Lord  God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph .

translation.kha: ban ong ha u Aaron , ha ki khun shynrang jongki u , bad ha ki Israel baroh , Haba uno uno u Israel lane u nongwei uba ha Israel u ai ïa ka jingainguh thang , la ka long ka jingpyndep ïa kano kano ka jingkular lane kum ka jingweng mon sngewbha , kata ka jingainguh ,
translation.en: Speak unto Aaron , and to his sons , and unto all the children of Israel , and say unto them , Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel , or of the strangers in Israel , that will offer his oblation for all his vows , and for all his freewill offerings , which they will offer unto the  Lord  for a burnt offering  ;

translation.kha: U Joshua u la kurup ïa kine ki nongbet baroh bad ïa ki syiem jong ki , da kaba pynïap ïa ti pa uwei , ruma u Moses , u shakri jongki U thri , u la hukum .
translation.en: And all the cities of those kings , and all the kings of them , did Joshua take , and smote them with the edge of the sword , and he utterly destroyed them , as Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded .

translation.kha: U Shebuel , uba na ka kur u Gershon , u khun jong u Moses , u dei u rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh uba kitkhlieh ïa ki ïing jingkynshew jong ka Templ .
translation.en: And Shebuel the son of Gershom , the son of Moses , was ruler of the treasures .
And if the priest see that , behold , the scab spreadeth in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a leprosy .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa u sa shisien , bad lada kata ka prum ka la pur , un pynbna ba u long u bymkhuid ; ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh .

translation.en: Get you out of the way , turn aside out of the path , cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us .
translation.kha: Wat ïeng ha ka lynti jong ngi bad wat kah ïa ka lynti ïaid jong ngi . Ngim kwah ban ïohsngew shaphang U Blei Bakhuid jong phi ki Israel .
Ngan phah ka jingïapthem bad pynjot thiaw ïa ki , hynrei ïa me ngan pynlong u kpa ka jaitbynriew kaba kham khrawburom pynlang kham khlam ban ïa ki !
translation.en: I will smite them with the pestilence , and disinherit them , and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they .

translation.kha: U pynkhlur ïa ka jingshai na ka jingdiang da ka syrwiang ba la pruid dak ha khmat ka duriaw .
translation.en: He hath compassed the waters with bounds , until the day and night come to an end .
Thou wilt say then , The branches were broken off , that I might be grafted in .
translation.kha: Hynrei phin ong ,  Ho-oid , ïa ki tnat la pynkheiñ noh ban ai jaka na ka bynta jong nga .
Bad ka longsem katba bha tam ban nang ïa kan ka jingïaishah ha ka jinglong samla jong ngi .
translation.en: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth .

translation.kha: Ïa ki jingteh kiba u Dabid u la ai ha ki lyngdoh bad ki lehbeiñ kiba ïadei Bad ki ïing buh tiar bad kyiuh kiwei ki kam la bud bniah .
translation.en: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter , or concerning the treasures .

translation.kha: ka por ngab phyllad jingieit bad ka por ban ym jingïaphylliew jingieit , ka na ban ïadoh bad ka por ban ym ïadoh .
translation.en: A time to cast away stones , and a time to gather stones together  ; a time to embrace , and a time to refrain from embracing  ;

translation.kha: U Isaak u ong , Wanrah Hangne ïa sakma ka doh . Adonijah ba nga la ba-im ïa ka , ngan sa kyrkhu ïa phi . U Jakob u wanrah ïa ka sha u , malade u la bam ; u wanrah katto katai ka waiñ ruh ïa u ban dih .
translation.en: And he said , Bring it near to me , and I will eat of my son s venison , that my soul may bless thee . And he brought it near to him , and he did eat : and he brought him wine , and he drank .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka jingïohipaw ha ka por mynmiet , nga la ïohi ïa katai ka i kum u briew . U la wan sha la , ba la ker sawdong da u lyoh , bad u la wait sha uta uba la im jyrngam nabar la ai sngewbha ha u .
translation.en: I saw in the night visions , and , behold , one like the Son of man came with the clouds of heaven , and came to the Ancient of days , and they brought him near before him .

translation.kha: Ka sah” jong me ka don bad nga ha ka jer baroh bad ka pynlong ïa nga uba khnam Stad ban ïa ki nongshun jong nga .
translation.en: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies : for they are ever with me .

translation.kha: U tharai un pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew kumba u la leh ïa u Saphon bad u Og , ki syiem Amor , bad kumba u la pynjot ïa ka ri lad ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og , kings of the Amorites , and unto the land of them , whom he destroyed .
And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding : and they would not come .
translation.kha: U la phah ïa ki shakri jong u ban ïathuh ha ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ban wan sha ka jingkhawai , hynrei kim kwah ban wan .

translation.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David his father : and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Rehoboam u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
Em ! Ngin sien malade phi shai ki briew jong phin .
translation.en: And they said unto her , Surely we will return with thee unto thy people .
And being brought on their way by the church , they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria , declaring the conversion of the Gentiles : and they caused great joy unto all the brethren .
translation.kha: La leit on lynti ïa ki da ka balang ; bad kaba ki dang leit lyngba ka Phoenisia bad ka Samaria , ki la ïathuh kumno ba ki Jentil ki la phai sha U Blei ; kane ka khubor ka la wallam ka jingkmen bakhraw ïa ki parabangeit baroh .
U Blei u la ai ïa ka hukum lyngba u Moses , hynrei ka jinghikai bad ka jingshisha ki la wan lyngba U Jiw Khrist .
translation.en: For the law was given by Moses , but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Ki la shakri kum ki nongbishar na ka bynshet u paidbah ha ki por baroh , da kaban wallam ïa ki kam kiba eh sha u Mosah hynrei ki bishar hi ïa ki jingïakajia kiba rit .
translation.en: And they judged the people at all seasons : the hard causes they brought unto Moses , but every small matter they judged themselves .

translation.kha: U Blei um shym la klet ïa u Noah , bad ïa ki nud baroh Ibbah ïada lakam bad u ha ka lieng ; u la pynlong ïa ka lyer ba beh , bad ka um ka la sdang hiar .
translation.en: And God remembered Noah , and every living thing , and all the cattle that was with him in the ark : and God made a wind to pass over the earth , and the waters assuaged  ;

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa u angel babha la lah kren ha nga ba u kum sha khmat bad ba uwei pat u angel u la wan ban ïashad ïa u .
translation.en: And , behold , the angel that talked with me went forth , and another angel went out to meet him ,

translation.kha: U angel jong U Trai u la wanpaw ha u hangta , bad u ong , U Trai u don ryngkat bad me , me u briew bashlur bad bakhlaiñ !
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto him , and said unto him , The  Lord  is with thee , thou mighty man of valour .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki synran ki la wan sha ryngkew ha ka lieng , ki da ïatan ïa ka tong kaba la dap da ki shongkha . Kim shym da don jngai eh na ryngkew , kumba shispah mitar ei ei .
translation.en: And the other disciples came in a little ship  ; ( for they were not far from land , but as it were two hundred cubits , ) dragging the net with fishes .
When Joab and all the host that was with him were come , they told Joab , saying , Abner the son of Ner came to the king , and he hath sent him away , and he is gone in peace .
translation.kha: Haba u Joab bad ki rangbah jong u ki la poi , la ïathuh ha u ba u Abner u la wan sha u syiem Dabid , bad ba u Dabid u la phah noh ïa u lem bad ka jingkular jingshngain .
Katba phi dang ïania Slem , kor ka dang long ka bymngeit , bad phim shym long uba kham bit khem ibiang .
translation.en: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity , what is man the better ?

translation.kha: Naba ngi long ki khun jong U Blei , ngin ïohkynti ïa ki jingkyrkhu kiba u buhai na ka bynta ki briew jong u , bad ngin ïohkynti ruh lem bad U Khrist ïa kadei kaba U Balei u la eh buh na ka bynta jong u ; Naba lada sem ïadon bynta lem ha ka jingshah shitom U Khrist , ngin ïoh ruh ban ïadat bynta ha ka burom jong u .
translation.en: And if children , then heirs ; heirs of God , and joint-heirs with Christ ; if so be that we suffer with him , that we may be also glorified together .
Said he not unto me , She is my sister ? and she , even she herself said , He is my brother : in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this .
translation.kha: U Abraham hi u la ong ba ka dei ka para jong u , bad ka ruh ka ong kumjuh . Nga la leh ïa kane da ka jingïatiplem kaba sngur , bad ngam shym la leh bakla .
Kumno nga eh ban tei ïa kadei ka U Blang um shym la tim , Lane kren shaphang ka jingjot hajan U Trai um shym kren ?
translation.en: How shall I curse , whom God hath not cursed ? or how shall I defy , whom the  Lord  hath not defied ?

translation.kha: Nangta ki lyngdoh ki bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jong sha ka Templ pynlang ki thuh ïa ka ha Ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam , hapoh ki kherub .
translation.en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  unto his place , into the oracle of the house , to the most holy place , even under the wings of the cherubims .

translation.kha: Nangta u nongrah khuri u ong ha u syiem , Nga dei ban phla mynta ba per la leh bakla .
translation.en: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh , saying , I do remember my faults this day :

translation.kha: Te , kaei pat ? Ngin ïong ha phi ba wat la un ym khie malu ai ha phi ïa u kpu , nabar ba pa dei u paralok jong u , pynban un khie joit bad ai ha pa’ ïa kaei kaei barieh kob phi donkam Naaman ba phim lehrain ban ïaid panpoh .
translation.en: I say unto you , Though he will not rise and give him , because he is his friend , yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth .

translation.kha: Ka dur ka i phin la kum ka ainong hateng ka tyngkan .
translation.en: And I saw as the colour of amber , as the appearance of fire round about within it , from the appearance of his loins even upward , and from the appearance of his loins even downward , I saw as it were the appearance of fire , and it had brightness round about .

translation.kha: Nga ïaroh ïa me , A Trai , namar me la sngewkyiuh ïa nga , bad me la ai ka jingjop ïa nga .
translation.en: I will praise thee : for thou hast heard me , and art become my salvation .

translation.kha: U Solomon u la shongkurim hynñiewspah nud ki khun syiem kynthei bad laispah ngut ruh ki tnga kliar .
translation.en: And he had seven hundred wives , princesses , and three hundred concubines : and his wives turned away his heart .
Doth not wisdom cry ? and understanding put forth her voice ?
translation.kha: To shahshkor ! Ka jingstad ka pyrta jam . Ka jingshemphang ka kren jam .
Hynrei u Moses u Joab , Em , Kynrad , sngewbha phah noh daiñ dano .
translation.en: And he said , O my Lord , send , I pray thee , by the hand of him whom thou wilt send .

translation.kha: U Abraham u la iehnoh ïa kaei kaei kaba u don ha u Isak ;
translation.en: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac .

translation.kha: U duh u ong , Nga mynjur ïa kata , tnga tang uta uba sping ïa ka khuri un long u mraw jong nga ; kiwei patan ki lah ïa-ban leit noh .
translation.en: And he said , Now also let it be according unto your words : he with whom it is found shall be my servant  ; and ye shall be blameless .

So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded , and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath , with them that were to go out on the sabbath : for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi bad ki briew ka Judah ki leh kumba la bthah da u Jehoïada . Ym shym la phah noh ïa ki rangbah haba ki la pyndep ïa la ki kamram ha ka Sabbaton , kumta ki rangbah ai hukum ki ïoh lang ïa kito kiba dang wan sha la ki kam bad kito kiba la pyndep kam .
Kin sorkar lyngba ka Judah ha ka jingshlei um , da kaba kiwei haduh tyngkan bad tap lin ïa kaei kaei baroh . U Blei u long lem dara ngi ! Ki thiang jong u ba la pyiar shabi ki ïada ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And he shall pass through Judah  ; he shall overflow and go over , he shall reach even to the neck  ; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land , O Immanuel .

translation.kha: Kito ki ban tei pat ïa pha kin sa wan shen , bad kito kiba pynjot ïa phasi kin ithuh noh .
translation.en: Thy children shall make haste  ; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee .

translation.kha: Bad namar ka jingpynshisha ïa kambah kane ka jingshakri lad phi ka wallam , bun ki ban ai burom ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingïaineh jong phi ha ka gospel U Khrist , ïa kaba phi ïaphla , bad ïa ka jinglehsbun jong pa ha kaba ïasah bynta lakam bad ki bad uwei pa uwei shwa .
translation.en: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ , and for your liberal distribution unto them , and unto all men ;
Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins  ; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they , and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done .
translation.kha: Ka Samaria kam shym leh pop shiteng na kaei kaba pha la leh . Pha la leh kham ijli ban ïa kaba ka la leh . Ka jingbamsap jong pha ka pynlong ïa ki hynmen ki para kynthei jong pha ban i lui lui da kaba ïanujor .
Men ai ïa ngi ka jingroi jingpar , A Trai ; baroh kata kaba ngi pyndih ha ka jingjop ka long ka jingkhum na kaei kaba me leh .
translation.en: Lord  , thou wilt ordain peace for us : for thou also hast wrought all our works in us .

translation.kha: U Isaak u phah noh ïa u Jakob shiah Mesopotamia , sha u Aben , uba long u khun jong u Bethuel u nongïam Aram , bad u hynmen lad ka Rebekka , ka kmie jong Jakob bad u Iso .
translation.en: And Isaac sent away Jacob : and he went to Paddan–aram unto Laban , son of Bethuel the Syrian , the brother of Rebekah , Jacob s and Esau s mother .
But the lad knew not any thing : only Jonathan and David knew the matter .
translation.kha: khlem da peiphang ei ei ka mut aïu kane baroh ; tang u Jonathan bad u Dabid ki tip .

translation.en: And fell at his feet , and said , Upon me , my lord , upon me let this iniquity be : and let thine handmaid , I pray thee , speak in thine audience , and hear the words of thine handmaid .
translation.kha: ha ki kjat jong u Dabid , bad ka ong ha u ,  Sngewbha , ko kynrad , to sngap ïa nga ! Ai ngan kit pop ma nga .
Haba ka sngi ka la jaiñ sep , u Abram u shoh Sephanaïah eh , pynlang ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingsngew shyrkhei ka la wan ha u .
translation.en: And when the sun was going down , a deep sleep fell upon Abram  ; and , lo , an horror of great darkness fell upon him .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbamsap bad ka um phi ia ban thied na ki .’
translation.en: Ye shall buy meat of them for money , that ye may eat  ; and ye shall also buy water of them for money , that ye may drink .

translation.kha: Bad uwei na ki u la shohdoh ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad u la ot nong ïa ka sorkar kamon jong u .
translation.en: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest , and cut off his right ear .

translation.kha: Hynrei Mynta nga noh ha phiah : ïa uno uno uba bitar ïa la u para yn wallam sha ka jingbishar , ïa du uno uba khot ïa la u para ‘ Me u bymlarkam ei ei !’ yn Wanlam ha khmat ka Dorbar Bah , bad ïa Uno uno uba khot ïa la u para ‘ u bieit bymmyntoi’ un don ha ka jingma ka jingkit sha ka dujok ding .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment : and whosoever shall say to his brother , Raca , shall be in danger of the council : but whosoever shall say , Thou fool , shall be in danger of hell fire .

translation.kha: Namar kamai kaba u Phinehas u la leh , ngam bitar thuh ïa ki paid Israel . U kyntait ban shah ïa ka jingmane ïa uno uno u blei lait tang ïa ang , bad namarba kata ngam Shimham la pynjot ïa ki wat hajuh de la bitar .
translation.en: Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel , while he was zealous for my sake among them , that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy .
They took their sheep , and their oxen , and their asses , and that which was in the city , and that which was in the field ,
translation.kha: Ki la shim ïa ki kynhun jingri , ki jingri , ki kada , bad baroh katba don ha shnong bad ha lyngkha .

translation.en: And the  Lord  did so  ; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh , and into his servants  houses , and into all the land of Egypt : the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u leh kumta ; ki skain da ki kynhun bah ki wan rung hapoh ïing jong u Pharaoh bad hapoh ïing jong ki rangbah synshar jong u . Ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei ka julor ha kita ki skain .
Uno une u bym bthah ïa la ka diengphna bad wan nadien jong de , um lah ban long u synran jong sa .
translation.en: And whosoever doth not bear his cross , and come after me , cannot be my disciple .
And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph , even to Ephraim and to Manasseh , saying , Thou art a great people , and hast great power : thou shalt not have one lot only :
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki jait Ephraim bad Manasseh ba sha Sepngi ,  Da shisha phi ïabun paid , bad phi long kiba khlaiñbor . Phi ïoh shuh shuh nalor ka shi bynta .
U Israel um dei u mraw ; ym shym la kha ïa u shat ka jinglongmraw . Balei te ba ki nongshun jrong u ki behmrad ïa u ?
translation.en: Is Israel a servant ? is he a homeborn slave ? why is he spoiled ?

They sent therefore and gathered all the lords of the Philistines unto them , and said , What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel ? And they answered , Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried about unto Gath . And they carried the ark of the God of Israel about thither .
translation.kha: Kumta ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad khot lang ïa baroh san ngut ki syiem Philistia bad kylli ïa ki ,  Ngin leh kumno ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Israel ?   Leit rah ïa ka sha Gath ,  ki la jubab ; kumta ki bah ïa ka sha Gath , kawei pat ka nongbah ki Philistia .
Khat-ar tylli ki dur sing ki ei ha ki mawkyntang , uwei uei ha ka tduh jong kawei pa kawei ka kyrdon . Ym pat ju don ka khet kaba kum khnai ha kaei pat ka hima .
translation.en: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps . There was not the like made in any kingdom .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam ki Jiw ki la pyndih bha ïa ka jingtei ïa ka Templ , ba la ai jingpyrshang da ki nongïathuhlypa , u Haggai bad u Sekharaïah . Ki pynsep ïa ka Templ kumba la hukum da U Blei ki Israel bad da u Syros , u Darius bad u Artakserksis , ki patsha ka Persia .
translation.en: And the elders of the Jews builded , and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo . And they builded , and finished it , according to the commandment of the God of Israel , and according to the commandment of Cyrus , and Darius , and Artaxerxes king of Persia .

translation.kha: U sdang da ka jingkren beiñ Bad u kut ha ka jinglamwir .
translation.en: The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness : and the end of his talk is mischievous madness .
Wilt thou play with him as with a bird ? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens ?
translation.kha: Hato men teh ïa u kum ïa ka sim ba ri ha ïing , kum kaei kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa ki shakri kynthei jong me ?

U Trai u ong ha ki briew jong u , To sum jaiñ khain bad to tyllun ha u dpei . To ïam sngewsih lam bad ki ummat kthang kumba phin ïan ïa u khun Moraïah , namar uta uba woh ban pynjot ïa phira un tur ïaleh kynsan .
translation.en: O daughter of my people , gird thee with sackcloth , and wallow thyself in ashes : make thee mourning , as for an only son , most bitter lamentation : for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us .
By me kings reign , and princes decree justice .
translation.kha: Nga ïarap ïa ki syiem ban synshar , bad ki nongsynshar ban thaw ki aiñ kiba bha .

translation.en: He saith , Yes . And when he was come into the house , Jesus prevented him , saying ,  What thinkest thou , Simon ? of whom do the kings of the earth take custom or tribute ? of their own children , or of strangers ?
translation.kha: Ho-oid shisha ,  u Petros u la jubab . Haba u Petros u la rung shapoh ïing , U Jisu u la kren nyngkong ,  Ko Simon , kaei ka jingpyrkhat jong me ? Mano ba siew ïa ki bai khrong lane ki khajna sha ki syiem jong kane ka pyrthei ? Ki traishnong jong ka ri ne ki nongwei ?

translation.en: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort :
translation.kha: U Rehum ruh , u lat , bad u Shimshai , u sekretari jong ka probins    , ki thoh ïa kane ka shithi sha u Artakserksis na Jerusalem :

Ha kata ka sngi U Trai un pyndonkam ïa ka waitsum bymdondor dara ba-ishyrkhei jong u ban pyndem ïa u Lebiathan , uta u Ïakjakor uba khih bad uba khyrwait , bad ban pynïap ïa uta u mrad kynsha wahbah im ha ka duriaw .
translation.en: In that day the  Lord  with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent , even leviathan that crooked serpent  ; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea .

translation.kha: Te , kamra u syiem Josaïah u la hukum , la kun ïa kiei kiei baroh ha kata ka sner ban mane ïa U Tharai , ban sumar ïa ka Jingkhawai Maham Ka Jinglaitluid , bad ïa ka jingai ïa ki jingainguh thang ha ka duwan .
translation.en: So all the service of the  Lord  was prepared the same day , to keep the passover , and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the  Lord  , according to the commandment of king Josiah .

translation.kha: Ngan lai ïa kane namar ki briew ki la iehnoh ïa nga bad ki la pyntngit ïa Kanah ka jaka da kaba ai jingkñia hangne sha kiwei pat ki blei — ki blei kiba ym ma ki lymne ki kpa tymmen jong ki lymne ki syiem jong ka Judah ki la tip ei ei . Ki la pynpyut ïa kane ka jaka da ka snam jong ki briew bakha la lui ,
translation.en: Because they have forsaken me , and have estranged this place , and have burned incense in it unto other gods , whom neither they nor their fathers have known , nor the kings of Judah , and have filled this place with the blood of innocents  ;

And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal , and brake it down  ; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly , and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars . And the priest appointed officers over the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta ki paidbah ki leit sha ka templ u Baal bad ki pynkyllon ïa ka ; ki pynpra ïa ki duwan bad ïa ki bleithaw , bad ki pynïap ïa u Mattan , u lyngdoh jong u Baal , ha khmat ki duwan . U Jehoïada u buh ïa ki nongap phira kiba dei treikam ha ka Templ ,
Kumta te ki tieng baroh ki ong ha u dieng shiah , ‘ Ale wan bad long u syiem jong ngi .’
translation.en: Then said all the trees unto the bramble , Come thou , and reign over us .

translation.kha: Shi pynbha jongu ka ri ha ka phan sepngi jong ka Jordan la ai ha ki katto katne ki longïing kiba hiarpateng na u Mareshah , u khun nyngkong jong u Joseph . U Makhir , u kpa jongki u Gilead , u dei u khun nyngkong jongki u Manasseh bad u kylla-kaba-mut uba pawnam ; kumta ïa ka Gaddah bad ka Bashan , ha ka phang mihngi ka Jordan , la ai ha u .
translation.en: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh  ; for he was the firstborn of Joseph  ; to wit , for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh , the father of Gilead : because he was a man of war , therefore he had Gilead and Bashan .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U Trai un pynlong ïa ki ba kin shaïong jingman bad pyrkhing ïaheh main ba imat uwei baroh un kem ïa u Briew hajan jong u bad Tur ïaleh ïa u .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that a great tumult from the  Lord  shall be among them  ; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour , and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour .

translation.kha: Hodaïah ba ki sawphew snem ki la ïaid , u angel u la paw ha u Moses ha ki tyllai ding jong ka lawlynnong kaba ing hasem u lum Sinai .
translation.en: And when forty years were expired , there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sinai an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada Uno uno um sumar ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , khmat ïa ki dkhot ka Long jong u hi , u la len ïa ka jingngeit bad u kham sniew ban ïa u bymnang .
translation.en: But if any provide not for his own , and specially for those of his own house , he hath denied the faith , and is worse than an infidel .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ka Jehoïada kan long ka nongkynti bakyrpang jong U thri ha ka ri Bakyntang jong u , bad ka Jerusalem kan long ka nongbah kaba u ieit tam na baher .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall inherit Judah his portion in the holy land , and shall choose Jerusalem again .
And the time that he reigned over Israel was forty years  ; seven years reigned he in Hebron , and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U la synshar ha Hebron hynñiew snem ha Jerusalem laiphew lai snem .

translation.en: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city , and they said unto him , Shew us , we pray thee , the entrance into the city , and we will shew thee mercy .
translation.kha: kiba la ïohi ïa uwei u briew uba wan mih bad ki ong ha u ,  Pyni ïa ngi kumno ngin ïohrung shapoh ka nongbah bad ngin ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .

translation.en: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation , spoken of by Daniel the prophet , stand in the holy place ,  ( whoso readeth , let him understand : )
translation.kha: Phin ïohi ïa ‘ Ka Jingijli Bashyrkhei’ ïa kaba u Daniel u nongïathuh lypa u la kren . Kan ïeng ha ka jaka bakhuid .  ( Ka jingkynthoh ïa u nongpule : Da pynthikna ban shemphang aïu kane ka kit jingmut ! )

translation.en: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually , that is , the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name .
translation.kha: Namarkata , to ngin ai jingïaroh ïa U Blei khlem da pud kum ka jingkñia da U Jisu , kaba long ka jingainguh da ki rmiang shyntur kiba phla ïa u kum U Trai .
Ki ktien ba-thylli , ko Job ! Ki ktien ba-thylli !
translation.en: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge , and fill his belly with the east wind ?
Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do  ; for evil is determined against our master , and against all his household : for he is such a son of Belial , that a man cannot speak to him .
translation.kha: Sngewbha da pyrkhat shaphang kane bad sa rai ïa kaei ban leh . Kane ka lah ban long kaba shyrkhei ïa u kynrad jong ngi bad ïa ka longïing jong u baroh . U long uba sniew jinglong ba un ym sngap ïano ïano ruh !

To shuh ha ka jingthoh , namar kam pat dei ka na ba kane ïalong . Hynrei ka na ka wan kloi , bad kaei kaba nga pyn-i ha me kan urlong . Ka i kumba ka wan suki jai , hynrei to ap ïa ka ; kan sa jai lama shisha , bad yn ym pyntud ïa ka .
translation.en: For the vision is yet for an appointed time , but at the end it shall speak , and not lie : though it tarry , wait for it  ; because it will surely come , it will not tarry .

translation.kha: Hynrei Kumno kin kah ban kut kyrpad ïa u na ka bynta ka jingïarap lada kim shym la ngeit ? Bad kynum kin lah ban ngeit lada kim shym la ïohsngew ïa ka khlur ? Bad kumno ki lah ban ïohsngew lada ïa ka khubor ym shym la pynnep ?
translation.en: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed ? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard ? and how shall they hear without a preacher ?
He burneth part thereof in the fire  ; with part thereof he eateth flesh  ; he roasteth roast , and is satisfied : yea , he warmeth himself , and saith , Aha , I am warm , I have seen the fire :
translation.kha: Da katto katne ki dieng u pynmeh ding ; u syang doh , u bam ïa ka , bad u kdang . U pynsyaid ïa lade bad u ong ,  Katno kaba sngewtynnat bad sngewsyiad ! Katno ka rhem ka ding !
Na shoh pynkyllon ïa ki , bad ktien lah khie shuh ki thiah ha ka jingsngap ha kham jong nga .
translation.en: And I have consumed them , and wounded them , that they could not arise : yea , they are fallen under my feet .
And when the blood of thy martyr Stephen was shed , I also was standing by , and consenting unto his death , and kept the raiment of them that slew him .
translation.kha: Bad haba la pynïap ïa u Stephan , u sakhi jong me , nga hi nga la don hangta , nga da mynjur ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u bad nga da sumar ïa ki jaiñ jong ki nongpynïap ïa u .’
Ha ka snem kaba para jong ka jingsynshar u Hobah u khun jong u Elah kum u shem ka Israel , u Jehiskaïah u khun jong u Ahas u long u syiem ka Judah
translation.en: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel , that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Judah began to reign .

translation.kha: Kumta nga shem ba kane ka hukum ka thik ; long nga kwah ban leh ïa kaei kaba bha , kamai naba sniew ka un-long tang ma ka , ka jingjied kambah nga don .
translation.en: I find then a law , that , when I would do good , evil is present with me .
You will be benefited spiritually by seeing the place called Bethel .
translation.kha: Ka jingngeit jong phi kan kham skhem da kaba ïohi ïa ka jaka ba khot ka Bethel .
Naba kaei kaba nga har , ka dat kaei kaba ngam kwah ban leh , kane ka pyn-i ba nga ïamynjur ba ka Hukum ka long kaba dei .
translation.en: If then I do that which I would not , I consent unto the law that it is good .
And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the first day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai . . .    ha ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingshah ringmraw , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites :
translation.kha: U Lebi u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang , u Gershon , u Kohath , bad u Merari , kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong kita ki kur kiba don ïa ki kyrteng jong ki . U Gershon u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : U Libni bad u Shimei ; u Kohath u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel ; bad u Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : u Mahli bad u Mushi . Kine ki long ki kpa tymmen jong kito ki ïing kiba don ïa ki kyrteng jong ki .
Ka por ka la poi ba U Trai u shim noh ïa u Isaia sha bneng ha ka erlangthari . U Elijah mala u Elisha ki la mihnoh na Gilgal ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the  Lord  would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind , that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal .
So David and his men went to Keilah , and fought with the Philistines , and brought away their cattle , and smote them with a great slaughter . So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit sha Keilah bad ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ; ki la pynïap bun ngut na ki bad ki la shim ïa ki jingri jong ki . Bad ka la long kumta ba u Dabid u la pyllait im ïa kata ka shnong .

Ka kmierad jong u Sisera ka la khmih na ka jingkhangïit ; Ka la phngoid na shadien ka jingker . Balei ka kali ïapmat jong u ka slem ban wan ? ka la ong . Areli ki kylla jong u ki tud banbeiñ wan phai ?
translation.en: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window , and cried through the lattice , Why is his chariot so long in coming ? why tarry the wheels of his chariots ?

translation.kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki la ino , To ap , to ing peit lada u Elijah un woh bad pyllait im ïa u !
translation.en: The rest said , Let be , let us see whether Elias will come to save him .

translation.kha: namar um shym la pynïap ïa nga ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa ang . Te ka kpoh jong i mei jong nga kan jin da la long ka jingmihpat jong nga .
translation.en: Because he slew me not from the womb  ; or that my mother might have been my grave , and her womb to be always great with me .
Let all bitterness , and wrath , and anger , and clamour , and evil speaking , be put away from you , with all malice :
translation.kha: To bret noh ïa baroh ka jingkthang mynsiem , ka jingkwah brai bad ka jingbitar . Keiñ noh ka jingkaw kaw , lane ka jingkrenbeiñ bad keiñ noh ki jingsngew isih la ha kano kano ka rukom .

translation.en: Of the Amramites , and the Izharites , the Hebronites , and the Uzzielites :
translation.kha: Ïa ki kamram la pynkhamti ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .
Uno uno uba ieit ïa la u hynmen u Para u ïasaid ha ka jingshai , bad kumta ym don kadei kaei ha u ka ban pynlong ïano ïano pat ban leh pop .
translation.en: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light , and there is none occasion of stumbling in him .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la jubab , Kata te kaba da phylla ! Phim tip nangno u wang , hynrei u la pynkoit ïa por na ka jingmatlah jong nga !
translation.en: The man answered and said unto them , Why herein is a marvellous thing , that ye know not from whence he is , and yet he hath opened mine eyes .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki briew jong ka Damaskos ki ïai leh pop , dara na ka bynta kane len pynshitom da shisha ïa ki ; ki la shohbeiñ ïa ki briew ka Gilead da ka ki shun ba khleh bieit .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Damascus , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron :

And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents , glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the  Lord  had shewed unto David , and to Solomon , and to Israel his people .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud kaba long ka sngi kaba arphew lai jong u bnai uba hynñiew , u Solomon u phah noh ïa ki briew sha la ïing . Ki la kmen ïa baroh ki jingkyrkhu ba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki briew jong u ki Israel , ha u Dabid bad ha u Solomon .
U shñiuh jong phi u itynnat halor ki ngab jong phoi , bad u noh riewbymman ha ka ryndang jong phi khim ki mawkordor .
translation.en: My beloved spake , and said unto me , Rise up , my love , my fair one , and come away .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingong kob shisha : Lada ngi la ïaphah bad u , ngin sa ïoh im ruh lymne bad u .
translation.en: It is a faithful saying : For if we be dead with him , we shall also live with him :

translation.kha: Nahash ba nga la wan ïalang ïa ki na Ijipt , ki la phai nong na nga bad ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ; pynlang mynnin ki leh ïa me bania ki la ju leh ïa nga .
translation.en: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even unto this day , wherewith they have forsaken me , and served other gods , so do they also unto thee .

translation.kha: Ki jingïohipaw jong ki , ki long kiba bakla , bad ki jingïathuh lehbha jngai ki , ki long kiba lamler . Ki kam ba ki krai ïa ka khubor jong nga , hynrei ngam shym la phah ïa ki . Pynban ki khmih lynti ba ki ktien jong ki kin urlong shisha !
translation.en: They have seen vanity and lying divination , saying , The  Lord  saith : and the  Lord  hath not sent them : and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word .

translation.kha: U la imat ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai , kumba u kpa jrong u , u la kuna ; hynrei , ym kumno u kput jong u , um shym la leh pop da kaba thang jingiwbih ha ka Templ . Ki briew pynban , ki dang ïai leh pop .
translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father Uzziah did : howbeit he entered not into the temple of the  Lord . And the people did yet corruptly .

translation.kha: ‘ Pynkloi , phet pun lait im !’ ki ong . ‘ Mareh kum u kada khlaw ka ri shyiap !’
translation.en: Flee , save your lives , and be like the heath in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ngan tei ïa phi . Sa shisien pud phin shim ïa ki khar bad phin shad da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Again I will build thee , and thou shalt be built , O virgin of Israel : thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets , and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry .

I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt : your young men have I slain with the sword , and have taken away your horses  ; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga la phah ïa ka khlam ha phi kum kata kaba nga la phah ha Ijipt . Nga la pynïap ïa ki samla shynrang jong phi ha ka thma bad nga la knieh noh ïa ki kulai jong phi . Nga la pyndap ïa ki thliew khmut jong phi da ka jingiwtung ki metïap ha ki jaka shong dara jong phi . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .
U Barukh , u khun jong u Sibaïah u tei ïa ka bynta ka bud , haduh ka jaka rung sha ka ïing jong u Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh .
translation.en: After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece , from the turning of the wall unto the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest .
And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram s cattle and the herdmen of Lot s cattle : and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land .
translation.kha: Kumta la mih ka jingïakajia hapdeng ki nongap jingri jong u Abram bad ki nongap jingri jong u Lot . ( Ha kata ka por ki Kanaan bad ki Peris ki dang shong ha kata ka ri . )
Nga sngewkhuslai shaphang jongngi phi ! Hato ka lah ban long ba baroh ka jingtrei jong nga na ka bynta jong phi ka la shu long lehnoh-ei ?
translation.en: I am afraid of you , lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain .

translation.kha: Namar kata , U Trai un pynshitom tyngeh ïa ki briew jrong me , ïa ki khun jong me , pynlang ïa ki tnen jong me , mala un pynjot thiaw ïa ki jingdon jingem jong me .
translation.en: Behold , with a great plague will the  Lord  smite thy people , and thy children , and thy wives , and all thy goods :
But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul : all they that hate me love death .
translation.kha: U briew u bym shem ïa nga u pynmong ïa lade ; kat uba isih ïa nga u ieit ïa ka jingïap .

translation.en: For we can do nothing against the truth , but for the truth .
translation.kha: Naba ngim lah ban leh ïa kaei kaei pyrshah ïa ka jingshisha , hynrei tang na ka bynta ka jingshisha .

U pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , u pynsyrwa ïa ki païa maw , bad u pyndkut ïa ki durblei jongno ka blei Arsa . U pynpra ruh lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u bseiñ rnong ïa Uba u Moses u la shna , ïa uba la khot Nehushtan . Haduh kata ka por ki bani Israel ki la thang jingiwbih na ka bynta ka bur jong u .
translation.en: He removed the high places , and brake the images , and cut down the groves , and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made : for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it : and he called it Nehushtan .
O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes !
translation.kha: A katno nga kyrmen ba ngan long uba ïaineh ha kaba sumar ïa ki jingbthah jong me !
Phi don ka jingong , ‘ Sa saw bniat bad nangta pat ka aïom ot .’ jynreiñ nga ong ïa phi , to da khmih ïa ki lyngkha ; ki jingthung mynta ki la ih bad ki la dei ba-bang ot !
translation.en: Say not ye , There are yet four months , and then cometh harvest ? behold , I say unto you , Lift up your eyes , and look on the fields  ; for they are white already to harvest .

translation.kha: U Herod u la sheptieng ïa u Ïoannis namar u la tap ba u Ïoannis u long u briew uba bha bad uba khuid , mala kumta u ju da ïa u . U ju sngewbha ban sngap ïa u , waiñ la u shitom jingmut shatei eh man ka por ba u ïohsngew ïa u .
translation.en: For Herod feared John , knowing that he was a just man and an holy , and observed him  ; and when he heard him , he did many things , and heard him gladly .

translation.kha: U Trai u la batip la ka kular bad u la ai ka jingstad ïa u Solomon . La don ka jingïasuk hapdeng u Hiram nabar u Solomon , bad kine baroh ar nud ki pynlong ka jingïateh lok .
translation.en: And the  Lord  gave Solomon wisdom , as he promised him : and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon  ; and they two made a league together .

translation.kha: Saw jrut ki syiem , u Amraphel jongnga ka babniah , u Ariokh jong ka Ellasar , u Khedorlaomer jong ka Elah , Bad u Tidal jong ka Goiim ,
translation.en: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar , Arioch king of Ellasar , Chedorlaomer king of Elam , and Tidal king of nations  ;
Be not afraid , ye beasts of the field : for the pastures of the wilderness do spring , for the tree beareth her fruit , the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength .
translation.kha: Ko ki mrad , wat sheptieng . Ki jaka phlang ki long kiba jyrngam ; ki dieng ki sei ïa la ki soh , bad don kyrhai ki soh Dumbur bad sohwaiñ .

Nangno , da kaba kumjuh ïa ki jingbthah u nongïathuhlypa , u syiem u plie ïa ka jingkhang kabu phai khmat sha Syria . Siat ïa u khnam ! u Elisheba u hukum . Hamar ba u syiem u siat ïa u khnam , u nongïathuhlypa u pyrta , Me long u khrum jong U Tlai , da u , un sa ïoh ka jingjop halor ka Sarai . Men ïaleh ïa ki Syria ha Aphek haduh ba men da jop thiaw ïa ki .
translation.en: And he said , Open the window eastward . And he opened it . Then Elisha said , Shoot . And he shot . And he said , The arrow of the  Lord s  deliverance , and the arrow of deliverance from Syria : for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek , till thou have consumed them .

translation.kha: Suk kito kaba sngewtynnat ; kin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular !
translation.en: Blessed are the meek : for they shall inherit the earth .

translation.kha: Ngan pynkylla ïa ka Nongbah Rabbah sha ka jaka ba ri ïa ki ut , bad ïa ka ri ki Ammon baïar khwai sha ka jaka ban ri ïa ki langbrot , khnang ba phin tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels , and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
Whereof I was made a minister , according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power .
translation.kha: Ïa nga keiñ la pynlong u shakri jong kata ka gospel da ka jingai bakyrpang U Blei , kaba u la ai ha nga lyngba ka jingtrei ka bor jong u .

translation.en: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Judah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day , which were all valiant men  ; because they had forsaken the  Lord  God of their fathers .
translation.kha: Namar ba u syiem Ahas u la leh pop , U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u la shah ïa u syiem ka Syria ban jop ïa u bad ban ring koidi bun bah na ki Judia sha Damaskos . U  Trai  u la shah ruh ïa u Pekah u syiem ka Israel , u khun jong u Remalaïah , ban jop ïa u Ahas bad pynïap shi lakh arphew hajar ki shipai Judia kiba shlur bha tang hapoh shi sngi . U  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki u la shah ïa kane ban jia , namar ki briew ka Judah ki la kyntait noh ïa u .

translation.en: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom : but within few days he shall be destroyed , neither in anger , nor in battle .
translation.kha: Yn bud ïa u da uwei pat u syiem , u ban phah ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam ban banbeiñ ïa ki briew da ki khajna na ka bynta ban pynroi ïa ka spah jong ka hima jong u . Tang khyndiat por ïa uta u syiem yn pynïap , hynrei ym ha kaba paw bad ym ha ka thma .

translation.en: Then Joshua passed from Makkedah , and all Israel with him , unto Libnah , and fought against Libnah :
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki leit na Makkedah sha Libnah bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .

U balui u ong , To sngap pan bad to shahshkor ïa nga , Phin ki ri shai jngai bah ! To pynkhreh ban wanrah ïa ka jingmudui jongnga Phin ha ka Jingbishar ; phin ïoh ïa ka lad jong phi ban kruiñ . To ngin ïawanlang ban rieh mano ba dei .
translation.en: Keep silence before me , O islands  ; and let the people renew their strength : let them come near  ; then let them speak : let us come near together to judgment .

translation.kha: Mynta , Weng noh ïa ki laiphew ar jngut ki nongsynshar na ka kyrdan ai hukum bun bujli noh ïa ki da ki pynbah ai hukum na madan thom .
translation.en: And do this thing , Take the kings away , every man out of his place , and put captains in their rooms :

translation.kha: Phai sha ka mynnor , sha kata ka por shuwa ban Kha ïa phi , thir shi ter haduh kata ka por mynba U Blei u la thaw ïa u briew’ ha ka pyrthei . Lud ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . Hato kiei katai kambah khraw kat kane ka la ju jia mynshuwa ? don mo u brup Uba la ju sngewkyiuh ïa Kiei kaei kaba katno kane ?
translation.en: For ask now of the days that are past , which were before thee , since the day that God created man upon the earth , and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other , whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is , or hath been heard like it ?

But he that knew not , and did commit things worthy of stripes , shall be beaten with few stripes . For unto whomsoever much is given , of him shall be much required : and to whom men have committed much , of him they will ask the more .
translation.kha: Hynrei u shakri u bymtip aïu u kynrad jong u , u kwah ; bad pynban , u leh ïa kaei re kaei ïa kaba u dei hok ban ïoh ka jingsympat , un shah pynshitom da ka jingsympat kaba sting . Shibun la dawa na u briew ha uba la ai kham bun ; kham bun shuh shuh la dawa na u briew ha uba la ai kham bun shuh shuh .

translation.en: Javan , Tubal , and Meshech , they were thy merchants : they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market .
translation.kha: Pha ïakhaïi pateng ha Gris , Tubal , bad ha Meshekh bad ïakylliang ïa ki mar na ka bynta ki mraw bad na ka bynta ki tiar rnong .
Wat Lada don kiba la shu khot ki blei , la ha Bneng ne ha pyrthiew , bad waiñ lada don shibit kum kine ki Blei’ bad ki trai ;
translation.en: For though there be that are called gods , whether in heaven or in earth , ( as there be gods many , and lords many , )

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u da ki jingweng jrong . To ïaroh ïa u da ki waiñ rnong bajam .
translation.en: Praise him upon the loud cymbals : praise him upon the high sounding cymbals .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Hesekaïah bad u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jrong u Amos ki duwai ha U Blei mala ki khot kynrad ïa u ban ieh jingïarap .
translation.en: And for this cause Hezekiah the king , and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz , prayed and cried to heaven .
If there arise among you a prophet , or a dreamer of dreams , and giveth thee a sign or a wonder ,
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa ne u nongbatai ïa ki jingphohsniew u lah ban kular ïa ka kambah ne ka kamphylla ,
Um kren ha ki khlem pyndonkam da ki pharshi , hynrei hajan u don tang bad ki synran , u batai ïa kiei kiei baroh ha ki .
translation.en: But without a parable spake he not unto them : and when they were alone , he expounded all things to his disciples .

So he arose and went to Zarephath . And when he came to the gate of the city , behold , the widow woman was there gathering of sticks : and he called to her , and said , Fetch me , I pray thee , a little water in a vessel , that I may drink .
