translation.kha: Ki sngi ki la poi ,  ong U  Trai  ,  haba u kew un san stet ban ïa kaba lah ban ot , bad ki sohwaiñ kin san stet ban ïa ka waiñ ba lah ban shna . Ki lumbah kin jaw da ka waiñ kaba thiang , bad ki lumrit kin tuid da ka .

translation.en: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering , and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering , and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot :
translation.kha: Un pynïap ïa uta u khunlangbrot bad un shim khyndiat ka snam bad un tah ïa ka ha ka shkor kamon jong uta u briew , ka  tikmie kamon jong u , bad ha ka  jatkmie kamon jong u .
Kumta u Jakob u ong ha la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-ei dara ha kita baroh kiba don lem bad u , Bret noh ïa ki blem nongïoh baroh kiba phi don ; pynkhuid ïa lade , bad phong da ki jaiñ kiba khuid .
translation.en: Then Jacob said unto his household , and to all that were with him , Put away the strange gods that are among you , and be clean , and change your garments :

translation.kha: U Moses u la ïathuh ïa kane ha ki Jeraïah , hynrei kim shym sngur ïa u , namar ka mynsiem jong ki ka la pait la pra na kata ka jinglongmraw basohsat jong ki .
translation.en: And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel : but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit , and for cruel bondage .

translation.kha: Ki la jubab , La kha malade la pynsan ïa me hapoh ka pop — sad me pyrshang ban hawei ïa ngi ? Bad kumta ki la beh noh ïa u na ka synagog .
translation.en: They answered and said unto him , Thou wast altogether born in sins , and dost thou teach us ? And they cast him out .

translation.kha: To shim bynta lem ha ka jingshah shitrhem , kum u shipai bashaniah jong U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: Thou therefore endure hardness , as a good soldier of Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Nangta U ijuh u la jingjubab , Ïa nga la phah tang shata ki longsem ba la jah nala jong ki paid Israel .
translation.en: But he answered and said ,  I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel .
But we , brethren , being taken from you for a short time in presence , not in heart , endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire .
translation.kha: Te ma ngi , ko parabangeit , haba ïa ngi la pynïakhlad na phi shipor — ym ha ki jingpyrkhat jong ngi , shisha , hynrei tang ha ka met — kumno ba ngi la sngewkynjah khlem ma phi bad katno ngi la pyrshang jur ban ïohi pat ïa phi !

translation.en: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit , neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit .
translation.kha: U dieng uba plung bha um lah ban pynmih ki soh kiba sniew , bad u dieng uba swai um lah ban pynmih ki soh kiba bha .
Nangta ha ka por khat-ar baje Bad ruh ha ka por lai baje u la leh kumne .
translation.en: Again he went out about the sixth and ninth hour , and did likewise .
And the multitude rose up together against them : and the magistrates rent off their clothes , and commanded to beat them .
translation.kha: Bad u paidbah u la ïasoh lang ha kaba tur pyrshah ïa u Paul bad u Silas . Ki rangbah synshar ki la tar ïa ki jaiñ jong u Paul bad u Silas , bad ki la ai hukum ban sympat ïa ki .

Phi , phi long kum ka pluh ïa u paid bynriew baroh . Hynrei lada ka mluh ka la blad noh , ym to kano kano ka lad ban pynrangbah pat ïa ka . Ka la kylluid long ka bymdondor , kumta la bret noh! ïa ka sharud bad ki briew ki ïa-ïuh khlur jong ka .
translation.en: Ye are the salt of the earth : but if the salt have lost his savour , wherewith shall it be salted ? it is thenceforth good for nothing , but to be cast out , and to be trodden under foot of men .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ba phin tep ïa nga bad la ki kpa tymmen ; rah ïa nga na Joppa , bun tep ïa ar ha ka dik ba la tep ïa ki . U Jakob u jyllop , Ngan leh kumba phi ong .
translation.en: But I will lie with my fathers , and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt , and bury me in their buryingplace . And he said , I will do as thou hast said .

translation.kha: “lada uno uno u brai u ngat ïa ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh , dei ban ïalam ïa u ha u lyngdoh ,
translation.en: When the plague of leprosy is in a man , then he shall be brought unto the priest  ;

translation.kha: U Abner u phah ïa ki nongpyntrei sha u Dabid uba don ha Hebron ha kata ka por , ban ong , Uei u ban synshar ïa khie ka ri ? Ïateh kular bad nga , bad ngan ïarap ïa phi ban pynpang ïa ki Israel baroh shiah ka wad jong phi .
translation.en: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf , saying , Whose is the land ? saying also , Make thy league with me , and , behold , my hand shall be with thee , to bring about all Israel unto thee .

translation.kha: U Solomon u la ieit ïa kiba bun ki kynthei nongïoh . Nalor ka Kynhun u syiem ka ri Ijipt , u la shongkurim hajuh ïa ki kynthei nongïeng Hit malade ki kynthei nong Moab , Haman , Edom bad Sidon .
translation.en: But king Solomon loved many strange women , together with the daughter of Pharaoh , women of the Moabites , Ammonites , Edomites , Zidonians , and Hittites  ;
And she said unto her husband , Behold now , I perceive that this is an holy man of God , which passeth by us continually .
translation.kha: Ka ong ha la u tnga ,  Nga thikna ba une u briew uba wan bunsien hangne u dei u riewkhuid .

Hynrei nga la jop , Em , ko Trai Nongsynshar ! Ngam pat ju pyntngen ïa lade . nadong dang khana ngam pat ju bam ïa ka doh jong uno une u mrad uba ïap hi ne uba shiah pynïap ha ki riewkhlaw . Ngam pah ju bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam ba la kheiñ ka bymkhuid .
translation.en: Then said I , Ah Lord  God  ! behold , my soul hath not been polluted : for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself , or is torn in pieces  ; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pyllait ïa ka ri Kishon , ha kaba ki briew jongki na ki shong , ba kumta yn ym ne skain hangta . Ngan leh ïa kane ba manna tip ba nga U Tlai per trei ha kane ka ri .
translation.en: And I will sever in that day the land of Goshen , in which my people dwell , that no swarms of flies shall be there  ; to the end thou mayest know that I am the  Lord  in the midst of the earth .

translation.kha: Hangta ha khmat U Trai U Blei jong phiah , uba la kyrkhu ïa phi , ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem lad phiah phin ïabam Bad law ha keiñ kiei babha bha kiba Phin la trei shitom .
translation.en: And there ye shall eat before the  Lord  your God , and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto , ye and your households , wherein the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee .
Their throat is an open sepulchre ; with their tongues they have used deceit ; the poison of asps is under their lips :
translation.kha: Ki ktien jong ki , ki dap da ki jingshukor bashyrkhei ; ki jingthok ba-bymman ki mih na ki thylliej jong ki , bad ki jingbyrngem kiba ma , kum ka bih bseiñ , na ki rmiang shyntur jong ki ;
Pynbna , men leit sha ki briew u kpa jong nga , bad sha ki kur ki jait jyllang nga , bad jied ka tnga na ka bynta jong u .’
translation.en: But thou shalt go unto my father s house , and to my kindred , and take a wife unto my son .
Butter and honey shall he eat , that he may know to refuse the evil , and choose the good .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ba u la rangbah bha ban pynlong ïa la ki jingkut jingmut , ki briew kin dih dud bad bam ngap .
Un ai ïa ka jingshemphang jong ka jingbishar hok ïa Kito kiba trei Kum ki nongbishar , bad ka jingsuhsieng ïa kito naba ïalade ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah na ka jingshah hiarthma .
translation.en: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment , and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate .

translation.kha: U balamler u patsha ka Assyria u ïaleh thom pyrshah ïa u ; u Hoshea u pyndem wait ha u Shalmaneser bad u siew jingnguh syiem man la ka snem .
translation.en: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria  ; and Hoshea became his servant , and gave him presents .
And they took their bones , and buried them under a tree at Jabesh , and fasted seven days .
translation.kha: Nangta ki khar ïa ki shyieng bad ki tep ïa ki hapoh uwei u dieng Tamarisk uba ha kata ka shnong , bad ki ïashahjingit hynñiew sngi .

Ki la pyrta biang , To pynïap noh ïa u ! Pynphai noh ïa u ! Sahnarphna ïa u ! U Pilat u la kylli ïa ki , phiah kwah ïa nga ba ngan sahnarphna ïa u syiem Jong phi ? Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la jaboh , U syiem uba ngi don u dei tang u Patsha !
translation.en: But they cried out , Away with him , away with him , crucify him . Pilate saith unto them , Shall I crucify your King ? The chief priests answered , We have no king but Caesar .

translation.kha: Ma me , A Trai U Blei jong ngi , me la pynkhreh ban pynsum ïa ngi , bad me la leh kumta , namar borabor me ju ïai leh ïa kawei kaba dei , bad ngim shitrhem la pynshahshkor ïa me .
translation.en: Therefore hath the  Lord  watched upon the evil , and brought it upon us : for the  Lord  our God is righteous in all his works which he doeth : for we obeyed not his voice .

translation.kha: Ngan ïai lehkmen bad shadkmen , namar U Tiras U Blei u long u nongpynim jrong nga .
translation.en: Yet I will rejoice in the  Lord  , I will joy in the God of my salvation .

translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Nga la ieit ïa u Jakob , hynriew nga la najan ïa u katta .
translation.en: As it is written , Jacob have I loved , but Esau have I hated .

translation.kha: Men pynmeh ding da ka jakhlia briew kaba tyrkhong , shet ïa u kpu ha ka ding , bad bam ïa u ha kaba baroh ki lah ban ïor ïa me .
translation.en: And thou shalt eat it as barley cakes , and thou shalt bake it with dung that cometh out of man , in their sight .

translation.kha: Hato phi sheptieng ïa ki waitlam ? Neng wallam ïa ki bariew pyntud malu ki waitlam ban tur ïaleh ïa phi .
translation.en: Ye have feared the sword  ; and I will bring a sword upon you , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ki shim katto katne na ki jinglute ba ki ïohknieh ha ka thma bad pynkyntang ïa ki Ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ .
translation.en: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the  Lord .
Behold , I have given him for a witness to the people , a leader and commander to the people .
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ïa u , u nongïalam bad u nongai hukum ïa ki jaitbynriew ; bad lyngba jong u nga la pyn-i ha ki ïa ka bor jong nga .

Uno Une u lah ban kiew na ka jingkit ban long u shym jong ka ri jong u , lane u ban sien na ka ïingbyndi sha ka khet , hynrei lada ha ka jinglong tymmen jong u , u long suba bieit eh ban shim ïa ka jingaibuit , um long uba kham bha kum u apil uba duk hynrei babha shemphang .
translation.en: For out of prison he cometh to reign  ; whereas also he that is born in his kingdom becometh poor .
And he that doubteth is damned if he eat , because he eateth not of faith : for whatsoever is not of faith is sin .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u sngew artatien ïa kaei kaba u bam , U Blei u pynrem ïa u haba u bam ïa ka , namar kaei kaba u leh , kam shong nongrim ha ka jingngeit . Bad kaei kaei ka bym shong nongrim ha ka jingngeit ka long ka pop .

translation.en: He is the Rock , his work is perfect : for all his ways are judgment : a God of truth and without iniquity , just and right is he .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u nongïada bakhlaiñbor jong phi , ki lynti jong u ki long kiba janai , bad bahok ; U Blei jong phi u long uba ïaineh bad uba shisha ; u leh ïa kaba hok bad kaba beit .
Haba ka jingeh ka wan , hato U Blei un ïohsngew ïa ki jingïam jong ki ?
translation.en: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him ?
God can hear even silent prayers said in our heart .
translation.kha: U Blei u lah ban ïohsngew wat ïa ki jingduwai ba jar jar hapoh ka dohnud jong ngi .
Te u Jakob u ong ha u Laban , Ka por ka la khun nala ; to shahshkor ba ngan shongkurim noh ïa ka khwan jong phi .
translation.en: And Jacob said unto Laban , Give me my wife , for my days are fulfilled , that I may go in unto her .

translation.kha: To kner ïa la ka kti ban pynkhiah , bad ai ba ki kamphylla bad ki kambah yn kun ha ka kyrteng jyllang U Jisu u Shakri bakhuid jong me .
translation.en: By stretching forth thine hand to heal  ; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of thy holy child Jesus .

translation.kha: lem bad u Elisaphan u khun jong u Ussiel kum u rangbah kur .
translation.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation : and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , to kren pyrshah ïa ka nongbah Sidon .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against Zidon , and prophesy against it ,
Ye shall walk after the  Lord  your God , and fear him , and keep his commandments , and obey his voice , and ye shall serve him , and cleave unto him .
translation.kha: Bud ïa U  Trai  bad tiengburom ïa u ; kohnguh ïa u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong u ; mane ïa u bad ïaineh ha u .

translation.en: This is that bread which came down from heaven : not as your fathers did eat manna , and are dead : he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever .
translation.kha: Une te , u long u kpu uba la wan hiar na bneng ; um long kum uta u kpu uba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la bam , hynrei hadien ki la ïap . Uta uba bam ïa une u kpu un im junom .
ianga u ai ïa ka ha phi , phi dem ban ai Sha U thri ïa u khun iing baroh . Man uba la kha nyngkong na ki krad u long u Jong U Trai .
translation.en: That thou shalt set apart unto the  Lord  all that openeth the matrix , and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast  ; the males shall be the  Lord s .
Six days ye shall gather it  ; but on the seventh day , which is the sabbath , in it there shall be none .
translation.kha: Hynriew sngi phin ïalum jingbam , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ka sngi shongthait , yn ym don ei ei .
Ki kren ïa ki jingsynran sarong bad ba-mutlop , bad ki riam phah da ki jingkyang brai jong ka doh ïa ki briew kiba dang shuki sdang don phet ïap napdeng ki briew kiba im ha ka jingleh bymdei .
translation.en: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity , they allure through the lusts of the flesh , through much wantonness , those that were clean escaped from them who live in error .

translation.kha: kaba ing namarba kaba ïng , ka jingmong namar ka jingainong , ka jingjngem snam namar ka jingjngem snam .
translation.en: Burning for burning , wound for wound , stripe for stripe .
He answered and said to Arioch the king s captain , Why is the decree so hasty from the king ? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel .
translation.kha: u la kylli ïa u Ariokh balei ba u syiem u la pynmih kum kane ka hukum kaba eh . Kumta u Ariokh u la ïathuh ïa u Daniel ïa kaei kaba la lah jia .
Ki ai bynta ïa baroh ki shynrang kiba laiphew snem ka rta ne kham ïaw kiba don jinglyngkhuit man ka sngi ha ka Templ kat kum ki kyrdan jong ki .
translation.en: Beside their genealogy of males , from three years old and upward , even unto every one that entereth into the house of the  Lord  , his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses  ;

translation.kha: Ka hok ka pyllait ïa tun kiba lehbeiñ , hynrei kito ïa kiba ym lah ban shaniah ki shah riam ha la ka jong ka jingkwah brai hi .
translation.en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them : but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness .

translation.kha: Wat pynpyiar ïa lade da nangno kano na keiñ ki kam , namar dei da kine ba ki briew ki bymngeit Bela ki la pyntngit ïa lade , kito ki jaitbynriew kiba im ha kata ka ri ha shuwa jong phi bad ïa kiba ngan beh noh , ba phin ïoh leit sping hangno .
translation.en: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things : for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you :

translation.kha: U Obed Edom u ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shathie , bad ki khun jong u ki hap peit ïa ka kamra buh tiar .
translation.en: To Obed–edom southward  ; and to his sons the house of Asuppim .

The sword of the  Lord  is filled with blood , it is made fat with fatness , and with the blood of lambs and goats , with the fat of the kidneys of rams : for the  Lord  hath a sacrifice in Bozrah , and a great slaughter in the land of Edom .
translation.kha: Ïa ka waitlam jong u yn tap da ka snam bad ka khleiñ jong ki , kum ka snam bad ka khleiñ jong ki langbrot bad ki blang ïa kiba la kñia . U  Trai  un pynlong ïa kane ka jingkñia ha ka nongbah Bosrah ; un pynlong ïa kane ka jingpynïap bakhraw ha ka ri ki Edom .
Kim dei ba dat bynta na ka khyndew ka shyiap kum kiwei pat ki Para jait jong ki ; ka bynta jong ki ka long ka kabu ka jinglong ki lyngdoh jong U Trai , kumba u la kular .
translation.en: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren : the  Lord  is their inheritance , as he hath said unto them .

translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki lei jong de . Kam shah ba ki jingri jong phi kin ïapoi kha bad ki ngi dei na kajuh ka jahthait . Wat thung ha kajuh ka lyngkha ar jait u symbai . Wat phan ïa ka jaiñ kaba la suh da ki ar jait ki ksai .
translation.en: Ye shall keep my statutes . Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind : thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed : neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee .

translation.kha: U ong ha nga , To ïakhmih , ko Kynhun u briew , shahshkor kyndiang bad pynleit jingmut bha ïa kata baroh kaba nga pyn-i ha me ; namar ba na ka bynta kane la ïalam ïa me hangne . Me dei baneh ïathuh ïa sier baroh ba me ïohi sha ki briew ka Israel .
translation.en: And the man said unto me , Son of man , behold with thine eyes , and hear with thine ears , and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee  ; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither : declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel .
And of Benjamin  ; Eliada a mighty man of valour , and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand .
translation.kha: U nongïalam jong ki shipai na ka kur Benjamin u dei u Eliada , u shipai batbit , uba long halor ki ar lakh ngut ki rangbah ba la kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki ryntieh .

translation.en: I am a stranger in the earth : hide not thy commandments from me .
translation.kha: Nga don hangne ha ka pyrthei tang shipor ; wat buhrieh ïa ki hukum jong me na nga .

translation.en: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled : and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people , and they said , Why have we done this , that we have let Israel go from serving us ?
translation.kha: Haba la ïathuh ha u Pharaoh ba uta u paidbah u la phet , ma u bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ki kylla ka jingmut jong ki , bad ki la ong ,  Ngi la leh aïu ? Ngi la shah ïa ki Israel ba kin phet noh , bad ngi la duh ïa ki kum ki mraw jong ngi !
Hadien kane , u Johanan bad ki nongaikam jong ki swai ki bim shym la pyndem ki la wan ha u Gedalaïah ha Mispah bad ki la ong ha u ,
translation.en: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that were in the fields , came to Gedaliah to Mizpah ,

translation.kha: nongthaw , sa bahynñiew tyllun ki masi kyntiap ki la wan mih kiba ïakhih bad kiba sah sa ka shyieng suda . Ki long ki masi kynthei kiba isangsot eh kiba ngam pat ju ïohi hangtai hangno ha ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And , behold , seven other kine came up after them , poor and very ill favoured and leanfleshed , such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for badness :
For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country , who called his own servants , and delivered unto them his goods .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ka Hima ki bneng kan long kumne . Shisien la don u briew u ban sa leit jingleit ; u la khot ïa ki shakri jong u bad u la buh ïa ki ban khmih ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u .

translation.en: Yet hear the word of the  Lord  , O ye women , and let your ear receive the word of his mouth , and teach your daughters wailing , and every one her neighbour lamentation .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  To sngap ïa U  Trai  , phi ki kynthei , bad to pynshahshkor ïa ki ktien jong u . To hikai ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi kumno ban ïambriew , bad ïa ki paralok jong phi kumno ban rwai ka jingrwai ïapbriew .
Bad lehse hadien habud ka kynhun kam lah ban leh lut ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Trai u la hukum lymbung u Moses .
translation.en: Even all that the  Lord  hath commanded you by the hand of Moses , from the day that the  Lord  commanded Moses , and henceforward among your generations  ;
But if any man love God , the same is known of him .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa u briew uba ieit ïa U Blei la ithuh da u .

translation.en: Having therefore obtained help of God , I continue unto this day , witnessing both to small and great , saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come :

translation.kha: Bad ïa ka Jingot Bakhuid la pynshisha haba ka la ong , U Abraham u la ngeit ha U blei ; bad namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Bel u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok . Bad kumta ïa u Abraham la khot u paralok jong U Blei .
translation.en: And the scripture was fulfilled which saith , Abraham believed God , and it was imputed unto him for righteousness : and he was called the Friend of God .

translation.kha: Hynrei pyn-i ka jinglehsbun ïa ki khun shajrong jong u Barsillai uba na Galilaïa bad ri sumar ïa ki , namar ki la lehsbun ïa nga mynba ang la phet krad na u Absalom , u hynñiew jong me .
translation.en: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite , and let them be of those that eat at thy table : for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother .

translation.kha: Sngewbha jarjar .
translation.en: Please keep your voice down .

translation.kha: Ynda ki la dep tep , u nongïathuhlypa u ong ha la ki khun , Ynda nga ïap , thup ïa nga ha kane ka jingtep bad bthuh ïa ka met jong nga syndah bad ka jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , after he had buried him , that he spake to his sons , saying , When I am dead , then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried  ; lay my bones beside his bones :

translation.kha: Kumta atiar ha ngi hynñiew jrut na ki khun ki kyrsiew shynrang jong u , bad ngin phasi ïa ki ha khmat U Trai ha Gibeah , ka sheng trai lad u Saul , u syiemsad ba la jied da U Trai . Ngan aiti ïa ki , u syiem u ong .
translation.en: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us , and we will hang them up unto the  Lord  in Gibeah of Saul , whom the  Lord  did choose . And the king said , I will give them .

translation.kha: U la ïohknieh ïa ka jaka Hoham bad Sobah bad u kerkut ïa ka nongbah Baaltamar ha ka ri shahjop .
translation.en: And Solomon went to Hamath–zobah , and prevailed against it .

translation.kha: U Joshua u rah ïa la u synrum uba la kdew sha ka Ai bad um smam pynher ïa u tad haduh ba uwei pa uwei u briew hangta u la shah pynïap . Baroh ki nongshong shnong jong ka Ai kiba la shah pynïap ha kata ka sngaid — khat-ar hajar ngut ki shynrang bad ki kynthih .
translation.en: For Joshua drew not his hand back , wherewith he stretched out the spear , until he had utterly destroyed all the inhabitants of Ai .

translation.kha: U Tharai u la ong ha ar ,
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Mynta ha kane ka sien to map ïa ka pop jong nga bad ïaboi ha U Trai U Blei jong ph ban Shim noh na nga ïa kane ka jingpynshitom kaba shyrkhei na nga .
translation.en: Now therefore forgive , I pray thee , my sin only this once , and entreat the  Lord  your God , that he may take away from me this death only .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïoh jinghikai uwei na uwei pat , kumba u nar u pynnep ïa u nar .
translation.en: Iron sharpeneth iron  ; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend .

translation.kha: U Moses u kyrpad jur ïa U Trai , bad U Trai u pyn-i ha u ïa uwei u lyngkhuit dieng , ïa uba u la bret khoh ka um ; bad ka um ka la kylla longïng Kaba bit ban dih . Dei hangta ba U Trai u ai ha ki ïa ki waiñ ba kin bud , bad dei hangta ruh ba u la tynjuh ïa ki .
translation.en: And he cried unto the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  shewed him a tree , which when he had cast into the waters , the waters were made sweet : there he made for them a statute and an ordinance , and there he proved them ,

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong hangta ki long khyllem bor ; ki la sheptieng bad lyngdoh . Ki la long kum u phlang ha lyngkha ne ki ñiup Ibbah satang ha tdem haba ka lyer khluit ba na mihngi ka beh ha ki .
translation.en: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power , they were dismayed and confounded  ; they were as the grass of the field , and as the green herb , as the grass on the housetops , and as corn blasted before it be grown up .

translation.kha: Nongbah ngi tip ba haduh ka na ba mandriek , ki jingthaw Baroh ki ud da ka jingpang , kum ka jinghap jong ka jingsah kha .
translation.en: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now .

translation.kha: u la ïohkem ïa uwei u samla uba na Sukkoth bun u kyllut ïa u . U samla u la thoh na ka bynta u Hadien ïa ki kyrteng jong ki hynriewspah hynñiew ngut ki rangbah ba ha khmat eh jong ka Sukkoth .
translation.en: And caught a young man of the men of Succoth , and enquired of him : and he described unto him the princes of Succoth , and the elders thereof , even threescore and seventeen men .

translation.kha: U Tharai u la pynlong ïa ki ban ktung jingput ban ïaleh ïa ki Jerusalem , ba kumta kin shah pynriam sha ka jingpynjot thiaw bad ba baroh keiñ shad pynïap khlem ka jingisynei . Kane ka un-long kaba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: For it was of the  Lord  to harden their hearts , that they should come against Israel in battle , that he might destroy them utterly , and that they might have no favour , but that he might destroy them , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

And Joseph said unto his brethren , and unto his father s house , I will go up , and shew Pharaoh , and say unto him , My brethren , and my father s house , which were in the land of Canaan , are come unto me  ;
translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u ong ha la ki hynmen bad ha ki khun ki kti u kpa jong u ,  Nga dei ban leit ïathuh ha u syiem ba ki hynmen ki para jong nga bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem i pa kiba shong ha Kanaan ki la wan poi sha nga .

Nangta u sharai uba la iohpateng shihajar tyllep ki sbai u la wan thring malu u la Ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga tap ba me long u briew umbiah eh ; me ot ïa ki jingot na kambah mem shym la bet , bad me lum ïa ki jingthung na kaba mem shitrhem la bet symbai .
translation.en: Then he which had received the one talent came and said , Lord , I knew thee that thou art an hard man , reaping where thou hast not sown , and gathering where thou hast not strawed :

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep kren ïa ktien kiei kiei , u paidbah u la sngewlyngngoh ïa ka mano kaba u la hawei .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had ended these sayings , the people were astonished at his doctrine :

translation.kha: Ki pyndonkam ïa ki diengkhap Kseh-Phir na u lum Hermon kum ki dieng shna ïing . Bad ïa ki dieng Kedar na Lebanon na ka bna ki dieng sieh lama .
translation.en: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir : they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee .

translation.kha: Ïa u , u nar u stang kum u phlangïap , bad ka rudnong ka jem kum ka dieng pyut .
translation.en: He esteemeth iron as straw , and brass as rotten wood .

translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud u bamatlah u la leit sha ki nonglamktien jong u bashalak bad u nong , Khie leit phai sha la ïing ; U Trai um shah ba kun leit bad phi .
translation.en: And Balaam rose up in the morning , and said unto the princes of Balak , Get you into your land : for the  Lord  refuseth to give me leave to go with you .

translation.kha: Haba ki hynñiew snem ki la leit , la ong u symboh , Nga la khmih jingkhroh sha sahit bneng , bad ka jingtipbriew jong nga ka la wan phai . Nga la ïaroh ïa U Balei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh dara nga la ai ka jingpyndonburom bad ka bur ïa uta uba im junom . Un synshar jrong , bad ka hangta jongno u kan neh ha ki par baroh’ .
translation.en: And at the end of the days I Nebuchadnezzar lifted up mine eyes unto heaven , and mine understanding returned unto me , and I blessed the most High , and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever , whose dominion is an everlasting dominion , and his kingdom is from generation to generation :

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba riewarsap ki ju pynkut borabor ba ki long naba stad , hynrei u brup uba duk , umbah don ka jingsngewthuh shaphang ka jingkhlaiñbor u tip) kham bha .
translation.en: The rich man is wise in his own conceit  ; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out .

translation.kha: Tang da kumta , U ikwah un Joab ïa ki jingmudui jong phiah .—Hebru 11 :6 .
translation.en: Only then will Jehovah answer your prayers .—Hebrews 11 :6 .

translation.kha: Don mo hangne uba ïan Shu dep rep bri sohwaiñ , hynrei u bih pat ïohlad ba-bang ngeit ïa ki soh jong ka ? Lymda don , ai un leit phai shad la ïing , ïoh ba u ïap ha madan thma , bad ba aiwai pat un ïoh bam ïa ki soh jong ka .
translation.en: And what man is he that hath planted a vineyard , and hath not yet eaten of it ? let him also go and return unto his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man eat of it .
To Timothy , my dearly beloved son : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord .
translation.kha: Ha u Timothi , u khun ba-ieit jong nga : To ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi un ai ha me ïa ka jingaiei , ka jingisynei , bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And the Lord  God  of hosts is he that toucheth the land , and it shall melt , and all that dwell therein shall mourn : and it shall rise up wholly like a flood  ; and shall be drowned , as by the flood of Egypt .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh u ktah ïa ka pyrthei , bad ka khynñiuh baroh kiba shong ha ka ki ïambriew , ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka kiew ka hiar kum ka wah Nile .

Ki wallam sha u mawshun ïa kata ka jingïoh bad ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka baroh , ïa ki bnoh jong ka , ïa ki jingïar jongno ka , ïa ki diengkhap jong ka , ïa ki rishot jong ka , bad ïa ki tliw tnat lad ka ;
translation.en: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses , the tent , and all his furniture , his taches , his boards , his bars , and his pillars , and his sockets ,
Just balances , just weights , a just ephah , and a just hin , shall ye have : I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Pyndonkam ïa ki tarajur kiba biang , ki mawthew kiba biang , bad ïa ki tiar thew kiba biang . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad nga wallam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: I will teach you by the hand of God : that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal .
translation.kha: Shah ïa nga ba ngan hikai ïa phi katno ka khraw ka bor U Blei , bad ban batai kaei kaba U Blei Badonbor baroh u la thmu lypa .
Nga don ka spah malade ka bhor ban ai , ka jingdap kyrhai bad ka jingjop .
translation.en: Riches and honour are with me  ; yea , durable riches and righteousness .

translation.kha: Balei phyrnai pyni ïa la ki dohnud dom kun u Pharaoh bad ki nong Ijipt ? Wat klet kumno U Blei u la pynlong ki biah ïa ki shuh ba kin da shah ïa ki Eliel ban mihngi na ibieit .
translation.en: Wherefore then do ye harden your hearts , as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened their hearts ? when he had wrought wonderfully among them , did they not let the people go , and they departed ?

translation.kha: Phi tip ïa ka jingbam kaba bang dei haba pa la mad ïa ka , hynrei kam long kumta ïa ki kyntien kiba riewstad Haba phi ïohsngew ïa ki .
translation.en: For the ear trieth words , as the mouth tasteth meat .
Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth–lehem–judah , whose name was Jesse  ; and he had eight sons : and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul .
translation.kha: U Dabid u dei u khun jong u Jesse , uba dei u nong Ephrath na Bethlehem kaba ha Judah . U Jesse u don phra ngut ki khun shynrang , bad ha ka por ba u Saul u long syiem , u la tymmen bha .
wahbah u Judah u ïohi ïa ka , u la pyrkhat ba ka dei ka nuti , namar ba ka la ktah ïa la ka ïakhmih .
translation.en: When Judah saw her , he thought her to be an harlot  ; because she had covered her face .

translation.kha: Leummim ïa ki jingai jingmut baroh katba phi da , nabar phin jop ; khlem tala phin shahïap .
translation.en: Without counsel purposes are disappointed : but in the multitude of counsellors they are established .

translation.kha: Don ka Hadad bad ka Geba , lem bad ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , kiba kynjoh sha ka riewhadem ha khappud jong ka Ijipt bad ka rud lad ka duriaw-rit Mediterranian .
translation.en: Ashdod with her towns and her villages , Gaza with her towns and her villages , unto the river of Egypt , and the great sea , and the border thereof :
For as long as the son of Jesse liveth upon the ground , thou shalt not be established , nor thy kingdom . Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me , for he shall surely die .
translation.kha: Hato mem sngewthuh ba katba u Dabid u dang im , lano lano men ym ïoh long u syiem jong kane ka ri ? Mynta hi to khie leit bad wallam ïa u shane — u dei ban ïap !

Kin shimet por saw pateng bynriew shuwa ba ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin wan phai patan shane ; namar ngan ym pat beh noh ïa ki Amor tad bynda ki la Long bymman haduh katta katta kat haduh ba ki dei ban shah pynkhyllem .
translation.en: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again : for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full .

translation.kha: sad ka Khynñiuh kan pynkhih ïa u kew , Bad ki sohwaiñ , bad ki soh Olib .
translation.en: And the earth shall hear the corn , and the wine , and the oil  ; and they shall hear Jezreel .

translation.kha: Me la phah ki jingjynjar bad ki jingshitom halor jong por , hynrei men pynni pat ka jingkhlaiñ ha nga ; men sumar ïa nga na ka jingtep .
translation.en: Thou , which hast shewed me great and sore troubles , shalt quicken me again , and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth .

translation.kha: Ha kaba nyngkong , ki biria ha ka pyrthei baroh ki la to tang kawei ka Ktien ka thylliej bad pynsakma ïa kijuh ki kyntien .
translation.en: And the whole earth was of one language , and of one speech .
The prophet that hath a dream , let him tell a dream  ; and he that hath my word , let him speak my word faithfully . What is the chaff to the wheat ? saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa uba ïoh ka jingphohsniew u dei ban ong ïa ka ba ka long tang ka jingphohsniew , hynrei u nongïathuhlypa uba la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor jong nga u dei ban pynbna hok ïa kata ka khubor . Kaei ka jingbha u jyntang ban ïanujor bad u kew ?
U pynduk ïa ki katto katne bad u pynrieh ïa kiwei pat ; U pynrit ïa ki kat katne malade u pynkhraw ïa kiwei pat .
translation.en: The  Lord  maketh poor , and maketh rich : he bringeth low , and lifteth up .

translation.kha: U la ong ha nga , Bad myntoi , ko Daniel to khylliap noh ïa ka kino bad shon muhor halor jong ka hapoh ka jingkut jong ka Pyrthei . Ha kajuh ka por , kiba bun ki briew kin pynlehnoh-ei ïa ki jingpynnang jyllang ki ban sngewkwah ïa kaei kabu jia .
translation.en: But thou , O Daniel , shut up the words , and seal the book , even to the time of the end : many shall run to and fro , and knowledge shall be increased .

And he lighted upon a certain place , and tarried there all night , because the sun was set  ; and he took of the stones of that place , and put them for his pillows , and lay down in that place to sleep .
translation.kha: Ha ka por sep sngi , u poi sha ka jaka bakhuid bad u la sher dara hangta . U dem ban thiah , u da pynshaniah ïa la ka khlieh halor u maw .

translation.en: And when he knew it of the centurion , he gave the body to Joseph .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïathuh u rangbah shipai , u Pilat u la ong ïa u Joseph ba u lah ban shim ïa ka met .

To ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga ong : Pha bam ïa ka doh kaba dang bit snam ha ka . Phi mane ïa ki bleithaw . Phi pynïap brai . Kaei kaba pynlong ïa Phi ba pyrkhat ba ka ri ka dei ka jong phi ?
translation.en: Wherefore say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Ye eat with the blood , and lift up your eyes toward your idols , and shed blood : and shall ye possess the land ?

translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud phin sngew kumba ph la shad puh da u seiñïong .
translation.en: At the last it biteth like a serpent , and stingeth like an adder .
Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses , even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam s transgression , who is the figure of him that was to come .
translation.kha: Hynrei naduh ka por jong u Adam haduh ka por jong u Moses , ka jingïap ka synshar halor u bynriew baroh , wat halor kito ki bym shym la leh pop ha ka rukom kumba u Adam u la leh mynba um shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Blei . U Adam u la long ka dur jong uta u ban sa wan .

translation.en: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest , and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight , and have made thee a great name , like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth .
translation.kha: Nga la don ryngkat bad me kat shaba me leit , bad nga la jop ïa ki nongshun jong me baroh katba me nang ïaid shaphrang . Ngan pynlong ïa me uba pawnam kat ki nongïalam kiba khraw tam ha ka pyrthei .
Ki Philistia ki la ïaleh tyngeh bad ki la jop ïa ki Israel , kiba phet ïa-ïap sha la ki ïit . Ka la Don ka jingshah pynsep kaba khraw : Laiphew hajir ngat ki shipai Israel ki shuh pynïap .
translation.en: And the Philistines fought , and Israel was smitten , and they fled every man into his tent : and there was a very great slaughter  ; for there fell of Israel thirty thousand footmen .

translation.kha: Ka spah baroh ka U Blei u la shim noh na i pa jong ngi ka de ka jong ngi bad jong ki khun jong ngi . To sa katai U Blei u la bthah ïa pa’ .
translation.en: For all the riches which God hath taken from our father , that is ours , and our children s : now then , whatsoever God hath said unto thee , do .

translation.kha: Hynrei phai shim kabu’ ïa ka jingbhabriew bad ka nam jngai phan , ban ïaishah bad uno uno uba pha ïakynduh .
translation.en: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty , and playedst the harlot because of thy renown , and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by  ; his it was .

translation.kha: Ki khum ki ksiew jong u kthaw kurim u Moses , na ka jait Ken , ki la leit ryngkat bad u paid Judah na Jerikho , ka nongbah ki dieng Tlai , sha ka ri shrah ha ka phang bashathie Jong ka Arad ha Judah . Ki shongduh hangthie hapdeng ki Amalek .
translation.en: And the children of the Kenite , Moses  father in law , went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah , which lieth in the south of Arad  ; and they went and dwelt among the people .
Those things , which ye have both learned , and received , and heard , and seen in me , do : and the God of peace shall be with you .
translation.kha: Pyntreikam ïa kaei kaba phi la nang bad ïohpdiang na nga , na ki ktien jong nga bad ki kam jong nga . Bad U Blei uba ai ha ngi ka jingsuk , un long lem bad phi .

translation.en: Hearken not to Hezekiah : for thus saith the king of Assyria , Make an agreement with me by a present , and come out to me : and eat ye every one of his vine , and every one of his fig tree , and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern  ;
translation.kha: A wat sngap ïa u Hesekaïah ! U patsha ka Assyria u hukum ïa phi ban mihnoh na ka nongbah bad ban pyndem . Ïa phi baroh yn shah ban bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na la ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki soh Dumbur na ki jong ki dieng jong ki , bad ban dih um na ki pukri jong phi —
Ha baroh ki lytar bad ha syrngiew jong uwei pa wai u dieng ki pynïeng ïa ki païa maw bad ki dur Jong ka blei Asherah ,
translation.en: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill , and under every green tree :
Behold , I have made thee small among the heathen : thou art greatly despised .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ka Edom ,  Ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba tlot bor ; baroh kin ibeiñ ïa pha .

translation.en: Egypt is like a very fair heifer , but destruction cometh  ; it cometh out of the north .
translation.kha: Ka Ijipt ka long kum ka masi baphylla , ba la tur ïaleh da u skain ba kynthah na shatei .

translation.en: This man was instructed in the way of the Lord  ; and being fervent in the spirit , he spake and taught diligently the things of the Lord , knowing only the baptism of John .
translation.kha: La hikai ïa u ha ka Lynti jong U Trai , bad da ka jingshitrhem bakhraw u la pynbna bad hikai khlem bakla ïa ki jingshisha shaphang U Jisu . Pynban u la tip tang ïa ka jingpynbaptis jong u Ïoannis .
Ki ap ha ki rudwah jong ka wah Onan malade ki ïaid khlem jingot shane shatai , Kum ki ha-sem kiba la shah beh noh na ki skum jongnga ki .
translation.en: For it shall be , that , as a wandering bird cast out of the nest , so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon .

translation.kha: Ynda ki poi ha ka jaka shoh kew kaba ha Adadah , kaba sha jingkhie na ka Judah , ki ïapynlong hangta ïa ka jingïambriew kaba jur bad kaba kthong mynsiem ; bad u Joseph u pyndep ïa ka jingïambriew ïa la u kpa sa hynñiew sngem .
translation.en: And they came to the threshingfloor of Atad , which is beyond Jordan , and there they mourned with a great and very sore lamentation : and he made a mourning for his father seven days .

translation.kha: Ki la pynlut hynñiew sngem ha kaba pynkyntang ïa ka duwan , bad nangta sa hynñiew sngem ha kaba rakhe ïa ka Jingïohipaw Niam . Ha ka sngi kaba khatwei ki la pynlong ïa ka jingrakhe pynwai .
translation.en: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly : for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days , and the feast seven days .

translation.kha: U Joab u la longing , bad ka kylli , Phi dei u Joab ? Ho-oid , na dei , u jubab . Kynrad , sngap ïa nga , ka ong . Nga sngi keiñ , u jubab .
translation.en: And when he was come near unto her , the woman said , Art thou Joab ? And he answered , I am he . Then she said unto him , Hear the words of thine handmaid . And he answered , I do hear .

translation.kha: Pynban tang shisien pyrsad na me , ko Tharai , ka la pynïap jyllop ïa ki nong Ijipt ; ki ngam kum ka biar ha ka ïabuh bashyrkhei .
translation.en: Thou didst blow with thy wind , the sea covered them : they sank as lead in the mighty waters .

translation.kha: Ki la lah bud ïa U Jisu mynba u don ha Galilaïa bad ïahap ïa u . Bun kiwei pat ki kyntiap kaba la wan sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad u ki la ïadon ruh hangta .
translation.en: ( Who also , when he was in Galilee , followed him , and ministered unto him  ; ) and many other women which came up with him unto Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U Kynrad u donkam ïa u , ki la jop , bad ki la ïalam ïa u khun kada shaw U Jisu .
translation.en: And they said , The Lord hath need of him .

And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land , and they shall no more be remembered : and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan weng noh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki bleithaw na ka ri , bad ym don mano mano ban kynmaw shuh ïa ki . Ngan weng noh ïa uno uno uba kam ba u long u nongïathuhlypa bad ngan shim noh ïa ka jingkwah ban mane ïa ki bleithaw .
Thaw saw tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pyndait ïa ki ha ki saw tylli ki dongnai ha kiba khong ki kjat jong ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt make for it four rings of gold , and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof .

translation.kha: Mynmiet bad mynsngi phi ïaid bakla , bad ki nongïathuhlypa kim long kham babha ban ïa phi . Ngan sa pynjot ïa ka Israel , ka kmie jongno phi .
translation.en: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day , and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night , and I will destroy thy mother .
And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful , he said ,  How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ba u la sngewsih bad u la ong ,  Katno ka long kaba eh ïa ki briew bariewspah ban rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei !
To ïeng joit malu mihnoh ; naba ym ni shuh ka jingshngain hangne . Ki pop jong phin ki la long jingjngem sha ka jingpynjot ïa kane ka jaka .
translation.en: Arise ye , and depart  ; for this is not your rest : because it is polluted , it shall destroy you , even with a sore destruction .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Ujuh u la ïaphai peit sawdong ban ïohi mano ba la leh ïa kata .
translation.en: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing .

And when Peter was come to himself , he said , Now I know of a surety , that the Lord hath sent his angel , and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod , and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews .
translation.kha: Te u Petros u la sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba la lah jia ha u , bad u la ong ,  Mynta nga tip ba ka long kaba shisha ! U Trai u la phah ïa u angel jong u ban pyllait ïa nga na ka bor jong u Herod bad na kaei kaei baroh kaba ki Jiw ki la khmih lynti ba kan jia .
Lada nga la tip ba un leh , ngan rynsied da kaba kmen , kam pher katno khraw ka jingpang jong per . Nga tip ba U Blei u long uba khoit ; ngam pat ju pyrshah ïa kaei kaba u hukum .
translation.en: Then should I yet have comfort  ; yea , I would harden myself in sorrow : let him not spare  ; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One .

translation.kha: Kiba ïap kim eh ban ïohi ne ïohsngew ne leh ei ei .—Hebru 9 :5 , 10 .
translation.en: The dead are not able to see or hear or do anything . —Ecclesiastes 9 :5 , 10 .

translation.kha: kiwei! pat kiba sah jong ka kur khot ki ïoh shiphew tylli ki nongbah na ki khang jong ki jait Hapharaim , Dan , Manasseh ba sha Sepngi .
translation.en: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim , and out of the tribe of Dan , and out of the half tribe of Manasseh , ten cities .

translation.kha: hynrei salia ka wan na U Bela , phim lah don jop ïa ki . Phi lah ban shem ïa lade kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei ! Ka Dorbar ka la kohnguh ïa ka jingai jingmut jong u Gamaliel .
translation.en: But if it be of God , ye cannot overthrow it  ; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God .

translation.kha: Nangta katto katjuh ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad katto katne ki Pharisi ki la kriah . Ko Nonghikai , ki la ong , ngi kwah ban Ïohi ïa me ba me leh ïabam .
translation.en: Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered , saying , Master , we would see a sign from thee .

translation.kha: Haba u ïohi ïa u nongshun ba u wan pah , u put ïa ka turoi ban ramhah ïa uwei pa aiwai .
translation.en: If when he seeth the sword come upon the land , he blow the trumpet , and warn the people  ;

translation.kha: Nga la khmih ïa u langbrot ba u tynrah da ki reng jong u sha sepngi , shait , bad shathie . Ym don uno uno u mrad uba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u lane lait phet na ka bor jong u . U la ar katba u sngewbha bad u la nang jingsngewmeng .
translation.en: I saw the ram pushing westward , and northward , and southward  ; so that no beasts might stand before him , neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand  ; but he did according to his will , and became great .

Now set your heart and your soul to seek the  Lord  your God  ; arise therefore , and build ye the sanctuary of the  Lord  God , to bring the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and the holy vessels of God , into the house that is to be built to the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Mynta , shakri ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong phi baroh . Sdang noh ban tei ïa ka Templ , khnang ba phi lah ban buh ha ka ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  bad ïa baroh kiwei pat ki tiar bakyntang ba ju pyndonkam ha kaba mane ïa u .
Ai ha nga lai ngut ki rangbah na kiwei kawei ka jait . nur phah ïa ki ban leit lyngba ïa ka ri barhem kawei bad jurip ïa kata ka iaki kaba kin mon don ïohkynti . Hadien kata kin wan pat ha to .
translation.en: Give out from among you three men for each tribe : and I will send them , and they shall rise , and go through the land , and describe it according to the inheritance of them  ; and they shall come again to me .

translation.kha: Haba uno uno na ki Sikhri jong nga u mudui pyrshah ïa nga , ngan shukor bad leh da Kaba hok ïa u .
translation.en: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant , when they contended with me  ;

translation.kha: Ki synran ki la khun jingmut ba uwei pa uwei na ki un phah katba lah bor ban ïarap ïa ki phyrngab Kiba shong lehrain ha Judia .
translation.en: Then the disciples , every man according to his ability , determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea :
And he said , Appoint me thy wages , and I will give it .
translation.kha: To kheiñ ïa ka bainong jong me , bad ngan siew ïa ka .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Take these evidences , this evidence of the purchase , both which is sealed , and this evidence which is open  ; and put them in an earthen vessel , that they may continue many days .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la hukum ïa phi ban shim ïa kine ki dulir thied jaka baroh ar tylli , ka dulir thied jaka ba la shon muhor bad ka kopi ba khlem shon muhor , bad ban buh ïa ki ha u khra khyndew , khnang ba kin neh ha ki snem ki ban wan .

translation.en: The king of Libnah , one  ; the king of Adullam , one  ;
translation.kha: ka Libnah , ka Adullam ,

translation.en: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years , and begat sons and daughters :
translation.kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun

translation.en: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them , which I command thee this day , to love the  Lord  thy God , and to walk ever in his ways  ; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee , beside these three :
translation.kha: te phi dei ban jied sa lai tylli ki shnong . ( Un ai ha phi ïa kane ka ri lada phi leh ïa baroh kaba nga hukum ïa phi ha kane ka sngi bad lada phi ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad im kat kum ki jinghikai jong U . )

translation.en: But while men slept , his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat , and went his way .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet , haba baroh ki la ïohthiah , u nongshun u la wan bad u la bet ïa ki ñiut hapdeng u kew , bad u la leit noh .
Katto ka dang khuid kha , aiwai na ki u pynmeh shabar ïa la ka kti ; ka nongpynkha khun ka bat ïa kata ka kti , ka teh ïa ka da u saisaw , bad ka ong , Une u dei uba mih nyngkong .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when she travailed , that the one put out his hand : and the midwife took and bound upon his hand a scarlet thread , saying , This came out first .
Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith : neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto : it is confusion .
translation.kha: Ym bit ïa uno uno u briew ne ka briew ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki mrad ; kum kata ka kam khyllah ka pynlong ïa me u bymkhuid .
U hukum ïa ki paid ka Judah ban leh ïa ka myn jong U thri , U Blei jong ki kba tymmen jyllang ki , bad ban kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai bad hukum jong u .
translation.en: And commanded Judah to seek the  Lord  God of their fathers , and to do the law and the commandment .

translation.kha: Khlem ka diengïap , ka ding ka lip noh ; khlem ka jinglorni , ka jingïakajia ka kput noh .
translation.en: Where no wood is , there the fire goeth out : so where there is no talebearer , the strife ceaseth .

translation.kha: Mynta bapaw , sngewbha leh ïa kaweh nga jong . Shah ngan wanrah bam ïa phi . Phi dei ban ïam ba phin dup ïohbor ynda phi leit sha la ka jingleit .
translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid , and let me set a morsel of bread before thee  ; and eat , that thou mayest have strength , when thou goest on thy way .
When they were filled , he said unto his disciples ,  Gather up the fragments that remain , that nothing be lost .
translation.kha: Haba baroh ki la ïakdang , u la ong ha la ki synran ,  To khar ïa ki lyngkhot kiba tam ; ngim dei ban pynsep-ei .

Bad mynta kaba ap ïa la ka long ka bainong jyllang ka jingkup ïa kaba la bah beit da U Balei uba U Troas , u nongbishar bak , u ban ai ha nga ha said ka Snem — ym tang ïa nga , hynrei ïa tun baroh kiba ap ïa u da ka jingieit ba un wanpaw .
translation.en: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness , which the Lord , the righteous judge , shall give me at that day : and not to me only , but unto all them also that love his appearing .

translation.kha: Kiba bun Aner kiba ju leh myntor ki la wallam lang ïa ki kitab jong ki baroh bad thang ïa kita ha khmat u Paidbah . Ki la kheiñlang ïa ka dor jong ki kitab , bad ka jingkheiñ ka hir kumba sanphew hajar tylli ki shabi rupa .
translation.en: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together , and burned them before all men : and they counted the price of them , and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver .

translation.kha: Phai la pyrthuh bud ïa ngi bad ïa U Trai ; wat la phi la shahshitom shikatdei eh , Phin la pdiang ïa ka khubor da ka jingkmen kaba wan na U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: And ye became followers of us , and of the Lord , having received the word in much affliction , with joy of the Holy Ghost :

translation.kha: Na bneng , ha kaba me shong , sngap ïa u bad leh ïa kaei kaba u kyrpad ïa me ban leh , khnang ba baroh ki briew Jong khie ka pyrthei kyang tip ïa me bad kohnguh ïa me main ki bani Israel ki leh . Te kin tip ba kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei kan long ka jaka ha kaba yn ma ïa me .
translation.en: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for : that all people of the earth may know thy name , to fear thee , as do thy people Israel  ; and that they may know that this house , which I have builded , is called by thy name .

translation.kha: To krenbeiñ bad to leh kum ki biria ïa kiba yn sa bishar da ka hukum kaba pyllaitluid ïa ngi .
translation.en: So speak ye , and so do , as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty .

translation.kha: Ngan ïai leh ïa kaei kaba nga leh mynta , ktang ban pynkhlad ïa kito kiwei ki baphylla ba kin ïoh daw ban katba sahnar bad ban ong ba ki trei ha kajuh ka lap kumba ngi ter .
translation.en: But what I do , that I will do , that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion ; that wherein they glory , they may be found even as we .

translation.kha: Kumta ha ka snem kaba laiphew wei jong ka jingsynshar u Sa u syiem ka Judah , u Omri u long u syier ka Israel , bad u la synsar khat-ar snem . Ha ki hynriew snem kiba nyngkong u la synshar ha Tirsah ,
translation.en: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Judah began Omri to reign over Israel , twelve years : six years reigned he in Tirzah .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingkynjah lang jong ki briew jongngi me baroh , ha ka dik kyntang jngai ka Templ jngai me ha Jerusalem , ngan ai ha me ïa Kaei kaba la la kular . A to khroh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: In the courts of the  Lord s  house , in the midst of thee , O Jerusalem . Praise ye the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ngan ym shah shuh ba kan dang klun ïa ka kyrteng u Baal .
translation.en: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth , and they shall no more be remembered by their name .

And it was so , when the days of their feasting were gone about , that Job sent and sanctified them , and rose up early in the morning , and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all : for Job said , It may be that my sons have sinned , and cursed God in their hearts . Thus did Job continually .
translation.kha: Ha man ka step kaba bud jong ka jingkhawai , u Job u ju khie dang step bad u ai ïa ki jingkñia na ka bynta iwei pa iwei na ki khun jong u ban pynkhuid ïa ki . U ju leh ïa kane borabor namar u pyrkhat ba ïoh iwei na ki i leh pop da kaba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei khlem poi pyrkhat .
Ka long ka samla kaba bhabriew eh pynlang kaba ïalang kata . Ka leit Hirah sha ka pynroi , ka pyndap um ha la u khiew sad ka wan kiew bajrong .
translation.en: And the damsel was very fair to look upon , a virgin , neither had any man known her : and she went down to the well , and filled her pitcher , and came up .

translation.kha: Da naba dud ïa ki rukom ba la bthuh da u Dabid u kpu jong u , u buh ryntih ïa ka kai shakri kaba man ka sngi jong ki lyngngoh bad ki Lebi kiba ïarap ïa ki lynghoh ha ki jingrwai ïaroh malade haba pyndep ïa ki kam jong ki . U buh rynsied ruh ïa ki nongap jingkhang ka Tubal da ki kynhun ha kawei pa kawei ka khyrdop , ban pyndep ïa ki kada jong ki kiba man la ka Sngi katto kum ki hukum u Dabid , u briew jyllang U Blei .
translation.en: And he appointed , according to the order of David his father , the courses of the priests to their service , and the Levites to their charges , to praise and minister before the priests , as the duty of every day required : the porters also by their courses at every gate : for so had David the man of God commanded .

translation.kha: Kumba U Trai u shoh Bad u ïai shoh ïa ki , ki briew’ jong u pang kin ïa-ïaid rynsied dara ki sur jong ki ksing bad ki duna . U blem hi da lade un ïalap pyrshah ïa ki Assyria .
translation.en: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass , which the  Lord  shall lay upon him , it shall be with tabrets and harps : and in battles of shaking will he fight with it .

translation.kha: Ïa ka khleiñ jyllang u baroh dei ban weng bad ainguh halor kata ka duwan : ka dongnai , ka khleiñ kiba sop ïa ki doh jem ,
translation.en: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof  ; the rump , and the fat that covereth the inwards ,
And I saw in a vision  ; and it came to pass , when I saw , that I was at Shushan in the palace , which is in the province of Elam  ; and I saw in a vision , and I was by the river of Ulai .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw nga la shem kynsan ïa lade ha ka nongbah Susa ba la ker kynroh ha ka probins    jong ka Elam . Nga la ïeng harud ka wah Ulai ,
Ka long kaba ibieit ban ym suidñiew ïa kiei kaba ki kmie ki kpa jong phi ki hikai ; ka long kaba jingstad ban pdiang ïa ka jingsneng jongno ki .
translation.en: A fool despiseth his father s instruction : but he that regardeth reproof is prudent .

translation.kha: To ngin ïaroh ïa U thri , U Blei jong ki Jesreel ! U la wan ïa ka ban ïarap ïa ki briew jong u bad ban pyllaitluid ïa ki .
translation.en: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel  ; for he hath visited and redeemed his people ,

translation.kha: U la im haduh ba u da ïohi ïa ki khun Bad ki ksiew jong u Ephron , bad haduh ba u da ïohpdiang ïa ki khun jong u Makhir , u khur jong u Manasseh .
translation.en: And Joseph saw Ephraim s children of the third generation : the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph s knees .
( After that Jeconiah the king , and the queen , and the eunuchs , the princes of Judah and Jerusalem , and the carpenters , and the smiths , were departed from Jerusalem  ; )
translation.kha: Nga la thoh ïa ka hadien ba u syiem Jehoïakhin , ka kmie jong u , ki rangbah synshar ha ka ïingsyiem , ki nongïalam jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem , ki nong-ohdur , bad ki nongtrei batbit ki la shah ringmraw .
Ki jingïasylla bymman kiba pa pynlong ki long kiba samrkhie kum ki pyrshang jyllang ki bseiñ bakha don bih . Pynpait ïa kata ka pylleng , un mih u bseiñ .
translation.en: They hatch cockatrice  eggs , and weave the spider s web : he that eateth of their eggs dieth , and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper .
And Jesus said unto him ,  Friend , wherefore art thou come ?  Then came they , and laid hands on Jesus , and took him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  To pynkloi shaphang jong ka , ko paralok !  Nangta ki la ïawan kiew , ki la kem ïa U Jisu , bad ki la batskhem ïa u .
Haba u Ehud u la dep ai ha u ïa ki jingai sngewbha , u la ainong ha ki rangbah kba la kit ïa kita ban leit phai noh patan sha ïing .
translation.en: And when he had made an end to offer the present , he sent away the people that bare the present .
Why doth thine heart carry thee away ? and what do thy eyes wink at ,
translation.kha: Hynrei me leh shitrhem bad peit shin ïa ngi da ka jingbitar .

translation.en: And he took the captains of hundreds , and the nobles , and the governors of the people , and all the people of the land , and brought down the king from the house of the  Lord  : and they came through the high gate into the king s house , and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah shipai , ki riewpawkhmat , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , bad ki briew baroh , ki ïadon lang bad u Jehoïada ha jingïa-ïaid paidbah kaba wan ïalam ïa u syiem na ka Templ sha ka ïingsyiem . Ki rung na ka khyrdop bah , bad u syiem u shong halor ka khet .
U Blei u long thrang aiwai , bad un pynlong ha lade hi ka khor bad ki Jiw halor ka nongrit jong ka jingieit jong ki , bad un pynlong ka hok bad ki Jentil lyngba ka jingngeit jyllang ki .
translation.en: Seeing it is one God , which shall justify the circumcision by faith , and uncircumcision through faith .
But bring your youngest brother unto me  ; so shall your words be verified , and ye shall not die . And they did so .
translation.kha: Nangta phi dei ban wan ïalam ïa u para khatduh jong phi sha nga . Kane kan pynshisha ba phi kren hok , bad ngan ym pynïap ïa phi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  hath performed his word that he spake , and I am risen up in the room of David my father , and sit on the throne of Israel , as the  Lord  promised , and have built an house for the name of the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: Bad mynta U  Trai  u la pyndep ïa ka kular jong u . Nga la kiew ïa ka khet u kpa jong nga , u syiem ki Israel bad nga la tei ïa ka Templ ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: Let the priests , the ministers of the  Lord  , weep between the porch and the altar , and let them say , Spare thy people , O  Lord  , and give not thine heritage to reproach , that the heathen should rule over them : wherefore should they say among the people , Where is their God ?
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh , kiba shakri ïa U  Trai hapdeng ka duwan bad ka jaka rung ka Templ , ki dei ban ïam bad duwai :  To isynei ïa la ki briew , A  Trai . To wat ai ba kiwei ki jaitbynriew kin krenbeiñ bad ñiewbeiñ ïa ngi da kaba ong , ‘ Hangno U Blei jong phi ?’

translation.en: A friend loveth at all times , and a brother is born for adversity .
translation.kha: Ki paralok borabor ki pynpaw ïa ka jingieit jong ki . Ki hynmen ki para ki dei na ka bynta kaei lada kim ïarap lem ha por jingjynjar ?
U Mesha u la kuna kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u . U la pynjngut ïa u Jehoash ha kham u Eleasar u lyngdoh bad uta u phlang baroh .
translation.en: And Moses did as the  Lord  commanded him : and he took Joshua , and set him before Eleazar the priest , and before all the congregation :

translation.kha: Kum u jingjop uba wan mih na ka jakarieh jong u , u nongpynjot jong ki jaitbynriew u la mihnoh . U wan ban pynjot ïa ka Judah . Ïa ki nongbah Jong ka Judah yn ieh ha ki jingjot , bad yn ym don mano mano basngur ba law ha ki .
translation.en: The lion is come up from his thicket , and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way  ; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate  ; and thy cities shall be laid waste , without an inhabitant .

translation.kha: Kñia ïa ki jingainguh tdong hangta ha ka duwan U Trai . Kñia hati ïa kita ki jingainguh na kiba phi bam ïa ka doh jong ki , Bad theh ïa ka snam jong ki ha ka kito .
translation.en: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings , the flesh and the blood , upon the altar of the  Lord  thy God : and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the  Lord  thy God , and thou shalt eat the flesh .

translation.kha: Na suiñbneng me phah ïa u slap halor ki lam , bad ïa ka pyrthei la pynnep da ki jingkyrkhu jong me .
translation.en: He watereth the hills from his chambers : the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jobab u pynlong ka jingsma ha U Trai : Lada men long ryngkat bad nga Bad ïadon ïa nga ha khnai ka jingleit jong nga , bad men ai ka bam ka ieh bad ka kup ka sem ïa nga ,
translation.en: And Jacob vowed a vow , saying , If God will be with me , and will keep me in this way that I go , and will give me bread to eat , and raiment to put on ,

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Une u long u shakri jrong nga , uba nga pynshaitbor — Uta uba nga la jied , ha u nga shet sngewbha . Ngam la pyndap ïa u da U Mynsngi jong nga , bad un ïalam jingbishar dkhoh ha man la ka jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Behold my servant , whom I uphold  ; mine elect , in whom my soul delighteth  ; I have put my spirit upon him : he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles .

translation.kha: Nga ïohi ba ki briew ki shlei , kumta nga ong ha ki Bad ha ki nongïalam malade ki rangbah synshar jong ki , Wat ïasheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong ngi . Kynmaw kynum U Trai u lama uba khraw bad uba shyngkub , bad u ïaleh na ka bynta ki brai ka ri jngai phi , ki khulom jong phi , ki tnga jngai phi , bad ki ïing jong phi .
translation.en: And I looked , and rose up , and said unto the nobles , and to the rulers , and to the rest of the people , Be not ye afraid of them : remember the Lord , which is great and terrible , and fight for your brethren , your sons , and your daughters , your wives , and your houses .

translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit jong ar , ban bud ïa ka jingïalam jong bakha kumne i'u ki briew , bad uno uno de uba twa bad sharak lang bad ki .
translation.en: That ye submit yourselves unto such , and to every one that helpeth with us , and laboureth .
And Reuben heard it , and he delivered him out of their hands  ; and said , Let us not kill him .
translation.kha: Haba u Reuben u la ïohsngew ïa ki , u la pyrshang ban pyllait im ïa u Joseph .  To ngin ym pynïap ïa u ,  u ong .

Ngi pynshlur ïa phi ba phin ïai bteng Ban pule shaphang U Bel , ban ïathuh ïa la ki bahaïing ïasam pynlang ki paralok lad Phi shaphang kiei kiba phi pule bad ban ïasyllok bad ngi khlem da pud ha ki jingïalang Khristan jong ngi . —Hebru 10 :23-25 .
translation.en: We encourage you to keep on taking in knowledge of God , to tell the rest of your family and friends about what you are learning , and to associate regularly with us at our Christian meetings . —Hebrews 10 :23-25 .

translation.kha: Ngi dei baneh jingeh ïa U Blei ha ki por baroh na ka bynta jong phin , ko parabangeit , phi kiba U Terah u ieit . Nabal U Blei u la jied ïa phi kumno kiba nyngkong ba-bang pynim da ka ber U Mynsiem ban pynlong ïa phi ki riewkyrpang Jong u bad da ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka jingrisa .
translation.en: But we are bound to give thanks alway to God for you , brethren beloved of the Lord , because God hath from the beginning chosen you to salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief of the truth :
If thou meet thine enemy s ox or his ass going astray , thou shalt surely bring it back to him again .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïohi ïa ka masi ne ïa ka kada u nongshun jong phi ba ka ïaid sakma , leit ïalam pat ïa ka sha u .
U la jubab , Uta uba don ar tylli ki sopti , u dei ban ai kawei ha u briew u bym don , bad uno uno uba ei jingbam u dien ban ïasam ïa ka .
translation.en: He answereth and saith unto them , He that hath two coats , let him impart to him that hath none  ; and he that hath meat , let him do likewise .

translation.kha: To kdew ïa ka lyndum sha Seïon ! To phet ban lait im ! Wat ym pynslem ! U Trai u wallam ka jingjop bad ka jingpynkoit kaba khraw na shatei .
translation.en: Set up the standard toward Zion : retire , stay not : for I will bring evil from the north , and a great destruction .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Haba phi duwai , to ong ïa khie : ‘ Ko Kpa : Ai ba ka kyrteng jong me kan long naba la pynbun ; ai ban wan ka Hima jong me .
translation.en: And he said unto them , When ye pray , say ,  Our Father which art in heaven , Hallowed be thy name . Thy kingdom come . Thy will be done , as in heaven , so in earth .

translation.kha: Kiba bun na ki nongbud jong u ki la iohsngew ïa kane bad ki la ong , Kane ka jinghikai ka long kaban eh than . Uei u ban shahshkor ïa ka ?
translation.en: Many therefore of his disciples , when they had heard this , said , This is an hard saying  ; who can hear it ?

translation.kha: Ki shna saw thyllah ki baïap da ka tieng akasia ha kiba yn wah ïa “kata ka pyrshah , ki suit ïa ki da ka kseh , bad ki pahuh ha ki ïa ki bnoh ksiar . Hangta ki shna saw tylli ki tyllep tngaw rupa kiba batskhem ïa kita ki païa .
translation.en: And he made thereunto four pillars of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold : their hooks were of gold  ; and he cast for them four sockets of silver .
For they will turn away thy son from following me , that they may serve other gods : so will the anger of the  Lord  be kindled against you , and destroy thee suddenly .
translation.kha: ïoh kin phai dien noh na U  Trai  ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Lada jia kumta , U  Trai  un bitar lep ïa phi bad un pynjot ïa phi shisyndon .

translation.en: And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God , and saying ,
translation.kha: Kynsan ka kynhun bah jong ki angel ka bneng , ka la mihpaw lem bad u angel , ki da rwai ki jingïaroh ïa U Blei :
Kum ïa ki briew jong kane ka juk yn pynshitom na ka byndi ka jingpynïap ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la shuh pynïap naduh ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei ,
translation.en: That the blood of all the prophets , which was shed from the foundation of the world , may be required of this generation  ;
They that come after him shall be astonished at his day , as they that went before were affrighted .
translation.kha: Na mihngi sha sepngi , baroh kiba ïohsngew ïa ka kupar jong u ki suhjer ka met bad ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: And all the people of Judah took Azariah , which was sixteen years old , and made him king instead of his father Amaziah .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah Judah te ki pynkup syiem ïa u khun jong u , u Ussaïah uba don khathynriew snem ka rta .

Bad katba u dang ai jingkieng , u Absalom u phah khot ruh na ka shnong Gilo ïa u Ahithophel , uba long uwei na ki nongthied jong u Shim Dabid . Ka jingthmu barieh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka nang jur , bad ki nongbud jongu u Absalom ki nang bun .
translation.en: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite , David s counsellor , from his city , even from Giloh , while he offered sacrifices . And the conspiracy was strong  ; for the people increased continually with Absalom .

translation.kha: U kpa jongnga u briew uba khih u don ka daw babiang don kmen . Phi lah ban sngewsarong ha u khuid kiba stad .
translation.en: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice : and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him .

And he carried out thence all the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house , and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the temple of the  Lord  , as the  Lord  had said .
translation.kha: bad u la kit sha Babilon ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ha ka Templ bad ïingsyiem . Kumba U  Trai  u la ïathuhlypa , u Nebukhadnessar u la pynpait ïa baroh ki khiew ki pliang ksiar kiba u syiem Solomon u la thaw na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ .
Kito kiba lait im kin ïap ha ka jingtap , malu wat ki tnga jong ki kin ym ïam na ka bynta ka jingïap jongki ki .
translation.en: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death : and his widows shall not weep .

translation.kha: Ha ka snieh kaba ar jong ka jingsyier u Jeshaïah u khun jyllang u Jehoahas kum u syiemsad ka Israel , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u Joahas u long u syiem ka Judia
translation.en: In the second year of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel reigned Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah .

translation.kha: Ki jingïakut jong kiba stad ki long ka umpohliew ka jingim ; kin ïarap ïa phi ïa-ban lait im haba ka jingriam jong phi ka dat ha ka jingem .
translation.en: The law of the wise is a fountain of life , to depart from the snares of death .

translation.kha: Wat lada Phi shoh ïa u bieit haduh ba u la jan ïap , pynban phin ym lah satia Ban weng ïa ka jingbieit na u .
translation.en: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle , yet will not his foolishness depart from him .
Of the sons of Uzziel  ; Michah the first , and Isshiah the second .
translation.kha: U Ussiel , u khun uba saw jong u Kohath , u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Mikah bad u Isshaïah .
Haba kiwei pat ki shiphew ngut ki synran ki la ïohsngew sanphew kane , ki la bitar ïa kita ar jngut shi sa .
translation.en: And when the ten heard it , they were moved with indignation against the two brethren .
And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this , there is none so discreet and wise as thou art :
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u Joseph ,  U Blei u la pynpaw ha me ïa kane baroh , kumta ka long kaba shai ba me don ka jingstad bad jingshemphang kaba kham khraw ban ïano ïano .

translation.en: For I will have respect unto you , and make you fruitful , and multiply you , and establish my covenant with you .
translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa phi bad ngan ai ha phi shibun ki khun ; ngan pynskhem ïa ka bynta ka jutang jong nga kaba nga la pynlong bad phi .

translation.en: Give ye ear , and hear my voice  ; hearken , and hear my speech .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba nga ong ha phi .
Un pyllait ïa phiah lada phi long lui lui , lada kaei kaba phiah leh ka long kaba dei .
translation.en: He shall deliver the island of the innocent : and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands .

translation.kha: Wat ïathuh ïa ki nongshun jong ngi ha Gog shaphang ka jingshahjop jong im ; wat ai ba kin ïohi ba phi ïam . Ko ki briew ka Beth Leaphrah , pyn-i ïa ka jinglyng-a jong phi da kaba kyrdoh ha u pui pien !
translation.en: Declare ye it not at Gath , weep ye not at all : in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust .

translation.kha: malade ngi thring ruma kum ki biria kiba matlah . Neng jynthut ha ka por shiteng sngi , la kumba hir mynmiet , la kumba Ngi don ha ka pyrthei kaba dum jrong kiba ïap .
translation.en: We grope for the wall like the blind , and we grope as if we had no eyes : we stumble at noonday as in the night  ; we are in desolate places as dead men .

translation.kha: Ki la jam ïa ka Jordan bad ki la sher dara ha ka phang bashathie jongnga ka Aroer , ka nongbah kaba don hapdeng jong ka them , ha ka ri ki Gad . Na sier ka jaka ki la saw shaphang shatei sha Jaser ;
translation.en: And they passed over Jordan , and pitched in Aroer , on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad , and toward Jazer :

translation.kha: Shi beit jong ka ri ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Joanan la ai ha ki katei katne ki longïing kiba hiarpateng na u Manasseh , u khun nyngkong jong u Joseph . U Makhir , u kpu jong u Gedalaïah , u dei u khun nyngkong jngai u Manasseh bun u khla-ka-wait uba pawnam ; kumta ïa ka Gilead dara ka Bashan , ha ka phang mihngi ka Jordan , la ai ha u .
translation.en: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh  ; for he was the firstborn of Joseph  ; to wit , for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh , the father of Gilead : because he was a man of war , therefore he had Gilead and Bashan .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u , Ko paralok jong nga , mano ba la ai ha nga ka bor ban bishar lane ba pynbynta ïa ka jingdon jingem hapdeng jong phiah ar ngat ?
translation.en: And he said unto him ,  Man , who made me a judge or a divider over you ?

translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba syrdep ïa ka jaiñkup ka rim da ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba Thummim , naba kata ka syrdep bathymmai kan ran bad kan pynlong ka thliem naba khem heh ha ka jaiñkup .
translation.en: No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment , for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment , and the rent is made worse .

translation.kha: U Trai u long u nongïada bakhlaiñbor jong phi , ki lynti jong u ki long kiba janai , bad bak ; U Blei jong ph u long wahbah ïaineh bad uba shisha ; u leh ïa kaba hok pynlang kaba ibieit .
translation.en: He is the Rock , his work is perfect : for all his ways are judgment : a God of truth and without iniquity , just and right is he .

translation.kha: Kiba kumne kine ki bleithaw ki long kum ki jingpyntieng ïa ki sim ha ki lyngkha sohkhia ; kim lah ban kren ; la dei ban rah ïa ki namar kim lah ban ïaid . Wat sheptieng ïa ki : kim lah ban pynmynsaw ïa phi , bad kim lah ban lehbha ïa phi .
translation.en: They are upright as the palm tree , but speak not : they must needs be borne , because they cannot go . Be not afraid of them  ; for they cannot do evil , neither also is it in them to do good .

translation.kha: U Syiem Solomon u la jied laiphew ïahiar ngut ki pynrangbah kum ki nongtrei ba shah pynbor na kylleng ka ri Isaia ,
translation.en: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel  ; and the levy was thirty thousand men .

translation.kha: U dieng uba sloit um pynmih u soh uba sniew , lymne u dieng kiba swai ïa u soh uba bol .
translation.en: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit  ; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit .

translation.kha: U Khereth u synshar hangta halor baroh ki nongsynshar ba kynja bneng , ki kun synshar , ki bor , bad ki kynran ; u don ka kyrteng kaba kham hajrong ban ïa kiwei pat ki kyrteng kiba don ka leh ha kane ka pyrthei mynta bad ka ban sa waiñ .
translation.en: Far above all principality , and power , and might , and dominion , and every name that is named , not only in this world , but also in that which is to come :

translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko ki paralok lad nga , phi la tip lymda ïa kane . To sumar ïa lade , namarkata , ba phin ym shahskhor ïalam shit da ki jingpynkhlaiñ ki briew ki bym bat aiñ bad phiah hap noh na ka jaka ba la jingsngewshngain kaba phi ei .
translation.en: Ye therefore , beloved , seeing ye know these things before , beware lest ye also , being led away with the error of the wicked , fall from your own stedfastness .

translation.kha: U Jisu Krist da biar hi u la nong : “Wat sniew kyntait ia kane , namar ka por ka la jia , ha kaba kito katba don ha ki jing tep kin ioh sngew ia ka jingpyrta jong u Bad kin ia mih noh .” —Ioanis 5 :28 , 29 ; Ki Kam 24 :35 .
translation.en: Jesus Christ himself said : “Do not marvel at this , because the hour is coming in which all those in the memorial tombs will hear his voice and come out .”—John 5 :28 , 29  ; Acts 24 :15 .

translation.kha: Ka tang mar shu ïohi ïa ki , ka la dap da ka jingkwah briew bad ka phah nonglamktien sha ki ha Babilonia .
translation.en: And as soon as she saw them with her eyes , she doted upon them , and sent messengers unto them into Chaldea .

translation.kha: afi kirteng ayu
translation.en: What is your age
