translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la pynkhiah ïa bakha bun ki briew na ki jingshitom jong ki , ki jingpang jong ki , bad na ki mynsiem bymkhuid , mala u la ai ka jingïohi pah ha kaba bun ki briew kiba matlah .
translation.en: And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues , and of evil spirits  ; and unto many that were blind he gave sight .

translation.kha: Ki Lyngba ki ïaid halor jong ka , bad ha ka u Elnathan u lehkai , u mrad kynsha ka ïarwai uba me la thaw .
translation.en: There go the ships : there is that leviathan , whom thou hast made to play therein .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , Ka kynta ka la poi mynta ïa U Khun U briew’ Ban ïohpdiang ïa ka burom kaba khraw .
translation.en: And Jesus answered them , saying ,  The hour is come , that the Son of man should be glorified .
And lead us not into temptation , but deliver us from evil : For thine is the kingdom , and the power , and the glory , for ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Wat ïalam ïa ngi sha ka jingtynjuh kaba eh , hynrei sumar ïada ïa ngi na Uba Sniew . Naba ka jong me long ka hima , bad ka bor , bad ka burom junom . Amen .’
jhieh ïa ki khunswet bad nga , sad kun sumar ïa ki . Ki riewpyrthei ki la ban shaniah ha to .
translation.en: Leave thy fatherless children , I will preserve them alive  ; and let thy widows trust in me .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa kane mynta , khnang ba haba kata kan khia , phin ngeit ba ‘ Nga long uba nga long .’
translation.en: Now I tell you before it come , that , when it is come to pass , ye may believe that I am he .

translation.kha: Nga la khmied bad nga la ïohi ïa ka jingïohipaw ïa ka dur Kaba i kum ka durbriew bameh ding . Na ka syngkai sharum , ka met jong u ka long khem ka ding , bad na ka syngkai shaneng , u shad phyrnai kumne ka rnong ba la kyrshut phyrnai bha .
translation.en: Then I beheld , and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire : from the appearance of his loins even downward , fire  ; and from his loins even upward , as the appearance of brightness , as the colour of amber .
But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise , Say not in thine heart , Who shall ascend into heaven ? ( that is , to bring Christ down from above : )
translation.kha: Hynrei kaei kaba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shaphang ka jingïadei bad U Blei lyngba ka jingngeit ka long kane :  Phim dei ban kylli ïa lade , Uei u ban leit sha bneng ?  ( kata ka long , ban wallam ïa U Khrist sha tbian ) .
To ngin long shlur , te , bad nguh , U Trai u long u nongrahbor jong nga , len ym sheptieng . Uei umbah lah ban leh ei ei ïa nga ?
translation.en: So that we may boldly say , The Lord is my helper , and I will not fear what man shall do unto me .

translation.kha: Kat uba ïohi ïa ka u ong , Ngim pat ju ïohsngew ïa kaba kum kane kaei kaei ! Ym pat ju khia mynno mynno kaba kum kano naduh ba ki Israel ki la mih na Jephthah ! Ngi dei don kun ei ei na ka bynta kane ! Kan jat aïu shadien ?
translation.en: And it was so , that all that saw it said , There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day : consider of it , take advice , and speak your minds .

translation.kha: A wat sngewbishni ïa u Hesekaïah ! U patsha ka Assyria u hukum ïa ph Ban mihnoh na ka nongpang bad banbeiñ pyndem . Ïa phi baroh yn shah ban bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na la ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki sop Dumbur na ki jong ki dieng jong ki , bad ban sdieh um na ki pukri jong phi —
translation.en: Hearken not to Hezekiah : for thus saith the king of Assyria , Make an agreement with me by a present , and come out to me : and eat ye every one of his vine , and every one of his fig tree , and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern  ;

translation.kha: U Moses u leh kamar U Trai u la hukum , bad haba ki paidbah ki la ïalumlang ,
translation.en: And Moses did as the  Lord  commanded him  ; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Kaei kaei bhor ba u briew u bymkhuid u Ktah ka long ka bymkhuid , badno uno uno uwei pat uba kthaw ïa kata u long u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
translation.en: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean  ; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la ai ki lawbah ïa u Joab bad ïa kiwei pat ki rangbah pynïaidkam , Khie leit lyngba ka Isaia , na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat ka tduh , bad ñiewkor ïa ki briew . Nga kwah ban tipthuh haduh katno ngut ki ïadon .
translation.en: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people , Go , number Israel from Beer–sheba even to Dan  ; and bring the number of them to me , that I may know it .
And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God , saying , Tell me , I pray thee , all the great things that Elisha hath done .
translation.kha: Ka shem ba u syiem u dang ïakren bad u Gehasi , u shakri jong u Elisha ; u syiem u kwah ban tip shaphang ki kambah jong u Elisha .

translation.en: The king s strength also loveth judgment  ; thou dost establish equity , thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob .
translation.kha: Ko Syiem bakhlaiñbor , me ieit ïa kaei kaba dei ; me la pynskhem ïa ka jingbishar hok ha Israel ; me la wanrah ïa ka hok bad ka jinglehhok .
Aïu ngan noh Shua ha me ! Me tip ibha ïa la , bad pynban me pynïohburom ïa nga , u shakri jong me .
translation.en: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant ? for thou knowest thy servant .
And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet , and cover the same with a covering of badgers  skins , and shall put in the staves thereof .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban sumar ïa baroh ki tiar ki tar ka Ïingjaiñ bad ban pyndep ïa ki kamram kiba ïadei bad ki Israel .
Nga ainguh borabor ïa U Blei jong nga na ka bynta jong phin namar sier ka jingaiei ïa kaba u la ai ha phoi da U Khrist Jehu .
translation.en: I thank my God always on your behalf , for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ ;

translation.kha: U Jehoba u them kynsan ha ka met u kput , u da ïam , bad doh ïa u .
translation.en: And Joseph fell upon his father s face , and wept upon him , and kissed him .

translation.kha: Me tharai ba me kham bha’ ban ïa u Balaam , u khun jong u Sippor , u syiem Moab ? Um ju ïakhleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel . Hato u la ju ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa moi ?
translation.en: And now art thou any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab ? did he ever strive against Israel , or did he ever fight against them ,

translation.kha: U Iso u kylli , Kumno pat shngain kato ka kynhun kaba nga la ïakynduh ? Ka mut aïu kato ? U Jakob u jubab Ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong pa’ .
translation.en: And he said , What meanest thou by all this drove which I met ? And he said , These are to find grace in the sight of my lord .

translation.kha: U Isaïah u ïathuh ha u syiem ban buh ka jingtah ba la shna da ki soh Dumbur ha u tohjaw jong u , mala un sa jem .
translation.en: For Isaiah had said , Let them take a lump of figs , and lay it for a plaster upon the boil , and he shall recover .

translation.kha: U Trai un shah ïa ki briew ban shah synshar ha ki khynnah shynrang ki bym bapaw ïaw .
translation.en: And I will give children to be their princes , and babes shall rule over them .

translation.kha: U la leit peiñ pat sha ka nongbah Jesreel don ïohkhiah na ki jingshong jong u , bad u Asasaïah u la leit shata banbeiñ jngoh ïa u .
translation.en: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah , when he fought with Hazael king of Syria . And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel , because he was sick .

translation.kha: Nangta u tam ïa ka jaiñkup jong u Elisha kaba la hap na u , bad u leit phai bad ïeng harud ka Judah .
translation.en: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him , and went back , and stood by the bank of Jordan  ;

The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat , to wave it for a wave offering before the  Lord   ; and it shall be thine , and thy sons  with thee , by a statute for ever  ; as the  Lord  hath commanded .
translation.kha: Kin wallam ïa ka kjat-dien bad ïa ka shadem katba dang kñia ïa ka khleiñ kum ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai . Kine ki bynta ki long ki jong me bad jong ki khun jong me pateng la pateng , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon  ; and my servants shall be with thy servants : and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint : for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians .
translation.kha: Kumta phah ïa ki rangbah jong me sha Lebanon ban pynngat ïa ki dieng Kedar na ka bynta jong nga . Ki rangbah jong nga kin ïatreilang bad ki , bad ngan siew ïa ki rangbah jong me kat kaba me pynbeit . Kumba me tip bha , ki rangbah jong nga kim tip kumno ban pynngat ïa ki dieng kumba ki jong me ki tip .
Lada phi long uba jaipdeh , phyrnai ym ïoh da lei lei ïa katai kaba phi kwah ngab long hadien , hynrei lada phi trei minot , phin ïoh spah .
translation.en: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting : but the substance of a diligent man is precious .
When Mordecai perceived all that was done , Mordecai rent his clothes , and put on sackcloth with ashes , and went out into the midst of the city , and cried with a loud and a bitter cry  ;
translation.kha: Haba u Mordekai u tip ïa kata baroh ba la leh , u tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jinglyng-a bajur . Nangta u phong da ki jaiñ khain bad sleh ïa ka khlieh da u dpei , bad ïaid lyngba ïa ka nongbah , u da ïam lynñiar kthang , haduh ba un da poi ha ka jaka rung sha ka ïingsyiem .
U Jisu u dang ïaid lyngba katto katne ki lyngkha kew ha ka sner Sabbaton . Kaba ki synran jong u ki dang ïa-ïaid ryngkat bad u , ki dang ban khet ïa ki symboh kew .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day  ; and his disciples began , as they went , to pluck the ears of corn .

translation.kha: U Balei u thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , bad phim ha ban shemphang shuh ïa kaei kiba u leh ban ïa kaba phi sngewbit kumno ka jingim bathymmai ka sdang ha ka khop jong ka kynthei kaweh umkhriat .
translation.en: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit , nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child : even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all .

translation.kha: U la ainong ha lade” , Kumta kiei kiei ki long mynta , lada ki briew jong nga ki leit sha Jerusalem’ malu ban kñia ïa ki jingainguh sha U Tiras ha ka templ kaba don hangta , ngin pynkynriah ka jingnguh syiem na nga sha u Rehoboam u syiem ka Judah bad kmen sa pynpoh ïa nga .
translation.en: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the  Lord  at Jerusalem , then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord , even unto Rehoboam king of Judah , and they shall kill me , and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la pynhiar ïa u tyllai lem nabar u sisa ba la teh ha u , bad ki la shem ba ka um ka don kumba sawphew mitar ka jingjylliew ; khnam kato katne hadien ki la leh kumjuh malu ki la shem ba ka don laiphew mitar ka jingjylliew .
translation.en: And sounded , and found it twenty fathoms : and when they had gone a little further , they sounded again , and found it fifteen fathoms .

translation.kha: Bad ngan tynjuh ïa ka bniat kabu lai kaba dang lait im bad ngan pynkhuid ïa ki kumba phrang ïa ka rupa da ka ding . Ngan tynjuh ïa ki kumba la ju tynjuh ïa ka ksiar . Nangta kin ïaboi ha nga , bad kun jubab ïa ki . Ngan ïathuh ïa ki ba ki long ki brup jong per , bad kin phla ba por lama U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And I will bring the third part through the fire , and will refine them as silver is refined , and will try them as gold is tried : they shall call on my name , and I will hear them : I will say , It is my people : and they shall say , The  Lord  is my God .

translation.kha: Ngi phah ha ph , te , ïa u Judah bad u Silas , ki ban ïathuh ïa phi matlah ïa kijuh kiei kiei bakha ngi thoh .
translation.en: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas , who shall also tell you the same things by mouth .

But none of these things move me , neither count I my life dear unto myself , so that I might finish my course with joy , and the ministry , which I have received of the Lord Jesus , to testify the gospel of the grace of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ñiew ïa la ka jingim ba ka long ka bymdondor ei ei ïa nga ; nga kwah tang ban pyndep ïa ka jingtrei jong nga bad pyndep pura ïa ka kam kaba U Trai Jisu u la ai ha nga ban leh , kaba long ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka jingaiei jong U Blei .

Ka jingduwai u syiemsad bad ka jingjubab U Blei ïa ka , sad ka jingthoh shaphang ki pop kaba u la leh ha shuwa ba un kylla-kaba-mut — ka jingkiew kaba u la leh , ki bakwah mane beit thawsha bad ki durblei jong ka blei Asherah kaba u la thaw bad ki bleithaw kiba u la ma — baroh la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori jong ki Nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: His prayer also , and how God was entreated of him , and all his sin , and his trespass , and the places wherein he built high places , and set up groves and graven images , before he was humbled : behold , they are written among the sayings of the seers .

translation.kha: Hato phin ong . . .
translation.en: Would you say . . .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha ki briew jong u , To kup jaiñ khait badno to tyllun ha u dpei . To ïam sngewsih lem bad ki ummat kthang kamra phin ïam ïa u khun marwei , namar uta uba waiñ ban pynjot ïa phi un tur ïaleh kynsan .
translation.en: O daughter of my people , gird thee with sackcloth , and wallow thyself in ashes : make thee mourning , as for an only son , most bitter lamentation : for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jaboh ïa u , Me ong katkum . Hynrei nga ong ïa phi baïar : Naduh kane ka por phiah ïohi ïa U Khun U ibhabriew ba u da shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Bakhrawbor tam bad u da woh ha ki lyoh bneng !
translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Thou hast said : nevertheless I say unto you , Hereafter shall ye see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power , and coming in the clouds of heaven .

translation.kha: U shakri kum U Rangbah Lyngdoh ha ka Jaka naba Kyntang Tam , sier ka longsem , ha ka ïingjaiñ kaba shiah ïa kaba U Trai u la pynïeng , ym da u briew .
translation.en: A minister of the sanctuary , and of the true tabernacle , which the Lord pitched , and not man .

translation.kha: Ka la dei ban ïoh kynhun synrap , bad ha shu ba yn khah ïa ki , ki ïakhreh ïaksaid par ma ki ha ka khep jong ka . Ka ong , Balei kaba kum kane ka wan jia ha nga ? Kumba ka la leit kylla na U Trai ban ïoh jubab .
translation.en: And the children struggled together within her  ; and she said , If it be so , why am I thus ? And she went to enquire of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ngi la kmen Naaman jong u , ngi shaniah ha ka ktang bakhuid jong u .
translation.en: For our heart shall rejoice in him , because we have trusted in his holy name .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miet U Trai u ong ha u Jonathan ,
translation.en: And it came to pass that night , that the word of the  Lord  came unto Nathan , saying ,

translation.kha: U Abraham u la noh , ‘ Ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me ki don u Moses bad ki nongïathuhlypa ba-bang maham ïa ki ; ki hynmen ki to shynrang jong me ki dei ban shukor ïa kaei kaba ki ong .’
translation.en: Abraham saith unto him , They have Moses and the prophets  ; let them hear them .

translation.kha: Ha ka por shiteng sngi , ïa ka ri baroh kawei la tap da ka jingdum , kaba neh lai kynta .
translation.en: And when the sixth hour was come , there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour .

Wherein was written , It is reported among the heathen , and Gashmu saith it , that thou and the Jews think to rebel : for which cause thou buildest the wall , that thou mayest be their king , according to these words .
translation.kha: La thoh :  U Geshem u ong ïa nga ba ka don ka hamsaïa kaba ïaid kylleng hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kaba don marjan , ba ma phi bad ka jaitbynriew Jiw phi don jingthmu ban ïaleh pyrshah bad dei na kane ka daw balei ba phi la tei pat ïa ka kynroh . U ong ruh ba phi thmu ban pynlong ïa lade u syiem

translation.en: Then goeth he , and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself  ; and they enter in , and dwell there : and the last state of that man is worse than the first .
translation.kha: Nangta u mih bad wallam ïa ki hynñiew ngut kiwei pat ki mynsiem kiba kham sniew ban ïa u hi , bad ki wan bad shongsah hangta . Kumta haba ka la dep baroh , uta u briew un don ha ka jinglong ba kham sniew ban ïa kaba u la long ha kaba sdang .
bad salia hadien , ha kata ka jaka ba mih u tohjaw , ka ba-don ka jingat kaba leilieh ne ka dak kaba byrsaw-lieh , u dadien ban leit pyn-i ha u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising , or a bright spot , white , and somewhat reddish , and it be shewed to the priest  ;
And he brought the meat offering , and took an handful thereof , and burnt it upon the altar , beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning .
translation.kha: U kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam bad u shim shi kham u purew bad u thang ïa u halor ka duwan . ( Kane ka long nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba man ka sngi . )
Nga la pynlong ïa u , u jingïalam bad u nongai hukum ïa ki jaitbynriew ; bad lyntang jong u nga la pyn-i ha ki ïa ka bor jong nga .
translation.en: Behold , I have given him for a witness to the people , a leader and commander to the people .
As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely with a mighty hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with fury poured out , will I rule over you :
translation.kha: Kumba da shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im , nga maham ïa phi ba ha ka jingbitar jong nga ngan synshar halor jong phi da ka ksang ti kaba khlaiñ , da ka bor jong nga baroh .
Kumta ïa ki briew jong kaei ka juk yn pynshitom na ka boitha ka jingpynïap ïa baroh ki ïathuhlypa kiba la shah pynap naduh ka jingpynlong ïa ka pynrieh ,
translation.en: That the blood of all the prophets , which was shed from the foundation of the world , may be required of this generation  ;

And it came to pass on the seventh day , that they rose early about the dawning of the day , and compassed the city after the same manner seven times : only on that day they compassed the city seven times .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew ki la khie dang step phyrngab bad ki ïaid tawiar hynñiew sien ïa ka nongbah ha kajuh ka rukom — dei tang ha kane ka sngi ba ki ïaid tawiar ïa ka hynñiew sien .

translation.en: Beasts , and all cattle  ; creeping things , and flying fowl :
translation.kha: baroh ki mrad ba la pynjuh bad kiba ha khlaw , ki mrad bapar bad ki sim .
Ha kadei patiaw ka jingïohipaw na la ïohi ïa u briew uba don u ksai thew ha ka kti jong u .
translation.en: I lifted up mine eyes again , and looked , and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand .

translation.kha: U Paul sad u Ïoannis ki dang kren ha ki paidbah mynba katto katne nguid ki lyngdoh , u nongbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa ki nongap phira ka Templ , bad katto katne ngut ki Saddusi ki la wan nang .
translation.en: And as they spake unto the people , the priests , and the captain of the temple , and the Sadducees , came upon them ,
They lavish gold out of the bag , and weigh silver in the balance , and hire a goldsmith  ; and he maketh it a god : they fall down , yea , they worship .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki plied ïa la ki pla pisa bad ki theh shabar ïa ka ksiar ; ki thew ïa ka rupa ha ki tarajur . Ki ainong ïa u bania ban shna durblei ; nangta ki dem ngon bad mane ïa ka !
Ka dei ka durkhmat jongu phi hi kaba phalang ha ka um sad ka daym ka pyndum jong phi hi kaba phi Ïohi ha ka dohnud jong phi .
translation.en: As in water face answereth to face , so the heart of man to man .

translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha uta u paidbah , Hangne u hir uta u briew umbiah U Tharai u la jied . Ym don uba kum ma u hapdeng jong ngi . Baroh u paidbah u risa , To un im slem u syiem !
translation.en: And Samuel said to all the people , See ye him whom the  Lord  hath chosen , that there is none like him among all the people ? And all the people shouted , and said , God save the king .
And they shall answer and say , Our hands have not shed this blood , neither have our eyes seen it .
translation.kha: bad kin phla , ‘ Ym dei ma ngi kiba pynïap ïa uto u briew , bad ngim shym ïohi ruh mano ba la leh ïa kata ka kam .
To rwai ha U Trai ïa ka jingrwai bathymmai ! To rue ha U Trai , ko Phin ka pyrthei baroh !
translation.en: O sing unto the  Lord  a new song : sing unto the  Lord  , all the earth .

translation.kha: Ki nong Beth Shemesh ha kata ka por ki dang ïa-ot kew ha them , bad kynsan hajuh ki khmied ki la ïew ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ki dap da ka jingkmen haba ki ïohi ïa ka .
translation.en: And they of Beth–shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley : and they lifted up their eyes , and saw the ark , and rejoiced to see it .

translation.kha: naba U Trai un pyndep kloi kloi ïa ka jingainong ba-pura na ka bynta ka pyrthei .
translation.en: For he will finish the work , and cut it short in righteousness : because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Kane ka jingïakhih kam treikam ïa baroh , hynrei tang ha kito kaba U Blei u la ai ïa ka .
translation.en: But he said unto them ,  All men cannot receive this saying , save they to whom it is given .

translation.kha: Mynta kane ka dat Kaei Kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ïai-ong : Ha ka jingbitar jong sa ngan phiah ïa ka lawar bajur , u slap bajur , bad u phria ban pynjot ïa ka kynroh .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury  ; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger , and great hailstones in my fury to consume it .

translation.kha: Baroh ki kren shaphang katto-katne u long uba kohnguh bad baïaineh , hynrei Shua pyrshang ban wad ïa eit uno uba long kumta !
translation.en: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness : but a faithful man who can find ?
This heap be witness , and this pillar be witness , that I will not pass over this heap to thee , and that thou shalt not pass over this heap and this pillar unto me , for harm .
translation.kha: Kine baroh ar — ka kynton bad une u maw pynsah jingkynmaw ki long ki jingpynkynmaw . Ngan ym jam palat ïa kane ka kynton ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa me , bad me ruh men ym jam palat ïa kane ka kynton bad ïa une u maw pynsah kynmaw ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga .
Ken ka khia ha Meribah , ha kaba ki Israel ki la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa U Trai , bad ha kaba u la pynpaw ïa lade ba u long uba khuid .
translation.en: This is the water of Meribah  ; because the children of Israel strove with the  Lord  , and he was sanctified in them .
No man putteth a piece of new cloth unto an old garment , for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment , and the rent is made worse .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba syrdep ïa ka jaiñkup kaba rim da ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba thymmai , naba kata ka syrdep bathymmai kan ran bad kan pynlong ka thliew kaba kham heh ha ka jaiñkup .

translation.en: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in , and served the idols that his father served , and worshipped them :
translation.kha: U pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh u kpa jong u , bad u mane ïa ki bleithaw ba u kpa jong u , u la mane .

translation.en: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song  ; and they that wasted us required of us mirth , saying , Sing us one of the songs of Zion .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ringmraw ïa ngi ki ong ba ngin rwai ; ki ong ïa ngi ba ngin pynsngewbha ïa ki :  To rwai ha ngi ïa ka jingrwai shaphang ka Seïon .
barieh kin ïohi ba ma Ngin , U Trai , nga la thang ïa ka bad ba yn ym don mano Mano ba lah ngab pynlip ïa ka .
translation.en: And all flesh shall see that I the  Lord  have kindled it : it shall not be quenched .

translation.kha: Phi sngewtynnat ban pdiang jingïaroh uwei na ti pat , hynrei phim pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingïaroh na uta uba ma u hi u long U Blei ; kumno , te , phi lah ban ngeit ha nga ?
translation.en: How can ye believe , which receive honour one of another , and seek not the honour that cometh from God only ?

translation.kha: Ki rangbah Judah ki kylliang ïa ki , Balei phi wan tur ïaleh ïa ngi ? Ki jubab , Ngi wan ban jam koidi ïa u Samson malu ban leh ïa u bania u la leh ïa ngi .
translation.en: And the men of Judah said , Why are ye come up against us ? And they answered , To bind Samson are we come up , to do to him as he hath done to us .

translation.kha: u hi da lade un dih ïa ka waiñ ka jong U Blei , ka waiñ ka jingbitar shrah jong U , kaba u la theh noh ha ka kuna jong ka baroh ha ka khuri ka jingbitar jong U ! Baroh kiba kun ïa kane kin shah pynsaja ha ka ding bad ha u kyndok ha khmat ki angel bakhuid bad ha khmat U langbrot .
translation.en: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God , which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation  ; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels , and in the presence of the Lamb :

translation.kha: U ong ha ki , To long kiba kut jingmut pynlang bakha sngewskhem , bad wat sheptieng ïa u patsha ki nong Assyria jlan ïa ka kynhun shiphew kambah u ïalam . Ngin kein kham bun ka tam ha ka liang jong ngi ban ïa kaba u don ha ka liang jong u .
translation.en: Be strong and courageous , be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria , nor for all the multitude that is with him : for there be more with us than with him :

translation.kha: Kumba u nongap langbrot u rim khia ban sumar ïa la ki langbrot , ki rangbah balang ruh ki ïapyrshang ban tip ïa uwei pa ïohi i dkhot ka balang .
translation.en: Just as a shepherd diligently cares for each one of his sheep , the elders try to get to know every member of the congregation individually . —Proverbs 27 :23 .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la noh ruh ha ki briew , Haba phi ïohi ïa u lyoh ba u wan mih ha ka phang sepngi , hangta hi pa’ ong ba kan slap — bad ka long kumta .
translation.en: And he said also to the people ,  When ye see a cloud rise out of the west , straightway ye say , There cometh a shower  ; and so it is .

translation.kha: U Jeshua , u Libni , lem bad ki khun shynrong bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u bad u Kemuel bad ki khun shynrang jong u ( na ka kur Hodabaïah ) , ki la ïasnohkti lang! ha kaba khmih ïa ka jingtei biang ïa ka Templ . ( Ïa ki la ïarap da ki Lebi jong ka mana Hadien . )
translation.en: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren , Kadmiel and his sons , the sons of Judah , together , to set forward the workmen in the house of God : the sons of Henadad , with their sons and their brethren the Levites .
Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city .
translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la sngewsih haba nga ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ki kynthei jong ka nongbah .
U Trai u la ong ha sa .
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,

translation.kha: Hynrei por la buk bad kiwei pat ki kam , kumta uta u briew u lait noh . U symboh u jubab , phiah la pynbna hi ïa ka rai , bad phiah khap siew ïa ka kuna .
translation.en: And as thy servant was busy here and there , he was gone . And the king of Israel said unto him , So shall thy judgment be  ; thyself hast decided it .

translation.kha: u la kylli ïa u Ariokh balei ba u syiem u la pynmih kumno kane ka hukum kaba eh . Kumta u Ariokh u la ïathuh ïa u Hanniel ïa kaei kaba la haw jhieh .
translation.en: He answered and said to Arioch the king s captain , Why is the decree so hasty from the king ? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel .

translation.kha: Ha ka khlur bashisha , ka Khubor Babha , ka la wan nyngkong ha phi , phi! la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingmynjur ba ka tyrwa . Kumne ïa ka jingneh bad ka jingieit jong phi la pynshong nongrep ha kaei kaban phi kyrmen , ïa kaba la bsuh sumar na ka bynta jong phi ha bneng .
translation.en: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven , whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel ;
Yet hath he not root in himself , but dureth for a while : for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word , by and by he is offended .
translation.kha: Hynrei kam shym ngam jylliew hapoh jong ki , bad kim shym neh slem . Kumta haba ka jingjynjar lane ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ ka wan namar ka khubor , ki iehnoh shisyndon .

translation.en: And he said unto him , If thy presence go not with me , carry us not up hence .
translation.kha: U Moses u la jubab ,  Lada me hi men ym leit ryngkat bad ngi , wat ai ba ngin mihnoh na kane ka jaka .
Khynñiuh me — me pyntriem ïa ar da ki jingphohsniew ; me phah ha nga da ki jingïohipaw bad ki jingphohsniew kynsha
translation.en: Then thou scarest me with dreams , and terrifiest me through visions :

translation.kha: Ynda ita u shakri u la lap ïa ki , u la krenbeiñ ha ki ïa kijuh ki kiei .
translation.en: And he overtook them , and he spake unto them these same words .
So he departed from Elisha , and came to his master  ; who said to him , What said Elisha to thee ? And he answered , He told me that thou shouldest surely recover .
translation.kha: U Hasael u leit phai sha u Benhadad , uba kylli ïa u ,  U Elisha u ong kumno ?  U Hasael u jubab ,  U ong ha nga ba phin sa koit sa khiah bha pat .
Haba —kata Kan jia , ngan pynlong ïa ki paid Eliel kiba khlaw bad ngan shah ïa me , ko Esekiel , ban klun ha kaweh baroh kin ïohsngew ïa me , khnang ba kin tip ba nga long U Tiras .
translation.en: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth , and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
And he said unto me , Unto two thousand and three hundred days  ; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa uta uwei pat u angel ba u jubab ,  Kan ïailong haduh shi hajar shispah sanphew sngi , ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia janmiet bad mynstep yn ym ai . Hadien kata yn sa pynbha pat ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: And other fell on good ground , and sprang up , and bare fruit an hundredfold .  And when he had said these things , he cried ,  He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
translation.kha: Bad katto katne ki symbai ki la hap ha ka khyndew babha ; ki jingthung ki la san bad ki la pynmih symboh , da ki spah symboh uwei uwei .  Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !

translation.en: For the Father judgeth no man , but hath committed all judgment unto the Son :
translation.kha: Lymne U Kpa da lade hi um bishar ïano ïano . U la ai ha la U Khun ïa ka hok baroh ban bishar , ba baroh kin burom ïa U Khun kumba ki burom ïa U Kpa .
Ki shithi ki ong : pynbna ïa ka sngi ban shahjingit , khot lang ïa ki paidbah baroh nabar ai ïa u Naboth ka jaka kaba donburom .
translation.en: And she wrote in the letters , saying , Proclaim a fast , and set Naboth on high among the people :

translation.kha: U Blei un buh khapngiah ïa ki skhem kum ki koidi ha ka thliew . Un set ïa ki ha ka ïingbyndi haduh ka por jong ka jingpynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: And they shall be gathered together , as prisoners are gathered in the pit , and shall be shut up in the prison , and after many days shall they be visited .
In one house shall it be eaten  ; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house  ; neither shall ye break a bone thereof .
translation.kha: Dei ban bam ïa ka jingbam baroh hapoh ka ïing ha kaba la khreh ïa ka ; phim bit ban rah ïa ka shabar ; bad ym dei ban pynkheiñ wat tang kawei ruh ka shyieng jong u mrad .
U Joseph u jubab , Lada phim don peiñ shuh , wallam ïa ki jingri jong phi ; te ngan ïapli ïa ka jingbah bad kita ki jingri .
translation.en: And Joseph said , Give your cattle  ; and I will give you for your cattle , if money fail .

translation.kha: To ïai-ong ïa Kinah ki kti ha ka jingjrong ïa U Tharai , ma phi baroh ïa kiba u la pynim .
translation.en: Let the redeemed of the  Lord  say so , whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy  ;

translation.kha: Kumta ka ong ha u , Kumno phi lah ban ong ba phi ieit ïa nga haba phim mut kumno ? Phi pynlong ka bieit ïa nga la na sien , bad phim pat shym la ïathuh satia ha nga kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi kaba khlaiñbor bha .
translation.en: And she said unto him , How canst thou say , I love thee , when thine heart is not with me ? thou hast mocked me these three times , and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth .

translation.kha: Dang mynstep phyrngab u Joshua u la khie bad lumlang ïa ki shipai . Nangta ma u bad ki nongïalam jongngi ki Israel ki la ïalam ïa ki sha Ai .
translation.en: And Joshua rose up early in the morning , and numbered the people , and went up , he and the elders of Israel , before the people to Ai .
Then I said , I have laboured in vain , I have spent my strength for nought , and in vain : yet surely my judgment is with the  Lord  , and my work with my God .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Nga la trei , hynrei katno ka long kaba duh jingkyrmen ! Nga la pyndonkam ïa la ka jingkhlaiñ , hynrei ym lah ban pyndep ei ei .  Pynban nga lah ban shaniah ha U  Trai ban kyrshan na ka bynta jong nga ; un ai bainong ïa nga ïa kaei kaba nga leh .
kum ki shakri kiba ap khmih ïa u kyndiah jong ki ban wan phai pat na ka jingkhawai shongkurim . Haba u wan bad u tied jingkhang , mar kumta hi , kin plie ïa ka jingthang na ka bynta jngai u .
translation.en: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord , when he will return from the wedding  ; that when he cometh and knocketh , they may open unto him immediately .

translation.kha: Katba u Paul u dang ap ha Athens ïa u Silas bad u Timothi , u sngew shitom jingmut shikatdei eh haba u la ïohi ba ka nongbah ka shlei da ki bleithaw .
translation.en: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens , his spirit was stirred in him , when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry .

translation.kha: Hato ine u dei u briew uba la pynjot ïa ki nongbah malu pynkylla ïa ka pyrthei sha ka ri shyiap ? Hato une u dei u briew u bym ju jingpyllaitluid ïa ki koidi jong u lane shah ïa ki ban leit sha ïing ?’
translation.en: That made the world as a wilderness , and destroyed the cities thereof  ; that opened not the house of his prisoners ?

translation.kha: Kane ka dei kadei ka ban jia ha baroh ki jaitbynriew kylleng ka pyrthei . ka long kum ka jingkam jong ka jingtah , haba ïa ki soh Olib la dep tied pyndap na Uei pa uwei u dieng bad ba ïa ki sohwaiñ bakhatduh la kheit na ki tieng sohwaiñ .
translation.en: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people , there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree , and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done .

translation.kha: U la shongkurim ïa ka , bad ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u , ïa babha u la khot kyrteng u Er .
translation.en: And she conceived , and bare a son  ; and he called his name Er .
Then Jonathan said to David , To morrow is the new moon : and thou shalt be missed , because thy seat will be empty .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jonathan u ong ha u ,  Naba lashai ka dei ka jingkhawai mih bnai thymmai , ka jingbymdon jong phi kan paw shai lada phim don ha jingïabam .

translation.en: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold  ; for it is their perpetual possession .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki jaka phlang kiba don sawdong ki shnong jong kito kiba na ka jait Lebi , ym dei ban die ïa ki , namar ki long ka hok kynti jong ki shi junom .
Nangta ki la shim ïa u Jonah bad bret ïa u sha ka Duriaw , bad ka la long jai jai ha ka shikhyllipmat .
translation.en: So they took up Jonah , and cast him forth into the sea : and the sea ceased from her raging .

translation.kha: Kum u sing Uba wan mih na ki khleh barben katba don shi lyndum ka rud Jordan haduh ka jaka phlang jingbyrngem , ma to , U thri , ngan wan bad ngan pynlong ïa ki nongïeng Babilonia ban phet krad kynsan na ka nongbah jong ki . Te u nongïalam uba nga jied un synshar ïa ka hima . Mano ban ïanujor bad nga ? Uno uba nud ban ïan kob ïa nga ? Uei u nongsynshar suba lah shun ïeng pyrshah ïa na ?
translation.en: Behold , he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong : but I will make them suddenly run away from her : and who is a chosen man , that I may appoint over her ? for who is like me ? and who will appoint me the time ? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me ?
In those days , and in that time , saith the  Lord  , the children of Israel shall come , they and the children of Judah together , going and weeping : they shall go , and seek the  Lord  their God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Haba ka por ka poi , ki paid Israel bad Judah kin wan ïa-ïam , kin wad ïa nga , U Blei jong ki .
Beor na ki , ki la kada ïa la ki khlieh bad ki la hakpoh ïa la ki ñiuhtmoh . Baroh ki la pynmong ïa la ki kti , bad uwei pa uwei u phong ïa ki jaiñsem khain .
translation.en: For every head shall be bald , and every beard clipped : upon all the hands shall be cuttings , and upon the loins sackcloth .

translation.kha: To sngewkynjah , ko mynnin jong nga , namar U Trai u la lehbha ïa nga .
translation.en: Return unto thy rest , O my soul  ; for the  Lord  hath dealt bountifully with thee .

translation.kha: Kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang hangta ha ka duwan U Trai . Khynnah mad ïa kita ki jingainguh na kiba phi bam ïa ka soh jong ki , bad theh ïa ka snam jong ki ha ka duwan .
translation.en: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings , the flesh and the blood , upon the altar of the  Lord  thy God : and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the  Lord  thy God , and thou shalt eat the flesh .

Because ye have said , We have made a covenant with death , and with hell are we at agreement  ; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through , it shall not come unto us : for we have made lies our refuge , and under falsehood have we hid ourselves :
translation.kha: Phi sarong ba phi la pynlong ïa ka jingïateh bad ka jingïap bad poi sha ka jingïakut bad ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Phi sngewthikna ba phin lait na ka jingjot haba kan wan , namar phi shaniah ha ki jinglamler bad ki jingshukor ban pyllait ïa phi .

A katno ka longsyiem kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nongrit lyngkot kiba matsohlah ! Phi sakhi , ‘ “lada uno uno u smai da ka Templ , ïa u ym shym la teh da ka jingsmai jong u ; hawei lada u smai da ka ksiar hajuh ka Templ , u un-long uba la shah teh .’
translation.en: Woe unto you , ye blind guides , which say , Whosoever shall swear by the temple , it is nothing  ; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple , he is a debtor !

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa U Khunlangbrot uba ïeng phangpdeng ka khet , ïa kaba la ker sawdong da ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im bad ki nongsharai balang . U Khunlangbrot u la paw ba u la shah pynïap . U don hynñiew tylli ki reng badno hynñiew tyrnem ki khmat , kiba long ki bahynñiew ki mynsiem U Blei ïa Ibbah la phah sha kylleng ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And I beheld , and , lo , in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts , and in the midst of the elders , stood a Lamb as it had been slain , having seven horns and seven eyes , which are the seven Spirits of God sent forth into all the earth .

translation.kha: Kumno u nud don kren Kumne ? Kane ka dei ka jingkheiñbriew Blei’ ! Dei tang U Bel hi marwei uba eh ban map ïa ki pop !
translation.en: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies ? who can forgive sins but God only ?

translation.kha: Hobah u briew uba hok u keiñ noh na kaba leh ïa kaba bha bad u sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew , un ïa-ïap na ka bynta kata .
translation.en: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , he shall even die thereby .

But at the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose to place his name in , there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even , at the going down of the sun , at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kñia ïa ki jingainguh na ka bynta ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha kata ka jaka mane Blei ba U  Trai  un jied — ym hawei pat ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ai ha phi . Leh ïa kata ha ka por sep sngi , kaba ïadei bad ka por ba phi mih na Ijipt .
Tahan phin shong , nga noh ïa phi , tad haduh ba phin da sieb dep ïa ka pisa bakhatduh jong ka jingshahdaiñ kuna .
translation.en: Verily I say unto thee , Thou shalt by no means come out thence , till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing .

translation.kha: u la khot ïa la u shakri , bad u Ong , Beh noh ïa Kane ka bynriew na iitkhmat Jong nga ! Pynmih ïa ka shabar Bad khang ïa ka jingkha !
translation.en: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him , and said , Put now this woman out from me , and bolt the door after her .
And he stripped off his clothes also , and prophesied before Samuel in like manner , and lay down naked all that day and all that night . Wherefore they say , Is Saul also among the prophets ?
translation.kha: U loit noh ïa la ki jaiñ bad u shad bad risa ha khmat u Samuel , bad u thiah lyngkhuit ha kata ka sngi baroh shi sngi bad ha kata ka miet baroh shi miet . ( Ha kane ka rukom la mih ka jingong ,  Hato wat u Saul ruh u la kylla long u nongïathuhlypa ?  )
Ki bymman ki phet ha sem ne ba Beh ïa ki , isynei u briew uba hok u shlur kum u song .
translation.en: The wicked flee when no man pursueth : but the righteous are bold as a lion .

translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u jingsngewsih ïa kaei kaban jia , u phah ïa u Joab ryngkat bad ka kynoi shipai baroh kawei .
translation.en: And when David heard of it , he sent Joab , and all the host of the mighty men .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi , hynrei kiei shemphang ïa kaei kaba u la mut .
translation.en: This parable spake Jesus unto them : but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them .

translation.kha: Hib ki riewngeit ki la ïohsngew ïa kata , baroh ki la ïasoh lang ha ka jingduwai sha U Blei : Ko Kynrad bad ko Nongthaw ïa ka bneng , ka pyrthei , bad ka duriaw , bad ïa bhor kaba don ha ki !
translation.en: And when they heard that , they lifted up their voice to God with one accord , and said , Lord , thou art God , which hast made heaven , and earth , and the sea , and all that in them is :

And when Gideon was come , behold , there was a man that told a dream unto his fellow , and said , Behold , I dreamed a dream , and , lo , a cake of barley bread tumbled into the host of Midian , and came unto a tent , and smote it that it fell , and overturned it , that the tent lay along .
translation.kha: Haba u Gideon u la poi , u la ïohsngew ïa uwei u briew uba ïathuh ha la u paralok shaphang ka jingphohsniew . U ong ,  Nga phohsniew ba uwei u kpu barli u tyllun sha ka jaka sher dara jong ngi bad u tyngkhuh ïa ka dara . Ka dara ka la kyllon bad ka don lyngktar ha madan .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee .
translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ïa u syiem Ijipt ,  Men mad ïa ka waitlam u syiem Babilon .

translation.en: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot , upon the blood of the trespass offering :
translation.kha: Un shim ruh khyndiat ka umphniang na la ka sla ti bad khyndiat ka snam jong u khunlangbrot bad un tah ha ka shkor kamon , ka  tikmie kamon , bad ka  jatkmie kamon jong uta u briew ïa uba yn pynkhuid .

Haba ki la leit ei , u Ahimaas bad u Jonathan ki wan mih na kata ka shok bad ki la leit ïathuh ha u Syiem Dabid . Ki la ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kob u Ahithophel u la pynkhreh pyrshah ïa u bad ong , To pynkloi bad jam ïa ka wah .
translation.en: And it came to pass , after they were departed , that they came up out of the well , and went and told king David , and said unto David , Arise , and pass quickly over the water : for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you .
And the messenger said unto David , Surely the men prevailed against us , and came out unto us into the field , and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Ki nongshun jong ngi ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa ngi , bad ki la wan mih shabar na kata ka nongbah ban ïaleh ïa ngi ha madan , hynrei ngi beh krad biang ïa ki sha ka khyrdop shnong .
U Jisu u la ino ha ka sur kaba jam , Uno uno uba jingieit ha nga u ngeit ym tang ha nga hynrei ruh ha uta uba la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: Jesus cried and said ,  He that believeth on me , believeth not on me , but on him that sent me .

translation.kha: Katto katne ki rangbah na ka nongbah Tyros ki shong ki sah ha Jerusalem , malade ki wanpaw doh dara baroh ki jaiñjot mar sha ka nongbah ban die ha ki briew jong ngi ha ka sngew Sabbaton .
translation.en: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein , which brought fish , and all manner of ware , and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah , and in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ho-oid ki rangbah jong ka Memphis bad ka Tahpanhes ki la pynbeit ïa ka shynrong khlieh jong u .
translation.en: Also the children of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of thy head .

translation.kha: U la leit phai pat sha ka nongbah Jesreel ban jhieh na ki jingsngem jong u , bad u Ahasaïah u la leit shata ban jngoh ïa u .
translation.en: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah , when he fought with Hazael king of Syria . And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel , because he was sick .

translation.kha: U Trai’ U Blei u la ong ha nga , Ko Jeremaïah , ïathuh ïa ki paid Israel ba ïa Uei pa uwei u khra buh wai dei ban pyndap da ka waiñ . Kin jubab ba ki tip ba ïa uwei pa eiei u khra buhai waiñ dei ba pyndap da ka saiñ .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word  ; Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Every bottle shall be filled with wine : and they shall say unto thee , Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine ?

translation.kha: Ngim dadien ban leh ïa kane ha ka por Ka Jingïakajia Niam , ki la ong , lympat kumta ki paidbah ki lah ban khih jingjur .
translation.en: But they said , Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar of the people .

translation.kha: U syiem Shelomoth u don seh hajar tylli ki sem khuslai na ka bynta ki kali ïapom bad ki kulai jong u , bad u don khat-ar hajar tylli ki kulai thma . Katto katne na ki u buh ha Jerusalem Bad ïa kiba sah u buh ha kiwei pat ki nongbet .
translation.en: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen  ; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities , and with the king at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Pynban U Trai u la jingïashoh ïa ki haba ki kyang , dara u khmih ïa ki jingjynjar jong ki .
translation.en: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction , when he heard their cry :

translation.kha: U daiñ duwai bad ha ka jingïohipaw u la ïohi ïa u briew suba ktung u Ananias ba u Wan rung dara buhai ïa la ki kti ha u , khnang ba un oh imat pat .
translation.en: And hath seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in , and putting his hand on him , that he might receive his sight .

And he said , Certainly I will be with thee  ; and this shall be a token unto thee , that I have sent thee : When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt , ye shall serve God upon this mountain .
translation.kha: U Blei u jubab ,  Ngan long lem bad me , bad haba me ïalam noh ïa ki briew jong nga na Ijipt , phin ïamane ïa nga ha une u lum . Kata kan long ka jingpynshisha ba nga la phah ïa me .

translation.en: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways : and a good man shall be satisfied from himself .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew kin ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban ïoh . Ki briew kiba bha kin ïoh bainong na ka bynta ki kam jong ki .
Ki la sangeh ban mane ïa U Trai Bad ki la sakhrai ïa ki beit Baal bad Astarte .
translation.en: And they forsook the  Lord  , and served Baal and Ashtoreth .
And at Taberah , and at Massah , and at Kibroth–hattaavah , ye provoked the  Lord  to wrath .
translation.kha: Phi la pynbitar ruh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi mynba phi don ha Taberah , ha Massah , bad ha Kibroth Hattaabah .

U Trai Nongsynshar Badonbor Balah u la ai kane ka jingmaham bakyntang : Ngin isih ïa ka jingshon ki briew’ ka Israel ; nga ñiewbeiñ ïa ki ïohnang pynkie dulan jong ki . Teng ai ïa ka nongbah bakhraw bad baroh bakha don ha ka , ha u nongïeng .
translation.en: The Lord  God  hath sworn by himself , saith the  Lord  the God of hosts , I abhor the excellency of Jacob , and hate his palaces : therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein .

translation.kha: Ka um ka khroh ïa ki mawsiang , bad u thup uba jur un rong noh! ïa ka khyndew ; kumta me pynduh ïa ka jingkmen junom .
translation.en: The waters wear the stones : thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth  ; and thou destroyest the hope of man .
Haran , and Canneh , and Eden , the merchants of Sheba , Asshur , and Chilmad , were thy merchants .
translation.kha: Ki nongbah ka Haran , Kanneh , bad Eden , ki nongkhaïi ka Sheba , ki nongbah ka Asshur bad Khilmad — baroh ki ïakhaïi pateng bad pha .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The labour of Egypt , and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans , men of stature , shall come over unto thee , and they shall be thine : they shall come after thee  ; in chains they shall come over , and they shall fall down unto thee , they shall make supplication unto thee , saying , Surely God is in thee  ; and there is none else , there is no God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ki Israel ,  Ka spah ki Ijipt bad ki Sudan kan long ka jong phi , bad ki rangbah bajrong jong ka Seba kin long ki mraw jong phi ; kin bud ïa phi ha ki kynjri . Kin dem ngon ha phi bad kin phla , ‘ U Blei u don ryngkat bad phi — tang ma u , u long U Blei .
Ha kata ka por U Josis u la ong , Ko Kpa , U Trai ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ! Nga ainguh ïa me namar ba me la pyn-i ha ki bymstad ïa kaei katba me la buhrieh na kiba stad bad kiba la ïoh jinghikai .
translation.en: At that time Jesus answered and said ,  I thank thee , O Father , Lord of heaven and earth , because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent , and hast revealed them unto babes .

translation.kha: U la ïohi na jngai ïa u dieng Dumbur ba la tap da ki shla , kumta u la leit ban peit la u lah ban shem ki soh ha u . Hynrei haba u la wei shai uta u dieng , u la shem tang ki sla , namar kam pat dei ka por ban ñiah soh .
translation.en: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves , he came , if haply he might find any thing thereon : and when he came to it , he found nothing but leaves  ; for the time of figs was not yet .

translation.kha: ) . Nangta u Paul u thoh kham sharai shu ïa kane ka pynphieng . Baroh ki jaitbynriew , ki Jiw Bad ki Jentil , ki donkam ban don ka jinglehhok bad U Blei , ibha baroh ki don hapoh ka bor jyllang ka pop . Ka jinglonghok ki briew bad U Blei ka long lymbung ka jingngeit ha U Jisu Khrist . Nangta u pyllew u batai ïa ka jingim bathymmai ha U Khrist kaba mih na kane ka jingïadei batymmen mala U Blei . Uba jingkit u don ka jingïasuk bad U Balei nabar ïa u la pyllait da U Mynsiem jong U Blei na ka leh jong ka pop bad ka jingïap . Ha ki lynñiar
translation.en: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks , and laid them on the fire , there came a viper out of the heat , and fastened on his hand .

translation.kha: U Jakob u la mihnoh na Beersheba mala u leit shaphang Haran .
translation.en: And Jacob went out from Beer–sheba , and went toward Haran .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la ai ruh ïa ki tuh pynkhreh naba ïadei bad ki jingpynbeit rynïeng ïa ki lyngdoh sad ki Lebi , bad pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki , ban trei ïa ki kam jongu ka Templ bad ban sumar ïa baroh ki khiew ki pliang jong ka Templ .
translation.en: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites , and for all the work of the service of the house of the  Lord  , and for all the vessels of service in the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nongthaw u leit tur ïaleit ïa ki briew kiba shong ha Debir . ( Ïa kane ka nongbah la ju khot ka Kiriath Sepher . )
translation.en: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir : and the name of Debir before was Kirjath–sepher .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ka hukum , bad kine wan biang sha kane ka nongbah . kin tur ïaleh ïa ka , kin kurup ïa ka , bad thang duh ïa ka . Ngan pynlong ïa ki shnong ka Judah ba kin Long kum ka ri shyiap ha kaba yn ym ba-don mano mano ban shong ban sah ha ka . Ma at , U Terah , nga la kren .
translation.en: Behold , I will command , saith the  Lord  , and cause them to return to this city  ; and they shall fight against it , and take it , and burn it with fire : and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation without an inhabitant .

translation.kha: Un kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga , pynlang len pynshitom ïa uno ine u bymsngewnguh ïa u .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name , I will require it of him .

translation.kha: To ai ba U Blei ibha U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Grace to you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Lada a uno u leh pop khlem tip da kaba u pynkheiñ ïa kano kano ka hukum U Trai , u long uba la rim bad u daiñ ba ïoh ïa ka bainong .
translation.en: And if a soul sin , and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the  Lord   ; though he wist it not , yet is he guilty , and shall bear his iniquity .

translation.kha: Hynrei “lada wanrah waiñ tyngkan khyndiat na ka snam shabi ka ïingjah bad pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba lehniam ban ïohmap ïa ki pop , ïa u mrad ym dei ban bam ; dei ban thang lut khoit ïa u .
translation.en: And no sin offering , whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place , shall be eaten : it shall be burnt in the fire .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na ine , u la ïohpdiang ïa ka jingai bakyrpang kat kum ka jingjaw ïa katei kaba U kyrshut u la ai .
translation.en: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ .

translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud , ha ka por kñia ba man ka step , ka um ka la wan tuid na ka phlang Emim , bad ka la pynpyut ïa ka mawdong .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , when the meat offering was offered , that , behold , there came water by the way of Edom , and the country was filled with water .

translation.kha: Wat pynphriang lamler shaphang jongno jrong , bad haba uno Une u sdang don ha ka jingbishar namar la ka jingim , kren pynsep ïada ka jingphla jong phi kan long jingïarap ïa u . Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people : neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Pynïap ïa baroh ki shynrang , mala ïa kawei pa kawei ka kynthei ka bym dei shuh ka theisotti .
translation.en: And this is the thing that ye shall do , Ye shall utterly destroy every male , and every woman that hath lain by man .

translation.kha: Haba U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait noh ïa ka jingpynkut kaba hynñiew , ka la don ka jingsngap jar ha bneng kumba sangeh kynta .
translation.en: And when he had opened the seventh seal , there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour .

translation.kha: Kumno re Kumno pat , u shipai Syria u siaw ïa u khnam uba dei ïa u syiem Ahab sohpdung ka jaka daitbuid ïa ka jingkieng atiar jongno u . Nga la mynsiem ! u pyrta shad u nongñiah ka kai ïapom jong u . Phai noh mala phet noh na ka thma !
translation.en: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture , and smote the king of Israel between the joints of the harness : therefore he said to his chariot man , Turn thine hand , that thou mayest carry me out of the host  ; for I am wounded .
Which were a grief of mind unto Isaac and to Rebekah .
translation.kha: Kine ki la pynkthang mynsiem ïa u Isaak bad ïa ka Rebekka .
U Lasaros u la mihnoh , ïa ki ktha dara ki kjat jong u la kyllaiñ da ki jaiñsop ïa kiba ïan , bad da ka jaiñ la teh ïa ka khmat jong u . To law noh na u , U Jisu u la ong ha ki , bad ai ba un ïawad .
translation.en: And he that was dead came forth , bound hand and foot with graveclothes : and his face was bound about with a napkin . Jesus saith unto them ,  Loose him , and let him go .
Thou , O king , sawest , and behold a great image . This great image , whose brightness was excellent , stood before thee  ; and the form thereof was terrible .
translation.kha: Ko Syiem Kynrad , ha ka jingïohipaw jong phi , phi la ïohi ba la ïeng ha khmat jong phi ka durbriew bakhraw , kaba phyrnai bad thaba , bad kaba ishyrkhei ban khmih .
sah” ïa u Joshua , bad pynshlur ïa u , naba un ïalam ïa u paidbah shatai sha shiliang ban ïakyndit ïa kata ka ri kaba me ïor .’
translation.en: But charge Joshua , and encourage him , and strengthen him : for he shall go over before this people , and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see .

translation.kha: Ki biria kiba bieit kin nang ban sngewthuh , bad kito uba khñium borabor kin kmen ban ïoh jinghikai .
translation.en: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding , and they that murmured shall learn doctrine .

translation.kha: Haba ki ber ïa ka slipar , keiñ ïoh ot ïa ka erlangthari ! U kew baroh shi pynthor u bym pat ih un ym lah ban pynmihpat kpu . Hynrei wat “lada u pynmih ruh , ki nongwei kin bameh ei ïa u .
translation.en: For they have sown the wind , and they shall reap the whirlwind : it hath no stalk : the bud shall yield no meal : if so be it yield , the strangers shall swallow it up .

translation.kha: U briew umbiah jaipdeh u long uba sniew kumto uno uno uba pynjot .
translation.en: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster .

translation.kha: te ïa ka kyrteng jong me yn ïai kynmaw ha ka kotbah jong nga bad hapdeng ki briew jyllang nga kham slem ngab ïa kaba me don ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei . Yn ym klet ïa me lano lane ruh .
translation.en: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters : I will give them an everlasting name , that shall not be cut off .

translation.kha: U Trai u hukum ïa u Moses ban ong ha ki Israel ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: Haba u Elijah u la ïohsngew ïa ka , u tap ïa la ka khmut da la ka barandi bad u leit ngab ïeng ha khmat —kata ka krem . Ka sur kaba kren ha u , Elijah , me leh aïu hangne ?
translation.en: And it was so , when Elijah heard it , that he wrapped his face in his mantle , and went out , and stood in the entering in of the cave . And , behold , there came a voice unto him , and said , What doest thou here , Elijah ?

translation.kha: “Wat mynta hi u dang rieh ha kawei na ki krem lane ha kawei pait ka jaka . Hamar ba u dabi u tun ïajah ïa ki rangbah jong phi , kato umbiah ïohsngew ïa kata un ong ba ki rangbah jrong phi ki la shahjop .
translation.en: Behold , he is hid now in some pit , or in some other place : and it will come to pass , when some of them be overthrown at the first , that whosoever heareth it will say , There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom .
Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: kiba ka kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ha ka jingshakri ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: And if so be that he find it , verily I say unto you , he rejoiceth more of that sheep , than of the ninety and nine which went not astray .
translation.kha: Haba u shem ïa ka , nga ong ha phi , u kham kmen ïa kane kawei ka langbrot ban ïa ki khyndaiphew khyndai tylli ki bym shym la jah .
Hynrei ngi pat ngi dang ïai shakri ïa U Trai U Blei jong ngi dara ngim shym pat iehnoh ïa u . Ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ki pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki , bad ki Lebi ki ïarap lem ïa ki .
translation.en: But as for us , the  Lord  is our God , and we have not forsaken him  ; and the priests , which minister unto the  Lord  , are the sons of Aaron , and the Levites wait upon their business :

translation.kha: Jeroboam , ngan pynlong ïa me u syiem ki Israel , bad men synshar ïa ka jaka baroh kat ka me kwah .
translation.en: And I will take thee , and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth , and shalt be king over Israel .
So Abner came to David to Hebron , and twenty men with him . And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast .
translation.kha: Haba u Abner u wan sha u Dabid ha Hebron ryngkat bad arphew ngut ki rangbah , u Dabid u pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta jong ki .
pynlang u ïalam ïa ki sha Baal ha Judas khnang baneh wallam nangta ïa ka Synreit ka Jutang U Blei , kaba don ïa ka kyrteng U Trai bymdonbor Baroh , uba ka khet jong u ka long halor ki Kherub .
translation.en: And David arose , and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah , to bring up from thence the ark of God , whose name is called by the name of the  Lord  of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims .
And they took up Asahel , and buried him in the sepulchre of his father , which was in Beth–lehem . And Joab and his men went all night , and they came to Hebron at break of day .
translation.kha: U Joab bad ki rangbah jong u ki la shim ïa ka met jong u Asahel bad ki la tep ïa ka ha ka jingtep ka longïing jong u ha Bethlehem . Nangta ki la ïaid baroh shi miet , bad ha ka por kynjat shai ki la wan poi biang ha Hebron .
Katba ki kai thied kew , u Joseph u mluh ïa ka pisa bad u otsher ai ïa ki shata ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , for the corn which they bought : and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh s house .

translation.kha: Ki sngi ki la poi , ong U Trai , haba u kew un san sti ban ïa kaba lah ban ot , badno ki sohwaiñ kin san stet ban ïa ka waiñ ba lah ban shna . Ki lehbha ken jaw da ka waiñ kaba thiang , bad ki lumrit kin tuid da ka .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that the plowman shall overtake the reaper , and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed  ; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine , and all the hills shall melt .

translation.kha: U la Jobab ïa ki nonglamktien jong u Ïoannis , Kiwei leit noh bad ïathuh ïa u —Ïoannis ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohi bad ïohsngew : Ibbah matlah ki lah ban ïoh , kiba dkhat ki lah ban ïaid , kito kiba pang ñiangthohlieh ki la long khuid , kiba kyllum ki lah ba ïohsngew , ïa kiba ïarap pynim pat , bad ïa ka Khubor Babha la ïalap ha kiba duk .
translation.en: Then Jesus answering said unto them ,  Go your way , and tell John what things ye have seen and heard  ; how that the blind see , the lame walk , the lepers are cleansed , the deaf hear , the dead are raised , to the poor the gospel is preached .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un sping ruh khyndiat ka umphniang Ophel bad un theh ïa ka ha la ka sla ti kadiang ,
translation.en: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil , and pour it into the palm of his own left hand :

translation.kha: Kine baroh ki kdew ïa kaei kiei kiba longkmie ki bymmyntoi shisien ba la dep pyndonkam ; ki long tang ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai u briew .
translation.en: Which all are to perish with the using ; ) after the commandments and doctrines of men ?

translation.kha: Naba nga ïohi ba me dap da ka jingbishni baïapher bad me long u khuid jong ka pop .
translation.en: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness , and in the bond of iniquity .

translation.kha: Ki rep lyngkha malade ki thung ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki lum ka jingot kaba dap kyrhai .
translation.en: And sow the fields , and plant vineyards , which may yield fruits of increase .
He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth : his word runneth very swiftly .
translation.kha: U ai hukum ïa ka pyrthei , bad ïa kaei kaba u ong la leh kloi .
ka Kidron , ka Migdalel , ka Horem , ka Bethbarah , bad ka Beth Shekhem : khatkhyndai tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongri sawdong jrong ki .
translation.en: And Iron , and Migdal–el , Horem , and Beth–anath , and Beth–shemesh  ; nineteen cities with their villages .
There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun , who rideth upon the heaven in thy help , and in his excellency on the sky .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , ym don u blei uba kum U Blei jong phi , Uba ïaid ha ka burom ha sahit bneng , Uba ïaid ha ki lyoh ban wan ïarap ïa phi .

Ngan pynshai sawdong ïa u , sam buh ki khwai ha ki tyngam jong u bad ngan patan ei ïa u bad ïa ka kynum shipai lad u baroh . Ka kynhun shipai jong u ka long kaba khrup , lem bad ki kulai bad ki nongshong khuslai ibha riam ryntih , bad man la u shipai umbiah rah ka stieh bad ksiang ka waitlam .
translation.en: And I will turn thee back , and put hooks into thy jaws , and I will bring thee forth , and all thine army , horses and horsemen , all of them clothed with all sorts of armour , even a great company with bucklers and shields , all of them handling swords :
Take him , and look well to him , and do him no harm  ; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee .
translation.kha: Khie leit wad ïa u Jeremaïah bad sumar bha ïa u . Wat pynmynsaw ïa u , hynrei leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u kwah .
Mynta ki dei ïa-ban sangeh noh na kaba Mane ïa kawei pait ki blei bad Weng ïa ki metïap jong ki shem jong ki . Lada ki leh katkum , ngan shong hapdeng jong ki julam .
translation.en: Now let them put away their whoredom , and the carcases of their kings , far from me , and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever .
Therefore I said unto the children of Israel , No soul of you shall eat blood , neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood .
translation.kha: Dei namar kata ba U  Trai  u la ong ha ki paid Israel ba kam bit ïa uno uno na ki , lane ïa uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong ki , ban bam ïa kano kano ka doh kaba dang don snam ha ka .

translation.en: Then rose up Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Jeshua the son of Jozadak , and began to build the house of God which is at Jerusalem : and with them were the prophets of God helping them .
translation.kha: Haba u Serubbabel u khun jong u Shealtiel bad u Joshua u khun jong u Jehosadak ki la ïohsngew ïa ki khubor , ki sdang ban tei biang ïa ka Templ ha Jerusalem , bad ki ar ngut ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïarap ïa ki .
U Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah u im khatsan snem Hadien ka jingïap u Jehoash u Syiem ka Israel .
translation.en: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years .

translation.kha: Ki ong , wai wiang ïalam ïa kito ki koidi shane , Ngi la leh pop lypa pyrda ïa U Troas bad pynbitar la biang ïa u ban pynbudnam ïa ngi . Mynta phi kwah ban leh ei ei ban nang pynjngut ngop ïa ngi .
translation.en: And said unto them , Ye shall not bring in the captives hither : for whereas we have offended against the  Lord  already , ye intend to add more to our sins and to our trespass : for our trespass is great , and there is fierce wrath against Israel .

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki Ïeng hapdeng jong ka Jordan haduh ban da pyndep lut ïa kadei kaei baroh ba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Joshua don ong ïa u paidbah ban ni . Kane ka Dei kata kaba u Moses u la hukum . U paidbhur u la pynkhuid sha shiliang ka wah .
translation.en: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan , until every thing was finished that the  Lord  commanded Joshua to speak unto the people , according to all that Moses commanded Joshua : and the people hasted and passed over .

translation.kha: Haba ka Elishaphat ka la ïohsngew ïa ka ïakhublei jong ka Mari , i khunlung i la khih hapoh jong ka . La pyndap ïa ka Elisabeth da U Mynsiem Bakhuid
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary , the babe leaped in her womb  ; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Ghost :

translation.kha: U Jehoahas u la ei khatphra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , malu u la synshar tang lai bnai mala shiphew snoh ha Jerusalem . U ruh u leh thup pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem : and he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U u briew u dang ïai khmih jar jar ïa ka , ban peit la ka long ba U Trai u la ai jingjop ïa u .
translation.en: And the man wondering at her held his peace , to wit whether the  Lord  had made his journey prosperous or not .

translation.kha: Ïa uto uba la shah kdew bad ha uba la lap ïa ki tiar ki tar kiba la mana yn thang ha ka ding , lem bun ïa ka longïing jong u , bad kamai kaei baroh Kaba u don , naba u wanrah ïa ka jinglehrain buhrieh ïa ki Jesreel bad u la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong nga .
translation.en: And it shall be , that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire , he and all that he hath : because he hath transgressed the covenant of the  Lord  , and because he hath wrought folly in Israel .

translation.kha: Baroh kiba mian bleithaw kin shah pynlehrain , baroh ki blei ki daym ngon ha khmat jongki U Trai .
translation.en: Confounded be all they that serve graven images , that boast themselves of idols : worship him , all ye gods .
Then said Jesus unto him ,  Except ye see signs and wonders , ye will not believe .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban ngeit lymda u ïohi ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla .
Haba ka por ka la pei ban lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa ki mraw jong u sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpateng ïa ka bhah jong u na ka jingkheit .
translation.en: And when the time of the fruit drew near , he sent his servants to the husbandmen , that they might receive the fruits of it .

translation.kha: Kawei kaba pynlong ïa phin ban pyrkhat ba ngi long ki bieit kumta ki phasi ?
translation.en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts , and reputed vile in your sight ?
For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner .
translation.kha: Baroh ki paidbah jong u Dabid bad baroh ki paidbah ha Israel ki sngewthuh ba u syiem um don bynta ha ka jingpynïap ïa u Abner .
U Trai u ong , Ha kata ka por ngan pynïoh pat ïa ka jingroi kyrhai jong ka Judith bad ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: For , behold , in those days , and in that time , when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem ,
This is thy lot , the portion of thy measures from me , saith the  Lord   ; because thou hast forgotten me , and trusted in falsehood .
translation.kha: U la ong ba kane kan dei ka kupar jong pha . Kane ka dei kaei kaba u la kut jingmut ban leh ïa pha , namar pha la klet ïa u bad pha la shaniah ha ki blei thala .

translation.en: Blessed shalt thou be in the city , and blessed shalt thou be in the field .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa ki shnong jong phi bad ïa ki lyngkha jong phi .
Em , la jubab u Saul . Kumno men lah ban leit ïaleh ïa u ? Me long tang u khynnah , katba ma u , u la Long u shipai ha baroh ka jingim jong u !
translation.en: And Saul said to David , Thou art not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him : for thou art but a youth , and he a man of war from his youth .

translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa ki briew bamatlah jong per na ki lynti ibha Kam pat ju ïaid . Ngan pynkyllon ïa ka jingdum jong ki sha ka jingshai bad pynlong ïa ki jakarieh khohruh khohram kiba jem ha khmat jong ki . Kine ki long ki Jingkular jong nga , bad ngan batskhem ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not  ; I will lead them in paths that they have not known : I will make darkness light before them , and crooked things straight . These things will I do unto them , and not forsake them .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la Ong ha ki , To wei bad nga , bad ngan hikai ïa phi ban tong briew .
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Follow me , and I will make you fishers of men .

translation.kha: Ki briew U Trai ki la riewspah , hynrei kiba ïalap marpyrshah ; ki la sngaid bun ki la dap ibha da ka jingbam . Te ki la iehnoh ïa U Blei uba la thab ïa ki , bad ki la kyntait ïa u nongpynim bakhrawbor jong ki .
translation.en: But Jeshurun waxed fat , and kicked : thou art waxen fat , thou art grown thick , thou art covered with fatness  ; then he forsook God which made him , and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation .
And she arose at midnight , and took my son from beside me , while thine handmaid slept , and laid it in her bosom , and laid her dead child in my bosom .
translation.kha: Ka la khie ha ka por mynmiet , ka shim ïa u khun jong nga na syndah jong nga katba nga dang ïohthiah , bad ka la rah ïa u sha ka jingthiah jong ka ; nangta ka buh ïa u khun ba la ïap ha ka jingthiah jong nga .

translation.en: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth , that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace .
translation.kha: bad ba ïa uno uno u bym dem ngon bad mane dei ban bret ha ka lawar ding baklang .

U Tharai Badonbor Baroh u noh , Mynba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki pynbitar ïa nga , nga la pynkhraw ka jingpynjot ïa ki bad ngap shym pynkylla ïa la ka jingmut , hynrei nga pynbud ïa ki jingthmu jngai nga .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; As I thought to punish you , when your fathers provoked me to wrath , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I repented not :

translation.kha: Ha ka snem naba lai jong ka jingsynshar jong u , u la pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta ki rangbah synshar bad ki nongpynïasuk . Ki kynhun shipai ka Persia bad ka Media ki la ïadon lang , kumjuh ruh ki lat bad ki riewpawkhmat jong ki jylla .
translation.en: In the third year of his reign , he made a feast unto all his princes and his servants  ; the power of Persia and Media , the nobles and princes of the provinces , being before him :
And Samuel died  ; and all the Israelites were gathered together , and lamented him , and buried him in his house at Ramah . And David arose , and went down to the wilderness of Paran .
translation.kha: Te u Samuel u la ïap , bad ki Israel baroh ki ïawanlang bad ïambriew na ka bynta jong u . Nangta ki tep ïa u ha ka ïing jong u ha Ramah . Hadien kane , u Dabid u leit sha ka ri khlaw Paran .
Kumta khie otsher phai ei sha ïingjaiñ da kob suk , bad wat leh ei ei kambah pynsngewsih ïa ki .
translation.en: Wherefore now return , and go in peace , that thou displease not the lords of the Philistines .

translation.kha: Don u ban nguh , Nga lah ban leh ïa kano kan . Ho-oid , hynrei ym baroh kiei kiei ki long kiba bha ïa phin . Nga lah ban ong ba nga lah ban ar ïa kano kan , hynriew ngan ym shahskhor ïa kano kano ban pynlong ïa nga u mraw jong ka .
translation.en: All things are lawful unto me , but all things are not expedient : all things are lawful for me , but I will not be brought under the power of any .

translation.kha: Kum u lyoh suba mih bad u jah noh , u briew u ïap bad um wan phan shuh ; la klet noh da baroh kiba ithuh ïa u .
translation.en: He shall return no more to his house , neither shall his place know him any more .

translation.kha: U uno uba ïatei leh ïa ka ngop , u long jong u Soitan , nabar u call u la leh pop naduh kaba mynnyngkong eh . U Khun U balui u la paw na ka boitha kane hi ka daw , ban pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba la leh da u Soitan .
translation.en: He that committeth sin is of the devil  ; for the devil sinneth from the beginning . For this purpose the Son of God was manifested , that he might destroy the works of the devil .

That all of you have conspired against me , and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse , and there is none of you that is sorry for me , or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me , to lie in wait , as at this day ?
translation.kha: Hato dei na kata ba phi baroh phi la ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga ? Ym don uwei ruh na phi uba la ïathuh ha nga ba u khun jong nga hi u la ïateh kular bad u Dabid . Ym don uwei ruh uba pyrkhat sngewlem ïa nga lane ïathuh ha nga ba u Dabid , uwei na ki rangbah jong nga , u don hangne mynta , u da wad ïa ka kabu ban pynïap ïa nga , bad ba u khun jong nga u la pynshlur ïa u !

translation.en: This is the thing which the  Lord  doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad , saying , Let them marry to whom they think best  ; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry .
translation.kha: bad kumta U  Trai  u ong ba ki khun kynthei u Selophehad ki lah ban ïashongkurim bad uno uno uba ki mon , hynrei tang hapoh ka jait jong ki hi .

translation.en: But if ye have respect to persons , ye commit sin , and are convinced of the law as transgressors .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi ñiew ïa ki briew kat kum ba ki paw shabar , phi long ba la rem ha ka pop , bad ka hukum ka pynrem ïa phi kum u nongpynkheiñ hukum .

translation.en: That is , They which are the children of the flesh , these are not the children of God : but the children of the promise are counted for the seed .
translation.kha: Kane ka mut ba ki khun ba la kha kat kum ka rukom , kim dei ki khun jong U Blei ; hynrei , ïa ki khun ba la kha kat kum ka jingkular U Blei , la ñiew kum ki nonghiarpateng bashisha .

translation.en: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child , his name was called JESUS , which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb .
translation.kha: Hadien shi taïew , haba ka por ka la poi na ka bynta ban otsher ïa u khunlung , la ai kyrteng ïa u , U Jisu , ka kyrteng kaba u angel u la lah ai na ka bynta jong U ha shuwa ba yn pun ïa U .
Hynrei mynta , ha U Khrist Jisu , ïa ph kiba la ju erlangthari Jngai la wallam hajan da ka jingïap kaba longïng ka jingkñia U Khrist .
translation.en: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ .

translation.kha: Ha U Blei u rai hangtei ba u snar un hap , nabar ïa ka lyndum ki lyoh ba pynlong pyrthat ;
translation.en: When he made a decree for the rain , and a way for the lightning of the thunder :

translation.kha: Kumno lah ban kha pat ïa u briew’ wahbah la rangbah ? U Nikodemos u la Kylli . Kam lah ban long ba un rung shapoh ka khop Jong ka kmie jong u bad ban khiah sa shisien !
translation.en: Nicodemus saith unto him , How can a man be born when he is old ? can he enter the second time into his mother s womb , and be born ?

translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha u kpa jongnga u , Nga kwah ba phyrnai pynïoh ïa ka Dinah kum ka tnga ïa nga .
translation.en: And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor , saying , Get me this damsel to wife .

translation.kha: Haduh ka jingkyrshan jong u , barben ki dkhot kiba ïapher jong ka met ki ïabiang lang sbak , bad ïa ka met baïar khwai la bat lang da Kaei pa kawei ka jingpynjot ïa kaba ka la pynbiang .
