Kumta haba kawei pa kawei ka bynda kaba ïaphah ka ïatrei kam kumba ka daiñ ban ter , ka met baroh kawei ka san bad ka tei ïa lade da ka jingieit .
translation.en: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth , according to the effectual working in the measure of every part , maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love .

translation.kha: Ki briew kin shah pynïap kylliang , dara kito kiba lait im kin sa sngewthuh ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you , and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
But unto the damsel thou shalt do nothing  ; there is in the damsel no sin worthy of death : for as when a man riseth against his neighbour , and slayeth him , even so is this matter :
translation.kha: Ym dei ban leh ei ei ïa kata ka briew , namar kam shym la leh ïa ka pop ba ka dei ban ïap , naba kane ka kam ka ïasyriem kum ïa kato kaba u briew u shoh bad pynïap ïa uwei pat u briew .
uno u long uta U Jisu u nongïathuhlypa , uba na Nasareth ha ijakhlia , ki paidbah ki la jubab .
translation.en: And the multitude said , This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee .
But let your communication be , Yea , yea  ; Nay , nay : for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil .
translation.kha: Shu ong ‘ Ho-oid’ lane ‘ Em’ — kano kano kawei pat kaba phi ong ka wan na Uta uba Sniew .
Nangta u Mordekai u leit noh bun u leh ïa baroh Kaba ka Esther ka la ong ïa u ban leh .
translation.en: So Mordecai went his way , and did according to all that Esther had commanded him .

And it came to pass , as he was telling the king how he had restored a dead body to life , that , behold , the woman , whose son he had restored to life , cried to the king for her house and for her land . And Gehazi said , My lord , O king , this is the woman , and this is her son , whom Elisha restored to life .
translation.kha: Katba u Gehasi u dang ïathuh ïa u syiem kumno u Elisha u la pynim pat ïa u briew uba la ïap , kata ka briew ka la pynlong ïa ka jingkyrpad na u syiem . U Gehasi u ong ha u ,  Ko syiem kynrad , kane keiñ kata ka briew , bad une keiñ u khun jong ka ïa uba u Elisha u la pynim pat .
U la nang san nang san tad haduh ba u la kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng bad ba lah ïa-ban ïohi da baroh kiba don ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: The tree grew , and was strong , and the height thereof reached unto heaven , and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth :

Thou , even thou , art  Lord  alone  ; thou hast made heaven , the heaven of heavens , with all their host , the earth , and all things that are therein , the seas , and all that is therein , and thou preservest them all  ; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee .
translation.kha: Bad nangta ki Israel ki duwai ïa kane ka jingduwai :  Ma me , Ko  Trai  , tang ma me hi marwei me long U  Trai  ; me thaw ïa ki bneng bad ki khlur jong ka sahit bneng . Me thaw ïa ka ryngkew bad ïa ka duriaw bad baroh kiba don ha ki ; me ai jingim ïa baroh . Ki bor ha bneng ki dem bad ki mane ïa me .
Phi Ïohi , namarkata , ka dei da ki kada jong u ba ïa u bri la pynksan ha U Balei , ym tang da ka jingngeit Jong u hi .
translation.en: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified , and not by faith only .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki tih ïa ki mawsiang ïa-ei tam , ki thik ha syn jong ki lumbah .
translation.en: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock  ; he overturneth the mountains by the roots .
And I will shake all nations , and the desire of all nations shall come : and I will fill this house with glory , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkyllon ïa ki hima baroh , bad ïa ki jingkynshew yn wallam shane , bad ïa ka Templ yn pyndap da ka spah .

translation.en: And they shall hearken to thy voice : and thou shalt come , thou and the elders of Israel , unto the king of Egypt , and ye shall say unto him , The  Lord  God of the Hebrews hath met with us : and now let us go , we beseech thee , three days  journey into the wilderness , that we may sacrifice to the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga kin shahshkor ïa kaei kaba me ong ha ki . Nangta me dei ban leit bad ki nongïalam jong ki Israel sha u Pharaoh bad ong ha u , ‘ U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki Hebru , u la pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi . Mynta shah ïa ngi ban leit lai sngi lynti sha ka ri shyiap ban ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi .’
Katba u dang im , u Saul u hap ban ïaleh tyngeh pyrshah ïa ki Pisidia . Kumta , mano ka por ba u lap ïa u biria uba khlaiñ lane uba shlur , u ju pynrung ïa u ha ka kynjoh ïapom jong u .
translation.en: And there was sore war against the Philistines all the days of Saul : and when Saul saw any strong man , or any valiant man , he took him unto him .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , wahbah ka por ka poi , ki paid Israhaïah bad Judah kin wang ïa-ot , kin wad ïa nga , U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: In those days , and in that time , saith the  Lord  , the children of Israel shall come , they and the children of Judah together , going and weeping : they shall go , and seek the  Lord  their God .
Shall evil be recompensed for good ? for they have digged a pit for my soul . Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them , and to turn away thy wrath from them .
translation.kha: Hato ka jingsniew ka dei ka bainong na ka bynta kaba bha ? Pynban ki la tih ka thliew na ka bynta jong nga ba ngan hap ha ka . To kynmaw kumno ba nga la wan sha me bad kren na ka bynta jong ki , khnang ba men ym leh ei ei ïa ki ha ka jingbitar .

A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum Bad ki Pharisi ! Phi Kiba arsap ! Phi shim kabu ïa ki riewkhlaw bad phi knieh noh ïa ki ïng jyllang ki , bad nangta phi pyndei ïa ka jingduwai bajlan ! Nalor kane , ka jingpynmihpat ïa phi tista longïng kaweh kham Sniew !
translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye devour widows  houses , and for a pretence make long prayer : therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation .
There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus , who walk not after the flesh , but after the Spirit .
translation.kha: Ym don jingpynrem shuh mynta na ka bynta kito kiba im ha U Khrist Jisu .
Tam dei namar ba phoi ïeng ha ka jinglehburom ïa U Blei ba u sngem ïa phi bad wanrah ïa phi sha ka jingbishar .
translation.en: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee ? will he enter with thee into judgment ?

And Abner said to him , Turn thee aside to thy right hand or to thy left , and lay thee hold on one of the young men , and take thee his armour . But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him .
translation.kha: Sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa nga !  ong u Abner .  Khie leit beh ïa uwei na ki shipai bad shim kat ïa kaba u don .  Hynrei u Asahel u ïai beh kthong hi sia ïa u .
U ong , Ki nongshun jong im ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa ngi , bad ki la wan mih shabar na tala ka nongbah ban ïaleh ïa i ha madan , hynrei ngi beh krad beiñ ïa ki sha ka khyrdop shnong .
translation.en: And the messenger said unto David , Surely the men prevailed against us , and came out unto us into the field , and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jongno nga , to kiar noh na kaban mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translation.en: Wherefore , my dearly beloved , flee from idolatry .
Proud and haughty scorner is his name , who dealeth in proud wrath .
translation.kha: Pyni ha nga ïa u briew uba sarong bad ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa u briew uba hangamei , uba sarong bad u bym ju kheiñ briew .

translation.en: The wise in heart will receive commandments : but a prating fool shall fall .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sngewthuh ki pdiang ïa ki jingpyn-i kiba dei , ki briew kiba kren bieit ki tur ruma sha ka jingjot .
U Jisu u la jubab da ka jingijli , Kaei Kaba ka hukum u Moses ka ai ha phin ?
translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  What did Moses command you ?

translation.kha: Ki hynmen lad u ki ïamynjur , malu haba katto katne ki nongkhaïi na Midian ki ïadoh lynti nangta , ki hynmen ki la sei noh ïa u Joseph na kata ka pukri bad ki la die noh ïa u ha kita ki nong Ismakhaïah arphew tylli ki sbai rupa , bad ki ruh ki la ïalam noh ïa u sha Ijipt .
translation.en: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen  ; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit , and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver : and they brought Joseph into Egypt .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Mynba u Isaia u dang khnai , sa la ieit ïa u , bad to la khot noh ïa u na Ijipt khem u khwan jongnga nga .
translation.en: When Israel was a child , then I loved him , and called my son out of Egypt .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha ktang ïuh bainong na ka pynbha kaei kaba ki ong , hawei kito katba shukor ki thrang tang ban leh jubab .
translation.en: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth : but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence .
Now Samuel was dead , and all Israel had lamented him , and buried him in Ramah , even in his own city . And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits , and the wizards , out of the land .
translation.kha: Mynta u Samuel u la ïap , bad baroh ki Israel ki la ïambriew ïa u bad ki la tep ïa u ha ka shnong jong u hi , ha Ramah . U Saul u la lah beh lut ïa ki nongai ksuid bad ki nongkren byrtong baroh na Israel .

Ki kmie ki kjap jong u kim tip shaphang kane ; ki dang pyllait ba u la don lang pynlang ka kynhun , kumta ki la ïaleit lynnong baïar shi snieh , bad nangta , ki la sheng ban wad ïa u hapdeng ki ba-ha-ïing bad ki paralok .
translation.en: But they , supposing him to have been in the company , went a day s journey  ; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u ong ïa me , ‘ Ngan pynngat ïa ka jingjot ha me . Ngan sar noh phasi ïa me , bad ngan pynduh khoit ïa uwei pa uwei u shynraiñ na ka longïing jrong me , la u samla bad tymmen kumjuh .
translation.en: Behold , I will bring evil upon thee , and will take away thy posterity , and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel ,
Neither let us commit fornication , as some of them committed , and fell in one day three and twenty thousand .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban long kiba shah kynnoh ba leh awria , kumba don na ki , kiba la leh kumta — bad ha ka shi sngi , arphew lai hajar ngut na ki , ki la kyllon ïap .
U Trai u phah sa kamai pat ka khubor shat u Ahas :
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  spake again unto Ahaz , saying ,

translation.kha: U Blei u pynkulmar ba u Jisu un-long U Syiem jong ka Hima jongki u .
translation.en: God promised that Jesus would become the King of His Kingdom .

translation.kha: Kata ka jingïakut ka la long ka jong ki hi ; hynrei ha ka jingjyrsieh , ki la don ïa ka jingsngew kit ram ban ïarap ïa ki . Namar ki Jiw ki la ïasam bynta lem ïa ki jingkyrkhu ba kynja mynsiem jong ki bad ki Jenesis , ki Jentil ki dei ban pyndonkam ïa ki jingkyrkhu ba ki don ban ïarap ïa ki Jiw .
translation.en: It hath pleased them verily ; and their debtors they are . For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things , their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things .

translation.kha: kumin ka ki U Blei kan kham pynrangbah ïa ka jingim jong phi ?
translation.en: How can God’s Word improve your life ?

Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish , and gold from Uphaz , the work of the workman , and of the hands of the founder : blue and purple is their clothing : they are all the work of cunning men .
translation.kha: Ïa ki bleithaw jong ki la sop da ka rupa na Spain bad da ka ksiar na Uphas baroh ki jingtrei jong ki nongtrei ; la pynphong jaiñ ïa ki ha ki jaiñ ïongjngum bad sawbthuh ba la thain da ki nongthain jaiñ batbit .
Gera Kumta ma nga , U Troas ngan buh biang ïa ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa ki briew jong nga . Ngan wanrah ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa ki khun ki kyrsiew jong ki .
translation.en: Wherefore I will yet plead with you , saith the  Lord  , and with your children s children will I plead .

translation.kha: Nangta u Nathan u leit sha ka Bathsheba , ka kmie jong u Solomon , bad u ong ha ka , Phim pat ïohsngew ba u Adaïah , u khun jong ka Haggith u la thung syiem ïa lade ? Jaban u Syiem Sabad um tip ei ei shemphang kata !
translation.en: Wherefore Nathan spake unto Bath–sheba the mother of Solomon , saying , Hast thou not heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith doth reign , and David our lord knoweth it not ?
Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind , he chose out of all the choice of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians .
translation.kha: U Joab u ïohi ba ki shipai nongshun kin tur ïaleh ïa u na sha khmat bad na shadien , kumta u jied ki shipai Israel bakynsai tam bad pynap da kaba pynphai khmat ïa ki shaphang ki Syria .

translation.en: Now for a long season Israel hath been without the true God , and without a teaching priest , and without law .
translation.kha: Slem bah ki Israel ki la im khlem U Blei uba shisha , khlem ki lyngdoh ban hikai ïa ki , bad khlem ka hukum .

translation.en: And there went out after him Joab s men , and the Cherethites , and the Pelethites , and all the mighty men : and they went out of Jerusalem , to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri .
translation.kha: Kumta ki rangbah jong u Joab , ki nongïada ïa u syiem , bad kiwei pat ki shipai ki la mihnoh na Jerusalem bad u Abishai ban leit thwet ïa u Sheba .
Da lei laiñ U Trai’ un ym shah ïa nga ban pynmynsaw ïa uta uba U Trai u la pynlong syiem ! To ïng ïashim ïa une u sum bad une u khihwin um jong u , bad ïa ngin ïaleit noh .
translation.en: The  Lord  forbid that I should stretch forth mine hand against the  Lord s  anointed : but , I pray thee , take thou now the spear that is at his bolster , and the cruse of water , and let us go .

translation.kha: kumba la thoh ha ka aiñ jong U TRAI’ : Ïa uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong dei ïa-ban pynkyntang sha U Trai .
translation.en: ( As it is written in the law of the Lord , Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord  ; )

translation.kha: U la kylli ïa nga , Hato mem tipbriew ? Em , ngam tip , ko rangbah , nga la jubab .
translation.en: And he answered me and said , Knowest thou not what these be ? And I said , No , my lord .
For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt : it shall not be eaten .
translation.kha: Ym dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka jingainguh bam ba u lyngdoh u wanrah , ïa baroh dei ban thang lut khoit .

translation.en: Then said the king to Amasa , Assemble me the men of Judah within three days , and be thou here present .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha u Amasa ,  Khot lang ïa ki rangbah Judah bad wan biang shane la shi sngi lem bad ki .
Ki jubab , Mynta ngi tip ba U Trai u khong bad Phin , bad ngi pyrkhat ba ka dei ban don ka jingïateh kular badonburom hateng jong ngi .
translation.en: And they said , We saw certainly that the  Lord  was with thee : and we said , Let there be now an oath betwixt us , even betwixt us and thee , and let us make a covenant with thee  ;

translation.kha: Ong ha u Aaron , ym bit ïa uno Une na ki khun ki ksiew jong me pynpang la pateng uba ei jinganna ha ka met ban ktien ïa ka jingtieng bam sha nga .
translation.en: Speak unto Aaron , saying , Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish , let him not approach to offer the bread of his God .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa u Abraham , u kparad tymmen jong pa , na ka ri kaba sha shiliang ka wah Ïuphratis malade nga ïalam ïa u lyngba ka ri Kano baroh khawai . Nga la ai ha u shibun ki khun ki ksiew . Nga la ai ha u ïa u Isaak ,
translation.en: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the flood , and led him throughout all the land of Canaan , and multiplied his seed , and gave him Isaac .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kadei kaba U Trai u ong ha ki briew jong u ki Israel : Wat la ki nong Assyria ki khlaiñbor bad ki kham bhor bastad , ïa ki yn pynjot thiaw bad kin jah noh . Ko ki briew jong nga , nga la pynlong ïa ph ban shahshitom , hynne ngan ym leh shuh ïa ka .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Though they be quiet , and likewise many , yet thus shall they be cut down , when he shall pass through . Though I have afflicted thee , I will afflict thee no more .

translation.kha: un mihngi na kata ka ïing bad un khang ïa ka hynñiew sngi .
translation.en: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house , and shut up the house seven days :

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Trai , namar u long uba bha ; to rwai ki jingïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u , namar u Long uba bha sbun .
translation.en: Praise the  Lord   ; for the  Lord  is good : sing praises unto his name  ; for it is pleasant .

translation.kha: Haba u Herod , u nongsynshar ka Galilaïa , u la jingsngewsih shaphang kiei kiew barhem kiba la jia , u la kulmar jingmut , namar katto katne thut ki bhabriew ki la ong ba u Ïing u Nongaplangbrot u la mihpat .
translation.en: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him : and he was perplexed , because that it was said of some , that John was risen from the dead  ;

translation.kha: A Trai U Blei , me la shah ïa nga ban longsyiem syiem hadien i pa jong ar , wat la nga dang khynwin bad ngam pyntip kumta ban synshar .
translation.en: And now , O  Lord  my God , thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father : and I am but a little child : I know not how to go out or come in .
Saying ,  The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses  seat :
translation.kha: Ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ki long kiba la pynkupbor ban batai ïa ka Hukum u Moses .

dong step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bud , ki la ïashem ban leit hiarthma ïa ka ri lumlang , ki da ong , Mynta te ngi la kliar ban leit sha Kata ka jaka ïa kaweh U Trai u la ïatyngkhuh ha i'u . neng phla ba I la leh pop .
translation.en: And they rose up early in the morning , and gat them up into the top of the mountain , saying , Lo , we be here , and will go up unto the place which the  Lord  hath promised : for we have sinned .
Howbeit Jesus spake of his death : but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep .
translation.kha: U Jisu u mut ban ong ba u Lasaros u la ïap , hynrei ki la pyrkhat ba u mut ba u shu ïohthiah .
Ka dei lyngba U Khrist ba baroh ma ngi , ki Jiw bad ki Jentil , ngi la ia Ban wan ha uwei U Mynsiem sha ka jingsdang ryngkat lad U Kpa .
translation.en: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father .

translation.kha: Katba u Jobab u dang ïakren bad ki , ka Hakhlieh ka la poi bad la ka kynjoh langbrot .
translation.en: And while he yet spake with them , Rachel came with her father s sheep : for she kept them .

translation.kha: Ma phiah ki briew phi la kyntait ïa nga ; pa la pynphai ïa la ki ingdong sha nga . Kumta nga la kner ïa la ka Ki bad pynteh ïa phi namar nga la thait ban teh lakam ïa ka jingbitar jong nga .
translation.en: Thou hast forsaken me , saith the  Lord  , thou art gone backward : therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee , and destroy thee  ; I am weary with repenting .
They shall not drink wine with a song  ; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it .
translation.kha: Ym don shuh ka jingrwai bakmen ha ka por ba dih waiñ ; ym don basngewtynnat shuh ïa ka jingmad jong ka .
Ka jingieid baneh bad ka jingisynei jong U Trai ka ïaineh ,
translation.en: It is of the  Lord s  mercies that we are not consumed , because his compassions fail not .
Now these things were our examples , to the intent we should not lust after evil things , as they also lusted .
translation.kha: Mynta , kane baroh ka long ka nuksa ïa ngi , ban maham ïa ngi ban ym kwah brai ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew , kumba ki la leh , lymne mane ïa ki bleithaw , kumba don na ki kiba la leh kumta .

Ha ka snem kaba saw jong ka jingsynshar u Hesekaïah — kabu long ka snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Shilhim Hoshea ha Israel — u Shalmaneser u patsha ka Assyria u tur ïaleh ïa ka Israel bad kerkut ïa ka Syria .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah , which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel , that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria , and besieged it .
And even to your old age I am he  ; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you : I have made , and I will bear  ; even I will carry , and will deliver you .
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei jong phi bad ngan sumar ïa phi haduh ba phin da tymmen bad ba u shñiuh jong phi u la lieh . Nga la thaw ïa phi bad ngan sumar ïa phi ; Ngan ai jingïarap ïa phi bad ngan pyllait ïa phi .

Hato ym don u nongïathuhlypa ïa uba ki kpa thnam jongngi phi ki la pynshitom beit ? Ki la pynkup ïa ki nongleitkurim jong U blei , kiba slem bah mynshuwa ki la pynbna ïa ka jingwan jong u shakri bahok jngai u .
translation.en: Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted ? and they have slain them which shewed before of the coming of the Just One  ; of whom ye have been now the betrayers and murderers :

translation.kha: Ko Babilonia pha long kum u lumbah uba pynjot ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei , hynrei ma nga , U Trai , nga long u nongshun jong pha . Ngan shim noh ïa pha , pynmadan ïa pha ha ka khynñiat , bad ieh ïa pha ha u diengïap .
translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , O destroying mountain , saith the  Lord  , which destroyest all the earth : and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee , and roll thee down from the rocks , and will make thee a burnt mountain .
And the sea arose by reason of a great wind that blew .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi , ka lyer kaba jur ka la beh bad la pynkhih ïa ka um .

Ka kmienah kiba la duh ne ïa ki hynne ngut ki khun jongngi ka , ka la ïapler , ka da thring ïa ka jingring mynsiem . Ka jingshaïong jong ka sngi jong ka , ka la hylla shat ka jingdum ; la pynjahburom ïa ka bad ka pien ka dohnud . Ngi shad ïa ki nongshun jong phi ban pynïap ïa kito na phi kiba dang im . Ma na , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: She that hath borne seven languisheth : she hath given up the ghost  ; her sun is gone down while it was yet day : she hath been ashamed and confounded : and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: La ba-don ka pliang hangta , kaba dap da ka waiñ ka bym bah ; kumta la wieh ïa suiñ ha ka waiñ , la Tei ha ka khuid Hissop , bad la kyntiew ha ki rmiang shyntur jong u .
translation.en: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar : and they filled a sponge with vinegar , and put it upon hyssop , and put it to his mouth .
And there was a widow in that city  ; and she came unto him , saying , Avenge me of mine adversary .
translation.kha: Bad la don ka riewkynthei ha kata kajuh ka shnong kaba ïai wan sha u bad kyrpad na ka bynta ki hok jong ka , da kaba ong , ‘ To ïarap ïa nga pyrshah ïa u nongïaleh pyrshah jong nga !’

translation.en: And I saw , and bare record that this is the Son of God .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa kata ,  la ong U Ïoannis ,  bad nga ong ha phi ba une u dei U Khun U Blei .
To tynjuh ïa lade bad bishar hi da lade , ban shem la phi im ne em ha ka jingngeit . Hato da Shishak phi tip ba U Kiriath Jisu u don ha phi ? — lymda phi la long kiba la shahjop ei .
translation.en: Examine yourselves , whether ye be in the faith ; prove your own selves . Know ye not your own selves , how that Jesus Christ is in you , except ye be reprobates ?

translation.kha: Haba u Joab bad ki ngab jong u ki la poi , la ïathuh ha u ba u Abner u la wan sha u syiem Dabid , bad ba u Dabid u la phah noh ïa u lem malade ka jingïalang jingshngain .
translation.en: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come , they told Joab , saying , Abner the son of Ner came to the king , and he hath sent him away , and he is gone in peace .

translation.kha: Dei pun bam ïa ka jingdam baroh hapoh ka ïing ha kaba la khreh ïa ka ; phim bit ban rah ïa ka shabar ; bad ym dei ba pynskuiñ wat dang kawei ruh ka shyieng jngai u mrad .
translation.en: In one house shall it be eaten  ; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house  ; neither shall ye break a bone thereof .

translation.kha: U Moses u jingbabe , Phira ïakhawai ban shong don sah hangne katba kiwei pat ki Israel kin longing shuh ka thma ?
translation.en: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben , Shall your brethren go to war , and shall ye sit here ?
And Elijah came unto all the people , and said , How long halt ye between two opinions ? if the  Lord  be God , follow him : but if Baal , then follow him . And the people answered him not a word .
translation.kha: U Elijah u leit sha u paidbah bad ong ,  Sa katno slem ba phin pynbeit ïa ki jingmut jong phi ? Lada U  Trai  u dei U Blei , mane ïa u ; hynrei lada u Baal u dei U Blei , mane ïa u !  Hynrei u paidbah u la shu sngap jar .
Ko syiem Ijipt , shano kito ki nongai jingmut bashalak jong me ? Lehse ki ha ban ïathmu ha me ïa ki jingthmu jong U Tlai Badonburom Baroh kiba u don ïa ka Ijipt .
translation.en: Where are they ? where are thy wise men ? and let them tell thee now , and let them know what the  Lord  of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt .

translation.kha: bad ai ïa kane ka hukum ha u Hilkaïah u lyngdoh , ha u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , ha u Akhbor u khun jong u Mikaïah , ha u Shaphan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad ha u Asaïah , u nongbud jong u syiem :
translation.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Achbor the son of Michaiah , and Shaphan the scribe , and Asaiah a servant of the king s , saying ,
Why did the knees prevent me ? or why the breasts that I should suck ?
translation.kha: Balei te ka kmie jong nga ka thum ïa nga ha la pneh ? Balei ka ai buiñ ïa nga ha ka shadem jong ka ?

translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: Hearken not to Hezekiah : for thus saith the king of Assyria , Make an agreement with me by a present , and come out to me , and then eat ye every man of his own vine , and every one of his fig tree , and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern :
translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa u Hesekaïah . U patsha ka Assyria u hukum ïa phi ban mihnoh na ka nongbah bad ban pyndem wait . Yn shah ïa phi ba phin bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki dieng sohwaiñ , bad ïa ki soh Dumbur na ki dieng ki jong phi hi , bad ban dih um na ki pukri jong phi hi —
thaba la dep pynbiang ïa kiei kiei baroh na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Mamre Ka Jinglait , ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki Shim ïa la ki bynta , kam la hukum da u syiem .
translation.en: So the service was prepared , and the priests stood in their place , and the Levites in their courses , according to the king s commandment .

translation.kha: Ngin la kyrpad ïa ki synran jrong me ba-bang baher noh ïa u , hynrei kim lah .
translation.en: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out  ; and they could not .

translation.kha: Keiñ ka long kaei kaba U Trai nongsynran u ïai-ong ïa u Gog : Babha said ka por ka la poi , men sa sdang pyrkhat ïa ka buit sniew .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; It shall also come to pass , that at the same time shall things come into thy mind , and thou shalt think an evil thought :

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong me ki ïalaw pyrshah mala leh bymkohnguh ïa me ; ki phai dien noh na ka Hukum jong me . Ki pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba maham ïa ki ,
translation.en: Nevertheless they were disobedient , and rebelled against thee , and cast thy law behind their backs , and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee , and they wrought great provocations .

translation.kha: Nga ai ïa ki ha phira mynta ka sngi na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi ïa phi hi .
translation.en: To keep the commandments of the  Lord  , and his statutes , which I command thee this day for thy good ?
And Lebaoth , and Shilhim , and Ain , and Rimmon : all the cities are twenty and nine , with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Lebaoth , ka Shilhim , ka Ain bad ka Rimmon : baroh lang ki long arphew khyndai tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit kiba don sawdong jong ki .

Namar na ka dohnud jong u ki mih ki jingpyrkhat basniew katba ïalam ïa u ban pynsep briew , ban klim , dara ban leh ïa kiwei kiwei! ki kam bakhia ; ba-bang ïalute , ban lamler , mala ba-bang kren sniew ïa kiwei .
translation.en: For out of the heart proceed evil thoughts , murders , adulteries , fornications , thefts , false witness , blasphemies :

translation.kha: Ki pynkylla kthang ïa ka laiñ Sha ka dien , kum ka kthang u kpa tymmen u Dan , u khun jongngi u Jakob .
translation.en: And they called the name of the city Dan , after the name of Dan their father , who was born unto Israel : howbeit the name of the city was Laish at the first .

And , behold , I purpose to build an house unto the name of the  Lord  my God , as the  Lord  spake unto David my father , saying , Thy son , whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room , he shall build an house unto my name .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kular ïa u Dabid , u kpa jong nga , ‘ U khun jong me , uba ngan pynlong syiem hadien jong me , un tei ka Templ ïa nga .’ Bad mynta nga la kut jingmut ban tei ka templ na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong nga .

translation.en: Behold , at that time I will undo all that afflict thee : and I will save her that halteth , and gather her that was driven out  ; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame .
translation.kha: Ka por ka poi ! Ngan pynshitom ïa ki nongbanbeiñ jong pha ; ngan pyllait im ïa baroh kiba dkoh bad ngan wallam sha ïing ïa kiba shah ringmraw . Ngan pynphai ïa ka jinglehrain jong ki sha ka jingdonburom , bad baroh ka pyrthei kan ïaroh ïa ki .

Bun kumta , mar syn ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ki tiar put tiar Tema , ki briew jong baroh ki ri , ki jaitbynriew , sad ki jahthait ktien ki la ïadem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksiar kaba u Syiem Nongbishar u la phah pynïeng .
translation.en: Therefore at that time , when all the people heard the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and all kinds of musick , all the people , the nations , and the languages , fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up .

translation.kha: Iathuh hok .
translation.en: Be honest .

translation.kha: Ka Abimael ka dem ngon ha khyndew bad ka ong , Nga long ka shakri jong u , kaba kloi ban sait ïa ki kjat jong ki shrak jong u .
translation.en: And she arose , and bowed herself on her face to the earth , and said , Behold , let thine handmaid be a servant to wash the feet of the servants of my lord .

translation.kha: hynrei lada ngi noh ‘ Na u bri ,’ kine ki paidbah hangne kin lynthem maw ïa sem , namar ki la jingsngewskhem ba u Ïoannis u la long u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But and if we say , Of men  ; all the people will stone us : for they be persuaded that John was a prophet .

translation.kha: Nga la bat ïa ka khuri jong u syiem ; kumto to la Shim ïa kita ki sohwaiñ bad nga khem ïa ki ha “kata ka khuri , bad nga la ai ïa ka ha u .
translation.en: And Pharaoh s cup was in my hand : and I took the grapes , and pressed them into Pharaoh s cup , and I gave the cup into Pharaoh s hand .
And the multitude said , This is Jesus the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee .
translation.kha: Une u long uta U Jisu u nongïathuhlypa , uba na Nasareth ha Galilaïa ,  ki paidbah ki la jubab .
Ka la don ka por mynba me wan bad ar ïa kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kiba ngim shym khmih lynti ; ki lumbah ki ïohi ïa me bad ki khñium da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for , thou camest down , the mountains flowed down at thy presence .

translation.kha: U la pyrshang ngab ïohi ïa U Ujuh ba u long uba kumno , hynrei u long u briew uba rit bad um lah ban ïohi ïa U Jisu namar ki paidïapom .
translation.en: And he sought to see Jesus who he was  ; and could not for the press , because he was little of stature .

translation.kha: Ki ïaring shaphang U Blei ka Jerusha kumba ki ïakren shaphang ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jyrthiaw , ki bleithaw ba la shna da ki kti ki briew’ .
translation.en: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem , as against the gods of the people of the earth , which were the work of the hands of man .
And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one , and bringest me into judgment with thee ?
translation.kha: Hato men ym khmih ïa nga , A Blei , lane buh ïa nga ha ka jingbishar bad jingtian bishar ?
Kawei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ka longkmie khyllai mitar ka lytar bad ar majistor ka kynjoh ; mala baroh khatwei tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki long katjuh ka jingheh .
translation.en: The length of one curtain was thirty cubits , and four cubits was the breadth of one curtain : the eleven curtains were of one size .

translation.kha: Kine baïar ki long ki aiñ bad ki hukum ba U Trai u la ai ha u Moses , ha u Lum Sinai na ka bynta ki paid Israel .
translation.en: These are the statutes and judgments and laws , which the  Lord  made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: Ki riewsniew ki anna hapdeng ki briew jong to ; ki apthap kumto ki briew kiba phriang ïa ki jar baneh riam ïa ki sim , hynrei ibha pynap ïa ki jingriam jong ki ban riam ïa ki briew .
translation.en: For among my people are found wicked men : they lay wait , as he that setteth snares  ; they set a trap , they catch men .

translation.kha: U Joshua u long kum u kada khlaw harud ka umpohliew u khuid kada khlaw ha sharing lum .
translation.en: Joseph is a fruitful bough , even a fruitful bough by a well  ; whose branches run over the wall :

translation.kha: U la pynlong ïa ki ktieh jong nga kiba nep kum ka waitlam . Da la ka kti u ïada ïa nga . U la pynlong ïa nga kum u khnam , uba nep dara ba la biang baneh pyndonkam .
translation.en: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword  ; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me , and made me a polished shaft  ; in his quiver hath he hid me  ;
Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye come into the land which I give you , then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ynda phi rung ha kata ka ri kaba U  Trai  u ai ha phi , phin burom ïa U  Trai  da kaba phin ym rep ïa ka khyndew ha man la ka snem kaba hynñiew .
Kiba bun kyang jinglute ; kin kyllaiñ malade kmen shah pynstet . Yn pynngat ïa ki ha ka jingriam .
translation.en: And many among them shall stumble , and fall , and be broken , and be snared , and be taken .

Or if a soul swear , pronouncing with his lips to do evil , or to do good , whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath , and it be hid from him  ; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty in one of these .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u smai khlem da pyrkhat , kam pher la ka long ïa kano kano , u long uba la rem mar ïasngewthuh ïa kaei ba u la leh .

U la buh ïa ka Dura jong ka bieit Asherah ha ka Templ , ka jaka kaba U Trai u ong ïa u Dabid bad ïa u Solomon u khun jong u : Hangta ha Jerusalem , ha kane ka Templ , ka dei ka jaka ba per la jied na ki ri baroh jongnga ki khat-ar jait ki Israel kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .
translation.en: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house , of which the  Lord  said to David , and to Solomon his son , In this house , and in Jerusalem , which I have chosen out of all tribes of Israel , will I put my name for ever :

translation.kha: U Petros u la dud ïa u shabar lad ka byndi , khlem da tip , la kaei kaba u angel u la leh ka long kaba shisha ; u la pyrkhat ba u la ïohi ka jingïohipaw .
translation.en: And he went out , and followed him  ; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel  ; but thought he saw a vision .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Sa katno kine ki briew kin kyntait ïa nga ? Sa katno ruh kin kyntait ban shaniah ha nga , kam la nga la leh bun ki kambah napdeng jong ki ?
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , How long will this people provoke me ? and how long will it be ere they believe me , for all the signs which I have shewed among them ?

translation.kha: Ki rangbah na Siph ki wan sha u Suah ha ibieit bad ki ïateh ha u ba u Dabid u dang rieh ha u lut Hakhilah ha tduh jong ka ri khlaw Judia .
translation.en: And the Ziphites came unto Saul to Gibeah , saying , Doth not David hide himself in the hill of Hachilah , which is before Jeshimon ?

translation.kha: Mynta phi dei ban jied ïa u briew umbiah stad bad uba shemphang bad thung ïa u ba un peit ïa ka ri .
translation.en: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise , and set him over the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Hato pa dat ka tnga ? Te wat pylleng ban iehnoh ïa ka . Hato phim pat shongkurim ? Te wat ym wad tnga .
translation.en: Art thou bound unto a wife ? seek not to be loosed . Art thou loosed from a wife ? seek not a wife .

translation.kha: Ïalumlang ban myn Blei ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew ; wat bam ei ei bad kdew trei kano kano ka kam .
translation.en: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation  ; and ye shall afflict your souls : ye shall not do any work therein :

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u don ïa kane ban ong ïa ka nongbah Tyros : Haba la jop ïa pha , ki brup kiba shong mutdur ha ki pud duriaw kin sngewtynnad ha ka jinglynñiar jong kito kiba shat pynïap .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  to Tyre  ; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall , when the wounded cry , when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee ?

translation.kha: bad napdeng jong ki , la don uba i kum U te U Briew , kaba kup ka jingkup kaba kot haduh ki kjat jong u , nabar u don u panpoh ksiar sawdong ka shadem jongno u .
translation.en: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man , clothed with a garment down to the foot , and girt about the paps with a golden girdle .
Doth not he see my ways , and count all my steps ?
translation.kha: U Blei u tip ïa kiei kiei baroh ba nga leh ; u ïohi man ka sien jam ba nga jam .
U Trai’ u la ong ha nga ,
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka jingshai ban pynpyut ïa ka myn jongngi me ha ki Jentil nabar ban wallam ka burom ha ki briew jong me , ki Israel .
translation.en: A light to lighten the Gentiles , and the glory of thy people Israel .

translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa ki bad ngan shah ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha sawdong u lum bakyntang jong nga . Hangta ngan kyrkhu ïa ki da kambah pynsaphriang ïa u lup praw haba ki donnam ïa u .
translation.en: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing  ; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season  ; there shall be showers of blessing .
I have therefore delivered him into the hand of the mighty one of the heathen  ; he shall surely deal with him : I have driven him out for his wickedness .
translation.kha: kumta nga la kyntait noh ïa u bad ai ha u nongsynshar nongwei . Un sa ainong ïa uta u dieng ïa kaei kaba u dei ban ïoh na ka bynta ka jingbymman jong u .

translation.en: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse , deceiving , and being deceived .
translation.kha: bad ki briew kiba sniew bad kiba shukor kin nang ïaid na kaba sniew sha kaba kham sniew , da kaba shukor ïa kiwei bad shah shukor ïa lade .
To U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ïa phi ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Grace be to you , and peace , from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Nalorkata , une um dei u Dabid , iathuh uba ki kynthei ki ïaphawar katba ki dang ïashad , ‘ U Saul u la pynïap da ki hajar , hynne u Dabid u la pynïap da ki phew hajar ?’
translation.en: Is not this David , of whom they sang one to another in dances , saying , Saul slew his thousands , and David his ten thousands ?

translation.kha: Haba u syiad Nebukhadnessar jong ka Baibl u la rah ïa u Jehoïakhin u syiem ka Joïada ha ka jingringmraw na Jerusalem , ryngkat bad Shi kynhun ki koidi , u Mordekai u long uwei na ki .
translation.en: Who had been carried away from Jerusalem with the captivity which had been carried away with Jeconiah king of Judah , whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away .

translation.kha: Ngan pynngat ha phi ïa ka jingjynjar — ki jingpang bym lah pynkhiah , bad ki jingdap shitrhem ki ban pynmatlah ïa phi bad ban pynlong ïa ka jingtem jong phin Ban sep-ei . Phin bet ïa u symbai , hynrei um myntoi ïa phi , naba ki nongshun jong phi kin jop ïa phi bun kin bam-im ïa kaba phi la thung .
translation.en: I also will do this unto you  ; I will even appoint over you terror , consumption , and the burning ague , that shall consume the eyes , and cause sorrow of heart : and ye shall sow your seed in vain , for your enemies shall eat it .

translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka jubab , To ai ba kano nangno ka jingjam kan hap halor Jong nga ; ko khun jong nga , shu lai kumba nga ong ; bad khie lytar bun wanrah ïa ki blem sha sa .
translation.en: And his mother said unto him , Upon me be thy curse , my son : only obey my voice , and go fetch me them .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba kut jingmut ban leh ïa kaba dei un im , hynrei uno uno uba ïai beh ban leh ïa kaba sniew un ïap .
translation.en: As righteousness tendeth to life : so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death .

translation.kha: Yn don hi man la ka para ki Isaia kiba nur bad kiba kyrduh , bad kumta nga hukum ïa phi ban lehsbun ïa ki .
translation.en: For the poor shall never cease out of the land : therefore I command thee , saying , Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother , to thy poor , and to thy needy , in thy land .

translation.kha: te to ai ba ka tnga jong ar kan shet ïa ka jingbam na ka bynta uwei pat u briew bad ban thiah ha ka jingthiah jong uwei pat .
translation.en: Then let my wife grind unto another , and let others bow down upon her .

translation.kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jaiñ Issakhar ki la ïohpdiang synsar tylli ki nongbah : ka Kishion , ka Daberath ,
translation.en: And out of the tribe of Issachar , Kishion with her suburbs , Daberath with her suburbs ,

translation.kha: U Elijah u la khie joit , u bam mala u dih pynlang ka jingbat ka la ai bor ïa u ban ïaid sawphew sngi sha Sinai , u lum bakhuid .
translation.en: And he arose , and did eat and drink , and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God .

translation.kha: bad u la phah ïa phi lem badno ka hukum , don pynjot ïa ki Amalek , ki briew bymman . U la Ong ïa phin ban ïaleh haduh ba phin da pynïap ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  sent thee on a journey , and said , Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites , and fight against them until they be consumed .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ha kata ka sngi , kata ka jingkieng ïa ka jingjop ka la kylla sha ka jingsngewsih ïa baroh ki shipai jong u Dabid , namar ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem u ïambriew na ka bynta la u khun .
translation.en: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people : for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son .
Then Moses said unto Aaron , This is it that the  Lord  spake , saying , I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me , and before all the people I will be glorified . And Aaron held his peace .
translation.kha: Te u Moses u ong ha u Aaron ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la kren shaphang jong ka mynba u ong , ‘ Baroh kiba shakri ïa nga ki dei ban burom ïa ka jinglongkhuid jong nga ; ngan pynpaw ïa ka burom jong nga ha la ki briew .’   Hynrei u Aaron u shu sngap jar .

translation.en: For he that is entered into his rest , he also hath ceased from his own works , as God did from his .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingjahthait ïa kaba U Blei u la kular , un shongthait na ka kam jong u hi , kumba U Blei u la shongthait na ka kam jong u .

Ki la ong ha u Moses Bad u Aaron , U Trai u la ïuh ïa khie kaban phi la leh , bad un pynshitom ïa phi namar ba phoi pynlong ïa u Pharaoh sad ïa ki radbah pynjam jong u ban isih ïa ngi . Phi la ai dabi ïa ki baneh pynïap ïa ngi .
translation.en: And they said unto them , The  Lord  look upon you , and judge  ; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of his servants , to put a sword in their hand to slay us .

translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u hukum ïa u Joab bad ïa ki rangbah jong u ban kad ïa la ki jaiñ , ban phong ka jaiñ khain , bad ban ïambriew na ka bniat u Abner . Bad ha ka jingleit thep , u syiem Dabid da lade hi u ïaid hadien ka synduk metïap .
translation.en: And David said to Joab , and to all the people that were with him , Rend your clothes , and gird you with sackcloth , and mourn before Abner . And king David himself followed the bier .

translation.kha: Don uwei u sakhrai uba kyrteng u Ibbah ha ka longïing jong u Saul , mala la bthah ïa u ngab rupa sha u Dabid . Me dei u Siba ? u syiem u la kylli . ?(Nga hangne , ko Kynrad , u jubab .
translation.en: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba . And when they had called him unto David , the king said unto him , Art thou Ziba ? And he said , Thy servant is he .
A sword is upon the Chaldeans , saith the  Lord  , and upon the inhabitants of Babylon , and upon her princes , and upon her wise men .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka Jingïap ïa ka Babilonia ! Ka Jingïap ïa ki briew jong ka , ïa ki nongsynshar jong ka , ïa ki rangbah bastad jong ka .
Ka la ber dpei ha la ka khlieh , ka la kad ïa la ka sopti jynsur , bad da kaba buhrieh ïa la ka durkhmat da kaba tap da ki ktha ka la leit noh da kambah ïam .
translation.en: And Tamar put ashes on her head , and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her , and laid her hand on her head , and went on crying .

translation.kha: kaba me la Pynkhreh ha khmut jong ki jaitbynriew baroh :
translation.en: Which thou hast prepared before the face of all people  ;

translation.kha: U Jehoïakhin u la don khriat snem ka rta mynnin u long u symboh ka Judah , badno u la synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Nehushta , ka khun jongki u Elnathan ibha na Jerusalem .
translation.en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem three months . And his mother s name was Nehushta , the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem .
And when he had apprehended him , he put him in prison , and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him  ; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la kem ïa u , ïa u Petros la thep ha phatok , ha kaba la aiti ïa u ban ap phira da ki saw tylli ki kynhun kiba kawei kawei ka don saw ngut ki shipai . U Herod u la thmu ban bishar ha khmat u paidbah hadien ka Niam Ka Jinglait .

translation.en: For now they shall say , We have no king , because we feared not the  Lord   ; what then should a king do to us ?
translation.kha: Kine ki briew shen kin sa ong ,  Ngim don syiem , namar ngim shym la sheptieng ïa U  Trai . Hynrei kaei kaba u syiem un lah ban leh na ka bynta jong ngi ?

translation.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the first month , in the seventh day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew jong u bnai uba nyngkong ha ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

Wat trei na ka bynta ka jingbam ka ban sa sniew ; pynban , trei na ka byndi ka jingbam ka ban neh sha ka jingimat bymjukut . Kane ka un-long ka jingbat kaba U ju U Briew un ai ha phin , namar ba U Bel wahbah U Kpa , u la sngewbha ban shonshab ha u .
translation.en: Labour not for the meat which perisheth , but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life , which the Son of man shall give unto you : for him hath God the Father sealed .

They come to fight with the Chaldeans , but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men , whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury , and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city .
translation.kha: Katto katne kin ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki nong Babilonia , ki ban pyndap ïa ki ïing da ki metïap jong kito kiba ngan sa pynïap namar ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla jong nga . Nga la phai noh na kane ka nongbah namar kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba ki briew jong ka ki la leh .
Ïa kano kano ka doh kaba sah haduh ka sngi kaba lai dei ban thang noh ïa ka .
translation.en: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire .

translation.kha: Ka jingthew , ïa phi la taïew ha ki tarajur bad la shem ba phi duna palat ;
translation.en: TEKEL  ; Thou art weighed in the balances , and art found wanting .
For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom , that was overthrown as in a moment , and no hands stayed on her .
translation.kha: Ïa ki briew jong nga la pynshitom wat kham jur ban ïa ki nongshong shnong jong ka Sodom , kiba la ïashem da ka jingkyllon kaba kynsan ha ki kti jong U Blei .

translation.en: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them : but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness .
translation.kha: Ka hok ka pyllait ïa kito kiba lehhok , hynrei kito ïa kiba ym lah ban shaniah ki shah riam ha la ka jong ka jingkwah brai hi .
Ka ei ka jingiw kaba iwbih shaphang jong Phin ; ka jingsait ka kyrteng jong phi ka pynkynmaw ïa kata . Ym don kano kano ka briew ka bym lah khlem da ibit ïa phi .
translation.en: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood , so is my beloved among the sons . I sat down under his shadow with great delight , and his fruit was sweet to my taste .

translation.kha: Wat pynhiarkput ïano ïaineh lap ban ïai isih ïa u , hynrei ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba phi ieit ïa lade . Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Thou shalt not avenge , nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people , but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Ahab u ong ïa u Jehoshaphat , Nga la ong ïa phi ba um juh ïathuhlypa ïa kane kano kaba babha ïa nga ; ka long borabor kaei kaei kaba sniew !
translation.en: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat , Did I not tell thee that he would not prophesy good unto me , but evil ?
The  Lord  hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob , Surely I will never forget any of their works .
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la smai ,  Ngan ym klet lano lano ïa ki kam sniew jong ki .
Da kaba bud ïa kaei kaba la pyni haneng , pynkhraw ban pule ïa ka Kerkut Ap Phira ne ka Jingpule Baibl jong ka Balang .
translation.en: Following the method just outlined , prepare for the Watchtower Study or the Congregation Bible Study .

translation.kha: Un shimet ïa kaba shiphew na u kew bad na u sohwaiñ jongno phi na ka bynta ki rangbah synshar Aiñ badno Kawei ki rangbah shihajar .
translation.en: And he will take the tenth of your seed , and of your vineyards , and give to his officers , and to his servants .

translation.kha: Ki jingpyut jong u briew ki long kum ka um ha ka pukri kaba jylliew , hynrei uba don ka jingïohi jngai u da ïa-ban tong noh ïa ki shabar .
translation.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water  ; but a man of understanding will draw it out .

translation.kha: Me la pyn-i ïa ka jingieit banep sha ki hajar , hawei me pynshitom ruh ïa ki briew na ka bynta ki pop ki kmie ki kpa jong ki . Me long U Blei bakhraw bad badonbor ; me long U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands , and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them : the Great , the Mighty God , the  Lord  of hosts , is his name ,

translation.kha: Ki tnga jong phi , ki khun jong Phi , bad ki jingrai jong ph kin sah hangne , hynrei ki shipai jong phi , kiba la kieng atiar na ka bynta ka thma , kin dam shuwa ïa kiwei pat ki Israel khnang ban ïarap ïa ki
translation.en: Your wives , your little ones , and your cattle , shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan  ; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed , all the mighty men of valour , and help them  ;

translation.kha: U Gaddah bad ki kynhun shynrang jong u : U Sephon , u Haggi , u Shuni , u Esbon , u Eri , u Arod , bad u Areli .
translation.en: And the sons of Gad  ; Ziphion , and Haggi , Shuni , and Ezbon , Eri , and Arodi , and Areli .

translation.kha: Me pyndonkam ïa ki lyer kum ki nongpynïaidkam jong me malade ki jingthaba leilieh kum ki shakri jong me .
translation.en: Who maketh his angels spirits  ; his ministers a flaming fire :

translation.kha: Dei U Blei jong u kpa jongno me uba ïarap ïa me , U Blei Badonbor Baroh uba kyrkhu ïa me da ki jingkyrkhu u skud najrong , Bad da ki um bakha jylliew napoh khyndaiphew , Ki jingkyrkhu da shibun ki jingri bad ki khum ki kti ,
translation.en: Even by the God of thy father , who shall help thee  ; and by the Almighty , who shall bless thee with blessings of heaven above , blessings of the deep that lieth under , blessings of the breasts , and of the womb :

translation.kha: U Iso u la ïew jingtip ba u Isaak u la kyrkhu ïa u Jakob bad ba u la phah noh ïa u sha Mesopotamia ban shem ïa ka tnga . U la ïoh jingtip hati ba haba u Isaak u la kyrkhu ïa u , u lawlynnong ba un ym sohkhram ïa ka kynthei nong Kanaan .
translation.en: When Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob , and sent him away to Paddan–aram , to take him a wife from thence  ; and that as he blessed him he gave him a charge , saying , Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan  ;
How art thou fallen from heaven , O Lucifer , son of the morning ! how art thou cut down to the ground , which didst weaken the nations !
translation.kha: Ko syiem ka Babilonia , u khlur step baphyrnai , me la hap na bneng ! Ha kaba mynshuwa me la jop ïa ki hima , hynrei mynta la bret ïa me sha madan .
Tang Uto uba mutlop shaba patlun ban paw ka lynti sha ïing un pynthait ïa lade da ka jingtrei .
translation.en: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them , because he knoweth not how to go to the city .

translation.kha: Khmut ki la ai dak ïa ki lop jong ki kiba ha kawei paw ka lieng ban wan bad ïarap ïa ki . Ki la ïan bad pyndap smam ïa ki lieng baroh ar tylli da ki dohkha , ba ki lieng ki la jan ngam .
translation.en: And they beckoned unto their partners , which were in the other ship , that they should come and help them . And they came , and filled both the ships , so that they began to sink .

translation.kha: Ïa ka tare ha ka phrang sorki Jong ka Jordan la ai ïa ki longïing Ibbah sah na ka jait Mahseïah : u Abieser , u Balak , u Suriel , u Shekhem , u Sher , nabar u Shemiramoth . Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u Manasseh , u khun jong u Joseph bad ki long ki khlieh jong ki Long .
translation.en: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families  ; for the children of Abiezer , and for the children of Helek , and for the children of Asriel , and for the children of Shechem , and for the children of Hepher , and for the children of Shemida : these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families .

translation.kha: U ni badonbor ïa ka jingong U Blei ; hynrei um shym pyrkhat ïa kata da ka bor ba u dei ban pyrshang ban pynlong mar ryngkat bad U Blei .
translation.en: Who , being in the form of God , thought it not robbery to be equal with God :

translation.kha: Ha baroh kaba u leh u long uba ïajan bad uba hok ; ki Law jong u barieh ki long ibha haw ban shaniah .
translation.en: The works of his hands are verity and judgment  ; all his commandments are sure .
Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished .
translation.kha: Kan mut ruh ba kiba ngeit ha U Khrist , kiba la ïap ki long kiba la jot noh keiñ .
(Nga jubab , Ka mynstep ka wan , hynrei ka miet sa wan biang . Lada phi kwah ban Kylli biang , sa wan pat bad kylli .
translation.en: The watchman said , The morning cometh , and also the night : if ye will enquire , enquire ye : return , come .

translation.kha: Nangta , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phin leh ne phi ong , dei ban leh ha ka kyrngah Jong U Trai Jisu , ha kaba phira nongtuh da u ïa U Blei uba U kba .
translation.en: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed , do all in the name of the Lord Jesus , giving thanks to God and the Father by him .

translation.kha: Nga khot ïa me , A Blei , hynñiew mem ju Joab ; bad haba nga ïadie , mem sngap shuh .
translation.en: I cry unto thee , and thou dost not hear me : I stand up , and thou regardest me not .
Son of man , speak unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , and to his multitude  ; Whom art thou like in thy greatness ?
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to ong ha u syiem jong ka Ijipt bad ha ki briew jong u baroh :  Katno ka jingkhrawbor jong me ! Bad kaei ngan ïanujor ïa me ?
Ki wahduid kiba la khleh lang bad ka ïor lem bad u thah ,
translation.en: Which are blackish by reason of the ice , and wherein the snow is hid :
And he made a veil of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen : with cherubims made he it of cunning work .
translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ka pyrda da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u  saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad la suh pynpur itynnat bha ha ka da ki dur ki Kherub .

translation.en: And I heard another voice from heaven , saying , Come out of her , my people , that ye be not partakers of her sins , and that ye receive not of her plagues .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa kawei pat ka sur na bneng , ka da ong ,  To mihnoh , ko ki briew jong nga ! To mihnoh na ka ! Phim dei ban ïashim bynta ha ki pop jong ka ; phim dei ban ïoh bynta ha ka jingshah pynshitom jong ka !

translation.en: When they stood , these stood  ; and when they were lifted up , these lifted up themselves also : for the spirit of the living creature was in them .
translation.kha: Haba ki kherub ki sangeh , ki shalyntem ruh ki sangeh ; bad haba ki kherub ki her , ki shalyntem ruh ki leit lang bad ki , namar ki kherub ki pynïaid ïa ki .

Bad kaei kaba ngan ïathuh ïa me ka long kaba shisha . U apostol u la ong , Sa per ngut ki syiem kin synshar hajar ka Persia , yn bud sa uba saw , u baneh kham riewspah Ban ïa baroh kiwei patiaw . Haba u la khlaiñbor bhah bad riewspah eh un kiba ïa ka hima Gris .
translation.en: And now will I shew thee the truth . Behold , there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia  ; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all : and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia .

translation.kha: Phi ïuh katno ki tai heh nga pynong haba nga thoh sha phi Mynta da la ka jong ka kiei!
translation.en: Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand .

translation.kha: U la pynhun ïa tun kiba sliang bad pyndih ïa Kiba thngan da kiei kiei kiba bha .
translation.en: For he satisfieth the longing soul , and filleth the hungry soul with goodness .
If thine enemy be hungry , give him bread to eat  ; and if he be thirsty , give him water to drink :
translation.kha: Lada u nongshun jong phi u thngan , bsa ïa u ; lada u sliang , ai um ba un dih .

translation.en: For here have we no continuing city , but we seek one to come .
translation.kha: Naba ym don ka nongbah kaba ïaineh na ka bynta jong ngi hangne ha pyrthei , ngi ap khmih ïa ka nongbah ka ban sa wan .

translation.en: And he answered , Thou shalt not smite them : wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow ? set bread and water before them , that they may eat and drink , and go to their master .
translation.kha: U jubab ,  Em ! ym dei wat ïa ki shipai kiba me la ïohkem ha ka jingïaleh mem dei ban pynïap . Ai ïa ki katto katne ban bam bad dih , bad ieh kin leit phai sha la u syiem .
U Jisu , da ka ktien kaweh eh u la hukum ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid ban ym ïathuh ïano ïano ba u long uei .
translation.en: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known .

translation.kha: Wat ju pynkynriah ïa u mawpud ba ki kpa tmain jong Phin ki la thung naduh mynbarim .
translation.en: Remove not the ancient landmark , which thy fathers have set .

translation.kha: Kartan me long ibha khraw ; A Trai Nongsynshar ! Ym don uwei pat uba khem ma me , ngi la ju tip ba dien tang ma me hi uba long U Blei .
translation.en: Wherefore thou art great , O  Lord  God : for there is none like thee , neither is there any God beside thee , according to all that we have heard with our ears .

translation.kha: Haba u Shelah u la dap laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh kynhun shynrang , u Eber ;
translation.en: And Salah lived thirty years , and begat Eber :

translation.kha: Kita ki khynnah shynrang ki la nang san nang ïabah , bad u Iso u kyllan long u nongbeh nud uba tbit , u briew uba iktiar ban shang lum shang wah , katba u Jobab pat u longïng u briew uba jar jar , uba shong tang ha ïohnong .
translation.en: And the boys grew : and Esau was a cunning hunter , a man of the field  ; and Jacob was a plain man , dwelling in tents .
The land of Zabulon , and the land of Nephthalim , by the way of the sea , beyond Jordan , Galilee of the Gentiles  ;
translation.kha: Ko ka ri Sebulun bad ka ri Naphtali , kaba ha lynti sha ka duriaw , ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka Jordan , ka Galilaïa , ka ri ki Jentil !
Nangta u trai u la phah ïa uwei pat u mraw ; ki nongshimwai ki la tied ïa u na ka khlieh bad ki la sa khlem akor ïa u .
translation.en: And again he sent unto them another servant  ; and at him they cast stones , and wounded him in the head , and sent him away shamefully handled .

translation.kha: To ar ïa kiei kiei baroh khlaw da khñium ne khlem ïania ,
translation.en: Do all things without murmurings and disputings :

All that pass by clap their hands at thee  ; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem , saying , Is this the city that men call The perfection of beauty , The joy of the whole earth ?
translation.kha: U Trai u rkhiebeiñ ïa baroh ki shipai bakhlaiñ tam jong nga ; u la phah ka kynhun shipai ban pynjot ïa ki samla shynrang jong nga . U la pynlwet ïa ki briew jong nga kum ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ka jaka khñiot sohwaiñ .

translation.en: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good ?
translation.kha: Kaba bha bad kaba sniew kumjuh ki jia ha ka hukum jong u .

translation.en: Which commandeth the sun , and it riseth not  ; and sealeth up the stars .
translation.kha: U lah ban khang ïa ka sngi ba kan mih , bad ïa ki khlur ban tyngshaiñ mynmiet .
U Jisu u la jop , Khie leit phai bad ïathuh ïa u Ïoannis ïa kaei kaba phin sngewkwah bad ïohi :
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Go and shew John again those things which ye do hear and see :

Behold now , I have two daughters which have not known man  ; let me , I pray you , bring them out unto you , and do ye to them as is good in your eyes : only unto these men do nothing  ; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof .
translation.kha: Khmih shane , nga don ar ngut ki khun kynthei kiba dang sotti . Shah ngan wallam ïa ki sha phi , bad phi lah ban leh ïa ki katba phi mon . Hynrei wat leh ei ei ïa kine ki rangbah ; ki dei kiba nga la khot sngewbha sha ka ïing jong nga , bad nga dei ban ïada ïa ki .
Da ïaid ha ki lyndet kiba beit , haneng ba ïa kata ka kjat kaba dkoh yn ym pynduhbor noh , hynrei pynban , yn pynitynnat Keiñ ïa ka .
translation.en: And make straight paths for your feet , lest that which is lame be turned out of the way  ; but let it rather be healed .

translation.kha: Mynta , to leit ban pynskhem bajngum ïa ki rangbah jong phoi . Nga smai ha ka kyrteng U tharai ba dalade phim har kumta , yn ym don shuh uwei ruh na ki u ban don bad phi lehkai mynstep . Kata kan long ka jingjynjar kambah sniew kam ka phin shah ha ka jingim jyllang phi baroh .
translation.en: Now therefore arise , go forth , and speak comfortably unto thy servants : for I swear by the  Lord  , if thou go not forth , there will not tarry one with thee this night : and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now .

translation.kha: Naba ki la ïarwai jingjaw bad ki la leit noh sha u lum ki Oreb .
translation.en: And when they had sung an hymn , they went out into the mount of Olives .
This is the first and great commandment .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka hukum kaba khraw tam bad kaba donkam tam .

translation.en: Which yet my soul seeketh , but I find not : one man among a thousand have I found  ; but a woman among all those have I not found .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih ïa kiwei pat ki jubab hynrei ngam shem ei ei . Nga la shem uwei u briew na ki shihajar ngut uba nga lah ban burom , hynrei ym don kawei ruh ka kynthei .

translation.en: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way .
translation.kha: Ka la long ha kaba kum kane ka por ba ka la don ka jingeh kaba jur ha Ephesos namar ka Lynti jong U Trai .

translation.en: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai , and spakest with them from heaven , and gavest them right judgments , and true laws , good statutes and commandments :
translation.kha: Ha u Lum Sinai me wan hiar na bneng ; me kren ha ki briew bad me ai ïa ki , ki hukum babha bad ki jinghikai baskhem .

translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , I will disguise myself , and enter into the battle  ; but put thou on thy robes . And the king of Israel disguised himself , and went into the battle .
translation.kha: U Ahab u ong ha u Jehoshaphat ,  Katba ngi dang leit sha ka thma , ngan riam pher ïa lade , hynrei phi riam ha ki jaiñphong syiem jong phi .  Kumta u syiem Israel u leit sha ka thma da jingriam pher .

translation.en: Ye mountains of Gilboa , let there be no dew , neither let there be rain , upon you , nor fields of offerings : for there the shield of the mighty is vilely cast away , the shield of Saul , as though he had not been anointed with oil .
translation.kha: Wat ai ban hap u slap ne ka umjer halor ki lum Gilboa ; Ai ba ki lyngkha jong ka kin ïailong shrah ! Naba ki stieh jong kiba shlur ki don hangta ha ka jingjahburom ; ïa ka stieh u Saul ym shym la shut phyrnai shuh da ka umphniang .
Ai ba ka jingieit babniah jong me kan pyntngen ïa nga , kitab me la kular ïa nga , u shakor Jong me .
translation.en: Let , I pray thee , thy merciful kindness be for my comfort , according to thy word unto thy servant .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , ki Philetos ki la jingïalumlang ïa la u paidïapom ban ïaleit ïa ki Jesreel bad U Akhish u ong ha u Nadab , Da shisha phi tip ba ma phi malade ki briew jong phi ki dei ban ïaleh ha ka liang jong sa .
translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare , to fight with Israel . And Achish said unto David , Know thou assuredly , that thou shalt go out with me to battle , thou and thy men .
In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah , and made a king over themselves .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ba u Jehoram u synshar , ka Edom ka ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Judah , bad ka la kylla long ka hima kaba laitluid .

translation.en: For the law having a shadow of good things to come , and not the very image of the things , can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect .
translation.kha: Ka Hukum ki Jiw kam dei ka nuksa ba-pura bad baïaineh jong kiei kiei kiba shisha ; ka long tang ka nuksa batlot jong kita kiei kiei kiba bha ki ban sa wan . Ïa kijuh ki jait jingkñia la ju ainguh lynter , na kawei ka snem sha kawei pat ka snem . Kumno kata ka Hukum , te , da kaba leh ïa kine ki jingkñia kan lah ban pynjanai ïa ki briew kiba wan sha U Blei ?
Bad kumta nga pynbna ba ngan Tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia malade ban pynjah syndon ïa ki . nur pynjot ïa kiba sah baroh kiba ïalang im ha ki jaka madan ka Philistia .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines , and I will cut off the Cherethims , and destroy the remnant of the sea coast .

As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel , because it was desolate , so will I do unto thee : thou shalt be desolate , O mount Seir , and all Edom , even all of it : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: kumba me shadkmen ha ka jingpynjot ïa ka Israel , ka nongkynti jong nga . Ki lumbah ka Seir , ho-oid , baroh ka ri Edom kin sah kynjah . Te baroh kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .

U Moses u thoh ïa ki hukum baroh jong U Trai . Dang step pynphieng ha ka sngi kaba buid , u tei ïa ka duwan ha trai jong u lum , bad u pynïeng duh khat-ar tylli ki maw , uwei u maw na ka bynta Kaei kawei ka jait Israel .
translation.en: And Moses wrote all the words of the  Lord  , and rose up early in the morning , and builded an altar under the hill , and twelve pillars , according to the twelve tribes of Israel .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki paid Israel ki la ker sawdong ïa nga da ki jinglamler bad jingshukor , bad ki paid Judah ki dang ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , U Blei baïaineh bad uba khuid .
translation.en: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies , and the house of Israel with deceit : but Judah yet ruleth with God , and is faithful with the saints .

translation.kha: U Moses u pynkloi ban nguh dem haduh Khynñiuh bad u la mane .
translation.en: And Moses made haste , and bowed his head toward the earth , and worshipped .

translation.kha: Pynban ki paid Manasseh kim skhem lah ban beh noh ïa ki bynriew kiba shong basah ha wer ki nongbah , kumta ki Kanaan ki dang ïaishong hangno .
translation.en: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities  ; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .

translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki la ïaleh ïahiar bad ka , bad ki briew jong ka pyrthei ki la buaid na kaba dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka jingawria jong ka .
translation.en: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication , and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication .

translation.kha: Nga long hok , A Blei’ . Pdiang ïa ka ktien jongki nga . Ym ni mano mano u ban kyrshan ïa kaba nga ong .
translation.en: Lay down now , put me in a surety with thee  ; who is he that will strike hands with me ?
And I will make thee exceeding fruitful , and I will make nations of thee , and kings shall come out of thee .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew , bad katto katne na ki , kin long ki syiem . Men ïoh shibun ki khun ki ksiew kiba yn sa long ki jaitbynriew .
Gera kumta ka Hukum ka synshar ïa ngi tad haduh ba U Khrist u la wan , khnang ba yn lah ban pynksan ïa ngi ha U blei da ka jingngeit .
translation.en: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ , that we might be justified by faith .

translation.kha: hynrei haba la dep baher , ka khlem Ieh ei ei ïa phi hynrei tang ka jingkthang bad ka jingpang .
translation.en: But her end is bitter as wormwood , sharp as a twoedged sword .

translation.kha: U la bitar jin ïa ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u Job . Kim shym don lynti ban jingbabe ïa u Hobab , bad ka pynjop pynban kumba U Balei u la rumal .
translation.en: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled , because they had found no answer , and yet had condemned Job .

translation.kha: Ka khubor babha ka long jin ba ka jingbishar ïa ki niam kiba hikai bakla kan sa wan shen .
translation.en: The coming judgment of false religion is good news .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la jingsngewsih ïa kawei kaweh sai kum u paid ibha bun , kum ka jingsam jong ka jingkyrhuh jongu ka ksai , kum ki jingtied jam jong u pynthait . Nga la ïasngew ïa ki ba ki ong , To ïaroh ïa U Blei ! Nadab U Trai , U Blei Badonbor Baroh jong ngi , u long U Syiem !
translation.en: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude , and as the voice of many waters , and as the voice of mighty thunderings , saying , Alleluia : for the Lord God omnipotent reigneth .

translation.kha: Kumta katba u Joah u dang kerkut ïa kata ka nongbah , u la phah ïa u Ur sha ka jaka ha kaba u ïatip ba u nongshun u khlaw bha .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joab observed the city , that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were .

translation.kha: Nangta nga ïakyrpad ïa u ban Lehsbun ïa at da kaba ai ha nga ïa ki shithi sha ki lat ka Probins Ïuphratis Kaba Shaphang Sepngi , da kiba bthah ïa ki ngab Shah ïa nga ban ïaid lyngba sha Judah .

translation.kha: U rangbah Shipai uba stad u lah ban ngop ïa ka nongbah kaba la ïalade da ki briew kiba khlaw , bad pynkhyllem ïa ki kynrei ha kiba ki shaniah .
translation.en: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty , and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof .

translation.kha: Shah tun wanrah khyndiat ka um ba phin ïohi saisaw ïa ki khet jong phi ; phi lah ban shong jahthait ha trai jongno une u dieng .
translation.en: Let a little water , I pray you , be fetched , and wash your feet , and rest yourselves under the tree :
That which is born of the flesh is flesh  ; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit .
translation.kha: Ïa u briew la kha ha ka doh na ki kmie ki kpa kiba long ki briew , hynrei la kha ha kaba kynja mynsiem na U Mynsiem .

translation.en: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim , saying , Come down against the Midianites , and take before them the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan . Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together , and took the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan .
translation.kha: U Gideon u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ka ri lum Ephraim baroh ban ong ,  Ale wan hiar ban ïaleh ïa ki Midian . Ïeng skhem ha ka wah Jordan bad ha ki wahduid haduh Bethbarah , ban khang ïa ki Midian na kaba jam ïa ki sha shiliang .  Ki rangbah Ephraim ki la ïalumlang , bad ki la ïeng skhem ha ka wah Jordan bad ha kita ki wahduid haduh Bethbarah .
Ho-oid , ko Trai ! ka la Jubab . Nga ieit ba me long U Messaïah , U Khun U Blei , u ban sa wan sha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: She saith unto him , Yea , Lord : I believe that thou art the Christ , the Son of God , which should come into the world .
Then certain of the scribes and of the Pharisees answered , saying , Master , we would see a sign from thee .
translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad katto katne ki Pharisi ki la kren .  Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  ngi kwah ban ïohi ïa me ba me leh kambah .
Nangta ki la ïoh ïa kaei kaba i kum ki thylliej dieng kiba pur kadlieng bad ktah ïa uwei pa uei u briew hangtai .
translation.en: And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like as of fire , and it sat upon each of them .

translation.kha: Heldai khnai baroh , don tang kawei ban ong : To tiengburom ïa U Blei , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u , namar dei ïa kan keiñ ba la thaw ïa u briew .
translation.en: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter : Fear God , and keep his commandments : for this is the whole duty of man .

translation.kha: Bad myntoi por don kawei ka jingkyrpad ; sngewbha wat kyrngah ïa nga . Kaei sier ? ka Bathsheba ka kyrmen .
translation.en: And now I ask one petition of thee , deny me not . And she said unto him , Say on .

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha Jerushah , la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki da ka balang , da ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang , ha kiba ki la ïathuh ïa baroh kaban U Blei u la leh lyngngoh jong ki .
translation.en: And when they were come to Jerusalem , they were received of the church , and of the apostles and elders , and they declared all things that God had done with them .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la ong , to kren pyrshah ïa ka ri ki Amen .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against the Ammonites , and prophesy against them  ;

translation.kha: Ki san nud ki syiem Amor , pynban , ki la phet ïap bad riew hapoh ka kem ha Makkedah .
translation.en: But these five kings fled , and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah .

translation.kha: Ahian ba U Jisu u la ïai-ong ïa kane , u la khuslai jur nabar u la pynbna da kob shai , “Nga ïathuh ha phira ïa ka jingshisha : Uwei na phi un sa shalyngka ïa por .
translation.en: When Jesus had thus said , he was troubled in spirit , and testified , and said ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , that one of you shall betray me .

translation.kha: Ko Jeriel , U Blei uba la thaw ïa phi! u ainong , Wat sheptieng — nur-um pyllait im ïa phi , por la khot ïa phi! da ka kyrteng — phi long u jyllang ang .
translation.en: But now thus saith the  Lord  that created thee , O Jacob , and he that formed thee , O Israel , Fear not : for I have redeemed thee , I have called thee by thy name  ; thou art mine .

And they shall cover the face of the earth , that one cannot be able to see the earth : and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped , which remaineth unto you from the hail , and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field :
translation.kha: Kin jyllei kat haduh ba kin tap lin ïa ka khyndew baroh . Kin bam lut khoit ïa kata baroh kaba u phria um shym la pynjot , bad wat ïa ki dieng kiba dang sah .

translation.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day , as the king bade , saying , Come again to me on the third day .
translation.kha: Hadien lai sngi u Jeroboam bad ki briew baroh ki leit pat sha u syiem Rehoboam , kumba u la bthah ïa ki .
Wat ym pynsheptieng , ko ka nongbah Seïon ! Hangne u shym jrong pha u wan , u da shong hajar u khun kam .
translation.en: Fear not , daughter of Sion : behold , thy King cometh , sitting on an ass s colt .
Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: ban ong ha ki Israel ,  Ka Jingkhawai Niam ki Ïingtrep ka sdang na ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba hynñiew , bad ka neh hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: And it came to pass from that time forth , that the half of my servants wrought in the work , and the other half of them held both the spears , the shields , and the bows , and the habergeons  ; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah .
translation.kha: Naduh kata , shiteng na ki rangbah jong nga ki trei bad shiteng ki ïeng ban ap phira , da kaba phong ki jingphong jong ka jingkieng atiar bad bat da ki sum , ki stieh bad ki ryntieh . Ki nongïalam jong ngi ki ai ka jingkyrshan batylli ïa ki briew kiba trei ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh .

translation.en: This is the law , when a man dieth in a tent : all that come into the tent , and all that is in the tent , shall be unclean seven days .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u ïap hapoh ka ïingjaiñ , mano mano ba don hapoh ka ïingjaiñ ha ka por ba ïap lane ba rung hapoh jong ka u long u bymkhuid haduh hynñiew sngi .

translation.en: Through wisdom is an house builded  ; and by understanding it is established :
translation.kha: Ïa ki ïing la tei halor ka nongrim jong ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang .
Ym don mane mano ba lah ban thied ne die khlem ne kaei ka shab , kaba long , ka kyrngah jong u mradkhlaw lane u dak jingkhein uba ïeng na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u .
translation.en: And that no man might buy or sell , save he that had the mark , or the name of the beast , or the number of his name .

translation.kha: Bun ki briew kin kyndit haba kin ïohi ïa u ; la pynsmieij briew’ ïa u haduh ba um i shuh kum u briew .
