translation.en: As many were astonished at thee  ; his visage was so marred more than any man , and his form more than the sons of men :
And Moses was very wroth , and said unto the  Lord  , Respect not thou their offering : I have not taken one ass from them , neither have I hurt one of them .
translation.kha: U Moses u la bitar lep , bad u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Wat pdiang ïa kano kano ka jingainguh ba kine ki briew ki wallam . Ngam shym la leh bymdei ïa uwei ruh na ki ; ngam shym la shim ruh wat tang kawei na ki kada jong ki .

translation.en: Thy sun shall no more go down  ; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself : for the  Lord  shall be thine everlasting light , and the days of thy mourning shall be ended .
translation.kha: Ki sngi ka jingjynjar jong pha kin kut noh . Ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan long ka jingshai bymjukut jong pha , kham palat ban ïa ka sngi bad u bnai .
Long ba la tim kata ka sngi ba la kha ïa ang ! To kheit noh ïa ka snieh ba i mei jong nga i kha ïa nga !
translation.en: Cursed be the day wherein I was born : let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed .
Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar , and sanctify it  ; and it shall be an altar most holy : whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi lynter men leh ïa kane man la ka sngi . Te ka duwan kan sa long kaba khuid phar ; bad ka bor jong ka jingkhuid jong ka kan pynmynsaw kat ïa uba ktah ïa ka .
Hynrei um kheiñ kor ïa ka jingiw jingmut jong kita ki riewrangbah , bad u leit pynban sha ki sum Kiba ïajah ïatan pyntud bad u bad Ibbah long mynta ki nongaibuit jongki u .
translation.en: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him , and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him , that stood before him .

translation.kha: La ai ha nga ïa u ding uba syriem ïa u diengthew , bad la ong ïa nga , Khie leit bad thew ïa ka Templ U Blei bad ïa ka jingnguh , bad ñiew ïa kito kiba mane ha ka palat .
translation.en: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod : and the angel stood , saying , Rise , and measure the temple of God , and the altar , and them that worship therein .

translation.kha: Uno eit uba pyrshang ban pynïoh mynta ïa la ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka , hynrei uno uno uba duh nala ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un ïoh ïa ka .
translation.en: He that findeth his life shall lose it : and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it .

And it came to pass at the end of the year , that the host of Syria came up against him : and they came to Judah and Jerusalem , and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people , and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus .
translation.kha: Haba ka synrai ka la poi ha kata ka snem , ka kynhun shipai Syria ka la tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , ki la pynïap ïa ki nongïalam baroh , bad ki la kit shibun ki mar lute sha Damaskos .

translation.en: And her parents were astonished : but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done .
translation.kha: Ka kmie bad u kpa jong ka ki la lyngngoh shikatdei , hynrei U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ban ym ïathuh hano hano ïa kaei kaba la jia .
U Trai U Blei jong nga u la ong ha nga , To leh ïa ka bynta jong u nongaplangbrot jong ka kynhun langbrot kaba dei ban shahskhor shohdoh .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  my God  ; Feed the flock of the slaughter  ;

translation.kha: Haba phi rung sha ka ri ïa kaba U Trai u la kular ban ai ha phi , phin dei ban leh ïa kane ka jingshim .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when ye be come to the land which the  Lord  will give you , according as he hath promised , that ye shall keep this service .

And the blood shall be to you for a token upon the houses where ye are : and when I see the blood , I will pass over you , and the plague shall not be upon you to destroy you , when I smite the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ka snam ha ki shawkad kan long ka dak ban pyn-i ïa ki ïing ha kiba phi shong . Haba nga ïohi ïa kata ka snam , ngan ïaid lait na phi , bad ngan ym ktah ïa phi haba nga pynshitom ïa ki nong Ijipt .
Te ngan pynhap noh ïa ka ryntieh jong u na ka kti kadiang lad u nabar ki khnam jong u Kin hap noh na ka kti kamon Jong u .
translation.en: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand , and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand .

translation.kha: Ki nonghikai jingmad jong u syiem ki la ïawan sha khmat , hynrei ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban pule ïa ka jingtynjuh lane ïathuh ha u syiem aïu ka kit jingmut .
translation.en: Then came in all the king s wise men : but they could not read the writing , nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof .
And ships shall come from the coast of Kittim , and shall afflict Asshur , and shall afflict Eber , and he also shall perish for ever .
translation.kha: Ki nonghiarthma kin wan da ki lieng na Sypros ; Kin jop ïa u Assyria bad u Eber , Hynrei ma ki ruh kin jah noh jar .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Take a pot , and put an omer full of manna therein , and lay it up before the  Lord  , to be kept for your generations .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ong ha u Aaron ,  Shim uwei u khiew , thep ar kilo ka manna ha u , nangta buh ïa u ha khmat U  Trai  , na ka bynta ki khun ki ksiew jong ngi .
Hynrei Ladan hapoh ka dohnud jong phi , phi ni ka jingpyntieng , bad khnang myntoi , to wat leh ngop pyrshah ïa ka jingshisha da kaba kren sarong ïa la ka jingstad .
translation.en: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts , glory not , and lie not against the truth .

translation.kha: U biria u bym shem ïa de u pynmong ïa lade ; kat uba Isih ïa por u ieit ïa ka jingïap .
translation.en: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul : all they that hate me love death .

translation.kha: Wat shah ïano ïano ban Shur ïa phi ha kano Kanah ka rukom . Naba ka Sngi kan ym Wan tad ïada ka Jingïaleh pyrshah ka jia bad ba utai Uba Sniew u mawthoh ïa suba la buh lypa na ka bynta ka dujok .
translation.en: Let no man deceive you by any means : for that day shall not come , except there come a falling away first , and that man of sin be revealed , the son of perdition ;

translation.kha: Ki la bitar Haduh katta! katta ïa nga badno suda ban shoh ïa nga bad ban set ïa nga ha ka ïng u Ioannis , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , kaba ïa ka ïing jong u la pynlong ka bynriew .
translation.en: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah , and smote him , and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe : for they had made that the prison .
But Peter said , Not so , Lord  ; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la ong ,  Da lei lei ruh em , ko Trai ! ngam pat ju bam mynno mynno ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid lane kaba sang kat kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: And Adam was not deceived , but the woman being deceived was in the transgression .
translation.kha: Bad ym dei u Adam uba la shah shukor ; dei ka kynthei kaba la shah shukor bad pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum U Blei .

translation.en: And Jacob took a stone , and set it up for a pillar .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u shim uwei u maw bad u pynïeng ïa u kum ka jingsah jingkynmaw .

Ka khyndew baroh ha kaba phin ïuhkjat kan long ka jong phi . Ka ri jong phi kan ïar naduh ka ri shyiap shaphang shathie haduh ki lum Lebanon shaphang shait , nabar naduh ka wah Ïuphratis shang mynhyndai shuh ka Duriaw Maaseïah Shaphan sepngi .
translation.en: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours : from the wilderness and Lebanon , from the river , the river Euphrates , even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be .

translation.kha: Ki nongwei ki dem ngon ha iitkhmat jong nga ; haba ki ïohsngew ïa nga , ki kohnguh .
translation.en: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me : as soon as they hear , they shall be obedient unto me .
And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity : the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him  ;
translation.kha: Baroh ar , u nongïathuhlypa bad uta uba kylli na u , kin ïoh ïa kajuh ka jingshah pynshitom .

translation.en: And in the wilderness , where thou hast seen how that the  Lord  thy God bare thee , as a man doth bear his son , in all the way that ye went , until ye came into this place .
translation.kha: bad ha ka ri shyiap . Phi la ïohi kumno u la bah ïa phi khlem jingmynsaw baroh shi lynter lynti haduh kane ka jaka , kumba u kpa u bah ïa la u khun .’

translation.en: But they hearkened not : and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the  Lord  destroyed before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong ka Judah kim shym kohnguh ïa U  Trai  bad u Manasseh u la ïalam ïa ki ban leh wat ïa ki pop kiba kham khraw ban ïa kito kiba la leh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki tur shaphrang .
To Shahshkor ïa ki na ka iing jong me ha bneng , map ïa ki , bad ïarap ïa ki . Dang ma me hi suba tipbriew ïa ki jingmut jong ka dohnud briew .
translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and forgive , and do , and give to every man according to his ways , whose heart thou knowest  ; ( for thou , even thou only , knowest the hearts of all the children of men  ; )

translation.kha: hynriew u ïuh ba ka jaka shongthait ka long kaba bha , Bun ba ka khyndew ka erlangthari kaba itynnat . Kumjuh u pyndem la ka met ban kit ïa ka jingit , Bad la pynbor ban trei kum u mraw .
translation.en: And he saw that rest was good , and the land that it was pleasant  ; and bowed his shoulder to bear , and became a servant unto tribute .
And Abraham planted a grove in Beer–sheba , and called there on the name of the  Lord  , the everlasting God .
translation.kha: Te U Abraham u la thung uwei u dieng Tamarisk ha Beersheba bad u la mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei Bymjukut .

translation.en: O  Lord  , correct me , but with judgment  ; not in thine anger , lest thou bring me to nothing .
translation.kha: Pynbeit ïa ki briew jong me , A  Trai  ; hynrei wat leh tyngeh halor jong ngi lane pynshitom ïa ngi haba me bitar ; kata ka lah ban long ka jingkut jong ngi .
Te ïa U Khrist la peh ha ki kynïan ! Hato dei u Paul uba la ïalap halor ka diengphna namar jongno phi ? Hato la pynbaptis ïa phi kum ki synran jong u Paul ?
translation.en: Is Christ divided ? was Paul crucified for you ? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul ?
And whatsoever ye do , do it heartily , as to the Lord , and not unto men ;
translation.kha: Ïa kaei kaei kaba phi leh , trei ïa ka naduh mynsiem , kumba phi trei na ka bynta U Trai bad ym na ka bynta ki briew .

U Blei u la jingduh haneng ïa kai kaba ka pyrthei ka kheiñ ba ka lama kaba ibieit khnai ïa-ban pynlehrain ïa kiba stad , bad u la jied ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka kheiñ ba ka long kabu tlot khnang ban pynlehrain ïa kiba donbor .
translation.en: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise ; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty ;
And five of them were wise , and five were foolish .
translation.kha: San ngut na ki , ki la long kiba bieit , bad san ngut kiwei pat ki la long kiba stad .
Nangta u Moses u ïathuh ïa ki ktien jong kane ka jingrwai barben kawei katba ki paid Israel borbah ki shahshkor .
translation.en: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song , until they were ended .

translation.kha: La don u briew uba kyrteng u Elkanah , uba na ka khait Hapharaim , uba shong ha ka shnong Ramah kaban ha ri lum Ephraim . U dei u khun jong u Jeroham bad u khun kiew jongngi u Elah , bad u dei na ka longïing jong u Tohu kaba hap hapoh ka jait Suph .
translation.en: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim–zophim , of mount Ephraim , and his name was Elkanah , the son of Jeroham , the son of Elihu , the son of Tohu , the son of Zuph , an Ephrathite :
And brought out Israel from among them : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: U la ïalam noh ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame , and thine infamy turn not away .
translation.kha: Lym kumta baroh kin tip ba phi long u bym lah ban set ïa kiei kiei kiba rieh bad phin ym lah ban lait na kane ka jinglehrain .

U don ka kynruh ki liengbah kiba ïaid sha duriaw ryngkat bad ki lybong jong u syiem Hiram . Shisien lai snem ki lieng jong u ki wan phai , ki da kit ïa ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki bniat duh , ki tngaw , bad ki shrieh .
translation.en: For the king s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram : every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold , and silver , ivory , and apes , and peacocks .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , ong u Stad saiñpyrkhat , nga la shem ïa kane khyndiat pa khyndiat katba nga dang wad ïa ki jubab .
translation.en: Behold , this have I found , saith the preacher , counting one by one , to find out the account :

translation.kha: Lada phi kwah ban hir kiba kmen , to Lehsbun ïa kiba duk ; ka long ka pop ban ñiuhlieh ïano ïano .
translation.en: He that despiseth his neighbour sinneth : but he that hath mercy on the poor , happy is he .

translation.kha: bad u Jehu u ong ha u Bidkar , u nongjop jong u , Shim bret ïa ka tat jong u ha ka lyngkha kaba daiñ ka jong u Nephtoah . Phi kynmaw ba mynba ma Phin bad ma nga ngi ïangat ïabud ha la ki kulai nadien u Ahab , u kpa jong u syiem Joram , U Trai u la kren ïa kine ki ktien pyrshah ïa u Asaph :
translation.en: Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain , Take up , and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite : for remember how that , when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father , the  Lord  laid this burden upon him  ;

That thou mightest fear the  Lord  thy God , to keep all his statutes and his commandments , which I command thee , thou , and thy son , and thy son s son , all the days of thy life  ; and that thy days may be prolonged .
translation.kha: Katba phi dang im , ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi , phi dei ban tiengburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u ïa kiba nga ai ha phi , khnang ba phi lah ban im slem ha kata ka ri .

translation.en: Yet he also is wise , and will bring evil , and will not call back his words : but will arise against the house of the evildoers , and against the help of them that work iniquity .
translation.kha: U tip ïa kaei kaba u leh ! U phah ka jingjot . U phah ïa ki jingbyrngem ban pynshitom ïa ki briew kiba sniew bad kito kiba ïada ïa ki .
Hynrei ngan pyllait im ïa la ki langbrot bad ngan ym shah ba yn lehbeiñ shu ïa ki . Ngan hajar ïa kawei pa kadei na ki langbrot jong nga bad pynïakhlad ïa kiba bha na kiba sniew .
translation.en: Therefore will I save my flock , and they shall no more be a prey  ; and I will judge between cattle and cattle .

translation.kha: Ki tnat jong u ki long kiba khlaiñbor bun ki san ban long u diengsynshar ba kynja syiem . U Dieng sohwaiñ u la syn jrong eh ban kut ïa ki lyoh ; wai uwei baroh u la ïohi haduh katno u la long uba rdin ki sla bad uba jrong .
translation.en: And she had strong rods for the sceptres of them that bare rule , and her stature was exalted among the thick branches , and she appeared in her height with the multitude of her branches .
And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering , and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering .
translation.kha: Un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong ka bad un pynïap ïa ka ha ka phang kaba shatei jong ka duwan , ha ka jaka ba ju pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia ainguh thang .

translation.en: And all the men were about twelve .
translation.kha: Ki la don baroh khat-ar ngut ki rangbah .
U Trai un ainong ïa kito baroh naba hok nabar ïaineh . Ha kane ka sngi u la aiti ïa phi ha ka bor jongngi nga , hyndai ngam shym la pynmynsaw ïa phi , uta ïa uba U Trai u la pynphong syep .
translation.en: The  Lord  render to every man his righteousness and his faithfulness : for the  Lord  delivered thee into my hand to day , but I would not stretch forth mine hand against the  Lord s  anointed .

translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingriam U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba ïaisah shongkha bad la ka kiaw kurim .’ Badno u paidbah baroh un jubab plain , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that lieth with his mother in law . And all the people shall say , Amen .
The wise men are ashamed , they are dismayed and taken : lo , they have rejected the word of the  Lord   ; and what wisdom is in them ?
translation.kha: Ïa ki rangbah bastad jong phi la buh ha ka jinglehrain ; ki la shaïong bad shah riam . Ki la kyntait ïa ki ktien jong nga ; ka jingstad kaba kumno ki la ïoh mynta ?

translation.en: Fear ye not therefore , ye are of more value than many sparrows .
translation.kha: Kumta wat sheptieng , phi kham kor bun shah ban ïa shibun ki sim ïing .

Haba u nongwei uba shong jngai na ka ri u jingïohknieh shaphang ka nam jrong me pynlang ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba me la leh na ka bynta ki briew jong me , malu un wan ban mane ïa me bad duwai ha kane ka Templ , to shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong u .
translation.en: ( For they shall hear of thy great name , and of thy strong hand , and of thy stretched out arm  ; ) when he shall come and pray toward this house  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei u briew u ïapom noh , bad kata ka erlangthari kiba kut jong u ; u ïap mala hangno keiñ u don ?
translation.en: But man dieth , and wasteth away : yea , man giveth up the ghost , and where is he ?

translation.kha: Bad ka jingsuk U Blei’ kaba palat ïa ka jingshemphang briew baroh , Kan ri jai jai ïa ki dohnud jong phi , bad ïa ki jingmut jong Phi ha U Khereth Jisu .
translation.en: And the peace of God , which passeth all understanding , shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: La thuh ïa me hapoh ka jingtim bad men ym lah shuh ban rep ha ka khiew . Ka la kjit noh ïa ka snoh u sa jong me , i kumba ka la ang ïa la ka shyieng ban pdiang ïa kata mynba me la pynpoh ïa u .
translation.en: And now art thou cursed from the earth , which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother s blood from thy hand  ;
And call ye on the name of your gods , and I will call on the name of the  Lord  : and the God that answereth by fire , let him be God . And all the people answered and said , It is well spoken .
translation.kha: Nangta ai ba ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal kin duwai ha u blei jong ki , bad ma nga ngan duwai ha U  Trai  , bad uta uba jubab da kaba phah ïa ka ding — uta u dei U Blei .  U paidbah u la pyrta bad ai ïa ka jingmynjur .
U la pynïaid ïa nga sawdong ka them , bad nga la ïohi ba la don shibun bah ki shyieng bad ki long kiba la tyllong bha .
translation.en: And caused me to pass by them round about : and , behold , there were very many in the open valley  ; and , lo , they were very dry .

translation.kha: Napdeng kine ki long — u Hymenaïos Bad u Aleksandar , ïa babha nga la pynshitom da kaba aiti noh ïa ki sha ka bor u Soitan ; kane kan hawei ïa ki ba sangeh na kaba krenbeiñ blang .
translation.en: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander ; whom I have delivered unto Satan , that they may learn not to blaspheme .
Then fled Moses at this saying , and was a stranger in the land of Madian , where he begat two sons .
translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la phet noh na Ijipt bad u la leit noh ban shong ban sah ha ka ri ki Midian . Hangta u la don ar ngut ki khun shynrang .
Ki la ïalade sha shiliang ka duriaw bad ki la wan poi ha Gennesaret , ha kaba ki briew ki la ithuh ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And when they were gone over , they came into the land of Gennesaret .
And when he was come in , he saith unto them ,  Why make ye this ado , and weep ? the damsel is not dead , but sleepeth .
translation.kha: U la rung shapoh bad u la ong ïa ki ,  Balei katne katne ka jingkhynwin ? Balei ba phi ïa-ïam ? Ka khynnah kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !
Ha ka jingsliang bun jingphylla ki la pynmanbha , Kine ki briew’ kiba krung kumne ki long ki nong Galilaïa !
translation.en: And they were all amazed and marvelled , saying one to another , Behold , are not all these which speak Galilaeans ?

translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa U Trei malade shakri hok ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh . To kynmaw ïa ki kiei kiba khraw kiba u la leh na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: Only fear the  Lord  , and serve him in truth with all your heart : for consider how great things he hath done for you .

translation.kha: ( U Jakob 1 :17 ) Phin ioh tipthuh kumno ban wanpaw shajan jong u lyngba ka jingduwai .
translation.en: ( James 1 :17 ) You will come to know how to approach him in prayer .

translation.kha: Ko kynthei Jerusalem’ , to ïam namar u Saul ! Uba la pynkup ïa phi da ki jaiñ rupa syn-iang , Gera u la pyndeng ïa phi da ki mawlynnai bad ka ksiar .
translation.en: Ye daughters of Israel , weep over Saul , who clothed you in scarlet , with other delights , who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel .
Therefore hearken unto me , ye men of understanding : far be it from God , that he should do wickedness  ; and from the Almighty , that he should commit iniquity .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki rangbah kiba don jingshemphang ! Hato U Blei Badonbor Baroh u leh ïa kaei ka bymdei ?

translation.en: Because they have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands  ; therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place , and shall not be quenched .
translation.kha: Ki la kyntait ïa nga bad ki la ai ïa ki jingkñia ha kiwei ki blei , bad kumta la pynkhih bitar ïa nga da baroh kaba ki leh . Ka jingbitar jong nga ka khie pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem , bad kan ym duh noh .

translation.en: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight : for by the law is the knowledge of sin .
translation.kha: Naba ym don uno uno ruh uba hok ha khmat U Blei da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa ; kaei kaba ka Hukum ka leh ka long ban pynlong ïa u briew ban tip ba u la leh pop .
Bad to pdiang ïa ka jingpynim kum ka jingïadie khlieh , bad ka ktien U Blei kumno ka waitlam ka U Mynsiem u ai ha Phi .
translation.en: And take the helmet of salvation , and the sword of the Spirit , which is the word of God :

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki lyer ban beh pyrshah ïa ka Elam na ki liang baroh , bad ngan pynsakma ïa ki briew lad ka kylleng , haduh ba yn ym don ki ri ha kiba ki nongphetwir na ka kim shym poi .
translation.en: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven , and will scatter them toward all those winds  ; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come .
Asshur is there and all her company : his graves are about him : all of them slain , fallen by the sword :
translation.kha: Ka Assyria ka don hangta , lem bad ki jingtep jong ki shipai jong ka ha baroh sawdong .
U Jisu u la ong , Ko Pa , to map ïa ki ! Kim tip ïa kaei kaba ki leh . Ki la pynbynta ïa ki ïajan jngai u phangpdeng jong ki hi da kaba kynting sbai .
translation.en: Then said Jesus ,  Father , forgive them  ; for they know not what they do .  And they parted his raiment , and cast lots .

translation.kha: U pynkhiah ïa ki da ka hukum jong u bad Pyllait im ïa ki na ka jingap .
translation.en: He sent his word , and healed them , and delivered them from their destructions .
Then answered them the Pharisees , Are ye also deceived ?
translation.kha: Hato u la pynbieit ïa phi ruh ?  ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa ki .
To thaw ki jingpynshong jong phi ! Hynrei kin ym urlong . To kren ïa baroh kaba Phi kwah ! Hynrei baroh ka long ka bymmyntoi , namar U Blei u long lem bad ngi .
translation.en: Take counsel together , and it shall come to nought  ; speak the word , and it shall not stand : for God is with us .

translation.kha: Ai ba keiñ pyrta jam kaba ki ïaroh ïa U Blei , bad ki waitlam banep ha ki kad jong ki
translation.en: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth , and a twoedged sword in their hand  ;
The people of the land have used oppression , and exercised robbery , and have vexed the poor and needy : yea , they have oppressed the stranger wrongfully .
translation.kha: Kiba riewspah ki shukor bad ki lute . Ki leh bymdei ïa kiba duk bad ki shim kabu ïa ki nongwei .
Ha ka hukum u Salome ki la shah ïa ki maw uba ha itynnat na ka pynbha ka nongrep jong ka Templ .
translation.en: And the king commanded , and they brought great stones , costly stones , and hewed stones , to lay the foundation of the house .
He shall fly away as a dream , and shall not be found : yea , he shall be chased away as a vision of the night .
translation.kha: Un jah noh kum ka jingphohsniew , kum ka jingïohipaw mynmiet , bad ba yn ym ïohi shuh .

translation.en: Thy navel is like a round goblet , which wanteth not liquor : thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies .
translation.kha: Uba ieit jong nga u la leit sha la ka kper , ha kaba ki dieng balsam ki mih . U dang pynbamphlang ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong u bad lum ïa ki  tiew lili .
U la kyllaiñ na ki katno katba ki rangbah ha Enaim , shang kato ka nuti kob don hangne harud lynti ? Ym ju don nuti stong , ki jingjubab .
translation.en: Then he asked the men of that place , saying , Where is the harlot , that was openly by the way side ? And they said , There was no harlot in this place .

translation.kha: Kaba pynrem ïa kba lui lui litar kaba pynksan ïa ki bymman — baroh ar ki long ka jingijli ha U Trai .
translation.en: He that justifieth the wicked , and he that condemneth the just , even they both are abomination to the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Mikaïah u jubab , Nga ïohi ïa ka kynhied ba-shiphew Israel ba la pynsakma halor ki lwa kum ïa ki langbrot bym don nongsharai . Bad U Trai u ong , ‘ Kine ki rangbah kim don nongïalam ; ai ba kin leit phai noh sha la ïing ha ka jingsuk .’
translation.en: Then he said , I did see all Israel scattered upon the mountains , as sheep that have no shepherd : and the  Lord  said , These have no master  ; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace .

But they rebelled against me , and would not hearken unto me : they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes , neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt : then I said , I will pour out my fury upon them , to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad ki la kyntait ban shahshkor . Kim shym la bret noh ïa ki bleithaw ba-ijli jong ki lane iehnoh ïa ki blei jong ki nong Ijipt . Nga la kloi ban shah ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ba-pura jong ka jingbitar jong nga hangta ha Ijipt .

‘ Me la lehbha ,’ u la ong ; ‘ me long u shakri uba bha ! Namar ba me longïing uba lah shun shangkhawiah ha kiei kiei kiba riew , ngan buh ïa me ban Khmih ïa ki kawei-na-kaba-shiphew tylli ki nongbah .’
translation.en: And he said unto him , Well , thou good servant : because thou hast been faithful in a very little , have thou authority over ten cities .

translation.kha: U syiem Shishak u wan sha Jerusalem nabar u shim ïa ki jingkynshew na ka Templ bad na ka ïingsyiem . U shim lut ïa kiei kiei , kaba kynthup ïa ki stet ksiar kaba u syiem Salmone u la thaw .
translation.en: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem , and took away the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house  ; he took all : he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made .

translation.kha: Hynrei namarba ba nga la ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jongnga u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , ym shym la aiti ïa nga ha ki briew bad shah pynïap .
translation.en: Nevertheless the hand of Ahikam the son of Shaphan was with Jeremiah , that they should not give him into the hand of the people to put him to death .

translation.kha: kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka Ong , Nga la pyntong ïa me u Kpa jong ki jaitbynriew babud . Kumta ka jingkular ka long kaba bha ha khamtam U Blei , ha uba u Abraham u la ngeit — U Blei kaba wallam ïa kiba la ïap sha ka jingim bad uba ka hukum jong u ka pynlong ïa kaei ka bym shym la don .
translation.en: ( As it is written , I have made thee a father of many nations , ) before him whom he believed , even God , who quickeneth the dead , and calleth those things which be not as though they were .

translation.kha: Nga kiew ïa uta u lum ban pdiang ïa ki mawlyngkniap ha naba la thoh ïa ka jutang ba U Trai u la pynlong bad phira . Nga sah hangta sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , bad ngam shem la Bam ne dih ei ei .
translation.en: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone , even the tables of the covenant which the  Lord  made with you , then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights , I neither did eat bread nor drink water :

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Nga un-long uta wahbah pynkhlaiñ ïa phi . Balei phin sheptieng ïa u bhabriew u bym im junom , u ngi khim neh ban ïa u phlang ?
translation.en: I , even I , am he that comforteth you : who art thou , that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die , and of the son of man which shall be made as grass  ;
For unto every one that hath shall be given , and he shall have abundance : but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath .
translation.kha: Naba ïa uwei pa uwei u briew uba don ei ei , yn sa ai kham bun , bad un don kyrhai ; hynrei ha u briew u bym don ei ei , wat ïa kaba khyndiat kaba u don yn shim noh na u .

translation.en: And he said ,  Take heed that ye be not deceived : for many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and the time draweth near : go ye not therefore after them .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Sumar ; wat shah shukor . Kiba bun ki rangbah , kiba kam ba ki kren na ka bynta jong nga , kin wan bad ong , ‘ Nga long ma u !’ bad , ‘ Ka por ka la poi !’ Hynrei wat bud ïa ki .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did so : and Joseph gave them wagons , according to the commandment of Pharaoh , and gave them provision for the way .
translation.kha: Ki khun U Jakob ki leh kumta kumba la bthah ïa ki . U Joseph u ai kali ïa ki , kumba u syiem u la hukum , bad u ai jingbam ïa ki ba kin bam ha lynti .
U peit ibeiñ wat ïa ki mrad kiba iphieng tam ; u long u syiem jong ki mradkhlaw baroh .
translation.en: He beholdeth all high things : he is a king over all the children of pride .

translation.kha: U Dabid u phet krad na ka nongbah Gath bad u leit sha ka krem hajan ka nongring Adullam . Haba ki hynmen shynrang jongno u bad kiwei pat ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u ki tip ba u don hangta , ki la ïasoh bad u .
translation.en: David therefore departed thence , and escaped to the cave Adullam : and when his brethren and all his father s house heard it , they went down thither to him .

translation.kha: Ki jubab , U Saul u la khwai ban pynjot ïa ngi dara ban ym pynsah eiei ruh Hangto hangno ha Israel .
translation.en: And they answered the king , The man that consumed us , and that devised against us that we should be destroyed from remaining in any of the coasts of Israel ,
Be thou my strong habitation , whereunto I may continually resort : thou hast given commandment to save me  ; for thou art my rock and my fortress .
translation.kha: To long ka jakarieh kaba skhem jong nga , ka kut bakhlaiñ ban ïada ïa nga ; me long ka jakarieh bad ka jingkyrshan jong nga .

Ka bynta kaba sha trai eh jong ka rangli , na ka bynta ba-halor jong ka trai , ka long shu mitar ka jingjrong . Ka bynda kaba buiñ na ka tduh ka long sanphew sentimitar baroh basawdong , bad ka long ar mitar ka jingjrong . Ka bynta shadien kata na ka tduh ruh ka long sanphew sukher baroh sawdong .
translation.en: And from the bottom upon the ground even to the lower settle shall be two cubits , and the breadth one cubit  ; and from the lesser settle even to the greater settle shall be four cubits , and the breadth one cubit .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Trai , namar u long uba bha ; to ïarwai ki jingïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u , namar u long uba ibha sbun .
translation.en: Praise the  Lord   ; for the  Lord  is good : sing praises unto his name  ; for it is pleasant .

translation.kha: Hynrei u khur syiem umbah synshar , u lah shun rung hangtai ban bam ïa ka jingman bakhuid ha ka jingdon ryngkat jyllang nga . Un rung bad mih ïa ka khyrdop lyngba ka kamra ban rung ban mih ha ka bynta kaba kham shapoh .
translation.en: It is for the prince  ; the prince , he shall sit in it to eat bread before the  Lord   ; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate , and shall go out by the way of the same .
And he went on his journeys from the south even to Beth–el , unto the place where his tent had been at the beginning , between Beth–el and Ai  ;
translation.kha: Te u la mihnoh nangta bad u la ïaid na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat , da kaba leit sha Bethel .
Te u Isaïah u la phah ka Khubor ban ïathuh ha u syiem Hesekaïah kaba jubab ïa ka jingïarwai u syiem .
translation.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria :

translation.kha: ap habar badno ieh un da wallam hi ïa ka ha phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt stand abroad , and the man to whom thou dost lend shall bring out the pledge abroad unto thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei u kynrad jong u , u ong , Ngin ym leit sah” ha ka nongbah ha kaba ki briew kim dei ki Israel . Ngin ïaid shaphrang ngab ïalute sahmiet ha Geba lane Ramah .
translation.en: And he said unto his servant , Come , and let us draw near to one of these places to lodge all night , in Gibeah , or in Ramah .

translation.kha: Ki Jeraïah ki long ka jaitbynriew ka bym ni ka har sngewthuh ; kim don satia ka jingtied .
translation.en: For they are a nation void of counsel , neither is there any understanding in them .

translation.kha: Badno ba U Blei un ïasyllok khnang baneh tip bad sngewthuh bad ban hikai kumno ba ïa kiei kiei dei baneh leh ?
translation.en: With whom took he counsel , and who instructed him , and taught him in the path of judgment , and taught him knowledge , and shewed to him the way of understanding ?
And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil : three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram  ;
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bam kaba dei da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw , ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ,
Te pa kumta long ki nongbud jong u Trai , namar phi long ki Kynhun kiba ainguh eh jong U Blei ,
translation.en: Be ye therefore followers of God , as dear children ;

translation.kha: La ai ha ki ïa ka nongbud Ot ( u Arba u dei u kpa jong u Anak ) , ïa kaba Mynta la khot ka Hebron , ha ka ri lum Judith , lem bad ki pyntha phalang sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak , which city is Hebron , in the hill country of Judah , with the suburbs thereof round about it .
Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven ? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth ?
translation.kha: Hato me tip ïa ki aiñ kiba synshar ïa ki suiñbneng , bad hato me lah ban pyndei ïa ki ha ka pyrthei ?
A katno kiba phylla long kiei kiei babha U Trai u la leh ! Baroh kiba la kmen badno ki , ki kwah ban shaphrang ïa ki .
translation.en: The works of the  Lord  are great , sought out of all them that have pleasure therein .

And the king called for Jehoiada the chief , and said unto him , Why hast thou not required of the Levites to bring in out of Judah and out of Jerusalem the collection , according to the commandment of Moses the servant of the  Lord  , and of the congregation of Israel , for the tabernacle of witness ?
translation.kha: kumta u phah khot ïa u Jehoïada , u nongïalam jong ki , bad u dawa ,  Balei ba phim peit ïa kane ba ki Lebi ki lum na Judah bad Jerusalem ïa ka khajna kaba u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  , u la pan na ki briew ban siew ïa ka ban kyrshan ïa ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai  ?

Shim uwei u khiew nangne bad pynïeng ïa u kum ka kynroh hapdeng jong me bad ka nongbah . Phai khmat sha ka nongbah . Ka don ha ka jingshah kerkut , bad dei ma me uba kyrkhu ïa ka . Kane kan long ka dak ïa ka jaitbynriew Isaia .
translation.en: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan , and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city : and set thy face against it , and it shall be besieged , and thou shalt lay siege against it . This shall be a sign to the house of Israel .

translation.kha: Kumta u Noah lakam bad la ka tngen , bad ki khun shynrang jyllang u bad ki tnga jong ki , ki la ïamih shabar na kata ka lieng .
translation.en: And Noah went forth , and his sons , and his wife , and his sons  wives with him :

The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth–aven : for the people thereof shall mourn over it , and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it , for the glory thereof , because it is departed from it .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka nongbah jong ka Samaria kin sheptieng bad ïam sngewsih namar ka jingduh noh ïa u masi ksiar ha Bethel . Ma ki bad kita ki lyngdoh kiba shakri ïa u bleithaw kin ïam sngewsih namar jong u . Kin sa ïam pangnud haba yn law lyngkhuit ïa ka jingthaba rong ksiar jong u .
Ngan pyndonkam ïa ka Judah kum ka ryntieh jong u swai badno ïa ka Israel kum ki khnam . Ngan pyndonkam ïa ki rangbah jong ka Senas kum ka thnam , ba ïaleh ïa ki rangbah jong ka Gris .
translation.en: When I have bent Judah for me , filled the bow with Ephraim , and raised up thy sons , O Zion , against thy sons , O Greece , and made thee as the sword of a mighty man .
And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels , Go your ways , and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam kaba kren na ka Templ , ha ki hynñiew ngut ki angel :  Khie leit bad theh noh ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang jong ka jingbitar U Blei ha ka pyrthei !
Ki shah ïa ki khunlung jong ki ban ïap ha ka jingthngan bad jingsliang ; ki khynnah ki khrong jingbam kaba ym don mano mano ban ai ha ki .
translation.en: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst : the young children ask bread , and no man breaketh it unto them .

translation.kha: Kine baroh shipawa thut ki don khih ka jingthmu , bad ki ai ïa ka har bad ka iktiar jong ki ha u mrad .
translation.en: These have one mind , and shall give their power and strength unto the beast .
And I will appoint over them four kinds , saith the  Lord  : the sword to slay , and the dogs to tear , and the fowls of the heaven , and the beasts of the earth , to devour and destroy .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kut jingmut ba saw tylli kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kin jia ha ki : kin shah pynïap ha ka thma ; ïa ki met jong ki yn patan noh da ki ksew ; ki sim kin bam ïa ki , bad ki mradkhlaw kin bam ïa kaei kaba sah .

translation.en: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate , and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste  ; and I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jaka ha kiba ki khun ki ksiew u Isaak ki mane Blei yn sa pynjot noh . Ïa ki jaka kyntang jong ki Israel yn sa iehnoh ha ki jingjot . Ngan wallam ïa ka longïing syiem jong u syiem Jeroboam sha ka jingkut .
Nga la hukum shun don ka jingtohkit , bad la shem shisha ba naduh ki por mynhyndai ka Jesreel ka la ju ïaleh pyrthuh ïa ka bor syiem bad ba ka dap da ki nongïaleh pyrshah bad ki nongshet jingkulmar .
translation.en: And I commanded , and search hath been made , and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings , and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein .
Let the  Lord  , the God of the spirits of all flesh , set a man over the congregation ,
translation.kha: A  Trai  uba U Blei , uba long ka thymmei jong ka jingim baroh , nga kyrpad ïa me to thung ïa u briew uba lah ban ïalam ïa u paidbah ,
Ka Joppa kan long kabu suda khlem jingmyntoi . Te phin tip ba nga long U Trai . Namar me la ong ba ka wah Nile ka dei ka jong me bad ba me la pynlong ïa ka ,
translation.en: And the land of Egypt shall be desolate and waste  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  : because he hath said , The river is mine , and I have made it .

translation.kha: bad ngan ai ïa me ha ki briew’ ïa kiba me sheptieng , ki briew kiba kaweh ban pynïap ïa me . Ngan ai ïa me ha u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia bad ha ki shipa jong u .
translation.en: And I will give thee into the hand of them that seek thy life , and into the hand of them whose face thou fearest , even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of the Chaldeans .

translation.kha: U ong ha u samla nongrah atiar jong u , Sei ïa ka tiensyiem jong me malu dung ïap ïa nga , ban ym shah ba kine ki Philistia ki bym to blei kyang ïuhbeiñ halor jong na . Hynrei uta u apil u la jingkhynñiuh tyngeh ban leh ïa ka . Kumta u Salu u sei ïa la ka waitlam bad u rynsied ïa lade ha ka .
translation.en: Then said Saul to his armourbearer , Draw thy sword , and thrust me through therewith  ; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me . But his armourbearer would not  ; for he was sore afraid . So Saul took a sword , and fell upon it .
Though thou , Israel , play the harlot , yet let not Judah offend  ; and come not ye unto Gilgal , neither go ye up to Beth–aven , nor swear , The  Lord  liveth .
translation.kha: Wat lada phi ki briew ka Israel phim ïaineh ha nga , ai ba ki Judah kin ym ngop ha kijuh ki jingleh pop . Wat leit mane sha Gilgal lane sha Bethaben , lane pynlong ki jingïateh kular ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  uba im .
Ngan leit sad ngan ïeng hajan i pa ha katai ka jaka ba phi rieh , bad ngan ïakren bad i shaphang jong phi . Lada nga shem ei ei , ngan sa ïathuh ïa phi .
translation.en: And I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where thou art , and I will commune with my father of thee  ; and what I see , that I will tell thee .

translation.kha: Namarkata mynhynne ka miet u angel jrong U Blei ha uba nga longkmie bad ïa uba nga mane u la wan sha nga bad u la ong ,
translation.en: For there stood by me this night the angel of God , whose I am , and whom I serve ,
That he would grant you , according to the riches of his glory , to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man ;
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa U Blei na ka jingkynrei spah ka burom jong u ban ai ha phi ïa ka bor da U Mynsiem jong u ba phin long kiba khlaiñ ha ki jinglong bashapoh jong phi , bad nga duwai ba U Khrist un pynlong ka ïingshong jong u ha ki dohnud jong phi da ka jingngeit .

Leh ki briew kin shahshkor bad iehnoh ïa la ki lynti basniew . Lada ki kuna kamet , te ngan kylla ïa la ka jingmut shaphang ka jingpynkut kaba at la thmu ïa-ban wallam khashor jong ki na ka bynta ki Kam bymman jongki ki .
translation.en: If so be they will hearken , and turn every man from his evil way , that I may repent me of the evil , which I purpose to do unto them because of the evil of their doings .

translation.kha: Te namar kane hi ka daw phi dei ban leh ïa kaba ibha tam jong phi Ban pynlang ïa ka jingbha ha ka jingngeit jong phi ; ha ka jingbha jongno phi pynlang ïa ka jingtip ;
translation.en: And beside this , giving all diligence , add to your faith virtue  ; and to virtue knowledge  ;

translation.kha: Wat long uba ibieit , hynmen , ïapyrshang ban wad ïa kaei kaba U Trai u kwah ïa phira Ban lai .
translation.en: Wherefore be ye not unwise , but understanding what the will of the Lord is .
These are the statutes , which the  Lord  commanded Moses , between a man and his wife , between the father and his daughter , being yet in her youth in her father s house .
translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki aiñ ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses kiba ïadei bad ki jingkular ba la pynlong da ka theisamla kaba dang sah ha ka ïing u kpa jong ka lane da ka kynthei kaba la shongkurim .

U Trei u ong , Nimrim ka jutang jong nga Bad phi katba la shonshab da ka snam jong ki jingkhia , len pyllaitluid ïa ki briew jong phi — kaba laitluid na ki thliew bym ni um jong ka jingshah jingkraw .
translation.en: As for thee also , by the blood of thy covenant I have sent forth thy prisoners out of the pit wherein is no water .

translation.kha: Nangta u phah ïa u shakri jong u , u Moses , dara u Aaron , ïa uba u la jied .
translation.en: He sent Moses his servant  ; and Aaron whom he had chosen .

translation.kha: Kin ibeiñ ïa phi! bad kin kyrhai , U la kular ban wan , shano um shym la kular kumta ? Hangno u kein ? Ki khap tymmen ki la lah ïap , hynrei kaei kiei baroh ki daiñ ïaisah kumjuh kum mynba la pynbang ïa ka pyllait !
translation.en: And saying , Where is the promise of his coming ? for since the fathers fell asleep , all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation .

translation.kha: Shahshkor haba nga mai tyngeh ïa pa ; ngan ai ïa phoi ïa ki jinghikai kiba bha bad ngan ïathuh lang ïa ka jingtip jong nga bad Phi .
translation.en: Turn you at my reproof : behold , I will pour out my spirit unto you , I will make known my words unto you .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ka jingpynjot ka ban wan hap ha ka Edom kan long kaba da shyrkhei haduh ba kiba ïaid nangta kin kyndit bad sheptieng .
translation.en: Also Edom shall be a desolation : every one that goeth by it shall be astonished , and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof .

translation.kha: hynrei pien ym kheit , ngab khung dat ki langbrot jong nga .
translation.en: But ye believe not , because ye are not of my sheep , as I said unto you .

translation.kha: Gaal U Jisu u la pynkut , Khmut kiba khatduh kan longsem ha shuwa , bad kito kiba ha shuwa kin long khatduh .
translation.en: So the last shall be first , and the first last : for many be called , but few chosen .

translation.kha: U Solomon u la pyndonkam ïa Kinah ki dieng ha kaba shniah jingker ha ka Templ bad ha ka jingsngem , bun ha kaba sha tyrha bad jingtem ksai ïa ki nongput nongtem . Ki longïing ki dieng Kseh-Juniper kiba kynsai tam ïa kiba la wanrah sha Israel , ym don shuh khem kita pun dang lah ban ïohi biang . )
translation.en: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the  Lord  , and for the king s house , harps also and psalteries for singers : there came no such almug trees , nor were seen unto this day .

translation.kha: Ki la pynshong ïa u halor u khashor jngai u syiem , bad u Sadok bad u Nathan ki la pynsleh ïa u kum u syiem ha ka Umpohliew Kishion . Nangta ki la leit sha ka nongbah , ki risa da ka jingmane , bad ki paidbah mynta ki ei ha ka jingkhihwin . Kata ka dei ka jingsawa kaba phi dang shu ïohsngew .
translation.en: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon : and they are come up from thence rejoicing , so that the city rang again . This is the noise that ye have heard .

Take thee a roll of a book , and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel , and against Judah , and against all the nations , from the day I spake unto thee , from the days of Josiah , even unto this day .
translation.kha: Shim ïa ka kot kli bad thoh ha ka ïa baroh kaba nga la ong ha me shaphang ka Israel bad ka Judah bad baroh ki jaitbynriew . Thoh lut ïa baroh kaba nga la ong ha me naduh ka por ba nga la kren nyngkong ha me , mynba u Josaïah u long syiem , haduh mynta .

translation.en: Now therefore go to , proclaim in the ears of the people , saying , Whosoever is fearful and afraid , let him return and depart early from mount Gilead . And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand  ; and there remained ten thousand .
translation.kha: Pynbna ha u paidbah , ‘ Uno uno uba sheptieng u dei ban leit phai noh sha ïing , bad ngi ngin sah hangne ha u lum Gilead .’   Kumta arphew ar hajar ngut ki leit phai noh , bad shiphew hajar ngut ki sah .

Hynrei u Sanballat , na ka shnong Beth Khroh , bad u Tobiah , u pynbah synshar jong ka probins Ammon , ki la ïohsngew ba don mano mane ba la ïan ban trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki Israel , bad ki la bitar haduh katta katta .
translation.en: When Sanballat the Horonite , and Tobiah the servant , the Ammonite , heard of it , it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan thah noh ïa U Mynsiem jongnga ang wat ha ki shakri , ki shajrong badno ki kynthei kumjuh .
translation.en: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit .

translation.kha: U Trai u la jubab , Me don hok aïu ban bitar ?
translation.en: Then said the  Lord  , Doest thou well to be angry ?

translation.kha: bad u la mareh sha u Eli , bad u noh , Phi khot ïa nga , bad nga hangne . jynreiñ u El u jubor , Ngam shem khot ïa phi ; khie leit thiah biang . Kumba u Samuel u saw thiah biang .
translation.en: And he ran unto Eli , and said , Here am I  ; for thou calledst me . And he said , I called not  ; lie down again . And he went and lay down .
And the  Lord  turned a mighty strong west wind , which took away the locusts , and cast them into the Red sea  ; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u la pynkylla ïa ka lyer mihngi sha ka lyer sepngi kaba jur , kaba la rong noh ïa ki puit bad bret ïa ki sha ka Duriaw Basaw . Ym shym sah shuh uwei ruh u puit ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

Ka Assyria sa ym lah da lei lei ban pyrsad im ïa ngi , nabar ki kulai thma kim lah ban ïada ïa ngi . Ngam ym ong shuh ha ki Bealoth jong ngi ba ki longsem U Balei jongngi ngi . A Trai , me pyn-at jinglehisynei ha kito ki bym khong uno uno sha uba ki lah ban phai .
translation.en: Asshur shall not save us  ; we will not ride upon horses : neither will we say any more to the work of our hands , Ye are our gods : for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong , Sa shisien pat ngan shah ïa ki Israel ba kin pan jingïarap na nga bad ngan shah ïa ki ba kin roi ha ka jingbun briew kamon ka kynha khunlangbrot .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel , to do it for them  ; I will increase them with men like a flock .
Why do you drive the car ?
translation.kha: Balei phi ngiah ia ka kali ?
‘ Ka jingjam U Blei kan hap ha Uto u briew uba pdiang pisa ban pynïap ïa u briew uba lui lui .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingïap , kaba khlei kum ka Neah , kum ka wah ba shlei ïa ki rud jong ka . Ka Ijipt ka ong , ‘ Ngan shlei bad ngan tyllep ïa ka pyrthei ; ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah bad ïa ki briew bashong hangta .
translation.en: Egypt riseth up like a flood , and his waters are moved like the rivers  ; and he saith , I will go up , and will cover the earth  ; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof .
And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen  ; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities , and with the king at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u don saw hajar tylli ki sem kulai na ka bynta ki kali ïapom bad ki kulai jong u , bad u don khat-ar hajar tylli ki kulai thma . Katto katne na ki u buh ha Jerusalem bad ïa kiba sah u buh ha kiwei pat ki nongbah .

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og , kings of the Amorites , and unto the land of them , whom he destroyed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew kumba u la leh ïa u Sihon bad u Og , ki syiem Amor , bad kumba u la pynjot ïa ka ri jong ki .
U Trai u ïa-ong ha ki brai jong ka Jehoïada bad Jerusalem , To lur ïa ki lyngkha jong phi ki bym pat ju lur ; ki bet ïa ki symbai jong phira pangnud ki sha .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  to the men of Judah and Jerusalem , Break up your fallow ground , and sow not among thorns .

translation.kha: Ynda u Moses u la da ïakren bad ki , u tap ïa la ka khmat da ka jaiñtapkhmat .
translation.en: And till Moses had done speaking with them , he put a veil on his face .
And ye shall teach them your children , speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house , and when thou walkest by the way , when thou liest down , and when thou risest up .
translation.kha: Hikai ïa ki ha ki khun ki kti jong phi . Ïalap shaphang jong ki haba phi don ha ïing bad haba phi ïaid ha lynti , haba phi shongthait bad haba phi trei phi ktah .

translation.en: Daniel spake and said , I saw in my vision by night , and , behold , the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea .
translation.kha: Ki lyer ki beh kyrthep na ki liang baroh bad ki shoh ïa ka sla ka duriaw-bah .
Un pynngam wat ïa ki liengbah kiba khraw bad kiba itynnat tam .
translation.en: And upon all the ships of Tarshish , and upon all pleasant pictures .

translation.kha: To pynkloi pynlang to wan , phi Baroh ki jaitbynriew ba don sawdong , bad ïalumlang ha ka them .’ To phah , A Trai , ïa ka kynhun shipai ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .
translation.en: Assemble yourselves , and come , all ye heathen , and gather yourselves together round about : thither cause thy mighty ones to come down , O  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta u kiew ha la ka kali ïalam mala u leit sha Jesreel . U Joram um pat shym ïoh jingkoit , bad u Ahasaïah u syiem ka Judah u dang don hangta , u rupa jngoh ïa u .
translation.en: So Jehu rode in a chariot , and went to Jezreel  ; for Joram lay there . And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram .

translation.kha: Kaei kane kaba ka jingkhmih jrong ka , ka long kum ka step ? Ka long kaba bhabriew bad kaba phyrnai , ka jingphyrnai kum ka sngi ne u bnai .
translation.en: I am my beloved s , and his desire is toward me .

translation.kha: Uno uno u bym shim ïa la ka diengphna bad bud ha dien jat jong nga um long uba bit ba long u synran jong nga .
translation.en: And he that taketh not his cross , and followeth after me , is not worthy of me .

translation.kha: Katto kiba me la pyllait im kin oh poi ha Jerusalem da ka jingkyrmen , da kaba ïarwai mala risa da ka jingkmen . Kin long kiba kmen junom , junom kiba laitluid na ka jingsngewsih Bad jingkthang mynsiem .
translation.en: Therefore the redeemed of the  Lord  shall return , and come with singing unto Zion  ; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head : they shall obtain gladness and joy  ; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away .
And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Behold , all that he hath is in thy power  ; only upon himself put not forth thine hand . So Satan went forth from the presence of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kam pher ,  U  Trai  u ong ïa u Soitan ,  baroh kaba u don ki long hapoh ka bor jong me , hynrei men ym pynmong ïa u Job hi .  Te u Soitan u la leit noh .
Rung Shabeh lyngba ka khyrdong kaba khim , namsop ka khyrdop shat ka dujok ka long kaban kylluid bad ka lynti kaba ïalam sha ka , ka long kaba suiñ , bad to shibun bakha ïaid na ka .
translation.en: Enter ye in at the strait gate : for wide is the gate , and broad is the way , that leadeth to destruction , and many there be which go in thereat :

translation.kha: Hynrei kim shem la sngewthuh aïu kane ka jinghikai ka kit jingmut , bad ki la sngewsheptieng ban kylli ïa u .
translation.en: But they understood not that saying , and were afraid to ask him .

translation.kha: nga lehkmen ha ka pyrthei , bad leh sngewbha bad ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth  ; and my delights were with the sons of men .

translation.kha: Kiba pyn-i ka jingsngewtynnat kaba katta katta ïa pa , hynrei kam bha . Hooid , kin kyntien ia phi , lah kumba phi pynsniew jinghikai .
translation.en: They zealously affect you , but not well ; yea , they would exclude you , that ye might affect them .

translation.kha: wah jingpynjahburom ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongsuk bad la ka kmie , namarba Amam dei ba pynduhbor ïa la ka jong ka kmie .
translation.en: The nakedness of thy father , or the nakedness of thy mother , shalt thou not uncover : she is thy mother  ; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .

translation.kha: Ïa me , ko khun jong nga , yn khot u nongïathuhlypa jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . men kitei ha shuwa jong U Trai ban pynkhreh ka lynti na ka pyntwa jong u ,
translation.en: And thou , child , shalt be called the prophet of the Highest : for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways  ;

translation.kha: Mynta , bad kaei to haw ban nujor ïa ki briew jongu kane ka per ? Ki longkmie kum ki khynraw kiba ïashong ha ki Jaka ïit . Kawei ka kynhun ka pyrta ïa kawei paw ,
translation.en: But whereunto shall I liken this generation ? It is like unto children sitting in the markets , and calling unto their fellows ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Daniel u la leit sha ïing bad u la iathuh ïa ki paralok jong u — u Hananaïah , u Mishael , bad u Asaraïah — ïa kai kaban la jia .
translation.en: Then Daniel went to his house , and made the thing known to Hananiah , Mishael , and Azariah , his companions :

translation.kha: Na u Paul , u apostol U Khrismas Jingsuk da ka mon U Blei! , mala na u Timothi u para Jong i — Sha ka balang U Balei kaba ha Korinth , pynlang sha ki briew jong U Blei borbah kiba ha Akhaïa :
translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , and Timothy our brother , unto the church of God which is at Corinth , with all the saints which are in all Achaia :
Afterwards the spirit took me up , and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea , to them of the captivity . So the vision that I had seen went up from me .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw , U Mynsiem jong U Blei u la rah shajrong ïa nga bad wallam pat ïa nga sha kiba shah ringmraw ha Babilonia . Nangta ka jingïohipaw ka jah noh ,

translation.en: Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah , and smote him , and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe : for they had made that the prison .
translation.kha: Ki la bitar haduh katta katta ïa nga bad hukum ban shoh ïa nga bad ban set ïa nga ha ka ïing u Jonathan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , kaba ïa ka ïing jong u la pynlong ka byndi .

translation.en: And the third row , a ligure , an agate , and an amethyst .
translation.kha: ïa u Turkwois , u Agate , bad u Amethyst ha ka kyrdon kaba lai ;
U Ephraim u kpa jong ki u ïambriew na ka boitha jong ki bun sngew , bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong u ki wan pyntngen ïa u .
translation.en: And Ephraim their father mourned many days , and his brethren came to comfort him .
And , behold , there was a man which had his hand withered . And they asked him , saying , Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days ? that they might accuse him .
translation.kha: ha kaba la don u briew uba don ka kti kaba la ïapshiliang . Katto katne ki briew hangta kiba la kwah ban mudui ïa U Jisu ha ka jingleh bakla , kumta ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hato ka long pyrshah ïa Ka Aiñ jong ngi ban pynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton ?
( 2 Korinth 1 :24 ) Kumba u nongput langbrot u shim khia ban sumar ïa la ki langbrot , ki rangbah balang ruh ki Pyrshang pun tip ïa iwei pa iwei i dkhot ka balang . —Proberb 27 :23 .
translation.en: ( 2 Corinthians 1 :24 ) Just as a shepherd diligently cares for each one of his sheep , the elders try to get to know every member of the congregation individually . —Proverbs 27 :23 .

translation.kha: Sa wan biang hadien lai sngaid pynlang ngan ai ha phoi ïa ka Joab jong nga , u phai ktien . Kumta ki leit noh .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Depart yet for three days , then come again to me . And the people departed .

If any man speak , let him speak as the oracles of God  ; if any man minister , let him do it as of the ability which God giveth : that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ , to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ïalap , u dei ban ïalap ïa ki khubor jong U Blei ; uno uno uba shakri , u dei ban shakri da ka bor kaba U Blei u ai ïa u , khnang ba ha kiei kiei baroh yn ai ïa ka jingïaroh sha U Blei da U Jisu Khrist , ha uba ka burom bad ka bor ki long ki jong u junom la junom , Amen .

Ka por kan poi , bad ka la lah long mynta , haba ïa phi baroh yn sa pynsakma , imat pa uwei sha la ka jyllang ka ïing , bad ngan shuh iehnoh tang marwei . Hynrei ngam long shisha marwei , nongmareh U kper u long lem bad nga .
translation.en: Behold , the hour cometh , yea , is now come , that ye shall be scattered , every man to his own , and shall leave me alone : and yet I am not alone , because the Father is with me .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba ngeit ha U U u don ka jingim bymjukut ; uno uno u bymsuidñiew ïa U Khun un ym ïoh ïa ka jingim , hynrei un ïaisah ha ka jingpynshitom jong U Blei .
translation.en: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life : and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life  ; but the wrath of God abideth on him .
And I sent the hornet before you , which drave them out from before you , even the two kings of the Amorites  ; but not with thy sword , nor with thy bow .
translation.kha: Katba phi nang tur sha khmat , nga la pynshaïong ïa ki khnang ban beh noh ïa ki ar ngut ki syiem Amor . Ki waitlam bad ki ryntieh jong phi kim ïadon bynta ei ei bad kane .

translation.en: Know ye not that we shall judge angels ? how much more things that pertain to this life ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba ngin sa bishar ïa ki angel ? Katno tam , te , ïa kiei kiei ki jong kane ka jingim !

translation.en: And when we burned incense to the queen of heaven , and poured out drink offerings unto her , did we make her cakes to worship her , and pour out drink offerings unto her , without our men ?
translation.kha: Bad ki kynthei ki ong shuh shuh ,  Haba ngi shet ïa ki kpu ha ka dur kum ka Syiem jong ka Bneng , ngi ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ka , bad theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ ha ka , ki tnga jong ngi ki mynjur ïa kaei kaba ngi leh .
To trei khim bad wat longsyiem kiba alhia . To shakri ïa U Trai da ka dohnud kaba aiti lut .
translation.en: Not slothful in business ; fervent in spirit ; serving the Lord ;

translation.kha: Ka Judas bad ka Israel ki la siew na ka bynta ki mar jong pha da u kew , ka nep , ka umphniang Olib , bad ki musli musla .
translation.en: Judah , and the land of Israel , they were thy merchants : they traded in thy market wheat of Minnith , and Pannag , and honey , and oil , and balm .

translation.kha: wahbah ki Israel kiba Shong basah ha ka Them Jesreel ki la ïohsngew ba ka kynhun Shiphew ka la kjat ïap , bad ba u Saul sad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la ïap , ki hynñiew ïa la ki shnong bad ki phet ïap . Nangta ki Philistia ki wan malade ki shong ha ki .
translation.en: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled , and that Saul and his sons were dead , then they forsook their cities , and fled : and the Philistines came and dwelt in them .

translation.kha: Kumjuh ka Herodias ka buhnud pyrshah ïa u Ijon bad ka la kwah ban pynïap noh ïa u , hynrei kam shym la lah namar u Herod .
translation.en: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him , and would have killed him  ; but she could not :

translation.kha: ka dei ban pyndep lum ïa kata kaba ka la kylluid lymda u tnga jong ka u pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrshah haba u ïohsngew ïa kata .
translation.en: And her husband heard it , and held his peace at her , and disallowed her not : then all her vows shall stand , and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand .

translation.kha: Kumta te , salia ka ïashong bun uwei pat u briew katba u tnga jong ka u dang im ; yn khot ïa ka , ka briew kaba klim ; hynrei lada u tnga jyllang ka u la ïap , katei kamon ka aiñ ka long ka bynriew ba la laitluid sad kam leh ïa ka jingklim haba ka jingshongkurim ïa uwei pat .
translation.en: So then if , while her husband liveth , she be married to another man , she shall be called an adulteress : but if her husband be dead , she is free from that law ; so that she is no adulteress , though she be married to another man .

translation.kha: Te u Judas Iskariot , eiei na ki khat-ar nongput ki synran , u la mihnoh ban leit sha ki rangbah lynghoh khnang ban shetkylla ïa U Jehu ha ki .
translation.en: And Judas Iscariot , one of the twelve , went unto the chief priests , to betray him unto them .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ka Dorbar baroh kawei ki la pyrshang ban lap ki sabut lamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu ban pynïap ïa u ;
translation.en: Now the chief priests , and elders , and all the council , sought false witness against Jesus , to put him to death  ;

I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field , and thou hast increased and waxen great , and thou art come to excellent ornaments : thy breasts are fashioned , and thine hair is grown , whereas thou wast naked and bare .
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ïa pha ban san kum u jingthung baplung . Pha la nang khlaiñ bad jrong bad pha la long ka kynthei samla . Ka shadem jong pha ka la wandur itynnat , bad u shñiuh jong pha u la san , hynrei pha long kaba lyngkhuit .

Kito kiba la im phuh pahai shisien mynta ki lytar bylla ban ïoh bam , hynrei kito kiba thngan ktem tyndong shuh . Ka briew kaba lyngki ka ïoh khun hynñiew jrut , hynmen ka kmie kaba bun ki khun ka sah mawlynnai .
translation.en: They that were full have hired out themselves for bread  ; and they that were hungry ceased : so that the barren hath born seven  ; and she that hath many children is waxed feeble .
And the men are shepherds , for their trade hath been to feed cattle  ; and they have brought their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have .
translation.kha: Ngan ïathuh ha u ba phi dei ki nongri jingri , bad ba phi la wan ïalam ïa la ki kynhun langbrot , ïa kiwei de ki jingri , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kat kiba phi don .

translation.en: As for the living bird , he shall take it , and the cedar wood , and the scarlet , and the hyssop , and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water :
translation.kha: Un shim sa ïa kawei pat ka sim , ïa u lyngkhot dieng Kedar , ïa u  saiwul uba saw , bad ïa u tnat Hissop , bad un wieh lang ïa ki ha ka snam jong kata ka sim kaba u la pynïap .
u Absalom u ju ong , Khmih , ka aiñ ka ha ka liang jong me , hynrei ym don mano mano u ban markhmat ïa u syiem ban Sngap ïa ka kam jong me .
translation.en: And Absalom said unto him , See , thy matters are good and right  ; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear thee .

translation.kha: Ha u patsha Darius , to synshar ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: They sent a letter unto him , wherein was written thus  ; Unto Darius the king , all peace .

translation.kha: Ha Shisien , u lum bakyntang jong nga , u ong , nga la thung ïa u syiem jongnga nga .
translation.en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion .

translation.kha: bad ka tait sha ka pdeng jong ka lyndang bah jong ka nongbah . Ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka wah la don u dieng ka jingim , umbiah pynmih soh khat-ar synshar shisnem , shisien ha uwei uwei u bnai , bad ki sla jong u ki long na ka bynta ban ai jingkhiah ïa ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: In the midst of the street of it , and on either side of the river , was there the tree of life , which bare twelve manner of fruits , and yielded her fruit every month : and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations .

translation.kha: Ka jingim jong ngi ka long kaba lyngkot , ngim ïatip ei ei ; ngi iehnoh kum ka syrngiew ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: ( For we are but of yesterday , and know nothing , because our days upon earth are a shadow : )

translation.kha: U Benhadad u la mynjur ïa ka jingiwtung u Asa bad u phah ïa ki nongïam shipai bad ki kynhun shipai jongno ki ban Tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ka Israel . Ki jop ïa ka imon , Dan , Abel Beth Maakah , sad baroh ki nongbah ka Naphtali ha kiba la buh ïa ki mar ki mata .
translation.en: And Ben–hadad hearkened unto king Asa , and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel  ; and they smote Ijon , and Dan , and Abel–maim , and all the store cities of Naphtali .

translation.kha: Kata ka daym tang ka jinglehmeng .—Jenesis 3 :1-5 .
translation.en: Of course , that was a lie . —Genesis 3 :1-5 .

translation.kha: Ha Katai ka sngi u Dabid u ino ha ki rangbah jong u , Hato don uno uno hangne umbah isih ïa ki Jebus kam isih ma nga ? Khatduh katta kat ban pynïap ïa ki ? Te khie leit kiew lyngba ka len bad tur ïaleh ïa kito ki bapli ki matlah bad ki dkoh . ( Dei na kata ka daw ba la nguh , Kiba matlah nabar kiba dkoh kim lah Ban shok sha ka ïing ka jong U Terah . )
translation.en: And David said on that day , Whosoever getteth up to the gutter , and smiteth the Jebusites , and the lame and the blind , that are hated of David s soul , he shall be chief and captain . Wherefore they said , The blind and the lame shall not come into the house .

translation.kha: Don ki bynriew kiba pyrthat ba ki long kiba bha palat — oh , katno ka jingbha ki pyrkhat ba ki long !
translation.en: There is a generation , O how lofty are their eyes ! and their eyelids are lifted up .

translation.kha: U angel u la bthah ïa nga ban ai ha u Segub ïa kane ka khubor na U Trai : lad jop , ym da ka bor Shiphew lymne da ka bor ka jingkhlaiñ jong me , hynrei da U Mynsiem jong nga .
translation.en: Then he answered and spake unto me , saying , This is the word of the  Lord  unto Zerubbabel , saying , Not by might , nor by power , but by my spirit , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: U Harod u la ai lei ban pud ïa u , hynrei kim shym la shem ïa u . Kumta u la pham tohkit ïa ki ngap phira bad u la hukum ban pynïap ïa ki . Hadien kñia , u Oded u la iehnoh ïa ka Judia bad u la pynteh katei katne nga ha Kaisaria .
translation.en: And when Herod had sought for him , and found him not , he examined the keepers , and commanded that they should be put to death . And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea , and there abode .
Moreover he provided him cities , and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance : for God had given him substance very much .
translation.kha: Nalor kine , U Blei u la ai ha u ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi bad shibun ka spah ka phew ba u ïoh ban tei shibun ki nongbah .
U briew u bym shem ïa nga u pynmong ïa latai ; kat uba isih ïa nga u ieit ïa ka jingïap .
translation.en: But he that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul : all they that hate me love death .
And Jethro , Moses  father in law , came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness , where he encamped at the mount of God :
translation.kha: U Jethro u la wan bad ka tnga jong u Moses lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka sha ka ri shyiap ha kaba u Moses u la sher dara ha u lum bakhuid .
Yn sa leit ma u .
translation.en: He will go .

translation.kha: ka Ephron , ka Rehob , ka Hammon , bad ka Kanah , shaduh Sidon .
translation.en: And Hebron , and Rehob , and Hammon , and Kanah , even unto great Zidon  ;

translation.kha: Ken ka long ka khubor ba U Trai u la ai ha u Hosia u khun jong u Beri , ha ki sngi mynba u Ussaïah , u Jotham , u Ahas , bad u Hesekaïah ki longsyiem ki syiem ha Judah , bad u Jeroboam u khun jong u Joash u long syiem ha Israel .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came unto Hosea , the son of Beeri , in the days of Uzziah , Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash , king of Israel .

translation.kha: Ngan law lyngngeit ïa ka ha khmied katba iktiar jong ka , bad yn ym ni uno uno ruh uba lah ban pyllait ïa ka na ka bor jong nga .
translation.en: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers , and none shall deliver her out of mine hand .

translation.kha: Da shisha u Dabid u jingjubab , Nga long u shakri Jong phi bad Phin sa ïohi da lap kaei ba nga lah ban leh . U Akhish u ong , Ka biang ! Ngan pynlong ïa phi u nongïada jong nga shi rta .
translation.en: And David said to Achish , Surely thou shalt know what thy servant can do . And Achish said to David , Therefore will I make thee keeper of mine head for ever .
And if he be not redeemed in these years , then he shall go out in the year of jubilee , both he , and his children with him .
translation.kha: Lada ym lah ban pyllait ïa u da kano kano na kine ki lad , ïa u bad ki khun jong u dei ban pyllait pat ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat ka ban wan .

translation.en: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him , and turned to the Lord .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew kiba shong basah ha Lydda bad Sharon ki la ïohi ïa u , bad ki la phai sha U Trai .
Ngan sngewbha eh ha ki aiñ jong me ; ïa ki sah jngai me ngan ym klet .
translation.en: I will delight myself in thy statutes : I will not forget thy word .

translation.kha: Katto katai ngut na ki paidbah ki la pyrta ïa kawei kaei kaei , kiwei ïa kawei pat . Ka la don ka jingkem kambah khih main ba u pynrangbah ai sah” um lah ban pyntip thikna ïa kaei kaba la lah jia , kumta u la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u ban ïalam ïa u pyllew shad ka kut shipai .
translation.en: And some cried one thing , some another , among the multitude : and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult , he commanded him to be carried into the castle .
So that we may boldly say , The Lord is my helper , and I will not fear what man shall do unto me .
translation.kha: To ngin long shlur , te , bad ong ,  U Trai u long u nongïarap jong nga , ngan ym sheptieng . Uei uba lah ban leh ei ei ïa nga ?
Un buh bad u ïa kata ka kitab bad un pule na ka synñia sngi , ba un tip ïa-ban tiengburom ïa U Troas bad kohnguh hok ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum bhor ïa naba la thoh hangta .
translation.en: And it shall be with him , and he shall read therein all the days of his life : that he may learn to fear the  Lord  his God , to keep all the words of this law and these statutes , to do them :

translation.kha: U Dabid u la ïohkem shihajar hynñiewspah ngut ki shipai shong kulai bad arphew hajar ngut ki shipai ïaid kjat . U la buh bun tylli ki kulai na ka bynta ki shispah tylli ki kali ïapom bad ïa ibha sah u la pyndkoh .
translation.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven hundred horsemen , and twenty thousand footmen : and David houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them for an hundred chariots .

translation.kha: Da ka jingstad jong u , u la thaw ïa ki bneng ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translation.en: To him that by wisdom made the heavens : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba i pa jong sa i la ïaleh na ka bna jong phi . I la khynñiuh ïa la ka jingim ban pyllait im ïa phi na ki Midian .
translation.en: ( For my father fought for you , and adventured his life far , and delivered you out of the hand of Midian :

translation.kha: Shim bad me ïa baroh ki sim dara ki mrad , khnang ba ki lah ban ïaroi bad saphron kylleng ka khynwin .
translation.en: Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee , of all flesh , both of fowl , and of cattle , and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth  ; that they may breed abundantly in the earth , and be fruitful , and multiply upon the earth .

translation.kha: Phin ym shongsuk hapdeng kita ki jaitbynriew , bad phin ym eh jaka ban kam kum la ka jong ; hangtei U Trai un pynshong synriah , un pynduh jingkyrmen , nabar un pynsniew Mynsiem ïa phi .
translation.en: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease , neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest : but the  Lord  shall give thee there a trembling heart , and failing of eyes , and sorrow of mind :

translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai bad um shym la bud haw ïa U Terah , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong u , u la long .
translation.en: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and went not fully after the  Lord  , as did David his father .

And all the people , even the people of war that were with him , went up , and drew nigh , and came before the city , and pitched on the north side of Ai : now there was a valley between them and Ai .
translation.kha: Ma u bad ki shipai ki ïaleit sha ka khyrdop bah jong ka nongbah bad ki sher dara ha ka phang bashatei , ha kaba don ka them hapdeng jong ki bad ka Ai .
nabar dei namar kata Keiñ ba ïa ka bakwah la khot ka Ahikam . Hangta ki la ai jingkieng ha U Trai .
translation.en: And they called the name of that place Bochim : and they sacrificed there unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ha U Jisu u la ai ïa ka Kam lyngdoh kaba kham halor ban ïa ka jong ki , kumba ka jutang ïa kaba u la pynbeit pyndeng U Blei bad la ki briew ka Long kaba kham bha , namar la seng nongrim ïa ka ha ki jingkular ïa ktieh kiei kiba kham ba .
translation.en: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry , by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant , which was established upon better promises .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki la saphriang ha kylleng ka pyrthei , bun hato ki la ïoh ki khun kynthei ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when men began to multiply on the face of the earth , and daughters were born unto them ,

translation.kha: Ka Ruth ka nguh ngon haduh khyndew , bad ka ong ha u Boas , barli pa’ da pyrkhat ïa na haduh katta katta ? Balei phi da Lehsbun haduh katta katta ïa ka nongwei ?
translation.en: Then she fell on her face , and bowed herself to the ground , and said unto him , Why have I found grace in thine eyes , that thou shouldest take knowledge of me , seeing I am a stranger ?

translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki Jaka Mano blei jong phi kiba ha ki lum , ngan pynper ïa ki duwan thang jingiwbih jong phi , bad ngan bret ïa ki tapmoh jong pa hiar ki bleithaw jong phi babha la kyllon .
translation.en: And I will destroy your high places , and cut down your images , and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols , and my soul shall abhor you .

translation.kha: U Moses u rah ïa la ka kti shajan , bad kumta ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei ka la dum ngaiñ lai sngi lynter .
translation.en: And Moses stretched forth his hand toward heaven  ; and there was a thick darkness in all the land of Egypt three days :

translation.kha: Haba phi lum ïa ki jingmih na ki Lyngkha jong phi , wat ot ïa u kew uba dat ha ki tduh jong ki lyngkha , bad wat leit ban ot ruh ïa u sohkew uba sah hadien ba phira la lum .
translation.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land , thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field , neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest .

translation.kha: U nonghiarthma Syria un leh ïa ki katjuh kaba u sngewbha , khleh kano Kana ka jingpyrshang . Un ïeng ha ka Ri ka Jingkular bad un ïoh ïa ka baroh ha ka bor jong u .
translation.en: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will , and none shall stand before him : and he shall stand in the glorious land , which by his hand shall be consumed .

translation.kha: Saw ngut na ki rangbah ba kham pawkhmat jong ka Hima Bashatei , u Asasaïah u khun jong u Jehohanan , u Berekhaïah u khun jong u Jeshimoth , u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Shallum , bad u Amasa u khun jngai u Hadlai ruh ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki jinglah ka kynhun shipai .
translation.en: Then certain of the heads of the children of Ephraim , Azariah the son of Johanan , Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth , and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum , and Amasa the son of Hadlai , stood up against them that came from the war ,

translation.kha: Kumta shongsuk bad ka tnga jong phi bad shem ïa ka jingkmen bad ka kynthei kaba phi shongkurim —
translation.en: Let thy fountain be blessed : and rejoice with the wife of thy youth .
