Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt , from twenty years old and upward , shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham , unto Isaac , and unto Jacob  ; because they have not wholly followed me :
translation.kha: ‘ Nga smai ba namar kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga , uwei ruh na ki rangbah uba arphew snem lane kham heh uba la wan na Ijipt un ym ïohrung sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ha u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .’
U Dan , U Naphtali , U Gad , bad U Ashan .
translation.en: Dan , and Naphtali , Gad , and Asher .

For , lo , I will raise up a shepherd in the land , which shall not visit those that be cut off , neither shall seek the young one , nor heal that that is broken , nor feed that that standeth still : but he shall eat the flesh of the fat , and tear their claws in pieces .
translation.kha: Nga la buh u nongaplangbrot ban khmih ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong nga , hynrei um shym la ïarap ïa ki langbrot kiba la shah byrngem da ka jingpynjot ; lymne ba u leit wad ïa kaba la jah noh , lane pynkhiah ïa kito kiba la mynsaw , lane bsa ïa kiba khiah . Pynban u bam ïa ka doh jong ki langbrot kiba sngaid bad u weng noh ïa ki khnap jong ki .

translation.en: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria , and the head of Samaria is Remaliah s son . If ye will not believe , surely ye shall not be established .
translation.kha: Ka Israel kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka Samaria , ka nongbah jong ka , bad ka Samaria kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa u Syiem Pekah .  Lada ka jingngeit jong phi kam long kaba ïaineh , phin ym ïaineh .
Ïa uno uno u rangbah lyngdoh la jied napdeng ki bakhraw , bad la thung ban shakri ïa U Blei na ka bniat jong ki , ban ai ïa ki jingkñia bad ka jingainguh na ka bynta ki pop .
translation.en: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God , that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins :
And the  Lord  sent Jerubbaal , and Bedan , and Jephthah , and Samuel , and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side , and ye dwelled safe .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u phah ïa u Gideon , u Barak , u Jephthah , bad khatduh ïa nga . Uwei pa uwei na ngi , ngi la pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi , bad phi la ïoh shongsuk shongshngain .
Ngan sloit ïa ki jaiñ teh khlieh jong phoi bad ngan shah ïa ki briew jong ang ban lait shisyndon na ka bor jong phoi . Te phin tip ba nga long U thri .
translation.en: Your kerchiefs also will I tear , and deliver my people out of your hand , and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba ong ba u anna ha ka jingshaïong , pynban u wer ïa la u hynmen u para , u don ha ka jingdum haduh kane hi ka kynta .
translation.en: He that saith he is in the light , and hateth his brother , is in darkness even until now .

translation.kha: Hynrei phi tyllai ba nga shukor — bad phi tharai ba ngam lah ban ïathmu ïa ka kadei na ka bymdei .
translation.en: Is there iniquity in my tongue ? cannot my taste discern perverse things ?
If a man find a damsel that is a virgin , which is not betrothed , and lay hold on her , and lie with her , and they be found  ;
translation.kha: Lada lap ïa u briew ba u batbor ïa ka briew ka bym pat shym ïatehktien badno badno ,
Me la kem ïa nga ; me dei u nongshun jongngi nga . Nga la hukum sa tang ka snep bad ki shyngoid , bad ki briew ki shim ïa kata kum ka jingpynshisha ïa ka jingpynpaw jongnga nga .
translation.en: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles , which is a witness against me : and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face .
Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , to the saints which are at Ephesus , and to the faithful in Christ Jesus :
translation.kha: Na u Paul , uba da ka mon U Blei u long u Apostol jong U Khrist Jisu — Sha ki briew jong U Blei ha Ephesos , kiba ïeng skhem ha ka jingim jong ki ha U Khrist Jisu :
U Dabid u sah ha ri Philistia khynñiuh bniah .
translation.en: And the time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a full year and four months .

translation.kha: U Joahas u la don arphew la snem ka rta mynhynnin u lama syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai bnoh ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jyllang u ka dei ka Shemuel , ka khulom jong u Jeremaïah na ka nongbah Libnah .
translation.en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hamutal , the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .

translation.kha: Katno kiba suk ki lama kito ki i don jingartatien shaphang jong nga !
translation.en: And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me .

translation.kha: ibha ki leit ïateh ïa kane ha u Ieh , u la ong , Kenan ka long kaei kambah U Trai u la nguh ba kan jia , mynba u la kren lyngkha u shakri jongki u , u Elijah : ‘ Ki ksah kin bameh ïa ka met jongu ka Jesebel ha ka thain Jesreel .
translation.en: Wherefore they came again , and told him . And he said , This is the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servant Elijah the Tishbite , saying , In the portion of Jezreel shall dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel :

translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewtriem kan long ïa kito kiba peitmat bad thmu ïa kaban sniew ! Haba poi ka step , mar ïa-ïoh ïa ka kaba , ki leh ïa kaba sniew kob ki la thmu .
translation.en: Woe to them that devise iniquity , and work evil upon their beds ! when the morning is light , they practise it , because it is in the power of their hand .

translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba kyntait ïa por ha kaba paw , U Khun U briew ruh un kyntait ïa u ha khmat ki angel jongno U Blei .
translation.en: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God .
Thou shalt not eat it  ; that it may go well with thee , and with thy children after thee , when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa kane ka hukum , U  Trai  un sngewbha , bad ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin manbha .
Namar mynhynne ka miat u angel jong U Blei ha Uba nga un-long bad ïa uba nga mane u la wan sha nga bad u la ong ,
translation.en: For there stood by me this night the angel of God , whose I am , and whom I serve ,

translation.kha: Une u pynbah um tip ïa ka Hukum u Moses , te ki long hapoh ka jingtim jong U Blei! !
translation.en: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed .

translation.kha: U Moses u kren ha u babha , Kynmaw ïa Kanah ka sngi — ka sngi ha kaba phiah mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha katba phi long ki mraw . Ken ka dei ka sngi ba U Trai u la ïalam noh ïa phiah da ka borbah jong u . Wat bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the people , Remember this day , in which ye came out from Egypt , out of the house of bondage  ; for by strength of hand the  Lord  brought you out from this place : there shall no leavened bread be eaten .

translation.kha: Bad u Saul u la mynjur ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u Stephan . Ha kata hi ka sngi , ka balang ha Jerusalem ka la pdang ban mad ïa ka jingpyndonkam beiñ kiba shakuriaw . Baroh ki riehtngen , lait noh ki apostol , ki la sakma shai kylleng jong ki thain ka Judas bad ka Samaria .
translation.en: And Saul was consenting unto his death . And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem  ; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria , except the apostles .
I will keep thy statutes : O forsake me not utterly .
translation.kha: Ngan kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me : A wat iehnoh da lei lei ïa nga !

Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Hesekaïah u la har , ki kam shlei jong u , bad ki jingïohthiah ba kumno u la tei ïa ka jaka pynlang um bad u tih ïa ka nur ban wallam um sha ka nongbah , la nguh jingthoh baroh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah , and all his might , and how he made a pool , and a conduit , and brought water into the city , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

translation.kha: Nangta u suh sha ka sharing lum ha ka phang bashathie jrong ka Lus ( kaba la khot ruh ka Bethel ) , nangta bret shaduh Ataroth Addar , ha u lym Uba shathie na ka Beth Horon kaba shakor .
translation.en: And the border went over from thence toward Luz , to the side of Luz , which is Beth–el , southward  ; and the border descended to Ataroth–adar , near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth–horon .

translation.kha: kumta u ïalam ïa la ki briew , u pynkhlad ïa ki ha ki prie kynhun , bad ki rakhe apthap ha ki lyngkha . Haba u ïohi ïa ki briew ba ki mih shabar na ka nongbah , u la mih na la ka jakarieh Ban pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: And he took the people , and divided them into three companies , and laid wait in the field , and looked , and , behold , the people were come forth out of the city  ; and he rose up against them , and smote them .

translation.kha: Kum u Amam u saw thiah bad u la imat mynleh kum uba pang . U Simri Dabid u la leit jngoh ïa u , malu u Amon u ong ha u , Sngewbha shait ïa i Tamar ban wan bad shet katne katne ki kpu hangne ha kaba nga lah baneh ïohi ïa i , badno nangta in ai bam ïa sa da ma i hi .
translation.en: So Amnon lay down , and made himself sick : and when the king was come to see him , Amnon said unto the king , I pray thee , let Tamar my sister come , and make me a couple of cakes in my sight , that I may eat at her hand .
He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand , and took Sela by war , and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day .
translation.kha: U Amasaïah u pynïap shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Edom ha ka Them Mluh ; u kurup ïa ka nongbah Sela ha ka thma bad u khot ïa ka , ka Joktheel , ka kyrteng kaba dang ïaisah .

translation.en: The  Lord  reigneth  ; let the earth rejoice  ; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem ! Ko pyrthei , to lehkmen ! To shadkmen , ko ki dewlynnong ha ki duriaw !

translation.en: The fishers also shall mourn , and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament , and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish .
translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh uba kamai ïa lade da kaba khwai ha ka Nile un ud khuslai bad un ïam ; ki khwai bad ki jar jong ki kin long ki bymmyntoi shuh .

translation.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions : and the plague brake in upon them .
translation.kha: Ki la pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  da ki jingleh jong ki , bad ka jingpang bashyrkhei ka la mih hapdeng jong ki .
Kano nangno ka jingthmu ba u ba-beit u pyrkhat ka longïng pop . Ki briew ki pli ïa u briew u im don ei ei Hynrei uba rkhiebeiñ ïa kiwei .
translation.en: The thought of foolishness is sin : and the scorner is an abomination to men .

translation.kha: Te khie leit ïada jingtip U syiem u hukum .
translation.en: And the king said , Enquire thou whose son the stripling is .

translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka por ki paidbah Benjamin ki ïohsngew ba ki para jait Israel baroh ki la ïalumlang ha Mispah . Ki Ishmael ki kylla , Ïathuh ïa ngi , Kumne Kanneh ka kam runar ka la jia ?
translation.en: ( Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpah . ) Then said the children of Israel , Tell us , how was this wickedness ?

translation.kha: Kaei kaei baroh ba ki paid Israel ki leh naduh mynstep haduh da suri ka long ka bymmyntoi bad kaba pynjot . Ka jingshetkylla bad ki jingleit jubor ki nang jylli hapdeng jong ki . Ki ïateh jutang bad ka Assyria , nabar ki ïakhaïi bad ka Ijipt .
translation.en: Ephraim feedeth on wind , and followeth after the east wind : he daily increaseth lies and desolation  ; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians , and oil is carried into Egypt .

To the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves for their height , neither shoot up their top among the thick boughs , neither their trees stand up in their height , all that drink water : for they are all delivered unto death , to the nether parts of the earth , in the midst of the children of men , with them that go down to the pit .
translation.kha: Bad kumta naduh mynta hi , yn ym don shuh u dieng , kam pher katno la ai um bha ïa u , un jrong pat sa shisien ne u ban kynjoh ïa la ka kliar lyngba ki lyoh bad u ban kot kat kato ka rynïeng . Ïa ki baroh la buh ban ïap kum ïa baroh ki briew ba dei ban ïap , la buh ba kin ïasoh bad kito kiba leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

translation.en: Arise , walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it  ; for I will give it unto thee .
translation.kha: Mynta , khie leit bad khmih ïa ka ri baroh kawei , naba ngan ai ïa ka baroh ha me .
Bat synshar ïa la ka jingkhluit khlaiñ ; ka longsem ka jingbieit ban pynlang ïa ka jingbatnud .
translation.en: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry : for anger resteth in the bosom of fools .
And there are three that bear witness in earth , the Spirit , and the water , and the blood : and these three agree in one .
translation.kha: Ki don lai ki sakhi : U Mynsiem , ka um bad ka snam ; bad kine baroh lai ki ai ïa kajuh ka jingphla .

ban pyntip ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar to ong ha ki : La kein u pukni rahah uba ni ki sner ba-ieit nabar ki thapniang kiba khraw , kiba pyiar heh . U la her sha ki lehbha Libni bad u la pynkieng ïa ka kliar jong u dieng Hadadeser ,
translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; A great eagle with great wings , longwinged , full of feathers , which had divers colours , came unto Lebanon , and took the highest branch of the cedar :

When the king of Babylon s army fought against Jerusalem , and against all the cities of Judah that were left , against Lachish , and against Azekah : for these defenced cities remained of the cities of Judah .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai ka dang tur ïaleh ruh ïa ka Lakhish bad ka Asekah , kiba long tang ma ki kiwei pat ki nongbah ba la tei kynroh kiba dang sah jong ka Judah .
U Trai u ong , Phin ïohi ïa nga ba nga siew kylliang ïa ka Babilonia bad ïa ki briew jong ka na ka pyntwa ka jingsniew baroh kaba ki la ar ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight , saith the  Lord .

And he spake unto the man clothed with linen , and said , Go in between the wheels , even under the cherub , and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims , and scatter them over the city . And he went in in my sight .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen ,  To leit hapdeng ki shalyntem hapoh ki kherub bad pyndap ïa ki kti jong phi da ki rnga ding barhem . Nangta bret ïa ki rnga halor ka nongbah .  Nga la peit ïa u ba u leit .
U tnen jong ka u khong hok ïa-ban pynskhem ne ban pyndam ïa kano kano ka ïakular ba ka la pynlong .
translation.en: Every vow , and every binding oath to afflict the soul , her husband may establish it , or her husband may make it void .

translation.kha: Uno na phi uba la Ïathuhlypa ba kane kan jia , khnang ba Ngin lah Ban ong ba phi long uba daym ? Ym don na phi uba la ong wat shikyntien shaïong jong ka ; ym ne uba la ïohsngew ïa ph ba phi ainong ïa kata .
translation.en: Who hath declared from the beginning , that we may know ? and beforetime , that we may say , He is righteous ? yea , there is none that sheweth , yea , there is none that declareth , yea , there is none that heareth your words .

translation.kha: Phi Iohi ïa katai ka nongrit ? Katai te ka khah jan . Shah lang leit shata — pa ïohi ïa ka ba ka long tang ka nongrit — mala ngan ïohlait im .
translation.en: Behold now , this city is near to flee unto , and it is a little one : Oh , let me escape thither , ( is it not a little one ? ) and my soul shall live .

For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth : for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Naduh kaba sdang eh jong ka histori jong ki , ki paid Israel bad ki paid Judah ki la pynsngewsih ïa nga bad ki la pynbitar ïa nga da kaei kaba ki la leh .

translation.en: For their redeemer is mighty  ; he shall plead their cause with thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u nongkyrshan uba donbor jong ki , bad un ïasaid ïa ka kam jong ki pyrshah ïa phi .

translation.en: And I will set my throne in Elam , and will destroy from thence the king and the princes , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki syiem bad ïa ki nongïalam jong ki , bad ngan buh ïa ka khet jong nga hangta .

translation.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered , saying , As the  Lord  hath said unto thy servants , so will we do .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah na ka jait Gad bad ka jait Reuben ki jubab ,  Kynrad , ngin leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  to Tyre  ; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of thy fall , when the wounded cry , when the slaughter is made in the midst of thee ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u don ïa kane ban ong ïa ka nongbah Tyros :  Haba la jop ïa pha , ki briew kiba shong basah ha ki rud duriaw kin sngewtriem ha ka jinglynñiar jong kito kiba shah pynïap .
To pyndei ha por ïa ka pisa na ka bynta ban shaw ïa ka khajna ! Ki la wanrah ha u ïa ka pisa ,
translation.en: Shew me the tribute money .  And they brought unto him a penny .

translation.kha: Ki briew jongu U Bela kin lait na ki jingkhuslai , bad ki ïohnang jong ki kin shok bad kine shngain .
translation.en: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation , and in sure dwellings , and in quiet resting places  ;

translation.kha: Lada phi king kynriah ïa ka dud , ka pynmih makhon . Lada phira tied ïa ka khmut jongno jongno , ka pynmih snam . Lada ph pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar , phi ngat ha ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter , and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood : so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife .

translation.kha: U Terah Nongsynshar u ong , Jamynrei mynta ngan sngewsyiad ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Jakeh , ki briew ka Jerusalem , bad ngan pynmanbha biang ïa ki . Ngan ïada ïa la ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Now will I bring again the captivity of Jacob , and have mercy upon the whole house of Israel , and will be jealous for my holy name  ;

translation.kha: Ki rangbah syier jong u ruh ki ai sngewbha ïa ki paidbah , ki lyngdoh , Bad ki Lebi ba kin pyndonkam . Bad ki jingbabe synshar ba dei peit ïa ka Templ — u Hilkaïah , u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u Sekharaïah , bad u Jehiel — ki ai ïa ki lyngkdong ar hajar hynriewspah thylli ki langbrot pynlang ki khunlung bad laispah tylli ki masi lyngraw na ka bynta ki jingkñia ha ka nga ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translation.en: And his princes gave willingly unto the people , to the priests , and to the Levites : Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel , rulers of the house of God , gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle , and three hundred oxen .

translation.kha: Blei ki nongsharai jylli ki wan ïakynduh ïa ki balang ?
translation.en: For what purpose do circuit overseers visit the congregations ?

translation.kha: Ha kaba nongtong u la ong , Mem shym la mon lane mem shym la sngewbha ïa ki jingkñia bad ïa ki jingainguh lane ïa ki mrad ban thang ha ka duwan bad ïa ki jingkñia ïa ka pun samla noh ïa ki pop . U la ong ïa khnai wat haba ïa baroh ki jingkñia la ainguh kat kum ka Hukum .
translation.en: Above when he said , Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not , neither hadst pleasure therein  ; which are offered by the law  ;

translation.kha: Ahian ka jingïamai kabu slem u Petros u la ïohnang bad u la ong , Ko hynmen ko para jong nga , phi tip ba la khim sleh mynshuwa U Blei u la jied ïa nga napdeng jong phi ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha sha ki Jentil , khnang ba ki lah ban ïohsngew bad bieit .
translation.en: And when there had been much disputing , Peter rose up , and said unto them , Men and brethren , ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us , that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel , and believe .
For the poor shall never cease out of the land : therefore I command thee , saying , Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother , to thy poor , and to thy needy , in thy land .
translation.kha: Yn don hi man la ka por ki Israel kiba duk bad kiba kyrduh , bad kumta nga hukum ïa phi ban lehsbun ïa ki .
U Judah u ong ha la u kpa , Phah ïa u para dara nga , bad ngin ïamihnoh kumne kumne . Te yn ym don uwei ruh na ine u ban ïapthngan .
translation.en: And Judah said unto Israel his father , Send the lad with me , and we will arise and go  ; that we may live , and not die , both we , and thou , and also our little ones .

translation.kha: Ko khun , to shahshkor bha , bad shah ba ka jingim jong nga kan long ka nuksa ïa phi .
translation.en: My son , give me thine heart , and let thine eyes observe my ways .

translation.kha: To tong ïa ka um ban pynkhreh na ka bynta ka jingshah kerkut , nabar to pynkhlaiñ ïa ki kut jong pha ! To ijuh ïa ka dewbyrtha banbeiñ shna ïa ki maw-it , Bad to pynkhreh ïa ki tiar shnong maw-it !
translation.en: Draw thee waters for the siege , fortify thy strong holds : go into clay , and tread the mortar , make strong the brickkiln .
But he knew their thoughts , and said to the man which had the withered hand ,  Rise up , and stand forth in the midst .  And he arose and stood forth .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong ki bad u la ong ha uta u briew ,  Ïeng joit bad wan shane sha khmat .  Uta u briew u la ïeng joit bad u la ïeng hangta .

translation.en: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar : they kept his testimonies , and the ordinance that he gave them .
translation.kha: U la kren ha ki na u rishot lyoh ; ki kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum ba u la ai ha ki .

translation.en: And he said ,  Verily I say unto you , No prophet is accepted in his own country .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa kane ,  U Jisu u la bynrap ,  ïa u nongïathuhlypa ym ju pdiang sngewbha ha la ka shnong .

pynlang ngan aiti ha kito katba kwah shun pyndap ïa ki , ha u Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia malade ka kynhun shipai jong u . Hynrei shen hadien , ki briew keiñ shongneh kin sah biang ha Ijipt , kumba ki la leh ha ki por ba la leit . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives , and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon , and into the hand of his servants : and afterward it shall be inhabited , as in the days of old , saith the  Lord .
Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead , if the dead rise not at all ? why are they then baptized for the dead ?
translation.kha: Mynta , aïu kan long ïa kito ki briew kiba la pynbaptis na ka bynta kiba ïap ? Aïu ki kyrmen ban pyndep ? Lada ka long kaba shisha , kumba don kiba kam , ba ïa kiba ïap yn ym pynmihpat , balei ïa kito ki briew la pynbaptis na ka bynta kiba ïap ?
Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka noh , Namar sa tieng shibit eh , bad ithuh babha Wan un woh ; un ym slem shuh .
translation.en: For yet a little while , and he that shall come will come , and will not tarry .

translation.kha: Lada phira kloi ban phah ïa u para jongngi ngi bad ngi , ngin rupa thiat bam ïa phi .
translation.en: If thou wilt send our brother with us , we will go down and buy thee food :

translation.kha: Nangta uba ar u la shongkurim ïa kata ka briew , bad nangta sa uba lai .
translation.en: And the second took her to wife , and he died childless .

translation.kha: U blem u kular ba u Jisu un-long U Syiem jong ka Shimham jong u .
translation.en: God promised that Jesus would become the King of His Kingdom .

translation.kha: U apostol u la ong ruh ha nga , Ki um ïa kiba me la ïohi , ha kaba kata ka nud ka shong , ki long ki jaitbynriew , ki paidlang , ki kynja bynriew bad ki jait ktien .
translation.en: And he saith unto me , The waters which thou sawest , where the whore sitteth , are peoples , and multitudes , and nations , and tongues .

translation.kha: Hato ngan ym pynsamthiah ïa ki na ka bynta kine kiei Kiei ? Hato ngan ym pynhiarkput khlur ka jaitbynriew kaba kum kane ? Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Shall I not visit them for these things ? saith the  Lord  : shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this ?

translation.kha: Na ka bynda ki angel , te , ka briew ka dei ba-bang don ka jingda halor la ka khlieh ban pyn-i ba ka long hapoh ka hab u tnga jong ka .
translation.en: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels .
Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning , to comfort them for the dead  ; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ban bam lane dih badno badno ban pyntngen ïa u mynba iba ieit bathoiñ i ïap . Ym don mano mano ban pyn-i jingsngewlem , wat ïa uta uba la duh noh ïa la u kpa lane ïa ka kmie .
nangta ha ka Jaka u kew bad u barli , to ai ba ki ñiut bad ki shiah kin mih . Ki ktien u Job ki kut hangne .
translation.en: Let thistles grow instead of wheat , and cockle instead of barley . The words of Job are ended .

translation.kha: Da phikir kumno phi pyrkhat ; nala ki jingpyrkhat jongno phira ki saiñdur ïa ka jingïam jong phi .
translation.en: Keep thy heart with all diligence  ; for out of it are the issues of life .
For we that are in this tabernacle do groan , being burdened : not for that we would be unclothed , but clothed upon , that mortality might be swallowed up of life .
translation.kha: Katba ngi dang shong ha kane ka ïingjaiñ kaba na kane ka khyndew , ngi ud sat da ka jingsngew ba shah banbeiñ ; kam dei ba ngi kwah ban lait noh na ka met kaba na ka khyndew , hynrei ba ngi kwah ban ïoh noh ban phong da kata kaba kynja bneng , khnang ba ïa kata kaba ïap yn ïoh pynkylla dur noh da kaba im .
Naba ma u hi u la ong , Ïa u nongïathuhlypa ym ju ñiewkor ha la ka jong ka ri .
translation.en: For Jesus himself testified , that a prophet hath no honour in his own country .
And Saul said unto Ahiah , Bring hither the ark of God . For the ark of God was at that time with the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Wallam hangne ïa ka Ephod ,  u Saul u ong ha u Ahijah u lyngdoh . ( Ha kata ka sngi u Ahijah u dang rah ïa ka ha khmat ki paid Israel . )

translation.en: Open thy mouth , judge righteously , and plead the cause of the poor and needy .
translation.kha: Kren na ka bynta jong ki bad long u nongbishar uba hok . Ïada ïa ki hok jong kiba duk bad kiba kyrduh .

translation.en: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal .
translation.kha: La pynpaw ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U Mynsiem ha kano kano ka rukom ha uwei pa uwei na ka bynta ka jingbha ïa baroh .
U Khrist u long khem kawei ka met , kaba don shibit ki dkhot ; ka long hi tang kawei ka met , wat haba la pynlong ïa ka da ki dkhot kiba ïaphah .
translation.en: For as the body is one , and hath many members , and all the members of that one body , being many , are one body : so also is Christ .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kyrhuh kyrhai ïa phi ha ki bynta baroh , hynmen phim shym shakri ïa u da ka dohnud kob sngewbha mala kaba kmen .
translation.en: Because thou servedst not the  Lord  thy God with joyfulness , and with gladness of heart , for the abundance of all things  ;

translation.kha: Ryngkat bad uta u khunlangbrot uba nyngkong , ainguh kumba shi kilo u khiew ba la tylliat ni bha ba la khleh lang bad shi riej ka umphniang Eliab kaba bha . Theh ruh shi litar ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh .
translation.en: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil  ; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering .
That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart , because they are all estranged from me through their idols .
translation.kha: Kito ki bleithaw baroh ki la pynphai noh ïa ki Israel na nga , hynrei da ka jubab jong nga , nga kyrmen ban ïoh pat ïa ka jingshaniah jong ki .
Khie leit ha kaba suk , u Eloi u ong , malade to U Blei ki Israel un ai ha pha ïa said kaba pha pan na u .
translation.en: Then Eli answered and said , Go in peace : and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him .

translation.kha: kumto u syiem ka Israel u la maham ïa ki brai kiba shong hangta , bad ki la hir phiah ïa lade . Kane ka jia bun bunsien .
translation.en: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of , and saved himself there , not once nor twice .

In those days saw I in Judah some treading wine presses on the sabbath , and bringing in sheaves , and lading asses  ; as also wine , grapes , and figs , and all manner of burdens , which they brought into Jerusalem on the sabbath day : and I testified against them in the day wherein they sold victuals .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , nga ïohi ba ki briew ha Judah ki khñiot umsoh na ki sohwaiñ ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Kiwei pat ki dang kyntiew halor ki kada jong ki ïa u kew , ka waiñ , sohwaiñ , soh Khajur , bad kiwei kiei kiei bad leit rah ïa ki sha Jerusalem ; nga la maham ïa ki ban ym die ei ei ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
U dem ioh ki bniap shiah , bad u rieh hapdeng ki khah ha ki jaka sngem .
translation.en: He lieth under the shady trees , in the covert of the reed , and fens .
And one of Joab s men stood by him , and said , He that favoureth Joab , and he that is for David , let him go after Joab .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki rangbah jong u Joab u la ïeng harud ka metïap jong u Amasa bad u pyrta ,  Uno uno uba ha ka liang jong u Joab bad u Dabid , to un bud ïa u Joab !
U ong , Pyntyllun katto katne ki maw kiba heh ha khmat dat ka krem . Buh katto katne ki nongap phira hangta ,
translation.en: And Joshua said , Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave , and set men by it for to keep them :

translation.kha: katto kattne na ki jingthaw ba kynja bneng ki la ïew ba kine ki samla kynthei ki long bakha bhabriew , kumjuh ki la shim ïa kita kiba ki la mon .
translation.en: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair  ; and they took them wives of all which they chose .

translation.kha: Ym don ei ei ïa u kpa hynrei ka jingsngewthuh bad jingkthang haba u khun jong u leh ïa ki ki bieit .
translation.en: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow : and the father of a fool hath no joy .
Now as soon as this letter cometh to you , seeing your master s sons are with you , and there are with you chariots and horses , a fenced city also , and armour  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka shithi la thoh :  Phi dei ki nongpeit ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem jong phi bad phi don ruh bad phi ki kali ïapom , ki kulai , ki tiar ïapom bad ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh .

translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,
Ïa ka jingsarong jong kito ki nongïaleh buaid yn ïuhroit haduh ki kjat .
translation.en: The crown of pride , the drunkards of Ephraim , shall be trodden under feet :

translation.kha: To lama kiba tari ha ka rukom kaba phi leh ïa kiwei ki im pat ngeit , da kaba pyndonkam ha ka rukom kaba daiñ ïa kawei pa kawei ka kabu kaba phi ïoh .
translation.en: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without , redeeming the time .

I also will do this unto you  ; I will even appoint over you terror , consumption , and the burning ague , that shall consume the eyes , and cause sorrow of heart : and ye shall sow your seed in vain , for your enemies shall eat it .
translation.kha: Ngan pynngat ha phi ïa ka jingjynjar — ki jingpang bym lah pynkhiah , bad ki jingpang shit ki ban pynmatlah ïa phi bad ban pynlong ïa ka jingim jong phi ban sep-ei . Phin bet ïa u symbai , hynrei um myntoi ïa phi , naba ki nongshun jong phi kin jop ïa phi bad kin bam ïa kaba phi la thung .
To ïashukor ïa nga , phi ki briew mutlop kiba pyrkhat ba ka jingjop ka dang shaei jingïohi bah .
translation.en: Hearken unto me , ye stouthearted , that are far from righteousness :

translation.kha: Mano ba bat ïa ki rishot kiba kyrshan ïa ka khyndew ? Mano ba buh ïa u mawdong jong ka pyrthei ?
translation.en: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened ? or who laid the corner stone thereof  ;

translation.kha: Un kren ïa-pyrshah ïa U Blei Berekhaïah Tam Eh bad banbeiñ ïa ki briew jong U Blei . Un Pyrshang Ban pynkylla ïa ki aiñ niam bad ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong ki , bad ki biria jong U Balei kin long hapoh ka bor jngai u haduh sa snem shiteng .
translation.en: And he shall speak great words against the most High , and shall wear out the saints of the most High , and think to change times and laws : and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time .

translation.kha: Ngi ïaroh ïa ka bor jong me , A Trai U Nongsynshar ; ngan pynbna ïa ka jingbuh jong me , tang ka jong me hi .
translation.en: I will go in the strength of the Lord  God  : I will make mention of thy righteousness , even of thine only .

translation.kha: Te u diengduh jong uta u briew ïa uba nga la jied un ktieh malade . Da kumta ngan pynsngap pan ïa ki jingïaikren khñium jong Kin ki Israel pyrshah ïa me .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that the man s rod , whom I shall choose , shall blossom : and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel , whereby they murmur against you .
And Nathan departed unto his house . And the  Lord  struck the child that Uriah s wife bare unto David , and it was very sick .
translation.kha: Nangta u Nathan u leit phai noh sha ïing . U  Trai  u la pynngat ka jingshitom bajur ha u khunlung ba ka tnga u Uriah ka la ïoh na u Dabid .
Nga la kren ha ki nongïathuhlypa bad ai ha ki shibun ki jingpyniwbih , bad lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa nga ai jingmaham ïa ki briew Jong nga .
translation.en: I have also spoken by the prophets , and I have multiplied visions , and used similitudes , by the ministry of the prophets .
And I will bring back all the people unto thee : the man whom thou seekest is as if all returned : so all the people shall be in peace .
translation.kha: bad nangta ngan wan ïalam pat ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh sha phi , kum ka nongleitkurim kaba wan phai sha la u jong u tnga . Phi kwah ban pynïap tang ïa uwei u briew ; kiba sah na ki paidbah kin lait im .
ki eh ka jingjop bad ka jingpynjot shano shano ba ki lytar .
translation.en: Destruction and misery are in their ways :

translation.kha: Khynñiuh mynta de ong ha phi : kdew pynhiarkput ïa uno uno uba leh sniew ïa phi . Lada uno uno u thab ïa phi na ka ngab kamon , ai ba un thab ïa ka ngab sdang jong phi ruh .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That ye resist not evil : but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek , turn to him the other also .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga la duwai na ka bynta jong me , ko Simon , ba ka jingbymngeit jong me kan ym duh noh! . Bad haba me la wan phai pat sha nga , me dei ban pynkhlaiñ ïa ki hynmen ki para jong me .
translation.en: But I have prayed for thee , that thy faith fail not : and when thou art converted , strengthen thy brethren .

translation.kha: U ong , Shahshkor ïa ka jingphohsniew jong nga .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Hear , I pray you , this dream which I have dreamed :

translation.kha: jynreiñ mynta ïa ki khun ki ksuid jong ki la shah pynjot , Shi lynter naduh Heshbon haduh Dibon , Naduh Nashim haduh Nophah , hajan ka Medeba .
translation.en: We have shot at them  ; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon , and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah , which reacheth unto Medeba .

translation.kha: Ki la teh ïa u ha ki kynjri , ki la ïasam ïa u , bad ki la aiti ïa u ha u Pilat , u lyngktop ka hangta kamar .
translation.en: And when they had bound him , they led him away , and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor .

translation.kha: ka Jarmuth , bad ka Engannim , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: Jarmuth with her suburbs , En–gannim with her suburbs  ; four cities .

translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongsynshar jong ngi , bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la pynlehrain bad ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa me a Trai .
translation.en: O Lord , to us belongeth confusion of face , to our kings , to our princes , and to our fathers , because we have sinned against thee .

And let these my words , wherewith I have made supplication before the  Lord  , be nigh unto the  Lord  our God day and night , that he maintain the cause of his servant , and the cause of his people Israel at all times , as the matter shall require :
translation.kha: To ai ba un leh-isynei borabor ïa ki paid Israel bad ïa u syiem jong ki kat kum ki jingdonkam jong ki kiba man la ka sngi .

translation.en: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity , because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the  Lord  : and that soul shall be cut off from among his people .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba bam ïa ka un ngat ha ka jingpynrem ba u kheiñ dew thala ïa kaba la pynkyntang sha nga , bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .
ka Baalah , ka Iim , ka Esem ,
translation.en: Baalah , and Iim , and Ezem ,

translation.kha: U la ap hynñiew sngi ïa u saiwul , kumba u Shemuel u la bthah ïa u ïa-ban leh , hynmen u Samuel um pat shym wan iar sha Gilgal .
translation.en: And he tarried seven days , according to the set time that Samuel had appointed : but Samuel came not to Gilgal  ; and the people were scattered from him .
He hath stripped me of my glory , and taken the crown from my head .
translation.kha: U la shim noh ïa ka spah jong nga baroh bad pynjot ïa ka burom jong nga .
U Tom u heh ia por tang katto-katne snep .
translation.en: Tom is a couple of years older than me , I think .
And David said unto Abiathar , I knew it that day , when Doeg the Edomite was there , that he would surely tell Saul : I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father s house .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u ,  Haba nga ïohi ïa u Doeg hangta ha kato ka sngi , nga la tip skhem ba un sa ïathuh ha u Saul . Kumta nga kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi baroh .
Ki briew’ jong U Trai ki la len ïa u mala ki la ong , Un ym leh ei ei da shisha . Ngam ym mad ïa ki por ba-eh ; ngin ym mad ïa ka thma lap ka nongaibuit .
translation.en: They have belied the  Lord  , and said , It is not he  ; neither shall evil come upon us  ; neither shall we see sword nor famine :

translation.kha: pynlang nangta U Blei un wallam ka jingjot ïa ka nongbah ïa ka la khot ka duwan U Blei . Kan don ka jingïam nabar ka jingïambriew , bad ka nongbah baroh kawei kan long kum ka duwan ba la tap da ka snam .
translation.en: Yet I will distress Ariel , and there shall be heaviness and sorrow : and it shall be unto me as Ariel .
Therefore they gathered them together , and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves , which remained over and above unto them that had eaten .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïalum ïa baroh kaba la tam bad ki la pyndap haduh khat-ar tukri da ki lyngkhot kiba la sah tam na ki san tylli ki kpu barli kiba ki briew ki la bam .

Phi long ba la tim ! Phi ong ha ka lyngkhot dieng , Khie noh ! ne ïa u maw , Ïeng joit ! hato ka bleithaw ka lah ban pynpaw ei ei ïa phi ? Heh ban suit ïa ka da ka reng bad ka ksiar , hynrei ym don jingtim ha ka .
translation.en: Woe unto him that saith to the wood , Awake  ; to the dumb stone , Arise , it shall teach ! Behold , it is laid over with gold and silver , and there is no breath at all in the midst of it .

translation.kha: U Tlai u la kyntait ïa ki Israel baher , u pynshitom ïa ki bad u aiti noh ïa ki sha ki nongshun barunar haw ha kaweh khatduh pun pyndam ïa ki na khmat jong u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  rejected all the seed of Israel , and afflicted them , and delivered them into the hand of spoilers , until he had cast them out of his sight .

translation.kha: Baroh kaba i'u Don hangne ki long san tylli ki kpu bad ar tylliat ki dohkha , ki la ïajubab .
translation.en: And they say unto him , We have here but five loaves , and two fishes .
There shall no evil befall thee , neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling .
translation.kha: bad kumta ka jingpynjot kan ym shoh ïa me , ka jingleh jubor kan ym wan hajan ka ïing jong me .
Ko ki shynrang , to ainguh ïa la ki tnga bad wat erlangthari bakha leh khor ïa ki .
translation.en: Husbands , love your wives , and be not bitter against them .

Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers  ; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them , according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Bad lada ki paid Israel kin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh , bad sumar ïa ka Hukum baroh kaba u Moses u shakri jong nga u la ai ïa ki , te ngan ym shah ban beh noh ïa ki na ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: And these are they which are sown among thorns  ; such as hear the word ,
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai ba la bet hapdeng ki bniap shiah . Kine ki long kita kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ,

translation.en: Then began he to speak to the people this parable  ;  A certain man planted a vineyard , and let it forth to husbandmen , and went into a far country for a long time .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki paidbah ïa kane ka pharshi :  La don shisien uwei u briew uba don ka bri sohwaiñ , u la aiwai ha ki nongshimwai , bad nangta u la mihnoh na ïing ban jah kham slem .

translation.en: For his God doth instruct him to discretion , and doth teach him .
translation.kha: U tip kumno ban trei ïa ka kam jong u namar U Blei u hikai ïa u .

translation.en: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold , for all instruments of all manner of service  ; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight , for all instruments of every kind of service :
translation.kha: U ai jingbthah ruh katno ka rupa bad ka ksiar kan leit ha kaba shna ïa kita ki khiew ki pliang ,

translation.en: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens  ; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingpyrsad jong u kaba pynkhuid ïa ka suiñbneng , bad dei ka kti jong u kaba pynïap ïa u mrad kynsha uba ïaleh ban phet .
U khnam khlaiñ ban ianga .
translation.en: He's stronger than me .

translation.kha: Teh jin ha ki kulai jong phi Bad shong halor jong ki ! ïong riewngeit bad reng ïa ki jingda khlieh jong phi ! Pynnep ïa ki sum jong phi ! Kieng ïa ka atiar jngai phi !’
translation.en: Harness the horses  ; and get up , ye horsemen , and stand forth with your helmets  ; furbish the spears , and put on the brigandines .
Who can stand before his indignation ? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger ? his fury is poured out like fire , and the rocks are thrown down by him .
translation.kha: Haba u bitar , uei uba lah ban lait im ? Uei uba lah ban lait na ka jingbitar shla bashyrkhei jong u ? U theh noh ïa ka jingbitar bameh ding jong u ; ki mawsiang ki lko pum ha khmat jong u .
Na ki jingkñia ainguh kiba da u masi ne ka nongaplangbrot , ki lyngdoh ki dei don ïoh ïa ka tyrpeng , baroh ar ki ngab , bad ka nierbah .
translation.en: And this shall be the priest s due from the people , from them that offer a sacrifice , whether it be ox or sheep  ; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder , and the two cheeks , and the maw .
For God hath not given us the spirit of fear ; but of power , and of love , and of a sound mind .
translation.kha: Naba U Mynsiem uba U Blei u la ai ha ngi um pynlong ïa ngi kiba khawpud ; pynban , U Mynsiem jong u , u pyndap ïa ngi da ka bor , ka jingieit , bad ka bor halor lade .
Reba ngut ki syiem , u Amraphel jong ka Babilonia , u Ariokh jong ka Ellasar , u Gomer jong ka Elam , Bad u Tidal jong ka Goiim ,
translation.en: And it came to pass in the days of Amraphel king of Shinar , Arioch king of Ellasar , Chedorlaomer king of Elam , and Tidal king of nations  ;
Neither shall one thrust another  ; they shall walk every one in his path : and when they fall upon the sword , they shall not be wounded .
translation.kha: lane ïatyngkhuh para ma ki . Ki ïa-ïaid kynhun lyngba ïa ki jingker-ïada , bad ym don kano kano kaba lah ban pynsangeh ïa ki .

translation.en: And come to the king , and speak on this manner unto him . So Joab put the words in her mouth .
translation.kha: Nangta leit sha u syiem bad ong ha u ïa kaei kaba nga bthah ïa phi ban ong .  Nangta u Joab u la ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei ban ong .

translation.en: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom : but the friend of the bridegroom , which standeth and heareth him , rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom s voice : this my joy therefore is fulfilled .
translation.kha: Ka nongleitkurim ka dei ka jong u nongleitkurim ; hynrei u paralok jong u nongleitkurim , uba ïeng marsyndah bad shahshkor , u kmen haba u ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u nongleitkurim . Kane ka long kumno ba ïa ka jingkmen jong nga la pyndap pura .
To Shahshkor ïa nga , pa’ baroh ! Ki don ki jingshyrkhei , ki lypa , bad ki jingriam kiba ap ïa phi .
translation.en: Fear , and the pit , and the snare , are upon thee , O inhabitant of the earth .
The cities of Aroer are forsaken : they shall be for flocks , which shall lie down , and none shall make them afraid .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Syria yn sa iehnoh junom . Kin long ka jaka pynbamphlang ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi , bad ym don mano mano ba beh noh ïa ki .

translation.en: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together , and went northward , and said unto Jephthah , Wherefore passedst thou over to fight against the children of Ammon , and didst not call us to go with thee ? we will burn thine house upon thee with fire .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah Ephraim ki khreh ban ïaleh thma ; ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan sha Saphon bad ki ong ha u Jephthah ,  Balei phi leit ïaleh ïa ki Ammon khlem da khot lem ïa ngi ban leit lang bad phi ? Ngin thang im ïa me hapoh ïing !

translation.en: Thou shalt increase my greatness , and comfort me on every side .
translation.kha: Men pynlong ïa nga uba kham khraw ban ïa kaba ju long ; bad men pyntngen biang ïa nga .

Baroh ki briew kiba shong ha ka pyrthei kin mane ïa u , lait noh ïa kito kiba ïa ki kyrteng jong ki la thop ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei ha ka kitab jong kiba im kiba dem ki jong uto U khunlangbrot ïa uba la shah pynïap .
translation.en: And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him , whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world .

translation.kha: Hato me thop haduh katno ki kit ïa la ki khun rit ? Hammoth me tip ïa ka por ba yn kha ïa ki ?
translation.en: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil ? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth ?

translation.kha: Wat thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ki blei kiba da ka rupa ne da ka ksiar banbeiñ mane ïa ki nalor jong nga .
translation.en: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver , neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khyrdop jongnga U Trai ; tangba kba khak ki lai ban ring shapoh .
translation.en: This gate of the  Lord  , into which the righteous shall enter .

translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan haduh ha uta u briew uba pynïap briew ha kambah rieh .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly . And all the people shall say , Amen .

But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth , to burn incense unto the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , as we have done , we , and our fathers , our kings , and our princes , in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem : for then had we plenty of victuals , and were well , and saw no evil .
translation.kha: Ngin leh ïa kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba ngi la ong ban leh . Ngin ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ka blei jong ngi , ka Syiem jong ka Bneng , bad ngin theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ sha ka , kumba ma ngi bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u syiem jong ngi bad ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki la ju leh ha ki shnong ka Judah bad ha ki surok bah ka Jerusalem . Nangta ngi don ka bam kyrhai , ngi manbha , bad ngim ju don jingjynjar .

Haba u syiem Jehoïakim bad ki shipai malu ki rangbah synshar jongu u ki la iohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Uriah u la lah ong , u syiem u la pyrshang ban phad pynïap ïa u . hynne u Uriah u la ïohsngew shaphang kata ; kumta u la phet ha ka jingsngewlem bad u la lait phet sha Ijipt .
translation.en: And when Jehoiakim the king , with all his mighty men , and all the princes , heard his words , the king sought to put him to death : but when Urijah heard it , he was afraid , and fled , and went into Egypt  ;

translation.kha: phiah sarong ba phira la pyningkhong ïa ka jingieit dara ka jingdap bad pah sha ka jingïakut pynlang ka pyrthei kiba ïan . Phi sngewthikna ba phiah lait na ka jingjngem haba kan wan , nabar phi shaniah ha ki jinglamler bad ki jingshakri ban pyllait ïa phi .
translation.en: Because ye have said , We have made a covenant with death , and with hell are we at agreement  ; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through , it shall not come unto us : for we have made lies our refuge , and under falsehood have we hid ourselves :

translation.kha: Wat khum ïa ka shyntur u masi dab haba phi pyndonburom ïa u ha kiba shoh kew .
translation.en: Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn .
And as he reasoned of righteousness , temperance , and judgment to come , Felix trembled , and answered , Go thy way for this time  ; when I have a convenient season , I will call for thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei katba u Paul u dang batai shaphang ka jingbha , ka bor halor lade , bad ka Sngi ka Jingbishar ka ban sa wan , u Pheliks u la sheptieng bad u la ong ,  Mynta me lah ban leit noh shuwa . Ngan sa phah khot pat haba nga ïohlad .
Haduh hynñiew snem un ym don ka bor pyrkhat briew , hynrei ka jingpyrkhat kum u mrad .
translation.en: Let his heart be changed from man s , and let a beast s heart be given unto him  ; and let seven times pass over him .
Even those that were numbered of them , throughout their families , by the house of their fathers , were two thousand and six hundred and thirty .
translation.kha: U Moses u kohnguh bad u buh jingthoh ïa ki khun shynrang baroh kiba la kha nyngkong ha Israel kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ,
Nga don hangto sohpdung ki briew ïa kiba me la jied kum la ki jong , ki briew kiba bun paid mawria katta ba ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki .
translation.en: And thy servant is in the midst of thy people which thou hast chosen , a great people , that cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude .
The  Lord  will destroy the house of the proud : but he will establish the border of the widow .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynjot ïa ki longïing jong ki briew kiba sarong , hynrei un ïada ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ka riewkynthei .
Suk ma phi kiba thngan mynta ; yn pyndap ïa phi ! Suk ma phi katba ïam mynta ; phin rkhie !
translation.en: Blessed are ye that hunger now : for ye shall be filled . Blessed are ye that weep now : for ye shall laugh .

translation.kha: Me la pyrsad ïa ka duli bad ka um ka kynton shajrong eh ; ka ngin beit thik kum ka kynroh ; ka bynta bajylliew tam jong ka duriaw ka kylla eh .
translation.en: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together , the floods stood upright as an heap , and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea .

translation.kha: Khie leit , U ju u ong ïa u , ka jingngeit jong me ka la pynkhia ïa me . Mar katkum hi u la da ba-bang ïohi bad u la bud ïa U Jisu ha ka lynti .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Go thy way  ; thy faith hath made thee whole .  And immediately he received his sight , and followed Jesus in the way .
I have put off my coat  ; how shall I put it on ? I have washed my feet  ; how shall I defile them ?
translation.kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong phi ki long kum u ribon basawbthuh ; katno ki long kiba i-ieit haba phi kren . Ki ngab jong phi ki thaba napoh ka jaiñtapkhmat .
U Malkhijah , u khun jong u Khim bad u Hushah , u khun jong u Pahath Hobab , ki teh baroh ar tylli ki bynda kiba bud nabar ïa u Mot siat kput .
translation.en: Malchijah the son of Harim , and Hashub the son of Pahath–moab , repaired the other piece , and the tower of the furnaces .

translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi phi la pynbna ba U Trai u long U Blei jong pa’ ; phi la kular ban kohnguh ïa u , ban sumar ïa ki waiñ bad ki hukum jong u , bad ban leh ruh kat ïa kaba u hukum .
translation.en: Thou hast avouched the  Lord  this day to be thy God , and to walk in his ways , and to keep his statutes , and his commandments , and his judgments , and to hearken unto his voice :
And the  Lord  said unto him , Surely I will be with thee , and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u jubab ,  Me lah ban leh ïa ka namar ngan ïarap ïa me . Men pynlwet ïa ki Midian da kaba suk i kumba ki long tang uwei u briew .

Shata phi dih ban leit rah ïa ki jingainguh thang malade ki jingkñia jongnga phiah , ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jyllang phi , bun ïa ki jingainguh jong phi , ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba phi kular ïa U Trai , ïa ki jingainguh niam sngewbha jong phi , bad ïa kiba la kha nyngkong na ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi .
translation.en: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings , and your sacrifices , and your tithes , and heave offerings of your hand , and your vows , and your freewill offerings , and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks :

translation.kha: Phan ym leit khleiñ ñiuhkhlieh lane khlem sopkjat lane sngewsih ne ïabam . Phan pyn-ap namar ki pop jong phah , bad phan ïa-ud iwei ha iwei .
translation.en: And your tires shall be upon your heads , and your shoes upon your feet : ye shall not mourn nor weep  ; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities , and mourn one toward another .

translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa ki kmie ki kpa u Moses ban buhrieh ïa u lah bnai hadien ba la kham ïa u . Ki la ïohi ba u la long u khunlung uba barabor , bad kim shym la bymsheptieng ban pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum u phaloh .
translation.en: By faith Moses , when he was born , was hid three months of his parents , because they saw he was a proper child  ; and they were not afraid of the king s commandment .
Then said I , Woe is me ! for I am undone  ; because I am a man of unclean lips , and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips : for mine eyes have seen the King , the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Ym don jingkyrmen ïa nga ! Nga long ba la tim namar kawei pa kawei ka kyntien kaba mih na ki rmiang shyntur jong nga ka long kaba pop , bad nga shong nga sah hapdeng ki briew kiba kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ka long kaba pop . Bad pynban , da la ki jong ki khmat nga la ïohi ïa U Syiem , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time , houses , and brethren , and sisters , and mothers , and children , and lands , with persecutions  ; and in the world to come eternal life .
translation.kha: Un ïohpdiang shispah shah shuh shuh ki ïing , ki hynmen ki para shynrang ne kynthei , ki kmie , ki khun bad ki lyngkha — bad ki jingshah pynshitom beiñ ruh kumjuh ; bad ha ka pateng ka ban sa wan un ïoh ka jingim bymjukut .
Ba U Khrist un pynsuhthied ha mynsiem jongphi da jingngeit , ba phna , pynshong nongrim ha ka jingieit ,
translation.en: That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith ; that ye , being rooted and grounded in love ,
So I prophesied as I was commanded : and as I prophesied , there was a noise , and behold a shaking , and the bones came together , bone to his bone .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la ïathuhlypa kumba la bthah ïa nga . Katba nga dang kren , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa kum ka jingkhih shane shatai , bad ki shyieng ki la sdang ban ïadait lang .

translation.en: But he that received the seed into stony places , the same is he that heareth the word , and anon with joy receiveth it  ;
translation.kha: Ki symbai kiba la hap ha ka jaka mawsiang ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba pdiang ïa ka khubor da kaba kmen mar ïa ïohsngew ïa ka .

translation.en: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace .
translation.kha: Bad ka jingbha ka long ka jingmih ba la pynmih na ki symbai kiba ki nongpynïasuk ki la bet ha ka jingsuk .

translation.en: For the  Lord  thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp , to deliver thee , and to give up thine enemies before thee  ; therefore shall thy camp be holy : that he see no unclean thing in thee , and turn away from thee .
translation.kha: Sumar khuid ïa ka jaka shong dara jong phi , namar U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u don ryngkat bad phi hangta ban ïada ïa phi bad ai ha phi ka jingjop ïa ki nongshun jong phi . Wat leh ïa kano kano kaba khlem akor kaba lah ban pynlong ïa U  Trai  ban phai noh na phi .

translation.en: But whoso hath this world s good , and seeth his brother have need , and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him , how dwelleth the love of God in him ?
translation.kha: Lada u briew uba riewspah u ïohi ïa la u parabriew ha ka jingkyrduh , pynban , u khang khyrdep ïa la ka dohnud pyrshah ïa la u parabriew , kumno u lah ban kam ba u ieit ïa U Blei ?
Hynrei ïa ki Jeraïah u Solomon um shym la pynurlong mraw ; ki la shakri ïa u kum ki shipai , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki pynbah ai sah , ki kapten kali ïapom , bad ki nongshong khuri jong u .
translation.en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no bondmen : but they were men of war , and his servants , and his princes , and his captains , and rulers of his chariots , and his horsemen .

translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u duwai : Me , A Trei , me la buh ïa ka sngi ha ka sahit bneng , pynban me la jied ba shong ha ki lyoh bad ka jingdiang .
translation.en: Then spake Solomon , The  Lord  said that he would dwell in the thick darkness .

translation.kha: U la pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshukor jong phi bad u la wallam pat ïa phi na ki ri nongwei , na mihngi bad sepngi , na shatei bad shathie .
translation.en: And gathered them out of the lands , from the east , and from the west , from the north , and from the south .

translation.kha: Nga tharai , u Sidon u la jingjubab , un long tur uba la ïohmap kham badno . Me ong kob dei , U Jisu u la Ong .
translation.en: Simon answered and said , I suppose that he , to whom he forgave most . And he said unto him ,  Thou hast rightly judged .
And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother  ;
translation.kha: u la lait na kaba ïarap ïa la u kpa lane ka kmie .
Me la jied ïa ki napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ban longsyiem u paidlang jong me , main me la ïathuh ha ki lymbung u Moses u shakri jong me mynba me wan ïalam ino na Ijipt ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translation.en: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth , to be thine inheritance , as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant , when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt , O Lord  God .
And he said , I beseech thee , shew me thy glory .
translation.kha: Nangta U Moses u kyrpad ,  Sngewbha shah ngan ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong me .
Ki Kanaan bad baroh kiba hapoh ka ri kin sa ïohsngew ïa kane . Kin sa kerkut ïa ngi , pynlang kin sa pynïap ïa utai pa uwei ïa ngi ! Susah nangta aïu men leh ban ïada ïa la ka burom ?
translation.en: For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it , and shall environ us round , and cut off our name from the earth : and what wilt thou do unto thy great name ?

translation.kha: Kumta nga la phai bad leit hiar na uta u lumlang , nga da rah ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap ar tylli , ha kiba la thoh ïa ka jutang . Ki thylliej ding ki dang meh ha uta u lum .
translation.en: So I turned and came down from the mount , and the mount burned with fire : and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands .

Then thou shalt see , and flow together , and thine heart shall fear , and be enlarged  ; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee , the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee .
translation.kha: Phin sa ïohi ïa kane bad yn pyndap da ka jingkmen . Phin khynñiuh da ka jingsngewkmen . Ki spah jong ki jaitbynriew yn wallam sha pha ; na shiliang ka duriaw ki spah jong ki kin wan .
Kanneh keiñ , ka longïing Kumne phi dei ban duwai : ‘ Ko Kpa jong ngi uba ha bneng : Ai ba ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me lai long katba la pyndonburom ;
translation.en: After this manner therefore pray ye : Our Father which art in heaven , Hallowed be thy name .

translation.kha: Baroh keiñ kiei kiba u syiem Sekharaïah u la leh , ki kada shlur jong u , bad ki jingïathuh ba kumno u la tei ïa ka jaka pynlang um bad u tih ïa ka nur ba wallam um sha ka nongbat , la buh jingïathoh baroh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Shilhim Ka Judah .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah , and all his might , and how he made a pool , and a conduit , and brought water into the city , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

translation.kha: ka Dimnah , sad ka Nahalal , lem bad ki pynsat phlang jong ki .
translation.en: Dimnah with her suburbs , Nahalal with her suburbs  ; four cities .
For it is written , Rejoice , thou barren that bearest not ; break forth and cry , thou that travailest not : for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband .
translation.kha: Naba la thoh ,  Suk , pha ka kynthei kaba lyngki ! To risa bad kyang da ka jingkmen , pha ka bym ju la ïohmad ïa ki jingpang jong ka jingsuh kha ! Naba kata ka kynthei kaba la shah iehnoh kan ïoh kham bun ki khun ban ïa ka kynthei kaba u tnga um ju iehnoh ïa ka .

translation.en: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath : so Tibni died , and Omri reigned .
translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh , kito kiba kwah ïa u Omri ki la jop ; u Tibni u la ïap bad u Omri u la long u syiem .

Kaba mih ka long ba u trai jong une u sordar bymhok u la ïaroh ïa u ba u kuna ïa kaba kumto kane kaba sianti ; namar ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei ki long ibha kham sianti ha kaba trei ïa la ki kam don ïa ki briew kiba long ki jong ka jingshai .
translation.en: And the lord commended the unjust steward , because he had done wisely : for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa uwei patar u angel ba u wan mihnoh na ka Templ ha bneng , bad u shiah u la don ka rashi kaba nep .
translation.en: And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven , he also having a sharp sickle .
And if any man hear my words , and believe not , I judge him not : for I came not to judge the world , but to save the world .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u ïohsngew ïa ka khubor jong nga bad um kohnguh ïa ka , ngan ym bishar ïa u . Nga la wan , ym ban bishar ïa ka pyrthei , hynrei ban pynim ïa ka .
Ha ka met lad u diengpynïeng sharak hi yn don rupa tylli ki khuri kiba kum ki syntiew almond lem bad ki shylluit bad ki dop-syntiew ba la ïa-ïohpdiang itynnat .
translation.en: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds , with their knops and their flowers .

translation.kha: bad un longïng u syiem jongu ki khun ki ksiew u Jobab jingkhum ; ka hima jong u kan ym kut shuh da lei lin !
translation.en: And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever  ; and of his kingdom there shall be no end .
Now Philip was of Bethsaida , the city of Andrew and Peter .
translation.kha: ( U Philip u dei na Bethsaida , ka shnong ha kaba u Andriw bad u Petros ki sah . )
Bad ïa kane ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Shemida yn ïalap ha kylleng ka pynrieh na ka bynta ka jingsakhi sha ki jaitbynriew baroh ; bad nangta kaba kut kan wan .
translation.en: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations  ; and then shall the end come .

translation.kha: Aïu nga lah ban ong , A Trai , mynta ba ki Israel ki la kynram dien na u nongshun ?
translation.en: O Lord , what shall I say , when Israel turneth their backs before their enemies !

translation.kha: U Blei hi da lade u long u nongïalam jong ngi bad ki lyngdoh jong u ki don Hangno lem nabar ki turoi , ba la khreh ban put ïa ki malade ban khot ïa ngi bun ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa phi . Ko pyllut Israel , wat ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai , U Blei jong ki kop tymmen jong phi ! Phin ym ïap !
translation.en: And , behold , God himself is with us for our captain , and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you . O children of Israel , fight ye not against the  Lord  God of your fathers  ; for ye shall not prosper .

translation.kha: Na kane ka lynti ngi ïaid na ka bynta ka jingtur ïajah ? Nangne ïaid ïa ka lyntait kaba jlop , lyngba ka ri khlaw Edom , u Jotham u jubab .
translation.en: And he said , Which way shall we go up ? And he answered , The way through the wilderness of Edom .
Not purloining , but shewing all good fidelity ; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things .
translation.kha: Pynban , ki dei ban pyn-i ba ki long borabor kiba bha bad ba lah ban shaniah , khnang ban pynshisha ïa ka jinghikai shaphang U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi ha baroh ba ki leh .
U blang u kren ban pynlong ïa ki ban pynphai ïa ki na kaba lai pop malade ban pyllait ïa ki na kaba sngewsarong .
translation.en: That he may withdraw man from his purpose , and hide pride from man .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïohi ïa ka jingshitom kaba jur jong ki Jerusalem’ ; ym don mano me ruh ban ïaroh ïa ki .
translation.en: For the  Lord  saw the affliction of Israel , that it was very bitter : for there was not any shut up , nor any left , nor any helper for Israel .
Now therefore thus saith the  Lord  , Thou shalt not come down from that bed on which thou art gone up , but shalt surely die . And Elijah departed .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha u syiem ba U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Men ym ïohkhiah na ki jingmynsaw jong me ; men ïap !’  U Elijah u la leh kumba la hukum U  Trai  ,

translation.en: Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified . And they took Jesus , and led him away .
translation.kha: Te u Pilat u la aiti noh ïa U Jisu sha ki ïa ka ban sahnarphna . Kumta ki la shimti noh ïa U Jisu .
phna ym shongsuk hapdeng kita ki jaitbynriew , bad phin ym ïoh khang ban Kam kum la ka jongno ; hangta U Trai un pynshong syier , un pynduh jingkyrmen , bad un pynswai mynsiem ïa phira .
translation.en: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease , neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest : but the  Lord  shall give thee there a trembling heart , and failing of eyes , and sorrow of mind :

translation.kha: Neng bahkhlieh da la ka jingim , bad ngan jingkitkhlieh na ka pyntha jong u . Lada ngam wan ïalam pat ïa u sha phi bad buh ïa u ha khmat jong Phi , ieh ngan kit pop ma nga shi Mid .
translation.en: I will be surety for him  ; of my hand shalt thou require him : if I bring him not unto thee , and set him before thee , then let me bear the blame for ever :
And he built fenced cities in Judah : for the land had rest , and he had no war in those years  ; because the  Lord  had given him rest .
translation.kha: U tei ïa ki kynroh na ka bynta ki nongbah ka Judah ha ka por jong u , bad ym shym don thma bun bun snem , namar ba U  Trai  u ai ha u ïa ka jingsuk .
Baalah Phin haw ban leit mynta ka sngi ? u tnga jong ka u kyllan . Kam Shim Dei ka Sabbaton lin ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai . Kam lei lei , ka jubab .
translation.en: And he said , Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day ? it is neither new moon , nor sabbath . And she said , It shall be well .
And the beast that was , and is not , even he is the eighth , and is of the seven , and goeth into perdition .
translation.kha: Bad u mradkhlaw uba la ju im shisien , hynrei u bym shym im shuh , u dei hi u syiem uba phra uba long uwei na ki hynñiew ngut bad u mihnoh ban shah pynjot .

Buh dak sawdong uta u lum khnang ba ki briew kim dei baneh khim palat , bad nong ïa ki ba kine ym leit kiew sha u lum , lane wat ban lytar tur sha jan jong u . Lada uno a u leit ïuhkjat ha u lum , yn pynïap ïa u ;
translation.en: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about , saying , Take heed to yourselves , that ye go not up into the mount , or touch the border of it : whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death :
For as in Adam all die , even so in Christ shall all be made alive .
translation.kha: Naba kumba ki briew baroh ki ïap namar ka jingïadei jong ki ha u Adam , kumjuh ruh ïa baroh yn pynmihpat namar ka jingïadei jong ki ha U Khrist .

translation.en: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him  ; and he said to Abiathar the priest , Bring hither the ephod .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u tip ba u Saul u la pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa u , u la ong ha u Abiathar u lyngdoh ,  Wallam hangne ïa ka ephod .

translation.en: Shall horses run upon the rock ? will one plow there with oxen ? for ye have turned judgment into gall , and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock :
translation.kha: Hato ki kulai ki ju mareh halor ki mawsiang ? Hato ki briew ki ju lur ïa ka duriaw da ki masi dab ? Pynban phi la pynkylla ïa ka jingbishar hok sha ka bih , bad ïa kaba dei sha ka bymdei .
U Gomer bun ka kynhun shipai jong u pynlang kiba ïateh lehhok bad u kin kyllon ïap ha ki lumbah ka Israel , bad ngan ai ïa ki met jongnga ki ba kin long ka jingjam ïa baroh ki sim bad ki mradkhlaw .
translation.en: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel , thou , and all thy bands , and the people that is with thee : I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort , and to the beasts of the field to be devoured .

translation.kha: Nga la buh u nongaplangbrot ban khmih ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong nga , hynrei um shym la ïarap ïa ki langbrot kiba la shah byrngem da ka jingpynjot ; lymne ba u leit wad ïa kaba la Da-ei neh , lane pynkhiah ïa kito katba la mynsaw , lane bsa ïa uba khiah . Pynban u bam ïa ka doh jong ki langbrot bakha sngaid mala u weng noh ïa ki khnap jong ki .
translation.en: For , lo , I will raise up a shepherd in the land , which shall not visit those that be cut off , neither shall seek the young one , nor heal that that is broken , nor feed that that standeth still : but he shall eat the flesh of the fat , and tear their claws in pieces .

translation.kha: Phi bad baroh kaba phi leh kim long ei ei ; kito kiba mane ïa phi ki longkmie kiba isaitmet !
translation.en: Behold , ye are of nothing , and your work of nought : an abomination is he that chooseth you .

translation.kha: Bad mynta phi kwah ba kan leit ïathaw ïa u ba phin don hangne ?
translation.en: And now thou sayest , Go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here .

translation.kha: Na ka jingdap jongngi ka jingaiei jong u , u la kyrkhu ïa ngi baroh , da kaba ai ha ine ïa ka jingkyrkhu kawei hadien kamai pat .
translation.en: And of his fulness have all we received , and grace for grace .
Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus , that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body .
translation.kha: Ha ki por baroh ngi kit halor ki met baïap jong ngi ïa ka jingïap U Jisu , khnang ba ka jingim jong u ruh kan paw ha ki met jong ngi .

Wat la Iso ruh ngan ym pynsum ïa ki na ka bynta kane , Naamah ma phi hi phi ïa-ïaid lang bad ki nuti kaba ha ka templ , bad ryngkat badno ki , phi ai ki jingkñia babha . Kumba ka proberb ka noh , ‘ Ki briew kiba khlem pyrkhat kin sa jot noh .’
translation.en: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom , nor your spouses when they commit adultery : for themselves are separated with whores , and they sacrifice with harlots : therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall .

translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la tar ïa la ki jaiñkup bun u la ong , Ngim donkam shuh kino kino ki sakhi !
translation.en: Then the high priest rent his clothes , and saith , What need we any further witnesses ?

translation.kha: U weng noh ïa ka Makhpelah , ka kmierad jong u na ka kyrdan syiemsad , namar ba ka la shrong ïa ka pynlwet ba-ijli jong ka Asherah ka bleithaw jingkharoi . U Asa u pynkyllon ïa ka bleithaw malade u thang ïa ka ha ka them jong ka wah Jingdon .
translation.en: And also Maachah his mother , even her he removed from being queen , because she had made an idol in a grove  ; and Asa destroyed her idol , and burnt it by the brook Kidron .

translation.kha: Ki la ïakhun lang baroh bad ki la ïasnohkti lang ban ïalang pyrshah ïa u Joshua bad ki Israel .
translation.en: That they gathered themselves together , to fight with Joshua and with Israel , with one accord .
Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him , because he not only had broken the sabbath , but said also that God was his Father , making himself equal with God .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingong ka la pynlong ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba kin nang wad dong shuh shuh ban pynïap ïa u ; ym tang ba u la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum Sabbaton , hynrei ba u la ong ba U Blei hi u dei U Kpa jong u bad da kumne u la pynlong ïa lade uba ïaryngkat bad U Blei .

translation.en: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them ,  Murmur not among yourselves .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Keiñ noh kaba ïakren khñium hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur  ; and a third part at the gate behind the guard : so shall ye keep the watch of the house , that it be not broken down .
translation.kha: sa shi bynta na ka lai bynta kin ïeng ap phira ha ka Khyrdop Sur , bad kiba sah shi bynta na ka lai bynta na phi kin ïeng ap phira ha ka khyrdop ha lyndet jong kiwei ki nongap phira .
Ka nong Samaria ka la wanlam ban tong um , bad U Jingsuk u la ong ha ka , To ai um ba nur dih .
translation.en: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water : Jesus saith unto her ,  Give me to drink .

translation.kha: Kane ka ïing kaba da kat ka ïng kan kylla long naba sah kynjah , bad kat uba ïaid tun jong ka un kyndit thret bad un pang met ; bad kmen ïakylli , ‘ Balei mo U Trai u la leh sat kumne ïa kane ka ri bad ïa kane ka ïing ?’
translation.en: And at this house , which is high , every one that passeth by it shall be astonished , and shall hiss  ; and they shall say , Why hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land , and to this house ?
I was eyes to the blind , and feet was I to the lame .
translation.kha: Nga la long ki khmat ïa kiba matlah , bad ki kjat ïa kiba dkoh .
Hadien katto katne pa , bun na ki bri , kynthup ïa ki shynna bad ki kynthei , ki sdang don shipor pyrshah ïa ki para Jiw jong ki .
translation.en: And there was a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brethren the Jews .

translation.kha: Man ka snem u syiem Salmunna u ïohpdiang dom arphew lai hajar kilo ka ksiang ,
translation.en: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold ,
Then they rent their clothes , and laded every man his ass , and returned to the city .
translation.kha: Kita shi para ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , ki la buh biang ïa la ki jingkit halor ki kada jong ki bad ki la leit phai sha kata ka nongbah .

translation.en: How shall I curse , whom God hath not cursed ? or how shall I defy , whom the  Lord  hath not defied ?
translation.kha: Kumno nga lah ban tim ïa kaei kaba U Blei um shym la tim , Lane kren shaphang ka jingjot haba U  Trai  um shym kren ?
Nangta baroh ki Israel ki sdang wanrah baklang sha ki kamar buh tyrwa ïa kiba shiphew na u kew jong ki , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib .
translation.en: Then brought all Judah the tithe of the corn and the new wine and the oil unto the treasuries .

translation.kha: hynñiew kiwei pah ki kren biria ïa ki riewngeit , da kaba ïong , Kine ki briew ki la buhnud !
translation.en: Others mocking said , These men are full of new wine .

translation.kha: Wat ki maw ha ki kynroh ki kyang pyrshah ïa phi , sad ki shankhung ki pynshai ïa ka jingkyang .
translation.en: For the stone shall cry out of the wall , and the beam out of the timber shall answer it .
And he shall take the two goats , and present them before the  Lord  at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Nangta un shim ar tylli ki blang sha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

U Ahas u jubab , Don sa uwei , u Malkhaïah u khun jong u Imlah . Hynrei nga pli ïa u namar um ju ïalap kaba bha ïa sa ; ka ju lama borabor kaei kaei kaba sniew . Phim dei ban ong kumta ! u Jehoshaphat u jubab .
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , There is yet one man , by whom we may enquire of the  Lord  : but I hate him  ; for he never prophesied good unto me , but always evil : the same is Micaiah the son of Imlah . And Jehoshaphat said , Let not the king say so .

translation.kha: Nga don ka bor ban mad ïa baroh ki jinglong da ka bor kaba U Khrist u ai ïa nga .
translation.en: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me .

translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi ban pynjot ïa ka Philistia , ban pyndam noh na ka Tiberios bad ka Sidon ïa ka jingïarap baroh kaba dang hukum . Ma sa , U Trai , ngan pynjot ïa ki nong Pisidia , baroh kiba wan na ki rud duriaw ka Krit .
translation.en: Because of the day that cometh to spoil all the Philistines , and to cut off from Tyre and Zidon every helper that remaineth : for the  Lord  will spoil the Philistines , the remnant of the country of Caphtor .
Jarmuth with her suburbs , En–gannim with her suburbs  ; four cities .
translation.kha: ka Jarmuth , bad ka Engannim , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering , which is for himself , and shall make an atonement for himself , and for his house , and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself :
translation.kha: Haba u Aaron u kñia ïa uta u masi lyngraw kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop na ka bynta ïa lade bad ka longïing jong u ,
U Trai , u Syiem ki Israel , u to ïa kan ban Ong : “Phi ki blei jyllang ki jaitbynriew , to buh ïa ka nang jong pa’ . Wallam ïa ki jingsyiad nia babha tam ba phi don !
translation.en: Produce your cause , saith the  Lord   ; bring forth your strong reasons , saith the King of Jacob .

translation.kha: Ko Sedekaïah , ngan jop ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa u symboh ka Babilonia bad ki shipai jong u . Ngan kynton ïa ki tiar ïapom jongngi ki shipai jong me hamar pdeng jong ka nongbam .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel  ; Behold , I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands , wherewith ye fight against the king of Babylon , and against the Chaldeans , which besiege you without the walls , and I will assemble them into the midst of this city .
If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me , or lifted up myself when evil found him :
translation.kha: Ngam pat ju kmen haba ki nongshun jong nga ki shah jynjar , ne sngewbha haba ki ïakynduh ïa ka jingpynjot ;

translation.en: Swear now therefore unto me by the  Lord  , that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me , and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father s house .
translation.kha: Hynrei kular ïa nga ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ba phin ri pynim ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , ba kumta ka kyrteng jong nga bad ka kyrteng ka jait jong nga kan ym jah junom .
