translation.en: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave , and the noise of thy viols : the worm is spread under thee , and the worms cover thee .
translation.kha: Me la mlien ban ïoh ka jingpyndonburom da ki sur jingtem ki duitara , hynrei mynta hangne me don ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Me thiah ha ka jingthiah jong ki ksaiñ bad la tap nep da ki wieh .’

U la ainong , Ki radbah ïew ki la ïakut ban kyrpad ïa me lehkai ka sngi ban ïalam ïa u pyllew sha ka Derbe , da kaba leh mynleh ba ka Dorbar ka kwah ban ïoh ka jingtip kaba kham Tyngka shaphang jong u .
translation.en: And he said , The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council , as though they would enquire somewhat of him more perfectly .
Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land , died by the plague before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la shoh ïa ki da ka jingpang , bad ki la ïap .
Ngan sdang ïa ka ding ha ka ri u Magog bad ha baroh shuh lynñiar ki rud duriaw ; ha kaba ki briew ki shong khlem jingpynwit badno uwei pa imat un tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And I will send a fire on Magog , and among them that dwell carelessly in the isles : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Phi ki khun , ka long ka kamram kumto kiba ieit ban kohnguh ïa la ki kamai ki kpa , namar Kanneh ka long kaba phin dei ban leh .
translation.en: Children , obey your parents in the Lord : for this is right .
It is good for me that I have been afflicted  ; that I might learn thy statutes .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynshitom jong nga ka la long kaba bha ïa nga , namar ka pynlong ïa nga ban nang ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: The king also said unto them , Take with you the servants of your lord , and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule , and bring him down to Gihon :
translation.kha: u ong ha ki ,  Ïalam bad phi ïa ki rangbah synshar ka ïingbishar jong nga ; pynshong ïa u Solomon , u khun jong nga halor u khashor jong nga , bad synran ïa u shathie sha ka Umpohliew Gihon ,

translation.en: Six days thou shalt work , but on the seventh day thou shalt rest : in earing time and in harvest thou shalt rest .
translation.kha: Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban trei jingtrei , hynrei wat trei ei ei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , wat la ka long ha ka aïom lur ne ka aïom ot .

translation.en: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering , or for a sacrifice in performing a vow , or peace offerings unto the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Haba la wanrah ïa u masi kum ka jingainguh thang , lane kum ka jingkñia ha kaba pyndep ïa kano kano ka jingsmai skhem , lane kum ka jingainguh jingpynïasuk ,
Tur pyrshah ïa ki la shawei ka sngi haba kmen waiñ kiew na ka them ha Sei . phiah ïadih ïa ki ha kaba khot jong ka them kaba poi sha ka ri khlaw hajan Jeruel .
translation.en: To morrow go ye down against them : behold , they come up by the cliff of Ziz  ; and ye shall find them at the end of the brook , before the wilderness of Jeruel .
Wherefore we labour , that , whether present or absent , we may be accepted of him .
translation.kha: Pynban , palat ban ïa kaei kaei baroh , ngi kwah ban pynsngewbha ïa u , la ngi don ha kane ka ïing hangne lane hangtei .

translation.en: Now about the midst of the feast Jesus went up into the temple , and taught .
translation.kha: Hamar kaba shiteng na ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la jan kut U Jisu u la leit sha ka Templ bad u la sdang ban hikai .

translation.en: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth–tabor , and then goeth out to Daberath , and goeth up to Japhia ,
translation.kha: Na kawei pat ka liang jong ka Sarid , u pud u suh shaphang mihngi sha u pud jong ka Khisloth Tabor , nangta sha Daberath bad artet haduh Japhia .
U Troas u la kriah ha nga shaphang ki hima , da kaba sdang na ka Ijipt .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles  ;

translation.kha: U nong Sudan uba kyrteng u Serah u tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai kaba don shi million ki rangïapom bad laispah tylliat ki kali ïapmat bad ki tur shaphrang haduh Mareshah .
translation.en: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand , and three hundred chariots  ; and came unto Mareshah .
Who will render to every man according to his deeds :
translation.kha: Naba U Blei un ainong ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum kaei kaba u la leh .

translation.en: But these things have I told you , that when the time shall come , ye may remember that I told you of them . And these things I said not unto you at the beginning , because I was with you .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane , ba haba ka por ka poi ïa ki ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei , phin sa kynmaw ba nga la ïathuh ïa phi .  Ngam shym la ïathuh ha phi ïa kine kiei kiei ha kaba mynnyngkong , naba nga la don lem bad phi .
Baana phin nujor ïa nga ? ino U Trai . Hato don Uno uno uba kamon ma nga ?
translation.en: To whom will ye liken me , and make me equal , and compare me , that we may be like ?

translation.kha: shadien ba u Terah u la dap hynñiewphew snem ka rta , u la hir u kpa jong u Abram , u Nahor , bad u Haman .
translation.en: And Terah lived seventy years , and begat Abram , Nahor , and Haran .

translation.kha: U la ïaphylliew jingmut hapoh synagog mano la ka sngew Sabbaton , da kaba phyrngab ban pynkohnguh ïa ki Jiw sad ki Grik .
translation.en: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath , and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks .

translation.kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U Trai , pynlang u pynim ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .
translation.en: Then they cried unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he saved them out of their distresses .

translation.kha: Uta u lyngkhuit un synrum ïa ka sner ha baroh sawdong ka duwan ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ bad un thang ïa ka khleiñ ban pynmih ïa ka jingiwbih kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the  Lord  at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai un ong ha ki briew jong u , Ngan wan shaei Jerusalem don ïadat ïa phi malade ban pynim ïa pa baroh kiba la phai noh na ki pop jong phi .
translation.en: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion , and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Don katto katne ka jingman ïa u bieit uba mutlop ba ïa uno Uno uba kren khlem pyrthuh .
translation.en: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words ? there is more hope of a fool than of him .
Saying , Let us alone  ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art  ; the Holy One of God .
translation.kha: Ieh ! Kaei me kwah bad ngi , ko Jisu uba na Nasareth ? Hato me la wan hangne ban pynjot ïa ngi ? Nga ithuh me long uei : Me long u nonglamktien bakhuid jong U Blei !
Ki khun shynrang jong u Jotbathah — u Gomer , u Magog , u Madai , u Jaban , u Tubal , u Meshek , bad u Trai’ — ki la erlangthari ki kpa thlim jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na ki .
translation.en: The sons of Japheth  ; Gomer , and Magog , and Madai , and Javan , and Tubal , and Meshech , and Tiras .
And they brought the colt to Jesus , and cast their garments on him  ; and he sat upon him .
translation.kha: Ki la wallam ïa uta u kada ha U Jisu , ki la tap ïa ki jaiñkup jong ki halor uta u khun kada , bad U Jisu u la shong halor jong u .

Kumta ki pynïeng kiwei ka ïinglieng ïa u Absalom ha tnaw ka ïingsyiem ; bad ha ka jingïohi jrong uwei pa utai baroh , u Absalom u leit rung shapoh bad u la ïathiah shongkha bad ki tnen kliar jyllang u kpa lad u .
translation.en: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house  ; and Absalom went in unto his father s concubines in the sight of all Israel .
But when they sought to lay hands on him , they feared the multitude , because they took him for a prophet .
translation.kha: kumta ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa u . Hynrei ki la sngewsheptieng ïa u paidbah , uba la ñiew ba U Jisu u dei u nongïathuhlypa .

Ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba phylla kiba u la leh , kumjuh ruh ïa baher ka jingïathuhkhana kumno ba u la pynkiew ïa u Merodakh sha ka kyrni thik kaba halor , la buh jingkynmaw ha ki jingthiah ba dei ïa ki syiem ka Persia bad Media .
translation.en: And all the acts of his power and of his might , and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai , whereunto the king advanced him , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia ?
And he said to the king of Israel , Put thine hand upon the bow . And he put his hand upon it : and Elisha put his hands upon the king s hands .
translation.kha: bad u Elisha u ong ha u ba un pynkhreh ban siat . U syiem u leh kumta , bad u Elisha u buh ïa la ki kti ha ki kti u syiem .
Hato me tip lano kin dem ban wallam ïa ki khun rit sha ka pyrthei ?
translation.en: They bow themselves , they bring forth their young ones , they cast out their sorrows .

translation.kha: U syiem u leit phai noh sha la ïing ha Samaria da kaba khuslai Bad rit mynsiem .
translation.en: And the king of Israel went to his house heavy and displeased , and came to Samaria .
And the servant said unto him , Peradventure the woman will not be willing to follow me unto this land : must I needs bring thy son again unto the land from whence thou camest ?
translation.kha: Hynrei uta u shakri u kylli ,  Kumno lada jia ba kata ka samla kam mon ban iehnoh ïa la ka ïing ban wan ryngkat bad nga sha kane ka ri ? Hato ngan phah noh ïa u khun jong phi sha kata ka ri na kaba phi wan ?
Ka snem jong u mrad ba la kñia ïa uba la wanrah kum ka jingainguh thrang ruh ka dei jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia .
translation.en: And the priest that offereth any man s burnt offering , even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered .

translation.kha: Kumta u Petros u la kren bad u la ong ha U Jeshua , Ko Trai , katno ka long kaba bha ba ngi ïadon hangne ! Lada me mon , ngan shna lai tylli ki ïingjaiñ hangne , kawei na ka pyntha jngai me , kawei na ka bynta u Moses , bad kawei na ka bynta u Elijah .
translation.en: Then answered Peter , and said unto Jesus , Lord , it is good for us to be here : if thou wilt , let us make here three tabernacles  ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias .

translation.kha: Pynduh khoit ïa kita ki jaitbynriew baroh : ïa ki Hit , ki Amana , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , malade ki Jebus , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa phin .
translation.en: But thou shalt utterly destroy them  ; namely , the Hittites , and the Amorites , the Canaanites , and the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites  ; as the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee :

translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , kiwei pat kin ïew ïa ka burom kaba phi la ïoh shisien , bad phin ïap samla ha ki kti ki bri ki lai ba-don jingisynei .
translation.en: Lest thou give thine honour unto others , and thy years unto the cruel :

Send therefore now , and gather thy cattle , and all that thou hast in the field  ; for upon every man and beast which shall be found in the field , and shall not be brought home , the hail shall come down upon them , and they shall die .
translation.kha: Mynta ai hukum ban pynrieh ïa ki jingri jong me bad ïa kiwei kiwei pat baroh kiba me don ha lum . U phria un hap ha ki briew bad ki mrad kiba don habar khlem jingda , bad baroh kin ïap lut .’
U Blei u la pyndem ïa ki nongbah ka Sodom bun ka Gomorrah , da kaba pynjot ïa ki da ka ding , bad u la pynlong ïa ki ka nongmuna jong kamai ka ban jia ha ki bymtip Blei .
translation.en: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow , making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly  ;

translation.kha: Kumta te , dang mar ïa-ïohpdiang ïa kane ka shithi phi dei ban jat ïa umbah kynsai tam bad uba bit tam na ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem , pynlong syiem ïa u , malu ïaleh ïa-ban ïada ïa u .
translation.en: Look even out the best and meetest of your master s sons , and set him on his father s throne , and fight for your master s house .
The mouth of strange women is a deep pit : he that is abhorred of the  Lord  shall fall therein .
translation.kha: Ka jingklim ka long ka jingriam — ka pynngat ïa kito kiba U  Trai  u bitar .
shiphew tylli ki masi ba la bsa pynsngaid ha sem , arphew tylli ki masi bam phla ha lum , nabar shispah tylli ki langbrot , nalor ki skei , ki khiat , ki kirteng , bad ki syiar .
translation.en: Ten fat oxen , and twenty oxen out of the pastures , and an hundred sheep , beside harts , and roebucks , and fallowdeer , and fatted fowl .

translation.kha: Ha khmih shuh katai U Kpa u la ieit ïa ngi ! Ka jingieit jong u ka longsyiem kaba khraw katta mawria ba ïa ngi la khot ki ïakhun U Blei — bad kumta , ha ka jingshisha , ngi un-long . dem kane ba balei ka pyrthei kam ithuh ïa ngi : Kam pat la ithuh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Behold , what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us , that we should be called the sons of God : therefore the world knoweth us not , because it knew him not .

translation.kha: To pynïeng ki jingwad lyndum bad pyrem dak ha ka shok ; to wad biah ïa ka lynti kiba Phi la iehnoh . To wan blei biang , ko phi ki paid Israel , to wanpaw shuh la ka ri , shaw ki shnong kiba phi la iehnoh .
translation.en: Set thee up waymarks , make thee high heaps : set thine heart toward the highway , even the way which thou wentest : turn again , O virgin of Israel , turn again to these thy cities .

translation.kha: Uei uba la ju ai ei ei ïa u , ba u khep ba-bang siew pat ïa said ?
translation.en: Or who hath first given to him , and it shall be recompensed unto him again ?
For a dream cometh through the multitude of business  ; and a fool s voice is known by multitude of words .
translation.kha: Kat phi nang bun jingkhuslai , katta phin ïoh ki jingphohsniew kynsha , bad kat phi nang bunktien katta phin liat ha kaba kren ïa kaei kaei kaba bieit .
bad u la phah ha ki ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba wallam ha ki ïa kane ka khubor na U Trai , U Blei! ki Israel : Nga la wallam ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ha jingïap .
translation.en: That the  Lord  sent a prophet unto the children of Israel , which said unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I brought you up from Egypt , and brought you forth out of the house of bondage  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei sngi lynter ym dei ban paw ïa u thiat ha ki ïit jong phi ; namarba lada uno eit u bah ïa u kpu uba la khleh tat la u dei u nongwei ne u traishnong , yn ym kheiñ shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: Ye shall eat nothing leavened  ; in all your habitations shall ye eat unleavened bread .

translation.kha: Ko ki mrad , wat sheptieng . Ki jaka phalang ki long kiba jyrngam ; ki ngin ki seh ïa la ki sop , bun don kyrhai ki soh Dumbur bad sohwaiñ .
translation.en: Be not afraid , ye beasts of the field : for the pastures of the wilderness do spring , for the tree beareth her fruit , the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength .

translation.kha: Ngan ym leh lyndum ïa ki jingbthah jong me , namsop da ki me la ri pynim ïa nga .
translation.en: I will never forget thy precepts : for with them thou hast quickened me .
The thoughts of the righteous are right : but the counsels of the wicked are deceit .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba beit kin lehbha ïa phi ; ki bymman ki kwah tang ban shukor ïa phi .
Shisien ka por la don u syep pynlang ka syiem , bad ki don u khun ba kyrteng u Sigurd uba khlain ba smat , sad ba bhabriew ba .
translation.en: There were once a King and a Queen , and they had a son called Sigurd , who was very strong and active , and good-looking .
By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not , when she had received the spies with peace .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la ïada ïa ka Rahab ka nuti na kaba shah pynïap lem bad kito ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa U Blei ; naba ka la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nongsyntiat na Israel .
U Jakob u jubab , Phi tip kumno nga la shakri ïa phi bad kumno ki kynhied jingri jong phi ki la roi ha ka jingsumar jong nga .
translation.en: And he said unto him , Thou knowest how I have served thee , and how thy cattle was with me .

translation.kha: Haba U Trai u ïohi ba u Moses u wan kham hajan , u khot ïa u napdeng kata ka lawlynnong , Bad u ong , Moses ! Moses ! U hati u jubab , Oi ! ?(Nga don hangne .
translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw that he turned aside to see , God called unto him out of the midst of the bush , and said , Moses , Moses . And he said , Here am I .

translation.kha: Nahath u Joseph u ong ïa la ki briew ban smai . khlur ïa nga , u ong , ba ynda U Blei u ïalam noh ïa phi sha kata ka ri , phin rah lang ïa ka kun jong nga nangne .
translation.en: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel , saying , God will surely visit you , and ye shall carry up my bones from hence .
Now therefore , I pray you , tarry ye also here this night , that I may know what the  Lord  will say unto me more .
translation.kha: Hynrei sngewbha to ïasah miet mynta ruh , ba nga lah ban ïoh tip aïu pat U  Trai  un ong ha nga .

U Trei Nongsynshar u ong ha nga , Ko khun u briew , to khot ïa ki sim bad ki mrad baroh kiba ha khlaiñ , ba ïalang na barabor sawdong ban ïabam ïa ka jingkñia kaba nga Pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ki . Kun long ka jingkhihwin kaba heh ha ki lumbah Israel , ba ktang ïapom ïa ka thoh bad dih ïa ka sner .
translation.en: And , thou son of man , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Speak unto every feathered fowl , and to every beast of the field , Assemble yourselves , and come  ; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you , even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel , that ye may eat flesh , and drink blood .

translation.kha: Ki nongmih Ijipt hajuh ki la Beh kthong ïa ki bad ki la leit nongthain jong ki sha ka duriaw lem bad ki kulai , ki kali ïapom bad ki nongïeng .
translation.en: And the Egyptians pursued , and went in after them to the midst of the sea , even all Pharaoh s horses , his chariots , and his horsemen .

He appointed also the king s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings , to wit , for the morning and evening burnt offerings , and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths , and for the new moons , and for the set feasts , as it is written in the law of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Na la ki kynhun jingri u pyndap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang man la ka step bad man la ka janmiet , bad na ka bynta kito ïa kiba ainguh ha ka sngi Sabbaton , ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ha kiwei ki jinglehkmen ïa kiba donkam da ka hukum jong U  Trai .
U bhabriew u Lah ban ïohnang ïa ka ïing bad ka spah na la ki kmie ki kpa , hynrei tang U Trai wahbah lah ban ai ha u ïa ka thngan kaba shemphang .
translation.en: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers : and a prudent wife is from the  Lord .
For the son dishonoureth the father , the daughter riseth up against her mother , the daughter in law against her mother in law  ; a man s enemies are the men of his own house .
translation.kha: Ha kine ki por , ki khun shynrang ki ñiew ïa la ki kpa kum kiba bieit , ki khun kynthei ki pyrshah ïa la ki kmie , bad ki kynthei samla ki ïakajia bad la ki kiaw ; ki nongshun jong u briew ki dei ki dkhot na ka longïing jong u hi .

translation.en: Dan , and Naphtali , Gad , and Asher .
translation.kha: U Dan , U Naphtali , U Gad , bad U Asher .
U Gideon u ïaid na ka lynti na ki thoh jong ka ri shyiap , ha ka pdeng jingkhie jngai ka Nobah bad ka Jogbehah , mala u la tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai ha kaba kim Shimham poi kyrkhoit .
translation.en: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah , and smote the host : for the host was secure .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha ang , ‘ Wat pynjynjar ïa ki briew jong ka ri Moab , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lot , lynti wat ïaleh thma bad ki . Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka shaneng Ar , bad ngan ym ai ei ei ïa phi na ka ri jong ki .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Distress not the Moabites , neither contend with them in battle : for I will not give thee of their land for a possession  ; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession .

translation.kha: Balei me longsyiem kum u briew uba la shat shim kynsan , kum u shipai u jingpynbor ban ïarap ? Da pahara , A Trai , me long bad ngi ! i long ki briew jong me ; wat iehnoh ïa ngi .’
translation.en: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonished , as a mighty man that cannot save ? yet thou , O  Lord  , art in the midst of us , and we are called by thy name  ; leave us not .
But I will deliver thee in that day , saith the  Lord  : and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan ïada , bad ngan ym aiti noh ïa me sha ki briew kiba me sheptieng .

translation.en: Others said , This is the Christ . But some said , Shall Christ come out of Galilee ?
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki la ong ,  U dei U Messaïah !  Hynrei kiwei ki la ong ,  U Messaïah un ym wan na Galilaïa ?

translation.en: If any man will do his will , he shall know of the doctrine , whether it be of God , or whether I speak of myself .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba mon ban leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah , un tip la kaei kaba nga hikai ka wan na U Blei ne la nga kren ha ka bor jong nga hi .
u khun jong u Serahaïah , u khun jong u Mushi , u ïakhun jong u Bukki ,
translation.en: The son of Zerahiah , the son of Uzzi , the son of Bukki ,
