translation.kha: Shahshkor ! Ngin la ai ha phi ka bor , khnang ba phi lah ban ïaid halor ki bseiñ malu ki ñianglartham bad jop ïa ka bor baroh jong u Nongshun , bad ym don kan kano ka ban pynmynsaw ïa phi .
translation.en: Behold , I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions , and over all the power of the enemy : and nothing shall by any means hurt you .
I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches . I am the root and the offspring of David , and the bright and morning star .
translation.kha: Nga , U Jisu , nga la phah ïa u angel jong nga ban pynbna ïa kine kiei kiei ha phi ha ki balang . Nga la hiarpateng na ka longïing jong u Dabid ; nga long u khlur step uba phyrnai .

translation.en: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said , It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab :
translation.kha: Uta u briew u jubab ,  Ka dei ka theisamla nongwei kaba la wan phai na Moab bad ka Naomi .

ibha u tnga jongno ka u khie ha kata ka step , bad hato u plie ïa ka jingkhang ban mian shabar pun leit noh , u lap ïa la ka tnga kliar ba ka thiah ha khmat jingkhang , ryngkat bad ki kti kiba kner sha kata ka jingkhang .
translation.en: And her lord rose up in the morning , and opened the doors of the house , and went out to go his way : and , behold , the woman his concubine was fallen down at the door of the house , and her hands were upon the threshold .
And when they came to Reuel their father , he said , How is it that ye are come so soon to day ?
translation.kha: Ynda ki leit phai sha la u kpa , u kylli ïa ki ,  Kumno phi ïawan kloi mynta ka sngi ?
Suk kito kiba syaid pynkhuid ïa la ki jaiñkup bad kumta ki don ka hok ban ba-ima ïa u soi na u tieng ka jingim bad ban leit lyngba ki khyrdop shapoh ka nongbah .
translation.en: Blessed are they that do his commandments , that they may have right to the tree of life , and may enter in through the gates into the city .
And Abimelech called Isaac , and said , Behold , of a surety she is thy wife : and how saidst thou , She is my sister ? And Isaac said unto him , Because I said , Lest I die for her .
translation.kha: Kumta u Abimelekh u phah khot ïa u Isaak , bad u ong ,  Pleng , ka dei ka tnga jong me ! Balei pat me ong ba ka dei ka para jong me ?  U jubab ,  Namar nga pyrkhat ïoh ba nga shah pynïap lada nga ong ba ka dei ka tnga jong nga .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon , first and last , are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet , and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite , and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat ?
translation.kha: Ïa kiwei kiwei ki jingïathuh shaphang u Solomon naduh ba sdang haduh ba kut la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori u Nathan u Nongïathuhlypa  , ha  Ka Jingïathuhlypa u Ahijah uba na Shiloh  , bad ha  Ki Jingïohipaw u Iddo u Nongïathuhlypa  , kiba ïathuh ruh shaphang ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel .
Hynrei pynban , la pynhiar ïa me sha ka bynta kaba jylliew kuna jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translation.en: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell , to the sides of the pit .

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u ki wandur ïa ka snem , bad u wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka , bad u tah ïa ka ha ki lak naba ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad u theh ïa kaba sah baroh ha trai ka duwan .
translation.en: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him : and he dipped his finger in the blood , and put it upon the horns of the altar , and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar :
Son of man , because that Tyre hath said against Jerusalem , Aha , she is broken that was the gates of the people : she is turned unto me : I shall be replenished , now she is laid waste :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  kane ka long kaei kaba ki briew ha ka nongbah Tyros ki ïa sngewkmen . Ki pyrta , ‘ Ka Jerusalem ka la pra ! Ka bor khaïi pateng jong ka kam don shuh ! Kan ym long shuh ka nongïaleh pyrshah jong ngi !’

translation.en: And I gave them my statutes , and shewed them my judgments , which if a man do , he shall even live in them .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa ki hukum jong nga bad nga la hikai ha ki ïa ki aiñ jong nga , kiba wallam ka jingim ïa uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ki .

Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Dabid u khiew ïalang step phyrngab , u ïoh ïa ki longsem ha uwei patan u nongsharai , u rah ïa kata ka jingbam , bad u leit kumba u Geser u la bthat ïa u . U poi ha ka iaki sher dara hamar ba ki Israel ki dang leit sha ka ïadon thlim , ki da ïarisa ha ka tdam .
translation.en: And David rose up early in the morning , and left the sheep with a keeper , and took , and went , as Jesse had commanded him  ; and he came to the trench , as the host was going forth to the fight , and shouted for the battle .
And likewise he that had received two , he also gained other two .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom u shakri uba la ïohpdiang ar hajar tylli ki sbai u la ïohnong sa ar hajar .

To ïadem bad to ud , ko dieng Kseh-Sypress — ki Kedar ki la kyllon ; ïa kito ki dieng pyndonburom la pynjot ! To ïam bad to ud , ko ki dieng Sning jong ka Bashan — ïa ka khlaw katba rben la khet noh !
translation.en: Howl , fir tree  ; for the cedar is fallen  ; because the mighty are spoiled : howl , O ye oaks of Bashan  ; for the forest of the vintage is come down .

translation.kha: Suk ma phi haba ki biria ki krenbeiñ bad pynshitom beiñ ïa phi , sad ong Bun jait ki jinglamler basniew pyrshah ïa phi namar ba phi long ki nongbud jong por .
translation.en: Blessed are ye , when men shall revile you , and persecute you , and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely , for my sake .

translation.kha: Ka la erlangthari ha kawei ka sngur kumba lai bajam nep sngi mynba u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw , ha kaba u la ïohi da naba shai kdar ïa u angel jong U Blei uba wan shahïap bad ïong ha u , Kornelios !
translation.en: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him , and saying unto him , Cornelius .

translation.kha: Borabor kaba per sheptieng bad sngewtriem ka wan jia shisha .
translation.en: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me , and that which I was afraid of is come unto me .
And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty .
translation.kha: Suh ki jaiñphong lyngdoh ïa u Aaron u hynmen jong me khnang ba un ishongkun shongkhia bad idonburom .

translation.en: Rob not the poor , because he is poor : neither oppress the afflicted in the gate :
translation.kha: Wat shim kabu ïa kiba duk tang namar ba phi lah ; wat shim kabu ïa kito kiba ïeng khlem jingïarap ha ka ïingbishar .
Haduh ka por jong u Ïoannis baroh ki jingïathuhlypa bad ka Judia u Moses ki la kren shaneng ka Hima ;
translation.en: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John .

translation.kha: Bad u la pyndeng , Kane hi ka dei ka daw kaba nga la ïatih ïa phi ba ym don uba lai ban wan sha nga lymda U Kpa u pynlah ïa u ban imat kumta .
translation.en: And he said ,  Therefore said I unto you , that no man can come unto me , except it were given unto him of my Father .
And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha , that is to say , a place of a skull ,
translation.kha: Ki la poi ha ka jaka ba la khot Golgotha , kaba mut  Ka jaka ka Maloi khlieh .
Ka jingaiei U Trai Jisu to kan long lem bad phi .
translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you .
And when they came to Nachon s threshingfloor , Uzza put forth his hand to the ark of God , and took hold of it  ; for the oxen shook it .
translation.kha: Haba ki wan poi ha jaka shoh kew jong u Nakon , ki masi dab ki la jynthut , bad u Ussah u kner bad ïohbat ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang .

Ha kawei ka snieh katto katne ki briew na ka jait Judah ki la wanlam ha u Joshua ha Gilgal . Uwei na ki , u Kaleb u khuid jong u Jeshanah u nong Kenis , u ïai-ong ha u , Phi ïatip kaei kaba U Trai u ong ha Hadad Barnea shaphang jong phoi bad por ha u Moses , u briew jong U Blei’ .
translation.en: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal : and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him , Thou knowest the thing that the  Lord  said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadesh–barnea .
They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous , and condemn the innocent blood .
translation.kha: kiba ïasylla lang pyrshah ïa ki briew kiba bha bad rai pynrem ïa kiba lui lui sha ka jingïap .

translation.en: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad , and said unto him , Go , carry them to the city .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ai ïa kita ki tiar ïaleh u ha uta u khynnah , bad u ong ïa u ban leit rah ïa ki baroh sha shnong .
U la ïatip , bad la thop ïa u ha ka Nongbuh u Dabid , bad u Ahas u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Jotham slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David : and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead .
And Pharaoh s daughter said unto her , Take this child away , and nurse it for me , and I will give thee thy wages . And the woman took the child , and nursed it .
translation.kha: Ka khun u Pharaoh ka ong ha ka ,  Shim ïa une u khunlung bad ri ïa u na ka bynta jong nga , bad ngan da siew ïa pha .  Kumta kata ka kynthei ka shim ïa uta u khunlung , bad ka ri ka sumar ïa u .

translation.en: Either make the tree good , and his fruit good  ; or else make the tree corrupt , and his fruit corrupt : for the tree is known by his fruit .
translation.kha: Ban ïoh ïa u soh uba bha phi dei ban don u dieng uba plung bha ; lada phi don u dieng uba swai , phin ïoh u soh uba sniew . Ïa u dieng la tip da u jait soh ba u pynmih .
Ki khun shynrong jong ka Silpah , ka mraw ka Elijah , ki long u Gad bad u Asher . Ïa kine ki khun shynrang la khap ha Mesopotamia .
translation.en: And the sons of Zilpah , Leah s handmaid  ; Gad , and Asher : these are the sons of Jacob , which were born to him in Paddan–aram .
He delighteth not in the strength of the horse : he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man .
translation.kha: Ka jingsngewbha jong u kam long ha ki kulai bakhlaiñ ; lymne ka jingkmen jong u ha ki shipai bashlur ;
Namar ba ka Rebekka kam ïew khur , u Isaak u la duwai ha U Terah na ka bynta jrong ka . U TRAI’ u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai lad u , bad ka Rebekka ka la punkhun .
translation.en: And Isaac entreated the  Lord  for his wife , because she was barren : and the  Lord  was entreated of him , and Rebekah his wife conceived .

translation.kha: Kumta ka la pynshoi ïa u da ki jingkitkhlieh jong ka , Bad u la ngat ha ki kiei jali ja-um jong ka .
translation.en: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield , with the flattering of her lips she forced him .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la wallam ïa phi ha U Khrist Jisu , bad U Blang u la pynlong ïa U Khrist ban long ka jingstad jong ngi . Da u , la pynsaja ïa ngi bad U Bela ; ngi erlangthari ki bynriew bakhuid jong U Blei bad la pyllaitluid ïa me .
translation.en: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus , who of God is made unto us wisdom , and righteousness , and sanctification , and redemption :
For thou hast made of a city an heap  ; of a defenced city a ruin : a palace of strangers to be no city  ; it shall never be built .
translation.kha: Me la pynjot ïa ki nongbah bad pynpra ïa ki jingtei-kut . Ki ïingsyiem kiba ki nongshun jong ngi ki la tei ki la jah noh junom .

U Dabid u ai ha u Solomon ïa ka dur pynkhreh jong ka jingtei baroh jong ka Templ , sad ïa ki kamra buh tiak jong ka bad ïa kiei pat ki kamra bad ïa ka jaka kaba kyntang tam , ha kaba la map ïa ki nongpop .
translation.en: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch , and of the houses thereof , and of the treasuries thereof , and of the upper chambers thereof , and of the inner parlours thereof , and of the place of the mercy seat ,

translation.kha: U jongu u la kren ïa kane bad nangta u la nang leit sha Jeremaïah ha shuwa jong ki .
translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he went before , ascending up to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki synran , iathuh ïa uba U Jisu u ieit , u da shong shane ha U Jisu .
translation.en: Now there was leaning on Jesus  bosom one of his disciples , whom Jesus loved .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Phin ïohi ïa nga ba nga siew kylliang ïa ka Babilonia bad ïa ki briew jong ka na ka bynta ka jingkynshew barabor kaba ki la leh ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Mynta to leit malu ai ïa kane ka khubor shiah ki synran jong u , kynthup ïa u Petros : ‘ Un leit sha Galilaïa ha shuwa jong phi ; hangta phin ïohi ïa u , kumba u la ong ha phi .’
translation.en: But go your way , tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee : there shall ye see him , as he said unto you .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Saul u don ha Gibeah , u da shongduh ha trai u dieng Tamarisk halor u lum , lem bad la u sum ha ka kti , bad baroh ki rangbah pynjam jong u ki don sawdong jongno u .
translation.en: When Saul heard that David was discovered , and the men that were with him , ( now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah , having his spear in his hand , and all his servants were standing about him  ; )

translation.kha: Ym namar ba nga Kwah banbeiñ ïohpdiang ïa ki jingai sngewbha ; pynban , nga kaweh ban ïew ba la pynlang ïa ka jingïohnong ha ka jingbnoh jingkheiñ jong phi .
translation.en: Not because I desire a gift : but I desire fruit that may abound to your account .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren ha ar ha ka snam kaba shipor ba u Sedekaïah u hir u skhem ka Judah , kaba erlangthari hati ka snem kaba khatphra jongngi u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia .
translation.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah , which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar .

translation.kha: Nob uno uno naba kwah ban pyllait la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; hynmen uno uno uba duh noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un shem ïa ka .
translation.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it : and whosoever will lose his life for my sake shall find it .
Yet someone may ask : ‘ Don’t humans have an immortal soul that survives death ?’
translation.kha: Jarkatta don kiba ong : ‘ Ym u briew u don ka mynsiem ka ba iaid lait na ka jingiap ?’

ba sam ai ha ki Eliel ïa kane ka khubor : Pha sarong ha ka jingkhraw jong ka Templ . Pha sngewbha ban khmih ïa ka bad ban leit jngoh ïa ka , hawei U Trai un pyntngit ïa ka . Bad ki dkhot ba khampoh samla ha ki longïing jong pha kiba la shah iehnoh ha Jesreel kin shah pynsep ha ka thma .
translation.en: Speak unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will profane my sanctuary , the excellency of your strength , the desire of your eyes , and that which your soul pitieth  ; and your sons and your daughters whom ye have left shall fall by the sword .

translation.kha: U Barak u la khot ïa ki jait Sebulun bad Naphtali shwa Kedesh , malu shiphew hajar jrut ki rangbah ki la bud ïa u . Ka Deborah ka la leit badno u .
translation.en: And Barak called Zebulun and Naphtali to Kedesh  ; and he went up with ten thousand men at his feet : and Deborah went up with him .

translation.kha: Wah ïa Kata ka pyrda na ki jingpyndait kiba don haduh tnum Ïingjaiñ , bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang kaba don ar thylli ki mawlyngkniap buh ïa ka shai lyndet ka ïada . Kata ka Pyrta kan pynïakhlad ïa ka Jaka Kyntang na ka Jaka Kaba kyrteng Tam .
translation.en: And thou shalt hang up the veil under the taches , that thou mayest bring in thither within the veil the ark of the testimony : and the veil shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy .

translation.kha: U bariewblei , uba na Goliath , u la wan hiar ruh na Rogelim ban synrum ïa u syiemsad sha shiliang ka Jadon .
translation.en: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim , and went over Jordan with the king , to conduct him over Jordan .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka snem u Hoshea u Phah nonglamktien sha u So , u syiem ka Jephthah , ban pan ïa ka jingïarap jong u , Bad u sangeh noh ka jingsiew ïa ka jingnguh syiem ba man ka snem sha ka Assyria . Haba u Shammah u tip ïa kane , u phah kem ïa u Hoshea bad buh ïa u ha ka byrni .
translation.en: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea : for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt , and brought no present to the king of Assyria , as he had done year by year : therefore the king of Assyria shut him up , and bound him in prison .

translation.kha: Ngan pynbuaid ïa ki Nongsynshar jong ka — ki rangbah kiba stad , ki nongïalam , bad ki shipawa . Kin ïohbat bad kin ym kyntait shu . Ma nga u syiem , nga la kruiñ . Nga long U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: And I will make drunk her princes , and her wise men , her captains , and her rulers , and her mighty men : and they shall sleep a perpetual sleep , and not wake , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: U Paul u la rung ha ka synagog malade ha ki lai bnoh u la kren shlur malu ki Paidbah’ , u da pynlong ki jingïatainia jingmut bad ki bad pyrshang ban pynpeit ïa ki shngain ka Hima U blem .
translation.en: And he went into the synagogue , and spake boldly for the space of three months , disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba dei ban ym bam doh , dih waiñ , lane ban leh kano kano ka ban pynong ïa la u pansngiat ban kyllan noh .
translation.en: It is good neither to eat flesh , nor to drink wine , nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth , or is offended , or is made weak .

translation.kha: Ha koum kaei ka por la pyndep ïa ki kam ki jam u Solomon baroh . Naduh kaba seng ïa ka nongrim jyllang ka Templ U Trai haduh ka jingpyndep ïa ka , baroh ka kur ka la long kaba jop .
translation.en: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of the  Lord  , and until it was finished . So the house of the  Lord  was perfected .
For my sighing cometh before I eat , and my roarings are poured out like the waters .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka ban bam , nga ïam sngewsih , bad ngam shym sangeh ban ud .
Ki paidbah ki la kyrpad ïa u ban sah kham slem , hynne u kyrngah .
translation.en: When they desired him to tarry longer time with them , he consented not  ;

translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u ai ïa ka syiem jong ka ri Sheba ïa baroh kaba ka panpoh , nabar Kiwei paw ki jingai sngewbha kat koum ka dustur ïa kiba u la lah ai ha ka na ka jingjynsur mynsiem . Nangta ma ka bad ki nongbanbeiñ jong ka ki wait phai sha ka ri Sheba .
translation.en: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatsoever she asked , beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty . So she turned and went to her own country , she and her servants .

translation.kha: kabu kita ki Rangbah ki dang leit noh na U Jisu , u Paulos u la ong ha u , Ko Kynther , katno ka long naba bha ba ngi ïadon hangne ! Ngin shna la tylli ki ïingjaiñ , kawei na ka bynta jong me , kawei na ka bynta u Moses , sad kawei na ka bynta u Elijah . ( Um tip da shispah ïa kaei kaba u kren . )
translation.en: And it came to pass , as they departed from him , Peter said unto Jesus , Master , it is good for us to be here : and let us make three tabernacles  ; one for thee , and one for Moses , and one for Elias : not knowing what he said .
Yea also , when he that is a fool walketh by the way , his wisdom faileth him , and he saith to every one that he is a fool .
translation.kha: Ka jingmutlop jong u ka paw wat ha ki nongwei kiba u ïakynduh ha ka lynti ; u ailad ïa iwei pa iwei ban tip ba u dei u bieit .

U Pilat u la ong ha ki ha ka shoh kaba lai , Hynrei kamai ka kam Rung kaba u la leh ? Ngam lah ban skhem ïa Kanaan kano kaba u la leh kob u dih baneh ïap ! Ngan phah sympat ïa u bad pyllaitluid noh ïa u .
translation.en: And he said unto them the third time , Why , what evil hath he done ? I have found no cause of death in him : I will therefore chastise him , and let him go .
So Gehazi followed after Naaman . And when Naaman saw him running after him , he lighted down from the chariot to meet him , and said , Is all well ?
translation.kha: Kumta u leit mih hadien jong u Naaman . Haba u Naaman u la ïohi ïa u briew uba mareh hadien jong u , u la hiar na la ka kali ïapom ban ïashem ïa u , bad kylli ,  Don ei ei kaba pher ?
Ka kmie bad u kpa jong ka ki la lyngngoh shikatdei , hynrei U Jisu u la lawbah ïa ki ban ym ïathuh hano hano ïa kaei kambah la jia .
translation.en: And her parents were astonished : but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done .
You can recognize them by the way they take no part in politics or social conflicts .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban ithuh ïa ki namar kim ju shim bynta ha ki kam saiñ pyrthei ne ha kam ïaleh pyrshah ha ka imlang sahlang .
To imat ïa ka turoi , to pynsawa ba don jingma ha Senas , u lum bakyntang jong U Blei . To khynñiuh , ko ki paid Judah ! Ka sngi jong U Trai shen kan sa wan .
translation.en: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion , and sound an alarm in my holy mountain : let all the inhabitants of the land tremble : for the day of the  Lord  cometh , for it is nigh at hand  ;

translation.kha: Te Kita ki kynthei ki la kynmaw ïa ki kyndat jong u ,
translation.en: And they remembered his words ,

translation.kha: Lada ka khriat , ki ar ngut ki lah ban ïathiah lai bun ban khong ha ka jingsyiad , hynne kumno phin pynneh jingsyiad tang ma phi da lap hi ?
translation.en: Again , if two lie together , then they have heat : but how can one be warm alone ?

translation.kha: ( jingpynnang 3 :19 ) U Jisu hi u la ong ba u la ‘ pyntip ia ka kyrtong jong U Blei’ bad u la ïai “phla skhem ia ka jingshisha” shaphang U Blei .
translation.en: ( Revelation 3 :14 ) Jesus himself said that he ‘ made God’s name known’ and kept ‘ bearing witness to the truth’ about God .
And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram ,
translation.kha: Ainguh ïa ka jingainguh bam da u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad u masi lyngraw , sa ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ,

U long ma u , uba la ïadon slem bad ki paid Israel haba ki la ïalumlang ha ka ri shympriah ; u la khong Lem hangta bad ki kpa tymmen jong I laiñ bad u angel uba la kren ha u , ha u lum Sinai , malu u la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor ba-im ka jong U Blei ïa-ban ai pateng ha ngi .
translation.en: This is he , that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spake to him in the mount Sinai , and with our fathers : who received the lively oracles to give unto us :

translation.kha: Hadien ba u Ehud u la ïap , ki paid Israel ki leh pop biang pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , when Ehud was dead .
There is one come out of thee , that imagineth evil against the  Lord  , a wicked counsellor .
translation.kha: Na pha , ko Ninebeh , la wan u briew uba dap da ki jingpyrkhat bymman , uba la ïasylla pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
Nga la ar ïa kaei kaba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ïa ngi . Ngi mih na u lum Sinai bad ngi ïadie lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap kaba ïar bad ba-ima sha ka ri lum Amor . Ynda me poi ha Kadesh Barnea ,
translation.en: And when we departed from Horeb , we went through all that great and terrible wilderness , which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites , as the  Lord  our God commanded us  ; and we came to Kadesh–barnea .

translation.kha: U Bakhlem u la Kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa : Kiei film ki briew kiba ïalumlang shaphang Shaei ?
translation.en: And he took up his parable , and said , Alas , who shall live when God doeth this !

translation.kha: Baroh ki ïam pangnud na ka pyntwa jong phan , ki da sleh pui pui ha ki khlieh jong ki bad tyllun ha u dpei .
translation.en: And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee , and shall cry bitterly , and shall cast up dust upon their heads , they shall wallow themselves in the ashes :
And John was clothed with camel s hair , and with a girdle of a skin about his loins  ; and he did eat locusts and wild honey  ;
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la phong da ki jaiñ ba la shna na ki shñiuh ut , bad u panpoh snieh sawdong ïa ka syngkai jong u , bad ka jingbam jong u ka la long da ki puit bad ka ngap khlaw .

Hynrei , lehse don sawphew san nguid ha ka jaka sanphew ngut kiba hok . ithuh men pynjot noh ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei namar ba duna sa ngut ? U thri u ong , Ngan ym pynjot noh ïa ka lada nga shem sawphew san ngut kiba hok .
translation.en: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous : wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five ? And he said , If I find there forty and five , I will not destroy it .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , To pyrta jam kabu phi lah ! Ïathuh ïa ki briew jyllang nga ki Jesreel shaphang ki pop jong ki .
translation.en: Cry aloud , spare not , lift up thy voice like a trumpet , and shew my people their transgression , and the house of Jacob their sins .
Let all your things be done with charity .
translation.kha: Leh ïa ki kam jong phi baroh da ka jingieit .
Myntan , ha ka snieh ha kaba kiba ïap keiñ mihpat , kan long ka tngaw jongno ? Ma ki bhor ki la shongman ïa ka .
translation.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven ? for they all had her .

translation.kha: Ki la tiduh ïa u khup masi ksiar ha Sinai badno mane ïa uta u bleithaw ;
translation.en: They made a calf in Horeb , and worshipped the molten image .
And when I could not see for the glory of that light , being led by the hand of them that were with me , I came into Damascus .
translation.kha: Nga la matlah namar ka jingshai baphyrnai , bad kumta ki paralok jong nga ki la btin ïa nga da ka kti bad ki la ïalam ïa nga sha Damaskos .
Ki long ki briew ba nga la pynlong na ka bynta ïa latai , bad ki rwai ïa ka jingïaroh jong at !
translation.en: This people have I formed for myself  ; they shall shew forth my praise .

translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la lutphut , bad nga la khyndew . Namar jong U Trei , namar ki ktien kiba khuid jong u , ba nga la long kum u bri uba pynbuaid u briew uba la dih bun eh ka waiñ .
translation.en: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets  ; all my bones shake  ; I am like a drunken man , and like a man whom wine hath overcome , because of the  Lord  , and because of the words of his holiness .
To him which led his people through the wilderness : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa la ki briew lyngba ka ri shyiap ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .

Kumba hi ka nar , ka dewbyrtha , ka rnong , ka rupa bad ka ksiar ki la khyllem bad ki la long kumto u pui pui ha ka jaka shoh kew ha ka por lyiur . Ka lyer ka la kit noh ïa u , khlaw da pynsah dien ei ei . Hynrei u maw u la san ban long u lumbah uba tap ïa ka pyrthei bhor Kaei .
translation.en: Then was the iron , the clay , the brass , the silver , and the gold , broken to pieces together , and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors  ; and the wind carried them away , that no place was found for them : and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain , and filled the whole earth .

translation.kha: Ha —kata khih ka Por la don uwei u sum Lebi wahbah ju sah ha nongrit Bethlehem kaban ha Judah .
translation.en: And there was a young man out of Beth–lehem–judah of the family of Judah , who was a Levite , and he sojourned there .
Draw nigh to God , and he will draw nigh to you . Cleanse your hands , ye sinners  ; and purify your hearts , ye double minded .
translation.kha: To wan hajan U Blei , bad un wan hajan jong phi . To sait ïa la ki kti , ko phi ki nongpop ! To pynkhuid ïa la ki dohnud , phi kiba arsap !
Nga kyntur ïa phi , te — nga uba long u nongsah byndi nabar ba nga shakri ïa U TRAI’ ; to im ka jingim kaba la thew kat kum ka rukom kaba U blei u la buh ibha u la khiat ïa phira .
translation.en: I therefore , the prisoner of the Lord , beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called ,

translation.kha: Haba ki nong Ijipt ki la kdang ban kyrduh bam , ki la leit ud sha u syiem ba un ai bam ïa ki . Kumta u la hukum ïa ki ban kitei sha u Joseph , malade ban ni kat kaba u ong ïa ki .
translation.en: And when all the land of Egypt was famished , the people cried to Pharaoh for bread : and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians , Go unto Joseph  ; what he saith to you , do .
His children shall seek to please the poor , and his hands shall restore their goods .
translation.kha: bad ki khun shynrang jong u kin ai noh pat ïa kaei kaba u la tuh na kiba duk .

translation.en: And as he entered into a certain village , there met him ten men that were lepers , which stood afar off :
translation.kha: U la leit lyngba ka shnong ha kaba la ïashem ïa u da ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah kiba pang  ñiangthohlieh .
Ha kata kajuh ka sngi , ar ngut na ki nongbanbeiñ jong U Jisu ki dong leit sha ka shnong kaba kyrteng ka Emmaus , dom khatwei kilomitar na Jerusalem ,
translation.en: And , behold , two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus , which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs .
Then he sent out a second on horseback , which came to them , and said , Thus saith the king , Is it peace ? And Jehu answered , What hast thou to do with peace ? turn thee behind me .
translation.kha: Nangta la phah sa uwei u nonglamktien uba kylli ha u Jehu ïa kajuh ka jingkylli . U Jehu u la jubab biang ,  Kata kam dei ka kam jong me ! Bud nadien jong nga .
Te u Soitan u la wan ha U bad u la ong , Lymda me long U ju U blem , hukum ïa kine ki maw ban kylla kpu .
translation.en: And when the tempter came to him , he said , If thou be the Son of God , command that these stones be made bread .

translation.kha: Man ka snem , u Elkanah u mih na Ramah ban leit mane nabar keiñ ïa ki jingainguh ha U Trai Badonbor Baroh ha Shiloh ; ha kaba u khapnoh bad u Phinehas , ki ar ngut ki khun shaneng u Eli , ki erlangthari ki lyngdoh jong U Trai .
translation.en: And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the  Lord  of hosts in Shiloh . And the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , the priests of the  Lord  , were there .
I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt , to be your God : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; nga la wallam ïa phi na Ijipt ban long U Blei jong phi . Nga long U  Trai .

Kumta ïathiah ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba la U Trai Badonbor Baroh nga ong ha u , ‘ Nga la shim ïa me na ka sharai ïa ki langbrot ha ki pyntha phlang , bad nga la thung ïa me u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jngai nga ki Israel .
translation.en: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I took thee from the sheepcote , from following the sheep , to be ruler over my people , over Israel :

translation.kha: Weng nong ïa ki jingbymkhuid na ka rupa , bad u nong-ohdur un pynmih ïa kaei kaei kaba itynnat .
translation.en: Take away the dross from the silver , and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer .

translation.kha: Nalorkata U Tiras u la kren biang ha na , bad u la nguh ,
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me the second time , saying ,

translation.kha: Katba ki dang wan hiar na u lat , U Josis u la hukum ïa ki , Wat ïathuh hano hano ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohi , den haduh ba U Khun U Briew u la mihkhmat na ka jingïap .
translation.en: And as they came down from the mountain , he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen , till the Son of man were risen from the dead .

translation.kha: Ka long baburom katba smat kaba sting bad ka khmih ïa ki jingdonkam ha ka longïing jongu ka .
translation.en: She looketh well to the ways of her household , and eateth not the bread of idleness .

translation.kha: Ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Kibroth Hattaabah ( kaba mut ki Jingtep ka jingkwah rhah ) , namar hangto ki la tep ïa ki bynriew bakha la kwah rhah ban bam doh .
translation.en: And he called the name of that place Kibroth–hattaavah : because there they buried the people that lusted .

And I saw , when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away , and given her a bill of divorce  ; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not , but went and played the harlot also .
translation.kha: Ka Judah ka la ïohi ba nga la pyllait tnga ïa ka Israel bad phah noh ïa ka namar ba ka la phai noh na nga bad ka la kylla long ka nuti . Hynrei ka Judah , ka para bymïaineh jong ka Israel , kam shym sheptieng . Ma ka ruh ka la kylla long ka nuti
Ki Israel ki sah ha Ijipt sawspah laiphew snem .
translation.en: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel , who dwelt in Egypt , was four hundred and thirty years .

When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field , and hast forgot a sheaf in the field , thou shalt not go again to fetch it : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow : that the  Lord  thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands .
translation.kha: Haba phi lum ïa u kew bad phi kum klet shi song ha lyngkha , wat leit tam shuh ïa u ; ieh ïa u hangta na ka bynta ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , khnang ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu ïa phi ha ka kam jong phi baroh .

translation.en: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam , who did sin , and who made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un iehnoh ïa ki Israel namar ba u Jeroboam u la leh pop bad u la ïalam ïa ki paid Israel ban leh pop .
Nangta u syiem Jehoshaphat u dem ngon , ka iitkhmat jong u kaba dei ha ka khyndew , nabar baroh u paidbah u dem ryngkat bad u bad mane ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground : and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before the  Lord  , worshipping the  Lord .

translation.kha: Naba ka pop ka sting ïa la ka bainong — ka jingïap ; hynrei ka jinghikai jong U Blei ka long ka jingim bymïap ha U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .
translation.en: For the wages of sin is death ; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord .
Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem , Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words ? saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ïa nga ban leit bad ong ha ki paid Judah bad ka Jerusalem ,  Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga kylli ïa phi balei ba phi kyntait ban shahshkor ïa nga bad ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong nga .

translation.en: The calamity of Moab is near to come , and his affliction hasteth fast .
translation.kha: Ka jingshahjop jong ka Moab ka la jan ; ka jingjot jong ka , ka la jan .
Hynriew lada uno uno u kwah ban ïasaidnia shaphang sakma , baroh kaba por don ban nong ka long ba ma ngi lymne ki ïalang U Blei sem don da kawei pat ka rukom ha ka jingma .
translation.en: But if any man seem to be contentious , we have no such custom , neither the churches of God .

translation.kha: U la hukum ïa u paidbah ban shong ha madan . Nangta u la shim ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu bad u la ainguh ïa U Blei , u kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha la ki synran ban sam ha ki paidbah ; bad ki synrum ki la leh kumta .
translation.en: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground : and he took the seven loaves , and gave thanks , and brake , and gave to his disciples to set before them  ; and they did set them before the people .

translation.kha: Ki kulai jongngi ki , ki kham stong ngab ïa ki labasa , kham shyrkhei ban ïa ki suri bathngan . Ki nongsah kulai jong ki , ki wan tur na ki jakarieh ba sha jngai ; ki kulai jong ki , ki trud ïa ka khyndew . Ki wan suh wia kum ki pukni kiba tur ha ka jingbam .
translation.en: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards , and are more fierce than the evening wolves : and their horsemen shall spread themselves , and their horsemen shall come from far  ; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat .
That seeing they may see , and not perceive  ; and hearing they may hear , and not understand  ; lest at any time they should be converted , and their sins should be forgiven them .
translation.kha: khnang ba ,   ‘ Kin khmih bad ïai khmih , pynban kin ym ïohi ; Kin sngap bad ïai sngap , pynban kin ym sngewthuh . Namar lada ki ïohi lane sngewthuh , kin phai sha U Blei , bad un map ïa ki .’
U Trai u ino , Ka bneng ka long ka khat jongu nga bad ka Khynñiuh ka long ka jingkerkut jongu nga . Kaba kumno kñi ka ïing men tei ïa ang , bad kaba kumno ka jaka ba ngan shnong ?
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , The heaven is my throne , and the earth is my footstool : where is the house that ye build unto me ? and where is the place of my rest ?
Nevertheless he saved them for his name s sake , that he might make his mighty power to be known .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la pynim ïa ki , kumba u la kular , khnang ban pyn-i ïa ka bor bakhraw jong u .
Kynmaw u Abraham , u kpa tymmen jong phi u la longsem uba la pynksan da U Blei ? Ka la long namar ki kam ki jong u , mynba u la aiti ïa u Isaak u khun jong u ha ka duwan .
translation.en: Was not Abraham our father justified by works , when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar ?

translation.kha: Pynïap , ki Lebi kin ym ïoh kano kano ka bynta jong ka ri lem bad Phin , namar ka bynshet jong ki ka long ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh jong U Trai . Doeg da bashisha , ki jait phad , Reuben , Manasseh ba sha Mihngi te ki la ha ïohpdiang ïa la ka jaka ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan , ïa kaba u Moses u shatri jong U Trai u la ai ha ki .
translation.en: But the Levites have no part among you  ; for the priesthood of the  Lord  is their inheritance : and Gad , and Reuben , and half the tribe of Manasseh , have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east , which Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave them .

Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all , because I have you in my heart ; inasmuch as both in my bonds , and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel , ye all are partakers of my grace .
translation.kha: Phi long borabor ha ka dohnud jong nga ! Kumta ka long kaba dei ïa nga ban sngew kumba nga sngew shaphang jong phi . Namar phi baroh phi la ïoh bynta lem bad nga ha kane ka lad kaba U Blei u la ai ha nga , mynta haba nga don ha byndi bad ruh haba nga la long laitluid ban ïada ïa ka gospel bad ha kaba tei pynskhem ïa ka .

translation.en: Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me : and behold a basket of summer fruit .
translation.kha: Nga la ïoh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U  Trai  Nongsynshar . Ha ka , nga la ïohi shi shang ki soh .

translation.en: In every thing give thanks : for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you .
translation.kha: to long kiba sngewnguh ha kiei kiei baroh . Kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u kwah na phi ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .
Ko mut ba ar dei ban da ïoh ïa ka jingphla Jong u briew ; nga ong ïa kane ba khnang ba phin jingtehkular im .
translation.en: But I receive not testimony from man : but these things I say , that ye might be saved .

translation.kha: Ngi dei ban siew na ka bynshet ka um kaba sem dih ; I dei ba thad ïa ka dieng kaba ngi donkam ban thang .
translation.en: We have drunken our water for money  ; our wood is sold unto us .

translation.kha: Pynïap ïa u ! Sdang jingsuk ma phi ban lynthem maw ïa u , bad nangta uwei pa uwei ruh un lynthem maw ïa u .
translation.en: But thou shalt surely kill him  ; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death , and afterwards the hand of all the people .
And Mizpah  ; for he said , The  Lord  watch between me and thee , when we are absent one from another .
translation.kha: U Laban u ong ruh ,  To U  Trai  un khmih halor jong ngi haba ngi la ïakhlad iwei na iwei pat .  Kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot ruh ka Mispah .
Ha ka sner kaba to , u Joseph u ong ha ki , Nga long u briew babha sheptieng Blei , kumta ngan pyllait im ïa phi ha Kane ka kyndon :
translation.en: And Joseph said unto them the third day , This do , and live  ; for I fear God :

translation.kha: bad ha mon ba thang ïa ki jingainguh ba la ai shaw U Tharai ha ka Sabbaton , ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , sad ha kiwei kiew ki Jingkhawai Ma . La thaw ïa ki jingpyndait ryntih da kaba kdew ïa ka jingdon ki Lebi kiba la pynkhamti ban leh ïa Kane ka kam man ka por .
translation.en: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the  Lord  in the sabbaths , in the new moons , and on the set feasts , by number , according to the order commanded unto them , continually before the  Lord  :

translation.kha: U Kynthei la kylla long u briew bun , kaba ba-dap da ka jingaiei mala ka jingshisha , u la im hapdeng jong ngi . Ngi la ïohi ïa ka burom jongki u , ka donburom kaba u la ïohpdiang kumta U ti marwei jongnga U Kpa .
translation.en: And the Word was made flesh , and dwelt among us , ( and we beheld his glory , the glory as of the only begotten of the Father , ) full of grace and truth .

translation.kha: Ang long u Ahab bad u Omega , ong U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , uba long , uba la long bad u ban sa woh .
translation.en: I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the ending ,  saith the Lord ,  which is , and which was , and which is to come , the Almighty .

translation.kha: Haba u kew u la ih , u briew u sdang ban ot ïa u da ka rashi , namar ka aïom ot ka la poi .
translation.en: But when the fruit is brought forth , immediately he putteth in the sickle , because the harvest is come .
But he that is an hireling , and not the shepherd , whose own the sheep are not , seeth the wolf coming , and leaveth the sheep , and fleeth : and the wolf catcheth them , and scattereth the sheep .
translation.kha: Haba u nongbylla sngi , u bym dei u nongaplangbrot bad u bym dei trai ïa ki langbrot , u ïohi ïa u suri ba u wan , u iehnoh ïa ki langbrot bad u phet noh ; kumta u suri u kynrup ïa ki langbrot bad pynsaphred ïa ki .
Wat thok .
translation.en: Don't tell a lie .

translation.kha: Kaei ka kamai jong u thah nabar jong u thah stang ,
translation.en: Out of whose womb came the ice ? and the hoary frost of heaven , who hath gendered it ?

translation.kha: ka snieh langsohmoh ba la wieh rong saw , ka sneng kaba bha , bad ka Dieng akasia ;
translation.en: And rams  skins dyed red , and badgers  skins , and shittim wood ,

translation.kha: Uta u rangbah synshar u la hukum ban pynsangeh ïa ka kali kulai , bad baroh ar ngut , u Philip bad uta u rangbah synshar ki la ïaleit Hirah sha ka um , bad u Philip u la pynbuaid ïa u .
translation.en: And he commanded the chariot to stand still : and they went down both into the water , both Philip and the eunuch  ; and he baptized him .

translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngem , kaba sawphew saw jong u bnai , U Trai u la ai ha u Haggai ïa ka khubor kaba ar
translation.en: And again the word of the  Lord  came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month , saying ,
I ate no pleasant bread , neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth , neither did I anoint myself at all , till three whole weeks were fulfilled .
translation.kha: Ngam shym bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam bang lane kano kano ka doh , lane dih ïa kano kano ka waiñ , lane sad ïa u shñiuh jong nga tad haduh ba ki lai taïew ki la leit noh .

Mynta hukum ïa ki paid Israel baroh ba-bang ïakynduh ïa nga ha u Lum Karmel . Wallam ruh siewspah sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal nabar sawspah ngut ki nongpynkhiah jong ka blei Asherah kiba ïoh jingkyrshan na ka syiem Jesebel .
translation.en: Now therefore send , and gather to me all Israel unto mount Carmel , and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty , and the prophets of the groves four hundred , which eat at Jezebel s table .

translation.kha: Ki jaboh , Ka ri lum kam biang ïa ngi ; hynriewphew ki Kanaan ha ki ri thor ki ei ki kali ïapom da ka nar , na ka bynta kito kiba Shong ha Beth Shan bad ïa ki nongot kiba sarong jong ka bad na ka pyntwa kito kiba shong ha ka Them Jesreel .
translation.en: And the children of Joseph said , The hill is not enough for us : and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron , both they who are of Beth–shean and her towns , and they who are of the valley of Jezreel .

translation.kha: Te men ïakhot , bad ngan jubab , bad Man shem sngewbha ïa nga , u jingthaw jong me .
translation.en: Thou shalt call , and I will answer thee : thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Wan kiaw sha nga ha a u lum , bad katai me sdang don hangne , ngan ai ha me ar thylli ki mawlyngkniap ibha don ïa ki hukum baroh kiba sa la thop na ka pyntha ban hikai ïa ki briew .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Come up to me into the mount , and be there : and I will give thee tables of stone , and a law , and commandments which I have written  ; that thou mayest teach them .

translation.kha: A thri me la ai ha ngi ïa ki aiñ Jong me Bad me la ong ïa ngi ban khlong biang biang ïa ki .
translation.en: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently .

translation.kha: U Petros u la jingbabe , Ngan ym iehnoh ïa me , wat la barhem kiwei pat kin ni kumta !
translation.en: But Peter said unto him , Although all shall be offended , yet will not I .
And the  Lord  said , Shall I hide from Abraham that thing which I do  ;
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u ong ha lade ,  Ngan nym buhrieh na u Abraham ïa kaei kaba ngan sa leh .
te un tang shu tip ba u la leh thup kumta , un Wallam kum ka jingainguh jong u ïa ka blang kynthei ka bym don kano Kanah ka jingduna .
translation.en: Or if his sin , which he hath sinned , come to his knowledge : then he shall bring his offering , a kid of the goats , a female without blemish , for his sin which he hath sinned .
The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst : the young children ask bread , and no man breaketh it unto them .
translation.kha: Ki shah ïa ki khunlung jong ki ban ïap ha ka jingthngan bad jingsliang ; ki khynnah ki khrong jingbam kaba ym don mano mano ban ai ha ki .

Nga lah ban kular ha u briew uba bha , hynrei lada u sdang ba-bang pyrkhat ba ka jingleh babha jong u kaba mynshuwa ka la baïong bad u sdang ban lai nongpop , Ngan ym kynmaw ïa kano kano kaba bha ba u la ai . Un ïap namar ki pum jongki u .
translation.en: When I shall say to the righteous , that he shall surely live  ; if he trust to his own righteousness , and commit iniquity , all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered  ; but for his iniquity that he hath committed , he shall die for it .
Call unto me , and I will answer thee , and shew thee great and mighty things , which thou knowest not .
translation.kha: To khot kyrpad ïa nga , bad ngan jubab ïa phi ; ngan ïathuh ïa phi kiei kiei kiba phylla bad kiba sngewphylla kiba phim shym la tip ei ei shaphang jong ki .

translation.en: The meek also shall increase their joy in the  Lord  , and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duk bad kiba rit kyrdan kin shem pat ïa ka jingsuk kaba U  Trai  , U Blei Bakhuid jong ki Israel , un ai .

Hynrei ïa kito kiba idei ban long ki nongmareh — nga ong ïa kane namar kam phira ei ei ïa nga la ki long kiba kumta kynum ruh ; U Blei um bishar na ki durkhmat bashabar — kito ki nongriam , nga ïai-ong , kiei don ei ei ki jingai jingmut bathymmai na ka bynta jongno nga .
translation.en: But of these who seemed to be somewhat , (whatsoever they were , it maketh no matter to me : God accepteth no man s person :) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me :

translation.kha: ïa ka duwan tdong jingiwbih Bad ki jingbah ïa ka ; ïa ka umphniang pynjlan ; ïa ka jingiwbih ; ïa ka pyrda na ka bynta ka jingkhang jongki ka Ïingjaiñ ;
translation.en: And the incense altar , and his staves , and the anointing oil , and the sweet incense , and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle ,
And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth : so that if a man can number the dust of the earth , then shall thy seed also be numbered .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki baroh ; kan kham jem ban ñiew ïa ki phngit pui pui ha ka khyndew !

translation.en: Am I now come up without the  Lord  against this place to destroy it ? The  Lord  said to me , Go up against this land , and destroy it .
translation.kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba nga la tur ïaleh ïa ka ri jong phi bad ban pynjot ïa ka khlem ka jingïarap jong U  Trai  ? U  Trai  da lade hi u ong ha nga ban tur ïaleh bad ban pynjot ïa ka .

baroh na ki , ki la ïaleit lang sha u syiem ban musli ïa u Daniel . Ki la ong , Ko Shimiet Kynrad , phi la soi ïa ka hukum ba na ka bynta ki laiphew Sngi kiba Bud ïa uno uno uba kyrpad ïa kano kano na uno uno u blei lane na Uno uno u briew lait tieng na phin , yn bret ïa u haduh ka thliew ba-ima da ki sing . U syiem u la jaboh , Ho-oid , ka hukum kaban pyrkhing , ka Aiñ jong ki Mid bad ki Persia , ka im la ban pynkylla .
translation.en: Then they came near , and spake before the king concerning the king s decree  ; Hast thou not signed a decree , that every man that shall ask a petition of any God or man within thirty days , save of thee , O king , shall be cast into the den of lions ? The king answered and said , The thing is true , according to the law of the Medes and Persians , which altereth not .

translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban shaniah ha U Trai ban ïa kaba shaniah ha ki nongïalam ba kynjoh briew’ .
translation.en: It is better to trust in the  Lord  than to put confidence in princes .

translation.kha: Nangta u la khop ïa u khuid jong u Rehob , u Hadadeser , u syiem ka hima Sebah jong ka syriem , kabu u Hadadeser u dang don ha lynti ban pynïoh pat ïa la ka bol nongsynshar halor ka ri harud ka wah Ïuphratis kaba shaneng .
translation.en: David smote also Hadadezer , the son of Rehob , king of Zobah , as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U TRAI’ bad u la leit kumba u Gad u la ïathmu ïa u .
translation.en: And David , according to the saying of Gad , went up as the  Lord  commanded .
And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat , and for a place of refuge , and for a covert from storm and from rain .
translation.kha: Ka burom jong u kan kah ïa ka nongbah na ka jingshit jong ka sngi bad pynlong ïa ka , ka jaka kaba shngain , kaba la da na u slap bad ka  erïong .
Pi lah banbeiñ thain jaiñ na u saiwul jong ki langbrot jong phi bad thied jaka da ka pisa kaba phi ïoh na kaba sla na ki katto katne ki blang jong phi .
translation.en: The lambs are for thy clothing , and the goats are the price of the field .

translation.kha: Nongbah lada kaei kaba U Blei u kular ban ai ha kito Kiba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum , te ka jingngeit u briew kam ei jingmut bad ka jingkular U Blei kam donakor ei ei .
translation.en: For if they which are of the law be heirs , faith is made void , and the promise made of none effect :

translation.kha: U Hilkaïah , u Tebah , bad u Sekharaïah . Ha baroh ki ïadon khatlai ngut ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong u Jehoash kiba den ki nongap phira ïa ka Tubal .
translation.en: Hilkiah the second , Tebaliah the third , Zechariah the fourth : all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen .

He is like a man which built an house , and digged deep , and laid the foundation on a rock : and when the flood arose , the stream beat vehemently upon that house , and could not shake it : for it was founded upon a rock .
translation.kha: U long kum u briew uba , ha kaba tei ïa la ka ïing , u la tih jylliew bad u la pynshong nongrim halor u mawsiang . Ka wah ka la shlei bad ka la lynshop ïa kata ka ïing hynrei kam lah ban pynkhih ïa ka , namar la shna bha ïa ka .

translation.en: For when they had slain their children to their idols , then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it  ; and , lo , thus have they done in the midst of mine house .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi hi ba ki pynïap ïa ki khun jong nga kum ki jingkñia sha ki bleithaw , ki la wan sha ka Templ jong nga bad pyntngit ïa ka !

translation.en: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation , and concerning a kingdom , to build and to plant it  ;
translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka liang , lada nga ong ba ngan seng lane tei ïa kano kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka hima ,

translation.en: I will also break in pieces with thee the shepherd and his flock  ; and with thee will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen  ; and with thee will I break in pieces captains and rulers .
translation.kha: ban pynïap ïa ki nongaplangbrot bad ki kynhun langbrot jong ki , ban pynïap ïa ki nonglur bad ïa ki kulai jong ki , ban ïuhroit ïa ki nongsynshar bad ki rangbah synshar ba-halor .

translation.en: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together , and appoint themselves one head , and they shall come up out of the land : for great shall be the day of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Judah bad ki briew ka Israel kin ïasoh lang kawei sa shisien . Kin sa jied tang uwei u nongïalam na ka bynta jong ki , bad sa shisien pat kin sa manbha bad roi kyrhai ha la ka ri . Ho-oid , ka sngi jong ka Jesreel kan long ka sngi kaba khraw !

Lada u briew u ïathiah shongduh bad ka briew haba ka dang poi bnai , dih ban tat noh ïa ki baroh ar nongput na la ki bakhraw , namar ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki jingbabe ryntih kiba ïadei bad ka jingbymkhuid .
translation.en: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness , and shall uncover her nakedness  ; he hath discovered her fountain , and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood : and both of them shall be cut off from among their people .

translation.kha: Lada ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phiah phin phan bapaw sha U Trai , bad kohnguh da ka dohnud jong phoi baroh , bad da ka mynsiem jong phi baroh ïa ki Law jongu u kiba nga ai ha phi myntri ka sneng ,
translation.en: And shalt return unto the  Lord  thy God , and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day , thou and thy children , with all thine heart , and with all thy soul  ;

And it came to pass , when he began to reign , as soon as he sat on his throne , that he slew all the house of Baasha : he left him not one that pisseth against a wall , neither of his kinsfolks , nor of his friends .
translation.kha: Mar ïalong syiem , u Simri u la pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot na ka longïing u Baasha . Ïa uwei pa uwei u ba-ha-ïing bad uwei pa uwei u paralok la pynïap .

Ngi la pynlut kham bun ka por hangta , tad ynda ka la long kaba ma ban bteng ïa ka jingleit da ka lieng , naba mynta ka Sngi ka jingshahjop ka la dpei . Kumta u Paul u la ai ïa kane ka jingai jingmut ha ki :
translation.en: Now when much time was spent , and when sailing was now dangerous , because the fast was now already past , Paul admonished them ,

translation.kha: Ki krong bahryntieh jong ki , ki long ki shiphew bakhrawbor kiba pynpyut khlem jingisynei .
translation.en: Their quiver is as an open sepulchre , they are all mighty men .

translation.kha: lada uno uno na phi da ka jingjia ryngkhat u pynïap nangno ïano , u lah ban leit shata malu maji na uta uba wan khop .
translation.en: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither : and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood .
Yet I will rejoice in the  Lord  , I will joy in the God of my salvation .
translation.kha: Ngan ïai lehkmen bad shadkmen , namar U  Trai  U Blei u long u nongpynim jong nga .
Rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jingot haba ph sdang ban ot ïa u soh nyngkong na u kaw jong phira ; rakhe ruh ïa ka Jingkhawai Mamre Ki ïingtrep ha ka synrai hajuh phi lum ïa la ki soh .
translation.en: And thou shalt observe the feast of weeks , of the firstfruits of wheat harvest , and the feast of ingathering at the year s end .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki syndon jong u , Uno du uba shahshkor ïa phi u shahshkor ïa ang ; uno uno uba kyntait ïa phi u kyntait ïa nga ; bad eit uno uba kyntait ïa nga u kyntait ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: He that heareth you heareth me  ; and he that despiseth you despiseth me  ; and he that despiseth me despiseth him that sent me .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh hir u sngew artatien ïa kaei kabu u bam , U Blei u pynrem ïa u haba u bah ïa ka , namar kaei kaba u leh , kam shong nongrim ha ka jingngeit . Bad kaei Kiei ka bym shong nongrim ha ka jingngeit ka long ka pop .
translation.en: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat , because he eateth not of faith : for whatsoever is not of faith is sin .
From whence come wars and fightings among you ? come they not hence , even of your lusts that war in your members ?
translation.kha: Nangno ki mih ki thma bad ki jingïakajia hapdeng jong phi ? Ki mih na ki jingkwah brai jong phi ïa ka jingsngewbha , kiba ïai ïaleh hapoh jong phi .
Susah lada kano kano ka ïing ne ka shnong kam pdiang sngewbha ïa phi lane pynshahshkor ïa phin , te mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong phi .
translation.en: And whosoever shall not receive you , nor hear your words , when ye depart out of that house or city , shake off the dust of your feet .
Now when he had ended all his sayings in the audience of the people , he entered into Capernaum .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ban kren ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki paidbah , u la leit sha Kapernam .

translation.en: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth  ; that there be just men , unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked  ; again , there be wicked men , to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous : I said that this also is vanity .
translation.kha: Hynrei kane ka long ka bym don jingmut . Khmih kaei kaba jia ha ka pyrthei : Teng teng uba hok u ïoh ïa ka jingshah pynshitom jong u bymman , bad ki riewbymman ki ïoh ïa ka bainong jong kiba hok . Nga ong ba ka long ka bymmyntoi .

translation.en: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver .
translation.kha: Ka aiñ kaba me la ai ka kham kordor ïa nga ban ïa ka pisa baroh ha ka pyrthei .

translation.en: He removed the high places , and brake the images , and cut down the groves , and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made : for unto those days the children of Israel did burn incense to it : and he called it Nehushtan .
translation.kha: U pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , u pynpra ïa ki païa maw , bad u pyndkut ïa ki durblei jong ka blei Asherah . U pynpra ruh lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u bseiñ rnong ïa uba u Moses u la shna , ïa uba la khot Nehushtan . Haduh kata ka por ki paid Israel ki la thang jingiwbih na ka bynta ka burom jong u .
Ha ka sngi kyntiew kurim , u Othniel u kyntu ïa ka ba pan lyngkha na u kpa jyllang ka . Ka la hiar na ka kada ba ka shong , Bad u Kaleb u kylli Aïu ba ka kwah .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as she came unto him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field : and she lighted off her ass  ; and Caleb said unto her , What wouldest thou ?
Which say , Stand by thyself , come not near to me  ; for I am holier than thou . These are a smoke in my nose , a fire that burneth all the day .
translation.kha: Bad nangta ki ong ïa kiwei pat , ‘ To ïeng jngai na ngi , naba ngi long kiba khuid shaba palat ym bit ban ktah ïa ngi !’ Ngam lah ban shah ïa ki briew kiba kum kita — ka jingbitar jong nga pyrshah ïa ki ka long kum ka ding ka bym ju lip shuh .
Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane Haneng ba phin ïuh ïa ka jingsuk da kaba phi long lak bad nga . Ka pyrthei kan pynlong ïa phin ban shahshitom . Hynñiew to long shlur ! Nga , nga la jop ïa ka pyrthei !
translation.en: These things I have spoken unto you , that in me ye might have peace . In the world ye shall have tribulation : but be of good cheer  ; I have overcome the world .

translation.kha: kiei kaba phi kham jied ? Heth ngan wan sha phoi da u dieng sympat , ne ha ka mynsiem ka jingieit bad ka jingjynjar ?
translation.en: What will ye ? shall I come unto you with a rod , or in love , and in the spirit of meekness ?

translation.kha: Hynrei nga kylla : Hato ka long kaba shisha ba kim shym la ïasngew ïa ka kyrhuh ? Da shisha ki la ïohsngew — naba kumba ka jingkhot Bakhuid ka ïa-ong : Ka jingsawa jong ka sa jong ki ka la leit sha ka pyrthuh baroh ; ki ktien jong ki , ki la poi shaduh kiba kut ka pyrthei .
translation.en: But I say , Have they not heard ? Yes verily , their sound went into all the earth , and their words unto the ends of the world .

translation.kha: U syiem u ong ruh ha u , Ang longkmie u syiem — bad yn ym don uwei ruh ha ka ri Ijipt baroh’ kawei u ban leh ei ei khleiñ ka jingai jingbit jong me .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I am Pharaoh , and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt .
And I , behold , I establish my covenant with you , and with your seed after you  ;
translation.kha: Mynta ngan pynlong ka jutang bad phi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ,
Ngam ba-don tnad , ka la jubab . U Jisu u la phai ktien , Ka longsyiem kaba dei haba pha ainong ba pham dat tngen .
translation.en: The woman answered and said , I have no husband . Jesus said unto her ,  Thou hast well said , I have no husband :

translation.kha: Wat tei ïa ka ïing jong phi bad pynskhem ïa ka longïing tad haduh ban pynbiang ïa ki lyngkha jong phi , malu phin thikna ba phi lah ban kamai ha ka jingshim .
translation.en: Prepare thy work without , and make it fit for thyself in the field  ; and afterwards build thine house .

translation.kha: U TRAI’ Nongbishar u ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ . U pynlong ïa nga uba skhem ki kjat kum ka skei mala u sumar ïa nga halor ki lapbah .
translation.en: The  Lord  God is my strength , and he will make my feet like hinds  feet , and he will make me to walk upon mine high places . To the chief singer on my stringed instruments .

translation.kha: Ki te ki ïakohnguh ban leh kumta , bad ki ïa-ong para ma ki , Ho-oid , myntan ngi shah jyntang namar kaei kaba ngi la leh ïa la u jongno u to . Naei la ïohi haduh katno u khuslai mynba u kyrpad ba ngin ïarap ïa u , bad ngim shym la shahshkor . Dei Namar “kata ba ngi shah jynjar kumne mynta .
translation.en: And they said one to another , We are verily guilty concerning our brother , in that we saw the anguish of his soul , when he besought us , and we would not hear  ; therefore is this distress come upon us .

translation.kha: U tharai u ong , Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , to otsher bad pynbudnam ïa ki nongshun jong phira ! Neng pynlong ïa phi kiba khlaiñ kum u masi kyrtong uba don ki reng nar bad ki kjat rnong . phin pynlwet ïa ki jaitbynriew ba bun , nabar ïa ka spah kabu ki la ïoh da ka jingleh jubor phin ai sngewbha ïa nga , U Trai jong ka pyrthei baroh khawai .
translation.en: Arise and thresh , O daughter of Zion : for I will make thine horn iron , and I will make thy hoofs brass : and thou shalt beat in pieces many people : and I will consecrate their gain unto the  Lord  , and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth .

And I will take away his blood out of his mouth , and his abominations from between his teeth : but he that remaineth , even he , shall be for our God , and he shall be as a governor in Judah , and Ekron as a Jebusite .
translation.kha: Kin ym lah shuh ban bam ïa ka doh lem bad ka snam ha ka , lane ïa kiwei pat ki jingbam ba la mana . Baroh kiba lait im kin long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga bad kin long kum ka kur ha ka jait Judah . Ka Ekron kan kylla long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga , kumba ki Jebus ki la long .
To shad , to shad , ko theisamla ka Shullam . Sah ïa ngi ban peit ïa phi katba phi dang shad . Balei phi kiaw ban khmih ïa nga kabu nga dang sharud napdeng ki nongkhmih kai ?
translation.en: The mandrakes give a smell , and at our gates are all manner of pleasant fruits , new and old , which I have laid up for thee , O my beloved .

translation.kha: Baroh kaba ar kwah ka lama ba ngan ithuh ïa U Khrist bad ban mad ïa ka bor ka jingmihpat jong u , ban ïoh bynta ha ki jingshahshitom jrong u , bad ban longsyiem kum ma u ha ka jingïap jong u ,
translation.en: That I may know him , and the power of his resurrection , and the fellowship of his sufferings , being made conformable unto his death ;

translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi don ei ei ban ong , to ai ba ngan sngew ïa katai ; ngan pdiang da naba sngewbha lada kaba phi ong ka long kaba daym .
translation.en: If thou hast any thing to say , answer me : speak , for I desire to justify thee .

translation.kha: baneh ïathuh ha ki Israel ba une uno u briew uba leh pop khlem tip bad u pynkheiñ ïa kano kano ka Law U Trai , u dei ban bud ïa kine ki waiñ harum .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which ought not to be done , and shall do against any of them :

translation.kha: Nga la pynshitom ïa phalang , hynrei kam shym Wanlam Kano kano ka jingkha ; phan ym da la shiah ïa nga ban pynpait ïa pha . kumne u sing uba shyrkhei , pha la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong nga .
translation.en: In vain have I smitten your children  ; they received no correction : your own sword hath devoured your prophets , like a destroying lion .

translation.kha: Ban bujli ïa ki , u Rehoboam u thaw ïa ki stieh da ka rnong nabar aiti ïa ki ha ki pynrangbah pynïaidkam kiba kitkhlieh ban ïada ïa ki khyrdop ka ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass , and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard , that kept the entrance of the king s house .

translation.kha: Dei ha me , ym ha ki hynmen jong me , ba nga ai ïa ka Shekhem , kata ka jaka kaba seisoh ba nga la ïohknieh na ki Amor da ka waitlam bad ka ryntieh jong nga .
translation.en: Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren , which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow .
And if a man also strive for masteries , yet is he not crowned , except he strive lawfully .
translation.kha: U nongmareh thong uba mareh ïa ka thong un ym lah ban ïoh ïa ka prais lymda u kohnguh ïa ki rukom pynïaid .
Na kata ka jaka u peit shang bad shai ban ïoh ei ei ïa-ban pynïap nabar ban bam .
translation.en: From thence she seeketh the prey , and her eyes behold afar off .

translation.kha: U nongap phira u pyrta , Ko kyndiah , nga la ïeng ap phira ha ka kam jong nga mynsngi bad mynsngi .
translation.en: And he cried , A lion : My lord , I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime , and I am set in my ward whole nights :

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa u ksiang ym donkam haba treikam tang uwei u brup ; bad U Blei u long uwei .
translation.en: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one , but God is one .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ai ha u nabar ha u Oholiab u khun jong u Ahikam , na ka jait Dan , ïa ka sap ban hikai ïa ki buit treikam ha kiwei pud .
translation.en: And he hath put in his heart that he may teach , both he , and Aholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba u Law ka long ba ngi ngeit ha U Jisu Khrist , U Khun jong u bad ngi ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei , kumba U Khrist u la hukum ïa i'u .
translation.en: And this is his commandment , That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ , and love one another , as he gave us commandment .

translation.kha: Nga la tip shwa ba ki nongtem nongput ka Templ bad kiwei ki Lebi ki la mihnoh na Jerusalem bad poi biang sha ki jaka rep , namar ki briew kim shym la ai kaba biang ïa ki ban im .
translation.en: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them : for the Levites and the singers , that did the work , were fled every one to his field .

translation.kha: Kito kiba ktah ïa ka metïap ki long ki bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam ïaheh hynñiew sneng .
translation.en: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days .
And falling into a place where two seas met , they ran the ship aground  ; and the forepart stuck fast , and remained unmoveable , but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka lieng ka la tyngkhuh ïa ka jaka shyiap bad ka la sangeh ; ka bynta ba sha khmat jong ka lieng ka la sahkut bad kam lah ban khih , katba ka bynta ba shadien ka la shah pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ha ki jingat phyllung bashyrkhei .
La kumno kumno , lada “kata ka lah baneh long , to ing ïa-ïaid shad khmat kat kum kijuh ki kyntien kiba ngi la bud haduh mynta .
translation.en: Nevertheless , whereto we have already attained , let us walk by the same rule , let us mind the same thing .

translation.kha: Ma phi ïa lade hi phi dei ban Long kiba sumar bha . Phin shah krem bad shiah ïabam sha ka ïingbishar . Ïa phira yn sa shoh ha ki synagog ; pien sa Ïeng ha khmat ki nongsynshar bad ki syiem na ka bynta jongu nga ban ïathuh ha ki ïa ka Khrawbor Babha .
translation.en: But take heed to yourselves : for they shall deliver you up to councils  ; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten : and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake , for a testimony against them .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kabu ar ka u Darius u longkmie u patsha ka Persia , ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba hynriew , U TRAI’ u la kren lyngba u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa . translation.kha: Wad ïa u bankhia naba tbit ba un ohdur ha moi ki ar tylli ki mawkordor ïa ki ktang jong ki khulom shynrang jong u Jakob bad pynshong ïa ki ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar .
translation.en: With the work of an engraver in stone , like the engravings of a signet , shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel : thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold .
Which devour widows  houses , and for a shew make long prayers : the same shall receive greater damnation .
translation.kha: kiba shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei bad kiba knieh noh ïa ki ïing jong ki , bad nangta kiba pyn-i paidbah da kaba duwai jlan ! Ka jingpynshitom ïa ki kan long kaba kham shyrkhei !
Nangta u Elijah u ong , Ngam ni sa tang ma nga u nongïathuhlypa jong U Trai uba daiñ sah , hynrei ki don sawspah sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal .
translation.en: Then said Elijah unto the people , I , even I only , remain a prophet of the  Lord   ; but Baal s prophets are four hundred and fifty men .
Is it good that he should search you out ? or as one man mocketh another , do ye so mock him ?
translation.kha: Lada U Blei u khmih bha ïa me , hato un shem kano kano kaba bha ? Hato me pyrkhat ba me lah ban shukor ïa U Blei kumba me shukor ïa ki briew ?

translation.en: For man also knoweth not his time : as the fishes that are taken in an evil net , and as the birds that are caught in the snare  ; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time , when it falleth suddenly upon them .

translation.kha: Shen , u Jisu un weng noh baroh ki jingsiew bad jingjynsur na Kanah ka pyrthei .—Salm 37 :9-11 ; Proberb 2 :21 , 22 .
translation.en: Soon Jesus will remove all wickedness and suffering from this earth .—Psalm 37 :9-11  ; Proverbs 2 :21 , 22 .

translation.kha: Berakah ktieh kiei kiba u Elah u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori jrong Ki Syiem Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Elah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
And into whatsoever city ye enter , and they receive you , eat such things as are set before you :
translation.kha: Ha man ba phi leit shapoh ka nongrit bad la pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , bam ïa kaei kaba la buh ha khmat jong phi ,
Ki la shon la sah hangne bad tei ïa ka templ ban burom ïa me , da kaba tip
translation.en: And they dwelt therein , and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name , saying ,

translation.kha: To ïadem lem ïa ki jingdon lad phi bad ki parabangeit kiba kyrduh , bad to pdiang sngewbha sha ki ïing jong phi! ïa ki nongwei .
translation.en: Distributing to the necessity of saints ; given to hospitality .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem u ai ha uwei ïa ka khubor ba-dap da ka jingstad , katba ha uwei pat , jhur U Mynsiem u ai ïa ka khubor ba-dait da ka jingtip .
translation.en: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom ; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit ;

And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived , that I lifted up mine eyes , and saw in a dream , and , behold , the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked , speckled , and grisled .
translation.kha: Ha ka aïom pakor nga la phohsniew , bad nga la ïohi ba ki  langsohmoh kiba ïa-pakor ki long kiba thohshuid , kiba thohbria bad kiba thohbroin .

translation.en: The Lord  God  hath opened mine ear , and I was not rebellious , neither turned away back .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ïa ka jingshemphang , bad nga shym la ïaleh pyrshah lane phai noh na u .

U Joab u them khrup haduh khynñiuh ha khmat u Dabid da ka jinglehburom bad u ong U Blei! un kyrkhu ïa phi , ko Syiem Kynrad ! Mynta nga thup ba phi sngewbha ïa na , nalor phi la mynjur ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga .
translation.en: And Joab fell to the ground on his face , and bowed himself , and thanked the king : and Joab said , To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight , my lord , O king , in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant .

translation.kha: Me don bun ki nongtrei . Ki don ki jingbabe ki ban trei ha ki par miej , bad ki don ki myllung maw bad jingsmai diengduh , bad shibun ki nongtrei kad ha ki jait ki baroh ba ki lah ban trei ha ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong bad ka nala .
translation.en: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance , hewers and workers of stone and timber , and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work .

translation.kha: Ko kynïan , balei pha ïam ? U Jisu u la kyllan ïa ka , Ïano pha pud ? Ka la nang pyrkhat ba u la dei u nongsumar kper , kumta ka la ong ha u , Lada me la rah noh ïa u , ko kynrad , to ïateh ïa nga hangno me la buh ïa u , bun ngan ïoh leit bad shim ïa u .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , why weepest thou ? whom seekest thou ?  She , supposing him to be the gardener , saith unto him , Sir , if thou have borne him hence , tell me where thou hast laid him , and I will take him away .

Thou shalt also make a laver of brass , and his foot also of brass , to wash withal : and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar , and thou shalt put water therein .
translation.kha: Shna kawei ka dabor rnong , kaba ka jingpynshong jong ka ruh dei da ka rnong . Buh ïa ka hapdeng ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad pyndap um ïa ka .
U thiah mynmiet , u khiew bad ha ka por mynsngi , Bad ha baroh kata ka por ki symbai ki speh bad ki nang san . Pynban um tip kumno kane ka jia .
translation.en: And should sleep , and rise night and day , and the seed should spring and grow up , he knoweth not how .

translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por U Jisu u la shang ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor jong u : To phad noh na ki pop jong phi , namar ka shiah ki bneng ka la jan !
translation.en: From that time Jesus began to preach , and to say ,  Repent : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand .
And when they had preached the gospel to that city , and had taught many , they returned again to Lystra , and to Iconium , and Antioch ,
translation.kha: U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha Derbe bad ki la ïoh bun ki synran . Nangta ki la leit phai pat sha Lystra , sha Ikoniom , bad nangta sha Antiokh kaba ha Pisidia .
U Elisha u khie joit , u ïadih shane shatai hapoh kamra , bad nangne u leit biang bad u pyiar ïa lade halor u khynnah . U khynnah u la synñia hynñiew sien dara u peit la ki khmat .
translation.en: Then he returned , and walked in the house to and fro  ; and went up , and stretched himself upon him : and the child sneezed seven times , and the child opened his eyes .
And his disciples asked him , saying , Master , who did sin , this man , or his parents , that he was born blind ?
translation.kha: Ki synran jong u ki la kylli ïa u ,  Ko Nonghikai , ka pop jongno kaba la pynlong ïa u ban kha matlah ? Hato ka dei ka pop jong u hi ne ka jong ki kmie ki kpa jong u ?

translation.en: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the  Lord   ; and , behold , he is by the altar . Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , saying , Go , fall upon him .
translation.kha: Haba ka khubor ka la poi ha u Syiem Solomon ba u Joab u la phet krad sha ka Ïingjaiñ bad ba u don harud ka duwan , u Solomon u la phah ïa u nonglamktien sha u Joab ban kylli ïa u balei ba u la phet sha ka duwan . U Joab u jubab ba u la phet krad sha U  Trai  namar ba u la sheptieng ïa u Solomon . Kumta u Syiem Solomon u la phah ïa u Benaïah ban pynïap ïa u Joab .
Haba ka sngi Pentekost ka la poi , baroh ki jingneit ki la ïalumlang ha kawei ka jaka .
translation.en: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come , they were all with one accord in one place .

translation.kha: Pha ïatip katno ngi lah ïohnong ?
translation.en: Do you know how much profit we made ?

translation.kha: Wat bishar ïa kiwei pat , khring ba U Blei un ym bishar ïa phi ,
translation.en: Judge not , that ye be not judged .

translation.kha: Ka pynstet ban phylliew ïa ka um na u khiew jyllang ka ha ka shyngoid ai um ïa ki jingri bad ka mareh sha kata ka pukri don otsher tong um shuh , rahah ba kan da dep ban ai um ïa ki ut jong u baroh .
translation.en: And she hasted , and emptied her pitcher into the trough , and ran again unto the well to draw water , and drew for all his camels .
I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body , and the visions of my head troubled me .
translation.kha: Ki jingïohipaw ki la pynsheptieng ïa nga , bad la pynwit shikatdei eh ïa nga .

Ha Jerusalem , u Jehoshaphat u thung ïa ki Lebi , ki lyngdoh bad katne katne ki riewkhmat ka shnong kum ki nongbishar ha ki kam ba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhreh ïa ka Hukum U Trai lane ki jingïakajia ba dadien ïa ka ngaiñ hapdeng ki nongshong shnong jong ka nongbah .
translation.en: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites , and of the priests , and of the chief of the fathers of Israel , for the judgment of the  Lord  , and for controversies , when they returned to Jerusalem .

And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead four hundred young virgins , that had known no man by lying with any male : and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh , which is in the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: Hapdeng ki briew ha Jabesh ki lap sawspah ngut ki theisotti , kumta ki wan ïalam ïa ki sha ka jaka shong dara ha Shiloh , kaba don ha ka ri Kanaan .

translation.en: But ye are come unto mount Sion , and unto the city of the living God , the heavenly Jerusalem , and to an innumerable company of angels ,
translation.kha: Pynban , phi la wan sha u lum Seïon bad sha ka nongbah jong U Blei uba im , ka Jerusalem kaba kynja bneng , ha kaba la don bun hajar ki angel .

translation.en: Even that it would please God to destroy me  ; that he would let loose his hand , and cut me off !
translation.kha: Lada u tang shu mon bad pynïap ïa nga !

translation.en: After these things the word of the  Lord  came unto Abram in a vision , saying , Fear not , Abram : I am thy shield , and thy exceeding great reward .
