translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Abram u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw bad ïohsngew ïa U  Trai  ba u ong ha u ,  Wat sheptieng , ko Abram . Ngan ïada ïa me na ka jingma , bad ngan ai ha me ka bainong kaba khraw .

translation.en: As the living Father hath sent me , and I live by the Father : so he that eateth me , even he shall live by me .
translation.kha: U Kpa uba im u la phah ïa nga , bad namar jong u nga ruh nga im . Ha kajuh ka rukom uno uno uba bam ïa nga un im namar jong nga .
U kitei ha ki lyndang ïa ki kum kiba ki de pun trei ha ka Templ bad u pynsngewrem ïa ki ban da lehbha ïa ki .
translation.en: And he set the priests in their charges , and encouraged them to the service of the house of the  Lord  ,

translation.kha: Nga la khmih biang , bad per la ïohsngew ïa ki angel , da ki hajar bad ki million na ki ! Ki la ïeng sawdong ka khet , ki saw tylli ki jingthaw bam-im , bad ki nongsharai balang ,
translation.en: And I beheld , and I heard the voice of many angels round about the throne and the beasts and the elders : and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand , and thousands of thousands  ;

translation.kha: Sngap , u la ong ïa ki , Ngi ïalang leit kiew sha Jerushah ha kaba ïa U Khun U Beeroth yn sa aiti ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Jin rai pynim ban pynïap ïa u malu nangta kin aiti ïa u sha ki Nethanel ,
translation.en: Saying ,  Behold , we go up to Jerusalem  ; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests , and unto the scribes  ; and they shall condemn him to death , and shall deliver him to the Gentiles :
Then one of them , which was a lawyer , asked him a question , tempting him , and saying ,
translation.kha: bad uwei na ki , u nonghikai ka Hukum , u la pyrshang ban riam ïa u da ka jingkylli .
Hynrei kine ki jaitbynriew kim tip ïa kaei kaba U Trai u don ha ka jingmut jong u . Kim sngewthuh ba la lumlang ïa ki ban shah pynshitom ha kajuh ka armet ba Wanlam ïa u kew ban shoh .
translation.en: But they know not the thoughts of the  Lord  , neither understand they his counsel : for he shall gather them as the sheaves into the floor .

translation.kha: Lada me la leh ïa kaba dei , men jin da la phuh shyrkhei ; hynrei namar ba me la leh ïa kaba sngew , ka thup ka apthap ha ka jingkhang jong me . Ka kwah ban synshar ïa me , hynrei me dei ban jop ïa ka .
translation.en: If thou doest well , shalt thou not be accepted ? and if thou doest not well , sin lieth at the door . And unto thee shall be his desire , and thou shalt rule over him .
In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood : and in thee they eat upon the mountains : in the midst of thee they commit lewdness .
translation.kha: Don na ki briew jong phi kiba ïathuh lamler shaphang kiwei khnang ban ïoh pynïap ïa ki . Don na ki , kiba bam ïa ki jingkñia ba la ai ha ki bleithaw . Don kiba sngewhun borabor ha la ki jingkwah brai .

translation.en: If I wait , the grave is mine house : I have made my bed in the darkness .
translation.kha: Ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka dei ka pyrthei kiba ïap , sha kaba ngan sa dem ban thiah ha ka jingdum .
Jamynrei shaphang kita ki angel U balui u la ong , U Blei u la pynlong ïa la ki angel koum ki reng , bad ïa ki shakri jong u kum ki thylliej ting .
translation.en: And of the angels he saith , Who maketh his angels spirits , and his ministers a flame of fire .

translation.kha: Nga bat ïa la ka kular na ka bynta ki babe ïahiar ki pateng bynriew bad nga map ïa ka jingbymman , bad ïa ka pop ; isynei , ngan pynsum ïa ki khun ki ksiew haduh ka pateng Briew kaba lai bad kaba shoh namar ki pop jong ki kmie ki kpa jong ki .
translation.en: Keeping mercy for thousands , forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin , and that will by no means clear the guilty  ; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children , and upon the children s children , unto the third and to the fourth generation .

translation.kha: Ka jingkwah bam jong u nongkyllan sngi ka pynjrong ïa u ban kham Trei shitom , namar u kwah ban pynhun ïa la ka jingthngan .
translation.en: He that laboureth laboureth for himself  ; for his mouth craveth it of him .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me , bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me , ïa kano ka ri ha kaba mynta me un-long u nongwei . Ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei kan long ka jingtyngshaiñ junom jongno ki khun ki ksew jong me ; Bad nga ngan long U Blei jongu ki .
translation.en: And I will give unto thee , and to thy seed after thee , the land wherein thou art a stranger , all the land of Canaan , for an everlasting possession  ; and I will be their God .

Egypt , and Judah , and Edom , and the children of Ammon , and Moab , and all that are in the utmost corners , that dwell in the wilderness : for all these nations are uncircumcised , and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka por ka wan haba ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew ka Ijipt , ka Judah , ka Edom , ka Ammon , ka Moab , bad ki briew ka ri shyiap , kiba la ot lyngkot ïa ki shñiuh jong ki . Kine ki briew baroh ki long kiba la otsher , hynrei ki bym shym la bat ïa ka jutang kaba ka thmu . Ym don mano mano na kine ki briew bad ym don mano mano na ki paid Israel kiba la bat ïa kane ka jutang jong nga .
Hynrei ka khubor kam ngam jylliew hapoh jong ki , sad kim neh slem . Kumta haba ka jingeh lane ka jingpynshitom beiñ ka wan namar ka khubor , thrang kumta hi ki phai dien noh .
translation.en: And have no root in themselves , and so endure but for a time : afterward , when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word s sake , immediately they are offended .
And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the  Lord  hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Me dei ban hikai ïa ki paid Israel ïa ki aiñ baroh kiba nga la ai ha me lyngba u Moses .

translation.en: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained .
translation.kha: Kine ki longïing jong ka kur Kohath ki la ïohpdiang shiphew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

Haba phi kyang ban ïoh jingïap , ai ba kito ki bleithaw jong pa kin pyllew ïa phi ! Tang Shisien pyrsad ka lyer kan rong noh ïa ki ! Khenani kito kiba shaniah ha nga kin ïoh im ha ka ri bun kin mane ïa nga ha ka Templ jong nga .
translation.en: When thou criest , let thy companies deliver thee  ; but the wind shall carry them all away  ; vanity shall take them : but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land , and shall inherit my holy mountain  ;

translation.kha: Yn don ka jingjynsur bad ka jingpang na ka bynta kito baroh naba imat ïa kaei kaba sniew , na ka pyntwa ki Jiw nyngkong bad na ka bniat ki Jentil ruh .
translation.en: Tribulation and anguish , upon every soul of man that doeth evil , of the Jew first , and also of the Gentile ;
But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished . This is the first resurrection .
translation.kha: ( Kiba sah na kiba ïap kim shym la im pat tad ynda ki shihajar snem ki la kut . ) Kane ka dei ka jingpynmihpat kaba nyngkong ïa kiba ïap .
Berakah ki parabangeit hangne ki phah ka jingkhublei . To jingkhublei iwei ïa Uei da ka jingïadoh phlangïap .
translation.en: All the brethren greet you . Greet ye one another with an holy kiss .

translation.kha: Na bnai , ha kaba me shong , sngap ïa u bad leh ïa kiei katba u kyrpad ïa me ba leh , khnang ba baroh ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei kin tip ïa me bad kohnguh ïa me main ki pangnud Israel ki leh . Te kin tip ba kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la twa kan hir ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa me .
translation.en: Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and do according to all that the stranger calleth to thee for : that all people of the earth may know thy name , to fear thee , as do thy people Israel  ; and that they may know that this house , which I have builded , is called by thy name .
For the  Lord  saw the affliction of Israel , that it was very bitter : for there was not any shut up , nor any left , nor any helper for Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïohi ïa ka jingshitom kaba jur jong ki Israel ; ym don mano mano ruh ban ïarap ïa ki .

translation.en: For the Jews require a sign , and the Greeks seek after wisdom :
translation.kha: Ki Jiw ki kwah ïa ki kambah kum ka sakhi , bad ki Grik ki wad ïa ka jingstad .

translation.en: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the  Lord  thy God , of the flock and the herd , in the place which the  Lord  shall choose to place his name there .
translation.kha: Leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei kaba U  Trai  un jied , bad kñia hangta kawei ka langbrot lane kawei ka masi jong phi na ka bynta ka Niam Ka Jinglait khnang ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
Baalis , A Blei , me shahïap ba yn kha ïa nga ? Nga la dei ban ïap ha shuwa ba uno uno un ïohi ïa nga !
translation.en: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb ? Oh that I had given up the ghost , and no eye had seen me !
For now I will stretch out my hand , that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence  ; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth .
translation.kha: Lada nga la rah ïa la ka kti bad shoh ïa me bad ki briew jong me da ka jingpang , phin jin da la ïap lut khoit .

translation.en: Wherefore the well was called Beer–lahai–roi  ; behold , it is between Kadesh and Bered .
translation.kha: Dei namar kata ba ki briew ki khot kyrteng ïa ka pukri hapdeng ka Kadesh bad ka Bered  Ka Pukri jong Uta Uba Im Uba Ïohi Ïa Nga .

translation.en: And a great multitude followed him , because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased .
translation.kha: U paidbah byllien u la bud ïa u , namar ba ki la ïohi ïa ki kambah jong u ha kaba pynkhiah ïa kito kiba pang .
Baroh ki brisoh ki la dap da ka jingkmen , bad ka nongjop ka kynjah , naba mynta la pynïap ïa ka Athalaïah ha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And all the people of the land rejoiced , and the city was in quiet : and they slew Athaliah with the sword beside the king s house .

translation.kha: Un wan bad pynïap ïa pli ki Rangbah , mala un ai ïa ka bri sohwaiñ ha kiwei pat ki nongshimwai . Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la ong , Ym kumta keiñ !
translation.en: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen , and shall give the vineyard to others .  And when they heard it , they said , God forbid .

Yea , the  Lord  will answer and say unto his people , Behold , I will send you corn , and wine , and oil , and ye shall be satisfied therewith : and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen :
translation.kha: U la jubab ïa ki :  Mynta ngan ai ïa phi u kew bad ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib , bad phin long kiba la sngewhun . Kiwei ki jaitbynriew kin ym ñiewbeiñ shuh ïa phi .
Bad kumin , kum ka burom ïa ka kyrteng U Ujuh baroh ki jingthaw ha bneng , ha pyrthat bad ha ka pyrthei hapoh kyang dem khrup ha ki khohsiew jyllang ki ,
translation.en: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow , of things in heaven , and things in earth , and things under the earth ;

translation.kha: Lada mei mano , u briew ne ka brup , u ban leit shad ka jaka ba kham shahjop ka phyllaw u syiem bad leit ïakohnguh ïa u khlem shah khot , un ïap . Kata ka dei ka aiñ ; naduh ki nongai jingmut u syiem haduh ki riewpaidbah jong ki jylla , ki tip ïa kata . Ka don tang kawei ka lynti ban lait na kane ka aiñ : lada u syiem u pyn-i ïa u diengsynshar ksiar ïatan ïaineh , tang kata ka ban pyllut im ïa uta u briew . Hynrei ka la long mynta shi bnai ba u syiem u la phah khot ïa nga .
translation.en: All the king s servants , and the people of the king s provinces , do know , that whosoever , whether man or woman , shall come unto the king into the inner court , who is not called , there is one law of his to put him to death , except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre , that he may live : but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ïa ki synran jong u , Balah ba phi sheptieng ? Hato phim pat kein jingiw satia ?
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Why are ye so fearful ? how is it that ye have no faith ?

translation.kha: Te mynta , ko ka kynhun jong nga ; ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga ïathuh ha phi ba kan bishar ïa khawai pa kawei na phi dara lang pynkhlad ïa kiba bha na naba sniew , ïa ki Langbrot na ki blang .
translation.en: And as for you , O my flock , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I judge between cattle and cattle , between the rams and the he goats .

translation.kha: Kumta ki ai ïa phim ki jingbthah mala ki phah ïa ki shaei baroh ha Jerusalem bad kiwei pat ki nongjop bad ki shnongrit : kiei wait sha ki lut bad pom ïa ki tnat na ki dieng Kseh , ki dieng Elul , ki dieng Martl , ki dien Tlai bad kiwei ki dieng , Ban shna ïingtrep kat kum ki jingbthah ba la thoh ha ka Hukum .
translation.en: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities , and in Jerusalem , saying , Go forth unto the mount , and fetch olive branches , and pine branches , and myrtle branches , and palm branches , and branches of thick trees , to make booths , as it is written .

translation.kha: Mynta stong , kane ka briew ka hiarpateng na u Abraham ïa kaba u Soitan u la khum la khatphra snem ; hato ym dei ban pyllun ïa ka ha ka sngi Sabdi ?
translation.en: And ought not this woman , being a daughter of Abraham , whom Satan hath bound , lo , these eighteen years , be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day ?

And David lifted up his eyes , and saw the angel of the  Lord  stand between the earth and the heaven , having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem . Then David and the elders of Israel , who were clothed in sackcloth , fell upon their faces .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohi ïa u angel uba ïeng ha shiteng suiñ , u da bat ïa la ka waitlam ha la ka kti , uba la pynkhreh ban pynjot thiaw ïa ka Jerusalem . Nangta u Dabid bad ki nongïalam jong ki paidbah — baroh na ki , kiba la phong ki jaiñ khain — ki dem pynrit , bad la ki khlieh kiba kynduh ha madan .
Nangta U Jisu u la ktah ïa ki khmat jong ki bad u la ong , Ai ba kan jia long , te , kumba phi bieit ! —
translation.en: Then touched he their eyes , saying ,  According to your faith be it unto you .
These four were born to the giant in Gath , and fell by the hand of David , and by the hand of his servants .
translation.kha: Kine saw ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong ki ramhah ka Gath , bad ki la shah pynïap ha u Dabid bad ha ki rangbah jong u .
Un long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba duh noh ïa ki soh ki bym patiaw ih ; koum u Dieng Abib uba hap noh ki shylluit .
translation.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine , and shall cast off his flower as the olive .

translation.kha: Kam hir ka jingryntih ïa ine ban leit shapoh ka nongbah Naamah ngin sa iohpateng Haneng , hynrei lada ngi Shong hangne , ïong ïap kumjuh . Kumta , ïa jing ïaleit noh sha ka jaka shong dara ki Syria ; kaba sniew tam ba ki lah ïa-ban leh ka long ba kin pynïap ïa ngi , hynrei lehse kin pyllait im ïa ngi .
translation.en: If we say , We will enter into the city , then the famine is in the city , and we shall die there : and if we sit still here , we die also . Now therefore come , and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians : if they save us alive , we shall live  ; and if they kill us , we shall but die .

translation.kha: Eliada ki dei da shaid ki ïathuhlypa bad salia ki don ïa ka khubor jong nga , shah ïa ki ban kylli ïa nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , ban ym shah ïa ki jingkynshew babha to ha ka Tubal bad ha ka jingïamai ban shah rah sha Babilonia .
translation.en: But if they be prophets , and if the word of the  Lord  be with them , let them now make intercession to the  Lord  of hosts , that the vessels which are left in the house of the  Lord  , and in the house of the king of Judah , and at Jerusalem , go not to Babylon .

translation.kha: Kumta la pynmih ïa ka lawbah na ka bniat jong ki barabor baneh shah pynïap , kynthup ïa u Daniel bad ki paralok jong u .
translation.en: And the decree went forth that the wise men should be slain  ; and they sought Daniel and his fellows to be slain .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki jubab , Ngi don ba-shiphew shah ki jingtip halor u syiem kumba phi , phi! don , wat la u dei uwei na phi . Balei phi khmih pien ïa ngi ? wah klet ba ngi dei kiba nyngkong ban ïakren shaphrang ka jingwallam patiaw ïa u syiem ! Khenani ki pynbah ka Judah ki kham pyneh ha kaba pynkup ïa ki jingkam jong ki ban ïa ki nongbah ka Israel .
translation.en: And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah , and said , We have ten parts in the king , and we have also more right in David than ye : why then did ye despise us , that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king ? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel .

translation.kha: U phiah ïa ka jingpang ha shuwa jong u bad hukum ba ka jingïap tista bud ïa u .
translation.en: Before him went the pestilence , and burning coals went forth at his feet .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba lehhok kan ïoh ka jingim kob kyrhai bad kaba suk . Hynrei lada phi long kyrkieh ban riewspah , phin ym lait na kaba shah pynshitom .
translation.en: A faithful man shall abound with blessings : but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent .

translation.kha: Ngan jat ïa u lyngdoh u ban kohnguh ïa nga mala kuna ïa kata baroh Kaba nga kwah ïa u . Ngan ai ha u ki khun ki ksiew ki ban ïai sharak ha khmat u syiem uba la jied jong nga .
translation.en: And I will raise me up a faithful priest , that shall do according to that which is in mine heart and in my mind : and I will build him a sure house  ; and he shall walk before mine anointed for ever .
And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead , and took it , and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it .
translation.kha: Ka kur u Makhir u khun jong u Manasseh ka la hiarthma ïa ka ri Gilead , bad ka la ïohknieh ïa ka , bad beh krad ïa ki Amor kiba don hangta .
ngiam nang kumno ban pynthor , bad U Blei shem un pynshitom ïa nga “lada at leh kumta .
translation.en: For I know not to give flattering titles  ; in so doing my maker would soon take me away .

translation.kha: ïa kaba u la shim bad bam ha khmat jongno ki .
translation.en: And he took it , and did eat before them .

translation.kha: U du U Briew u la wan ban wad bad ban pynrem ïa kiba la jah noh .
translation.en: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost .

translation.kha: katjuh Katno ki leit da ka liengbah halor ka duriaw-bah , ki trei na ka bynta ka jingim jong ki ha ki duriaw-rit .
translation.en: They that go down to the sea in ships , that do business in great waters  ;

translation.kha: Ki Israel kiba hapoh ka nongbah mynta ki wan hiar ban ïasoh lem ha ka thnam . Kumta ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki syiem ïa lade! ba ki la shah kerkut ha ki Israel , bad ba ki la shah pynïap lut . Ym don uwei ruh wahbah wai im , bad ym dat uwei ruh umbah lait na kata lait tang u syiem jrong ka Ai .
translation.en: And the other issued out of the city against them  ; so they were in the midst of Israel , some on this side , and some on that side : and they smote them , so that they let none of them remain or escape .
This is he of whom I said , After me cometh a man which is preferred before me : for he was before me .
translation.kha: Une u long uta ïa uba nga la kren mynba nga la ong , ‘ U briew uba wan hadien jong nga , hynrei u long uba kham khraw ban ïa nga , namar u la don shuwa ban kha ïa nga .’

translation.en: Behold , with a great plague will the  Lord  smite thy people , and thy children , and thy wives , and all thy goods :
translation.kha: Namar kata , U  Trai  un pynshitom tyngeh ïa ki briew jong me , ïa ki khun jong me , bad ïa ki tnga jong me , bad un pynjot thiaw ïa ki jingdon jingem jong me .
Ha kawei ka por , u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah u la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad u Ahasaïah u syiem ka Israel , kiba la ar bun kiei kiei kiba sniew .
translation.en: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Judah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel , who did very wickedly :

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jingïapan dor bad phi ha ka kyrteng jongnga u patsha . Ngan ai ha phi ar hajar ki kulai lada phi lah ban pynïoh katta ngut ki briew ban shong ha ki !
translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria , and I will deliver thee two thousand horses , if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them .

translation.kha: Ki la shim ïa ka na ka Ïing jong u Anab kaba don halor lam , bad ki buh ïa ka ha ka kali thymmai . U Ussah bad u Ahio , ki khun shynrang jong u Abinadab , ki lam lynti ïa ka kada ,
translation.en: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart , and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah : and Uzza and Ahio , the sons of Abinadab , drave the new cart .

translation.kha: Un wallam ïa ka khleiñ lem mala ka shadem lad u nard pun ai kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U Tharai .
translation.en: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , the fat with the breast , it shall he bring , that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the  Lord .
And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah , and built Ramah , that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah .
translation.kha: U Baasha u hiarthma ïa ka Judah bad u tei pynskhem ïa ka Ramah khnang ban ym shah ïa ka leit ka wan sha Judah .

Shu pdiang ba phasi la bastang bad ba pha la ïeng ïaleh pynshisha ïa U Trai , U Blei jong pha . To phla ba haduh uwei pa uei u dieng bajyrngam pha la ai ïa la ka jingtei ha ki beit nongwei pynlang ba pham shyiap la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga . Ma nga , U Trai , at la kren .
translation.en: Only acknowledge thine iniquity , that thou hast transgressed against the  Lord  thy God , and hast scattered thy ways to the strangers under every green tree , and ye have not obeyed my voice , saith the  Lord .
I will say of the  Lord  , He is my refuge and my fortress : my God  ; in him will I trust .
translation.kha: u lah ban ong ha u ,  Me long u nongkyrshan bad nongïada jong nga , me long U Blei jong nga ; ha me nga shaniah .

translation.en: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus , and of the love which ye have to all the saints ,
translation.kha: Naba ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu bad ïa ka jingieit jong phi ïa ki briew baroh ki jong U Blei .

translation.en: Behold , I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them , and will return your recompence upon your own head :
translation.kha: Mynta ngan wallam pat ïa ki na ki jaka na kiba ki la shah die . Ngan leh ïa phi ïa kaei kaba phi la leh ïa ki .
Ki la nang ha Ephesos , ha kaba u Paul u la iehnoh ïa ka Priskila mala ïa u Akwila . U la leit sha ka synagog bad u la pynlong ka jingïaphylliew jingot badno ki Jia .
translation.en: And he came to Ephesus , and left them there : but he himself entered into the synagogue , and reasoned with the Jews .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingsuki , u Tom u iathuh ia nga ba ngam dei ban wan shuh ha iing jong u .
translation.en: In fact , Tom told me never to come back to his house again .

translation.kha: Ka jingrkhie ka lah ban buhrieh ïa ka jingkhuslai . Haba ka jingkmen ka la ja , ka jingsngewthuh ka dang ïadie don hangno .
translation.en: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful  ; and the end of that mirth is heaviness .

translation.kha: To tep ïa ki dkhot thoh kiba kynsai tam — ki tyrkhong bad ki kjat — pyndap ïa u ruh da ki kyrkhoit shyieng ba la jied .
translation.en: Gather the pieces thereof into it , even every good piece , the thigh , and the shoulder  ; fill it with the choice bones .

translation.kha: Ha kane hi ka sngew u la leit ai jingbna da shibun ki masi , ki langbrot , bad ki khun smai ba la pynsngaid . U la khiat sngewbha ïa ki khun shynrang jong phi borbah , ïa u Joah u ïabah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong phi , bad ïa u Abiathar u lyngdoh , bad Myntan hi ki sdang ïabam ïadih bad u bad ki pyrthat , ‘ Im slem Syiem Adnah !’
translation.en: For he is gone down this day , and hath slain oxen and fat cattle and sheep in abundance , and hath called all the king s sons , and the captains of the host , and Abiathar the priest  ; and , behold , they eat and drink before him , and say , God save king Adonijah .
And out of the half tribe of Manasseh , Taanach with her suburbs , and Gath–rimmon with her suburbs  ; two cities .
translation.kha: Na ka jaka jong ka Manasseh ba sha Sepngi , la ai ar tylli ki nongbah : ka Taanakh bad ka Gathrimmon , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: And the king , and all Israel with him , offered sacrifice before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon bad ki paidbah baroh hangta ki kñia ki jingainguh ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And Isaac said unto Jacob , Come near , I pray thee , that I may feel thee , my son , whether thou be my very son Esau or not .
translation.kha: U Isaak u ong ïa u Jakob ,  Sngewbha wan kham hajan , ba ngan da ïohktah ïa phi . Hato phi dei shisha u Iso ?
Ynda U Trai u wan ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti , phna pynbna ïa ka jingtyrkhong nalor u lum Gerisim pynlang ïa sier ka jingjngem nalor u lum Ebal .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when the  Lord  thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it , that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim , and the curse upon mount Ebal .
Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow , and against him that lifteth himself up in his brigandine : and spare ye not her young men  ; destroy ye utterly all her host .
translation.kha: Wat ai por ïa ki shipai ban siat ïa ki khnam ne kieng ïa ki atiar ïaleh jong ki . Wat pyllait ïa ki samla shynrang ! Pynjot ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei !
lymne ki la ïoh jinghikai ïa ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei .
translation.en: There is no fear of God before their eyes .

translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshem : Ngi kren ïa kaei ka ngi tip bad ngi ïathaw ïa katei kiba ngi la ïohi , pynban , ym don na phi uba mon ban pdiang ïa ka khubor jyllang ngi .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto thee , We speak that we do know , and testify that we have seen  ; and ye receive not our witness .

translation.kha: Haba ki khun jong phi ki kylli ïa phi , ‘ Ka mih Aïu Kane ka jinglehniam ?’
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when your children shall say unto you , What mean ye by this service ?

translation.kha: U briew uba don ha ka lyngkha um dei ban phai dien ban leit shim ïa ka jaiñkup jong u .
translation.en: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes .

translation.kha: Mano ba la ban ïathuh ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba khraw kba u la leh ? Me ba lah ban ïaroh ïa u kumba dei biah ?
translation.en: Who can utter the mighty acts of the  Lord  ? who can shew forth all his praise ?
And the  Lord  turned the captivity of Job , when he prayed for his friends : also the  Lord  gave Job twice as much as he had before .
translation.kha: Nangta , hadien ba u Job u la duwai na ka bynta ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u , U  Trai  u la pynriewspah biang ïa u bad u la ai ha u ar shah ban ïa kaba u la don mynshuwa .
Ko ki kynthei , to pyndem ha la ki tnga , kumba ha U Trai .
translation.en: Wives , submit yourselves unto your own husbands , as unto the Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la bitar ïa u Salmon , bun u la ong ha u , Namar ba me la leh khnang ban pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang ba me la ïateh bad nga nabar ba mut kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong ar , na kular ban shim noh ïa ka hima na me mala ngan ai ha uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong me .
translation.en: Wherefore the  Lord  said unto Solomon , Forasmuch as this is done of thee , and thou hast not kept my covenant and my statutes , which I have commanded thee , I will surely rend the kingdom from thee , and will give it to thy servant .

translation.kha: U Sadok u lyngdoh u la to hangta , bad ryngkat bad u la ni ki Lebi kiba bah ïa ka syndah ka Jutang Kaba kyntang . Ki la pynpyiar ïa ka bad kim shym la rah shuh tad haduh ba ki briew baroh kin da mihnoh na ka nongbah . U Anaharath , u lyngdoh u la don lang Haneng .
translation.en: And lo Zadok also , and all the Levites were with him , bearing the ark of the covenant of God : and they set down the ark of God  ; and Abiathar went up , until all the people had done passing out of the city .

translation.kha: Bad ma phi ki Israel phi ïong , ‘ Kaei kaba U Trai u leh ka long ka bym dei .’ Phi pyrkhat ba ka lynñiar jong nga kam shym long kaba dei , thah ym daiñ kumta ? Ka dei ka lynnong jong phi ka bym hir kaba dei .
translation.en: Yet saith the house of Israel , The way of the Lord is not equal . O house of Israel , are not my ways equal ? are not your ways unequal ?

And Moses spake unto the children of Israel , and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece , for each prince one , according to their fathers  houses , even twelve rods : and the rod of Aaron was among their rods .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la kren ha ki Israel , bad uwei pa uwei na ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la ai ha u mar uwei u diengduh , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jait , baroh ki long khat-ar tylli , bad ïa u diengduh jong u Aaron la buh lem bad ki .

wahbah u wan , un sa synshar ïa la ki briew da ka jingkhlaiñ kaba wan na U Trai dara da ka burom jong U Trai U Balei hi . Ki briew jong u kin shong ha ka jingshngain ñiar ki brisoh na kylleng ka pyrthei kin ithuh ïa ka jingkhraw jongno u , bad un wanrah ïa ka jingsuk .
translation.en: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the  Lord  , in the majesty of the name of the  Lord  his God  ; and they shall abide : for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth .

translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u don saw hajar thylli ki sem kulai na ka boitha ki kali ïalam bad ki kulai jongu u , bad u don khatphra hajar tylli ki kulai tdem . Katto katne na ki u bsuh ha Israel bad ïa kiba sah u buh ha kiwei pat ki nongbah .
translation.en: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots , and twelve thousand horsemen  ; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities , and with the king at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Kito kiba longkmie bymïap kat kum ka jingsngem bad ki bym pynkhuid ïa lade ki ïailong ki bymkhuid , namar ba ym shym la synreit ïa ka um ka jingpynkhuid halor jong ki . Ki pynjngut ïa ka Ïingjaiñ U Trai bad yn ym ñiewkor shuh ïa ki kum ki briew jong U Blei .
translation.en: But the man that shall be unclean , and shall not purify himself , that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation , because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the  Lord  : the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him  ; he is unclean .
He shall build an house for my name  ; and he shall be my son , and I will be his father  ; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever .
translation.kha: Un tei ïa ka Templ na ka bynta jong nga . Un long u khun jong nga bad ngan long u kpa jong u . Ka longïing syiem jong u kan synshar ïa ka Israel junom .’

translation.en: I advised Tom not to waste his time trying to do that .
translation.kha: Nga ai-jingmut ia u Tom ba un ym pynlut por ban leh ia kato .

translation.en: And when they were assembled with the elders , and had taken counsel , they gave large money unto the soldiers ,
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ïakynduh ïa ki tymmen ki san bad ki la ïathaw buit ; ki la ai shibun ka pisa ïa ki shipai ,
Ki briew kiba leh jubor ki shukor ïa la ki paralok bad ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingjot .
translation.en: A violent man enticeth his neighbour , and leadeth him into the way that is not good .
And afterward Moses and Aaron went in , and told Pharaoh , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Let my people go , that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha u Pharaoh , bad ki la ong ,  U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong , ‘ Shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban leit , khnang ba kin ïoh pynlong ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam ha ka ri shyiap ban pyndonburom ïa nga .’

translation.en: But Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  besides , that we might enquire of him ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Jehoshaphat u kylli ,  Hato ym don sa uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa ïa uba ngin kylli ïa U  Trai  ?
Nangta ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong u Adonijah ki la sheptieng , bad baroh ki la ïeng joit malu leit noh , ti uwei ha la ka lynnong .
translation.en: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid , and rose up , and went every man his way .

translation.kha: Lada phi dei uba khlaiñ bam , da synshar babha ïa lade .
translation.en: And put a knife to thy throat , if thou be a man given to appetite .

translation.kha: Ai ba baroh kiba manna ïa u kin ong , Ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: Let them now that fear the  Lord  say , that his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Kainan ki long ki hukum ïa kiba U Trai u la ai ha phi baroh mynbarim phi ïalumlang ha uta u lum . U la kren da ka sur kaba donbor napdeng kata ka ding bad u lyoh uba rben , mynba u ai ïa ki ha phi khlem da bynrap ïa kiwei pat . Nangta u thoh ïa ki ha ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap bad u ai ïa ki ha nga .
translation.en: These words the  Lord  spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire , of the cloud , and of the thick darkness , with a great voice : and he added no more . And he wrote them in two tables of stone , and delivered them unto me .
My beloved is white and ruddy , the chiefest among ten thousand .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit jong phi ka pynkmen ïa nga , ko ba-ieit thep mynsiem bad ko nongleitkurim jong nga . Ka jingieit jong phi ka kham bha ban ïa ka waiñ ; ka jingsleh jong phi ka kham iwbih ban ïa uno uno u musla .
U pynjam ïa ki na kito kiba shun ïa ki ; u pyllait ïa ki na ki nongsuhjaiñ jong ki .
translation.en: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them , and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy .

translation.kha: U Eli u la khoit ïa u , Ko Samuel , ko khun jong nga ! Oi , kynrad , u Samuel u jubab .
translation.en: Then Eli called Samuel , and said , Samuel , my son . And he answered , Here am I .
And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam , and took cities from him , Beth–el with the towns thereof , and Jeshanah with the towns thereof , and Ephrain with the towns thereof .
translation.kha: U Abijah u beh kthong ïa ka kynhun shipai u Jeroboam bad u ïohknieh katto katne na ki nongbah jong u : ka Bethel , ka Jeshanah , bad ka Ephron , bad ki nongrit kiba hajan jong kine ki nongbah .

Ïa ki metïap yn pynsaphriang hapdeng ki bleithaw bad sawdong ki duwan , yn pynsaphriang hajir uwei pa uwei u lum uba jongu , ha kliar uwei pa uwei u lumbah , ha thad imat pa uwei u dieng jyrngam bad uwei pa uwei u dieng Sning uba heh , ha ki jaka baroh ba ki thang ïa ki jingkñia ïa ki bleithaw jong ki .
translation.en: Then shall ye know that I am the  Lord  , when their slain men shall be among their idols round about their altars , upon every high hill , in all the tops of the mountains , and under every green tree , and under every thick oak , the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols .

Then said Jehu to Bidkar his captain , Take up , and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite : for remember how that , when I and thou rode together after Ahab his father , the  Lord  laid this burden upon him  ;
translation.kha: bad u Jehu u ong ha u Bidkar , u nongbud jong u ,  Shim bret ïa ka met jong u ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Naboth . Phi kynmaw ba mynba ma phi bad ma nga ngi dang ïabud ha la ki kulai nadien u Ahab , u kpa jong u syiem Joram , U  Trai  u la kren ïa kine ki ktien pyrshah ïa u Ahab :

translation.en: Hear , all ye people  ; hearken , O earth , and all that therein is : and let the Lord  God  be witness against you , the Lord from his holy temple .
translation.kha: To sngew ïa kane , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh ; to sngap ïa kane , ko phi kiba im ha ka pyrthei ! U  Trai  Nongsynshar un sakhi pyrshah ïa phi . To shahshkor ! U kren na ka templ ba kynja bneng .
Haba ki la hiar na ka lyngki , mar kumta hi , ki briew ki la ithuh ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And when they were come out of the ship , straightway they knew him ,

translation.kha: Don katba la kylli ïa u , Ko Kynrad , haw tang khyndiat ngut ki briew ki ba-bang loit im ?
translation.en: Then said one unto him , Lord , are there few that be saved ? And he said unto them ,
But the high places were not removed : nevertheless Asa s heart was perfect with the  Lord  all his days .
translation.kha: Wat la u Asa um shym la pynjot lut ïa ki jaka mane blei thala baroh , u ïaineh ha U  Trai  katba u dang im .
dien ban Lied noh ïa ka , bad ïa ki maw , ki dieng , bad ka sorki jong ka baroh dei ban kit shalor shnong bad phret ha ka jaka theh ñiut .
translation.en: And he shall break down the house , the stones of it , and the timber thereof , and all the mortar of the house  ; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place .

And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi , Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land , among the Canaanites and the Perizzites : and I being few in number , they shall gather themselves together against me , and slay me  ; and I shall be destroyed , I and my house .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u ong ha u Simeon bad ha u Lebi ,  Phi la pynjynjar ïa nga ; ki Kanaan bad ki Peris , bad kat kiba don ha kane ka ri , mynta kin sa shun ïa nga . Ngam dei uba bun paid ; lada ki ïa-tylli lang kawei pyrshah ïa nga , bad ki ïaleh ïa nga , ma nga bad ka ïing jong nga baroh ngin sa shah pynjot .

translation.en: He smote their vines also and their fig trees  ; and brake the trees of their coasts .
translation.kha: u la pynjot ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ jong ki bad ïa ki dieng Dumbur bad u la pynkheiñ ïa baroh ki dieng .

translation.en: By Silvanus , a faithful brother unto you , as I suppose , I have written briefly , exhorting , and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand .
translation.kha: Nga thoh ha phi ïa kane ka shithi kaba lyngkot da ka jingïarap u Silas , ïa uba nga ñiew kum u para Khristan baïaineh . Nga kwah ban pynshlur ïa phi bad ban ai ïa ka jingphla jong nga ba kane ka dei ka jingaiei bashisha jong U Blei . To ïeng skhem ha ka .
U Trai u la kren biang ha nga .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
And the  Lord  commanded us to do all these statutes , to fear the  Lord  our God , for our good always , that he might preserve us alive , as it is at this day .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la ong ïa ngi ban kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh bad ban tiengburom ïa u , na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ngi ba un ri pynim ïa ngi kumba ha kane ka sngi .

Na ka bynta ka jingpynksan , ki ai shispah tylli ki mangi kyrtong , arsien ki langbrot , bad sawspah tylli ki khunlangbrot kum ki jingainguh thang , pynlang kharai tylli ki blang kum ki jingnguh ïa ka pop , uwei na ka bynta kawei ka jait ki Israel .
translation.en: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks , two hundred rams , four hundred lambs  ; and for a sin offering for all Israel , twelve he goats , according to the number of the tribes of Israel .
For the tabernacle of the  Lord  , which Moses made in the wilderness , and the altar of the burnt offering , were at that season in the high place at Gibeon .
translation.kha: Ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong U  Trai  kaba u Moses u la thaw ha ka ri khlaw , bad ka duwan ha kaba la thang ïa ki jingkñia ka dang don ha ka jaka mane ha Gibeon ha kane ka por ;
Bad ynda u la kut jingmut ban pynïap ïa la U Khun ha nga , khnang ba nga lah ngab ïalap ïa ka kyrhuh babha shaïong jong u ha ki Jentil , ngam shym la leit wad buit nala nano ,
translation.en: To reveal his Son in me , that I might preach him among the heathen ; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood :

translation.kha: U Barak u jubab , Ngan leit lada phin sien pyntud bad nga ; hynriewphew lada phim lytar bad nga , nga ruh nur ym leit .
translation.en: And Barak said unto her , If thou wilt go with me , then I will go : but if thou wilt not go with me , then I will not go .
Why is my pain perpetual , and my wound incurable , which refuseth to be healed ? wilt thou be altogether unto me as a liar , and as waters that fail ?
translation.kha: Balei nga dei ban ïaishah shitom ? Balei ba ki jingmynsaw jong nga ym lah ban pynkoit ? Balei ba kim koit ? Hato me thmu ban pynnoh mynsiem ïa nga kum ka wahduid kaba ryngkhiang ha ka por lyiur ?
Ka wan phad pang sha ka lieng , bad u Noah u kner ïa la ka ki , bad u rah ïa ka bashapoh .
translation.en: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot , and she returned unto him into the ark , for the waters were on the face of the whole earth : then he put forth his hand , and took her , and pulled her in unto him into the ark .

translation.kha: Ïa ka kotbah ym pat shym la tei na ka pyntwa U Trai , bad kumta ki briew ki dang ai ki jingkñia ha ki duwan ba-iwbih bapher .
translation.en: Only the people sacrificed in high places , because there was no house built unto the name of the  Lord  , until those days .

I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel : speak unto them , saying , At even ye shall eat flesh , and in the morning ye shall be filled with bread  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingkhñium jong ki Israel . Ïathuh ïa ki ba ynda la kem ïongreiñ kin sa ïoh ka doh ban bam , bad ha ka por mynstep kin sa ïoh u kpu uba ki kwah . Te kin tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  nga long U Blei jong ki .
Hynrei ïa ka doh Bad ïa ka snieh u thang shabar ka jaka shong dara .
translation.en: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp .

translation.kha: ban ym shuh pynshaïong jingdum da kaba Suk ha ka jingpynkoit jong phi lane ban shah pynkhuslai da ka jingkam ba ka Sngi jong U Trai ka la lah wan . Lehse ka long ba la mut ba ngi la ong ïa kane kaba im’ dang ïathuhlypa lin ïalap , lin ba i la thoh ïa ka ha ka shithi .
translation.en: That ye be not soon shaken in mind , or be troubled , neither by spirit , nor by word , nor by letter as from us , as that the day of Christ is at hand .

translation.kha: Lehsbun bad lehhok bad phyrnai im slem ; kiwei kin barhem ïa phi bad kin lehbha ïa phi .
translation.en: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life , righteousness , and honour .

translation.kha: Haba phi ïohi ïa kane ba ka jia , phin sa shongman ; kan pynlong ïa phi ban longsem khlaiñ bad khie krat . Te phin sa tipbriew ba ma nga , U Trai , nga ïarap ïa kito kiba kohnguh ïa nga , bad nga pyn-i ïa la ka jingbitar pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jongno ar .
translation.en: And when ye see this , your heart shall rejoice , and your bones shall flourish like an herb : and the hand of the  Lord  shall be known toward his servants , and his indignation toward his enemies .
For her house inclineth unto death , and her paths unto the dead .
translation.kha: Lada phi leit sha ka ïing jong ka , phi ïaid ha ka lynti sha ka jingïap . Ban leit shata ka long ban tur sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .

Te U Trai U Blei u la pynurlong ïa u jingthrang ban san kham jrong ïa u Jonah khnang ban ai ïa u katto katne ka jingktah syrngiew , khnang ba un kham tngen . U Jonah u la sngewkmen shibun ïa u jingiwtung .
translation.en: And the  Lord  God prepared a gourd , and made it to come up over Jonah , that it might be a shadow over his head , to deliver him from his grief . So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd .
But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise ; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty ;
translation.kha: U Blei u la jied khnang ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka kheiñ ba ka long kaba ibieit khnang ban pynlehrain ïa kiba stad , bad u la jied ïa kaei kaba ka pyrthei ka kheiñ ba ka long kaba tlot khnang ban pynlehrain ïa kiba donbor .

translation.en: Them also king David dedicated unto the  Lord  , with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations  ; from Edom , and from Moab , and from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines , and from Amalek .
translation.kha: U syiem Dabid u pynkyntang ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingmane , ryngkat bad ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba u la kurup na ki jaitbynriew kiba u la jop — ki Edom , ki Moab , ki Ammon , ki Philistia bad ki Amalek .

translation.en: And where is now my hope ? as for my hope , who shall see it ?
translation.kha: Hangno ka don ka jingkyrmen jong nga ? Mano ba ïohi ïa nga ?
( U rangbah nongap jingri jong u Saul , u Doeg uba na Amon , da kaban jia ryngkhat u ni hangamei ha kata ka sngi , namar u hap ban pyndep ïa ka kamram lehniam . )
translation.en: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day , detained before the  Lord   ; and his name was Doeg , an Edomite , the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul .
And the fourth , Adonijah the son of Haggith  ; and the fifth , Shephatiah the son of Abital  ;
translation.kha: u Adonijah , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Haggith ; u Shephataïah , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abital ;

translation.en: Blessed are ye , when men shall revile you , and persecute you , and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely , for my sake .
translation.kha: Suk ma phi haba ki briew ki krenbeiñ bad pynshitom beiñ ïa phi , bad ong bun jait ki jinglamler basniew pyrshah ïa phi namar ba phi long ki nongbud jong nga .

translation.en: Judge not , that ye be not judged .
translation.kha: Wat bishar ïa kiwei pat , khnang ba U Blei un ym bishar ïa phi ,
Bad mynta pat , to U Trai un lehsbun malu ïaineh skhem bad phi . Nga umdih ngan lehbha ïa phi namar kaei kaba Phin la leh .
translation.en: And now the  Lord  shew kindness and truth unto you : and I also will requite you this kindness , because ye have done this thing .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ïa ki pharshi lad U Jisu bad ki la tip ba u la kren Shaphan jong ki ,
translation.en: And when the chief priests and Pharisees had heard his parables , they perceived that he spake of them .

translation.kha: To bret noh ïa baroh’ ka jingkhang mynsiem , ka jingkwah brai mala ka jingbitar . Ken ne ka jingkaw kew , lane ka jingkrenbeiñ bad keiñ noh ki jingsngew dum la ha kano kano ka rukom .
translation.en: Let all bitterness , and wrath , and anger , and clamour , and evil speaking , be put away from you , with all malice :

translation.kha: Kane ka long kai kaba U Trai u la ïa-ong sanphew u patsha Assyria : ‘ Un ym ïongreiñ ha kane ka nongbah lane siat ïa uwei u khnam pyrthuh ïa ka . Yn ym don ki shipai lym malade ki stet ki ban wan hajan ka nongbah , bad yn ym don ka kynton ba la tei ha sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  concerning the king of Assyria , He shall not come into this city , nor shoot an arrow there , nor come before it with shields , nor cast a bank against it .

translation.kha: Haba ki bajaipdeh ki la ïohi ba U Jisu ne ki synran jong u kim don hangta , ki la kiew ha i'u ki lyndang bad ki la leit sha khapnoh ban wad ïa u .
translation.en: When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there , neither his disciples , they also took shipping , and came to Capernaum , seeking for Jesus .
And they were instant with loud voices , requiring that he might be crucified . And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la ïai pyrta da ka sur kaba jam eh ba ïa U Jisu dei ban sahnarphna , bad khatduh ka jingpyrta jong ki ka la jop .
Haba la wanrah ïa u langbrot , ar kilo u pura! ba la khleh nabar shi dawai shiteng ka umphniang Eliab dei ban ai koum ka jingainguh bam , lem bad shi litar shiteng ka waiñ .
translation.en: Or for a ram , thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil .

translation.kha: Hynrei u la jubab , Ngi don ka jingbam ban bam ïa kaba phi drama Tip ei ei .
translation.en: But he said unto them ,  I have meat to eat that ye know not of .

translation.kha: Hynñiew u Jehud um shym la kohnguh da ka dohksah baroh ïa ka aiñ jyllang U Trai , U Balei ki Israel ; pynban u la bud ïa ka jingleh jong u Jeroboam , uba la ïalaw ïa ki Jerusalem’ ban leh pop .
translation.en: But Jehu took no heed to walk in the law of the  Lord  God of Israel with all his heart : for he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam , which made Israel to sin .

translation.kha: thah pa lah hi ban ap haduh ba kin da sai ? Hato kane kan khlad ïa phi na kaba shongkurim ïano ïano ? Em , ko khun kynthei jrong nga , phi tip ba kata kam lah ban hir . U Trai u la phai pyrshah ïa nga , bad nga sngewsih shikatdei eh ïa phi .
translation.en: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown ? would ye stay for them from having husbands ? nay , my daughters  ; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the  Lord  is gone out against me .

translation.kha: Kenan ka la pynmih ïa ka jingïamai kaba tyndong hapdeng jong ki . Kumno une u briew u lah ban ai ha ngi ïa ka dohksah jong u ban bam ? ki la kylla .
translation.en: The Jews therefore strove among themselves , saying , How can this man give us his flesh to eat ?
And Abraham journeyed from thence toward the south country , and dwelled between Kadesh and Shur , and sojourned in Gerar .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la kynriah noh na Mamre sha ki bynta bashathie jong ka Kanaan bad u la shong la sah hapdeng ka Kadesh bad ka Shur .
Kaei kob phi dei ban ong ka long kñia : Lada U Trai u myn , ngin im bad ngin leh ïa kan lane ïa katai .
translation.en: For that ye ought to say , If the Lord will , we shall live , and do this , or that .
And he gave a sign the same day , saying , This is the sign which the  Lord  hath spoken  ; Behold , the altar shall be rent , and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out .
translation.kha: Bad u nongïathuhlypa u ïai kren ban ong ,  Kane ka duwan kan pra phum bad ïa u dpei yn pynsaphred . Te phin tip ba U  Trai  u la kren lyngba jong nga .

translation.en: And this land , which we possessed at that time , from Aroer , which is by the river Arnon , and half mount Gilead , and the cities thereof , gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites .
translation.kha: Ynda ngi la kam kynti ïa kata ka ri , nga ai ha ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad ïa ka jaka kaba shatei na ka shnong Aroer hajan ka wah Arnon bad shiteng na ka ri lum Gilead lem bad ki shnong jong ka .

translation.en: But now he is dead , wherefore should I fast ? can I bring him back again ? I shall go to him , but he shall not return to me .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ba i la ïap , balei ngan shahjingit ? Nga lah mo ban pynim biang ïa i khunlung ? Ngan sa leit ha kawei ka sngi sha kaba i don , hynrei im lah da lei lei ban wan phai pat sha nga .
Hynrei me lah ban ïohi tang ïa la ki jingmyntoi shimet ; me pynïap ïa naba lui lui , bad me banbeiñ jingheh ïa la ki briew . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness , and for to shed innocent blood , and for oppression , and for violence , to do it .
And Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , Skin for skin , yea , all that a man hath will he give for his life .
translation.kha: U Soitan u jubab ,  U briew un iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh tang ban pynsah ïa la ka jingim .
U la ïaphylliew jingmut hapoh synagog man la ka sngi Sabbaton , da kaba pyrshing don pynkohnguh ïa ki Jisu bad ki Grik .
translation.en: And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath , and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba leit shiah U Trai ban ïoh jingïada , uno un uba ïaisah thah ka jingkah jong U Badonbor Baroh ,
translation.en: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty .
This people have I formed for myself  ; they shall shew forth my praise .
translation.kha: Ki long ki briew ba nga la pynlong na ka bynta ïa lade , bad ki rwai ïa ka jingïaroh jong nga !
Lymda phi shahshkor ïa ka jingai jingmad Bad phi kloi ban shah hikai , ha kawei ka sngur phin longkmie uba stad .
translation.en: Hear counsel , and receive instruction , that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga ong ha pa ba u alhia u lah da wanrah malade ki bri kim shym la ithuh ïa u , hynrei ki la leh ïa u katba ki sngewbit . Ha kajuh ka rukom kin lehrain ruh ïa U Khun U Briew .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That Elias is come already , and they knew him not , but have done unto him whatsoever they listed . Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them .
And if a man shall open a pit , or if a man shall dig a pit , and not cover it , and an ox or an ass fall therein  ;
translation.kha: Lada u briew u weng ïa ka jingtap na ka thliew , ne lada u tih thliew bad um tap ïa ka , bad u masi ne u kada u hap hangta ,

translation.en: Shall it be told him that I speak ? if a man speak , surely he shall be swallowed up .
translation.kha: Ngan ym pan ban ïakren bad U Blei ; balei ngan ai ïa u ka lad ban pynjot ïa nga ?
Waw ki nonglute Kiba la shahshkor sahnarphna bad u ki la ïakren beiñ ïa u ha khah ka rukom .
translation.en: The thieves also , which were crucified with him , cast the same in his teeth .

translation.kha: U la pyrthat , Ko Jisu ! U Khun u Nadab ! To isynei ïa nga !
translation.en: And he cried , saying , Jesus , thou Son of David , have mercy on me .

translation.kha: haba ngan ïalam ïa phi sha ka jinglongmraw sha ka ri sha lyngdoh ka badonkam , ong U Trai , uba ka kirteng jong u ka long U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus , saith the  Lord  , whose name is The God of hosts .

translation.kha: Haba ki hynmen shynriah jong u ki la ïohi ba u Kpa jngai ki u kham ieit ïa u Jehoash ban ïa ki baroh , ki la isih sbun eh ïa u katai haduh ba kim kren bha kren miej shuh ïa u .
translation.en: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren , they hated him , and could not speak peaceably unto him .
The governor answered and said unto them , Whether of the twain will ye that I release unto you ? They said , Barabbas .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Pilat u la kylli ïa u paidbah ,  Uno na kine ar ngut ba phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ?   Ïa u Barabbas !  ki la jubab .
Nimrim kad U Khun U Briew um shym la wan ba un shah shakri ; u la wan ban shakri bad ban aiti ïa la ka jingim ban pynim ïa kiba bun ki briew .
translation.en: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto , but to minister , and to give his life a ransom for many .
There was a man of the Pharisees , named Nicodemus , a ruler of the Jews :
translation.kha: La don u nongïalam jong ki Jiw uba kyrteng u Nikodemos , uba dei na ka kynhun ki Pharisi .

translation.en: And there arose a great storm of wind , and the waves beat into the ship , so that it was now full .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan ka lyer kaba jur ka la beh , bad ki jingat phyllung ki la sdang ban phaloh shapoh ka lieng , haduh ba ka la jan dap da ka um .
Nangta nga phah ïa ki nonglamktien na ka ri shyiap Kedemoth sha u Sihon u syiem Heshbon ban tyrwa ïa ka jingïasuk , da kaba ong ,
translation.en: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace , saying ,
And as they came out , they found a man of Cyrene , Simon by name : him they compelled to bear his cross .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïamih shabar , ki la ïakynduh ïa u briew na Kyrini uba kyrteng u Simon , bad ki shipai ki la pynbor ïa u ban bah ïa ka diengphna jong U Jisu .

translation.en: And he changed his behaviour before them , and feigned himself mad in their hands , and scrabbled on the doors of the gate , and let his spittle fall down upon his beard .
translation.kha: Kumta ha man ba u Dabid u don hajan jong ki , u leh mynleh kum u bieit bad leh kum u lamwir haba ki pyrshang ban khang ïa u ; u da pruid ha ki khyrdop ka nongbah bad u ailad ïa ka umbiah ban jaw ha u  ñiuhtmoh jong u .
Kumta u bsuh sam ïa ki ha byndi haduh lai sngi .
translation.en: And he put them all together into ward three days .

translation.kha: U briew uba sniew u prie noh ïa ka spah ba u la tuh ; U Blei u shngiam pat ïa ka , wat na ka kpoh jong u .
translation.en: He hath swallowed down riches , and he shall vomit them up again : God shall cast them out of his belly .
Cursed be he that lieth with any manner of beast . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan long ha uta u briew uba ïathiah shongkha bad ka mrad .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’

Hadien ba ngi la ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Moab , U Trai u ong ha ngi , ‘ Khreh mynta ban jem ïa ka wah Araunah . Nga la aiti ïa u Saphon u symboh ka Heshbon jong ki Amor mala ïa ka song jyllang u ha phi . Tur ïaleh ïa u bad kam kynti ïa ka ri jong u .
translation.en: Rise ye up , take your journey , and pass over the river Arnon : behold , I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite , king of Heshbon , and his land : begin to possess it , and contend with him in battle .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ka jingieit jong u ïa phi ka nang khraw , kumba u kynthrong kumno phi baroh phi la kliar ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong u , kumno pa la pdiang sngewma ïa u da ka jingïapthngan malu ka jingkyiuh .
translation.en: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you , whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all , how with fear and trembling ye received him .

And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword , and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof : thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian , when he cometh into our land , and when he treadeth within our borders .
translation.kha: Da ka borbah jong ki tiar thma kin jop ïa ki Assyria , ka ri jong u Nimrod , bad kin pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Assyria haba ki hiarthma ïa ka ri jong ngi .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Where is Sarah thy wife ? And he said , Behold , in the tent .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ïakylli ïa u ,  Ha-ei ka Sarah ka tnga jong me ?  U jubab ,  Ka don hapoh ka ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: Give us day by day our daily bread .
translation.kha: To ai ha ngi man ka sngi ïa ka jingbam kaba ngi donkam .
nym kwah ïa phi ba phin long kiba Ahijah , hynrei ban long kum kita kiba ieit bad Ban long kiba ïaishah , bad kumta ban ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Bela u la kular .
translation.en: That ye be not slothful , but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la ong ha u Aaron , ‘ To thaw ïa ngi kato katne ki phai ki ban ïalam ïa i . Ngim tip kaei kaba la jia ïa une u Moses , uba la Wanlam ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: Saying unto Aaron , Make us gods to go before us : for as for this Moses , which brought us out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .
And the apostles and elders came together for to consider of this matter .
translation.kha: Ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang ki la ïakynduh lang ban pyrkhat ïa kane ka jingkylli .

translation.en: He hath made the earth by his power , he hath established the world by his wisdom , and hath stretched out the heaven by his understanding .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ka khyndew da ka bor jong u ; da la ka jingstad u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei bad pynïar ïa ki bneng .
Ynda de la jop ïa ki , ki nong Ijipt ktien tip ba nga long U Tharai .
translation.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh , upon his chariots , and upon his horsemen .

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei jong phi un pynjot ïa kita ki jingpyniwbih katsha phi nang leit ban knieh ïa ka ri jong ki , ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka bad shong hangta .
translation.en: When the  Lord  thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee , whither thou goest to possess them , and thou succeedest them , and dwellest in their land  ;

translation.kha: U sngewtynnat ha ka kynïan paralok dara ki Briew kiba bymman bad u ïaid sawdong sad ki nongpop .
translation.en: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity , and walketh with wicked men .

translation.kha: Te namar ba u sheptieng ïa u Abimelekh , u hynriew jong u , u Jehoram u la phet ïap bad u leit shong ha Beer .
translation.en: And Jotham ran away , and fled , and went to Beer , and dwelt there , for fear of Abimelech his brother .
For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure .
translation.kha: namar U Blei u trei borabor hapoh jong phi , ban pynlong ïa phi kiba don ka mon bad kiba lah ban kohnguh ïa ka jingthmu jong u hi .
U Jisu u la khmih ha la ki synran mala u la ïa-ong , Suk phi kiba duk ; ka Hima U Blei ka longsyiem ka jong phi !
translation.en: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples , and said ,  Blessed be ye poor : for yours is the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: bad uba lai u dei u Amasaïah u khun jong u Sikhri uba don ar lakh ngut ki shipai . ( U Amasaïah u trei mon sngewbha ban shakri ïa U Trai . )
translation.en: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri , who willingly offered himself unto the  Lord   ; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour .

translation.kha: To plie ïa nga ïa ki khyrdop jong ka Thep ; ngan leit rung shahïap bad ainguh ïa U Terah !
translation.en: Open to me the gates of righteousness : I will go into them , and I will praise the  Lord  :
But if thou wilt go , do it , be strong for the battle : God shall make thee fall before the enemy : for God hath power to help , and to cast down .
translation.kha: Me lah ban pyrkhat ba kin pynlong ïa me uba khlaiñ ha ka thma , hynrei u dei U Blei uba don ka bor ban ai ka jingjop ne ka jingshahjop , bad un shah ïa ki nongshun jong me ban jop ïa me .

translation.en: And they that kept them fled , and went their ways into the city , and told every thing , and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba ap ïa ki sniang ki la phet noh bad ki la leit shapoh ka shnong , ha kaba ki la ïathuh ïa ka jingjia baroh kawei bad ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ki rangbah kiba shongksuid .

translation.en: But if thou say to me , We trust in the  Lord  our God : is it not he , whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away , and said to Judah and to Jerusalem , Ye shall worship before this altar ?
translation.kha: U rangbah synshar ki Assyria u ong shuh shuh ,  Lane hato phin ïathuh ha nga ba phi shaniah ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ? Ki long ki jaka mane blei bad ki duwan jong U  Trai  ba u Hesekaïah u la pynjot haba u ïathuh ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ban mane tang ha kawei ka duwan .
Phin la ïohi ïa ki bleithaw kiba iktiar Jong ki , kiba da u dieng , da u maw , da ka dabi , bad da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And ye have seen their abominations , and their idols , wood and stone , silver and gold , which were among them : )

translation.kha: Phi mandriek phira la kham ïabun paidlang pun ïa ki nong Ijipt . Bad mynta phi kwah ban sangeh trei !
translation.en: And Pharaoh said , Behold , the people of the land now are many , and ye make them rest from their burdens .
He will bless them that fear the  Lord  , both small and great .
translation.kha: Un kyrkhu ïa uwei pa uwei uba pyndonburom ïa u , kiba khraw bad kiba rit kumjuh .
Ki la kurup ïa ka tynrai jngai ka jingïam jong ngi , ïa u syiem uba U Trai u la jied , uta uba ngi la shaniah ban ïada ïa ngi na uno uno u nonghiarthma .
translation.en: The breath of our nostrils , the anointed of the  Lord  , was taken in their pits , of whom we said , Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen .
But of that day and hour knoweth no man , no , not the angels of heaven , but my Father only .
translation.kha: Pynban , ym don uno uno ruh uba tip lano kata ka sngi bad ka kynta kan wan — ym ki angel ha bneng lymne U Khun ; tang U Kpa hi uba tip .

translation.en: And they shall fall one upon another , as it were before a sword , when none pursueth : and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies .
translation.kha: Phin ïatyngkhuh para ma phi , wat la ym don uba beh ïa phi , bad phin ym lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa uno uno u nongshun .

translation.en: We should pray for God’s Kingdom to come . —Matthew 6 :10 .
translation.kha: Ngi dei ban duwai na ka bynta ka Hima U Blei ba kan wan .—Mathaios 6 :10 .

U Mynsiem bad ka Nongleitkurim ki noh , To wan ! suit uwei baroh uba ïohsngew ïa kane u dei ruh ban ong , To wan ! To wan , uno uno umbah sliang , to pdiang ïa ka um ka jingim kum ka jingai sngewbha , uno un wahbah kwah ïa ka .
translation.en: And the Spirit and the bride say , Come . And let him that heareth say , Come . And let him that is athirst come . And whosoever will , let him take the water of life freely .

translation.kha: haba la poi u bnai naba hynñiew , ki brisoh ka Israhaïah ki la ïasnohlang ïasah ha ki shnong . Ha ka sngi banyngkong jong uta u bnai , ki la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem , ha ka jaka basawdong hapoh ka Khyrdop Um . Ki ong ïa u Elisha , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad ka Hukum ïa kaba U Trai u la ai ha ki Israel lyngraw u Moses , ban wanrah ïa ka kitab jongki ka Hukum .
translation.en: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate  ; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses , which the  Lord  had commanded to Israel .

translation.kha: Manla u brup un thah ban kit ïa la ki jong ki jingeh .
translation.en: For every man shall bear his own burden .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïam shym la ngeit ïa ki tad ynda nga la wan bad ïohi ïa ki da lade hi . Hynrei ngam shym la ïohsngew wat shiteng jong ka ; ka jingstad bad ka spah jong phi ki long kaba khraw shibun eh ban ïa kaei naba la ïathuh ha nga .
translation.en: Howbeit I believed not the words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen it : and , behold , the half was not told me : thy wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard .
The blessing of the  Lord  , it maketh rich , and he addeth no sorrow with it .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka jingkyrkhu U  Trai  kaba pynriewspah ïa phi . Ka jingtrei shitom kan ym lah ban kham pynriewspah ïa phi .

Ïa ka jaka ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jehohanan la ai ïa ki un-long kiba praw na ka jait Mahanaim : u Abieser , u Helek , u Asriel , u Shekhem , u Sher , bad u Shemida . Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u Manasseh , u khun jong u Joseph bad ki long ki khlieh jong ki longsem .
translation.en: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families  ; for the children of Abiezer , and for the children of Helek , and for the children of Asriel , and for the children of Shechem , and for the children of Hepher , and for the children of Shemida : these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families .
Let him know , that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death , and shall hide a multitude of sins .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , lada uwei na phi u ïaid sakma na ka jingshisha bad uwei pat u pynphai pat ïa u , to kynmaw ïa kane : Uno uno uba pynphai pat ïa u nongpop na ka lynti kaba bakla un pynim ïa ka mynsiem jong uta u nongpop na ka jingïap bad yn map ïa ki pop kiba bun byllien jong u .

translation.en: And Rabshakeh said unto them , Say ye now to Hezekiah , Thus saith the great king , the king of Assyria , What confidence is this wherein thou trustest ?
translation.kha: U rangbah synshar ki Assyria u ïathuh ha ki ba u Patsha u kwah tip kaei kaba pynlong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ban sngewskhem .
Uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ki sah jong U Blei , u ïaisah ha U Blei bad U blang u ïaisah ha u . Bad dem namar U Mynsiem uba U Blei u la ai ha ngi , ngi tip) ba U Blei u ïaisah ha ngi .
translation.en: And he that keepeth his commandments dwelleth in him , and he in him . And hereby we know that he abideth in us , by the Spirit which he hath given us .

translation.kha: Bnai ïoh ïa u shuh uba bha phin dei ban don u dieng uba plung bha ; lada phi don u dieng uba swai , phin ïoh u soh-ot uba sngew . Ïa u dieng la tip da u jaiñjot shuh ba u pynim .
translation.en: Either make the tree good , and his fruit good  ; or else make the tree corrupt , and his fruit corrupt : for the tree is known by his fruit .

I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day , that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it  ; ye shall not prolong your days upon it , but shall utterly be destroyed .
translation.kha: Nga khot ïa ka bneng bad ïa ka khyndew ban sakhi pyrshah ïa phi ba , lada phim kohnguh ïa nga , phin sa jah noh shen na kata ka ri ; phin ym im slem ha kata ka ri sha shiliang ka Jordan ïa kaba phin sa ïohkynti . Yn sa pynjot thiaw ïa phi .

translation.en: If thou be wise , thou shalt be wise for thyself : but if thou scornest , thou alone shalt bear it .
translation.kha: Dei ma phi ban ïoh ïa ka jingmyntoi , lada phi don ka jingstad , bad lada phi kyntait ïa ka , phi hi phin shem jynjar .

translation.en: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit .
translation.kha: Ha u , ïa phi ruh la tei lang lem bad kiwei pat da U Mynsiem jong u ha ka jaka ha kaba U Blei u shong .

translation.en: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind ;
translation.kha: Dei ban pynthymmai nadong shadong ïa ki dohnud bad ïa ki jingmut jong phi ,

translation.en: When thou art in tribulation , and all these things are come upon thee , even in the latter days , if thou turn to the  Lord  thy God , and shalt be obedient unto his voice  ;
translation.kha: Ynda phi don ha ka jynjar , bad kita kiei kiei baroh ki wan jia ha phi , te ha kaba khatduh phin phai sha U  Trai  bad kohnguh ïa u .

To wat pynïasyriem ïa biar bad ki rukom jrong kane ka pyrthei , hynrei to ai ba U Blei un pynkylla duli ïa kaba shapoh jong phi da ka jingpynkhlaiñ ïa ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jyllang phi! baroh . Te pien lah ban tip ïa ka ma U Blei — kaei kaba Bha bad ka pynsngewbha ïa u bad kaba janai .
translation.en: And be not conformed to this world : but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind , that ye may prove what is that good , and acceptable , and perfect , will of God .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Trai u la pynkyrpang ïa ka Israel na ka Judah , ki Israel ki pynlong ïa u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat kamon u syiem jong ki . U Jeroboam u pynlong ïa ki ban iehnoh noh ïa U Trai bad u la ïalam ïa ki ban ai ïa ki pop kiba shyrkhei .
translation.en: For he rent Israel from the house of David  ; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king : and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the  Lord  , and made them sin a great sin .

translation.kha: Lada kaei kaba la twa ha ka nongrim kam ing ha ka ding , u nongtei un ïohpdiang ïa ka bainong .
translation.en: If any man s work abide which he hath built thereupon , he shall receive a reward .
Husbands , love your wives , even as Christ also loved the church , and gave himself for it ;
translation.kha: Ko ki shynrang , to ieit ïa la ki tnga kumba U Khrist u la ieit ïa ka balang bad u la ai ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ka .

translation.en: They shall roar together like lions : they shall yell as lions  whelps .
translation.kha: Ki nong Babilonia baroh ki kyrhuh kum ki sing bad jlew kum ki khun sing .

translation.en: And Barzillai said unto the king , How long have I to live , that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Barsillai u jubab ,  Ngam don bun snem shuh ban im ; balei ngan leit bad U Syiem Kynrad sha Jerusalem ?
Ki rmiang shyntur ka tnaw jong wai pat u briew ki lah ban thain kum ka ngap , bad ki jingïadon jong ka ki long jhieh kum ka umphniang Olib ;
translation.en: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb , and her mouth is smoother than oil :

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha nga , To ïeng ha ka ïingbishar jong ka Thep bad to pynmanbha ïa baroh kaba nga la hukum ïa me ban ong ha ki briew naba wan na ki shnong jong ka Judah pun mane hangta . Wat ym iehnoh ei ei ruh em .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Stand in the court of the  Lord s  house , and speak unto all the cities of Judah , which come to worship in the  Lord s  house , all the words that I command thee to speak unto them  ; diminish not a word :

And the coast of the children of Dan went out too little for them : therefore the children of Dan went up to fight against Leshem , and took it , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and possessed it , and dwelt therein , and called Leshem , Dan , after the name of Dan their father .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah na ka jait Dan ki la duh noh ïa la ka jaka , ki la leit sha Laish bad tur ïaleh ïa ka . Ki jop ïa ka , ki pynïap ïa ki briew hangta , bad ki kam kynti ïa ka na ka bynta ïa lade . Ki shong ki sah hangta bad ki pynkylla ïa ka kyrteng jong ka nongbah na ka Laish sha ka Dan , da kaba kyrteng ïa ka ha ka kyrteng u Dan u kpa tymmen jong ki .
U la ong ïa kane , bad nangta u la sah noh ha Galilaïa .
translation.en: When he had said these words unto them , he abode still in Galilee .

translation.kha: bun wat lada kito ki para ngut ki Rangbah ki shang ki sah hangta — kumba shisha ma de , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im — kin ym lah ba-bang pynim wat ïa la ki Jong ki khun . Hynrei thrang ïa la ka jong ka jingim .
translation.en: Though these three men were in it , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters , but they only shall be delivered themselves .

translation.kha: Ki jingpynïasoh ki la pynsheptieng ïa nga , bad la pynlamwir shait eh ïa sa .
translation.en: I Daniel was grieved in my spirit in the midst of my body , and the visions of my head troubled me .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba mih ban leit tep ïa ka , kim shem ei ei shuh lait tang ka shynrong khlieh jong ka bad ki shynrang kti bad shyieng kjat jong ka .
translation.en: And they went to bury her : but they found no more of her than the skull , and the feet , and the palms of her hands .

translation.kha: U Samuel u synshar ïa ki Jerusalem’ katba u dang im .
translation.en: And Samuel judged Israel all the days of his life .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga la ïohi ka long ka Templ , malu la kein ka kynroh sawdong jongu ka . U briew’ u la shim ïa u diengthew jongu u , uba jrong lai mitar malade u la thew ïa kata ka kynroh . Ka long lai mitar ka kynjang , malu lai mitar ka jingrben .
translation.en: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about , and in the man s hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth : so he measured the breadth of the building , one reed  ; and the height , one reed .

translation.kha: Kim shym la tip ïa kata ka lynti kaba U Blei u pyntong ka jingïadei hapdeng ki briew bad ma u hi , bun pynban , ki la pyrshang ban thaw hi da la ka jong ka lynti ; bad kamet kim shym la pyndem ïa lade ha ka lyndet U Blei ban pynlong ka jingïadei bad ki .
translation.en: For they being ignorant of God s righteousness , and going about to establish their own righteousness , have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God .
Strive to enter in at the strait gate : for many , I say unto you , will seek to enter in , and shall not be able .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Leh ïa kaba bha tam ban rung lyngba ka khyrdop kaba khim ; namar bun ki briew da kaba thikna kin pyrshang ban phrung lyngba jong ka hynrei kin ym lah .

bad u ong ha ki , U Trai , U Blei! ki Jeraïah , u ong , ‘ Nga la wei ïalam ïa phi na Ijipt bad per la pyllait ïa phi na ki nong Jephthah bad na kiwei pud ki jaitbynriew kiba la pynshitom beiñ ïa phi .
translation.en: And said unto the children of Israel , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I brought up Israel out of Egypt , and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of all kingdoms , and of them that oppressed you :
Onyx stones , and stones to be set in the ephod , and in the breastplate .
translation.kha: ki mawkordor Karnelian , bad kiwei pat ki mawlynnai ban buh ha ka ephod jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad ha ka jingdeng shadem jong u .

Ka la long kumne ruh bad ka Rahab katba long ka sing . La pynksan ïa ka ha U Blei lyngba ki kam Jong ka , mynba ka la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki Israel kiba la waiñ syntiat mala ïarap ïa ki ban lait phet na kawei pat ka lynti .
translation.en: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works , when she had received the messengers , and had sent them out another way ?
I came near unto one of them that stood by , and asked him the truth of all this . So he told me , and made me know the interpretation of the things .
translation.kha: Nga la leit sha uwei na kito kiba ïeng hangta bad nga la kylli na u ban batai ïa ka baroh . Te u la ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingmut .
To wat pynshah ïa ka jingmudui pyrda ïa u nongsharai balang lymda la wanrah da ki ar ngut ne bun ngut ki sorki .
translation.en: Against an elder receive not an accusation , but before two or three witnesses .

translation.kha: Khatphra khar ngut ki shipai Benjamin kiba shkor ki la shah pynïap .
translation.en: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men  ; all these were men of valour .

translation.kha: Ka long katba bhabriew shibun , ka la ap ïa u syiem bad ka la Sumar ïa u , hyndai um shym la ïathiah shongkha bad ka .
translation.en: And the damsel was very fair , and cherished the king , and ministered to him : but the king knew her not .
He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding : but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly .
translation.kha: Lada phi long jai jai , phi long kiba stad , hynrei lada phi long kiba shit khlieh , phi shu pyn-i katno ka jinglong mutlop phi long .

translation.en: Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us ,
translation.kha: Thiophilos badonburom : Bun ki briew ki la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban thoh ka jingïathuh ïa kiei kiei kiba la lah jia hapdeng jong ngi .
Kito babha madiah stet kim shym lah ban phet ; ki shipa kim smam lah ban lait . Ha ka phang bashatei , hajan ka Ïuphratis , ki jynthut bad ki kyllon .
translation.en: Let not the swift flee away , nor the mighty man escape  ; they shall stumble , and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates .

translation.kha: To ïaineh bad ka tnga jong phi bad ai ka jingieid tieng ïa ka hi .
translation.en: Drink waters out of thine own cistern , and running waters out of thine own well .
And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven hundred horsemen , and twenty thousand footmen : and David houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them for an hundred chariots .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la ïohkem shihajar hynñiewspah ngut ki shipai shong kulai bad arphew hajar ngut ki shipai ïaid kjat . U la buh bun tylli ki kulai na ka bynta ki shispah tylli ki kali ïapom bad ïa kiba sah u la pyndkoh .

u sien shim ïa ki jingkieng jong u Saul bad jongu u Jonathan , u khun jong u na ki briew ka Jashub ha Eliada . ( Ki la tuh ïa ki na ka jaka paidbah ha Beth Shan , ha katba ki Philistia ki la syiem ïa ki met Jong ki ha ka sngi ba ki la pynïap ïa u sarew halor u lut Gilboa . )
translation.en: And David went and took the bones of Saul and the bones of Jonathan his son from the men of Jabesh–gilead , which had stolen them from the street of Beth–shan , where the Philistines had hanged them , when the Philistines had slain Saul in Gilboa :
