translation.kha: Naba yn ym ba-don shuh kano kano ka jingkñia kaba kah ban kit noh ïa ki pop dalade ngi ïai leh pop hadien ba ngi la tip ïa ka jingshisha .
translation.en: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth , there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins ,

translation.kha: Mano ba ai um ïa ka khyndew kaba tyrkhong bad kaba thynrang , ba kumto u phlang u maw ?
translation.en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground  ; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth ?

translation.kha: Mynta , to leit ban pynskhem biang ïa ki rangbah jongnga phi . Ngin smai ha ka kyrteng U Trai ba lada phim leh kumta , yn ym don shuh uwei ruh na ki u don don bad phi lashai mynstep . Katta kan longkmie ka jingjynjar kaba sniew tam kaba phyrnai shah ha ka jingim jngai phi baroh .
translation.en: Now therefore arise , go forth , and speak comfortably unto thy servants : for I swear by the  Lord  , if thou go not forth , there will not tarry one with thee this night : and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now .

translation.kha: Nangta u Shimei un ong ha ki briew kiba ha ka liang kamon jong u , ‘ To wan , phi kiba la ring da U Kpa jong nga ! To wan bad to ïoh ïa ka shem kaba la pynkheiñ na ka bynta jong phi nadong kaba pynlong ïa ka pyut .
translation.en: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand , Come , ye blessed of my Father , inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world :

translation.kha: Na jngi ki la ïuh ïa u , bad katba un da poi hajan jong ki , ki lai da ïasylla pyrshah ïa u bad rai ba pynïap noh ïa u .
translation.en: And when they saw him afar off , even before he came near unto them , they conspired against him to slay him .

translation.kha: U Simri Dabid u hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synsar jongno ki Israel ban ïalumlang ha Jerusalem . Kumta baroh ki rangbah synshar jong ki jait , ki rangbah synshar kiba pynïaid ïa ka kim lad ka Hima , ki nongïalam jong ki kur , ki nongpeit ïa ki jingdon jing malade ki jingri kiba dei jong u shym bad ki khun shynrang jongu u — Shisha ki rangbah synshar ka ïingsyiem , ki shipai kiba lamkhmat , bad ki rangbah badonkam — ki la ïalumlang ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And David assembled all the princes of Israel , the princes of the tribes , and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course , and the captains over the thousands , and captains over the hundreds , and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king , and of his sons , with the officers , and with the mighty men , and with all the valiant men , unto Jerusalem .
What could have been done more to my vineyard , that I have not done in it ? wherefore , when I looked that it should bring forth grapes , brought it forth wild grapes ?
translation.kha: Don kano kano kaba ngam shym la leh ïa ka ? Te balei ka pynmih ki sohwaiñ kiba jew bad ym kiba bha kumba nga la khmih lynti ?

translation.en: And the disciples were filled with joy , and with the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Ki riewngeit ha Antiokh ki la dap da ka jingkmen bad da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: These are the generations of Shem : Shem was an hundred years old , and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood :
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Shem . Ar snem hadien ka jingshlei um , haba u Shem u la dap shispah snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Arpakhshad .
Haba U ijuh u la poi , u la shem ba la lah tep ïa u Lasaros saw sngi mynshuwa .
translation.en: Then when Jesus came , he found that he had lain in the grave four days already .

translation.kha: Ngam la leh pop , u Saul u jubab . Hynrei la kumno kumno pyn-i ka jingñiewkor ïa nga ha khmat ki nongïalam jong ki briew jong nga bad ki Israel baroh . Ïaleit phai ryngkat bad na , ba nur-um lah ban mane ïa U Trai U Blei jongno phi .
translation.en: Then he said , I have sinned : yet honour me now , I pray thee , before the elders of my people , and before Israel , and turn again with me , that I may worship the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Dei tang ka Baibl kaba ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba ine dei ban leh khnang ban pynsngewsih ïa U Blei .—Salm 1 :1-3 ; Jeshaïah 48 :17 , 18 .
translation.en: The Bible alone tells us what we must do to please God .—Psalm 1 :1-3  ; Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 .

translation.kha: Ka Bilhah ka la punkhun , bad ka kha khun shynrang ïa u Jakob .
translation.en: And Bilhah conceived , and bare Jacob a son .

translation.kha: Kam dondor bad dei Ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ki ; ïa ki yn sa pynjot haba U Trai u wan ban har ïa ki .
translation.en: They are vanity , the work of errors : in the time of their visitation they shall perish .

translation.kha: Ki jingthoh ki ïathuh kumno u la synshar , haduh Katto u longkmie uba khrawbor , bun ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la jia ha u , ha ki Israel , bad ha ki hima baroh kiba marjan .
translation.en: With all his reign and his might , and the times that went over him , and over Israel , and over all the kingdoms of the countries .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u ong ha u Simeon badno ha u Lebi , Phi la pynjynjar ïa nga ; ki Hanan bad ki Peris , bad kat kiba don ha kane ka ri , mynta kin sa shun ïa nga . Ngam dei uba bun paid ; lama ki ïa-tylli lang kawei pyrshah ïa de , bad ki ïaleh ïa nga , ma nga nabar ka ïong jongno nga baroh ngin sa shah pynjot .
translation.en: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi , Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land , among the Canaanites and the Perizzites : and I being few in number , they shall gather themselves together against me , and slay me  ; and I shall be destroyed , I and my house .

translation.kha: A katno ka shyrkhei ïa phira ! Phi long kum ki lam jingtep ki bym don daym Shuh ha kaba ki briew ki ïadih nalor khlem tip ïa ka .
translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye are as graves which appear not , and the men that walk over them are not aware of them .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba trei shym , kaba khlain bad kaba minot .
translation.en: She girdeth her loins with strength , and strengtheneth her arms .

translation.kha: Ka jingtur ïajah ka la shang ha ka por shiteng sngem kato u Benhadad bad ki laiphew ar ngut kiba ïateh lok bad u ki dang ïaid buaid ha ki ïingjaiñ jrong ki .
translation.en: And they went out at noon . But Ben–hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions , he and the kings , the thirty and two kings that helped him .

translation.kha: Kumta ar la ong ha ki , U Trai u la kren ha nga bad u la noh
translation.en: Then I answered them , The word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

And all Israel shall mourn for him , and bury him : for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave , because in him there is found some good thing toward the  Lord  God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam .
translation.kha: Baroh ki paid Israel kin ïambriew na ka bynta jong u bad kin tep ïa u . Un dei tang ma u na ka longïing u Jeroboam ïa uba yn ïoh tep donburom , namar u long tang ma u hi ïa uba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u sngewbha .
Ki briew kiba ïaid nangta ki la kyrngah ïa la ki khlaw bad kren ïa U Jiw : Ade ! lad pynjop ïa ka Templ bad te pat ïa ka hapoh lai sngem !
translation.en: And they that passed by railed on him , wagging their heads , and saying , Ah , thou that destroyest the temple , and buildest it in three days ,

translation.kha: Ha kane ka por nga ong ïa ki rangbah kiba khmih ïa ka kam , ba ma ki sad ki nongïarap jong ki , ki hap ban sah” ha Jerusalem ha ka por mynmiet , khnang ba i'u lah don ap phira ïa ka nongbah mynmiet bad kumjuh ruh ban trei ha ka por mynsngi .
translation.en: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people , Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem , that in the night they may be a guard to us , and labour on the day .
Why tell others about what you are learning ?
translation.kha: Balei phi dei ban ïathuh lem ïa kiwei pat ïa kiei kiei kiba phi la tip ?
Kane ka long kumne la buh ryntih ïa kita ktieh kiei . Ki lyngdoh ki rung shapoh ka bynta Kaba ha khmat jngai ka Jingiaid man ka sngi ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki ,
translation.en: Now when these things were thus ordained , the priests went always into the first tabernacle , accomplishing the service of God .

translation.kha: Hynrei kum ka tnga ka bymïaineh , phar shym la ïaineh ha na . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Surely as a wife treacherously departeth from her husband , so have ye dealt treacherously with me , O house of Israel , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses bad u Aaron ki den khrup ha khyndew bad ki ong , A Blei! , me , me long ka thymmei jong ka jingrem baroh . Babha iwei na ngi u leh pop , hato men Shu bitar lep ïa ka kynhun baroh kawei ?
translation.en: And they fell upon their faces , and said , O God , the God of the spirits of all flesh , shall one man sin , and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation ?
And he that regarded not the word of the  Lord  left his servants and his cattle in the field .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat kim suidñiew ïa ka jingmaham U  Trai  bad ki ieh ïa la ki mraw bad ïa la ki jingri ha lum .

U Blei u la pynpaw ha kine ki nongshetkylla ba ka jingtrei jong ki kam Shimham la long na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jongnga ki hi , hynrei na ka bynta jong phi , kaba ki dang kah kren shaphang kita kiwei kiei ïa Kiba pa’ la ïohsngew mynta na ki nongpynim kiba la pynbna ïa ka khubor Babha da ka bor U Mynhyndai Bakhuid ba la phah na bneng . Kine ki long kiei khie kiba wat ki angel ki thrang ban shemphang .
translation.en: Unto whom it was revealed , that not unto themselves , but unto us they did minister the things , which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven  ; which things the angels desire to look into .

translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u la khot ïa kita ki shipai samla kiba Long Hapoh ki nongtei hukum jong ki dalade , kiba don arspah laiphew ar ngut baroh . Nangta u la khoit ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel , kaba don hynñiew hajir ngut ki rangbah .
translation.en: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces , and they were two hundred and thirty two : and after them he numbered all the people , even all the children of Israel , being seven thousand .

translation.kha: Shu iathuh ianga jia aiu .
translation.en: Just tell me what's going on .

translation.kha: Kumta u Samson u leit hiar sha Timnah ryngkat bad la u kper bad ka kmie . Katba ki dang ïaid lyngba ki ber sohwaiñ hangta , u ïohsngew ïa u sing samla ba u kyrhuh .
translation.en: Then went Samson down , and his father and his mother , to Timnah , and came to the vineyards of Timnah : and , behold , a young lion roared against him .

translation.kha: U mai ïa ki jaitbynriew — hab un ym pynshitom ïa ki ? U long u nongsakhi jong ngi baroh — hato un ym ba-don jingtip ei ei ?
translation.en: He that chastiseth the heathen , shall not he correct ? he that teacheth man knowledge , shall not he know ?

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , nga ïadih ïa ka jingïap man la ka sngi! Ka jingsngew sarong kaba nga don ha phi , ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu uba U Trai jyllang ngi , ka pynlong ïa sa ban pynbna ïa kane .
translation.en: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord , I die daily .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ruh shibun ki khun ki ktem ïa u khun jong kata ka mraw ba kin long kawei ka jaitbynriew . U ruh u dei u khun jong me .
translation.en: And also of the son of the bondwoman will I make a nation , because he is thy seed .
And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his fathers had done .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh ki kpa tymmen jong u , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
Ki Jiw ki la jam ïa i'u u briew bad sa ba kan pynïap ïa u . (Nga la ïoh jingtip ba u long u tyrkhong ka Hima Rom , kumta nga la leit bun ki shipai jong nga bad nga la pyllait im ïa u .
translation.en: This man was taken of the Jews , and should have been killed of them : then came I with an army , and rescued him , having understood that he was a Roman .

translation.kha: U Ananias , u Rahab Lyngdoh , u la praw ïa kita kiba ïeng hajan lad u pyllew ban thab ïa u na ka shyntur .
translation.en: And the high priest Ananias commanded them that stood by him to smite him on the mouth .

translation.kha: Ka khuri kaweh ngi pyndonkam ha ka Jingkhawai U Tharai nabar ïa kaba i'u ainguh ïa U Blei : Haba ine dih na ka , ngi ïoh bynta lem ha ka snam U Khrist . Gera u kpu naba me kdiah : Haba ngi bam ïa u , ngi ïoh bynta lem ha ka met U Khristan .
translation.en: The cup of blessing which we bless , is it not the communion of the blood of Christ ? The bread which we break , is it not the communion of the body of Christ ?

translation.kha: To ai ba ngan Nimrim lah shuh ba rwai biang lada mem kynmaw ïa pha , lada ngam pyrkhat ïa phan khim ka jingkmen bakhraw tam jngai nga !
translation.en: If I do not remember thee , let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth  ; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la rung shapoh ïing , ki synlar jong u ki la kylli jar jar ïa u , barli ba ngim Lah ban beh noh ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid ?
translation.en: And when he was come into the house , his disciples asked him privately , Why could not we cast him out ?

translation.kha: Kata ka pateng bynriew barieh ka la ïap , bad ka pateng bynriew kaba bud ka la klet ïa U Trai bad ïa katai kaba u la leh na ka bynta ki Israel .
translation.en: And also all that generation were gathered unto their fathers : and there arose another generation after them , which knew not the  Lord  , nor yet the works which he had done for Israel .

And I will make void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place  ; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies , and by the hands of them that seek their lives : and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven , and for the beasts of the earth .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka jaka ngan pynpulom ïa baroh ki jingthmu jong ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem . Ngan shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban risa halor jong ki bad pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma . Ngan ai ïa ki metïap jong ki ha ki sim bad ha ki mradkhlaw kum ka jingbam .

U Sadok u lyngdoh u la don hangta , bad ryngkat bad u la don ki Lebi kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang kaba kyntang . Ki la pynhiar ïa ka bad kim shym la rah shuh tad haduh ba ki briew baroh kin da mihnoh na ka nongbah . U Abiathar , u lyngdoh u la don lang hangta .
translation.en: And lo Zadok also , and all the Levites were with him , bearing the ark of the covenant of God : and they set down the ark of God  ; and Abiathar went up , until all the people had done passing out of the city .

translation.kha: Lada U Trai u la sngewbit ïa ngi , un ïalam ïa i shata badno ai ha im’ ïa kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka ding bad ka ngap .
translation.en: If the  Lord  delight in us , then he will bring us into this land , and give it us  ; a land which floweth with milk and honey .
But the people took of the spoil , sheep and oxen , the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed , to sacrifice unto the  Lord  thy God in Gilgal .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jong nga kim shym pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi kiba kynsai tam ba ki la ïoh kurup ; pynban , ki la wallam ïa ki hangne ha Gilgal ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

Ko ki khwan jong nga , kaba kut ka la jat ! La ïathuh ha ph ba u Nongshun jongki U Khristan un sa wan ; bad mynta ki nongshna babun jong U Khrist ki la eh paw , bad kumta ngi tip ba kaba kut ka la ïajan .
translation.en: Little children , it is the last time : and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come , even now are there many antichrists  ; whereby we know that it is the last time .

translation.kha: Lada phin ngeit , phin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan ha ka jingduwai .
translation.en: And all things , whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer , believing , ye shall receive .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba ïohi ïa nga u ïohi shwa ïa uta uba la pha ïa nga .
translation.en: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me .

translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U Trai , Baroh ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei , ïaroh ïa ka Burom bad ka bor jong u .
translation.en: Give unto the  Lord  , ye kindreds of the people , give unto the  Lord  glory and strength .

translation.kha: Kane ka bynta ka la kham shai shuh shuh , ba uwei pat u lyngngeit uba pher u la paw , uba syiem ïa u Melkhisedek .
translation.en: And it is yet far more evident : for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest ,
But I say unto you , That every idle word that men shall speak , they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban thikna ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar uwei pa uwei un hap ban ai jingkheiñ ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ka bymmyntoi kaba u la kren .
Me pynduhbor ïa u briew dara phah nong ïa u junom ; ka durkhmat jong u ka sniew dur ha ka por ka jingïap .
translation.en: Thou prevailest for ever against him , and he passeth : thou changest his countenance , and sendest him away .
Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te namarkata , haba ka por ka poi ba ïa ka ri yn ai pat sha ki briew jong U  Trai  , yn ym don shuh ka bynta ïano ïano na phi .
Nga sngewtynnat ïa kine ki briew , namar ki la don bad nga la na sngi bun mynta kim don ei ei haw ban bam .
translation.en: I have compassion on the multitude , because they have now been with me three days , and have nothing to eat :

translation.kha: Babha me woh , to wanrah ïa ka jaiñkup ba nga la iehnoh ha Troas bad u Karpos ; wan ruh ïa ki kjit , bad khamtam ïa ki koit ba la sop snieh .
translation.en: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus , when thou comest , bring with thee , and the books , but especially the parchments .

translation.kha: U pyndonkam main shiphew syang kyllum ka ksiar nangta ba-bang shna ïa uto u diengphna sharak bad ïa ki jingpynkut jyllang u baroh .
translation.en: Of a talent of pure gold made he it , and all the vessels thereof .

And for the majesty that he gave him , all people , nations , and languages , trembled and feared before him : whom he would he slew  ; and whom he would he kept alive  ; and whom he would he set up  ; and whom he would he put down .
translation.kha: U la long uba khraw katta katta ba ki briew jong ki hima baroh , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki thylliej ki la sheptieng ïa u bad khynñiuh . Lada u la kwah ban pynïap ïano ïano u leh kumta ; lada u kwah ban ri pynim ïano ïano , u leh kumta . U pyndonburom lane pynjahburom ïa uno uno , uba u kwah .
Hynñiew U Jisu u la ud jylliew dara u la ong , Balei ba ki Briew mynnin ki kwah ban ïohi kambah ? Em , nga ong ïa phira ! Yn ym ai kum kata ka jingpynshisha ha film ki brup !
translation.en: And he sighed deeply in his spirit , and saith ,  Why doth this generation seek after a sign ? verily I say unto you , There shall no sign be given unto this generation .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la pyndih buaid ïa la u kpa ha kata ka miet shwa , bad kata ka khun kaba ar ka leit ïathiah shongkha malu u . Ha Kanneh ka kyndok ruh u la bujli shaba palat kat haduh ba um tip ei ei shaphang tala .
translation.en: And they made their father drink wine that night also : and the younger arose , and lay with him  ; and he perceived not when she lay down , nor when she arose .

translation.kha: Baroh ki ïaroh ïa nga borabor , bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong de kim ju heh noh na nga .
translation.en: My glory was fresh in me , and my bow was renewed in my hand .

translation.kha: La thok ïa ki na ka bynta jong ngi ruh ïa kiba la pynpdang kum kiba khor , kiba jingieit ha uta uba la pynmih na ka jingïap ïa U Jisu uba U Troas jong ngi .
translation.en: But for us also , to whom it shall be imputed , if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead ;
Confounded be all they that serve graven images , that boast themselves of idols : worship him , all ye gods .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba mane bleithaw kin shah pynlehrain , baroh ki blei ki dem ngon ha khmat jong U  Trai .

translation.en: The lion hath roared , who will not fear ? the Lord  God  hath spoken , who can but prophesy ?
translation.kha: Haba u sing u kyrhuh , uei uba lah ban lait na ka jingtieng ? Haba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u kren , uei uba lah ban lait khlem pynbna ïa ka khubor jong u ?
Hato me tip kumno ki lyoh ki per ha ka sahit bneng , ka jingtrei jong ka jingtbit Bakhraw jongngi U Blei ?
translation.en: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds , the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge ?

translation.kha: U lyngdoh u ong , Ngam anna shuh u kpu paidbah , kein sa tang u kpu ba la pynkyntang ; phi lah don bam ïa u tang lada ki rangbah jong phi kim shym la ïathiah shongkha dang shen .
translation.en: And the priest answered David , and said , There is no common bread under mine hand , but there is hallowed bread  ; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women .

translation.kha: Haba u Sisera u tip ba u Barak u la leit kiew shaei u Lur Tabor ,
translation.en: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor .
And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known .
translation.kha: U Jisu , da ka ktien kaba eh u la hukum ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid ban ym ïathuh ïano ïano ba u long uei .
Mynmiet , thoh ïa kane ka jingrwai . Hikai ïa ka ha ki Israel , khnang ba ka kan ïong kum ka sakhi pyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: Now therefore write ye this song for you , and teach it the children of Israel : put it in their mouths , that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Da sngap ha shuwa ba pher jubab . Lada phim ai kumta , phi hir babha bieit sad shah rkhiebeiñ .
translation.en: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it , it is folly and shame unto him .

translation.kha: Kumta u Petros u la ïa-ong ha ka , Balei ba ma phah bad u tnga jrong phasi , Phi kut jingmut ban tynjuh ïa U Mynsiem jong U Trai ? Ki samla kiba la tep ïa u tnga jong pha ki la anna mynta ha ka jingkhang , bad ngin bah noh! ïa pham ruh shabar !
translation.en: Then Peter said unto her , How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord ? behold , the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door , and shall carry thee out .
Say not , I will do so to him as he hath done to me : I will render to the man according to his work .
translation.kha: Wat ong ,  Ngan leh ïa u kumba u la leh ïa nga ! Ngan leh kylliang kumba u la leh !

U Mesha u la jubab , Ngin ïaleit loit baroh , kynthup ki khun jong ngi haduh ki thnum jong ngi . Ngin ïalam ïa ki khun shynrang malade ki khup kynthei jong ngi , lem dara ki langbrot mala ki blei , Bad ki masi jong ngi , namar ngi dei ban pynjrong ka jingkhawai ban pyndonburom ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And Moses said , We will go with our young and with our old , with our sons and with our daughters , with our flocks and with our herds will we go  ; for we must hold a feast unto the  Lord .

Belshazzar , whiles he tasted the wine , commanded to bring the golden and silver vessels which his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken out of the temple which was in Jerusalem  ; that the king , and his princes , his wives , and his concubines , might drink therein .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïadih , u Belshassar u la ai hukum ban wallam ha ki khuri ksiar bad rupa bad ha ki pliang kiba u Nebukhadnessar u kpa jong u , u la rah noh na ka Templ kaba ha Jerusalem . U syiem u la phah shim ïa ki khnang ba ma u , ki rangbah donburom jong u , ki tnga jong u , bad ki tnga kliar jong u ki lah ban dih na ki .
Sneng pynbeit ïa la u khun bad phi lah banbeiñ sngewsarong dorbar ïa u . Un ym long daw ïa phi ban shah lehkai .
translation.en: Correct thy son , and he shall give thee rest  ; yea , he shall give delight unto thy soul .
Now the parable is this : The seed is the word of God .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingmut jong ka pharshi : U symbai u long ka ktien U Blei .
Kauda ka ri ba phin sa ïohkynti kam dei kum ka ri Ijipt ha kaba phi shong mynshuwa . Hangta , haba phi bet ïa u symbai , Phin hap ban da trei shitom ban ai um ïa ki lyngba ;
translation.en: For the land , whither thou goest in to possess it , is not as the land of Egypt , from whence ye came out , where thou sowedst thy seed , and wateredst it with thy foot , as a garden of herbs :
Moreover the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,

Lada ki briew ki la lait im na ki bor ba pynpyut jong ka pyiar da ka jingtip jongno ki ïa U Jisu Khristan umbah U Trai bad U Nongpynim jong ngi , bad nongap ki ngat biang bad shahjop ha ki , koum kita ki briew ki don ha ka jinglong kaba kham sniew ha kaba kut ban ïa kaba ki la long ha kaba sneng .
translation.en: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ , they are again entangled therein , and overcome , the latter end is worse with them than the beginning .

translation.kha: Ka pansngiat tud long ka jingpynsah kynmaw ha ka Templ jong U Trai ha ka jingñiewburom ïa u hadien , u Tobijah , u Jedaïah , bad u Jehoahas .
translation.en: And the crowns shall be to Helem , and to Tobijah , and to Jedaiah , and to Hen the son of Zephaniah , for a memorial in the temple of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka sur ka la ong ha u , Ïeng joit , ko Peres ; to pynsep nabar to bam !
translation.en: And there came a voice to him ,  Rise , Peter  ; kill , and eat .

translation.kha: Ïa ka nongbah bad baroh kiba don ha ka dei ban pynjot tliw kum ka jingangnud ha U Trai . Thang ïa ka Rahab ka nuti bad ïa ka longïing Long jong ka yn pyllait im , namar ka la pynrieh ïa ki nongsyntiat jngai ngi .
translation.en: And the city shall be accursed , even it , and all that are therein , to the  Lord  : only Rahab the harlot shall live , she and all that are with her in the house , because she hid the messengers that we sent .

translation.kha: Ngan ïai lehkmen bad shadkmen , namar U Trai U Blei u long u nongpynïaid jong nga .
translation.en: Yet I will rejoice in the  Lord  , I will joy in the God of my salvation .

Gather the people together , men , and women , and children , and thy stranger that is within thy gates , that they may hear , and that they may learn , and fear the  Lord  your God , and observe to do all the words of this law :
translation.kha: Khot lang ïa ki shynrang , ïa ki kynthei , bad ïa ki khynnah baroh , bad ïa ki nongwei ruh kiba shong ha ki shnong jong phi , khnang ba uwei pa uwei un ïohsngew ïa ka bad un nang ban burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai jong U .

translation.en: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Kumta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki leh ïa kata baroh kaba U  Trai  u la hukum lyngba u Moses .
U Tiras u la ong ha nga , To ïathuh ïa u syiem bad ïa ka kmie jong u pun wan hiar na ki khet jong ki , Namar ba ki pansngiat ba-beit jong ki , ki la hap noh na ki khlieh jyllang ki .
translation.en: Say unto the king and to the queen , Humble yourselves , sit down : for your principalities shall come down , even the crown of your glory .

translation.kha: laispah tylli ki ut ai dud lem bad ki khunlung jong ki , sawphew tylli ki musli kynthei sad shiphew tylli ki masi kyrtong , arphew thlia ki kada kynthei bad shiphew tylli ki kada shajrong .
translation.en: Thirty milch camels with their colts , forty kine , and ten bulls , twenty she asses , and ten foals .
And though they say , The  Lord  liveth  ; surely they swear falsely .
translation.kha: Wat la phi kam ba phi mane ïa U  Trai  , phim shym mut kumba phi ong .
Ym don myntor , ym don jingleh byrtong , Kaba lah ban pyndonkam pyrshah ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . Mynta ki briew kin ïakren shaneng ki Israel , ‘ khmied aïu U blang u la leh !’
translation.en: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob , neither is there any divination against Israel : according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel , What hath God wrought !

translation.kha: ngat ki la wan poi ha Eli , ha kaba la don khat-ar tylli ki umpohliew bad hynñiewphew tylli ki dieng Tharai ; bad hangta ki la ïasher dara rahah um .
translation.en: And they came to Elim , where were twelve wells of water , and threescore and ten palm trees : and they encamped there by the waters .
How long wilt thou speak these things ? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind ?
translation.kha: Hato me la dep ka jingkren jong me kaba kum ka lyer ?

translation.en: And he said unto her ,  For this saying go thy way  ; the devil is gone out of thy daughter .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong ïa ka ,  Namar kata ka jubab , khie leit phai pat sha ïing , ha kaba phan shem ba u ksuid u la mihnoh na ka khun jong pha !
Katto katne na u shabi ki la hap ha ka jaka mawleiñ , bun haba ki jingthung ki la khluit , ki la tyrkhong noh! Namar ka khyndew kam don kano kano ka jingsngem .
translation.en: And some fell upon a rock  ; and as soon as it was sprung up , it withered away , because it lacked moisture .

translation.kha: Wat la ka Babilon ka lah ban kiew sha suiñbneng bad tei ka kut baskhem hangta , ngan dang ïai phah hi ïa ki briew banbeiñ pynjot ïa ka . Ma nga , U Trai nga la kren .
translation.en: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven , and though she should fortify the height of her strength , yet from me shall spoilers come unto her , saith the  Lord .
And many of the people believed on him , and said , When Christ cometh , will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done ?
translation.kha: Hynrei bun na uta u paidbah u la ngeit ha u bad u la ong ,  Haba U Messaïah un wan , hato un leh kham bun ki kambah ban ïa kaba une u briew u la leh ?

Kartan kaba kynjah longsyiem ka Jeroboam , kaba shikhung ka long kaba dap da ki briew ! Shisien la pyndonburom da ka pyrthei , mynta ka long kum ka riewkynthei ; kaba donburom tam na ki nongbah ka la kyllon sha ka jinglongmraw .
translation.en: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger , and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel , and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger !
When the even was come , they brought unto him many that were possessed with devils : and he cast out the spirits with his word , and healed all that were sick :
translation.kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , ki briew ki la wallam sha U Jisu shibun kiba la don ki ksuid hapoh jong ki . U Jisu u la beh noh ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid da ka ktien bad u la pynkhiah ïa baroh kiba la shitom .

translation.en: And Moses went out , and told the people the words of the  Lord  , and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people , and set them round about the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la mihnoh bad ïathuh ha uta u paidbah ïa kaba U  Trai  u la ong . U la lumlang hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam bad u la buh ïa ki sawdong ka Ïingjaiñ .
Pha la dei ban ym rung shabi ka nongbah jong ki briew jongngi nga ban risa beiñ halor ki jingiashah shitom jong ki bad ngab kurup ïa ka speh jong ki ha ka sngi ka jingjot jong ki .
translation.en: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of my people in the day of their calamity  ; yea , thou shouldest not have looked on their affliction in the day of their calamity , nor have laid hands on their substance in the day of their calamity  ;

translation.kha: Ïa ka metïap jong u la rhah biang shaw Jerusalem khashor u khuslai bad la ter ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid .
translation.en: And they brought him on horses : and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David .
This is the interpretation of the thing : MENE  ; God hath numbered thy kingdom , and finished it .
translation.kha: Bad kane ka dei ka jingmut jong ka :  Ka dak jingkheiñ  , U Blei u la kheiñ ïa ki sngi jong ka hima jong phi bad u la wallam ïa ka sha ka jingkut ;
Ko ki khuid jong nga , ka jingieit jong ngi kam dei ban long tang da ki ktien dara ka jingkren ; ka dei ban long ka jingneit kaba shisha , kaba pynpaw ïa lade da ka kam .
translation.en: My little children , let us not love in word , neither in tongue  ; but in deed and in truth .

translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ka jingïapthngan sad ki khrawburom ba kin pynïap ïa ki khuid jong pha , Bad ngan phah ïa ka jingpah , ka jinglehhok thom , badno ka thma ban pynjop ïa pha . Ma nga , U Terah , nga la kren .
translation.en: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts , and they shall bereave thee  ; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee  ; and I will bring the sword upon thee . I the  Lord  have spoken it .
Shall not they teach thee , and tell thee , and utter words out of their heart ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ai ba ki riewstad mynbarim kin hikai ïa me , to sngap ïa kaei kaba ki don ban ong .
Kam long kaba den ban pynlong ïa u briew barli lui ngab siew ïa ka kuna ; ka pynkylla khongpong ïa ka jingbishar bahok haba ki briew kiba bol ki shah pynmih .
translation.en: Also to punish the just is not good , nor to strike princes for equity .
And the  Lord  did according to the word of Moses  ; and he removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh , from his servants , and from his people  ; there remained not one .
translation.kha: bad U  Trai  ruh u leh kumba u Moses u la kyrpad . Ki skain ki phet noh na u Pharaoh , na ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad na ki briew jong u ; wat tang uwei ruh um sah shuh .
Ki la phai tait sawdong Hynrei kim shem la ïohi ïano ïano pat ; tang U Jisu u la don bad ki .
translation.en: And suddenly , when they had looked round about , they saw no man any more , save Jesus only with themselves .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa phi la pynshitom kitab phi dei ban ïoh .
translation.en: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked : judgment and justice take hold on thee .

translation.kha: Kumta haba ki nong Samaria ki la wan ha u , ki la kyrpad ïa u ban sawa bad ki , bad U Jingsuk u la sah hangta ar sngi .
translation.en: So when the Samaritans were come unto him , they besought him that he would tarry with them : and he abode there two days .
For though I be absent in the flesh , yet am I with you in the spirit , joying and beholding your order , and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ .
translation.kha: Naba wat la ngam don ryngkat ha ka met , pynban nga don bad phi ha ka mynsiem , bad nga kmen haba nga ïohi ïa ka jingkut jingmut kaba skhem da kaba phi ïa-ïeng lang ha ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Khrist .
U Nongthaw jong pha un long kum u tnga ïa pha — U Trai Badonbor Baroh long ka kyrteng jongngi u . U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel un pynim ïa pha — u long u nongsynshar jngai ka Pyrthei baroh .
translation.en: For thy Maker is thine husband  ; the  Lord  of hosts is his name  ; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel  ; The God of the whole earth shall he be called .

translation.kha: U Ahimaas , uba shongkurim ïa ka Basemath , kawei pat na ki khun kynthei jong u Solomon : ka ri Naphtali
translation.en: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali  ; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife :

translation.kha: Bad kumta u briew u long u nongshun Jong U Blei haba u shah pynsyaid ha ka jinglong ba kynja doh ; namar um kohnguh ïa ka hukum U blang , bad ha ka jingshisha um lah ban kohnguh ïa ka .
translation.en: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God : for it is not subject to the law of God , neither indeed can be .

translation.kha: Bud ïa ang , U Jisu u la jubab , bad ai kiba ïap kin tep ïa kaba ïap jong ki .
translation.en: But Jesus said unto him ,  Follow me  ; and let the dead bury their dead .

translation.kha: Naba ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la pita na u pyrta ban shah ïa ki ban pynkheiñ ïa ki kjat jong kita ki briew naba la shah sahnar , bad ban pynhiar noh ïa ki met! jongno ki na ki diengphna . Ki la kyrpad ïa kane namar ba ka la dei ka Sniew dohthang , bad kim kwah ba ki met ktien sah kumta ha ki diengïap ha ka sngi Shebat , naba ka sngi Sabbaton ka lama kyr-ang kaba Khuid .
translation.en: The Jews therefore , because it was the preparation , that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day , ( for that sabbath day was an high day , ) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken , and that they might be taken away .

Again , thou shalt say to the children of Israel , Whosoever he be of the children of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel , that giveth any of his seed unto Molech  ; he shall surely be put to death : the people of the land shall stone him with stones .
translation.kha: Ong ha ki Israel , uno uno na phi lane u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong phi , uba ai ïa uwei na ki khun jong u ha u blei Molekh , u dei ban shah lynthem maw ha u paidbah haduh ba un da ïap .

Hato mem ngeit , ko phyllaw , ba nga long ha U Kpa bad U Kpa u longsem ha ar ? Ki ktien kiba nga la kren ha phira , U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran , kim shym la Wan na nga hi . U Kpa , uba ïaisah bad nga , u trei la ka jong ka kam .
translation.en: Believest thou not that I am in the Father , and the Father in me ? the words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself : but the Father that dwelleth in me , he doeth the works .

translation.kha: U Jakob u ïathiah shongkha bad ka Rakkath ruh , dara u kham ieit ïa ka ban ïa ka Leah . Nangno u la trei na ka bynta u Jaban sa ingiew snem .
translation.en: And he went in also unto Rachel , and he loved also Rachel more than Leah , and served with him yet seven other years .

translation.kha: Ha ki khun jong phi! ki kyrhai ïa phi , ‘ Ka mutdur aïu kan ka jinglehniam ?’
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when your children shall say unto you , What mean ye by this service ?
Shall even he that hateth right govern ? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just ?
translation.kha: Hato phi rai pynrem ïa U Blei uba hok ? Hato phi pyrkhat ba  U  isih ïa ka jingbishar hok ?
Kumta ki shakri ki la bud ïa ki jingbthah jong u Absalom bad ki la pynïap ïa u Almon . Baroh kiwei pat ki khuid shynrang jong u Dabid ki kiei shalor ki khashor jong ki bad ki la pher krad .
translation.en: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded . Then all the king s sons arose , and every man gat him up upon his mule , and fled .

translation.kha: ïada me longkmie uba hok bad Uba khuid , te U Bel um wan don ïarap ïa me bad pynïong pat ïa ka ïing ka sem jong me kum ka pdeng .
translation.en: If thou wert pure and upright  ; surely now he would awake for thee , and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous .

translation.kha: Mar ïarung shab , ki leit sha ka Hall thiah u Ishbosheth , ha kaba u dong ïohthiah lyngkhai , bad ki la pynïap ïa u . Nangta ki la ot ïa ka khlieh jong u , ki rah ïa ka bad ki , bad ki ïaid baroh shi miat lyngba ka Them Jordan .
translation.en: For when they came into the house , he lay on his bed in his bedchamber , and they smote him , and slew him , and beheaded him , and took his head , and gat them away through the plain all night .

translation.kha: Nangta uwei pat u sangeh u la wan mynhynne na ka Templ bad u la pyrta da ka sur Kaba ïam sha Uta uba shon halor u lyoh , To pynmong ïa la ka rai bad to ot ïa ka jingot , namar ka to ka la peh ; ka pyrem ka la ih na ka bynta ka jingkit !
translation.en: And another angel came out of the temple , crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud , Thrust in thy sickle , and reap : for the time is come for thee to reap  ; for the harvest of the earth is ripe .

translation.kha: U rangbah bran ne u nongïalap balang u pynïaid ïa ki kam , bad u peit ïa kiei ba ki dei ban ar .
translation.en: An elder or a ministerial servant coordinates the work , usually following a checklist of things to do .

translation.kha: Nalor kane baroh kaba nga la pynbiang , ar la ai ruh ïa ka rupa badno ka ksing na ka jingdon jingem jong nga namar ka jingieit jong nga ïa ka Tabor lad U Blei! .
translation.en: Moreover , because I have set my affection to the house of my God , I have of mine own proper good , of gold and silver , which I have given to the house of my God , over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house ,
Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you , and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body s sake , which is the church :
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga kmen shaphang ki jingshahshitom jong nga na ka bynta jong phi , naba da ki jingshahshitom jong nga ha ka doh , nga ïarap ban pyndep ïa kaei kaba dang sah na ki jingshahshitom jong U Khrist na ka bynta ka balang , kaba long ka met jong u .

U Trai u ong , Haba kane baroh ka wia , ngan ai ïa u Gog ka jaka tep hangta ha Israel , ha ka lui ki nongot jingleit , shaphang jingiw ka duriaw-bah bapaw ; hangta yn tep ïa u Gog bad ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad ïa ka them yn khot ïa ka , ‘ Ka them ka kynthup shipai u Gog .’
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel , the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea : and it shall stop the noses of the passengers : and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude : and they shall call it The valley of Hamon–gog .
Then said Jeremiah unto them , Thus shall ye say to Zedekiah :
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la kren ha nga , bad nga la ïathuh ha ki rangbah kiba la phah sha nga ban ïathuh ha u Sedekaïah ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel u la ong ,
Ka jingbabe kaweh eh , ha kawei pat ka pipa , ka long ïa kiba la rangbah , kiba lyngba ka jingpynmlien ki lah ba pynïapher ïa kaba bha na naba sniew .
translation.en: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age , even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil .

translation.kha: Ngin leh ïa kiwei ktien baroh ïa kiba ngi la ong pun kun . Ngin ai ïa ki jingkñia sha ka blei jong ngi , ka Shem jong ka Bneng , bad ngin theh ïa ki jingtieng waiñ sha ka , kumba ma ngi badno ki kpa tymmen jong ine , u syep lad im’ bad ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki la ju leh ha ki shnong ka Judah bad ha ki surok bah ka Jerusalem . Nangta ngi don ka bam kyrhai , ngi manbha , bad ngim ju don jingjur .
translation.en: But we will certainly do whatsoever thing goeth forth out of our own mouth , to burn incense unto the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , as we have done , we , and our fathers , our kings , and our princes , in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem : for then had we plenty of victuals , and were well , and saw no evil .

translation.kha: Phin ym lait im ; yn kem ïa phi bad yn ai noh ïa phi sha u . Phin ïohi ïa u markhap bad kren ïa u da lade hi ; te nongbat phin wait sha Babilonia .
translation.en: And thou shalt not escape out of his hand , but shalt surely be taken , and delivered into his hand  ; and thine eyes shall behold the eyes of the king of Babylon , and he shall speak with thee mouth to mouth , and thou shalt go to Babylon .

translation.kha: Ki la ïada ïa ngi mynsngi bad mynsngi ha ka por baroh ba ngi anna bad ki haba ngi sharai ïa la ki langbrot .
translation.en: They were a wall unto us both by night and day , all the while we were with them keeping the sheep .

translation.kha: Ka Samaria kam shym leh pop shiteng na katei kaba pha la leh . Pha la leh kham ijli ban ïa kaban ka la kun . Ka jingbamsap jong pha ka pynlong ïa ki hynmen ki para kynthei jong pha ban i lui lui da kaba jynjar .
translation.en: Neither hath Samaria committed half of thy sins  ; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they , and hast justified thy sisters in all thine abominations which thou hast done .

translation.kha: U shem Jehoshaphat u kylli , Hato anna nongïathuhlypa hangne da umbah im’ lah ïa-ban Kylli na U Trai ? U rangbah pynïaidkam jongno ki kynhun u syiad Joram u jubab , U Elisha u khun jong u Shaphat u don hangne . U dei u nongïarap jong u Elijah .
translation.en: But Jehoshaphat said , Is there not here a prophet of the  Lord  , that we may enquire of the  Lord  by him ? And one of the king of Israel s servants answered and said , Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat , which poured water on the hands of Elijah .

translation.kha: Bad balei pa khuslai shaphang ki jaiñ ? Khmih kumno ki tiewkhlaw ki sanphew : kiei trei lap thain jaiñ na ka bynta ïa lap .
translation.en: And why take ye thought for raiment ? Consider the lilies of the field , how they grow  ; they toil not , neither do they spin :
Then shall the lambs feed after their manner , and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat .
translation.kha: Ha ki jaka bapra jong ki nongbah , ki khunlangbrot kin bam phlang bad ki blang samla kin shem ka jaka bam phlang .
Lada um don khun kynthei , ki hynmen ki para shynrang jyllang u kin ïohpateng ïa ka .
translation.en: And if he have no daughter , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren .

translation.kha: To U Trai un ai ki khun ha phi — ïa phi bad ïa ki khun ki ksiew jongki phi !
translation.en: The  Lord  shall increase you more and more , you and your children .
And all the prophets prophesied so , saying , Go up to Ramoth–gilead , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the king s hand .
translation.kha: Baroh na kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ïa kajuh .  Leit kiew pyrshah ïa ka Ramoth , bad phin jop ,  ki ong .  U  Trai  un ai ha phi ka jingjop .
U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki ïakren , kumta u la ong ha ki , Balei ba phi pynsalia ïa kane ka briew ? Ka Long kaei kaei kaba biang bad kaba itynnat ba ka la leh na ka byndi jong nga .
translation.en: When Jesus understood it , he said unto them ,  Why trouble ye the woman ? for she hath wrought a good work upon me .

translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Barukh , U Blei jong ka Israel , per don ban ong . Ngan pynsngap jar ïa ki jingsawa ka jingkmen bad ka jingshadkmen nabar ki jingsawa bakthang jong ki jingkhawai shongkurim . Ki briew hangne kin im ban ïohi ba kane ka jia .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes , and in your days , the voice of mirth , and the voice of gladness , the voice of the bridegroom , and the voice of the bride .
And the disciples came , and said unto him , Why speakest thou unto them in parables ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Balei me pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi haba me kren ha ki paidbah ?

U Blei u la ong ha u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen , To leit pangnud ki shalyntem hapoh ki kherub bad pyndap ïa ki kti jong phi da ki rnga dieng batskhem . Nongthaw bret ïa ki rnga halor ka nongbah . Nga la peit ïa u ba u leit .
translation.en: And he spake unto the man clothed with linen , and said , Go in between the wheels , even under the cherub , and fill thine hand with coals of fire from between the cherubims , and scatter them over the city . And he went in in my sight .
I thank God that I baptized none of you , but Crispus and Gaius ;
translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei ba ngam shym la pynbaptis ïano ïano na phi lait noh ïa u Krispos bad u Gaïos .
Bad na ka bynta jong ngi — balei ma ngi ngin kheiñduh ïa lade trai la ka kynta ?
translation.en: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour ?

translation.kha: Ma me , A Trai , me ai ka jingsuk bajanai ïa kito kiba batskhem ïa ka jingthmu jongnga ki bad kiba buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha me .
translation.en: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace , whose mind is stayed on thee : because he trusteth in thee .

translation.kha: Ki buh ïa u hapoh ka ruh bad ki la rah ïa u sha u syiem ka Babilonia . Ki la buh ïa u hapoh ki nongap , ba kumjuh ïa ka jingkyrhuh jongnga u yn ym sngewkwah pat halor ki lum jong ka Israhaïah .
translation.en: And they put him in ward in chains , and brought him to the king of Babylon : they brought him into holds , that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel .

translation.kha: Namar ba ngi la ïapom bad U Khrist , ngi ieit ba ngin im ruh bad u .
translation.en: Now if we be dead with Christ , we believe that we shall also live with him :
And Pharaoh s cup was in my hand : and I took the grapes , and pressed them into Pharaoh s cup , and I gave the cup into Pharaoh s hand .
translation.kha: Nga la bat ïa ka khuri jong u syiem ; kumta nga la shim ïa kita ki sohwaiñ bad nga khem ïa ki ha kata ka khuri , bad nga la ai ïa ka ha u .

U la long ma u , babha la ai ki jingai Sngewbha ha u bynriew ; u la thung katto katne jngut ban long ki apostol ; ïa kiwei , ki nongïathuhlypa ; ïa kiwei , ki nongïalap ; ïa kiwei pat , ki nongsharai tong bad ki nonghikai .
translation.en: And he gave some , apostles ; and some , prophets ; and some , evangelists ; and some , pastors and teachers ;

translation.kha: Kim dei ban ai shongthait ïa u tam ynda u dep tei pang ïa ka Jerusalem , bad pynlong ïa ka , ka nongbah ha kaba ka pyrthei baroh khwai ka ïajah .
translation.en: And give him no rest , till he establish , and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth .

translation.kha: Ma nga , u Sennakherib , u Patsha ka Asaraïah , nga kylli uei uba ai ha phi ba phin don ïa ka jingskhem katba ka Jesreel ka dang don ha ka jingshah kerkut .
translation.en: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria , Whereon do ye trust , that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem ?

translation.kha: Ha ka por shiteng sngi , ïa ka ri baroh kawei la tap da ka jingdum kaba la neh lai kyntu .
translation.en: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour .

translation.kha: Ka pyrthuh ka tyrkhong bad ka stai ei ; ka pyrthei baroh Kawei ka kylla sloit ; ka pyrthei bad ka sahit bneng , baroh ar , kin pyut noh .
translation.en: The earth mourneth and fadeth away , the world languisheth and fadeth away , the haughty people of the earth do languish .

translation.kha: Ka Shong ha ka jingkhang jong ka iing jongno ka lane ha ki jaka shong kiba Jong tam ha ka shnong ,
translation.en: For she sitteth at the door of her house , on a seat in the high places of the city ,
And thou shalt anoint the altar of the burnt offering , and all his vessels , and sanctify the altar : and it shall be an altar most holy .
translation.kha: Nangta pynkyntang ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad ïa ki tiar jong ka baroh da kaba synreit da ka umphniang pynsleh ; te kan sa long kaba kyntang nadong shadong .
Ym don eit eit na im’ uba im tang na ka bynta ïa lade , ym don isangsot uno na ngi suba ïap tang na ka bynta ïa lade .
translation.en: For none of us liveth to himself , and no man dieth to himself .

translation.kha: Ngan pyllait im ïa ki briew jong la na ki ri sha kiba la shim noh ïa ki ,
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will save my people from the east country , and from the west country  ;

translation.kha: Katba ngi dang pynlur ïa ki Lyngkha da ki masi lur , u la ong , badno ki kada ki dang ïabam phlang marjan .
translation.en: And there came a messenger unto Job , and said , The oxen were plowing , and the asses feeding beside them :
And the  Lord  spake unto the fish , and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u dohkha ban prie noh ïa u Jonah harud duriaw , bad u la leh kumta .

translation.en: The soul of the wicked desireth evil : his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes .
translation.kha: Ki briew ba-bymman ki kwah borabor ïa kaba sniew ; kim don jingisynei ïano ïano ruh .
Hynrei nga tip lut sanphew jong me , kaei ba me leh pynlang shano ba me wait . Nga ïatip kumno me bitar shla pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: But I know thy abode , and thy going out , and thy coming in , and thy rage against me .

translation.kha: Ngi ino ha phi ba ka don kaei kaei hangne kambah kham khraw ban ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That in this place is one greater than the temple .

This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven , who shall hear report of thee , and shall tremble , and be in anguish because of thee .
translation.kha: U briew baroh un khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka kyrteng jong phi .’

Ki lyngdoh ki sheng hapdeng jong ka Jordan haduh ban da pyndep lwait ïa kaei kaei baroh ba U Trai u la sah ïa u Joshua ban ong ïa u paidbah don leh . Kane ka dei kata kaba u Moses u la lei . U paidbah u la pynkloi shuh Shillong ka wah .
translation.en: For the priests which bare the ark stood in the midst of Jordan , until every thing was finished that the  Lord  commanded Joshua to speak unto the people , according to all that Moses commanded Joshua : and the people hasted and passed over .

translation.kha: Shtah ïa nga kum kato ka jingbah bangeit kaba nga ju sngewtynnat , mala wanrah ïa ka sha nga . Ynda per la thep bam ïa ka , ngan sa ai ha me ka jingshyrkhei bakthang shwa ba ngan ïaphah .
translation.en: And make me savoury meat , such as I love , and bring it to me , that I may eat  ; that my soul may bless thee before I die .

translation.kha: Ym don kano kano ka waitbnoh kaba lah ban pynmong ïa u ; Ym don sum ne khamtam ne waitsum kaba lah ban pynsngewrem ïa u .
translation.en: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold : the spear , the dart , nor the habergeon .

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam jrong ki Israel ki leit phai sha ka jaka shong dara .
translation.en: And Moses gat him into the camp , he and the elders of Israel .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Jeriel , u la kren shaphang u Ahab u khun jong u Kolaïah bad u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Maaseïah , kiba ïathuh ki jinglehmeng ha ka kirteng jongnga U . U la jong ba un aiti ïa ki ha ka bor jong u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia , u ban pynïap ïa ki ha khmat jong phin .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , of Ahab the son of Kolaiah , and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah , which prophesy a lie unto you in my name  ; Behold , I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon  ; and he shall slay them before your eyes  ;

translation.kha: Ki la ïadait sha jingïailong ka dewlynnong sha Parosh , ha kaba ki la ïakynduh ïa uwei u nongtuh myntor uba kyrteng u Bar Jisu , u Jiw uba la kam ba u un-long u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos , they found a certain sorcerer , a false prophet , a Jew , whose name was Bar–jesus :

translation.kha: Ym den ban bam ïa kano kano ka bynta jongki ka jingiaseng bam ba u lyndang u wanrah , ïa baroh dei ban thang lut khoit .
translation.en: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt : it shall not be eaten .
Thus Solomon finished the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house : and all that came into Solomon s heart to make in the house of the  Lord  , and in his own house , he prosperously effected .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Syiem Solomon u la pyndep ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , u da pyndep janai ïa kiei kiei baroh kumba u la buh jingmut ban leh ïa ki ,

translation.en: And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord . Then prayed they him to tarry certain days .
translation.kha: Kumta u la hukum ba yn pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist . Te ki la kyrpad ïa u ban sah bad ki sa khyndiat sngi .
Bad u la ong shuh shuh , Ka lama katai kaba mih na u brup katba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u .
translation.en: And he said ,  That which cometh out of the man , that defileth the man .
For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world : but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself .
translation.kha: Lymda kumta ka la dei ïa u ban shah bunsien naduh myn dang long ka pyrthei . Pynban , mynta haba ka por baroh ka la jan poi sha kaba kut , u la paw tang shisien hi , ban pyndam noh ïa ka pop da kaba kñia ïa lade .

Balei keiñ U Trai u ïalam ïa ngi sha kata ka ri ? Ngin shah pynïap ha ka thma , bun ki tnga jong ngi laiñ bad ki khun ki ki kin shahïap kem . Hato kdew long kaba kham bha ba ngin ïalaw phai pat sha Ijipt ?
translation.en: And wherefore hath the  Lord  brought us unto this land , to fall by the sword , that our wives and our children should be a prey ? were it not better for us to return into Egypt ?

And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee , and will keep the passover to the  Lord  , let all his males be circumcised , and then let him come near and keep it  ; and he shall be as one that is born in the land : for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof .
translation.kha: Lada u nongwei uba shong basah bad phi u kwah ban rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , nyngkong eh phi dei ban otsher shuwa ïa ki shynrang baroh na ka ïing jong u . Hadien kata , lah ban kheiñ ïa u kum u traishnong , bad nangta u lah ban ïashim bynta ha ka Jingkhawai Niam .
U Almon u la ne arphew ar snem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah malade u la synshar ar snem ha Jeroham .
translation.en: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned two years in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei keiñ kiba u Jehoash u la lai , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingshlur jong u ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Amasaïah u syiem ka Ïuodia , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Shem Ka Israhaïah .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash which he did , and his might , and how he fought with Amaziah king of Judah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
His own hands shall bring the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire , the fat with the breast , it shall he bring , that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Un wallam ïa ka khleiñ lem bad ka shadem jong u mrad ban ai kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang sha U  Trai .
wahbah phi bet ha ki lyngkha ha ka snem kaba phret , Phon nang bam ïa kaei katba la ot ha ka snem kiba hynriew , bad phin dang ni khiar shun bam haduh ba phin da ot ïa u jingthung ha —kata ka snem .
translation.en: And ye shall sow the eighth year , and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year  ; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingshongkurim dei ban ri burom da baroh , nabar ibha long Shi tnga ki dei ban shaniah iwei ïa iwei pat . U Blei un sa bishar ïa iba kiba alhia bun ïa kito katba kylliang .
translation.en: Marriage is honourable in all , and the bed undefiled : but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge .

translation.kha: Naba ngi la wallam ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi , ym tang ha ki ktien , hynrei ruh ha ka bor bad ha U Mynsiem Bakhuid , bad da ka jingsngewthuh purim ïa ka jingshisha jong ka . Pha tip kumno ngi la im mynba ngi la don bad phi ; ka la longïing na ka bynta ka jingbna jong pa hi .
translation.en: For our gospel came not unto you in word only , but also in power , and in the Holy Ghost , and in much assurance ; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake .
If thy brother be waxen poor , and hath sold away some of his possession , and if any of his kin come to redeem it , then shall he redeem that which his brother sold .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u Israel u kylla duk bad u hap ban die ïa la ka khyndew , u ba-ha-ïing bajan eh jong u , un thied pat ïa ka .

translation.en: And I will say to my soul , Soul , thou hast much goods laid up for many years  ; take thine ease , eat , drink , and be merry .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan ong ha lade , A u briew badonbok ! Me la don kiei kiei kiba bha baroh kiba me donkam na ka bynta bun snem . Wat khuslai ïa la ka jingim , to bam , to dih , bad to lehkmen ïa lade !’
Ïa kane ka khubor ka babha na U Blei ym haw ban ïanujor bad kaei kaei ruh .
translation.en: Few things are as fascinating as the good news from God .
Truly the light is sweet , and a pleasant thing it is for the eyes to behold the sun :
translation.kha: Ka long kaba bha ba yn lah ban lehkmen ïa ka jingshai itynnat jong ka sngi .

translation.en: Really good !
translation.kha: Bha bha !

translation.en: Blessed is the man that trusteth in the  Lord  , and whose hope the  Lord  is .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan kyrkhu ïa u briew uba buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong u ha nga .
khnang ban ïalam ïa phi ngab mane bad shakri ïa ki blei kiba tv pat ju mane ba-mynshuwa . Wai la kata kaba u kular ka urlong shisha , wat shahshkor ïa u .
translation.en: And the sign or the wonder come to pass , whereof he spake unto thee , saying , Let us go after other gods , which thou hast not known , and let us serve them  ;

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki , Katba phi anna kpu ? Khie leit bad khmih . wahbah ki la skhem , ki la ïathuh ïa u , Seng tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha shwa .
translation.en: He saith unto them ,  How many loaves have ye ? go and see .  And when they knew , they say , Five , and two fishes .

translation.kha: Ka khun jongki ka Herodias ka la wan bashapoh bad ka la shad , bad ka la pynsngewsih ïa u Oded bad ïa kiba u la khot sngewbha . Kumta u syiem u la ong ha sier ka khynwin , Kaei kaba phar kiaw ban ïew ? Ngan ai ïa pha ïa kano kano kaban pha kwah .
translation.en: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in , and danced , and pleased Herod and them that sat with him , the king said unto the damsel , Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt , and I will give it thee .
And Gideon came to Jordan , and passed over , he , and the three hundred men that were with him , faint , yet pursuing them .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka por , u Gideon bad la ki laispah ngut ki rangbah ki la wan sha ka wah Jordan bad jam sha shiliang ïa ka . Ki la thait hi ïan , hynrei ki dang beh kthong ïa ki nongshun .

translation.en: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters , that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass .
translation.kha: Katno kan long kaba kmen haba uwei pa uwei un ïoh kyrhai ka um na ka bynta ki jingthung bad ki jaka pynbamphlang bashngain ha kylleng na ka bynta ki kada bad ki masi .

Wat la katta , kam dei ka kamram jongu to ban bishar ïa kiba nabar . U Blei un sa bishar ïa ki . Hynrei hato kim dei ban bishar ïa ki dkhot na la ka jyllang ka kynhun hi ? Kumba ka jingïathuh bakhatduh ka ong , Pynmih noh ïa u briew uba sniew na ka kynhun Jong phi .
translation.en: But them that are without God judgeth . Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person .

translation.kha: Namar ngi sngewkwah ba don katto katne ngut ki briew hapdeng jongno phi kiba im ka jingrem paidbah bad ki bim Tertios ei ei laiñ tang ban lushia ha ka kam jyllang kawei pat ki briew .
translation.en: For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly , working not at all , but are busybodies .
Because thou hast kept the word of my patience , I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation , which shall come upon all the world , to try them that dwell upon the earth .
translation.kha: Namar ba pha la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga ban shahshitom , nga ruh ngan ri sumar ïa pha ha ka por jong ka jingjynjar ka ban wan ha ka pyrthei ban tynjuh ïa ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei .
Nangta u kpa jong u , u nguh ha u , Ale khah ïasan ko khun bad to doh ïa nga .
translation.en: And his father Isaac said unto him , Come near now , and kiss me , my son .

translation.kha: Haba katai ka por ka woh , kan ni ka duwan ïa U Trai ha ka ri Ijipt bad u rishot maw ba la pynkyntang sha U ha ka pud Ijipt .
translation.en: In that day shall there be an altar to the  Lord  in the midst of the land of Egypt , and a pillar at the border thereof to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Elieser u khur jong u Dodabahu , na ka Shong Mareshah , u la maham ïa u Jehoshaphat malade ong , Namar ba phi la ïaktah lok bad u Hoshaïah , U Trai un sa pynjot ïa kamai kaba Phin la tei . Bad ki liengbah ki la shah pynjot bad kim shym la lah ban ïaid dulir .
translation.en: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat , saying , Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah , the  Lord  hath broken thy works . And the ships were broken , that they were not able to go to Tarshish .

translation.kha: Uta u tymmen u ïohi ha madan shnong ïa uta u nongïaleh jinglanot bad u kylli ïa u , Na-ei phi wan ? shnong phin leit ?
translation.en: And when he had lifted up his eyes , he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city : and the old man said , Whither goest thou ? and whence comest thou ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Moses , myntan ngan pynhap bam na bneng ïa phi baroh . Ki briew ki dei baneh mih shabar man ka sngi ban lum kat ban wiang na ka bynta “kata ka sngi . Da kumta nga lah ngab tynjuh ïa ki ba shem la kin kohnguh ne em ïa ki jingbthah jong nga .
translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto Moses , Behold , I will rain bread from heaven for you  ; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day , that I may prove them , whether they will walk in my law , or no .

And he said unto her , What form is he of ? And she said , An old man cometh up  ; and he is covered with a mantle . And Saul perceived that it was Samuel , and he stooped with his face to the ground , and bowed himself .
translation.kha: Ka dur jong ka kaba kumno ?  u kylli .  Dei u tymmen uba wan mih ,  ka jubab .  U kup da ka barandi .  Kumta u Saul u tip ba uta u dei u Samuel , bad u dem ngon haduh khyndew da ka jingburom .
Nangta U Jisu u la otsher pat sha ka synagog , ha kaba u la ïohi ïa umbiah ïapshiliang ka kti .
translation.en: And he entered again into the synagogue  ; and there was a man there which had a withered hand .

translation.kha: U Petros u la bud na jngai bad u la leit shapoh ka phyllaw lad ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh . U shong hangta bad ki nongjop phira , u pyndik ïa put harud ding .
translation.en: And Peter followed him afar off , even into the palace of the high priest : and he sat with the servants , and warmed himself at the fire .

translation.kha: Kaei U balui Borabor Baroh u bor ïa ine ? Kumno u siew kylliang ïa ki kam u bynriew ?
translation.en: For what portion of God is there from above ? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high ?

translation.kha: U Blei u la khmih’ ïa ka pyrem bad u la ïohi ba ka la sngi , namar ki biria baroh ki la im ka jingim kaba sniew .
translation.en: And God looked upon the earth , and , behold , it was corrupt  ; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth .

translation.kha: Ko khun , to sngewthuh ïa kaei ba ang hikai ïa phi , bad Wat klet ïa kaei kaba nga ïathuh ïa phi ban kuna .
translation.en: My son , if thou wilt receive my words , and hide my commandments with thee  ;
And the  Lord  appeared unto him , and said , Go not down into Egypt  ; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u Isaak bad u ong ,  Wat leit sha ri Ijipt ; sah ha kane ka ri ha kaba nga la ong ha me ban sah .

translation.en: They said unto him , Grant unto us that we may sit , one on thy right hand , and the other on thy left hand , in thy glory .
translation.kha: Ki la jubab ,  Haba men shong halor ka khet jong me ha ka Hima kaba dap da ka burom jong me , ngi kwah ba men shah ïa ngi ban shong bad me , uwei sha kamon jong me bad uwei sha kadiang jong me .

Ka Ïoanna , uba u Ussah u tnga jong ka u long u rangbah pynbuaid ha ka ïingbishar jong u Heldai ; bad ka Susanna , bad bun kiwei pah ki kynthei kiba la pyndonkam ïa la ki jongngi ki jingïoh ban ïap ïa U Jingsuk bad ïa ki synran jong u .
translation.en: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod s steward , and Susanna , and many others , which ministered unto him of their substance .

But Jesus answered and said ,  Ye know not what ye ask . Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of , and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ?  They say unto him , We are able .
translation.kha: Phim tip ïa kaei kaba phi pan ,  U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki khun shynrang jong ka .  Hato phi lah ban dih ïa ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ïa kaba ngan sa dih ?   Ngi lah ,  ki la jubab .

baroh ki riewarsap ki leit bad ki ïaid baroh shi miet sha Beth Shan . Ki shim noh ïa ki met jong u Saul bad jong ki khun Shaneng jong u na kata ka kynroh , ki wallam pat ïa ki sha Jabesh , bad ki thang ïa ki hangta .
translation.en: All the valiant men arose , and went all night , and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth–shan , and came to Jabesh , and burnt them there .

translation.kha: ibha u Abner u wan sha u Dabid ha Hebron ryngkat dara arphew ngut ki rangbah , u Dabid u pynlong ka jingkhawai na ka bynta jrong ki .
translation.en: So Abner came to David to Hebron , and twenty men with him . And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast .

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei’ jongu phin un pynim ïa kita ki jaitbynriew katba phi nang leit ban knieh ïa ka ri jong ki , ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka bad shong hangta .
translation.en: When the  Lord  thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee , whither thou goest to possess them , and thou succeedest them , and dwellest in their land  ;
And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius , that the word of the  Lord  came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month , even in Chisleu  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Darius u long u patsha , ha ka sngi kaba saw jong u bnai uba khyndai ( u bnai Kisleb ) , U  Trai  u la ai ka khubor ha nga .

translation.en: The way of the just is uprightness : thou , most upright , dost weigh the path of the just .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me pynlong ka lynti kaba beit na ka bynta ki briew kiba bha ; ka surok kaba ki ïaid ka long kaba madan .

translation.en: Howbeit he refused to turn aside : wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib , that the spear came out behind him  ; and he fell down there , and died in the same place : and it came to pass , that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Asahel um shym sangeh ; kumta u Abner , da ka jingtynrah shadien ïa la u sum , u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh ba kumta u sum u da pei bla ha ka ingdong jong u . U Asahel u kyllon ïap ha madan , bad uwei pa uwei uba wan poi ha ka jaka ha kaba u kyllon u la sangeh bad ïeng hangta .

Wat la ki dieng donburom kim don soh bad ym don sohwaiñ ba mih ha ki dieng sohwaiñ , wat la u dieng Olib um sei ei ei bad ki lyngkien ktieh pynmih kew , wat la ki longsem baroh ki ïap bad ki sem masi ki thylli ,
translation.en: Although the fig tree shall not blossom , neither shall fruit be in the vines  ; the labour of the olive shall fail , and the fields shall yield no meat  ; the flock shall be cut off from the fold , and there shall be no herd in the stalls :

translation.kha: Hangta u Moses u la ong , Dei U Trai u ban ai ïa phi ka doh ban bam ha ka por janmiet bad kyrhai u kpu ha ka prie mynstep , namsop ba u la ïohsngew ïathuh katno phi la ïakhñium pyrshah ïa u . Haba phi khñium pyrshah ïa ngi , phi ïakhñium pahara keiñ pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And Moses said , This shall be , when the  Lord  shall give you in the evening flesh to eat , and in the morning bread to the full  ; for that the  Lord  heareth your murmurings which ye murmur against him : and what are we ? your murmurings are not against us , but against the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Peor u la peitmat shlip sha ka Borabor bad u la ong , Ko ki sa nong Israel jong nga ! Ka jingïatiplem jongngi nga ka sngur Shaphang ka mano ha kaba nga la im ha khmat U Blei haduh kane ka sngi .
translation.en: And Paul , earnestly beholding the council , said , Men and brethren , I have lived in all good conscience before God until this day .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ïa phi la pynshitom ruma phi dei ban ïohi .
translation.en: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked : judgment and justice take hold on thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha ki lumbah ka Israel ki dieng ktang Sei biang ki sla bad pynmih soh na ka bynta jong phi , ki briew jong nga , ki Eliel . Pi la jin ban wan noh sha la ka ri .
translation.en: But ye , O mountains of Israel , ye shall shoot forth your branches , and yield your fruit to my people of Israel  ; for they are at hand to come .

translation.kha: U jongu u la tip ba ki la kwah ban kylli ïa u , kumta u la ong ha ki , Nga la ong , ‘ Sa tyngka shipor phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , bad nangta sa shipor hadien Phon sa ïohi ïa nga .’ Hato dei kane kaba phi ïakylli la ma phi hi ?
translation.en: Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him , and said unto them ,  Do ye enquire among yourselves of that I said , A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me ?

translation.kha: Ïa ki briew ba-mutlop la ai ki kyrdan ba don iktiar katba ïa kiba riewspah la kun bymsuidñiew .
translation.en: Folly is set in great dignity , and the rich sit in low place .

translation.kha: phim dei ban lade ha ki lyngkha jong phi lane ot ïa u kew Uba shu mih hi lane kheit ïa ki soh na ki bsuh jong phi kiba phim shym la ïakhlad .
translation.en: A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you : ye shall not sow , neither reap that which groweth of itself in it , nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed .
Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens , that thou wouldest come down , that the mountains might flow down at thy presence ,
translation.kha: Balei ba mem kad arliang ïa ka sahit bneng bad wan hiar ? Ki lumbah kin ïohi ïa me bad khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

translation.en: And the ark of God was taken  ; and the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , were slain .
translation.kha: La knieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei , bad ki khun shynrang jong u Eli baroh ar ngut , u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki la shah pynïap .
bad nangta u bsuh ïa kita ki dieng lyngba ki kyrwoh ha baroh arliang kata ka synduk .
translation.en: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark , to bear the ark .

translation.kha: Wat Ladan Kito ki bym daiñ hok ban shah pynshitom ki dei ban thah na ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom , hato phi pyrkhat ba ma phi phin lait noh khlem shah pynïapmat ? Em , Phi dei ban dih na kane ka kyrni !
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken  ; and art thou he that shall altogether go unpunished ? thou shalt not go unpunished , but thou shalt surely drink of it .

translation.kha: Men ïohsngew ïa ka jingkyang jong katba shah nongbanbeiñ bad jong ki khunswet ; men bishar da kaba sngewlem ïa ki ; ba kumta ki briew kin ym pynïoh jingkyrkieh shuh .
translation.en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed , that the man of the earth may no more oppress .
And he said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? there is none good but one , that is , God : but if thou wilt enter into life , keep the commandments .
translation.kha: Balei me kylli na nga shaphang kaei kaba bha ?  la jubab U Jisu .  Don tang Uwei uba bha . To sumar ïa ki hukum lada me kwah ban rung sha ka jingim .

Ynda mynstep , u leit sha Katai ka khrud shnong , bad u ong ha ki briew naba don hangtei , Nga dei ma nga uba la sylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Jearim bad uba la pynpei ïa u ; phim dei kiba kitkhlieh na ka bynda tala . hynriew mano ba la pynïap ïa Kin baroh ?
translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , that he went out , and stood , and said to all the people , Ye be righteous : behold , I conspired against my master , and slew him : but who slew all these ?

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai un long u skhem jong ka pynrieh baroh ; uwei pa eiei baroh un mane ïa u kumto U Blei bad tip ïa u da kajuh ka kyrteng .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall be king over all the earth : in that day shall there be one  Lord  , and his name one .

Then thine handmaid said , The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable : for as an angel of God , so is my lord the king to discern good and bad : therefore the  Lord  thy God will be with thee .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ha lade ba ki kular jong phi , ko Kynrad , kin pynshngain ïa nga , namar ba u syiem u long kum u angel jong U Blei bad u lah ban pynïapher ïa kaba bha na kaba sniew . To U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un long lem bad phi !
Phi ki rangbah phira long kiba da stad , kiba sian bha , to shahshkor! mynta ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
translation.en: Hear my words , O ye wise men  ; and give ear unto me , ye that have knowledge .

translation.kha: Kan mut shwa ba kiba ngeit ha U Kiriath , kiba la ïap ki long kaba la jot nala keiñ .
translation.en: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma nga , U Trai , ngan ïaduna , bad ngan ym aiti noh ïa me sha ki briew kiba me bthing .
translation.en: But I will deliver thee in that day , saith the  Lord  : and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid .

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ïor jingmyntoi haba phi pynshlur bad ïaroh ïa ki .
translation.en: Children benefit when you encourage and commend them .

translation.kha: Lada ine uno u briew u ngat ïa ka jingpang ñiuhkhlieh , den ban ïasam ïa u ha u lyngkhot ,
translation.en: When the plague of leprosy is in a man , then he shall be brought unto the priest  ;

translation.kha: U Tlai un aiti ha phi ïa ki nongshun jong phi badno un pynkdor ïa ki hapoh ba ngin da shah pynjot lut thiaw .
translation.en: But the  Lord  thy God shall deliver them unto thee , and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction , until they be destroyed .

translation.kha: Katba ka dang shai , to teh ïa ka song jong me na ka bynshet ka jingshaniah ringmraw , khnang ba kin lah ban ïohi ïa me , bad nangta shah ïa ki banbeiñ khmih ïa me ba me mihnoh ha ka premmiet kumba me leit shata ka jingshah ringmraw .
translation.en: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight , as stuff for removing : and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight , as they that go forth into captivity .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïohi lut ïa ka buit jong ki bad u la ong ha ki ,
translation.en: But he perceived their craftiness , and said unto them ,  Why tempt ye me ?

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , ki kynhun shipai jong ka Mahalab bad ka Amnon , ryngkat bad kiba ïateh lok bad ki , ki mut , ki hiarthma ïa ka Judia .
translation.en: It came to pass after this also , that the children of Moab , and the children of Ammon , and with them other beside the Ammonites , came against Jehoshaphat to battle .

translation.kha: Nga thiah badno pyrshang ban pynjahthait ; nga khmih ban laitluid na ka jingpang jngai nga .
translation.en: When I say , My bed shall comfort me , my couch shall ease my complaint  ;

translation.kha: Ka la leh ïa kane bun sngi , hajuh ba u Apostol u la sngew salia eh ba u la phai Sawdong malade u la ong ha ita u mynsaw bymman , Ha ka kirteng jngai U Jisu Khereth de lawbah ïa me ban mihnoh na ka ! Utai u mynsiem bymdonkam u la mihnoh na ka ha kata hi ka khyllipmat .
translation.en: And this did she many days . But Paul , being grieved , turned and said to the spirit , I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her . And he came out the same hour .

translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh bakhiah ka ong , Ïa u briew uba nyngkong , u Adam , la thaw uba don jingim ; hynrei u Adam uba khatduh u la long U Mynhyndai uba ai jingim .
translation.en: And so it is written , The first man Adam was made a living soul ; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit .
And he became very hungry , and would have eaten : but while they made ready , he fell into a trance ,
