translation.kha: U la sngew thngan , bad u la kwah ban bam ei ei ; katba dang pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam , u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw .

To long u nongaplangbrot ïa la ki briew , A Trai , ki briew kiba me la jied . wai la ki shong saphred ha ka ri khlaw , ka don ka jaka bashispah sawdong jong ki . To ai ba kin leit malu bam na ki jaka phlang jingjahburom jong ka Bashan bad ka Gilead , kumba ki la leh mynshuwa la slem bah .
translation.en: Feed thy people with thy rod , the flock of thine heritage , which dwell solitarily in the wood , in the midst of Carmel : let them feed in Bashan and Gilead , as in the days of old .

translation.kha: Kumta ki shipai ki la leit nabar pynkheiñ ïa ki kjat jong uta uba nyngkong bad nongtih sa ïa ki jong uwei pat kiba la shah sahnarphna lak bad U Jisu .
translation.en: Then came the soldiers , and brake the legs of the first , and of the other which was crucified with him .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïohi lut ïa ka buit jong ki bad u la ong ha ki ,
translation.en: But he perceived their craftiness , and said unto them ,  Why tempt ye me ?
( 2 ) His miracles proved that he was God’s Son .
translation.kha: ( 2 ) Ki kambah jong u ki pynshisha ba u long u Khun U Blei .

translation.en: Judgment also will I lay to the line , and righteousness to the plummet : and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies , and the waters shall overflow the hiding place .
translation.kha: Ka jingbishar hok kan long u  sai-thew na ka bynta ka nongrim , bad ka jinglehhok kan long u  sai-sawar jong ka .  U phria un sar noh ïa baroh ki jingshukor ha kiba phi shaniah , bad ki jingshlei kin pynjot ïa ki jingsngewshngain jong phi .

translation.en: Thy riches , and thy fairs , thy merchandise , thy mariners , and thy pilots , thy calkers , and the occupiers of thy merchandise , and all thy men of war , that are in thee , and in all thy company which is in the midst of thee , shall fall into the midst of the seas in the day of thy ruin .
translation.kha: Ka spah jong ki mar khaïi jong pha baroh , ki maji jong pha baroh , ki misteri liengbah bad ki nongkhaïi jong pha baroh , uwei pa uwei u shipai halor ka liengbah — baroh , baroh ki la ngam jyllop ha ka duriaw mynba ka liengbah jong pha ka la shah pynjot .
Kumjuh ka jaka Bam phla kam biang ïa ki baroh ar ngut ban ïasah ryngkat , namsop ba ki don shibun eh ki jingri .
translation.en: And the land was not able to bear them , that they might dwell together : for their substance was great , so that they could not dwell together .
For I have given unto them the words which thou gavest me  ; and they have received them , and have known surely that I came out from thee , and they have believed that thou didst send me .
translation.kha: Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor kaba me la ai ha nga , bad ki la pdiang ïa ka ; ki tip ba ka long kaba shisha ba nga la wan na me , bad ki ngeit ba me la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: He hath cast me into the mire , and I am become like dust and ashes .
translation.kha: U la bret ïa nga ha ka ktieh ; ngam da ïapher shuh na ka jaboh .
Un tap ïa me da ki thapniang jong u ; men long shngain hapoh ka jingsumar jong u ; ka jinglyngngoh baïaineh jong u kan ïada bad kyrshan ïa me .
translation.en: He shall cover thee with his feathers , and under his wings shalt thou trust : his truth shall be thy shield and buckler .

translation.kha: U shakri uba sian un ïoh long khleh Halor u khunlung bymlarkam jongu u kyndiang bad ïohpdiang shi bynta na ka jinghiarpateng .
translation.en: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame , and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren .

translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , to sngew ïa kane ka khubor kaba U Trai u la kren shaphang jong phi , ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei kaba u la wan ïalam na ka ri Ijipt ;
translation.en: Hear this word that the  Lord  hath spoken against you , O children of Israel , against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt , saying ,

translation.kha: Kumta u Pontios u la longing hiar bad u la ong ha kita ki rangbah , Dei ma nga uta uba phi ïawad . Phi nongkam aïu ?
translation.en: Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius  ; and said , Behold , I am he whom ye seek : what is the cause wherefore ye are come ?

translation.kha: Hynrei don U Bela ha bneng , uba pynpoh ïa ki jingmaïan . U la pyntip ïa u syiem Kynrad kaei ka don jia ha ka lawei . Mynta ngan ïathuh ha phin ïa ka jingphohsniew , ka jingïohipaw kaba phi lai eh mynba phi dang ïohthiah .
translation.en: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets , and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days . Thy dream , and the visions of thy head upon thy bed , are these  ;

translation.kha: Ïa phi ym dei Ban khor ‘ ko Nonghikai ,’ ñiar ba Phin baroh phi ïalong ma ryngkat bad to tieng uwei U Nonghikai .
translation.en: But be not ye called Rabbi : for one is your Master , even Christ  ; and all ye are brethren .

translation.kha: ( Ki long kijuh ki jingthaw kiba nga ïohi harud ka wahbah Khebar ) .
translation.en: And the cherubims were lifted up . This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar .

translation.kha: U sahmiet Jehoïakim u la lum khajna na ki briew kat kum ka jingïadon spah jongu ki , khnang ban pynmih ïa ka pisa ba dei ban siew ïa ka bai thuh syiem kumba la dawa da u syep Ijipt .
translation.en: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh  ; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh : he exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land , of every one according to his taxation , to give it unto Pharaoh–neco .

translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha u Jetur , u khun nyngkong jong u , Haei , pynïap ïa ki ! Hynrei ita u khynnah um shym sei ïa la ka waitlam . Um sngew nud , nongmareh ba u ïalang long tyngkan u khynnah .
translation.en: And he said unto Jether his firstborn , Up , and slay them . But the youth drew not his sword : for he feared , because he was yet a youth .

translation.kha: U paidbah u jubab , Da lei lei ngin ym ioh ïa U Trai ban shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei !
translation.en: And the people answered and said , God forbid that we should forsake the  Lord  , to serve other gods  ;
And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them , that they heard that they were their neighbours , and that they dwelt among them .
translation.kha: Lai sngi hadien kata ka jingïateh lok , ki Israel ki sa tip ba kine ki briew ki dei shisha kiba shong basah hajan .

Kumba ki patlun lyngkot ki biang sbiak sawdong ka syngkai , kumta nga la thmu ba bhor ki briew jong ka Israel bad Joïada kin snoh skhem ha nga . Nga la leh ïa ken khnap ba kin ïoh long ki briew jong nga bad wallam ka jingïaroh bad ka burom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ; hynrei kim shym kohnguh ïa por .
translation.en: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man , so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah , saith the  Lord   ; that they might be unto me for a people , and for a name , and for a praise , and for a glory : but they would not hear .

translation.kha: U Trai un ïasaid ïa ka kam jongu ki na ka bynta jong ki , bad un byrngem ïa ka jingkem jngai uno uno uba byrngem ïa ki .
translation.en: For the  Lord  will plead their cause , and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingstad kaba wan najrong nyngkong eh ka long kaba sngur ; ka long kaba pynïashong suk , kaba jemnud bad kaba Pynlong paralok ; ka dap da ka jinglehisynei bad ka pynmih ïa ka jingseisoh ha ki kam babniah ; ka lait na ka jingshah shiliang bad ka jingarsap .
translation.en: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure , then peaceable , gentle , and easy to be entreated , full of mercy and good fruits , without partiality , and without hypocrisy .

translation.kha: Katto u Abimelekh dara ka kynhied jong u ki tur pynkloi sha Khmut ban ïada ïa ka khyrdop shnong , kiwei pat ki ar kynïan ki tur ïaleh ïa ki briew hapoh lynghoh bad ki pynïap ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: And Abimelech , and the company that was with him , rushed forward , and stood in the entering of the gate of the city : and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields , and slew them .
Let no man deceive you by any means : for that day shall not come , except there come a falling away first , and that man of sin be revealed , the son of perdition ;
translation.kha: Wat shah ïano ïano ban shukor ïa phi ha kano kano ka rukom . Naba ka Sngi kan ym wan tad ynda ka Jingïaleh pyrshah ka jia bad ba uta Uba Sniew u mihpaw ïa uba la buh lypa na ka bynta ka dujok .
Haba u Ham , u kpa jong u Kanaan , u la ïohi ba u khop jong u , u la lyngkhuit , u la miej shakor bad ïathuh ha la ki hynmen shynrang baroh ar ngut .
translation.en: And Ham , the father of Canaan , saw the nakedness of his father , and told his two brethren without .

translation.kha: Ki jingjam jong u ki la ju long kiba skhem , hynrei mynnin u jinglute ; u kyllon — u shah lehbeiñ ha la ka jong ka jingai jingtem jong u hi .
translation.en: The steps of his strength shall be straitened , and his own counsel shall cast him down .
And he said unto them , Hinder me not , seeing the  Lord  hath prospered my way  ; send me away that I may go to my master .
translation.kha: Hynrei u ong ,  Wat pynsah shuh ïa ngi . U  Trai  u la ai jingjop ïa ka jingleit jong nga ; to shah ngan leit phai pat sha la u kynrad .

U tharai un pyllait ïa phi na ka jait jingpang baroh , bad un ym pynngat ha ph kam tang kawei ruh na ki jingpang kiba sngewtriem ba phi la mad ha ka ri Ijipt , hynrei un pyndih ïa ki ha ki nongshun jong phi .
translation.en: And the  Lord  will take away from thee all sickness , and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt , which thou knowest , upon thee  ; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee .

translation.kha: Balei ba u briew naba jaiñtapkhmat um ju mih na la ïing ? Ïa kaei u pyrkhing ? Ïa ki sopti ?
translation.en: The slothful man saith , There is a lion in the way  ; a lion is in the streets .

translation.kha: U bieit u kren pynlang ïai kren . Ym khong mano mano batip kaei ka ban Jia marbud , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban ïathuh kan jia aïu hadien ba ngi ïap .
translation.en: A fool also is full of words : a man cannot tell what shall be  ; and what shall be after him , who can tell him ?

translation.kha: Kam da donkam ïa nga ban pynrem ïa me ; la pynrem ïa me da Kaei pa Kawei ka kyntien ba me kren .
translation.en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee , and not I : yea , thine own lips testify against thee .

translation.kha: U la ïalam duh ïa la ki briew nabar ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki , bad ki la shongduh ha ki nongrit sawdong ïa ka Bethrehob .
translation.en: And his men that were with him did David bring up , every man with his household : and they dwelt in the cities of Hebron .

translation.kha: Mynta , ko Job , ïasuk noh! bad U Balei Bad sangeh ino na ka pynjrong ïa u khim u nongshun ; lada phi leh kumta , te un sa kyrkhu ïa phi .
translation.en: Acquaint now thyself with him , and be at peace : thereby good shall come unto thee .
Yea , I will cause men to walk upon you , even my people Israel  ; and they shall possess thee , and thou shalt be their inheritance , and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men .
translation.kha: Ngan sa wallam pat ïa phi , ki briew jong nga ki Israel ban shong biang ha ka ri . Kan long noh ka ri jong phi bad ki khun jong phi kin ym kyrduh bam .

Ki kmie ki kpa kim dei ban shah pynïap Naaman ki kur runar ki khun jongki ki , bad ki khwan ruh kim dei don shah pynïap namar ki kam runar ki kmie ki kpa jngai ki ; u brai u dei ban shah pynkup tang namar ka kam runar jong u hi .
translation.en: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers : every man shall be put to death for his own sin .

translation.kha: Nangta u Mynno bad u wan ïalam sa hynñiew ngut kiwei pat ki mynsiem wat kiba kham sniew ban ïa u , bad ki wan shongsah hangta . Kumta haba baroh ka la khup , uta u briew un don ha ka jinglong katba khampoh sniew ba-bang ïa kaba u la long ha kaba sdang . Kane ka hir kaei ka baneh jia ha ki briew kaba sniew jong kane ka por .
translation.en: Then goeth he , and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself , and they enter in and dwell there : and the last state of that man is worse than the first . Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation .

translation.kha: Hynrei yn sa ïalam ïa ine shata rud duriaw ha kadei ka dewlynnong .
translation.en: Howbeit we must be cast upon a certain island .

translation.kha: ( Ïa u Barnabas la buh ha ka byndi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin kob ha jia ha ka nongbah , bad namar ka jingpynïap briew . )
translation.en: ( Who for a certain sedition made in the city , and for murder , was cast into prison . )

translation.kha: Baroh ki rangbah synshar lad u ki la ïeng hajan jyllang u , katba ka kynjah ki shiphew ïada syiem ki Dang ïaid na khmat jong u . Ki hynriewspah ngut ki shipai kiba la bud ïa u na Gath ki la ïaid ,
translation.en: And all his servants passed on beside him  ; and all the Cherethites , and all the Pelethites , and all the Gittites , six hundred men which came after him from Gath , passed on before the king .

translation.kha: To pynim ïa ngi , A TRAI’ , U Blei jong ngi , mala wallam pat ïa ngi nongput ki jingpyniwbih , ba ngi lah ban sngewnguh malu ïar ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me .
translation.en: Save us , O  Lord  our God , and gather us from among the heathen , to give thanks unto thy holy name , and to triumph in thy praise .

translation.kha: U la leit biang shat ka jaka ïoh ha ka por khyndai baje , bad u la ieh katto kattne ngut ki rangbah kaba ïa-ïeng hangta khlup kam ,
translation.en: And he went out about the third hour , and saw others standing idle in the marketplace ,
Then I saw , and considered it well : I looked upon it , and received instruction .
translation.kha: Nga peit ïa kane , nga la pyrkhat shaphang jong ka , bad nga ïoh ka jinghikai na ka :
U syiem Serksis u la pynlong ka jingpyntrei jubor ïa ki briew kiba ha ki rud duriaw jong ka hangta jong u kumjuh ruh ïa kito ki briew kiba shong bashapoh .
translation.en: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land , and upon the isles of the sea .
And ye , in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing , lest ye make yourselves accursed , when ye take of the accursed thing , and make the camp of Israel a curse , and trouble it .
translation.kha: Hynrei phim dei ban rah ïa kano kano kaba dei ïa ka ban pynjot ; lada phi leh kumta , phin wanrah ka jingjynjar bad ka jingpynjot ïa ka jaka shong dara ki Israel .

translation.en: And he brought the other ram , the ram of consecration : and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u wanlam ïa u langbrot uba ar uba long na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang ïa ki lyngdoh , bad u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .
Ka kham bha ban longsyiem kaba sngew bad sah duk ban ïa kaba long uba meng badno ïoh bynta na ka jinglute jong ki .
translation.en: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly , than to divide the spoil with the proud .
And if it spread much abroad in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a plague .
translation.kha: Lada kata ka dak ka pur , u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid ; u la bit jingpang .
U la them bad u la ïohi ïa ki jaiñsop linen , hynrei um smam la sping shapoh .
translation.en: And he stooping down , and looking in , saw the linen clothes lying  ; yet went he not in .

translation.kha: U Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , u tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem’ , bad u Menahem u ai ïa u laiphew seh ton ka rupa ïa-ban ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong u ban at pynkhraw ïa u Menahem halor ka ri .
translation.en: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land : and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver , that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand .

translation.kha: Phi dem ban peiñ bha ban pynbiang ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei lad ka Bneng u donkam na ka bynta ka Templ jong u , bad ban pynthikna un ym bitar ïa nga lynti ïa kito ki ban syier hawei jong nga .
translation.en: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven , let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven : for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons ?

translation.kha: Kumjuh ïa ki balang la kai pynkhih ha ka jingngeit bad ki la nang roi ha ka jingbna briew’ man ka sngi .
translation.en: And so were the churches established in the faith , and increased in number daily .
For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father , saying , If I bring him not unto thee , then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever .
translation.kha: Shuh shuh , nga la bahkhlieh ha i pa da la ka jingim na ka bynta u para . Nga ong ïa i ba lada ngam wan ïalam pat ïa u para sha i , ngan sa kit pop ma nga shi rta .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , as David sat in his house , that David said to Nathan the prophet , Lo , I dwell in an house of cedars , but the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  remaineth under curtains .
translation.kha: U syiem Dabid mynta u shong ha ka ïingsyiem jong u . Ha kawei ka sngi u phah khot ïa u Nathan u nongïathuhlypa bad ong ha u ,  Hangne nga shong ha ka ïing ba la thaw da ki dieng Kedar , hynrei ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  la buh ha ka ïingjaiñ !
U Dabid u la shongkurim ïa ka Ahinoam kaba na Jesreel , bad mynta ka Abel ruh ka la longkmie ka tnga jongki u .
translation.en: David also took Ahinoam of Jezreel  ; and they were also both of them his wives .

translation.kha: Haba nga la sngew Rumah ka jingim jong nga ka la syntuid noh na nga , te , A thri , nga la Khot kyrpang ïa me , bad ha ka Templ bakhuid jong me , me la ïohsngew ïa nga .
translation.en: When my soul fainted within me I remembered the  Lord  : and my prayer came in unto thee , into thine holy temple .

If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment , between blood and blood , between plea and plea , and between stroke and stroke , being matters of controversy within thy gates : then shalt thou arise , and get thee up into the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose  ;
translation.kha: Lada don ki kam kiba kham eh ïa ki nongbishar shnong ban rai , kum ki mokotduma ïaknieh khyndew , lane kiba dei shaphang kaba ïashoh ïadat , lane kito kiba hap ban pynïapher hapdeng ka jingpynïap briew bad kawei pat ka jait jingpynïap briew , leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei ïa kaba la jied da U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ,
malade man la ka por nga duwai na ka bynta jong phi baroh , at duwai da ka jingkmen ,
translation.en: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy ,
For if ye turn away from after him , he will yet again leave them in the wilderness  ; and ye shall destroy all this people .
translation.kha: Lada phi ki briew na ka jait Reuben bad ka jait Gad phi kyntait ban bud ïa u mynta , sa shisien un iehnoh ïa kine ki briew baroh ha ka ri khlaw , bad phin kitkhlieh ïa ka jingpynjot thiaw ïa ki .
La shah ïa u ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki briew jong U blei bad ban ïap ïa ki , bad la ai ha u ïa ka bor halor khwai pa kawei ka jaitbynriew , ka hima , ka ktien bad Halor u bynriew pynïapher .
translation.en: And it was given unto him to make war with the saints , and to overcome them : and power was given him over all kindreds , and tongues , and nations .
And ye shall smite every fenced city , and every choice city , and shall fell every good tree , and stop all wells of water , and mar every good piece of land with stones .
translation.kha: Phin jop ïa baroh ki nongbah ba-itynnat jong ki ïa kiba la ker kynroh ; phin pom ïa baroh ki diengsoh jong ki , phin pynsangeh ïa baroh ki umpohliew jong ki ; bad phin pynjot ïa baroh ki lyngkha baseisoh jong ki da kaba tap ïa ki da ki maw .
Ka Ruth ka jyllop , Ngan leh ïa kawei kaei baroh kaba phi ong .
translation.en: And she said unto her , All that thou sayest unto me I will do .

translation.kha: Nalor kane baroh kaba nga la pynbiang , nga la ai ruh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksaiñ na ka jingdon jingshem jong nga namar ka jingieit jong nga ïa ka Templ jongngi U Blei .
translation.en: Moreover , because I have set my affection to the house of my God , I have of mine own proper good , of gold and silver , which I have given to the house of my God , over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house ,

And David said unto God , Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered ? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed  ; but as for these sheep , what have they done ? let thine hand , I pray thee , O  Lord  my God , be on me , and on my father s house  ; but not on thy people , that they should be plagued .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la duwai ,  A Blei , nga long ma nga uta uba la leh bakla . Nga dei uta uba la hukum ban kheiñ briew . Kine ki paidbah bapli ki la leh aïu ? A  Trai  , U Blei jong nga , pynshitom ïa nga bad ïa ka longïing jong nga , bad pyllait ïa la ki briew .
Lada me tong shu mih bad leit shat shiliang ka wahduid Kidron , men ïap da shisha — bad me hi men shah kynnoh .
translation.en: For it shall be , that on the day thou goest out , and passest over the brook Kidron , thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die : thy blood shall be upon thine own head .

translation.kha: Shiteng na ki khulom jyllang ki , ki klun ïa ka ktien Ashdod lane ïa kiwei ki ktien bun kim tip kumto shun kren ïa ka ktien jongki ngi .
translation.en: And their children spake half in the speech of Ashdod , and could not speak in the Jews  language , but according to the language of each people .

translation.kha: sa shi bynta na ka la bynta kin ïeng ap phira ha ka Khyrdop Sur , sad kiba sah shi bynta na ka lai bynshet na phi kin ïeng ap pher ha ka khrawbor ha lyndet jong kiwei ki nongap phira .
translation.en: And a third part shall be at the gate of Sur  ; and a third part at the gate behind the guard : so shall ye keep the watch of the house , that it be not broken down .

translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno umbah ïeng skhem haduh kaba ktung un lait im .
translation.en: But he that shall endure unto the end , the same shall be saved .
And , behold , there arose a great tempest in the sea , insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves : but he was asleep .
translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan ka  erïong kaba jur ka la beh halor ka duriaw , bad ka lieng ka la don ha ka jingma ban sa ngam . Hynrei u Jisu u la ïohthiah .
Ki briew jong pha kba la kha ha ka to ka jinglongmraw ha kawei ka sngi kin ong ha pha , ‘ Kane ka jaka ka rit eh — me donkam jaka shuh ban shong !’
translation.en: The children which thou shalt have , after thou hast lost the other , shall say again in thine ears , The place is too strait for me : give place to me that I may dwell .
Then came also publicans to be baptized , and said unto him , Master , what shall we do ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki nonglum khajna ki la wan ban shah pynbaptis , bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Ko nonghikai , kaei ba ngi dei ban leh ?
Ha ka Sngi Kaba bud u Paul u la otsher bad ngi ïa-ban ïakynduh ïa u Jehosabad ; bad baroh ki nongri balang jong ka balang ki la ïadon lang .
translation.en: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James  ; and all the elders were present .
And when the mourning was past , David sent and fetched her to his house , and she became his wife , and bare him a son . But the thing that David had done displeased the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba ka por ïambriew ka la kut , u Dabid u phah wan ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïingsyiem ; ka la long noh ka tnga jong u , bad ka kha u khun shynrang na u . Hynrei U  Trai  um sngewbha ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh .

Ki kpa tymmen jong I ha Ijipt kim khim la sngewthait ïa ki kam baphylla jong U Blei ; ki la klet ba bishni u la pyn-i ha ki ïa ka jingtieng jongngi u , bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Badonbor Baroh ha ka Duriaw Basaw .
translation.en: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt  ; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies  ; but provoked him at the sea , even at the Red sea .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u la leit sha Ijipt , ha kaba ma u bad ki khum shynraiñ jrong u ki la ïap .
translation.en: So Jacob went down into Egypt , and died , he , and our fathers ,

translation.kha: Kumta nga la thied ïa ki bad phong ïa ki .
translation.en: So I got a girdle according to the word of the  Lord  , and put it on my loins .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi U Jisu u dang duwai ha kawei ka jaka . Haba u la dep , uwei na ki synran jong u , u la ïong ha u , Ko Trai , to hikai ïa im ban Duwai , kumba u Ïoannis u la hikai ïa ki synran jongngi u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as he was praying in a certain place , when he ceased , one of his disciples said unto him , Lord , teach us to pray , as John also taught his disciples .

translation.kha: Uta u biria na uba ki ksuid ki la mihnoh u la kyrpad ïa U Jisu! , Shah ïa nga ban leit lym bad me . Hynrei U Jisu u la phah noh ïa u , u da ong ,
translation.en: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him : but Jesus sent him away , saying ,

translation.kha: Ki syiem Philistia ki ïalumlang ban ïaheh sngewngiah bad ban ai ïa ka jingsuh kaba khraw ïa u Dagon u blei jong ki . Ki ïarwai , U beit jong ngi u la ai ha im’ ka jingjop ïa u Jason u nongshun jong ngi .
translation.en: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god , and to rejoice : for they said , Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand .
This persuasion cometh not of him that calleth you .
translation.kha: Ym shym la leh da U Blei , uba la khot ïa phi .
Bad la don bun ki briew babha pang ñiangthohlieh kiba la im ha Israel ha ka por jong u Elisha u nongïathuhlypa ; pynban ym shym la pynkhiah ïa uno uno na ki , hynrei , tang ïa u Naaman u nong Syria .
translation.en: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet  ; and none of them was cleansed , saving Naaman the Syrian .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por ka Naomi ka ïohsngew ba U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa la ki bariew da kaba ai ha ki ka jingot kaba babha ; kumta ka la khreh ban mihnoh na Joab laiñ dara la ki pyrsa kurim .
translation.en: Then she arose with her daughters in law , that she might return from the country of Moab : for she had heard in the country of Moab how that the  Lord  had visited his people in giving them bread .

translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa u angel jong ar ban ïalam ïa phi , bad ngan beh noh ïa ki Kanaan , ki Amor , ki tap , ki Peris , ki Hobah , bad ki Jabesh .
translation.en: And I will send an angel before thee  ; and I will drive out the Canaanite , the Amorite , and the Hittite , and the Perizzite , the Hivite , and the Jebusite :
Wherefore my sentence is , that we trouble not them , which from among the Gentiles are turned to God :
translation.kha: Ka long ka jingpyrkhat jong nga ,  u Jakob u la ong ,  ba ngim dei ban pynjynjar ïa ki Jentil kiba la phai sha U Blei .
Kumta te , haba u briew u smai da ka reng , u smai da ka bad da baroh ki jingai sngewlah halor jong ka ;
translation.en: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar , sweareth by it , and by all things thereon .

translation.kha: Pynbiang , ki dei ban pynsep-ei ba ki longïng borabor uba babha badno ba lah ban shaniah , khnang ban pynshisha ïa ka jinghikai shaphang U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi ha baroh ba ki ni .
translation.en: Not purloining , but shewing all good fidelity ; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things .

translation.kha: Naba u Ïoannis u long uta uba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka nong : ‘ U Blang u la nguh , ngan phah ïa u nonglamktien ha shuwa jong me ban plie ka lynti na ka bynta jong me .’
translation.en: This is he , of whom it is written , Behold , I send my messenger before thy face , which shall prepare thy way before thee .
So the people rested on the seventh day .
translation.kha: Kumta u paidbah um shym leh kano kano ka kam ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew .

translation.en: I will send my fear before thee , and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come , and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki briew kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa phi ban sheptieng ïa nga ; ngan pynkulmar thlim ïa kito kiba phi ïaleh pyrshah , bad ngan pynher krad ïa ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Jehoshaphat , because he walked in the first ways of his father David , and sought not unto Baalim  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa u Jehoshaphat namar u la bud ïa ka nuksa ba-mynshuwa jong ka jingim u kpa jong u bad um shym mane ïa u Baal .

U Trai u nong , Ki paid Israel ki la ïadei ar pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynum da shisha ïa ki . Ki die Sha ka jinglongmraw ïa ki briew naba hok ki bym lah thret pat ïa ki ram jong ki , ki briew kiba duk ki bym lah siew pat wat ïa ka dor shi jur ki juti .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Israel , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they sold the righteous for silver , and the poor for a pair of shoes  ;

translation.kha: U pynpyut shipai ha ki nongbah ba la tei kut ka Judah , ha ki rudnong Judah , bad ha ki nongbud kiba u Asa u la jop ha ka ri ki Ephraim .
translation.en: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah , and set garrisons in the land of Judah , and in the cities of Ephraim , which Asa his father had taken .

translation.kha: Phi long kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ibieit jong nga ; katno ki khmat jrong phi ki phyrnai itynnat da ka jingieit !
translation.en: Take us the foxes , the little foxes , that spoil the vines : for our vines have tender grapes .

Then he remembered the days of old , Moses , and his people , saying , Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock ? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him ?
translation.kha: Hynrei nangta ki kynmaw ïa ki por kiba mynshuwa , ïa ki sngi u Moses , u shakri U  Trai  bad ki kylli ,  Hangno mynta u don U  Trai  , uba pyllait im ïa ki nongïalam jong ki briew jong u na ka duriaw ? Hangno u don U  Trai  , uba la ai ïa U Mynsiem jong u ha u Moses ?
Pynkhreh ïa kaei kaba U balui u la leh . Kumno kew uno Un un pynmihpat ïa kiei kaba U Blei u la pynkdor .
translation.en: Consider the work of God : for who can make that straight , which he hath made crooked ?

With him will I speak mouth to mouth , even apparently , and not in dark speeches  ; and the similitude of the  Lord  shall he behold : wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses ?
translation.kha: Kumta nga ïakren bad u markhmat , da kaba shai , bad ym ha ki jingkyntip ; u la ïohi wat ïa ka dur jong nga . Kumno keiñ phi nud ban kren pyrshah ïa u Moses u shakri jong nga ?
Me la Pynlong ïa ki Israel ki briew Jong me junom , bad me , ko Trai , me la long U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever  ; and thou ,  Lord  , becamest their God .

translation.kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew , la ka khrud katto kattne , kaba don u blei uba hajan kum U Trai U Blei jongki ngi , haba ki donkam ïa u . Man ka por ba ngi khot kyrpad ïa u , u jubab ïa me .
translation.en: For what nation is there so great , who hath God so nigh unto them , as the  Lord  our God is in all things that we call upon him for ?

translation.kha: Ïa kane ka jingsleh ba-iwbih lah ban die ha ka dor kaba ram pynlang ïa ka pisa ban ai ha kiba duk .
translation.en: For this ointment might have been sold for much , and given to the poor .
The fear of the  Lord  is the instruction of wisdom  ; and before honour is humility .
translation.kha: Ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  ka long ka jinghikai na ka hi . Phi dei ban long kiba sngewrit ha shuwa ba phin ïoh ïa ki jingkyntiew burom .
Hynrei lada kata ka kynthei ka mynnor , ka jingpynshitom ka dei pun long ka jingim namar ka jingshim ,
translation.en: And if any mischief follow , then thou shalt give life for life ,

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jingjubab , Nga ong ha phi ba lada ki sngap jar , ki maw hi ktien sa sdang ban pyrta .
translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  I tell you that , if these should hold their peace , the stones would immediately cry out .

translation.kha: Balei ka jaiñkup jong u ka saw palat , kum ka jrong u brup uba ïuh ïa ki sohwaiñ ba sha waiñ ?
translation.en: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel , and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat ?

translation.kha: ban ong ha ki paid Israel , Jied ïa ki nongbeh jakarieh kiba nga la hukum ha u Moses ban ïathuh ha Phi .
translation.en: Speak to the children of Israel , saying , Appoint out for you cities of refuge , whereof I spake unto you by the hand of Moses :
Let no man say when he is tempted , I am tempted of God : for God cannot be tempted with evil , neither tempteth he any man :
translation.kha: Lada u briew u shah pynshoi da kum kita ki jingtynjuh , um dei ban ong ,  Kane ka jingpynshoi ka wan na U Blei .  Naba ïa U Blei ym lah ban pynshoi da kaba sniew , bad ma u hi da lade um pynshoi ïano ïano .

translation.en: Wherefore then serveth the law ? It was added because of transgressions , till the seed should come to whom the promise was made ; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator .
translation.kha: Kaei te , ka jingthmu jong ka Hukum ? La bynrap khnang ban pyn-i ïa kaei ba ka long ka jingpalat , bad la thmu ba kan neh haduh ka jingwan uta u nonghiarpateng jong u Abraham , ha uba la pynlong ïa ka jingkular . Ïa ka Hukum la aiti da ki angel , lem bad u briew uba ïeng kum u ksiang .
Hynrei U Jisu u la ong , Ieh ïa ka mawthew ! Balei ba phi pynwit ïa ka ? Ka la leh ïa kaei kaei kaba bha bad ba-beit na ka bynta jong nga .
translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Let her alone  ; why trouble ye her ? she hath wrought a good work on me .

Was then that which is good made death unto me ? God forbid . But sin , that it might appear sin , working death in me by that which is good ; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful .
translation.kha: Hynrei hato kane ka mut ba kaei kaba bha ka pynlong ïa ka jingïap ïa nga ? Ym kumta! Ka dei ka pop kaba pynlong ïa kata ; da kaba pyndonkam ïa kaei kaba bha , ka pop ka la wallam ka jingïap ïa nga , khnang ba ïa kata ka jinglong bashisha jong ka pop yn pynpaw . Bad kumta , lyngba ka hukum , ïa ka pop la pynpaw ba ka long kaba kham shyrkhei .
Nga la pynlong ka jutang ïa ka sngi bad ka Die , khnang ba kin wan mih ha la ki por kiba biang ; malade ïa ka jutang yn ym lah ban pynkheiñ .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; If ye can break my covenant of the day , and my covenant of the night , and that there should not be day and night in their season  ;

translation.kha: Me bat ïa la ka kular , me la ïalaw noh ïa ki briew kiba me la pyllait im ; da ka bor jong me , me la bteng ïa ki shuh ka ri kaba kyntang jongu me .
translation.en: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed : thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation .

translation.kha: U la hylla lieh juh blaid bad u la sheptieng katta katta ba ki khohsiew jong u ki la sawdong ban Khynñiuh .
translation.en: Then the king s countenance was changed , and his thoughts troubled him , so that the joints of his loins were loosed , and his knees smote one against another .

Wherefore , O king , let my counsel be acceptable unto thee , and break off thy sins by righteousness , and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor  ; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko Syiem Kynrad , to bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga . Sangeh ban leh pop , to leh ïa kaba dei , bad to sngewsynei ïa kiba duk . Te phin ïailong uba manbha .
hynne u Petros u la jubab ïa u , Ai ba ïa me Bad ka pisa jong me yn briew sha ka dujok , nala me pyrkhat ba me lah banbeiñ thied ïa ka jingai jong U Blei da ka pisa !
translation.en: But Peter said unto him , Thy money perish with thee , because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew’ hangthie ki kylli shapoh ka tnga jong u , u jyllop ba ka dih ka para jong u . Um shym ïathuh ba ka dei ka tnga jong u , namar u sheptieng ïoh ba ki briew hangta kin pynïap ïa u ban ïoh ïa ka Rebekka , kaba longsem kaba bhabriew eh .
translation.en: And the men of the place asked him of his wife  ; and he said , She is my sister : for he feared to say , She is my wife  ; lest , said he , the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah  ; because she was fair to look upon .
And I heard the angel of the waters say , Thou art righteous , O Lord , which art , and wast , and shalt be , because thou hast judged thus .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa u angel uba dei khmih ïa ki um ba u ong ,  Ki jingbishar kiba me la pynlong ki long kiba hok , A Uba Khuid , me uba long bad uba la long !

translation.en: And when she had so said , she went her way , and called Mary her sister secretly , saying , The Master is come , and calleth for thee .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka Martha ka la ong ïa kane , ka la leit noh bad ka la khot jar jar ïa ka Mari ka para jong ka ,  U Nonghikai u don hangne ,  ka la ïathuh ïa ka ,  bad u phah khot ïa pha .
Kumta u Adonisedek u Phah ïa kane ka khubor harum sha u Hoham u syiad ka Bethrehob , u Piram u syiem ka Jarmuth , u Japhia u syiem ka Lakhish , bad sha u Debir u syiem ka Eglon :
translation.en: Wherefore Adoni–zedek king of Jerusalem sent unto Hoham king of Hebron , and unto Piram king of Jarmuth , and unto Japhia king of Lachish , and unto Debir king of Eglon , saying ,
There is Meshech , Tubal , and all her multitude : her graves are round about him : all of them uncircumcised , slain by the sword , though they caused their terror in the land of the living .
translation.kha: Ka Meshekh bad ka Tubal ki don hangta , lem bad ki jingtep jong ki shipai jong ki ha baroh sawdong . Ki long baroh kiba khlem otsher , baroh ki la shah pynïap ha ka thma . Pynban shisien ki la pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im .

translation.en: Do you want to come sit by me ?
translation.kha: Phi kwah ban wan shong bad nga ?
Ha ka phang bashatei u pud u phai shaphang ka Hannathon , bad u ngut ha ka Them Iphtahel .
translation.en: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon : and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Iphtah–el :
The sons of Jehieli  ; Zetham , and Joel his brother , which were over the treasures of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki ar ngut kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Ladan ; u Setham bad u Joel , ki dei peit ïa ki ïing jingkynshew bad ïing buh tiar jong ka Templ .

Hadien katto katne pa , ki Philistia ki la ïalumlang ïa la u paidïapom ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel bad U Akhish u ong ha u Nadab , Da shisha pa’ tip ba ma phi bad ki briew jong phi ki dei ban ïaleh ha ka jar jong nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that the Philistines gathered their armies together for warfare , to fight with Israel . And Achish said unto David , Know thou assuredly , that thou shalt go out with me to battle , thou and thy men .
They compassed me about like bees  ; they are quenched as the fire of thorns : for in the name of the  Lord  I will destroy them .
translation.kha: Ki la ïaboi sawdong jong nga kum ki ngap , hynrei ki la ing duh kloi kum ka ding hapdeng ki shiah ; da ka bor ka jong U  Trai  nga la pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: Salute all them that have the rule over you , and all the saints . They of Italy salute you .
translation.kha: To ai ki jingkhublei jong ngi sha baroh ki nongïalam jong phi bad sha ki briew jong U Blei baroh . Ki parabangeit jong ngi na Italy ki phah ki jingkhublei jong ki ïa phi .
Ki la pyrta bad kylli , Dong mo u nongshong ba hangne uba kyrteng u Simran Petros ?
translation.en: And called , and asked whether Simon , which was surnamed Peter , were lodged there .

translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ki jinglamler ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong la . Ngam shym phan ïa ki . Ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .’
translation.en: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name : I have not sent them , saith the  Lord .
Hell and destruction are never full  ; so the eyes of man are never satisfied .
translation.kha: Ki jingkwah u briew ki long kum ka pyrthei kiba ïap — Ka don borabor ka jingkwah shuh shuh .

translation.en: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land , concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein , save Caleb the son of Jephunneh , and Joshua the son of Nun .
translation.kha: Nga la kular ba ngan shah ïa phi ban shong hangta , hynrei yn ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban ïoh ïa kata , lait tang u Kaleb bad u Joshua .
Kumta nga la Ang ïa la ka shynrang , bad u la ai ha nga ïa ka kot kli ban bam .
translation.en: So I opened my mouth , and he caused me to eat that roll .

translation.kha: Haba u Pharisi u la ïohi ïa kñia , u la ong ha ailad , Lada une u briew u den shisha u nongïathuhlypa , un da la tip kaba kumno kane ka brup ka long naba ktah ïa u ; un da la ïatip ka jait jingim bapop kaweh kumin ka la im !
translation.en: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it , he spake within himself , saying , This man , if he were a prophet , would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him : for she is a sinner .

translation.kha: Nangta u satang uba hynñiew u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jongnga u ha suiñ . Ka sur kaba jam ka la wan na ka khet kaba ha ka thalab , ka da ong , La pyndep !
translation.en: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air  ; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven , from the throne , saying , It is done .

Therefore David ran , and stood upon the Philistine , and took his sword , and drew it out of the sheath thereof , and slew him , and cut off his head therewith . And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead , they fled .
translation.kha: U mareh sha u , u ïeng halor jong u , u sei ïa ka waitlam u Goliath na ka jingsop jong ka , bad u ot ïa ka khlieh jong u bad u pynïap ïa u . Haba ki Philistia ki ïohi ba u rangkynsai jong ki u la shah pynïap , ki phet krad .
U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la khot ïa ki . Kaei phi kwah ïa nga ban bor na ka bynta jong phi ? u la kylli ïa ki .
translation.en: And Jesus stood still , and called them , and said ,  What will ye that I shall do unto you ?

translation.kha: Kin rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka bynta jong pha : Ïa nongbeh bapawnam la pynjot ! Ïa ki liengbah jong ka la rong nong na ki duriaw . Ki briew Jong kane ka nongkhap ki synshar ïa ki duriaw bad pyndkut ïa baroh bakha shong Haron duriaw .
translation.en: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee , and say to thee , How art thou destroyed , that wast inhabited of seafaring men , the renowned city , which wast strong in the sea , she and her inhabitants , which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it !
And his brethren went to feed their father s flock in Shechem .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi haba ki hynmen shynrang jong u Joseph ki leit ïalam bam phlang ïa ki jingri jong u kpa jong ki sha Shekhem ,
Ha kane ka sngi phi la pyndei haduh katno phi long uba bha ïa nga , naba phim shym la pynïap ïa nga , wat la U Trai u la buh ïa nga ha ka bor jong phi .
translation.en: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me : forasmuch as when the  Lord  had delivered me into thine hand , thou killedst me not .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu! u sdang shang halor u lum ki Olib , ki synlar ki la wan shaei u ha kaba jar jar . To ïatih ha me lano kan baroh kuna long , ki la kyllut , bad kaei ka ban jliah ban pyn-i ba ka la dei ka por ïa ka jinghun jong me bad kaba kut ka Ïa .
translation.en: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives , the disciples came unto him privately , saying , Tell us , when shall these things be ? and what shall be the sign of thy coming , and of the end of the world ?
The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early , when it was yet dark , unto the sepulchre , and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka Sngi U Trai , katba ka dang dum , ka Mari ka nong Magdala ka la leit sha kata ka jingtep bad ka la ïohi ba ïa u mawkhang la weng noh na ka jingkhang ka jingtep .

translation.en: When a bullock , or a sheep , or a goat , is brought forth , then it shall be seven days under the dam  ; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba kha ïa uno uno u khun masi , lane ïa u khunlangbrot , lane ïa u khunblang , ieh ïa u bad la ka kmie haduh hynñiew sngi , hynrei hadien kata lah ban pdiang ïa u kum ka jingainguh bam .

translation.en: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the  Lord  , and to record , and to thank and praise the  Lord  God of Israel :
translation.kha: U Dabid u thung katto katne ki Lebi ban ïalam ïa ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , da ki jingrwai bad ki jingïaroh ïa u .

kin sa ïathuh ïa kata ha ki briew kiba shong ha khie ka ri . Kine ki briew ki la lah ïohsngew ba me , A Tlai , me anna lem bad ngi , mala ba me paw ha kaba ïohi shai haba u lyoh jong me u sangeh halor jngai ngi bad ba me leit ha shuwa jongno ngi ha u rishot lyoh mynsngi bad u rishot ding mynmiet .
translation.en: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land : for they have heard that thou  Lord  art among this people , that thou  Lord  art seen face to face , and that thy cloud standeth over them , and that thou goest before them , by day time in a pillar of a cloud , and in a pillar of fire by night .

translation.kha: Ki pum u riewbymman ki long ka jingriam . U ngat ha ka jingriam jong ki thup jong u hi .
translation.en: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself , and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins .
And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus , and told him all things , both what they had done , and what they had taught .
translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la wan phai bad ki la ïakynduh ïa U Jisu ; bad ki la ïathuh ha u ïa baroh kaba ki la leh bad la hikai .

Hato u khih khyndew un nud ban ïatainia bad u nongthaw jongngi u , u khiew naba long kum baroh kiwei pat ? Hato ka dewbyrtha kan noh ïa u nongtem kiaw kaei ba u leh ? Hammoth u khiew un mudui ïa la u nongthaw khie ba um don jingtbit ?
translation.en: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker ! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth . Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it , What makest thou ? or thy work , He hath no hands ?

translation.kha: U Trai un kyrkhu ïa kaei kaei baroh katno kaba phi leh .
translation.en: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in , and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out .

And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue , and put thereon the dishes , and the spoons , and the bowls , and covers to cover withal : and the continual bread shall be thereon :
translation.kha: Kin trei ïa ka kam kat kaba donkam ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad kin pyndep ïa ki kamram na ka bynta ki lyngdoh bad na ka bynta ka kynhun baroh kawei .
Haba ki kyrmen lapbah don ka kynhun na ki jait Israel ka bym shym la leit sha ka jingïalumlang ha Mispah , ki skhem ba ym Don uwei ruh na Jabesh ha Gilead kiba la don hangta ;
translation.en: And they said , What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpah to the  Lord  ? And , behold , there came none to the camp from Jabesh–gilead to the assembly .

translation.kha: ïa u briew u ba jingneh u ban ïam ïa ïano Kanaan ka jingbam : U wei pat u briew uba tlot , u bam da ki jhur .
translation.en: For one believeth that he may eat all things : another , who is weak , eateth herbs .

And as Samuel was offering up the burnt offering , the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel : but the  Lord  thundered with a great thunder on that day upon the Philistines , and discomfited them  ; and they were smitten before Israel .
translation.kha: Katba u Samuel u dang ai ïa ka jingkñia , ki Philistia ki tur sha jan ban ïaleh ; hynrei hangta U  Trai  u kyrhuh kum u pyrthat na bneng pyrshah ïa ki . Ki la shaïong ngaiñ , bad ki la phet krad ha ka jingkulmar .
Lada wat hadien katto kane phim treh satia ban shahshkor ïa nga , ngan pynthnam jur ïa phi sa hynñiewphew shah .
translation.en: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me , then I will punish you seven times more for your sins .

translation.kha: Kam ne ruh ha ïinglieng duriaw . Phim donkam shun da kylli , ‘ Uei keiñ u ban leit sha shiliang duriaw bad wallam ïa ka sha ngi , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïohsngew bad kohnguh ïa ka ?’
translation.en: Neither is it beyond the sea , that thou shouldest say , Who shall go over the sea for us , and bring it unto us , that we may hear it , and do it ?

translation.kha: U Hushai u jubab , Ka jingai jingman kaweh u Ahithophel u la ai ha phi ha kane ka por kam long kaba ibha .
translation.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom , The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time .

translation.kha: Haseroth u samla Absalom u tang im ? u syiem u kylli . U mraw u jubab , Ko Kynrad , nga sngew ba kaei kiba la jia ha u kan jin da la jia ha baroh ki nongshun jong ngi , bad ha baroh Kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi .
translation.en: And the king said unto Cushi , Is the young man Absalom safe ? And Cushi answered , The enemies of my lord the king , and all that rise against thee to do thee hurt , be as that young man is .

translation.kha: Nangta la don ka thma ha ka ri , Haba ki Israel ki jied ki plie tymmen . Na ki sawphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha Israel Don mano mano ba rah ïa ka stieh ne u sum ?
translation.en: They chose new gods  ; then was war in the gates : was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel ?

translation.kha: Nangta u kynrad jong uto u shakri un wan pat ha kawei ka snieh haba u shakri um shym khmih lynti ïa u bad ha ka por kaba um kop .
translation.en: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him , and in an hour that he is not aware of ,

translation.kha: Kumno uno uno un shem aïu ka jingim ka mut ? Ka long kaba jylliew eh ïa ngi , kaba eh per ban sngewthuh .
translation.en: That which is far off , and exceeding deep , who can find it out ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Shaphang kaei ba phi ïakren na ma phi , katba phi nang ïa-ïaid ? Ki la ïeng , lem bad ka durkhmat basngewsih .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What manner of communications are these that ye have one to another , as ye walk , and are sad ?

translation.kha: lem bad ka jingainguh bam kaba shi kilo u purew ba la khlup lang bad shi litar ka umphniang Olib kaba bha tam .
translation.en: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering , mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil .

translation.kha: U Trai u hukum ïa u Moses ban kren ha ki lyngkhot , ki khun u Aaron , bad ïong ha ki ba uno uno na ki um dei ban pyntngit ïa lade ha ka por ba lehniam haba don uba ïap napdeng ki briew jong u ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron , and say unto them , There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people :

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingpynbna ba la dep pynmih ha ka kyrteng u syiem bad ba la shen da ka muhor syiem , ym ia ban pynkylla . Phi lah pat ban thoh sha ki Jiw ïa katei kaei kaba ph kajuh ; bad phi lah ban thok ïa ka ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad shongsah ïa ka da ka muhor syiem .
translation.en: Write ye also for the Jews , as it liketh you , in the king s name , and seal it with the king s ring : for the writing which is written in the king s name , and sealed with the king s ring , may no man reverse .

translation.kha: Kito kiba bha ki ïaid na ka lynti kaba lait na kabu sniew ; te khmih shano ba phi leit — ka la ban pyllait ïa ka jingriam jongki phi .
translation.en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil : he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul .
Surely the Lord  God  will do nothing , but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar um ju leh ei ei khlem da pynpaw ïa ka jingthmu jong u ha la ki shakri , ki nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: He it is , who coming after me is preferred before me , whose shoe s latchet I am not worthy to unloose .
translation.kha: U wan hadien jong nga , hynrei nga ngam long uba bit wat ban law ïa ki ksai juti jong u .

translation.en: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field , keeping watch over their flock by night .
translation.kha: La don katto katne ngut ki nongap langbrot ha kata ka bynta jong ka ri kiba la sahmiet ha ki lum , da kaba sumar ïa ki kynhun langbrot jong ki .
Ngan leh ïa ka longïing jong u Asaph kumba nga leh ïa ka longïing jong u Jeroboam u syiem ka Jerusalem bad jong u Baasha u syiem ka Israel .
translation.en: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah :
So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it : Ahab went one way by himself , and Obadiah went another way by himself .
translation.kha: Ki la ïamynjur ïa kano ka bynta jong ka ri uwei uwei un leit wad , bad ki ïaleit sha la ka jong ka jong ka lad .
Uta u briew un wallam uwei u langbrot ha khmied ka ïingjah Ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga kum ka jingkñia namar ka jingpalat jong u ,
translation.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , even a ram for a trespass offering .
That innocent blood be not shed in thy land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance , and so blood be upon thee .
translation.kha: To leh ïa kane , ba ki briew kiba shida kin ym shah pynïap ei , bad kumta phin ym kit pop ba dei ma phi kiba la pynïap ïa ki ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  u ai ha phi .
U Blei u thir ha ka kad shaphang shait bad shatai , hynrei pynpdang ngiam shym ïohi ïa u .
translation.en: On the left hand , where he doth work , but I cannot behold him : he hideth himself on the right hand , that I cannot see him :

translation.kha: Ha kaba sdang , ka hima jong u ka kynthup ïa ka Babilon , ka Erek , bad ka Akkad , uba don barieh ha ka ri Bethania .
translation.en: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel , and Erech , and Accad , and Calneh , in the land of Shinar .
His lord answered and said unto him , Thou wicked and slothful servant , thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not , and gather where I have not strawed :
translation.kha: ‘ Me u shakri uba sniew bad uba jaipdeh !’ u kynrad jong u , u la ong . ‘ Me la tip , ym dei , ba nga ot ïa ki jingot na kaba ngam shym bet , bad lum ïa ki jingthung na kaba ngam shym bet symbai ?
Uba lorni u thad ïa kaba la buhrieh , hynrei phi lah ban buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha uba lah ban bahkhlieh .
translation.en: A talebearer revealeth secrets : but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter .
He shall purify himself with it on the third day , and on the seventh day he shall be clean : but if he purify not himself the third day , then the seventh day he shall not be clean .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban pynkhuid ïa lade da ka um ka jingpynkhuid ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , te kin sa long kiba khuid . Hynrei lada kim pynkhuid ïa lade ha ka sngi kaba lai bad ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , kin ym long kiba khuid .
Teng ym ïap ; hynrei Ngan im dara ngan pynbna ïa kaei kaba U Trai’ u la leh .
translation.en: I shall not die , but live , and declare the works of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Wat la katta ruh ngan ym pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kane , namar ma phi hi phi ïa-ïaid lang bad ki nuti kiba ha ka baphylla , nabar ryngkat bad ki , phi ai ki jingkñia ba-thala . Kumba ka proberb ka ong , ‘ Ki briew kiba khyllem pyrkhat kin sa jot noh .’
translation.en: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom , nor your spouses when they commit adultery : for themselves are separated with whores , and they sacrifice with harlots : therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall .
For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever : and thou ,  Lord  , art become their God .
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ki Israel , ki briew jong me hi junom , bad me , A  Trai  , me la long U Blei jong ki .
Ym don uwei ruh ha ka nongbam ibha burom ïa la ki kmie ki kpa . phiah shukor ïa ki nongwei bad shim kambah ïa ki riewkai bad ki khunswet .
translation.en: In thee have they set light by father and mother : in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger : in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow .

translation.kha: U Blei um dei uba bishar bymhok . Un ym katei ïa ka kam kaba ph la leh lane ïa ka jingieit kaba phi la pynsep na ka bynta jong u da ka jingïarap kaban phi la ai bad dang ïai ïarap ïa ki parabangeit .
translation.en: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love , which ye have shewed toward his name , in that ye have ministered to the saints , and do minister .

translation.kha: Wan ïalam sa ïa ki khun shynrang lad u , bad pynlong sopti ïa ki .
translation.en: And thou shalt bring his sons , and clothe them with coats :

translation.kha: Kumta u la pyrta , ‘ Ko Kpa Abraham ! To sngewsynei ïa ar , bad phah ïa u Lasaros ban wieh ïa ka shynriah ti jongki u ha ka um khyndiat bad pyngtngen ïa u thylliej jong nga , namar nga don ha ka jingshitom bakhraw ha kane ka ding !’
translation.en: And he cried and said , Father Abraham , have mercy on me , and send Lazarus , that he may dip the tip of his finger in water , and cool my tongue  ; for I am tormented in this flame .

translation.kha: Wat la U Trai u la maham ïa u Mahseïah bad ïa ki bynriew jongnga u , ki kyntait ban shahskhor .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake to Manasseh , and to his people : but they would not hearken .

translation.kha: U shaniah ha U Blei Bad u kam ba u long U Khun U Blei . Kumta , te , to ngin peit lada U Blei! u kwah ban pynsum ïa u myntri !
translation.en: He trusted in God  ; let him deliver him now , if he will have him : for he said , I am the Son of God .

translation.kha: dat jingda nga buh ïa ki nongshun jong me kum ka jingïuhkjat hapoh ki kjat jong me .’
translation.en: Until I make thy foes thy footstool .

translation.kha: Baroh ki rangïapom jong Phi kin jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad hapoh ka jingïalam jong U Trai ki dei ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jngai ngi haduh ba U Trai un da jlop thiaw ïa ki
translation.en: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the  Lord  , until he hath driven out his enemies from before him ,
And they were both righteous before God , walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless .
translation.kha: Baroh ar ngut ki im ka jingim kaba bha ha khmat U Blei bad ki la kohnguh lut ïa baroh ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong U Trai .
Lada ka la pur , un hukum ba dei ban phang noh ïa ki maw-it ha Ibbah la bit bthuh bad bret noh ïa ki shata ka kajuh theh ñiut shabar shnong .
translation.en: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is , and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city :
There is a lad here , which hath five barley loaves , and two small fishes : but what are they among so many ?
translation.kha: Don uwei u khynnah hangne uba don san tylli ki kpu barli bad ar tylli ki dohkha . Hynrei kine kin ym pat biang na ka bynta kine ki briew baroh .
Bad khlem da pynpaw ïa kiwei pah kiei kiei , man ka sngi la ban ïa de da ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta ki balang baroh .
translation.en: Beside those things that are without , that which cometh upon me daily , the care of all the churches .
Jesus answered him ,  If I have spoken evil , bear witness of the evil : but if well , why smitest thou me ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Lada nga la kren ïa kano kano kaba bakla , to ïathuh ïa baroh hangne ka dei kaei . Hynrei lada ka long kaba dei ha kaei kaba nga la ong , balei ba me da thab ïa nga ?

Nangta un shim ïa uwei na ki nongaplangbrot shynrang , shrong pynlang ka shai bynta na ka lai bynta ka nongpynim , bad un ai kum ka jingainguh namar ka jingleh palat . Un ai ïa ki kum ka jingai kaba hasem kyrpang ha U Trei na ka bynta u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And the priest shall take one he lamb , and offer him for a trespass offering , and the log of oil , and wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Nga da kwah ba baroh na phi phin kren-ïa ha ki thylliej bapher ; hynrei nga da kwah ba phi ïoh ïa ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei . Naba u briew ibha pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei u kham kor ngab ïa ita uba kren ha ki thylliej bapynjot — lym don uno uno umbiah batai ïa kaei ka u kren , khnang ba kan long ka jingïarap ïa ka balang baroh kawei .
translation.en: I would that ye all spake with tongues , but rather that ye prophesied : for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues , except he interpret , that the church may receive edifying .
And he said , The  Lord  is my rock , and my fortress , and my deliverer  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u nongïada jong nga , u long ka kut baskhem jong nga .

Mynta ñiar ba u syiem u la ai ki hukum bapyrkhing na ka bynta ban pynlong ïa ka lawar ding kaba khluit haduh katta katta , ki thylliej ding ki la step ïa ki nongap phira kiba ïalum ïa ki rangbah sha ka lawar ding .
translation.en: Therefore because the king s commandment was urgent , and the furnace exceeding hot , the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïathmu ïa Baroh kaban la tam badno ki la pynpyut haduh khaw-eit tukri da ki lyngkhot kiba la sah tam na ki san tylli ki kpu barit kiba ki briew ki la bam .
translation.en: Therefore they gathered them together , and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves , which remained over and above unto them that had eaten .

translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi ki la leit shadien ba U Trai U la saw ïa ka bhah .
translation.en: And seven days were fulfilled , after that the  Lord  had smitten the river .

translation.kha: Uno uno Uba pdiang ïa u nonglamktien jong U Blei namar ba u long u nongkren Jong U Blei , un ïoh bna ha ka bainong jong u . Bad uno uno uba pdiang ïa u brisoh wahbah bha namar ba u long uba bha , un ïoh bynta ha ka bainong jong u .
translation.en: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet s reward  ; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man s reward .
Pass me the pen .
translation.kha: Ai sha nga u khulom .

translation.en: So went Satan forth from the presence of the  Lord  , and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown .
translation.kha: Nangta u Soitan u mihnoh na khmat U  Trai  bad u pynsaja da ki tohjaw ha baroh shi rynïeng ka met jong u Job .

translation.en: And they said unto him , Why do the disciples of John fast often , and make prayers , and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees  ; but thine eat and drink ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la ong ïa U Jisu ,  Ki synran jong U Ïoannis ki shahjingit man ka por bad ki duwai , bad ki synran jong ki Pharisi ki leh kumjuh , hynrei ki synran jong me ki ïabam bad ïadih .
Ïa ka jingsarong ba kynja briew yn pynpait bad ïa ka jinglehmeng ki briew yn pynjot . Ki bleithaw kin jah noh plain , bad tang ïa U Trai yn kyntiew prum ha kata ka sngi .
translation.en: And the idols he shall utterly abolish .

translation.kha: Ngim kwah ïano ïano ban wad daw ïa ka jingtei jong ngi , kumne sem pyrshang ban ym buh ïa ki jingjynthut ha ka lynti jongno jongno .
translation.en: Giving no offence in any thing , that the ministry be not blamed :

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , ha kaba shabar phi i kumba phi bha ïa baroh , hynrei shapoh ph dap da ka jingarsap bad ki pop .
translation.en: Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men , but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity .
So I prophesied as he commanded me , and the breath came into them , and they lived , and stood up upon their feet , an exceeding great army .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la ïathuhlypa kumba u la bthah ïa nga . Ka jingpynhiar mynsiem ka la rung ha kita ki met , bad ki la khie im bad ki la ïeng joit . Ki la ïabun bah na ki kat ban pynlong ka kynhun shipai .
ka jingriew ka turoi , bad ka jingsawa jong ka na kaba kren . Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kata ka jingsam , ki la kyrpad ba kim kwah hajuh ba-bang ïohsngew sa ïa kawei pat ka ktien .
translation.en: And the sound of a trumpet , and the voice of words  ; which voice they that heard entreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more :

translation.kha: Shim malu me shapoh kata ka lieng ïa u shynraiñ malade ka kynthei na khwai pa katai ka jait mrad bad jwat sim baroh , na ka bynta ba yn ri pynim ïa ki .
translation.en: Of fowls after their kind , and of cattle after their kind , of every creeping thing of the earth after his kind , two of every sort shall come unto thee , to keep them alive .
And after that I looked , and , behold , the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened :
translation.kha: Hadien kane nga la ïohi ïa ka templ ha bneng ba ka plie , lem bad ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Blei hapoh jong ka .

translation.en: Thine , O  Lord  , is the greatness , and the power , and the glory , and the victory , and the majesty : for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine  ; thine is the kingdom , O  Lord  , and thou art exalted as head above all .
translation.kha: Me long uba khraw bad uba donbor , uba donburom , uba itynnat bad uba iphieng . Kiei kiei baroh ha bneng bad ha khyndew ki dei ki jong me ; me dei u syiem , u nongsynshar bahakhlieh duh halor baroh .

Phi ïoh hynriew sngaid ban trei jingtrei , hynrei ka snoh kaba khyndew ka dei ban long kaban kyntang , ka sngi shongshit ba la pynkyntang sha nga U Trai . Uno uno uba trei ïa Kanaan kano ka kam ha kata ka sngi un shah pynïap .
translation.en: Six days shall work be done , but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day , a sabbath of rest to the  Lord  : whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka Pynmih ïa ki shiah bad ïa ki ñiut , kam dondor ei ei ; ka don ha ka , ka jingma naba U Blei un tim bun pynjot da ka ding .
translation.en: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected , and is nigh unto cursing  ; whose end is to be burned .
Tell us , when shall these things be ? and what shall be the sign when all these things shall be fulfilled ?
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi lano kane kan sa long ,  ki la ong ,  bad to ïathuh ïa ngi kaei ka ban jia ban pyn-i ba ka por ka la poi na ka bynta kine kiei kiei baroh ban long .

U Meshesabel , u Joshua nabar ki rangbah kur ki ong ïa ki , Ngim donkam ïa ka jingaibor jong phi ngab tei ïa ka templ na ka bniat U Terah U Blei’ jong ngi . Ngin tei hi ïa ka da lade , kumba u Syros , u pashat ka Persia , u la hukum ïa ngi .
translation.en: But Zerubbabel , and Jeshua , and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel , said unto them , Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God  ; but we ourselves together will build unto the  Lord  God of Israel , as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us .

translation.kha: Ngim shym pyrshang don pynbor ïa khie kaba phi dadien ban ngeit ; ngi tip ba phi Ïeng skhem ha ka jingieit . Pynban , ngi ïatrei lem bad phi na ka bynta ka jingkmen lad phi hi .
translation.en: Not for that we have dominion over your faith , but are helpers of your joy : for by faith ye stand .

translation.kha: U Tom u sia ia u shabi bad u plie ia ka jingkynjah .
translation.en: Tom pulled out his key and opened the door .

translation.kha: bad ban ap ïa U Khun jong u ba-bang wan na bnoh — U Jeshua , U Khun jong u , ïa uba u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap bad kiba pyllait im ïa ngi na ka jingbitar jongno U Blei ka ban sa wanpaw .
translation.en: And to wait for his Son from heaven , whom he raised from the dead , even Jesus , which delivered us from the wrath to come .

translation.kha: U Jisu! u dang ïaid ha ka baranda u Solomon kaba ha ka Templ , haba ki briew ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u mala kyllut , Sa katno men dang ïai pynap ïa ngi ha ka jingsngap ? Ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka jingshisha kaba shai khadar : Hammoth me longsyiem U Messaïah ?
translation.en: Then came the Jews round about him , and said unto him , How long dost thou make us to doubt ? If thou be the Christ , tell us plainly .
But he answered and said unto them ,  An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign  ; and there shall no sign be given to it , but the sign of the prophet Jonas :
translation.kha: Katno kiba sniew bad bym don blei ki long ki briew jong kane ka por !  U Jisu u la pynbna .  Phi pan na nga ïa ka kambah ? Em ! Ka kambah kaba yn ai ha phi ka long tang ka kambah jong u Jonah u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: The  Lord  shall reign for ever , even thy God , O Zion , unto all generations . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem junom . U Blei jong pha , ko Seïon , un synshar baroh shi rta . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem ? come , and I will send thee unto them . And he said to him , Here am I .
translation.kha: u Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  Nga kwah ba men leit sha Shekhem , ha kaba ki hynmen shynrang jong me ki ap sumar ïa ki kynhun jingri .  U Joseph u jubab ,  Nga kloi .
Nangta u la ong ha u briew naba don ka kti kaba la ïapshiliang , To kner sawar ïa la ka kti . U la kner shabar ïa ka bad ka la kylla bha pat , kitab long kata Kawei pat .
translation.en: Then saith he to the man ,  Stretch forth thine hand .  And he stretched it forth  ; and it was restored whole , like as the other .

translation.kha: U Trai , wahbah la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , uba la pynpang ïa ka bad buh ïa ka ha la ka jaka , u la kren ha ang . uto uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U Trai , u la ong ,
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  the maker thereof , the  Lord  that formed it , to establish it  ; the  Lord  is his name  ;

translation.kha: U Paul u la ïeng ha khmat jong ka dorbar jong ka nongbah bad u la ong , Nga ioh ba ha ki liang baroh ma phi ki nong Artemis ph long kiba kit mai bha .
translation.en: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars  hill , and said , Ye men of Athens , I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious .

translation.kha: to ai um ïa ki briew kiba sliang kiba Wan sha Phin . Pi ki briew jong ka ri Tema , to ai jingbang ïa ki nongpeit .
translation.en: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty , they prevented with their bread him that fled .
And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal  ; and he sat down among the ashes .
translation.kha: U Job u leit bad u shong ha ka kynton ñiut bad u shim da ki saraw khiew ba la pait ban trud ïa ki tohjaw kiba don ha u .
Ngim dei ban tynjuh ïa U Tharai , kumba don na ki , kiba la leh kumta — malade la pynïap ïa ki da ki bseiñ .
translation.en: Neither let us tempt Christ , as some of them also tempted , and were destroyed of serpents .
And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies : but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth  ; for they proceed from evil to evil , and they know not me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki long borabor kiba kloi ban ïathuh lamler ; ka jingbymhok ha ka jaka jong ka jingshisha , ka synshar ïa ka ri . U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew jong nga ki leh ïa kawei kaba sniew hadien kawei pat bad kim shym pdiang ïa nga kum U Blei jong ki .
Ka la lama ka sngi Thohdieng , bad ka sngi Sabteka ka la jan sdang .
translation.en: And that day was the preparation , and the sabbath drew on .

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei jong phi un wiang ïamareh ïa phi sha kata ka ri kaba phin ïuhkjat , sad un beh napoh nangta ïa ki jingtipbriew kiba bun . Kabbon phi nang ïaid sha khmat , un beh noh ïa ki hynñiew ki jaitbynriew uba kham bun paid bad kham khrawbor ban ïa phi . Kita ki dei ki Hit , ki Girgash , ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hobab , bad ki bakla .
translation.en: When the  Lord  thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it , and hath cast out many nations before thee , the Hittites , and the Girgashites , and the Amorites , and the Canaanites , and the Perizzites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites , seven nations greater and mightier than thou  ;

translation.kha: namar ka rukom kaba pa’ la ïaphah ïa per ha ka kam jong ka gospel sha kiwei pat naduh ka sneng kaba sdang haduh mynta .
translation.en: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now ;
And when thou sendest him out free from thee , thou shalt not let him go away empty :
translation.kha: Haba phi pyllait ïa ki , wat phah noh thylli ïa ki .
U Blang jong ngi u don ha bneng ; u leh ïa kano kano kaba u mane .
translation.en: But our God is in the heavens : he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased .

translation.kha: Nga sneng bad sympat ïa baroh ibha ar ieit . Long kaba thrang eh , te , Bad pait noh na ki pop jong pha .
translation.en: As many as I love , I rebuke and chasten : be zealous therefore , and repent .
Thou therefore , my son , be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong me , ko khun jong nga , to long khlaiñ da ka jingaiei kaba dei ka jong ngi ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: My people , go ye out of the midst of her , and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , to phet noh nangta ! Phet ban lait im na ka jingbitar shla jong nga .
Ngin pyntieng kular ïa ki nongshun jong phi . Ngan beh noh ïa ki Hib , ki Kanaan , bad ki Hit katba phi nang tur sha khmat .
translation.en: And I will send hornets before thee , which shall drive out the Hivite , the Canaanite , and the Hittite , from before thee .

translation.kha: Wat klet ba phi la Long ki mraw ha Ijipt ; de namsop kata ba nga la ai ha phi ïa Kanah ka hukum .
translation.en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt : therefore I command thee to do this thing .

And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Bring Aaron s rod again before the testimony , to be kept for a token against the rebels  ; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me , that they die not .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Buh biang ïa u diengduh jong u Aaron ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang . Dei ban buh ïa u kum ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel kiba ïaleh pyrshah ba kin ïap lymda ki sangeh noh ïa ki jingkren khñium jong ki .

translation.en: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the  Lord  your God , and his testimonies , and his statutes , which he hath commanded thee .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba phi dei ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh kiba u la ai ha phi .

Ki suri bad ki khunlangbrot kin ïabam lang , ki sing kin bam phlang , kumba bam ki masi , bad ki bseiñ kin ym long shuh ka jingma . Ha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jyllang nga yn ym to shuh ka jingma ne kaba sniew .
translation.en: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together , and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock : and dust shall be the serpent s meat . They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain , saith the  Lord .
Then said Joab to Cushi , Go tell the king what thou hast seen . And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab , and ran .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ïa u mraw jong u na Sudan ,  Khie leit ïathuh ha u syiem ïa kaei kaba me la ïohi .  U mraw u la nguh bad u la mareh bran .
Lane lehse phi ibeiñ ïa ka jingsbun bakhraw jong u , ka jingshah laitluid , bad ka jingïaishah . Da sha phi tip) ba U Blei u longsem uba sbun , namar u pyrshang ban ïalam ïa phi Ban tap-matlah .
translation.en: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering ; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance ?

translation.kha: U dei U Trai uba la khanglad ïa phi ban pynhiarkput bad pynïap ïa ki nongshniah jong phi . Bad mynta nga smai ha phi da U Trai naba im ba ki nongshun jongnga phi bad baroh kiba kwah baneh pynmynsaw ïa phi keiñ sha pynkhamti kumta u Nongbah .
translation.en: Now therefore , my lord , as the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , seeing the  Lord  hath withholden thee from coming to shed blood , and from avenging thyself with thine own hand , now let thine enemies , and they that seek evil to my lord , be as Nabal .

translation.kha: Ki la long ki briew ki bym lah ban leh ei ei shuh , kaba tlot palat ban leh ïa kano kane ka kur na ka bynta jong nga .
translation.en: Yea , whereto might the strength of their hands profit me , in whom old age was perished ?

translation.kha: U la ieh ïa ka dohthang jongki nga ha ka jingthiah badno u la pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong nga .
translation.en: My flesh and my skin hath he made old  ; he hath broken my bones .
Thou shalt be for fuel to the fire  ; thy blood shall be in the midst of the land  ; thou shalt be no more remembered : for I the  Lord  have spoken it .
translation.kha: Yn pynjot ïa phi da ka ding . Ïa ka snam jong phi yn pynmih ha la ka ri , bad yn ym don ba kynmaw shuh ïa phi .’   U  Trai  u la kren .
Ki dei ban sngewnguh ïa U Trai na ka bynta ka jingieit baneh jong u , na ka bynta khie kiei kiba phylla kiba u la lai na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !

translation.kha: Ka la don ka jingïa-pasiaw kaba jreiñ shaphang jong u hapdeng u pynbah . U long u briew uba Bha , don kiba la ong . Em , kyiuh ki la ong , u ïalam kynjoh ïa ki briew .
translation.en: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him : for some said , He is a good man : others said , Nay  ; but he deceiveth the people .

translation.kha: namar ka khun marwei jong u , kaba la khat-ar snieh ka ter , ka la jan ïarep . Katto U Jehu u dang ïaid , ki briew ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u na ki liang baroh .
translation.en: For he had one only daughter , about twelve years of age , and she lay a dying . But as he went the people thronged him .

translation.kha: Haba la phah da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u Barnabas Bad u Saul ki la leit sha Seleukia mala ki la leit da ka lieng nangta sha ka dewlynnong Sypros .
translation.en: So they , being sent forth by the Holy Ghost , departed unto Seleucia  ; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus .

translation.kha: U Ujuh u la wan pat sha ka Templ ; bad katba u ïan hawei , ki pynrangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wan sha u bad ki la kylli , Me ni hok aïu ban har ïa kine kiew kiei ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa kane ka hok ?
translation.en: And when he was come into the temple , the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching , and said , By what authority doest thou these things ? and who gave thee this authority ?

translation.kha: U syiem Nebukhadnessar u la phah ïa ka khubor harum shata ki briew jong baroh ki jingpyniwbih , ki jait ki kynjoh , bun ki ktien ki thylliej ha ka pyrthei : Khublei !
translation.en: Nebuchadnezzar the king , unto all people , nations , and languages , that dwell in all the earth  ; Peace be multiplied unto you .
