And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon : and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men  ; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom , and slew two thousand men of them .
translation.kha: Kiba sah ki phai bad phet ïap shaphang ri khlaw sha u Mawsiang Rimmon . San hajar ngut na kita ki shah pynïap ha lynti bah . Ki Israel ki ïai beh ïa kiba dang sah haduh Gidom , ki da pynïap ar hajar ngut na kita .
U Trai u la sngewkwah ïa ka jingkynjah pyrshah kaba jur ïa kine ki briew’ pynlang u la phah ba ngin pynjot thiaw ïa ka Sodom .
translation.en: For we will destroy this place , because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  hath sent us to destroy it .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki hynñiew ngut ki angel uba la don ïa ki hynriewphew tylliat ki pliang kiba dap da ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam Kiba ïathuh u la wan sha de badno u la ong , To wan , bad Ngan pyn-i ha me ïa ka Nongleitkurim , ka tnga jongki U Khunlangbrot .
translation.en: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues , and talked with me , saying , Come hither , I will shew thee the bride , the Lamb s wife .
And they were all amazed , and were in doubt , saying one to another , What meaneth this ?
translation.kha: Da kaba lyngngoh bad shaïong , ki la ïai kylli uwei ïa uwei pat ,  Aïu kane ka kit jingmut ?

translation.en: Because they provoked his spirit , so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips .
translation.kha: Ki la pynkthang ïa u haduh katta katta haduh ba u la kren khlem da ap ban pyrkhat .
Me kner ïa la ka kti kamon , sad ka khynwin ka nguid ïa ki nongshun jong ine .
translation.en: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand , the earth swallowed them .
Because they have not hearkened to my words , saith the  Lord  , which I sent unto them by my servants the prophets , rising up early and sending them  ; but ye would not hear , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane kan jia ha ki namar kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka khubor kaba nga ju ïai phah sha ki lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jong nga . Ki la kyntait ban shahshkor .

jynreiñ ki Israel ki la pynïap bun ki nongshun ha ka thma bad ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki naduh ka wah Araunah na shaphang shatei haduh ka Jabbok , kata , haduh ki Ammon , namar ka khappud ki Ammon ka long kaba khlaiñ bha ka jingïada .
translation.en: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword , and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok , even unto the children of Ammon : for the border of the children of Ammon was strong .

translation.kha: Ngi la leh bymman pyrshah ïa me bad ngim shym la leh ïa khie kaba me la hukum . Ngim shym la sumar ïa ki hukum kiba me la ai ha ngi lyngba u Manasseh , u shakri Jong me .
translation.en: We have dealt very corruptly against thee , and have not kept the commandments , nor the statutes , nor the judgments , which thou commandedst thy servant Moses .

translation.kha: Hangta ha khmat uta u paidbah baroh , u syiem Dabid u ïaroh ïa U Trai . U ong A tharai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jongki ngi , ai ba yn ïaroh ïa me jyrngam la junom !
translation.en: Wherefore David blessed the  Lord  before all the congregation : and David said , Blessed be thou ,  Lord  God of Israel our father , for ever and ever .

translation.kha: Ym don uno eit umbiah thang ïa ka sharak bad buh ïa ka hapoh ka shang ; hynrei u buh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharai , na kaba ka ai jingshai ïa baroh Kiba hapoh ka ïing .
translation.en: Neither do men light a candle , and put it under a bushel , but on a candlestick  ; and it giveth light unto all that are in the house .

translation.kha: U syiem u jyllop , Emim donkam ban ong ei ei shuh shuh . NGA la rai ba ma me bad u Siba men ïabynta ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u Saul .
translation.en: And the king said unto him , Why speakest thou any more of thy matters ? I have said , Thou and Ziba divide the land .

translation.kha: Katno ka un-long kaba kordit ïa ki ! Ki la bud ha ka lynti kaba u Kain u la ïaid . Na ka bynta ka tyngkai , ki la aiti ïa lade sha ka jingbah kaba u Baladan u la bor . Ki la ïaleh pyrshah kumba u Korah u la ïaleh pynshah , bad kum ma u , la pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: Woe unto them ! for they have gone in the way of Cain , and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward , and perished in the gainsaying of Core .

translation.kha: U Trai un iehnoh ïa ki Israel namar ba u Jeroboam u la leh pop malade u la ïalam ïa ki paid Israel ban leh pop .
translation.en: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam , who did sin , and who made Israel to sin .

translation.kha: Nga la tip ba ïa phi ym lah ba shaniah , la ju tipbriew ïa phi kum u nongïathuh pyrshah . Na kata ka daw phim pang ju ïohsngew satia ïa kane , balei ba wat shikyntien ruh kam shym la wan ha ki shkor jong phira ?
translation.en: Yea , thou heardest not  ; yea , thou knewest not  ; yea , from that time that thine ear was not opened : for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously , and wast called a transgressor from the womb .
You will find such friends among Jehovah’s Witnesses .
translation.kha: Phin shem ïa kum kita ki paralok hapdeng ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah .

Lada don ki kam kiba kham eh ïa ki nongbishar shnong ban rai , kum ki ñiuhmat ïaknieh khyndew , lane kiba dei shngain kaba ïaishah ïadat , lynti kito kiba hap ban pynïapher hapdeng ka jingpyndep briew bad kawei paw ka jait jingpynïap briew , ithuh sha kata ka tare miej Blei ïa kaba la ïaid da U tharai U Blei jong phi ,
translation.en: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment , between blood and blood , between plea and plea , and between stroke and stroke , being matters of controversy within thy gates : then shalt thou arise , and get thee up into the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose  ;

translation.kha: Kumta ki la ong ïa ki baneh mihnoh na ka kamra ka Lodebar , bad nangto ki la sdang ïaphylliew jingmut para ma ki .
translation.en: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council , they conferred among themselves ,
Now there are diversities of gifts , but the same Spirit .
translation.kha: Ki don bun jait ki jingai ba kynja mynsiem , hynrei ujuh U Mynsiem u ai ïa ki .
Haba me ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïaid halor ki kliar dieng , te tuh ïaleh ïa ki namar ngan ïaid ha suk jong me ban jop ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ki Philistia .
translation.en: And let it be , when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees , that then thou shalt bestir thyself : for then shall the  Lord  go out before thee , to smite the host of the Philistines .
Without father , without mother , without descent , having neither beginning of days , nor end of life  ; but made like unto the Son of God  ; abideth a priest continually .
translation.kha: Ym shym la don jingthoh shaphang u kpa lane ka kmie lane jong kino kino ki kpa tymmen jong u Melkhisedek ; ym shym la don jingthoh shaphang ka jingkha lane ka jingïap jong u . U syriem ïa U Khun U Blei , u ïaisah u lyngdoh junom .
Kenan , la kumno kynum , kam dih ka stang ban long hapdeng jong phi . Ladan uwei na phi u khoh ban long uba khrong , u dei ban long u shakri ïa kiwei pat ;
translation.en: But it shall not be so among you : but whosoever will be great among you , let him be your minister  ;

translation.kha: U Trai u la jubab , Kane ka la jia namar ki briew jong ang ki la iehnoh ïa ka jinghikai jong la kaba nga la ai ha ki . Kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga litar leh ïa kaei kaba nga la baheh ïa ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  saith , Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them , and have not obeyed my voice , neither walked therein  ;
And that ye study to be quiet , and to do your own business , and to work with your own hands , as we commanded you ;
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa ka , ka jingthmu jong phi ban im ka jingim kaba jar jar , ban pyrkhat ïa la ka kam , ban kamai na ka bynta ka jingim jong phi hi , kumba ngi la bthah ïa phi mynshuwa .

translation.en: Which story did you tell ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka Jingiathuh khana ba phi iathuh ?
Tang ma nga hi at thop ïa ki jingthmu kiba nga kein na ka bynta jong phi , ki jinghukum ban wallam ha phi ka jingmane bad ym ka jingpynjot , ki jingthmu ban wallam ïa ka lawei kaba phira ap kyrmen .
translation.en: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you , saith the  Lord  , thoughts of peace , and not of evil , to give you an expected end .

translation.kha: Hangta u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad baroh bakha synrap ïa u , ki dkhot jong ka kynjah ki Saddusi na kata ka jaka , ki la bishni shait eh ïa ki Apollos ; kumta ki la kut jingput ban leh ei ei .
translation.en: Then the high priest rose up , and all they that were with him , ( which is the sect of the Sadducees , ) and were filled with indignation ,

translation.kha: Dan mano mano ba la pyn-i ha me ïa ki khyrdep kaba ap phira ïa ka pyrthei ba-dum jong katba ïap ?
translation.en: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee ? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jyllop ïa ki , A katno phi long kiba bakla ! Ka long nalor ba phim tip ïa ki jingthoh bakhuid lane ïa ka bor U Blei .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Ye do err , not knowing the scriptures , nor the power of God .

translation.kha: To U Blei Badonbor Baroh un kyrkhu ïa ka shongkha shongman jongngi me bad un ai ïa me bhor ki khunlung ki kti , ba men ïoh longkmie u kba jong kiba bun ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: And God Almighty bless thee , and make thee fruitful , and multiply thee , that thou mayest be a multitude of people  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei haba nga ong , lang klet noh ïa U Terah bad ngan ym kren shu ha ka kyrteng jong u , te ka khohruh jong me ka long kum ka ryndang kaba klang jylliew hapoh lad nga . Nga la pyrkhing kat kaba nga lah don kun ïa ka , hynrei ngam eh ban bat ïa ka .
translation.en: Then I said , I will not make mention of him , nor speak any more in his name . But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones , and I was weary with forbearing , and I could not stay .

translation.kha: Te Namarba ba u sheptieng ïa u Abimelekh , u hynñiew Jong u , u Jotham u la phet ïap bun u leit shong ha Beer .
translation.en: And Jotham ran away , and fled , and went to Beer , and dwelt there , for fear of Abimelech his brother .

translation.kha: Phi eh banbeiñ bam ïa ki ha ïing . Baroh na phi , la phi Long kiba khuid ne ki bymkhuid , phi eh ba bam ïa ki , kumba bam ïa ka doh pukni ne ka doh ut .
translation.en: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates : the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike , as the roebuck , and as the hart .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngin imat ïa kine ki briew ? ki la kyllut . Erastos uwei baroh ha Jerusalem u tip ba ïa kane ka kambah kaba phetwir la leh da ma ki , bad ngim lah ban sam ïa ka .
translation.en: Saying , What shall we do to these men ? for that indeed a notable miracle hath been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem  ; and we cannot deny it .

translation.kha: U Boas u kylli ïa u briew Uba pynïaidkam , Katba ka bymsalia ka dei mano ?
translation.en: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers , Whose damsel is this ?

translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane , khnang ba phin ym iehnoh ïa ka jingiw jong pa .
translation.en: These things have I spoken unto you , that ye should not be offended .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit bad ïaleh ba ki briew kin phai noh na ki pop lad ki .
translation.en: And they went out , and preached that men should repent .

translation.kha: Ka Mari ka la kynmaw ïa kine keiñ ktien baroh bad ka la pyrkhat jylliew shaphang kita .
translation.en: But Mary kept all these things , and pondered them in her heart .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki kylli ïa nga , Balei ba me leh kumne ?
translation.en: And the people said unto me , Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us , that thou doest so ?

translation.kha: U Gallio u ïew ïa ki , bad u Ong ha u Sebul , Ha khmih ! La anna ki briew kiba wan hiar na kliar ki lum ! Kito kim dei ki briew , ïajubab u Sebul . Ki shu long tyngkan ki syrngiew halor ki lum .
translation.en: And when Gaal saw the people , he said to Zebul , Behold , there come people down from the top of the mountains . And Zebul said unto him , Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men .
And Lot went out at the door unto them , and shut the door after him ,
translation.kha: U Lot u mih shabar , u da khang tdam ïa ka jingkhang .
U Phinehas u la Jobab , Ko Terah , bun ki briew ki la ïathuh ïa at shaphang uno u briew bad Shaphan kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kiba u la leh ïa ki briew’ jong me ha Jerushah .
translation.en: Then Ananias answered , Lord , I have heard by many of this man , how much evil he hath done to thy saints at Jerusalem :

translation.kha: Mynta , U Blei u la tyrwa ha ngi ïa ka jingkular ba I lah ban pdiang ïa ka jingjahthait ïa kaba u la kren . Te , to ngin da sumar , ba yn ym shet ïa uno uno na phi u me kot ban ïohpdiang ïa kata ka jingjahthait ba la kular .
translation.en: Let us therefore fear , lest , a promise being left us of entering into his rest , any of you should seem to come short of it .

The burden of Egypt . Behold , the  Lord  rideth upon a swift cloud , and shall come into Egypt : and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence , and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Ijipt . U  Trai  u wan sha Ijipt , u da shong ha u lyoh uba ïaid stet . Ki bleithaw jong ki Ijipt ki khynñiuh ha khmat jong u , bad ki briew jong ka Ijipt ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur jong ki .

translation.en: And he spake many things unto them in parables , saying ,  Behold , a sower went forth to sow  ;
translation.kha: U la pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ban ïathuh ïa ki shibun kiei kiei .  Shisien la don u briew uba la mihnoh ban bet symbai .
Lada U Blei u rai don nym ai ei ei ruh , ym don uno uno uba lah ban wad daw ïa u . Lada u buhrieh ïa ka khmat jong u , ki briew kin long kiba khlem ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: When he giveth quietness , who then can make trouble ? and when he hideth his face , who then can behold him ? whether it be done against a nation , or against a man only :

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban ïaisah dom u la hir mynba u la pdiang ïa ka jingthoh U Blei .
translation.en: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called .

translation.kha: Lada phi kwah ba ki briew kin sngewtynnat ïa phi , to map ïa ki haba ki kumne leh bakla ïa phi . To kynmaw ba ki jingbakla ki ia ban pynpra ïa ka jingïada paralok .
translation.en: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love  ; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends .

translation.kha: Ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai , te mynta ngi dei ban ïaishah ïa ka jingtip jong u shipor . Hynrei ha kaba kut un ïada ïa ngi dara un pynbeit ïa ka ba-bymman kaba la imat ha ngi . Un wallam ïa ngi sharak sha ka jingshai ; ngin im ban ïohi ba u pyut im ïa ngi .
translation.en: I will bear the indignation of the  Lord  , because I have sinned against him , until he plead my cause , and execute judgment for me : he will bring me forth to the light , and I shall behold his righteousness .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la sdang ban mihnoh na Jerahmeel bad ban wait shaei ka thain Benjamin ban leit shim ïa ka bynshet jongnga nga na ka nongkynti ka long-briew .
translation.en: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin , to separate himself thence in the midst of the people .

translation.kha: Nangta ka smat ïa ka lynthaw na ïing , ka pyndem ïa ka ha jingthiah , ka buh ka syngkhlieh kaba da u shñiuh biang ha khlieh jngai sier , bad ka buh jingtap halor jongngi ka .
translation.en: And Michal took an image , and laid it in the bed , and put a pillow of goats  hair for his bolster , and covered it with a cloth .

translation.kha: Naba kito kin longsem ‘ Ki Sngi ka Jingpynshitom ,’ ban pynurlong ïa baroh kaba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ban urlong shisha .
translation.en: For these be the days of vengeance , that all things which are written may be fulfilled .
A divine sentence is in the lips of the king : his mouth transgresseth not in judgment .
translation.kha: U syiem u kren da ka iktiar blei ; ki rai jong u borabor ki long kiba dei .

translation.en: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord ? for as for me , straightway there remained no strength in me , neither is there breath left in me .
translation.kha: Nga long kum u mraw uba ïeng ha khmat u kynrad jong u . Kumno nga lah ban ïakren bad phi ? Ngam donbor lane jingpynhiar mynsiem kaba dang sah ha nga .
ïaheh ba u patsha un da pynbeit pud ïa phi ha ka ri kaba kum ka jong phi hi , ha kaba don ki bri sohwaiñ ban ai wat bad ha kaba don u kew ban shna jingbam .
translation.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land , a land of corn and wine , a land of bread and vineyards .

There is one alone , and there is not a second  ; yea , he hath neither child nor brother : yet is there no end of all his labour  ; neither is his eye satisfied with riches  ; neither saith he , For whom do I labour , and bereave my soul of good ? This is also vanity , yea , it is a sore travail .
translation.kha: Hangne don uwei uba shong basah marwei . Um don khun shynrang lymne u para , pynban u ïai trei , um ju sngewhun ïa ka spah kaba u don . Na ka bynta jongno ba u trei shitom haduh katta katta bad ba u khanglad ïa lade hi na kano kano ka jingpynsngewbha ? Kane ruh ka long ka bymmyntoi — bad ka lynti ba-isangsot ban im .
U Trai , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki , u ïaw phah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa baneh mawjam ïa ki briew jong u , namar ba u kwah ban da ïa ki malade ïa ka templ .
translation.en: And the  Lord  God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers , rising up betimes , and sending  ; because he had compassion on his people , and on his dwelling place :

translation.kha: Kito sha kba u ju phan khmat basbun na ka boitha ka jingai jingman ki long u Karshena , u Sephathah , u Adah , u Tarshish , u Mareal , u Manasseh bad u Memukan — ki iehnoh ngut ki rangbah synsar jrong ka Persia sad ka Media kiba bat ïa ki kyrdan treikam bahakhlieh duh jong ka hima .
translation.en: And the next unto him was Carshena , Shethar , Admatha , Tarshish , Meres , Marsena , and Memucan , the seven princes of Persia and Media , which saw the king s face , and which sat the first in the kingdom  ; )
And the king sat upon his seat , as at other times , even upon a seat by the wall : and Jonathan arose , and Abner sat by Saul s side , and David s place was empty .
translation.kha: bad u shong ha ka jaka ba u ju shong hajan kynroh . U Abner u shong hajan jong u , bad u Jonathan ha pyrshah jong u .

Te , kaei kan long ïa u briew uba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Khun U Blei ? uba ñiew dew thala ïa ka snam jong ka jutang U Blei kaba pynkhuid ïa u na ka pop ? naba ñiewshiliang ïa U Mynsiem ka jingisynei ? To pyrkhat haduh katno Kan long ka jingpyntreikam naba kham sngewshyrkhei kaba u daiñ shun ïoh !
translation.en: Of how much sorer punishment , suppose ye , shall he be thought worthy , who hath trodden under foot the Son of God , and hath counted the blood of the covenant , wherewith he was sanctified , an unholy thing , and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace ?

translation.kha: Kine ki bariew ki la ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid , kumba ma ngi ruh ngi la ïohpdiang . Hato don uno a , te , u ban khang ïa ki na kaba shahïap pynbaptis da ka um ?
translation.en: Can any man forbid water , that these should not be baptized , which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we ?
And the  Lord  said unto me , Say unto them , Go not up , neither fight  ; for I am not among you  ; lest ye be smitten before your enemies .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la ong ha nga , ‘ Maham ïa ki ban ym leit tur , naba ngan ym long ryngkat bad ki , bad ki nongshun jong ki kin sa jop ïa ki .’
Ki shipai jongngi u nongïeng ki rah ïa ki shait rong saw mala ki phong ki sopti rong saw . Ki pynkhih ban tur ïaleh ! Ki kali ïapom jongngi ki , ki thaba kum ka ding ! Ki kyllaiñ jong ki skum stet !
translation.en: The shield of his mighty men is made red , the valiant men are in scarlet : the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation , and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken .

And the people stood up all that day , and all that night , and all the next day , and they gathered the quails : he that gathered least gathered ten homers : and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki briew ki ïakem  iar khiar baroh shi sngi ha kata ka sngi , baroh shi miet , bad baroh shi sngi ha kawei pat ka sngi ; ym don uwei ruh uba lum duna ïa ka shihajar kilo . Nangta ki thad ïa ki sawdong kata ka jaka shong dara .

translation.en: Again , David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel , thirty thousand .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u Dabid u khot lang ïa ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel , kiba long baroh laiphew hajar ngut ,

Mynta te , ko Oholibah , kan ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong ha pha . Pha la thiat ïa kito ki nongtih , hynrei ngan pynpang ïa ki ïa-ban bitar ïa pha bad ngan wanlam ïa ki ban ker sawdong ïa pha .
translation.en: Therefore , O Aholibah , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will raise up thy lovers against thee , from whom thy mind is alienated , and I will bring them against thee on every side  ;
And he that saw it bare record , and his record is true : and he knoweth that he saith true , that ye might believe .
translation.kha: ( Uta uba la ïohi ïa kane ba ka jia u la kren shaphang jong ka , khnang ba ma phi ruh phin ïoh ngeit . Kaei kaba u la ong ka long kaba shisha , bad u tip ba u kren ïa ka jingshisha . )

jynreiñ u rangbah shipai u la kwah ban phlait im ïa u Paulos , kumta u la khang ïa ki na kaba leh ïa kane . Pynban , u la hukum ïa kito kiba lah ban jngi ban ryngkoh nyngkong bad ban jngi sha ryngkew ;
translation.en: But the centurion , willing to save Paul , kept them from their purpose  ; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea , and get to land :

translation.kha: Katto katne na u symbai ki la tap ha ka jaka maw , bad haba ki jingthung ki la shylliah , ki la tyrkhong nala namar ka khyndew kam don kano kano ka jingsngem .
translation.en: And some fell upon a rock  ; and as soon as it was sprung up , it withered away , because it lacked moisture .

translation.kha: Ka kyrpad ïa at Ban shah ba tud bud nadien jong ki nongot mala tam ïa u kew . Ka la trei naduh dang step phrangsngi bad dang myntan ka shongthait shipor hapoh ka jingkahtngen .
translation.en: And she said , I pray you , let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves : so she came , and hath continued even from the morning until now , that she tarried a little in the house .

translation.kha: Nga ong baïong , na tip ba ïa une u briew la rong noh sha ka Paradais “ka Sihon , Ngam tip la khie ka da jia shisha ne ka la long tang ka jingïohipaw — tang U Blei uba tip) , bad hangta u la ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba ym lah ban buh ha ki kyntien , kiei kiew kiba ki rnong shyntur briew kim lah ban kruiñ .
translation.en: How that he was caught up into paradise , and heard unspeakable words , which it is not lawful for a man to utter .

translation.kha: Ka sngi ka la jan Haba U Trai un shong ha ka jingbishar ; kumne to sngap jar ha ka jingdon jingkad jong u . U Trai u pynkhreh baneh kñia ïa ki briew jong u bad u la khot Sngewbha ïa ki nongshun ban lute ïa ka Judah .
translation.en: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord  God  : for the day of the  Lord  is at hand : for the  Lord  hath prepared a sacrifice , he hath bid his guests .

translation.kha: bad ha ka sngap kaba bur , ki la bret noh katto katne ki bynta jong ki tiar ki tar jong ka lieng .
translation.en: And the third day we cast out with our own hands the tackling of the ship .
And beholding the man which was healed standing with them , they could say nothing against it .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym don kano kano kaba ki lah ban ong , namar ba ki la ïohi ïa u briew uba la ïohkhiah uba ïeng hangta lem bad u Petros bad u Ïoannis .
Nga khmih lynti borabor ban im slem bad ban ïap ha la ïing ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Then I said , I shall die in my nest , and I shall multiply my days as the sand .

translation.kha: Bad kum ban shu ong , haba u Abraham u la siew ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew , u Lebi ( kiba iohpateng na u ki lum ïa shiphew ) shwa u la siew ïa ka .
translation.en: And as I may so say , Levi also , who receiveth tithes , payed tithes in Abraham .

translation.kha: lada ka dih kaba larkam jingrem lane kaba lam seh , ka dei ka jingbthuh kaba pur bad dei ban leit pyn-i ïa ka ha u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment , or in the skin , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ; it is a plague of leprosy , and shall be shewed unto the priest :
The  Lord  is King for ever and ever : the heathen are perished out of his land .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long u syiem junom la junom . Kito kiba mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei kin jah noh na ka ri jong u .
kumto nga pynkieng atiar ïa ki briew da ki wait , ki sum , bad ki ryntieh , bad na pynap ïa ki da ki kur hadien ki kynroh , ha ki jaka bym pat dep tei .
translation.en: Therefore set I in the lower places behind the wall , and on the higher places , I even set the people after their families with their swords , their spears , and their bows .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ki jemnud jong ki , ki long kiba shukor , mynta ki dei ban Shimham namar ki pop jong ki . U Bel un pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , bad un pynjot ïa ki rishot kyntang jong ki .
translation.en: Their heart is divided  ; now shall they be found faulty : he shall break down their altars , he shall spoil their images .
To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend  ; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingjynjar kum kane nga donkam ïa ki paralok bashisha — la nga la klet ne khlem klet ïa U Blei .
Ka pum ka la ïoh ïa ka jong , bad da ka jong jong ka hukum , ka la shukor ïa nga bad ka la pynïap ïa nga .
translation.en: For sin , taking occasion by the commandment , deceived me , and by it slew me .

translation.kha: Ngan sa pynshlei ïa ka pyrthuh da ka um ngab pynduh nep khot ïa ki kynja ba-im baroh . Baroh kat kaba don ha ka pyrta kine ïap .
translation.en: And , behold , I , even I , do bring a flood of waters upon the earth , to destroy all flesh , wherein is the breath of life , from under heaven  ; and every thing that is in the earth shall die .
Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree , that we , being dead to sins , should live unto righteousness : by whose stripes ye were healed .
translation.kha: U Khrist da lade hi u la bah noh ïa ki pop jong ngi ha ka met jong u sha ka diengphna , khnang ba ngin ïap ïa ka pop bad ïoh im na ka bynta ka hok . Ka dei da ki jingjngem snam jong u ba la pynkhiah ïa phi .

translation.en: So Joab came to the king , and told him : and when he had called for Absalom , he came to the king , and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king : and the king kissed Absalom .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joab u la leit sha u Syiem Dabid bad u ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba u Absalom u la ong . U syiem u la phah khot ïa u Absalom ; uba la leit sha u bad u dem ngon ha khyndew ha khmat jong u . U syiem u la pdiang sngewbha ïa u da ka jingdoh .
Ki la leh ïa ki kam kiba donbor jong U blem bad kun ïa ki kambah ha Ijipt .
translation.en: They shewed his signs among them , and wonders in the land of Ham .

translation.kha: Kynsan harum ki longsyiem ki jong me na ki jingainguh kiba kyntang tam ïa ki bym shym la thang ha ka kito : ki jingainguh bam , ki jingkñia Naaman ka jop , bad ki jingainguh namar ka jingpalat . Baroh kaba la wanrah ha nga kum ka jingainguh bakyntang ka hir ka jong me bad jong ki khunlung Shynrang jong me .
translation.en: This shall be thine of the most holy things , reserved from the fire : every oblation of theirs , every meat offering of theirs , and every sin offering of theirs , and every trespass offering of theirs , which they shall render unto me , shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons .
But ye , brethren , are not in darkness , that that day should overtake you as a thief .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko parabangeit , phim long ha ka jingdum , bad ba ka Sngi kan lap kyndit ïa phi kum u nongtuh .

translation.en: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh , and said , My father and my brethren , and their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have , are come out of the land of Canaan  ; and , behold , they are in the land of Goshen .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u leit ïalam san ngut na ki hynmen jong u sha u syiem . U ong ,  I pa bad ki hynmen ki para jong nga ki la wan na ka ri Kanaan ryngkat bad ki kynhun langbrot bad ki jingri jingdup jong ki , bad baroh ruh kat kiba ki don . Mynta ki don ha Goshen .
Nga lah wan .
translation.en: I am coming .

translation.kha: Wat la ka Babilon ka lah ban kiew shai suiñbneng bad tei ka kut baskhem hangta , kan dang ïai phah hi ïa ki briew ban pynjot ïa ka . Ma nga , U Trai nga la kriah .
translation.en: Though Babylon should mount up to heaven , and though she should fortify the height of her strength , yet from me shall spoilers come unto her , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai’ un pynshitom ïa ki Ijipt , hynrei pynban un pynkhiah ïa ki . Kin phai sha u , bad un ïohsngew ïa ki jingduwai jong ki bad pynkoit ïa ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall smite Egypt : he shall smite and heal it : and they shall return even to the  Lord  , and he shall be entreated of them , and shall heal them .

translation.kha: Ha shuh banbeiñ kynjat shai , U Trai u la khih ïa ka kynhun shipai jingïaphet na u rishot ding bad u rishot lyoh bad u pynslem thliem ïa ki .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that in the morning watch the  Lord  looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud , and troubled the host of the Egyptians ,

translation.kha: Uno uno uba dei baneh shah kum un shah kem da shisha ; un uno uba den ban shah pynïap da ka waitlam un shah pynkup shisha da ka waitlam . Kñia ka dawa ïa ka jingïaishah nabar ïa ka jingngeit na ka liang jong ki biria jongnga U Blei .
translation.en: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity : he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword . Here is the patience and the faith of the saints .
And I will establish my covenant with thee  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Ngan pynthymmai ïa ka jutang jong nga bad pha , bad phan tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And he put the breastplate upon him : also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim .
translation.kha: U pyndeng ha u ïa ka jingdeng shadem , bad u buh ha ka ïa u Urim bad u Thummim   .

translation.en: Should thy lies make men hold their peace ? and when thou mockest , shall no man make thee ashamed ?
translation.kha: Ko Job , hato me pyrkhat ba ngim lah ban jubab ïa me ? Ba ki kyntien beiñ jong me kin ieh ïa ngi ban nym nang kren shuh ?

Pynphong ïa kine ki jaiñ ha u Aaron u hynmen Jong me mala ha ki khun shynna lad u . Nongthaw pynkupbor ïa ki bad pynkyntang da naba pynsleh ïa ki da ka jingman Olib , khnang ba ki Lah ban shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngngoh .
translation.en: And thou shalt put them upon Aaron thy brother , and his sons with him  ; and shalt anoint them , and consecrate them , and sanctify them , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office .
That as sin hath reigned unto death , even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord .
translation.kha: Te kumta , kumba ka pop ka synshar da ka jingïap , kumta ruh ka jingaiei U Blei ka synshar da ka hok , ka ïalam ïa ngi sha ka jingim bymjukut lyngba U Jisu Khrist U Trai jong ngi .

Hynrei u Samson u thir tieng khih shiteng synñia . U khie nangta bad u batip khak ïa ka khyrdop shnong bad u rat syndon ïa ka — ki jingkynjah , ki shawkad , u nar-khang bad baroh . U ba-eh ïa ki ha la ka tyrpeng bad u rah ïa ki baroh artet lynti sha kliar jong u lum uba marpyrshah ïa ka thohbroin .
translation.en: And Samson lay till midnight , and arose at midnight , and took the doors of the gate of the city , and the two posts , and went away with them , bar and all , and put them upon his shoulders , and carried them up to the top of an hill that is before Hebron .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka prie un ïeng halor u lum Olib , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jerusalem . Te ïa u Lum Olib yn sa kad arliang na mihngi sha sepngi da ka them kaba khraw . shongkhet jongu u lumbah un kynriah sanphew shatei bun shiteng jong u shaphang shathie .
translation.en: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives , which is before Jerusalem on the east , and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west , and there shall be a very great valley  ; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north , and half of it toward the south .

translation.kha: Ki briew kin ïaid sakma na ka durbriew Baïap sha ka Meraïoth malu nangta shuh shuh na shatei shad mihngi . Keiñ ïakhmih kylleng kylleng ïa ka khubor na U TRAI’ , hynrei kin ym shem ïa ka .
translation.en: And they shall wander from sea to sea , and from the north even to the east , they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the  Lord  , and shall not find it .

translation.kha: Lada phi shah ba uba bieit un sam ïa ka khubor , ka long kam ot ïa la ki jong ki kjat ; phi pan ïa ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet , and drinketh damage .

translation.kha: Pynban , ki Israel ktien shym beh noh! ïa ki briew jong ka Geshur bad Maakah ; ki dang shong ha Israel .
translation.en: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites , nor the Maachathites : but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day .
Hast thou heard the secret of God ? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself ?
translation.kha: Hato me ïohsngew pateng ïa ki jingthmu U Blei ïa kiba u la thaw ? Hato ka jingstad briew ka dei ka jong me marwei ?
Ha ka , la don baroh ki jait mrad , ki kynha bapar bun ki sim khlaw .
translation.en: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth , and wild beasts , and creeping things , and fowls of the air .

translation.kha: Dei u Kaïaphas uba la ai jingmut ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba ka kham bha ba uwei u bynriew un ïap na ka bynta ka briew baroh .
translation.en: Now Caiaphas was he , which gave counsel to the Jews , that it was expedient that one man should die for the people .

translation.kha: Akaba Kut ka la woh ha phi ki briew kiba shong ha ka ri . Ka prie ka la jan ha kabu yn ym don shuh ka jingïaleh kmen ha ki jaka ma ha ki lumbah , tang ka jingjur suda .
translation.en: The morning is come unto thee , O thou that dwellest in the land : the time is come , the day of trouble is near , and not the sounding again of the mountains .

translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ha ka Sngap Bishar , U blei un pyn-i shibun ka jingisynei ïa ka Sodom ban ïa kata ka shnong !
translation.en: But I say unto you , that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom , than for that city .
One of the two which heard John speak , and followed him , was Andrew , Simon Peter s brother .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la long u Andriw , uba shi para bad u Simon Petros .
Ki riewngeit ha Antiokh ki la thep da ka jingkmen bad da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: And the disciples were filled with joy , and with the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , pa long ki jong U Blei , ko ki khun jong nga , sad phi la jop ïa ki nongïathuhlypa balamler , nalor U Mynsiem uba ni ha phi , u long uba kham donbor ban ïa u mynsiem ha kito babha long na ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Ye are of God , little children , and have overcome them : because greater is he that is in you , than he that is in the world .

translation.kha: Kat phi nang bun jingkhuslai , katta phin ïoh ki jingphohsniew kynsha , pynlang kat phi nang bunktien katta phin klet ha kaba krenbeiñ ïa kaei kawei kaba bieit .
translation.en: For a dream cometh through the multitude of business  ; and a fool s voice is known by multitude of words .

translation.kha: Mar kumta hynriew ngut ki briew ki wan na ka khyrdop kaba shabar kaba don shaphang shatei jong ka Templ , uwei uwei u rah la ka tiar ïaleh . lynti Bad ki la don u brisoh wahbah khup da ki jaiñ linen , uba rah ki tiar ban thoh . Baroh ki wan bad sheng hajan ka duwan kaba da ka rnong .
translation.en: And , behold , six men came from the way of the higher gate , which lieth toward the north , and every man a slaughter weapon in his hand  ; and one man among them was clothed with linen , with a writer s inkhorn by his side : and they went in , and stood beside the brasen altar .

translation.kha: Haba u Jakob bad ka ïing jong u ki leit sha Ijipt , bad ki nong jingtep ki banbeiñ ïa ki , ki kpa thnum jong phi ki kyang ban ïoh jingïarap sha U Trai , mala U Trai u phah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , kiba la wan ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt bad pynshong pynïasoh ïa ki ha kane ka ri .
translation.en: When Jacob was come into Egypt , and your fathers cried unto the  Lord  , then the  Lord  sent Moses and Aaron , which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt , and made them dwell in this place .
That which hath been is now  ; and that which is to be hath already been  ; and God requireth that which is past .
translation.kha: Kaei kaei kaba jia lane kaba lah ban jia ka la lah jia mynshuwa . U Blei u pynlong ïa kajuh ban jia bad ïai jia .

translation.en: For where a testament is , there must also of necessity be the death of the testator .
translation.kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingai sngewbha da ka jingthoh    , ka long kaba donkam ban pynshisha ba u briew uba ai ïa ka u la ïap ,
bad haba nga la leit sha Jerusalem , ki jingbabe lyndang jong ki Jiw lem bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wanrah ïa ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u bad ki la kyrpad ïa nga ban rwai pynrem ïa u .
translation.en: About whom , when I was at Jerusalem , the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me , desiring to have judgment against him .

translation.kha: Kumba ka long bad u thylliej : La u long uba rit , u lai ba sngewhun shaphang kiei kiei kiba khrud . Shu pyrkhat katjuh ka lawbah lah ban pynpluh ïa ka da i thylliej ding iba rit !
translation.en: Even so the tongue is a little member , and boasteth great things . Behold , how great a matter a little fire kindleth !

translation.kha: Naba ïa ka jingsawa hi ym shym la pynlong tang da kawei ka dkhot met , hynrei da shibun ki dkoh .
translation.en: For the body is not one member , but many .

translation.kha: Nangta ki pyningkhong ka jingtur ïaleh naba tyngeh pyrshah ïa ki Israel , da kob buh ïa ki ha ka khim khait . Katto katne na ki Israel ki rieh ha ki salm bad ha ki thliew , lane khappud ki mawsiang jlan ha ki thliew bad ki puk um ;
translation.en: When the men of Israel saw that they were in a strait , ( for the people were distressed , ) then the people did hide themselves in caves , and in thickets , and in rocks , and in high places , and in pits .

translation.kha: U nonghikai Aiñ u la wan sha u . Ko Nonghikai , u la ong , Neng la kloi ban leit bad me kat shaba me leit .
translation.en: And a certain scribe came , and said unto him , Master , I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest .

All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the  Lord  thy God : thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock , nor shear the firstling of thy sheep .
translation.kha: Buh kyrpang sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa ki shynrang baroh ba la kha nyngkong na ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi ; wat pyntreikam ïa kita ki masi , bad wat ot shñiuh ïa kita ki langbrot .

Ki lama borabor kiba kloi ban ïathuh lamler ; ka jingbymhok ha ka jaka jong ka jingshisha , ka syier ïa ka ri . U Trai u ong , Ki briew jong nga ki leh ïa kawei kaba sniew dadien khawai pat bad kim shym pdiang ïa nga kum U blei lad ki .
translation.en: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies : but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth  ; for they proceed from evil to evil , and they know not me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Da kumta u samla un lah ban sumar khuid ïa la ka jingshim ? Da kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .
translation.en: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way ? by taking heed thereto according to thy word .
Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him , O generation of vipers , who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come ?
translation.kha: U paidbah byllien u la leit sha u Ïoannis ban shah pynbaptis ha u .  Phi ki bseiñ !  u la ong ha ki .  Mano ba la ong ïa phi ba phi lah ban lait na ka jingpynshitom kaba U Blei un sa phah ?

translation.en: That thou hast also built unto thee an eminent place , and hast made thee an high place in every street .
translation.kha: harud jong kawei pa kawei ka surok pha la tei ki jaka ban mane ïa ki bleithaw bad ban ïaleh nuti .

translation.en: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow : but a prating fool shall fall .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba len ïa ka jingshisha u thaw jingkulmar , hynrei uta uba pyn-i markhmat u trei na ka bynta ka jingsuk .
Wat ju bam ïa ka ngap pyllait ban ïa kaba phi donkam ; kiba bam palat ka lah ban pynlong ïa phi ban prie .
translation.en: Hast thou found honey ? eat so much as is sufficient for thee , lest thou be filled therewith , and vomit it .

translation.kha: Kam long ka jingmyntoi ïa ngi ban leit shapoh ka nongbah namar ngin sa ïapthngan hangta , hynrei lada i shongduh hangne , ngin ïap kumjuh . kumto , ïa ngin ïatrei noh sha ka jaka shong dara ki Syria ; kaba sniew tam ba ki lah ban leh ka long ba kin pynïap ïa ngi , hynrei lehse kin pyut im ïa ngi .
translation.en: If we say , We will enter into the city , then the famine is in the city , and we shall die there : and if we sit still here , we die also . Now therefore come , and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians : if they save us alive , we shall live  ; and if they kill us , we shall but die .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Trai bad u la leit ruma u Gad u la ïathuh ïa u .
translation.en: And David , according to the saying of Gad , went up as the  Lord  commanded .

translation.kha: kiei leit lumlang ïa ki thlim ki san jong ki Israel bad ïathuh ha ki ba nga U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei jong u Abbim , U Isaak , badno u Jobab , nga la mihpaw ha me . Ïathuh ruh ha ki ba nga la wan jngoh ïa ki , bun nga la ïohi aïu ki nong Ijipt ki la leh ïa ki .
translation.en: Go , and gather the elders of Israel together , and say unto them , The  Lord  God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , of Isaac , and of Jacob , appeared unto me , saying , I have surely visited you , and seen that which is done to you in Egypt :
And in those days , when the number of the disciples was multiplied , there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews , because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , katba ka jingdon ki synran ka nang ïai kiew , la don ka jingïania hapdeng ki Jiw kiba kren Grik bad ki Jiw kiba kren ktien tynrai . Ki Jiw kiba kren Grik ki la kam ba ïa ki riewkynthei la leh klet ha ka jingsam pisa kaba man ka sngi .
Kumta te , to shah ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , ngan leh : Ngan ai ki jhur kthang ha ki bri jong nga ban ba-im bad ka bih ban dkoh .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will feed them , even this people , with wormwood , and give them water of gall to drink .

translation.kha: Ki jingïohipaw jong ki , ki long kiba bakla , bad ki jingïathuh lypa jong ki , ki long kiba lamler . Ki kam ba ki kren ïa ka khubor lad nga , hynrei ngam shym la phah ïa ki . Pynkup ki khmih lyngki ba ki ktien jong ki kin urlong shisha !
translation.en: They have seen vanity and lying divination , saying , The  Lord  saith : and the  Lord  hath not sent them : and they have made others to hope that they would confirm the word .
For he that is called in the Lord , being a servant , is the Lord s freeman : likewise also he that is called , being free , is Christ s servant .
translation.kha: Naba u mraw uba la khot da U Trai u long uba laitluid na ka bynta U Trai ; kumjuh ruh u briew uba laitluid ïa uba la khot da U Khrist u long u mraw jong U .

translation.en: Not for any injustice in mine hands : also my prayer is pure .
translation.kha: hynrei ngam shym la shah kynnoh pop ïa kano kano ka jingïaleh pynmynsaw , bad ka jingduwai jong nga sha U Blei ka long kaba beit .
U la ong shai bha ïa kane ha ki . Kumta u Petros u la shim kyrpang ïa u dara u la pdang ban sneng ïa u .
translation.en: And he spake that saying openly . And Peter took him , and began to rebuke him .
And when the centurion , which stood over against him , saw that he so cried out , and gave up the ghost , he said , Truly this man was the Son of God .
translation.kha: U shipai rangbah uba ïeng hangta ha khmat ka diengphna u la ïohi kumno U Jisu u la ïap .  Une u briew u long shisha U Khun U Blei !  u la ong .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did eat manna forty years , until they came to a land inhabited  ; they did eat manna , until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la bam ïa ka manna sawphew snem lynter , haduh ba kin da poi ha ka ri Kanaan , ha kaba ki la shongduh .

translation.en: And he smote Moab  ; and the Moabites became David s servants , and brought gifts .
translation.kha: U jop ruh ïa ki Moab kiba kylla long ki raïot jong u bad siew khajna sha u .
Te u la pyndonkam da u bsein ban krai ha ka Im ba lada ka bameh ïa u seh na uta u dieng , kan ym ïap , Hynrei kan long kum U Blei .
translation.en: So he used a serpent to tell Eve that if she ate the fruit from that tree , she would not die , but she would be like God .

translation.kha: Nga sei ïa ka hab jong nga baroh na ka bynta ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynduh bad ngam shym wad don ïoh kano nangno ka jingdon jingem . Baroh kiba trei na ka bynta jong nga , ki ïashah ha ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh .
translation.en: Yea , also I continued in the work of this wall , neither bought we any land : and all my servants were gathered thither unto the work .

translation.kha: Bad hangta ka la ïakynduh ïa u , ka da riam kum ka nuti bad ka da pyrkhat snieh .
translation.en: And , behold , there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot , and subtil of heart .

translation.kha: U Nathanael u la kyllaiñ ïa u , Kumno me ithuh ïa per ? U Jisu u la jop , Nga la ïohi ïa me mynba me dang don ha trai u Dieng Burom ha shuwa ba u Philip un khot ïa me .
translation.en: Nathanael saith unto him , Whence knowest thou me ? Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Before that Philip called thee , when thou wast under the fig tree , I saw thee .

translation.kha: da naba la pyllaitluid ïa ngi , kata ka long , ba la map ïa ki pop jong ngi .
translation.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood , even the forgiveness of sins :

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang u Eli ki dei ki riewbymman . Kin ju shah ïa U Trai
translation.en: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial  ; they knew not the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka por kan poi haba ki nongshun jong pha kin ker sawdong ïa pha da ki jingker , ki jinglongkhuid ïa pha , bad ki kad tur jan sha pha na ki liang baroh .
translation.en: For the days shall come upon thee , that thine enemies shall cast a trench about thee , and compass thee round , and keep thee in on every side ,

translation.kha: hynne u Dabid u Jobab , Ko ki hynmen ki para jyllang nga , phim dei shun leh kumta ïa kaba U TRAI’ u la ai ha ngi ! U la ri la da ïa ngi , bad u la ai ha i ka jinghap halor kito ki nonglute .
translation.en: Then said David , Ye shall not do so , my brethren , with that which the  Lord  hath given us , who hath preserved us , and delivered the company that came against us into our hand .
And Pharaoh said , Behold , the people of the land now are many , and ye make them rest from their burdens .
translation.kha: Phi mynta phi la kham ïabun paid ban ïa ki nong Ijipt . Bad mynta phi kwah ban sangeh trei !

Hato daiñ na kata ba pa’ barben phi la jingïasylla pyrshah ïa nga ? Ym don uwei ruh na phi uba la ïathuh ha nga ba u khuid jong nga hi u la ïateh kular bad u Dabid . Ym don Uei ruh uba pyrkhat sngewlem ïa nga lane ïateh ha nga ba u Dabid , uwei na ki rangbah jong nga , u don hangne mynta , u da thad ïa ka kabu ban pynïap ïa nga , bad ba u khun jong nga u la pynshlur ïa u !
translation.en: That all of you have conspired against me , and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse , and there is none of you that is sorry for me , or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me , to lie in wait , as at this day ?

translation.kha: Kito kiba pyrshang ban buhai ïa ki jingshitom jongki ki na U Troas , kin jot noh ! Ki pynïaid ïa ki rukom treikam jong ki ha kaba rieh badno ki pyrkhat ba yn ym don ba ïohthiah ïa ki lane tipthuh ïa kaei kabu ki imat .
translation.en: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the  Lord  , and their works are in the dark , and they say , Who seeth us ? and who knoweth us ?
That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God , and may with you be refreshed .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan wan sha phi da ka jingkmen kaba dap , lada ka long ka mon jong U Blei , bad ngan dap da ka jinghun ba pynpyngngad haba ngan wan khmih ïa phi .
Ki khynnah na la ka tynrai ki leh kiei kaei Kiba ibeiñ , khlem synrum , hyndai ka jingsneng sympat kaba bha ka hikai ïa ki kumno ban long .
translation.en: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child  ; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him .

translation.kha: Ai ba ki paid Israel kin ong , Ka jingkheit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: Let Israel now say , that his mercy endureth for ever .

And it shall be , when the  Lord  thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give thee great and goodly cities , which thou buildedst not ,
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob , un ai ha phi ïa ka ri kaba don ki shnong kiba heh bad kiba pahuh pahai kiba phim shym la tei .
U paidbah babun u la bud ïa u ; hapdeng jong ki , la don katto katne nongput ki kynthei kiba la ïam bad ïam sngewsih na ka bynda jong u .
translation.en: And there followed him a great company of people , and of women , which also bewailed and lamented him .
And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold .
translation.kha: Shna ïa kine ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia bad suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .
Mynno nga dang khynnah , ka jingkren jong nga , ki jingsngew , bad ki jingpyrkhat ki erlangthari baroh kum ki jong u khynnah ; mynnin ba nga la ïabah , nga iehnoh ïa ki rukom khñiang .
translation.en: When I was a child , I spake as a child , I understood as a child , I thought as a child : but when I became a man , I put away childish things .

translation.kha: Kumno me tip ba u Saul bad u Jonathan ki la ïap ? u Dabid u la kyllan ïa u .
translation.en: And David said unto the young man that told him , How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead ?

translation.kha: Khie leit dara ïathuh ha u ïaiban ba nga ai ha u lai tylli ki jingjied . Ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba u jied .
translation.en: Go and tell David , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , I offer thee three things : choose thee one of them , that I may do it unto thee .

translation.kha: Kita baroh’ kiba shong ha ka Dorbar ki la khmih’ slap ha u Stephan bad ki la ïohi ba ka khatduh jong u ka la long kum ka durkhmat jong u angel .
translation.en: And all that sat in the council , looking stedfastly on him , saw his face as it had been the face of an angel .
And they laid the ark of the  Lord  upon the cart , and the coffer with the mice of gold and the images of their emerods .
translation.kha: Ki buh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kata ka kali , lem bad ïa kata ka synduk ha kaba la thep ïa ki dur khnai bad ki dur u thung kiba da ka ksiar .

U Hananaïah , u khun jong u Shelemaïah bad u Hanun , u khun bahynñiew lad u Salaph , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , ka jingtrei kaba ar jong ki . U Meshullam , u khun jong u Berekhaïah u tei ïa ka bynta katba bud , kaba long ha khmat ka ïing jong u .
translation.en: After him repaired Hananiah the son of Shelemiah , and Hanun the sixth son of Zalaph , another piece . After him repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah over against his chamber .
And take with thee ten loaves , and cracknels , and a cruse of honey , and go to him : he shall tell thee what shall become of the child .
translation.kha: Rah sha u shiphew tylli ki kpu , khyndiat ki kpu stang , bad shi khiew ka um ngap . Kylli ïa u kaei ka ban jia ïa u khun jong ngi , bad un sa ïathuh ïa phi .
Ki nongsuhjaiñ jong ka ki la lute ïa ka jingkynshew jong ka baroh . Ka la ïohi ïa ki , ba ki thung sha ka Templ hi , ha kaban U Trai u la lah khang ïa ki Jentil ban longing .
translation.en: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground , and keep silence : they have cast up dust upon their heads  ; they have girded themselves with sackcloth : the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground .

translation.kha: Uta ïa uba U Blei u la phah , u krenbeiñ ïa ki ktien jong U Blei’ , namar ba U Blei u ai ha u ïa ka jingdap jong U Mynsiem jong u .
translation.en: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God : for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him .

translation.kha: Naba nga ïohi ba me dap da ka jingbynta ïabishar bad me long u kadei jong ka pop .
translation.en: For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness , and in the bond of iniquity .

translation.kha: Ki briew ba la jied jong na kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong phi kum ka jingtim . Ma at , U Trai nongsynshar ngan pynap ïa phi . Hynrei ngan ai ka kyrteng bathymmai ha kito kiba kthong ïa nga .
translation.en: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen : for the Lord  God  shall slay thee , and call his servants by another name :

If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law , and if thou turn unto the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul .
translation.kha: hynrei phi dei ban kohnguh ïa u bad sumar ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab jong ki jinghikai jong u . Phi dei ban phai sha u da ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong phi baroh .

translation.en: And now , little children , abide in him  ; that , when he shall appear , we may have confidence , and not be ashamed before him at his coming .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , ko ki khun jong nga , to ïaisah ha u , khnang ba ynda u wanpaw , ngin long kiba dap da ka jingshlur bad ngim donkam ban rieh ha ka jinglehrain na u ha ka Sngi kaba u wan .

translation.en: And Moses said unto him , As soon as I am gone out of the city , I will spread abroad my hands unto the  Lord   ; and the thunder shall cease , neither shall there be any more hail  ; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the  Lord s .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha u ,  Nga tang shu poi shabar kane ka shnong , ngan duwai ha U  Trai . U pyrthat un sangeh , bad u phria un ym hap shuh , ba phin ïoh tip ba ka pyrthei ka long ka jong U  Trai .
Lada u brai u klim bun ka tngit jong u para Israel , ma u bad katai ka kynthei kin Shah pynïap .
translation.en: And the man that committeth adultery with another man s wife , even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour s wife , the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death .

translation.kha: Nga la lah don hangta mynba u thaw ïa ka sahit bteng , mynhynnin u pynïeng ïa ka jylli halor ka duriaw ,
translation.en: When he prepared the heavens , I was there : when he set a compass upon the face of the depth :
And Jesus answering said unto them ,  They that are whole need not a physician  ; but they that are sick .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ki briew kiba khiah kim donkam ïa u nongpynkhiah , hynrei tang kito kiba pang .
Balei phim shym ïabam ïa kata ka jingkñia namar ka pop ha ka jaka kyntang ? Ka long kaba khuid bha , Bad U Trai u la ai ïa ka ha phi na ka pyntwa ban kit noh ïa ka pop jong u phlangïap .
translation.en: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place , seeing it is most holy , and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation , to make atonement for them before the  Lord  ?
And the angel of the  Lord  said unto him , Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times ? behold , I went out to withstand thee , because thy way is perverse before me :
translation.kha: U angel u la kylli ,  Balei me da sympat kumne ïa la ka kada ha kine lai sien ? Nga la wan ban khang lynti ïa me namar mem shym la dei ban leit sha kane ka jingleit .
U nongleitkurim u la slem ba wan , kumta ki theisotti ki la dang ban khlong samthiah .
translation.en: While the bridegroom tarried , they all slumbered and slept .
So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption , and this mortal shall have put on immortality , then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written , Death is swallowed up in victory .
translation.kha: Kumta haba kane ka jia , bad ïa kaba dei ban ïap la pynkylla sha ka bym dei ban ïap , te ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kan urlong shisha :  Ïa ka jingïap la pynjot thiaw ; ka jingjop ka la long kaba pura!

Haba u Barak u wan wad ïa u Shisha , ka Jael ka ñiah shabar ban ïakynton ïa u , bad ka ong ha u , Ale hangne ! Ngan pyndei ha phi ïa u briew uba phi wad . Kumta u la leit shapoh bad ka , bad hangta ha madan don u Sisera , ibha la ïap , bad u snar pynskhem Dara lyngba ka khlieh jong u .
translation.en: And , behold , as Barak pursued Sisera , Jael came out to meet him , and said unto him , Come , and I will shew thee the man whom thou seekest . And when he came into her tent , behold , Sisera lay dead , and the nail was in his temples .
Who have for my life laid down their own necks : unto whom not only I give thanks , but also all the churches of the Gentiles .
translation.kha: kiba la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga . Nga dap da ka jingsngewnguh ïa ki — ym tang ma nga , hynrei baroh ki balang Jentil kumjuh .

translation.en: For these are not drunken , as ye suppose , seeing it is but the third hour of the day .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew kim shym buaid , kumba phi tharai ; ka dang khyndai baje mynstep .

translation.en: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego  ; these men , O king , have not regarded thee : they serve not thy gods , nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up .
translation.kha: La don katto katne ngut ki Jiw ïa kiba phi la buh ban khmih ïa ka probins jong ka Babilon — u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego — ki bym shym kohnguh ïa ki hukum u Syiem Kynrad . Kim shym mane ïa u blei jong phi lane dem ngon sha ka durbriew kaba phi la phah pynïeng .

translation.en: And I will make thy windows of agates , and thy gates of carbuncles , and all thy borders of pleasant stones .
translation.kha: Ngan tei ïa ki kut jong pha da ki maw Rubi , ïa ki khyrdop jong pha da ki maw kiba rhem kum ka ding , bad ki kynroh sawdong jong pha da ki mawlynnai .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if ye diligently hearken unto me , saith the  Lord  , to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day , but hallow the sabbath day , to do no work therein  ;
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa kine ki briew ba ki dei ban kohnguh ïa baroh ki hukum jong nga . Kim dei ban kit kano kano ka jingkit shapoh lyngba ki khyrdop jong kane ka nongbah ha ka Sabbaton . Ki dei ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton kum ka sngi bakyntang bad kim dei ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam .

translation.en: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly , and gave the sense , and caused them to understand the reading .
translation.kha: Ki ai ka jingpynkylla da ka ktien bad ki batai ïa ka khnang ba u paidbah u lah ban sngewthuh ïa ka .

Haba U Jisu u la wan hiar na u lum blem dara ki apostol , u la ïeng ha ka iaka madiah lem bad kiba bun ki synran jong u . U paid byllien u la don hangtai na khyllung ka Judia bad na Jerusalem bad na ki nongbah Tyros bad Shion kiba harud Duriaw ;
translation.en: And he came down with them , and stood in the plain , and the company of his disciples , and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem , and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon , which came to hear him , and to be healed of their diseases  ;

translation.kha: Nga la kamar-tama ha uta u lum sawphew sngi pynlang seraph miet , kumba per la leh ha ka shen kaba nyngkong . U Trai u la shahshkor ïa sa sa shisien bad um mon pun pynjot ïa phi .
translation.en: And I stayed in the mount , according to the first time , forty days and forty nights  ; and the  Lord  hearkened unto me at that time also , and the  Lord  would not destroy thee .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Hato phi pyrkhat ba phi lah ban pyningkhong ïa Kiba shah khot sngewbiang sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim ban leit noh khlem bam kaba u nongleitkurim u dang to bad ki ? Da shisha em !
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Can ye make the children of the bridechamber fast , while the bridegroom is with them ?

translation.kha: Ngin la ïohsngew ïa ki rukom kren kob-pia jong me ba me la kren pyrshah ïa at .
translation.en: Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me , and have multiplied your words against me : I have heard them .
But I said unto their children in the wilderness , Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers , neither observe their judgments , nor defile yourselves with their idols :
translation.kha: Pynban , nga la maham ïa ki samla hapdeng jong ki : Wat sumar ïa ki aiñ kiba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki thaw ; wat bud ïa ki rukom jong ki lane pyntngit ïa lade da ki bleithaw jong ki .

translation.en: And their windows , and their arches , and their palm trees , were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east  ; and they went up unto it by seven steps  ; and the arches thereof were before them .
translation.kha: Ka kamra rung , ki jingkhangïit , bad ki dieng Tlai ba la oh-shrong , ki la long kum kito kiba ha ka khyrdop kaba sha mihngi . Hangne la don hynñiew tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha ka khyrdop , bad ka kamra rung ka la long ha kaba kut marpyrshah ka phyllaw .

translation.en: And I have also given thee that which thou hast not asked , both riches , and honour : so that there shall not be any among the kings like unto thee all thy days .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ruh ha me ïa kaei kaba mem shym la pan : baroh shi rta ka jingim jong me , men don ka spah bad ka burom , kham bun ban ïa kata ka jong uno uno uwei pat u syiem .

To sngew ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai , na ong ! Nga longkmie pyrshah ïa kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ïathuh ïa la ki jingphohsniew kiba dap da ki jinglamler . Ki ïathuh ïa kine ki jingphohsniew bad ïalam bakla ïa ki brisoh jong nga da ka jinglamler bad ka jingsngewmeng jong ki . Ngam shym la phah ne hukum ïa ki ban leit , bun kdor shym la Long satia ka jingïap ïa ki briew . Ma por , U TRAI’ , de la kruiñ .
translation.en: Behold , I am against them that prophesy false dreams , saith the  Lord  , and do tell them , and cause my people to err by their lies , and by their lightness  ; yet I sent them not , nor commanded them : therefore they shall not profit this people at all , saith the  Lord .
Moreover I said unto the king , If it please the king , let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river , that they may convey me over till I come into Judah  ;
translation.kha: Nangta nga kyrpad ïa u ban lehsbun ïa nga da kaba ai ha nga ïa ki shithi sha ki lat ka Probins    Ïuphratis Kaba Shaphang Sepngi , da kaba bthah ïa ki ban shah ïa nga ban ïaid lyngba sha Judah .

Phi de ban sah ha iitkhmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ miet la bad sngi haduh hynñiew sngi , shun leh ïa kata kaba U Trai u la hukum . Lada phim leh kumta , phin ïap . Kane ka long kaba U Tlai u la hukum ïa per .
translation.en: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days , and keep the charge of the  Lord  , that ye die not : for so I am commanded .

translation.kha: To pyndap ha man la ka jaka them ; to pynmadan ïa man la u lumlang , ki lumrit ki kylla madiah , bad ïa ki jaka khohruh khroh yn pynjlih .
translation.en: Every valley shall be exalted , and every mountain and hill shall be made low : and the crooked shall be made straight , and the rough places plain :

translation.kha: Bad u bhabriew u dei ban ieit ïa U blem da ka dohnud jong u barieh bad da ka jingmut jong u baïar bad da ka bor jong u baroh ; bad u dei ban ieit ïa la u paramarjan Rumah u Ieit ïa latai . Ka long kaba kham donburom ban kohnguh ïa kine ki ar tylli ki hukum ban ïa kaba ai jingsuh da ki mrad bad kiwei ki jingkñia sha U Blei .
translation.en: And to love him with all the heart , and with all the understanding , and with all the soul , and with all the strength , and to love his neighbour as himself , is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices .
Delight is not seemly for a fool  ; much less for a servant to have rule over princes .
translation.kha: Kiba bieit kim dei ban im ha ka pahuh pahai , bad ki mraw kim dei ban synshar halor ki briew badonburom .

Ma nga , U Trai nongbanbor Baroh , nga long u syiem . Ngi long U blem Ibbah im . Kumba u lum Tabor u ïeng kynjang tam ïa ki lum bad u lum Keramim u ïeng hajrong tam ïa ka duriaw , kumta kan long ka jingkheiñ jong uta uba tur ïaleh ïa me .
translation.en: As I live , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts , Surely as Tabor is among the mountains , and as Carmel by the sea , so shall he come .

translation.kha: Haba ka Mari ka la ïohsngew ïa kane , ka la ïeng piat malade ka la leit kyrkieh ban ïakynduh ïa u .
translation.en: As soon as she heard that , she arose quickly , and came unto him .

translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi na ka bynta ka jingbishar ba kan sdang , malade ki briew jongnga U Blei! hi kin long kiba nyngkong ban shah bishar . Lada ka sdang na ngi , kumno kan Kut ha kito ki bym shym ngeit ïa ka Khrawbor Babha na U Blei ?
translation.en: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God : and if it first begin at us , what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God ?

translation.kha: U Sillah Bad ki rangbah jongu u ki miat ban leit wad ïa u , hynrei u la ïohsngew shaphang kata bad u la leit sha u mawsiang lbong ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Maon bad u la sah hangta . Haba u Saul u tip ïa kane , u leit beh nadien u Dabid .
translation.en: Saul also and his men went to seek him . And they told David : wherefore he came down into a rock , and abode in the wilderness of Maon . And when Saul heard that , he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon .

translation.kha: Ngin hap ban shah ïa ki ba ken im namar ka jingkular jong im ; lada ngim leh Kumta , U Blei! un pynshitom ïa ngi .
translation.en: This we will do to them  ; we will even let them live , lest wrath be upon us , because of the oath which we sware unto them .
To be discreet , chaste , keepers at home , good , obedient to their own husbands , that the word of God be not blasphemed .
translation.kha: ban long kiba synshar ïa lade bad kiba sngur mynsiem , bad ki nongsumar ïing babha kiba pyndem ha la ki tnga , ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban kren sniew ïa ka khubor kaba wan na U Blei .

Hynrei ki briew kin ong ïa me ban kylli ïa ki khublei na ki nongbatai kupar bad ki nongkren byrngia kiba kren jam bad kiba kren me mynshem . Kin ong , Nalor baroh , ki bariew ki dei ban kylli ïa ki khubor na ki mynsiem malu kylli na kiba ïarap na ka bynta kiba im .
translation.en: And when they shall say unto you , Seek unto them that have familiar spirits , and unto wizards that peep , and that mutter : should not a people seek unto their God ? for the living to the dead ?

translation.kha: Haba u briew uba duk u kriah , u hap kparad donakor , hynrei haba u bhabriew uba riewspah’ u jubab , u kren khor .
translation.en: The poor useth entreaties  ; but the rich answereth roughly .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba u ïathuh ha ki ban ai ha u Isaiah ; Mynta ka long ka sngi Jong ka jingjynjar ; ngi la shah pynmih nabar ngi long ha ka jinglehrain . Ngi long Kum ka kynthei kaba la suh kha , hynrei kaba tlot Katta katta ba kam lah ban kha .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Thus saith Hezekiah , This day is a day of trouble , and of rebuke , and of blasphemy : for the children are come to the birth , and there is not strength to bring forth .
And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon , and the house that he had built ,
translation.kha: Ka syiem jong ka Sheba ka la ïohi ïa ka jingstad u Solomon , bad ka la ïohi ïa ka ïingsyiem ba u la tei .
Kaei Phi Lehab ?
translation.en: What did you do ?

The rest of all the acts of Asa , and all his might , and all that he did , and the cities which he built , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Asa u la leh , ki kam shlur jong u bad ki shnong kiba u la tei pynskhem , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah . Hynrei ha ka jinglong tymmen u la dkoh na ka jingpang kjat .

translation.en: For by thee I have run through a troop : by my God have I leaped over a wall .
translation.kha: Me ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong nga bad ka bor ba ngan jop ïa ki jingïada jong ki .

translation.en: And the  Lord  brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand , and with an outstretched arm , and with great terribleness , and with signs , and with wonders :
translation.kha: Da ka borbah bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong u , u la pyllait ïa ngi na Ijipt . U leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla , bad u la pynjia ïa kiei kiei kiba sngewtriem .
Pynbun , men leit shwa ki bhabriew u kjap jong nga , Bad sha ki kada ki jait jong por , bad jied ka tngen na ka bynta jong u .’
translation.en: But thou shalt go unto my father s house , and to my kindred , and take a wife unto my son .

translation.kha: U Beelsebul , u Oholiab , bad kiwei pat ki nongtrei ïa naba U Trai u la ai ka jingtbit bad ka jingshemphang , kiba tip ban Tertios ïa ka kam baroh kaba ïadei bad ka jingtrei ïa ka Ïingjaiñ kaba kyntang , ki dei ban shna ïa kaei kaei baïar kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab , and every wise hearted man , in whom the  Lord  put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary , according to all that the  Lord  had commanded .

translation.kha: Ko Moab , to kynmaw kumno pha rkhiebeiñ ïa ki paid Jeriel ? Pha la leh ïa ki kamra ki la ngat ha ka kynhun ki nonglute .
translation.en: For was not Israel a derision unto thee ? was he found among thieves ? for since thou spakest of him , thou skippedst for joy .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por u khun ba kham heh u la ne ha lyngkha . Ha ka lynti ba u wan phai , haba u la poi sha jan ka ïing , u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingput jingtem bad ka jingïashad .
translation.en: Now his elder son was in the field : and as he came and drew nigh to the house , he heard musick and dancing .
For who hath known the mind of the Lord , that he may instruct him ? But we have the mind of Christ .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Mano batip ïa ka jingmut U Trai ? Mano ba lah ban ai jingmut ïa u ?  Pynban , ma ngi , ngi don ïa ka jingmut U Khrist .

U Tiglath Pileser , haba jubab ïa ka jingkyrpad u Ahas , u tur sha khmat bad la ka kynhun shipai pyrshah ïa ka Damaskos , u kurup ïa ka , u pynïap ïa u syiem Resin , bad u ïalam koidi ïa ki briew sha kyr-ang .
translation.en: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him : for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus , and took it , and carried the people of it captive to Kir , and slew Rezin .

translation.kha: Me dei ban jubab , ‘ Ki dei ki jong u Jakob u Sikhri lad phi . U phah ïa ki kumno ka jingai sngewlah sha u kyndiah jong u , u Iso . U Jakob hi u hadien jyllang ngi .’
translation.en: Then thou shalt say , They be thy servant Jacob s  ; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau : and , behold , also he is behind us .

And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year , and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof : it shall be a jubilee unto you  ; and ye shall return every man unto his possession , and ye shall return every man unto his family .
translation.kha: Bad to pynkyntang khuid ïa ka snem kaba sanphew bad pynbna ïa ka jinglaitluid ha ki traishnong baroh jong kata ka ri . Ha kane ka snem , ïa ki jingdon jingem baroh ba la dep die dei ban pynphai pat sha u trai jong ka , lane sha ki khun ki ksiew jong u , bad uno uno u briew uba la shah die mraw un leit phai pat sha la ïing .

hynñiew ki briew ki la klet noh ïa U Trai U Blei jong ki , bad kumta u la shah ïa ki Philistia bad ïa u syep Moab bad ïa u Siba , u ïabah ka kynhun ba-shiphew ka nongbah Hasor , ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi sad ïa-ban jop ïa ki .
translation.en: And when they forgat the  Lord  their God , he sold them into the hand of Sisera , captain of the host of Hazor , and into the hand of the Philistines , and into the hand of the king of Moab , and they fought against them .

translation.kha: Nga la thied ïa ka lyngkha na u Hanamel bad nga thew ïa ka pisa na ka bynta jong u ; ka shongdor khathynñiew lyngkhot ki sbai shoh .
translation.en: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle s son , that was in Anathoth , and weighed him the money , even seventeen shekels of silver .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ka katto kli ha ka kiei kamon Jong uta uba shong halor ka khet ; kaba la dap da ka jingteh ha baroh arliang bad kaba la pyndait da ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndait .
translation.en: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside , sealed with seven seals .
When Jesus heard it , he marvelled , and said to them that followed ,  Verily I say unto you , I have not found so great faith , no , not in Israel .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la lyngngoh bad u la ong ha ki briew kiba bud ïa u ,  Nga ong ha phi , ngam pat ju shem ïano ïano ha Israel lem bad ka jingngeit kaba kum kane .

Ki ong , Sngap jar . Wat la shikyntien ruh . Ang bad ngi bad long u lyngdoh bad u nongaibuit jongu ngi . Hato phim kham lah ban long u lyngdoh ïa ka jaiñ Israel baher kawei ban tang ïa kawei ka longïing jong uwei u bhabriew ?
translation.en: And they said unto him , Hold thy peace , lay thine hand upon thy mouth , and go with us , and be to us a father and a priest : is it better for thee to be a priest unto the house of one man , or that thou be a priest unto a tribe and a family in Israel ?
And he charged them , saying , Thus shall ye do in the fear of the  Lord  , faithfully , and with a perfect heart .
translation.kha: U ai ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah :  Phi dei ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong phi ha ka jingsheptieng burom ïa U  Trai  , da kaba kohnguh hok ïa u ha kiei kiei ba phi leh .

translation.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel , u Abijah u la long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai snem ha Jerusalem .
Ym don kiba sngewtynnat ïa kiba tukri , wat ki paramarjan jong ki , hynmen kiba riewspah ki don shibun ki paralok .
translation.en: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour : but the rich hath many friends .

translation.kha: Kawei na ki ka ong , Syiem Kynrad , ma nga bad kane ka briew ngi ïasah ha kajuh ka ïing , malu nga la kha ïakhun shynrang hangta ha ïing ha kaba ka ruh ka don lang .
translation.en: And the one woman said , O my lord , I and this woman dwell in one house  ; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house .

translation.kha: U blem jong ki kpa Thummim jong ine u la pynmihpatlada ïa U Jisu na ka jingïap , hadien ba Phin la ha pynïap ïa u da kaba sahnar ïa u ha ka diengphna .
translation.en: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus , whom ye slew and hanged on a tree .

translation.kha: Kumta u Ishbosheth u pah shim noh ïa ka na u tnga jong ka , u Paltiel u khun jong u Laish .
translation.en: And Ish–bosheth sent , and took her from her husband , even from Phaltiel the son of Laish .

translation.kha: U Jingsuk u la krung bad u la ong ha u , Ko Simon , nga don ei ei ban ong ha me . Ko Nonghikai , u la ainong , to ïathuh ïa nga .
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Simon , I have somewhat to say unto thee .  And he saith , Master , say on .

translation.kha: pynbun na ka bynta ka jingpynjynjar barhem ba kane ka riewkhuid ka ai ha nga , ngan khmih ïa kata ba kan ïuh ïa ki hok jong ka . Lada ngam leh kumta , kan ïai wan bad khatduh kan pynlwait ïa nga !’
translation.en: Yet because this widow troubleth me , I will avenge her , lest by her continual coming she weary me .

translation.kha: Ki mradkhlaw ki leit sha la ki kem .
translation.en: Then the beasts go into dens , and remain in their places .

translation.kha: La don hangta u nongleh khajna uba ha khlieh duh suba kyrteng , u Sakhaïos , wahbah riewspah .
translation.en: And , behold , there was a man named Zacchaeus , which was the chief among the publicans , and he was rich .
And his mother said unto him , Upon me be thy curse , my son : only obey my voice , and go fetch me them .
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka jubab ,  To ai ba kano kano ka jingtim kan hap halor jong nga ; ko khun jong nga , shu leh kumba nga ong ; bad khie leit bad wanrah ïa ki blang sha nga .

Ka dei ha ka lyntang ha ka pa shiteng sngi , ko Syiem Kynther , ba de la ïuh ïa ka jingshai naba kham phyrnai ban ïa ka sner , kaba wan na sahit bneng bad kaba tyngshaiñ barben sawdong ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah kiba la ïaleit lang bad nga .
translation.en: At midday , O king , I saw in the way a light from heaven , above the brightness of the sun , shining round about me and them which journeyed with me .

translation.kha: Borabor nga la lehhok bad Lehab .
translation.en: I put on righteousness , and it clothed me : my judgment was as a robe and a diadem .
And Ben–hadad hearkened unto king Asa , and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel  ; and they smote Ijon , and Dan , and Abel–maim , and all the store cities of Naphtali .
translation.kha: U Benhadad u la mynjur ïa ka jingtyrwa u Asa bad u phah ïa ki nongïalam shipai bad ki kynhun shipai jong ki ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ka Israel . Ki jop ïa ka Ijon , Dan , Abel Beth Maakah , bad baroh ki nongbah ka Naphtali ha kiba la buh ïa ki mar ki mata .

translation.en: And thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; If ye will not hearken to me , to walk in my law , which I have set before you ,
