translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bthah ïa nga ban ong ha ki briew ,  Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la ong ba phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga da kaba bud ïa ka jinghikai kaba nga la ai ha phi ,
U Abishai , u khun jong ka Seruïah , u jop ïa ki Edom ha ka Them mluh bad pynïap khatphra hajir ngut na ki .
translation.en: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab la pynjot ; ha sngap ïa ki khynnah ba ki ïam .
translation.en: Moab is destroyed  ; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard .

translation.kha: Hato ngim don ka hok ban ni katba nga sngewbit ïa la ka jongnga ka pisa ? Ne phi ïa-bishni namar ba nga long uba sbun ?’
translation.en: Is it not lawful for me to do what I will with mine own ? Is thine eye evil , because I am good ?
Are all religions pleasing to God , or is just one ?
translation.kha: Hato baroh ki niam ki pynsngewbha ïa U Blei , ne tang kawei ?

translation.en: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it , the cattle also concerning the vapour .
translation.kha: U pyrthat u pynbna ïa ka jingwan ka  erïong bad ki jingri ki tip ba kan wan .
Ki kynhun shipai ki ïakynduh ha ri lum Ephraim . U syiem Abijah u kiew sha u lum Semaraim bad u pyut shaei u Jeroboam bad ki Israel : Shahshkor ïa nga ! u ong .
translation.en: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim , which is in mount Ephraim , and said , Hear me , thou Jeroboam , and all Israel  ;
Then said they all , Art thou then the Son of God ? And he said unto them ,  Ye say that I am .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ong ,  Hato ma me , te , me long U Khun U Blei ?  U la jubab ïa ki ,  Phi ong ba nga long .
U Jesse u phah ïa u Dabid sha u Suah lem bad u khunblang , u kada uba kit shikhung u kpu bad ka pla snieh dap da ka wan .
translation.en: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread , and a bottle of wine , and a kid , and sent them by David his son unto Saul .

translation.kha: Mar ïa ïohsngew ïa kane ka khubor , u syiem Hesekaïah u la thab ïa la ki daiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , u la phong ki jaiñ khain , pynlang u la lytar sha ka Tubal jong U Trai .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes , and covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khuid jong nga , Namarba Phi ithuh ïa U Kpa . Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki kpa , namar phi ithuh ïa u , uba la don narud kaba mynnyngkong . Nga thoh sha phi , ko ki khun jingkam , namar phi! long kiba khlaiñ ; ka ktien U Blei ka ïaisah ha phi , bad phi la jop noh thew ïa Uta u Basniew .
translation.en: I have written unto you , fathers , because ye have known him that is from the beginning . I have written unto you , young men , because ye are strong , and the word of God abideth in you , and ye have overcome the wicked one .

Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , ye fall down and worship the image which I have made  ; well : but if ye worship not , ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace  ; and who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands ?
translation.kha: Te mynta , tang mar shu ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong ki turoi , ki tangmuri , ki jingtem ksai , ki marynthing , ki duitara , bad baroh kiwei pat ki tiar put tiar tem , to dem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew . Lada phim leh kumta , yn bret kloi lan ïa phi ha ka lawar ding baklang . Hato phi pyrkhat ba don uno uno u blei uba lah ban pyllait im ïa phi ?
Ki ksuid ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban ym phiah ïa ki sha ka liewlong khlem trai .
translation.en: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep .

translation.kha: Hynrei , to kynshew spaiñ na ka bynta ïa lade ha bneng , ha kaba ki khñiang bad ka sarang kim lah ban pynjot , bad ki nongleh kim da ban prong bad tad .
translation.en: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven , where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt , and where thieves do not break through nor steal :

translation.kha: Ka lawbah jongngi nga ka long kane : To ïa-ieit wai ïa iwei pat , kumba nga ieit ïa phi .
translation.en: This is my commandment , That ye love one another , as I have loved you .

translation.kha: Ha ka jinglalot jongnga ki , kine ki nonghikai balamler kin kamon da kaba ïashoh ïa phiah ïa ki jingïathuhkhana ba shu sleit . La kham slem mynba U Nongbishar jongno ki u la long ibha la khlei , bad u Nongpynjot jong ki u la long u sem ju ïohphet !
translation.en: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you : whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not , and their damnation slumbereth not .
And they came to him , and awoke him , saying , Master , master , we perish . Then he arose , and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water : and they ceased , and there was a calm .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la leit sha U Jisu bad ki la kyrsiew ïa u , da kaba ong ,  Kynrad , Kynrad ! Ngi la jan ïap !  U Jisu u la khie joit bad u la hukum ïa ka lyer bad ïa ka um ba khie  erïong ; ki la sangeh bad ka la don ka jingjai jai kaba khraw .
da ka kti bakha jong u , ka ksang ti Badonbor jong u ; ka jingieit jong u ka kein bymmyntoi .
translation.en: With a strong hand , and with a stretched out arm : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Kumta u angel u la pyndonkam ïa la ka rashi ha ka pyrthei , u la ot ïa ki sohwaiñ na uta u dieng sohwaiñ , mala u la bret ïa ki sha ka jaka khñiot wieh jong ka jingbitar shla jong U Blei’ .
translation.en: And the angel thrust in his sickle into the earth , and gathered the vine of the earth , and cast it into the great winepress of the wrath of God .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Jehoïada , u khunlung jong u Josaïah , u long u syiem ka Judah , U Tiras u la ong ha nga ,
translation.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , that this word came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
And the sons of Kohath  ; Amram , and Izhar , and Hebron , and Uzziel : and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years .
translation.kha: U Kohath u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel . U Kohath u la im haduh shispah laiphew lai snem ka rta .

Phi la bet shibun u kew , hynrei phi la ot tang Khyndiat . Phi don ka bam ban bam , ishyrkhei kada biang kat ban pynkdang ïa phi . phi don ka aiñ ban dih , hynrei mana biang kat ba pynbuaid ïa phi ! Phi don ki jaiñkup , hynrei kam biang kat ba-bang pynsyaid ïa phi . Gaal u nongtrei um haw ban kamai kato ban wiang ba-bang im .
translation.en: Ye have sown much , and bring in little  ; ye eat , but ye have not enough  ; ye drink , but ye are not filled with drink  ; ye clothe you , but there is none warm  ; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes .

translation.kha: Kaba bam than ïa ka ngap kdew ibha ïa phi ; bad katkum ruh ka long kaba pyrshah ban ïoh palat ka jingkhroh .
translation.en: It is not good to eat much honey : so for men to search their own glory is not glory .

translation.kha: U Barnabas u la khoh ban ïalam ïa u Ïoannis Markos lema bad ki ,
translation.en: And Barnabas determined to take with them John , whose surname was Mark .

translation.kha: U Lebi sad ki khun shynrong jong u : u Karshena , u khiat , bad u Merari .
translation.en: And the sons of Levi  ; Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .
And there were a thousand men of Benjamin with him , and Ziba the servant of the house of Saul , and his fifteen sons and his twenty servants with him  ; and they went over Jordan before the king .
translation.kha: U la don bad u shihajar ngut ki rangbah na ka jait Benjamin . Bad u Siba ruh , u shakri jong ka longïing jong u Saul , u la wan lem bad ki khatsan ngut ki khun shynrang jong u bad arphew ngut ki shakri , bad ki la wan poi ha Jordan ha shuwa jong u syiem .
Ha kawei ka sneng , U Jisu u la kiwei khashor ka lieng lem bad ki synreit jong u Bad u la ong ha ki , Ïa ngin leit sha shiliang sha kawei pat ka liang jyllang ka duriaw . Kumta ki la ïaleit .
translation.en: Now it came to pass on a certain day , that he went into a ship with his disciples : and he said unto them ,  Let us go over unto the other side of the lake .  And they launched forth .
There is no healing of thy bruise  ; thy wound is grievous : all that hear the bruit of thee shall clap the hands over thee : for upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually ?
translation.kha: Ym don jingpynkoit ei ei ïa ki jingmynsaw jong me , bad ïa ki jingmong jong me ym lah ban pynkoit . Baroh kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang ka jingpynjot ïa me ki thap ïa la ki kti ha ka jingkmen . Hato uno uno un lait phet na ka jinglong runar bymkut jong me ?
Kane ka den kaei ba ngin leh : ngim ïakynting sbai sad ngin jied katno katne ngut ki rangbah ban leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Geba .
translation.en: But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah  ; we will go up by lot against it  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei ma ph , u khun jong u , phim shym la pynrit ïa lade , wat la pa la tip ïa kane baroh .
translation.en: And thou his son , O Belshazzar , hast not humbled thine heart , though thou knewest all this  ;

translation.kha: Te u Samson u Duwai , A Trai Bakhraw , to kynmaw ïa nga , ai ha nga ïa ka bor sa tang shisien , khnang ba dang da kane sam lah ban pynhiarkput ïa ki Philistia namar ba ki la khlaw ïa ki khmat jongki nga baroh ar .
translation.en: And Samson called unto the  Lord  , and said , O Lord  God  , remember me , I pray thee , and strengthen me , I pray thee , only this once , O God , that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes .

translation.kha: Don suba la ïathuh ha ka tamasa ba u kthaw kurim jong ka u la leit sha Timnah ban khap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot .
translation.en: And it was told Tamar , saying , Behold thy father in law goeth up to Timnah to shear his sheep .

translation.kha: Ki briew babha bha kin don ka spah ban ïoh pateng ha ki ksiew jongnga ki , hynrei ka spah jong ki nongpop kan leit shad kiba hok .
translation.en: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children s children : and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just .

translation.kha: man sa ïap halor uta u lum kumba u Aaron u hynmen jong me u la ïaw ha u Lum Hor ,
translation.en: And die in the mount whither thou goest up , and be gathered unto thy people  ; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor , and was gathered unto his people :

translation.kha: Tang leh aiu ?
translation.en: What are you doing ?

translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa U Trai , mala phin im kham slem . Ki bymman ki ïarap shuwa ka por jong ki .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  prolongeth days : but the years of the wicked shall be shortened .

translation.kha: Nga tip ki jingmut marpyrshah aïom phi ba-don .
translation.en: Behold , I know your thoughts , and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me .
They fought from heaven  ; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera .
translation.kha: Ki khlur ki ïaleh na sahit bneng ; Katba ki dang ïaid sha shiliang ka sahit bneng , Ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u Sisera .
bad na Hamath sha ka them ha ka ri Moab , harum ka kliar u Lum Pisgah na uba lah ban ïohi ïa kata ka ri shispah .
translation.en: And from Bamoth in the valley , that is in the country of Moab , to the top of Pisgah , which looketh toward Jeshimon .

translation.kha: Hynriew mynta ngan lumlang ïa ki badno pynshitom ïa ki . Shen shen ktien sa kyrteng ha ka jingpang , haba u patsha ka Assyria u banbeiñ ïa ki .
translation.en: Yea , though they have hired among the nations , now will I gather them , and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes .

translation.kha: U Ahas u shim ïa ki rupa bad ksiar na ka Templ bad na ka ïing jingpynkynmaw ha ïingsyiem bad u phah kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa u nongshoh-nar .
translation.en: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the  Lord  , and in the treasures of the king s house , and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria .

translation.kha: Nga la jied ïa me ha shuwa ba nga ai jingim ïa me , bad ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa me , nga la jied ïa me ban long u nongïathuhlypa shiah ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee  ; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee , and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations .

Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people  ; for the cause was from the  Lord  , that he might perform his saying , which the  Lord  spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat .
translation.kha: Ka long ka mon jong U  Trai  ban pynjia ïa kaei kaba U la kren ha u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat lyngba u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa na Shiloh . Dei namar kane balei ba u syiem um shym shahshkor ïa ki paidbah .
Ki shipai apil ki la tur nyngkong . Ki nongpynïaid ba la phar da u Benhadad , ki leit ïathuh ha u ba shi kynïan ki shipai ki la wan mih na Samaria .
translation.en: And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first  ; and Ben–hadad sent out , and they told him , saying , There are men come out of Samaria .
And when he had begun to reckon , one was brought unto him , which owed him ten thousand talents .
translation.kha: U la dang shu sdang ban leh kumta haba la wallam ïa uwei uba la kit ram bun tyngka .
U TRAI’ u la Jobab ïa ka , Martha , Martl ! Pha la shlei bad pha la sngew jynjar halor bhor kiei kiei ,
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto her ,  Martha , Martha , thou art careful and troubled about many things :

translation.kha: Ka sngi kan wan hajan U Tiras Badonbor Baroh un longïing kum ka pansngiat badonburom jong ki syntiew na ka bynta ki brai jyllang u kiba dang sah .
translation.en: In that day shall the  Lord  of hosts be for a crown of glory , and for a diadem of beauty , unto the residue of his people ,

translation.kha: Kum ka nuksa , haba ar ngut ki briew ki leit thoh dieng lang shuh khlaw pynlang , Kaba uwei na ki u dang khot ïa uwei u Dieng , u sdie u lait na u sping bad u ithuh dei ha uta uwei pat , bad kumto u ïap , u lah ban phet shaw khawai na kita ki lai tylli ki shnong , bad un leit rieh bad ïohlait im hangta .
translation.en: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood , and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree , and the head slippeth from the helve , and lighteth upon his neighbour , that he die  ; he shall flee unto one of those cities , and live :
And there was war again with the Philistines  ; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite , whose spear staff was like a weaver s beam .
translation.kha: Ka don sa kawei ka thma bad ki Philistia , bad u Jair u khun jong u Elhanan u pynïap ïa u Lahmi , uba shi para bad u Goliath na Gath , uba u sum jong u , u don u dieng thung sum uba ka jingrben jong u ka long kat u khung jong u nongthain jaiñ .
hynne ki riewbymman ki Long kamon ka duriaw kaba khih phaloh , Kiba ki jingtah phyllung jong ka kim ju sangeh , ki wanrah ïa ka jakhlia bad ka kyiuh .
translation.en: But the wicked are like the troubled sea , when it cannot rest , whose waters cast up mire and dirt .

translation.kha: Ki shiphew ngut ki isaitmet ki la khie joit bad ki la pynkhreh ïa la ki sharak .
translation.en: Then all those virgins arose , and trimmed their lamps .

translation.kha: Bad ka jingïathuh shaphang U Jisu ka la pyrshang kylleng ha dat ka thain .
translation.en: And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about .
And when the messengers of John were departed , he began to speak unto the people concerning John ,  What went ye out into the wilderness for to see ? A reed shaken with the wind ?
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki nonglamktien jong u Ïoannis ki la leit noh , U Jisu u la sdang ban kren shaphang jong u ha u paidbah :  Haba phi la leit sha u Ïoannis ha ka ri shyiap , aïu phi la khmih lynti ban ïohi ? Hato ïa ka sla phlang kaba khun ha ka lyer ?

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses  hand , when he came down from the mount , that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him .
translation.kha: Mynba u Moses u wan hiar na u Lum Sinai , u da rah ïa kita ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ki Shiphew Hukum , ka khmat jong u ka tyngshaiñ namar ba u la ïakren bad U  Trai  ; hynrei um tip satia ïa kata .

Hadien katai U Jisu u leit ba-im ha ka ïohnong u Lebi . Don bun ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei babha la shah kyntait na ka imlang ka shaphang kiba ïabud ïa U Jisu , nabar bun na ki , ki la ïadoh bynta nabar u lem bad ki synran jong u ha ka miej bam .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as Jesus sat at meat in his house , many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples : for there were many , and they followed him .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalamwir ïa nga sha ka khyrdop kaba kham shabar ha ka bynta bashaphang mihngi lad ka Templ .
translation.en: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east  ; and it was shut .

translation.kha: Kuth U Trai u la phah ïa ka jingpang ha kita ki briew , namsop ba ki la pynlong ïa u Aaron don thaw ïa u khun masi ksiar .
translation.en: And the  Lord  plagued the people , because they made the calf , which Aaron made .
But the people held their peace , and answered him not a word : for the king s commandment was , saying , Answer him not .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki sngap jar , kumba u syiem Hesekaïah u la ong ïa ki ban leh kumta ; kim shym kren shikyntien ruh .
Ki jingkhublei ruh ïa u stad , uba ïatrei Lem bad ngi ha ka kam U Khrist , bad ïa u Malkhos , u paralok ba-ieit jong nga .
translation.en: Salute Urbane , our helper in Christ , and Stachys my beloved .

translation.kha: Ka la jia ryngkhat ba u lyngdoh u la ithuh hajar na kata ka lynti ; ishyrkhei haba u la ïohi ïa uta u briew , u la ïaid lait na kawei ka liang .
translation.en: And by chance there came down a certain priest that way : and when he saw him , he passed by on the other side .

translation.kha: U pynïap lut ïa ki lyngdoh nongmane blei thala hajar ki duwan ba ki shakri , bad u thang ïa ki shyieng briew ha kawei pa katai ka duwan . Nangta u sien phai pat shwa Jerusalem .
translation.en: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars , and burned men s bones upon them , and returned to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Nga nongkit ïa U Blei , ïa umbah nga shakri da ka jingïatiplem bakhuid , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong nga ki la leh . Nga ainguh ïa u haba ang kynmaw ïa me kotbor ha ki jingduwai jong per mynmiet bad mynsngi .
translation.en: I thank God , whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience , that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day ;

translation.kha: Babha u brai u khluit tyngkan , bad lada ka sniehdoh ka kylli lieh ne lam byrsaw-lieh , u lyngkdong un peit bniah ïa u .
translation.en: Or if there be any flesh , in the skin whereof there is a hot burning , and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot , somewhat reddish , or white  ;
Look not every man on his own things , but every man also on the things of others .
translation.kha: Bad to khmih ïa ki jingdonkam jong iwei ïa iwei pat , ym tang ïa la ka jong .
Ko Pa , to pyndonburom ïa la ka kyrteng ! Te ka sur ka la kren na bteng , Ngin la wallam ka burom ïa ka , dara ngan bor wiang kumta .
translation.en: Father , glorify thy name .  Then came there a voice from heaven , saying , I have both glorified it , and will glorify it again .

translation.kha: Baroh kaba ki don ka longïng katno katne ki jingïania shaneng ka niam jong ki bad shaphang u briew uba kyrtong U jongu , uba la ïap ; hynrei u Paul u kam ba u dang im .
translation.en: But had certain questions against him of their own superstition , and of one Jesus , which was dead , whom Paul affirmed to be alive .
The  Lord  shall establish thee an holy people unto himself , as he hath sworn unto thee , if thou shalt keep the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , and walk in his ways .
translation.kha: Lada phi kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad leh kat ïa kaba u hukum , un pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong u hi , kumba u la kular .
Wat ingiew ïa ka jingsdang , bad kun ïawad ïa Phin ; ieit ïa ka , te kan sumar bha ïa phi .
translation.en: Forsake her not , and she shall preserve thee : love her , and she shall keep thee .

translation.kha: Kishion la don ka jingsawa na sahit bneng kaba sawa kum ka jingbeh ka lyer bajur , bad ka la pyndap ïa ka ïing baroh kawei ha kaba ki la ïashong .
translation.en: And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind , and it filled all the house where they were sitting .

translation.kha: Ha ka jaka ban lumlang badno ban tep , ki shyieng jong ki kin long kum ka sboh kaba to ha madan . Yn pynphriang ïa ki shab ha khmat ka sneng , u bnai , bad ki khlei , kiba kine ki briew ki olib bad shakri , bad kiba ki la ïakhalai bad mane .
translation.en: And they shall spread them before the sun , and the moon , and all the host of heaven , whom they have loved , and whom they have served , and after whom they have walked , and whom they have sought , and whom they have worshipped : they shall not be gathered , nor be buried  ; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth .

translation.kha: Balei , te , ba phi khmih ïa u thiat ha ka khmat u par jong pa’ , malade phi khlem pynleit jingmad ïa ka lyngngoh dieng hapoh ka khmat jong phi hi ?
translation.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother s eye , but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?

translation.kha: uba la dap shi bnai lane kham heh ; baroh ki Long arphew ar hajar arsien hynñiewphew kad ngut .
translation.en: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon , of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation , whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the  Lord .

And say , Ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord  God   ; Thus saith the Lord  God  to the mountains , and to the hills , to the rivers , and to the valleys  ; Behold , I , even I , will bring a sword upon you , and I will destroy your high places .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki lum ka Israel ban sngap ïa ka ktien jong U  Trai  — ban sngap ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki lumbah , ki lumrit , ki khap maw bad ki them : Ngan phah ïa ka waitlam ban pynjot ïa ki jaka ha kiba ki briew ki mane bleithaw .

Katba ki dang don kham sha jingjai ki la ïohi ïa u Tob , hynrei kim shym ithuh ba dei ma u . Haba ki la iathuh , ki la sdang ban ïam bad lynñiar kthang , ki kad ïa la ki jaiñphong ha ka jingsngewsih bad ki kynting pien pui sha suiñ bad ha la ki khlieh .
translation.en: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off , and knew him not , they lifted up their voice , and wept  ; and they rent every one his mantle , and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven .

He that is far off shall die of the pestilence  ; and he that is near shall fall by the sword  ; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine : thus will I accomplish my fury upon them .
translation.kha: Kito kiba sha jngai bah kin ïohpang bad ïap noh ; kito kiba hajan kin ïap ha ka thma ; kito kiba lait im kin ïapthngan . Kin sngew ïa ka jingbitar jong nga kaba nga la pynmih lut .
Ka tyllai jong ka jingim ba riew Blei kaba don ha ka Baibl ka pyni ïa ngi kumno ban im ba-bang sah ha ka rukom ka ïa-ban wanrah ka jingbymngeit shimet .
translation.en: The godly principles in the Bible show us how to live in a way that brings physical benefits .

translation.kha: Ka buh ïa said ka jingbam ha khmat u Saul bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ki ïamih . Nangta ki ïeng bad leit noh ha —kata hi ka miet .
translation.en: And she brought it before Saul , and before his servants  ; and they did eat . Then they rose up , and went away that night .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngim shym leit sha jan ka ri ki Ammon lane sha ki jaka harud ka Wah Joab lane sha ki shnong ha ri lum lane sha kano katno ka jaka sha kaba U Trai U blem jongki ngi u la nadong ïa ngi .
translation.en: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not , nor unto any place of the river Jabbok , nor unto the cities in the mountains , nor unto whatsoever the  Lord  our God forbad us .
Then said the princes unto Baruch , Go , hide thee , thou and Jeremiah  ; and let no man know where ye be .
translation.kha: Te ki la ong ha u ,  Ma me bad u Jeremaïah phi dei ban leit noh bad ban rieh . Wat ai ïano ïano ban tip hangno phi ïadon .

translation.en: He had gone .
translation.kha: U la Leit Ma u .
U la buh ïa u ban pynïadait ïa ka sorkar Jong u bad pynlong ïa u , u nongsynshar khlur ka ri baroh Kawei ,
translation.en: He made him lord of his house , and ruler of all his substance :

translation.en: And they answered , We will willingly give them . And they spread a garment , and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey .

translation.en: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb  ; and if thou wilt not redeem it , then thou shalt break his neck : and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem .

translation.kha: Kainan ki long nia ki ai shaphang ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh ;

And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses , that they be not unfruitful .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ngi ki dei ban nang ban pynlut ïa la ka por ha kaba leh babha , khnang ba ki lah ban pyndap ïa ki jingdonkam bashisha ; kim dei ban im ka jingim ka bymlarkam .
Khynñiuh ka khubor shaphang U Jisu ka la kham phyrnai kylleng , nabar ki paid byllien ki la wan ban sngap ïa u bad ban ïoh jingpynkhiah na ki jingpangnud jong ki .
translation.en: But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him : and great multitudes came together to hear , and to be healed by him of their infirmities .
And he left them , and went away again , and prayed the third time , saying the same words .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa ki , u la leit noh , bad u la duwai ha ka sien kaba lai , da kaba ong ïa kijuh ki kyntien .
Da ki hajar hajar ki don ha ka Them jong ka Jingbishar . Dei hangto ba ka Sngap jong U TRAI’ shane kan wan .
translation.en: Multitudes , multitudes in the valley of decision : for the day of the  Lord  is near in the valley of decision .

translation.kha: Nalorkata u Joseph u sah” ngab kylliang jingibieit ïa ka met u kpa jongno u . Ki nongkyllan jingiwbih ruh ki leh kumne .
translation.en: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father : and the physicians embalmed Israel .

translation.kha: Kum ka shaïong nga la sor noh ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha ki ri nongwei . Ïa kane ka ri babha la iohnong kynjah ïa ka , khlem don mano mian basarong ba sah hangtei .
translation.en: But I scattered them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they knew not . Thus the land was desolate after them , that no man passed through nor returned : for they laid the pleasant land desolate .

translation.kha: haba nga ong katno ka jingsngewthuh jong de , katno ka jingpang ba khlem kut jong ka dohnud jong nga na ka bynta ki briew jong nga , kiba long ka doh ka snam jong nga!
translation.en: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart .
When he prepared the heavens , I was there : when he set a compass upon the face of the depth :

translation.en: So Omri slept with his fathers , and was buried in Samaria : and Ahab his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Omri u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Samaria , bad u Ahab u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus , and bound him ,
translation.kha: Nangta ki shipai Rom lem bad u rangbah shipai jong ki bad ki nongap phira jong ki Jiw , ki la kem ïa U Jisu , ki la khum ïa u ,

translation.en: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead , and strengthened himself against Israel .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u long syiem hadien u Asa u kpa jong u , bad u la pynkhlaiñ ïa lade pyrshah ïa ka Israel .
Me longsyiem kum u dieng Kedar ka Libnah , lem malu ki thet Ibbah itynnat dara ba kah syrngiew , u dieng uba jrong mawria katta uba kot haduh ki lyoh .
translation.en: Behold , the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches , and with a shadowing shroud , and of an high stature  ; and his top was among the thick boughs .

translation.kha: bad sa uwei u musli bad uwei u langbrot ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh ïasyllok . Dei ban kñia ïa ki ha U Trai ryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam ba la khleh bad ka umphniang . Ki dei ban sa ïa kane namar U Trai un wanpaw ha ki mynta ka sngi .
translation.en: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings , to sacrifice before the  Lord   ; and a meat offering mingled with oil : for to day the  Lord  will appear unto you .

translation.kha: Ki lyer ki beh kyrthep na ki liang baroh’ malu ki shohbeiñ ïa ka sla ka duriaw-bah .
translation.en: Daniel spake and said , I saw in my vision by night , and , behold , the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea .

When thou art departed from me to day , then thou shalt find two men by Rachel s sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah  ; and they will say unto thee , The asses which thou wentest to seek are found : and , lo , thy father hath left the care of the asses , and sorroweth for you , saying , What shall I do for my son ?
translation.kha: ynda me mih nangne mynta ka sngi , men ïakynduh ar ngut ki rangbah hajan ka jingtep jong ka Rakhel ha Selsah kaba ha ka ri Benjamin . Kin ïathuh ha me ba la lap ïa kita ki kada kiba me leit wad , bad i pa jong me im shym khuslai shuh shaphang jong ki , hynrei i khuslai shaphang jong me , i da ïai kylli , ‘ Ngan leh kumno keiñ shaphang la u khun ?’
Nongthaw u pynkdang ki ïingjaiñ shipai ha ka ri jong ki , bad ki kylla long ki raïot jong u bun ki siew khajna sha u . U Trai u ai jingap ïa u dab ha ïakylliang .
translation.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria–damascus  ; and the Syrians became David s servants , and brought gifts . Thus the  Lord  preserved David whithersoever he went .
How shall we sing the  Lord s  song in a strange land ?
translation.kha: Kumno keiñ ngi lah ban rwai ïa ka jingrwai ha U  Trai ha ka ri nongwei ?

U don ruh ka kynha shipawa kaba heh kaba la kloi na ka bynta ka thma . Ïa ki jingpuh jingthoh jong ka la sumar da u Jael u bad u Maaseïah , ki kapten jong u hapoh ka jingpeit u Hananaïah , u dkhot jyllang ki nongleit jong u syiem .
translation.en: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men , that went out to war by bands , according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler , under the hand of Hananiah , one of the king s captains .

translation.kha: Hangta u Joshua u khot ïa ki rangbah ka Israel baroh bad u hukum ïa ki rangbah shipai kiba la leit ryngkat bad u Ban ïan bad buh ïa la ki kjat ha ki ryndang jongnga ki syiem . Ki la sa kumta .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when they brought out those kings unto Joshua , that Joshua called for all the men of Israel , and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him , Come near , put your feet upon the necks of these kings . And they came near , and put their feet upon the necks of them .

translation.kha: To risa da ka jingkyrmen , pa’ ki bneng ! To rashi , ko ki iaka bajylliew jongki ka pyrthei ! To Risia da ka jingkyrmen , ko ki lumbah , bad man la u dieng jong ka khlaw ! U Trai u la pyn-i ïa ka jingkhraw jong u da kaba u pynim ïa ki briew jongno u ki Israel .
translation.en: Sing , O ye heavens  ; for the  Lord  hath done it : shout , ye lower parts of the earth : break forth into singing , ye mountains , O forest , and every tree therein : for the  Lord  hath redeemed Jacob , and glorified himself in Israel .

translation.kha: Nangta ai ba ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baalah kin duwai ha u bieit jongno ki , bad ma nga ngan duwai ha U TRAI’ , bad uta uba jubab da kabu phah ïa ka ding — uta u dei U Blei . U paidbah u la pyrta Bad ai ïa ka jingmynjur .
translation.en: And call ye on the name of your gods , and I will call on the name of the  Lord  : and the God that answereth by fire , let him be God . And all the people answered and said , It is well spoken .
But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree  ; and none shall make them afraid : for the mouth of the  Lord  of hosts hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un shongsuk hapdeng ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Dumbur la ki jong hi , bad yn ym don mano mano ban pynsheptieng ïa u . U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kular ïa kane .
Kito kiba thmu sniew kin ei ha ka jingkyndit thret , hynrei kito babha trei na ka bynta kaba bha ktang shem ïa ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil : but to the counsellors of peace is joy .

translation.kha: To duwai ha U Blei ba phin ym hap ban phet noh ha ka prie tlang lane ha ka sngi Sabbaton !
translation.en: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter , neither on the sabbath day :

translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka miet ba U Trai u ap miet ban ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Ïa kane kajuh ka miet la pynkyntang sha U Trai pateng la pateng kum ka miet ha kaba ki Eliel ki dien ban ap miet .
translation.en: It is a night to be much observed unto the  Lord  for bringing them out from the land of Egypt : this is that night of the  Lord  to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations .

translation.kha: Bad haba ïa kiei kiei baroh la Wanlam sha ka jingshai , te ïa ka jinglong bashisha jong ki la pynpaw shynna ; babha katei kaei kaba la pynpaw shynna ka kylla long ka jingshai .
translation.en: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light : for whatsoever doth make manifest is light .
And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat , and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the  Lord  : it is a sin offering .
translation.kha: Un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong u bad un pynïap ïa u ha ka phang kaba shatei jong ka duwan , ha ka jaka ba ki ju pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia ainguh thang . Kane ka long ka jingkñia ainguh ban map noh ïa ka pop .
Katto katne na u symbai ki la hap hapdeng ki banep shiah , kiba la san ryngkat bad ki jingthung bad ki la ïap ïa ki .
translation.en: And some fell among thorns  ; and the thorns sprang up with it , and choked it .

translation.kha: Phi ruh phi dei ban long kiba ïaishah . To batskhem ïa ki jingkyrmen jong phi , naba ka sngi ka jingnang U Trai ka la jan .
translation.en: Be ye also patient  ; stablish your hearts : for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh .

translation.kha: Khenani u tymmen u mih shabar bad u nong ha ki , Em , ko parad jong nga ! sngewbha ! Wat sa kaba kum kata ka kam bymman , ka kam bakhlemrain ! Une u bri u long Uba nga la khot sngewbha .
translation.en: And the man , the master of the house , went out unto them , and said unto them , Nay , my brethren , nay , I pray you , do not so wickedly  ; seeing that this man is come into mine house , do not this folly .

translation.kha: To shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki sharak !
translation.en: He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .

translation.kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad u Eleasar u khun jong u sha kliar u Lum Hor ,
translation.en: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son , and bring them up unto mount Hor :

translation.kha: Lydia ka long ka ma U Trai , nga kyrmen ba nga ha ban phah shen sha phi ïa u Timothi , khnang ba nga la ban ïoh ka jingpynshlur da ka khubor shaphang jong Phin .
translation.en: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy shortly unto you , that I also may be of good comfort , when I know your state .

translation.kha: Mano mano , samla ne tymmen , shynrang ne kynthei , ki bym ma ïa U , la pynjop .
translation.en: That whosoever would not seek the  Lord  God of Israel should be put to death , whether small or great , whether man or woman .

translation.kha: U nonglamktien uba lah ban shaniah u ai jinghun myn ïa uta uba Pha ïa u , kum ka umkhriat ha ka jingshit tyrha ha ka aïom ot .
translation.en: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest , so is a faithful messenger to them that send him : for he refresheth the soul of his masters .

translation.kha: U la thew ïa khnai ka kamra Bad u la lap ba ka jylliew saw mitar shapoh . Ka pynlong ka tduh jong ka lynti thring kaba jan kuna sha ka Templ bad sha babud jong ka , ki kynroh ki rben shi mirr .
translation.en: Then measured he the porch of the gate , eight cubits  ; and the posts thereof , two cubits  ; and the porch of the gate was inward .

translation.kha: Bun kiei pat kiba U Blei u la bitar haduh sawphew snem ? bad ine ki briew kiba la leh pop , kiba la kyllon ïap ha ka ri shyngkub .
translation.en: But with whom was he grieved forty years ? was it not with them that had sinned , whose carcases fell in the wilderness ?

translation.kha: Nangta U Terah u phah ïa ka ding kiba meh , bad ka bam duh khoit ïa moi ki arspah sanphew ngut ki briew kiba la wandur ïa ki jingiwbih .
translation.en: And there came out a fire from the  Lord  , and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense .

And they said , Cornelius the centurion , a just man , and one that feareth God , and of good report among all the nation of the Jews , was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house , and to hear words of thee .
translation.kha: U Kornelios , u rangbah shipai u la phah ïa ngi ,  ki la jubab .  U long u briew uba bha uba mane ïa U Blei bad uba la ñiewburom shikatdei da ki Jiw baroh . U angel jong U Blei u la ïathuh ïa u ban khot sngewbha ïa phi sha ka ïing jong u , khnang ba u lah ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba phi don ban ong .

translation.en: And let it be , when thou hearest the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees , that then thou shalt bestir thyself : for then shall the  Lord  go out before thee , to smite the host of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Haba me ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïaid halor ki kliar dieng , te tur ïaleh ïa ki namar ngan ïaid ha shuwa jong me ban jop ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ki Philistia .

translation.en: The king of Jarmuth , one  ; the king of Lachish , one  ;

translation.en: But let it be the hidden man of the heart , in that which is not corruptible , even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit , which is in the sight of God of great price .
translation.kha: Pynban , ka jingbhabriew jong phi ka shong ha ka jinglong bashisha hapoh jong phi , ka jingbhabriew bym sti noh jong ka mynsiem ba long jai jai bad bajar jar , kaba long kaba khraw tam ha khmat U Blei .

Ka Etham ka ba-don hangta , lem bad ki jingap ki shipawa jong ka ha baroh sawdong . Ki hir baroh kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , bad ki la sien hiar , khlem otsher sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Ha ka jingim ki pynphriang ïa ka jingpynshitom , hynrei mynta ki thiah ïap bad jahburom .
translation.en: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave , all of them slain , fallen by the sword , which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth , which caused their terror in the land of the living  ; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit .
For this gird you with sackcloth , lament and howl : for the fierce anger of the  Lord  is not turned back from us .
translation.kha: Kumta to kup ka jaiñ khain , bad to ïam bad ud sngewsih namar ka jingbitar shla jong U  Trai kam shym la phai noh na ka Judah .
U shna ruh ïa ka mei da ka dieng akasia , kabu phraphew phra sentimitar ka lynter , sawphew saw sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .
translation.en: And he made the table of shittim wood : two cubits was the length thereof , and a cubit the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof :

translation.kha: Kan long kumba u briew uba mih na ïing ban leit jingleit , mala u ieh ha ki shakuriaw ban khmih ïa ka kam , hadien ba u ai ha ti pa uwei ïa ka kam jong u don leh , bad hadien ba u ong ïa u nongap khyrdop ban peit bha .
translation.en: For the Son of man is as a man taking a far journey , who left his house , and gave authority to his servants , and to every man his work , and commanded the porter to watch .

translation.kha: Ngan iehnoh ïa ki briew kiba laitim im bad aiti ïa ki ha ki nongshun jongki ki , ki ban jop ïa ki bad lute ïa ka ri jong ki .
translation.en: And I will forsake the remnant of mine inheritance , and deliver them into the hand of their enemies  ; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies  ;

translation.kha: ïa u Turkwois , u Agate , bad u Arimathaïa ha ka kyrdon kaba lai ;
translation.en: And the third row , a ligure , an agate , and an amethyst .

translation.kha: Kumta u Iso u sngewthuh ba u kpa jong u , u ISAIAH um mynjur ïa ki kynthei nong Kane .
translation.en: And Esau seeing that the daughters of Canaan pleased not Isaac his father  ;
And he said , O my Lord , send , I pray thee , by the hand of him whom thou wilt send .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u jubab ,  Em , Kynrad , sngewbha phah noh dano dano .

translation.en: And David arose , and fled that day for fear of Saul , and went to Achish the king of Gath .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u mihnoh , u da phet krad na u Saul , bad u la leit sha u Akhish u syiem ka Gath .
Nangta u la ong , Ngan ai ha pha bun ki khun ki ksiew ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto her , I will multiply thy seed exceedingly , that it shall not be numbered for multitude .

translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka pyrsa kurim , baroh ar ngut kin shah pynïap . Ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba Lied , bad ki la kupar kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .
translation.en: And if a man lie with his daughter in law , both of them shall surely be put to death : they have wrought confusion  ; their blood shall be upon them .

translation.kha: Haba u leit sa ha kawei paw ka sngi , u iohi ar ngut ki Hebru kiba ïashoh . U ong ha uta uba kuna bymdei , Balei me da synsar ïa la u para Hebru ?
translation.en: And when he went out the second day , behold , two men of the Hebrews strove together : and he said to him that did the wrong , Wherefore smitest thou thy fellow ?

translation.kha: uba san u maw Antiokh , uba hynriew u maw Karnelian , uba hynñiew u mawleiñ bastem , uba phra u maw Baibl , uba khyndai u maw Topas , uba Shiphew u maw Khalkedon , ibha khatwei u maw Tertullos , uba khat-ar u maw Amethyst .
translation.en: The fifth , sardonyx  ; the sixth , sardius  ; the seventh , chrysolite  ; the eighth , beryl  ; the ninth , a topaz  ; the tenth , a chrysoprasus  ; the eleventh , a jacinth  ; the twelfth , an amethyst .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la don ha ka jingjynjar haba la bthah ba ki dei banbeiñ shna katjuh ki maw-it man ka sngi kumba ki la ju shna mynshuwa .
translation.en: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case , after it was said , Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task .
And the Philistine said unto David , Am I a dog , that thou comest to me with staves ? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods .
translation.kha: U ong ïa u Dabid ,  Men leh aïu da uto u diengduh ? Me tharai nga dei u ksew ?  Bad u pyrta da ki jingtim ki blei jong u halor u Dabid .

Sa shisnem pat ki Israel ki la leh ngop pyrshah ïa U Trai da katba mane ïa ki Baal bad ïa ki Astarte , lymne bad ïa ki blei jong ki Assyria , jong ki Sidon , jong ki Moab , jong ki Ammon , bad jong ki Philistia . Ki la iehnoh ïa U Trai nabar ki la sangeh ban mane ïa u .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord  , and served Baalim , and Ashtoreth , and the gods of Syria , and the gods of Zidon , and the gods of Moab , and the gods of the children of Ammon , and the gods of the Philistines , and forsook the  Lord  , and served not him .
And the boys grew : and Esau was a cunning hunter , a man of the field  ; and Jacob was a plain man , dwelling in tents .
translation.kha: Kita ki khynnah shynrang ki la nang san nang rangbah , bad u Iso u kylla long u nongbeh mrad uba tbit , u briew uba ieit ban shang lum shang wah , katba u Jakob pat u long u briew uba jar jar , uba shong tang ha ïing .
Naba ïa ka Hukum u mawshun la pyllew la slem bah ha ki synagog man la ka sngi Sabdi , bad ïa ki ktien jong u la ïaleh ha man ki shnong .
translation.en: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him , being read in the synagogues every sabbath day .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingïadei bad ka Hukum , la kumno kumno nga la ïahap — la pynïap da ka Hukum hi — khnang ba nga ia ban im na ka bynta U blem . La pynïap ïa nga lem bad U Khrist ha ka diengphna jongu u ,
translation.en: For I through the law am dead to the law , that I might live unto God .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , u Tom u iathuh ia nga ba ngam dei ban wan hajuh ha iing jong u .
translation.en: In fact , Tom told me never to come back to his house again .
And when Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , saw it , he rose up from among the congregation , and took a javelin in his hand  ;
translation.kha: Haba u Phinehas , u khun jong u Eleasar bad u ksiew jong u Aaron uba long lyngdoh , u la ïohi ïa kane , u ïeng joit bad u mih na kata ka kynhun .
Khim ïa une u diengduh bad me , Naamah da u men sa lai ïa ki kambah .
translation.en: And thou shalt take this rod in thine hand , wherewith thou shalt do signs .

translation.kha: Mynno na kine ki blei jong ki ri baroh kiba la ju pyllait im ïa ki ri jong ki na u patsha jong ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa ph ban pyrkhat ba U Trai un pyllait im ïa ka Jerusalem ?
translation.en: Who are they among all the gods of the countries , that have delivered their country out of mine hand , that the  Lord  should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand ?

translation.kha: khnang ba ma phi baroh lang , phi lah ban ïaroh da kawei ka prie ïa U Blei bad U Kpa jongnga U Jisu Khrist uba U Tharai jngai i'u .
translation.en: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God , even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka jingkhot Bakhuid ka ong : Lada u nongshun jong phi u thngan , to ai bam ïa u ; lada u sliang , to ai ïa u ban dih ; uba da kaba leh ïa kane phin pynlong ïa u ban ing da ka jingsngewlehrain .
translation.en: Therefore if thine enemy hunger , feed him ; if he thirst , give him drink : for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingkordit jong nga , nga la khot kyrpad ïa U Trai ; u la jubab ïa nga bad u la pyllaitluid ïa ar .
translation.en: I called upon the  Lord  in distress : the  Lord  answered me , and set me in a large place .

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kyang hikai ïa ki briew Jong nga ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng kaei kaba Khuid bad ka bymkhuid , bun hapdeng kaei kaba khuid katno kum ka jinglehkmen bad kaei ka bym long kumta .
translation.en: And they shall teach my people the difference between the holy and profane , and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean .

translation.kha: Me tip ba kum uta ki bhabriew u longkmie wahbah bamsap bad ki pop jongu u ki pynsawa ba u bakla .
translation.en: Knowing that he that is such is subverted , and sinneth , being condemned of himself .
Go through , go through the gates  ; prepare ye the way of the people  ; cast up , cast up the highway  ; gather out the stones  ; lift up a standard for the people .
translation.kha: Ko ki paid ka Jerusalem , leit shabar ka nongbah bad shna ka lynti na ka bynta u paidlang u ban wan phai ! Pynkhreh ïa ka lynti bah ; da pynkhuid ïa ki maw kiba don ha ka ! To sieh ïa ka lama , khnang ba ki jaitbynriew kin tip .
ka Anathoth , bad ka Almon , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: Anathoth with her suburbs , and Almon with her suburbs  ; four cities .
And the haft also went in after the blade  ; and the fat closed upon the blade , so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly  ; and the dirt came out .
translation.kha: Ka waitlam baroh kawei lem bad ka sping ka la rung shapoh bad ka khleiñ ka la tap ïa ka . U Ehud um shym la sei ïa ka na ka kpoh jong u syiem , bad ka la pei bla shadien , hapdeng ki kjat jong u .

translation.en: Ye Ethiopians also , ye shall be slain by my sword .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynïap ruh ïa ki briew jong ka Sudan .
Haba ki la rung pat shapoh ïing , ki synran ki la kylli ïa U Jisu shang kane .
translation.en: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba ki nongshahkhot sngewngiah kin leit thiah noh , ki shynraiñ jong ka Setham ki la kerkut ïa ka ïing . Balah ki shynrang jongu kata ka nongbah , bad samla bad Thummim , ki la ïadon hangno .
translation.en: But before they lay down , the men of the city , even the men of Sodom , compassed the house round , both old and young , all the people from every quarter :

translation.kha: Hynrei nga khoh ïa phi ba phin sngewtmang ba U Khristan u longïing halor tam ïa uwei pa uwei bariew , u tnga u longsem khashor la ka tnga , mala U Balei u hir khlur tam ïa U Khrist .
translation.en: But I would have you know , that the head of every man is Christ ; and the head of the woman is the man ; and the head of Christ is God .

translation.kha: U Elisha u ïathuhlypa u la kem pang na ka jaiñjot jingpang kaba shyrkhei , bad katba u ding thiaw sa ba un ïap u Jehoash u syiem Israel u loit jngoh ïa u . Ko pa jong nga , pa jong por ! u pyrta da kaba ïam . Phi la long u nongïada bakhlaiñbor jong ka Israel !
translation.en: Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died . And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him , and wept over his face , and said , O my father , my father , the chariot of Israel , and the horsemen thereof .
But now this shall be the thing which we will do to Gibeah  ; we will go up by lot against it  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei ba ngin leh : ngin ïakynting sbai bad ngin jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah ban leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Gibeah .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  the King of Israel , and his redeemer the  Lord  of hosts  ; I am the first , and I am the last  ; and beside me there is no God .
translation.kha: U  Trai  uba synshar bad uba ïada ïa ki Israel , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , u don ïa kane ban ong :  Nga long uba nyngkong , uba khatduh , tang ma nga hi U Blei ; ym don uwei pat U Blei hynrei tang ma nga .

translation.en: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron s head , and anointed him , to sanctify him .
translation.kha: U pynkyntang ïa u Aaron da kaba theh khyndiat ïa ka umphniang pynsleh ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: Now therefore why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth , which maketh himself a prophet to you ?
translation.kha: Balei phim shym leh ïa kane ha u Jeremaïah jong ka Anathoth , uba la kren kum u nongïathuhlypa sha ki briew ?

translation.en: And the sons of Levi  ; Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .
translation.kha: U Lebi bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Gershon , u Kohath , bad u Merari .
To hikai ïa ngi aïu ïeng ong ha U Blei ; ki jingtem jrong ngi ki tylli ; ngim don ei ei ban ong .
translation.en: Teach us what we shall say unto him  ; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness .

translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut , Kata ka long kumno ba U Kpu jong nga uba ha bneng un kuna ïa uwei pa uwei na pa’ lymda phi ïamap ïa la u hynmen u para naduh ka dohnud .
translation.en: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you , if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses .
Let us get up early to the vineyards  ; let us see if the vine flourish , whether the tender grape appear , and the pomegranates bud forth : there will I give thee my loves .
translation.kha: Nga la khynñiuh ; phi la pynlong ïa nga ban thrang eh ïa ka jingieit kum u nongñiah kali ïapom u thrang ïa ka thma .
O em , ko Kynrad , la jubab u rangbah pynïaidkam . Ngam long uba dih hok ba phin wan Shobab ka ïing jong nga . Shu ai hukum , Bad u shakri jong nga un ïohkhiah .
translation.en: The centurion answered and said , Lord , I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof : but speak the word only , and my servant shall be healed .

translation.kha: Ka kmang jong u ka pynbuh briew ïa u bad ka nong Ijipt .
translation.en: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Paran : and his mother took him a wife out of the land of Egypt .
Take ye heed , watch and pray : for ye know not when the time is .
translation.kha: Sumar bha bad peitngor , namar phim tip lano kata ka por kan wan .
Khmut , khie leit , sha ki briew baroh kylleng bad pynlong ïa ki , ki synran jongnga nga : To pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U Kpa , U ka , bad U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,
translation.en: Go ye therefore , and teach all nations , baptizing them in the name of the Father , and of the Son , and of the Holy Ghost :
Another parable spake he unto them  ;  The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven , which a woman took , and hid in three measures of meal , till the whole was leavened .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki sa kawei pat ka pharshi .  Ka Hima ki Bneng ka long kumne . Ka briew ka shim khyndiat u thiat bad ka khleh ïa u bad sawphew kilo u purew tad haduh ba u  purew ba la khleh u sieb .

translation.en: Therefore let us keep the feast , not with old leaven , neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness ; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth .
translation.kha: To ngin rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam , te , ym da u kpu uba don u thiat uba rim jong ka pop bad ka jingbymman , hynrei da u kpu u bym don thiat , u kpu jong ka jingkhuid bad ka jingshisha .
( Ki synran jong u ki la lah leit sha shnong ban thiat jingbamsap . )
translation.en: ( For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat . )
For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver , and his idols of gold , which your own hands have made unto you for a sin .
translation.kha: Ka por kan wan haba baroh na phi phin bret noh ïa ki bleithaw bapop kiba phi la thaw na ka rupa bad ka ksiar .
Mynta , nga pynthikna ïa phi ba hangno hangno haba yn ïarap ïa kane ka Gospel ha kylleng ka pyrthei , ïa kaei kaba ka la ai yn ïathuh ïa ka ban kynmaw ïa ka .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world , there shall also this , that this woman hath done , be told for a memorial of her .

translation.kha: Hynrei uno eit babha leh ïa kaei kaba shisha u wanpaw sha ka jingshai khnang ba ka jingshai kan pynpyut ïa kaei Kaba u la leh ka long da kaba kohnguh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light , that his deeds may be made manifest , that they are wrought in God .

translation.kha: Phi dei ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong nga , ki para doh ki para snam jrong de ; balei phin dei kiba khatduh ban ïalam pat ïa nga ?
translation.en: Ye are my brethren , ye are my bones and my flesh : wherefore then are ye the last to bring back the king ?

translation.kha: U syiem u phiah shane ruh ka khet kaba heh . shi bynta jong ka la sop da ka bniat hati , bad ïa kaba sah jong ka la sopkjat da ka ksiar kaba nylla .
translation.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with pure gold .

translation.kha: U pynsynjor halor ka pyrthei baroh , na ki krem kiba jylliew tur sha kliang ki lum bajrong tam .
translation.en: In his hand are the deep places of the earth : the strength of the hills is his also .

And he went forth unto the spring of the waters , and cast the salt in there , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , I have healed these waters  ; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land .
translation.kha: bad u la leit sha ka umpohliew , u la bret ïa ka mluh ha ka um , bad u ong ,  Kane ka dei kaba U  Trai  u ong : ‘ Nga pynkhuid ïa kane ka um , bad kan ym pynjia shuh kano kano ka jingïap lane ki jinghap khun .’

Hynrei uwei na ki , u Pharisi uba kyrtong u Mahalalel , uba erlangthari u nonghikai ka Hukum bun ïa uba la burom shikatdei da ki briew baroh , u la ainong ha ka Dorbar . U la hukum ban ïalam ïa ki apostol shipa shabar ,
translation.en: Then stood there up one in the council , a Pharisee , named Gamaliel , a doctor of the law , had in reputation among all the people , and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space  ;

translation.kha: Kuth phi phla shisha ba phi un-long ki khun ki ksiew jong kito kiba la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa !
translation.en: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves , that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets .

translation.kha: Kin bam ïa ki jingri jingdup malu ïa ki jingthung jingtep jong ph , bad phin ïapthngan . Ki ym pynsah ei ei , ïa u kaweh , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , ki masi , lane ki langbrot ; bad pien ïarep .
translation.en: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle , and the fruit of thy land , until thou be destroyed : which also shall not leave thee either corn , wine , or oil , or the increase of thy kine , or flocks of thy sheep , until he have destroyed thee .

translation.kha: Nga thoh ha phiah ïa kane ba phin tip ba phi don ka jingim bymjukut — phi! kiba ngeit ha U Khun U Blei .
translation.en: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God  ; that ye may know that ye have eternal life , and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la kaweh ban tip) kham babe shaphang jngai u mradkhlaw uba saw , u bym lama kumno kiwei pat — u mradkhlaw bakynsha uba khñiot pynlwet ïa kiba u la ïoh da ki tnaw rmiang badno da ki bynshet nar bad nangne u kyrdem Hamor jong ki .
translation.en: Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast , which was diverse from all the others , exceeding dreadful , whose teeth were of iron , and his nails of brass  ; which devoured , brake in pieces , and stamped the residue with his feet  ;
Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed  ; the mighty men of Moab , trembling shall take hold upon them  ; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka Edom ki la sngewshyrkhei ; ki rangbah bakhlaiñbor jong ka Moab ki sngewkyiuh ; ki briew ka Kanaan ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur jong ki .

translation.en: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ ; that every one may receive the things done in his body , according to that he hath done , whether it be good or bad .
translation.kha: Naba baroh na ngi ngin paw ha khmat U Khrist , ba yn bishar ïa ngi da u . Ngin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba ngi dei hok , kat kum kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi la leh , la bha ne la sniew , ha kane ka jingim ha ka met jong ngi .
Shan ki syiem jong ki nongbah Hamath , Arpad , Sepharbaim , Hena , bad Tikbah ?
translation.en: Where is the king of Hamath , and the king of Arpad , and the king of the city of Sepharvaim , of Hena , and Ivah ?
Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten , so thou shalt eat them : the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike .
translation.kha: Uno uno , u lah ban bam ïa kata ka doh , uba khuid ne bymkhuid , kumba bam ïa ka doh skei ne ka doh sier .

translation.en: That through them I may prove Israel , whether they will keep the way of the  Lord  to walk therein , as their fathers did keep it , or not .
translation.kha: Ngan pyndonkam ïa ki ban shem la kine ki Israel kin bud ne em ïa ki lynti jong nga , kumba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la leh .

translation.en: And she said , Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah thy brother to wife .
translation.kha: Ka jubab ,  Shah ba u Adonijah , u hynmen jong me un ïoh ïa ka Abishag kum ka tnga jong u .
Ngam kwah ba kan jaw kumba na pyrshing shun pynsheptieng ïa phi da ki shithi jong nga .
translation.en: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters .

translation.kha: Bad ngi la kyrmen ba un daym ma u tur u ban sa Wan ban ïapyllait ïa ki Israel ! Nalor kata baïar , kane mynta ka dei ka sngi kaba lai naduh ba ka la jhieh .
translation.en: But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel : and beside all this , to day is the third day since these things were done .

translation.kha: Bad kumta U thri u ong , Phi dei ban ioh ïa ki bad pynkyllaiñ ïa lade na ki . Wat ïan bynta malade kaei kaei ka bymkhuid , bad ngan pdiang ïa phi .
translation.en: Wherefore come out from among them , and be ye separate , saith the Lord , and touch not the unclean thing ; and I will receive you ,
And they burnt the house of God , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem , and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire , and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof .
translation.kha: U thang ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka nongbah , lem bad ki ïingsyiem baroh bad ka spah jong ka , bad u pyntwa ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah .
U la Leit Ma u .
translation.en: He had gone .
( Proverbs 6 :27-29 , 32 ) Wisely , therefore , the Bible urges : “Be happy with your wife and find your joy with the girl you married . . .
translation.kha: Ka jingklim bunsien ka pynjot ia ka longing longsem . —Proberb 6 :27-29 , 32 .
Mynta u Trei , U Trai Badonbor baroh un sa shim noh na Jerusalem malu Judas ïa kaei kaei baroh bad ïa uwei pa uwei ba ki briew ki shaniah . Un shim nala ïa ka jingmap bad ka um jong ki ,
translation.en: For , behold , the Lord , the  Lord  of hosts , doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff , the whole stay of bread , and the whole stay of water ,

translation.kha: hynrei lada phi kular ei ei da la ka moi sngewbha , kynmaw ban pynïap ïa ka .
translation.en: That which is gone out of thy lips thou shalt keep and perform  ; even a freewill offering , according as thou hast vowed unto the  Lord  thy God , which thou hast promised with thy mouth .
But there came a messenger unto Saul , saying , Haste thee , and come  ; for the Philistines have invaded the land .
translation.kha: Hamar kata ka por u nonglamktien u wan poi bad u ong ha u Saul ,  Wan phai noh shisyndon ! Ki Philistia ki la wan hiarthma ïa ka ri !

translation.en: And he said unto them , When ye pray , say ,  Our Father which art in heaven , Hallowed be thy name . Thy kingdom come . Thy will be done , as in heaven , so in earth .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Haba phi duwai , to ong ïa kane :   ‘ Ko Kpa : Ai ba ka kyrteng jong me kan long kaba la pyndonburom ; ai ban wan ka Hima jong me .
Kine ki Long ki hukum ba ph dei ban kohnguh katne phi dang shong ha kata ka ri ïa kaba U Tharai , U Blei jngai ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u ai ha phi .
translation.en: These are the statutes and judgments , which ye shall observe to do in the land , which the  Lord  God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it , all the days that ye live upon the earth .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Whosoever hath sinned against me , him will I blot out of my book .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Dei ïa kito kiba la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga kiba ngan weng noh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki na ka kitab jong nga .
Phi ïoh Hynriew sngi ban Trei , hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ka long ka sngi shongthait ïa kaba la pynkyntang sha at . Uno Uno uba trei ïa kano ïano ka kam ha kata ka sngi un shah pynïap .
translation.en: Six days may work be done  ; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest , holy to the  Lord  : whosoever doeth any work in the sabbath day , he shall surely be put to death .
And he took the damsel by the hand , and said unto her ,  Talitha cumi  ;  which is , being interpreted ,  Damsel , I say unto thee , arise .
translation.kha: U la shim ïa ka na ka kti bad u la ong ïa ka ,   Talitha , koum ,   kaba mut ,  Ko Khynnah rit , nga ong ïa pha ban khie joit !

translation.en: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock , and he said unto them , Hear now , ye rebels  ; must we fetch you water out of this rock ?
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la lumlang ïa u paidbah baroh ha khmat u mawsiang , bad u Moses u ong ,  Sngap mynta , phi ki nongïaleh pyrshah ! Hato ngi hap pynmih um na une u mawsiang na ka bynta jong phi ?
Ki Israel ki shim ha lade ïa ki jingri bad ïa ki meng ki mata ba ki ïoh kurup na ka nongbah , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Joshua .
translation.en: Only the cattle and the spoil of that city Israel took for a prey unto themselves , according unto the word of the  Lord  which he commanded Joshua .
But to Israel he saith , All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people .
translation.kha: Hynrei shaphang ki Israel u ong ,  Baroh shi sngi nga la rah ïa la ki kti ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh bad kiba ïaleh pyrshah .
U lah ban mon khraw , ban jrong shaduh suiñbneng , u khraw haduh ba ka khlaw jong u ka kot sha ki lyoh ,
translation.en: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens , and his head reach unto the clouds  ;

translation.kha: U skhem u ong ha u Amasa , Khot lang ïa ki rangbah Judia bad wan biang shane la shi sngi lem bad ki .
translation.en: Then said the king to Amasa , Assemble me the men of Judah within three days , and be thou here present .

translation.kha: Sawdong ïa ka khet , la dat arphew saw tylli kiwei pat ki khet , ha kaba la shong arphew saw thut ki nongsharai balang kiba la riam da kaba lieh nabar phong ki pateng ksiar .
translation.en: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats : and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting , clothed in white raiment  ; and they had on their heads crowns of gold .

translation.kha: Ki la sngewkmen ïa-ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u don ban ino , bad ki la kular ban ai pisa ïa u . Kumta u Judas u la sdang ba wad ïa ka trai Kaba biang ban aiti noh ïa U Jisu shaei ki .
translation.en: And when they heard it , they were glad , and promised to give him money . And he sought how he might conveniently betray him .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingkmen la shim noh na ki jaka basian jngai ka Joab . ?(Nga la pynlong ïa ka waiñ ban sangeh ïa-ban tuid na ki jaka khñiot saiñ ; ym don shuh myn mano ba shna ïa ka saiñ bad ban pyrta da ka jingkren .
translation.en: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field , and from the land of Moab  ; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses : none shall tread with shouting  ; their shouting shall be no shouting .

translation.kha: La don katto katto ngut ki Jiw ïa bakha phi la buh ban khmih ïa ka probins jngai ka byllien — u Hadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego — ki bym shym kohnguh ïa ki hukum u Simri Kynrad . Kim shym mane ïa u blei lad phi lane dem ngon sha ka durbriew kaba phira la phah pynïeng .
translation.en: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego  ; these men , O king , have not regarded thee : they serve not thy gods , nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma ph , ko ki parabangeit , to wat man thait ha kaba leh ïa kaba bha’ .
translation.en: But ye , brethren , be not weary in well doing .
Harness the horses  ; and get up , ye horsemen , and stand forth with your helmets  ; furbish the spears , and put on the brigandines .
translation.kha: Teh jin ha ki kulai jong phi bad shong halor jong ki ! Ïeng ryntih bad phong ïa ki jingda khlieh jong phi ! Pynnep ïa ki sum jong phi ! Kieng ïa ka atiar jong phi !’

translation.en: And they had no child , because that Elisabeth was barren , and they both were now well stricken in years .
translation.kha: Kim don khun namar ba ka Elisabeth kam shym lah ban ïoh wat iwei ruh , bad ma ka lem bad u Sekharaïah ki la tymmen bha .

translation.en: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker : and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished .
translation.kha: Lada phi rkhiebeiñ ïa ki briew kiba duk , phi ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei uba la thaw ïa ki . Phin shah pynshitom lada phi leh sngewbha ha ka apot jongno jongno .
kamut u Saul u ong ïa u Doeg , Ma me , pynïap ïa ki ! — pynlang u Doeg u la pynïap ïa ki barabor . Ha Katai ka sngi u la pynïap phraphew san ñiut ki lynghoh naba bit ban phong ïa ka ephod .
translation.en: And the king said to Doeg , Turn thou , and fall upon the priests . And Doeg the Edomite turned , and he fell upon the priests , and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod .

translation.kha: Haba phi pynurlong ïa ka jinganna ainguh sngewbha sha U Trai , bud bieit ïa ki lap lehniam kthang ba yn pdiang hun ïa phin .
translation.en: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the  Lord  , offer it at your own will .
Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; An adversary there shall be even round about the land  ; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee , and thy palaces shall be spoiled .
translation.kha: Bad kumta , u nongshun un kerkut ïa ka ri , un pyntwa ïa ki jingker jong ki , bad un lute ïa ki ïing paki dulan jong ki .

Katba nga dang khmih’ ïa ki reng , nga la ïohi ïa ka reng kaba rit , kaba miej napdeng kiwei pat . Ka la tar ïa ki lai tylli ki reng kiba la anna lypa hangta . Kane ka reng ka la don ki khmat brisoh bad ka shijur kaba kob sarong .
translation.en: I considered the horns , and , behold , there came up among them another little horn , before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots : and , behold , in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man , and a mouth speaking great things .
He yearns to bring back those who are in his memory and to see them live on earth again . —Job 14 :14 , 15 .
translation.kha: U kwah ban wanrah biang ïa kito kiba u buh jingkynmaw bad ban ïohi ba ki im biang ha pyrthei .—Job 14 :14 , 15 .

translation.en: Who shall be punished with everlasting destruction from the presence of the Lord , and from the glory of his power ;
translation.kha: Kin shah ïa ka jingpynshitom jong ka jingpynjot bymjukut , kiba la pynïakhlad na ka jingdon ryngkat ka jong U Trai bad na ka jingkhlaiñbor badonburom jong u ,

Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga pynbha ba yn ym don uno uno u nongwei bym shym la otsher , isangsot uno u bymkohnguh ïa nga , un rung ha ka Telem jong nga , thew u nongai uba shong basah phangpdeng ki paid Israel .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; No stranger , uncircumcised in heart , nor uncircumcised in flesh , shall enter into my sanctuary , of any stranger that is among the children of Israel .
The nakedness of thy father s wife s daughter , begotten of thy father , she is thy sister , thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka khun ka tnga u kpa jong me , naba ka ruh ka dei ka para jong me .
U Asa u pynlyngngoh ïa U Trai , U Blei jong u , da kaba leh ïa kaei Kaba dei malu naba bha .
translation.en: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the  Lord  his God :

translation.kha: Ka pop jong ki Jiw ka la wallam ki jingkyrkhu ïa-ïap kyrhai ha ka pyrthei , bad ka jingduk ba kynja mynsiem jong ki ka la wallam ki jingkyrkhu ba-dap kriah ïa ki Jentil . Te , haduh kattne ki jingkynnoh ba kham khraw kin long haba ïa baïar ki Jiw yn kynthih lang!
translation.en: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world , and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles ; how much more their fulness ?

translation.kha: U Mordekai u tip shaphang kane bad u ïathmu ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei ; kaba la ïathuh pat ïa u syiem ïa kaei kaba u Mordekai u la shem .
translation.en: And the thing was known to Mordecai , who told it unto Esther the queen  ; and Esther certified the king thereof in Mordecai s name .
Go from the presence of a foolish man , when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge .
translation.kha: Kiar na ki briew kiba bieit ; kim don ei ei ban hikai ïa phi .

U Trai u la jubab , Lada phi don ka jingngeit kato u thymmei tyrso , phi lah ban ong ha une u diengsoh lyngdkhur , ‘ To jynrat noh ïa laiñ na ki thied bun thut ïa lade hapoh duriaw !’ bun un kohnguh ïa phi .
translation.en: And the Lord said ,  If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed , ye might say unto this sycamine tree , Be thou plucked up by the root , and be thou planted in the sea  ; and it should obey you .

translation.kha: Nangta ma u malu ki rangbah jong u baroh ki ïaid sha ka thma pyrshah ïa ki Philistia , kiba ïaleh iwei ïa iwei pat ha ka jingkulmar bajur .
translation.en: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves , and they came to the battle : and , behold , every man s sword was against his fellow , and there was a very great discomfiture .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoahas u la leh bad ki kam shlur jong u baroh la bhah jingwoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Susim Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz , and all that he did , and his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: Kumta u la kylli ïa ki , Ko samla , phira la ïangat ei ei ? Ei ei umdih em , ki la jubab .
translation.en: Then Jesus saith unto them ,  Children , have ye any meat ?  They answered him , No .

translation.kha: U ong ha la ka kmie , Mynshuwa ba-don ba tuh ïa ki shi hajar shispah tylli ki sbai mata na phi , phi buh ka jingtim halor uta u nongtuh . Nga la ïohsngew Phi leh Kumta . Khmih , nga don ka pisa . dat ma per uba shim ïa ki . Ka kmie jong u ka ong , To U Trai un kyrkieh ïa Phin , ko khup jong nga !
translation.en: And he said unto his mother , The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee , about which thou cursedst , and spakest of also in mine ears , behold , the silver is with me  ; I took it . And his mother said , Blessed be thou of the  Lord  , my son .
Wash your hands .
translation.kha: Thet ki kti .

U Mosah u la dep ai ïa ka ri ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jehohanan ha kiwei pat ki ar jait bad shiteng jong kawei jait . ( Ïa kiba hiarpateng na u Jehosheba la bynta ha ki ar jaitniam : Manasseh bad Jeremaïah . ) Wat la katta , u Moses um shym la ai kano kano ka bynta Jong ka iaki ïa ki Lebi . Tangba , ki la ïoh ïa ki nongbah ban shong ban sah” , lem bad ki pyntha na ka byndi ki jingri jong ki .
translation.en: For the children of Joseph were two tribes , Manasseh and Ephraim : therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land , save cities to dwell in , with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance .

translation.kha: Ki la leit shata namar dei hangta ba ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Krit U thri ka don , ha kaba u Moses , u sakhrai jong U Trai , u la pynïeng ha ka ri khlaw .
translation.en: So Solomon , and all the congregation with him , went to the high place that was at Gibeon  ; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God , which Moses the servant of the  Lord  had made in the wilderness .
For he knew who should betray him  ; therefore said he ,  Ye are not all clean .
translation.kha: ( U Jisu u la lah tip lypa uei u ban sa shetkylla ïa u ; na kata ka daw balei u la ong ,  Baroh na phi , lait noh uwei , phi long kiba khuid .  )

translation.en: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due , when it is in the power of thine hand to do it .
translation.kha: Ha kano kano ka por ba phi ïoh ka kabu , leh ïa kaba bha ïa kito kiba donkam ïa ka .

translation.en: Say not thou , I will recompense evil  ; but wait on the  Lord  , and he shall save thee .
translation.kha: Wat shim ha lade ban siew kylliang ïa kaba sniew . Shaniah ha U  Trai  bad un pynlong ïa ka kaba dei .

translation.en: And he took it , and the king thereof , and all the cities thereof  ; and they smote them with the edge of the sword , and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein  ; he left none remaining : as he had done to Hebron , so he did to Debir , and to the king thereof  ; as he had done also to Libnah , and to her king .
translation.kha: U la kurup ïa ka bad ïa u syiem jong ka , bad ïa baroh ki shnong kiba markhap . Ki pynïap lut ïa uwei pa uwei hangta . U Joshua u la leh ïa ka Debir bad ïa u syiem jong ka kumba u la leh ïa ka Hebron bad ïa ka Libnah bad u syiem jong ka .
Man ka por ba ki Israel ki thung jingthung , ki Midian , ki wan malade ki Elam , bad ki jingpyniwbih ka ri shyiap ban tur ïalang ïa ki .
translation.en: And so it was , when Israel had sown , that the Midianites came up , and the Amalekites , and the children of the east , even they came up against them  ;
The word that the  Lord  spake to Jeremiah the prophet , how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Mynba u Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ijipt , U  Trai  U la kren ha nga . U ong ,
Te ngan long ka dak ïa pha ; phan leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ar la sa . U Trai u nong ba haba kano kan wia , phan ïoh tip ba u long U TRAI’ Nongsynshar .
translation.en: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign : according to all that he hath done shall ye do : and when this cometh , ye shall know that I am the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ko syiem , phi dei ban tip ba ngi la leit sha ka probins jong ka Judah bad skhem ba ïa ka Templ jong U Blei bakhraw la dang shna wiang da ki mawthew bahkhlieh bad da ki bam-im dieng ba la pyndait ha ka kynroh . Ïa ka kam la pyntrei ha ka rukom kaba biang bha Bad ka ïan ïaid shaphrang .
translation.en: Be it known unto the king , that we went into the province of Judah , to the house of the great God , which is builded with great stones , and timber is laid in the walls , and this work goeth fast on , and prospereth in their hands .
And he said , Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day ? it is neither new moon , nor sabbath . And she said , It shall be well .
translation.kha: Balei phi hap ban leit mynta ka sngi ?  u tnga jong ka u kylli .  Kam shym dei ka Sabbaton lane ka Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai .   Kam lei lei ,  ka jubab .

U tharai u kren biang ha u Moses , Bsuh ïa la ka ktah shapoh ka jaiñkup jong me . U Moses u la kohnguh ; bad ynda u sei pat ïa la ka kti , ka la ïoh jingpang kaba la tap da ki jingthohlieh , kum ka ther .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said furthermore unto him , Put now thine hand into thy bosom . And he put his hand into his bosom : and when he took it out , behold , his hand was leprous as snow .

translation.kha: Lymne ba ki lah ban ai ki jingpynshisha jong ki jingkynnoh jong ki kaweh ki wallam mynta pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: Neither can they prove the things whereof they now accuse me .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba riewspah , pynbna , ki mutdur ba ka spah jong ki ka ïada ïa ki kamon ki kynroh bajrong bakhlaiñ sawdong ïa ka nongbah .
translation.en: The rich man s wealth is his strong city , and as an high wall in his own conceit .

Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , from the iron furnace , saying , Obey my voice , and do them , according to all which I command you : so shall ye be my people , and I will be your God :
translation.kha: Ka dei ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki mynba nga la wallam noh ïa ki na Ijipt , ka ri kaba long kum ka lawar ding baklang ïa ki . Nga la ong ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa nga bad ban leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la lah hukum . Nga la ong ïa ki ba lada ki kohnguh , kin ïoh long ki briew jong nga bad ngan ïoh long U Blei jong ki .
U Moses u la jingbabe , Lada me hi men ym leit ryngkat bad ngi , wat ai ba ngin mihnoh na kane ka jaka .
translation.en: And he said unto him , If thy presence go not with me , carry us not up hence .
