O thou that art named the house of Jacob , is the spirit of the  Lord  straitened ? are these his doings ? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly ?
translation.kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba ki paid Israel ki don hapoh ka jingtim ? Hato U  Trai  u la duh noh ïa la ka jingïaishah ? Hato un da leh shisha ïa kine kiei kiei ? Hato um shym kren bha ïa kito kiba leh ïa kaba dei ?
Me la jingaiti ïa sa , bad me sumar ïa nga ; to ai ha nga ka jingshemphang , khnang ba len lah ban nang ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translation.en: Thy hands have made me and fashioned me : give me understanding , that I may learn thy commandments .
And I said , Hear , I pray you , O heads of Jacob , and ye princes of the house of Israel  ; Is it not for you to know judgment ?
translation.kha: To shahshkor , phi ki nongsynshar ki Israel ! Phi la dei ban sngewkhia shaphang ka jingbishar hok ,

translation.en: So I sware in my wrath , They shall not enter into my rest . )
translation.kha: Nga la bitar bad nga la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang : ‘ Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei sha ka ri ha kaba ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingjahthait !’

translation.en: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord s sake : whether it be to the king , as supreme  ;
translation.kha: Na ka bynta U Trai , to pynkohnguh ïa lade ha ki bor synshar baroh : Ha u Patsha uba long ka bor kaba ha khlieh tam ,
Waw ai ba u Hesekaïah un pynbieit ïa phi pun pyrkhat ba U Trai un pyllait im ïa phira . Haduh ki blei Jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ki pyrsad ïa ki ri jong ki na u katsha ka Assyria ?
translation.en: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you , saying , The  Lord  will deliver us . Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria ?

translation.kha: Mynta nga phah ïa me sha u Pharaoh khnang ba men ïalam ne ïa ki Israel , ki bynriew jong nga , na Ijipt .
translation.en: Come now therefore , and I will send thee unto Pharaoh , that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt .

translation.kha: Lashai haba ki pangnud Judah kin ïohsngew shang barieh ka jingpynjot kaba la thum ïa-ban khlam halor jong ki , Kin phai noh na ki lynter bymneh jong ki . Te nur-um map ïa ka jingbymman jong ki bad ïa ki pop jong ki .
translation.en: It may be that the house of Judah will hear all the evil which I purpose to do unto them  ; that they may return every man from his evil way  ; that I may forgive their iniquity and their sin .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki paidbah ki ong ha u Saul , Hato u Ioannis , uba la jop ka jingjop kaba khrawburom na ka bna ki Israel , un shah pynïap ? Em ! Ngi kular ha U Trai uba im ba uwei u shngiam na ka khlieh jong u ruh un ym hap ha khyndew . Kaei kaba u la leh ha kane ka sngi la leh da ka jingïar jong U Blei . kumto ki paidbah ki la pyllait im ïa u Jehohanan na kaba shah pynïap .
translation.en: And the people said unto Saul , Shall Jonathan die , who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel ? God forbid : as the  Lord  liveth , there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground  ; for he hath wrought with God this day . So the people rescued Jonathan , that he died not .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka , Nga long ka jingput bad ka jingim . Ïano uno uba ngeit ha nga un im , wat la u la ïap ; un ïoh im , bad eit uno uba im , bad kaba thwet ha nga un ym ïap lieng Lano ruh .
translation.en: Jesus said unto her ,  I am the resurrection , and the life : he that believeth in me , though he were dead , yet shall he live :

translation.kha: Kumba u Trai u la hukum , u Moses u buh ïa la ki kti halor ka khlieh jong u Joshua , bad u la pynbna ba une un erlangthari u nongmih bujli jong u .
translation.en: And he laid his hands upon him , and gave him a charge , as the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: Ha kane ki synñiang ki la sngewphylla haduh katta bad ki la ïa-ong per ma ki , Mano ken uba lah shun lehse im ?
translation.en: And they were astonished out of measure , saying among themselves , Who then can be saved ?

translation.kha: U ong , I pa i la buh ha pa’ ïa ka jingkit kaba khie ; nga ngan kham pynkhia shuh shuh ïa kita . I pa i la shoh ïa phi da u ryndang ; nga ngan sympat ïa phi da u shabuk !
translation.en: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men , saying , My father made your yoke heavy , and I will add to your yoke : my father also chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .

translation.kha: Ka shad jong phi ka la pyut nong , bad ki jaiñ jong phi ki la smam kruiñ .
translation.en: Your riches are corrupted , and your garments are motheaten .

translation.kha: U Laban u ong ïa u Jakob , Balei me shukor ïa nga bad ïalam noh ïa ki khun kynthei jong la la kum ïa ki kynthei kiba shah kem ha ka thma ?
translation.en: And Laban said to Jacob , What hast thou done , that thou hast stolen away unawares to me , and carried away my daughters , as captives taken with the sword ?

translation.kha: Nangta ngan bat ïa ka kular kaweh nga la pynlong ha ki khop tymmen jong ki ba ngan ai ha ki ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud malade ka ngap kaba ki don mynsiem . Nga la ïong , Ho-oid , ko Trai .
translation.en: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers , to give them a land flowing with milk and honey , as it is this day . Then answered I , and said , So be it , O  Lord .
And Israel journeyed , and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la nang ïaid noh , bad u la sher dara ha kawei pat ka liang jong u mot Eder .

translation.en: And they that heard it said , Who then can be saved ?
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la ïohsngew ïa kane ki la kylli ,  Mano , te , uba lah ban lait im ?

translation.en: He answered and said , Who is he , Lord , that I might believe on him ?
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la jubab ,  To ïathuh ïa nga u dei uei , ko Kynrad , khnang ba ngan lah ban ngeit ha u !

U Trai u la ong ha at , To ïeng ha ka ïingbishar lad ka Templ bad to pynbah ïa borbah kambah nga la hukum ïa me ban ong ha ki briew kiba wan na ki shnong jong ka Judah ban mane hangta . Wat ym iehnoh ei ei ruh em .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Stand in the court of the  Lord s  house , and speak unto all the cities of Judah , which come to worship in the  Lord s  house , all the words that I command thee to speak unto them  ; diminish not a word :

translation.kha: La u Abraham u la ïarap shisha , na une uwei u briew , la mih ngon kiba hiarpateng kat ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng , kat u shahjop bymïap ñiew Shu Harhas duriaw .
translation.en: Therefore sprang there even of one , and him as good as dead , so many as the stars of the sky in multitude , and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable .

translation.kha: Wat lynthem ïa nga bad mane ïa ki bleithaw ; wat thaw ïa ki blei ba shu sai na ka sisa bad ban mane ïa ki . Nga long U Tlai U Blei lad phi .
translation.en: Turn ye not unto idols , nor make to yourselves molten gods : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Haba nga tbeh ding ha ka Ijipt pynlang ïa ki nongkyrshan jong ka baroh yn pynpoh , te ki pyntip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have set a fire in Egypt , and when all her helpers shall be destroyed .

translation.kha: Ka jingdih ka ngap ka don ha ki rmiang shyntur jong phin , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; u thliew jong phi u long ka dud bad ka ngap ïa nga . Ka jaiñ jong phi ka don baroh ki jingiwbih ka Lebanon .
translation.en: His head is as the most fine gold , his locks are bushy , and black as a raven .

translation.kha: Ki la ïohkhiah ïa ka ri jong u pynlang ïa ka ri u Og u shem Bashngain , uwei pat u syiem Amor wahbah shong shad mihnoh na ka wah Jordan .
translation.en: And they possessed his land , and the land of Og king of Bashan , two kings of the Amorites , which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising  ;

translation.kha: Nangno u la ïalap noh ïa ki shaba bad u la kyllaiñ , Ko rangbah , kaei sa daym ban leh ba yn pynsum ïa nga ?
translation.en: And brought them out , and said , Sirs , what must I do to be saved ?
Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter , but within they are full of extortion and excess .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi pynkhuid ïa kaba shabar jong ka khuri bad ka pliang jong phi , katba kaba shapoh ka dap da kaei kaba phi ïoh da ka jingleh jubor bad ka jingpyrkhat tang ïa lade .
Ïa ki khiew ki pliang ksiar bad rupa shiah kiba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la ïalum sha Babilon na ka baphylla ha Jerushah , dei ban pynpoi patiaw shuh ka jaka jong ki ha ka Templ ha Jerusalem’ .
translation.en: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God , which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem , and brought unto Babylon , be restored , and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem , every one to his place , and place them in the house of God .

And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work  ; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it  ; of gold , of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine twined linen , shalt thou make it .
translation.kha: Shna ïa ka jingdeng shadem na ka bynta u Rangbah Lyngdoh ban pyndonkam ha kaba sngewthuh ïa ka mon jong U Blei . Shna ïa ka da kijuh ki tiar kiba la pyndonkam ha kaba suh ïa ka ephod , bad da kijuh ki jingsuh pynpur itynnat .
To kynmaw , ko Trai , ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ngi . To khum ïa me , bad peitmat ïa ka jinglehburom jong me .
translation.en: Remember , O  Lord  , what is come upon us : consider , and behold our reproach .

translation.kha: Ka don sa kawei ka thma bad ki Philistia , bad u Jair u khun jong u Elhanan u pynïap ïa u Lahmi , uba shi para Bad u Goliath na Gog , uba u sum jong u , u don u dieng thut sum uba ka jingrben jong u ka long katba u bran jong u nongthain jaiñ .
translation.en: And there was war again with the Philistines  ; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite , whose spear staff was like a weaver s beam .
For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake , and for my servant David s sake .
translation.kha: Ngan ïada ïa kane ka nongbah bad ngan ïada ïa ka , na ka bynta ka burom jong nga hi bad namar ka kular kaba nga la pynlong ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid .’

translation.en: But I have a baptism to be baptized with  ; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished !
translation.kha: Nga don ka jingpynbaptis ban ïohpdiang , bad katno nga sngewkhia mynsiem tad haduh ba kan da kut noh !

mala u sam jingbam sha ki baroh . U ai ha eiei pa uwei u shynrang bad ha khawai pa kawei ka kynthei ha Jesreel mar uwei u kpu , shi lyngkhot ka doh syang , bad katto katne ki shiah kismis . Nangta baroh ki la leit phai shiah ïing .
translation.en: And he dealt among all the people , even among the whole multitude of Israel , as well to the women as men , to every one a cake of bread , and a good piece of flesh , and a flagon of wine . So all the people departed every one to his house .

translation.kha: ngan ym randien lano laiñ jin na ka jingidiaw ba ngam shym bakla ; ka jingïatiplem jong nga ka beit .
translation.en: My righteousness I hold fast , and will not let it go : my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live .

translation.kha: Teng pyningkhong ïa ka ri lum Edom ka ri khlieh ; bad ngan pynïap ïa uwei pa wai uba ïaid lyndum na ka .
translation.en: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate , and cut off from it him that passeth out and him that returneth .
And being made perfect , he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him  ;
translation.kha: Haba la pynlong janai ïa u , u la jia long ka tynrai jong ka jingim bymjukut na ka bynta kito baroh kiba kohnguh ïa u ,
U Trai un ym iehnoh ïa la ki briew ; bad un ym iehnoh ïa kito kiba long ki jong u .
translation.en: For the  Lord  will not cast off his people , neither will he forsake his inheritance .

translation.kha: Ki briew pat ki long kiba radbah badno kiba jrong rynsan ; ki dei ki ramhah , mala pa’ la bna ba don naba ong ba ym don mano mynshem naba lah ban ïeng ïateh ïa ki .
translation.en: A people great and tall , the children of the Anakims , whom thou knowest , and of whom thou hast heard say , Who can stand before the children of Anak !
And he said unto the elders , Tarry ye here for us , until we come again unto you : and , behold , Aaron and Hur are with you : if any man have any matters to do , let him come unto them .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki nongïalam ,  Ap ïa ngi hangne ha ka jaka sher dara tad ynda ngi wan phai . U Aaron bad u Hur ki don hangne bad phi ; bad kumta uno uno uba don kano kano ka jingïakajia ban pynbeit , u lah ban leit sha ki .

Nongthaw patiaw , uta u briew u la thew sa ïa ka pyngkiang jong ka lynti ïaid kaba ha ka khyrdop . Ka la long barabor Hynrei mitar shiteng bad ka jaka ba lait hapdeng ki khyrdop kiba rynghang ka la long san mitar .
translation.en: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate , ten cubits  ; and the length of the gate , thirteen cubits .
And the chief butler told his dream to Joseph , and said to him , In my dream , behold , a vine was before me  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u nongrah khuri rangbah u ong ,  Ha ka jingphohsniew jong nga , la don uwei u dieng sohwaiñ ha khmat jong nga , uba don lai tylli ki tnat .
Hynrei u Dabid u ong , Phim dei ban pynmynsaw ïa u . U Terah un pynshitom shisha ïa uto uba pynmynsaw ïa u syiem ba la jied jong u .
translation.en: And David said to Abishai , Destroy him not : for who can stretch forth his hand against the  Lord s  anointed , and be guiltless ?
And he also that is valiant , whose heart is as the heart of a lion , shall utterly melt : for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man , and they which be with him are valiant men .
translation.kha: Nangta wat ki rangbah kiba shlur tam , ki bym ju tieng kum ki sing , kin sheptieng namar uwei pa uwei ha Israel u tip ba u kpa jong phi u dei u shipai bakhraw bad ba ki rangbah jong u ki dei ki nongïaleh kiba satar .

NGA la buh u nongaplangbrot ïa-ban khmih ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong nga , hynrei um shym la ïarap ïa ki langbrot babha la shah byrngem da ka jingpynjot ; lymne ba u leit wad ïa kaba la jah neh , dawai pynkhiah ïa kito kiba la mynsaw , lane bsa ïa kiba kwah . Pynban u bam ïa ka doh jong ki langbrot kiba sngaid bun u weng noh ïa ki khnap jong ki .
translation.en: For , lo , I will raise up a shepherd in the land , which shall not visit those that be cut off , neither shall seek the young one , nor heal that that is broken , nor feed that that standeth still : but he shall eat the flesh of the fat , and tear their claws in pieces .

translation.kha: Ka jingmut jong kane ka hukum ka long ba naduh mynta ki Israel ki daiñ ban wallam sha U Trai ïa ki mirr ba ki ju pynïap ha lum ha wah . myntor ki dei ban Wallam ïa ki ha u lynghoh ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ malu pynïap ïa ki kum ki jingainguh ïasyllok .
translation.en: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices , which they offer in the open field , even that they may bring them unto the  Lord  , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , unto the priest , and offer them for peace offerings unto the  Lord .
The mountains skipped like rams , and the little hills like lambs .
translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki ryngkoh kum ki blang ; ki lumrit , ki kynthih kum ki khunlangbrot .

Ka duwan rnong kaban la thret da u Besalel , u khun jong u Ur bad u ksew jong u Hur , ka don ruh ha Gibeon ha khmat Jong ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai . U syiem Solomon Bad ki briew baroh ki la Mano ïa U Trai hangtei .
translation.en: Moreover the brasen altar , that Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , had made , he put before the tabernacle of the  Lord  : and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it .
Then I said unto you , Dread not , neither be afraid of them .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ong , ‘ Wat tieng ïa kita ki briew .

U Gaal u ong , Ki rangbah kiba kumno ngi long ha Shekhem ? Balei ba ngi Sikhri ïa u Abimelekh ? U dei eiei uta ? U khun jong u Gibeon ! Bad u Segub u la ïoh hukum na u , hynrei balei ngi dat ban shakri ïa u ? To ïaineh ha u Hamor , u khop tymmen jongu Phin , uba la seng ïa ka kur jong phi !
translation.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed said , Who is Abimelech , and who is Shechem , that we should serve him ? is not he the son of Jerubbaal ? and Zebul his officer ? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem : for why should we serve him ?

translation.kha: Nga la thiah ba kine ki long kijuh ki jingthaw ba-im ba nga la ïohi kiba shong hapoh U blei ki Israel harud ka wah Khebar .
translation.en: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar  ; and I knew that they were the cherubims .

translation.kha: wah sheptieng — nga un-long ryngkat bad me ! Nga long U Blei jong me — wat ai ba kano kano lai pynsheptieng ïa me ! Ngan pynlong ïa me uba khlaiñ malade tun ïarap ïa me ; ngan ïada ïa me bad lang! pynim ïa me .
translation.en: Fear thou not  ; for I am with thee : be not dismayed  ; for I am thy God : I will strengthen thee  ; yea , I will help thee  ; yea , I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness .
Tell others about Jehovah and his ways . —Isaiah 43 :10 .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha kiwei shaphang U Jehobah bad ki lynti jong u .—Isaiah 43 :10 .
U ong , Ki nongshun jong ngi ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa ngi , bad ki la wanlam mih shalor na kata ka nongbah ban ïaleh ïa ine ha madan , hynrei sem beh krad biang ïa ki sha ka khyrdop shnong .
translation.en: And the messenger said unto David , Surely the men prevailed against us , and came out unto us into the field , and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate .

Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and forgive , and do , and give to every man according to his ways , whose heart thou knowest  ; ( for thou , even thou only , knowest the hearts of all the children of men  ; )
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki na ka ïing jong me ha bneng , map ïa ki , bad ïarap ïa ki . Tang ma me hi uba tip ïa ki jingmut jong ka dohnud briew .

Namar U Mynsiem uba U Blei u la ai ïa phi um pynlong ïa phi ki mraw bad pynlong ïa phi ban sheptieng ; pynpdang U Mynhyndai u pynjrong ïa phi ki khwan lad U Blei , bad da ka bor U Mynsiem ngi pyrta sha U Blei jong ine , Ko Kpa ! Ko Kpa jyllang nga !
translation.en: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear ; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption , whereby we cry , Abba , Father .

translation.kha: U Trai u nguh , Ka jer ka wan ibha ki briew kin ym smai shuh da por kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that it shall no more be said , The  Lord  liveth , that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt  ;
And as they went on their way , they came unto a certain water : and the eunuch said , See , here is water  ; what doth hinder me to be baptized ?
translation.kha: Katba ki nang ïaleit ha lynti , ki la poi ha ka jaka ha kaba la don khyndiat ka um , bad uta u rangbah synshar u la ong ,  Hangne ka don ka um . Kaei kaba khang ïa nga na kaba shah pynbaptis ?

translation.en: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew : and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus .
translation.kha: U Philip u la leit bad u la ïathuh ha u Andriw , bad baroh ar ngut ki la leit bad ïathuh ïa U Jisu .

Hynrei ïa ka doh jong uta u masi lyngraw , ïa ka sniew jong u , bad ïa ki nierlang jong u , dien ban thang ïa ki shabar ka jaka shongneh dara . Kane ka long ka jingainguh baneh sait ïa ki pop Jong ki lyngkdong .
translation.en: But the flesh of the bullock , and his skin , and his dung , shalt thou burn with fire without the camp : it is a sin offering .
And when ye reap the harvest of your land , thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field , neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest .
translation.kha: Haba phi lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi , wat ot ïa u kew uba don ha ki tduh jong ki lyngkha , bad wat leit ban ot ruh ïa u sohkew uba sah hadien ba phi la lum .
Phi la ong ïa kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei shaphang jong nga , ong U Trai . hynriew Phi kylli , ‘ Kaei ba Ngi la ïai-ong shaphang jong me ?’
translation.en: Your words have been stout against me , saith the  Lord . Yet ye say , What have we spoken so much against thee ?
Then said they unto him , What shall we do , that we might work the works of God ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki la kylli ïa u ,  Kaei ngi lah ban leh khnang ban ïoh leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa ngi ban leh ?

Bad halor kata ka diengphna , U Kherith u la pyllaitluid ïa lade na ka ni jong ki nongsynshar ba kyntang mynsiem bad na ki bor synshar ; u la pynlong ka jingthadrong ïa ki da kaba ïalam ïa ki kum ki mraw ha ka jingïaid paidbah kaba ngop jngai u .
translation.en: And having spoiled principalities and powers , he made a shew of them openly , triumphing over them in it .

translation.kha: Kato ka long kaba dei ïa me ban lehbeiñ katne katne ? Ban ñiewbeiñ ïa uta uba me hi me la thaw ? Bad nangne ban phuh shyrkhei ha ki jingthmu ki riewbymman ?
translation.en: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress , that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands , and shine upon the counsel of the wicked ?

translation.kha: Hynrei mynba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la hiarthma ïa ka ri , ngi la rai pun Wan sha Jerusha ngab lait na ki kynhun shipai ka Babilonia bad ka Simri . Dei na ken ka daw balei ba ngi ïashong ïasah ha Jerushah .
translation.en: But it came to pass , when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land , that we said , Come , and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans , and for fear of the army of the Syrians : so we dwell at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Nangta u Soitan u mihnoh na iitkhmat U Trai bad u pynsaja da ki tohjaw ha baroh shi rynïeng ka met! jong u Hobah .
translation.en: So went Satan forth from the presence of the  Lord  , and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown .

translation.kha: Ko Pa ! To ai ka burom ïa nga ha khmat jongnga me mynta , kajuh ka burom kaba to la don lema bad me ha shuwa don pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And now , O Father , glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was .

translation.kha: Phi bhabriew bha .
translation.en: You are so beautiful .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki hynñiew jrut ki gospel uba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang kiba dap da ki hynñiew tyllai ki khlam kiba khatduh u la wan shaei nga bad u la ong , To wang , bad ngan pynjam ha me ïa ka Nongleitkurim , ka tnga jong U Kibroth .
translation.en: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues , and talked with me , saying , Come hither , I will shew thee the bride , the Lamb s wife .

translation.kha: Hynrei hir u Pharaoh u ïohi ba nia ki jakoid ki la ïap , u la kylla mutlop biang , bad kamra U Trai u la lah ïai-ong , u Pharaoh um shym la shahshkor ïa u Moses malade u Aaron .
translation.en: But when Pharaoh saw that there was respite , he hardened his heart , and hearkened not unto them  ; as the  Lord  had said .

translation.kha: Lada me ieh ha lade , yn ym don uba sheptieng ïa U Blei ; yn ym khong u ban duwai ha u .
translation.en: Yea , thou castest off fear , and restrainest prayer before God .

translation.kha: Hangta la don u briew uba la pang haduh laiphew phra snem .
translation.en: And a certain man was there , which had an infirmity thirty and eight years .
Out of his nostrils goeth smoke , as out of a seething pot or caldron .
translation.kha: Ka tdem ka wan mih na ki thliew khmut jong u , kum ka tdem ki ñiut kiba la thang sha trai jong u khiew .
‘ Wat sakhrai lamler ïano ïaineh .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour .

translation.kha: Ma nga , shisien ang la im khlem ka hukum ; hynrei haba ka hukum ka la Wan , ka pop ka khie im , bad la la ïap .
translation.en: For I was alive without the law once : but when the commandment came , sin revived , and I died .
Then I contended with the nobles of Judah , and said unto them , What evil thing is this that ye do , and profane the sabbath day ?
translation.kha: Nga la sneng ïa ki nongïalam Jiw bad ong ,  Peit ïa kaba sniew kaba phi leh ! Phi pyntngit ïa ka sngi Sabbaton .
Haba ki synrai jong u Ïoannis ki la ïohsngew shaphang kan , ki la wan bad shimet napoh ïa ka met jong u bad tep noh ïa ka .
translation.en: And when his disciples heard of it , they came and took up his corpse , and laid it in a tomb .

Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia , that the word of the  Lord  spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished , the  Lord  stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia , that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom , and put it also in writing , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong ba u Syros ka ri Persia u long u patsha . U  Trai  u pynlong ïa kaei kaba u la ong lyngba u nongïathuhlypa Jeremaïah ban urlong shisha . U pynsngew ha u Syros ban pynmih ïa ka hukum harum bad ban phah ha ka jingthoh ïa ka ban pule jam ha kylleng ka hima jong u :
Ha shwa ban poi ki snem ka nemsniew , u Jehoash u la ïoh ar ngut ki khuid shynrang na ka Asenath .
translation.en: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came , which Asenath the daughter of Poti–phera priest of On bare unto him .
Who have received the law by the disposition of angels , and have not kept it .
translation.kha: Phi long kita kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka hukum jong U Blei , kata kaba la wan ai da ki angel — pynban phim shym la kohnguh ïa ka !
Ma u , kum kiba ha shuwa jong u , u leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai . U bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u syiem Jeremaïah u khun jong u Nadab , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , as his fathers had done : he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
And he was there with the  Lord  forty days and forty nights  ; he did neither eat bread , nor drink water . And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant , the ten commandments .
translation.kha: U Moses u la sah hangta bad U  Trai  sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , khlem bam khlem dih . U thoh ruh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa ki ktien jong kata ka jutang — ki Shiphew Hukum keiñ .
Ha ka sngi ba ïa ki jaka ba la kerkut jong ki nongsuhjaiñ lad phi la kurup dara ba ïa ki brisoh jong ki la pynïap , ki wahduid kin tuid na baher ki liewlep malu ki lumrit .
translation.en: And there shall be upon every high mountain , and upon every high hill , rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter , when the towers fall .
For Zion s sake will I not hold my peace , and for Jerusalem s sake I will not rest , until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness , and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth .
translation.kha: Ngan kren jam ban pynshlur ïa ka Jerusalem ; ngan ym sngap jar haduh ba yn pynim ïa ka , bad ka jingjop jong ka kan tyngshaiñ kum ka jingshai ha ka por mynmiet .
Nga un-long u paralok jong kito baroh’ Ibbah shakri ïa me , jyllang baroh kaba khlong ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translation.en: I am a companion of all them that fear thee , and of them that keep thy precepts .
Therefore if any man be in Christ , he is a new creature : old things are passed away ; behold , all things are become new .
translation.kha: Kumta Uno uno ïa uba la pynïasoh ha U Khrist u long u jingthaw uba thymmai ; kaba rim ka la leit noh , kaba thymmai ka la wan .
ki kjat jong u ki phyrnai kum ka rnong ba la phrang bad ba la pynphyrnai , bad ka sur jong u ka sawa kum ka kshaid bakyrhuh .
translation.en: And his feet like unto fine brass , as if they burned in a furnace  ; and his voice as the sound of many waters .
And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons , he gathered up his feet into the bed , and yielded up the ghost , and was gathered unto his people .
translation.kha: Ynda u Jakob u la dep sneng ïa la ki khun , u thiah noh , bad u la ïap .

Kane ka long kaei ka U Trai nongbishar u ong : Ha ka sneng ba u diengïap u longing hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ngan pynlong ïa ki um shapoh khynraw ban tap-lup ïa u kumin ka dak ka jingïambriew . Ngan set nong ïa ki wah bad Ngan ym shah ïa ki wahduid ban tuid baher . Namar ba u dieng u la ïap , ngan wallam ka jingdum hajir ki lumbah ka Lehsbun nabar lang! pynlong ïa baroh ki dieng ha khlaw ba kin ïapstai .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning : I covered the deep for him , and I restrained the floods thereof , and the great waters were stayed : and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him , and all the trees of the field fainted for him .

translation.kha: Ngan pynsum ïa ka Moab , bad kin ïoh tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And I will execute judgments upon Moab  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nga la sngewthait ban im . To sngew ïa ki jingud kthang jong nga .
translation.en: My soul is weary of my life  ; I will leave my complaint upon myself  ; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul .
And when they had mocked him , they took off the purple from him , and put his own clothes on him , and led him out to crucify him .
translation.kha: Haba ki la dep na kaba rkhiebeiñ ïa u , ki la law noh ïa ka jaiñkup basawbthuh bad ki la pynkup pat halor jong u da ki jaiñ jong u hi . Nangta ki ïalam noh ïa u ban sahnarphna .

Ha baroh kawei ka ri jong ka Hima bashatei u pynpra ïa ki duwan bad ki durblei jong ka Asherah , u pynlwet ïa ki bleithaw) kum ki pui kjit , bad pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa baroh ki duwan jingiwbih . Nangta u ithuh phai sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves , and had beaten the graven images into powder , and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel , he returned to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Hynrei bun kiba la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ki la bieit ; malu ka jingbun ki briew ka la roi sha kumba san hajuh ngut .
translation.en: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed  ; and the number of the men was about five thousand .

translation.kha: Nangno U thri u ïong ha nga , ‘ Khie otsher hiar kloi na ine u lum , namar kita ki briew jrong me ïa kiba me la ïalam na Ijipt , ki la ngut sniew bad ki la leh bymneh . Ki lah da kynriah noh na kata ka lynti ïa kabu nga la hukum ïa ki , bad ki la thaw pynban ïa ka durblei na ka bynta ïa lade .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , get thee down quickly from hence  ; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves  ; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them  ; they have made them a molten image .

translation.kha: Naba ki jingkwah barli jong u ki pun haduh jong u bad ka jingmih ka long ban leh ïa ka pop ; bad ka pop , haba ka la ih bha , ka pynmih ïa ka jingïap .
translation.en: Then when lust hath conceived , it bringeth forth sin : and sin , when it is finished , bringeth forth death .

translation.kha: Ngam la ïohsngew ïa u sangeh uba dei khmih ïa ki um ba u Ong , Ki jingbishar bakha me la pynlong ki long kiba hok , A Ibbah Khuid , me babha long bad uba la long !
translation.en: And I heard the angel of the waters say , Thou art righteous , O Lord , which art , and wast , and shalt be , because thou hast judged thus .

translation.kha: Na u Paul , ïa naba la khot ban long u apostol U Khrist Jisu da ka mon U blem , bad na u Sosthenes u parabangeit jong im —
translation.en: Paul , called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God , and Sosthenes our brother ,

translation.kha: Ai ïa ki lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh barben kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kabu nyngkong .
translation.en: And one goat for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , his meat offering , and his drink offering .

translation.kha: Ki neh slem ha ki por baroh ; la ai ïa ki ha ka jingshisha bad ha ka hok .
translation.en: They stand fast for ever and ever , and are done in truth and uprightness .
And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim , and the ears of them that hear shall hearken .
translation.kha: Ki khmat bad ki shkor jong ki kin ïohi bad kin ïohsngew ïa ki jingdonkam jong ki briew .

Phi dei ban ïasngewskhem ba yn ym don uno uno uba awria , kaba long jakhlia , rue uba kajuh lalot (Khlem ka jingkyiuh lalot ka long hi ka rukom mane bleithaw) u ban ïoh bynta ha ka Hima jong U Khristan bad jong U Blei .
translation.en: For this ye know , that no whoremonger , nor unclean person , nor covetous man , who is an idolater , hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U Trai u la wan ha u , bad u kylla long u nongaikam jong ki Israel . U Othniel u leit sha ka thma , bad U Trai u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor u syiem ka Mesopotamia .
translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon him , and he judged Israel , and went out to war : and the  Lord  delivered Chushan–rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand  ; and his hand prevailed against Chushan–rishathaim .
they will come
translation.kha: Kin Sa Wan

Kumta u Jehoram u leit sha Sair bad ki kali ïabam jong u baroh , ha kaba ka kynhun shipai Edom ka la kerkut ïa ki . Ha ka prie mynmiet ma u bad ki rangbah ai hukum jongngi ki kha ïapom ki la ïakhlad ban lait bad ki kjit ïap , bad ki shipai jong u ki phet sakma sha ki ïing jong ki .
translation.en: So Joram went over to Zair , and all the chariots with him : and he rose by night , and smote the Edomites which compassed him about , and the captains of the chariots : and the people fled into their tents .

translation.kha: Naba ïa ka Hukum u Massah la pule la slem bah ha ki synagog man la ka sngi Sabbaton , bad ïa ki ktien jong u la ïalap ha man ki shnong .
translation.en: For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him , being read in the synagogues every sabbath day .

translation.kha: Nga la kren ha ki nonghiarpateng bad ai ha ki shibun ki jingïohipaw , pynlang lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa nga ai jingmaham ïa ki biria jong nga .
translation.en: I have also spoken by the prophets , and I have multiplied visions , and used similitudes , by the ministry of the prophets .

translation.kha: A Trai , me la pynkhia ïa nga . Ngim tem ki duitara bad ria ka jingïaroh ïa me , ngin rwai ïaroh ha ka Thep jong me Kaba ngi ding im .
translation.en: The  Lord  was ready to save me : therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the  Lord .

Also I spake to the priests and to all this people , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Hearken not to the words of your prophets that prophesy unto you , saying , Behold , the vessels of the  Lord s  house shall now shortly be brought again from Babylon : for they prophesy a lie unto you .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ong ïa ki lyngdoh bad ïa ki paidbah ba U  Trai  u la lah ong :  Wat shahshkor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ong ba ïa ki jingkynshew ka Templ yn sa wanrah pat shen shen na Babilonia . Ki shukor ïa phi .

translation.en: Son of man , behold , they of the house of Israel say , The vision that he seeth is for many days to come , and he prophesieth of the times that are far off .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , ki Israel ki pyrkhat ba ki jingïohipaw bad ki jingïathuhlypa jong me ki dei shaphang ka lawei kaba dang slem .
Hadien ka jingïap jngai u Abarim , U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa u ISAIAH u khun jongu u , uba sah hajan Ka Pukri jong Uta Uba Im Uba Ïohi Ïa Nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass after the death of Abraham , that God blessed his son Isaac  ; and Isaac dwelt by the well Lahai–roi .

translation.kha: U Joseph u pyndap pynbiang jingbam ïa la u kpa , ïa la ki hynmen ki para , bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing u kpa jong u baroh katba ki ïadon , haduh kiba khynnah tam .
translation.en: And Joseph nourished his father , and his brethren , and all his father s household , with bread , according to their families .
For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty , and shalt lift up thy face unto God .
translation.kha: Te phin shaniah ha U Blei borabor bad shem ba u long ka thymmei jong ka jingkmen jong phi .
Khmih shai per ! ka pyrta sha uwei pa wai uba ïaid lynti najan . Ym don mano mano ba ni ka Jingpang kum ka jong nga , ka Jingpang kaba U Trai u la ïam halor jong por ha ka por ka jingat jong u .
translation.en: They say to their mothers , Where is corn and wine ? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city , when their soul was poured out into their mothers  bosom .
The apostle Paul told one of the congregations in his day : “I am longing to see you , . . . that we may have an interchange of encouragement by one another’s faith , both yours and mine .”
translation.kha: U apostol Paul u la ong ha kawei na ki balang : “Nga kwah hir hir ban iohi ia phi , . . . ba ha phi yn pyniasngew tngen lem ia nga bad phi , da la ka jingngeit jingngeit . . . ka jong phi ruh bad ka jong nga de .”
U Shim u la sngewlehrain ïa u , kumta u la map ïa ka remdor jong u nabar u la pyllait noh ïa u .
translation.en: Then the lord of that servant was moved with compassion , and loosed him , and forgave him the debt .

translation.kha: Don na ki briew jong phi kiba ïathuh lamler shaphang kiwei khnang don oh pynïap ïa ki . Don na ki , kiba bam ïa ki jingkñia ba la ai ha ki bleithaw . Don kiba sngewhun borabor ha la ki jingkwah brai .
translation.en: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood : and in thee they eat upon the mountains : in the midst of thee they commit lewdness .

translation.kha: Bad ngan ym bam ne dih ei ei bad phi hangne , namar U Trai u la hukum ïa at ban ym bam ne dih ei ei , bad ban ym leit phai sha ïohnang na kajuh ka lynti .
translation.en: For it was said to me by the word of the  Lord  , Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there , nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest .

translation.kha: Haba katai ka jia , u thret uba la pynskhem un sa kylluid bad haw . badno kata kan long ka jingkut jongno kiei kiei barben kiba la sdie ha u . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed , and be cut down , and fall  ; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïalaw shai ki Pharisi ïa uta u Briew uba la ju long uba matlah .
translation.en: They brought to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind .

translation.kha: Ka jingshahjop jong ka Moab ka la jan ; ka jingjynjar jong ka , ka la jan .
translation.en: The calamity of Moab is near to come , and his affliction hasteth fast .
Verily I say unto you , All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men , and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme :
translation.kha: Nga ong skhem ïa phi ba ïa ki briew lah ban map ïa ki pop jong ki baroh , bad ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba ki lah ban ong .
Ki nongshong kulai kin tur lyngba ki lynti bah jong pha , da kaba pynkup ïa ki briew da ki waitlam jong ki . Ki rishot bakhraw jong pha kmen khep ha khyndew .
translation.en: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets : he shall slay thy people by the sword , and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground .

And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits : The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth  ; even the bottom shall be a cubit , and the breadth a cubit , and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span : and this shall be the higher place of the altar .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingthew jingwoh jong ka duwan , kiba long ha kajuh ka rukom kumba thew ïa ka Templ . Ha baroh sawdong ka trai jong ka duwan ka don ka nur kaba sanphew sentimitar ka jingjylliew bad sanphew sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad ka rmiang ha ka tduh kaba shabar kaba long arphew san sentimitar ka jingjrong .
Haba u briew uba hok u keiñ noh na kaba leh ïa kaba bha bad u sdang ba-bang leh ïa kob sniew , un ïap na ka bynta kata .
translation.en: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , he shall even die thereby .

translation.kha: Ki la sniew kthang , ki ïambriew , bad ki la shahjingit hapoh janmiet na ka bynta u Saul bad u Jonathan bad na ka pynbha ki Israel , ki briew’ jong U Tlai , namar bun bah ki la shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translation.en: And they mourned , and wept , and fasted until even , for Saul , and for Jonathan his son , and for the people of the  Lord  , and for the house of Israel  ; because they were fallen by the sword .

translation.kha: U Simon ( ïa uba u la ai kyrteng , u Petros ) bad u Andriw u para jong u , u Jakob bad u —Ïoannis , u phin Bad u Bartholomai ,
translation.en: Simon , ( whom he also named Peter , ) and Andrew his brother , James and John , Philip and Bartholomew ,

translation.kha: Nga la phah ïa ka lyer khluit ban pyntyrkhong ïa ki jingthrang jongki phi . Ki puit ki la bameh heh ïa baroh ki kper malade bri sohwaiñ jong phi , ki dieng Dumbur pynlang ki dieng Olib jong Phin . Katta shwa phim shym la wan phai pat Sha nga .
translation.en: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew : when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased , the palmerworm devoured them : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka Synreit ka Jutang U Blei ka don Hangta ha Bethel ha kito ki sngi , bad u Pynshad , u khun jong u Eleasar bad u khun ksiew jongki u Aaron , u khmih ïa ka , ki bhabriew ki kylli ïa U Trai , Hato ngin ithuh ïaleh pyrshah biang ïa ki Benjamin , ki para joit jong ngi , ne ngin kheiñ noh ? U Trai u jubab , Ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki . Lashai ka sngi ngan ai ïa ka jingjop ha pa .
translation.en: And Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron , stood before it in those days , ) saying , Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother , or shall I cease ? And the  Lord  said , Go up  ; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand .
And now , behold , I go unto my people : come therefore , and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days .
translation.kha: U Balaam u ong ha u Balak ,  Mynta ngan leit phai pat sha la ki briew , hynrei shuwa ba ngan mih , nga maham lypa ïa phi aïu ki Israel kin leh ïa ki briew jong phi hadien habud .

U Bela uba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap ïa U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi , uba long u nongbanbor umbah khraw jong ki langbrot da kata ka jingïap ha katba la kñia ïa u , da kaba la pynkmen ïa ka jutang bymjukut . To ai ba U Blei ka jingsuk un pyndap ïa phi da kawei kaei kaba beh baroh’ kaba phoi donkam khnang shun leh ïa ka mon jongno u , bad ai ba ma u , da U Jisu Khrist , un ai ha ngi ïa kaei kamai kaba pynsngewbha ïa u . Bad ha U khriat to long ka burom junom la junom , Anam .
translation.en: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will , working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight , through Jesus Christ  ; to whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .

translation.kha: Nangta u la shim shi lyngkhot u kpu , bad U la jingeh ha U Blei , U la kdiah ïa u , bad U la ai ïa u ha ki , da kaba ong , Une u long ka saw jong nga , ïa kaba la ai na ka bynta jong pa . To kuna ïa kane ban kynroh ïa nga .
translation.en: And he took bread , and gave thanks , and brake it , and gave unto them , saying ,  This is my body which is given for you : this do in remembrance of me .
And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam , even to cut it off , and to destroy it from off the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Kane ka pop kaba u la leh ka wanrah ïa ka jingpynjot bad jingduh jingdam noh ka longïing syiem jong u .
“Wat ka kynhied shipai kaba khlaiñ tam jongngi u syiem ka Ijipt kada lah ban ïarap ïa u ban ïaleh haba ki nongri Ijipt ki tei ki jingtei khihwin bad tih ki khuri khnang ban pynïap bun ngut ki briew .
translation.en: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company make for him in the war , by casting up mounts , and building forts , to cut off many persons :
Know now that God hath overthrown me , and hath compassed me with his net .
translation.kha: Hato phim lah ban ïohi ba dei U Blei uba la leh ïa kane ? U la buh ïa ka jingriam ban kem ïa nga .
Ki lah don thah ka jingsynshar u Khedorlaomer haduh khat-ar sngi , hynrei ha ka snem Kaba khatlai ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer , and in the thirteenth year they rebelled .

translation.kha: Te mynta , ko ki Kynhun jong nga , shahshkor ïa ang nabar wat klet ïa ki ktien jyllang nga .
translation.en: Hear me now therefore , O ye children , and depart not from the words of my mouth .

translation.kha: A , phi ki briew kiba bieit ! Slem katno keiñ phi ïangat kwah ban sah bieit ? Sa katno keiñ phin tang kmen ha kaba krenbeiñ ïa ka jingtip ? Katto phim kwah ban ïoh jingsuki ?
translation.en: How long , ye simple ones , will ye love simplicity ? and the scorners delight in their scorning , and fools hate knowledge ?

translation.kha: Ka la ong ha ailad , Lada nga tyngka shi ïohphet ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , ngan sa koit .
translation.en: For she said within herself , If I may but touch his garment , I shall be whole .
Then Job answered the  Lord  , and said ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Job u jubab ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Being then made free from sin , ye became the servants of righteousness .
translation.kha: La pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka pop bad phi la long pat ki mraw jong ka hok .

Kiba kum kita ki brai ki hikai ba ka long ka bym dei ba-bang sngewjahburom bad ïa-ban bam kyndiah ïa ki katto katne ki jait jingbam . Hynrei U blei u la thawsha ïa kito ki jingbam ban bam , hynne ka jingduwai sngewnguh , da kito Ibbah long kiba ngeit bad kiba la tip) ïa ka jingshisha .
translation.en: Forbidding to marry , and commanding to abstain from meats , which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth .

translation.kha: Bad hadien kata ki la ino ïa la ka jingtieng ! Ka long ka bih Lah long ban ïalam pat ïa ki ban kylla-kaba-mut biang , namar ki la sahnarphna biang ïa U Khun U Blei bad pynlehrain ïa u ha khmat ka pyrthei .
translation.en: If they shall fall away , to renew them again unto repentance  ; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of God afresh , and put him to an open shame .

translation.kha: bad u pynlong ïa ki , ki paralok jong ki khun syiem shynrang , ki khur syiem shynrang jong ki briew jongno u .
translation.en: That he may set him with princes , even with the princes of his people .

translation.kha: ban shna ïa laiñ ka lyngngoh da ki tyllai snieh bad ki dieng jingkynha bad ban buh ïa ka ha u ryndang jong nga .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  to me  ; Make thee bonds and yokes , and put them upon thy neck ,
For mine enemies speak against me  ; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together ,
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong nga ki kwah ban pynïap ïa nga ; ki ïakren bad sylla pyrshah ïa nga .

translation.en: And the spirit cried , and rent him sore , and came out of him : and he was as one dead  ; insomuch that many said , He is dead .
translation.kha: U mynsiem bymkhuid u la lynñiar , u la pynring kyrthat jur ïa u khynnah , bad u la mihnoh . U khynnah u la i kum uba ïap , bad baroh ki la ïa-ong ,  U la ïap !
Kumta ka Herodias ka buhnud pyrshah ïa u Ïaineh pynlang ka la kwah ban pynïap ei ïa u , hynrei kam shym la lah nongmareh u Herod .
translation.en: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him , and would have killed him  ; but she could not :

translation.kha: hynriew ma nga , U Trai , ngan ïada , bad ngan ym aiti noh ïa me sha ki briew kiba me sheptieng .
translation.en: But I will deliver thee in that day , saith the  Lord  : and thou shalt not be given into the hand of the men of whom thou art afraid .

translation.kha: Da ka borbah bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong u , u la pyllun ïa ngi na Ijipt . U leh ki kambah bad ki jakhlia , bad u la pynjia ïa kiei kiei kiba sngewbitar .
translation.en: And the  Lord  brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand , and with an outstretched arm , and with great terribleness , and with signs , and with wonders :

translation.kha: Ha U Trai ki jingïohipaw kim longsem ei ei , ym don wat tang shi jaw ka um ; ki dewlynnong ba shwa jngai ki sting kum u pui boi .
translation.en: Behold , the nations are as a drop of a bucket , and are counted as the small dust of the balance : behold , he taketh up the isles as a very little thing .

translation.kha: hynrei uno une u mraw ba phi la thied u lah ïa-ban bam ïa ka lada phi otsher shuwa ïa u .
translation.en: But every man s servant that is bought for money , when thou hast circumcised him , then shall he eat thereof .

translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew jong nga namar ki la leh pop ; ki la phai dadien nep na nga , ki la ai jingkñia sha kiwei pat ki Blei , bad ki la shna ïa ki Bealoth bad mane ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness , who have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , and worshipped the works of their own hands .

And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary , and all the vessels of the sanctuary , as the camp is to set forward  ; after that , the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it : but they shall not touch any holy thing , lest they die . These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: ban buh jingthoh ïa ki Lebi katno ngut ki don shi kur shi kur bad shi ïing shi ïing , da kaba thoh kyrteng ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang uba la dap shi bnai ne kham heh ,
?(Nga lama uba nyngkong bad uba khatduh , uba sdang bun uba koit .
translation.en: I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the end , the first and the last .

translation.kha: Da ka ber bakhraw ki apostol ki la hikai ïa ka jingphet jong U Trai Jisu , bad U Blei u la thah ki jingkyrduh ba-dap kyrhai ha ki baroh .
translation.en: And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus : and great grace was upon them all .

translation.kha: U Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shynraiñ , u Meholah bad u Mushi . U Mahli ruh u don ar ngut ki khum shynrang , u Eleasar bad u Kish ,
translation.en: The sons of Merari  ; Mahli , and Mushi . The sons of Mahli  ; Eleazar , and Kish .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ngi tip ba ngi ieit ïa ki khun U blei : Ka un-long da kaba ieit ïa U Blei bad khunlung ïa ki hukum jong u .
translation.en: By this we know that we love the children of God , when we love God , and keep his commandments .
And the glory of the  Lord  went up from the midst of the city , and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city .
translation.kha: Nangta ka jingshai batyngshaiñ ka iehnoh ïa ka nongbah bad ka la leit sha u lumbah ha ka phang mihngi jong ka .
Kumta ka akor babha jong phi ka lah ban khyrdong ïa kawei patar ban Shahshkor ïa ka khubor ba phi ïatih ha ki .—Mathaios 5 :16 ; 1 Petros 3 :1 , 2 , 16 .
translation.en: So your good conduct may draw others to listen to the message you tell them .—Matthew 5 :16  ; 1 Peter 3 :1 , 2 , 16 .

translation.kha: ki syiem kin sher dara hangta lem bad ki kynhun shipai jongu ki . Kin pynrngad ïa la ki ïingjaiñ sawdong ka nongbah , bad uwei uwei un sher dara hangno hangno ba u kwah .
translation.en: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her  ; they shall pitch their tents against her round about  ; they shall feed every one in his place .
And Serug lived thirty years , and begat Nahor :
translation.kha: Haba u Serug u la dap laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Nahor ;

U Tharai u phah ïa ki nonglamktien bad ki nongïathuhlypa shun maham ïa ki Ishmael bad Judah : Iehnoh noh ïa ki lynti kynriang bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , ïa kiba la don ha ka Aiu kaweh nga la ai ïa ki kpa tymmen Jong phi bun kaba nga la aiti pateng ha phi lyngba ki shakri jrong nga bad ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: Yet the  Lord  testified against Israel , and against Judah , by all the prophets , and by all the seers , saying , Turn ye from your evil ways , and keep my commandments and my statutes , according to all the law which I commanded your fathers , and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets .

translation.kha: U Blei u bitar bad tur pyrshah ïa nga ; u leh ïa nga kum ïa u nongshukor basniew tam jong u .
translation.en: He hath also kindled his wrath against me , and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies .

translation.kha: Nangta un shim ïa ka khleiñ jong u baroh bad thang halor ka duwan .
translation.en: And he shall take all his fat from him , and burn it upon the altar .

translation.kha: hynriew khap bha ban ïa kine baroh ar long tun ki bym pat shym la kha , ki bym patan ïohi ïa ka jingbymlehhok kaba trei ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Yea , better is he than both they , which hath not yet been , who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun .
And not many days after the younger son gathered all together , and took his journey into a far country , and there wasted his substance with riotous living .
translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat sngi , u khun ba kham rit u la die ïa ka bynta jong ka jingdon jingem jong u bad u la mihnoh na ïing lem bad ka pisa . U la leit sha ka ri kaba jngai , ha kaba u la pynsyrwa ei ïa ka pisa jong u ha ka jingim ba-thurmur .

te phin shem ka jingkmen kaba wan na kaba shakri ïa nga . Ngan pynlong ïa phi pun ïoh burom ha kylleng ka pyrthei . Bad phin lehniam ha ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha u kpa Thummim jong Phin , u Jakob . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the  Lord   ; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth , and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father : for the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken it .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pop jngai ka Seïon ki khynwin da ka jingsheptieng . Ki ong , Ka jingbishar U Blei ka long kum ka ding kaba meh junom . Hato uno uno na ngi un mait im na ka ding kaba kumta kata ?
translation.en: The sinners in Zion are afraid  ; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites . Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire ? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings ?

translation.kha: khnam ba ym Dei shuh ma por uba im , hynrei dei U khriat uba im ha nga . Kana ka jingim kaba nga im mynta , nga im da ka jingngeit ha U Khun U Blei , uba la ieit ïa nga bad uba la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynda jong nga .
translation.en: I am crucified with Christ : nevertheless I live ; yet not I , but Christ liveth in me : and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God , who loved me , and gave himself for me .
The crown of pride , the drunkards of Ephraim , shall be trodden under feet :
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsarong jong kito ki nongïalam buaid yn ïuhroit hapoh ki kjat .

Pleng da kumin mo phin thor kylliang ïa U Trai , a , phi ka jingtipbriew kaba bieit bad kaba anna ? Hato um daym u kjap jong phi , umbiah la thaw ïa phi , uba la seng ïa phi kum kawei ka jaitbynriew ?
translation.en: Do ye thus requite the  Lord  , O foolish people and unwise ? is not he thy father that hath bought thee ? hath he not made thee , and established thee ?

He sent Hadoram his son to king David , to enquire of his welfare , and to congratulate him , because he had fought against Hadarezer , and smitten him  ; ( for Hadarezer had war with Tou  ; ) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass .
translation.kha: Kumta u phah ïa u Joram u khun jong u ban leit khublei bad ai burom ïa u na ka bynta ka jingjop jong u ïa u Hadadeser , ïa uba u Toi u la ïaleh thma bunsien . U Joram u wallam ki jingai sngewbha ba la thaw da ka ksiar , ka rupa bad ka rnong .
Mynba phi la mihnoh na ri Ijipt , nga la kular ba ngan long lem bad phin baburom . Nga dang long lem bad phi , kamet wat sheptieng .
translation.en: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt , so my spirit remaineth among you : fear ye not .

translation.kha: Ka thain ïa ki jaiñ siang thiah malu ka phan da ki jaiñ linen bani bad basawbthuh .
translation.en: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry  ; her clothing is silk and purple .

translation.kha: Wat khuslai u Elihu u la ong ha ka . Khie leit malade pynkhreh ïa ka jingbat jong phi . Hynrei sneng shet ïa u kpu uba rit na kawei kaba pha don bad wahbah ïa u sha nga , pynlang nongap sa shet ïa kabu sah na ka pyntwa jong pha bad ïa u khun jongno pha .
translation.en: And Elijah said unto her , Fear not  ; go and do as thou hast said : but make me thereof a little cake first , and bring it unto me , and after make for thee and for thy son .

translation.kha: Katba phi! dang khmih ïa ka , u maw uba khraw u la lait na ka synrang khlem ba-don mano mano ba ktah ïa u , u la shoh ïa ka kjat nar bad dewbyrtha jong ka durbriew , bad u la pynkhynñiuh ïa ki .
translation.en: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands , which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay , and brake them to pieces .

translation.kha: U Samson u ïalam ïa ki Eliel arphew snem katai ki Philistia ki synriah ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And he judged Israel in the days of the Philistines twenty years .

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit Sha u Pharaoh , bad ki la ïong , U Trai , U Blei ki Ishmael , u ong , ‘ Shah ïa ki Briew jong nga banbeiñ leit , khnang ba kan ïoh pynlong ïa ka jingïakhaïi Mem ha ka ri shyiap ban pyndonburom ïa nga .’
translation.en: And afterward Moses and Aaron went in , and told Pharaoh , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Let my people go , that they may hold a feast unto me in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la long u Andriw , uba shi para bad u Simon Petros .
translation.en: One of the two which heard John speak , and followed him , was Andrew , Simon Peter s brother .
He removeth away the speech of the trusty , and taketh away the understanding of the aged .
translation.kha: U pynsngap jar ïa kito ki lah ban shaniah , bad u shim noh ïa ka jingstad jong ki riewtymmen .

translation.en: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers , the Chaldeans , and the soothsayers . And the king spake , and said to the wise men of Babylon , Whosoever shall read this writing , and shew me the interpretation thereof , shall be clothed with scarlet , and have a chain of gold about his neck , and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom .
translation.kha: U la pyrta ïano ïano ban wallam shapoh ïa ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , bad ki nongpeit kti . Haba ki la ïawan shapoh , u syiem u la ong ha ki ,  Ïa uno uno uba lah ban pule ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingmut jong ka yn pynphong ha ki jaiñkup syiem kiba sawbthuh , un deng u kynjri ksiar ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jong u , bad un long uba lai ha ka bor hapoh ka hima .

lada u nongïathuhlypa u kren ha ka Kyrteng U Trai bad kata kaba u kren kam shitrhem urlong , kata kam dei ka khubor U Trai . Utai u nongïathuhlypa u la kren na lade” hi , bad phim dat ban sheptieng ïa u .
translation.en: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the  Lord  , if the thing follow not , nor come to pass , that is the thing which the  Lord  hath not spoken , but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously : thou shalt not be afraid of him .

translation.kha: Nangta ki saw sha khmat . U Mikhael u ïohi ïa katai ba ki kham khlaiñ ban ïa u , kumta u leit phai noh sha la ïing .
translation.en: And the children of Dan went their way : and when Micah saw that they were too strong for him , he turned and went back unto his house .

translation.kha: U Soitan u la ong ïa u , Lada me long U Khun U Blei , hukum ïa une u maw ïa-ban kylla kpu .
translation.en: And the devil said unto him , If thou be the Son of God , command this stone that it be made bread .

translation.kha: Bad u la ong , La pynjop ! Na long uba nongdih bad uba khatduh , naba sdang bad uba kut . Ha Un uno uba sliang ngan ai ïa ka hok ban dih na ka umpohliew jong ka um ka jingim khlem da siewdor ïa ka .
translation.en: And he said unto me , It is done . I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the end . I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely .

translation.kha: Da ki jingkhroh bym don jinglehrain , ki longsem ka jingthohbria ha ki jingkhawai jingïasyllok jong phoi . Ki kitkhia tang na ka bynta ïa lade . Ki long kum ki lyoh ba rah ka slipar , hynrei khlem wanrah slap . Ki longkmie kum ki diengduh ba khlem soh , thew ha ka synrai , ki dieng ba la rabbit naduh ki thab bad kiba la ïap noh .
translation.en: These are spots in your feasts of charity , when they feast with you , feeding themselves without fear : clouds they are without water , carried about of winds  ; trees whose fruit withereth , without fruit , twice dead , plucked up by the roots  ;

translation.kha: Katto katne ki briew ki ïai leh ïa kaba bah , bad jar burom , ka nam bakha , malu ka jingim bymïap shiah ; ïa ki U Blei un ai ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality , eternal life :

translation.kha: Hynriew ïa u bri uba ieit ïa U Blei la ithuh da u .
translation.en: But if any man love God , the same is known of him .
Let your speech be always with grace , seasoned with salt , that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man .
translation.kha: Ka jingkren jong phi ka dei ban long borabor kaba sngewbang bad kaba sngewtynnat , bad phi dei ban tip kumno ban ai ka jubab kaba dei ha uwei uwei baroh .

Ka jingïakut jongnga nga kan hap kumto ki jingjaw slap , bad kan jreiñ ha khyndew kumne ka umjer . Ki keiñ jyllang ar kin hap kum u lap praw ha ki jingthung ba tang lung , kum u slap ñiup ñiup ha u phan ba dang nyngkong .
translation.en: My doctrine shall drop as the rain , my speech shall distil as the dew , as the small rain upon the tender herb , and as the showers upon the grass :

translation.kha: Ki la jop ruh ïa u Og u syiem ka Bashan , uba long uwei na katba khatduh jong ki Rephaim ; u synshar ha Ashtaroth bad ha Eder .
translation.en: And the coast of Og king of Bashan , which was of the remnant of the giants , that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei ,
And Jesus answering said unto him ,  It is said , Thou shalt not tempt the Lord thy God .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Wat tynjuh ïa U Trai U Blei jong me .’

Hynñiew uta u briew u jubab , Wat la pa’ ai ïa nga shihajar tylli ki sbai rupa , ngan ym rah iwei i shynriah ti pyrshah ïa u khun jong u syiem . Baroh ngi la sngewkyiuh ba u syiem u hukum ïa phi , ïa u Abishua bad ïa u Ittai , ‘ Na ka bynta jong nga wat pynmynsaw ïa u samla Amraphel .’
translation.en: And the man said unto Joab , Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in mine hand , yet would I not put forth mine hand against the king s son : for in our hearing the king charged thee and Abishai and Ittai , saying , Beware that none touch the young man Absalom .

translation.kha: Kumta mynta , ma nga , U Trai , nga maham ïa ki ba ngan Wanlam ka jingpynjot halor jong ki , bad kin ym lah ban loit . Bad haba ki kyr-ang sha nga ba-bang ïoh jingïarap , ngan ym shah ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will bring evil upon them , which they shall not be able to escape  ; and though they shall cry unto me , I will not hearken unto them .

translation.kha: Nangta shim ïa uwei na ki riewdonburom naba don ka kyrdan ba-halor eh ban pynriam ïa uta u biria da kine ki jingriam bad un ïalam ïa u , ba la pynshong halor u kyllaiñ lyndang ka jaka Baïap jrong ka nongbah . Ai ba ithuh u riewdonburom un pyrta katba ki at ïaid : ‘ Peit kumno u syiem un ainong ïa u bariew suba u kwah ban pyndonburom !’
translation.en: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king s most noble princes , that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour , and bring him on horseback through the street of the city , and proclaim before him , Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour .

Come now therefore , I pray thee , curse me this people  ; for they are too mighty for me : peradventure I shall prevail , that we may smite them , and that I may drive them out of the land : for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed , and he whom thou cursest is cursed .
translation.kha: Ki kham bun paid ban ïa ngi ; kumta sngewbha wan bad tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong nga . Ïoh lehse ngin lah ban jop ïa ki bad beh noh ïa ki na kane ka ri . Nga tip ba haba phi pynbna ka jingkyrkhu , ki briew ki ïoh ka jingkyrkhu , bad haba phi pynbna ka jingtim , la buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingtim .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel , which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them ?
translation.kha: Dei ma me uta uba nga kren la slem bah , haba nga pynbna lyngba ki shakri jong nga , ki nongïathuhlypa ka Israel , ba ha ki sngi ki ban wan ngan sa wallam ïa uno uno ban tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
Kumne kane ka lah ban long ? la kylli u Nikodemos .
translation.en: Nicodemus answered and said unto him , How can these things be ?

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na ngi , u la pdiang ïa ka jingai kyrpang kat kum ka jingthew ïa Kaei kaba U Khrist u la ai .
translation.en: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ .

And I will cleanse them from all their iniquity , whereby they have sinned against me  ; and I will pardon all their iniquities , whereby they have sinned , and whereby they have transgressed against me .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhuid ïa ki na ki pop kiba ki la leh pyrshah ïa nga , bad ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong ki .
U lehhok ïa ki khunswet bad ïa ki riewkynthei ; u ieit ïa ki nongwei kiba don badno ngi , bad u ai bam bad ai kput ai sem ïa ki .
translation.en: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow , and loveth the stranger , in giving him food and raiment .
Do ye imagine to reprove words , and the speeches of one that is desperate , which are as wind ?
translation.kha: Phi tharai ngam shym kren ei ei hynrei tang ka lyer ; te balei phi jubab ïa ki ktien ka jingkutlad jong nga ?

U Trai Nongsynshar u ong , Bad mandriek , ma phi ki Israel baroh , to pynsngewbha ïa lade ! To khie bad to shakri ïa ki bleithaw jong phi ! Hynrei nga maham ïa phi ba hadien kane , phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga bad sangeh ban pynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga da kaba ai ki jingai sngewbha ha ki bleithaw jong phiah .
translation.en: As for you , O house of Israel , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Go ye , serve ye every one his idols , and hereafter also , if ye will not hearken unto me : but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts , and with your idols .
God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew . Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias ? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel , saying ,
translation.kha: U Blei um shym la kyntait ïa la ki jong ki briew , ïa kiba u la jied naduh kaba sdang . Phi tip ïa kaei kaba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ha ka jingïathuh shaphang u Elijah ba u ïasaid bad U Blei pyrshah ïa ki Israel :
Hynrei kane kam shngiam la jia ha uta ïa uba U Blei u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
translation.en: But he , whom God raised again , saw no corruption .

Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering , that is for the people , and bring his blood within the veil , and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock , and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat , and before the mercy seat :
translation.kha: Hadien kata , un pynïap ïa uta u  langsohmoh kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop na ka bynta u paidbah , un rah ïa ka snam jong u sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , bad un synreit ïa ka halor ka jingtap bad ha khmat jong ka Synduk ka Jutang , kumba u la leh da ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw .
haba u Shelah u la dap laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Aben ;
translation.en: And Salah lived thirty years , and begat Eber :
There is none greater in this house than I  ; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee , because thou art his wife : how then can I do this great wickedness , and sin against God ?
translation.kha: Ha kane ka ïing , nga don kajuh ka iktiar kumba u don , bad um shym la tyngkai ei ei shuh na nga lait noh tang ïa phi . Kumno keiñ nga lah ban leh kat ïa kata ka kam runar , bad ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U Blei ?

translation.en: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection : on such the second death hath no power , but they shall be priests of God and of Christ , and shall reign with him a thousand years .
translation.kha: Katno kiba suk bad kiba la ïoh jingkyrkhu shikatdei eh ki long kito kiba la kynthup ha kane ka jingpynmihpat banyngkong ïa kiba ïap . Ka jingïap kaba ar kam donbor halor jong ki ; kin long ki lyngdoh jong U Blei bad jong U Khrist , bad kin synshar bad u shihajar snem .

U Gaïos , uba ai jaka sah ïa nga , uba ha ka ïing jong u ka balang ka ïaseng , u phah ïa phi ki jingai khublei ; u Erastos , u nongsumar ïa ki jingkynshew ha ka nongbah , bad u Kuartos , u nongaplangbrot jong sem , ki phah ïa ki jingkhublei jong ki .
translation.en: Gaius mine host , and of the whole church , saluteth you . Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you , and Quartus a brother .

translation.kha: Bad na ka bniat jong ngi — balei ma me ngin kheiñduh ïa lade man la ka kynta ?
translation.en: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour ?

translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha uta u paidlang , Wat bymsheptieng ; la phi la leh ïa ka kam ba-bymman , waiñ phai noh na U Trai , hynrei shakri ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .
translation.en: And Samuel said unto the people , Fear not : ye have done all this wickedness : yet turn not aside from following the  Lord  , but serve the  Lord  with all your heart  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei me lah mo , A Blei , ban shong shiah ha ka pyrthei ? Wat ka Bteng baroh kam biang pura ban ngiam ïa me , kumta kumno ka lah ban long ba kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei kan heh haduh long ?
translation.en: But will God indeed dwell on the earth ? behold , the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee  ; how much less this house that I have builded ?

And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him , they said , The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha . And they came to meet him , and bowed themselves to the ground before him .
translation.kha: Ki sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa na Jerikho ki la ïohi ïa u bad ki ong ,  Ka bor u Elijah ka don ha u Elisha !  Ki la leit ban ïashem ïa u , ki la nguh ngon ha khmat jong u ,
Nahath u Elisha u peitmat shlip ïa u da ka jingpeit kaba shyrkhei ïa ka khamtam jong u haduh ba u Hasael u la kem pat . Kynsan u Elisha u balung ki ummat brup .
translation.en: And he settled his countenance stedfastly , until he was ashamed : and the man of God wept .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha ngi ,
translation.en: That the  Lord  spake unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Me don borabor katto katne ngut ki nongsakhi pyrshah ïa nga ; ka jingbet jongki me ïa per ka nang jubor nang jur ; me ïakit ki lad thymmai banbeiñ ïateh ïa por .
translation.en: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me , and increasest thine indignation upon me  ; changes and war are against me .

translation.kha: Kaei me pyrkhat ba men ïoh da kaba sien sha Ijipt ban dih um na ka Neiel ? Kaei me pynkoit ba men ïoh da kambah lytar sha Assyria ban dih um na ka Ïuphratis ?
translation.en: And now what hast thou to do in the way of Egypt , to drink the waters of Sihor ? or what hast thou to do in the way of Assyria , to drink the waters of the river ?

translation.kha: Kane ka ïing kaba da katjuh ka ïing tud kylla long kaba sah kynjah , bad katjuh uba ïaid najan jong ka un kynjat thret bad un pang set ; bad kin ïakylli , ‘ Balei mo U Trai u la bor sat kumin ïa khie ka ri bad ïa Kane ka ïing ?’
translation.en: And at this house , which is high , every one that passeth by it shall be astonished , and shall hiss  ; and they shall say , Why hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land , and to this house ?

translation.kha: Wat kwah lalot ïa ki jingbam bang ba u pynheh ; u lah ban pyrshang ban riam ïa pa’ .
translation.en: Be not desirous of his dainties : for they are deceitful meat .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Nga pynthiah ïa phi ba lada phi ngeit bad phim sngew artatien , phin ha banbeiñ leh ïa kaei kabu nga la leh ïa une u diengsoh thurmur . Bad ym tang kane , hynrei phin lah wat ba-bang ong ha une u lum , ‘ Khie joit malu pynnoh ïa lade sha duriaw ,’ dara un ni kumta .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , If ye have faith , and doubt not , ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree , but also if ye shall say unto this mountain , Be thou removed , and be thou cast into the sea  ; it shall be done .

translation.kha: Une u paidbah um tip ïa ka Hukum u Moses , te ki longkmie hapoh ka jingtim jngai U Blei !
translation.en: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed .

Take heed unto yourselves , lest ye forget the covenant of the  Lord  your God , which he made with you , and make you a graven image , or the likeness of any thing , which the  Lord  thy God hath forbidden thee .
translation.kha: Sumar ban ym klet ïa ka jutang ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pynlong bad phi . Kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u ban ym thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ïa kano kano ka durblei ,

Ha kane ka rukom U Trai u la pyllait im ïa u syiem Hesekaïah bad ki briew ka Jerusalem na ka bor u Sennakherib , u pajwa ka Assyria , bad ruh na kiwei ki nongshun jong ki . U ai ba ki briew kmen im ha ka jingsah bad baroh ki ri kiba marjan .
translation.en: Thus the  Lord  saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria , and from the hand of all other , and guided them on every side .

translation.kha: U Paidbah babun u la bud ïa u ; hapdeng Jong ki , la don katto-katne katne ngut ki kyntur kiba la ïam bun ïam sngewsih na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: And there followed him a great company of people , and of women , which also bewailed and lamented him .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam bastad jong ki briew kin ïamareh ïa ka jingstad jong ki bad kiaw pat ki briew babun . hynne shipor katto katne na ki kin Shah pynïap ha ka thma lieng shah thang ïalap , bad Katto katne kin shah lute bad shahïap pynlong koidi .
translation.en: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many : yet they shall fall by the sword , and by flame , by captivity , and by spoil , many days .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka kham jem ïa ka bneng malu ka pyrthei ban jah noh ban ïa kaba iehnoh ïa ka bynta kaba rit tam jong ka Hukum .
translation.en: And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass , than one tittle of the law to fail .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u ong ha u Joshua , Kumba phi ïohi , nga la jan ïap , hynñiew U Balei un don ryngkat malade me , bad un sa ïasam pat ïa me sha ka ri ki kpa thymmei jong me .
translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , Behold , I die : but God shall be with you , and bring you again unto the land of your fathers .

In the second year of Darius the king , in the sixth month , in the first day of the month , came the word of the  Lord  by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , governor of Judah , and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha ka Persia , ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba hynriew , U  Trai  u la kren lyngba u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa . Ka khubor ka la long na ka bynta u lat ka Judah , u Serubbabel u khun jong u Shealtiel , bad na ka bynta u Rangbah Lyngdoh , u Joshua u khun jong u Jehosadak .

translation.en: And Balak said unto Balaam , Come , I pray thee , I will bring thee unto another place  ; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence .
translation.kha: U Balak u ong ,  Ale bad nga , bad ngan ïalam ïa phi sha kawei pat ka jaka . Lehse U Blei un shah ïa phi ban tim ïa ki na ka bynta jong nga nangta .

ha kaba katto katne ki briew ki la wallam sha u ïa u briew uba ïapshiliang , uba thiah ha ka jingïathuh . Haba U Jisu u la ïohi haduh katno ka jingtah ki khong , u la ino ha u briew uba ïapshiliang , To long shlur , ko khun jrong nga ! Ïa ki pop jong me la map .
translation.en: And , behold , they brought to him a man sick of the palsy , lying on a bed : and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy  ;  Son , be of good cheer  ; thy sins be forgiven thee .

translation.kha: Na ka khot jong u ha bneng U Trai u riewkai u rkhie ïa ki jingthmu batlot jong ki .
translation.en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh : the Lord shall have them in derision .
Forty years old was I when Moses the servant of the  Lord  sent me from Kadesh–barnea to espy out the land  ; and I brought him word again as it was in mine heart .
translation.kha: Nga la don sawphew snem ka rta mynba u Moses u shakri U  Trai  u la phah ïa nga na Kadesh Barnea ban syntiat ïa kane ka ri . Nga la wanrah ha u ïa ka khubor bashisha .
Kohnguh ïa U Trai U blem jong phi , te kine ki jingkyrkhu baroh kin wan ha phi .
translation.en: And all these blessings shall come on thee , and overtake thee , if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Ki ïingjaiñ jong ki Eliel ki long kiba itynnat , Kum ki diengkhap Tei kiba ïeng laiñ .
translation.en: How goodly are thy tents , O Jacob , and thy tabernacles , O Israel !

translation.kha: U hukum ïa ka duriaw , bad ka rngad ! U pynlong ïa ki wah ban tyrkhong . Ki pyntha jong ka Bashan ki swai , u lamwir Karmel u kylluid bthuh , bad ki syntiew jong u Lebanon ki jlew .
translation.en: He rebuketh the sea , and maketh it dry , and drieth up all the rivers : Bashan languisheth , and Carmel , and the flower of Lebanon languisheth .

translation.kha: Kum u hynmen jong me ha U Krit na ka bynta kane ka daw ba la lah ban sngew shlur katne , ban hukum ïa me ban leh ïa khie kaba dei shun leh .
translation.en: Wherefore , though I might be much bold in Christ to enjoin thee that which is convenient ,
And she answered them , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Tell ye the man that sent you to me ,
translation.kha: Ki ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaba la jia , bad ka ong ïa ki ban leit phai pat sha u syiem bad ban ai ha u ïa kane harum ka khubor na U  Trai  :

translation.en: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god , whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory : and he shall cause them to rule over many , and shall divide the land for gain .
translation.kha: Ban ïada ïa la ki kut , un pyndonkam ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u blei nongwei . Un ai ka jingpyndonburom kaba khraw ïa kito kiba pdiang ïa u kum u nongsynshar , un buh ïa ki ha ki jaka treikam ba-halor , bad un ai ka jaka ïa ki kum ka bainong .

Phin ym hap ban ïaleh ïa kane ka thma . Shuwa don ha la ki jaka bad ap ; phin ïohi U Tlai u ai jingjop ïa phi . Ko ki briew jong ka Judah bad Israel , wat sangeh ne sheptieng . Men sha ka thmu , bad U Trei un long ryngkat bad phi !
