translation.en: Ye shall not need to fight in this battle : set yourselves , stand ye still , and see the salvation of the  Lord  with you , O Judah and Jerusalem : fear not , nor be dismayed  ; to morrow go out against them : for the  Lord  will be with you .
In those days they shall say no more , The fathers have eaten a sour grape , and the children s teeth are set on edge .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por kan wan , ki briew kin ym ong shuh ,   ‘ Ki kmie ki kpa ki la bam ïa u sohwaiñ bajew , hynrei ki khun ki ïoh ïa ka jingmad kaba jew .’
Nangno ki synran ki la wan sha U Jisu bun ki la kylli ïa u , Balei me pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi haba me kren ha ki paidbah ?
translation.en: And the disciples came , and said unto him , Why speakest thou unto them in parables ?

translation.kha: Kumta da husiar ïa kaei kambah phi ar ! Lada u hynmen u para jong phi u leh thup , to sneng tieng ïa u , nabar lada u kylla-kaba-mut , to map ïa u .
translation.en: Take heed to yourselves : If thy brother trespass against thee , rebuke him  ; and if he repent , forgive him .

translation.kha: Ki nongwei kiba shong hapdeng jongnga pa’ kin nang kham ïohbor katba ma phi pat phan nang duh ïa la ka bor .
translation.en: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high  ; and thou shalt come down very low .
And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos , they found a certain sorcerer , a false prophet , a Jew , whose name was Bar–jesus :
translation.kha: Ki la ïaid sha shiliang ka dewlynnong sha Paphos , ha kaba ki la ïakynduh ïa uwei u nongleh myntor uba kyrteng u Bar Jisu , u Jiw uba la kam ba u long u nongïathuhlypa .
Bad shaphang ka Jesebel , U Trai u ong , ‘ Ki ksew ktang bam ïa ka met jong ka ha ka nongbah Jehiel hi .’
translation.en: And of Jezebel also spake the  Lord  , saying , The dogs shall eat Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel .

translation.kha: U Herod u la ai suda ban wad ïa u , hynrei kim shym la shem ïa u . Kumta u la phah tohkit ïa ki nongbah phira bad u la hukum ban pynïap ïa ki . Hadien kane , u Herod u la iehnoh ïa ka Judia bad u la pynlut katto kat por ha Kaisaria .
translation.en: And when Herod had sought for him , and found him not , he examined the keepers , and commanded that they should be put to death . And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea , and there abode .

translation.kha: A Balei jong de , to pyllut im ïa nga na ki bymman , na ka bor jong kito kiba runar bad kiba sniew .
translation.en: Deliver me , O my God , out of the hand of the wicked , out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man .

translation.kha: barieh ki mrad ha ki khlur jong ka Lebanon ktieh pat biang na ka pyntwa ka jingkñia sha U Blei jongno ngi , bad ki dieng jong ka ki khathynñiew eh ban pynum ïa ka ding .
translation.en: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn , nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering .

translation.kha: Lada pa ki briew na ka jait Reuben bad ka jat Gad phiah kyntait ban bud ïa u myntri , sa shisien un iehnoh ïa kine ki bynriew baroh ha ka ri khlaw , bad phin kitkhlieh ïa ka jingpyntieng thiaw ïa ki .
translation.en: For if ye turn away from after him , he will yet again leave them in the wilderness  ; and ye shall destroy all this people .

translation.kha: Nangta u pynmih bad ïalam neh ïa ki Israel ; ki rah ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , bad baroh ki la long kiba koit kiba khiah bad kiba khlaiñ .
translation.en: He brought them forth also with silver and gold : and there was not one feeble person among their tribes .

translation.kha: Ki la shah tynjuh palat da ki jingjynjar kiba ki la ïaid Lyngba ; hynrei ka jingkmen jong ki ka la long kaba khraw hajuh mawria katta ba ki la long naba sbun shikatdei eh ha ka jingai jong ki , kad la ki long katba duk shisha .
translation.en: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality .

translation.kha: Hib u Nahor u la dap ahor khyndaiphew snem ka rta , u la ioh khun shynrang , u Terah ;
translation.en: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years , and begat Terah :

translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïalumlang ban ïalap ïa u ; ki Briew ki la ïawan na kylleng sawdong . Ki la phriang ïa la ki jar behmrad bad ki la ïohktah ïa u ha ka jingriam jong ki .
translation.en: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces , and spread their net over him : he was taken in their pit .

translation.kha: U phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha kylleng ki bynta jong ka jaka ki Manasseh Ban khot ïa ki ban bujli ïa u . U phiah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ki jait Asher , Shebna , bad ki Naphtali , bad ki ruh ki la wang ban ïasoh malade u .
translation.en: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh  ; who also was gathered after him : and he sent messengers unto Asher , and unto Zebulun , and unto Naphtali  ; and they came up to meet them .

translation.kha: Ngi tip , ko syiem kynrad , haduh katno phi kwah ban kem ïa u ; kumta to wan sha ka ri jong ngi , bad ngin pynthikna ba phi ïohkem ïa u .
translation.en: Now therefore , O king , come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down  ; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king s hand .

translation.kha: Uwei u samla umbiah kyrngah u Ïutikhos u la shong ha ka jingkhangïit , bad katba u Paul u ïalang kren , u Ïutikhos u la shoh samthiah jur , katai haduh ba u la ïohthiah lyngngai bad u la iphuh na ka mala kaba lai shuh madan . Haba ki la rah ïa u , u la ïap .
translation.en: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus , being fallen into a deep sleep : and as Paul was long preaching , he sunk down with sleep , and fell down from the third loft , and was taken up dead .

translation.kha: Kumta nga kurim ban phah shen ïa u shaei phi tang mar shi tip kumno kiei ki kin long na ka bynta jong nga .
translation.en: Him therefore I hope to send presently , so soon as I shall see how it will go with me .

translation.kha: U Trai un pynïap ruh ïa ki briew jngai ka Sudan .
translation.en: Ye Ethiopians also , ye shall be slain by my sword .
And nation was destroyed of nation , and city of city : for God did vex them with all adversity .
translation.kha: Kawei ka jaitbynriew ka banbeiñ ïa kawei pat ka jaitbynriew , bad kawei ka nongbah ka banbeiñ ïa kawei pat ka nongbah , namar U Blei u wanrah ka jingjynjar bad jingshitom ha ki .
Kumba ka pukni ka hikai them ïa la ki khun , Bad ka pyllew la ki thapniang ban kyrshan ïa ki , kumin ruh U Trai u kyrshan ïa ki Israel ba kin ym hap .
translation.en: As an eagle stirreth up her nest , fluttereth over her young , spreadeth abroad her wings , taketh them , beareth them on her wings :

translation.kha: To ïai rkhie , ko ki briew ka Amon bad ka Us ; to kmen kaba phi dang lah . Ka jingpynjot ïa phi ruh ka wan ; ma phi umdih phin ïadih sheng sheng lyngkhuit ha ka jinglehrain .
translation.en: Rejoice and be glad , O daughter of Edom , that dwellest in the land of Uz  ; the cup also shall pass through unto thee : thou shalt be drunken , and shalt make thyself naked .

translation.kha: Te u Eliakim , u Shebna bad u Jehoash ki la tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih bad leit dara ïathuh ha u syiem ïa kawei kaba u rangbah synshar Israhaïah u la nong .
translation.en: Then came Eliakim , the son of Hilkiah , that was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , the son of Asaph , the recorder , to Hezekiah with their clothes rent , and told him the words of Rabshakeh .

translation.kha: Ha ka jinglyngngoh bad jingphyrnai ki la pynthaba , Kine ki briew kiba kren kumne ki long ki nong Galilaïa !
translation.en: And they were all amazed and marvelled , saying one to another , Behold , are not all these which speak Galilaeans ?
As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire  ; so shall it be in the end of this world .
translation.kha: Kumba ïa ki ñiut la lumlang bad la thang ïa ki hapoh ka ding , kumta kajuh hi kan jia ha kaba kut ka Ïa :
hynrei u la khñiang ïa nga ban tei ïa ka , namar nga dei u nongïaleh sma bad nga lah pynmih shibun ka snam .
translation.en: But God said unto me , Thou shalt not build an house for my name , because thou hast been a man of war , and hast shed blood .
And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me , then I will punish you seven times more for your sins .
translation.kha: Lada wat hadien kat kane phim treh satia ban shahshkor ïa nga , ngan pynshitom jur ïa phi sa hynñiew shah .

translation.en: And it shall be , when thou art come in unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance , and possessest it , and dwellest therein  ;
translation.kha: Ynda phi la ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi bad phi la shong la sah hangta ,

translation.en: Then said Ziba unto the king , According to all that my lord the king hath commanded his servant , so shall thy servant do . As for Mephibosheth , said the king , he shall eat at my table , as one of the king s sons .
translation.kha: U Siba u jubab ,  Ngan leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ma phi Syiem Kynrad phi hukum .  Kumta u Mephibosheth u ïabam lang ha ka miej bam jong u syiem , kum uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u syiem .

translation.en: And one of them smote the servant of the high priest , and cut off his right ear .
translation.kha: Bad uwei na ki u la shoh ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad u la ot noh ïa ka shkor kamon jong u .
U Trai u longsyiem Uba dep da ka jingisynei bad uba ba ; U Blei jong ngi u longsyiem uba sngewlem .
translation.en: Gracious is the  Lord  , and righteous  ; yea , our God is merciful .
And it was so from that day forward , that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel unto this day .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la buh ïa kane kum ka aiñ bad la ju bud ha Israel hadien kata .

translation.en: And know ye this day : for I speak not with your children which have not known , and which have not seen the chastisement of the  Lord  your God , his greatness , his mighty hand , and his stretched out arm ,
translation.kha: Kynmaw mynta ïa kaei kaba phi la tip shaphang U  Trai  lyngba ki jingïashem jong phi bad u . Dei ma phi , ym ki khun ki kti jong phi kiba la ïohmad ïa kine ki jingïashem . Phi la ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw jong u , ïa ka bor jong u , bad ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong u , bad ïa ki kambah jong u .

Lada phi sngewbha , ko syiem , pynmih da ka hukum ba dei ban pynïap noh ïa ki . Lada phi leh kum , nga pynthikna ba ngan lah ban buh palat lai lakh sawphew khiar kilo ka mata sha ka jingkynshew ka ïingsyiem na ka bynta ka jingpynïaid kam ha ka Hima .
translation.en: If it please the king , let it be written that they may be destroyed : and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver to the hands of those that have the charge of the business , to bring it into the king s treasuries .

translation.kha: Lada ha tala ka ri ki kylla-kaba-mut da kaba shisha bad kaban sngur myn , bad ki duwai ha me da kaba phai khmih sha kane ka ri kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong im’ , sha kane ka nongbah kaba me la iaid , bad sha khie ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei na ka bynta jong me , to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki .
translation.en: And so return unto thee with all their heart , and with all their soul , in the land of their enemies , which led them away captive , and pray unto thee toward their land , which thou gavest unto their fathers , the city which thou hast chosen , and the house which I have built for thy name :
And I will prepare destroyers against thee , every one with his weapons : and they shall cut down thy choice cedars , and cast them into the fire .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki briew ban pynjot ïa ka . Ki baroh kin wanrah ïa la ki sdie , kin pynngat ïa ki dieng Kedar kiba itynnat bad kin bret ïa ki ha ka ding .
U la set ïa nga ha ka ïingbyndi lad ka jingjynjar bad ka jinglyng-a .
translation.en: He hath builded against me , and compassed me with gall and travail .
And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , to offer it unto the  Lord   ; even that man shall be cut off from among his people .
translation.kha: Uno uno u Israel lane uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong ryngkat hapdeng jong ki , uba kñia ïa ka jingainguh thang lane ïa kano kano ka jingkñia kum ka jingainguh sha U  Trai  hangno hangno lait tang ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong U Blei .

translation.en: But God forbid that I should glory , save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ , by whom the world is crucified unto me , and I unto the world .
translation.kha: Pynban , na ka bynta jong nga , ngan sngewsarong tang shaphang ka diengphna U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ; naba da ka diengphna jong u , ka pyrthei ka la ïap ïa nga , bad nga la ïap ïa ka pyrthei .

Katno kiba suk bad kiba la ïoh jingkyrkhu sahit eh ki long kito kiba la kynthup ha kane ka jingpynmihpat jingainong ïa kiba ïap . Ka jingïap kaba ar kam donbor halor jong ki ; kin long ki lyngdoh jongngi U Blei bad jong U kyrshut , bad kin synlar bad u shihajar snem .
translation.en: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection : on such the second death hath no power , but they shall be priests of God and of Christ , and shall reign with him a thousand years .
And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba , and the Philistines heard of it . And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land , saying , Let the Hebrews hear .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u pynïap ïa u rangbah ai hukum jong ki Philistia ha Geba , bad ki Philistia baroh ki ïohsngew shaphang kata . Nangta u Saul u phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban khot ïa ki Hebru sha ka thma da kaba put ïa ka turoi ha kylleng ka ri .

Hynrei nalor Kata , phi dat ban jied katto katne nguh ki ngab kiba tbit , bad thung ïa ki koum ki nongïalam jong u paidbah : ki nongïalam ïa ki khashor , ïa ki spah , ïa ki sanphew , bad ïa ki phew . Ki dei ban long ki briew kiba sheptieng ïa U Blei , kiba lah ban shaniah , nabar kiba ym lah ban pynbunkam sap .
translation.en: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men , such as fear God , men of truth , hating covetousness  ; and place such over them , to be rulers of thousands , and rulers of hundreds , rulers of fifties , and rulers of tens :
Ye have not eaten bread , neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink : that ye might know that I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Phim shym ïoh kpu ban bam , bad phim shym ïoh waiñ lane kyiad ban dih , hynrei U  Trai  u pyndap ïa ki jingdonkam jong phi khnang ba phin tip ba u long U Blei jong phi .

Lada uno du um kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jongu U Blei jongno me lane ki daiñ jong ka shiah , ïa u dei ban pynshitom mardor : da ka jingïapan lane da ka jingringmraw lane da kaban nongdih ïa ki jingdonkam jingem jong u litar da ka jingset byndi .
translation.en: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God , and the law of the king , let judgment be executed speedily upon him , whether it be unto death , or to banishment , or to confiscation of goods , or to imprisonment .

translation.kha: Nga longsem ka Jingstad , bad nga don ka bor sngewthuh ; nga khong ka jingtip bad ka kun pyrkhat kaba khlaiñ .
translation.en: I wisdom dwell with prudence , and find out knowledge of witty inventions .
Then asked we those elders , and said unto them thus , Who commanded you to build this house , and to make up these walls ?
translation.kha: Nangta , ngi kylli ïa ki nongïalam jong ki ban ïathuh ïa ngi mano ba la ai bor ïa ki ban tei biang ïa ka Templ bad pynbiang ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jong ka .
U phlangïap u ong , Mynmiet ngi tip bapli U Blei um pyllait ïa ngi na kito kiba baïaineh ïa ngi . Ngi kyrmen ïa ka jingshai pun ïaid ryngkat , hynrei ka don thiang ka jingdup ,
translation.en: Therefore is judgment far from us , neither doth justice overtake us : we wait for light , but behold obscurity  ; for brightness , but we walk in darkness .

translation.kha: Nangta de kyrthep ïa u ban lehhok ïa nga da kaba ai ha nga ïa ki shithi sha ki lat ka Probins ïuhroit Kaba Shaphang Sepngi , da Kaba bthah ïa ki pun shah ïa nga shun ïawad lyngba shai Judah .
translation.en: Moreover I said unto the king , If it please the king , let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river , that they may convey me over till I come into Judah  ;

translation.kha: La don khamtam bun ki riewkynthei ha ka ri jong phi ba-bang ïa ki symboh shyiap harud ka Duriaw . Nga la pynïap ïa ki rangsamla jong Phi ha ka rta kaba dang khie babha bad pynurlong ïa ki kmie jong ki ban shahshitom . Nga lynshop kynsan ïa ki da ka jingkhuslai bad ka jingtriem .
translation.en: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas : I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday : I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly , and terrors upon the city .

translation.kha: Sngewbha pdiang ïa kane ka jingïamai sngewbha kaba nga la Wallam ïa phi ; U Blei u la lymbung ïa nga , bad u la ai ïa ang baroh kaba nga donkam . U Jakob u la ïai kyrpad ïa u haduh ba un da pdiang .
translation.en: Take , I pray thee , my blessing that is brought to thee  ; because God hath dealt graciously with me , and because I have enough . And he urged him , and he took it .

translation.kha: La beh noh! ïa u na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew , badno ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong u ka la long kum u mrad . U la shong la sah bad ki kada khlaw , u la bam phlang kum u masi dab bad u la shiah ha ka kajuh bym don jingkah khlem kano kano ka ban ïadat ïa u na ka umjer . Ha kob khadu u la pdiang ba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u synshar ïa Baroh ki hima ki briew bad u lah baneh ai ïa ki ha uno un Uba u jied .
translation.en: And he was driven from the sons of men  ; and his heart was made like the beasts , and his dwelling was with the wild asses : they fed him with grass like oxen , and his body was wet with the dew of heaven  ; till he knew that the most high God ruled in the kingdom of men , and that he appointeth over it whomsoever he will .

translation.kha: Da kaba buiñ ïa ka jingleh ki kpa tymmen jong u , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his fathers had done .
Ye shall not therefore oppress one another  ; but thou shalt fear thy God : for I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Wat shukor ïa la u para Israel , hynrei kohnguh ïa U  Trai  uba U Blei jong phi .
La kha ïa nga shuwa ki lumbah , ha shuwa ban pynrngad ïa ki lumrit ,
translation.en: Before the mountains were settled , before the hills was I brought forth :

translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki synran , Ka to kan poi ha kaba phin kwah ban ïoh ïa kawei na ki sngi jong U Khun U Briew , Hynrei phin ym ïohi ïa ka .
translation.en: And he said unto the disciples ,  The days will come , when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man , and ye shall not see it .

translation.kha: Lydda don uno uno ibha bitar shen , to ai ba un shim ïa ki soh ba mih na kata . “lada phi pyllait ïa u na ka jingjynjar shisien , phin sa hap kun biah .
translation.en: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment : for if thou deliver him , yet thou must do it again .

translation.kha: Ïa ka met jong u la wan kit sha Jerusalem halor u kulai , dara la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid .
translation.en: And they brought him upon horses , and buried him with his fathers in the city of Judah .

translation.kha: Mynta ka sngi U Trai u la pdiang ïa phi kum la ki jongnga ki briew , kumba u la kular ïa Phin ; bad u hukum ïa phi ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u barhem .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath avouched thee this day to be his peculiar people , as he hath promised thee , and that thou shouldest keep all his commandments  ;

Unto the church of God which is at Corinth , to them that are sanctified in Christ Jesus , called to be saints , with all that in every place call upon the name of Jesus Christ our Lord , both theirs and ours :
translation.kha: Sha ka balang U Blei kaba ha Korinth , ha kito baroh kiba la khot ban long ki briew bakhuid jong U Blei , kiba dei ki jong u ha U Khrist Jisu , lem bad ki briew baroh kylleng kiba mane ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , uba long U Trai jong ki ruh :

Baroh ki dieng kin tip ba nga longsem U Trai . Nga khet ïa ki ngin basngur bad nga pynlong ïa ki dieng rit ban san jrong . Nga pynïap stai ïa ki dieng bajyrngam bad pynlong ïa ki dieng ba-tyrkhong ban hylla jyrngam . Ma nga , U Trai , na la kren . nur leh ïa kaei kaban na la noh ba ngan leh .
translation.en: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the  Lord  have brought down the high tree , have exalted the low tree , have dried up the green tree , and have made the dry tree to flourish : I the  Lord  have spoken and have done it .

translation.kha: Me wan jingbeh ïa ki man ka step , bad me tynjuh ïa ki man la ka minit ?
translation.en: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning , and try him every moment ?

translation.kha: Kim dei ban don bynta na ka khyndew ka shyiap kum kiwei pat ki para khait jong ki ; ka bynshet Jong ki ka long ka kabu ka jinglong ki lyngdoh jong U Trai , kumba u la kular .
translation.en: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren : the  Lord  is their inheritance , as he hath said unto them .

translation.kha: Ym slem hadien kata , u Ahithophel u ong ha u Absalom , Shah ngan jied khat-ar hajar lwet ki rangbah , bad ha kane ka miet ngan mih ban otsher thiat ïa u Dabid .
translation.en: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom , Let me now choose out twelve thousand men , and I will arise and pursue after David this night :

translation.kha: Lydia uno uno u ïalam ïa phiah shwa ka ïingbishar shun mudui ïa phi! na ka pyntwa ka soh-ot jong phi , ai ha u ïa ka jaiñkup jynsur ruh .
translation.en: And if any man will sue thee at the law , and take away thy coat , let him have thy cloak also .

translation.kha: bun Uba lai u dien u Amasaïah u khup jongki u Sakhi uba don ar lieh ngut ki shipai . ( U Amasaïah u trei mon sngewbha ban shakri ïa U Troas . )
translation.en: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri , who willingly offered himself unto the  Lord   ; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour .
The crown is fallen from our head : woe unto us , that we have sinned !
translation.kha: Ym don shuh kano kano kaba dang sah na baroh kaba ngi la ju sngewsarong . Ngi la leh pop bad mynta ngi long kiba la tim .
Te u Philip u la sdang ban krensih ; da kaba sawdong na kane ka bynta jong ka Jingthoh bakhatduh , u la ïathuh ïa u ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Jisu .
translation.en: Then Philip opened his mouth , and began at the same scripture , and preached unto him Jesus .

translation.kha: Mynta to shim ïa ka bainong jongngi phi! malade khie leit shad ïing . Ang kwah pun ai ha ine u briew uba la shahskhor khot khatduh khiat kumba nga la ai ha pa .
translation.en: Take that thine is , and go thy way : I will give unto this last , even as unto thee .
Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days : for yet the vision is for many days .
translation.kha: Nga la wan ban pynsngewthuh ïa me ïa kaei ka ban jia ha ki briew jong me ha ka lawei . Kane ka dei ka jingïohipaw ïa ka lawei .
Kine ki san ngut ki syiem ki la pynpang ka jingïateh lok bad ki la ïasoh lang kum khwai ka kynhun shipawa ha ka ih Siddim , kaba long mynta ka Duriaw Baïap .
translation.en: All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim , which is the salt sea .

translation.kha: To pyllaitluid ïa nga na ki jingibeiñ bad jingkrenbeiñ jong ki , namar nga la sumar ïa ki aiñ jong me ;
translation.en: Remove from me reproach and contempt  ; for I have kept thy testimonies .

translation.kha: Baroh ki pyrshang ban shem sngewbha bad ki biria kiba khlaw ; baroh ki kob ïa ka jingïadei paralok nabar Aner Ibbah lah ban pynsngewbha .
translation.en: Many will entreat the favour of the prince : and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts .

translation.kha: hynmen ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki la ïaroi shikatdei eh ; ki la nang bun nang bun , bad ki la nang khlaiñ hajuh ba kata ka ri ka la khapngiah da ki .
translation.en: And the children of Israel were fruitful , and increased abundantly , and multiplied , and waxed exceeding mighty  ; and the land was filled with them .

translation.kha: Haba u Ïing u la wan , u la jingkheit bad um shem dih waiñ , bad uwei uwei baroh u la ïa-ong , ‘ Une uba shongksuid !’
translation.en: For John came neither eating nor drinking , and they say , He hath a devil .
Teach me , and I will hold my tongue : and cause me to understand wherein I have erred .
translation.kha: Kam lei lei , hikai ïa nga ; ïathuh ha nga ïa ki jingbakla jong nga . Ngan sngap jar bad shahshkor ïa phi .

translation.en: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingkhraw bad ïa ka spah jong ki jaitbynriew yn wallam shapoh ka nongbah .
U Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la bynta jaka ïa ki jingïapthngan ; u la buh hangno ki briew Kin shongduh . U la ai uwei u blei ïa kamai kawei ka jaitbynriew ,
translation.en: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance , when he separated the sons of Adam , he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba ïa ki jaka ba la kyrthat jong ki nongshun jong phi la kop bad ba ïa ki briew jong ki la pynïap , ki wahduid kin tuid na baroh ki lumbah bad ki lamwir .
translation.en: And there shall be upon every high mountain , and upon every high hill , rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter , when the towers fall .

translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa ki bad ngan shah ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha sawdong u lum bakyntang jong nga . Hangta ngan kyrkhu ïa ki da kaba pynhap ïa u lap praw hir ki dumok ïa u .
translation.en: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing  ; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season  ; there shall be showers of blessing .

translation.kha: Kumta u la duwai , A Trai’ , hato ngam la ong shuwa ba ngan mian na ïing ba kane ka dei kaei kaba men kuna ? Dei na tala ka daw ba ang la pyrshang tyngeh ban phret noh sha Spain ! Nga la tip ba me long U Blei ka jingkheit bad ka jingisynei , uba ïaishah slem , uba shibun borabor , bad uba kloi borabor ban kylluid ïa la ka jingput ban ym pynshitom .
translation.en: And he prayed unto the  Lord  , and said , I pray thee , O  Lord  , was not this my saying , when I was yet in my country ? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish : for I knew that thou art a gracious God , and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and repentest thee of the evil .

translation.kha: U Jesse u phah ïa u Dabid sha u Saul lem bad u khunblang , u kada ibha kit shikhung u kpu bun ka plie snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ .
translation.en: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread , and a bottle of wine , and a kid , and sent them by David his son unto Saul .

translation.kha: Kawei kaban donkam ïa kum uta u shakri ka long ba un long uba ïania ha u kynrad jong u .
translation.en: Moreover it is required in stewards , that a man be found faithful .
So the chief captain then let the young man depart , and charged him , See thou tell no man that thou hast shewed these things to me .
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la ong ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano ba me la ïathuh ïa kane ha nga .  Bad u la phah noh ïa uta u samla .

translation.en: And Micaiah said , If thou certainly return in peace , then hath not the  Lord  spoken by me . And he said , Hearken , all ye people .
translation.kha: Lada phi wan phai khlem shah pynïap ,  u Mikaïah u pyrta ,  te U  Trai  um shym la kren lyngba jong nga !  Bad u ong shuh ,  Sngap ïa nga phi baroh , ïa kaei kaba nga la ong !
Ka sngaid bad u bnai ki kylla ngam , dara ki khlur kim tyngam shuh .
translation.en: The sun and the moon shall be darkened , and the stars shall withdraw their shining .
And a very great multitude spread their garments in the way  ; others cut down branches from the trees , and strawed them in the way .
translation.kha: U paidbah babun u la siang ïa la ki jaiñkup ha lynti katba kiwei pat ki la khyllad da ki tnat dieng bad ki la siang ïa ki ha lynti .
To khynñiuh , ko khyndew , ha ka jingwan jong U Trai , ha ka jingdon jingkad jongno U Blei jong u jaboh ,
translation.en: Tremble , thou earth , at the presence of the Lord , at the presence of the God of Jacob  ;

translation.kha: U Sedekaïah u la don syn wei snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , badno u la synshar khatwei snem ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem .

They shall not offer wine offerings to the  Lord  , neither shall they be pleasing unto him : their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners  ; all that eat thereof shall be polluted : for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kito ki ri nongwei kin ym lah ban ai ka jingainguh waiñ ha U  Trai  , lane wanlam ki jingkñia ha u . Ki jingbam jong ki kin pyntngit ïa uno uno uba bam ïa ki , kum ki jingbam ba bam ha ka por ïapbriew . Yn pyndonkam ïa ki tang ban pynkdang ïa la ka jingthngan ; ym don kawei ruh ka ban shim kum ka jingainguh ha ka Templ U  Trai .

Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai nongsynshar u nguh : Ha ka sngi ba u dieng u lytar hiar sha ka pyut kiba ïap , ngan pynlong ïa ki um shapoh khyndew ban tapmoh ïa u kum ka dak ka jingïambriew . Ngin set noh ïa ki wah bad ngan ym sha ïa ki shawkad ban thut shabar . Namar ba u dieng u la ïap , lang! khlam ka jingduh halor ki lumbah ka Lebanon bad ngan pynlong ïa borbah ki dieng ha khlaw ba kin ïapstai .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning : I covered the deep for him , and I restrained the floods thereof , and the great waters were stayed : and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him , and all the trees of the field fainted for him .

translation.kha: Ha kaba jingsuk eh , la ïathuh ïa nga ba ha ki jingïaseng jong phi , ki don ki kynhun kiba ïa-pyrshah ; bad kane nga ngeit ka don katto katne ka jingshisha .
translation.en: For first of all , when ye come together in the church , I hear that there be divisions among you ; and I partly believe it .
And the fat of the bullock and of the ram , the rump , and that which covereth the inwards , and the kidneys , and the caul above the liver :

Kumta u Pyrthat u la kylli ïa u , Haba kumta , me , me dei u syiem ? U Jisu u la jop , Me hi me ong ba nga long u syiem . Ïa nga la khaïi bad nga la wan sha ka pyrthat na ka bynta kane kawei ka jingshitom , ban kren shaphang ka jingshisha . uno uno uba dadien jong ka jingsma u shahshkor ïa nga .
translation.en: Pilate therefore said unto him , Art thou a king then ? Jesus answered ,  Thou sayest that I am a king . To this end was I born , and for this cause came I into the world , that I should bear witness unto the truth . Every one that is of the truth heareth my voice .

translation.kha: Ngi dei ban leit lai sngi lynti sha ka ri shyiap shun kñia ainguh ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi , kumba u la hukum ïa ngi .
translation.en: We will go three days  journey into the wilderness , and sacrifice to the  Lord  our God , as he shall command us .

translation.kha: Nga pynap bieit ïa ki nongthied kti dara pynsmai ïa ki jingïathuh lypa ki nongai kupar . Ki ktien jyllang kiba stad na kyntait bad pynsep-ei ba ka jingstad jong ki ka longkmie ka jinglait .
translation.en: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars , and maketh diviners mad  ; that turneth wise men backward , and maketh their knowledge foolish  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei nangta ki kynmaw ïa ki por kiba mynshuwa , ïa ki sngi u Moses , u shrak U Trei bad ki kylli , Hangno mynta u don U Trai , uba pyllait im ïa ki nongïalam jong ki briew jong u na ka duriaw ? Hangno u don U Trai , umbiah la ai ïa U Mynsiem jong u ha u Moses ?
translation.en: Then he remembered the days of old , Moses , and his people , saying , Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock ? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him ?

translation.kha: Baroh kiba Shaniah ha ki bleithaw , kiba khot ïa ki dur ki balieh jyllang ki , yn pynkhap sad pynkhyllem .
translation.en: They shall be turned back , they shall be greatly ashamed , that trust in graven images , that say to the molten images , Ye are our gods .

translation.kha: Shaphang ki jait Sebulun bad Issakhar u nong , Kiba na ka jait Sebulun to kin pynmanbha ha ki jingkhaïi pateng ha duriaw ; Bad to ka spah jong ka jait Issakhar kan nang roi ha la ka ri .
translation.en: And of Zebulun he said , Rejoice , Zebulun , in thy going out  ; and , Issachar , in thy tents .
Both riches and honour come of thee , and thou reignest over all  ; and in thine hand is power and might  ; and in thine hand it is to make great , and to give strength unto all .
translation.kha: Ka spah baroh ka wan na me ; me synshar halor kiei kiei baroh da ka jingkhlaiñ bad ka bor jong me , bad me lah ban pynlong ïano ïano uba khraw bad uba khlaiñ .
To ïadie ba ngan lait na ka jingmane na ki bymngeit Kiba ei ha Judia bad ba ka jingshakri jong nga ha Jerusalem kan longïng katba la pdiang da ki briew jong U Blei hangta .
translation.en: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea ; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints ;
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand toward heaven , that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt , even darkness which may be felt .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Rah ïa la ka kti shajrong ba ka jingdum kaba rben la kumba lah ban tba ïa ka , kan tap ïa ka ri Ijipt .
(Nga la wallam ïa u ha ki synran jong me , hynrei kim lah ban pynheh ïa u .
translation.en: And I brought him to thy disciples , and they could not cure him .

translation.kha: ( Ki nongphetwir ki la lait phet na Babilonia bad wanpaw sha Jerusalem , bad ki ïathuh kumno U thri U Blei jong ngi u siew kylliang na ka bynta kaei kaba ki nongïeng bajakhlia ki la leh ïa ka Templ jong u . )
translation.en: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon , to declare in Zion the vengeance of the  Lord  our God , the vengeance of his temple .

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingphah noh ïa u paidbah , u la leit kiew ïa u lumrit marwei hi ba duwai .
translation.en: And when he had sent the multitudes away , he went up into a mountain apart to pray : and when the evening was come , he was there alone .

translation.kha: U patsha ka Arsa u phuh ïa ka kynhun shipai Kaba lep na Lakhish ban tur ïaleh ïa u Mahseïah ha Jerusalem ; hapoh ka jingai hukum ki lai ngut ki rangbah synshar ba-halor Tam . Haba ki wan poi ha Jerusalem , ki pyndap ïa ka surok ha kaba ki nongthain jaiñ ki trei , hadien ka nur-um kaba wan tuid um na ka Pung ba hangno .
translation.en: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab–shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem . And they went up and came to Jerusalem . And when they were come up , they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool , which is in the highway of the fuller s field .
But the land , whither ye go to possess it , is a land of hills and valleys , and drinketh water of the rain of heaven :
translation.kha: hynrei kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit rung ka dei ka ri lum bad ri them , kaba ïoh um na u slap .

translation.en: For these be the days of vengeance , that all things which are written may be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Naba kito kin long ‘ Ki Sngi ka Jingpynshitom ,’ ban pynlong ïa baroh kaba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ban urlong shisha .

translation.en: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel ,
translation.kha: U Abimelekh u synshar ïa ki Israel haduh lai snem .
NGA long u diengkhap sohwaiñ , bad phi long ki tnat . Uno uno uba ïaineh ha nga , bad ma nga ha u , un seisoh shibun ; naba phim lah banbeiñ leh ei ei khlem ma nga .
translation.en: I am the vine , ye are the branches : He that abideth in me , and I in him , the same bringeth forth much fruit : for without me ye can do nothing .
For except we had lingered , surely now we had returned this second time .

ïa ka Ïingjaiñ , ka jingsngap jong ka bad ka jingsop kaba shabar jong ka , ïa ki bnoh bad ïa ki jingkit jong ka ; ïa ki diengkhap , ki rishot , bad ki thliew tduh jong ka ;
translation.en: The tabernacle , his tent , and his covering , his taches , and his boards , his bars , his pillars , and his sockets ,

translation.kha: u ong ha lade , ‘ Teng leit blei pat sha la ïing .’ Kumta u leit phah pat Bad u shem ba ka ïing ka thylli , ka khuid , bad baroh la nguh ryntih .
translation.en: Then he saith , I will return into my house from whence I came out  ; and when he is come , he findeth it empty , swept , and garnished .

translation.en: And when these days are expired , it shall be , that upon the eighth day , and so forward , the priests shall make your burnt offerings upon the altar , and your peace offerings  ; and I will accept you , saith the Lord  God .
And why have ye brought up the congregation of the  Lord  into this wilderness , that we and our cattle should die there ?
translation.kha: Balei te ba phi wan ïalam ïa ngi sha kane ka ri khlaw ? Hato ba ngin ïap hangne bad la ki jingri ?

Namar kane ngan wallam lang ïa baroh ki nong-ohdieng jong pha kiba mynshuwa — kito kiba pha la sngewtynnat bad kito kiba pha la isih . Ngin wallam ïa ki sawdong jong pha ha ka jali , bad nangta ngan law ïa ki jaiñ jong pha Bad shah ïa ki ban ïohi ba phad lyngkhuit .
translation.en: Behold , therefore I will gather all thy lovers , with whom thou hast taken pleasure , and all them that thou hast loved , with all them that thou hast hated  ; I will even gather them round about against thee , and will discover thy nakedness unto them , that they may see all thy nakedness .

translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U Trai babha la pyllait im ïa phi na u Pharaoh bad na ki nong jingpeit ! Ïaroh ïa U Trai uba la pyllut im ïa une u paidbah na ka jinglongmraw !
translation.en: And Jethro said , Blessed be the  Lord  , who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of Pharaoh , who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians .

Of how much sorer punishment , suppose ye , shall he be thought worthy , who hath trodden under foot the Son of God , and hath counted the blood of the covenant , wherewith he was sanctified , an unholy thing , and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace ?
translation.kha: Te , kaei kan long ïa u briew uba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Khun U Blei ? uba ñiew dew thala ïa ka snam jong ka jutang U Blei kaba pynkhuid ïa u na ka pop ? uba ñiewbeiñ ïa U Mynsiem ka jingaiei ? To pyrkhat haduh katno kan long ka jingpynshitom kaba kham shyrkhei kaba u dei ban ïoh !

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships , by the way whereof I spake unto thee , Thou shalt see it no more again : and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen , and no man shall buy you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un phah biang ïa phi da ka lieng sha Ijipt , wat la nga la ong ba phim dei ban leit shuh shata lano lano ; bad hangta phin sa tyrwa die mraw ïa lade ha ki nongshun jong phi , hynrei yn ym don ba thied ïa phi .

translation.en: Now it came to pass , after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites , that he brought the gods of the children of Seir , and set them up to be his gods , and bowed down himself before them , and burned incense unto them .
translation.kha: Haba u Amasaïah u la wan phai na ka jingjop ïa ki Edom , u wanrah ïa ki bleithaw jong ki lem bad u , u pynïeng ïa ki , u la mane ïa ki , bad u thang jingiwbih ïa ki .

translation.en: And this is the thing that thou shalt do unto them to hallow them , to minister unto me in the priest s office : Take one young bullock , and two rams without blemish ,
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaba me dei ban leh ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ban pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh ki ban shakri ïa nga . Shim uwei u masi lyngraw bad ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang ki bym don jingduna .
To ngin pyllew ïa la ki jemnud sha U Blei ha bneng bun duwai ,
translation.en: Let us lift up our heart with our hands unto God in the heavens .

translation.kha: Bad sa shaniah ha U Trai ba nga da biar hi , nga haw ban Wan shen sha phi .
translation.en: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly .

translation.kha: Nga don ki mai , ki kada , ki longïng , ki phalang , bad ki mraw . Nga phah ktien shata phin ko kynrad da ka jingkyrmen ba ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong phi .
translation.en: And I have oxen , and asses , flocks , and menservants , and womenservants : and I have sent to tell my lord , that I may find grace in thy sight .

translation.kha: U syiad Ijipt ha la ka jingbitar un leit sha ka thma pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Syria mala kumne ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhraw jong u .
translation.en: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler , and shall come forth and fight with him , even with the king of the north : and he shall set forth a great multitude  ; but the multitude shall be given into his hand .

As the  Lord  thy God liveth , there is no nation or kingdom , whither my lord hath not sent to seek thee : and when they said , He is not there  ; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation , that they found thee not .
translation.kha: Da U  Trai  uba im , U Blei jong phi , nga smai ba u syiem u la phah wad ïa phi ha baroh sawdong ki ri ka pyrthei . Haba uno uno u nongsynshar ka ri u ïathuh ba phim don ha ka ri jong u , u Ahab un dawa na uta u nongsynshar ban smai ba phi long u bym lah ban shem .
phi la ïohi ïa ki khlam kba ishyrkhei , ïa ki kambah nabar ki kamphylla kiba khraw ba U Trai u la leh .
translation.en: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen , the signs , and those great miracles :

translation.en: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine , they were dismayed , and greatly afraid .

translation.kha: U bishar jongu U Troas u la wanrah ha u hangta , bad u ïai-ong , U Trai u ni ryngkat bad me , me u briew bashukor bad bakhlaiñ !
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto him , and said unto him , The  Lord  is with thee , thou mighty man of valour .

translation.kha: Ki Rangbah jong ka Judah ki ïaleh ban ïada ïa ka Jeroboam . Ken shim kum ka jinglute ïa ka shapoh jongno ki hima baroh — ka ksar , ka rupa bad ki jaiñphong babun .
translation.en: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem  ; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together , gold , and silver , and apparel , in great abundance .

translation.kha: U la shong bam bad ki , u la skhem ïa u kpu , bad u la ïaboi ; nangta u la khyndai ïa u kpu bad u la ai ïa u ha ki .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he sat at the table with them , he took bread , and blessed it , and brake , and gave to them .

translation.kha: Hynñiew u Jakob u la wait sha Sukkoth , ha kaba u la shna ka ïing ïa lat bad ki Im na ka bynta ki jingri jong u . Dei namar “kata ba la khot kyrteng ïa Kata ka jaka , Ka Sukkoth .
translation.en: And Jacob journeyed to Succoth , and built him an house , and made booths for his cattle : therefore the name of the place is called Succoth .

translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha uta u paidlang , Mynba ngi dang don ha u Lum Sinai , nga la ïathuh ha phi , ‘ Ka jingkitkhlieh ban ïalam ïa phiah ka khia than ïa nga , ngap lah shuh ban kit ïa ka tang marwei .
translation.en: And I spake unto you at that time , saying , I am not able to bear you myself alone :

translation.kha: Gaal kumta ma phi ki Jiw phyrnai sha pynrem ha ki Jentil namarba phi pynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum , wat la na ka bna jong phi ïa ka sah” la thoh bad ïa phi la otsher ; hynrei ki kohnguh ïa ka praw , wat la ym shym la otsher ïa ki ha ka thoh .
translation.en: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature , if it fulfil the law , judge thee , who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law ?

translation.kha: Kim shem la thop ïa kata ka lynti kaban U Blei u pynhieng ka jingïadei sohpdung ki briew pynlang ma u hi , bad pynban , ki la pyrshang ban thaw hi da la ka jong ka lynter ; bad kumta kim shym la pyndem ïa lade ha ka lynti U blang ban pynlong ka jingïadei bad ki .
translation.en: For they being ignorant of God s righteousness , and going about to establish their own righteousness , have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God .

translation.kha: namar man u kynhun U Blei u lah ban jop noh thiaw ïa ka pyrthei . Bad ngi ïoh ïa ka jingjop phalor ka pyrthei lymbung ka jingngeit jong moi .
translation.en: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world : and this is the victory that overcometh the world , even our faith .

translation.kha: U Herod u bitar shikatdei eh ïa briew jong ka Tyros bad shisyndon , kumta ki la leit shi kynhun ban ïakynduh ïa u . tyngkong ki la pynngeit ïa u Blastos , u briew uba dat Khmih ïa ka ïingsyiem , ba u daiñ ban ïarap ïa ki . Nangta ki la leit sha u Herod sad pan don ïasuk bad u , namar ka ri ka jong ki ka ïoh ïa ki jingbam na ka ri ka jong u syiem .
translation.en: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon : but they came with one accord to him , and , having made Blastus the king s chamberlain their friend , desired peace  ; because their country was nourished by the king s country .

translation.kha: Kam don ruh ha shiliang duriaw . Phim donkam ban da kylli , ‘ Uei keiñ u ban leit sha shiliang dulir bad wallam ïa ka sha ngi , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïohsngew bad kohnguh ïa ka ?’
translation.en: Neither is it beyond the sea , that thou shouldest say , Who shall go over the sea for us , and bring it unto us , that we may hear it , and do it ?

translation.kha: Ngan map noh ïa ki pop ba u la leh , bad un im namar ba u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei sad kiba beh .
translation.en: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be mentioned unto him : he hath done that which is lawful and right  ; he shall surely live .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Ishbosheth u khun jong u Saul u kynnoh sniew ïa u Abner ba u ïathiah bad ka Rispah , ka tnga kliar jong u Saul , ka khun jong u Aïah .
translation.en: And Saul had a concubine , whose name was Rizpah , the daughter of Aiah : and Ish–bosheth said to Abner , Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father s concubine ?

translation.kha: Ha ka jingtep , ki riewbymman ki sangeh noh ban leh ki kam bymman , bad ki nongtrei ba la thait , khatduh ki Ïohi jingïathiah .
translation.en: There the wicked cease from troubling  ; and there the weary be at rest .

translation.kha: U dei u parabriew jyllang me uba shahshitom na ki pep jong me , bad kaba bha kaba me leh ka ïarap ïa u .
translation.en: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art  ; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man .
And Hamor communed with them , saying , The soul of my son Shechem longeth for your daughter : I pray you give her him to wife .
translation.kha: U Hamor u ong ha u ,  U khun jong nga u Shekhem u la ïapmat ïa ka khun jong phi ; sngewbha shah ïa u ban shongkurim ïa ka .
Haba ki dang Mihnoh , ki ïakynduh ïa u Moses bad u Onan , kiba ap ïa ki .
translation.en: And they met Moses and Aaron , who stood in the way , as they came forth from Pharaoh :
Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself , according to the good pleasure of his will ,
translation.kha: Namar ka jingieit jong u , U Blei u la rai lypa ba da U Jisu Khrist un pynlong ïa ngi ki khun jong u — kane ka long ka jingsngewbha bad ka jingthmu jong u .
Khim leit sha ki Lum Aram kiba ha ka ri Mahalab marpyrshah ïa ka shnong Jerikho ; kiew ïa u Lum Nebo bad khmih ïa ka ri Kanaan ïa naba ngan ai ha ki paid Israel .
translation.en: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim , unto mount Nebo , which is in the land of Moab , that is over against Jericho  ; and behold the land of Canaan , which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession :

translation.en: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir , utterly to slay and destroy them : and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir , every one helped to destroy another .

translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la thnum bha , u thung ïa u Solomon u khun jong u kum u shem halor ki Israel .
translation.en: So when David was old and full of days , he made Solomon his son king over Israel .
We love him , because he first loved us .
translation.kha: Ngi ieit namar U Blei u la ieit shuwa ïa ngi .
U leit sha ka haduh jong ka lynti bad u ong , To ïai-ong , katno phi buh dor ? ( Um shyiap tip ba ka dei ka pyrsa kyrni jong u . ) Ka ainong Phibi ai aïu ïa nga ?
translation.en: And he turned unto her by the way , and said , Go to , I pray thee , let me come in unto thee  ; ( for he knew not that she was his daughter in law . ) And she said , What wilt thou give me , that thou mayest come in unto me ?

translation.kha: Ki la wan sha Bethsaida , ha kaba katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ha U Jisu ïa u briew suba matlah , bad ki la kparad ïa U Jisu ngab ktah ïa u .
translation.en: And he cometh to Bethsaida  ; and they bring a blind man unto him , and besought him to touch him .

translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la kren bad u la ïong ha ki , Hato phi donkam ban wan ryngkat malade ki waitlam malade ki dieng tyngkan ba-bang kem ïa nga , la kumba nga Dei u riewsniew ?
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Are ye come out , as against a thief , with swords and with staves to take me ?

translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Ahab u syiem Jesreel bad u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah ki leit tur ïajah ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .
translation.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth–gilead .

translation.kha: bad u Elisha u ong ha ka , Kum ha kane ka por ha ka snem kaba bud phin rah ïa u khun ha ki ksang ti jong phi . O ! ka ong da kaba kyndit . Sngewbha , ko kynrad , wat lamler ïa nga . Phi dien u briew jrong U Blei !
translation.en: And he said , About this season , according to the time of life , thou shalt embrace a son . And she said , Nay , my lord , thou man of God , do not lie unto thine handmaid .

translation.kha: Ynda janmiet u dih ban sait baneh sum ïa lade , dara ha ka to sep sner u lah ïa-ban wan pat sha ka jaka Shong dara .
translation.en: But it shall be , when evening cometh on , he shall wash himself with water : and when the sun is down , he shall come into the camp again .

translation.kha: Lydia ha —kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , phi lap ha lumlang ha wah ïa u brisoh uba la shahskhor pynïap , bad Kino tip mano ba la pynap ïa u .
translation.en: If one be found slain in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to possess it , lying in the field , and it be not known who hath slain him :
How long shall I bear with this evil congregation , which murmur against me ? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel , which they murmur against me .
translation.kha: Slem sa katno ba kine ki riewbymman kin khñium pyrshah ïa nga ? Nga la ïohsngew shibun ïa kine ki jingkhñium !

translation.en: And there shall be an hole in the top of it , in the midst thereof : it shall have a binding of woven work round about the hole of it , as it were the hole of an habergeon , that it be not rent .
translation.kha: Ka dei ban don ka thliew ha ka jaka ban phrung ïa ka khlieh , bad suh khylliap ïa ka baroh sawdong kumba leh ïa ka jymphong , khnang ba kan ym kad .
Te ki Jesreel baroh , naduh kawei ka tduh jong ka ri haduh kawei patan ka tduh , ki tip ba u Samuel u lama shisha u nongïathuhlypa jong U Trai .
translation.en: And all Israel from Dan even to Beer–sheba knew that Samuel was established to be a prophet of the  Lord .
This is the day which the  Lord  hath made  ; we will rejoice and be glad in it .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka sngi jong ka jingjop jong U  Trai  ; to ngin ïakmen , to ngin ïalehkmen !
Khim ka um na ka jaka den um ba la pra ki briew ki mareh napoh ka Nehemaïah ! Sangeh ! Sangeh ! ka jingpyrta ka sawa — hynrei ym to ma mano ba phai dien .
translation.en: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water : yet they shall flee away . Stand , stand , shall they cry  ; but none shall look back .

translation.kha: Ha u Timothi , u ïakhun bashisha jong nga ha ka jingngeit : To U Blei U Kpa bad U Kiriath ijuh uba U Trai jongno ngi un ai ha me ïa ka jingaiei , ka jinghikai bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Unto Timothy , my own son in the faith : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei phi kylli , ‘ Balei ba u khun un ym shahshitom nalor ki pop jong u kpa jong u ?’ Ka jubab ka longsyiem ba u khun jong u la leh ïa kai kaba dei dara kaba bha . U la sumar ïa ki aiñ Jong nga bad u la buid biang wiang ïa ki , bad kumta un im da shiah .
translation.en: Yet say ye , Why ? doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father ? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right , and hath kept all my statutes , and hath done them , he shall surely live .

translation.kha: Em , ngam Shimham ar bymdei ei ei ïa me . Ma me uba imat daym ïa nga da kaba ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa nga . U Trai u longsem u Nongbishar . Un rai mynta ka sngi hapdeng ki Israel sad ki Ammon .
translation.en: Wherefore I have not sinned against thee , but thou doest me wrong to war against me : the  Lord  the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: Ki briew ba-bymman ki kajuh Badonbor ïa kaba sniew ; kim don jingisynei ïano ïano ruh .
translation.en: The soul of the wicked desireth evil : his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes .
They are passed away as the swift ships : as the eagle that hasteth to the prey .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong nga ka ïaid kum ka lieng kaba stet tam , kum ka jingstet u pukni uba suh kynsan shapoh ban kynrup ïa ka rabbit .

translation.en: And she vowed a vow , and said , O  Lord  of hosts , if thou wilt indeed look on the affliction of thine handmaid , and remember me , and not forget thine handmaid , but wilt give unto thine handmaid a man child , then I will give him unto the  Lord  all the days of his life , and there shall no razor come upon his head .
translation.kha: Ka Hannah ka pynlong ka jingsmai kyntang ,  A  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , to khmih ïa nga ka shakri jong me ! To peit ïa ka jingkordit jong nga bad kynmaw ïa nga ! To wat klet ïa nga ! Lada men ai khun shynrang ïa nga , nga kular ba ngan aiti ïa u sha me baroh shi rta ka jingim jong u , bad da lei lei yn ym khap ïa u shñiuh jong u .
Ki rangbah kiba la ïalam ïa u Paul ki la ïalaw bad u haduh Athens bad nangta ki la wan phai sha Beria lem bad ki jingbeh na u Paul ba u Silas dara u Timothi ki dei ban leit sha u kulai katba lah .
translation.en: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens : and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timothy for to come to him with all speed , they departed .

translation.kha: Kumta u shakri u buh ïa kata ka jingbam ha khmat jong ki , bad , kumba U Trai u la lah ong , baroh ki la bam nabar dang don bun kaba sah tam .
translation.en: So he set it before them , and they did eat , and left thereof , according to the word of the  Lord .

For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature , and wert grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree : how much more shall these , which be the natural branches , be grafted into their own olive tree ?
translation.kha: Namar phi long kum ka tnat jong u dieng Olib khlaw ïa uba la pynkheiñ bad nangta , pyrshah ïa ka jinglong tynrai , la pynïasoh bad u dieng Olib ba la thung . Ki Jiw ki long kum une u dieng uba la thung ; bad kan long kaba kham suk ïa U Blei ban pynïasoh biang ïa kine ki tnat ba la pynkheiñ sha ki dieng jong ki hi .

translation.en: And the Pharisees and scribes murmured , saying , This man receiveth sinners , and eateth with them .
translation.kha: ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la sdang ban khñium ,  Une u briew u pdiang sngewbha ïa kiba shah kyntait bad u da ïabam lem bad ki !
Baroh kiba ïohi ïa pha kin kynran dien . Kin ong , ‘ Ka Ninebeh ka don ha ki jingjot ! Mano ba kein katno Kanah ka jingisynei ïa ka ? Mane ba kwah ban pyntngen ïa ka ?’
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee , and say , Nineveh is laid waste : who will bemoan her ? whence shall I seek comforters for thee ?

translation.kha: ngat U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Rah ïa la ka kti shajrong ba ka jingdum kaba rben la kumba lah ban tba ïa ka , kan tap-lup ïa ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand toward heaven , that there may be darkness over the land of Egypt , even darkness which may be felt .

translation.kha: Ym da donkam ba U blang un buh por ïa ki bri ban leit bad ba yn bishar ïa ki da u .
translation.en: For he will not lay upon man more than right  ; that he should enter into judgment with God .

translation.kha: wah sngewlyngngoh ha kane ; ba ka por ka wan haba baroh kiba ïap kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u bad kan mihnoh na ki jingtep jong ki : Kito kiba la leh ïa kaba bha’ kin mihpat bad kin im , bad kito kiba la leh ïa kiba sniew kin mihpaw bad yn pynrem ïa ki .
translation.en: And shall come forth  ; they that have done good , unto the resurrection of life  ; and they that have done evil , unto the resurrection of damnation .

translation.kha: Hynñiew sngaid lynter men leh ïa kane man la ka sngi . Te ka duwan kan sa long kaba Khuid phar ; Bad ka bor jong ka jingkhuid jong ka kan pynmynsaw katai ïa uba ktah ïa ka .
translation.en: Seven days thou shalt make an atonement for the altar , and sanctify it  ; and it shall be an altar most holy : whatsoever toucheth the altar shall be holy .

translation.kha: U Blang u la pynlong ïa im kumba ngi long , bad ha U Khrist Jisu u la pynlong ïa ngi ban im na ka bynta ki kam babha , ïa Kiba u la pynkhiah lypa ba ngin leh ïa ki .
translation.en: For we are his workmanship , created in Christ Jesus unto good works , which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them .

translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la jubab , Me long u Jiw , bad nga longïng ka nong Samaria — te kumno me Lah ban pan um na nga ban dih ? ( Ki Jiw kim pyndonkam ïa kijuh ki khuri bad ki pliang kiba ki nong Samaria ki pyndonkam . )
translation.en: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him , How is it that thou , being a Jew , askest drink of me , which am a woman of Samaria ? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la shem ïa u kada bad u la shong halor jong u , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,
translation.en: And Jesus , when he had found a young ass , sat thereon  ; as it is written ,

translation.kha: U lyngdoh u dei baneh khmih bha ïa u , bad lada ka don shisha ka prum kaba byrsaw-lieh ,
translation.en: Then the priest shall look upon it : and , behold , if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head , or in his bald forehead , as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh  ;

translation.kha: U bri uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher , te , u dei ban duwai khnang ban ïoh ïa ka jngai shun batai ïa kai kaba u kren .
translation.en: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret .
Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart , to think that all the king s sons are dead : for Amnon only is dead .
translation.kha: Kumta wat ngeit ïa ka khubor ba ki khun shynrang jong me baroh ki la ïap ; tang u Amnon uba la shah pynïap .
Nangta u leit tur ïaleh ïa ki briew kiba shong ha Debir . ( Ïa kane ka nongbah la ju khot ka Kiriath Sepher . )
translation.en: And he went up thence to the inhabitants of Debir : and the name of Debir before was Kirjath–sepher .

translation.kha: Ka Shimham ka Dei ka jingshukor ha kaba U Shem u long u khliehduh .
translation.en: A kingdom is a government that is headed by a king .
Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify God for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Christ , and for your liberal distribution unto them , and unto all men ;
translation.kha: Bad namar ka jingpynshisha ïa kaba kane ka jingshakri jong phi ka wallam , bun ki ban ai burom ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingïaineh jong phi ha ka gospel U Khrist , ïa kaba phi ïaphla , bad ïa ka jinglehsbun jong phi ha kaba ïasam bynta lem bad ki bad uwei pa uwei ruh .

translation.en: Through mighty signs and wonders , by the power of the Spirit of God ; so that from Jerusalem , and round about unto Illyricum , I have fully preached the gospel of Christ .
translation.kha: da ka bor jong ki kambah bad ki jingphylla , bad da ka bor jong U Mynsiem jong U Blei . Bad kumta , ha ka jingleit baroh shi lynter lynti naduh Jerusalem sha Illyrikom , nga la pynbna pura ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist .

translation.en: And also let the golden and silver vessels of the house of God , which Nebuchadnezzar took forth out of the temple which is at Jerusalem , and brought unto Babylon , be restored , and brought again unto the temple which is at Jerusalem , every one to his place , and place them in the house of God .
translation.kha: Ïa ki khiew ki pliang ksiar bad rupa ruh kiba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la wallam sha Babilon na ka Templ ha Jerusalem , dei ban pynphai pat sha ka jaka jong ki ha ka Templ ha Jerusalem .
Hynrei U Trai u ong , Ko Ishmael pynlang Judas , Katai kaba ngan leh ïa Phin ? Ka jingieit jong phi ïa nga ka jah ino shen kum u slap mynstep ; ka long kum ka umjer , kaba jah noh shen ha ka sngi .
translation.en: O Ephraim , what shall I do unto thee ? O Judah , what shall I do unto thee ? for your goodness is as a morning cloud , and as the early dew it goeth away .

translation.kha: Sngap batuid ianga ka jingmut ba iahap tam jong ka kyntien .
translation.en: Will you please explain to me the exact meaning of the word ?
For what is a man advantaged , if he gain the whole world , and lose himself , or be cast away ?
translation.kha: Hato u briew un ïohnong ei ei lada u jop ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hynrei u hi u duh noh lane u shahjop ? Em da shisha !

nangta nga la ong , Ko Trai Nongsynshar , nga tip ba ki nonghiarthma ki nong ïa ki briew ba yn ym khong ka thma kane ka jingïapthngan , namar me la kular , ki ong , ba kan don tang ka jingsuk ha ka ri jong ngi .
translation.en: Then said I , Ah , Lord  God  ! behold , the prophets say unto them , Ye shall not see the sword , neither shall ye have famine  ; but I will give you assured peace in this place .
And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , See , I have set thee over all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Mynta , nga thung ïa me u lat halor ka ri Ijipt .
Wat sngewkthang ïa ki Briew Ibbah leh pop , ai ba ka jingïaburom ïa U Trai kan erlangthari ha khmat ka jingriam jong phi .
translation.en: Let not thine heart envy sinners : but be thou in the fear of the  Lord  all the day long .

translation.kha: Ha ka Por ka jingsynshar jong u , u Hiel uba na Bethel u tei pat ïa ka Jerikho . Kumba U Trai u la lah kren da u Josaïah u khun jong u Nun , u Hiel u la shuh noh ïa u khun nyngkong jong u , u Abraham mynleh u buh ïa ka nongrim jongngi ka Jerikho , bad ïa u khun khatduh jongki u , u Segub mynba u tei ïa ki khyrdop jong ka .
translation.en: In his days did Hiel the Beth–elite build Jericho : he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn , and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun .

translation.kha: U ai jingbthah duh katno ka rupa bad ka ksiar kan leit ha kaba shniah ïa kita ki khihwin ki pliang ,
translation.en: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold , for all instruments of all manner of service  ; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight , for all instruments of every kind of service :
All the males among the priests shall eat thereof : it is most holy .
translation.kha: Uno uno u shynrang uba na ka longïing u lyngdoh u lah ban bam ïa kane ka jingainguh ; ka dei kaba khuid bha .
Pynban , to pyrkhat ïa ka Hima jong u , bad un pyndap ïa phi da kine kaei ki .
translation.en: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God  ; and all these things shall be added unto you .

translation.kha: Ka khum u Pharaoh ka ong ha ka , Syiem ïa une u khunlung bad ri ïa u na ka bynta jong nga , Bad tun da siew ïa pha . Kumta kata ka kynthei ka shim ïa uta u khunlung , sad ka ri ka satia ïa u .
translation.en: And Pharaoh s daughter said unto her , Take this child away , and nurse it for me , and I will give thee thy wages . And the woman took the child , and nursed it .

translation.kha: Ko syiem kynrad , sngap ïa kaei ba ngan ong . Lada dei U Trai uba la pynkhie ïa phi pynshisha ïa nga , ka jingsuh ïa u , to kan pynkylla ïa ka jingmut jngai u ; hynrei lama ki brisoh ki la ar ïa ka , to ka jingtim U Trai kan haw ha ki . Naba ki la beh noh ïa nga na ka ri U Trai’ sha ka ri ha kaba nga haw ban mane tyngkan ïa ki balieh nongwei .
translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , let my lord the king hear the words of his servant . If the  Lord  have stirred thee up against me , let him accept an offering : but if they be the children of men , cursed be they before the  Lord   ; for they have driven me out this day from abiding in the inheritance of the  Lord  , saying , Go , serve other gods .

translation.kha: Ym don uwei pat u ïathuhlypa uba la da ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw bad kiba sngewtriem kum kiba u Messaïah u la leh ha khmat ki Israel baroh .
translation.en: And in all that mighty hand , and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel .
The Father loveth the Son , and hath given all things into his hand .
translation.kha: U Kpa u ieit ïa la U Khun bad u la buh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha ka bor jong u .

translation.en: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues , that he is the Son of God .
translation.kha: U la leit beit sha ki synagog u la sdang ban ïalap ba U Jisu u long U Khun U Blei .
bad ha ken ka stang , un pyllaitluid ïa kita borbah kiba la long ki khra-maw shi lyndum ka jingshim Jong ki , namar ka jingsheptieng jong ki ïa ka jingïap .
translation.en: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage .

translation.kha: Beor na kiwei! ki nongïathuhlypa ki nong ïa hajuh . Leit kiew pyrshah ïa ka Ramoth , bad phin jop , ki ong . U Trai un ai ha pa ka jingjop .
translation.en: And all the prophets prophesied so , saying , Go up to Ramoth–gilead , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the king s hand .

translation.kha: U Moses u long uta kaba la Kren ha ki pyllut Israel , ‘ U Blei un phah ha phi ïa u nongïathuhlypa , kumba u la phah ïa nga , bad un long uba napdeng ki briew jong Phi .’
translation.en: This is that Moses , which said unto the children of Israel , A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren , like unto me  ; him shall ye hear .
Thus saith the  Lord  the maker thereof , the  Lord  that formed it , to establish it  ; the  Lord  is his name  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  , uba la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , uba la pynlong ïa ka bad buh ïa ka ha la ka jaka , u la kren ha nga . Uta uba ka kyrteng jong u ka long U  Trai  , u la ong ,

translation.en: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom : but the froward tongue shall be cut out .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki kren ïa ka jingstad , hynrei ïa u thylliej uba kren sniew yn pynsangeh .
Kumta , hangta ha khmat jong phi nga bret ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap Bad nga pynpait pharia ïa ki .
translation.en: And I took the two tables , and cast them out of my two hands , and brake them before your eyes .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïeng joit bad u la leit sha ïohnong .
translation.en: And he arose , and departed to his house .

translation.kha: Hynrei shadien ba phi la shahshitom tang kynhied por , U Blei jong ka jingaiei baroh , uba la khot ïa phi ban ïoh pynbha na ka burom bymjukut jongngi u ha U Khrist , ma u hi keiñ un pynjanai ïa phi bad un ai ha phi ïa ka jingsngewskhem , ka jingïalang , bad ka nongrim naba skhem shisha .
translation.en: But the God of all grace , who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus , after that ye have suffered a while , make you perfect , stablish , strengthen , settle you .

translation.kha: U angel uba nyngkong u la put ïa la ka turoi . U phria bad ka ding , ba la khleh lang! bad ka snar , ki la haw halor ka khynwin . Shisha bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka khyndew la thang ruh noh , shi byndi na ka lai pyntha jong ki dieng , bad ïa baroh ki phlang jingbyrngem .
translation.en: The first angel sounded , and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood , and they were cast upon the earth : and the third part of trees was burnt up , and all green grass was burnt up .

bad kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Peresh Ussah naduh tala ka por . U Nadab u la bitar nabar U Trai u la pynshitom ïa u Ussah ha ka jingbitar .
translation.en: And David was displeased , because the  Lord  had made a breach upon Uzza : wherefore that place is called Perez–uzza to this day .

translation.kha: U Saul u don hapdeng ka jingïaleh kaba jur bha , bad u la shah siat da u khnam ha u nongshun bad u la mynleh jur .
translation.en: And the battle went sore against Saul , and the archers hit him , and he was wounded of the archers .

And when all Israel saw that the king would not hearken unto them , the people answered the king , saying , What portion have we in David ? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse : every man to your tents , O Israel : and now , David , see to thine own house . So all Israel went to their tents .
translation.kha: Haba kita ki briew ki ïohi ba u syiem um shahshkor ïa ki , ki pyrta jam ,  Keiñ noh ïa u Dabid bad ka longïing jong u ! Ki la leh aïu na ka bynta jong ngi ? Ko ki rangbah Israel , ïa ngin ïaleit noh sha la ïing ! Ai ba u Rehoboam un khmih hi na ka bynta ïa lade .  Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïaleh pyrshah ,
Lada phi thup shaphang kamai kaba phi kren , phi don ei ei kaba kham kordor Ban ïa ka ksiar ne ki mawkordor .
translation.en: There is gold , and a multitude of rubies : but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel .

translation.kha: Kito kiba dang sah ha dat ka ri ki long ki san lwet ki syiem Philistia , ki Hanan baroh , ki Sidon , bad ki Hib uba shong ha ki Lum Lebanon naduh u Lum Baal Hermon haduh ka Khim Hamath .
translation.en: Namely , five lords of the Philistines , and all the Canaanites , and the Sidonians , and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon , from mount Baal–hermon unto the entering in of Hamath .
As for his father , because he cruelly oppressed , spoiled his brother by violence , and did that which is not good among his people , lo , even he shall die in his iniquity .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka liang , u kpa jong u , u la shukor bad lute bad u ïai leh ïa kaba sniew ha uwei pa uwei baroh . Bad kumta u la ïap namar ki pop kiba ma u hi u la leh .
Ki “ langbrot ” ki dei Kito uba pyni ba ki long kiba kohnguh snoh ïa u .
translation.en: The “ sheep ” are those who will have proved themselves his loyal subjects .
If the priest s daughter also be married unto a stranger , she may not eat of an offering of the holy things .
