translation.en: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red , when it giveth his colour in the cup , when it moveth itself aright .

translation.kha: Judas , ki hynmen ki para jong me kin ïaroh ïa me ; Me shim na ka lyndang ïa ki nongsynran jong me ; Ki hynmen ki para jong me kin nguh kin dem ïa phi .
translation.en: Judah , thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise : thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies  ; thy father s children shall bow down before thee .

translation.kha: Ki bakla shaphang ka pop , namar ba kim shym la jingkit ha nga ;
translation.en: Of sin , because they believe not on me  ;
And , behold , there came a leper and worshipped him , saying , Lord , if thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .
translation.kha: Nangta u briew uba shitom na ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh u la wan sha u , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u , bad u la ong ,  Ko Kynrad , lada me mon , me lah ban pynlong khuid ïa nga .

translation.en: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand , women , sons , and daughters , and took also away much spoil from them , and brought the spoil to Samaria .
translation.kha: Wat la ki Judia ki dei ki para ri jong ki , ki shipai Israel ki ring koidi ïa ki ar lakh ngut ki kynthei bad khynnah bad ki rah ïa ki sha Samaria , lem bad ka jinglute kaba bun .
Hynrei u nong Samaria uba la leit jinglwet na Katai ka lyntang u la wan lap ïa uta u briew , bad haba u la ïohi ïa u , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingsngewsynei .
translation.en: But a certain Samaritan , as he journeyed , came where he was : and when he saw him , he had compassion on him ,
So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house  ; and Absalom went in unto his father s concubines in the sight of all Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta ki pynïeng kawei ka ïingjaiñ ïa u Absalom ha tnum ka ïingsyiem ; bad ha ka jingïohi jong uwei pa uwei baroh , u Absalom u leit rung shapoh bad u la ïathiah shongkha bad ki tnga kliar jong u kpa jong u .

translation.en: And I said unto them , Whosoever hath any gold , let them break it off . So they gave it me : then I cast it into the fire , and there came out this calf .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa ki ba kin wallam ha nga ïa la ki jingdeng ksiar , bad kito kiba don ki law ïa ki bad ki ai ïa ki ha nga . Nga bret ïa ki ha ka ding , bad wan mih da une u khun masi .

translation.en: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things , so will we hearken unto thee : only the  Lord  thy God be with thee , as he was with Moses .
translation.kha: Ngin kohnguh ïa me kumba ngi la ju kohnguh ïa u Moses , bad ai ba U  Trai  U Blei jong me un long ryngkat bad me kumba u la long bad u Moses !

len tbeh ïa ka ding ha ki templ jong ki blei ki Ijipt , bad u syiem ka bakhia un thang ïa ki bleithaw jong ki ne ïalam noh ïa ki . Naba ki nongap langbrot ki dang jied ïa ki jaiñjot jong ki kiba lait na ki jynreiñ , te u syiem ka Babilonia un lngaid pyndik ïa ka ri Ijipt bad nangta ki mih da ka jingjop .
translation.en: And I will kindle a fire in the houses of the gods of Egypt  ; and he shall burn them , and carry them away captives : and he shall array himself with the land of Egypt , as a shepherd putteth on his garment  ; and he shall go forth from thence in peace .

translation.kha: Ia ki jingartatiend ; nga ñiew ïa kiei Kiei baroh kum ka jingduh ba-pura na ka pyntha kata kaba kham kor paila , ka jingtip ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U tharai jong nga .
translation.en: Yea doubtless , and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord : for whom I have suffered the loss of all things , and do count them but dung , that I may win Christ ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Isaïah u ong ha kiba synran ïa u syiem ban thap ha u tohjaw da i symboh ba la shna na ki soh Dumbur , bad un ïohkhiah .
translation.en: And Isaiah said , Take a lump of figs . And they took and laid it on the boil , and he recovered .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la synsar pynlah ïa kita ki shynrang baroh naba don habar ktang ba kin ym shem ïa ka jingkhang .
translation.en: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness , both small and great : so that they wearied themselves to find the door .
He shall not see the rivers , the floods , the brooks of honey and butter .
translation.kha: Un ym im ban ïohi ïa ki wah ka umphniang Olib lane ïa ki wahduid kiba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap .
Hadien katto katne por , katba ki rangbah uba ïeng hangta ki la ïawan sha u Petros . Da shaid me longïing uwei na ki , ki la ong . Nalor baroh , ka rukom kren jong me ka pynpaw ïa kata !
translation.en: And after a while came unto him they that stood by , and said to Peter , Surely thou also art one of them  ; for thy speech bewrayeth thee .

translation.kha: Wat khang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ;
translation.en: Quench not the Spirit .
And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice , for one lamb .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba wanrah ïa ka langbrot ne ka blang kum ka jingainguh thang ha U  Trai  u dei ban wallam lem bad kata ka jingri shi kilo u  purew ba la khleh bad shi litar ka umphniang Olib kum ka jingainguh bam , lem bad shi litar ka waiñ .

translation.en: They have corrupted themselves , their spot is not the spot of his children : they are a perverse and crooked generation .
translation.kha: Pynban phi , phi long kiba ïaid kdor , ki bym dei hok ban long ki briew jong u , ka jaitbynriew kaba pop bad kaba shukor .

translation.en: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , throughout thy tribes : and they shall judge the people with just judgment .
translation.kha: Thung ïa ki nongbishar bad kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar ha man la ka shnong ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi . Kine kin bishar hok ïa ki briew .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that they shall no more say , The  Lord  liveth , which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt  ;
translation.kha: Ka por kan wan  , ong U  Trai  ,  haba ki briew kin ym smai shuh da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa u paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt .

U Jehoba u ong ha la ki hynmen bad ha la u per , Nga dei u Joseph ! Shisha i pa i dang im ? Ki hynmen shynrang jong u kim lait ang shuh , ki la sngewbishni shikatdei eh kat haduh ba kim lah ban jubab .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , I am Joseph  ; doth my father yet live ? And his brethren could not answer him  ; for they were troubled at his presence .

translation.kha: Ha-ei ngan wanlam sha U Trai , U Blei ka banyngkong , haba nga wan ban mane ïa u ? Hato ngan wallam shuh u da ki khun masi bakynsai tam kum ki jingainguh thang ?
translation.en: Wherewith shall I come before the  Lord  , and bow myself before the high God ? shall I come before him with burnt offerings , with calves of a year old ?

translation.kha: Badno phin nujor ïa nga ? ong U Trai . Hato anna uno Une uba kum ma per ?
translation.en: To whom will ye liken me , and make me equal , and compare me , that we may be like ?
For he knoweth vain men : he seeth wickedness also  ; will he not then consider it ?
translation.kha: U Blei u tip kino ki briew ki bymlarkam ; u ïohi ïa ki kam sniew jong ki baroh .

translation.en: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment , and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him , he shall be put to death : only be strong and of a good courage .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba artatien ïa ka iktiar jong me lane u bymkohnguh ïa kano kano na ki hukum jong me un shah pynïap . To long uba kut jingmut triang bad uba skhem .

To risa da ka jingkmen , phi ki bneng ! To risa , ko ki jaka bajylliew jong ka pyrthei ! To risa da ka jingkmen , ko ki lumbah , bad man la u dieng jongu ka khlaw ! U Troas u la pyn-i ïa ka jingkhraw jong u da naba u pynni ïa ki briew jong u ki Israel .
translation.en: Sing , O ye heavens  ; for the  Lord  hath done it : shout , ye lower parts of the earth : break forth into singing , ye mountains , O forest , and every tree therein : for the  Lord  hath redeemed Jacob , and glorified himself in Israel .
The vile person shall be no more called liberal , nor the churl said to be bountiful .
translation.kha: Yn ym don u ban pyrkhat ba uba bieit u long uba donburom lane ban ong ba u riewshukor u long uba hok .

haba ki briew ha ka nongrep ki khie dang step phyrngab ha ka step kambah brup , ki shem ba ka duwan ïa u Baal bad ka dak jong ka Asherah la pynkhyllem , mala ba la trep ïa u masi kyrtong uba ar halor ka kito ïa kaba la ter hangta .
translation.en: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning , behold , the altar of Baal was cast down , and the grove was cut down that was by it , and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built .

translation.kha: Kine ki ñianglartham ki long kumjuh kum kito kiba nga la ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw kaba nyngkong jong nga .
translation.en: As for the wheels , it was cried unto them in my hearing , O wheel .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïam .
translation.en: Jesus wept .

translation.kha: U Trai nongbishar u ong , Hadien sawphew snem ngan ïam pat ïa ki nong Ijipt na ki ri sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki ,
translation.en: Yet thus saith the Lord  God   ; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered :

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , mane ban isynei ïa phi , ki briew jong ka Jerusalem , bad mano ban ïam sngewsih halor jong phi ? Mano ban Seneh kham slem ban kylli phi long kumno ?
translation.en: For who shall have pity upon thee , O Jerusalem ? or who shall bemoan thee ? or who shall go aside to ask how thou doest ?

translation.kha: U syiem u ong ïa ka , Wat shaphang ! Phi ïohi aïu ? Nga ïuh ïa ka sna-ïap ba ka ñiah na kheiñduh , ka jubab .
translation.en: And the king said unto her , Be not afraid : for what sawest thou ? And the woman said unto Saul , I saw gods ascending out of the earth .

translation.kha: Katto katne ki la ïap tang shiphang , hynrei uwei na ki u la don ha jingtep la saw sngi .—Ioannis 11 :39-44 .
translation.en: Some had been dead for a short while , but one had been in a tomb for four days ! —John 11 :39-44 .
For whosoever will save his life shall lose it  ; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel s , the same shall save it .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba kwah ban pynim ïa la ka jong ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka ; hynrei uno uno u ban duh noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Gospel un pynim ïa ka .
U Trai u ong , Ka aiñ , kaba rim bad kaba thymmai ruh , ka pyntlot ïa ka bor pyrkhat ki briew jongno nga !
translation.en: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart .

translation.kha: Rung shapoh lyngka ka khyrdop kaba khim , ñiar ka khyrdop sha ka dujok ka long kaba kyllum bun ka lyndang kaba ïalam sha ka , ka long kaba suk , bad don saihon kiba ïaid na ka .
translation.en: Enter ye in at the strait gate : for wide is the gate , and broad is the way , that leadeth to destruction , and many there be which go in thereat :
Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him , seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u long uba lah , mynta bad borabor , ban pynim ïa kita kiba wan sha U Blei da u , namar u im junom ban ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta jong ki .
Te U Trai u la nong ha nga , ‘ Shtah ar thyllah ki mawlyngkniap kum kito kiba nyngkong bad shna hajuh kawei ka synduk dieng ïa-ban buh ïa ki .
translation.en: At that time the  Lord  said unto me , Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first , and come up unto me into the mount , and make thee an ark of wood .

translation.kha: Wah ïathuhlypa shuh hangne ha Bethel . Kane ka dei ka jaka myn Blei jong u syiem , ka Templ jong ka hima .
translation.en: But prophesy not again any more at Beth–el : for it is the king s chapel , and it is the king s court .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ka por kan poi haba sam sa pynlong ïa ka jingmut bamaïan bad ki paid Israel bad ki pyllut Judah .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel , and with the house of Judah :

translation.kha: Ang la kylli ïa ki : kine ki jaka bajrong sha kiba phi leit ki dei kiei ? Kumta la khiat ïa kine ‘ Ki jaka bajrong’ naduh katai ka por .
translation.en: Then I said unto them , What is the high place whereunto ye go ? And the name thereof is called Bamah unto this day .

translation.kha: Ki khlur ki la hap ha pyrthei , kum ki soh Dorbar bym pat ih na u dieng haba kynther ka kyntu kaba jur .
translation.en: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth , even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs , when she is shaken of a mighty wind .

translation.kha: Nangta na la ïohi ar ngut ki ngab kiba ïeng harud wah , uwei ha kaei kaei ka liang .
translation.en: Then I Daniel looked , and , behold , there stood other two , the one on this side of the bank of the river , and the other on that side of the bank of the river .

translation.kha: Nga long ka Jingstad , nga kham kordor ban ïa ki mawlynnai ; baroh kaba phi angnud kur lah ban ïanujor mala nga .
translation.en: For wisdom is better than rubies  ; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Dabid u jubab , I pa jong phi i tip bha katno ba Phin sngewieit ïa to , mala i la rai ba phin ym tip ïa kaei ba i thmu ban leh , nongmareh ba phin sa sngewkthang eh . Nga smai ha pa da U Trai uba im ba nga don sa tang shisien jam na ka jingïap !
translation.en: And David sware moreover , and said , Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes  ; and he saith , Let not Jonathan know this , lest he be grieved : but truly as the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , there is but a step between me and death .

translation.kha: Ngan sa loit noh shen bad ngan ym wan phah shuh — ban leit shad ka ri kaba dum bad kaba bym don jingkem ,
translation.en: Before I go whence I shall not return , even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death  ;
But Jesus answered them ,  My Father worketh hitherto , and I work .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  U Kpa jong nga u ïai trei , bad ka dei ïa nga ruh ban trei .

U Baana , u khun jong u Ahilud : ki nongbeh Taanakh , Migdalel , bad baroh ka thain hajan ka Beth Shan , hajan ka nongrit Sarethan , kaba shngain shathie jong ka Jesreel , haduh ka nongbah Abel Meholah bad ka nongbah Jokmeam
translation.en: Baana the son of Ahilud  ; to him pertained Taanach and Megiddo , and all Beth–shean , which is by Zarethan beneath Jezreel , from Beth–shean to Abel–meholah , even unto the place that is beyond Jokmeam :

translation.kha: U syiem bun ki nongïalam ki phla ba ki la leh jop , bad ki ong , Kaei kaba U Trai’ u leh ka long kaba shongnia .
translation.en: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves  ; and they said , The  Lord  is righteous .

translation.kha: Katto katba ngut ki shipai hajuh ki la kylli ïa u , kumin ma i pat ? Kaei ba ngi dien ba-bang leh ? U la ong ha ki , Wat shim pisa nano nano da ka bor lane mudui lamler ïano ïano . To sngewhun ha la ka thar .
translation.en: And the soldiers likewise demanded of him , saying , And what shall we do ? And he said unto them , Do violence to no man , neither accuse any falsely  ; and be content with your wages .

translation.kha: Ngin mynjur tang ha kane : ba pien long Kum ma ngi da kaba ki shynrang jong phi baroh kin shah otsher .
translation.en: But in this will we consent unto you : If ye will be as we be , that every male of you be circumcised  ;

translation.kha: Baroh kin shun ïa phi na ka bniat jngai nga . Hynrei uta uba ïaineh haduh kaba kut , un jingjynjar im .
translation.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name s sake : but he that shall endure unto the end , the same shall be saved .

For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle  ; and the city shall be taken , and the houses rifled , and the women ravished  ; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity , and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un wallam lang ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ban ïaleh thma ïa ka Jerusalem . Ïa ka nongbah yn sa shim noh , ïa ki ïing la lute , bad ïa ki kynthei la batbor . Shiteng na ki briew kin leit sha ka jingshah ringmraw , hynrei ïa kiba sah na ki yn ym shim noh na ka nongbah .
Kin ai ha phi ïa ka jingim — ka jingim kaba sngewtynnat bad kaba kmen .
translation.en: So shall they be life unto thy soul , and grace to thy neck .

translation.kha: Kito kiba dei napdeng ki briew jong im’ kiba la ïa-ïap kin im biang ! Ki met jong ki keiñ wan phai biang shat ka jingim . Baroh kito kiba iathuh ha ki jingdap jngai ki kin kyndit thiah bad kin Rwai namar ka jingkmen . Kumba ka umjer baphyrnai ka pynthymmai bor ïa ka khihwin , kumta ruh U thri un pynkhie im pang ïa kito kba la ïap la slem .
translation.en: Thy dead men shall live , together with my dead body shall they arise . Awake and sing , ye that dwell in dust : for thy dew is as the dew of herbs , and the earth shall cast out the dead .

translation.kha: Me ïuh hajir ka duriaw da ki kulai jong me , bad ki umbah ki khnam shaid .
translation.en: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses , through the heap of great waters .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Kine ki briew ki nguh ba ki mane ïa ang , hynrei ki ktien jong ki kim ei jingmut ei ei , bad ki dohnud jong ki , ki long shawei pat . Ka niam jong ki kam long ei ei , hynrei ka long tang ki aiñ bun ki rukom briew , kiba ki Shuah spel lyngdoh .
translation.en: Wherefore the Lord said , Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth , and with their lips do honour me , but have removed their heart far from me , and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men :

translation.kha: Mynta phi don kyrhai ban bam , bad phin sngewhun . Phan ïaroh ïa U Trai U Blei lad phi , ibha la leh khie kiei kiba phyllaw na ka byndi jong phi ki briew jong ang kin ym shah ñiewburom shuh .
translation.en: And ye shall eat in plenty , and be satisfied , and praise the name of the  Lord  your God , that hath dealt wondrously with you : and my people shall never be ashamed .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ang don ei ei ban ong Shaphang ki paramarjan jong ka Jeriel kaba la pynjot ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan shim noh ïa kito ki briew bymman na ki ri jongngi ki kum ïa u jingthung ba la rat , bad ngan pyllait im ïa ka Judah na ki .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  against all mine evil neighbours , that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Israel to inherit  ; Behold , I will pluck them out of their land , and pluck out the house of Judah from among them .

translation.kha: ( U la ong ïa kane khnap ba ïa kaei kaba u la lah ong kan urlong shisha : Ko Pa , ïam Shimham la duh noh kam uwei ruh na nia ïa kiba me la ai ha nga . )
translation.en: That the saying might be fulfilled , which he spake ,  Of them which thou gavest me have I lost none .

translation.kha: U la khong hynñiew ngut ki khwan shynrang mala lah ngut ki khun kynthei , bad u ni ruh hynñiew hajar tylli ki langbrot , lai hajar tylli ki ut , shihajar tylli ki masi thab , bad sanspah tylli ki kada .
translation.en: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters .

translation.kha: Un hap ban iehnoh ïa baroh kaba u la dep ba-thurmur ; un ym ïohlad ban lehkmen Halor ka spah jong u ,
translation.en: That which he laboured for shall he restore , and shall not swallow it down : according to his substance shall the restitution be , and he shall not rejoice therein .

translation.kha: Ha ka por shiteng synñia ang kiei ban ïaroh ïa me namar ki jingisih hok jong me .
translation.en: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments .

translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Ijipt u phah khot ïa kita ki nongpynkha khun , bad u kylli ïa ki , Balei phi kuna kumne , bad phi shah ïa ki khun shynrang ba kin im ?
translation.en: And the king of Egypt called for the midwives , and said unto them , Why have ye done this thing , and have saved the men children alive ?

translation.kha: Me dei ban pynteh ïa ki khmat jong ki bad pynphai ïa ki na ka jingdum sha ka jingshai , bad na ka bor jong u Soitan shat U balui , khnang ba da ka jingngeit jong ki ha nga kin ïoh ka jingmap noh ïa ki pop jongnga ki bun ïohpdiang ïa la ka jaka hapdeng ki briew uba la jied jong U Blei .’
translation.en: To open their eyes , and to turn them from darkness to light , and from the power of Satan unto God , that they may receive forgiveness of sins , and inheritance among them which are sanctified by faith that is in me .

translation.kha: Kaba sngewshyrkhei mala kaba sngewtynnat ka la jat ha kane ka ri :
translation.en: A wonderful and horrible thing is committed in the land  ;

translation.kha: Phin ym long uba jop ha ka jingim lada phi pyrshah pun buhrieh ïa la ki pop . Phla ïa ki bad iehnoh ïa ki ; te U balui un pynsep-ei ka jingisynei ïa phi .
translation.en: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper : but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy .

translation.kha: Eliada phi la ngeit da shisha ha u Moses , phin jin da la jingkit ha nga , namar u la thoh shemphang lad nga .
translation.en: For had ye believed Moses , ye would have believed me : for he wrote of me .

translation.kha: Ki malai mala ki blang jongno de ki la ai shibun ka dud , bad ki dieng Olib ki la san ha ki Khynñiuh jong ki jaka maw .
translation.en: When I washed my steps with butter , and the rock poured me out rivers of oil  ;

translation.kha: bad ki la ïapynlong ki jingthmu shun kem ïa U Jisu ha kaba rieh bad ban pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtilty , and kill him .

translation.kha: U Trai u ai ha u Moses ïa kine harum ki jingbthah ryntih .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: Gera haba uno uno u shakri ïa U Khrist ha kane ka rukom , u pynsngewbha ïa U Blei Bad la ïa-pdiang da kiwei pat .
translation.en: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God , and approved of men .
Many shall be purified , and made white , and tried  ; but the wicked shall do wickedly : and none of the wicked shall understand  ; but the wise shall understand .
translation.kha: Ïa kiba bun ki briew yn pynkhuid . Kito kiba bymman kin ym sngewthuh hynrei kin ïailong bymman ; tang kito kiba stad kin shemphang .

translation.en: And straightway his ears were opened , and the string of his tongue was loosed , and he spake plain .
translation.kha: Shisyndon uta u briew u la lah ban ïohsngew , bad la weng noh ïa kata kaba teh ïa ka jinglah kren jong u , bad u la sdang ban kren khlem kano kano ka jingeh .

Te baroh ki ïabah synshar ki la woh ban kylli ïa por , bad nga la ong ïa ki thik ruma u syiem u la ong ïa nga ban ong ha ki . Ym khong ei ei pat kaba ki lah ban leh , namar ym Don mano mano ba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïakren .
translation.en: Then came all the princes unto Jeremiah , and asked him : and he told them according to all these words that the king had commanded . So they left off speaking with him  ; for the matter was not perceived .

Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer , while his heart is hot , and overtake him , because the way is long , and slay him  ; whereas he was not worthy of death , inasmuch as he hated him not in time past .
translation.kha: Lada don tang kawei ka shnong , ka lynti shata ka lah ban jngai than , bad uta uba wad kput u lah ban lap ïa u bad ha la ka jingbitar u lah ban pynïap ïa u briew u bym dei hok ban ïap , namar um shym don ka jingïashun bad la u paramarjan mynshuwa .

translation.en: And if ye be Christ s , then are ye Abraham s seed , and heirs according to the promise .
translation.kha: Lada phi dei ki jong U Khrist , te , phi long ki nonghiarpateng u Abraham bad phin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .
Ai ba ki briew jong U Blei kin shadkmen ha ka jingjop jong ki bad rwai da kaba kum baroh shi miet .
translation.en: Let the saints be joyful in glory : let them sing aloud upon their beds .

translation.kha: Kam pher katai ka jingkylli ba u symboh u la kylli , lane kano ka jingeh kaba u pynpaw , Kino ki saw ngat ki la khap tip shipai shah ban ïa uno uno u nongbatai kupar lane u nongleh myntor ha ka shiah lad u baroh kawei .
translation.en: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding , that the king enquired of them , he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm .

translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u long ibha saw doh , bad ka sniehdoh jong u ka long kum ka jaiñkup shñiuh ; kumto la khot kyrngah ïa u , u Iso .
translation.en: And the first came out red , all over like an hairy garment  ; and they called his name Esau .

translation.kha: Bad nga tip ba ka hukum jong u ka wallam ïa ka jingtem bymjukut . Kaei kaba nga ong , namarkata , ka long kaei kaba U Kpa u la iathuh ïa nga ban ong .
translation.en: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting : whatsoever I speak therefore , even as the Father said unto me , so I speak .

translation.kha: Nangta U TRAI’ u la ong ha u Moserah , U Pharaoh u long uba mutlop eh malu u kynti ban shah ïa ki paidbah ban leit .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Pharaoh s heart is hardened , he refuseth to let the people go .

translation.kha: U syiem Rehoboam u ïasyllok bad ki riewbieit kiba la shakri ïa u Solomon u kpa jong u kum ki nongaibuit . kaei ka jubab ba phin ai jingmut ïa nga ba ngan ai ha kine ki Briew ? u kylli .
translation.en: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived , saying , What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people ?

And this shall be a statute for ever unto you : that in the seventh month , on the tenth day of the month , ye shall afflict your souls , and do no work at all , whether it be one of your own country , or a stranger that sojourneth among you :
translation.kha: Kine harum ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba dei ban bud pateng la pateng . Ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew , ki Israel bad ki nongwei kiba shong ryngkat bad ki , ki dei ban shahjingit bad ban ym trei ïa kano kano ka kam .
A ba phin da pyrkhat sngew ïa nga kumta men ka por , ka ïajubab . Nangta ka kitei noh , ka bam ka dih , bad kam shym ar sngewsih shuh .
translation.en: And she said , Let thine handmaid find grace in thy sight . So the woman went her way , and did eat , and her countenance was no more sad .
Thou knowest Abner the son of Ner , that he came to deceive thee , and to know thy going out and thy coming in , and to know all that thou doest .
translation.kha: U la wan shane ban shukor ïa phi bad ban tip ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh bad ïa ka leit ka wan jong phi . Khlem pep , phi tip ïa kata !
Haba U Trai u Iohi ba ka jingieit ka kham duna ïa ka Leah ban ïa ka Hakhlieh , u la pynlah ïa ka ban ïoh Kynhun , hynrei ka Rakal ka ïailong kaba khulom khun .
translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw that Leah was hated , he opened her womb : but Rachel was barren .

translation.kha: U la ïohi ïa uwei na ki ba u la shah lehbeiñ ha u nong Ijipt , kumta u la leit ban ïapra ïa u bun u la pynhiarkput ïa u nong Ijipt da kaba pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And seeing one of them suffer wrong , he defended him , and avenged him that was oppressed , and smote the Egyptian :
Ye are cursed with a curse : for ye have robbed me , even this whole nation .
translation.kha: Ka jingtim ka long halor jong phi baroh namar ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka shukor ïa nga .
Nga don kajuh ka jingkyrmen ha U Blei kaba kine hi ki don , kata , ba ki briew baroh , kiba bakha bad kiba sniew , kin ñiat na ka jingïap .
translation.en: And have hope toward God , which they themselves also allow , that there shall be a resurrection of the dead , both of the just and unjust .

translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi don na ki Saddusi ki la wan sha U Ujuh bad ki la kam ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap .
translation.en: The same day came to him the Sadducees , which say that there is no resurrection , and asked him ,

translation.kha: U tar ïa ka suiñbneng bad u wan thir ; dara u lyoh wahbah dum hapoh ki kjat jong u .
translation.en: He bowed the heavens also , and came down  ; and darkness was under his feet .

translation.kha: Ha ki hukum jong u Sargon , u patsha jong ka Assyria , u rangbah ai hukum bajhieh tam jong ka kynhun shipai Assyria u la tur ïaleh ïa ka Ashdod ka nongbah Philistia .
translation.en: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod , ( when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him , ) and fought against Ashdod , and took it  ;
For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day  ; but have gone from tent to tent , and from one tabernacle to another .
translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba nga la pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt haduh mynta , ngam shym la shong ha ka templ ; nga la shong borabor ha ki ïingjaiñ bad kynriah na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat .

Mynba u Josaïah u longïng symboh , U Trai u la ong ha nga , Hato me la ïohi ïa kaei ba ka Israel , sakma ka kynthei bymïaineh , ka la leh ? Ka la phai lyndet noh na nga , bad halor uwei pa uwei u lum bajrong bad shiah uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam , ka la sa kum ka nuti .
translation.en: The  Lord  said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king , Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done ? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree , and there hath played the harlot .

translation.kha: U la lytar shad ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U tharai bad u ong ha u Joab , U syiem u hukum ba men mih shabar . Em , u Joab u jubab , kan ïahap hangne . U Benaïah u la leit phai sha u syiem bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei ba u Joab u la Ong .
translation.en: And Benaiah came to the tabernacle of the  Lord  , and said unto him , Thus saith the king , Come forth . And he said , Nay  ; but I will die here . And Benaiah brought the king word again , saying , Thus said Joab , and thus he answered me .
In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Joram u khun jong u Ahab kum u syiem ka Israel , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u Jehoram u long u syiem ka Judah

translation.en: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them  ; and the  Lord  delivered them into his hands .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jephthah u jam sha shiliang wah ban ïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad U  Trai  u ai ha u ka jingjop .

translation.en: And again , Praise the Lord , all ye Gentiles ; and laud him , all ye people .
translation.kha: Shuh shuh ka ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U Trai , ko ki Jentil baroh ; ïaroh ïa u , ko ki jaitbynriew baroh!
U Jisu u la jubab , Kaei kaweh U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban leh ka long ban ngeit ha tur ïa uba u la phah .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  This is the work of God , that ye believe on him whom he hath sent .

translation.kha: bad ka Leah ka ïa-ong , katto nga long kaba kmen ! Mynta ki kynthei kin khet ïa nga kaba kmen ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Asher .
translation.en: And Leah said , Happy am I , for the daughters will call me blessed : and she called his name Asher .
And truly , if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out , they might have had opportunity to have returned .
translation.kha: Kim shym la im sngi ban pyrkhat ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba ki la iehnoh ; lada ki leh kumta , kin jin da la ïoh ka kabu ban leit phai pat .
Ki briew kiba na ka jait bashaphang shithi ki phah khot ïa u ; bad baroh ki ïaleit lang sha u Rehoboam , bad ki ong ha u ,
translation.en: And they sent and called him . So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam , saying ,

And the children of Israel said unto him , We will go by the high way : and if I and my cattle drink of thy water , then I will pay for it : I will only , without doing any thing else , go through on my feet .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki ong ,  Ngin ïaid beit na lynti bah , bad lada ma ngi lane ki jingri jong ngi , ngi dih ïa ka um jong phi , ngin da siewdor ïa ka — baroh kaba ngi kwah ka long ban shu ïaid lyngba .
Wat buh ïa ka jingshaniah jongngi phi ha ki nongïalam ba kynja briew ; ym don u brup uba ia ban pyllait im ïa phi .
translation.en: Put not your trust in princes , nor in the son of man , in whom there is no help .

translation.kha: hynrei mynba u dang im , u la ai ki jingai sngewbha ïa ki khulom shynrang ba u la ïoh na kiwei pat ki tnga jongu u . Nangta u phah noh ïa kine ki khun shyieng sha ka ri kaba shaphang mihngi , jngai na u khum jong u , u Isaak .
translation.en: But unto the sons of the concubines , which Abraham had , Abraham gave gifts , and sent them away from Isaac his son , while he yet lived , eastward , unto the east country .

translation.kha: Te u Balak u ong ha u Balaam , Phi leh lei ïa nga kumne ? Ngin la wang ïalam ïa phi hangne ban tim ïa ki nongshun jong per , hynrei phira la kylla pynban ïa ki .
translation.en: And Balak said unto Balaam , What hast thou done unto me ? I took thee to curse mine enemies , and , behold , thou hast blessed them altogether .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Kabul u shakri jong nga u don ka jinglong baïar malu u la ïaineh ha nga , tun wallam ïa u sha “kata ka ri kaba u la shaw , bad ki khun ki ksiew jongu u kin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri
translation.en: But my servant Caleb , because he had another spirit with him , and hath followed me fully , him will I bring into the land whereinto he went  ; and his seed shall possess it .
And Saul asked counsel of God , Shall I go down after the Philistines ? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel ? But he answered him not that day .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u kylli ïa U Blei ,  Hato ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ? Hato men ai ha ngi ka jingjop ?  Hynrei U Blei um shym jubab ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: And Moses made haste , and bowed his head toward the earth , and worshipped .
translation.kha: U Moses u pynkloi ban nguh dem haduh khyndew bad u la mane .

Me long uba khraw bad kiba donbor , uba donburom , uba itynnat bad uba iphieng . khie kiei baroh ha pdeng bad ha khyndew ki dei ki jong me ; me dei u syiemsad , u nongsynshar bahakhlieh hajuh halor Baroh .
translation.en: Thine , O  Lord  , is the greatness , and the power , and the glory , and the victory , and the majesty : for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine  ; thine is the kingdom , O  Lord  , and thou art exalted as head above all .

translation.kha: To kmen ba ngi long ki jongki u ; ai ba baroh kiba miej ïa u kin shadkmen .
translation.en: Glory ye in his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the  Lord .

translation.kha: ( Uta wahbah la ïohi ïa khnai ba ka jia u la kren shaphang jongu ka , khnang ba ma phi ruh phin oh ngeit . Kaei kaba u la ong ka longsyiem kaba shisha , bad u tip ba u kren ïa ka jingshisha . )
translation.en: And he that saw it bare record , and his record is true : and he knoweth that he saith true , that ye might believe .

translation.kha: ban leit beit na ka khop sha ka jingtep , kan jin da la long kaba ba kum ka bym shym don .
translation.en: I should have been as though I had not been  ; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave .
And thou shalt put it on a blue lace , that it may be upon the mitre  ; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be .
translation.kha: Teh ïa ka ha khmat ka jaiñspong da u ksai bajngum .

translation.en: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead , and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall . And there was great indignation against Israel : and they departed from him , and returned to their own land .
translation.kha: Kumta u shim ïa u khun nyngkong jong u , uba dei ban long syiem hadien jong u , bad u la tyrwa ïa u halor ka kynroh shnong kum ka jingkñia sha u blei Moab . Ki Israel ki la sngewshyrkhei bad kumta ki la kynran na ka nongbah bad ki la leit phai sha la ka ri .
( O ho-oid , to la pynïap ruh ïa u Shaphang bad ïa ka long Jong u ; hynrei ngam kynmaw la nga la pynbaptis sa ïabna ïano pat . )
translation.en: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas : besides , I know not whether I baptized any other .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka riewkai ka don ki khun ne ki khun ksiew , ki dei ban nang shuwa nyngkong ban khem ïa ki kam ba kynja mynhyndai ka longsem la Jong hi bad ha kane ka prie ki siew kylliang ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad ïa ki kmierad parad , nabar kata ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
translation.en: But if any widow have children or nephews , let them learn first to shew piety at home , and to requite their parents : for that is good and acceptable before God .
And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense .
translation.kha: U angel jong U Trai u la paw ha u , u da ïeng ha ka liang kamon jong ka duwan ha kaba la thang ïa ka jingiwbih .

translation.en: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them , and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy .
translation.kha: U pynim ïa ki na kito kiba shun ïa ki ; u pyllait ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki .
U Trai u ong , La jingphohsniew ïa ka jingsawa ha rahah , ka jingsat jong ka jingïalam kthang . Ka Rakhel ka ïam namar ki khun jong ka ; ki la ïalap noh , malu kam treh ba yn pyntngen ïa ka .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; A voice was heard in Ramah , lamentation , and bitter weeping  ; Rachel weeping for her children refused to be comforted for her children , because they were not .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , to pynphai noh ïa kato ka briew ha u tnga jongki ka . U dei u nongïathuhlypa , bad un sa ïarwai na ka bynta jongki me , ba kumta men ym ïaw . Khynñiuh lada im pynphai pat ïa ka , la mawjam ïa me ba men ïap , ma me bad ki briew jong me baroh .
translation.en: Now therefore restore the man his wife  ; for he is a prophet , and he shall pray for thee , and thou shalt live : and if thou restore her not , know thou that thou shalt surely die , thou , and all that are thine .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit sha ka jaka shong dara ha Gilgal , bad ki ong ha u Joshua bad ha ki Israel , Ngi la wanlam na ka ri kaba jngai . Ngi kwah ïa phi ban ïateh lok bad ngi .
translation.en: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal , and said unto him , and to the men of Israel , We be come from a far country : now therefore make ye a league with us .

translation.kha: Ar ngut ki kynthei kin to ha ka jaka thylli kpu : Ïa kawei yn shim noh , ïa kawei pat yn iehnoh shadien .
translation.en: Two women shall be grinding at the mill  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .

translation.kha: U Ammon lane u Moab — lane a uno na ki khun ki ksiew jngai ki haduh Kaba shiphew pateng Briew — ym de ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U Troas .
translation.en: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord   ; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the  Lord  for ever :

And if any man said unto him , Let them not fail to burn the fat presently , and then take as much as thy soul desireth  ; then he would answer him , Nay  ; but thou shalt give it me now : and if not , I will take it by force .
translation.kha: Lada uta u briew u jubab ,  Ai ngin leh ïa kaba dei bad ieh kin da thang shuwa ïa ka khleiñ ; nangta sa shim katba phi kwah ,  uta u shakri u lyngdoh u ju ong ,  Em ! Ai noh mynta kumne ! Lym kumta , ngan shim ïa ka da ka bor !
dalade men dang eh kynhun thuh nongrit jong ki , kita kin ym dei ki jong at ; kano kano ka bynta kaba kin ïohphet kan wan na u Ephraim bad u Manasseh .
translation.en: And thy issue , which thou begettest after them , shall be thine , and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance .

translation.kha: Nangta u la pynlong koidi ïa ki khun kynthei u syiem bad ïa ki briew baroh ha Mispah kiba dang sah ïa kiba u Nebat u rangbah shipai u la iehnoh ha ka jingpeit u Jediael . U Ammiel u la smat ïa ki kum ki koidi bad u la leit ha ka phlang jongngi ka ri ki Ammon .
translation.en: Then Ishmael carried away captive all the residue of the people that were in Mizpah , even the king s daughters , and all the people that remained in Mizpah , whom Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had committed to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam : and Ishmael the son of Nethaniah carried them away captive , and departed to go over to the Ammonites .

translation.kha: Uwei u bania uba kyrteng u Timotheus uba la thaw ïa ki dur templ jong ka blei Artemis da ka rupa , bad ka kam jong u ka la pynïohnong shibun eh ïa ki nongtrei .
translation.en: For a certain man named Demetrius , a silversmith , which made silver shrines for Diana , brought no small gain unto the craftsmen  ;

translation.kha: Bad haba la jam ïa phi malu ïalam shad ka ïingbishar , wat khuslai lwep ïa kaei kaba phin kren ; haba ka por kan poi , to kren ïa kaei kaei kaba yn sa ai ha phi ha kata ka por . Namar ki ktien kba phin sa kren-ïa , kin ym long ki jngai phi ; kin wan na U Mynsiem! Bakhuid .
translation.en: But when they shall lead you , and deliver you up , take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak , neither do ye premeditate : but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour , that speak ye : for it is not ye that speak , but the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban kynthrong , ko ki parabangeit jong at , ba bishni nga la thmu ban wan jngoh ïa phi , hynrei don kaei kaei kaba la ju khanglad ïa na borabor na ka leh kumta . Ngin khwai ban jop ïa ki mynsiem napdeng jong phi ruh , kumba nga la ju leh phangpdeng kiwei! ki Jentil .
translation.en: Now I would not have you ignorant , brethren , that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you , (but was let hitherto ,) that I might have some fruit among you also , even as among other Gentiles .

translation.kha: Wat ïalam ïa ngi sha ka jingtynjuh kaba eh , hynrei sumar ïada ïa ngi na Uba Sniew . Naba ka jong me long ka hima , bad ka bor , bad ka burom junom . Amen .’
translation.en: And lead us not into temptation , but deliver us from evil : For thine is the kingdom , and the power , and the glory , for ever . Amen .

translation.kha: Ka ktien jong U Trai ka la phriang kyllan ha sakma ka thain .
translation.en: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region .

translation.kha: Dem ka jingngeit kaba la ïada ïa ka Rahab ka naki na kob shah pynïap lak bad kito ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa U Blei ; naba ka la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nongsyntiat na Israel .
translation.en: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not , when she had received the spies with peace .

translation.kha: Me hi man ïoh ka jingpang shabar ha ki snier ka ba-bang khnam jur na katai ka sngi sha kawei pat .
translation.en: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels , until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day .
And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth  ; for I have hoped in thy judgments .
translation.kha: Pynlah ïa nga ban kren ïa ka jingshisha ha ki por baroh , namar ka jingkyrmen jong nga ka long ha ki jingbishar jong me .

translation.en: But though he had done so many miracles before them , yet they believed not on him :
translation.kha: Wat la U Jisu u la leh ïa kine ki kambah baroh ha khmat jong ki , kim shym la ngeit ha u , ba yn pyndep ïa kaei kaba u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa u la ong ba kan long shisha :

translation.en: Consistent with the laws of genetics , we have inherited that imperfection and death . —Romans 5 :12 .
translation.kha: Namar ba ngi dei ki khun jong ki ngi la iohpateng ia kita ki jingbymjanai bad jingiap . —Nong Rom 5 :12 .
lem bad u Elisaphan u khun Jong u Ussiel kum u rangbah kur .
translation.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation : and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest .

translation.kha: Kan shim por ïa ki Israel iehnoh bnai ban tep ïa ki batip bhor bad ban pynlong khuid pat ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them , that they may cleanse the land .
Why standest thou afar off , O  Lord  ? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble ?
translation.kha: Balei me don jngai palat , A  Trai  ? Balei me buhrieh ïa lade haba ngi don ha ka jynjar ?
Ha ka jaka rung sha ka nongbah , harud ki khapbrip , ka pyut :
translation.en: She crieth at the gates , at the entry of the city , at the coming in at the doors .
And Ephraim their father mourned many days , and his brethren came to comfort him .
translation.kha: U Ephraim u kpa jong ki u ïambriew na ka bynta jong ki bun sngi , bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong u ki wan pyntngen ïa u .

malu to kylla-kaba-mut bad pynrit ïa laiñ ha khmat jrong nga , da katba kad ïa la ki jaiñ bad da kaba ïam , lehbha me ïohsngew kumno nga la byrngem ban pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jong ka .
translation.en: Because thine heart was tender , and thou didst humble thyself before God , when thou heardest his words against this place , and against the inhabitants thereof , and humbledst thyself before me , and didst rend thy clothes , and weep before me  ; I have even heard thee also , saith the  Lord .

And David said to Abishai , and to all his servants , Behold , my son , which came forth of my bowels , seeketh my life : how much more now may this Benjamite do it ? let him alone , and let him curse  ; for the  Lord  hath bidden him .
translation.kha: Bad u Dabid u ong ha u Abishai bad ha ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ,  U khun jong nga hi u pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga , te balei phin lyngngoh ïa une u nong Benjamin ? U  Trai  u la ong ïa u ban tim ; kumta wat pynwit ïa u , ai un leh ïa ka .
Ka shang ka la don ka jingtep ba la Shna da ka sisa . Katba de dang khmih’ , la plied ïa ka jingtep , sad hangta hapoh ka shang la shong ka kynthei !
translation.en: And , behold , there was lifted up a talent of lead : and this is a woman that sitteth in the midst of the ephah .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa u syiem uba kum u shakri jong nga u ïaiban ba un erlangthari uwei u nongri jong ki , bad un sumar bha ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will set up one shepherd over them , and he shall feed them , even my servant David  ; he shall feed them , and he shall be their shepherd .

translation.kha: Ki Etam ki siew khajna ha u Ussah , bad u sylla long uba khlaiñbor haduh katta kata ba ka nam Jong u ka phriang wat shadong shaei Ijipt .
translation.en: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah : and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt  ; for he strengthened himself exceedingly .
