translation.en: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the  Lord  , and find the knowledge of God .

translation.kha: Nga la buh u pud ïa ka duriaw bad nga la buh ïa ka haduh ki khyrdop babha la khang .
translation.en: And brake up for it my decreed place , and set bars and doors ,

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba une u bariew , u Boas , uba phi la ïadei lem bad ki kynthei Jong u , u dei u ba-ha-ïing jong ngi . shahshkor mynta . Ha kane ka janmiet un leit dung ïa u barli .
translation.en: And now is not Boaz of our kindred , with whose maidens thou wast ? Behold , he winnoweth barley to night in the threshingfloor .

translation.kha: baroh ki dkhot jong ka ïinglieng ki lah ban pule pur mar pynïadait , ngat barieh ki haw ban ïamih ïa kaei kaba ki sngewthuh .
translation.en: A portion of the reading could be assigned to each family member , and then all can discuss what was learned from the Scriptures .

translation.kha: Ka la khah na u ïa u Simran , u Jokshan , u Medan , u Midian , u Ishbak , bad u Shuah .
translation.en: And she bare him Zimran , and Jokshan , and Medan , and Midian , and Ishbak , and Shuah .

And Samuel said to Saul , Why hast thou disquieted me , to bring me up ? And Saul answered , I am sore distressed  ; for the Philistines make war against me , and God is departed from me , and answereth me no more , neither by prophets , nor by dreams : therefore I have called thee , that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha u Saul ,  Balei me la pynthut ïa nga ? Balei me pynlong ïa nga ban wan pat ?  U Saul u jubab ,  Nga la poi ha ka khim khait ! Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma ïa nga , bad U Blei u la iehnoh ïa nga . Um shym jubab shuh ïa nga , la da ki nongïathuhlypa , lane da ki jingphohsniew . Bad kumta nga la khot ïa phi ba phin ïathuh ïa nga aïu nga dei ban leh .
Ko ki kynrad , to long kiba beit bad kiba hok ha ka jingkam kaba phi ni ïa ki mraw jong phi . pynkynmaw ba ma phi ruh phi don U Kynrad ha bneng .
translation.en: Masters , give unto your servants that which is just and equal ; knowing that ye also have a Master in heaven .

translation.kha: Ki synran ki la sngewkyndit Halor kine ki ktien , hynrei U Jisu u la ong shuh shuh , Ko khun jong nga , katno ka long kaweh eh ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei !
translation.en: And the disciples were astonished at his words . But Jesus answereth again , and saith unto them ,  Children , how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God !

translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ka jingtipbriew bhor kawei ba kane ka dei ka kherub jong U Trai Nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem kiba dang shong dang sah ha ka ri jong ki : Kun kyiuh haba ki bam bad ken khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng hir ki dih . Ïa ka ri jong ki yn sloit lyngkhuit , nongmareh uwei uwei baroh ibha shong hangta u long ibha thurmur .
translation.en: And say unto the people of the land , Thus saith the Lord  God  of the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and of the land of Israel  ; They shall eat their bread with carefulness , and drink their water with astonishment , that her land may be desolate from all that is therein , because of the violence of all them that dwell therein .

translation.kha: ngi de ban nguh ha ka jingpyndem , namar dang lah Ban don ka jingkyrmen .
translation.en: He putteth his mouth in the dust  ; if so be there may be hope .

translation.kha: U la pynduh jaiñjot ïa baroh ki sdien shngain bad kynthei kaba shakri ha ki duwan jongnga ki blei thala kiba dang sah nongdih ki sngi u Ita u kba jong u .
translation.en: And the remnant of the sodomites , which remained in the days of his father Asa , he took out of the land .
And Jeremiah said to Seraiah , When thou comest to Babylon , and shalt see , and shalt read all these words  ;
translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa u Seraïah ,  Haba men poi ha Babilon , pynthikna ban pule jam ha ki briew ïa kiei kiei baroh ba la thoh hangne .

U syiem u la klet ïa ka jingshakri baklang ba u Jehoïada , u kpa jong u Sekharaïah u la ai ïa u , bad u la phah pynjop ïa u Sekharaïah . Shuwa ba u Sekharaïah un ïarep , u pyrta , Ai ba U tharai un ïohi ïa kai kaba ph leh bad un pynshitom ïa phi !
translation.en: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him , but slew his son . And when he died , he said , The  Lord  look upon it , and require it .

translation.kha: U synran ïa uba U Jehu u ieit u la ong ha u Peris , U den U Trai ! Haba u Petros u la ïohsngew ba dei U Trai , u tap da ka jaiñ ïa la ka met ( naba u la loit khong ïa la ki jaiñphong ) bad u la ryngkoh shapoh um .
translation.en: Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter , It is the Lord . Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord , he girt his fisher s coat unto him , ( for he was naked , ) and did cast himself into the sea .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Gihon , Ngan pyllait im ïa me bad ngan ai ha me ka jingap halor ki Midian da ki laispah jrut ki rangbah katba shu jylla ïa ka um . Ong ïa kiwei bapaw kine leit noh sha ïing .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Gideon , By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you , and deliver the Midianites into thine hand : and let all the other people go every man unto his place .

translation.kha: Ynda me ïap , bad la tep ïa me bad ki kpa tymmen jong me , ngan thung syiem ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ka hima jongngi u .
translation.en: And when thy days be fulfilled , and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers , I will set up thy seed after thee , which shall proceed out of thy bowels , and I will establish his kingdom .
Behold , your house is left unto you desolate : and verily I say unto you , Ye shall not see me , until the time come when ye shall say , Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa ka Templ jong pha yn iehnoh . Nga pynthikna ïa pha ba phan ym ïohi ïa nga tad ynda ka por ka poi haba phan ong , ‘ U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai .’

translation.en: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease , and that this city be not builded , until another commandment shall be given from me .
translation.kha: Namarkata phi dei ban pynmih ki hukum ba kito ki rangbah kin sangeh noh na ka jingtei pat ïa ka nongbah haduh ba ngan da ai hukum da kumwei pat .
Ki kpa tymmen jrong ngi ki la bam ïa ka mana ha ri shyiap , kamar ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U la ai ha ki ïa u kpu na bneng ba kin bam .’
translation.en: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert  ; as it is written , He gave them bread from heaven to eat .
The sons of Shemaiah  ; Othni , and Rephael , and Obed , Elzabad , whose brethren were strong men , Elihu , and Semachiah .
translation.kha: U Shemaïah , u khun nyngkong jong u Obed Edom , u don hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Othni , u Rephael , u Obed , u Elsabad , u Elihu , bad u Semakhaïah . Ki dei ki rangbah kiba donkam ha ka kur jong ki namar ka jingtbit palat jong ki ; ki ar ngut kiba khatduh , ki long kiba don ka sap bakyrpang .
To ïa-ap bad to duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi . Ka mynsiem ka ma , hynriewphew ka doh ka tlot .
translation.en: Watch and pray , that ye enter not into temptation : the spirit indeed is willing , but the flesh is weak .
That the slayer might flee thither , which should kill his neighbour unawares , and hated him not in times past  ; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live :
translation.kha: sha kiba u briew u lah ban phet rieh bad lait im lada jia ba u kum pynïap ïa uno uno u briew u bym dei u nongshun jong u . U lah ban phet rieh sha kawei na kine ki shnong bad un ym shah pynïap .
Ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ka la jan .
translation.en: And the passover , a feast of the Jews , was nigh .

translation.kha: Hobah u Gideon u ïohsngew shaphrang ka jingphohsniew jong uta u briew bad ba ka ngut kumno , u dem khohsiew khrup malade u mane ïa U Terah . Nangta u leit pait pat shwa ka jaka sher dara ki Israel , bad u ong , Khie joit ! U Trai u ai ha phi ka jingjop halor ka kynhun shipai jong ki Midian !
translation.en: And it was so , when Gideon heard the telling of the dream , and the interpretation thereof , that he worshipped , and returned into the host of Israel , and said , Arise  ; for the  Lord  hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian .

translation.kha: hynrei ïahap pa’ la rung shata ka ri kaba bah , phi la kdang mala sngewhun , bad nangta phi la sngewhun bad khet noh ïa nga .
translation.en: According to their pasture , so were they filled  ; they were filled , and their heart was exalted  ; therefore have they forgotten me .
This I had , because I kept thy precepts .
translation.kha: Nga shem ïa ka jingkmen jong nga ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .

translation.en: And they were all amazed , and spake among themselves , saying , What a word is this ! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits , and they come out .
translation.kha: Ki briew baroh ki la sngewphylla bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Ki jait ktien aïu kine ? Da ka iktiar bad ka bor une u briew u ai ki hukum ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid , bad ki ïamihnoh !
Pynban , to lehsbun bad long jemnud aiwai ïa wei pat , bad to ïamap iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba U Blei u la map ïa phi ha U Khrist .
translation.en: And be ye kind one to another , tenderhearted , forgiving one another , even as God for Christ s sake hath forgiven you .

translation.kha: Ai ba u kew bad ki ñiup kin ïasan lang tad haduh ka aïom ot . Nangta ngan ong ha ki nongot shun rat nyngkong ïa ki ñiut , ban tehsong ïa ki bad ban thang ïa ki , bad nangta baneh lumlang shapoh ïa u kew nabar buh ïa u ha ka thiar lad nga .’
translation.en: Let both grow together until the harvest : and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers , Gather ye together first the tares , and bind them in bundles to burn them : but gather the wheat into my barn .
And I answered again , and said unto him , What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves ?
translation.kha: Bad kaei ka jingmut jong ki ar tylli ki tnat dieng Olib hajan ki ar tylli ki tyndong ksiar na kaba la phylliew ïa ka umphniang Olib ?

translation.en: I John , who also am your brother , and companion in tribulation , and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ , was in the isle that is called Patmos , for the word of God , and for the testimony of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Nga long u Ïoannis , u parabangeit jong phi , bad kum u nongbud jong U Jisu nga long uba ïadon bynta lem bad phi ban ïaishah ïa ka jingjynjar kaba wan ha kito kiba long na ka Hima jong u . Ïa nga la buh ha ka dewlynnong Patmos namar nga la pynbna ïa ka Ktien U Blei bad ka jingshisha kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw .
len ai ki kambah ha ka sahit bneng shajrong bad ïa ki jingphylla ha ka khyndew sha tbian . Kan don ka snam , ka ding , bad ka tdem kaba rben ;
translation.en: And I will shew wonders in heaven above , and signs in the earth beneath  ; blood , and fire , and vapour of smoke :

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Hesion , Pynkyrteng ïa u , u ‘ Jesreel ,’ namar kan ym slem Shuh shuwa ba Ngan pynshitom ïa u syiem ki Israel namar ki kam pynjop briew ba u kpa tymmen jong u , u Jehu u la leh ha Jediael . nur pynkut nep ïa ka jingsynshar na ka longïing syiem jong u Jehu .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Call his name Jezreel  ; for yet a little while , and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu , and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut ki Jia na ka probins jong ka Ahian ki la don hangta ; ki hi ki dei ban waiñ ha khnam jong me badno buh ïa ki jingmudui jongno ki ïada ki ei ei ei pyrshah ïa la .
translation.en: Who ought to have been here before thee , and object , if they had ought against me .
Thus hath the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me , to take away my reproach among men .
translation.kha: Mynta khatduh U Trai u la ïarap ïa nga ,  ka la ong .  U la shim noh ïa ka jahburom jong nga hapdeng ki briew !
ka Siph , ka Telem , ka Bealoth ,
translation.en: Ziph , and Telem , and Bealoth ,

translation.kha: Ar ngut ki briew ki lah ban ïada na ka jingtur ïalang kaban lah ngab jop ïa u brup ba tang marwei . U tyllai suba la jyrthiaw da ki kad tylli ki tyllai u long uba jwat ban ïakit .
translation.en: And if one prevail against him , two shall withstand him  ; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha kata ka briew , Ïa ki pop jong pha la map .
translation.en: And he said unto her ,  Thy sins are forgiven .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , namar ka jingisynei kaba phi la ïohpdiang , ki jlew mynta kim jongu ïa U blang , khnang ba ma ki ruh mynnin kin ïohsngew ïa ka jingisynei U Blei .
translation.en: Even so have these also now not believed , that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy .

translation.kha: Napdeng pli kiba ki paid Israel ki la pynïap , u dei u Balaam , u nongkren byrtong , u khun jong u Beor .
translation.en: Balaam also the son of Beor , the soothsayer , did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them .

translation.kha: Mynta u Trai , U Trai Badonbor baroh un sa shngiam noh na Jerusalem bad Judah ïa kaei kaei baroh’ bad ïa eiei pa uwei ba ki briew ki shaniah . Un smat noh ïa ka jingbam bad ka um jong ki ,
translation.en: For , behold , the Lord , the  Lord  of hosts , doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff , the whole stay of bread , and the whole stay of water ,
And he said , Amos , what seest thou ? And I said , A basket of summer fruit . Then said the  Lord  unto me , The end is come upon my people of Israel  ; I will not again pass by them any more .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kylli ,  Ko Amos , me ïohi aïu ?   Shi shang ki soh ,  nga la jubab . Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Kaba kut ka la wan ha ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan ym kylla shuh la ka jingmut shaphang kaba pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: And Jesus , when he had found a young ass , sat thereon  ; as it is written ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la shem ïa u kada bad u la shong halor jong u , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,

Nga la phah ïa ka khlam ha phi kum kata kaba sa la phah ha Ieit . Nga la pynïap ïa ki samla shynrang jong phi ha ka thma bad nga la knieh noh ïa ki kulai jong phi . Nga la pyndap ïa ki thliew khmut jongu phi da ka jingiwtung ki metïap ha ki jaka shong dara jong phi . Katta hima phim shym la wan pei pat sha nga .
translation.en: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt : your young men have I slain with the sword , and have taken away your horses  ; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta kita ki briew ki leit wad phlang khyllung ka ri jingtep .
translation.en: So the people were scattered abroad throughout all the land of Egypt to gather stubble instead of straw .

translation.kha: Ki shna ar tylli ki jingteh tyrpeng bad ki pyndait ïa ki ha ki rmiang jong ka ephod na baroh erïong , khnap ba lah ban teh skhem ïa ka .
translation.en: They made shoulderpieces for it , to couple it together : by the two edges was it coupled together .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Jonathan u Ong ha u sumar uba buh ïa ki aiti jong u , Ïa ngin leit shat shyieng sha ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia . Hynrei u Jonathan um shym ïathuh ha la u kpa , u Saul
translation.en: Now it came to pass upon a day , that Jonathan the son of Saul said unto the young man that bare his armour , Come , and let us go over to the Philistines  garrison , that is on the other side . But he told not his father .
And Gederoth , Beth–dagon , and Naamah , and Makkedah  ; sixteen cities with their villages :
translation.kha: ka Gederoth , ka Bethdagon , ka Naamah , bad ka Makkedah : khathynriew tylli ki nongbah lem ruh bad ki nongrit kiba don sawdong jong ki .
U Trai U blei jong phi u isih ïa ki brai katba leh ïa kine ki kam kiba isaitmet , bad dei namar katai ba u la beh nala ïa Kita ki jaitbynriew na —kata ka ri katba phi nang tur sha khmat .
translation.en: For all that do these things are an abomination unto the  Lord  : and because of these abominations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee .

translation.kha: mynba u Jehoïakim u khun jongnga u Josaïah u long u shym ka Jehoïada , U Trai u la ong ha nga .
translation.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , saying ,

translation.kha: Nangta u la khot ïa la ki shakri bad u la ong ha ki , ‘ La thep khreh ïa ka jingkhawai jong to , hynrei ki briew kiba nga la khot sngewbha kim don hok shun ïoh ïa ka .
translation.en: Then saith he to his servants , The wedding is ready , but they which were bidden were not worthy .
And all the congregation lifted up their voice , and cried  ; and the people wept that night .
translation.kha: Baroh shi miet ki paidbah ki la kyang ha ka jingnoh mynsiem .

Mynba , U Blei u la pynlong ïa ki Jingkular jngai u ha u Abraham bad ha u jinghiarpateng jong u . Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kam khim pyndonnam da ki kyntien ki nonghiarpateng , kaban taïew shibun ki Briew , hynrei ka pyndonkam da ka kyntien u nonghiarpateng , kaba mut tang uwei u briew , kaba mut U Khrist .
translation.en: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made . He saith not , And to seeds , as of many ; but as of one , And to thy seed , which is Christ .

translation.kha: Wat sarong shaphang kaba lashai . Phim tip Aïu kan jia hapdeng mynta bad hadien .
translation.en: Boast not thyself of to morrow  ; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth .

translation.kha: Ngan sa wanlam pat ïa phi! , ki briew Jong nga ki Israel ban shong biang ha ka ri . KA long noh ka ri jong phi nabar ki khun jong phi kin ym kyiad bam .
translation.en: Yea , I will cause men to walk upon you , even my people Israel  ; and they shall possess thee , and thou shalt be their inheritance , and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of men .

And Terah took Abram his son , and Lot the son of Haran his son s son , and Sarai his daughter in law , his son Abram s wife  ; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldeans , to go into the land of Canaan  ; and they came unto Haran , and dwelt there .
translation.kha: U Terah u shim ïa u Abram u khun jong u , ïa u Lot u ksiew jong u , uba long u khun jong u Haran , bad ïa ka pyrsa kurim jong u ka Sarai , ka tnga jong u Abram , bad ki ïamih lang noh na ka shnong Ur kaba ha ka ri Babilonia ban leit sha ka ri Kanaan . Ki la leit haduh ha Haran bad ki la ïashong ïasah noh hangta .

translation.en: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God s elect ? It is God that justifieth .
translation.kha: Uei u ban mudui ïa kiba la jied jong U Blei ? U Blei hi da lade u la pynbna ba ki long khlem pop!

translation.en: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem , and had taken it , and smitten it with the edge of the sword , and set the city on fire .
translation.kha: Ki paid Judah ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem bad ki kurup ïa ka . Ki pynïap ïa ki briew jong ka bad ki wiang ding ïa ka nongbah .

translation.en: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gath–hepher , to Eth–kazin , and goeth out to Rimmon–methoar to Neah  ;
translation.kha: U bteng nangta sha ka phang mihngi haduh Gath Hepher bad Ethkasin , da kaba phai ha ka liang jong ka Neah ha ka lynti sha Rimmon .

translation.en: The nobleman saith unto him , Sir , come down ere my child die .
translation.kha: Ko Kynrad ,  la phai ktien u rangbah synshar ,  to wan bad nga shuwa ba u khun jong nga un ïap .

translation.en: He said unto them ,  But whom say ye that I am ?  Peter answering said , The Christ of God .
translation.kha: Kumno pat ma phi ?  u la kylli ïa ki .  Phi ong ba nga long uei ?  U Petros u la jubab ,  Me long U Messaïah jong U Blei .
Ma ka bad ki khunlung kynthei jong ka ki la sngewkthang nabar ki la don kyrhai ban baibam bad im ha ka jingsuk bad ka jingjar jar , hynrei kim shym la sumar ïa kiba duk bad ïa katba rangli .
translation.en: Behold , this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom , pride , fulness of bread , and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters , neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy .

translation.kha: Ngi la leit da ka lieng na iphylla hadien ka Jingkhawai Niam U kput Bakhlem Thiat , bad hadien syn sngi ngi la ïasoh ïa ki ha Troas , ha naba ngi la sah shu taïew .
translation.en: And we sailed away from Philippi after the days of unleavened bread , and came unto them to Troas in five days  ; where we abode seven days .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , To shahshkor ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïam ha Babilon , jong ka jingïam pangnud namar ka jingpynjot ha ka ri .
translation.en: A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon , and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans :

translation.kha: Namar phi long kum ka tnat jong u dieng Abib khlaw ïa uba la pynkheiñ bad nangta , ïa-pyrshah ïa ka jinglong tynrai , la pynïasoh bad u dieng Olib ba la thung . Ki Jiw ki long kum une u dieng uba la thung ; bad kan long naba kham shok ïa U Blei pun pynïasoh biang ïa kine ki tnat ba la pynkheiñ sha ki dieng jongki ki hi .
translation.en: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature , and wert grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree : how much more shall these , which be the natural branches , be grafted into their own olive tree ?

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba leh jubor ki shukor ïa la ki paralok mala ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingit .
translation.en: A violent man enticeth his neighbour , and leadeth him into the way that is not good .

translation.kha: Pha long ka jat nud ka kyr-ang . Ym don mano mano ba pynbor ïa pha ban long kumne . Pha shym ïoh jingsiew , phai thret ïa ki ! Ho-oid , pha long kaba pher .
translation.en: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms , whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms : and in that thou givest a reward , and no reward is given unto thee , therefore thou art contrary .

translation.kha: Bad wat sngewkhuslai haba phi ïohsngew ki jingsawa ki thma hajan jong phi badno ïa ki khubor jong ki thma jngai na phi . Ka dei ïa keiñ kiei ktien ban jia , hynrei kam mut ba ka jingkut ka la long .
translation.en: And when ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars , be ye not troubled : for such things must needs be  ; but the end shall not be yet .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la khmied biang ha baroh ki jingbymlehhok kaba trei ha kane ka pyrthei . Kiba la shah banbeiñ ki lynñiar , mala ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa ki . Ym don ma ma ban ïarap ïa ki namar ki nongïapeiñ jongki ki , ki don ka bor ha ka liang jong ki .
translation.en: So I returned , and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun : and behold the tears of such as were oppressed , and they had no comforter  ; and on the side of their oppressors there was power  ; but they had no comforter .

translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki paid Eliel baroh , Kane ka lama kaei naba U Trai u la hukum :
translation.en: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Israel , saying , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded , saying ,

translation.kha: U Abner u pyrta ïa u Joab , Hato ngin ïahap ban ïaleh syang junom ? Hato mem ïor ba ha kaba kut ym don ei ei Hynrei tang ka jingkthang ? Ngi long ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong Phi . Slem sa katno ha shuwa ba men hukum ïa ki ïabah jong me ban sangeh na naba beh kthong ïa ngi ?
translation.en: Then Abner called to Joab , and said , Shall the sword devour for ever ? knowest thou not that it will be bitterness in the latter end ? how long shall it be then , ere thou bid the people return from following their brethren ?

translation.kha: U Aaron malu ki khun shynrang jong u ki dei ban thiat ïa la ki kti badno sait ïa la ki kjap
translation.en: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat :

translation.kha: Kito kiba dat jong ka pyrthei ki long kum uta uba la thaw na ka dewmet ; pli kiba dei jongnga ka bneng ki long kumne uta umbah la wan na bneng .
translation.en: As is the earthy , such are they also that are earthy : and as is the heavenly , such are they also that are heavenly .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa ki — Ngin kam ïa ki Khlieh jongno ki bad kun ieh lyndang ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion , and the  Lord  will discover their secret parts .

translation.kha: Nga la dep ïathuh ïa ki paidbah baroh kiei kiei kiba U Trai U balui lad ki u la phah ïa sa ban ong ha ki .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Jeremiah had made an end of speaking unto all the people all the words of the  Lord  their God , for which the  Lord  their God had sent him to them , even all these words ,

translation.kha: Khie ithuh ! Nga phah ïa phin kum ki khunlangbrot pynpdang ki suri .
translation.en: Go your ways : behold , I send you forth as lambs among wolves .

translation.kha: Un synreit ruh hynñiew sien ïa kata ka snam ha ka met Utai u bhabriew ïa uba yn dang pynkhlad na ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh , nabar hadien katai un sa pynmanbha ba u long uba khuid . Un pyllait noh ïa kata ka bai kaba dang im ba kan her kat shaba ka mon .
translation.en: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times , and shall pronounce him clean , and shall let the living bird loose into the open field .

translation.kha: To pynkhiah ïa kiba pang , to pynim pat ïa kiba ïap , to pynkdiah ïa kito kiba shitom na ki jingap ñiangthohlieh , bad to beh noh ïa ki ksuid . Phi la ïohpdiang ei , kumta to ai ei .
translation.en: Heal the sick , cleanse the lepers , raise the dead , cast out devils : freely ye have received , freely give .

translation.kha: Kun long ka dak kaba sakhi ïa ka jingbishar U Blei ha phi bad ha ki khup ki ksiew jongno phi junom .
translation.en: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder , and upon thy seed for ever .
And David smote the land , and left neither man nor woman alive , and took away the sheep , and the oxen , and the asses , and the camels , and the apparel , and returned , and came to Achish .
translation.kha: ki da pynïap lut ïa ki shynrang bad ki kynthei baroh , bad rah noh ïa ki langbrot , ki masi , ki kada , ki ut , bad wat ïa ki jaiñkup jaiñsem ruh .
Ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ine sad Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Grace be to you and peace from God the Father , and from our Lord Jesus Christ ,

translation.kha: Hynriew ki jingkylla jong phi kim wandur jingbabe ei ei ïa pa’ — ki Long bajyrngam kum ka jaiñphong ba la thain da ka snur thalab !
translation.en: Their webs shall not become garments , neither shall they cover themselves with their works : their works are works of iniquity , and the act of violence is in their hands .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba katsha , ka sngi ha kaba ka Jingkhawai Niam kambah Neah hynñiew sngap ka sdang ; ha kata ka por Dei ban ïam Teng ïa u kpu ba la shet khlem thiat .
translation.en: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast : seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten .

translation.kha: U briew um donkam ban tap ïa la ka khlieh , ñiar u pynphriang ïa ka dur bad ka burom U Blei . Hynrei ka briew ka pynphalang ïa ka burom jong u briew ; naba ïa u briew ym shym la sloit ïa na ka Briew , Hynrei ïa ka briew na u briew .
translation.en: For the man is not of the woman ; but the woman of the man .
Why don't you like me ?
translation.kha: Balei phim sngewtynnad ianga ?

translation.en: For , behold , I will shake mine hand upon them , and they shall be a spoil to their servants : and ye shall know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  da lade hi un ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi , bad ïa phi yn sa lute da ki briew kiba shisien ki la long ki shakri jong phi .  Haba kane ka jia , uwei uwei baroh un tip ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa nga .

Hato me pyrkhat ba men sa long u syiem bad synshar ïa i ? Ki hynmen shynrang jongu u ki ong . Kumba ki la nang kham isih Shuh shuh ïa u namar ki jingphohsniew jong u bad namar kaei kaba ba u la kren-ïa shaphang jongu ki .
translation.en: And his brethren said to him , Shalt thou indeed reign over us ? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us ? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams , and for his words .
And this they did , not as we hoped , but first gave their own selves to the Lord , and unto us by the will of God .
translation.kha: Ka la long palat ban ïa kaba ngi la khmih lynti! Nyngkong ki la aiti ïa lade ha U Trai ; bad nangta , da ka mon U Blei ki la aiti ïa lade ha ngi ruh .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people  ; Ye have scattered my flock , and driven them away , and have not visited them : behold , I will visit upon you the evil of your doings , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong shaphang ki nongsynshar kiba la tharai ba kin sumar ïa ki briew jong u :  Phim shym la sumar bha ïa ki briew jong nga ; phi la pynsakma ïa ki bad phi la beh noh ïa ki . Mynta ngan pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingbymman jong phi kaba phi la leh .
U Dabid u dei u khun khatduh , bad katba ki lai ngut shi para kiba nyngkong ki sah” bad u Saul ,
translation.en: And David was the youngest : and the three eldest followed Saul .

translation.kha: Un aiti ha phi ïa ki syep Jong ki . Phin pynïap ïa ki , bad yn klet nep ïa ki . Yn ym don mano mano ban khang ïa phi ; phin pynjot ïa ki bhor .
translation.en: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand , and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven : there shall no man be able to stand before thee , until thou have destroyed them .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don u briew wahbah kyrteng u Manoah na ka shongneh Sorah . U dei na ka jait Dang . Ka tnga jong u kdew pateng shym la lah ban ïoh khun .
translation.en: And there was a certain man of Zorah , of the family of the Danites , whose name was Manoah  ; and his wife was barren , and bare not .
Art thou called being a servant ? care not for it : but if thou mayest be made free , use it rather .
translation.kha: Hato phi la long u mraw mynba U Blei u la khot ïa phi ? Kam pher , wat pynkhuslai ei ei ; hynrei lada phi ïoh ïa ka lad ban long uba laitluid , pyndonkam ïa ka .

translation.en: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jerusha , the daughter of Zadok .
translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba arphew san snem , bad u synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jerusha ka khun jong u Sadok .

Lada la bam ïa ka ha ka sngi kabu lai , U Blei un ym pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jong uta u briew . Ïa kata ka jingainguh yn ym ñiew kumin ka jingainguh jong u Hynrei yn kheiñ ba ka long ka bymïap , bad uno uno uba bam-im ïa ka un kit hi ïa la ka pop .
translation.en: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day , it shall not be accepted , neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it : it shall be an abomination , and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity .

translation.kha: Namar ba U Jisu Khrist u la leh ïa katei kabu U Blei u kwah ïa u ban leh , ïa ngi baroh la pynkhuid na ka nongpop da ka jingainguh kaba u la aiti ïa la ka jongki ka met tang shisien hi .
translation.en: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all .
And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob , and he loved the damsel , and spake kindly unto the damsel .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u shem ba ka samla ka long kaba i-ieit kat haduh ba u la ïapmat ïa ka , bad u la pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewieit na ka .
Kine ki Briew ki kwah ïa u jait nongpynkhiah uba ïaid kylleng suba dap da ka lamler malade jingshukor bad u ino , ‘ Nga ïathuhlypa ba ka waiñ bad ka kyiad kin thwet na ka bynta jong phi .’
translation.en: If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie , saying , I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink  ; he shall even be the prophet of this people .

translation.kha: Ngi tip , ko syiem kynrad , haduh katno phi kaweh ban kem ïa u ; kumta to wan shaw ka ri jong ngi , bad ngin pynthikna ba phi ïohkem ïa u .
translation.en: Now therefore , O king , come down according to all the desire of thy soul to come down  ; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king s hand .

translation.kha: Kum kita ki briew ki longïing kiba bieit eh shun tip ïa kiei kaba ki leh . Ki khapbrip ïa la ki khmat nabar ïa la ki jingmut na ka jingshisha .
translation.en: They have not known nor understood : for he hath shut their eyes , that they cannot see  ; and their hearts , that they cannot understand .

translation.kha: Nalor kata , hato ki wieh Abana bad Pharpar kiba ha Damaskos kim khampoh bha ban ïa kano kane ka wah ha Israel ? nga lah ban meng ha ki bad ban ïitkhmih !
translation.en: Are not Abana and Pharpar , rivers of Damascus , better than all the waters of Israel ? may I not wash in them , and be clean ? So he turned and went away in a rage .
And he called one of the servants , and asked what these things meant .
translation.kha: Kumta u la khot ïa uwei na ki shakri bad u la kylli ïa u , ‘ Ka jia aïu ?’
Nga kner ïa la ki kti , hynrei ym don mano mei ban ïarap ïa nga . U Trai u la ïakhot ïa ki nongshun pyrshah ïa nga na ki liang baroh ; ki la leh ïa nga kum ïa kaei khie kaba jakhlia .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath done that which he had devised  ; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old : he hath thrown down , and hath not pitied : and he hath caused thine enemy to rejoice over thee , he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries .

translation.kha: U ong ha u Abraham , Kane barabor ka dei ka ri jong nga ; to shong to sah katto ha kaba me kwah .
translation.en: And Abimelech said , Behold , my land is before thee : dwell where it pleaseth thee .

translation.kha: Ka por lai wan haba baroh na phi phin bret noh ïa ki bleithaw bapop kiba phi la thaw na ka rupa bad ka ksiar .
translation.en: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver , and his idols of gold , which your own hands have made unto you for a sin .
Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin , altars shall be unto him to sin .
translation.kha: Katba nang bun ki duwan ba ki paid Israel ki thaw ban pynkhuid ïa ki pop , katta nang bun ki jaka ba ki ïoh ban leh pop .

translation.en: And Jehu said , Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal . And they proclaimed it .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehu u hukum ,  Pynbna ïa ka sngi jong ka jingmane ban lehburom ïa u Baal !

translation.en: And old shoes and clouted upon their feet , and old garments upon them  ; and all the bread of their provision was dry and mouldy .
translation.kha: Ki phong da ki jaiñjot bad ki slipar snieh ba la jot kiba la dep syrdep . U kpu ba ki rah u long uba tyrkhong bad uba bthuh .
Balei ka sieh ia ka pisa ?
translation.en: Why did she pay the money ?

translation.kha: Ngan theh ibha ïa U mynsaw jong nga ha ki paid Israel , bad ngan ym phai diengtied Shua na ki . Ma nga , U tharai Nongsynshar , por la kren .
translation.en: Neither will I hide my face any more from them : for I have poured out my spirit upon the house of Israel , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: bad Baroh ki jingthung ba la bet ha ki rudwah jong ka nylla kin tyrkhong bun yn sa rnong noh .
translation.en: The paper reeds by the brooks , by the mouth of the brooks , and every thing sown by the brooks , shall wither , be driven away , and be no more .

translation.kha: Ka bha tang ban thang ding . Haba ki tduh ki la ïng lut khoit bad ba ka pdeng ka la sylla rnga , hato phi lah ban shane ei ei na ka ?
translation.en: Behold , it is cast into the fire for fuel  ; the fire devoureth both the ends of it , and the midst of it is burned . Is it meet for any work ?

translation.kha: Ïa ka thiaw ka thliew ha ka jaka ban phrung ïa ka khlieh la suh khylliap ïa ka baroh sawdong Haneng ba kan ym kad .
translation.en: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe , as the hole of an habergeon , with a band round about the hole , that it should not rend .
He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the  Lord  : but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him .
translation.kha: Long kiba beit bad phi pyn-i ba phi don ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai  ; long kiba kynriang bad phi pyn-i ba phim don ïa kata .
U Jisu u la ong ha u , Me la haw ioh ïa u , bad u dien uta uba ïakhun nabar me mynta .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Thou hast both seen him , and it is he that talketh with thee .

translation.kha: Mynta te , u Joshua u bteng , pyndonburom ïa U Trai , malu shakri ïa u da kaba sngur bad ka sha . Iehnoh shisyndon ïa ki blei ba ki kpa Thummim jong phi ki la ju mane ha Mesopotamia bad ha Ijipt , bad shakri tang ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Now therefore fear the  Lord  , and serve him in sincerity and in truth : and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood , and in Egypt  ; and serve ye the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Blei u phah ïa u slap ban ai um ïa ka khyndew ; u lah ban phah ïa u ban pynshitom ïa ngi , lane banbeiñ pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewbha jong u .
translation.en: He causeth it to come , whether for correction , or for his land , or for mercy .

translation.kha: U Trai u la Kular ïa u ïaiban , u kpa jong nga , ‘ U khun jong me , uba ngan pynong syiem hadien jong me , un theh ka Templ ïa nga .’ Bad myntan nga la kut jingmut ban tei ka templ na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa U Trai U Blei jong nga .
translation.en: And , behold , I purpose to build an house unto the name of the  Lord  my God , as the  Lord  spake unto David my father , saying , Thy son , whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room , he shall build an house unto my name .

Then ye answered and said unto me , We have sinned against the  Lord  , we will go up and fight , according to all that the  Lord  our God commanded us . And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war , ye were ready to go up into the hill .
translation.kha: Te phi la jubab , ‘ Moses , ngi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai . Hynrei mynta ngin leit tur , kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la hukum ïa ngi .’ Nangta uwei pa uwei na phi u khreh ban ïaleh thma , u da tharai ba ka long kaba jem ban leit hiarthma ïa kata ka ri .
Nalorkata u Samuel u leit sha Ramah , bad u syiem Saul u leit sha la ïing ha Hephsibah .
translation.en: Then Samuel went to Ramah  ; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul .

translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah baïar kiba tip ba ki tnga jongnga ki , ki ai jingkñia ha kiwei! patar ki blei , bad ki kynïan baroh kiba ïohnang hangta , kaba kynthup ïa ki Israel kiba shnong ha ki bynta bashathie ka Ijipt — u Paidbah’ babun baroh — ki ong ha nga ,
translation.en: Then all the men which knew that their wives had burned incense unto other gods , and all the women that stood by , a great multitude , even all the people that dwelt in the land of Egypt , in Pathros , answered Jeremiah , saying ,
And the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom .
translation.kha: Ka pyrda kaba wah ha ka Templ ka la kad arliang , naduh khlieh haduh tbian .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Take a censer , and put fire therein from off the altar , and put on incense , and go quickly unto the congregation , and make an atonement for them : for there is wrath gone out from the  Lord   ; the plague is begun .
translation.kha: bad u Moses u ong ha u Aaron ,  Shim ïa u khiew buh ding jong phi , buh hangta ïa u rnga uba rhem na ka duwan , bad buh khyndiat ka jingiwbih halor ki rnga . Nangta leit rah kloi kloi ïa ka sha u paidbah bad pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong ki . Pynkloi ! Ka jingbitar U  Trai  ka la mih , bad ka khlam ruh ka la sdang .

translation.en: For the indignation of the  Lord  is upon all nations , and his fury upon all their armies : he hath utterly destroyed them , he hath delivered them to the slaughter .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u bitar ïa baroh ki hima bad baroh ki kynhun shipai jong ki . U la pynrem ïa ki sha ka jingjot .

translation.en: And am I now come up without the  Lord  against this land to destroy it ? the  Lord  said unto me , Go up against this land , and destroy it .
translation.kha: Hato phi tharai ba nga la tur ïaleh ïa ka ri jong phi bad pynjot ïa ka khlem ka jingïarap U  Trai  ? U  Trai  da lade u la ïathuh ha nga ban tur ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka bad pynjot ïa ka .
Hynrei u nongrah khuri um shym la pyrkhat ei ei shaphang u Jehoash — u la kliar noh ïa kaei Kaei baroh shaphang jong u .
translation.en: Yet did not the chief butler remember Joseph , but forgat him .
But it was so , that in the three and twentieth year of king Jehoash the priests had not repaired the breaches of the house .
translation.kha: Hynrei kat haduh ka snem kaba arphew lai jong ka jingsynshar u Joash ki lyngdoh kim pat shym la shna pynbha ïa ka Templ .

translation.en: Lord  , thou wilt ordain peace for us : for thou also hast wrought all our works in us .
translation.kha: Men ai ïa ngi ka jingroi jingpar , A  Trai  ; baroh kata kaba ngi pyndep ha ka jingjop ka long ka jingmih na kaei kaba me leh .

Hato me pyrkhat ba men sa un-long u syiem bad synshar ïa ngi ? Ki hynmen shynrang jongngi u ki ong . Kumta ki la nangto khem isih shuh shuh ïa u namar ki jingphohsniew jongno u bad namar kaei Kaba ba u la kren shemphang jong ki .
translation.en: And his brethren said to him , Shalt thou indeed reign over us ? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us ? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams , and for his words .
Now in the morning as he returned into the city , he hungered .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka lynti ba u leit phai sha ka nongbah , U Jisu u la thngan .
To ngin pynlong ka jingïateh kular ba kad don noh ka jingïashongkha khleh hapdeng jongnga ngi bad ki jong phi .
translation.en: And make ye marriages with us , and give your daughters unto us , and take our daughters unto you .

translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong : Ka long kaba eh ïa ki briew ki babha ba kin ïohlait im ; aïu te , kan long ïa ki nongpop ba khlieh Blei ?
translation.en: And if the righteous scarcely be saved , where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear ?

translation.kha: Kumta ong U thri , uba la pyntip ïa kane slem beh mynshuwa .’
translation.en: Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world .
Be strong and courageous , be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria , nor for all the multitude that is with him : for there be more with us than with him :
translation.kha: U ong ha ki ,  To long kiba kut jingmut bad kiba sngewskhem , bad wat sheptieng ïa u patsha ki nong Assyria lane ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba u ïalam . Ngi don kham bun ka bor ha ka liang jong ngi ban ïa kaba u don ha ka liang jong u .
Ka jingsngewsih bakhraw ka la wan ha ki briew Jong ka Gasa , bun ki briew jongu ka Eshkol ki sngapjar jar . katne slem kiba dang sah ha Philistia kin ïam sngewsih ?
translation.en: Baldness is come upon Gaza  ; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley : how long wilt thou cut thyself ?

translation.kha: bad ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka khwai ban wan bad sngap ïa ka jingstad ba U Blei u la ai ha u .
translation.en: And all the earth sought to Solomon , to hear his wisdom , which God had put in his heart .
Lie not one to another , seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds ;
translation.kha: Wat ïa-lamler iwei ïa iwei pat , naba phi la loit noh ïa ka jinglong barim lem bad ki jingmlien jong ka bad ba phi la kup ïa ka jinglong bathymmai .

Kumta ki la khmih ïa ka kabu . Ki la pynbam pisa ïa ki katto katne nongput ki rangbah ban leh mynleh kumin kiba shida , bun ki la phah ïa ki ban riam ïa U Jisu da ki jingkylli , khnai ba ngin lah ïa-ban aiti ïa u ha ki bor synshar bad shaei ka bor jong u lyngskor ka Hima Rom .
translation.en: And they watched him , and sent forth spies , which should feign themselves just men , that they might take hold of his words , that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor .

translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa sawspah lai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translation.en: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years , and begat sons and daughters .

For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; I have put a yoke of iron upon the neck of all these nations , that they may serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon  ; and they shall serve him : and I have given him the beasts of the field also .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ba un buh ka lyngkor nar halor kine ki jaitbynriew baroh bad ba kin shakri ïa u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilonia . U  Trai  u la ong ba un pynlong wat ïa ki mradkhlaw ban shakri ïa u Nebukhadnessar .
kham palat ban ïa u briew u bym ïoh lehkmen ha ka jingim , la u lah ban im ar hajar snem . Namarkata , baroh ar ki leit shwa kajuh ka jaka .
translation.en: Yea , though he live a thousand years twice told , yet hath he seen no good : do not all go to one place ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ka por ka wan haba ngan pynshitom ïa ki briew ka Ijipt , ka Judah , ka Edom , ka Ammon , ka Moab , malade ki briew ka ri syep , kiba la ot lyngkot ïa ki shñiuh jongnga ki . Kine ki briew baroh ki long kiba la otsher , hynrei ki bym Shim la bat ïa ka jutang kaba ka thmu . Ym don mano mano na Kino ki Briew bad ym ne mano mano na ki paid Israel Ibbah la bat ïa kane ka jutang jong nga .
translation.en: Egypt , and Judah , and Edom , and the children of Ammon , and Moab , and all that are in the utmost corners , that dwell in the wilderness : for all these nations are uncircumcised , and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart .
Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife ; and some also of good will :
translation.kha: Da shisha katto katne ngut na ki , ki ïalap ïa U Khrist namar ka jingpihuiñ bad ka jingïakajia , hynrei kiwei pat na ka mon kaba khuid .

bad ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ïa ki : Ma phi ki kynthei phi long kiba la tim ! Phi mluh ki jingteh kti myntor na ka bynta uwei ti Baroh bad phi thaw ki jaiñ teh khlieh myntor na ka bynta uwei Uei baneh phong ha ki khlieh jong ki , khnam ba ki lah ïa-ban don ka tam hajar ka jingim jong Kiwei pat ki briew . Phi kwah ban to ka bor jong ka jingim bad jingïap halor ki briew jong por nabar ban pyndonkam ïa ka na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi ïa lade hi .
translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes , and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls ! Will ye hunt the souls of my people , and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you ?

translation.kha: Nimrim phi long kiba la pynkyntang khuid Sha U tharai U Blei jongnga phi . U la jied ïa phi napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei ba phyrnai long ka jaitbynriew kaba keirang jong u .
translation.en: For thou art an holy people unto the  Lord  thy God : the  Lord  thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself , above all people that are upon the face of the earth .
The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead .
translation.kha: Ka jingïap ka ap ïa uta uba ïaid sakma na ka lynti ka jingshemphang .
Ha kajuh ka por , hapoh ka ïingsyiem , ka bashathie , ka mahadei ka ai ka jingkhawai na ka bynta ki kyntur .
translation.en: Also Vashti the queen made a feast for the women in the royal house which belonged to king Ahasuerus .

translation.kha: Pha la long ka nuti ïa ki jingïapthngan bad pynjakhlia ïa lade bad ki bleithaw .
translation.en: I will do these things unto thee , because thou hast gone a whoring after the heathen , and because thou art polluted with their idols .
But now , O  Lord  , thou art our father  ; we are the clay , and thou our potter  ; and we all are the work of thy hand .
translation.kha: Hynrei , A  Trai  , me long u Kpa jong ngi . Ngi long kum ka dewbyrtha , bad me long kum u nongthaw khiew .
U la jubab , Keiñ ki long ki sawlyer , ki dang shu lah wan na ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Trai ka pyrthei baroh .
translation.en: And the angel answered and said unto me , These are the four spirits of the heavens , which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth .

translation.kha: Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ki jingjubab bastad jong u .
translation.en: And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , Te , to dabor ! Ka jingngeit jongu me ka la pynkhiah ïa me .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Receive thy sight : thy faith hath saved thee .

And the  Lord  said unto Samuel , How long wilt thou mourn for Saul , seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel ? fill thine horn with oil , and go , I will send thee to Jesse the Beth–lehemite : for I have provided me a king among his sons .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Samuel ,  Sa katno slem men dang ïai sngewsih ïa u Saul ? Nga la kyntait ïa u kum u syiem ki Israel . Hynrei mynta pynïoh katto katne ka umphniang Olib bad leit sha Bethlehem , sha u briew uba kyrteng u Jesse , namar nga la jied ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u ban long syiem .

translation.en: But grow in grace , and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ . To him be glory both now and for ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Hynrei to phin nang roi ha ka jingaiei bad ka jingtip ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai bad U Nongpynim jong ngi . Ha u , to long ka burom , mynta bad shaduh bymjukut ! Amen .
U Abimelekh u synshar ïa ki Israel hajuh lai snem .
translation.en: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Israel ,

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei baroh u la sngewphylla . U bri uba kumno une u long ? ki la ong . Wat ki lyer bad ki jingat phyllung ki nongshong ïa u !
translation.en: But the men marvelled , saying , What manner of man is this , that even the winds and the sea obey him !

translation.kha: Hangne nga don . Lada nga la leh ïa kano kano kaba bakla , suki pyrshang ïa nga ha khmat U Trai bad ha khmat u syiemsad uba u la pynsleh . Hato nga la shem ïa ka masi ne ka kada jongno jongno ? Hato nga la shukor ne banbeiñ ïano ïano ? Heth nga la basma nano nano ? Lada nga la leh ïa kine kiei kiei ngan pynpoi noh ïa kata kaba nga la shim .
translation.en: Behold , here I am : witness against me before the  Lord  , and before his anointed : whose ox have I taken ? or whose ass have I taken ? or whom have I defrauded ? whom have I oppressed ? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind mine eyes therewith ? and I will restore it you .

translation.kha: U syiem Ahab u ïathuh ha ka Jesebel ka tnga jong u ïa Baroh naba u Elijah u la leh bad kumno ba u la pynkup lut ïa ki nongïathuhlypa u Baal .
translation.en: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done , and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword .

translation.kha: Ka Mari ka la sah bad ka Elisabeth kumba lai bnai malade nangta ka la leit pat sha ïing .
translation.en: And Mary abode with her about three months , and returned to her own house .

translation.kha: Kum ka nuksa , ki nongaikam ki kham jied ïa ki nongtrei kiba trei thok , kiba minot bad kiba bud ïa ki ïoh jong ka Baibl .
translation.en: For example , employers often prefer workers who live by the Bible principles of honesty and diligence .

And thou shalt speak unto all that are wise hearted , whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom , that they may make Aaron s garments to consecrate him , that he may minister unto me in the priest s office .
translation.kha: Khot ïa ki nongsuhjaiñ batbit kiba nga la ai ha ki ka sap bad ong ïa ki ba kin suh ïa ki jaiñkup u Aaron khnang ba yn ïoh pynkyntang ïa u kum u lyngdoh ban shakri ïa nga .

translation.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away : but my words shall not pass away .
translation.kha: Ka bneng bad ka pyrthei kin leit noh , hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym leit noh lano lano ruh .

Ki syriem sad ki khunlangbrot kin ïabam lang , ki sing kmen bam phalang , kumba bam ki masi , bad ki bseiñ kin ym long shuh ka jingma . Ha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong nga yn ym don shuh ka jingma ne kaba sniew .
translation.en: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together , and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock : and dust shall be the serpent s meat . They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain , saith the  Lord .
Honour the  Lord  with thy substance , and with the firstfruits of all thine increase :
translation.kha: To burom ïa U  Trai  da kaba ai ha u ka jingainguh da kiei kiei kiba bha tam ba ka lyngkha jong phi ka pynmih .

Kane ka pyndap ïa i da ka jingkyrmen ba-im , pynlang kumta ngi peit sha khmat ban ïapynbiang ïa ki jingkyrkhu kyrngah ibha U Blei u la buh na ka bynta ki briew jong u . U nguh ïa ki ha bneng na ka bynda jongno phi , ha kaba kim haw ban pait lane shuh noh lane sep noh .
translation.en: To an inheritance incorruptible , and undefiled , and that fadeth not away , reserved in heaven for you ,
I will come
translation.kha: Ngan Sa Wan

U dei ban wanlam sha u lyngngoh kum ïa ka jingkynha namar ka jingsuk palat da u langbrot ne u jingsngewskhem u lai don kano kano ka jingduna . Ka jingpynlong pynlang ïa u kan longsyiem kat kumno ba la Buh . U lyndang un ai ïa ka jingjia namar ka pop jong uta u briew malade yn map ïa u .
translation.en: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock , with thy estimation , for a trespass offering , unto the priest : and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not , and it shall be forgiven him .

translation.kha: phiah ïa Katai ka ri ha ki lai bynta . Kawei ka bynta kan don kawei ka shnong ha kaba yn Don ruh ka lynti ka syngkien . Te u briew uba pynkup ïano ïatan u lah ban phet rieh sha kawei na ki .
translation.en: Thou shalt prepare thee a way , and divide the coasts of thy land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to inherit , into three parts , that every slayer may flee thither .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don shuh ka jingkhriat lane u thah ,
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the light shall not be clear , nor dark :

translation.kha: Ha kata ka janmiet ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong , Ka la da dier eh , bad kane ka dei ka kajuh bakynjah . To phah noh ïa ki paidbah malu shah ïa ki ban leit sha ki shnong banbeiñ krad jingbabe na ka pyntwa ïa lade .
translation.en: And when it was evening , his disciples came to him , saying , This is a desert place , and the time is now past  ; send the multitude away , that they may go into the villages , and buy themselves victuals .

translation.kha: Ki sngi jong nga ki la na ïaid ; ki jingthmu jong nga kim syiem urlong ; ka jingkren jong nga ka la shuh noh .
translation.en: My days are past , my purposes are broken off , even the thoughts of my heart .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei Kiei kiba u Jehoahas u la leh bad ki kam shlur jong u baroh la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israhaïah .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz , and all that he did , and his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
We all benefit from our spiritual food
translation.kha: Baroh ngi ïoh jingmyntoi na ki jingbam bakynja mynsiem

translation.en: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul  ; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt .
translation.kha: Ai ba kito kiba tur ïaleh ïa nga kin shahjop bad shah pynjot . Ai ba kito kiba pyrshang ban pynmynsaw ïa nga kin shah pynlehrain bad shah pynjahburom .

Naba kad ba phi la tip ïa kane baroh , nga kwah ban pynkynmaw biang ïa phi ba kumno U Trai u la pyllut im Kishion ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt , hynrei shadien , u la pyndeng ïa iba ki bym Shim la ngeit .
translation.en: I will therefore put you in remembrance , though ye once knew this , how that the Lord , having saved the people out of the land of Egypt , afterward destroyed them that believed not .

translation.kha: Ngan pynphai pat ïa ki pyntud Israel shai ka ri jong ki . Kin bam ïa ka jingbam kaba mih ha u lumrit Karmel bad ha ki phang ka Bashan , nabar kin bam ïa baroh kaba ki kwah na ki jingthung kiba mih ha ki jakarieh jong ki Ephraim bad Gilead .
translation.en: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation , and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan , and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u — kumba hynñiewphew ngut baroh — ki mihnoh shongshngain na Keilah bad ki ïadih sa ïaid . Haba u Saul u tip ba u Dabid u la kjat noh na Shelah , u la sangeh noh ïa la ka jingpynkhreh .
translation.en: Then David and his men , which were about six hundred , arose and departed out of Keilah , and went whithersoever they could go . And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah  ; and he forbare to go forth .

translation.kha: Lane nga Lah ngab wallam ka thma ha ka ri bad phah ki tarajur pynjot ban pynduh loit ïa ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh ,
translation.en: Or if I bring a sword upon that land , and say , Sword , go through the land  ; so that I cut off man and beast from it :

translation.kha: Ki kynhun nongshun ki la wang mih na ka nongbat bad ki la ïaleh ïa ki kynhun jrong u Jubab ; katto katne na ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Dabid ki la shah pynïap , pynlang kumjuh ruh ka la long ïa u Uriah .
translation.en: And the men of the city went out , and fought with Joab : and there fell some of the people of the servants of David  ; and Uriah the Hittite died also .

translation.kha: Nga la shahshkor ba katba phi ding kren bad ar ap katai phi dang sei ïa la ki jingkren bastad .
translation.en: Behold , I waited for your words  ; I gave ear to your reasons , whilst ye searched out what to say .

Notwithstanding , lest we should offend them , go thou to the sea , and cast an hook , and take up the fish that first cometh up  ; and when thou hast opened his mouth , thou shalt find a piece of money : that take , and give unto them for me and thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngim kwah ban pynmong ïa kine ki briew . Kumta khie leit sha ka pung bad bret ïa u khwai . Shim ïa ka dohkha ba la ngat nyngkong , bad hapoh ka shyntur jong ka men shem ïa ka pisa kaba shongdor biang na ka bynta ka khajna Templ ïa nga bad ïa me . To shim ïa ka bad siew ïa ki khajna jong ngi .

Ko khun u briew , u ong , haba ki Israel ki dang shong ha la ka ri , ki la pyntngit ïa ka da ki rukom ba ki im bad ki leh , nga ñiew ïa ka rukom im jong ki kum ka bymkhuid katjuh kum ka jinglehniam kum ka kynthei ha ka por ba ka poi bniah .
translation.en: Son of man , when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land , they defiled it by their own way and by their doings : their way was before me as the uncleanness of a removed woman .

translation.kha: Baroh ki briew’ U Bel hangne ki phah ïa ki jingai khublei , khlam kita babha na ka ïingsyiem jong u Patsha .
translation.en: All the saints salute you , chiefly they that are of Caesar s household .

translation.kha: Uta u Briew u ïeng ha shniah jong nga hangta , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa U Trai ba u kren ha nga shabar ka Thymmai nabar ong :
translation.en: And I heard him speaking unto me out of the house  ; and the man stood by me .

translation.kha: To U Trai un pynurlong ïa ka jingieit jong phi iwei ïa iwei patan bad ïa ki bariew baroh ban nang ïai san bad ban man khraw ha ka jingneit jongngi ngi ïa phi .
translation.en: And the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another , and toward all men , even as we do toward you :

translation.kha: To sngap ko ki Israel ! U thri U Blei jong ngi u long tang ma u hi U Trai .
translation.en: Hear , O Israel : The  Lord  our God is one  Lord  :

translation.kha: Ïa ki jingbeh kiba u Dabid u la ai ha ki lyngdoh mala ki Lebi kiba ïadei bun ki ïing buh tiar bad khiew kiwei ki kam la bud bniah .
translation.en: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter , or concerning the treasures .

translation.kha: Hato u khiew khyndew un nud ban nongïatainia Bad u nongthaw jong u , u khiew uba long kamon baroh kiwei pat ? Hato ka dewbyrtha kan ong ïa u nongthaw khiew kaei ba u leh ? Hammoth u khih un mudui ïa la u nongthoh khiew ba um to jingtbit ?
translation.en: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker ! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth . Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it , What makest thou ? or thy work , He hath no hands ?
And Jesus said ,  Let her alone  ; why trouble ye her ? she hath wrought a good work on me .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Ieh ïa ka marwei ! Balei ba phi pynwit ïa ka ? Ka la leh ïa kaei kaei kaba bha bad ba-itynnat na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: And he brought forth the people that were therein , and put them under saws , and under harrows of iron , and under axes of iron , and made them pass through the brickkiln : and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon . So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem .
translation.kha: bad u la pyntrei ïa ki briew jong ka ha ki kurat , ki mohkhiew , bad ki sdie nar , bad u la pynbor ïa ki ban trei ha kaba shna maw-it . U la leh kumjuh ïa ki briew jong kiwei pat ki nongrit jong ka Ammon baroh . Nangta ma u lem bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem .
U Blei u la pham ïa u nonglamktien jong u , u briew uba kyrtong u Ïoannis , suba la wan ban ïathuh ïa ki briew shaphang ka jingshai , ba baroh ki dei Ban shahshkor ïa ka khubor bad ban ngeit .
translation.en: The same came for a witness , to bear witness of the Light , that all men through him might believe .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la ong ïa u , Ïathuh ha i , mynba , kumin phiah la poi thoh ïa kane baroh ? Hato u Jeremaïah u la ong ïa ka ha phi ban thoh ?
translation.en: And they asked Baruch , saying , Tell us now , How didst thou write all these words at his mouth ?
And Jesus , immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him , turned him about in the press , and said ,  Who touched my clothes ?
translation.kha: Mar kumta U Jisu u la tip ba ka bor ka la mihnoh na u , kumta u la phai sawdong sha u paidbah bad u la kylli ,  Mano ba la ktah ïa ki jaiñkup jong nga ?

translation.en: In that day will I cause the horn of the house of Israel to bud forth , and I will give thee the opening of the mouth in the midst of them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba kata kan jia , ngan pynlong ïa ki paid Israel kiba khlaiñ bad ngan shah ïa me , ko Esekiel , ban kren ha kaba baroh kin ïohsngew ïa me , khnang ba kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .

U Trai Nongsynshar u ong , Ka nongbah ha Israhaïah ka pah noh shihajar ngut ki shipai , hynrei tang shispah ngut ki wan phai ; kawei pat ka nongbah ka phah shispah ngut , hynrei tang shiphew ngut ki wan phai pat .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred , and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten , to the house of Israel .

translation.kha: Ki da kwah ban pynlong mraw ïa ngi , hynrei khnang ban pynneh ïa ka jingshisha ka jingialam na ka beit jong phi , ngim khim la ailad ïa ki wat tang shi minit ruh .
translation.en: To whom we gave place by subjection , no , not for an hour ; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you .
Behold , thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands , by destroying them utterly : and shalt thou be delivered ?
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u patsha ka Assyria u leh ïa kano kano ka ri kaba u rai ban pynjot . Hato phi pyrkhat ba phin ïohlait im ?

Wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki pynbuaid Bha bad ki ïadat sheng sheng . Ki la dih waiñ bad dkoh kyiad haduh mawria katta haduh ba ki jynrat kulmar . Ki nongïohipaw ki ïabuaid hajuh katta Iso ba kim sngewnguh Shua ïa ki jingïohipaw ba U Blei u phah , bad ki lyngdoh ki buhnud haduh ba kim lah shuh ban ai jingrai ïa ki nang ba la wanlam ha ki .
translation.en: But they also have erred through wine , and through strong drink are out of the way  ; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink , they are swallowed up of wine , they are out of the way through strong drink  ; they err in vision , they stumble in judgment .

translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u kham riewpaidbah malu kham stad ban ïa Une uno u syiem ,
translation.en: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom .

translation.kha: Nangta u Kain u nong ïa u Abel u para jong u , Ïa ngin ïaleit shiah lyngkien . wahbah ki la khong ha lyngkha , u Kain u la shoh ïa la u para bad u la pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And Cain talked with Abel his brother : and it came to pass , when they were in the field , that Cain rose up against Abel his brother , and slew him .

translation.kha: U Ehud pat da la ka kti kadiang u sei ïa ka waitlam na ka jar kamet jong u sad u dung pynngam ïa ka ha ka kpoh jong u syiem .
translation.en: And Ehud put forth his left hand , and took the dagger from his right thigh , and thrust it into his belly :
And labour , working with our own hands : being reviled , we bless ; being persecuted , we suffer it :
translation.kha: Haba la tim ïa ngi , ngi kyrkhu ; haba la pynshitom ïa ngi , ngi ïaishah ; haba la krenbeiñ ïa ngi , ngi pynphai kylliang da ki ktien kiba jem .
U Trai u la kren ha nga
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came unto me again , saying ,

translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U Trai , ko mynsiem jong nga ! A Trai , U Blei jong at , katno me long kaba khlaw ! Me kup da ka burom syiem malu ka burom ;
translation.en: Bless the  Lord  , O my soul . O  Lord  my God , thou art very great  ; thou art clothed with honour and majesty .

These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers  ; even the chief of the fathers , as they were counted by number of names by their polls , that did the work for the service of the house of the  Lord  , from the age of twenty years and upward .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lebi , kat kum ki kur bad ki longïing , bad ïa uwei pa uwei na ki la buh jingthoh da ka kyrteng . Uwei pa uwei na ki khun ki ksiew , uba arphew snem ka rta ne tam , u ïoh ka bynta ha ka kam ha ka Templ jong U  Trai .
Kumta u Saul u khoh ïa ki kynjoh nongïapom jong u shaei ka thma , ban ïaid pyrshah ïa ka Mahlah bad ban kem ïa u Dabid bad ki Rangbah jong u .
translation.en: And Saul called all the people together to war , to go down to Keilah , to besiege David and his men .

translation.kha: To ai ba kum uto u briew un sngewthuh ba kam don ka jingïapher pyndeng kaei kaba ngi thoh ha ki shithi lad ngi haba Ngi don sha jngi bad ïa kaei kaba Ngin har haba ngi don markhmat bad phi .
translation.en: Let such an one think this , that , such as we are in word by letters when we are absent , such will we be also in deed when we are present .
Say unto them , As truly as I live , saith the  Lord  , as ye have spoken in mine ears , so will I do to you :
translation.kha: Mynta , ai ha ki ïa kane ka jubab : ‘ Nga smai ba kumba nga long uba im , ngan leh kumba phi la pan . Nga U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him , to uncover their nakedness : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih . Wat ïathiah shongkha bad kano kano kaba ïadei kur dei jait bad me .
Leh ïa ki bania phi sa ïa la u para Israel , bad ieit ïa ki kumba phoi ainguh ïa lade . Kynmaw ba Phin ruh shisien phi la long ki nongwei ha ri Jingtep . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you , and thou shalt love him as thyself  ; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Hynrei ym shym la Don ha bneng lane ha khyndew lane ha ka pyrthei kaba bashapoh , uba lah ban sleit ïa ka kot kloi bad ban khmih shapoh jong ka .
translation.en: And no man in heaven , nor in earth , neither under the earth , was able to open the book , neither to look thereon .

translation.kha: Teh ïa ka ha khmat ka jaiñspong da u ksew bajngum .
translation.en: And thou shalt put it on a blue lace , that it may be upon the mitre  ; upon the forefront of the mitre it shall be .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ba u briew uba bet tang khyndiat ki thymmai un ïoh ot ruh jingkyndit ; uta uba bet shibun ki symbai un Ïohi ot ruh shibun .
translation.en: But this I say , He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly ; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully .

translation.kha: Ki riewthombor ki pynphriang ïa ki ktien lorni ; ki pynjynjar bad pynjop ïa ka jingïadei parad .
translation.en: A froward man soweth strife : and a whisperer separateth chief friends .

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynshitom ïa ki briew jongno u da kaba phah ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw . U la shngiam ïa ki da ka slipar bashyrkhei na shaphang jingiw .
translation.en: In measure , when it shooteth forth , thou wilt debate with it : he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind .

translation.kha: bad ynda phi la poh sha shiliang ka Joïada , pynïeng ïa kita ki maw ha u lum Ethbaal , kumba nga la hukum ïa phi mynta ka sngi , bad ñiad astor ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan , that ye shall set up these stones , which I command you this day , in mount Ebal , and thou shalt plaster them with plaster .
