translation.en: He that loveth not knoweth not God  ; for God is love .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym ieit , um ithuh ïa U Blei , naba U Blei u long ka jingieit .
U angel u la bthah ïa per ban ai ha u Serubbabel ïa kane ka khubor na U Trai : Man khop , ym da ka bor shipai lymne da ka bor ka jingkhlaiñ jongu me , hynriew da U Mynsiem jong nga .
translation.en: Then he answered and spake unto me , saying , This is the word of the  Lord  unto Zerubbabel , saying , Not by might , nor by power , but by my spirit , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Ko Kynhun u briew , u ong , to ïamkthang nalor baïar u Baïap babun ka Ijipt . Phah ïa ki pun hiar lem bad ki jingïohipaw badonbor sha ka pyrthei ibha ïap .
translation.en: Son of man , wail for the multitude of Egypt , and cast them down , even her , and the daughters of the famous nations , unto the nether parts of the earth , with them that go down into the pit .

translation.kha: U syiem u ainong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u , Pham ïasngewthuh ba ha kane ka sngi uwei u nongïalam bakhraw ha Jeraïah u la ïap ?
translation.en: And the king said unto his servants , Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel ?

translation.kha: Hato phi kwah ba ïakynduh ïa u briew uba khraw ? Rah sha u ka jingai sngewbha bad kan pynsuk ïa phiah .
translation.en: A man s gift maketh room for him , and bringeth him before great men .
But blessed are your eyes , for they see : and your ears , for they hear .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong phi , katno kiba donbok phi long ! Ki khmat jong phi ki ïohi bad ki shkor jong phi ki ïohsngew .

translation.en: Son of man , prophesy and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Howl ye , Woe worth the day !
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to ïathuhlypa bad pynbna ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong . Men pyrta ïa kine ki ktien :  Ka sngi kaba sngewtriem kan wan !
Lehi nga lai ban phah ïa ki mawkynroh ban pynïap ïa ki briew , da kaba pynlong ïa ka ri Kaba ma Iso katta ba ym don uno uno uba lah ban leit lyndang ïa ka ,
translation.en: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land , and they spoil it , so that it be desolate , that no man may pass through because of the beasts :
Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me ; but I went into Arabia , and returned again unto Damascus .
translation.kha: lane ngam shym la leit sha Jerusalem ban ïakynduh ïa kito kiba long ki apostol shuwa jong nga . Pynban shisyndon nga la leit sha Arabia , nangta nga la wan phai pat sha Damaskos .
Mynta , ha mon la ka Pateng , katto katne na ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin ïap ka jingïap kaba sngewma namar ba mem shym kohnguh ïa nga bad ba me la shim ïa ka tnga jong u Uriah .
translation.en: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from thine house  ; because thou hast despised me , and hast taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be thy wife .

translation.kha: ktieh naba dawa ba ki long kiba hok ki la kyndit , bad baroh ki la pynrem ïa nga ba ngam don Blei .
translation.en: Upright men shall be astonished at this , and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite .

translation.kha: Ka jingieid kaweh khraw tam kaba u briew u lah Ban don na ka bynta ki paro jong u ka long pun aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jngai ki .
translation.en: Greater love hath no man than this , that a man lay down his life for his friends .
And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers , nor inclined mine ear to them that instructed me !
translation.kha: Ngam shym sngap ïa ki nonghikai jong nga , ngam shym la shahshkor ïa ki .
Nangta kita kiba lah ban shynna ki la wan hiar sha la ki nongïalam ; Ki briew jong U Trai ki la waiñ sha u da ka jingïasyllok ba ïaleh .
translation.en: Then he made him that remaineth have dominion over the nobles among the people : the  Lord  made me have dominion over the mighty .

translation.kha: Me la long u nongshong basa ha ka ïing jongki ki jingïatylli babha khlem otsher , bad me da ïabam lem Bad ki !
translation.en: Saying , Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised , and didst eat with them .

translation.kha: Katba baroh ki paidbah ki dang shahshkor ïa u , U Ujuh u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,
translation.en: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples ,

translation.kha: Eliada nga la kwah ban sngewsarong , ngan ym jaiñ-jin da la long uba bieit , namar ngan jin da la ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha . Hynrei kan ym kob sarong , namar ngam kiaw mano mano ban don ka jingpynjot ba kham halor ïa na ban ïa kaei kiba u la ieh ba nga leh lane u la ïohsngew ïa kaba nga ong .
translation.en: For though I would desire to glory , I shall not be a fool ; for I will say the truth : but now I forbear , lest any man should think of me above that which he seeth me to be , or that he heareth of me .

translation.kha: Ka ong umdih , ‘ Ki rah ïa me ha ki kti jong ki khnang ba wat ki kjat jong me ktang ym mynhynne ha ki maw .’
translation.en: And in their hands they shall bear thee up , lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone .

translation.kha: Bad ïa uwei pa uwei uba leh bakla yn siew na ka bynta khie kiei bakha kynroh kiba u leh , namar U Blei u bishar ïa uwei pa eiei da kajuh ka jingthew .
translation.en: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done : and there is no respect of persons .

A sword is upon their horses , and upon their chariots , and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her  ; and they shall become as women : a sword is upon her treasures  ; and they shall be robbed .
translation.kha: Pynjot ïa ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom jong ka ! Ka Jingïap ïa ki shipai ba shu wai — Katno ki long kiba tlot ! Pynjot ïa ki jingkynshew jong ka ; lute bad rong noh .
Hynrei lada phim pyndem , te ïa kane ka nongbat yn aiti noh sha ki nongïam Babilonia , ki ban sa thang duh ïa ka , bad phin ym lait im na ki .
translation.en: But if thou wilt not go forth to the king of Babylon s princes , then shall this city be given into the hand of the Chaldeans , and they shall burn it with fire , and thou shalt not escape out of their hand .

translation.kha: Nga isih ïa u masi ksiar ba mane da ki briew jongki ka nongbah Gemaraïah . NGA bitar lep ïa ki . Sa katno kan shim por shuwa ba kin sangeh noh na kiba mane bleithaw) ?
translation.en: Thy calf , O Samaria , hath cast thee off  ; mine anger is kindled against them : how long will it be ere they attain to innocency ?

translation.kha: Ma phi ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abbim , u shakri jong u ; ma phi ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , u bhabriew uba u la jied : Kynmaw ïa ki kambah ba U Blei u la leh Bad ki jingbishar kiba u la ai .
translation.en: O ye seed of Abraham his servant , ye children of Jacob his chosen .
And among these nations shalt thou find no ease , neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest : but the  Lord  shall give thee there a trembling heart , and failing of eyes , and sorrow of mind :
translation.kha: Phin ym shongsuk hapdeng kita ki jaitbynriew , bad phin ym ïoh jaka ban kam kum la ka jong ; hangta U  Trai  un pynshong syier , un pynduh jingkyrmen , bad un pynswai mynsiem ïa phi .

Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba u syiem um shahshkor ïa ki , ki la pyrta , “long ba la ñiewbeiñ ïa u Dabid bad ka longïing jong u ! Ki la leh aïu na ka bynta jong ngi ? Ko ki rangbah Jeriel , ïa ïeng kitei noh sha ïing ! To ai ba u Rehoboam un khmih hi ïa lade !
translation.en: So when all Israel saw that the king hearkened not unto them , the people answered the king , saying , What portion have we in David ? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse : to your tents , O Israel : now see to thine own house , David . So Israel departed unto their tents .

translation.kha: Naba Kim nud shuh ban kyrmen ïa u kano kano ka jingkylli .
translation.en: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all .
Which long for death , but it cometh not  ; and dig for it more than for hid treasures  ;
translation.kha: Ki ap ïa ka jingïap , hynrei kam wan satia ; ki kham mon ban jied ïa ka jingtep ban ïa ka spah .

Ka Mesha bad ka Tubal ki don hangta , lym bad ki jingtep jong ki shipai jong ki ha baroh sawdong . Ki long baroh kiba khlem otsher , baroh ki la shat pynïap ha ka thma . Pynban Sihon ki la pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im .
translation.en: There is Meshech , Tubal , and all her multitude : her graves are round about him : all of them uncircumcised , slain by the sword , though they caused their terror in the land of the living .

translation.kha: Naduh Mynta , te , ph dei baneh im ïa kaba sah jong ka jingim ha kane ka pyrthiew , ka jingriam ba la syiar da ka mon U Blei bad ym da ki jingkhwan jong ka deng .
translation.en: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men , but to the will of God .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la dih shibun ka waiñ , ki ïalap sngewbha ha ki kam nuti jong ki , ki jingdih ïa ka jingjahburom ban ïa ka burom .
translation.en: Their drink is sour : they have committed whoredom continually : her rulers with shame do love , Give ye .

translation.kha: U Barsillai , uba na Gilead , u la woh khah ruh na Rogelim ngab synran ïa u symboh sha shiliang ka Jordan .
translation.en: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim , and went over Jordan with the king , to conduct him over Jordan .
Let them now that fear the  Lord  say , that his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: Ai ba baroh kiba mane ïa u kin ong ,  Ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
sad u la pha ïa ki shaw U Trai baneh kylli ïa u , Hato me long uta uba u Ïoannis u la ong u ban sa wanrah , ne hab ngin khmih lynti ïa uwei pat ?
translation.en: And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus , saying , Art thou he that should come ? or look we for another ?

translation.kha: Ngan wanlam phai pah sha Jerusalem , ka nongbah bakhuid jongki nga , bad ban shong ban sah hangto . Ïa ka yn tip kum ka nongbah baïaineh , bad ïa u lum jong U Trai Badonbor Baroh yn khot u lum bakyntang .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; I am returned unto Zion , and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem : and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth  ; and the mountain of the  Lord  of hosts the holy mountain .
Cease not to give thanks for you , making mention of you in my prayers ;
translation.kha: ngam shym la sangeh ban ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And the temple of God was opened in heaven , and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament : and there were lightnings , and voices , and thunderings , and an earthquake , and great hail .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Templ U Blei ha bneng la plie , bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang la ïohi hangta . Nangta la don ki jingthaba leilieh , ki jingkyrhuh bad ki jingsawa u pyrthat , ka jingkhynñiuh jumai bad ka jinghap phria kaba jur .
U Trai u ong ha ki jaitbynriew , myntor Ngan ai ïa la ka kai . Ngan pyn-i katno nga long uba donbor .
translation.en: Now will I rise , saith the  Lord   ; now will I be exalted  ; now will I lift up myself .

translation.kha: U Daniel u la don ha ka Jingbishar syiem khih ba u Syros u patsha jong ka Persia u la jop ïa ka Babilonia .
translation.en: And Daniel continued even unto the first year of king Cyrus .

translation.kha: Kumta u nongïathuhlypa samla u sien shaw Ramoth ,
translation.en: So the young man , even the young man the prophet , went to Ramoth–gilead .

translation.kha: Phan ym leit khlem kitkhlieh lane Khlem sopkjat lane sngewsih ne ïatim . Phan pynsep-ei namar ki pop jong pha , bad pham ïa-ud iwei ha iwei .
translation.en: And your tires shall be upon your heads , and your shoes upon your feet : ye shall not mourn nor weep  ; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities , and mourn one toward another .
He that walketh with wise men shall be wise : but a companion of fools shall be destroyed .
translation.kha: Ïalang paralok bad uba stad bad phin kylla stad . Lada phi ïalang paralok bad ki briew kiba bieit , phin long kiba bieit .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles , and set up my standard to the people : and they shall bring thy sons in their arms , and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ha la ki briew :  Ngan pyn-i dak sha ki jaitbynriew , bad kin wallam ïa ki khun jong pha sha ïing .
Wat ïathaw katno kane ka jutang bad ki lane bad ki blei jong ki .
translation.en: Thou shalt make no covenant with them , nor with their gods .
Flee out of the midst of Babylon , and deliver every man his soul : be not cut off in her iniquity  ; for this is the time of the  Lord s  vengeance  ; he will render unto her a recompence .
translation.kha: To phet noh na Babilonia ! Phet ban lait im ! Wat ai ba yn shah pynïap na ka bynta ka pop jong ka Babilonia . Nga mynta nga siew kylliang bad pynshitom ïa ka kumba ka dei hok .
Pynban don na phiah ki bymngeit . ( U Jiw u la tip naduh katba mynnyngkong kino ki dei Kita ki ban ym ngeit badno uno na ki u pun ikhyllah ïa u . )
translation.en: But there are some of you that believe not .  For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not , and who should betray him .
Will the  Lord  be pleased with thousands of rams , or with ten thousands of rivers of oil ? shall I give my firstborn for my transgression , the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul ?
translation.kha: Hato U  Trai  un sngewbha lada nga wallam sha u da ki hajar ki langbrot lane da ka umphniang Olib kaba tuid khlem kut ? Hato ngan ai ha u da u khun nyngkong jong nga ban siew na ka bynta ki pop jong nga ?
Bad u Kain u lytar noh na ka jingdon thang U Trai nabar u la shong la sah ha ka ri ba la kyrteng Ka Nongap kaba don shngain mihngi na ka Kper Oded .
translation.en: And Cain went out from the presence of the  Lord  , and dwelt in the land of Nod , on the east of Eden .

translation.kha: Uta pa uwei un shongsuk pangnud ki ber sohwaiñ bad ki dieng Dumbur la ki jong hi , bad yn ym ni mano mei ban pynsheptieng ïa u . U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la kular ïa kñia .
translation.en: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig tree  ; and none shall make them afraid : for the mouth of the  Lord  of hosts hath spoken it .
For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel , They are entangled in the land , the wilderness hath shut them in .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh un sa tharai ba ki Israel ki la phet sakma bad ba ki la shah khang kut ha ka ri shyiap .

Dei ka jingngeit kaban la pynlong ïa u Moses ban mih na ka ri Ijipt khlem da sheptieng ïa ka jingbitar u Pharaoh . Ka la long kumba u la ïohi ïa U Blei u bymïap lah ban ïohi , u la kynta ban phai dien .
translation.en: By faith he forsook Egypt , not fearing the wrath of the king : for he endured , as seeing him who is invisible .
But now our soul is dried away : there is nothing at all , beside this manna , before our eyes .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta te ka bor met ruh ngim don shuh . Ym don ei ei ban bam — thylli lait sa tang kane ka manna na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat !
da uba la pyllaitluid ïa ngi , kata ka erlangthari , ba la map ïa ki pop jrong me .
translation.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood , even the forgiveness of sins :
And on the fifth day nine bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba san , ai khyndai tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
Ym don kano kano kaba u Lah ban ïa-peiñ na ka beit la ka jingim .
translation.en: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul ?

translation.kha: U Abraham hi u la ong ba ka dei ka para jong u , bad ka ruh ka ong kumjuh . Nga la lai ïa Kanneh da ka jingïatiplem kaba sngur , bad ngam shym la leh bakla .
translation.en: Said he not unto me , She is my sister ? and she , even she herself said , He is my brother : in the integrity of my heart and innocency of my hands have I done this .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ka nongmih baskhem kaba U Blei! u la buh ym lah ban pynkhih ; malade shalor jong ka la thoh ïa kine ki ktieh : U Tiras u ithuh ïa kito Kiba dei ki jong u bad Baroh kiba ong ba ki dei ki jong U Trai ki dei ban phai noh na kaba leh bymdei .
translation.en: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure , having this seal , The Lord knoweth them that are his . And , Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity .

translation.kha: ïa ka umphniang pynsleh , bad ïa ka jingiwbih basma sngewtynnat na ka bynta Ka Jaka Kyntang . Ha kaba shna ïa kine baroh , ki dei ban leh thik kat kumba nga la hukum ïa me .
translation.en: And the anointing oil , and sweet incense for the holy place : according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do .

translation.kha: Ka la ni ïa kaei kaba ka la lah ban leh ; ka la thew ïa ka jingsleh ibeiñ halor ka met jong nga ban pynkhreh lypa shuwa ka por jyllang ka jingtep ïa ka kun jong to .
translation.en: She hath done what she could : she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying .
And when the king was come from Damascus , the king saw the altar : and the king approached to the altar , and offered thereon .
translation.kha: Haba u wan phai na Damaskos , u Ahas u ïohi ba la dep shna ïa ka duwan ,
Kumta shwa , ka prie riam jong ngi ha ki jingïaineh ka pynum ba i bud ïa “U Nongbishar ka pyrthei baroh kadei ,” U Blei Jehobah , pynlang ïa ka dik kaba ngi mane ïa u . —Joshua 18 25 .
translation.en: Likewise , the way we appear at meetings shows our esteem for “the Judge of all the earth ,” Jehovah God , and for the place where we worship him . —Genesis 18 :25 .
And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Israel , At even , then ye shall know that the  Lord  hath brought you out from the land of Egypt :
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki la ong ha ki Israel baroh ,  Ha kane ka janmiet , phin tip ba dei U  Trai  uba la wallam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt .
Phi kiba shong ha Lashai , teh ïa ki kali ïapom ha ki Kulai . Phibi pynbud ïa ki thup jong ki Israel bad kumta ka pynbang ïa ka Jerusalem ban leh pop .
translation.en: O thou inhabitant of Lachish , bind the chariot to the swift beast : she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion : for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee .

translation.kha: Bad haba phi ïingjaiñ bad duwai , to map ïa kaei kaei kaba phi lah ban kein pyrshah ïano ïano , khnang ba U Kpa jyllang phi uba ha Bneng un map ïa ki jingleh bymdei kiba phi la leh .
translation.en: And when ye stand praying , forgive , if ye have ought against any : that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses .

translation.kha: U la long u nongïathuhlypa , bad u la tip aïu U blei u la kylluid ïa u : U Blei u la pynlong ka jingsmai ba un pynjrong syiem ïa iwei na ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid , kumba u Dabid u la long .
translation.en: Therefore being a prophet , and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him , that of the fruit of his loins , according to the flesh , he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne  ;

translation.kha: Ka jingsarong jong phalang ka la shukor ïa pha . Ym don ba sheptieng ïa Pha jaka kumba phasi pyrkhat ba ki long kumta . Pha sheng ha ki synrang maw , ha kliar ki lumbah ; hynrei wat la pha shon hajrong tam kum u pukni , U tharai un salm ïa phai sha tbian . U thri u la kren .
translation.en: Thy terribleness hath deceived thee , and the pride of thine heart , O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock , that holdest the height of the hill : though thou shouldest make thy nest as high as the eagle , I will bring thee down from thence , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha ka thang kaba bud , u Joshua bad ki paid Israel baïar ki khie dang step phyrngab , bad ki mihnoh na ka jaka shong dara ha Akasia , bad ki la ithuh sha Jordan , ha kaba ki la sher dara katba ki dang ap ban jam ïa ka .
translation.en: And Joshua rose early in the morning  ; and they removed from Shittim , and came to Jordan , he and all the children of Israel , and lodged there before they passed over .
So they laid hands on her  ; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king s house , they slew her there .
translation.kha: Ki la kem ïa ka , ki ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïingsyiem , bad hangta ha ka Khyrdop Kulai ki pynïap ïa ka .

Shah ïa ki ban khum ba me wahbah ïa la ka rang halor ka tyrpeng jong me bad miej shabar shaei kaba dum da kaba tap ïa ki khmat jong me , khnang ba Men ym ïohi shano me leit . Katai ka me leh kan long ka jingmaham ïa ki Eliel .
translation.en: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders , and carry it forth in the twilight : thou shalt cover thy face , that thou see not the ground : for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel .

translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , namarkata , ba phin pyrthuh buhnud ïa nga .
translation.en: Wherefore I beseech you , be ye followers of me .

translation.kha: Kut phim dat shun bishar ïano ïano Shua ba ka por kaban dei kan poi . Ka jingbishar bakhatduh ka dei ïa-ban ap tad ynda U Trai un wan ; un wallam ha ka jingshai ïa ki jingkhublei ba-dum nabar pynpaw ïa ki jingthmu barieh jong ki jingmut ki briew . Bad nangta uwei pa uwei un ïohpdiang na U Blei ïa ka jingïaroh kambah u dei hok ban ieh .
translation.en: Therefore judge nothing before the time , until the Lord come , who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness , and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts : and then shall every man have praise of God .

translation.kha: Kumta ar la shim ïa ka kur Rekhab baroh kawei — u Jaasanaïah ( u khun jong uwei pat u Jeremaïah , uba dei u khwan jong u Shebanaïah ) bad ïa baroh ki shynrang kiba shi para bad u pynlang ki khun shynrang lad u — bad wallam ïa ki sha ka Tabeel .
translation.en: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah , the son of Habaziniah , and his brethren , and all his sons , and the whole house of the Rechabites  ;
And Moses said unto his father in law , Because the people come unto me to enquire of God :
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Nga dei ban leh ïa kane namar ki briew ki ïawan sha nga ban tip ïa ka mon U Blei .

Kumta , kumba u Joshua u la hukum , ka kynhun shipai ka la ïaid ha shuwa ki lyngdoh Kiba put ïa ki turoi ; hadien jong phim buiñ sa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai , kiba la bud patar da ka kynhun shipa na shadien . Ha ki por baroh la put ïa ki turoi .
translation.en: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets , and the rearward came after the ark , the priests going on , and blowing with the trumpets .
And the times of this ignorance God winked at  ; but now commandeth all men every where to repent :
translation.kha: U Blei u la peit lyndet ïa ki por haba ki briew kim shym la ithuh ïa u , hynrei mynta u hukum ïa ki baroh kylleng sawdong ban phai noh ïa ki lynti bymman jong ki .

translation.en: Until the  Lord  removed Israel out of his sight , as he had said by all his servants the prophets . So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day .
translation.kha: haduh ha kaba khatduh U  Trai  u pyndam noh ïa ki na khmat jong u , kumba u la maham lyngba ki shakri jong u ki nongïathuhlypa , ba un leh kumta . Te ki paid Israel ki la shah pynryngkang par sha Assyria , ha kaba ki dang ïaisah hangta .

Ki briew jong nga ki kyang jam sha nga , ‘ Wat la ki pop jong ngi ki pynrem ïa ngi , to ïaroh ïa ngi , A Trai , kumba me la kular . Ngi la blei dien noh na me bun bunsien ; ngi la sa thup pyrshang ïa me .
translation.en: O  Lord  , though our iniquities testify against us , do thou it for thy name s sake : for our backslidings are many  ; we have sinned against thee .

translation.kha: U la Hikai ha ki synriah bad uwei pa uwei u la ïarep ïa u .
translation.en: And he taught in their synagogues , being glorified of all .

translation.kha: kamut la mih ka jingïania hapdeng ki nongjop jingri jong u Amraphel mala ki nongap jingri jong u Lot . ( Ha kata ka por ki Kanaan sad ki Peris ki dang shong ha Kata ka ri . )
translation.en: And there was a strife between the herdmen of Abram s cattle and the herdmen of Lot s cattle : and the Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then in the land .

translation.kha: U Trai u kylla biang la ka jingmut bad u la ong , Kane ruh kan ym jia .
translation.en: The  Lord  repented for this : This also shall not be , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Khim leit phai noh sha ïing , naba nga la tymmen ban shongkurim biang . wiat lada na pyllait ba ïalang don jingkyrmen , bad kumta ban ïashongkurim ha kane ka Die bad ïoh khun shynrang ,
translation.en: Turn again , my daughters , go your way  ; for I am too old to have an husband . If I should say , I have hope , if I should have an husband also to night , and should also bear sons  ;
Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , all my words that I shall speak unto thee receive in thine heart , and hear with thine ears .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong shuh shuh ,  Ko khun u briew , sngap bha bad kynmaw ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga ong ha me .
Ka wir jyllang me kan long kob khraw , bad ki bariew keiñ ong junom , ‘ U Terah Nongsynshar u long U Blei halor ki Israel .’ Bad men pynneh ïa ka longïing syiemsad jong nga ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: And let thy name be magnified for ever , saying , The  Lord  of hosts is the God over Israel : and let the house of thy servant David be established before thee .

translation.kha: Kane ka ïailong na ka snem sha ka snem ; man ka por ba ki leit sha ka iing U Trai , ka Peninnah ka ju pynsngewsih palat ïa ka Hannah , haduh ba kan da ïabam malu kam treh ban bam ei ei .
translation.en: And as he did so year by year , when she went up to the house of the  Lord  , so she provoked her  ; therefore she wept , and did not eat .

translation.kha: Nga thop sha phi , plied , ym namar ba phim tip ïa ka jinglah ; pynban , ka long Naaman ba Phi da tip ïa ka , bad phi tip ruh ym don ka lamler kaba ju mihnoh na ka jingshisha .
translation.en: I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth , but because ye know it , and that no lie is of the truth .
Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father : but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïaroh ïa ka jingstad , u kpa jong phi un sngewsarong ïa phi . Ka long ka jingpynlehnoh-ei ba-bieit ban pynlut pisa ha ki nuti .

translation.en: Who can tell if God will turn and repent , and turn away from his fierce anger , that we perish not ?
translation.kha: Lehse U Blei un kylla ka jingmut jong u ; lehse un sangeh noh na kaba bitar , bad ngin ym ïap !

translation.en: And seven days were fulfilled , after that the  Lord  had smitten the river .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi ki la leit hadien ba U  Trai  U la shoh ïa ka wah .

translation.en: Then they cried out with a loud voice , and stopped their ears , and ran upon him with one accord ,

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u nong ïa u syiem Jingtep , Men mad ïa ka waitlam u syiem Babilon .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong , Ngan pyndonkam ïa u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilon ban pyndkut noh ïa ka spaiñ jong ka Ijipt .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon .
Yea , so have I strived to preach the gospel , not where Christ was named , lest I should build upon another man s foundation :
translation.kha: Ka jingangnud jong nga borabor ka long ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha ha ki jaka ha kiba ïa U Khrist ym pat shym la ïohsngew , khnang ban ym tei halor ka nongrim ba la seng da kiwei pat .

translation.en: Deliver me , O my God , out of the hand of the wicked , out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man .
translation.kha: A Blei jong nga , to pyllait im ïa nga na ki bymman , na ka bor jong kito kiba runar bad kiba sniew .

translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against them  ; and he departed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki ; bad kumta katba u dang leit noh ,
Wat sheptieng ïa ki ; hynriewphew to ïai kynmaw aiñ U Trai U Blei jong phi u la leh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki briew jyllang u baroh .
translation.en: Thou shalt not be afraid of them : but shalt well remember what the  Lord  thy God did unto Pharaoh , and unto all Egypt  ;

translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka jong ha u , Kynrad , hato nga pan khun shynrang na phi ? Hato ngam shym ïathuh ïa phi shun ym kyntiew ïa ki jingkyrmen jong nga ?
translation.en: Then she said , Did I desire a son of my lord ? did I not say , Do not deceive me ?

translation.kha: Naba U Khrist u la pynkut ïa ka Hukum , khnang ba uei uei baroh uba ngeit u don ka jingïadei bad U Blei .
translation.en: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth .

translation.kha: Napdeng ki khun ki ksiew jong u Hebron , u Hashabaïah bad Shihajar hynñiewspah ngut ki bahaïing jong u , barabor ki briew kiba tbit , la buh Ban peit ïa ka Kam synshar ha baroh ki kam mem bad ki kam hima sima ha Israel kaba shaphang sepngi jong ka wah Jordan .
translation.en: And of the Hebronites , Hashabiah and his brethren , men of valour , a thousand and seven hundred , were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the  Lord  , and in the service of the king .
For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus  sake , that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh .
translation.kha: Ha shi lynter ka jingim , ngi don ha tmier jong ka jingïap na ka bynta U Jisu , khnang ba yn ïohi ïa ka jingim jong u ha kane ka met baïap jong ngi .
Ïa ka ïing jngai u yn tip ha Isaia kumno ‘ Ka ïing jong uta u briew uba la shah loit juti .’
translation.en: And his name shall be called in Israel , The house of him that hath his shoe loosed .
I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving , and will call upon the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ka jingkñia ainguh bad ai ka jingduwai sha me .
Ki la ïashong ban ïasaidnia para ma ki , katai ba ngin ong ? Lada ngi ong , ‘ Na U Blei ,’ un ong ha ngi , ‘ Balei , te , ba phim shym la ngeit ïa u Ïoannis ?’
translation.en: And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven  ; he will say , Why then believed ye him not ?

translation.kha: nangta khatsaw sniehdoh nga la leit pat sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad u Barnabas , nga da ïalumlang lang hati ïa u Titos .
translation.en: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas , and took Titus with me also .
And when the time of the fruit drew near , he sent his servants to the husbandmen , that they might receive the fruits of it .
translation.kha: Haba ka por ka la poi ban lumlang ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa ki mraw jong u sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang ïa ka bhah jong u na ka jingkheit .
Ki la shim ïa ka na ka ïing jong u Abinadab kaba don halor lum , bad ki buh ïa ka ha ka kali tymmen . U Ussah bad u Ahio , ki khun shynrang jong u Abinadab , ki lamler lynti ïa ka kali ,
translation.en: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart , and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah : and Uzza and Ahio , the sons of Abinadab , drave the new cart .
All things have I seen in the days of my vanity : there is a just man that perisheth in his righteousness , and there is a wicked man that prolongeth his life in his wickedness .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong nga ka long ka bym don jingmut , hynrei ha ka nga la ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh . Katto katne ki briew kiba bha ki lah ban ïap katba kiwei pat ki dang im wat haba ki long kiba sniew .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead , that they might enlarge their border :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ka Ammon ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ha ki thma jong ki ban pynïoh bun ki jaka , ki la puid wat ïa ki kynthei kiba punkhun ha Gilead .
Ka durkhmat jong u ka phyrnai kum ki mawkordor , kum u Jasper mala u Karnelian , bad baroh sawdong ka khet la don u simpyllieng uba don ka urlong kum ka jong u Diamond .
translation.en: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone : and there was a rainbow round about the throne , in sight like unto an emerald .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ki Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai , kumta u shah ïa ki Midian ban synshar ïa ki haduh hynñiew snem .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  : and the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years .

translation.kha: Ïa ka ïingsyiem la pynitynnat da ki pyrda bajngum mala balieh , ba la teh da ki tyllai lynñiar sawjngum bani ha ki syrwiang rupa bad pynstet ha ki rishot maw marbl . Ïa ki jaka shong shaniah ha ka ïingsyiem , la shniah da ka ksiar pynlang ka rupa , bad ïa ka madan la siang da u maw mar balieh , maw marbl basaw , u mawkordor baphyrnai , Bad u mawkordor jingbudnam .
translation.en: Where were white , green , and blue , hangings , fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble : the beds were of gold and silver , upon a pavement of red , and blue , and white , and black , marble .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Bret ïa u ha madan . Haba u Moses u bret ïa u , uta u diengduh u kila bseiñ , badno u Moses u phet na uta .
translation.en: And he said , Cast it on the ground . And he cast it on the ground , and it became a serpent  ; and Moses fled from before it .

translation.kha: U Aristarkhos , naba ha byndi lem bad sa , u phah ka jingkhublei ïa phi , malade kamut ruh u Markos , u bakha lad u Barnabas . ( Phi la da ïohsngew lypa ïa ki jingbeh ba pdiang sngewbha ïa u Markos lada u wan sha phi . )
translation.en: Aristarchus my fellowprisoner saluteth you , and Mark , sister s son to Barnabas , ( touching whom ye received commandments : if he come unto you , receive him ; )
Ye see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand .
translation.kha: Phi ïohi katno ki dak heh nga pynlong haba nga thoh sha phi mynta da la ka jong ka kti!

translation.en: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain , and make them joyful in my house of prayer : their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar  ; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people .
translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa phi sha Seïon , sha u lum bakyntang jong nga , ngan ai ha phi ka jingkmen ha ka ïing jingduwai jong nga ; bad pdiang ïa ki jingkñia kiba phi ai ha ka duwan jong nga . Ïa ka ïing jong nga yn khot ka ïing jingduwai na ka bynta ki briew jong ki ri baroh .
hynriew U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Kam dei na ka bynta jong nga ba kane ka sur ka la kren , hynrei na ka byndi jong phi .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said ,  This voice came not because of me , but for your sakes .
Give heed to me , O  Lord  , and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la duwai ,  A  Trai  , to sngap ïa kaei ba nga ong bad to shahshkor ïa kaei ba ki nongshun jong nga ki ong shaphang jong nga .

translation.en: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah , saying , As the  Lord  liveth , that made us this soul , I will not put thee to death , neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life .

translation.kha: Hato u la pynbieit ïa phi ruh ? ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa ki .
translation.en: Then answered them the Pharisees , Are ye also deceived ?

translation.en: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering  ; he shall put no oil upon it , neither shall he put any frankincense thereon : for it is a sin offering .
According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God , which was committed to my trust .

translation.en: Yet the  Lord  testified against Israel , and against Judah , by all the prophets , and by all the seers , saying , Turn ye from your evil ways , and keep my commandments and my statutes , according to all the law which I commanded your fathers , and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets .

translation.en: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down , and without walls .
translation.kha: Lada phim lah ban synshar ïa ka jingbitar jong phi , phin long khlem ka jingïarap kum ka nongbah bym don kynroh , kaba lait rynghang ban shah tur ïaleh .
Ka shadem jong phoi lai kyndeh da ka jingsheptieng kat ïa kaba phi ïohi . Man ka step phin kwah ba tud wan noh ka janmiet ; man ka jingimat pat phin kwah ba kan waiñ noh ka pha .
translation.en: In the morning thou shalt say , Would God it were even ! and at even thou shalt say , Would God it were morning ! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear , and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see .
Two things have I required of thee  ; deny me them not before I die :
translation.kha: Nga pan na me , A Blei , ban shah ïa nga ban don ar tylli kiei kiei shuwa ba ngan ïap :

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; As I live , surely mine oath that he hath despised , and my covenant that he hath broken , even it will I recompense upon his own head .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , ngan pynshitom ïa u na ka bynta ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka jingïateh lok kaba u la smai ha ka kyrteng jong nga ban bat .
Kin ïap na ka jingthngan bad ka jingpang shit ; kin ïapom na ki jingtap kiba ishyrkhei . Te ngan phah ki mradkhlaw ban kynrup ïa ki , bad ki bseiñ kiba don bih ban puh ïa ki .
translation.en: They shall be burnt with hunger , and devoured with burning heat , and with bitter destruction : I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them , with the poison of serpents of the dust .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep ai ïa kine ki jinghikai ha ki khat-ar ngut ki synran jong u , u la mynno na kata ka jaka nabar u la leit noh ban hikai bad ïalap ha ki shnong naba hajan hangta .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples , he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities .
This is the burnt offering of every sabbath , beside the continual burnt offering , and his drink offering .
translation.kha: Ïa kane ka jingainguh thang dei ban ainguh man la ka Sabbaton nalor ka jingainguh kaba man ka sngi lem bad ka jingainguh da ka waiñ .
U Solomon un ïoh kawei ka jait , na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba nga la jakoid don long ka jong nga na ka ri Israel baroh .
translation.en: ( But he shall have one tribe for my servant David s sake , and for Jerusalem s sake , the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel : )
And as touching the matter which thou and I have spoken of , behold , the  Lord  be between thee and me for ever .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jingkular kaba ngi la pynlong hapdeng jong ngi , U  Trai  un pynthikna ba ngin bat ïa ka junom .
Hadien ba la daiñ ïa u , pynban u dang don hi ka hok ïa-ban shah thied biang .
translation.en: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again  ; one of his brethren may redeem him :

translation.kha: Ngin long U Trai , u Nongpynim jong ph ; na long uto uba la thaw ïa phi . Nga hir U Trai , u Nongbuh ïa baroh kiei kiei . Nga marwei hi per pynpyiar ïa ki bneng ; haba por thaw ïa ka pyut , ym anna u ban ïarap ïa nga .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , thy redeemer , and he that formed thee from the womb , I am the  Lord  that maketh all things  ; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone  ; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself  ;

That ye may eat the flesh of kings , and the flesh of captains , and the flesh of mighty men , and the flesh of horses , and of them that sit on them , and the flesh of all men , both free and bond , both small and great .
translation.kha: Ale bad bam ïa ka doh jong ki syiem , ki nongïalam shipai , bad jong ki shipai , ka doh jong ki kulai bad ki nongshong jong ki , ka doh jong ki briew baroh , ki mraw bad kiba laitluid , kiba rit bad kiba khraw !
Phi la ïuh kumno u la ni ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei .
translation.en: And his miracles , and his acts , which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt , and unto all his land  ;

translation.kha: Kam dei ban bam ïa Kano kano kaba miat na u tieng sohwaiñ ; kam daiñ ban dih waiñ lane thah kyiad , lane ba-im ïa kano kano ka bymkhuid . Ka dei ngab ni ïa kata baroh ïa kaba nga la ong ha ka .
translation.en: She may not eat of any thing that cometh of the vine , neither let her drink wine or strong drink , nor eat any unclean thing : all that I commanded her let her observe .

translation.kha: Uei u shipai uba ju dei ban siew ïa la ki jingpynlut ha ka kam shipai ? Uei u nongrep u bym bam ïa ki soh na la ka bri sohwaiñ ? Uei u nongaplangbrot u bym pyndonkam ïa ka dud na la ki jong ki langbrot ?
U tharai u la ong ha nga , To ïathuh ïa u syiem bad ïa ka kmie jong u ban wan hiar na ki khet jong ki , namar ba ki pansngiat itynnat jong ki , ki la hap noh na ki khlieh jong ki .
translation.en: Say unto the king and to the queen , Humble yourselves , sit down : for your principalities shall come down , even the crown of your glory .

translation.kha: U tei ïa ki kynroh na ka bynta ki nongbah ka Judah ha ka por jong u , mala ym shym don thnam bun bun snieh , namar ba U Trai u ai ha u ïa ka jingsuk .
translation.en: And he built fenced cities in Judah : for the land had rest , and he had no war in those years  ; because the  Lord  had given him rest .

translation.en: And he took all the gold and the silver , and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed–edom , and the treasures of the king s house , the hostages also , and returned to Samaria .
