translation.kha: Phin ym lait im ; yn kem ïa phi bad yn ai noh ïa phi sha u . Phin ïohi ïa u markhmat bad kren ïa u da lade hi ; te nangta phin leit sha Babilonia .

translation.en: And the third took her  ; and in like manner the seven also : and they left no children , and died .
translation.kha: Kajuh ka la jia ha baroh hynñiew ngut — ki la ïap khlem don khun .
U Ishar , u khun uba ar jong u Kohath , u don u khur , u Shelomith , u khlieh Jong ka kur .
translation.en: Of the sons of Izhar  ; Shelomith the chief .

translation.kha: Kuth ki ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa kane , bad u jaboh , Ka hir ka barim kiba khrud ban long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem , kaban khraw than ïa uba kum ma nga uba duk bad u bymdondor ei ei .
translation.en: And Saul s servants spake those words in the ears of David . And David said , Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king s son in law , seeing that I am a poor man , and lightly esteemed ?

translation.kha: Haba u la wan pat ha ka sien kaba lai , u la ong ïa ki , Hattush phira dang ïohbat bad dang shongthait ? Ka la ibiang ! Ka kynta ka la poi ! Khmih , ïa U Khun U Briew yn ai noh mynta ha ka bor jong ki briew kiba pop .
translation.en: And he cometh the third time , and saith unto them ,  Sleep on now , and take your rest : it is enough , the hour is come  ; behold , the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners .

translation.kha: Pynban , na ka bynta jong nga , ngan sngewsarong tang shapoh ka diengphna U Jisu Khrist naba U Tiras jong ngi ; Naba da ka diengphna jong u , ka pyrthei ka la ïap ïa nga , pynlang nga la ïarap ïa ka pyrthat .
translation.en: But God forbid that I should glory , save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ , by whom the world is crucified unto me , and I unto the world .
What then ? shall we sin , because we are not under the law , but under grace ? God forbid .
translation.kha: Kaei te ngin ïa-ong ? Hato ngin leh pop , namar ngim long hapoh ka hukum hynrei hapoh ka jingaiei U Blei ? Ym kumta!

translation.en: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence : and likewise also the wife unto the husband .
translation.kha: U briew u dei ban pyndep hok ïa la ka kamram kum u tnga , bad ka briew ka dei ban pyndep hok ïa la ka kamram kum ka tnga , bad ban pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam iwei ïa iwei pat .
U Trai u ong , Ha kata ka por ngan shim noh ïa ki kulai jong phi bad yn pynïong ïa ki kali ïapom .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  , that I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee , and I will destroy thy chariots :

translation.kha: Pha lah ba-bang sngewthikna ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , U Blei un pyn-i kham bun ka jingisynei ïa ka Salome ban ïa pha !
translation.en: But I say unto you , That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment , than for thee .

translation.kha: U angel uba lai u la bud ïa ki ar ngut ki angel kiba sha khmat , da kaba kren ha ka sur naba jam , Uno uno u mane ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ka dur jong u bad pdiang ïa ka shab ha ka shyllangmat jong u lin ha ka kti Jong u ,
translation.en: And the third angel followed them , saying with a loud voice , If any man worship the beast and his image , and receive his mark in his forehead , or in his hand ,
And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw jong ka jingsynshar u Ahab u syiem ka Israel , u Jehoshaphat u khun jong u Asa u la long u syiem ka Judah ,

translation.en: Ye hypocrites , well did Esaias prophesy of you , saying ,
translation.kha: Phi kiba arsap ! A katno ka long kaba dei haba u Isaïah u la ïathuhlypa shaphang jong phi !

translation.en: And above all these things put on charity , which is the bond of perfectness .
translation.kha: Bad nalor kine ki jinglong baroh , to bynrap ïa ka jingieit , kaba tehsong lang ïa kiei kiei baroh lang ha ka jingïatylli kaba janai .
Ko Sedekaïah , shakor ïa kaei kaba ar ïai-ong Shaphang jong me . Men ym shahïap pynpyut ha ka thma .
translation.en: Yet hear the word of the  Lord  , O Zedekiah king of Judah  ; Thus saith the  Lord  of thee , Thou shalt not die by the sword :

translation.kha: Naba ym anna kano kano kaba U Blei’ um lah ban leh .
translation.en: For with God nothing shall be impossible .

translation.kha: Uba khmih ïa ki shakri ïingsyiem : U Issakhar Ibbah ïakhmih ïa ka jingrai kambah shu pynbor : u Adonijah , u khun jngai u Abda .
translation.en: And Ahishar was over the household : and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute .

translation.kha: Ki la ïamynjur ïa Kanaan ka bynta jong ka ri nawei uei un leit wad , bun ki ïaleit sha la ka jong ka jong ka lad .
translation.en: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it : Ahab went one way by himself , and Obadiah went another way by himself .

translation.kha: san tylli ïa ki jingker naba ha katai pat ka Hul , bun san tyllun ïa ki jingker kiba shadien , Shaphan sepngi .
translation.en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle , and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the sides westward .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ki la kyndat ïa u . U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Ïa u Nongïathuhlypa la burom ha kylleng lieh nala tang hapoh ka shaneng jong u Bad da kiba ha ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: And they were offended in him . But Jesus said unto them ,  A prophet is not without honour , save in his own country , and in his own house .

translation.kha: Hynrei U tharai u la snep tyngeh ïa u Moses bad u Sharon . U ong Namar ba Phim don ka jingneh kaba skhem ban pynpaw ïa ka kun bakhuid jong nga ha khmat ki paid Israel , phyrnai ym ïoh ïa-ban ïamareh ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ban ai ha ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron , Because ye believed me not , to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel , therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them .

translation.kha: Kumta te , tang mar ïa-ïohpdiang ïa kane ka shithi phi dei ban Jedidah ïa wahbah kynsai tam bad uba bit kam na ki khun ki ksiew jong u syiem , pynlong syiem ïa u , bad ïaleh ban ïadait ïa u .
translation.en: Look even out the best and meetest of your master s sons , and set him on his father s throne , and fight for your master s house .

translation.kha: Ka la pynbeit ban don katto katne ki rangbah ha kawei pateng ka kamra , kumta ka pyrta , Samson ! Ki Philistia ki la wanrah ! Hynrei u bthat ïa nia ki saisiej kumba dkut u sian haba dei jing . Kumta kim shym tip satlak ïa kaba rieh ka borbah jong u .
translation.en: Now there were men lying in wait , abiding with her in the chamber . And she said unto him , The Philistines be upon thee , Samson . And he brake the withs , as a thread of tow is broken when it toucheth the fire . So his strength was not known .

translation.kha: Wat ai ba ngim iehnoh ïa ka jingmlien ban ïaseng lang , kumba don kiba leh . Pynban , to ngaiñ pynshlur uwei ïa uwei pat , khim haba phi ïohi ba ka Sngi U Trai ka la nang jan .
translation.en: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together , as the manner of some is  ; but exhorting one another : and so much the more , as ye see the day approaching .
But them that are without God judgeth . Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person .
translation.kha: Wat la katta , kam dei ka kamram jong nga ban bishar ïa kiba nabar . U Blei un sa bishar ïa ki . Hynrei hato kam dei ban bishar ïa ki dkhot na la ka jong ka kynhun hi ? Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Pynmih noh ïa u briew uba sniew na ka kynhun jong phi .
U long uba phi daym ban ïaroh — u long U Blei jongu phi ; bad phi la ïohi da la ki khmat ïa ki kur kiba khraw badno kiba iphylla kiba u la leh na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: He is thy praise , and he is thy God , that hath done for thee these great and terrible things , which thine eyes have seen .
Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the  Lord  thy God , which thou shalt make thee .
translation.kha: Haba phi tei ïa ka duwan U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , wat pynïeng hajan jong ka ïa uno uno u dieng uba don ka dur jong ka bleithaw Asherah .

translation.en: And thou shalt set upon the table shewbread before me alway .
translation.kha: Ïa ka miej dei ban buh ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad u kpu ainguh uba kyntang u dei ban don halor jong ka borabor .

translation.en: And when they bring you unto the synagogues , and unto magistrates , and powers , take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer , or what ye shall say :
translation.kha: Haba ki wallam ïa phi ban shah tian bishar ha ki synagog lane ha khmat ki lyngskor lane ki nongsynshar , wat sngewkhuslai shaphang kumno phin ïasaid da ïa lade lane ïa kaei phin kren .
Ki shna ruh sa ar tyrnem ki jingtap , kawei kaba da ka snieh u langbrot kaba la wieh rong mata , bad kawei pat kaba da ka snieh kaba jlih , ban long kum ka jingtap nalor .
translation.en: And he made a covering for the tent of rams  skins dyed red , and a covering of badgers  skins above that .
The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar  ; it shall never go out .
translation.kha: Ka ding ka dei ban ïai meh lynter halor ka duwan bad ym dei ban shah ba kan lip noh .
U bynriew uba hok , pang , u lah ban ai , Bad ban ai kylluid .
translation.en: He coveteth greedily all the day long : but the righteous giveth and spareth not .

translation.kha: NGA la kylli , ‘ Aïu ngan leh , A Trai ?’ bad U Trai u la ong ha nga , ‘ Ïeng joit bun leit sha Damaskos , bad hangta yn sa ïathuh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la thmu na ka bynta jong me ban leh .’
translation.en: And I said , What shall I do , Lord ? And the Lord said unto me ,  Arise , and go into Damascus  ; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do .

translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u la pynkyntang ïa ki na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka jingmane , lymne bad ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba u la kup na ki jaitbynriew naba u la jop —
translation.en: Which also king David did dedicate unto the  Lord  , with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued  ;
And the gate of the inner court was over against the gate toward the north , and toward the east  ; and he measured from gate to gate an hundred cubits .
translation.kha: Sha shiliang ka khyrdop bashatei la don ka khyrdop kaba ïalam sha ka phyllaw bashapoh , katjuh kumba la don ha ka liang mihngi . Uta u briew u la thew ïa ka jingjngai hapdeng kine ki ar tylli ki khyrdop , bad ka long sanphew mitar .

translation.en: And he was with her hid in the house of the  Lord  six years . And Athaliah did reign over the land .
translation.kha: Ka Jehosheba ka sumar ïa u khynnah haduh hynriew snem bad ka pynrieh ïa u ha ka Templ , katba ka Athalaïah ka dang synshar kum ka syiem .

translation.en: So shall they be life unto thy soul , and grace to thy neck .
translation.kha: Kin ai ha phi ïa ka jingim — ka jingim kaba sngewtynnat bad kaba kmen .
Shisien katba nga dang peit baher ka jingkhangïit ka iing jong nga ,
translation.en: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement ,

translation.kha: Haba phi ïaid lynti na ka lyngkhuit kew jongno jongno , phi lah ban sip ïa u sohkew uba phira kheit da la ki kti , hynriew kitab dei ban ot ïa u da ka rashi .
translation.en: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour , then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand  ; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour s standing corn .
For Moses of old time hath in every city them that preach him , being read in the synagogues every sabbath day .
translation.kha: Naba ïa ka Hukum u Moses la pule la slem bah ha ki synagog man la ka sngi Sabbaton , bad ïa ki ktien jong u la ïalap ha man ki shnong .
Lymne ba u donhok ei ei naba ine lah shun ai da kaba 3 na ka bynta jong u , namar ba u long ma u hi suba ai ka jingim bad ka jingpyrsad Mynsiem bad ïa kaei kaei baroh ha uwei pa uwei .
translation.en: Neither is worshipped with men s hands , as though he needed any thing , seeing he giveth to all life , and breath , and all things  ;
One woe is past  ; and , behold , there come two woes more hereafter .
translation.kha: Ka jingkordit kaba nyngkong ka la kut ; hadien kane ka don sa ar tylli ki jingkordit ki ban wan .

translation.en: And they shall take a cloth of blue , and cover the candlestick of the light , and his lamps , and his tongs , and his snuffdishes , and all the oil vessels thereof , wherewith they minister unto it :
translation.kha: Ka kamram ba ki Lebi ki don ka long tang ban shakri ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u .
U ruh u ithuh ïa ka , bad u ong , ïa-ïohi , ka dei ka sopti jong u ! U mradkhlaw aïu re u la pynïap ïa u . Ïa u Joseph u khun jong nga la tar lyngkhuit lyngkhai !
translation.en: And he knew it , and said , It is my son s coat  ; an evil beast hath devoured him  ; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces .

translation.kha: U Trai u jubab , Ka jait Judah kan leit sneng . Nga ai ha ki ban bat synshar ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Judah shall go up : behold , I have delivered the land into his hand .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , A Trai , me long ha ka liang jongngi nga , uba khlaiñ bad bakhrawbor , bad re kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga kin ym jop , ktien Shah pynlehrain junom , namar Kam lah ban jop . Ïa ka jingjahburom jong ki yn ym klet noh da lei lei .
translation.en: But the  Lord  is with me as a mighty terrible one : therefore my persecutors shall stumble , and they shall not prevail : they shall be greatly ashamed  ; for they shall not prosper : their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew kiba sniew ki long kiba la tim ; kaei kaba ki la leh ïa kiaw mynnin yn leh ïa ka ha ki .
translation.en: Woe unto the wicked ! it shall be ill with him : for the reward of his hands shall be given him .

translation.kha: Ka la long katkum ha baroh ki arphew snem kiba nga la don bad phi . Khatsaw snem nga la shakri ban ïoh ïa ki khun kynthei jyllang phi ar ñiut — nabar hynriew snem na ka bynta ki jingri jong phi . Wat la Katta ruh , phi la pynkylla ïa ka bainong jong por ïathuh shiphew sien .
translation.en: Thus have I been twenty years in thy house  ; I served thee fourteen years for thy two daughters , and six years for thy cattle : and thou hast changed my wages ten times .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la pdiang ba u briew u dih banbeiñ pynsngewbha ïa lade namar ka jingpynsngewbha kaba tang ma ka kaba u ïoh ha kane ka jingim ka long ka jingïaburom bad ka jingïadih bad ka jinglehsngewbha ïa lade . U da la kumno kumno ban leh ïa kano katba u treh ha ka jingim kaba U Blei u la ai ha u ha kane ka pyrem .
translation.en: Then I commended mirth , because a man hath no better thing under the sun , than to eat , and to drink , and to be merry : for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life , which God giveth him under the sun .
Simon Peter said unto him , Lord , whither goest thou ? Jesus answered him ,  Whither I go , thou canst not follow me now  ; but thou shalt follow me afterwards .
translation.kha: Ko Trai , shano men leit ?  u Petros u la kylli ïa u .  Mem lah ban bud ïa nga mynta shano sha ba ngan sa leit ,  U Jisu u la jubab ;  hynrei hadien men sa bud ïa nga .
To wan Bad khmih ïa u bynriew uba la ïathiah ïa nga ïa kiei ki baroh kiba nga la leh . Hato une u da banbeiñ long U Messaïah ?
translation.en: Come , see a man , which told me all things that ever I did : is not this the Christ ?
And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us . God is love  ; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God , and God in him .
translation.kha: Bad ma ngi da lade ngi tip bad ngeit ïa ka jingieit kaba U Blei u don na ka bynta jong ngi . U Blei u long ka jingieit , bad uno uno uba im ha ka jingieit , u im bad U Blei bad U Blei u im hapoh jong u .
Nangta u Moserah u phah khot ïa u Dathan bad u Abiram , hynrei ki ong , Ngim wan !
translation.en: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab : which said , We will not come up :

translation.kha: Ka ïadon ka dei u pudina uba shaphang mihngi . Kine ki dei ki pud jong ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jahthait Bymman ki la jingpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: And Jordan was the border of it on the east side . This was the inheritance of the children of Benjamin , by the coasts thereof round about , according to their families .

If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , thou shalt not harden thine heart , nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother :
translation.kha: Lada don u para Israel uba kyrduh ha kano kano ka shnong kaba ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , wat khim mynsiem bad wat kyntait ban ïarap ïa u ;
U syiem u la ong ha u Daniel ( ïa uba la khot ruh u Belteshassar ) , Hato me da ngab ïathuh ha nga ïa kaei kaba nga phohsniew bad aïu ka kit jingmut ?
translation.en: The king answered and said to Daniel , whose name was Belteshazzar , Art thou able to make known unto me the dream which I have seen , and the interpretation thereof ?
But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest s palace , and went in , and sat with the servants , to see the end .
translation.kha: U Petros u la bud na jngai , haduh ka phyllaw jong ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh . U la leit shapoh ka phyllaw bad u la shong lem bad ki nongap byndi ban khmih kumno kan jia baroh .

Hangne ngi ieh kattne U Blei u longïng uba sbun bad katno u long uba eh . U long kaba eh ïa kito kiba la kyllon , hynrei uba sbun ïa phi — lade phira ïaineh ha ka jingsbun jong u . Hynrei paila phim leh kumta , ma phi hima phin sa shah pynkheiñ .
translation.en: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God : on them which fell , severity ; but toward thee , goodness , if thou continue in his goodness : otherwise thou also shalt be cut off .
And at midnight there was a cry made , Behold , the bridegroom cometh  ; go ye out to meet him .
translation.kha: Ka la da shiteng synñia haba ka jingpyrta ka la sawa jam , ‘ U nongleitkurim u la don hangne ! To wan bad ïashem ïa u !’
Ki synrap ki la kylli ïa u , Nangno ngin ïoh Bam kaba biang ha kane ka ri shyiap ban bsa ïa eit u paidbah ?
translation.en: And his disciples say unto him , Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness , as to fill so great a multitude ?

And the  Lord  said unto him , Call his name Jezreel  ; for yet a little while , and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu , and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Hosia ,  Pynkyrteng ïa u , u ‘ Jesreel ,’ namar kan ym slem shuh shuwa ba ngan pynshitom ïa u syiem ki Israel namar ki kam pynïap briew ba u kpa tymmen jong u , u Jehu u la leh ha Jesreel . Ngan pynkut noh ïa ka jingsynshar na ka longïing syiem jong u Jehu .
Kaba khyndiat kaba phi don shuwa ba tun woh ka la roi kyrhai , bad U Trai u la pyrkhat ïa phi kat kaba nga leit . Mynta ka la dei ka por ïa nga ban peit sa na beit ïa lade .
translation.en: For it was little which thou hadst before I came , and it is now increased unto a multitude  ; and the  Lord  hath blessed thee since my coming : and now when shall I provide for mine own house also ?

translation.kha: Ki phah ruh ïa ki dur khnai kiba da ka ksiar , nawei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka nongjop ba la synshar da ki san ngut ki syep Philistia , ki shongneh ba la ker kynrup malade ki bym shym la ker kynroh . Uta u mawbah ha ka lyngkha u Jeshua uba ha Beth Shemeber , ha uba ki buh ïa ka synduk ka Jutang , u dang don hangta kumin u sakhi haduh ken ka sngi ïa kaei kaba la jia .
translation.en: And the golden mice , according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords , both of fenced cities , and of country villages , even unto the great stone of Abel , whereon they set down the ark of the  Lord  : which stone remaineth unto this day in the field of Joshua , the Beth–shemite .

Then the Levites , Jeshua , and Kadmiel , Bani , Hashabniah , Sherebiah , Hodijah , Shebaniah , and Pethahiah , said , Stand up and bless the  Lord  your God for ever and ever : and blessed be thy glorious name , which is exalted above all blessing and praise .
translation.kha: Kine ki Lebi harum ki ai ïa ka jingkhot sha ka jingmane : u Jeshua , u Kadmiel , u Bani , u Hashabneïah , u Sherebaïah , u Hodaïah , u Shebanaïah , bad u Pethahaïah . Ki ong :  Ïeng bad ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ; ïaroh ïa u junom la junom ! Ai ba baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom jong u , wat la ym don ka jingïaroh ba kynja briew kaba khraw palat .
Naba u Moses u la hukum , ‘ Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ,’ bad , ‘ uno uno kiba tim ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kumwei yn pynïap .’
translation.en: For Moses said , Honour thy father and thy mother  ; and , Whoso curseth father or mother , let him die the death :

translation.kha: Nangne u Moserah u ïathuh ha u Aaron ïa ktien kiei baroh babha U Trai u la ong mynba u phah ïa u ban ithuh phai sha Ijipt ; u ïatyngkhuh ruh ha u shaïong ki kambah kiba U Trai u la hukum ïa u ban ni .
translation.en: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the  Lord  who had sent him , and all the signs which he had commanded him .

translation.kha: Lashai hain khie ka jer , ngan pynhap da u phria wahbah jubor , uba katto uta ka ri Ijipt kam pat ju tip mynno mynno ha ka histori jong ka .
translation.en: Behold , to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail , such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now .

And Moses stretched forth his rod over the land of Egypt , and the  Lord  brought an east wind upon the land all that day , and all that night  ; and when it was morning , the east wind brought the locusts .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u rah ïa la u diengduh , bad U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka lyer na shaphang mihngi ban beh ha kata ka ri baroh shi sngi bad baroh shi miet . Ynda mynstep kata ka lyer mihngi ka wan kit ïa ki puit .
U blei u la Ong , Ko khun u briew , shim ti u maw-it , buh ïa u ha kham jong me bad pruid dak ha u ban ïeng na ka bynta ka nongbah Jerusalem .
translation.en: Thou also , son of man , take thee a tile , and lay it before thee , and portray upon it the city , even Jerusalem :

translation.kha: Hynrei katba u Paul u ïangat batai shaphang ka jingbha , ka bor halor latai , bad ka Sngi ka Jingbishar ka ban sa wan , u Pheliks u la sheptieng bad u la ïa-ong , Mynta me da ban leit noh shuwa . Ngan sa phah khot pat haba nga ïohlad .
translation.en: And as he reasoned of righteousness , temperance , and judgment to come , Felix trembled , and answered , Go thy way for this time  ; when I have a convenient season , I will call for thee .

translation.kha: Nga sngewkmen .
translation.en: I am happy .

translation.kha: Ka la long kumba khat-ar baje haba ka sner ka la sangeh ban tyngshaiñ bun ka jingdum ka la tap ïa ka ri baroh kawei hapoh lai baje ;
translation.en: And it was about the sixth hour , and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour .

translation.kha: Nga lah ban pynkhlaiñ ïa phi da ki jingai jingmut bad ngan ïai kren ban pynkyrteng ïa phi .
translation.en: But I would strengthen you with my mouth , and the moving of my lips should assuage your grief .
And Joseph returned into Egypt , he , and his brethren , and all that went up with him to bury his father , after he had buried his father .
translation.kha: Ynda u Joseph u la lah tep ïa la u kpa , u leit phai pat sha Ijipt ryngkat bad la ki hynmen ki para lem bad kita baroh kiba leit ontep ïa u kpa jong u .

translation.en: If any of you lack wisdom , let him ask of God , that giveth to all men liberally , and upbraideth not  ; and it shall be given him .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno na phi u duna ïa ka jingstad , u dei ban duwai ha U Blei , u ban ai ïa ka ha u ; namar U Blei u ai kylluid bad ai ei ïa baroh .
U Lot , u pyrsad jong u Abram , u la shong la Hukum ha Simon , kumta ki la shym ïa u lema bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u bhor .
translation.en: And they took Lot , Abram s brother s son , who dwelt in Sodom , and his goods , and departed .
And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren , they hated him , and could not speak peaceably unto him .
translation.kha: Haba ki hynmen shynrang jong u ki la ïohi ba u kpa jong ki u kham ieit ïa u Joseph ban ïa ki baroh , ki la isih shibun eh ïa u kat haduh ba kim kren bha kren miat shuh ïa u .
Ale lang sad sngem , phi ki khun shynrang jyllang u Jakob , Shahshkor ïa u Israel u kpa jong phin .
translation.en: Gather yourselves together , and hear , ye sons of Jacob  ; and hearken unto Israel your father .

translation.kha: Ha khih ka rukom , kumno uno uno u lah ban sngewthuh ïa khie kaba phi kriah lada ka khubor jong phi ha ki thylliej baïar kam long naba shai ? Ki ktah jong phi kin jah noh ha suiñ!
translation.en: So likewise ye , except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood , how shall it be known what is spoken ? for ye shall speak into the air .

translation.kha: ban hikai ïa ki Israel ban wanrah sha U Blei ha ki por ba la buh ïa ki jingweng bam badonkam kiba pynsngewbha ïa u .
translation.en: Command the children of Israel , and say unto them , My offering , and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire , for a sweet savour unto me , shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season .
If we say that we have fellowship with him , and walk in darkness , we lie , and do not the truth :
translation.kha: Lada , namarkata , ngi ong ba ngi don ka jingïasyllok bad u , pynban , ha kajuh ka por ngi ïaid ha ka jingdum , ngi lamler da ki ktien jong ngi bad ha ki kam jong ngi .

Don ki Pharoah babha la ong , Uta u briew naba la ar ïa kane um kah baneh long na U Blei , naba um shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum Sabbaton . Hynrei , kiwei pat , ki la ong , Kumno u briew uba long u nongpop u haw ban leh kum kita ki kambah kat kine ? Bad ka la don ka jingïapait hapdeng jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore said some of the Pharisees , This man is not of God , because he keepeth not the sabbath day . Others said , How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles ? And there was a division among them .

translation.kha: Kumta mynta ki don ki jingriam baher sawdong jong pa , bad kynja kynsan phi thap da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: Therefore snares are round about thee , and sudden fear troubleth thee  ;

translation.kha: Namarba ïa baroh kiwei kiei la thaw da u , bad baroh kiei kiei ki long lyngba jong u mala na ka bynda jong u . Ha U Blei! , to lama ka burom junom ! Amen .
translation.en: For of him , and through him , and to him , are all things : to whom be glory for ever . Amen .

translation.kha: Ïa khie kiei baroh la leh kat kum ka jingthmu sad ka jingïohi U Blei ; bad U Blei u la jied ïa ngi shun long ki briew jong u hi ha U Khrist namsop ka jingthmu jongno u hi , ba la pynshong nongrim ha kadei kaban u la rai naduh kaba mynnyngkong .
translation.en: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance , being predestinated according to the purpose of him who worketh all things after the counsel of his own will :
For I say unto you , Ye shall not see me henceforth , till ye shall say , Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord .
translation.kha: Naduh mynta , nga ong ha pha , phan ym ïohi shuh ïa nga tad haduh ba phan ong , ‘ U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong u Trai .’

Kiei kita ? u la kylli . Kiwei kiei kiba la jia ha U Jisu uba na Nasareth , ki la jubab . Une u bynriew u la long u nongïathuhlypa bad la ñiew da U Blei bad da ki brup baroh ba u long uba donbor ha kiei Kiei baroh kiba u Kren bad har .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What things ?  And they said unto him , Concerning Jesus of Nazareth , which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people :
I went down to the bottoms of the mountains  ; the earth with her bars was about me for ever : yet hast thou brought up my life from corruption , O  Lord  my God .
translation.kha: Nga la ngam shaduh ki trai jong ki lumbah , sha ka ri kaba ki khyrdop ki khang junom . Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  U Blei jong nga , me la wanrah im pat ïa nga na ki jingjylliew .

Ka ri kan ym shahshkor shu ïa ki jingïohipaw kiba krenbeiñ ïa ka , lane ïohi ki kynja bynthiew bakha peitbeiñ ïa ka . Ka ri kan ym knieh shuh ïa la ki khun na ka jingbhabriew . Ma nga , U Trai nongshong , nga la kren .
translation.en: Neither will I cause men to hear in thee the shame of the heathen any more , neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the people any more , neither shalt thou cause thy nations to fall any more , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Mynta to ïathuh ïa ki Israel ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga ong : Balei phi den ban leh ïa kijuh ki pep kaba ki kpa jrong phi ki la leh Bad ba phi ïabud niewbein ki bleithaw jong ki ?
translation.en: Wherefore say unto the house of Israel , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Are ye polluted after the manner of your fathers ? and commit ye whoredom after their abominations ?

translation.kha: Ale waiñ shane , phi ki briew kiba duna ka jingsngewthuh ! Ha u briew uba bieit ka ong ,
translation.en: Whoso is simple , let him turn in hither : and as for him that wanteth understanding , she saith to him ,
And Saul s servants said unto him , Behold now , an evil spirit from God troubleth thee .
translation.kha: Ki shakri jong u ki ong ha u ,  Ngi tip ba u mynsiem bymman ba la phah U Blei u pynjynjar ïa phi .
Ki biria bahok kin pynrem ïa ki shalor ka daw jong ka jingawria bad jingpynïap briew , namar ki ïai klim bad ki kti jong ki , ki bit da ka snam .
translation.en: And the righteous men , they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses , and after the manner of women that shed blood  ; because they are adulteresses , and blood is in their hands .

translation.kha: Namar ba U Jisu Khrist u la leh ïa Kiei kaba U Balei u kwah ïa u ban leh , ïa ngi baroh la pynkhuid na ka nongpop da ka jingainguh kaba u la aiti ïa la ka jongnga ka jemnud tang shisien hi .
translation.en: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all .

translation.kha: hynrei U Trai u la ïai-ong ha u , ‘ Me la leh ïa kaba dei ba me kwah ban tei ïa ka Templ ïa nga ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto David my father , Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name , thou didst well that it was in thine heart .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingteh ha ka shatei : Ha u patsha Artakserksis , na ki Sikhri jong , ki rangbah ka Epaphras Sepngi .
translation.en: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him , even unto Artaxerxes the king  ; Thy servants the men on this side the river , and at such a time .
Thou makest darkness , and it is night : wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth .
translation.kha: Me la thaw ïa ka miet , bad ha ka jingdum baroh ki mradkhlaw ki mih shabar .

translation.en: Who changed the truth of God into a lie , and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator , who is blessed for ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Ki bujli ïa ka jingshisha U Blei da ka jinglamler ; ki mane bad shakri ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la thaw , ha ka jaka ban mane bad shakri ïa U Nongthaw hi , ïa uba dei ban ïaroh junom ! Amen .
Nangta ngan sa wang nep ïa ka kti jong at , bad “Men sa Iohi ïa ka ingdong jongnga ar ym ïa ka khmat jong nga .
translation.en: And I will take away mine hand , and thou shalt see my back parts : but my face shall not be seen .

translation.kha: U Blei jong ki kpa thnum Jong ngi u la pynmihpat ïa U Jisu na ka jingïap , hadien ba phi la lah pynïap ïa u da kaba sahnar ïa u ha ka diengphna .
translation.en: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus , whom ye slew and hanged on a tree .

translation.kha: Lai sien nga la duwai ha U Trai shaphang kane bad nga la kyrpad ïa u don weng noh ïa ka .
translation.en: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice , that it might depart from me .

But Jehosheba , the daughter of king Joram , sister of Ahaziah , took Joash the son of Ahaziah , and stole him from among the king s sons which were slain  ; and they hid him , even him and his nurse , in the bedchamber from Athaliah , so that he was not slain .
translation.kha: Tang u Joash u khun jong u Ahasaïah u lait im . U la jan shah pynïap ryngkat bad kiwei , hynrei la pyllait im ïa u da ka ñiakha jong u , ka Jehosheba , kaba long ka khun jong u syiem Jehoram bad ka bakha u Ahasaïah . Ka shim ïa u lem bad ka nongsumar jong u sha ka kamra thiah kaba don ha ka Templ bad ka la pynrieh ïa u na ka Athalaïah , kumta um shym la shah pynïap .
Shen u nongshukor un ot ïa ki bun un ïuhroit ïa ki kum u kew ha ka jaka tylliat kew . Ma nga , U Trai Borabor Baroh , U Blei jong ki Israel , nga la kren .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor , it is time to thresh her : yet a little while , and the time of her harvest shall come .

translation.kha: Naba kumba ka jingïap ka la wan da ti u briew , ha kajuh ka rukom ka jingmihpat na ka jingïapan ka wan da uwei u bhabriew .
translation.en: For since by man came death , by man came also the resurrection of the dead .

translation.kha: Ki nongbah Bakyntang jong me ki long kum ka ri shyiap ; ka Jerusalem ka longïng ka jaka kynjah ba la pynïoh ,
translation.en: Thy holy cities are a wilderness , Zion is a wilderness , Jerusalem a desolation .

translation.kha: de u Jotham uba tei ïa ka Khyrdop kaba shaneng jong ka Templ , bad u la twa pynheh sha shuh ïa ka kynroh ka nongbah hapoh ka jaka jong ka Jerusalem ba la khot ka Ophel .
translation.en: He built the high gate of the house of the  Lord  , and on the wall of Ophel he built much .
And when the seven among four thousand , how many baskets full of fragments took ye up ?  And they said , Seven .
translation.kha: Bad haba nga la kdiah ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki saw hajar ngut ki briew ,  U Jisu u la kylli ,  katno tukri kiba da ki lyngkhot kpu ba sah tam kiba phi la ïalum ?   Hynñiew ,  ki la jubab .

translation.en: I will also smite mine hands together , and I will cause my fury to rest : I the  Lord  have said it .
translation.kha: Nga ruh ngan thab ïa la ki kti , bad ka jingbitar jong nga kan jah noh . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
U Blang u la ong ha ki , Pyntngit ïa ka Templ . Pyndap ïa ki phyllaw jong ka da ki metïap . shadong noh ïa ka kam ! Kumta ki la ïasdang ban pynïap ïa ki briew ha ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Defile the house , and fill the courts with the slain : go ye forth . And they went forth , and slew in the city .

translation.kha: Ïa uta uba la shah kdew malade ha babha la lap ïa ki tiar ki tar kiba la kam yn thang ha ka ding , lem bad ïa ka longïing jong u , malu kaei kaei baroh kaba u don , nala u wandur ïa ka jinglehrain bashyrkhei ïa ki Jerusalem malu u la pynkheiñ ïa ka jrong jngai nga .
translation.en: And it shall be , that he that is taken with the accursed thing shall be burnt with fire , he and all that he hath : because he hath transgressed the covenant of the  Lord  , and because he hath wrought folly in Israel .

translation.kha: Ngi sawa ha tyllong .
translation.en: I live in Shillong .

translation.kha: ( 1 Petros 3 :18 ) Hadien kata , U Bel u la thung ïa u kum u Syiem .
translation.en: ( 1 Peter 3 :18 ) Since then , God has made him a King .
Then he returned , and walked in the house to and fro  ; and went up , and stretched himself upon him : and the child sneezed seven times , and the child opened his eyes .
translation.kha: U Elisha u khie joit , u ïaid shane shatai hapoh kamra , bad nangta u leit biang bad u pyiar ïa lade halor u khynnah . U khynnah u la synriah hynñiew sien bad u peit la ki khmat .
Lada uno uno u setkut ïa phi , ka jingai sngewkwah kaba ai ha kaba riat ka pynjem jai ïa u .
translation.en: A gift in secret pacifieth anger : and a reward in the bosom strong wrath .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ka Dimonah , ka khun jong u Jakob bad ka Leah , ka la leit jngut ïa ki katto katne ki kynther Kane .
translation.en: And Dinah the daughter of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob , went out to see the daughters of the land .

translation.kha: Nga lah ban khong ka jingai ban ïalap da ka jingpyrsad Mynsiem ; nga lah ban don ïa ka jingtip baroh bad shemphang ha ki jingïamai baroh ; nga lah ba-bang khong ïa ka jingngeit baroh kaba donbok ban pynkynriah ïa ki lumbah — hynrei lada ngam don ka jingieid , ngam longkmie ei ei .
translation.en: And though I have the gift of prophecy , and understand all mysteries , and all knowledge ; and though I have all faith , so that I could remove mountains , and have not charity , I am nothing .

translation.kha: U Elkanah u tnaw jong ka u kylli ïa ka , Hannah , balei ba phi da ïa-ïam ? Balei ba phim bam ei ei ? Bel ba phi shu sngewsih sah ? Hato ngam khnam lah ma nga ha ph ban ïa shipai ngut ki khun shynrang ?
translation.en: Then said Elkanah her husband to her , Hannah , why weepest thou ? and why eatest thou not ? and why is thy heart grieved ? am not I better to thee than ten sons ?

translation.kha: Don tang kawei ka aiñ kaba ïadei lang ïa ka jingkñia namarba ka pum bad ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh patar : ka doh ka dei jong u lyngdoh ibha pyndep ïa ka jingbna .
translation.en: As the sin offering is , so is the trespass offering : there is one law for them : the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it .

And it was so , when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court , that she obtained favour in his sight : and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand . So Esther drew near , and touched the top of the sceptre .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u ïohi ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei , ba ka ïeng habar , ka la ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong u , bad u pyn-i ïa ka ïa u diengsynshar ksiar . Nangta ka kiew shalor bad ka ktah ïa ka tduh uta u diengsynshar .
Ha ki por baïar Ngi kit halor ki met baïap jong ngi ïa ka jingïap U Jisu , khnang ba ka jingim jong u ruh kan paw ha ki met jong im’ .
translation.en: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus , that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body .
The sons of Gershon  ; Libni , and Shimei , according to their families .
translation.kha: U Gershon u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : u Libni bad u Shimei , bad ki ruh ki don bun ki khun ki ksiew .

To lehkmen ha ka jingim bad ka briew kaba phi ieit , katba phi dang im ka jingim ka bymmyntoi ka U Blang u la ai ha phiah ha kane ka pyrthei . Lehkmen ïa kawei pa kamai ka sner bymmyntoi jong ka , namar kata baroh ka long kaba pher ïoh na ka bynta ka jingjyrsieh jong phi baroh .
translation.en: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity , which he hath given thee under the sun , all the days of thy vanity : for that is thy portion in this life , and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun .

translation.kha: U jubab , Nga lah ban kren tang ïa kaei kaba U Trai u ong ïa nga ban kruiñ .
translation.en: And he answered and said , Must I not take heed to speak that which the  Lord  hath put in my mouth ?
And it fell on a day , that he came thither , and he turned into the chamber , and lay there .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Elisha u la wan phai sha Shunem bad u la leit kiew sha la ka kamra ban pynjahthait .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that every one that is left in thine house shall come and crouch to him for a piece of silver and a morsel of bread , and shall say , Put me , I pray thee , into one of the priests  offices , that I may eat a piece of bread .
translation.kha: Kat uba dang sah na ki khun ki ksiew jong me un leit ha uta u lyngdoh bad pan na u ïa ka pisa bad ka jingbam , bad kyrpad ïa u ban shah ba un ïarap ïa ki lyngdoh khnang ba un ïoh ei ei ban bam .
U Laban u jubab , Kam ju dei ka dustur hangne ngab ai shuwa ïa ka Kynhun khatduh ban shongkurim ha shuwa ka hynñiew .
translation.en: And Laban said , It must not be so done in our country , to give the younger before the firstborn .

translation.kha: Baroh ki Israel ibha don hangta ki la phet ïarep haba ki jingïohknieh ïa ka jinglynñiar jong ki . Ki la ïa-pyrta , Pha , Ka Khynñiuh ka lah ban nguid ïa ngi mad !
translation.en: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them : for they said , Lest the earth swallow us up also .

And when I saw that ye delivered me not , I put my life in my hands , and passed over against the children of Ammon , and the  Lord  delivered them into my hand : wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day , to fight against me ?
translation.kha: Haba nga la ïohi ba phim shym wan ïarap ïa nga , nga la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim bad nga jam ïa u pud ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ; bad U  Trai  u la ai ha nga ka jingjop halor jong ki . Te balei pat phi wan ban ïaleh ïa nga mynta ?
Kata ka long ka kupar jong ki briew kiba sngewieit , ka kupar jong kito ki bymsalia ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked , and this is the place of him that knoweth not God .

translation.kha: Phi la lehbha Iso katta! Uei suba la pynlong ïa phi ban sheng ïa-ban kohnguh ïa ka jingshisha ? Da kumno u la khroh ïa phi ?
translation.en: Ye did run well ; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth ?

translation.kha: Ki nongap khyrdop ki pynbna ïa kata ka khubor , malu la leit rah ïa ka shiah ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And he called the porters  ; and they told it to the king s house within .

translation.kha: Kumjuh , ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew u dam ïa ki mawlynnai kiba kordor ,
translation.en: Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man , seeking goodly pearls :

And when he had removed him , he raised up unto them David to be their king  ; to whom also he gave testimony , and said , I have found David the son of Jesse , a man after mine own heart , which shall fulfil all my will .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la weng noh ïa u , U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban long u syiem jong ki . Kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la ong shaphang jong u : ‘ Nga la shem ba u Dabid u khun jong u Jesse , u long u jait briew uba nga sngewbha , u briew u ban leh ïa baroh kaba nga kwah ïa u ban leh .’
Mynmiet haba ki briew ki dang ïohthiah , U Blei u kren ha ki jingphohsniew bad jingïohipaw .
translation.en: In a dream , in a vision of the night , when deep sleep falleth upon men , in slumberings upon the bed  ;

translation.kha: A Trai , men shahshkor ïa ki jingaiei jong Kiba rit kyrduh ; me ai ha ki ka jingshlur .
translation.en: Lord  , thou hast heard the desire of the humble : thou wilt prepare their heart , thou wilt cause thine ear to hear :
Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot , the mistress of witchcrafts , that selleth nations through her whoredoms , and families through her witchcrafts .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Ninebeh , ka nuti la nang pynshitom . Kaba khring bad kaba dap da ki jingpynshohbieit kiba ma , ka la pynshohbieit ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ka la ringmraw ïa ki .

Ki ksai jyrthiaw kin long koum ki jingpynkynmaw , bad man ka por ba phi ïohi ïa ki , phin kynmaw ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh bad kohnguh ïa ki ; te kumto phin ym phai noh na nga bad bud ïa ki jingkwah mon bad ki jingkwah brai jong phi .
translation.en: And it shall be unto you for a fringe , that ye may look upon it , and remember all the commandments of the  Lord  , and do them  ; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes , after which ye use to go a whoring :

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Shem — u Elah , u Assir , u Arpakhshad , u Lud , nabar u Aram — kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ joit na ki .
translation.en: The children of Shem  ; Elam , and Asshur , and Arphaxad , and Lud , and Aram .

translation.kha: nangta ïa ngi kiba dang im ha kata ka por yn lumlang lem Bad ki ha ki ha ki lyoh ban ïashem ïa U Trai ha suiñ . Bad kamet ngin ïailong borabor bad U Trai .
translation.en: Then we which are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds , to meet the Lord in the air : and so shall we ever be with the Lord .
And it came to pass , when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book , until they were finished ,
translation.kha: U Moses u thoh lut ïa ka Aiñ U Blei ha ka kitab , khlem da ieh kawei ruh ka ktien .

translation.en: And he said unto them , Know ye Laban the son of Nahor ? And they said , We know him .
translation.kha: U kylli ,  Phi ithuh ïa u Laban u khun jong u Nahor ?   Ho-oid , ngi ithuh ,  ki jubab .
Ïa ki kamram la pynkhamti ha ki khun ki kiew jong u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .
translation.en: Of the Amramites , and the Izharites , the Hebronites , and the Uzzielites :

translation.kha: Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie , ba pa’ lah ban im slem ha ka ri kaba nga ai ha phoi .
translation.en: Honour thy father and thy mother : that thy days may be long upon the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .

translation.kha: Lada , namarkata , sem nong ba ngi khong ka jingïasyllok mala u , pynban , ha kajuh ka par I ïaid ha ka jingdum , ngi lamler! da ki ktien jong I bad ha ki kam jong ngi .
translation.en: If we say that we have fellowship with him , and walk in darkness , we lie , and do not the truth :

translation.kha: Ki ba-don lai ki sakhi : U Mynsiem , ka um bad ka sngem ; bad kine baroh lai ki ai ïa kajuh ka jingphla .
translation.en: And there are three that bear witness in earth , the Spirit , and the water , and the blood : and these three agree in one .
Then the priest shall come and look , and , behold , if the plague be spread in the house , it is a fretting leprosy in the house : it is unclean .
translation.kha: Lada ka la pur , kata ka ïing ka long ka bymkhuid .

translation.en: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt , furnish thyself to go into captivity : for Memphis shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: To pynkhreh ban shah kem koidi , phi ki briew ka Ijipt ! Ïa ka Memphis yn sa pynlong ka ri shyiap , ka jingjot ha kaba yn ym don ban shong ban sah .

translation.en: And when the south wind blew softly , supposing that they had obtained their purpose , loosing thence , they sailed close by Crete .
translation.kha: Ka lyer kaba jai jai na shathie ka la sdang ban beh , bad ki rangbah ki la pyrkhat ba ki lah ban pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong ki , kumta ki la ïaring noh ïa u angkor bad ki la king kham jan katba lah marsyndah jong ka rud duriaw jong ka Krit .
u tip) mynnin ngam khim ïoh ïa ki hok jong ngi kiba u la ai ïa ngi ;
translation.en: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High ,

translation.kha: Uta u briew uba leit ñiah ïa uta u langsohmoh sha ka ri shyiap sha u Asasel u dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad un sum suk ba un wan pat shapoh ka jaka shong dara .
translation.en: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes , and bathe his flesh in water , and afterward come into the camp .
Behold , this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom , pride , fulness of bread , and abundance of idleness was in her and in her daughters , neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy .
translation.kha: Ma ka bad ki khun kynthei jong ka ki la sngewsarong namar ki la don kyrhai ban bam bad im ha ka jingsuk bad ka jingjar jar , hynrei kim shym la sumar ïa kiba duk bad ïa kiba rangli .

translation.en: And Bethuel begat Rebekah : these eight Milcah did bear to Nahor , Abraham s brother .
translation.kha: Ka Milkah ka ïoh ïa kine ki phra ngut ki khun na u Nahor , u para u Abraham .
U symboh u la kyndit thiah Bad u sngewthuh ba u la pynshoi .
translation.en: And the seven thin ears devoured the seven rank and full ears . And Pharaoh awoke , and , behold , it was a dream .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba la ïohi ka long kaba sngewtriem katta katta ba u Moses u la ong , Nga la khynñiuh bad nga la sheptieng !
translation.en: And so terrible was the sight , that Moses said , I exceedingly fear and quake : )
And the priest said unto them , Go in peace : before the  Lord  is your way wherein ye go .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh u jubab ,  Phim donkam ban khuslai ei ei . U  Trai  un sumar ïa phi ha ka jingleit jong phi .
Ka lawar ding ka jingleh rhem bha , ishyrkhei ka eitnar kam um bad ka tuid noh . Ka long ka bymmyntoi ban ïai phrang ïa ki briew jong nga , namar ïa Kito kiba sniew ym smam la weng noh .
translation.en: The bellows are burned , the lead is consumed of the fire  ; the founder melteth in vain : for the wicked are not plucked away .

translation.kha: Pynbna ha u paidbah , ‘ Uno uno uba sngewbishni u dei ban leit blei noh sha ïing , bad I ngin sah hangne ha u lum Gilead .’ Kumta ahor ar hajar ngut ki leit phai noh , bad shiphew hajir ngut ki sah .
translation.en: Now therefore go to , proclaim in the ears of the people , saying , Whosoever is fearful and afraid , let him return and depart early from mount Gilead . And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand  ; and there remained ten thousand .

translation.en: And they shall make themselves utterly bald for thee , and gird them with sackcloth , and they shall weep for thee with bitterness of heart and bitter wailing .

translation.en: Whereupon the king took counsel , and made two calves of gold , and said unto them , It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem : behold thy gods , O Israel , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .

translation.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the host : and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai bad u la dumok ïa ki bad u la ong ,  Phim tip phi dei na u jait Mynsiem aïu ; naba U Khun U Briew um shym la wan ban pynjot ïa ka jingim jong ki briew , hynrei ban pynim ïa ki .
U shim katto katne ka malai , ka dud , bad ka thoh , dara u buh ïa kita ki jingbam ha khmat jongnga kita ki rangbah . Hangta ha trai u dieng u la pynbiang ïa ki da lade hi , bad ki la ïabam .
translation.en: And he took butter , and milk , and the calf which he had dressed , and set it before them  ; and he stood by them under the tree , and they did eat .

translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang sha U Tharai , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : uwei u masi lyngdoh , uwei u langbrot bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the  Lord  for a sweet savour  ; one young bullock , one ram , and seven lambs of the first year  ; they shall be unto you without blemish :

translation.kha: U Trai un kyrkhu ba phin roi kyrhai ha ki khun ki ktien , ba ki jingthung jongu phi ktang seisoh shibun , bad ba ki masi bun ki byrngut jongki Phi kin at bun .
translation.en: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body , and the fruit of thy ground , and the fruit of thy cattle , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep .

translation.kha: U Saul u don hapdeng ka jingïalap kaba jur bha , bad u la shah Siat da u khnam ha u nongshun bad u la mynsaw jur .
translation.en: And the battle went sore against Saul , and the archers hit him , and he was wounded of the archers .

translation.kha: U khap jong phi u la buh ki jingkit kiba khia ïa ngi . Lada phi pynsting ïa kine ki jingkit mala pynlong ïa ka jingim jong ngi katba kham suk te ngin long ki khun ki raïot kiba shakri hok ïa phi .
translation.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous : now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father , and his heavy yoke that he put upon us , and we will serve thee .
They turn the needy out of the way : the poor of the earth hide themselves together .
translation.kha: Ki khanglad ïa kiba duk ba kin ïoh ïa ki hok jong ki bad pynbor ïa kiba kyrduh ban phet rieh .

hynrei ma phi pat wat sah Haneng . Ïai bah ïa ki nongshun jong phi , bad tur ïaleh ïa ki na Sdien ; wat ailad ba kin ïohrung sha la ki jong ki nongbah ! U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor jong ki .
translation.en: And stay ye not , but pursue after your enemies , and smite the hindmost of them  ; suffer them not to enter into their cities : for the  Lord  your God hath delivered them into your hand .

translation.kha: Nga long ka Jingstad , nga khnam kordor ban ïa ki mawleiñ ; baroh kaba phi angnud kam lah don ïanujor bad nga .
translation.en: For wisdom is better than rubies  ; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar , uba la Wanlam pat ïa ki paid Israel sha ïing na ka ri ka jinglongmraw , u la kular ba un sa wallam ïa kiwei pat ki briew ban ïasoh lang bad ki .
translation.en: The Lord  God  which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith , Yet will I gather others to him , beside those that are gathered unto him .

translation.kha: Kin im Haneng ha ka jingshongshngain . Kin Tei ïa ki ïing bad kan pynlong ïa ki byrni sohwaiñ . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki paramarjan jongki ki baroh kiba la ñiuhlieh ïa ki da ka jingibeiñ , bad ki Israel kine shong shym . Te kin tip ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And they shall dwell safely therein , and shall build houses , and plant vineyards  ; yea , they shall dwell with confidence , when I have executed judgments upon all those that despise them round about them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord  their God .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki kyang jam , Ka lynñiar ka la leit , ka jingot ka la kut , hynrei ym shym la pynim ïa ngi .
translation.en: The harvest is past , the summer is ended , and we are not saved .

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingkren ka anna ka Jingpule na “Ka Kut Ap “Ka kaba shikynta ha kaba ki dkhot ka balang ki lah ïa-ban ai ïajubab na ka Kut Ap Phira ( ha ka phrung ) .
translation.en: After the discourse , there is a one-hour “Watchtower” Study , in which members of the congregation are welcome to participate in a discussion of an article from the study edition of The Watchtower .

translation.kha: Katto u jaboh u dang shong dang hukum ha dat ka ri , u Reuben u la ïathiah shongkha bad ka Bilhah , kawei na ki tnga kliar jyllang u kpa jong u . U Jakob u la tip ïa kata bad u bitar shla . U Jobab u don khriat ngut ki khur shynrang .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Israel dwelt in that land , that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father s concubine : and Israel heard it . Now the sons of Jacob were twelve :
Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things , O  Lord  ? wilt thou hold thy peace , and afflict us very sore ?
translation.kha: A  Trai  , hato yn ym pynkhih ïa me da kane baroh ? Hato men ym leh ei ei bad shah ba ngin shah jynjar palat ïa kaba ngi lah ban shah ?
To kynmaw ïa kine ki hukum bad ñiewkor ïa ki . Teh ïa ki ha ki ksang ti jong phi bad deng ïa ki ha ki shyllangmat jong phi kum ka jingpynkynmaw .
translation.en: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul , and bind them for a sign upon your hand , that they may be as frontlets between your eyes .

translation.kha: Kumno phi nud ban pyrshang ban pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki Israel na kaba jam sha shiliang ka Jordan ban rupa shata kata ka ri ba U Trai u la ai ha ki ?
translation.en: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the  Lord  hath given them ?

translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ki phut lad phi ban long skhem bad u pynkdang ïa phi da u kew babha tam .
translation.en: He maketh peace in thy borders , and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la ai ruh ïa ki duli pynrieh Ibbah ïadei mala ki jingpynbeit ryntih ïa ki lyngngeit bad ki Lebi , bad pyndep ïa ki kham jong ki , ban ter ïa ki kam jong ka Templ bad ban sumar ïa barben ki khiew ki pliang jong ka Templ .
translation.en: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites , and for all the work of the service of the house of the  Lord  , and for all the vessels of service in the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai badonburom Baroh u la khun jingmut ban leh ïa kane , u la kyntur ïa la ka kti ban pynthnam , malu ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynsangeh ïa u .
translation.en: For the  Lord  of hosts hath purposed , and who shall disannul it ? and his hand is stretched out , and who shall turn it back ?

translation.kha: U Hakhilah , u Ahikam , u Akhbor , u Shaphan , bad u Asaïah , ki leit ïa-ban kylli na ka briew’ kaba kyrteng ka Huldah , ka nongïathuhlypa , kaba shong ba sai ha ka iaka ba kham thymmai jrong ka Jerusalem . ( U Shallum u tnga jong ka , u khun jong u Tikbah bad u ksiar jong u Harhas , uba dei khmih ïa ki barandi ka Templ . ) Ki bapalat ha ka , ïa kaei kaba la jia ,
translation.en: So Hilkiah the priest , and Ahikam , and Achbor , and Shaphan , and Asaiah , went unto Huldah the prophetess , the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah , the son of Harhas , keeper of the wardrobe  ; ( now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college  ; ) and they communed with her .

translation.kha: Bad u la Ong shuh shuh , Ka long Kaei kaba mih na u briew kaba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u .
translation.en: And he said ,  That which cometh out of the man , that defileth the man .
I must work the works of him that sent me , while it is day : the night cometh , when no man can work .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang don ka sngi , ngi dei ban trei ïa ka kam jong uta uba la phah ïa nga ; ka miet ka wan haba ym don uba lah ban trei .

translation.en: On the east three gates  ; on the north three gates  ; on the south three gates  ; and on the west three gates .
translation.kha: La don lai tylli ki khyrdop ha kawei kawei ka liang : Lai tylli ha ka phang mihngi , lai tylli ha ka phang shathie , lai tylli ha ka phang shatei , bad lai tylli ha ka phang sepngi .
Kane ka bynta ka la khah shai shuh shuh , ba uwei pat u lyngkdong uba pher u la paw , uba syriem ïa u Melkhisedek .
translation.en: And it is yet far more evident : for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest ,

translation.kha: Bad Myntan U Trai u Ong , Ha ki lai snem thik , ka spah bakhraw jong ka Moab kan jah noh . Na ki briew kiba buiñ jong ka , tang khyndiat ki ban laitluid im , nabar ktien long kiba tlot .
translation.en: But now the  Lord  hath spoken , saying , Within three years , as the years of an hireling , and the glory of Moab shall be contemned , with all that great multitude  ; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble .

translation.kha: Ka long thik bania nga la ong , phi dei ki nongsyntiat , u Josaïah u jubab .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto them , That is it that I spake unto you , saying , Ye are spies :

translation.kha: Ki la kem ïa ki ar ngut ki khlieh synshar jyllang ki Midian , u Aroer bad u Seba ; ki la pynïap ïa u Oreb ha u Mawsiang Oreb bad ïa u Seir ha ka Thliew khem um sohwaiñ jong u Seeb . Ki bteng ban beh kthong ïa ki Medan bad ki wallam ïa ki Khlieh jong u Oreb bad u Seeb sha u Eden , uba don mynta sha mihngi jongnga ka Jordan .
translation.en: And they took two princes of the Midianites , Oreb and Zeeb  ; and they slew Oreb upon the rock Oreb , and Zeeb they slew at the winepress of Zeeb , and pursued Midian , and brought the heads of Oreb and Zeeb to Gideon on the other side Jordan .

translation.kha: Ki la kli ïa U Blei Uba la pyllait im ïa ki da ki kam badonbok jong u ha Ijipt .
translation.en: They forgat God their saviour , which had done great things in Egypt  ;

translation.kha: Ym lei lei .
translation.en: You are welcome .

translation.kha: Ka Leah ka la punkhun bad ka kha khun shynrang . Ka ïa-ong , U Trai u la ïohi ïa ka jingjynjar jong nga , bad mynta u tnat jong ar un ieit ïa nga ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Rehob .
translation.en: And Leah conceived , and bare a son , and she called his name Reuben : for she said , Surely the  Lord  hath looked upon my affliction  ; now therefore my husband will love me .

translation.kha: ( U Laban u ai ïa ka mraw jong u ka Silpah ha ka Leah ka khun jong u ban Sikhri ïa ka . )
translation.en: And Laban gave unto his daughter Leah Zilpah his maid for an handmaid .

translation.kha: ( Kim pat sngewthuh hi ïa ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba la ong ba u dei ban mihpat na ka jingïap . )
translation.en: For as yet they knew not the scripture , that he must rise again from the dead .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phin ki briew ïa-bujli kiba pyrkhat ba ka jingjop ka ïangat sha jngai bah .
translation.en: Hearken unto me , ye stouthearted , that are far from righteousness :

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïalap khat-ar snam ka rta , ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Maham kumba ju longsyiem .
translation.en: And when he was twelve years old , they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast .
So the last shall be first , and the first last : for many be called , but few chosen .
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut ,  Kumta kiba khatduh kin long ha shuwa , bad kito kiba ha shuwa kin long khatduh .
jynreiñ u Peris u la ïajubab , Ko rangbah , ngam sngewthuh shaphang Kiei phi ïakren ! Kumjuh hi , kabu u dang klun , u syiar u la kynjoh .
translation.en: And Peter said , Man , I know not what thou sayest . And immediately , while he yet spake , the cock crew .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren biang ha ar .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Da katto katne ki diengsoh u pynmeh ding ; u syang doh , u bam ïa ka , bad u kdang . U pynsyaid ïa lade bad u ong , katto kaba sngewtynnat malade sngewsyiad ! Katno ka rhem ka ding !
translation.en: He burneth part thereof in the fire  ; with part thereof he eateth flesh  ; he roasteth roast , and is satisfied : yea , he warmeth himself , and saith , Aha , I am warm , I have seen the fire :

translation.kha: Hynrei don ki riewkai kiba ong , Kumno da kum une u briew u lah ban lehbha ïa ngi ? Ki ibeiñ ïa u Saul bad kim shym wanrah ïa u kano kano ka jingai sngewbha .
translation.en: But the children of Belial said , How shall this man save us ? And they despised him , and brought him no presents . But he held his peace .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ha Ijipt , ki Medan ki la die noh ïa u Joseph ha u Potiphar , imat na ki rangbah synshar jong u syiemsad , uba dei u kapten jong ki ngap phria ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt unto Potiphar , an officer of Pharaoh s , and captain of the guard .

translation.kha: Haba kiba duk ki lynñiar , nga ïarap ïa ki ; nga ai jingïaroh ïa ki kynruh ki bym don lad shu .
translation.en: Because I delivered the poor that cried , and the fatherless , and him that had none to help him .
Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin  ; for his seed remaineth in him : and he cannot sin , because he is born of God .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba long u khun jong U Blei , um ïai leh pop , naba ka jinglong blei batynrai jong U Blei hi ka don ha u ; bad namar U Blei u long u Kpa jong u , um lah ban ïai bteng ban leh pop .

translation.en: And David built there an altar unto the  Lord  , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings , and called upon the  Lord   ; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering .
translation.kha: U la tei hangta ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  bad u la ai ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok . U la duwai , bad U  Trai  u la jubab ïa u da kaba phah ïa ka ding na bneng ban thang ïa ki jingainguh halor ka duwan .
Ka pynkut u Jakob ka la don hangta , bad U Jisu , uba la thait na kata ka jingleit , u la shongtynrai Harod kata ka pluh . Ka hir kumba shiteng snoh .
translation.en: Now Jacob s well was there . Jesus therefore , being wearied with his journey , sat thus on the well : and it was about the sixth hour .

translation.kha: Haba ki la ïa-pyrshah ïa u bad ki la noh kiei kiei kiba sniew shaneng jong u , u la pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewdiaw pyrshah da kaba kynther ïa u pui pui na ki jaiñ-jin jongnga u malade ong ha ki , Lada phiah long kiba la jah noh , phi hi da lade phi dien ban shim ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta jongngi ka ! Ngam don jingkitkhlieh . Naduh mynta ngan leit sha ki Jentil .
translation.en: And when they opposed themselves , and blasphemed , he shook his raiment , and said unto them , Your blood be upon your own heads  ; I am clean : from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles .

translation.kha: Ngin ym leit phai sha la ki longïing jongngi I tad haduh ba kiwei pat ki Israel baroh ki la shim kyntien ïa ka ri kaba la ai ha ki .
translation.en: We will not return unto our houses , until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance .

translation.kha: Long kiba khuid , namar la , U Trai U Blei! jong phi , sa longsyiem uba khun .
translation.en: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel , and say unto them , Ye shall be holy : for I the  Lord  your God am holy .
And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies : thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me : thou hast delivered me from the violent man .
translation.kha: bad u pyllait im ïa nga na ki nongshun jong nga . A  Trai  , me ai ha nga ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga bad me ïada ïa nga na ki riewthombor .
Ha ka jaka rung sha ka nongbah , tuklar ki khyrdop , ka pyrshah :
translation.en: She crieth at the gates , at the entry of the city , at the coming in at the doors .

translation.kha: U Aaron u ong ha ki , Law noh ïa ki sohshkor ksiar ba ki tnga jong phi , ki khum shynrang bad ki khun kynther jong phi ki ding , bad ïalam ïa ki sha nga .
translation.en: And Aaron said unto them , Break off the golden earrings , which are in the ears of your wives , of your sons , and of your daughters , and bring them unto me .
And why stand we in jeopardy every hour ?
translation.kha: Bad na ka bynta jong ngi — balei ma ngi ngin kheiñduh ïa lade man la ka kynta ?
Lada u briew u lehrain ïa nga bad ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , te U Khun U Briew un lehrain ïa u haba u wan ha ka burom jong u bad ha ka burom jong U Kpa bad jong ki angel bakhuid .
translation.en: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words , of him shall the Son of man be ashamed , when he shall come in his own glory , and in his Father s , and of the holy angels .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Samuel ,
translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto Samuel , saying ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Gihon u la sngewthuh ba dei u angel jong U Trai ba u la ïuh , bad u ong ha ka jingsheptieng , A Trai bhabriew ! Nga la ïohi ïa u angel jong me maham !
translation.en: And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the  Lord  , Gideon said , Alas , O Lord  God  ! for because I have seen an angel of the  Lord  face to face .

translation.kha: Mem shym la ailad ba ngan ioh doh ïa la ki khun ksew bun ki khun kynhied jong nga . Kato ka long ka kam babit ban leh !
translation.en: And hast not suffered me to kiss my sons and my daughters ? thou hast now done foolishly in so doing .

translation.kha: Wat la nga la pynsakma ïa ki hap ki jaitbynriew , pynban ha ki jaka ibha jngai eh kin kynmaw ïa sa . Ma ki bad ki khun jong ki kin lait im bad kin wan phai lang sha ïing .
translation.en: And I will sow them among the people : and they shall remember me in far countries  ; and they shall live with their children , and turn again .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la sngewbit te ba kaba bha den kaba ngi lah ban leh ka long ban lehkmen ïa kai kaba ngi la trei . Ym don Kane kano kawei pat kaba i'u lah ban leh . Ym don kano kano ka lyndum ïa ngi shun tip kaei ka pun jia ynda ngi ïapom .
translation.en: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better , than that a man should rejoice in his own works  ; for that is his portion : for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him ?

translation.kha: Naba ym don khubor jingpynjia kaba la ju wan tang na ka mon u briew , hynrei ki briew ki la long hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong U Mynsiem bakynjah katba ki dang kren ïa ka khubor kaba la wan na U Blei .
translation.en: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man : but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba bahynñiew u la put ïa la ka turoi , bad la don ki sur kiba jam ha bneng , uba ong , Ka bor ba nongsynshar halor ka pyrthei ka long mynta ka jong U Trai jong I bad jong U Messaïah jngai u , bad un synshar junom la junom !
translation.en: And the seventh angel sounded  ; and there were great voices in heaven , saying , The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord , and of his Christ  ; and he shall reign for ever and ever .

translation.kha: Haba ki nongap phira ki la otsher phai noh , ki rangbah lyngdoh mala ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa ki , Balei phi khlem waiñ ïalam ïa u ?
translation.en: Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees  ; and they said unto them , Why have ye not brought him ?

translation.kha: U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa U Trai na ka jingïap , malade un pynpluh shwa ïa ngi da ka ba jong u .
translation.en: And God hath both raised up the Lord , and will also raise up us by his own power .

translation.kha: Haba ki synran ki la ïohsngew ïa ka sur , ki la sheptieng hajuh katta katta ba ki la dem khrup la ki durkhmat sha khyndew .
translation.en: And when the disciples heard it , they fell on their face , and were sore afraid .

translation.kha: Phi dem ban raikhoh ïa Kane ka sngi kum ka Jingkhawai mem ban pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa kaei kaba nga , U Trai , nga la leh . Rakhe ïa ka pateng la pateng bynriew .
translation.en: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial  ; and ye shall keep it a feast to the  Lord  throughout your generations  ; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever .

translation.kha: Ngan map ïa ki pah jong ki bad ngan ym kynram shuh ïa ki jinglehhok byndi jyllang ki .
translation.en: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness , and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Asahel um shym sangeh ; kum u Abner , da ka jingtynrah shadien ïa la u sum , u la ting ïa u na ka kpoh ba kumta u sum u da pei bla ha ka ingdong jong u . U Asahel u kyllon ïaphah ha madan , bad uwei pa uwei uba wan Nakon ha ka kajuh ha kaba u kyllon u la sangeh bad ïeng hangta .
translation.en: Howbeit he refused to turn aside : wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib , that the spear came out behind him  ; and he fell down there , and died in the same place : and it came to pass , that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still .
For where two or three are gathered together in my name , there am I in the midst of them .
translation.kha: Namar haba ar lane lai ngut ki ïawanlang ha ka kyrteng jong nga , nga don hangta lem bad ki .

translation.en: Because he slew me not from the womb  ; or that my mother might have been my grave , and her womb to be always great with me .
translation.kha: namar um shym la pynïap ïa nga ha shuwa ba yn kha ïa nga . Te ka kpoh jong i mei jong nga kan jin da la long ka jingtep jong nga .
Nangne kwah ba kun paw kumba ang pyrshang ba pynsheptieng ïa phi da ki shithi jong ar .
translation.en: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters .

translation.kha: Balei ba me la kren ha ka kyrteng jrong U Trai ba khie ka Templ kan long kum ka Shiloh bad ba ïa kane ka nongbah yn pynjot bad yn ym don bashong ba sawa hangta ? Nangta ki briew ki ïalum sawdong ïa nga .
translation.en: Why hast thou prophesied in the name of the  Lord  , saying , This house shall be like Shiloh , and this city shall be desolate without an inhabitant ? And all the people were gathered against Jeremiah in the house of the  Lord .
Where no counsel is , the people fall : but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety .
translation.kha: Ka jaitbynriew kan kyllon lada ym don ka jingïalam . Ha ka jingbun ki nongaibuit don ka jingshngain .
Nga kloi don phah ïa ki rangbah jong nga bad ïarap laiñ ïa ki jong phi ha kambah pynkhreh shibun ki dieng , namar kane ka Templ kaba nga mut ban tei kan hir kaba khraw bad kaba ishongkun .
translation.en: Even to prepare me timber in abundance : for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great .

translation.kha: U Shah ïa u slap ban theh na ki lyoh ha kambah ai um ïa u khunbynriew baroh .
translation.en: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly .

translation.kha: Ktien ki sheng barabor ki long kiba la kerkut syiem da ki kynroh kiba rnong , ki khyrdop , pynlang ki nar-khang khyrdop , bad don pajut bun ki shnong ki bym don kynroh .
translation.en: All these cities were fenced with high walls , gates , and bars  ; beside unwalled towns a great many .

translation.kha: U Sekharaïah u phai ïa la ka iitkhmat sha ka kynroh bad u duwai :
translation.en: Then he turned his face to the wall , and prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: Te u syiem Meshekh u kylli , kadei ka dak ban pynshisha ba nga lah ban leit sha ka Tep ?
translation.en: Hezekiah also had said , What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the  Lord  ?

translation.kha: Man ka sngi u Marduk u ju ïaid sharum shnong ha khmat ka phyllaw ka ïing ki kynthei , khnang ngab tip kamon ka erlangthari Bad katai ka ban jia ïa ka .
translation.en: And Mordecai walked every day before the court of the women s house , to know how Esther did , and what should become of her .
The eye also which saw him shall see him no more  ; neither shall his place any more behold him .
translation.kha: Un jah noh na ka jaka kaba u ju shong ju sah ;

U Trai Nongsynshar u ong , Ko Israel , la slem Bah me la kyntait ïa ka iktiar jong nga ; me la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa to Bad mane ïa per . Ha uwei pa uwei u lum bakynjang bad khoh uwei pa iwei u dieng bajyrngam me la mane ïa ki bleithaw ka jingkharoi .
translation.en: For of old time I have broken thy yoke , and burst thy bands  ; and thou saidst , I will not transgress  ; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest , playing the harlot .
And when he came into the house , he suffered no man to go in , save Peter , and James , and John , and the father and the mother of the maiden .
translation.kha: Haba u la poi ha ïing , um shym shah ïano ïano ban rung shapoh bad u lait noh u Petros , u Ïoannis bad u Jakob , bad u kpa bad ka kmie jong ka khynnah .

translation.en: And , lo , he hath given occasions of speech against her , saying , I found not thy daughter a maid  ; and yet these are the tokens of my daughter s virginity . And they shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city .
translation.kha: U la kynnoh pynban ïa ka da kaba ong ba kam long shuh kaba sotti haba u shongkurim ïa ka . Hynrei kine ki long ki dak jong ka jinglong sotti ka khun jong nga ; khmih ïa ki jingbitsnam ha ka jingsiangthiah shongkurim !’

Nahath un shim ïa uwei na ki khunlangbrot shynrang , ryngkat dara ka shi bynshet na ka lai bynta ka umphniang , pynlang un ai kum ka jingainguh namar ka jingleh palat . Un ai ïa ki khem ka jingai kaba kham kyrpang ha U Trai na ka bynta u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And the priest shall take one he lamb , and offer him for a trespass offering , and the log of oil , and wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord  :
And he called unto him his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That this poor widow hath cast more in , than all they which have cast into the treasury :
translation.kha: U la khot lang ïa ki synran jong u baroh bad u la ong ïa ki ,  Nga ong ïa phi ba kane ka riewkynthei kaba duk , ka la pynnoh kham bun ha ka synduk jingainguh ban ïa baroh kiwei pat .
Ki kren ïa ki jingkren sarong bad ba-mutlop , dara ki riam pah da ki jingkwah brai jong ka doh ïa ki bariew kiba tdong Shuh sdang baneh phet ïap napdeng ki briew kiba im ha ka jingleh bymdei .
translation.en: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity , they allure through the lusts of the flesh , through much wantonness , those that were clean escaped from them who live in error .

translation.kha: hadien Kata u la im sa sawspah lai snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translation.en: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years , and begat sons and daughters .

translation.kha: ha kaba u la sheng Hangta sawphew sngaid , da kaba shahskhor pynshoi ha u “Soitan” . Ki mradkhlaw ki la kein ruh hangta , hynrei ki bishar ki la wan bad ïarap ïa u .
translation.en: And he was there in the wilderness forty days , tempted of Satan  ; and was with the wild beasts  ; and the angels ministered unto him .
Seeing then that we have such hope , we use great plainness of speech :
translation.kha: Namar ba ngi don ïa kane ka jingkyrmen , ngi long kiba shlur bha .
Kam long kaba dei ban pyntong ïa u briew balui lui ban siaw ïa ka kuna ; ka pynkylla khongpong ïa ka jingbishar bahok haba ki briew kiba bha ki sha pynshitom .
translation.en: Also to punish the just is not good , nor to strike princes for equity .

translation.kha: Tang ma u hi u leh ïa ki kambah bakhraw ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymkohnguh .
translation.en: To him who alone doeth great wonders : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Ko ki shynrang , to olib ïa la ki tnga kumba U Khrist u la ieit ïa ka jar malade u la ai ïa la ka jingjam na ka bynta jong ka .
translation.en: Husbands , love your wives , even as Christ also loved the church , and gave himself for it ;
Jesus said unto her ,  I am the resurrection , and the life : he that believeth in me , though he were dead , yet shall he live :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Nga long ka jingmihpat bad ka jingim . Uno uno uba ngeit ha nga un im , wat la u la ïap ; un ïoh im , bad uno uno uba im , bad uba ngeit ha nga un ym ïap lano lano ruh .
jlan haw tang u Barnabas bad ma nga mo kiba dem ban trei na ka pyntwa ban im ?
translation.en: Or I only and Barnabas , have not we power to forbear working ?

translation.kha: U Kornelios , u rangbah shiphang u la phah ïa ngi , ki la jubab . U long u briew Uba bol uba mane ïa U Blei bad uba la ñiewburom shikatdei da ki Jiw baroh . U angel jong U Blei u la ïathuh ïa u ngab khet sngewbha ïa phi sha ka ïng jong u , khnang ba u lah baneh ïasngew ïa kaei kaba pa to ban ong .
translation.en: And they said , Cornelius the centurion , a just man , and one that feareth God , and of good report among all the nation of the Jews , was warned from God by an holy angel to send for thee into his house , and to hear words of thee .

And Lot went out , and spake unto his sons in law , which married his daughters , and said , Up , get you out of this place  ; for the  Lord  will destroy this city . But he seemed as one that mocked unto his sons in law .
translation.kha: Nangta u Lot u la leit sha ki rangbah kiba la ïatehktien bad ki khun kynthei jong u , bad u ong ,  To pynkloi bad mihnoh nangne ; naba U  Trai  un sa pynjot thiaw ïa kane ka jaka .  Hynrei ki pyrkhat ba u shu kren biria .

translation.en: They also went down into hell with him unto them that be slain with the sword  ; and they that were his arm , that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the heathen .
translation.kha: Kin ïahiar lang bad u sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ban pynïasoh bad kito kiba la khyllem lypa . Bad ïa baroh kiba im hapoh ka jingkah syrngiew jong u , yn pynsakma hapdeng ki jaitbynriew .
Em , ha kine baroh ngi ïoh ïa ka jinghap baroh lyngraw jong uta uba la ieit ïa ngi!
translation.en: Nay , in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us .

translation.kha: Ong phi kwah aïu ngan ai , bad pynshongdor katba phi sngewbit ïa ka Nongleitkurim , ngan ai ha ph kat kaba phi patan , tangba paila phi shah ïa nga ban shongkurim ïa ka .
