translation.en: Ask me never so much dowry and gift , and I will give according as ye shall say unto me : but give me the damsel to wife .
She is not afraid of the snow for her household : for all her household are clothed with scarlet .
translation.kha: Haba hap ka ïor , kam khuslai namar kiba ha ka ïing jong ka ki biang ki jaiñ syaid .
Hato ki jingïar jongnga ki bad baroh kaba ki don , kin ym long ki jong ngi ? To ngin ïamynjur ba ki lah ban shong ban sah hapdeng jong ngi .
translation.en: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours ? only let us consent unto them , and they will dwell with us .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha lade , U Blei un kotbah kumjuh ïa uba hok bad uba snep , namarba kaei katai baroh , kan kano ka jingleh , kan jia ha ka Por ba la Buh ïa ka hi .
translation.en: I said in mine heart , God shall judge the righteous and the wicked : for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work .

translation.kha: Haba ki theisamla na Shiloh ki wan shad ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Maham , phi to wan mih na kita ki bri sohwaiñ . Uwei pa uwei na phi un shim da ka bor napdeng kita ki thliem bad ïalang ban longsem ka tnga jong Phi sha ka jaka ki Benjamin .
translation.en: And see , and , behold , if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances , then come ye out of the vineyards , and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh , and go to the land of Benjamin .

translation.kha: Te phi kumta long ki nongbud jong u Trai , namar phin long ki khun kiba ieit eh jong U Blei ,
translation.en: Be ye therefore followers of God , as dear children ;
For as the woman is of the man , even so is the man also by the woman ; but all things of God .
translation.kha: Naba kumba ïa ka briew la thaw na u briew , kumta ruh ïa u briew la kha na ka briew ; bad dei U Blei uba pynlong ïa kiei kiei baroh .

translation.en: The archers have sorely grieved him , and shot at him , and hated him :
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong u ki tur ïaleh tyngeh ïa u , Bad ki beh ïa u da ki ryntieh bad ki khnam ;
Hynrei u syiem un long khlem bor ban ïarap ïa ki , bad ka jingïada ka Ijipt kan kut ha ka jingjot .
translation.en: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame , and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion .
And the most proud shall stumble and fall , and none shall raise him up : and I will kindle a fire in his cities , and it shall devour all round about him .
translation.kha: Ka hima basarong jong pha kan jynthut bad kyllon , bad yn ym don ban ïarap ban khyllie ïa pha . Ngan thang ïa ki nongbah da ka ding , bad kiei kiei baroh sawdong yn pynjot .

Hynrei ki la ïaleit pyrshah ïa nga bad ki la kyntait ban shahshkor . Kim shym la bret noh ïa ki bleithaw bajlih jngai ki lane iaineh ïa ki blei jong ki nong Ijipt . Ngam la kloi shun shahskhor ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor bapra jong ka jingbitar Jong ang hangta ha Ijipt .
translation.en: But they rebelled against me , and would not hearken unto me : they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes , neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt : then I said , I will pour out my fury upon them , to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Uta uba tim ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie u dei ban shah pynïap .
translation.en: And he that curseth his father , or his mother , shall surely be put to death .

translation.kha: Ka long kum ka shithi na u kpa u baïaineh thep mynsiem Sha la ki khulom .
translation.en: It is like a letter from a loving father to his children .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u Abimelekh u leit bad u Phikol , u pynrangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u , malu u ong ha u Abraham , U Blei u long ryngkat nabar me ha kaei kaei baroh ba me leh .
translation.en: And it came to pass at that time , that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham , saying , God is with thee in all that thou doest :

translation.kha: Dei ban pynsangeh ïa u namar u la ong ïa ki briew ha Babilonia ba kine long ki koidi slem bah hangta bad ba kin twa ïa ki ïing , ktang shongduh , kin thaw ki kper , bad bam ïa kaei kaba ki thung .
translation.en: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon , saying , This captivity is long : build ye houses , and dwell in them  ; and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them .

translation.kha: Ki tih shaduh ki tyllong jong ki wah , bad ki wallam sha ka jingshai ïa kaei kaba la bahryntieh .
translation.en: He bindeth the floods from overflowing  ; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light .
And in the eleventh year of Zedekiah , in the fourth month , the ninth day of the month , the city was broken up .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khyndai jong u bnai basaw jong ka snem kaba khatwei ka jinglong syiem u Sedekaïah , ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah la pynpra lut .
Wat ong ei ei , bad don ki ban pyrkhat ba me erlangthari kiba stad !
translation.en: O that ye would altogether hold your peace ! and it should be your wisdom .

And his servants said unto him , Behold now , we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings : let us , I pray thee , put sackcloth on our loins , and ropes upon our heads , and go out to the king of Israel : peradventure he will save thy life .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u ki leit sha u bad ki ong ,  Ngi ïohsngew ba ki syiem Israel ki long kiba isynei . Ai jingbit ïa ngi ba ngin leit sha u syiem jong ka Israel ryngkat bad ki jaiñ byrni sawdong ki syngkai jong ngi bad ki tyllai sawdong ki ryndang jong ngi , bad lehse un pyllait im ïa phi .

translation.en: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples , and said ,  Blessed be ye poor : for yours is the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la khmih ha la ki synran bad u la ong ,  Suk phi kiba duk ; ka Hima U Blei ka long ka jong phi !

translation.en: Thus did Moses : according to all that the  Lord  commanded him , so did he .
translation.kha: U Moses u leh ïa kata baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .
Ki ieit ïa ka jingpynksan u briew ban ïa ka jingpynksan na U Blang .
translation.en: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God .

translation.kha: Nimrah U Jehoahas u “mon ba ki briew baroh kin ioh lait im , bad ba kin poi sha ka jingmihpat ia ka jingshisha .” —1 Timothi 2 :3 , 4 .
translation.en: Because it is Jehovah’s will that “all sorts of people should be saved and come to an accurate knowledge of truth .” —1 Timothy 2 :3 , 4 .
But to the rest speak I , not the Lord : If any brother hath a wife that believeth not , and she be pleased to dwell with him , let him not put her away .
translation.kha: Ha kiwei nga ong ( ma nga da lade hi , ym dei U Trai ) : Lada u parabangeit u don ka tnga ka bymngeit bad ka mynjur ban ïaishong bad u , um dei ban pyllait noh ïa ka .

translation.en: And Pilate answered and said again unto them , What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews ?
translation.kha: U Pilat u la kren biang ha u paidbah ,  Kaei te , phi kwah ïa nga ban leh ïa uta uba phi khot u syiem jong ki Jiw ?
U Nahash u jubab , Neng ïathaw jutang bad pa’ hajar kawei ka kyndon : Ngan khlaw ïa ka Khmut kamon Jong phi baroh , mala da kumta ngan pynjahburom halor ki Israel baroh .
translation.en: And Nahash the Ammonite answered them , On this condition will I make a covenant with you , that I may thrust out all your right eyes , and lay it for a reproach upon all Israel .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah na ki jait ba na shatei ki Phah khat ïa u , bad nangta ma ki baroh ki ïaleit lang sha u Rekhab bad ki ong ha u ,
translation.en: That they sent and called him . And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Israel came , and spake unto Rehoboam , saying ,
And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God , and from his power  ; and no man was able to enter into the temple , till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled .
translation.kha: Ïa ka templ la pyndap da ka tdem na ka burom bad ka bor jong U Blei , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban leit shapoh ka templ tad haduh ba ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam ba la wanrah da ki hynñiew ngut ki angel , ki la poi sha kaba kut .

Ïa ka jingmut jong khwai pa kawei ka jingïohipaw u nongïathuhlypa yn buhrieh noh na phi ; kan Long kum ka kot kli ba la khang pynskhem da ka mut . Lada phi leit rah ïa ka sha uno uno uba tip ban pule bad ong ïa u ban pule ïa ka ha phira , un ong ba um la ban pule namar ba la khang pynskhem da ka muhor ïa ka .
translation.en: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed , which men deliver to one that is learned , saying , Read this , I pray thee : and he saith , I cannot  ; for it is sealed :
Among the bushes they brayed  ; under the nettles they were gathered together .
translation.kha: Shabar ha ki khlaw ki pah kum ki mrad bad ki ïa-thngian lang hapoh ki  lawlynnong .
Kumta ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , nga kular ba u Jehosabad u khun lad u Rekhab un kein Borabor ïa u shynrang u Ban thapniang ba shakri ïa la .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not want a man to stand before me for ever .
The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,

Haba ka por ïambriew ka la kut , u Dabid u phah wan ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïingsyiem ; ka la long noh ka tnga jong u , bad ka kham u khun Shynrang na u . Hynrei U Trai um sngewlah ïa kai kaba u Dabid u la leh .
translation.en: And when the mourning was past , David sent and fetched her to his house , and she became his wife , and bare him a son . But the thing that David had done displeased the  Lord .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban sumar ïa kane ka jingpynbeit ryntih ha ki por ki ban wan barabor . Uta u briew uba synreit ïa ka um ka jingpynkhuid u dei ruh ïa-ban syaid ïa la ki jaiñ ; uno uno umbiah ktah ïa kata ka um u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .
translation.en: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them , that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes  ; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even .

translation.kha: U Trai nongbanbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ai ha nga ka nongrah-khubor na ka bynta u Shemaïah jong ka Nehelam , uba la phah ka shithi ha ka kyrteng jong u hi Sha baroh ki briew jong ka Jerusalem bad sha u Sephanaïah , u lyndum u khun jong u Mattanaïah bad sha baroh kiwei pat ki lyngdoh . Ha khnai ka shithi , u Shemaïah u la thoh shuh u Sephanaïah :
translation.en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saying , Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem , and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest , and to all the priests , saying ,

translation.kha: Nangta , thret ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar nabar thuh ïa ki ha ka bynda ba shad trai Jong ka jingdeng shad ha ka tnaw bashapoh khatsan ka ephod .
translation.en: And thou shalt make two rings of gold , and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof , which is in the side of the ephod inward .

translation.kha: U Manasseh u la pynïap bun ki briew balui den , khih ba ki surok Bah ka Jerusalem ki la tuid da ka snam ; u la leh ïa kane nalor ba u ïalumlang ïa ki bri ka Judah sha ka jingmane bleithaw da kaweh pynlong ïa ki ban leh pop pyrshah ïa U Troas .
translation.en: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much , till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another  ; beside his sin wherewith he made Judah to sin , in doing that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord .

translation.kha: ban ai ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ha baroh ki paid Israel ïa kine pruid ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .
translation.en: Speak unto Aaron , and unto his sons , and unto all the children of Israel , and say unto them  ; This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded , saying ,

translation.kha: U bat synlar ïa ki por bad ki aïom ; u pynlong pynlang u sheng ïa ki syiem ; lama ma u , uba ai ka jingmad bad ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: And he changeth the times and the seasons : he removeth kings , and setteth up kings : he giveth wisdom unto the wise , and knowledge to them that know understanding :

translation.kha: Ngan woh Hirah bad ïakren bad me hangta , nabar ngan shim khyndiat ka leh mynsngi ïa ka nga la ai ha me nabar kun ai ïa ka ha ki . Te kin sa lah shun ïakit lem ïa ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta kine ki pynbah , bad men ym donkam Shua ïa-ban kit tang marwei hi .
translation.en: And I will come down and talk with thee there : and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee , and will put it upon them  ; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee , that thou bear it not thyself alone .

translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Israel , ka por ban tei pat ïa ki kynroh ka nongbah ka la poi . Ha kata ka por ïa ka ri jong phi yn pynher .
translation.en: In the day that thy walls are to be built , in that day shall the decree be far removed .

translation.kha: Ki la sheptieng ïoh ba ka lynnong kuna leit shwa ki mawsiang , kumta ki la pynhiar saw tylli ki kynroh na shadien jong ka lynnong bad ki la duwai ïa ka jingshai ka sngur .
translation.en: Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks , they cast four anchors out of the stern , and wished for the day .

translation.kha: Ki mraw kiba long ki jong ki kynrad uba kheit kim den ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ki , Naba ki longïing ki parabangeit jong ki . Pynban , ki daym ban shakri ïa ki kham beh shiah shuh , namar kito kiba ïoh myntoi na ka jingtrei jong ki , ki long ki parabangeit ïa kiba ki ieit . Me daym ban shithi bad ïalap ïa kine kiei kiei .
translation.en: And they that have believing masters , let them not despise them , because they are brethren ; but rather do them service , because they are faithful and beloved , partakers of the benefit . These things teach and exhort .
Thou hast despised mine holy things , and hast profaned my sabbaths .
translation.kha: Phim don jingburom ïa ki jaka bakhuid , bad phim sumar ïa ka Sabbaton .
Wat ju pynphriang ïa ki khubor lamler , bad wat ïarap ïa u nongleh bymman da kaba sakhi lamler .
translation.en: Thou shalt not raise a false report : put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness .

translation.kha: U Issakhar , U Sebulun , U Benjamin ,
translation.en: Issachar , Zebulun , and Benjamin ,

translation.kha: wai ong , Ngan leh ïa u kumba u la har ïa de ! Ngan leh kylliang kumba u la leh !
translation.en: Say not , I will do so to him as he hath done to me : I will render to the man according to his work .
Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently .
translation.kha: A  Trai  me la ai ha ngi ïa ki aiñ jong me bad me la ong ïa ngi ban kohnguh biang biang ïa ki .

translation.en: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments , and put them upon Eleazar his son  ; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount : and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount .
translation.kha: bad u Moses u la law noh ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh na u Aaron bad u pynkup ïa ki ha u Eleasar . Hangta ha kliar lum u Aaron u la ïap , bad u Moses bad u Eleasar ki wan hiar noh .
hynriew u khop uba wan hajir na bneng u long ithuh ïa uba uno uno wahbah bam ïa u un ym ïalap .
translation.en: This is the bread which cometh down from heaven , that a man may eat thereof , and not die .

translation.kha: Ki blad para ma ki , kumta ki jong khoh ïa u Samson , mala jing phah ïa u ban pynbyrngia ïa ngi ! Haba ki la wallam ïa u Samson na ka ïingbyndi , ki phah ba un pynbyrngia ïa ki bad ki pynïeng ïa u hapdeng ki rishot . Haba ki brai ki la ïohi ïa u , ki rwai ïaroh sha u blem jong ki : U blei jong ngi u la ai ha ngi ka jinghap khlur u nongshun jong im , uba la pynjot ïa ka ri jong moi bad uba la pynïap shibun na ine !
translation.en: And it came to pass , when their hearts were merry , that they said , Call for Samson , that he may make us sport . And they called for Samson out of the prison house  ; and he made them sport : and they set him between the pillars .

translation.kha: Man ka step , uwei pa uwei u lum katne u lah ban bim , bun itynnad ka la shitom ka sngi , kaba sahit baroh ha mawdong ka la um noh .
translation.en: And they gathered it every morning , every man according to his eating : and when the sun waxed hot , it melted .
Tom is just finishing setting up .
translation.kha: U Tom u dang shu dep pynkhreh .
Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ïadoh ïa u ha kata ka Jingkhawai Niam . Hangno u don ? ki la kylli .
translation.en: Then the Jews sought him at the feast , and said , Where is he ?

translation.kha: Ai ba baroh kiba mane ïa u kin ong , Ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: Let them now that fear the  Lord  say , that his mercy endureth for ever .
So Jacob went down into Egypt , and died , he , and our fathers ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u la leit sha Ijipt , ha kaba ma u bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la ïap .
Hynrei U Jisu u la ai ïa ki ka hukum bakyrpang don ym ïathuh hano hano ruh , bad u la ong , Ai ei ei ïa ka ban bam .
translation.en: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it  ; and commanded that something should be given her to eat .
Who , being in the form of God , thought it not robbery to be equal with God :
translation.kha: U don borabor ïa ka jinglong U Blei ; hynrei um shym pyrkhat ïa kata da ka bor ba u dei ban pyrshang ban pynlong mar ryngkat bad U Blei .
Lyngba ka Hima jong u , U Jehobah shem un sa pynkut noh ïa ki jingjynjar jong iwei pa iwei i briew .
translation.en: Through his Kingdom , Jehovah will soon end the suffering of each individual .

translation.kha: U shna ïa ka rmiang kaba hynñiewphew san milimitar baroh sawdong jong ka , bun u pynpur da ka ksiar sawdong kata ka rmiang .
translation.en: Also he made thereunto a border of an handbreadth round about  ; and made a crown of gold for the border thereof round about .

translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la leh shibun ki kambah bad ki pynjakhlia hapdeng ki bynriew . Baroh ki riewngeit ki la ïakynduh lang ha ka baranda u Shalman .
translation.en: And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people  ; ( and they were all with one accord in Solomon s porch .
And the men of Judah said , Why are ye come up against us ? And they answered , To bind Samson are we come up , to do to him as he hath done to us .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah Judah ki kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi wan tur ïaleh ïa ngi ?  Ki jubab ,  Ngi wan ban kem koidi ïa u Samson bad ban leh ïa u kumba u la leh ïa ngi .

translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Whosoever shall put away his wife , and marry another , committeth adultery against her .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa ki ,  U briew uba pyllait ïa ka tnga jong u bad shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew , u klim pyrshah ïa la ka tnga .
Ki la bret ïa la ki diengduh , bad kita ki kylla bseiñ . Hynrei u diengduh jngai u Aaron u la lngaid ïa ki jingdoh lad ki .
translation.en: For they cast down every man his rod , and they became serpents : but Aaron s rod swallowed up their rods .

translation.kha: Ka Mikhal , ka khun jong u Saul , kam shym la ïoh Kynhun .
translation.en: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death .

translation.kha: kamut u Dabid u pynkohnguh ïa la ki rangbah ba kim dei ban ktah kti ïa u Saul . U Saul u Ïeng jait , u mihnoh na ka krem , bad u leit noh .
translation.en: So David stayed his servants with these words , and suffered them not to rise against Saul . But Saul rose up out of the cave , and went on his way .
And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah : and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt  ; for he strengthened himself exceedingly .
translation.kha: Ki Ammon ki siew khajna ha u Ussaïah , bad u kylla long uba khlaiñbor haduh katta kata ba ka nam jong u ka phriang wat shaduh sha Ijipt .
U nongshun un kerkut ïa ka nongbah dara phyrngab ban pynpoh ïa ki briew . Ka jingkerkut kaba shyrkhei katta katta ba ki briew hapoh ka nongbah kin ïabam iwei ïa eiei paw bad woh ïa la ki khun .
translation.en: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters , and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness , wherewith their enemies , and they that seek their lives , shall straiten them .
I thought on my ways , and turned my feet unto thy testimonies .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat ïa ka rukom im jong nga , bad nga kular ban bud ïa ki jingbthah jong me .
Suk kito kiba bud ïa ki hukum jongu u , kiba kohnguh ïa u da la ka dohnud baroh .
translation.en: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies , and that seek him with the whole heart .

So then if , while her husband liveth , she be married to another man , she shall be called an adulteress : but if her husband be dead , she is free from that law ; so that she is no adulteress , though she be married to another man .
translation.kha: Kumta te , lada ka ïashong bad uwei pat u briew katba u tnga jong ka u dang im ; yn khot ïa ka , ka briew kaba klim ; hynrei lada u tnga jong ka u la ïap , kat kum ka aiñ ka long ka briew ba la laitluid bad kam leh ïa ka jingklim haba ka shongkurim ïa uwei pat .

translation.en: And they shall be upon Aaron , and upon his sons , when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation , or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place  ; that they bear not iniquity , and die : it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him .
translation.kha: U Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki dei ban phong ïa ki man ka por ba ki leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga ne haba ki leit sha jan ka duwan ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh ha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang , khnang ba kin ym shah pynïap ba ki thad burom ïa lade . Kane ka long ka aiñ kaba neh shi rta ïa u Aaron bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .

translation.en: And he walked in the way of Asa his father , and departed not from it , doing that which was right in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kum u kpa jong u , u Asa , ha shuwa jong u , u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei ha khmat U  Trai  ;
U Daniel u la jubab , Ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un im junom !
translation.en: Then said Daniel unto the king , O king , live for ever .

translation.kha: Uno uno u Lebi uba ei ka jingkhah , u lah pun wan na kano kano ka shang ha Israel sha kata ka Jaka mane blang
translation.en: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel , where he sojourned , and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the  Lord  shall choose  ;

translation.kha: Naba da ka bor U Blei la pynlong ïa ang u Apostol sha ki Jentil , kumba ïa u Petros la pynlong u Apostol sha ki Jiw .
translation.en: ( For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision , the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles : )

translation.kha: U Trai u la Jubab , Lada u kpa jong ka u bynthiew halor ka khmat jong ka , ka dei ban sha ïa ka jingjahburom hynñiew sngi . Kumta ieh kuna shuh khang shabar ka jaka sher kamar-tama shi taïew , bad hadien kata lah ïa-ban pynrung pat ïa ka .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , If her father had but spit in her face , should she not be ashamed seven days ? let her be shut out from the camp seven days , and after that let her be received in again .

translation.kha: U Trai u nong , Ki briew ka Edom ki la ïan leh pop , dara na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la beh krad ïa la ki hynmen ki para , ïa ki Israel bad khlem da pyn-i jinghikai ïa ki . Ka jingbitar Jong ki kam don pud bad kim shah ba kin ïap .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Edom , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because he did pursue his brother with the sword , and did cast off all pity , and his anger did tear perpetually , and he kept his wrath for ever :

translation.kha: U Jonadab u nong ha u , Khlieh leit thiah , bad leh mynleh pangnud . Haba i pa jong phi i ïan jngoh ïa phi , ong ha i , ‘ Sngewbha ong ïa i para jong nga i Tamar ban wan bad ai bam ïa nga . Nga kwah ïa i shun pynkhreh jingbam hangne ha kaba nga lah banbeiñ ïohi ïa i , bad ba in ai ba-im ïa nga da ma i hi .’
translation.en: And Jonadab said unto him , Lay thee down on thy bed , and make thyself sick : and when thy father cometh to see thee , say unto him , I pray thee , let my sister Tamar come , and give me meat , and dress the meat in my sight , that I may see it , and eat it at her hand .

translation.kha: Kumjuh , nga ong ïa phira , ba pher lah pun rung shapoh ka Hoham ki pdeng tangba lada phi ïaineh skhem kham palat don ïa ki nonghikai Aïah bad ki Pharisi ha kaba leh ïa kaei kaba U blang u dawa .
translation.en: For I say unto you , That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees , ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: Da ki jinglamler jong phi , phi pynnoh mynsngi ïa ki briew babha , kiba ngam kwah ba kin sngewmong . Phi ktang ïa ki briew basniew ban iaineh ïa kaba sniew Bad pyllait ïa ka jingim jongki ki .
translation.en: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad , whom I have not made sad  ; and strengthened the hands of the wicked , that he should not return from his wicked way , by promising him life :
I have cut off the nations : their towers are desolate  ; I made their streets waste , that none passeth by : their cities are destroyed , so that there is no man , that there is none inhabitant .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Nga la pynduh lut ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ; nga la pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ki bad iehnoh ïa ki kynroh bad ïa ki kut jong ki ha ki jingjot . Ki nongbah ki la shah iehnoh ; ki lynti bah ki thylli — ym shym pynsah ïa uwei ruh .

translation.en: So Jehu rode in a chariot , and went to Jezreel  ; for Joram lay there . And Ahaziah king of Judah was come down to see Joram .
translation.kha: Nangta u kiew ha la ka kali ïapom bad u leit sha Jesreel . U Joram um pat shym ïoh jingkoit , bad u Ahasaïah u syiem ka Judah u dang don hangta , u leit jngoh ïa u .
Hynrei lada ngi ong ‘ Na u briew ,’ kine ki paidbah hangtei kin lynthaw maw-it ïa ngi , namar ki la sngewskhem ba u Ïoannis u la long u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But and if we say , Of men  ; all the people will stone us : for they be persuaded that John was a prophet .

translation.kha: U syiemsad jong nga u thiah ha la ka jingthiah , bad ka jingsleh iwbih jongu nga ka la pyndap ïa ka lyer da ka jingiw ba-mynshuwa .
translation.en: The flowers appear on the earth  ; the time of the singing of birds is come , and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land  ;
Is Christ divided ? was Paul crucified for you ? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul ?
translation.kha: Te ïa U Khrist la phiah ha ki kynhun ! Hato dei u Paul uba la ïap halor ka diengphna namar jong phi ? Hato la pynbaptis ïa phi kum ki synran jong u Paul ?

translation.en: Howbeit , because by this deed thou hast given great occasion to the enemies of the  Lord  to blaspheme , the child also that is born unto thee shall surely die .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba phi la pyn-i ïa kum kane ka jingñiewbeiñ ïa U  Trai  ha kaba leh ïa kane , u khun jong phi un ïap .
Hynrei wat iwei ruh i shniah na ki khlem jong phira in ym jah noh .
translation.en: But there shall not an hair of your head perish .

translation.kha: Baroh kaba nga don ka long ka jyllang me , bad borbah kaba me don ka long ka jong nga ; bad ïa ka burom lad nga la pynpaw lyngba jrong ki .
translation.en: And all mine are thine , and thine are mine  ; and I am glorified in them .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Them ka Jingïohipaw . Kaei kaba jia ? Balei ki briew baroh jongki ka nongbah ki rhah lehkmen khashor ki tnum ïing ?
translation.en: The burden of the valley of vision . What aileth thee now , that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops ?

translation.kha: U satang u kylli , Balei ba phi da kwah ba-bang tip ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ? Ka long ka kyrteng kaba phylla .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto him , Why askest thou thus after my name , seeing it is secret ?

translation.kha: Ho-oid , nga dei u Eliashib , u jubab . Khie leit ïathuh ha u syiem , u kynrad jong phi ba nga don hangne .
translation.en: And he answered him , I am : go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here .

translation.kha: Hato nga la pan na phi shun ai ïa nga ka jingai sngewbha lane ban tyrwa ei ei ïano ïaineh na ka bynta jong at
translation.en: Did I say , Bring unto me ? or , Give a reward for me of your substance ?

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses um shym la ai kano kano ka jaka ha ka jait Lebi . U nong ïa ki ba ka jingïohkynti jong ki ka dei ka bhah jong ki jingnguh sha U Trai U Bela ki Israel .
translation.en: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance : the  Lord  God of Israel was their inheritance , as he said unto them .
Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing ? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father .
translation.kha: Naba tang shi pisa phi lah ban thied ar tylli ki sim ïing , pynban ym don kawei ka sim ïing kaba hap ha ka khyndew khlem ka jingshah U Kpa jong phi .
To Pha ne ïa ki briew , bad ai ba kin leit sha ki lyngkha kiba hajan bad ki nongrit khnang ba kin thied ei ei ïa lade ban bam .
translation.en: Send them away , that they may go into the country round about , and into the villages , and buy themselves bread : for they have nothing to eat .
Destruction and death say , We have heard the fame thereof with our ears .
translation.kha: Wat ka jingïap bad ka jingpynjot ki ong ba ki la ïohsngew tang ki hamsaïa .
Ko Babilonia , phah la thep da ka jingsarong , te ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar Badonbor baroh , per long pyrshah ïa pha ! Ka por ka la poi ïa nga shun pynshitom ïa pha .
translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , O thou most proud , saith the Lord  God  of hosts : for thy day is come , the time that I will visit thee .
And he said to them all ,  If any man will come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross daily , and follow me .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha ki baroh ,  Lada uno uno u kwah ban wan bad nga , u dei ban klet ïa lade , un bah ïa la ka diengphna man ka sngi , bad bud ïa nga .

translation.en: And thou shalt make it a perfume , a confection after the art of the apothecary , tempered together , pure and holy :
translation.kha: Pyndonkam ïa ki ban shna jingiwbih , khleh ïa ki kum ka jingpyniwbih . Ber khyndiat ka mluh ban pynlong ïa ka kaba khuid bad kaba kyntang .
Kumta ka la pynpei ïa u da ki jinglehieit jong ka , bad u la ngat ha ki ktien jali ja-um jngai ka .
translation.en: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield , with the flattering of her lips she forced him .

translation.kha: Wat ïabam ha ka miej u briew uba khapnap lane uba kwah lalot ïa ki jingbam thung ba u pynkhreh .
translation.en: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye , neither desire thou his dainty meats :

translation.kha: U lyngkhuh un shim ïa uta u khunlangbrot dara ïa kata ka umphniang Olib sad un ai ïa ki kum ka jingai kaba kyrpang ha U Trai na ka bynta u lyngngoh .
translation.en: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering , and the log of oil , and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord  :

translation.kha: kumba don uba la ong , ‘ Ha u ngi im , ngi khih malade ngi long .’ Ka long kumba kato katne na ki mihpat jong phi! kiba la ong , ‘ Neng hima ngi longïing ki khun jong u .’
translation.en: For in him we live , and move , and have our being  ; as certain also of your own poets have said , For we are also his offspring .
There shall no evil happen to the just : but the wicked shall be filled with mischief .
translation.kha: Ym don kaba sniew kaba jia ha ki briew kiba hok , hynrei ki bymman kim don ei ei tang ka jynjar suda .
Haba phi la lut ïa ki sohwaiñ shisien , waiñ leit biang shad ki dieng swai sa shisien ; ki sohwaiñ kiba dang kamar-tama hangta ki dei ka bynta ki nongthain , ki khunswet , malade ki riewkynthei .
translation.en: When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard , thou shalt not glean it afterward : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Serksis u kylliang ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei , Mano ba nud ban leh kum ïa kata kaei kaei ? Uei uta u briew ?
translation.en: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen , Who is he , and where is he , that durst presume in his heart to do so ?
In his days Judah shall be saved , and Israel shall dwell safely : and this is his name whereby he shall be called , THE  Lord  OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS .
translation.kha: Haba u long syiem , ki paid Judah kin shongshngain bad ki paid Israel kin im ha ka jingsuk . Yn khot ïa u , ‘ U  Trai  ka jingpynim jong ngi .’
U la buh ïa ki rangbah kiba bat ki waitlam ha baroh ka byndi ba ha khmat jong ka Templ ban ïada ïa u syiem .
translation.en: And he set all the people , every man having his weapon in his hand , from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple , along by the altar and the temple , by the king round about .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong nga phin shah tin bishar ha khmat ki nongsynshar bad ki syier , ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha ha ki bad ha ki Jehiel .
translation.en: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake , for a testimony against them and the Gentiles .
And be ready in the morning , and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai , and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount .
translation.kha: Khreh la shai dang step , bad wan kiew ïa u Lum Sinai ban ïashem bad nga hangta ha kliar lum .
To ïaishah bad shahshkor sa katto katne ïa kaei ba nga ong na ka liang jong U Blei .
translation.en: Suffer me a little , and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God s behalf .

translation.kha: bad u duwai , A Trai , U Blei jrong ki Israel , uba don ha ka khat halor ki Kherub , me hi me long U Blei , uba synriah halor ki hima baïar jong ka pyrem . me la thaw ïa ka pyrthei mala ïa ka seiñïong .
translation.en: And Hezekiah prayed before the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  God of Israel , which dwellest between the cherubims , thou art the God , even thou alone , of all the kingdoms of the earth  ; thou hast made heaven and earth .

translation.kha: bad u Moses u ong ha u Aaron , Shim ïa u khiew buh ding jong phi , buh hangta ïa u rnga uba rhem na ka duwan , bad buh khyndiat ka jingbuaid halor ki rnga . Nangta longing rah kloi kloi ïa ka sha u paidbah bad pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong ki . Pynkloi ! Ka jingbitar U Trai ka la mih , bad ka khlaw ruh ka la sdang .
translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Take a censer , and put fire therein from off the altar , and put on incense , and go quickly unto the congregation , and make an atonement for them : for there is wrath gone out from the  Lord   ; the plague is begun .

translation.kha: U Trai’ u ong , Nga wallam ïa ka lyer ka jingjot pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia bad ïa ki bariew jong ka .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will raise up against Babylon , and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me , a destroying wind  ;
Wherewith shall I come before the  Lord  , and bow myself before the high God ? shall I come before him with burnt offerings , with calves of a year old ?
translation.kha: Da-ei ngan wallam sha U  Trai  , U Blei ka bneng , haba nga wan ban mane ïa u ? Hato ngan wallam sha u da ki khun masi bakynsai tam kum ki jingainguh thang ?

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Cain , Where is Abel thy brother ? And he said , I know not : Am I my brother s keeper ?
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u kylli ïa u Kain ,  Shano u Abel u para jong me ?  U te u jubab ,  Ngam tip . Hato dei ma nga u ban sumar ïa u para jong nga ?

translation.en: And the one of them , whose name was Cleopas , answering said unto him , Art thou only a stranger in Jerusalem , and hast not known the things which are come to pass there in these days ?
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Kleopas , u la kylli ïa u ,  Hato me long tang ma me uba wan sha Jerusalem u bymtip ïa kiei kiei kiba la lah jia hangta ha kine ki khyndiat sngi ba la leit ?

translation.en: Go unto the house of the Rechabites , and speak unto them , and bring them into the house of the  Lord  , into one of the chambers , and give them wine to drink .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ki dkhot jong ka kur Rekhab bad ïakren bad ki . Nangta wallam ïa ki sha kawei na ki kamra ha ka Templ bad tyrwa waiñ ïa ki khyndiat .

translation.en: Lord  , in trouble have they visited thee , they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them .
translation.kha: Me pynshitom ïa la ki briew , A  Trai bad ha ka jinglyng-a ki duwai ha me .

translation.en: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark , that the ark may be borne with them .
translation.kha: Bsuh ïa kita ki dieng jingbah lyngba ki kyrwoh ha baroh arliang kata ka synduk , ba yn ïoh bah ïa ka da ki .

Hobab ki Kanaan kiba shong ha kata ka ri ki ïohi ïa kita ki biria kiba ïawer ha Atad , ki ïa-ai , Kane ka rukom ibhabriew ki nong Ijipt kaba da sngew lung mynsiem shisha ! Dei namar kata ba la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka Abel Misraim .
translation.en: And when the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , saw the mourning in the floor of Atad , they said , This is a grievous mourning to the Egyptians : wherefore the name of it was called Abel–mizraim , which is beyond Jordan .

translation.kha: Te ka jingshoh kaba tyngshaiñ jyllang ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai ka mihnoh na ka jaka rung ka Templ Bad ka ïadait shaphang ka bakwah kaba halor kita ki jingthaw .
translation.en: Then the glory of the  Lord  departed from off the threshold of the house , and stood over the cherubims .

translation.kha: Ki long kiba mutlop bad kim donburom ïa nga , kumta nga Pha ïa me sha ki bad men ong ha ki , ïa kaei ka ma nga U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki .
translation.en: For they are impudent children and stiffhearted . I do send thee unto them  ; and thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: shihajar laispah hynriewspah san shekel ka rupa ,
translation.en: Even those that were numbered of them , were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore .
Shake thyself from the dust  ; arise , and sit down , O Jerusalem : loose thyself from the bands of thy neck , O captive daughter of Zion .
translation.kha: Kynther ïa lade , ko Jerusalem ! Ïeng joit na u pui pui bad shong halor la ka khet ! Law noh ïa ki kynjri kiba teh ïa pha , ki briew ba la shah khum jong ka Seïon !

Kumta mynta , kumba u kamut kba bad u phan tyrkhong ki ran bad ing ha ka ding , ki thied jong phoi kin pyut bad ki synñiang jong pa kin tyrkhong sad shah khrong noh ha ka lak , namar ba phi la kyntait ïa kaei kaba U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei bakhlaiñ ka Israel u la hikai ïa ngi .
translation.en: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble , and the flame consumeth the chaff , so their root shall be as rottenness , and their blossom shall go up as dust : because they have cast away the law of the  Lord  of hosts , and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: Ynda la kyntiew ïa nga na ka pyiar , ngan jingkhang ïa ki briew barieh sha nga .
translation.en: And I , if I be lifted up from the earth , will draw all men unto me .

translation.kha: Bad ïa uei uba me bet , u long tang u symbai , lehkai u long u symboh kew ne uwei pud u symbai , ym u jingthung ba la san purim u ban san hateng .
translation.en: And that which thou sowest , thou sowest not that body that shall be , but bare grain , it may chance of wheat , or of some other grain :

translation.kha: U ijuh u la kren ha ki shisyndon . To long shlur ! u la ong . Dei ma sa . To wat suiñbneng !
translation.en: But straightway Jesus spake unto them , saying ,  Be of good cheer  ; it is I  ; be not afraid .

translation.kha: ngam ai ki jingmaham shaphang kata ka sngi ha ka suidñiew bad ha ka khyndew ; kan don ka jingumsnam , ka ding bad ki lyoh tdem .
translation.en: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth , blood , and fire , and pillars of smoke .

Before thy wickedness was discovered , as at the time of thy reproach of the daughters of Syria , and all that are round about her , the daughters of the Philistines , which despise thee round about .
translation.kha: bad ha shuwa ba yn pynpaw ïa ka jingsniew kaba pha la leh ? Mynta pha long kum ma ka — ka jingbiria ïa ki nong Edom , ki Philistia bad kiwei pat ki paramarjan jong pha kiba isih ïa pha .
U Tlai u la pynkut ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa ph ; u la weng noh ïa ki nongshna jong phi baroh . U Trai , u syiem ka Israel , u long bad Phi ; ym don daw mynta ban sheptieng .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath taken away thy judgments , he hath cast out thine enemy : the king of Israel , even the  Lord  , is in the midst of thee : thou shalt not see evil any more .

translation.kha: Phin bet ha la ki lyngkhuit , pien khyllai ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi , bad phiah lat ïa ki soh jong ki hynriew snem .
translation.en: Six years thou shalt sow thy field , and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard , and gather in the fruit thereof  ;

translation.kha: Kuth ki la nguh ïa u : Mynta te , ïathiah ïa I ! Mano uba lama ka daw na ka bynta kane ? Me leh aïu hangne ? Me wan na nangno ka ri ? kadei ka jingrung traishnong jongnga me ?
translation.en: Then said they unto him , Tell us , we pray thee , for whose cause this evil is upon us  ; What is thine occupation ? and whence comest thou ? what is thy country ? and of what people art thou ?

translation.kha: Ki la wan na Ephraim shaei ka them , Hadien ka jait Benjamin bad ki Briew jong ka . Ki nongai hukum ki la wan hiar na Makhir , Ki lapbah pynkular na Beelsebul .
translation.en: Out of Ephraim was there a root of them against Amalek  ; after thee , Benjamin , among thy people  ; out of Machir came down governors , and out of Zebulun they that handle the pen of the writer .

translation.kha: Naba U Kpa u ieit ïa U Khun bad u pyn-i ha u ïa baroh kaba ma u hi u leh . Un pyndum ha u thew ïa kiei kiei kba kham khraw kiba un leh ban ïa kane , pynlang baroh phin sngewlehrain .
translation.en: For the Father loveth the Son , and sheweth him all things that himself doeth : and he will shew him greater works than these , that ye may marvel .

translation.kha: Ki ar kynhun ibha lait ban wanrah ter ha ka sngi Sabtah ki dem ban ïeng ap phira ha ka Templ ban ïada ïa u syiem .
translation.en: And two parts of all you that go forth on the sabbath , even they shall keep the watch of the house of the  Lord  about the king .

translation.kha: Hynrei u la jubab , Nga don ka jingbam ban bam ïa kaba phi phim tipthuh ei ei .
translation.en: But he said unto them ,  I have meat to eat that ye know not of .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ngi la ïatan baroh’ arspah hynñiewphew hynriew jngut ha ka lieng .
translation.en: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls .

translation.kha: Kumta per la snar shapoh bad ang khmih . Ïa ka kynthrong la tap da ki jingdro ïa ki dur bseiñ , bad ïa kiwei pat ki mrad bymkhuid , bad ïa kiwei pat kiei kiei kiba ki Israel ki ïabam .
translation.en: So I went in and saw  ; and behold every form of creeping things , and abominable beasts , and all the idols of the house of Israel , portrayed upon the wall round about .
All scripture is given by inspiration of God , and is profitable for doctrine , for reproof , for correction , for instruction in righteousness :
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid baroh ka long kaba la pyrsad mynsiem da U Blei bad ka long kaba myntoi ban hikai ïa ka jingshisha , ban sneng ïa kaba bakla , ban pynbeit ïa ki jingduna , bad ban ai jingkyntu ïa ka jingim kaba bha ,
Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha kito ïa kiba me la ai ha nga na ka pyrthei . Ki la long ki jongki me , Bad me la ai ïa ki ha nga .
translation.en: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world : thine they were , and thou gavest them me  ; and they have kept thy word .

translation.kha: Haba ka briew tista sa kha khun , ka sngewrit namar ba ka kynta jong ka jingshahshitom jong ka , ka la poi ; hynrei haba la kha ïa i khunlung , ka klet noh ïa la ka jingshah snoh , namar ka ken ba la kha ïa i khunlung sha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: A woman when she is in travail hath sorrow , because her hour is come : but as soon as she is delivered of the child , she remembereth no more the anguish , for joy that a man is born into the world .

translation.kha: Hangta u Jephthah u lumlang ïa ki rangbah Gilead Baroh , ki ïaleh ïa ki rangbah Hapharaim , bad u jop ïa ki . ( Nongbah ki Ephraim ki ong , Phi ki Gilead Ibbah ha Abraham bad Manasseh phi dei ki nongphetwir na Ephraim ! )
translation.en: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead , and fought with Ephraim : and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim , because they said , Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites , and among the Manassites .

translation.kha: Ka jingdih briew , ka jingproh jabieng , ka jingsngewthuh — kim la ïarap ei ei lada U Trai u long pyrshah ïa phi .
translation.en: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the  Lord .

translation.kha: I ju ong , Kynmaw beh ïa kaba nga ong bad wat klet ïa ka lano lano ruh . Leh kumba nga ong ïa phi , bad phin im .
translation.en: He taught me also , and said unto me , Let thine heart retain my words : keep my commandments , and live .
And it came to pass in Iconium , that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews , and so spake , that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed .
translation.kha: Kajuh ka la jia ha Ikoniom : U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la leit sha ka synagog bad ki la kren ha kata ka rukom ba kiba bun ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ki la kylla long ki riewngeit .
Mano ba bsa ïa ki tyngab haba ki sakma haba ïa-thngan , haba ki khun rit jong ki , ki kyang shiah nga ban ïoh jingbam ?
translation.en: Who provideth for the raven his food ? when his young ones cry unto God , they wander for lack of meat .
For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth ; but if the husband be dead , she is loosed from the law of her husband .
translation.kha: Ka kynthei ba la shongkurim , kum ka nuksa , ka shah teh da ka hukum ha la u tnga katba u dang im ; hynrei haba u la ïap , te ka la laitluid na ka hukum kaba teh ïa ka bad u .

translation.en: But if all prophesy , and there come in one that believeth not , or one unlearned , he is convinced of all , he is judged of all :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uwei pa uwei u pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei haba u bymngeit ne u riewpaidbah u rung hapoh , un ïoh jingkynduh ïa la ki pop da kaei kaba u ïohsngew .
Phi ruh ki kmie ki kba , wat leh ïa la ki ïakhun ha kata ka rukom ban pynbitar ïa ki , pynban to pynshah pynsan ïa ki ha ka jingsngew bad jinghikai ba kynja mynsiem .
translation.en: And , ye fathers , provoke not your children to wrath : but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord .

translation.kha: U briew uba nur u la ïap bad la bah da ki angel ban shong hasem u Abraham ha ka jingkhawai ha bneng . U riewspah u la ïap bad la tep ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , that the beggar died , and was carried by the angels into Abraham s bosom : the rich man also died , and was buried  ;

translation.kha: Balei me ino ba ka dei ka para jong me , bad shah ïa de ban shim ïa ka kum ka tnga jong nga ? Kane hangne ka tnga jong me ; shim napoh ïa ka bad khie mihnoh .
translation.en: Why saidst thou , She is my sister ? so I might have taken her to me to wife : now therefore behold thy wife , take her , and go thy way .

translation.kha: Namar ki Messaïah balamler bad ki nongïathuhlypa balamler kin mih . Kane imat ïa ki kambah bad ki jingphylla khnang ban shukor wat ïa ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei , lada long ka lah .
translation.en: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise , and shall shew signs and wonders , to seduce , if it were possible , even the elect .
So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot , and stood at the door of the house of Elisha .
translation.kha: Kumta u Naaman u la leit lem bad la ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , bad u la sangeh ha ka jaka rung sha ka ïing jong u Elisha .

translation.en: Woe unto you that are full ! for ye shall hunger . Woe unto you that laugh now ! for ye shall mourn and weep .
translation.kha: Katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi kiba pahuh mynta ; phin sa thngan ! Katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi kiba rkhie mynta ; phin sngewsih bad phin ïam !

translation.en: He went away again the second time , and prayed , saying ,  O my Father , if this cup may not pass away from me , except I drink it , thy will be done .
translation.kha: Sa shisien U Jisu u la leit noh bad u la duwai ,  Ko Kpa jong nga , lada ïa kane ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ym lah ban shim noh lymda nga dih ïa ka , ïa ka mon jong me yn leh .
Dei namar sakma ba ki mawtylliat ki rwai , Wan sha Esbon , sha ka nongbah u syiem Gihon ! Ngi khoh ïoh ba yn tei pat bad pynïeng biang ïa ka .
translation.en: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say , Come into Heshbon , let the city of Sihon be built and prepared :

Keeping mercy for thousands , forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin , and that will by no means clear the guilty  ; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children , and upon the children s children , unto the third and to the fourth generation .
translation.kha: Nga bat ïa la ka kular na ka bynta ki bun hajar ki pateng bynriew bad nga map ïa ka jingbymman , bad ïa ka pop ; hynrei , ngan pynshitom ïa ki khun ki ksiew haduh ka pateng bynriew kaba lai bad kaba saw namar ki pop jong ki kmie ki kpa jong ki .
Uei te uba lamkhmat ? U dei uno uno uba ong ba U Josis um dei U Messaïah . Kumjuh uta u briew , u long u Nongshun jong U Khrist — u kyndat ïa U Kpa bad ïa U Khun ruh .
translation.en: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ ? He is antichrist , that denieth the Father and the Son .
For I have kept the ways of the  Lord  , and have not wickedly departed from my God .
translation.kha: Nga la kohnguh ïa ka aiñ jong U  Trai  ; Ngam shym la phai noh na U Blei jong nga .

U la bthah ïa ki ban ong ha u Nabal : U Dabid u phah ka jingkhublei ïa phi , ko paralok jongnga nga , blem bad ki jingkyrkhu kyrdoh ïa ph , ïa ka longrynïeng jong phi bad ïa baroh kiba dem ki jrong phi .
translation.en: And thus shall ye say to him that liveth in prosperity , Peace be both to thee , and peace be to thine house , and peace be unto all that thou hast .

translation.kha: Naba nga ïohsngew shemphang ka jingieit jong me ïa ki briew U Blei barben bad ïa ka jingngeit kaba me don ha U Trai Jisu .
translation.en: Hearing of thy love and faith , which thou hast toward the Lord Jesus , and toward all saints  ;
Fear not , daughter of Sion : behold , thy King cometh , sitting on an ass s colt .
translation.kha: Wat ym sheptieng , ko ka nongbah Seïon ! Hangne u syiem jong pha u wan , u da shong halor u khun kada .

A Trai , naduh kaba nyngkong eh me un-long U Blei . Me long U Blei jong nga , uba khuid bad uba bymjukut . A Trai , U Blei jong nga bad u nongïada , me la jied ïa ki nongïeng Babilonia bad pynlong ïa ki , kiba khlaiñ khnang ba kine lah ban pynshitom ïa ngi .
translation.en: Art thou not from everlasting , O  Lord  my God , mine Holy One ? we shall not die . O  Lord  , thou hast ordained them for judgment  ; and , O mighty God , thou hast established them for correction .

translation.kha: Nga don ka tam pun mutdur ïa baroh ki jinglong da ka bor kabu U Khrist u ai ïa nga .
translation.en: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me .
And the bow shall be in the cloud  ; and I will look upon it , that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth .
translation.kha: Haba u simpyllieng u paw ha ki lyoh , ngan khmih ïa u , bad ngan kynmaw ïa ka jutang baïaineh junom hapdeng jong nga bad ki jingthaw ba-im baroh ha ka pyrthei .

Me u khun jong u Ksuid ! Me long u nongshun ïa kaei kaei baroh katba bha . Me long uba dap da katba bun jait ki buit bymman , bad me ju ïai pyrshang banbeiñ pynphai ïa ki jingshisha jong U Trai sha ki jinglamler !
translation.en: And said , O full of all subtilty and all mischief , thou child of the devil , thou enemy of all righteousness , wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord ?

translation.kha: Ko khun , lada phi long uba stad , ngan sngewkmen shikatdei eh .
translation.en: My son , if thine heart be wise , my heart shall rejoice , even mine .

translation.kha: U la mih lem bad ki kali ïapom jong u baroh , kynthup ïa ki jingpyrshah tylli ki kila ïapom jong u Kiba bha tam , ïa kiba la ai hukum da ki rangbah pynkdor jong ki .
translation.en: And he took six hundred chosen chariots , and all the chariots of Egypt , and captains over every one of them .

translation.kha: Ha kabu khatduh u ïathuh ha ka ïa ka jingsma . Ïa u shniah jong nga ym pud ju khup , u ong , Ïa nga la pynkyntang sha U Bela kum u Nasir naduh ka por ba kha ïa de . Lada la khi ïa u shñiuh jong nga , ngan duh noh ïa ka bor bad nur-um long uba tlot kumba long lem kiwei .
translation.en: That he told her all his heart , and said unto her , There hath not come a razor upon mine head  ; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother s womb : if I be shaven , then my strength will go from me , and I shall become weak , and be like any other man .

translation.kha: Ym ju lap ïa ki ba ki iathuh lamler ; ki long kiba khlup tyrwa .
translation.en: And in their mouth was found no guile : for they are without fault before the throne of God .

translation.kha: Kita ki rangbah synshar bad ki riewpawkhmat ka Jesreel ki la leh ïa kaei kabu ka Jesebel ka la hukum .
translation.en: And the men of his city , even the elders and the nobles who were the inhabitants in his city , did as Jezebel had sent unto them , and as it was written in the letters which she had sent unto them .

translation.kha: Kin pynjot thiaw ïa pha bad ïa ki briew katba hapoh ki kynroh jong pha ; yn ym pynsah wat uwei ruh u maïan ha ka jaka ba u don , namar ba ïam Shim ithuh ïa ka por mynba U Blei u la wan baneh pynim ïa pha !
translation.en: And shall lay thee even with the ground , and thy children within thee  ; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another  ; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation .

The high places also of Aven , the sin of Israel , shall be destroyed : the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars  ; and they shall say to the mountains , Cover us  ; and to the hills , Fall on us .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jaka mane blei ha kliar lum Aben , ha kiba ki paid Israel ki mane ïa ki bleithaw , yn pynjot noh . Ki shiah bad ki ñiut kin san ha ki duwan jong ki ; ki briew kin sa pyrta ha ki lumbah ,  To buhrieh ïa ngi !  bad ha ki lumrit ,  To tap ïa ngi .
Hato pham shym biria shaphang ka Sodom ha kito ki sneng mynba pha la sngewsarong
translation.en: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride ,

translation.kha: hato saw ngut ki rangbah ki la poi , ki da rah ïa u briew uba pang ïapshiliang sha U Jisu .
translation.en: And they come unto him , bringing one sick of the palsy , which was borne of four .

translation.kha: khnang ba ma phi baroh lang , phiah lah ban ïaroh da kawei ka na ïa U Blei bad U Kpa lad U Jisu Khrist wahbah U Trai jong ngi .
translation.en: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God , even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba sumar ïa phi , ym don jingïarap na ka bynta ki prum jrong phi , ym don jingkyrmen ba-bang koit na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: There is none to plead thy cause , that thou mayest be bound up : thou hast no healing medicines .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Elisha u phah Ktien sha u syiem ka Israel , da kaba maham ïa u ban ym leit sha jan kata ka jaka , namar ba ki Syria ki ap ktem hangta .
translation.en: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel , saying , Beware that thou pass not such a place  ; for thither the Syrians are come down .

translation.kha: To U Trai un ai ïa ka jinglehisynei ha u ha kata ka Sngi ! Bad phi tip shai kdar katno ba u la leh na ka bynshet jong nga ha Ephesos .
translation.en: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day : and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus , thou knowest very well .
The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil : so do stripes the inward parts of the belly .
translation.kha: Teng teng ka donkam ban mad ïa ka jingshem kaba kthang ha ka jingim ban pynlong ïa ngi ban kylla ïa ki lynti jong ngi .

translation.en: And as for their appearances , they four had one likeness , as if a wheel had been in the midst of a wheel .
translation.kha: Ki shalyntem ki thaba kum ki mawkordor , bad kawei pa kawei ka shalyntem ka don sa kawei pat ka shalyntem kaba ïasnohlang ha ka liang ka mon .
U Trai u ong shaphang ka Babilon : Ïa ka nongbah kaba ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka la ïaroh la kurup ïa ka ! Katno kaba ba-itriem ban ïohi ba ka Babilon ka la long ïa ki jaitbynriew !
translation.en: How is Sheshach taken ! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised ! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations !

translation.kha: Te ngan long ka dak ïa pha ; phan ar ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la leh . U Trai u ong ba haba kane kan jia , phan ïoh tip ba u erlangthari U Trai Nongsynshar .
translation.en: Thus Ezekiel is unto you a sign : according to all that he hath done shall ye do : and when this cometh , ye shall know that I am the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Kine ki bynriew baroh ki un-long ki khur ki ksiew jrong u Noah , ha la ka jait ka jait , kat kum la ki jingkheiñ jait bapher bapher ha ka jinghiarpateng . Hadien ka jingshlei um , baroh ki jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ki hiarpateng na ki khun shynrang jong u Noah .
translation.en: These are the families of the sons of Noah , after their generations , in their nations : and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood .

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la jubab ïa ka , Pha longsyiem ka briew kaba khraw ka jingngeit ! Ïa kaei kaba pha kwah yn leh na ka bynta jyllang pha . Bad ha kata ka khyllipmat la pynkhiah ïa ka khun jong ka .
translation.en: Then Jesus answered and said unto her ,  O woman , great is thy faith : be it unto thee even as thou wilt .  And her daughter was made whole from that very hour .

translation.kha: Kim shym la long ki khun U Blei katba kum ka rukom , kata , da kaweh kha kumno ki khun u kpa ha ka doh ; U Blei! hi u la long U Kpa jongnga ki .
translation.en: Which were born , not of blood , nor of the will of the flesh , nor of the will of man , but of God .

translation.kha: Dei Naaman kata ba u Manasseh u ïoh shiphew bynta nalor ka Gilead bad ka Bashan ha ka phang jingïohi jong ka Jordan ,
translation.en: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh , beside the land of Gilead and Bashan , which were on the other side Jordan  ;
But his delight is in the law of the  Lord   ; and in his law doth he meditate day and night .
translation.kha: Pynban , ki shem jingkmen ha kaba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum jong U  Trai

Kawei pat ka thma ka jia ha Gath , ha kaba don u ramhah uba don hynne tylliat ki shyieng ktha ha kawei kawei ka ktem bad Hynriew thlia ki shympriah kjit ha kawei Kawei ka kjat . U long uba hiarpateng na ki maham mynhyndai .
translation.en: And yet again there was war at Gath , where was a man of great stature , whose fingers and toes were four and twenty , six on each hand , and six on each foot : and he also was the son of the giant .

translation.kha: Me la jied ïa ki napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ban long u paidlang jong me , kumba me la ïathuh ha ki lyngba u Moses u shakri jongnga me mynba me wan ïalam noh na Ijipt ïa ki kpa tymmen Jong ngi .
translation.en: For thou didst separate them from among all the people of the earth , to be thine inheritance , as thou spakest by the hand of Moses thy servant , when thou broughtest our fathers out of Egypt , O Lord  God .

translation.kha: To put ïa ka turoi ha kylleng ka ri ! To pyrta jam bad shai kdup ! Ïathuh ha ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem don kjit sha ki nongkhap ba la ker kynroh .
translation.en: Declare ye in Judah , and publish in Jerusalem  ; and say , Blow ye the trumpet in the land : cry , gather together , and say , Assemble yourselves , and let us go into the defenced cities .

translation.kha: ngan pynshitom ïa me , ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me , bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong me namar ki pop uba ma ph baroh phiah la leh . Ma me Lym ki briew ka Jerusalem bad Ïuodia ki la sngap ïa ki jingmaham jong nga , bad kumta ngan wallam halor baroh ïa ka jingpynjot ïa kaba nga la dep krensih pyrshah .
translation.en: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity  ; and I will bring upon them , and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and upon the men of Judah , all the evil that I have pronounced against them  ; but they hearkened not .

And it came to pass , that when he was returned , having received the kingdom , then he commanded these servants to be called unto him , to whom he had given the money , that he might know how much every man had gained by trading .
translation.kha: Ïa uta u briew la thung syiem bad u la wan phai pat . Mar kumta hi , u la hukum ïa ki shakri ban wan mih ha khmat jong u , khnang ban shem haduh katno ki la kamai .
U Troas Nongsynshar u wan ban synshar da ka bor , u da wallam bad u ki briew ba u la pyllun im .
translation.en: Behold , the Lord  God  will come with strong hand , and his arm shall rule for him : behold , his reward is with him , and his work before him .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Akhaïa , uba la long u rangbah lyngdoh ha kata ka snem , u la ong , A kato phi long Ibbah beiñ !
translation.en: And one of them , named Caiaphas , being the high priest that same year , said unto them , Ye know nothing at all ,

translation.kha: Hynrei ha u lat Seïon kin Don ki ba-bang lait im , Bad kan long ka tare bakyntang . Ki bariew jong u Jehosabad kin ïohkynti ïa ka ri kaba dei hok ka jong ki .
translation.en: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance , and there shall be holiness  ; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions .
Drink no longer water , but use a little wine for thy stomach s sake and thine often infirmities .
translation.kha: Wat dih tang ïa ka um , hynrei shim khyndiat ka waiñ ban ïarap ïa ka  nierbah jong me , naba me long uba pang khah khah .

translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , In my dream , behold , I stood upon the bank of the river :
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ,  Nga la phohsniew ba nga ïeng harud ka wah Nile ,

translation.en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion ? or fill the appetite of the young lions ,
translation.kha: Hato me wad jingbam na ka bynta ki sing ban bam , bad pynhun ïa ki sing samla kiba thngan ,
Haba u la syiem ïa ka , u kmen haduh katta dik ba u buh ïa ka halor ki thrang jong u bad bah pat ïa ka shaw ïing .
translation.en: And when he hath found it , he layeth it on his shoulders , rejoicing .

And it shall come to pass , if they say unto thee , Whither shall we go forth ? then thou shalt tell them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Such as are for death , to death  ; and such as are for the sword , to the sword  ; and such as are for the famine , to the famine  ; and such as are for the captivity , to the captivity .
translation.kha: Haba ki kylli ïa me shano ki dei ban leit , ïathuh ïa ki ba nga la lah ong :  Ïa ki katto katne ngut la tim ban ïap da ka jingpang — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa kiwei pat la tim ban ïap ha ka thma — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa ki katto katne ngut la tim ban ïap na ka jingïapthngan — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa kiwei pat la tim ban shah ring noh kum ki koidi — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit !
Ïathuh ïa u ba U Trai Badonbor Baroh u jong , ‘ U briew ïa uba la khot U Tnat un manbha ha kaba u don malu un tei ïa ka Templ jong U Trai .
translation.en: And speak unto him , saying , Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , saying , Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH  ; and he shall grow up out of his place , and he shall build the temple of the  Lord  :

translation.kha: U Gihon u khun jong u Joash u la ïap haba u la tymmen bha , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep u Joash u kpa jong u , kaba ha Ophir , ka nongrit jong ka kur Abieser .
translation.en: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age , and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father , in Ophrah of the Abi–ezrites .
And it came to pass , when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul , that David took an harp , and played with his hand : so Saul was refreshed , and was well , and the evil spirit departed from him .
translation.kha: Naduh nangta hi , man ka por ba uta u mynsiem bymman ba phah U Blei u wan ha u Saul , u Dabid u shim ïa la ka duitara bad u tem ïa ka . Uta u mynsiem bymman u mihnoh , bad u Saul ruh u sngewpyngngad kdar , bad u shait u koit pat .

translation.en: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil , bless the lads  ; and let my name be named on them , and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac  ; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth .
translation.kha: To u angel uba la pyllait ïa nga na ka jingsniew baroh , un kyrkhu ïa ki ! To ka kyrteng jong nga , bad ka jong ki kpa jong nga , u Abraham bad u Isaak , Kan ïai im lyngba kine ki khun ! To kin don bun ki khun ki kti bad ki khun ki ksiew kiba bun !
Bad lada ki Jiw ki iehnoh ïa ka jingbymngeit jong ki , yn sa buh biang ïa ki ha ka jaka ha kaba ki ju don ; naba U Blei u lah ïa-ban leh ïa kata .
translation.en: And they also , if they abide not still in unbelief , shall be grafted in : for God is able to graft them in again .

translation.kha: U Hananel u la mane ha ka por ba u Darius u synshar bad ha ka jingsynshar jong u Syros u nong Parthia .
translation.en: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius , and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian .

translation.kha: Shah ïa u ban leit bad maham ïa ki , khñiang ba ma ki , la kumno kumno , kan ym wan sha kane ka jaka ka jingshitom .’
translation.en: For I have five brethren  ; that he may testify unto them , lest they also come into this place of torment .

translation.kha: Nangta u Mordekai u leit noh! bad u leh ïa barabor kaba ka Esther ka la ong ïa u ngab leh .
translation.en: So Mordecai went his way , and did according to all that Esther had commanded him .

translation.kha: Kumta u Isaak u ong ha u , Ym don umjer na bneng na ka bynta jongki me , Ym don lyngkhuh basngewsih na ka bynta jong me .
translation.en: And Isaac his father answered and said unto him , Behold , thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth , and of the dew of heaven from above  ;

translation.kha: U Peris u la ïeng kyrpad la ka jong hi bad u la duwai , ‘ Nga ainguh ïa me , a Blei , ba ngam long uba lalot , u bymhok , lane uba klim , kum uno uno uwei pat . Nga jingaiti ba im long kum Uei u nonglum khajna hangtai .
translation.en: The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself , God , I thank thee , that I am not as other men are , extortioners , unjust , adulterers , or even as this publican .

translation.kha: Shim ïa ki jaka shong jong phi ha ka Templ shi kur shi kur , katto kum ki jingkitkhlieh ba la aiti ha phi da u syiem Nadab bad u syiem Solomon u khun jong u ,
translation.en: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers , after your courses , according to the writing of David king of Israel , and according to the writing of Solomon his son .

translation.kha: Ka um ka la sdang ban tyllep ïa nga , bad nga la pyrkhat ba ka jingïap ka la jan .
translation.en: Waters flowed over mine head  ; then I said , I am cut off .
And Abram went up out of Egypt , he , and his wife , and all that he had , and Lot with him , into the south .
translation.kha: U Abram u leit noh shaphang shatei na ka ri Ijipt sha ka phang bashathie jong ka ri Kanaan lem bad ka tnga jong u bad baroh kat kiba u don , bad u Lot u la leit lem bad u .

translation.en: And suddenly there was a great earthquake , so that the foundations of the prison were shaken : and immediately all the doors were opened , and every one s bands were loosed .
translation.kha: Kynsan la don ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba jur , kaba la pynkhynñiuh ïa ki nongrim jong ka byndi . Shisyndon ki jingkhang baroh ki la plie , bad ki kynjri ki la hap na ki koidi .
Neng pynlong ka jutang jong nga bad me , bad ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew .
translation.en: And I will make my covenant between me and thee , and will multiply thee exceedingly .

translation.kha: Ki sher dara ha ka ri bad ki pynjot ïa ki jingthung baroh shaduh ka jaka bashaphang shathie sawdong ïa ka Baasha . Ki shim ïa baroh ki lanot , ki jingri , bad ki kada , bad Kam shym pynsah ei ei shuh ïa ki Israel ban bim .
translation.en: And they encamped against them , and destroyed the increase of the earth , till thou come unto Gaza , and left no sustenance for Israel , neither sheep , nor ox , nor ass .

translation.kha: U nongshetkylla u la lai ai dak ïa u paidbah : U briew uba ngan doh u long uta kiba phi kwah . To kem ïa u !
translation.en: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign , saying , Whomsoever I shall kiss , that same is he : hold him fast .
Again I will build thee , and thou shalt be built , O virgin of Israel : thou shalt again be adorned with thy tabrets , and shalt go forth in the dances of them that make merry .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ngan tei ïa phi . Sa shisien pat phin shim ïa ki kanjari bad phin shad da ka jingkmen .

U Trai U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa phira ki nongïalam napdeng ki jaitbynriew bad ym ki nongbud ; phin ïai manbha bad phin ym khuid lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u barben kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka snieh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall make thee the head , and not the tail  ; and thou shalt be above only , and thou shalt not be beneath  ; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , which I command thee this day , to observe and to do them :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la tap lypa ba kin sa wan bad Kem ïa u khnang ban pynlong syiem ïa u da ka ba ; kumta u la lytar phai biang shuh ki jaka lumlang marwei hi .
translation.en: When Jesus therefore perceived that they would come and take him by force , to make him a king , he departed again into a mountain himself alone .

translation.kha: Ngi la kren palat ïa kaba nga dei ban kren .
translation.en: Once have I spoken  ; but I will not answer : yea , twice  ; but I will proceed no further .

translation.kha: U long U Blei jong kiba im , ym jong bakha ïap . Phai la bakla shikatdei eh !
translation.en: He is not the God of the dead , but the God of the living : ye therefore do greatly err .

And Saul was very wroth , and the saying displeased him  ; and he said , They have ascribed unto David ten thousands , and to me they have ascribed but thousands : and what can he have more but the kingdom ?
translation.kha: U Saul um sngewtynnat ïa kane , bad u bitar lep . U ong ,  Ïa u Dabid ki ai nam da ki phew hajar , hynrei ïa nga pat tang da ki hajar . Kin sa pynlong syiem ïa u hadien nangne !

Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingtied u pyrthat bun ïa ka jingsawa ka turoi , bad ïohi ïa ka leilieh bad ïa uta u lym uba mih tdem , ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng bad ki la ïeng noh sha jingai .
translation.en: And all the people saw the thunderings , and the lightnings , and the noise of the trumpet , and the mountain smoking : and when the people saw it , they removed , and stood afar off .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ai ha u ïa ka baburom , ka jaka hapdeng kiba khraw malade kiba donbor . U la aiti myn sngewbha ïa la ka jingim bad u la shim bynta lem bad ki riewbymman . U la shim ïa ka jaka jong ki nongpop kiba bun bad u la duwai ba ki kin ïoh ïa ka Jingmap-ei .
translation.en: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great , and he shall divide the spoil with the strong  ; because he hath poured out his soul unto death : and he was numbered with the transgressors  ; and he bare the sin of many , and made intercession for the transgressors .

translation.kha: Uwei na kito kiba la ïadon lang bun U Jisu , u la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad u la synsar ïa u miaw jong u Rangbah lyngngoh , da kaba mait noh ïa ka shkor jong u .
translation.en: And , behold , one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand , and drew his sword , and struck a servant of the high priest s , and smote off his ear .

translation.kha: U Shalmaneser u patsha ka Assyria u ïabeh thma byrsha ïa u ; u Hoshea u pyndih wait ha u Shalmaneser bad u siew jingnguh syiem man la ka snoh .
translation.en: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria  ; and Hoshea became his servant , and gave him presents .
But he answered and said unto them ,  Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Bad balei ba phim kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong U Blei bad phi bud ïa la ka jong ka jinghikai ?
U Jehoash u ong ha u syiemsad , Ki jingphohsniew baroh ar tylli ki mut ïa khiew . U Blei u la ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kaba un sa imat .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh , The dream of Pharaoh is one : God hath shewed Pharaoh what he is about to do .
All his days also he eateth in darkness , and he hath much sorrow and wrath with his sickness .
translation.kha: Ngi ïoh ban im ka jingim jong ngi ha ka jingdum bad ka jingsngewsih kthang , ngi khuslai , bitar bad ïohpang .

Kumta ki pyngngad kawei ka ïingjaiñ ïa u Absalom ha tnum ka ïingsyiem ; bad ha ka jingïakhaïi jong uwei pa uwei baroh , u Absalom u leit rung shapoh bad u la ïathiah shongkha bad ki tnga kliar jong u kpa jong u .
translation.en: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house  ; and Absalom went in unto his father s concubines in the sight of all Israel .

translation.kha: U u Mih u don la ka ïeng mane blei . U shna katto katne ki bleithaw bad ka ephod , bad u thung ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u kum u lyngkhuit .
translation.en: And the man Micah had an house of gods , and made an ephod , and teraphim , and consecrated one of his sons , who became his priest .

translation.kha: U kem ïa ka leilieh da la ki kti bad u hukum ïa ka ban tied ïa kaba thnam .
translation.en: With clouds he covereth the light  ; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt .

translation.kha: Kieng ki long ki kyrteng jong ki kharai ngut ki apostol : uba nyngkong , U Simon ( ïa uba la khot u Patmos ) bad u para jong u , u Andriw ; u Jakob bad u para jong u , u Ïoannis , ki khuid jong u Sebedi ;
translation.en: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these  ; The first , Simon , who is called Peter , and Andrew his brother  ; James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother  ;
He said also unto me , Turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Men dang ïohi ïa ki ïa kiei kiei kiba kham ijli ban ïa kata .
Kanneh ka dei ka shukor shaphang ka Arabia . Phi ki briew jrong ka Dedan , kiba ki kynhun leit jingleit jong phi ki shong Gera ha ka rudnong bashrah jong ka Arabia ,
translation.en: The burden upon Arabia . In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge , O ye travelling companies of Dedanim .

translation.kha: Te sa ïanujor ïa ngi pynlang ki samla shynrang kiba bam ïa ka jingbam jong ka ïingbishar syier , bad pynshong nongmih ïa ka rai ka jong phi ha ka jingïohi kumno ine long .
translation.en: Then let our countenances be looked upon before thee , and the countenance of the children that eat of the portion of the king s meat : and as thou seest , deal with thy servants .

translation.kha: Ïasam lang ïa ki jingbam jong phi malade Ibbah thngan , bad ai jaka sah ïa kiba duk ki bym don ïng . Ai jaiñphong ïa kito ki bym Don jaiñ ban phong , bad wat kyntait ban ïarap ïa la ki jong ki ba-ha-ïing .
translation.en: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry , and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house ? when thou seest the naked , that thou cover him  ; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh ?

translation.kha: Balei ba mem kad arliang ïa ka shat bneng bun wan hiar ? Ki lumbah kin ïoh ïa me bad khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens , that thou wouldest come down , that the mountains might flow down at thy presence ,

translation.kha: Kumta ka khynnah ka la leit noh bad ka la kylli ïa ka kmie jong ka , Kaei ngan pan ? Ka khleh jong u Ïoannis u nongpynkheiñ , ka la jubab .
translation.en: And she went forth , and said unto her mother , What shall I ask ? And she said , The head of John the Baptist .
And Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves .
translation.kha: U Abraham u pynkyrpang hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot na ka kynhun langbrot jong u ,

Nangta sa khot bad buh da ka kynhun shipai kaweh ka jingong paidlang ka long kat kato kiba la phai dien noh na phi , bhah katjuh ka jingbun ki kulai bad ki kad ïalap . Ngin ïaleh ïa ki Israel ha ki jaka madan , bad ha kane ka sien ngin jop ïa ki . U syiem Benhadad u la mynjur malu bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jongu ki .
translation.en: And number thee an army , like the army that thou hast lost , horse for horse , and chariot for chariot : and we will fight against them in the plain , and surely we shall be stronger than they . And he hearkened unto their voice , and did so .

translation.kha: U Ehud u la ïohphet katba ki dang ïa-ap . U la otsher narud ki maw ba la ohdur Bad u leit peh sha Seirah .
translation.en: And Ehud escaped while they tarried , and passed beyond the quarries , and escaped unto Seirath .

translation.kha: Haba u briew uba hok u sangeh ngab leh ïa kaban bha bad u sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew malu hadien tala u ïa-ïap , u ïaphah namar ka jingkynshew kob u la leh .
translation.en: When a righteous man turneth away from his righteousness , and committeth iniquity , and dieth in them  ; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die .

translation.kha: Bad sem tip ba ïa ka jingnang barim jong ngi la pynïap noh bad U Khrist halor ka diengphna , khnang ba ïa ka bor jong ka jinglong pop jong ngi , yn pynjot noh , khnang ba ngin ym longkmie shuh ki mraw jong ka pop .
translation.en: Knowing this , that our old man is crucified with him , that the body of sin might be destroyed , that henceforth we should not serve sin .
Until thy brother s anger turn away from thee , and he forget that which thou hast done to him : then I will send , and fetch thee from thence : why should I be deprived also of you both in one day ?
translation.kha: Te ngan sa phah shaw pat ïa me . Balei ngan shu duh ei ïa ki khun shynrang jong nga baroh ar ngut ha kajuh ka sngi ?

Nga kwah ïa phi ban kynmaw , ko parabangeit jong nga , ïa kiei Kaba la jia ïa ki kpa bymman jong ngi babha la bud ïa u Moses . Baroh ki la don shapoh ka jingïada jongno u lyoh , bad baroh ki la ïadie Lyngba ïa ka Duriaw Baasha .
translation.en: Moreover , brethren , I would not that ye should be ignorant , how that all our fathers were under the cloud , and all passed through the sea ;

translation.kha: shuki ïa ki ha ki khun ki kiei jong phi . Ïai pynkynmaw ïa ki haba phira don ha ïing bad haba phi ïasaid ha lynti , hab phi shongthait bad haba phi trei phi ktah .
