translation.en: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children , and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house , and when thou walkest by the way , and when thou liest down , and when thou risest up .

translation.kha: Naba , ka Jingthoh bakhuid ka ong , Ka khyndew bad kiei kiei kiba don ha ka ki Long ki jong U Trai .
translation.en: For the earth is the Lord s , and the fulness thereof .

If thou seest the oppression of the poor , and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province , marvel not at the matter : for he that is higher than the highest regardeth  ; and there be higher than they .
translation.kha: Wat lyngngoh haba phi ïohi ba ka sorkar ka banbeiñ ïa kiba duk bad kam ai ha ki ïa ka jinglehhok bad ïa ki hok jong ki . Ïa uwei pa uwei u rangbah synshar la ïada da uno uno uba kham halor bad ïa baroh ar la ïada da ki rangbah synshar kiba kham halor .
Ïa ki jingnoh shiliang jong ki yn bat pyrshah ïa ki . Ki leh pop khlem rieh kumba ki briew ka Setham ki la leh . Ki long kiba la tim , bad ki la ïalum ïa ka halor jong ki hi .
translation.en: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them  ; and they declare their sin as Sodom , they hide it not . Woe unto their soul ! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves .

translation.kha: U la tied ïa ka um da ka jaiñkup jong u Elijah , malade u ong , Hangno U Trai , U Blei jong u Eli ? Nangta u la tied biang ïa ka um , bad ka la nang arliang , badno u la ïaid sha shyieng .
translation.en: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him , and smote the waters , and said , Where is the  Lord  God of Elijah ? and when he also had smitten the waters , they parted hither and thither : and Elisha went over .

translation.kha: To ieit ïa ki turoi thma ha Gibeah ! Pynsawa ïa ka jingkyrsiew ha ramhah ! pyrthuh jam shaphang ka thma ha Bethaben ! Tur sha ka sma , ko ki rangbah Benjamin !
translation.en: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah , and the trumpet in Ramah : cry aloud at Beth–aven , after thee , O Benjamin .

translation.kha: Nongbah ka khun jongnga kaba la 12 snem karta ka la iap .
translation.en: His 12-year-old daughter had died .

translation.kha: Haba ki la wan sha U Jisu , ki la ong , U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la phar ïa ngi ban kylli lada me long Uta Uba u la jong ba Un wan ne “lada ngi dei ban khmied lynti ïa Ussi pang .
translation.en: When the men were come unto him , they said , John Baptist hath sent us unto thee , saying , Art thou he that should come ? or look we for another ?
And the anointing oil , and sweet incense for the holy place : according to all that I have commanded thee shall they do .
translation.kha: ïa ka umphniang pynsleh , bad ïa ka jingiwbih basma sngewtynnat na ka bynta Ka Jaka Kyntang . Ha kaba shna ïa kine baroh , ki dei ban leh thik kat kumba nga la hukum ïa me .
U pynshaitbor ïa kito kiba tlot badno kiba thait .
translation.en: He giveth power to the faint  ; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength .

translation.kha: Ka la ong ha u Syiem Salome , Kata ka nga la ïohsngew ha la ka jong ka ri shaphang jongu phi bad shaphang ka jingdih jong phi ka long kaba shisha !
translation.en: And she said to the king , It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom .

But now the  Lord  hath spoken , saying , Within three years , as the years of an hireling , and the glory of Moab shall be contemned , with all that great multitude  ; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble .
translation.kha: Bad mynta U  Trai  u ong ,  Ha ki lai snem thik , ka spah bakhraw jong ka Moab kan jah noh . Na ki briew kiba bun jong ka , tang khyndiat ki ban lait im , bad kin long kiba tlot .

translation.en: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant , and to his supplication , O  Lord  my God , to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer , which thy servant prayeth before thee to day :
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , U Blei jong nga , nga long u shakri jong me . Shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong nga , bad to ai ïa ki jingkyrpad kiba nga la pan na me ha kane ka sngi .

Nangta u la Duwai jam , Ko Trai U Blei Jong nga , balei me la leh kat khie kaei kai kaweh shyrkhei ïa kane ka riewkynthei ? Ka la lehsbun shibit ban sumar ïa nga , Bad mynta me pynïap ïa u khun jong ka !
translation.en: And he cried unto the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  my God , hast thou also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn , by slaying her son ?
And the  Lord  saith , Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them , and have not obeyed my voice , neither walked therein  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la jubab ,  Kane ka la jia namar ki briew jong nga ki la iehnoh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga kaba nga la ai ha ki . Kim shym la kohnguh ïa nga lane leh ïa kaei kaba nga la bthah ïa ki .
Pynban , ym don uno uno ruh uba tip lano kata ka sngi bad ka kynta kan wan — ym ki angel ha bneng lymne U Khun ; tang U Kpa hi suba thup .
translation.en: But of that day and hour knoweth no man , no , not the angels of heaven , but my Father only .
Prove thy servants , I beseech thee , ten days  ; and let them give us pulse to eat , and water to drink .
translation.kha: To tynjuh ïa ngi shiphew sngi ,  u la ong .  Ai ha ngi ki jhur ban bam bad ka um ban dih .
U Trai un kyrkhu ïa kaei kai baroh kat kaba pa leh .
translation.en: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in , and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out .

Thus saith the  Lord  , He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence : but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live  ; for he shall have his life for a prey , and shall live .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Uno uno uba shong ha ka nongbah un ïap ha ka thma lane ka jingïapthngan lane ka jingpang . Hynrei uno uno uba mihnoh bad uba pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia , yn ym pynïap ; la kumno kumno un pyllait ïa la ka jingim .
Te katto katne ngut na ki Saddusi , kiba ong ba ki briew kmen ym mihpat na ka jingïap , ki la wan ha U Jisu bad ki la ong ,
translation.en: Then come unto him the Sadducees , which say there is no resurrection  ; and they asked him , saying ,

translation.kha: Mihnoh na kane ka jaka bad leit shaphang mihngi , bad leit rieh ïa lade hajan ka wahduid Kherith , kaba sha mihngi jong ka Jordan .
translation.en: Get thee hence , and turn thee eastward , and hide thyself by the brook Cherith , that is before Jordan .
For death is come up into our windows , and is entered into our palaces , to cut off the children from without , and the young men from the streets .
translation.kha: Ka jingïap ka la wan shapoh lyngba ki jingkhangïit jong ngi bad ka la rung sha ki ïingsyiem jong ngi ; ka la ot ïa ki khynnah ha ki surok bad ïa ki samla shynrang ha ki jaka ïew .

translation.en: And the princes said unto them , Let them live  ; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation  ; as the princes had promised them .
translation.kha: To ai kin im , hynrei kin dei ban long ki nongthoh dieng bad ki nongtong um na ka bynta jong ngi .  Kane ka long kaei kaba ki nongïalam ki la ai jingmut .

translation.en: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest .
translation.kha: Te u Annas u la phah noh ïa u , uba dang shah khum , sha u Kaïaphas u Rangbah Lyngdoh .

Hynrei haba u syiem Ussaïah u la kylla long uba khlaiñbor , u la sngewmeng noh pynban , bad kata ka ïalam sha ka jingkhyllem noh jong u . U ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Tiras U Blei jong u da kaba u leit rung sha ka Tubal ban thang jingbhabriew ha ka duwan step jingiwbih .
translation.en: But when he was strong , his heart was lifted up to his destruction : for he transgressed against the  Lord  his God , and went into the temple of the  Lord  to burn incense upon the altar of incense .

translation.kha: Nga lah pun maham ïa u briew uba sngewieit ba u dei ban ïap , hynrei lada u sangeh na kaba leh pop bad leh ïa kaei kaba dei badno kaba bha —
translation.en: Again , when I say unto the wicked , Thou shalt surely die  ; if he turn from his sin , and do that which is lawful and right  ;

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Haba ka por ka pa , ki bani Israel bad Judah kin wan ïa-ïam , kin wad ïa sa , U balui jong ki .
translation.en: In those days , and in that time , saith the  Lord  , the children of Israel shall come , they and the children of Judah together , going and weeping : they shall go , and seek the  Lord  their God .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip) ba ma phi bad ki rangbah synlar jong phi phim pat sheptieng ïa U Tlai .
translation.en: But as for thee and thy servants , I know that ye will not yet fear the  Lord  God .
( And his daughter was Sherah , who built Beth–horon the nether , and the upper , and Uzzen–sheerah . )
translation.kha: U Ephraim u don kawei ka khun kaba kyrteng ka Sheerah . Ka tei ïa ki shnong jong ka Beth Horon Neng bad ka Beth Horon Rum , bad ïa ka Ussen Sheerah .
Ngin ai ïa ki ha phi mynta ka sngi na ka bynta ka jingryntih ïa phi hi .
translation.en: To keep the commandments of the  Lord  , and his statutes , which I command thee this day for thy good ?
And it came to pass , after he had buried him , that he spake to his sons , saying , When I am dead , then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of God is buried  ; lay my bones beside his bones :
translation.kha: Ynda ki la dep tep , u nongïathuhlypa u ong ha la ki khun ,  Ynda nga ïap , tep ïa nga ha kane ka jingtep bad buh ïa ka met jong nga syndah bad ka jong u .

translation.en: And the people flew upon the spoil , and took sheep , and oxen , and calves , and slew them on the ground : and the people did eat them with the blood .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka por ki Israel ki la tlot palat na ka jingthngan , bad kumta ki la kynrup ïa kata kaba ki la ïohknieh na ki nongshun , ki la shim ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri , ki la pynïap ïa ki hangta , bad ki la bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka .
Kumta u syiem Ahab u la ïap . Ïa ka jemnud jong u la kit bad la tep ha Samaria .
translation.en: So the king died , and was brought to Samaria  ; and they buried the king in Samaria .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit sha Keilah bad ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki phria ; ki la pynïap bun ngut na ki bun ki la shim ïa ki jingri jyllang ki . Bad ka la long kumta ba u Dabid u la pyllait im ïa kata ka shnong .
translation.en: So David and his men went to Keilah , and fought with the Philistines , and brought away their cattle , and smote them with a great slaughter . So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah .
Why died I not from the womb ? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly ?
translation.kha: A ba ngan da la ïap noh hapoh ka kpoh ka kmie jong nga lane ïap noh ha ka khyllipmat ba la kha ïa nga .

translation.en: Say ye unto your brethren , Ammi  ; and to your sisters , Ru–hamah .
translation.kha: Kumta khot ïa ki para Israel  Ki briew jong U Blei  bad  kiba ieit da U Trai .
Hynrei u Petros u la ong , Da law lei ruh em , ko Trai ! ngam pat ju bameh mynno mynno ïa Kiei kaei ka bymkhuid rue kaweh sang kat Kum ka jinglehniam .
translation.en: But Peter said , Not so , Lord  ; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean .

translation.kha: U la ktah ïa ka kti jong ka , ka jingshit ka la iehnoh ïa ka , pynlang ka la khie joit bad ka la sdang ban shakri ïa u .
translation.en: And he touched her hand , and the fever left her : and she arose , and ministered unto them .

translation.kha: Shi tawah hadien ki synrang ki la ïadon lang biang hapoh ïing , bad u Thomas u la don laiñ bad ki . Ïa ki jingkhang la ktang shadem , hynrei U Jisu u la wan nabar u la ïeng hapdeng jong ki bad u la ong , To ka jingsngur kan long lymne bad phi .
translation.en: And after eight days again his disciples were within , and Thomas with them : then came Jesus , the doors being shut , and stood in the midst , and said ,  Peace be unto you .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u leit noh na u Pharaoh , bad u la duwai ha U Tharai .
translation.en: And he went out from Pharaoh , and entreated the  Lord .

translation.kha: Phi la thah neh ïa ki briew ka Jehud bad Jesreel jngai na ka ri jong ki hi bad die ïa ki ha ki Grik .
translation.en: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians , that ye might remove them far from their border .

translation.kha: Ki don ki shkor , hynrei ki lah ba ïohsngew ; pynlang ki khmut , hynne kim lah ban iw .
translation.en: They have ears , but they hear not : noses have they , but they smell not :

translation.kha: Kam ïawer jingbha ïa ita i khunlung i ban sa kha , i jah noh sha ka jingjam , ha kaba la klet noh ïa i .
translation.en: For he cometh in with vanity , and departeth in darkness , and his name shall be covered with darkness .
The word that the  Lord  spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor kaba U  Trai  u la ai ha nga shaphang ka nongbah Babilon bad ki briew jong ka :
U briew u eh pun ïap kynsan mynmiet . U balui u shoh-ïap ïa ki briew bad ki jop noh ; u pynïap ïa kiba khraw da kaba suk .
translation.en: In a moment shall they die , and the people shall be troubled at midnight , and pass away : and the mighty shall be taken away without hand .
This means that in a personal , private prayer you tell him that you are giving yourself to him to do his will .—Matthew 16 :24  ; 22 :37 .
translation.kha: Kane ka mut ban ïathuh ha u ha ka jingduwai ba jar jar marwei , ba phi aiti ïalade ha u ban leh ïa ka mon jong u .—Mathaios 16 :24 ; 22 :37 .
Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Ngi kren ïa kaei kob ngi tip bad I ïathuh ïa kaei kaban ngi la ïohi , pynbam , ym don na phi uba mon ban pdiang ïa ka khubor jong ngi .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto thee , We speak that we do know , and testify that we have seen  ; and ye receive not our witness .

translation.kha: Mynno kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong : Namar pha la klet ïa nga dara pha phai daiñ ïa ang , phan sa shahshitom na ka bynta ka jingkwah brai jong pha bad ka jingleh nuti jrong Phah .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast forgotten me , and cast me behind thy back , therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms .

translation.kha: Lada la die ïa ka ha uno uno wahbah smat ban pynpang ïa ka , ka tnga jong u , hynrei um sngewngiah ïa ka , te u dei ban die pat ïa ka ha u kpu jrong ka ; u kynrad jong ka um lai ban die ïa ka ha ki nongwei , namar u la leh bymdei ïa ka .
translation.en: If she please not her master , who hath betrothed her to himself , then shall he let her be redeemed : to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power , seeing he hath dealt deceitfully with her .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Gibeon ki la phah ktien sha u Joshua ha ka jaka shrah dara ha jingïalam , ki da ong , Kynrad , kdew iehnoh ïa ngi ! waiñ mar marbl ban ïarap ïa ngi ! Pyllait im ïa ine ! Baroh ki syiem Amor ha ri lam ki la ïasoh lang Kawei bad ki la wan tur ïabeh ïa i'u .
translation.en: And the men of Gibeon sent unto Joshua to the camp to Gilgal , saying , Slack not thy hand from thy servants  ; come up to us quickly , and save us , and help us : for all the kings of the Amorites that dwell in the mountains are gathered together against us .

translation.kha: Haba u Aaron u la pyndep lut ïa nia ki jingkñia , u rakhe ïa la ki kti sha uta u paidbah sad u kyrkhu ïa ki ; bad nangta u wan hiar noh .
translation.en: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people , and blessed them , and came down from offering of the sin offering , and the burnt offering , and peace offerings .
In Hebrew , “Gilead” means “Witness Pile .”
translation.kha: Ha ka ktien Hebru “Gilead” ka mut “Ka Sakhi ba Kynton .”
To shaniah ha U Trai , phi ki paid Israel . U ïarap ïa phi badno u ïadat ïa phi .
translation.en: O Israel , trust thou in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .

And the king loved Esther above all the women , and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins  ; so that he set the royal crown upon her head , and made her queen instead of Vashti .
translation.kha: U syiem la u itynnat ïa ka palat ban ïa kiwei pat ki samla kynthei , bad palat ban ïa kiwei pat , ka la ïoh ïa ka jinglehbha bad ka jingsngewieit . U buh ïa ka pansngiat syiem ha ka khlieh jong ka bad pynlong mahadei ïa ka ha ka jaka jong ka Bashti .
Ki la tbeh noh ïa ka snam jong ki bariew jong U Blei bad jongu ki nongïathuhlypa , bad kumta me la ai ha ki ïa ka snam ban diaw . Ki la ïoh ïa kaba ki den hok ban ïoh !
translation.en: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets , and thou hast given them blood to drink  ; for they are worthy .
And David called one of the young men , and said , Go near , and fall upon him . And he smote him that he died .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u khot ïa uwei na ki briew jong u , bad u ong ,  Pynïap ïa u !  U briew u la shoh ïa u nong Amalek bad u la pynmynsaw ïa u ,

translation.en: Saying , This fellow persuadeth men to worship God contrary to the law .
translation.kha: Une u briew ,  ki la ong ,  u pyrshang ban pynkohnguh ïa ki briew ban mane ïa U Blei ha ka rukom kaba long pyrshah ïa ka aiñ !
Ko Jerusalem , ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ba pha ïoh ka jinghap ! bad ki syiem jong ki baroh kin ïohi ïa ka bud jongu pha . Yn khor ïa pha da ka kyrteng kaba thymmei , ka kyrteng ba U Trai hi u ai .
translation.en: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness , and all kings thy glory : and thou shalt be called by a new name , which the mouth of the  Lord  shall name .

translation.kha: Kuth U Jisu um ïaid shuh ha Judia ha kaba paw , hynrei u la mihnoh bad leit sha ka jaka hajan ka ri shyiap , sha ka shnong ïa kaba la khot ka Abraham , ha kaba u la sah bad ki synran .
translation.en: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews  ; but went thence unto a country near to the wilderness , into a city called Ephraim , and there continued with his disciples .

translation.kha: bad ha ka jingdon jongki u ha ka mynsiem , u la leit sad ïap ha ki mynsiem kiba la shah khum .
translation.en: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison  ;

translation.kha: Namar ba ïa kine kiei kiei baroh yn pynjop ha kaei ka rukom , ki briew Kiba kumno phi dei ban long ?
translation.en: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved , what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness ,
Have I need of mad men , that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence ? shall this fellow come into my house ?
translation.kha: Hato ngam shym la don lypa bun bah ki lamwir ? Balei phi wan ïalam sa uwei pat ban pynwit ïa nga da ki jingleh lamwir jong u hangne ha ka ïing jong nga ?
Hato phi rai pynrem ïa U Blang uba hok ? Heth phi pyrkhat ba U isih ïa ka jingbishar hok ?
translation.en: Shall even he that hateth right govern ? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just ?

translation.kha: Un tei ïa ka Templ na ka bynta jong nga . Un long u khun jong na bad ngan long u kpa jong u . Ka longïing syiem jongngi u kan synshar ïa ka Eliel junom .’
translation.en: He shall build an house for my name  ; and he shall be my son , and I will be his father  ; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever .

translation.kha: U Eli , uba dang pyrkhat khuslai shaphang ka Synduk ka Ijon , u tdong shong harud lynti , u da klet lyngraw . Uta u rangbah u pynphriang ïa ka khubor kyllaiñ ka shnong bad ti pa uwei u lyntang da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: And when he came , lo , Eli sat upon a seat by the wayside watching : for his heart trembled for the ark of God . And when the man came into the city , and told it , all the city cried out .

translation.kha: U Abram u la wallam ïa kine ki mrad sha U Blei , u ot ïa ki ar lyngkhot , bad u buh ïa ki lyngngoh doh marpyrshah kawei ïa kiwei pat ha ki ar laiñ ; hynrei ïa ki sim um shym la ot lyngkot .
translation.en: And he took unto him all these , and divided them in the midst , and laid each piece one against another : but the birds divided he not .
And though they found no cause of death in him , yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain .
translation.kha: Bad wat la kim shym la shem kano kano ka daw ban rai pynïap ïa u , ki la kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban phah pynïap ïa u .
Haba nga la pyrkhat bha ïa ka , nga sngewthuh ba U Blei um paw shym la kren ha u Shemaïah , hynrei ba u Tobiah bad u Sanballat ki la pynbam phlait ïa u ïa-ban ai ïa nga ïa kan ka jingkhem .
translation.en: And , lo , I perceived that God had not sent him  ; but that he pronounced this prophecy against me : for Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him .
Take heed to yourselves : If thy brother trespass against thee , rebuke him  ; and if he repent , forgive him .
translation.kha: Kumta da husiar ïa kaei kaba phi leh !  Lada u hynmen u para jong phi u leh pop , to sneng tyngeh ïa u , bad lada u kylla-kaba-mut , to map ïa u .
Ki la ïashongkha khleh bad ki , bad ki la ma ïa ki blei jong ki .
translation.en: And they took their daughters to be their wives , and gave their daughters to their sons , and served their gods .
And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children , My son , despise not thou the chastening of the Lord , nor faint when thou art rebuked of him :
translation.kha: Hato phi la klet noh ïa ki ktien pynshlur ïa kiba U Blei u la kren ha phi kum ïa la ki khun ?  Ko khun jong nga , to pynleit jingmut haba U Trai u sneng pynbeit ïa phi , bad wat sngew noh mynsiem haba u sneng ïa phi .

translation.en: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba U Blei u la pynpaw ha u Habakkuk u nongïathuhlypa .

Haba u Petros u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah , u la ïong ha ki , Ko para Israel , balei phi ïadait ha kane , malu balei ba ph peit seh ïa ngi ? Hato phi pyrkhat ba ka dei da ka bor jong ngi hi lane da ka jinglongbriew jongnga ngi hi ba ngi la pyningkhong ïa une u briew ban ïaid ?
translation.en: And when Peter saw it , he answered unto the people , Ye men of Israel , why marvel ye at this ? or why look ye so earnestly on us , as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk ?

translation.kha: Naba u la ong ha u Moses , Ngan leh-isynei ha a un uba nga kwah ; ngan sngewlehrain ïa uno uno Uba na Kwah .
translation.en: For he saith to Moses , I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy , and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion .
Were not the Ethiopians and the Libyans a huge host , with very many chariots and horsemen ? yet , because thou didst rely on the  Lord  , he delivered them into thine hand .
translation.kha: Hato ki Sudan bad ki Libya kim don ki kynhun shipai baheh paid ryngkat bad ki kali ïapom bad ki nongshong kulai ? Hynrei namar ba me la shaniah ha U  Trai  , u la ai ka jingjop ïa me halor jong ki .
lano ka ïing apthap ha kyndong , teng teng ha ki surok bah , bad teng teng ha ka jaka ïew .
translation.en: Now is she without , now in the streets , and lieth in wait at every corner . )
And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes , and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground  ; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ngan ym shah ïa ki khñiang ban pynjot ïa ki jingthung jingtep jong phi , bad ki dieng sohwaiñ jong phi kin dap da ki sohwaiñ .
U Syiem Dabid u la tama ha la ka ïingsyiem , bad U Trai u la sumar ïa u na ki nongshun jngai u baroh .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king sat in his house , and the  Lord  had given him rest round about from all his enemies  ;

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong ka Rakhel ki Long u Joseph bad u Benjamin .
translation.en: The sons of Rachel  ; Joseph , and Benjamin :

translation.kha: Te u angel ïa uba de la ïohi ba u ïeng hajar ka duriaw bad Hamor ka khñiot u la rah ïa la ka kti kamon shuh bneng
translation.en: And the angel which I saw stand upon the sea and upon the earth lifted up his hand to heaven ,

translation.kha: Bud ïa ki aiñ jong nga , bad leh kat ïa kaban nga hukum . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Ye shall do my judgments , and keep mine ordinances , to walk therein : I am the  Lord  your God .

On the eighth day he sent the people away : and they blessed the king , and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that the  Lord  had done for David his servant , and for Israel his people .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra u Solomon u phah noh sha ïing ïa u paidlang . Baroh ki la ïaroh ïa u bad ki leit suk sha ïing namar ki jingkyrkhu baroh ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Dabid u shakri jong u bad ha ki briew jong u ki Israel .
ino uno naba ngeit ha U Khun u don ka jingim bymjukut ; uno uno u bymkohnguh ïa U ti un ym ïoh ïa ka jingim , hynne un ïaisah ha ka jingpynshitom jong U Blei .
translation.en: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life : and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life  ; but the wrath of God abideth on him .

translation.kha: La pynlong khuid lypa ïa phi da ka jinghikai kaba sa la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you .

translation.kha: Pynkyntang mynta ïa ki Lebi kum ki jong nga ha ka dik ki Kynhun shynrang ba la khap nyngkong baroh napdeng ki paid Israel , bad pynkyntang ruh ïa ki jingijli Jong ki Libya ha ka jaka kito kiba la kha nyngkong na ki jingri jong ki Jesreel .
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that entereth into the service , for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation ,
Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars , and commanded Judah and Jerusalem , saying , Ye shall worship before one altar , and burn incense upon it ?
translation.kha: Dei ma u uba pynjot ïa ki jaka mane bad ki duwan bad nangta u ong ïa ki paid Judah bad ïa ka Jerusalem ban mane bad thang jingiwbih tang ha kawei ka duwan .

translation.en: The  Lord  judge between me and thee , and the  Lord  avenge me of thee : but mine hand shall not be upon thee .
translation.kha: To U  Trai  un bishar mano ba bakla napdeng jong ngi ! To un pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingleh jong phi pyrshah ïa nga , naba ngan ym pynmynsaw ïa phi da lei lei ruh .
Hadien katne katto por , kata ka wahduid ka sdang noh namar ba ym shym la don slap .
translation.en: And it came to pass after a while , that the brook dried up , because there had been no rain in the land .

And lo Zadok also , and all the Levites were with him , bearing the ark of the covenant of God : and they set down the ark of God  ; and Abiathar went up , until all the people had done passing out of the city .
translation.kha: U Sadok u lyngdoh u la don hangta , bad ryngkat bad u la don ki Lebi kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang kaba kyntang . Ki la pynhiar ïa ka bad kim shym la rah shuh tad haduh ba ki briew baroh kin da mihnoh na ka nongbah . U Abiathar , u lyngdoh u la don lang hangta .

translation.en: And the man of God sent unto the king of Israel , saying , Beware that thou pass not such a place  ; for thither the Syrians are come down .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Elisha u phah ktien sha u syiem ka Israel , da kaba maham ïa u ban ym leit sha jan kata ka jaka , namar ba ki Syria ki ap ktem hangta .

translation.en: And one of the same place answered and said , But who is their father ? Therefore it became a proverb , Is Saul also among the prophets ?
translation.kha: U briew uba shong hangta u jubab ,  Kumno shaphang kine kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa — ki kpa jong ki , ki dei kiei ?  Dei kumta ba la mih ka jingong ,  Hato wat u Saul ruh u la long u Nongïathuhlypa ?
Hynrei kim shym bud ïa ka nuksa u kpa jong ki ; ki im sngi tang ha Kaba kmie spah , kumta ki bamsap bad kim bishar hok ïa ki jingïakajia .
translation.en: And his sons walked not in his ways , but turned aside after lucre , and took bribes , and perverted judgment .

translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew’ , la la pynphong ïa me u nongap ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . Me den pun pynpoi shaei ki ïa ki jingmaham ba nga ai ha me .
translation.en: So thou , O son of man , I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel  ; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth , and warn them from me .
Come now therefore , and I will send thee unto Pharaoh , that thou mayest bring forth my people the children of Israel out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Mynta nga phah ïa me sha u Pharaoh khnang ba men ïalam noh ïa ki Israel , ki briew jong nga , na Ijipt .
U Salu pynlang u Dabid ki la dep ka jingïakren hapdeng jong ki . Hodaïah kata , u Nathan u khun jong u Saul u la sngew jan eh ïa u Dabid bad u sngewbit ïa u kumba u ieit ïa lade! hi .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul , that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David , and Jonathan loved him as his own soul .

translation.kha: Borabor nga la lehhok mala lehbha .
translation.en: I put on righteousness , and it clothed me : my judgment was as a robe and a diadem .
Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about , so that in the day of the  Lord s  anger none escaped nor remained : those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed .
translation.kha: To pynrem ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingbymman jong ki baroh ; to pynshitom ïa ki kumba me la pynshitom ïa nga na ka bynta ki pop jong nga . Nga ud ha ka jingjynjar , bad nga pang ha ka dohnud jong nga .
U Ephraim u kpa jong ki u ïambriew na ka bynta Jong ki bun sngi , sad ki ba-ha-ïing jong u ki wan pyntngit ïa u .
translation.en: And Ephraim their father mourned many days , and his brethren came to comfort him .

translation.kha: U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la wan , bad u la shahjingit bad um dih wei , bad phi ong , ‘ U don u ksuid hapoh jong u !’
translation.en: For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine  ; and ye say , He hath a devil .

translation.kha: Bad ki la ong shibun kiwei pat ki jingibeiñ ïa u .
translation.en: And many other things blasphemously spake they against him .

translation.kha: U Blei um shaniah ïa ki shakri jongnga u ha Bneng ; u Shem ka jingdiang wat bad ki angel jong u .
translation.en: Behold , he put no trust in his servants  ; and his angels he charged with folly :

translation.kha: Ko khunlung u briew , ki Israel ki pyrkhat ba ki jingïohthiah Bad ki jingpynjia jong me ki dei shaphang ka lawei kaba ïalang slem .
translation.en: Son of man , behold , they of the house of Israel say , The vision that he seeth is for many days to come , and he prophesieth of the times that are far off .
For though there be that are called gods , whether in heaven or in earth , ( as there be gods many , and lords many , )
translation.kha: Wat lada don kiba la shu khot  ki blei  , la ha bneng ne ha pyrthei , bad wat lada don shibun kum kine  ki blei  bad  ki trai  ;
U Troas u long U Blei ; u la long uba bha ïa ngi . Lem bad ki tnat dieng ha ki ki jyllang phi , to sdang ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam bad ïaid sawdong ïa ka duwan .
translation.en: God is the  Lord  , which hath shewed us light : bind the sacrifice with cords , even unto the horns of the altar .

translation.kha: U syiem Benhadad u mynjur ïa ka jingtyrwa u Asa bad u phah ïa ki rangbah shipai jong u lem bad ka kynjah shipai ba tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah jong ka Israel . Ki la kurup ïa ka Ijon , ka dei , ka Abel Beth Meshakh , ka kajuh hadien ka duriaw “Gilead” , mala ka ri Naphtali baroh kawei .
translation.en: So Ben–hadad hearkened unto king Asa , and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel , and smote Ijon , and Dan , and Abel–beth–maachah , and all Chinneroth , with all the land of Naphtali .

Therefore their inhabitants were of small power , they were dismayed and confounded  ; they were as the grass of the field , and as the green herb , as the grass on the housetops , and as corn blasted before it be grown up .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong hangta ki long khlem bor ; ki la sheptieng bad lyngngoh . Ki la long kum u phlang ha lyngkha ne ki ñiut kiba san ha tnum haba ka lyer khluit ba na mihngi ka beh ha ki .

translation.en: So that we ourselves glory in you in the churches of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and tribulations that ye endure :
translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba ma ngi hi ngi sngewsarong shaphang jong phi ha ki balang jong U Blei . Ngi sngewsarong shaphang ka rukom kaba phi ïaineh ban shah bad ban ngeit lyngba baroh ki jingpynshitom beiñ bad ki jingshahshitom kiba phi ïohmad .

Ka por kan pei ha kaba ki dkhot jong ka kad kin jied uwei napdeng jong ki bad ong ha u , Ma phi la kumno kumno phi don ei ei ban Phong , kumta to lama u nongïalam jong ngi ha khie ka por ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father , saying , Thou hast clothing , be thou our ruler , and let this ruin be under thy hand :

translation.kha: hynrei ki maji pat , ki la pyrshang ban ïaleh ban pynpei ïa ka liengbah sharud Duriaw , da kaba khan katne don ka bor jong ki . Hynrei ka erïong ka la nang jur , bad kim iar shuh saihon shano ruh .
translation.en: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land  ; but they could not : for the sea wrought , and was tempestuous against them .
While he yet spake , there came from the ruler of the synagogue s house certain which said , Thy daughter is dead : why troublest thou the Master any further ?
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kren ïa kane , katto katne ngut ki nonglamktien ki la wan na ka ïing jong u Jairos bad ki la ong ïa u ,  Ka khun jong phi ka la lah ïap . Balei phin pynshitom shuh ïa U Nonghikai ?

bad ki da rwai ïa ka jingrwai u Moses , u sharai jong U Blei , bad ïa ka jingrwai U Khunlangbrot : U Tharai uba U Blei Badonbor Baroh , katno kiba khrum bad kiba phylla long ki nang jong me ! U Shim jong ki jaitbynriew , katno kiba dih bad kiba shisha ki long lynti Jong me !
translation.en: And they sing the song of Moses the servant of God , and the song of the Lamb , saying , Great and marvellous are thy works , Lord God Almighty  ; just and true are thy ways , thou King of saints .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsawa jong ka tdam la ïohsngew ha ka ri , Bad ka don ka jingpynjot bakhraw .
translation.en: A sound of battle is in the land , and of great destruction .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Jakob u ong ïa la ka kumwei , Phi tip ba Iso u long u brai uba Bun shñiuh , kato nga pat nga long kiba jlih ka sniehdoh .
translation.en: And Jacob said to Rebekah his mother , Behold , Esau my brother is a hairy man , and I am a smooth man :

translation.kha: Ïohi , Ko Kpa , kane ka la long kumno me la kwah ïa ka ba kan Jia .
translation.en: Even so , Father : for so it seemed good in thy sight .

translation.kha: Uta uba bet bad uta uba ai um kim longsem ei ei da shisha . Dei U Blei uba kongsan , nabar u pyningkhong ïa u jingthung ban san .
translation.en: So then neither is he that planteth any thing , neither he that watereth ; but God that giveth the increase .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga ñiew ïa la ka jingim ba ka long ka bymdondor ei ei ïa nga ; nga kwah tang don pyndep ïa ka jingtylli jong nga bad pyndep pura ïa ka kam kaba U Trai Jisu u la ai ha ang baneh leh , kaba long baneh pynbna ïa ka Khrawbor Babha shaphang ka jingaiei jongu U Blei .
translation.en: But none of these things move me , neither count I my life dear unto myself , so that I might finish my course with joy , and the ministry , which I have received of the Lord Jesus , to testify the gospel of the grace of God .

translation.kha: U duh ia ka kim jong u lyngka ka jingbymshimkhia jong u .
translation.en: He lost his job through his irresponsibility .

translation.kha: hynrei un shah pyrsad noh kum u pui pui . Kito kiba ju ithuh ïa u kin lyngngoh shano ba u la leit .
translation.en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung : they which have seen him shall say , Where is he ?

translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa u Hesekaïah . U patsha ka Assyria u hukum ïa pa ba mihnoh na ka nongbah bad ban pyndem waitsum . Yn shah ïa phi ba phan bam ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki dieng sohwaiñ , bad ïa ki soh Dumbur na ki dieng ki jong phi hi , bad ban dih um na ki pukri jongu ph hi —
translation.en: Hearken not to Hezekiah : for thus saith the king of Assyria , Make an agreement with me by a present , and come out to me , and then eat ye every man of his own vine , and every one of his fig tree , and drink ye every one the waters of his cistern :
It shall dwell in his tabernacle , because it is none of his : brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation .
translation.kha: Mynta uno uno u lah ban shong ha ka ïingjaiñ jong u — hadien ba la ber da u kyndok ban pynïap ïa ki khñiang jingpang !

translation.en: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God , which thou shalt have occasion to bestow , bestow it out of the king s treasure house .
translation.kha: Bad kano kano kaba phi dang donkam shuh ha ka Templ , phi lah ban ïoh na ka ïing jingkynshew syiem .
Ka jingbishar hok kan wanlam biang ha ki ïingbishar , bad baroh ki briew kiba hok kmen kyrshan ïa ka .
translation.en: But judgment shall return unto righteousness : and all the upright in heart shall follow it .

translation.kha: Ong ïa ka khlaw bashaphang shathie ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong : Ha khim ! Nga pynmeh ïa ka ding , mala kuna thang khoit ïa eiei pa uwei u dieng ha phi , la uba jyrngam ne uba tyrkhong . Yn ym don mian mano ba lah baneh pynsep ïa ka . Kan plain na shathie haduh shatei , bun uwei eiei baroh un sngew ïa ka jingkhluit ki thylliej ding .
translation.en: And say to the forest of the south , Hear the word of the  Lord   ; Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will kindle a fire in thee , and it shall devour every green tree in thee , and every dry tree : the flaming flame shall not be quenched , and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein .

translation.kha: Katba ka dang im , ka trei ban pynbha bad ym ban pynpyut ïa u .
translation.en: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka prie ka wan , ïa ka ktien Hebron yn kren ha ki san tylli ki nongbah jongki ka Ijipt . Ki briew hangta kin shim jingsmai ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Badonbor Baroh . Ïa kawei na ki nongbah yn khot , Ka Nongbah jong ka Sngi .
translation.en: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan , and swear to the  Lord  of hosts  ; one shall be called , The city of destruction .
Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs , singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord ;
translation.kha: To ïakren iwei ïa iwei pat da ki ktien ha ki salm , ki jingrwai ïaroh bad ki jingrwai ba kynja mynsiem ; da kaba rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh bad ki salm sha U Trai da ki jingïaroh ha ki dohnud jong phi .
Un shim noh ïa ki jingkynshew ksiar bad rupa ba la buhrieh jong ka Ijipt bad ïa kiwei kiwei ki jingdon jingem jong ka kiba la ñiewkordor eh . Un hiarthma ïa ka Libya bad ka Sudan .
translation.en: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver , and over all the precious things of Egypt : and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps .

Then the woman went unto all the people in her wisdom . And they cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri , and cast it out to Joab . And he blew a trumpet , and they retired from the city , every man to his tent . And Joab returned to Jerusalem unto the king .
translation.kha: Nangta ka leit sha ki briew jong ka nongbah lem bad ka jingthmu jong ka , bad ki la khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u Sheba bad bret ïa ka sha u Joab nalor ka kynroh . U la put ïa ka turoi kum ka dak ïa ki rangbah jong u ban iehnoh ïa ka nongbah , bad ki leit phai noh sha ïing . Bad u Joab u la leit phai noh sha Jerusalem sha u syiem .

Ka spah ka long kaba shukor . Ki briew kaba lalot ki long kiba sarong bun bym lah Ban shong khop — kum ka jingïap hi da lei lwa kdor ju hun . Namarkata ki ïap ïa kaweh ka hima hadien kawei pat na ka bynta ïa lade .
translation.en: Yea also , because he transgresseth by wine , he is a proud man , neither keepeth at home , who enlargeth his desire as hell , and is as death , and cannot be satisfied , but gathereth unto him all nations , and heapeth unto him all people :

translation.kha: U angel jyllang U Trai u la ong ha u phyllaw , To khreh bad leit shngain shiah shat Katai ka lynter kaba leit na Jeremaïah sha Gerasa . ( Kane ka long ka lynti ka bym ju pyndonkam shuh mynta . )
translation.en: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip , saying , Arise , and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza , which is desert .

And the saying pleased the whole multitude : and they chose Stephen , a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost , and Philip , and Prochorus , and Nicanor , and Timon , and Parmenas , and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch :
translation.kha: Ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la sngewbha ïa ka jingtyrwa jong ki apostol , kumta ki la jied ïa u Stephan , u briew uba dap da ka jingngeit bad da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , bad u Philip , u Prokhoros , u Nikanor , u Timon , u Parmenas , bad u Nikolas , u Jentil uba na Antiokh uba mynshuwa u la kylla sha ka niam Jiw .
U Jakob u jingbabe , Ngan ai ïa ka lapbah phi ai shuwa ha nga ïa ki hok jong phi kumta u khun nongtong .
translation.en: And Jacob said , Sell me this day thy birthright .
And the evil spirit from the  Lord  was upon Saul , as he sat in his house with his javelin in his hand : and David played with his hand .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u mynsiem bymman na U  Trai  u wan tyllep ïa u Saul . U dang shong ha la ïing bad u sum ha la ka kti , bad u Dabid u don hangta , u dang tem ïa la ka duitara .
Te nangta , nga ong ba ka por ka Nakon ba ngan leh ei ei ïa ki bleithaw jong ka Babilon , bad kiba mynsaw Kin ud ha ka ri baroh kawei .
translation.en: Wherefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will do judgment upon her graven images : and through all her land the wounded shall groan .

translation.en: But they were exceedingly afraid , and said , Behold , two kings stood not before him : how then shall we stand ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar ka Samaria ki la sheptieng ,  Kumno ngi lah ban pyrshah ïa u Jehu ,  ki la ong ,  naba wat u syiem Joram lymne u syiem Ahasaïah kim lah ?
U Abram u la shongsuk ïa ka Sarah , nabar u Nahor u la shongsuk ïa ka Milkah , ka khun jongu u Haran , kiba long ruh u kpa jong ka Iskah .
translation.en: And Abram and Nahor took them wives : the name of Abram s wife was Sarai  ; and the name of Nahor s wife , Milcah , the daughter of Haran , the father of Milcah , and the father of Iscah .
And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship , and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida , while he sent away the people .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi U Jisu u la pynlong ïa ki synran ban kiew halor ka lieng bad ban leit ha shuwa jong u sha Bethsaida , sha shiliang jong ka duriaw , katba u dang phah noh ïa u paidbah .

Hadien ba ka Jingkhawai mem ka la kut , baroh ki paid Israel ki leit sha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah ha Judah bad ki pynpra ïa ki rishot maw , ki pyndkut ïa ki duriaw ka blei Asherah , bad ki pyndeng ïa ki duwan bad ki jaka mane bieit thala . Ki leh ïa kajuh ha baroh ki bynta basah jong ka Judah , bad ïa ki ri Jong ki Benjamin , Ephraim bad Manasseh ; nangta baroh na ki , ki leit phai sha Ïing .
translation.en: Now when all this was finished , all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah , and brake the images in pieces , and cut down the groves , and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin , in Ephraim also and Manasseh , until they had utterly destroyed them all . Then all the children of Israel returned , every man to his possession , into their own cities .

translation.kha: U Blei jong ngi u don ha bneng ; u leh ïa kano kano kaba u mon .
translation.en: But our God is in the heavens : he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased .

translation.kha: U Sa u leit ban ïaleh ïa u , bad baroh arliang ki ïeng ha la ki jaka ha ka Them Sephathah hajan Mareshah .
translation.en: Then Asa went out against him , and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah .
And take your father and your households , and come unto me : and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt , and ye shall eat the fat of the land .
translation.kha: Ai ba kin wan ïalam shane ïa u kpa jong phi ryngkat bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki . Ngan ai ïa ki ka jaka kaba bha tam ha Ijipt , bad kin ïoh palat ïa kaba ki donkam .

U Trai da lade hi un ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi , bad ïa phi yn sa lute da ki briew Ibbah saihon ki la long ki sakhrai jong phi . Haba kane ka jia , uwei uwei baroh un tip ba U Trai nongbanbor Ïaroh u la phan ïa nga .
translation.en: For , behold , I will shake mine hand upon them , and they shall be a spoil to their servants : and ye shall know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me .

translation.kha: Mynno ngi la ju ioh ïa me ba me longkmie u nongwei , dara ba ngi pdang sngewbha ïa me ha ki ïing jong ngi , lieng ba me lyngkhuit sad ba ngi pynkup jaiñ ïa me ?
translation.en: When saw we thee a stranger , and took thee in ? or naked , and clothed thee ?

translation.kha: Lada uno a u Israel , lane uno uno u nongwei uba wan shong hapdeng jong ki , u bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam ha ka , U Trai un phalang pyrshah ïa u pynlang yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki bariew jong U Blei .
translation.en: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn among you , that eateth any manner of blood  ; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood , and will cut him off from among his people .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ieh ïa katai ka jingbam ha u rangbah uba dei peit ïa ka bam , u mar shuh ba don ki hynmen , bad u kylli kumin ki ïalong .
translation.en: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage , and ran into the army , and came and saluted his brethren .

translation.kha: U Joash u la don hynñiew snem ka rta mynba u erlangthari u syiem ka Judah , badno u synshar sawphew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Siba na ka nongbah Hephsibah .
translation.en: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign , and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Zibiah of Beer–sheba .
When Christ , who is our life , shall appear , then shall ye also appear with him in glory .
translation.kha: Ka jingim bashisha jong phi ka long U Khrist , bad haba u mihpaw , te ma phi ruh phin mihpaw lem bad u bad ïoh bynta ïa ka burom jong u!

translation.en: And their coast was from Mahanaim , all Bashan , all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan , and all the towns of Jair , which are in Bashan , threescore cities :
translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ki ka ïar naduh Mahanaim bad kynthup ïa ka Bashan baroh — baroh ka hima u Og , u syiem Bashan , bad ruh baroh hynriewphew tylli ki shnong jong u Jair ha Bashan .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even rend it with a stormy wind in my fury  ; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger , and great hailstones in my fury to consume it .
translation.kha: Mynta kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ha ka jingbitar jong nga ngan phah ïa ka lyer bajur , u slap bajur , bad u phria ban pynjot ïa ka kynroh .

U Dabid u jubab , Me wanlam ïaleh ïa nga da ka waitlam , da u lyngka , bad da u sum , hynrei per wan pyrthuh ïa me ha ka kyrteng U Trai Badonbor , U Blei Jong ki kynhun ïapom ki Israel , ïa uba me la ñiewbeiñ .
translation.en: Then said David to the Philistine , Thou comest to me with a sword , and with a spear , and with a shield : but I come to thee in the name of the  Lord  of hosts , the God of the armies of Israel , whom thou hast defied .

translation.kha: Haba nga la ïohi ba phim shym wanrah ïarap ïa nga , nga la ïakheiñ ïa la ka jingkem bad nga jam ïa u pud ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ; bad U Trai u la ai ha nga ka jingjop ba-halor Jong ki . Te baïar pat phi wan ban ïaleh ïa nga mynta ?
translation.en: And when I saw that ye delivered me not , I put my life in my hands , and passed over against the children of Ammon , and the  Lord  delivered them into my hand : wherefore then are ye come up unto me this day , to fight against me ?

translation.kha: U Nathan u jubab , Leh kat kaba don ha ka jingmut jong phi , namar U Blei u long jingset bad phi .
translation.en: Then Nathan said unto David , Do all that is in thine heart  ; for God is with thee .
And I give unto them eternal life  ; and they shall never perish , neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand .
translation.kha: Nga ai ha ki ïa ka jingim bymjukut , bad kin ym ïap da lei lei ruh . Ym don uno uno uba lah ban knieh noh ïa ki na nga .
To pynim ïa lade lada me long u syiem ki Jiw !
translation.en: And saying , If thou be the king of the Jews , save thyself .

translation.kha: Ïa baroh’ ki khuri jong u syiem Solomon la shna da ka ksiar , bad baroh ki khiew ki pliang ha ka Kamra heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon ki long kiba da ka ksiar nala . Ha ki sngi u Solomon ïa ka dabi ym pat ñiew kambah kyrdoh .
translation.en: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold : none were of silver  ; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon .

translation.kha: bad u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa : Ka khubor u Balaam u khuid jong u baher , Ki ktien jong u briew uba lah ban ïohi shai ,
translation.en: And he took up his parable , and said , Balaam the son of Beor hath said , and the man whose eyes are open hath said :

translation.kha: Kynther ïa lade , ko Jerusha ! Ïeng joit na u pui kjit bad shong hiar la ka khiat ! Law noh ïa ki kynjri kiba teh ïa pha , ki briew ba la shah khem jong ka Seïon !
translation.en: Shake thyself from the dust  ; arise , and sit down , O Jerusalem : loose thyself from the bands of thy neck , O captive daughter of Zion .

translation.kha: U lyngkhuit un pyndep ïa ka jingshim ka jingpynkhuid ïa ka kynhun , bad yn sa map ïa ki , namar ka jingbakla ka Long kaba khlem da mut khnang pynlang ba ki la wallam ruh ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop kum ka jingkohnguh bam sha U Trai .
translation.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel , and it shall be forgiven them  ; for it is ignorance : and they shall bring their offering , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord  , and their sin offering before the  Lord  , for their ignorance :

translation.kha: Habor u la poi ha Galilaïa , ki briew hangta ki la pyngkiang sngewkwah ïa u , namar ba ki la leit sha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha Jerusalem bad ki la ïohi ïa kiew kiei baroh kiba u la leh ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam .
translation.en: Then when he was come into Galilee , the Galilaeans received him , having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast : for they also went unto the feast .

translation.kha: Namar ba Ngi dei ki khun jong ki ngi la iohpateng ia me ki jingbymjanai bad jingiap . —Nong Rom 5 12 .
translation.en: Consistent with the laws of genetics , we have inherited that imperfection and death . —Romans 5 :12 .

translation.kha: Ki ong ïa u Jephthah , Ïeng phai sha me mynta Namarba ngi khiew ïa me ban leit pur bad ngi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Ammon , bad ban long u nongïalam ïa ki Gilead baroh .
translation.en: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah , Therefore we turn again to thee now , that thou mayest go with us , and fight against the children of Ammon , and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead .

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u shim ïa ka jingbam na ki bad u thang ïa ka ha ka duwan , halor ka jingkñia ainguh thang , kum ka jingainguh jingpynkyntang . Kane ka long ka jingkñia ainguh bam , bad ka jingiw na ka , ka pynbamphlang ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And Moses took them from off their hands , and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering : they were consecrations for a sweet savour : it is an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha pli ki sngi ym don Mano mano ba lah ïa-ban wang bad leit ha ka jingshngain , namar ba ka la don ka jingjot bad jingkhihwin ha ka ri Baroh .
translation.en: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out , nor to him that came in , but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries .

translation.kha: U Trai u Long u nongïada uba khlaiñ jong nga ; u hir ma u , umbah la pyrsad im ïa nga . U dei U blang jngai sa , bad ngan ïaroi ïa u , U Blei jong u kpa jong at , bad ngan rwai shngain ka jingryngkhiang jong u .
translation.en: The  Lord  is my strength and song , and he is become my salvation : he is my God , and I will prepare him an habitation  ; my father s God , and I will exalt him .

translation.kha: U briew uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher , te , u dei ban duwai khnang ïa-ban ïoh ïa ka jingai shun batai ïa kaei Kaba u kren .
translation.en: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret .

translation.kha: Kim don bynta ha ka jingim kaba U Blei u ai , naba ki erlangthari kiba bieit tasam bad kiba eh dohnud .
translation.en: Having the understanding darkened , being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them , because of the blindness of their heart :

translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , ki jingpyniwbih kin ïohi ba pha ïoh ka jingjop ! nabar ki syep jong ki baroh kin ïuh ïa ka burom jong pha . Yn khot ïa phah da ka kyrteng kaba thymmai , ka kirteng ba U Trai hi u ai .
translation.en: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness , and all kings thy glory : and thou shalt be called by a new name , which the mouth of the  Lord  shall name .

translation.kha: Naba wat lada kata ka shithi jong nga ka la pynsngewsih ïa phi , per te ngam sniew ba nga la thoh ïa ka . Ngan jin da la sngewsih hajan nga la ïohi ba ka la pynsngewsih ïa phi shipa .
translation.en: For though I made you sorry with a letter , I do not repent , though I did repent : for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry , though it were but for a season .
So Joshua ascended from Gilgal , he , and all the people of war with him , and all the mighty men of valour .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh , kynthup ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba kynsai tam , ki la mihnoh na Gilgal .

translation.en: Now therefore , O  Lord  our God , save us from his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the  Lord  , even thou only .
translation.kha: Mynta , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Assyria , kumta ba baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang ma me hi me long U Blei .

La don u briew uba kyrteng u Joseph na Arimathaïa , ka shnong kaba ha Judith . U la long u briew uba bol bad uba donburom , uba la apkhmih ïa ka jingjaw jong ka Hima U blei . Wat la u long u dkhot jong ka Dorbar , um shngiam la mynjur bad ka jingrai bad jingleh jongki ki .
translation.en: ( The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them  ; ) he was of Arimathaea , a city of the Jews : who also himself waited for the kingdom of God .

O Jerusalem , Jerusalem , thou that killest the prophets , and stonest them which are sent unto thee , how often would I have gathered thy children together , even as a hen gathereth her chickens under her wings , and ye would not !
translation.kha: A Jerusalem , Jerusalem ! Pha pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bad lynthem maw ïa ki nonglamktien kiba U Blei u la phah ha pha ! Katno sien nga la kwah ban kdup ha ki ksang ti jong nga ïa ki briew jong pha baroh , kumba ka syiar ka lumlang ïa la ki khun hapoh ki thapniang jong ka , hynrei pham shym la shah ïa nga .

translation.en: As for the sons of Merari , thou shalt number them after their families , by the house of their fathers  ;
translation.kha: Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ïa ka miej , ïa u diengpynïeng sharak , ïa ki duwan , ïa ki khiew ki pliang ba ki lyngdoh ki pyndonkam ha ka Jaka Kyntang , bad ïa ka pyrda ha ka jingkhang sha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam . Kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad kine tiar ki tar .
Haba u Joseph u la wan ha ki mynstep , u la ïohi ba ki leh diaw .
translation.en: And Joseph came in unto them in the morning , and looked upon them , and , behold , they were sad .

translation.kha: Ym don jingpyndem shuh mynta na ka bynta kito kaba im ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus , who walk not after the flesh , but after the Spirit .
For the same cause also do ye joy , and rejoice with me .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , phi ruh phi dei ban shadkmen , bad ïasam bynta lem ïa ka jingkmen jong phi bad nga .

translation.en: Forty stripes he may give him , and not exceed : lest , if he should exceed , and beat him above these with many stripes , then thy brother should seem vile unto thee .
translation.kha: Lah ban sympat ïa u haduh sawphew thri , hynrei ym palat ïa kata ; lada palat ïa kata , kan pynpoh dor ïa u ha khmat ki briew .

da kaba ai ha ngi ïa baroh ki jingpynshitom kiba la batai ha ka Aiñ jong u Moses . hynne wat mynta , A Trai U Blei jong ngi , ngim shym la pynjrong ban pynïapthngan ïa me da kaba phan ino na ki pop jong ngi lane da kaba bud ïa ka jingshisha jong me .
translation.en: As it is written in the law of Moses , all this evil is come upon us : yet made we not our prayer before the  Lord  our God , that we might turn from our iniquities , and understand thy truth .

translation.kha: Ki briew kin rieh ha ki krem ha mawsiang lum lano tih thliew ha khyndew ban pyrshang ban lieh na ka jingbieit jong U Trai nabar ban rieh na ka bor bad ka burom jongu u , haba u woh ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks , and into the caves of the earth , for fear of the  Lord  , and for the glory of his majesty , when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Abiathar , uwei na ki khun shynrang Jong u Ahimelekh , u la lait im , bad u leit ïasoh bad u Dabid .
translation.en: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub , named Abiathar , escaped , and fled after David .

translation.kha: Kum ïa ki shiah kiba la thai bad ïa u phlangïap ba-tyrkhong , ïa phi ki nongbuaid yn thang shuh !
translation.en: For while they be folden together as thorns , and while they are drunken as drunkards , they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry .
Having made known unto us the mystery of his will , according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself :
translation.kha: U Blei u la leh ïa kata ha ka jingstad bad jingïohi jong u baroh ïa kaei kaba u la thmu , bad u la pynpaw shynna ha ngi ïa ka jingthmu ba la buhrieh ïa kaba u la lah thmu lypa ban pyndep da U Khrist .
Hynrei haba ki la ithuh ba u den u Jiw , ki la ïa-pyrta lang ïa kajuh haduh ar kynta : Kaba khraw ka longïing ka Artemis jong ka Ephesos !
translation.en: But when they knew that he was a Jew , all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out , Great is Diana of the Ephesians .
And the people gave a shout , saying , It is the voice of a god , and not of a man .
translation.kha: Ym dei u briew uba kren , hynrei u blei !  ki la pyrta .
Naba kim napdeng Shu ban kylli ïa u kano kano ka jingkylli .
translation.en: And after that they durst not ask him any question at all .

translation.kha: Lada phi kyntien ïa ka jingai jingjam kaba bha , phi pan ïa ka jingjngem ; bud ïa ka bad phin lait im .
translation.en: Whoso despiseth the word shall be destroyed : but he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded .

translation.kha: Nangta ki nongïalam bad ki paidbah ki ong ha ki lyngkdong bad ki nongïathuhlypa , uno u briew u la kren ha ngi ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai U Blei jong ngi ; um dei baneh shait pynïap .
translation.en: Then said the princes and all the people unto the priests and to the prophets  ; This man is not worthy to die : for he hath spoken to us in the name of the  Lord  our God .

translation.kha: U syiem Nebukhadnessar u la dem khrup ha khyndew bad u la ai hukum na ka beit ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh kiba dei ban ai ïa u Daniel .
translation.en: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face , and worshipped Daniel , and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odours unto him .

translation.kha: Ka jingthiah ba pynkohnguh ka haka ban pynrit ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah bakhlaiñ tam bad ka kah ban pynngeit wat ïa ki nongsynshar .
translation.en: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded , and a soft tongue breaketh the bone .

For who hath despised the day of small things ? for they shall rejoice , and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven  ; they are the eyes of the  Lord  , which run to and fro through the whole earth .
translation.kha: Ki la noh mynsiem namar ka jingsuki jong ka jingïaid ka kam . Hynrei kin ïohi ba u Serubbabel u dang ïai tei ïa ka Templ , bad kin long kiba kmen .  U angel u la ong ha nga ,  Ki hynñiew tylli ki sharak ki long ki hynñiew tylli ki khmat jong U  Trai  kiba khmih halor ka pyrthei baroh .

translation.en: And Micaiah said , Behold , thou shalt see in that day , when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself .
translation.kha: Phin sa shem haba phin leit shadien ka kamra ban rieh ,  U Mikaïah u jubab .

translation.en: In all the signs and the wonders , which the  Lord  sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh , and to all his servants , and to all his land ,
translation.kha: Ym don uwei pat u nongïathuhlypa uba la leh ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kum kito kiba U  Trai  u la phah ïa u Moses ban leh ha u syiem ka Ijipt , ha ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ha ka ri hi baroh kawei .

Thoh ha u jin jong ka bran ha syrdoh : Kane ka long ka khubor na uta uba don ki hynñiew ki mynnin jong U Blei bad ki hynñiew ki khlur . Nga tipbriew ïa kaei kaba pha leh ; la pyntip ba pha khong ka nam baïap ba pha long kaba im , wat la pha la ïap !
translation.en: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write  ; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God , and the seven stars  ; I know thy works , that thou hast a name that thou livest , and art dead .

translation.kha: Lum ïa ki jingai jingmut baroh katba phi lah , bad phin jop ; khlem sakma phin shahjop .
translation.en: Without counsel purposes are disappointed : but in the multitude of counsellors they are established .

translation.kha: U Hasiel u shna ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang da ka dieng akasia , kaweh bashispah shiphew sentimitar ka lynter , hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew synshar ka jingsarong .
translation.en: And Bezaleel made the ark of shittim wood : two cubits and a half was the length of it , and a cubit and a half the breadth of it , and a cubit and a half the height of it :

And if , when the priest seeth it , behold , it be in sight lower than the skin , and the hair thereof be turned white  ; the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un peit bniah ïa u , bad lada kata ka dak ka paw ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka bad ba u shñiuh hangta ruh u la kylla lieh , un pynbna ba uta u long u bymkhuid . Kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh kaba sdang na uta u tohjaw .

translation.en: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again , even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him .
translation.kha: Ngi ngeit ba U Jisu u la ïap bad u la mihpat , bad kumta ngi ngeit ba U Blei un shim pat bad U Jisu ïa kito kiba la ïap da kaba ngeit ha u .

Tikbah mane blei thala ki la dap da ka jingbitar shla , namar ka por jong ka jingbitar jong me ka la poi , ka nga ban bishar ïa kiba ïap . Ka por ka la poi ban ainong ïa ki shakri jongki me , ki nongïathuh , bad ïa ki briew jong me baroh , iba baroh ibha tiengburom ïa me , kiba khraw bad kiba rit kumjuh . Ka por ka la pa banbeiñ pynjot ïa iar kiba pynjot ïa ka pynrieh !
translation.en: And the nations were angry , and thy wrath is come , and the time of the dead , that they should be judged , and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets , and to the saints , and them that fear thy name , small and great  ; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth .
But if any man seem to be contentious , we have no such custom , neither the churches of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u kwah ban ïasaidnia shaphang kata , baroh kaba nga don ban ong ka long ba ma ngi lymne ki balang U Blei ngi don da kawei pat ka rukom ha ka jingmane .

translation.en: For he said unto him ,  Come out of the man , thou unclean spirit .
translation.kha: ( U la ong ïa kane namar U Jisu u la ong ,  Me u mynsiem bymkhuid , mihnoh na une u briew !  )
Ki buhai ïa ka Synduk ka million ha kata ka kali , lem bad ïa kata ka synduk ha kaba la thep ïa ki dur khaïi bad ki dur u thum kiba da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And they laid the ark of the  Lord  upon the cart , and the coffer with the mice of gold and the images of their emerods .

translation.kha: U briew naba shem ïa sa u shem ïa ka jingim , sad U Trai un sngewbha ïa u .
translation.en: For whoso findeth me findeth life , and shall obtain favour of the  Lord .
And Joshua said unto the people , Sanctify yourselves : for to morrow the  Lord  will do wonders among you .
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki paidbah ,  Pynkhuid ïa lade , namar lashai U  Trai  un leh ki kambah hapdeng jong phi .

translation.en: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah , saying , As the  Lord  liveth , that made us this soul , I will not put thee to death , neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Sedekaïah u la kular ïa nga ha kaba rieh ,  Nga smai da U Blei uba im , U Blei uba ai jingim ïa ngi , ba ngan ym pynïap ïa phi lane ai noh ïa phi sha ki briew kiba kwah ban pynïap ïa phi .

translation.en: And the  Lord  came down in a cloud , and spake unto him , and took of the spirit that was upon him , and gave it unto the seventy elders : and it came to pass , that , when the spirit rested upon them , they prophesied , and did not cease .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u wan hiar ha u lyoh bad u la kren ïa u . U la shim khyndiat ka bor mynsiem kaba u la ai ha u Moses bad u ai ïa ka ha kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongïalam . Haba kata ka bor mynsiem ka la wan shong ha ki , ki sdang ban pyrta jam kum ki nongïathuhlypa , hynrei tang shipor .

translation.en: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel , and say unto them , Ye shall be holy : for I the  Lord  your God am holy .
translation.kha: Long kiba khuid , namar nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , nga long uba khuid .

translation.en: And thy servant my father said unto us , Ye know that my wife bare me two sons :
translation.kha: Nangta i pa i ong ha ngi , ‘ Phi tip ba ka Rakhel ka tnga jong nga ka ïoh tang ar ngut ki khun shynrang na nga .
A Blei , to pynbna ba nga long uba lui den , bad ïasaid da ïa nga na ki bymriewblei ; pyllait ïa por na ki brup kiba ïashukor bad kiba snem !
translation.en: Judge me , O God , and plead my cause against an ungodly nation : O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man .

translation.kha: Ha tala ka por u khynnah Samuel u ïai shakri ïa U Trai , u da phong da ka sopti-lor da ka jaiñ linen kaba kyntang .
translation.en: But Samuel ministered before the  Lord  , being a child , girded with a linen ephod .

translation.kha: Lada u nongwei umbah shang bad phi u kylla riewspah , katba u para Israel u kylla duk bad u die mraw noh ïa lade ha uta u nongwei ne ha u dkhot ka longsem jong u .
translation.en: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee , and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor , and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee , or to the stock of the stranger s family :

translation.kha: Haba phi pynïap ïa u mrad ban pynlong ka jingainguh ïasyllok , bud beit ïa ki jingbuhbeit rit kaba nga la ai ha phi , dara ngan pdiang ïa kata ka jingainguh .
translation.en: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the  Lord  , ye shall offer it at your own will .

translation.kha: Haba u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la leit sha jingtep ban phet ïap na u sahmiet Salmone , u la ïohsngew ïa kane ka khubor , u wan peiñ noh na Ijipt .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who was yet in Egypt , heard of it , ( for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon , and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt  ; )

translation.kha: ka thma kan sa wan ha ki brup jong phi , bad ïa ki kut jong phi baroh yn pynjot . Kan long kum ka sngi ha kaba u syiem Shalman u la pynjot ïa ka nongbah Betharbel ha ka thma , ha kaban ïa ki kmie bad ki khun jong ki la pynlwet haduh ban da ïap .
translation.en: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people , and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled , as Shalman spoiled Beth–arbel in the day of battle : the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children .
Let as many servants as are under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honour , that the name of God and his doctrine be not blasphemed .
translation.kha: Kito kiba long ki mraw ki dei ban ñiew ba ki kynrad jong ki , ki long kiba dei hok ban ïoh ïa ka burom baroh , khnang ba yn ym don mano mano ki ban kren sniew ïa ka kyrteng U Blei bad ïa ka jinghikai jong ngi .

translation.en: Therewith bless we God , even the Father  ; and therewith curse we men , which are made after the similitude of God .
translation.kha: Ngi pyndonkam ïa u ban ainguh ïa U Trai bad U Kpa jong ngi bad ban tim ruh ïa la u parabriew , ïa uba la thaw ha ka dur U Blei .
Ki la leit sha Khmut bad ki la ap ïa ngi ha Troas .
translation.en: These going before tarried for us at Troas .

translation.kha: La pynphai pat ïa ki pisa jong nga , u la khot ïa la ki hynriew shynrong . Kane hangne ha ka barli jong nga ! Mar kumta ki rit mynjur ri , bad da kaweh sheptieng ki ïakylli para ma ki , Kaei keiñ kane kaba U Blei u la leh ïa i ?
translation.en: And he said unto his brethren , My money is restored  ; and , lo , it is even in my sack : and their heart failed them , and they were afraid , saying one to another , What is this that God hath done unto us ?
And now thou sayest , Go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here : and he shall slay me .
translation.kha: Te kumno phin hukum ïa nga ban leit ban ong ïa u syiem ba phi don hangne ? Un sa pynïap ïa nga !
Ki la khang ïa ka lynti phet jong nga bad pyrshang ban pynjot ïa nga ; bad ym don mano mynno ban pynsangeh ïa ki .
translation.en: They mar my path , they set forward my calamity , they have no helper .
And when ye came unto this place , Sihon the king of Heshbon , and Og the king of Bashan , came out against us unto battle , and we smote them :
translation.kha: Bad ynda ngi la poi ha kane ka jaka , U Sihon u syiem Heshbon bad u Og u Syiem Bashan ki la wan ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ngi .
Bad kumta , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , lada ka jingpynïap kam pynrem ïa ngi , ine don ka jingshlur ha khmat U Blei .
translation.en: Beloved , if our heart condemn us not , then have we confidence toward God .

translation.kha: Phi ieit ïa u , wat haba phim pat ïohi ïa u , bad phi beit ha u , wat la phim pat ïohi ïa u mynta . Te phi shadkmen da ka jingkmen kaba khraw bad kaba dap da ka burom kiba ki ktien kim lah ban batai ,
translation.en: Whom having not seen , ye love  ; in whom , though now ye see him not , yet believing , ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory :

translation.kha: To shadkmen , ko ka bneng , Namar ka jingpynjot ïa ka ! to shadkmen , ko ki briew jong U Blei bad ki apostol bad ki nongshetkylla ! Naba U Blei u la pynrem ïa ka na ka bynda kaei kaba ka la leh ïa phi !
translation.en: Rejoice over her , thou heaven , and ye holy apostles and prophets  ; for God hath avenged you on her .

translation.kha: nongthaw ki paidbah ki longing sha ka templ u Baal bad ki pynkyllon ïa ka ; ki pynpaw ïa ki duwan bad ïa ki bleithaw , bad ki pynpyut ïa u Mattan , u lyngdoh jong u Baal , ha khmat ki duwan . U Jehoba u buh ïa ki nongap phira kiba daiñ treikam ha ka Templ ,
translation.en: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal , and brake it down  ; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly , and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars . And the priest appointed officers over the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Te por la ong ïa ka kur Rekhab ba U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong , phiah la kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba u kpa tymmen jong phi u Jonadab u la ai ha phi ; phi la bud ïa baroh ki jingbthah jong u , bad phi la leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u la praw ïa phi .
translation.en: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jehonadab your father , and kept all his precepts , and done according unto all that he hath commanded you :

translation.kha: U shakri u la dem khrup ha ki khohsiew ha khmat u Syiem . ‘ To ïaishah bad nga ,’ u la kyrpad , ‘ bad ngan snar ïa phi ïa kaei kaei baroh !’
translation.en: The servant therefore fell down , and worshipped him , saying , Lord , have patience with me , and I will pay thee all .

translation.kha: ka bai shut sdie bad ka bai mawleiñ ïa ki dieng tyndung ka long shi sbai rit , bad ka bai shut nar lyngkor lieng shut mohkhiew ka long ar tylli ki sbai rit . )
translation.en: Yet they had a file for the mattocks , and for the coulters , and for the forks , and for the axes , and to sharpen the goads .

translation.kha: Thang noh ïa ka doh ne ïa u kpu ba sah baroh’ .
translation.en: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire .
And Joseph knew his brethren , but they knew not him .
translation.kha: Wat la u Joseph u la ithuh ïa la ki hynmen , ki pat kim shym la ithuh ïa u .
ka kynhun shipai Judia ka la shispah , sad ki shipai ki la phet sha la ki ïing .
translation.en: And Judah was put to the worse before Israel , and they fled every man to his tent .

translation.kha: Mynta pat , ïa kata ka jingshisha la pynkhih ha kaba paw lyngba ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa ; bad da ka hukum jong U Blei bymsuidñiew , ïa ka la pyntip sha baroh ki jaitbynriew , khnap ba barabor ki lah ban ngeit bad khunlung .
translation.en: But now is made manifest , and by the scriptures of the prophets , according to the commandment of the everlasting God , made known to all nations for the obedience of faith :
And they that passed by railed on him , wagging their heads , and saying , Ah , thou that destroyest the temple , and buildest it in three days ,
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ïaid nangta ki la kyrngah ïa la ki khlieh bad krenbeiñ ïa U Jisu :  Ade ! men pynjot ïa ka Templ bad tei pat ïa ka hapoh lai sngi !

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam , and all that he did , and his might , how he warred , and how he recovered Damascus , and Hamath , which belonged to Judah , for Israel , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jeroboam Uba Ar u la leh , ki thma bashlur jong u , bad kumno u pynïoh pat ïa ka Damaskos bad ka Hamath sha ki Israel , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan theh noh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga wat ha ki shakri , ki shynrang bad ki kynthei kumjuh .
Bad ki bri jong U Bela Bahakhlieh Tam Eh kin ïohpdiang ïa ka bor ba kynja syiem bad ban bat ïa ka junom la junom .
translation.en: But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom , and possess the kingdom for ever , even for ever and ever .

translation.kha: Kumta hi ka nar-khang , ka dewbyrtha , ka rnong , ka daw badno ka ksiar ki la khyllem bad ki la long kum u pui pui ha ka khak shoh kew ha ka por lyiur . Ka lyer ka la kup noh ïa u , khlem da pynïasoh dien ei ei . Hynrei u maw u la san ba long u lumbah uba tap ïa ka pyiar baroh Kawei .
translation.en: Then was the iron , the clay , the brass , the silver , and the gold , broken to pieces together , and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors  ; and the wind carried them away , that no place was found for them : and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain , and filled the whole earth .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki rkhie ïa nga baroh Sei Sngi ; to long ka jingbiria ïa ki baïar .
translation.en: I was a derision to all my people  ; and their song all the day .

translation.kha: La longing on lynti ïa ki da ka balang ; bad katba ki ïan leit Lyngba ka Phoenisia sad ka Syria , ki la ïathmu kumno ba ki Jentil ki la phai sha U Blei ; kane ka khubor ka la salm ka jingkmen Bakhraw ïa ki bangeit baroh .
translation.en: And being brought on their way by the church , they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria , declaring the conversion of the Gentiles : and they caused great joy unto all the brethren .
And shall put my spirit in you , and ye shall live , and I shall place you in your own land : then shall ye know that I the  Lord  have spoken it , and performed it , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pyrsad da ka mynsiem jong nga ha ki , bad kin im biang , bad ngan sa shah ïa ki ban im ha ka ri jong ki hi . Te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai . Nga la kular ba ngan leh ïa kane — bad ngan leh . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: I should have been as though I had not been  ; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave .
translation.kha: Ban leit beit na ka kpoh sha ka jingtep , kan jin da la long kaba bha kum ka bym shym don .
Wat ïaktah ïong bad ki briew jong —kata ka ri shata naba phi leit , namar kata ka lah ïa-ban long ka jingriam ka ba pynïap ïa phi .
translation.en: Take heed to thyself , lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest , lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee :

translation.kha: Lydia phi dong ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad phim Tertios ban kohnguh ïa nga , ngan pynshitom hajuh shuh ïa phi sa khyndew shah .
translation.en: And if ye walk contrary unto me , and will not hearken unto me  ; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins .

translation.kha: Kumta ka Bathsheba ka leit jngoh ïa u syiem ha ka kamra thiah jong u . U la tymmen bol , bad ka Abishag , ka samla kynthei na Shunem , ka sumar ïa u .
translation.en: And Bath–sheba went in unto the king into the chamber : and the king was very old  ; and Abishag the Shunammite ministered unto the king .

translation.kha: te to ai ba yn kdiah ïa ki kti jyllang ang ; to ai ba yn sloit ïa ki na ki tyrpeng jongu ar .
translation.en: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade , and mine arm be broken from the bone .

translation.kha: Kumta bun ki briew ki la ïawanlang Sihon wan ba ym don jaka sha kaweh lait , ym don jaka shuh wat habar ha khmat ka jingkhang . U Jisu u Dang ïalap ïa ka khubor ha ki ,
translation.en: And straightway many were gathered together , insomuch that there was no room to receive them , no , not so much as about the door : and he preached the word unto them .
And his sisters , are they not all with us ? Whence then hath this man all these things ?
translation.kha: Hato ki para kynthei jong u baroh kim shong kim sah hangne ? Nangno u ïoh ïa kane baroh ?

translation.en: And David said unto him , From whence comest thou ? And he said unto him , Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped .
