translation.kha: U Dabid u kylli ïa u ,  Nangno me wan ?   Nga la lait phet na ka jaka sher dara ki Israel ,  u la jubab .
U bri umbah sngewhun u lum ïa ki soh ha ka aïom kaba biang ; ka long kaba jahburom ban thiah thai ha ka por ka aïom ot .
translation.en: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son : but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame .
Now , O king , establish the decree , and sign the writing , that it be not changed , according to the law of the Medes and Persians , which altereth not .
translation.kha: Kumta ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un pynmih ïa kane ka hukum bad soi ïa ka , bad kan treikam , ka aiñ jong ki Mid bad ki Persia , ka bym lah ban pynkylla .
Ngan pynbna ïa ki hukum jong me ha ki syiem , bad ngan ym shah pynlehrain .
translation.en: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings , and will not be ashamed .

translation.kha: Ono uno uba ieit ïa la ka jong ka jingim un duh ïa ka ; uno uno uba tun ïa la ka jong ka jingim ha Kane ka pyrthei un ri ïa ka sha ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: He that loveth his life shall lose it  ; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal .

translation.kha: Hato don ba kylli shaphang u Titos , u long u nongïatrei lang bad la ba ïarap ïa phi ; bad Shaphan kiwei pat ki parabangeit kiba ïaleit lang bad u , ki mihkhmat ïa ki balang dara ki wallam ka burom ïa U Khereth .
translation.en: Whether any do enquire of Titus , he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you : or our brethren be enquired of , they are the messengers of the churches , and the glory of Christ .

translation.kha: Bad “lada ïa ka burom U Blei la pynpaw lyngba jong u , te U Blei! un pynpaw ïa ka burom jong U Khun U Briew ha lade , bad un ai kumta kumne kumne .
translation.en: If God be glorified in him , God shall also glorify him in himself , and shall straightway glorify him .

translation.kha: kumto te , ko parabangeit jngai nga , haduh katno phi long kiba ieit ïa nga bad haduh katno na la sngewtmang ïa phi ! Haduh katno phi pynbunkam ïa nga , bad haduh katno nga sngewsarong namar jong phi ! Kane te , ko ki parabangeit ba-ieit , ka hir kumno phi dei ban ïng skhem ha ka jingshim jong phi ha U Trai .
translation.en: Therefore , my brethren dearly beloved and longed for , my joy and crown , so stand fast in the Lord , my dearly beloved .

Then Abigail made haste , and took two hundred loaves , and two bottles of wine , and five sheep ready dressed , and five measures of parched corn , and an hundred clusters of raisins , and two hundred cakes of figs , and laid them on asses .
translation.kha: Ka Abigail ka la pynstet ban lum arspah tylli ki kpu , ar tylli ki pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ , san tylli ki langbrot kiba la syang , khathynñiew kilo u kew ba la sdieh ; shispah tylli ki rynjup soh kismis , bad arspah tylli ki thup soh Dumbur tyrkhong , bad ka pynkit ïa ki halor ki kada .

translation.en: For if ye live after the flesh , ye shall die : but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body , ye shall live .
translation.kha: Naba lada phi im kat kum ka jinglong ba kynja doh , phin sa ïap ; hynrei lada da U Mynsiem phi pynïap noh ïa ki jingleh ka pop , phin im .

Ka dang don shuh sa kawei pat . Me kynruh ïa kaei kaba u Joab u la leh ïa nga da kaba pynïap ïa ki ar ngut ki rangbah ai hukum jong ki shipai Israel — u Abner , u khun jong u Ner bad u Amasa , u khun jong u Gether . Me kynthup kumno u la pynïap ïa ki ha ka por suk pyrthei kum ka jingpynhiarkput ïa ka jingïap kaba ki la leh ha ka nga thma . U la pynïap ïa ki ngab balui lui , bad mynta per bah ka jingkitkhlieh ïa kamai kaba u la leh , badno nga la shah jynjar na ka bynta kata .
translation.en: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me , and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel , unto Abner the son of Ner , and unto Amasa the son of Jether , whom he slew , and shed the blood of war in peace , and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins , and in his shoes that were on his feet .

translation.kha: Hangta ka Esther ka kren biang ha u syiem da kaba dem ha ki kjit jong u bad ïam . Ka kyrpad ïa u ban leh ei ei don pynsangeh ïa ka jingsylla basniew kaba u Haman , wahbah hiarpateng na u Agag , pyrshah ïa ki Jiw .
translation.en: And Esther spake yet again before the king , and fell down at his feet , and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite , and his device that he had devised against the Jews .

translation.kha: Kiwei pud , kim ïalap ïa U Khrist da kaba sngur , hynrei na ka mynsiem ka jingkwah rhah ; ba ki da pyrkhat ba kin nang pynpyiar shuh shuh ïa nga katba per dang don ha bynta .
translation.en: But the other of love , knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel .

translation.kha: Ka bainong jong phi ka Shong ha katei kaba phi ong nabar kaei kaba phoi leh ; phin ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi daym hok .
translation.en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth : and the recompence of a man s hands shall be rendered unto him .

translation.kha: Don sanspah sanphew ngut ki rangbah synshar kiba peit ïa ki briew kiba tei ïa ki jingtei u Solomon .
translation.en: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon s work , five hundred and fifty , which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work .
Anathoth with her suburbs , and Almon with her suburbs  ; four cities .
translation.kha: ka Anathoth , bad ka Almon , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: And they went out , and preached that men should repent .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit bad ïalap ba ki briew kin phai noh na ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: Then asked he them again ,  Whom seek ye ?  And they said , Jesus of Nazareth .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylli biang ïa ki ,  Ïano phi ïawad ?   U Jisu uba na Nasareth ,  ki la ong .
Ki don ki khup bad ki khun kyrsiew , bad ki im ban khmih ïa ki baroh ba ki heh ki san ;
translation.en: Their seed is established in their sight with them , and their offspring before their eyes .

translation.kha: Kiei kiei baroh ki kulmar lum — ka ri ka kynrei da ki jingïa-pynïap bad ki nongbah ki shlei da ka jingleh thombor .
translation.en: Make a chain : for the land is full of bloody crimes , and the city is full of violence .

translation.kha: La sleh bah nga la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha ki briew jong nga : ‘ Phi dei ban peit ba ïa ka jinglehbeiñ la pyndep , bad phi daiñ ban pyn-i ka jingbhasbun sad ka jinglehisynei iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , saying , Execute true judgment , and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother :

translation.kha: Ki briew ki saw shiah shiliang jong ka Them ki dieng Jamynrei , da Kaba pyrshang baneh lieh phet lem bad la ki jingdon jingem jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore the abundance they have gotten , and that which they have laid up , shall they carry away to the brook of the willows .

translation.kha: Kine baroh shiphew ngut ki don khwai ka jingthmu , dara ki ai ïa ka bor bad ka iktiar jong ki ha u mrad .
translation.en: These have one mind , and shall give their power and strength unto the beast .

translation.kha: Na u Horem , u lat , na u Shimshai , u sekretari jong ka pun , na ki paralok jong ki , ki nongbishar bad na baïar ki kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar , kiba long ki lapbah traishnong na Erekh , Babilon nabar Susa ha ka ri Elam ,
translation.en: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor , and Shimshai the scribe , and the rest of their companions  ; the Dinaites , the Apharsathchites , the Tarpelites , the Apharsites , the Archevites , the Babylonians , the Susanchites , the Dehavites , and the Elamites ,

translation.kha: Ka jingbeit ka pynsuk ïa ka jingim u briew uba bha , hynriewphew u Bymman u kyllon da la ki jong ki kam bymman .
translation.en: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way : but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness .

translation.kha: hynñiew u la shuki tyndung ïa lade badno u leit sha ïng . nangta u khot sngewbha ïa ki phlangïap jong u sha ka ïeng jong u pynlang ong ïa ka tnga jong u ka Teresh ban wang ban ïadon ryngkat bad ki .
translation.en: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself : and when he came home , he sent and called for his friends , and Zeresh his wife .

translation.kha: U la ithuh beit sha ki synagog u la sdang ban ïalap ba U Jehu u long U Khun U Blei .
translation.en: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues , that he is the Son of God .

translation.kha: ïingshong ha ïasakma bad ha Israel bad nangta ha ka Joïada baroh bad napdeng ki Jentil , na la ïalap ba ki dei ïa-ban kylla-kaba-mut na ki pum jong ki badno ban phai sha U Blei bad leh ïa ki kiei ki ban pynpaw ba ki la khra-maw .
translation.en: But shewed first unto them of Damascus , and at Jerusalem , and throughout all the coasts of Judaea , and then to the Gentiles , that they should repent and turn to God , and do works meet for repentance .
Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not , nor unto any place of the river Jabbok , nor unto the cities in the mountains , nor unto whatsoever the  Lord  our God forbad us .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngim shym leit sha jan ka ri ki Ammon lane sha ki jaka harud ka Wah Jabbok lane sha ki shnong ha ri lum lane sha kano kano ka jaka sha kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la adong ïa ngi .
U Jisu u la jubab , Me long u nonghikai uba khraw ha Israel , bad mem tip ïa kane ?
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Art thou a master of Israel , and knowest not these things ?
And they that were vexed with unclean spirits : and they were healed .
translation.kha: ki la wan ban shahshkor ïa u bad ban ïoh jingkhiah na ki jingpang jong ki . Kito kiba la shah pynjynjar da ki mynsiem bymman ruh ki la wan bad la pynkhiah ïa ki .

translation.en: And could not find what they might do : for all the people were very attentive to hear him .
translation.kha: hynrei kim shym shem ka lad ban leh ïa kata , namar baroh ki briew ki la ïai shahshkor ïa u , kim kwah ban duh noh wat kawei ka kyntien .
Ki Rangbah jong u Dabid ki la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Nabal ha ka kyrteng u Dedan .
translation.en: And when David s young men came , they spake to Nabal according to all those words in the name of David , and ceased .

translation.kha: Baroh ki ki jong nga ki long kiba beit mala nga kren ïa ka jingshisha .
translation.en: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart : and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly .
And I will scatter you among the heathen , and will draw out a sword after you : and your land shall be desolate , and your cities waste .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhie da ka thma ban pynsakma ïa phi kylleng kylleng ki ri nongwei . Ka ri jong phi kan sah kynjah , bad ki shnong jong phi kin sah ha ka jingjot .
U trai u la phah ïa uwei pat u mraw , ki la pynïap ïa u ; bad ki la leh ïa kiwei pat kiba bun ha kajuh ka rukom , da kaba shohbeiñ ïa ki kattne katne ngut nabar pynïap ïa kiwei pat .
translation.en: And again he sent another  ; and him they killed , and many others  ; beating some , and killing some .
In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria , and from the fortified cities , and from the fortress even to the river , and from sea to sea , and from mountain to mountain .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong phi kin wan phai na kylleng — na Assyria kaba ha mihngi , na Ijipt ha ka phang shathie , na ki thain ka Ïuphratis , na ki duriaw ba sha jngai bad ki lumbah ba don sha jngai bah .
Wat la ki nongkit tiensyiem jong ki , ki la lah Nakon lehbha ha ki nongbah ka Jephthah , ka Soan bad ka Hanes ,
translation.en: For his princes were at Zoan , and his ambassadors came to Hanes .

translation.kha: Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi ; nga la wallam ïa phi na Ijipt ban long U Blei jong phi . Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: I am the  Lord  your God , which brought you out of the land of Egypt , to be your God : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Ko Syiem bakhlaiñbor , me ieit ïa kaei kaba daiñ ; me la pynskhem ïa ka jingbishar hok ha Israel ; me la wanrah ïa ka khot bad ka jinglehbor .
translation.en: The king s strength also loveth judgment  ; thou dost establish equity , thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob .

translation.kha: Lada jia ba ha kata ka ri ki kylla-kaba-mut bad ki duwai sha me , ki da phla haduh katai ki la long kiba pop bad kiba bymman , to sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong ki A Trai’ .
translation.en: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives , and repent , and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives , saying , We have sinned , and have done perversely , we have committed wickedness  ;

translation.kha: Ka bor jong U Trai ka la wan ha nga da ka baroh , bad katba U mynsngi jong u , u rah noh ïa nga , nga la sngewsarong bad sngewbitar .
translation.en: So the spirit lifted me up , and took me away , and I went in bitterness , in the heat of my spirit  ; but the hand of the  Lord  was strong upon me .

translation.kha: Ïa kawei pa kawei la pynïadait skhem malade kawei pat , ba wat ka lyer ruh kam lah ban rung hapdeng .
translation.en: One is so near to another , that no air can come between them .

translation.kha: ka la long ka jingkñia kaba riewdum jong U Khrist , uba la long khim u khunlangbrot uba khlem don jingthohbria lane jingdum .
translation.en: But with the precious blood of Christ , as of a lamb without blemish and without spot :

translation.kha: A Trai , Me ïada bad me pynim ïa at , ka jingïarap jngai me ka la pynkhreh ïa nga .
translation.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation : and thy gentleness hath made me great .

translation.kha: Ki jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah , bad u syiem u phah ïa ki ha ki ar tylliat ki kali ïamap lem bad ki jingbthah ban leit bad wad jingtip ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ka kynhun shipai Syria .
translation.en: They took therefore two chariot horses  ; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians , saying , Go and see .

Then the king of Israel gathered the prophets together , about four hundred men , and said unto them , Shall I go against Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And they said , Go up  ; for the Lord shall deliver it into the hand of the king .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ahab u khot ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kumba sawspah ngut na ki , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Hato ngan leit ne em ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ?   Tur ïaleh ïa ka ,  ki jubab ,  U  Trai  un ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop .
Ban pynsuk : Wat ai ba ine uno un buh jingeh shuh ïa ang , namar ki dak ti kiba na don ha ka met jong nga ki pyn-at ba nga long u mraw jong U Jisu .
translation.en: From henceforth let no man trouble me : for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus .

And they cast dust on their heads , and cried , weeping and wailing , saying , Alas , alas , that great city , wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness ! for in one hour is she made desolate .
translation.kha: Ki la kynting pui pui halor ki khlieh jong ki , ki la lynñiar bad ki la ïambriew , da kaba ong ,  Katno kaba shyrkhei ! Katno kaba itriem ïa ka nongbah kaba khraw ! Ka long ka nongbah ha kaba baroh kiba don ki liengbah kiba ïaid ha ki duriaw ki la kylla riewspah ha ka spah jong ka ! Bad ha ka shi kynta ka la duh lut ïa kiei kiei baroh !

Hato dei u Joah uba la ai buit ïa pha ha kane baroh ? u la Kylli ïa ka . Ka ïajubab , ?(Nga shym da kata baroh kambah kyntang , ko Syiem kyndon , ba ym don kano Kanaan ka lad ban kiar na kaba jubab ïa ka jingïatylli jong phi . Ka dei kaba shisha ba u Shobab , u rangbah pynïaidkam Jong phi kiba la bthah ïa nga ïa kaei ngan ni bad ïa kaei ngan kren .
translation.en: And the king said , Is not the hand of Joab with thee in all this ? And the woman answered and said , As thy soul liveth , my lord the king , none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king hath spoken : for thy servant Joab , he bade me , and he put all these words in the mouth of thine handmaid :

translation.kha: Haba dat ka kada ka la ïohi ïa u angel ba u ïeng hangta ba u da bat ïa ka waitlam , ka phet nep na suk bad ka la phai sha ki lyngkha . U Balaam u sympat ïa kata ka kada bad u wan ïalam pat ïa ka sha surok .
translation.en: And the ass saw the angel of the  Lord  standing in the way , and his sword drawn in his hand : and the ass turned aside out of the way , and went into the field : and Balaam smote the ass , to turn her into the way .
At that time shall it be said to this people and to Jerusalem , A dry wind of the high places in the wilderness toward the daughter of my people , not to fan , nor to cleanse ,
translation.kha: Ka por ka wan ha kaba ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem yn ïathuh ba ka lyer khluit ka beh shapoh sha ki na ka ri shyiap . Kan ym long ka lyer kaba jai jai kaba shu beh pynher noh ïa u stait —

translation.en: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ , who in presence am base among you , but being absent am bold toward you :
translation.kha: Nga u Paul , nga pynlong ka jingkyrpad ïa phi — ïa nga ïa kaba la ong ba nga long uba jemnud bad jai jai haba nga don bad phi , hynrei uba eh haba nga don jngai na phi .

translation.en: Beloved , believe not every spirit , but try the spirits whether they are of God : because many false prophets are gone out into the world .
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , wat ngeit ïa baroh kiba kam ba ki don U Mynsiem , hynrei , to phin da tynjuh ïa ki ban shem lada u mynsiem ba ki don u wan ne em na U Blei . Naba shibun ki nongïathuhlypa balamler ki la leit kylleng sawdong .

Ïathuh ïa kine ki bri ba ki dei ban Kohnguh ïa baroh ki hukum jong nga . Kim dei ïa-ban kit kano Kanah ka jingkit shapoh lyngba ki khyrdop lad kaei ka nongbah ha ka Sabbaton . Ki dei ban rakhe ïa ka Sabbaton kum ka sngi Bakyntang bad kim dien ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if ye diligently hearken unto me , saith the  Lord  , to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day , but hallow the sabbath day , to do no work therein  ;
And Jesus said unto the centurion ,  Go thy way  ; and as thou hast believed , so be it done unto thee .  And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Khie leit noh sha ïing , bad ïa kaei kaba me ngeit yn sa leh na ka bynta me .  Bad ïa u shakri jong u rangbah pynïaidkam la pynkhiah ha kata hi ka khyllipmat .

Kine ki Lebi ki tei patar ïa kiba bun ki bynta kiba bud jong ka kynroh : U Rehum u khwan jong u Bnai u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud ; U Hashabaïah , u nongsynshar ïa rynghang jong ka Keilah distrik , u tei ïa ka bniat kaba bud na ka bniat ka lap jong u ;
translation.en: After him repaired the Levites , Rehum the son of Bani . Next unto him repaired Hashabiah , the ruler of the half part of Keilah , in his part .
Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart : so doth the sweetness of a man s friend by hearty counsel .
translation.kha: Ki umphniang sleh bad ba-iwbih ki pynlong ïa phi ban sngewkmen , hynrei ka jingjynjar ka pynkulmar ïa ka jingsuk jingmut jong phi .

Ha sngap , ka por kan poi ha kaba ngan pynïap lut ïa ki samla shynrang baïar kiba na ka long-briew jong me bad na ka kur jong me , kumta ba yn ym don uwei ruh u brai u ban im tymmen ha ka ïit jong me .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , that I will cut off thine arm , and the arm of thy father s house , that there shall not be an old man in thine house .

translation.kha: uwei ha kawei ka tduh badno iwei ha khwai pat ka tduh jongngi ka jingtap , malu pynlong ïa ki ba kin i kumba ki ïadait nur-um badno kata ka jingtap .
translation.en: And make one cherub on the one end , and the other cherub on the other end : even of the mercy seat shall ye make the cherubims on the two ends thereof .
Thy father made our yoke grievous : now therefore make thou the grievous service of thy father , and his heavy yoke which he put upon us , lighter , and we will serve thee .
translation.kha: U Solomon u kpa jong phi u la banbeiñ ïa ngi bad u buh ki jingkit kiba khia ha ngi . Lada phi pynsting ïa kine ki jingkit bad pynsuk jingim ïa ngi , ngin long ki shakri bashaniah jong phi .

Ha Jerusalem , u Jehoshaphat u thung ïa ki Lebi , ki lyngdoh bad katto katei ki riewkhmat ka shnong kum ki nongrahbor ha ki kai ba ïadei bad ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum U Trai lane ki jingiashah ba dei ïa ka aiñ hapdeng ki nongshong shnongrit jong ka nongbah .
translation.en: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites , and of the priests , and of the chief of the fathers of Israel , for the judgment of the  Lord  , and for controversies , when they returned to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Haba ki la dep na kaba rkhiebeiñ ïa u , ki la law nala ïa ka jaiñkup bashapoh bad ki la pynkup pat halor Jong u da ki jaiñ jong u hi . Nangta ki ïalam noh ïa u ban sahnarphna .
translation.en: And when they had mocked him , they took off the purple from him , and put his own clothes on him , and led him out to crucify him .

translation.kha: Katba u dang kren , u lym uba tyngshaiñ u la wan halor jrong ki , pynlang ka sur na u lyoh ka la ong , uno u un-long U Khun uba ieit jong nga , ha uba nga sngewbiang eh — to shahshkor ïa u !
translation.en: While he yet spake , behold , a bright cloud overshadowed them : and behold a voice out of the cloud , which said , This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased  ; hear ye him .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki ïambriew ïa u laiphew snoh hangno ha ri them Moab .
translation.en: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days : so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended .

translation.kha: Hib ithuh u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u ïohsngew ïa kata , u ong , Utai u dei u nongïathuhlypa umbiah la lyndet ïa ka hukum U Terah . Bun kumta U Trai u phah ïa u sing uba la patar bad pynïap ïa u , kumba U Trai u la kren ha u .
translation.en: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof , he said , It is the man of God , who was disobedient unto the word of the  Lord  : therefore the  Lord  hath delivered him unto the lion , which hath torn him , and slain him , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake unto him .

translation.kha: Nangta , ki la shaphrang ïa u bad ki la ïabynta ïa ki jaiñ jong u hapdeng jong ki , da kaba ïaring symbai ban khmih mano baneh ïoh ïa kano ka bynta jong ka jaiñ .
translation.en: And when they had crucified him , they parted his garments , casting lots upon them , what every man should take .
And they gave them drink in vessels of gold , ( the vessels being diverse one from another , ) and royal wine in abundance , according to the state of the king .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingdih la sam ha ki khuri ksiar , kiba ïapher dur kawei na kawei pat , bad u syiem u la ai pahuh ïa ka waiñ jong u .
Lada phi pynshitom ïa la ki khun , kino ieit ïa ki . Eliada phi ieit ïa ki , phin sneng pynbeit ïa ki .
translation.en: He that spareth his rod hateth his son : but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes .

translation.kha: Pynban , u Jiw bashisha u dei u briew kiba dei u ïew ha kaba shapoh , kata , uba ïa ka dohnud jong u la ot , bad ken ka dadien ka jingtrei Jong U Mynsiem jong U Blang , ym jong ka Hukum ba la thuh . Kum uta u briew u ïoh ïa la ka jingïaroh na U Blei , ym na u briew .
translation.en: But he is a Jew , which is one inwardly ; and circumcision is that of the heart , in the spirit , and not in the letter ; whose praise is not of men , but of God .

translation.kha: Nangta thep ioh ka synduk ïa ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kiba ngan ai ha me , ha kiba la thoh ïa ki hukum jong nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee .

translation.kha: haba la ktah jreiñ sa shisien , U Jisu u la loit sha ka jingtep , ka erlangthari ka krem ba la khan da u mawkyntang .
translation.en: Jesus therefore again groaning in himself cometh to the grave . It was a cave , and a stone lay upon it .

translation.kha: U Herod u bitar shikatdei eh ïa briew jrong ka Tyros bad sawdong , kumta ki la leit shi kynhun ban ïakynduh ïa u . ïongjngum ki la pynngeit ïa u balaitluid , u briew uba dei khmih ïa ka ïingshong , ba u dei ban ïarap ïa ki . Nangta ki la leit sha u Hahiroth pynlang pan ban ïasuk bad u , namar ka ri ka jongki ki ka ïoh ïa ki jingbam na ka ri ka jong u syiem .
translation.en: And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon : but they came with one accord to him , and , having made Blastus the king s chamberlain their friend , desired peace  ; because their country was nourished by the king s country .
And in their mouth was found no guile : for they are without fault before the throne of God .
translation.kha: Ym ju lap ïa ki ba ki ïathuh lamler ; ki long kiba khlem thohbria .
Balei me long kumno u briew uba la shah rim kynsan , kum u shiphew u bymdonbor ban ïarap ? Da shisha , A Troas , me long bad ngi ! ngi long ki briew jong me ; wat iehnoh ïa me .’
translation.en: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonished , as a mighty man that cannot save ? yet thou , O  Lord  , art in the midst of us , and we are called by thy name  ; leave us not .

translation.kha: Mynmiet nga thrang ïa me da ka dohnud jrong nga baroh ; long me bishar ïa ka Pyrthei mala ki briew jong ka , baroh kin tip kaei ka un-long ka jingbishar hok .
translation.en: With my soul have I desired thee in the night  ; yea , with my spirit within me will I seek thee early : for when thy judgments are in the earth , the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness .

translation.kha: Katno ka long kaba kordit ïa ki ! Ki la Bud ha ka lynti kaba u Kain u la ïaid . Na ka bynta ka tyngka , ki la aiti ïa lade sha ka jingbha kaban u Balaam u la leh . Ki la ïaleh pyrshah kumba u Korah u la ïaleh pynshah , bad khim ma u , la pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: Woe unto them ! for they have gone in the way of Cain , and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward , and perished in the gainsaying of Core .

translation.kha: ba haba ngi la long kiba ïap ha ka jinglong ba kynoi mynsiem ha ka jingbymkohnguh jong ngi u la wallam ïa ngi shwa ka jingim lem bad U Khrist . Ka dei da ka jingïamai U Blei ba la pynim ïa phi .
translation.en: Even when we were dead in sins , hath quickened us together with Christ , ( by grace ye are saved ; )
And the king said unto him , Why speakest thou any more of thy matters ? I have said , Thou and Ziba divide the land .
translation.kha: U syiem u jubab ,  Mem donkam ban ong ei ei shuh shuh . Nga la rai ba ma me bad u Siba men ïabynta ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u Saul .
Ka long kaba shisha , u Akhan u jop , nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , bad kane ka long kaei ba nga la bor .
translation.en: And Achan answered Joshua , and said , Indeed I have sinned against the  Lord  God of Israel , and thus and thus have I done :

translation.kha: Hynrei to la kulai ha phi ïa said ka ri kaba thum da ka dud malu ka ngap kum ka jingïohkynti jongki phi! , bad ngan ai ïa ka ha ph . “Nga long U Trai U Blei jong Phi , bad nga la pynpyngngad ïa phi na kiwei pat ki jingpyniwbih .
translation.en: But I have said unto you , Ye shall inherit their land , and I will give it unto you to possess it , a land that floweth with milk and honey : I am the  Lord  your God , which have separated you from other people .

translation.kha: Kumta u Paul u la sah” hangta shisnem shiteng , u da hikai ha ki ïa ka ktien jong U Blei .
translation.en: And he continued there a year and six months , teaching the word of God among them .

translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u la kylla hynriewspah bha , bad uwei pa eiei u bhor ïa u . U khong ki kamra kynshew ba la shna na ka bynta ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawkordor , ki musla , ki stieh , bad kiwei ki tiar remdor jong u .
translation.en: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour : and he made himself treasuries for silver , and for gold , and for precious stones , and for spices , and for shields , and for all manner of pleasant jewels  ;

translation.kha: Pynkup , ngi daym ban thoh ka shithi da kaba ong ïa ki shun ym bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam ka bymkhuid kat kumin ka jinglehniam namarba ba la kñia ïa ka ha ki bleithaw ; ban kynthih na ka jingaibor ; bad ban ym bam ïa kano katno ka mrad kaba la khyrwait , lane bam ïa kano kano ka snam .
translation.en: But that we write unto them , that they abstain from pollutions of idols , and from fornication , and from things strangled , and from blood .

translation.kha: U Blei um daym uba bishar bymhok . Un ym klet ïa ka kim katba phi la leh lane ïa ka jingtied kaba phi la pynpaw na ka bynta jong u da ka jingïarap kaba Phi la ai bad dang ïaw ïarap ïa ki parabangeit .
translation.en: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love , which ye have shewed toward his name , in that ye have ministered to the saints , and do minister .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duna ka jingtip ki ïoh ïa kaei kaba ka jingsait Jong ki ka dei ban ïoh , hynrei ha kba sian la Ainong da ka jingtip .
translation.en: The simple inherit folly : but the prudent are crowned with knowledge .

translation.kha: Kumta u Samuel u leit phai rynsied badno u , bad u Saul u la mane ïa U Trai .
translation.en: So Samuel turned again after Saul  ; and Saul worshipped the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la ong , la don shisien ar ngut ki kynthei kiba shi para .
translation.en: Son of man , there were two women , the daughters of one mother :
And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle , the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys :
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki kynriah jaka tang lada uta u lyoh u kiew shajrong na kata ka Ïingjaiñ .
Pyntyllun noh ïa u mawkhang ! U Jisu u la hukum . Ka Matthat , ka hynmen uta uba la ïa-ïap , ka la jaboh , Kan sa don ka jingsma iwtung , ko thri . La lah tep ïa u la saw sngi .
translation.en: Jesus said ,  Take ye away the stone .  Martha , the sister of him that was dead , saith unto him , Lord , by this time he stinketh : for he hath been dead four days .

translation.kha: Shisien na kane ka nongbah Heshbon Ka kynhun ïapom jong u Sihon ka mih kum ka ding ; Ka da pynjot ïa ka nongbah Ar ha Moab Bad ka bam duh ïa ki lum ka Arnon bashaneng .
translation.en: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon , a flame from the city of Sihon : it hath consumed Ar of Moab , and the lords of the high places of Arnon .
For my thoughts are not your thoughts , neither are your ways my ways , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki jingmut jong nga ,  ong U  Trai  ,  kim long kum ki jong phi , bad ki lynti jong nga ki ïapher na ki jong phi .

Ym don kano ïano kawei pat ka jaitbynriew kaba kylla ïa la ki blei , dak la kim dei kiba shisha . Jamynrei ki briew jong nga ki la brup ïa nga , U Blei! uba la wanrah ha ki ka jingpyndonburom , da ki blei ki me lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki .
translation.en: Hath a nation changed their gods , which are yet no gods ? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , to leit bad pynsamthiah ïa ki nongshun jong phi ! Ngan pynlong ïa phi kiba khlieh kum u masi kyrtong uba don ki reng nar nabar ki kjat rnong . Phin pynlwait ïa ki jaitbynriew ba bhor , dara ïa ka spah kambah ki la ïoh da ka jingleit jubor phin ai sngewbha ïa nga , U Trai lad ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translation.en: Arise and thresh , O daughter of Zion : for I will make thine horn iron , and I will make thy hoofs brass : and thou shalt beat in pieces many people : and I will consecrate their gain unto the  Lord  , and their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth .

translation.kha: U Trai un iehnoh ïa ki Israel namar ba u Jeroboam u la leh pop bad u la ïalum ïa ki paid Israel ïa-ban leh pop .
translation.en: And he shall give Israel up because of the sins of Jeroboam , who did sin , and who made Israel to sin .
Then Jonah prayed unto the  Lord  his God out of the fish s belly ,
translation.kha: Na ka jingjylliew hapoh u dohkha u Jonah u la duwai sha U  Trai  U Blei jong u :
U Trai u wanpaw ha u Solomon mynleh . U ong ha u , Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong me , bad nga la pdiang ïa kane ka Templ kum ka jaka ha kaba yn ai ïa ki jingkñia ha nga .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared to Solomon by night , and said unto him , I have heard thy prayer , and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice .

translation.kha: Ka sorkar kaba hok kaba lah Ban pynkmen ïa phi shym shim .—Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 .
translation.en: A righteous government that can benefit you personally . —Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 .

translation.kha: Kaba ngim ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki briew hynrei pyrsad ïa ki ber bymman ba kynja mynsiem ha ka pyrthei ba kynja pdeng , ki nongsynshar , ki bor synlar , bun ki bor pyrthei jong kane ka juk ba-dum .
translation.en: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood , but against principalities , against powers , against the rulers of the darkness of this world , against spiritual wickedness in high places .

translation.kha: bad kumta pajut katto katne ngut ki kynteit kiba la ïohkhiah na ki mynsiem bymman bad ki jingpang : Ka Mareh ( kaba la khot , ka nong Magdala ) , na ka ba la beh noh ïa ki hynñiew ki kshaid ;
translation.en: And certain women , which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities , Mary called Magdalene , out of whom went seven devils ,

translation.kha: Nangta ki ïa-pyrkhat , Ka Jingkhawai Niam kaba shisien shisnem ha U Trai ha Shiloh shen ka la wan poi . ( Ka Shiloh ka don shatei na Bethel , shait na lawbah , malu sha mihngi na ka lynti bah hapdeng ka Bethel bad ka Hakkherem . )
translation.en: Then they said , Behold , there is a feast of the  Lord  in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth–el , on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth–el to Shechem , and on the south of Lebonah .

translation.kha: Baroh ki hangta kiba ïalumlang ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem kin long kumin u briew uba ïap-tyrsaw uba pynnoh ba u bam jingbah bad u kyndit na ka jingïohthiah hapdeng ka jingthngan , lane kum u biria u ban sa ïap na ka jingsliang uba phohsniew ba u dih um bad u kyndit na ka jingïathoh ryngkat bad u pdot ba-tyrkhong .
translation.en: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth , and , behold , he eateth  ; but he awaketh , and his soul is empty : or as when a thirsty man dreameth , and , behold , he drinketh  ; but he awaketh , and , behold , he is faint , and his soul hath appetite : so shall the multitude of all the nations be , that fight against mount Zion .
So also is the resurrection of the dead . It is sown in corruption ; it is raised in incorruption :
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno kan jia haba ïa kiba ïap la pynmihpat . Haba ïa ka met la tep , ka long kaba ïap ; haba la pynmihpat , ka long ka bymïap shuh .
Ïa ki jaijai uba seisoh jong ka Judah la pynnep da ki kali ïalap ; ki shiphang halor ki kulai ki da ïeng ha khmat ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots , and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate .
And when he was come out of the ship , immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit ,
translation.kha: Tang shu hiar na ka lieng , U Jisu u la ïakynduh ïa u briew uba wan mih na ki krem jingtep kiba don hangta . Une u briew u don ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid hapoh jong u bad u shong u sah ha ki jaka tep briew .
Ang pynpaw bieit ïa ki nongpeit kti bad pynkulmar ïa ki jingthoh lypa ki nongbatai pan . Ki ktien jongno babha stad nga kyntait mala pyn-i ba ka jingwad jong ki ka long ka jingbieit .
translation.en: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars , and maketh diviners mad  ; that turneth wise men backward , and maketh their knowledge foolish  ;

translation.kha: Kim donkam ngab leit , la jubab U Jisu . Ma phi hi to ai ei ei ha ki ban bam !
translation.en: But Jesus said unto them ,  They need not depart  ; give ye them to eat .
But our God is in the heavens : he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased .
translation.kha: U Blei jong ngi u don ha bneng ; u leh ïa kano kano kaba u mon .
Ynda u Nob u la pyngngad , pynlang u la tip aïu u khun khatduh jong u , u la leh ïa u ,
translation.en: And Noah awoke from his wine , and knew what his younger son had done unto him .
And thou say in thine heart , My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth .
translation.kha: Husiar ïoh phi ong ha lade , ‘ Ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga hi ki la pynriewspah katne ïa nga .’
Hynrei kam long kaei kaba phi la nang shaphang U Khrist !
translation.en: But ye have not so learned Christ !
Be ye therefore followers of God , as dear children ;
translation.kha: Te phi kumta long ki nongbud jong u Trai , namar phi long ki khun kiba ieit eh jong U Blei ,
Ka Baibl ka ong : “U Blei u la iohi ia Kiei Kiei baroh ba u la thaw , ha khmih mad , ka la bha eh .”
translation.en: The Bible states : “God saw everything he had made and , look ! it was very good .”

translation.kha: Kumta sumar pun kohnguh bad leh ïa kaei khie baroh kaba la thoh ha ka kino ka Aiu u Moses .
translation.en: Be ye therefore very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses , that ye turn not aside therefrom to the right hand or to the left  ;
Then Rab–shakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Jews  language , and spake , saying , Hear the word of the great king , the king of Assyria :
translation.kha: Nangta u rangbah synshar u ïeng joit bad u pyrta ha ka ktien Hebru ,  Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba u patsha ka Assyria u ong ïa phi !

translation.en: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard , when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people .
translation.kha: U Mikaïah u la ong ïa ki ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u la ïohsngew ba u Barukh u la pule ha ki paidbah .

U la sping ïa u sum , u la buhnud ïa uta u shynriah bad kata ka kynthei shapoh ïingjaiñ , bad u dung ïap da u sum ïa ki barhem ar ngut . Da kumne la pynjngai ïa ka jingïapthem kaba la pynjot ïa ki Israel ,
translation.en: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent , and thrust both of them through , the man of Israel , and the woman through her belly . So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel .

translation.kha: U Jobab u la kaei dang step phrangsngi , u smat ïa ithuh u maw ïa umbiah u la syngkhlieh , bad u thung ïa u ïa-ban sah jingkynmaw . Hangta u tah ïa ka umphniang Olib halor jong u ban pynkyntang ïa u sha U Blei .
translation.en: And Jacob rose up early in the morning , and took the stone that he had put for his pillows , and set it up for a pillar , and poured oil upon the top of it .

translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ka met jong nga da ki shyieng , bad ki thied bad me la tap ïa ki shyieng da ki ksah bad ka sniehdoh .
translation.en: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh , and hast fenced me with bones and sinews .

translation.kha: Kane ka daiñ ka jingïathuh ba ki la phah sha u patsha :
translation.en: The copy of the letter that Tatnai , governor on this side the river , and Shethar–bozenai , and his companions the Apharsachites , which were on this side the river , sent unto Darius the king :

translation.kha: Hynrei lada Kane kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka shem kam pyndem ha ka jingsynshar jong u , te lang! pynshitom ïa kata ka jingïambriew da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad da ka jingpang tad haduh ba ngan da shah ïa u Nebukhadnessar ban pynjot khiat ïa ka .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon , that nation will I punish , saith the  Lord  , with the sword , and with the famine , and with the pestilence , until I have consumed them by his hand .

translation.kha: Uno uno ne utai uei uba ktah ïa ka doh jong uta u jingkñia un mynsaw da ka bor jong ka jingkhuid jong ka . Lada kan kano ka bynta jong jaiñkup ka bit snam na uta u jingkñia , daiñ ban sait ïa ka ha ka jaka bakyllut .
translation.en: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy : and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment , thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kaei kambah nga la ong ha phi : ‘ U khra-maw um long khem khraw ba ïa la u kynrad .’ Lada ki pynshitom ïa de , kin pynshitom ïa phi ruh ; lama ki la kohnguh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , kin nongshong ïa ka jong phi ruh .
translation.en: Remember the word that I said unto you , The servant is not greater than his lord . If they have persecuted me , they will also persecute you  ; if they have kept my saying , they will keep yours also .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u ong ba un phah shabi ïa kane ka jingtim , bad kan rung Shobab ka ïing jong uwei pa iwei u nongtuh bad sha ka ïing jong uwei pa uwei uba ïathuh lamler hapoh ka jingsmai . ka ïaineh ha ki ïing jong ki bad ieh ïa ki ha ka jingud .
translation.en: I will bring it forth , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and it shall enter into the house of the thief , and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name : and it shall remain in the midst of his house , and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof .

translation.kha: Baroh na phi , phi long ka met U Khrist , bun wai pa uwei u Long u bynta jong ka .
translation.en: Now ye are the body of Christ , and members in particular .

translation.kha: jynreiñ haba U Messaïah un wan , ym Don ba tip na-ei ba u wan . Doeg baroh im’ tip nangno une u briew u waiñ .
translation.en: Howbeit we know this man whence he is : but when Christ cometh , no man knoweth whence he is .
Then they cried unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he saved them out of their distresses .
translation.kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pynim ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .
Hynrei ki briew kiba sniew kim long kumne da lei lei ; ki long khem u phlangïap uba ka lyer ka tbeh noh .
translation.en: The ungodly are not so : but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away .

translation.kha: U la ïohi na jngai ïa u dieng Dumbur ba la tap da ki sla , kumta u la kitei ban peit la u lah ban shem ki soh ha u . Hynrei haba u la wan sha uta u diengthang , u la Shim tang ki sla , Naamah kam pat dei ka por ban mih soh .
translation.en: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves , he came , if haply he might find any thing thereon : and when he came to it , he found nothing but leaves  ; for the time of figs was not yet .

translation.kha: Khie ïashitom na kato ka lieng dara la ka tnga , ki khun shynrang Jong me lem bad ki tnga jong ki .
translation.en: Go forth of the ark , thou , and thy wife , and thy sons , and thy sons  wives with thee .

translation.kha: bun hajar ki ïasoh pur ha ka jingtap ontep , bad wat ka khyndew ka tap suki jai halor ka set jongu u .
translation.en: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him , and every man shall draw after him , as there are innumerable before him .
And Moses brought out all the rods from before the  Lord  unto all the children of Israel : and they looked , and took every man his rod .
translation.kha: U Moses u la shim ïa kita ki diengduh baroh bad u la pyn-i ïa ki ha ki Israel . Ki la ïohi ïa kaba la jia , bad uwei pa uwei u nongïalam u la shim noh ïa la u jong u diengduh .

ianga haba Ngan pynpaw ha ki jaitbynriew ïa ka jingkhuid ka kylleng bakhraw jong nga — ka kyrteng ïa kaba phin la pynjahburom sohpdung jong ki — te kin sa ïatip ba nga long U Trai . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , ang la kren . nur pyndonkam ïa phira ban pyn-i ha ki jaitbynriew ba nga long uba khum .
translation.en: And I will sanctify my great name , which was profaned among the heathen , which ye have profaned in the midst of them  ; and the heathen shall know that I am the  Lord  , saith the Lord  God  , when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes .
And he said unto him , Why art thou , being the king s son , lean from day to day ? wilt thou not tell me ? And Amnon said unto him , I love Tamar , my brother Absalom s sister .
translation.kha: U Jonadab u ong ha u Amnon ,  Phi dei u khun jong u syiem ; pynban na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat nga ïohi ba phi i sngewsih . Jia aïu ?   Nga ibha ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u Absalom , uba ïalong shi para bad nga na ijuh i pa ,  u la jubab .
Hynrei ki paidbah ki sdang ïeng hi sha jngai , bad tang u Moses uba la leit sha jan u lyoh uba rben ha uba U Blei u ba-don .
translation.en: And the people stood afar off , and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was .

translation.kha: Ki jait Manasseh kim shem la beh noh ïa ki briew bakha shong basah ha Betah Shan , Taanakh , Dor , Ibleam , Megiddo bad ha ki nongrit kiba hajan ; ki Kanaan ki dang shong hangta .
translation.en: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Beth–shean and her towns , nor Taanach and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns , nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns : but the Canaanites would dwell in that land .

translation.kha: Ngi thoh sha phi tang ïa kaba phi lah ban pule bad sngewthuh . Hynrei kam lada phi sngewthuh ïa ngi mynta thiang katto katei , per kyrmen ba phin poi sha kata ka jingsngewieit kaba pura , haneng ba ha ka Sngi jong U Jisu babha U Trai jong ngi phin ïoh sngewmong ïa ngi kitab ngi sngewsarong ïa phi .
translation.en: As also ye have acknowledged us in part , that we are your rejoicing , even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus .
And the angel answered and said unto me , These are the four spirits of the heavens , which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth .
translation.kha: U la jubab ,  Kine ki long ki sawlyer , ki dang shu lah wan na ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Trai ka pyrthei baroh .
Ki khyrdop hapoh ka wah ki bthei ; ïa ka ïingsyiem la pyndap da ka jingsngewtriem .
translation.en: The gates of the rivers shall be opened , and the palace shall be dissolved .

translation.kha: Haba u Ïoannis u la ïohi ïa shibun ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi kiba la woh sha u ban shait pynbaptis , u la ong ha ki , Phi ki bseiñ — uei wahbah la iathuh ha phi ba phi lah ban lait na ka jingpynshitom kaba U Blei un sa phah ?
translation.en: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism , he said unto them , O generation of vipers , who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come ?

translation.kha: ibha ka jingtipbriew jong nga ka la wan phai , ïa ka burom jong nga , ka jinglong syiem jong nga , bad ka burom jong ka hima jong nga la ai pateng ha nga . Ki rangbah nongsynshar jong nga bad ki rangbah donburom jong nga ki la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga , bad la ai pat ha nga ïa ka bor ba kyntu Syiem , bad wat ka jingpyndonburom kaba kham khriat shun ïa kaba mynshuwa .
translation.en: At the same time my reason returned unto me  ; and for the glory of my kingdom , mine honour and brightness returned unto me  ; and my counsellors and my lords sought unto me  ; and I was established in my kingdom , and excellent majesty was added unto me .

translation.kha: Shano ñiut na ki , ki la un-long kaba bieit , bad san ngut kiwei pat ki la long Ibbah sngewstad .
translation.en: And five of them were wise , and five were foolish .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa imat pa uwei u nongshun ha ka jaka bashrah ha kaba ki la bah ïa ki . Nangta ki la leit phai pat shaw Ai bad ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei Uba don hangta .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field , in the wilderness wherein they chased them , and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword , until they were consumed , that all the Israelites returned unto Ai , and smote it with the edge of the sword .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Buh biah ïa u diengduh jong u Aaron ha khat ka Synduk ka jutang . dat ban buh ïa u kum ka jingbymman ïa ki Jeriel kiba ïaleh pyrshah ba kin ïap lypa ki sangeh noh ïa ki jingkren khñiang jong ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Bring Aaron s rod again before the testimony , to be kept for a token against the rebels  ; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me , that they die not .

translation.kha: U nongshim , uba ha ka nyngkong u la kitei ban ïakynduh ïa U Jisu mynmiet , u la wait ryngkat bad u Joseph , u da rah malade u kumba laiphew kila ki musla , ka jingthohlieh lang jong ka mirr bad ka alos .
translation.en: And there came also Nicodemus , which at the first came to Jesus by night , and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes , about an hundred pound weight .

translation.kha: bad ha ka por kaba biang u la pynpaw ïa ka ha ka kyrhuh lad u . Ïa kane la pynkhamti ha nga , bad la pynbha ïa ka da ka hukum U Blei U Nongpynim jong ngi .
translation.en: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching , which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour ;
Only be sure that thou eat not the blood : for the blood is the life  ; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh .
translation.kha: Tangba wat bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka , namar ka jingim ka don ha ka snam , bad phim dei ban bam ïa kata ka jingim lem bad ka doh .
Naba u mluh uba la khot da U Trai u long uba ïalade na ka bynta U TRAI’ ; kumjuh ruh u briew uba laitluid ïa uba la khot da U Khrist u longïng u mraw jngai U .
translation.en: For he that is called in the Lord , being a servant , is the Lord s freeman : likewise also he that is called , being free , is Christ s servant .
Or what man is there of you , whom if his son ask bread , will he give him a stone ?
translation.kha: Hato uno uno na phi uba long u kpa un ai ïa la u khun da u maw haba u pan ïa u kpu ?

translation.en: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight : but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do .
translation.kha: Ym don kaei kaei ïa kaba lah ban buhrieh na U Blei ; ïa kiei kiei kiba don ha ki jingthaw baroh la pynpaw bad pyn-i shynna ha ki khmat jong u . Bad ka dei sha u ba ngi dei ban ai jingkheiñ ïa lade .
Nga la ïeng hapdeng jong phiah bad U Trai ha sakma ka por ban ïathuh ha phi aïu u ong , nabar ba Phi sheptieng ïa kata ka ding bad kino shym leit kdew sha uta u lbong . U Trai u la ong ,
translation.en: ( I stood between the  Lord  and you at that time , to shew you the word of the  Lord  : for ye were afraid by reason of the fire , and went not up into the mount  ; ) saying ,
And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and they fell upon their faces : and the glory of the  Lord  appeared unto them .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki kynriah noh na uta u paidbah bad ki la ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ . Ki dem khrup ha khyndew , bad ka jingshai kaba tyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ka la paw ha ki .

Baroh kiba kwah kumta , kynthei bad shynrang , ki ïawan rah ïa ki jingïapyndait ba la ïai-ong , ki sohshkor , ki sati , ki kpieng , dara ki jingdeng ksah katba har rukom , sad ki pynkyntang ïa ki shwa U Trai .
translation.en: And they came , both men and women , as many as were willing hearted , and brought bracelets , and earrings , and rings , and tablets , all jewels of gold : and every man that offered offered an offering of gold unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hadien “kata u la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha Elhanan kaba ha ri Sebulun .
translation.en: And Elon the Zebulunite died , and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun .

translation.kha: Ka jingim Jong u mynta ka pdang ban leit noh shuh ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
translation.en: Yea , his soul draweth near unto the grave , and his life to the destroyers .
An horse is a vain thing for safety : neither shall he deliver any by his great strength .
translation.kha: Ki kulai thma kim lah ban ai jingjop ; ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki kam lah ban pyllait im .

translation.en: And Terah lived seventy years , and begat Abram , Nahor , and Haran .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Terah u la dap hynñiewphew snem ka rta , u la long u kpa jong u Abram , u Nahor , bad u Haran .
La jia aïu ïa ka jingkyrshan jong me ïa u Dabid , u paralok jongki me ? u Absalom u la kylli ïa u . Balei meng leit ryngkat bad u ?
translation.en: And Absalom said to Hushai , Is this thy kindness to thy friend ? why wentest thou not with thy friend ?
And he took and put the testimony into the ark , and set the staves on the ark , and put the mercy seat above upon the ark :
translation.kha: Nangta u shim ïa kita ki mawlyngkniap ar tylli bad u buh ïa ki hapoh ka Synduk ka Jutang . U bsuh ïa ki dieng jingbah ha ki kyrwoh jong kata ka synduk bad u buh ïa ka jingtap halor jong ka .
To phin pynrit ïa lade , jingkam , haw ka kti badonbor U Blei , khnang ba un ïoh kyntiew ïa phi! shajrong ha ka por katba biang jong u hi .
translation.en: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God , that he may exalt you in due time :

translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa ki biria jong u bad u la bah nadien ïa u jaboh kumba hynñiew sngur haduh ba un da lap ïa u ha ka ri lum Gilead .
translation.en: And he took his brethren with him , and pursued after him seven days  journey  ; and they overtook him in the mount Gilead .
Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts : half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath , to make him king  ; and half followed Omri .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Israel ki ïa-pait : don napdeng jong ki kiba kwah ban pynlong syiem ïa u Tibni u khun jong u Ginath , bad kiwei pat ki kwah ïa u Omri .

translation.en: This shall they have for their pride , because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kumno ki briew jong ka Moab bad ka Ammon kin shah pynshitom na ka bynta ka jingsarong bad jingmeng jong ki bad na ka bynta ka jingkrenbeiñ ïa ki briew jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .
Ka Edom ka la ïalade na ka Judah narud kata ka prie . Ha kane kajuh ka por , ka nongbah Libnah ruh ka la ïeng ïakhleh pyrsad , namar u Horem u la iehnoh ïa U Trai , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong u .
translation.en: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day . The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand  ; because he had forsaken the  Lord  God of his fathers .

translation.kha: ( Hynrei u pharia un hap ha ki khlaw , bad ïa ka nongbah yn pynjot . )
translation.en: When it shall hail , coming down on the forest  ; and the city shall be low in a low place .

translation.kha: phin pynlong ïa ki jingthmu bymlarkam bad kiei kiei baher kiba phi leh ki longïing ki i don jingmyntoi . U Mynsiem jongki la u long kum ka ding ka ba-bang pynjot ïa ph .
translation.en: Ye shall conceive chaff , ye shall bring forth stubble : your breath , as fire , shall devour you .

translation.kha: Wat la ki Jedidah ki dei ki para ri jong ki , ki shipai Israel ki thong koidi ïa ki ar lakh ngut ki kynthei bad khynnah sad ki rah ïa ki sha Samaria , lem bad ka jinglute kaba bun .
translation.en: And the children of Israel carried away captive of their brethren two hundred thousand , women , sons , and daughters , and took also away much spoil from them , and brought the spoil to Samaria .
The thief cometh not , but for to steal , and to kill , and to destroy : I am come that they might have life , and that they might have it more abundantly .
translation.kha: U nongtuh u wan tang ban ïoh tuh , ban pynïap bad ban pynjot . Nga la wan khnang ba phin ïoh ïa ka jingim — ka jingim ha ka jingdap kyrhai jong ka .

translation.en: And thou shalt take the other ram  ; and Aaron and his sons shall put their hands upon the head of the ram .
translation.kha: Shim ïa uta uwei pat u langbrot — u langbrot ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka jingpynkyntang — bad ong ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u .

translation.en: For he shall have judgment without mercy , that hath shewed no mercy  ; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment .
translation.kha: Naba U Blei un ym pyn-i jingsngewsynei haba u bishar ïa u briew u bym shym la leh-isynei ; hynrei ka jinglehisynei ka jop noh halor ka jingbishar .

translation.en: So the  Lord  saved Israel that day : and the battle passed over unto Beth–aven .
translation.kha: ki da ïaleh shi lynter lynti shaduh palat ka Bethaben . U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa ki Israel ha kata ka sngi .
Hato u masi prut un trei na ka bynta jong me ? Hato u mon ban pynliem ïa ka miet ha ka sem jong me ?
translation.en: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee , or abide by thy crib ?

translation.kha: Te U tharai u kylli ïa u Kain , Shano u Abel u per jong me ? U te u jubab , Ngam tipthuh . Hato Dei ma nga u ban sumar ïa u para jong nga ?
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Cain , Where is Abel thy brother ? And he said , I know not : Am I my brother s keeper ?

translation.kha: Ka dang don ka ri ki Kanaan Baroh kawei , bad ka Mearah ( kaba daym ka jong ki nong Sidon ) , haduh ka Aphek , kaba ha khappud ki Amal ;
translation.en: From the south , all the land of the Canaanites , and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians , unto Aphek , to the borders of the Amorites :
He that loveth his life shall lose it  ; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ieit ïa la ka jong ka jingim un duh ïa ka ; uno uno uba isih ïa la ka jong ka jingim ha kane ka pyrthei un ri ïa ka sha ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee ? will he enter with thee into judgment ?
translation.kha: Kam dei namar ba phi ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei ba u sneng ïa phi bad wanrah ïa phi sha ka jingbishar .
Phi ki nong Sarai phim da tip shai ïano phi mane ; hynrei ma ngi ki Jiw ngi tip ïano ngi mane , namar ka long na ki Jiw ba ka jingpynim ka wan .
translation.en: Ye worship ye know not what : we know what we worship : for salvation is of the Jews .

translation.kha: U la iohi ba pha leh ïa kiei kiei kiba u isih . U la ïohi ba Phah bud ïa ki blei thala Hamor ki lum bad ki lyngkha , kum u bynriew suba threw jakhlia ïa ka tnga u paramarjan jong u lane kum u kulai ïa ka khwai . Ko ki brai jong ka Jerusalem , ph erlangthari kiba la Tim ! Lano phin ïoh long kiba khuid ?
translation.en: I have seen thine adulteries , and thy neighings , the lewdness of thy whoredom , and thine abominations on the hills in the fields . Woe unto thee , O Jerusalem ! wilt thou not be made clean ? when shall it once be ?

translation.kha: Da ka jingtah , ki kynthei ki la pdiang ïa ki ba-ha-ïing kiba la ïap ïa kiba la pynim pat . Kiwei pat , kiba kyntait ban pdiang ïa ka jinglaitluid , ki la ïap ha ka jingsah pynshitom ibeiñ khnang ba yn pynmihpat Sha ka jingim kaba kham bha .
translation.en: Women received their dead raised to life again : and others were tortured , not accepting deliverance  ; that they might obtain a better resurrection :
And Peter remembered the word of Jesus , which said unto him ,  Before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .  And he went out , and wept bitterly .
translation.kha: bad u Petros u la kynmaw ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la lah ïathuh ha u :  Shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .  U la mihnoh bad u la ïamkthang .

U Trai u Ong ha u Moses , wiat sheptieng ïa u . Ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor jongu u , ïa ki briew jong u baroh , bad ïa ka ri jongu u . Leh ïa u kumba me la leh ïa u Shisyndon u syiem Amor uba synshar ha Heshbon .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Fear him not : for I have delivered him into thy hand , and all his people , and his land  ; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .
And being let go , they went to their own company , and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them .
translation.kha: Mar ïapyllait , u Petros bad ïa u Ïoannis ki la leit phai sha la ka kynhun bad ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ong .
Ka la sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u Paul bad ka la kmen haduh thar mawria ba ka la mareh patar shapoh khlem da plie ïa ka jingkhang , bad ka la pynbang ba u Petros u ainong shabar .
translation.en: And when she knew Peter s voice , she opened not the gate for gladness , but ran in , and told how Peter stood before the gate .

translation.kha: u khun jongno u Joshua , u khun lad u Elieser , u khur jong u Goiim , u khun jong u Mephaath , u khuid jongno u Lebi ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Jose , which was the son of Eliezer , which was the son of Jorim , which was the son of Matthat , which was the son of Levi ,
And the two disciples heard him speak , and they followed Jesus .
translation.kha: Ki ar ngut ki synran ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ïa kane bad ki la leit lem bad U Jisu .
Shan hadien dat , uwei na ki ba-bieit jong ka un long syiem . Un tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem Syria , un rung Shobab ki kut jngai ki , bad jop ïa ki .
translation.en: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate , which shall come with an army , and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north , and shall deal against them , and shall prevail :

translation.kha: U Josaïah u la don phra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar laiphew wei snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jedidah , ka khun jong u Akhaïa , na ka shnong na basohsat .
translation.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jedidah , the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath .

translation.kha: Ngi dei na Pyrthei , na Madai , bad na Elam ; na Moses , na Judia , bad na Kappadokia ; na Pontos bad na Asia ,
translation.en: Parthians , and Medes , and Elamites , and the dwellers in Mesopotamia , and in Judaea , and Cappadocia , in Pontus , and Asia ,

translation.kha: Shim ïa u , u Hukum bad uta u briew u dem bad u la shim ïa u .
translation.en: Therefore said he , Take it up to thee . And he put out his hand , and took it .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka lah ban ïohi da kaba suk , hynrei mana shem la pynpaw jingsngewkhia ei ei ïa la ka pipa . Ka jingïalong jong ka , ka long kaba shyrkhei ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyntngen ïa ka . Ki nongshun jong ka ki la jop , bad ka kyang sha U Trai na ka byndi ka jingisynei .
translation.en: Her gates are sunk into the ground  ; he hath destroyed and broken her bars : her king and her princes are among the Gentiles : the law is no more  ; her prophets also find no vision from the  Lord .

translation.kha: Uwei u dei u Sihon , u syiem ynda uba synshar ha Hephsibah . Ka hima jong u ka kynthup shiteng lad ka Gilead : naduh Aroer ( ha ka thew jong ka ih Ainong ) bad na ka nongbah kabu hapdeng jong kata ka them , shaduh ka wah Jabbok , ka khap jongu ki Ammon ;
translation.en: Sihon king of the Amorites , who dwelt in Heshbon , and ruled from Aroer , which is upon the bank of the river Arnon , and from the middle of the river , and from half Gilead , even unto the river Jabbok , which is the border of the children of Ammon  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei u khun syiem uba synshar , u lah ban rung hangthie shun bameh ïa ka jingbah bakhuid ha ka jingdon pyllut jong nga . Un rung bad mih ïa ka khyrdop lyngba ka ruma ban rung ban mih ha ka bynta kaba kham shapoh .
translation.en: It is for the prince  ; the prince , he shall sit in it to eat bread before the  Lord   ; he shall enter by the way of the porch of that gate , and shall go out by the way of the same .

translation.kha: Kumta na la sngewshyrkhei ïa baroh kaban nga la ong bad nga kylla-kaba-mut ha u pui pait bad u diengpynïeng .
translation.en: Wherefore I abhor myself , and repent in dust and ashes .

translation.kha: Ki la thaw bleithaw ha ka dur jong u khun smai bad ong ba u dei u blei uba la ïalam ïa ki na Joppa ! Haduh katno ki la pynjyrngam ïa me , Ko Trai’ !
translation.en: Yea , when they had made them a molten calf , and said , This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt , and had wrought great provocations  ;

translation.kha: Pyni ha nga ïa u briew uba saraw bad ngan pyn-i ha phi ïa u briew uba jinglehmeng , uba shajrong bad u bym ju Kheiñ briew .
translation.en: Proud and haughty scorner is his name , who dealeth in proud wrath .

translation.kha: U la ai ïa ki ri jong ki sha ki bariew jong u ; u la ai ïa ki ha ki Israel .
translation.en: And gave their land for an heritage , an heritage unto Israel his people .

translation.kha: U kñia ïa la u khunlung kum ka jingainguh thang . U khynnah bad u sa myntor , bad u ïatyllun bad ki nongjop kti bad ki nongleh byrtong . U la leh pop patlun pyrshah ïa U Trai bad pynkhih bitar ïa u .
translation.en: And he made his son pass through the fire , and observed times , and used enchantments , and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards : he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .

translation.kha: ( Jenesis 1 :31 ) Lada kila kohnguh ia U Blei , ken ngin da la kha ia ki khun ki bamaïan , bad ka pyrthei baroh ka jin da la long ka paro , ha kaba ki briew kin ieh im haka jingkmen bad jingsuk junom .
translation.en: ( Genesis 1 :31 ) If they had obeyed God , they would have produced perfect children , and the earth would have become a global paradise , where people would live forever in peace and happiness .

translation.kha: U la pyrta nangno ïano ban wallam shahïap ïa ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , malade ki nongpeit kti . Haba ki la ïawan shapoh , u syiem u la ong ha ki , Ïa uno uno wahbah lah ban pluh ïa kane ka jingthoh bad ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingmut jong ka yn pynphong ha ki jaiñkup sahmiet kiba sawbthuh , un deng u kynjoh ksiar ka jingdonburom sawdong ka ryndang jongno u , bad un longsyiem uba lai ha ka hab hapoh ka hima .
translation.en: The king cried aloud to bring in the astrologers , the Chaldeans , and the soothsayers . And the king spake , and said to the wise men of Babylon , Whosoever shall read this writing , and shew me the interpretation thereof , shall be clothed with scarlet , and have a chain of gold about his neck , and shall be the third ruler in the kingdom .
Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke : among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be .
translation.kha: Ka sngi ka jingpynshitom ka la wan , bad ki Israel kin sa shah pynjot . Ko ki paid Israel , kane kan jia da shisha !

translation.en: Behold , your house is left unto you desolate .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa ka Templ jong pha yn iehnoh bad kan long kaba thylli .

translation.en: Then spake Elisha unto the woman , whose son he had restored to life , saying , Arise , and go thou and thine household , and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn : for the  Lord  hath called for a famine  ; and it shall also come upon the land seven years .
translation.kha: Mynta u Elisha u la lah ïathuh ha ka briew kaba shong ha Shunem , ha kaba ïa u khun jong ka u la pynim pat , ba U  Trai  un phah ïa ka  nemsniew ka ban neh hynñiew snem ha ka ri bad ba ka dei ban mihnoh bad ka longïing jong ka bad leit sah shawei pat .
Kata ka long ka gospel , ka khubor kaba nga la ïaleh ha phi . Ïa pa’ la pynim da ka gospel lada Phi batskhem ïa ka — lymda phi la ngeit lehnoh-ei .
translation.en: By which also ye are saved , if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you , unless ye have believed in vain .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïathuh ha u Moses , ban ong ha ki paid Israel ,
Mynba u Jisu u don ha pyut u pynkoit ïa kiba pang , u pynïeng ïa kiba thngan bad u pynjaijai ïa ki eriong .
translation.en: When on earth Jesus cured the sick , fed the hungry , and calmed storms .

And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee  ; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee : for thy merchants were the great men of the earth  ; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingshai ka sharak yn ym ïohi shuh da lei lei ha pha ; ïa ka sur u nongleitkurim bad ka nongleitkurim yn ym ïohsngew shuh ha pha ! Ki nongkhaïi jong pha ki la long kiba donbor tam ha ka pyrthei baroh , bad da ka myntor balamler pha la shukor ïa ki briew baroh jong ka pyrthei !
Phin sa ïohsngew ïa ki jingsawa ki thma kiba hajan bad ïa ki khubor thma kiba sha jngai ; hynrei wat khah khuslai . Kiba kum kine kiei kiei ki dien ban jia , hynrei kim smat ba kaweh kut ka la poi .
translation.en: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars : see that ye be not troubled : for all these things must come to pass , but the end is not yet .
Though they dig into hell , thence shall mine hand take them  ; though they climb up to heaven , thence will I bring them down :
translation.kha: Wat lada ki tih ïa ka lynti jong ki shapoh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ngan kem ïa ki . Wat lada ki kiew sha bneng , ngan patan ïa ki shapoh .
Haba ki Jingtylli ki la ïohsngew ïa kan , ki la kmang bad ki la ïaroh ïa ka khur jongno U Tharai , bad kito ïa naba la jia na ka bynta ka jingim bymjukut ki la long ki riewngeit .
translation.en: And when the Gentiles heard this , they were glad , and glorified the word of the Lord : and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed .
And there stood up one of them named Agabus , and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world : which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Agabos , u la ïeng joit bad da ka bor jong U Mynsiem u la ïathuh lypa ba ka  nemsniew bajur kan sa wan ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . ( Ka la wan jia mynba u Klaudius u la long u Patsha . )

Hynrei kumno me lah ban shah ïa kine ki riewshukor , ki briew kaba sniew ? Ki khmat jong me ki khadu palat kat ban peitbeiñ ïa kaba sniew , bad mut lai shah ban peiñ ïa ki briew ba leh bymdei . Te balei ba me shu sngap jar shkor kaban ki dang pynjot ïa ki briew Kiba kham hok ban ïa ki ?
translation.en: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil , and canst not look on iniquity : wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously , and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he ?

translation.kha: Susah ynda U Nongaplangbrot Rangbah un pat , phin ïohpdiang ïa ka pansngiat badonburom kaba ka jingtyngshaiñ kan ym jah na ka lano lano ruh .
translation.en: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear , ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki biria jongno nga ki kyntait da ka jingmynthi ban pynbyrsieh ïa nga . Ki khang ïa ki jingmut jong ki
translation.en: But they refused to hearken , and pulled away the shoulder , and stopped their ears , that they should not hear .

translation.kha: Pynngam dei u nongthaw jingkulmar , u Elijah u la jubab . Dei ma phi! — ma phi bad u kpa jong phi . Phim shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Trai bad phi maïan ïa ki bleithaw u Baal .
translation.en: And he answered , I have not troubled Israel  ; but thou , and thy father s house , in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the  Lord  , and thou hast followed Baalim .

translation.kha: Haba U Blei u la ong ban pynim ïa ki Briew jongu u , u shakri ba la jied jong u , u mawshun , u la ïing pyrshah ïa U blei bad khang ïa ka jingbitar jong u na kaba pynjot noh ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them , had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach , to turn away his wrath , lest he should destroy them .
Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near , and smote Micaiah upon the cheek , and said , Which way went the Spirit of the  Lord  from me to speak unto thee ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Sedekaïah nongïathuhlypa u leit sha u Mikaïah , u thab ïa u bad kylli ,  Naduh mynno u mynsiem U  Trai  u la mih na nga bad kren ha phi ?

Ka kynjoh ïa ki nongbah baroh jong ka jaka padun bad ka hima baroh katai jongki u Sihon u syiem Amor , uba la synshar ha Heshbon . U Mesha u la jop ïa u , bad ruh ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki maïan : u Ebi , u Rephaim , u thar , u Hur , bad u Reba . Kine baroh ki la synshar na ka bynta u Shisyndon .
translation.en: And all the cities of the plain , and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites , which reigned in Heshbon , whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian , Evi , and Rekem , and Zur , and Hur , and Reba , which were dukes of Sihon , dwelling in the country .

translation.kha: Ki la wan sha Jerikho , bad katba U Jisu u sdang ban mihnoh pyllut dara ki synran jong u bad u paidbah babun , u nongkawang umbah matlah uba kyrteng u Bartimaïos , u khun jong u Timaïos , u tang shongkha harud lynti .
translation.en: And they came to Jericho : and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people , blind Bartimaeus , the son of Timaeus , sat by the highway side begging .

translation.kha: Mynta nga da sngewtynnat ba phin sa longïng u syiem ki Israel bad ba ka hima Israel kan ïaineh ha ka jingsynshar jong phi .
translation.en: And now , behold , I know well that thou shalt surely be king , and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand .

translation.kha: Wat ktah ïa nga , U Jisu u la ino ha ka , namar ngam pat shym la leit kew sha U kput . Hynrei khie leit sha ki para jong nga bad ïathuh ïa ki ba ngan leit phai sha u , uba long U Kpa jrong per bad U Kpa jong ki , U Blei jong nga sad U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Touch me not  ; for I am not yet ascended to my Father : but go to my brethren , and say unto them , I ascend unto my Father , and your Father  ; and to my God , and your God .
But when David saw that his servants whispered , David perceived that the child was dead : therefore David said unto his servants , Is the child dead ? And they said , He is dead .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la ïohi ba ki ïakren pasiaw para ma ki , u la sngewthuh ba u khunlung u la ïap . Kumta u kylli ïa ki ,  Hato u khunlung u la ïap ?   Ho-oid , u la ïap ,  ki la jubab .
Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka duriaw la pynkylla snam , shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki jingthaw ba-im ha ka duriaw ki la ïap , bad shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki lieng la shah pynjot .
translation.en: And the third part of the creatures which were in the sea , and had life , died  ; and the third part of the ships were destroyed .

translation.kha: Balei ba ki nongri Ijipt kyang ïoh ong ba me la ïalam ïa la ki briew na ka ri Jephthah , da kaba me thum shun pynïap ïa ki ha ki lum , mala ban pynjot taiew ïa ki ? Sangeh ban bitar ; pynkylla noh ïa ka jingjam jong me , dara kdew ai ba kñia ka jingpynjot kan ngat ha ki briew jong me .
translation.en: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak , and say , For mischief did he bring them out , to slay them in the mountains , and to consume them from the face of the earth ? Turn from thy fierce wrath , and repent of this evil against thy people .

translation.kha: U jubab , Phi tip ba nga la dat baneh erlangthari syiem bad ba uwei pa uwei baroh ha Israel u khmih lyntang ïa kata . Hynrei ka la jia long da kumwei pat , bad u per jong nga u la long syiem namar ka dei ka mon U Trai .
translation.en: And he said , Thou knowest that the kingdom was mine , and that all Israel set their faces on me , that I should reign : howbeit the kingdom is turned about , and is become my brother s : for it was his from the  Lord .

translation.kha: Elim ruh ïa la u para , bad ïawan phai mar mar .
translation.en: Take also your brother , and arise , go again unto the man :
And I will rejoice in Jerusalem , and joy in my people : and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her , nor the voice of crying .
translation.kha: Ïa nga ruh yn pyndap da ka jingkmen namar ka Jerusalem bad ki briew jong ka . Hangta yn ym don shuh ka jingïam , yn ym don shuh ki ban khot kyrpad ban ïoh jingïarap .

Neng wallam ïa u Sis , u rangbah ai hukum jongu ka kynjah shipawa jong u Jabin , ban ïaleh pynshisha ïa phi ha ka wah Kishon . Un don ki kali ïap bad ki Shiphew , hynrei ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong u .’
translation.en: And I will draw unto thee to the river Kishon Sisera , the captain of Jabin s army , with his chariots and his multitude  ; and I will deliver him into thine hand .

translation.kha: Ka jingmutlop jong u ka paw kad ha ki nongwei kiba u ïakynduh ha ka lynti ; u ailad ïa ïohi pa iwei ban kop ba u dei u bieit .
translation.en: Yea also , when he that is a fool walketh by the way , his wisdom faileth him , and he saith to every one that he is a fool .
Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled , because they had found no answer , and yet had condemned Job .
translation.kha: U la bitar ruh ïa ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u Job . Kim shym don lynti ban jubab ïa u Job , bad ka pynpaw pynban kumba U Blei u la bakla .
Kan shym la wan phai , hynrei ka shwa ih kylleng kylleng haduh ba ka um kan da rngad .
translation.en: And he sent forth a raven , which went forth to and fro , until the waters were dried up from off the earth .

translation.kha: U long uba hakhlieh tam halor kaweh pa kaei ka jingsynshar ba kynja mynsiem bad ka bor synshar .
translation.en: And ye are complete in him , which is the head of all principality and power :
But now thus saith the  Lord  that created thee , O Jacob , and he that formed thee , O Israel , Fear not : for I have redeemed thee , I have called thee by thy name  ; thou art mine .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , U Blei uba la thaw ïa phi u ong ,  Wat sheptieng — ngan pyllait im ïa phi , nga la khot ïa phi da ka kyrteng — phi long u jong nga .
Kumba ngi ïoh bynta na ki jingshan shitom babun lad U Krit , kumta ruh , lyngba U Khrist , ngi ïoh bynta na i'u ki jingïarap bakhraw jong U Blei .
translation.en: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us , so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ .
The cities of the south shall be shut up , and none shall open them : Judah shall be carried away captive all of it , it shall be wholly carried away captive .
translation.kha: Ki shnong jong ka Judah bashathie ki don hapoh ka jingshah kerkut ; ym don mano mano ba lah ban leit lyngba sha ki . Ïa ki briew baroh jong ka Judah la shim noh sha ka jinglongmraw .

translation.en: Then Uzziah was wroth , and had a censer in his hand to burn incense : and while he was wroth with the priests , the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the  Lord  , from beside the incense altar .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u ïeng hangta hapoh ka Templ harud ka duwan thang jingiwbih , bad u bat ïa ka pliang thang jingiwbih . U la bitar ïa kita ki lyngdoh , bad mar kumta ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh ka mih ha ka shyllangmat jong u .
U Petros u dang ïai pyrshang ban shaphang aïu ka jingïohknieh ka kit jingmut , haba U Mynsiem u la ong , Ha sngap ! Lai ngut ki rangbah ki ïawad ïa me .
translation.en: While Peter thought on the vision , the Spirit said unto him , Behold , three men seek thee .

translation.kha: ( Kane ka la long ha shuwa ban set byndi ïa u Ïingjaiñ . )
translation.en: For John was not yet cast into prison .

translation.kha: U la beiñ ïa ki Israel , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Shammah , u hynmen jong u Dabid , u la pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And when he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u pynmynsaw ïa uei pat u Briew , dom u la leh ïa uta , kumta ruh yn leh kylliang ïa u .
translation.en: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour  ; as he hath done , so shall it be done to him  ;
