And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press , they uncovered the roof where he was : and when they had broken it up , they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay .
translation.kha: Na ka daw jong u paidbah , kim shym la lah ban wallam ïa uta u briew sha u . Kumta ki la weng ïa ka jingsop na ka tnum ïing hamar ka jaka ba U Jisu u don . Haba ki la dep weng ïa ka jingsop ïing , ki la pynhiar ïa uta u briew shapoh , u da thiah ha ka jingthiah jong u .

translation.en: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy : and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment , thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place .
translation.kha: Uno uno ne uei uei uba ktah ïa ka doh jong uta u jingkñia un mynsaw da ka bor jong ka jingkhuid jong ka . Lada kano kano ka bynta jong jaiñkup ka bit snam na uta u jingkñia , dei ban sait ïa ka ha ka jaka bakhuid .
Kaei kaba moi hikai ïa phiah mynta ka longsem ka jingaiei jyllang U Trai : Ma ngi bakha dang im ha ka sngem ba U Trai u wan , ngin ym leit ha shuwa jong kito katba la ïaphah .
translation.en: For this we say unto you by the word of the Lord , that we which are alive and remain unto the coming of the Lord shall not prevent them which are asleep .

translation.kha: Ka ksiar batynrai jongno ngi ka la jngut ; ki maw jong ka Templ ki don ha ka jingsaphred ha ki lynti beh .
translation.en: How is the gold become dim ! how is the most fine gold changed ! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street .
But of the cities of these people , which the  Lord  thy God doth give thee for an inheritance , thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth :
translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi ïohknieh ïa ki shnong kiba hapoh kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi ban long ka jingïohpateng , pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei .
U Trai u longsyiem uba bhah ïa uwei pa uwei uba Shaniah ha u ,
translation.en: The  Lord  is good unto them that wait for him , to the soul that seeketh him .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei katba nga la shem : Kiba bakha tam kaba ngi lah ban kun ka long shun bam nabar ban dih bad ban lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei ha ka jingim balyngkot kaba U Blei u la ai ïa ngi ; kane ka dei ka kupar jong ngi .
translation.en: Behold that which I have seen : it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink , and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life , which God giveth him : for it is his portion .

translation.kha: Kumta nga pynbna skhem ha phi ha kane hi ka sngi : Lada uno uno na phi u Dei ban jot noh , ngam khong ka jingkitkhlieh .
translation.en: Wherefore I take you to record this day , that I am pure from the blood of all men .

translation.kha: Pynmih ïa uto u brisoh shabar ka jaka shong dara . ino uno u briew uba la ïohpdiang ïa u ba u tim u tla un Sakhi ïa kata da kaba u buh ïa la ki kti ha ka khlieh jong u , bad nangta u paidbah baroh un lynthem maw ïa u rahah ba un da ïap .
translation.en: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp  ; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head , and let all the congregation stone him .

translation.kha: Baroh ki briew bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la ïamynjur ban pyllaitluid ne ïa la ki mraw bad ban ym pynlong mraw shuh ïa ki .
translation.en: Now when all the princes , and all the people , which had entered into the covenant , heard that every one should let his manservant , and every one his maidservant , go free , that none should serve themselves of them any more , then they obeyed , and let them go .

Her priests have violated my law , and have profaned mine holy things : they have put no difference between the holy and profane , neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean , and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths , and I am profaned among them .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki pynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ jong nga bad kim burom ïa kaei kaba khuid . Kim pynïapher hapdeng kaei kaba khuid bad kaei ka bymkhuid . Kim hikai ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng kiba khuid bad kiba jakhlia , bad kim suidñiew ïa ka Sabbaton . Kaba mih ka long ba ki paid Israel kim ñiewkor ïa nga .
Nga la buh ka por ïa ka ban wallam ka jingpynjot ha ki briew jong ka Asnoth , bad haba kata ka por ka wan , yn ym don mano mano ruh na ki u ban lait im .
translation.en: And there shall be no remnant of them : for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth , even the year of their visitation .

translation.kha: U Amos u jubab , Ngam dei kum uta u jait nongïathuhlypa , uba ïathuhlypa na ka bynta ban ïoh jingsiew . Nga dei u nongri jingri , bad nga sorkar ïa ki dieng Dumbur .
translation.en: Then answered Amos , and said to Amaziah , I was no prophet , neither was I a prophet s son  ; but I was an herdman , and a gatherer of sycomore fruit :
Shall not the day of the  Lord  be darkness , and not light ? even very dark , and no brightness in it ?
translation.kha: Ka sngi U  Trai  kan wallam ïa ka jingdum , bad ym ïa ka jingshai ; kan long ka sngi ka jingdum tliw tliw , khlem kano kano ka jingphyrnai .

translation.en: And he took the blind man by the hand , and led him out of the town  ; and when he had spit on his eyes , and put his hands upon him , he asked him if he saw ought .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la shim ïa uta u briew uba matlah na ka kti bad ïalam ïa u shabar ka nongrit . Hadien ba u la bynthiew ha ki khmat jong uta u briew , U Jisu u la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong u bad kylli ïa u ,  Me lah ban ïohi ei ei ?
Ka la jop , Mynta nga tip ba me long u briew jong U Bela , bad ba U Trai da shisha u krong lyngba jongu me !
translation.en: And the woman said to Elijah , Now by this I know that thou art a man of God , and that the word of the  Lord  in thy mouth is truth .
That thou hast slain my children , and delivered them to cause them to pass through the fire for them ?
translation.kha: khlem da shim ïa ki khun jong nga bad kñia ïa ki ha ki bleithaw ?

translation.en: For the which cause I also suffer these things : nevertheless I am not ashamed : for I know whom I have believed , and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day .
translation.kha: Nabynta kaei nga ruh nga jynjar kumne baroh , Hynrei nga dap da ka jingsngewskhem , namar nga tip hano nga la shaniah , bad nga sngewthikna ba u lah ban sumar skhem haduh kata ka Sngi ïa kaei kaba u la aiti ha nga .
Kumno nga lah ban tem ïa kaei kaba U Blei um shym la thlim , Lane kren shaphang ka jingjot haba U Trai um skhem kren ?
translation.en: How shall I curse , whom God hath not cursed ? or how shall I defy , whom the  Lord  hath not defied ?

translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki aiñ ba U Trai u la ai ha u Moses kiba ïadei bad ki jingkular ba la pynhieng da ka theisamla kaba dang sah ha ka ïing u kpa jongno ka lane da ka kynthei kaba la shongkurim .
translation.en: These are the statutes , which the  Lord  commanded Moses , between a man and his wife , between the father and his daughter , being yet in her youth in her father s house .
And they smote all the cities round about Gerar  ; for the fear of the  Lord  came upon them : and they spoiled all the cities  ; for there was exceeding much spoil in them .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la lah ban pynjot ïa ki nongbah ha ki phang ka Gerar , namar ba ki briew hangta ki la khynñiuh ïa U  Trai . Ka kynhun shipai ka la lute ïa baroh kito ki nongbah bad ki kurup shibun ka jinglute .

translation.en: And he sent out arrows , and scattered them  ; lightning , and discomfited them .
translation.kha: U siat ïa ki khnam bad u pynsaphriang ïa ki nongshun jong u ; da ka jingthaba ka leilieh u pynher ïa ki .
shadien nangta , bun ki jaitbynriew nongwei kin ïaid lynñiar bad kin ïakylli uwei ïa uwei pat balamler ba nga , U Trai nga la leh katne katne ïa kane ka nongbah kaba khraw .
translation.en: And many nations shall pass by this city , and they shall say every man to his neighbour , Wherefore hath the  Lord  done thus unto this great city ?
And called , and asked whether Simon , which was surnamed Peter , were lodged there .
translation.kha: Ki la pyrta bad kylli ,  Don mo u nongshong basa hangne uba kyrteng u Simon Petros ?

translation.en: He turneth rivers into a wilderness , and the watersprings into dry ground  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki wah ban rngad lut bad pynsangeh ïa ki umpohliew ban mih .
U Blei u Jubab ïa ka jingduwai ka Leah , bad ka la punkhun bad ka kha ïa u khur uba san ïa u Jakob .
translation.en: And God hearkened unto Leah , and she conceived , and bare Jacob the fifth son .
Therefore Saul removed him from him , and made him his captain over a thousand  ; and he went out and came in before the people .
translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u phah noh ïa u bad u thung ïa u kum u nongïalam ïa ki shihajar ki rangbah .

translation.en: Who in the days of his flesh , when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death , and was heard in that he feared  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka jingim jong u ha kane ka pyrthei , U Jisu u la duwai bad khot kyrpad da kaba pyrta jam bad ïam ha khmat U Blei , uba lah ban pyllait ïa u na ka jingïap . Namar ba u long uba sngewrit bad aiti lut , U Blei u la shahshkor ïa u .
Wat ka pyrthei kiba ïap kam lah ban buhrieh na U Trai ba un ym tip kaei kaba don hangta ; kumno te i lah ban buhrieh ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ngi na U Blei ?
translation.en: Hell and destruction are before the  Lord  : how much more then the hearts of the children of men ?

translation.kha: Ki phai bad ki leit noh , bad ki khynnah , ki jingri jingsngap , bad ki jingdon jingem jong ki , ki leit ha shuwa .
translation.en: So they turned and departed , and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them .

translation.kha: un uno uba dang dih dud u dang long u khynñiat , khlem pat don kano kano ka jingshemphang ïa kaei kaba dat bad ka bymdei .
translation.en: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness : for he is a babe .
The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more : thine eyes are upon me , and I am not .
translation.kha: Me ïohi ïa nga mynta , hynrei mem ïohi shuh lada me peit ïa nga , nga la jah noh !
Lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka kyntait ban leit bad mane ïa U Trai Badonbor baroh kum u syiem , te u slap un ym hap ha ka ri jong ki .
translation.en: And it shall be , that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King , the  Lord  of hosts , even upon them shall be no rain .

translation.kha: U Joab u ïohi ba ki shipai nongshun ken tur ïaleh ïa u na sha khmat bad na shadien , kumta u jied ki shipai Isaia bakynsai tam bad pynap da kaba pynphai khmat ïa ki shaphang ki Syria .
translation.en: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind , he chose out of all the choice of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians .
Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin  ; neither say thou before the angel , that it was an error : wherefore should God be angry at thy voice , and destroy the work of thine hands ?
translation.kha: Wat ai ba ki kyntien jong phi kin ïalam ïa phi sha ka pop , ba kumta phi hap ban ïathuh ïa u lyngdoh jong U Blei ba phim shym mut shisha . Balei ban pynlong ïa U Blei ban bitar ïa phi ? Balei yn shah ïa u ban pynjot thiaw ïa kaei kaba phi la trei ?

translation.en: And if he have betrothed her unto his son , he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u thied mraw ïa ka kynthei ban ai ïa ka ha la u khun , u dei ban ñiew ïa ka kum la ka khun .

translation.en: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea  ; and he shall be for an haven of ships  ; and his border shall be unto Zidon .
translation.kha: U Sebulun un shong harud duriaw ; Ka jaka shong jong u kan long ka jakarieh ïa ki liengbah , Bad ka khyndew ka shyiap jong u kan ïar haduh Sidon .

translation.en: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger , and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel , and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger !
translation.kha: Katno kaba kynjah long ka Jerusalem , kaba shisien ka long kaba dap da ki briew ! Shisien la pyndonburom da ka pyrthei , mynta ka long kum ka riewkynthei ; kaba donburom tam na ki nongbah ka la kyllon sha ka jinglongmraw .

Nangta kan smat para patan sa Laiphew lai sngi ba yn ñiew ïa ka kaba la khuid biang na ka jingsngem . Kam dei ban ktah ïa kaei kaei kaba khuid lane rung Sha ka Ïingjaiñ tad Ynda la kut ka por pynkhuid ïa ka .
translation.en: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days  ; she shall touch no hallowed thing , nor come into the sanctuary , until the days of her purifying be fulfilled .
Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day , that ye may be strong , and go in and possess the land , whither ye go to possess it  ;
translation.kha: To kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Kumta te phin lah ban jam sha shiliang wah bad ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit rung .
U dei U Trai umbiah ïarap ïa ar ; bad ngan ïohi ba ki nongshun jong nga ki shahjop .
translation.en: The  Lord  taketh my part with them that help me : therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me .

translation.kha: Lai snoh hadien u Jeroboam bad ki paidbah baroh ki wan biang sha u syiem Rehoboam , dom u la bthah ïa ki .
translation.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day , as the king had appointed , saying , Come to me again the third day .

translation.kha: Da kumta keiñ u Joshua u jop thiaw ïa ki Amalek .
translation.en: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword .

translation.kha: Lano ka Paradais Kan wan ?
translation.en: When Will Paradise Come ?

translation.kha: Hynrei hato kane ka mut ba kaei kaba bhah ka pynurlong ïa ka jingïap ïa nga ? Ym dujok! Ka daym ka ngop kaba pynlong ïa kata ; da kaba pyndonkam ïa kiei kaba bha , ka pop ka la wallam ka jingïap ïa nga , khnang ba ïa Katai ka jinglong bashisha jong ka pop yn pynpaw . Bad kumin , lyngba ka hukum , ïa ka pop la pynpaw ba ka long katba kham shyrkhei .
translation.en: Was then that which is good made death unto me ? God forbid . But sin , that it might appear sin , working death in me by that which is good ; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful .

translation.kha: U khun uba mutlop u lah ban wallam ka jingpynjot ha la u kpa . Ka tnga kaba bunktien ka long kum ka um kaba jaw jrop shi jrut .
translation.en: A foolish son is the calamity of his father : and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping .

translation.kha: Te ki Amalek bad ki Kano ibha shong hangta ki wan ter ïaleh bad ki la jop ïa ki , bad ki beh krad ïa ki haduh Hormah .
translation.en: Then the Amalekites came down , and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill , and smote them , and discomfited them , even unto Hormah .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , Ngan kyrhai ïa phi tang kawei ka jingkylli , bad lada ph ai ïa nga ïa ka jubab , kan ïathuh ïa phi da kaei ka haw ba sa Don ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I will also ask of you one question , and answer me , and I will tell you by what authority I do these things .

And the man , the master of the house , went out unto them , and said unto them , Nay , my brethren , nay , I pray you , do not so wickedly  ; seeing that this man is come into mine house , do not this folly .
translation.kha: Hynrei u tymmen u mih shabar bad u ong ha ki ,  Em , ko paralok jong nga ! Sngewbha ! Wat leh kaba kum kata ka kam bymman , ka kam bakhlemrain ! Une u briew u long uba nga la khot sngewbha .
Kumta ki la mihnoh nabar ki la pynskhem ïa ka jingtep da kaba buh ïa ka muhor halor u Maw bad buh ïa ki nongap phira ngab ap .
translation.en: So they went , and made the sepulchre sure , sealing the stone , and setting a watch .
So ye in like manner , when ye shall see these things come to pass , know that it is nigh , even at the doors .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , haba phi ïoh ïa kine kiei kiei ba ki jia , phin tip ba ka por ka la jan , kaba la kloi ban sdang .
U ong ha latai , len ym bakla da law lei ; da lei lei Ngan ym poi ha ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: He hath said in his heart , I shall not be moved : for I shall never be in adversity .
Behold , it is come , and it is done , saith the Lord  God   ; this is the day whereof I have spoken .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ka sngi ïa kaba nga la kren kan wan da shisha .

translation.en: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country  ; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine .
translation.kha: Kumta u la leit ban trei na ka bynta uwei na ki traishnong jong kata ka ri , uba la phah ïa u sha ka jaka ri jingri jong u ban sumar ïa ki sniang .
ki la shemphang , badno ki ong , U balieh u la wan poi ha ayu jong ki ! Ngi la shahjop ! Kumno Kanah kam pat ju jia ha ngi Mynno mynno !
translation.en: And the Philistines were afraid , for they said , God is come into the camp . And they said , Woe unto us ! for there hath not been such a thing heretofore .
And Abimelech said , Behold , my land is before thee : dwell where it pleaseth thee .
translation.kha: U ong ha u Abraham ,  Kane baroh ka dei ka ri jong nga ; to shong to sah kat ha kaba me kwah .

Kun jin da la bhah ba U tharai u seh ïap ïa ngi ha ri Ijipt . Hangta , la kumno kumno , ngi dang ïoh ban shong bad bameh doh bad kyrhai ka jingbah katai kaba ngi kwah . Khenani phin la wan ïam ïa ngi sha ken ka ri shyiap ban pynïapthngan ïa moi baroh .
translation.en: And the children of Israel said unto them , Would to God we had died by the hand of the  Lord  in the land of Egypt , when we sat by the flesh pots , and when we did eat bread to the full  ; for ye have brought us forth into this wilderness , to kill this whole assembly with hunger .
And Ziklag , and Madmannah , and Sansannah ,
translation.kha: ka Siklag , ka Madmannah , ka Sansannah ,

Ki briew ki ïa-ong ba kano ka ri kan long kum ka ri shyiap ha kaba ki briew lymne ki mrad ktien im , bad ba ïa ka yn ai nep sha ki nong Babilonia . Hynrei ïa ki Lyngkha yn sa thied pat ha kane ka ri .
translation.en: And fields shall be bought in this land , whereof ye say , It is desolate without man or beast  ; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans .
And I will give thee the treasures of darkness , and hidden riches of secret places , that thou mayest know that I , the  Lord  , which call thee by thy name , am the God of Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ïa me ki jingkynshew na ki jaka ba-dum , bakynjah ; te men tip ba nga long U  Trai  , bad ba U Blei ki Israel u la khot ïa me da ka kyrteng .

translation.en: Then Jerubbaal , who is Gideon , and all the people that were with him , rose up early , and pitched beside the well of Harod : so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them , by the hill of Moreh , in the valley .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Gideon bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki la khie dang step phyrngab bad ki la sher dara harud ka Umpohliew Harod . Ki Midian pat ki sher dara shaphang shatei na ki , ha ka them kaba harud u Lum Moreh .
ïada u briew u ïoh ïa ka tnga u hynmen jong u , baroh ar ngut kin ïap khlem kynhun . U la leh ïa kaei kaei ka bymkhuid bad u la pynkheiñ burom ïa la u hynmen .
translation.en: And if a man shall take his brother s wife , it is an unclean thing : he hath uncovered his brother s nakedness  ; they shall be childless .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u Patsha Augustus u la hukum ba shim jingkheiñ ïa ki Briew baroh ha ka Hima Rom .
translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus , that all the world should be taxed .

translation.kha: Hynrei wat thew ïa ki phyllaw kiba shabar , namar la ai noh ïa ki ha kiba mano blei thala , ki ban sa ïuhroit ïa ka Nongbah bakylluid khih sawphew ar bnai .
translation.en: But the court which is without the temple leave out , and measure it not  ; for it is given unto the Gentiles : and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months .

translation.kha: U syiem u ong ha ki pynbah synshar jongki u , Phim ïasngewthuh ba ha kñia ka sngi uwei u nongïalam bakhraw ha Israel u la ïap ?
translation.en: And the king said unto his servants , Know ye not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Israel ?

translation.kha: To pyrthuh bud ïa nga , te , kumba nga ruh nga pyrthuh bud ïa U Khrist .
translation.en: Be ye followers of me , even as I also am of Christ .
Is not God in the height of heaven ? and behold the height of the stars , how high they are !
translation.kha: Hato U Blei um shong ha ki bneng kiba hajrong tam bad jngoh shapoh ïa ki khlur , wat la ki don hajrong ?

translation.en: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee  ; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Men shu khmih ïa kata ka ri na jngai , ka ri ba nga ai ha ki Israel , hynrei men ym ïoh leit rung shata .
ka ïar sha Beth Hobah , nangta ka ïaid shaphang shatei jong ka kynjang ha kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Jordan . nongthaw ka kiew artet sha u Maw Jong u Bohan ( u Bohan u dei u khun jong u Reuben ) ,
translation.en: And the border went up to Beth–hoglah , and passed along by the north of Beth–arabah  ; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben :

translation.kha: Namar Ibbah kumno Kino kiei kiei , ka jingbitar jong U Blei ka wan ha iar ki bakohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: For which things  sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience :

translation.kha: Hynrei nga la jubab , Em , ko Trai Nongsynshar ! Ngam pat ju pynkit ïa lade . Naduh dang khynnah ngam pat ju ba-im ïa ka doh jong uno uno u mrad uba ïap hi ne uba shah pynpoh ha ki mradkhlaw . Ngam pateng ju bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam ba la kheiñ ka bymïap .
translation.en: Then said I , Ah Lord  God  ! behold , my soul hath not been polluted : for from my youth up even till now have I not eaten of that which dieth of itself , or is torn in pieces  ; neither came there abominable flesh into my mouth .

translation.kha: Bad u la jied ïa ki rangbah kiba tbit napdeng ki Israel bhor . U la thring ïa ki Kum ki nongïalam ïa ki hajar , ki spah , ki sanphew , bad ki phew .
translation.en: And Moses chose able men out of all Israel , and made them heads over the people , rulers of thousands , rulers of hundreds , rulers of fifties , and rulers of tens .
And when his disciples heard of it , they came and took up his corpse , and laid it in a tomb .
translation.kha: Haba ki synran jong u Ïoannis ki la ïohsngew shaphang kane , ki la wan bad shim noh ïa ka met jong u bad tep noh ïa ka .
Ki la lynñiar , ki da khaweh ïa la ki jaiñ , bad ki da kynting ïa u pui pui sha suiñ .
translation.en: And as they cried out , and cast off their clothes , and threw dust into the air ,

translation.kha: Hib Katai ka para ka wan , hynñiew ngut ki kynthei kin batbor ïa uwei u briew bad ong , Ngi lah ban bsa bad pynkup ïajan ïa lade , hynrei sngewbha shah ïa ngi ban ong ba phi long u tnga jyllang Ngi , ba kumta ngim donhok ban shah ïa ka jinglehrain jong ka jinglong bih pateng shongkurim .
translation.en: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man , saying , We will eat our own bread , and wear our own apparel : only let us be called by thy name , to take away our reproach .
I gave thee a king in mine anger , and took him away in my wrath .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingbitar jong nga , nga la ai ha phi ïa ki syiem , bad ha ka jingbitar shla jong nga , nga la shim noh ïa ki .

translation.en: He answered them , I have told you already , and ye did not hear : wherefore would ye hear it again ? will ye also be his disciples ?
translation.kha: Nga la dep ïathuh ïa phi ,  u la jubab ,  bad phim shym la shahshkor . Balei ba phi kwah ban ïohsngew biang ïa ka ? Lehse ma phi , ruh , phi kwah ban long ki synran jong u ?

Ki la wan sha u bad ki la ïai-ong , Ko nongkheiñ , ngi thop ba me kren ïa ka jingsuki , khlem da khuslai ïa Kiei kaban ki briew ki pyrkhat . Mem ñiew ïa ka kyrdan u briew , hynrei me hikai ïa ka jingbishar shaphang ka mon U Blei na ka bynta u brisoh . To ïathuh ïa ngi , hato ka longïng pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ban siew ki khajna sha u Patsha ka Rom ? Hato ka dei ïa i'u ban siew ne ban ym siew ?
translation.en: And when they were come , they say unto him , Master , we know that thou art true , and carest for no man : for thou regardest not the person of men , but teachest the way of God in truth : Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar , or not ?

translation.kha: U Moses u long uba lah ban shaniah ha ka ïing U Blei koum u shakri , bad u krensih ïa kiei ki kiba U Blei un sa kren ha ki por ki ba sa wan .
translation.en: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house , as a servant , for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after  ;

translation.kha: La Iso ruh , ki briew jong nga kiba khor kin ngeit Bad kin im ; hynrei lada uno uno na ki u pha dien ngan ym sngewngiah shuh ïa u .
translation.en: Now the just shall live by faith : but if any man draw back , my soul shall have no pleasure in him .

Where were white , green , and blue , hangings , fastened with cords of fine linen and purple to silver rings and pillars of marble : the beds were of gold and silver , upon a pavement of red , and blue , and white , and black , marble .
translation.kha: Ïa ka ïingsyiem la pynitynnat da ki pyrda bajngum bad balieh , ba la teh da ki tyllai linen sawjngum bani ha ki syrwiang rupa bad pyndait ha ki rishot maw marbl . Ïa ki jaka shong shaniah ha ka ïingsyiem , la shna da ka ksiar bad ka rupa , bad ïa ka madan la siang da u maw marbl balieh , maw marbl basaw , u mawkordor baphyrnai , bad u mawkordor bajngum .

translation.en: They shall bring thee down to the pit , and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas .
translation.kha: Kin pynïap ïa me bad kin phah ïa me sha ka jingtep bashong um .

translation.en: And it came to pass the third day , which was Pharaoh s birthday , that he made a feast unto all his servants : and he lifted up the head of the chief butler and of the chief baker among his servants .
translation.kha: Hadien lai sngi , ha ka lyngkhuh sngi kha jong u , u syiem u pynlong ka jingkhawai ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ; u la pyllait noh ïa u nongrah khuri bad ïa u nongshet kpu rangbah jong u , bad u la wallam ïa ki ha khmat ki rangbah synshar jong u .

translation.en: Unto Shem also , the father of all the children of Eber , the brother of Japheth the elder , even to him were children born .
translation.kha: U Shem , u hynmen jong u Japheth , u la long u kpa tymmen jong ki Hebru baroh .

Phan long shisha ka khun jrong ka kmie jong Phah . Ka la isih jur ïa u tnga jong ka bad ïa ki khun jyllang ka . Pha longïing kum ki hynriew ki para kynthei jong pha , kiba la isih ïa la ki tnga bad ïa la ki khun . Ma pha bad ki nongbam kiba shi para bad pha , phi la don ka kmie ka nong Hit bad u kpa u nong Amor .
translation.en: Thou art thy mother s daughter , that lotheth her husband and her children  ; and thou art the sister of thy sisters , which lothed their husbands and their children : your mother was an Hittite , and your father an Amorite .

So that the fishes of the sea , and the fowls of the heaven , and the beasts of the field , and all creeping things that creep upon the earth , and all the men that are upon the face of the earth , shall shake at my presence , and the mountains shall be thrown down , and the steep places shall fall , and every wall shall fall to the ground .
translation.kha: Man la ka dohkha bad ka sim , man la ka mrad , barit bad baheh , bad man la u briew halor ka sla pyrthei kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng ïa nga . Ki lumbah kin khyllem , ki riat kin twa , bad kawei pa kawei ka kynroh kan kyllon .

translation.en: And when he was come in , he did eat and drink , and said , Go , see now this cursed woman , and bury her : for she is a king s daughter .
translation.kha: u rung shapoh ïingsyiem , bad u bam jingbam . Hadien kata u ong ,  Shim ïa kato ka kynthei ba la shah tim , bad tep ïa ka ; naba ka dei ka khun jong u syiem .

translation.en: And Mizraim begat Ludim , and Anamim , and Lehabim , and Naphtuhim ,
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ijipt ki long ki briew jong ka Lydia , ka Anam , ka Lehab , ka Naphtuh ,
Slem sa katto-katne ba kine ki riewbymman kin khñium pyrshah ïa per ? Ngin la ïohsngew shibun ïa kine ki jingkynjah !
translation.en: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation , which murmur against me ? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel , which they murmur against me .

translation.kha: Kumta u leit ban kem laispah tylli ki myrsiang . U teh syrdoh ïa ki dohthang lad ki , shi jur shi jur , bad u buh ïa ki dongmusa ha kita ki sdieh .
translation.en: And Samson went and caught three hundred foxes , and took firebrands , and turned tail to tail , and put a firebrand in the midst between two tails .
And they spake unto him , saying , If thou be kind to this people , and please them , and speak good words to them , they will be thy servants for ever .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Lada phi lehsbun ïa kine ki briew bad phi pyrshang ban pynsngewbha ïa ki , da kaba ai ka jubab kaba jem kin shakri hok ïa phi borabor .

Uno uno uba pdiang ïa u nonglamktien jong U Blei nabar ba u longïng u nongpruid jong U Blei , un ïoh bynta ha ka bainong jongnga u . Bad uno uno uba pdiang ïa u briew’ uba bha namar ba u hir ibha babha , un ïoh bynta ha ka bainong jyllang u .
translation.en: He that receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet s reward  ; and he that receiveth a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man s reward .

But he that heareth , and doeth not , is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth  ; against which the stream did beat vehemently , and immediately it fell  ; and the ruin of that house was great .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong nga bad u bymkohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba la tei ïa la ka ïing khlem da pynshong nongrim ; haba ka jingshlei um ka lynshop ïa kata ka ïing , ka khyllem shisyndon — bad katno ka jingkhyllem kaba shyrkhei kata ka la long !

Ki ngor kiba long ki jongno ki kynrad ibha ngeit kim dei ban ñiuhlieh ïa ki , naba ki long ki parabangeit jong ki . Pynban , ki dien ba shakri ïa ki kham Bha shuh shuh , namar Aner kiba ïoh myntoi na ka jingtrei jong ki , ki long ki parabangeit ïa kiba ki ieit . Me dei ban hikai bad ïap ïa kino kiei kiei .
translation.en: And they that have believing masters , let them not despise them , because they are brethren ; but rather do them service , because they are faithful and beloved , partakers of the benefit . These things teach and exhort .

translation.kha: Neng la matlah namar ka jingshai baphyrnai , bad kumta ki paralok jong nga ki la btin ïa ar da ka ktieh bad ki la ïalam ïa nga sha Damaskos .
translation.en: And when I could not see for the glory of that light , being led by the hand of them that were with me , I came into Damascus .

translation.kha: Sa tang shipor phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , bad nangta sa shipor hadien phin sa ïohi ïa nga .
translation.en: A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me , because I go to the Father .

translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan ka lyer kaba jhur ka la beh , bun ki jingat phyllung ki la sawdong ban phaloh shapoh ka lieng , haduh ba ka la jin dap da ka um .
translation.en: And there arose a great storm of wind , and the waves beat into the ship , so that it was now full .
For I will set mine eyes upon them for good , and I will bring them again to this land : and I will build them , and not pull them down  ; and I will plant them , and not pluck them up .
translation.kha: Ngan khmih halor jong ki bad ngan wallam biang ïa ki sha kane ka ri . Ngan tei bha ïa ki bad ngan ym tar lyngkhot ïa ki ; ngan thung ïa ki bad ngan ym rat ïa ki .
Hammoth me lah ban pyn-i ïa ki haduh katno dei shun wait , lane ban phah noh biang ïa ki ?
translation.en: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof , and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof ?

translation.kha: Hynrei kim shngiam ong ei ei . U Jisu u la shim ïa uta u briew , U la pynkhiah ïa u , badno U la phah noh ïa u .
translation.en: And they held their peace . And he took him , and healed him , and let him go  ;
Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynsakma ïa pha kum ïa u phlangïap uba la beh noh da ka lyer ri shyiap .

Ki brai jong ka Ninebeh ki la ngeit ïa ka khubor U Blei . Kumta ki la ïa-rai ba baroh ki dei ngab shahjingit , bad ba baroh ki briew , naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw kam , ban phong jaiñ khain ban pynpaw ba ki la kylla-kaba-mut .
translation.en: So the people of Nineveh believed God , and proclaimed a fast , and put on sackcloth , from the greatest of them even to the least of them .

translation.kha: Kan ym tip ba dadien ma nga uba la ai ïa ka u kwah , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , bad baroh ka rupa bad ka ksiar ba ka ju pyndonburom ha kaba mane ïa u Baal .
translation.en: For she did not know that I gave her corn , and wine , and oil , and multiplied her silver and gold , which they prepared for Baal .

translation.kha: Pynïeng , ha shuwa ba keiñ ki kiei baroh kin jia , ïa phi yn kem bad pynthnam biah ; yn aiti ïa phi ban shah tian bishar ha ki synagog bad ban shah thep ha ka bynñiaw ; yn wallam ïa phi ha khmat ki syiem bad ki nongsynshar na ka bna jong nga .
translation.en: But before all these , they shall lay their hands on you , and persecute you , delivering you up to the synagogues , and into prisons , being brought before kings and rulers for my name s sake .
She hath done what she could : she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying .
translation.kha: Ka la leh ïa kaei kaba ka la lah ban leh ; ka la theh ïa ka jingsleh iwbih halor ka met jong nga ban pynkhreh lypa shuwa ka por jong ka jingtep ïa ka met jong nga .

translation.en: And when she had thus said , she turned herself back , and saw Jesus standing , and knew not that it was Jesus .
translation.kha: Te ka la phai dien bad ka la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u ïeng hangta ; hynrei kam shym tip ba u dei U Jisu .
Ki syiem kim haka shah ïa ka jingsniew , Namar ka jingbishar hok ka de kaba pynlong ïa ka jingsynshar kaba khlaiñ .
translation.en: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness : for the throne is established by righteousness .
Why did Jehovah create the earth ?
translation.kha: Balei U Jehobah u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei ?

translation.en: His bones are as strong pieces of brass  ; his bones are like bars of iron .
translation.kha: Ki shyieng jong u ki khlaiñ kum ka rnong , bad ki khohwah jong u ki long kum ki shalyngka nar .

translation.en: And Israel abode in Shittim , and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab .
translation.kha: Mynba ki Israel ki la shong dara ha ka Them Akasia , ki rangbah ki la sdang ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki kynthei Moab kiba don hangta .

Te ki khun Israel ki leit kyiuh sha jaka mane Blei bad ki ïamkthang ha khmat U Trai haduh janmiet . Ki kylli ïa u , Hato ngin leit ïabeh thma pyrshah ïa ki para jait jong ngi ki Benjamin ? U Trai u jubab , Ho-oid . Kumta ki paidïapom ki Israel ki la ïoh mynsiem , bad ki pynïeng ïa la ki Shiphew ha kajuh ka man kumba ki la leh ha ka sngi kaba la dep .
translation.en: ( And the children of Israel went up and wept before the  Lord  until even , and asked counsel of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go up again to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother ? And the  Lord  said , Go up against him . )

translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw , pynban , kam mon ba kheit ba une u brisoh u la long uba matlah mala mynta u la lah ban miat pat , tad ynda ki la khot ïa ki kmie ki kpa jong u bad kylli na ki ,
translation.en: But the Jews did not believe concerning him , that he had been blind , and received his sight , until they called the parents of him that had received his sight .
For by thy words thou shalt be justified , and by thy words thou shalt be condemned .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kyntien jong phi yn sa pyndonkam ban bishar ïa phi — ban pynbna ïa phi la phi long uba lui lui ne uba shah pynrem .

Un jop ïa ki bad un pynïap ïa ki , bad ki metïap jong ki kin shu sah ha ka surok bah jong kata ka nongbah bakhraw , ha kaba ïa U Trai jong ki la sahnarphna . Ka kyrteng phasi jong dat ka nongbah ka long ka Sodom , lane ka Jephthah .
translation.en: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city , which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt , where also our Lord was crucified .

translation.kha: Bad U Trai u la pynkylla ïa ka lyer mihngi sha ka lyer sepngi naba jur , ka la rong noh ïa ki puit bad bret ïa ki sha ka Duwai Basaw . Ym shym sah shuh uwei hati u puit ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kiwei .
translation.en: And the  Lord  turned a mighty strong west wind , which took away the locusts , and cast them into the Red sea  ; there remained not one locust in all the coasts of Egypt .

translation.kha: Jahath ïa ki ba kadei kaba me la leh ka dei ka dak jong Kiei ka ban jia ha ki — kine long ki nongphetwir bad kiba shat ring koidi .
translation.en: Say , I am your sign : like as I have done , so shall it be done unto them : they shall remove and go into captivity .

translation.kha: Ha u la san dap rynïeng , u la ïaleit thap mrad malu kiwei pat ki nuti . Ma u ruh u la na ban behmrad bad u kila long u nongbat briew .
translation.en: And he went up and down among the lions , he became a young lion , and learned to catch the prey , and devoured men .

translation.kha: Nga la kylli , Sa katno kan long kumne , ko Trai ? U la jubab , Tad haduh ba ki nongbah kin jaiñjot kin pra bad un-long thliem — tad haduh ba ki ïingjaiñ kin long jingheh — tad ïathuh ba ka ri hi kuna long ka jaka thylli kaba kynjah .
translation.en: Then said I , Lord , how long ? And he answered , Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant , and the houses without man , and the land be utterly desolate ,
He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine , and shall cast off his flower as the olive .
translation.kha: Un long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba duh noh ïa ki soh ki bym pat ih ; kum u dieng Olib uba hap noh ki shylluit .
U Paul u la ïajubab , Ko para nong Israel jong nga , ngam shym tip ba u dei u pynbah Lyngdoh . Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ Mem daym ban kren sniew ïa u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong me .’
translation.en: Then said Paul , I wist not , brethren , that he was the high priest : for it is written , Thou shalt not speak evil of the ruler of thy people .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingpynriam dei ban shem tang lyngba jong u ; ha ka pyrthei baroh ym khong uno uno ïa uba U Blei u la ai uba lah ban pynim ïa ngi .
translation.en: Neither is there salvation in any other : for there is none other name under heaven given among men , whereby we must be saved .

translation.kha: Ki synran ki la sngewkyndit halor kine ki ktung , hynrei U Jisu u la ong shuh shuh , Ko khun jongnga la , katto ka long kaba eh baneh rung sha ka Hima U balui !
translation.en: And the disciples were astonished at his words . But Jesus answereth again , and saith unto them ,  Children , how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God !

translation.kha: bad u la kren ibiang ha u haba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem . Hadien “kata , U Trai u la kren ha u bun bunktien , tam haduh ka sneng kob kawei jong ka jingsynshar u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Josaïah . Ha u bnai uba san jong said ka sngi , ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem la jingthrew noh! .
translation.en: It came also in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the end of the eleventh year of Zedekiah the son of Josiah king of Judah , unto the carrying away of Jerusalem captive in the fifth month .

translation.kha: Me long kumne ka umbah kaweh shaei . Hynrei men ym oh ïa ka ïadon bapawkhmat tam , Naba me la ïateh shongkha bad ka tnga kliar jong at , bun me la pynjahburom ïa ka jingïathuh u kjap jong me .
translation.en: Unstable as water , thou shalt not excel  ; because thou wentest up to thy father s bed  ; then defiledst thou it : he went up to my couch .

translation.kha: To thoh ka jingbeit shaphang kine ki hynñiew bynta bad wallam ïa ka sha nga . Nangta ngan kynoi sbai ban ïakhun bad U Tlai U Blei jong i'u na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts , and bring the description hither to me , that I may cast lots for you here before the  Lord  our God .

translation.kha: Katto katjuh ngut ki kynthei ki la don hangta , ki khmih na jngai . Napdeng jong ki , longkmie ka Mari ka nong Magdala , ka Mari ka kmie jong u Jakob ba kham rit bad u Joash , bad ka Salome .
translation.en: There were also women looking on afar off : among whom was Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses , and Salome  ;

translation.kha: U pynkylla ki pung-um ïa ki ri shyieng sad pynmih ñiuhkhlieh ha ki jaka ba-rkhiang .
translation.en: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water , and dry ground into watersprings .
He hath put down the mighty from their seats , and exalted them of low degree .
translation.kha: U la pynhiar ïa ki syiem bakhrawbor na ki khet jong ki , bad u la kyntiew shajrong ïa kiba rangli .

translation.en: For if ye love them which love you , what reward have ye ? do not even the publicans the same ?
translation.kha: Balei U Blei un ainong ïa phi lada phi ieit tang ïa ki briew kiba ieit ïa phi ? Wat ki nonglum khajna ki leh ïa kata !

translation.en: She hath sent forth her maidens : she crieth upon the highest places of the city ,
translation.kha: Ka la phah ïa la ki shakri kynthei ban pyrta na ka jaka kaba jrong tam ha kata ka nongbah :

translation.en: Your glorying is not good . Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump ?
translation.kha: Kam long kaba dei ïa phi ba phin sngewsarong ! Phi tip ïa ka jingong ,  Tang khyndiat u thiat , u pynsieb ïa u kpu im ba la khleh ?
Ka jubab , Syiem Kynrad , phi la pynong ka jingsmai bakyntang ha nga ha ka kyrteng U Trai’ U Blei jong phiah ba u Solomon , u khunlung jong nga un long syiem hadien jong phi .
translation.en: And she said unto him , My lord , thou swarest by the  Lord  thy God unto thine handmaid , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne .
This wisdom descendeth not from above , but is earthly , sensual , devilish .
translation.kha: Kaba kum kata ka jingstad kam long kaba wan hiar na bneng ; ka long jong ka pyrthei , kam long kaba kynja mynsiem bad ka long kaba kynja ksuid .

translation.en: My lips shall not speak wickedness , nor my tongue utter deceit .
translation.kha: Ki rmiang shyntur jong nga kin nym ong lano lano ïa kaba sniew , u thylliej jong nga un ym kren ïa kaba shukor lano lano ruh .
U Esra u ong , Hiar ïa U Trai , U blang naba khraw ! Baroh u paidbah u rah la ki kti shajrong bad ino , Amen ! Amen ! Ki dem khohsiew ha ka jingshakri , ki phai ki khmat jong ki sha khyndew .
translation.en: And Ezra blessed the  Lord  , the great God . And all the people answered , Amen , Amen , with lifting up their hands : and they bowed their heads , and worshipped the  Lord  with their faces to the ground .

translation.kha: bad kumta ruh katto kattne nguh ki kynthei kiba la ïohkhiah na ki mynsiem bymman bad ki jingpangnud : Ka Mari ( kaba la khot , ka nong Gedalaïah ) , na ka ba la beh noh ïa ki hynñiew ki ksuid ;
translation.en: And certain women , which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities , Mary called Magdalene , out of whom went seven devils ,

translation.kha: Ka shadem jong u mrad ka longïing ka jingai katba kyrpang , bad ka kjat-dien khambun ka long ka jingai kaba kyrpang kaba U Trai u la shimet na ki paid Israel bad ban ai ha ki lyngdoh . Kainan ka long kaba ki paid Israel ki dei ban ai ha ki lyngdoh pateng la patan .
translation.en: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings , and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan , ha ka padun ri shyiap sha mihngi jong ka Jerikho , ki jied ïa ka Beser kaba ha ka jaka ki jait Reuben , ïa ka Ramoth ha Gilead ha ka jaka ki jait Gad ; bad ïa ka Golan ha Bashan ha ka jaka ki jait Massah .
translation.en: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho eastward , they assigned Bezer in the wilderness upon the plain out of the tribe of Reuben , and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad , and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh .
Then said his sister to Pharaoh s daughter , Shall I go and call to thee a nurse of the Hebrew women , that she may nurse the child for thee ?
translation.kha: Nangta ka hynmen jong u ka ong ha ka khun u Pharaoh ,  Hato ngan leit khot ïa kawei ka kynthei Hebru ba kan ri bad sumar ïa une u khunlung na ka bynta jong phi ?
Katto katto ki rangbah na ka nongbah tyrsim ki shong ki sah ha Jerusalem , bad ki wanrah dohkha bad baroh ki jait mar sha ka nongbah ban die ha ki briew jong i ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: There dwelt men of Tyre also therein , which brought fish , and all manner of ware , and sold on the sabbath unto the children of Judah , and in Jerusalem .
She chatted with her friends about the baseball game .
translation.kha: Ka iakren bad ki paralok jongka shaphang ka baseball game .

Man ba sdang u bnai , wanrah ka jingweng thrang sha U TRAI’ : ar tylli ki masi lyngdoh , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingdiah .
translation.en: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , and one ram , seven lambs of the first year without spot  ;
And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy , and between unclean and clean  ;
translation.kha: Me dei ban pynïapher ïa kata kaba long ka jong U  Trai  na kata kaba lah ban pyndonkam paidbah , ïa kata kaba khuid na kata ka bymkhuid .
Ïaroh ïa U Trai ! To ai ki jingïaroh ïa U Terah , ñiar u long uba bha ; ka jingieit jong ka lama bymjukut .
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
And he asked them ,  How many loaves have ye ?  And they said , Seven .
translation.kha: Katno tylli u kpu phi don ?  U Jisu u la kylli .  Hynñiew tylli ki kpu ,  ki la jubab .
Kaba shiteng khlieh ka thaw ki jingïania , hynrei ka jingïaishah ka Wallam ïa ka jingsuk .
translation.en: A wrathful man stirreth up strife : but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife .

translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkmen jong to kan ïoh long ha phi malu ba ka jingkmen jong phoi kan long kaba dap pura .
translation.en: These things have I spoken unto you , that my joy might remain in you , and that your joy might be full .

translation.kha: Ki briew uba sarong ki la ïathuh Lamekh sanphew jong nga , hynrei da la ka dohthang baroh nga kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong me .
translation.en: The proud have forged a lie against me : but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart .

translation.kha: Pha la ïohsngew ïa kaei katba u patsha ka Assyria u leh ïa kano ïano ka ri kaba u rai ban pynjot . Hato phi pyrthat ba phi ïohlait im ?
translation.en: Behold , thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands , by destroying them utterly : and shalt thou be delivered ?

translation.kha: Wat klet ïa kaei kaba sam ïathuh ha phi ! Yn sa aiti noh ïa U Khun U Briew ha ka bor jong ki brup .
translation.en: Let these sayings sink down into your ears : for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men .
They chose new gods  ; then was war in the gates : was there a shield or spear seen among forty thousand in Israel ?
translation.kha: Nangta la don ka thma ha ka ri , Haba ki Israel ki jied ki blei thymmai . Na ki sawphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha Israel Don mano mano ba rah ïa ka stieh ne u sum ?

translation.en: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover , in the feast day , many believed in his name , when they saw the miracles which he did .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang don ha Jerusalem ha ka por ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , shibun ki la ngeit ha u haba ki la ïohi ïa ki kambah kiba u la leh .
Baroh ki wad jingtip na u don sngap ïa ka jingstad ba U Blei u la ai ha u .
translation.en: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon , to hear his wisdom , that God had put in his heart .

translation.kha: badno u phong ka jingkieng tait da ka rnong kaba khia kumba sanphew hynñiew kila bad ka jingda khlieh da ka rngai .
translation.en: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head , and he was armed with a coat of mail  ; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass .
But Jesus yet answered nothing  ; so that Pilate marvelled .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kyntait biang ban ong ei ei , bad u Pilat u la sngewlyngngoh .

translation.en: They have deeply corrupted themselves , as in the days of Gibeah : therefore he will remember their iniquity , he will visit their sins .
translation.kha: Ki la long sniew khlem jingkyrmen ha kaei kaei kaba ki leh , kumba ki la long ha Gibeah . U Blei un kynmaw ïa ka pop jong ki , bad un pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kata .

Hadien katai katne por , ka tnad jong u Jehoïada ka la ïap . Hadien ba u la pyndep ïa ka por ka jingïam sngewsih , ma u lem bad u paralok jong u , u Hiar uba na Adullam ki la ïaleit sha Timnah , ha kaba la khap shñiuh ïa ki lumlang jong u .
translation.en: And in process of time the daughter of Shua Judah s wife died  ; and Judah was comforted , and went up unto his sheepshearers to Timnah , he and his friend Hirah the Adullamite .

translation.kha: U ong ha la ki briew ban lum katto katne ki mawbah bad ban kynthah halor jong ki . Nangta ki ïashong ba-im ïasan kata ka kynton maïan .
translation.en: And Jacob said unto his brethren , Gather stones  ; and they took stones , and made an heap : and they did eat there upon the heap .

And Moses said unto the people , Remember this day , in which ye came out from Egypt , out of the house of bondage  ; for by strength of hand the  Lord  brought you out from this place : there shall no leavened bread be eaten .
translation.kha: U Moses u kren ha u paidbah ,  Kynmaw ïa kane ka sngi — ka sngi ha kaba phi mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha kaba phi long ki mraw . Kane ka dei ka sngi ba U  Trai  u la ïalam noh ïa phi da ka borbah jong u . Wat bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .

translation.en: Sorrow is better than laughter : for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better .
translation.kha: Ka jingsngewsih ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingrkhie ; ka lah ban pynsngewsih ïa ka durkhmat jong phi , hynrei ka pynnep ïa ka jingshemphang jong phi .

translation.en: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue , and seeth the tumult , and them that wept and wailed greatly .
translation.kha: Ki la poi ha ka ïing jong u Jairos , ha kaba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka jingkhynwin bad u la ïohsngew ïa baroh ka jingïam bad ka jingïam kthang .
Ngi pan ba U Blei ha ka mon babha jong u ha naba khatduh un pynlah ïa nga ban wan jngoh ïa phi mynta .
translation.en: Making request , if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you .

translation.kha: Ka pop jong ki Jiw ka la wallam ki jingkyrkhu ba-dap kyrhai ha ka pyiar , bad ka jingduk ba kynja mynsiem jong ki ka la wallam ki jingkyrkhu ba-dap kyrhuh ïa ki Jentil . Te , haduh katno ki jingkyrkhu ba kham khraw keiñ lama haba ïa baroh ki Jiw yn kynthup lang!
translation.en: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world , and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles ; how much more their fulness ?

translation.kha: Bad kumta U Blei u la ai ino ïa kita ki briew sha ka ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba bajakhlia uba ki dohnud jyllang ki , ki kwah , bad ki leh ïa kiei kiei uba khlemrain para ma ki .
translation.en: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts , to dishonour their own bodies between themselves :

translation.kha: Lynthem ym ni eit uno u ban heh ïa ka waiñ bathymmai hapoh ki lwa snieh kiba la pyndonkam , namar ki snieh kin pdang bad ka waiñ kan tuid shabar , malade ïa ki lwa snieh yn pynsniew . hynriew , ïa ka wiang kaba thymmai la theh noh ha ki lwa snieh im pat ju pyndonkam , bad baïar ar kin Neah .
translation.en: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles : else the bottles break , and the wine runneth out , and the bottles perish : but they put new wine into new bottles , and both are preserved .

translation.kha: Ka jingrisa , ka jingjop ! ïa-ïohi , Ngan pynlong ïa ka nongpang ka jot . Hynrei kane kan ym jia tad haduh ba uta umbah at la jied ban pynshitom ïa ka nongbah u la wan . Nangta ngan sa ai ïa ka ha u .
translation.en: I will overturn , overturn , overturn , it : and it shall be no more , until he come whose right it is  ; and I will give it him .

translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar u la ring koidi ïa ki bariew ka Jerusalem , ïa ki khun syiem shynrang baroh , bad baroh ki rangbah bapawkhmat , baroh lang shiphew hajuh ngut . U la pynryngkang par ruh ïa baroh ki nongtrei kiba tbeh , kynthup ïa ki banylla , da kaba iehnoh shad ha Judah tang ïa ki briew kiba duk tam eh .
translation.en: And he carried away all Jerusalem , and all the princes , and all the mighty men of valour , even ten thousand captives , and all the craftsmen and smiths : none remained , save the poorest sort of the people of the land .

translation.kha: U Krispos , uba long u nongïalam jong ka synagog , u la ngeit ha U Trai , lem bad ka longïing Jong u baroh ; bad kiba bun kawei pat ki briew ha kyrthat ki la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki la jingkit , bad la pynpyut ïa ki .
translation.en: And Crispus , the chief ruler of the synagogue , believed on the Lord with all his house  ; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed , and were baptized .
But thou , when thou fastest , anoint thine head , and wash thy face  ;
translation.kha: Haba phi leit khlem bam ei ei , bta ïa ka khmat jong phi bad sad ïa u shñiuh jong phi ,

Hynrei namar ba ngim lah sa ei ei ban bat ïa la ki khun kynoi bad ïa ki khun jong ki , nga kloi ban pynbang ka jingïateh kular bad me . To ngin ïaknieh ïa ki miaw ki ban pynkynmaw ïa ka jingïohthiah pynkulmar jong ine .
translation.en: Now therefore come thou , let us make a covenant , I and thou  ; and let it be for a witness between me and thee .
These shall make war with the Lamb , and the Lamb shall overcome them : for he is Lord of lords , and King of kings : and they that are with him are called , and chosen , and faithful .
translation.kha: Kin ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Khunlangbrot ; hynrei U Khunlangbrot , lem bad ki nongbud jong u ïa kiba u la khot , u la jied , bad kiba ïaineh skhem , un jop ïa ki , namar ba u dei U Trai jong ki trai bad U Syiem jong ki syiem .

translation.en: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel , saying , In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb , according to the house of their fathers , a lamb for an house :
translation.kha: Ai ïa kine ki jingbthah ha u paid Israel baroh : ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong une u bnai , uwei pa uwei u rangbah un jied ïa u khunlangbrot lane ïa u khunblang na ka bynta la ka jong ka ïing .

Kine ki longïing ki ktung jong kata ka jutang ba U Trai’ u la hukum ïa u Mosah ba-bang pynlong bad ki Israel ha ka ri ki Moab ; kane baroh ka la long ka jingbishar shuh shuh halor said ka jutang kob U Trai u la pynlong bad ki ha u Lum synrai .
translation.en: These are the words of the covenant , which the  Lord  commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab , beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb .
Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas , and took Titus with me also .
translation.kha: nangta khatsaw snemhadien  nga la leit pat sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad u Barnabas , nga da ïalam lang ruh ïa u Titos .
U Syiem Dabid u Ong , Ïa kane baroh la kynthup ha ka dur pynkhleh kaba la thoh kat kum ki jingbthah kiba U Trai da lade hi u la ai ha nga ban pyntrei .
translation.en: All this , said David , the  Lord  made me understand in writing by his hand upon me , even all the works of this pattern .

translation.kha: Ynda i'u la kam kynti ïa kata ka ri , nga ai ha ki jait Reuben bad ki jaiñjot Gad ïa ka jaka kaba shatei na ka shnong Aroer Ashan ka wah Arnon bad shiteng na ka ri lum Gaddah lem bad ki shnong jongngi ka .
translation.en: And this land , which we possessed at that time , from Aroer , which is by the river Arnon , and half mount Gilead , and the cities thereof , gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites .

translation.kha: To sngap ïa Kanneh , pha kaba ieit ïa ka jinglehsngewbha , pha kaba pyrkhat ba pha shongshngain pynlang sngewskhem . Pha kam ba pha long kaba khraw kum U Blei — ba ym don mano me pah kum ma Pha . Phan pyrkhat ba da lin lei phan ym long ka riewkynthei lane mad ïa ka jingduh noh ïa la ki khun .
translation.en: Therefore hear now this , thou that art given to pleasures , that dwellest carelessly , that sayest in thine heart , I am , and none else beside me  ; I shall not sit as a widow , neither shall I know the loss of children :
Tell it not in Gath , publish it not in the streets of Ashkelon  ; lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice , lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph .
translation.kha: Wat pynbna ïa ka ha Gath lane ha ki surok ka Ashkelon . Wat pynlong ïa ki kynthei Philistia ban kmen , wat ai ba ki khun kynthei jong ki bymngeit blei kin risa .

translation.en: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart , that , as a man chasteneth his son , so the  Lord  thy God chasteneth thee .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba kumba u kpa u sneng pynbeit ïa la u khun , kumta ruh U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u sneng pynbeit ïa phi .
Hynrei kadei ka kynthei ka pynhapoh najrong da u mawtylliat halor ka khlieh jong u , bad ka shynrong khlieh jong u ka la pait .
translation.en: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech s head , and all to brake his skull .

translation.kha: Nga la kyndit bad nga jubab , Ko Syiem Kynrad , to im junom ! Kumno ngan lah khlem imat sngewrit haba ka nongbah ha kob la tep ïa ki kpa tmain jong nga ka don hapdeng ki jingjot nabar ïa ki khyrdop jong ka la pynim ha ka ding ?
translation.en: And said unto the king , Let the king live for ever : why should not my countenance be sad , when the city , the place of my fathers  sepulchres , lieth waste , and the gates thereof are consumed with fire ?

translation.kha: Iohi ïa ki khunswet bad la , bad ngan sumar ïa ki . Ki riewkynthei ki eh ban shongkhia ha ar .
translation.en: Leave thy fatherless children , I will preserve them alive  ; and let thy widows trust in me .
My root was spread out by the waters , and the dew lay all night upon my branch .
translation.kha: Nga la long kum u dieng uba ki thied ki ïoh um borabor bad uba ki tnat ki jhieh da ki umjer .
