translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor , by the coast of the land of Edom , saying ,

translation.kha: Hato ki Sudan malade ki Libya kim don ki kynhun shaei bah pyllut ryngkat bad ki kali ïapom bad ki nongshong kulai ? Hynrei namsop ba me la shaniah ha U Trai , u la ai ka jingjop ïa me halor jong ki .
translation.en: Were not the Ethiopians and the Libyans a huge host , with very many chariots and horsemen ? yet , because thou didst rely on the  Lord  , he delivered them into thine hand .

translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai sad um shem la bud hok ïa U Trai , kumba u Daberath u kpa jong u , u la lama .
translation.en: And Solomon did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and went not fully after the  Lord  , as did David his father .

translation.kha: Kane ka mut , ba u dei ban long uba syriem kum ki para jong u ha kiei kiei baroh , ba un eh long u rangbah lyngdoh uba lah ban shaniah bad umbah sngewsynei ha ka jingshakri ïa U Balei , kumta ba yn map noh ïa ki pop ki briew .
translation.en: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren , that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God , to make reconciliation for the sins of the people .

translation.kha: U Isaïah u jubab , U Troas un sa ai ïa ka dak ban pynshisha ba un bat ïa la ka kular . Mynba , hato men jied ïa ka syrngiew ha ki mawkyrdon baneh khem shiphew jam sha khmat ne ban leit shiphew jam shait ?
translation.en: And Isaiah said , This sign shalt thou have of the  Lord  , that the  Lord  will do the thing that he hath spoken : shall the shadow go forward ten degrees , or go back ten degrees ?

translation.kha: La ei kawei ka kynthei Kaba stai hapoh ka nongbet kaba la pyrta na ka kynrup , Ha sngap ! Ha sngi ! Ong ïa u Joab ba un wan hangne ; to khiew ban ïarep bad u .
translation.en: Then cried a wise woman out of the city , Hear , hear  ; say , I pray you , unto Joab , Come near hither , that I may speak with thee .
But as God is true , our word toward you was not yea and nay .
translation.kha: Kat kumba U Blei u kren ïa ka jingshisha , ka jingkular jong nga ïa phi kam long kaba  Ho-oid  bad kaba  Em .

translation.en: The life is more than meat , and the body is more than raiment .
translation.kha: Ka jingim ka long kaba donkam kham bun shah ban ïa ka jingbam , bad ka met ka long kaba donkam kham bun shah ban ïa ki jaiñphong .

une uno uba narud ban ïaleh marpyrshah ïa u nongbishar Lane ïa u lyngngeit naba shakri ha kata ka por ha khmat U tharai U Blei jong pa ; u daym ban shah pynïap . Da kumne phin pynkhuid ïa kata ka jingbymman na Israel .
translation.en: And the man that will do presumptuously , and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the  Lord  thy God , or unto the judge , even that man shall die : and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel .

translation.kha: U pynpaw ïa ka jingtyngshaiñ ka burom U Blei bad u ïasyriem thik bad ka duriaw U Blei hi , suba kyrshan ïa ka pyrthei da ka ktien badonbor jong u . Hadien ba u la jingpdiang ka jingmap ïa ki pop u jingkhihwin , u la shong ha bneng ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei , U Bakhrawbor dak .
translation.en: Who being the brightness of his glory , and the express image of his person , and upholding all things by the word of his power , when he had by himself purged our sins , sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high  ;
Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab , and mine inward parts for Kir–heres .
translation.kha: Nga la ud da ka jingsngewsih namar ka Moab , da ka jingpangnud namar ka Kir Heres .
U Jisu u la pynkhiah bun katba pang na ki jait jingtap kiba bun bad beh noh ïa kiba bun ki ksuid . Um shah ba ki ksuid kin kren ei ei , nabar ki la tip u long ai .
translation.en: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases , and cast out many devils  ; and suffered not the devils to speak , because they knew him .

translation.kha: Ha ka Them Jordan ka kynrup ïa ka Beth Haram , ka Bethnimrah , ka Sukkoth , bad ka Sephon , kaba praw na ka hima u Sihon u syiem Heshbon . Ka pud bashaphang sepngi jongu ki ka de ka wah Jordan rahah ka Duriaw Gamaliel ha ka phang bashatei .
translation.en: And in the valley , Beth–haram , and Beth–nimrah , and Succoth , and Zaphon , the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon , Jordan and his border , even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward .

translation.kha: Ka tdem ka wanpaw mih na ki thylliej khmat jong u , kum ka tdem ki ñiut kiba la thang sha trai jong u khiew .
translation.en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke , as out of a seething pot or caldron .

Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place , where the ashes are poured out , and burn him on the wood with fire : where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt .
translation.kha: un rah ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara sha ka jaka lehniam bakhuid ha kaba yn theh ïa u dpei , bad hangta un thang ha ka kynton diengïap .

translation.en: And the children of Israel arose , and went up to the house of God , and asked counsel of God , and said , Which of us shall go up first to the battle against the children of Benjamin ? And the  Lord  said , Judah shall go up first .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki leit sha ka jaka mane ha Bethel , bad hangta ki kylli na U Blei ,  Ka jait jongno ka ban leit ïaleh nyngkong ïa ki Benjamin ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Ka jait Judah .
Uwei u briew hapdeng u paidbah u la jubab , Ko Nonghikai , la la wallam ïa u khun jongki nga sha me , namar u don u mynsiem bymhok ha u bad um nang kren .
translation.en: And one of the multitude answered and said , Master , I have brought unto thee my son , which hath a dumb spirit  ;
Then I came to them of the captivity at Tel–abib , that dwelt by the river of Chebar , and I sat where they sat , and remained there astonished among them seven days .
translation.kha: Kumta nga leit poi sha Tel Abib hajan ka wah Khebar , ha kaba shong kiba la shah ringmraw bad nga sah hangta hynñiew sngi bad ka jingsngew shaïong shaphang kaei kaba nga la ïohi bad ïohsngew .

Ngan pynlong ha kito na phi kiba dang sah ha ka jinglongmraw ka jingsheptieng kaba khraw kat haduh ba ka jingriew ka sla ngin ha ka jingbet ka lyer kan pynhiar krad ïa phi . Phin her ïap la kumba shah beh ha makhon thma , bad phin kyllon haba u nongshun um pat don hajan .
translation.en: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies  ; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them  ; and they shall flee , as fleeing from a sword  ; and they shall fall when none pursueth .

translation.kha: Ki Jiw uba la ngeit kiba la wei na Joppa lymne bad u Petros ki la sngewlyngngoh ba U Blei u la theh ïa ka jingai ïa U Mynsiem bakhadduh ha ki jingtylli ruh .
translation.en: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished , as many as came with Peter , because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: To wat duh noh ïa la ka jingshlur , te , namar ka wallam bad ka , ïa ka bainong kaba khraw .
translation.en: Cast not away therefore your confidence , which hath great recompence of reward .

translation.kha: Ka Serah ka ong , U Blei u la wanrah ka jingkmen bad ka jingrkhie ïa nga . Kat kiba ïohsngew ïa kane kin ïa-rkhie bad nga .
translation.en: And Sarah said , God hath made me to laugh , so that all that hear will laugh with me .
For through the anger of the  Lord  it came to pass in Jerusalem and Judah , until he had cast them out from his presence , that Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar haduh katta katta ïa ki briew ka Jerusalem bad Judah ha kaba u la beh noh ïa ki na khmat jong u .

Ki briew kin jubab , ‘ Dei namar ba ki la iehnoh na U Trai U Blei suba la wan ïalam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki na ka ri Ijipt . Ki la ai ïa la ka jingnguh ïa kiwei pat ki balieh , bad ki la Mane ïa ki . Kata ka long balamler ba U Trai u la pynngat ha ki ïa kane ka apot .’
translation.en: And it shall be answered , Because they forsook the  Lord  God of their fathers , which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , and laid hold on other gods , and worshipped them , and served them : therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them .

translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na Bteng kaba sawa kum ka jingkyrhuh jong ka kshaid , pynlang kum ka jingtied jam jong u pyrthat . Ka dara Kum ka sur jingim ba la tem da ki nongtem kba tem ïa la ki duitara .
translation.en: And I heard a voice from heaven , as the voice of many waters , and as the voice of a great thunder : and I heard the voice of harpers harping with their harps :
And shall cause their voice to be heard against thee , and shall cry bitterly , and shall cast up dust upon their heads , they shall wallow themselves in the ashes :
translation.kha: Baroh ki ïam pangnud na ka bynta jong pha , ki da sleh pui pui ha ki khlieh jong ki bad tyllun ha u dpei .
Nangta u Josaïah u wei phai , u la kop ïa ka Hasor bad pynïap ïa u syiem jong ka . ( Ha kata ka por , ka Hasor ka long Kaba khlei tam na kito ki hima baher . )
translation.en: And Joshua at that time turned back , and took Hazor , and smote the king thereof with the sword : for Hazor beforetime was the head of all those kingdoms .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , nga ong ha phi , ki angel jong U Blei ki risa halor iwei u nongpop uba kylla-kaba-mut .
translation.en: Likewise , I say unto you , there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repenteth .

translation.kha: Hato me haka ban pyrta hukum ïa ki lyoh bad pynlong ïa ki ban pynjhieh ïa me da u slap ?
translation.en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds , that abundance of waters may cover thee ?

And Araunah said , Wherefore is my lord the king come to his servant ? And David said , To buy the threshingfloor of thee , to build an altar unto the  Lord  , that the plague may be stayed from the people .
translation.kha: bad u kylli ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi wan shane ?  U Dabid u jubab ,  Ban thied ïa ka jaka shoh kew jong phi bad ban tei ka duwan ïa U  Trai  , khnang ban pynsangeh ïa ka jingïapthem .
La khot lang ïa ki rangbah baroh kiba ha ka nongbah ban rupa eh ïa ki , bad katba ki nang beh ïa u Joshua , kor ruh ki nang jngai na ka nongbah .
translation.en: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them : and they pursued after Joshua , and were drawn away from the city .
And when they came to Marah , they could not drink of the waters of Marah , for they were bitter : therefore the name of it was called Marah .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la wan poi ha ka jaka ïa kaba la khot ka Marah , hynrei ka um hangta ka long kaba kthang haduh katta katta ba kim lah ban dih ïa ka . Dei na kata ka daw ba la khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Marah .
ka Kabbon , ka Lahmam , ka Shitlish ,
translation.en: And Cabbon , and Lahmam , and Kithlish ,

translation.kha: bad ha ka bran kaba ïakynduh ha ka ïing jong me , bad ka Apphia ka para jong ngi , bad u Arkhippos u para shipai jong ngi :
translation.en: And to our beloved Apphia , and Archippus our fellowsoldier , and to the church in thy house :
In those days the  Lord  began to send against Judah Rezin the king of Syria , and Pekah the son of Remaliah .
translation.kha: Ka la jia ba katba u dang long syiem ba U  Trai  u phah nyngkong ïa u Resin u syiem ka Syria bad u Pekah u syiem ka Israel ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah .
Ki mawkynroh kin ïaid kai hangta , dara ki ksuid kin ïakhot para ma ki . U kparad kynsha ba shang mynmiet un wan hangta bad un wad jaka shongthait .
translation.en: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island , and the satyr shall cry to his fellow  ; the screech owl also shall rest there , and find for herself a place of rest .

translation.kha: bad laispah tyllep ki shait bakha kham rishot , ïa Kaei pa kawei la ngop da ka ksiar ba la soi kaba khia kumba lai kilo . U phah buh ïa ki barhem ha ka ruma Theh jyllang ka Khlaw Laban .
translation.en: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold : three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield . And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar Badonbor baroh u la ai kane ka jingmaham bakyntang : Nga isih ïa ka jingsarong ki briew ka Jesreel ; nga ñiewbeiñ ïa ki ïing paki dulan jong ki . Ngan ai ïa ka nongbah bakhraw bad baroh bakha don ha ka , ha u nongshun .
translation.en: The Lord  God  hath sworn by himself , saith the  Lord  the God of hosts , I abhor the excellency of Jacob , and hate his palaces : therefore will I deliver up the city with all that is therein .

translation.kha: U Dabid u rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai sngewsynei ïa u Salu Bad u Jonathan u khun jong u ,
translation.en: And David lamented with this lamentation over Saul and over Jonathan his son :

translation.kha: Ngam shym la ïohpateng ïa ka na uno isangsot u briew , dawai ym shym la don mano mano umdih ba la shithi ïa ka ha sa . U dei U Jisu Khrist hi uba la pynpaw ïa ka ha nga .
translation.en: For I neither received it of man , neither was I taught it , but by the revelation of Jesus Christ .
And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother s eye , but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?
translation.kha: Balei ba phi khmih ïa u thiat ha ka khmat jong u para jong phi , hynrei phim pynleit jingmut ïa ka lyngkhot dieng ha ka khmat jong phi ?

translation.en: This he said , signifying what death he should die .
translation.kha: ( Haba u ong ïa kane u kdew ïa ka jingïap kaba kumno un shah . )

translation.en: In the mean while his disciples prayed him , saying , Master , eat .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka por ki synran ki la ïakyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Ko Nonghikai , to bam ei ei !
Ka la anna ka nongpynim ha kiwei ruh ki ri ; hynrei ha ka ri jingïap baroh kawei , don kyrhai ka bam .
translation.en: And the seven years of dearth began to come , according as Joseph had said : and the dearth was in all lands  ; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread .

translation.kha: Nangta sa shim ïa ka samla kaban phi itynnat tam bad pynlong ïa ka , ka mahadei ha ka jaka jong ka Bashti . U syiem u la pyrkhat ba kane ka long ka jingai jingtim kaba bakha , kumta u la pynhieng ïa kata .
translation.en: And let the maiden which pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti . And the thing pleased the king  ; and he did so .
And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood , and on which it was borne up , of the one with his right hand , and of the other with his left .
translation.kha: U Samson u bat ïa kita ki rishot pdeng ar tylli kiba kyrshan ïa kata ka ïing . Da kaba buh ïa kawei ka kti ha uwei u rishot bad kawei pat ha uwei u rishot , u khynñiat pyrshah ïa ki

translation.en: And Shem and Japheth took a garment , and laid it upon both their shoulders , and went backward , and covered the nakedness of their father  ; and their faces were backward , and they saw not their father s nakedness .
translation.kha: Nangta u Shem bad u Japheth ki la shim kawei ka jaiñkup bad ki tawah ïa ka hadien jong ki ha la ka tyrpeng . Ki ïaid dadien shapoh ka ïingjaiñ bad ki tap ïa la u kpa , ki da phai dien khnang ba kin ym ïohi ïa u , ba u lyngkhuit .
Nahath ka la ïathuh ha u ïa kajuh ka khana : Uto u mluh Hebru ba phi la wan ïalam hangne , u la wanpaw rung shapoh ka kamra jong nga bad pynduhbor ïa nga .
translation.en: And she spake unto him according to these words , saying , The Hebrew servant , which thou hast brought unto us , came in unto me to mock me :

translation.kha: U phah ïa ka jingjynjar bad jingpynjot ïa kito kiba leh bymhok .
translation.en: Is not destruction to the wicked ? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity ?
The  Lord  said , Verily it shall be well with thy remnant  ; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat thee well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , ai ba ki jingtim jong ki baroh kin urlong shisha lada ngam shym la shakri bha ïa me , lada ngam shym la ïasaid bad me na ka bynta ki nongshun jong nga mynba ki don ha ka jingjynjar bad jingeh bajur .

translation.en: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out , being hastened and pressed on by the king s commandment . And the decree was given at Shushan the palace .
translation.kha: Ha ka jinghukum u syiem , ki nongshong kulai ki kiew ha ki kulai syiem bad ki pynmareh ha ka jingstet bajur . Ïa ka hukum la pynbna paidbah ruh ha Susa , ka nongbah ka hima .
Ki paidbah ki jubab , Ngin ai ïa ki ha phi da kaba sngewbha . Ki siang kawei ka jaiñ , malade uwei pa uwei u buh hangthie ïa ki sohshkor ba u la shim .
translation.en: And they answered , We will willingly give them . And they spread a garment , and did cast therein every man the earrings of his prey .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , To shahskhor , phi ki brup kiba kyllut ! To peit bha , Phin kiba matlah !
translation.en: Hear , ye deaf  ; and look , ye blind , that ye may see .
Then they told Saul , saying , Behold , the people sin against the  Lord  , in that they eat with the blood . And he said , Ye have transgressed : roll a great stone unto me this day .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul ,  Khmih , ki briew ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  da kaba bam ïa ka doh kaba dang don snam hapoh jong ka .   Phi dei ki nongshetkylla !  u Saul u kyang .  Pyntyllun uwei u maw heh shane sha nga .

translation.en: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for , the evidence of things not seen .
translation.kha: Ban ngeit ka long ban sngewskhem ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba ngi kyrmen , ban sngewthikna ïa kiei kiei kiba ngim lah ban ïohi .

Shahshkor ïa ki , ko Ishmael , nabar kohnguh ïa ki ! Te phin shem bha , bad phin nang roi malu long ka jaitbynriew kaba donbor nabar phin ïoh shong ha kata ka ri kaba tait da ka dud bad ka ngap , kumba U Trai U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la kular .
translation.en: Hear therefore , O Israel , and observe to do it  ; that it may be well with thee , and that ye may increase mightily , as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath promised thee , in the land that floweth with milk and honey .

translation.kha: To wan bad Khmih , u la jubab . ( Ka la long ha kata ka Por kamra saw baje jingtei . ) Kumta ki la saw bad u , sad ki la ïohi hangne u sah , bad ki la pynlut ïa kaba sah jong ka sngi bad u .
translation.en: He saith unto them ,  Come and see .  They came and saw where he dwelt , and abode with him that day : for it was about the tenth hour .
Wondrous works in the land of Ham , and terrible things by the Red sea .
translation.kha: Haduh katno ki kam baphylla u la leh hangta ! Haduh katno ki kam baphylla u la leh ha ka Duriaw Basaw !
U Hesekaïah u phai la ka lamkhmat sha ka kynroh bad u duwai :
translation.en: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall , and prayed unto the  Lord  ,
( John 17 :3 ) However , others also need to hear the good news so that they too can be saved .
translation.kha: ( Ioannis 17 :3 ) Hynrei , kiwei ruh ki donkam ban ïohsngew ïa ka khubor babha , khnang ba ma ki ruh kin ïoh lait im .

translation.en: Even to prepare me timber in abundance : for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great .
translation.kha: Nga kloi ban phah ïa ki rangbah jong nga bad ïarap lem ïa ki jong phi ha kaba pynkhreh shibun ki dieng , namar kane ka Templ kaba nga mut ban tei kan long kaba khraw bad kaba ishongkun .

khnam pun pyntreikam ïa ki aiñ ba la thoh ha ka blad ba u Hilkaïah u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la shem ha ka Templ , u skhem Josaïah u la weng noh na Jerusalem bad ki bynta ka Jedaïah ïa barabor ki nongleh byrtong bad ki nongïatrei kupar , bad ïa baroh ki blei ïing , ki bleithaw) , malade ki tyrwa mane plie thala .
translation.en: Moreover the workers with familiar spirits , and the wizards , and the images , and the idols , and all the abominations that were spied in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem , did Josiah put away , that he might perform the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh , te , u la leit ban ai kyrteng ïa lade , uwei uwei sha la ka jngai hi ka shnong .
translation.en: And all went to be taxed , every one into his own city .

And cast him into the bottomless pit , and shut him up , and set a seal upon him , that he should deceive the nations no more , till the thousand years should be fulfilled : and after that he must be loosed a little season .
translation.kha: U angel u la bret ïa u sha ka  liewlong khlem trai , u la khang tala ïa ka , bad u la pynskhem ïa ka , khnang ba un ym lah ban shukor shuh ïa ki jaitbynriew tad haduh ba ki shihajar snem ki la kut . Hadien kata ïa u dei ban pyllait shipor .

translation.en: The  Lord  said also unto me in the days of Josiah the king , Hast thou seen that which backsliding Israel hath done ? she is gone up upon every high mountain and under every green tree , and there hath played the harlot .
translation.kha: Mynba u Josaïah u long syiem , U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Hato me la ïohi ïa kaei ba ka Israel , kata ka kynthei bymïaineh , ka la leh ? Ka la phai lyndet noh na nga , bad halor uwei pa uwei u lum bajrong bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam , ka la leh kum ka nuti .

translation.en: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches , and the multitude of his children , and all the things wherein the king had promoted him , and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king .
translation.kha: U la kren sarong ha khmat jong ki kumno ba u long uba riewspah , ba u don bun ki khun shynrang , kumno ba u syiem u la pynkiew ïa u sha ka kyrdan ba-halor , bad kumno ba u long uba kham donkam ban ïa kiwei ki rangbah synshar u syiem .

To ai ïa ka dat ban uta ïaleh ! Put ïa ka tharai khnang ba ki jaitbynriew kin ïohsngew ! Pynkhreh ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka pynbha ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia ! Ong ïa ki hangta Ararat , Minni , bad Asekah ban tur ïaleh . Thung ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam ban ïalam ïa ka jingtur ïaleh . Wallam ïa ki kulai kum ka kynhun ki puit .
translation.en: Set ye up a standard in the land , blow the trumpet among the nations , prepare the nations against her , call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat , Minni , and Ashchenaz  ; appoint a captain against her  ; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers .

translation.kha: U Rangbah Lyngdoh jong ngi um long uta u bym lah ban sngewlem ïa ki jingtlot jong ngi . Pynban , ngi don U Rangbah Lyngdoh uba la shah pynshoi ha kiei kiei baroh kum ma ngi , hynriewphew u bym shym la leh pop .
translation.en: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities  ; but was in all points tempted like as we are , yet without sin .
And Abraham said , I will swear .
translation.kha: U Abraham u ong ,  Nga kular .
Ka jingïashad ba pynkohnguh ka ha ban pynpur ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah bakhlaiñ dak bad ka lah banbeiñ pynngeit wat ïa ki nongsynshar .
translation.en: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded , and a soft tongue breaketh the bone .

translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa , u Jehu u khun jong u Hanani , u lytar ba-bang ïakynduh ïa u syiem bad ong ha u , Hato ka long kaba Dei ban ïarap ïa kito ki briew kiba sngewieit bad ba-bang ïashoh bad kito kiba isih ïa U Trai ? katai kaba phi la leh ka la wallam ïa ka jingbitar U Trai Hamor jong phi .
translation.en: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him , and said to king Jehoshaphat , Shouldest thou help the ungodly , and love them that hate the  Lord  ? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the  Lord .
For as the lightning , that lighteneth out of the one part under heaven , shineth unto the other part under heaven  ; so shall also the Son of man be in his day .
translation.kha: Kumba ka leilieh ka thaba na shiliang sha shiliang jong ka sahit bneng bad ka pynshai ïa ka na kawei ka liang sha kawei pat , kumta un long U Khun U Briew ha ka sngi jong u .
Hynrei san katto kat kein , ka jingjia kaba phylla kan sa wan jia .
translation.en: Soon , though , an amazing event will take place .

translation.kha: Me lah ban ïakren bad u , bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba un ïa-ong . Ngan ïarap ïa phi baroh ar ngat ban kren , bad ngan ïathaw ha pa’ aïu phin sa .
translation.en: And thou shalt speak unto him , and put words in his mouth : and I will be with thy mouth , and with his mouth , and will teach you what ye shall do .

translation.kha: bad u ong , Mynno nga la dap shispah arphew snem pynlang ma haka thuh baneh long u nongïalam jong phi . Nalorkata , U Trai u la ïatyngkhuh ha na ba ngan ym ïoh ba khem ïa ka wah Jordan .
translation.en: And he said unto them , I am an hundred and twenty years old this day  ; I can no more go out and come in : also the  Lord  hath said unto me , Thou shalt not go over this Jordan .

translation.kha: Hynrei , to kynshew spah na ka bynta ïa lap ha bneng , ha kaba ki khñiang bad ka sarang kim lah baneh pynstet , bad ki nongtuh Kam lah ban prong bad tuh .
translation.en: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven , where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt , and where thieves do not break through nor steal :
For the Canaanites and all the inhabitants of the land shall hear of it , and shall environ us round , and cut off our name from the earth : and what wilt thou do unto thy great name ?
translation.kha: Ki Kanaan bad baroh kiba hapoh ka ri kin sa ïohsngew ïa kane . Kin sa kerkut ïa ngi , bad kin sa pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei ïa ngi ! Bad nangta aïu men leh ban ïada ïa la ka burom ?

translation.en: Because they have committed villany in Israel , and have committed adultery with their neighbours  wives , and have spoken lying words in my name , which I have not commanded them  ; even I know , and am a witness , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane kan long ka kupar jong ki namar ki la shah rem na ki pop bashyrkhei — ki la leh awria bad ki la ïathuh ki jinglamler ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai . Kane ka long pyrshah ïa ka mon ka jong U  Trai  ; u tip ïa kaei kaba ki la leh , bad u long u sakhi pyrshah ïa ki . U  Trai  u la kren .
kaba pynhieng ïa ka pud sepngi . Ephah kine ki pud sawdong ki shong ki sah ki briew kiba na ki longïing u Judah .
translation.en: And the west border was to the great sea , and the coast thereof . This is the coast of the children of Judah round about according to their families .

translation.kha: Nangta , ki lah ngut ki synran ki la ïohi ïa u Elijah bad ïa u Moses ba ki ïakren bad U Jisu .
translation.en: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses : and they were talking with Jesus .

translation.kha: Leh sngi hadien u Jeroboam bad ki paidbah baroh ki wan biang sha u syiem Rehoboam , kumba u la bthah ïa ki .
translation.en: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day , as the king had appointed , saying , Come to me again the third day .

translation.kha: Ha ki pateng ki ban wan , ki khun ki ksiew jyllang phi bad ki nongwei na ki ri kiba jngai kin ïohi ïa ki jingpynjot bad ki jingshah shitom ba U Trai u la pynngat ha ka ri jong phi .
translation.en: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you , and the stranger that shall come from a far land , shall say , when they see the plagues of that land , and the sicknesses which the  Lord  hath laid upon it  ;
And this man went up out of his city yearly to worship and to sacrifice unto the  Lord  of hosts in Shiloh . And the two sons of Eli , Hophni and Phinehas , the priests of the  Lord  , were there .
translation.kha: Man ka snem , u Elkanah u mih na Ramah ban leit mane bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh ha U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ha Shiloh ; ha kaba u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang u Eli , ki long ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai .

Hynrei khie joit bad ïeng . “Nga la paw ha me ban thung ïa me kum u shakri jongngi nga . Me dei ban ïaheh ïa kiwei pat ïa kaba me la ïohi ïa nga ha kane ka sngi , bad ïa kaei Kaba ngan pyn-ap ha me ha ka ban sa wang .
translation.en: But rise , and stand upon thy feet : for I have appeared unto thee for this purpose , to make thee a minister and a witness both of these things which thou hast seen , and of those things in the which I will appear unto thee  ;
And they , when they had heard that he was alive , and had been seen of her , believed not .
translation.kha: Ka la leit bad ïathuh ïa ki nongbud jong u . Ki dang ïasngewsih bad ïam ; bad haba ki la ïohsngew ïa ka , ba ka ong ba U Jisu u im bad ba ka la lah ïohi ïa u , kim shym la ngeit ïa ka .
bad u la ong ha ki , Ka jingsngewsih ha ka dohnud jong nga ka longïng kaba khraw katta jaka haduh ba ka la jan pynpeit ïa nga . Eshan Hangno bad to ïai ap .
translation.en: And saith unto them ,  My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death : tarry ye here , and watch .

translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki pyrkhat ba ngin ym ïohi ïa ki ne tip ïa kaei kabu jia haduh ba ki la long halor jong ngi , ban pynïap ïa ngi bad ban pynduh pyndam ïa ka jingtrei jong ngi .
translation.en: And our adversaries said , They shall not know , neither see , till we come in the midst among them , and slay them , and cause the work to cease .

translation.kha: Balei ba me la sngewkyndit ? u satang u la kylli ïa nga . Ngan ïathiah ha me ïa ka jingmut balieh jong kata ka briew , bad jong u mradkhlaw uba kit ïa ka , Uto u mradkhlaw uba don hynñiew tylli ki khlieh bad shiphew tylli ki rang .
translation.en: And the angel said unto me , Wherefore didst thou marvel ? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman , and of the beast that carrieth her , which hath the seven heads and ten horns .
I have digged and drunk strange waters , and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places .
translation.kha: Me kob sarong ba me la tih pukri bad dih ïa ki um ha ki ri nongwei bad ba ki kjat jong ki shipai jong me ki la ïoh ïuh pyntyrkhong ïa ka wah Nile .
Ki rangbah kiba ïaleit ryngkat malu nga , pynban , ki pynsheptieng ïa ki briew jong ngi . Hynrei nga , de la kohnguh hok ïa U Trai U Blei jong sa .
translation.en: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt : but I wholly followed the  Lord  my God .

translation.kha: Kane baroh kan jia namar ba ki paid Jeraïah ki la lai pop bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei . Ïoanna yn kynnoh na ka bynta ka jingïaleh pyrsad ki Jeraïah ? Ka Samaria hi , ka nongbah ! Mano ba shah kynnoh ïa ka jingmane bleithaw ha Judah ? Ka Jerusalem hi !
translation.en: For the transgression of Jacob is all this , and for the sins of the house of Israel . What is the transgression of Jacob ? is it not Samaria ? and what are the high places of Judah ? are they not Jerusalem ?
Yea , thou shalt go forth from him , and thine hands upon thine head : for the  Lord  hath rejected thy confidences , and thou shalt not prosper in them .
translation.kha: Phin phai noh na ka Ijipt , da kaba sdien ïa ka khlieh jong phi ha ka jinglehrain . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kyntait ïa kito kiba phi la shaniah ; phin ym ïoh kano kano ka jingmyntoi na ki .

translation.en: The nations also heard of him  ; he was taken in their pit , and they brought him with chains unto the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew shaphang jong u bad ki la riam ïa u ha ka thliew . Da ki bnoh ki tan noh ïa u sha Ijipt .

translation.en: They can provide comfort and guidance in times of trouble .—James 5 :14-16  ; 1 Peter 5 :2 , 3 .
translation.kha: Ki lah ban ai jingtngen bad kdew lynti ha ki por bajynjar .—Jakob 5 :14-16 ; 1 Petros 5 :2 , 3 .
U Joseph u jubab , Kine ki dei ki khun jrong nga kiba U Blei! u la ai ïa na hangne ha Ijipt . U Jehoba u noh , Wan ïalap ïa ki shata nga ba ngan ïoh kyrkhu ïa ki .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto his father , They are my sons , whom God hath given me in this place . And he said , Bring them , I pray thee , unto me , and I will bless them .

I am crucified with Christ : nevertheless I live ; yet not I , but Christ liveth in me : and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of God , who loved me , and gave himself for me .
translation.kha: khnang ba ym dei shuh ma nga uba im , hynrei dei U Khrist uba im ha nga . Kane ka jingim kaba nga im mynta , nga im da ka jingngeit ha U Khun U Blei , uba la ieit ïa nga bad uba la aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga .
Kumta u syiem Saul u phah khot ïa u Ahimelekh u lyngdoh bad ïa baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u , kiba la long pajut ki Lyngdoh ha Nob , bad ki la ïatan sha u .
translation.en: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest , the son of Ahitub , and all his father s house , the priests that were in Nob : and they came all of them to the king .

translation.kha: hynrei un shah pyrsad khong kum u kjit pui . Kito kiba ju tiduh ïa u kin lyngngoh shano ba u la leit .
translation.en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung : they which have seen him shall say , Where is he ?
And , lo , a spirit taketh him , and he suddenly crieth out  ; and it teareth him that he foameth again , and bruising him hardly departeth from him .
translation.kha: U mynsiem bymman u tur ïaleh ïa u da ka jinglynñiar kynsan bad bret ïa u ha ka jingkhie ring , ba kumta u sei tyrtho ha ka shyntur ; u ïai pynshitom ïa u bad da kaba eh un pyllait ïa u !

translation.en: The name of the  Lord  is a strong tower : the righteous runneth into it , and is safe .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long kum ka kut baskhem , sha kaba kiba hok ki lah ban leit bad sngewshngain .

translation.en: And the priest shall offer the sin offering , and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness  ; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering :
translation.kha: Nangta pat u lyngdoh un pynlong sa ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid . Hadien kata , un pynïap ïa uta u jingri namar ka jingainguh thang ,

translation.en: O Lord , righteousness belongeth unto thee , but unto us confusion of faces , as at this day  ; to the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and unto all Israel , that are near , and that are far off , through all the countries whither thou hast driven them , because of their trespass that they have trespassed against thee .
translation.kha: Ma me ko Trai , me leh borabor ïa kaba dei , hynrei borabor ngi la wallam ka jingjahburom ha lade hi . Kane ka long kaba shisha ïa baroh na ngi kiba shong basah ha Judia bad ha Jerusalem bad jong baroh ki khun Israel ïa kiba me la pynsakma ha ki ri kiba jan bad kiba jngai namar ki la long ki bymïaineh ha me .

translation.en: The desire of the slothful killeth him  ; for his hands refuse to labour .
translation.kha: U briew uba jaipdeh uba kyntait ban trei u shu pynïap ei ïa lade ; baroh kaba u leh ka long ban pyrkhat shaphang kaei ba u kwah ban don .

translation.en: Lo , when the wall is fallen , shall it not be said unto you , Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it ?
translation.kha: Ka kynroh kan khyllem , bad uwei uwei baroh un kylli ïa phi kaba bha aïu ka la long da ka jingpushara lieh .

translation.en: Because thou servedst not the  Lord  thy God with joyfulness , and with gladness of heart , for the abundance of all things  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu kyrhai ïa phi ha ki bynta baroh , hynrei phim shym shakri ïa u da ka dohnud kaba sngewbha bad kaba kmen .

translation.en: And I , behold , I have given with him Aholiab , the son of Ahisamach , of the tribe of Dan : and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom , that they may make all that I have commanded thee  ;
translation.kha: Nga la jied ruh ïa u Oholiab u khun jong u Ahisamakh , na ka jait Dan , ban ïatrei lem bad u . Nga la ai ruh ïa ka jinglah kaba bakhraw ha kiwei pat ki misteri kiba tbit , khnang ba ki lah ban shna ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ba dei ban shna :

translation.en: We will become perfect humans just as Adam and Eve were before they sinned .
translation.kha: Ngin sa long ki briew kiba janai kum u Adam bad ka Im shuwa ba kin leh pop .

translation.en: For the terrible one is brought to nought , and the scorner is consumed , and all that watch for iniquity are cut off :
translation.kha: Kan sa long kaba kut ïa kito kiba banbeiñ ïa kiwei bad kiba pyn-i jingñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei . Ïa uwei pa uwei u nongpop yn pynjot .
Waw ki paralok jong nga ki rkhie ïa nga mynta ; ki rkhie , wat la nga longsyiem uba hok bad u bym shah kyntiew thup ; hynne ka don ka por mynba U Blei u jubab ïa ki jingduwai jongnga nga .
translation.en: I am as one mocked of his neighbour , who calleth upon God , and he answereth him : the just upright man is laughed to scorn .

translation.kha: Ki nongtei , la jubab u Petros . kumta , te , la jubab U Jehu , kata ka mut ba ki traishnong kim dumok ban siew .
translation.en: Peter saith unto him , Of strangers . Jesus saith unto him ,  Then are the children free .

translation.kha: Nahath u Joab u la phah khubor sha u Sabad da kaba ïaheh ïa u shaphang ka tmoh ,
translation.en: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war  ;

translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat sloit bad pyrkhing shitom ïa kane baroh bad nga la ïohi ba U Blei u synshar ïa ki jinglehhok jong ki briew kiba stad bad bashalak , wat ïa ka jingieit dara ka jingisih jong ki . Ym don mano mano batip ei ei Shaphan kaei kaba dat ha khmat jong u .
translation.en: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this , that the righteous , and the wise , and their works , are in the hand of God : no man knoweth either love or hatred by all that is before them .
Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David . And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid bad u Jehoram u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

Hynrei u Sanballat , na ka shnong Beth Horon , malu u Tobiah , u rangbah synshar jong ka probins Ammon , ki la ïohsngew ba don mano myn ba la wan shun trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki Israel , bad ki la bitar haduh katta katta .
translation.en: When Sanballat the Horonite , and Tobiah the servant , the Ammonite , heard of it , it grieved them exceedingly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Israel .
Therefore will I return , and take away my corn in the time thereof , and my wine in the season thereof , and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka aïom ot ngan shim noh ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong nga da u kew bad ka waiñ , bad ngan shim noh ruh ïa u  saiwul bad ka jaiñ linen ba nga la ai ïa ka ban phong .
U Sedekaïah u la jingjubab , Wat ai ba uno uno ruh un tip ïa kane ka jingïakren , bad ka jingim jong me kan ym don ha ka jingma .
translation.en: Then said Zedekiah unto Jeremiah , Let no man know of these words , and thou shalt not die .

translation.kha: U ong , Khie leit sha Ninebeh , “kata ka nongbet kaba khraw , bad to kren pyrshah ïa ka ; nga tip ïaheh katne kiba bymman ki biria jong ka ki long .
translation.en: Arise , go to Nineveh , that great city , and cry against it  ; for their wickedness is come up before me .
And by a prophet the  Lord  brought Israel out of Egypt , and by a prophet was he preserved .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la phah ïa u nongïathuhlypa ban pyllait ïa ki paid Israel na ka jinglongmraw ha Ijipt bad ban sumar ïa ki .
Namar mynta Ngi im sha , lada phi ïeng skhem ha ka ha U thri .
translation.en: For now we live , if ye stand fast in the Lord .

translation.kha: Pynngam pat ju kmen haba ki nongshun Jong nga ki shah jyntang , ne sngewbha haba ki ïakynduh ïa ka jingpynjot ;
translation.en: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me , or lifted up myself when evil found him :

translation.kha: Haba la ïakhot ha u Dabid ba u Ahithophel u la ïasoh lang bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong u Abimael , u la duwai , Ko Trai , sngewbha pynpulom ïa ka jingaibuit u Ophel .
translation.en: And one told David , saying , Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom . And David said , O  Lord  , I pray thee , turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness .

translation.kha: Ka ïai kylli ïa u kawei ka sngi haei kawei pat . U da ngiah hi shoiñ bad thait ïa ka jingtylliat jrong ka ïa u shaphang kata .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when she pressed him daily with her words , and urged him , so that his soul was vexed unto death  ;

And in every province , whithersoever the king s commandment and his decree came , there was great mourning among the Jews , and fasting , and weeping , and wailing  ; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes .
translation.kha: Ha baroh ki jylla , hangno hangno ba la pynbna paidbah ïa ka jingpynbna u syiem , la don ka jingsawa jong ka jingïambriew hapdeng ki Jiw . Ki shahjingit , ki ïam bad lynñiar bad bun na ki , ki phong jaiñ khain bad thiah ha u dpei .
khnang ba u briew uba shakri ïa U Blei un lah ban Long uba bit pura Bad Uba la biang bha ban leh ïa baroh ki jaitniam kam kiba bha baroh .
translation.en: That the man of God may be perfect , thoroughly furnished unto all good works .
When all Israel is come to appear before the  Lord  thy God in the place which he shall choose , thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing .
translation.kha: Pule ïa ka ha ki paid Israel haba ki wan ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki ha kata ka jaka mane Blei .
Hib u Shekhem u khun jong u Hoham u khait Hib , ibha long u khlei jong kata ka thain , u la ïohi ïa ka , u la shim ïa ka , bad u la batbor ïa ka .
translation.en: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite , prince of the country , saw her , he took her , and lay with her , and defiled her .

translation.kha: Haba ki la pyndap ïa me ki khra borbah , ka la kylli la dang don shuh ne em . Uto u dei uba khatduh , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong ka u Jubab . Bad ka umphniang Olib ka la sangeh ban thuh .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the vessels were full , that she said unto her son , Bring me yet a vessel . And he said unto her , There is not a vessel more . And the oil stayed .

translation.kha: Dei na kata ka daw ba U Trai un sa hikai ïa phi kawei pa kawei ka kyntien , kawei pa kawei ka laiñ , kawei pa kawei ka jinghikai . Te phin jynthut ha kawei pa khwai ka jingjam ba phi shim . Phin sa mynsaw , shah riam bad phin long koidi .
translation.en: But the word of the  Lord  was unto them precept upon precept , precept upon precept  ; line upon line , line upon line  ; here a little , and there a little  ; that they might go , and fall backward , and be broken , and snared , and taken .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ki dohnud jong ki , ki long kiba shahskhor , mynta ki dei ban shahshitom namar ki pop jong ki . U Blei un pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , bad un pynjot ïa ki rishot kyntang jong ki .
translation.en: Their heart is divided  ; now shall they be found faulty : he shall break down their altars , he shall spoil their images .
And Pharaoh said unto Joseph , I am Pharaoh , and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ruh ha u ,  Nga long u syiem — bad yn ym don uwei ruh ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei u ban leh ei ei khlem ka jingai jingbit jong me .
Ki bymneh u Joseph te ki la bishni ïa u , hynrei u kpa jong u , u ïai puson shaphang kata baroh .
translation.en: And his brethren envied him  ; but his father observed the saying .
Rejoice and be glad , O daughter of Edom , that dwellest in the land of Uz  ; the cup also shall pass through unto thee : thou shalt be drunken , and shalt make thyself naked .
translation.kha: To ïai rkhie , ko ki briew ka Edom bad ka Us ; to kmen katba phi dang lah . Ka jingpynjot ïa phi ruh ka wan ; ma phi ruh phin ïaid sheng sheng lyngkhuit ha ka jinglehrain .

Ki paid Israel ki ong , Ngin ïaid beit na lynnong bah , bad dalade ma ngi lane ki jingri jong ngi , i'u dih ïa ka um jongnga phi , ngin da siewdor ïa ka — baroh Kaba i'u kwah ka un-long ban shu ïaid lyngba .
translation.en: And the children of Israel said unto him , We will go by the high way : and if I and my cattle drink of thy water , then I will pay for it : I will only , without doing any thing else , go through on my feet .

translation.kha: Wai sheptieng — nga lama ryngkat bad phi ! Naduh mihngi bajngai bad sha sepngi bashngain kur , ngan ïalum sha ïing ïa ki briew jongngi phi .
translation.en: Fear not : for I am with thee : I will bring thy seed from the east , and gather thee from the west  ;
And the devil said unto him , If thou be the Son of God , command this stone that it be made bread .
translation.kha: U Soitan u la ong ïa u ,  Lada me long U Khun U Blei , hukum ïa une u maw ban kylla kpu .
Tang u Loukas u don bad nga . Leit wad ïa u Markos bun wan ïalumlang ïa u ryngkat bad me , namar u lah ban ïarap ïa nga .
translation.en: Only Luke is with me . Take Mark , and bring him with thee : for he is profitable to me for the ministry .

translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ïaleit sha u Bad kyrsiew ïa u . Pyllait im ïa ngi , A Trai ! ki la ong . Ngin sa ïap !
translation.en: And his disciples came to him , and awoke him , saying , Lord , save us : we perish .
And when the Pharisee saw it , he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner .
translation.kha: U Pharisi u la kyndit haba u ïohi ba U Jisu um shym la thet ha shuwa ban bam .

translation.en: And of Dan he said , Dan is a lion s whelp : he shall leap from Bashan .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Dan u ong ,  U Dan u dei u sing samla ; Na Bashan u mih kynsan .

Haba ki shakri kynthei Jong ka Shethar pynlang ki ïunukh ki ïathuh ha ka ïa kaei kaba u Mordekai u leh , ka la skhem jingmut haduh katta katta . Ka phah Sha u Mordekai katto katne ki jaiñ ban phong ha ka jaka ki jaiñ khain , hynrei um shym pdiang ïa ki .
translation.en: So Esther s maids and her chamberlains came and told it her . Then was the queen exceedingly grieved  ; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai , and to take away his sackcloth from him : but he received it not .
It stood still , but I could not discern the form thereof : an image was before mine eyes , there was silence , and I heard a voice , saying ,
translation.kha: Nga lah ban ïohi ïa kaei kaei kaba ïeng hangta ; nga peit lyngngoh , hynrei ngam lah ban ong ka dei kaei .

translation.en: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same , and made them other five talents .
translation.kha: U shakri uba la ïohpdiang san hajar tylli ki sbai u la leit shisyndon bad u la khaïi ïa la ka pisa bad u la ïohnong sa san hajar .
Ki kherub ki ïeng shaphang shathie na ka Templ haba u rung khoh , bad u lyoh u tap ïa ka phlait kaba shapoh .
translation.en: Now the cherubims stood on the right side of the house , when the man went in  ; and the cloud filled the inner court .

translation.kha: Bad u nongïathuhlypa u ïai klun ban ong , Kane ka duwan kan pra phum Bad ïa u dpei yn pynsaphred . Te phin Tip ba U Trai u la kren lyngba jong nga .

translation.en: He blesseth them also , so that they are multiplied greatly  ; and suffereth not their cattle to decrease .
Who provideth for the raven his food ? when his young ones cry unto God , they wander for lack of meat .

translation.en: And such were some of you : but ye are washed , but ye are sanctified , but ye are justified in the name of the Lord Jesus , and by the Spirit of our God .

translation.en: And Samuel spake unto all the house of Israel , saying , If ye do return unto the  Lord  with all your hearts , then put away the strange gods and Ashtoreth from among you , and prepare your hearts unto the  Lord  , and serve him only : and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines .

translation.kha: Bad ma phin , hima , phi daym ban lama kiba la kloi , namar ba U Khun U Briew un wan ha ka kynta hajuh phim shym khim lynti ïa u .
translation.en: Be ye therefore ready also : for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not .

Then Jesus beholding him loved him , and said unto him ,  One thing thou lackest : go thy way , sell whatsoever thou hast , and give to the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come , take up the cross , and follow me .

translation.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains , and embrace the rock for want of a shelter .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai bad U Nonghikai jong phi , nga la sait ïa ki kjat jong phi . Phibi , te , phi dei ban sait ïa ki kjat sa ma phi .
translation.en: If I then , your Lord and Master , have washed your feet  ; ye also ought to wash one another s feet .

translation.kha: U Maakah u la ong ïa ki ïa ki ktieh baroh kiba u la ïohsngew ba u Barukh u la pule ha ki babha .
translation.en: Then Michaiah declared unto them all the words that he had heard , when Baruch read the book in the ears of the people .

And ye are risen up against my father s house this day , and have slain his sons , threescore and ten persons , upon one stone , and have made Abimelech , the son of his maidservant , king over the men of Shechem , because he is your brother  ; )

U la leit sha u pynbah Lyngdoh , malu u la pan ïa ki shithi pynithuh sha ki synagog kiba ha Damaskos , khnang ba lada un lap ïano ïano hangtai kiba stem ïa ka Lynti jong U Tharai , un haka ban kem ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei bad Wanlam pat ïa ki sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues , that if he found any of this way , whether they were men or women , he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la iehnoh ïa u paidbah bun u la leit rung shapoh ïing , ki synran jong u ki la wan sha u sad ki la ong , To ïathuh ïa ngi aïu ka pharshi shaphang ki ñiut hapoh ka lyngkhuit ka kit jingot .
translation.en: Then Jesus sent the multitude away , and went into the house : and his disciples came unto him , saying , Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field .
An ungodly man diggeth up evil : and in his lips there is as a burning fire .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki wad ïa ki lynti ban pynmynsaw ïa kiwei ; wat ki ktien jong ki , ki long kiba thang da ka jingsniew .

translation.en: Know therefore this day , and consider it in thine heart , that the  Lord  he is God in heaven above , and upon the earth beneath : there is none else .
translation.kha: Namar kata , kynmaw ïa kane ka sngi , bad wat klet ïa ka lano lano : U  Trai  u long U Blei ha bneng bad ha pyrthei . Ym don blei da uwei pat .
Ki Jahlil kim kein ka Hukum u Massah ; ki leh pop bad khrew lynti khlem ka Hukum . Ki Jiw ki don ka Hukum ; ki leh pop bad shah bishar da ka Hukum .
translation.en: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law : and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law ;
And believers were the more added to the Lord , multitudes both of men and women . )
translation.kha: Hynrei la nang pynïasoh kham bun ki briew sha ka kynhun — u paid ki rangbah bad ki kynthei kiba la ngeit ha U Trai .

translation.en: Then came Jesus forth , wearing the crown of thorns , and the purple robe . And Pilate saith unto them , Behold the man !
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la mih shabar , da kaba phong ïa ka pansngiat shiah bad kup da ka jaiñkup kaba sawbthuh . U Pilat u la ong ha ki ,  Khmih ! hangne uta u briew !
Pha ïakhaïi pateng ha Bela , Tubal , bad ha Meshek bad ïakylliang ïa ki ma na ka bynta ki mraw bad na ka bynta ki tiar ainong .
translation.en: Javan , Tubal , and Meshech , they were thy merchants : they traded the persons of men and vessels of brass in thy market .
Saying , Thou wentest in to men uncircumcised , and didst eat with them .

translation.en: She openeth her mouth with wisdom  ; and in her tongue is the law of kindness .

translation.en: Therefore their goods shall become a booty , and their houses a desolation : they shall also build houses , but not inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , but not drink the wine thereof .

translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , O inhabitant of the valley , and rock of the plain , saith the  Lord   ; which say , Who shall come down against us ? or who shall enter into our habitations ?

translation.en: A golden bell and a pomegranate , a golden bell and a pomegranate , upon the hem of the robe round about .

translation.en: For decades , Jehovah’s Witnesses used , printed , and distributed various versions of the Bible .

translation.en: Whom having not seen , ye love  ; in whom , though now ye see him not , yet believing , ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory :
Shall I bring to the birth , and not cause to bring forth ? saith the  Lord  : shall I cause to bring forth , and shut the womb ? saith thy God .
translation.kha: Wat pyrkhat ba ngan wallam ïa ki briew jong nga sha ka jingsuh kha bad khlem lah ban kha ïa ki .  U  Trai  u la kren .
U Petros malu kiwei pat ki apostol ki la pait ktien , Ngin dei ban kohnguh ïa U Blei , ym ïa ki Briew .
translation.en: Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said , We ought to obey God rather than men .
For God so loved the world , that he gave his only begotten Son , that whosoever believeth in him should not perish , but have everlasting life .
translation.kha: Naba U Blei u la ieit katta katta ïa ka pyrthei kat haduh ba u la aiti noh ïa U Khun ba tang marwei jong u , ba uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym ïap noh hynrei un ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut .
Nga da kwah eh ba phin long kiba laitluid na ka jingkhuslai . U briew u bym shym shongkurim u pyrkhat ïa lade ha ka kam U Trai , namar u wad ban pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: But I would have you without carefulness . He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord , how he may please the Lord :

translation.en: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them .

Hadien ka jingpule na ka Hukum u Moses bad na ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa , ki rangbah synshar jong ka synagog ki la phah khubor sha ki : Ko hynmen ko na , ngi kwah ïa phi ban kren ha u paidbah lada phi don ka khubor ai Mynsiem na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them , saying , Ye men and brethren , if ye have any word of exhortation for the people , say on .

translation.en: For it is written , He shall give his angels charge over thee , to keep thee :

translation.en: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh , and hast fenced me with bones and sinews .

translation.en: And Solomon slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David his father : and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead .

translation.en: For if I do this thing willingly , I have a reward : but if against my will , a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me .

translation.en: So David gathered all Israel together , from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hamath , to bring the ark of God from Kirjath–jearim .

translation.en: Now Samuel was dead , and all Israel had lamented him , and buried him in Ramah , even in his own city . And Saul had put away those that had familiar spirits , and the wizards , out of the land .
