translation.kha: Lada ki rangbah kiba ïashoh ki pynmynsaw ïa ka kynthei kaba punkhun , bad kata ka briew ka hap khun , hynrei kam shym mong shym mynsaw da kumwei pat , uta uba pynmynsaw ïa ka un shah shaiñ kuna kat kumba u tnga jong kata ka briew u dawa , bad u dei ban siew kumba la buh dor ki nongbishar .

translation.en: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines , and unto the border of Egypt : they brought presents , and served Solomon all the days of his life .
translation.kha: Ka hima u Solomon ka kynthup ïa baroh ki ri naduh ka wah Ïuphratis haduh ka ri ki Philistia bad ka pud Ijipt . Ki la siew khajna ïa u bad ki la hap hapoh jong u katba u dang im .
Nangta u la phar khot ïa u Joab , ban kyrpad ïa u ban leit sha u syiem na ka bynta jong u ; Hynrei u Joab um Wan . Sa syier u Absalom u la phah khot ïa u ; malade u Joab u kyntait baïong ban wanlam .
translation.en: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab , to have sent him to the king  ; but he would not come to him : and when he sent again the second time , he would not come .

translation.kha: Te ka dohnud jong ar ka ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka Moab bad na ka bynta ki briew ka Ki Heres , kumba me re ba tem ïa ka jingrwai ïapbriew ha ka jingmudui , namar baroh kiei kiei kiba daiñ ki jong ki kim don Shuah .
translation.en: Therefore mine heart shall sound for Moab like pipes , and mine heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir–heres : because the riches that he hath gotten are perished .

translation.kha: Kumta ka leit sha ka ïit jong u Ahijah ha Shual . Ka jinglong tymmen ka la pynlong ïa u Ahijah ban Mahath .
translation.en: And Jeroboam s wife did so , and arose , and went to Shiloh , and came to the house of Ahijah . But Ahijah could not see  ; for his eyes were set by reason of his age .

translation.kha: Te ïa ka burom jong U Trai yn sa pynpaw , bad baroh ki brisoh kyang ioh ïa ka . U Trai da lade u la kulai ïa kaei .
translation.en: And the glory of the  Lord  shall be revealed , and all flesh shall see it together : for the mouth of the  Lord  hath spoken it .
Save only that which the young men have eaten , and the portion of the men which went with me , Aner , Eshcol , and Mamre  ; let them take their portion .
translation.kha: Ngan ym shim ei ei na ka bynta ïa lade ; ngan pdiang tang ïa kata kaba ki briew jong nga ki la pyndonkam . Hynrei shah ba ki paralok jong nga , u Aner , u Eshkol , bad u Mamre ba kin shim ïa la ka bynta .

translation.en: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family , because he hath no son ? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father .
translation.kha: Tang namar ba im don khun shynrang , balei keiñ ba ka kyrteng jong i kan jah na Israel ? Ai bynta kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi hapdeng ki kur ki jait jong i pa .
U Jakob u jubab , Nga la sheptieng , namar la pyrkhat ïoh phin knieh jhur ïa ki khun kynthei jong phi na nga .
translation.en: And Jacob answered and said to Laban , Because I was afraid : for I said , Peradventure thou wouldest take by force thy daughters from me .

translation.kha: Ka longsem kaba ibieit ban ym suiñbneng ïa kaei Kaba ki kmie ki kpa jong phi ki hikai ; ka un-long kaba jingstad ba-bang pdiang ïa ka jingsneng jong ki .
translation.en: A fool despiseth his father s instruction : but he that regardeth reproof is prudent .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka , u la pyrta ïa ka , Ko ka briew , phan la lieh phar na ka jingpang jongno pha !
translation.en: And when Jesus saw her , he called her to him , and said unto her ,  Woman , thou art loosed from thine infirmity .

translation.kha: Haba ki para nongshong shnong na phim kino ki nongbah ki ïalum ha khmat jong phi ïa ka kam pynïap brisoh ne kano kano ka jingpynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ ne ka hukum , phi dei don bthah babha ïa ki kumno ba ki dei Ban leh donakor ïa lade! ha ka jer lad ka jingbishar , khnang ba kin ym leh ngop pyrshah ïa U Trai . Lada drama leh kumta , ma pa’ Bad ki para nongshong shang jong phi , kin sngew ïa ka bor jongki ka jingbitar U Trai . Hynrei lada phi leh ïa la ka kamram , phin long kiba la ksan .
translation.en: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities , between blood and blood , between law and commandment , statutes and judgments , ye shall even warn them that they trespass not against the  Lord  , and so wrath come upon you , and upon your brethren : this do , and ye shall not trespass .

translation.kha: bad u la ong ha U , Lada me long U Khun U Blei , pynnoh ïa lade sha tbian ; naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong : ‘ U Blei un ai lawlynnong ïa la ki angel shaphang jong me ; kin bat ïa me hajrong da ki kti jong ki , khnang ba wat ki kjat jong me ruh kine ym mynsiem ha ki maw .’
translation.en: And saith unto him , If thou be the Son of God , cast thyself down : for it is written , He shall give his angels charge concerning thee : and in their hands they shall bear thee up , lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone .
It is a continual burnt offering , which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingainguh kaba man ka sngi ba la thang lut , kaba la leh nyngkong ha u Lum Sinai kum ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
Ai burom ïa ka ïa baroh kaba ka leh . Ka dei hok ban burom da baher .
translation.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands  ; and let her own works praise her in the gates .

translation.kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi , te — nga uba long u nongsah byndi namar ba nga shakri ïa U Trai ; to im ka jingim kaba la thew kat kum ka rukom kaba U Blei u la buh haba u la khot ïa phi .
translation.en: I therefore , the prisoner of the Lord , beseech you that ye walk worthy of the vocation wherewith ye are called ,

And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah , the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah , at Beth–shemesh , and came to Jerusalem , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate , four hundred cubits .
translation.kha: U Jehoash u kem koidi ïa u Amasaïah , u tur shaphrang sha Jerusalem , bad u pyntwa ïa ka kynroh ka nongbah naduh Khyrdop Ephraim haduh Khyrdop Kyndong , ka jingjngai kumba arspah mitar .

translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  , will I assemble her that halteth , and I will gather her that is driven out , and her that I have afflicted  ;
translation.kha: Ka por kan poi ,  ong U  Trai  ,  haba ngan lumlang ïa ki briew kiba nga la pynshitom , kito kiba la shahshitom ha ka jingshah ringmraw .
Lada u briew u die mluh ïa la ka khulom , kam lah ngab ïoh ïaleit kumba ki mraw shynrang ki ïoh .
translation.en: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant , she shall not go out as the menservants do .

translation.kha: U Asekah u phah noh ïa u Jakob sha Moses , sha u lapbah , uba hir u khun jong u Bethaben u nong Abram , bad u hynmen jong ka Rebekka , ka kamai jong Jakob bad u Iso .
translation.en: And Isaac sent away Jacob : and he went to Paddan–aram unto Laban , son of Bethuel the Syrian , the brother of Rebekah , Jacob s and Esau s mother .
Nevertheless for thy great mercies  sake thou didst not utterly consume them , nor forsake them  ; for thou art a gracious and merciful God .
translation.kha: Bad pynban , namar ka jingkhraw ka jingisynei jong me , mem shym iehnoh ne pynjot ïa ki . Me long U Blei ka jingaiei bad ka jingisynei !

Ha kane ka jingtem , hato nga i kum u bymneh jingman ? Haba na pynlong ïa ki jingmut jong nga , hato nga leh ïa ki da ki jingthmu ba khwan myntoi , kum uba la kulai ban ong Iohi , ho-oid bad Em , em ha kajuh ka por ?
translation.en: When I therefore was thus minded , did I use lightness ? or the things that I purpose , do I purpose according to the flesh , that with me there should be yea yea , and nay nay ?

translation.kha: Kumjuh hadien khyndai bnai bad laiphew sngi ki la leit phai sha Jerusalem , da kaba ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri baroh kawei .
translation.en: So when they had gone through all the land , they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days .

translation.kha: Neng la leh pep , u Shaul u jubab . Khenani la kumno kumno pyn-i ka jingñiewkor ïa nga ha kham ki nongïalam jong ki briew jongngi nga malu ki Israel Baroh . Ïaleit phai ryngkat bad por , ba ngan lah Ban mane ïa U Trai U Blei jong phiah .
translation.en: Then he said , I have sinned : yet honour me now , I pray thee , before the elders of my people , and before Israel , and turn again with me , that I may worship the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: U Abram , u khulom sneng jong u , u dei u kper jong u Aaron bun u Moses . ( Ïa u Aaron bad ki ïakhun ki ksew jong u la pynkyrpang ban sumar jongno ïa ki tiew ki tar kiba khuid , ban trep jingiwbih ha ka jingmane ïa U Trai , ban shatri ïa u , malu ban kyrkhu ïa ki briew ha ka kyrteng jong u .
translation.en: The sons of Amram  ; Aaron and Moses : and Aaron was separated , that he should sanctify the most holy things , he and his sons for ever , to burn incense before the  Lord  , to minister unto him , and to bless in his name for ever .
There salute thee Epaphras , my fellowprisoner in Christ Jesus  ;
translation.kha: U Epaphras , uba don lang bad nga ha ka byndi na ka bynta U Khrist Jisu , u phah ïa ki jingai khublei jong u ïa me ,

translation.en: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God  ; that ye may know that ye have eternal life , and that ye may believe on the name of the Son of God .
translation.kha: Nga thoh ha phi ïa kane ba phin tip ba phi don ka jingim bymjukut — phi kiba ngeit ha U Khun U Blei .

translation.en: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle , and the tabernacle of the congregation , his covering , and the covering of the badgers  skins that is above upon it , and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation ,
translation.kha: Na ka jait u Kohath ki mih ki longïing jong u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebron , bad u Ussiel .
U Barak u jubab , Ngan leit lada pher leit ryngkat bad nga ; hynrei lada phim saw bad nga , nga ruh ngan ym leit .
translation.en: And Barak said unto her , If thou wilt go with me , then I will go : but if thou wilt not go with me , then I will not go .

translation.kha: kata ka nongbah kaba ngin ha tduh jong ka duriaw pynlang kaba ïakhaïi patan bad ki briew kiba shnong ha man ki rud duriaw . To ong ha ka ïa kaei kaba U Trai Nongsharai u ong : Ko Tyros , pha sngewsarong ïa ka jingbhabriew bajanai jong pha .
translation.en: And say unto Tyre , O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea , which art a merchant of the people for many isles , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; O Tyre , thou hast said , I am of perfect beauty .

translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la khot lai ïa ki baïar sha u bad u la ong , Phi tip ba ki briew ïa katba la ñiup kum ki nongsynshar jong kita kiba mane blei thala , ki leh dondor halor jong ki , bad ki nongïalam ki don ïa ka hab nadong shadong .
translation.en: But Jesus called them to him , and saith unto them ,  Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them  ; and their great ones exercise authority upon them .

translation.kha: ngat U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Khie saw sha u Pharaoh . Nga la pynmutlop ïa u malade ki rangbah syiar jongu u , khnang ba nga lah ban bor ïa phim ki kambah hapdeng jong ki ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go in unto Pharaoh : for I have hardened his heart , and the heart of his servants , that I might shew these my signs before him :
And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly  ; and he built in Judah castles , and cities of store .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jehoshaphat u nang roi bad nang khrawbor .
Ïa ki ar tylli ki thynrang jong uwei pa uwei u jingthaw la rah shajrong kumta ba ki den ïa ki khmut thapniang jong ki jingthaw ba-marsyndah , bad ki ar tylli ki thapniang ki tap ïa ki met jong ki .
translation.en: Thus were their faces : and their wings were stretched upward  ; two wings of every one were joined one to another , and two covered their bodies .
And from Mattanah to Nahaliel : and from Nahaliel to Bamoth :
translation.kha: bad nangta ki leit sha Nahaliel , bad na Nahaliel sha Bamoth ,
Thaw ar tylli ki kherub da ka ksiar kaba la shohdab tylli ,
translation.en: And thou shalt make two cherubims of gold , of beaten work shalt thou make them , in the two ends of the mercy seat .

translation.kha: Ka jingroi ki tyrpeng ki kherub ka sawa shait ka phylla kaba shabar . Ka sawa kum ka sur kren U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: And the sound of the cherubims  wings was heard even to the outer court , as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh .

translation.kha: ( Pynbna , Ka Synduk ka Jutang ka don ha Jeroboam , la buh ïa ka ha ka ïingjaiñ kaba u Syiem dab u la pynïeng mynba u wanrah ïa Ka Synduk na Kiriath Jearim . )
translation.en: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath–jearim to the place which David had prepared for it : for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Baroh ki khun ki ksiew jongno u Jehosabad kiba la wait sha Ijipt , lait noh ki tnga jong ki khun shynrang jong u , ki long hynriewphew hynriew ngut .
translation.en: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt , which came out of his loins , besides Jacob s sons  wives , all the souls were threescore and six  ;

translation.kha: Me la pyrsad ïa ka duriaw bad ka um ka kynton shynrong eh ; ka ïeng beit thik kum ka kynroh ; ka bynta bajylliew tam jong ka duriaw ka kylla eh .
translation.en: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together , the floods stood upright as an heap , and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea .

translation.kha: Mynno ngi la ju ïohi ïa me ba me pang Lane ba me don ha ka ïingbyndi , bad ba ngi wiang jngoh ïa me ?’
translation.en: Or when saw we thee sick , or in prison , and came unto thee ?

translation.kha: Man ka sngi , khlem pep , phi dei ban ai ïa ki lyngdoh ha Jeroboam ïa kaei kaei kaba ki ong ïa phi ba ki donkam : ki masi lyngraw , ki langbrot , lane ki jingkhlaiñbor ban kynsha khim ki jingtah sha U Bela jong ka Bneng , lane u khep , ka Mluh , ka waiñ , lane ka jingmane Olib .
translation.en: And that which they have need of , both young bullocks , and rams , and lambs , for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven , wheat , salt , wine , and oil , according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem , let it be given them day by day without fail :
Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad ? where are the gods of Sepharvaim ? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand ?
translation.kha: Hangno ki don mynta , ki blei jong ka Hamath bad ka Arpad ? Hangno don ki blei jong ka Sepharbaim ? Hato don uno uno uba pyllait ïa ka Samaria ?
U la ong ha nga , Ko khun u briew , Hato kine ki shyieng ki da ban ïoh pat ïa ka jingim ? Nga la jubab , A Trai nongsynshar , thrang ma me uba lah ban jubab ïa kata !
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , can these bones live ? And I answered , O Lord  God  , thou knowest .

translation.kha: Ka sniehdoh jong nga kam ïadait bha shuh bad ki shyieng ; nga la shu lait im da ka —kata .
translation.en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh , and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha kan ïoh bainong na ka bynta kaei kaba ki ong , hynrei kito kiba shukor ki thrang tang ban leh julor .
translation.en: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth : but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence .

translation.kha: Te u Annas u la phah neh ïa u , wahbah tang shah khum , shuh u Kaïaphas u Rangbah lyngkdong .
translation.en: Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest .

translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba ki pop jong ki , ki long kiba paw tyngkreiñ , bad ki pop jong ki , ki sien ha shuwa jong ki sha ka jingaibor ; hynriew ki pum jong kiwei pat ki paw kham hadien .
translation.en: Some men s sins are open beforehand , going before to judgment ; and some men they follow after .

translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong ïa ki briew ha ka por mynmiet , ‘ Wat pynsep briew ; ïa uno uno naba leh kumta yn wallam sha ka jingbishar .’
translation.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time , Thou shalt not kill  ; and whosoever shall kill shall be in danger of the judgment :
At that time Jesus answered and said ,  I thank thee , O Father , Lord of heaven and earth , because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent , and hast revealed them unto babes .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la ong ,  Ko Kpa , U Trai ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ! Nga ainguh ïa me namar ba me la pyn-i ha ki bymstad ïa kaei kaba me la buhrieh na kiba stad bad kiba la ïoh jinghikai .
Hato ki jingri jong ki bad baroh kaba ki don , kin ym long ki jong ngi ? To ïeng jyrngam ba ki lah ban shong ban sah Hapdeng jong ngi .
translation.en: Shall not their cattle and their substance and every beast of theirs be ours ? only let us consent unto them , and they will dwell with us .

translation.kha: Naba U Blei un ainong ïa uwei pa uwei kat kum kaei kaba u la leh .
translation.en: Who will render to every man according to his deeds :

translation.kha: Ka dur jong ka kaba kumno ? u kylli . Dem u tymmen uba wan mih , ka jubab . U kup da ka barandi . kamut u Saul u tip ba uta u dei u Samuel , bad u dem mynshem haduh khyndew da ka jingburom .
translation.en: And he said unto her , What form is he of ? And she said , An old man cometh up  ; and he is covered with a mantle . And Saul perceived that it was Samuel , and he stooped with his face to the ground , and bowed himself .

translation.kha: U la synshar ha Hebron halor ka Judah haduh hynñiew snem shiteng , bad ha Jeruel halor ki Israel bad Judah baroh ïathuh laiphew lai snem .
translation.en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months : and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah .
But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts : and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear :
translation.kha: Hynrei to tiengburom ïa U Khrist ha ki dohnud jong phi , bad pyndonburom ïa u kum U Trai . To long kiba la kloi ha ki por baroh ban ai ka jubab ïa uno uno uba kylli ïa phi ban batai ïa ka jingkyrmen kaba don ha phi ,
Ka don ka duriaw-bah , kaba heh dara kaba ïaroh , ha kaba ki jingthaw bym lah ñiew shuh ki im , kiba rit nabar kiba haei kumjuh .
translation.en: So is this great and wide sea , wherein are things creeping innumerable , both small and great beasts .
And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the  Lord  : and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward , by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz .
translation.kha: U Isaïah u duwai ha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew jam shadien ha ki mawkyrdon ba la buh da u Syiem Ahas .

U Joab u dem khrup haduh khyndew ha khmat u Dabid da ka jingburom bad u ainong U Blei un kerkut ïa phi , ko Syiem Kynrad ! Mynta nga tip ba phiah sngewbha ïa nga , namar phi la mynjur ïa ka jingkyrpad Jong to .
translation.en: And Joab fell to the ground on his face , and bowed himself , and thanked the king : and Joab said , To day thy servant knoweth that I have found grace in thy sight , my lord , O king , in that the king hath fulfilled the request of his servant .

translation.kha: Lada ka la pulit , un hukum ba dei ban weng noh ïa ki maw ha kiba la bit bthuh bad bret noh ïa ki sha ka jaka theh ñiah shabar shnong .
translation.en: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is , and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city :
And he said , For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand , that they may be a witness unto me , that I have digged this well .
translation.kha: U Abraham u jubab ,  To pdiang ïa kine ki hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot . Da kaba leh kumne , me kubur ba dei ma nga uba la tih ïa kane ka pukri .

translation.en: Maon , Carmel , and Ziph , and Juttah ,
translation.kha: Don ka Maon , ka Karmel , ka Siph , ka Juttah ,

translation.en: And in the fourteenth year came Chedorlaomer , and the kings that were with him , and smote the Rephaims in Ashteroth Karnaim , and the Zuzims in Ham , and the Emims in Shaveh Kiriathaim ,
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khatsaw , u Khedorlaomer lem bad kita ki syiem kiba don ha ka liang jong u ki la wan ryngkat bad la ki shipai bad jop ïa ki Rephaim ha Ashteroth Karnaim , ïa ki Susim ha Ham , ïa ki Emim ha ka pyntha jong ka Kiriathaim ,
Hynrei U ju u la ïohi ïa ka buit bashapoh jong ki bad u la jubab , Balei ba phi ïapyrshang ban riam ïa at ? Wallam ïa ka sbai rupa , Bad ai ba ngan khmih ïa ka .
translation.en: Shall we give , or shall we not give ? But he , knowing their hypocrisy , said unto them ,  Why tempt ye me ? bring me a penny , that I may see it .

translation.kha: Ki bymman ki phret ha bym ni ba beh ïa ki , hynrei u briew uba dkhoh u shlur kum u sing .
translation.en: The wicked flee when no man pursueth : but the righteous are bold as a lion .

translation.kha: Kaba kut jong kaei kaei ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingsdang jong ka . Ka jingïaishah ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingsarong .
translation.en: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof : and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit .

translation.kha: Ki de ban sngewnguh ïa U Trai na ka bynta ka jingieit baneh jong u , na ka bynta kiei ki kiba phylla naba u la leh na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: Oh that men would praise the  Lord  for his goodness , and for his wonderful works to the children of men !
But Hannah went not up  ; for she said unto her husband , I will not go up until the child be weaned , and then I will bring him , that he may appear before the  Lord  , and there abide for ever .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka kynti ka Hannah kam shym la leit . Ka ong ha la u tnga ,  Nga tang shu pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u , ngan wan ïalam ïa u sha ïing U  Trai  , bad hangta un shong baroh shi rta .

U la ïalum ïa phi lyngba ka ri shyiap kaba ïar bad kaba ishyrkhei eh , ha kaba la don ki bseiñ kiba don bih bad ki ñianglartham . Ha kata ka ri kob tyrkhong bad ka sem don um , u la pynmih um na u mawsiang na ka bynda jongno phi .
translation.en: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness , wherein were fiery serpents , and scorpions , and drought , where there was no water  ; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint  ;

translation.kha: Haba U balui u la ong ban pynjot ïa ki briew jong u , u shakri ba la jied jong u , u Moses , u la ïeng pyrshah ïa U Blei bun khan ïa ka jingbitar jongngi u na kaba pynjot noh ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore he said that he would destroy them , had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach , to turn away his wrath , lest he should destroy them .

translation.kha: U synriah halor ka duriaw , kaba u la shrong ; ka khyndew ruh , kaba u hi u la pynlong .
translation.en: The sea is his , and he made it : and his hands formed the dry land .

translation.kha: bad ki kynjoh shaphang ka jingbishar , ñiar ba ïa u nongsynshar jngai kaei ka pynrieh la lah bishar .
translation.en: Of judgment , because the prince of this world is judged .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka sngem kan poi haba ïa u nongleitkurim yn shim noh na ki , sad kumta kin sa shahthngan .
translation.en: But the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them , and then shall they fast in those days .

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u la phai biang sha U Trai bad u la ong , A Trai , balei me lehbeiñ sat ïa la ki briew ? Balei me phah ïa nga shane ?
translation.en: And Moses returned unto the  Lord  , and said , Lord , wherefore hast thou so evil entreated this people ? why is it that thou hast sent me ?

translation.kha: Haba nga shem ïa uno uno uba khrud , ibha duk palat ban ïoh thied jaiñ thied nep ,
translation.en: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing , or any poor without covering  ;
Now God himself and our Father , and our Lord Jesus Christ , direct our way unto you .
translation.kha: To U Blei hi uba U Kpa jong ngi da lade hi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi un plie ka lynti na ka bynta jong ngi ban wan sha phi!

Ngan phah ïa ki jingpang ha pha bad ban shah ba ka snep kad tuid ha ki lynti bah jong pha . Phan shah tur ïaleh na baroh ki liang , bad ïa ki briew lad pha yn pynkup . Te phan tip ba de long U tharai .
translation.en: For I will send into her pestilence , and blood into her streets  ; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la kren , Ha khmih , u la ong , ngi la iehnoh ïa kiei kai baroh bad ngi la bud ïa me . Ngin ïoh aïu ?
translation.en: Then answered Peter and said unto him , Behold , we have forsaken all , and followed thee  ; what shall we have therefore ?

translation.kha: To plie ïa ki Khyrdop ka nongbeh bad to ai ba ka jingïohipaw bashaniah kan rung , ka jaitbynriew kaba ki briew jong ka , ki leh ïa kaba dei .
translation.en: Open ye the gates , that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in .

translation.kha: Katai kaei kaba jia ka dei ka la rai lypa slem bah mynshuwa , bad ngi baroh sem tip ba phim lah ban ïania bad uno uno uba kham khlaiñ don ïa Phin .
translation.en: That which hath been is named already , and it is known that it is man : neither may he contend with him that is mightier than he .
And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias , which saith , By hearing ye shall hear , and shall not understand  ; and seeing ye shall see , and shall not perceive :
translation.kha: Kumta ka jingïathuhlypa jong u Isaïah ka la treikam ha ki :   ‘ Kine ki briew kin shahshkor bad ïai shahshkor , hynrei kim shemphang ; kin khmih bad ïai khmih , hynrei kim ïohi ,
Haba ka shukor shaphang ka jingjop ki Israel ka la Nakon ha u Jabin u syiem ka Hasor , u phah ktien sha u Jobab u syiem ka Madon , shai u symboh ka Shimron nabar u syiem ka Akhshaph ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things , that he sent to Jobab king of Madon , and to the king of Shimron , and to the king of Achshaph ,

translation.kha: Uei uba la ju ai ei ei ïa u , ba u hap baneh thor paw ïa tala ?
translation.en: Or who hath first given to him , and it shall be recompensed unto him again ?

translation.kha: Naaman ba mem shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Trai , dara mem shym la pynjot thiaw ïa ki Amalek bad ïa baroh kat kaba ki ei . Na kata ka daw U Trai u la leh kumne ïa me mynta .
translation.en: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the  Lord  , nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek , therefore hath the  Lord  done this thing unto thee this day .

translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko Trai , to khmih ïa ki jingbyrngem kiba ki la pynlong , bad shah ïa ngi , ki shakri jong me , ban kren ïa ka khubor jong me da ka jingshlur baroh .
translation.en: And now , Lord , behold their threatenings : and grant unto thy servants , that with all boldness they may speak thy word ,

translation.kha: Ki khanglad ïa kiba duk ba kin ïoh ïa ki hok jong ki bad pynbor ïa kiba kyrduh ban phet riej .
translation.en: They turn the needy out of the way : the poor of the earth hide themselves together .
Which say , It is not near  ; let us build houses : this city is the caldron , and we be the flesh .
translation.kha: Ki ong , ‘ Shen ngin tei pat ïa ki ïing . Ka nongbah ka long kum u khiew shet , bad ngi long kum ka doh hapoh jong u , hynrei la kumno kumno u la ïada ïa ngi na ka ding .’
U ïadait ïa ka jingim jong kito kiba shaniah ha u , hynrei kiba bymman kin sha jah lngaid ha ka jingdum ; u briew u jop ym da ka bor la jong .
translation.en: He will keep the feet of his saints , and the wicked shall be silent in darkness  ; for by strength shall no man prevail .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Messaïah , Ong ïa u Aaron ba un rah ïa la u diengduh halor ki wah , halor ki nur-um , bad halor ki pung-um , bad pynmih ïa ki jakoid ba ktang pyndep ïa ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Stretch forth thine hand with thy rod over the streams , over the rivers , and over the ponds , and cause frogs to come up upon the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: To ni sngewsih , to ïam , bad to ïamkthang ; to pynphong ïa ka jingrkhie ban kylla sha ka jingïam , ka jingkmen sha ka jingsngewdiaw !
translation.en: Be afflicted , and mourn , and weep : let your laughter be turned to mourning , and your joy to heaviness .
And he made the breastplate of cunning work , like the work of the ephod  ; of gold , blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ka jingdeng shadem da kijuh ki tiar da kiba la suh ïa ka ephod , bad ki pynpur itynnat ïa ka ruh ha kajuh ka rukom .

translation.en: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom , and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba da jaipdeh wat ban tian jingbam ha la ki jong ki shyntur .

Uta u briew u jubab , Mano ba thung ïa phi kamon u syiem bad nongbishar jong ngi ? Hato phi mut ban pynïap ïa ang kam phi la pynïap ïa uto u nong Ijipt ? Kumta u Moses u la sheptieng , malu u pyrkhat , Pdeng , ki bri ki la thup ïa kaei ba to la har .
translation.en: And he said , Who made thee a prince and a judge over us ? intendest thou to kill me , as thou killedst the Egyptian ? And Moses feared , and said , Surely this thing is known .

translation.kha: Ai ba baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong U Troas ! U shu hukum , bad ïa ki la pynbang ;
translation.en: Let them praise the name of the  Lord  : for he commanded , and they were created .
And thou shalt put the mitre upon his head , and put the holy crown upon the mitre .
translation.kha: Pynphong ïa ka jaiñspong ha ka khlieh jong u bad teh halor jong ka ïa ka dak bakyntang jong ka jingpynkyntang ba la thoh ‘ La Pynkyntang sha U  Trai .’
Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Ieit ïa ki phalang jong phi bad isih ïa ki nongshun jong phi .’
translation.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said , Thou shalt love thy neighbour , and hate thine enemy .

translation.kha: badno don sa kawei pat ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong , Ki bynriew kin ïakhmih ïa uta ïa uba ki la sum .
translation.en: And again another scripture saith , They shall look on him whom they pierced .

translation.kha: U Nathan u ïathuh ha u Abda ïa baroh’ naba U Blei’ u la pynpaw ha u .
translation.en: According to all these words , and according to all this vision , so did Nathan speak unto David .

translation.kha: Haba U Josis u la sngewkwah ïa kñia , u la lyngngoh bad u la ong ha ki briew katba bud ïa u , Nga ong ha phoi , ngam pat ju shem ïano ïano ha Jeriel lem bad ka jingngeit kaba kum ken .
translation.en: When Jesus heard it , he marvelled , and said to them that followed ,  Verily I say unto you , I have not found so great faith , no , not in Israel .

translation.kha: U Trai u khot wiang ïa u Samuel . U khynnah um Shim tipbriew satia ba dei U Trai , namar U Trai um pat ju la krai bad u mynshuwa . Kumta u khie joit bad u leit sha u Eli , bad u ong , Phi kut ïa nga , bun nga hangne . Hynrei u Eli u jubab , Khun jong nga , ngam shym khot ïa phi ; khie otsher thiah biang .
translation.en: Now Samuel did not yet know the  Lord  , neither was the word of the  Lord  yet revealed unto him .

translation.kha: Baroh kiba ju ïathied narud ki lyngkha lad phi ki la ïohi ba kumne ba la san jrong bad ba la iaineh khlaw ïa ki , hynrei Ngan shah ba phin rep wiang ha ki .
translation.en: And the desolate land shall be tilled , whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by .

translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u la pynkut noh ïa u Abiathar na kaban shakri kum u lyngkhuh jong U Trai , badno kumta u la pynurlong ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la ong ha Shiloh shaphang u Eli , u lyngdoh bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translation.en: So Solomon thrust out Abiathar from being priest unto the  Lord   ; that he might fulfil the word of the  Lord  , which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh .

translation.kha: Ki la klim bad pynïap briew — kaba klim bad ki bleithaw bad ka jingpynïap ïa ki khun kiba la khah na ka bynta jong nga . Ki kñia ïa ki khur jong de ha ki bleithaw jong ki .
translation.en: That they have committed adultery , and blood is in their hands , and with their idols have they committed adultery , and have also caused their sons , whom they bare unto me , to pass for them through the fire , to devour them .

translation.kha: Me kner ïa la ka kti kamon , Bad ka khyndew ka naduh ïa ki nongshun jong ngi .
translation.en: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand , the earth swallowed them .

translation.kha: Suh ki sopti , ki panpoh , bad ki tupia na ka byndi ki khun shynrang jrong u Aaron ba kin ishongkun shongkhia bad itynnat .
translation.en: And for Aaron s sons thou shalt make coats , and thou shalt make for them girdles , and bonnets shalt thou make for them , for glory and for beauty .

And ye shall offer a burnt offering , a sacrifice made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; thirteen young bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year  ; they shall be without blemish :
translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi kaba nyngkong , ai ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai  , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa u : khatlai tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , baroh ki dei ban long ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

Ha ka synsar kaba lai U Josis u la Ong , Ko Simon , u khun jong u Jona , me ieit ïa nga ? U Pethor u la sngewieit namar ba U Jisu u la kylli ïa u ha ka sien kaba lai , Me ieit ïa nga ? kumta u la ong ha u , Ko Trai , me kop ïa kiei kiei barieh ; me thup ba nga ieit ïa me ! U Jisu u la ong ha u , To sumar ïa ki langbrot jong nga .
translation.en: He saith unto him the third time ,  Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me ?  Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time , Lovest thou me ? And he said unto him , Lord , thou knowest all things  ; thou knowest that I love thee . Jesus saith unto him ,  Feed my sheep .

translation.kha: To wallam ka jingjahburom halor kita kiba pynshitom pihuiñ ïa nga , hyndai pyllait im ïa nga , A Trai . Pyndap ïa ki da ka jingshyrkhei , hynrei wat pynshyrkhei ïa sa . To wallam ka jingjot ha ki bad pynkdiah lyngkhot ïa ki .
translation.en: Let them be confounded that persecute me , but let not me be confounded : let them be dismayed , but let not me be dismayed : bring upon them the day of evil , and destroy them with double destruction .

translation.kha: Ki buh sanphew tylli ki kyrwoh ha ka rmiang jong ka lyngkhot daiñ kaba harud eh jong ka sut kaba nyngkong , bad sa Sawphew tylli ha rmiang jong ka jaiñ ka sut kaba ar .
translation.en: And he made fifty loops upon the uttermost edge of the curtain in the coupling , and fifty loops made he upon the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second .

translation.kha: Ka jinglorni kam kah ban set ïa kaba buhrieh . Kiar na ki briew kiba buiñ palat .
translation.en: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets : therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem bashlur un mihpaw . Un synshar halor ka hima bakhraw bad un har ïa kaei katai kaba u kwah .
translation.en: And a mighty king shall stand up , that shall rule with great dominion , and do according to his will .

translation.kha: U Moses u la sngewlyngngoh ïa kaei kaba u la ïohi , bun u la leit hajan ka lawlynnong ban ïohi kham Bha . Hynrei u la sngewkyiuh ïa ka sur jong U Trai :
translation.en: When Moses saw it , he wondered at the sight : and as he drew near to behold it , the voice of the Lord came unto him ,
And it shall come to pass in that day , I will hear , saith the  Lord  , I will hear the heavens , and they shall hear the earth  ;
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan phah ïa u slap ba un hap ha ka khyndew
Ki briew jong U Blei ki la mane ïa ki bleithaw , bad Kane ka la pynlong ïa ki ba kin shah pynstet .
translation.en: And they served their idols : which were a snare unto them .

translation.kha: U riewbymman u sngewsarong ha la ki jong ki jingkwah basniew ; u riewlalot u tdam bad kyntait ïa U Trai .
translation.en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart s desire , and blesseth the covetous , whom the  Lord  abhorreth .
And there came one that had escaped , and told Abram the Hebrew  ; for he dwelt in the plain of Mamre the Amorite , brother of Eshcol , and brother of Aner : and these were confederate with Abram .
translation.kha: Te uwei uba la ïohlait u wan ïathuh ïa kane baroh ha u Abram , u Hebru , uba la shong la sah hajan ki dieng kyntang jong u Mamre u kynja Amor . U Mamre bad ki para shynrang jong u , u Eshkol bad u Aber , ki dei ki paralok u Abram .
U ei ka bor briew , hyndai ngi don U Trai U Blei jong ngi u ban ïarap ïa ngi ban ïaleh ïa ki thma lad ngi . Ki briew ki eh ïa ka jingpynshlur da kine ki ktien jong u syiem jong ki .
translation.en: With him is an arm of flesh  ; but with us is the  Lord  our God to help us , and to fight our battles . And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah .

translation.kha: Haba u Seth u la dap shispah san snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Enosh ,
translation.en: And Seth lived an hundred and five years , and begat Enos :

translation.kha: Te u satang u la leit noh! , bad u Karnelian u la khot ar ngut na ki shakri ïing jrong u bad uwei u shipai uba riewblei uba long uwei na kiba shakri ïa u .
translation.en: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed , he called two of his household servants , and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually  ;

translation.kha: Me la pyni ïa ka jingieit banbeiñ sha ki hajar , hynrei me pynshitom hajuh ïa ki briew na ka bynta ki pop ki kmie ki kput jong ki . Me long U blem bakhraw bad badonbor ; me long U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands , and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them : the Great , the Mighty God , the  Lord  of hosts , is his name ,
Their visage is blacker than a coal  ; they are not known in the streets : their skin cleaveth to their bones  ; it is withered , it is become like a stick .
translation.kha: Mynta ki thiah khlem don batip ha ki lynti bah , ïa ki durkhmat jong ki la pynïong ha ka jingïap ; ka sniehdoh jong ki , ka tyrkhong kum ka dieng , ka la sti halor ki shyieng jong ki .
Bad man ba ki briew kiba don ki mynsiem bymkhuid ha ki , ki la ïohi ïa u , ki dem khrup ha khmat jong u bad ki lynñiar , Me longïing U Kun U Blei !
translation.en: And unclean spirits , when they saw him , fell down before him , and cried , saying , Thou art the Son of God .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Lusias , u rangbah Shipai u la setkut bad u la knieh jubor ïa u na im’ .
translation.en: But the chief captain Lysias came upon us , and with great violence took him away out of our hands ,

translation.kha: Naba ïa ka jingkular U Blei la pynlong ha kine ki ktien : Ha ka por kaba dei ngan wan pah , bad ka Sarah kan ïoh khum shynrang .
translation.en: For this is the word of promise , At this time will I come , and Sara shall have a son .

translation.kha: Ka Mari ka nongïeng Magdala bad ka Mari ka kmie u Josis ki la khmih bad ïohi haneng ba la buh ïa ka jemnud U jongu .
translation.en: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid .

translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki khun shngain ba ka Leah ka la kha na u Jakob ha Mesopotamia nalor ka khun kyntur jong u , ka Dinah . Baroh ki khun ki ksiew kiba u ïoh na ka Leah ki long laiphew lai ngut .
translation.en: These be the sons of Leah , which she bare unto Jacob in Paddan–aram , with his daughter Dinah : all the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty and three .
I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the ending ,  saith the Lord ,  which is , and which was , and which is to come , the Almighty .
translation.kha: Nga long u Alpha bad u Omega ,  ong U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , uba long , uba la long bad u ban sa wan .
Ki Briew ki rkhie ïa nga baroh shi sngi ; nga long ka jingbiria ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: I was a derision to all my people  ; and their song all the day .
And he said , Men , brethren , and fathers , hearken  ; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham , when he was in Mesopotamia , before he dwelt in Charran ,
translation.kha: U Stephan u la jubab ,  Ko ki hynmen ki para bad ko ki kpa , shahshkor ïa nga ! Ha shuwa ba u kpa tymmen jong ngi u Abraham un leit noh ban shong ha Haran , U Blei ka burom u la mihpaw ha u ha Mesopotamia bad u la ong ha u ,

Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai u la rai shaphang ki nong Assyria : Kin ym don kino kino kiba hiarpateng ki ban bah ïa ka kyrteng jong ki . Ngan pyndeng ïa ki bleithaw kiba don hapoh ka templ jyllang ki blei jong ki . Nga pynkhreh ka jingtep ïa ki nongtih Asaraïah — kim don hok ban im !
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath given a commandment concerning thee , that no more of thy name be sown : out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image : I will make thy grave  ; for thou art vile .

translation.kha: U pynïeng ruh ïa ka dur jong ka Blei’ Asherah . U leh shibun ban pynkhih bitar ïa U Trei , U Blei ki Jeraïah , kham king ban ïa ki syiem Jeraïah baroh ha shuwa jong u .
translation.en: And Ahab made a grove  ; and Ahab did more to provoke the  Lord  God of Israel to anger than all the kings of Israel that were before him .

translation.kha: bad nangta ki rupa sha Nahaliel , bad na Nahaliel Sha Bamoth ,
translation.en: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel : and from Nahaliel to Bamoth :
Know ye not that your bodies are the members of Christ ? shall I then take the members of Christ , and make them the members of an harlot ? God forbid .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba ki met jong phi ki long ki dkhot jong ka met U Khrist . Hato ngan shim noh shi lyngkhot na ka met U Khrist bad pynlong ïa ka shi bynta jong ka met jong ka nuti ? Kam lah ban long!

bad kumta ïa ka kulmar la pynshongduh nongrah ha ka jingngeit , khnang ba ïa ka jingngeit yn pynthikna kum ka jingai sngewbha jongnga U Blei ïa baher kiba hiarpateng na u Abraham — ym tang ïa kito kiba ngeit ïa ka Hukum , hynrei ïa kito ruh kiba ngeit kumba u Abraham u la leh . Namar u Abraham u long u kput ba kynja mynsiem jong ngi baroh ;
translation.en: Therefore it is of faith , that it might be by grace ; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed ; not to that only which is of the law , but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham ; who is the father of us all ,
The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner .
translation.kha: U maw uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymdondor u la jia long uba donkam eh na baroh .
hynne ki paidbah jongngi ka Gibeon , kiba dei ki Hiel , ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Joshua u la bor ïa ka Jeberekhaïah malu ïa ka Ai ,
translation.en: And when the inhabitants of Gibeon heard what Joshua had done unto Jericho and to Ai ,

translation.kha: Ka dei ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u ba ka kynruh shipai Babilonia , ha ka hukum ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Nebukhadnessar , ki la tur pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem , malu kerkut ïa ka .
translation.en: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem , and the city was besieged .
And he said unto them ,  How is it that ye do not understand ?
translation.kha: Bad phim pat shemphang ?  u la kylli ïa ki .
Jaban nga la ïai jur ha U Trai U Blei , da kaba ïasaid bad u , da kaba shahjingit , da kaba pha ki jai khain , bad da kaba shong ha u dpei .
translation.en: And I set my face unto the Lord God , to seek by prayer and supplications , with fasting , and sackcloth , and ashes :
But when his disciples saw it , they had indignation , saying , To what purpose is this waste ?
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ïohi ïa kane bad ki la bitar .  Balei ba shu pynsep-ei ïa kane baroh ?  ki la kylli .
U Jisu u la jingjubab , Ngam ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Ym don babha lah Ban ïohi ïa ka Hima U Blei lymda kha pat ïa u .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Verily , verily , I say unto thee , Except a man be born again , he cannot see the kingdom of God .
For it became him , for whom are all things , and by whom are all things , in bringing many sons unto glory , to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba dei eh ba U Blei , uba thaw bad pynneh ïa kiei kiei baroh , un pynlong ïa U Jisu uba janai lyngba ka jingshah shitom , khnang ban pynwan ïa kiba bun ki khun ban ïoh bynta ha ka burom jong u . Namar U Jisu u long uta uba ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingpynim .
To shahshkor ïa ki jingpyrta da kaba kum ïa ka jingjop ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki briew jong U Blei : Ka borbah jong U Trai ka la ai ïa ka !
translation.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous : the right hand of the  Lord  doeth valiantly .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba ar , kñia kharai tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shaneng , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks , two rams , fourteen lambs of the first year without spot :

translation.kha: To ki lam kiba naduh mynbarim kine dap kyrhai da u soh uba kynjai .
translation.en: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains , and for the precious things of the lasting hills ,
Thou blind Pharisee , cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter , that the outside of them may be clean also .
translation.kha: Ko Pharisi bamatlah ! To pynkhuid nyngkong ïa kaei kaba shapoh jong ka khuri , bad nangta kaba shabar kan long ruh kaba khuid !
Ka la sngewtlot ïa ka sur jong u Petros bad ka la kumne haduh katta katta ba ka la mareh pang shapoh khlem da plie ïa ka jingkhan , Bad ka la pynbna ba u Petros u ngin shabar .
translation.en: And when she knew Peter s voice , she opened not the gate for gladness , but ran in , and told how Peter stood before the gate .

translation.kha: U bymman u kyrhuh bad u byrngem kumto ki sing , isynei U Blei u pynsngap jar ïa ki bad u throsh ïa ki bniat jong ki .
translation.en: The roaring of the lion , and the voice of the fierce lion , and the teeth of the young lions , are broken .
What do ye imagine against the  Lord  ? he will make an utter end : affliction shall not rise up the second time .
translation.kha: Aïu phi ïasylla pyrshah ïa U  Trai  ? un pynjot ïa phi . Ym don mano mano uba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u palat ïa ka shisien .
Ka jingsian bad ka jingsngem jong Phin kin ïada ïa phi
translation.en: Discretion shall preserve thee , understanding shall keep thee :

Mynta nga la leh aïu keiñ ? u dabi u kylli . Haduh ngam lah seh ban kylli jingkylli ?
translation.en: And David said , What have I now done ? Is there not a cause ?

translation.kha: Hamar pdeng jong kata ka erïong , nga ïohthiah ïa kaei kaei kaba i kum ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-donnam ha ka dur ki briew ,
translation.en: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures . And this was their appearance  ; they had the likeness of a man .

translation.kha: Mynmiet ki thiah khlem don ei ei ban tap nalor jong ki , kim don ei ei ban ïada na ka jingkhraw .
translation.en: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing , that they have no covering in the cold .

translation.kha: Katba nang bun ki duwan ba ki paid Israel ki thaw ba pynkhuid ïa ki pop , katta nang bun ki jaka ba ki ïoh ngab leh pop .
translation.en: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin , altars shall be unto him to sin .

translation.kha: Ngin tur ïaleh mynmiet ; ngin pynjot ïa ki Kut jong ka nongbah .
translation.en: Arise , and let us go by night , and let us destroy her palaces .

translation.kha: Ki riewbymman ki apthap ban pynïap ïa nga , hynrei kun puson ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translation.en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me : but I will consider thy testimonies .

translation.kha: U Moses u ïohi ba u Aaron u la Pyllait lan ïa kita ki baïap kat haduh ba ki la pynkhlemrain ïa lade ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki .
translation.en: And when Moses saw that the people were naked  ; ( for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies : )
They that dwell under his shadow shall return  ; they shall revive as the corn , and grow as the vine : the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat kin shong hapoh ka jingïada jong nga . Kin thung ïa u kew bad seisoh kum ka bri sohwaiñ . Kin pawnam kum ka waiñ jong ka Lebanon .
U Dabid u kylli ïa u , Nangno me woh ? Nga la lait phet na ka jaka sher dara ki Israel , u la jubab .
translation.en: And David said unto him , From whence comest thou ? And he said unto him , Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped .

translation.kha: Kumjuh nga la sdang ban mihngi na Jerusalem dara ban leit sha ka thai Benjamin ban leit shim ïa ka bynta jong sa na ka nongkynti ka longïing .
translation.en: Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin , to separate himself thence in the midst of the people .

translation.kha: khnang ba haba na don patar bad phoi , phin ba-don wat kham bun ka daw ban sngewsarong ïa nga ha ka jingshem jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again .
For we brought nothing into this world , and it is certain we can carry nothing out .
translation.kha: Ngi wallam aïu sha ka pyrthei ? Ym don ei ei ! Ngi lah ban rah aïu pat na ka pyrthei ? Ym don ei ei !

translation.en: Hate the evil , and love the good , and establish judgment in the gate : it may be that the  Lord  God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph .
translation.kha: Isih ïa kaei kaba sniew , ieit ïa kaei kaba bha , bad peit ba ka jingbishar hok ka ïeng ha ki ïingbishar . Lehse U  Trai  , un isynei ïa ki briew jong kane ka hima kiba dang pynsah ban im .
Kut U Trai u ong ha nga , ‘ Ki la kyrwep ïa kaba dei eh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , They have well spoken that which they have spoken .

translation.kha: Lada phi la un-long kiba bieit shisha ban sngewmeng bad ban thmu sniew , shaneng pynlang pyrkhat !
translation.en: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself , or if thou hast thought evil , lay thine hand upon thy mouth .

translation.kha: U Terah u la hukum ïa ngi ban leh ïa keiñ kai kiba ngi la leh mynta ka sngi , khnang ban map ïa ka pop jyllang phi! .
translation.en: As he hath done this day , so the  Lord  hath commanded to do , to make an atonement for you .
Yea , and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith , I joy , and rejoice with you all .
translation.kha: Lehse ïa ka snam jong ka jingim jong nga la dei ban theh noh kum ka jingainguh halor ka jingkñia kaba long ka jingngeit jong phi ba ai sha U Blei . Lada kata ka long kumta , nga shadkmen bad nga ïasam bynta lem ïa ka jingkmen jong nga bad phi baroh .

translation.en: And Samuel said to all the people , See ye him whom the  Lord  hath chosen , that there is none like him among all the people ? And all the people shouted , and said , God save the king .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha uta u paidbah ,  Hangne u long uta u briew uba U  Trai  u la jied . Ym don uba kum ma u hapdeng jong ngi .  Baroh u paidbah u risa ,  To un im slem u syiem !

U lyngdoh un kñia ïa ka jingainguh jong ka ha U Trai bad un pynlong ka jinglehniam ban shim noh ïa ka jingbymkhuid jong ka ; bun Kan sa long kaba la pynkhuid . Kane ka long kaba ka kynthei ka dei don leh hadien ba kha khwan .
translation.en: Who shall offer it before the  Lord  , and make an atonement for her  ; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood . This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female .

translation.kha: A Blei me la iehnoh ïa ki briew jong me , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob ! Ka ri ka dap da ki jingleh myntor na ka ri Mihngi bad na ka Philistia . Ki briew ki bud ïa ki dustur nongwei .
translation.en: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob , because they be replenished from the east , and are soothsayers like the Philistines , and they please themselves in the children of strangers .
A good man sheweth favour , and lendeth : he will guide his affairs with discretion .
translation.kha: Suk uta u briew uba sbun ha ka jingairam jong u , uba pynïaid hok ïa ka kam khaïi jong u .
Ki blei jongno kiwei ki jyrthiaw barhem ki long tang ki balaitluid , hynne U Trai u thaw ïa ki bneng .
translation.en: For all the gods of the people are idols : but the  Lord  made the heavens .
And he denied it again . And a little after , they that stood by said again to Peter , Surely thou art one of them : for thou art a Galilaean , and thy speech agreeth thereto .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la len biang ïa kata . Katto katne por hadien , kiba ïa-ïeng hangta ki la mudui biang ïa u Petros ,  Mem lah ban len ba me long uwei na ki , namar ma me ruh , me long na Galilaïa .

translation.en: But the tongue can no man tame  ; it is an unruly evil , full of deadly poison .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym don mano mano ba la lah ban pynjuh ïa u thylliej . U long uba sniew bad bym lah ban synshar , uba dap da ka bih ba pynïap .
Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka Khubor jong me , bad ka pyrthei ka la shun ïa ki , namar ba kdor dem jong kane ka pyrthei , kumba to ruh ngam dei na khnai ka pyrthei .
translation.en: I have given them thy word  ; and the world hath hated them , because they are not of the world , even as I am not of the world .

translation.kha: U Tiras u kylli ïa u , Na-ei me wan ? U Goiim u jubab , Nga la leit ïaid shaniah bad shathie , da kaba shankhung pylleng sawdong ka pyrthiew .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , From whence comest thou ? And Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , From going to and fro in the earth , and from walking up and down in it .
And he brought forth his people with joy , and his chosen with gladness :
translation.kha: Kumta u ïalam noh ïa ki briew ba la jied jong u , bad ki rwai bad pyrta da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: Therefore , behold , I will allure her , and bring her into the wilderness , and speak comfortably unto her .
translation.kha: Te ngan leit ïalam biang ïa ka sha ri shyiap ; hangta ngan khroh biang ïa ka da ki ktien ieit .

translation.en: And it came to pass at noon , that Elijah mocked them , and said , Cry aloud : for he is a god  ; either he is talking , or he is pursuing , or he is in a journey , or peradventure he sleepeth , and must be awaked .
translation.kha: Ynda la dap shiteng sngi u Elijah u la sdang ban kren biria ïa ki :  Duwai kham jam ! U dei u blei ! Lehse u dang phohsniew lane u dang leit shabar lane lehse u dang leit jingleit ! Lane lehse u dang ïohthiah , phin hap ban kyrsiew ïa u !

translation.en: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness , and prayed .
translation.kha: Hynrei u ju leit noh sha ki jaka kynjah , ha kaba u la duwai .

U Trai u la ïar ïa ki paid Judah , bad ki la shim kynti ïa ka ri lum . Hynriew kim shym la kurup ïa ka Gasa , ka Ashkelon , lane ka Ekron lem bad ki jaka Syndong jong ki . Kine ki briew kiba shong basah harud duriaw ki don ïa ki kali ïapom da ka nar , bad kumta ki paid Judah Ki shym la lah ban beh kparad ïa ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Judah  ; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain  ; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley , because they had chariots of iron .

translation.kha: Ka don ka jingïam kaweh la pynpaw ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid , kaba nga sngewtmang kaba tnaw ïa U Khrist mala ïa ka balang .
translation.en: This is a great mystery : but I speak concerning Christ and the church .

translation.kha: Ki ei u syiem uba synshar phalor jongno ki , uba long u angel uba khum ïa ka liewlong ba khlem trai . Ka kyrteng jong u ha ka ktien Khebar ka long u ïadon ; bad ha ka kti Grik ka long u Apollyon ( kaba mut u Nongpynjot ) .
translation.en: And they had a king over them , which is the angel of the bottomless pit , whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon , but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon .

translation.kha: bad ha ïakylliang ka ri , ar na ka lai bynta ki briew kin ïap .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that in all the land , saith the  Lord  , two parts therein shall be cut off and die  ; but the third shall be left therein .

translation.kha: bad u la ong , Ko Kynrad , to isynei ïa u khun jong la ! U erlangthari uba pang ring dara u la don ka jingkhie ring kaba shyrkhei eh ba basian u tap ha ka ding lane ha ka um .
translation.en: Lord , have mercy on my son : for he is lunatic , and sore vexed : for ofttimes he falleth into the fire , and oft into the water .

translation.kha: Ki shna ruh sa ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bun ki pyndait ïa ki ha trai jong kita ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng kiba sha khmied jong ka ephod , hamar ka jaka suh pyndait , bad haneng ka jingpanpoh ba la thapniang ibit bha .
translation.en: And they made two other golden rings , and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart of it , over against the other coupling thereof , above the curious girdle of the ephod .

translation.kha: Namarba ki long ki bym janai , ki dei pun nang ban ïamap iwei ïa iwei , kane ka long kaba donkam khnang ba kin ïoh jingkmen .—Pule Ephesos 4 :31 , 32 ; 5 :22-25 , 33 ; 1 Petros 3 :7 .
translation.en: Since all husbands and wives are imperfect , learning to forgive is a key to happiness in marriage . —Read Ephesians 4 :31 , 32  ; 5 :22-25 , 33  ; 1 Peter 3 :7 .

translation.kha: U la Law ïa ki sharai baneh pynsngap ka jaiñspong bakhuid halor ka khlieh jong u Jehosheba . Ki la leh kumta , bad nangta ki la pynphong ki jaiñ thymmai ïa u katba u angel jong U Trai’ u ding ïeng hangta .
translation.en: And I said , Let them set a fair mitre upon his head . So they set a fair mitre upon his head , and clothed him with garments . And the angel of the  Lord  stood by .

translation.kha: Ki la ïalumlang tista ban duwai kum ka kynha , ryngkat lem bad ki kynthei bad ka Mari ka kmie jong U Jisu bad ki para shynrang jong u .
translation.en: These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication , with the women , and Mary the mother of Jesus , and with his brethren .

translation.kha: Namar ba la rai pynrem ïa nga , balei te sam salia shiah ?
translation.en: If I be wicked , why then labour I in vain ?

translation.kha: Uwei pat u la ong , ‘ Nga la thied san jrut ki masi dab bad nga don ha ka lynti ïa-ban tynjuh ïa ki ; sngewbha pynpdang ïa ka jingblei wan jong nga .’
translation.en: And another said , I have bought five yoke of oxen , and I go to prove them : I pray thee have me excused .
And Abram was very rich in cattle , in silver , and in gold .
translation.kha: U Abram u la long uba riewspah shibun , ha ka jingdon ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang , kumjuh ruh ha ka jingdon ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar .
Ka la tan ïa u na ka jaiñkup , Bad ka jong , Abel shiah Bad nga . Hynrei u la laitim pui sad u la mareh shabar da kaba iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup ha ka ki jong ka .
translation.en: And she caught him by his garment , saying , Lie with me : and he left his garment in her hand , and fled , and got him out .

translation.kha: Suk kita ïa naba la map noh! ïa ki jingleh bymdei , kiba ïa ki pop la map iwei!
translation.en: Saying , Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven , and whose sins are covered .
Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba long U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ïa ka jingsuk .

translation.en: (For many walk , of whom I have told you often , and now tell you even weeping , that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ :
translation.kha: Nga la ïathuh ha phi ïa kane bunsien mynshuwa , bad mynta nga ïathuh biang ïa ka da ki jingjaw ummat ; don shibun kiba ka jingim jong ki , ka pynlong ïa ki , ki nongshun jong ka jingïap U Khrist ha ka diengphna .

translation.en: So Gad came to David , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Choose thee
translation.kha: U Gad u la leit sha U Dabid , u ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ong , bad u kylli ,  Kano men jied ?
Kaei kaba la jia ha ki , ka pynpaw ba ki Proberb ki long kiba pahara : U ksar u leit phai pat sha la ka prie bad u sniang ïa uba la pynsum pynsait u leit kyrsum pat ha ka ktieh .
translation.en: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb , The dog is turned to his own vomit again  ; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire .

translation.kha: Ka Martha ka la khuslai halor ki kam baroh kiba ka la dei ban lai , kumta ka la wan sad ka la ong , Ko Trai , Hato mem pyrkhat lem ba ka para jong sa ka la ih ïa nga ba ar ïa ka kam baroh da lade hi ? To ong ïa ka banbeiñ wan bad ïarap ïa nga !
translation.en: But Martha was cumbered about much serving , and came to him , and said , Lord , dost thou not care that my sister hath left me to serve alone ? bid her therefore that she help me .
And I will set my tabernacle among you : and my soul shall not abhor you .
translation.kha: Ngan shong hapdeng jong phi ha ka ïingjaiñ bakyntang jong nga , bad ngan ym phai noh na phi da lei lei .
da ki hukum jongno u ïa ki la pynneh ha ki bakwah jong ki junom , bad kim lah khlem kohnguh .
translation.en: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever : he hath made a decree which shall not pass .
Let your moderation be known unto all men . The Lord is at hand .
translation.kha: To pynpaw ïa ka jinglong jemnud sha uwei pa uwei baroh . U Trai u la jan wan .
Te ki briew jong u ki la ieit ïa ki kular jong u malade ki rwai ki jingïaroh ïa u .
translation.en: Then believed they his words  ; they sang his praise .

translation.kha: Ki la ïa-ong para ma ki , Ngin ym shem kano kano da kaba moi lah don kynsha ïa u Dionysius lymda dei kaei kaei kaba ïasoh bad ka niam jong u .
translation.en: Then said these men , We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel , except we find it against him concerning the law of his God .
And it came to pass , when Joab observed the city , that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were .
translation.kha: Kumta katba u Joab u dang kerkut ïa kata ka nongbah , u la phah ïa u Uriah sha ka jaka ha kaba u tip ba u nongshun u khlaiñ bha .

translation.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes , and my judgments : which if a man do , he shall live in them : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Bud ïa ki rukom leh bad ki hukum kiba nga ai ha phi ; da kaba leh kumta , phin ïoh im . Nga long U  Trai .
U briew uba kyrteng u Simon u shong u sah hangtai , uba shipor u la pynrkhiang ïa ki nong Syria da ka jingleh myntor jong u .
translation.en: But there was a certain man , called Simon , which beforetime in the same city used sorcery , and bewitched the people of Samaria , giving out that himself was some great one :
And the  Lord  God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers , rising up betimes , and sending  ; because he had compassion on his people , and on his dwelling place :
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ki , u ïai phah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki briew jong u , namar ba u kwah ban da ïa ki bad ïa ka templ .

translation.en: Say thou thus unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; As I live , surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword , and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured , and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga maham ïa ki ba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , ki briew kiba shong basah ha ki nongbah ba la pynjot kin shah pynïap . Kito kiba shong ha ka ri kin shah bam da ki mradkhlaw . Kito kiba rieh ha ki lumbah bad ki krem kin ïap da ka jingpang .

translation.en: See , I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness , until there come word from you to certify me .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ngan ap ha ka jaka jam ïa ka wah ha ka ri khlaw tad haduh ba ngan da ïoh khubor na phi .

translation.en: And whosoever will not receive you , when ye go out of that city , shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them .
translation.kha: hangno hangno ha kaba ki briew kim pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , to iehnoh ïa kata ka shnong bad kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong phi kum ka jingmaham ïa ki .

translation.en: Go to , let us go down , and there confound their language , that they may not understand one another s speech .
translation.kha: Ïa , ngin ïaleit hiar bad pynkhleh ïa ka ktien jong ki , ba kumta kin ym ïasngewthuh shuh iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , one ram , seven lambs of the first year  ;
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  : ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

bad ïa ka siasia , ki musla , ïa ka jingiwbih , ka mirr , bad ka jingiwbih remdor ; ïa ka waiñ bad ka umphniang Olib , ïa u purew bad u khiew , ïa ki jingri bad ki langbrot , ïa ki kulai bad ki kali balui , ïa ki mraw mala kdew ïa ki mynsiem briew ruh .
translation.en: And cinnamon , and odours , and ointments , and frankincense , and wine , and oil , and fine flour , and wheat , and beasts , and sheep , and horses , and chariots , and slaves , and souls of men .

translation.kha: Shim ïa ka shadem jong uta u langbrot bad pynkyntang ïa ka kum ka jingainguh pynrangbah sha de . Kane ka bynta jong u mrad ba la kñia ka dei ka jongki me .
translation.en: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron s consecration , and wave it for a wave offering before the  Lord  : and it shall be thy part .

translation.kha: kine long kaba khampoh stad ban ïa kiwei pat , U Jisu u la ong ïa ki . Hato phim shemphang ? Ym don kaba rung shapoh u briew na shabar kaba lah pahara ban pynlong bymkhuid ïa u ,
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Are ye so without understanding also ? Do ye not perceive , that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man , it cannot defile him  ;

translation.kha: Kumta ki lyngdoh ki put ïa ki turoi . Uta u paidbah , u tang shu ïohsngew ïa kata , u la risa jam , bad kita ki kynroh ki la khyllah . Te ki shaei baroh ki leit ba-beit beit shiah u lum shwa kata ka nongbah bad ki kurup ïa ka .
translation.en: So the people shouted when the priests blew with the trumpets : and it came to pass , when the people heard the sound of the trumpet , and the people shouted with a great shout , that the wall fell down flat , so that the people went up into the city , every man straight before him , and they took the city .

translation.kha: Uta u khynnah Samuel , u nang san bad u nang shem ïa ka jingsngewbha na U Trai bad na ki briew .
translation.en: And the child Samuel grew on , and was in favour both with the  Lord  , and also with men .
And when Jesus knew it , he saith unto them ,  Why reason ye , because ye have no bread ? perceive ye not yet , neither understand ? have ye your heart yet hardened ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki dang ïakren , kumta u la kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi ïakren shaphang ka jingbymdon kpu ? Hato phim pat tip lane sngewthuh ? Hato ki jingmut jong phi ki dang dum ?

Ka long ka mon jong U Terah U Blei ban pynkhia ïa kaei ba u la kren ha u Jeroboam u khulom jong u Nebat lyngba u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa na Shilhi . Kenan ka long balei ba u syier um shym la shahshkor ïa ki bariew .
translation.en: So the king hearkened not unto the people : for the cause was of God , that the  Lord  might perform his word , which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïai-ong ha ki , To sumar ; to phikir ïa lade pyrshah ïa u thiat ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi .
translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees .
And when Rachel saw that she bare Jacob no children , Rachel envied her sister  ; and said unto Jacob , Give me children , or else I die .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka Rakhel kam shym ïoh khun na u Jakob , kumta ka la bishni ïa la ka hynmen , bad ka ong ha u Jakob ,  Ai khun ïa nga , lane ngan ïap noh .

Te la ïalamwir shapoh ïa baroh ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , bad ki nongpeit kti , bad nga la ïathuh ha ki ïa ka jingphohsniew jong nga , hynrei kim lah ban bato ïa ka ha nga .
translation.en: Then came in the magicians , the astrologers , the Chaldeans , and the soothsayers : and I told the dream before them  ; but they did not make known unto me the interpretation thereof .

translation.kha: Phin sha beh noh na ki synagog , bad ka por kan poi haba uno Un uba pynïap ïa phi un pyrkhat ba da kaba leh kumta u Shakri ïa U Blei .
translation.en: They shall put you out of the synagogues : yea , the time cometh , that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa ka Templ jong pha yn hynñiew . Ngam pynthikna ïa phalang ba phan ym ioh ïa nga tad ynda ka por ka poi haba phan ong , ‘ U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka Kyrteng jong U Trai .’
translation.en: Behold , your house is left unto you desolate : and verily I say unto you , Ye shall not see me , until the time come when ye shall say , Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u khreh ban leit phai pat sha la u kpa ha ka ri Kanaan . U pynshong ïa ki ïakhun bad ki tnga jong u halor ki ut , nabar u ïalam ïa la ki kynhun jingri jong u baroh ha shuwa jongki u , lem bad baroh kiba u la ïohlum ha Mesopotamia .
translation.en: And he carried away all his cattle , and all his goods which he had gotten , the cattle of his getting , which he had gotten in Paddan–aram , for to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan .

translation.kha: Kata ka dih ka rukom haba wanrah ïa uwei u masi , u langbrot , ka langbrot , ne u langsohmoh .
translation.en: Thus shall it be done for one bullock , or for one ram , or for a lamb , or a kid .
( For not the hearers of the law are just before God , but the doers of the law shall be justified .
translation.kha: Naba ym dei da kaba ïohsngew ïa ka Hukum ba ki briew ki don ka jingïadei bad U Blei , hynrei da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa .
Hynrei u nong Samaria uba la leit jingleit na kata ka lyntang u la wan lap ïa uta u bhabriew , bad haba u la ïohi ïa u , la pynbud ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingsngewsynei .
translation.en: But a certain Samaritan , as he journeyed , came where he was : and when he saw him , he had compassion on him ,
We shall find all precious substance , we shall fill our houses with spoil :
translation.kha: Ngin ïoh kurup ïa ki markordor kiba har rukom bad pyndap ïa la ki ïing da ki mar lute !

Neng lalot ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew bad wallam ïa ki sha ka Them jong ka Jingbishar . Hangta nur-um bashabar ïa ki na ka bynta baïar kaba ki la imat ïa ki briew jong to . Ki la pynsmieij ïa ki Israel sha ki ri nongwei bad ki la phiah ïa ka Israel , ka ri jyllang nga .
translation.en: I will also gather all nations , and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat , and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel , whom they have scattered among the nations , and parted my land .
And there was a famine in the land , beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham . And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar .
translation.kha: Ka la jia sa kawei pat ka  nemsniew ha kata ka ri , nalor kata kaba la jia ha ki sngi u Abraham . U Isaak u la leit sha u Abimelekh u syiem jong ki Philistia , ha Gerar .
Ki set ïa u , bad ki ap haduh ba U Trai’ un ïathuh ïa ki kumno yn leh ïa u .
translation.en: And they put him in ward , that the mind of the  Lord  might be shewed them .
For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord , and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink  ; and he shall be filled with the Holy Ghost , even from his mother s womb .
translation.kha: Un long u briew uba khraw ha khmat U Trai . Um dei ban dih kano kano ka waiñ lane ka jingdih kaba khor . Naduh ka jingkha ïa u , yn pyndap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ,
U Samuel u Ong , Balei keiñ ba me da khot ïa nga haba U Trai u la iehnoh ïa me bad u la kylla long u nongshun jong me ?
translation.en: Then said Samuel , Wherefore then dost thou ask of me , seeing the  Lord  is departed from thee , and is become thine enemy ?

translation.kha: Nga long uta uba im ! Nga la ïap , hynne mynta nga im junom la junom . “Nga don ka bor halor ka jingïap bad ka pyrthei ibha ïap .
translation.en: I am he that liveth , and was dead  ; and , behold , I am alive for evermore , Amen  ; and have the keys of hell and of death .
And forgive us our sins  ; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us . And lead us not into temptation  ; but deliver us from evil .
translation.kha: To map ïa ki pop jong ngi , naba ngi map ïa uwei pa uwei uba leh bakla ïa ngi . Bad wat ïalam ïa ngi sha ka jingtynjuh kaba eh .’

translation.en: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white , and with a great crown of gold , and with a garment of fine linen and purple : and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad .
translation.kha: U Mordekai u mih na ka ïingsyiem , ha ki jingphong syiem kiba jngum rong bad balieh , ka barandi linen ba sawbthuh bad ka pansngiat ksiar ba-itynnat . Nangta ki lynti bah ka Susa ki sawa da ki jingpyrta ïaroh jong ka jingkmen .

translation.en: The proud have digged pits for me , which are not after thy law .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sarong , ki bymkohnguh ïa ka aiñ jong me , ki la tih ki thliew ban riam ïa nga .
Kawei pat ki Rangbah synshar lad ka jingtreikam ha ïingsyiem ki la kylli ïa u balei ba um kohnguh ïa ka lawbah u syep ;
translation.en: Then the king s servants , which were in the king s gate , said unto Mordecai , Why transgressest thou the king s commandment ?

translation.kha: Ban ïada ïa la ki Kut , un pyndonkam ïa ki briew kiba mane ïa u blei nongwei . Un ai ka jingpyndonburom ka khraw ïa pli Kiba pdiang ïa u kum u nongsynshar , un buh ïa ki ha ki jaka treikam ba-halor , dara un ai ka khak ïa ki kumta ka bainong .
translation.en: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god , whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory : and he shall cause them to rule over many , and shall divide the land for gain .

translation.kha: Namarkata ba me ki nongpynkha khun ki bthing ïa U Blei , u ruh u pynmanbha ïa ki , bad u ai ha ki ba kin don la ki khun ki katei . Ki Israel ruh ki nang roi nabar ki nang khlaiñ .
translation.en: And it came to pass , because the midwives feared God , that he made them houses .

translation.kha: Pynban mynta me ïai leh thuh hajuh ; me la Pynlong ki kutlad na ka bynta ki khunlung ki ksiew jong nga ha ki snem ki Ban wan , bad me , ko Trai U Blei , me la lah pynlong ïa nga kamon u briew uba khroh .
translation.en: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes , O God  ; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant s house for a great while to come , and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree , O  Lord  God .

translation.kha: Hynrei ai ïa kaei kaba haw ki khuri bad ki pliang jong phin ha kiba duk , bad kiei khie baroh kin long kiba khuid katno kumto ka jinglehniam na ka bynta jong phoi .
translation.en: But rather give alms of such things as ye have  ; and , behold , all things are clean unto you .

translation.kha: Ki Assyria kin khynñiuh haba kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur U Tlai bad sngew ïa ka bor jong ka jingpynshitom jong u .
translation.en: For through the voice of the  Lord  shall the Assyrian be beaten down , which smote with a rod .

translation.kha: U Pharisi u la kyndit haba u ieh ba U Jisu um shym la thet ha suk ban bam .
translation.en: And when the Pharisee saw it , he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner .

translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi da ka iktiar jong U Trai ban pule ïa khie ka shithi ha ki parabangeit baroh .
translation.en: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren .

translation.kha: namar ka Shimham ki bneng ka long kamut . Shisha la don u Syiem umbah la kut jingmut ban jurip ïa ki jingkhaïi jingïadie jongnga u shakri Jong u .
translation.en: Therefore is the kingdom of heaven likened unto a certain king , which would take account of his servants .

translation.kha: kumto u Joseph u Mynno , u da kit lut baroh kat kiba u don , bad u leit sha Beersheba , bad hangta u kñia ainguh ha U Blei jong u Issakhar u kpa jong u .
translation.en: And Israel took his journey with all that he had , and came to Beer–sheba , and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac .

translation.kha: Te u Samuel u la ïap , bad ki Israel baroh ki ïawanlang bad ïambriew na ka bynta jong u . Nahath ki tep ïa u ha ka ïing jong u ha Ramah . Hadien kane , u Dabid u leit sha ka ri khlaw Paran .
translation.en: And Samuel died  ; and all the Israelites were gathered together , and lamented him , and buried him in his house at Ramah . And David arose , and went down to the wilderness of Paran .

translation.kha: u la khot ïa la u shakri , nabar u ong , Beh khong ïa kane ka briew na khmat jong nga ! Pynim ïa ka shabar bad khang ïa ka jingkhang !
translation.en: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him , and said , Put now this woman out from me , and bolt the door after her .

translation.kha: U Mephibosheth u dem ngon sa shisien bad u ong , Ko Kynrad , ngam long uba kham bha ban ïa u ksew uba la ïaw ! Balei ba phin da long uba babha haduh katne ïa nga ?
translation.en: And he bowed himself , and said , What is thy servant , that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am ?

translation.kha: Ki masi kynthei kiba raikhoh ki la bam lur plain ïa kita kiba sngaid ,
translation.en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la shong , u la khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synrang , bad u la ong ïa ki , Uno uno uba khwai ban hir iing u dem ban buh khatduh eh ïa put bad u dadien ban long u shakri ïa baroh .
translation.en: And he sat down , and called the twelve , and saith unto them ,  If any man desire to be first , the same shall be last of all , and servant of all .

translation.kha: Hato da shisha um mut ïa ngi haba u la ïa-ong ïa kata ? Da shisha ïa kata la thoh na ka bynta jong ngi . U briew uba lur bad u bynriew uba ot ki dih ban trei ïa la ki kam da kaba kmen ban ïoh bynta na u jingthung .
translation.en: Or saith he it altogether for our sakes ? For our sakes , no doubt , this is written : that he that ploweth should plow in hope ; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope .
And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies , then know that the desolation thereof is nigh .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïohi ba la kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem da ki kynhun shipai , te phin tip ba shen yn sa pynjot noh ïa ka .
Kin san kin plung kum u phlang ba la ai um bhah , kum ki dieng Jamynrei harud ki ïawad jong ka um batuid .
translation.en: And they shall spring up as among the grass , as willows by the water courses .
