translation.kha: Ïa ki Israel ym shym la pyndonkam ha kaba pyntrei jubor , hyndai ki shakri kum ki shiphew , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki nongai hukum ïa kali ïapom , bad ki nongïeng khuri .
translation.en: But of the children of Israel did Solomon make no servants for his work  ; but they were men of war , and chief of his captains , and captains of his chariots and horsemen .
For they were about five thousand men . And he said to his disciples ,  Make them sit down by fifties in a company .
translation.kha: ( La don kumba san hajar ngut ki rangbah hangta . ) U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,  To pynshong ïa u paidbah ha ki kynhun kiba sanphew ngut kawei kawei .
Ka ktien jong U Trai ka la phriang kylleng ha kata ka thain .
translation.en: And the word of the Lord was published throughout all the region .

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ïoh jingmyntoi haba phi pynshlur bad ïaroh ïa ki .
translation.en: Children benefit when you encourage and commend them .

translation.kha: U Trai u Ong , Ki nongïathuhlypa sad ki lyngdoh ki long ki bymriewblei ; per la lap ïa ki ba ki leh bymman ha ka Templ hi .
translation.en: For both prophet and priest are profane  ; yea , in my house have I found their wickedness , saith the  Lord .
That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong , so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress .
translation.kha: U wallam jingjot ha kiba khlaiñ bad ïa ki Kut baskhem jong ki .
Naba ka long ïahap U Tharai u pynduk bha ïa u briew , ba u briew u long uba la ïa-pdiang theh , bad ym haba u briew u pyrkhat bha shaphang ïa lade .
translation.en: For not he that commendeth himself is approved , but whom the Lord commendeth .

translation.kha: Ynda Phi la ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jong phiah u ai ha phiah bad phi la shong la sah hangno , phin sa ïa-pynthait ban khong ei u syiem kumba ïalong slem ki jaitbynriew barhem sawdong jong phi .
translation.en: When thou art come unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and shalt possess it , and shalt dwell therein , and shalt say , I will set a king over me , like as all the nations that are about me  ;

translation.kha: “Nga la rai ba U Blang u tynjuh ïa ngi , ban pyn-i ïa ngi ba ngim long kham bha ban ïa ki mrad .
translation.en: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men , that God might manifest them , and that they might see that they themselves are beasts .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ïan ban synshar da ka bor , u da Wallam bad u ki briew ba u la pyllait im .
translation.en: Behold , the Lord  God  will come with strong hand , and his arm shall rule for him : behold , his reward is with him , and his work before him .

translation.kha: Phi ki brai kiba jynjar lad ka Jerusalem , phi kiba ïadait sheng shnong kumba phi la buaid ,
translation.en: Therefore hear now this , thou afflicted , and drunken , but not with wine :

translation.kha: Badno kum ban shu ong , haba u Abraham u la siew ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew , u Lebi ( kiba hiarpateng na u ki lum ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew ) ruh u la siew ïa ka .
translation.en: And as I may so say , Levi also , who receiveth tithes , payed tithes in Abraham .

translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko Job , shahshkor bakha ïa na ïa baher kaweh nga don banbeiñ ong .
translation.en: Wherefore , Job , I pray thee , hear my speeches , and hearken to all my words .

translation.kha: Pyrkhat pat myntoi . Jer ïa katai ka sien mynnin u riewkhraw u ïakynduh ïa ka jingpynjot .
translation.en: Remember , I pray thee , who ever perished , being innocent ? or where were the righteous cut off ?

translation.kha: Haduh Pham shym kiba shaphang ka Sodom ha kito ki sngi mynba pha la sngewsarong
translation.en: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride ,

translation.kha: Haba phi ïeng ha khmat u syiem , wat phyrngab ban shuh jur ïa u sad leh mynleh kum uba pawkhmat .
translation.en: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king , and stand not in the place of great men :

translation.kha: Ngi khmih kumno baroh ki krenbeiñ ïa ar da ka jingkthang .
translation.en: Are there not mockers with me ? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation ?

translation.kha: Phin sa shah ïa kajuh ka jingpynshitom kum ki riewpaidbah ! Ngan pynshitom ïa phi bad pynlong ïa phi ban siew na ka bynta ka jingsniew ba phi leh .
translation.en: And there shall be , like people , like priest : and I will punish them for their ways , and reward them their doings .
Hear now my reasoning , and hearken to the pleadings of my lips .

translation.kha: Ka ri ka jyllei da ki briew ki bymïaineh ha U Tharai ; ki im ka jingim Jingbymman bad pyndonkam bakla ïa la ka bor . Naamah ka jingtim U Trai , ka ri ka ïamkthang , bad ki jaka phlang ki tyrkhong .
translation.en: For the land is full of adulterers  ; for because of swearing the land mourneth  ; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up , and their course is evil , and their force is not right .
And when we had sailed slowly many days , and scarce were come over against Cnidus , the wind not suffering us , we sailed under Crete , over against Salmone  ;
translation.kha: Ngi la ïaid suki bun sngi , bad da ka jingeh bakhraw , khatduh ngi la poi harud jong ka shnong Knidos . Ka lyer kam ailad shuh ïa ngi ban ïaid sha khmat ha kata ka liang , kumta ngi la ïaid arsut na ka liang kaba kah lyer jong ka Krit , da kaba ïaid najan ka Salmone .

translation.en: He that believeth on him is not condemned : but he that believeth not is condemned already , because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ngeit ha U Khun un ym shah bishar ; hynrei ïa uno uno u bymngeit la lah bishar lypa ïa u , namar ba um shym la ngeit ha U Khun ba tang marwei jong U Blei .
To pynim ïa ngi , A Trai , to pynim ïa ngi ! to ai ha i'u ïa ka jingjop , A Trai !
translation.en: Save now , I beseech thee , O  Lord  : O  Lord  , I beseech thee , send now prosperity .

translation.kha: Ko ïakhun u bynriew , u la noh , to klun pyrshah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong ka Israel ibha shu sleit hi ïa la ki jngai ki jingïathuhlypa . Ïathuh ïa ki ban shahshkor ïa ka ktien ka jongu U Trai .
translation.en: Son of man , prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy , and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts , Hear ye the word of the  Lord   ;

translation.kha: Naei phi wan ?
translation.en: Where did you come from ?

translation.kha: Kumta ka nuksa , ki nongïamareh ki kham jied ïa ki nongri kiba ter dkhoh , kiba minot bad uba dud ïa ki aiñ jngai ka Baibl .
translation.en: For example , employers often prefer workers who live by the Bible principles of honesty and diligence .

And said unto the children of Israel , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I brought up Israel out of Egypt , and delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of all kingdoms , and of them that oppressed you :
translation.kha: bad u ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong , ‘ Nga la wan ïalam ïa phi na Ijipt bad nga la pyllait ïa phi na ki nong Ijipt bad na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew kiba la pynshitom beiñ ïa phi .
Da kumta phin leh ïa kita ki shnong kiba sha jngai na Kata ka ri ha Kaba phiah shongsah .
translation.en: Thus shalt thou do unto all the cities which are very far off from thee , which are not of the cities of these nations .

translation.kha: Balei ba phi wan ïalap ïa I na Ijipt sha ka jaka kaba sngew kumne kane ha kaba u jingthung ei ei ruh um ñiah ? Kane ka dei ka jaka ha kaba u kew ruh um long , u soh Dorbar ruh um long , u sohwaiñ ruh um lama , bad u soh Pomkranet hati um long . Wat ka umdih ruh kam don !
translation.en: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt , to bring us in unto this evil place ? it is no place of seed , or of figs , or of vines , or of pomegranates  ; neither is there any water to drink .

translation.kha: Pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong ki riewbymman bad ki riewsniew ; pynshitom ïa ki nalor ka jingbakla kaba ki la leh tad haduh ba ngin ym leh shuh ïa ka .
translation.en: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man : seek out his wickedness till thou find none .

translation.kha: Baroh ki traishnong Israel ki dei ban leh ïa kane haba ki wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynïapthngan ïa U Trai .
translation.en: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner , in offering an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka Long kaba khamtam bha ban shahshkor ïa ki ktien kiba jar jar jongno uno Un uba riewstad ban ïa ki jingpyrta jong u nongsynshar ha ka batbor jong ki bieit .
translation.en: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools .

translation.kha: Aïu ph ïaleit pyrshah ïa U Trai ? un pynjot ïa phoi . Ym don mano mano wahbah ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u palat ïa ka shisien .
translation.en: What do ye imagine against the  Lord  ? he will make an utter end : affliction shall not rise up the second time .

translation.kha: Shuh ma phi haba phi shat krenbeiñ namar ba phi long ki nongbud jong U Khrist ; Kanah ka mut ba U Mynsiem ka burom , U Mynsiem jong U Blang , u don ha phi .
translation.en: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ , happy are ye  ; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you : on their part he is evil spoken of , but on your part he is glorified .

translation.kha: Lada phi tih ïa ka thliew , phin hap hapoh jong ka , lada phi phrung lyngba ka kynroh , u bseiñ un puh ïa phoi .
translation.en: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it  ; and whoso breaketh an hedge , a serpent shall bite him .

In the first year of Cyrus the king the same Cyrus the king made a decree concerning the house of God at Jerusalem , Let the house be builded , the place where they offered sacrifices , and let the foundations thereof be strongly laid  ; the height thereof threescore cubits , and the breadth thereof threescore cubits  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka snem banyngkong jong ka jingsynshar jong u patsha Syros , u la hukum ba ïa ka Templ ha Jerusalem yn tei pat ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh yn thang . Ka Templ ka dei ban long arphew hynñiew mitar ka jingjrong bad arphew hynñiew mitar ka pyngkiang .
Ha Kaei ka miet , U Bela u mihpaw ha u ha ka jingphohsniew , bad u ong ha u , Men sa ïap , namar me la shim ïa Kane ka briew ; ka la dep shongkurim .
translation.en: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night , and said to him , Behold , thou art but a dead man , for the woman which thou hast taken  ; for she is a man s wife .

translation.kha: Lada nga dei u briew jong U Blei , u Elijah u jubab , ai ba ka dang kan wang hiar na bneng bad pynïap ïa me bad ïa ki rangïapom jongngi me ! Hangta hi ka ding ka la wanrah hiar bad ka la pynïap ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam bad ïa ki rangbah jong u .
translation.en: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty , If I be a man of God , then let fire come down from heaven , and consume thee and thy fifty . And there came down fire from heaven , and consumed him and his fifty .
Then all the multitude kept silence , and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul , declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la sngap jar katba ki dang sngap ïa ka jingïathuh jong u Barnabas bad u Paul ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla baroh kiba U Blei u la leh lyngba jong ki hapdeng ki Jentil .
U Kylli , Kumno ngan lah ban shakor bad ong ba la la bakla ? (Nga la mynsaw jur palat , hynrei nga long uba khlem pep .
translation.en: Should I lie against my right ? my wound is incurable without transgression .

translation.kha: Ngi rah noh ïa ki jingroi , bad ki jinglui na ki shnong jong ki .
translation.en: But all the cattle , and the spoil of the cities , we took for a prey to ourselves .

translation.kha: nongthaw u Jakob u leit sha Ijipt bad u shongduh ha kata ka ri .
translation.en: Israel also came into Egypt  ; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham .

translation.kha: ( Ki Jeruel ki mihnoh na ki pukri ki nong Jaakan bad ki leit sha Mearah . Hangta u Yiron u la ïap , bad hangta hima la tep ïa u , bad u Eleasar u khum jong u , u shim ïa ka jaka jong u kumta u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Moserah : there Aaron died , and there he was buried  ; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest s office in his stead .

translation.kha: mynba hati U Jehoahas u sdang ïai pynkhih da ki phew lak ngut ki briew ban ïoh im ha païa .
translation.en: Today , Jehovah is preparing millions of people for life in the future Paradise on earth .
And all the elders of that city , that are next unto the slain man , shall wash their hands over the heifer that is beheaded in the valley :

translation.en: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause .

translation.en: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought  ; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised , and her magnificence should be destroyed , whom all Asia and the world worshippeth .
And the superscription of his accusation was written over , THE KING OF THE JEWS .
translation.kha: Ka jingthoh jong ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa u ka long :  U Syiem jong ki Jiw .

translation.en: And say unto him , Take heed , and be quiet  ; fear not , neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands , for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria , and of the son of Remaliah .

translation.en: Come , eat of my bread , and drink of the wine which I have mingled .

translation.kha: Haba ka pyrem ka la poi , u syiem Nebukhadnessar u ïalam ïa u Jehoïakhin shuh Babilonia kum u koidi , bad u rah lang ïa ki jingkynshew jong ka Templ . Nangta u Nebukhadnessar u pynong ïa u Sedekaïah u kiei jong u Jehoïakhin kum u shem ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: And when the year was expired , king Nebuchadnezzar sent , and brought him to Babylon , with the goodly vessels of the house of the  Lord  , and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ki jingkular jong U Blei lyngraw ki nongïathuhlypa ki long na ka bynta jongnga phi , bad phi ïoh bynta ha ka ïong kaba U Blei u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jyllang phi! . Kumba u la ong ha u Aram , ‘ Lyngba ki khun ki ksiar jong me len kyrkhu ïa ki briew baher ha ka pynrieh .’
translation.en: Ye are the children of the prophets , and of the covenant which God made with our fathers , saying unto Abraham , And in thy seed shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed .

translation.kha: Sumar bad Kiar ïa la ka jingim na kaba ieit spah , bad sngewhun Bad kita kiei kiei kiba phi don . Namar U Blei u la nguh , Ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi , ngan ym kyntait ïa pa’ .
translation.en: Let your conversation be without covetousness  ; and be content with such things as ye have : for he hath said , I will never leave thee , nor forsake thee .

And the  Lord  shall cause his glorious voice to be heard , and shall shew the lighting down of his arm , with the indignation of his anger , and with the flame of a devouring fire , with scattering , and tempest , and hailstones .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un shah ïa baroh ban ïohsngew ïa ka sur bamaïan jong u bad ïa ka bor jong ka jingbitar jong u . Kin don ki thylliej ding , ki jingjur eh u slap , ki phria bad u slap khlem sangeh .
U la kynmaw ban pyn-i jingisynei ha u Abraham bad ha baroh ki khun ki ksiar jongu u junom !
translation.en: As he spake to our fathers , to Abraham , and to his seed for ever .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ko Trai , ai ba ki khun jong ki , kin ym ioh jingbam haduh ba da ïap ; ai ba kin shah pynïap ha ka tmoh . Ai ba ki kynthei Kin duh noh ïa la ki tnga bad ïa ki khun jong ki ; ai ba ki rangbah kyang ïap na ka jingpang sad ba ki samla shynrang kin shah pynjop ha ka sma .
translation.en: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine , and pour out their blood by the force of the sword  ; and let their wives be bereaved of their children , and be widows  ; and let their men be put to death  ; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle .

translation.kha: Phi long kiba la tim , phi kiba pynkyllaiñ ïa ka jingbishar hok bad kiba shukor ïa ki briew ban pynduh ïa ki hok jong ki !
translation.en: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood , and leave off righteousness in the earth ,
He sealeth up the hand of every man  ; that all men may know his work .
translation.kha: U pynsangeh ïa ka jingtrei jong ki briew ; u pyn-i ha ki ïa kaei kaba u lah ban leh .
shun ong ha ki bastad Israel , Shna ki ksai jyrthiaw ha ki dong jaiñkup jong phi bad buh ïa u ksai uba jngai ha uwei uwei u jyrthiaw . Phi dei ban leh ïa ken shi lynter .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations , and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue :
Now learn a parable of the fig tree  ; When his branch is yet tender , and putteth forth leaves , ye know that summer is nigh :

?(Nga sngewkmen .
translation.en: I am happy .

translation.kha: Haba phi dulir , un jubab ïa phi , bad pher bat ïa ki kular ba ph la pynlong .
translation.en: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him , and he shall hear thee , and thou shalt pay thy vows .

translation.kha: Ki don ki shkor , hawei kim lah ban sngewkyiuh ; kdor lah wat ban pynhiar mynsiem .
translation.en: They have ears , but they hear not  ; neither is there any breath in their mouths .

translation.kha: Nob ïa ka jingkular U balui la pynlong ha kine ki ktien : Ha ka por kaba dei ngan wan pat , bad ka Sarah kan ïew khun shynrang .
translation.en: For this is the word of promise , At this time will I come , and Sara shall have a son .

translation.kha: Katba kata ka Sur ka dang kren , U Mynhyndai U Blei u la bang ha nga , bad u la pynkdang ïa nga , badno nga la iohnong ïa kata ka ar ba ka sdang ïai kren ,
translation.en: And the spirit entered into me when he spake unto me , and set me upon my feet , that I heard him that spake unto me .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka sah” ki la jam sha khmat bad ki la pynlong ki jingmudui kiba khlaiñ pyrshah ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him .
Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art  ; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man .
translation.kha: U dei u parabriew jong me uba shahshitom na ki pop jong me , bad kaba bha kaba me leh ka ïarap ïa u .
Ahian kata , ngi la ïaleit shaphang shatei sha ka thain Bashan , bad u Og u Syiem jong ka u la wan ryngkat bad la ki rangïapom ban ïaleh ïa ngi hajuh ka shnong Elead .
translation.en: Then we turned , and went up the way to Bashan : and Og the king of Bashan came out against us , he and all his people , to battle at Edrei .

translation.kha: Ha kine ki por baroh , u Rehoboam nabar u Jeroboam ki don ha ka jingïaleh thma borabor phangpdeng jong ki .
translation.en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days .

Let all the nations be gathered together , and let the people be assembled : who among them can declare this , and shew us former things ? let them bring forth their witnesses , that they may be justified : or let them hear , and say , It is truth .
translation.kha: Khot hajir ïa ki jaitbynriew ban wan sha ka jingbishar . Kino na ki blei jong ki kiba lah ban ïathuhlypa ïa ka lawei ? Kino na ki kiba la ong lypa kaei ka ban jia mynta ? Ai ba kine ki blei kin wanrah ïa ki sakhi jong ki ban pynshisha ba ki long kiba dei , ban phla ïa ka jingshisha jong ki ktien jong ki .

translation.en: The legs of the lame are not equal : so is a parable in the mouth of fools .
translation.kha: U bieit u lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka proberb tang kumba u briew uba dkoh u lah ban pyndonkam ïa ki kjat jong u .
Haba ki briew ki la ïuh ïa U Jisu , ki la sngewkthang shikatdei eh , Bad ki la wan mareh sha u ban khublei ïa u .
translation.en: And straightway all the people , when they beheld him , were greatly amazed , and running to him saluted him .

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Israel kin sa bun kum u shitaiew ka dur , ngin bun haduh bym eh Shuah ban ñiew lane ban thew . myntor U Blei’ u ong ïa ki , Phim dei ki briew jong nga , hynrei ka sngi kan poi ha kaba un ino ha ki , Phi dei ki khun jongnga U blem uba im .
translation.en: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea , which cannot be measured nor numbered  ; and it shall come to pass , that in the place where it was said unto them , Ye are not my people , there it shall be said unto them , Ye are the sons of the living God .

translation.kha: Nga khih ïa phi ban tip ba ïa u la jong ngi , u Timothi la pyllait na ka ïingbyndi . Lada u wan kloi , tun wan ryngkat bad u haba nga wan jngoh ïa phi .
translation.en: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty  ; with whom , if he come shortly , I will see you .

translation.kha: Yn aiti ïa phi da ki kmie ki kpa jong phi , da ki hynmen ki para shynriah jong Phin , da ki ba-ha-ïing jyllang phi , bad da ki paralok jong phi ; bad ïa kato katne na phi yn pynïap .
translation.en: And ye shall be betrayed both by parents , and brethren , and kinsfolks , and friends  ; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death .

translation.kha: Nga long U Tharai , U Blei bakhuid jyllang phi , nga la thaw ïa phi , ko Israel , bad nga long u Syiem jong phi .
translation.en: I am the  Lord  , your Holy One , the creator of Israel , your King .
Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly .
translation.kha: U shah ïa u slap ban theh na ki lyoh ha kaba ai um ïa u khunbynriew baroh .

translation.en: For verily I say unto you , That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see , and have not seen them  ; and to hear those things which ye hear , and have not heard them .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba bun ki nongïathuhlypa bad bun ki briew ki jong U Blei ki la kwah shikatdei eh ban ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi , hynrei kim lah ïohi , bad ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba phi ïohsngew , hynrei kim shym la lah ïohsngew .
Usai u brai u Jubab , ‘ Da kumne sam tip ba phim dei ki riewshukor , uwei na phi un sah Bad nga ; ioh kiwei pat kin leit kit kew sha la ki ba-ha-ïing kiba shahjingit , bad kin leit noh .
translation.en: And the man , the lord of the country , said unto us , Hereby shall I know that ye are true men  ; leave one of your brethren here with me , and take food for the famine of your households , and be gone :

translation.kha: Lada uno Une u pynbna ha kaba shin ba u long u jongno nga , nur-um leh kumjuh ha khmut U Kpa jong nga naba ha bneng .
translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men , him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven .

translation.kha: Burom ïa U Tiras U Blei jong phi da kambah phi ramhah ïa ka Niam Ka Jinglait ha u bnai Abib , naba dei ha kawei ka miet jong uta u bnai ba u la pyllait ïa phi na jingïaphet .
translation.en: Observe the month of Abib , and keep the passover unto the  Lord  thy God : for in the month of Abib the  Lord  thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night .
For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren , my kinsmen according to the flesh :
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong ki nga kwah ba ngan jin da la don hapoh ka jingtim U Blei ba la pynïakhlad na U Khrist .

translation.en: These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs : but the time cometh , when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs , but I shall shew you plainly of the Father .
translation.kha: Nga la pyndonkam da ki rukom kren bapher ban ïathuh ïa phi ïa kine kiei kiei . Hynrei ka por kan poi haba ngan ym pyndonkam ïa ki rukom kren bapher , hynrei ngan kren ha phi da kaba shai kdar shaphang U Kpa .
Hynrei iwei na phi un ong ha nga , Lada Kanah ka long kumta , kumno U Blei un shem jingbakla bun badno ? uei uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ka mon U Blei ?
translation.en: Thou wilt say then unto me , Why doth he yet find fault ? For who hath resisted his will ?

translation.kha: To ieit ïa U Trai U Blei! jong phi , kohnguh bad ïaineh ha u ; te ma phi bad ki khur ki ksiew jong phi phyrnai im snam ha kata ka ri ba u la klun ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isak , bad u Jakob .
translation.en: That thou mayest love the  Lord  thy God , and that thou mayest obey his voice , and that thou mayest cleave unto him : for he is thy life , and the length of thy days : that thou mayest dwell in the land which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give them .
And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers : Of Judah , the captains of thousands  ; Adnah the chief , and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand .
translation.kha: U Adnah u long u nongïalam shipai na ki kur ka Judah , bad u don lai lakh ngut ki shipai hapoh jong u .

translation.en: And the righteous men , they shall judge them after the manner of adulteresses , and after the manner of women that shed blood  ; because they are adulteresses , and blood is in their hands .
translation.kha: Ki briew bahok kin pynrem ïa ki halor ka daw jong ka jingawria bad jingpynïap briew , namar ki ïai klim bad ki kti jong ki , ki bit da ka snam .
Wat la tv ïohi ïa une uno u slap lane ïa ka lyer , yn sa pynïap ïa kane ka phud um da ka um , malade ma phi , ki jingroi jong phi , malu ki kynhun mrad jong phiah kin ïoh kyrjaw ban dih .’
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , Ye shall not see wind , neither shall ye see rain  ; yet that valley shall be filled with water , that ye may drink , both ye , and your cattle , and your beasts .

translation.kha: To shahshkor sa kawei pat ka Persia , U Jisu u la ong . La kein shisien u trai khang uba la thung ka bri shitaiew , u la buh ka jingker sawdong jong ka , u la tih ka thliew na ka bynta ka jaka khñiot ïew , bad u la tei ka jaka ap phira . Nangta u la swai ïa ka bri sohwaiñ ha ki nongshimwai bad u la leit jingleit .
translation.en: Hear another parable : There was a certain householder , which planted a vineyard , and hedged it round about , and digged a winepress in it , and built a tower , and let it out to husbandmen , and went into a far country :

translation.kha: Naduh mihngi shaduh sepngi A to ïaroh ïa ka kyr-ang jong U Trai !
translation.en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the  Lord s  name is to be praised .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la hap hapoh u Aijalon haduh khatphra snem .
translation.en: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years .
Verily I say unto you , Whatsoever ye shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven : and whatsoever ye shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ong ha phi baroh : ïa kaei kaba phi khang ha ka pyrthei yn khang ha bneng , bad ïa kaei kaba phi shah ha ka pyrthei yn shah ha bneng .

translation.en: Salute one another with an holy kiss . The churches of Christ salute you .
translation.kha: To ïakhublei iwei ïa iwei da ka jingïadoh parabangeit . Baroh ki balang jong U Khrist ki phah ki jingkhublei jong ki ïa phi .

U la hukum ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa u Paul ban buh ïa u thah ka jingap phira , hynrei ban ai ha u katto katne ka jinglaitluid bad ban shah ïa ki phlangïap jong u ban pynban ïa ki jingdonkam jongngi u .
translation.en: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul , and to let him have liberty , and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him .

translation.kha: Ha ka aïom pakor nga la phohsniew , Bad nga la ïohi ba ki langsohmoh kiba ïa-pakor ki longïng kiba thohshuid , kiba thohbria bad kiba thoiñ .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the time that the cattle conceived , that I lifted up mine eyes , and saw in a dream , and , behold , the rams which leaped upon the cattle were ringstraked , speckled , and grisled .

translation.kha: U jaboh u ong ha u Joseph , U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la wan mihpaw ha nga ha Lus ha ka ri Kanaan , bad u la kyrkhu ïa nga .
translation.en: And Jacob said unto Joseph , God Almighty appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan , and blessed me ,

translation.kha: Te U Trai u la ong ha nga , Men dang ïohi ïa ki ïa ktieh kiew kiba kham ijli ban ïa kata .
translation.en: He said also unto me , Turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do .

The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear : and there is a multitude of slain , and a great number of carcases  ; and there is none end of their corpses  ; they stumble upon their corpses :
translation.kha: Ki nongshong kulai ki kynha , ki waitlam ki thaba , ki sum ki phalang ! ïa ki metïap la kynton shajrong , ki metïap bym don jingkheiñ — ki briew ki jynthut halor jong ki !

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab , and all that he did , and the ivory house which he made , and all the cities that he built , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Ahab u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingïathuh shaphang ka ïingsyiem jong u ba la pynitynnat da ki bniat hati bad ïa baroh ki nongbah ïa kiba u la tei , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel
Ki paid Hasor ki shongduh bad ki Kanaan kiba ha kita ki jaka naba kim shym la beh ïa ki .
translation.en: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites , the inhabitants of the land : for they did not drive them out .

translation.kha: Ki die noh ïa ka khak ka puta bad ka jingdon jingem jong ki , bad sam ïa ka pud hapdeng jong ki baroh , kat kum kaei kaba uwei uei u donburom .
translation.en: And sold their possessions and goods , and parted them to all men , as every man had need .

translation.kha: U angel u la pyn-i ruh ha nga ïa ka wah jong ka um ka jingim , kaba shet phyrnai sngur bhah , bad kaba wiang mih na ka khet jong U Blei bad ka jong U Khunlangbrot
translation.en: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life , clear as crystal , proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb .

translation.kha: Bad kumta , ko Amasaïah , U Trai u ong ïa me , ‘ Ka tnga jong me kan long ka nuti ha ki lyndet bah , bad ïa ki khur jong me yn sa pynïap ha ka thma . Ïa ka khyndew jong me yn phiah bad sam ha kiwei pat ; bad me ïa lade manna ïap ha ka ri bymngeit blang . Sin ki paidbhur Israel da shisha kmen shah ringmraw na la ka ri .’
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Thy wife shall be an harlot in the city , and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword , and thy land shall be divided by line  ; and thou shalt die in a polluted land : and Israel shall surely go into captivity forth of his land .
Then Judas , which had betrayed him , when he saw that he was condemned , repented himself , and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders ,
translation.kha: Haba u Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la tip ba ïa U Jisu la dep pynrem , u la kylla-kaba-mut bad u la leit rah biang ïa ki laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa sha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad sha ki tymmen ki san .

U dem ngon ha khmat jong ki , bad u ino , Ko rangbah , nga don hangne ban shakri ïa phi . Sngewbha wan sha ïing jong nga . Phi lah pun sait ïa la ki kjat , bad ban sahmiet ruh . Lashai phi lah don khie dang step , bad bteng ïa la ka jingleit . Hynrei ki jubab , Em , ngin sahmiet hangne ha ka jaka bakylluid jong ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he said , Behold now , my lords , turn in , I pray you , into your servant s house , and tarry all night , and wash your feet , and ye shall rise up early , and go on your ways . And they said , Nay  ; but we will abide in the street all night .
And Jacob sod pottage : and Esau came from the field , and he was faint :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba u Jakob u dang shet syrwa jhur , u Iso u la wan na kaba behmrad .

translation.en: The Lord was as an enemy : he hath swallowed up Israel , he hath swallowed up all her palaces : he hath destroyed his strong holds , and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ka ki la jop ; ki la bat ïa ka ha ka bor jong ki . U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ka ban shahshitom na ka bynta ki pop kiba bun jong ka baroh . Ïa ki khun jong ka la kem bad la shah rah noh .

(Nga la pyrkhat ba phin shahshkor malade pyllait im ïa nga na uto uba pyrshang ban pynjop ïa nga bad ïa u khunlung jong nga , nabar kumta ban jingweng khong ïa ngi na ka ri kaba U Blei u la ai ha ki briew jong u .
translation.en: For the king will hear , to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God .

translation.kha: U Shion Petros u la jubab , Ko Trai , to wat sait tang ïa ki kjat jong nga , te ! To sait ruh ïa ki kad bad ïa ka khlieh jong nga umdih .
translation.en: Simon Peter saith unto him , Lord , not my feet only , but also my hands and my head .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba u angel uba hynñiew u ainguh ïa la ka turoi , te U Blei un pynnep ïa ka jingthmu barieh jong u , kitab u la pynbna ha la ki shakri , ki nongïalap .
translation.en: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel , when he shall begin to sound , the mystery of God should be finished , as he hath declared to his servants the prophets .

translation.kha: Haba u syiem ka Ninebeh u la ïohsngew Shaphang kata , u ïeng joit na la ka khait , u lawlynnong noh ïa la ka jaiñkup , u phong da ka jaiñ khain , bad u shong ha u dpei .
translation.en: For word came unto the king of Nineveh , and he arose from his throne , and he laid his robe from him , and covered him with sackcloth , and sat in ashes .

translation.kha: Ki la don borbah khat-ar ngut ki rangbah .
translation.en: And all the men were about twelve .
That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you , and ye in him , according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom ka kyrteng jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi kan ïohpdiang ïa ka burom na phi , bad ma phi na u , da ka jingaiei jong U Blei jong ngi bad jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai .

translation.en: A sound of battle is in the land , and of great destruction .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsawa jong ka thma la ïohsngew ha ka ri , bad ka don ka jingpynjot bakhraw .

U don u briew ha ka hangamei jong phi uba don ïa u mynhyndai jong ki blei bakhuid hapoh jong u . Mynba u kpa jongu phi u longsyiem syiem , une u briew u la pyn-i ka jingtim kaba bha , ka jingtip , bad ka jingstad kum ka jingstad jong ki blei . Bad u syiem Nebukhadnessar , u kpa jong phi , u la pyningkhong ïa u , u khlieh duh jong ki nongai kupar , ki nongleh myntri , ki nongleh byrtong , bun ki nongpeit kti .
translation.en: There is a man in thy kingdom , in whom is the spirit of the holy gods  ; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom , like the wisdom of the gods , was found in him  ; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father , the king , I say , thy father , made master of the magicians , astrologers , Chaldeans , and soothsayers  ;

translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U Trai ! To ai ki jingïaroh ïa U Trai , namar u long uba bha ; ka jingtied jong ka long bymjukut .
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .

And say to the forest of the south , Hear the word of the  Lord   ; Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will kindle a fire in thee , and it shall devour every green tree in thee , and every dry tree : the flaming flame shall not be quenched , and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ka khlaw bashaphang shathie ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong : Ha khmih ! Nga pynmeh ïa ka ding , bad kan thang khoit ïa uwei pa uwei u dieng ha phi , la uba jyrngam ne uba tyrkhong . Yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban pynlip ïa ka . Kan pur na shathie haduh shatei , bad uwei uwei baroh un sngew ïa ka jingkhluit ki thylliej ding .
Kine ki longïing jong ka kur Kohath ki la ïohpdiang shiphew tylli ki nongbah lem nabar ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained .

translation.kha: ‘ Ang ïai-ong ha phi ,’ u la jubab , ‘ ba ha uno uno u briew uba kein ei ei , yn ai kham buiñ shu Shuh ; hynrei ha u brisoh u bym don ei ei , wat ïa kaba rit kaba u don yn shim noh na u .
translation.en: For I say unto you , That unto every one which hath shall be given  ; and from him that hath not , even that he hath shall be taken away from him .

translation.kha: U Joshua u la khie sdang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , bad ha ka sien kob ar ki lyngdoh bad ki shiphew ki la ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah ha kajuh ka rukom kumba ki la leh ha ka sngi kaba la dep : jingsuk , ka kynhun ba-shiphew na sha khmat ; hateng kata , ki hynne ngut ki lyngdoh kiba put ïa ki hynñiew thlia ki turoi ; nangta , ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai ; bad khatduh , ka kynhun ba-shiphew na shadien . Ha ki por baroh la put ïa ki turoi .
translation.en: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams  horns before the ark of the  Lord  went on continually , and blew with the trumpets : and the armed men went before them  ; but the rearward came after the ark of the  Lord  , the priests going on , and blowing with the trumpets .

translation.kha: Khmih ! haneng ka don ka tnga kliar jong u bad ka khun jong nga , kaba dang sotti . Ngan wan ïalam ïa ki mynta sharak , bad phi lah ban shim ïa ki . Leh ïa ki katba phi sngewnguh . Khenani wat leh ïa ka kam bymman ha une u briew !
translation.en: Behold , here is my daughter a maiden , and his concubine  ; them I will bring out now , and humble ye them , and do with them what seemeth good unto you : but unto this man do not so vile a thing .

Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will bring again the captivity of Jacob s tents , and have mercy on his dwellingplaces  ; and the city shall be builded upon her own heap , and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ngan buh pat ïa ki briew jong nga ha ka ri jong ki bad ngan isynei ïa kawei pa kawei ka longïing ; ïa ka Jerusalem yn tei pat , bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong ka yn pynbha pat .
Katba u Abimelekh bad ka kynhun jong u ki tur pynkloi sha khmat ban ïada ïa ka khyrdop shnong , kiwei pat ki ar kynhun ki tur ïaleh ïa ki briew hapoh lyngkha bad ki pynpyut ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: And Abimelech , and the company that was with him , rushed forward , and stood in the entering of the gate of the city : and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields , and slew them .
Wherefore , O harlot , hear the word of the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Mynta te , ko Jerusalem , pha ka nuti ! Sngap ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong .
Hynrei nga pynpaw ïa la ka jingieit ha ki hajar ki pateng kiba ieit ïa nga , bad kiba sum ïa ki praw jong nga .
translation.en: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments .

translation.kha: Ki traishnong jong ka ki la phet sha Gittaim , ha kaba ki la shong la sah naduh kata ka por . )
translation.en: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim , and were sojourners there until this day . )

translation.kha: Ko kynthei , balei pha ïam ? U Jisu u la kylli ïa ka , Ïano pha wad ? Ka la at pyrkhat ba u la dei u nongsumar kper , kumta ka la ong ha u , Lada me la rem noh ïa u , ko kynrad , to ïathuh ïa nga hangno me la buh ïa u , bad ngan ïoh loit bad shim ïa u .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , why weepest thou ? whom seekest thou ?  She , supposing him to be the gardener , saith unto him , Sir , if thou have borne him hence , tell me where thou hast laid him , and I will take him away .

translation.kha: Khmut me la shet ïa u khun jong nga , bad ngi la bam ïa u . Ha ka sngew kaba Bud , por ong ha ka ba ngin ïabam ïa u khun jongngi ka , hynrei ka la buhrieh ïa u !
translation.en: So we boiled my son , and did eat him : and I said unto her on the next day , Give thy son , that we may eat him : and she hath hid her son .

translation.kha: U ai ha nga ka jingap halor ki nongshun jong nga , U pyndem ïa ki jaitbynriew hapoh jong nga ,
translation.en: It is God that avengeth me , and that bringeth down the people under me ,

Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria , saying , The nations which thou hast removed , and placed in the cities of Samaria , know not the manner of the God of the land : therefore he hath sent lions among them , and , behold , they slay them , because they know not the manner of the God of the land .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ïa u patsha ka Assyria ba ki briew kiba u la pynshongduh ha ki nongbah ka Samaria kim shym la tip ïa ki aiñ jong u blei jong kata ka ri , bad kumta u blei u la phah ïa ki sing , kiba la pynïap ïa ki .
U Moses u shim khyndiat ka snam bad u thab ïa ka ha ka shkor kumno jong u Aaron , ha ka tikmie ba sha kamon , bad ha ka ïakynting ba sha kamon jong u .
translation.en: And he slew it  ; and Moses took of the blood of it , and put it upon the tip of Aaron s right ear , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot .

translation.kha: Un phah noh ïa ki angel sha sawdong ka pyrthei ban ïalumlang ïa ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei , na kawei ka dong jrong ka pyrthei sha kawei bapaw .
translation.en: And then shall he send his angels , and shall gather together his elect from the four winds , from the uttermost part of the earth to the uttermost part of heaven .

translation.kha: kaba itynnat malade shongkai Kum ka skei . Ai ba ki jingitynnat jong ka kin pynkmen ïa phi ; ai ba kan jer sawdong ïa Phi da ka jingieit jong ka .
translation.en: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe  ; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times  ; and be thou ravished always with her love .

And they removed the burnt offerings , that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people , to offer unto the  Lord  , as it is written in the book of Moses . And so did they with the oxen .
translation.kha: Nangta ki pynïabynta hapdeng ki briew , kat kum ki kynhun longïing , ïa ki jingri na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang , khnang ba kin lah ban ai ïa ki kat kum ki jingbthah ha ka Hukum u Moses .

translation.en: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left : remove thy foot from evil .
translation.kha: Kiar na kaba sniew bad ïaid beit sha khmat . Wat jam palat na ka lynti kaba dei .
U Aaron un sumar bad bthuh ryntih ïa kita ki shalor ha u diengpynïeng sharak kseh , bad un khmih ba kin meh bathoiñ ka por ha khmat U Trai .
translation.en: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the  Lord  continually .
And then will I profess unto them , I never knew you : depart from me , ye that work iniquity .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan ong ha ki , ‘ Ngam ju la ithuh ïa phi . Khie leit noh na nga , phi ki briew bymman !’

Nalor kane , ki nongïamareh ka Judah , ki lyngdoh , bad ki briew ki buhnud ïa ka jingleh bymman jong ki jaitbynriew shohdoh jong ki ha kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw , bad kumta ki pyntngit ïa ka Templ , ïa kaban U Trai da lade hi u la pynpang naba kynha .
translation.en: Moreover all the chief of the priests , and the people , transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen  ; and polluted the house of the  Lord  which he had hallowed in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Katba ki dkut jongu ka Dorbar ki pynshahshkor ïa u Stephan , ki la bitar shla bad ki la kyr-iat bniat ïa u ha ka jingbitar .
translation.en: When they heard these things , they were cut to the heart , and they gnashed on him with their teeth .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Mahalab la pynkhynñiuh ! To kyang jam ! Ïa ka Moab la pynjahburom . Ka don ha ki jingjot , bad baroh ki ha-sem ba kein sawdong ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ka . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: They shall howl , saying , How is it broken down ! how hath Moab turned the back with shame ! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him .

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh ki don ka jinglong lyngdoh kum ka bniat jong ki ïa kaei kaba to la ai ha Israel ban hiarpateng na kawei ka pateng sha kawei pat . Kin ym don jingïadon jingem ha Israel ; nga long tang ma nga uba ki donkam .
translation.en: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance : I am their inheritance : and ye shall give them no possession in Israel : I am their possession .

translation.kha: Ka Sillah ka la kha ïa u Jubal Kain , babha dei u kamar uba shynna ïa ki jait tiar baroh na ka rnong bad ka nar . Ka para jong u Tubal Kain ka dei ka Naamah .
translation.en: And Zillah , she also bare Tubal–cain , an instructor of every artificer in brass and iron : and the sister of Tubal–cain was Naamah .

translation.kha: Ki briew bakha sniew ki sngapjar ïa ki jingmut kiba sniew , bad ki nongkhrong ki sngap ïa ki jingshukor .
translation.en: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips  ; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue .

translation.kha: Ka jingsian sad ka jingshemphang jong phi kin ïada ïa phi
translation.en: Discretion shall preserve thee , understanding shall keep thee :

translation.kha: Balei ka siew ia ka pisa ?
translation.en: Why did she pay the money ?

translation.kha: Te kiwei pat ki nongpynïaid bad ki lat ki la ïaishong ban shem kaei kaei kaweh bakla bad ka rukom kaba u Daniel u pynïaid ïa ka hima , hawei kim lah , namar ba u Daniel u long uba lah ban shaniah , mala um shym leh kano kano kaba bakla lane ka jingbymhok .
translation.en: Then the presidents and princes sought to find occasion against Daniel concerning the kingdom  ; but they could find none occasion nor fault  ; forasmuch as he was faithful , neither was there any error or fault found in him .
And Samuel said unto him , The  Lord  hath rent the kingdom of Israel from thee this day , and hath given it to a neighbour of thine , that is better than thou .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha u ,  U  Trai  u la kad ïa ka hima Israel na me ha kane ka sngi , bad u la ai ïa ka ha uta u briew uba kham bha ban ïa me .

Nga la ong , Ngan ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ki lumbah bad jaw ummat na ka bniat ki jaka pynbamphlang , namar ki la tyrkhong , dara ym ni mano mano ba sien jingleit lyngba jong ki . Ïa ka jingbhasbun ki jingri ym shym ïohsngew Shuh ; ki jah bad ki mradkhlaw ki la phet bad kim ne shuh .
translation.en: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing , and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation , because they are burned up , so that none can pass through them  ; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle  ; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled  ; they are gone .

translation.kha: Nangne u Jakob u la leit sha jingpeit , ha kaba ma u bad ki khun shynrang lad u ki la ïap .
translation.en: So Jacob went down into Egypt , and died , he , and our fathers ,

translation.kha: bad u Meshullam u khun jong u pat u la dap khatlai snieh ka rta .
translation.en: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old , when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin .

translation.kha: ïa ki pyrda na ka bynta ka phyllaw , ki riewstad bad ki thliew tnaw jong ka ; ïa ki pyrda na ka bynta ka jingkhang jong ka phyllad ;
translation.en: The hangings of the court , his pillars , and their sockets , and the hanging for the door of the court ,

translation.kha: Phim dei ba leit lang bad I , ki la ong . Kam don jingktah ei ei ïa u nongshniah lada kiba sah na ngi ki phalang dei bad phet lane ïada shiteng na i'u ki la shah pynïap ; hynrei phi ïaryngkat dor bad shiphew hajar ñiut na Ngi . Kan kham bha lada phi shong hangne ha ka nongbah bad phah jingïarap ïa ngi .
translation.en: But the people answered , Thou shalt not go forth : for if we flee away , they will not care for us  ; neither if half of us die , will they care for us : but now thou art worth ten thousand of us : therefore now it is better that thou succour us out of the city .

translation.kha: Nangta ki aiti saw jngut ki nongsharai balang kiba shong ha ki khet jong ki ha khmat U blem ki la dem ngon ïa lade bad ki la mane ïa U Blei , da kiba ong : Ko Trai U Blei Badonbor Berakah , uta uba long bad uba la ju longïing ! ngi ainguh ïa me ba me la Shimiet ïa ka bor bakhraw jong me bad me la sdang ban synshar !
translation.en: Saying , We give thee thanks , O Lord God Almighty , which art , and wast , and art to come  ; because thou hast taken to thee thy great power , and hast reigned .
And in the evening he cometh with the twelve .
translation.kha: Haba la janmiet , U Jisu u la wan ryngkat bad ki khat-ar ngut ki synran .
Mano mynshem , samla ne tymmen , shyieng ne kynthei , ki bym mane ïa U , la pynïap .
translation.en: That whosoever would not seek the  Lord  God of Israel should be put to death , whether small or great , whether man or woman .
How can God’s Word improve your life ?
translation.kha: Kumno ka ktien U Blei kan kham pynbha ïa ka jingim jong phi ?

translation.en: So Jotham became mighty , because he prepared his ways before the  Lord  his God .
translation.kha: U Jotham u la nang khlaiñbor , namar u kohnguh hok ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u .

Ki leh kumta , badno halor lad ka u la hiar thret ha ka lynti nongsaiñ u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah bad u lap ïa u ba u shong ha trei aiwai u dieng sniang . Hato phi dei uta u nongïathuhlypa suba na Joïada ? u kylli . Nga dei , uta u briew u jubab .
translation.en: And went after the man of God , and found him sitting under an oak : and he said unto him , Art thou the man of God that camest from Judah ? And he said , I am .

translation.kha: Ka Dei ka briew kob shlur bad ka im to jinglehrain , kaba ju ïaid borabor ha ki lyngkot bah ;
translation.en: ( She is loud and stubborn  ; her feet abide not in her house :

translation.kha: Ka jingbhabriew ha ka briew ka bym don ka jingshemphang ka long Kum ka sati ksiar ha ka khmut u sliang .
translation.en: As a jewel of gold in a swine s snout , so is a fair woman which is without discretion .
But now is made manifest , and by the scriptures of the prophets , according to the commandment of the everlasting God , made known to all nations for the obedience of faith :
translation.kha: Mynta pat , ïa kata ka jingshisha la pynmih ha kaba paw lyngba ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa ; bad da ka hukum jong U Blei bymjukut , ïa ka la pyntip sha baroh ki jaitbynriew , khnang ba baroh ki lah ban ngeit bad kohnguh .

translation.en: When Jesus was on earth , he always prayed to his Father , not to anyone else .
translation.kha: Por ba u Jisu u don ha ka pyrthei , manla ka-por u duwai ha la u Kpa , ym ha kiwei pat .

Sngewbha shah ïa ngi ban ïaid lynti na ka hima jong phi . Ma moi lem bad ki jingri jong ngi , ngin ym sakma na ka lynti ïaid lane leit sha ki lyngkha ne ki bri sohwaiñ jong phi , bad ngin ym dih um na ki pukri lad phi . Ngin ïaid na lyngkot baher haduh ba ngim da ïaid lieh na ka hima jong phi .
translation.en: Let us pass , I pray thee , through thy country : we will not pass through the fields , or through the vineyards , neither will we drink of the water of the wells : we will go by the king s high way , we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left , until we have passed thy borders .
Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days , and keep the charge of the  Lord  , that ye die not : for so I am commanded .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban sah ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ miet la bad sngi haduh hynñiew sngi , ban leh ïa kata kaba U  Trai  u la hukum . Lada phim leh kumta , phin ïap . Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga .

translation.en: The righteous shall see it , and rejoice : and all iniquity shall stop her mouth .
translation.kha: Kiba hok ki ïohi ïa kane bad ki kmen , hynrei ïa baroh kiba bymman la pynsngap jar .
U Shimei u la sdang ban kawang mraw ïa u ïaiban malu ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , wat haba la ker dala ïa u Dabid da ki rangbah jong u bad ki nongïada jong u .
translation.en: And he cast stones at David , and at all the servants of king David : and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left .
Then he saith , I will return into my house from whence I came out  ; and when he is come , he findeth it empty , swept , and garnished .
translation.kha: u ong ha lade , ‘ Ngan leit phai pat sha la ïing .’ Kumta u leit phai pat bad u shem ba ka ïing ka thylli , ka khuid , bad baroh la buh ryntih .
( U Trai u la kdang artat ban pynïoh pat ïa ka bhor jrong ka Jerusalem , kumba ka la long ha khmat ki nongshun kiba la lute ïa ka . )
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath turned away the excellency of Jacob , as the excellency of Israel : for the emptiers have emptied them out , and marred their vine branches .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ïathuh keiñ ha i pa khih katno nga Long uba donbor ha Ijipt , bad ïathuh ruh shaphang Kiei kiei baroh kiba phi la ïohi . Khie ïapyllait bran bran , bad wan ïalam ïa i shaei .
translation.en: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt , and of all that ye have seen  ; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither .

translation.kha: Nangta u la jop ïa u khun jong u Rehob , u Kedesh , u syiem ka hima Sobah jong ka Syria , katai u Hadadeser u dang don ha lynti ban pynïoh patan ïa la ka bor synshar khashor ka ri harud ka wah Ïuphratis kaba shaneng .
translation.en: David smote also Hadadezer , the son of Rehob , king of Zobah , as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates .

translation.kha: Ka kyrpad ïa nga pun shah ba tista bud nadien jong ki nongot bad kuna ïa u kew . Ka la trei naduh dang step phyrngab bad dang myntan ka shongshit shipor hapoh ka jingkynthih .
translation.en: And she said , I pray you , let me glean and gather after the reapers among the sheaves : so she came , and hath continued even from the morning until now , that she tarried a little in the house .

translation.kha: U Jehu u la jubab , Hato phim ju pulom ïa kawei kaba u Dabid u la leh ha kata ka por mynba u la donkam ei ei ban baibam ? Ma u bad ki rangbah kiba bad u ki la ïai-ong ,
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Have ye never read what David did , when he had need , and was an hungred , he , and they that were with him ?
And Jezreel , and Jokdeam , and Zanoah ,
translation.kha: ka Jesreel , ka Jokdeam , ka Sanoah ,
Katba U ju u dang khie sha Jeroham , u la shimti kyrwep ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synlar badno u la kren lade jar ha ki , katba ki ïalang ïa-ïaid .
translation.en: And Jesus going up to Jerusalem took the twelve disciples apart in the way , and said unto them ,
And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer : but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day , and serve under tribute .
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym beh noh ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong ha Geser ; kumta ki Kanaan ki la shong la sah hapdeng ki Ephraim haduh kane ka sngi , hynrei la pynbor ïa ki ban trei kum ki mraw .

translation.en: And he saith unto him , Friend , how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment ? And he was speechless .
translation.kha: ‘ Ko paralok , kumno phi ïohrung hangne khlem ki jaiñ shongkurim ?’ u syiem u la kylli ïa u . Hynrei uta u briew um shym ong ei ei .

translation.en: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit , and her company is round about her grave : all of them slain , fallen by the sword , which caused terror in the land of the living .
translation.kha: Ki long baroh kiba la ïap ha ka thma , bad ki jingtep jong ki , ki don ha ki bynta ba sha trai eh jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Ki shipai jong ka baroh ki la kyllon ïap ha ka thma bad ki jingtep jong ki , ki ker sawdong ïa u lum jingtep jong ka . Pynban shisien ki la pyntriem ïa ka ri kiba im .

Lada ar ngut shi para ki ïashong lang ha kajuh ka jakarieh bad uwei na ki u ïarep Khlem da ieh khum shynrang , ka tnga jong uta uba ïap kam dei pun sngewjahburom ïa Un uno u bym dei na ka ïing ka sem jong u ; u para jong uta uba la ïap u dien baneh shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: If brethren dwell together , and one of them die , and have no child , the wife of the dead shall not marry without unto a stranger : her husband s brother shall go in unto her , and take her to him to wife , and perform the duty of an husband s brother unto her .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ka Por ka wan haba ki briew kin ym smai shuh da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that it shall no more be said , The  Lord  liveth , that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt  ;

translation.kha: Kumta to ai ha nga ka jingstad kaba nga donkam ban synshar ïa ki biria jong me ha ka jinglehhok bad ban thiah ka jingïapher pyndeng kaba bha’ bad kaba sniew . Lym kumta , kumno ngan kah ban synshar ïa u paidlang jong me wahbah khrawburom katne katne ?
translation.en: Give therefore thy servant an understanding heart to judge thy people , that I may discern between good and bad : for who is able to judge this thy so great a people ?

translation.kha: U Shimei u la sdang ban kawang maw ïa u Dabid badno ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , wat lehbha la k tawiar ïa u Arbad da ki rangbah jong u bad ki nongïada jyllang u .
translation.en: And he cast stones at David , and at all the servants of king David : and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left .

translation.kha: U mohkhiew u ïa-ong ïa u ïa kaei baroh katba la jia ïa u bad haduh katno ka pisa ba u Haman u la kular ban buh ha ka ïing jingkynshew u syiem lada ïa baroh ki Jiw la pynïap .
translation.en: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him , and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king s treasuries for the Jews , to destroy them .

translation.kha: Ko phi ki Israel , wat peh banbeiñ leh ïa kaei kaei barieh kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la law ïa phi . Wat pynskuiñ ïa Kawei ruh na ki aiñ jong u .
translation.en: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the  Lord  your God hath commanded you : ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left .

translation.kha: Men ieit ïa U Trai U balui jngai me da ka dohnud jongki me baroh , da ka mynsiem jong me bhor , da ka jingmut jong me baroh , bad da ka bor jngai me baroh .’
translation.en: And thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy mind , and with all thy strength : this is the first commandment .

translation.kha: Bad U ijuh u la bteng da Kaba ong , phin anna ka man bsein jong ka jingkyntait ïa ka law U Blei ban pynneh ïa la ka jong ka jinghikai hi .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Full well ye reject the commandment of God , that ye may keep your own tradition .

translation.kha: Bad shisha phi la leh ïa kane ha ki parabangeit baroh ha Makedonia . Kumta i'u kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit , ba phin nang leh shuh shuh .
translation.en: And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia : but we beseech you , brethren , that ye increase more and more ;

He that walketh righteously , and speaketh uprightly  ; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions , that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes , that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood , and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil  ;
translation.kha: Phi lah ban lait im lada phi ong bad phi leh ïa kaba dei . Wat pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong phi ban shukor ïa kiba duk bad wat pdiang ïa ka pisa bashukor . Wat ïasnohkti bad kito kiba thmu ban pynïap briew lane ban leh ïa kiwei ki kam sniew .

translation.en: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear , we thought it good to be left at Athens alone ;
translation.kha: Ha kaba kut ngim lah shah shuh . Kumta ngi la rai ban sah tang ma ngi ha Athens

Ngan pynshitom ïa me , ïa ki kynhun ki khiew jong me , bad ïa ki lapbah synran jong me namar ki pop ibha ma phi baroh phi la leh . Ma me lymne ki briew ka Jerusalem bad Joïada ki la sngap ïa ki jingmaham jong nga , bad kumta lang! ïam halor baroh ïa ka jingpynjot ïa kaba nga la thep kren pyrshah .
translation.en: And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity  ; and I will bring upon them , and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and upon the men of Judah , all the evil that I have pronounced against them  ; but they hearkened not .

translation.kha: Te , ynda U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phiah ïa “kata ka ri mala u la pyllait im ïa phi na ki nongshna Jong pa baroh’ bakha shong sawdong jong phi , pynpyut lut ïa ki Amalek baroh , khnang ban ym don shuh uba kynmaw ïa ki . Waw kli ïa kane !
translation.en: Therefore it shall be , when the  Lord  thy God hath given thee rest from all thine enemies round about , in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it , that thou shalt blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven  ; thou shalt not forget it .

translation.kha: Ka longïng kaba dei ban kynmaw , da shuwa , ba ïa ki hukum la thaw , ym na ka bna ki Briew ki uba , hynrei ïa ki nongpynkheiñ praw bad ki riewrunar , na ka bynta kiba khlem Blang bad kiba jop , na ka bynta kito ki bymriewblei ne ki bymlah long kiba kynja Mynsiem , kito kiba pynïap ïa la ki kpa bad ki kmie , na ka bynta ki nongpynïap briew , na ka bynta babha leh kam ba-ijli , na ka bniat kiba awria , ki nongrahbor , na ka bynta kito kiba shukor bad kiba ai jingphla lamler lynti kito kiba leh ïa kano kano kaba markhongpong ïa ka jinghikai kaba shisha .
translation.en: For whoremongers , for them that defile themselves with mankind , for menstealers , for liars , for perjured persons , and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine ;

translation.kha: U Tharai u long u syiem ! Ko pyrthei , to lehkmen ! To shadkmen , ko ki dewlynnong ha ki duriaw !
translation.en: The  Lord  reigneth  ; let the earth rejoice  ; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof .

And it came to pass , when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of God , which had cried against the altar in Beth–el , that he put forth his hand from the altar , saying , Lay hold on him . And his hand , which he put forth against him , dried up , so that he could not pull it in again to him .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Jeroboam u ïohsngew ïa kane , u kdew ïa u bad u hukum ,  Kem ïa uto u briew !  Mar kumta hi ka kti u syiem ka long kumba ïap haduh ba um lah pynkhun shuh ïa ka .

Bad u Jehoash u ong , Balei me la pyndih ha ngi ïa ka jynjar kaba kum ken ? U Trai myntoi un pynngat ïa ka jynjar ha me ! Te ki brisoh baroh ki lynthem maw ïa u Adnah haduh ba un da ïap ; ki lynthem maw bad ki thang ruh ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jyllang u .
translation.en: And Joshua said , Why hast thou troubled us ? the  Lord  shall trouble thee this day . And all Israel stoned him with stones , and burned them with fire , after they had stoned them with stones .

And , behold , I will send a lad , saying , Go , find out the arrows . If I expressly say unto the lad , Behold , the arrows are on this side of thee , take them  ; then come thou : for there is peace to thee , and no hurt  ; as the  Lord  liveth .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan ong ïa u shakri jong nga ban leit tam ïa ki . Bad lada nga ong ha u , ‘ Khmih , kito ki khnam ki don ha kane ka liang jong phi ; tam ïa ki ,’ kata ka mut ba kam lei lei bad phi lah ban mih shabar . Nga smai ha U  Trai  uba im ba phin ym don ha ka jingma .
Kut mynta u paralok jong nga u ong : Ma phi ki briew kiba shong ha Jerusalem bad Judah , to bishar hapdeng jong nga bad ka bri swai jong nga .
translation.en: And now , O inhabitants of Jerusalem , and men of Judah , judge , I pray you , betwixt me and my vineyard .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jingsynshar u Joram u khun jong u Ahab kum u syiem ka Israel , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u Jehoram u long u syiem ka Judah
translation.en: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign .

translation.kha: Ka bneng ka pynpaw ïa ka pop jong une u Briew , mala ka pyrthei ka phla pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity  ; and the earth shall rise up against him .

translation.kha: Ka ruh ka dap da ka jingkwah brai ïa ki rieh kynsai bad ki rangbah shipai nong Arsa — ki shipai ha ki raïot shipai baphyrnai — bad ïa ki samla shiphew ba-bhabriew , baroh kito ki set shyieng barabor .
translation.en: She doted upon the Assyrians her neighbours , captains and rulers clothed most gorgeously , horsemen riding upon horses , all of them desirable young men .

translation.kha: Nangta la khoh shapoh ïa u Paul , bad u Tertullos u la sdang ban ai ïa ka jingmudui jong u ïa u Paul kum harum : Pheliks Badonburom ! Ka jingïalam bastad jong me ka la wanrah ha ngi ïa ka por shongsuk kaba kham sloit , bad ïa shisien ki jingpynbeit thymmai Ibbah donkam la tiduh na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ka ri jong I .
translation.en: And when he was called forth , Tertullus began to accuse him , saying , Seeing that by thee we enjoy great quietness , and that very worthy deeds are done unto this nation by thy providence ,

Have ye not cast out the priests of the  Lord  , the sons of Aaron , and the Levites , and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands ? so that whosoever cometh to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams , the same may be a priest of them that are no gods .
translation.kha: Phi beh noh shabar ïa ki lyngdoh ki jong U  Trai  , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron , bad phi beh noh ïa ki Lebi . Ha ka jaka jong ki phi la thung ïa ki lyngdoh ha kajuh ka rukom ba kiwei ki jaitbynriew ki leh . Uno uno uba wanrah lang bad u masi ne hynñiew tylli ki langbrot u lah ban ïoh pynkyntang kum u lyngdoh jong kito kiba shu khot ki blei jong phi .

translation.en: And if thine eye offend thee , pluck it out , and cast it from thee : it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye , rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire .
translation.kha: Bad lada ka khmat jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , to khlong bad to bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban rung sha ka jingim tang da kawei ka khmat ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki khmat bad ban shah bret shapoh ka dujok ding .
Kumta ki shah ïa ka Rebekka bad ïa ka shakri ïing bamut jyllang ka ba kin rupa ryngkat bad u Shakri jong u Abraham lem bad ki brisoh jyllang u .
translation.en: And they sent away Rebekah their sister , and her nurse , and Abraham s servant , and his men .

translation.kha: ïa u diengpynïeng sharak ksiar , ïa ki sharak jong u , ïa ki tiar jong u baroh , bad ïa ka umphniang ïa ki sharak jong u ;
translation.en: The pure candlestick , with the lamps thereof , even with the lamps to be set in order , and all the vessels thereof , and the oil for light ,
Then said one unto him , Lord , are there few that be saved ? And he said unto them ,
translation.kha: Don kiba la kylli ïa u ,  Ko Kynrad , hato tang khyndiat ngut ki briew ki ban lait im ?
Kajuh ka jingjia ka la wan wia ha u para uba ar , uba para , bad khappud ha baroh hynriew ngut .
translation.en: Likewise the second also , and the third , unto the seventh .
He leadeth princes away spoiled , and overthroweth the mighty .
translation.kha: u pynrit khop ïa ki lyngdoh bad ïa ki rangbah kiba don ha ka bor .

translation.en: And , being assembled together with them , commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem , but wait for the promise of the Father ,  which ,  saith he ,  ye have heard of me .
translation.kha: Bad haba ki la ïawanlang , u la ai ha ki ïa kane ka hukum :  Wat leit noh na Jerusalem , hynrei ap ïa ka jingkular kaba nga la ïathuh , ka jingai kaba U Kpa jong nga u la kular .
Kumta u rangbah ai hukum u la leit shai u Paul bad u la kylli ïa u , Ïathuh ïa nga , hato me dei u traishnong ka Hima Rom ? Ho-oid , la jingjubab u Paul .
translation.en: Then the chief captain came , and said unto him , Tell me , art thou a Roman ? He said , Yea .

translation.kha: Hynrei kiaw pat ki la ong , To ap , to ngin peit lada u Elijah un wan bun pyllait im ïa u !
translation.en: The rest said , Let be , let us see whether Elias will come to save him .
And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly ; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba ai ha ngi ka jingsuk un pynlong ïa phi kiba khuid ha ki liang baroh bad un sumar ïa ka longrynïeng jong phi — ka mynsiem , ka jingim , bad ka met — kaba lait na kano kano ka jingbakla ha ka jingwan jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .

translation.en: Jehovah tells us to avoid sinful practices because he knows they will harm us .
translation.kha: U Jehobah u ong ïa ngi ban kiar na ka jingmlien ba long pop namar ba u tip ba kin pynsniew ïa ngi .
Ka Niam Ka Jinglait , ïa kaba ju Rakhel ban pyndonburom ïa U Trai , ka sdang ha ka por sieh sngi ha ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong .
translation.en: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the  Lord s  passover .

translation.kha: Bad wat ai ïa u ban pynngeit ïa phi ban shaniah ha U Troas . Wat pyrkhat ba U Trai un pyllait ïa phi bad ba un pynsangeh ïa ki shipor Assyria na kaba knieh neh ïa ka nongbah jong phi .
translation.en: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the  Lord  , saying , The  Lord  will surely deliver us : this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria .

translation.kha: U shakri u la ong ha lade , ‘ U Kynrad jong nga un sa beh ïa nga na ka kam jong nga . Katai ba ngan leh ? Ngam long kiba khlaiñbor ban tih kharai , bad nga sngewhun ban khrong .
translation.en: Then the steward said within himself , What shall I do ? for my lord taketh away from me the stewardship : I cannot dig  ; to beg I am ashamed .

translation.kha: Kumta u Jonathan u khot ïa u Dabid bad u ïathuh ha u ïa kita baroh ; nongap u ïalam ïa u shuh u Saul , bad u Dabid u sharai ïa u syiem kumba u ju ai mynshuwa .
translation.en: And Jonathan called David , and Jonathan shewed him all those things . And Jonathan brought David to Saul , and he was in his presence , as in times past .
And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon : and the people were very faint .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi , ki Israel ki jop ïa ki Philistia , ki da ïaleh shi lynter lynti naduh Mikhmash haduh Aijalon .
Bad mynta ka jingshlei ha ka sahit bneng ka phyrnai eh , ka phin haduh katta katta ïa ngi ïa-ban khmih ïa ka ; bad ïa ka siat bneng la sar pynïakhlad da ka reng .
translation.en: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds : but the wind passeth , and cleanseth them .

translation.kha: Burom ïa U Trai bad trei bha , Naaman U Trai U Blei jong ngi um lah shah ïa ka jingsuk bymdei lane ka jingleh shiliang khmat lane ka jingshim pisa thop .
translation.en: Wherefore now let the fear of the  Lord  be upon you  ; take heed and do it : for there is no iniquity with the  Lord  our God , nor respect of persons , nor taking of gifts .

translation.kha: U la poi kham jan sha ka nongbah , bad haba u la ïohi ïa ka , u la ïan na ka bynta jong ka , u da ong ,
translation.en: And when he was come near , he beheld the city , and wept over it ,

Thou shalt burn with fire a third part in the midst of the city , when the days of the siege are fulfilled : and thou shalt take a third part , and smite about it with a knife : and a third part thou shalt scatter in the wind  ; and I will draw out a sword after them .
translation.kha: Ïa ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong uta u shñiuh men thang hapoh ka nongbah , ynda la dep ka jingkerkut . Shim ïa ka bynta kaba ar bad shaiñ ïa ka da ka waitlam jong me haba me ïaid baroh sawdong ka nongbah . Ïa ka bynta kaba dang sah men pynher ha ka lyer , bad ngan sa pynbud da ka waitlam jong nga nadien jong ki .

translation.en: In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah , in the tenth month , came Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his army against Jerusalem , and they besieged it .
translation.kha: Ha u bnai ba-shiphew jong ka snem bakhyndai ba u Sedekaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan bad ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh bad u la tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem .
U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa u Jephthah namar u la buiñ ïa ka napoh ba-mynshuwa jongno ka jingim u kpa jong u bad um shym mane ïa u Baal .
translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Jehoshaphat , because he walked in the first ways of his father David , and sought not unto Baalim  ;

translation.kha: Ïa kano kano kaba la buhrieh noh yn wallam shabar ha kaba paw , bad ïa kano Kane kaba la tap yn sa lap bad yn sa pynpaw ha kaba sharai .
translation.en: For nothing is secret , that shall not be made manifest  ; neither any thing hid , that shall not be known and come abroad .

translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki jingjia jingman jong ki , u la ïasoh bad u Joram u syier ka Israel ha ka thlim pyrsa ïa u Hasar u skhem ka Syria . Ki kynhun shipai ki la ïaleh ha Ramoth ha Gedalaïah , bad u Joram u la mynsaw ha ka thma .
translation.en: He walked also after their counsel , and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth–gilead : and the Syrians smote Joram .

translation.kha: U Pharpar u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong ha ki , Ha kane ka sien nga la leh pop ; U Trai u leh ïa kaba dih ; ma nga bad ki briew jong nga ngi la leh bakla .
translation.en: And Pharaoh sent , and called for Moses and Aaron , and said unto them , I have sinned this time : the  Lord  is righteous , and I and my people are wicked .
So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the  Lord  with shouting , and with the sound of the trumpet .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ma u bad ki Israel baroh ki la rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  shatei sha Jerusalem da ka jingrisa kmen bad ka jingpynsawa ïa ki turoi .

Hynrei u Ehud ïa lade u la kyllan dien ha ki Maw ba la saiñdur hajuh Gilgal , u la leit biang sha u Eglon , bad u ong , Susim Kyndit , nga don ka khubor barieh na ka bynta jongki phi . Kumta u syiem u suda ïa la ki shakri , Ieh ïa ngi tieng baroh ar ngut ! Bad baroh ki la ïamih shaba .
translation.en: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal , and said , I have a secret errand unto thee , O king : who said , Keep silence . And all that stood by him went out from him .

translation.kha: daiñ pateng phyrngab u nongpynïap briew u ktieh bad u mih ban leit pyndap ïa uba duk , bad mynmiet u tuh .
translation.en: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy , and in the night is as a thief .
Sell that ye have , and give alms  ; provide yourselves bags which wax not old , a treasure in the heavens that faileth not , where no thief approacheth , neither moth corrupteth .
translation.kha: Die noh ïa ki jingdon jingem jong phi baroh bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kiba duk . Pynbiang ïa lade ki pla kynshew ki ban ym jot noh , bad kynshew ïa ka spah jong phi ha bneng , ha kaba kan ym duna , namar ba ym don u nongtuh uba lah ban ïoh ïa ka , bad ym don khñiang ba lah ban pynjot ïa ka .

Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih uba dei ban rakhe pateng la pateng . Ïa Kane ka rukom lehniam dei ban imat shisien shisnem Ban pynkhuid ïa ki Israel na ki pop jong ki . Kumta u Moses u leh , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u .
translation.en: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you , to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year . And he did as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u peit halor ki nongïaleh jong ki Jiw , bad ki rangbah syier ki Persia ki rai ban ym leh ei ei haduh ba Kin da ha thoh sha u Delaïah bad ïoh ïa ka jubab .
translation.en: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews , that they could not cause them to cease , till the matter came to Darius : and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter .

translation.kha: Bad Kumta ang la bitar ïa kita ki briew bad nga la ong , ‘ Ki la iehnoh ïa nga Badonbor bad ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jongki nga .’
translation.en: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation , and said , They do alway err in their heart  ; and they have not known my ways .

translation.kha: Shilhim ar tylli ki mardor Karnelian , pynlang thoh ha ki ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khuid shynrang Jong u Jakob ,
translation.en: And thou shalt take two onyx stones , and grave on them the names of the children of Israel :

translation.kha: Te U Trai u la ong ha nga , Men dong ïohi ïa ki ïa kiei kiei kiba kham ijli ban ïa kata .
translation.en: He said also unto me , Turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations that they do .

translation.kha: A Blei , U Blei jong ngi , katai me long uba khraw ! Katno me long uba shyrkhei malade uba donbor ! Me batskhem ïa ki kular ka jingïateh jutang . Naduh ka por ba ki syiem Assyria ki banbeiñ ïa ine , wat haduh kane ka para , haduh katno ngi shahshitom ! Ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki lyngdoh jong ngi bad ki nongïathuhlypa , ki kpa Thummim jong me , bad baroh ki briew jong ngi ki shitom . To kynmaw haduh katno ngi la shahshitom !
translation.en: Now therefore , our God , the great , the mighty , and the terrible God , who keepest covenant and mercy , let not all the trouble seem little before thee , that hath come upon us , on our kings , on our princes , and on our priests , and on our prophets , and on our fathers , and on all thy people , since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day .
So speak ye , and so do , as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty .
translation.kha: To kren bad to leh kum ki briew ïa kiba yn sa bishar da ka hukum kaba pyllaitluid ïa ngi .

Khenani u Josaïah u ngut jingmut ban ïajah . U kyntait ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U blang u la ainong lyngba u skhem kein , kumta u riej pher ïa lai bad u leit sha ka thma ha ka them jrong ka Megiddo .
translation.en: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him , but disguised himself , that he might fight with him , and hearkened not unto the words of Neco from the mouth of God , and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo .

translation.kha: Ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la byrngem ban lynthem maw ïa ki , hynrei kynsan ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingainong ryngkat U Trai ba ka paw hajar ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones . And the glory of the  Lord  appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Naba da kumno ki briew ngin tip ba me sngewbha ïa une u paidlang bad ïa nga lada me men ym wait ryngkat bad ngi ? Ka Jingdon ryngkat jong me bad I sa pyn-i ba ngi hir kiba pher na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight ? is it not in that thou goest with us ? so shall we be separated , I and thy people , from all the people that are upon the face of the earth .

translation.kha: U Tlai Badonbor Baroh u nong ha ang , Ïa ka Israel yn sloit pynbuaid kum ka bri sohkew na kaba la kheit ïa uwei pa uwei u sohwaiñ . Kumta pha dei ban pyllait im ïano ïano katba pha lah katba dang don ka por .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine : turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets .
