For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land , saith the  Lord  : but , lo , I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour s hand , and into the hand of his king : and they shall smite the land , and out of their hand I will not deliver them .
translation.kha: ( U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ngan ym isynei shuh ïano ïano ha ka pyrthei . Ma nga da lade ngan buh ïa ki briew baroh hapoh ka bor jong ki nongsynshar jong ki . Kine ki nongsynshar kin pynjot ïa ka pyrthei , bad ngan ym pyllait ïa ka na ka bor jong ki .  )
Hadien ka jingphah noh ïa u paidbah , u la leit ktieh ïa u lumrit marwei hi ba duwai .
translation.en: And when he had sent the multitudes away , he went up into a mountain apart to pray : and when the evening was come , he was there alone .

translation.kha: Me lah ban pyrthat ba kin pynlong ïa me uba khlaiñ ha ka thma , hynrei u dei U Blei umbah ni ka bor ban ai ka jingpar ne ka jingshahjop , bad un shah ïa ki nongshun jong me ban jop ïa me .
translation.en: But if thou wilt go , do it , be strong for the battle : God shall make thee fall before the enemy : for God hath power to help , and to cast down .

translation.kha: Ha iba ki ri nongwei kin ym lah baneh ai ka jingsuh waiñ ha U Trai , lane wanlam ki jingkñia ha u . Ki jingbam jong ki kin pyntngit ïa uno uno uba bam ïa ki , kum ki jingbam ba bam ha ka por ïambriew . Yn pynsakma ïa ki tang ban pynkdang ïa la ka jingthngan ; ym Don kawei ruh ka ban Shim kum ka jingnguh ha ka Templ U Trai .
translation.en: They shall not offer wine offerings to the  Lord  , neither shall they be pleasing unto him : their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners  ; all that eat thereof shall be polluted : for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the  Lord .
And wherefore hath the  Lord  brought us unto this land , to fall by the sword , that our wives and our children should be a prey ? were it not better for us to return into Egypt ?
translation.kha: Balei keiñ U  Trai  u ïalam ïa ngi sha kata ka ri ? Ngin shah pynïap ha ka thma , bad ki tnga jong ngi lem bad ki khun ki kti kin shah kem . Hato kam long kaba kham bha ba ngin ïaleit phai pat sha Ijipt ?
U phraphew u la khot sngewbha ïa U Ujuh ban ïabam miet bad u , bad U Jisu u la longing sha ka ïinglieng jong u bad u la shong ba-bang ba-ima .
translation.en: And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him . And he went into the Pharisee s house , and sat down to meat .

translation.kha: U Dedan u la har kumba U Trai u la hukum , bad u la ia ban beh nong paw ïa ki Philistia naduh Geba Shi lynti lynti haduh Geser .
translation.en: And David did so , as the  Lord  had commanded him  ; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gezer .

translation.kha: U Abib u ïong ha u Jehosheba , Hato ngam shym la ïathuh ïa phi ba um ju ïathuhlypa ei ei kaba bha ïa nga ? Ka long badonbor kaba sniew !
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me , but evil ?

translation.kha: U Jakob u ong , Balei kheiñ phi pynpyiar sat ïa to katne katne ba phi da ïathuh ha uta u briew ba phiah don sa uwei u para ?
translation.en: And Israel said , Wherefore dealt ye so ill with me , as to tell the man whether ye had yet a brother ?

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , namar ka jingtei kaba phi la ïohpdiang , ki Jiw mynta ktien Kohnguh ïa U Blei , khnap ba ma ki ruh mynta kin ïohpdiang ïa ka jingaiei U Blei .
translation.en: Even so have these also now not believed , that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy .
From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth .
translation.kha: Na ka jaka ba u synshar , u khmih shapoh halor baroh kiba shong ha ka pyrthei .

To ïathuh ïa ka jaitbynriew baroh kamai ba kane ka dei ka khubor jong U Trai nongsynran ïa ki briew jongngi ka Jerusalem kiba dang shong sdang sah ha ka ri jong ki : Kin kyiuh hir ki bam bad kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng haba ki dih . Ïa ka ri jong ki yn sloit lyngkhuit , namar uwei uwei baroh uba shong Hangta u longkmie uba thurmur .
translation.en: And say unto the people of the land , Thus saith the Lord  God  of the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and of the land of Israel  ; They shall eat their bread with carefulness , and drink their water with astonishment , that her land may be desolate from all that is therein , because of the violence of all them that dwell therein .

translation.kha: Phi lah ban thung ki rangbah synshar ha trai ki probins jong ka hima bad sah ïa ki ban wallam ïa baroh kine ki samla kynthei ba-bhabriew sha ka ïing ki kynthei jong phi hangne ha Susa , ka nongbah jong ka hima . bsuh ïa ki hapoh ka jingkhmih jong u Haggi , u ïunukh uba plied halor ki kynthei jong phi , sad ban ai ka jingsumar na ka bynta ka jingpynbha briew ïa ki .
translation.en: And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom , that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace , to the house of the women , unto the custody of Hege the king s chamberlain , keeper of the women  ; and let their things for purification be given them :

And it shall come to pass , that as the  Lord  rejoiced over you to do you good , and to multiply you  ; so the  Lord  will rejoice over you to destroy you , and to bring you to nought  ; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u pynmanbha bad pynroi ïa phi da kaba kmen , kumta ruh da kaba kmen un pynjot bad pynduh pyndam ïa phi . Yn sa rat dyngkhong ïa phi na kata ka ri ba phin ïohkynti .
Wat lada ka jingduwai ainguh Jong phi ka biang bha , kam ïarap ei ei ïa uwei pat u briew .
translation.en: For thou verily givest thanks well , but the other is not edified .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Trai u la thep kren ha u Job , U ong ha u Eliphas , Ngin bitar ïa me bad ïa ki ar ngut ki lop jong me , namar mem shym kren ïa ka jingshisha shaphang jong nga , kumba u Jehoba u shakri jong nga u la leh .
translation.en: And it was so , that after the  Lord  had spoken these words unto Job , the  Lord  said to Eliphaz the Temanite , My wrath is kindled against thee , and against thy two friends : for ye have not spoken of me the thing that is right , as my servant Job hath .

For the seller shall not return to that which is sold , although they were yet alive : for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof , which shall not return  ; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life .
translation.kha: Yn ym don nongkhaïi ki ban im haduh ban ïoh biang ïa kaei kaba ki la duh , namar ka jingbitar U Blei ka long halor baroh . Kito kiba bymman kin ym lait im .

translation.en: Strengthen ye the weak hands , and confirm the feeble knees .
translation.kha: Kin ai ka jingkhlaiñ ïa ki kti kiba la thait bad ïa ki khohsiew bakyiuh da ka jingtlot .
katba u paidbah habar u la duwai ha ka kynta ha kaba la thang ïa ka jingiwbih .
translation.en: And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense .

translation.kha: hynrei kito na phi kiba ïaineh ha U Trai U Blei jong phi ki dang im haduh myntoi .
translation.en: But ye that did cleave unto the  Lord  your God are alive every one of you this day .
And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east , and unto the sea of the plain , even the salt sea on the east , the way to Beth–jeshimoth  ; and from the south , under Ashdoth–pisgah :
translation.kha: ka kynthup ïa ka Them Jordan naduh Duriaw Galilaïa arsut shaduh Beth Jeshimoth ( shaphang mihngi jong ka Duriaw Baïap ) bad sha trai jong u Lum Pisgah .
U Syiem Dabid mynta u la tymmen bha , bad wat la ki shakri lad u ki tap ïa u da ki nep-syiad , um shym syaid satia .
translation.en: Now king David was old and stricken in years  ; and they covered him with clothes , but he gat no heat .

translation.kha: U suki naba lah ban shaniah , Badonbor u ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , hynmen u bih lah ban shaniah , u ïathuh tang ïa kaba lamler .
translation.en: A faithful witness will not lie : but a false witness will utter lies .

translation.kha: Lada ka pyrthei ka shun ïa phi , to kynmaw ba ka la shun ïa nga nyngkong .
translation.en: If the world hate you , ye know that it hated me before it hated you .
And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Un wallam ïa ki sha u lyngdoh ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ ha ka sngi kaba phra jong ka jingpynkhuid ïa u .

translation.en: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep .
translation.kha: Ki ksuid ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban ym phah ïa ki sha ka  liewlong khlem trai .
Haba u sangeh , ka pyrthei ka khih ; u tang Shua klet , ki jaitbynriew ki kyiuh . Ki lumbah ba bymjukut ki khih ; ki lumlang baneh junom ki ngam Shabeh , ki lum ha kiba u ju ïaid ha ki nga mynbarim .
translation.en: He stood , and measured the earth : he beheld , and drove asunder the nations  ; and the everlasting mountains were scattered , the perpetual hills did bow : his ways are everlasting .
Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers . For there is no power but of God : the powers that be are ordained of God .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ban kohnguh ïa ki bor synshar , namar ym don ka bor khlem ka jingaibor jong U Blei , bad ïa ki bor synshar kiba don mynta la buh hangta da U Blei .
Ki briew kiba khlem Blei! ki longsyiem kum Aner ki khih ; ka jingkyrmen jrong ki ka duh napoh , shisien ba la klet ïa U Balei .
translation.en: So are the paths of all that forget God  ; and the hypocrite s hope shall perish :
Now the God of peace be with you all . Amen .
translation.kha: To U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingsuk jong ngi , un long ryngkat bad phi baroh . Amen .
Hynrei lada phi khlong ïa u , bad leh kat ïa kaba nga sah” , ngan ïaleh pyrsad ïa ki nongshun Jong phi baroh .
translation.en: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice , and do all that I speak  ; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies , and an adversary unto thine adversaries .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba im u dei ban long uba stad ; ka long kiba bha kum ka jingïohpdiang ïa ka jingïohpateng
translation.en: Wisdom is good with an inheritance : and by it there is profit to them that see the sun .

translation.kha: Ka ktang jong uta u jingpynphai sharak ka don sawphew tylli ki khuri kiba kum ka dur ki synrum soh Elmadam lem bad ki shata syntiew ba la oh-shrong itynnat .
translation.en: And in the candlestick were four bowls made like almonds , his knops , and his flowers :

translation.kha: Ki parabangeit baroh kiba don hangne ki ïasnohkti lang nabar nga ha kambah phad ïa ki jingai khublei sha ki balang ha Galatia :
translation.en: And all the brethren which are with me , unto the churches of Galatia :

translation.kha: Ki briew uba la shahjop ki beiñ pyrshah ïa kiba jop ïa ki bad ki pyn-i jingsuk ïa ki . Kin ino , Phi shim ïa kaei ka im dei ka jong phi , hynrei phi longsem ba la tim ! Katno snam phin ïapynlong kiba riewspah da naba pynbun ïa ki nongaikam ram jong Phin ban siew noh ?
translation.en: Shall not all these take up a parable against him , and a taunting proverb against him , and say , Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his ! how long ? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay !
Then Shaphan the scribe told the king , saying , Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book . And Shaphan read it before the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u pyndap ,  Nga don hangne ka kitab kaba u Hilkaïah u la ai ha nga .  Bad u pule jam ïa ka ha u syiem .

translation.en: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees , when the kingdom of God should come , he answered them and said ,  The kingdom of God cometh not with observation :
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa U Jisu lano ka Hima U Blei kan wan . Ka jubab jong u ka long ,  Ka Hima U Blei kam wan ha ka rukom kum kaba lah ban ïohi .

U Saul u ong ha ki rangbah jong u , Ïa ngin leit Hiar malade tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia mynmiet , ngin lute ïa ki haw ban da kynjat shai , bad ngin pynïap lut ïa ki baroh . Leh ïa kaei kaba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam , ki jyllop . Hynrei u lyngdoh u ïa-ong , To ngin da kylli shuwa na U Bela .
translation.en: And Saul said , Let us go down after the Philistines by night , and spoil them until the morning light , and let us not leave a man of them . And they said , Do whatsoever seemeth good unto thee . Then said the priest , Let us draw near hither unto God .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la nong ha u Moses , Mynta men sa ïohi aïu ngan leh ïa u Pharaoh . Ngan pynbor ïa u ban shah ïa ki brup jong nga ban otsher . Ha ka jingshisha , ngan pynbor ïa u ban beh noh ïa ki na ka ri jong u .
translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto Moses , Now shalt thou see what I will do to Pharaoh : for with a strong hand shall he let them go , and with a strong hand shall he drive them out of his land .

translation.kha: ban ong ha u , U blei ha uba phin shaniah u la nguh ïa phi ba phin ym hap ha ki kti ki jong nga , hynrei wat shah ba yn shukor ïa phi .
translation.en: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah , saying , Let not thy God in whom thou trustest deceive thee , saying , Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria .

translation.kha: Kat u Moses u dang don ha Medad , U Trai u ong ha u , Khie leit phai sha Ijipt , namar ba kito baroh kiba thnam baneh pynnep ïa me ki la ïap .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses in Midian , Go , return into Egypt : for all the men are dead which sought thy life .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban kha ïa nga , U Trai u la thung ïa nga ; u la pynlong ïa nga u shrak jong u ban wallam pat ïa ki briew jong u , ban wallam pat ïa ka jaitbynriew Jesreel kaba la saphriang kylleng . U Trai u ai ha nga ka burom ; u long u tyrkhong jngai ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga .
translation.en: And now , saith the  Lord  that formed me from the womb to be his servant , to bring Jacob again to him , Though Israel be not gathered , yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the  Lord  , and my God shall be my strength .
Now I tell you before it come , that , when it is come to pass , ye may believe that I am he .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa kane mynta , khnang ba haba kata kan jia , phin ngeit ba ‘ Nga long uba nga long .’
Lada u daiñ u briew uba tduh , wat bat ïa ka baroh shi miet ;
translation.en: And if the man be poor , thou shalt not sleep with his pledge :

translation.kha: bad ïa-ong ha ki paidbah , Haba phi ïohi ïa ki lyngdoh ba ki bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang Jong U Trai U Bel jong phi , loit neh ïa ka jaka shongsuk dara bad bud ïa ki .
translation.en: And they commanded the people , saying , When ye see the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  your God , and the priests the Levites bearing it , then ye shall remove from your place , and go after it .

translation.kha: U Pilat u la phai ktien , Me tharai nga dei u Jiw ? Dei ki briew jong me hi bad ki rangbah lyngdoh kaba la aiti ïa me sha to . Kaei kaba me la leh ?
translation.en: Pilate answered , Am I a Jew ? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me : what hast thou done ?

translation.kha: Nga long u Ïoannis , u parabangeit jong phi , bad kum u nongbud jong U Jisu nga long uba ïadon bynshet lem bad phi ban ïaisah ïa ka jingjynjar kaba wan ha kito kiba longsyiem na ka Hima jong u . Ïa nga la buh ha ka dewlynnong Patmos namar nga la pynbna ïa ka Ktien U Blei bad ka jingshisha kiba U Jisu u la pynpaw .
translation.en: I John , who also am your brother , and companion in tribulation , and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ , was in the isle that is called Patmos , for the word of God , and for the testimony of Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Shuwa ba phin sheng ïaleh , u lyngdoh un wan sha khmat bad kren ha kata ka kynhun shipai ,
translation.en: And it shall be , when ye are come nigh unto the battle , that the priest shall approach and speak unto the people ,
So is this great and wide sea , wherein are things creeping innumerable , both small and great beasts .
translation.kha: Ka don ka duriaw-bah , kaba heh bad kaba ïar , ha kaba ki jingthaw bym lah ñiew shuh ki im , kiba rit bad kiba heh kumjuh .

translation.en: And David commanded his young men , and they slew them , and cut off their hands and their feet , and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron . But they took the head of Ish–bosheth , and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ai hukum , bad ki shipai jong u ki la pynïap ïa u Rekhab bad ïa u Baanah bad ki la ot ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jong ki , ïa kiba ki la sdien hajan ka pung ha Hebron . Ki la shim ïa ka khlieh jong u Ishbosheth bad ki la tep ïa ka ha ka jingtep jong u Abner hangta ha Hebron .
U Jisu! u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , malu kaban u dang ïawad , ar ngut ki rangbah kiba matlah ki la sdang ban bud ïa u . To ibeiñ ïa ngi , ko khup u Dabid ! ki la pyrta .
translation.en: And when Jesus departed thence , two blind men followed him , crying , and saying , Thou Son of David , have mercy on us .

translation.kha: U Ahishar u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Tola , u Puah , u Jubab , Bad u Shim .
translation.en: Now the sons of Issachar were , Tola , and Puah , Jashub , and Shimron , four .
For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God , and approved of men .
translation.kha: Bad haba uno uno u shakri ïa U Khrist ha kane ka rukom , u pynsngewbha ïa U Blei bad la pdiang da kiwei pat .

Ho-oid’ , to ong , phi shem ïa de , bad ngan buh pat ïa ph ha ka ri jong phi hi . Ngan lumlang ïa phira na kawei pa kawei ka ri bad na kawei ka jaka shiah kaba at la pynsakma ïa phi , bad ngan ïalum pat ïa phi sha ka ri na kaba nga la phah noh ïa phi sha ka jingshah ringmraw . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .’
translation.en: And I will be found of you , saith the  Lord  : and I will turn away your captivity , and I will gather you from all the nations , and from all the places whither I have driven you , saith the  Lord   ; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah Judah ki kylli ïa ki , balei phi wan ter ïaleh ïa ngi ? Ki jubab , Ngi wanpaw ban kem koidi ïa u Samson bad ngab leh ïa u kumba u la imat ïa ngi .
translation.en: And the men of Judah said , Why are ye come up against us ? And they answered , To bind Samson are we come up , to do to him as he hath done to us .

translation.kha: U Joshua , lem bad ki dala Israel , ki shimti ïa u Akhan , ka rupa , ka barandi , ka lyngkhot ksiar , lem bun ïa ki khun shynriah bad khunlung kynthei lad u Akhan , ki jingroi jong u , ki kada jong u , bun ki langbrot jong u , ka ïingjaiñ jong u , bad kaei Kiei baroh kaba u don , bad ki ïalam ïa ki shiah ka Them Jingjynjar .
translation.en: And Joshua , and all Israel with him , took Achan the son of Zerah , and the silver , and the garment , and the wedge of gold , and his sons , and his daughters , and his oxen , and his asses , and his sheep , and his tent , and all that he had : and they brought them unto the valley of Achor .

translation.kha: Bad u la pyndap , Kane hi ka dei ka daw kaba nga la ïathuh ïa phi ba ym to uba lah ban wan sha nga lymda U Kpa u pynlah ïa u ban leh kumno .
translation.en: And he said ,  Therefore said I unto you , that no man can come unto me , except it were given unto him of my Father .

translation.kha: U briew u bym don ba-ha-ïing ban thied pat ïa ka , hadien habud haba u la pynbha Bad dap biang u lah ban sleit pud ïa ka da lade .
translation.en: And if the man have none to redeem it , and himself be able to redeem it  ;
Salute Urbane , our helper in Christ , and Stachys my beloved .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei ruh ïa u Urbanos , uba ïatrei lem bad ngi ha ka kam U Khrist , bad ïa u Stakhos , u paralok ba-ieit jong nga .
U Blei u pynshitom ïa ki , namar ïa kaei kaba lah ban tip shaphang U blang ka long kaba shai ha ki , naba U Blei da lade hi u la pynjia ïa kata .
translation.en: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them ; for God hath shewed it unto them .

translation.kha: bad u Moses u la sa kumta kitab U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light , and the sweet incense , and the daily meat offering , and the anointing oil , and the oversight of all the tabernacle , and of all that therein is , in the sanctuary , and in the vessels thereof .

translation.kha: Lada at phna na ka byndi ïa lade , ïa kaei katba nga ong ym dei ban pdiang kumno ka jingpynshisha kaba dei .
translation.en: If I bear witness of myself , my witness is not true .

translation.kha: Ki la pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar U Trai da ki jingleh jong ki , bad ka jingpang bashyrkhei ka la mih pangnud lad ki .
translation.en: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions : and the plague brake in upon them .
The word of the  Lord  came also unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren pat ha nga bad u la ong ,

translation.en: Your wives , your little ones , and your cattle , shall remain in the land which Moses gave you on this side Jordan  ; but ye shall pass before your brethren armed , all the mighty men of valour , and help them  ;
translation.kha: Ki tnga jong phi , ki khun jong phi , bad ki jingri jong phi kin sah hangne , hynrei ki shipai jong phi , kiba la kieng atiar na ka bynta ka thma , kin jam shuwa ïa kiwei pat ki Israel khnang ban ïarap ïa ki

translation.en: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city : wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein ?
translation.kha: Lada ki don sanphew ngut kiba hok ha kata ka nongbah , hato men pynjot noh ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei ? Men ym pyllait ïa ka ba ki sanphew ngut kin lait im ?
Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel ha u Lud Gilboa . Kiba bun na ki Israel ki la shat pynïap hangta badno kiwei pat na ki , kynthah ïa u syiad Saul bad ki khun jong u ki la shet krad .
translation.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel : and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain in mount Gilboa .

translation.kha: Te kumba U Trai u la ainong , u Hanamel u la wan sha nga hangta ha ka phyllaw bad u la ong ïa nga ba ngan thied ïa ka lyngkha . Kumta nga sngewthuh ba U Trai u la kren shisha ha nga .
translation.en: So Hanameel mine uncle s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the  Lord  , and said unto me , Buy my field , I pray thee , that is in Anathoth , which is in the country of Benjamin : for the right of inheritance is thine , and the redemption is thine  ; buy it for thyself . Then I knew that this was the word of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka tyrwa ha ka khynñiuh kaba rkhiang , katba ki um ki ïeng kum ki kynjoh na barben arliang .
translation.en: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea  ; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand , and on their left .

translation.kha: U shohdab jingieit ïa ka haduh katta katta , haduh ba u da kem pang , naba um i ni lad da kumto Kumno ban ïohi ïa ka ; kum ka kynthei kaba dang sotti , ym shym shah ïa ka ngab ïashongduh ïa ki shynrang .
translation.en: And Amnon was so vexed , that he fell sick for his sister Tamar  ; for she was a virgin  ; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her .
He that keepeth his mouth keepeth his life : but he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction .
translation.kha: Husiar ïa kaei kaba phi ong bad ri ïa la ka jingim . Uba kren thurmur u pynjot ïa lade .
Haba ki briew ki kheit sohwaiñ , ki ieh de kato katne ba-halor dieng , bad haba ki nonglute ki wan mynmiet , ki shim tang ïa kaei kaba ki kwah .
translation.en: If grapegatherers come to thee , would they not leave some gleaning grapes ? if thieves by night , they will destroy till they have enough .

translation.kha: Bad u la siew ïa u Araunah hynriewspah ki sbai ksiar na ka bynta ka jaka shoh kew .
translation.en: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight .

translation.kha: Ki syiem bakhlaiñbor ki la synriah hangto bad ki la shihajar ïa ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi baroh kawei , ki da lum khajna bad ki jingmih .
translation.en: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem , which have ruled over all countries beyond the river  ; and toll , tribute , and custom , was paid unto them .
And the fifth angel sounded , and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth : and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba san u la put ïa ka turoi . Nga la ïohi ïa u khlur uba la hap sha ka khyndew , bad la ai ha u ïa u shabi jong ka liewlong ba khlem trai .
Leit rah ïa ki jingainguh jong phiah nabar ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba phi la kular shad U Trai tieng shata kata ka jaka mane Blei .
translation.en: Only thy holy things which thou hast , and thy vows , thou shalt take , and go unto the place which the  Lord  shall choose :
Moreover the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga
Ki shipai Phrygia ki ju wan ban ïaleh thma , hynrei ha man ki jingïaleh , u Dabid u kham jop ïa ki ban ïa uno uno u Rangbah shipai jong u Saul . Kumta u Dabid u la pynthnam shibun .
translation.en: Then the princes of the Philistines went forth : and it came to pass , after they went forth , that David behaved himself more wisely than all the servants of Saul  ; so that his name was much set by .

translation.kha: Ïa ka kali ïapom jong u la shet ha ka pun Samaria ; ha kaba ki ksew ki jliah ïa ka snam jong u , bad ki nuti ki sum ki sleh hangta , kumba U Trai u la ong ba kan jia .
translation.en: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria  ; and the dogs licked up his blood  ; and they washed his armour  ; according unto the word of the  Lord  which he spake .

translation.kha: Na la ïuh ïa ki bri ka Kushan ba ki shaphang bad ki briew ka Midian ki khñiot .
translation.en: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction : and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble .

translation.kha: U la ai ha ki ïa ka jingtbit ban trei ïa ki jait kad baroh ba la ju trei da ki nong-ohdur , ki nongthawdur , sad ki nongsuh nongthain ïa ka linen kaba ni ; ïa u saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw ; badno ïa kiwei pat ki jait jaiñ . Ki nang ban trei ïa ki jait kam barabor , bad ki long ruh ki nongpruid dur babha tbit .
translation.en: Them hath he filled with wisdom of heart , to work all manner of work , of the engraver , and of the cunning workman , and of the embroiderer , in blue , and in purple , in scarlet , and in fine linen , and of the weaver , even of them that do any work , and of those that devise cunning work .
The fear of man bringeth a snare : but whoso putteth his trust in the  Lord  shall be safe .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba ma ban sngewkhia ïa kaei kaba kiwei ki pyrkhat shaphang jong phi , hynrei lada phi shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi long shngain .

Khmih shaei , nga don ar ngut ki khuid kynther kiba dang sotti . shiah ngan wallam ïa ki sha phi , bad phi lah ban leh ïa ki katba phi mon . Hynrei wat leh ei ei ïa kine ki rangbah ; ki dei kiba nga la khot sngewbha sha ka ïing jong nga , bad na dei ban ïawad ïa ki .
translation.en: Behold now , I have two daughters which have not known man  ; let me , I pray you , bring them out unto you , and do ye to them as is good in your eyes : only unto these men do nothing  ; for therefore came they under the shadow of my roof .

translation.kha: Ym don uno uno na i uba im tang na ka pyntha ïa lade , ym Don uno uno na ngi uba ïap Tang na ka bynta ïa lade .
translation.en: For none of us liveth to himself , and no man dieth to himself .

translation.kha: To ap phira bha te , namar phim Tip lieng u kynrad jongu ka ïing un wan — ka lah Ban long ha ka por janmiet lieng ha ka para shiteng synñia lane ha Shua ka step phyrngab lane ha ka par thiang shu ñiah sngi .
translation.en: Watch ye therefore : for ye know not when the master of the house cometh , at even , or at midnight , or at the cockcrowing , or in the morning :

translation.kha: wai shukor haba phi thew jingthew da u mawser ne da u diengthew .
translation.en: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures , a great and a small .

translation.kha: Lada u nongshna jong phi u thngan , bna ïa u ; lada u sliang , ai um ba un theh .
translation.en: If thine enemy be hungry , give him bread to eat  ; and if he be thirsty , give him water to drink :

translation.kha: U Joseph u la thied ïa ka jaiñ linen , u la pynhiar ïa ka met shapoh , u la sop ïa ka da ka ïajan , bad u la buh ïa ka ha ka jingtep ïa kambah la lai tih ha u mawsiang . Nangta u pynlapmiet ïa u maw uba heh ha ka jaka rung jong ka jingtep .
translation.en: And he bought fine linen , and took him down , and wrapped him in the linen , and laid him in a sepulchre which was hewn out of a rock , and rolled a stone unto the door of the sepulchre .

translation.kha: bad ba phi la pyndait ba katto kattne ki nonghiarpateng keiñ pynbna ha Jeremaïah ba phi long u syiem ka Judah . U syiemsad , khlam ngap , un ïohsngew shaphang kane , kumta la ai jingmut ba ma phi bad de ngin ïakynduh ban ïakmen halor kane ka kam .
translation.en: And thou hast also appointed prophets to preach of thee at Jerusalem , saying , There is a king in Judah : and now shall it be reported to the king according to these words . Come now therefore , and let us take counsel together .

translation.kha: bad wat lada kito ki lai ngut ki rangbah ki shong ki sah hangta — kumba shisha ma nga , U thri Nongsynshar , nga long U Bela uba im — ngin ym lah ban pynim woh ïa la ki jngai ki khun . Hynrei tang ïa la ka jngai ka jingim .
translation.en: Though these three men were in it , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters , but they only shall be delivered themselves .

translation.kha: Bad haba nga la sdang don kren , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan hiar halor jong ki kumba ka la long shalor Jong ngi ha kaweh sdang .
translation.en: And as I began to speak , the Holy Ghost fell on them , as on us at the beginning .

translation.kha: Nangta katto katno ngat ki briew ki la wallam sha U Jisu ïa u briew uba la matlah bad u bymnang kren namar u la shongsuk . U Jisu u la pynkhiah ïa u briew , ba kumta u la lah ban Kren bad ïohi .
translation.en: Then was brought unto him one possessed with a devil , blind , and dumb : and he healed him , insomuch that the blind and dumb both spake and saw .

translation.kha: Bad tala ka um ka la khuid naduh kata ka sngi , kamra u Elihu u la ong ba kan long kumta .
translation.en: So the waters were healed unto this day , according to the saying of Elisha which he spake .

translation.kha: Hato phim pat shemphang ? Phim kynmaw mynba la la ktah ïa ki san thylli ki kpu na ka bynta ki san hajar ngut ki ïabah ? Katno shang phi la ïa-pihuin ?
translation.en: Do ye not yet understand , neither remember the five loaves of the five thousand , and how many baskets ye took up ?

translation.kha: Nga wallam ïa ka sngi ka jingjop sha jan — kam long sianti kaba dang shiah jngai . Ïa ka jingtip jongki nga yn ym pynpulom . Ngan pyllait im ïa ka Jeremaïah bad lang wallam ïa ka prum ka Israel hangta .
translation.en: I bring near my righteousness  ; it shall not be far off , and my salvation shall not tarry : and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u , u la rupa neh na kata ka jaka , bad bun ki briew ki la bud ïa u . U la pynkhiah ïa kito baroh Ibbah pangnud
translation.en: But when Jesus knew it , he withdrew himself from thence : and great multitudes followed him , and he healed them all  ;

translation.kha: Shabar ha ki khlaw ki pah kum ki mrad bad ki ïa-bishni lang hapoh ki lawlynnong .
translation.en: Among the bushes they brayed  ; under the nettles they were gathered together .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka Templ bad u la bah noh ïa baroh kito uba ïadie bad kiba ïathied hangta . U la pynkylla khongpong ïa ki miej jong ki nongpynkhiah sbai bad ïa ki jaka shong jngai kito kiba die paro ,
translation.en: And Jesus went into the temple of God , and cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple , and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers , and the seats of them that sold doves ,
And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass , and the earth that is under thee shall be iron .
translation.kha: U slap un ym hap , bad ka khyndew kan kylla eh kum u nar .

translation.en: Then shall ye call upon me , and ye shall go and pray unto me , and I will hearken unto you .
translation.kha: Nangta phin khot kyrpad ïa nga . Phin wan bad duwai ha nga , bad ngan jubab ïa phi .

translation.en: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway , to cut off those of his that did escape  ; neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his that did remain in the day of distress .
translation.kha: Pha la dei ban ym ïeng ha ka jaka ba ïashem ki lad ban kem ïa kito kiba pyrshang ban lait im . Pha la dei ban ym aiti ïa ki sha ki nongshun ha ka sngi jong ka jingshipa jong ki .
Pynphai ïa ki khmat jong phira shawei pat na nga ; ki pynshohbieit ïa ang . U jingkhynñiuh jongngi phi u shad kum ka kynhun ki blang kiba ïadait shaw trai jong ki lum ka Gilead .
translation.en: Thine head upon thee is like Carmel , and the hair of thine head like purple  ; the king is held in the galleries .

translation.kha: U Blei u la jied ïa ki nong Israel ban longsyiem ki nongsakhi jong u .
translation.en: God chose the Israelites to be his witnesses .

translation.kha: Kum u syiem Jeroboam ha shuwa jongnga u , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Troas bad u ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop ; um shym la iohnong ïa ki lynti bymman .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and followed the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , which made Israel to sin  ; he departed not therefrom .
And Esau said , Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me . And he said , What needeth it ? let me find grace in the sight of my lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u Iso u ong ,  Te kumta , shah ngan ieh katto katne ngut ki briew jong nga bad phi .  Hynrei u Jakob u ong ,  Ym da donkam ban leh kumta namar nga kwah tang ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong phi .

translation.en: They shall not build , and another inhabit  ; they shall not plant , and another eat : for as the days of a tree are the days of my people , and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands .
translation.kha: Kum ki dieng , ki briew jong nga kin im slem . Kin ïoh ban lehkmen pura ha kiei kiei kiba ki la trei shitom .
Wan ïalam sa ïa ki khun shngain lad u , bad pynong sop ïa ki .
translation.en: And thou shalt bring his sons , and clothe them with coats :

translation.kha: Hobah phi ai shiliang ei ei ïano ïano , phim dei ban shim ïingbyndi da u mawtylliat kew jyllang u , namsop kata ka longsem bania phi shimti bynda ïa ka tiar khreh bam kambah kirteng ïa ka jingim jong u .
translation.en: No man shall take the nether or the upper millstone to pledge : for he taketh a man s life to pledge .

translation.kha: Ki paidlang Israel ki la boitha ïa ka ri kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: As the  Lord  commanded Moses , so the children of Israel did , and they divided the land .

translation.kha: La ne sa kawei pat ka thma bad ki Philistia ha Gob , dara u Elhanan , u khun jong u Jair uba na Bethlehem u la pynïap ïa u Goliath na Gath , uba u sum jong u , u don u dieng thung ngam uba rben kat u khung jong u nongthain jait .
translation.en: And there was again a battle in Gob with the Philistines , where Elhanan the son of Jaare–oregim , a Beth–lehemite , slew the brother of Goliath the Gittite , the staff of whose spear was like a weaver s beam .
And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi , Let me now go to the field , and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace . And she said unto her , Go , my daughter .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi ka Ruth ka ong ha ka Naomi ,  Shah ba ngan leit sha ki lyngkha ban tam ïa u kew ba ki nongot ki ieh . Nga thikna ban shem u briew u ban shah ïa nga ban trei bad u .  Ka Naomi ka ong ,  Khie leit , ko khun jong nga .

translation.en: But man dieth , and wasteth away : yea , man giveth up the ghost , and where is he ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u briew u ïap noh , bad kata ka long kaba kut jong u ; u ïap bad hangno keiñ u don ?

translation.en: A bruised reed shall he not break , and the smoking flax shall he not quench : he shall bring forth judgment unto truth .
translation.kha: Un ym pynkheiñ ïa u khah ba la dem un ym pynlip ïa ka sharak ba dang mehding , un wanrah ka jingbishar hok baneh ïa baroh .

U Blei u la ong ha nga , Ko khun u briew , plied shaïong shatei . Ngi la peit , bad Hangta hajan ka duwan Harod ka jaka rung ka khyrdop ang la ïohi ïa ka dur bleithaw ka long ka jingidiaw ba pynbitar ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north . So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north , and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry .
Thus the  Lord  saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians  ; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U  Trai  u pyllait im ïa ki Israel na ki Ijipt , bad ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ki ba ki thiah ïap harud duriaw .

translation.en: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Dabid u la pyndep ban ai ïa ki jingkñia , u kyrkhu ïa ki paidbah ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  bad sam jingbam ïa ki baroh .

Na ka bynta U Khrist ngi long kaba bieit ; hynrei , phi long kiba stad ha U Kherith ! Nga long kiba tlot , hynrei phi long kiba khlaiñ ! ngin long bakha la ibeiñ , hynrei phi long kiba la pyndonburom !
translation.en: We are fools for Christ s sake , but ye are wise in Christ ; we are weak , but ye are strong ; ye are honourable , but we are despised .

translation.kha: U Trai u ai ha ki ïa kane ka jubab , Ki Ijipt , ki Amor , ki Ammon , ki Philistia
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto the children of Israel , Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians , and from the Amorites , from the children of Ammon , and from the Philistines ?

translation.kha: Te u Moses u ong ha u Aaron , Kane ka long kaei kaban U Trai u la kren shaphang jong ka mynba u ïong , ‘ Baroh kiba shakor ïa nga ki dei ngab burom ïa ka jinglongkhuid jong por ; ngan pynpaw ïa ka burom jong nga ha la ki bynriew .’ Hynrei u Horon u shu sngap Jar .
translation.en: Then Moses said unto Aaron , This is it that the  Lord  spake , saying , I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me , and before all the people I will be glorified . And Aaron held his peace .

translation.kha: ‘ Ym don mano ma ba khot bylla ïa ine ,’ ki la jubab . ‘ Lada kumta , te , phi ruh ktieh leit nabar twa ha ka bri sohwaiñ ,’ u la ong ha ki .
translation.en: They say unto him , Because no man hath hired us . He saith unto them , Go ye also into the vineyard  ; and whatsoever is right , that shall ye receive .

translation.kha: Ïa ki metïap jongngi ki shipai jong ki yn iehnoh ha ki da bad ki mradkhlaw . Ha ka lyiur ki da kin bam ïa ki , mala ha ka tlang ki mrad .
translation.en: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains , and to the beasts of the earth : and the fowls shall summer upon them , and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them .

translation.kha: wahbah U Trai u ai ïa ka hukum , ki ïing kiba rit mala uba khah kin shah pynpaw lyngkhot lyngkhai .
translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  commandeth , and he will smite the great house with breaches , and the little house with clefts .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïada ïa ki bym don jingïar ; haba sa la don ha ka jingma , u la pyllait im ïa nga .
translation.en: The  Lord  preserveth the simple : I was brought low , and he helped me .

translation.kha: Nga la pynshitom beiñ haduh kaba pynjop ïa ki briew kiba la burom ïa kane ka ryntih . NGA la kem ïa ki rangbah bad ki kynthih mala de la thep ïa ki ha ka byndi .
translation.en: And I persecuted this way unto the death , binding and delivering into prisons both men and women .

translation.kha: U pynïap lat ïa ki lyndang nongmane beit thad halor ki duwan ba ki Shakri , bad u thang ïa ki shyieng briew ha kawei pa kawei ka Eri . Nangta u leit phad pat sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And he slew all the priests of the high places that were there upon the altars , and burned men s bones upon them , and returned to Jerusalem .
And they met Moses and Aaron , who stood in the way , as they came forth from Pharaoh :
translation.kha: Haba ki dang mihnoh , ki ïakynduh ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , kiba ap ïa ki .
Ka jingpang bashyrkhei kan ïahap halor ki balui , ki khashor , ki ut , bad ki kam — halor ki mrad baroh ha ki jaka sher dara jong u nongshun .

translation.en: And when they did mete it with an omer , he that gathered much had nothing over , and he that gathered little had no lack  ; they gathered every man according to his eating .
And this is but a light thing in the sight of the  Lord  : he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand .
translation.kha: Bad u Elisha u bteng ,  Hynrei kane ka long kaba jem ïa U  Trai  ban leh ; un ai ruh ha phi ka jingjop halor ki Moab .

translation.en: The king shall mourn , and the prince shall be clothed with desolation , and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled : I will do unto them after their way , and according to their deserts will I judge them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem un ïam pangnud , u khun syiem un duh jingkyrmen , bad ki briew kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ngan pynshitom ïa phi na ka bynta baroh kaba phi la leh , bad ngan bishar ïa phi ha kajuh ka rukom kumba phi la bishar ïa kiwei . Kane kan pyn-i ha phi ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: This is the law of the house  ; Upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy . Behold , this is the law of the house .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka hukum jong ka Templ : Baroh ka jaka sawdong jong ka halor jong u lum ka long kaba kyntang bad kaba khuid .

translation.en: And straightway he called them : and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants , and went after him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u tang shu ïohi ïa ki , u la khot ïa ki ; ki la iehnoh ïa la u kpa jong ki , u Sebedi ha ka lieng ryngkat bad ki rangbah kiba trei bylla , bad ki la leit bad U Jisu .
Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki ïaid sha khmat ryngkat bad la ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut bad kiba shihajar ngut , u Dabid bad ki briew jyllang u ki ïaid nadien bad u syiem Akhish .
translation.en: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds , and by thousands : but David and his men passed on in the rearward with Achish .

translation.kha: Ka kti “ksuid” kamut uno eit uba kren lamwir shaphang kiwei pat .
translation.en: The word “devil” means someone who tells wicked lies about another person .

translation.kha: Phi shang sngewkynduh hateng ki dieng Kedar ba wanrah na Lebanon ; hynrei katno kaba sngewieit ynda wan ka jingshitom ha phi , bad phi ud haba ka jingsait kan lap ïa phi , ki jingshitom kum kito ki jong ka kynthei kiba suh kwah .
translation.en: O inhabitant of Lebanon , that makest thy nest in the cedars , how gracious shalt thou be when pangs come upon thee , the pain as of a woman in travail !

translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Blei ba ngam shym la pynbaptis ïano ïan na pa lait noh ïa u Krispos bad u Gaïos .
translation.en: I thank God that I baptized none of you , but Crispus and Gaius ;
Hear ye this word which I take up against you , even a lamentation , O house of Israel .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko ki paid Israel , ïa kane ka jingrwai leit ontep kaba nga rwai ha phi :

translation.en: Then Naomi her mother in law said unto her , My daughter , shall I not seek rest for thee , that it may be well with thee ?
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por ka Naomi ka ong ha ka Ruth ,  Nga dei ban shem u tnga na ka bynta jong phi , khnang ba phin don la ka jong ka longïing .
Katto U Jisu u don ha la ka lynti sha Jerusalem , u la leit na ka pud hapdeng ka Samaria bad ka Gamaliel .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he went to Jerusalem , that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee .
And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold : two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof , and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka jingtap da ka ksiar nylla , kaba shispah shiphew sentimitar ka lynter bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang .

translation.en: Then came Jeremiah from Topheth , whither the  Lord  had sent him to prophesy  ; and he stood in the court of the  Lord s  house  ; and said to all the people ,
translation.kha: Nangta nga la iehnoh ïa ka Topheth , ha kaba U  Trai  u la phah ïa nga ban pynbna ïa ka khubor jong u . Nga la leit bad ïeng hapoh ka phyllaw jong ka Templ bad ïathuh ha ki briew baroh
Un kitei phai na khwai ka lynti na kaba u la wan , khyllem da rung sha kane ka nongbah . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: By the way that he came , by the same shall he return , and shall not come into this city , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki ïam ba leit phai lang! sha Judah , hynrei ha lynti ka ino ïa ki ,
translation.en: Wherefore she went forth out of the place where she was , and her two daughters in law with her  ; and they went on the way to return unto the land of Judah .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba lai jongki ka jingshah jingleit , ka Esther ka phong ïa ki jingriew syiem jong ka bad ka leit bad ïeng ha ka phyllaw ba kham shahïap ka ïingsyiem , kaba phai khmat sha ka kamram ba Don ka khet syiem . U syiem u don ioh , u shong halor ka khet syiem , da kambah phai khmut sha ka khyrdop .
translation.en: Now it came to pass on the third day , that Esther put on her royal apparel , and stood in the inner court of the king s house , over against the king s house : and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house , over against the gate of the house .

translation.kha: Ngan phah ha ki ïa u nongïathuhlypa kaba kum ma me napdeng ki para jait jong ki hi ; ngan sa ïateh ha u aïu un ong , bad un kren ha ki briew kat ïa kaba por suda .
translation.en: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren , like unto thee , and will put my words in his mouth  ; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him .

translation.kha: U Simon hi ruh u la ngeit ; bad hadien ba la pynbaptis ïa u , u la bud ha kti ha kjat ïa u Philip bad u la sngewlyngngoh haba u la ïew ïa ki kamphylla bad ki kambah ïa kiba la leh .
translation.en: Then Simon himself believed also : and when he was baptized , he continued with Philip , and wondered , beholding the miracles and signs which were done .

translation.kha: Te u Hosea u khun jong u Nun , uba hir u nongïarap jong u naduh ba u dang kup , u ong , Ko Kynrad , pynshongduh ïa ki !
translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of Moses , one of his young men , answered and said , My lord Moses , forbid them .

translation.kha: Un wan bad pynïap ïa kito ki rangbah , bad un ai ïa ka byrni sohwaiñ ha kiwei pat ki nongshimwai . Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la ong , Ym kumta ksaiñ !
translation.en: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen , and shall give the vineyard to others .  And when they heard it , they said , God forbid .
Let all the earth fear the  Lord  : let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him .
translation.kha: To mane ïa U  Trai  , phi baroh ka pyrthei ! To pyndonburom ïa u , phi baroh ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei !
phiah ia mynjur bad u Tom , dei ?
translation.en: You agree with Tom , right ?

translation.kha: U Trai u shoh ïa u Ussaïah da ka jingpang sniehdoh kaba shongkai kabu la sah bad u shi lynter ka jingim jong u . U sah hi Mareh ha la ka jong ka ïing , la pyllew ïa u na ki kamram baroh , katba u Jotham u Kynhun jong u , u pynïaid ïa ka hima .
translation.en: And the  Lord  smote the king , so that he was a leper unto the day of his death , and dwelt in a several house . And Jotham the king s son was over the house , judging the people of the land .

translation.kha: Haba ka Bathsheba ka la sngewkyiuh ba u tnga jongki ka u la shah pynïap , ka ïalamwir na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead , she mourned for her husband .

translation.kha: ïa ka jingkynnoh , dalade phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Trai U Blei jong pa ïa kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi ;
translation.en: A blessing , if ye obey the commandments of the  Lord  your God , which I command you this day :
Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world , but was manifest in these last times for you ,
translation.kha: La jied ïa u da U Blei ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei bad la pynpaw ha kine ki sngi kiba khatduh na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: That thou mayest regard discretion , and that thy lips may keep knowledge .
translation.kha: Te phin sa nang kumno ban leh donakor , bad ki ktien jong phi kin pynpaw ba phi don ka jingtip .

translation.en: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you , because ye go to law one with another . Why do ye not rather take wrong ? why do ye not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded ?
translation.kha: Ka jingshisha ba phi ïadon ki jingïakajia hapoh ka aiñ hapdeng jong phi hi , ka pyn-i phi la rem nadong shadong . Hato kam kham bha ïa phi ban shah bymdei ? Hato kam kham bha ba phin shah lute noh ?
Phibi hi phi tip bha ba phi dei ban leh ïa kaei katba me la leh . Ngim shyiap la erlangthari kiba jaipdeh mynba ngi la don bad phi .
translation.en: For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us : for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you ;

And I will give her her vineyards from thence , and the valley of Achor for a door of hope : and she shall sing there , as in the days of her youth , and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ngan ai pat ha ka ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong ka , bad ngan pynlong ïa ka Them Jingshitom sha ka khyrdop ka jingkyrmen . Hangta kan sa phai ktien ïa nga kumba ka la leh mynba ka dang samla , mynba ka wan mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt .
Hato phim thup ba u syier Baalis jongno ki Ammon u la phah ïa u Ishmael banbeiñ pynpei ïa phi ? Hynrei u Igdalaïah um shym ngeit ïa kata .
translation.en: And said unto him , Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee ? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not .

translation.kha: Ïa u Asaph la thung nongïalam bad ïa u Sekharaïah kum u nongap . La thrang ïa u Jeiel , u Shimrith , u Jehiel , u Mattithaïah , u Elijah , u Benaïah , u Obed Edom bad u Jeiel ban tem ki duitara . U Ahasaïah un pynsan ki shakuriaw ,
translation.en: Asaph the chief , and next to him Zechariah , Jeiel , and Shemiramoth , and Jehiel , and Mattithiah , and Eliab , and Benaiah , and Obed–edom : and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps  ; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals  ;
But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces : and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold , and silver , and with precious stones , and pleasant things .
translation.kha: Pynban , un pyndonburom ïa u blei uba ïada ïa ki kut . Un ai ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawlynnai , bad kiwei kiwei ki jingai babha sha u blei uba ki kpa tymmen jong u kim shym la ju mane .
Bad ma phi ! Phibi pyrshang ban pyntngen ïa nga ha ka jingsait ! Balah ka jubab ba phoi ai ka long ka jingshukor !
translation.en: How then comfort ye me in vain , seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood ?
Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law : she is thy son s wife  ; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .
translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bad la ka pyrsa kurim
Ki samla shyieng jongngi ki nongbah ka Heliopolis bad Bubastis keiñ ïalap ha ka thma , bad kiwei ki briew kin shah rah kum ki kadei .
translation.en: The young men of Aven and of Pi–beseth shall fall by the sword : and these cities shall go into captivity .

translation.kha: Ko pyntud Israel , ki nongïathuhlypa jongno phi ki long ki bymjukut kum ki myrsiang kiba shongsuk hapdeng ki jingjied jong ka nongbah .
translation.en: O Israel , thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , u Benhadad u syiem ka Syria u la ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh kawei pyrshah ïa ka Israel bad kyrthat ïa ka nongbah Samaria .
translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that Ben–hadad king of Syria gathered all his host , and went up , and besieged Samaria .

And I saw the dead , small and great , stand before God  ; and the books were opened : and another book was opened , which is the book of life : and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books , according to their works .
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa kiba ïap , kiba rit bad kiba khraw kumjuh , kiba ïeng ha khmat jong ka khet . Ïa ki kitab la plied , bad nangta la plied sa kawei pat ka kitab , ka kitab jong kiba im . Ïa kiba ïap la bishar kat kum kaei kaba ki la leh , kumba la buh jingthoh ha ki kitab .
Kim don khuid namar ba ka Elisabeth kam shym lah ban ïoh wat iwei shwa , dara ma ka lem badno u Sekharaïah ki la tymmen bha .
translation.en: And they had no child , because that Elisabeth was barren , and they both were now well stricken in years .

translation.kha: Ka mut aïu khnai ‘ sa tong shipor ?’ ngin thop ba u kren shaphrang kaei !
translation.en: They said therefore , What is this that he saith ,  A little while ?  we cannot tell what he saith .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ban kha ïa nga , U Trai u la thung ïa nga ; u la pynlong ïa nga u shakri jong u ban wallam patar ïa ki brai jong u , ban wallam pat ïa ka jingïambriew Israel kaba la saphriang kylleng . U TRAI’ u ai ha nga ka burom ; u long u tyllong jongu ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga .
translation.en: And now , saith the  Lord  that formed me from the womb to be his servant , to bring Jacob again to him , Though Israel be not gathered , yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the  Lord  , and my God shall be my strength .

translation.kha: U Ussaïah u kurup biang bad tei pat ïa ka Elath hateng ka jingïap u kpa jong u .
translation.en: He built Elath , and restored it to Judah , after that the king slept with his fathers .

translation.kha: Utai u bhabriew uba la ïap u la khie shong bad u la ïasdang ban kren , bad U Jisu u la ai ïa u patiaw sha ha ka kmie jongngi u .
translation.en: And he that was dead sat up , and began to speak . And he delivered him to his mother .

And he said , Is not he rightly named Jacob ? for he hath supplanted me these two times : he took away my birthright  ; and , behold , now he hath taken away my blessing . And he said , Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me ?
translation.kha: U Iso u ong ,  Kane ka dei ka sien kaba ar ba u la shet shukor ïa nga . Kam long kaba phylla ba ka kyrteng jong u ka dei u Jakob . U la shim noh ïa ki hok ka jinglong khun nyngkong jong nga , bad mynta pat u la shim sa ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong nga . Hato phim shym la tyngkai ka jingkyrkhu ïa nga ?

translation.en: Yet saith the house of Israel , The way of the Lord is not equal . O house of Israel , are not my ways equal ? are not your ways unequal ?
translation.kha: Bad ma phi ki Israel phi ong , ‘ Kaei kaba U  Trai  u leh ka long ka bym dei .’ Phi pyrkhat ba ka lynti jong nga kam shym long kaba dei , hato ym dei kumta ? Ka dei ka lynti jong phi ka bym long kaba dei .

Habor u rangbah Shiphew bad ki shipor kiba pynlang u , uba la ïa-ap ïa U Jisu ki la ieh ïa u jumai bad ïa kiei kiei barhem kiba la jia , ki la sngewkynduh bad ki la ong , Da shisha u la long U Khun U Blei !
translation.en: Now when the centurion , and they that were with him , watching Jesus , saw the earthquake , and those things that were done , they feared greatly , saying , Truly this was the Son of God .

translation.kha: Haba u briew u jaipdeh shaba palat ban shynna pynbha ïa ka tnum ïing jong u , kan jaw um , bad ka ïing kan khyllem .
translation.en: By much slothfulness the building decayeth  ; and through idleness of the hands the house droppeth through .

translation.kha: Balei U Blei’ um ai ha nga ïa kaba nga pan ? Balei um jyllop ïa ka jingïarwai lad la ?
translation.en: Oh that I might have my request  ; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for !

translation.kha: Ka pyllait kan ka ïapra mala kan jot . U thri u la kren bad ïa kata yn pyndep .
translation.en: The land shall be utterly emptied , and utterly spoiled : for the  Lord  hath spoken this word .

translation.kha: Haba u hiarthma ïa kito ki ri baroh , woh ïa ka Ijipt ruh yn ym ïoh .
translation.en: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries : and the land of Egypt shall not escape .

translation.kha: U Joseph u la hukum ban pyndap ïa ki byrni jong ki hynmen shynraiñ jong u da u kew , bad ba-bang thep biang ïa ki pisa jong uwei pa uwei ha ka byrsha jong u , nabar ban ai jingbam de ba kin ïor bam ha lynti . Ïa Kanneh la kuna .
translation.en: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn , and to restore every man s money into his sack , and to give them provision for the way : and thus did he unto them .

translation.kha: Ka sur jong nga ka rit bad tlot , mala nga ud kum ka paro . Ki khmat jong nga ki la thait na kiba khmied sha bneng . A Trai , pyllait im ïa nga na kane ka jinglwet barhem .
translation.en: Like a crane or a swallow , so did I chatter : I did mourn as a dove : mine eyes fail with looking upward : O  Lord  , I am oppressed  ; undertake for me .

And Moses besought the  Lord  his God , and said ,  Lord  , why doth thy wrath wax hot against thy people , which thou hast brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power , and with a mighty hand ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u la ïasaid bad U  Trai  U Blei jong u , bad u la ong ,  Ko  Trai  , balei ba men bitar haduh katne ïa la ki jong ki briew , kiba me la pyllait na ka ri Ijipt da ka jingkhlaiñ bakhraw bad da ka bor ?

translation.en: And he gave them their request  ; but sent leanness into their soul .
translation.kha: kumta u la ai ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki la pan kwah , bad u la phah ruh ïa ka jingpang bashyrkhei hapdeng jong ki .
U Trai u ong , To shahshkor mynta , ko Israel , u shakri Jong nga , ki briew ba la jied jong nga , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob .
translation.en: Yet now hear , O Jacob my servant  ; and Israel , whom I have chosen :

translation.kha: U Tola u ba-don hynriew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Ussi , u Rephah , u Jeriel , u Jahmai , u Ishbah , bun u Shemuel . Ki dei ki khlieh jongno ki longïing kiba na ka kur Talitha , bad ki dem ruh ki shipai ba-bymman . Ha ka jer u syiem Dabid , ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki don arphew ar khashor hynriew ngut .
translation.en: And the sons of Tola  ; Uzzi , and Rephaiah , and Jeriel , and Jahmai , and Jibsam , and Shemuel , heads of their father s house , to wit , of Tola : they were valiant men of might in their generations  ; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred .

translation.kha: Lada don ki kam kiba khem eh ïa ki nongsynshar shnong pun rai , kum ki mokotduma ïaknieh khyndew , lane kiba dei shaphang kaba ïashoh ïadat , litar kita naba hap ban pynïapher hapdeng ka jingpynïap briew bad kawei pat ka jait jingpynpoi briew , leit sha kata ka jaka mane Blei ïa kaban la jied da U Trai U Blang jong pa’ ,
translation.en: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment , between blood and blood , between plea and plea , and between stroke and stroke , being matters of controversy within thy gates : then shalt thou arise , and get thee up into the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose  ;

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la wan Sha u bad ki la pyrshang ban riam ïa u da kaba kylli , Hato ka Aiu jongnga ngi ka shah ïa u briew ban pyllut noh ïa ka tnga jong u na ka bynda kano kano ka daw kaba u mon ?
translation.en: The Pharisees also came unto him , tempting him , and saying unto him , Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause ?
They that were foolish took their lamps , and took no oil with them :
translation.kha: Kita kiba bieit ki la rah ïa la ki sharak hynrei kim shym la rah tam ïa ka umphniang bad ki ,

Ong ïa ki Israel ba ma nga , U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei jong u Abbim , u Isaak bun u Jakob , u la phah ïa me sha ki . Kane ka long ka Kyrteng jong nga junom la jingmut ; kumne ruh ki pateng briew ki ban dang wan ki dei ban khot ïa nga .
translation.en: And God said moreover unto Moses , Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel , The  Lord  God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , hath sent me unto you : this is my name for ever , and this is my memorial unto all generations .

translation.kha: Haba U Khun U Briew u la wan , u la bam bad u la dih , bad uwei uwei bhor u la ong , ‘ Ha khmih ïa une u briew ! U long uba laiñ bad u nongdih , u paralok jong ki nonglum khñiang badno Kawei pud kiba la shah kyntait !’ Pynban , ïa ka jingstad Blei la pyni ba ka long kaba shisha da kiba mih na ka .
translation.en: The Son of man came eating and drinking , and they say , Behold a man gluttonous , and a winebibber , a friend of publicans and sinners . But wisdom is justified of her children .

translation.kha: phi! dei ban tohmet bniah ïa kata .
translation.en: And it be told thee , and thou hast heard of it , and enquired diligently , and , behold , it be true , and the thing certain , that such abomination is wrought in Israel :

translation.kha: U tnga u dei ban ieit ïa la ka tnga kumba u ieit ïalade .
translation.en: A husband should love his wife just as he loves himself .

translation.kha: Nangno ki mih ki thnum bad ki jingkajia napdeng jong phi ? Ki mih na ki jingkwah brai jong phira ïa ka jingsngewbha , katba ïai ïaleh hapoh jong phi .
translation.en: From whence come wars and fightings among you ? come they not hence , even of your lusts that war in your members ?

translation.kha: Uta suba tim ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie u dei ban shah pynïap .
translation.en: And he that curseth his father , or his mother , shall surely be put to death .

translation.kha: Ka daw ba nga pynsakma ïa ki pharshi ha kaba ïakren bad ki ka long ba ki peit , hynne ki ïohi , bad ki shahshkor , hynrei kim ïohsngew lane Shaphang .
translation.en: Therefore speak I to them in parables : because they seeing see not  ; and hearing they hear not , neither do they understand .

translation.kha: haba u Shaul u ïohsngew ba u Arbad u la phet ïarep sha Hangta , u sangeh noh ban wad ïa u .
translation.en: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath : and he sought no more again for him .

Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah , and said unto him , What said these men ? and from whence came they unto thee ? And Hezekiah said , They are come from a far country , even from Babylon .
translation.kha: Nangta u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u leit sha u syiem Hesekaïah bad u kylli ,  Nangno kine ki rangbah ki la wan bad ki la ong aïu ïa me ?  U Hesekaïah u jubab ,  Ki la wan na ka ri kaba jngai , na Babilonia .
Habor me wan , to wanrah ïa ka jaiñkup ba nga la iehnoh ha Troas bad u Karpos ; ïawer ruh ïa ki kot , bad khamtam ïa ki kot ba la sop snieh .
translation.en: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus , when thou comest , bring with thee , and the books , but especially the parchments .

translation.kha: U la ïohi ïa ki jaiñsop linen kiba la dat hangta , bad ïa ka jaiñ ka spaiñ ïa ka khlieh U Jisu . Kane kdew shym don lang bad ki jaiñsop linen ishyrkhei kaba la krai ïa ka jong .
translation.en: And the napkin , that was about his head , not lying with the linen clothes , but wrapped together in a place by itself .

Your iniquities , and the iniquities of your fathers together , saith the  Lord  , which have burned incense upon the mountains , and blasphemed me upon the hills : therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom .
translation.kha: na ka bynta ki pop jong ki bad ki pop jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Ki la thang ki jingiwbih ha ki duwan thala kiba halor ki lum bad ki la kren sniew ïa nga . Kumta ngan pynshitom ïa ki kumba ka dei hok ïa ki namar ki kam ba ki la leh mynshuwa .

translation.en: And the nations were angry , and thy wrath is come , and the time of the dead , that they should be judged , and that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants the prophets , and to the saints , and them that fear thy name , small and great  ; and shouldest destroy them which destroy the earth .
translation.kha: Kiba mane blei thala ki la dap da ka jingbitar shla , namar ka por jong ka jingbitar jong me ka la poi , ka por ban bishar ïa kiba ïap . Ka por ka la poi ban ainong ïa ki shakri jong me , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ïa ki briew jong me baroh , kito baroh kiba tiengburom ïa me , kiba khraw bad kiba rit kumjuh . Ka por ka la poi ban pynjot ïa kito kiba pynjot ïa ka pyrthei !

translation.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall : and , behold , if the scall be not spread in the skin , nor be in sight deeper than the skin  ; then the priest shall pronounce him clean : and he shall wash his clothes , and be clean .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u lyngdoh un peit biang ïa kata ka prum , bad lada kam pat pur bad kam kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid . Uta u briew un sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad un long uba khuid .

translation.en: The way of the  Lord  is strength to the upright : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïada ïa ki briew kiba ïaid hok ; hynrei u pynjot ïa kito kiba leh bymdei .
U Joseph u thuh ïa u Ephraim ha ka kular kadiang jong u Jakob bad ïa u Manasseh ha ka liang kamon jongki u .
translation.en: And Joseph took them both , Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel s left hand , and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel s right hand , and brought them near unto him .

translation.kha: Te kamut ngin kohnguh ba kan don ka jingïashongkha khleh hapdeng jongki ngi . Ngin shong ïong sah hapdeng jongno phi , bad iing ïalong kawei ka jaitbynriew bad phi .
translation.en: Then will we give our daughters unto you , and we will take your daughters to us , and we will dwell with you , and we will become one people .

translation.kha: Hadien ba la dep ïa kaei , ki Lebi ki pynkieng doh na ka byndi ïa lade bad na ka bynta ki lyndang kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron , Namarba ba ki lyngkhuh ki bunkam haduh mynmiet , ha kaba thang tylli ïa ki jingri bad ïa ka khleiñ jongki ki jingkñia .
translation.en: And afterward they made ready for themselves , and for the priests : because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night  ; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves , and for the priests the sons of Aaron .

translation.kha: ïa u brup u ba jingngeit u ban bameh ïa kano kano ka jingbamsap : U wei pat u briew uba tlot , u bam da ki jhur .
translation.en: For one believeth that he may eat all things : another , who is weak , eateth herbs .

translation.kha: Haba ki rieh ha la ki kram ne haba ki dem baneh ap ha la ki Kem ?
translation.en: When they couch in their dens , and abide in the covert to lie in wait ?

And they beat down the cities , and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone , and filled it  ; and they stopped all the wells of water , and felled all the good trees : only in Kir–hareseth left they the stones thereof  ; howbeit the slingers went about it , and smote it .
translation.kha: bad pynjot ïa ki nongbah jong ki . Katba ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka lyngkha baseisoh , uwei pa uwei u Israel u ju kawang maw ha ka haduh ba la tap lin ïa baroh ki lyngkha ; ki la pynsangeh ruh ïa ki umpohliew bad ki la pom ïa ki diengsoh . Ha kaba khatduh tang ka nongbah Kir Heres ka dang sah , bad ki nongkawang maw ki kerkut ïa ka bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .

Man ka na ba ka langbrot ka shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw , nga kitkhlieh hi ma nga . Ngam ju wanpaw ïa kata ban pyn-i ha phi ba kam shem dei ka jingbakla jong nga . Phi dawa ba ma nga hi ngan hap buria ïa kaba lah shah shit la ka long mynsngi lane mynmiet .
translation.en: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee  ; I bare the loss of it  ; of my hand didst thou require it , whether stolen by day , or stolen by night .

translation.kha: Phi tip shaphang u Stephanas malu ka longïing jong u ; ki long ki Khristan uba nyngkong eh ha Asaïah bad ki la aiti ïa lade ïa ka ban shakri ïa ki briew jong U Blei .
translation.en: I beseech you , brethren , (ye know the house of Stephanas , that it is the firstfruits of Achaia , and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints ,)
And thou shalt set up the court round about , and hang up the hanging at the court gate .
translation.kha: Pynïeng ïa ka phyllaw kaba baroh sawdong bad wah ïa ka pyrda ha ka khyrdop jong ka .

translation.en: And Saul tarried in the uttermost part of Gibeah under a pomegranate tree which is in Migron : and the people that were with him were about six hundred men  ;
translation.kha: uba sher dara ha trai u soh Pomkranet ha Migron , ym da jngai na Gibeah ; u la don bad u kumba hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah .
Nangta sa khmied beiñ ïa ka pyrthei , kum uba skhem bad uba shlur .
translation.en: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot  ; yea , thou shalt be stedfast , and shalt not fear :

translation.kha: Mar ïa jingphohsniew ïa kane , u Ananias u la kyllon ïap ; bad barhem kiba la ïohpdiang shaphang kane , ki la sngewkhlaiñ .
translation.en: And Ananias hearing these words fell down , and gave up the ghost : and great fear came on all them that heard these things .

translation.kha: A katno kmie jongno phi ka la long kum ka rang ! Ka la pynheh pynsan ïa ki khun jong ka hapdeng ki sing shynrang kiba ishyrkhei .
translation.en: And say , What is thy mother ? A lioness : she lay down among lions , she nourished her whelps among young lions .
One Lord , one faith , one baptism ,
translation.kha: Don tang uwei U Trai , kawei ka jingngeit , kawei ka jingpynbaptis ;
Ïa kito ki lyngdoh ym shyiap la shah ban shakri ha ka Templ , hynrei ki lah ban bam-im ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat ba la ju ai ïa ki para lyngdoh jong ki .
translation.en: Nevertheless the priests of the high places came not up to the altar of the  Lord  in Jerusalem , but they did eat of the unleavened bread among their brethren .

translation.kha: Kam da jngai nangta la don ka kynhun bah ki sniang Kiba dang ïapmat jingbam .
translation.en: And there was a good way off from them an herd of many swine feeding .

translation.kha: Nangta katba u dang ïam kumta , u piam u dohkha sa ïa ki bymneh jong u baroh ; hadien kata , ki hynmen jong u ki sa ïakren ïakhana bad u .
translation.en: Moreover he kissed all his brethren , and wept upon them : and after that his brethren talked with him .

translation.kha: U Isaak u mihnoh nangta bad u leit Sha Hephsibah .
translation.en: And he went up from thence to Beer–sheba .

translation.kha: Don Saw tylli kiei kiei kiba ktien umjer ïa ka jingmut haba pynlut ba ki ïadat :
translation.en: There be three things which go well , yea , four are comely in going :

translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , te , to bam khyndiat ka jingjam ; phi donkam ïa ka kthang ban im . Wah iwei i shñiuh na ka khlieh jongu Phi in ym hap ei .
translation.en: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat : for this is for your health : for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you .
And he closed the book , and he gave it again to the minister , and sat down . And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him .
