La ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa halor ki kliar lum : ki dei ki paid Israel kiba ïam bad ïasaid , namar ba ki la im ka jingrem ba-dap da ka pop bad ba ki la klet ïa U Tlai U balui jong ki .
translation.en: A voice was heard upon the high places , weeping and supplications of the children of Israel : for they have perverted their way , and they have forgotten the  Lord  their God .

translation.kha: Hynrei , kine ki briew , ki tur ïaleh da kaba krenbeiñ da kiei kiei kiba kim sngewthuh ; malade kito kiei kiei kaba ki tip da ka bor tipthuh kum ki mradkhlaw , ki long kita hi kiei kiei kiba pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: But these speak evil of those things which they know not : but what they know naturally , as brute beasts , in those things they corrupt themselves .
Of course , that was a lie . —Genesis 3 :1-5 .
translation.kha: Kata ka dei tang ka jinglamler .—Jenesis 3 :1-5 .
Ka la pynheh pynsan ïa uwei u khun sing sad iaki ïa u kumno ban behmrad ; u la long u nongbam briew .
translation.en: And she brought up one of her whelps : it became a young lion , and it learned to catch the prey  ; it devoured men .
Now king David was old and stricken in years  ; and they covered him with clothes , but he gat no heat .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid mynta u la tymmen bha , bad wat la ki shakri jong u ki tap ïa u da ki nep-syiad , um shym syaid satia .
badno Kanah to duwai , ba ka jingieit jong ph kan nang ïoh rong kyrhai shuh shuh , ryngkat bad ka jingtip bashisha bad ka jingbit bajanai .
translation.en: And this I pray , that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment ;

translation.kha: Bad ngi dkoh ïa ka jingbymman la kum ba ka dei ka um ; ho-oid , ngi long kiba bamsap ; ngim dondor ei ei .
translation.en: How much more abominable and filthy is man , which drinketh iniquity like water ?
If when he seeth the sword come upon the land , he blow the trumpet , and warn the people  ;
translation.kha: Haba u ïohi ïa u nongshun ba u wan poi , u put ïa ka turoi ban maham ïa uwei pa uwei .
Haba phi pyllait ïa ki , wat phah noh thylli ïa ki .
translation.en: And when thou sendest him out free from thee , thou shalt not let him go away empty :

translation.kha: naphang kba hiarpateng na u Issakhar , ïa u Khenanaïah bad ki khun shynrang jong u la buh ban peit ïa ki kam synshar khadar : Kaba buh jingthoh bad kaba bishar ïa ki paid Israel .
translation.en: Of the Izharites , Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel , for officers and judges .
So his father went down unto the woman : and Samson made there a feast  ; for so used the young men to do .
translation.kha: U kpa jong u , u leit sha ïing kata ka kynthei , bad u Samson u pynlong ka jingkhawai hangta . Kane ka long kaba ki ju leh hapdeng ki para samla shynrang .
Ki briew kiba beit kin lehbha ïa phi ; ki bymman ki Kwah tang ban shukor ïa phi .
translation.en: The thoughts of the righteous are right : but the counsels of the wicked are deceit .
Behold , the former things are come to pass , and new things do I declare : before they spring forth I tell you of them .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei kiba nga ïathuhlypa mynta ki la jia shisha . Mynta ngan ïathuh ïa phi ïa kiei kiei kiba thymmai wat ha shuwa ba kin sdang ban jia .
Phi la ïohsngew kumno ba na la ju im mynba nga dang don ha ka niam Jiw , kumta la la pynshitom beiñ khlem jingisynei ïa ka balang U Blei bad na la leh ïa kaba bakha kad ban pynduh noh ïa ka .
translation.en: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews  religion , how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God , and wasted it :

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki ai jingkñia ha U Trai na ka jinglwet kaba ki la wanrah biang : hynñiewspah tukri ki khlieh jongno ki masi bad hynñiew hajar tylli ki langbrot .
translation.en: And they offered unto the  Lord  the same time , of the spoil which they had brought , seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep .
Then I looked , and , behold , in the firmament that was above the head of the cherubims there appeared over them as it were a sapphire stone , as the appearance of the likeness of a throne .
translation.kha: Nga la khmied sha tnum halor ki khlieh ki kherub bad halor jong ki ka don kaei kaei kaba i kum ka khet ba la shna na u mawkordor sapphir .

translation.en: At his day thou shalt give him his hire , neither shall the sun go down upon it  ; for he is poor , and setteth his heart upon it : lest he cry against thee unto the  Lord  , and it be sin unto thee .
translation.kha: Man la ka sngi shuwa ban sep sngi , siew dep ïa ka bainong jong u ha kata ka sngi , namar u dei uba duk bad u ap dngong ban ïoh ïa ka . Lada phim ai ïa ka , un kyang ha U  Trai  pyrshah ïa phi , bad kata kan long ka pop ïa phi .

Kin tur ïaleh ïa pha naphang shatei , da kaba wanrah ïa ka kynhun shipai babun lem bad ki kali ïapom bad ki , ki kali ba-dap kyrhai ka jingbat . Da kaba ksiang da ki stieh bad ki jingïada khlieh , kin ker sawdong ïa pha . Ngan aiti ïa pha ha ki , bad kin bishar ïa phalang da la ki jong ki aiñ .
translation.en: And they shall come against thee with chariots , wagons , and wheels , and with an assembly of people , which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about : and I will set judgment before them , and they shall judge thee according to their judgments .

translation.kha: Nangta u Boas u jong ha ka Kuth , Shah ngan ai jingmut katto katne ïa phi . “Wat otsher tam kew shawei pait lait tang ha ken ka lyngkha . Trei para kynthei hangne ;
translation.en: Then said Boaz unto Ruth , Hearest thou not , my daughter ? Go not to glean in another field , neither go from hence , but abide here fast by my maidens :
Of judgment , because the prince of this world is judged .
translation.kha: bad ki bakla shaphang ka jingbishar , namar ba ïa u nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthei la lah bishar .

translation.en: But I have greater witness than that of John : for the works which the Father hath given me to finish , the same works that I do , bear witness of me , that the Father hath sent me .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga don ka jingphla na ka bynta jong nga kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka jingphla kaba u Ïoannis u la ai : Kaei kaba nga leh , kata ka long , ki kam kiba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ïa nga ban leh , kine ki kren na ka bynta jong nga bad ki pyn-i ba U Kpa u la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: And the hand of the  Lord  was on Elijah  ; and he girded up his loins , and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Ka bor jong U  Trai  ka la wan ha u Elijah ; u la pynskhem ïa la ki jaiñ sawdong ka syngkai jong u bad u mareh ha shuwa u Ahab haduh ban da poi ha Jesreel .

Buh ïa ki panpoh ha ki syngkai jong ki , bad teh ïa ki tupia ha ki khlieh jong ki . Ha kane ka rukom men pynshngain ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u . Ma ki bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin shakri ïa nga junom kum ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: And thou shalt gird them with girdles , Aaron and his sons , and put the bonnets on them : and the priest s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute : and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons .
And Jacob went out from Beer–sheba , and went toward Haran .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la mihnoh na Beersheba bad u leit shaphang Haran .

translation.en: Who cut up mallows by the bushes , and juniper roots for their meat .
translation.kha: Ki la phut ïa ki jingthung jong ka ri shyiap bad bam ïa ki , wat ïa ki thied bym don jingmad jong u diengsynshar !
mynta ko Amasaïah , me kiba ba me la jop ïa ki Edom , hynmen nga ai jingmut ïa me ba men shong ha ïing . Balei me pynkheiñ jingkulmar ka Ban shu wanrah tang ka jingjot ha me bad ki briew jong me ?
translation.en: Thou sayest , Lo , thou hast smitten the Edomites  ; and thine heart lifteth thee up to boast : abide now at home  ; why shouldest thou meddle to thine hurt , that thou shouldest fall , even thou , and Judah with thee ?

translation.kha: Naba ka nongtih aïu ka don lada phi ïaishah ïa ki jingkhah sympat ba phi den hok haba phi la leh ïa kaba bakla ? Hynrei ïada phi ïaishah ïa ka jingshahshitom wat haba phi la leh ïa kaba dem , U Blei un kyrkhu ïa phiah na ka boitha kata .
translation.en: For what glory is it , if , when ye be buffeted for your faults , ye shall take it patiently ? but if , when ye do well , and suffer for it , ye take it patiently , this is acceptable with God .

translation.kha: Nangta u angel suba ar u la theh noh ïa ka pliang Jong u ha ka duriaw . Ka um ka la kylla long kum ka snam jong u briew uba ïap , bad uwei pa uwei u jingthaw ba-im hapoh duriaw u la ïan .
translation.en: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea  ; and it became as the blood of a dead man : and every living soul died in the sea .

translation.kha: Ki wanrah ïa ki shabar ka ïongreiñ , ki leit lam ïa ki sha u Joshua bad sha kita ki Israel baroh , bad ki buh ïa ki ha khmat U Trai .
translation.en: And they took them out of the midst of the tent , and brought them unto Joshua , and unto all the children of Israel , and laid them out before the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la kynmaw ïa ka jingkular bakyntang jong u ïa u Abraham u sharati jong u .
translation.en: For he remembered his holy promise , and Abraham his servant .

translation.kha: Ka Miriam ka la ïarwai na ka bynta jong ki : To rwai ha U Trai namar ba u la jop ka jingjop badonburom ; u la bret ïa ki kulai bad ïa ki nongshong jong ki sha ka duriaw .
translation.en: And Miriam answered them , Sing ye to the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously  ; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .

translation.kha: hynrei u angel u la ong ha ki , To wat sheptieng ! Nga kein hangne lem bad ka khubor babha na ka bynta jong phiah , ka ban wanrah ka jingkmen kaba khraw ha ki briew baroh .
translation.en: And the angel said unto them , Fear not : for , behold , I bring you good tidings of great joy , which shall be to all people .

translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa ngi , hato ka long pyrshah ïa ka Aiñ jong Ngi ba ngi dei ban siew khajna shat u Patsha ka Hima Rom , ne kumno ?
translation.en: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar , or no ?
Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Tyre , and will cause many nations to come up against thee , as the sea causeth his waves to come up .
translation.kha: Mynta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong : Nga long u nongshun jong pha , ko nongbah Tyros . Ngan wallam ïa kiba bun ki jaitbynriew ban tur ïaleh ïa pha , bad kin wan kum ki jingat phyllung jong ka duriaw .
ka Kedesh , ka Hasor , ka Ithnan ,

translation.en: But his delight is in the law of the  Lord   ; and in his law doth he meditate day and night .

translation.kha: Nangta u la Phah khot ïa u Joab , ban kyrpad ïa u Ban leit Sha u skhem na ka bynta jong u ; hynrei u Joab um wan . Sa shisien u Absalom u la Phah khot ïa u ; bad u Joab u kyntait biang ban wan .
translation.en: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab , to have sent him to the king  ; but he would not come to him : and when he sent again the second time , he would not come .

translation.kha: Te mynta ki paidbhur Ishmael ki leit sha Bethel bad ki shong Haneng ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei haduh janmiet . Ha ka sur kaba jam bad ha ka jingkthang ki ïam sngewsih :
translation.en: And the people came to the house of God , and abode there till even before God , and lifted up their voices , and wept sore  ;

translation.kha: Ym kumta da shisha ! Pynban , phi jong ha u , ‘ To pynkheiñ ïa ka jingbam miet jong nga , nangta to phong ïa ka jaiñ-da jongngi me bad shakri ïa nga katba nga daiñ bam-im bad dih ; hadien kata me lah ban bam ïa ka jingbam lad me .’
translation.en: And will not rather say unto him , Make ready wherewith I may sup , and gird thyself , and serve me , till I have eaten and drunken  ; and afterward thou shalt eat and drink ?

And the border went out unto the side of Ekron northward : and the border was drawn to Shicron , and passed along to mount Baalah , and went out unto Jabneel  ; and the goings out of the border were at the sea .
translation.kha: Nangta u pud u suh sha u lum shaphang shatei jong ka Ekron , u phai sha ka Shikkeron , lyngba u Lum Baalah , bad ter ter sha Jamnia . U kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian ,

U Trai u nong , Kaei ka jingkynnoh ba ki kpa tymmen jong ph ki la ïarah pyrsad ïa nga ? Kaei kaba pynpang ïa ki ban phai nala na nga ? Ki la ïamane ïa ki bleithaw bymdondor ei ei bad ki hi ki la kylla long ki bymdondor .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , What iniquity have your fathers found in me , that they are gone far from me , and have walked after vanity , and are become vain ?

translation.kha: Hynriew phi la pynlong ïa ki Nasir ban dih wat , bad phi la hukum ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban ym kren ïa ka khubor jong nga .
translation.en: But ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink  ; and commanded the prophets , saying , Prophesy not .

translation.kha: To leh adkar , to sharai ! U nongshniah jongngi phi , u Ksuid , u shang kylleng kumno u sing bakyrhuh , da katba wad ïa uno uno ba un nongdih thyllah .
translation.en: Be sober , be vigilant  ; because your adversary the devil , as a roaring lion , walketh about , seeking whom he may devour :

translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la lwet , bad nga la khynñiuh . Namar Jong U Trai , namar ki ktien kiba khuid jong u , ba nga la long kum u briew uba buid u Briew uba la dih bun eh ka waiñ .
translation.en: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets  ; all my bones shake  ; I am like a drunken man , and like a man whom wine hath overcome , because of the  Lord  , and because of the words of his holiness .
I have chosen the way of truth : thy judgments have I laid before me .
translation.kha: Nga la jied ban kohnguh ; nga la pynshahshkor ïa ki jingbishar jong me .
U dei U Blei hi uba pynlong ïa ngi , ryngkat bad phi , ka jingpynthikna ïa ka jingim jong ngi ha U Kherith ; u dei U Blei hi da biar uba la pynkyrpang ïa ngi ,
translation.en: Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ , and hath anointed us , is God ;

translation.kha: U Absalom u ïajubab , Namar ba khung wan haba ang la Phah khot ïa ph . ?(Nga la kwah ïa phi ban leit shaei u syiem malade ban kylli na ka bynta jong to : ‘ Balei nga dei baneh iehnoh ïa ka Geshur bad wan hangne ? Kan jin da la khamtam bha ïa nga ban sah hangta .’ U Absalom u bteng , nga kwah ïa phi ban pynbeit ïa nga ban ïohi ïa u syiem , bad lada nga la kit pop , te shah ïa u ban pynïap ïa at .
translation.en: And Absalom answered Joab , Behold , I sent unto thee , saying , Come hither , that I may send thee to the king , to say , Wherefore am I come from Geshur ? it had been good for me to have been there still : now therefore let me see the king s face  ; and if there be any iniquity in me , let him kill me .

translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei ka hap ha ithuh u briew uba pynïap briew ha kaba rieh .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lai , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly . And all the people shall say , Amen .
Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem Ammon um patiaw ei ei ruh em ïa kane ka khubor na u Jephthah .
Kut u Moses u la mihnoh bad ïathuh ha uta u paidbah ïa kaba U Trai u la ong . U la lumlang hynriewspah ngut ki nongïalam badno u la buh ïa ki sawdong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And Moses went out , and told the people the words of the  Lord  , and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people , and set them round about the tabernacle .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïong ha u Joshua , wat sheptieng ïa ki . Ha kane ka par lashai ka sner ngan pynïap ïa ki barhem na ka bynta ki Israel . Phi dei ban pynkhlad ïa ki kloi jong ki bad thang ïa ki kali ïapom jong ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Be not afraid because of them : for to morrow about this time will I deliver them up all slain before Israel : thou shalt hough their horses , and burn their chariots with fire .
These going before tarried for us at Troas .
translation.kha: Ki la leit sha khmat bad ki la ap ïa ngi ha Troas .
Kumta hi kaei re kaei kaba kumin ki snep dohkha ki la hap na ki kham jong u Saul , bad u la lah ban ïohi pat . U la ïeng joit bad la pynbaptis ïa u ;
translation.en: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales : and he received sight forthwith , and arose , and was baptized .

translation.kha: Nangta u la ïaid na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat , u da leit shaphang ka pyntwa bashathie jong ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And Abram journeyed , going on still toward the south .
And their border was Helkath , and Hali , and Beten , and Achshaph ,
translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ka , ka kynthup ïa ka Helkath , ka Hali , ka Beten , ka Akhshaph ,
Wat ïashongkha khleh bad ki , bad shang ïa ki khun ki kti lad phi ban ïashong khlei bad ki ,
translation.en: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them  ; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son , nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son .

translation.kha: Nga kparad ïa me da la ka dohnud baïar ; ban isynei ïa nga , wohnia me la kutlad !
translation.en: I entreated thy favour with my whole heart : be merciful unto me according to thy word .

Thou art thy mother s daughter , that lotheth her husband and her children  ; and thou art the sister of thy sisters , which lothed their husbands and their children : your mother was an Hittite , and your father an Amorite .
translation.kha: Pha long shisha ka khun jong ka kmie jong pha . Ka la isih jur ïa u tnga jong ka bad ïa ki khun jong ka . Pha long kum ki hynmen ki para kynthei jong pha , kiba la isih ïa la ki tnga bad ïa la ki khun . Ma pha bad ki nongbah kiba shi para bad pha , phi la don ka kmie ka nong Hit bad u kpa u nong Amor .

translation.en: And when he had sent the multitudes away , he went up into a mountain apart to pray : and when the evening was come , he was there alone .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingphah noh ïa u paidbah , u la leit kiew ïa u lumrit marwei hi ban duwai .

translation.en: And Delilah said unto Samson , Behold , thou hast mocked me , and told me lies : now tell me , I pray thee , wherewith thou mightest be bound .
translation.kha: Ka Delilah ka ong ha u Samson ,  Peit , phi la pynlong ka bieit ïa nga bad phim ïathuh ha nga ïa kaba shisha . Sngewbha ïathuh ïa nga kumno yn lah ban khum ïa phi .
Ha kawei ka sngi , katba u Jeroboam u dang mih na Jerusalem , u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa uba na Shiloh , u ïakohnguh ïa u marwei ha lyndet kaba ha rudnong .
translation.en: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem , that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way  ; and he had clad himself with a new garment  ; and they two were alone in the field :
For he that soweth to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption ; but he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting .
translation.kha: Lada u bet ha ka lyngkha jong ki jingkwah brai ka doh jong u , na ka un lum ïa ka jingot ka jingïap ; lada u bet ha ka lyngkha U Mynsiem , na U Mynsiem un lum ïa ka jingot jong ka jingim bymjukut .

translation.en: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab , to have sent him to the king  ; but he would not come to him : and when he sent again the second time , he would not come .
translation.kha: Nangta u la phah khot ïa u Joab , ban kyrpad ïa u ban leit sha u syiem na ka bynta jong u ; hynrei u Joab um wan . Sa shisien u Absalom u la phah khot ïa u ; bad u Joab u kyntait biang ban wan .
Lada nga ïoh ïa kano kano ka jingjop , me beh khnang ïa nga kum u Song ; ban pynmynsaw ïa nga me ai wiat da ki kambah .
translation.en: For it increaseth . Thou huntest me as a fierce lion : and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me .

And said , If it please the king , and if I have found favour in his sight , and the thing seem right before the king , and I be pleasing in his eyes , let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite , which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king s provinces :
translation.kha: Lada ka pynsngewbha ïa phi , ko syiem , bad lada phi sngewsynei ïa nga bad ka long kaba dei ha phi , sngewbha pynmih ka jingpynbna ban khang ïa ki hukum u Haman na kaba pyntreikam ïa ki — kito ki hukum kiba u khun jong u Hammedatha uba hiarpateng na u Agag u la ai na ka bynta ka jingpynjot ïa ki Jiw baroh ha ka hima .
Lydda Phin ïaroi ïa ka jingsyiad , u kpa jngai phi un sngewsarong ïa pa . Ka long ka jingpynlehnoh-ei ba-bieit ban pynlut phlait ha ki nuti .
translation.en: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father : but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance .
And thou shalt put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings which are on the ends of the breastplate .
translation.kha: bad teh ïa kita ki kynjri ksiar ha kita ki kyrwoh .
u la die ïa ka lyngkha ba u long trai , u la wallam ïa ka pisa , bad u la ai ha ki apostol .
translation.en: Having land , sold it , and brought the money , and laid it at the apostles  feet .
And he discerned him not , because his hands were hairy , as his brother Esau s hands : so he blessed him .
translation.kha: Um shym la ithuh ïa u Jakob namar ba ki kti jong u ki long kiba mih shñiuh kum ki jong u Iso .
Naba u Aaron u dang krenbeiñ ha ka kynhun baroh khwai , ki phai shaphang ka ri shyiap , bad kynsan ka jingkhaïi baphyrnai jong U Trai ka la paw ha u lyoh .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Israel , that they looked toward the wilderness , and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  appeared in the cloud .

translation.kha: Kiba kham palat ïa kata ka long ba ïa ngi la pynpaw ba ngi shu lamler shngain U Blei , namar ba ngi la ong ba u la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist na ka jingïap — hynrei paila ka long kaba shisha ba ïa kiba ïap ym shym la pynmihpat , te um skhem la pynmihpat ïa U Khrist .
translation.en: Yea , and we are found false witnesses of God ; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ : whom he raised not up , if so be that the dead rise not .
Thus saith the king , Let not Hezekiah deceive you : for he shall not be able to deliver you .
translation.kha: U maham ïa phi ban ym shah ba u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi . U Hesekaïah um lah ban pyllait ïa phi .

translation.en: A time to be born , and a time to die  ; a time to plant , and a time to pluck up that which is planted  ;
translation.kha: U buh ka por ban kha bad ka por ban ïap , ka por ban thung bad ka por ban rat noh ,

translation.en: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech s head , and all to brake his skull .
translation.kha: Hynrei kawei ka kynthei ka pynhap najrong da u mawtylliat halor ka khlieh jong u , bad ka shynrong khlieh jong u ka la pait .

translation.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days .
translation.kha: U Asa u syiem ka Judah bad u Baasha u syiem ka Israel ki don ha ka jingïaleh thma borabor katba ki dang don ha ka bor .
To leh ïa ki kambah na ka bynta jong nga , A Trai , kumba me la leh ha ki sngi mynba me la ïalamwir ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous things .

translation.kha: U pyllew u la jubab , Nga long u Jiw , ïa Uba la kha ha Tarsos ha Kilikia , u traishnong ka nongbah ba-donnam . jingsngewbha shah ïa nga ban kren ha u paidbah .
translation.en: But Paul said , I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus , a city in Cilicia , a citizen of no mean city : and , I beseech thee , suffer me to speak unto the people .
Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden  ; and in the garden a new sepulchre , wherein was never man yet laid .
translation.kha: Ka la don ka kper ha kata ka jaka ha kaba la pynïap ïa U Jisu , bad ha kata ka kper la don ka jingtep kaba thymmai ha kaba ym pat shym la tep ïano ïano .

translation.en: And her mother in law said unto her , Where hast thou gleaned to day ? and where wroughtest thou ? blessed be he that did take knowledge of thee . And she shewed her mother in law with whom she had wrought , and said , The man s name with whom I wrought to day is Boaz .
translation.kha: Ka Naomi ka kylli ïa ka ,  Hangno phi ïohlum ïa kine baroh ? Ha ka lyngkha jongno phi ïoh trei ? To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa u briew uba shem jingsngewbha ha phi !  Kumta ka Ruth ka ïathuh ha ka Naomi ba ka la trei ha ka lyngkha kaba dei jong u briew uba kyrteng u Boas .
Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , slem shuwa ban shai , U Jisu! u la ïeng bad mihnoh na ka ïing . U la Mynno na ka shnong sha ka jaka bakynjah , hangta u la duwai .
translation.en: And in the morning , rising up a great while before day , he went out , and departed into a solitary place , and there prayed .

translation.kha: Ka jingsbun jingthoh ïa ki khun ki ksiew da ki longïng ki long arphew hajar arspah ngut ki rangbah kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam Shiphew .
translation.en: And the number of them , after their genealogy by their generations , heads of the house of their fathers , mighty men of valour , was twenty thousand and two hundred .

The great temptations which thine eyes saw , and the signs , and the wonders , and the mighty hand , and the stretched out arm , whereby the  Lord  thy God brought thee out : so shall the  Lord  thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ruh ïa ki jingtynjuh kiba shyrkhei kiba phi la ïohi , da ki kambah bad ki kamphylla , bad da ka borbah da ka ksang ti kaba la kner da kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la pyllait ïa phi , kumta ruh un pynjot ïa kita ki jaitbynriew baroh ïa kiba phi sheptieng .
hynrei ka sngi lai Nakon haba ïa u nongleitkurim yn shim noh na ki , te kin sa shahjingit .
translation.en: But the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them , and then shall they fast in those days .

translation.kha: Bad ma phi , ruh , phin kren shaphang jong nga , namar ba pa’ la don lem bad nga naduh kaba sdang .
translation.en: And ye also shall bear witness , because ye have been with me from the beginning .

translation.kha: Ka jingshahjop jong ka Moab ka la jaiñ ; ka jingjot jong ka , ka la jan .
translation.en: The calamity of Moab is near to come , and his affliction hasteth fast .

translation.kha: U blang u ïailong ka jingïadie jong phi ; Ki ksan ti uba na bymjukut ki kyrshan ïa phi . U beh ïa ki nongshun jong phi katba phi kad ïaid sha khmat , Bad u ong ïa phira ban pynjop thiaw ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: The eternal God is thy refuge , and underneath are the everlasting arms : and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee  ; and shall say , Destroy them .
The word “devil” means someone who tells wicked lies about another person .
translation.kha: Ka Ktien “ksuid” kamut uno uno uba kren lamler shaphang kiwei pat .
wahbah U la ïohi haduh katno ba ki ei ka jingngeit , U Jisu u ong ha uta wahbah pang pynshaïong , Ko khun jong nga , ïa ki pop jong me la ïohmap .
translation.en: When Jesus saw their faith , he said unto the sick of the palsy ,  Son , thy sins be forgiven thee .
Even the sea monsters draw out the breast , they give suck to their young ones : the daughter of my people is become cruel , like the ostriches in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Wat ka kmie suri kan sumar ïa la ki khun , hynrei ki briew jong nga ki long kum ki ostrit , kiba lehbeiñ ïa ki khun rit jong ki .

Hynrei u Dabid u ong ïa u Abishai bad ïa u Joab , u prie jong u , mynno ba pan ïa ka jingmut na phi ? Hato phi thmu ban pynwit ïa nga ? Mynta , nga dih ma nga u Syiem jong ka Israel bad ha kane ka sngi yn ym pynïap ïa uno Uno ruh u Israel .
translation.en: And David said , What have I to do with you , ye sons of Zeruiah , that ye should this day be adversaries unto me ? shall there any man be put to death this day in Israel ? for do not I know that I am this day king over Israel ?
And the devil , taking him up into an high mountain , shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time .
translation.kha: Nangta , u Soitan u la ïalam ïa u shajrong bad u la pyn-i ha u ha ka shikhyllipmat ïa baroh ki hima jong ka pyrthei .
hynrei lada u tnga Jong ka , u khang ïa ka ban pyndep ïa ka kular haba u ïohsngew ïa kata , kam donkam ban bat ïa kata . U Trai un map ïa ka .
translation.en: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it  ; then he shall make her vow which she vowed , and that which she uttered with her lips , wherewith she bound her soul , of none effect : and the  Lord  shall forgive her .

translation.kha: Pynbna paidbah ïa kine ki Jingkhawai Niam ha ki nga ba la buh ban pynlong ïa ki .
translation.en: These are the feasts of the  Lord  , even holy convocations , which ye shall proclaim in their seasons .
Unto which promise our twelve tribes , instantly serving God day and night , hope to come . For which hope s sake , king Agrippa , I am accused of the Jews .
translation.kha: ïa kata hi kaba ki khat-ar jait jong ki briew jong ngi ki kyrmen ban ïohpdiang , haba ki mane ïa U Blei mynsngi bad mynmiet . Bad ka dei namar jong kane ka jingkyrmen , ko Syiem Kynrad , ba nga la shah mudui da ki Jiw !

translation.en: But and if we say , Of men  ; all the people will stone us : for they be persuaded that John was a prophet .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngi ong ‘ Na u briew ,’ kine ki paidbah hangne kin lynthem maw ïa ngi , namar ki la sngewskhem ba u Ïoannis u la long u nongïathuhlypa .
Nangta u la shym ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu bad ki dohkha , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , u la kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha ki synreit ; bad ki synran ki la ai ïa ki ha u paidlang .
translation.en: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes , and gave thanks , and brake them , and gave to his disciples , and the disciples to the multitude .

translation.kha: Hynriew , kine ki brisoh , ki tur ïaleh da kaba krenbeiñ da kiei kiei kiba kim sngewthuh ; bad kito kiei kiei kiba ki tip da ka kuna tip kumno ki mradkhlaw , ki long kita hi kiei kiei kiba pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: But these speak evil of those things which they know not : but what they know naturally , as brute beasts , in those things they corrupt themselves .

translation.kha: U Trai u kylli , ‘ Uei u shun shukor ïa u Ahab khnang ba un leit bad shah pynïap ha Ramoth ?’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Who shall persuade Ahab , that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead ? And one said on this manner , and another said on that manner .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , I have seen this people , and , behold , it is a stiffnecked people :
translation.kha: Nga tip haduh katno kine ki briew ki long kiba mutlop .

Kum ki khat-ar ngut ki apostol ki la khot lang ïa ka kynhun riewkynthei baroh kawei sad ki la ong , Kam long kaba dei ïa ngi ban kun klet ïa ka jingïalap ïa ka ktien U Blei khnang ban pynïaid ïa ka kam pisa Tyngka .
translation.en: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them , and said , It is not reason that we should leave the word of God , and serve tables .
But whoso keepeth his word , in him verily is the love of God perfected : hereby know we that we are in him .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong u , u long uta uba ïa ka jingieit ïa U Blei la pynjanai da shisha . Dei da kane ba kumno ngi lah ban sngewskhem ba ngi long ha U Blei :

translation.en: Save us , O  Lord  our God , and gather us from among the heathen , to give thanks unto thy holy name , and to triumph in thy praise .
translation.kha: To pynim ïa ngi , A  Trai  , U Blei jong ngi , bad wallam pat ïa ngi napdeng ki jaitbynriew , ba ngi lah ban sngewnguh bad ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me .

translation.en: Be ye also patient  ; stablish your hearts : for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh .
translation.kha: Phi ruh phi dei ban long kiba ïaishah . To batskhem ïa ki jingkyrmen jong phi , naba ka sngi ka jingwan U Trai ka la jan .
Me la pynong ïa U Trai u nongkyrshan jong me , ïa U Pekahaïah Tam u nongïada jong me ,
translation.en: Because thou hast made the  Lord  , which is my refuge , even the most High , thy habitation  ;

translation.kha: U Moses u la dep ai ïa ka ri ha ka phang mih jong ka Jordan ha kiew patiaw ki ar jait bad shiteng jong kawei jaitniam . ( Ïa kiba hiarpateng na u Joseph la bynta ha ki ar jait : Manasseh pynlang Ephraim . ) Wat la katta , u Moses um shym la ai Kanah kano ka bynta jong ka jaka ïa ki Lebi . Tangba , ki la ïoh ïa ki nongbah ban shong ïa-ban sahit , lem sad ki pyntha na ka bynta ki jingri jong ki .
translation.en: For the children of Joseph were two tribes , Manasseh and Ephraim : therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land , save cities to dwell in , with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance .

translation.kha: U —Isaïah u sien noh na u syiem , hynrei ha shuwa ba un ïaid lyngba ïa ka phyllaw pdeng ka ïingbishar jong ka jingmih , U Trai u ong ïa u
translation.en: And it came to pass , afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court , that the word of the  Lord  came to him , saying ,

translation.kha: Kyndit kyndit U Tharai u phiah ïa ka lyer kaba wan kit ïa ki iar khiar na duriaw , kiba her kumba Sei mitar na salia Khynñiuh . Kine ki dem ha ka jaka sher dara bad baroh sawdong jong ka da bun bun kilomitar kat shaba phai .
translation.en: And there went forth a wind from the  Lord  , and brought quails from the sea , and let them fall by the camp , as it were a day s journey on this side , and as it were a day s journey on the other side , round about the camp , and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth .
Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee , and accomplish mine anger upon thee : and I will judge thee according to thy ways , and will recompense thee for all thine abominations .
translation.kha: Mynta kumne kumne phan sa sngew ïa ka bor jingbitar jong nga baroh . Ngan bishar ïa pha kat kum kiei kiei kiba pha la leh , bad pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kam ba-ijli jong pha baroh .

nongkit , hangta ha khmat ka jingdonkam ryngkat U Trai phin ong ïa kine ki ktien : ‘ U kpa tymmen jngai nga u dei u nong Aram uba ïaidwir , uba la leit ïalam ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem sha Ijipt ban shong ban sawa . Ki ïadon tang khyndiat eh mynba ki ïadon hangta , hynrei ki la man long ka jaitbynriew kaba bun paid bad kaba khrawbor .
translation.en: And thou shalt speak and say before the  Lord  thy God , A Syrian ready to perish was my father , and he went down into Egypt , and sojourned there with a few , and became there a nation , great , mighty , and populous :

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la bitar ïa per ñiar jongu pa bad um shahshkor shuh ïa nga . U ong pynban , ‘ Ka la biang Iso ! Wat kren ei ei shuh shaphang kata !
translation.en: But the  Lord  was wroth with me for your sakes , and would not hear me : and the  Lord  said unto me , Let it suffice thee  ; speak no more unto me of this matter .

Then Israel sent messengers unto the king of Edom , saying , Let me , I pray thee , pass through thy land : but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto . And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab : but he would not consent : and Israel abode in Kadesh .
translation.kha: Nangta ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u syiem Edom ban pan jingbit ban ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u . Hynrei u syiem Edom um shym shah ïa ki . Ki kyrpad ruh ïa u syiem Moab , u ruh um shym shah ba kin ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u . Kumta ki Israel ki hap ban sah ha Kadesh .
Ha khmat jong U Bela bad jong U Khrist Jisu malu jong ki ebanjelist to kohnguh ïa kyang ki jingkhaïi khlem jingujor lane khlem shah shikhung ïano ïano ha kano Kane naba me leh .
translation.en: I charge thee before God , and the Lord Jesus Christ , and the elect angels , that thou observe these things without preferring one before another , doing nothing by partiality .

translation.kha: Nalor ki khlem la niewkor ia ki jinglehsbun jong U Blei , u Amen bad ka Im ki la saitlah .
translation.en: Lacking appreciation for God’s kindness , Adam and Eve did disobey and were made to pay the prescribed penalty .

translation.kha: hynrei uno uno u khra-maw ba phi la thied u lah ba bam ïa ka lada phi otsher shaw ïa u .
translation.en: But every man s servant that is bought for money , when thou hast circumcised him , then shall he eat thereof .

translation.kha: Ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ka la jan .
translation.en: And the passover , a feast of the Jews , was nigh .

And it came to pass , after they were departed , that they came up out of the well , and went and told king David , and said unto David , Arise , and pass quickly over the water : for thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you .
translation.kha: Haba ki la leit noh , u Ahimaas bad u Jonathan ki wan mih na kata ka pukri bad ki la leit ïathuh ha u Syiem Dabid . Ki la ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba u Ahithophel u la pynkhreh pyrshah ïa u bad ong ,  To pynkloi bad jam ïa ka wah .

translation.en: O righteous Father , the world hath not known thee : but I have known thee , and these have known that thou hast sent me .
translation.kha: Ko Pa Bahok ! Ka pyrthei kam ithuh ïa me , hynrei nga ithuh ïa me , bad kine ki tip ba me la phah ïa nga .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  I am the way , the truth , and the life : no man cometh unto the Father , but by me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Nga long ka lynti , ka jingshisha , bad ka jingim , ym don uno uno u ba leit sha U Kpa lait na nga .

translation.en: And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him : and Esau said in his heart , The days of mourning for my father are at hand  ; then will I slay my brother Jacob .
translation.kha: U Iso u la isih ïa u Jakob , namar ba u kpa jong u , u la ai ha u Jakob ïa ka jingkyrkhu . U la pyrkhat ,  Ka por ban ïambriew na ka bynta i pa jong nga ka la jan ; te kumta ngan sa pynïap ïa u Jakob .

Hynrei lada du isangsot u nongïathuhlypa u nguid ban kren ha ka kyrteng jong at ïa ka khubor kaba ngam shym la hukum ïa u , u dei ban ïap namar kata ; bad eit uno u nongïathuhlypa uba kren ha ka kyrteng jong kiwei pat ki blei u hati u dei ngab ïap .’
translation.en: But the prophet , which shall presume to speak a word in my name , which I have not commanded him to speak , or that shall speak in the name of other gods , even that prophet shall die .

translation.kha: Ïaleh ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi ! U la pynpaw kaba kattne u sngewbha ïa phi da kaba pynphong ïa phi u syiem u ban synshar ha ka kyrteng jongngi u . Namar ba u ieit ïa ki bri jongnga u , ki Israel , bad u kwah banbeiñ pynneh ïa ki junom , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jyllang ki khnang don pynneh ïa ka hukum bad ka jingsuh thok .
translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne , to be king for the  Lord  thy God : because thy God loved Israel , to establish them for ever , therefore made he thee king over them , to do judgment and justice .

translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt .

translation.en: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty , not walking in craftiness , nor handling the word of God deceitfully ; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man s conscience in the sight of God .

translation.en: And immediately he rose up before them , and took up that whereon he lay , and departed to his own house , glorifying God .

translation.en: And he began to teach them , that the Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders , and of the chief priests , and scribes , and be killed , and after three days rise again .

ha ka rta Kaba arphew san snem , bad u synshar synreit khyndai snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Abijah , ka khun jong u Sekharaïah .

translation.en: Seek good , and not evil , that ye may live : and so the  Lord  , the God of hosts , shall be with you , as ye have spoken .
