But there was a strong tower within the city , and thither fled all the men and women , and all they of the city , and shut it to them , and gat them up to the top of the tower .
translation.kha: La don uwei u mot baskhem hangta , bad uwei pa uwei u shynrang bad ka kynthei ha ka nongbah , kynthup ïa ki nongïalam , ki mareh sha u . Ki khang ïa lade shapoh bad ki kiew shalor ka tnum .
Mynta wallam ha to ïa u nongtem . Katba u nongtem u dang tem ïa la ka dala , ka ber jong U Trai ka la wan hiar u Elisha ,
translation.en: But now bring me a minstrel . And it came to pass , when the minstrel played , that the hand of the  Lord  came upon him .
And when he was come near , he beheld the city , and wept over it ,
translation.kha: U la poi kham jan sha ka nongbah , bad haba u la ïohi ïa ka , u la ïam na ka bynta jong ka , u da ong ,

thaba Kata ka por ka poi , ki briew kin pyndonkam ïa ka jingïathuhkhana jong phi kum ka nylla ïa ka jingpynjot , bad ktien rwai ïa Kanneh ka jingrwai sngewsih ïa ka jingrem jong phi : La pynjot thiaw ïa ngi ! U Trai u la shim noh ïa ka ri jong ngi bad u la ai ïa ka sha wer kiba la ring koidi ïa ngi .
translation.en: In that day shall one take up a parable against you , and lament with a doleful lamentation , and say , We be utterly spoiled : he hath changed the portion of my people : how hath he removed it from me ! turning away he hath divided our fields .

translation.kha: Kata ka ri kan long kum ka kyntiew ñiut ha kaba ki ïalaw ki im . Kan long kaba shyrkhei ban klet ; yn ym don mano mano ba sah hangta , bad baroh katba ïohi ïa ka kin sngewshyrkhei .
translation.en: And Babylon shall become heaps , a dwellingplace for dragons , an astonishment , and an hissing , without an inhabitant .
But by the grace of God I am what I am : and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain ; but I laboured more abundantly than they all : yet not I , but the grace of God which was with me .
translation.kha: Hynrei da ka jingaiei U Blei nga long kumba nga long , bad ka jingaiei kaba u la ai ha nga kam shym long lehnoh-ei . Ha kawei ka liang , nga la kham trei shitom ban ïa uno uno uwei pat na ki apostol , wat la kam shym la long da ka jingleh jong nga hi , hynrei ka jingaiei U Blei kaba trei ha nga .
Phai lah ruh ban download ïa ki jingproh Baibl ba la pynwandur ha ki rukom drama , ki drama na Baibl bad ki jingrwai ba sngewtieng ban sngap ha ki por ba phi shongkai .
translation.en: You can download dramatic Bible readings , Bible dramas , and beautiful music to enjoy at your leisure .

translation.kha: Hammoth phin ong . . .
translation.en: Would you say . . .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Jerikho ki te ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Sakkur , u khun jong u Imri u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .
translation.en: And next unto him builded the men of Jericho . And next to them builded Zaccur the son of Imri .
And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me , but walk contrary unto me  ;
translation.kha: Lada hadien kat kane phim treh ban shahshkor ïa nga bad phi dang ïai pyrshah hi ïa nga ,
Shisien la don u briew uba kyrteng u Makhir , uba shong ha ri lum Ephraim .
translation.en: And there was a man of mount Ephraim , whose name was Micah .

translation.kha: Ono uno u lai long ha ka wad jong nga u pyrshah da shisha ïa por ; uno uno u bym ïarap ïa nga ban lum u pynsaphriang da shisha .
translation.en: He that is not with me is against me : and he that gathereth not with me scattereth .
Glory ye in his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the  Lord .
translation.kha: To kmen ba ngi long ki jong u ; ai ba baroh kiba mane ïa u kin lehkmen !
Bad nangta kin wan sha ka jingsngewthuh bad kin lieh na ka jingairam u Ksuid , uba la pynngat ïa ki bad la pynlong ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa ka mon jong u .
translation.en: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil , who are taken captive by him at his will .

translation.kha: Nangta u phah ïa ki ha ki lah kynhun , ryngkat bad u Joab Lem bad u Abishai , u para jong u Joab bad u ita babha na Gath , kiba long ki nongai hukum ha la ka kynhied kynjah . Bad u syiad u ong ha la ki rangbah , Nga ruh da lade len leit lang bad phi .
translation.en: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab , and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah , Joab s brother , and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite . And the king said unto the people , I will surely go forth with you myself also .

translation.kha: Ki ïap haba ki dang samla , ki ringswai da ka jingim bajahburom
translation.en: They die in youth , and their life is among the unclean .

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang u Elijah ki dei ki riewbymman . Kim ju shahshkor ïa U Trai
translation.en: Now the sons of Eli were sons of Belial  ; they knew not the  Lord .

translation.kha: bad nangta thoh ïa ka kyrteng u Aaron ha u diengduh na ka bynta ka jait Lebi . Dei ban don uwei u diengduh ïa u nongïalam jong kamai pa kaweh ka jait .
translation.en: And thou shalt write Aaron s name upon the rod of Levi : for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers .

translation.kha: Tur ïaleh ïa ki Midian bad pynjot thiaw ïa ki ,
translation.en: Vex the Midianites , and smite them :
And the  Lord  said unto him , What is that in thine hand ? And he said , A rod .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u kylli ïa u ,  Aïu me bat ha la ka kti ?   U diengduh ,  u jubab .

translation.en: The sinners in Zion are afraid  ; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites . Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire ? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings ?
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pop jong ka Seïon ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ki ong ,  Ka jingbishar U Blei ka long kum ka ding kaba meh junom . Hato uno uno na ngi un lait im na ka ding kaba kum kata ?

translation.en: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning , and thine health shall spring forth speedily : and thy righteousness shall go before thee  ; the glory of the  Lord  shall be thy rearward .
translation.kha: Te ka jinglehieit jong nga kan tyngshaiñ ha phi kum ka sngi mynstep , bad ki jingmong jong phi kin sa koit kloi . Ngan don ryngkat bad phi borabor ban pyllait ïa phi ; ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga kan ïada ïa phi ha ki liang baroh .

Ma u bad ki bariew jong u ki la sah Hynriew bnoh ha Edom , bad ha kata ka por ki pynnep ïa eiei pa uwei u shynrang ha Edom lait khong u Hadad bad katto katne ngut ki nongtih Edom kaba Long ki shakri u kpa jong u , kiba la kjit ïap sha Ijipt . ( Ha dat ka por u Harod u dang long tang u khynnah . )
translation.en: That Hadad fled , he and certain Edomites of his father s servants with him , to go into Egypt  ; Hadad being yet a little child .

translation.kha: Ka sur jrong nga ka long sngewsih bad marwei kum ka jingïam u pyrshang lane ka shatri .
translation.en: I am a brother to dragons , and a companion to owls .

translation.kha: U pynphong ïa ka hima jngai u kaba khlaiñbor , ba kumta baroh ki briew jong u ki ïaroh ïa u — ki paid Israel , kiba u ieit eh . To ïaroh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: He also exalteth the horn of his people , the praise of all his saints  ; even of the children of Israel , a people near unto him . Praise ye the  Lord .

translation.kha: namar U Khun U Briew u long U Trai jong ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day .

translation.kha: Mynta te , u Joshua u bthah , pyndonburom ïa U Trai , bad shakri ïa u da kaba sngur bun kaba shisha . iohnong syndon ïa ki blei ba ki kpa thnam jong pa’ ki la ju mane ha Bethmeon malade ha Ijipt , bad shakri tong ïa U Trai’ .
translation.en: Now therefore fear the  Lord  , and serve him in sincerity and in truth : and put away the gods which your fathers served on the other side of the flood , and in Egypt  ; and serve ye the  Lord .
Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet , which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day s journey .
translation.kha: Nangta ki apostol ki la leit phai pat sha Jerusalem na u lum ki Olib , uba jngai kumba shi kilomitar na ka nongbah .

translation.en: And they shall not lie with the mighty that are fallen of the uncircumcised , which are gone down to hell with their weapons of war : and they have laid their swords under their heads , but their iniquities shall be upon their bones , though they were the terror of the mighty in the land of the living .
translation.kha: Ym shym la ai ha ki ka jingtep donburom kum ïa ki riewshlur ha ki por mynbarim , kiba da kieng atiar bha haba ki leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ïa ki waitlam jong ki la buh hapoh ki khlieh jong ki bad ïa ki stieh jong ki halor ki met jong ki . Kine ki riewshlur ki la long shisien kiba khlaiñbor bha ban pynshyrkhei ïa kiba dang im .
Kin kitkhlieh ruh ïa ki riewsaid , ïa ki thliew tnaw , ïa ki snar , bad ïa ki tyllai jong ka phyllad .
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that entereth into the service , for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation :

translation.kha: Lyngba ka jingïarap jyllang i nonghikai Baibl jong phi , pynkhreh ïa ka jingbabe kaba phira lah ban ai ha ka jingïalang ka ban bud .
translation.en: With your Bible teacher’s help , prepare a comment that you might make at the next meeting .

translation.kha: Ki la pra ha ka ïing jongu u Jairos , ha kaba U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka jingkhynwin bad u la jingphohsniew ïa baroh ka jingïam dara ka jingïam ksiang .
translation.en: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue , and seeth the tumult , and them that wept and wailed greatly .

translation.kha: Lada ngi kohnguh hok ïa kaei khie baroh kiba U Blei u la hukum ïa ngi , u ruh un Sngewbha ïa ngi .’
translation.en: And it shall be our righteousness , if we observe to do all these commandments before the  Lord  our God , as he hath commanded us .

translation.kha: U Abram u la long Uba riewspah shibun , ha ka jingsdang ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang , kumjuh ruh ha ka jingdon ïa ka rupa bad ka kseh .
translation.en: And Abram was very rich in cattle , in silver , and in gold .
So I got a girdle according to the word of the  Lord  , and put it on my loins .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la thied ïa ki bad phong ïa ki .

translation.en: In the year of this jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka snem , ïa ka jingdon jingem baroh ba la dep die dei ban pynphai pat sha u trai jong ka .

translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and served Baalim :
translation.kha: Nangta ki paid Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad ki la sdang ban shakri ïa ki Baal .
Nga la Ïohi ïa ka kot kli ha ka kti kamon jong uta naba sheng halor ka khoit ; kaba la dap da ka jingthoh ha baroh arliang bad naba la pyndait da ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndait .
translation.en: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside , sealed with seven seals .
And he said , Cast it on the ground . And he cast it on the ground , and it became a serpent  ; and Moses fled from before it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Bret ïa u ha madan .  Haba u Moses u bret ïa u , uta u diengduh u kylla bseiñ , bad u Moses u phet na uta .

Khenani im shym la pyndonkam ïa kano kano na kine ki jingneit , lymne ngam shym la theh ïa Kanah mynta khnang ban dawa ïa kiba koum keiñ ki hok na ka bynta ïa lade . Kan kham bha ïa la ba ngan ïap shuwa ! Ym don mano mano banbeiñ pynleh ïa ka jingkob babud hok jong nga sha ki kyntien ba thylli !
translation.en: But I have used none of these things : neither have I written these things , that it should be so done unto me : for it were better for me to die , than that any man should make my glorying void .

translation.kha: U phah shna duh kawei ka khet kaba heh . Shion bynta na ka la klop da ka bniat hati , bad kaba sah pat la tap da ka ksiar nylla .
translation.en: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory , and overlaid it with the best gold .

translation.kha: Hynrei phim dei ban rah ïa kano kano kaba dei ïa ka ban pynjot ; lada phi leh kumta , phin wanrah ka jingjynjar bad ka jingpynjot ïa ka jaka shong dara ki Isaia .
translation.en: And ye , in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing , lest ye make yourselves accursed , when ye take of the accursed thing , and make the camp of Israel a curse , and trouble it .

translation.kha: Te nga la shim ïa kawei pat ka kot kli bad de la ai ïa ka ha u sekretari jong nga u Barukh , bad u la thoh hangta ïa kiei ktieh baroh kiba nga la ong . U la thoh ïa kai kiei baroh Kiba la don ha ka kot kli kaba nynkong bad kijuh ki khubor kiba to la ong ha u ban thoh .
translation.en: Then took Jeremiah another roll , and gave it to Baruch the scribe , the son of Neriah  ; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire : and there were added besides unto them many like words .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh kaba khia ïa uta u mrad un bam ïa u ha ka jaka bakhuid , ha ka phyllaw jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai .
translation.en: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it : in the holy place shall it be eaten , in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: nongbam leh ïa kaba bha kaba ar kwah ban leh ; pynban , nga leh ïa kaba sniew kaba ngam kwah ban leh .
translation.en: For the good that I would I do not : but the evil which I would not , that I do .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kiew Hamor ka lieng bad u la sien phai pat sha shiliang ka duriaw sha la ka jong shang ,
translation.en: And he entered into a ship , and passed over , and came into his own city .

translation.kha: barieh ki long kiba shetkylla badno ki bym lah shaniah . Ka jingsuh jong ki , ka ngin suki kum ka ding ha ka tyndur , ka bym shym la pynkhih da u nongshet kpu haduh ba u purew u lah long ban shet .
translation.en: They are all adulterers , as an oven heated by the baker , who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough , until it be leavened .

translation.kha: ieid u syiem Solomon u la dap tei ïa ka ïing U Trai bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , nalor kiwei bapaw kiba u la kiaw ban tei ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house , and all Solomon s desire which he was pleased to do ,

translation.kha: Neng buh ïa ka jaiñkup bad u panpoh nongpynïaid jong me halor jong u bad ngan ai ha u ka iktiar baroh kaba me la don . U , un longïing koum u kpa ïa ki bynriew jong ka Jesreel bad ka Judah .
translation.en: And I will clothe him with thy robe , and strengthen him with thy girdle , and I will commit thy government into his hand : and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and to the house of Judah .

translation.kha: dara ngan wallam pat ïa ki na mihngi bad na seiñpuh ban shong banbeiñ sah ha Israel . Kin long ki briew jongnga nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki , da kaba synshar ha ka jingïaineh bad ha ka jinglehhok .
translation.en: And I will bring them , and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem : and they shall be my people , and I will be their God , in truth and in righteousness .
We will not return unto our houses , until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance .
translation.kha: Ngin ym leit phai sha la ki longïing jong ngi tad haduh ba kiwei pat ki Israel baroh ki la shim kynti ïa ka ri kaba la ai ha ki .
( U la ong ïa kane ban tynjuh ïa u Eliphas ; ha ka jingshisha u la lah tip lypa ïa kaei ba un imat . )
translation.en: And this he said to prove him : for he himself knew what he would do .

translation.kha: Ka dei shaphang kane ka jingpynim ba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïawad bad ïit bha biang biang , bad ki la ïathuhlypa shaphang ken ka jingai ïa kaban U Balei un ai ha phi! .
translation.en: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently , who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you :

translation.kha: Ha khah ka rukom ka jingshai jong phi ka daym ban shai ha lamkhmat ki briew , khnang ba kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba bha kiba phi imat bad ïaroh ïa u Kpa jong phin uba ha pdeng .
translation.en: Let your light so shine before men , that they may see your good works , and glorify your Father which is in heaven .

translation.kha: hynrei hadien , kata ka jaitbynriew ka phai ino na ka jingsniew jong ka , ngan ym leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ba kun leh .
translation.en: If that nation , against whom I have pronounced , turn from their evil , I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them .

translation.kha: Ka Jingkhot Sngewbha Ban Hikai
translation.en: An Invitation to Learn
Strangers shall submit themselves unto me : as soon as they hear , they shall be obedient unto me .
translation.kha: Ki nongwei ki dem ngon ha khmat jong nga ; haba ki ïohsngew ïa nga , ki kohnguh .
Hynrei ym baher ki la pdiang ïa ka Khubor Babha . U Isaïah da lade hi u la ong , A tharai , uei uba la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong ngi ?
translation.en: But they have not all obeyed the gospel . For Esaias saith , Lord , who hath believed our report ?

translation.kha: Kumta te , por kwah hir longsem ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha pa hajuh kiba shong ha Rom .
translation.en: So , as much as in me is , I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also .

translation.kha: Ha Jerusalem , ki nongshna tiar jong u ki shniah ïa ki tiar ki tar ban siat ïa ki khnam pynlang kawang ïa ki miej babha heh na ki kut bad ki kyndong jong ka kynroh ka nongbah . Ka nia jong u ka la phriang pylleng sawdong , bad u la long kiba khlaiñbor katta! katta namar ka jingpynïap ba u ïapynbiang na U Blei .
translation.en: And he made in Jerusalem engines , invented by cunning men , to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks , to shoot arrows and great stones withal . And his name spread far abroad  ; for he was marvellously helped , till he was strong .

translation.kha: Phi kyndat shlur ïa kiba pang bad phi ñiew ïa ki shabar na ka kynruh .
translation.en: Because ye have thrust with side and with shoulder , and pushed all the diseased with your horns , till ye have scattered them abroad  ;

translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong nga ban phet krad na nga ; nga pynjot ïa kito kiba shun ïa nga .
translation.en: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies , that I might destroy them that hate me .
Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u long syiem haba u la don khathynriew snem ka rta ; bad u synshar sanphew ar snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jekolaïah kaba na Jerusalem .
U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa ki bad u la jubab , Ki briew kiba koit bakhiah kim donkam ïa u nongrim , hynrei tang kito Kiba pang .
translation.en: But when Jesus heard that , he said unto them ,  They that be whole need not a physician , but they that are sick .

translation.kha: U Samuel u ong , Kumba ka waitlam jong me ka la pynlong ïa naba bun ki kmie ban dih khun , kumta mynta ka kmie jong me kan long khleiñ khun . Bad u pom lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u Agag ha khmat ka duwan ha Gilgal .
translation.en: And Samuel said , As thy sword hath made women childless , so shall thy mother be childless among women . And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the  Lord  in Gilgal .

translation.kha: Ynda ki la pynïap ïa uta u masi , ki ïalam ïa uta u khynnah sha u Eli .
translation.en: And they slew a bullock , and brought the child to Eli .

translation.kha: to ïathuh ha ki , ba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , ngan shngiam ïa u lyngkhot dieng uba ïeng na ka bynta ka Israel , bad ngan buh lang ïa u Bad uta uba ïeng na ka byndi ka Judah . Na kita ar tylli tun pynlong uwei u diengsoh , bad Ngan batip ïa u ha ka ktien jong nga .
translation.en: Say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will take the stick of Joseph , which is in the hand of Ephraim , and the tribes of Israel his fellows , and will put them with him , even with the stick of Judah , and make them one stick , and they shall be one in mine hand .
To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High ,
translation.kha: u tip mynno ngim shym ïoh ïa ki hok jong ngi kiba u la ai ïa ngi ;
To pan , bad phin ïohpdiang ; to pud , bad phin shem ; to tied , malade ïa ka jingkhang yn plie ïa phi .
translation.en: Ask , and it shall be given you  ; seek , and ye shall find  ; knock , and it shall be opened unto you :

translation.kha: Phibi ïohi , namarkata , ka dei da ki kam jong u ba ïa u briew la pynksan ha U Blei , ym tang da ka jingngeit jong u hi .
translation.en: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified , and not by faith only .

translation.kha: U Laban u ong ha u Jakob , Kane ka kynton maw Kan un-long ka jingkynshew ïa ngi baroh ar ngut . Nalor kata , la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Galeed .
translation.en: And Laban said , This heap is a witness between me and thee this day . Therefore was the name of it called Galeed  ;

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lad u Dabid ki leit phai noh bad ïathuh ha u ïa kaei ba u Nabal u la lah ong .
translation.en: So David s young men turned their way , and went again , and came and told him all those sayings .

translation.kha: U la shrong ki durblei nar-khang jong u Baal ,
translation.en: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel , and made also molten images for Baalim .
And Abraham called the name of his son that was born unto him , whom Sarah bare to him , Isaac .
translation.kha: U Abraham u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Isaak ,
Lada phi shah ïa nga ban tep ïa la ka tnga hangne , to pynkyrpad lem ïa u Ephron u khun jong u Sohar ba un die ha nga ïa ka krem Makhpelah , kaba don ha trai ka lyngkha jong u .
translation.en: And he communed with them , saying , If it be your mind that I should bury my dead out of my sight  ; hear me , and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar ,

translation.kha: Kam wanrah ei ei kaba bha lada pynlut pisa ha ka jingpynksan pynstad ïa uba bieit , nalor um anna jingshemphang satia .
translation.en: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom , seeing he hath no heart to it ?

translation.kha: Phi Sargon ba phi la pynlong ïa ka jingïateh bad ka jingïaiban bad peh sha ka jingkyntait bad ka pyrthei kiba ïaphah . Phi sngewthikna ba phin lait na ka jingjot hab kan wan , namar phi shaniah ha ki jinglamler malade ki jingshukor ban pyllait ïa phi .
translation.en: Because ye have said , We have made a covenant with death , and with hell are we at agreement  ; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through , it shall not come unto us : for we have made lies our refuge , and under falsehood have we hid ourselves :

translation.kha: U la ïohknieh hima ïa ki kynjah langbrot bad ki kynhun masi baroh ; ki briew jong u ki ñiut ïa me ki jingri ha shuwa jong ki bad ki ong , Kanneh ka dien ka jrong u Dabid !
translation.en: And David took all the flocks and the herds , which they drave before those other cattle , and said , This is David s spoil .
On the first day of the first month shalt thou set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba nyngkong pynïeng ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day when he went down to the grave I caused a mourning : I covered the deep for him , and I restrained the floods thereof , and the great waters were stayed : and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him , and all the trees of the field fainted for him .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong :  Ha ka sngi ba u dieng u leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ngan pynlong ïa ki um shapoh khyndew ban tap ïa u kum ka dak ka jingïambriew . Ngan set noh ïa ki wah bad ngan ym shah ïa ki wahduid ban tuid shabar . Namar ba u dieng u la ïap , ngan wallam ka jingdum halor ki lumbah ka Lebanon bad ngan pynlong ïa baroh ki dieng ha khlaw ba kin ïapstai .

translation.en: And they rose up early in the morning , and the sun shone upon the water , and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood :
translation.kha: Haba ki la khie thiah ha ka step kaba bud , ka sngi ka la tyngshaiñ halor ka um , da kaba pynlong ïa ka ba kan saw kum ka snam .

translation.en: If David then call him Lord , how is he his son ?
translation.kha: Kumta lada u Dabid u khot ïa u ‘ U Trai ,’ kumno ka lah ban long ba U Messaïah un dei uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ?
Wai shim kabu ïa kiba dukan tang namar ba phi lah ; wat shim kabu ïa kito kiba ïeng khlaw jingïarap ha ka ïingbishar .
translation.en: Rob not the poor , because he is poor : neither oppress the afflicted in the gate :

translation.kha: Une u maw buh jingkynmaw ïa uba nga la thret un long ka jakarieh ha kaba ïa me yn mane , bad ngan ai sha me ïa kaba kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na kiei kiei baroh kiba me ai ïa nga .
translation.en: And this stone , which I have set for a pillar , shall be God s house : and of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee .

translation.kha: Ka ktien jong nga ka long kum ka ïor bad u slap bakha wan hap na sheptieng ban ai um ïa ka pyrthei . Ki pynlong ïa ki jingthung ban san bad pynmih ïa u symbai shun ïoh bet Bad ka jingbam ban bam .
translation.en: For as the rain cometh down , and the snow from heaven , and returneth not thither , but watereth the earth , and maketh it bring forth and bud , that it may give seed to the sower , and bread to the eater :

translation.kha: Nangne ki la leit phalang patan sha ïing bad ki la pynkhreh ïa ki musla bad ki jingbeh na ka bynta ka met . Ha ka sngi Sabbaton ki la shongthait , kumba ka Hukum ka dala .
translation.en: And they returned , and prepared spices and ointments  ; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment .
Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing , if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka kynthei kan ïohlait im ha ka por ba ka kha khun , lada ka ïaineh ha ka jingngeit bad ka jingieit bad ka jingkhuid , lem bad ka jingdon akor .
Mynta la thung ïa u ha ka ri shyiap , ha ka khyndew kaba tyrkhong bad ka bym don um .
translation.en: And now she is planted in the wilderness , in a dry and thirsty ground .

translation.kha: To ngin ïakhmih ïa U Messaïah , u syiem ki Jeruel , un hiar na ka diengphna mynta , bad ngin ngeit ha u ! Bad kita ki ar ngut kiba la shah sahnarphna bad U Jisu , ki la jingrben ruh ïa u .
translation.en: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross , that we may see and believe . And they that were crucified with him reviled him .

translation.kha: Ngan beh kyrtong ïa ki da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingdap , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew lad ka pyrthei kin sngewtriem ha kai kaba ki ïohi . kliang kylleng nga pynsakma ïa ki , ki brai kin kyndit bad sngewshyrkhei ha kaei kaba la jia ha ki . Ki briew ktien krenbeiñ ïa ki bad pyndonkam ïa ki kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim .
translation.en: And I will persecute them with the sword , with the famine , and with the pestilence , and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth , to be a curse , and an astonishment , and an hissing , and a reproach , among all the nations whither I have driven them :
When they now shoot forth , ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïohi ba ki sla jong ki , ki la sdang ban mih , phi tip ba ka lyiur ka la jan .

translation.en: Then I said , I shall die in my nest , and I shall multiply my days as the sand .
translation.kha: Nga khmih lynti borabor ban im slem bad ban ïap ha la ïing ha ka jingsuk .
Ha kine ki por barhem , u Rehoboam bad u Jeroboam ki don ha ka jingïaleh sur-thma borabor hapdeng jong ki .
translation.en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days .

translation.kha: Ko Hagar , ka mraw jong ka Sarah , na-ei pha wan bad shano phan leit ? Ka jubab , “Nga phet nep na la ka kynthih .
translation.en: And he said , Hagar , Sarai s maid , whence camest thou ? and whither wilt thou go ? And she said , I flee from the face of my mistress Sarai .

translation.kha: da ka hab jong ki kambah bad ki jingkhylliap , bad da ka bor jong U Mynsiem jong U Blei . Bad kumta , ha ka jingleit baroh shi lynter lyndum naduh Jerusalem sha Illyrikom , nga la pynbna pura ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Khrist .
translation.en: Through mighty signs and wonders , by the power of the Spirit of God ; so that from Jerusalem , and round about unto Illyricum , I have fully preached the gospel of Christ .

translation.kha: Un dei ma u , u ban tei ka Templ ïa la , bad ngan pynthikna ba ka longïing syiem jong u kan ïaineh .
translation.en: He shall build an house for my name , and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever .

translation.kha: Ki teh ïa kita ki kyrwoh jongnga ka jingdeng shadem ha ki kyrwoh jong ka ephod da u ksai uba jngoh , khnang ba kata ka jingdiang snem kan neh halor kata ka jingpyndap , bad ba kan ym lait na ka ephod , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Mosah .
translation.en: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue , that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod , and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Ïa baroh yn pynkhuid da ka ding kumba ïa ka jingkñia la pynkhuid da ka maw .
translation.en: For every one shall be salted with fire , and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt .

translation.kha: U Angel jongno U Trai u leit shuh ka jaka shong dara ki Israhaïah bad u pynïap shi lakh phraphew san khiar ngut ki shipai . Dang step phyrngab ka sngi Kaba brup hangta ki thoh , baroh ki la ïarep !
translation.en: Then the angel of the  Lord  went forth , and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand : and when they arose early in the morning , behold , they were all dead corpses .

translation.kha: Phi beh noh ïa ki kynthei jong ki briew jong nga na ki ïinglieng ba ki ieit , bad Phi lute khlem ngut ïa ki jingkyrkhu jong nga na ki khun jong ki .
translation.en: The women of my people have ye cast out from their pleasant houses  ; from their children have ye taken away my glory for ever .
O thou sword of the  Lord  , how long will it be ere thou be quiet ? put up thyself into thy scabbard , rest , and be still .
translation.kha: Phi kyang jam , ‘ Ka waitlam jong U  Trai  ! Katno slem phin ïai talain ïa ka ? Khie leit phai noh sha ka jingsop , sah hangta bad shongthait !’

Bad ngi tip ba ïa ka jingong barim Jong ngi la pynïap nep bad U Khrist halor ka diengphna , khnang ba ïa ka bor jong ka jinglong pop jong ngi , yn pynjot noh , khnang ba ngin ym long shuh ki mraw jong ka pop .
translation.en: Knowing this , that our old man is crucified with him , that the body of sin might be destroyed , that henceforth we should not serve sin .
And Balak sent yet again princes , more , and more honourable than they .
translation.kha: Nangta u Balak u la phah kham bun ki nongïalam kiba kham pawkhmat ban ïa kito kiba mynshuwa .

translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  It is one of the twelve , that dippeth with me in the dish .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Un long uwei na phi ki khat-ar ngut , uta u ban wieh ïa u kpu jong u ha ka pliang bad nga .
To pdiang jingsngewbha ïa u briew uba tlot ha ka jingngeit , hynriewphew wat ïania Bad u shaphang ki jingpyut bashispah jong u .
translation.en: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye , but not to doubtful disputations .

translation.kha: Hynrei da kthong , jingjam lah ban leh ei ei khlup ki dkhot jong ka met kiba i kham tlot ;
translation.en: Nay , much more those members of the body , which seem to be more feeble , are necessary :

translation.kha: Ha ki jingïaid lynti jong ki baroh shi lynter , ki lah ban ïohi mynsngi ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai ha uta u lyoh halor ka Ïingjaiñ , bad mynmiet pat ha ka dieng kaba meh halor jong ka .
translation.en: For the cloud of the  Lord  was upon the tabernacle by day , and fire was on it by night , in the sight of all the house of Israel , throughout all their journeys .

translation.kha: U Moses u la loit hiar na uta u lum , u da rah ïa wir ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ki hukum ha baroh arliang .
translation.en: And Moses turned , and went down from the mount , and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand : the tables were written on both their sides  ; on the one side and on the other were they written .
And when they were come to the place , which is called Calvary , there they crucified him , and the malefactors , one on the right hand , and the other on the left .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha ka jaka ba la khot  Ka Maloi Khlieh ,  ki la sahnarphna ïa U Jisu hangta , bad ïa ki ar ngut ki nongleh kam runar , uwei sha kamon jong u bad uwei pat sha kadiang jong u .
Ieh ! Kaei me kwah bad ngi , ko Jisu! uba na Nasareth ? Hato me la wan jingeh ban pynjot ïa sem ? Nga thiah me long uei : Me long u nongkyllan bakhuid jong U Blei !
translation.en: Saying , Let us alone  ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art  ; the Holy One of God .

translation.kha: Na wai u Briew u la jingaiti ïa ki jingbhabriew baroh ha ka pyrthei bun u la pynlong ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha kylleng ka pyrthei . U hi da lade u la pynskhem lehbha ïa ki por kiba biang bad ïa ki pud jong ki tare ha kaba kin shong kin praw .
translation.en: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth , and hath determined the times before appointed , and the bounds of their habitation  ;

translation.kha: u khun jong u Jubab , u khun jyllang u Isaak , u khun jong u Abraham , u khun jong u Thiah , u khun jongngi u Nahor ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Jacob , which was the son of Isaac , which was the son of Abraham , which was the son of Thara , which was the son of Nachor ,

translation.kha: Wat ainguh da u kpu ba la khleh thiat haba phi kñia ïa uno Une u jingri ha nga . Wah pynsah haduh mynstep ïa ka doh khia ba la pyndonkam ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka jingleh .
translation.en: Thou shalt not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven  ; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning .

translation.kha: Lada phi long jai ai , phi long kiba stad , ishyrkhei lada phi longïng kiba shit khlieh , phi shu pyn-i katno ka jinglong mutlop phi long .
translation.en: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding : but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly .

translation.kha: Man la ka sngi shuwa shun sei sngur , siew dep ïa ka pang jong u ha kata ka sngi , namar u dei uba duk bad u ap dngong ban ïoh ïa ka . Lada phim ai ïa ka , un keirang ha U Trai pyrshah ïa phi , malade kata kan long ka bapop ïa phiah .
translation.en: At his day thou shalt give him his hire , neither shall the sun go down upon it  ; for he is poor , and setteth his heart upon it : lest he cry against thee unto the  Lord  , and it be sin unto thee .
Why did you come ?
translation.kha: Balei phi wan ?
To pynim ïa lai lapbah me longïng u syiem ki Jiw !
translation.en: And saying , If thou be the king of the Jews , save thyself .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit ban jngoh ïa u syiem bad ki la ong , Ko syiem Darius , ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un im junom !
translation.en: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king , and said thus unto him , King Darius , live for ever .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada u shong jing-jngai , lin lada phim tip) na-ei u trai jongnga ka , ïalam ïa ka sha ïing jyllang ph . india u trai u wan dam ïa ka , ai ïa ka ha u .
translation.en: And if thy brother be not nigh unto thee , or if thou know him not , then thou shalt bring it unto thine own house , and it shall be with thee until thy brother seek after it , and thou shalt restore it to him again .

translation.kha: Nga don ka jingpyrkhat ba ka donakor ban pha sha phi ïa u per jong ngi u Ephphatha , uba la trei bad ïaleh ha syndah jong nga bad uba la shakri kum u nonglamktien jngai phi ha kaba ïarap ïa nga .
translation.en: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus , my brother , and companion in labour , and fellowsoldier , but your messenger , and he that ministered to my wants .
And when he was departed thence , he went into their synagogue :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la leit sha ka Synagog ,
U la ïong , Nga ong ha phi ba kane ka riewkynthei kaba tduh ka la thep kham bun shah ban ïa kiwei .
translation.en: And he said ,  Of a truth I say unto you , that this poor widow hath cast in more than they all :
And Isaac entreated the  Lord  for his wife , because she was barren : and the  Lord  was entreated of him , and Rebekah his wife conceived .
translation.kha: Namar ba ka Rebekka kam ïoh khun , u Isaak u la duwai ha U  Trai  na ka bynta jong ka . U  Trai  u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad ka Rebekka ka la punkhun .

translation.en: Now we , brethren , as Isaac was , are the children of promise .
translation.kha: Mynta , ma phi , ki parabangeit jong nga , phi long ki khun U Blei na ka jingkular jong u , kumba ka la long bad u Isaak .
U Nadab u la duwai ïa U Blei ba uba u khulom un koit . Um treh bam ei ei , dara lad ka miat u thung shat la ka ruma , bad u Thiah ha madan baroh shi miet .
translation.en: David therefore besought God for the child  ; and David fasted , and went in , and lay all night upon the earth .
For the head of Syria is Damascus , and the head of Damascus is Rezin  ; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken , that it be not a people .
translation.kha: Balei ? Namar ba ka Syria kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka Damaskos , ka nongbah jong ka , bad ka Damaskos kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa u Syiem Resin . Katba ïa ka Israel , hapoh ki hynriewphew san snem yn sa pynkhynñiuh ïa ka ruh ban lait im kum ka jaitbynriew .

Nangta u Joshua u ïa-ong ïa ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la shakri kum ki nongsyntiat , Haei leit shai ka ïing jong ka jingrisa bad wan ïalam ïa ka nabar ïa ka longïing longsem jong ka , kumba phi la kular ïa ka .
translation.en: But Joshua had said unto the two men that had spied out the country , Go into the harlot s house , and bring out thence the woman , and all that she hath , as ye sware unto her .
And when it was day , he called unto him his disciples : and of them he chose twelve , whom also he named apostles  ;
translation.kha: Haba ka la shai , u la khot ïa la ki synran sha u bad u la jied khat-ar ngut na ki , ïa kiba u la ai kyrteng , ki apostol :
Ngan ai ha me bad ha ki khunlung ki kiew jong me ïa ka ri baroh katno kaba me ïohi , bad kan long ka jong me junom .
translation.en: For all the land which thou seest , to thee will I give it , and to thy seed for ever .

translation.kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka leit sha ka jaka kop kew bad ka la imat ïa kiei kaba ka kiaw kyrdem lad ka , ka la bthah ïa ka .
translation.en: And she went down unto the floor , and did according to all that her mother in law bade her .

translation.kha: Ki nonghikai ka Hukum malu ki nongbah lyngdoh ki la pynjrong don kem ïa U Jisu hangto hi , nabar ki la tip ba u la ïathuh ïa kane ka pharshi pyrshah ïa ki ; hynrei ki la ïapyrshang ïa ki paidbah .
translation.en: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him  ; and they feared the people : for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them .
Then came she and worshipped him , saying , Lord , help me .
translation.kha: Ha kane , ka briew ka la wan bad dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u .  To ïarap ïa nga , ko Kynrad !  ka la ong .

U la ong ha ki , Phi hi phin tip beh ba la khang ïa u Jiw da ka niam jong u ban leit jngoh lane ïajan bad ki Jahlil . Hynrei U Bel u la pyn-i ha nga ba ngam dei ban ñiew bymkhuid ne basang kat kum ka jinglehniam ïa uno du u briew .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company , or come unto one of another nation  ; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban sngewskhem ba yn ym don uno uno uba awria , uba long jakhlia , lane uba kwah lalot (naba ka jingkwah lalot ka long hi ka rukom mane bleithaw) u ban ïoh bynta ha ka Hima jong U Khrist bad jong U Blei .
translation.en: For this ye know , that no whoremonger , nor unclean person , nor covetous man , who is an idolater , hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God .

translation.kha: Ki kali ïam ki tyngkhuh kulmar ha ki lynti bah , da kaba maw shane shatai lyngka ki jaka paidbah ka nongbah . Ki thaba kum ki dongmusa bad ki stet kum ka leilieh .
translation.en: The chariots shall rage in the streets , they shall justle one against another in the broad ways : they shall seem like torches , they shall run like the lightnings .

translation.kha: U Jakob u la mihnoh na Beersheba bad u leit shaphang Haran .
translation.en: And Jacob went out from Beer–sheba , and went toward Haran .

translation.kha: Uta u nongap phira u ong , Nga Ïohi ba u briew uba ha khmat u mareh kum u Ahisamakh . U dei u briew uba bha , u syiem u ong , bad u wanrah ka khubor kiba ba .
translation.en: And the watchman said , Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok . And the king said , He is a good man , and cometh with good tidings .
And think not to say within yourselves , We have Abraham to our father : for I say unto you , that God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham .
translation.kha: Bad wat leit pyrkhat ba phi lah ban lait na ka jingpynshitom da kaba ong ba u Abraham u long u kpa tymmen jong phi . Nga ong ha phi ba U Blei u lah ban shim ïa kine ki maw bad pynlong ki khun ki ksiew na ka bynta u Abraham !
Kata ka briew ka kitei Sha u sahmiet , ka dem ngon haduh khyndew ha ka jingñiewburom bad ka ong , Ïarap ïa nga , ko Syiem Kynrad !
translation.en: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king , she fell on her face to the ground , and did obeisance , and said , Help , O king .
For though ye have ten thousand instructors in Christ , yet have ye not many fathers : for in Christ Jesus I have begotten you through the gospel .
translation.kha: Wat haba phi don shiphew hajar ngut ki nongsumar ha ka jingim jong phi kum ki bangeit , phi don tang uwei u kpa . Naba ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu nga la long u kpa jong phi da kaba wallam ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi .

translation.en: And round about the throne were four and twenty seats : and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting , clothed in white raiment  ; and they had on their heads crowns of gold .
translation.kha: Sawdong ïa ka khet , la don arphew saw tylli kiwei pat ki khet , ha kaba la shong arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang    kiba la riam da kaba lieh bad phong ki pansngiat ksiar .
myntan , halor ka jingai jingmut u Miphkad , ka Esther ka bat tang ha lade khlup ïathuh hano hano ba ka long ka Jiw .
translation.en: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred : for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew it .
For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool , and troubled the water : whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had .
translation.kha: Ki da ap ïa ka jingkhih jong ka um , namar u angel U Trai hateng hateng u ju hiar sha kata ka pungsum ban pynkhih ïa ka um . Ïa u nongpang uba nyngkong uba hiar ha ka pungsum hadien ba la pynkhih ïa ka um la pynkhiah na kano kano ka jingpang kaba u don .
Kat kaba shyrkhei ibha baroh ki briew ki kren bha shaphang jong phi ; ki kpa tymmen Jong ki , ki la kren-ïa ïa kijuh kiei kiei shaphang ki nonghiarpateng lamler .
translation.en: Woe unto you , when all men shall speak well of you ! for so did their fathers to the false prophets .

translation.kha: bad pa’ ïohi hapdeng jong ki ïa ka kynthei kaba bakhraw kaba ph imon ban shongkurim ,
translation.en: And seest among the captives a beautiful woman , and hast a desire unto her , that thou wouldest have her to thy wife  ;

translation.kha: Thaw ruh sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka ksiar , bad pynïasoh ïa ki jingkam da kita ki jingpait ba kin long tang kawei .
translation.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold , and couple the curtains together with the taches : and it shall be one tabernacle .

translation.kha: hynrei ha ka jingshit ki jah noh , pynlang ki phud wahduid ki rngad bad ki tyrkhong .
translation.en: What time they wax warm , they vanish : when it is hot , they are consumed out of their place .

translation.kha: Da kumta ken ka khyndew jong u Ephron kob ha Makhpelah , kaba don shaphang mihngi na Mamre , ka kylla long ka jong u Abraham . Ka kynthup ïa ka lyngkha , ïa ka krem kaba ne hangta , bad ïa ki dieng baroh Kiba don hapoh ki pud jrong ka .
translation.en: And the field of Ephron , which was in Machpelah , which was before Mamre , the field , and the cave which was therein , and all the trees that were in the field , that were in all the borders round about , were made sure
That's impossible for me .
translation.kha: Ka long ka bymlahlong ianga .
Ha kito kiba ïoh ïa ka jingit ngan ai ïa ka hok ban shong ha syndah jyllang nga ha ka khet jong nga , kumba nga shiah nga la jop bad mynta nga shong ha shniah U Kpa jong nga ha ka khet jong u .
translation.en: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne , even as I also overcame , and am set down with my Father in his throne .

translation.kha: Phim tip da lei lei lano ka por lad phi ka wan . Kum ki sim kiba la ngat kynsan ha ki jingriam , kum ki dohkha kiba la ngat ha ka jar , ngi la shah riew ha ki katto kat ki khep basniew ha kaba ngim shym khim lynnong satlak ïa kata .
translation.en: For man also knoweth not his time : as the fishes that are taken in an evil net , and as the birds that are caught in the snare  ; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time , when it falleth suddenly upon them .

translation.kha: mynsngi u buh ïa ki lyoh ha sahit bna , mynba u seng ïa ki umpohliew ka duriaw-bah ,
translation.en: When he established the clouds above : when he strengthened the fountains of the deep :

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la noh ïa ngi pun kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh bad ban jingpynrem ïa u , na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ngi ba un ri pynim ïa ngi bania ha kñia ka sngi .
translation.en: And the  Lord  commanded us to do all these statutes , to fear the  Lord  our God , for our good always , that he might preserve us alive , as it is at this day .

translation.kha: balieh mynta pat , me da kwah rhah sa ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh ba nga dawa na la ki briew ? balieh Elisha ba me Kham ai burom ïa la ki khun shynrang ban ïa nga da kaba me shah ba kin pynshad ïa lade da ki bynta kiba bha tam na ki jingkñia ba ki briew ki ai ha per ?
translation.en: Wherefore kick ye at my sacrifice and at mine offering , which I have commanded in my habitation  ; and honourest thy sons above me , to make yourselves fat with the chiefest of all the offerings of Israel my people ?

translation.kha: Katno nga sngewkmen ban shet ba Don na ki khun jong phi kiba ïaid ha ka jingshisha , kumba U Kpa u la hukum ïa ngi .
translation.en: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth , as we have received a commandment from the Father .

translation.kha: Hynrei , A thri , me ithuh ïa nga ; me ïohi Kaei ba nga leh , bad kumno nga la ieit ïa me . To paring sharud ïa kine ki rangbah basniew kum ïa ki langbrot ki ban shah ot doh ; to sumar ïa ki tad haduh ba ka dei ka pa ïa ki ban shahskhor pynïap .
translation.en: But thou , O  Lord  , knowest me : thou hast seen me , and tried mine heart toward thee : pull them out like sheep for the slaughter , and prepare them for the day of slaughter .

translation.kha: Wat ju pynphriang ïa ki khlur lamler , bad wat ïalap ïa u nongleh bymman da kaba sakhi lamler .
translation.en: Thou shalt not raise a false report : put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness .

translation.kha: Kato ka long kaba phylla ban ïohi ïa u nonglamktien ba u wan na ki lumbah , u wanrah ïa ka khubor babha , ka khubor jong ka jingsuk ! U pynban ïa ka jingjop bad u ong ïa ka Seïon , U Blei jong phi u long u syiem !
translation.en: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings , that publisheth peace  ; that bringeth good tidings of good , that publisheth salvation  ; that saith unto Zion , Thy God reigneth !

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u shim ïa kata ka Snam na ki dabor bad u synreit ïa ka ha uta u paidbah . U ong , “Kane ka long ka snar kaba pynskhem ïa ka jinghun kaba U Trai u la pynlong bad phi , mynleh u ai ïa kine ki hukum baroh .
translation.en: And Moses took the blood , and sprinkled it on the people , and said , Behold the blood of the covenant , which the  Lord  hath made with you concerning all these words .

translation.kha: Kumno me lah Ban pynpang ïa ki briew Kum ka dohnud lieng kamon ka kynhun ki khñiang ki bym don nongsynshar ban ïalam ïa ki ?
translation.en: And makest men as the fishes of the sea , as the creeping things , that have no ruler over them ?

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Samson u leit sha Geser , ka shnong ki Philistia , hangto u ïakynduh ïa ka nuti bad u leit ïathiah bad ka .
translation.en: Then went Samson to Gaza , and saw there an harlot , and went in unto her .

translation.kha: U Blei jong ki pangnud Israel u la jied ïa ki kpa tymmen Jong ngi bad u la pynlong ka jaitbynriew kob khraw ïa une u paid ha ka por ba ki la im kum ki nongïoh ha ka ri Ijipt . U Blei u la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri jingïaphet da ka bor bakhraw jong u ,
translation.en: The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers , and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt , and with an high arm brought he them out of it .

translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u leit noh sha shiliang lad ka them bad u ïeng ha kliar uwei u lum uba kham ha pajih ,
translation.en: Then David went over to the other side , and stood on the top of an hill afar off  ; a great space being between them :

translation.kha: Na mihngi sha sepngi , baroh kiba jingïashoh ïa ka kupar jong u ki suhjer ka met Bad ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: They that come after him shall be astonished at his day , as they that went before were affrighted .
If this man were not of God , he could do nothing .
translation.kha: Lymda une u briew u la wan na U Blei , un ym lah ban leh ïa kaba kum kane .
Baroh ki Jia bun ki Jentil kiba shang basah ha Ephesos ki la ïohsngew ïa kane ; la pyndap ïa ki baroh da ka jingshemphang , badno ïa ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu la ai ka burom kiba kham khraw .
translation.en: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus  ; and fear fell on them all , and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified .

translation.kha: U pynkit ïa ki katto katne bad u pynriewspah ïa kiwei pat ; U pynrit ïa ki katno katne bad u pynkhriat ïa kiwei pateng .
translation.en: The  Lord  maketh poor , and maketh rich : he bringeth low , and lifteth up .

translation.kha: Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïalumlang banbeiñ ïaleh ïa u ; ki briew ki la ïawan na kylleng sawdong . Ki la phriang ïa la ki jar behmrad bad ki la ïohkem ïa u ha ka jingriam lad ki .
translation.en: Then the nations set against him on every side from the provinces , and spread their net over him : he was taken in their pit .

translation.kha: Kane ka kynthup ïa said ka thain baroh kaba sha mihngi na ka kwah Jordan hapoh ka Duriaw Baïap kaba shaphang shathie , Bad nangta haduh ka kjat lum Pisgah shaphang mihngi .
translation.en: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward , even unto the sea of the plain , under the springs of Pisgah .

translation.kha: Wat leh Shillong khmat ïa uba duk haba bishar ïa u .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou countenance a poor man in his cause .
Go not forth into the field , nor walk by the way  ; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side .
translation.kha: Ngim nud ban leit sha ki rudnong lane ïaid ha ki surok , namar ki nongshun jong ngi ki la kieng atiar bad ka jingshyrkhei ka don ha baroh sawdong jong ngi .
hynrei ha ka jingshitom ki jah noh , malade ki phud wahduid ki rngad bad ki tyrkhong .
translation.en: What time they wax warm , they vanish : when it is hot , they are consumed out of their place .
And again the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Israel , and he moved David against them to say , Go , number Israel and Judah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki Israel sa shisien , bad kumta u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban wanrah jingjynjar halor jong ki . U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Khie leit bad ñiew ïa ki paid Israel bad ki paid Judah .

translation.en: And the sons of Simeon  ; Jemuel , and Jamin , and Ohad , and Jachin , and Zohar , and Shaul the son of a Canaanitish woman .
translation.kha: U Simeon bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Jemuel , u Jamin , u Ohad , u Jakhin , u Sohar , bad u Shaul , u khun ka kynthei nong Kanaan .

translation.en: Having a good conscience  ; that , whereas they speak evil of you , as of evildoers , they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Christ .
translation.kha: hynrei , to leh ïa kata ha ka jingjai jai bad da kaba burom . To sumar khuid ïa ka jingïatiplem jong phi , khnang ba haba phi shah krenbeiñ , kita kiba kren sniew ïa ka jinglong jingim babha jong phi kum ki nongbud jong U Khrist kin shah lehrain na ka bynta kaei kaba ki ong .

translation.en: So Hushai David s friend came into the city , and Absalom came into Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Kumta u Hushai , u paralok jong u Dabid , u la leit phai sha ka nongbah hamar ba u Absalom u dang wan poi .

translation.en: They wrote his thoughts, not their own .
translation.kha: Ki thoh ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong U Blei , ym ïa la ki jong .

translation.en: And it shall be , that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King , the  Lord  of hosts , even upon them shall be no rain .
translation.kha: Lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew ka kyntait ban leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh kum u syiem , te u slap un ym hap ha ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt , he sent out our fathers first .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym shem jingbam ei ei , bad haba u Jakob u la ïohsngew ba don kew ha Ijipt , u la phah ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ha ka jingleit banyngkong jong ki shata .
Ki briew ka pyrthei kin ïaid ha ka jingïakhaïi jong ka , bad ki syiem jong ka pyrthei Kin wallam ïa ka shtah jong ki shapoh jong ka .
translation.en: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it : and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it .

translation.kha: Kumta u Haman u wan shapoh , bad u syiem u ong ha u , Don uba nga kwah eh ban lehburom . khie kaba ngan bor na ka bynta une u briew ? U Haman u la pyrkhat ha put , Mynta ïano u Syiem u khwai eh ban pyndonburom ? dien ïa nga keiñ .
translation.en: So Haman came in . And the king said unto him , What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour ? Now Haman thought in his heart , To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself ?

translation.kha: wahbah ki paidbah ki la sngewkwah Shaphan kata , ki la buiñ ïa u . U la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki , u la kren ha ki Shaphan ka Hima U Blei , bad u la pynkhiah ïa iba kiba dumok ïa ka .
translation.en: And the people , when they knew it , followed him : and he received them , and spake unto them of the kingdom of God , and healed them that had need of healing .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa ka Sarah wohnia u la kular , bad ka la punkhun bad kha khun shynrang ïa u Abraham haba u la tymmen .
translation.en: And the  Lord  visited Sarah as he had said , and the  Lord  did unto Sarah as he had spoken .

translation.kha: Ngim long ki briew kiba phai dat bad kiba jot noh . Pynban , ngi don ka jingngeit bad la pynum ïa ngi .
translation.en: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition  ; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul .

translation.kha: Nangta ka thoh katto katne ki shithi , bad ka soi ïa ki ha ka kyrteng u Ahab , ka shongsaiñ ïa ki da ka muhor jong u , mala ka phah ïa ki sha ki rangbah synshar bad ki riewpawkhmat ka Jesreel .
translation.en: So she wrote letters in Ahab s name , and sealed them with his seal , and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city , dwelling with Naboth .
Jesus saith unto him ,  If I will that he tarry till I come , what is that to thee ? follow thou me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Lada nga mon ïa u ba un im tad ynda nga wan , ka pher aïu ïa me ? To bud ïa nga !

translation.en: Thou hast planted them , yea , they have taken root : they grow , yea , they bring forth fruit : thou art near in their mouth , and far from their reins .
translation.kha: Me la thung ïa ki , bad ki la suhthied ; ki san bad ki pynmih soh . Ki ju kren bha shaphang jong me , pynban kim da salia eh shisha shaphang jong me .

translation.en: And two turtledoves , or two young pigeons , such as he is able to get  ; and the one shall be a sin offering , and the other a burnt offering .
translation.kha: Un wallam ruh ar tylli ki paro ne ki lyngdkhur , kawei na ka bynta ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad kawei pat na ka bynta ka jingkñia ainguh thang .

translation.en: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the  Lord  , saying , The  Lord  will surely deliver us : this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Bad wat ai ïa u ban pynngeit ïa phi ban shaniah ha U  Trai . Wat pyrkhat ba U  Trai  un pyllait ïa phi bad ba un pynsangeh ïa ki shipai Assyria na kaba knieh noh ïa ka nongbah jong phi .
Ym don uno uno uba la ïuh ïa U Blei mihnoh mynno ruh , isynei , lada ngi ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei patiaw , U Blei u im Hapoh jong Ngi , bad ïa ka jingieit jyllang u la pynjanai noh ha im .
translation.en: No man hath seen God at any time . If we love one another , God dwelleth in us , and his love is perfected in us .
Then the priest shall wash his clothes , and he shall bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp , and the priest shall be unclean until the even .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , un sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad theh um ïa lade , bad nangta u lah ban rung sha ka jaka shong dara ; hynrei u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .

translation.en: With thy wisdom and with thine understanding thou hast gotten thee riches , and hast gotten gold and silver into thy treasures :
translation.kha: Ka jingstad bad ka jingtbit jong me ka la pynriewspah ïa me da ki jingkynshew ksiar bad rupa .

translation.en: And the whole city was filled with confusion : and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus , men of Macedonia , Paul s companions in travel , they rushed with one accord into the theatre .
translation.kha: Ka jingkhihwin ka la par ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei . Ki paidbhur ki la kem ïa u Gaïos bad ïa u Aristarkhos , ki ar ngut ki nong Makedonia kiba ïaleit ryngkat bad u Paul , bad ki la paring mareh bad ki sha ka rynsan leh tamasa .
Ka ri kan siaw bha , bad phin ieh ban bam kat ïa kaba phi kwah , bad phin ïoh shongshngain hangta .
translation.en: And the land shall yield her fruit , and ye shall eat your fill , and dwell therein in safety .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba Ngin ïa-ong te , ba u Ahab u kpa , jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi , Kaei ka jingshem jong u ?
translation.en: What shall we say then that Abraham our father , as pertaining to the flesh , hath found ?

translation.kha: u la sngewsih ba u lah tiduh bad buh ïa ki ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And it repented the  Lord  that he had made man on the earth , and it grieved him at his heart .

translation.kha: adong umdih ïa ki ba kin shim ïa ki kali na Ijipt na ka bynta ki tnat mala ki khum rit jong ki , bad pun ïan ïalang ïa u kpa jrong phi bad ki .
translation.en: Now thou art commanded , this do ye  ; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones , and for your wives , and bring your father , and come .
And thou shalt shew thy son in that day , saying , This is done because of that which the  Lord  did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ha kaba sdang jong ka Jingkhawai Niam , pynsngewthuh ha ki khun shynrang jong phi ba phi leh ïa kane baroh namar kaei kaba U  Trai  u la leh ha phi mynba phi mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: Then he went down into the king s house , into the scribe s chamber : and , lo , all the princes sat there , even Elishama the scribe , and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah , and Elnathan the son of Achbor , and Gemariah the son of Shaphan , and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah , and all the princes .
translation.kha: Te u la leit sha ka ïingsyiem , sha ka kamra u sekretari ka ïingbishar , ha kaba baroh ki rangbah synshar ki dang don ha ka jingïalang . U Elishama , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u Delaïah u khun jong u Shemaïah , u Elnathan u khun jong u Akhbor , u Gemaraïah u khun jong u Shaphan , u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Hananaïah , bad baroh kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar ki la don hangta .
“Nga la ïoh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U Tlai Nongsynshar . Ha ka , nga la ïohi shi shang ki soh .
translation.en: Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me : and behold a basket of summer fruit .

translation.kha: Hattush uno Une na phi u lah ban im kham slem da kaba u khuslai shaphang jongno ka ?
translation.en: Which of you by taking thought can add one cubit unto his stature ?

translation.kha: Ki riewbymman ki khiar lung kum ki ñiut ha ka sngi , kum ki ñiut kiba saphriang kylleng ka kpoh .
translation.en: He is green before the sun , and his branch shooteth forth in his garden .

translation.kha: La jia aïu ïa ka jingsynran jong me ïa u Daberath , u paralok jong me ? u Absalom u la kyllan ïa u . Balei smam leit ryngkat bad u ?
translation.en: And Absalom said to Hushai , Is this thy kindness to thy friend ? why wentest thou not with thy friend ?

translation.kha: Kren na ka bynta jong ki bad long u nongbishar uba hok . Ïada ïa ki hok jong kiba duk bad babha kyrduh .
translation.en: Open thy mouth , judge righteously , and plead the cause of the poor and needy .

translation.kha: Kumta ki ïatyngkhuh ha u Dabid ïa khnai , bad u jubab , Ka long ka bhor kaba khraw ban long u phira kurim jong u syiem , kaba khrong than ïa uba kum ma to uba duk badno u bymdondor ei ei .
translation.en: And Saul s servants spake those words in the ears of David . And David said , Seemeth it to you a light thing to be a king s son in law , seeing that I am a poor man , and lightly esteemed ?

translation.kha: hynrei U tharai u long uba khah , namar ngiam shym la kohnguh ïa u . To shahshkor ïa nga , ko ki briew Hangne hangno ; to khmih ïa nga ha ka jingpang jong nga . Ki samla shynrang bad kyntur jong nga ki la shahshkor ringmraw noh .
translation.en: Their heart cried unto the Lord , O wall of the daughter of Zion , let tears run down like a river day and night : give thyself no rest  ; let not the apple of thine eye cease .

translation.kha: ‘ Hato me kwah ban pynïap ïa na , kumba me la pynïap ïa uto u nong Ijipt mynhynnin ?’
translation.en: Wilt thou kill me , as thou diddest the Egyptian yesterday ?

translation.kha: Ngi wallam aïu sha ka pyrthei ? Ym don ei ei ! neng kah ban rah aïu pat na ka pyrthei ? Ym don ei ei !
translation.en: For we brought nothing into this world , and it is certain we can carry nothing out .

translation.kha: Ki bang thwet sha ka nongbah ; ki mareh nalor ki kynroh ; ki kiew shwa ki ïohnong badno ki rung lyngba ki jingkhangïit kum ki nongtuh .
translation.en: They shall run to and fro in the city  ; they shall run upon the wall , they shall climb up upon the houses  ; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief .
And the sons of Ulla  ; Arah , and Haniel , and Rezia .
translation.kha: bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ulla ki dei u Arah , u Hanniel , bad u Risia .
Teng khmih ïa ka bad ïai ai um ïa ka . Ngan ap phira ïa ka mynmiet bad Mynsngi khnang ba yn ym don mano mano u ban pynsniew ïa ka .
translation.en: I the  Lord  do keep it  ; I will water it every moment : lest any hurt it , I will keep it night and day .

translation.kha: Lada phi long jai jia , Phin long kiba stad , hynrei lada phoi long kiba lud khlieh , phi shu pyn-i katno ka jinglong thup phi long .
translation.en: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding : but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly .
The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity  ; but a wounded spirit who can bear ?
translation.kha: Ka mon jong phi ban im kan kyrshan ïa phi haba phi pang , hynrei lada phi duh ïa ka , ka jingkyrmen jong phi kaba sah ka la jah noh .

translation.en: ( For the  Lord  thy God is a merciful God  ; ) he will not forsake thee , neither destroy thee , nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them .
translation.kha: U long U Blei uba isynei . Un ym iehnoh lane pynjot ïa phi , bad un ym klet ïa ka jutang kaba u hi u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
bad ynda me la poi hangta , wad ïa u Jehu u khulom jong u Jehoshaphat bad u kiew jong u Nimshi . Ïalam ïa u Sha ka kamra kaba kyrpad jngai na ki paralok jong u ,
translation.en: And when thou comest thither , look out there Jehu the son of Jehoshaphat the son of Nimshi , and go in , and make him arise up from among his brethren , and carry him to an inner chamber  ;

translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew kumno ba nga la ju im mynhynne por dang don ha ka niam Jiw , kumno nga la pynshitom beiñ khlem jingisynei ïa ka buid U Blei bad nga la bor ïa kabu bha tam ïa-ban pynduh noh ïa ka .
translation.en: For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews  religion , how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God , and wasted it :

No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper  ; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn . This is the heritage of the servants of the  Lord  , and their righteousness is of me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei yn ym don ka tiar thma ka ban lah ban pynmynsaw ïa pha ; phan don ka jubab ïa kito baroh kiba mudui ïa pha . Ngan kyrshan ïa ki shakri jong nga bad ngan ai jingjop ïa ki .  U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes .
translation.kha: To bat ha ka kti jong me ïa kito ki lyngkhot dieng ar tylli bad ai ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa ki .
Don jingkyrmen aïu na ka bynta ki briew kiba khlem blei ha ka kynta ba U Blei un ïadep ïa ka jingrem jongki ki ?
translation.en: For what is the hope of the hypocrite , though he hath gained , when God taketh away his soul ?
I will be his father , and he shall be my son : and I will not take my mercy away from him , as I took it from him that was before thee :
translation.kha: Ngan long u kpa jong u bad un long u khun jong nga , ngan ym weng noh ïa ka jingkyrshan jong nga na u kumba nga la leh ïa u Saul , ïa uba nga la weng khnang ba me lah ban long syiem .

translation.en: And when he saw that , he arose , and went for his life , and came to Beer–sheba , which belongeth to Judah , and left his servant there .
translation.kha: U Elijah u la sheptieng bad u la phet ban pyllait im ïa lade ; u shim ïa u shakri jong u bad leit noh sha Beersheba kaba ha Judah . Da kaba iehnoh ïa u shakri hangta ,
jynreiñ uno uno uba ïeng skhem khah kaba kut un lait im .
translation.en: But he that shall endure unto the end , the same shall be saved .

translation.kha: Ki nongkheiñ ki jong ha ka , Baroh kiei ktien katba bha kiba pha la angnud ban ïoh ki la jah noh , bad baroh ka spah jong pha bad ka jrong phong jong pha ki la leit ino , phan ym shem shiah ïa ki !
translation.en: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee , and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee , and thou shalt find them no more at all .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la mareh shisyndon , u la shim ïa u spoiñ , u la pynngam ïa u khah ka waiñ ka bym bha , u buh ïa u ha tduh jong u ding , malade u la pyrshang ban pyndih ïa u .
translation.en: And straightway one of them ran , and took a sponge , and filled it with vinegar , and put it on a reed , and gave him to drink .
If a man abide not in me , he is cast forth as a branch , and is withered  ; and men gather them , and cast them into the fire , and they are burned .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno u bymïaineh ha nga yn bret noh ïa u kum ka tnat bad u ïap tyrkhong ; kum ïa kita ki tnat , la lumlang bad la bret noh ha ka ding , ha kaba la thang ïa ki .
Kinah ki proberb ki lah ban nang pynkhraw ïa ka jingtip jong ki riewstad malade ksew lynti ïa ibha la nang la tip ,
translation.en: A wise man will hear , and will increase learning  ; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels :
And it shall come to pass , that in all the land , saith the  Lord  , two parts therein shall be cut off and die  ; but the third shall be left therein .
translation.kha: bad ha kylleng ka ri , ar na ka lai bynta ki briew kin ïap .
Katba U Jisu u dang kren ïa ken , u nonglamktien u la wan na ka ïing u rangbah synshar . Ka khun jong me ka la ïap , u la ong ha u Jairos ; wat pynshitom shuh ïa u nonghikai .
translation.en: While he yet spake , there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue s house , saying to him , Thy daughter is dead  ; trouble not the Master .
And he said unto the men of Succoth , Give , I pray you , loaves of bread unto the people that follow me  ; for they be faint , and I am pursuing after Zebah and Zalmunna , kings of Midian .
translation.kha: Haba ki poi ha Sukkoth , u ong ha ki rangbah jong kata ka nongrit ,  Sngewbha ai ïa ki rangbah jong nga katto katne ki kpu . Ki la thait ïan , bad nga dang beh ïa u Sebah bad u Salmunna , ki syiem Midian .

U Jisu u dang kren haba u Judas , uwei na ki kharai lwet ki synran , u la wan poi . Ryngkat pynlang u , la don u paidbah babun uba la kieng atiar da ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , ïa kiba la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh bun ki tymmen ki san .
translation.en: And while he yet spake , lo , Judas , one of the twelve , came , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and elders of the people .
And he , as a rotten thing , consumeth , as a garment that is moth eaten .
translation.kha: Kaba mih nangta ka long ba nga khyllem kum ka dieng pyut , kum ka jaiñphong ba la bam khñiang .
To ainguh ïa U tharai , pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u ; ïathuh ïa ki jaitbynriew ïa kaei kaba u la leh .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; call upon his name : make known his deeds among the people .
And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone , they caught Paul and Silas , and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers ,
translation.kha: Haba ki kynrad jong ka ki sngewthuh ba ka lad thaw pisa jong ki ka la duh noh , ki la kem ïa u Paul bad u Silas bad ki la tan ïa ki sha ki bor synshar ha ka jaka ïew .
Nangta ma u bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki ïaid shwa ka thnum pyrshah ïa ki Philistia , kiba ïaleh iwei ïa iwei pat ha ka jingkulmar bajur .
translation.en: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves , and they came to the battle : and , behold , every man s sword was against his fellow , and there was a very great discomfiture .

translation.kha: Ngam wad ïa ka jingnoh ki briew .
translation.en: I receive not honour from men .
And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times , and cleanse it , and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Da la ka shynriah ti un synreit khyndiat na kata ka snam ha kata ka duwan hynñiew sien . Ha kane ka rukom u dei ban pynkhuid ïa ka na ki pop jong ki paid Israel , bad un pynlong khuid ïa ka .
Ka kynruh shipai Babilonia ka sdang kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem , hynrei haba ki la ïohsngew ba ka kynhun shipai Ijipt ka la jam sha shiliang u pud ka Ijipt , ki la phai dien noh .
translation.en: Then Pharaoh s army was come forth out of Egypt : and when the Chaldeans that besieged Jerusalem heard tidings of them , they departed from Jerusalem .

But Moses  hands were heavy  ; and they took a stone , and put it under him , and he sat thereon  ; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands , the one on the one side , and the other on the other side  ; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun .
translation.kha: Haba ki kti u Moses ki la sakhrai , u Aaron bad u Hur ki rah uwei u maw ba un shong , katba ma ki pat ki ïeng ha syndah jong u , uwei sha kadiang bad uwei pat sha kamon , bad ki kyrshan ïa ki kti jong u , ki da kyrshan skhem ïa ki kumta haduh ban da sep ka sngi .

U Petros u dang ïeng hangamei ban pynsyaid ïa lat . Kumta kiwei pah ki la ong ha u , Hato me duh mem dei iwei na ki synran jongnga uta u briew ? hynne u Petros u la len ïa Kata . Em , ngam dei , u la ïa-ong .
translation.en: And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself . They said therefore unto him , Art not thou also one of his disciples ? He denied it , and said , I am not .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Phestos u la kwah ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha badno ki Jiw , kumin u la kylli ïa u Paul , Hato me mon Ban leit sha Jerusalem ba yn bishar hajir kine ki jingmudui ha khmat jongnga nga klang ?
translation.en: But Festus , willing to do the Jews a pleasure , answered Paul , and said , Wilt thou go up to Jerusalem , and there be judged of these things before me ?

translation.kha: Kiba bun na ki , ki la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong u bad la pynbaptis ïa ki , Bad kumba lai hajar ngut ki briew la pynïasoh sha ka kynjah ha “kata ka sngi .
translation.en: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized : and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls .

translation.kha: U Benabinadab , uba sohkhram ïa ka Tibhath , ka khun jong u Solomon : ka thain dor baroh kawei ;
translation.en: The son of Abinadab , in all the region of Dor  ; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife :

translation.kha: ki san ngut ki nongïasaid ki rung beit shapoh ïing bad ki shim ïa kata ka bleithaw ba la Suit da ka rupa , Kawei pat ruh ki bleithaw , nabar ïa ka ephod , katba u lyngdoh u dang ïeng ha ka khyrdep nabar ki hynriewspah ngut ki rangbah Ibbah la kieng atiar .
translation.en: And the five men that went to spy out the land went up , and came in thither , and took the graven image , and the ephod , and the teraphim , and the molten image : and the priest stood in the entering of the gate with the six hundred men that were appointed with weapons of war .

translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ka jingjop na sahit bneng kum u slap ; ka khyndew ka in ban pdiang ïa u bad kan phuh da ka jinglaitluid bad ka jingbishar hok . Nga , U Trai , ngan pynphong ïa kane ban jia .
translation.en: Drop down , ye heavens , from above , and let the skies pour down righteousness : let the earth open , and let them bring forth salvation , and let righteousness spring up together  ; I the  Lord  have created it .

translation.kha: Bakhraw la pyndonkam pun siew ïa ki nongtrei bad ba-bang thied ïa ki tyrwa ha kaba shna pynbha .
translation.en: But they gave that to the workmen , and repaired therewith the house of the  Lord .
Yet I will distress Ariel , and there shall be heaviness and sorrow : and it shall be unto me as Ariel .
translation.kha: bad nangta U Blei un wallam ka jingjot ïa ka nongbah ïa kaba la khot  ka duwan U Blei .  Kan don ka jingïam bad ka jingïambriew , bad ka nongbah baroh kawei kan long kum ka duwan ba la tap da ka snam .

translation.en: If those ordinances depart from before me , saith the  Lord  , then the seed of Israel also shall cease from being a nation before me for ever .

translation.en: And shall come forth  ; they that have done good , unto the resurrection of life  ; and they that have done evil , unto the resurrection of damnation .
translation.kha: Wat sngewlyngngoh ha kane ; ba ka por kan wan haba baroh kiba ïap kin ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u bad kin mihnoh na ki jingtep jong ki : Kito kiba la leh ïa kaba bha kin mihpat bad kin im , bad kito kiba la leh ïa kaba sniew kin mihpat bad yn pynrem ïa ki .

Phim tip seh ïa ka jaka , ko Kaba bhabriew tam napdeng ki kynïan ? Khie leit badno bud ïa ka kynhied langbrot ; to wad ïa ki pyntha phlang na ka bynta ki blang jongnga phi hajan ki ïingjaiñ jongno ki napdeng langbrot .
translation.en: The voice of my beloved ! behold , he cometh leaping upon the mountains , skipping upon the hills .

translation.kha: Ym don kaba kren lamler ha ka ïingbishar u ban ïohlait na ka Jingpynshitom ; u la shah pynrem .
translation.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished , and he that speaketh lies shall perish .

translation.kha: U Jehoïakim u la ïap bad u Jehoïakhin u khum jong u , u la long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers : and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: To ngin ingiew ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingai jong u ka bym lah ban pynshongdor !
translation.en: Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift .

I beheld till the thrones were cast down , and the Ancient of days did sit , whose garment was white as snow , and the hair of his head like the pure wool : his throne was like the fiery flame , and his wheels as burning fire .

Ma nga hi nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei ! “Nga shet sngewkwah bad Kito babha sngewthait bad kiba kob-pia , Kiba sheptieng ïa nga bun kiba jongu ïa nga .
translation.en: For all those things hath mine hand made , and all those things have been , saith the  Lord  : but to this man will I look , even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit , and trembleth at my word .

translation.kha: Ki Kam u Jisu ki kynthup ïa ka ban hikai , ban leh ïa ki kambah , wat haduh ban aiti noh ïa la ka jingim na ka pyntwa jong i

translation.en: And straightway coming up out of the water , he saw the heavens opened , and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him :
