translation.en: And on the fourth day ten bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish :

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki briew kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa phi ban sheptieng ïa nga ; ngan pynkulmar thliem ïa kito kiba phi ïaleh pyrshah , pynlang ngan pynher krad ïa ki nongshun jong Phi .
translation.en: I will send my fear before thee , and will destroy all the people to whom thou shalt come , and I will make all thine enemies turn their backs unto thee .

Go and get thee in unto king David , and say unto him , Didst not thou , my lord , O king , swear unto thine handmaid , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne ? why then doth Adonijah reign ?
translation.kha: leit mar mar sha u Syiem Dabid bad pan na u , ‘ Syiem Kynrad , hato phim shym la kular kyntang ïa nga ba u Solomon , u khun jong nga un long syiem hadien jong phi ? Kumno te ka lah ban long ba u Adonijah u la long syiem ?’
U Abraham u la ïaishah snam , bad kumta u la ïohpdiang ïa kaei kob U Bela u la kular .
translation.en: And so , after he had patiently endured , he obtained the promise .

translation.kha: U Dabid u nang ïai bteng la ka lynti jong u lem sad saphred ngut ki rangbah ; me arspah ngut kiwei pat , namar ba ki la tait eh , kdor lah shuh ban jam sha arliang ka wahduid , bad ki sah noh shaiñ .
translation.en: But David pursued , he and four hundred men : for two hundred abode behind , which were so faint that they could not go over the brook Besor .

translation.kha: Hato ngin ong te , ba ka Hukum hi ka long Kaba pop! ? Ym kumta kheiñ ! Hynrei ka la long ka Hukum ka pynlong ïa ngi ban tip kaei ka pop . Lada ka Hukum kam shym la ong , wai kwah ïa katai kaba dei jong uwei pat , ngan ym jin da la tip ïa kum kata ka jingkwah .
translation.en: What shall we say then ? Is the law sin ? God forbid . Nay , I had not known sin , but by the law : for I had not known lust , except the law had said , Thou shalt not covet .
Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts , and bring the description hither to me , that I may cast lots for you here before the  Lord  our God .
translation.kha: To thoh ka jingbatai shaphang kine ki hynñiew bynta bad wallam ïa ka sha nga . Nangta ngan kynting sbai ban ïakren bad U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi na ka bynta jong phi .
Kan long kum ka jingpynjot , ka ryndang bashyrkhei , ka ba-bang bam duh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga dat .
translation.en: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction , and would root out all mine increase .

translation.kha: Khie leit noh kumne hi sha u Laban u hynñiew jongnga la ha Haran , bad sah Bad u shipor , tad haduh ba ka jingbitar u hynmen jong me Kan pjiah , bad ba u klet noh ïa kata kaba me la leh ïa u .
translation.en: And tarry with him a few days , until thy brother s fury turn away  ;
He hath hedged me about , that I cannot get out : he hath made my chain heavy .
translation.kha: U la khum ïa nga ha ki kynjri ; nga long u koidi u bym don kano kano ka jingkyrmen ban lait phet .
Mem khim la sngewbha ïa ki ñiad kumin ka jingainguh thang halor ka duwan lane ïa ki jingkñia ban shim noh ïa ki pop .
translation.en: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure .

And yet they would not hearken unto their judges , but they went a whoring after other gods , and bowed themselves unto them : they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in , obeying the commandments of the  Lord   ; but they did not so .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel kim shym shahshkor ïa la ki nongïalam . Ki Israel kim shym la ïaineh ha U  Trai  bad ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Ki kpa jong ki , ki la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong U  Trai  , hynrei kane ka pateng bathymmai shen ka la sangeh ban leh kumta .
Nga la pynphong jaiñ ïa phasi ha ki jaiñ jynsur kiba la mluh syntiew bad nga la ai ha phasi ki juti na ki snieh kiba bha tam , ka jingteh khlieh linen bad ka tapmoh rusom .
translation.en: I clothed thee also with broidered work , and shod thee with badgers  skin , and I girded thee about with fine linen , and I covered thee with silk .

translation.kha: Ynda U Trai U Blang jngai phi u la pynjot ïa Us ki jaitbynriew bad u ai ha phin ïa ka ri jong ki , bad hadien ba phi la ïaknieh ïa ki shnong sad ki ïing jong ki bad ba phi la shong la sah hangta ,
translation.en: When the  Lord  thy God hath cut off the nations , whose land the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and thou succeedest them , and dwellest in their cities , and in their houses  ;

translation.kha: Don tieng kawei ka aiñ kaba ïadei lang ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop bad ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat : ka doh ka dei jong u lyngdoh uba pyndep ïa ka jingkñia .
translation.en: As the sin offering is , so is the trespass offering : there is one law for them : the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it .

For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days , saith the Lord  ; I will put my laws into their mind , and write them in their hearts : and I will be to them a God , and they shall be to me a people :
translation.kha: Mynta , kane ka long ka jutang ïa kaba ngan pynlong bad ki paid Israel ha ki sngi ki ban wan , ong U Trai : Ngan buh ïa ki hukum jong nga ha ki jingmut jong ki , bad ngan thoh ïa ki ha ki dohnud jong ki ; ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad ki kin long u paidlang jong nga .

translation.en: And the sons of Beriah  ; Heber , and Malchiel , who is the father of Birzavith .
translation.kha: U Beraïah u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang , u Heber bad u Malkhiel . ( U Malkhiel u seng ïa ka nongbah Birsaith . )

translation.en: Art thou bound unto a wife ? seek not to be loosed . Art thou loosed from a wife ? seek not a wife .
translation.kha: Hato phi don ka tnga ? Te wat pyrshang ban iehnoh ïa ka . Hato phim pat shongkurim ? Te wat ym wad tnga .
“Nga kyrpad ïa Phi , ki parabangeit jong na , ba phin long kum ma nga . La shuwa , nga long hi kumne ma phi . kino shym la leh sniew ei ei ïa ang .
translation.en: Brethren , I beseech you , be as I am ; for I am as ye are : ye have not injured me at all .

translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem Hapoh bad ong , Kane ka long kaei kaba U Troas u ong : ‘ Namar ba ki Syria ki ong ba nga long u blei jongki ki lum bad ym jong ki jaka madan , kun sa ai jingjop ïa Phi halor ka kynhun Shiphew bakhraw jong ki , bad ma pa bad ki briew lad phoi ken tip ba nga long U Trai .’
translation.en: And there came a man of God , and spake unto the king of Israel , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , Because the Syrians have said , The  Lord  is God of the hills , but he is not God of the valleys , therefore will I deliver all this great multitude into thine hand , and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
And it came to pass , afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court , that the word of the  Lord  came to him , saying ,
translation.kha: U Isaïah u leit noh na u syiem , hynrei ha shuwa ba un ïaid lyngba ïa ka phyllaw pdeng ka ïingbishar jong ka ïingsyiem , U  Trai  u ong ïa u

Phi ïoh hynriewspah sngem ban trei ïa la ka kam , hynrei kynmaw ba ka sner kaba hynñiew , ka Sabbaton , ka dei ka snieh shongthait . Ha kata ka sngi , wat trei ei ei . Ka Sabbaton ka long ka jyllang U Trai , ha ki ïing jongu phi baroh .
translation.en: Six days shall work be done : but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest , an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no work therein : it is the sabbath of the  Lord  in all your dwellings .

translation.kha: U la leh ïa kane Ban pynpaw ha ki para baroh ki ban sa wan ïa ka jingryngkhiang tam eh ka jingaiei jong u ha ka jingieit ïa kaba u la pyn-i sha ngi ha U Khreh Jisu .
translation.en: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus .
And God said , This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you , for perpetual generations :
translation.kha: Kum ka dak jong kata ka jutang baïaineh junom ïa kaba nga la pynlong bad phi lem bad ki jingthaw ba-im baroh , nga buh ïa ka ryntieh jong nga ha u lyoh .
Nangta u Hananaïah u la loit ïa ka lyngkor na u ryndang jong nga , u la pynkheiñ lynghoh ïa ka ,
translation.en: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from off the prophet Jeremiah s neck , and brake it .
Likewise also the chief priests mocking him , with the scribes and elders , said ,
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki tymmen ki san ki la rkhiebeiñ ïa u :

translation.en: And I have declared unto them thy name , and will declare it : that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them , and I in them .
translation.kha: Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha ki , bad ngan ïai leh kumta , khnang ba ka jingieit kaba me don ïa nga kan ïoh long bad ki , bad kumta nga ruh ngan ïoh long bad ki .

Baroh kiba nga la ïathuh lypa , mynta ki la ainong ; phi hap ban pdiang ba ki jingïathuh lypa jong per ki long Ibbah dei . Mynta ngan ong ïa phi ïa kiei keiñ kiba thymmai ki ban wan , ki jingjai kiba ngam shym la pynpyut mynshuwa .
translation.en: Thou hast heard , see all this  ; and will not ye declare it ? I have shewed thee new things from this time , even hidden things , and thou didst not know them .

translation.kha: Hato phi la long u mraw mynba U Blei u la khot ïa phi ? Kam phler , kdew pynkhuslai ei ei ; ishyrkhei lada phi ïoh ïa ka lad ban long uba laitluid , pyndonkam ïa ka .
translation.en: Art thou called being a servant ? care not for it : but if thou mayest be made free , use it rather .

translation.en: ( She is loud and stubborn  ; her feet abide not in her house :

translation.en: For as often as ye eat this bread , and drink this cup , ye do shew the Lord s death till he come .

translation.en: Yet a little while , and the world seeth me no more  ; but ye see me : because I live , ye shall live also .
Where are the gods of Hamath , and of Arpad ? where are the gods of Sepharvaim , Hena , and Ivah ? have they delivered Samaria out of mine hand ?

Neng la wan hiar napdeng ki dieng Elmadam ban ïohi ïa ki jingthain balung ha ka them , ban ïohi ïa ki sla bathymmai halor ki dieng sohwaiñ bad ki synreit halor ki diengsoh Pomkranet .
translation.en: Come , my beloved , let us go forth into the field  ; let us lodge in the villages .
And the servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master , and sware to him concerning that matter .

Ynda la ïap u Aaron , ïa ki jabieng lyngdoh jong u dei ban aiti ha ki khun shynrang jong u ba kin phong ha ka par ba pynkyntang ïa ki .
translation.en: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons  after him , to be anointed therein , and to be consecrated in them .

Nangno u syiem , u lyngskor , bad ka Berniki , bad barieh kiwei pat ki la ïeng joit ,
translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , the king rose up , and the governor , and Bernice , and they that sat with them :

translation.kha: Ha ka snam kaba laiphew khyndai ba u Asa u long symboh , u la dkoh na ka jingpah katjuh kaba ju ; wat la katta hati um shym la phai sha U Trai’ na ka bynta ka jingïarap , hynrei sha ki nongpynkhiah .
translation.en: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet , until his disease was exceeding great : yet in his disease he sought not to the  Lord  , but to the physicians .

translation.kha: ïa baroh ki briew’ bad ki mrad , ki sim bad ki dohkha . Teng wallam ka jingkyllon jong u bymman . Ngan pynstet ïa u bynriew baroh , bad yn ym pynsah ïa uno uno uba lait im . Ma nga , U thri nga la kren .
translation.en: I will consume man and beast  ; I will consume the fowls of the heaven , and the fishes of the sea , and the stumblingblocks with the wicked  ; and I will cut off man from off the land , saith the  Lord .
And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod s steward , and Susanna , and many others , which ministered unto him of their substance .
translation.kha: Ka Ïoanna , uba u Khusa u tnga jong ka u long u rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka ïingbishar jong u Herod ; bad ka Susanna , bad bun kiwei pat ki kynthei kiba la pyndonkam ïa la ki jong ki jingïoh ban ïarap ïa U Jisu bad ïa ki synran jong u .

translation.en: And David s heart smote him after that he had numbered the people . And David said unto the  Lord  , I have sinned greatly in that I have done : and now , I beseech thee , O  Lord  , take away the iniquity of thy servant  ; for I have done very foolishly .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ba u Dabid u la dep shim ïa ka jingkheiñbriew , ka jingïatiplem jong u ka la sdang ban pynshitom ïa u , bad u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Nga la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei ha kaba leh ïa kane ! Sngewbha map ïa nga . Nga la leh bieit .
U Trai u dap da ka jingisynei bad un ym kyntait ïa i'u junom .
translation.en: For the Lord will not cast off for ever :
Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy people Israel , and bring them again unto the land which thou gavest unto their fathers .
translation.kha: To map ïa ki pop jong ki briew jong me bad wan ïalam biang ïa ki sha kata ka ri ïa kaba me la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: And a stranger will they not follow , but will flee from him : for they know not the voice of strangers .
translation.kha: Kin ym bud ïa uwei pat ; pynban , kin phet ïap na uba kum uta u briew , namar kim sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u .
Dei ruh ma ki kiba la nguh ha u Pharaoh ban pyllait noh ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: These are they which spake to Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring out the children of Israel from Egypt : these are that Moses and Aaron .
But as an hired servant , and as a sojourner , he shall be with thee , and shall serve thee unto the year of jubilee :
translation.kha: U dei ban shong bad phi kum u nongtrei bad shakri ïa phi haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .

translation.en: Within two full years will I bring again into this place all the vessels of the  Lord s  house , that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took away from this place , and carried them to Babylon :
translation.kha: Hapoh ar snem ngan wallam pat sha kane ka jaka ïa baroh ki jingkynshew ka Templ kaba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la rah sha Babilonia .
Bad U blem u la ong , ‘ Namar kane ka rupa u briew un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie bad un ïashong ïasah sad la ka tnga , bun ma ki baroh ar ngut kin ïalong kawei .’
translation.en: And said , For this cause shall a man leave father and mother , and shall cleave to his wife : and they twain shall be one flesh ?

translation.kha: Kumta u Lot u jied ïa ka them Jordan baroh na ka bynta ïa lade bad u leit noh shaphang mihngi . Da kumta keiñ kine ar ngut ki la ïakhlad .
translation.en: Then Lot chose him all the plain of Jordan  ; and Lot journeyed east : and they separated themselves the one from the other .

translation.kha: U Trai u long u syiem . U kup da ka main longsyiem bad ka bor . Ïa ka pyrthei la pynslem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah ïa-ban pynkhiah ïa ka .
translation.en: The  Lord  reigneth , he is clothed with majesty  ; the  Lord  is clothed with strength , wherewith he hath girded himself : the world also is stablished , that it cannot be moved .

translation.kha: Ngi la jam ïa ka duriaw da kaba ïaid lait ïa ka Kilikia bad Pamphylia , pynlang ngi la nang sha Mura , ha Lukia .
translation.en: And when we had sailed over the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia , we came to Myra , a city of Lycia .

translation.kha: U la ieid ïa kaei kaban ka pyrthei ka ñiew pjah bad ibeiñ , pynlang ka pyrkhat ba kam long ei ei , khnang ban pynjot ïa kamai kaba ka pyrthei ka pyrkhat ba ka long kaba donkam .
translation.en: And base things of the world , and things which are despised , hath God chosen , yea , and things which are not , to bring to nought things that are :

translation.kha: U Benhesed u syiem ka Syria u la ïalumlang ïa ki shipai jong u baroh , bad ba la kyrshan da ki laiphew ar ngat kiwei! pait ki Nongsynshar lem bad ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom jong ki , u la tur pynlang kerkut ïa ka Samaria bad hiarthma ïa ka .
translation.en: And Ben–hadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together : and there were thirty and two kings with him , and horses , and chariots : and he went up and besieged Samaria , and warred against it .

translation.kha: U la pyllait im ïa Phin na ki nongshun jong phi bad u la wallam pat ïa Phi na ki ri nongwei , na mihngi bad sheng , na shatei bad shathie .
translation.en: And gathered them out of the lands , from the east , and from the west , from the north , and from the south .

translation.kha: U syiem u la ong , To ïaroh ïa U Blei jong u shawkad , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego ! U la phuh ïa u sangeh jong u bad pyllaitluid im ïa film ki rangbah kiba la shakri bad shaniah ha u . Kim shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga bad ki la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim ban ïa kaba dem ngon bad mane ïa uno uno u blei lait tang u jong ki hi .
translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar spake , and said , Blessed be the God of Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , who hath sent his angel , and delivered his servants that trusted in him , and have changed the king s word , and yielded their bodies , that they might not serve nor worship any god , except their own God .

translation.kha: U briew uba shem ïa nga u shem ïa ka jingim , bad U Trai un sngewbha ïa u .
translation.en: For whoso findeth me findeth life , and shall obtain favour of the  Lord .
For false Christs and false prophets shall rise , and shall shew signs and wonders , to seduce , if it were possible , even the elect .
translation.kha: Namar ki Messaïah balamler bad ki nongïathuhlypa balamler kin mih . Kin leh ïa ki kambah bad ki jingphylla khnang ban shukor wat ïa ki briew ba la jied jong U Blei , lada long kaba lah .
U Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah u wan phai khlem shah pynïap shata ka ïingjaiñ ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat the king of Judah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem .
And he returned to Judah , and said , I cannot find her  ; and also the men of the place said , that there was no harlot in this place .
translation.kha: Kumta u leit phai noh sha u Judah , bad u ong ,  Ngam shym lap satia ïa ka . Ki rangbah jong kata ka jaka ruh ki ong ba ym ju don nuti hangta .

Phin ïohsngew ïa ka jingriew ki turoi , ba la bud da ka jingput ïa ki tangmuri , ki jingtem ksai , ki marynthing , bad ki duna ; bad nangta sa baroh kiwei pat ki tiar put tiar tem kin ïasoh lang . Tang mar ïasdang ka jingput jingthmu , phi dei ban dem bun bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksing kaba u syiem Nebusaradan u la phah pynïeng .
translation.en: That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up :

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka pa , u nongïathuhlypa u rupa sha u syiem Ahab , bad u la ong , U Trai u ong , ‘ wai sheptieng ïa katai ka kynhied shipai kaba heh ! Ngan ai jingjop ïa me halor jong ka mynta ka sngi , bad men ïoh tip ba nga dei U Trai .’
translation.en: And , behold , there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Hast thou seen all this great multitude ? behold , I will deliver it into thine hand this day  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka kyrteng uta u Israel uba la shah pynïap lang bad kata ka kynthei Midian ka long u Simri u khup jong u Salu , u khlieh jong ka longïing kaba na ka jait Simeon .
translation.en: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain , even that was slain with the Midianite woman , was Zimri , the son of Salu , a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites .
The  Lord  standeth up to plead , and standeth to judge the people .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kloi ban kren ïa ka kam jong u , u long uba la kloi ban bishar ïa ki briew jong u .

U jop , A Tharai , U Blei Badonbor Baroh , nga la shakri ïa me borabor — tang ïa me hi . Hynrei ki paid Israel ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad me , ki la pynpra ïa ki duwan jong me malu pynpaw ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong me . Dei tang ma nga naba dang Hukum — bad ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ruh !
translation.en: And he said , I have been very zealous for the  Lord  God of hosts : for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant , thrown down thine altars , and slain thy prophets with the sword  ; and I , even I only , am left  ; and they seek my life , to take it away .

translation.kha: Eliada phi leh shisha kumba nga la lei , te ki khun ki khiew u Dabid kmen ïailong syiem . Gaal ma ki , lem bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki bad ki briew jong ki , kin ïai bteng banbeiñ ïaid lyngba ïa ki khyrdop Jong kano ka ïingsyiem ha ki kad ïalap bad halor ki kulai .
translation.en: For if ye do this thing indeed , then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David , riding in chariots and on horses , he , and his servants , and his people .
And I will give them one heart , and one way , that they may fear me for ever , for the good of them , and of their children after them :
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa kawei ka jingthmu ha ka jingim : ban burom ïa nga ha ki por baroh , na ka bynta ka jingbha jong ki hi bad ka jingbha jong ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .
Haba u ïabuaid u la ïohi ba ki ïasynran pasiaw para ma ki , u la sngewthuh ba u khunlung u la ïatip . Kumta u kylli ïa ki , Hato u khunlung u la ïap ? Ho-oid , u la ïap , ki la jubab .
translation.en: But when David saw that his servants whispered , David perceived that the child was dead : therefore David said unto his servants , Is the child dead ? And they said , He is dead .

translation.kha: Te U Jisu u la kyllan ïa ki , Hato phim sngewtlot ïa kane ka pyrshah ? Kumno , te phi! lah ngab sngewthuh ïa kiwei pat ki pharshi ?
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Know ye not this parable ? and how then will ye know all parables ?
And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren , Let me find grace in your eyes , and what ye shall say unto me I will give .
translation.kha: Nangta u Shekhem u ong ha u kpa jong ka Dinah bad ha ki hynmen shynrang jong ka ,  Sngewbha pdiang ïa kane ka jingkyrpad jong nga , bad kat kaba phi kwah ngan ai .

translation.en: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues , and talked with me , saying , Come hither , I will shew thee the bride , the Lamb s wife .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki hynñiew ngut ki angel uba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang kiba dap da ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam kiba khatduh u la wan sha nga bad u la ong ,  To wan , bad ngan pyn-i ha me ïa ka Nongleitkurim , ka tnga jong U Khunlangbrot .
ba ha kane ka snoh ngan bat ïa ka kliar kaba de la pynjrong ha pha ha ka kyr-ang jong U Trai , U Blei ki Isaia , ba u Solomon , u khun jong pha un long syep hadien jong nga .
translation.en: Even as I sware unto thee by the  Lord  God of Israel , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead  ; even so will I certainly do this day .
And the  Lord  appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud : and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle .
translation.kha: U Moses bad u Joshua ki la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ bad U  Trai  u wanpaw ha ki hangta ha u rishot lyoh uba ïeng ha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ .
U Elisha u jubab , To shakor ïa kaei kaba U Trai u ong ! Kum ha kane ka por lashai ka sngi phin lah ban sleit ha Seraïah lai kilo u kew uba bha kam lane hynriew kilo u barli tang shi sbai rupa .
translation.en: Then Elisha said , Hear ye the word of the  Lord   ; Thus saith the  Lord  , To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel , and two measures of barley for a shekel , in the gate of Samaria .
And as for the perfume which thou shalt make , ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof : it shall be unto thee holy for the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat pyndonkam ïa kajuh ka rukom khleh ban shna kum kane na ka bynta ïa lade . Ñiew ïa ka ba ka long kaba kyntang bad kaba la pynkyntang sha nga .
Shna kawei ka lieng na ka bynta ïa lade da u khait dieng uba bha ; shna ki kamra ha ka bad thoh ruh ïa ka da ka bsiang na shapoh bad shabar .
translation.en: Make thee an ark of gopher wood  ; rooms shalt thou make in the ark , and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch .
Then thou shalt say , They be thy servant Jacob s  ; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau : and , behold , also he is behind us .
translation.kha: Me dei ban jubab , ‘ Ki dei ki jong u Jakob u shakri jong phi . U phah ïa ki kum ka jingai sngewbha sha u kynrad jong u , u Iso . U Jakob hi u hadien jong ngi .’

translation.en: It is a night to be much observed unto the  Lord  for bringing them out from the land of Egypt : this is that night of the  Lord  to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations .
translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka miet ba U  Trai  u ap miet ban ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Ïa kane kajuh ka miet la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  pateng la pateng kum ka miet ha kaba ki Israel ki dei ban ap miet .

translation.en: Let their eyes be darkened , that they may not see , and bow down their back alway .
translation.kha: Ai ba ki khmat jong ki kin matlah khnang ba kin ym ïohi ; bad ai ba kin dem hapoh ki jingjynjar jong ki ha ki por baroh .
Nga la sheptieng ïa me namar ba me long u briew uba eh . Me shim ïa Kaei ka bym dei ka jong me bad ot ïa kaei kaba mem shym bet .’
translation.en: For I feared thee , because thou art an austere man : thou takest up that thou layedst not down , and reapest that thou didst not sow .

translation.kha: Namar kata , kohnguh ïa kaei kaba la lah hikai ïa phi , sumar ban leh ïa ki hukum dara ki aiñ baroh ïa kiba na la ai ha phi! mynta ka sngi .
translation.en: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments , and the statutes , and the judgments , which I command thee this day , to do them .

Now Naaman , captain of the host of the king of Syria , was a great man with his master , and honourable , because by him the  Lord  had given deliverance unto Syria : he was also a mighty man in valour , but he was a leper .
translation.kha: U Naaman , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Syria , u long u briew ïa uba la burom shikatdei eh bad ñiewkor shibun da u syiem Syria , namar lyngba u Naaman , U  Trai  u la ai ka jingjop ïa ki shipai Syria . U la long u shipai bakhraw , hynrei u don ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh .
Ai ki jingnguh sha U Trai , pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u ; Haduh ha ki jaitbynriew ïa kamai kaba u la bor .
translation.en: Give thanks unto the  Lord  , call upon his name , make known his deeds among the people .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Baroh ki kam snem Jong ki , ki la sdang ha Gilgal . Ka la longïing hangta ba nga sdang ban isih ïa ki . Bad namar ka jingsniew ba ki la kun , ngan beh noh ïa ki na ka ri jong nga . Ngan ym ieit shuh ïa ki ; baroh ki jingïalam jong ki , ki la ïakhleh pyrshah ïa la .
translation.en: All their wickedness is in Gilgal : for there I hated them : for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house , I will love them no more : all their princes are revolters .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la pynleit jingmut bha ïa kaei kaba u Philip u la ong , haba ki la shukor ïa u pynlang ïohi ïa ki kambah kiba u la har .
translation.en: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake , hearing and seeing the miracles which he did .

translation.kha: wiat hajan la pynshitom , ym smam la pynïap ; kad haba la pynsngewsih , i un-long borabor kiba kmen ; ngi paw kum bakha duk , hynrei ngi pynriewspah ïa ki bri kiba bun ; ngi thop kum ki bym don ei ei , pynbam ngi don lut ïa kiei Kiei baroh .
translation.en: As sorrowful , yet alway rejoicing ; as poor , yet making many rich ; as having nothing , and yet possessing all things .

translation.kha: U Paidbah bajlan u la bud ïa u , namar ba ki la Ïohi ïa ki kambah jong u ha kaba pynkhiah ïa Kito kiba pang .
translation.en: And a great multitude followed him , because they saw his miracles which he did on them that were diseased .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki nongaplangbrot jong nga ki hap ban bam ïa u phlang ba phiah la kurim bad dih ïa ka um kaba phi! pynjngut .
translation.en: And as for my flock , they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet  ; and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet .
Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt  ; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies  ; but provoked him at the sea , even at the Red sea .
translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ha Ijipt kim shym la sngewthuh ïa ki kam baphylla jong U Blei ; ki la klet ba bunsien u la pyn-i ha ki ïa ka jingieit jong u , bad ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Badonbor Baroh ha ka Duriaw Basaw .

Ha ka sngi nyngkong jong ka taïew ngi la ïalumlang na ka bynta ka jingïabam miet . U Paul u la kren ha ki paidbah pynlang u la ïai kren haw shiteng synñia , nongmareh ba un sa mihnoh ha ka sneng kaba bur .
translation.en: And upon the first day of the week , when the disciples came together to break bread , Paul preached unto them , ready to depart on the morrow  ; and continued his speech until midnight .

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Ahab u syiem Jeriel , ka ri Moab ka la ïalap pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: Then Moab rebelled against Israel after the death of Ahab .

translation.kha: Ka jingieit jong phin ka pynkmen ïa nga , ko ba-ïaitrei thep mynsiem nabar ko nongleitkurim jong nga . Ka jingieit jong phi ka kham bha ban ïa ka waiñ ; ka jingpynsleh jongno phi ka kham iwbih pun ïa uno du u musla .
translation.en: My beloved is white and ruddy , the chiefest among ten thousand .

translation.kha: Ha ka jinglalot Jong ki , kine ki nonghikai balamler kin kamai da kaba ïathuh ïa phi ïa ki jingïathuhkhana ba Shua thaw . La kham slem mynta U Nongbishar jong ki u la erlangthari uba la khlaw , bun u Nongpynjot lad ki u la long u ngi ju iathuh !
translation.en: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you : whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not , and their damnation slumbereth not .
And she conceived , and bare a son  ; and he called his name Er .
translation.kha: U la shongkurim ïa ka , bad ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u , ïa uba u la khot kyrteng u Er .
Ym don mano mano hapoh ka kynhun kiba don ka jingdonkam . Kito kiba long trai ïa ki lyngkha , ki wallam ïa ka pisa ba la ïohpdiang na ka jingdie ,
translation.en: Neither was there any among them that lacked : for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them , and brought the prices of the things that were sold ,

translation.kha: Sah ha kata kaweh ka ïing , bim bad dih ïa nangno kano kaba ki ai ïa pa , naba u nongrwai u dei ban ïoh ïa ka bainong jong u . Wat leit sawdong na Kaei ka ïng sha kawei pat .
translation.en: And in the same house remain , eating and drinking such things as they give : for the labourer is worthy of his hire . Go not from house to house .

translation.kha: Katto katne na u symbai u la hap hapdeng ki pynïabiang shiah , kiba mih bad kiba la kjap noh ïa ki jingtngen , bad Kim Shim la pynmareh kew ei ei .
translation.en: And some fell among thorns , and the thorns grew up , and choked it , and it yielded no fruit .

translation.kha: Ka thar ka pyrta jam , To pynkhreh ha ka ri khlaw ïa ka lynti na ka bynta U Trai ! To pynkhuid ïa ka lyngki ha ka ri shyiap na ka bynta U Blei jong ngi !
translation.en: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness , Prepare ye the way of the  Lord  , make straight in the desert a highway for our God .
The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself , or torn , whether it be fowl or beast .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka sim ne mrad kaba la ïap hi lane kaba la shah pynïap ha uwei pat u mrad .

Da shisha , ko parabangeit jong nga , nga shisha ngam pyrkhat ba nga la jop lym ïa ka ; ïa kane kawei nga leh , la kumno kumno , da kob kliar noh ïa kaei kaei kaba hadien jong nga bad nga ïaleh smat ban pah sha kaei naba shiah khmat .
translation.en: Brethren , I count not myself to have apprehended : but this one thing I do , forgetting those things which are behind , and reaching forth unto those things which are before ,
And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles  hands the Holy Ghost was given , he offered them money ,
translation.kha: U Simon u la ïohi ba la ai ïa U Mynsiem ha ki bangeit haba ki apostol ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki . Kumta u la tyrwa pisa ha u Petros bad u Ïoannis ,

translation.en: A wise man feareth , and departeth from evil : but the fool rageth , and is confident .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sngewthuh ki husiar ban kiar na kaba sniew , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop kim suidñiew bad ki tur ruma kat shaba lap .

translation.en: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him : for he had said , I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers . And he laid him down upon his bed , and turned away his face , and would eat no bread .
translation.kha: U Ahab u leit phai sha la ïing , u da sngewsih bad bitar ïa kaei kaba u Naboth u ong ha u . U dem ha la ka jingthiah , u phai shaphang ka kynroh , bad um treh bam ei ei .
Ki don bad ki ïa ki khun shynrang jong ki , u Amasaïah bad u Jonathan , bad phi lah ban Pha ïa ki shad nga lem bad ki jingtip baroh kiba ph la ïoh .
translation.en: Behold , they have there with them their two sons , Ahimaaz Zadok s son , and Jonathan Abiathar s son  ; and by them ye shall send unto me every thing that ye can hear .

translation.kha: Ngi kwah ba pher tip ba ym don uno uno uba la ïalam da U Mynsiem U Blei u ha ban ong Long ba la tim ïa U Jisu! bad ym don uno uno uba lah ban phla U Jisu u long U Trai , lymda la ïalam ïa u da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: Wherefore I give you to understand , that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed : and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord , but by the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: bad ka bor jong u kan pynjop ïa me da ka jingtriem .
translation.en: Shall not his excellency make you afraid ? and his dread fall upon you ?
For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day , he shall be cut off from among his people .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba bam ei ei ha kata ka sngi yn ñiew uba la shah tait na ki briew U Blei .

translation.en: When it goeth well with the righteous , the city rejoiceth : and when the wicked perish , there is shouting .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah ka kmen haba ki briew kiba hok ki manbha , bad ka don ki jingrisa sngewbha haba u bymman u ïap .
Ngin sngewlyngngoh ïa phi ! tdong katto katne para phi la iehnoh ïa uta uba la khoit ïa phi da ka jingaiei U Khrist , bad ba phi la pdiang ïa kawei pat ka Gospel .
translation.en: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel :

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Moab , u Balak u khun lad u Sippor , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phin . U la phah keiñ ïa u Balaam u khun jong u Ber bad u la ong ïa u ïa-ban pahuh ka jingtim halor jong phi .
translation.en: Then Balak the son of Zippor , king of Moab , arose and warred against Israel , and sent and called Balaam the son of Beor to curse you :
What shall I say ? he hath both spoken unto me , and himself hath done it : I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul .
translation.kha: Kaei nga lah ban ong ? U  Trai  u la leh ïa kane . Ka dohnud jong nga ka kthang , bad ngam shym lah ïohthiah .

translation.en: And the priest shall come again the seventh day , and shall look : and , behold , if the plague be spread in the walls of the house  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , un leit biang bad khmih bha ïa kata ka jingbthuh .
wah la ki paidbah ki ïai bneng ban ai jingweng ryngkat ha kiwei ki jaka mane , ki ainguh ïa ki tieng sha U Trai’ .
translation.en: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places , yet unto the  Lord  their God only .

translation.kha: Sumar bha ïa u dieng Dumbur bad Phin ïor ïa ki soh ban bam . U shakri uba sumar bha ïa la u kynrad un ïoh burom .
translation.en: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof : so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured .

Moreover , because I have set my affection to the house of my God , I have of mine own proper good , of gold and silver , which I have given to the house of my God , over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house ,
translation.kha: Nalor kane baroh kaba nga la pynbiang , nga la ai ruh ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar na ka jingdon jingem jong nga namar ka jingieit jong nga ïa ka Templ jong U Blei .

translation.en: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat : for this is for your health : for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , te , to bam khyndiat ka jingbam ; phi donkam ïa ka khnang ban im . Wat iwei i shñiuh na ka khlieh jong phi in ym hap noh .

Kumta u syiemsad Sedekaïah u la kular ïa nga ha katba rieh , Nga smai da U Blei umbah im , U Blei uba ai jingïam ïa ngi , ba ngan ym pynïap ïa phi lane ai noh ïa phi sha ki briew kiba kwah ba pynïap ïa phi .
translation.en: So Zedekiah the king sware secretly unto Jeremiah , saying , As the  Lord  liveth , that made us this soul , I will not put thee to death , neither will I give thee into the hand of these men that seek thy life .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la khie ïa u . Nga mon , u la jubab . To men long khuid ! Shisyndon la pynkhiah ïa u briew na ka jingpang jong u .
translation.en: And Jesus put forth his hand , and touched him , saying ,  I will  ; be thou clean .  And immediately his leprosy was cleansed .

translation.kha: U Manasseh u la don khriat snem ka rta mynba u la long u shym ka Judah , bun u synshar ha Jerusalem sanphew san snam .
translation.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign , and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem :
Who is like unto thee , O  Lord  , among the gods ? who is like thee , glorious in holiness , fearful in praises , doing wonders ?
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , uei uba kat ma me hapdeng ki blei ? Uei keiñ uba kum ma me , uba phylla ha ka jinglongkhuid ? Uei uba lah ban leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kum ma me ?

translation.en: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air  ; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven , from the throne , saying , It is done .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynñiew u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha suiñ . Ka sur kaba jam ka la wan na ka khet kaba ha ka templ , ka da ong ,  La pyndep !
Hynrei dei U mynsiem jong U Blei Badonbor Baroh uba wan sha ki briew bad uba ai ha ki ka jingstad .
translation.en: But there is a spirit in man : and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding .

translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat jong ki ha ka jingpyrshah ïa ki bad ki la leit noh sha Ikoniom .
translation.en: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them , and came unto Iconium .

translation.kha: Anna wan shane , phi ki briew Kiba duna ka jingsngew ! Ha u bynriew uba bieit ka ong ,
translation.en: Whoso is simple , let him turn in hither : and as for him that wanteth understanding , she saith to him ,

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong , Ngan pyndonkam ïa u Nebukhadnessar u shym ka bniah ban pyndkut khong ïa ka shispah jrong ka Ijipt .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also make the multitude of Egypt to cease by the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon .

translation.kha: U jongu u la jubab , A katno ki bymmyntoi malade kaba bakla phi ki briew phi long ! Sa katno nga dei ban dang don bad ph ? Sa katne ngan dang ïashoh ïa phi ? To wallam ïa u khana shaneng sha at !
translation.en: Then Jesus answered and said ,  O faithless and perverse generation , how long shall I be with you ? how long shall I suffer you ? bring him hither to me .
For we are labourers together with God : ye are God s husbandry , ye are Gods building .
translation.kha: Naba ngi long ki nongïatrei lem bad U Blei , phi long ka lyngkha jong U Blei , phi long ruh ka jingtei jong U Blei .

translation.en: And Saul s uncle said , Tell me , I pray thee , what Samuel said unto you .
translation.kha: Bad kaei u ïathuh ïa phi ?  u kñi u Saul u kylli .
Ka long ka bymlehraiñ iaka .
translation.en: That's impossible for me .

translation.kha: U Hebron , u khun uba lai lad u Kohath , u ni saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jeraïah , u Amaraïah , u Jehasiel , bad u Jekameam .
translation.en: Of the sons of Hebron  ; Jeriah the first , Amariah the second , Jahaziel the third , and Jekameam the fourth .

translation.kha: len sngewbha eh ha ki aiñ jongnga me ; ïa ki Hukum jong me ngan ym kliar .
translation.en: I will delight myself in thy statutes : I will not forget thy word .

translation.kha: Kheiñ hynñiew taïew naduh kata ka sngi kaba bud ïa ka Sabbaton ha kaba phi wanlam ïa ka song kew ba-bang ainguh sha U Trai .
translation.en: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath , from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering  ; seven sabbaths shall be complete :
Hearken unto thy father that begat thee , and despise not thy mother when she is old .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa la u kpa ; khlem ma u phin ym ïoh jingim . Haba ka kmie ka la tymmen , pyn-i ha ka ïa ka jingïaroh jong phi .
U Hesekaïah u la ïap , bad u khun jong u , u Manasseh u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers : and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: hynriew mynta ngan leit nala sha uta Uba la phah ïa nga , pynban ym don aiwai ruh na phi uba kylli ïa nga shaei ba ngan leit .
translation.en: But now I go my way to him that sent me  ; and none of you asketh me , Whither goest thou ?

translation.kha: shu ba u Jakob un ïaphah , u khot ïa u Joseph u khun jong u , bad u ong ha u , Buh ïa la ka kti hapdeng ki lymbung jongngi de , bad kular da shisha ba phin ym tep ïa nga ha Ijipt .
translation.en: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die : and he called his son Joseph , and said unto him , If now I have found grace in thy sight , put , I pray thee , thy hand under my thigh , and deal kindly and truly with me  ; bury me not , I pray thee , in Egypt :
Behold , to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail , such as hath not been in Egypt since the foundation thereof even until now .
translation.kha: Lashai hamar kane ka por , ngan pynhap da u phria uba jur , uba kat uta ka ri Ijipt kam pat ju tip mynno mynno ha ka histori jong ka .
I ñiah ïa ngi kum ki nongwei . I la die ïa ngi , bad mynba i la pynpait ïa ka phlait baroh kaba long ka dor jong ngi .
translation.en: Are we not counted of him strangers ? for he hath sold us , and hath quite devoured also our money .
Drought and heat consume the snow waters : so doth the grave those which have sinned .
translation.kha: Kumba ka ïor ka jah noh ha ka jingshit bad ka jingryngkhiang , kumjuh ruh u nongpop u jah noh na ka ri jong kiba im .

U Trai u Ong ha u Aaron , Ma me , ki khunlung shynrang jong me , bad ki Lebi ruh , phin hap shah ïa kiei kiei kiba miaw na kano kano ka jingleh palat ha ka jingshakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga , hynrei tang ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me kin shiah ïa kiei kiba mian ha ka jinglehkai ha ka jinglong lyngdoh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Aaron , Thou and thy sons and thy father s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary : and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood .

translation.kha: Lada uwei na ki briew Jong nga ne u nongïathuhlypa ne u lyngdoh kdew la u pyndonkam ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingkit U Trai ,’ ngan pynsamthiah ïa u mala ïa ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: And as for the prophet , and the priest , and the people , that shall say , The burden of the  Lord  , I will even punish that man and his house .

translation.kha: Ki nang ïai bor pop! shuh shuh da kaba saiñ ïa ki duriaw ban mane — ki thliew kaba da ka daw , kiba la sdien da ka jingpyrkhat briew , ba la shna da ki kti briew . Bad nangta ki ong , Ai ki jingkñia sha ki ! Kumno ki briew kin doh ïa iar ki bleithaw — ki bleithaw ha ka dur ki masi kyrtong !
translation.en: And now they sin more and more , and have made them molten images of their silver , and idols according to their own understanding , all of it the work of the craftsmen : they say of them , Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves .
The  Lord  your God which goeth before you , he shall fight for you , according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïalam ïa phi , bad un ïaleh na ka bynta jong phi , kumba phi la ïohi ïa u ba u leh ha Ijipt
Kumta u Dabid um shym leit rah shuh ïa ka shaei Jerusalem . Pynban , u ieh ïa ka ha ka ïing jong u briew uba kyrteng u Obed Eden , u traishnong ka nongbah Gath .
translation.en: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David , but carried it aside into the house of Obed–edom the Gittite .
And the soldiers likewise demanded of him , saying , And what shall we do ? And he said unto them , Do violence to no man , neither accuse any falsely  ; and be content with your wages .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki shipai ruh ki la kylli ïa u ,  Kumno ma ngi pat ? Kaei ba ngi dei ban leh ?  U la ong ha ki ,  Wat shim pisa nano nano da ka bor lane mudui lamler ïano ïano . To sngewhun ha la ka bainong .
Kumta ki Israel ki mih ha ka step kaba bud bad ki sher dara shajan ka nongbah Gibeah .
translation.en: And the children of Israel rose up in the morning , and encamped against Gibeah .

translation.kha: U Ujuh u la ïalumlang sharud ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran bad u la ong ha ki , Ha sngap ! Ngi ïarieh sha Jerusalem ha kaba ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la theh shaphang U te U Beeroth kan urlong shisha .
translation.en: Then he took unto him the twelve , and said unto them ,  Behold , we go up to Jerusalem , and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished .
But when ye sin so against the brethren , and wound their weak conscience , ye sin against Christ .
translation.kha: Bad ha kane ka rukom phin leh pop pyrshah ïa U Khrist keiñ da kaba leh pop pyrshah ïa la ki parabangeit bad pynmong ïa ka jingïatiplem batlot jong ki .
Ki dala ka Judah ki pynïap kylla ïa ki nongpynïap ïa u Amon bad ki pynlong syiem ïa u Josaïah u khum jong u .
translation.en: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon  ; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead .
For John said unto him , It is not lawful for thee to have her .
translation.kha: Naba katto katne por u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la ong ïa u Herod ,  Ka long ka bym dei ïa me ban shongkurim ïa ka Herodias !
Thoh ïa ki ha ki shawkad ki ïing jong phi bad ha ki khyrdop Jong phi .
translation.en: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house , and upon thy gates :

translation.kha: Ki la long Kum ki kulai ba la bta bha , ki bym haw syiar ha ki jingkwah , uwei pa uwei u da kwah brai ïa ka tnga jongngi u paramarjan jong u .
translation.en: They were as fed horses in the morning : every one neighed after his neighbour s wife .

From thence they removed , and pitched on the other side of Arnon , which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites : for Arnon is the border of Moab , between Moab and the Amorites .
translation.kha: Nangta pat ki la mihnoh bad sher dara ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Wah Arnon , ha ka ri khlaw kaba ïar shaduh ki khappud ka ri Amor . ( Ka wah Arnon ka la long ka pud hapdeng ka ri Moab bad ki Amor . )

translation.en: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily . Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh , shall he find faith on the earth ?
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi , un bishar ha ka liang jong ki bad un leh kloi ïa ka . Hynrei hato U Khun U Briew un shem mo ïa ka jingngeit ha ka pyrthei haba u wan ?

U Trai u la kular ha u Dabid ba un shim noh ïa ka hima na u Shaul bad ki khun ki ksiew Jong u , bad un thung ïa u dabi khem u syiemsad jong ki Israel bad ki Judah , naduh na kawei ka tduh sha kawei pat ka tduh jong ka ri . Mynta to U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga Ladan ngam pynurlong shispah ïa kane !
translation.en: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul , and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah , from Dan even to Beer–sheba .

translation.kha: U Trai u don ïa uto Uba khlaiñ bad badonbor naba la kli ïa-ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , uta u ban waiñ kum u phylliah bakhor , khim u Lehab , kumta ka jingshlei um bakyllut , bad kun thup lup ïa ka ri .
translation.en: Behold , the Lord hath a mighty and strong one , which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm , as a flood of mighty waters overflowing , shall cast down to the earth with the hand .
Then the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kren biang ha nga u la ong ,
Phin shem ïa kum kita ki paralok hapdeng ki nongsaiñ U Jehobah .
translation.en: You will find such friends among Jehovah’s Witnesses .
And to knowledge temperance  ; and to temperance patience  ; and to patience godliness  ;
translation.kha: ha ka jingtip jong phi pynlang ïa ka jingsynshar ïa lade ; ha ka jingsynshar ïa lade pynlang ïa ka jingïaishah ; ha ka jingïaishah pynlang ïa ka jinglong riewblei ;
Ka por kun poi haba U Trai un pynshitom ïa ki bor ba-ïapher bad ïa ki nongshukor ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high , and the kings of the earth upon the earth .
And Jacob went on his way , and the angels of God met him .
translation.kha: Katba u Jakob u nang leit ha la ka lynti , katto katne ngut ki angel ki la wan ïashem ïa u .
U Barukh u khun jongngi u nierbah u la pynkhih ïa phi pyrshah ïa ngi , kumta ki nong Babilonia kin ïa-ïohbor hajar jong ngi bad ki lah ban pynïap ïa ngi ne ïalam noh ïa ngi sha Babilonia .
translation.en: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us , for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans , that they might put us to death , and carry us away captives into Babylon .
Such is the way of an adulterous woman  ; she eateth , and wipeth her mouth , and saith , I have done no wickedness .
translation.kha: Ka tnga ka bymïaineh ka leh kumne : ka klim , ka sum , bad ka ong ,  Hynrei ngam shym leh ei ei ka bymdei !
Nga ïar ïa me , A Trai ; to hikai ïa nga ïa ki lynti jongno me .
translation.en: Blessed art thou , O  Lord  : teach me thy statutes .

translation.kha: U ju khie dang step phyrngab bad u ju leit ïeng harud lynti ha ka khyrdop shnong . Haba uno uno u briew u wan hangta bad ka jingïakajia kaba u kwah ïa u syiem ban pynbeit , u Absalom u ju khot ïa u , Bad kylli ïa u , u dei uba nangno . Bad hadien ba u briew u la ïathuh ïa u na kano ka jait u dei ,
translation.en: And Absalom rose up early , and stood beside the way of the gate : and it was so , that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment , then Absalom called unto him , and said , Of what city art thou ? And he said , Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka jingdum kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba khlaw . Ha re kiba im ha ka ri ba-dum jong ka jingïap ka jingshai kan tyngshaiñ .
translation.en: The people which sat in darkness saw great light  ; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up .
If iniquity be in thine hand , put it far away , and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles .
translation.kha: Iehnoh ïa kaba sniew bad ka bymdei na ka ïing jong me .
Lada phi leh kumta , ïa ki thiar jong phi yn pyndap da u kew , bad pien ïoh ruh Shion bha ka waiñ haduh ba phim eh shuh ban pynlang ïa ka .
translation.en: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty , and thy presses shall burst out with new wine .

translation.kha: Ka khubor shaphang kane ka la poi ha ka Balang ha Jerusalem , kumta ki la pham ïa u Barnabas sha Antiokh .
translation.en: Then tidings of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem : and they sent forth Barnabas , that he should go as far as Antioch .

translation.kha: Kumno kan erlangthari lada U Mynsiem jrong U Trai u rah noh ïa phi shad ka jaka bymtip tang meng ïamih ma nga ? nongthaw , haba ngan ïathuh ïa u Ahab ba Phin don hangne , bad um lah ban shem ïa phi , un sa pyndap ïa ar . To kynmaw ba ar long uba mane hok ïa U Trai naduh ba nga dang khynnah .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , as soon as I am gone from thee , that the Spirit of the  Lord  shall carry thee whither I know not  ; and so when I come and tell Ahab , and he cannot find thee , he shall slay me : but I thy servant fear the  Lord  from my youth .
But he , knowing their thoughts , said unto them ,  Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation  ; and a house divided against a house falleth .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki la pyrkhat , kumta u la ong ha ki ,  Kano kano ka ri kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan ym neh slem ; ka longïing kaba ïa-pait pyrshah ïa lade kan kyllon la ka jong ka jong .

translation.en: Then certain of the scribes answering said , Master , thou hast well said .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ong ,  Ka jubab kaba dei , ko Nonghikai !
Na u patsha Artakserksis ha u Esra , u lyngdoh , riewstad ka Hukum jong U Blei ka Bneng .
translation.en: Artaxerxes , king of kings , unto Ezra the priest , a scribe of the law of the God of heaven , perfect peace , and at such a time .

translation.kha: U Thomas u la ainong ha u , Ko Kynrad , ngim Tip shano ba bathoiñ leit ; te kumno ïeng tip ïa ka lynti ban poi hangta ?
translation.en: Thomas saith unto him , Lord , we know not whither thou goest  ; and how can we know the way ?
Behold ye among the heathen , and regard , and wonder marvellously : for I will work a work in your days , which ye will not believe , though it be told you .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha la ki briew ,  To khmih thuh ïa ki jaitbynriew sawdong jong phi , bad phin lyngngoh ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi . Ngan leh ei ei kaba phin ym lah ngeit haba phi ïohsngew shaphang jong ka .

translation.en: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the  Lord  out of all nations upon horses , and in chariots , and in litters , and upon mules , and upon swift beasts , to my holy mountain Jerusalem , saith the  Lord  , as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kin wallam pat ïa baroh ki para kur ki para jait jong phi na ki jaitbynriew baroh kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa nga . Kin wallam ïa ki sha u lum bakyntang jong nga ha Jerusalem ha ki kulai , ki khashor bad ha ki ut , bad ha ki kali ïapom bad ki kali kit jingkit , kumba ki Israel ki wanrah ïa ki jingainguh bam sha ka Templ ha ki khiew lehniam kiba khuid .
Ha ka sngi ka bud u Moses u ong ha ki paidbah , Phi la leh ïa ka pop kabu shyrkhei eh . Mynta ngan kitei kiew biang sha U Trai ; lehse nga lah ban pynïoh ïa ka jingap ïa ka pop jongki phi .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses said unto the people , Ye have sinned a great sin : and now I will go up unto the  Lord   ; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin .

translation.kha: U Tlai u noh ha u Samuel ,
translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto Samuel , saying ,
And the sons of Eliezer were , Rehabiah the chief . And Eliezer had none other sons  ; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many .
translation.kha: U Elieser u don tang uwei u khun , u Rehabaïah , hynrei u Rehabaïah u don shibun ki khun ki ksiew .

U Trai u ong ha ka , Ar tylli ki jaitbynriew ki don hapoh jongngi pha ; Phan sa khap ar jat ki briew kiba ïaleh pyrshah to ma ki . Kawei kan kham khlaiñbor ban ïa Kawei pat , Kaba ha shuwa kan shakri ïa kaba hadien .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto her , Two nations are in thy womb , and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels  ; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people  ; and the elder shall serve the younger .
The man departed , and told the Jews that it was Jesus , which had made him whole .
translation.kha: Te uta u briew u la leit noh bad u la ïathuh ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ba dei U Jisu uba la pynkhiah ïa u .
Mynta , A Trai U Blei jong I , to pyllait ïa ngi na ki Assyria , khring ba baroh ki hima ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang ma me hi , U Trai , me long U Blei .
translation.en: Now therefore , O  Lord  our God , I beseech thee , save thou us out of his hand , that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the  Lord  God , even thou only .

translation.kha: bad U Trai u ong ha u ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
And Judas also , which betrayed him , knew the place : for Jesus ofttimes resorted thither with his disciples .
translation.kha: U Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la tip ha-ei ka don , namar bunsien U Jisu u la ïakynduh hangta bad la ki synran .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when ye be come to the land which the  Lord  will give you , according as he hath promised , that ye shall keep this service .
translation.kha: Haba phi rung sha ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kular ban ai ha phi , phi dei ban leh ïa kane ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; If heaven above can be measured , and the foundations of the earth searched out beneath , I will also cast off all the seed of Israel for all that they have done , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Lada ha kawei ka sngi ïa ka suiñbneng la lah ban thew bad ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei la ïitbniah , tang kata hi ka ban pynlong ba un kyntait ïa ki paid Israel namar baroh kaba ki la leh . U  Trai  u la kren .
Ngan pynlong ïa ki liat ban beh pyrshah ïa ka Elam na ki liang baroh , bad nur-um pynkmen ïa ki briew jong ka kylleng , haduh ba yn ym ei ki ri ha kiba ki nongphetwir na ka kim shym poi .
translation.en: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven , and will scatter them toward all those winds  ; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come .
Come unto me , all ye that labour and are heavy laden , and I will give you rest .
translation.kha: To wan ha nga , phi baroh kiba thait na kaba kit ïa ki jingkit kiba khia , bad ngan ai ha phi ka jingjahthait .
U nongïam Sudan uba kyrteng u Serah u tur ïaleh ïa ka Judah shlip badno ka kynhun shipai kaba don shi million ki rangbah bad laispah tylli ki kila ïapmat bad ki tur shynrang haduh Mareshah .
translation.en: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand , and three hundred chariots  ; and came unto Mareshah .

translation.kha: U la kyrshut ïa ka durkhmat jong nga ha khyndew bad la pynkheiñ ïa ki bthat jong nga ha ki mawria .
translation.en: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones , he hath covered me with ashes .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong , Wat pynwit ïa ka ! To ai ba kan buh ïa kaei kaba ka don na ka beit ka sngur ban tep jong per .
translation.en: Then said Jesus ,  Let her alone : against the day of my burying hath she kept this .
Go and tell David my servant , Thus saith the  Lord  , Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in :
translation.kha: Leit bad ïathuh ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba nga ong ha u , ‘ Mem dei uta u ban tei ïa ka templ na ka bynta jong nga ba ngan shong .

translation.en: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees , which were of Jerusalem , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la wan sha U Jisu na Jerusalem bad ki la kylli ïa u ,
Naba ka long da ka jingngeit jong ngi ba ngi don ka jingïadei bad U Blei ; ka Long da ka jingthala jong ngi ba ïa ngi la pyntam .
translation.en: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness ; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation .

translation.kha: Dannah mangi shaduh sepngi A to ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong U Trai !
translation.en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the  Lord s  name is to be praised .
And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt , and linen yarn : the king s merchants received the linen yarn at a price .
translation.kha: Ki nongpyntrei kam jong u syiem ki pynïaid ïa ka jingshalan kulai na Musri bad Kilikia bad ïa ka jingshalan kali ïapom na Ijipt .

translation.en: A whip for the horse , a bridle for the ass , and a rod for the fool s back .
translation.kha: Phi donkam ban sympat ïa u kulai , phi dei ban teh lakam ïa u kada , bad phi dei ban sympat ïa uba bieit .
Uwei pa uwei un sping kaw ïa uwei pat . Ki sum kin ym burom ïa ki rangbah , bad ki riewpoh kine ym burom ïa babha halor jong ki .
translation.en: And the people shall be oppressed , every one by another , and every one by his neighbour : the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient , and the base against the honourable .
And I heard a man s voice between the banks of Ulai , which called , and said , Gabriel , make this man to understand the vision .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba pyrta na shiliang ka wah Ulai ,  Ko Gabriel , to batai ïa u ïa ka jingmut jong kaei kaba u la ïohi .
U don malade u ka byrsha pynher stait , ban shoh ïa u khie baroh bad ban lumlang ïa u kew shapoh ka thiar jongki u ; hynrei un thang ïa u stait ha ka ding ka bym ju lip .
translation.en: Whose fan is in his hand , and he will thoroughly purge his floor , and will gather the wheat into his garner  ; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable .
Ask thee a sign of the  Lord  thy God  ; ask it either in the depth , or in the height above .
translation.kha: To pan na U  Trai  U Blei jong me ban ai ka dak ha me . Ka lah ban long na kaba jylliew ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap lane nang tei najrong eh jong ka bneng .

Ko khun u Briew , ki Israel kim long jingmyntoi ei ei ïa nga . Ki long kumno ka mar bymmyntoi shuh — ka tama , ka tin , ka nalor , bad ka sisa — kiba la pynsah hadien ba la saiñ ïa ka rupa ha ka ding .
translation.en: Son of man , the house of Israel is to me become dross : all they are brass , and tin , and iron , and lead , in the midst of the furnace  ; they are even the dross of silver .

And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it : and as he was destroying , the  Lord  beheld , and he repented him of the evil , and said to the angel that destroyed , It is enough , stay now thine hand . And the angel of the  Lord  stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite .
translation.kha: Nangta u phah ïa u angel ban pynjot thiaw ïa ka Jerusalem ; hynrei u kylla ïa kaba u mut bad u ong ha u angel ,  Keiñ noh ! Katto ka la biang !  U angel u ïeng hajan ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah , u nong Jebus .
Hadien khyndiat sngi , ka la don ka jingïalang jong ki riewngeit , kumba shispah arphew ngut baroh , bad u Petros u la ïeng ban kren .
translation.en: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples , and said , ( the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty , )
And when he was cast out , Pharaoh s daughter took him up , and nourished him for her own son .
translation.kha: La sumar ïa u ha ïing haduh lai bnai , bad haba la buh ïa u shabar na ka ïing jong u , ka khun jong u syiem ka la ting khun ïa u bad ka la pynheh pynsan ïa u kum la u jong u khun .
kamut , de ong ïa phi , ba phin lah ban rung shapoh ka Hima ki bneng tang lada phiah ïaineh skhem kham palat ban ïa ki nonghikai Aiñ bad ki Pharisi ha kaba leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dait .
translation.en: For I say unto you , That except your righteousness shall exceed the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees , ye shall in no case enter into the kingdom of heaven .
The people asked , and he brought quails , and satisfied them with the bread of heaven .
translation.kha: Ki pan , bad u phah ïa ki syiar khlaw ; u ai ïa ki ka jingbam na bneng ban pynhun ïa ki .

translation.en: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi , namely , Gershon , Kohath , and Merari .
translation.kha: U Dabid u pynbynta ïa ki Lebi ha ki lai kynhun kat kum ki kur jong ki : Gershon , Kohath , bad Merari .
Ka jingstad ka don ha ki jingjam jingpyrkhat jong ki briew kiba stad ; babha bieit kim tip ei ei shaphang ka jingstet .
translation.en: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding : but that which is in the midst of fools is made known .

translation.kha: Kabbon U Jisu u Dang waiñ hajar ka Jerikho , la don u briew bamatlah uba shong harud ka lynti bah , u da khnang .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that as he was come nigh unto Jericho , a certain blind man sat by the way side begging :

translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem u la jubab , Ngi sheptieng ïa la ki para ri babha la phet bad ïasoh bad ki nong Babilonia . Ka lah ban long ba ïa nga yn aiti noh sha ki bad kin pynshitom sat ïa nga .
translation.en: And Zedekiah the king said unto Jeremiah , I am afraid of the Jews that are fallen to the Chaldeans , lest they deliver me into their hand , and they mock me .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken : for thou hast found grace in my sight , and I know thee by name .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Ngan leh thik kumta kumba me la kyrpad , namar nga tip bha ïa me , bad nga sngewbha ïa me .

translation.en: So I went , and hid it by Euphrates , as the  Lord  commanded me .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit bad buhrieh ïa ki hajan ka Ïuphratis .

translation.en: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month , when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land , ye shall keep a feast unto the  Lord  seven days : on the first day shall be a sabbath , and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath .
translation.kha: Ynda phi la dep lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phi , rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam hynñiew sngi naduh ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba hynñiew . Ka sngi nyngkong ka dei ka sngi shongthait , bad kumjuh ruh ka sngi kaba phra .

Na ka daw jong u paidbah , kim shym la lah ban wallam ïa ita u briew sha u . Kumta ki la bneng ïa ka jingsop na ka thnum ïing hamar ka kajuh ba U Jisu u don . Hobah ki la dep weng ïa ka jingsop ïing , ki la pynhiar ïa uta u briew shapoh , u da thiah ha ka jingthiah jong u .
translation.en: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press , they uncovered the roof where he was : and when they had broken it up , they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay .

translation.kha: Ki ap ïa ka jinghap , isynei kam wan satia ; ki kham mon ban jied ïa ka jinghap ban ïa ka spah .
translation.en: Which long for death , but it cometh not  ; and dig for it more than for hid treasures  ;

translation.kha: Ka don ka jingkem na ka pynbha ka lawei jong phi ; ki khun jong phi ken wan phai pat sha la ka ri . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kriah .
translation.en: And there is hope in thine end , saith the  Lord  , that thy children shall come again to their own border .

translation.kha: bad u lyoh u kynriah noh na ka Ïing , hangta hi ka sniehdoh jong ka Miriam ka la klop da ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh badno ka la kylla lieh kum ka ïor . Haba u Aaron u peit ïa ka bad u ïohi ba ka la nangto ïa kata ka jingpangnud ,
translation.en: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle  ; and , behold , Miriam became leprous , white as snow : and Aaron looked upon Miriam , and , behold , she was leprous .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U TRAI’ , nga ïathuh ïa phi ïa kiei ba ngan kun ïa wer ki Nongïathuhlypa kiba mem skhem phah hynrei kiba kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad ong ba ka thma bad ka jingïapthngan kin ym lyngkhuh ïa khie ka ri — ngan pynïap ïa ki ha ka thma malu da ka jingïapthngan .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name , and I sent them not , yet they say , Sword and famine shall not be in this land  ; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed .

translation.kha: kamut nga la leit hangamei bad nga la ïohi ïa u nongthaw khiew ba u trei ha ka shem-lanot jong u .
translation.en: Then I went down to the potter s house , and , behold , he wrought a work on the wheels .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa ka ri kaba nga la ai ha u Amraphel bad ha u Isaak , bad ngan ai ïa ka ruh ha ki khun ki ksiew hadien jong me .
translation.en: And the land which I gave Abraham and Isaac , to thee I will give it , and to thy seed after thee will I give the land .
Then Jesus said unto them ,  Take heed and beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  To sumar ; to phikir ïa lade pyrshah ïa u thiat ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi .
Ko Job , kim ei kynjai ïa ph ; Kam ne jubab ban ai ha phi .
translation.en: They were amazed , they answered no more : they left off speaking .
And he shall look on the plague , and , behold , if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes , greenish or reddish , which in sight are lower than the wall  ;
translation.kha: Lada don ki dak lam jyrngam lane lam saw kiba paw kumba ki la ngam ha ka kynroh ,

translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , O thou most proud , saith the Lord  God  of hosts : for thy day is come , the time that I will visit thee .
translation.kha: Ko Babilonia , pha la dap da ka jingsarong , te ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh , nga long pyrshah ïa pha ! Ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban pynshitom ïa pha .
Nga la jingdih ban kohnguh ; nga la pynshahshkor ïa ki jingbishar jong me .
translation.en: I have chosen the way of truth : thy judgments have I laid before me .
But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you , and thou shalt love him as thyself  ; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Leh ïa ki kumba phi leh ïa la u para Israel , bad ieit ïa ki kumba phi ieit ïa lade . Kynmaw ba phi ruh shisien phi la long ki nongwei ha ri Ijipt . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .

translation.en: I pray thee , let me go over , and see the good land that is beyond Jordan , that goodly mountain , and Lebanon .
translation.kha: Shah ïa nga , A Trai , ban jam ïa ka wah Jordan bad ïohi ïa kata ka ri kaba seisoh shatai sha shiliang , ka ri lum kaba itynnat , bad ki lum Lebanon .’
Na ka khet la mih ki jingthaba leilieh , ki jingkyrhuh , ki jingsawa u pyrkhat . Ha khmat jong ka khait , la don hynñiew tylli ki dongmusa bameh , kiba long ki hynñiew ki mynnin jong U Blei .
translation.en: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices : and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne , which are the seven Spirits of God .

translation.kha: To ïashukor , ko ki paid Israel , ïa kane ka jingrwai leit ontep kaba nga rwai ha phi :
translation.en: Hear ye this word which I take up against you , even a lamentation , O house of Israel .

translation.kha: Te ki la pylleng ban kem ïa u , ishyrkhei ym don uba la kwah kti ïa u , Namarba ba ka kynta jong u kam pat poi .
translation.en: Then they sought to take him : but no man laid hands on him , because his hour was not yet come .
Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass ? or loweth the ox over his fodder ?
translation.kha: U Kada u sngewhun haba u bam phlang , bad ka masi ka sngap jar haba ka bam skum kba ?
Wat rung shapoh ka ïing ha kaba ki briew ki ïakhawai . Wat shongsah badno ki ban bam bad dih .
translation.en: Thou shalt not also go into the house of feasting , to sit with them to eat and to drink .
And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah , and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon , these cities which are here mentioned by name ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Judah bad Simeon ïa kiba la ai

Ha ka shaneng Dibri ka wah ka saw da ka snoh , bad U Blei u don kaei kaei kaba kham sngur ba la buh na ka bynta ki brup hangta . Ho-oid , yn don ka jingpynïap ba lyngkien snep ïa uei uwei baroh ba la iehnoh ha Moab .
translation.en: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood : for I will bring more upon Dimon , lions upon him that escapeth of Moab , and upon the remnant of the land .

translation.kha: Napdeng kito kiba ki paid Israel ki la pynïap , u Dei u Balaam , u nongkren byrtong , u khun jong u Beor .
translation.en: Balaam also the son of Beor , the soothsayer , did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them .
Only in the land of Goshen , where the children of Israel were , was there no hail .
translation.kha: Ka thain Goshen , ha kaba ki Israel ki shong ki sah , ka long tang ma ka , ka jaka ha kaba u phria um shym hap .
Te ïa ki samla Shaneng jong ka yn pynpoh ha ki surok bah jong ka nongbah , bad ki swai jong ka baroh yn pynïong ha kata ka sngi . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets , and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha Leit ba riew ka turoi ki peh sngewsheptieng ; ki lah shun iw ïa ka thma ha shuwa ba kin poh hajan , nabar ki sngew ïa ka sur hukum jong ki rangbah shiphang .
translation.en: He saith among the trumpets , Ha , ha  ; and he smelleth the battle afar off , the thunder of the captains , and the shouting .

translation.kha: Kumta u Manoah u shim uwei u khunblang badno khyndiat u kew , bad u ainguh ïa ki halor ka duwan maw shad U Trai kaba leh kattne .
translation.en: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering , and offered it upon a rock unto the  Lord  : and the angel did wondrously  ; and Manoah and his wife looked on .
Therefore seeing we have this ministry , as we have received mercy , we faint not ;
translation.kha: Kumta ngi iohi ia ka jongisynei jingblei , ba u la ai ha ngi ka jingisynei , te ngim dei ban kyllon
bad ai ïa Kata ka rupa ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u .
translation.en: All those that were numbered of the Levites , whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered , after their families , and after the house of their fathers ,

translation.kha: Ha katai ka sngi , u Petros pynlang u Onan ki la leit shuh ka Templ ha ka por lai baje nohphai sngi , kambah long ka kynta jingduwai .
translation.en: Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer , being the ninth hour .

translation.kha: Mynba nga dang Hukum ha Geshur kaba ha Syria , nga la kular ïa U Trai ba lada un ïalam biang ïa nga sha Jerusalem , ngan mane ïa u ha Hebron .
translation.en: For thy servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria , saying , If the  Lord  shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem , then I will serve the  Lord .

translation.kha: Te u Saul u ong ha ki nongïalam jong u paidbah , Ale hangne bad wad ka pop aïu la leh ha khnai ka sngi .
translation.en: And Saul said , Draw ye near hither , all the chief of the people : and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day .
But they gave that to the workmen , and repaired therewith the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Baroh la pyndonkam ban siew ïa ki nongtrei bad ban thied ïa ki tiar ha kaba shna pynbha .

U Trai u la ong ha nga , Buh ïa ka ha ka jingkynshew jongno ka thalab . Kumta nga la shim ïa ki laiphew thlia ki sbai rupa — ka jingkhie kaba khrawbor kaba ki la pyrthat ba nga la shongdor — bad buh ïa ka ha ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Cast it unto the potter : a goodly price that I was prised at of them . And I took the thirty pieces of silver , and cast them to the potter in the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynñiew lada um thied pat ïa ka hapoh kata ka snem , u duh noh ïa katai ka hok ban thied biang , bad kata ka ïing ka sah duh ha uta u nongthied bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u pyntong la pateng ; yn ym pyllait ïa ka ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .
translation.en: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year , then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations : it shall not go out in the jubilee .

translation.kha: Ha Kajuh ka rukom ki kam babha ki paw shai kdar , bad wat ïa kito ki bym da paw shai ym lah ba-bang buhrieh .
translation.en: Likewise also the good works of some are manifest beforehand ; and they that are otherwise cannot be hid .
And it came to pass by the way in the inn , that the  Lord  met him , and sought to kill him .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka sahmiet ha lynti , U  Trai  u ïashem bad u Moses , bad u mut ban pynïap noh ïa u .

translation.en: And the meat of his table , and the sitting of his servants , and the attendance of his ministers , and their apparel , and his cupbearers , and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of the  Lord   ; there was no more spirit in her .
translation.kha: Ka la ïohi ïa ka jingbam ba la buh ha ka miej jong u , ïa ki ïing sah jong ki rangbah synshar jong u , ïa ki shakri kiba shakri ïa u ha ki jingkhawai , bad ïa ki jingkñia kiba u la ai ha ka Templ . Ki la pynlyngngoh ïa ka .
Kumta ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U Trai , nga ong : Yn ym Don shuh ka jingpyntud . Ïa katei kaba to la ong yn pyndep . Ma per , U Trai nongsynshar , nga la kren-ïa !
translation.en: Therefore say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more , but the word which I have spoken shall be done , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: U kñi jong u Saul u ïor ïa u bad ïa uta u shakri , bad u kyrhai ïa ki , Phi ïajah shano ? Ngi ïaleit wad ïa ki kada , u Saul u jubab . Ynda ngim lade ïa ki , ngi leit sha u Saul .
translation.en: And Saul s uncle said unto him and to his servant , Whither went ye ? And he said , To seek the asses : and when we saw that they were no where , we came to Samuel .

When ye have transgressed the covenant of the  Lord  your God , which he commanded you , and have gone and served other gods , and bowed yourselves to them  ; then shall the anger of the  Lord  be kindled against you , and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you .
translation.kha: Lada phim sumar ïa ka jutang kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa phi ban sumar bad lada phi shakri bad mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei , kumta te ha ka jingbitar jong u , un pynshitom ïa phi , bad shen ym don uwei ruh na phi u ban lait im ha kane ka ri babha kaba u la ai ha phi .

translation.en: Now when all the captains of the forces which were in the fields , even they and their men , heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land , and had committed unto him men , and women , and children , and of the poor of the land , of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon  ;
translation.kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah nongpynïaidkam ka Judah bad ki shipai kim shym la pyndem . Ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la lah pynlong ïa u Gedalaïah u lat ka ri bad ba la buh ïa u ban khmih ïa kito baroh ki bym shym la ïalam noh sha Babilonia — ki briew kiba duk tam ha ka ri .
Ki tiduh nalor ki lumbah bad sha ki them , sha ka jaka ba me la buh na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: They go up by the mountains  ; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them .

translation.kha: Ka theisotti Israel ka la kyllon ; Na ym khie pat lano lano ! Ka shah iehnoh ha ka khyndew Bad ym don uwei ruh u ban khyllie ïa ka .
translation.en: The virgin of Israel is fallen  ; she shall no more rise : she is forsaken upon her land  ; there is none to raise her up .
