translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ang , phi ki rangbah kiba don jingshemphang ! Hato U Blei badonburom Baroh u leh ïa kaei ka bymïaineh ?
translation.en: Therefore hearken unto me , ye men of understanding : far be it from God , that he should do wickedness  ; and from the Almighty , that he should commit iniquity .

translation.kha: ka Lakhish , ka Boskath , ka Eglon ,
translation.en: Lachish , and Bozkath , and Eglon ,

translation.kha: To long wahbah sngewnguh ïa kawei pa kawei ka snem ba phi im . Kam pher haduh Katto phira im , kynmaw ba phin ïa-ïap kham slem . Kam don kano kano ruh ïa ka ban khmih lynti .
translation.en: But if a man live many years , and rejoice in them all  ; yet let him remember the days of darkness  ; for they shall be many . All that cometh is vanity .

translation.kha: Kine ki un-long ki proberb u Samson : U ïakhun uba stad u pynsngew sarong ïa la u jong u kpu ; uba bieit u wallam ka jingsngewnguh ïa la ka kmie .
translation.en: The proverbs of Solomon . A wise son maketh a glad father : but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother .

translation.kha: Ki masi bad ki blang jong ki , ki ai kyrngah ka dud , ki la anna ki langbrot , ki blang , bad ki smai ruh uba da kynsha , u kew uba kynsai tam bad ka waiñ kaban bang tam .
translation.en: Butter of kine , and milk of sheep , with fat of lambs , and rams of the breed of Bashan , and goats , with the fat of kidneys of wheat  ; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape .

translation.kha: Haba nga ai jingmut , ki briew ki sngap jar bad ki shahshkor bha ïa kaei kaweh nga ong ;
translation.en: Unto me men gave ear , and waited , and kept silence at my counsel .
He cried also in mine ears with a loud voice , saying , Cause them that have charge over the city to draw near , even every man with his destroying weapon in his hand .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ba U Blei u pyrta ,  Wan hangne , phi ki briew kiba leit ban pynshitom ïa ka nongbah . Wallam ïa ki tiar ïaleh bad phi .

translation.en: Jesus answered them ,  Many good works have I shewed you from my Father  ; for which of those works do ye stone me ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Nga la leh shibun ki kam babha ha khmat jong phi ïa kiba U Kpa u la ai ïa nga ban leh ; kano na kine ba phi kwah ban lynthem maw ïa nga ?

U Syiem Dabid u kylli ïa u , Men leh aïu ïa kine katne katne ? U Siba u jubab , Ki kada ki de na ka bynta ki ba-ha-ïing jong u Syiem Kren ban shong , u kpu bad u soh-ot ki dei na ka bynta ki rangbah jong phi ban bam , bad ka waiñ ka daym na ka bynta jong ki ban dih haba ki la thait ha ka ri khleiñ .
translation.en: And the king said unto Ziba , What meanest thou by these ? And Ziba said , The asses be for the king s household to ride on  ; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat  ; and the wine , that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink .

translation.kha: U Trai un kyrkhu ïa u kew jong phi , pynlang ïa ka jingbam ba phi khreh da u .
translation.en: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store .

translation.kha: bad u pynlong ïa ki , ki paralok jongngi ki khun syiem shynrang , ki ïakhun syiem shynna jngai ki briew jong u .
translation.en: That he may set him with princes , even with the princes of his people .
For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you , and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God ;
translation.kha: Kito ki briew baroh , ki kren shaphang kumno ba phi la pdiang ïa ngi myn haba ngi la wan jngoh ïa phi , bad kumno ba phi la phai noh na ki bleithaw sha U Blei , ban shakri ïa U Blei uba shisha bad uba im

translation.en: Simon Peter saith unto him , Lord , not my feet only , but also my hands and my head .
translation.kha: U Simon Petros u la jubab ,  Ko Trai , to wat sait tang ïa ki kjat jong nga , te ! To sait ruh ïa ki kti bad ïa ka khlieh jong nga ruh .

Ka bor jong U Blei’ ka la ai ha sem ïa kiei kiei baroh Kiba ngi donkam ban im ïa ka jingkem riewblei bashisha da ka jingtip jong sem ïa Uto uba la khot ïa ngi ba ïadon bynta ha ka burom bad ka jingbha lad u hi .
translation.en: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness , through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue :

translation.kha: Ki shynrang baroh kiba la dap shi bnai lane kham eh kiba la shah ñiew ki long phira hajar hynriewspah ngut .
translation.en: And the hangings of the court , and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court , which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about , and their cords , and all the instruments of their service , and all that is made for them : so shall they serve .

translation.kha: Bad ki la kyrshut kyrdoh ïa ka Rebekka da kine ki kyntien : To phi , ka para , phin long ka kiei u paidbah byllien ! To ki Kynhun ki ksiew lad phi ken da jop thiaw ïa ki nongbet jong ki Nongshun jong ki !
translation.en: And they blessed Rebekah , and said unto her , Thou art our sister , be thou the mother of thousands of millions , and let thy seed possess the gate of those which hate them .

translation.kha: Ka snam jong ki blang bad ki masi ktang dara u dpei jong u masi lud la synrai halor ki briew ïa kiba la ñiew bymkhuid kat kumto ka jinglehniam , bad kane ka pynkhuid ïa ki da ka weng noh ïa ka jingbymkhuid katba kum ka jinglehniam .
translation.en: For if the blood of bulls and of goats , and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean , sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh :

translation.kha: Kino ki long ki briew kiba pynlong ki jingïapait , naba shah ïalam ha ki jingkwah ba kynja doh jong ki , ki bym don U Mynsiem .
translation.en: These be they who separate themselves , sensual , having not the Spirit .

translation.kha: ïa ki syiem jong ka Elam , ka Goiim , ka Babilonia bad ka Ellasar , ki san nongput ki Syiem pyrsa ïa ki saw ngut ki syiem .
translation.en: With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam , and with Tidal king of nations , and Amraphel king of Shinar , and Arioch king of Ellasar  ; four kings with five .

translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phoi ba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u longïng ibha kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u briew uba la ju im . Hynrei uta uba riat dak ha ka Hima ki bneng u long suba Kham khraw ban ïa u Ïaineh .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Among them that are born of women there hath not risen a greater than John the Baptist : notwithstanding he that is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he .
And two chains of pure gold at the ends  ; of wreathen work shalt thou make them , and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches .
translation.kha: bad ar tylli ki kynjri kiba da ka ksiar nylla kiba la jyrthiaw kum ki tyllai bad pyndait ïa ki ha kita ki shrong .
Pynban , ha kiei kiei baroh kiba ngi leh ngi pyn-i ba ngi long ki sharak U Balei da kaweh ïaishah slem ha ki jingjynjar , ki jingeh , pynlang ki jingshitom .
translation.en: But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God , in much patience , in afflictions , in necessities , in distresses ,
And David and all Israel played before God with all their might , and with singing , and with harps , and with psalteries , and with timbrels , and with cymbals , and with trumpets .
translation.kha: katba u Dabid bad ki paidbah baroh ki ïashad da ka bor baroh ban ainguh ïa U Blei . Ki rwai bad ki tem ïa ki jingtem — ki duitara , ki ksing , ki shakuriaw , bad ki turoi .

U syier Salmunna u ai ïa ka symboh jong ka ri Sheba ïa baroh kaba ka mat , nalor kiwei pat ki jingai sngewbha kat kum ka dustur ïa kiba u la lah ai ha ka na ka jingjynsur mynsiem . Nangta ma ka bad ki nongbud jong ka ki leit phai sha ka ri Sheba .
translation.en: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatsoever she asked , beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty . So she turned and went to her own country , she and her servants .

translation.kha: U la kren shaphang u Judas , u khun jongu u Simon Aristarkhos . Nongbah u Judas , wat la u dei uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , un sa ikhyllah ïa u .
translation.en: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon : for he it was that should betray him , being one of the twelve .

translation.kha: Naba ïa ka Hukum borbah kaei la kylla lang ha kawei ka hukum kaba ong , Phin ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba phi ieit ïa lade .
translation.en: For all the law is fulfilled in one word , even in this ; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .

translation.kha: U Trai u noh , Nga isih ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi ; ngam lah shah ïa ki !
translation.en: I hate , I despise your feast days , and I will not smell in your solemn assemblies .

translation.kha: Ka dei ka jutang kaba nga la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ki Mynba nga la wallam noh ïa ki na Ijipt , ka ri kabu longsyiem kum ka lawar ding baklang ïa ki . Nga la ong ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa to mala don kuna ïa ktieh kiei baroh kiba nga la lah hukum . Nga la nong ïa ki ba salia ki Kohnguh , kin ïoh long ki bri jongki nga bun nur-um eh long U blei jong ki .
translation.en: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , from the iron furnace , saying , Obey my voice , and do them , according to all which I command you : so shall ye be my people , and I will be your God :
And these are the names of the sons of Ishmael , by their names , according to their generations : the firstborn of Ishmael , Nebaioth  ; and Kedar , and Adbeel , and Mibsam ,
translation.kha: ka la ïoh ïa kine ki khun shynrang , ïa kiba la thoh ter ter kat kum ka sngi kha jong ki : u Nebaïoth , u Kedar , u Adbeel , u Mibsan ,
Shuh shuh ka ong , Ïarap ïa U Trai , ko ki Jentil baroh ; ïarep ïa u , ko ki jaitbynriew baroh!
translation.en: And again , Praise the Lord , all ye Gentiles ; and laud him , all ye people .

translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba kumta U Tharai U Blei jongki ngi . U shong ha kiba kynjang shajrong ,
translation.en: Who is like unto the  Lord  our God , who dwelleth on high ,

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u khie piat na madan , u sum u speh , u sad ïa la u khynñiuh , bad u pli ïa la ki ïajan . Nahath u la sien bad mane ha ka ïng U Trai . Haba u la wan phai sha ka ïingsyiem ; u pan jingbam , badno u la bam ïa ka meng ïadep moi .
translation.en: Then David arose from the earth , and washed , and anointed himself , and changed his apparel , and came into the house of the  Lord  , and worshipped : then he came to his own house  ; and when he required , they set bread before him , and he did eat .
And Moses said , We will go with our young and with our old , with our sons and with our daughters , with our flocks and with our herds will we go  ; for we must hold a feast unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Moses u la jubab ,  Ngin ïaleit lut baroh , kynthup ki khun jong ngi haduh ki tymmen jong ngi . Ngin ïalam ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong ngi , lem bad ki langbrot bad ki blang , bad ki masi jong ngi , namar ngi dei ban pynlong ka jingkhawai ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai .
Ïa ki briew jong nga la pynshitom wat khah jur ban ïa ki nong-ohdieng shnong jong ka Sidon , kiba la ïashem da ka jingkyllon kaba kynsit ha ki kti jong U blem .
translation.en: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom , that was overthrown as in a moment , and no hands stayed on her .

translation.kha: U shakri u la leit phai bad u la ïathuh ïa kaei baroh ha u kynrad jong u . U kynrad u la batai shla bad u la nong ha u shakri , ‘ To leit kloi sha ki lynti bah bad ki lynti rit jong ka nongbah , bun wallam ïa kiba tun , kiba khrew , kiba matlah , bad kiba dkoh .’
translation.en: So that servant came , and shewed his lord these things . Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant , Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city , and bring in hither the poor , and the maimed , and the halt , and the blind .
Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time , and in the world to come life everlasting .
translation.kha: kin ïohpdiang kham bun shah ha kane ka pateng bad ïa ka jingim bymjukut ha ka pateng ka ban wan .

translation.en: And turneth toward the sunrising to Beth–dagon , and reacheth to Zebulun , and to the valley of Iphtah–el toward the north side of Beth–emek , and Neiel , and goeth out to Cabul on the left hand ,
translation.kha: Haba ka phai sha mihngi , u pud u suh sha Bethdagon , u da kynjoh ïa ka Sebulun bad ka Them Iphtahel ha ka lynti shaphang shatei sha Bethemek bad Neiel . U bteng shaphang shatei sha ka Kabul ,
Ïa ka templ ym pat khim la thet na ka bynta U Trai , bad kumta ki briew ki dang ai ki jingkñia ha ki duwan bapher bapher .
translation.en: Only the people sacrificed in high places , because there was no house built unto the name of the  Lord  , until those days .
For until the law sin was in the world : but sin is not imputed when there is no law .
translation.kha: La don ka pop ha ka pyrthei shuwa ba yn ai ïa ka Hukum ; hynrei hangno ha bym don ka hukum , ym don jingbuh jingkynmaw ïa ki pop .

Ki la ïohi ba katto katne ngut ki synran jong u ki dang ïabam ïa la ki jingbam da ki kti ki bym khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam — kata , kim pat put ha kata ka rukom kaba ki Pharisi ki nguh ba ki briew ki dih ban leh .
translation.en: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled , that is to say , with unwashen , hands , they found fault .

translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba u Onesimos u la don jngai na me katto katne por khnang ba men ioh pat ïa u ha ki to baroh .
translation.en: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season , that thou shouldest receive him for ever  ;

translation.kha: U Samuel u la leit Sha u Saul , umbah la khublei ïa u , da kambah ong , U Trai u kyrkhu ïa phi , Samuel ! Nga la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Trai’ .
translation.en: And Samuel came to Saul : and Saul said unto him , Blessed be thou of the  Lord  : I have performed the commandment of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nga la leit namar U balui u la pynpaw ha nga ba nga dei ban leit . Ha ka jingïakynduh bajarjar jar bad ki nongïalam , nga la batai ïa ka khubor ka Angel ïa katba de ïalap ha ki Jentil . Ngam shym la kwah ba ka jingtrei jong nga kaba mynshuwa bad kaba mynta kin shu sep-ei .
translation.en: And I went up by revelation , and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles , but privately to them which were of reputation , lest by any means I should run , or had run , in vain .

translation.kha: U khong bad u ka byrsha pynrieh stait , ban sien ïa u kew borbah bad Ban lumlang ïa u kew shapoh ka stang jong u ; hynrei un thang ïa u stait ha ka ding ka bymlah ju lip .
translation.en: Whose fan is in his hand , and he will thoroughly purge his floor , and will gather the wheat into his garner  ; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable .

translation.kha: Bad u Mikaïah u pynkut : Kane ka daiñ kiei kaba la jia . U Trai u pynlong ïa kine ki ïathuhlypa jong phi ban lamler ïa phi . Hynrei u hi da lade u la dep riat ba phin ïakynduh ïa ka jingshyrkhei !
translation.en: Now therefore , behold , the  Lord  hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of these thy prophets , and the  Lord  hath spoken evil against thee .

translation.kha: Ka long kaei kaei kaba eh ïa uno uno banbeiñ ïaw na ka bynta u briew uba hok . Ka lah ban long ba dat uno uno uba nud ban ïap na ka bynta u biria uba Bha .
translation.en: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die : yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die .

Thus he said , The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth , which shall be diverse from all kingdoms , and shall devour the whole earth , and shall tread it down , and break it in pieces .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingbatai kaba la ai ha nga :  U mradkhlaw uba saw u dei ka hima kaba saw ka ban don ha ka pyrthei bad kan long kaba pher na kiwei pat ki hima . Kan pynlwet ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad kan kyrdem ïa ka .

U angel ibha nyngkong u la ithuh pynlang u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka pyrthei . Ki burom kiba shyrkhei bad ibha tyrha ki la mihnoh ha kito bakha la anna ïa ka Shabeh jrong u mraw bad ha kito kiba la mane ïa ka trud jong u .
translation.en: And the first went , and poured out his vial upon the earth  ; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast , and upon them which worshipped his image .

translation.kha: Ki la pynlong ïa ki apostol ban ïng ha khmat jong ki bad kylli ïa ki , Kamon phi la leh ïa kane ? Ka bor aïu phiah la ïohi lane ïa ka kyrteng jong phi pyndonnam ?
translation.en: And when they had set them in the midst , they asked , By what power , or by what name , have ye done this ?

translation.kha: Ngan teh ïa u thylliej jong me ba kumta men ym lah ban maham ïa kine ki riewïaleh pyrshah .
translation.en: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth , that thou shalt be dumb , and shalt not be to them a reprover : for they are a rebellious house .

translation.kha: Te un sa beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew katba phi nang ïaid shiah khmat , bad phin sa ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri jong ki jaitbynriew kiba kham khynraw bad kham donbor ban ïa phi .
translation.en: Then will the  Lord  drive out all these nations from before you , and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves .

translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha bun ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew ; naba sier lai pynlong ïa me u bymkhuid .
translation.en: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour s wife , to defile thyself with her .

translation.kha: Phin tip ba U Blei uba im u don hapdeng jongki pa’ haba ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai jong ka pyrthiew baroh kan jam ïa ka Jordan ha shuwa jongngi phi .
translation.en: Behold , the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan .

translation.kha: Shahshkor , ïa nga ! Kine ki koidi ki dei ki hynmen ki para jong phi . Pyllait noh ïa ki , ne U Trai un pynsum ïa Phin ha ka jingtur jong u .
translation.en: Now hear me therefore , and deliver the captives again , which ye have taken captive of your brethren : for the fierce wrath of the  Lord  is upon you .

translation.kha: haba ïa ka jingbynrap hok la pynkylla khongpong ha ka ïingbishar , u tip .
translation.en: To subvert a man in his cause , the Lord approveth not .

translation.kha: U Troas un ïaleh kumba u la leh ha u lum Pynmih pynlang ha ka them Gibeon , khnang ba un leh ïa kaei kob u thmu ban leh — wat la ki jingleh jong u kin longkmie kum kiba ikhyllah . Un pyndep ïa ka kam jngai u baroh , ka kam bamaïan jong u .
translation.en: For the  Lord  shall rise up as in mount Perazim , he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon , that he may do his work , his strange work  ; and bring to pass his act , his strange act .

translation.kha: Kiwei pah , ki la jong , U dei u Elijah . kyiuh ki ong , U dei u Nong ïathuhlypa , kum Uei na ki Nongïathuhlypa jong ki prie ba-mynshuwa .
translation.en: Others said , That it is Elias . And others said , That it is a prophet , or as one of the prophets .

translation.kha: Lada don uba lait im sad uba Pyllait im ïa ki khur jongngi u , to khmih sha ki Haba ki wan sha phin . Peit haduh katno ki long kiba sniew , bad to sngewbha ba ka jingpynshitom kaba nga wallam ha ka Jerusalem ka longkmie kaba dei hok ,
translation.en: Yet , behold , therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth , both sons and daughters : behold , they shall come forth unto you , and ye shall see their way and their doings : and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem , even concerning all that I have brought upon it .

translation.kha: bad ha ka ri shyiap . Phi la ïohi kumno u la bah ïa phi khyllem jingmynsaw barhem shi lynter lynti haduh kane ka jaka , kumba u kpa u bah ïa la u khun .’
translation.en: And in the wilderness , where thou hast seen how that the  Lord  thy God bare thee , as a man doth bear his son , in all the way that ye went , until ye came into this place .

translation.kha: Une te , u long u kpu uba la wan hiar na bneng ; um long kum uta u kpu uba ki kpa tymmen Jong phi! ki la bam , hynrei hadien ki la ïaw . Uta uba bam ïa a u kpu un im junom .
translation.en: This is that bread which came down from heaven : not as your fathers did eat manna , and are dead : he that eateth of this bread shall live for ever .

translation.kha: Ki la pyntngen ïa ka Templ jong nga da kob shait ïa ki nongwei bym shym la ostrit , ki briew ki bymkohnguh ïa nga ban rung shaw ka Templ katba ïa ka khleiñ bad ka snam jong ki jingkñia la dang ainguh ha nga . Kum ki briew jong nga ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong nga da baroh kiei ktieh kiba ijli kiba ki la leh .
translation.en: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers , uncircumcised in heart , and uncircumcised in flesh , to be in my sanctuary , to pollute it , even my house , when ye offer my bread , the fat and the blood , and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations .

translation.kha: U nongshun u la kyrwep ïa ka jaka ba jam ïa ka wah bad u la thang ïa ki kut . Ki shipai Babilonia ki la lamwir .
translation.en: And that the passages are stopped , and the reeds they have burned with fire , and the men of war are affrighted .
But we know that the law is good , if a man use it lawfully ;
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ka hukum ka long kaba bha lada pyndonkam ïa ka kumba dei .

Na la khum , bad hangta la ni u kulai uba lieh bthuh . Ïa u nongshong kulai la ai kyrteng ka jingpynïap , bad ka Hades ka bud syndah nongïeng . La ai ha ki ka leh halor shipawa na ka pyllait , ban pynap da ka thma , ka nongaibuit , ka khlam , bad da ki mradkhlaw .
translation.en: And I looked , and behold a pale horse : and his name that sat on him was Death , and Hell followed with him . And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth , to kill with sword , and with hunger , and with death , and with the beasts of the earth .

translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , un sa pynsaphriang slap ha ka khyndew jong pa’ ha ka aïom kaweh biang , ha ka por synrai dara ha ka por pyrsa , khnang ba phin ïohlad ïa u kew , ïa ka waiñ , bad ïa ka umphniang Elul na ka bynshet jong phi hi , bad ïa u phlang na ka bynta ki jingri jong phi .
translation.en: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season , the first rain and the latter rain , that thou mayest gather in thy corn , and thy wine , and thine oil .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa ka um bad sait ïa ka snam na phalang . Nga kyllan umphniang Oholibah phalor ka sniehdoh jong pha .
translation.en: Then washed I thee with water  ; yea , I thoroughly washed away thy blood from thee , and I anointed thee with oil .

translation.kha: ba ha kane ka sngi ngan bat ïa ka kular naba nga la pynlong ha pha ha ka kyrteng jong U Tharai , U Blei ki Israel , ba u Solomon , u khwan jongnga pha un long syiem hadien jong nga .
translation.en: Even as I sware unto thee by the  Lord  God of Israel , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne in my stead  ; even so will I certainly do this day .
And all the men of might , even seven thousand , and craftsmen and smiths a thousand , all that were strong and apt for war , even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar u la pynryngkang par ïa baroh ki rangbah badonkam sha Babilonia , baroh lang hynñiew hajar ngut , bad shihajar ngut ki nongtrei kiba tbit , kynthup ïa ki bania , baroh na ki , ki long ki rangbah bakhlaiñ kiba bit na ka bynta ka kam shipai .

translation.en: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel . Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle , and pitched beside Eben–ezer : and the Philistines pitched in Aphek .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ki Philistia ki ïalumlang ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel , kumta ki Israel ki mih ban ïaleh ïa ki . Ki Israel ki sher dara ha Ebeneser bad ki Philistia pat ha Aphek .

translation.en: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day : for he thought , Something hath befallen him , he is not clean  ; surely he is not clean .
translation.kha: Ka jaka shong u Dabid ka thylli , hynrei u Saul um shym ong ei ei ha kata ka sngi , namar u pyrkhat ,  Kaei re kaei ka la jia ïa u , bad um shym long uba bit kat kum ka jinglehniam .

wah ong ha la ka angnud ieid U Trai U Blei jong phi u la pynher krong ïa ki na khmut jong phi , ka long ñiar ka hok jongki ngi ba U Trai u la wan ïalam ïa ngi ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri . Pynnep ka long namar ka jingbymman kita ki jaitbynriew ba U Trai u la beh krad ïa ki namar jong pa’ .
translation.en: Speak not thou in thine heart , after that the  Lord  thy God hath cast them out from before thee , saying , For my righteousness the  Lord  hath brought me in to possess this land : but for the wickedness of these nations the  Lord  doth drive them out from before thee .

translation.kha: Ka long thik kumba nga la ïathuh ha phi — U Bel u la pyn-i ha phiah ïa kaei ba un sa leh .
translation.en: This is the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh : What God is about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh .

translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi tv dei ban mih na ka jingkhang ka ïingjaiñ , tah ynda la pyndep lut ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkyntang .
translation.en: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days , until the days of your consecration be at an end : for seven days shall he consecrate you .
And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead , now no more to return to corruption , he said on this wise , I will give you the sure mercies of David .
translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la ong shaphang kaba pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , ym ban pyut noh ha ka jingtep :   ‘ Ngan ai ha me ïa kita ki jingkyrkhu bakyntang bad kiba thikna kiba nga la kular ha u Dabid .’
Me la pynïohburom ïa nga , A Blei ; me la shah ba yn pynïap ïa ka erlangthari jong nga .
translation.en: But now he hath made me weary : thou hast made desolate all my company .

translation.kha: Haba ka rakhe ka ïuh ïa u iaisah , ka la hiar noh na ka ut ,
translation.en: And Rebekah lifted up her eyes , and when she saw Isaac , she lighted off the camel .

translation.kha: Ma me , A Trai , me ai ka jingsuk bajai ïa kito kba batskhem ïa ka jingthmu lad ki pynlang kiba bhah ïa la ka jingshaniah ha me .
translation.en: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace , whose mind is stayed on thee : because he trusteth in thee .
And they of Beth–shemesh were reaping their wheat harvest in the valley : and they lifted up their eyes , and saw the ark , and rejoiced to see it .
translation.kha: Ki nong Beth Shemesh ha kata ka por ki dang ïa-ot kew ha them , bad kynsan haba ki khmied ki la ïohi ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ki dap da ka jingkmen haba ki ïohi ïa ka .
Kiba lamler kin ym ïoh rung ha ka Hima U Blei .
translation.en: Liars will not enter God’s Kingdom .

translation.kha: Lada u nongshun jong phi u thngan , bsa ïa u ; lada u sliang , ai um ba un dih .
translation.en: If thine enemy be hungry , give him bread to eat  ; and if he be thirsty , give him water to drink :
Even the very dust of your city , which cleaveth on us , we do wipe off against you : notwithstanding be ye sure of this , that the kingdom of God is come nigh unto you .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat ïa u pui pui na ka shnong jong phi uba dambit ha ki kjat jong ngi , ngi ñiad noh pyrshah ïa phi . Hynrei kynmaw ba ka Hima U Blei ka la wan hajan jong phi !’
Kaei ka kirteng jong me ? uta u briew u kulai . U Jakeh , u jubab .
translation.en: And he said unto him , What is thy name ? And he said , Jacob .
They say to their mothers , Where is corn and wine ? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city , when their soul was poured out into their mothers  bosom .
translation.kha: Khmih sha nga !  ka pyrta sha uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lynti najan .  Ym don mano mano ba don ka jingpang kum ka jong nga , ka Jingpang kaba U  Trai  u la wallam halor jong nga ha ka por ka jingbitar jong u .
bad ïa pa yn khot ki lyngdoh U Trai , ki shakri jong U Blang jong ngi . Phon sa lehkmen ïa ka spah ki jaitbynriew , bad phira sa sngewsarong ba ka dei ki jong Phi .
translation.en: But ye shall be named the Priests of the  Lord  : men shall call you the Ministers of our God : ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles , and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves .

And they shall come against thee with chariots , wagons , and wheels , and with an assembly of people , which shall set against thee buckler and shield and helmet round about : and I will set judgment before them , and they shall judge thee according to their judgments .
translation.kha: Kin tur ïaleh ïa pha naphang shatei , da kaba wanrah ïa ka kynhun shipai babun lem bad ki kali ïapom bad ki , ki kali ba-dap kyrhai ka jingbam . Da kaba kieng da ki stieh bad ki jingïada khlieh , kin ker sawdong ïa pha . Ngan aiti ïa pha ha ki , bad kin bishar ïa pha da la ki jong ki aiñ .

translation.en: And while they were yet talking with him , came the king s chamberlains , and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïakren , ki ïunukh ka ïingsyiem ki wan poi ha ka jingkyrkieh ban ïalam ïa u Haman sha ka jingkhawai ka Esther .

translation.en: Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world , there shall also this , that this woman hath done , be told for a memorial of her .
translation.kha: Mynta , nga pynthikna ïa phi ba hangno hangno haba yn ïalap ïa kane ka Gospel ha kylleng ka pyrthei , ïa kaei kaba ka la leh yn ïathuh ïa ka ban kynmaw ïa ka .
Ki nongwan jong u ki tur ïaleh tyngkan ïa u , Badno ki Bah ïa u da ki ryntieh bad ki kham ;
translation.en: The archers have sorely grieved him , and shot at him , and hated him :

translation.kha: U Jehoahas um don ki shipai kieng atiar kiba dang sah , lait sa tang ki sanphew ngut ki shipai shong kulai , shiphew tylli ki kali ïapom , bad shiphew khadar ngut ki Shipai ïaid kjat , namar u syiem ka Syria u la pynjot ïa kiwei , da kaba ïuh halor jrong ki kum ïa u pui pui .
translation.en: Neither did he leave of the people to Jehoahaz but fifty horsemen , and ten chariots , and ten thousand footmen  ; for the king of Syria had destroyed them , and had made them like the dust by threshing .
And they were astonished at his doctrine : for he taught them as one that had authority , and not as the scribes .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ka rukom ba u la hikai , namar um long kum ki nonghikai ka Hukum ; hynrei u la hikai da ka bor .

translation.en: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward : he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them .
translation.kha: Lada phi ieit ïa la ka jingim , phet krad na ki jingriam kaba pynngat ïa u bymman ha ka lynti ïaid .

translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .
Kumba u Kpa uba bha u kwah ïa kaba bha tam na ka bynta ki khun , u Kpa bnoh jrong ngi ruh u kwah ba ngin ïoh ïa ka jingkmen bymjukut .
translation.en: Just as a good father wishes the best for his children , our heavenly Father desires that we enjoy eternal happiness .
And he said unto Jehoshaphat , Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth–gilead ? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel , I am as thou art , my people as thy people , my horses as thy horses .
translation.kha: Bad u Ahab u kylli ïa u Jehoshaphat ,  Phin leit lang bad nga ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ?   Nga la kloi , haba phi la kloi ,  u Jehoshaphat u jubab  bad kumta ruh ki briew bad ki shipai bad ki shipai shong kulai jong nga ruh .
U kynthih ïa kiba duk na ka khyndew ; u rah ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingsangsot jong ki ,
translation.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust , and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill  ;

translation.kha: Hapdeng ka thma u Syiem Josaïah u la shah siat da ki khnam u nongri Ijipt . U hukum ïa la ki shakri , Rah noh ïa nga ; Nga la mynshuwa jur !
translation.en: And the archers shot at king Josiah  ; and the king said to his servants , Have me away  ; for I am sore wounded .

translation.kha: hynrei kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit rung ka dei ka ri lam bun ri them , kaba oh um na u skud .
translation.en: But the land , whither ye go to possess it , is a land of hills and valleys , and drinketh water of the rain of heaven :
It is as sport to a fool to do mischief : but a man of understanding hath wisdom .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba bieit ban sngewtynnat haba leh bymdei . Ki briew kiba stad ki sngewbha ha ka jingstad .

translation.en: And I will delight myself in thy commandments , which I have loved .
translation.kha: Nga shem sngewbha ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me , namar nga ieit ïa ki .
Kaei kaba u Syiem Kynrad u pan ka long naba eh haduh katta katta ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban leh ïa sakma lait tang ki bleithaw , bad kim shong kim sah hapdeng ki bynriew .
translation.en: And it is a rare thing that the king requireth , and there is none other that can shew it before the king , except the gods , whose dwelling is not with flesh .
So Samuel called unto the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  sent thunder and rain that day : and all the people greatly feared the  Lord  and Samuel .
translation.kha: Kumta u Samuel u la duwai , bad U  Trai  u phah ïa u pyrthat bad u slap ha kata ka sngi . Te uta u paidbah baroh u la sheptieng ïa U  Trai  bad ïa u Samuel ,

Uwei u pynbah uba na ka jait Ben-ammi u la mareh na ka madan thma shaduh Shiloh bad u la poi hangtei ha kajuh ka sngi . Ban pynpaw ïa la ka jingsngewsih u da kad ïa la ki jaiñ , bad u sleh ïa la ka khlieh da ka khyndew .
translation.en: And there ran a man of Benjamin out of the army , and came to Shiloh the same day with his clothes rent , and with earth upon his head .

translation.kha: U Blei u la wan ïalam ïa ki na ibieit ; U ïaleh namar jong ki la kum u Massah prut . Ki ba-im duh ïa ki nongshun jongki ki , Ki pynlwet ïa ki Shaneng jong ki , ki pynkheiñ ïa ki khnam jong ki .
translation.en: God brought him forth out of Egypt  ; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn : he shall eat up the nations his enemies , and shall break their bones , and pierce them through with his arrows .

translation.kha: Pha long ba la pynrem namar kito ki jingpynïap briew bhor bad ba la pynngat da ki bleithaw ba pha la thab , bad te ka sngi jongnga pha ka la wan , ka por ka la kut ! Dei na kata ka daw at la pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew ban ibeiñ ïa pha bad ki ri baroh ki ñiewbeiñ ïa phalang .
translation.en: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed  ; and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made  ; and thou hast caused thy days to draw near , and art come even unto thy years : therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen , and a mocking to all countries .

Behold , I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb  ; and thou shalt smite the rock , and there shall come water out of it , that the people may drink . And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel .
translation.kha: Nga ngan ïeng ha khmat jong me ha u mawsiang ha u Lum Sinai . Tied ïa u mawsiang ; te ka um kan sa mih na u ba u paidbah un ïoh dih .  U Moses u leh kumta ha ka jingdon ryngkat ki nongïalam jong ki Israel .

U kamar u shim shi lyngkhot ka nar bad u pynwandur ïa ka ha ka thiang . Ka ksang ti bakhia jongki u ka pynkhih ïa u tyrnem ban tied pynwandur ïa ka nar . Katba u dang trei , u thngan , u sliang bad u la thait .
translation.en: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals , and fashioneth it with hammers , and worketh it with the strength of his arms : yea , he is hungry , and his strength faileth : he drinketh no water , and is faint .

translation.kha: Pynkyntang ha nga ïa uba la kha nynkong baroh , namar kat uba la kha nyngkong napdeng ki Israel , la u briew ne u mrad , u long u jong nga .
translation.en: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn , whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel , both of man and of beast : it is mine .
Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding : but that which is in the midst of fools is made known .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka don ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki briew kiba stad ; kiba bieit kim tip ei ei shaphang ka jingstad .
Ïa ka jingbishar hok la beh noh , bad ka hok kam lah shun wan hajan . Ka jingshisha ka kyllon ha ki lynti shnong , nabar ka thok kam don jaka hangta .
translation.en: And judgment is turned away backward , and justice standeth afar off : for truth is fallen in the street , and equity cannot enter .

translation.kha: Ka jingleh bymman bad ka jingleh Jubab ki long kum ka smam ka dih ïa ki .
translation.en: For they eat the bread of wickedness , and drink the wine of violence .

translation.kha: Ki dang ïai leh hi ïa la ki rukom barim khih kane ka sngi . Kim shem maïan ïa U Trai lane ïanguh ïa ki ïoh bad ki hukum kiba u la ai ha ki khun ki kiew u Jakob , ïa uba u pynkyrteng u Israel .
translation.en: Unto this day they do after the former manners : they fear not the  Lord  , neither do they after their statutes , or after their ordinances , or after the law and commandment which the  Lord  commanded the children of Jacob , whom he named Israel  ;
And no sin offering , whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place , shall be eaten : it shall be burnt in the fire .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada wanrah wat tang khyndiat na ka snam shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ bad pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba lehniam ban ïohmap ïa ki pop , ïa u mrad ym dei ban bam ; dei ban thang lut khoit ïa u .

Nangta u la kylli ïa eiei pat , ‘ Susah ma phi — sa katno phi Dei ban pynswai ? Shihajar byrni u kew ,’ u la jubab . ‘ Kane hangne ka long ka jingkheiñ jong phi ,’ u sordar u la ong ïa u ; ‘ to thoiñ phraspah .’
translation.en: Then said he to another , And how much owest thou ? And he said , An hundred measures of wheat . And he said unto him , Take thy bill , and write fourscore .

translation.kha: Pynban tang shisien pyrsad na me , ko Tharai , ka la pynïap jyllop ïa ki nong Jephthah ; ki ngam kum ka sisa ha ka umbah ishyrkhei .
translation.en: Thou didst blow with thy wind , the sea covered them : they sank as lead in the mighty waters .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba leh ïa kiwei kiei kiba sniew u Isih ïa ka jingpynshai malu un ym wan shaw ka jingshai , namar um khiah ba ïa ki kam sniew jongnga u yn paw .
translation.en: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light , neither cometh to the light , lest his deeds should be reproved .

translation.kha: kadei patiaw te ngin ïa-ïoh ? Ki paid Israel Kam shitrhem la shem ïa kaei Kaba ki ïawad . Ka la long Teng ka kynhun kaba ri kaba U Blei u la jied , kaba la shem ïa said ; kiba sah na kita ki la set khluit ïa ka jingkhot jong U Blei .
translation.en: What then ? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for ; but the election hath obtained it , and the rest were blinded

translation.kha: ki kjat jong u ki phyrnai kum ka rnong ba la phrang pynlang ba la pynïapher , sad ka at jong u ka sawa kumin ka kshaid bakyrhuh .
translation.en: And his feet like unto fine brass , as if they burned in a furnace  ; and his voice as the sound of many waters .
But those things , which God before had shewed by the mouth of all his prophets , that Christ should suffer , he hath so fulfilled .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynbna naduh mynshuwa lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa baroh ba U Messaïah jong u , u dei ban shahshitom ; bad u la pynlong ïa ka , ban jia shisha ha kane ka rukom .

translation.en: For we will destroy this place , because the cry of them is waxen great before the face of the  Lord   ; and the  Lord  hath sent us to destroy it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkynnoh pyrshah kaba jur ïa kine ki briew bad u la phah ba ngin pynjot thiaw ïa ka Sodom .

translation.en: Thou shalt sell me meat for money , that I may eat  ; and give me water for money , that I may drink : only I will pass through on my feet  ;
translation.kha: Ngin da siewdor ïa ka jingbam ba ngi bam bad ïa ka um ba ngi dih . Kaba ngi kwah ka long tang ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri jong phi ,

Kane baroh kan jied namar ba ki pyllut Israel ki la leh Pop bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei . Ïano yn kynnoh na ka bynta ka jingïalang pyrshah ki Israel ? Ka Semaraim hi , ka nongbeh ! myn ba shah kynroh ïa ka jingmane bleithaw ha Judah ? Ka Jerusalem hi !
translation.en: For the transgression of Jacob is all this , and for the sins of the house of Israel . What is the transgression of Jacob ? is it not Samaria ? and what are the high places of Judah ? are they not Jerusalem ?

translation.kha: Nangta shiphew ngut na ki shipai jong u Joab ki ker sarong ïa u Absalom sad pyndep ban pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And ten young men that bare Joab s armour compassed about and smote Absalom , and slew him .
This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka ri ba ki longïing jong ka jait Judah ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee , Moab  ; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler : for the extortioner is at an end , the spoiler ceaseth , the oppressors are consumed out of the land .
translation.kha: To ngin shong ha ka ri jong ngi . To ïada ïa ngi na kito kiba kwah ban pynjot ïa ngi .  ( Ka jingshah banbeiñ bad ka jingpynjot kin kut , bad kito kiba pynjot ïa ka ri kin jah noh .

translation.en: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge : but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shemphang ki kwah ban ïoh hikai , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop ki sngewhun ha ka jingbieit .

ngam shngiam la ngeit ïa kaei kaba ki ïathmu ïa nga den ynda per la wiang bad ïohi da lade hi . Ngam shym pat ïohsngew wat tang shiteng na ka jingstad jong phi . Phi kham stad shuh shuh ban ïa kiba ki briew ki ong .
translation.en: Howbeit I believed not their words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen it : and , behold , the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me : for thou exceedest the fame that I heard .

translation.kha: U ai bainong ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba ki sa nabar u leh ha ki kat koum kaba ki dei hok .
translation.en: For the work of a man shall he render unto him , and cause every man to find according to his ways .

translation.kha: U la pynbna ha ki brai , U bri u ban wan hadien jong ar u long uba kham khraw ba ïa per . Ngim long uba bit nam dak ban dem bad sah ïa ki juti jong u .
translation.en: And preached , saying , There cometh one mightier than I after me , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose .
Haman said moreover , Yea , Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself  ; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba khamtam ïa ka kata ,  u Haman u ong shuh shuh ,  ka Esther , ka mahadei , ka la pynlong ka jingkhawai ym na ka bynta jongno jongno , hynrei tang ïa u syiem bad ïa nga , bad la khot sngewbha biang ïa ngi na ka bynta la shai ka sngi .
Mynsngi bad mynhynne ngi kyrpad ïa u da ka dohnud jong ngi baroh ba-bang shah ïa ngi ban ïohi ïa phi matlah bad ban pyndap ïa Kiei kaba donkam ha ka jingngeit jongno phi .
translation.en: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face , and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith ?

And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven , and when thou seest the sun , and the moon , and the stars , even all the host of heaven , shouldest be driven to worship them , and serve them , which the  Lord  thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven .
translation.kha: Sumar ban ym shah pynshoi kat haduh ban da mane bad shakri ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi ha sahit bneng — la ka long ka sngi , u bnai , lane ki khlur , ïa kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ai ha kiwei pat ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei ba kin ïoh mane .
Ngi tip) ba ha ktien kiei baroh , U Blei u trei na ka bynta ka jingpynbha ïa kito kiba ieit ïa u , ïa kito ïa kiba u la khot katjuh kum ka jingthmu jong u .
translation.en: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God , to them who are the called according to his purpose .

translation.kha: Namar me la pynjot pynpra ïa ka ri , bad pyndap ïa la ki briew , ïa me yn ym tep kum ïa kiwei pat ki syiem . Ym khong mane mano na ka longrynïeng bynñiaw jong me ban lait im .
translation.en: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial , because thou hast destroyed thy land , and slain thy people : the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu bad ki synran jongu u ki la ïalap sha kawei pat ka nongrit .
translation.en: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men s lives , but to save them .  And they went to another village .
I came forth from the Father , and am come into the world : again , I leave the world , and go to the Father .
translation.kha: Nga la wan na U Kpa , bad nga la wan sha ka pyrthei ; bad mynta ngan sa iehnoh ïa ka pyrthei bad ngan leit sha U Kpa .
nabar ïa ki Hor ha ki lumlang jong ka Edom , bad ki thwet ïa ki haduh Elparan kaweh harud ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: And the Horites in their mount Seir , unto El–paran , which is by the wilderness .

translation.kha: Em kynrad , ngam shym buaid ka la jubab . Ngam shym dih ! Nga jinglur sat bad nga dang duwai bad khlei lut ïa ki jingjynjar baroh ha U Trai .
translation.en: And Hannah answered and said , No , my lord , I am a woman of a sorrowful spirit : I have drunk neither wine nor strong drink , but have poured out my soul before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki shipai ruh ki la krenbeiñ ïa u : Ki la wan sha u bad ki la tyrwa ha u ïa ka saiñ bym bha , bad ki la ïai-ong ,
translation.en: And the soldiers also mocked him , coming to him , and offering him vinegar ,

translation.kha: Ka Templ jong ngi ka long kum ka khet badonburom , kaba ainong halor jong u lumbah babiang naduh kaba sdang .
translation.en: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary .
And it came to pass about this time , that Joseph went into the house to do his business  ; and there was none of the men of the house there within .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka sngi haba u Joseph u leit rung shapoh ïing ban trei ïa la ka kam , uwei ruh na ki shakri ïing um don .

translation.en: And her husband heard it , and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it : then her vows shall stand , and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand .
translation.kha: ka dei ban pyndep lut ïa kata kaba ka la kular lymda u tnga jong ka u pynpaw ka jingsngew pyrshah haba u ïohsngew ïa kata .

translation.en: And ye shall be brought before governors and kings for my sake , for a testimony against them and the Gentiles .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong nga phin shah tian bishar ha khmat ki nongsynshar bad ki syiem , ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha ha ki bad ha ki Jentil .

translation.en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe to the bloody city , to the pot whose scum is therein , and whose scum is not gone out of it ! bring it out piece by piece  ; let no lot fall upon it .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ka nongbah jong ki nongpynïap briew ba la tim ! Ka long kum u khiew ba sarang u bym ju pynkhuid . Ïa kawei hadien kawei ka dkhot doh la sei shabar , bad ym shym pynsah kawei ruh .
Kumno ngin jubab ïa ki nonglamktien kiba wiang sha ngi na ki phylliah ? Ngin ïathuh ïa ki ba U Trai u la seng nongrim ïa ka Seïon bad ba ki briew jong u kiba sohkhram kin Shem ka jingshngain klang .
translation.en: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation ? That the  Lord  hath founded Zion , and the poor of his people shall trust in it .

translation.kha: Kumta ïathuh ïa ki ba ma nga , U Trai , nga ong : Yn ym don shuh ka jingpyntud . Ïa kaei katba nga la ong yn pynspong . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , por la kren !
translation.en: Therefore say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more , but the word which I have spoken shall be done , saith the Lord  God .
