translation.en: And Joktan begat Almodad , and Sheleph , and Hazarmaveth , and Jerah ,
My heart panted , fearfulness affrighted me : the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me .
translation.kha: Ka khlieh jong nga ka king , bad nga khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Nga la khmih lynti ïa ka janmiet ban wan , hynrei kam shym wallam ei ei hynrei tang ka jingtriem .
U la ong , Ko khun u briew , bam ïa kane ka kot kli ba nga ai ha me , pyndap ïa ka kpoh jong me da ka . Te por smam ïa ka , sad ka thiang kum ka ngap .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , cause thy belly to eat , and fill thy bowels with this roll that I give thee . Then did I eat it  ; and it was in my mouth as honey for sweetness .
Thou shalt fan them , and the wind shall carry them away , and the whirlwind shall scatter them : and thou shalt rejoice in the  Lord  , and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Men kynting ïa ki ha ka lyer ; ka lyer kaba jur kan kit lut ïa ki , bad yn pynsaphriang ïa ki da ka  erïong . Te men sa kmen namar nga long U Blei jong me ; men ïaroh ïa nga , U Blei bakhuid ki Israel .
U jongu u la jubab ïa ki , Leh ïa kaba bha tam ban rung lyngba ka khyrdop kaba khim ; namar bad ki briew da kaba thikna kin pyrshang ban phrung lyngba jong ka hynrei kyang ym lah .
translation.en: Strive to enter in at the strait gate : for many , I say unto you , will seek to enter in , and shall not be able .
The same dealt subtilly with our kindred , and evil entreated our fathers , so that they cast out their young children , to the end they might not live .
translation.kha: U la shukor ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad u la long uba shyrkhei ïa ki , da kaba pynbor ïa ki ban bret ïa ki khunlung jong ki na ki longïing jong ki , khnang ba kin ïap .
Ka dei kaba phi ïong , U Moses u jubab . Phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga lano lano .
translation.en: And Moses said , Thou hast spoken well , I will see thy face again no more .

translation.kha: Wat shad ïano ïano ba-bang shrak ïa phi da ki ktien bieit , namar dei na kine kiew ktieh ba ka jingtur U Blei kan woh ha kito ki bymkohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: Let no man deceive you with vain words : for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience .
But as for you , ye thought evil against me  ; but God meant it unto good , to bring to pass , as it is this day , to save much people alive .
translation.kha: Phi shisha phi la thmu sniew ïa nga , hynrei U Blei u la pynphai ïa kata sha kaba bha , khnang ba bun ki briew kiba dang im mynta kin ïoh im namar kaba la jia .
Ha kata ka miet U Blei u leh ïa kata . Ha ka step kaba bud u shñiuh longïng u rkhiang , hynrei ka khyndew ka la jhieh da ka umjer .
translation.en: And God did so that night : for it was dry upon the fleece only , and there was dew on all the ground .

translation.kha: Ka Hakhlieh ka ino , Nga la ïakhun ka Jingïaleh kaweh jwat bad la ka hynñiew , hynrei nga la iap ; kumta ka la Khot kyrteng ïa u , u Naphtali .
translation.en: And Rachel said , With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister , and I have prevailed : and she called his name Naphtali .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la mih bad leit noh sha ka jaka kabu hajan ka nongbah Tyros . U la leit sha kawei ka ïing Bad um shym la khiah mano mano ban tip ba u don hangta , hynrei ba u lah ban shong ha kaba riat .
translation.en: And from thence he arose , and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon , and entered into an house , and would have no man know it : but he could not be hid .

translation.kha: U la leh pop ïa-pyrshah ïa U Trai , hynrei um da sniew eh kat u kpa jong u , lane kat ka Jesebel , ka kmienah Jong u ; u la pynkhyllem ïa ka dur kaba u kpa jong u , u la thaw na ka bynta ban mane ïa u Baal .
translation.en: And he wrought evil in the sight of the  Lord   ; but not like his father , and like his mother : for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made .

translation.kha: Nga sakma ba ngam shym la leh kaba bymman ; malu meng ju pyrshang ban shkor ïa kiwei .
translation.en: If I have walked with vanity , or if my foot hath hasted to deceit  ;
And when they had seen it , they made known abroad the saying which was told them concerning this child .
translation.kha: Haba ki nongaplangbrot ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba u angel u la ïathuh shaphang u khunlung .
Mynta to leit Bad ai ïa khie ka khubor sha ki synran jong u , kynthup ïa u Petros : ‘ Un leit sha Galilaïa ha shata jong phi ; hangta phyrnai Ïohi ïa u , kumba u la ong ha ph .’
translation.en: But go your way , tell his disciples and Peter that he goeth before you into Galilee : there shall ye see him , as he said unto you .

translation.kha: Pynbiang kulai na ka bynta u Apollos ngab shong sad pynpoi ha kaba suk ïa u shaw u Philip u Lyngskor .
translation.en: And provide them beasts , that they may set Paul on , and bring him safe unto Felix the governor .

translation.kha: Kiba kum kine ki bleithaw ki long kum ki jingpyntieng ïa ki sim ha ki lyngkha sohkhia ; kim kah ban krong ; la dei ban rah ïa ki namar kim ia ban ïathied . Wat sheptieng ïa ki : kim lah ban pynmynsaw ïa ph , bad kim haka ban lehbha ïa pa’ .
translation.en: They are upright as the palm tree , but speak not : they must needs be borne , because they cannot go . Be not afraid of them  ; for they cannot do evil , neither also is it in them to do good .
And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly . The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you . Amen .
translation.kha: Bad U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingsuk jong ngi , shen un pynlwet ïa u Soitan hapoh ki kjat jong phi . To ka jingaiei jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi kan long lem bad phi .

translation.en: Be not among winebibbers  ; among riotous eaters of flesh :
translation.kha: Wat ïalang lok bad ki briew kiba kyrni dih waiñ lane bad kiba lalot jingbam .
Ki Israel kin tip naduh kata ba nga longsem U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the  Lord  their God from that day and forward .

translation.kha: Kaei ka jylla kaba hapoh india ba bun briew tam ?
translation.en: Which Indian state has the largest population ?

translation.kha: ki phad ïa ki nonglamktien sha ki nong Kiriath Jearim ban ong , Ki Philistia ki la pynkhie ïa ka Synduk Ka Jutang U tharai . Ale wan shim neh ïa ka .
translation.en: And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kirjath–jearim , saying , The Philistines have brought again the ark of the  Lord   ; come ye down , and fetch it up to you .
Then came the word of the  Lord  unto Samuel , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Samuel ,
To wan bad khmih , u la jubab . ( Ka la long ha Katai ka por kumba mata baje janmiet . ) Kumta ki la leit bad u , bad ki la ïoh hangno u sahit , bad ki la pynlut ïa kaba sah jong ka sngi bad u .
translation.en: He saith unto them ,  Come and see .  They came and saw where he dwelt , and abode with him that day : for it was about the tenth hour .
Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the  Lord  God of Israel  ;
translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ki briew ka Judah bad Benjamin ki la ïohsngew ba kita kiba la wan phai pat na ka jingshah ringmraw ki dang ïatei pat ïa ka Templ U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
Ko kyndon , la phai ktien u rangbah synshar , to wan bad nga shuwa ba u khup jong nga un ïarep .
translation.en: The nobleman saith unto him , Sir , come down ere my child die .

translation.kha: Ka Israel kan jyllop ïa ki nongshoh-nar jong ka bad pynjot ïa ki barhem .
translation.en: Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries , and all thine enemies shall be cut off .

translation.kha: Nalor kata , da ka bor ka jong U Blei phi la pynïap ïa ki ar ngut ki khlieh synshar jongki ki milian , u Oreb bad u syep . Nga la bor aïu baneh ïanujor sad kata ? Haba u la kren ïa kane , kim shym la bitar shuh .
translation.en: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian , Oreb and Zeeb : and what was I able to do in comparison of you ? Then their anger was abated toward him , when he had said that .
Art thou better than populous No , that was situate among the rivers , that had the waters round about it , whose rampart was the sea , and her wall was from the sea ?
translation.kha: Ko Ninebeh , hato pha kham bha ban ïa ka Thebes , ka nongbah jong ka Ijipt ? Ma ka ruh ka la don ka wah ban ïada ïa ka kum ka kynroh — Ka wah Nile ka la long kum ka jingker jong ka .

Ka jingkulmar ka la pur ha ka nongbah barben kawei , bad ki briew ki la ïakhmih lang , ki la kem ïa u Paul , Bad ki la patan ïa u shalor jong ka Templ . Shisyndon hi la khang ïa ki jingkhang jongnga ka Templ .
translation.en: And all the city was moved , and the people ran together : and they took Paul , and drew him out of the temple : and forthwith the doors were shut .

translation.kha: Ki la ïaboi Sawdong jong per khem ki ngap , hynrei ki la ing lud kloi kum ka ding hapdeng ki siaw ; da ka bor ka jong U Trai nga la pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: They compassed me about like bees  ; they are quenched as the fire of thorns : for in the name of the  Lord  I will destroy them .

translation.kha: Lada U Blei u dem u briew , ngan jin da la jop ïa u , Ngi lah ban leit sha ka ïingbishar ngab rai ïa ka jingïakajia jong i .
translation.en: For he is not a man , as I am , that I should answer him , and we should come together in judgment .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah nongïaleh lad ka Teman kin kyiuh , bad ïa uwei pa uwei u shaei ha Edom yn pynap .
translation.en: And thy mighty men , O Teman , shall be dismayed , to the end that every one of the mount of Esau may be cut off by slaughter .

translation.kha: U Baana , u khwan jong u Hushai : ka thain Asher bad ka Shong Bealoth
translation.en: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth :

translation.kha: Ym don utai bapaw u nongïathuhlypa uba la lah ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khrong bad bakha sngewtriem khim kiba u Moses u la leh ha khmat ki Israel baroh .
translation.en: And in all that mighty hand , and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel .

translation.kha: Nga hir u briew uba laitluid , ym u miaw jongno jongno ; hynrei nga pynlong ïa lade u miaw jongno borbah khnang ba ngan jop katba lah ïa ki briew kiba bun .
translation.en: For though I be free from all men , yet have I made myself servant unto all , that I might gain the more .

translation.kha: A Trai , U Blei’ jong ngi , me la jubab ïa la ki briew ; me la pyn-i ïa ki ba me long U Blei uba map ei , wat la me pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki .
translation.en: Thou answeredst them , O  Lord  our God : thou wast a God that forgavest them , though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions .
The beast of the field shall honour me , the dragons and the owls : because I give waters in the wilderness , and rivers in the desert , to give drink to my people , my chosen .
translation.kha: Wat ki mradkhlaw kin burom ïa nga ; ki myrsiang bad ki ostrit kin ïaroh ïa nga haba ngan pynlong ïa ki wah ba kin tuid ha ka ri shyiap ban ai um ïa ki briew ba la jied jong nga .
Ka jingjia jyllang nga kam dei bad ki briew ki bym im jingkhum ; nga don ka daw kaba biang ba ngam lah ban ïaishah .
translation.en: As for me , is my complaint to man ? and if it were so , why should not my spirit be troubled ?
And my people are bent to backsliding from me : though they called them to the most High , none at all would exalt him .
translation.kha: Ki ïaleh ban phai lyndet na nga . Kin sa lynñiar namar ka lyngkor kaba ban ïa ki , hynrei yn ym don ban weng ïa ka na ki .
Te u angel u la ong , To ba-pnah ïa lade bad phong ïa la ki juti . U Patmos u la leh kumta , bad u angel u la ong , To tawah ïa la ka jaiñkup sawdong jongnga me bad wan bad to .
translation.en: And the angel said unto him , Gird thyself , and bind on thy sandals . And so he did . And he saith unto him , Cast thy garment about thee , and follow me .

translation.kha: Nangta u Eliakim , u Shebna , Bad u Joah ki ïathuh ïa u rangbah synrai , krung ha ka ktien Aramaik ïa ngi , ko kynrad . Ngi sngewthuh ïa ka . Kam krenbeiñ ha ka ktien Heber ; baroh ki bhabriew ha ka kynduh ki ïasngap .
translation.en: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , and Shebna , and Joah , unto Rab–shakeh , Speak , I pray thee , to thy servants in the Syrian language  ; for we understand it : and talk not with us in the Jews  language in the ears of the people that are on the wall .

translation.kha: U Soitan u jubab , Heth u Job un mane ïa me lada um ïoh ei ei na ka ?
translation.en: Then Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , Doth Job fear God for nought ?
But thou shalt surely kill him  ; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death , and afterwards the hand of all the people .
translation.kha: Pynïap ïa u ! Sdang nyngkong ma phi ban lynthem maw ïa u , bad nangta uwei pa uwei ruh un lynthem maw ïa u .

U Benhadad u la mynjur ïa ka jingpyrta u Asa dara u phah ïa ki jingïalam shipai bad ki kynhun shipai jrong ki ban tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah ka Israel . Ki jop ïa ka Jadon , Dan , Ahab Beth Mahlah , bad baroh ki nongbet ka Nahalal ha kiba la buh ïa ki mar ki mata .
translation.en: And Ben–hadad hearkened unto king Asa , and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel  ; and they smote Ijon , and Dan , and Abel–maim , and all the store cities of Naphtali .

translation.kha: Katto katne ki briew ki koit ki khiah haduh ka sngi ka jingïarap ; ki ïatip suk bad khlem shitom , ki met jong ki kiba la ïoh jingbsa bha .
translation.en: His breasts are full of milk , and his bones are moistened with marrow .
And they cut off his head , and stripped off his armour , and sent into the land of the Philistines round about , to publish it in the house of their idols , and among the people .
translation.kha: Ki khrai ïa ka khlieh u Saul , ki loit noh ïa ki atiar jong u , bad ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien kylleng ka ri Philistia ban pynbna ïa kata ka khubor babha sha ki blei jong ki bad ha ki briew jong ki .
Ka jingïalumlang u Joshua ka ïalam ïa u naduh Kadesh Barnea ha ka phang shathie haduh Gasa shajan ka rud duriaw , kaba kynrup ïa barabor ki jaka ka ri Goshen haduh Gibbethon ha ka phang bashatei .
translation.en: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh–barnea even unto Gaza , and all the country of Goshen , even unto Gibeon .
And the chief seats in the synagogues , and the uppermost rooms at feasts :
translation.kha: kiba jied ban buh jaka lypa ha ki synagog bad jied ïa ki jaka babha tam ha ki jingkhawai .
Ki la kem ïa ki apostol bad ki la sor ha ka pham .
translation.en: And laid their hands on the apostles , and put them in the common prison .

translation.kha: Nga la pyllaitluid ïa ki paidbhur Israel sad pynim ïa ki na ka hima bakhrawbor .
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath redeemed Jacob , and ransomed him from the hand of him that was stronger than he .
That the residue of men might seek after the Lord , and all the Gentiles , upon whom my name is called , saith the Lord , who doeth all these things .
translation.kha: Bad kumta baroh kiba sah na u bynriew kin wan sha nga , baroh ki Jentil ïa kiba nga la khot ban long ki jong nga .
kyrshan kynsan la don ka jingkheiñ bymdei kaba jurip ; u apostol U Trai u la wan hiar na bneng , u la pyntyllun ïa u maïan , pynlang u la shong halor jong u .
translation.en: And , behold , there was a great earthquake : for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven , and came and rolled back the stone from the door , and sat upon it .
If the wicked restore the pledge , give again that he had robbed , walk in the statutes of life , without committing iniquity  ; he shall surely live , he shall not die .
translation.kha: kum ka nuksa , lada u pynphai noh ïa ka bynda ba u shim ïa ka ram lane u pynphai noh ïa kaei ba u la tuh — lada u sangeh kaba leh pop bad u bud ïa ki aiñ kiba ai jingim , un ym ïap hynrei un im .
Nangta ki la sahnarphna ruh ïa ki ar ngut ki nonglute lem bad U Jisu , uwei sha ka liang kamon jong u bad uwei pat sha ka liang kadiang jong u .
translation.en: Then were there two thieves crucified with him , one on the right hand , and another on the left .
And Jesus stood still , and commanded him to be called . And they call the blind man , saying unto him , Be of good comfort , rise  ; he calleth thee .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la ong ,  Khot ïa u .  Kumta ki la khot ïa uta u briew uba matlah .  To lehkmen !  ki la ong .  Ïeng joit , u khot ïa me .

Un shim ruh khyndiat ka umphniang na la ka sla ti dara khyndiat ka snam jong u khunlangbrot bad un tah ha ka shkor kamon , ka tikmie kamon , bad ka jatkmie kamai jong Uto u briew ïa uba yn pynïakhlad .
translation.en: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot , upon the blood of the trespass offering :
And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant , that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard .
translation.kha: Haba ka por ka la poi ban lum ïa ki sohwaiñ , u la phah ïa u mraw sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang ïa la ka bynta na ka jinglum soh .

translation.en: And these are the generations of Isaac , Abraham s son : Abraham begat Isaac :
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khana shaphang u Isaak u khun jong u Abraham .
U la tei wat ïa ki jaka manna Blei’ thala ha ki ri lum Judith bad u ïalam ïa ki briew ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ban leh jop pyrshah ïa U Troas .
translation.en: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Judah , and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication , and compelled Judah thereto .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la phah ïa ka jingïapthem ha ki paid Israel , bad hynñiewphew hajar ngut na ki , ki la ïap .
translation.en: So the  Lord  sent pestilence upon Israel : and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men .

translation.kha: A Trai , me la pynlong ïa ka hangta jongno im ban roi , da kaba pynïar ïa ka ri ha bhor sdang , bad kane ka la wallam ïa me ka burom .
translation.en: Thou hast increased the nation , O  Lord  , thou hast increased the nation : thou art glorified : thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth .
And it came to pass , when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead , that Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite , to take possession of it .
translation.kha: Shisyndon u Ahab u leit sha ka bri sohwaiñ ban shimti ïa ka .
U Mynsiem u la ai ha ngi ka jingtem , u dei ruh ban shihajar ïa ki jingim jong ngi .
translation.en: If we live in the Spirit , let us also walk in the Spirit .

translation.kha: Kumta u symboh Ahab u la ïap . Ïa ka set jong u la setkut bad la tep ha Samaria .
translation.en: So the king died , and was brought to Samaria  ; and they buried the king in Samaria .

translation.kha: U Manoah um shym tip ba u den u angel jong U Trai , kumta u ong ha u , Sngewbha ki nym pat sien . Ai ba ngin ïoh shet uwei u khunblang na ka beit jongu phi . Hynrei u angel u ïai-ong , Lada nga dei pun ap , ngan nym bam ïa ka jingbang jongngi phoi . Hynrei lada phi kwah ban pynrieh ïa ka , thang ïa ka kum ka jingainguh sha U Trai .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Manoah , Though thou detain me , I will not eat of thy bread : and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering , thou must offer it unto the  Lord . For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the  Lord .

translation.kha: kumto Uno eit ïa uba la pynshoh ha U Khrist u long u jingthaw uba thymmai ; kaba rim ka la leit noh , kaba tymmen ka la wan .
translation.en: Therefore if any man be in Christ , he is a new creature : old things are passed away ; behold , all things are become new .

Therefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will even do according to thine anger , and according to thine envy which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them  ; and I will make myself known among them , when I have judged thee .
translation.kha: Kumta te , da shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im , ngan sa siew kylliang na ka bynta ka jingbitar jong me , ka jingbishni jong me bad ka jingisih jong me ïa ki briew jong nga . Kin sa tip ba nga pynshitom ïa me na ka bynta kaei kaba me la leh ïa ki .
Pynban , hadien lai snem , ar ngut na ki mraw jong u Shimei ki la pui noh sha u Akhish , u shem ka Gath , u khun jong u Maakah .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of three years , that two of the servants of Shimei ran away unto Achish son of Maachah king of Gath . And they told Shimei , saying , Behold , thy servants be in Gath .
And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts : he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them : he clave the rock also , and the waters gushed out .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u ïalam ïa la ki briew lyngba ka ri shyiap kaba khluit , kaba tyrkhong , kim shym la shahshitom na ka jingsliang . U la pynlong ïa ka um ban mih na u mawsiang na ka bynta jong ki ; u pynpait ïa u mawsiang , bad ka um ka mih nangta .

Ha ka jingtbit namar ka jingshaïong , ki briew jongnga kiba babe ki nongbah ki la leit shai ka nongbah kiba ki kyrmen ban ïoh um , hynrei kim ïoh ka jingaiti ka shun biang . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .
translation.en: So two or three cities wandered unto one city , to drink water  ; but they were not satisfied : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: ( Lur 21 :1-4 ) Te mano mano ruh ki lah ban “U noh ha “ki barabor ban ai “katba u thmu ha la ka dohnud .” —1 Korinth 16 :2 ; 2 Korinth 9 :7 .
translation.en: ( Luke 21 :1-4 ) Thus anyone can regularly “set something aside” to give “just as he has resolved in his heart .” —1 Corinthians 16 :2  ; 2 Corinthians 9 :7 .

translation.kha: Kumta , te , balei ngam buh ïa ka peiñ jong nga ha ka jaka kynnoh pisa ? Nangta te ngan jin da la ïohpdiang pat ïa ka lem bad ka sut haba nga la wan phai .’
translation.en: Wherefore then gavest not thou my money into the bank , that at my coming I might have required mine own with usury ?

translation.kha: To map ïa ka pop jong ki ; hynrei lada men ym map , at kyrdoh ba men weng noh! ïa ka kyrteng jong nga na kata ka kitab ha kaba me la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong u paidlang jong me .
translation.en: Yet now , if thou wilt forgive their sin―  ; and if not , blot me , I pray thee , out of thy book which thou hast written .
Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch , teaching and preaching the word of the Lord , with many others also .
translation.kha: U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la pynlut katto katne por ha Antiokh , bad ryngkat lem bad bun kiwei pat , ki la hikai bad ïalap ïa ka ktien jong U Trai .
Ka jingkmen jong phiah ka longkmie ka jong phi hi ; ka jingkthang jongngi phoi ka lama ka jong phi hi . Ym ba-don uba lah ban ïasam ïa ki bad phi .
translation.en: The heart knoweth his own bitterness  ; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy .
And they put his armour in the house of their gods , and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon .
translation.kha: Ki buh ïa ki atiar jong u ha kawei na ki templ jong ki bad wah ïa ka khlieh jong u ha ka templ jong u Dagon u blei jong ki .
Ai ba kiba sarong kin lehrain , nabar ki mudui lamler ïa nga ; hynrei ma nga , Ngan poh ïa ki jingbthah jong me .
translation.en: Let the proud be ashamed  ; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause : but I will meditate in thy precepts .
Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh , and all that he did , and his sin that he sinned , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Manasseh u la leh , kynthup ïa ki pop ba u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah
Lada phi ïaineh ha nga bad ki ktien jong nga ki ïaineh ha phi , te phin pan ïa kiei kaei kaba phi kwah , bad phna ïoh ïa ka .
translation.en: If ye abide in me , and my words abide in you , ye shall ask what ye will , and it shall be done unto you .

translation.kha: Ngan ïada ïa Kanah ka nongbah bad ngan ïada ïa ka , na ka bynta ka burom jong ang hi sad Namar ka kular kaba nga la pynlong ha u shakri jongu nga u Dabid .’
translation.en: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake , and for my servant David s sake .

translation.kha: Ka ding ka ïadat ha shuwa jong u mala ka thang ïa ki nongshun kiba don sawdong jong u .
translation.en: A fire goeth before him , and burneth up his enemies round about .

translation.kha: U Iskah , u khun uba ar jong u Kohath , u don u khun , u Shelomith , u khleh jong ka khi .
translation.en: Of the sons of Izhar  ; Shelomith the chief .

translation.kha: Kuth te , kumba da kawei ka pop la pynrem ïa u bynriew baïar , ha kajuh ka paw kaweh ka kam bahok ka pyllait bad ka ai jingim ïa u ibhabriew baroh .
translation.en: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation ; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life .

translation.kha: Haba u Hushai u la wan poi , u Absalom u ong ha u , Kanneh ka dei ka jingai jingtem jong u Ahithophel kaba u la ai ïa moi ; Hato ngin bud ïa ka ? Lada em , to iathuh ma phi ïa ngi kaei ba ngin leh .
translation.en: And when Hushai was come to Absalom , Absalom spake unto him , saying , Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner : shall we do after his saying ? if not  ; speak thou .
And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses , whom the  Lord  knew face to face ,
translation.kha: Ym pat ju don u nongïathuhlypa ha Israel uba kum u Moses ; U  Trai  u ïakren bad u markhmat .
Mano mano ba ïohi ïa u Lebiathan u duh ka jingshlur bad u kyllon ha madan .
translation.en: Behold , the hope of him is in vain : shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him ?

translation.kha: khoit lang ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal baroh , ïa ki nongmane jong u baroh , bad ïa ki lyngdoh jong u baroh . Uwei hima um dadien ban pep ; nga ai ka jingkñia ainguh kambah khraw ha u Baal , bad uno uno uba jah un shah pynïap . ( Kane ka long ka buit synñia ha ka liang jong u Jehu da kaba u meng ngab pynjop lut ïa ki nongmane ïa u Baal . )
translation.en: Now therefore call unto me all the prophets of Baal , all his servants , and all his priests  ; let none be wanting : for I have a great sacrifice to do to Baal  ; whosoever shall be wanting , he shall not live . But Jehu did it in subtilty , to the intent that he might destroy the worshippers of Baal .
Then the woman said , Let thine handmaid , I pray thee , speak one word unto my lord the king . And he said , Say on .
translation.kha: Sngewbha , ko Syiem Kynrad , shah ïa nga ban ong sa tang kawei ,  ka briew ka ong .  To ong  u jubab .
Wai iaineh ïa ka jingdeng , bun kan ïada ïa phi ; ieit ïa ka , te kuna satia bha ïa phiah .
translation.en: Forsake her not , and she shall preserve thee : love her , and she shall keep thee .

And whosoever speaketh a word against the Son of man , it shall be forgiven him : but whosoever speaketh against the Holy Ghost , it shall not be forgiven him , neither in this world , neither in the world to come .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba kren ei ei pyrshah ïa U Khun U Briew u lah ban ïoh jingmap ; hynrei uno uno uba kren ei ei pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid un ym ïoh jingmap — mynta lane junom .

To ïashongkurim bad to ïoh ki khun ki kti . Nangta shah ïa ki khunlung ki kiei jong phi ban shongkurim , ba kumta ma ki ruh kin don ki khulom ki kti . Phi dei ban roi ha ka jingbun briew’ bun ym ïa-ban duna .
translation.en: Take ye wives , and beget sons and daughters  ; and take wives for your sons , and give your daughters to husbands , that they may bear sons and daughters  ; that ye may be increased there , and not diminished .

translation.kha: Khatduh ar jrut ki rangbah ki la wan bad ki la ong , Une u briew u la ong , ‘ Nga lah baneh pynjot ïa ka Templ jong U Blei bad ha ki lai sngi ngan tei patar ïa ka .’
translation.en: And said , This fellow said , I am able to destroy the temple of God , and to build it in three days .
And when Eli heard the noise of the crying , he said , What meaneth the noise of this tumult ? And the man came in hastily , and told Eli .
translation.kha: U Eli u la ïohsngew ïa kata ka jingsawa bad u kylli ,  Ka jingsawa aïu kata ?  Uta u rangbah u leit kloi kloi sha u Eli ban ïathuh ha u ïa kaba la jia baroh .
Ngan ïathuh ha u ba phi dei ki nongri jingïar , bad ba pa’ la wan ïalam ïa la ki kynhun langbrot , ïa kiwei de ki jingri , bad ïa kiei kiei barben kat babha phiah don .
translation.en: And the men are shepherds , for their trade hath been to feed cattle  ; and they have brought their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have .
In those days there was no king in Israel : every man did that which was right in his own eyes .
translation.kha: Ym shym la don syiem ha Israel ha kata ka por . Uwei pa uwei u leh katba u sngewbha .
To ngin pyrkhat khia uwei ïa uwei pat , pun ïarap uwei ïa uwei pait , ban pynap ïa ka jingïa-ieit bad ban lehbha .
translation.en: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works :

translation.kha: U shuh jong ki u long kum u shñiuh kyntiew , ki bniat jong ki , ki long khem ki bniat Sing .
translation.en: And they had hair as the hair of women , and their teeth were as the teeth of lions .

translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa kito kiba ïai sumar ïa ka Sabbaton bad ki bymïap pyndonkam khrew ïa ka . Ngan kyrkhu ïa iar ki ngi leh ïa kaei kaei kambah sniew .
translation.en: Blessed is the man that doeth this , and the son of man that layeth hold on it  ; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it , and keepeth his hand from doing any evil .

translation.kha: Pynbeit ïa ki briew jongngi me , A Tlai ; hynrei wat leh tyngeh halor jyllang ngi lane pynshitom ïa ngi haba me bitar ; kata ka lah ban longsem ka jingkut jong ngi .
translation.en: O  Lord  , correct me , but with judgment  ; not in thine anger , lest thou bring me to nothing .

translation.kha: Nalor kine , U Blei u la ai ha u ïa ki langbrot bad ki masi malu shibun ka spah ka phew ba u ïoh ban Tei shibun ki nongbah .
translation.en: Moreover he provided him cities , and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance : for God had given him substance very much .
And Esau said , Behold , I am at the point to die : and what profit shall this birthright do to me ?
translation.kha: U Iso u ong ,  Ka biang hi ! Nga sngew kum ban sa ïap noh ; kita ki hok jong nga kin myntoi aïu pat ïa nga ?
Kaba kut jyllang kaei kiei ka kham bha ban ïa ka jingdeng jongnga ka . Ka jingïathiah ka kham bhah ban ïa ka jingsarong .
translation.en: Better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof : and the patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit .

translation.kha: Ngan buh ïa u baneh lymbung ka tyngam jongki me bad ngan pynlong ïa ka dohkha ha ka wah jong me ba-bang sahkut suk ha me . Nangta ngan teng ïa me na ka wah Nile bad ïa ki dohkha baroh Ibbah snoh ha me .
translation.en: But I will put hooks in thy jaws , and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales , and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers , and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki ju leit hiarthma ïa ki briew jong ka Geshur , ki Girsi , bad ki Anammelekh , kiba la ju shong ha kata ka thain napoh mynhyndai . U ju leit lute ïa ka ri jong ki haduh Shur , baroh shi lynter lynti haduh ka ri Ijipt ,
translation.en: And David and his men went up , and invaded the Geshurites , and the Gezrites , and the Amalekites : for those nations were of old the inhabitants of the land , as thou goest to Shur , even unto the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Naamah bym don slap bad ba ka khyndew ka la tyrkhong ki nongrep ki pang ka dohnud ; ki buhrieh ïa la ki durkhmat .
translation.en: Because the ground is chapt , for there was no rain in the earth , the plowmen were ashamed , they covered their heads .

translation.kha: haduh ha kaba ïathaw U Trai u pyndam noh ïa ki na khmat jong u , kumba u la maham lyngba ki shakri jong u ki nongïathuhlypa , ba un leh kumta . Te ki paid Jeriel ki la shat pynryngkang pa shat Assyria , ha kaba ki dang ïaisah hangthie .
translation.en: Until the  Lord  removed Israel out of his sight , as he had said by all his servants the prophets . So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day .

translation.kha: Ka pynïaid ia nga .
translation.en: It took me by surprise .

translation.kha: Nga la kut ïa kiba ïateh lok bad nga , hynrei ki la kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga . Ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam ki la ïap ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah , ki da wad ïa ka jingbah ban ri pynim ïa lade .
translation.en: Arise , cry out in the night : in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord : lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children , that faint for hunger in the top of every street .
Smite a scorner , and the simple will beware : and reprove one that hath understanding , and he will understand knowledge .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsngewmeng dei ban pynshitom , khnang ba ki briew ki bym da sngewthuh bha kin ïoh jinghikai . Lada phi long uba stad , phin ïoh jinghikai haba pynbeit ïa phi .
Nangta u Eleasar un rim khyndiat na ka snam jong ka bad un synrum ïa ka hynñiew sien da la ka shynriah ti sha ka phalang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger , and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times :
Quicken me after thy lovingkindness  ; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingieit baneh jong me , to long uba bha ïa nga , khnang ba ngan lah ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .
U kynïan ïa ka jingainguh bam bad u shim shi khim u purew bad u thang ïa u halor ka jingnguh . ( Kane ka long nalor ka jingainguh thang ka Men ka sngi . )
translation.en: And he brought the meat offering , and took an handful thereof , and burnt it upon the altar , beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning .

translation.kha: Te ngan ia ban jubab ïa kito kiba ibeiñ ïa nga namar nga shaniah ha ka ktien jong me .
translation.en: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me : for I trust in thy word .

translation.kha: To ngin batskhem da ka jingkynrum ïa kaba moi ïaphla , ñiar i'u lah ban shaniah ba U Blei u bat ïa la ka kular .
translation.en: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering  ; ( for he is faithful that promised  ; )

And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah  ; for there they blessed the  Lord  : therefore the name of the same place was called , The valley of Berachah , unto this day .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba saw , ki ïalumlang ha ka Them Berakah bad ïaroh ïa U  Trai  na ka bynta baroh kaba u la leh . Dei na kata ka daw ba la khot ïa ka them ,  Ka Berakah .
Un wallam nur ïa ki khap bad ki khun sa shisien ; lym kumta ngan hap ba-bang wan bad pynjot ïa ka ri jong phi .
translation.en: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children , and the heart of the children to their fathers , lest I come and smite the earth with a curse .
Then the Philistines went up , and pitched in Judah , and spread themselves in Lehi .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki wan bad sher dara ha Judah , bad ki hiarthma ïa ka shnong Lehi .

Ïa ka templ la pyndap da ka tdem na ka burom bad ka bol jong U Blei , bad ym ei mano mano ba lah ban longing shapoh ka templ tad haduh ba ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam ba la wanrah da ki Hynñiew nud ki angel , ki la poi sha kaba kut .
translation.en: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God , and from his power  ; and no man was able to enter into the temple , till the seven plagues of the seven angels were fulfilled .

translation.kha: bad ki ong ha u , Peit , Phi te mynta phi la tymmen , bad ki khun jong phoi kim shym bud ïa ka nuksa jong phi . Kumta , thung noh da u syiem ban synshar shalor jongki ngi , ba kumta ngin don noh la u Syiem bania kiwei patan ki ri ki don .
translation.en: And said unto him , Behold , thou art old , and thy sons walk not in thy ways : now make us a king to judge us like all the nations .

translation.kha: ( Long ba la tei ïa u briew u bymlah leh ïa ka kdew U thri da ka dohnud jong u baroh ! Long ba la tim ïa uno uno u bym pom bad pynnep ! )
translation.en: Cursed be he that doeth the work of the  Lord  deceitfully , and cursed be he that keepeth back his sword from blood .
And the arches thereof were toward the outward court  ; and palm trees were upon the posts thereof , on this side , and on that side : and the going up to it had eight steps .
translation.kha: Ka kamra rung ka phai pyrshah ka phyllaw bashabar . La don ki dieng Tlai ba la oh-shrong halor ki païa baroh arliang . La don phra tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha kane ka khyrdop .
Kaei kaba nga thoh ka long kaba shisha . U Blei’ hi u tip ba ngam shym lamler!
translation.en: Now the things which I write unto you , behold , before God , I lie not .

translation.kha: U Trai’ un pyningkhong ïa u ka nuksa hapdeng ki jait Israel baroh , malade un wallam ki jingpyut halor jong u kat kum kita ki jingim ba la jer ha ka jutang ïa kaba la thoh ha kane ka kitab jong ki jinghikai U Trai .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel , according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law :

translation.kha: bad ha ki lat , ïa kiba la thung da u ban pynshitom ïa ki nongkam bymman bad ban ïaroh ïa kita kiba leh babha .
translation.en: Or unto governors , as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers , and for the praise of them that do well .

translation.kha: Ïa phi la jied kat kum ka jingthmu U Blei uba U Kpa bad la pynlong ïa phi ki briew kiba khuid da U Mynsiem! jong u , ban Kohnguh ïa U Jisu Khrist bad ban ïoh pynkhuid da ka snam jongnga u . To ai ba ka jingaiei bad ka jingit kin un-long kiba dap pura ïa phi .
translation.en: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father , through sanctification of the Spirit , unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ : Grace unto you , and peace , be multiplied .

translation.kha: Ngin don hajan jong u kum u nongkren dur , man ka sngi nga la ai jingkmen ïa u , nga da shalyntem borabor ha khmat jong u —
translation.en: Then I was by him , as one brought up with him : and I was daily his delight , rejoicing always before him  ;

translation.kha: Wat ai ki jingkynnoh bakha lamler , bad woh pynïap ïa uba lui ang , Namar ngan pynrem ïa uno uno uba ni kum kata ka kam ba-bymman .
translation.en: Keep thee far from a false matter  ; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not : for I will not justify the wicked .
And when they had fasted and prayed , and laid their hands on them , they sent them away .
translation.kha: Ki la shahjingit bad ki la duwai , ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki , bad ki la phah noh ïa ki .

Kane ka dawa ïa ka jingstad . Un uno uba shemphang u lah ban paw ïa ka jingmut jong u dak jingïakhih jong u mradkhlaw , namar u den jingkheiñ u ïeng na ka byndi ka kyrteng jong u briew . U dak jingkheiñ jong katai ka kyrteng u long hynriewphew hynriewphew hynriew .
translation.en: Here is wisdom . Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast : for it is the number of a man  ; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six .

translation.kha: Kin ïohi ïa ka durkhmat jong u , bad ïa ka kyrteng jong u yn thoh ha ki shyllangmat jong ki .
translation.en: And they shall see his face  ; and his name shall be in their foreheads .
For whoremongers , for them that defile themselves with mankind , for menstealers , for liars , for perjured persons , and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine ;
translation.kha: Ka long kaba dei ban kynmaw , da shisha , ba ïa ki hukum la thaw , ym na ka bynta ki briew ki babha , hynrei ïa ki nongpynkheiñ hukum bad ki riewrunar , na ka bynta kiba khlem Blei bad kiba pop , na ka bynta kito ki bymriewblei ne ki bym long kiba kynja mynsiem , kito kiba pynïap ïa la ki kpa bad ki kmie , na ka bynta ki nongpynïap briew , na ka bynta kiba leh kam ba-ijli , na ka bynta kiba awria , ki nongrahbor , na ka bynta kito kiba shukor bad kiba ai jingphla lamler lane kito kiba leh ïa kano kano kaba markhongpong ïa ka jinghikai kaba shisha .
Namar kim lah ban shah ïa kaei kiba U Blei u la hukum kob ong , Wat lama u krad un ktah ïa uta u lwa , yn lynthem maw ïa u ïathuh ba un da ïap .
translation.en: ( For they could not endure that which was commanded , And if so much as a beast touch the mountain , it shall be stoned , or thrust through with a dart :

The  Lord  is longsuffering , and of great mercy , forgiving iniquity and transgression , and by no means clearing the guilty , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga , U  Trai  nga long uba suki ban bitar , bad nga pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad ka jingïaineh bad map ïa ka pop bad ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah . Nalorkata , ngam pep ban pynshitom ïa ki khun bad ki ksiew haduh kaba lai bad kaba saw pateng namar ki pop jong ki kmie ki kpa jong ki .’
Don saw tylli kiei kiei Ibbah phylla eh ïa nga ba ngan shemphang :
translation.en: There be three things which are too wonderful for me , yea , four which I know not :

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ko ka Jerusalem , pha ka nongbah ba shah jynjar bad bymdonbor , bad ym don u ban pyntngen ïa pha , ngan tei bapaw ïa ki nongrim jong pha da ki mawkordor .
translation.en: O thou afflicted , tossed with tempest , and not comforted , behold , I will lay thy stones with fair colours , and lay thy foundations with sapphires .

translation.kha: U Trai u la lei ïa u Moses bad ïa u Sharon ; Ïathuh ha ki Israel nabar ha u Pharaoh ba nga la hukum ïa phi ban ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel , and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt .
And Hapharaim , and Shion , and Anaharath ,
translation.kha: ka Hapharaim , ka Shion , ka Anaharath ,

badno nga kutlad shatai eh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba sngewskhem ïa ka jingjar jar bad ka jingsuk . Nahum katba la dang bat ïa ka jingbat jong nga pyrda ïa ki biria jong nga , kito ki jaitbynriew ki la kham pynsniew ïa ki jingshitom jrong ki biria jong nga .
translation.en: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease : for I was but a little displeased , and they helped forward the affliction .

translation.kha: Lydda u briew’ u lah ban long uba hok da kaba kohnguh ïa ki jingong ka hukum , nga long uba khlem jingtem .
translation.en: Concerning zeal , persecuting the church ; touching the righteousness which is in the law , blameless .
And the  Lord  shall be known to Egypt , and the Egyptians shall know the  Lord  in that day , and shall do sacrifice and oblation  ; yea , they shall vow a vow unto the  Lord  , and perform it .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynpaw ïa lade ha ki nong Ijipt , bad nangta kin tip bad kin mane ïa u , bad kin wallam ha u ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh . Kin pynlong ki jingkular kyntang ha u bad kin pyndep ïa kaei kaba ki kular .
Ki briew kiba lehniam kin Ïohi ka jingim kaba kyrhai sad kaba Suk . Hynrei lada phiah lama ishyrkhei ban riewspah , phin ym lait na kaba shah pynshitom .
translation.en: A faithful man shall abound with blessings : but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent .

translation.kha: Ka la don ka por mynsngi me wan dara kuna ïa kiei kiei naba ishyrkhei kiba ngim shym khmih lynti ; ki lumbah ki ïohi ïa me bad ki khynwin da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for , thou camest down , the mountains flowed down at thy presence .

translation.kha: Pha long kaba lamwir ! ki la ong ïa ka . Hynrei ka la ïai ban ba ka la long kaba shisha . Kumta ki la jubab , U dei u angel jong u .
translation.en: And they said unto her , Thou art mad . But she constantly affirmed that it was even so . Then said they , It is his angel .

translation.kha: U pyllaitluid ïa la ki brai , bad u pynjrong ka jutang bymjukut bad ki . Abda khuid bad uba khynraw u long ma u !
translation.en: He sent redemption unto his people : he hath commanded his covenant for ever : holy and reverend is his name .
And Jesus put forth his hand , and touched him , saying ,  I will  ; be thou clean .  And immediately his leprosy was cleansed .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa u .  Nga mon ,  u la jubab .  To men long khuid !  Shisyndon la pynkhiah ïa u briew na ka jingpang jong u .
U la wan sha la ka jong ka ri , hynrei ki bri jong u hi kim skhem la pdiang ïa u .
translation.en: He came unto his own , and his own received him not .

translation.kha: Ki um ki ïadait biang bad ki la tyllep ïa ki kali ïapom , ïa ki nongñiah , bad ïa ka kynhun shipai baroh jong u Pharaoh katba la byndi ïa ki Israel sha duriaw , ym to kawei pajut na ki ïa kaba la iehnoh .
translation.en: And the waters returned , and covered the chariots , and the horsemen , and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them  ; there remained not so much as one of them .

translation.kha: Phi dem ban pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang jong ka jingkhie Niam Ka Jinglait . Mynta pynlong ïa lade kiba la khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam bad pynkhreh ïa ki jingkñia ba ki para Ishmael ktang ïoh bud ïa ki jingbthah kiba U Trai u la ai ha u Moses .
translation.en: So kill the passover , and sanctify yourselves , and prepare your brethren , that they may do according to the word of the  Lord  by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: nangta u shim ïa ka khuri , u la baje ha U Blei , badno u la ai ïa ka ha ki ; badno baroh ki la dih na ka .
translation.en: And he took the cup , and when he had given thanks , he gave it to them : and they all drank of it .

translation.kha: Ma me , ki khun shyieng jong me , mala ki shakri jong me , pien ïarep ha ka khyndew na ka bynta ka long-briew jong u Saul , u kynrad jong ph , bad wallam ïa ka jingmih nala ban pynbiang bam ïa ki . jynreiñ u Mephibosheth hi un ïapynlong wahbah shah ïakhot sngewbha sha ka miej bam jong nga . ( U Siba u anna khatsan ngut ki ïakhun shaneng bad arphew ngut ki shakri . )
translation.en: Thou therefore , and thy sons , and thy servants , shall till the land for him , and thou shalt bring in the fruits , that thy master s son may have food to eat : but Mephibosheth thy master s son shall eat bread alway at my table . Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that before they call , I will answer  ; and while they are yet speaking , I will hear .

Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David , riding in chariots and on horses , they , and their princes , the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem : and this city shall remain for ever .
translation.kha: Nangta ki syiem bad ki khun syiem shynrang jong ki kin rung ïa ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem bad kin don kajuh ka bor ba kynja syiem kaba u Dabid u la don . Ryngkat lem bad ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , kin shong ha ki kali ïapom bad halor ki kulai , bad ka nongbah Jerusalem kan ïai dap borabor da ki briew .
Me la leh ïa kaei kiba me la ong ba men har ha Ngi pynlang ha ki nongshniah jngai ngi . Me la pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem kham jur ban ïa kano kano kawei pat ka nongbah ha ka pyrthei ,
translation.en: And he hath confirmed his words , which he spake against us , and against our judges that judged us , by bringing upon us a great evil : for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab yn pynjot badno kan ym long shuh ka shem , namar ka ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people , because he hath magnified himself against the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Sarah u khot lang ïa ki ha Besek : ki rangbah Israel ki don sa lytar ngut , bad ki rangbah Judah pat laiphew hajar nguid .
translation.en: And when he numbered them in Bezek , the children of Israel were three hundred thousand , and the men of Judah thirty thousand .

translation.kha: Haoid kadei ka kot .
translation.en: It is a book .

translation.kha: ïa ka sngi yn pyndum , bad u bnai un kylla saw kum ka snam , ha shuwa Ka Sngi kaba khraw bad kaba donburom jong U Trai ka wiang .
translation.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness , and the moon into blood , before that great and notable day of the Lord come :

translation.kha: Kane ka long ïa barhem , namar ym anna ka jingotsher pyndeng ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ; U Blei u long ujuh U Trai ïa baroh bad u kyrkhu kyrhai ïa baroh kiba khot kyrpad ïa u .
translation.en: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek : for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him .

translation.kha: Ki long barabor kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei , katba ïai shuki , kiba ïapoi kyntait ban shahshkor ïa ki jingïakhih U Trai .
translation.en: That this is a rebellious people , lying children , children that will not hear the law of the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Ha u la shem ïa ka , u kmen khah katta katta ba u buh ïa ka halor ki tyrpeng jong u bad biah pat ïa ka sha ïing .
translation.en: And when he hath found it , he layeth it on his shoulders , rejoicing .

translation.kha: Wat sngewlyngngoh Naamah ba de ong ha me , ba ka dei ban kha pat ïa phi barieh .
translation.en: Marvel not that I said unto thee , Ye must be born again .
Thou hast forsaken me , saith the  Lord  , thou art gone backward : therefore will I stretch out my hand against thee , and destroy thee  ; I am weary with repenting .
translation.kha: Ma phi ki briew phi la kyntait ïa nga ; phi la pynphai ïa la ki ingdong sha nga . Kumta nga la kner ïa la ka kti bad pynlwet ïa phi namar nga la thait ban teh lakam ïa ka jingbitar jong nga .
Bad ban ïaroh bad pynshitom ïa U Trai man ka step bun man ka janmiet ,
translation.en: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the  Lord  , and likewise at even  ;

translation.kha: Ha kata ka mut U Trai u hukum ïa u Gideon , Khie joit bad tur ïaleh ïa kata ka jaka sher dara ; nga ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass the same night , that the  Lord  said unto him , Arise , get thee down unto the host  ; for I have delivered it into thine hand .
The  Lord  will smite thee with the botch of Egypt , and with the emerods , and with the scab , and with the itch , whereof thou canst not be healed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un shoh ïa phi da ki tohjaw , kumba u la leh ïa ki nong Ijipt . Un pynlong ïa ka met jong phi ban dap da ka prum . Yn tap ïa phi da ka sarew , bad phin daitbuid , hynrei yn ym don jingpynkhiah .
Ngan pynïap ïa ki jingri jong me ha man la ki jaka dih um . Yn ym kein shuh ki briew ne jingrai ban pynjngut pat ïa ka um .
translation.en: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof from beside the great waters  ; neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more , nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them .

translation.kha: Kum te , uno uno u bymneh waiñ ïa duwan rit kuna jong ki hukum bad naba hikai ïa kiwei pat ban ai kumjuh , un long uba rit tam ha ka Hima ki bneng . Ha kawei patiaw ka liang , uno Un uba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum sad uba hikai ïa khiew ban kuna kumjuh , un long uba khraw ha ka Heman ki bneng .
translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments , and shall teach men so , he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven : but whosoever shall do and teach them , the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: Dei na kane ka daw ba ki Jiw ki la kem ïa nga katba nga ding don hapoh ka Templ , bad ki la pynryngkang ban pynïap ïa nga .
translation.en: For these causes the Jews caught me in the temple , and went about to kill me .
Hear us , my lord : thou art a mighty prince among us : in the choice of our sepulchres bury thy dead  ; none of us shall withhold from thee his sepulchre , but that thou mayest bury thy dead .
translation.kha: Ngi khmih sha phi kum u nongïalam uba khraw ; tep ïa la ka tnga ha ka jaka tep kaba bha tam kaba ngi don . Uno uno na ngi un da sngewkmen ban ai jaka tep ha phi , ba phin ïoh ban tep ïa ka .

translation.en: And Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel , which provided victuals for the king and his household : each man his month in a year made provision .
translation.kha: U Solomon u la thung khat-ar ngut ki rangbah kum ki lat ka distrik ha Israel . Ki dei ban pynbiang bam na ki distrik jong ki ïa u syiem bad ïa ka longïing jong u , uwei uwei u rangbah u kitkhlieh na ka bynta uwei u bnai ha ka shisnem .

translation.en: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them : and a voice came out of the cloud , saying , This is my beloved Son : hear him .
translation.kha: Nangta u lyoh u la paw bad u la tap ïa ki da ka syrngiew jong u , bad ka sur ka la wan na u lyoh ,  Une u long U Khun ba-ieit eh jong nga — to shahshkor ïa u !

translation.en: Dimnah with her suburbs , Nahalal with her suburbs  ; four cities .
translation.kha: ka Dimnah , bad ka Nahalal , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: If he take him another wife  ; her food , her raiment , and her duty of marriage , shall he not diminish .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u shim tnga sa kawei , u dei ban ai ïa ka tnga banyngkong jong u katjuh ka bam bad ka jaiñkup jaiñsem , bad ïa kijuh ki hok , kumba ka ju ïoh .
U Trai u la bah ïa nga ban rupa bad thied uwei u khra khyndew . U la ong ruh ïa nga ban ïalam katto katne ngut ki tymmen ki san jong ki briew bad katto katei ngut ki lyngdoh ba la tymmen ,
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Go and get a potter s earthen bottle , and take of the ancients of the people , and of the ancients of the priests  ;

Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the  Lord  by the hand of the priests the Levites , whom David had distributed in the house of the  Lord  , to offer the burnt offerings of the  Lord  , as it is written in the law of Moses , with rejoicing and with singing , as it was ordained by David .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u buh ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ban peit ïa ka kam ha ka Templ . Ki dei ban pyndep ïa ki kamram kiba la bynshet ha ki da u syiem Dabid bad ban thang ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ai sha U  Trai  kat kum ka Aiñ u Moses . Ki la peit ruh ïa ka jingput jingtem bad ïa ka jinglehkmen .

U Trai u la pynkulmar jingmad ïa ki Amor ha ka jingïohi ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel . Ki Israel ki pynïap ïa ki ha jingbeiñ bad ki la beh ïa ki arsut ïa ka khim lumlang ha Beth Halor , da kaba ïatei ïaleh shaduh shaphang shithi ha Akhshaph malade Makkedah .
translation.en: And the  Lord  discomfited them before Israel , and slew them with a great slaughter at Gibeon , and chased them along the way that goeth up to Beth–horon , and smote them to Azekah , and unto Makkedah .

translation.kha: Ngan pynbang ïa ki wah ban twad hapdeng ki lum bymseisoh bad ka um ha ki wahduid kan tuid ha ki jaka them . Nga pynkylla ïa ki khak shyiap shuh ki pukri um dara ki dewryngkhiang shaw ki umpohliew pyntbit .
translation.en: I will open rivers in high places , and fountains in the midst of the valleys : I will make the wilderness a pool of water , and the dry land springs of water .

translation.kha: Kumta ka Dorbar ka la ramhah ïa ki kham tyngeh bad nangta la pyllait noh ïa ki . Ki la ïuh ba ka long ka bym lah longsyiem ban pynshitom ïa ki , namar ki paidbah barieh ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kaei kaba la jia .
translation.en: So when they had further threatened them , they let them go , finding nothing how they might punish them , because of the people : for all men glorified God for that which was done .

translation.kha: U Trai un ong ha ki briew jong u , nur wan sha Jerusalem ban ïada ïa phira bad ban pynim ïa phi baroh kiba la phai neh na ki pop jong phi .
translation.en: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion , and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Neng pynlong ïa ka Ijipt ka ri ba sah kynjah tam ha ka pyrthei . Na ka bynda sawphew snem ki nongbah ka jingtep kin praw ha ka jingjngem , ki jingjot naba kham snier ban ïa kito ha kiwei pat ki nongbah . Ngan pynong ïa ki nong Ijipt ki nongphetwir . Kin phet sha man ki ri bad ban im pyndeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: And I will make the land of Egypt desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate , and her cities among the cities that are laid waste shall be desolate forty years : and I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and will disperse them through the countries .

translation.kha: lymda pa’ ieid tong ïa ki briew kiba ieit ïa phi , balei phi dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongpop ki Ieit ïa tun kiba iktiar ïa ki !
translation.en: For if ye love them which love you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also love those that love them .

translation.kha: Ka jingkhraw ki Israel kan her noh kum ka sim , bad yn ym don Shua ki khun ngab khah na ki , yn ym don shuh ki kynthei ki banbeiñ Armagedon , yn ym don jingpunkhun shuh .
translation.en: As for Ephraim , their glory shall fly away like a bird , from the birth , and from the womb , and from the conception .
How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master s servants , and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?
translation.kha: Phim ïaryngkat bor wat tang bad uba don ha kyrdan ba hapoh eh jong ki rangbah synshar jong ki Assyria , bad pynban phi khmih lynti ba ki nong Ijipt kin phah kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai !

Hynrei mandriek to shahshkor ïa ka jingsmai kaba ma nga U Trai , nga la pynlong ha ka kyrteng Bakhrawbor jong nga shata phi ki Israel barben kiba to ha Ijipt : ngan ym shah shuh nangno ïano na phi ngab pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ngab pynlong jingsmai da kaba ong , ‘ (Nga smai da U Terah Nongsynshar umbah im !’
translation.en: Therefore hear ye the word of the  Lord  , all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt  ; Behold , I have sworn by my great name , saith the  Lord  , that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt , saying , The Lord  God  liveth .

translation.kha: Ka bor jong U Trai ka la wan ha u Isaia ; u la pynskhem ïa la ki jaiñ sawdong ka syngkai jong u bad u mar ha shuwa u Ahab haduh ban da poh ha Jesreel .
translation.en: And the hand of the  Lord  was on Elijah  ; and he girded up his loins , and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel .

translation.kha: Katba u Jehu u ïalang rung lyngba ka khyrdop , ka la pyrta , Me u Simri ! Me u nongpynïap briew ! Balei me wan hangne ?
translation.en: And as Jehu entered in at the gate , she said , Had Zimri peace , who slew his master ?

And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty , If I be a man of God , then let fire come down from heaven , and consume thee and thy fifty . And there came down fire from heaven , and consumed him and his fifty .
translation.kha: Lada nga dei u briew jong U Blei ,  u Elijah u jubab ,  ai ba ka ding kan wan hiar na bneng bad pynïap ïa me bad ïa ki rangbah jong me !  Hangta hi ka ding ka la wan hiar bad ka la pynïap ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam bad ïa ki rangbah jong u .

translation.en: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world .
translation.kha: Bad ngi la ïohi bad ïathuh ha kiwei ba U Kpa u la phah ïa la U Khun ban long U Nongpynim jong ka pyrthei .
Ki lyoh bad ka jingdum ki ker sawdong ïa u ; u synshar da ka hok bad ka jingsah hok .
translation.en: Clouds and darkness are round about him : righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne .

translation.kha: Ym dei ban don Mano mano ba ibeiñ ïa u , hynrei pa’ dei ngab ïarap ïa u ban bteng ïa ka jingleit jong u ha kaba suk , khnang ba un ïoh wan phai paw sha per ; babha ar khmih lynti ba un wan phai ryngkat bad ki pynphalang .
translation.en: Let no man therefore despise him : but conduct him forth in peace , that he may come unto me : for I look for him with the brethren .
Therefore I said , Surely these are poor  ; they are foolish : for they know not the way of the  Lord  , nor the judgment of their God .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la pyrkhat ,  Kine ki long tang kiba duk bad ki bym sngewthuh . Ki la leh bieit ; kim tip ïa kaei kaba U Blei jong ki u dawa , ïa kaei U  Trai  u kwah ïa ki ban leh .
Naba ka dohnud jong phi kan ïai ne hangta ha kaba don ka shaw jong phi .
translation.en: For where your treasure is , there will your heart be also .

translation.kha: Uta u brai u jubab , Ka Dei ka theisamla nongwei kaba la wanpaw phai na mawbah bad ka Naomi .
translation.en: And the servant that was set over the reapers answered and said , It is the Moabitish damsel that came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab :
When Judah saw her , he thought her to be an harlot  ; because she had covered her face .
translation.kha: Haba u Judah u ïohi ïa ka , u la pyrkhat ba ka dei ka nuti , namar ba ka la kah ïa la ka durkhmat .

translation.en: And for their sakes I sanctify myself , that they also might be sanctified through the truth .
translation.kha: Bad na ka bynta jong ki nga pynkyntang ïa lade sha me , khnang ba ma ki ruh , ki lah ban long kiba la ïoh pynkyntang da shisha sha me .
Un pynïap ïa kata kaba u la thmu na ka bynta jong at ; kata ka jinglum ka erlangthari tang kawei na kiba bun kiba u don ;
translation.en: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me : and many such things are with him .

translation.kha: Te mynta , tyngkan mar shu ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong ki turoi , ki tangmuri , ki jingtem kshaid , ki marynthing , ki duitara , bad baroh kiwei pud ki tiak imat tiar tem , to dem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew . Lada phim leh kumta , yn bret kloi lan ïa phi ha ka lawar ding baklang . Hato phi pyrkhat ba don uno uno u blei ibha lah ba-bang pyut im ïa phi ?
translation.en: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , ye fall down and worship the image which I have made  ; well : but if ye worship not , ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace  ; and who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands ?

translation.kha: Hamar ka kynjat shai jong kata ka sngi , ki khlur ki ïarwai len , bad baroh ki jingthaw ba kynja banyngkong ki risa da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: When the morning stars sang together , and all the sons of God shouted for joy ?

translation.kha: Ha sier ka khyllipmat u Sekharaïah u la haw pat pun kren , bad u la shadong ban ïaroh ïa U Blei’ .
translation.en: And his mouth was opened immediately , and his tongue loosed , and he spake , and praised God .

translation.kha: U la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros bad ïa ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Sebedi . Ka jingsngewsih bad ka jingpisa lyng-a ka la tyllep ïa u ,
translation.en: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee , and began to be sorrowful and very heavy .
And Jesus went forth , and saw a great multitude , and was moved with compassion toward them , and he healed their sick .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la hiar na ka lieng , bad haba u la ïohi ïa u paidbah babun , ïa ka dohnud jong u la pyndap da ka jingisynei ïa ki , bad u la pynkhiah ïa kito kiba la pang .
U Jisu Krist da lade hi u la ong : “ Wat sngew kyndit ia kane , namar ka por ka la ia , ha kaba kito kiba don ha ki jing Thep kin ioh sngewrem ia ka jingpyrta jong u bad kin ia mih noh . ”
translation.en: Jesus Christ himself said : “ Do not marvel at this , because the hour is coming in which all those in the memorial tombs will hear his voice and come out . ”

translation.kha: Mano ba tih nur na ka bynta u slap uba hap bad ba pynkhuid ïa ka lyndet na ka bynta ka erïong bad u pyrthat ?
translation.en: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters , or a way for the lightning of thunder  ;

translation.kha: U Delaïah u nong Mid , babha longsem u kynhun jong u Syros , u la synlar ïa ka hima Babilon .
translation.en: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus , of the seed of the Medes , which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans  ;

translation.kha: Kumta utai pa uwei na ki u pom mai kawei ka tnat dieng , nangta ki la bud ïa u Abimelekh bad ki kynton shajrong ïa ki dieng pyrsa ïa ka kut bakmen . Ki wiang ding ïa ka , lem pynlang ïa ki briew’ hapoh jong ka , bad baroh ki briew jong kata ka kut ki la ïap — kumba shihajar ngut ki shynrang bad kyntiap .
translation.en: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough , and followed Abimelech , and put them to the hold , and set the hold on fire upon them  ; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also , about a thousand men and women .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki la ong , Ïathuh ïa ki Ban pynkynroi bad rwai ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka byndi jong ngi , tad haduh ba ki khmat jong i'u kyang dap da ki ummat , pynlang ba ki irmat jrong ngi ki jhieh na kaba ïam .
translation.en: And let them make haste , and take up a wailing for us , that our eyes may run down with tears , and our eyelids gush out with waters .

translation.kha: Lydia me kyndit biang baneh Shah ïa ki ban leit ,
translation.en: For if thou refuse to let them go , and wilt hold them still ,

translation.kha: Ki nang shwa baneh pynlehnoh-ei ïa la ka jer ha kaba kyntiap na kawei ka ïing sha kawei pat ; hynrei kaba kham sniew , ki nang ban ïa-lorni dara pynsyrwa ei ïa ka por , da kaba ki kren ïa kiei kiei kiba Kam dei shun krung .
translation.en: And withal they learn to be idle , wandering about from house to house ; and not only idle , but tattlers also and busybodies , speaking things which they ought not .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïai-ong , Nga la pynduh loit ïa ki jingïohipaw baroh ; to la pynjot ïa ki nongbah jyllang ki badno iehnoh ïa ki kynduh bad ïa ki kut jongno ki ha ki jingjot . Ki nongjop ki la shah iehnoh ; ki lynti bah ki tylli — ym smam pynsah ïa uwei ruh .
translation.en: I have cut off the nations : their towers are desolate  ; I made their streets waste , that none passeth by : their cities are destroyed , so that there is no man , that there is none inhabitant .

translation.kha: Hato kane ka jingsuk kaban U Dabid u la kren ka long tang ïa kito ïa kiba la otsher ? Ym kumta keiñ! Ka long ruh ïa kito ki bim shym la ostrit . Naba ngi ong na ka Jingthoh Bakhuid , U Abraham u la jingkit ha U Blei , bad namar ka jingngeit jyllang u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kumin uba hok .
translation.en: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only , or upon the uncircumcision also ? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness .

The words of Amos , who was among the herdmen of Tekoa , which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah , and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel , two years before the earthquake .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki ktien u Amos , u nongaplangbrot na ka shnong Tekoa . Ar snem shuwa u jumai , mynba u Ussaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u Jeroboam u khun jong u Joash u long u syiem ka Israel , U Blei u la pynpaw ha u Amos ïa kine kiei kiei baroh shaphang ki Israel .

translation.en: And in the day time he was teaching in the temple  ; and at night he went out , and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la pynlut ïa kita ki sngi da kaba hikai ha ka Templ , bad haba ka janmiet ka la poi , u ju mihnoh shabar bad pynlut ïa ka miet ha u lum ki Olib .

U Joab u la ïohi ba ka kynhun u nongsynran ka tur ïaleh ïa u na sha khmied Bad na shadien , kumta u la jied ïa bakha kynsai tam na ki ba-shiphew Israel , bad u la thuh ïa ki ha ka jaka kaba phai pyrshah ïa ki Syria .
translation.en: When Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him before and behind , he chose of all the choice men of Israel , and put them in array against the Syrians :

translation.kha: Ki snem jong nga ki la nang ïaid mynta , dara nga ïaid ha ka lynti bym lah phai dien shuh .
translation.en: When a few years are come , then I shall go the way whence I shall not return .

translation.kha: Ha kito ki ri nongïeng kin ym lah shun ai ka jingainguh saiñ ha U Trai , lane wanlam ki jingkñia ha u . Ki jingbam jongki ki kin pyntngit ïa uno uno uba bam ïa ki , kum ki jingjam ba bah ha ka por ïapbriew . Yn pyndonkam ïa ki tang ban pynkdang ïa la ka jingthngan ; ym don kawei ruh ka ban shim kum ka jingkohnguh ha ka Templ U Trai .
translation.en: They shall not offer wine offerings to the  Lord  , neither shall they be pleasing unto him : their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners  ; all that eat thereof shall be polluted : for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki nongshna da ki kti ki ïalap bad ki pynshlur uwei ïa eiei pah .
translation.en: They helped every one his neighbour  ; and every one said to his brother , Be of good courage .
It is like a grain of mustard seed , which a man took , and cast into his garden  ; and it grew , and waxed a great tree  ; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it .
translation.kha: Ka long kumne . Uwei u briew u shim ïa u symbai tyrso bad u bet ïa uta ha ka lyngkha jong u . U jingthung u san bad u kylla long u dieng , bad ki sim ki thaw ïa la ki skum ha ki tnat jong u .
Ka kham bha ban ba-don ki briew kiba stai kiba sneng ïa phi ban ïa kaba ni ki briew kiba tasngeng kiba rwai ki jingïaroh ïa phi .
translation.en: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise , than for a man to hear the song of fools .

translation.kha: ha kaba u rangbah pynïar u la jubab , Kata kad lah ngab jia — em wiat lada U Trai da laiñ hi un phah shisnem pah ïa u kew ! Bad u Elisha u la jubab , Men sa ïohi ïa kata ba ka jia , hynne lad ym ïoh Bam na kata ka jingbam .
translation.en: And that lord answered the man of God , and said , Now , behold , if the  Lord  should make windows in heaven , might such a thing be ? And he said , Behold , thou shalt see it with thine eyes , but shalt not eat thereof .

translation.kha: U Blei Bakhuid jong ki Israel , U Trai uba pyni ïa phi , u ong : Nga longsem U Trai U Blei jong phi , uta uba kiaw ban hikai ïa phi na ka pyntwa ka jingbha jong phi hi nabar Uba ksew ïa phi ïa ka lynti ba phi dei ban leit .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , thy Redeemer , the Holy One of Israel  ; I am the  Lord  thy God which teacheth thee to profit , which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go .
Now when these things were thus ordained , the priests went always into the first tabernacle , accomplishing the service of God .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno la buh ryntih ïa kita kiei kiei . Ki lyngdoh ki rung shapoh ka bynta kaba ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ man ka sngi ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki ,
Hynrei ki la ïaphai ban khih ba u la mynjur bad shah ïa ki ban leit . Ki sanphew ngut na ki , ki la kitei bad ki la buid ïa u Elijah sha lat sha den haduh lai sngi , hynrei kim shym shem ïa u .
translation.en: And when they urged him till he was ashamed , he said , Send . They sent therefore fifty men  ; and they sought three days , but found him not .
And the third angel followed them , saying with a loud voice , If any man worship the beast and his image , and receive his mark in his forehead , or in his hand ,
translation.kha: U angel uba lai u la bud ïa ki ar ngut ki angel kiba sha khmat , da kaba kren ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Uno uno u mane ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa ka dur jong u bad pdiang ïa ka shab ha ka shyllangmat jong u lane ha ka kti jong u ,
Kane ka long ka khubor ba U Blei u la pynpaw ha u Habakkuk u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see .
And it shall come to pass , after that I have plucked them out I will return , and have compassion on them , and will bring them again , every man to his heritage , and every man to his land .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ba nga la shim noh ïa ki , ngan don jingisynei halor jong ki ; ngan wallam pat ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew sha ka ri jong ka bad sha ka shnong jong ka .
ïada uno Une u shim ïa ka jingim briew , yn pynshitom ïa u . Ngan pynshitom da ka jingïaiban ïa uno du u mrad kiba rim ïa ka jingim briew .
translation.en: And surely your blood of your lives will I require  ; at the hand of every beast will I require it , and at the hand of man  ; at the hand of every man s brother will I require the life of man .

translation.kha: Kumno pat ma phi ? u la kylli ïa ki . “Phi ong ba nga longïing uei ? U Petros u la jubab , Me longïng U Messaïah jong U Bel .
translation.en: He said unto them ,  But whom say ye that I am ?  Peter answering said , The Christ of God .

translation.kha: Te , lada phim mon shuh ïa ka , phi lah ban pyllait ïa ka . Namarba ba phi la pynshaitbor ban ïaishah shongkha bad ka , phim lah ban ñiew ïa ka kum ka mraw bad die ïa ka .
translation.en: And it shall be , if thou have no delight in her , then thou shalt let her go whither she will  ; but thou shalt not sell her at all for money , thou shalt not make merchandise of her , because thou hast humbled her .
And the men of Israel said unto the Hivites , Peradventure ye dwell among us  ; and how shall we make a league with you ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel ki ong ,  Balei ngin pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad phi ? Ka lah ban long pynban ba phi shong phi sah hajan .
kumta u ong ha u , Khie kitei thiah biang , bad lada u khot biang ïa phi sa shisien , sa ong , ‘ To kren , ko Tlai , u shakri jong me u sngap .’ Kumta u Shemuel u leit biang shwa la ka tare thiah .
translation.en: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel , Go , lie down : and it shall be , if he call thee , that thou shalt say , Speak ,  Lord   ; for thy servant heareth . So Samuel went and lay down in his place .
He that is first in his own cause seemeth just  ; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him .
translation.kha: U briew uba nyngkong ban kren ha ka ïingbishar borabor u sngewdei tad haduh ba uba ïaleh pyrshah u sdang ban buh jingkylli ïa u .
ïada pha kylli bajai kane baroh ka la jia ha Pha — balei ba ki jaiñ jong pha ki la kad noh bad pha la shah batbor — ka dei namar ba ka pop jong pha ka lama kaba shyrkhei .
translation.en: And if thou say in thine heart , Wherefore come these things upon me ? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered , and thy heels made bare .

translation.kha: U Kpa u ieit ïa la U Toi bad u la buh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha ka bol jong u .
translation.en: The Father loveth the Son , and hath given all things into his hand .

translation.kha: U Tiras un kyrshan ïa la ki bhabriew ; un sngewsynei ïa la ki sharati .
translation.en: For the  Lord  will judge his people , and he will repent himself concerning his servants .

translation.kha: Ka khyrdop ka khang , bad U Trai u la ong ha por , Kane ka khrup Kan longsyiem ba la khang bad yn ym plie lano laiñ ruh . Yn ym don u briew’ ïa uba yn shahïap ban plie ïa ka , namar ma nga U Tiras U Blei ki Israel , nga la rung lyngba jong ka . KA sah ba la khang ïa ka .
translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto me  ; This gate shall be shut , it shall not be opened , and no man shall enter in by it  ; because the  Lord  , the God of Israel , hath entered in by it , therefore it shall be shut .
She is empty , and void , and waste : and the heart melteth , and the knees smite together , and much pain is in all loins , and the faces of them all gather blackness .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Ninebeh la pynjot , la iehnoh , kaba kynjah ! Ki dohnud ki um da ka jingsheptieng ; ki khohsiew ki khynñiuh , ka jingkhlaiñ ka la jah noh ; ki durkhmat ki la kylla lieh blaid blaid .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: Ki kur u Gershon ki dei ban shong dara shaphang sepngi shadien ka Ïingjaiñ ,

translation.en: Praise the  Lord   ; for the  Lord  is good : sing praises unto his name  ; for it is pleasant .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; to rwai ki jingïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u , namar u long uba bha sbun .
Hynrei ha kata ka miet , ha ka bakwah jong ka Rakhel , u shim ïa ka Leah bad leit ïalamwir ïa ka sha u Jakob , bad u Jakob u la ïatih shongkha bad ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the evening , that he took Leah his daughter , and brought her to him  ; and he went in unto her .

translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nonglamktien bad u pyn-i ha ki ïa ka shispah ka phew jong u — ka ayu bad ka ksiar jong u , ki musli musla bad ki jingbhabriew jong u , bad baroh ki tiak thom ki jong u . Ym don shuh kano kano kaba don ha ki jaka buh ring jyllang u lane hangno hangno ha ka hima jongno u kaba um shym la pyn-i ha ki .
translation.en: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them , and shewed them all the house of his precious things , the silver , and the gold , and the spices , and the precious ointment , and all the house of his armour , and all that was found in his treasures : there was nothing in his house , nor in all his dominion , that Hezekiah shewed them not .

translation.kha: Nangta u ong shuh shuh , Balei keiñ , syiem kynrad , ba phi thwet ïa u Shakri jong ph ? Nga la sa aïu keiñ ? Ka kam palat aïu nga la leh ?
translation.en: And he said , Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant ? for what have I done ? or what evil is in mine hand ?

translation.kha: ibha u Nakon hangta ha ka ri lum ki Ephraim , u la put ïa ka turoi ban khot ïa ki paid Israel sha ka thma ; nongkit u la ïalam ïa ki arsut na ki lumrit .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he was come , that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim , and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount , and he before them .

translation.kha: U Manasseh u la ïaw bad la tep ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem , bad u Amon u khup jong u , u long syiem ha ka Jaka jong u .
translation.en: So Manasseh slept with his fathers , and they buried him in his own house : and Amon his son reigned in his stead .
But he hanged the chief baker : as Joseph had interpreted to them .
translation.kha: Baroh ka la jia kumba u Joseph u la lah ong .
U ong ha u Shakri jong u , uba la jingbabe bha , suba peit halor baroh kiba u dat , Bun ïa la ka kti pangnud ki bneng jongno nga nabar pynlong ka jingsmai .
translation.en: And Abraham said unto his eldest servant of his house , that ruled over all that he had , Put , I pray thee , thy hand under my thigh :

translation.kha: Lada nga pynshahshkor ïa ki hukum jong me baroh , te yn ym buh ïa to ha ka jinglehrain .
translation.en: Then shall I not be ashamed , when I have respect unto all thy commandments .

translation.kha: Nangta u la hikai ïa u paidbah : La tah ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ba U Blei u la ong , ‘ Ïa ka Templ jongu nga yn khot ka ïing jingïabuaid ïa ki briew jong ki jaitbynriew baïar .’ Hynrei phi la pynlong ïa ka , ka jakarieh jong ki nongtuh !
translation.en: And he taught , saying unto them ,  Is it not written , My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer ? but ye have made it a den of thieves .

translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha u , Nga tang shu poi shabar kane ka shnong , ngan ïai ha U Terah . U pyrthat un sangeh , bad u phylliah un ym hap shuh , ba phin ïoh tip ba ka pyrthei ka long ka jong U Trai .
