translation.en: And Moses said unto him , As soon as I am gone out of the city , I will spread abroad my hands unto the  Lord   ; and the thunder shall cease , neither shall there be any more hail  ; that thou mayest know how that the earth is the  Lord s .
If thy whole body therefore be full of light , having no part dark , the whole shall be full of light , as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light .
translation.kha: Lada ka met jong phi baroh kawei ka dap da ka jingshai , khlem kano kano ka bynta jong ka ha kaba dum , kan long kaba phyrnai ha baroh , kum haba ka sharak ka tyngshaiñ ha phi da ka jingphyrnai jong ka .
Nga la wan ban pynsngewthuh ïa me ïa kaei ka ban jied ha ki briew lad me ha ka lawei . “Kane ka dei ka jingpynkhiah ïa ka olib .
translation.en: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days : for yet the vision is for many days .

translation.kha: Ko syiem Agrippa ! Nga lah ban kren ha me da ka jingshlur , namar ba me tip ïa kine kiei kiei . Nga sngewskhem ba me la bat bha ïa kawei pa kawei na ki , nia kane kaei kaei kam shym jia ha kob rit ha kyndong .
translation.en: For the king knoweth of these things , before whom also I speak freely : for I am persuaded that none of these things are hidden from him  ; for this thing was not done in a corner .

translation.kha: U ïa-dawa , Hato pa pyrkhat ba ki ktien ki lah ban shim ïa ka jaka jongnga ka jingtbit ha ka kam shipai bad ka har ? Mano phi pyrkhat u ban ïarap ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Assyria ?
translation.en: Thou sayest , ( but they are but vain words , ) I have counsel and strength for the war . Now on whom dost thou trust , that thou rebellest against me ?

And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians , and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large , unto a land flowing with milk and honey  ; unto the place of the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites .
translation.kha: bad kumta nga la wan ban pyllait ïa ki na ki nong Ijipt bad ban ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt sha kata ka ri kaba ïar bad kaba seisoh , kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ha kaba ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Hib bad ki Jebus ki shong mynta .

translation.en: And I said , My strength and my hope is perished from the  Lord  :
translation.kha: Ngam slem shuh ban im ; ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha U  Trai  ka la duh .

translation.en: Then commanded Belshazzar , and they clothed Daniel with scarlet , and put a chain of gold about his neck , and made a proclamation concerning him , that he should be the third ruler in the kingdom .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi u Belshassar u la ai hukum ïa ki shakri jong u ban pynphong ïa u Daniel ha ka jaiñkup syiem kaba sawbthuh bad ban pyndeng u kynjri ksiar ka jingpyndonburom sawdong ka ryndang jong u . Bad u la pynlong ïa u , uba lai ha ka bor hapoh ka hima .
Phi ki briew pa isih ïa uta naba pyrshah ïa ka jingbymhok bun kren ïa ka jingshisha baroh ha ka jingsynshar .
translation.en: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate , and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly .
He shall lend to thee , and thou shalt not lend to him : he shall be the head , and thou shalt be the tail .
translation.kha: Kin don ka spah ka phew kat ban ai kylliang ïa phi , hynrei phi pat phin ym don ei ei ban ai kylliang ïa ki . Ha kaba khatduh kin sa long ki nongsynshar jong phi .

Ha ka jaka ban lumlang bad ban tep , ki shynrang jong ki kin long kum ka sboh kaba don ha madan . Yn pynphriang ïa ki shabar ha khmat ka sngi , u bniap , badno ki khlur , kiba kine ki briew ki ieit bad shakri , Bad kiba ki la ïakylli bad mane .
translation.en: And they shall spread them before the sun , and the moon , and all the host of heaven , whom they have loved , and whom they have served , and after whom they have walked , and whom they have sought , and whom they have worshipped : they shall not be gathered , nor be buried  ; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth .
All these were joined together in the vale of Siddim , which is the salt sea .
translation.kha: Kine ki san ngut ki syiem ki la pynlong ka jingïateh lok bad ki la ïasoh lang kum kawei ka kynhun shipai ha ka Them Siddim , kaba long mynta ka Duriaw Baïap .
U Dan bad u Hushim u kynhun jong u .
translation.en: And the sons of Dan  ; Hushim .
And if the man be poor , thou shalt not sleep with his pledge :
translation.kha: Lada u dei u briew uba duk , wat bat ïa ka baroh shi miet ;

translation.en: But I will send a fire upon Teman , which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha nongbah Teman , bad kan thang duh ïa ki kut ka Bosrah .

U Trai u ino ha u Samuel , Sa katno slem men dang ïaid sngewsih ïa u Saul ? Nga la kyntait ïa u kum u syiem ki Israel . Hynrei mynta pynïoh katto katne ka umphniang Olib bad leit sha Bethgamul , sha u briew’ uba kyrteng u Jesse , namar per la jied ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u ban long syiem .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Samuel , How long wilt thou mourn for Saul , seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Israel ? fill thine horn with oil , and go , I will send thee to Jesse the Beth–lehemite : for I have provided me a king among his sons .
We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , praying always for you ,
translation.kha: Ngi ainguh borabor ïa U Blei , U Kpa jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , haba ngi duwai na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: The north wind driveth away rain : so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue .
translation.kha: Ka jinglorni ka wanrah ïa ka jingbitar kumba da shisha ka lyer na shatei ka wanrah slap .
Kumta U Jisu u la mih shabar , da ka phong ïa ka pansngiat shiah bad kup da ka jaiñkup kaba sawbthuh . U Pilat u la Ong ha ki , Khmih ! hangne uta u briew !
translation.en: Then came Jesus forth , wearing the crown of thorns , and the purple robe . And Pilate saith unto them , Behold the man !

translation.kha: Kaei kaba me kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong me ? U Jisu u la kylli ïa u . Ko Nonghikai , uta u briew uba matlah u la jubab , Nga kwah ban ïoh imat biang .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  What wilt thou that I should do unto thee ?  The blind man said unto him , Lord , that I might receive my sight .
And when Joseph had taken the body , he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth ,
translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u la shim ïa ka , u la spaiñ da ka jaiñ linen kaba thymmai ,
La pyndap ïa ki baïar da ka jingsheptieng bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei . U nongïathuhlypa umbah khraw u la mihpaw hapdeng jongki ngi ! ki la ong ; U Blei u la wan ban pynim ïa ki briew jong u !
translation.en: And there came a fear on all : and they glorified God , saying , That a great prophet is risen up among us  ; and , That God hath visited his people .

translation.kha: Gera ïa phai , ko khapnap ! Hato pha kwah don kyntiew ïa lade shaduh sha bneng ? Yn bret ïa pha Sha tbian sha dujok !
translation.en: And thou , Capernaum , which art exalted to heaven , shalt be thrust down to hell .

translation.kha: u Nun , u Joshua .
translation.en: Non his son , Jehoshua his son .
That thou shalt set apart unto the  Lord  all that openeth the matrix , and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast  ; the males shall be the  Lord s .
translation.kha: Ynda u ai ïa ka ha phi , phi dei ban ai sha U  Trai  ïa u khun nyngkong baroh . Man uba la kha nyngkong na ki mrad u long u jong U  Trai .
U Trai u ainong ïa per namar ba sa leh ïa kaba dei ; u la kylla ïa nga namar ba nga long uba probins .
translation.en: The  Lord  rewarded me according to my righteousness : according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me .
And Hannah prayed , and said , My heart rejoiceth in the  Lord  , mine horn is exalted in the  Lord  : my mouth is enlarged over mine enemies  ; because I rejoice in thy salvation .
translation.kha: Ka Hannah ka la duwai :  U  Trai  u la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong nga da ka jingkmen ; katno nga sngewtynnat namar kaei kaba u la leh ! Nga rkhie ïa ki nongshun jong nga ; katno nga shadkmen namar ba U Blei u la ïarap ïa nga .
Pha lah ban sngewthikna ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , U Blei un pyn-i kham bun ka jingisynei ïa ka Sodom ban ïa pha !
translation.en: But I say unto you , That it shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom in the day of judgment , than for thee .

translation.kha: U Joshua u thoh ïa kita ki sah ha ka kitab Ka Aiñ U Blei . Nangta u la shim uwei u maw uba heh , bun u pynïeng ïa u hapoh u dieng Sning ha ka iaka kyntang jong U Tharai .
translation.en: And Joshua wrote these words in the book of the law of God , and took a great stone , and set it up there under an oak , that was by the sanctuary of the  Lord .

translation.kha: len pynïapher ïa ki jingri jongki ki Jesreel na ki jong ki nadong Ijipt , badno kumta yn ym don wat kawei hima ka jingri ki Israel ka ban ïan noh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall sever between the cattle of Israel and the cattle of Egypt : and there shall nothing die of all that is the children s of Israel .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka ri ba ki longïing jong ka jait Judah ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families .

translation.kha: Ïathuh keiñ ha i pa haduh katno nga long uba donbor ha Ijipt , sad ïathaw ruh shaphang keiñ Kiei baroh kiba phi la ïohi . Khie ïaleit bran barben , bad wan ïalam ïa i shane .
translation.en: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt , and of all that ye have seen  ; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither .

And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea : for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt , and brought no present to the king of Assyria , as he had done year by year : therefore the king of Assyria shut him up , and bound him in prison .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka snem u Hoshea u phah nonglamktien sha u So , u syiem ka Ijipt , ban pan ïa ka jingïarap jong u , bad u sangeh noh ka jingsiew ïa ka jingnguh syiem ba man ka snem sha ka Assyria . Haba u Shalmaneser u tip ïa kane , u phah kem ïa u Hoshea bad buh ïa u ha ka byndi .
Ki shoh stang khim ki jingsiang ïa ka ksiar bad ki ot ïa ka ksar kum ki ksew ïa ka don suh ha kata ka jaiñ linen kaba ni , bad ha u saiwul Uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw .
translation.en: And they did beat the gold into thin plates , and cut it into wires , to work it in the blue , and in the purple , and in the scarlet , and in the fine linen , with cunning work .
And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one bullock  ; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , for one ram  ;
translation.kha: Kum ka jingainguh bam , wanrah u  purew ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib : lai kilo u  purew lem bad uwei u masi lyngraw ; ar kilo u  purew lem bad u langbrot ;
ka por ban pynïap bad ka por ban pynkhiah , ka por ban pynkhyllem bad ka por ban tei .
translation.en: A time to kill , and a time to heal  ; a time to break down , and a time to build up  ;

translation.kha: Ïa ka nongap kaba khraw la kur ha ki lai bynta , bad ïa ki nongbah jong ki ri baroh la pynjot . U Blei u la kynmaw ïa ka Babilon bakhraw bad u la Pynlong ïa ka ban dih ïa ka waiñ na ka khuri jong u — ka waiñ jong ka jingbitar shla jong u .
translation.en: And the great city was divided into three parts , and the cities of the nations fell : and great Babylon came in remembrance before God , to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath .
If ye abide in me , and my words abide in you , ye shall ask what ye will , and it shall be done unto you .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïaineh ha nga bad ki ktien jong nga ki ïaineh ha phi , te phin pan ïa kaei kaei kaba phi kwah , bad phin ïoh ïa ka .
Ym dat nongpang ki Anakim kiba dang sah ha ka ri Jesreel ; pynban , tang katto katne , la ingiew ha Gasa , Gath bad Ashdod .
translation.en: There was none of the Anakims left in the land of the children of Israel : only in Gaza , in Gath , and in Ashdod , there remained .
And he said unto him , Take me an heifer of three years old , and a she goat of three years old , and a ram of three years old , and a turtledove , and a young pigeon .
translation.kha: U te u ong ha u ,  Wanrah kawei ka masi , kawei ka blang , uwei u langbrot , kawei pa kawei na ki ka dei ban long kaba lai snem ka rta , bad kawei ka paro , bad kawei ka lyngdkhur .
U nongsaiñdur na Israel uba la thaw ïa u thliew , bad um dei satia u blei ! Ïa u kynhun masi khiar ba mane ha Samaria yn sa pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai .
translation.en: For from Israel was it also : the workman made it  ; therefore it is not God : but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces .

translation.kha: Haba ka kyntiap ka la poi , U Jisu u la shong ha la ka jaka ha ka miej Lem bad ki apostol .
translation.en: And when the hour was come , he sat down , and the twelve apostles with him .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la pyrkhat ba ka long kaba donkam ban kyntu ïa kine ki parabangeit ban wait ha shuwa jong nga sha phi bun ïoh pynkhreh lypa ïa ka jingai kaba phi la kular . Te kad long kaba la pynkhreh haba at poi , bad kan pyn-i ba phi ai namar ba phi kwah ban leh kumta , ym namar ba phi dei ban ai kumta .
translation.en: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren , that they would go before unto you , and make up beforehand your bounty , whereof ye had notice before , that the same might be ready , as a matter of bounty , and not as of covetousness .

translation.kha: Pynngam bitar shuh ïa ka ber shaiñ . Dang lada ki don ki shiah bad ki shiah buid ban hap ban ïakhun pyrshah , te ngan thang ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: Fury is not in me : who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle ? I would go through them , I would burn them together .

And the king stood in his place , and made a covenant before the  Lord  , to walk after the  Lord  , and to keep his commandments , and his testimonies , and his statutes , with all his heart , and with all his soul , to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book .
translation.kha: U ïeng hajan ka jaka ïeng ki syiem bad u pynlong ka jutang bad U  Trai  ban kohnguh ïa u , ban sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong u da la ka dohnud bad mynsiem baroh , bad ban pyntreikam ïa ki jingdawa ba ïasoh bad ka jutang , kumba la thoh ha ka kitab .
U Joab u ong ïa u , Lada phi ïuh ba ki Syria ki jop ïa nga , wan bad ïarap ïa nga , bad salia ki Ammon ki jop ïa phi , ngan leit shun ïarap ïa phi .
translation.en: And he said , If the Syrians be too strong for me , then thou shalt help me : but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee , then I will help thee .
Repent therefore of this thy wickedness , and pray God , if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee .
translation.kha: To kylla-kaba-mut , te , na kane ka jingthmu bymman jong me , bad duwai ha U Trai ba un map ïa me na kaba pyrkhat ïa kaba kum kane .
Hynrei kine ki briew ki ar la ka leh , kum ki khrawbor ïa kiba la khiah ïa ka ban shah kem bad shah pynnep ; ki ter ïaleh da ki jingkren ïa kiei kai kiba kim sngewthuh .
translation.en: But these , as natural brute beasts , made to be taken and destroyed , speak evil of the things that they understand not  ; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption  ;

translation.kha: Ki jaboh , Ïa ka jingsngewkhia bad u Saul lem bad ka long jong u ym lah ban pynbeit da ka mata lane ka ksiar , lehniam ba ngi kwah ban pynïap ïa Uno uno u Israel . Te , Kaei phi pyrkhat ba Ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi ? u Dabid u kylli .
translation.en: And the Gibeonites said unto him , We will have no silver nor gold of Saul , nor of his house  ; neither for us shalt thou kill any man in Israel . And he said , What ye shall say , that will I do for you .
Thus saith the  Lord   ; Take heed to yourselves , and bear no burden on the sabbath day , nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem  ;
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba lada ki ieit ïa la ka jingim , kim dei ban kit kano kano ka jingkit ha ka Sabbaton ; kim dei ban rah ïa kano kano shapoh lyngba ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem
Kumba hadien lai kynja , ka tnga jong u , ka bymtip ïa kiba lah jia , ka la wan rung shapoh .
translation.en: And it was about the space of three hours after , when his wife , not knowing what was done , came in .

translation.kha: kim lah ban peit ïa ka jingbam bad ki la jan ban ïap .
translation.en: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat  ; and they draw near unto the gates of death .
The Jews therefore strove among themselves , saying , How can this man give us his flesh to eat ?
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynmih ïa ka jingïatainia kaba tyngeh hapdeng jong ki .  Kumno une u briew u lah ban ai ha ngi ïa ka doh jong u ban bam ?  ki la kylli .
Kiwei pat ki Lebi ki shut halor ka jingpynkit jingkit bad halor ki nongtrei ha ki kam bapher bapher , bad kiwei ki buh jingpihuiñ lane ki shakri kum ki nongap phira .
translation.en: Also they were over the bearers of burdens , and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service : and of the Levites there were scribes , and officers , and porters .

translation.kha: Lada me ai ïa kine ki jingkhaïi ha ki parabangeit , men long u sakhrai babha jong U Khrist Jisu , kumba me bsa ïa lai ha ka mynsiem da ki kti jong ka jingngeit bad jong ki jingïohi bashisha ïa bakha me la stem .
translation.en: If thou put the brethren in remembrance of these things , thou shalt be a good minister of Jesus Christ , nourished up in the words of faith and of good doctrine , whereunto thou hast attained .

translation.kha: Ïa ki ar tylli ki thapniang jongnga uwei pa uwei u jingthaw la rah shajrong kumta ba ki dei ïa ki khot thapniang jong ki jingthaw ba-marsyndah , bad ki ar tylli ki tasngeng ki tip ïa ki met jong ki .
translation.en: Thus were their faces : and their wings were stretched upward  ; two wings of every one were joined one to another , and two covered their bodies .

And the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon him , and he judged Israel , and went out to war : and the  Lord  delivered Chushan–rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand  ; and his hand prevailed against Chushan–rishathaim .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem jong U  Trai  u la wan ha u , bad u kylla long u nongïalam jong ki Israel . U Othniel u leit sha ka thma , bad U  Trai  u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor u syiem ka Mesopotamia .
Ki ktien sa shisien pat ki pyn-i shaei ba ïa kiei khie kiba la tiduh yn pynkhynñiuh bad yn weng noh , khnang ba ïa kiei kiei ki bym lah ban pynkhynñiuh yn pynheh .
translation.en: And this word , Yet once more , signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken , as of things that are made , that those things which cannot be shaken may remain .

translation.kha: Ngan jubab ïa me bad ïa ki paralok jong me ruh .
translation.en: I will answer thee , and thy companions with thee .

translation.kha: hynñiew tong suba shahshkor ïa na un shongsuk kyndat . Un lieh na ki jingjam khlem sheptieng ïa kaba sngi .
translation.en: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely , and shall be quiet from fear of evil .
In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison , desirous to apprehend me :
translation.kha: Haba nga la don ha Damaskos , u lyngskor hapoh u syiem Aretas u la pynap phira ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah ban kem ïa nga .
U paidlang u la kynhied ïa ki bad ong ïa ki ban sngap jar . Hynrei ki la nang pyrta kham jam , Ko Khun u Dabid ! To sngewlehrain ïa moi , ko Kynrad !
translation.en: And the multitude rebuked them , because they should hold their peace : but they cried the more , saying , Have mercy on us , O Lord , thou Son of David .
And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah which are in Babylon , saying , The  Lord  make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab , whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire  ;
translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba la shah rah noh kum ki koidi na Jerusalem sha Babilonia ki kwah ban wallam ka jingtim hano hano , kin ong , ‘ To U  Trai  un ñiew ïa phi kum u Sedekaïah bad u Ahab , kiba u syiem ka Babilonia u la syang im !’

Wat sheptieng — ar hir ryngkat bad me ! Nga long U Blei jong me — wat ai ba kano Kano kan pynsheptieng ïa me ! Ngan pyntong ïa me uba khlaiñ bad ngan ïarap ïa me ; ngan ïada ïa me bad ngan pynim ïa me .
translation.en: Fear thou not  ; for I am with thee : be not dismayed  ; for I am thy God : I will strengthen thee  ; yea , I will help thee  ; yea , I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness .
Bring forth the blind people that have eyes , and the deaf that have ears .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ,  Khot hajir ïa ki briew jong nga sha ïingbishar . Ki don ki khmat hynrei ki long kiba matlah ; ki don ki shkor hynrei ki long kiba kyllut !

translation.en: Wherefore Hanun took David s servants , and shaved off the one half of their beards , and cut off their garments in the middle , even to their buttocks , and sent them away .
translation.kha: U Hanun u la kem ïa ki nonglamktien jong u Dabid , u la khi shiliang ïa u  ñiuhtmoh jong ki , u khap ïa ki jaiñ jong ki na mar skhep , bad u la phah noh ïa ki .
Nangta u syiem Abib u hukum ïa uei na ki nongbah nongpynïaidkam , Kem ïa u Mikaïah bad ithuh lam ïa u sha u Amon , u lat ka nongbah , bad sha u khun syiem Joash .
translation.en: Then the king of Israel said , Take ye Micaiah , and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city , and to Joash the king s son  ;

translation.kha: Nga long U Trai , U Blei bakylluid jong phi , nga la thret ïa phira , ko Israel , pynlang nga long u Syiem jong phi .
translation.en: I am the  Lord  , your Holy One , the creator of Israel , your King .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong U balui ki long kynhied ha ka jingbun briew , ki longïing ki nongwei ha ka ri Naaran .
translation.en: When they were but a few men in number  ; yea , very few , and strangers in it .
And in all vineyards shall be wailing : for I will pass through thee , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Yn don ka jinglynñiar ha ki bri sohwaiñ baroh . Baroh kane kan jia namar ba nga wan ban pynshitom ïa phi .  U  Trai  u la kren .
Ki ktien jong ki , ki dap da ki jingshukor ishyrkhei ; ki jingthok bymdonkam ki mih na ki tyllep jong ki , bad ki jingbyrngem kiba ma , kum ka bih bseiñ , na ki rmiang shyntur jong ki ;
translation.en: Their throat is an open sepulchre ; with their tongues they have used deceit ; the poison of asps is under their lips :
And all that sat in the council , looking stedfastly on him , saw his face as it had been the face of an angel .
translation.kha: Kita baroh kiba shong ha ka Dorbar ki la khmih shlip ha u Stephan bad ki la ïohi ba ka durkhmat jong u ka la long kum ka durkhmat jong u angel .

translation.en: Whom Jason hath received : and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar , saying that there is another king , one Jesus .
translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong u Patsha , da kaba ong ba don uwei pat u syiem , uba kyrteng U Jisu .
Hynrei la don ka nemsniew ha ka ri Kanaan , bad ka la lama Kaba jur shikynta eh kat haduh ba u Abram u la longing jngai shaphang sahit sha ka ri Ieit ban shong ban sah hangta shipor .
translation.en: And there was a famine in the land : and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there  ; for the famine was grievous in the land .

translation.kha: Gera kumta ki kynthei ki dei ban aiti lut ha ki tnga jong ki ruma ka balang ka aiti ïa lade ha U Khristan .
translation.en: Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ , so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing .

translation.kha: Bad U Blei , wahbah ïohi ïa kabu Shabeh ki dohnud Jong ngi , u tip kaei ka long jingmut jong U Mynsiem ; Naaman U Mynsiem u ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynda la ki briew bad katai kum ka ma jong u .
translation.en: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit , because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God .

translation.kha: U Jotham u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka nongbah u Dabid , bad u Ahas u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Jotham slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father : and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead .
Commit thy works unto the  Lord  , and thy thoughts shall be established .
translation.kha: Kyrpad na U  Trai  ban kyrkhu ïa ki jingthmu jong phi , bad phin ïoh jingjop ha kaba pyntreikam ïa ki .
Katto katne bapaw , ki la pdiang ïa u pynlang ki la beit ha u ; kumta u la ai bor ha ki , ban long ki khulom U blang .
translation.en: But as many as received him , to them gave he power to become the sons of God , even to them that believe on his name :
For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek : for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ïa baroh , namar ym don ka jingïapher hapdeng ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ; U Blei u long ujuh U Trai ïa baroh bad u kyrkhu kyrhai ïa baroh kiba khot kyrpad ïa u .
Hadien ka jingïap u Moses , u shakri jrong U Trai ; U Trai u la Kren ha u nongïapeiñ lem jong u Moses , u Josaïah u khun jong u Nun .
translation.en: Now after the death of Moses the servant of the  Lord  it came to pass , that the  Lord  spake unto Joshua the son of Nun , Moses  minister , saying ,

translation.kha: Lada mano mano na phi , phi leh pop khlem da mut khnang , phi dei ïa-ban wan kawei ka blang kaba shisnem ka rta kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop .
translation.en: And if any soul sin through ignorance , then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering .

translation.kha: U buhai ïa ka jingset ksiar hapoh ka jingïoh , ha khmat ka pyrda ,
translation.en: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the veil :

And Saul sent messengers to take David : and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying , and Samuel standing as appointed over them , the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul , and they also prophesied .
translation.kha: Ki ïohi ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ba ki ïashad bad ki ïarisa , lem bad ïa u Samuel uba u ïalam na khmat . Nangta U Mynsiem U Blei u wan hiar tyllep ha ki rangbah jong u Saul , bad ki ruh ki sdang ban ïashad bad ïarisa .

translation.en: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate , ten cubits  ; and the length of the gate , thirteen cubits .
translation.kha: Nangta pat , uta u briew u la thew sa ïa ka pyngkiang jong ka lynti ïaid kaba ha ka khyrdop . Ka la long baroh hynriew mitar shiteng bad ka jaka ba lait hapdeng ki khyrdop kiba rynghang ka la long san mitar .
Shim ïa u , u hukum bad uta u briew u dem bad u la shim ïa u .
translation.en: Therefore said he , Take it up to thee . And he put out his hand , and took it .

translation.kha: U Simeon u la kyrkhu ïa ki bad u la ong ha ka Mari , ka kmie jong u , Ïa Un u khunlung la jied da U Blei na ka bynta ka jingpynjot dara ka jingpynim ïa kiba bun ha Israel . Un long ka dat na U Blei ïa kaba kiba bun ki briew kin kren pyrthuh bad kumta un pynpaw ïa ki jingpyrkhat barieh jngai ki .
translation.en: And Simeon blessed them , and said unto Mary his mother , Behold , this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel  ; and for a sign which shall be spoken against  ;

translation.kha: Bad lada ka shkor kan ong , Namar ba ngam dadien ka khmat , te Ngam Dei ka jong ka met , kata kam pynlong ïa ka , ba kam dei ka dkhot jong ka met! .
translation.en: And if the ear shall say , Because I am not the eye , I am not of the body ; is it therefore not of the body ?

translation.kha: Hadien , kabu u dang sheng ha Gerar , u la ong ba ka tnga jong u , ka Sarah ka dei ka para jong u . Te u Abimelekh lad ka Gerar u la phah ban wallam ïalam ïa ka Sarah sha u .
translation.en: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife , She is my sister : and Abimelech king of Gerar sent , and took Sarah .

translation.kha: Ki don ki shkor , hynrei kim lah don ïohsngew ; kim lah wat ban pynhiar mynmiet .
translation.en: They have ears , but they hear not  ; neither is there any breath in their mouths .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Absalom u ong , Lada kumta te , phin shah mo la kumta kumno ïa u Amnon , u para jongu nga banbeiñ wan ? Balei un wait ? u Syiem u kylli .
translation.en: Then said Absalom , If not , I pray thee , let my brother Amnon go with us . And the king said unto him , Why should he go with thee ?
Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only , or upon the uncircumcision also ? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness .
translation.kha: Hato kane ka jingsuk kaba U Dabid u la kren ka long tang ïa kito ïa kiba la otsher ? Ym kumta keiñ! Ka long ruh ïa kito ki bym shym la otsher . Naba ngi ong na ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ,  U Abraham u la ngeit ha U Blei , bad namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kum uba hok .
Nangta , ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bneng uba hynñiew , kaba dei ka Sngi ka Jingpynïasuk , phuh ïa u briew ban pynsawa ïa ka tarajur ha ka ri baroh kawei .
translation.en: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubilee to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month , in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land .

translation.kha: Kumno phi ha ban ong ha u to jong phi , ‘ Ko para , sngewbha shah ïa na ban sai ïa u thiat na ka khmat jyllang phi ,’ pynïap phim lah ban ïohi ïa ka lyngkhot dieng ha la ka jong ka khmat ? Phi kiba arsap ! Nyngkong to shim ino ïa ka lyngkhot ngin na ka khmat jong phi , nabar nangta Phin lah ban ïohi sharai ban sei ïa u tat na ka khmat jong u par jong phi .
translation.en: Either how canst thou say to thy brother , Brother , let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye , when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye ? Thou hypocrite , cast out first the beam out of thine own eye , and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother s eye .

translation.kha: Palat ïa Kishion , haba nga donkam jingïarap ha Sosthenes , phi la phah ïa ka shata nga .
translation.en: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity .

translation.kha: Da kumta keiñ ka khyndew jrong u Ephron ka ha Makhpelah , kaba don shaphang mihngi na Mareh , ka kylla long ka Jong u Abraham . Ka kynthih ïa ka lyngkha , ïa ka krem kaba don hangta , pynlang ïa ki dieng baroh kiba don hapoh ki pud jong ka .
translation.en: And the field of Ephron , which was in Machpelah , which was before Mamre , the field , and the cave which was therein , and all the trees that were in the field , that were in all the borders round about , were made sure
And they glorified God in me .
translation.kha: Bad ki ïaroh ïa U Blei ha nga .

translation.en: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul : he heareth cursing , and bewrayeth it not .
translation.kha: U para nongtuh u long u nongshun uba sniew tam jong u hi . Un shah pynshitom lada u ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ha ka ïingbishar , U Blei un tim ïa u lada um leh kumta .
Ki briew kiba bieit ktieh suidñiew paila ki leh pop , hynrei ki briew kiba beit ki kwah baneh ïohmap .
translation.en: Fools make a mock at sin : but among the righteous there is favour .
How thy garments are warm , when he quieteth the earth by the south wind ?
translation.kha: Em , me lah ban shah tang ïa ka jingshit haba ka lyer na shaphang shathie ka lynshop ïa ka ri .

translation.en: And Isaac s servants digged in the valley , and found there a well of springing water .
translation.kha: Ki shakri jong u Isaak ki la tih ïa ka pukri ha kata ka them bad ki lap ba ka don um .
ngat U Jisu u la leit sha ïing . U paidbah babit u la ïalum biang katba haduh ba U Jisu bad ki synran jong u kim don por shuh ban bam .
translation.en: And the multitude cometh together again , so that they could not so much as eat bread .

translation.kha: Kaba da kumno ki bri kin pyntip ba me sngewbha ïa une u paidlang bad ïa nga salia me men ym leit ryngkat bad I ? Ka jingdon rynsied jong me bad ngi tud pyn-i ba ngi long kiba pher na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ha ka pyut .
translation.en: For wherein shall it be known here that I and thy people have found grace in thy sight ? is it not in that thou goest with us ? so shall we be separated , I and thy people , from all the people that are upon the face of the earth .

translation.kha: Hadien lai sngi shiteng , ka jingpyrsad mynsiem ba ai jingimat ka la wan na U Blei pynlang ka la rung ha ki , bad ki la ïng joit ; bad baroh kiba la ïohi ïa ki , ki la sngewthait .
translation.en: And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them , and they stood upon their feet  ; and great fear fell upon them which saw them .
And Jacob loved Rachel  ; and said , I will serve thee seven years for Rachel thy younger daughter .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ïapmat ïa ka Rakhel , kumta u ong ,  Ngan trei hynñiew snem na ka bynta jong phi , lada phi shah ba ngan shongkurim ïa ka Rakhel .
U Aaron un kñia ïa u nongmihkhmat uba hap ha U Trai da ka jingkynting sbai , bad un kñia ïa u kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop .
translation.en: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the  Lord s  lot fell , and offer him for a sin offering .

translation.kha: Ha Kata ka por u syiem u la rung ïa u mawkordor ha ka kur synshar khadar .
translation.en: And when the virgins were gathered together the second time , then Mordecai sat in the king s gate .

translation.kha: U Blei u thaw ïa ki Bneng badno u pynpyiar ïa ki ; u pynwandur ïa ka Pyrthei bad ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka ; u ai jingim bad u pyrsad mynsiem ïa la ki bariew baroh . Bad mynta U Tharai U Blei u ong ha la u shakri ,
translation.en: Thus saith God the  Lord  , he that created the heavens , and stretched them out  ; he that spread forth the earth , and that which cometh out of it  ; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it , and spirit to them that walk therein :

translation.kha: Kana ka longïing ka jingïapher kob shai kdar hapdeng ki khun U Blei bad ki khun u Soitan : Uno uno u bym leh ïa katai Kaba dei lane u bym ieit ïa la u hynmen u prie um long u khunlung U Blei .
translation.en: In this the children of God are manifest , and the children of the devil : whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of God , neither he that loveth not his brother .
It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise , than for a man to hear the song of fools .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban don ki briew kiba stad kiba sneng ïa phi ban ïa kaba don ki briew kiba tasngeng kiba rwai ki jingïaroh ïa phi .
Habor ki la ïohsngew ïa kane ka jingsawa , u paidbah babun u la ïalum . Ki la ïasngewtynnat , namar ba uwei pa uwei na ki u la ïohsngew ba ki riewngeit ki kruiñ ha ka keiñ jong u hi .
translation.en: Now when this was noised abroad , the multitude came together , and were confounded , because that every man heard them speak in his own language .
And Moses returned unto the  Lord  , and said , Oh , this people have sinned a great sin , and have made them gods of gold .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u leit phai sha U  Trai  , bad u ong ,  Kine ki briew ki la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei eh . Ki la thaw ïa u blei uba da ka ksiar bad ki la ïamane ïa u .
La don katto katne ngut ki nongap langbrot ha kata ka bynda jong ka ri kiba la sahmiet ha ki lum , da kaba sumar ïa ki kynhun langbrot jong ki .
translation.en: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field , keeping watch over their flock by night .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , Ngan leh thik kumta kumba me la kyrpad , namar nga tip bha ïa me , bad nga sngewbha ïa me .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , I will do this thing also that thou hast spoken : for thou hast found grace in my sight , and I know thee by name .

translation.kha: To phin ïakhublei lap da ka jingïadoh pynrangbah .
translation.en: Greet one another with an holy kiss .

translation.kha: hapoh lai hajar sawspah kilo ka dabi , shiphew hajar kilo u kew , ar hajar lane ka wieh , ar hajar litar ka jingmaïan Olib , bad katba donkam ka lieh .
translation.en: Unto an hundred talents of silver , and to an hundred measures of wheat , and to an hundred baths of wine , and to an hundred baths of oil , and salt without prescribing how much .

translation.kha: U Moses u la leit shim ïa utai diengduh kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: And Moses took the rod from before the  Lord  , as he commanded him .

translation.kha: Katba ki Amor ki dang phet arsut na ka khim lum na ki shipai Israel , U Trai u pynhap Halor jong ki ïa u phria uba heh baroh shi lynter lynti haduh Asekah . khamtam bad ki la ïap na u phria ba-bang na kaba ki shah pynïap ha ki Israel .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as they fled from before Israel , and were in the going down to Beth–horon , that the  Lord  cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah , and they died : they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword .

translation.kha: Na ka bniat kane ka gospel , nga long u nongkit tiensyiem wat la mynta nga don ha ïingbyndi . To duwai ba nga lah ngab long uba shlur ha ka jingrang shaphang ka gospel kumba por dei .
translation.en: For which I am an ambassador in bonds : that therein I may speak boldly , as I ought to speak .

The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the low country , and of the south of Judah , and had taken Beth–shemesh , and Aijalon , and Gederoth , and Soco with the villages thereof , and Timnah with the villages thereof , Gimzo also and the villages thereof : and they dwelt there .
translation.kha: Ha kane kajuh ka por ki Philistia ruh ki hiarthma ïa ki shnong kiba ha ki kjat lum kiba shaphang sepngi bad ïa ka Judah bashaphang shathie . Ki la ïohknieh ïa ki nongbah jong ka Beth Shemesh , ka Aijalon , bad ïa ka Gederoth , bad ruh ïa ki nongbah jong ka Soko , ka Timnah , bad ka Gimso lem bad ki nongrit jong ki , bad ki shongduh hangta .
Hynrei ym don uno eit uba Wan hapdeng jong ngi — ym don u ban bishar ïa U Blei bad ïa por .
translation.en: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us , that might lay his hand upon us both .

translation.kha: Nga long uba la kliar borabor ba-bang pynpdang sngewbha ïa ki briew jongki la , kiba longïing mutlop don ïai kun ïa ka bymdei bad ïaid ha la ka jong ka lynti ,
translation.en: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people , which walketh in a way that was not good , after their own thoughts  ;

translation.kha: Kaei kaba la jia ha ki , ka pynpaw ba ki Proberb ki long kiba shispah : U ksai u leit phai pat sha la ka para bad u sniang ïa ibha la pynsakma pynsait u leit kyrwep pud ha ka ktieh .
translation.en: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb , The dog is turned to his own vomit again  ; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire .

And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer , and said , Come up to us , and we will shew you a thing . And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer , Come up after me : for the  Lord  hath delivered them into the hand of Israel .
translation.kha: Nangta ki pyrta ïa u Jonathan bad ïa uta u samla ,  Ale shane ! Ngi don ei ei ban ong ïa phi !  U Jonathan u ong ïa uta u samla ,  Bud ïa nga . U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop halor jong ki .

translation.en: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king , Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king ? let me go over , I pray thee , and take off his head .
translation.kha: U Abishai , uba ka kmie jong u , ka Seruïah , u ong ha u syiem ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi shah ïa une u ksew ban tim ïa phi ? Shah ngan leit hangtai bad khrai ïa ka khlieh jong u !
Hynrei , to pynkoit nalor kiei kiei baroh ïa ka Hima U Blei bad ïa kaei kaba u dawa na phi , pynlang un pyndap ïa phi da kine kiei ktien baroh .
translation.en: But seek ye first the kingdom of God , and his righteousness  ; and all these things shall be added unto you .
And Moses did as the  Lord  commanded : and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation .
translation.kha: U Moses u la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Ki la ïaleit kiew ïa u Lum Hor haba ïohi uta u paidlang baroh ,
U Simon Petros u la pyni tam ïa u pynlang u la ong , Kylli ïa u ba u kren shaphang jongno .
translation.en: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him , that he should ask who it should be of whom he spake .

translation.kha: NGA la pyndonkam ïa la ka jingstad ban tynjuh ïa kane barhem . Nga la kut jingmut ban long uba stad , hynñiew ka la long palat pud ïa nga .
translation.en: All this have I proved by wisdom : I said , I will be wise  ; but it was far from me .

translation.kha: U Bel un tat ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , un don sdang jong ka bad un kerkut ïa ka .
translation.en: And I will camp against thee round about , and will lay siege against thee with a mount , and I will raise forts against thee .

translation.kha: Phim kwah pynsangeh ia u Tamar ?
translation.en: Don't you want to stop Tom ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ko ki briew jong nga , por la leh aïu ïa phi ? Kumno nga la long ka jingkit ïa phi ? To Jobab ïa de .
translation.en: O my people , what have I done unto thee ? and wherein have I wearied thee ? testify against me .
And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , See , I have given into thine hand Jericho , and the king thereof , and the mighty men of valour .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Nga buh ha ki kti jong me ïa ka Jerikho , lem bad u syiem jong ka bad ïa ki shipai bashlur jong u baroh .

translation.en: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons , and the diseases departed from them , and the evil spirits went out of them .
translation.kha: Wat ïa ki rumal bad ki jaiñ-da kiba u la pyndonkam la leit lam sha kito kiba pang , bad ïa ki jingpang jong ki la beh noh , bad ki mynsiem bymman ki ju mihnoh na ki .
U la peit ïa ki bhabriew babha shong sawdong jong u bad u la ïong , Khmih ! Hangne ki don ka kmie jong nga badno ki para lad nga !
translation.en: And he looked round about on them which sat about him , and said ,  Behold my mother and my brethren !

translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la Jubab da kabu shim na u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah : Neng long ‘ ka per jrong uto uba pyrta ha ka ri shyiap : To pynbeit ïa ka lynti ïaid jong U Trai ba un ïaid !’
translation.en: He said , I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness , Make straight the way of the Lord , as said the prophet Esaias .

translation.kha: Ki Lebi Bad ki briew ka Judah ki leh ruma la bthah da u Jehoïada . Ym shym la phah noh ïa ki rangbah hajan ki la pynbud ïa la ki kamon ha ka Sabbaton , kumta ki rangbah ai hukum ki ïoh lang ïa kito kiba dang wan sha la ki kam bad kito kiba la pyndep kam .
translation.en: So the Levites and all Judah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded , and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath , with them that were to go out on the sabbath : for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses .

translation.kha: suk ba U Blei un ïakit ïa ka khyndew bad ïa ki pyntha jong ka , ne wat shi hasem ka khynñiat kaba Nyngkong .
translation.en: While as yet he had not made the earth , nor the fields , nor the highest part of the dust of the world .

translation.kha: Ka ri shyiap kan shadkmen , badno ki syntiew kin phuh ha ka ri khlaw .
translation.en: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them  ; and the desert shall rejoice , and blossom as the rose .

And thou shalt remember all the way which the  Lord  thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness , to humble thee , and to prove thee , to know what was in thine heart , whether thou wouldest keep his commandments , or no .
translation.kha: Kynmaw kumno U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la ïalam ïa phi baroh shi lynter lynti lyngba ka ri shyiap ha kine ki sawphew snem kiba la dep ba un pyndem ïa phi , u da tynjuh ïa phi ba un ïoh tip aïu phi thmu ban leh , bad la phin kohnguh ne em ïa ki hukum jong u .
Te U Trai’ u long lem bad u , bad u long uba ioh ha ktieh kiei kiba u leh . U ïaleh pyrthuh ïa u patsha ka Assyria malade u kyntait ban pyndem ha u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  was with him  ; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth : and he rebelled against the king of Assyria , and served him not .
Whereas our substance is not cut down , but the remnant of them the fire consumeth .
translation.kha: Ïa kata baroh kaba ki bymman ki don la pynjot , bad ka ding ka thang duh ïa kano kano kaba dang sah .
Kane ka mut ba ki khun ba la kha katno kum ka mano , kim de ki khun jrong U Blei ; hynrei , ïa ki khun ba la kha katne kum ka jingkular U balui , la ñiew kum ki nongpynkha bashisha .
translation.en: That is , They which are the children of the flesh , these are not the children of God : but the children of the promise are counted for the seed .

translation.kha: Kito kiba dang sahit ha kata ka ri ki long ki sa jngut ki syiem Philistia , ki Kainan baroh , ki shisyndon , bun ki Hib kiba shong ha ki lum Lebanon naduh u Lym Baal Hermon haduh ka Khie Hamath .
translation.en: Namely , five lords of the Philistines , and all the Canaanites , and the Sidonians , and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon , from mount Baal–hermon unto the entering in of Hamath .

translation.kha: Im ïor da lei lei ïa ka jingshai jong ka sngi litar tipthuh kumin ka jingim ka un-long , hynrei la kumno kumno i la shem ka jingjahthait —
translation.en: Moreover he hath not seen the sun , nor known any thing : this hath more rest than the other .

translation.kha: U Joseph u poi ha Shekhem bad katba u dang ïaid sakma Kylleng ïa ka shnong ha kiba uwei u briew u ïohi ïa u badno u kylli , Phi wad ïano ?
translation.en: And a certain man found him , and , behold , he was wandering in the field : and the man asked him , saying , What seekest thou ?

translation.kha: Pynban , ma phi hi phi ïaleh bymïaineh wai ïa iwei pateng badno ïalade ïohi ïa iwei patiaw , wat ïa la ki jong ki parabangeit!
translation.en: Nay , ye do wrong , and defraud , and that your brethren .
And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops  ; and them that worship and that swear by the  Lord  , and that swear by Malcham  ;
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa uno uno uba leit kiew sha tnum ïing bad mane ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khlur . Nga pynjot ruh ïa kito kiba mane ïa nga bad kiba smai ban ïaineh ha nga , hynrei pynban ki shim smai ha ka kyrteng jong u blei Molekh .
u la ong ha u Hasael , aiwai na ki rangbah synshar jong u , Khie loit rah ka jingai sngewbha ïa u nongïathuhlypa , bad kyrpad ïa u shun kylli na U Trai la ngan kot biang ne em .
translation.en: And the king said unto Hazael , Take a present in thine hand , and go , meet the man of God , and enquire of the  Lord  by him , saying , Shall I recover of this disease ?

translation.kha: Hib u Hushai u la woh poi , u Absalom u ïong ha u , Kane ka dei ka jingai jingmut jong u Ahithophel kaba u la ai ïa ngi ; Hato ngin bud ïa ka ? Lada em , to ïathuh ma phi ïa ngi kaei ba ngin ni .
translation.en: And when Hushai was come to Absalom , Absalom spake unto him , saying , Ahithophel hath spoken after this manner : shall we do after his saying ? if not  ; speak thou .

But if the priest s daughter be a widow , or divorced , and have no child , and is returned unto her father s house , as in her youth , she shall eat of her father s meat : but there shall no stranger eat thereof .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka khun u lyngdoh kaba la long riewkynthei lane kaba la ïapyllait tnga , ka bym don khun , bad kaba la wan phai ban shong ban sah bad la u kpa kumba ka la leh mynba ka dang samla , ka lah ban bam ïa kata ka jingbam ba u kpa jong ka u ïohpdiang kum u lyngdoh . Dei tang uta uba na ka longïing lyngdoh uba lah ban bam ïa ka .
Ka sniehdoh jong nga kam ïadait bha shu bad ki shyieng ; nga la shu lait im da ka said .
translation.en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh , and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ngan weng noh ïa ki kali tdam na Israel bad shim ïa ki kulai na Jerusalem ; ïa ki ryntieh ba la pyndonkam ha ka thlim yn pynjot . U syiem jong phi un pynlong jingshongsuk hapdeng ki jaitbynriew ; un synshar na ka duriaw shat ka duriaw-bah , na ka wah Epaphroditos shuh kiba koit jngai ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim , and the horse from Jerusalem , and the battle bow shall be cut off : and he shall speak peace unto the heathen : and his dominion shall be from sea even to sea , and from the river even to the ends of the earth .
And out of the tribe of Gad , Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Mahanaim with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: Na ka jait Gad ki la ïohpdiang saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Ramoth ha Gilead , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ka ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , ka Mahanaim ,

translation.en: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold , and make their rings of gold for places for the bars : and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold .
translation.kha: Suit ksiar ïa kita ki jingker , bad pyndait ha ki ïa ki kyrwoh ksiar ban bat ïa ki diengkhap . Suit ksiar ruh ïa kita ki diengkhap .
Hynrei baroh khmut ki ïap Bad la tep ïa ki ; ïa ki baroh la tap da ki krung .
translation.en: They shall lie down alike in the dust , and the worms shall cover them .
And the priest shall see him : and , behold , if the plague be turned into white  ; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague : he is clean .
translation.kha: Lada kata ka prum ka la kylla lieh , uta u briew u long uba khuid , bad uta u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid .
Ki la duh noh! ïa baroh ki jingsngew jong ka jinglehrain ; ki pynlapmiet ïa lade ha ki ki thala bad ki leh ïa bhor ki jait kam sniew khlem salia .
translation.en: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness , to work all uncleanness with greediness .
He said , I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness , Make straight the way of the Lord , as said the prophet Esaias .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la jubab da kaba shim na u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah :  Nga long ‘ ka sur jong uta uba pyrta ha ka ri shyiap : To pynbeit ïa ka lynti ïaid jong U Trai ba un ïaid !’
Ka biang ! u Dabid u la jubab . Dang ïaid sha lamkhmat ! Kumta u Ittai u la ïadait sha khamtam nabar la ki rangbah jong u lem bad ki ba-ha-ïing ba-im jong ki baroh .
translation.en: And David said to Ittai , Go and pass over . And Ittai the Gittite passed over , and all his men , and all the little ones that were with him .
Then saith he to Thomas ,  Reach hither thy finger , and behold my hands  ; and reach hither thy hand , and thrust it into my side : and be not faithless , but believing .
translation.kha: Te u la ong ha u Thomas ,  Buh ïa ka shynriah ti jong me hangne , bad peit ïa ki kti jong nga ; nangta kner ïa la ka kti bad buh ïa ka ha ka krung jong nga . Wat artatien shuh bad to ngeit !
Kito kiba ha Judah kiba maji im kin roi kum ki jingthung kiba ki thied ki sam jylliew ha ka khyndew bad pynmih soh .
translation.en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall yet again take root downward , and bear fruit upward .

translation.kha: Ka duriaw-bah Basaw ka la khmih bad ka pait noh , ka wah Jordan ka la syngkhlieh ban sting .
translation.en: The sea saw it , and fled : Jordan was driven back .
For ye have heard of my conversation in time past in the Jews  religion , how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of God , and wasted it :
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew kumno ba nga la ju im mynba nga dang don ha ka niam Jiw , kumno nga la pynshitom beiñ khlem jingisynei ïa ka balang U Blei bad nga la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban pynduh noh ïa ka .

Kumta ong ha u shakri jong nga u Dabid ba nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , nga ong ha u , ‘ nga la shim ïa me na kaba sumar ïa ki longsem ha ki jaka phlang bad pyntong ïa me u nongsynshar jong ki briew jyllang nga ki Jeriel .
translation.en: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I took thee from the sheepcote , even from following the sheep , that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel :

And Joseph saw his brethren , and he knew them , but made himself strange unto them , and spake roughly unto them  ; and he said unto them , Whence come ye ? And they said , From the land of Canaan to buy food .
translation.kha: Haba u Joseph u la ïohi ïa la ki hynmen , bad u la ithuh ïa ki , hynrei u leh kum bym ithuh ïa ki , bad u kren khor ïa ki ,  Phi kiba na-ei ?   Ngi ïawan na ka ri Kanaan , ban thied jingbam ,  ki jubab .

translation.en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have wrought with you for my name s sake , not according to your wicked ways , nor according to your corrupt doings , O ye house of Israel , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Haba nga leh ban da ïa la ka burom , ma phi ki Israel phin tip ba nga long U  Trai  , namar ngam shym leh ïa phi kat kum ki jingbymman jong phi , ki jingleh basniew kiba phi dei hok ban ïoh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .

Na u Ïoannis shiah ki hynñiew tylli ki balang ha ka probins jong ka Asia : Ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk ïa phi! na U Blei! , uba long , uba la long bad u ban sa wan , bad na ki hynñiew ki mynsiem kiba ha khmat ka khet Jong u ,
translation.en: John to the seven churches which are in Asia : Grace be unto you , and peace , from him which is , and which was , and which is to come  ; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne  ;

translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka jubab , To ai ba kano kano ka jingtim kan hap halor jong por ; ko khun jong nga , shu leh kumba nga ong ; bad kai leit bad wanrah ïa ki blang shai na .
translation.en: And his mother said unto him , Upon me be thy curse , my son : only obey my voice , and go fetch me them .

translation.kha: Ha ka step kaweh bud u Balak u la ïalam ïa u Baaltamar sha Ramoth Baal , na kaba u Balaam u lah ban ieh shi bynta jong ki paid Israel .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Balak took Balaam , and brought him up into the high places of Baal , that thence he might see the utmost part of the people .

translation.kha: U Mordekai u ong ïa u ïa kaei baroh kaba la jia ïa u bad haw kato ka pisa ba u Haman u la kular ban bah ha ka ïing jingpynkynmaw u syiem lada ïa baroh ki Jiw la pynïap .
translation.en: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him , and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king s treasuries for the Jews , to destroy them .

translation.kha: U Arbad u jubab , Abner , hato ngim dei u briew uba khraw tam ha Israel ? Haba kumta , balei mem ïada ïa u syiem , u kynrad jong me ? Myntan uwei u briew’ u la ïohrung ha ka ïing dara ban pynïap ïa u syiem kynhied jong me .
translation.en: And David said to Abner , Art not thou a valiant man ? and who is like to thee in Israel ? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king ? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord .

translation.kha: To tama nala bad nga bad wat sheptieng . U Saul u kwah ban pynpyut ïa phiah bad ïa sa , hynrei phi lait na ka jingma malu nga .
translation.en: Abide thou with me , fear not : for he that seeketh my life seeketh thy life : but with me thou shalt be in safeguard .

translation.kha: Haba u syiem Baasha u la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la sangeh noh ïa ka jingtei pynskhem ïa ka Ramah bad u leit sha Tibhath .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Baasha heard thereof , that he left off building of Ramah , and dwelt in Tirzah .

translation.kha: Sa shisien U Jisu u la leit noh bad u la duwai , Ko Kpa jong nga , Ladan ïa kane ka tukri ka jingshoh shitom ym lah ban skhem noh lymda nga dih ïa ka , ïa ka mon jong me yn ni .
translation.en: He went away again the second time , and prayed , saying ,  O my Father , if this cup may not pass away from me , except I drink it , thy will be done .
Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the  Lord  : for men abhorred the offering of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ka pop jong ki khun u Eli ka long kaba la shyrkhei palat ha khmat U  Trai  , namar ba ki la ñiew khlem ka jingburom ïa ki jingainguh ha U  Trai .

translation.en: My son , fear thou the  Lord  and the king : and meddle not with them that are given to change :
translation.kha: Ko khun , tiengburom ïa U  Trai  bad burom ïa u syiem . Wat leh ei ei bad ki briew kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ;
U Simon u la ïohi ba la ai ïa U Mynsiem ha ki bangeit haba ki apostol ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki . Kumta u la tyrwa pyrta ha u Petros bad u Ïoannis ,
translation.en: And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles  hands the Holy Ghost was given , he offered them money ,

translation.kha: Bad phi lah ban sngewthikna ba lada u trai ïinglieng u la tip ïa ka por haba u nongtuh un wan , un ym shah ïa u nongpang ban prong shapoh ka ïing jong u .
translation.en: And this know , that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come , he would have watched , and not have suffered his house to be broken through .
O Israel , thou hast destroyed thyself  ; but in me is thine help .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa phi , ko ki paid Israel ! Te uei uba lah ban ïarap ïa phi ?
To Bishar ha ka balang jong nga ; me tip ïa ki jingbakla katba la leh pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: O  Lord  , thou hast seen my wrong : judge thou my cause .

translation.kha: u la kylli ïa u Ariokh balei ba u syiem u la pynmih kum kane ka hukum katba eh . Kumta u Ariokh u la ïathaw ïa u Daniel ïa kai kaba la lah jia .
translation.en: He answered and said to Arioch the king s captain , Why is the decree so hasty from the king ? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel .
And the lot of the children of Joseph fell from Jordan by Jericho , unto the water of Jericho on the east , to the wilderness that goeth up from Jericho throughout mount Beth–el ,
translation.kha: Ïa u pud bashaphang shathie jong ka ri la ai ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph ; u sdang na ka Jordan hajan ka Jerikho , ha ka bynta kaba sha mihngi jong ki umpohliew ka Jerikho , bad u suh sha ka ri shyiap . U suh na ka Jerikho artet sha ka ri lum haduh ka Bethel .

translation.en: And the whole multitude sought to touch him : for there went virtue out of him , and healed them all .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew ki la pyrshang ban ktah ïa u , naba ka bor ka la mih na u bad ka da pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .
U khap u dei ruh ban pynbiang ha la ïing ïa ki jingdonkam ba kynja mynsiem .
translation.en: A father must also provide for his family’s spiritual needs .

translation.kha: ( U Jakob 1 :17 ) Phin ioh tip Kamon ban wan shajan jong u lyngba ka jingduwai .
translation.en: ( James 1 :17 ) You will come to know how to approach him in prayer .

translation.kha: Da ka borbah jong ki tiar thma kin jop ïa ki Assyria , ka ri jong u Nimrim , bad kin pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Assyria ïahap ki hiarthma ïa ka ri jong ngi .
translation.en: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword , and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof : thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian , when he cometh into our land , and when he treadeth within our borders .

translation.kha: Ia ka pyrthei mynta la pynkhleh ha kiba bun tylli ki ri .
translation.en: Now the earth is divided up into many countries .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jongnga iathuh u paidlang kin buh ïa la ki ktah ha ka khlieh jong u , bad kin pynïap ïa u hangta .
translation.en: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the  Lord  : and the bullock shall be killed before the  Lord .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh jong u blei Seus , uba ka templ jong u ka ïeng khap pyut shabar shnong , u la wallam ïa ki mangi dab bad ki syntied sha ka khyrdop , naba ma u bad ki paidbah ki la khiew ban ai ka jingkñia sha ki apostol .
translation.en: Then the priest of Jupiter , which was before their city , brought oxen and garlands unto the gates , and would have done sacrifice with the people .

translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah khyndai snep , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .
translation.en: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years , and begat sons and daughters .

translation.kha: Ki la rung shat ka nongbah bad ki la leit sha ka kamra ha ka ki la sah : U Petros , u Ïoannis , u Jubab bad u Andriw , u Philip bad u Thomas , u Bartholomai bad u Matthaïos , u Jobab u khun jong u Alphaïos , u Simon u duriaw-rit Ri , bad u Judas u khun jong u Jakob .
translation.en: And when they were come in , they went up into an upper room , where abode both Peter , and James , and John , and Andrew , Philip , and Thomas , Bartholomew , and Matthew , James the son of Alphaeus , and Simon Zelotes , and Judas the brother of James .

translation.kha: bad sa eiei u phasi bad uwei u langbrot ban pynlong ka jingkñia ingiew ïasyllok . dem ban kñia ïa ki ha U Trai ryngkat bad ka jingainguh ba-im ba la khleh bad ka umphniang . Ki dei ban imat ïa kane namar U Trai un wanpaw ha ki mynta ka snoh .
translation.en: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings , to sacrifice before the  Lord   ; and a meat offering mingled with oil : for to day the  Lord  will appear unto you .
And unto the families of the children of Merari , the rest of the Levites , out of the tribe of Zebulun , Jokneam with her suburbs , and Kartah with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: Kiba sah jong ki Lebi , ka kur Merari , ka la ïohpdiang na ka jaka jong ka jait Sebulun saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Jokneam , ka Kartah ,
Hadien ba u la tiduh khyndiat ka wei , u la bakhor , u law ïa la ki jaiñ bad u thiah lyngkhuit hapoh la ka ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And he drank of the wine , and was drunken  ; and he was uncovered within his tent .

translation.kha: To ka burom jong U Trai kan ne junom ! To U Trai un kmiesan ïa kaei ka u la thaw !
translation.en: The glory of the  Lord  shall endure for ever : the  Lord  shall rejoice in his works .

translation.kha: Kum ki jingjngem ki bym don ei ei ban pynïap bad ban bam , ki ïap , bad ki khwan jong ki baroh ki saitlah .
translation.en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey , and the stout lion s whelps are scattered abroad .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha por ,
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: U Trai u la leh ha me kumba u la kren da ar : u la knieh kynthet ïa ka hima na me , bad pynban u la ai ïa ka ha u ïabuaid .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath done to him , as he spake by me : for the  Lord  hath rent the kingdom out of thine hand , and given it to thy neighbour , even to David :

translation.kha: Hynñiew la pynhiar ïa nga ha ka Shaneng na ka jingkhangïit kaweh ha ka kynroh bad la pyllait im ïa por na u .
translation.en: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall , and escaped his hands .
The word of the  Lord  which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga shaphang ki hima , da kaba sdang na ka Ijipt .
Nangta ki Pharisi ki la mihnoh bad ki la pynong ki jingmut ban pynïap ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: Then the Pharisees went out , and held a council against him , how they might destroy him .

translation.kha: A Trai to khie malade ïarap ïa ngi ! Pyndonkam ïa la ka bor bad pynim ïa ngi ; pyndonkam ïa ka kum ha ka por mynbarim . Dei ma me uba la ot lyngkhot lyngngai ïa u Rahab u mrad duriaw bakynsha .
translation.en: Awake , awake , put on strength , O arm of the  Lord   ; awake , as in the ancient days , in the generations of old . Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab , and wounded the dragon ?

translation.kha: Kaba mih nangta ka hir ba nga khyllem kum ka dieng pyut , Kum ka jaiñphong ba la bam ksiang .
translation.en: And he , as a rotten thing , consumeth , as a garment that is moth eaten .

translation.kha: Ki bhabriew kiba riewspah , pynban , ki mutdur ba ka spah jong ki ka ïada ïa ki kum ki kynroh babiang bakhlaiñ shohdoh ïa ka nongbud .
translation.en: The rich man s wealth is his strong city , and as an high wall in his own conceit .

translation.kha: Ka shithi kaba u patsha u la thuh ka kren pyrshah ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Israel . Ka ong , Ki blei jong ki hima kiei shem da ban pyllait ïa ki brup jong ki na ka bor jong nga , bad da laiñ lem U Balei jong u Hesekaïah un ym lah ba pyllait im ïa la ki briew na nga .
translation.en: He wrote also letters to rail on the  Lord  God of Israel , and to speak against him , saying , As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand , so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand .

translation.kha: Bad u Joshua u ong , Balei me la pynngat ha ngi ïa ka jynjar kaba kum Kanneh ? U Tiras myntoi un pyngngad ïa ka jynjar ha me ! Te ki briew baroh ki lyngkhuit maw ïa u Akhan haduh ba un da ïarep ; ki lynthem Maw bad ki thang hati ïa ki ba-ïaishah ha-sem jong u bad ïa ki jingdon jingem jong u .
translation.en: And Joshua said , Why hast thou troubled us ? the  Lord  shall trouble thee this day . And all Israel stoned him with stones , and burned them with fire , after they had stoned them with stones .

translation.kha: lem bad sawphew tylli ki thliew tnat rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei ka jingñiewkor .
translation.en: And their forty sockets of silver  ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .
For who will hearken unto you in this matter ? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle , so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff : they shall part alike .
translation.kha: Ym don u ban mynjur ïa kata ka jingong jong phi ! Baroh dei ban ïasam kumjuh : uta uba sah shadien bad ki jingkit jingbah un ïoh bynta mar katjuh kum uta uba leit sha ka thma .
U Tel u la kwah ban wallam jingjynjar ha ki paid Israel , kumin u la pynlong ïa u Dabid ban rai ban rim ka jingkheiñbriew .
translation.en: And Satan stood up against Israel , and provoked David to number Israel .

translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki briew na kata ka thain ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban leit noh , namar ba ki la sheptieng shikyntien eh . Kumta U Jisu u la kiew Hamor ka lieng bad u la leit noh .
translation.en: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them  ; for they were taken with great fear : and he went up into the ship , and returned back again .

translation.kha: Ka jingpynshitom ïa ka jingshah pynïap jong ki kan hap ha u Joab pynlang ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u shi junom . Jamynrei U Trai un ïadei ai ka jingjop ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid kiba shong ha ka khet jong u .
translation.en: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab , and upon the head of his seed for ever : but upon David , and upon his seed , and upon his house , and upon his throne , shall there be peace for ever from the  Lord .
Thou shalt be blessed above all people : there shall not be male or female barren among you , or among your cattle .
translation.kha: Yn ym don ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ka ban ïoh kat kine ki jingkyrkhu . Yn ym don mano mano u ban lyngki napdeng jong phi , lane napdeng ki jingri jong phi .

translation.en: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre , saying , As thou didst deal with David my father , and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein , even so deal with me .
translation.kha: U Solomon u phah khubor sha u Hiram u syiem ka Tyros :  To ïakhaïi bad nga kumba phi la leh bad u syiem Dabid , u kpa jong nga , mynba phi la die ïa u ki dieng Kedar tylli na ka bynta ban tei ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u .
Ki jaitbynriew ki la ïohsngew shaphang ka jingshat lehrain jong phad ; bhor ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam jong pha . Uwei u shipai u Ban Hamor iwei pat , sad baroh ar ngut ki kyllon ha maïan .
translation.en: The nations have heard of thy shame , and thy cry hath filled the land : for the mighty man hath stumbled against the mighty , and they are fallen both together .

translation.kha: Kren na ka bynta jong ki bad long u nongbishar uba hok . Ïada ïa ki hok jong babha duk bad kiba kyrduh .
translation.en: Open thy mouth , judge righteously , and plead the cause of the poor and needy .
And Heber begat Japhlet , and Shomer , and Hotham , and Shua their sister .
translation.kha: U Heber u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Japhlet , u Shomer , bad u Hotham , bad kawei ka khun , ka Shua .
U Moses u duwai ,
translation.en: And Moses spake unto the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong , Em , ko Trai , wat phah ïa nga . Ngam ju lama u nongkren ba-pnah , bad ngam shym long kum uwei na kita naduh ba me la sdang ban kren ïa to . Nga long u bym pnah ban kren , uba Sukki bad babha thlun .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , O my Lord , I am not eloquent , neither heretofore , nor since thou hast spoken unto thy servant : but I am slow of speech , and of a slow tongue .

translation.kha: shaneng mihngi , ni bahynriew nguid ki nongap phira man la ka sngi ; shaphrang shatei , bad shaneng shai , rupa ngat synsar lwet la buh na ka bynta ka kamra buh tiar .
translation.en: Eastward were six Levites , northward four a day , southward four a day , and toward Asuppim two and two .

translation.kha: Pha la lehbha Katta katta! Uei umbiah la pynlong ïa phi ban sangeh ban kohnguh ïa ka jingshisha ? Da kumno u la khroh ïa phi ?
translation.en: Ye did run well ; who did hinder you that ye should not obey the truth ?

translation.kha: Tei ïa nga kawei ka duwan da ka khyndew , bad kynïan ïa ki lbong bad ki masi jong phi halor jong ka kum ki jingngeit thang bad ki jingtah ïasyllok . Ha man la ka jaka ba nga pynkyrpang ba phira ma ïa nga , ngan waiñ bad kyrkhu ïa phi .
translation.en: An altar of earth thou shalt make unto me , and shalt sacrifice thereon thy burnt offerings , and thy peace offerings , thy sheep , and thine oxen : in all places where I record my name I will come unto thee , and I will bless thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kaba nyngkong , ha ka por ka jingpynlong , ‘ U Blei u la Thaw ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei ,’ kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong .
translation.en: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female .

translation.kha: rahah ba u patsha un pynshong pynïasoh pat ïa phi ha ka ri kumba ka dei ka jong phi hi , ha kaba don ki bri sohwaiñ ban ai sohwaiñ bad yn don ki kwah ban pynlong kpu ; ka dei ka ri ki Olib , ka jingmane Oholiab , Bad ka ngap . Lada phi leh ïa kaei kaba u hukum , phin ym ïap , hynrei phan im . Wat ai ba u Hesekaïah un pynbtai ïa phi ba phin pyrkhat ba U Trai un pynkoit im ïa Phi .
translation.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land , a land of corn and wine , a land of bread and vineyards , a land of oil olive and of honey , that ye may live , and not die : and hearken not unto Hezekiah , when he persuadeth you , saying , The  Lord  will deliver us .

And now , Israel , what doth the  Lord  thy God require of thee , but to fear the  Lord  thy God , to walk in all his ways , and to love him , and to serve the  Lord  thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul ,
translation.kha: Mynta , ko ki paid Israel , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u dawa na phi : Mane ïa U  Trai  bad leh ïa kata baroh kaba u hukum . Ieit ïa u , shakri ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi baroh , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh .

translation.en: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the  Lord  to bless Israel , he went not , as at other times , to seek for enchantments , but he set his face toward the wilderness .
translation.kha: Haduh mynta u Balaam u la tip ba U  Trai  u kwah ïa u ba un kyrkhu ïa ki paid Israel , kumta um shym leit wad shuh ïa ki dak ki shin kumba u la leh mynshuwa . U la phai la ki khmat shaphang ka ri shyiap ,
Baroh ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Israel ! Ïaroh ïa u mynta bad junom ! Nangta baroh u paidbah u Ong , Amen , mala ïaroh ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel for ever and ever . And all the people said , Amen , and praised the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki bri kin ïaid sakma lyngba ka ri , kiba la noh mynsiem nabar thngan . Ha ka jingthang bad jingbitar jong ki , ktien tim ïa u syiem jong ki bad ïa U Blei jong ki . Ki ia ban khmih sha ka sahit bneng
translation.en: And they shall pass through it , hardly bestead and hungry : and it shall come to pass , that when they shall be hungry , they shall fret themselves , and curse their king and their God , and look upward .
Then there arose certain of the synagogue , which is called the synagogue of the Libertines , and Cyrenians , and Alexandrians , and of them of Cilicia and of Asia , disputing with Stephen .
translation.kha: Hynrei la pyrshah ïa u da katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba long ki dkhot ka synagog jong ki briew kiba la laitluid ( kumba la khot ïa ki ) , kaba kynthup ïa ki Jiw na Kyrini bad na Aleksandria . Ma ki bad kiwei pat ki Jiw na ki thain ka Kilikia bad Asia ki la ïasdang ban ïasaidnia bad u Stephan .
Ka lama kaba beiñ ban sngewtynnat haba leh byndi . Ki briew bakha stad ki sngewbha ha ka jingstad .
translation.en: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief : but a man of understanding hath wisdom .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , Ki briew kiba khiah kim bunkam ïa u nongpynkhiah , hynrei tang kito kiba pang .
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  They that are whole need not a physician  ; but they that are sick .

translation.kha: Kñia ka long ka sngi jong U Trai Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh : ha khnai ka sngi un pynhiarkput ; ha kane ka sngi un pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jong u . Ka waitlam jong u kan bam ïa ki haduh ban da kdang , pynlang dih ïa ka snem jong ki haduh ïa-ban da sngewhun . Ha kano ka sngi u Badonbor Baroh u kñia ïa bakha la shah pynmong ha ka phang bashatei , ïasan ka Ïuphratis .
translation.en: For this is the day of the Lord  God  of hosts , a day of vengeance , that he may avenge him of his adversaries : and the sword shall devour , and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood : for the Lord  God  of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates .
And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate , a damsel came to hearken , named Rhoda .
translation.kha: U Petros u la tied ïa ka jingkhang kaba shabar , bad ka shakri kaba kyrteng ka Rhoda ka la wan ban peit uei uba tied .
Ki briew jong nga ki la Shah shahskhor ha ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la kular ïa ka jingsuk ïa kito katba da siewdor ïa ki , hynrei ki byrngem da ka tdem ïa kito ki bym siew .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  concerning the prophets that make my people err , that bite with their teeth , and cry , Peace  ; and he that putteth not into their mouths , they even prepare war against him .

translation.kha: Nangta , U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka , u la leit sha ka probins jong ka Judia , bad u la jam shaei shikhung ka wah Jadon . Ki paidbah ki la ïalum babiang ha u , bad u la hikai ïa ki , kumba u ju leh .
translation.en: And he arose from thence , and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan : and the people resort unto him again  ; and , as he was wont , he taught them again .

translation.kha: jynreiñ u Nathan um shym la jingsngewsih ba u kpa jong u , u la maham jur ïa ki rangbah da ka jingairam ; kumta u la kner da u dieng ba u rah , u pynngam ïa u ha ka rewngap , bad u bam khyndiat ka ngap . Hangta hi u la sngew ïohbor .
translation.en: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath : wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand , and dipped it in an honeycomb , and put his hand to his mouth  ; and his eyes were enlightened .

translation.kha: Nangta u la phah ïa u nongbah pynïaidkam lem bad basanphew ngut ki nongbah ban wanlam ïa u Elijah . U rangbah pynïaidkam u shem ïa u ba u shnong Hamor u lum bad u ong ha u , Ko briew jongno U blem , u syiem u hukum ïa phi ban wan hiar shano .
translation.en: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty . And he went up to him : and , behold , he sat on the top of an hill . And he spake unto him , Thou man of God , the king hath said , Come down .

translation.kha: U Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego ki la ïajubab , Ko Syiem Kynrad , ngin ym pyrshang ngab ïasaid da ïa lap .
translation.en: Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , answered and said to the king , O Nebuchadnezzar , we are not careful to answer thee in this matter .

translation.kha: Ïa ki kjat jong u la soh da ka rnong , bad u kieng ïa u sum rnong ba thah ha ka tyngkreiñ .
translation.en: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs , and a target of brass between his shoulders .

translation.kha: Ki sei ïa u na ka kali ïapom jong u , ki buh ïa u ha ka kali ïapom kaba ar kaba u don hangta , bad ki kit ïa u sha Jerusalem . Hangta u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem . Baroh ki paid Ïuodia bad Jerushah ki ïambriew namar ka jingïap jong u .
translation.en: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot , and put him in the second chariot that he had  ; and they brought him to Jerusalem , and he died , and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers . And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah .

translation.kha: To ieit ïa ki turoi thma ha Gibeah ! Pynsawa ïa ka jingkyrsiew ha Ramath ! Pyrkhat jam shaphang ka thma ha Bethaben ! Tur sha ka sur-thma , ko ki Rangbah Benjamin !
translation.en: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah , and the trumpet in Ramah : cry aloud at Beth–aven , after thee , O Benjamin .

translation.kha: Hynrei namar kein shibun babha khop sarong na ki daw ba kynja briew , per ruh ngan leh kumjuh .
translation.en: Seeing that many glory after the flesh , I will glory also .
The son of Abinadab , in all the region of Dor  ; which had Taphath the daughter of Solomon to wife :
translation.kha: U Benabinadab , uba shongkurim ïa ka Taphath , ka khun jong u Solomon : ka thain Dor baroh kawei ;

Lymda kumta ka la dei ïa u don sha Bunsien naduh myn dang long ka pyllait . Pynban , mynsiem hato ka to Baroh ka la jaiñ poi sha kaba kut , u la paw tang shikyntien hi , ban pyndam noh ïa ka nongpop da kaba kñia ïa lade .
translation.en: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world : but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself .

translation.kha: Hadien , wat haba ka jingbitar u syiem ka la pjah , u ïai pyrkhat shaphang kaei kaba ka Bashti ka la kuna bad shaphang ka jingpynbha jrong u pyrshah ïa ka .
translation.en: After these things , when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased , he remembered Vashti , and what she had done , and what was decreed against her .

translation.kha: dalade phi pynkdang ïa ka kti u balui , phin long ki briew ba kmen tam .
translation.en: If you apply God’s Word , you will be a happier person .
Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler , and from the noisome pestilence .
translation.kha: Un ri sumar ïa me na ki jingma barieh baroh bad na ki jingpang bashyrkhei baroh .
Ki lah don hapoh ka jingsynshar u Khedorlaomer haduh khat-ar snam , hynmen ha ka snem kaba khatlai ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer , and in the thirteenth year they rebelled .
And beside this , giving all diligence , add to your faith virtue  ; and to virtue knowledge  ;
translation.kha: Te namar kane hi ka daw phi dei ban leh ïa kaba bha tam jong phi ban pynlang ïa ka jingbha ha ka jingngeit jong phi ; ha ka jingbha jong phi pynlang ïa ka jingtip ;
