Ki khyrdop jong ka nongbah kin plie baroh shi sngem ; yn ym khang ïa ki da lei lei , namar yn ym don ka miet hangta .
translation.en: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day : for there shall be no night there .
For of old time I have broken thy yoke , and burst thy bands  ; and thou saidst , I will not transgress  ; when upon every high hill and under every green tree thou wanderest , playing the harlot .
translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ,  Ko Israel , la slem bah me la kyntait ïa ka iktiar jong nga ; me la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa nga bad mane ïa nga . Ha uwei pa uwei u lum bakynjang bad hapoh uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam me la mane ïa ki blei ka jingkharoi .
Kumta ki la ïashem na shnong bad ki la leit sha U Jisu .
translation.en: Then they went out of the city , and came unto him .

translation.kha: Ynda ka por pynkhuid ïa ka , ka la kut , la ka long na ka bynta u khun ne ka khun , ka dei ban wallam shiah u lyngdoh ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U thri ïa u khunlangbrot uba shisnem kum ka jingainguh thang bad ïa ka lyngdkhur ne ka paro kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop .
translation.en: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled , for a son , or for a daughter , she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering , and a young pigeon , or a turtledove , for a sin offering , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , unto the priest :

translation.kha: Wat lada don kiba la shu khot ki blei , la ha bneng ne ha pyrthei , bad wat Ladan don shibun kum kine ki blei bad ki trai ;
translation.en: For though there be that are called gods , whether in heaven or in earth , ( as there be gods many , and lords many , )
Beside that he had of the merchantmen , and of the traffick of the spice merchants , and of all the kings of Arabia , and of the governors of the country .
translation.kha: nalor ki khajna ba la siew da ki nongkhaïi , ki jingïohnong na ka khaïi ka pateng , ka bai nguh syiem na ki syiem Arabia , bad na ki lat jong ki distrik ha Israel .

translation.en: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the  Lord  , which is in the tabernacle of the congregation  ; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering , which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Nangta un tah snam khyndiat ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan ka jingiwbih thang kaba hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ . U dei ban theh ïa ka snam kaba sah , ha trai ka duwan ki jingkñia ainguh thang kiba don ha khmat jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ .

translation.en: And the king said unto me , ( the queen also sitting by him , ) For how long shall thy journey be ? and when wilt thou return ? So it pleased the king to send me  ; and I set him a time .
translation.kha: U patsha , ryngkat bad ka mahadei kaba shong ha syndah jong u , u la mynjur ïa ka jingkyrpad jong nga . U la kylli ïa nga katno slem ngan jah bad ba ngan wan phai pat , bad nga ïathuh ha u .
U Dabid u lytar shat u Ahikam u lyngdoh ha Nob . U Ahimelekh u mih da kaba pyrkhing ban leit tan ïa u , bad u kylli , Balei ba phi wan hangtei tang maw ?
translation.en: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest : and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David , and said unto him , Why art thou alone , and no man with thee ?

translation.kha: Neng la ïohi kumno ki im , hynrei ngan pynkhiah pang ïa ki . Ngan ïalam ïa ki bad ïarap ïa ki , bad ngan pyntngen ïa kito naba ïam sngewsih .
translation.en: I have seen his ways , and will heal him : I will lead him also , and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners .
The heaven for height , and the earth for depth , and the heart of kings is unsearchable .
translation.kha: Phim ju tip kaei u syiem u pyrkhat ; ki jingmut jong u ki long sha lyndet ka jingtip jong ngi , kumba jrong ka sahit bneng ne kumba jylliew ka duriaw-bah .

U Samuel u Mihnoh na Gilgal bad u saw la ka lynti . Kiba sah na ki bri ki la bud ïa u Saul Katba u dang ithuh pun ïasoh dara la ki shipai . Ki leit na jingïalam shiah Gibeah ha ka tian Benjamin . U Saul u leit peit ïa la ka kynhun shipai , kiba khong kumba pynriewspah ngut .
translation.en: And Samuel arose , and gat him up from Gilgal unto Gibeah of Benjamin . And Saul numbered the people that were present with him , about six hundred men .

That sendeth ambassadors by the sea , even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters , saying , Go , ye swift messengers , to a nation scattered and peeled , to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto  ; a nation meted out and trodden down , whose land the rivers have spoiled !
translation.kha: Na kata ka ri , ki nongkit  tiensyiem ki la wan arsut ïa ka Nile ha ki lieng ba la shna da ki khah . Khie noh sha ïing , ko nonglamktien bastet ! Rah noh ïa ka khubor sha ka ri jong phi kaba la pynïakhlad ïa ki wah , sha ka jaitbynriew jong phi kaba khlaiñ bad kaba donbor , sha ki briew jong phi kiba jrong bad kiba jlih ka sniehdoh , ïa kiba la sheptieng ha kylleng ka pyrthei baroh .
Ha ka Jingïohipaw , U Mynsiem! jong U Blei u la rakhe shajrong ïa nga Bad wallam pat ïa nga sha kiba shah ringmraw ha bniah . Nangta ka jingïohipaw ka ja noh ,
translation.en: Afterwards the spirit took me up , and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea , to them of the captivity . So the vision that I had seen went up from me .
There are only books on the shelf .
translation.kha: Don tang ki kot ha duli .
U Trai U Blei jong phi u pynbudnam ïa u ban tynjuh ïa phi , ba khmih la phi ieit ne em ïa U Trai da ka dohnud jrong ph baroh .
translation.en: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet , or that dreamer of dreams : for the  Lord  your God proveth you , to know whether ye love the  Lord  your God with all your heart and with all your soul .

translation.kha: Thaw ruh sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka rnong , pynliat ïa ki ha Kita ki kyrwoh , bad suh lang ïa kita ki jaiñ jingtap ar tylli ba kin long kawei ka jinghap .
translation.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass , and put the taches into the loops , and couple the tent together , that it may be one .
And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love , and they defiled her with their whoredom , and she was polluted with them , and her mind was alienated from them .
translation.kha: Ki nong Babilonia ki wan ïathiah shongkha bad ka . Ki pyndonkam ïa ka bad ki pyntngit ïa ka katta katta haduh ba khatduh kan da sngewngiah ïa ki .
bad hajan kata u la im sa phraspah hynñiew snem . U la ïoh ruh Kiwei bapaw ki khun
translation.en: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years , and begat sons and daughters :

translation.kha: Kumta ïa ki balang la nang pynkhlad ha ka jingbeit bad ki la nang roi ha ka jingbun briew man ka sngi .
translation.en: And so were the churches established in the faith , and increased in number daily .

For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time , then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place  ; but thou and thy father s house shall be destroyed : and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this ?
translation.kha: Lada pha sngap jar ha ka por kum kane , ka jingïarap kan wan na bneng ïa ki Jiw , bad kin lait im , hynrei phan ïap , bad ka longïing u kpa jong pha kan kut noh . Pynban mano ba lah ban tip — lehse ka dei na ka bynta ka por kum kane ba la pynlong mahadei ïa pha !
Uwei uwei baroh u la ïoh ïa kaei kaba u la leh ; hynrei ngi lah tieng ban Shu khmih na jngai .
translation.en: Every man may see it  ; man may behold it afar off .

And the king shall do according to his will  ; and he shall exalt himself , and magnify himself above every god , and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods , and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished : for that that is determined shall be done .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Syria un leh kat kaba u sngewbha . Un kob ba u long kham khraw ban ïa uno uno u blei , kham halor wat ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Un lah ban leh ïa kane tad haduh ha ka por haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa u . U Blei un leh thik ïa kaei kaba u la thmu .

Mynta , lada ka pynsngewbha ïa phi , ko syiad , ai ba yn ïit ha ki jingshoh syiem ha Babilon ban shem lada u Sirion u la ai ne um shym la ai ki sah na ka bynda ka jingtei pat ïa kane ka Templ ha Jerusalem , bad nangta sa pynteh ïa ngi kaei ka myn jong phi ha kane ka kam .
translation.en: Now therefore , if it seem good to the king , let there be search made in the king s treasure house , which is there at Babylon , whether it be so , that a decree was made of Cyrus the king to build this house of God at Jerusalem , and let the king send his pleasure to us concerning this matter .

translation.kha: Ki pukni ki wan hiar ha kita ki metïap , hynrei u Abram u beh noh ïa ki .
translation.en: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases , Abram drove them away .

translation.kha: Phin ïohi ïa ‘ Ka Jingijli Bashyrkhei’ ïa ka u Daniel u nongïathuh lypa u la kren . Kan ïingjaiñ ha ka jaka bakhuid . ( Ka jingkynthoh ïa u nongpule : Da pynthikna ban shaphrang aïu kane ka kit jingmut ! )
translation.en: When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation , spoken of by Daniel the prophet , stand in the holy place ,  ( whoso readeth , let him understand : )

translation.kha: ( Naba baroh ki sohshnong jngai ka Athens bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah hangta ki sngewtynnat shun pynlut ïa ka por jong ki barabor ha kaba ïathuh bad sngap ïa kaei kaei kaba thymmai tam . )
translation.en: ( For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else , but either to tell , or to hear some new thing . )

translation.kha: Kin rwai da kaba kmen , hynrei phi Phon ïam ha ka jingpait dohnud .
translation.en: Behold , my servants shall sing for joy of heart , but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart , and shall howl for vexation of spirit .

And when the year was expired , king Nebuchadnezzar sent , and brought him to Babylon , with the goodly vessels of the house of the  Lord  , and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Haba ka pyrem ka la poi , u syiem Nebukhadnessar u ïalam ïa u Jehoïakhin sha Babilon kum u koidi , bad u rah lang ïa ki jingkynshew jong ka Templ . Nangta u Nebukhadnessar u pynlong ïa u Sedekaïah u kñi jong u Jehoïakhin kum u syiem ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem .
Kam long ha u brup uba iaid ban pynbeit ia la ki jingjam .
translation.en: It does not belong to man who is walking even to direct his step .

And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance , and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly , and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the  Lord  concerning things which should not be done , and are guilty  ;
translation.kha: Lada dei u paid Israel baroh uba leh pop khlem tip bad u hap ha ka jingpynrem ba u la pynkheiñ ïa kawei na ki hukum U  Trai  ,

translation.en: An evil man seeketh only rebellion : therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him .
translation.kha: Ka jingïap kan wan kum u nonglamktien barunar ïa ki riewbymman kiba pynkhih jingkulmar borabor .
Ha ka sien ïaid tawiar kaba hynñiew , hain ba ki lyngdoh kin put ïa ki turoi , u Joshua u sah ïa u paidbah baneh ria , sad u ong , U Trai u la ai ha phi ïa ka nongbah !
translation.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time , when the priests blew with the trumpets , Joshua said unto the people , Shout  ; for the  Lord  hath given you the city .

translation.kha: Ngan sa pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jong ka baroh , kumba la thoh ha ka Kitab ba u syiem u la pule .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will bring evil upon this place , and upon the inhabitants thereof , even all the words of the book which the king of Judah hath read :

translation.kha: Haba u Elisha u la poi , u la leit marwei shab ka dom bad u la ïohi ïa u khynnah ba u thiah ïap halor ka jingthiah .
translation.en: And when Elisha was come into the house , behold , the child was dead , and laid upon his bed .

translation.kha: ban long kiba synshar ïa lade mala kiba sngur myn , bad ki nongsynshar ïing babha kiba pyndem ha la ki tnga , ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban kren sniew ïa ka khubor kaba wan na U Blei .
translation.en: To be discreet , chaste , keepers at home , good , obedient to their own husbands , that the word of God be not blasphemed .
The poor is hated even of his own neighbour : but the rich hath many friends .
translation.kha: Ym don kiba sngewtynnat ïa kiba duk , wat ki paramarjan jong ki , hynrei kiba riewspah ki don shibun ki paralok .
len pynshitom ïa ki briew jong nga namar ki la leh jop ; ki la phai dien noh na nga , ki la ai jingkñia sha kiwei pat ki blei , mala ki la shna ïa ki bleithaw bad mane ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will utter my judgments against them touching all their wickedness , who have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , and worshipped the works of their own hands .

And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley , and they that were on the other side Jordan , saw that the men of Israel fled , and that Saul and his sons were dead , they forsook the cities , and fled  ; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel kiba ha shiliang kata ka them Jesreel bad kiba sha mihngi ka wah Jordan ki ïohsngew ba ka kynhun shipai ki Israel ka la phet ïap bad u Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki la kyllon ïap , ki ruh ki iehnoh noh ïa la ki shnong bad ki phet ïap . Nangta ki Philistia ki wan bad ki shong shnong hangta .
Don ki briew kaba pynliem kai ïa la ka pisa bad ki nang ïai riewspah . Kiwei ki husiar , bad pynban ki nang ïai kyrduh .
translation.en: There is that scattereth , and yet increaseth  ; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet , but it tendeth to poverty .

translation.kha: Nga shakri kum u lyngdoh ha kaba ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blang , khnang ba ki Jentil ki lah ba-bang long ka jingkñia ba la pdiang sha U Balei , ba la pynkyntang shuh u da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles , ministering the gospel of God , that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable , being sanctified by the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: Khie mihnoh na Babilon , kiba laitluid ! Pyrta jam da ka jingkmen ïa ka khubor ; to pyntip ïa ka kylleng : U Trai u la pynim ïa ki shakri jong u , ki Israel !
translation.en: Go ye forth of Babylon , flee ye from the Chaldeans , with a voice of singing declare ye , tell this , utter it even to the end of the earth  ; say ye , The  Lord  hath redeemed his servant Jacob .
Now then it is no more I that do it , but sin that dwelleth in me .
translation.kha: Kumta ngam long shisha uta uba leh ïa kane kaei kaei ; pynban , ka dei ka pop kaba im hapoh jong nga .

translation.en: And if a soul sin , and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the  Lord   ; though he wist it not , yet is he guilty , and shall bear his iniquity .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u leh pop khlem tip da kaba u pynkheiñ ïa kano kano ka hukum U  Trai  , u long uba la rem bad u dei ban ïoh ïa ka bainong .
Ko phi ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem phin ym ïam shuh lano lanot ruh . U Trai u long uba sngewsynei , bad haba phi kyang sha u ba ïoh jingpyiar , un jubab ïa phi .
translation.en: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem : thou shalt weep no more : he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry  ; when he shall hear it , he will answer thee .

translation.kha: dei ïa-ban Shuh lynthem ïa u da u maw , ne ban siat ïarap ïa u da ki khnam , khlieh da ktah kti mano mano ïa u . Kane ka treikam ïa ki briew bad ki mrad ; dei ban pynïap ïa ki . Hynñiew haba la put ïa ka turoi , te ki briew kyang sa leit kiew sha u lum .
translation.en: There shall not an hand touch it , but he shall surely be stoned , or shot through  ; whether it be beast or man , it shall not live : when the trumpet soundeth long , they shall come up to the mount .
And when he had taken him , and brought him to his mother , he sat on her knees till noon , and then died .
translation.kha: U shakri u la bah ïa u khynnah sha ka kmie jong u , kaba thum ïa u ha la ka pneh haduh shiteng sngi , ka por ha kaba u la ïap .

Nangta to shim ïa ka jaiñ ba la teh sawdong ïa ka syngkai jong nga bad kynther ïa ka . Kumne U Blei un kynther ïano ïano na Phin u me bat ïa la ka kylluid , nga ong . U Blei un shim noh ïa ki ïing jong phi bad ïa kiei kiei baroh ba phi anna , malade un iehnoh ïa phoi khlem don ei ei shuh . Baroh kiba don hangta ki ong , Amen ! bad ki ïaroh ïa U Trai . Doeg ki nongïalam ki bat ïa ka kular jong ki .
translation.en: Also I shook my lap , and said , So God shake out every man from his house , and from his labour , that performeth not this promise , even thus be he shaken out , and emptied . And all the congregation said , Amen , and praised the  Lord . And the people did according to this promise .

translation.kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïaishah pyrda , da kaba iehnoh ïa u Rehoboam kum u syiem tang jong ki briew kiba shongkha shnong ha ka ri Jedaïah .
translation.en: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah , Rehoboam reigned over them .

translation.kha: Bad katkum , kumno ka burom ïa ka kyrteng U Jisu baroh’ ki jingthaw ha bneng , ha pyrthei pynlang ha ka pyrthei hapoh kin dem khrup ha ki khohsiew jong ki ,
translation.en: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow , of things in heaven , and things in earth , and things under the earth ;
And it came to pass , when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah , that he came down with an ephod in his hand .
translation.kha: Mynba u Abiathar u khun jong u Ahimelekh u la lait phet bad leit ïasoh bad u Dabid ha Keilah , u la rah ïa ka ephod lem bad u .
U thang ïa ki shyieng jong ki lyngdoh ba-thala ha ki kito ba ki la maïan . Da kaba leh ïa kane baroh , u pynlong ïa ka Jehoïada bad ïa ka Jerusalem ba la pynkhuid pat katjuh kum ka jinglehniam .
translation.en: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars , and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem .

And the name of the man was Elimelech , and the name of his wife Naomi , and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion , Ephrathites of Beth–lehem–judah . And they came into the country of Moab , and continued there .
translation.kha: Slem bah mynshuwa , ha ki sngi shuwa ba ki Israel kin ïoh syiem , la don ka  nemsniew ha ka ri . Kumta u briew uba kyrteng u Elimelekh , uba na ka kur Ephrath bad uba shong ha Bethlehem kaba ha Judah , u leit bad ka Naomi ka tnga jong u lem bad ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ki , u Mahlon bad u Khilion , ban sah shipor ha ka ri Moab . Katba ki dang sah hangta ,
Namar ba u don shibun ki kynhun langbrot malu ki kynhun masi , dara bun nguh ki shakri , ki Philetos ki la bishni ïa u .
translation.en: For he had possession of flocks , and possession of herds , and great store of servants : and the Philistines envied him .

translation.kha: Kumta ym dei shisha ma phi kiba la phah ïa nga shane , hynrei U Blei hi . U la pynlong ïa nga u rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh . Nga dei u nongkhmih ïa ka ri jngai u baroh kawei ; de long u nongsynshar ïa ka ri Jephthah baroh kawei .
translation.en: So now it was not you that sent me hither , but God : and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh , and lord of all his house , and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: La ïathuh ha barben ki Israel ba u Saul u la pynïap ïa u rangbah ai hukum jong ki Philistia bad ba ki phria ki la isih ïa ki . Kumta ki paidbah ki jubab ïa ka jingkhot ban ïasnoh bad u Saul ha Gilgal .
translation.en: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines , and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines . And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal .
And these are they which are sown on good ground  ; such as hear the word , and receive it , and bring forth fruit , some thirtyfold , some sixty , and some an hundred .
translation.kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai ba la bet ha ka khyndew kaba bha . Ki ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki pdiang ïa ka , bad ki seisoh : katto katne laiphew , katto katne hynriewphew , bad katto katne shispah .

translation.en: Then the king s servants , which were in the king s gate , said unto Mordecai , Why transgressest thou the king s commandment ?
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki rangbah synshar jong ka jingtreikam ha ïingsyiem ki la kylli ïa u balei ba um kohnguh ïa ka hukum u syiem ;

translation.en: But they said , Not on the feast day , lest there be an uproar of the people .
translation.kha: Ngim dei ban leh ïa kane ha ka por Ka Jingkhawai Niam ,  ki la ong ,  lymda kumta ki paidbah ki lah ban khih kulmar .
U la rah ïa nga kham sha junom , bad na la ïuh ïa eiei u briew uba phyrnai kum ka rnong . U bat ha ka ktien ïa u pita uba da ka jait lynti bad ïa u dkhiew nabar u ïohnang hajuh ka khyrdop .
translation.en: And he brought me thither , and , behold , there was a man , whose appearance was like the appearance of brass , with a line of flax in his hand , and a measuring reed  ; and he stood in the gate .

translation.kha: U Jisu , da ka ktien kabu eh u la hukum ïa ki mynsiem bymkhuid ban ym ïathuh ïano ïano ba u long uei .
translation.en: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known .

translation.kha: U Shelemaïah u ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba sanphew mihnoh , bad u Sekharaïah u khun lad u , u briew uba ai ki jingmut kiba ba na ka por sha ka por , u ïoh ïa ka khyrdop kaba shaphang shat .
translation.en: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah . Then for Zechariah his son , a wise counsellor , they cast lots  ; and his lot came out northward .

translation.kha: Naba ïa ka Hukum baher katai la kyllum lang ha khwai ka hukum kiba ïai-ong , Phibi ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba phi ieit ïa lade .
translation.en: For all the law is fulfilled in one word , even in this ; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ki Philistia ki ïalumlang ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel , kumta ki Israhaïah ki mih baneh ïaleh ïa ki . Ki Israel ki sher dara ha Ebeneser bad ki Philistia pat ha Akhaikos .
translation.en: And the word of Samuel came to all Israel . Now Israel went out against the Philistines to battle , and pitched beside Eben–ezer : and the Philistines pitched in Aphek .

translation.kha: U Isaak u pynkhreh ka jingkhawai ïa ki , bad ki ïabam ïadih .
translation.en: And he made them a feast , and they did eat and drink .

translation.kha: To wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ïa phi , ko ki khun Jong nga ! Uno uno uba leh ïa kaei kaba Dei , u erlangthari uba hok , kumba U Khrist u Long uba hok .
translation.en: Little children , let no man deceive you : he that doeth righteousness is righteous , even as he is righteous .
And hast given them this land , which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them , a land flowing with milk and honey  ;
translation.kha: Me la ai ha ki ïa kane ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , kumba me la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

Nangta ngan lynghoh ïa ki kum ïa ki khra uwei pyrshah ïa uwei pat , uba tymmen mala uba samla kumjuh . Ym don ka jingsngewsih , ka jingsngewlem , lane ka jingisynei ka ban pynsangeh ïa nga na kaba pynsep ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will dash them one against another , even the fathers and the sons together , saith the  Lord  : I will not pity , nor spare , nor have mercy , but destroy them .
A man shall not be established by wickedness : but the root of the righteous shall not be moved .
translation.kha: Ka jingleh bymman kam wanrah ïa ka jingshngain , hynrei ki briew kiba hok ki ïeng skhem .
Ki otsher phai malade ïai leit sha kine ki nuti . Ki sien biang sha ka Oholah bad ka Oholibah ; re ki kynthei barunar .
translation.en: Yet they went in unto her , as they go in unto a woman that playeth the harlot : so went they in unto Aholah and unto Aholibah , the lewd women .

translation.kha: ‘ Kenan ka long kaei kaba ngan kun ha ki sngi bakhatduh , U Blei u ong : Teng theh noh ïa U Mynsiem jong la halor uwei pa uwei baroh . Ki khwan shynna bad ki khun kynthei jong phi ken pynbun ïa ka khubor Jong nga ; ki samla shynrong jong phi kin ïohi ki jingïohipaw , bad ki rangbah ba la tymmen jong phi! kin ïoh ki jingpynïasoh .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in the last days , saith God , I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh : and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy , and your young men shall see visions , and your old men shall dream dreams :

translation.kha: Ka duriaw kaba jylliew ka la tap ïa ki ; ki la ngam sha trai duriaw kum u maw .
translation.en: The depths have covered them : they sank into the bottom as a stone .

translation.kha: Te u la nong ha u Timotheus , Buh ïa ka shylliah ti jong me hangne , bad peit ïa ki kti jong nga ; nangta kner ïa la ka kti bad buh ïa ka ha ka krung jong nga . Wat artatien shuh bad to ngeit !
translation.en: Then saith he to Thomas ,  Reach hither thy finger , and behold my hands  ; and reach hither thy hand , and thrust it into my side : and be not faithless , but believing .

translation.kha: Doeg kumta ngi la ïanguh lang Bad baroh sem la jingmynjur shun jied katto katne nguh ki nonglamktien bad phah ïa ki sha phira . Kin ïaleit bad ki paralok ba-itynnat jong ngi : U Barnabas sad u Paul ,
translation.en: It seemed good unto us , being assembled with one accord , to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul ,

So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought  ; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised , and her magnificence should be destroyed , whom all Asia and the world worshippeth .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingma , te , ba kane ka kam jong ngi kan budnam . Ym tang kata , hynrei ka don ruh ka jingma ba ka templ jong ka blei Artemis kan ym don jingmut ei ei shuh bad ba ïa ka jingkhraw jong ka yn pynduh — ka blei ba la mane da uwei pa uwei ha Asia bad ha ka pyrthei baroh !

translation.en: But thy servants will pass over , every man armed for war , before the  Lord  to battle , as my lord saith .
translation.kha: Hynrei baroh na ngi , ngi la kloi ban leit sha ka thma hapoh ka hukum jong U  Trai . Ngin jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad ïaleh , kumba phi la ong .

Ki paid Israel kim don bynta ei ei shuh bad ki bleithaw ; ngan jubab ïa ki jingïadei jngai ki bad samla ïa ki ; kum u diengduh ba ïai jingmaham ngan kah tngen ïa ki ; nga long u tyngeh jong ki jingkyrkhu jong ki baroh .
translation.en: Ephraim shall say , What have I to do any more with idols ? I have heard him , and observed him : I am like a green fir tree . From me is thy fruit found .

translation.kha: Kiei kaba me kwah na ngi , ko Jisu na Nasareth ? Hato me la wan hangne banbeiñ pynjot ïa ngi ? Nga tap me longïng uei — me long u nonglamktien Bakhuid jongngi U Blei! !
translation.en: Saying , Let us alone  ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art , the Holy One of God .

translation.kha: Katba u Petros u sdang rung , u Kornelios u la leit kynduh ïa u , u la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u , bad u la nguh dem ha khmat jong u .
translation.en: And as Peter was coming in , Cornelius met him , and fell down at his feet , and worshipped him .

translation.kha: Hattush phi sheptieng ïa ki waitlam ? Ngan wallam ïa ki briew ryngkat bad ki waitlam ban tat ïabeh ïa phi .
translation.en: Ye have feared the sword  ; and I will bring a sword upon you , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: U Blei u la pynlong ïa ngi kumba ngi long , bad ha U Khrist Jisu u la pynlong ïa ngi ban im na ka byndi ki kam babha , ïa kba u la pynkhreh lypa ba ngin ar ïa ki .
translation.en: For we are his workmanship , created in Christ Jesus unto good works , which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them .

translation.kha: Mynta , ha kaba ïadei malade ka jingmihpat kiba ïap : Hato kino pat ju pluh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la ïathuh ha phi ? U la ong ,
translation.en: But as touching the resurrection of the dead , have ye not read that which was spoken unto you by God , saying ,

And say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen , whither they be gone , and will gather them on every side , and bring them into their own land :
translation.kha: Nangta to ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , ngan shim noh ïa ki briew jong nga baroh na ki jaitbynriew sha kiba ki la leit , ngan lumlang ïa ki na ki , bad wanrah pat ïa ki sha la ka jong ka ri .
Ngin pynlong ïa ka Judah bad Israel kiba roi kyrhai , Bad ngan pynlong pat ïa ki kumba mynhynne .
translation.en: And I will cause the captivity of Judah and the captivity of Israel to return , and will build them , as at the first .

translation.kha: U tei duh ïa ki jaka mane Blei ha kaba ki tnen nongwei jong u baroh kin ïoh thang ïa ki jingbuaid bad kñia ïa ki jingiw ha ki blem jong ki .
translation.en: And likewise did he for all his strange wives , which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods .

translation.kha: Ïa kine ki nongïathuhlypa , U Trai u nong , Ko ki nongïathuhlypa , ka sngew jong phi ka la jan koit noh ; ka sngi ka la jan wai na ka boitha jong phi . Namar ba phi ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong ang , phin ym khong shuh ki jingïohipaw ban ïathuhlypa , bad Phon ym haka ban ïathuh lympat ei ei .
translation.en: Therefore night shall be unto you , that ye shall not have a vision  ; and it shall be dark unto you , that ye shall not divine  ; and the sun shall go down over the prophets , and the day shall be dark over them .

translation.kha: U Adonijah u long u nongïalam shaei na ki kur ka Judah , bad u ne lai lakh ngut ki shipai hapoh Jong u .
translation.en: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers : Of Judah , the captains of thousands  ; Adnah the chief , and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand .

I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets , rising up early and sending them , saying , Return ye now every man from his evil way , and amend your doings , and go not after other gods to serve them , and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers : but ye have not inclined your ear , nor hearkened unto me .
translation.kha: Nga la ïai phah sha phi ïa baroh ki shakri jong nga , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ki la ong ïa phi ban iehnoh ïa ki lynti bymman jong phi bad ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei . Ki la maham ïa phi ban ym mane bad shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei , khnang ba phi lah ban ïaishong ha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Hynrei phim shym la shahshkor ïa nga lane sngap ïa nga .
Ki dei hima ban shna ka Ïingjaiñ kaba kyntang na ka bynta jong nga , khnang ba ngan ïoh shong hapdeng jong ki .
translation.en: And let them make me a sanctuary  ; that I may dwell among them .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel kim shitrhem shahshkor ïa la ki nongïalam . Ki Israel kim shym la ïaineh ha U Trai bad ki la mian ïa kiwei pait ki blei . Ki khap jong ki , ki la kohnguh ïa ki lawbah jyllang U Trai , hynrei khie ka pateng bathymmai shen ka la sangeh ban kuna katkum .
translation.en: And yet they would not hearken unto their judges , but they went a whoring after other gods , and bowed themselves unto them : they turned quickly out of the way which their fathers walked in , obeying the commandments of the  Lord   ; but they did not so .
And the next day we that were of Paul s company departed , and came unto Caesarea : and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist , which was one of the seven  ; and abode with him .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud ngi la mihnoh bad ngi la poi ha Kaisaria . Hangta ngi la sah ha ka ïing jong u Philip u ebanjelist , uwei na ki hynñiew ngut ki rangbah ba la jied kum ki nongïarap ha Jerusalem .
Kumta U Trai u la phah ïa ka jingpang ha kita ki briew , Namarba ba ki la pyningkhong ïa u Aaron ban thaw ïa u khun masi ksiar .
translation.en: And the  Lord  plagued the people , because they made the calf , which Aaron made .
But when Moses went in before the  Lord  to speak with him , he took the veil off , until he came out . And he came out , and spake unto the children of Israel that which he was commanded .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Moses u leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ban ïakren bad U  Trai  , u weng noh ïa kata ka jaiñtapkhmat . Ynda u mih biang shabar u ïathuh ha ki Israel ïa kata baroh ïa kaba la hukum ïa u ban kren ,

translation.en: Saying , I am the God of thy fathers , the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . Then Moses trembled , and durst not behold .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga long U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong me , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob .’ U Moses u la khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng bad um shym la nud ban peit .

Kiba sah ki phai bad phet ïap shang ri khlaw sha u Mawsiang Lymne . San hajar ngut na kita ki shah pynïap ha lynti bah . Ki Israel ki ïai bhah ïa kiba dang sah haduh Gidom , ki da pynïap ar hajar ngut na kita .
translation.en: And they turned and fled toward the wilderness unto the rock of Rimmon : and they gleaned of them in the highways five thousand men  ; and pursued hard after them unto Gidom , and slew two thousand men of them .

translation.kha: U Hanani , uwei na kiba shi para bad nga , u wan poi na Judah ryngkat bad ka kynhun Jong kiwei pat ki rangïapom , bad nga kylli ïa ki shaphang ka Jerusalem malade sanphew ki para Jisu jong ngi kiba la leit phai na ka jingïashad ringmraw ha Babilon .
translation.en: That Hanani , one of my brethren , came , he and certain men of Judah  ; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped , which were left of the captivity , and concerning Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Pyndep , Kaei kaba dang kamar-tama ka long ban ap da ka jingsheptieng ïa ka ïingbishar ka ban sa wanlam malade ïa ka ding kaba klang ka ban sa bam duh ïa Kita kba ïaleh marpyrshah ïa U Blei !
translation.en: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation , which shall devour the adversaries .
But when the multitudes saw it , they marvelled , and glorified God , which had given such power unto men .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki la ïohi ïa kata , ki la sheptieng , bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei uba la ai kum kata ka iktiar ha ki briew .
Te nga ong ha me , ka jingieit bakhraw kaba ka la pyn-i ka pynshisha ba ïa ki pop jrong ka kiba bun la map . Hynrei uno uno Uba la ïohmap Khyndiat u pyn-i tang khyndiat ka jingieit .
translation.en: Wherefore I say unto thee , Her sins , which are many , are forgiven  ; for she loved much : but to whom little is forgiven , the same loveth little .
Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily , therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil .
translation.kha: Balei ki briew ki stet haduh katta katta ban leh ïa ki kam sniew ? Namar ïa ka kam sniew ym ju kham pynshitom kloi .
Da kaweh bud ïa ka jingleh ki kpa tymmen jongngi u , u Jehoïakim u la leh Pop pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his fathers had done .

translation.kha: Haba u paidbah u la ïalum bad sdang ban kylli ïa u pyllait na ka byndi ka jingleh bakyrpang ba ju har , u la kylli ïa ki , Hato phi kwah ïa nga ban ïapyllait na ka bynta jong phi ïa u syiem jong ki Jisu ?
translation.en: But Pilate answered them , saying , Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews ?
Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap , like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble , as a strong people set in battle array .
translation.kha: Katba ki kynthih halor ki lumbah , ki riew kum ki kali ïapom ; ki sawa kum u phlangïap ha ka ding . Ki ïeng laiñ kum ka kynhun shipai bakhraw ban ïaleh thma .
Ngan leh ïa ken ha ki briew jong nga , namar ki la bor pop pyrshah ïa nga bad pynkhih bitar ïa nga naduh ka por ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la mihnoh na Ijipt haduh kane ka sngi .
translation.en: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight , and have provoked me to anger , since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt , even unto this day .

translation.kha: Te u Abimelekh u pynphai pat ïa ka Sarah ha u Abraham , malu ha khwai ka por u la ai ha u ïa ki lbong , ki musli , bad ki mraw .
translation.en: And Abimelech took sheep , and oxen , and menservants , and womenservants , and gave them unto Abraham , and restored him Sarah his wife .

translation.kha: U dieng u dei u syiem ka Ijipt bad ki brai jong u baroh . Wat ki diengsoh ha Eden kim lah ban jyllang ne ban ikhain kum ma u . Hynrei mynta , kum ki dieng ha Ehud , un hiar shapoh shad ka pyrthei kiba ïap pynlang ïashong lem bad ki bymriewblei pynlang kito kiba la ïap ha ka thma , nga la kren , ong U Trai Nongsynshar .
translation.en: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden ? yet shalt thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth : thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that be slain by the sword . This is Pharaoh and all his multitude , saith the Lord  God .
Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening .
translation.kha: Nangta ki briew ki mih shabar ban trei ïa ki kam jong ki bad ki trei haduh ynda la janmiet .

U Saul u la ïap namar ka jingbymïaineh jong u ha U Trai . Um skhem la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Trai ; u Pyrshang ban wad jingshai da kaba kyrhai na ki mynjur jong kiba la ïap , ha ka jaka ba un kylli na U Trai .
translation.en: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the  Lord  , even against the word of the  Lord  , which he kept not , and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit , to enquire of it  ;

translation.kha: U paralok jong u , u pha ktien , Ka dei ka waitlam jong u nong Israel , u Gideon u khun jong u Joash ! Kam maw da kumwei pat ! U Blei u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor ki Midian bad ïa ka kynhun Shipai jongnga ngi barhem .
translation.en: And his fellow answered and said , This is nothing else save the sword of Gideon the son of Joash , a man of Israel : for into his hand hath God delivered Midian , and all the host .

translation.kha: ba pien ïohrung ha kata ka jutang kaba U Trai U Blei jyllang phi u pynlong bad pa’ bad ban pdeng ïa ki kiei ba la thoh ha ka ,
translation.en: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the  Lord  thy God , and into his oath , which the  Lord  thy God maketh with thee this day :

translation.kha: A Trei Nongsynshar , me la thaw ïa ka khyndew bad ka suiñbneng da ka bor bun ka borbah bakhraw ; ym don kaba eh than ïa me .
translation.en: Ah Lord  God  ! behold , thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm , and there is nothing too hard for thee :

translation.kha: Ka dang long mynmiet eh , hynrei u syiemsad u khie joit na jingthiah bad u ong ha ki rangbah synshar jong u , Ngan ïathiah ha phi ïa kaei ba ki Syria ki thmu . Ki tip ba ngi shahthngan hangne , kumin ki mih na la ka jaka shon dara ban leit rhah ha ki rudnong . Ki da pyrkhat ba ngin iehnoh ïa ka nongpang ban longing wad jingbam bad kumta kin sa kem ïa ngi bad kurup ïa kane ka nongbah .
translation.en: And the king arose in the night , and said unto his servants , I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us . They know that we be hungry  ; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field , saying , When they come out of the city , we shall catch them alive , and get into the city .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la Khmih ha la ki synran bad u la ong , Suk phi kiba tukri ; ka Hima U Blei ka long ka jong phi !
translation.en: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples , and said ,  Blessed be ye poor : for yours is the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: U syiem bad ki rangbah synlar ki la sngewtynnat ïa kata ka jingai jingmut , badno u syiem u la leh ïa katei naba u Memukan u la ai jingmut .
translation.en: And the saying pleased the king and the princes  ; and the king did according to the word of Memucan :

translation.kha: Ïa ka bor malade ka jingkhraw jong baroh ki hima ha ka pyllait yn ai ha ki briew jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Ka bor ba kynja syiem jong ki kan ym kut shuh nabar ki nongsynshar Baroh ha ka pyrthei keiñ shakri sad kohnguh ïa ki .
translation.en: And the kingdom and dominion , and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven , shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High , whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom , and all dominions shall serve and obey him .

translation.kha: To ka ri jong ki kan dap kyrhai da kaweh bha baroh , Ba la kyrkhu da ka jingbha U Trai , Kumba kren na ka liewlong kaba mihngi . To kine ki jingkyrkhu kin wan ha ka jait u Joseph , Namar u la long u nongïalam ïa la ki hynmen nabar Para .
translation.en: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof , and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush : let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph , and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren .

translation.kha: bad u Ahio u ïaid na khmat .
translation.en: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah , accompanying the ark of God : and Ahio went before the ark .
And ye know that with all my power I have served your father .
translation.kha: Phi baroh ar ngut phi tip ba nga la trei na ka bynta i pa jong phi katba kot la ka bor .
Ki bor synshar ki la pynlong ïa u Joanan bad ïa kiwei pat baneh siew ïa ka peiñ kaba donkam ban jingjynjar , bad nangta ki la phlait ïa ki .
translation.en: And when they had taken security of Jason , and of the other , they let them go .

Thou therefore , and thy sons , and thy servants , shall till the land for him , and thou shalt bring in the fruits , that thy master s son may have food to eat : but Mephibosheth thy master s son shall eat bread alway at my table . Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants .
translation.kha: Ma me , ki khun shynrang jong me , bad ki shakri jong me , phin ïarep ha ka khyndew na ka bynta ka longïing jong u Saul , u kynrad jong phi , bad wallam ïa ka jingmih nangta ban pynbiang bam ïa ki . Hynrei u Mephibosheth hi un ïailong uba shah khot sngewbha sha ka miej bam jong nga .  ( U Siba u don khatsan ngut ki khun shynrang bad arphew ngut ki shakri . )

translation.en: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said unto his neighbour in the word of the  Lord  , Smite me , I pray thee . And the man refused to smite him .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum U  Trai  u dkhot jong ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa u hukum ïa la u para nongïathuhlypa ban shoh ïa u .

translation.en: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter : so he made it again another vessel , as seemed good to the potter to make it .
translation.kha: Man ba u lyngkhot khiew um da wandur bha , u ju shim ïa ka dewbyrtha bad pynwandur ïa ka sha kawei pat .

translation.en: Then went the devils out of the man , and entered into the swine : and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake , and were choked .
translation.kha: Ki la mihnoh na uta u briew bad ki la rung shapoh ki sniang . Ka kynhun ki sniang baroh ka la noh sha riat shapoh ka duriaw bad ki la ïap jyllop .
Me long barhem uba ang kwah , A Trai ; nga kular ban khongdong ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translation.en: Thou art my portion , O  Lord  : I have said that I would keep thy words .

translation.kha: A , ba keiñ da la ïoh ïa kane ka buhnud ! Ba kin da la sheptieng burom ïa nga mala kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga borabor , ma ki bad ki khun ki khiew jong ki kin jinghun da la manbha junom .
translation.en: O that there were such an heart in them , that they would fear me , and keep all my commandments always , that it might be well with them , and with their children for ever !

translation.kha: Nangta nga la kylli , Kaei ka kam runar ba nga la leh pyrshah ïa Phin lieng ïa ki rangbah synshar jong phi lane ïa kane ka jaitbynriew , kaba pynlong ïa phi ban thep ïa nga ha byndi ?
translation.en: Moreover Jeremiah said unto king Zedekiah , What have I offended against thee , or against thy servants , or against this people , that ye have put me in prison ?

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong ha nga , Ephah shisnem thik ka jingkhraw jong ki jait jong ka khadar kan poi sha kaba kut .
translation.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me , Within a year , according to the years of an hireling , and all the glory of Kedar shall fail :

translation.kha: Te nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaweh noh , Ko khun u briew ïeng joit . Nga kwah banbeiñ ïakhun bad me .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , stand upon thy feet , and I will speak unto thee .

translation.kha: Baana ka ebanjelist ka pynpaw kumin U Blei u pynlong ïa ki briew ban don ka jingïadei kaba ibieit malade U hi : Ka un-long lyngba ka jingngeit naduh kaba tdong rahah kaba kut . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , U briew naba beit bad U Blei’ da ka jingngeit un im .
translation.en: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith : as it is written , The just shall live by faith .

translation.kha: Hynrei kine ki briew ki leh la ka ai , kum ki mradkhlaw ïa kiba la kha ïa ka ban sha kem bad shah pynïap ; ki tur ïaleh da ki jingkrenbeiñ ïa ktien kiei Ibbah kim sngewthuh .
translation.en: But these , as natural brute beasts , made to be taken and destroyed , speak evil of the things that they understand not  ; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption  ;

translation.kha: U Trai un pynshitom ïa ki Ijipt , hynrei pynban un pynkhiah ïa ki . Kin phai sha u , bad un ïohsngew ïa ki jingduwai jong ki bad pynkoit ïa ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall smite Egypt : he shall smite and heal it : and they shall return even to the  Lord  , and he shall be entreated of them , and shall heal them .
Flee also youthful lusts : but follow righteousness , faith , charity , peace , with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart .
translation.kha: To kiar noh na ki jingkwah brai ka jinglong samla , bad ïaleh tyngeh na ka bynta ka hok , ka jingngeit , ka jingieit , bad ka jingsuk , lem bad kito kiba da ka dohnud basngur ki khot kyrpad ïa U Trai na ka bynta ka jingïarap .
U dieng , ibha jrong main katta uba la kynjoh ïa ka sahit bteng , uba lah ban ïohi da baroh uba don ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: The tree that thou sawest , which grew , and was strong , whose height reached unto the heaven , and the sight thereof to all the earth  ;

translation.kha: Baroh kiba la ïapkhlam ki long khatsaw hajuh hynñiewspah ngut , khlem da ñiew ïa Kito kiba la ïahap noh ha ka jingïalumlang pyrshah u Sorah .
translation.en: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred , beside them that died about the matter of Korah .

translation.kha: Ki shi Jutang sawphew saw khashor ngut ki brup ki la ïeng ha khmat ka khet , ha khmat ki saw tyllep ki jingthaw ba-don , bad ha khmat ki nongsharai balang ; ki la ïawer ïa ka jingrwai kaba thymmai , kaba tang ma ki hi ki lah ban nang . Na ki bynriew barabor , ki long tang ma ki , kiba la siewspah .
translation.en: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne , and before the four beasts , and the elders : and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand , which were redeemed from the earth .

translation.kha: ha shuwa ba kin leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , lieng shuwa ba kin leit hajan ka duwan ban ai ïa ka jingainguh bam khnang ba kin ym ïap .
translation.en: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation , they shall wash with water , that they die not  ; or when they come near to the altar to minister , to burn offering made by fire unto the  Lord  :
And Jehoiada made a covenant between him , and between all the people , and between the king , that they should be the  Lord s  people .
translation.kha: U Jehoïada u lyngdoh u pynlong ïa u syiem Joash bad ïa ki paidbah ban ïasnohkti lang bad u ha kaba pynlong ka jutang ba kin long ki briew jong U  Trai .

Ha baroh ki jylla , hangno hangno ba la pynnep paidbah ïa ka jingpynbna u skhem , la Don ka jingsawa jong ka jingïambriew hapdeng ki Jiw . Ki shongthait , ki ïamih bad lynñiar bad bun na ki , ki phrung jaiñ khain malu thiah ha u dpei .
translation.en: And in every province , whithersoever the king s commandment and his decree came , there was great mourning among the Jews , and fasting , and weeping , and wailing  ; and many lay in sackcloth and ashes .

translation.kha: Lada uta u smai kyrtong u pynïap ïa u maw , shynrang ne kynthei , uta u trai masi u dei ban siew ïa u kynrad jong uta u mraw laiphew ki sbai rupa , bad ïa uta u masi dei ban lynthem maw .
translation.en: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant  ; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver , and the ox shall be stoned .
Malchijah the son of Harim , and Hashub the son of Pahath–moab , repaired the other piece , and the tower of the furnaces .
translation.kha: U Malkhijah , u khun jong u Harim bad u Hasshub , u khun jong u Pahath Moab , ki tei baroh ar tylli ki bynta kiba bud bad ïa u Mot shet kpu .
Shen hadien ba u Sedekaïah u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , U Trai u la ong ha nga
translation.en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
Thou hast played the whore also with the Assyrians , because thou wast unsatiable  ; yea , thou hast played the harlot with them , and yet couldest not be satisfied .
translation.kha: Namar ym shym la pynhun ïa pha da kiwei , pha la leit bud nadien ki nong Assyria . Pha la long ka nuti jong ki , hynrei ki ruh kim shym la pynhun ïa pha .
ka Jokhebed , malu ka Mephaath , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: Kedemoth with her suburbs , and Mephaath with her suburbs  ; four cities .
Ye shall eat the flesh of the mighty , and drink the blood of the princes of the earth , of rams , of lambs , and of goats , of bullocks , all of them fatlings of Bashan .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban bam ïa ki met jong ki shipai bad dih ïa ka snam jong ki nongsynshar ka pyrthei , ïa ki baroh yn pynïap kumba pynïap ïa ki langbrot shynrang ne ki khunlangbrot ne ki blang ne ki masi dab kiba sngaid .
Haba kata ka por kan wan , ki briew kin ym ong shuh , ‘ Ki kmie ki kpa ki la ba-ima ïa u sohwaiñ bajew , hynrei ki khun ki ïoh ïa ka jingmad kaba jew .’
translation.en: In those days they shall say no more , The fathers have eaten a sour grape , and the children s teeth are set on edge .

translation.kha: Haba u la san dap ryñiot , u la ïaleit thap mirr bad kiwei pat ki sopti . Ma u ruh u la khi ban behmrad bad u kylla longsyiem u nongbam bynriew .
translation.en: And he went up and down among the lions , he became a young lion , and learned to catch the prey , and devoured men .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la haka don pynjot ïa ki nongbah ha ki phang ka Gerar , namar ba ki briew hangta ki la khynñiuh ïa U Trai . Ka kynhun shipai ka la lumrit ïa baroh kito ki nongbah bad ki kurup shibun ka jinglute .
translation.en: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar  ; for the fear of the  Lord  came upon them : and they spoiled all the cities  ; for there was exceeding much spoil in them .

translation.kha: U Jeroboam u la ïap bun la tep ha ka jingdap ki syiem , bad u khun jong u , u sakhrai u long symboh ha ka iaka jong u .
translation.en: And Jeroboam slept with his fathers , even with the kings of Israel  ; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: U Trai u khot , ïa u Salome . U ruh u jubab , Oi , Kynrad !
translation.en: That the  Lord  called Samuel : and he answered , Here am I .

translation.kha: Kumta u la wan ha u Moses , u da ïalam ruh ïa ka Sipporah , ka tnga jong u Moses , kaba u khlem ïamareh lai ,
translation.en: Then Jethro , Moses  father in law , took Zipporah , Moses  wife , after he had sent her back ,

translation.kha: bad u Abimelekh u kylluid ïa u , Phi bor lei kumne ?
translation.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham , What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves ?

translation.kha: Ki ïakhublei ïa u Philologos bad ka Julia , ïa u nemsniew bad ka para jong u , ïa u Olumpas badno ïa ki biria jongnga U Blei baroh kiba ïadon bad ki .
translation.en: Salute Philologus , and Julia , Nereus , and his sister , and Olympas , and all the saints which are with them .

translation.kha: U Joshua u la ïohsngew ïa ki paidbah ba ki ïarisa bad u la ong ha u Mysia , Nga jingphohsniew ïa ka jingsawa kumba ïaleh thma ha ka dik sher sawa .
translation.en: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted , he said unto Moses , There is a noise of war in the camp .

translation.kha: ka Jarmuth , bad ka Engannim , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: Jarmuth with her suburbs , En–gannim with her suburbs  ; four cities .
And when thou hast seen it , thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people , as Aaron thy brother was gathered .
translation.kha: Ynda me la ïohi ïa ka , men sa ïap noh , kumba u Aaron u hynmen jong me u la ïap ,

translation.en: For all they did cast in of their abundance  ; but she of her want did cast in all that she had , even all her living .
translation.kha: Naba kiwei ki la pynnoh ïa kaei kaba tam na ka spah jong ki ; hynrei ma ka , ha ka jingduk jong ka , ka la pynnoh ïa baroh kaba ka don — ka la ai ïa baroh kaba kyrshan ïa ka jingim jong ka .
Babha ngi la ïohsngew ïa kane , ma me bad kiwei pait kiba hangta , ngi la kyrpad ïa u Paul ban ym leit sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And when we heard these things , both we , and they of that place , besought him not to go up to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U blang u phah ïa ki jumai bad u pynkheiñ ïa ka khynraw ; u kynjrat ïa ki païa kiba kyrshan ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Which shaketh the earth out of her place , and the pillars thereof tremble .
He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets : therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips .
translation.kha: Ka jinglorni kam lah ban set ïa kaba buhrieh . Kiar na ki briew kiba bunktien palat .

translation.en: Thou art to pass over through Ar , the coast of Moab , this day :
translation.kha: ‘ Mynta ka sngi phi dei ban ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Moab ha Ar .
Kan dei ka kupar jngai pa ban ïap ka jingïap bashyrkhei , namar phim shym la jubab haba nga khot ïa phi lane shahshkor haba nga kren . Phibi jied ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad leh ïa kaba sniew .
translation.en: Therefore will I number you to the sword , and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter : because when I called , ye did not answer  ; when I spake , ye did not hear  ; but did evil before mine eyes , and did choose that wherein I delighted not .
All hands shall be feeble , and all knees shall be weak as water .
translation.kha: Ki kti uwei pa uwei kin tlot , bad ki khohsiew kin kyiuh .

translation.en: By the word of truth , by the power of God , by the armour of righteousness on the right hand and on the left ,
translation.kha: Ngi don ïa ka hok kum ka atiar jong ngi , ïa ka ban ïaleh bad ban ïada ïa lade ruh .

Kumta ki la kyang sha U Trai , A Trai , ngi duwai , to wat pynshitom ïa ngi da ka jingïap ban shim ïa ka jingim jong une u briew ! Ma me , ko Trei , me kitkhlieh na ka bynta Kanneh baroh ; ka longkmie ka jinglah jong me .
translation.en: Wherefore they cried unto the  Lord  , and said , We beseech thee , O  Lord  , we beseech thee , let us not perish for this man s life , and lay not upon us innocent blood : for thou , O  Lord  , hast done as it pleased thee .

And Moses said unto God , Behold , when I come unto the children of Israel , and shall say unto them , The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you  ; and they shall say to me , What is his name ? what shall I say unto them ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u phai ktien ,  Haba nga leit sha ki Israel bad ngan ong ha ki , ‘ U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi u la phah ïa nga sha phi ,’ kin sa kylli ïa nga , ‘ Kaei ka kyrteng jong u ?’ Ngan ong kumno ïa ki ?

translation.en: The anger of the  Lord  shall not return , until he have executed , and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart : in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly .
translation.kha: bad kan ym kut haduh ba un da leh ïa baroh kaba U thmu ban leh . Ha ki sngi ki ban wan ki briew jong U kin sa sngewthuh shai ïa kane .
U Solomon un oh kawei ka jait , na ka boitha u Daberath u shakri jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Jeremaïah , ka nongbah ïa kaba ang la iaid baneh long ka jong nga na ka ri Israel Baroh .
translation.en: ( But he shall have one tribe for my servant David s sake , and for Jerusalem s sake , the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel : )
He shall come and destroy these husbandmen , and shall give the vineyard to others .  And when they heard it , they said , God forbid .
translation.kha: Un wan bad pynïap ïa kito ki rangbah , bad un ai ïa ka bri sohwaiñ ha kiwei pat ki nongshimwai .  Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la ong ,  Ym kumta keiñ !

baroh kim long ki Apostol ne ki Nongïathuhlypa ne ki nonghikai . Ym baroh ki don ïa ka bor ban leh ïa ki kambah lane ban pynkhiah ïa ki jingpang lane ba kruiñ ha ki thylliej bapher lane ban batai ïa kaei kaba la kren-ïa .
translation.en: Have all the gifts of healing ? do all speak with tongues ? do all interpret ?

translation.kha: Ha sakma ka para ka Hima jong u Blei kan pynïoh pat ka jingsuk kaba ïadei bad kot ka ni ha ka Kper Eden hapdeng ki mrad , bad hapdeng ki mrad bad ki briew .
translation.en: In time , God’s Kingdom will even restore the peaceful relations that existed in the garden of Eden between animals , and between animals and humans .

translation.kha: Shisien uwei u briew u la wan shaei U Jisu . Ko Nonghikai , u la kylli , kaei kaba bha kaba nga dei ban leh ba ngan ïoh ïa ka jingim bymtip ?
translation.en: And , behold , one came and said unto him , Good Master , what good thing shall I do , that I may have eternal life ?

translation.kha: U ju u la ong , Ka Hima jong nga kam erlangthari na ka jong kane ka pyrthei , lada ka hima jong nga ka la long na ka jong kane ka pyiar , ki nongbud jong nga kin jaiñ-jin da la ïaleh ban ïada ïa nga na kaba aiti ha ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw . Em , ka hima jong nga kam long hangne !
translation.en: Jesus answered ,  My kingdom is not of this world : if my kingdom were of this world , then would my servants fight , that I should not be delivered to the Jews : but now is my kingdom not from hence .
And he passed over before them , and bowed himself to the ground seven times , until he came near to his brother .
translation.kha: U Jakob u la leit ha shuwa jong ki , u da nguh ngon haduh khyndew hynñiew sien katba u nang leit sha jan u hynmen jong u .

Hynrei ïa kiba la khah nyngkong na ki masi , ki langbrot bad ki blang ym dem ban thied pat ; ki long kiba la pynkyrpang shaw nga , bad dei ban kñia ïa ki . Synreit ïa ka snam jong ki ha ka duwan bad thang ïa ka khlain jong ki kum ka jingiw bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa por .
translation.en: But the firstling of a cow , or the firstling of a sheep , or the firstling of a goat , thou shalt not redeem  ; they are holy : thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar , and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire , for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba U Trai u la ïohi haduh katno ka jingsniew jong uwei pa uwei u briew ha ka pyrthiew sad kat ki jingmut jingpyrkhat bymman jong ki ha ki na Baroh ,
translation.en: And  God  saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth , and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually .

translation.kha: Lada i pa jong phi i shem ba ngam to lang ha ka miej bam , ïathuh ïa i ba nga la pan jingbit na phi ban leit sha la iing ha Bethlehem , namarba ba ka dei ka por jong ka jingkñia baje ba shisien shisnem hangta ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ba-eh jong ang baroh’ .
translation.en: If thy father at all miss me , then say , David earnestly asked leave of me that he might run to Beth–lehem his city : for there is a yearly sacrifice there for all the family .

translation.kha: Pynphai ïa ka jingbitar jong me halor ki jaitbynriew ki bym mane ïa me bad halor ki briew katba kyntait ïa me . Ki la pynïap ïa ki Briew jong me ; ki la pynngat khoit ïa ngi bad iehnoh ïa ka ri jong ngi ha ka jingjngem jingpra .
translation.en: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not , and upon the families that call not on thy name : for they have eaten up Jacob , and devoured him , and consumed him , and have made his habitation desolate .

translation.kha: Katto katto para hajan kane , u nongrah khuri jong u syier Ijipt bad u nongshet kpu rangbah jong u ki la pynbitar ïa u syiem .
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker had offended their lord the king of Egypt .

translation.kha: ( La don kumba synran hajar lwet ki Rangbah hangta . ) U Jehu u la ong ha ki synran jong u , To pynshong ïa u Paidbah ha ki kynhun kiba sanphew ngut kawei kawei .
translation.en: For they were about five thousand men . And he said to his disciples ,  Make them sit down by fifties in a company .

Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened , and the moon shall not give her light , and the stars shall fall from heaven , and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken :
translation.kha: Shen hadien ka jingjynjar jong kito ki sngi , ka sngi kan dum , u bnai un ym tyngshaiñ shuh , ki khlur kin hap na bneng , bad ki bor ha ka haw haw kin shah beh na ki lynti jong ki .

translation.en: And he said unto Jether his firstborn , Up , and slay them . But the youth drew not his sword : for he feared , because he was yet a youth .
translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha u Jether , u khun nyngkong jong u ,  Khie , pynïap ïa ki !  Hynrei uta u khynnah um shym sei ïa la ka waitlam . Um sngew nud , namar ba u dang long tang u khynnah .

Kat ka kynthei ka la ïohi ba la lap ïa ka , kumta ka la wan da kaba khynñiuh mala ka dem khop ha ki kjat jong U Jisu . Hangta ha khmat jong uwei pa wai borbah , ka la ïathuh ïa u balei ba ka la ktien ïa u bad kumno ba la pynkhiah ïa ka shisyndon .
translation.en: And when the woman saw that she was not hid , she came trembling , and falling down before him , she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him , and how she was healed immediately .

translation.kha: U Blei u jubab ïa u ha katai ka jingsniew , Ho-oid , nga tip ba me la leh ïa kane da ka jingïatiplem kaba snur ; kumno nga la khang ïa me ban leh thup pyrshah ïa nga , bad ngam shem la shiah ïa me ban ktah ïa ka .
translation.en: And God said unto him in a dream , Yea , I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart  ; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me : therefore suffered I thee not to touch her .

translation.kha: khnang ba , ‘ Kin khmih bad ïai khmih , pynban kin ym Iohi ; Kin sngap bad ïai sngap , pynban kin ym sngewtlot . Namar lada ki ïohi lane sngewthuh , kin phalang sha U Blei , bad un map ïa ki .’
translation.en: That seeing they may see , and not perceive  ; and hearing they may hear , and not understand  ; lest at any time they should be converted , and their sins should be forgiven them .
And if she had at all an husband , when she vowed , or uttered ought out of her lips , wherewith she bound her soul  ;
translation.kha: Lada ka kynthei ka bym pat shongkurim ka pynlong ka jingkular , da kaba mut khnang ne khlem da pyrkhat ban kyndiah na kano kano bad nangta ka shongkurim ,
U Toi u syiem Hamath u ïohsngew ba u dab u la jop ïa baroh ka kynhun ïapom jong u Kedar .
translation.en: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer ,
And thou shalt make them linen breeches to cover their nakedness  ; from the loins even unto the thighs they shall reach :
translation.kha: Suh ki patlun lyngkot kiba da ka jaiñ linen , kiba kot naduh syngkai haduh lbong , khnang ba kin ym thad burom ïa lade .
ibha phi ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , ka don ka jingbishar hok , hynrei ki jingshukor ki ïalam sha ka jingiashah bishar bymhok .
translation.en: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness : but a false witness deceit .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kawei ka sngi , jia ryngkhat wai u khynñiat u ïohi ïa ki , bad u leit ïathuh ha u Absalom ; kumta ki la leit bran bran ban rieh ha ka ïing lad uwei u briew ha Bahurim . U don ka pukni hajan ka ïing jong u , bad ki hiar shapoh jong ka .
translation.en: Nevertheless a lad saw them , and told Absalom : but they went both of them away quickly , and came to a man s house in Bahurim , which had a well in his court  ; whither they went down .
And it came to pass , when he had made an end of speaking unto Saul , that the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David , and Jonathan loved him as his own soul .
translation.kha: U Saul bad u Dabid ki la dep ka jingïakren hapdeng jong ki . Hadien kata , u Jonathan u khun jong u Saul u la sngew jan eh ïa u Dabid bad u sngewieit ïa u kumba u ieit ïa lade hi .
Ki la shakri ïa kiwei pait ki blei ba kim ju mane mynno mynno , bad ïa Ibbah U Trai u la adong ïa ki ban mane .
translation.en: For they went and served other gods , and worshipped them , gods whom they knew not , and whom he had not given unto them :

translation.kha: U Trai u isih ïa ki briew katba shkor .
translation.en: For all that do such things , and all that do unrighteously , are an abomination unto the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Mynta , kane baroh ka long ka napoh ïa ngi , ban maham ïa me ban ym khoh brai ïa ki kiei kiba sniew , kumba ki la leh , lymne mane ïa ki bleithaw , kumba don na ki kiba la leh kumta .
translation.en: Now these things were our examples , to the intent we should not lust after evil things , as they also lusted .
And I turned , and lifted up mine eyes , and looked , and , behold , there came four chariots out from between two mountains  ; and the mountains were mountains of brass .
translation.kha: Nga la ïoh sa kawei pat ka jingïohipaw . Ha kane ka por nga la ïohi saw tylli ki kali ïapom kiba wan mih napdeng ki ar tylli ki lumbah rnong .

translation.en: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee , and their kings shall be sore afraid , they shall be troubled in their countenance .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba shong ha lynter ka rud duriaw u kyndit ïa ka kupar jong pha . Wat ki syiem jong ki , ki sngewtriem , bad ka jingsheptieng ka paw ha ki khmat jong ki .

translation.en: And went away again beyond Jordan into the place where John at first baptized  ; and there he abode .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit phai biang sha shiliang ka wah Jordan sha ka jaka ha kaba u Ïoannis u la ju pynbaptis , bad u la sah hangta .
Men rem sad me ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa na ka bynta ki jingainguh , ïa kiba ma nga bad ki nongai jingmut jong nga , Ngi kwah ban ai sha U Blei ki Israel , uba ka Templ jong u ka don ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And to carry the silver and gold , which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel , whose habitation is in Jerusalem ,

translation.kha: Ka ïoh kaba me la ai ka kham kordor ïa nga ban ïa ka pisa baroh ha ka pyrthat .
translation.en: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver .
The rod and reproof give wisdom : but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame .
translation.kha: Ka jingsneng bad ka jingpynbeit ki long kiba bha ïa ki khynnah . Lada u khynnah u ïoh leh katba u mon , u pynlehrain ïa la ka kmie .

translation.en: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey , and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil  ; and they shall pollute it .
translation.kha: Ngan ailad ïa ki nongwei ban lute ïa ki ,  ong U  Trai  ,  bad ki nongpynkheiñ aiñ kin shim noh ïa ka spah jong ki bad pyntngit ïa ka .

translation.en: And your tires shall be upon your heads , and your shoes upon your feet : ye shall not mourn nor weep  ; but ye shall pine away for your iniquities , and mourn one toward another .
translation.kha: Phan ym leit khlem tapkhlieh lane khlem sopkjat lane sngewsih ne ïam . Phan pynsep-ei namar ki pop jong pha , bad phan ïa-ud iwei ha iwei .

translation.en: If I had called , and he had answered me  ; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice .
translation.kha: Pynban wat la katta , lada u shah ïa nga ban kren , Ngam lah ngeit ba un shahshkor ïa nga .
Bud ïa ki ai jong nga , bad leh kat ïa kaba nga hukum . Nga long U Trai U blem jong pa .
translation.en: Ye shall do my judgments , and keep mine ordinances , to walk therein : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki baroh ; Kan kham jem ban ñiew ïa ki phngit pui pui ha ka khyndew !
translation.en: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth : so that if a man can number the dust of the earth , then shall thy seed also be numbered .

And there came in two men , children of Belial , and sat before him : and the men of Belial witnessed against him , even against Naboth , in the presence of the people , saying , Naboth did blaspheme God and the king . Then they carried him forth out of the city , and stoned him with stones , that he died .
translation.kha: Kita ki ar ngut ki riewrunar ki kynnoh pyrshah ïa u ha khmat u paidbah ba u la tim ïa U Blei bad ïa u syiem . Bad kumta la sei ïa u shabar ka nongbah bad lynthem maw ha ban da ïap .

translation.en: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads : and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynlong ruh ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem ban shitom namar ka jingbymman jong ki , kumba u Jotham , u khun jong u Gideon , u ong ïa ki ba kin long kumta haba u la tim ïa ki .

translation.en: For our gospel came not unto you in word only , but also in power , and in the Holy Ghost , and in much assurance ; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake .
translation.kha: Naba ngi la wallam ïa ka Khubor Babha ha phi , ym tang ha ki ktien , hynrei ruh ha ka bor bad ha U Mynsiem Bakhuid , bad da ka jingsngewthuh pura ïa ka jingshisha jong ka . Phi tip kumno ngi la im mynba ngi la don bad phi ; ka la long na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi .

Lada nga pynbna ba u bri basniew , un sa ïap noh bad mem shitrhem la maham u ban kylla ne na ki lynti jong u , khnang ba u da ban pyllait ïa la ka jingïam , un ïap hi kum u nongpop , bad ngan pynkitkhlieh ha me ïa ka jingïap jngai u .
translation.en: When I say unto the wicked , Thou shalt surely die  ; and thou givest him not warning , nor speakest to warn the wicked from his wicked way , to save his life  ; the same wicked man shall die in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at thine hand .

translation.kha: Nangta u kpa u la leit shaw uwei pat u khun bad u la ong ïa kajuh . ‘ Ho-oid , pa’ u la jubab , hynrei um shym la leit .
translation.en: And he came to the second , and said likewise . And he answered and said , I go , sir : and went not .

translation.kha: Kane ka la pynsangeh ïa ka khlam bad u la shu ïeng hapdeng katba im bad kiba ïap .
translation.en: And he stood between the dead and the living  ; and the plague was stayed .

translation.kha: Namar kiba kum kine kiei kai , ka jingbitar lad U Blei ka wanlam ha kita ki bymkohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: For which things  sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience :

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka snam jong uba u mrad , un tah ïa ka ha ki lyer kiba ba-don ha ki dang jong ka duwan , bad un theh ïa kaba sah , ha trai jong kata ka duwan .
translation.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger , and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering , and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba ïa kiei Kiei baroh la buh hapoh ka jingsynshar U Khrist , te ma u hi , U Khun , un pyndem ïa lade! hapoh U Blei uba la buh ïa Kiei kiei baroh hapoh jong u ; nabar U Blei un synshar lut halor baroh .
translation.en: And when all things shall be subdued unto him , then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him , that God may be all in all .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u ong ïa u Kaiwan , Balah me bitar , bad balei ka durkhmat jongki me ka kylla dur ?
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Cain , Why art thou wroth ? and why is thy countenance fallen ?
But all the silver , and gold , and vessels of brass and iron , are consecrated unto the  Lord  : they shall come into the treasury of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba la shna da ka rupa , ka ksiar , ka rnong lane ka nar , la buh kyrpang na ka bynta U  Trai . Dei ban buh ïa kata ha ka ïing jingkynshew U  Trai .
Ha ki hynriew snem to thut to thop ha la ka lyngkha , bad lalot ïa ki jingmong jongki ka .
translation.en: And six years thou shalt sow thy land , and shalt gather in the fruits thereof :

translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban ïatreilang ryngkat bad ki bymngeit , naba kam haw ban long . Kumno kaba dei bad kaba bakla kin ïadon beit ngan ? Kumno ka jingshai bad ka jingdiang kin ïaisah lang ?
translation.en: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers : for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness ? and what communion hath light with darkness ?

translation.kha: Ïa nga la tar ïaring da ka jingkhuslai bad ka jingpang ; nga la ïoh ïa ka jingjynjar na katai ka sngi sha kawei pat .
translation.en: My bowels boiled , and rested not : the days of affliction prevented me .
And Moses said unto the  Lord  , The people cannot come up to mount Sinai : for thou chargedst us , saying , Set bounds about the mount , and sanctify it .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Ki briew kim lah ban wan kiew shajrong , naba me la hukum ïa ngi ban kheiñ kyntang ïa u lum bad ban buh dak sawdong jong u .

translation.en: I lifted up mine hand unto them also in the wilderness , that I would scatter them among the heathen , and disperse them through the countries  ;
translation.kha: Kumta nga la pynlong sa kawei pat ka jingkular ha ka ri shyiap . Nga la smai ba ngan pynsakma ïa ki ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
Amam ngeit ïa nga haba nga ïathuh ïa me shaphang kiei kiei jong kane ka pyrthei ; kumno men lah ban jingieit ïa nga , te , haba nga ïathuh ha me shaphrang kiei kiei jong ka bneng ?
translation.en: If I have told you earthly things , and ye believe not , how shall ye believe , if I tell you of heavenly things ?
And when the chief Shepherd shall appear , ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away .
translation.kha: Bad ynda U Nongaplangbrot Rangbah un paw , phin ïohpdiang ïa ka pansngiat badonburom kaba ka jingtyngshaiñ kan ym jah na ka lano lano ruh .
Haba ki apostol ki la tip shaphang Katai , ki la phet sha ki nongbah Lystra bad Thebes kiba ha Lukia , bad sha ka thain ba-marjan .
translation.en: They were ware of it , and fled unto Lystra and Derbe , cities of Lycaonia , and unto the region that lieth round about :
And Joshua rose up early in the morning , and numbered the people , and went up , he and the elders of Israel , before the people to Ai .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab u Joshua u la khie bad lumlang ïa ki shipai . Nangta ma u bad ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la ïalam ïa ki sha Ai .

translation.en: Lift up your eyes on high , and behold who hath created these things , that bringeth out their host by number : he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might , for that he is strong in power  ; not one faileth .
translation.kha: A to khmied sha ka sahit bneng ! Mano ba thaw ïa ki khlur ba phi ïohi ? Uta uba ïalam ïa ki shabar kum ka kynhun shipai , u tip katno ki don bad u khot ïa uwei uwei da ka kyrteng ! Ka bor jong u ka khraw katta katta — Ym don uwei na ki u ban jah noh .
Pa long ka jait sangsot kabu kyrpang . Ym don mano mano ba pynbor ïa pha ba-bang long kumta . Pham shym ïoh jingsiew , pha siew ïa ki ! Ho-oid , Phah long kaba pher .
translation.en: And the contrary is in thee from other women in thy whoredoms , whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms : and in that thou givest a reward , and no reward is given unto thee , therefore thou art contrary .

translation.kha: Ki ïakhun shynrang jongno u Jaban ki long ki briew Jong ka Elasah , ka Spain , ka Sypros , bad ka Herodias ; ki la longsem ki khap tymmen jong ki briew kiba shong ha ki rud duriaw bad ha ki dewlynnong .
translation.en: And the sons of Javan  ; Elishah , and Tarshish , Kittim , and Dodanim .
But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? Yea , I say unto you , and much more than a prophet .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , ïa kaei phi la leit ban peit ? Hato ïa u nongïathuhlypa ? Ho-oid , da shisha , hynrei phi la ïohi kham bun shah ban ïa u nongïathuhlypa .
Kan Jin da la kham bha ïa ki ba kyang ym jin da la tip ïa ka lynti ka khot ban ïa kaba thup ïa ka bad Nangta pat ban phai den noh na ka hukum bakyntang ïa kaba la ai ha ki .
translation.en: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness , than , after they have known it , to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them .

translation.kha: U leh kumjuh ha ki nongbah pynlang ki jaka ba la ieh kynjah jong ki Manasseh , Ephraim , bad Simeon , bad jngai shad Shaei haduh Arah .
translation.en: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh , and Ephraim , and Simeon , even unto Naphtali , with their mattocks round about .

translation.kha: kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ïa kata kawei pat kum ka jingainguh thang ryngkat bun ka jingainguh ba-ima . Kumne keiñ ithuh u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka niam ka stang kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid .
translation.en: Even such as he is able to get , the one for a sin offering , and the other for a burnt offering , with the meat offering : and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka jingshim jong phi kan don borabor ha ka jingma . Synñia sngi phin khynñiuh da ka jingpyntieng , bad phin sngew kum ban ïapom ha kano kano ka khyllipmat .
translation.en: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee  ; and thou shalt fear day and night , and shalt have none assurance of thy life :

translation.kha: Wat ki mradkhlaw kin burom ïa nga ; ki myrsiang sad ki artat kin ïaroh ïa nga haba lang! pyntong ïa ki wah ba kin tuid ha ka ri shyiap ban ai um ïa ki briew ba la jied jong nga .
translation.en: The beast of the field shall honour me , the dragons and the owls : because I give waters in the wilderness , and rivers in the desert , to give drink to my people , my chosen .

translation.kha: Phi la ieh kumno u la leh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei .
translation.en: And his miracles , and his acts , which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt , and unto all his land  ;

translation.kha: Wat buhnud ïano ïano , hynrei ïapynbeit ïa ka jingpynhiar jingmut hapdeng jong phi! , Khnang ba yn ym pynliat pop ïa phi namar jong u .
translation.en: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart : thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour , and not suffer sin upon him .
For yourselves know how ye ought to follow us : for we behaved not ourselves disorderly among you ;
