translation.kha: Phi hi phi tip bha ba phi dei ban leh ïa kaei kaba ngi la leh . Ngim shym la long kiba jaipdeh mynba ngi la don bad phi .
Ngim lah ba shem u bariew uba kham bit ban ïa u Jehosheba , u briew uba don U Minnith U blang .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto his servants , Can we find such a one as this is , a man in whom the Spirit of God is ?

And the next unto him was Carshena , Shethar , Admatha , Tarshish , Meres , Marsena , and Memucan , the seven princes of Persia and Media , which saw the king s face , and which sat the first in the kingdom  ; )
translation.kha: Kito sha kiba u ju phai khmat bunsien na ka bynta ka jingai jingmut ki long u Karshena , u Shethar , u Admatha , u Tarshish , u Meres , u Marsena bad u Memukan — ki hynñiew ngut ki rangbah synshar jong ka Persia bad ka Media kiba bat ïa ki kyrdan treikam bahakhlieh duh jong ka hima .
Kin sa manbha pat , dara ïa pha bad ki nongrit jong pha ruh yn sa pynni .
translation.en: When thy sisters , Sodom and her daughters , shall return to their former estate , and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate , then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate .
Fear , and the pit , and the snare , are upon thee , O inhabitant of the earth .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi baroh ! Ki don ki jingshyrkhei , ki  liewlep , bad ki jingriam kiba ap ïa phi .

U dab u aiti ïa ki ha ki paid Shibun , kiba la phasi ïa ki halor u lumlang ha khmat U Trai — barieh hynñiew ngut ki la ïa-ïap lang . Ka dei hajuh jan khun artat ka pyrem , ha katba sdang ka aïom ot barli , haba la pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites , and they hanged them in the hill before the  Lord  : and they fell all seven together , and were put to death in the days of harvest , in the first days , in the beginning of barley harvest .
But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ , who hath abolished death , and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel :
translation.kha: U la ai ha ngi ïa kane ka jingaiei lyngba U Khrist Jisu ha shuwa ban sdang ka pyrthei , hynrei mynta la pynpaw da ka jingwan U Nongpynim jong ngi , U Khrist Jisu . U la pynkut noh ïa ka bor jong ka jingïap bad lyngba ka Gospel la pynpaw ïa ka jingim bymïap shuh .
U kñia ïa la u khun kum ka jingainguh thang . U khan bad u leh myntri , bad u ïasyllok bad ki nongpeit kad bad ki nongleh byrtong . U la leh pop palat pyrshah ïa U Trai bad pynkhih pynkoit ïa u .
translation.en: And he made his son pass through the fire , and observed times , and used enchantments , and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards : he wrought much wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u tdong kren ïa khie , katto katne ngut ki nonglamktien ki la wan na ka ïing jyllang u Jehoahas bad ki la ong ïa u , Ka khum jong pa’ ka la eh ïap . Balei phin pynshitom shuh ïa U Nonghikai ?
translation.en: While he yet spake , there came from the ruler of the synagogue s house certain which said , Thy daughter is dead : why troublest thou the Master any further ?

translation.kha: Nga sngewlyngngoh ïa phi ! Tang katto katne por phi la iehnoh ïa uta uba la khot ïa ph da ka jingaiei U khriat , bad ba phi la pdiang ïa kawei pait ka bishar .
translation.en: I marvel that ye are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel :
And they rose up in the twilight , to go unto the camp of the Syrians : and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria , behold , there was no man there .
translation.kha: Kumta , haba ka la sdang dum , ki leit sha ka jaka shong dara ki Syria , hynrei ynda ki poi ha ka , ym don mano mano hangta .
U Gershon u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : u Libnah bad u Shimei , bad ki umdih ki don lep ki khun ki ksiew .
translation.en: The sons of Gershon  ; Libni , and Shimei , according to their families .

translation.kha: Sur ban ym shah pynshoi katei haduh ban da mane malu shakri ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi ha shait bneng — la ka long ka sngi , u bnai , lane ki khlur , ïa kiba U Trai U Blei lad phi u la ai ha kiwei pat ki brai borbah ha ka pyut ba kin ïew Mane .
translation.en: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven , and when thou seest the sun , and the moon , and the stars , even all the host of heaven , shouldest be driven to worship them , and serve them , which the  Lord  thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingong kaba shisha : Lada ngi la ïap bad u , ngin sa ïoh im ruh lem bad u .
translation.en: It is a faithful saying : For if we be dead with him , we shall also live with him :

translation.kha: Mynta , namar ba i don hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong phi , ko syiad , ngim kwah ban ïohi ïa kan ba lai jia , malade kumta ngi ai jingman
translation.en: Now because we have maintenance from the king s palace , and it was not meet for us to see the king s dishonour , therefore have we sent and certified the king  ;

translation.kha: ki Amana , ki Kanah , ki Girgash , bad ki Jebus .
translation.en: And the Amorites , and the Canaanites , and the Girgashites , and the Jebusites .

translation.kha: Nangta sa la ïohi ïa uwei pat u jin uba her shajrong eh ha suiñ , lem bad ka khubor bymjukut jong ka Khebar Babha ba pynbna ha ki bynriew ka pyrthei , ha kaweh pa kawei ka jingtipbriew , ka jait , ka ktien bad ka kynjai bynriew .
translation.en: And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven , having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth , and to every nation , and kindred , and tongue , and people ,

translation.kha: Mar shu dep pule da u Jehudi ïa ki lai ne saw bynta , u shym u la ot ïa ki da ka tari barli malade bret ïa ki ha ka ding . U ïai leh ïa kane haduh ba la thang lut ïa ka khoit kli baroh kawei .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Jehudi had read three or four leaves , he cut it with the penknife , and cast it into the fire that was on the hearth , until all the roll was consumed in the fire that was on the hearth .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Nga phah khot ïa shibun ki nongtong dohkha ban wan bad kem ïa kine ki bynriew . Nalorkata ngan phah khet ïa shibun ki nongbeh ñiad ban thiat pynïap ïa ki halor uwei pa uwei u lumbah bad u lumrit malade hapoh ki krem hapdeng ki mawsiang .
translation.en: Behold , I will send for many fishers , saith the  Lord  , and they shall fish them  ; and after will I send for many hunters , and they shall hunt them from every mountain , and from every hill , and out of the holes of the rocks .
And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them : for they said , Lest the earth swallow us up also .
translation.kha: Baroh ki Israel kiba don hangta ki la phet ïap haba ki ïohsngew ïa ka jinglynñiar jong ki . Ki la ïa-pyrta ,  Phet , Ka khyndew ka lah ban nguid ïa ngi ruh !
man kaba ki rung Shabeh ka Ïingjaiñ ne ki leit sha jan kata ka duwan , kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: When they went into the tent of the congregation , and when they came near unto the altar , they washed  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
And they said unto him , Wherefore saith my lord these words ? God forbid that thy servants should do according to this thing :
translation.kha: Ki ruh ki jubab ïa u ,  Phi mut kumno , bah , da kaba kren ïa ngi kumne ? Ngi smai ba ngim shym leh ïa kaba kum kane .
U Pharaoh u jubab , Duwai na ka bynta jong nga la shai . U Moses u ong , Ngi leh kumba phi ong , ba phin ïoh thup ba ym don mano mano ruh uba khim U Trai U blang jong ngi .
translation.en: And he said , To morrow . And he said , Be it according to thy word : that thou mayest know that there is none like unto the  Lord  our God .
Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone , a tried stone , a precious corner stone , a sure foundation : he that believeth shall not make haste .
translation.kha: Kane , mynta , ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan buh ha Seïon ka nongrim kaba skhem bad bakhlaiñ . Ha ka ngan buh ïa u mawdong baskhem ha uba yn thoh ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingngeit kaba skhem ka long ruh kaba ïaishah .’

translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , I had not thought to see thy face : and , lo , God hath shewed me also thy seed .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  Ngam shym poi pyrkhat ba ngan dang ïohi biang ïa ka khmat jong me ; pynban U Blei u la shah ba ngan ïohi sa ïa ki khun jong me ruh .

translation.en: So now the  Lord  God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel , and shouldest thou possess it ?
translation.kha: Kumta dei U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , uba la beh noh ïa ki Amor na ka bynta ki briew jong U , ki Israel keiñ .

translation.en: But seek ye first the kingdom of God , and his righteousness  ; and all these things shall be added unto you .
translation.kha: Hynrei , to pyrkhat nalor kiei kiei baroh ïa ka Hima U Blei bad ïa kaei kaba u dawa na phi , bad un pyndap ïa phi da kine kiei kiei baroh .

Ki laiphew ar hajar tylli ki kai ïalam kiba ki wieh pynlang ka kynhun shipai u syiem Maakah ki wan sher dara khatsan ka Medeba . Ki Ammon ruh ki wan na baroh ki nongbah jong ki bad ki long kiba la kloi ban ïaleh .
translation.en: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots , and the king of Maacah and his people  ; who came and pitched before Medeba . And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities , and came to battle .

And when he had restored the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother , his mother said , I had wholly dedicated the silver unto the  Lord  from my hand for my son , to make a graven image and a molten image : now therefore I will restore it unto thee .
translation.kha: U pynphai pat ïa ka pisa sha la ka kmie , bad ka ong ,  Ban khang ïa ka jingtim ban hap ha u khun jong nga , nga hi da lade nga aiti da kaba kyntang ïa kane ka rupa sha U  Trai . Yn pyndonkam ïa ka ban shna ka durblei da ka dieng ba la suit da ka rupa . Te mynta ngan ai pat ïa ki sbai rupa sha phi
hynrei saw rah ïa ki tong ha kawei ka jaka ha kaba U Trai un lngaid na ka ri lad kawei na ki jait jong phi , badno hangta phin leh ïa kita baroh kiba nga la Law ïa phi .
translation.en: But in the place which the  Lord  shall choose in one of thy tribes , there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings , and there thou shalt do all that I command thee .

translation.kha: U Paul sad u Barnabas ki la ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha Derbe bad ki la ïoh Bun ki synran . Hangta ki la leit phai pat shwa Lystra , sha Ikoniom , bad nangta Sha Antiokh kaba ha Pisidia .
translation.en: And when they had preached the gospel to that city , and had taught many , they returned again to Lystra , and to Iconium , and Antioch ,

translation.kha: kumta u Mushi u mih ban leit ïakynduh ïa u , u dem ha khmat jong u , bad u doh ïa u . Ki ïakylli para ma ki kumno ki ïalong , Bad nangta ki la loit sha ka ïingjaiñ jongno u Moses .
translation.en: And Moses went out to meet his father in law , and did obeisance , and kissed him  ; and they asked each other of their welfare  ; and they came into the tent .
The woman was a Greek , a Syrophenician by nation  ; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter .
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la long ka Jentil , ba la kha ha ka thain Phoenisia ha Syria . Ka la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban beh noh ïa u ksuid na ka khun jong ka .

translation.en: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter , James , and John his brother , and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart ,
translation.kha: Hadien hynriew sngi U Jisu u la ïalam bad u ïa u Petros bad ïa ki ar ngut shi para , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis bad u la ïalam ïa ki sha u lumbah uba jrong ha kaba ki la ïadon tang ma ki hi .
U Saul u la khie joit na madan bad u la Peit , Hynrei um lah ban ïohi ei ei . kamut ki la shim ïa u na ka kti bad ki la ïalam ïa u sha Damaskos .
translation.en: And Saul arose from the earth  ; and when his eyes were opened , he saw no man : but they led him by the hand , and brought him into Damascus .

And when there had been much disputing , Peter rose up , and said unto them , Men and brethren , ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us , that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel , and believe .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïatainia kaba slem u Petros u la ïeng bad u la ong ,  Ko hynmen ko para jong nga , phi tip ba la kham slem mynshuwa U Blei u la jied ïa nga napdeng jong phi ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha sha ki Jentil , khnang ba ki lah ban ïohsngew bad ngeit .

Ka Israel kun long kaba khlem jingïada , bad ka Damaskos kun shuh noh ïa ka jinglanot jong ka . Kito ki nong Syria kiba lehse im kmen ni ha ka jinglehrain kum ki briew jong ka Israel . ?(Nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .
translation.en: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim , and the kingdom from Damascus , and the remnant of Syria : they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Da ka sur kaba jam u pan ki jingkyrkhu na U Blei halor u paidbah baroh uba ïalang hangta .
translation.en: And he stood , and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice , saying ,

translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa ki na ka lynti kaba beit shaei ka nongbud ha kaba ki lah ban shon ban sah .
translation.en: And he led them forth by the right way , that they might go to a city of habitation .

He fought also with the king of the Ammonites , and prevailed against them . And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver , and ten thousand measures of wheat , and ten thousand of barley . So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him , both the second year , and the third .
translation.kha: U ïaleh pyrshah ïa u syiem ka Ammon bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u bad u jop ïa ki . Nangta u pynbor ïa ki Ammon ban siew ïa u ka khajna man ka snem haduh lai snem kumne : lai hajar sawspah kilo ka rupa , shihajar ton u kew , bad shihajar ton u barli .
U Jokshan u la don khatphra snem ka Mid mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar tang to bnai bad shiphew sngi ha Jerusalem . U ruh u ar pop pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign , and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem : and he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka jingïaleh ka pura! kylleng ki rong , bad kham bun ki rangbah ki la ïaw ha khlur ban ïa kiba shah pynïap ha ka thnam .
translation.en: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country : and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured .

translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi kaba arphew saw jong ujuh u bnai , ki Jerusalem’ ki ïalumlang ba-bang shahjingit don pynpaw ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta ki pop Jong ki . Ki la ha pynïakhlad ïa lade na ki nongwei baroh . Ki phong ki janai khain bad sleh pui puid ha ki khlieh jngai ki kumto ka dak jong ka jingsngewsih . Nangta ki ïeng bad sdang ban phlang ïa ki pop kiba ma ki bad ki kpa thom jong ki , ki la leh .
translation.en: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers , and stood and confessed their sins , and the iniquities of their fathers .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka kherub kaba U Blei u la ai ha u Isaïah u khuid jong u Ammon shaïong ka Judah mala ka Israel :
translation.en: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem .
And the king said unto the man of God , Come home with me , and refresh thyself , and I will give thee a reward .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ong ha u nongïathuhlypa ,  Wan ngin ïaleit bad nga sha ïing bad ngin ïabam ei ei . Ngan ainong ïa phi namar kaei kaba phi la leh .
To khie joit , ko Jerusalem dara tyngshaiñ kum ka sngi ; ka burom ka jong U Trai ka jingshahdaiñ ha phi !
translation.en: Arise , shine  ; for thy light is come , and the glory of the  Lord  is risen upon thee .

translation.kha: Ka jingïamai jingmut jong ar ka long ba phin lumlang ïa ki Israel baroh na kawei ka tduh jrong ka ri sha Kawei pat , ki ban bun kat u shahjop ka rud duriaw , bad ba ma phin da lade hi phin ïalam ïa ki ha ka thom .
translation.en: Therefore I counsel that all Israel be generally gathered unto thee , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , as the sand that is by the sea for multitude  ; and that thou go to battle in thine own person .

translation.kha: Hadien jong Phin kan kein sa kawei ka hima , ka bym da khraw kum ka jong phi , mala hadien tala sa kaba lai , ka hima kaba da ka rnong , ka ban synshar ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translation.en: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee , and another third kingdom of brass , which shall bear rule over all the earth .
And ye shall be my people , and I will be your God .
translation.kha: U nongsynshar jong ki un wan na ka jaitbynriew jong ki hi , u khun syiem jong ki napdeng ki briew jong ki hi . Un wan sha nga haba nga khot sngewbha ïa u , namar uei uba nud ban wan khlem shah khot sngewbha ? Kin long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Lada me maham ïa u briew uba bha ba un ym leh thup , bad u shahshkor ïa me bad um leh pop , un im da shisha , bad ïa ka jingim jong me ruh yn pyllait .
translation.en: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man , that the righteous sin not , and he doth not sin , he shall surely live , because he is warned  ; also thou hast delivered thy soul .

translation.kha: Katba U Jingsuk u dang ba-don ha Jeroboam ha ka por ka jingkhie Niam Ka Jingtylli , shibun ki la ngeit ha u haba ki la ïohi ïa ki kambah kiba u la leh .
translation.en: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover , in the feast day , many believed in his name , when they saw the miracles which he did .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki la ïohi ïa Katai , ki la sheptieng , bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei uba la ai kum kata ka iktiar ha ki briew .
translation.en: But when the multitudes saw it , they marvelled , and glorified God , which had given such power unto men .

translation.kha: U la im hapoh ba u da ïoh ïa ki khun badno ki ksiew jong u Ephraim , bad haduh ba u da ïohpdiang ïa ki khun Jong u Makhir , u khun jong u Manasseh .
translation.en: And Joseph saw Ephraim s children of the third generation : the children also of Machir the son of Manasseh were brought up upon Joseph s knees .

translation.kha: Ieh kin ïashong ïasah ha Goshen , ka jaka kaba bha’ tam ha ka ri . Bad lada don napdeng jrong ki , ki briew kiba tbit , buh ïa ki ban peit ïa ki jingri jong por .
translation.en: The land of Egypt is before thee  ; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell  ; in the land of Goshen let them dwell : and if thou knowest any men of activity among them , then make them rulers over my cattle .

translation.kha: U tip kumno ban thir ïa ka kam lad u namar U Blei u hikai ïa u .
translation.en: For his God doth instruct him to discretion , and doth teach him .

translation.kha: Hato me tip lano kin dem ban wallam ïa ki khun rit sha ka pyrthei ?
translation.en: They bow themselves , they bring forth their young ones , they cast out their sorrows .
And they served their idols : which were a snare unto them .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong U Blei ki la mane ïa ki bleithaw , bad kane ka la pynlong ïa ki ba kin shah pynjot .
Ki shnong jong ka Judah bashathie ki Don haw ka jingshah kerkut ; ym don moi mian ba lah shun leit lyndang sha ki . Ïa ki briew baroh jongki ka —Judah la shim noh sha ka jinglongmraw .
translation.en: The cities of the south shall be shut up , and none shall open them : Judah shall be carried away captive all of it , it shall be wholly carried away captive .
There the righteous might dispute with him  ; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge .
translation.kha: Nga long uba hok ; nga lah ban ïasaidnia bad U Blei ; un pynbna shisien pynbna , ba nga long uba hok .
Kumta u Hahiroth u la kyrmen ïa U Jisu Sihon ki jingkylli , hynrei U Jehu um shitrhem jubab ei ei .
translation.en: Then he questioned with him in many words  ; but he answered him nothing .

And Jesus said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That ye which have followed me , in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory , ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones , judging the twelve tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Phi lah ban thikna ba haba U Khun U Briew u shong ha ka khet badonburom jong u ha ka Ïa kaba thymmai , te ma phi ki khat-ar ngut ki nongbud jong nga phin ïashong ruh ha ki khet , ban synshar ïa ki khat-ar ki jait Israel .

ngam pynlong ïa ki wah ban tuid hapdeng ki lym bymseisoh Bad ka um ha ki wahduid tud tuid ha ki jaka them . Nga pynjakhlia ïa ki jaka shyiap sha ki pukri um badno ki dewryngkhiang sha ki umpohliew batuid .
translation.en: I will open rivers in high places , and fountains in the midst of the valleys : I will make the wilderness a pool of water , and the dry land springs of water .

translation.kha: Ki nong Babilonia baroh ki khrud kum ki sing bad jlew kum ki khun sing .
translation.en: They shall roar together like lions : they shall yell as lions  whelps .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem! U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga bad uba ai jingshim ïa nga .
translation.en: The Spirit of God hath made me , and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life .

translation.kha: Men ïuhroit Halor ki jingjop bad ki bseiñ , ïa ki sing ba-itriem bad ïa ki seiñpuh .
translation.en: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder : the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet .

translation.kha: U Jakob u la leit ha shuwa jongnga ki , u da nguh ngon haduh khyndew hynñiew sien katba u nang leit shaei jat u hynmen jong u .
translation.en: And he passed over before them , and bowed himself to the ground seven times , until he came near to his brother .

translation.kha: Bad lada ka shrak kan ong , Namar ba ngam dei ka khmat , te ngam dei ka jong ka kun , kata kur pynlong ïa ka , ba kam dei ka dkhot jong ka met .
translation.en: And if the ear shall say , Because I am not the eye , I am not of the body ; is it therefore not of the body ?
And the flesh of them shall be thine , as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine .
translation.kha: Ka doh na ki , kum ka shadem bad ka kjat-dien kamon kiba long ki jingainguh bakyrpang , ki long ka bynta jong me .

translation.en: For I say unto you , I will not drink of the fruit of the vine , until the kingdom of God shall come .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ba naduh mynta ngan ym dih ïa kane ka waiñ tad ynda ka Hima U Blei ka wan .

translation.en: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king  ; but my lord the king is as an angel of God : do therefore what is good in thine eyes .
translation.kha: U la lamler shaphang jong nga ha phi ko Syiem kynrad ; hynrei phi , phi long kum u angel U Blei , kumta leh ïa kaei kaba idei ïa phi .

balieh phi leh ïa kane ? Ngi hi ngi long tang ki brai kiba kum ma phi ! Ngi don hangne ban pynbna ïa ka Khebar Babha , ban pynswai noh ïa phi na kine khie kai ki bymmyntoi sha U Blei wahbah im , uba la thaw ïa ka banyngkong , ïa ka khyndew , ïa ka duriaw , bad ïa barben Kat kaba to ha ki .
translation.en: And saying , Sirs , why do ye these things ? We also are men of like passions with you , and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God , which made heaven , and earth , and the sea , and all things that are therein :
And again he went away , and prayed , and spake the same words .
translation.kha: U la leit noh sa shisien bad u la duwai , da kaba ong ïa kijuh ki ktien .
U Elisha u la ïathuh ha u syiem ba ha kaba kum Katai ka por ha ka sngi kaba bud la kilo u khiew uba bha tam lane hynriew kilomitar u barli yn die ha Syria ha ka dor syang sbai saw ,
translation.en: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king , saying , Two measures of barley for a shekel , and a measure of fine flour for a shekel , shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria :
This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families , these cities with their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Asher ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
Ngi tip ka mut aïu ban sheptieng ïa U Trai , bad kumta ngi pylleng ban pynshahthngan ïa kiwei . U Blei u tip lut shaphang jong im’ , bad nga kyrmen ba ha ki dohnud jong phi , phi tip ïa nga kumjuh .
translation.en: Knowing therefore the terror of the Lord , we persuade men ; but we are made manifest unto God ; and I trust also are made manifest in your consciences .

Moreover the altar that was at Beth–el , and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin , had made , both that altar and the high place he brake down , and burned the high place , and stamped it small to powder , and burned the grove .
translation.kha: U Josaïah u la pyntwa ruh ïa ka jaka mane ha Bethel kaba la tei da u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop . U Josaïah u la pyntwa ruh ïa ka duwan , u pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki maw jong ka , bad u pynlwet phum ïa ki ; u la thang ruh ïa ka dur jong ka Asherah .
Ki nongwei kiba shong sohpdung jong phi kin nang khlam khroh katba ma Phin pat phin nang duh ïa la ka bor .
translation.en: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high  ; and thou shalt come down very low .
Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them , Is it true , O Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , do not ye serve my gods , nor worship the golden image which I have set up ?
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Ko Shadrakh , Meshakh , bad Abednego , hato ka long kaba shisha ba phi kyntait ban mane ïa u blei jong nga bad ban dem ngon sha ka durbriew kaba nga la phah pynïeng ?
U pynshitom ïa ki nongpynjot ha kaba baroh kin ïohi ïa kata ,
translation.en: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei nga la kylluid ha phi ïa kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kum ka jingïohkynti jongki pa’ , nabar ngan ai ïa ka ha phi . Na long U Trai U Blei jong phi , bad nga la pynkyrpang ïa phi na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: But I have said unto you , Ye shall inherit their land , and I will give it unto you to possess it , a land that floweth with milk and honey : I am the  Lord  your God , which have separated you from other people .
These things said he in the synagogue , as he taught in Capernaum .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa kane katba u dang hikai ha ka synagog ha Kapernam .

translation.en: But I said unto you , That ye also have seen me , and believe not .
translation.kha: Mynta , nga la ïathuh ïa phi ba phi la ïohi ïa nga hynrei phin ym ngeit .
Hangta kin sa khot kyrpad ïa ka jingstad , hynrei ngan ym jubab ; phin sa wan wad ïa nga kyrteng sawdong , hynrei phin ym shem ïa ang .
translation.en: Then shall they call upon me , but I will not answer  ; they shall seek me early , but they shall not find me :
For thou hast delivered my soul from death , mine eyes from tears , and my feet from falling .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa nga na ka jingïap , u la pynsangeh ïa ki ummat jong nga , bad u la sumar ïa nga na ka jingshahjop .
Nangta u Saul u kylla ïa u Jonathan , Me la sa aïu ? U Jonathan u jop , Nga la bam khyndiat ka ngap da u dieng uba nga rah . Nga don hangne — nga la kloi shun ïap .
translation.en: Then Saul said to Jonathan , Tell me what thou hast done . And Jonathan told him , and said , I did but taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in mine hand , and , lo , I must die .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ale lang , ko ki brai jong ki hima , baroh kiba lait im na ka jingainong ka hima-patsha ; ai ïa lat na ka bynta ka jinglah ! Ki briew kiba ïaid bad la ki bleithaw kiba da ki dieng badno duwai sha ki blei ki bym lah ban pynim ïa ki — kito ki briew ki bymtip ei ei satia !
translation.en: Assemble yourselves and come  ; draw near together , ye that are escaped of the nations : they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image , and pray unto a god that cannot save .
And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind , a light of them which are in darkness ,
translation.kha: Bad phi thikna ba phi long daladie  u nongïalam ïa uba matlah , ka jingshai ïa kito kiba ha ka jingdum ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  shall guide thee continually , and satisfy thy soul in drought , and make fat thy bones : and thou shalt be like a watered garden , and like a spring of water , whose waters fail not .
translation.kha: Bad ngan ïalam ïa phi borabor , bad pynkdang ïa phi da kiei kiei kiba bha . Ngan pynlong ïa phi kiba khlaiñ bad khiah krat . Phin long kum ka kper kaba pahuh um , kum ka umpohliew ka bym ju rngad .

translation.en: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood , and stablisheth a city by iniquity !
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi la buh nongrim ïa ka nongbah halor ka kam runar bad la tei ïa ka da ka kam pynïap briew .
Ngan lyndum noh ïa ki briew jong nga haduh ba kin shahshitom ha ban da biang na ka bynta ki pop jongki ki bad ïan ban wad ïa at . Leh ha ki jingshah khim jong ki , kin pyrshang ban wad ïa nga .
translation.en: I will go and return to my place , till they acknowledge their offence , and seek my face : in their affliction they will seek me early .

translation.kha: U briew uba sniew u prie noh ïa ka spah ba u la tuh ; U balui u shem pat ïa ka , wat na ka kpoh jong u .
translation.en: He hath swallowed down riches , and he shall vomit them up again : God shall cast them out of his belly .

translation.kha: ithuh u tnga nyngkong um dem shuh ïa-ban ïapoi shongdor Bad ka , namar ba ka la shah pyntngit . Lada u leh kumta , kan longsyiem kaba ijli ha khmut U Trai , bad phim dei ban kuna kum kata ka pop kaba sngewshyrkhei ha kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei Jong pa’ u ai ha phi .
translation.en: Her former husband , which sent her away , may not take her again to be his wife , after that she is defiled  ; for that is abomination before the  Lord  : and thou shalt not cause the land to sin , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance .

translation.kha: Shna kawei ka lyngba na ka bniat ïa lade da u jait dieng Uba bha ; shna ki kamra ha ka bad tah ruh ïa ka da ka bsiang na shapoh mala shabar .
translation.en: Make thee an ark of gopher wood  ; rooms shalt thou make in the ark , and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch .

translation.kha: Te uta u bhabriew u la leit noh bad u la ïathuh ïa ki nongbishar jong ki Jia ba dei U Jehu uba la pynkhiah ïa u .
translation.en: The man departed , and told the Jews that it was Jesus , which had made him whole .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ka khubor jong U Tlai , phi ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , phi ki jait jong ka Israel .
translation.en: Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , O house of Jacob , and all the families of the house of Israel :
And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim , it displeased him : and he held up his father s hand , to remove it from Ephraim s head unto Manasseh s head .
translation.kha: U Joseph um sngewtynnat haba u ïohi ïa u kpa jong u ba u buh ïa la ka kti kamon ha ka khlieh u Ephraim ; kumta u bat ïa ka kti u kpa jong u ban pynkynriah ïa ka na ka khlieh u Ephraim sha ka khlieh u Manasseh .
Hato me tipthuh haduh Katno ki kit ïa la ki ïakhun ryñiot ? Hato me tip ïa ka Por ba yn kha ïa ki ?
translation.en: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil ? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth ?

translation.kha: Nga la thngan bad phi la basa ïa nga , nga la sliang bad phi la ai jingieid ïa na ; nga la long u nongwei badno phi la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ha ki ïing jongno ph ,
translation.en: For I was an hungred , and ye gave me meat : I was thirsty , and ye gave me drink : I was a stranger , and ye took me in :

translation.kha: Nga la lama tang ma nga hi uba la ïohi ïa ka jingïohipaw . Ki rangbah kiba ïadon badno nga kim shym ïohi ei ei , isynei ki la sngewlehrain mala ki la ïamareh bad wait rieh .
translation.en: And I Daniel alone saw the vision : for the men that were with me saw not the vision  ; but a great quaking fell upon them , so that they fled to hide themselves .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por phiah bud ïa ka lap im basniew jong ka pyrthei ; ph la tyngkhuh ïa u nongsynshar jong ki har mynsiem ha ka haw haw , u mynsiem uba synshar mynta ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh ïa U Blang .
translation.en: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world , according to the prince of the power of the air , the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience :

translation.kha: Naba ki phai dien bad ki wan poi biang sha Kadesh ( kaba la thop mynshuwa kum ka Enmishpat ) . Ki la jop ïa ka ri baroh jong ki Amalek , bad ki la khop ïa ki Amor jin kaba shong basah ha Hasason Tamar .
translation.en: And they returned , and came to En–mishpat , which is Kadesh , and smote all the country of the Amalekites , and also the Amorites , that dwelt in Hazazon–tamar .

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la khyndew bad ong , Ho-oid , nga lah ban ïohi ïa ki briew , hynrei nga ïohi koum ki dieng kiba ïa-ïaid .
translation.en: And he looked up , and said , I see men as trees , walking .
So then it is not of him that willeth , nor of him that runneth , but of God that sheweth mercy .
translation.kha: Kumta te , kiei kiei baroh ki shong , ym ha kaei kaba u briew u kwah ne u leh , hynrei tang ha ka jingisynei U Blei .

translation.en: Withdraw thine hand far from me : and let not thy dread make me afraid .
translation.kha: Shah ba ngan pan ar tylli kiei kiei ; to mynjur ïa ki , bad ngan nym pyrshang ban buhrieh na me : to sangeh noh ban pynshitom ïa nga , bad wat khñiot ïa nga da ka jingsngewtriem .
U la sei ïa ka ryntieh jong u bad u pynlong ïa na ka sohpdung ïa ki khnam jong u .
translation.en: He hath bent his bow , and set me as a mark for the arrow .
Then I Daniel looked , and , behold , there stood other two , the one on this side of the bank of the river , and the other on that side of the bank of the river .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ar ngut ki rangbah kiba ïeng harud wah , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang .
U phah ïa ka jingjied bad jingpynjot ïa kito kiba imat bymhok .
translation.en: Is not destruction to the wicked ? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity ?

translation.kha: ka Beth Lebiathan , bad ka Sharuhen : khatlai tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongtrei Sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: And Beth–lebaoth , and Sharuhen  ; thirteen cities and their villages :
And if Christ be not raised , your faith is vain ; ye are yet in your sins .
translation.kha: Bad lada ïa U Khrist ym shym la pynmihpat , te ka jingngeit jong phi kam long kaba shisha bad phi dang don hi ha ki pop jong phi .

Wat mane ïa U Trai U blei jong phi kumba ki mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki , namar ba ha kaba mane ïa ki , ki leh duh ïa ki kam isaitmet baroh kiba U Trai u sisa . Ki kñia wat ïa la ki khun ki kti ruh ha ka ding halor ki duwan jong ki .
translation.en: Thou shalt not do so unto the  Lord  thy God : for every abomination to the  Lord  , which he hateth , have they done unto their gods  ; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods .

translation.kha: U Blei un tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , un don sawdong jong ka bad un kerkut ïa ka .
translation.en: And I will camp against thee round about , and will lay siege against thee with a mount , and I will raise forts against thee .

translation.kha: U Jonathan , u khun jong u Abiathar , bad u Ammihud , u khun jong u Sadok , ki dang ap khatsan ka riewpoh Enrogel , kaba ha rudnong jong ka Jerusalem , namar kim naduh ban rung shapoh ka nongbat ïoh don ba ieh ïa ki . Kawei ka shakri kynthei ka ju leit ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba jia , bad ki pat ki ju rupa ïaheh ha u Syiem dab .
translation.en: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by En–rogel  ; for they might not be seen to come into the city : and a wench went and told them  ; and they went and told king David .

translation.kha: Te u Moses lem bad ki nongïalam Jeraïah , ki ong ha uta u paidbah , Kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ïa kiba la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
translation.en: And Moses with the elders of Israel commanded the people , saying , Keep all the commandments which I command you this day .

translation.kha: Ka long naduh kata ka por ba u Dabid u la ai nyngkong eh ha u Salaph bad ki para Lebi jong u ïa ka jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ki jingrwai ïaroh ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the  Lord  into the hand of Asaph and his brethren .
Howbeit the  Lord  would not destroy the house of David , because of the covenant that he had made with David , and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever .
translation.kha: hynrei U  Trai  um mon ban pynduh ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Dabid , namar u la lah pynlong ka jutang bad u Dabid bad ba u la kular ba ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin ïai bteng ban synshar .
Kumba u kba uba beh u kwah ïa kaba bhah tam na ka bynta ki khun , u Kpa bneng jong ngi ruh u kwah ba ngin ïoh ïa ka jingkmen bymjukut .
translation.en: Just as a good father wishes the best for his children , our heavenly Father desires that we enjoy eternal happiness .

translation.kha: bad u Ishmael u kynhun jong u bapaw u la dap khatlai snem ka rta .
translation.en: And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old , when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin .
For a fire is kindled in mine anger , and shall burn unto the lowest hell , and shall consume the earth with her increase , and set on fire the foundations of the mountains .
translation.kha: Ka jingbitar jong nga kan meh lep kum ka ding , bad kan thang duh katba don ha sla pyrthei . Kan pur de shaduh ñiamra , bad kan thang ïa ki tynrai jong ki lumbah .
U Amasa u la leit khop ïa ki , hynrei um syiem poi ha ka na ba u syiem u la buh .
translation.en: So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah : but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him .

translation.kha: Kumta te — da shisha ma nga , U Trai Nongsharai , nga long U Blei uba im — ka jingïarap ka long ka kupar jong pha , bad men ym lah lait na ka . Me long uba la rem na ka jingpynpaw briew , bad ka jingpynïap briew kan buddien ïa me .
translation.en: Therefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , I will prepare thee unto blood , and blood shall pursue thee : sith thou hast not hated blood , even blood shall pursue thee .

translation.kha: Ïa ka kali ïapom jrong u la Siat ha ka pung Syria ; ha kaban ki ksew ki jliah ïa ka snam jong u , bad ki nuti ki sum ki sleh hangta , kumba U Trai u la ong ba kan jia .
translation.en: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria  ; and the dogs licked up his blood  ; and they washed his armour  ; according unto the word of the  Lord  which he spake .

translation.kha: Da shisha phin sa sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba ngan sa ainong , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , namar pa’ barieh phi tip ïa ka sah . Ka lawlynnong ka synshar halor ki briew tieng haba ki ïan im .
translation.en: Know ye not , brethren , (for I speak to them that know the law ) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth ?
They envied Moses also in the camp , and Aaron the saint of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hangta ha ka ri shyiap ki la pihuiñ ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , ki shakri bakhuid jong U  Trai .
Haoid kadei ka kot .
translation.en: It is a book .
And they made a calf in those days , and offered sacrifice unto the idol , and rejoiced in the works of their own hands .
translation.kha: Ka la long hangta ba ki la thaw ïa ka bleithaw ha ka dur jong u masi , ki la ai jingkñia ha ka , bad ki la ïakhawai ha kaba ai burom ïa kaei kaba ma ki hi ki la lah thaw .
U Trai u la hukum ïa nga shun hikai ïa phi ïa ki aïu bad ki hukum baroh ïa kiba phin dei ban sumar pynlang leh ha said ka ri sha naba phin sa leit Bad ïohkynti .
translation.en: And the  Lord  commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments , that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki trei ïa kane ka kam baroh kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Messaïah .
translation.en: According to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses , so the children of Israel made all the work .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïong ha u Aaron , ‘ To ïakit ïa I katto katne ki blei ki ban ïalam ïa ngi . Ngim tip kaei katba la jia ïa une u Moses , uba la wallam ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: Saying unto Aaron , Make us gods to go before us : for as for this Moses , which brought us out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .
It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth , and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers  ; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain , and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in :
translation.kha: La thaw ïa ka da uta uba shong halor ka khet jong u shajrong ka khyndew bad sha lyndet ka sahit bneng ; ki briew shapoh ki i rit tang kum ki dkhiew . U pynpyiar ïa ka suiñbneng kum ka pyrda , kum ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba yn shong .
U Syiem Dabid u la pynkyntang ïa ki na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka jingmane , lem badno ka rupa bad ka ksiar kambah u la thup na ki jaitbynriew katba u la jop —
translation.en: Which also king David did dedicate unto the  Lord  , with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued  ;
And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon , and there shall he be until I visit him , saith the  Lord  : though ye fight with the Chaldeans , ye shall not prosper .
translation.kha: Ïa u Sedekaïah yn rah noh sha Babilonia bad un sah hangta haduh ba ngan da pyndep ïa kaei ban leh ïa u . Wat lada un ïaleh ïa ki nong Babilonia , un ym lah ban jop . Ma nga U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: This is the law of the burnt offering , of the meat offering , and of the sin offering , and of the trespass offering , and of the consecrations , and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings  ;
translation.kha: Kine keiñ ki long kita ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh thang , ki jingainguh bam , ki jingkñia namar ka pop , ki jingkñia namar ka jingleh palat , ki jingkñia pynkyntang , bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok .
U Saul u khot Ngan ïa ki ha bahok : ki rangbah Jerusalem ki don lai lakh ngut , bad ki rangbah Judah pat laiphew hajar ngut .
translation.en: And when he numbered them in Bezek , the children of Israel were three hundred thousand , and the men of Judah thirty thousand .
And she said unto them , Call me not Naomi , call me Mara : for the Almighty hath dealt very bitterly with me .
translation.kha: Wat khot ïa nga , ka Naomi ,  ka jubab ;  khot noh ïa nga , ka Marah , namar U Blei Bakhrawbor u la pynlong ïa ka jingim jong nga kaba kthang .
ka Dimnah , bad ka Nahalal , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: Dimnah with her suburbs , Nahalal with her suburbs  ; four cities .

translation.kha: na kawei ka pateng bynriew sha kawei pud u pynum ka jingisynei ha kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u .
translation.en: And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation .

translation.kha: Naba U Blei u la pynlong ïa barabor ki briew , ki koidi jong ka jingbymkohnguh , khnang ba un lah ban pyn-i ïa ka jingisynei ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief , that he might have mercy upon all .
And he set the priests in their charges , and encouraged them to the service of the house of the  Lord  ,
translation.kha: U aiti ha ki lyngdoh ïa ki kamram kiba ki dei ban trei ha ka Templ bad u pynshlur ïa ki ban da lehbha ïa ki .
Ho-oid , nga dei u Elijah , u jubab . Khie leit ïathuh ha u syiem , u kynrad jyllang Phin ba nga don hangtai .
translation.en: And he answered him , I am : go , tell thy lord , Behold , Elijah is here .

translation.kha: Ussaïah hadien uwei , ki briew kin ong , ‘ nga long u jong U tharai . Kim ïawan ban ïasnoh bad u pangnud Israel . Uwei pa Uei un shon ha ka khñiang ti jongnga u ïa ka kyrteng jong U Trei bad un khot ïa lade uwei na ki brai U Blei .
translation.en: One shall say , I am the  Lord s   ; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob  ; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the  Lord  , and surname himself by the name of Israel .
I Tertius , who wrote this epistle , salute you in the Lord .
translation.kha: Ma nga , u Tertios , uba thoh ïa kane ka shithi , nga phah ïa phi ki jingkhublei parabangeit .
Haba nga la wan shai phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ban ïalap ïa ka jingshisha barieh jong U Blei , ngim skhem la pyndonkam da ki kyntien Kiba eh bad ka jingtip kaba khraw .
translation.en: And I , brethren , when I came to you , came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom , declaring unto you the testimony of God .

translation.kha: Ki la kurup ïa ka ha kajuh ka sngi bad ki la pynnep ïa uwei pa uwei hangta , kumba ki la ni ha Lakkum .
translation.en: And they took it on that day , and smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein he utterly destroyed that day , according to all that he had done to Lachish .

translation.kha: Ka jingkhia u maw malade u shyiap kam long ei ei shun haba ïanujor bad ka jingjynjar kabu uba mutlop u lah ban pynjanai .
translation.en: A stone is heavy , and the sand weighty  ; but a fool s wrath is heavier than them both .
But my servant Caleb , because he had another spirit with him , and hath followed me fully , him will I bring into the land whereinto he went  ; and his seed shall possess it .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Kaleb u shakri jong nga u don ka jinglong bapher bad u la ïaineh ha nga , ngan wallam ïa u sha kata ka ri kaba u la swar , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri
Kumta u Jehubbah u jam sha shiliang wah ban ïaleh ïa ki Ammon , bad U Trai u ai ha u ka jingtip .
translation.en: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them  ; and the  Lord  delivered them into his hands .
Soon , though , an amazing event will take place .
translation.kha: Hynrei satang katto katne kein , ka jingjia kaba phylla kan sa wan jia .

Ki jingblei ruh ïa ka balang kaba ïasan ha ka ïing jong ki . Ki jingkhublei ïa u paralok ba-ieit jong nga u Epainetos , uba long u nongbah babha nyngkong ha ka probins jong ka Aïah ban ngeit ha U Khrist .
translation.en: Likewise greet the church that is in their house . Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus , who is the firstfruits of Asia unto Christ .
And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem , and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall .
translation.kha: Phi la shem ïa ki jaka ha kaba ki kynroh jong ka Jerusalem ki donkam ïa ka jingshna pynbha . Phi la leit khmih ïa ki ïing baroh ha Jerusalem bad phi la pynkhyllem katto katne na ki ban ïoh ki maw ban shna pynbha ïa ki kynroh jong ka nongbah .

translation.en: Remember Lot s wife .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa ka tnga u Lot !
Ka peiñ ianga .
translation.en: She looked at me .
Be strong , and quit yourselves like men , O ye Philistines , that ye be not servants unto the Hebrews , as they have been to you : quit yourselves like men , and fight .
translation.kha: Long shlur , ko ki Philistia ! Ïaleh kum ki rangbah , lym kumta ngin kylla long ki mraw ha kine ki Hebru , kumba ma ki , ki la long ki mraw jong ngi . Kumta to ïaleh kum ki rangbah !

translation.en: Therefore will I save my flock , and they shall no more be a prey  ; and I will judge between cattle and cattle .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pyllait im ïa la ki langbrot bad ngan ym shah ba yn lehbeiñ shuh ïa ki . Ngan bishar ïa kawei pa kawei na ki langbrot jong nga bad pynïakhlad ïa kiba bha na kiba sniew .

Hangta u pynbynta kynhun kynruh ïa la ki briew , u tur pyrshah ïa ki nongshun mynmiet , bad u jop ïa ki . U beh ruh ïa ki khih Hobah , kaba shaphang shatei jong ka Damaskos , bad u la ïoh bapaw ruh ïa kato kaba ki la lute .
translation.en: And he divided himself against them , he and his servants , by night , and smote them , and pursued them unto Hobah , which is on the left hand of Damascus .
I have also spoken by the prophets , and I have multiplied visions , and used similitudes , by the ministry of the prophets .
translation.kha: Nga la kren ha ki nongïathuhlypa bad ai ha ki shibun ki jingïohipaw , bad lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa nga ai jingmaham ïa ki briew jong nga .

Naduh nangta hi , man ka por ba Utai u mynsiem ba-bymman ba phah U Blei u wan ha u Saul , u Dabid u shim ïa la ka duitara bad u tem ïa ka . Uta u mynsiem bymman u mihnoh , bad u Saul ruh u sngewpyngngad kdar , bad u shait u koit pat .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the evil spirit from God was upon Saul , that David took an harp , and played with his hand : so Saul was refreshed , and was well , and the evil spirit departed from him .

translation.kha: Ma ngi baroh kiba la ih bha ka jinglong mynsiem , ngi dadien ban ïoh ïa kane kajuh ka jingmut . Hynrei lade don napdeng jongngi phiah kiba don da ka jingmut baïapher , U Blei un pynshai ïa kane ha phi .
translation.en: Let us therefore , as many as be perfect , be thus minded : and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded , God shall reveal even this unto you .
Behold , these shall come from far : and , lo , these from the north and from the west  ; and these from the land of Sinim .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga kin wan na jngai bah , na shatei bad na sepngi , bad na Aswan kaba don shathie .
Ka durkhmat jongngi u ka phyrnai kum ki mawkordor , kumta u Jasper bad u Kalneh , bad barabor Syndong ka khet la don u simpyllieng babha don ka rong kum ka jyllang u Emerald .
translation.en: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone : and there was a rainbow round about the throne , in sight like unto an emerald .
Every male among the priests shall eat thereof : it shall be eaten in the holy place : it is most holy .
translation.kha: Uno uno u shynrang na ka longïing lyngdoh u lah ban bam ïa ka , hynrei dei ban bam ïa ka ha ka jaka kaba khuid , naba ka long kaba khuid bha .
Naba Aner kin long ‘ Ki sngur ka Jingpynshitom ,’ ban pynlong ïa baroh kaba ki Jingthoh bakhiah ki Ong pun jingurlong shisha .
translation.en: For these be the days of vengeance , that all things which are written may be fulfilled .
And the  Lord  God of Israel delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Israel , and they smote them : so Israel possessed all the land of the Amorites , the inhabitants of that country .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ai jingjop ha ki Israel pyrshah ïa u Sihon bad ka kynhun shipai jong u . Kumta ki Israel ki shimti ïa baroh ka ri jong ki Amor kiba shong ha kata ka thain .
U Baalah u noh ha u Balak , Mynmiet len leit phai pat sha la ki briew , hynrei shuwa ba ngan miej , to maham lwep ïa ph aïu ki Israhaïah ngin leh ïa ki bynriew jong phi haduh habud .
translation.en: And now , behold , I go unto my people : come therefore , and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days .

translation.kha: Hangta u angel jongnga U Trai u la mihpaw ha u ha ka tuh ka tylli ding nongput kawei ka lawlynnong . U Moses u ïohi ba kata ka lawlynnong ka la skum ding , hynrei kam shym ing satia .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush : and he looked , and , behold , the bush burned with fire , and the bush was not consumed .

translation.kha: Ha ka jaiñkup jong u bad ha ka lbong jong u la thop ïa ka kyrteng : U Shimiet jong ki syiemsad mala U Trai jong ki trai .
translation.en: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written , KING OF KINGS , AND   OF LORDS .

translation.kha: Neng la dem khohsiew bad maïan ïa U Trai . Nga ïaroh ïa U Trai , U blem jong u kynrad jong nga u Abraham , uba la ïalam beit ïa nga sha u kur u jait jong u kynrad jong nga , ha kaba nga la shem ïa ka khun jong u na ka bynta u khun jong u kynrad jong sa .
translation.en: And I bowed down my head , and worshipped the  Lord  , and blessed the  Lord  God of my master Abraham , which had led me in the right way to take my master s brother s daughter unto his son .

translation.kha: Mynta , la don hynñiew ngut ki shynrang ba shi la kiba la ju shong ju Hukum hangne . Uba heh duh u la shongkurim bad u la ïap khlem don khun , kumta u la iohnong ïa ka tnga Jong u ha la u lad u para .
translation.en: Now there were with us seven brethren : and the first , when he had married a wife , deceased , and , having no issue , left his wife unto his brother :
He brought me to the banqueting house , and his banner over me was love .
translation.kha: To shim ïa nga bad phi , bad ngin ïaphet noh ; to long u syiem jong nga bad shim ïa nga sha ka kamra jong phi . Ngin ïakmen lang , ngin ïadih bun bad pyllaitluid war ïa lade ha ka jingieit . Kam long kaba phylla ba baroh ki kynthei ki ieit ïa phi !
Ki Jeruel kin long kum kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew bad kin longïng ki bymlarkam kum u khra ba la pait .
translation.en: Israel is swallowed up : now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure .
The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the  Lord  : but the words of the pure are pleasant words .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki jingpyrkhat kiba sniew , hynrei u sngewbha ha ki ktien kiba sngur jingmut .

translation.en: Thou liftest me up to the wind  ; thou causest me to ride upon it , and dissolvest my substance .
translation.kha: Me la shah ïa ka lyer ban beh noh ïa nga ; me la kynting ïa nga ha ka  erïong bajur .
bad U Trai u ïa-ong , Mynta sngap aïu ngan ong ! Babha don ki nongïathuhlypa hapdeng jong phi , nga pynpaw ïa lade ha ki ha ka jingïohipaw bad nga kren ha ki ha ki jingphohsniew .
translation.en: And he said , Hear now my words : If there be a prophet among you , I the  Lord  will make myself known unto him in a vision , and will speak unto him in a dream .
I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people , which walketh in a way that was not good , after their own thoughts  ;
translation.kha: Nga long uba la kloi borabor ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki briew jong nga , kiba long mutlop ban ïai leh ïa ka bymdei bad ïaid ha la ka jong ka lynti ,

translation.en: And all king Solomon s drinking vessels were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold  ; none were of silver : it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon .
translation.kha: Baroh ki khuri dih jingdih jong u Solomon ki long kiba la shna da ka ksiar , bad baroh ki khiew ki pliang ha ka Kamra heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon    ki long kiba da ka ksiar nylla . Ym shym pyndonkam da ka rupa , namar kam shym long kaba la ñiewkordor ha ki sngi u Solomon .

U Trai Nongsynshar u la Ong ha per , Ko khun u briew , to sngi ïa kaei kaba ngan ong ha me . Haba la tei ïa ka duwan , me Dei ban pynkyntang ïa ka da kaba thang ki jingkñia halor jong ka bad da kaba syn halor jong ka ïa ka snam jong ki narud ba la kñia .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , thus saith the Lord  God   ; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it , to offer burnt offerings thereon , and to sprinkle blood thereon .

translation.kha: Te u nongïathuhlypa thom uba na Bethuel u ong ha u , Nga ruh per dei u nongïathuhlypa kum ma phi , pynlang ha ka hukum jrong U Trai , u angel u la ong ïa per ban ïalam ïa phi sha ïing bad ban ai ïa ka jingpdiang sngewbha ïa phi . Hynrei u nonghiarpateng tymmen u lamler .
translation.en: He said unto him , I am a prophet also as thou art  ; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the  Lord  , saying , Bring him back with thee into thine house , that he may eat bread and drink water . But he lied unto him .

translation.kha: Mynta ka snoh , U Troas U Blei jong phoi u sah ïa Phi ban kohnguh ïa ki ngaiñ jong u baroh ; kumta kohnguh ïa ki da ka dohnud jong phi baroh .
translation.en: This day the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee to do these statutes and judgments : thou shalt therefore keep and do them with all thine heart , and with all thy soul .
Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances , and with the bag of deceitful weights ?
translation.kha: Kumno nga lah ban map ïa kito kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur bad jingthew bashukor ?
Ka Bathsheba ka dem ngon ha khmat u syiem , bad u ong , Pha kwah aïu ?
translation.en: And Bath–sheba bowed , and did obeisance unto the king . And the king said , What wouldest thou ?

Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , which was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder , to Hezekiah with their clothes rent , and told him the words of Rab–shakeh .
translation.kha: Nangta u Eliakim , u Shebna , bad u Joah ki kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , bad ki leit bad ïathuh sha u syiem ïa kaei kaba u rangbah synshar ka Assyria u la ong .
Ki symboh kiba la hap ha ka jaka mawsiang ki ngin na ka bynta iba kiba pdiang ïa ka Khubor da kaba ken mar ïa ïohsngew ïa ka .
translation.en: But he that received the seed into stony places , the same is he that heareth the word , and anon with joy receiveth it  ;

translation.kha: Shaphang ka jingjynjar kaba Mynta , nga pyrkhat ba ka kham bha ïa u briew ban sah kumba u long .
translation.en: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress , I say , that it is good for a man so to be .
And God met Balaam : and he said unto him , I have prepared seven altars , and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram .
translation.kha: bad U Blei u ïakynduh ïa u . U Balaam u ong ha u ,  Nga la tei hynñiew tylli ki duwan bad nga la kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bad uwei u langbrot ha kawei kawei na ki .

Kane ka daiñ kai ka ban Jia ha baroh ki jaitbynriew kylleng ka pyrthei . Kan long kum ka jingkut jong ka jingot , haba ïa ki soh Olib la ïadep tied pynhap na uwei pa uwei u dieng bad ba ïa ki sohwaiñ bakhatduh la kheit na ki dieng sohwaiñ .
translation.en: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people , there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree , and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done .

translation.kha: Ka bneng bad ka pyrthei kin leit noh , hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym leit neh salia .
translation.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away : but my words shall not pass away .
It shall come to pass , when he seeth that the lad is not with us , that he will die : and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave .
translation.kha: Namar kata , ko kynrad ,  u Judah u bteng ,  lada ngan leit phai sha i pa khlem u para , in tang shu ïohi ba u para um don bad nga , in sa ïap . I ieit thep mynsiem ïa u , bad namar ba i la tymmen eh , ka jingleh jong ngi kan pynïap sngewsih ïa i .

translation.en: And he wrote a letter after this manner :
translation.kha: Nangta uta u rangbah ai hukum u la thoh ïa ka shithi kumne :

Ngi long na kajuh ka jaitbynriew kum ki para Jiw jongno ngi . Hato ki khun ki ktha jong ngi Kam erlangthari Khmut kamon ki jong ki ? hynrei ngi la hap ban pynlong mraw ïa ki khun ki kti jong ngi . Ïa ki katto katne ki khun kynthei jong im’ , la lah die ïa ki kum ki mraw . Ngim donbor ei ei namar ïa ki pynthor bad ki bri sohwaiñ la shim noh na ngi .
translation.en: Yet now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren , our children as their children : and , lo , we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters to be servants , and some of our daughters are brought unto bondage already : neither is it in our power to redeem them  ; for other men have our lands and vineyards .

translation.kha: Ynda phi la ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ba U Trai U Balei jongnga phi u ai ha phi bad Phi la shong la sah hangta , Phon sa ïa-pyrkhat Ban kein noh u syiem kumba ïalong lak ki jaitbynriew baroh sawdong jong phi .
translation.en: When thou art come unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , and shalt possess it , and shalt dwell therein , and shalt say , I will set a king over me , like as all the nations that are about me  ;
The king sent and loosed him  ; even the ruler of the people , and let him go free .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem ka Ijipt u la phah pyllait ïa u ; u nongsynshar ki jaitbynriew u la pyllait ïa u .

Ka thngan u Ephraim ka Sarai , kam shym la ïoh khun satia . Hynrei ka la don mala ka , kawei ka khra-maw na Ijipt kaba kyrteng ka Hagar , bad kumta ka ong ha u Ibsam , U Trai u la khang ïa ang ban ïoh khun .
translation.en: Now Sarai Abram s wife bare him no children : and she had an handmaid , an Egyptian , whose name was Hagar .

translation.kha: Nga lah ban sngewsarong ïa ka jingshakri jong nga ïa U blei , lyngka U Khrist Jisu
translation.en: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God .

translation.kha: Kane ka la i kum ka jingiw jingmut kaba bha ïa u Abel bad ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israhaïah .
translation.en: And the saying pleased Absalom well , and all the elders of Israel .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , u Abimelekh u leit bad u Phikol , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jongnga u , bad u ong ha u Abraham , U Blei u un-long ryngkat bad me ha katei kaei baroh ba me leh .
translation.en: And it came to pass at that time , that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham , saying , God is with thee in all that thou doest :

translation.kha: Pynban me la bud ïa ka jingleh jong ki syiemsad ka Israel badno me la ïalam ïa ki briew ka Jehud dara Israel sha ka jinglong bymïaineh shuh ha U Blei , kumba u Ahab bad ki nongmih bujli jong u ki la ïabam ïa ki Israel sha ka jingbymïaineh . Me la pynïap wat ïa la ki para shynna , kiba long ki rangbah kiba kham bha ban ïa kaba me long .
translation.en: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel , and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring , like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab , and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father s house , which were better than thyself :
And Jesus answered them , saying ,  The hour is come , that the Son of man should be glorified .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ka kynta ka la poi mynta ïa U Khun U Briew ban ïohpdiang ïa ka burom kaba khraw .
Kiei Kiei Ki jingkylla ?
translation.en: What were the questions ?
Praise him with the timbrel and dance : praise him with stringed instruments and organs .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u da ki ksing bad ka jingshad . To ïaroh ïa u da ki duitara bad ki tangmuri .
U ong ïa u Geser u shakri jong u ban sien bad khot ïa kata ka briew . Haba ka la wan ,
translation.en: And he said to Gehazi his servant , Call this Shunammite . And when he had called her , she stood before him .

translation.kha: Kumno u Abarim , u kpa tymmen jong phi u la longïing uba la pynsdien da U blei ? Ka la long namar ki Kam ki jong u , mynba u la aiti ïa u Isaak u khun lad u ha ka duwan .
translation.en: Was not Abraham our father justified by works , when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar ?

translation.kha: U Trai u la pyllait ïa ka bor ba-pura jong ka jingbitar jongno u ; u la pynmeh ka ting ha Seïon kaba la ïaryngkat duh ïa ka haduh khyndew .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath accomplished his fury  ; he hath poured out his fierce anger , and hath kindled a fire in Zion , and it hath devoured the foundations thereof .

translation.kha: U nonghikai ka Hukum u la wanlam bad u la pyrshang ban riam ïa U Jisu . Ko Nonghikai , u la kylli , Kaei nga dei ban leh ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?
translation.en: And , behold , a certain lawyer stood up , and tempted him , saying , Master , what shall I do to inherit eternal life ?

And let the king appoint officers in all the provinces of his kingdom , that they may gather together all the fair young virgins unto Shushan the palace , to the house of the women , unto the custody of Hege the king s chamberlain , keeper of the women  ; and let their things for purification be given them :
translation.kha: Phi lah ban thung ki rangbah synshar ha man ki probins    jong ka hima bad hukum ïa ki ban wallam ïa baroh kine ki samla kynthei ba-bhabriew sha ka ïing ki kynthei jong phi hangne ha Susa , ka nongbah jong ka hima . Buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingkhmih jong u Hegai , u ïunukh uba peit halor ki kynthei jong phi , bad ban ai ka jingsumar na ka bynta ka jingpynbha briew ïa ki .
Ki la jrop ïa ka ri Kanaan ; me la jop ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta . Me la ai ïa ki briew jong me ka bor ban leh ïa kaba ki sngewbha bad ki briew bad ki syiem ka Kainan .
translation.en: So the children went in and possessed the land , and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land , the Canaanites , and gavest them into their hands , with their kings , and the people of the land , that they might do with them as they would .
He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow : and the father of a fool hath no joy .
translation.kha: Ym don ei ei ïa u kpa hynrei ka jingsngewsih bad jingkthang haba u khun jong u leh ïa ki kam bieit .

Ha ki khyrdong ha man ki surok bah ki briew jong phah ki kyllon noh na ka jingtlot ; ki long kum ka shrong kaba la ngat ha ka shkor jong u nongbeh mrad . Ki la mad ïa ka bor jong ka jingbitar U Blei .
translation.en: Thy sons have fainted , they lie at the head of all the streets , as a wild bull in a net : they are full of the fury of the  Lord  , the rebuke of thy God .
Of the gold , the silver , and the brass , and the iron , there is no number . Arise therefore , and be doing , and the  Lord  be with thee .
translation.kha: Mynta sdang noh ïa ka kam , bad to U  Trai  un long ryngkat bad me .

translation.en: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising , or a bright spot , white , and somewhat reddish , and it be shewed to the priest  ;
translation.kha: bad lada hadien , ha kata ka jaka ba mih u tohjaw , ka don ka jingat kaba lieh ne ka dak kaba byrsaw-lieh , u dei ban leit pyn-i ha u lyngdoh .
khmih ba uno uno un ym snar kylliang ïa kambah sniew da naba sniew , hynrei ha ki par baroh to kut jingjam ïa-ban lehbha iwei ïa iwei pat nabar ïa ki briew baroh .
translation.en: See that none render evil for evil unto any man ; but ever follow that which is good , both among yourselves , and to all men .

translation.kha: Ngam shym kren shaphang jong phi baroh ; nga thop ïa kito Ibbah nga la jied . Hynrei ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka dien ban urlong shisha , kaba ong , ‘ U briew uba la ïabun lang ïa ka jingbat jong nga u phai pyrshah ïa nga .’
translation.en: I speak not of you all : I know whom I have chosen : but that the scripture may be fulfilled , He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me .

translation.kha: Hynrei bun kiba la iohsngew ïa ka khubor ki la bieit ; bad ka jingbun ki briew ka la roi sha kumba san hajar ngut .
translation.en: Howbeit many of them which heard the word believed  ; and the number of the men was about five thousand .

And the priest shall look on the plague , after that it is washed : and , behold , if the plague have not changed his colour , and the plague be not spread  ; it is unclean  ; thou shalt burn it in the fire  ; it is fret inward , whether it be bare within or without .
translation.kha: Hadien kata un khmih bha ïa ka , bad lada kata ka jingbthuh kam kylla rong , wat la kam pur , ka dang long hi ka bymkhuid ; dei ban thang noh ïa ka , kam pher la kata ka jingbthuh ka long na shapoh ne shalor .
ki mawkordor Karnelian , bad Kawei pat ki mawlynnai ban bthuh ha ka ephod jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad ha ka jingdeng shadem jong u .
translation.en: Onyx stones , and stones to be set in the ephod , and in the breastplate .
Jesus answered them ,  Have not I chosen you twelve , and one of you is a devil ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai ktien ,  Hato ngam shym la jied ïa phi baroh khat-ar ngut ? Pynban uwei na phi u long u ksuid !
To ïaroh ïa U Trai , ko Jerusalem ! To ïaroh ïa U Blei jong pha , ko Seïon !
translation.en: Praise the  Lord  , O Jerusalem  ; praise thy God , O Zion .
Thus saith the  Lord  , the Holy One of Israel , and his Maker , Ask me of things to come concerning my sons , and concerning the work of my hands command ye me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  , U Blei bakhuid ki Israel , uta uba saiñdur ïa ka lawei , u ong :  Phim don hok ban kylli ïa nga shaphang ki khun jong nga lane ban ïathuh ïa nga kaei ba nga dei ban leh !

translation.en: For this is the day of the Lord  God  of hosts , a day of vengeance , that he may avenge him of his adversaries : and the sword shall devour , and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood : for the Lord  God  of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka sngi jong U  Trai  Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh : ha kane ka sngi un pynhiarkput ; ha kane ka sngi un pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jong u . Ka waitlam jong u kan bam ïa ki haduh ban da kdang , bad dih ïa ka snam jong ki haduh ban da sngewhun . Ha kane ka sngi u Badonbor Baroh u kñia ïa kiba la shah pynmong ha ka phang bashatei , hajan ka Ïuphratis .
Ynda u syiem Solomon u la dep tei ïa ka ïing U Trai sad ïa ka ïingsyiem , nalor kiwei pat kiba u la khah Ban thew ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house , and all Solomon s desire which he was pleased to do ,

translation.kha: U Jisu u la peit basawdong ha ki synran jong u bad u la ong ïa ki , A katno ka long kaba eh ïa kiba riewspah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei !
translation.en: And Jesus looked round about , and saith unto his disciples ,  How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !

translation.kha: ka Aphek , ka Khorasin ,
translation.en: The king of Aphek , one  ; the king of Lasharon , one  ;

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sarong , ki bymkohnguh ïa ka aiñ jong me , ki la thiah ki thliem ban riam ïa nga .
translation.en: The proud have digged pits for me , which are not after thy law .

translation.kha: La otsher ïa na ïahap nga la don shi thliew ka rta . Nga long u Israel naduh ba la kha ïa la , na ka jaitniam Benjamin , u Kherub uba nylla . Ha ka buit kaba sumar ïa ka hukum ki Siew , nga la long u Pharisi , bad nga la long umbiah shitrhem katta katta haduh ba ar la pynshitom ïa ka balang .
translation.en: Circumcised the eighth day , of the stock of Israel , of the tribe of Benjamin , an Hebrew of the Hebrews ; as touching the law , a Pharisee ;

translation.kha: U Abram u ong , Nga la shimti ha khmat U Trai , U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh , u Nongthaw ïa ka bneng sad ïa ka khyndew , ba ngan ym bat ei ei ïa kaba daiñ ka jong me , wat ïa u sai juti ruh .
translation.en: And Abram said to the king of Sodom , I have lift up mine hand unto the  Lord  , the most high God , the possessor of heaven and earth ,
Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Phi ki paid Israel , phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa nga bad ïeng ïaleh ïa nga . Hynrei mynta , to phai pat sha nga !
Shisien shisnem , la buh ïa kaei ka sngi ban pynkhuid bha nadong shadong .
translation.en: At least once a year , a day is set aside to do a major cleaning .
And Solomon went to Hamath–zobah , and prevailed against it .
translation.kha: U la ïohknieh ïa ka jaka Hamath bad Sobah bad u kerkut ïa ka nongbah Palmyra ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And their father Israel said unto them , If it must be so now , do this  ; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels , and carry down the man a present , a little balm , and a little honey , spices , and myrrh , nuts , and almonds :
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha ki ,  Lada kumta te , to leit rah ïa ki jingmih kiba kynsai tam jong kane ka ri ha ki byrni jong phi kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa uta u lat : khyndiat ka jingiwbih , khyndiat ka ngap , ki musli musla , ka mirr , ki jait soh-ot , bad ki almond .

translation.en: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries : which is to them an evident token of perdition , but to you of salvation , and that of God .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ïa ki nongshun jong phi ; long borabor kiba shlur , bad kane hi kan pynshisha ha ki , ba kin shah rem bad ba phin jop , namar dei U Blei uba ai ïa phi ka jingjop .
pule ïa ka ha ki paid Jerusalem haba ki wan ban mane ïa U Trai U Blei jong ki ha sier ka jaka mane Blei .
translation.en: When all Israel is come to appear before the  Lord  thy God in the place which he shall choose , thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing .

translation.kha: Kumta lada ka hima jngai u Soitan ka don ki kynïan babha ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat , kumno ka neh ? “Phi nguh ba nga beh nong ïa ki ksuid namar ba u Shebuel u ai ha nga ka har ban leh kumta .
translation.en: If Satan also be divided against himself , how shall his kingdom stand ? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub .

translation.kha: To jlew da ka jingsngewsih , ko khun u briew ; kane ka waitlam ka dei na ka bynta ki briew jong nga bad na ka bynta ki nongïalam ki Israel barieh . Ïa ki yn pynïap sam bad kiba sah baroh na ki briew jongki nga . Tied ïa la ka shadem ha ka jingnoh mynsiem !
translation.en: Cry and howl , son of man : for it shall be upon my people , it shall be upon all the princes of Israel : terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people : smite therefore upon thy thigh .

translation.kha: To khmih bha ïa ki langbrot bad ïa ki masi jong phi katba phi da ,
translation.en: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks , and look well to thy herds .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Trai ha Seïon , ha Jerusalem , ka ïingshong jong u . To ïaroh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  out of Zion , which dwelleth at Jerusalem . Praise ye the  Lord .

translation.kha: Phi la pynkoit ïa nga bad ïa u Rangbah ki nongsah kpieng , bad phi la buh ïa im ha phatok ha ka ïing jongu u kapten jong ki nongap phira .
translation.en: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants , and put me in ward in the captain of the guard s house , both me and the chief baker :

translation.kha: Hangno u hap ? u Elisha u kylli . Ynda uta u briew u kdew ha u ïa kata ka jaka , bad u Elisha u daiñ ïa uwei u dieng , u pashat ïa u ha ka um , malu u pynïapher ïa u khlieh sdien .
translation.en: And the man of God said , Where fell it ? And he shewed him the place . And he cut down a stick , and cast it in thither  ; and the iron did swim .

translation.kha: Pha ko Jerusalem , pha kaba shong shajrong eh na ki ri Them , kumne u maïan uba ïeng shajrong na ka madan . Hynrei ngan ïaleh pyrthuh ïa pha . Phah ong ba ym don ba lah ban tur ïaleh ïa pha ne banbeiñ pynpra ïa ki jingshukor jong pha .
translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , O inhabitant of the valley , and rock of the plain , saith the  Lord   ; which say , Who shall come down against us ? or who shall enter into our habitations ?

And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God : and this is that spirit of antichrist , whereof ye have heard that it should come  ; and even now already is it in the world .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba len ïa kane shaphang U Jisu , um don U Mynsiem na U Blei . U mynsiem ba u don , u long na u Nongshun jong U Khrist ; phi la ïohsngew ba un wan , bad mynta u la da don hangne ha ka pyrthei .
Ki Sikhri jong u Isaak ki la tih ïa ka pukri ha kata ka them bad ki lade ba ka don um .
translation.en: And Isaac s servants digged in the valley , and found there a well of springing water .

translation.kha: Bad ki briew jong kane ka jaitbynriew basniew naba Dang im , kiba shong ha ki dik kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , kin lngaid ban ïaw ban ïa kaba ki ïai im . Ma de , U TRAI’ , nga la kren .
translation.en: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family , which remain in all the places whither I have driven them , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand .
translation.kha: Da la ka kti hi nga thoh ïa kane :  Ki Jingai Khublei na u Paul .

U buh ïa ka durblei ha ka Templ , ka jaka ha kaba U Blei u la ong ha u Dabid bad ha u Solomon u khun jong u : Hangne ha Jerusalem , ha kane ka Templ , ka longsyiem ka jaka ïa kaba nga la jied na baher Kaei ka ri jong ki khat-ar jait ki Israel kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .
translation.en: And he set a carved image , the idol which he had made , in the house of God , of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son , In this house , and in Jerusalem , which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel , will I put my name for ever :

translation.kha: hynrei ngam ei kano katno ka jingtep , bad ïa ka thap jong me la beit shabar ba kan pyut . La tip ïa ka da ki met jong ki shipai ba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , la kynjoh ïa ka slem bad ki ha ka thliew mawsiang , bad la ïuh ïa ka .
translation.en: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch , and as the raiment of those that are slain , thrust through with a sword , that go down to the stones of the pit  ; as a carcase trodden under feet .

translation.kha: Me iohi ïa nga myntor , hynrei im ïew shuh lada me peit ïa nga , nga la jah noh !
translation.en: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more : thine eyes are upon me , and I am not .
And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning , saying , What city is like unto this great city !
translation.kha: bad ki la lynñiar jam haba ki la ïohi ïa ka tdem na ki thylliej dieng kiba la bam duh ïa ka :  Ym pat ju don kawei pat ka nongbah kum kane ka nongbah kaba khraw !
Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka jong , Uno eit uba ngat ha u un ym ngab ha ka jingsngewshngain .
translation.en: For the scripture saith , Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed .

translation.kha: Uwei u samla uba kylleng u Ïutikhos u la shongduh ha ka jingkhangïit , bad katba u Paul u dang kren , u Ïutikhos u la shoh samthiah jur , kat haduh ba u la ïohthiah lyngngai bad u la hap na ka babe kaba lai sha madan . Haba ki la rah ïa u , u la ïap .
translation.en: And there sat in a window a certain young man named Eutychus , being fallen into a deep sleep : and as Paul was long preaching , he sunk down with sleep , and fell down from the third loft , and was taken up dead .

translation.kha: Ngi la leh pop kumba ki kpa thymmei jong ngi ki la leh ; ngi la long bymman bad sniew .
translation.en: We have sinned with our fathers , we have committed iniquity , we have done wickedly .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki baroh , Ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong ar ki long iba kiba ïohsngew ïa ka ktien U Blei malade bakha kohnguh ïa ka .
translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God , and do it .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u wan hiar ha u lyoh bad u la kren ïa u . U la shim khyndiat ka bor mynsiem katba u la ai ha u Mesha mala u ai ïa ka ha kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongaikam . Hobah kata ka bor mynsiem ka la wei shongduh ha ki , ki sdang ban pyrta jam kumno ki nongïohipaw , hynrei tyngka shipor .
translation.en: And the  Lord  came down in a cloud , and spake unto him , and took of the spirit that was upon him , and gave it unto the seventy elders : and it came to pass , that , when the spirit rested upon them , they prophesied , and did not cease .
For all the riches which God hath taken from our father , that is ours , and our children s : now then , whatsoever God hath said unto thee , do .
translation.kha: Ka spah baroh kaba U Blei u la shim noh na i pa jong ngi ka dei ka jong ngi bad jong ki khun jong ngi . To leh katba U Blei u la bthah ïa phi .
