U Joshua u la lumlang ïa ki jait Israel baroh ha Shekhem . U la khot ïa ki tymmen ki san , ki nongïalam , ki nongbishar , bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam lad ki Israel , malu ki la ïajan shai ka jingdon jingkad U Blei .
translation.en: And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem , and called for the elders of Israel , and for their heads , and for their judges , and for their officers  ; and they presented themselves before God .
Forsake her not , and she shall preserve thee : love her , and she shall keep thee .
translation.kha: Wat iehnoh ïa ka jingstad , bad kan ïada ïa phi ; ieit ïa ka , te kan sumar bha ïa phi .
Kumta U Trai u bitar lep ïa ki Israel , bad u shah ïa ki Philistia bad ki Ammon ban jop ïa ki .
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines , and into the hands of the children of Ammon .
And I gave Gilead unto Machir .
translation.kha: Nga ai ïa ka Gilead ha ki Makhir kiba na ka jait Manasseh .
Kumta to kiar napoh na ki jingmlien bahkhlieh baroh bad na ki jinglong bymman baroh . To pyndum ha U Blei bad pyndeng ïa ka ktien kaba u la thung ha ki dohnud jong phi , kaban lah ban pynim ïa phi .
translation.en: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness , and receive with meekness the engrafted word , which is able to save your souls .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , To rwai da ka jingkmen , ko ki paid ka Jesreel ! Nga wan ban shong ban sah hapdeng jyllang phi !
translation.en: Sing and rejoice , O daughter of Zion : for , lo , I come , and I will dwell in the midst of thee , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ko ki brup jong nga , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Balak u syiem ka Moab u la thmu ban lai ïa phi bad kumno u Baalah u ïakhun jongu u Beor u la jubab ïa u . To kynmaw ïa kiei kiei kiba la jia ha lynti na ka jaka shongsah ngon ha Akasia shuh Gilgal . To kynmaw ïa Kino kiei kiei bad phin shem ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ban pyllait im ïa phi .
translation.en: O my people , remember now what Balak king of Moab consulted , and what Balaam the son of Beor answered him from Shittim unto Gilgal  ; that ye may know the righteousness of the  Lord .
As for that night , let darkness seize upon it  ; let it not be joined unto the days of the year , let it not come into the number of the months .
translation.kha: Tap noh ïa kata ka miet na ka snem , bad wat ai ba yn ñiew biang ïa ka ;
Uno uno u Lebi uba don ka jingkwah , u lah ban wan na kano kano ka shnong ha Israel sha kata ka jaka mane Blei’
translation.en: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel , where he sojourned , and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the  Lord  shall choose  ;
She openeth her mouth with wisdom  ; and in her tongue is the law of kindness .
translation.kha: Ka kren da ka jingstad kaba jai jai .
Don mo hangne uba dang shu dpei ïatehktien ? Lada don , ai un leit phai sha la ïeng , ïoh ba u ïap ha madan thma , bad ba uwei pat un shongkurim ïa ka .’
translation.en: And what man is there that hath betrothed a wife , and hath not taken her ? let him go and return unto his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man take her .
And he said unto the disciples ,  The days will come , when ye shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man , and ye shall not see it .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki synran ,  Ka por kan poi ha kaba phin kwah ban ïohi ïa kawei na ki sngi jong U Khun U Briew , hynrei phin ym ïohi ïa ka .
Naba ïa baroh kiei kiei la shrong da u , bad baroh kiei Kiei ki longïng lyngba jongngi u bad na ka bynta jong u . Ha U Balei , to long ka prum jyrngam ! Amen .
translation.en: For of him , and through him , and to him , are all things : to whom be glory for ever . Amen .

translation.kha: Hynrei me leh shitrhem bad peit shin ïa ngi da ka jingbitar .
translation.en: Why doth thine heart carry thee away ? and what do thy eyes wink at ,

translation.kha: U ong ruh , Phah jingsarong ïa ka lama U Trai ! U Tlai un ïai ïalap ïa ki Emek junom !
translation.en: For he said , Because the  Lord  hath sworn that the  Lord  will have war with Amalek from generation to generation .
Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us  ; for thou hast done right , but we have done wickedly :
translation.kha: Me leh ïa kaba dei ban pynshitom ïa ngi ; Me long uba ïaineh , wat la ngi la leh pop .

translation.en: I reckoned till morning , that , as a lion , so will he break all my bones : from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me .
translation.kha: Baroh shi miet nga kyang bad ka jingpang , la kumba u sing u pynkheiñ ïa ki shyieng jong nga . Nga pyrkhat ba U Blei u la pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga .
Kito kiba khunlung ïa ki jinglong ba kynja doh , kim da ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
translation.en: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God .
Thus saith the  Lord   ; If ye can break my covenant of the day , and my covenant of the night , and that there should not be day and night in their season  ;
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ka jutang ïa ka sngi bad ka miet , khnang ba kin wan mih ha la ki por kiba biang ; bad ïa ka jutang yn ym lah ban pynkheiñ .
Phira shu ïa-pynthait ïa lade bad pajut ïa kine ki briew . Kane ka khia than eh ba pher kun tyngkan marwei hi .
translation.en: Thou wilt surely wear away , both thou , and this people that is with thee : for this thing is too heavy for thee  ; thou art not able to perform it thyself alone .

translation.kha: Yn ym Thep ïa ki metïap jong ki , hynrei kine pyut hangta bad kmen iwtung ; bad ki liewlep kin mata da ka sner .
translation.en: Their slain also shall be cast out , and their stink shall come up out of their carcases , and the mountains shall be melted with their blood .

translation.kha: (Nga pyndonkam ka katei kaba ïakren man ka sner namar ka jingtlot jong ka jingim tylli jong phi! .) Mynshuwa phi la pyndum ïa put nadong shadong kum ki mraw ka jingbymkhuid bad ka jingbymdon na ka bynta ki jingshitom bymman . Ha khih ka rukom mynta phi dei ban pyndem ïa lade nadong shadong kum ki mraw jong ka hok na ka bynta ki jingthmu bakhuid .
translation.en: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh : for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity ; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness .

translation.kha: U Syiem un ïajubab , ‘ Nga ong ha phi , ba man ba phi leh ïa kane na ka bynta uno ine uba rit tam na kine ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong nga , phi la leh ïa kane na ka bynta jong nga !’
translation.en: And the King shall answer and say unto them , Verily I say unto you , Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren , ye have done it unto me .
And this I do for the gospel s sake , that I might be partaker thereof with you .
translation.kha: Ïa kane baroh nga leh na ka bynta ka gospel , khnang ba ngan ïoh bynta ha ki jingkyrkhu jong ka .

translation.en: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens , that he might fill all things . )
translation.kha: Kumta uta uba hiar shapoh u long uta ujuh uba leit kiew shaneng , shajrong bad sha lyndet ki bneng , ban pyndap ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei da ka jingdon ryngkat jong u .
Kine ki longïing ki khun ki kiew na u Shem , kiba shong ha ki ri kiba phira bapynjot , nabar ha la ka jait ka jait kaba krong ïa la ka jongngi ka jong ka ktien .
translation.en: These are the sons of Shem , after their families , after their tongues , in their lands , after their nations .

translation.kha: Ka Reuma , ka tngen kylla jong u Nahor , ka la kha ïa u Tebah , u Gaham , u Tahash , bad u Maakah .
translation.en: And his concubine , whose name was Reumah , she bare also Tebah , and Gaham , and Thahash , and Maachah .

translation.kha: U Jehoïada u lyngdoh , u pynlong ïa u syiad Joash dara ïa ki paidbah ban rung sha ka jingïohthiah jutang malade U Trai ba kin long ki brisoh jong U tharai ; u pynlong ruh ïa ka jingïateh jutang hapdeng u symboh bad ki paidbah .
translation.en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the  Lord  and the king and the people , that they should be the  Lord s  people  ; between the king also and the people .

translation.kha: Haba ki rangïapom ki leit bang shahïap ïing u Mikah bad shim ïa ki tyrha bakyntang , u lyngdoh u kylliang ïa ki , Phi ïaleh aïu ?
translation.en: And these went into Micah s house , and fetched the carved image , the ephod , and the teraphim , and the molten image . Then said the priest unto them , What do ye ?

translation.kha: Hato ka dat ïa ngi pun bur ïa ka kynsha jong phi bad ban ym kohnguh ïa U Bela jong moi da kaba jingjahburom ïa ki kynthei nongwei ?
translation.en: Shall we then hearken unto you to do all this great evil , to transgress against our God in marrying strange wives ?

translation.kha: Kaei kaba ki khun kynthei u Selophehad ki kyrpad ka long kaba de ; ai byndi lem na ka jingong jingem jong ki kur ki jait u kpa jong ki . Ai ba ka jingïohkynti jong u tud hiarpateng ha ki .
translation.en: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right : thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father s brethren  ; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them .

And Festus said , King Agrippa , and all men which are here present with us , ye see this man , about whom all the multitude of the Jews have dealt with me , both at Jerusalem , and also here , crying that he ought not to live any longer .
translation.kha: U Phestos u la ong ,  Ko syiem Agrippa bad baroh kiba don hangne bad ngi : Phi ïohi ïa une u briew ïa uba ki Jiw baroh , kiba hangne bad ha Jerusalem , ki la wallam ki jingujor sha nga . Ki pyrta ba um dei shuh ban im .
Eliada nga la pah ïa me sha ki jaitbynriew bakhraw kiba kren ïa ki ktien kiba eh kiba mem sngewthuh , kin khashor ïa me .
translation.en: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language , whose words thou canst not understand . Surely , had I sent thee to them , they would have hearkened unto thee .

translation.kha: ym don mano mano ban thied ïa ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawkordor , bad ki paila jong ki ; ki mar linen , ka jaiñ sawbthuh , ka jaiñ rusom , bad ka jaiñ basaw hain hain ; ïa baroh ki jait dieng bakynsai bad baroh ki jait jingthaw ba la shna na ka bniat hati bad na ka dieng baremdor , na ka rnong , ka nar , bad u maw marbl ;

U Trai Nongsynshar u ino , Ka nongbah ha Israel ka phan noh shihajar ngut ki shipai , hynrei Tang shispah ngut ki wan phai ; kawei pateng ka nongbah ka phah shispah ngut , hynrei tang shiphew ngut ki ïan phai pat .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred , and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten , to the house of Israel .

translation.kha: U la leit biang sha ka iaka ieh ha ka prie khyllai baje , bad u la ïohi katto katne ngut ki rangïapom kiba ïa-ïeng hangta khlem kam ,
translation.en: And he went out about the third hour , and saw others standing idle in the marketplace ,

And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes , and be unclean until the even : and it shall be unto the children of Israel , and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them , for a statute for ever .
translation.kha: Uta uba khat ïa u dpei u dei ban da sait ïa la ki jaiñ , hynrei u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet . Kane ka rukom pynïaid ryntih ka long kaba dei ha ki por ki ban wan baroh na ka bynta ki Israel bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong ki .
Dei kiba im kiba ïaroh ïa me , kumba nga ïaroh ïa me mynta . Ki kpa ki ïathuh ïa la ki khun katno me long kaba ïaineh .
translation.en: The living , the living , he shall praise thee , as I do this day : the father to the children shall make known thy truth .

translation.kha: To kiar noh na ki jingïakren ba-thala bad ba-bieit , tang ban ïalam ïa ki briew kham jngai na U Blei .
translation.en: But shun profane and vain babblings : for they will increase unto more ungodliness .

And he was driven from the sons of men  ; and his heart was made like the beasts , and his dwelling was with the wild asses : they fed him with grass like oxen , and his body was wet with the dew of heaven  ; till he knew that the most high God ruled in the kingdom of men , and that he appointeth over it whomsoever he will .
translation.kha: La beh noh ïa u na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew , bad ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong u ka la long kum u mrad . U la shong la sah bad ki kada khlaw , u la bam phlang kum u masi dab bad u la thiah ha ka jaka bym don jingkah khlem kano kano ka ban ïada ïa u na ka umjer . Ha kaba khatduh u la pdiang ba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u synshar ïa baroh ki hima ki briew bad u lah ban ai ïa ki ha uno uno uba u jied .
Ki shynna ruh sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka ksiar , bad ki pynïasoh ïa kita ki jingkah ar tylli da kita ki jingpyndait ba kin long tang kawei .
translation.en: And he made fifty taches of gold , and coupled the curtains one unto another with the taches : so it became one tabernacle .
Be ye strong therefore , and let not your hands be weak : for your work shall be rewarded .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi dei ban long kiba khlaiñ bad phim dei ban noh mynsiem . Ka kam kaba phi leh yn sa ai bainong .
ka jingieit kur leh khlem akor lynti wad ïa la ka jingmyntoi lane khapnap ; ka jingieit kam ju buh jingkynmaw ïa ki jinglah ;
translation.en: Doth not behave itself unseemly , seeketh not her own , is not easily provoked , thinketh no evil ;
Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels , and have not charity , I am become as sounding brass , or a tinkling cymbal .
translation.kha: Nga lah ban kren ha ki ktien jong ki briew bad wat ha ka jong ki angel ruh , hynrei lada ngam don ka jingieit , ka jingkren jong nga ka long kum ka wiang rnong ba sawa ne kum ka shakuriaw bariew shaw shaw .

translation.en: And as they sat and did eat , Jesus said ,  Verily I say unto you , One of you which eateth with me shall betray me .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang don ha ka miej ban ïabam , U Jisu u la ong ,  Nga ong ïa phi , ba uwei na phi un shetkylla ïa nga — uta uba dang ïabam bad nga .

Wat lyngngoh haba phi ioh ba ka sorkar ka banbeiñ ïa kiba duk bad kam ai ha ki ïa ka jinglehbeiñ bad ïa ki khoh jong ki . Ïa uwei pa uwei u rangbah synshar la ïada da isangsot Un uba kham phalor bad ïa baroh ar la ïadait da ki rangbah synshar kaba kham halor .
translation.en: If thou seest the oppression of the poor , and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province , marvel not at the matter : for he that is higher than the highest regardeth  ; and there be higher than they .

translation.kha: Ong ïa u Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron uba long lyngdoh ban weng noh ïa ki khiew buh ding kiba da ka rnong na kiba sah jongno ki brai kiba la shah thang bad ban bret ïa u rnga dong na wir ki khiew shaei shaei , namar kita ki khiew buh ryndang ki Long kiba khuid .
translation.en: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest , that he take up the censers out of the burning , and scatter thou the fire yonder  ; for they are hallowed .

translation.kha: Ki buh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kata ka kali , lem bad ïa kata ka synduk ha kaba la thep ïa ki dur khynnah bad ki dur u sting kiba da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And they laid the ark of the  Lord  upon the cart , and the coffer with the mice of gold and the images of their emerods .

translation.kha: Kin jyllei katei haduh ba kin tap lin ïa ka khynñiuh baroh . Kin bam lut kheit ïa kata baroh kaba u phret um shngiam la pyndeng , malade wat ïa ki diengïap kiba dang sah .
translation.en: And they shall cover the face of the earth , that one cannot be able to see the earth : and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped , which remaineth unto you from the hail , and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field :

translation.kha: Naba U Mynsiem Bakhuid um pat shym la wan hiar hano hano ruh na ki ; la pynbaptis ïa ki tang ha ka kyrteng U Trai Jisu .
translation.en: ( For as yet he was fallen upon none of them : only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus . )

translation.kha: Kumta shisyndon u la phah ïa u nongap phira ryngkat bad ki hukum shun wallam ïa ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis . U nongap phira u la mihnoh , u leit sha ka byndi , dara khrai ïa ka khlieh lad u Ïano ;
translation.en: And immediately the king sent an executioner , and commanded his head to be brought : and he went and beheaded him in the prison ,
But when it pleased God , who separated me from my mother s womb , and called me by his grace ,
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei ha ka jingaiei jong u , u la jied ïa nga wat shuwa ban kha ïa nga , bad u la khot ïa nga ban shakri ïa u .
Sin lada U Trai U Bel jong phi u pynïar ïa ka ri jong phi , kumba u la ïathuh ha ki Kpa thnum jong phi , bad u ai ha Phin ïa kata ka ri baroh ïa kaba u la kular ,
translation.en: And if the  Lord  thy God enlarge thy coast , as he hath sworn unto thy fathers , and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers  ;
When wisdom entereth into thine heart , and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul  ;
translation.kha: Phin sa long uba stad , bad ka jingtip jong phi kan ai jingkmen ïa phi .
To long shlur ! Mynta phi ïohsngew ïa kyntur ki kyntien ba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren ha ka pa ba la nguh nongrim na ka bynta ban tei patiaw ïa ka Templ jongno ar .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Let your hands be strong , ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets , which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the  Lord  of hosts was laid , that the temple might be built .
The eye that mocketh at his father , and despiseth to obey his mother , the ravens of the valley shall pick it out , and the young eagles shall eat it .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba leh biria ïa la u kpa lane uba ñiewbeiñ ïa la ka kmie ha ka jinglong tymmen jong ka u dei ban shah bam ha ki pukni ne shah khlaw ki khmat ha ki tyngab khlaw .
Te u Petros bad uta uwei pat u synran ki la leit shiah ka jinghap .
translation.en: Peter therefore went forth , and that other disciple , and came to the sepulchre .
To the end he may stablish your hearts unblameable in holiness before God , even our Father , at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ with all his saints .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom un pynkhlaiñ ïa phi , bad phin long kiba janai bad kiba khuid ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei bad U Kpa jong ngi haba U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi u wan lem bad baroh kiba dei ki jong u .

Mynta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong : “Nga long u nongshun jong u syiem ka Ijipt . Ngan pynkyllaiñ ïa ki ksang ti jong u baroh ar tylli — kaba dang bakha bad kaba la khleiñ lypa — bad ka waitlam Kan hap na ka kti jong u .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and will break his arms , the strong , and that which was broken  ; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand .

translation.kha: Phin ym donkam ban khuslai ïa ka jingpynduh kaba wan kynsan , kum ka wan ha ki riewbymman kum ka erïong .
translation.en: Be not afraid of sudden fear , neither of the desolation of the wicked , when it cometh .
Thou hypocrite , first cast out the beam out of thine own eye  ; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother s eye .
translation.kha: Phi u riewarsap ! Nyngkong eh weng noh ïa ka lyngkhot dieng na la ka khmat jong phi hi , bad nangta phin lah ban ïohi shai kdar ban khlaw ïa u thiat na ka khmat u para jong phi .
Ngi la sngew kumba la rai pynrem ïa moi ban ïaphah . Hynrei kane ka la jia haneng ba ngi dei banbeiñ shaniah , ym ha ngi hi , hynrei tang ha U Blei keiñ , uba pynmihpat ïa kiba ïap .
translation.en: But we had the sentence of death in ourselves , that we should not trust in ourselves , but in God which raiseth the dead :
Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool , which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda , having five porches .
translation.kha: Hajan ka Khyrdop Langbrot ha Jerusalem ka la don ka pungsum kaba don san tylli ki baranda ; ha ka ktien Hebru la khot ïa ka ,  ka Bethesda .

translation.en: Can a woman forget her sucking child , that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb ? yea , they may forget , yet will I not forget thee .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u jubab ,  Hato ka briew ka lah ban klet noh ïa la i khunlung bad ban ym ieit ïa i khun iba ka la kha ? Wat la ka kmie ka lah ban klet ïa la i khun , da lei lei ngan ym klet ïa phi .
wat ju kñia ïa uba kum uta u jingri ba phi ïoh na ki nongwei na ka bynta ka jingainguh bam . Khim ïa kita ki jingri la ñiew ba ki long kiba don ka jingduna , bad ym lah ban pdiang ïa ki .
translation.en: Neither from a stranger s hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these  ; because their corruption is in them , and blemishes be in them : they shall not be accepted for you .

translation.kha: Ka kynroh bad iar kiba tap ïa ka da ka jingpushara lieh ngin sngew ïa ka bor ka jingbitar jong nga . Nangta ngan ïathuh ïa phiah ba ka kynroh kam don shuh sad kumta ruh long kito kiba ñiad pushara lieh ïa ka —
translation.en: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall , and upon them that have daubed it with untempered mortar , and will say unto you , The wall is no more , neither they that daubed it  ;

translation.kha: U la pyllait im ïa kiwei , hynrei um lah ban pynim ïa lade ! Hato um dei une u syiem ka Israel ? Lada u la hiar noh myntri na ka diengphna , ngin ngeit ha u !
translation.en: He saved others  ; himself he cannot save . If he be the King of Israel , let him now come down from the cross , and we will believe him .

translation.kha: Kaba sah jong ka khohsiew u Abijah , Kaei kaba u ong bad Kiei kaba u leh , la thoh ha Ka Histori jongnga u Iddo u Nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Abijah , and his ways , and his sayings , are written in the story of the prophet Iddo .

translation.kha: Kumta u Pharaoh u pynkhraw ïa la ka nang thma bad ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u ruh .
translation.en: And he made ready his chariot , and took his people with him :

translation.kha: A Trai , une umbiah la ngeit ïa ka khublei kaba ngi la ïathuh ? Tam ba U Trai u pynpaw ïa ka bor jongnga u ?
translation.en: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled , which he spake , Lord , who hath believed our report ? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed ?

translation.kha: Kumta u Hasael u pyndih ïa baroh ki jait jingmih kiba kynsai tam jong ka Damaskos ha ki sawphew tylli ki ut bad u leit shad u Elisha . Haba u Hasael u la ïakynduh ïa u , u ong , U shakri jong phi u syiem Benhadad u la phah ïa nga ban kylli na phi la un dang koit ne em na ka jingpang jong u .
translation.en: So Hazael went to meet him , and took a present with him , even of every good thing of Damascus , forty camels  burden , and came and stood before him , and said , Thy son Ben–hadad king of Syria hath sent me to thee , saying , Shall I recover of this disease ?
And straightway they forsook their nets , and followed him .
translation.kha: Shisyndon ki la iehnoh ïa la ki jar bad ki la leit bad u .
U la bitar ruh ïa ki lai ngut ki paralok jong u Job . Kim smam don lynti ban jubab ïa u Job , bad ka pynpaw pynban main U Blei u la bakla .
translation.en: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled , because they had found no answer , and yet had condemned Job .

Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The fast of the fourth month , and the fast of the fifth , and the fast of the seventh , and the fast of the tenth , shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness , and cheerful feasts  ; therefore love the truth and peace .
translation.kha: Ki jingshah jingit kiba la long ha u bnai basaw , uba san , uba hynñiew , bad uba shiphew kin kylla long ki Jingkhawai Niam ka jingkmen bad ka jingshadkmen ïa ki paid Judah . Phi dei ban ieit ïa ka jingshisha bad ka jingsuk .
Kumta kata ka lyngkhuit naba dei ka jong ki Memukan , ryngkat bad ka Keramim kambah don hangta , ka la kylla long ka jingïohkynti jong u Abiram kum ka jaka thup briew .
translation.en: And the field , and the cave that is therein , were made sure unto Abraham for a possession of a buryingplace by the sons of Heth .

translation.kha: bad kumta nga la wan ban pyllait ïa ki na ki nong Ijipt bad ban ïalap noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt sha kata ka ri kaba ïarap bad kaba seisoh , kaweh tuid da ka bud bad ka ngap , ha kiba ki Kanaan , ki Hit , ki Lem , ki Peris , ki Hib bad ki Jebus ki shong mynnin .
translation.en: And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians , and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large , unto a land flowing with milk and honey  ; unto the place of the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites .

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ïalam noh ïa ki Jeraïah na ka Duriaw basan sha ka ri shyiap Shur . Lah sngi lyndum ki la ïathied lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap , hynrei kim khim lade um satia .
translation.en: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea , and they went out into the wilderness of Shur  ; and they went three days in the wilderness , and found no water .
And the word of the  Lord  came unto Jonah the second time , saying ,
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat U  Trai  u la kren ha u Jonah .
Ka bneng ka long ka jong U Trai hi , hynrei u ai ïa ka pyrthei ha u bynriew .
translation.en: The heaven , even the heavens , are the  Lord s  : but the earth hath he given to the children of men .

translation.kha: ïa ka duwan thang jingiwbih bad ki jingbah ïa ka ; ïa ka umphniang pynsep ; ïa ka jingbhabriew ; ïa ka pyrda na ka pyntwa ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ;
translation.en: And the incense altar , and his staves , and the anointing oil , and the sweet incense , and the hanging for the door at the entering in of the tabernacle ,

translation.kha: Hynrei Ngam shem la leh kumta , naba kata Kan jin da la wanlam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrngah jong nga sohpdung ki jaitbynriew kiba la lah ïohi ïa ar ba nga ïalam ïa ki Israel shabar na ka Ijipt .
translation.en: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand , and wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen , in whose sight I brought them forth .
And when he had spoken such words unto me , I set my face toward the ground , and I became dumb .
translation.kha: Haba u la kren ïa kane , nga la peit sha khyndew , khlem lait kren .

translation.en: As for these things which ye behold , the days will come , in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Kane baroh kaba phi ïohi — ka por kan poi ha kaba yn ym iehnoh hangne ïa uwei ruh u maw ha ka jaka ba u don ; ïa uwei uwei baroh yn bret sha tbian .

translation.en: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness , and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more .
translation.kha: Ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki bad ngan ym kynmaw shuh ïa ki jingleh bymdei jong ki .

translation.en: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the  Lord s  priests .
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ha u kumno ba u Saul u la pynïap ïa ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai .
Nga ainguh ïa U Blei jongngi nga , man la ka por ba por pyrkhat shaphang Jong phi .
translation.en: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you .

translation.kha: Te ma ngi , ko parabangeit , haba ïa moi la pynïakhlad na Phin shipor — ym ha ki jingpyrkhat jong ngi , shiah , hynrei tang ha ka met — kumno ba i'u la sngewkynjah khlem ma phi bad katno i la phyrngab jur don ïohi pat ïa phi !
translation.en: But we , brethren , being taken from you for a short time in presence , not in heart , endeavoured the more abundantly to see your face with great desire .

And he was sore athirst , and called on the  Lord  , and said , Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant : and now shall I die for thirst , and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised ?
translation.kha: Nangta , u Samson u la sliang um palat , kumta u kyrpad ïa U  Trai  bad u ong ,  Me la ai ha nga ïa kane ka jingjop kaba khraw ; hato ngan shu ïap mynta na ka jingsliang um bad ban hap ha ki kti jong kine ki Philistia bymngeit ?
U Jiw u la ong , Hato me ngeit tang Namarba ba la la ïathuh ïa me ba la la ïohi ïa me mynba me dang don ha trai u dieng thurmur ? Men sa ïew ïa kaei kiei kiba Kham khraw ban ïa kane !
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Because I said unto thee , I saw thee under the fig tree , believest thou ? thou shalt see greater things than these .
( For they could not endure that which was commanded , And if so much as a beast touch the mountain , it shall be stoned , or thrust through with a dart :
translation.kha: Namar kim lah ban shah ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la hukum kaba ong ,  Wat lada u mrad un ktah ïa uta u lum , yn lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  : he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: U leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , namar haduh ka sngi ka jingïap jong u , u bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop haduh ka sngi ka jingïap jong u .
Ki la long kum ki kulai ba la bsa bha , ki bym lah synshar ha ki jingkwah , aiwai pa uwei u da kwah brai ïa ka tnga jong u paramarjan jong u .
translation.en: They were as fed horses in the morning : every one neighed after his neighbour s wife .

translation.kha: To khie kitei sha uwei u briew ha ka nongbah , u la ong ïa ki , bad ïathuh ha u : ‘ U Nonghikai u ainong , ka por jong nga ka la poi ; ki synran jongu nga mala ma nga iing ramhah ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha iing jong me !’
translation.en: And he said ,  Go into the city to such a man , and say unto him , The Master saith , My time is at hand  ; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples .

translation.kha: Sukki u bariew uba ïa ki pop jong u , U Trai un ym nguh jingsngew shuh !
translation.en: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin .

translation.kha: U Abram u la shong la sah ha ka ri Naaran , bad u lwet u la shong la sah hapdeng ki nongbah ha ka them
translation.en: Abram dwelled in the land of Canaan , and Lot dwelled in the cities of the plain , and pitched his tent toward Sodom .

translation.kha: To ai ba ma pa , ki briew jong u , phin ïailong kiba ïaid ha U Trai U Blei jong ngi , ban khlong ïa ki shaiñ bad ki hukum jong u baroh , kumba phi leh ha kaei ka sngi .
translation.en: Let your heart therefore be perfect with the  Lord  our God , to walk in his statutes , and to keep his commandments , as at this day .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki ong ba me dei u Ïoannis u nongpynïaid , ki la jubab . kiaw patar ki ong ba me de u Elijah , katba kiwei pat ki ïai-ong ba me dei imat na ki nongïathuhlypa na mynnor ibha la mihpat .
translation.en: They answering said , John the Baptist  ; but some say , Elias  ; and others say , that one of the old prophets is risen again .

translation.kha: Ngim la kohnguh ïa baroh ki jingthoh ba u Joab u la ai ha ngi . Ma ngi hi ngim ju dih waiñ , lymne ki tnga lad ngi , ki khun shynrang jong ngi , lane ki khuid kyntiap jong ngi .
translation.en: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jehonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us , to drink no wine all our days , we , our wives , our sons , nor our daughters  ;

translation.kha: dalade ïa ka ïing ha kaweh na kine ki shnong la die da kiba na ka jait Lebi bad ym shym thied pat ïa ka , dei ban pynïap pat ïa ka ha ka Snem ka Jingpynim pat , namar ki ïing jong kito katba na ka jait Lebi kiba don ha kita ki shnong jong ki , ki dei ki jingïohkynti jong ki hapdeng ki dala Israel .
translation.en: And if a man purchase of the Levites , then the house that was sold , and the city of his possession , shall go out in the year of jubilee : for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel .

But if not , let fire come out from Abimelech , and devour the men of Shechem , and the house of Millo  ; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem , and from the house of Millo , and devour Abimelech .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kam long kumta , ai ba ka ding kan mihnoh na u Abimelekh bad kan bam duh ïa ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad ka Bethmillo . Ai ba ka ding kan mih na ki rangbah ka Shekhem bad ka Bethmillo bad kan thang duh ïa u Abimelekh .

translation.en: And they were haughty , and committed abomination before me : therefore I took them away as I saw good .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewsarong bad mutlop bad leh ïa kiei kiei kiba nga isih , kumta nga la pynjot ïa ki , kumba pha tip bha .

translation.en: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years , whereof the word of the  Lord  came to Jeremiah the prophet , that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong ka jingsynshar jong u , nga la pule bniah ïa ki kitab bakyntang bad pyrkhat shaphang ki hynñiewphew snem kiba ka Jerusalem kan don ha ki jingpra , kat kum kaei kaba U  Trai  u la lah ïathuh ha u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa .
Ki ïaid shaphrang khih ba kin da poi ha Bethmillo . Haba ki la poi hangta , ka shnong baroh kawei ka la sngewkmen , bad ki kynthei kiba hangta ki la pyrta , Hato kan ka dei shisha ka Namar ?
translation.en: So they two went until they came to Beth–lehem . And it came to pass , when they were come to Beth–lehem , that all the city was moved about them , and they said , Is this Naomi ?

translation.kha: U la thaw jingkynnoh ia ki shrieh ki briew U Adam bad ka Im , bad u la buh ia ki haka kper Elead , bad u la hukum ia ki , ba kin ioh kynhun Ieh kti , bun ban pynrit ia ka pyrthei baroh kamai kum ka kper Eden .
translation.en: He created the first human pair Adam and Eve , placed them in an earthly paradise called Eden , and instructed them to have children and extend their Paradise home earth wide .
But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel : and beside all this , to day is the third day since these things were done .
translation.kha: Bad ngi la kyrmen ba un dei ma u uta u ban sa wan ban pyllaitluid ïa ki Israel ! Nalor kata baroh , kane mynta ka dei ka sngi kaba lai naduh ba ka la jia .
Ki briew kin tei ïa ki ïing ki sem bad kin shong hi ha ki — yn ym pyndonkam ïa ki da kiwei pait . Kim thung ki dieng shitaiew bad leh sngewbha ha ka waiñ — yn ym dih ïa ka da kiwei pang .
translation.en: And they shall build houses , and inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , and eat the fruit of them .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynriew , ki ïalum ar shah , saw kilo ïa uwei uwei u briew . Ki nongñiah baroh jong ka kynhun ki wiang ïathuh shaphang kata ha u Moses ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread , two omers for one man : and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses .
And Joshua the son of Nun , the servant of Moses , one of his young men , answered and said , My lord Moses , forbid them .
translation.kha: Te u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , uba long u nongïarap jong u naduh ba u dang samla , u ong ,  Ko Kynrad , pynsangeh ïa ki !
Kheiñ leit noh sha ïeng bad ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh na ka bynta jongki me . Uta u briew u la leit lyngba ïa ka shnong , u da ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh na ka pyntwa jong u .
translation.en: Return to thine own house , and shew how great things God hath done unto thee .  And he went his way , and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him .

translation.kha: ‘ Une u briew u la sdang ban tei hynrei um lah ban pyndep ïa ka kam !’ kmen Ong .
translation.en: Saying , This man began to build , and was not able to finish .
And the Pharisees came to him , and asked him , Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife ? tempting him .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la wan ha u bad ki la pyrshang ban riam ïa u .  Ïathuh ïa ngi ,  ki la kylli ,  hato ka Hukum jong ngi ka shah ne em ïa u briew ban pyllait ïa ka tnga jong u ?
Ka Maakah , ka tnga u Makhir , ka kha ar ngut ki khun shynrang , Kiba ka ai kyrteng ïa ki u Peris bad u Sheresh . U Peresh u don ar ngut ki khun shyieng , u Ulam bad u Rakem ,
translation.en: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son , and she called his name Peresh  ; and the name of his brother was Sheresh  ; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba brup , u mynsiem bymman na U Blei! kynsan kynsan u ïoh tyllep ïa u Saul , bad u pynsmai ha ïing la kum kaba lamwir . U Dabid u dang tem ïa ka duitara , kumba u ju leh man ka sngi , dara u Saul u bakut ïa la u sum .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that the evil spirit from God came upon Saul , and he prophesied in the midst of the house : and David played with his hand , as at other times : and there was a javelin in Saul s hand .

translation.kha: Don na ki , kiba thoh bad ka tnga u kpa jong ki . Dong kiba pynbor ïa ki kyntiew ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki ha ka por poi bnai .
translation.en: In thee have they discovered their fathers  nakedness : in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution .

translation.kha: U Abraham bad ka shrah ki la thlim bha , bad ka Sarah ruh ka la palat ïa ka por ban ïalang ïoh khun .
translation.en: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age  ; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women .

translation.kha: Nga long U Blei uba khraw bad uba khuid , uba im shi junom . Nga shong ha ki jaka kiba jrong bad kiba khuid , bad nga im ruh bad ki briew kiba sngewrit bad kylla-kaba-mut , kumta ba ngan pynjot biang ïa ka jingsngewma bad ka jingkem jong ki .
translation.en: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity , whose name is Holy  ; I dwell in the high and holy place , with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit , to revive the spirit of the humble , and to revive the heart of the contrite ones .

translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba leh riewspah , hynrei Kim don ei ei . Kiwei ki ar duk , hynriewphew ki don ka spah bha .
translation.en: There is that maketh himself rich , yet hath nothing : there is that maketh himself poor , yet hath great riches .
And when he had called all the people unto him , he said unto them ,  Hearken unto me every one of you , and understand :
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la khot ïa u paidbah sha u sa shisien bad ong ha ki ,  To shahshkor ïa nga , baroh na phi , bad to long kiba shemphang .
Te U Jisu u la praw ïa ki , Wat ïathuh hano hano ruh shang jong de .
translation.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him .
And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations , or of the bread , remain unto the morning , then thou shalt burn the remainder with fire : it shall not be eaten , because it is holy .
translation.kha: Lada don kaba tam na ka doh ne na u kpu kiba ym shym la lah bam lut haduh mynstep , dei ban thang noh ïa ki . Ym dei ban bam ïa ka , naba ka long kaba kyntang .
Lada phi donhok ïa ki mraw , phiah lah ban thied na ki jaitbynriew kiba don Syndong jong phi .
translation.en: Both thy bondmen , and thy bondmaids , which thou shalt have , shall be of the heathen that are round about you  ; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids .

translation.kha: U rangbah synshar u la jubab , Kumno ngan lah ban sngewthait lymda ei mei mano ba batai ïa ka ha nga ? Bad u la khot sngewbha ïa u phyllaw ban wan kiew dara shong ha ka kali kulai ryngkat bad u .
translation.en: And he said , How can I , except some man should guide me ? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him .

And Moses and Aaron did so , as the  Lord  commanded  ; and he lifted up the rod , and smote the waters that were in the river , in the sight of Pharaoh , and in the sight of his servants  ; and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood .
translation.kha: Nangta U Moses bad u Aaron ki la leh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum . Ha khmat jong u Pharaoh bad ha khmat ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , u Aaron u la rah ïa la u diengduh bad u tied ïa ka sla um jong ka wah Nile , bad ka um baroh ka la kylla snam .

Ki dei ban long kiba bhabriew , kiba nep jingmut , kiba la ïoh jinghikai bha , kiba stet don on , bad kiba lait na ka jinganna , ba kumta kin lah ïa-ban Long kiba bit ïa-ban Shakri ha ka ïingbyndi jong u syiem . U Ashpenas u dei ban sakhi ïa ki ban pule bad ban thoh ïa ka ktien ki nong Babilonia .
translation.en: Children in whom was no blemish , but well favoured , and skilful in all wisdom , and cunning in knowledge , and understanding science , and such as had ability in them to stand in the king s palace , and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans .
Go and say unto David , Thus saith the  Lord  , I offer thee three things  ; choose thee one of them , that I may do it unto thee .
translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Gad , u nongïathuhlypa jong u Dabid ,  Khie leit bad ong ha u Dabid ba nga ai ha u lai tylli ki jingjied . Ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba u jied .  Ha ka step kaba bud , hadien ba u Dabid u la khie thiah ,
bad ki ïohi ba ka khamtam jong u ka tyngshaiñ . Kut u pahuh biang ïa kata ka jaiñtapkhmat ïathuh ba un da leit kynran pat bad U Trai .
translation.en: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses , that the skin of Moses  face shone : and Moses put the veil upon his face again , until he went in to speak with him .

translation.kha: Khmih ïa ki kti jong nga bad ki kjat jong nga , bun peit ba daiñ ma nga hi . Tba ïa nga , bad phin tip , ngab ka jngai kam don ka doh bad ki shyieng , kitab phi ïohi ba nga don .
translation.en: Behold my hands and my feet , that it is I myself : handle me , and see  ; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones , as ye see me have .
And when Moses saw that the people were naked  ; ( for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies : )
translation.kha: U Moses u ïohi ba u Aaron u la pyllait lan ïa kita ki paidbah kat haduh ba ki la pynkhlemrain ïa lade ha khmat ki nongshun jong ki .
Hynñiew ngam don satia ka hok ban jied mei u ban shong sha kamon jong nga bad shaw kadiang jong nga . dem U Blei u ban ai ïa kine ki jaka ha kito ïa kiba u la pynkhreh ïa ki .
translation.en: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give  ; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared .
Until I make thy foes thy footstool .
translation.kha: tad ynda nga buh ïa ki nongshun jong me kum ka jingïuhkjat hapoh ki kjat jong me .’
Long ka “mon jong me ha ka khyndew kumba ha bneng .”
translation.en: Let your will take place , as in heaven , also on earth .”

And I will turn your feasts into mourning , and all your songs into lamentation  ; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins , and baldness upon every head  ; and I will make it as the mourning of an only son , and the end thereof as a bitter day .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkylla ïa ki Jingkhawai Niam jong phi sha ki jingtep briew bad ngan pynkylla ïa ki jingrwai kmen jong phi sha ki jingïam sngewsih . Ngan pynlong ïa phi ba phin khi lyndum ïa la ka khlieh bad phin phong ka jaiñ khain , bad phin long kum ki kmie ki kpa kiba ïambriew na ka bynta u khun ba tang marwei jong ki . Kata ka sngi kan long kaba kthang haduh kaba kut .

translation.en: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus , and it shall consume the palaces of Ben–hadad .
translation.kha: Ngan pynpluh ïa ki kynroh jong ka Damaskos da ka ding bad yn thang khoit ïa ki ïingsyiem jong u syiem Benhadad . Ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .

Mynta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai nongshoh-nar , to ong : Nga long u nongshun jongngi u symboh ka jingtep . Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ki ksang ti jong u baroh ar tylli — kob dang bha bad kaba la kheiñ lypa — bad ka waitlam kan hap na ka kti jong u .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt , and will break his arms , the strong , and that which was broken  ; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand .
And also the name of the city shall be Hamonah . Thus shall they cleanse the land .
translation.kha: ( Ka don ka shnong hajan hangta ïa kaba la khot da ka kyrteng kynhun shipai . ) Bad kumta yn pynlong khuid biang ïa ka ri .
Doeg kane ka long kai kaba U Khrist hi da lade u la kular ban ai ha ngi — ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: And this is the promise that he hath promised us , even eternal life .
No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment : else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old , and the rent is made worse .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba pyndonkam ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai ban syrdep ïa ka sopti barim , namar ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai kan ran bad kan pynkad katto katne ïa ka jaiñ barim , kan pynlong wat ïa ka jingkad kaba kham heh .
Naba tang mar ïa ïohsngew ïa ka jingkhublei jong phar , i khunlung hapoh jong at i la kynthih da ka jingmeng .
translation.en: For , lo , as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears , the babe leaped in my womb for joy .

translation.kha: lane ka ïeng apthap ha Kyndong , teng teng ha ki surok bah , bad teng teng ha ka jaka ïew .
translation.en: Now is she without , now in the streets , and lieth in wait at every corner . )

translation.kha: Phi don ki khmih — thah Kino lah ban ïohi ? Phi don ki shkor — hato phim lah ban ïohsngew ?
translation.en: Having eyes , see ye not ? and having ears , hear ye not ? and do ye not remember ?

translation.kha: Ki hynñiew ki angel kiba la don ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki khlam ki la mihnoh na ka Templ , kiba la kup da ki jaiñ linen ba-thaba kiba khiah lem bad ki pynpoi ksiar ba la teh sawdong ki shadem jyllang ki .
translation.en: And the seven angels came out of the temple , having the seven plagues , clothed in pure and white linen , and having their breasts girded with golden girdles .

translation.kha: Me tip ïa ki hukum : ‘ Wat pynïap ; wat ïaklim ; wat tuh ; wat kynsha bym dem ïano ïano ; wat thok ; burom ïa u kper jong me bad ïa ka kmie jong me .’
translation.en: Thou knowest the commandments , Do not commit adultery , Do not kill , Do not steal , Do not bear false witness , Defraud not , Honour thy father and mother .

translation.kha: Mynta to shym ïa ka bainong jong phi malu khiar kitei sha ïing . Nga kwah ban ai ha une u briew uba la shah khot khatduh katjuh kumba nga la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Take that thine is , and go thy way : I will give unto this last , even as unto thee .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la lah ban pynjot ïa ki nongbah ha ki phang ka Gerar , namar ba ki briew hangta ki la khynñiuh ïa U Trai . Ka kynthup shipai ka la lute ïa barhem kito ki nongbah bad ki kurup shibun ka jinglute .
translation.en: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar  ; for the fear of the  Lord  came upon them : and they spoiled all the cities  ; for there was exceeding much spoil in them .

translation.kha: Nangta ki shipai Rom lem bad u rangbah Shipai jong ki bad ki nongap phira jong ki Jiw , ki la kem ïa U Jisu , ki la khum ïa u ,
translation.en: Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus , and bound him ,

translation.kha: Nangta u Amasaïah u phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Jehoash u syiem ka Israel , u kob ïa u pun ïaleh .
translation.en: Then Amaziah sent messengers to Jehoash , the son of Jehoahaz son of Jehu , king of Israel , saying , Come , let us look one another in the face .

And Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shechem , and called for the elders of Israel , and for their heads , and for their judges , and for their officers  ; and they presented themselves before God .
translation.kha: U Joshua u la lumlang ïa ki jait Israel baroh ha Shekhem . U la khot ïa ki tymmen ki san , ki nongïalam , ki nongbishar , bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki Israel , bad ki la ïawan sha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei .
U briew uba bha u sei ïa kaei Kiei kiba bha na ka jingkynshew jongno khie kiew kiba bakha ; u briew uba sniew u sei ïa kiei kiew kiba snem na ka jingkynshew jong kiei kiei kiba snieh .
translation.en: A good man out of the good treasure of the heart bringeth forth good things : and an evil man out of the evil treasure bringeth forth evil things .
When they which were about him saw what would follow , they said unto him , Lord , shall we smite with the sword ?
translation.kha: Haba ki synran kiba ïadon bad U Jisu ki la ïohi ïa kaei ka ban jia , ki la kylli ,  Hato ngin pyndonkam ïa ki waitlam jong ngi , ko Kynrad ?
Hynrei un ong baklang , ‘ Ngam ithuh nangto phi ïabun . Khie leit noh na nga , phi baroh ki briew kiba bymman !’
translation.en: But he shall say , I tell you , I know you not whence ye are  ; depart from me , all ye workers of iniquity .

translation.kha: Ki ïaid shaphrang haduh ba kin da poh ha Bethel . Haba ki la poi hangta , ka shnong baroh kawei ka la sngewkmen , bad ki kynthei kiba Hangne ki la pyrta , Hato kane ka dei shisha ka Naomi ?
translation.en: So they two went until they came to Beth–lehem . And it came to pass , when they were come to Beth–lehem , that all the city was moved about them , and they said , Is this Naomi ?

translation.kha: ( Kam ki gospel 24 :15 ) Na kata ka daw u Jisu Khrist u la ong ha u nongpop ba la kylla bamut uba la pynpoh ia ka jingngeit ha u : “Men long lem bad nga ha ka paradais .” —Loukas 23 :43 .
translation.en: ( Acts 24 :15 ) That is why Jesus Christ could tell a repentant evildoer who expressed faith in him : “You will be with me in Paradise .” —Luke 23 :43 .

translation.kha: Doeg nga la ïor ïa U Khunlangbrot ba u pynpait ïa ka jingpyndait kaba hynriewphew . Ka la ei ka jingkhynñiuh jumai naba jur , bad ka sngi ka la kylla rong ïong kumno ka jaiñ ïong kaba khain , malu u bnai u la kylla rong mata kum ka snam .
translation.en: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal , and , lo , there was a great earthquake  ; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair , and the moon became as blood  ;

translation.kha: bad da la ka shynriah ti kamon un synreit khyndai ïa ka , hynñiew sien hangta ha khmat U Trai .
translation.en: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Ki la wan ïathuh ha u jin : Ngi la leit sha kylleng ka pyrthei bad ngi la skhem ba ka pyrthei baroh’ kawei ka don hapdeng ka jingbymlah shun leh ei ei mala ha ka jingshah pyndem .
translation.en: And they answered the angel of the  Lord  that stood among the myrtle trees , and said , We have walked to and fro through the earth , and , behold , all the earth sitteth still , and is at rest .
This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him , even unto Artaxerxes the king  ; Thy servants the men on this side the river , and at such a time .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingthoh ha ka shithi :  Ha u patsha Artakserksis , na ki shakri jong , ki rangbah ka Ïuphratis Sepngi .

Ha ka jingim jong u ha Kanneh ka pyllait , U Jisu u la duwai bad khot kyrpad da kaba pyrsad jam malade ïam ha khmat U Blei , umbiah lah Ban pyllait ïa u na ka jingtep . Namar ba u long wahbah sngewthait bad aiti lut , U Blei u la shahshkor ïa u .
translation.en: Who in the days of his flesh , when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death , and was heard in that he feared  ;

translation.kha: manbha u Moses u wan thir na u Lumlang Shinab , u da rah ïa kita ki ar tylli ki sngewlyngngoh ha kiba la thoh ïa ki Shiphew Hukum , ka lamkhmat jong u ka tyngshaiñ namar ba u la ïakren bad U Trai ; hynrei um tip sahit ïa kata .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses  hand , when he came down from the mount , that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him .

translation.kha: Ïa ki nongbah jong ka nongbeh , ïa-ïohi wat ki rangbah bakhlaiñ tam , yn pynïap ha ka thma .
translation.en: Thy men shall fall by the sword , and thy mighty in the war .
For the  Lord  shall judge his people , and repent himself for his servants , when he seeth that their power is gone , and there is none shut up , or left .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pyllait im ïa la ki briew haba u ïohi ba kim donbor shuh . Un isynei ïa kito kiba shakri ïa u haba u ïohi ba kim lah leh ei ei shuh .

Te ki rangbah synshar ki la leit sha u syiem bad ki ong , Ïa une u briew daym ban pynïap . Da Kaba u kren kum , u pynlong ïa ki shipai ha ka nongbah ban duh ne ïa ka jingshlur , bad u leh kumjuh ïa wai pa uwei baroh ba dang sah ha ka nongbah . Um shym pyrshing ban ïarap ïa ki Baïap ; u kwah tang ban pynmong ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore the princes said unto the king , We beseech thee , let this man be put to death : for thus he weakeneth the hands of the men of war that remain in this city , and the hands of all the people , in speaking such words unto them : for this man seeketh not the welfare of this people , but the hurt .
( For those priests were made without an oath  ; but this with an oath by him that said unto him , The Lord sware and will not repent , Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec : )
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la long u lyngdoh da ka jingsmai haba U Blei u la ong ha u ,  U Trai u la pynlong ka jingsmai bakyntang bad un ym kylla shuh : ‘ Me , me long u lyngdoh junom .’
Buh ïa kine baroh ha ki kti u Ïaroh bad ha ki kti ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ong ba kin pynkyntang ïa ki kum ka jingkohnguh kyrpang sha nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt put all in the hands of Aaron , and in the hands of his sons  ; and shalt wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord .
Then thy elders and thy judges shall come forth , and they shall measure unto the cities which are round about him that is slain :
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam bad ki nongbishar jong phi ki dei ban leit thew ïa ka jingjngai hapdeng kata ka jaka ha kaba la lap ïa ka metïap bad ki shnong kiba marjan .

translation.en: And they answered and said unto him , Where , Lord ? And he said unto them ,  Wheresoever the body is , thither will the eagles be gathered together .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la kylli ïa u ,  Hangno , ko Trai ?  U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hangno hangno ha kaba don ka metïap , ki pukni kin ïalum hangta .

U Jisu u la shym ïa ki san tyllep ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha , u la khmied sha bneng , u la ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kita , u la kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha ki synrum ban sam ha u paidbah .
translation.en: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes , and looking up to heaven , he blessed them , and brake , and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude .

translation.kha: Ki long baroh kiba la ïap ha ka thma , badno ki jingtip jong ki , ki don ha ki bynta ba sha trai eh jong ka pyrthuh kiba ïap . Ki shipai jong ka baroh ki la kyllon ïalap ha ka thma mala ki jingtep jongu ki , ki por Syndong ïa u lum jingtep jong ka . Pynban Sihon ki la pyntriem ïa ka ri kiba im .
translation.en: Whose graves are set in the sides of the pit , and her company is round about her grave : all of them slain , fallen by the sword , which caused terror in the land of the living .

translation.kha: Bad na dang khynnah , Me thup sngwthuh ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , kiba eh ban ai ha me ïa ka jingstad kaba ïalam sha ka jingpynim da ka jingngeit ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures , which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: Ngi phah noh ïa ki jingri jong ki bad ki jinglute na ki shnong jong ki .
translation.en: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves , and the spoil of the cities which we took .

translation.kha: Ki dkhoh bun ki tyngab kin shimti ïa ka ri . U Trai un ym pynseisoh Shuah ïa ka , kumba ka la long ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it  ; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it : and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion , and the stones of emptiness .

Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee , and the sons shall eat their fathers  ; and I will execute judgments in thee , and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds .
translation.kha: Kaba mih nangta kan long ba ki kmie ki kpa ha Jerusalem kin bam ïa la ki khun , bad ki khun pat kin bam ïa la ki kmie ki kpa . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha bad ngan pynsakma kylleng ïa kino kino kiba dang im .

Katto katne ngut na ki un thung kum ki rangbah synshar ki ban peit ïa ki shihajar ngut ki rangbah bad katto katne ngut ki ban peiñ ïa ki basanphew ngut ki rangbah : ki ïakhun shynrang jongngi phi kin hap ban loit ïa ki lyngkha jyllang u , banbeiñ lam ïa ki jingmih jong u na ka khyndew , bad ban shna ïa ki tiar thma bad ki tiar kada ïapom jong u .
translation.en: And he will appoint him captains over thousands , and captains over fifties  ; and will set them to ear his ground , and to reap his harvest , and to make his instruments of war , and instruments of his chariots .

translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa nga , ko ïa-ieit jong nga , shano phin ïalam pynbamphlang ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong phi ? Hangno kin pynjahthait na ka jingshit ka shit sngi ? Balei nga donkam pun buid ïa ph hapdeng ki kynha langbrot jongno kiwei pat ki nongap langbrot ?
translation.en: I charge you , O ye daughters of Jerusalem , by the roes , and by the hinds of the field , that ye stir not up , nor awake my love , till he please .

And it shall come to pass , when many evils and troubles are befallen them , that this song shall testify against them as a witness  ; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed : for I know their imagination which they go about , even now , before I have brought them into the land which I sware .
translation.kha: bad shibun ki jingjynjar kiba ishyrkhei kin wan ngat ha ki . Hynrei ïa kane ka jingrwai yn dang ïai rwai , bad ka kan ïeng kum ka sakhi pyrshah ïa ki . Wat mynta hi , shuwa ba ngan ïalam ïa ki sha kata ka ri ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki , nga tip aïu ki pyrkhat .

To wat pynïasyriem ïa lade” bad ki rukom jong kane ka pyrthei , hynrei to ai ba U Blei un pynkylla dur ïa kambah shapoh jong phi da ka jingpynkylla ïa ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phiah baroh . Te Phin lah ngab tip ïa ka mon U Blei — kaei kabu bha bad kaweh pynsngewbha ïa u bad kaba janai .
translation.en: And be not conformed to this world : but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind , that ye may prove what is that good , and acceptable , and perfect , will of God .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei un Beh noh ïa ki riewthombor na ka ri , bad rat jingtyrkhong ïa ki nongkhap na ka kamon ïa ki jingtieng na ka khyndew .
translation.en: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth , and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it .
Then answered one of the lawyers , and said unto him , Master , thus saying thou reproachest us also .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki nonghikai ka Hukum u la ong ha u ,  Ko Nonghikai , haba me ong ïa kane , me ñiewbeiñ ïa ngi ruh !
Ka kham bha kaba sah ha tnum ïing ban ïa kaba sah plain bad ka tnga kaba bunktien .
translation.en: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop , than with a brawling woman in a wide house .
And your covenant with death shall be disannulled , and your agreement with hell shall not stand  ; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through , then ye shall be trodden down by it .
translation.kha: Ka jingïateh kular kaba phi la pynlong bad ka jingïap yn pynduh , bad ïa ka jingïakut jong phi bad ka pyrthei kiba ïap yn pyndam noh . Haba ka jingjot ka sar , phin shahjop noh .

translation.en: Tribulation and anguish , upon every soul of man that doeth evil , of the Jew first , and also of the Gentile ;
translation.kha: Yn don ka jingjynjar bad ka jingpang na ka bynta kito baroh kiba leh ïa kaei kaba sniew , na ka bynta ki Jiw nyngkong bad na ka bynta ki Jentil ruh .

translation.en: Then said he unto him , Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the  Lord  , behold , as soon as thou art departed from me , a lion shall slay thee . And as soon as he was departed from him , a lion found him , and slew him .
translation.kha: Hynrei u kyntait , bad kumta u ong ïa u ,  Namar ba phim shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , u sing un sa pynïap ïa phi tang mar shu ïakhlad bad nga .  Tang mar shu ïamih , u sing u wan bad pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died , and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim , in the mount of the Amalekites .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Pirathon ha ka ri ki Ephraim ha ka ri lum jong ki Amalek .
haba ki rieh ha la ki krem ne hab ki dem ban ap ha la ki balsam ?
translation.en: When they couch in their dens , and abide in the covert to lie in wait ?

translation.kha: U la hukum , bad ki thor ki ïawan da ki million sad ym la ñiew Shua ïa ki ;
translation.en: He spake , and the locusts came , and caterpillers , and that without number ,
Who is weak , and I am not weak ? who is offended , and I burn not ?
translation.kha: Haba uno uno u tlot , te nga ruh nga tlot ; haba uno uno u hap ha ka pop , la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingkthang mynsiem .

Ka por ka la dei na ka bynta ka Esther ban leit sha u syiem . Ka Esther — ka khun u Abihail bad ka bakha jong u Mordekai , ibha la ri ïa ka koum la ka khun ; ka Esther — ïa kaba la ïaroi da barabor kiba ïohi ïa ka . Haba ka jer jongu ka , ka la Nakon , ka la riam thik bania u hikai , uta u ïunukh kaba khmih ïa ka ïing ki kynthei , u la ai jingmut ïa ka ban rai .
translation.en: Now when the turn of Esther , the daughter of Abihail the uncle of Mordecai , who had taken her for his daughter , was come to go in unto the king , she required nothing but what Hegai the king s chamberlain , the keeper of the women , appointed . And Esther obtained favour in the sight of all them that looked upon her .

translation.kha: Ngam sngewthikna katta katta ïa phi ; nga sngewsarong na ka bynta jong phi ! Ha ki jingjynjar jong ngi baïar nga dang dap hi da ka jingsuhsieng ; nga shlei da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Great is my boldness of speech toward you , great is my glorying of you : I am filled with comfort , I am exceeding joyful in all our tribulation .

translation.kha: U la leit noh sa shisien bad u la duwai , da katba ong ïa kijuh ki ktien .
translation.en: And again he went away , and prayed , and spake the same words .

translation.kha: Ka kham bha bashong ha ka ri shyiap ngab ïa kaba bad ka tnga ka bunktien bad ïai thnum .
translation.en: It is better to dwell in the wilderness , than with a contentious and an angry woman .

translation.kha: Hadien u jumai , la ïan ka ding — hynriewphew U Trai um shym don ha ka ding . Bun hadien ka tyngkan , la wan ka ar kaba sawa jem jai jai .
translation.en: And after the earthquake a fire  ; but the  Lord  was not in the fire : and after the fire a still small voice .

translation.kha: Nangno U Trai u kren-ïa ha u Joshua u khum jong u neh , bad u noh ha u , hir uba sngewskhem bha Bad uba kut jingmut , namar me men ïalam ïa ki Israel shaei kata ka ri ba nga la kular ban ai ha ki , bad ngan don ryngkat bad me .
translation.en: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge , and said , Be strong and of a good courage : for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them : and I will be with thee .

translation.kha: Lai nguh na ki pakor u Job ki long u Elishaphat na ka nongbah Teman , u Bildad na ka ri Shuah , sad u Sophar na ka ri Naamah . Ynda ki la ïohsngew katno ba u Ishbi u shah jynjar , ki ïakut ban leit dara pyntngen ïa u .
translation.en: Now when Job s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him , they came every one from his own place  ; Eliphaz the Temanite , and Bildad the Shuhite , and Zophar the Naamathite : for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him .

translation.kha: badno kumta U Blei u phiah ïa ka bor ka jingkñia ban trei ha ki khnang ba kin jingkit ïa kaei ka bashispah .
translation.en: And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion , that they should believe a lie :

translation.kha: U Amasaïah u kylli ïa u nongïathuhlypa , Hynrei kumno pat shaphang ka rupa baroh kiba nga la dep sleit ïa ki ? U nongïathuhlypa u jubab , U Trai u lah ban ai pat sha me kham dara ban ïa kata !
translation.en: And Amaziah said to the man of God , But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel ? And the man of God answered , The  Lord  is able to give thee much more than this .
Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men ; and the weakness of God is stronger than men .
translation.kha: Naba kaei kaba i kum ka jingibieit U Blei ka long kaba kham stad ban ïa ka jingstad briew , bad kaei kaba i kumba ka long ka jingtlot U Blei ka long kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka bor briew .
Ngan pynshitom ïa kito kiba shongsuk ha Ieit , wohnia nga pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem — da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad ka jingpang .
translation.en: For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt , as I have punished Jerusalem , by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence :

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba haw ki kren ïa ka jingstad , hynrei ïa u thylliej naba kren sniew yn pynsangeh .
translation.en: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom : but the froward tongue shall be cut out .

translation.kha: Te balei ba me Wad bniah ïa baïar ki pop jong nga bad ïit lut ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingduna ba nga don ?
translation.en: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity , and searchest after my sin ?

translation.kha: Phi la ïohi ïa baroh kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la leh ha kine ki jaitbynriew barhem na ka bynta jong phi . U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ïaleh na ka bniat jong phi .
translation.en: And ye have seen all that the  Lord  your God hath done unto all these nations because of you  ; for the  Lord  your God is he that hath fought for you .
And to carry the silver and gold , which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel , whose habitation is in Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: Men rah bad me ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa na ka bynta ki jingainguh , ïa kiba ma nga bad ki nongai jingmut jong nga , ngi kwah ban ai sha U Blei ki Israel , uba ka Templ jong u ka don ha Jerusalem .
A katno pha longkmie kaba kmen ban ngeit ba ka khubor jong U Trai ha pha kan urlong shisha !
translation.en: And blessed is she that believed : for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord .

translation.kha: U de U Blei Uba shim ïa ka um na ka khñiot bad pynkylla ïa ka shiah ki jingkiew jrong u plung .
translation.en: For he maketh small the drops of water : they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof :

translation.kha: Hynrei lama ka long kumin , da kumno ki jingthaw Bakhuid kiba ong ba kane ka long kaei kaba dei ban jylla , ken ia lama shisha ?
translation.en: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled , that thus it must be ?
Wherefore , my beloved brethren , let every man be swift to hear , slow to speak , slow to wrath :
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kane , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga ! Uwei pa uwei u dei ban long uba kloi ban shahshkor , hynrei uba suki ban kren bad uba suki ban bitar .

Ki jingkhublei ruh ïa ka balang ka ïaseng ha ka ïing jong ki . Ki jingkhublei ïa u paralok ba-ieit jong nga u Epainetos , uba long u rangbah uba sneng ha ka ïapynbeit jong ka Asia ban ngeit ha U Khrist .
translation.en: Likewise greet the church that is in their house . Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus , who is the firstfruits of Asia unto Christ .
And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations , and disperse them among the countries  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki nong Ijipt kylleng ka pyrthei . Te kin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
Da ki ktien ka hukum nga pyntyrkhong ïa ka duriaw-bah .
translation.en: That saith to the deep , Be dry , and I will dry up thy rivers :

translation.kha: U Jakob u la nang ïaid noh , bad u la sher dara ha kawei pat ka liang lad u para Ade .
translation.en: And Israel journeyed , and spread his tent beyond the tower of Edar .
And I gave unto Isaac Jacob and Esau : and I gave unto Esau mount Seir , to possess it  ; but Jacob and his children went down into Egypt .
translation.kha: bad ha u Isaak nga la ai ïa u Jakob bad u Iso . Nga la ai ha u Iso ïa ka ri lum Edom kum ka jingïohkynti jong u , hynrei u Jakob , u kpa tymmen jong phi , bad ki khun ki kti jong u , ki leit hiar sha Ijipt .
Bad kumta U Trai hi u jong ba un weng nep ïa me . Ha shuwa ba khun kane ka sner men ïap namar me la ong ïa ki briew ban ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I will cast thee from off the face of the earth : this year thou shalt die , because thou hast taught rebellion against the  Lord .
Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments  ; and they shall walk with me in white : for they are worthy .
translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut na pha hangto ha Sardis kim shym la pyntngit ïa ki jaiñkup jong ki . Phan ïaid ryngkat bad nga , da kaba phong da ki jaiñkup balieh , namar pha long kaba dei hok ban leh kumta .
Ka Naei ka ong ha ka , Ruth , ïasoh mynta , tad haduh ba phin da ioh kumno Kanneh baroh kan sa long . U Boas un ym shongthait mynta ka sngi tad haduh ba un da pyndem ïa kane ka kam .
translation.en: Then said she , Sit still , my daughter , until thou know how the matter will fall : for the man will not be in rest , until he have finished the thing this day .

translation.kha: Nga la thung ïa me ban ïarep ïa u Sikhri jong nga u Israel , ki briew bakha nga la jia . Nga la ai ha me ka burom bakhraw , wat la meng shym la thoh ïa nga .
translation.en: For Jacob my servant s sake , and Israel mine elect , I have even called thee by thy name : I have surnamed thee , though thou hast not known me .

translation.kha: Mynsngi bad mynmiet u ju shang ha ki jaka tep briew bad ki jaka lum , da kaba lynñiar bad ot ïa lade da ki maw .
translation.en: And always , night and day , he was in the mountains , and in the tombs , crying , and cutting himself with stones .
And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you ; though the more abundantly I love you , the less I be loved .
translation.kha: Ngan sngewkmen ban pynlut baroh kaba nga don , bad ïa lade ruh , khnang ban ïoh ïarap ïa phi . Hato phin ieit duna ïa nga namar ba nga ieit palat ïa phi ?
Ka erlangthari naba la tip bha ba ïa u la kha kum u dkhot jong ka jait Jedaïah ; mala u Moses um shym kam ïa kane ka jait haba u la kren shaphang ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Judah  ; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood .

translation.kha: U nongïalam jong ki Jiw u la kylli ïa U Jisu , Ko Nonghikai Baanah , kaei nga dei ban leh ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?
translation.en: And a certain ruler asked him , saying , Good Master , what shall I do to inherit eternal life ?
Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Judah , and made obeisance to the king . Then the king hearkened unto them .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Jehoïada u la ïap , ki nongïalam jong ka Judah ki khroh ïa u syiem Joash ban shahshkor noh ïa ki .

translation.en: And the Egyptians shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I stretch forth mine hand upon Egypt , and bring out the children of Israel from among them .
translation.kha: Te ki nong Ijipt kin tip ba nga long U  Trai  , haba nga rah ïa la ka kti pyrshah ïa ki bad ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na ka ri jong ki .
Sin U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka Parosh : U bri uba matlah um lah ban ïalam ïa uwei pat ; lada u ni kumta , baroh ar nguh kmen hap hapoh khatlai .
translation.en: And he spake a parable unto them , Can the blind lead the blind ? shall they not both fall into the ditch ?
Get you up from among this congregation , that I may consume them as in a moment . And they fell upon their faces .
translation.kha: Ïeng sharud na kine ki briew , bad ngan pynjot thiaw ïa ki hangto hi .  Baroh ar ngut ki la dem khrup ha khyndew ,
Nongbah kiwei ki la pyneh ïa kaei kaba tam na ka spah jongngi ki ; hynrei ma ka , ha ka jingduk jong ka , ka la pynnoh ïa baroh kaba ka don — ka la ai ïa baroh kaba kyrshan ïa ka jingim lad ka .
translation.en: For all they did cast in of their abundance  ; but she of her want did cast in all that she had , even all her living .

translation.kha: Bun ki briew kin kyndit haba ktang ïohi ïa u ; la pynsniew briew ïa u haduh ba um i shuh kum u briew .
translation.en: As many were astonished at thee  ; his visage was so marred more than any man , and his form more than the sons of men :

translation.kha: U Saul u ong ha u Elimelekh , shukor , Ahimelekh ! Nga hangne , ko kynrad , u jubab .
translation.en: And Saul said , Hear now , thou son of Ahitub . And he answered , Here I am , my lord .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ba ïa ki ïing , ki lyngkha bad ki bri sohwaiñ yn sa thied biang ha kane ka ri .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land .

translation.kha: Ki khoh kim lah ban mian haba ym don um ; yn ym lah ban shem shabar ka jaka sngewskhem .
translation.en: Can the rush grow up without mire ? can the flag grow without water ?
And after this it came to pass , that David smote the Philistines , and subdued them : and David took Metheg–ammah out of the hand of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , u Syiem Dabid u la tur ïaleh biang ïa ki Philistia , u la jop ïa ki bad la pynkut noh ruh ïa ka jingsynshar jong ki halor ka ri .
U dud ïa ka jingleh bymdon jongu u Syiem Ahab bad kiwei pat ki syiem Israel , nongmareh u la shongkurim ïa kawei na ki khun kynthei jongnga u Ahab , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai ,
translation.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel , like as did the house of Ahab : for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife : and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka kynthei kaba la shitom na ka jingsngem bajur la khat-ar snem , ka la wan na shadien jong U ijuh bad ka la ktah ïa ka rmiang jong ka jaiñkup jong u .
translation.en: And , behold , a woman , which was diseased with an issue of blood twelve years , came behind him , and touched the hem of his garment :

translation.kha: Ki nongshoh-nar ki Israel ki kren sarong bad ki ong , ‘ Mynta kito ki lum ba-sngewtriem ki long ki jong ngi !’
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because the enemy hath said against you , Aha , even the ancient high places are ours in possession :

translation.kha: dara u phlait im ïa at na ki nongsuhjaiñ jong nga . A Trai , me ai ha de ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong nga bad me ïada ïa nga na ki riewthombor .
translation.en: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies : thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me : thou hast delivered me from the violent man .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Trai ! Ka long kaba bha ban rwai ïaroh ïa U Blei jong ngi ; ka long kaba sngewtriem bad kaba dei ban ïaroh ïa u .
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord  : for it is good to sing praises unto our God  ; for it is pleasant  ; and praise is comely .

translation.kha: Pynban , ngam kajuh ban shim saihon ïa ka por jong me , kumta nga kyrpad ïa me ban sngewbha ban shahshkor! ïa ka jingïathuh lyngkdong jong ngi .
translation.en: Notwithstanding , that I be not further tedious unto thee , I pray thee that thou wouldest hear us of thy clemency a few words .

translation.kha: Nga thikna ba me ha , namar me la tymmen bha dara me la don hangta mynba la thaw ïa ka pyrthei !
translation.en: Knowest thou it , because thou wast then born ? or because the number of thy days is great ?

translation.kha: ( Naba baroh ki traishnong jong ka Athens bad ki nongwei kiba shong basah hangamei ki sngewtynnat ban pynlut ïa ka por jong ki baroh ha kaba ïathuh bad sngap ïa Kaei kaei kaba thymmai tam . )
translation.en: ( For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else , but either to tell , or to hear some new thing . )
Sit thou silent , and get thee into darkness , O daughter of the Chaldeans : for thou shalt no more be called , The lady of kingdoms .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ka Babilon ,  To shong ha ka jingjar jar bad ha ka jingdum ; kin ym khot shuh ïa pha ka syiem jong ki jaitbynriew !

Ngam shym la kylliang sopti wat ha ka par miet , lymne mano mano na ki paralok jong nga , lymne ki shakri jongki nga , lymne ki nongap phira jongu nga . Bad ma me barben ngi bat ïa ki tiar ïaleh ha ka kti .
translation.en: So neither I , nor my brethren , nor my servants , nor the men of the guard which followed me , none of us put off our clothes , saving that every one put them off for washing .
For mine eyes have seen thy salvation ,
translation.kha: Da la ki jong ki khmat nga la ïohi ïa ka jingpynim jong me ,
U Jisu u la peiñ sawdong ha ki synran jngai u bad u la ïa-ong ïa ki , A katno ka long kaba eh ïa kiba riewspah don rung sha ka Hima U Blei !
translation.en: And Jesus looked round about , and saith unto his disciples ,  How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !

And I fell at his feet to worship him . And he said unto me , See thou do it not : I am thy fellowservant , and of thy brethren that have the testimony of Jesus : worship God : for the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy .
translation.kha: Nga la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u ban mane ïa u , hynrei u la ong ha nga ,  Wat leh kumne ! Nga long u para shakri bad me bad kita ki parabangeit jong me , kito baroh kiba bat ïa ka jingshisha kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw . To mane ïa U Blei !  Naba ka jingshisha kaba U Jisu u la pynpaw ka long kata kaba pyrsad mynsiem ïa ki nongïathuhlypa .
U Blei u long u sakhi jong por , ba nga ïathuh ïa ka jingshem , haba nga ong ba ka jingsngew bajylliew na ka bniat jong phi baroh , ka wanrah na ka dohnud U Khrismas Jisu hi .
translation.en: For God is my record , how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ .
When they heard this , they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , la pynbaptis ïa ki ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu .
to un pynlong ïa ngi kiba khlong ïa u ba ngin haka ban im borabor kumba u kwah ïa ngi baneh im , dara ban sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh ïa kiba u la ai ha ki kpa thom jong ngi .
translation.en: That he may incline our hearts unto him , to walk in all his ways , and to keep his commandments , and his statutes , and his judgments , which he commanded our fathers .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la thab kaweh ka pynkut ka da u ding akasia bad sa la shiah ruh ar thyllah ki mawlyngkniap kum kita kiba nyngkong , bad nga leit rieh ïa ki shalor uta u lum .
translation.en: And I made an ark of shittim wood , and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first , and went up into the mount , having the two tables in mine hand .

translation.kha: U Joab u bah pynkhlad ïa ki langbrot na ki blang bad u pynphai ïa ki khmat jongki ki sha pli Ibbah thohshuid bad kiba ïong na ka kynhun u Laban . Ha kane ka man u pynroi ïa la ka kynhun jingri bad u buh pynkhlad ïa ki na ka jong u Ladan .
