translation.en: And Jacob did separate the lambs , and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked , and all the brown in the flock of Laban  ; and he put his own flocks by themselves , and put them not unto Laban s cattle .

translation.kha: Lada U Bela u rai ban nym leh ei ei ruh , ym don uno uno wahbah lah shun wad dabi ïa u . Lada u buhrieh ïa ka khmat jongki u , ki Briew kin long kiba khlem ïoh jingïarap .
translation.en: When he giveth quietness , who then can make trouble ? and when he hideth his face , who then can behold him ? whether it be done against a nation , or against a man only :
Where is the wise ? where is the scribe ? where is the disputer of this world ? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world ?
translation.kha: hangno don kiba stad ? hangno don ki riewshemphang ? hangno don ki nongïatainia batbit jong kane ka pyrthei ? U Blei u la pyn-i ba ka jingstad jong kane ka pyrthei ka long ka jingibieit !

kamut ïathuh ïa ki ba ha ka por mynstep yn ïabam ïa ki sha khmat , Kawei ka jait hadien kawei pat . Ka jait kaba to jied kan wan sha khmat , shi kur shu kur . Ka kur kaba nga jied kan wan sha khmat , kiwei ka longïing hadien kawei pat . Ka longïing kaba nga la jied kan wan sha khat uwei hadien uwei pat .
translation.en: In the morning therefore ye shall be brought according to your tribes : and it shall be , that the tribe which the  Lord  taketh shall come according to the families thereof  ; and the family which the  Lord  shall take shall come by households  ; and the household which the  Lord  shall take shall come man by man .

translation.kha: Kan long kum haba u briew u phet ïan na u sing bad u ïakynduh ïa ka dngiem ! lane kum ibha u briew u wan sha la Ïing bad buh ïa la ka kti ha ka kynroh — tang ban shah puh ha u bseiñ !
translation.en: As if a man did flee from a lion , and a bear met him  ; or went into the house , and leaned his hand on the wall , and a serpent bit him .
Then the Jews sought him at the feast , and said , Where is he ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ïawad ïa u ha kata ka Jingkhawai Niam .  Hangno u don ?  ki la kylli .

U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Hato phim pat ju pyllun ïa kai ba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ? ‘ Ïa u maw ba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymdondor u la kylla long wahbah donkam tam na barabor . Ïa kane la leh da U Trai ; katno ka long kaba itynnat !’
translation.en: Jesus saith unto them ,  Did ye never read in the scriptures , The stone which the builders rejected , the same is become the head of the corner : this is the Lord s doing , and it is marvellous in our eyes ?
The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed , and that he should not die in the pit , nor that his bread should fail .
translation.kha: Kito kiba long ki koidi shen yn sa pyllaitluid ïa ki ; kin im ka jingim kaba jlan bad kin ïoh ïa ka jingbam kat kaba ki donkam .
Ki miaw , to jongu ïa la ki kynrad da ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingkhynñiuh ; bad leh ïa ka da ka angnud basngur , Rumah phi shakri ïa U Khrist .
translation.en: Servants , be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh , with fear and trembling , in singleness of your heart , as unto Christ ;

translation.kha: Hynrei la Bishar bad la pynmih ïa ngi da U Trai , khnang ba yn ym pynrem ïa ngi lem bad ka Pyrthei .
translation.en: But when we are judged , we are chastened of the Lord , that we should not be condemned with the world .
If I covered my transgressions as Adam , by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom :
translation.kha: Kiwei ki pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa la ki pop , hynrei ïa la ki jong ngam ju buhrieh .
Ki Briew ki kylli ïa nga , Balei ba me imat kumne ?
translation.en: And the people said unto me , Wilt thou not tell us what these things are to us , that thou doest so ?
And Laban said to Jacob , What hast thou done , that thou hast stolen away unawares to me , and carried away my daughters , as captives taken with the sword ?
translation.kha: U Laban u ong ïa u Jakob ,  Balei me shukor ïa nga bad ïalam noh ïa ki khun kynthei jong nga la kum ïa ki kynthei kiba shah kem ha ka thma ?

translation.en: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart  ; and they defile the man .
translation.kha: Hynrei kiei kiei kiba mihnoh shabar na ka shyntur ki wan na ka dohnud , bad kine ki long kiei kiei kiba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u briew kat kum ka jinglehniam .
Sa kawei pat ka khubor ka la wan ha nga na U Trai .
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa ki kynroh ka Jingrakhe ban khyllung , hadien ba ki khuid Israel ki la ïaid tawiar sawkyr-ang ïa ki , hynñiew sngi .
translation.en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down , after they were compassed about seven days .

translation.kha: ngat u Joseph u ong ïa la ki briew ban smai . Kular ïa per , u ong , ba ynda U Blei! u ïalam noh ïa phi sha kata ka ri , phin rah Ngan ïa ka met lad nga nangne .
translation.en: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Israel , saying , God will surely visit you , and ye shall carry up my bones from hence .
Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering : they shall also prepare a young bullock , and a ram out of the flock , without blemish .
translation.kha: Man ka sngi na ka bynta hynñiew sngi men ai u  langsohmoh , u masi kyrtong , bad u langbrot kum ki jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . Baroh ki dei ban long khlem kino kino ki jingduna .
Kito kiba bha ki ïaid na ka lynti kaba lait na kaba sniew ; te khmih Shan ba phi leit — ka lah ban pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi .
translation.en: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil : he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul .

translation.kha: Jied khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , uwei na khwai kawei ka jait ,
translation.en: Take you twelve men out of the people , out of every tribe a man ,

translation.kha: To wat ïakren khñium paralok hi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ba U Blei un ym bishar ïa phi . U Nongbishar u la jan , u la kloi ban wanpaw .
translation.en: Grudge not one against another , brethren , lest ye be condemned : behold , the judge standeth before the door .

translation.kha: Ka rwai ka ïuh ngon haduh khyndew , bad ka ong ha u Boas , Balei phi da pyrkhat ïa nga haduh katta katta ? Balei phira da lehsbun haduh katta katta ïa ka nongwei ?
translation.en: Then she fell on her face , and bowed herself to the ground , and said unto him , Why have I found grace in thine eyes , that thou shouldest take knowledge of me , seeing I am a stranger ?

translation.kha: Ka jingkhraw ki Israel kan her nala kum ka sim , badno yn ym don shiah ki khun ban kha na ki , yn ym don shuh ki kynthei ki ban armet , yn ym don jingpunkhun shuh .
translation.en: As for Ephraim , their glory shall fly away like a bird , from the birth , and from the womb , and from the conception .

translation.kha: Wat dih thiang ïa ka um , hynrei rim khyndiat ka waiñ ban ïarep ïa ka nierbah jongu me , naba me long uba pang khoh khah .
translation.en: Drink no longer water , but use a little wine for thy stomach s sake and thine often infirmities .
And there went great multitudes with him : and he turned , and said unto them ,
translation.kha: Shisien mynba ki paidbah babun ki la ïaleit lem bad U Jisu , u la phai sha ki bad u la ong ha ki ,

Na kane ka jingkerkut , ka jingkyrduh bam ha ka nongbah ka la long kaba jur Katta katta kat haduh ba Kawei ka khlieh kada ka shongdor arphew ki sbai rupa , bad arspah gram ka eit paro ka shongdor san sbai spoiñ .
translation.en: And there was a great famine in Samaria : and , behold , they besieged it , until an ass s head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver , and the fourth part of a cab of dove s dung for five pieces of silver .

And thou , Capernaum , which art exalted unto heaven , shalt be brought down to hell : for if the mighty works , which have been done in thee , had been done in Sodom , it would have remained until this day .
translation.kha: Bad ïa pha pat ko Kapernam ! Hato pha kwah ban kyntiew ïa lade sha bneng ? Ïa pha yn bret sha tbian sha dujok ! Lada ïa ki kambah ïa kiba la leh ha pha , la lah leh ha Sodom , kan jin da la sah haduh mynta !

Ki la kyntait ïa nga bad ki la ai jingkñia ha kiwei! ki blei , bad kumta ki la pynkhih ïa ka jingbitar jong nga da baroh kaba ki la kuna . Ka jingbitar lad nga ka la khie bakor , bad len ym pynjah kumto .
translation.en: Because they have forsaken me , and have burned incense unto other gods , that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands  ; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place , and shall not be quenched .
And when he had thus spoken , he dismissed the assembly .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la kren ïa kane , u la pynwai ïa ka jingïalang .
Ha ka sngi kaba saw , ki ïalumlang ha ka ih Berakah sad ïaroh ïa U Trai na ka bynta baroh kaba u la ai . dih na kata ka daw ba la khet ïa ka them , Ka Berakah .
translation.en: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah  ; for there they blessed the  Lord  : therefore the name of the same place was called , The valley of Berachah , unto this day .
And God heard their groaning , and God remembered his covenant with Abraham , with Isaac , and with Jacob .
translation.kha: Kata ka jingud jong ki ka kiew sha U Blei , uba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud jong ki bad kynmaw ïa la ka jutang bad u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob .

Kumta ki mihnoh na ka jaka shnong dara jongno ki Syria , ki leit phai sha Samaria bad ki la khot ïa ki Nongap phira ha ki khrup : Ngi la leit sha ka jaka shong Gera jong ki Syria mala ngim shym la ïohi ne ïohsngew ïano ïano ; ki kulai bad ki kada kiba dang shah teh , bad ki ïingjaiñ ki Long kumjuh kumba ki Syria ki la ieh ïa ki .
translation.en: So they came and called unto the porter of the city : and they told them , saying , We came to the camp of the Syrians , and , behold , there was no man there , neither voice of man , but horses tied , and asses tied , and the tents as they were .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab , Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U briew um lah ban im tang da u kpu .’
translation.en: And Jesus answered him , saying ,  It is written , That man shall not live by bread alone , but by every word of God .

translation.kha: Nangta ki briew jong U Blei kin tyngshaiñ kum ka sngi ha ka Hima jong U Kpa jong ki . To shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki sorkar !
translation.en: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father . Who hath ears to hear , let him hear .

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei jong phi u ïada ïa phi bad u ong , Nga shim noh ïa ka khuri kaba por la ai ha phi ha ka jingtah jrong nga . Phin ym hap ban ieh shuh ïa ka waiñ kaba pyntong ïa phi ban ïaid sneng sheng .
translation.en: Thus saith thy Lord the  Lord  , and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people , Behold , I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling , even the dregs of the cup of my fury  ; thou shalt no more drink it again :

translation.kha: Un pynjot ïa ki kut jong ki Moab bad ïa ki kynjoh bajrong jong ki bad pynkhap ïa ki shapoh khyndew .
translation.en: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down , lay low , and bring to the ground , even to the dust .

translation.kha: Don shibun kiei kiei ba I tap ban ong shaphang kaei ka bynta , hynrei ka long katba eh ban batai ïa phi , namar phi long kba suki katta katta ïa ka ban sngewthuh .
translation.en: Of whom we have many things to say , and hard to be uttered , seeing ye are dull of hearing .

translation.kha: Kumjuh ki la krong shapoh ka jingtep , ha Kaba ki la Iohi ïa u samla uba shong ha ka liang kum uba phong da ka jaiñkup balieh — sad ki la shemphang .
translation.en: And entering into the sepulchre , they saw a young man sitting on the right side , clothed in a long white garment  ; and they were affrighted .

translation.kha: Haba ki paid Israel ki la sngewkwah ïa ka jingrai jong u Simon , ki la dap da ka jingñiewburom Bakhraw ïa u , namar ki tip hangta ba U Blei u la ai ha u ka jingstad ban pynpait ïa ki jingïakajia ha ka hok .
translation.en: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged  ; and they feared the king : for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him , to do judgment .

translation.kha: Ki pynmong ïa ki dieng Kseh-Phir na u lum Hermon kum ki dien shna iing . Bad ïa ki dieng Kedar na Libni na ka bynda ki dieng sieh lama .
translation.en: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir : they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee .

For it was of the  Lord  to harden their hearts , that they should come against Israel in battle , that he might destroy them utterly , and that they might have no favour , but that he might destroy them , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ïa ki ban kut jingmut ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel , ba kumta kin shah pynrem sha ka jingpynjot thiaw bad ba baroh kin shah pynïap khlem ka jingisynei . Kane ka long kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

Nongthaw u bsuh ïa ki diengthang khlur ka duwan , u ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa u masi dab bad buh ba-halor ki diengthang . U ong , Pyndap saw tylli ki khiew da ka um bad tah ïa ka um halor ka jingïania bad ki ding ,
translation.en: And he put the wood in order , and cut the bullock in pieces , and laid him on the wood , and said , Fill four barrels with water , and pour it on the burnt sacrifice , and on the wood .

translation.kha: uba pynkylla ïa ki mawsiang shad ki pung-um , pynlang ïa ki synrang ba-eh sha ki umpohliew naba tuid .
translation.en: Which turned the rock into a standing water , the flint into a fountain of waters .
And out of the tribe of Dan , Eltekeh with her suburbs , Gibbethon with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Dan la ai ha ki saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Eltekeh , ka Gibbethon ,

translation.en: And he lift up his eyes and looked , and , lo , three men stood by him : and when he saw them , he ran to meet them from the tent door , and bowed himself toward the ground ,
translation.kha: Tang mar shu ïohi ïa ki , u mareh ban leit ïashem ïa ki . Da kaba u nguh ngon haduh khyndew , u ong ,

Ki maji ki la sngewshyrkhei bad ki la pyrta ban ïohi jingïarap , uwei pa uwei sha la u jong u blei . Naba , khnang ban pynduna ïa ka jingma , ki bret noh ïa ka jingsuh nabar lieng . Ha kata ka por , u Jonah u la hiar sha ka bynta bashapoh , u thiah ha trai ka lieng , u ïohthiah lyngngai .
translation.en: Then the mariners were afraid , and cried every man unto his god , and cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea , to lighten it of them . But Jonah was gone down into the sides of the ship  ; and he lay , and was fast asleep .

translation.kha: Ka jingngeit jong phi , te , kam shong ha ka jingstad briew , hawei , ha ka bor U Blei .
translation.en: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men , but in the power of God .

And the  Lord  hath given a commandment concerning thee , that no more of thy name be sown : out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image : I will make thy grave  ; for thou art vile .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la rai shaphang ki nong Assyria :  Kin ym don kino kino kiba hiarpateng ki ban bah ïa ka kyrteng jong ki . Ngan pynjot ïa ki bleithaw kiba don hapoh ka templ jong ki blei jong ki . Nga pynkhreh ka jingtep ïa ki nong Assyria — kim don hok ban im !

translation.en: And Jesus saith unto them ,  All ye shall be offended because of me this night : for it is written , I will smite the shepherd , and the sheep shall be scattered .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Baroh na phi phin phet noh bad phin iehnoh ïa nga , naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , ‘ U Blei un pynïap ïa u nongaplangbrot , bad ïa ka kynhun langbrot yn pynsakma .’

U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , Namar ba ïa kito ki nong Galilaïa la pynïap ha kata ka rukom , hato phi pyrkhat ba ka pynshisha ba ki la un-long ki nongpop kiba kham sniew ban ïa baroh kiwei pat ki nongot Galilaïa ?
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Suppose ye that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans , because they suffered such things ?

translation.kha: Te U Trai u la ong ha la ki bhabriew , To khmih thuh ïa ki jaitbynriew Sawdong jong phi , sad phan lyngngoh ïa kaei kaba phi ioh . Ngan leh ei ei kaba phna ym lah bieit haba phi ïasngew shaphang jong ka .
translation.en: Behold ye among the heathen , and regard , and wonder marvellously : for I will work a work in your days , which ye will not believe , though it be told you .

Ye shall not need to fight in this battle : set yourselves , stand ye still , and see the salvation of the  Lord  with you , O Judah and Jerusalem : fear not , nor be dismayed  ; to morrow go out against them : for the  Lord  will be with you .
translation.kha: Phin ym hap ban ïaleh ïa kane ka thma . Shu don ha la ki jaka bad ap ; phin ïohi U  Trai  u ai jingjop ïa phi . Ko ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem , wat sangeh ne sheptieng . Leit sha ka thma , bad U  Trai  un long ryngkat bad phi !
Ka kur Gershom ka Ïoh khatlai tyllun ki nongbah na ki Jaka jong ki jait Ahishar , Eser , Naduh , Mareshah ba sha Mihngi .
translation.en: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar , and out of the tribe of Asher , and out of the tribe of Naphtali , and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan , thirteen cities .

translation.kha: baroh shi miat , u Joshua dara ka kynthup shipawa Jong u ki la ïada na Gilgal shuh Gibeon bad ki la tur kyndit ban ïalaw ïa ki Amor .
translation.en: Joshua therefore came unto them suddenly , and went up from Gilgal all night .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei katba U Trai Nongsynshar u ong : Ngan shym ïa ka kliar jong u diengduh Kedar bajrong mala kyiad ïa i shylluit balung ; ngan thung ïa i halor u lum bakynjang ,
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also take of the highest branch of the high cedar , and will set it  ; I will crop off from the top of his young twigs a tender one , and will plant it upon an high mountain and eminent :
For he bringeth down them that dwell on high  ; the lofty city , he layeth it low  ; he layeth it low , even to the ground  ; he bringeth it even to the dust .
translation.kha: U la pynhiar ïa kito kiba sarong ; u la pynjot ïa ka nongbah baskhem ha kaba ki shong , bad u pynlong ba ki kynroh jong ka kin pra bad hap sha tbian .
Ka long ka jingbieit ban bud ïa la ki jrong ki jingsngewthuh . To longsyiem shngain , bad bud ïa ki jinghikai jong ki briew kiba kham stad .
translation.en: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool : but whoso walketh wisely , he shall be delivered .
And he said unto me , Solomon thy son , he shall build my house and my courts : for I have chosen him to be my son , and I will be his father .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Dei u Solomon u khun jong me u ban tei ïa ka Templ jong nga . Nga la jied ïa u ban long u khun jong nga , bad nga ngan long u kpa jong u .

translation.en: And he said , Bring it near to me , and I will eat of my son s venison , that my soul may bless thee . And he brought it near to him , and he did eat : and he brought him wine , and he drank .
translation.kha: U Isaak u ong ,  Wanrah hangne ïa kata ka doh . Hadien ba nga la bam ïa ka , ngan sa kyrkhu ïa phi .  U Jakob u wanrah ïa ka sha u , bad u la bam ; u wanrah katto katne ka waiñ ruh ïa u ban dih .
U Mikah u ïa-ong , Shong noh bad nga . Long u nongaibuit bad u lyngkhuit jong sa , bad ngan ai ïa phi shiphew ki sbai shoh shisnem , ki jaiñ bad ka jingbabe ïa phi .
translation.en: And Micah said unto him , Dwell with me , and be unto me a father and a priest , and I will give thee ten shekels of silver by the year , and a suit of apparel , and thy victuals . So the Levite went in .

translation.kha: Ym don mano mano nabar ka kynhun kaba la nud ban ïasah bad ki , woh la ki paidlang ki la kren ïaroi ïa ki .
translation.en: And of the rest durst no man join himself to them : but the people magnified them .
Then said Jesus unto them again ,  Verily , verily , I say unto you , I am the door of the sheep .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong biang ,  Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Nga long ka jingkhang jong ki langbrot .
La khang pyrshah ïa phi na kaba lum khajna na ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi , ki nongjop nongthoh , ki nongap phira , ki nongtrei lane kino drama babha ei ka jingïadei bad kan ka Templ .
translation.en: Also we certify you , that touching any of the priests and Levites , singers , porters , Nethinims , or ministers of this house of God , it shall not be lawful to impose toll , tribute , or custom , upon them .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khadar jong ka jingïashun jong u , u syep Josaïah u phah ïa u Ashan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u khun jong u Asalaïah malu u kyrsiew jong u Meshullam , sha ka thalab bad ka lawlynnong :
translation.en: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah , that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , the son of Meshullam , the scribe , to the house of the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: badno mynta nga wan noh sha me ; ngiam don shuh ha kane ka pyrthat , hynriew ma ki , ki don ha ka pyrthei . Ko Pa Bakhuid ! To ri Kyndong ïa ki da ka bor ka kyrteng jong me , ka kyrteng naba me la ai ha nga , ba kin ïoh long Kaei kamar ma me malu nga ngi ïalong khwai .
translation.en: And now I am no more in the world , but these are in the world , and I come to thee . Holy Father , keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me , that they may be one , as we are .
Children , obey your parents in all things : for this is well pleasing unto the Lord .
translation.kha: Ki khun , ïai kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , naba kata ka long kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .

Hadien khyndiat sngi , u khun ba kham rishot u la die ïa ka bniat jong ka jingdon jingkmen jyllang u bad u la iehnoh na ïing lem bad ka pisa . U la leit sha ka ri kaba jngai , ha kaba u la pynsyrwa ei ïa ka pisa jong u ha ka jingim ba-thurmur .
translation.en: And not many days after the younger son gathered all together , and took his journey into a far country , and there wasted his substance with riotous living .

translation.kha: U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai , da kaba buid ïa ka jingleh basniew jong u Ahab u khop jong u , ka Jesebel ka kiei lad u , bad jong u syiem Jeroboam , kiba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban sa pop .
translation.en: And he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the way of his father , and in the way of his mother , and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin :

translation.kha: bad kumta ka jingpynjot lai ym shoh ïa me , ka jinglehhok jubor kan ym wan shajan ka Ïing jong me .
translation.en: There shall no evil befall thee , neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling .

translation.kha: Ki maw jong ka khyndew ki don u mawkordor Sapphir , Bad ki pien pui jong u ki don ksiar .
translation.en: The stones of it are the place of sapphires : and it hath dust of gold .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la sdang ban ujor ha U Trai shaphang ki jingjynjar jong ki . Hobab U Trai u la ïohpdiang ïa ki , u la pita lep bad u phiah da ka ngin ha kita ki paidbah . Kat ka dang ka rang pyndeng jong ki bad ka la pynjot ïa kawei ka dong jongno ka Jaka shongduh dara .
translation.en: And when the people complained , it displeased the  Lord  : and the  Lord  heard it  ; and his anger was kindled  ; and the fire of the  Lord  burnt among them , and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp .

translation.en: Then Jael Heber s wife took a nail of the tent , and took an hammer in her hand , and went softly unto him , and smote the nail into his temples , and fastened it into the ground : for he was fast asleep and weary . So he died .
translation.kha: U Sisera u la thait haduh katta katta ba u da ïohthiah jar . Nangta ka Jael ka shim ïa u tyrnem bad u snar pynskhem dara , ka la leit mian mian sha u , bad ka pynïap ïa u da kaba sah ïa u snar na ka moi moi jong u ha ban da pei phlait haduh khyndew .
u lah ban ong ha u , Me long u nongkyrshan malade nongïada jongu la , me longsyiem U Blei jong ang ; ha me nga shaniah .
translation.en: I will say of the  Lord  , He is my refuge and my fortress : my God  ; in him will I trust .

translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la iohnong ïa u .
translation.en: And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him .
The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations , and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished :
translation.kha: Bad kumta U Trai u tip kumno ban pyllait im ïa ki briew kiba riewblei na ki jingtynjuh jong ki bad kumno ban pynhap ïa ki bymman ha ka jingpynshitom ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , khamtam ïa kito kiba beh ïa ki jingkwah brai jakhlia jong ka met bad kiba ñiewbeiñ ïa ka bor synshar jong U Blei .

translation.en: As he spake by the mouth of his holy prophets , which have been since the world began :
translation.kha: U la kular lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid jong u na mynbarim
Ma nga , U Trai U Blei Badonbor Balah , ngam patiaw shym la iehnoh ïa ka Jesreel mala ka Judia , waiñ la ki la leh pop pynshah ïa nga , U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .
translation.en: For Israel hath not been forsaken , nor Judah of his God , of the  Lord  of hosts  ; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: Ki nongpynjot mraw ki ïai pyrshang ban pynbor ïa ki ban shna katjuh ki maw-it man ka Sngi kumba ki la Shna mynba dang ai phyrngab ïa ki .
translation.en: And the taskmasters hasted them , saying , Fulfil your works , your daily tasks , as when there was straw .

translation.kha: Phibi da ban pyndonkam ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba sah na ka bynta kano kano kaba ma phi bad ki para ri jong phi , phi kiaw ban pynsakma , kat khem ka mon U Blei jongngi phi .
translation.en: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee , and to thy brethren , to do with the rest of the silver and the gold , that do after the will of your God .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ko paralok jongnga ang , leh ïa kita Kiei kiei hi kiba phi bishar ïa kti! Hato phi pyrsad pien lait na ka jingbishar U Blei ?
translation.en: And thinkest thou this , O man , that judgest them which do such things , and doest the same , that thou shalt escape the judgment of God ?

And Gideon said unto God , Let not thine anger be hot against me , and I will speak but this once : let me prove , I pray thee , but this once with the fleece  ; let it now be dry only upon the fleece , and upon all the ground let there be dew .
translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u ong ha U Blei ,  Wat bitar ïa nga ; shah ngan tynjuh sa tang shisien . Sngewbha shah ïa nga ban pyrshang sa shisien da une u shñiuh langbrot . Ha kane ka sien , ai ba u shñiuh langbrot un rkhiang , bad ba ka khyndew pat kan jhieh .

translation.en: But the  Lord  hath taken you , and brought you forth out of the iron furnace , even out of Egypt , to be unto him a people of inheritance , as ye are this day .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi , phi dei ki briew kiba u la pyllait im na Ijipt , ka pajwa kaba klang da ka ding . U la wan ïalam ïa phi ban pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong u hi , kumne kumba phi long mynta .
Bun na ki briew kiba la wan jngoh ïa ka Mari ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh , bad ki la kheit ha u .
translation.en: Then many of the Jews which came to Mary , and had seen the things which Jesus did , believed on him .

translation.kha: Em , me lah ban shahïap tang ïa ka jingsait haba ka lyer na shaphang shathie ka lynshop ïa ka ri .
translation.en: How thy garments are warm , when he quieteth the earth by the south wind ?
And knowest his will , and approvest the things that are more excellent , being instructed out of the law ;
translation.kha: phi tip kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban leh , bad phi ïoh jinghikai na ka Hukum ban jied ïa kaei kaba dei ;

translation.en: And we were in all in the ship two hundred threescore and sixteen souls .
translation.kha: Ngi la ïadon baroh arspah hynñiewphew hynriew ngut ha ka lieng .
Ko Nonghikai , la jubab u Nathanael , me long U Khun U Blei ! Me long u Ngim ki Israel !
translation.en: Nathanael answered and saith unto him , Rabbi , thou art the Son of God  ; thou art the King of Israel .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Nga la leh ïa kawei ka kambah , Bad baroh phi ïa-sngewlyngngoh .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I have done one work , and ye all marvel .

translation.kha: Mynba nga mihnoh nangne , nga ei kyrhai , hynrei U Trei u la wallam thylli ïa nga . balui yn khot ïa nga ka nongïam haba U Trai Uba Khrawbor u la pynrem malade phah jingjynjar ha nga ?
translation.en: I went out full , and the  Lord  hath brought me home again empty : why then call ye me Naomi , seeing the  Lord  hath testified against me , and the Almighty hath afflicted me ?

Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver , and the ornament of thy molten images of gold : thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth  ; thou shalt say unto it , Get thee hence .
translation.kha: Phin shim ïa ki bleithaw jong phi ba la sop da ka rupa bad ïa ki blei jong phi ba la tap da ka ksiar , bad phin bret noh ïa ki kum ïa ka jakhlia , bad phin pyrta ,  Wat don shuh ha khmat jong nga !

Ka jingleh jongnga ki ka pyn-i ba ïa kaei kaba ka hukum ka dawa , la tah ha ki dohnud jong ki . Ki jingïatiplem jong ki ruh ki pyn-i ba Kanah ka long kaba shisha , namar ki jingpyrkhat jong ki teng teng ki pynrem ïa ki malade teng tun ki kyrshan ïa ki .
translation.en: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts , their conscience also bearing witness , and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another ; )

translation.kha: Kumta te , balei mynta phi kwah ban tynjuh ïa U Blei da kaba buh ka jingit halor ki met jyllang ki phyrngab ïa kaba ym ba-don ki kpu tymmen jong me lymne ma ngi hi katba lah ban set ?
translation.en: Now therefore why tempt ye God , to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples , which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear ?

translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Enokh u la im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei haduh laispah snam bad u la ioh ruh kiwei pat ki khuid .
translation.en: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years , and begat sons and daughters :

translation.kha: Ki la thaw balaitluid ha ka dur jong u khun masi bad ong ba u dei u blei umbiah la ïalumlang ïa ki na Ijipt ! Haduh katno ki la jingpynjahburom ïa me , Ko Trai !
translation.en: Yea , when they had made them a molten calf , and said , This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt , and had wrought great provocations  ;

translation.kha: Ka kynhun baroh kiwei ka la byrngem ban lyngkhuit maw ïa ki , hynrei kynsan ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon rijied U Trai ba ka paw halor ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones . And the glory of the  Lord  appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Hato me don hangta mynba nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthuh ? Lada me tip haduh katta katta , to ïathuh ïa nga shngain kata .
translation.en: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth ? declare , if thou hast understanding .
He that hath an ear , let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches .
translation.kha: Te lada pha don ki shkor , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Mynsiem u ong ha ki balang !
Pateng la pang , ïa kane ka jingai kaba kyrpang dei ban ai sha U Trai na u Kpu ba phi shet .
translation.en: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the  Lord  an heave offering in your generations .

translation.kha: ?(Nga ong ïa ki briew bad ïa ki rangbah pynsynjor bad ki nongïalam , Ka jingtreikam ka la ïar bad la pynïakhlad ïa me da ka jingjngai uei na uwei pat ha ka kynroh .
translation.en: And I said unto the nobles , and to the rulers , and to the rest of the people , The work is great and large , and we are separated upon the wall , one far from another .

translation.kha: Wat leit jngoh bunsien eh ïa u paramarjan jong pa’ , u haka ban sngewngiah ïa phi Bad isih pynban ïa phi .
translation.en: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour s house  ; lest he be weary of thee , and so hate thee .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngngoh bad ki nonghikai ka praw ki la bitar hab ki la Iohi ïa kiei kaei kiba phiah kiba u la leh bad ba ki khynnah ki ïa-pyrta ha ka Templ , To ïaroh ïa U Khun u Dabid !
translation.en: And when the chief priests and scribes saw the wonderful things that he did , and the children crying in the temple , and saying , Hosanna to the Son of David  ; they were sore displeased ,
Righteous lips are the delight of kings  ; and they love him that speaketh right .
translation.kha: U syiem u kwah ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingshisha bad u sngewbha ïa kito kiba kren ïa ka .
U Jisu u la phah ïa u Petros bad ïa u Ïoannis lem bad kine ki jingbthah : Khie leit bad pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynta lad ngi ngab ïabam .
translation.en: And he sent Peter and John , saying ,  Go and prepare us the passover , that we may eat .

translation.kha: wahbah u la ïuh ïa U Jisu , u la kyang jam , u la pynum ïa lade ha ki khet jong u , bad u la pyrta , Ko Jisu , U Khun jongngi U Blei Uba Malkhiel Tam Eh ! Me khih aïom nabar nga ? Nga kyrpad ïa me , wat pynshitom ïa nga !
translation.en: When he saw Jesus , he cried out , and fell down before him , and with a loud voice said , What have I to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of God most high ? I beseech thee , torment me not .

translation.kha: Un pynshitom ïa ki namar ki kam bymman jong ki bad un pyndeng ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki ; U Trai U Blei jong ngi un pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity , and shall cut them off in their own wickedness  ; yea , the  Lord  our God shall cut them off .

translation.kha: Uwei u kup Hebru u la don hangta lem bad ngi , uba dei u mraw jong u kapten jong ki nongput phira . Ngi la ïathuh ha u ïa la ki jingphohsniew , bad u la batai ïa ki ha ngi .
translation.en: And there was there with us a young man , an Hebrew , servant to the captain of the guard  ; and we told him , and he interpreted to us our dreams  ; to each man according to his dream he did interpret .
A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon , and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To shahshkor ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïam ha Babilon , jong ka jingïam pangnud namar ka jingpynjot ha ka ri .
To ïahiar ïa u , phi ka sngi bad u bnai ; to ïaroh ïa u , phi ki khlur baphyrnai .
translation.en: Praise ye him , sun and moon : praise him , all ye stars of light .

translation.kha: Ko nongsiatkhnam , to ïeng ryntih na ka bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilon bad kirteng ïa ka . To siat ïa ki khnam jong phi baroh ïa ka Babilon , namar ka la kuna pum pyrshah ïa nga , U Tiras .
translation.en: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about : all ye that bend the bow , shoot at her , spare no arrows : for she hath sinned against the  Lord .
For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John .
translation.kha: Haduh ka por jong u Ïoannis baroh ki nongïathuhlypa bad ka Hukum u Moses ki la kren shaphang ka Hima ;

translation.en: And David numbered the people that were with him , and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u la lumlang ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh , u pynbynta ïa ki ha ki kynhun kiba shihajar ngut bad kiba shispah ngut , bad u buh ki rangbah pynïaidkam ban ai hukum ïa ki .
U la ong ha ki , Ka don ka jingot bakhraw , hynrei tang khyndiat ngut ki nongtrei ban ïalum ïa ka . To kyrpad ïa u trai jong ka jingot ba un phah ïa ki nongtrei ban lumlang ha ka jingot jong u .
translation.en: Therefore said he unto them ,  The harvest truly is great , but the labourers are few : pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest , that he would send forth labourers into his harvest .
For they heard them speak with tongues , and magnify God . Then answered Peter ,
translation.kha: Naba ki la ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki kren ha ki ktien kiba pher bad ki da ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw jong U Blei . U Petros u la kren :
Kumta ki la khoit biang ïa ki shapoh pynlang ki la ong ïa ki ba ki dei da lwa lei ban kren lane iaki ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu .
translation.en: And they called them , and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus .

translation.kha: Ngi la kmen namar jong u , me shaniah ha ka kyr-ang bakhuid jong u .
translation.en: For our heart shall rejoice in him , because we have trusted in his holy name .

translation.kha: Lada phim ia ban synshar ïa ka jingbishar jong phi , phin longïng khlem ka jingïarap kum ka nongbah bym don kynroh , kaba lait rynghang ban shahïap tur ïaleh .
translation.en: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down , and without walls .
Then Gideon built an altar there unto the  Lord  , and called it Jehovah–shalom : unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abi–ezrites .
translation.kha: U Gideon u tei hangta ka duwan ïa U  Trai  bad u khot kyrteng ïa ka ,  U  Trai  u long ka Jingsuk .  ( Ka dang ïeng ha Ophrah , kaba dei jong ki kur jong u Abieser . )

translation.en: Therefore the law is slacked , and judgment doth never go forth : for the wicked doth compass about the righteous  ; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth .
translation.kha: Ka aiñ ka tlot bad kam myntoi ei ei , bad ym ju don ka jingbishar hok . Ki briew kiba sniew ki ïoh ïa kaba kham bha ban ïa kiba hok , bad kumta ïa ka jingbishar hok la pynjngut .
“Phi la ïohsngew shisha shaïong jong u , bad kum ki nongbud jong u , la hikai ha phi ïa kata ka jingshisha kaba don ha U Jisu .
translation.en: If so be that ye have heard him , and have been taught by him , as the truth is in Jesus :
And in the valley , Eshtaol , and Zorah , and Ashnah ,
translation.kha: Ki nongbah ha kjat ki lum ki long ka Eshtaol , ka Sorah , ka Ashnah ,

translation.en: That is , that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga mut ka long ba ma phi bad ma nga ngin ïoh ka jingïarap ha kajuh ka por , ma phi da ka jingngeit jong nga bad ma nga da ka jong phi .

translation.en: Which had the golden censer , and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold , wherein was the golden pot that had manna , and Aaron s rod that budded , and the tables of the covenant  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka la buh ïa ka duwan ksiar na ka bynta ban thang ïa ki jingiwbih bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ïa kaba la sop ksiar bad la don u khiew ksiar lem bad ka manna ha u , u diengduh jong u Aaron uba la mih sla , bad ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap ha kiba la thoh ïa ki hukum .

translation.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof , as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings  ; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him , and it shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: Nangta un weng ïa ka khleiñ jong ka baroh , kumba ju weng ïa ka khleiñ na ki mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ki jingainguh ïasyllok , bad un thang ïa ka ha ka duwan , khnang ba ka jingiw na ka kan pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai . Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop jong uta u briew , bad yn map ïa u .
To ïaroh ïa U Trai U Blei jong ngi , bad to mane ha u lem bakyntang jong u ! U Trai U Blei jong ngi u long uba kyrduh .
translation.en: Exalt the  Lord  our God , and worship at his holy hill  ; for the  Lord  our God is holy .

translation.kha: kamut , pynpra ïa ki kito jong ki , pynpait pharia ïa ki riewstad mawkyntang jong ki , mait ïa ki dak ka blei Asherah jong ki , bad stong ïa ki bleithaw jong ki .
translation.en: But thus shall ye deal with them  ; ye shall destroy their altars , and break down their images , and cut down their groves , and burn their graven images with fire .

translation.kha: Baroh ki kut jong pha Kin longïng kum ki jingïasoh dumok bad ki soh Dorbar ba la ih : Khynñiuh ïa ki dieng bad ki soh kin hap pynbit haduh ka shyntur jongnga pha !
translation.en: All thy strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs : if they be shaken , they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater .
Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant , even as I had pity on thee ?
translation.kha: Me la dei ban don jingisynei ïa la u para shakri , kumba nga la isynei ïa me .’
Da ka jingïap ba aiti lut jong u , mynta la pynlong ka jingïadei pynpdang jongu ngi bad U Blei ; katno tam te , ngin long ibha lait im da u na ka jingbitar U Blei!
translation.en: Much more then , being now justified by his blood , we shall be saved from wrath through him .
And Joseph said unto him , This is the interpretation of it : The three branches are three days :
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ,  Kane ka mut kumne : kita ki tnat lai tylli ki long lai tylli ki sngi .
‘Kaba kum kata ka jingstad kam long kaweh wan hiar na bneng ; ka long jong ka pyrthei , kam long kaba kynjai mynsiem bad ka longkmie ka kynja ksai .
translation.en: This wisdom descendeth not from above , but is earthly , sensual , devilish .

translation.kha: Hangta de la khmih , nga la ïohsngew ïa u sloit uba her shajrong eh jong ka suiñ ba u pyrta ha ka sur kaba jam , Kaba kordit ! Kaba kyrthat ! Katno kaba kordit kan long ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka pyrthei haba ka jingsawa ka mih na ki turoi ïa katba i'u kiwei pah ki lai ngut ki angel kin put .
translation.en: And I beheld , and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven , saying with a loud voice , Woe , woe , woe , to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels , which are yet to sound !

translation.kha: Ki katei u briew uba Bha ki lama kum ka rupa kaba kynsha ; ka jingai jingmut jongnga u riewbymman kim dondor ei ei .
translation.en: The tongue of the just is as choice silver : the heart of the wicked is little worth .

translation.kha: ‘ Da lat lei ruh em ! ngam ithuh ïa phi ,’ u nongleitkurim u la jubab .
translation.en: But he answered and said , Verily I say unto you , I know you not .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew Kiba ïaid nangta ki ïohi ïa kata ka metïap ha lynti , bun ïa u jingjngem uba ïeng hajan jongno ka . Ki leit haduh Bethel bad ïathuh ïa kaei kob ki la ïohi .
translation.en: And , behold , men passed by , and saw the carcase cast in the way , and the lion standing by the carcase : and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt .
O my dove , that art in the clefts of the rock , in the secret places of the stairs , let me see thy countenance , let me hear thy voice  ; for sweet is thy voice , and thy countenance is comely .
translation.kha: Uba ieit jong nga u long kum ki syntiew khlaw kiba phuh ha ki bri sohwaiñ ha Engedi .

translation.en: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice , and do all that I speak  ; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies , and an adversary unto thine adversaries .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi kohnguh ïa u , bad leh kat ïa kaba nga hukum , ngan ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh .
U Balaam u Ong ha u Balak , Mynta ngan leit phai pud shaw la ki briew , hynrei shuwa ba ngan mihngi , nga maham lypa ïa phi ïew ki Israel kin leh ïa ki briew jong phi hadien habud .
translation.en: And now , behold , I go unto my people : come therefore , and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days .

translation.kha: Ki la pynkup ïa ka jaiñkup basawbthuh ha U Jisu , ki la thaw ïa ka pynngat na ki tnat ba don shiah , bad pynphong ïa ka ha ka khlieh jong u .
translation.en: And they clothed him with purple , and platted a crown of thorns , and put it about his head ,
The proud have forged a lie against me : but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sarong ki la ïathuh lamler shaphang jong nga , hynrei da la ka dohnud baroh nga kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong me .
Da ka ding malade ka waitlam un pynshitom ïa ki briew baroh jong ka pyrthei kiba u shem ba la pynrem — bad shibun kin shah pynïap .
translation.en: For by fire and by his sword will the  Lord  plead with all flesh : and the slain of the  Lord  shall be many .
And he leaping up stood , and walked , and entered with them into the temple , walking , and leaping , and praising God .
translation.kha: u la kynthih , u la ïeng ha la ki kjat , bad u la sdang ban ïaid kylleng sawdong . Nangta u la leit shapoh ka Templ lem bad ki , u da ïaid bad kynthih bad ïaroh ïa U Blei .

Nangta u Syiem Sabad u longing shaphang ka Ïingjaiñ ka ingdong Ryngkat U Trai , u shong dara u duwai , A tharai Nongsynshar , ngam long uba bit ïa kaei kaba me la imat na ka bynta jrong to lymne wat ka longïing jong de .
translation.en: Then went king David in , and sat before the  Lord  , and he said , Who am I , O Lord  God  ? and what is my house , that thou hast brought me hitherto ?

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta to shahshkor ïa ka jingsmai kaba ma nga U Trai , la la pyntong ha ka kyrteng bakhrawbor jong nga sha pa ki Jeraïah baïar kiba don ha Ijipt : nur ym sha shuh ïano ïaineh na phi ban pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ban pynlong jingsmai da ka ong , ‘ ?(Nga smai da U tharai Nongsynshar uba im !’
translation.en: Therefore hear ye the word of the  Lord  , all Judah that dwell in the land of Egypt  ; Behold , I have sworn by my great name , saith the  Lord  , that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt , saying , The Lord  God  liveth .

translation.kha: baroh ki dei ban ai katba ki kotbor , kot kum ba U Trai U Blei jong pa’ u la kyrkhu ïa phi .
translation.en: Every man shall give as he is able , according to the blessing of the  Lord  thy God which he hath given thee .
This people draweth nigh unto me with their mouth , and honoureth me with their lips  ; but their heart is far from me .
translation.kha: ‘ Kine briew , ong U Blei , ki pyndonburom ïa nga da ki kyntien jong ki , hynrei ka dohnud jong ki , da shisha ka long jngai eh na nga .

Wat pynbyrsieh ïa lade da kan kano na kine ki nang , Namarba dei da kine ba ki briew ki bymngeit balui ki la pyntngit ïa lade , kito ki jaitbynriew kiba im ha kata ka ri ha shuwa jong pa bad ïa kiba ngan eh noh , ba phin ïoh kitei rung hangta .
translation.en: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things : for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you :

translation.kha: Ki khun ki kti jong phi ngin ïaid sakma ha kane ka ri khlaw sawphew snem , ngin shitom namar said ka jingïamai jong phi , dak haduh ba ibha ïathuh eh napdeng jong phi un ïap .
translation.en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years , and bear your whoredoms , until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ha khmih haduh katno ki kynthei ka Jesreel ki long kiba sorkar ! Ki ïaid da kaba pynhieng ïa la ki khmut . Ki ju long borabor kiba kynshleiñ . Ki shim ki sien jam kiba rit ibit dara ki jingtieng ha ki mawkhang ki sai .
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  saith , Because the daughters of Zion are haughty , and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes , walking and mincing as they go , and making a tinkling with their feet :
And Saul commanded his servants , saying , Commune with David secretly , and say , Behold , the king hath delight in thee , and all his servants love thee : now therefore be the king s son in law .
translation.kha: U hukum ïa la ki rangbah synshar ban ïakren jar jar bad u Dabid bad ban ïathuh ha u ,  U syiem u shem sngewbha ïa phi bad ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ki sngewtynnat ïa phi ; mynta ka dei ka por kaba biang ba phin shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u .
Khublei shibun
translation.en: Thanks a lot

Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne , to be king for the  Lord  thy God : because thy God loved Israel , to establish them for ever , therefore made he thee king over them , to do judgment and justice .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ! U la pynpaw kaba katno u sngewbha ïa phi da kaba pynlong ïa phi u syiem u ban synshar ha ka kyrteng jong u . Namar ba u ieit ïa ki briew jong u , ki Israel , bad u kwah ban pynneh ïa ki junom , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki khnang ban pynneh ïa ka hukum bad ka jingbishar hok .
ka Eliakim , ka Gibbethon , ka Baalath ,
translation.en: And Eltekeh , and Gibbethon , and Baalath ,

translation.kha: nongthaw ki lyngdoh ki bah ïa ka syntuid ka Jutang sha ka Templ bad ki buh ïa ka ha Ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam , hapoh ki kherub .
translation.en: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  unto his place , into the oracle of the house , to the most holy place , even under the wings of the cherubims .

And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel , and an hundred of a thousand , and a thousand out of ten thousand , to fetch victual for the people , that they may do , when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin , according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah ha Israel kin wanrah jingbam ïa ka kynhun shipai , bad kiwei pat kin leit ban pynshitom ïa ka Gibeah namar kane ka kam khlemrain ba ki la leh ha Israel .
Ka jingbuh jingthoh ïa ki khun ki kiew da ki longïing ki long arphew hajar arsien ngut ki rangbah kiba bat na ka bynta ka kam Shiphew .
translation.en: And the number of them , after their genealogy by their generations , heads of the house of their fathers , mighty men of valour , was twenty thousand and two hundred .

translation.kha: Shisien , hir la ni ka nemsniew ha kylleng ka ri , u Elisha u la leit phai sha Gilgal . Katba u dang hikai ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa , u la ong ïa u shakri jong u ban tiew ïa u khih kiba heh ha ryndang bad shet syrti na ka bynta jongno ki .
translation.en: And Elisha came again to Gilgal : and there was a dearth in the land  ; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him : and he said unto his servant , Set on the great pot , and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets .
And he left all that he had in Joseph s hand  ; and he knew not ought he had , save the bread which he did eat . And Joseph was a goodly person , and well favoured .
translation.kha: Kumta u Potiphar u aiti ïa kiei kiei baroh kat kiba u don ha ka jingpeit u Joseph , bad um shym pynkhuslai ei ei shuh ïa lade lait tang ka bam ba u ju bam .
ngam skhem la Seneh ban ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: Cease not to give thanks for you , making mention of you in my prayers ;

translation.kha: Sa shikhung pat u symboh u la Phah ïa u rangbah pynkdor lam bad shaphang ngut ki rangbah . U la leit kiei ïa u lym , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat u Elijah , bad u la ïasah , Ko briew jong U Blei , to hynrei ïa nga dara ïa ki rangbah jongki nga . To pyrsad ïa ka jingim jong ngi !
translation.en: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty . And the third captain of fifty went up , and came and fell on his knees before Elijah , and besought him , and said unto him , O man of God , I pray thee , let my life , and the life of these fifty thy servants , be precious in thy sight .

translation.kha: U la leit babit sha ki synagog u la sdang ban ïalap ba U Jisu u hir U ka U Blei .
translation.en: And straightway he preached Christ in the synagogues , that he is the Son of God .
Why did you sleep ?
translation.kha: Balei phi thiah ?
Na ka ri ki jait Jong phi baroh , U Tlai un jied tang kawei ka jaka sha kaba phi dei ban Wan manla ïa u .
translation.en: But unto the place which the  Lord  your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there , even unto his habitation shall ye seek , and thither thou shalt come :

translation.kha: Ha kane kajuh ka rukom ki briew ka Israel kin iphuh ban ap slem khlem ki syiem ne ki nongïalam , khlem jingkñia lap ryntih mawkyntang , khlem bleithaw lane dur ban pyndonkam ha katba khan blei .
translation.en: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king , and without a prince , and without a sacrifice , and without an image , and without an ephod , and without teraphim :

translation.kha: U Khereth um syiem la phah ïa nga baneh pynbaptis . U la phah ïa nga ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Babha , bad ban ïathuh ïa ka khlem da pyndonkam ïa ka ktien ha ka jingstad briew , khnang ban pynthikna ba ka jingïap U Khrist halor ka diengphna kan ym pynduh noh ïa ka ni jong ka .
translation.en: For Christ sent me not to baptize , but to preach the gospel : not with wisdom of words , lest the cross of Christ should be made of none effect .
Judas saith unto him , not Iscariot , Lord , how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us , and not unto the world ?
translation.kha: U Judas ( ym u Judas Iskariot ) u la ong ,  Ko Trai , kumno ka lah ban long ba men pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi bad ym ha ka pyrthei ?

Phi la ong , ‘ Kam myntoi ban shakri ïa U Balei . Kawei ka jingmyntoi ba-bang leh ïa kaei kaba u ïa-ong lano kaba pyrshang ban pyn-ap ïa U Trai Badonbor Balah ba ngi sngewsih na ka bynta kaei kaba ngi la leh ?
translation.en: Ye have said , It is vain to serve God : and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance , and that we have walked mournfully before the  Lord  of hosts ?
And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about , and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place :
translation.kha: Hadien kata , un phah khrud ïa ki kynroh baroh hapoh ïing , bad bret ïa kata ka khyndew shabar shnong ha ka jaka theh ñiut .
Nongbah katsha phi dang ïabam , phi ïabam shuwa ïa la ka jong ka jingbam marwei , te don kiba la thngan katba kiwei ki lah da buaid .
translation.en: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper : and one is hungry , and another is drunken .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la kren ha ki Israel , bad wai pa uwei na ki nongïalam jong ki , ki la ai ha u mar uwei u diengduh , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jwat , baroh ki long khat-ar thyllah , nabar ïa u diengduh jong u Aaron la bsuh lem Bad ki .
translation.en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel , and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece , for each prince one , according to their fathers  houses , even twelve rods : and the rod of Aaron was among their rods .

translation.kha: Ki paid Ishmael ki ong ha u Moses , Te kata ka den kaba kut ïa ngi !
translation.en: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses , saying , Behold , we die , we perish , we all perish .
Behold , he breaketh down , and it cannot be built again : he shutteth up a man , and there can be no opening .
translation.kha: Haba U Blei u pyntwa , uei uba lah ban tei pat , bad uno uba lah ban pyllait ïa u briew uba U Blei u la set byndi ?

translation.en: And Edom shall be a possession , Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies  ; and Israel shall do valiantly .
translation.kha: Un jop ïa ki nongshun jong u ha Edom , Bad un pynlong ïa ka ri jong ki ka jingïohkynti jong u , Katba ki Israel kin ïai jop .

translation.en: Be not desirous of his dainties : for they are deceitful meat .
translation.kha: Wat kwah lalot ïa ki jingbam bang ba u pynkhreh ; u lah ban pyrshang ban riam ïa phi .

U Joshua u la kurup ïa ka ri baroh — ka ri lum bad ki kjat lum , ïa kaba shaei bad shathie , ka jaka jong ka Kushan baroh , mala ki ri ryngkhiang ha ka phang shathie jong ka , kumjuh hima ïa ka Them Jordan .
translation.en: So Joshua took all that land , the hills , and all the south country , and all the land of Goshen , and the valley , and the plain , and the mountain of Israel , and the valley of the same  ;

translation.kha: Nangta u ju rupa pat sa sha la ïing ha Haram , hangamei ruh u ju Shakri kum u nongbishar . Ha Ramah u la tei ïa ka duwan ha U Trai hangta .
translation.en: And his return was to Ramah  ; for there was his house  ; and there he judged Israel  ; and there he built an altar unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u ong ha u Abiathar u lyngdoh , Khie leit sha la ka jngai ka ri ha Anaharath . Me dei khot ban ïap , isynei ngan ym phah pynïap ïa me mynta , namar ba me la khmih sumar ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Trai mynba me dang don bad u Dabid , u kput jong de , bad me la ïoh bynta lem ha ki jingrisa jong u barhem .
translation.en: And unto Abiathar the priest said the king , Get thee to Anathoth , unto thine own fields  ; for thou art worthy of death : but I will not at this time put thee to death , because thou barest the ark of the Lord  God  before David my father , and because thou hast been afflicted in all wherein my father was afflicted .

translation.kha: Nangta u la ïaid sha khmat bad u la ktah ïa ka klong , bad ki briew kiba bah ïa ka ki la sangeh . U Jisu u la nong , Ko samla ! To khie joit , nga ong ïa me !
translation.en: And he came and touched the bier : and they that bare him stood still . And he said ,  Young man , I say unto thee , Arise .

translation.kha: Lane , lada ki brisoh kin ïathmu ïa phi , ‘ Ha khmih , u don ha ka ri shyiap !’ — kdew leit Shata , lane ïada ki ong , ‘ Ha khmih , u riewhok hangne !’ — kam ngeit ïa —kata .
translation.en: Wherefore if they shall say unto you , Behold , he is in the desert  ; go not forth : behold , he is in the secret chambers  ; believe it not .

translation.kha: Kynmaw hati ïa ki jingtynjuh kiba jingshyrkhei kiba phi la ïohi , da ki khap mala ki jakhlia , bad da ka barben da ka ksang ti kaba la kner da kaba U Trai U Blei jong ph u la pyllait ïa phi , kumta ruh un pynjop ïa kita ki jaitbynriew baroh ïa kiba phi sheptieng .
translation.en: The great temptations which thine eyes saw , and the signs , and the wonders , and the mighty hand , and the stretched out arm , whereby the  Lord  thy God brought thee out : so shall the  Lord  thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid .
Go up to the mountain , and bring wood , and build the house  ; and I will take pleasure in it , and I will be glorified , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Mynta to leit kiew sha ki lumrit , pynïoh ïa ki dieng shna ïing , bad tei pat ïa ka Templ ; te ngan sngewbha ha ka bad ïa nga yn mane kumba ka dei .
Ha ki ar tylli ki phylliah jong ka Templ , u tei ïa ki Eri na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa ki khlur .
translation.en: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Dan , U Naphtali , U Gad , bad U Asher .
translation.en: Dan , and Naphtali , Gad , and Asher .

translation.kha: Em ! Ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phi! bad lehbha ïa ki ; to ai kylliang bad wiat khmih lynti ban ïoh ei ei pat . Te phin ïew ka pang kaba khriat , bad phin long ki khun jong U Blei Uba Hesekaïah Tamar Eh . Nadab u long suba bha ïa u bymsngewnguh Bad ïa uba bymman .
translation.en: But love ye your enemies , and do good , and lend , hoping for nothing again  ; and your reward shall be great , and ye shall be the children of the Highest : for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil .

translation.kha: U Trai u synrai hakhlieh eh ha bneng , kham khrawburom ban ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw-bah , khamtam donbor ban ïa ki jingat pynlong jong ka duriaw .
translation.en: The  Lord  on high is mightier than the noise of many waters , yea , than the mighty waves of the sea .
Thinkest thou this to be right , that thou saidst , My righteousness is more than God s ?
translation.kha: Kam long kaba dei , ko Job , na ka bynta jong me ban ong ba me long uba lui lui ha khmat U Blei ,

translation.en: And in the valley , Beth–haram , and Beth–nimrah , and Succoth , and Zaphon , the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon , Jordan and his border , even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward .
translation.kha: Ha ka Them Jordan ka kynthup ïa ka Beth Haram , ka Bethnimrah , ka Sukkoth , bad ka Saphon , kaba sah na ka hima u Sihon u syiem Heshbon . Ka pud bashaphang sepngi jong ki ka dei ka wah Jordan haduh ka Duriaw Galilaïa ha ka phang bashatei .

Kin bam duh ïa ki jingthung malu ïa ki jingbah jong phin ; kin pynnep ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi . Kin pynïap ïa ki kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun masi jong phi bad pynjot ïa ki dieng sohwaiñ bad diengsoh Dumbur jong pa . Ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh ha bakha phi shaniah yn pynjot da ka kynjah shiphang jongki ki .
translation.en: And they shall eat up thine harvest , and thy bread , which thy sons and thy daughters should eat : they shall eat up thy flocks and thine herds : they shall eat up thy vines and thy fig trees : they shall impoverish thy fenced cities , wherein thou trustedst , with the sword .

translation.kha: Na u Timon Petros , u shakri sad u Apostol jong U Jisu Khrist — Sha kito ha kiba da ka hok jong U Blei jong ngi bad U jongu kyrshut U Nongpynim la ai ïa ka jingneh kaba kordor kum ka jong ngi :
translation.en: Simon Peter , a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ , to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ :

translation.kha: nongthaw ki rangbah ki la wanlam bajrong sha u syiem badno ki la ong ha u , U Syiem Kynrad u tip ba kat kumto ki aiñ jong ki Mid bad ki Persia ym khong kano kano ka lawlynnong kaba u syiem u la ai ïa kiba lah ban pyntylli .
translation.en: Then these men assembled unto the king , and said unto the king , Know , O king , that the law of the Medes and Persians is , That no decree nor statute which the king establisheth may be changed .

translation.kha: U Eli u la ïohpdiang ïa kata ka jingsam malu u kylli , Ka jingsait aiu kata ? Uta u Rangbah u saw khleiñ kloi sha u Eli ban ïathuh ha u ïa kaba la jia baroh .
translation.en: And when Eli heard the noise of the crying , he said , What meaneth the noise of this tumult ? And the man came in hastily , and told Eli .
Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law .
translation.kha: Naba ngi pynkut ba u briew u don ka jinglonghok bad U Blei tang lyngba ka jingngeit , bad ym da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa .
U nongaikam thong uba marwei ïa ka thong un ym Lah banbeiñ ïoh ïa ka prais lymda u kohnguh ïa ki rukom pynïaid .
translation.en: And if a man also strive for masteries , yet is he not crowned , except he strive lawfully .

translation.kha: U Jeshua u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi , hynrei kim shemphang ïa kaei kaba u la ñiut .
translation.en: This parable spake Jesus unto them : but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them .

translation.kha: ïa ki jaiñ baïap jong ki , ki jaiñ jynsur , ki jabieng bad ki pla kynsit ;
translation.en: The changeable suits of apparel , and the mantles , and the wimples , and the crisping pins ,
And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings , yea , moreover of bonds and imprisonment :
translation.kha: Ïa ki katto katne la rkhiebeiñ bad sympat , bad ïa kiwei pat la teh ha ki kynjri bad la set phatok ïa ki .

translation.en: For he hath said , It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God .
translation.kha: U ong ba kam wanrah ei ei kaba bha haba u pyrshang ban bud ïa ka mon U Blei .
Kumba U Trai U Blei! jong phi u la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen Jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , mala u Jakob , un ai ha phi ïa ka ri kob don ki shnong uba heh bad kiba pahuh peh kiba khung shym la tei .
translation.en: And it shall be , when the  Lord  thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give thee great and goodly cities , which thou buildedst not ,

translation.kha: Neng la thngan , hynne phim shym bsa ïa nga , nga la sliang , hynrei phim shym ai jingïadih ïa nga ;
translation.en: For I was an hungred , and ye gave me no meat : I was thirsty , and ye gave me no drink :

translation.kha: Hato ka jingsngewsih ka dei ka bainong na ka bynta kaba bha ? Pynban ki la thiah ka thliew na ka bynta jong nga ba ngan haduh ha ka . To kynmaw kumno ba nga la wan sha me bad kren na ka beit jong ki , kthang ba men ym leh ei ei ïa ki ha ka jingtip .
translation.en: Shall evil be recompensed for good ? for they have digged a pit for my soul . Remember that I stood before thee to speak good for them , and to turn away thy wrath from them .

translation.kha: Ngan pynkhie da ka thlim ban pynsakma ïa phiah kylleng kylleng ki ri nongïoh . Ka ri jong phi kan sah kynjah , badno ki shnong jong phi kin sah ha ka jingot .
translation.en: And I will scatter you among the heathen , and will draw out a sword after you : and your land shall be desolate , and your cities waste .

translation.kha: bad ïa ki briew jong ki jaitbynriew baroh yn ïalang ha khmat jong u . Nangno un phiah ïa ki ha ki ar kynhun , kumba u nongrahbor u pynïakhlad ïa ki langbrot na ki blang .
translation.en: And before him shall be gathered all nations : and he shall separate them one from another , as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats :

translation.kha: To wat leh kyrkieh ha kaba Buh ïa ki kti phalor jongno jongki ban pynkyntang ïa u sha ka kam U Trai . To wat ïaduna bynta ha ki pop jong kiwei ; to ri ïa lade uba sngur .
translation.en: Lay hands suddenly on no man , neither be partaker of other men s sins : keep thyself pure .

translation.kha: Ngi kyntait ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba phi la ïathuh ha ka kyrteng jong U Tlai .
translation.en: As for the word that thou hast spoken unto us in the name of the  Lord  , we will not hearken unto thee .

translation.kha: U Trai u ni bad nga , ngan ym sheptieng ; u briew un lah leh aïu ïa nga ?
translation.en: The  Lord  is on my side  ; I will not fear : what can man do unto me ?

translation.kha: woh ngim pyrshing — phan ym shah pynlehrain biang ; phan ym shah pynjahburom . Phan klet nep ïa ka jingbymlongkhuid kum ka tnga ba dang kham samla , bad ïa ka jingweng marwei ba shah ibeiñ kamon ka riewkynthei .
translation.en: Fear not  ; for thou shalt not be ashamed : neither be thou confounded  ; for thou shalt not be put to shame : for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth , and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more .

translation.kha: U la pyllaitluid noh ïa u Briew uba ki la kiaw , uta uba la shah set bynñiaw na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin malu ka jingpynïap bhabriew , bad u la Aiti ïa U Jehu ha ki ban leh kumba ki la kwah .
translation.en: And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison , whom they had desired  ; but he delivered Jesus to their will .

And when the woman saw that she was not hid , she came trembling , and falling down before him , she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him , and how she was healed immediately .
translation.kha: Kata ka kynthei ka la ïohi ba la lap ïa ka , kumta ka la wan da kaba khynñiuh bad ka dem khrup ha ki kjat jong U Jisu . Hangta ha khmat jong uwei pa uwei baroh , ka la ïathuh ïa u balei ba ka la ktah ïa u bad kumno ba la pynkhiah ïa ka shisyndon .

translation.en: And those twelve stones , which they took out of Jordan , did Joshua pitch in Gilgal .
translation.kha: Hangta u Joshua u pynïeng ïa ki khat-ar tylli ki maw ba la shim na ka Jordan .
Wat ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga u para u kpa jong me , naba ka dei hi ka kmienah jongnga me .
translation.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father s brother , thou shalt not approach to his wife : she is thine aunt .

translation.kha: Ai ba ngan buh ha kane ka rukom : Uto pa uwei na phiah u ong ïa kaei kaei kaba ïapher . Uwei u nong , Nga bud ïa u Philip ; uwei pat , Ang bud ïa u Apollos ; uwei pat , Nga bud ïa u Petros ; bad uwei pat , Na bud ïa U Khrist .
translation.en: Now this I say , that every one of you saith , I am of Paul ; and I of Apollos ; and I of Cephas ; and I of Christ .
And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour , or buyest ought of thy neighbour s hand , ye shall not oppress one another :
translation.kha: Kumta , haba phi ïadie ïathied khyndew para Israel , wat ïashukor paralok hi .

Keiñ ka long kaei kaba nga ngut , ko parabangeit jong nga . Haba phi ïashem lang ïa ka ban mane ïa U Blei , eiei u to ka jingkhawai , uwei pat ïa ka jingïakhaïi , uwei patar ïa ka jingpynpaw na U Blei , sa utai pat ha ki thylliej bapher , bad sa uwei pat ïa ka jingbthei ïa katai kaba la kren . Baroh ki dei ban long ki ban ïarap ïa ka bajlan .
translation.en: How is it then , brethren ? when ye come together , every one of you hath a psalm , hath a doctrine , hath a tongue , hath a revelation , hath an interpretation . Let all things be done unto edifying .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki nongbah na ki jaka jong ki jait Judah bad Simeon ïa kiba la ai
translation.en: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah , and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon , these cities which are here mentioned by name ,

translation.kha: Hobab ka Sngi Bishar ka poi , kiba babe keiñ ong ha nga , ‘ A Trai , A Trai ! Ha ka kyrteng jong me ngi la kren ïa ka khubor jong U Blei , da ka kyrteng jong me ngi la beh noh ïa shibun ki ksiew bad ngi la leh shibun ki kabu !’
translation.en: Many will say to me in that day , Lord , Lord , have we not prophesied in thy name ? and in thy name have cast out devils ? and in thy name done many wonderful works ?

Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread ? and your labour for that which satisfieth not ? hearken diligently unto me , and eat ye that which is good , and let your soul delight itself in fatness .
translation.kha: Balei ban pynlut pisa ha kaei ka bym ai jinghun ? Balei ban pynlut ïa ka bainong jong phi bad ban dang hap shahthngan hi ? To shahshkor ïa nga bad leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong , bad phin sngewtynnat ïa ka jingbam kaba bang tam na baroh .

U Trai u la ong , Ko khun u brup , rim ïa ka waitlam kaba nep , bad pynmong ïa ka ban khi ïa la u ñiuhtmoh bad u ñiuhkhlieh jong me baroh . Nangta thew ïa u shñiuh ha ka tarajur bad pynbynta ïa u ha ki lai bynta .
translation.en: And thou , son of man , take thee a sharp knife , take thee a barber s razor , and cause it to pass upon thine head and upon thy beard : then take thee balances to weigh , and divide the hair .
That they may believe that the  Lord  God of their fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , hath appeared unto thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Leh ïa kane ban pynshisha ha ki Israel ba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob , u la mihpaw ha me .

U Tharai u la pynïap hynñiewphew ngut ki nongbah uba na Betah Shemesh namar ba ki khmih shapoh ka Synduk ka Jutang . Gera u paidbah u ïam pangnud namar ba U Trai u la pynjia kat tala ka jingpynïap hapdeng jong ki .
translation.en: And he smote the men of Beth–shemesh , because they had looked into the ark of the  Lord  , even he smote of the people fifty thousand and threescore and ten men : and the people lamented , because the  Lord  had smitten many of the people with a great slaughter .

translation.kha: Thaw met tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar mala pyndait ïa ki ha ki kjat jong ka baroh’ saw tylli , ar ar tylli ki kyrwoh ha kawei kawei ka liang .
translation.en: And thou shalt cast four rings of gold for it , and put them in the four corners thereof  ; and two rings shall be in the one side of it , and two rings in the other side of it .

translation.kha: Haba me khang ïa u slap ban hap Namar ba ki briew ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , bad nangta haba ki kylla-kaba-mut bad phai khmat sha kane ka Templ , ki da kyrpad da kaba sngew ha me , to shahshkor ïa ki na bneng .
translation.en: When heaven is shut up , and there is no rain , because they have sinned against thee  ; if they pray toward this place , and confess thy name , and turn from their sin , when thou afflictest them :

translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u pynskhem biang ïa ka kynhun ki lyngdoh bad ki lehbeiñ , hapoh jong sakma uwei pa aiwai u to la ka jong ka jong ka kamram . Kine ki kynthup ïa ki jingweng thang bad ki jingainguh ïasyllok , kaba shngiam bynta ha ka jingmane ha ka templ , bad kaba ai ïa ka jingïaroh pynlang jingainguh ha ki pyntwa bapher jong ka Templ .
translation.en: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses , every man according to his service , the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings , to minister , and to give thanks , and to praise in the gates of the tents of the  Lord .
And ye shall not swear by my name falsely , neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat ai ka jingkular ha ka kyrteng jong nga lada phim don jingmut ban bat ïa ka ; kata ka wanrah ïa ka jingpynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
Katba dum bun ki duwan ba ki dala Israel ki thaw ban pynkhuid ïa ki pep , katta nang bun ki jaka ba ki ïoh ban leh pop .
translation.en: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin , altars shall be unto him to sin .
Then said David to Jonathan , Who shall tell me ? or what if thy father answer thee roughly ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u kylli ,  Mano ban pyntip ïa nga lada i pa jong phi i kren dom ïa phi ?
bad u nongshun uba la bet ïa ki ñiah u long u ksiew . Ka jingot ka long kaba kut lad ka Ïa , bad ki nongot ki long ki ebanjelist .
translation.en: The enemy that sowed them is the devil  ; the harvest is the end of the world  ; and the reapers are the angels .
And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day , and put themselves in array against Gibeah , as at other times .
translation.kha: Nangta lynter ha ka sngi kaba lai ki leit tur pyrshah ïa ki kynhun shipai Benjamin bad ki pynïeng ïa la ki shipai pyrshah ïa ka Gibeah , kumba ki la leh mynshuwa .

translation.en: To open the blind eyes , to bring out the prisoners from the prison , and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house .
translation.kha: Phin pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong kiba matlah bad pyllaitluid ïa kito kiba shong ha ki ïingbyndi ba-dum .
uba la duh bor ha ka katei lieng ka kjat ;
translation.en: Or a man that is brokenfooted , or brokenhanded ,
So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour , and saith , Am not I in sport ?
translation.kha: U briew uba ïalam bakla ïano ïano bad nangta u kam ba u shu biria u long kum u briew uba lamwir uba ïalehkai bad ka tiar kaba pynïap .
Mynba ki kpa tymmen jong phiah ki leit shiah Ijipt , ki ïadon baroh tang hynñiewphew ngut ; hynne mynta U blem u la pynroi ïa phi kat ki khlur ha ka sahit bneng .
translation.en: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons  ; and now the  Lord  thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u , Ko khun jong nga , nga khih ban tei ïa ka Templ ban pyndonburom ïa U Trai U Blei jong nga .
translation.en: And David said to Solomon , My son , as for me , it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the  Lord  my God :
But if she bear a maid child , then she shall be unclean two weeks , as in her separation : and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days .
translation.kha: Khatsaw sngi hadien ba ka kynthei ka kha khun kynthei , kan long ka bymkhuid kum ha ka por ba ka poi bnai . Nangta kan shim por pat sa hynriewphew hynriew sngi ba yn ñiew ïa ka kaba la khuid biang na ka jingmihsnam .
Nangno nga la buh ïa ki khuri bad ki pynbang ba la dap waiñ ha iitkhmat ki Rekhab , badno nga ong ïa ki , To dih waiñ khyndiat .
translation.en: And I set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites pots full of wine , and cups , and I said unto them , Drink ye wine .
They shall not hunger nor thirst  ; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them : for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them , even by the springs of water shall he guide them .
translation.kha: Kin ym shahthngan lane sliang shuh . Ka jingshit jong ka sngi bad ka ri shyiap kin ym pynjynjar ïa ki , namar yn ïalam ïa ki da uta uba ieit ïa ki . Un ïalam ïa ki sha ki umpohliew .

translation.en: And the fear of the  Lord  fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah , so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u pynlong ïa ki hima kiba don sawdong ban sheptieng ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat .

translation.en: And Laban said to Jacob , Behold this heap , and behold this pillar , which I have cast betwixt me and thee  ;
translation.kha: Hangne kine ki mawbah ba nga la kynton hapdeng jong ngi , bad hangne u maw pynsah jingkynmaw .
U lyngdoh un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka snam jong kata ka mrad , un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad un theh ïa kabu sah , ha trai ka duwan .
translation.en: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger , and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering , and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar .

translation.kha: Hynñiew mynta ïa phi la pyllait na ka pop bad phi long ki mraw jong U Blei . Ka jingryntih ïa phin ka long ka jingim ba la aiti lut sha u , bad ka jingmih ka longsyiem ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: But now being made free from sin , and become servants to God , ye have your fruit unto holiness , and the end everlasting life .

translation.kha: Hynrei kai kiei kaba mihnoh shakor na ka shyntur ki wan na ka dohnud , bad kine ki long kiei ktien kiba pynurlong bymkhuid ïa u bhabriew kat kum ka jinglehniam .
translation.en: But those things which proceed out of the mouth come forth from the heart  ; and they defile the man .

translation.kha: Ki brisoh ibha sngwthuh ki pdiang ïa ki jingpyn-i naba dei , ki briew kiba klun bieit ki tuh ruma shat ka jingjot .
translation.en: The wise in heart will receive commandments : but a prating fool shall fall .

translation.kha: Nga pluh bniah ïa ki jingbthah jong me , nga bishar bniah ïa ki jinghikai jong me .
translation.en: I will meditate in thy precepts , and have respect unto thy ways .

And Moses told his father in law all that the  Lord  had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel s sake , and all the travail that had come upon them by the way , and how the  Lord  delivered them .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ïathuh ha u Jethro ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U  Trai  u la leh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki nong Ijipt khnang ba un ïoh pyllait im ïa ki Israel . U la ïathuh ruh ha u ïa ki jingeh ba ki Israel ki la ïakynduh ha lynti bad kumno U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa ki .
Ngan long shlur bad ngan kren-ïa tang shaphang kaei kaba U Khrist u la leh lyngba jong nga , ban ïalam ïa ki Jingtylli ïa-ban kohnguh ïa U Blei . U la leh ïa kane da ki ktien bad ki kam ,
translation.en: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me , to make the Gentiles obedient , by word and deed ,

translation.kha: mynba u syiemsad Sedekaïah bad baroh ki shipai jong u ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jliah , ki la pyrshang ban phet na ka nongap ha ka por mynhynnin . Ki la phet na ka lyndet jong ka kper Syiem , ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka khyrdop kambah pynïasoh ïa ki ar tylli ki kynrup , bad phet na ka liang jong ka Them Jordan .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when Zedekiah the king of Judah saw them , and all the men of war , then they fled , and went forth out of the city by night , by the way of the king s garden , by the gate betwixt the two walls : and he went out the way of the plain .

translation.kha: ianga ki la wan poh ha u Jakob u kparad jong ki ha ka ri Kanaan , ki ïathuh lut ha u ïa kaba la jia ha ki baroh :
