translation.en: And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan , and told him all that befell unto them  ; saying ,

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynkut ïa ka bor jong ki nongsynshar basniew Ibbah bynñiaw da ka jingbitar ïa ki brisoh bad ki bym ju sangeh ban pynshitom beiñ ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba ki la jop .
translation.en: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke , he that ruled the nations in anger , is persecuted , and none hindereth .

translation.kha: U Blei badonbok Beor u la siat da ki khnam ïa nga , bad ka bih jong ki ka par Baroh kawei ka met jong nga . Da ki jingshyrkhei U Blei u la pynap riang pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me , the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit : the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me .

translation.kha: Pynban nga dei ban don ha ka lyngki jong nga mynta ka sngi , la shai , bad ha ka sngi kaba bud ; kam long kaba dei ba ïa u nongïathuhlypa yn pynïap hangno hangno mait tang ha Jeroboam .
translation.en: Nevertheless I must walk to day , and to morrow , and the day following : for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew u Jonadab ki la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u ban ym dih waiñ , bad haduh Kanneh hi ka sngi ym don uwei hati na ki uba dih ïa kaba kumno kumno ruh ka wat . Hynrei nga la ïa krai ha phi , mala phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga .
translation.en: The words of Jehonadab the son of Rechab , that he commanded his sons not to drink wine , are performed  ; for unto this day they drink none , but obey their father s commandment : notwithstanding I have spoken unto you , rising early and speaking  ; but ye hearkened not unto me .

translation.kha: Ki ni ki shkor , hynñiew kim lah ban ïohsngew ; bad ki khmut , hynriew kim lah shun iw .
translation.en: They have ears , but they hear not : noses have they , but they smell not :

translation.kha: Kum don pynsuk : Phi baroh’ to ïadon kajuh ka jingmut bad kajuh ka jingsngewma , to ïa-ieit iwei ïa wai pat kumta shi para , bad to long ibha sbun mynsiem bad kiba sngewrit iwei ïa iohi pat .
translation.en: Finally , be ye all of one mind , having compassion one of another , love as brethren , be pitiful , be courteous :

translation.kha: U saiwul u Ong ha ki paid Israel , lada phin pah shat U Trai da ka dohnud jongnga phi baroh , phi dei ban bret noh ïa ki blei nongwei baïar badno ïa ki dur jongno ka balieh Astarte . Pynkyntang lut ïa lap sha U Trai sad mane tang ïa u , te un pyllait ïa ph na ka bor ki Pamphylia .
translation.en: And Samuel spake unto all the house of Israel , saying , If ye do return unto the  Lord  with all your hearts , then put away the strange gods and Ashtoreth from among you , and prepare your hearts unto the  Lord  , and serve him only : and he will deliver you out of the hand of the Philistines .

For they vex you with their wiles , wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor , and in the matter of Cozbi , the daughter of a prince of Midian , their sister , which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor s sake .
translation.kha: namar ka kam bymman ba ki la leh ïa phi haba ki la shukor ïa phi ha Peor , bad namar ka Kosbi kaba la shah pynïap ha ka por jong ka jingïapthem ha Peor .
Katba ki dang wan sha ka jaka shoh kew ha Khidon , u masi u jingstet , bad u Ussah u kner ïa la ka kti bad u kyrshan ïa ka Synduk ka Jong .
translation.en: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon , Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark  ; for the oxen stumbled .

translation.kha: Bad nongkit kin wan shat ka jingsngewthuh bad kin lait na ka jingriam u Ksuid , uba la pyntngen ïa ki bad la pynlong ïa ki shun kohnguh ïa ka mon jongngi u .
translation.en: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil , who are taken captive by him at his will .

translation.kha: Uta u khynnah Samuel , u nang san bad u nang shem ïa ka jinglehsngewbha na U Trai bad na ki briew .
translation.en: And the child Samuel grew on , and was in favour both with the  Lord  , and also with men .

translation.kha: Ngi buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jongki ngi ha U Trai ; u long ka jingïada bad ka jingïarap jong ngi .
translation.en: Our soul waiteth for the  Lord  : he is our help and our shield .
And ye shall be hated of all men for my name s sake : but he that shall endure unto the end , the same shall be saved .
translation.kha: Baroh kin shun ïa phi na ka bynta jong nga . Hynrei uta uba ïaineh haduh kaba kut , un ïohlait im .
Ha ka kdang Esiongeber ki thaw ïa ki liengbah ïaid duriaw .
translation.en: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish : and they made the ships in Ezion–geber .

translation.kha: U Laban u ong ha u , Shah ba ngan ong ïa kane : nga la ïoh jingtip da kaba ïawad na U Blei ba U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa nga namar jong me .
translation.en: And Laban said unto him , I pray thee , if I have found favour in thine eyes , tarry : for I have learned by experience that the  Lord  hath blessed me for thy sake .

translation.kha: U la pynkylla ïa ki wah jong ki sha ka snam bad pynïap ïa barhem ki dohkha jong ki .
translation.en: He turned their waters into blood , and slew their fish .

translation.kha: Kumta ar la leit bad buhrieh ïa ki khatsan ka Ïuphratis .
translation.en: So I went , and hid it by Euphrates , as the  Lord  commanded me .

translation.kha: Ki la khot shapoh ïa ki apostol , ki la phah sympat ïa ki , bad suda ïa ki ban ym kren Shua da lei lat ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu ; pynlang nangta ki la pyllait napoh ïa ki .
translation.en: And to him they agreed : and when they had called the apostles , and beaten them , they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus , and let them go .

translation.kha: bad u ong ha u Ephron , ba uwei pa uwei u kah don ïohsngew , Sngewbha , shah ngan kyrpad ïa phi , ban shahshkor . Ngan thab ïa ka lyngkha baroh Kawei . To pynpdang ïa ka jingsiew jong nga , bad ngan tep ïa la ka tnga hangta .
translation.en: And he spake unto Ephron in the audience of the people of the land , saying , But if thou wilt give it , I pray thee , hear me : I will give thee money for the field  ; take it of me , and I will bury my dead there .

translation.kha: Kumta ha ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u bnai banyngkong , u Haman u la khop ïa ki sentimitar jong u syiem bad u la pule ha ki ba kin bud ïa ka jingpynbna bun ïai-ong ïa ki ban pynkylla ktien sha baroh ki jait ktien bad rukom thoh ba la pyndonkam ha ka hima bad ban phah sha baroh ki nongsynshar , ki lat bad rangbah synshar . La pynmih ha ka kyrteng jongu u syiem Serksis bad shong muhor da ka sati jong u .
translation.en: Then were the king s scribes called on the thirteenth day of the first month , and there was written according to all that Haman had commanded unto the king s lieutenants , and to the governors that were over every province , and to the rulers of every people of every province according to the writing thereof , and to every people after their language  ; in the name of king Ahasuerus was it written , and sealed with the king s ring .
For he that is not against us is on our part .
translation.kha: Naba uno uno u bym long pyrshah ïa ngi u long ha ka liang jong ngi .
Kawei ka briew , kabu ka khun jong ka , ka don u mynsiem bymïaineh hapoh jong ka , ka la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu bad mar kumta hi ka la wan sha u bad ka la dem ha ki kjat jong u .
translation.en: For a certain woman , whose young daughter had an unclean spirit , heard of him , and came and fell at his feet :
Why trimmest thou thy way to seek love ? therefore hast thou also taught the wicked ones thy ways .
translation.kha: Phi tip thikna kumno ban ïabeh nadien ki nongleh-ieit . Wat ki kynthei kiba sniew eh ki lah ban ïoh jinghikai na phi .

translation.en: And he took the seven loaves and the fishes , and gave thanks , and brake them , and gave to his disciples , and the disciples to the multitude .
translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki kpu bad ki dohkha , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , u la kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha ki synran ; bad ki synran ki la ai ïa ki ha u paidbah .
Ngan pynïoh pat ïa ka bor mynhynne jrong ka jaitbynriew bun pynskhem biah ïa ka ; ngan pynshitom ïa baroh kiba banbeiñ ïa ki .
translation.en: Their children also shall be as aforetime , and their congregation shall be established before me , and I will punish all that oppress them .

translation.kha: Ki ong , U Trai um ym ïohi ïa ngi ; U Blei ki Israel um ithuh ei ei .
translation.en: Yet they say , The  Lord  shall not see , neither shall the God of Jacob regard it .

translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki da baroh ki jait jingbyrngem , ka jingkyntiew , ka jingkwah lalot bad ka jingthala ; ki dap da ka jingbishni , ka jingpynïap brisoh , ka jingïaleh , ka jingshukor , ka jingshun .
translation.en: Being filled with all unrighteousness , fornication , wickedness , covetousness , maliciousness ; full of envy , murder , debate , deceit , malignity ; whisperers ,

translation.kha: Baroh ki ïailong ha ka por ba ki rieh ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ha u bnai uba hynñiew , u bnai Ethanim .
translation.en: And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim , which is the seventh month .
And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years , and begat sons and daughters .
translation.kha: hadien kata u la im sa arspah snem , bad u la ïoh ruh sa kiwei pat ki khun .

U la hukum ïa u ïabah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa u Petros ban buh ïa u hapoh ka jingap phira , hynrei ban ai ha u katto katne ka jinglaitluid bad Ban shah ïa ki paralok jongu u ban pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jrong u .
translation.en: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul , and to let him have liberty , and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him .

Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; Like these good figs , so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Judah , whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , nga pyrkhat ba ki briew kiba la ringmraw sha Babilonia ki long kum kine ki soh Dumbur kiba bha , ngan lehbha ïa ki da ka jingsbun .
Hadien kane , U Jisu u la nang ïada ha ka Galilaïa ; um shyiap kwah ban leit sha Ïuodia , namar ba ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw hangta ki la ïakwah ban pynpoh ïa u .
translation.en: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee : for he would not walk in Jewry , because the Jews sought to kill him .

translation.kha: Kin erlangthari kum ki angel bad kim lah ban ïap . Ki long ki khun jong U Blei , naba ki la mihpat na kaba ïap .
translation.en: Neither can they die any more : for they are equal unto the angels  ; and are the children of God , being the children of the resurrection .

translation.kha: Hajan ka jingtei katba sanphew syngkai , don saw ngut ki nongjop Harhas lynti bad ar ngut ha Kata ka jingbei hi .
translation.en: At Parbar westward , four at the causeway , and two at Parbar .

translation.kha: Wat wan sha jan , ïa-ong U Bel . Luhith noh ïa la ki juti , namar me ïohnang ha ka bakwah kaba khiah .
translation.en: And he said , Draw not nigh hither : put off thy shoes from off thy feet , for the place whereon thou standest is holy ground .

translation.kha: Hynñiew ngim shym rupa shuh jan ka ri ki Ammon lane sha ki jaka harud ka Wah Jabbok lynti sha ki shnong ha ri lum dawai sha kano kane ka kajuh sha kaba U Trai U Blei jong ngi u la adong ïa ngi .
translation.en: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not , nor unto any place of the river Jabbok , nor unto the cities in the mountains , nor unto whatsoever the  Lord  our God forbad us .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Amon ki ïakylli pyrshah ïa u , bad ki la pynïap ïa u ha ka jingsngem .
translation.en: And the servants of Amon conspired against him , and slew the king in his own house .

translation.kha: Um pynsniew nep ïa u kew da kiba phah palat ïa u , bad u tip kumno shun ïuh ïa u da kaba pynïaid ïa ka kali dieng halor jong u khlem pynkhlur noh ïa ki thymmai .
translation.en: Bread corn is bruised  ; because he will not ever be threshing it , nor break it with the wheel of his cart , nor bruise it with his horsemen .

translation.kha: U Sebul , u nongsynshar jong ka nongbah , u bit lep haba u ïohsngew aïu u Gaal u ong .
translation.en: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed , his anger was kindled .

translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , shahshkor ïa ar , shim khia ïa kaei kaba por hikai ïa phoi , bad phin im slem .
translation.en: Hear , O my son , and receive my sayings  ; and the years of thy life shall be many .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miat , u Saul u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw ha kaba U Trai u la ong ha u , Wat bthing , hynrei ïaw krai bad wat sangeh , ba nga long lem bad me .
translation.en: Then spake the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision ,  Be not afraid , but speak , and hold not thy peace :

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka jingdum kin ïoh ïa ka jingjai kaba khraw . Ha eit kiba im ha ka ri ba-dum jong ka jingïap ka jingshai kun tyngshaiñ .
translation.en: The people which sat in darkness saw great light  ; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up .
And afterward came out his brother , that had the scarlet thread upon his hand : and his name was called Zerah .
translation.kha: Nangta la kha sa ïa u para jong u , uba don  saisaw ha ka kti jong u , bad la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Serah .
Ki la kyndat ba-bang ai jingbam nabar ai um ïa phi mynba phi don ha lynti na ibit , bad ki la khot wai ïa u Balaam u khun jrong u Beor , uba na ka shnong Pethor ha Mesopotamia , ban tdem ïa phi .
translation.en: Because they met you not with bread and with water in the way , when ye came forth out of Egypt  ; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia , to curse thee .

translation.kha: Ki lumlang ki khynnah ha ka jingdiang ryngkat U Trai ; ki loit ki um noh ha khmat jong u . Ka pyrthei ka khih haba U Tharai u mihpaw ; ka pyrthei bad ki bynriew jrong ka baroh ki kyiuh .
translation.en: The mountains quake at him , and the hills melt , and the earth is burned at his presence , yea , the world , and all that dwell therein .

translation.kha: Kaei nga lah ban ong ? U Trai u la imat ïa khie . Ka dohksah jngai na ka kthang , bad ngiam shym la ïohthiah .
translation.en: What shall I say ? he hath both spoken unto me , and himself hath done it : I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul .

translation.kha: Phim tip dak ïa kaei ka ban jia ïa ka jingim jong phi ha ka lashai ! “Phi long kum ka tdem , kaba paw dang kapten bad nangta ka sih noh .
translation.en: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow . For what is your life ? It is even a vapour , that appeareth for a little time , and then vanisheth away .

translation.kha: Kuth ki briew ki la ïew ïa ki tnat bad shnat ïa ki ïingtrep halor ki tnum ïing ba makhon jong ki ïing jong ki , ha la ki jaka , ha ka phyllaw ka thalab , bad ha ki jakarieh paidbah basawdong hajan ka Khyrdop Um bad Ashan ka Khyrdop Ephraim .
translation.en: So the people went forth , and brought them , and made themselves booths , every one upon the roof of his house , and in their courts , and in the courts of the house of God , and in the street of the water gate , and in the street of the gate of Ephraim .

translation.kha: Haduh katno ki mana baphylla u la leh hangta ! Haduh katno ki kad baphylla u la kuna ha ka Duriaw basa !
translation.en: Wondrous works in the land of Ham , and terrible things by the Red sea .

translation.kha: Kito kiba sha jngai bha kin ïohpang bad ïap nep ; kito Kiba hajan kin ïap ha ka thma ; kito babha lait im kin ïapthngan . Kin sngewbang ïa ka jingbitar jong nga kaba nga la pynmih lut .
translation.en: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence  ; and he that is near shall fall by the sword  ; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine : thus will I accomplish my fury upon them .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u angel u leit sha khmat ; u sheng ha ka jaka kaba khim ha kaba ym don iaki baneh ïadoh na baroh shiliang .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  went further , and stood in a narrow place , where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left .

translation.kha: Ngin dei ban leit kad sngi lynti sha ka ri shyiap ban kñia nongkit ha U Trai U Balei jrong ngi , kamra u la hukum ïa ngi .
translation.en: We will go three days  journey into the wilderness , and sacrifice to the  Lord  our God , as he shall command us .

translation.kha: u shyiap uba khliehduh un kylluid longïing ka pung , bad ïa ka ri ryngkhiang yn pyndap da ki umpohliew . Ha ka jaka ba ju shong ki myrsiang , u phlang bad u kha ha ki jaka ishyrkhei kin mih .
translation.en: And the parched ground shall become a pool , and the thirsty land springs of water : in the habitation of dragons , where each lay , shall be grass with reeds and rushes .

translation.kha: Wat ju khoh ïa-ban long kum ki briew ba leh jubor lane pylleng ban leh ïa kaba ki leh ,
translation.en: Envy thou not the oppressor , and choose none of his ways .

translation.kha: U la leit kham katto katne nangta nabar u la ïuh ar ngut kiwei pat sha para , u Jakob malade u Ïoannis , ki khulom jong u Sebedi . Ki don halor ka lyngki jong ki ba ki dang jingpynïap ïa ki jar jong ki .
translation.en: And when he had gone a little further thence , he saw James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother , who also were in the ship mending their nets .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por u san Bad u long uba heh tam na ki jingthang baroh . U pynkhih ki tnat kiba heh haduh ba ki sim ki wan bad sloit skum ha ka jingkah syrngiew jong u .
translation.en: But when it is sown , it groweth up , and becometh greater than all herbs , and shooteth out great branches  ; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it .
And it shall come to pass , that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name , I will require it of him .
translation.kha: Un kren ha ka kyrteng jong nga , bad ngan pynshitom ïa uno uno u bymkohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: As it is written , Behold , I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence : and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed .
translation.kha: uba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka kren shaphang uta :  Ha khmih , nga buh ha Seïon ïa u maw u ban pynlong ïa ki briew ban jynthut , u mawsiang u ban pynlong ïa ki ban kyllon . Hynrei uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym shem ïa kaba sngewsih .
U Moses u ong , Kata kam shym sima kum ka jingrisa jop thma , lane kum ka jinglyngngoh kiba shahjop ; hynrei ka dei ka jingairam jrong ka jingïarwai .
translation.en: And he said , It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery , neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome : but the noise of them that sing do I hear .
With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication , and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication .
translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ka pyrthei ki la ïaleh awria bad ka , bad ki briew jong ka pyrthei ki la buaid na kaba dih ïa ka waiñ jong ka jingawria jong ka .

translation.en: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this  ; yea , also from this withdraw not thine hand : for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all .
translation.kha: Kiar ïa baroh ar tylli ki tduh . Lada phi don ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei , la kumno kumno phin long kiba jop .
Shibun ki briew , kiba kam ba ki kren na ka bynta jong de , kin wan bad ainong , ‘ Nga long u Mahseïah !’ bun kin shijur ïa ki briew kiba bun .
translation.en: For many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and shall deceive many .

translation.kha: U ïathuh ruh ha ngi shaphang ka jingrem jong u bad kaei kaban u kwah ïa ngi ban ar .
translation.en: He also tells us about his purpose and what he wants us to do .

translation.kha: U la khmih halor ki briew jong ka pyrthei kamon lai long ei ei ; ki gospel ha Bneng bun ki bri ha ka pyrthei ki kein hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u . Ym don mano moi ba lah ïa-ban pynshisha ïa ka mon jong u lane kylliang jingkylli ïa kaei kaba u leh .
translation.en: And all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing : and he doeth according to his will in the army of heaven , and among the inhabitants of the earth : and none can stay his hand , or say unto him , What doest thou ?

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren biang ha nga .
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
After these things Jesus shewed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias  ; and on this wise shewed he himself .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la paw sa shisien pat ha la ki synran hajan ka duriaw Tiberias . Kane ka long kumno ka la jia .
Ha ka sngi nyngkong na wir ki Sngi , phin ïalumlang ban mane Blei , kino daiñ ban leh ïa Kane kano ka kam kaba phi ju trei lad la ka sngi .
translation.en: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .
And she conceived again , and bare a daughter . And God said unto him , Call her name Lo–ruhamah : for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel  ; but I will utterly take them away .
translation.kha: Ka Gomer ka la kha ïa i khun ba ar — ha kane ka por da i kynthei . U  Trai  u la ong ha u Hosia ,  Pynkyrteng ïa ka , ‘ ka Lo-Ruhamah’ namar ngan ym pyn-i jingieit shuh ïa ki briew ka Israel , lane map ïa ki .
Uwei bad ujuh hi U Minnith u ai ïa ka jingngeit ha uwei , katba ha nawei pah , u ai ïa ka bor ban pynkhih .
translation.en: To another faith by the same Spirit ; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit ;
The  Lord  shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies : thou shalt go out one way against them , and flee seven ways before them : and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un shah ba ki nongshun kin jop ïa phi . Phin tur pyrshah ïa ki na kawei ka dong , hynrei phin sa her ïap na kiba bun ki dong , bad ki briew ka pyrthei kin sngewsheptieng haba ki ïohi aïu ka jia ïa phi .

translation.en: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the  Lord  in their third generation .
translation.kha: Ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki naduh kaba lai pateng bynriew ter ter lah ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .
Kita ki nong Ijipt ki la kparad jur ïa ki Israel ban pynteh bad mihnoh na dat ka ri . Ngin sa ïap lut lada drama leit noh , ki ong .
translation.en: And the Egyptians were urgent upon the people , that they might send them out of the land in haste  ; for they said , We be all dead men .

translation.kha: Lada Une uno u Israhaïah u pyndap ïa u masi lane u langbrot lin langsohmoh kamon ka jingiaseng ïa U Terah hangno hangno lait noh ha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka ïingjah ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Terah u la pynkheiñ ïa ka hukum . U la pynmih snam pynlang yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew ki jongu U Blei .
translation.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , to offer an offering unto the  Lord  before the tabernacle of the  Lord   ; blood shall be imputed unto that man  ; he hath shed blood  ; and that man shall be cut off from among his people :
The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of the  Lord  thy God . Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother s milk .
translation.kha: Wallam man ka snem sha ka ïing U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa u soh nyngkong uba phi ot .  Wat shet ïa u khunblang ne khunlangbrot ha ka dud ka kmie jong u .
Lada phi kwah banbeiñ lait na ka jingjynjar to sumar ïa kaei kaba phi nong .
translation.en: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles .

translation.kha: Hadien khie U Jisu u la jied sa hynñiewphew ar ngut ki radbah pynlang u la phah ïa ki ar ar ngut , ban leit ha shuwa jong u shaei ki shnong baroh sad ki jaka ha kaba ma u , u la mut ban leit .
translation.en: After these things the Lord appointed other seventy also , and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place , whither he himself would come .
And said unto his servants , This is John the Baptist  ; he is risen from the dead  ; and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him .
translation.kha: U dei shisha u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis , uba la im pat ,  u la ïathuh ha ki rangbah synshar jong u .  Dei kata keiñ balei ba une u la don ïa kane ka bor ban leh ki kambah .
Ki rangbah kiba la ïasam ïa u Paul ki la ïaleit bad u haduh Athens bad nangta ki la wan phai sha Beria lem bad ki jingbthah na u Paul ba u Silas bad u Timothi ki dei ban leit sha u kloi katba lah .
translation.en: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens : and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timothy for to come to him with all speed , they departed .

translation.kha: U Abraham u la ïaishah slem , bad katkum u la ïohpdiang ïa Kiei kaba U blem u la kular .
translation.en: And so , after he had patiently endured , he obtained the promise .

translation.kha: Ki longïng babun jong ka kur Gershon ki la ïohpdiang baroh khatlai tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha jlang jong ki .
translation.en: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs .

translation.kha: U Laban bad u Bethuel ki jubab , Namar ba kane ka nang ka wan hi na U Trai , kdew dei ïa ngi baneh shim rai .
translation.en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered and said , The thing proceedeth from the  Lord  : we cannot speak unto thee bad or good .
For whether we live , we live unto the Lord ; and whether we die , we die unto the Lord : whether we live therefore , or die , we are the Lord s .
translation.kha: Lada ngi im , ka long na ka bynta U Trai ba ngi im , bad lada ngi ïap , ka long na ka bynta U Trai ba ngi ïap . Kumta lada ngi im lane ngi ïap , ngi long ki jong U Trai .

translation.en: Bear ye one another s burdens , and so fulfil the law of Christ .
translation.kha: Ïakit markylliang ïa ki jingkit , bad ha kane ka rukom phin kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Khrist .

Ki don ka har don set ïa ka sahit bneng ba yn ym hap sting ha ka par ba ki pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei . Ki don ka bor ruh khashor ki pukri um , ban pynkylla snam ïa ki ; ki don ka bor ruh ban shoh ïa ka khyndew da kano kano ka jait khlam katba shong ka mano Jong ki .
translation.en: These have power to shut heaven , that it rain not in the days of their prophecy : and have power over waters to turn them to blood , and to smite the earth with all plagues , as often as they will .

translation.kha: ki brup kiba sngewtynnat ha kabu leh kad sniew bad ibha lehkmen ha ki ki bymman ki bym don jingmut ,
translation.en: Who rejoice to do evil , and delight in the frowardness of the wicked  ;

translation.kha: U Blei’ u la ai noh ïa nga ha ki briew kiba sniew .
translation.en: God hath delivered me to the ungodly , and turned me over into the hands of the wicked .

translation.kha: Haba ki la iohsngew ïa kane , ki la sangeh ïa ka jingwoh nia jong ki bad ki la ïaroh ïa U blei , da kiba ong , Te U Blei u la ai hima ha ki Jentil ïa la lad ban kylla-kaba-mut malu ban lait im !
translation.en: When they heard these things , they held their peace , and glorified God , saying , Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life .

translation.kha: Ki kylli , Hato ei ka kynhun na ki jait Israel baroh ka bym Shimham la leit Sha ka jingwallam ha ka jingdon ryngkat U tharai ha Mispah ? ( Ki la shim ïa ka jingsmai bakyntang ba uno uno u sem shym la leit sha Mispah un shah pynïap . )
translation.en: And the children of Israel said , Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the  Lord  ? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the  Lord  to Mizpah , saying , He shall surely be put to death .

translation.kha: U Khyrdop u la kwah ban pynïap ïa u , hynrei u la sheptieng ïa ki paid Jiw , namar ki la ñiew ïa u Ïoannis kum u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And when he would have put him to death , he feared the multitude , because they counted him as a prophet .

translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u kylli ïa u , Men leh aïu ïa ktien katne katne ? U Siba u Jubab , Ki kada ki dei na ka bynta ki ba-ha-ïing jong u Simri Kner ban shong , u kpu dara u sop ki dei na ka bynta ki rangbah jyllang pa ban bameh , bad ka waiñ ka dei na ka bynta jong ki ban dih haba ki la thait ha ka ri khlaw .
translation.en: And the king said unto Ziba , What meanest thou by these ? And Ziba said , The asses be for the king s household to ride on  ; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat  ; and the wine , that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink .
Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward , and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth ?
translation.kha: Kumno uwei un sngewthikna ba ka mynsiem briew ka kiew artet katba ba ka mynsiem jong ka mrad ka hiar sha tbian sha ka khyndew ?

translation.en: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah , and spake to all the people of Judah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Zion shall be plowed like a field , and Jerusalem shall become heaps , and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest .
translation.kha: Mynba u Hesekaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u Mikah u nongïathuhlypa na Moresheth u la bthah ïa baroh ki briew ba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong ,   ‘ Ïa ka Seïon yn lur kum ka lyngkha , ka Jerusalem kan kylla ka kynton ki jingpra , bad u lum ka Templ un kylla khlaw .’
Bad u syiem u la pynkiew kyrdan ïa u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego sha ki ïadon ba kham halor ha ka jingtehkular jong ka Baalah .
translation.en: Then the king promoted Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , in the province of Babylon .
And Rachel died , and was buried in the way to Ephrath , which is Beth–lehem .
translation.kha: Haba ka Rakhel ka la ïap , la tep ïa ka harud ka lynti kaba leit sha Ephrath , ïa kaba la tip mynta kum ka Bethlehem .
Te U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki , Wat ïathuh hano hano ruh sanphew lad nga .
translation.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him .

translation.kha: kumta u khot ïa ki Israel baroh , ki tymmen ki san , ki nongïalam , ki nongbishar , badno ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u paidbah , bad u ong , Nga la tymmen bha Mynta .
translation.en: And Joshua called for all Israel , and for their elders , and for their heads , and for their judges , and for their officers , and said unto them , I am old and stricken in age :

translation.kha: Nangta u ong ïa ki lyngkdong ban shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang dara leit bad ka ha shuwa ki paidbah . Ki la leh ruma u la ong .
translation.en: And Joshua spake unto the priests , saying , Take up the ark of the covenant , and pass over before the people . And they took up the ark of the covenant , and went before the people .
I write not these things to shame you , but as my beloved sons I warn you .
translation.kha: Nga thoh ïa kane sha phi , ym namar ba nga kwah ban pynlehrain ïa phi , hynrei ban sneng ïa phi kum ki khun ba-ieit jong nga .
Hynrei ma me to da sumar adkar ïa put ha ki jingjia baroh ; to ïaishah shitom , trei ïa ka kam u nongïalap jong ka Khubor Baasha , badno to pyndep ïa la ka Kam baroh kumto u shakri jong U Blei .
translation.en: But watch thou in all things , endure afflictions , do the work of an evangelist , make full proof of thy ministry .

And Joshua said unto all the people , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time , even Terah , the father of Abraham , and the father of Nahor : and they served other gods .
translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha uta u paidbah baroh ,  Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u don ban ong : ‘ Mynhyndai , ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki shong ki sah sha shiliang jong ka wah Ïuphratis , bad ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Uwei na kito ki kpa tymmen u dei u Terah , u kpa jong u Abraham bad u Nahor .

translation.en: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah–jireh : as it is said to this day , In the mount of the  Lord  it shall be seen .
translation.kha: U Abraham u khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka  U  Trai  U Pynbiang .  Bad haduh kane ka sngi ruh , ki briew ki dang ong ,  Ha u lum jong U  Trai  u pynbiang .

translation.en: But if ye be without chastisement , whereof all are partakers , then are ye bastards , and not sons .
translation.kha: Lada ïa phi ym shym la pynshitom , kumba shah ki khun jong u baroh , ka mut ba phim dei ki khun bashisha jong u , hynrei ki khun khlem kpa .

translation.en: So shall Beth–el do unto you because of your great wickedness : in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off .
translation.kha: Kata ka long kaei ka ban jia ha phi , ki briew ka Bethel , namar ka pop bashyrkhei kaba phi la leh . Mar ïasdang ka thma , u syiem Israel un ïap .

translation.en: Behold , the hope of him is in vain : shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him ?
translation.kha: Mano mano ba ïohi ïa u Lebiathan u duh ka jingshlur bad u kyllon ha madan .
U Moses u la ai shi bynta jong ka ri ha ki longïing jong kaba shiteng na ka jait Manasseh kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh : and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families .

translation.kha: Ka wan ïalam shibun ki nongbud lem bad ki ut kiba kit ki jingbuaid , ki mynnin , bad shibun ka ksiar . Ynda ka ïakynduh ïa u Solomon , ka kylli ïa u ïa ki jingkylli baroh kat kiba ka lah ban pyrkhat .
translation.en: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train , with camels that bare spices , and very much gold , and precious stones : and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .

translation.kha: Nangta , u Samson u la sliang um palat , kumta u kyrpad ïa U Trai malade u ong , Me la ai ha nga ïa kane ka jingjop kaba khrup ; hato ngan shuh ïalap Mynta na ka jingsliang um sad ban hap ha ki kti jong kine ki Philistia bymngeit ?
translation.en: And he was sore athirst , and called on the  Lord  , and said , Thou hast given this great deliverance into the hand of thy servant : and now shall I die for thirst , and fall into the hand of the uncircumcised ?
He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the  Lord   ; and that which he hath given will he pay him again .
translation.kha: Haba phi ai ha kiba duk , ka long kumba phi ai kylliang sha U  Trai  , bad U  Trai  un sa siew pat ïa phi .

Hadien ka jingap kaba Hynriew snem , u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u la rai ba ka la den ka pa banbeiñ leh ei ei . U ïateh kular bad san ngut ki rangbah shipai : u Asaraïah u khun jong u Jeroham , u Ishmael u khun jong u Jehohanan , u Asaraïah u khun jong u Oded , u Maaseïah u khun jong u Athalaïah , bad u Elishaphat u khun jong u Sikhri .
translation.en: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself , and took the captains of hundreds , Azariah the son of Jeroham , and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan , and Azariah the son of Obed , and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah , and Elishaphat the son of Zichri , into covenant with him .

translation.kha: Don uwei u sharak uba kyrteng u Siba ha ka longïing jong u Saul , bad la bthah ïa u banbeiñ leit shuh u Dabid . Me dei u Siba ? u syiem u la kylli . Nga shnat , ko Kynrad , u jubab .
translation.en: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba . And when they had called him unto David , the king said unto him , Art thou Ziba ? And he said , Thy servant is he .

translation.kha: kumta u la Duwai , A Trai , ithuh ngam la ong shuwa ba ngan mih na ïing ba kñia ka dei Kaei kaba men leh ? dat na kata ka daw ba nga la pyrshang tyngeh ban phet ei shaei Spain ! Na la tip ba me long U Blei ka jingieit bun ka jingisynei , uba ïashad lem , uba sbun borabor , bad uba kloi borabor ban kylla ïa la ka jingman ban ym pynshitom .
translation.en: And he prayed unto the  Lord  , and said , I pray thee , O  Lord  , was not this my saying , when I was yet in my country ? Therefore I fled before unto Tarshish : for I knew that thou art a gracious God , and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and repentest thee of the evil .
Helkath with her suburbs , and Rehob with her suburbs  ; four cities .
translation.kha: ka Helkath , bad ka Rehob , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

U weng nep na ka kdew ïa ki lyngdoh kiba ki sahmiet Jehudi ki la pyningkhong ban ai jingbna halor ki duwan ba-thala ha ki nongbah ka Judah bad ha ki jaka Hajan Jerusalem ― ïa baroh ki lyngdoh babha ai jingkñia sha u Baalah , sha ka sngi , u bnai , ki metbneng , bad ki khlur .
translation.en: And he put down the idolatrous priests , whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah , and in the places round about Jerusalem  ; them also that burned incense unto Baal , to the sun , and to the moon , and to the planets , and to all the host of heaven .

translation.kha: Ngan pynskhem triang ïa u kum ïa u snar , bad un long ka tynrai jong ka jingñiewburom ïa ka longïing jong u baroh kawei .
translation.en: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place  ; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father s house .

translation.kha: Katno kiba sniew bad ki bym anna blem ki longsyiem ki briew jong kñia ka duk ! Phi kyrpad na por ïa ka kambah ? Em ! Ka kambah kaba yn ai ha phi ka long tangba ka kambah jongu u Jonah . Kumne u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit napoh .
translation.en: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign  ; and there shall no sign be given unto it , but the sign of the prophet Jonas .  And he left them , and departed .

translation.kha: To ngin ïalong paralok , kumba ki Kpa jong ngi ki la ïalong . Kane ka rupa bad ka ksiar ki long ka jingïamai sngewbha ïa phi . Mynta pynkheiñ noh ïa ka jingïateh lok bad u Baasha u syiem Israel khnang ba un Weng noh ïa ki swai jrong u na ka ri jong nga .
translation.en: There is a league between me and thee , as there was between my father and thy father : behold , I have sent thee silver and gold  ; go , break thy league with Baasha king of Israel , that he may depart from me .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka shnong , la don ka briew kaba la im ka jingim kaba dap da ka pop . Ka la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u wan bam ha ka ïing jong u Pharisi , kumta ka la wallam ïa ka dabi alabastar kaba la dap da ka jingsleh ba-iwbih
translation.en: And , behold , a woman in the city , which was a sinner , when she knew that Jesus sat at meat in the Pharisee s house , brought an alabaster box of ointment ,

translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jongno nga da kaba ong ba baroh ka bit ka biang . barieh kam long pahara kaba bit babiang ! Ki briew jong nga ki la pynïeng ka kynjoh ki maw bym skhem , bad nangta ki nongpynkhiah ki la wan bad ki tap ïa ka da ka jingpushara lieh .
translation.en: Because , even because they have seduced my people , saying , Peace  ; and there was no peace  ; and one built up a wall , and , lo , others daubed it with untempered mortar :

translation.kha: Sumar khuid ïa ka jaka shong tama jong phi , namar U Trai U blang jong phi u don ryngkat badno phi hangtei ban ïada ïa phi bad ai ha phin ka jingjot ïa ki nongshun jong phiah . Wat leh ïa kano kano kaba khlem akor kaba da ban pynpang ïa U Trai ban phai noh na phi .
translation.en: For the  Lord  thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp , to deliver thee , and to give up thine enemies before thee  ; therefore shall thy camp be holy : that he see no unclean thing in thee , and turn away from thee .

translation.kha: Da shisha u la pang bad u la ju ïap . Hynrei U Blei u la isynei ïa u , bad ym tang ïa u hynñiew ïa nga ruh , bad u la pyllait ïa nga wat na ka jingsngewsih kaba khap khraw .
translation.en: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death : but God had mercy on him ; and not on him only , but on me also , lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow .

translation.kha: Nangta u suh shaphang sepngi sha ka jaka jrong ki Japhlet ïathuh ka jaka jongki ka Beth Haron kaba Sharum . Nongthaw u suh sha Geser bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian .
translation.en: And goeth down westward to the coast of Japhleti , unto the coast of Beth–horon the nether , and to Gezer : and the goings out thereof are at the sea .
And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron , and for his sons ,
translation.kha: Ki suh ïa ki sopti-poh na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ,
Bad katkum ka Hukum ka shihajar ïa i nang haduh ba U Khrist u la wan , Khnang ba yn lah ban pynsuk ïa ngi ha U Blei da ka jingngeit .
translation.en: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Christ , that we might be justified by faith .

translation.kha: Te ki Israel ki la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha u Gihon u syiem Amor don ong :
translation.en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites , saying ,

translation.kha: Babha ki jingri kiba kham khlaiñ ki ïa-pakor , u Joab u buh ïa ki tnat dieng ha kham jongu ki ha ki shyngoid dih um , ba kin dup shaba khun pynpdang kita ki tnat dieng .
translation.en: And it came to pass , whensoever the stronger cattle did conceive , that Jacob laid the rods before the eyes of the cattle in the gutters , that they might conceive among the rods .

translation.kha: Ha Kata ka por , u pashat Augustus u la hukum ban shim jingkheit ïa ki Briew baroh ha ka Hima Rom .
translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus , that all the world should be taxed .

translation.kha: U Jonathan u ong ha u meeting , Ïa ngin ïaleit sha shiliang sha ka jaka sher dara jong kito ki Philistia ba mane blei thala . Lehse U Trai un ïarap ïa ngi ; Ladan u ïarap , ym don ei ei kaba la ban khang ïa u ba-bang ai ha ngi ka jingjop , kai pher la ngi don tang khyndiat ruh .
translation.en: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour , Come , and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised : it may be that the  Lord  will work for us : for there is no restraint to the  Lord  to save by many or by few .

translation.kha: To ai ba ki briew ka Seïon kin ong , To ai ba ka Babilonia kan kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jinglehbor halor jong ngi ! To ai ba ki Briew ka Jerusalem kin noh , To ai ba ka Babilonia kan kitkhlieh na ka pyntwa kaei kaba ngi la shahshitom !
translation.en: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon , shall the inhabitant of Zion say  ; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea , shall Jerusalem say .

translation.kha: balieh ba ki briew jong nga kim jubab haba nga la leit sha ki ban pynim ïa ki ? barli ba kim phai ktien lehbha nga la khot ïa ki ? Hato nga tlot eh ban pynum ïa ki ? Nga lah ban pynngat noh ïa ka duriaw da katba shu hukum mala pyntylli ïa ki wah sha ka ri shyiap , ba ki dohkha kiba don ha ki keiñ ïap na ka jingduna um .
translation.en: Wherefore , when I came , was there no man ? when I called , was there none to answer ? Is my hand shortened at all , that it cannot redeem ? or have I no power to deliver ? behold , at my rebuke I dry up the sea , I make the rivers a wilderness : their fish stinketh , because there is no water , and dieth for thirst .

translation.kha: Nga leh borabor ïa kadei kaba U blang u Law ; nga Bud ïa ka mon jong u , ym ïa ki jingkwah jong nga hi .
translation.en: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips  ; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u shahshkor ïa ki ïabah shipai jong ka kynhun shipai Assyria ban tur ïaleit ïa ka Judah . Ki la kem ïa u Manasseh , ki pyndait jingbuh ha u , ki teh ki kynjri ïa u , dara ïalam ïa u sha Babilon .
translation.en: Wherefore the  Lord  brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria , which took Manasseh among the thorns , and bound him with fetters , and carried him to Babylon .

translation.kha: Naba U Blei un ainong ïa iwei pa aiwai katai kumne kadei kaba u la leh .
translation.en: Who will render to every man according to his deeds :
Thine hand shall be lifted up upon thine adversaries , and all thine enemies shall be cut off .
translation.kha: Ka Israel kan jop ïa ki nongshun jong ka bad pynjot ïa ki baroh .
U phah ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha shuwa jyllang u bad u la sahmiet ha kata ka miet ha ka jaka sher dara .
translation.en: So went the present over before him : and himself lodged that night in the company .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Shem . Ar snem hadien ka jingshlei um , haba u Shem u la dap shyiap snem ka thet , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Abiasaph .
translation.en: These are the generations of Shem : Shem was an hundred years old , and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood :
And they came with haste , and found Mary , and Joseph , and the babe lying in a manger .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit kloi bad ki la shem ïa ka Mari bad u Joseph bad ki la ïohi ïa u khunlung uba thiah ha ka shyngoid .

translation.en: Shall I then take my bread , and my water , and my flesh that I have killed for my shearers , and give it unto men , whom I know not whence they be ?
translation.kha: Ngan ym leit ban shim ïa la u kpu bad ka um , bad ki mrad kiba nga la pynïap na ka bynta ki nongot shñiuh langbrot jong nga , bad ai ïa kita ha ki briew kiba ngam tip nangno ki wan !

Kumne ki ai ïa kine ki jingbthuh bad ki Pha ïa ki sha barieh ha Jerusalem bad kiwei pat ki nongbah sad ki shnong : Khie leit sha ki lum bad pom ïa ki tnat na ki diengsoh Kseh , ki dieng Olib , ki dieng Martl , ki diengkhap Tlai bad kiwei ki dieng , ban shen ïingtrep kato kum ki jingbthah ba la thoh ha ka Hukum .
translation.en: And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities , and in Jerusalem , saying , Go forth unto the mount , and fetch olive branches , and pine branches , and myrtle branches , and palm branches , and branches of thick trees , to make booths , as it is written .

translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u phohsniew sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew , bad u la ïathuh ha la ki hynmen shynrang . Nga la pynshoi sa kawei pat ka jingphohsniew , ha kiba nga la ieh ïa ka snieh , u bnai , bad ïa ki khlur khatwei tylli ba ki ïasangeh ïa la .
translation.en: And he dreamed yet another dream , and told it his brethren , and said , Behold , I have dreamed a dream more  ; and , behold , the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u la sdang biang ha ka jingïaid lynti jyllang u , uwei u briew u la wang mareh , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u , bad u la ino ïa u , Ko nonghikai Naba , kaei kaba nga dei ban leh ban ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?
translation.en: And when he was gone forth into the way , there came one running , and kneeled to him , and asked him , Good Master , what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life ?

translation.kha: U Petros u la ïaisah bun sngi ha Joah lema bad u nongpdem snieh uba kyrteng u Simon .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner .
Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you , and ye shall be clean : from all your filthiness , and from all your idols , will I cleanse you .
translation.kha: Ngan synreit ïa phi da ka um khuid , bad ngan pynkhuid ïa phi na ki bleithaw jong phi bad na baroh kiei kiei kiba la pyntngit ïa phi .
Haba ki nong Ijipt ki la sdang Ban kyrduh bam , ki la leit ud shad u sahmiet ba un ai smam ïa ki . Kumta u la suda ïa ki ban sien sha u Joseph , bad ban leh kat kaba u ong ïa ki .
translation.en: And when all the land of Egypt was famished , the people cried to Pharaoh for bread : and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians , Go unto Joseph  ; what he saith to you , do .
And Judah went up  ; and the  Lord  delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand : and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men .
translation.kha: bad Judah ki la leit ryngkat sha ka thma . U  Trai  u la ai ha ki ka jingjop halor ki Kanaan bad ki Peris , bad ki la jop ïa ki shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah ha Besek .

translation.en: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people , that they should be ready against that day .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingthoh ha ka jingpynbna dei ban pyntip paidbah ha kawei pa kawei ka probins , khnang ba baroh kin long ba la pynkhreh haba kata ka sngi kan wan .

translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto him , Why askest thou thus after my name , seeing it is secret ?
translation.kha: U angel u kylli ,  Balei ba phi da kwah ban tip ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ? Ka long ka kyrteng kaba phylla .

Bad u la ainong ruh , Ko khulom u briew , ngan sa pynduna ba-im ïa ka Jerusalem . Ki briew hangtai kin da sa Shema jynjar bad sngewkhuslai namar ba ki hap ban da thew ïa ka jingbam ba ki bam bad ïa ka um ba ki dih .
translation.en: Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , behold , I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem : and they shall eat bread by weight , and with care  ; and they shall drink water by measure , and with astonishment :

translation.kha: Kumno U Khrist bad u ksiew kin ïahap jingmut ? Kumno uba ngeit u don beit bad u bymngeit ?
translation.en: And what concord hath Christ with Belial ? or what part hath he that believeth with an infidel ?

translation.kha: Hynrei , kumba u Elisha u la lah ong , hamar Kata ka por ha ka snem kaba bujli ka la kha khun shyieng .
translation.en: And the woman conceived , and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her , according to the time of life .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u phalang ktien , Haba nga leit sha ki Israel bad ngan ong ha ki , ‘ U Blei jong ki kpa tmain jong pa’ u la phah ïa nga sha phi ,’ kin sa kylli ïa nga , ‘ katai ka kyrteng jong u ?’ Ngan ong kumno ïa ki ?
translation.en: And Moses said unto God , Behold , when I come unto the children of Israel , and shall say unto them , The God of your fathers hath sent me unto you  ; and they shall say to me , What is his name ? what shall I say unto them ?

translation.kha: Bun u syep u la pynkiew kyllan ïa u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego sha ki kyrdan ba kham halor ha ka Probins jong ka Baibl .
translation.en: Then the king promoted Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , in the province of Babylon .
For even that which was made glorious had no glory in this respect , by reason of the glory that excelleth .
translation.kha: Ngi lah ban ong ba namar jong kata ka burom kaba kham khraw mynta , kata ka burom kaba la tyngshaiñ bha ha ka por ba la leit , ka la jah noh .

Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u ban pynshong ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , bad hukum ban syn ïa ka snam ha ki jingkhang , ba u Angel jyllang ka Jingïap un ym pynïap ïa ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong jong ki Israel .
translation.en: Through faith he kept the passover , and the sprinkling of blood , lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them .
Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them  ; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath : their own way have I recompensed upon their heads , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Te ngan theh ïa ka jingbitar jong nga ha ki , bad kum ka ding ngan pynjot ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong .

Kumta to kieng mynta ïa ka jingkieng atiar U Blei! Nangta haba ka sngi basniew ka wan , phna lah ba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki bor ïalaw u nongshun ; bad hain ba ka jingïaleh ka la kut , phin tdong ïeng ïakem ha ka nongrim jong phi .
translation.en: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God , that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day , and having done all , to stand .
Counsel is mine , and sound wisdom : I am understanding  ; I have strength .
translation.kha: Nga don ki jingthmu bad nga pyntreikam ïa ki ; nga don ka jingshemphang , bad nga don ka bor .

translation.en: The  Lord  rewarded me according to my righteousness : according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ainong ïa nga namar ba nga leh ïa kaba dei ; u la kyrkhu ïa nga namar ba nga long uba shida .
Ïa ki shipai la pynbeit na ka bynta ka thmu bad ka jakarieh sher dara kaba Shatei jong ka nongbah , malade ïa kiba sah na ki rangbah sha ka phrang sepngi . U Judas u sahmiet ha ka them .
translation.en: And when they had set the people , even all the host that was on the north of the city , and their liers in wait on the west of the city , Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley .
Lay thine hand upon him , remember the battle , do no more .
translation.kha: Ktah ïa u shisien bad men ym pyrshang shuh da lei lei ; men ym klet da lei lei ïa ka jingïaleh !

translation.en: Then came the Jews round about him , and said unto him , How long dost thou make us to doubt ? If thou be the Christ , tell us plainly .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang ïaid ha ka baranda u Solomon kaba ha ka Templ , haba ki briew ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u bad kylli ,  Sa katno men dang ïai pynap ïa ngi ha ka jinglyngngoh ? Ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka jingshisha kaba shai kdar : Hato me long U Messaïah ?
Ïathuh ha u kynran jongnga nga , u skhem Benhadad , ba nga mynjur ; u lah ban shngiam ïa nga bad ïa kaei kaei baroh kiba de kein , u Ahab u jubab .
translation.en: And the king of Israel answered and said , My lord , O king , according to thy saying , I am thine , and all that I have .

translation.kha: Sa shisien u Abner u ong ha u , Sangeh na kaba beh kthong ïa nga ! Balei Men pynbor ïa nga ba nur-um pynïap ïa me ? kumto shiah ngan dang nud ban peit ïa ka khmat u Joab u hynmen jong me ?
translation.en: And Abner said again to Asahel , Turn thee aside from following me : wherefore should I smite thee to the ground ? how then should I hold up my face to Joab thy brother ?

translation.kha: Hynñiew phi dien ba longïng ibha khlaiñ bad phim dei ban noh mynsiem . Ka kam kaba phi sa yn sa ai bainong .
translation.en: Be ye strong therefore , and let not your hands be weak : for your work shall be rewarded .

translation.kha: Un pynhap ïa u slap ha la ka aïom na ka ïing kynshew jong u ha bneng bad un kyrkhu ïa ka jingtrei jong phira bhor , ba phin ïoh ai ïakylliang ha kiba babe ki jaitbynriew , Katba ma phi pat phin ym hap shim kylliang nano nano .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall open unto thee his good treasure , the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season , and to bless all the work of thine hand : and thou shalt lend unto many nations , and thou shalt not borrow .

translation.kha: A Blei , to shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai bad ka jingkyrpad jong nga . To pynbha pat ïa ka Templ jong me , ïa Kaba la pynjot ; to pynbha ïa ka Haneng ba uwei pa uwei baroh un tip ba me un-long U Blei .
translation.en: Now therefore , O our God , hear the prayer of thy servant , and his supplications , and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate , for the Lord s sake .

translation.kha: Um donkam ïa Kiba sarong , hynrei u lehkmen ïa kito bakha sngewrit .
translation.en: Surely he scorneth the scorners : but he giveth grace unto the lowly .

translation.kha: Napdeng jong ki , kan wan ki nongsynshar , ki nongïalam , bad ki rangbah ai lawlynnong ki ban synshar ïa ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: Out of him came forth the corner , out of him the nail , out of him the battle bow , out of him every oppressor together .

translation.kha: ngam shym ong ïa kane ïa ka ban pynmeh ïa phi ; naba kumba sa la ong mynshuwa , phi long kiba ngi olib eh ba ngi ïalong lang baburom , lada ngi im lane sem ïap .
translation.en: I speak not this to condemn you : for I have said before , that ye are in our hearts to die and live with you .

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba nga la hukum ïa me ban long uba kut jingmut tyrkhong bad uba skhem ! Wat sngewbishni lane noh mynsiem , namar nga , U Trai U Blei jong me , to long ryngkat lem bad me kat babha me saw .
translation.en: Have not I commanded thee ? Be strong and of a good courage  ; be not afraid , neither be thou dismayed : for the  Lord  thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest .
The woman answered and said , I have no husband . Jesus said unto her ,  Thou hast well said , I have no husband :
translation.kha: Ngam don tnga ,  ka la jubab . U Jisu u la phai ktien ,  Ka long kaba dei haba pha ong ba pham don tnga .

translation.en: And seeing the multitudes , he went up into a mountain : and when he was set , his disciples came unto him :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah bad u la kiew sha u lum , ha uba u la shong . Ki synran jong u ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u ,

translation.en: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities : for we know not what we should pray for as we ought : but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ruh U Mynsiem u wan ban ïarap ïa ngi , ha ka jingtlot kaba ngi don . Naba ngim tip kumno ngi dei ban duwai ; U Mynsiem hi da lade u ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta jong ngi ha ki jingud kiba ki ktien kim lah ban pynpaw .

translation.en: Jesus answered him ,  Sayest thou this thing of thyself , or did others tell it thee of me ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato kane ka jingkylli ka wan na me ne kiwei ki la ïathuh ïa me shaphang jong nga ?
Nangta ki leit shemphang sharati sha Tyros ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh , nangta sha baroh ki nongbah jong ki Hib dara ki Naaran , bad khatduh eh shad Beersheba , ha ka bynta bashathie jong ka Judah .
translation.en: And came to the strong hold of Tyre , and to all the cities of the Hivites , and of the Canaanites : and they went out to the south of Judah , even to Beer–sheba .

translation.kha: U Trai u kren ha u Moses hadien ka jingpynïap jongki ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Aaron kiba la shah pyndap mynba ki kñia ainguh ha U Trai da ka ding bymkhuid .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron , when they offered before the  Lord  , and died  ;
And Samuel said , As thy sword hath made women childless , so shall thy mother be childless among women . And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before the  Lord  in Gilgal .
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ,  Kumba ka waitlam jong me ka la pynlong ïa kiba bun ki kmie ban duh khun , kumta mynta ka kmie jong me kan long khlem khun .  Bad u pom lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u Agag ha khmat ka duwan ha Gilgal .

translation.en: Howl , ye ships of Tarshish : for your strength is laid waste .
translation.kha: To lynñiar da ka jingsngewsih , phi ki maji ha ka duriaw-bah ! La pynjot ïa ka nongbah kaba phi shaniah .
U Trai u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei da ka jingstad jong u ; da ka jingsngewbiang jong u , u la buh beit ïa ka sahit bteng ha la ka iaka .
translation.en: The  Lord  by wisdom hath founded the earth  ; by understanding hath he established the heavens .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu nabar ki synran jong u ki ïan leit ha ka jingleit jong ki , u la Wan sha ka shnong ha kaban ka briew kaba kthang ka Martha ka la pdiang sngewbha ïa u sha ka ïing jong ka .
translation.en: Now it came to pass , as they went , that he entered into a certain village : and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house .
Many will say to me in that day , Lord , Lord , have we not prophesied in thy name ? and in thy name have cast out devils ? and in thy name done many wonderful works ?
translation.kha: Haba ka Sngi Bishar ka poi , kiba bun kin ong ha nga , ‘ A Trai , A Trai ! Ha ka kyrteng jong me ngi la kren ïa ka khubor jong U Blei , da ka kyrteng jong me ngi la beh noh ïa shibun ki ksuid bad ngi la leh shibun ki kambah !’

translation.en: Thy people also shall be all righteous : they shall inherit the land for ever , the branch of my planting , the work of my hands , that I may be glorified .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong pha kin leh baroh ïa kaei kaba dei , bad kin ïohkynti ïa ka ri junom . Nga la thung ïa ki , nga la thaw ïa ki , ban pynpaw ïa ka jingkhraw jong nga sa baroh .
Lada phim kohnguh ïa ka hukum , U Balei un shem ïa ki jingaiei jong phi kiba ijli eh ban sngapjar .
translation.en: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law , even his prayer shall be abomination .
As in water face answereth to face , so the heart of man to man .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka durkhmat jong phi hi kaba phalang ha ka um bad ka dei ka malade jong phi hi kaba phi ïohi ha ka dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: And needed not that any should testify of man : for he knew what was in man .
translation.kha: Ym da donkam mano mano ban ïathuh ha u shaphang jong ki , namar u hi u la tip kaei kaba don ha ka dohnud jong ki .

bad u Ong ha la ki rangbah , To U Trai un bat ïa nga na naba pynmynsaw ïa u kynrad jong la , ïa uba U Trai u la jied kumne u syiem ! Ngam Dei shun pynmynsaw ïa u , naba u dei u sahmiet ba la jied da U Trai !
translation.en: And he said unto his men , The  Lord  forbid that I should do this thing unto my master , the  Lord s  anointed , to stretch forth mine hand against him , seeing he is the anointed of the  Lord .
And declared to be the Son of God with power , according to the spirit of holiness , by the resurrection from the dead :
translation.kha: shaphang ka jinglong Blei bakhuid jong u , la pyn-i shynna da ka bor bakhraw ban long U Khun jong U Blei da kaba pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
U la shoh ïa nga na baroh sawdong . U la jyntang noh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga bad u iehnoh ïa nga ban dyngkhong bad ban ïap .
translation.en: He hath destroyed me on every side , and I am gone : and mine hope hath he removed like a tree .
And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword , and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok , even unto the children of Ammon : for the border of the children of Ammon was strong .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel ki la pynïap bun ki nongshun ha ka thma bad ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki naduh ka wah Arnon na shaphang shatei haduh ka Jabbok , kata , haduh ki Ammon , namar ka khappud ki Ammon ka long kaba khlaiñ bha ka jingïada .
isynei ki khunlung ki kiew jrong ki , ki la ïar shikatdei eh ; ki la nang bun nang bad , bad ki la nang khlam haduh ba kata ka ri ka la jingpynkhiah da ki .
translation.en: And the children of Israel were fruitful , and increased abundantly , and multiplied , and waxed exceeding mighty  ; and the land was filled with them .

translation.kha: bad ïa ka pyrda ba la wah hapoh ka Tubal la pynkad arliang .
translation.en: And the sun was darkened , and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst .

translation.kha: Bad u Moses u pynshai da kaba shaei ba ïa kiba ïap la pynmihpat . Ha ka bynta shaphang ka lyngkdong kaba ing u kren shaphang U Trai kum ‘ U blem jong u Absalom , U Blei jong u Isaak , bad U Blei lad u Jakob .’
translation.en: Now that the dead are raised , even Moses shewed at the bush , when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob .

translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai , kam u syiem Jehoïakim u la leh .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that Jehoiakim had done .

translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki la shahjop ! Ki la lute bad shetkylla , wat la ym skhem don kiba la lwait ne shetkylla ïa ki . Hynrei ka por ban lute bad shikynta kan kut , bad ma ki hi kin sa long kiba shahshkor lutphut pynlang kiba shiah Shealtiel .
translation.en: Woe to thee that spoilest , and thou wast not spoiled  ; and dealest treacherously , and they dealt not treacherously with thee ! when thou shalt cease to spoil , thou shalt be spoiled  ; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously , they shall deal treacherously with thee .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha nga , Khim ka lyngdoh ring thoh jingthoh kaba heh bad thoh ha ka da ki dak naba heh : ‘ Maher-shalal-hash-bas . ’
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  said unto me , Take thee a great roll , and write in it with a man s pen concerning Maher–shalal–hash–baz .

translation.kha: Nga long uba Nyngkong bad uba khatduh , uba sdang malade uba kut .
translation.en: I am Alpha and Omega , the beginning and the end , the first and the last .

translation.kha: U la jubab , ‘ U Trai’ , ïa uba nga la ju kohnguh , un phah ïa u angel jong u lem Bad me bad ai ha me ka jingap . Men pynïoh ïa u khum jong nga ka tnaw na ki biria jongki ang hi , bad na ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u kpa jong nga .
translation.en: And he said unto me , The  Lord  , before whom I walk , will send his angel with thee , and prosper thy way  ; and thou shalt take a wife for my son of my kindred , and of my father s house :
Let them give glory unto the  Lord  , and declare his praise in the islands .
translation.kha: Ai ba kito kiba shong ha ki ri bajngai kin ai ka jingïaroh bad ka burom ïa U  Trai .
Ki baïap Judah te ki pynkup syiem ïa u khun jong u , u Ussaïah uba don khathynriew snem ka thet .
translation.en: And all the people of Judah took Azariah , which was sixteen years old , and made him king instead of his father Amaziah .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Babilonia yn lute , bad kito kiba lute ïa ka kin shim lut ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki kwah . Ma to , U Trai , nga la krong .
translation.en: And Chaldea shall be a spoil : all that spoil her shall be satisfied , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: bad ka khot ïa ki briew kiba ïawad nangta , kiba dang leit sha la ka kam :
translation.en: To call passengers who go right on their ways :
And I , brethren , when I came to you , came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom , declaring unto you the testimony of God .
translation.kha: Haba nga la wan sha phi , ko parabangeit jong nga , ban ïalap ïa ka jingshisha barieh jong U Blei , ngam shym la pyndonkam da ki kyntien kiba eh bad ka jingtip kaba khraw .
ka Kain , ka Jogbehah , bad ka Timnah : shiphew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nonglur sawdong jongno ki .
translation.en: Cain , Gibeah , and Timnah  ; ten cities with their villages :

translation.kha: U la pynduh ïa ka hukum ki Jiw da la ki jong ki lawlynnong bad ki kynton , khnang ban ïoh pynjrong ïa ki ar tylli ki jingñiewbeiñ kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba thymmai ha u hi , ha kane ka rukom u wanrah jingsuk .
translation.en: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity , even the law of commandments contained in ordinances ; for to make in himself of twain one new man , so making peace ;

translation.kha: Nga sngewlehrain Ban phla ba phim shym la long kiba shlur ban leh ïa kito kiei kiei! hynne lada uno uno ud nud ban sngewsarong shaphang kaei kadei — nga kren kum uba bieit — kun shu long uba shlur .
translation.en: I speak as concerning reproach , as though we had been weak . Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold , ( I speak foolishly , ) I am bold also .

translation.kha: Lymda dei u Rangbah Lyngdoh uba leh pop bad da kumta u wanrah ïa ka jingpynrem ha ki paidbah , un ai ïa u masi lyngraw u sem ne kano kano ka jingduna Bad un kñia sha U Trai namar ka pum lad u .
translation.en: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people  ; then let him bring for his sin , which he hath sinned , a young bullock without blemish unto the  Lord  for a sin offering .

translation.kha: dei ma u , uba pynlah ïa ngi banbeiñ shakri ïa ka jutang kaba thymmai , kaba khlem kynthup ïa ka sah ba la thoiñ hynrei kaba da U Mynsiem . Ka hukum ba la thoh ka khlam ïa ka jingïap , hynrei U mynsaw u ai jingim .
translation.en: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament ; not of the letter , but of the spirit : for the letter killeth , but the spirit giveth life .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba sien jong ka jingsynshar u Asaph u syiem ka Israel , u Jehosabad u khun jong u Asa u la long u syiem ka Judith ,
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Israel .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la leit sha ka thain hajan ki nongbah Tyros bad Sidon .
translation.en: Then Jesus went thence , and departed into the coasts of Tyre and Sidon .

translation.kha: Te ki rangbah kur , ki rangbah synshar jongno ki jait , ki nongai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai , bad ki nongpynïaid ïa ka jingdon jingem jyllang u syiem da la ka mon Sngewbha ki ai
translation.en: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Israel , and the captains of thousands and of hundreds , with the rulers of the king s work , offered willingly ,

translation.kha: Naba ki la ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki kren ha ki ktien kiba phetwir bad ki da ïarep ïa ka jingkren jong U Blei! . U Pontios u la kren :
translation.en: For they heard them speak with tongues , and magnify God . Then answered Peter ,

translation.kha: Hato , ko paralok jong nga , phi bishar ïa kiwei patiaw ? Phim lah lieh sianti , lada phi longkmie uei uei ruh . Namar hajuh phi bishar ïa kiwei bad nongtuh phi leh ïa kynta kiei kiei kiba ki leh , phi pynrem ïa lai .
translation.en: Therefore thou art inexcusable , O man , whosoever thou art that judgest : for wherein thou judgest another , thou condemnest thyself ; for thou that judgest doest the same things .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ïa ki samla shynrang yn pynïap ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah , bad ïa ki shipai jong ka baroh yn pynjot .
translation.en: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets , and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: To map ïa me ïa ki jingdap kiba sem la leh , main ngi map ïa ki jingdap kiba kiwei ki la leh ïa sem .
translation.en: And forgive us our debts , as we forgive our debtors .

translation.kha: Kaba ha kane ka kynti ngan pynshitom ym tang ïa ki rangbah synsar bad ïa ki briew jong me , hynrei ïa me hi ruh , khnang ba men ïoh tipbriew ba ym don naba kamon ma per ha ka pyrthei baroh .
translation.en: For I will at this time send all my plagues upon thine heart , and upon thy servants , and upon thy people  ; that thou mayest know that there is none like me in all the earth .
And Ben–hadad sent unto him , and said , The gods do so unto me , and more also , if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam bun ki rangbah ban pynjot ïa kane ka nongbah jong me bad ban rah mar shi kham ka khyndew ha ki kti jong ki . Ai ba ki blei kin shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam leh kumta !
Nangno U Trai u la noh ha nga , Ki biria jong ka Judah dara ka Jerusalem ki la ïathmu sniew pyrshah ïa nga .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah , and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
And the king of Israel said , Alas ! that the  Lord  hath called these three kings together , to deliver them into the hand of Moab !
translation.kha: Ngi la jan ïap !  u syiem Joram u la kyang jam .  U  Trai  u la buh ïa ngi lai ngut ha ka jingisynei jong u syiem Moab !

translation.en: And all the princes , and the mighty men , and all the sons likewise of king David , submitted themselves unto Solomon the king .
translation.kha: Baroh ki rangbah synshar bad ki shipai , bad wat kiwei pat ki khun shynrang baroh jong u Dabid ki kular ban kohnguh ïa u Solomon kum u syiem .
Naduh ka por ba nga la phlait ïa ki paid Israel na Ijipt haduh mandriek , ngam shym la shong ha ka templ ; ang la sheng borabor ha ki ïinglieng bad kynriah na kawei ka tare sha kawei pud .
translation.en: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day  ; but have gone from tent to tent , and from one tabernacle to another .
They hunt our steps , that we cannot go in our streets : our end is near , our days are fulfilled  ; for our end is come .
translation.kha: U Nongshun u la ap khmih ïa ngi ; ngim lah wat ban ïaid ha ki lynti bah . Ki sngi jong ngi ki la kut ; kaba kut ka la wan .

translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  What did Moses command you ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab da ka jingkylli ,  Kaei kaba ka hukum u Moses ka ai ha phi ?

translation.en: And when the  Lord  saw that they humbled themselves , the word of the  Lord  came to Shemaiah , saying , They have humbled themselves  ; therefore I will not destroy them , but I will grant them some deliverance  ; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u la ïohi ïa kane , u kren sa shisien ha u Shemaïah bad u ong ha u ,  Namar ba ki phla ïa la ki pop , ngan ym pynjot ïa ki . Hynrei haba u Shishak u tur ïaleh , kin ym lait im .

translation.en: With whom took he counsel , and who instructed him , and taught him in the path of judgment , and taught him knowledge , and shewed to him the way of understanding ?
translation.kha: Badno ba U Blei un ïasyllok khnang ban tip bad sngewthuh bad ban hikai kumno ba ïa kiei kiei dei ban leh ?
Khenani mynta , U Jisu u la ong , uno uno kiba don ka plie paila lane ka pla u dei baneh rah ïa ka ; bad uno uno u bym don ka wanlam u dei ban die noh ïa ka jaiñkup jong u malade thad kawei .
translation.en: Then said he unto them ,  But now , he that hath a purse , let him take it , and likewise his scrip : and he that hath no sword , let him sell his garment , and buy one .

translation.kha: U Syiem u la ong ha u Paulos bad u Ïano , Sngewbha duwai ha U Trai na ka bynta jong nga , khnang ba kawei ruh na kita kiei kiei kiba phi la kren kan ym jia ha nga .
translation.en: Then answered Simon , and said , Pray ye to the Lord for me , that none of these things which ye have spoken come upon me .

translation.kha: Hangne kine ki mawbah ba nga la kynton hapdeng jong ngi , bad hangno u maw pynsah jingkynmaw .
translation.en: And Laban said to Jacob , Behold this heap , and behold this pillar , which I have cast betwixt me and thee  ;

translation.kha: Hangta u ong ïa nga , Pynbthi ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong kine ki brai , pynkyllut ïa ki shkor jong ki , bad pynmatlah ïa ki khmat jong ki , ba kumta kin ym lah ban ioh lane ïohsngew lane sngewthuh . ïada ki leh kumta , ki lah ngab phai sha nga bad ïoh jingïakhih .
translation.en: Make the heart of this people fat , and make their ears heavy , and shut their eyes  ; lest they see with their eyes , and hear with their ears , and understand with their heart , and convert , and be healed .

translation.kha: Ha khmih ! U ïaring ha u paidbah , bad ktem ong ei ei pyrshah ïa u ! Hato ka lah ban long ba kim ithuh shisha ïa u ba u dei U Messaïah ?
translation.en: But , lo , he speaketh boldly , and they say nothing unto him . Do the rulers know indeed that this is the very Christ ?
Sing unto the  Lord  , praise ye the  Lord  : for he hath delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers .
translation.kha: To rwai ha U  Trai  ! To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ! u la pyllait im ïa kiba la shah banbeiñ na ka bor jong ki briew basniew .
Deborah , ki nongrit jong ka Israel ki sah kynjah , Ki ïeng thylli tad ynda pha wan , Pha wan kum ka kmie ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: The inhabitants of the villages ceased , they ceased in Israel , until that I Deborah arose , that I arose a mother in Israel .
We have given the hand to the Egyptians , and to the Assyrians , to be satisfied with bread .
translation.kha: Ban ïoh jingbam kaba biang ban im , ngi la leit khrong sha Ijipt bad Assyria .
Ha u byrthen ïa ki rishot kiba bat ïa ka suiñbneng , ki khih dara ki khyndew da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof .
And it came to pass after these things , that Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard , which was in Jezreel , hard by the palace of Ahab king of Samaria .
translation.kha: Hajan ka ïingsyiem jong u Ahab ha Jesreel , ka la don ka bri sohwaiñ kaba long trai da u briew uba kyrteng u Naboth .

translation.en: I said in the cutting off of my days , I shall go to the gates of the grave : I am deprived of the residue of my years .
translation.kha: Nga pyrkhat ba ha ka jingdap pura ka jingim , nga la leit sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ban ym lah ban pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga .
Ki dohkha kin ïarep , bad ka wah kan sa iwtung eh kat haduh ba ki nong Ijipt kin ym nguid ban dih um na ka .’
translation.en: And the fish that is in the river shall die , and the river shall stink  ; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river .

translation.kha: Nangta u leit rah ïa ki jingai sngewbha shata u Eglon , naba long u briew uba sngewdap shibun .
translation.en: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab : and Eglon was a very fat man .
And he said , I will go out , and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . And the  Lord  said , Thou shalt entice him , and thou shalt also prevail : go out , and do even so .
translation.kha: U mynsiem u jubab , ‘ Ngan leit bad ngan pynlong ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa u Ahab ban kren lamler .’ U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Khie leit bad shukor ïa u . Phin jop .’

Ha ka sngi kaba synran jong u bnai uba hynriew , jrong ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , ki rangbah kiba la shah ringmraw na Judah ki ïashong bad nga ha ka ïong jong nga . Kynhun kynsan ka bor jong U Trai nongshoh-nar ka la wan ba-halor jong na .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the sixth year , in the sixth month , in the fifth day of the month , as I sat in mine house , and the elders of Judah sat before me , that the hand of the Lord  God  fell there upon me .

translation.kha: Ha ka ri shyiap don ka Beth Rabbah , ka Middin , ka Sekakah ,
translation.en: In the wilderness , Beth–arabah , Middin , and Secacah ,

And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , I will disguise myself , and will go to the battle  ; but put thou on thy robes . So the king of Israel disguised himself  ; and they went to the battle .
translation.kha: U Ahab u ong ïa u Jehoshaphat ,  Haba ngi leit sha ka thma , ngan riam pher ïa lade , hynrei ma phi , phong ïa ki jaiñ syiem jong phi .  Kumta u syiem Israel u leit sha thma ha ka jingriam pher .

Ko Nonghikai’ , U Moses u la thoh ïa kane ka hukum na ka bynta jong i : ‘ Lada u bynriew u ïap bad u iehnoh ïa ka tnga khlem don khun , u Para jong uta u briew u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka khnang ba ki haka ban don ki khun ïa kiba yn ñiew kum ki khun lad uta u briew uba la ïap .’
translation.en: Master , Moses wrote unto us , If a man s brother die , and leave his wife behind him , and leave no children , that his brother should take his wife , and raise up seed unto his brother .

translation.kha: Ka burom bad ka jingweng syiem ki Jer sawdong ïa u , ka bor bad ka jingkyrmen ki dap ïa ka Templ jong u .
translation.en: Glory and honour are in his presence  ; strength and gladness are in his place .

translation.kha: Em , ngim tip ! ki la jubab . Khatduh ïa ngi ïa kaei ba u ong ! U ïatih ïa to ba U Terah u pynbna , ‘ Na pynshah ïa me ban long u syiem ka Israel .’
translation.en: And they said , It is false  ; tell us now . And he said , Thus and thus spake he to me , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , I have anointed thee king over Israel .
For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh , Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up , that I might shew my power in thee , and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth .
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ïa u syiem ka Ijipt ,  Nga la pynlong syiem ïa me khnang ban pyndonkam ïa me ban pyn-i ïa ka bor jong nga bad ban pynphriang ïa ka nam jong nga ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .

Hynrei ma me , me la brup ïa ka jingkhaïi jong nga , ka jinglong jingim jong nga , malade ka jingimat jong nga ha ka jingim ; me la khmih ïa ka jingngeit jong na , ka jingïaishah jong por , ka jingngeit jong nga , ka jingïaineh jong nga , ka jingshah pynshitom jong nga , Bad ki jingshah khim jong ang .
