translation.en: But thou hast fully known my doctrine , manner of life , purpose , faith , longsuffering , charity , patience ,

translation.kha: kaba long ka snem kaba khynñiat jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea , u bashisha ka Assir u kurup ïa ka Samaria , u rah ïa ki Israel sha Syria kum ki koit , bad pynsah katno katne ngut na ki ha ka nongbah Halah , katto katba pat hajan ka kah Habor ha ka bajar kongsan , bad Katto katne ha ki nongbah Jong ka Broadcasting .
translation.en: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria , and carried Israel away into Assyria , and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan , and in the cities of the Medes .
The arrow cannot make him flee : slingstones are turned with him into stubble .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno u khnam uba lah ban pynher krad ïa u ; ki mawbah kiba la kawang ïa u ki long kum ki lyngkhot phlangïap .

translation.en: For indeed the hand of the  Lord  was against them , to destroy them from among the host , until they were consumed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki haduh ba un da ïoh pynjot lut ïa baroh .
Hib u Saul u ïohsngew ïa kane , U Mynsiem! jong U Balei u wiang ha u da ka bol , bun u bitar lep .
translation.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings , and his anger was kindled greatly .
This know also , that in the last days perilous times shall come .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba kin sa wan ki por kiba jynjar ha ki sngi kiba khatduh .

translation.en: And Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron , stood before it in those days , ) saying , Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother , or shall I cease ? And the  Lord  said , Go up  ; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand .
translation.kha: Ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei ka don hangta ha Bethel ha kito ki sngi , bad u Phinehas , u khun jong u Eleasar bad u khun ksiew jong u Aaron , u khmih ïa ka , ki briew ki kylli ïa U  Trai  ,  Hato ngin leit ïaleh pyrshah biang ïa ki Benjamin , ki para jait jong ngi , ne ngin keiñ noh ?  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki . Lashai ka sngi ngan ai ïa ka jingjop ha phi .

translation.en: Whiles it remained , was it not thine own ? and after it was sold , was it not in thine own power ? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart ? thou hast not lied unto men , but unto God .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba men die ïa ka jaka , ka dei ka jong me ; bad hadien ba me la die ïa ka , ka pisa ka la long ka jong me . Balei , te , ba me la kut jingmut ban leh ïa kane ? Mem shym la shukor ïa ki briew — me la shukor ïa U Blei !
Bun ïa nga la buh ha ka phyllaw jong ka ïingsyiem haduh ka sngi ba la kurup ïa ka Jerusalem’ .
translation.en: So Jeremiah abode in the court of the prison until the day that Jerusalem was taken : and he was there when Jerusalem was taken .
A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it  ; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban isih ïa uno uno uba kwah ban pynmynsaw ïa u da ka jinglamler . Ka jingkren bymshisha kam wanrah ei ei hynrei ka jingpynjot .
U Jakob u la sngewtriem ïa ka Rakhel badno u ong , Ngam lah ban shim ïa ka jaka U Blei’ . Dei ma u uba khang ïa pha ban ieh khun .
translation.en: And Jacob s anger was kindled against Rachel : and he said , Am I in God s stead , who hath withheld from thee the fruit of the womb ?

translation.kha: Na ka kur jong u Merari la don u Hosah , uba Don saw nguh ki khun shynrang : u Shimri , ( u kpa jong u , u la pynphong nongïalam ïa u wat la um daym u khun nyngkong ) ,
translation.en: Also Hosah , of the children of Merari , had sons  ; Simri the chief , ( for though he was not the firstborn , yet his father made him the chief  ; )
And they offered unto the  Lord  the same time , of the spoil which they had brought , seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ki ai jingkñia ha U  Trai  na ka jinglute kaba ki la wanrah biang : hynñiewspah tylli ki khlieh jong ki masi bad hynñiew hajar tylli ki langbrot .
Haba phi la dep kheit ïa ki sop Olib shisien , wat leit kheit shuh ïa kito kiba dang sah ; kita ki dei ka bynta ki nongkhaïi , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei .
translation.en: When thou beatest thine olive tree , thou shalt not go over the boughs again : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow .

translation.kha: Reuben , khun phrangsngi jong por , Me longsem ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , U soh nyngkong ka jinglonghok rangbah jong nga , Uba sarong tam bad uba khlaiñ tam Na ki khun jong nga baroh .
translation.en: Reuben , thou art my firstborn , my might , and the beginning of my strength , the excellency of dignity , and the excellency of power :
For all seek their own , not the things which are Jesus Christs .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u sngewkhia tang ïa la ki jong ki kam , ym ïa kiei kiei ki jong U Jisu Khrist .

Ye blind guides , which strain at a gnat , and swallow a camel .
translation.kha: Ko ki nonglam lynti bamatlah ! Phi pjiar ïa u skain na ka jingdih jong phi , hynrei phi nguid ïa ka ut !
Ken ka dei ka jingthmu jong nga ïa ka pynrieh , Bad ka ïa ka kti jong nga la kner ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth : and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations .

translation.kha: Halor ki tnum ïing baroh ha Moab bad ha baroh ki jaka Baïap ym to ei ei hynrei tang ka jingïam sngewsynei , namar por la pynpait ïa ka Moab Kum u khra uba ym don shuh mano mano pun kwah .
translation.en: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab , and in the streets thereof : for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi Sabbaton , U Jisu u la leit ban bam ha ka ïing jyllang uwei na ki Pharisi Ibbah kham pawkhmat ; bad ki briew ki la khmih Bha ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day , that they watched him .

translation.kha: Ka skhem Jong ka Sheba ka bna shaphang ka na u Solomon , bad ka leit sha Jerushah ban tynjuh ïa u da ki jingïatylli kiba eh . Ka wei ïalap shisien ki nongbud lak bad ki ut kba kit ki musla , ki mawkordor , bad shibun ka ksiar . Haba ka la ïakynduh ïa u Solomon , ka kylli lut ïa baroh ki jingkylli kat kiba don ha ka jingmut jong ka .
translation.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon , she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem , with a very great company , and camels that bare spices , and gold in abundance , and precious stones : and when she was come to Solomon , she communed with him of all that was in her heart .

And David sware moreover , and said , Thy father certainly knoweth that I have found grace in thine eyes  ; and he saith , Let not Jonathan know this , lest he be grieved : but truly as the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , there is but a step between me and death .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Dabid u jubab ,  I pa jong phi i tip bha katno ba phi sngewieit ïa nga , bad i la rai ba phin ym tip ïa kaei ba i thmu ban leh , namar ba phin sa sngewkthang eh . Nga smai ha phi da U  Trai  uba im ba nga don sa tang shisien jam na ka jingïap !

Lada ma phi ko sahmiet phi lehsbun ban ai ïa ka jingsaphred Jong nga , nga kwah ba ma phi bad u Haman phin erlangthari ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha kaei pat ka jingkhawai la shai ka sngi ba ngan pynkhreh na ka bynta jong pa . Ha kata ka por Ngan sa ong ïa phi ïa kaei kaba nga kajuh .
translation.en: If I have found favour in the sight of the king , and if it please the king to grant my petition , and to perform my request , let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them , and I will do to morrow as the king hath said .

translation.kha: Ngam kyrpad ïa phi da ka ikhain jong U Trai ban pule ïa kane ka shithi ha ki parabangeit baroh .
translation.en: I charge you by the Lord that this epistle be read unto all the holy brethren .

translation.kha: Kito kiba im ka jingim kaba bha ki ïoh jingsuk bad jingjahthait ha ka jingpynïap .
translation.en: He shall enter into peace : they shall rest in their beds , each one walking in his uprightness .

translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u shaniah ha U Trai , U Blei ki Israel ; ki Judah kim shym ïoh da uei pat u syiem kum ma u , ha shuwa ne hadien ka por jongnga u .
translation.en: He trusted in the  Lord  God of Israel  ; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Judah , nor any that were before him .

translation.kha: Um ju shukor lane lute ïan ïano . U pynkhie ïa kaei kaba u nongshim ram u buh bynda ; u ïa-bta ïa kiba thngan Bad u ai jaiñ ïa kiba lyngkhuit .
translation.en: And hath not oppressed any , but hath restored to the debtor his pledge , hath spoiled none by violence , hath given his bread to the hungry , and hath covered the naked with a garment  ;

translation.kha: Nga tip me la rah ïa nga sha ka jingïarap , sha ka jar ba la buhai ïa baroh .
translation.en: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death , and to the house appointed for all living .

translation.kha: U Jisu lem bad ki 1 ,44 milimitar nud kin seng ïa ka hima ha bneng . Kata ka dei ka Hima jyllang U blei .—Jingpynpaw 14 :1-35 .
translation.en: Jesus and the 144 ,000 form a righteous heavenly government —God’s Kingdom . —Revelation 14 :1-3 .
Then said Elijah unto the people , I , even I only , remain a prophet of the  Lord   ; but Baal s prophets are four hundred and fifty men .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ,  Nga don sa tang ma nga u nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai  uba dang sah , hynrei ki don sawspah sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal .
U Briew u bym kah ïoh rupa ne ksiar u jied da ka dieng ka ban ym pyut . U shem ïa u nongtrei dieng ba-beit don shna ïa ka dur ka ban ym kyllon .
translation.en: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot  ; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image , that shall not be moved .
I will plant in the wilderness the cedar , the shittah tree , and the myrtle , and the oil tree  ; I will set in the desert the fir tree , and the pine , and the box tree together :
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki dieng Kedar ban mih ha ka jaka shyiap bad ki dieng Akasia bad ki dieng Martl bad ki dieng Olib . Bad ki khlaw kin mih ha ki jaka shrah ki khlaw dieng Kseh bad dieng Kseh-Juniper bad dieng Kseh-Sypress .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What things ?  And they said unto him , Concerning Jesus of Nazareth , which was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people :
translation.kha: Kiei kita ?  u la kylli .  Kiei kiei kiba la jia ha U Jisu uba na Nasareth ,  ki la jubab .  Une u briew u la long u nongïathuhlypa bad la ñiew da U Blei bad da ki briew baroh ba u long uba donbor ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u kren bad leh .

translation.en: And Jair died , and was buried in Camon .
translation.kha: U Jair u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Kamon .

translation.en: I heard also the noise of the wings of the living creatures that touched one another , and the noise of the wheels over against them , and a noise of a great rushing .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ki thapniang jong ki jingthaw ba-im kiba ïatyngkhuh lang ha suiñ , bad ka jingkhynwin ki shalyntem , kiba sawa jam kum u jumai .

translation.en: Behold , my servants shall sing for joy of heart , but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart , and shall howl for vexation of spirit .
translation.kha: Kin rwai da kaba kmen , hynrei phi phin ïam ha ka jingpait dohnud .
Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , To long phi kiba kyrduh namar nga long uba khuid .
translation.en: Because it is written , Be ye holy  ; for I am holy .
Thus shall it be done for one bullock , or for one ram , or for a lamb , or a kid .
translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka rukom haba wanrah ïa uwei u masi , u langbrot , ka langbrot , ne u  langsohmoh .
Shen hadien ka jingjynjar jongno kito ki sngi , ka sngi kan dum , u bnai un ym tyngshaiñ shuh , ki khlur kin khup na bneng , bad ki bor ha ka thah ha kin shah beh na ki lynti jong ki .
translation.en: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened , and the moon shall not give her light , and the stars shall fall from heaven , and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken :

translation.kha: To ïalumlang ha ka jingsheptieng , phi ki jaitbynriew ! To shahshkor , phi! ki bynta ba shata jngai jongu ka pyrthei . pynher ba ïabah , isynei to bymsheptieng ! Ho-oid to pynkheiñ , hynrei to sheptieng !
translation.en: Associate yourselves , O ye people , and ye shall be broken in pieces  ; and give ear , all ye of far countries : gird yourselves , and ye shall be broken in pieces  ; gird yourselves , and ye shall be broken in pieces .

translation.kha: bad shym kynti ïa ka ri . Ahian kata , phi lah ban wang phai , namar phin la pyndep ïa ka kamram jong phi sha U Troas bad sha kiwei pateng ki para Israel . Te U Trai un pynskhem ba kane ka ri sha mihngi jong ka Jordan ka de ka jong phi .
translation.en: And the land be subdued before the  Lord  : then afterward ye shall return , and be guiltless before the  Lord  , and before Israel  ; and this land shall be your possession before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynriew u da jong ha nga ba ngan sa punkhun bad ïoh khun shynrang . U ong ïa nga ban nym dkoh waiñ lane dih kyiad , lane bah ïa kano ïano ka bymkhuid , namar ithuh u khunlung un long suba yn pynkyntang shad U Blei kum u Nasir katba u ding im .
translation.en: But he said unto me , Behold , thou shalt conceive , and bear a son  ; and now drink no wine nor strong drink , neither eat any unclean thing : for the child shall be a Nazarite to God from the womb to the day of his death .

translation.kha: Hadien ba u Theh u la dap hynñiewphew sniew ka rta , u la longkmie u kpa jong u Abram , u Hano , bad u Haran .
translation.en: And Terah lived seventy years , and begat Abram , Nahor , and Haran .

translation.kha: Kumta u briew uba duwai lane pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ha ka jingïamane lang da kaba tapmoh ïa la ka khlieh u pynjahburom ïa U Khrist .
translation.en: Every man praying or prophesying , having his head covered , dishonoureth his head .
And Jesus answered and said unto them ,  I will also ask of you one question , and answer me , and I will tell you by what authority I do these things .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki ,  Ngan kylli ïa phi tang kawei ka jingkylli , bad lada phi ai ïa nga ïa ka jubab , ngan ïathuh ïa phi da kaei ka hok ba nga don ban leh ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk ? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good ?
translation.kha: Ym don uba stad u ban kren kumba kren ma me lane ïada ïa lade da kum kita ki ktien bym don jingmut .

translation.en: Howbeit certain men clave unto him , and believed : among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite , and a woman named Damaris , and others with them .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki la ïasoh bad u , napdeng jong ki , u dei u Dionysius , u dkhot jong ka dorbar ; la don ruh ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Damaris , bad kiwei pat ki briew .
Ki nongbah ba la ker da ki kynroh ki un-long ka sat , ka Ser , ka Hammath , ka Rakkath , ka Khinnereth ,
translation.en: And the fenced cities are Ziddim , Zer , and Hammath , Rakkath , and Chinnereth ,

translation.kha: U Thomas u la ino ha u , Ko Kynrad , ngim tip shano ba men leit ; te kumno ngin tip ïa ka lynti don poi hangta ?
translation.en: Thomas saith unto him , Lord , we know not whither thou goest  ; and how can we know the way ?

translation.kha: Ngi dei ban duwai na ka pynbha ka Khmih U Balei ba kan wang .—Mathaios 6 :10 .
translation.en: We should pray for God’s Kingdom to come . —Matthew 6 :10 .

translation.kha: Nga long kum u mluh uba ïong ha khmat u kynrad jong u . kumto nga lah banbeiñ ïakren bad phi ? Pynngam donbor litar jingpynhiar mynsiem kaba tang Hukum ha nga .
translation.en: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord ? for as for me , straightway there remained no strength in me , neither is there breath left in me .

translation.kha: To shah lang ïashoh ïa phi ïathuh katno nga la trei skhem na ka boitha jong phi , dara na ka bynta ki briew ha Laodikaïa bad na ka bynta kiwei patan baïar ki bym ithuh ïa nga markhmat .
translation.en: For I would that ye knew what great conflict I have for you , and for them at Laodicea , and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh ;

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kren bad u la ong ha u , Ko Simon , nga don ei ei ban ong ha me . Ko Nonghikai , u la ong , to ïathuh ïa nga .
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Simon , I have somewhat to say unto thee .  And he saith , Master , say on .
The law and the prophets were until John : since that time the kingdom of God is preached , and every man presseth into it .
translation.kha: Ka Hukum u Moses bad ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa ki treikam haduh ka por jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ; naduh kata ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hima U Blei la ïai ïathuh , bad uwei pa uwei u bsut jubor shapoh .
Heldai kane , la don ka thma bad ki Philistia ha Gob , ha katba u Sibbekai uba na Hushah u la pynïap ïa u ramhah uba kyrteng u Saphon .
translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob : then Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Saph , which was of the sons of the giant .
They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace , and calling one to another , and saying , We have piped unto you , and ye have not danced  ; we have mourned to you , and ye have not wept .
translation.kha: Ki long kum ki khynnah kiba shong ha ki jaka ïew . Kawei ka kynhun ka pyrta ïa kawei pat , ‘ Ngi la tem ka jingtem shongkurim na ka bynta jong phi , hynrei phim shym shad ! Ngi la rwai ki jingrwai ïapbriew , hynrei phim shym ïam !’
Lah ban jied da ka langbrot ne da ka blang , tangba u dei ban long u shynrang uba shisnem bad u bym don katno kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: Your lamb shall be without blemish , a male of the first year : ye shall take it out from the sheep , or from the goats :
And went to him , and bound up his wounds , pouring in oil and wine , and set him on his own beast , and brought him to an inn , and took care of him .
translation.kha: U la leit sha u , u la theh umphniang bad ka waiñ ha ki jingmong jong u bad u la spaiñ ïa ki ; nangta u la buh ïa uta u briew halor u jingri jong u bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ka ïingbasa    , ha kaba u la sumar ïa u .

mynba , la kumno kumno ngan phah ïa ki rangbah synshar jong ar ban ïit ha ka ïingshong jong me bad ha ki ïing jong ki rangbah synshar jong me , Bad ban shim ïa kaei katei baroh kiba ki kheit kordor . Kin poi hangto lashai kam katjuh por .
translation.en: Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time , and they shall search thine house , and the houses of thy servants  ; and it shall be , that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes , they shall put it in their hand , and take it away .

translation.kha: U Petros u la pynlong ïa kan ka jingkyrpad ha ki bad da ki kyntien babun u la jingkyrpad ïa ki , da kaba ino , To pynim ïa lade na ka Jingpynshitom kaba wan ha une u paidbah ba-bymman !
translation.en: And with many other words did he testify and exhort , saying , Save yourselves from this untoward generation .

translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul , Khmih , ki briew ki la leh pop pynshisha ïa U Trai da kaba bam ïa ka thop kaba dang don snam shiah jong ka . Phi dei ki ïashetkylla ! u Saul u kyang . Pyntyllun uwei u maw theh shane sha nga .
translation.en: Then they told Saul , saying , Behold , the people sin against the  Lord  , in that they eat with the blood . And he said , Ye have transgressed : roll a great stone unto me this day .
Then the king commanded , and they brought Daniel , and cast him into the den of lions . Now the king spake and said unto Daniel , Thy God whom thou servest continually , he will deliver thee .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u la ai ki hukum ban kem ïa u Daniel bad ban bret ïa u shapoh ka thliew kaba dap da ki sing . U la ong ha u Daniel ,  Ai ba U Blei jong me , ïa uba me shakri hok katta katta , un pyllait im ïa me .
Ïeng joit , ïa ngin ïaleit noh . Ha khmih , hangne u don u briew uba shetkylla ïa nga !
translation.en: Rise up , let us go  ; lo , he that betrayeth me is at hand .
And it came to pass , when the king had heard the words of the law , that he rent his clothes .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingpule na kata ka kitab , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih

Lada ka kti lane ka kjat jrong phi ka Pynlong ïa phi ban duh noh ïa ka jingkyntait jong phi , to ot khong bad bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban rung sha ka jingim khlem ka kti lane ka jait ban ïa kaba ne baroh ar tylli ki kti bad ki kjat bad ban shah bret shapoh ka ding bymjukut .
translation.en: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee , cut them off , and cast them from thee : it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed , rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire .

translation.kha: Kumno re kumno , la ei bun ki brisoh kiba la ïohi ïa ki ba ki leit bad ki la pyntip shisyndon ba ki long kiei ; kumta ki la ïaleh na barabor ki shnong bad mareh na ryngkhiang badno ki la poi ha ka jaka shuwa ïa U Jisu! bad ki synran .
translation.en: And the people saw them departing , and many knew him , and ran afoot thither out of all cities , and outwent them , and came together unto him .

translation.kha: Lada nga la tip ba un leh , ngan rynsied da kaba kmen , kam pher katno khroh ka jingpang jong nga . Nga tip ba U Blei u long uba khuid ; ngam pat ju pyrshah ïa kamai kaba u suda .
translation.en: Then should I yet have comfort  ; yea , I would harden myself in sorrow : let him not spare  ; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One .

But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb : and if thou redeem him not , then shalt thou break his neck . All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem . And none shall appear before me empty .
translation.kha: uba la kha nyngkong da kaba phin ai pat da u khunlangbrot ha ka jaka jong u . Lada phim thied biang ïa u , pynkheiñ ïa ka ryndang jong u . Thied biang ïa uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong jong phi .  Uno uno ruh , um dei ban wan ha khmat jong nga khlem ka jingainguh .

Ki la wan sha u bad ki la ong , Ko Nonghikai , ine tip ba me kren ïa ka jingjyrsieh , khlem da khuslai ïa kaei kaba ki briew ki pyrkhat . Mem ñiew ïa ka kyrdan u briew , hynmen me hikai ïa ka jingshisha shaphang ka mon U Blei na ka bynta u briew . To ïathuh ïa ngi , hato ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ban siew ki khajna shat u Patsha ka Rom ? Hato ka dei ïa ngi ban siew ne ban ym siew ?
translation.en: And when they were come , they say unto him , Master , we know that thou art true , and carest for no man : for thou regardest not the person of men , but teachest the way of God in truth : Is it lawful to give tribute to Caesar , or not ?

translation.kha: Nangta , pynsleh ïa ki kumba me leh ïa u Kpa jong ki , ba ki lah ban sakhrai ïa nga kum ki lyngngeit . Da kane ka jingpynshlur , kin ïailong ki lyngdoh sei rta .
translation.en: And thou shalt anoint them , as thou didst anoint their father , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office : for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations .

translation.kha: Nabal don ki briew ki bymriewblei hapdeng jong ngi , kba la syntuid noh khlem poi pyrkhat , ki briew naba la pynkylla ïa ka khubor shang ka jingbei jongu U Blei jongngi ngi , khnam ban pynksan ïa la ki jingleh bajakhlia , badno kiba kyntait ïa U Jiw Khrist , uba long tang ma u hi U Kynrad bad U Trai jong ngi . La sloit bah , ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki la ïathuhlypa ïa ka jingpynrem kaba ki la ïohpdiang .
translation.en: For there are certain men crept in unawares , who were before of old ordained to this condemnation , ungodly men , turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness , and denying the only Lord God , and our Lord Jesus Christ .
With him is wisdom and strength , he hath counsel and understanding .
translation.kha: Ki riewtymmen ki don ka jingstad , hynrei U Blei u don ka jingstad bad ka bor . Ki riewtymmen ki don ka jingïohi jngai ; U Blei u don ka jingïohi jngai bad ka bor ban pyntreikam .
Ha kita ki maw ba phi la ñiad astor , thoh shai ïa ki ktien baroh jong ki lawbah U Blei .
translation.en: And thou shalt write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly .

translation.kha: Nga la smai da ka kirteng jong nga — U Trai u kren — ba kan kyrkhu kyrhai ïa me . Namar me la lai ïa kane , bad mem shym la tyngkai noh ïa la u khuid maw na nga ,
translation.en: And said , By myself have I sworn , saith the  Lord  , for because thou hast done this thing , and hast not withheld thy son , thine only son :

translation.kha: Nga long uba hok ; nga lah don ïasaidnia bad U Blei ; un pynbna shisien pynbna , ba nga long uba hok .
translation.en: There the righteous might dispute with him  ; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge .
Then called I upon the name of the  Lord   ; O  Lord  , I beseech thee , deliver my soul .
translation.kha: Te nga la khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ,  Nga kyrpad ïa me , A  Trai  , to pynim ïa nga !
Ka long kaba sbun ïa kiba dukan , bad Ibbah kyrduh .
translation.en: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor  ; yea , she reacheth forth her hands to the needy .
Then he said , I have sinned : yet honour me now , I pray thee , before the elders of my people , and before Israel , and turn again with me , that I may worship the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Nga la leh pop ,  u Saul u jubab .  Hynrei la kumno kumno pyn-i ka jingñiewkor ïa nga ha khmat ki nongïalam jong ki briew jong nga bad ki Israel baroh . Ïaleit phai ryngkat bad nga , ba ngan lah ban mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
Yn ym don na ki u ban hikai ïa la u para shnong lane ong ïa la u lai ri , ‘ To tipbriew ïa U Trai .’ Namar baroh kin tip ïa nga , naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw tam .
translation.en: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the Lord : for all shall know me , from the least to the greatest .

translation.kha: Phi pynjahburom ïa nga ha khmat ki briew jong nga khnang ban ïoh katto katne kham u barli bad khyndiat tyrnem ki lyngngoh kpu . Phi pynïap ïa ki briew ki bym daiñ hok ban ïap , bad phi pynsah im ïa ki briew ki bym Dei hok ban im . Kumta phi ïathuh ki jinglamler ha ki briew jong nga , bad ki ngeit ïa phi .
translation.en: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread , to slay the souls that should not die , and to save the souls alive that should not live , by your lying to my people that hear your lies ?

translation.kha: Phin ïatyngkhuh para ma Phi , kam la ym don uba beh ïa phi , bad phin ym lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa uno uno u nongshun .
translation.en: And they shall fall one upon another , as it were before a sword , when none pursueth : and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies .

translation.kha: nabar mon la u khun nyngkong ha Ijipt un ïarep , naduh u khun nyngkong jong u syiem u ban ïoh ïa ka khet , haduh u khun nyngkong jong ka mraw kaba thylli kew . Kiba kha nyngkong na ki jingri baroh ruh kin ïan .
translation.en: And all the firstborn in the land of Egypt shall die , from the firstborn of Pharaoh that sitteth upon his throne , even unto the firstborn of the maidservant that is behind the mill  ; and all the firstborn of beasts .

translation.kha: Nga don ha ka liang jong phi , bad ngan pynthikna ba yn lur biang ïa ka khyndew Jong phi bad ïa ki symbai yn thung hangta .
translation.en: For , behold , I am for you , and I will turn unto you , and ye shall be tilled and sown :
And David was displeased , because the  Lord  had made a breach upon Uzza : wherefore that place is called Perez–uzza to this day .
translation.kha: bad kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot ka Peres Ussah naduh kata ka por . U Dabid u la bitar namar U  Trai  u la pynshitom ïa u Ussah ha ka jingbitar .
aiu ngan ong shuh ha me ! Me Tip bha ïa nga , nabar pynpang me pyndonburom ïa nga , u sharak jong me .
translation.en: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant ? for thou knowest thy servant .

translation.kha: U Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shajrong , u Mahli bad u Mushi . U Mahli hima u don ar ngut ki ïakhun shynrang , u Eleasar bad u Kish ,
translation.en: The sons of Merari  ; Mahli , and Mushi . The sons of Mahli  ; Eleazar , and Kish .

translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa kito naba kyrkhu ïa me , jynreiñ ngan tem ïa Aner kiba tei ïa me . Bad da me ngan kyrkhu ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translation.en: And I will bless them that bless thee , and curse him that curseth thee : and in thee shall all families of the earth be blessed .

translation.kha: Ha kaba khatduh , u nongtrei shrak u la haka ban pynjai jat ïa u Paidbah’ . Ko Para nong Ephesos ! u la ong . Uwei pa uwei u tip ba ka nongjop Ephesos ka dei ka nongsumar ïa ka templ jong ka Artemis bakhraw bun ïa u mawkyntang uba la hap na sahit bneng .
translation.en: And when the townclerk had appeased the people , he said , Ye men of Ephesus , what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana , and of the image which fell down from Jupiter ?

translation.kha: Ka jingim jongki nga ka ïaid kum ka lieng naba stet tam , khem ka jingstet u pukni Uba khuid kynshoit shapoh banbeiñ kynrup ïa ka rabbit .
translation.en: They are passed away as the swift ships : as the eagle that hasteth to the prey .

translation.kha: Ngan wan sha phi dara pyllait im ïa phi . Ngan pynjot ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , hynrei kan ym pynjot ïa phi . Ngan ym shah ïa phi ban rupa khlem shah pynmih ; hynrei haba nga pynmih ïa phi , ngan erlangthari u bym leh shiliang . Ma nga , U Trai’ , to la kren .
translation.en: For I am with thee , saith the  Lord  , to save thee : though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee , yet will I not make a full end of thee : but I will correct thee in measure , and will not leave thee altogether unpunished .

translation.kha: Keiñ ki dei ki khat-ar nud kiba u la jied : U Sihon ( U Jisu u la ai kyrteng ïa u , u Petros ) ;
translation.en: And Simon he surnamed Peter  ;

translation.kha: Ki ki jong me ki la pynlong bad pynwandur ïa nga , bad mynsiem kito kijuh ki kti ki pynjot ïa to .
translation.en: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about  ; yet thou dost destroy me .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh u jaboh , Phim dakmong baneh khuslai ei ei . U Trai un sumar ïa phi ha ka jingleit jong phi .
translation.en: And the priest said unto them , Go in peace : before the  Lord  is your way wherein ye go .

translation.kha: namar baroh ar ngut phi la leh palat ïa nga ha khmat ki Israel . Mynba phi ïadoh ha ki um Meribah , hajan ka shnong Kadesh , ha ka ri khlaw Sin , phi la pynjahburom ïa nga ha khmat u paidbah .
translation.en: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah–kadesh , in the wilderness of Zin  ; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei longsem ka jingsuh ïa U Blei! Naba wat mynshuwa haba phi la long ki mraw jong ka pop , phi la kohnguh da la ka dohnud baroh ïa ki jingshisha ba la shem ha ka jinghikai kaba phi la ïohsngew .
translation.en: But God be thanked , that ye were the servants of sin , but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you .
And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear , and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign , saith the  Lord  , whose fire is in Zion , and his furnace in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U patsha jong ki un phet ha ka jingsngew shyrkhei , bad ki rangbah shipai kin sheptieng haduh katta katta haduh ba kin iehnoh ïa ki lama thma jong ki .  U  Trai  u la kren — U  Trai  ïa uba la mane ha Jerusalem bad uba ka ding jong u ka thang hangta ïa ki jingkñia .

translation.en: On what pattern are our congregation meetings based ?
translation.kha: Ha kano ka rukom la pynshong nongrim ïa ki jingïalang jong ngi ?
Da kumta u Shual bad lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u baroh ki la ïap len bad ym don uba na ki kynhun ki ksiew jong u kiba ïoh ban synshar .
translation.en: So Saul died , and his three sons , and all his house died together .

translation.kha: Lada ki kohnguh ïa U Bel bad shakri ïa u , kin pynleit ïa ka jingim jong ki ha ka jingduk bad ka jingmanbha .
translation.en: If they obey and serve him , they shall spend their days in prosperity , and their years in pleasures .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Ninebeh , ka nuti la nang pynshitom . Kaba khring bad kaba dap da ki jingpynshohbieit kiba ma , ka la pynlyngngoh ïa ki jaitbynriew bad ka la jingringmraw ïa ki .
translation.en: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot , the mistress of witchcrafts , that selleth nations through her whoredoms , and families through her witchcrafts .
And they said one to another , Did not our heart burn within us , while he talked with us by the way , and while he opened to us the scriptures ?
translation.kha: Ki la ong para ma ki ,  Hato kam shym la long kum ka ding kaba klang hapoh jong ngi mynba u la kren ha ngi ha ka lynti bad batai ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ha ngi ?

translation.en: But now he hath made me weary : thou hast made desolate all my company .
translation.kha: Me la pynduhbor ïa nga , A Blei ; me la shah ba yn pynïap ïa ka longïing jong nga .

Lada ki rangbah kiba ïasah ki pynmynsaw ïa ka kynthei kaba pynhun , bad kata ka brup ka hap khun , hynrei kam smam mong shym mynsaw da kumwei pang , uta uba pynmynsaw ïa ka un shah shoiñ kuna kat kumba u tnga jong kata ka biria u dawa , bad u dei ban siew kumba la buh dor ki nongbishar .
translation.en: If men strive , and hurt a woman with child , so that her fruit depart from her , and yet no mischief follow : he shall be surely punished , according as the woman s husband will lay upon him  ; and he shall pay as the judges determine .
And he commanded the foremost , saying , When Esau my brother meeteth thee , and asketh thee , saying , Whose art thou ? and whither goest thou ? and whose are these before thee ?
translation.kha: U la hukum ruh ïa u shakri uba ha khmat eh ,  Ynda u Iso u hynmen jong nga u ïakynduh ïa me , bad u kylli , ‘ Uei u kynrad jong me ? Shano men leit ? Uei u trai jong kine ki jingri kiba ha khmat jong me ?’
U Gershom u ni ar ngat ki khun shynna : u Ladan bad u Shimei .
translation.en: Of the Gershonites were , Laadan , and Shimei .

translation.kha: Nga sien pynlehrain ïa ki , bad kam lah khia shuh ki thiah ha ka jingshahjop ha khmat jngai nga .
translation.en: And I have consumed them , and wounded them , that they could not arise : yea , they are fallen under my feet .

translation.kha: Hobab u Haman u la mihnoh na ka jingkhawai u la kmen bad ngap da ka jingsngewbha . Hynrei u ïew pat ïa u Mordekai ha ka khyrdop bad um shym la ïeng lane pyn-at kano kano ka dak jong ka jingburom hajuh u ïadih nangta , u Haman u la bato ïa u .
translation.en: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart : but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king s gate , that he stood not up , nor moved for him , he was full of indignation against Mordecai .

translation.kha: Pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong ki rymmiang bad ki riewsniew ; pynshitom ïa ki namar ka jingbakla kaba ki la ai tad haduh ba kin ym kuna shuh ïa ka .
translation.en: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man : seek out his wickedness till thou find none .
Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you , saying , The king of Babylon shall not come against you , nor against this land ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba la jia ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la ong ïa phi ba u syiem ka Babilonia un ym tur ïaleh ïa phi lane ïa ka ri ?

translation.en: And Esther said , The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman . Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen .
translation.kha: Ka Esther ka ong ,  U nongshun jong ngi , u nongpynshitom jong ngi , u dei une u briew uba sniew , u Haman !  U Haman u khmih sha u syiem bad ka mahadei da ka jingsheptieng .
Lada mano mano ban wan wat tang hajan ka Ïingjaiñ ruh un ïap , te ngi baroh ngi long hi Kum kiba la ïap .
translation.en: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the  Lord  shall die : shall we be consumed with dying ?

translation.kha: Ahian kane , U Jisu u la neng ïaid ha ka Galilaïa ; um shym kwah ban leit sha Jedaïah , namar ba ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw hangta ki la ïakwah pun pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: After these things Jesus walked in Galilee : for he would not walk in Jewry , because the Jews sought to kill him .

translation.kha: Kum u sing uba wan mih na ka jakarieh jongnga u , u nongpynjot jong ki jingpyniwbih u la mihnoh . U wan ban pynjot ïa ka Jedaïah . Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Judah yn ieh ha ki jingjot , bad yn ym don mano mano bashong ba sah ha ki .
translation.en: The lion is come up from his thicket , and the destroyer of the Gentiles is on his way  ; he is gone forth from his place to make thy land desolate  ; and thy cities shall be laid waste , without an inhabitant .

translation.kha: ngat ki la ïalam ei ruh ïa ka Dinah na ïong u Shekhem , bad ki ïalute noh .
translation.en: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword , and took Dinah out of Shechem s house , and went out .
He is despised and rejected of men  ; a man of sorrows , and acquainted with grief : and we hid as it were our faces from him  ; he was despised , and we esteemed him not .
translation.kha: Ngi la ñiewbeiñ ïa u bad ngi la kyntait ïa u ; u la shah ïa ka jingshitom bad jingpang . Ym don mano mano wat ban peit ïa u — ngi la leh bymsalia ïa u kum u bym long ei ei .

translation.en: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion  ; for he loved Hannah : but the  Lord  had shut up her womb .
translation.kha: Bad wat la u ieit eh ïa ka Hannah , u ai ïa ka tang shi bynta namar ba U  Trai  u la pynlyngki ïa ka .
Wat phong ïa ka jai ba la thain nur da u saiwul mala u sai linen .
translation.en: Thou shalt not wear a garment of divers sorts , as of woollen and linen together .
And he came to Ephesus , and left them there : but he himself entered into the synagogue , and reasoned with the Jews .
translation.kha: Ki la poi ha Ephesos , ha kaba u Paul u la iehnoh ïa ka Priskila bad ïa u Akwila . U la leit sha ka synagog bad u la pynlong ka jingïaphylliew jingmut bad ki Jiw .
U Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kylli ïa U Jisu shaphang ki synran jong u mala shaphang ka jinghikai jong u .
translation.en: The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples , and of his doctrine .

translation.kha: Ki la ïohpdiang na u ïa kita ki jingai baroh ba ki Israel ki la wallam na ka bynta ban tei ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ kambah kyntang . Khynñiuh ki Israel ki nang ïai wallam sha u Moses ïa ki jingainguh jong ki man ka step .
translation.en: And they received of Moses all the offering , which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary , to make it withal . And they brought yet unto him free offerings every morning .

translation.kha: Long kiba kohnguh bad kiba ïaineh , bad U Bel un ïohmap ïa ka pop jong phi . To kohnguh ïa U Tlai bun kaba sniew kan ym jia ha phi .
translation.en: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged : and by the fear of the  Lord  men depart from evil .

translation.kha: To sumar ban ym phai dien noh na ka jingïadei U Blei . Wat ai ba uno uno un long kum u jingthung babha kthang , uba san bad umbah pynjynjar da ka bih jong u .
translation.en: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God  ; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you , and thereby many be defiled  ;
And the eunuch answered Philip , and said , I pray thee , of whom speaketh the prophet this ? of himself , or of some other man ?
translation.kha: Uta u rangbah synshar u la kylli ïa u Philip ,  To ïathuh ïa nga , shaphang jongno u nongïathuhlypa u kren ïa kane ? Shaphang ïa lade ne shaphang uwei pat ?

Kine ki long ine ki Jingkhawai Niam ha kiba phoi ai burom ïa U Trai da kaba ïalumlang ban mane Blei bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh stong , ïa ki jingangnud bam , ïa ki jingkñia , mala ïa ki jingainguh dih , man la ka sngi kumba la buh .
translation.en: These are the feasts of the  Lord  , which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations , to offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord  , a burnt offering , and a meat offering , a sacrifice , and drink offerings , every thing upon his day :
And when I shall put thee out , I will cover the heaven , and make the stars thereof dark  ; I will cover the sun with a cloud , and the moon shall not give her light .
translation.kha: Ynda nga pynjot ïa me , ngan tap ïa ka sahit bneng bad pyndum ïa ki khlur . Ka sngi kan buhrieh sha lyndet ki lyoh , bad u bnai un ym ai jingshai .

Ki nong Babilonia ki la tei ïa ki kynton kerkut sawdong ïa ka nongbah ban kurup ïa ka , malade ki tur ïaleh ïa ka . Ka thma , ka jingïapthngan malade ka jingpang kin pynlong ïa ka nongbeh ban hap ha ki kti jong ki . Me lah ngab ïuh ba baroh kaba me la kren ka la urlong shisha .
translation.en: Behold the mounts , they are come unto the city to take it  ; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans , that fight against it , because of the sword , and of the famine , and of the pestilence : and what thou hast spoken is come to pass  ; and , behold , thou seest it .

translation.kha: Kat ngi ainguh ïa U Blei ba u la pynlong ïa u Titos ban thrang kum ma ngi ban ïarap ïa phi .
translation.en: But thanks be to God , which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you .
Blessed are the merciful : for they shall obtain mercy .
translation.kha: Suk kito kiba isynei ïa kiwei pat ; U Blei un isynei ïa ki !
Kiwei pang ki ai ksuid ïa ki nongsynran jongki ki ban pynpang lane wat ban pynpyut ïa ki .
translation.en: Others cast spells on their enemies to make them sick or even to kill them .
And one went out into the field to gather herbs , and found a wild vine , and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full , and came and shred them into the pot of pottage : for they knew them not .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki u leit sha lyngkha ban ïoh katto katne ki jhur . U lap uwei u jyrmi khlaw bad u kheit bun tylli ki klong katba u lah ban kit . U la wanrah ïa ki bad ot dkhot ïa ki hapoh ka syrwa , khlem da tip ki dei kiba kumno .

Haba ki Israel kiba ha shiliang kata ka them Jesreel bad kiba sha mihngi ka wah Joanan ki ïohsngew ba ka kynhun swai ki Israel ka la phet ïa-ïap bad u Saul pynlang ki khun shynrang jong u ki la kyllon ïap , ki ruh ki iehnoh ei ïa la ki sneng malu ki kjit ïa-ïap . Nangta ki Pamphylia ki wan mala ki shong shnong hangtei .
translation.en: And when the men of Israel that were on the other side of the valley , and they that were on the other side Jordan , saw that the men of Israel fled , and that Saul and his sons were dead , they forsook the cities , and fled  ; and the Philistines came and dwelt in them .

translation.kha: Wat ka jait ka kynja kaba rit bad ba duk tam kan sa long kambah khraw kumno ka jaitbynriew kaba donbor . Ha ka por kaba biang ka la wang , ngan pynkhia kloi ïa kine kiei kiei . Nga long U Trai !
translation.en: A little one shall become a thousand , and a small one a strong nation : I the  Lord  will hasten it in his time .

translation.kha: Ai ïa u khynnah ha nga , u Elijah u la ainong . U sping ïa uta u khynnah na ki kti jong ka , u rah ïa u shalor sha ka kamra kaba u sah , bad u pynthiah ïa u ha ka jingkhiah .
translation.en: And he said unto her , Give me thy son . And he took him out of her bosom , and carried him up into a loft , where he abode , and laid him upon his own bed .

translation.kha: U Ephah u phah nonglamktien wiang sha u syiem Ammon
translation.en: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon :
And in that day it shall come to pass , that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin , and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ka sngi ka wan ha kaba ka jingkhraw jong ka Israel kan poi sha kaba kut , bad ïa ka spah jong ka yn bujli da ka jingduk .
Ka um ka la sdang don tyllep ïa nga , bad nga la pyrkhat ba ka jingdap ka la junom .
translation.en: Waters flowed over mine head  ; then I said , I am cut off .

translation.kha: Kaei kob nga la ïohi bad ïohpdiang ha ka jingïohipaw ka la pyndap ïa nga da ka jingsngewtriem dara sngewpang , ka jingpang kum ka jong ka kynthei ha ka por suh kha .
translation.en: Therefore are my loins filled with pain : pangs have taken hold upon me , as the pangs of a woman that travaileth : I was bowed down at the hearing of it  ; I was dismayed at the seeing of it .
And the table and his furniture , and the pure candlestick with all his furniture , and the altar of incense ,
translation.kha: ïa ka miej bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka , ïa u diengpynïeng sharak ksiar bad ki tiar ki tar jong u baroh , ïa ka duwan ban thang jingiwbih ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Ahijah , Behold , the wife of Jeroboam cometh to ask a thing of thee for her son  ; for he is sick : thus and thus shalt thou say unto her : for it shall be , when she cometh in , that she shall feign herself to be another woman .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ïathuh ha u ba ka tnga u Jeroboam kan wan wad jingtip na u shaphang u khun jong ka , uba pang . Bad U  Trai  u bthah ïa u Ahijah aïu ban ong . Haba ka tnga u Jeroboam ka la poi , ka leh mynleh ïa lade kum kawei pat ka briew .

translation.en: Make bright the arrows  ; gather the shields : the  Lord  hath raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes : for his device is against Babylon , to destroy it  ; because it is the vengeance of the  Lord  , the vengeance of his temple .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynkhih ïa ki syiem jong ka Media , namar u thmu ban pynjot ïa ka Babilonia . Dei da kumta un siew kylliang namar ka jingpynjot ïa ka Templ jong u . Ki rangbah ai hukum ban tur ïaleh , ki hukum ,  Pynnep ïa ki khnam jong phi ! Pynkhreh ïa ki stieh jong phi !

Hadien ba U Jisu u la lah Ong ïa kane ka jingduwai , u la mihnoh bad la ki synran bad otsher sha shiliang ka wahduid ba la khot ka Kidron . Ka la don ka kper ha kata ka jaka , bad U Jisu mala la ki synran ki la rung shapoh .
translation.en: When Jesus had spoken these words , he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron , where was a garden , into the which he entered , and his disciples .

When thou hast made an end of tithing all the tithes of thine increase the third year , which is the year of tithing , and hast given it unto the Levite , the stranger , the fatherless , and the widow , that they may eat within thy gates , and be filled  ;
translation.kha: Shisien man ka lai snem , ai kawei-na-kaba-shiphew — kaba shiphew na ki jingthung jong phi — ha ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , khnang ba ha man la ka shnong kin ïoh bam kdang . Haba phi la leh ïa kane ,

Khmih shatei halor ki kliar lum . Hato Don kano kano ka jaka ha kaba pham shym la leh kum ka nuti ? Pha la ap ïa ki nongleh-ieit shi lynter ka rud siaw , kumba u Arab u apthap ha ka ri shyiap . Pha la pyntngit ïa ka ri da ka jingleh nuti jong pha .
translation.en: Lift up thine eyes unto the high places , and see where thou hast not been lien with . In the ways hast thou sat for them , as the Arabian in the wilderness  ; and thou hast polluted the land with thy whoredoms and with thy wickedness .
And the Syrians fled before Israel  ; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians , and forty thousand horsemen , and smote Shobach the captain of their host , who died there .
translation.kha: bad ki Israel ki la pynher krad ïa ka kynhun shipai Syria . U Dabid lem bad ki rangbah jong u ki la pynïap hynñiewspah ngut ki nongñiah kali ïapom bad sawphew hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai , bad ki la pynmynsaw ïa u Shobakh , u rangbah ai hukum jong u nongshun , uba la ïap ha ka madan thma .

translation.en: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh . If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh , I more :
translation.kha: Nga lah eh , da shisha , ban shaniah ha kum kito kiei kiei . Lada uno uno u pyrkhat ba u lah ban shaniah ha ki jinglehniam kiba shabar , nga don ka daw kaba kham khraw ban sngew kumta .
Kaei ka Jingiathuh khana ba phi iathuh ?
translation.en: Which story did you tell ?
But if the unbelieving depart , let him depart . A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases : but God hath called us to peace .
translation.kha: Pynban , lada u bymngeit u kwah ban iehnoh ïa tnga ka bangeit , ai ba kan long kumta . Ha kiba kum kita ki khep u tnga ne ka tnga bangeit , ki la laitluid ban jied . U Blei u la khot ïa phi ïa ka ban im ha ka jingsuk .

Ki brup kiba don hapoh ïing pynlang ka Mahli , ban pynshahthngan ïa ka , ki la ïabah ïa ka Haba ki la ïohi ba ka la ïeng joit bad miaw kyrkieh . Ki la pyrkhat ba ka leit sha ka jingtep shun ïatim hangta .
translation.en: The Jews then which were with her in the house , and comforted her , when they saw Mary , that she rose up hastily and went out , followed her , saying , She goeth unto the grave to weep there .
For the Lord  God  will help me  ; therefore shall I not be confounded : therefore have I set my face like a flint , and I know that I shall not be ashamed .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki jingkrenbeiñ jong ki kim lah ban pynmong ïa nga namar ba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ai jingïarap ïa nga . Nga pyneh ïa lade ban ïaishah ïa ki . Nga tip ba ngan ym shah pynjahburom ,

shadien ba la kut ki hynñiew bthei yn iaid kyrpang ïa ki rangbah ki ngab lytar lyngba ïa ka ri khnang ban wad bad ba thap ïa wer ki metïap kiba dang sah ha Madon , ba kumta yn pynlong khuid ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And they shall sever out men of continual employment , passing through the land to bury with the passengers those that remain upon the face of the earth , to cleanse it : after the end of seven months shall they search .

translation.kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ong ki brup ka Jerusalem , nabar ki kti jong ngi ki noh kyrsiew , la kem ïa ngi da ka jinglyng-a Bad ka jingpang kum ka kynthei kaba suh kha .
translation.en: We have heard the fame thereof : our hands wax feeble : anguish hath taken hold of us , and pain , as of a woman in travail .

translation.kha: Balei U Jehobah u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei ?
translation.en: Why did Jehovah create the earth ?

translation.kha: U shym ka Syria un pynkhreh ka jinghiarthma , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh kawei . Nangta , kthang ban pynjot ïa ka hima jong u nongshun , un pynlong ka jingïaineh lok bad u bad tyrwa ha u ban shongkurim ïa ka Kynhun jongno u ; hynrei ka jingthmu jong u kun ym jop .
translation.en: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom , and upright ones with him  ; thus shall he do : and he shall give him the daughter of women , corrupting her : but she shall not stand on his side , neither be for him .

translation.kha: Kum ki kwah kiba la sangeh noh ban tuid , bad ki pung-um kiba la rngad noh ,
translation.en: As the waters fail from the sea , and the flood decayeth and drieth up :
( And the  Lord  gave Israel a saviour , so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians : and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents , as beforetime .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ha ki Israel ïa u nongïalam , uba pyllaitluid ïa ki na ki Syria , bad kumta ki Israel ki im ha ka jingsuk , kumba mynshuwa .

translation.en: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith , and labour of love , and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ , in the sight of God and our Father ;
translation.kha: Naba ngi kynmaw ha khmat U Blei bad U Kpa jong ngi ba kumno phi pyntreikam ïa ka jingngeit , kumta ba ka jingieit jong phi ka pynlah ïa phi ban trei shitom , bad kumno ka jingkyrmen jong phi ha U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ka long kaba skhem .

Ki nongrah-khubor ki la rah ïa khie ka jingpynbna sha kawei pa kawei ka jingtehkular jong ka hima . Ka don ki jingbthah ba tang ha kawei ka sngi , ka sngi kaba khaïi jong u Adar , ïa baroh ki Jiw — sum bad tymmen , kynthei bad khynnah — dei pun pynïap . Ïa ki dei ban pynïap khlem jingtei bad ba ïa ki jingdon jingjam jrong ki dei ban shim nong .
translation.en: And the letters were sent by posts into all the king s provinces , to destroy , to kill , and to cause to perish , all Jews , both young and old , little children and women , in one day , even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar , and to take the spoil of them for a prey .

translation.kha: U syiem la u ba-itynnat ïa ka palat baneh ïa kiwei pat ki samla kynthei , mala palat ban ïa kiwei pat , ka la ïoh ïa ka jinglehbha dara ka jingsngewieit . U nguh ïa ka pansngiat symboh ha ka khlieh jong ka badno pynlong mahadei ïa ka ha ka jaka jong ka Bashti .
translation.en: And the king loved Esther above all the women , and she obtained grace and favour in his sight more than all the virgins  ; so that he set the royal crown upon her head , and made her queen instead of Vashti .

translation.kha: Ki kyntait ban wan phan sha nga , bad kumta ki dei ban otsher phai shiah Ijipt , bad ki nong Assyria kin synshar ba-halor jong ki .
translation.en: He shall not return into the land of Egypt , but the Assyrian shall be his king , because they refused to return .

translation.kha: Habor sakma ka por ka poi , U Trai un wai uwei u nongpynkha shñiuh na shaw shiliang ka wah Ïuphratis — u patsha jong ka Assyria ! — bad un khi ïa ki tmain jong phi bad ïa ki shñiuh halor ki khlieh mala ki met jong phi .
translation.en: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired , namely , by them beyond the river , by the king of Assyria , the head , and the hair of the feet : and it shall also consume the beard .

translation.kha: ki pun sa rkhie ïa u , kin bynthiew halor jong u , kin sympat ïa u , bad pynïap ïa u ; hynrei hadien lai sngi un sa mihpat .
translation.en: And they shall mock him , and shall scourge him , and shall spit upon him , and shall kill him : and the third day he shall rise again .

translation.kha: U Balak u kham tyngeh ïa la ki sla kti da ka jingbitar bad u ino ha u Balaam , Nga la khor ïa me ban tim ïa ki nongshun jong ang , hynrei la lai sien me la kyrshut pynban ïa ki .
translation.en: And Balak s anger was kindled against Balaam , and he smote his hands together : and Balak said unto Balaam , I called thee to curse mine enemies , and , behold , thou hast altogether blessed them these three times .

translation.kha: A Trai , hato yn ym pynkhih ïa me da kane baroh ? Hato Men ym leh ei ei bad sha ba ngin shah jynjar palat ïa kaba ngi lah ban shait ?
translation.en: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things , O  Lord  ? wilt thou hold thy peace , and afflict us very sore ?

translation.kha: Te lada ki sngewlehrain ïa kaei kaba ki la sa , sa batai ïa ka jingthmu jong ka Templ ha ki : Ïa ka jingpynwandur jong ka , ïa ki khyrdop jingrung bad jingmih jong ka , ïa ka dur jong ka , ïa ka jingbuhbeit ryntih ïa kiei kiei baher nabar ïa baroh ki aiñ . To thoh ïa kane baroh na ka bynta jong ki khnang ba ki lah ban ïohi kumno ïa kiei kiei baroh la buh ryntih bad ba lah ba-bang pyndep ïa baher ki aïu .
translation.en: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done , shew them the form of the house , and the fashion thereof , and the goings out thereof , and the comings in thereof , and all the forms thereof , and all the ordinances thereof , and all the forms thereof , and all the laws thereof : and write it in their sight , that they may keep the whole form thereof , and all the ordinances thereof , and do them .

translation.kha: Wat pynïeng ruh ïa uno uno u phiah maw na ka bynta ka jingmane bleithaw ; U Trai u isih ïa kita .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image  ; which the  Lord  thy God hateth .

translation.kha: Ym Don ei ei ïa u kpa ishyrkhei ka jingsngewsih bad jingkthang haba u khun jong u leh ïa ki kam bieit .
translation.en: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow : and the father of a fool hath no joy .

translation.kha: Kiwei leit bad khmih ïa ka nongbah Hangne . Nangta ïai leit sha ka nongbah bakwah ka Hoham bad leit hiar sha Gath , ka nongbah ki Philistia . Hato ki Kham bha ma ki ban ïa ki hima jong ka Judia bad Israel ? Hangto ka ri jong ki ka kham heh ban ïa ka jong phoi ?
translation.en: Pass ye unto Calneh , and see  ; and from thence go ye to Hamath the great : then go down to Gath of the Philistines : be they better than these kingdoms ? or their border greater than your border ?

translation.kha: U la kylli , Ko khun u briew , me ïohi ïa katne ? Men sa ïohi shuh shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba kham ijli .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , Hast thou seen this , O son of man ? turn thee yet again , and thou shalt see greater abominations than these .

translation.kha: Ngam shym bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam bang lane kano kano ka doh , lane dih ïa kane Kanah ka waiñ , lane sad ïa u shñiuh jong nga tad haduh ba ki lai taïew ki la leit noh .
translation.en: I ate no pleasant bread , neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth , neither did I anoint myself at all , till three whole weeks were fulfilled .

translation.kha: ne ban kylli ïa U Blei , Da kumno ka pum jrong nga ka kthaw ïa me ? Nga ïohnong Aïu na kaba khlem leh pop ?
translation.en: For thou saidst , What advantage will it be unto thee ? and , What profit shall I have , if I be cleansed from my sin ?
But now we are delivered from the law , that being dead wherein we were held ; that we should serve in newness of spirit , and not in the oldness of the letter .
translation.kha: Mynta pat , ngi la lait na ka Hukum , namar ngi la ïap noh ïa kata kaba shisien ka la khum ïa ngi kum ki koidi . Ngim shakri shuh ha ka rukom barim jong ka hukum ba la thoh , hynrei ha ka rukom bathymmai jong U Mynsiem .

translation.en: For I will send into her pestilence , and blood into her streets  ; and the wounded shall be judged in the midst of her by the sword upon her on every side  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki jingpang ha pha bad ban shah ba ka snam kan tuid ha ki lynti bah jong pha . Phan shah tur ïaleh na baroh ki liang , bad ïa ki briew jong pha yn pynïap . Te phan tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: Only then will Jehovah answer your prayers .—Hebrews 11 :6 .
translation.kha: Tang da kumta , U Jehobah un jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong phi .—Hebru 11 :6 .
Ym don kiba sngewtynnat ïa kiba thuh , dak ki paramarjan Jong ki , hynmen kiba riewspah ki don shibun ki paralok .
translation.en: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour : but the rich hath many friends .
Saying , Say ye , His disciples came by night , and stole him away while we slept .
translation.kha: bad ki la ong ,  Phi dei ban ong ba ki synran jong u ki la wan mynmiet bad ki la tuh ïa ka met jong u katba phi dang ïohthiah .
To phikir bha ïa lade dara ïa ki jinghikai kiba me ai . To nam ïaphai leh ïa kine kiei kiei , namar lada me leh kumta , me pynim ïa lade malade ïa kita kiba shahshkor ïa me .
translation.en: Take heed unto thyself , and unto the doctrine ; continue in them : for in doing this thou shalt both save thyself , and them that hear thee .

translation.kha: Ka khubor shaphang U Khrist ka la shong skhem ha phi kat haduh ba drama syiem duh noh ban pdiang wat tang ïa khwai ka jingkyrkhu , katba phi ïalang ap khim lynti ba yn pynkup ïa U Jisu Krit uba U Trai jong Ngi .
translation.en: So that ye come behind in no gift ; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ :

translation.kha: U Trai barabor Baroh u ong , Ki dala Israel bad Judah ki shah banbeiñ . Baroh kiba kurup ïa ki , ki khmih bymman ïa ki bad kin ym pyllait ïa ki .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together : and all that took them captives held them fast  ; they refused to let them go .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por phi bud ïa ka prie im basniew jong ka pyrthei ; phi la kohnguh ïa u nongsuhjaiñ jong ki bor mynsiem ha ka haw haw , u mynsiem uba synshar Mynta ïa ki briew ki bymkohnguh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Wherein in time past ye walked according to the course of this world , according to the prince of the power of the air , the spirit that now worketh in the children of disobedience :
So David gathered all Israel together , from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hamath , to bring the ark of God from Kirjath–jearim .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u lumlang ïa ki paid Israel na baroh kawei ka ri , naduh khappud Ijipt ha ka phang shathie sha Khim Hamath ha ka phang shatei , khnang ban wallam ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang na Kiriath Jearim sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia , the brethren wrote , exhorting the disciples to receive him : who , when he was come , helped them much which had believed through grace :
translation.kha: Nangta u Apollos u la kut jingmut ban leit sha Akhaïa , kumta ki parabangeit ha Ephesos ki la ïarap ïa u da kaba thoh sha ki parabangeit kiba ha Akhaïa , da kaba kyrpad ïa ki ban pdiang sngewbha ïa u . Haba u la poi , u la long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa kito kiba da ka jingaiei jong U Blei ki la kylla long ki parabangeit .

translation.en: He that is soon angry dealeth foolishly : and a man of wicked devices is hated .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shit khlieh ki leh ïa ki kam bieit ; ki briew kiba stad ki long jai jai .

Ki teh ïa kita ki kyrwoh jong ka jingdeng shadem ha ki kyrjaw jong ka Epher da u ksaiñ naba jngum , khnang ba kata ka jingdeng shadem kan khong halor kata ka jingpanpoh , bad ba kan ym lait na ka ephod , dom U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue , that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod , and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la dep ong ïa khie , u la khmied shai bneng bad u la ong , Ko Pa , ka kynta ka la poi . To ai ka burom ïa la U Khun , ba U Khun un ïoh ban ai ka burom ïa me .
translation.en: These words spake Jesus , and lifted up his eyes to heaven , and said ,  Father , the hour is come  ; glorify thy Son , that thy Son also may glorify thee :

translation.kha: Ym don u nongrep uba lur sah ïa ki lyngkha jong u bad uba pynkhreh ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingbet .
translation.en: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow ? doth he open and break the clods of his ground ?
The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats  ; and the rocks for the conies .
translation.kha: Ki blang khlaw ki im ha ki lumbah bajrong , bad ki phyllad ki rieh ha ki synrang maw .

translation.en: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees , which deny that there is any resurrection  ; and they asked him ,
translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ngut ki Saddusi , kiba ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap , ki la wan ha U Jisu bad ki la ong ,
U dieng , uba jingsarong katta! Katta uba la kynoi ïa ka sahit bneng , uba lah ban ïohi da baroh kiba don ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: The tree that thou sawest , which grew , and was strong , whose height reached unto the heaven , and the sight thereof to all the earth  ;

translation.kha: U mynsiem bymman u tur ïaleh ïa u da ka jinglynñiar kynsan bad bret ïa u ha ka jingkhie ring , ba kumta u sei tyrtho ha ka jingairam ; u ïai pynshitom ïa u bad da kabu eh un pyut ïa u !
translation.en: And , lo , a spirit taketh him , and he suddenly crieth out  ; and it teareth him that he foameth again , and bruising him hardly departeth from him .

And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram : for when he was come , he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi , whom the  Lord  had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab .
translation.kha: U Blei u pyndonkam ïa kane ka jingleit jngoh ïa u Joram ban wanrah ka jingkyllon noh jong u Ahasaïah . Katba u Ahasaïah u dang don hangta , ma u bad u Joram ki la shah kynroi ha u briew uba kyrteng u Jehu , u khun jong u Nimshi , uba U  Trai  u la jied ban pynjot ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Ahab .
Kumta ngi la nang ïaid , bad ngi kiar ïa ka lyntait kabu leit na ki shnong Elath bad Esiongeber sha ka Duriaw baïapher , bad sem phai shaneng shatei-lam-mihngi sha ka ri Moab .
translation.en: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau , which dwelt in Seir , through the way of the plain from Elath , and from Ezion–geber , we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab .

translation.kha: U la pyndap ïa kiba tieng da kiei kiei kiba bha , bad u la phah noh thylli ïa kiba riewspah .
translation.en: He hath filled the hungry with good things  ; and the rich he hath sent empty away .

translation.kha: shang pynsmieij ianga .
translation.en: Stop tickling me !
In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves ; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth ;
translation.kha: Me dei ban long uba lehsbun ïa baroh , u nonghikai uba bha bad ba-ïaishah , uba jemnud ha kaba pynbeit ïa ki nongïaleh pyrshah jong me , naba ka lah ban long ba U Blei un ai ha ki ïa ka lad ba kin kylla-kaba-mut bad wan sha ka jingtip ïa ka jingshisha .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I , even I , am against thee , and will execute judgments in the midst of thee in the sight of the nations .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la ïathuh ïa pha ba nga long u nongshun jong pha , nga ai ka jingbishar ïa pha ha kaba baroh ki jaitbynriew kin ïohi ïa kata .
U ïada ïa Kito kiba lehhok ïa kiwei pat , bad u ïadait ïa kita kiba kitei ha u .
translation.en: He keepeth the paths of judgment , and preserveth the way of his saints .

translation.kha: sarew snem U Trai u la ïalam ïa phi lyngba ka ri shyiap , hynrei ki kjap jong phi kim shym man rim , bad ki juti jong ph kam shym jot .
translation.en: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness : your clothes are not waxen old upon you , and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot .

translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat u long syiem hadien u ita u kpa jong u , bad u la pynkhlaiñ ïa lade pyrshah ïa ka Isaia .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead , and strengthened himself against Israel .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang don hangto , uwei u tymmen uba tdong wan phai na lyngkha bad ïawad nangta itynnad la janmiet . U dei uba na ri lumlang Ephraim , hynrei ha kata ka prie u shong u sah ha Gibeah . ( Kiwei Ibbah shong klang ki dei na ka jait Benjamin . )
translation.en: And , behold , there came an old man from his work out of the field at even , which was also of mount Ephraim  ; and he sojourned in Gibeah : but the men of the place were Benjamites .
But the word is very nigh unto thee , in thy mouth , and in thy heart , that thou mayest do it .
translation.kha: Em , ka don hangne bad phi . Phi tip ïa ka bad phi lah ban sot ïa ka ; kumta mynta , kohnguh ïa ka .

Nangta u mihnoh badno u wan ïalam sa hynñiew ngut kiwei pat ki mynsiem kad kiba kham sniew ban ïa u , bad ki wan sohshnong hangta . Kumta haba baroh ka la kut , uta u briew un anna ha ka jinglong kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba u la long ha kiba shadong . Kane ka longkmie kadei ka ban jai ha ki briew Kiba snier jyllang Kanah ka por .
translation.en: Then goeth he , and taketh with himself seven other spirits more wicked than himself , and they enter in and dwell there : and the last state of that man is worse than the first . Even so shall it be also unto this wicked generation .

translation.kha: bad Nangta u bsuh ïa kita ki Dieng lyngba ki kyrwoh ha baroh arliang kata ka syngkien .
translation.en: And he put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark , to bear the ark .

translation.kha: Ym Shimham la ai phalang shuh ïa ngi , hynrei la ïai hukum ïa ngi ban shniah ïa-ot ! Bad mynta pat ngi Shah shoh . Dei ki briew jong phi keiñ naba shit .
translation.en: There is no straw given unto thy servants , and they say to us , Make brick : and , behold , thy servants are beaten  ; but the fault is in thine own people .
I am the living bread which came down from heaven : if any man eat of this bread , he shall live for ever : and the bread that I will give is my flesh , which I will give for the life of the world .
translation.kha: Nga long u kpu uba im uba la wan hiar na bneng . Lada uno uno u bam ïa une u kpu , un im junom . U kpu ba ngan ai ha u , u long ka doh jong nga , ïa kaba nga ai khnang ba ka pyrthei kan ïoh im .

Mynta , ka bynta kaba donkam eh ka long , ba ka rukom ka jingim jongki phi ka dei pun long kat kumba ka gospel U Khrist ka dawa , Khnang ba , la de lah ne ngam lah ban leit bad ïohi ïa phi , ngan ïohsngew ba phi ïeng skhem ha khwai ka jingthmu , nabar kata , da kawei ka jingthrang , Phin ïakhun lang na ka bynta ka jingngeit ha ka angel .
translation.en: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ : that whether I come and see you , or else be absent , I may hear of your affairs , that ye stand fast in one spirit , with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel ;

If there be found among you , within any of thy gates which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , man or woman , that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the  Lord  thy God , in transgressing his covenant ,
translation.kha: Lada phi shem ha kawei na ki shnong jong phi ïa u shynrang lane ka kynthei kiba la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang jong u ,
Lada phi! ïakynduh ïa ki dkhot ka balang jong ngi , pyrshing ban Tip kham bha ïa ki .
translation.en: When you meet members of our local congregation , try to get to know them better .

translation.kha: U Shual u thmu banbeiñ sum ïa u Dabid ha ka kynrei , hynrei u Dabid u kynthih , bad uta u ngam u shabuk ha ka kynroh . U Dedan u phet ïap bad u lait im .
translation.en: And Saul sought to smite David even to the wall with the javelin  ; but he slipped away out of Saul s presence , and he smote the javelin into the wall : and David fled , and escaped that night .

translation.kha: Lada phi ai sngewbha sha ki briew kiba riewspah lane banbeiñ ïa kiba duk ban ïoh riewspah , phin long uba duk ïa lade .
translation.en: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches , and he that giveth to the rich , shall surely come to want .

Except the God of my father , the God of Abraham , and the fear of Isaac , had been with me , surely thou hadst sent me away now empty . God hath seen mine affliction and the labour of my hands , and rebuked thee yesternight .
translation.kha: Lada U Blei jong ki kpa jong nga , U Blei jong u Abraham bad u Isaak um shym la don ryngkat bad nga , phin jin da la phah thylli ïa nga . Hynrei U Blei u la ïohi ïa ka jingjynjar jong nga bad ïa ka jingtrei ba nga la pyndep , bad hynne mynmiet u la ai ïa ka jingbishar jong u .
U Saul um sngewthikna ïa kane , bad u bitar lep . U ong , Ïa u Dabid ki ai nam da ki phew khadar , hynrei ïa nga pat tang da ki hajar . Kun sa pynlong syiem ïa u hadien nangne !
translation.en: And Saul was very wroth , and the saying displeased him  ; and he said , They have ascribed unto David ten thousands , and to me they have ascribed but thousands : and what can he have more but the kingdom ?
For the poor always ye have with you  ; but me ye have not always .
translation.kha: Phin don borabor ki briew kiba duk lem bad phi , hynrei phin ym ïoh borabor ïa nga .
Katba phi at tur sha khmat , at la pynshaïong ïa ki khnai ban Beh noh ïa ki ar lwet ki syiem Amor . Ki waitlam malu ki ryntieh jong phi kdor ïadon bynta ei ei bad kane .
translation.en: And I sent the hornet before you , which drave them out from before you , even the two kings of the Amorites  ; but not with thy sword , nor with thy bow .

translation.kha: Kum ïa ki Anakim , la ju khot ruh ïa ki , ki Rephaim ; hynrei ki nong Moab ki khot ïa ki , ki Emim .
translation.en: Which also were accounted giants , as the Anakims  ; but the Moabites call them Emims .
Therefore now let your hands be strengthened , and be ye valiant : for your master Saul is dead , and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them .
translation.kha: To long kiba khlaiñ bad kiba shlur ! U Saul , u syiem jong phi u la ïap , bad ki paid Judah ki la pynsleh ïa nga kum u syiem jong ki .
U Trai u ong ha ki briew jong ka Israel bad Joïada :
translation.en: And these are the words that the  Lord  spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah .

translation.kha: Kumta ïa ka jingkular la pyndep ïa kaba U Trai u la kular ha u syiem Jehu : Ki khun ki ktieh Jong me , haduh ka pateng kaba saw , kin long ki syiem ha Israel .
translation.en: This was the word of the  Lord  which he spake unto Jehu , saying , Thy sons shall sit on the throne of Israel unto the fourth generation . And so it came to pass .

translation.kha: Nga la ainong , NGA la trei , hynrei katno ka long kaba dih jingkyrmen ! Nga la pyndonkam ïa la ka jingkhlaiñ , hynrei ym lah ban pyndep ei ei . Pynban nga lah ban shynna ha U Trai ban kyrshan na ka bynta jong nga ; un ai bainong ïa per ïa kaei kaba la leh .
translation.en: Then I said , I have laboured in vain , I have spent my strength for nought , and in vain : yet surely my judgment is with the  Lord  , and my work with my God .

translation.kha: Kumne la don ha thoh , U Blei u la pynluin ïa ki jingman bad ki dohnud jong ki , haduh kane hi ka sngi kim lah ban ïohi ne sngewkwah .
translation.en: (According as it is written , God hath given them the spirit of slumber , eyes that they should not see , and ears that they should not hear ;) unto this day .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïaid lyngba pynlang ïohi ba pha khih ha ka snam jong pha . La tap ïa pha da ka snam , hynrei ma shym la shiah ïa pha ban ïap .
translation.en: And when I passed by thee , and saw thee polluted in thine own blood , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live  ; yea , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live .

translation.kha: La sumar ïa u ha ïing haduh lai bnai , bad long la buh ïa u shabar na ka ïing jong u , ka khun jong u syiem ka la ting khun ïa u bad ka la pyneh pynsan ïa u kum la u jong u kynhun .
translation.en: And when he was cast out , Pharaoh s daughter took him up , and nourished him for her own son .

translation.kha: Ha ka miej jong nga kan bam-im baroh katba haka na ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai jong ki pynlang na ki shipai bad ki nongïaleh . Ma nga , U Tlai Nongsynshar , nga la krong .
translation.en: Thus ye shall be filled at my table with horses and chariots , with mighty men , and with all men of war , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , to pynleit jingmut ïa kaei katba u kpa bad ka kmie jong phin ki ong ïa phi .
translation.en: My son , hear the instruction of thy father , and forsake not the law of thy mother :

And it shall come to pass , when ye be multiplied and increased in the land , in those days , saith the  Lord  , they shall say no more , The ark of the covenant of the  Lord  : neither shall it come to mind : neither shall they remember it  ; neither shall they visit it  ; neither shall that be done any more .
translation.kha: Nangta haba phi la ïaroi bun ha kata ka ri , ki briew kin ym ïakren shuh shaphang ka Synduk ka Jutang jong nga . Kin ym pyrkhat shuh shaphang jong ka lane kynmaw ïa ka ; kin ym donkam shuh ïa ka , lymne kin ym shna sa kawei pat .
U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Sekharaïah :
translation.en: Again the word of the  Lord  of hosts came to me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ki don ki kti , hynrei kim lah ban tba , malade ki khait , hynrei kim lah ban ïadei ; kim lah ban pynmih sur jingsawa .
translation.en: They have hands , but they handle not : feet have they , but they walk not : neither speak they through their throat .
There were therefore seven brethren : and the first took a wife , and died without children .
translation.kha: Shisien la don hynñiew ngut shi para ki shynrang ; uba nyngkong duh u la shongkurim bad u la ïap khlem don khun .
U maham ïa phi ba phin ym shah ïa u Hesekaïah un shukor ïa phi . U Sekharaïah um lah ban pyrsad im ïa phi .
translation.en: Thus saith the king , Let not Hezekiah deceive you : for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand :

translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la long ka Jentil , ba la kha ha ka thapniang Phoenisia ha Syria . Ka la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban beh nala ïa u ksuid na ka khun jongngi ka .
translation.en: The woman was a Greek , a Syrophenician by nation  ; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter .

translation.kha: Ngim Shimham la ïa-pdiang ïa ka jingkyrshan jongnga jongki khlem da siewdor ïa ka . Pynban , ine la thri pynlang Myntan thop ; ngi ïatei trei mynhyndai bad mynmiet haneng ban ym long ka jingbankhia ïano ïano na phiah .
translation.en: Neither did we eat any man s bread for nought ; but wrought with labour and travail night and day , that we might not be chargeable to any of you :
And as I began to speak , the Holy Ghost fell on them , as on us at the beginning .
translation.kha: Bad haba nga la sdang ban kren , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la wan hiar halor jong ki kumba ka la long halor jong ngi ha kaba sdang .
U kylli nga dei uei , bun nga la ïatih ïa u ba nga dei u Elimelekh .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Who art thou ? And I answered him , I am an Amalekite .

translation.kha: Em , ka dei namar ba phi la leh pop haduh katta katta ; ka long namar ka jingsniew barben kaba phi sa .
translation.en: Is not thy wickedness great ? and thine iniquities infinite ?

translation.kha: Ko kynrad , kata ka briew ka la ong , mem don ïa ka jingtong , bad ka pukri ka hir kaba jyllang . Nangno men ïoh ïa kata ka um kaba ai jingshim ?
translation.en: The woman saith unto him , Sir , thou hast nothing to draw with , and the well is deep : from whence then hast thou that living water ?
And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people , Go , number Israel from Beer–sheba even to Dan  ; and bring the number of them to me , that I may know it .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la ai ki hukum ïa u Joab bad ïa kiwei pat ki rangbah pynïaidkam ,  Khie leit lyngba ka Israel , na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat ka tduh , bad ñiew ïa ki briew . Nga kwah ban tip haduh katno ngut ki ïadon .
U Trai u ïohi ïa baroh kaba pa’ leh , katei shaba phi leit , u peit ïa phi .
translation.en: For the ways of man are before the eyes of the  Lord  , and he pondereth all his goings .

translation.kha: Ki kup shynrang jong ki nongbah ka Heliopolis sad Bubastis kin ïap ha ka thma , bad kiwei ki briew ngin shah rahah kum ki koidi .
translation.en: The young men of Aven and of Pi–beseth shall fall by the sword : and these cities shall go into captivity .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïalap ïa u shakor bad u jong , Khmih ïa ka sahit bneng , bad pyrshang ñiuhlieh ïa ki khlur ; men ïoh bun ki khun ki ksiew kat i'u .
translation.en: And he brought him forth abroad , and said , Look now toward heaven , and tell the stars , if thou be able to number them : and he said unto him , So shall thy seed be .

translation.kha: A Trai , isangsot uba la ngeit ïa ka khubor kaba ngi la ïathuh ? Hano ba U Trai u pynpaw ïa ka leh jong u ?
translation.en: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled , which he spake , Lord , who hath believed our report ? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed ?
