translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha u pduh lad ka Mysia , ki la pyrshang ban leit sha ka probins jong ka Bithynia , hynrei U Mynsiem jong U Jisu um khim shah ïa ki .
translation.en: After they were come to Mysia , they assayed to go into Bithynia : but the Spirit suffered them not .

translation.kha: kumno kumno u Moses , u shakri jong U Trai , u la ïathuh ha phi ba U Trai U Blei jong phi un ai ha phi ïa kane ka ri ha ka Phan mihngi jong ka Jordan kumto ka ïing jong phi .
translation.en: Remember the word which Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded you , saying , The  Lord  your God hath given you rest , and hath given you this land .

Because thine heart was tender , and thou hast humbled thyself before the  Lord  , when thou heardest what I spake against this place , and against the inhabitants thereof , that they should become a desolation and a curse , and hast rent thy clothes , and wept before me  ; I also have heard thee , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad kylla-kaba-mut bad pynrit ïa lade ha khmat jong nga , kad ïa ki jaiñ jong phi bad ïam , haba phi ïohsngew kumno nga byrngem ban pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ki briew jong ka . Ngan pynlong ïa ka kaba ishyrkhei ban peit , ka jaka ha kaba ïa ka kyrteng jong ka , ki briew kin pyndonkam kum ka jingtim . Hynrei nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong phi ,
Hynrei namar ka Kular kaba kyntang kaba ma u bad u Jonathan ki la pynlong wai ïa uwei patar , u Dabid u la pyllait ïa u Mikhmethath , u khun jong u Jonathan bad u ksew jong u Salu .
translation.en: But the king spared Mephibosheth , the son of Jonathan the son of Saul , because of the  Lord s  oath that was between them , between David and Jonathan the son of Saul .

translation.kha: Nga lah ban ai baroh kob nga don , bad wat ïa ka met jong nga ïa ka ban thang — hynrei lada ïam don ka jingieit , kane kam myntoi ei ei ïa nga .
translation.en: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor , and though I give my body to be burned , and have not charity , it profiteth me nothing .
Thus saith the  Lord  my God  ; Feed the flock of the slaughter  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong nga u la ong ha nga ,  To leh ïa ka bynta jong u nongaplangbrot jong ka kynhun langbrot kaba dei ban shah shohdoh .

translation.en: If we live in the Spirit , let us also walk in the Spirit .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem u la ai ha ngi ka jingim , u dei ruh ban synshar ïa ki jingim jong ngi .
Te u Judas Issakhar , eiei na ki khat-ar ñiut ki synran , u la mihnoh ban leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh khnang ngab shetkylla ïa U Jisu ha ki .
translation.en: And Judas Iscariot , one of the twelve , went unto the chief priests , to betray him unto them .

translation.kha: hynriew phi hikai ba lada u briew u don ei ei , kaba u lah ba pyndonkam ha kaba ïarap ïa u kpa lano ka kmie , hynrei u ong , ‘ Kane ka long ka Korban’ ( kaba mut , ka long sha U Blei ) ,
translation.en: But ye say , If a man shall say to his father or mother , It is Corban , that is to say , a gift , by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me  ; he shall be free .

translation.kha: Habor phi ïaid lyngba ïa ki um jingïabujli , ngan long rynsied bad phi ; ki jingeh kin ym thup ïa phi . Haba phi ïaid lyngba ka thiang , phin ym ing ; ki jingkynjah ha-ei kiba wan kin ym pynmynsaw ïa phi .
translation.en: When thou passest through the waters , I will be with thee  ; and through the rivers , they shall not overflow thee : when thou walkest through the fire , thou shalt not be burned  ; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee .

translation.kha: To phah ïa u paidbhur ba-bang lute ïa ki ïing jong ki khlem ka jingmaham ; pynlong ïa ki ban kyr-ang ha ka jingshyrkhei . Ki la tih ka thliew na ka bynta jong nga ban hap ha ka bad ki la pynap ki jingriam ïa-ban pynjngut ïa nga .
translation.en: Let a cry be heard from their houses , when thou shalt bring a troop suddenly upon them : for they have digged a pit to take me , and hid snares for my feet .

translation.kha: Haba u mynsiem u tur ïaleh ïa u , u bret ïa u shad madan , bad u sei tyrtho ha ka shyntur , u kyrteng ki bniat , bad u eh tnen baroh shi rynïeng . Nga la ong ïa ki synran jong me ba-bang beh noh ïa u mynsiem bymkhuid , hynmen kim shym la lah .
translation.en: And wheresoever he taketh him , he teareth him : and he foameth , and gnasheth with his teeth , and pineth away : and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out  ; and they could not .
And he forsook the  Lord  God of his fathers , and walked not in the way of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U kyntait ïa U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong u , bad um shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai .
U Dabid u jaboh , Nga Don ha ka khim khiat ! Hynrei ngam kwah ba ngan shah pynshitom ha ki briew . Ai ba U Trai da lade! hi un dei uta u ban pynshitom ïa ngi , namar u long uba dap da ka jingisynei .
translation.en: And David said unto Gad , I am in a great strait : let us fall now into the hand of the  Lord   ; for his mercies are great : and let me not fall into the hand of man .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khem biang ïa u ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad lada ha ka jingshem jyllang u ba —kata ka prum ka long kumto bad kam Shimham pur , un pynkyrpang ïa u sa hynñiew sngi .
translation.en: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day : and , behold , if the plague in his sight be at a stay , and the plague spread not in the skin  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more :

translation.kha: To ud bad to kyang ban ieh jingïarap , phi baroh ki nongap ka Philetos ! To sngewshyrkhei , phi baroh ! U lyoh pui pui u wan na ka phang bashatei — u long ka kynhun shipai bym Don ki khawpud hapoh ka kyrdan jong ka .
translation.en: Howl , O gate  ; cry , O city  ; thou , whole Philistia , art dissolved : for there shall come from the north a smoke , and none shall be alone in his appointed times .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki bymman ki prie jong u lane u kñi jong u lano u bakha jongu u lane uwei na ki kur bajan jong u , u lah ba thied biang ïa u ; lane “lada u la ïohi kynshew haduh shun da biang , u hi u ia banbeiñ thied bajrong ïa la ka jinglaitluid .
translation.en: Either his uncle , or his uncle s son , may redeem him , or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him  ; or if he be able , he may redeem himself .

translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa ka jingpynjot kaba shyrkhei kum kñia ha kane ka nongbah ha kaba uwei pa uwei uba ïada lyngka un kyndit bad lyngngun .
translation.en: And I will make this city desolate , and an hissing  ; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof .

Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram , who was over the tribute  ; and all Israel stoned him with stones , that he died . Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Rehoboam u phah ïa u Adoniram , uba peit ïa ki nongtrei ba shu pynbor , ban leit sha ki Israel , hynrei ki lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap . Mar kumta , u Rehoboam u kiew pynstet ha la ka kali ïapom bad u phet rieh sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: By faith he forsook Egypt , not fearing the wrath of the king : for he endured , as seeing him who is invisible .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Moses ban mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt khlem da sheptieng ïa ka jingbitar u Pharaoh . Ka la long kumba u la ïohi ïa U Blei u bym lah ban ïohi , u la kyntait ban phai dien .

translation.en: For all the land which thou seest , to thee will I give it , and to thy seed for ever .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me ïa ka ri baroh kat kaba me ïohi , bad kan long ka jong me junom .
Kham hadien , nga la phah ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , badno nga la ïalamwir ka jingjynjar bakhraw halor ka Ijipt .
translation.en: I sent Moses also and Aaron , and I plagued Egypt , according to that which I did among them : and afterward I brought you out .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong ki u kynmaw ïa ka jutang jong u , bad namar ka jingieit bakhraw jong u , u la kylla jingmut .
translation.en: And he remembered for them his covenant , and repented according to the multitude of his mercies .
And the  Lord  commanded the angel  ; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa u angel ban buh noh sharud ïa ka waitlam jong u , bad u angel u kohnguh .

translation.en: And Elisha said unto her , What shall I do for thee ? tell me , what hast thou in the house ? And she said , Thine handmaid hath not any thing in the house , save a pot of oil .
translation.kha: Kaei ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi ?  u kylli .  Ïathuh ïa nga , phi don aïu ha ïing ?   Ym don ei ei shuh , lait sa tang u khra umphniang Olib uba rit ,  ka jubab .

translation.en: Who leave the paths of uprightness , to walk in the ways of darkness  ;
translation.kha: ki briew kiba iehnoh ïa ka jingim hok ban im ha ka jingdum ka pop ,
Ki longkmie tang kum ki jingthung ba dang lung , ba dang shu mih bad bym pat suhthied , haba U Trai u phah ïa ka lyer , ki tyrkhong noh bad kit noh kum u phlangïap .
translation.en: Yea , they shall not be planted  ; yea , they shall not be sown : yea , their stock shall not take root in the earth : and he shall also blow upon them , and they shall wither , and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble .

translation.kha: bad ki ïoh ïa U Blei ki Israel . Hapoh ki sla jat jong u , la don kaei kaba i kumne ka sliew da u mawkordor Sapphir , kaba jingsngem kum ka suiñbneng .
translation.en: And they saw the God of Israel : and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone , and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness .
O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , namar u long uba bha ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
U la ong ïa nga , Ko Israel , me long u shakri jong nga ; namar jong me , ki briew kin ïaroh ïa nga .
translation.en: And said unto me , Thou art my servant , O Israel , in whom I will be glorified .
I am the man that hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath .
translation.kha: Nga long uta uba tip kaba kumno ka long ban shah pynshitom ha U Blei .
kynmaw ban ym sngewsarong bad ban ym klet ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi uba la Pyllait ïa phi na ka ri Jingtep ha kaba phi la long ki mraw .
translation.en: Then thine heart be lifted up , and thou forget the  Lord  thy God , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt , from the house of bondage  ;

translation.kha: Bad mynta nga kmiesan shapoh ki jingshahshitom jong per na ka bynta jong phi , nabar da ki jingshahslem jong nga ha ka doh , ang ïarap ban pyndep ïa Kiei kaba dang sah na ki jingshahtehmraw jongnga U Khrist na ka bynta ka balang , kaba long ka met jong u .
translation.en: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you , and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body s sake , which is the church :
He hath remembered his covenant for ever , the word which he commanded to a thousand generations .
translation.kha: Un bat ïa ka jutang jong u junom , ki jingkular jong u na ka bynta ki hajar ki pateng .

translation.en: And Jesus being full of the Holy Ghost returned from Jordan , and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la wan phai na ka wah Jordan uba la dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad la ïalam ïa u da U Mynsiem sha ka ri shyiap ,

translation.en: Unto an hundred talents of silver , and to an hundred measures of wheat , and to an hundred baths of wine , and to an hundred baths of oil , and salt without prescribing how much .
translation.kha: haduh lai hajar sawspah kilo ka rupa , shiphew hajar kilo u kew , ar hajar litar ka waiñ , ar hajar litar ka umphniang Olib , bad katba donkam ka mluh .

U Moses u la kutlad lep , bad u ong ha U Trai , Wat pdiang ïa kano kano ka jingainguh ba kine ki briew ki wallam . Ngam shym la leh bymdei ïa uwei shwa na ki ; ngam shym la shim hima wat tang kawei na ki kada jong ki .
translation.en: And Moses was very wroth , and said unto the  Lord  , Respect not thou their offering : I have not taken one ass from them , neither have I hurt one of them .
He delivereth and rescueth , and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth , who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions .
translation.kha: U pynim bad u pyllait im ; u leh ïa ki jingphylla bad ki kambah ha bneng bad ha pyrthei . U la pynim ïa u Daniel na kaba shah pynïap ha ki sing .

translation.en: Therefore thus will I do unto thee , O Israel : and because I will do this unto thee , prepare to meet thy God , O Israel .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko ki paid Israel , ngan pynshitom ïa phi . Bad namar ba ngan leh ïa kane , to pynkhreh ban mad ïa ka jingbishar jong nga !

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Neither hath this man sinned , nor his parents : but that the works of God should be made manifest in him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Ka jingmatlah jong u kam don ei ei bad ki pop jong u ne ki pop jong ki kmie ki kpa jong u . U la long matlah khnang ban ïohi ba ka bor jong U Blei ka trei ha u .
Nga la tip ruh ba ki nongtem nongput ka thalab bun kiwei ki Lebi ki la mihnoh na Jerusalem bad poi biah shad ki jaka rep , namar ki briew kim shym la ai kaba biang ïa ki ban im .
translation.en: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them : for the Levites and the singers , that did the work , were fled every one to his field .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha U Blei , Ngi la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei eh ha kaba har ïa kane ! Sngewbha map ïa nga . Nga la ni bieit .
translation.en: And David said unto God , I have sinned greatly , because I have done this thing : but now , I beseech thee , do away the iniquity of thy servant  ; for I have done very foolishly .

translation.kha: u la ong ha ki , Kaei kaba ngan sa leh ka hir ïa kaei kiba U Tiras u la hukum .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the congregation , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded to be done .

translation.kha: Namar Kata , phi daym ban pynper ïa ki mrad bad ki sem ki bakhuid na tun ki bymkhuid . Wai bam ïa ki mrad bad ki ha-sem ki bymkhuid . Nga la ñiew ïa ki , ki bymkhuid , bad kaba bam ïa ki ka pynlong ïa phi ki bymkhuid .
translation.en: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean , and between unclean fowls and clean : and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast , or by fowl , or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground , which I have separated from you as unclean .

translation.kha: U blem u long uta suba la ïakit ïa ki lymbung bad suba pynong ïa ki lyer . U pynpaw ïa la ki jingmut ha u briew ; u pynkyllaiñ ïa ka sngem shwa ka moramot . U ïasaid ha bakha kyntang jong ka pyrthei . Kane ka long ka kyrngah jyllang u : U Trai U blem badonburom Balah !
translation.en: For , lo , he that formeth the mountains , and createth the wind , and declareth unto man what is his thought , that maketh the morning darkness , and treadeth upon the high places of the earth , The  Lord  , The God of hosts , is his name .
And God was with the lad  ; and he grew , and dwelt in the wilderness , and became an archer .
translation.kha: U Blei u la long ryngkat bad uta u khynnah katba u nang heh nang san ; u la im ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Paran bad u kylla long u nongbeh mrad uba tbit .
Haba ki rangbah kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ki la ïasaid hynriew jam , u Dabid u la phah ïa ki ban sangeh katba u dang ai ka jingkhia ïa U Trai da u maw bad u khun maw ba la pynsngaid .
translation.en: And it was so , that when they that bare the ark of the  Lord  had gone six paces , he sacrificed oxen and fatlings .

translation.kha: ïoh kin phai dien noh na U Troas ban mane ïa kiwei pait ki blei . Lada jia kumta , U Trai un bitar pei ïa phi bad un pyndait ïa phi shisyndon .
translation.en: For they will turn away thy son from following me , that they may serve other gods : so will the anger of the  Lord  be kindled against you , and destroy thee suddenly .

translation.kha: Ki ar jrut kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jongno u Ladan ; u Setham bad u Jahlil , ki dei peit ïa ki Ïing jingkynshew bad ïing buh tiar jong ka Templ .
translation.en: The sons of Jehieli  ; Zetham , and Joel his brother , which were over the treasures of the house of the  Lord .

But if the watchman see the sword come , and blow not the trumpet , and the people be not warned  ; if the sword come , and take any person from among them , he is taken away in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at the watchman s hand .
translation.kha: Lada , kumno kumno , u nongap u ïohi ïa u nongshun ba u wan bad um shym put ïa ka turoi jingmaham , u nongshun un wan bad un pynïap noh ïa kita ki nongpop ; hynrei ngan pynkit pop ïa u nongap na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki .
To ïaroh ïa u da ki turoi . To ïaroh ïa u da ki tiduh bad ki jingtem ksai .
translation.en: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet : praise him with the psaltery and harp .

Then took Jeremiah another roll , and gave it to Baruch the scribe , the son of Neriah  ; who wrote therein from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book which Jehoiakim king of Judah had burned in the fire : and there were added besides unto them many like words .
translation.kha: Te nga la shim ïa kawei pat ka kot kli bad nga la ai ïa ka ha u sekretari jong nga u Barukh , bad u la thoh hangta ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la ong . U la thoh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba la don ha ka kot kli kaba nyngkong bad kijuh ki khubor kiba nga la ong ha u ban thoh .

translation.en: And I will give unto thee , and to thy seed after thee , the land wherein thou art a stranger , all the land of Canaan , for an everlasting possession  ; and I will be their God .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me , bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me , ïa kane ka ri ha kaba mynta me long u nongwei . Ka ri Kanaan baroh kawei kan long ka jingïohkynti junom jong ki khun ki ksiew jong me ; bad nga ngan long U Blei jong ki .

U Judah , u khun jong u Paseah , bad u Meshullam , u khun jong u Besodeïah , ki tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Jeshanah . Ki buh ïa ki bim bad pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki nongkhrong bad ki jingkhang ka khyrdep .
translation.en: Moreover the old gate repaired Jehoiada the son of Paseah , and Meshullam the son of Besodeiah  ; they laid the beams thereof , and set up the doors thereof , and the locks thereof , and the bars thereof .

translation.kha: To ka jingpynshitom na ka beit kano kan haduh halor u Joab bun ka longkmie jong u baroh ! Ha kawei pa kawei ka pateng to yn don u shynrang ha ka longïing jong u , wahbah don ka jingpang ñiangkulia lane ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh katba shyrkhei lane uba hap banbeiñ trei tang ïa ka kam ba trei ki kynthei lane uba shah pynïap ha ka thma lane uba kyrduh bam !
translation.en: Let it rest on the head of Joab , and on all his father s house  ; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue , or that is a leper , or that leaneth on a staff , or that falleth on the sword , or that lacketh bread .
But in this will we consent unto you : If ye will be as we be , that every male of you be circumcised  ;
translation.kha: Ngin mynjur tang ha kane : ba phin long kum ma ngi da kaba ki shynrang jong phi baroh kin shah otsher .

translation.en: But thus shall ye deal with them  ; ye shall destroy their altars , and break down their images , and cut down their groves , and burn their graven images with fire .
translation.kha: Kumta , pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , pynpait pharia ïa ki rishot mawkyntang jong ki , mait ïa ki dak ka blei Asherah jong ki , bad thang ïa ki bleithaw jong ki .
Teng wallam bun ki nongbah ban pynïong ïa kane ka nongbah jongki me bad ban rah mar shi kham ka khyndew ha ki kti jong ki . Ai ba ki blei kin shoh ïap ïa nga lada ngam leh kumta !
translation.en: And Ben–hadad sent unto him , and said , The gods do so unto me , and more also , if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me .

translation.kha: Lada ma phi bad la u Pharpar phi ei ka jingpynhiar jingmut , ïaring pynbeit para ma phi mala wat pynpaw ïa kino kino ki kada barieh .
translation.en: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself  ; and discover not a secret to another :

translation.kha: Nga la jat ka jaka ïa ki briew jongki per ki Israel bad nga la pynsah ïa ki hangta , ha kaba kine im khlem da shah banbeiñ shuh . Naduh ba ki rung sha kane ka ri , ki la shah tur ïaleh ha ki riewrunar , hynrei kan kan ym jia shuh . Na kular ban sumar ïa me na ki nongshun jongngi me baroh bad ban ai ha me ki ïakhun ki ksiew .
translation.en: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel , and have caused thee to rest from all thine enemies . Also the  Lord  telleth thee that he will make thee an house .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Ishbosheth u khun jong u Shual u kynroh sniew ïa u Abilene ba u ïathied bad ka Rispah , ka tnga kliar Jong u Saul , ka khun jong u Adaïah .
translation.en: And Saul had a concubine , whose name was Rizpah , the daughter of Aiah : and Ish–bosheth said to Abner , Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father s concubine ?

translation.kha: U Haran u jubab , Wat bitar ïa nga . Phi tip ba kine ki briew ki long kiba im sngi tang ban leh ïa kaba sniew .
translation.en: And Aaron said , Let not the anger of my lord wax hot : thou knowest the people , that they are set on mischief .
And it came to pass , when Jesus had ended these sayings , the people were astonished at his doctrine :
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep kren ïa kine kiei kiei , u paidbah u la sngewphylla ïa ka rukom kaba u la hikai .

translation.en: Finally , be ye all of one mind , having compassion one of another , love as brethren , be pitiful , be courteous :
translation.kha: Kum ban pynkut : Phi baroh to ïadon kajuh ka jingmut bad kajuh ka jingsngew , to ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat kum shi para , bad to long kiba sbun mynsiem bad kiba sngewrit iwei ïa iwei pat .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Elah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Elah u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori jong Ki Syiem Israel .
Khmut ki ïathmu na Ijipt bad ki wan phai sha la u kpa ha Kanaan .
translation.en: And they went up out of Egypt , and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father ,
For I have satiated the weary soul , and I have replenished every sorrowful soul .
translation.kha: Ngan pynthymmai bor ïa kito kiba la thait bad pynhun da ka jingbam ïa baroh kiba la tlot na ka jingthngan .
Ka lah ban long ba nga la shah tied , phin ong ; ka lah ban long ba to la shah tangon , hyndai ngam kynmaw ïa ka . Balei ngam shym lah ban khie ? Nga donburom ban ïoh jingïadei biang .
translation.en: They have stricken me , shalt thou say , and I was not sick  ; they have beaten me , and I felt it not : when shall I awake ? I will seek it yet again .

translation.kha: U Jonadab u ong ha u , Khie leit thiah , bad kun mynjur pang . Haba i pa jong phi i wan jngoh ïa ph , ong ha i , ‘ Sngewbha jong ïa i para jong nga i Tamar ban wan bad ai bam ïa nga . Nga kwah ïa i ban pynkhreh jingbam hangne ha kiba nga lah ban ïohi ïa i , bad ba in ai bam ïa la da ma i hi .’
translation.en: And Jonadab said unto him , Lay thee down on thy bed , and make thyself sick : and when thy father cometh to see thee , say unto him , I pray thee , let my sister Tamar come , and give me meat , and dress the meat in my sight , that I may see it , and eat it at her hand .

translation.kha: U la thngan bad u ong ha u Jakob , Nga la thngan shaba palat , to ai khyndiat ba ngan dkhoh ïa kato ka syrwa saw . ( Dei namar kata ba la khot ïa u , u Edom . )
translation.en: And Esau said to Jacob , Feed me , I pray thee , with that same red pottage  ; for I am faint : therefore was his name called Edom .

translation.kha: U Trai un shait ba ki nongïeng kin kjap ïa phi . Phin turoi pyrshah ïa ki na kawei ka dong , hynrei phna sa her ïap na kiba bun ki dong , malu ki briew ka pyrthei kin sngewsheptieng haba ki ïohi aïu ka ia ïa phi .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies : thou shalt go out one way against them , and flee seven ways before them : and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth .
From that time many of his disciples went back , and walked no more with him .
translation.kha: Namar kane , kiba bun na ki nongbud jong U Jisu ki la phai dien noh bad kim leit shuh bad u .
Hynrei ïa ki hima ki bym shakri ïa pha yn pynjot thiaw .
translation.en: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish  ; yea , those nations shall be utterly wasted .
And Jacob lifted up his eyes , and looked , and , behold , Esau came , and with him four hundred men . And he divided the children unto Leah , and unto Rachel , and unto the two handmaids .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ïohi ïa u Iso ba u wan lem bad sawspah ngut ki rangbah . Kumta u pynïabynta ïa ki khun hapdeng ha Leah , ka Rakhel , bad ki tnga kliar ar ngut .
Ha u , ïa phi ruh la tei lang lem bad kiaw pat da U Mynsiem jong u ha ka jaka ha kaba U Blei u shong .
translation.en: In whom ye also are builded together for an habitation of God through the Spirit .

translation.kha: Kane ka lama ka dur kaba kiei sha ka por kiba mynnin . Ka mut ba ka jingainguh bad ki jinganna da ki narud ïa kiba la ai sha U Blei kim lah satia ngab pynjia ïa ka dohnud jong uta umbiah mane ,
translation.en: Which was a figure for the time then present , in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices , that could not make him that did the service perfect , as pertaining to the conscience  ;

translation.kha: Nga la shim noh ïa ka shem na kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid malu nga la ai ïa ka ha me . Hynrei ngam syiem long kum u Dabid u Shakri jong de , Uba bud tylli ïa nga , uba khlong ïa ki lawlynnong jong nga , bad uba leh ïa kaba dei ha khmat jong nga .
translation.en: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David , and gave it thee : and yet thou hast not been as my servant David , who kept my commandments , and who followed me with all his heart , to do that only which was right in mine eyes  ;

translation.kha: jynreiñ nga la sloit lut ïa ki kynhun ki ksiew u Iso dara pynnep ïa ki jarjar jongki ki , te ba kin ym lah buhrieh shuh . Ïa baïar ki bynriew ka Edom la pynïoh . Khlem pynsan shuh ïa uwei ruh .
translation.en: But I have made Esau bare , I have uncovered his secret places , and he shall not be able to hide himself : his seed is spoiled , and his brethren , and his neighbours , and he is not .

translation.kha: bad ki la tim ïa U blang jong ka bneng namar ki jingpang bad ki prum jong ki . Hynrei kim shym la peiñ noh na ki lynti basboh jong ki .
translation.en: And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores , and repented not of their deeds .
For the ear trieth words , as the mouth tasteth meat .
translation.kha: Phi tip ïa ka jingbam kaba bang dei haba phi la mad ïa ka , hynrei kam long kumta ïa ki kyntien kiba stad haba phi ïohsngew ïa ki .

Ha kano kano ka por ba nga kwah ban pynkheiñ ïa ki briew jong na ki Israhaïah bad pynlong ïa ki ban manbha sa shisien pat , baroh kob nga lah ban ïohi ka long ka jingbymman jong ki bad ka kam sniew kaba ki leh . Ki shukor uwei ïa uwei pat ; ki snar jubor ha ki ïing bad ki tuh ; ki lwait ïa ki briew ha ki lynti baheh .
translation.en: When I would have healed Israel , then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered , and the wickedness of Samaria : for they commit falsehood  ; and the thief cometh in , and the troop of robbers spoileth without .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi la ioh jingmyntoi na kaba leh ïa ki kiei kiba phi la sngewlehrain mynta ? Ka jingmih jong kita keiñ kiei ka long ka jingïap !
translation.en: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed ? for the end of those things is death .

translation.kha: U la rung shapoh bad u la ong ïa ki , Balei katne katne ka jingkhein ? Balei ba phi ïa-ïam ? Ka khynnah kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah !
translation.en: And when he was come in , he saith unto them ,  Why make ye this ado , and weep ? the damsel is not dead , but sleepeth .

translation.kha: Te ka la jia kamut ïa u ; u la ïap , da kiba shah ïuh ha ban da ïaphah ha u paidbah ha kata ka khyrdop shnong .
translation.en: And so it fell out unto him : for the people trode upon him in the gate , and he died .

translation.kha: dalade u tyngka shu mon sad pynïap ïa nga !
translation.en: Even that it would please God to destroy me  ; that he would let loose his hand , and cut me off !

translation.kha: Mynta te , kaei ka long kaei Kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong : Nga long u nongshun jong phai , ko nongbah Tyros . Ngan wallam ïa kiba bun ki jaitbynriew ban tur ïaleh ïa pha , bad kin wan kumno ki jingat phyllung jong ka duriaw .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Tyre , and will cause many nations to come up against thee , as the sea causeth his waves to come up .
The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren biang ha nga .
U angel U Blei u la kren ïa nga ha ka jingkynshew bad u ong , ‘ Jakob !’ ‘ Oi’ nga la jubab .
translation.en: And the angel of God spake unto me in a dream , saying , Jacob : And I said , Here am I .

translation.kha: U Gershon u don ar ngut ki khun shynraiñ : u Ladan bad u Shimei .
translation.en: Of the Gershonites were , Laadan , and Shimei .

translation.kha: Ïa ki sohwaiñ la khñiot ha ka khak khñiot wieh shabar ka nongbah , bad ka snam ka la mihnoh na ka jaka khñiot waiñ ha ka syngkhlieh kumba lypa kilomitar ka jingïalong bad la jan ar mitar ka jingjylliew .
translation.en: And the winepress was trodden without the city , and blood came out of the winepress , even unto the horse bridles , by the space of a thousand and six hundred furlongs .

translation.kha: Jamynrei ma me , ko u briew jong U Blei , to kiar na kine kiei khie . To ïaleh tyngeh ïa ka hok , ka jingriewblei , ka jingneit , ka jingtied , ka jingïaishah , bad ka jingjemnud .
translation.en: But thou , O man of God , flee these things ; and follow after righteousness , godliness , faith , love , patience , meekness .
And in the four and twentieth day of the first month , as I was by the side of the great river , which is Hiddekel  ;
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem , nga la ïeng harud jong ka wah Tigris kaba khraw .
Ka lynti kaba kiba hok ki ïaid ka long kum ka jingmih ka sngi ; ka nang phin nang phyrnai rahah ba ka da shabi bha kum mynsngi .
translation.en: But the path of the just is as the shining light , that shineth more and more unto the perfect day .
And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod s jurisdiction , he sent him to Herod , who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time .
translation.kha: Haba u la tip ba U Jisu u la dei na ka thain ba la synshar da u Herod , u la phah ïa u sha u Herod , uba la don ruh ha Jerusalem ha kata ka por .

U sarew u la phuh pynïap ïa baroh kiwei pat ki nongshong shnong ha Nob , ka nongbah jong ki lyngngeit : ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung , ki musli , ki kada , bad ki langbrot — ki la shah pynïap loit khoit .
translation.en: And Nob , the city of the priests , smote he with the edge of the sword , both men and women , children and sucklings , and oxen , and asses , and sheep , with the edge of the sword .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Kaei ka kmie jong nga ? Kiei ki para jong nga ?
translation.en: And he answered them , saying ,  Who is my mother , or my brethren ?

translation.kha: Nangta kita ki tnga kliar ki la wan lem bad ki khun jong ki , Bad ki noh ;
translation.en: Then the handmaidens came near , they and their children , and they bowed themselves .

translation.kha: U Blei u leh ïa kane baroh’ na kawei ka to sha kawei pud ;
translation.en: Lo , all these things worketh God oftentimes with man ,

translation.kha: Ka jingkwah ba-im jong u nongbylla sngi ka pynlong ïa u ban khap thir shitom , namar u kwah ban pynhun ïa la ka jingthngan .
translation.en: He that laboureth laboureth for himself  ; for his mouth craveth it of him .
And he said , What have I sinned , that thou wouldest deliver thy servant into the hand of Ahab , to slay me ?
translation.kha: U Obadaïah u la jubab ,  Kaei kaba nga la leh ba phi kwah ban buh ïa nga ha ka jingma jong ka jingshah pynïap noh ha u syiem Ahab ?
Ha kata hajuh ka sngem u Gadara u la leit sha u Dabid , bad u ino ha u , Kiwei leit shatei shata ka iaka saw kew jong u Araunah bad tat ka duwan ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And Gad came that day to David , and said unto him , Go up , rear an altar unto the  Lord  in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ! Ka jingsawa u shab , ka jingriew ki shahthngan , ka jingsawa ka jingïaid ki kulai , ka jingtynjuh jong ki kali ïasam !
translation.en: The noise of a whip , and the noise of the rattling of the wheels , and of the pransing horses , and of the jumping chariots .

translation.kha: Ki la tip borabor , lada ki mon don ph , ba naduh naba nyngkong nga la im kum u dkhot jong ka seng kaba pyrkhing tam jong ka niam jong ngi , ki Pharisi .
translation.en: Which knew me from the beginning , if they would testify , that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee .

translation.kha: Nalorkata u Manoah u kylli , Ynda la wan urlong ki ktah jong phi , tur u khynnah u dei ban leh aïu ? Ka jingshim kaba kumno u dei ban im ?
translation.en: And Manoah said , Now let thy words come to pass . How shall we order the child , and how shall we do unto him ?

translation.kha: nabar ka Resen , kaba don hapdeng ka Ninebeh sad ka nongbam bakhraw ka Kalah .
translation.en: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah : the same is a great city .

translation.kha: Da Kumne te ngin maji , lada ngi leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingpynim kaba khlaw katta! main ? U Trai hi u la pynbna nongtong ïa kane ka jingpynim , bad kita kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki pynshisha ha ngi ba ka longïng kaba Shispah .
translation.en: How shall we escape , if we neglect so great salvation  ; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord , and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him  ;

translation.kha: Me tip ba kumto uta ki briew u long uba bamsap bad ki pop jong u ki pynshisha ba u bakla .
translation.en: Knowing that he that is such is subverted , and sinneth , being condemned of himself .

translation.kha: Ka daw ba nga pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ha kaba ïakren bad ki ka long ba ki peit , hynrei kim ïohi , bad ki khashor , hynrei kim ïohsngew lano shemphang .
translation.en: Therefore speak I to them in parables : because they seeing see not  ; and hearing they hear not , neither do they understand .

And every daughter , that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel , shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father , that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers .
translation.kha: Man ka kynthei kaba ïohpateng ïa ka bri ka khyndew ha kano kano ka jait Israel ka dei ban ïashongkurim bad u briew uba na kata ka jait . Ha kane ka rukom ki Israel baroh kin ïohpateng ïa ka bri ka khyndew jong ki kpa tymmen jong u ,

translation.en: Thou shalt build the altar of the  Lord  thy God of whole stones : and thou shalt offer burnt offerings thereon unto the  Lord  thy God :
translation.kha: Tei ïa ka duwan na ka bynta U  Trai  U Blei jong phi da ki maw tylli ; bad kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang hangta ;
Ngi ainguh borabor ïa U Blei , U Kpa jong U Jisu Khereth uba U Trai jongngi ngi , haba ngi duwai na ka bynta jong pa’ .
translation.en: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , praying always for you ,
And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked , and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee , and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth .
translation.kha: Nga la long ryngkat bad me shano shano ba me leit , bad nga la jop ïa baroh ki nongshun jong me katba me ïaid shaphrang . Ngan pynlong ïa me uba pawnam kum ki nongïalam bakhraw tam ka pyrthei .
Nga sma ba ngan leh ïa kane ha phi u paidbah bymman uba la ïalumlang ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Hangne ha ka ri khlaw uwei pa nawei na phin un ïap . Nga , U Trai , nga la Kren .’
translation.en: I the  Lord  have said , I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation , that are gathered together against me : in this wilderness they shall be consumed , and there they shall die .

translation.kha: Ki la shoh ïa u na ka khlieh da u dieng , ki la bynthiew ïa u , ki la dem khohwah , bad ki la nguh ïa u .
translation.en: And they smote him on the head with a reed , and did spit upon him , and bowing their knees worshipped him .

translation.kha: Wat longing . U Trei um dat lem bad phi , pynlang ki nongshong jong phi kin kjap ïa phira .
translation.en: Go not up , for the  Lord  is not among you  ; that ye be not smitten before your enemies .

translation.kha: ym don mano Mano ngab thab ïa ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawkordor , mala ki pajwa jong ki ; ki mar linen , ka jaiñ-jin sawbthuh , ka jaiñ rusom , bad ka jai basaw hain ha ; ïa baroh ki jait dieng bakynsai bad baïar ki jait jingthaw ba la shna na ka bnai hati bad na ka ding baremdor , na ka rnong , ka nar , bad u maw marbl ;
translation.en: The merchandise of gold , and silver , and precious stones , and of pearls , and fine linen , and purple , and silk , and scarlet , and all thyine wood , and all manner vessels of ivory , and all manner vessels of most precious wood , and of brass , and iron , and marble ,

translation.kha: Katba uwei na ki u dang khet ïa uwei u ngin , kynsan u khlieh sdie jong u , u hap hapoh um . Ko kynrad , ngan kuna kumno ? u pyrta ha u Elisha . U dei u sdie ba la pan kylliang .
translation.en: But as one was felling a beam , the axe head fell into the water : and he cried , and said , Alas , master ! for it was borrowed .

translation.kha: Bad phim pang shemphang ? u la kylli ïa ki .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  How is it that ye do not understand ?

translation.kha: Ki khnam jong nga kin jreiñ da ka snur jong ki , malade ka thliem Jong nga kan pynïap lut ïa kiba pyrshah ïa nga . Ïa uno Un uba ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ngan ym map ; wat ki khoit bad kito kiba mynsaw ruh kin ïap .’
translation.en: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood , and my sword shall devour flesh  ; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives , from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy .

translation.kha: Ynda ki shipai kiba lait im ki wan phai shwa ka jaka shong dala , ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki nguh , Balei keiñ U Trai u shah ba ki Philistia kin jop ïa ngi mynba ka sngi ? Ïa iing ïaleit bad wanrah ïa ka Synduk Ka Jutang U Trai na Shaul , ba kumta un leit lem bad ngi bad pyut im ïa ngi na ki Nongshun jong ngi .
translation.en: And when the people were come into the camp , the elders of Israel said , Wherefore hath the  Lord  smitten us to day before the Philistines ? Let us fetch the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  out of Shiloh unto us , that , when it cometh among us , it may save us out of the hand of our enemies .
But go ye and learn what that meaneth , I will have mercy , and not sacrifice : for I am not come to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
translation.kha: Khie leit bad to wad kaei ka jingmut ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kaba ong : ‘ Dei ïa ka jingsbun ba nga kwah , ym ki jingkñia ïa ki mrad .’ Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki briew badonburom , hynrei ïa kiba la shah kyntait .
U Trai u la bthah ïa nga ban ong ha ki briew , Ma nga , U Trai , nga la ong ba phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga da kaba bujli ïa ka jinghikai kaba nga la ai ha phi! ,
translation.en: And thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; If ye will not hearken to me , to walk in my law , which I have set before you ,

translation.kha: Ma u , kum kiba ha Shuah jongki u , u leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai . U bur ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , suba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , as his fathers had done : he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
But thou hast utterly rejected us  ; thou art very wroth against us .
translation.kha: Lane hato me la kyntait ïa ngi junom ? Hato ym don jingkut ïa ka jingbitar jong me ?
Haba ki la ïohi ba u ïaid halor ka um , ki la sngewshyrkhei . Ka dei ka rngai ! ki la ong , sad ki la lynñiar da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: And when the disciples saw him walking on the sea , they were troubled , saying , It is a spirit  ; and they cried out for fear .
He said ,  Bring them hither to me .
translation.kha: Te wanrah ïa ki hangne ha nga ,  U Jisu u la ong .

translation.en: Hear ye this , O priests  ; and hearken , ye house of Israel  ; and give ye ear , O house of the king  ; for judgment is toward you , because ye have been a snare on Mizpah , and a net spread upon Tabor .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki lyngdoh ! To pynleit jingmut , phi ki paid Israel ! To shahshkor , phi kiba na ka longïing u syiem ! La khmih lynti ïa phi ban bishar da ka hok — Kumta ka jingbishar kan wan hap ha phi ! Phi la long ka jingriam ha Mispah , ka jar ba la pynap ha u lum Tabor ,
U Judas ( ym u Judia Iskariot ) u la Ong , Ko Trai , Kumne ka Lah ban long ba nam pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi bad ym ha ka pyrthei ?
translation.en: Judas saith unto him , not Iscariot , Lord , how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us , and not unto the world ?
And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan , he divided their land to them by lot .
translation.kha: U la pynjot ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki jaitbynriew ha ka ri Kanaan bad u la pynlong ïa ki briew jong u ki trai jong ka ri .
U dei ïa ka jingsiang halor ka Ïingjaiñ bad u buh sa ïa ka jingtap halor jong ka , kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle , and put the covering of the tent above upon it  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Phi la pyndap ïa uta uba ïalam sha ka jingimat , Hynrei U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap — bad ngi long ki sakhi ïa kane .
translation.en: And killed the Prince of life , whom God hath raised from the dead  ; whereof we are witnesses .

translation.kha: Katba nga dang ïaleh , u Rehabaïah u la kyllon ïap . Nga la rynsied pyllup ïa lade! ha khyndew bad pyrthuh jam , Em , ko Tiras Nongsynshar ! Hato men pynkup ïa uei uwei baroh ba dang sah ha Israel ?
translation.en: And it came to pass , when I prophesied , that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died . Then fell I down upon my face , and cried with a loud voice , and said , Ah Lord  God  ! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel ?
And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the  Lord  : seven days ye must eat unleavened bread .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khatsan uta u bnai , ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat ka sdang ; hynñiew sngi lynter phim dei ban bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .

translation.en: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets , and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi ïa ki samla shynrang yn pynïap ha ki lynti bah jong ka nongbah , bad ïa ki shipai jong ka baroh yn pynjot .
Haba u nang hangta ha ka ri lut ki Ephraim , u la put ïa ka tukri ban khot ïa ki paid Jeruel sha ka sur-thma ; nangta u la ïalam ïa ki arsut na ki lumrit .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he was come , that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim , and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount , and he before them .

translation.kha: U Moses u pynkut da kaba ong , Ki rangbah synshar jong phi baroh kin sa wan sha nga bad dem khrup ha khmat jongnga sa , nabar kin sa kyrpad ïa nga ban ïalam noh ïa ki briew jong nga baroh bad ban mihnoh . Hadien kata ngan sa leit . Nangta u Moses u mihnoh na u phaloh da ka jingbitar bakhraw .
translation.en: And all these thy servants shall come down unto me , and bow down themselves unto me , saying , Get thee out , and all the people that follow thee : and after that I will go out . And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger .
And the Lord said ,  Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation ? and to what are they like ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la bteng ,  Mynta bad kaei nga lah ban nujor ïa ki briew jong kane ka juk ? Ki long kiba kumno ?

translation.en: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace .
translation.kha: To ïaleh shitom ban pynneh ïa ka jinglong shi tylli ïa kaba U Mynsiem u ai lyngba ka jingsuk kaba tehsong lang ïa phi .
Shu ong ïa ki ba me kyrpad ïa nga ban ym phah pat ïa me sha byndi ban ïap hangno .
translation.en: Then thou shalt say unto them , I presented my supplication before the king , that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan s house , to die there .

And Gaal the son of Ebed said , Who is Abimelech , and who is Shechem , that we should serve him ? is not he the son of Jerubbaal ? and Zebul his officer ? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem : for why should we serve him ?
translation.kha: U Gaal u ong ,  Ki rangbah kiba kumno ngi long ha Shekhem ? Balei ba ngi shakri ïa u Abimelekh ? U dei uei uta ? U khun jong u Gideon ! Bad u Sebul u la ïoh hukum na u , hynrei balei ngi dei ban shakri ïa u ? To ïaineh ha u Hamor , u kpa tymmen jong phi , uba la seng ïa ka kur jong phi !
Nabal ka Shimham U Blei kam long thiang ha kaba kren hynrei ha ka bor .
translation.en: For the kingdom of God is not in word , but in power .

translation.kha: Nalorkata u Syiem Dabid phah khot ïa u Sadok , u Nathan , bad u Benaïah . Haba ki la rung shapoh ,
translation.en: And king David said , Call me Zadok the priest , and Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada . And they came before the king .

translation.kha: Haba U la ïohi haduh Katto ba ki ni ka jingngeit , U Jisu u ong ha Uto uba pang ïapshiliang , Ko khun jrong sa , ïa ki pop jong me la map .
translation.en: When Jesus saw their faith , he said unto the sick of the palsy ,  Son , thy sins be forgiven thee .
And bring your youngest brother unto me : then shall I know that ye are no spies , but that ye are true men : so will I deliver you your brother , and ye shall traffick in the land .
translation.kha: Wan ïalam ruh ïa u para khatduh jong phi sha nga . Da kumta ngan tip ba phim dei ki nongsyntiat , hynrei ki briew kiba hok ; ngan ai pat ha phi ïa u hynmen u para jong phi , bad phi lah ban sah hangne bad khaïi ruh .’

translation.en: Go now to the flock , and fetch me from thence two good kids of the goats  ; and I will make them savoury meat for thy father , such as he loveth :
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ka kynhun blang bad to shim ar tylli ki khunblang kiba sngaid , khnang ba ngan ïoh shet ïa ki bad khreh katto katne ïa kato ka jingbam kaba i pa jong phi i bang eh .
Ngan shuh ïa ka nongbah Pelusium , ka khup bakhraw jong ka Ijipt , ban mad ïa ka jingbitar shla jong nga . Ngan pynjot ïa ka spah jong ka Tishbe .
translation.en: And I will pour my fury upon Sin , the strength of Egypt  ; and I will cut off the multitude of No .

But it came to pass , when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land , that we said , Come , and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans , and for fear of the army of the Syrians : so we dwell at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynba u syiem Nebukhadnessar u la hiarthma ïa ka ri , ngi la rai ban wan sha Jerusalem ban lait na ki kynhun shipai ka Babilonia bad ka Syria . Dei na kane ka daw balei ba ngi ïashong ïasah ha Jerusalem .

Nga khwai ba phin tip ba ym don uno uno uba la ïalam da U Mynsiem U Blei u lah baneh jong Long ba la tim ïa U Jisu! malu ym don uno uno uba lah ban phla U Jisu u longïng U Tharai , lymda la ïalaw ïa u da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: Wherefore I give you to understand , that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed : and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord , but by the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: U Terah Badonbor Barukh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ba ïa ki ïing , ki lyngkhuh bad ki bnai sohwaiñ yn sa krad biang ha kane ka ri .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land .

translation.kha: namarba ki longïng ki bym jingai , ki daym ban nang ban ïamap iwei ïa iwei , kane ka long kaba donkam khnang ba kin ïoh jingkmen .—Pule Ephesos 4 :31 , 32 ; 5 :22-25 , 33 ; 1 Petros 3 :7 .
translation.en: Since all husbands and wives are imperfect , learning to forgive is a key to happiness in marriage . —Read Ephesians 4 :31 , 32  ; 5 :22-25 , 33  ; 1 Peter 3 :7 .
Verily I say unto you , All these things shall come upon this generation .
translation.kha: Nga ong shisha ha phi : Ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta kine ki jingpynïap baroh kan hap halor ki briew jong kane ka juk !
Balei phim peit ïa ka prokram ba la pyni ha JW Broadcasting ( tv .jw .org ) bad jingïasyllok lang hadien ?
translation.en: You could talk about a problem that your children encountered at school and how to deal with it .

translation.kha: Haba u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah u la riewspah bad pawnam , u la pynbeit ïa ka jingshongkurim hapdeng u dkhot ka longïing jong u bad ka longïing u Ahab u syiem ka Israel .
translation.en: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance , and joined affinity with Ahab .

translation.kha: Pynban , ka hukum kaba nga thoh mynta shuh phi ka hir kaba thymmai , namar ka jingshisha jong ka , ka la paw ha U Khrist bad kumjuh ruh ha phiah . Naba ka jingdiang ka la jah noh , bad ka jingai kaba shisha ka la da tyngshaiñ .
translation.en: Again , a new commandment I write unto you , which thing is true in him and in you : because the darkness is past , and the true light now shineth .

translation.kha: Haba ki la jan poi ha Jerusalem’ , hasem ki shnong Bethphage badno Bethania , ki la wan shat u lum ki Olib . U Jisu u la nang pha ar ngut na ki synran ha shuwa jyllang u bad kine ki jingtah :
translation.en: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem , unto Bethphage and Bethany , at the mount of Olives , he sendeth forth two of his disciples ,

translation.kha: Ïa ka khlaiñ jong ka la shna da ka ksiar banylla tam ; ïa ka shadem bad ki kti jong ka la shna da ka rupa ; ïa ka syngkai bad ka skhep jong ka da ka rnong ;
translation.en: This image s head was of fine gold , his breast and his arms of silver , his belly and his thighs of brass ,
And Micaiah said , As the  Lord  liveth , even what my God saith , that will I speak .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Mikaïah u jubab ,  Da U  Trai  uba im , ngan ong ïa kaei kaba U Blei u ong ïa nga ban ong !

translation.en: He built the high gate of the house of the  Lord  , and on the wall of Ophel he built much .
translation.kha: Dei u Jotham uba tei ïa ka Khyrdop kaba shaneng jong ka Templ , bad u la tei pynheh shuh shuh ïa ka kynroh ka nongbah hapoh ka jaka jong ka Jerusalem ba la khot ka Ophel .

U Jabesh u don khyndaispah thyllah ki kali ïasam kiba da ka nar , bad u la synsar ïa ki Israel da kaba banbeiñ dara lehbor haduh arphew snem . Nangta ki paid Jerusalem ki la khñiang kem ha U Tlai ban ieh jingïarap .
translation.en: And the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  : for he had nine hundred chariots of iron  ; and twenty years he mightily oppressed the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Kita ki khrup kin ïaphai markhmat , na sliang sha shiliang ka jingtap malu ki khapngiah ba-pyiar jongu ki , ki kah ïa kata ka jingtap .
translation.en: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high , covering the mercy seat with their wings , and their faces shall look one to another  ; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be .

translation.kha: dalade lap ïa uno uno u briew ba u ïathiah shongneh bad ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew , baroh ar ngat ki dei ban shah pynïap , badno kamet phin pynduh ei ïa kane ka jingbymman na Jesreel .
translation.en: If a man be found lying with a woman married to an husband , then they shall both of them die , both the man that lay with the woman , and the woman : so shalt thou put away evil from Israel .

translation.kha: haduh ba u pashat un da pynbeit pat ïa phi ha ka ri kaba kum ka Jong phi hi , ha naba khong ki bri shitaiew ïa-ban ai waiñ bun ha kob don u kew ban shna jingbam .
translation.en: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land , a land of corn and wine , a land of bread and vineyards .
And he said , Thou canst not see my face : for there shall no man see me , and live .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan ym shah ba men ïohi ïa ka khmat jong nga , namar uno uno uba ïohi ïa ka un ym im shuh ,
Yn aiti noh! ïa u ha u syiem ka Babilonia ; un peit ïa u markhmat bad un kren ïa u hi da lade .
translation.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans , but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon , and shall speak with him mouth to mouth , and his eyes shall behold his eyes  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei u Saul u la jingpyrshang ngab pynjot ïa ka balang , da kaba leit na kawei ka ïing sha kawei pat , u da paring shabar ïa ki riewngeit , shynrang bad kynthei , badno u la thep ïa ki sha ka ïingbyndi .
translation.en: As for Saul , he made havock of the church , entering into every house , and haling men and women committed them to prison .

translation.kha: U Jisu u long uta ïa uba ka Jingthoh Bakyntang ka ong , ‘ U maw uba ma phi ki nongtei phi la kyntait u la kylla long umbiah bunkam tam na baroh .’
translation.en: This is the stone which was set at nought of you builders , which is become the head of the corner .

And white robes were given unto every one of them  ; and it was said unto them , that they should rest yet for a little season , until their fellowservants also and their brethren , that should be killed as they were , should be fulfilled .
translation.kha: Ha uwei pa uwei na ki la ai ïa ka jaiñkup balieh , bad la ong ïa ki ba kin shongthait sa shipor , tad ynda la dep kheiñ lut ïa ki para shakri bad parabangeit kiba la shah pynïap , kumba la leh ïa ki .

Wat ai ba ki kynjai jong phi ngin ïalam ïa phi shata ka pep , ba kumta phi hap ban ïathuh ïa u lyngdoh jong U Blei ba phim Shimham mut shisha . Balei ban pynlong ïa U Bel ba-bang kutlad ïa phi ? Balei yn shah ïa u don pynjot thiaw ïa kaei kaba phi la trei ?
translation.en: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin  ; neither say thou before the angel , that it was an error : wherefore should God be angry at thy voice , and destroy the work of thine hands ?

translation.kha: Ha ki umpohliew ka Meribah ki briew ki la pynpyiar ïa U Trai Bad u Moses u la shem jingeh namar jong ki .
translation.en: They angered him also at the waters of strife , so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes :

translation.kha: Ngan pynngat ha phi ïa ka jingjynjar — ki jingpang bymïap lah pynkhiah , pynlang ki jingpang shit ki ban pynmatlah ïa phi bad ban pynlong ïa ka jingim jong phi baneh sep-ei . Phin bet ïa u symbai , hynrei um myntoi ïa phi , naba ki nongshun jong phi kin jop ïa phi malu kin bam ïa kaba phi la thung .
translation.en: I also will do this unto you  ; I will even appoint over you terror , consumption , and the burning ague , that shall consume the eyes , and cause sorrow of heart : and ye shall sow your seed in vain , for your enemies shall eat it .

translation.kha: Nangta haba nga krong biang ïa me bad ai biang ha me ïa ka tam don krai , men ïashoh ïa ki , ïa kaei naba ma de , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong . Don na ki , ki ban sngap , Hynrei ni na ki , ki bym leh Salu ïa me , ibha ki long ka jingbhabriew jong ki nongïaleh pyrshah .
translation.en: But when I speak with thee , I will open thy mouth , and thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; He that heareth , let him hear  ; and he that forbeareth , let him forbear : for they are a rebellious house .

translation.kha: Kumta u phah ïa u Jehoram u khun jong u ban longing khublei bad ai burom ïa u na ka bynta ka jinghap jong u ïa u Hadadeser , ïa kiba u Toi u la ïaleh thma bunsien . U Joram u wallam ki jingai sngewbha ba la thaw da ka ksiar , ka phong bad ka rnong .
translation.en: He sent Hadoram his son to king David , to enquire of his welfare , and to congratulate him , because he had fought against Hadarezer , and smitten him  ; ( for Hadarezer had war with Tou  ; ) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass .
Then answered the Jews and said unto him , What sign shewest thou unto us , seeing that thou doest these things ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la jubab da ka jingkylli ,  Ka kambah aïu ba me lah ban leh ban pyn-i ha ngi ba me don hok ban leh ïa kane ?

Un bishar ïa ki jingkñia hapdeng ki jaitbynriew . Kin tied tyrnem ïa ki waitlam jongu ki shai ki jinglur lyngkha bad ïa ki sum jong ki shiah ki waitbnoh khyllad tnat . Ki jingïambriew kin ym ïaleh thma shuh , kin ym pynkhriat tdam shuh .
translation.en: And he shall judge among the nations , and shall rebuke many people : and they shall beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruninghooks : nation shall not lift up sword against nation , neither shall they learn war any more .

translation.kha: U Ephron u don sa ar ngat ki khun shynrang nala u Shuthelah : u Eser bad u Elead , kiba la shah pynïap haba ki la pyrshang ban tong ïa ki jingri kiba dei jong ki traishnong jongno ka Gath .
translation.en: And Zabad his son , and Shuthelah his son , and Ezer , and Elead , whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew , because they came down to take away their cattle .
Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which delighted in thee , to set thee on the throne of Israel : because the  Lord  loved Israel for ever , therefore made he thee king , to do judgment and justice .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ! Uba la pynpaw katno u sngewbha eh ïa phi bad pynlong ïa phi u syiem ki Israel . Namar ba U  Trai  u ieit ïa ki Israel junom , u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem jong ki khnang ban synshar bha bad bishar hok .

translation.en: Behold that which I have seen : it is good and comely for one to eat and to drink , and to enjoy the good of all his labour that he taketh under the sun all the days of his life , which God giveth him : for it is his portion .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei kaei kaba nga la shem : Kaba bha tam kaba ngi lah ban leh ka long ban bam bad ban dih bad ban lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei ha ka jingim balyngkot kaba U Blei u la ai ïa ngi ; kane ka dei ka kupar jong ngi .

Ha ka por ba u Jahath , u Ahas , bad u Hesekaïah ki la longsem ki symboh ka Judah , U Tiras u la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Mikah , uba na ka Shong Moresheth . U Trai u la pynpaw ha u Mikah ïa ktien kai kiew baroh shaphang ka Samaria bad ka Israel .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Hajan ka jingtei kaba shaphang sepngi , don saw ngut ki nongap harud lynti bad ar ngut ha kata ka jingteh hi .
translation.en: At Parbar westward , four at the causeway , and two at Parbar .

translation.kha: Lada u rai pynrem ïa u briew uba lui lui , un long uba la tim bad isih da baroh .
translation.en: He that saith unto the wicked , Thou art righteous  ; him shall the people curse , nations shall abhor him :
He is the  Lord  our God  ; his judgments are in all the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long U Blei jong ngi ; ki hukum jong u ki long na ka bynta ka pyrthei baroh .

Ka long kumta bad phi , ko ki nongaplangbrot jong nga . Ha ka jingïadei bad ka hukum , ma phi ruh phi la ïap namar phin long ka bynta jong ka met U Khrist ; bad mandriek phi long ki jong u , uta ïa wahbah la pynmihpat na ka jingïap khnang ba ngi lah ban long kiba U Blei u lah ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka kam jong u .
translation.en: Wherefore , my brethren , ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ ; that ye should be married to another , even to him who is raised from the dead , that we should bring forth fruit unto God .

translation.kha: To ïeng jrut mynta koum u rangbah , bad jubab ïa ki jinglui jong nga .
translation.en: Gird up thy loins now like a man : I will demand of thee , and declare thou unto me .

translation.kha: Ha naba ïadei bad ka jingwan pat ka jong U Jisu Khrist U Tharai jong ngi bad ka jinglum lang ïa ngi ban long lak bad u : Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ki parabangeit jong nga ,
translation.en: Now we beseech you , brethren , by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ , and by our gathering together unto him ,

translation.kha: bad lada hadien , ha kata ka jaka ba mih u thiaw , ka don ka jingat kaba lieh ne ka dak kaba byrsaw-lieh , u dei ban leit pyn-i ha u Lyngdoh .
translation.en: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising , or a bright spot , white , and somewhat reddish , and it be shewed to the priest  ;

translation.kha: Ki khun shynraiñ jongnga u Shem — u Elam , u Asshur , u Arpakhshad , u Lud , bad u Abarim — kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na ki .
translation.en: The children of Shem  ; Elam , and Asshur , and Arphaxad , and Lud , and Aram .

translation.kha: Dang trep pynphriang ha ka Sngi U Trai , katba ka dang kad , ka Mari ka nongïam Magdala ka la leit sha kata ka jingtep bad ka la ïohi ba ïa u mawkhang la weng noh na ka jingkhang ka jingtep .
translation.en: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early , when it was yet dark , unto the sepulchre , and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre .
He sent his word , and healed them , and delivered them from their destructions .
translation.kha: U pynkhiah ïa ki da ka hukum jong u bad pyllait im ïa ki na ka jingtep .

Ha ka sngi kaba bujli , uwei u samla u la wang pra na ka jaka sher dara jongno u Saul . Ban pynpaw ïa la ka jingsngewsih , u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ bad sleh ïa la ka khlem da ka khyndaiphew . U leit sha u Dabid bad u dem ngon da katba burom haduh khyndew .
translation.en: It came even to pass on the third day , that , behold , a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent , and earth upon his head : and so it was , when he came to David , that he fell to the earth , and did obeisance .

translation.kha: U Pharaoh u nong , Ngan shah ba Phin ïaleit ban ai jingkhia ha U thri U Blei jong phi ha ka ri shyngkub ; lada phim leit jingai than . Duwai na ka bynta jong ar .
translation.en: And Pharaoh said , I will let you go , that ye may sacrifice to the  Lord  your God in the wilderness  ; only ye shall not go very far away : entreat for me .

Sojourn in this land , and I will be with thee , and will bless thee  ; for unto thee , and unto thy seed , I will give all these countries , and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father  ;
translation.kha: To shong to sah hangne , bad ngan long lem bad me , bad ngan kyrkhu ïa me . Ngan sa ai ïa kane ka ri baroh ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me . Ngan bat ïa la ka kular kaba nga la pynlong ha u Abraham u kpa jong me .
Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u paidbah byllien uba la wan sha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait u la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u dang wan sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: On the next day much people that were come to the feast , when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem ,

translation.kha: Bad u Absalom u la isih ïa u Amnon haduh kor katta namar ka jingbatbor ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u kat haduh ba um mon shuh ban kren ïa u .
translation.en: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad : for Absalom hated Amnon , because he had forced his sister Tamar .

translation.kha: Yn sa rong noh ïa ki kumba kit da ka lyer , bad kine sa shah ka jinglehrain nalor ba ki kynha ha ki blei thala .
translation.en: The wind hath bound her up in her wings , and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices .

translation.kha: ïa ki jaiñphong lyngdoh na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u ba ktang pyndonkam lehbha ki Shakri kum ki lyngdoh ,
translation.en: And the cloths of service , and the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and the garments of his sons , to minister in the priest s office ,

translation.kha: Ngi bud ïa ka moi jong me bad ine buh ka jinglehkmen jyllang ngi ha me ; me long tang ma me ibha Ngi kajuh .
translation.en: Yea , in the way of thy judgments , O  Lord  , have we waited for thee  ; the desire of our soul is to thy name , and to the remembrance of thee .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u noh ha u Nathan , u nonghiarthma , Nga shong hangne ha ka ïing ba la tei da ki dieng Kedar , hawei ïa ka syndah ka jinghun U Blei pat la buh ha ka ïingjaiñ !
translation.en: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet , See now , I dwell in an house of cedar , but the ark of God dwelleth within curtains .
He that is wounded in the stones , or hath his privy member cut off , shall not enter into the congregation of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U briew uba la shah shohdab kum u masi , lane uba la duh ïa la ka long shynrang ym dei ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U  Trai .

translation.en: And they called them , and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la khot biang ïa ki shapoh bad ki la ong ïa ki ba kim dei da lei lei ban kren lane hikai ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu .
U Trai u sngewbha ïa ki briew kiba ibha , hynrei u pynrem ïa kito kaba thnum sngur .
translation.en: A good man obtaineth favour of the  Lord  : but a man of wicked devices will he condemn .
And as he passed by , he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom , and said unto him ,  Follow me .  And he arose and followed him .
translation.kha: Katba u dang ïaid , u la ïohi ïa u nonglum khajna , u Lebi u khun jong u Alphaïos , ba u shong ha ka jaka treikam jong u . U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  Bud ïa nga .  U Lebi u la ïeng joit bad u la bud ïa u .
Ki khunlung shynrang u Noah kiba la ïawan mih na kata ka lieng ki long u shem , u Hammath , bad u Jogbehah . ( U Ham u long u kpa jong u Kana . )
translation.en: And the sons of Noah , that went forth of the ark , were Shem , and Ham , and Japheth : and Ham is the father of Canaan .

translation.kha: Ïa la u kpa ruh u phah lam shiphew tylli ki kada Ibbah kit ïa ki mar Ijipt babha bha tam , bad shiphew tylli ki kada kiba kit ïa u kew , u kpu bad kiwei pat ki jait jingbabe ba u kpa jong u un ïoh bam ha lynti .
translation.en: And to his father he sent after this manner  ; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt , and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel , and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses bad ïa u Aaron ;  Ïathuh ha ki Israel bad ha u Pharaoh ba nga la hukum ïa phi ban ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na ka ri Ijipt .
Hato u briew u ïohnong ei ei lada u jop ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei hynrei u duh noh ïa la ka jingim ? Em ym kumta ! Ko don kano kano kaba u lai ban ai ban ïoh pat ïa la ka jingim .
translation.en: For what is a man profited , if he shall gain the whole world , and lose his own soul ? or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul ?
And Moses called all Israel , and said unto them , Hear , O Israel , the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day , that ye may learn them , and keep , and do them .
translation.kha: U Moses u khot lang ïa ki Israel baroh bad u ong ha ki ,  Ko phi ki Israel , shahshkor ïa ki hukum baroh ïa kiba ngan ai ha phi mynta ka sngi . Pule ïa ki bad pynthikna ba phi kohnguh ïa ki .
Ki la ïa-ong ha u Moserah , Hato ym don jingtep mo ha Ijipt ? Hato phin hap wan ïalam ïa ngi stong ha ri shyiap ban ïarep ? Peit aïu pa’ la ni ïa ngi da kaba phi wan ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt !
translation.en: And they said unto Moses , Because there were no graves in Egypt , hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness ? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us , to carry us forth out of Egypt ?
But thou , Israel , art my servant , Jacob whom I have chosen , the seed of Abraham my friend .
translation.kha: Hynrei me , ko Israel u shakri jong nga , me long u paidlang ba nga la jied , ki khun ki ksiew u Abraham , u paralok jong nga .

Ki briew ki ïakren ha khmat jong nga shemphang baroh ki kai babha babha u Tobiah u la leh bad ki ïathuh ha u ïa kiei kiei baroh ba nga la kren . Bad u ïai phah ïa nga ki shuki ba-bang Pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa at .
translation.en: Also they reported his good deeds before me , and uttered my words to him . And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear .

translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah bad proh , hangno hangno ba la nongpule ïa ka jingpynbna u syiem , ki Jiw ki pynlong ki shuti lehkmen shlip bad ki jingkhawai sngewbha bad jingkmen . Ha ka jingrisa , ngon kiwei ki briew ki la kylla Jiw , namar mynta ki la sheptieng ïa ki .
translation.en: And in every province , and in every city , whithersoever the king s commandment and his decree came , the Jews had joy and gladness , a feast and a good day . And many of the people of the land became Jews  ; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them .

translation.kha: Phin jop ïa baroh ki nongbah ba-itynnat jongu ki ïa naba la ker kynriah ; phin pom ïa bhor ki diengsoh jong ki , phin pynsangeh ïa baroh ki mihpaw Jong ki ; sad phin pynjot ïa baroh ki lyngkha bashisha jong ki da kaba tap ïa ki da ki mut .
translation.en: And ye shall smite every fenced city , and every choice city , and shall fell every good tree , and stop all wells of water , and mar every good piece of land with stones .

translation.kha: Ki brisoh kiba sngewthuh ki iohi ïa ka jingma ba ka wan bad ki kynrei na ka , Hynrei u briew u bym pyrthat un ïaid beit ha ka bad un babe kylla hadien .
translation.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil , and hideth himself : but the simple pass on , and are punished .

translation.kha: katne katne ngut ki Pheliks Hapdeng jong kito kiba la leit sha Jerusalem ban mane ha ka por lad ka jingïarwai Mem .
translation.en: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast :
So they two went until they came to Beth–lehem . And it came to pass , when they were come to Beth–lehem , that all the city was moved about them , and they said , Is this Naomi ?
translation.kha: Ki ïaid shaphrang haduh ba kin da poi ha Bethlehem . Haba ki la poi hangta , ka shnong baroh kawei ka la sngewkmen , bad ki kynthei kiba hangta ki la pyrta ,  Hato kane ka dei shisha ka Naomi ?
Nangta sa shisien pat kan sa khiat bajngum ïa nga u tnen jongngi ka — kan ym khot shuh ïa nga u Baal jong ka .
translation.en: And it shall be at that day , saith the  Lord  , that thou shalt call me Ishi  ; and shalt call me no more Baali .

translation.kha: Nga krong ha phi kum ki briew kiba sngewthuh ; to bishar hi da lade ïa kaei kaba de nong .
translation.en: I speak as to wise men ; judge ye what I say .

translation.kha: ‘ Me la lehbor ,’ u la ong ; ‘ me un-long u shakri uba bha ! Namar ba me long uba Lah ban shaniah ha kiei kiei kiba riew , ngan buh ïa me ban khim ïa ki shiphew tylli ki nongbah .’
translation.en: And he said unto him , Well , thou good servant : because thou hast been faithful in a very little , have thou authority over ten cities .
One cherub on the end on this side , and another cherub on the other end on that side : out of the mercy seat made he the cherubims on the two ends thereof .
translation.kha: Uwei ha kawei ka tduh , bad uwei ha kawei pat ka tduh jong kata ka jingtap . U pyndait lang ïa ki kumta ba ki long lang bad kata ka jingtap .

translation.en: And when the living creatures went , the wheels went by them : and when the living creatures were lifted up from the earth , the wheels were lifted up .
translation.kha: Haba ki jingthaw ki ïaid , ki shalyntem ki ïatyllun lang bad ki , bad haba ki jingthaw ki kiew na ka khyndew ki shalyntem ruh ki leh kumjuh .
Nangta u Moses u ïathuh ha u Aaron ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai u la ong mynleh u phah ïa u ban leit phai sha Ijipt ; u ïathuh ruh ha u sanphew ki kambah Kiba U Trai’ u la hukum ïa u ban leh .
translation.en: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the  Lord  who had sent him , and all the signs which he had commanded him .

translation.kha: To wan phah , phi kiba shiah ringmraw kiba mynta phi la don ka jingkyrmen ; to ïan phai shai ka jaka jong phoi kaba shngain . Minnith nga ong ïa phi ba lang siew pat ar shah ïa phi da ka jingkyrkhu na ka bynta baroh katba phi la shahshitom .
translation.en: Turn you to the strong hold , ye prisoners of hope : even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee  ;

translation.kha: Ngi tip ba U Blei u leh ïa kaba dei haba u bishar ïa ki briew’ kiba leh ïa kiei kiei kum Kine .
translation.en: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things .

translation.kha: U Salmone mynta u long u syiem .
translation.en: And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom .

translation.kha: Mar kumta ki Rangbah kiba la leit don tohkit ïa u Paul ki la kynriah noh na u , bad Uto u rangbah ai lei u la shaphang haba u la sngewkwah ba u Paul u la long u traishnong ka Hima Rom Bad ba u la lah phuh khum kynjai ïa u .
translation.en: Then straightway they departed from him which should have examined him : and the chief captain also was afraid , after he knew that he was a Roman , and because he had bound him .

And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast  ; saying to them that dwell on the earth , that they should make an image to the beast , which had the wound by a sword , and did live .
translation.kha: Bad u la shukor ïa ki briew baroh kiba im ha ka pyrthei da ki kambah ïa kiba la shah ïa u ban leh ha khmat jong uta u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong . U mradkhlaw u la ong ïa ki ban tei ka durblei ha ka jingpyndonburom ïa u mradkhlaw ïa uba la shah pynmynsaw da ka waitlam bad pynban uba dang im .
Uei uba kham khraw , uta uba shong ban bam ne uta uba shakri ïa u ? Uta keiñ uba shong . Hynrei nga long hapdeng jong phi kum uta uba sharak .
translation.en: For whether is greater , he that sitteth at meat , or he that serveth ? is not he that sitteth at meat ? but I am among you as he that serveth .
And you , that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works , yet now hath he reconciled
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka por phi la long jngai eh na U Blei bad phi la long ki nongshun jong u namar jong kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba phi la leh bad pyrkhat .
U Nadab u kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong U Terah Bad u sien , kamar u Gad u la ong ïa u .
translation.en: And David went up at the saying of Gad , which he spake in the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: kadei kaba U Trai u la leh ha kata ka sngi , ka la pynlong ïa ki paid Israel ban ñiuhlieh ïa u Joshua u riewkhraw . Ki burom ïa u shiah lynter ka jingim jong u , kumba ki la burom ïa u Moses .
translation.en: On that day the  Lord  magnified Joshua in the sight of all Israel  ; and they feared him , as they feared Moses , all the days of his life .

translation.kha: Baroh ki traishnong Israhaïah ki dei banbeiñ sa ïa kane haba ki wanrah ïa ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner , in offering an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Me la longïng u nongshun baïaineh ka Israel bad me shah ba ki Briew jong ka kin shah pynïap ha ka por ka jingjynjar jyllang ka , ka por jongu ka jingshat pynshitom bakhiah namar ki pop jongki ka .
translation.en: Because thou hast had a perpetual hatred , and hast shed the blood of the children of Israel by the force of the sword in the time of their calamity , in the time that their iniquity had an end :

translation.kha: U ijuh u la synshar bapar phra snem ha Samaria Kum u syiem ka Israel .
translation.en: And the time that Jehu reigned over Israel in Samaria was twenty and eight years .
Because the law worketh wrath : for where no law is , there is no transgression .
translation.kha: Ka Hukum ka pynjem ïa ka jingbitar U Blei ; hynrei hangno hangno ka ha bym don ka Hukum , ym don ka jingbymkohnguh ïa ka hukum .
Tang khat-ar bnai hadien , katba u Dang ïaid hajir ka tnum jong ka jingsngem jong u ha Babilon ,
translation.en: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon .

translation.kha: Men kynjoh ïa ki ha ka lyer ; ka lyer kaba jur kan kit lut ïa ki , bad yn pynsaphriang ïa ki da ka erïong . Te men sa kmen namar nga long U Blei jong me ; men ïaroh ïa nga , U Blei bakylluid ki Israel .
translation.en: Thou shalt fan them , and the wind shall carry them away , and the whirlwind shall scatter them : and thou shalt rejoice in the  Lord  , and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel .
Joseph is a fruitful bough , even a fruitful bough by a well  ; whose branches run over the wall :
translation.kha: U Joseph u long kum u kada khlaw harud ka umpohliew u khun kada khlaw ha sharing lum .
Te mynta , A Trai , kat kum ka jingkhraw ka jingieit baïaineh jong me , to map , nga kyrpad na ka bynta ka pah jong kine ki briew’ kumba me la map ïa ki naduh ba ki la mih na Ieit .
translation.en: Pardon , I beseech thee , the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy , and as thou hast forgiven this people , from Egypt even until now .
And not only they , but ourselves also , which have the firstfruits of the Spirit , even we ourselves groan within ourselves , waiting for the adoption , to wit , the redemption of our body .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym dei tang ki jingthaw kiba ud ; ma ngi ruh kiba don ïa U Mynsiem kum ki jingai banyngkong jong U Blei , ngi ïa-ud hapoh lade hi , katba ngi dang ap ïa U Blei ba un pynlong ïa ngi ki khun jong u bad ban pyllaitluid phar ïa ngi .

translation.en: But the rich , in that he is made low : because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away .
translation.kha: Naba uba riewspah un tlor noh kum u syntiew jong u jingthung ha khlaw .

translation.en: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel , nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel .
translation.kha: Ym dei ïa u Israel , shynrang lane kynthei , ban leit long nuti ha ka jaka mane blei .

U Trai u ong shaphang kine ki briew , Ki ieit don phet noh na nga , bad kin ym lah ban bat synriah ïa lat . Kumta im shym la sngewbha bad ki . Ngan kynmaw ïa ki jingbakla kiba ki la leh bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  unto this people , Thus have they loved to wander , they have not refrained their feet , therefore the  Lord  doth not accept them  ; he will now remember their iniquity , and visit their sins .
They pluck the fatherless from the breast , and take a pledge of the poor .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki pynlong mraw ïa ki khunswet ba dang rit bad ki shim ïa ki khun jong u briew uba duk kum ka jingsiew ïa ki ram .
Ai ba ngan ïohi ïa ka jingroi jingpar ki briew jong me mala ïadon bynda ha ka jingkmen jongnga ka jaitbynriew jngai me , ha ka jingsarong bakmen jong kito kiba long ki jong me .
translation.en: That I may see the good of thy chosen , that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation , that I may glory with thine inheritance .
