translation.kha: Hangta bad ki la don u Hima bad u jingïathuh bad kiwei ïa kiba la jied bakyrpang ban rwai ki jingjaw ïaroh ha U Trai na ka bynta ka jingieit bymhok jong u .
translation.en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun , and the rest that were chosen , who were expressed by name , to give thanks to the  Lord  , because his mercy endureth for ever  ;

translation.kha: U la kren shaphang u Judas , u khun jong u Simon Iskariot . Naba u Judas , wat la u dei uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , un sa shalyngka ïa u .
translation.en: He spake of Judas Iscariot the son of Simon : for he it was that should betray him , being one of the twelve .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Saul u ong , Ym den ban pynsep ïano ïano ha kane ka sngi , naba kano ka dei ka sngi ba U Trai u la pyllait im ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And Saul said , There shall not a man be put to death this day : for to day the  Lord  hath wrought salvation in Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la ong ha u , Me don hok aïu ban bitar ïa u jingtieng ? U Jehohanan u la jubab , Nga don ka khoh baher ban bit — ban bitar eh ban ïap !
translation.en: And God said to Jonah , Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd ? And he said , I do well to be angry , even unto death .

translation.kha: bad ïa ki tupia jong ki ; ïa ki jingrang myntor kiba ki deng ha ki kti jong ki nabar ha ki syngkai jong ki ;
translation.en: The bonnets , and the ornaments of the legs , and the headbands , and the tablets , and the earrings ,
Though ye offer me burnt offerings and your meat offerings , I will not accept them : neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat beasts .
translation.kha: Haba phi wallam sha nga ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh bam jong phi , ngan ym pdiang ïa ki ; ngan ym pdiang ïa ki jingri ba phi la pynsngaid ban wallam sha nga kum ki jingainguh .

Uba ba-bieit u kren bieit pynlang u pyrkhat ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew . kaei kaba u leh bad kaei kaba u ong ka long ka jingbeiñ ïa U Trai , nabar um ju bsa ïa kiba ïa-thngan lane um ju ai ka jingdih ïa kiba sniang .
translation.en: For the vile person will speak villany , and his heart will work iniquity , to practise hypocrisy , and to utter error against the  Lord  , to make empty the soul of the hungry , and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail .
And call no man your father upon the earth : for one is your Father , which is in heaven .
translation.kha: Bad phim dei ban khot ïano ïano ha kane ka pyrthei ‘ u Kpa ,’ namar ba phi don tang uwei u Kpa ha bneng .

Kumta to shahshkor ïa ka jingimat kaba nga la don pyrshah ïa ka nongbah bapyllun bad ïa kaei kaba nga thnam ban imat ïa ki briew jong ka . Wat ïa ki khynnah yn pynïoh ïa ki , Bad baroh kin sngewtriem .
translation.en: Therefore hear ye the counsel of the  Lord  , that he hath taken against Babylon  ; and his purposes , that he hath purposed against the land of the Chaldeans : Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out : surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them .

translation.kha: Lada ha kano kano ka por nga ong ba kun rat , ngan pynkheiñ , dawai pynjot ïa kano kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka hima ,
translation.en: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation , and concerning a kingdom , to pluck up , and to pull down , and to destroy it  ;

translation.kha: Ngan pynurlong ïa uta uba jop , u rijied ha ka Tep jong U Blei jong la , bad un ïailong hangta . len thoh Halor jong u ïa ka kyr-ang U Blei jong por Bad ka kyrteng jong ka nongbah jong U Blei lad nga , ka Jerusalem bathymmai , ka ban wan hiar na bneng na U Blei jong nga . Ngan thoh ruh halor jong u ïa ka kyrteng batskhem jong nga .
translation.en: Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God , and he shall go no more out : and I will write upon him the name of my God , and the name of the city of my God , which is new Jerusalem , which cometh down out of heaven from my God : and I will write upon him my new name .

translation.kha: Namar ka bit iaka ka para jong ka , Ngam nang pynphriang ia ki .
translation.en: Because she takes after her younger sister , I cannot tell one from the other .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U tharai Badonbor Baroh , nga long u syiem . Nga long U Blei Uba im . Kumba u lum Tabor u ïeng kynjang Tam ïa ki lum bad u lum Karmel u ïeng hajrong den ïa ka duriaw-rit , kum kun longïing ka jingkhlaiñ jongnga uta uba tur ïaleh ïa me .
translation.en: As I live , saith the King , whose name is the  Lord  of hosts , Surely as Tabor is among the mountains , and as Carmel by the sea , so shall he come .

For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Let not your prophets and your diviners , that be in the midst of you , deceive you , neither hearken to your dreams which ye cause to be dreamed .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , nga maham ïa phi ban ym shah ïa lade ban shah shukor ha ki nongïathuhlypa kiba im hapdeng jong phi lane da kino kino kiwei pat kiba kam ba ki lah ban ïathuh lypa ïa ka lawei . Wat ym pynleit jingmut satia ïa ki jingphohsniew jong ki .
Nga la khynñiuh ; phi la pynbang ïa nga ban thrang eh ïa ka jingieit kum u nongñiah kali ïapom u thring ïa ka thma .
translation.en: Let us get up early to the vineyards  ; let us see if the vine flourish , whether the tender grape appear , and the pomegranates bud forth : there will I give thee my loves .

translation.kha: Ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi , bad ïai kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jongu u baher .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt love the  Lord  thy God , and keep his charge , and his statutes , and his judgments , and his commandments , alway .
The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him , and saith , Behold the Lamb of God , which taketh away the sin of the world .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U Ïoannis u la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u wan sha u , bad u la ong ,  Ha khmih , U Khunlangbrot jong U Blei , uba kit noh ïa ka pop jong ka pyrthei !
Ïa ka histori jong u syiem Dabid naduh kaba sdang haduh naba kut la buh jingthoh ha ki khoit buh jingkynmaw jong ki lai ngut ki nongïathuhlypa , u Samuel , u Nathan , bad u Gad .
translation.en: Now the acts of David the king , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of Samuel the seer , and in the book of Nathan the prophet , and in the book of Gad the seer ,
Now after the death of Moses the servant of the  Lord  it came to pass , that the  Lord  spake unto Joshua the son of Nun , Moses  minister , saying ,
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  ; U  Trai  u la kren ha u nongïarap lem jong u Moses , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun .
Ki kynthei ki dei Ban nang ban sngap jar malade da ka jingsngewrit baroh .
translation.en: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection .

translation.kha: U Trei U Blei um lah shah ïa kino Kino ki nongïaleh pyrshah ; u pynsum ïa kito kba ïeng pyrshah ïa u . Ha ka jingtur jong u , u siew kylliang ïa ki .
translation.en: God is jealous , and the  Lord  revengeth  ; the  Lord  revengeth , and is furious  ; the  Lord  will take vengeance on his adversaries , and he reserveth wrath for his enemies .

translation.kha: Lada me otsher sha ka ïing jong ka , me don ha ka lynti sha ka ri kiba ïap . Ka dat ka lynti kaba jan tam sha ka jingïap .
translation.en: Her house is the way to hell , going down to the chambers of death .

And there was also a man that prophesied in the name of the  Lord  , Urijah the son of Shemaiah of Kirjath–jearim , who prophesied against this city and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah :
translation.kha: ( La don uwei pat u briew , u Uriah u khun jong u Shemaïah na Kiriath Jearim , uba la kren ha ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  pyrshah ïa kane ka nongbah bad ka jaitbynriew kumba u Jeremaïah u la leh .
Bad u la hukum ïa ngi ban ïarap ïa ka Gospel ha ki briew , nabar ban sakhi ba u long uta ïa uba U blem u la thung ban long u Nongbishar ïa kiba im bad kiba ïap .
translation.en: And he commanded us to preach unto the people , and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead .
As birds flying , so will the  Lord  of hosts defend Jerusalem  ; defending also he will deliver it  ; and passing over he will preserve it .
translation.kha: Kumba ka sim ka her tawiar halor ka skum jong ka ban ïada ïa ki khun rit jong ka , kumta ruh ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , ngan ïada ïa ka Jerusalem bad kyrshan ïa ka .
Shisien ne ar sien ki nongkhaïi kba die bun jait ki tiew ki pynlut ïa ka miet shuwa ka sngur Sabad shabar ki kynroh ka nongbah .
translation.en: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u khot ïa u paidbah bad ïa la ki synran sha u . Lada uno uno u kaweh ngab wan bun nga , u la ong ïa ki , u dei ban klet noh ïa lade , bah ïa la ka diengphna , bad bud ïa nga .
translation.en: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also , he said unto them ,  Whosoever will come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross , and follow me .

translation.kha: katba u Pilat u dang shong ha ka kamra ïingbishar , ka rnga jong u ka la phah khubor sha u : Wat leh ei ei ïa uba u briew umbiah ang lui , namar ba ha ka jingphohsniew hynne mynmiet per la shahshitom shikatdei eh na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: When he was set down on the judgment seat , his wife sent unto him , saying , Have thou nothing to do with that just man : for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him .

translation.kha: Ki umphniang sleh bad ba-ieit ki pynlong ïa phi Ban sngewkmen , hynrei ka jingjynjar ka pynsynjor ïa ka jingsuk jingmut jong phi .
translation.en: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart : so doth the sweetness of a man s friend by hearty counsel .
I have long time holden my peace  ; I have been still , and refrained myself : now will I cry like a travailing woman  ; I will destroy and devour at once .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ,  La slem bah nga la sngap jar ; ngam shym la jubab ïa ki briew jong nga . Hynrei mynta ka por ban leh ka la wan ; nga kyang jam kum ka kynthei kaba suh kha .

translation.en: Jesus saith unto her ,  Said I not unto thee , that , if thou wouldest believe , thou shouldest see the glory of God ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ka ,  Hato ngam shym la ïathuh ïa pha ba phan sa ïohi ïa ka burom U Blei lada pha ngeit ?
Ka jingsam kaba lah la ai ha ki longkmie na ka jait Sebulun . Ka jaka kaba ki la ïohpdiang ka kot khih Sardis .
translation.en: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families : and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid :

translation.kha: Na ka jaka jong ka jait Ben-ammi la ai saw tyllai ki nongbah : ka Gibeon , ka Geba ,
translation.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin , Gibeon with her suburbs , Geba with her suburbs ,
All ye inhabitants of the world , and dwellers on the earth , see ye , when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains  ; and when he bloweth a trumpet , hear ye .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , phi baroh kiba shong ha ka pyrthei ! To ap ïa ka lama ai dak kaba yn kyntiew halor ki kliar jong ki lumbah ! To shahshkor ïa ka jingput ïa ka ronsing !
ban jop ïa ki hima malu ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew ;
translation.en: To execute vengeance upon the heathen , and punishments upon the people  ;
Now the  Lord  hath brought it , and done according as he hath said : because ye have sinned against the  Lord  , and have not obeyed his voice , therefore this thing is come upon you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la byrngem ïa kane ka ri da ka jingjot , bad mynta u la leh ïa kaei kaba u la ong ba un leh . Baroh kane ka la jia namar ki briew jong phi ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad kim shym la kohnguh ïa u .
Ki nongïalam bad ki nongbishar lad phi ki dei ban leit thiaw ïa ka jingjngai hapdeng sakma ka jaka ha kaba la lap ïa ka metïap bad ki shnong kiba mareh .
translation.en: Then thy elders and thy judges shall come forth , and they shall measure unto the cities which are round about him that is slain :

translation.kha: Ki la ïaid pyrshah ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong basah ha ka nongbah Hebron , ïa kaban la ju khiat ka kyrthat Arba . Hangta ki la ngop ïa ki kur jong u Shisha , u Ahiman bad u Talmai .
translation.en: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron : ( now the name of Hebron before was Kirjath–arba : ) and they slew Sheshai , and Ahiman , and Talmai .
Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel , and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat ?
translation.kha: Balei ka jaiñkup jong u ka saw palat , kum ka jong u briew uba ïuh ïa ki sohwaiñ ban shna waiñ ?

Wat sheptieng , u Dabid u jubab . Ngan lehbha ïa phi na ka bynda u Jonathan , u kpa jong phi . Ngan ai pat ha ph ïa ka khyndew ka shyiap baroh kaba dei ka jong u Saul , u kparad jong phi , bad phin long uba la pdiang sngewbha borabor ha ka miej bam jong nga .
translation.en: And David said unto him , Fear not : for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father s sake , and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father  ; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually .

translation.kha: Suk kito kiba tip ba ki long kiba duk ha kaba kynjoh mynsiem ; ka Hima ki bneng ka long ka jong ki !
translation.en: Blessed are the poor in spirit : for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: Baroh na phi , phi hir ki briew jong ka jingshlei , kiba long ki jong ka sngi . Ngim dat ki lad ka moramot Lane jongu ka jingdum .
translation.en: Ye are all the children of light , and the children of the day : we are not of the night , nor of darkness .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka prie ruh U Mynsiem u wanpaw ban ïarap ïa ngi , ha ka jingtlot kaba ngi don . Naba ngim tip kumno ngi dei ban duwai ; U Mynsiem hi da lade! u ïasaid bad U Bel na ka bynta jong ngi ha ki jingud Kiba ki ktien kim lah ban pynpaw .
translation.en: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities : for we know not what we should pray for as we ought : but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered .

translation.kha: U Blei u pyndonburom ïa kane ka jingleit jngoh ïa u Joram ban wanrah ka jingkyllon noh jong u Ahasaïah . Katba u Ahasaïah u dang don hangta , ma u bad u Joram ki la shah kynroi ha u briew uba kyrteng u Jehu , u khun jong u Nimshi , uba U Trai u la jakoid ban pynim ïa ka longïing syiem jong u Ahab .
translation.en: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of God by coming to Joram : for when he was come , he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi , whom the  Lord  had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab .
For his merciful kindness is great toward us : and the truth of the  Lord  endureth for ever . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi ka long kaba khlaiñ bad ka jingïaineh jong u ka long bymjukut . A to ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !

u lyngdoh un khmih babniah biang ïa uta u brisoh . Lada u Shem ba —kata ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh ka la sop shisha ïa ka met Jong u baroh shi rynïeng , un pynbna ba uta u briew u long uba khuid . Lada ka sngewtynnad jong u baroh ka la hylla lieh un longkmie uba khwai .
translation.en: Then the priest shall consider : and , behold , if the leprosy have covered all his flesh , he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague : it is all turned white : he is clean .

translation.kha: Kumta to ïeng ba la pynkhleh , da ka jingshisha kum u panpoh ba la pyndait ha ka syngkai jong phi , da ka hok kum ka jingda shadem jong pa ,
translation.en: Stand therefore , having your loins girt about with truth , and having on the breastplate of righteousness ;
And rams  skins dyed red , and badgers  skins , and shittim wood ,
translation.kha: ka snieh  langsohmoh ba la wieh rong saw , ka snieh kaba bha , bad ka dieng akasia ;
Phin ïatyngkhuh para ma phi , wat la ym don uba beh ïa phi , bad phin ym eh banbeiñ ïaleh pyrshah ïa uno du u nongshun .
translation.en: And they shall fall one upon another , as it were before a sword , when none pursueth : and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies .

In the same day shall the Lord shave with a razor that is hired , namely , by them beyond the river , by the king of Assyria , the head , and the hair of the feet : and it shall also consume the beard .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , U  Trai  un wai uwei u nongkhap shñiuh na sha shiliang ka wah Ïuphratis — u patsha jong ka Assyria ! — bad un khi ïa ki tmain jong phi bad ïa ki shñiuh halor ki khlieh bad ki met jong phi .
U nongshetkylla u la lah ai ha u paidbah ïa ka dak : U briew’ ïa uba nur doh u dei uta ïa uba phi kwah . Kem ïa u bad ïalam ïa u da kaba ap phira bha .
translation.en: And he that betrayed him had given them a token , saying , Whomsoever I shall kiss , that same is he  ; take him , and lead him away safely .

translation.kha: U Saul u kylli ïa u , Balei ma me bad u Dabid me ïasylla pyrshah ïa nga ? Balei ba me la ai ha u katto katne ka jingbam bad ka waitlam , bad ba me kylliang na U Blei na ka byndi lad u ? myntor u la phai pyrshah ïa nga bun u da ap ïa ka kabu ban ïoh pynïap ïa de !
translation.en: And Saul said unto him , Why have ye conspired against me , thou and the son of Jesse , in that thou hast given him bread , and a sword , and hast enquired of God for him , that he should rise against me , to lie in wait , as at this day ?

translation.kha: Ki para bangeit kiba Shim ka jingthohlieh ha ka tnad treikam ki mynjur ïa ki jingpynkha balang thymmei .
translation.en: Responsible brothers at the branch office approve the formation of new congregations .

translation.kha: U thri u la ong pajut ha nga , ‘ Nga tip ba kine ki brai ki longïing kiba mutlop palat .
translation.en: Furthermore the  Lord  spake unto me , saying , I have seen this people , and , behold , it is a stiffnecked people :

translation.kha: Ka por ka poi ! Ngan pynshitom ïa ki nongbanbeiñ jong pha ; ngan pyllait im ïa barhem kiba dkoh bad ngan ïalamwir shata ïing ïa kiba shah ringmraw . Neng pynphai ïa ka jinglehrain jongki ki sha ka jingdonburom , sad baroh ka pynrieh Kan ïaroh ïa ki .
translation.en: Behold , at that time I will undo all that afflict thee : and I will save her that halteth , and gather her that was driven out  ; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame .

translation.kha: Kane , pynban , kaba la den ban jia , khnang ba ïa kaei kaba la thoh ha ka sah” jong ki Kan urlong shisha : ‘ Ki la shun ïa nga khlem rupa ei ei .’
translation.en: But this cometh to pass , that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law , They hated me without a cause .

translation.kha: Te U tharai u ong ha u , Nga long U Trai , uba la wan ïalam ïa me na ka shaneng Ur kaba ha ka ri Babilonia , ban ai ha me ïa kane ka ri kum ka jong me hi .
translation.en: And he said unto him , I am the  Lord  that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldeans , to give thee this land to inherit it .

translation.kha: Kumta ki pynhiar kloi kloi ïa la ki byrni ha madan , bad uwei pa utai na ki u plied ïa la ka byrni .
translation.en: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground , and opened every man his sack .
They conceive mischief , and bring forth vanity , and their belly prepareth deceit .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki briew kiba thmu ban pynjynjar bad ban leh ïa kaba sniew ; ki dohnud jong ki , ki dap borabor da ka jingshet shukor .

U Solomon u pyndonburom ïa uta u dieng ha kaba shna ïa ki mawkyrdon ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u , bad ha kaba shna ïa ki duitara bad jingtem ksai na ka bynta ki nongot nongtem . Ym pat ju don kum kata ha naba lah ban ioh mynshuwa ha ka ri Judah . )
translation.en: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of the  Lord  , and to the king s palace , and harps and psalteries for singers : and there were none such seen before in the land of Judah .

translation.kha: Nga la shaniah ha me shi lynter ka jingim jong nga ; me la ïada ïa ar nud ka sngi ba la kha ïa nga . lang ïai ïaroh ïa me .
translation.en: By thee have I been holden up from the womb : thou art he that took me out of my mother s bowels : my praise shall be continually of thee .

translation.kha: Waw shukor ïa lade tang da kaba sngap ïa ka ktien jong u ; pynpang , to pyntreikam ïa ka .
translation.en: But be ye doers of the word , and not hearers only , deceiving your own selves .

translation.kha: Te katto katne jngut na ki Saddusi , kiba ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap , ki la wan ha U Jisu bad ki la ong ,
translation.en: Then come unto him the Sadducees , which say there is no resurrection  ; and they asked him , saying ,

translation.kha: Un shongkurim ïa ka theisotti ,
translation.en: And he shall take a wife in her virginity .
Take also your brother , and arise , go again unto the man :
translation.kha: Ïalam ruh ïa la u para , bad ïawan phai mar mar .

Ym don film Kino ki bleithaw jong ki jingpyniwbih kiba lah ban phah ïa u slap ; ka jingsbun da lade hi kam lah ban pynhap klop . Ngi la bthuh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me , A Trai U Blei jong ngi , namar me long uta uba leh ïa kine khie kiei .
translation.en: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain ? or can the heavens give showers ? art not thou he , O  Lord  our God ? therefore we will wait upon thee : for thou hast made all these things .

The adversaries of the  Lord  shall be broken to pieces  ; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them : the  Lord  shall judge the ends of the earth  ; and he shall give strength unto his king , and exalt the horn of his anointed .
translation.kha: Ïa ki nongïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  yn pynjot ; kum u pyrthat na bneng un tied pyrshah ïa ki . U  Trai  un bishar ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei ; Un ai ka bor ha la u syiem , Un pynlong ïa u syiem ba la jied jong u ban ïoh ïa ka jingjop .

Kumta u Ahab u jop ha ki nonglamktien jong u Benhadad , Ïathuh ha u syiem u kynrad jong nga , ba nga mynjur ïa ka jingdawa kaba nyngkong jrong u , hynrei ngam lah ban mynjur ïa kaba ar . Ki nonglamktien ki leit noh mala ngat ki woh biang da kawei pang ka khubor na u Benhadad ;
translation.en: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben–hadad , Tell my lord the king , All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do : but this thing I may not do . And the messengers departed , and brought him word again .
O foolish Galatians , who hath bewitched you , that ye should not obey the truth , before whose eyes Jesus Christ hath been evidently set forth , crucified among you ?
translation.kha: A phi ki nong Galatia kiba bieit! Uei uba la pynthame ïa phi ? Ha khmat ki khmat jong phi hi la batai shai kdar ïa ka jingïap U Jisu Khrist halor ka diengphna!

Nangta nga la ong ha ka kynhun langbrot , Ngan ym long shuh u nongaplangbrot jong phi . Ai kin ïap kito kiba dei ban ïap . Ai ba yn pynpait kito kiba dei ba-bang shah pynjot . Kito kiba dang sah keiñ pynjot iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: Then said I , I will not feed you : that that dieth , let it die  ; and that that is to be cut off , let it be cut off  ; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another .
Even so ye also outwardly appear righteous unto men , but within ye are full of hypocrisy and iniquity .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , ha kaba shabar phi i kumba phi bha ïa baroh , hynrei shapoh phi dap da ka jingarsap bad ki pop .
Ka long kaweh kham bha ban long u riewdum uba trei ban ïoh bam ban kaba leh mynleh kum uba khraw hynrei bad ka shahthngan .
translation.en: He that is despised , and hath a servant , is better than he that honoureth himself , and lacketh bread .
And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth , and hath determined the times before appointed , and the bounds of their habitation  ;
translation.kha: Na uwei u briew u la thaw ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei bad u la pynlong ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha kylleng ka pyrthei . U hi da lade u la pynskhem lypa ïa ki por kiba biang bad ïa ki pud jong ki jaka ha kaba kin shong kin sah .

translation.en: Thus were they defiled with their own works , and went a whoring with their own inventions .
translation.kha: Ki la pynlong ïa lade ki bymkhuid da ki jingleh jong ki bad ki la long bymïaineh ha U Blei .

Kito ki briew baroh , ki krung shaphang kumno ba phi la pdiang ïa ngi mynsngi hato i la wiang jngoh ïa phi , pynlang kumno ba phi la phai nong na ki bleithaw sha U Blei , ban shakri ïa U Blei uba shisha bad ibha im
translation.en: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you , and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God ;

translation.kha: hadien kata , U Jisu u la skhem ïa u ha ka Templ nabar u la ainong , khung shane , me la khiah mynnin ; te sangeh na kaba leh pop , ïoh kaei kaei kaba kham sniew ka lah shun jia ïa me .
translation.en: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple , and said unto him ,  Behold , thou art made whole : sin no more , lest a worse thing come unto thee .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïaid lyngba bad ïohi ba pha khih ha ka snam jong pha . La tap ïa pha da ka snam , hynrei ngam shym la shah ïa pha ban ïap .
translation.en: And when I passed by thee , and saw thee polluted in thine own blood , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live  ; yea , I said unto thee when thou wast in thy blood , Live .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long ka lynti kaba dei ka lah ban ïalaw sha ka jingïapan .
translation.en: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man , but the end thereof are the ways of death .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom phin pyrkhat ïa lade kum kiba la ïap , ha ka jingïaid bun ka pop , ishyrkhei kiba im ha ka jingïohknieh bad U Bela lyngba U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin , but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord .

translation.kha: Hynñiew u ju leit neh sha ki jaka kynjah , ha kaba u la duwai .
translation.en: And he withdrew himself into the wilderness , and prayed .
Whatsoever the  Lord  pleased , that did he in heaven , and in earth , in the seas , and all deep places .
translation.kha: U leh ïa kat kaba u mon ha bneng bad ha pyrthei , ha ki duriaw bad ha ki jingjylliew bashapoh .

translation.en: Then David said unto the messenger , Thus shalt thou say unto Joab , Let not this thing displease thee , for the sword devoureth one as well as another : make thy battle more strong against the city , and overthrow it : and encourage thou him .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha uta u nonglamktien ,  Pynshlur ïa u Joab bad ong ïa u ba un ym khuslai , namar phim lah ban ong mano ban ïap ha ka thma . Ïathuh ïa u ban pynlong ka jingtur ïaleh kaba kham khlaiñ ïa ka nongbah bad kurup ïa ka .

translation.en: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night  ; nor for the arrow that flieth by day  ;
translation.kha: Men ym sheptieng na ki jingma mynmiet ne na ki jingtur ïaleh ha ka por mynsngi ,

translation.en: Then washed I thee with water  ; yea , I thoroughly washed away thy blood from thee , and I anointed thee with oil .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la shim ïa ka um bad sait ïa ka snam na pha . Nga kyllan umphniang Olib halor ka sniehdoh jong pha .
Hynrei uei suba lah bam ïa ka jingbat ka bym don jingmad malade kob khlem nguh ? Don jingmad Aiu ha ka bynda kaba lieh jrong ka pylleng ?
translation.en: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt ? or is there any taste in the white of an egg ?

translation.kha: Nangta ka shim ïa ka Bealoth na ïing , ka pynmeh ïa ka ha jingthiah , ka buh ka jingsleh kaba da u shñiuh Bela ha khlieh jngai katai , bad ka buh jingtah phalor jong ka .
translation.en: And Michal took an image , and laid it in the bed , and put a pillow of goats  hair for his bolster , and covered it with a cloth .
And in those times there was no peace to him that went out , nor to him that came in , but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries .
translation.kha: Ha kito ki sngi ym don mano mano ba lah ban wan bad leit ha ka jingshngain , namar ba ka la don ka jingjynjar bad jingkhihwin ha ka ri baroh .

U shakuriaw u la leit phai bad u la ïathuh ïa ken baroh ha u kynrad jong u . U kynrad u la bitar shla bad u la Ong ha u sharati , ‘ To leit kloi sha ki lynti bah bad ki lynti rit jngai ka nongbud , bun wallam ïa katba duk , Kiba khrew , kiba maham , bad kiba donhok .’
translation.en: So that servant came , and shewed his lord these things . Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant , Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city , and bring in hither the poor , and the maimed , and the halt , and the blind .

So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem , and reigned : for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem , the city which the  Lord  had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel , to put his name there . And his mother s name was Naamah an Ammonitess .
translation.kha: U Rehoboam u synshar ha Jerusalem bad u nang khraw ha ka bor kum u syiem . U don sawphew wei snem mynba u long syiem , bad u synshar khathynñiew snem ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah kaba U  Trai  u la jied na ki jaka baroh jong ka Israel kum ka jaka hangno ba yn mane ïa u . Ka kmie jong u Rehoboam ka dei ka Naamah , na ka ri ki Ammon .
Ki la leit sha ka ri Ophrah badno ki wan kit nangta haduh khatsan hajar kilo ka ksiar .
translation.en: And they came to Ophir , and fetched from thence gold , four hundred and twenty talents , and brought it to king Solomon .

translation.kha: U Blei u la thaw ïa ki shkor jong ngi — hato un ym ïohsngew ? U la thaw ïa ki khmih jong ngi — hato un ym ïohi ?
translation.en: He that planted the ear , shall he not hear ? he that formed the eye , shall he not see ?

translation.kha: U Nongaplangbrot u la leit bad u la shngiam ïa ka kot kli na ka kti kamon jong ita uba shongkha halor ka khet .
translation.en: And he came and took the book out of the right hand of him that sat upon the throne .

translation.kha: Namar ba u pynbud noh ïa ki jakarieh mane blei thala bad ki duwan jingiwbih na baroh ki nongbah jong ka Judah , ka hima ka don ha ka jingsuk hajuh ka jingsynshar jong u .
translation.en: Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images : and the kingdom was quiet before him .
And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Manoah , Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware .
translation.kha: U angel u jubab ,  Ka tnga jong phi ka dei ban sumar ban leh ïa kita baroh ïa kaba nga la bthah ïa ka .

Ki phah bad ïai Pha ïa ki nongpynïaid ban leit khot sngewbha ïa ki rangbah ban wan na sha jngai bah , mala ki lapbah ki la wan . Baroh ar ngut shi para ki ngam bad tah ïa ki ñiuhmat bad dang ïa ki jingdeng mawkordor .
translation.en: And furthermore , that ye have sent for men to come from far , unto whom a messenger was sent  ; and , lo , they came : for whom thou didst wash thyself , paintedst thy eyes , and deckedst thyself with ornaments ,
And when the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  came into the camp , all Israel shouted with a great shout , so that the earth rang again .
translation.kha: Haba ka Synduk ka Jutang ka poi , ki Israel ki risa jam da ka jingkmen haduh ba ka khyndew ka khynñiuh .
Nga jubab , Ngam dei u briew uba shait phet bad rieh . Hato pa pyrkhat ba ngan pyrshang ban pynim ïa la ka jingim da kaba rahah ha ka Templ ? Ngan ym leh kumno .
translation.en: And I said , Should such a man as I flee ? and who is there , that , being as I am , would go into the temple to save his life ? I will not go in .

translation.kha: ki langsohmoh , ki iar-ryngkuh kiba ïaid pyn-at shadem , bad u syiem ha khmat ki briew jong u .
translation.en: A greyhound  ; an he goat also  ; and a king , against whom there is no rising up .

translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne ngut na pha hangto ha Sabdi kim shym la pyntngit ïa ki jaiñkup jong ki . Phan ïaid ryngkat bad nga , da kob khung da ki jaiñ balieh , namar pha long kaba dei hok ban leh kumta .
translation.en: Thou hast a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments  ; and they shall walk with me in white : for they are worthy .

translation.kha: La pyllaitluid ïa phin na ka pop mala phi la hir pat ki mraw jngai ka hok .
translation.en: Being then made free from sin , ye became the servants of righteousness .

translation.kha: Haba nga ïohsngew ïa ki jingïar jong ki , nga la bitar bad koit jingmut ban leh ei ei .
translation.en: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words .

translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki phai kylla , bad ki Benjamin ki la kulmar hi thlim namar ki sngewthuh ba kin sa shait pynjot .
translation.en: And when the men of Israel turned again , the men of Benjamin were amazed : for they saw that evil was come upon them .
Speak unto Aaron , saying , Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish , let him not approach to offer the bread of his God .
translation.kha: Ong ha u Aaron , ym bit ïa uno uno na ki khun ki ksiew jong me pateng la pateng uba don jingduna ha ka met ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam sha nga .

translation.en: Then spake the chief butler unto Pharaoh , saying , I do remember my faults this day :
translation.kha: Nangta u nongrah khuri u ong ha u syiem ,  Nga dei ban phla mynta ba nga la leh bakla .
Don ki briew kiba la peiñ dien noh na film bad ki la jah lynti ha ki jingïatainia ba-bieit .
translation.en: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling ;

translation.kha: Uwei u dadien u Sihon , u syiem Amor uba syiar ha Heshbon . Ka hylla jong u ka kynthup shiteng jong ka Eliada : nud Aroer ( ha ka tduh jong ka Them arsien ) malu na ka nongbah kaba hapdeng jong kata ka lui , shaduh ka wah Jabbok , ka khadar jong ki Ammon ;
translation.en: Sihon king of the Amorites , who dwelt in Heshbon , and ruled from Aroer , which is upon the bank of the river Arnon , and from the middle of the river , and from half Gilead , even unto the river Jabbok , which is the border of the children of Ammon  ;
And the  Lord  went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud , to lead them the way  ; and by night in a pillar of fire , to give them light  ; to go by day and night :
translation.kha: Mynsngi , U  Trai  u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki ha u rishot lyoh ban kdew lynti ïa ki , bad mynmiet pat u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki ha u rishot ding ban ai jingshai ïa ki , khnang ba ki lah ban ïaid mynsngi bad mynmiet .

translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed , and be cut down , and fall  ; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off : for the  Lord  hath spoken it .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka jia , u snar uba la pynskhem un sa kylluid bad hap . Bad kata kan long ka jingkut jong kiei kiei baroh kiba la sdien ha u .  U  Trai  u la kren .

translation.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished , and he that speaketh lies shall perish .
translation.kha: Ym don uba kren lamler ha ka ïingbishar u ban ïohlait na ka jingpynshitom ; u la shah pynrem .

“Nga la ïohi ba phin la lyndet ïa ka hukum ba U Trai U Blei jongnga phi u la ai ha phi , bad ba phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa u da kob phiah jingaiti na ka bynta ïa lade ka durblei ba la saiñ ha ka dur u khun masi .
translation.en: And I looked , and , behold , ye had sinned against the  Lord  your God , and had made you a molten calf : ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the  Lord  had commanded you .
Now the things which I write unto you , behold , before God , I lie not .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga thoh ka long kaba shisha . U Blei hi u tip ba ngam shym lamler!
U Jisu u la phai , u la ïohi ïa ki ba ki bud ïa u , bad u la kylli , Phi ïadait aïu ? Ki la jubab ïa u , Hangno me sah , ko Rekhab ? ( Kana ka kynjai ka mut U Nonghikai . )
translation.en: Then Jesus turned , and saw them following , and saith unto them ,  What seek ye ?  They said unto him , Rabbi , ( which is to say , being interpreted , Master , ) where dwellest thou ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , To shahshkor , phi ki briew kiba kyllut ! To pynlut bha , pa’ kiba mareh !
translation.en: Hear , ye deaf  ; and look , ye blind , that ye may see .

translation.kha: Kato pa kyrkhoit ba sa kmen ban ïohi ba ki bhabriew kiba sniew ki ïap ? U Trai Nongsynshar u kylli . Em , nga kham mane ban ïohi ïa ki ba ki kylla-kaba-mut mala ki im .
translation.en: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die ? saith the Lord  God  : and not that he should return from his ways , and live ?

translation.kha: Ki Lem ki beh da ka bor ïa ki briew na ka jaiñ Dan sha ka ri lum bad kim shah ïa ki ban wanrah khah shiah ri thor .
translation.en: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain : for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley :
But he said , Then bring meal . And he cast it into the pot  ; and he said , Pour out for the people , that they may eat . And there was no harm in the pot .
translation.kha: U Elisha u pan khyndiat u  purew , u ber ïa u ha uta u khiew , bad u ong ,  To theh kham bun ka syrwa na ka bynta jong ki .  Bad kam shym don kano kano kaba sniew ha ka .

Na la ïong , ‘ Lur ïa ka khynñiuh thymmai na ka bynta ïa lade , bet ïa ka jinglehhok , dara ot ïa ka jingkyrkhu ba ka jingmaham ïa to kan pynmih . Ka la dei ka por ïa phi ban phai sha nga , U Trai jong phi , bad lang! sa wan bad ieh ki jingkyrkhu hajir jong phi .’
translation.en: Sow to yourselves in righteousness , reap in mercy  ; break up your fallow ground : for it is time to seek the  Lord  , till he come and rain righteousness upon you .
And we said unto my lord , We have a father , an old man , and a child of his old age , a little one  ; and his brother is dead , and he alone is left of his mother , and his father loveth him .
translation.kha: Ngi ruh ngi la jubab , ‘ Ngi dang don i pa iba la tymmen , bad sa uwei u para uba la kha ha ka jinglong tymmen jong i . U hynmen jong u khynnah , u la ïap , bad na ki khun ka kmie jong u , dei sa tang ma u uba dang im ; i pa ruh i da ieit thep mynsiem ïa u .’

translation.en: And when neither sun nor stars in many days appeared , and no small tempest lay on us , all hope that we should be saved was then taken away .
translation.kha: Bun sngi ngim shym lah ban ïohi ïa ka sngi lane ïa ki khlur , bad ka lyer ka la nang beh jur . Ha kaba khatduh ngi la duh jingkyrmen ïa ka ban lait im .
Ngi la har pop kumba ki kparad tymmen jong ngi ki la leh ; ngi la long bymman malade sniew .
translation.en: We have sinned with our fathers , we have committed iniquity , we have done wickedly .
And he drave them from the judgment seat .
translation.kha: Bad u la beh noh ïa ki shabar ka ïingbishar .
Lydda sier ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh ka la pur ha ka jingsawa jong u naduh khlieh ïathuh katjuh ,
translation.en: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin , and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot , wheresoever the priest looketh  ;

translation.kha: Haba katto katne ngut ki Pharisi ki la ïalumlang , U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki ,
translation.en: While the Pharisees were gathered together , Jesus asked them ,

And the children of the Kenite , Moses  father in law , went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah , which lieth in the south of Arad  ; and they went and dwelt among the people .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u kthaw kurim u Moses , na ka jait Ken , ki la leit ryngkat bad u paid Judah na Jerikho , ka nongbah ki dieng Tlai , sha ka ri shrah ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Arad ha Judah . Ki shongduh hangta hapdeng ki Amalek .

translation.en: Then Peter said , Silver and gold have I none  ; but such as I have give I thee : In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la ong ha u ,  Ngam don pisa ei ei , hynrei nga ai ha me ïa kaei kaba nga don : Ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist uba na Nasareth nga hukum ïa me ban ïeng joit bad ïaid !

translation.en: Stand now with thine enchantments , and with the multitude of thy sorceries , wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth  ; if so be thou shalt be able to profit , if so be thou mayest prevail .
translation.kha: Buh ïa ki jingleh myntor bad jingkhan jong pha baroh ; pha la pyndonkam ïa ki naduh ba pha dang samla . Lehse ki lah ban long jingïarap katto katne ïa pha ; lehse pha lah ban pyntieng ïa ki nongshun jong pha .

Haba ki briew ha ka nongrah ki khiew dong step phrangsngi ha ka step kaba bud , ki shem ba ka duwan ïa u Baal badno ka dak jong ka Asherah la pynkhyllem , bad ba la thang ïa u masi Kyrteng uba ar halor ka duwan ïa kaba la tei hangta .
translation.en: And when the men of the city arose early in the morning , behold , the altar of Baal was cast down , and the grove was cut down that was by it , and the second bullock was offered upon the altar that was built .
And they shall scoff at the kings , and the princes shall be a scorn unto them : they shall deride every strong hold  ; for they shall heap dust , and take it .
translation.kha: Ki ñiewbeiñ ïa ki syiem bad ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ki rangbah synshar ba-halor . Ym don ka kut kaba lah ban pynsangeh ïa ki — ki kynton ïa ka khyndew pyrshah ïa ka bad ki knieh ïa ka .

Haba u ebanjelist U Trai u la jan pynjot ïa ka Jerusalem , U Trai u la kylla ka jingmut ban pynshitom ïa ki briew bad u ong ha u angel uba pynpyut ïa ki , Sangeh ! Ka la biang katto ! U angel u la don hajan ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah , u nong Jebus .
translation.en: And when the angel stretched out his hand upon Jerusalem to destroy it , the  Lord  repented him of the evil , and said to the angel that destroyed the people , It is enough : stay now thine hand . And the angel of the  Lord  was by the threshingplace of Araunah the Jebusite .

translation.kha: Ngam pynïap ïa eiei pa uwei uba shong ha kane ka nongbah ; ki briew bad ki mrad kumjuh ; ktien ïap da ka khulom kaba shyrkhei .
translation.en: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city , both man and beast : they shall die of a great pestilence .

translation.kha: Ki diengthang Kseh-Sypress kin san ha ka jaka kaba mynta ki don ki dieng shynraiñ ; ki dieng marbl kin mian ha ka jaka ki shiah . Kane kan long ka dak ka ban neh jingmut , ka jingpynkynmaw ïa Kiei kaba ma nga , U Trai , nga la leh .
translation.en: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree , and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree : and it shall be to the  Lord  for a name , for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off .

translation.kha: Hato la pynmynsaw ïa phi da ka pop jong nga , ko phi u nongap byndi ? Balei me pynbudnam ïa nga na ka boitha ka jingïa-pynïap jong me ? Kato nga long ka jingkit kambah khia eh ïa me ?
translation.en: I have sinned  ; what shall I do unto thee , O thou preserver of men ? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee , so that I am a burden to myself ?
Which was the son of Joanna , which was the son of Rhesa , which was the son of Zorobabel , which was the son of Salathiel , which was the son of Neri ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Joanan , u khun jong u Rhesa , u khun jong u Serubbabel , u khun jong u Shealtiel , u khun jong u Neri ,
U Tiras u da kyrkhu shisha ïa ka Hannah , bad ka ieh sa lai ngut ki khun shynrang bad ar ngut ki khun kynthih . Uta u khynñiat Samuel , u nang saiñ ha kaba shakri ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And the  Lord  visited Hannah , so that she conceived , and bare three sons and two daughters . And the child Samuel grew before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi , na Ïuphratis shaduh u pud ka ri Ijipt , U Trai un ïalum ïa uei pa uwei na ki briew jong u , kum uba pynkhlad ïa u kew na u stait .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt , and ye shall be gathered one by one , O ye children of Israel .

translation.kha: U para jong u , u dei u Jubal , u kpa tymmen jong ki nongtem jingtem baroh kiba ter ïa ka duitara bad meng tangmuri .
translation.en: And his brother s name was Jubal : he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ .

translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ka , kim tip ka Dei kaei , malu kumta ki ïakylli para ma ki , Kaei mo khie ? Te u Moses u ong ha ki , Une u dei u kdup ba U Trai u la ai ha phi don smam .
translation.en: And when the children of Israel saw it , they said one to another , It is manna : for they wist not what it was . And Moses said unto them , This is the bread which the  Lord  hath given you to eat .
So shall thy barns be filled with plenty , and thy presses shall burst out with new wine .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , ïa ki thiar jong phi yn pyndap da u kew , bad phin ïoh ruh shibun bha ka waiñ haduh ba phim lah shuh ban pynlang ïa ka .

translation.en: Watch ye therefore : for ye know not when the master of the house cometh , at even , or at midnight , or at the cockcrowing , or in the morning :
translation.kha: To ap phira bha te , namar phim tip lano u kynrad jong ka ïing un wan — ka lah ban long ha ka por janmiet lane ha ka por shiteng synñia lane ha shuwa ka step phyrngab lane ha ka por tang shu mih sngi .
Khenani ha u lumrit Sihon kin don ki ban wai im , bad sa long ka khak mawkyntang . Ki briew jong u Jakob kin ïohkynti ïa ka ri kabu dei hok ka jong ki .
translation.en: But upon mount Zion shall be deliverance , and there shall be holiness  ; and the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions .
These things command and teach .
translation.kha: Kine baroh ki jingbthah bad ki jinghikai .
Ko parabangeit jong sa , kum kiba ngeit ha U Jisu Khrist uba U thri jong ngi , U Trai ka burom , Phim dei ban ñiew ïa ki parabriew da ki armet kiba pher na kaei kaba ïohi ïa ki na shabar .
translation.en: My brethren , have not the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ , the Lord of glory , with respect of persons .

translation.kha: La tep ïa u Abner ha Hebron , bad u syiem u ïam da kaba kyang jam ha ka jaka tep , bad ki briew baroh’ ki leh Khmut .
translation.en: And they buried Abner in Hebron : and the king lifted up his voice , and wept at the grave of Abner  ; and all the people wept .

Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , my servants shall eat , but ye shall be hungry : behold , my servants shall drink , but ye shall be thirsty : behold , my servants shall rejoice , but ye shall be ashamed :
translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ïathuh ïa phi ba kito kiba mane bad kohnguh ïa nga kin ïoh kyrhai ban bam ban dih , hynrei phi phin thngan bad phin sliang . Ma ki kin shadkmen hynrei ma phi phin jahburom .

translation.en: If Satan also be divided against himself , how shall his kingdom stand ? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub .
translation.kha: Kumta lada ka hima jong u Soitan ka don ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat , kumno kan neh ? Phi ong ba nga beh noh ïa ki ksuid namar ba u Beelsebul u ai ha nga ka bor ban leh kumta .

translation.en: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee , O inhabitant of Mareshah : he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Mareshah , U  Trai  un aiti noh ïa phi ha u nongshun , u ban kurup ïa ka shnong jong phi . Ki nongïalam ka Israel kin leit bad rieh ha ka krem ha Adullam .
U Jehoram , u khun jong u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judia u don Hynriew ngut ki para shynrang : u Asaraïah , u Jehukal , u Sekharaïah , u Asalaïah , u Mikhael , bad u Shephataïah .
translation.en: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat , Azariah , and Jehiel , and Zechariah , and Azariah , and Michael , and Shephatiah : all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel .

translation.kha: ban ong ha ki paid Israel , Shna ki ksai jyrthiaw ha ki ïong jaiñspong jngai phi bad buh ïa u ksai uba jngum ha uwei uwei u jyrthiaw . Phira dat ban ai ïa kane shi lynter .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations , and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue :

translation.kha: Un jah noh kum ka jingphohsniew , kum ka jingïohipaw myn , bun ba yn ym ïohi shuh .
translation.en: He shall fly away as a dream , and shall not be found : yea , he shall be chased away as a vision of the night .

translation.kha: Mynta , U blem u la tyrwa ha ngi ïa ka jingïalang ba ngi lah ban pyndeng ïa ka jingjahthait ïa Kaba u la kren . Te , to ngin da sumar , ba yn ym shem ïa uno uno na phi u bim kato ïa-ban nongpdiang ïa kata ka jingjahthait ba la kular .
translation.en: Let us therefore fear , lest , a promise being left us of entering into his rest , any of you should seem to come short of it .

And Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan sware unto them and to their men , saying , Fear not to serve the Chaldeans : dwell in the land , and serve the king of Babylon , and it shall be well with you .
translation.kha: U Gedalaïah u la ong ïa ki ,  Nga ai ïa phi ïa la ka ktien ba kam donkam ïa phi ban sheptieng ban pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia , to shongduh ha kane ka ri , to shakri ïa u syiem ka Babilonia , bad baroh kan bha ïa phi .

translation.en: Therefore also said the wisdom of God , I will send them prophets and apostles , and some of them they shall slay and persecute :
translation.kha: Na kane ka daw ka Jingstad jong U Blei ka la ong , ‘ Ngan phah ha ki ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bad ïa ki nonglamktien ; kin pynïap katto katne ngut na ki bad kin pynshitom beiñ ïa kiwei pat .’

translation.en: Although many skilled tradesmen from the region volunteer their labor at every building site , members of the local congregation make up the bulk of the volunteer labor force .
translation.kha: Wat lada don shibun ki nongtrei mon sngewbha kiba tbit kiba wan na kiwei ki jaka , hynrei kiba bun pat ki dei ki para bangeit kiba trei mon sngewbha na kato hi ka jaka .

translation.en: And Moses spake before the  Lord  , saying , Behold , the children of Israel have not hearkened unto me  ; how then shall Pharaoh hear me , who am of uncircumcised lips ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u phai ktien ,  Wat ki Israel ruh kim shym sngap ïa nga , u Pharaoh lei shano un sngap ? Nga dei u briew uba duna ka ktien ka thylliej .

Ïa kane U Trai u la jubab , Lada me wan phalang , ngan shim pat ïa me , bad men Long biang u shakri Jong to . Lymda ha ka jaka ban krenbeiñ khlem jingmut me pynbna ïa ka khubor ba anna jingmut , Leit long biang u nongïathuhlypa jyllang nga . Ki briew kin wan phai pat sha me , malade mut donkam ban leit sha ki .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  , If thou return , then will I bring thee again , and thou shalt stand before me : and if thou take forth the precious from the vile , thou shalt be as my mouth : let them return unto thee  ; but return not thou unto them .
A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike .
translation.kha: Ka tnga kaba bunktien ka long syriem kum ka um kaba jaw jrop shi jrop ha ka sngi ba slap .

U Trai u ong , Ko ki briew jong ka Judas , ïa ka pop jong phi la thoh da u khulom nong ; la pruid jylliew halor ki dohnud jong phi da u diamond banep bad la ohdur shalor ki dong Jong ki duwan jong phi .
translation.en: The sin of Judah is written with a pen of iron , and with the point of a diamond : it is graven upon the table of their heart , and upon the horns of your altars  ;

translation.kha: U la pynpait ïa ki jingkhang rnong bad pynpur ïa ki nar kiba ker .
translation.en: For he hath broken the gates of brass , and cut the bars of iron in sunder .

translation.kha: kumta u la phiah khot ïa u nongriam , mala u la ong ha u , U briew barben u ai shuwa ïa ka waiñ kaba bha tur , bad hadien ba kiba la shah kut sngewbha ki la dih pahuh , u pynbudnam sa da ka waiñ kaba kham duna ka jingmad . Hynrei ma me , me thong ïa ka waiñ kob bha kad haduh mynta !
translation.en: And saith unto him , Every man at the beginning doth set forth good wine  ; and when men have well drunk , then that which is worse : but thou hast kept the good wine until now .

translation.kha: Baana nga long thoin ba ym Don kob lah ban pynïakhlad ïa ngi na ka jingieit Jong u : Ym ka jingïap lymne ka jingtem , lynthem ki angel , lyndum kiwei ki nongsynshar ba kynja bneng lane ki bor lymne jong kaba mynta lymne ka ban sa wanpaw ,
translation.en: For I am persuaded , that neither death , nor life , nor angels , nor principalities , nor powers , nor things present , nor things to come ,
And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother s eye , but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?
translation.kha: Balei , te , ba phi khmih ïa u thiat ha ka khmat u para jong phi , bad phi khlem pynleit jingmut ïa ka lyngkhot dieng hapoh ka khmat jong phi hi ?
Ong ha ki Jeraïah , eit uno na phi lane u nongwei suba wan shong pyndeng jong phi , uba ai ïa utai na ki khun jong u ha u blei Molekh , u dei shun shah lynthem maw ha u paidbah haduh ba un da ïap .
translation.en: Again , thou shalt say to the children of Israel , Whosoever he be of the children of Israel , or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel , that giveth any of his seed unto Molech  ; he shall surely be put to death : the people of the land shall stone him with stones .
Thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , a people cometh from the north country , and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki briew ki wan na ka ri ha ka phang bashatei ; ka jaitbynriew kaba khrawbor na sha jngai bah ka pynkhreh ïa ka thma .

translation.en: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves , that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets .
translation.kha: Kumta phi phla shisha ba phi long ki khun ki ksiew jong kito kiba la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa !
Kumta u Aaron u shoh ïa ka khyndew da la u diengduh ; te u phet pui baroh ha Ijipt u kylla mait , bad kumta la balui da u mait ha u briew bad ha u mrad .
translation.en: And they did so  ; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod , and smote the dust of the earth , and it became lice in man , and in beast  ; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt .

But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers , who were ancient men , that had seen the first house , when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes , wept with a loud voice  ; and many shouted aloud for joy :
translation.kha: Bun na ki lyngdoh ba la kham tymmen , ki Lebi , bad ki rangbah kur , ki la ïohi ïa ka Templ banyngkong , bad ki peit ïa ka nongrim jong kane ka Templ katba dang tei , ki ïam pangnud . Hynrei kiwei pat kiba don hangta ki pyrta da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings , and your sacrifices , and your tithes , and heave offerings of your hand , and your vows , and your freewill offerings , and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks :
translation.kha: Shata phi dei ban leit rah ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingkñia jong phi , ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew jong phi , bad ïa ki jingainguh jong phi , ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba phi kular ïa U  Trai  , ïa ki jingainguh mon sngewbha jong phi , bad ïa kiba la kha nyngkong na ki masi bad ki langbrot jong phi .
Dang step phyrngab ha ka lynti ba u leit phai sha ka nongbah , U Jisu u la tyndong .
translation.en: Now in the morning as he returned into the city , he hungered .

translation.kha: u Jakob u ong ha u Joseph , Nga kaweh ba men leit sha Shekhem , ha kaba ki hynmen shynrang jong me ki ap sumar ïa ki kynoi jingri . U Joseph u jubab , Nga kloi .
translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , Do not thy brethren feed the flock in Shechem ? come , and I will send thee unto them . And he said to him , Here am I .

Write ye also for the Jews , as it liketh you , in the king s name , and seal it with the king s ring : for the writing which is written in the king s name , and sealed with the king s ring , may no man reverse .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingpynbna ba la dep pynmih ha ka kyrteng u syiem bad ba la shon da ka muhor syiem , ym lah ban pynkylla . Phi lah pat ban thoh sha ki Jiw ïa kaei kaei kaba phi kwah ; bad phi lah ban thoh ïa ka ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad shon ïa ka da ka muhor syiem .
Haba ki briew ki ïakajia , bad uwei u seh da u maw ne u kura da ka kti ïa uwei pat khlem da pynïap ïa u , yn ym pynsamthiah ïa u ,
translation.en: And if men strive together , and one smite another with a stone , or with his fist , and he die not , but keepeth his bed :

translation.kha: Kumta u la leit ban trei na ka bynta uwei na ki traishnong jong kata ka ri , uba la phah ïa u shat ka jaka ri jingri jong u don sumar ïa ki sniang .
translation.en: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country  ; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine .

translation.kha: Ym shym la don jingïathuh shapoh u kop lane ka kmie lane jong kino ‘Phim ki kpa tymmen jngai u Melkhisedek ; ym shym la don jingtynjuh shaphang ka jingkhah lane ka jingïarap jong u . U Syria ïa U Khun U Blei , u ïaisah u lynghoh junom .
translation.en: Without father , without mother , without descent , having neither beginning of days , nor end of life  ; but made like unto the Son of God  ; abideth a priest continually .
So the spirit took me up , and brought me into the inner court  ; and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  filled the house .
translation.kha: U Mynsiem U  Trai  u la rah ïa nga sha ka bynta kaba kham shapoh jong ka phyllaw , ha kaba nga la ïohi ba ïa ka Templ la pyndap da ka burom U  Trai .
Kin pyllait ïa phi na ki tnga jong kiwei pat ki bri , na ki kynthei kiba na ban kren ïa ki ktien kiba pynshohbieit .
translation.en: That they may keep thee from the strange woman , from the stranger which flattereth with her words .

translation.kha: U ai bainong ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba ki har bad u leh ha ki kat kum kiba ki de hok .
translation.en: For the work of a man shall he render unto him , and cause every man to find according to his ways .

translation.kha: U Trei U Bela jong phi u ïadon ïa pa’ bad u ong , Nga shim noh ïa ka khuri kaba nga la ai ha phi ha ka jingbitar jong nga . Phin ym hap ban dih shuh ïa ka wai kaba pynlong ïa phi shun ïadei sheng sheng .
translation.en: Thus saith thy Lord the  Lord  , and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people , Behold , I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling , even the dregs of the cup of my fury  ; thou shalt no more drink it again :

translation.kha: Lymda ym shym la thaw ïa u briew na ka bynta ka briew , hynrei ïa ka briew na ka byndi u briew .
translation.en: Neither was the man created for the woman ; but the woman for the man .

Associate yourselves , O ye people , and ye shall be broken in pieces  ; and give ear , all ye of far countries : gird yourselves , and ye shall be broken in pieces  ; gird yourselves , and ye shall be broken in pieces .
translation.kha: To ïalumlang ha ka jingsheptieng , phi ki jaitbynriew ! To shahshkor , phi ki bynta ba sha jngai jong ka pyrthei . Pynkhreh ban ïaleh , hynrei to sheptieng ! Ho-oid to pynkhreh , hynrei to sheptieng !

translation.en: Send therefore to Joppa , and call hither Simon , whose surname is Peter  ; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side : who , when he cometh , shall speak unto thee .
translation.kha: Phah ïano ïano sha Joppa ban shem ïa u briew uba ka kyrteng pura ka long u Simon Petros . U shong basa ha ka ïing jong u Simon , u nongpdem snieh , uba shong basah harud duriaw .’

translation.en: And Rachel said , God hath judged me , and hath also heard my voice , and hath given me a son : therefore called she his name Dan .
translation.kha: Ka Rakhel ka ong ,  U Blei u la bishar hok ïa nga . U la shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad u la ai khun shynrang ha nga  ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Dan .
Kumba nga long U Blei uba im , nga rah la ka kti bad nga smam ,
translation.en: For I lift up my hand to heaven , and say , I live for ever .

translation.kha: Nahath nga la kylli ïa u , Kaei ka jingmut jong ki ar tukri ki diengsoh Olib ha kawei kawei ka liang jong u diengpynïeng sharak ?
translation.en: Then answered I , and said unto him , What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof ?
A man shall be commended according to his wisdom : but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised .
translation.kha: Lada phi long kiba shemphang , phin ïoh jingïaroh ; lada phi long kiba mutlop , ki briew kin peitbeiñ ïa phi .

translation.en: Then came forth unto him Eliakim , Hilkiah s son , which was over the house , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , Asaph s son , the recorder .
translation.kha: Lai ngut ki nong Judia ki wan ban ïakynduh ïa u ; u rangbah synshar uba dei peit ïa ka ïingsyiem , u Eliakim u khun jong u Hilkaïah ; u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u Shebna ; bad u rangbah synshar ba dei peit ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh , u Joah u khun jong u Asaph .

U Arabah u Rangbah Lyngdoh , un don ïa ka bor katba hakhlieh tam ha baroh ki kam niam , bad u Sebadaïah u khun jong u Ïasam , u lat ka Judia , un ne ïa ka bor balieh haduh ha baroh ki kam hima sima . Ki Lebi kin kheit ban peit hajar ki jingpyntreikam ïa ki jingbrai jong ki ïingbishar . Long khlur bad pyndep ïa kine ki jingbthah , bad to U Trai un long ha ka liang jong Ibbah sa ïa kaba dei !
translation.en: And , behold , Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of the  Lord   ; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael , the ruler of the house of Judah , for all the king s matters : also the Levites shall be officers before you . Deal courageously , and the  Lord  shall be with the good .

translation.kha: Balei ba ngi ïashong khoh ? Ki briew jong U Blang ki ïakylli . Ale , ngin ïaphet shuh ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh , bad ïap Hangne . U Trai U Blei jong I u la pynrem ïa ngi ban ïap ; u la ai ha ngi ka bih ban dih , namar ngi la bor ngop pyrsad ïa u .
translation.en: Why do we sit still ? assemble yourselves , and let us enter into the defenced cities , and let us be silent there : for the  Lord  our God hath put us to silence , and given us water of gall to drink , because we have sinned against the  Lord .
To Titus , mine own son after the common faith : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour .
translation.kha: Nga thoh sha u Titos , u khun bashisha jong nga ha ka jingngeit kaba ngi ïadon lang . To U Blei uba long U Kpa bad U Khrist Jisu uba long U Nongpynim jong ngi un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
Shahshkor hab nga mai tyngeh ïa phi ; ngan ai ïa phoi ïa ki jinghikai kiba bha bad kan ïathuh lang ïa ka jingtip jong nga malu phi .
translation.en: Turn you at my reproof : behold , I will pour out my spirit unto you , I will make known my words unto you .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingkup kiba u phong la tap da ka snam . Ka kyrteng jong u ka long U Kynthei Jong U Blei .
translation.en: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood : and his name is called The Word of God .

translation.kha: Kat kaban ishyrkhei ! Katno kaba itriem ïa ka nongbah kaba khriat ! Ka la ju riam ïa lade da ki jaiñ linen , kiba sawbthuh , bad kiba mata hain hain , bad ka sum ïa lade da ki jingdeng ksiar , ki mawkordor , bad ki paila !
translation.en: And saying , Alas , alas , that great city , that was clothed in fine linen , and purple , and scarlet , and decked with gold , and precious stones , and pearls !

translation.kha: Ha khim , A Trai , ha ka jingkordit jong nga , ha ka jingjynjar sahit ka mynsiem Jong nga ! Ka dohnud jong nga ka pait ha ka jingsngewsynei na ka bna ki pop jong nga . Ka don ka jingpynïap ha ki lynti baheh ; wat hapoh ïing ka don ka jingïapan .
translation.en: Behold , O  Lord  , and consider to whom thou hast done this . Shall the women eat their fruit , and children of a span long ? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord ?

translation.kha: Ha kaei ka sngi nga ai ha me ka iathuh halor ki jaitbynriew mala ki hima baneh rat bad ïa-ban pynkhyllem , ban pynjot bad ngab bret sharum , ban tei mala ban snar .
translation.en: See , I have this day set thee over the nations and over the kingdoms , to root out , and to pull down , and to destroy , and to throw down , to build , and to plant .

translation.kha: U Trai u long uba khraw bad uba dei eh ban ïarah ; u longsem uba daiñ ban shah pyndonburom kham palat ïa ki blei baroh .
translation.en: For the  Lord  is great , and greatly to be praised : he is to be feared above all gods .

That there came certain from Shechem , from Shiloh , and from Samaria , even fourscore men , having their beards shaven , and their clothes rent , and having cut themselves , with offerings and incense in their hand , to bring them to the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , shuwa ba uno uno un tip shaphang ka jingshah pynïap u Gedalaïah , phraphew ngut ki rangbah ki la poi ha Shekhem , Shiloh bad Samaria . Ki la khi ïa la ki  ñiuhtmoh , kad ïa la ki jaiñ , bad ki pynmong ïa lade . Ki dang ïashim kew bad jingiwbih ban ai ha ka Templ .

translation.en: Much food is in the tillage of the poor : but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment .
translation.kha: Ki lyngkha ba sah shrah ki lah ban pynmih shibun ka jingbam ïa kiba duk , hynrei ki bymhok kin shu ieh ïa kine khlem rep .

Ha ka jingjynjar jong nga , A Trei , nga la khot kyrwep ïa me , bad me la jubab ïa la . Na ka jingiwbih jngai ka pyrthei kiba ïap sa la khoit kyrpad na ka bynta ka jingïarap , bad me la ïohsngew ïa nga .
translation.en: And said , I cried by reason of mine affliction unto the  Lord  , and he heard me  ; out of the belly of hell cried I , and thou heardest my voice .
And he cried , saying , Jesus , thou Son of David , have mercy on me .
translation.kha: U la pyrta ,  Ko Jisu ! U Khun u Dabid ! To isynei ïa nga !
malade u la kylli , Phin ai Aïu ïa nga lada nga shetkylla ïa U Jisu ha phi ? Ki la ñiew shiphew tylliat ki sbai mata badno ki la ai ïa nam ha u .
translation.en: And said unto them , What will ye give me , and I will deliver him unto you ? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver .
To fulfil the word of the  Lord  by the mouth of Jeremiah , until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths : for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath , to fulfil threescore and ten years .
translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la ïathuh mynshuwa lyngba u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa la pyndep :  Ka ri kan sa sah kynjah haduh hynñiewphew snem , ban pynïabiang ïa ka jingshongthait Sabbaton , ïa kaba ym pat shym la rakhe .

translation.en: And he brought us out from thence , that he might bring us in , to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers .
translation.kha: U la pyllait ïa ngi na Ijipt ban wan ïalam ïa ngi shane bad ban ai ha ngi ïa kane ka ri , kumba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
Ki la pait ïa ki jingthung jong ka ri shyiap malade bam ïa ki , wat ïa ki thied bym don jingma jongnga u diengsynshar !
translation.en: Who cut up mallows by the bushes , and juniper roots for their meat .

translation.kha: Uta u mradkhlaw u ïasyriem ïa u ut , bad ki jait koum ki kjat dngiem bad ka shyntur u kum ka shym sing . U Ïakjakor u la ai ha u mradkhlaw ïa ka bor jong u hi , ïa ka khet jong u , bad ïa ka bor synsar baïar jong u .
translation.en: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard , and his feet were as the feet of a bear , and his mouth as the mouth of a lion : and the dragon gave him his power , and his seat , and great authority .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ïai pynkynmaw ïa phiah shaphang kine kiei kiei , wiat la phi la tip lehbha bad phi sheng skhem ha ka jingshisha kaba phi la ïohpdiang .
translation.en: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things , though ye know them , and be established in the present truth .

translation.kha: Habor u la rung shaei ka ri Ijipt , ki nong Ijipt ki la ïohi ba ka tnga jong u ka la long kaba bhabriew .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , when Abram was come into Egypt , the Egyptians beheld the woman that she was very fair .

translation.kha: U Ishod u ainong , Ïa ngin ïatrei noh ; ngan at ïaid ma nga sha khmat .
translation.en: And he said , Let us take our journey , and let us go , and I will go before thee .

translation.kha: Uwei pat u briew u la ong , Ngan buhnud ïa me , ko kynhied ; hynrei tyngkong shah ïa nga ban leit bad khublei ïa ka longrynïeng jong na .
translation.en: And another also said , Lord , I will follow thee  ; but let me first go bid them farewell , which are at home at my house .
Wherefore shew ye to them , and before the churches , the proof of your love , and of our boasting on your behalf .
translation.kha: To pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong phi ïa ki , khnang ba ki balang baroh kin sngewskhem ïa kata bad kin tip ba ngim shym bakla ha kaba ngi kob sarong shaphang jong phi .
Ha ka sngem Sabbaton kaba bud , la jan baroh shi shnong ki la wan banbeiñ sngap ïa ka ktien jong U Trai .
translation.en: And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word of God .

translation.kha: Nangta , lada uno uno u ong ha phi , ‘ Ha khmih , shnat U to U Messaïah !’ lane ‘ U khong hangtai !’ — wat thwet ïa kata .
translation.en: Then if any man shall say unto you , Lo , here is Christ , or there  ; believe it not .

translation.kha: Ha u nongshet kpu rangbah u la ïuh ba kata ka jingbatai ïa ka jingsniew jong u nongrah khuri ka long kaba ai jinghun , u ong ha u Joseph , Nga ruh nga la phohsniew ; ar la kit lai tylli ki shang kpu halor ka khlieh jong nga .
translation.en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good , he said unto Joseph , I also was in my dream , and , behold , I had three white baskets on my head :

translation.kha: U Phestos u la pynbna , Da lei lat ha kano Kane ka por manna ym ïoh ban sait ïa ki kjat jong nga . Lada ngam ïoh ban sait ïa ki kjat jong me , U Jisu u la jop , men ym ïoh long shuh u synrai jong nga .
translation.en: Peter saith unto him , Thou shalt never wash my feet . Jesus answered him ,  If I wash thee not , thou hast no part with me .
Their webs shall not become garments , neither shall they cover themselves with their works : their works are works of iniquity , and the act of violence is in their hands .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki jingïasylla jong phi kim wanrah jingbha ei ei ïa phi — ki long bymlarkam kum ka jaiñphong ba la thain da ka snur thapbawa !

translation.en: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates  ; and the water thereof was dried up , that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynriew u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka wahbah Ïuphratis . Ka wah ka la rngad , ban pynbiang ka lynti ïa ki syiem kiba wan na mihngi .

Ki Israel ki la ïaid lyngngoh ïa ka duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang . Hynrei haba ki kad ïalap jngai ki nong Ijipt lem bad ki kulai badno nongshniah ki loit shapoh ka duriaw , U Trai u pyndih patiaw ïa ka um bad ka la tyllep ïa ki .
translation.en: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea , and the  Lord  brought again the waters of the sea upon them  ; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong , Bsuh baïong ïa kato ka ktieh jong me shabi ka jaiñkup jong me . U ruh u leh kumta , bad haba u sei ïa ka , u ïohi ba ka la koit pat , kumba ka long mynhyndai .
translation.en: And he said , Put thine hand into thy bosom again . And he put his hand into his bosom again  ; and plucked it out of his bosom , and , behold , it was turned again as his other flesh .
And they smote him on the head with a reed , and did spit upon him , and bowing their knees worshipped him .
translation.kha: Ki la shoh ïa u na ka khlieh da u dieng , ki la bynthiew ïa u , ki la dem khohsiew , bad ki la nguh ïa u .
to long kiba sngewkyiuh ha kiei kaei baroh . Kane ka longsyiem kawei naba U Blei u kwah na phi ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: In every thing give thanks : for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you .
For they shall be an ornament of grace unto thy head , and chains about thy neck .
translation.kha: Ki jinghikai jong ki kin pynbha ïa ka jinglong jong phi kum ka jaiñspong kaba ishongkhia ha ka khlieh jong phi , lane kum u jingdeng uba pyniphuh ïa ka dur jong phi .

translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah , saying ,
translation.kha: Shen hadien ba u Sedekaïah u la long u syiem ka Judah , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la kren ha nga shaphang ka ri Elam .
U la shahskhor ïa ki kpa tymmen jongngi I bad u la long uba shyrkhei ïa ki , da kaba pynbor ïa ki ban bret ïa ki khunlung jong ki na ki longïing jong ki , khnang ba kin ïap .
translation.en: The same dealt subtilly with our kindred , and evil entreated our fathers , so that they cast out their young children , to the end they might not live .
As for their rings , they were so high that they were dreadful  ; and their rings were full of eyes round about them four .
translation.kha: Ïa ki rmiang jong ki shalyntem la tap da ki khmat .

translation.en: But the woman fearing and trembling , knowing what was done in her , came and fell down before him , and told him all the truth .
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ka , kumta ka la wan , ka da kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng , ka la dem khohsiew ha ki kjat jong u , bad ka la ïathuh ha u ïa ka jingshisha baroh .
naba katto katai pa u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la Ong ïa u Heldai , Ka long ka bym dei ïa me ban shongkurim ïa ka Hodaïah !
translation.en: For John said unto him , It is not lawful for thee to have her .
I have not written unto you because ye know not the truth , but because ye know it , and that no lie is of the truth .
translation.kha: Nga thoh sha phi , namarkata , ym namar ba phim tip ïa ka jingshisha ; pynban , ka long namar ba phi da tip ïa ka , bad phi tip ruh ym don ka lamler kaba ju mihnoh na ka jingshisha .

translation.en: Hearken unto me now therefore , O ye children , and attend to the words of my mouth .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ko ki khun jong nga , sngap ïa nga . Pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
U Daniel shisyndon u la loit pynlang u la ïoh por da ka jingai jingbit jong u syiemsad , Haneng ba u lah ban ïathuh ïa u syiem aïu ka jingphohsniew ka kit jingmut .
translation.en: Then Daniel went in , and desired of the king that he would give him time , and that he would shew the king the interpretation .

translation.kha: Ngan pynskhem triang ïa u kum ïa u snar , bad un long ka tynrai jong ka jingpyndonburom ïa ka longïing jongngi u baroh kawei .
translation.en: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place  ; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father s house .

translation.kha: U Jisu uba na Naïoth u dang ïadoh nangne , ki la ïathuh ïa u .
translation.en: And they told him , that Jesus of Nazareth passeth by .

translation.kha: Pynban , ki la longsem kba mutlop bad ki la maïan ïa ki bleithaw u Baalgad kumba ki kpa jong ki , ki la hikai ïa ki ban imat .
translation.en: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart , and after Baalim , which their fathers taught them :

translation.kha: ïathiah ïa kata , phi kiba shong halor ki kada balieh , katba sheng ha ki jingsan , badno phi kiba hap ïaid kjat kat shaba phi leit .
translation.en: Speak , ye that ride on white asses , ye that sit in judgment , and walk by the way .

translation.kha: Ngam don jingsuk , jingjahthait , bad ki jingjot jong nga kim don jingkut .
translation.en: I was not in safety , neither had I rest , neither was I quiet  ; yet trouble came .

translation.kha: Phi pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong phi bad ïa ka kyrdan jong phi ban shim nala ïa ka jaka baroh .
translation.en: But as for the mighty man , he had the earth  ; and the honourable man dwelt in it .

translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u pyniwtung sha khmat ïa ki ïing na ka jait Benjamin , bad ka ïing u Matri ka la sha jied . Nangta ki rangbah na ka ïingjaiñ kur u Matri ki wan sha khmat , bad u Saul u khun jngai u Kish u la shah jied . Ki wad ïa u hynñiew haba kim shet ïa u ,
translation.en: When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families , the family of Matri was taken , and Saul the son of Kish was taken : and when they sought him , he could not be found .

translation.kha: (Nga long ka Jingstad , bad nga don ka bor sngewthuh ; nga don ka jingtip bad ka bor pyrkhat kaweh khlaiñ .
translation.en: I wisdom dwell with prudence , and find out knowledge of witty inventions .

translation.kha: Nga la khmih ha ki lumbah — ki la khynñiuh , bad ki lumrit ki khih shadien bad shad khmat .
translation.en: I beheld the mountains , and , lo , they trembled , and all the hills moved lightly .

translation.kha: Sngewbha , khie nang ïaid sha khmat , ngan nangto bud suk suiñ , baneh ïaid kaba nga lah lak bad kine ki jingroi bad ki khynnah khah ba ing sa ïashem pud bad pa’ ha Edom .
translation.en: Let my lord , I pray thee , pass over before his servant : and I will lead on softly , according as the cattle that goeth before me and the children be able to endure , until I come unto my lord unto Seir .

translation.kha: U Ahas u leit phai sha la ïing , u da sngewsih bad bitar ïa kaei kaba u Naboth u ong ha u . U dem ha la ka jingtynjuh , u pha shaphrang ka kynroh , bad um 3 bam ei ei .
translation.en: And Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him : for he had said , I will not give thee the inheritance of my fathers . And he laid him down upon his bed , and turned away his face , and would eat no bread .

translation.kha: Nangta , ki la sahnarphna ïa u bad ki la ïabynta ïa ki jaiñ jong u hapdeng jong ki , da kaba ïakynting sbai ban khmih mano ban ïoh ïa kano ka bynta jong ka jaiñ .
translation.en: And when they had crucified him , they parted his garments , casting lots upon them , what every man should take .
The discretion of a man deferreth his anger  ; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression .
translation.kha: Lada phi long uba shemphang , phin lah ban kan ïa la ka jingbitar . Haba uno uno u leh bakla ïa phi , ka dei ka jinglong bakhraw ban leh klet ïa ka .

translation.en: Comfort from knowing that God feels for us when we suffer . —Zechariah 2 :8 .
translation.kha: Ngi ioh jingtngen naba ngi tip ba U Blei u don jingsngew haba ngi jynjar .—Sekharaiah 2 :8 .
Ishod ar la pynlong kynjah ïa ka Ijipt bad pynjot noh ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka , kin sa thop ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate , and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full , when I shall smite all them that dwell therein , then shall they know that I am the  Lord .
Did you get a good look at her ?
translation.kha: Me ioh ban peit iaka .
U Blei un buh ïa ki angel ban khmih khashor jong me ban ïada ïa me shano shano ba me leit .
translation.en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee , to keep thee in all thy ways .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la pait bad u la dumok ïa ki bad u la ong , drama thop phi dei na u jait Mynsiem ïew ; babha U Khun U bhabriew um khim la wan ban pynjot ïa ka jingim jongki ki briew’ , Hynrei ban pynim ïa ki .
translation.en: But he turned , and rebuked them , and said ,  Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of .

translation.kha: Phi long ki paralok jong nga ! To isynei ïa nga ! Ka kti U Blei ka la ïaleh ïa ar .
