translation.en: Have pity upon me , have pity upon me , O ye my friends  ; for the hand of God hath touched me .

translation.kha: Ha ka la ïohi ba u la iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñsop bad ba u la mareh shabar ïing ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand , and was fled forth ,

translation.kha: Ngi la khot ïa kiba ïateh lok bad nga , hynrei ki la kyntait ban ïalap ïa nga . Ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam ki la ïap ha ki lynti beh jong ka nongbah , ki da wad ïa ka jingbam ban ri pynsum ïa lade .
translation.en: Arise , cry out in the night : in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord : lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children , that faint for hunger in the top of every street .

translation.kha: Ïa ki jingdih la im ha ki khlur ksiar , katba ïapher dur khwai na kawei pat , dara u syiem u la ai pahuh ïa ka waiñ jong u .
translation.en: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold , ( the vessels being diverse one from another , ) and royal wine in abundance , according to the state of the king .

translation.kha: Ha katai ka miet , U Trai u ong ha u Gideon Shim ïa u basa ktang jong u kpa jrong me bad aiwai pat u masi ktang uba hynñiew snem ka rta , pynïap noh ïa ka kharai ba u kba jong me u la tei ha u Baalath , bad pynkhyllem ïa ka dak jong ka blei Ahishar katba ne ha syndah jong ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass the same night , that the  Lord  said unto him , Take thy father s young bullock , even the second bullock of seven years old , and throw down the altar of Baal that thy father hath , and cut down the grove that is by it :

translation.kha: Phim tip ïa kaei kaban phi pan , U Jisu u la jaboh ïa ki khun shynrang jong ka . hato phi lah ban dih ïa ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ïa kaba ngan sa dih ? Ngi lah , ki la jubab .
translation.en: But Jesus answered and said ,  Ye know not what ye ask . Are ye able to drink of the cup that I shall drink of , and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ?  They say unto him , We are able .

translation.kha: Um shym la rung Shobab namar ym ne kaba lah ba-bang rung shapoh ha ki jaiñ khain .
translation.en: And came even before the king s gate : for none might enter into the king s gate clothed with sackcloth .

translation.kha: U Jeshua u la nang san ha ka met bad ha ka jingstad , da kaba ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha bad U Blei lem bad ki bhabriew .
translation.en: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature , and in favour with God and man .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki parabangeit na Kaisaria ruh ki la ïaleit bad ngi bad ki la ïalam ïa ngi sha ka ïing jong u briew ha kiba ngi Hukum — u Mawsiang , uba na Sypros , uba la long u parabangeit naduh ki sngi kiba dang pdang .
translation.en: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea , and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus , an old disciple , with whom we should lodge .

translation.kha: Shahshkor , ïa nga ! Kine ki kaei ki dei ki imon ki para Jong phi . Pyllait noh ïa ki , ne U Trai un pynshitom ïa phi ha ka jingbitar jong u .
translation.en: Now hear me therefore , and deliver the captives again , which ye have taken captive of your brethren : for the fierce wrath of the  Lord  is upon you .

Get thee up into this mountain Abarim , unto mount Nebo , which is in the land of Moab , that is over against Jericho  ; and behold the land of Canaan , which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession :
translation.kha: Khie leit sha ki Lum Abarim kiba ha ka ri Moab marpyrshah ïa ka shnong Jerikho ; kiew ïa u Lum Nebo bad khmih ïa ka ri Kanaan ïa kaba ngan ai ha ki paid Israel .
To shahshkor , ma phi baroh , ïa ka sur ka jongnga U Blei , ïa u pyrthat uba mih na ka shyntur jong u .
translation.en: Hear attentively the noise of his voice , and the sound that goeth out of his mouth .

translation.kha: Pynban , Rumah ka long , U balui u la bthuh ïa ki khñiot kaba ïapher ha ka met kumba u kwah ïa ki ba kin longïng .
translation.en: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body , as it hath pleased him .
And Jeroboam slept with his fathers , even with the kings of Israel  ; and Zachariah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem , bad u khun jong u , u Sekharaïah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty . And he answered and said unto him , O man of God , thus hath the king said , Come down quickly .
translation.kha: U syiem u la phah sa uwei pat u rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah , kiba la leit kiew bad ong ha u Elijah ,  Ko briew jong U Blei , u syiem u hukum ïa phi ban wan hiar shisyndon !

translation.en: Wherefore , brethren , covet to prophesy , and forbid not to speak with tongues .
translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong nga , to ai ba ka dohnud jong phi kan kwah hir hir ïa ka ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei , hynrei wat adong ïa ka jingkren ha ki thylliej bapher .
Hynrei u pyllut ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingjynjar jong ki bad pynlong ïa ki longïing jong ki ban roi kum ki jingroi .
translation.en: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction , and maketh him families like a flock .

translation.kha: Tep ïa ki baroh hapoh ka khyndew ; tah ïa ki ha ka pyrthei ibha ïap .
translation.en: Hide them in the dust together  ; and bind their faces in secret .

translation.kha: Bad mynta , u lah ba ïarap ïa kita kaba shahskhor pynshoi , namar ma u hi u la shah pynshoi bad sohkhram .
translation.en: For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted , he is able to succour them that are tempted .

translation.kha: Ha ka met jong u diengpynïeng sharak hi yn don sawphew tylli ki khuri kiba kum ki syntiew mandriek lem bad ki shylluit malu ki diengphasi ba la oh-shrong itynnat .
translation.en: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds , with their knops and their flowers .
While they promise them liberty , they themselves are the servants of corruption : for of whom a man is overcome , of the same is he brought in bondage .
translation.kha: Ki kular ha ki ïa ka jinglaitluid katba ma ki , ki long ki mraw jong ki jingmlien bapynjot — naba u briew u long u mraw ha kano kano kaba jop halor u .

U nongïathuhlypa uba kyrteng u Elisha , uba na Tibni kaba ha Galatia , u la ong ha u Syiem Abib , Ha ka kyrteng U Trai , U Blei uba im jong ki Jeriel , ïa uba nga sharak , nga ong ha phi ba ha ki ar ne lai snem kiba bud yn ym don ka umjer lane u snar tad haduh ba ngan ong kumta .
translation.en: And Elijah the Tishbite , who was of the inhabitants of Gilead , said unto Ahab , As the  Lord  God of Israel liveth , before whom I stand , there shall not be dew nor rain these years , but according to my word .

translation.kha: U Benhail u la manbha ha ka por ba u Darius u synrai Bad ha ka jingsynshar jongnga u Syros u nong Persia .
translation.en: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius , and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian .

translation.kha: Ki jingat phyllung ka jingïap ki don sawdong jong nga , ki jingat phyllung ka jingpynjot ki tylli Halor jong nga ;
translation.en: When the waves of death compassed me , the floods of ungodly men made me afraid  ;

translation.kha: Ka la long ka ïingjaiñ jong u blei Malkhos uba phi la bah , bad ka dur jongu u Rephan , u blei khlur lad phi ; ki la long ki bleithaw kiba phi la thaw ïa ka ban mane . Bad kamet ngan phah ïa phi sha ka jinglongmraw shuh Palat ka Babilon .’
translation.en: Yea , ye took up the tabernacle of Moloch , and the star of your god Remphan , figures which ye made to worship them : and I will carry you away beyond Babylon .

translation.kha: U phong ka jingkup naba la shna na ki snieh narud , ïa Kaba la tah da u panpoh snieh , ki jubab . U daiñ u Elijah ! u syiem u la ainong ïam .
translation.en: And they answered him , He was an hairy man , and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins . And he said , It is Elijah the Tishbite .

And the hangings of the court , and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court , which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about , and their cords , and all the instruments of their service , and all that is made for them : so shall they serve .
translation.kha: Ki shynrang baroh kiba la dap shi bnai lane kham heh kiba la shah ñiew ki long phra hajar hynriewspah ngut .

Ka bynta ba ki pule ka kynthup ïa jingbuh jingthoh shaphang kumno u Mordekai u la lap ïa ka jingsylla ban pynïap ïa u syiem — ka jingsylla da u Ba-itynnat bad u Teresh , ki ar ngut ki tyngkhuh ka ïingsyiem kiba ap phira ïa ki Hall u sahmiet .
translation.en: And it was found written , that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh , two of the king s chamberlains , the keepers of the door , who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus .
And they shall kill him , and the third day he shall be raised again .  And they were exceeding sorry .
translation.kha: ki ban pynïap ïa u , hynrei hadien lai sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .  Ki synran ki la sngewsih eh .

translation.en: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared : there make ready for us .
translation.kha: Te un pyn-i ha phi ïa ka kamra kaba haneng kaba heh , ba la pynkhreh bad pynbiang , ha kaba phin ïoh baroh kiei kiei ba la pynkhreh lypa na ka bynta jong ngi .

Kumta u Shephataïah u leit bad ki nongïalam ka Gilead , malade u paidbah u thung ïa u kum u nongshoh-nar bad u nongïalam jong ki . U Jephthah u pynpaw ïa ki kyndeh na ka liang jong u ha Mispah ha khamtam U Tharai .
translation.en: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead , and the people made him head and captain over them : and Jephthah uttered all his words before the  Lord  in Mizpah .

translation.kha: Bad ki la ong , Ngim da donkam ïa kino kino ki sakhi ! Ma ngi hi moi la ïohsngew ïa kaei kambah u la nguh !
translation.en: And they said , What need we any further witness ? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth .

translation.kha: ‘ Ko paralok , kumno phi ïohrung hangne khlem ki jaiñ-jin shongkurim ?’ u syiem u la kylli ïa u . Hynrei uta u briew um shym ïai-ong ei ei .
translation.en: And he saith unto him , Friend , how camest thou in hither not having a wedding garment ? And he was speechless .

translation.kha: Phin lah ba don ka jingïadei ba kyrpang bad U Jehobah
translation.en: You can enter into a special relationship with Jehovah
The former treatise have I made , O Theophilus , of all that Jesus began both to do and teach ,
translation.kha: Thiophilos badonburom : Ha ka kitab banyngkong jong nga , nga la thoh shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba U Jisu u la leh bad hikai naduh ka por ba u la sdang ïa ka jingtrei jong u tad haduh ka sngi ha kaba la shim noh ïa u sha bneng .
Ha ka jingbitar U Blei u la pyndkut ïa ki katei ki kjat jong nga ; u peit ïa nga da ka jingisih .
translation.en: He teareth me in his wrath , who hateth me : he gnasheth upon me with his teeth  ; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me .

translation.kha: Ngin dei ban long kum u Kain ; u la long jong u Basniew pynlang u la pynïap ïa u Abel , u por jong u . Balei u Kñia u la pynïap ïa u ? Namar kiei kiei kiba u la leh da lade hi ki la hir ki ngi dei , hynrei khie kiei kiba u sa jong u , u la leh ki la long kiba dei .
translation.en: Not as Cain , who was of that wicked one , and slew his brother . And wherefore slew he him ? Because his own works were evil , and his brother s righteous .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u ong ïa me , ‘ Ngan pynngat ïa ka jingot ha me . Ngin sar nala phar ïa me , bad ngan pynduh khoit ïa imat pa uwei u shynrang na ka longïing jongnga me , la u samla bad tmain kamut .
translation.en: Behold , I will bring evil upon thee , and will take away thy posterity , and will cut off from Ahab him that pisseth against the wall , and him that is shut up and left in Israel ,
And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones , and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u , ka rupa bad ka ksiar ki kynrei ha Jerusalem kum ki maw , bad u dieng Kedar u jyllei kum u dieng Sykomore   .
Namar kata , ko kynrad , eh ngan sai ma nga hangtei kum u mraw jong phi ha ka jaka u para , bad shah ïa u ba un leit phan badno la ki hynmen .
translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , let thy servant abide instead of the lad a bondman to my lord  ; and let the lad go up with his brethren .

And he went unto his father s house at Ophrah , and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal , being threescore and ten persons , upon one stone : notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left  ; for he hid himself .
translation.kha: U leit sha ïing u kpa jong u ha Ophrah , bad hangta ha khlieh jong uwei u maw u la pynïap ïa ki hynñiewphew ngut ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u , ki khun shynrang jong u Gideon . Hynrei u Jotham , u khun khatduh jong u Gideon , u la rieh bad um shym la shah pynïap .
U kpa bad ka kmie jong u kim tip ba kane Baroh ka dei na U Trai , naba U Trai u wad ka lad banbeiñ ïaleh ïa ki Philistia . Ha kata ka por ki Philistia ki synshar ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the  Lord  , that he sought an occasion against the Philistines : for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel .

translation.kha: Ki nonghikai ka Hukum nabar ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la pyrshang ban krem ïa U Jehu hangta hi , namar ki la tip ba u la ïatih ïa kane ka phasi pyrshah ïa ki ; hynrei ki la ïasheptieng ïa ki paidbah .
translation.en: And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him  ; and they feared the people : for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them .

translation.kha: Bad ka jingbha ka long ka jingmih ba la pynmih na ki symbai kiba ki nongpynïasuk ki la bet ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace .

translation.kha: U Trai u iam ïa Baroh kiba leh mo ; da lei lei un ym shah ba kin loit na ka jingpynshitom .
translation.en: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the  Lord  : though hand join in hand , he shall not be unpunished .

translation.kha: Ka spah ba phi ïoh da ka jingbymhok shen kan jah noh ; hynrei ym ha shuwa ba kan ïalam ïa phi sha ki tyngam jong ka jingtep .
translation.en: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death .

translation.kha: Haba un uno u khor sngewbha ïa phi shaw ka jingkhawai jingjahburom , wat sheng ha ki jaka bakyrpang . Ka lah banbeiñ ia ba uno uno Uba kham donkam ban ïa phi u la shahshkor khot sngewbha ,
translation.en: When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding , sit not down in the highest room  ; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him  ;

translation.kha: Haba ki la tad ha u mawsiang baher ha Dibon , u Amasa u la ïakynduh ïa ki . U Joab u la phong ka jaiñ ïaleh tdem , bad ka waitlam hapoh ka jingsop jong ka ïa kaba la teh pynskhem ha u pynpoh jong u . Katba u waiñ shaei khmih ka waitlam ka la khup .
translation.en: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon , Amasa went before them . And Joab s garment that he had put on was girded unto him , and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof  ; and as he went forth it fell out .

translation.kha: Te u Petros u la sngewthuh ïa kaei kaban la lah jia ha u , bad u la ainong , Mynta la tip ba ka long kob Shisha ! U Trai u la phah ïa u duh jong u ban pyllait ïa por na ka bor jongki u Herod malade na kaei Kiei baroh kaba ki Jiw ki la khih lynnong ba sa jia .
translation.en: And when Peter was come to himself , he said , Now I know of a surety , that the Lord hath sent his angel , and hath delivered me out of the hand of Herod , and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews .
Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors .
translation.kha: Ki jingbthah jong me ki ai ka jingsngewbha ïa nga ; ki long ki nongaibuit jong nga .
Ma me lem bad ki shipai jong me men ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah shisien shi sngur haduh hynriew sngi .
translation.en: And ye shall compass the city , all ye men of war , and go round about the city once . Thus shalt thou do six days .
And Jehu slept with his fathers : and they buried him in Samaria . And Jehoahaz his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U la ïap , bad la tep ha Samaria , bad u Jehoahas u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
Ha ka dik snar jong ka Ïing , thaw ïa ka pyrda kaba da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u saiwul uba jngum , uba sawphew , bad umbiah rong saw , bad ba la suh pynpur itynnat bha .
translation.en: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , wrought with needlework .

translation.kha: Ngi sngewkmen haba im erlangthari kiba tlot hynrei phi long bakha khlaiñ . Bad kum ngi duwai ruh ba phin long uba janai .
translation.en: For we are glad , when we are weak , and ye are strong : and this also we wish , even your perfection .
Nevertheless what saith the scripture ? Cast out the bondwoman and her son : for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman .
translation.kha: Hynrei aïu ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ? Ka ïathuh ,  Beh noh ïa ka kynthei mraw bad ïa u khun jong ka ; naba u khun jong ka kynthei mraw un ym ïoh bynta na ka jingdon jingem u kpa lem bad u khun jong ka kynthei kaba laitluid .
u pynrit khop ïa ki lyndum bun ïa ki rangbah kiba don ha ka bor .
translation.en: He leadeth princes away spoiled , and overthroweth the mighty .

translation.kha: Ha kiwei ka sngi ka Ruth ka ong ha ka Namar , Shuh ba ngan leit sha ki lyngkha ban tam ïa u kew ba ki nongot ki ieh . Nga thikna banbeiñ shem u bynriew u ban shah ïa nga ngab trei bad u . Ka Naomi ka ong , Khie leit , ko khum jngai nga .
translation.en: And Ruth the Moabitess said unto Naomi , Let me now go to the field , and glean ears of corn after him in whose sight I shall find grace . And she said unto her , Go , my daughter .

translation.kha: ka Hapharaim , ka Shion , ka Anaharath ,
translation.en: And Hapharaim , and Shion , and Anaharath ,

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki ïambriew ïa u laispah sngi hangta ha ri ang Moab .
translation.en: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days : so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended .

translation.kha: Uwei uwei barben u ïai ïabam bad ïadih , bad ki shynrang bad ki kynthei ki ïashongkurim , haduh ka sngur kabu u Noah u la leit rung shapoh ka lieng bad ka jingshlei um ka la wan bad ka la pynïap ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: They did eat , they drank , they married wives , they were given in marriage , until the day that Noah entered into the ark , and the flood came , and destroyed them all .

translation.kha: Buh ïa ka duwan ksiar ban thap jingbeh ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad kwah ïa ka pyrda ha ka jaka ryndang jngai ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony , and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle .

translation.kha: To hukum ïa wir kiba riewspah ha kiei kiei jongngi kane ka jingim ba ktien ym sngewsarong , hynrei ba buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ki , ym ha kata kaei kaei ka bym thikna kumno ka shad , hynrei ha U Blei , Uba ai kyrngah ïa kiei kiei barben na ka bna ka jingsngewbha jong ngi .
translation.en: Charge them that are rich in this world , that they be not highminded , nor trust in uncertain riches , but in the living God , who giveth us richly all things to enjoy ;

translation.kha: lada ka dei katba lam ïongjngum lane kaba lam met , ka dei ka jingbthuh kaba pur bad dien ban leit pyn-i ïa ka ha u lyngkhuh .
translation.en: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment , or in the skin , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in any thing of skin  ; it is a plague of leprosy , and shall be shewed unto the priest :

translation.kha: Ka hukum ba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi kam dei kaba eh ban sngewthuh Lane kaba sha ngai ka bor jong phi .
translation.en: For this commandment which I command thee this day , it is not hidden from thee , neither is it far off .

translation.kha: Kum u Dabid u la ai hukum ïa u Joab , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jongnga u : Khie leit mala ki pynrangbah pynïaidkam jrong phi ha kylleng ki jait Israel na kawei ka tduh jongno ka ri sha khwai patan , bad ñiew ïa ki briew . Nga kwah ban tip ki don haduh katno .
translation.en: For the king said to Joab the captain of the host , which was with him , Go now through all the tribes of Israel , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , and number ye the people , that I may know the number of the people .

translation.kha: Pynban , mynta , phi dei pun map ïa u bad ban pynshlur ïa u , khnai ban ïada ïa u na kaba sngewsih eh kat ban da kyntait noh shisyndon ïa u .
translation.en: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him , and comfort him , lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow .
And he said , The God of our fathers hath chosen thee , that thou shouldest know his will , and see that Just One , and shouldest hear the voice of his mouth .
translation.kha: U la ong , ‘ U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la jied ïa me ban tip ïa ka mon jong u , bad ban ïohi ïa U Shakri bahok jong u , bad ban ïohsngew ïa u ba u kren ha ka sur jong u hi .

Pynban , phi la wan phai bad phi bam phi theh ha ka jakarieh ha kaba u la khang ïa phi ban bam baneh dih . Namar kane yn sa pynïap ïa phi , bad ïa ka met jongngi phi yn ym tep ha ka jingtep ki kper tymmen jong phi .
translation.en: But camest back , and hast eaten bread and drunk water in the place , of the which the  Lord  did say to thee , Eat no bread , and drink no water  ; thy carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of thy fathers .

translation.kha: Nangta ka ïingbishar ba kynja bneng kan shong bishar , kun knieh noh ïa ka bor jong u bad pynjot thiaw ïa u .
translation.en: But the judgment shall sit , and they shall take away his dominion , to consume and to destroy it unto the end .
For the  Lord  knoweth the way of the righteous : but the way of the ungodly shall perish .
translation.kha: Ïa kiba hok la ïalam lynti bad ïada da U  Trai  , hynrei kiba sniew ki don ha ka lynti sha ka jingjot jong ki .
Te kan long ka kam kaba rieh . Bad U Kpa jong phira , uba ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh ha katba rieh , un ainong ïa phi .
translation.en: That thine alms may be in secret : and thy Father which seeth in secret himself shall reward thee openly .

And Gehazi passed on before them , and laid the staff upon the face of the child  ; but there was neither voice , nor hearing . Wherefore he went again to meet him , and told him , saying , The child is not awaked .
translation.kha: U Gehasi u la nang leit sha khmat , bad u buh ïa u diengduh jong u Elisha halor u khynnah , hynrei ym don jingsawa ei ei lane kano kano ka dak ba don jingim . Kumta u la leit phai ban ïashem ïa u Elisha bad u ong ,  U khynnah um shym kyndit .

Te u lyngkdong u la ai ka ïa u Paul ban kren , u Peor u la jong , Nga tip ba me la long u nongbishar halor kane ka jaitbynriew la bun snem , bad kumta da kaba sngewbha nga ïasaid da ïa lade ha iitkhmat jong me .
translation.en: Then Paul , after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak , answered , Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation , I do the more cheerfully answer for myself :

translation.kha: Kata ka khynnah sharati ka la ïohi ïa u hangta bad ka la sdang pun ong biang kumjuh ha kiba ïa-ïeng hangta , U long uwei na ki !
translation.en: And a maid saw him again , and began to say to them that stood by , This is one of them .

When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate , as thou art in the way , give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him  ; lest he hale thee to the judge , and the judge deliver thee to the officer , and the officer cast thee into prison .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u wallam ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa phi bad rah ïa phi sha ka ïingbishar , to leh ïa kaba bha tam ban ïapynbeit ïa ka jingïakajia bad u ha shuwa ba phin poi sha ka ïingbishar . Lada phim leh kumta , un tan ïa phi ha khmat u nongbishar , u ban aiti ïa phi ha ki nongap phira , bad ïa phi yn buh ha ka byndi .
nabar u Ïoannis u la ïathuh ïa baroh kaban u la ïohi . Kana ka long ka jingïateh jong u sanphew ka khubor na U Blei bad ka jingshisha ba la pynpaw da U Jisu Kherith .
translation.en: Who bare record of the word of God , and of the testimony of Jesus Christ , and of all things that he saw .
But as they sailed he fell asleep : and there came down a storm of wind on the lake  ; and they were filled with water , and were in jeopardy .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang leit ha ka lieng , U Jisu u la ïohthiah . Kynsan ka lyer kaba jur ka la beh halor ka duriaw , bad ka lieng ka la sdang ban dap da ka um , ba kumta baroh ki la don ha ka jingma kaba khraw .
Nangta , sa hynñiew tylli kiwei pat ki kop kew ki la Shitlish , kiba rahah bad ba la pyntyrkhong da ka lyer ri shyngkub , bad ki kop kew kiba raikhoh ki la nguid noh ïa kiba met .
translation.en: And , behold , seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them .

translation.kha: U Jobab bad la ka longïing longsem ki la ïathmu na Bethel , mala haba ki la jan poi ha Ephrath , ka por ka la poi ba ka Rakhel kan kham khun , mala ka la ei ha ka jingsuh kha kaba shitom .
translation.en: And they journeyed from Beth–el  ; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath : and Rachel travailed , and she had hard labour .
Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite , Wherefore goest thou also with us ? return to thy place , and abide with the king : for thou art a stranger , and also an exile .
translation.kha: bad u syiem u ong ha u Ittai , u nongïalam jong ki ,  Balei phi ïaleit bad ngi ? Khie leit phai noh bad sah bad u syiem thymmai . Phi dei u nongwei , u nongphetwir na la ka jong ka ri .
Nga tip shuh katno phi long uba mutlop bad kiba ïakhleh pyrshah . Phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Tiras mynba ar dang im , Bad ynda nga la ïap lei lei , phin nang kham ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: For I know thy rebellion , and thy stiff neck : behold , while I am yet alive with you this day , ye have been rebellious against the  Lord   ; and how much more after my death ?

translation.kha: U Isaïah u la ong ïa kane namar u la Iohi ïa ka baburom U Jisu bad u la kren Shaphang jong u .
translation.en: These things said Esaias , when he saw his glory , and spake of him .

translation.kha: Naba ibha I long ha U Khrist Jisu , ka jingotsher lane ka jingbymdon jong ka kam don satia kano kano ka jingïapher ; kaei kaba kongsan ka long ka jingngeit kaba trei da ka jingibieit .
translation.en: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing , nor uncircumcision ; but faith which worketh by love .
They shall be burnt with hunger , and devoured with burning heat , and with bitter destruction : I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them , with the poison of serpents of the dust .
translation.kha: Kin ïap na ka jingthngan bad ka jingpang shit ; kin ïap na ki jingpang kiba ishyrkhei . Te ngan phah ki mradkhlaw ban kynrup ïa ki , bad ki bseiñ kiba don bih ban puh ïa ki .
kino ne hok ban jingïathoh ïa ki briew jong nga malu ba shim kabu ïa kiba duk . Ma nga U Nongsynshar U Trai Badonbor baroh nga la klun .
translation.en: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces , and grind the faces of the poor ? saith the Lord  God  of hosts .
And they said , We saw certainly that the  Lord  was with thee : and we said , Let there be now an oath betwixt us , even betwixt us and thee , and let us make a covenant with thee  ;
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Mynta ngi tip ba U  Trai  u don bad phi , bad ngi pyrkhat ba ka dei ban don ka jingïateh kular badonburom hapdeng jong ngi .

translation.en: For his princes were at Zoan , and his ambassadors came to Hanes .
translation.kha: Wat la ki nongkit  tiensyiem jong ki , ki la lah poi lypa ha ki nongbah ka Ijipt , ka Soan bad ka Hanes ,

translation.en: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen : for the Lord  God  shall slay thee , and call his servants by another name :
translation.kha: Ki briew ba la jied jong nga kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong phi kum ka jingtim . Ma nga , U  Trai  nongsynshar ngan pynïap ïa phi . Hynrei ngan ai ka kyrteng bathymmai ha kito kiba kohnguh ïa nga .

translation.en: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love  ; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends .
translation.kha: Lada phi kwah ba ki briew kin sngewtynnat ïa phi , to map ïa ki haba ki kum leh bakla ïa phi . To kynmaw ba ki jingbakla ki lah ban pynpra ïa ka jingïadei paralok .

translation.en: And Saul said , Draw ye near hither , all the chief of the people : and know and see wherein this sin hath been this day .
translation.kha: Te u Saul u ong ha ki nongïalam jong u paidbah ,  Ale hangne bad wad ka pop aïu la leh ha kane ka sngi .
Nangta u la kur sha la ki synran bad u la ong , Ha khmih ! Hangne ki long ka kmie dara ki na shynrang jyllang nga !
translation.en: And he stretched forth his hand toward his disciples , and said ,  Behold my mother and my brethren !
I will go in the strength of the Lord  God  : I will make mention of thy righteousness , even of thine only .
translation.kha: Ngan ïaroh ïa ka bor jong me , A  Trai  U Nongsynshar ; ngan pynbna ïa ka jingbha jong me , tang ka jong me hi .
bad ki Israel kim lah leh ei ei pyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: And Israel was greatly impoverished because of the Midianites  ; and the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord .
So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners , and the Ethiopians captives , young and old , naked and barefoot , even with their buttocks uncovered , to the shame of Egypt .
translation.kha: U patsha jong ka Assyria un ïalam lyngkhuit ïa ki koidi kiba u la kem na kito ki ar tylli ki ri . Kiba samla bad kiba tymmen , kin ïaid da ka kjat suda bad lyngkhuit , bad ki rain jong ki ba khlem tap , kaba wanrah ka jinglehrain halor ka Ijipt .

translation.en: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal , and said unto him , and to the men of Israel , We be come from a far country : now therefore make ye a league with us .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit sha ka jaka shong dara ha Gilgal , bad ki ong ha u Joshua bad ha ki Israel ,  Ngi la wan na ka ri kaba jngai . Ngi kwah ïa phi ban ïateh lok bad ngi .
Shisyndon ki la lynñiar , Me khwai aïu bad ngi , me U Khun jong U Blei ? Hato me la waiñ ban pynshitom ïa ngi ha shu ka por kaba dei ?
translation.en: And , behold , they cried out , saying , What have we to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of God ? art thou come hither to torment us before the time ?

translation.kha: U ïam rangbah rangsan hangta haduh ba wir ki nong Ijipt ki jingïashoh , bad la leit rah ïa ka shukor sha ka jingmihsnam .
translation.en: And he wept aloud : and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard .
Issachar , Zebulun , and Benjamin ,
translation.kha: U Issakhar , U Sebulun , U Benjamin ,
Phim ia myntri mo ka ing ka sem kan bha lada u tnat u synrum ia ka tnga da ka jingsngewlem kumba u kwah ba ki Ïwei ruh Kin leh kumta ia u ?
translation.en: Don’t you agree that any family will benefit if the husband treats his wife with concern , as he himself would want to be treated ?
These are the three sons of Noah : and of them was the whole earth overspread .
translation.kha: Kine lai ngut ki khun u Noah ki long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei .

Naba nga ïong ïa phi ba ka jingim jong ka jingrai U Khrist ka la long na ka bynta ki Jiw , ba-bang pyn-i ba U Blei u long uba ïania , ban pynlong ïa ki kular jong u ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ban urlong shisha ,
translation.en: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God , to confirm the promises made unto the fathers :
And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law , and to Israel for an everlasting covenant ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ka jutang bad u Jakob , ka jutang ka ban neh junom .

namar ki briew jong nga ki la leh ar tylli ki pop : Ki la peiñ noh na ar , ka umpohliew ki um basngur ; bun ki la tih ki khak pynlang um , ki Jaka pynlang um kiba la pdeng ki bym lah ban pynkad ïa ka um .
translation.en: For my people have committed two evils  ; they have forsaken me the fountain of living waters , and hewed them out cisterns , broken cisterns , that can hold no water .

In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit , and said ,  I thank thee , O Father , Lord of heaven and earth , that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent , and hast revealed them unto babes : even so , Father  ; for so it seemed good in thy sight .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la pyndap ïa U Jisu da ka jingkmen da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad u la ong ,  Ko Kpa , U Trai jong ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ! Nga ainguh ïa me namar ba me la pyn-i ha ki bymnang bymstad ïa kaei kaba me la buhrieh na kiba stad bad kiba shemphang . Ho-oid , ko Kpa , kane ka la long kumno me la kwah ïa ka ba kan jia .
Me la pynlong ïa ngi ka kynton jakhlia jong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people .

translation.kha: U sakhi u pyllait im ïa ki biria haba u jong ïa kaba shisha ; haba u ong ïa kaba shukor , u shetkylla ïa ki briew .
translation.en: A true witness delivereth souls : but a deceitful witness speaketh lies .

translation.kha: ngan sa lumlang ïa ki briew na bhor ki ri na kiba la la pynsakma ïa ki ha ka jingtur pynlang ka jingbitar shla jong nga , bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha kñia ka dik malu shah ïa ki ban shong ban sah hangne ha ka jingthngan .
translation.en: Behold , I will gather them out of all countries , whither I have driven them in mine anger , and in my fury , and in great wrath  ; and I will bring them again unto this place , and I will cause them to dwell safely :

translation.kha: Une u maw-it u longsyiem uba kordor eh ïa phi kiba ngeit ; hynrei ha kito ki bymngeit : U maw ïa uba ki nongbatai ki la kyntait kum u bymmyntoi u la kylla long uba donkam Tam na barhem .
translation.en: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious : but unto them which be disobedient , the stone which the builders disallowed , the same is made the head of the corner ,
How did their glasses get swapped ? Even they themselves didn't understand it !
translation.kha: Kumno ki iitkhmat jongki ki shah kylliang ? Maki ruh kim sngewthuh iakata .
Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban ba-im ïa kano kano ka sim ne mrad kaba la ïap hi lane kaba la shah pynïap ha uwei pat u mrad .
translation.en: The priests shall not eat of any thing that is dead of itself , or torn , whether it be fowl or beast .

translation.kha: bad ki la ong , Phi dei ban ong ba ki synran jong u ki la wan mynhyndai bad ki la tuh ïa ka kun jong u katba phi ding ïohthiah .
translation.en: Saying , Say ye , His disciples came by night , and stole him away while we slept .
A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him : neither will he go unto the wise .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba meng kim sngewtynnat ban shah sneng ; kim ju pan ïa ki jingai jingmut na kito kiba kham stad .

translation.en: And he was there in the wilderness forty days , tempted of Satan  ; and was with the wild beasts  ; and the angels ministered unto him .
translation.kha: ha kaba u la shong hangta sawphew sngi , da kaba shah pynshoi ha u Soitan . Ki mradkhlaw ki la don ruh hangta , hynrei ki angel ki la wan bad ïarap ïa u .
Ka Hannah ka ong ha u , Ko kynrad ! Phibi dang kynmaw mo ïa nga ? Nga dei kato ka briew naba phi ïohi kaba ïeng hangne kaba ïadei ha U Trai .
translation.en: And she said , Oh my lord , as thy soul liveth , my lord , I am the woman that stood by thee here , praying unto the  Lord .

And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the  Lord  , they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets , and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals , to praise the  Lord  , after the ordinance of David king of Israel .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah ki la sdang ban tei ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ , ki lyngdoh ha ki jingriam jong ki , ki ïeng ha la ki jaka bad ki turoi ha ki kti jong ki , bad ki Lebi jong ka kur Asaph ki ïeng hangta ryngkat bad ki shakuriaw . Ki ïaroh ïa U  Trai  kat kum ki jingbthah ba la ai pateng naduh ka por u syiem Dabid .
Ban ïoh jingbam kaba biang ban im , ngi la leit khrong sha Ijipt nabar Assyria .
translation.en: We have given the hand to the Egyptians , and to the Assyrians , to be satisfied with bread .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ïong , Ngam shah ïa ki jaitbynriew ba kin ïor ïa ka burom jong nga ; bad ngan pynpaw ha ki kumno nga pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong nga ban pyndep ïa ki jingrai bahok jong nga .
translation.en: And I will set my glory among the heathen , and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed , and my hand that I have laid upon them .

Up , sanctify the people , and say , Sanctify yourselves against to morrow : for thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee , O Israel : thou canst not stand before thine enemies , until ye take away the accursed thing from among you .
translation.kha: Ïeng joit ! Pynkhuid ïa u paidbah bad pynkhreh ban wan ha khmat jong nga . Bthah ïa ki ban long kiba la kloi lashai ka sngi , namar ma nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel nga don kane ban ong : ‘ Israel , phi don ha ki jingdon jingem jong phi katto katne kiba nga la hukum ïa phi ban pynjot ! Phim lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong phi tad haduh ba phin da lait na kine kiei kiei !’
Ma nga , u Tertios , uba thoh ïa kane ka shithi , nga phah ïa phi ki jingbthei parabangeit .
translation.en: I Tertius , who wrote this epistle , salute you in the Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki paid Israel ki ong ha U Trai , Ngi la ar pop . Leh ïa ngi katba me manna ; hynrei sngewbha , pyrsad im ïa ngi ha kane ka sngi .
translation.en: And the children of Israel said unto the  Lord  , We have sinned : do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee  ; deliver us only , we pray thee , this day .
Vex the Midianites , and smite them :
translation.kha: Tur ïaleh ïa ki Midian bad pynjot thiaw ïa ki ,

translation.en: And the lords of the Philistines came up unto her , and said unto her , Entice him , and see wherein his great strength lieth , and by what means we may prevail against him , that we may bind him to afflict him : and we will give thee every one of us eleven hundred pieces of silver .
translation.kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki leit sha ka bad ki ong ,  Khroh ïa u Samson ban ïathuh ha pha balei ba u long uba khlaiñbor bad kumno ngin lah ban jop ïa u , khum ïa u bad pynlong ba un ym lah leh ei ei shuh . Uwei pa uwei na ngi un ai ïa pha mar shihajar shispah tylli ki sbai rupa .
Ka jingap ka ïoh na ka pop ïa ka bor ban pynmong , bad ka pop ka ïoh ïa ka bor jong ka na ka Hukum .
translation.en: The sting of death is sin ; and the strength of sin is the law .

translation.kha: Pyndonkam ïa ka , ban pynsleh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon ryngkat jong nga , ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ,
translation.en: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith , and the ark of the testimony ,
And Jacob said unto them , My brethren , whence be ye ? And they said , Of Haran are we .
translation.kha: U Jakob u kylli ïa ki nongap langbrot ,  Ko paralok , phi dei kiba na-ei ?   Na Haran ,  ki jubab .

translation.en: For the priesthood being changed , there is made of necessity a change also of the law .
translation.kha: Namar haba ka jinglong lyngdoh ka la kylla , ka dei ban don ruh ka jingkylla ha ka hukum .

translation.en: They sacrificed unto devils , not to God  ; to gods whom they knew not , to new gods that came newly up , whom your fathers feared not .
translation.kha: Ki kñia ha ki blei ki bym dei shisha ki blei , ha ki blei thymmai kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ki kim ju tip , ki blei kiba ki Israel kim ju kohnguh .
Ïa ka ri yn pynbynta mar katjuh ha ki hynñiew bynta ; ka jait Judah kan sah ha la ka jaka shaphang shathie , dara ka jait Joseph ha la ka jaka shaphang shatei .
translation.en: And they shall divide it into seven parts : Judah shall abide in their coast on the south , and the house of Joseph shall abide in their coasts on the north .

translation.kha: Kata ka nemsniew ha Kanaan ka la nang jur nang jubor ,
translation.en: And the famine was sore in the land .

translation.en: She is hardened against her young ones , as though they were not hers : her labour is in vain without fear  ;

translation.en: Remember them , O my God , because they have defiled the priesthood , and the covenant of the priesthood , and of the Levites .
And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron : ( now the name of Hebron before was Kirjath–arba : ) and they slew Sheshai , and Ahiman , and Talmai .
translation.kha: Ki la ïaid pyrshah ïa ki Kanaan kiba shong basah ha ka nongbah Hebron , ïa kaba la ju khot ka Kiriath Arba . Hangta ki la jop ïa ki kur jong u Sheshai , u Ahiman bad u Talmai .
Nangno ki la sien sha ka jaka sheng dara ha Gilo , bad ki ainong ha u Joshua bad ha ki Israel , Ngi la wan na ka ri kaba jngai . Ngi kwah ïa phi ban ïateh lok bad ngi .
translation.en: And they went to Joshua unto the camp at Gilgal , and said unto him , and to the men of Israel , We be come from a far country : now therefore make ye a league with us .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem u la bat synshar ïa nga , malade u angel u la ramhah ïa nga sha ka ri shyiap . translation.en: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness : and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast , full of names of blasphemy , having seven heads and ten horns .

translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba la ïohi ïa U Blei mynno mynno ruh , hynrei , lada ngi ïa-ieit iwei ïa wai pat , U Blei u im hapoh jong ngi , bad ïa ka jingieit jong u la pynjanai noh ha ngi .
translation.en: No man hath seen God at any time . If we love one another , God dwelleth in us , and his love is perfected in us .
Now is the end come upon thee , and I will send mine anger upon thee , and will judge thee according to thy ways , and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , kaba kut ka la wan . Phan sa sngew ïa ka jingbitar jong nga ; naba ngan bishar ïa pha ïa kaei kaba pha la leh . Ngan pynshitom ïa pha namar ki kam ijli jong pha baroh .

translation.en: And I took my concubine , and cut her in pieces , and sent her throughout all the country of the inheritance of Israel : for they have committed lewdness and folly in Israel .
translation.kha: Nga shim ïa ka met jong ka , nga ot lyngkhot ïa ka , bad nga phah ïa kawei ka lyngkhot sha kawei pa kawei ka jait Israel . Kine ki briew ki la leh ïa ka kam kaba bymman bad ba-ijli hapdeng jong ngi .
Kane ka dei ka khyrdop jong U Trai ; tang kiba hok ki haka ban snar shapoh .
translation.en: This gate of the  Lord  , into which the righteous shall enter .
Who is he that will plead with me ? for now , if I hold my tongue , I shall give up the ghost .
translation.kha: Hato me wan ban kynnoh ïa nga , A Blei ? Lada me leh kumta , nga kloi ban shu sngap jar bad ïap noh .

Nongthaw u Gideon u leit sha ki rangbah jong ka Sukkoth bad u ong , Kynmaw haba phi la kyntait ban ïarap ïa nga ? Phi ong ba phim lah ban ai jingbam ei ei ïa ki shipai jong na kiba la thait ïan namar ba ngam pat shym la ïohkem ïa u Sebah bad u Salmunna . Te , kine hangne !

translation.en: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel : there is the whoredom of Ephraim , Israel is defiled .

translation.en: And he overtook them , and he spake unto them these same words .
translation.kha: Ynda uta u shakri u la lap ïa ki , u la kren ha ki ïa kijuh ki ktien .

translation.en: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease : for I was but a little displeased , and they helped forward the affliction .
translation.kha: bad nga bitar shikatdei eh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba sngewkmen ïa ka jingjar jar bad ka jingsuk . Namar katba nga dang bat ïa ka jingbitar jong nga pyrshah ïa ki briew jong nga , kito ki jaitbynriew ki la kham pynsniew ïa ki jingshitom jong ki briew jong nga .
( Pynban , Ka Synduk ka Jutang ka don ha Jerusalem , la bah ïa ka ha ka ïingjaiñ kaba u syiem Dabid u la pynïeng mynhynne u wanrah ïa Ka Synduk na Kiriath Jearim . )
translation.en: But the ark of God had David brought up from Kirjath–jearim to the place which David had prepared for it : for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem .

Then the five men departed , and came to Laish , and saw the people that were therein , how they dwelt careless , after the manner of the Zidonians , quiet and secure  ; and there was no magistrate in the land , that might put them to shame in any thing  ; and they were far from the Zidonians , and had no business with any man .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki rangbah san ngut ki mihnoh bad ki leit sha ka shnong Laish . Ki ïohi kumno ki briew hangta ki ïashong shngain , kumba long ki nong Sidon . Ki long kiba ïashongsuk bad ki briew kiba jar jar , kim don jingïania badno badno ; ki don lut kat kaba ki donkam . Ki shong kham jngai na ki nong Sidon bad kim pynïadei bad kiwei ki briew .
U Blei u ong ha u , Ka kirteng jngai me ka dei u Jakob , hynrei naduh mynta , kan long ei U Israel . Kumta U Blei u la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Jesreel .
translation.en: And God said unto him , Thy name is Jacob : thy name shall not be called any more Jacob , but Israel shall be thy name : and he called his name Israel .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiad Rehoboam u phah ïa u Adoniram , uba khmih ïa ki nongphetwir ba la shu pynbor , ban leit sha ki Israel , hynne ki la lynthem mawthew ïa u haw ba un da ïap . Ha Kanah u Rehoboam u ktieh pynstet ha la ka kali ïapom bad u phet shuh Jerusalem .
translation.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute  ; and the children of Israel stoned him with stones , that he died . But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Haba u Abram u la wan pha na ka jingjop ïa u Kedemoth bad ïa wir kiwei pat ki syiem , u syiem jong ka Sodom u leit ban ïadem ïa u ha ka them Shabeh ( ïa kaba la khot hima ka The u Syiem ) .
translation.en: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer , and of the kings that were with him , at the valley of Shaveh , which is the king s dale .

translation.kha: Phan sa sngew ïa ka jingshyrkhei ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla jong nga haduh ba ngan da sngewhun . Haba kane baroh ka jia , phan sa sngewthuh ba ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren-ïa ïa pha namar nga la bitar shla ïa ka jingbymïaineh jong pha .
translation.en: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished , and I will cause my fury to rest upon them , and I will be comforted : and they shall know that I the  Lord  have spoken it in my zeal , when I have accomplished my fury in them .

translation.kha: Kumta u Gideon u ïai-ong , To , kam lei lat ! Haba U thri u ai ïa u Sebah bad ïa u Salmunna ha de , ngan shoh ïa phi da ki shuh bad da ki shiah buid na ka ri shyiap !
translation.en: And Gideon said , Therefore when the  Lord  hath delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into mine hand , then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers .
And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you , to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year . And he did as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba dei ban rakhe pateng la pateng . Ïa kane ka rukom lehniam dei ban leh shisien shisnem ban pynkhuid ïa ki Israel na ki pop jong ki . Kumta u Moses u leh , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u .

Haba nga la pyndep ïa kane ka kam bad ba nga la dup aiti shwa ki ïa barben ka pisa ïa kaba la dep pynmihpat na ka beit jong ki , ngan sa mih ban leit shaei Spain bad wanpaw khmih artet ïa phi ha ka jingleit lyngki shata .
translation.en: When therefore I have performed this , and have sealed to them this fruit , I will come by you into Spain .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Kam dei na ka bynta jong nga ba kano ka sur ka la kren , hynrei na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said ,  This voice came not because of me , but for your sakes .
Seek the  Lord  and his strength , seek his face continually .
translation.kha: Leit sha U  Trai  na ka bynta ka jingïarap , bad mane khlem kut .
Na u Baal , u apostol U Khrist Josis da ka mon U Blei , ha uba la phah pynbna ïa ka jingriam ba la kular Kaba ngi don ha U Kynther Jehu —
translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus ,
For there is one God , and one mediator between God and men , the man Christ Jesus ;
translation.kha: Naba don tang uwei U Blei , bad don uwei uba pynwan lang ïa U Blei bad ïa u khunbynriew , U Khrist Jisu uba long ruh u briew , uba la aiti ïa lade ban siewspah ïa ki briew baroh .
Shahshkor katba nga tang ïasaid ïa ka kam jong nga .
translation.en: Hear now my reasoning , and hearken to the pleadings of my lips .
The gates of the rivers shall be opened , and the palace shall be dissolved .
translation.kha: Ki khyrdop hapoh ka wah ki bthei ; ïa ka ïingsyiem la pyndap da ka jingsngewtriem .

Ka nang nam nang ngam ha ka jinglong jingjakhlia jrong ka . Ka ïapmat ïa ki durbriew jong ki lapbah shipa ka Babilonia ba la ohdur ha ka kynroh bad ba la airong da ka rong saw batynrai , lem pynlang ki pynpoi ha ki syngkai jong ki bad ki jaiñspong ba-beit ha ki khlieh jong ki .
translation.en: Girded with girdles upon their loins , exceeding in dyed attire upon their heads , all of them princes to look to , after the manner of the Babylonians of Chaldea , the land of their nativity :

translation.kha: Bad uno Uno uba pyndeng sngewbha ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa uwei uba kum une u khynnah , u pynong ïa nga .
translation.en: And whoso shall receive one such little child in my name receiveth me .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , U Jisu u la ong ha ki , bad nga pynthikna ïa phi ba uno Un uba iehnoh ïa ka ïing lane ïa ka tngaw lane ïa ki hynmen ki para litar ïa ki kmie ki kpa lane ïa ki khwan na ka bynta ka Hima U Blei
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , There is no man that hath left house , or parents , or brethren , or wife , or children , for the kingdom of God s sake ,

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki paid Israel ki la kurim sawkyr-ang ïa nga da ki jingtriem bad jingshukor , bad ki paid Judah ki Dang ïai ïaleh pynshisha ïa nga , U Blei baïaineh bad uba khwai .
translation.en: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies , and the house of Israel with deceit : but Judah yet ruleth with God , and is faithful with the saints .

translation.kha: Namar lada phi map ïa kiwei ïa ki jingpalat kiba ki la leh ïa phi , U Kpa jongnga phi uba ha bneng un map ruh ïa phi .
translation.en: For if ye forgive men their trespasses , your heavenly Father will also forgive you :

translation.kha: Namar u ïohi ïa kiba kut jong ka pyrthei , u ïohi ïa kiei ktien Baroh hapoh ka suiñbneng .
translation.en: For he looketh to the ends of the earth , and seeth under the whole heaven  ;
And love the uppermost rooms at feasts , and the chief seats in the synagogues ,
translation.kha: Ki ieit ïa ki jaka bakor tam ha ki jingkhawai bad ïa ki jaka shong ba la buh kyrpang ha ki synagog ;
Ki nongshun kulai ki kynha , ki khla-ka-wait ki thaba , ki ngam ki phalang ! ïa ki metïap la kynton saphriang , ki Mephaath bym don jingkheiñ — ki briew ki jynthut phalor jongki ki !
translation.en: The horseman lifteth up both the bright sword and the glittering spear : and there is a multitude of slain , and a great number of carcases  ; and there is none end of their corpses  ; they stumble upon their corpses :

translation.kha: Un jop ïa ki nongshun jong u ha Edom , Bad un pynlong ïa ka ri jong ki ka jingïohkynti jongno u , Katba ki Israel kin ïai jop .
translation.en: And Edom shall be a possession , Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies  ; and Israel shall do valiantly .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,
kato kat nud ki Pharisi bad ki Sebadaïah Ibbah la wan sha U Jisu! ki la kwah ban riam ïa u , kumta ki la kyrpad ïa u ban leh ïa ka kambah na ka bynta jong ki , ban pyn-at ba U Blei u la pdiang ïa u .
translation.en: The Pharisees also with the Sadducees came , and tempting desired him that he would shew them a sign from heaven .

translation.kha: Kumno ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong : Ym don uno uno uba dkhoh ,
translation.en: As it is written , There is none righteous , no , not one :

translation.kha: Ki don lai ki sakhi : U Mynsiem , ka um bad ka snam ; bad kine baroh lai ki ai ïa kajuh ka jingphaloh .
translation.en: And there are three that bear witness in earth , the Spirit , and the water , and the blood : and these three agree in one .
And have tasted the good word of God , and the powers of the world to come ,
translation.kha: ki la tip naba ki la ïohmad ba ka Ktien U Blei ka long kaba bha , bad ki la ïohmad ruh ïa ki bor jong ka por ka ban sa wan .
U Jehud u la phar ïa u Hirah u paralok jong u , ban leit lamler ïa ka blang , bad ban rim noh na ka kynthei ïa ki tiar kaba u la kular , hynrei u Hirah um shym lap ïa ka .
translation.en: And Judah sent the kid by the hand of his friend the Adullamite , to receive his pledge from the woman s hand : but he found her not .

translation.kha: Mynta ka sngaid phi la pynbna ba U Trai u long U balui jong phi ; phi la kular ban kohnguh ïa u , ban sumar ïa ki ïoh mala ki hukum jong u , bad banbeiñ kun ruh kat ïa kob u hukum .
translation.en: Thou hast avouched the  Lord  this day to be thy God , and to walk in his ways , and to keep his statutes , and his commandments , and his judgments , and to hearken unto his voice :

translation.kha: Halor ka tnum ka ni kaei kaei kaba i kum ka khet ; ba la shna da u mawkordor Sippor ; bad don bashong halor kata ka khet ba i kum u briew .
translation.en: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne , as the appearance of a sapphire stone : and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it .

translation.kha: Hynrei don U Blei ha bneng , suba pynpaw ïa ki jingmaïan . U la pyntip ïa u Syiem Kynrad kaei ka pun jia ha ka lawei . myntor ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingphohsniew , ka jingïohipaw kaba phi lah ïoh mynba phiah dang ïohthiah .
translation.en: But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets , and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days . Thy dream , and the visions of thy head upon thy bed , are these  ;
How oft is the candle of the wicked put out ! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them ! God distributeth sorrows in his anger .
translation.kha: Hato ïa ka jingshai jong u bymman la ju pynlip noh ? Hato uno uno na ki u ju ïakynduh ïa ka jingjot ? Hato U Blei u ju pynshitom ïa u bymman ha ka jingbitar

translation.en: But as for thee and thy servants , I know that ye will not yet fear the  Lord  God .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip ba ma phi bad ki rangbah synshar jong phi phim pat sheptieng ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And David said to Solomon , My son , as for me , it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the  Lord  my God :
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u ,  Ko khun jong nga , nga kwah ban tei ïa ka Templ ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong nga .

U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ïa kiei kiei barabor . Ym don batip U Khun u long uei mlien tang U Kpa , bad ym don batip U kper u long uei lait tang U ka malade pli ha kiba U Khun u jingdih ngab pynpei ïa U .
translation.en: All things are delivered to me of my Father : and no man knoweth who the Son is , but the Father  ; and who the Father is , but the Son , and he to whom the Son will reveal him .

translation.kha: kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingmane ïa ka jingim bymjukut . U Blei , u bym ju shukor , u la kular ïa ngi ïa kane ka jingim naduh jingmynjur ,
translation.en: In hope of eternal life , which God , that cannot lie , promised before the world began ;

translation.kha: Hangta u la shem ïa u briew uba kyrteng u Ainias , babha la pang ïapshiliang bad u bym shym la lah ban khie na ka jingthiah la phra snem .
translation.en: And there he found a certain man named Aeneas , which had kept his bed eight years , and was sick of the palsy .

translation.kha: Namarkata , namar ba nga long U blang uba im — kano ka long ka ktieh U Trai Nongsynshar — nabar pha la pyntngit ïa ka thalab jong nga da khie kiei Kiba basniew , ki kam ijli kiba pha la leh , kan kyntait ïa pha khlem na-ei .
translation.en: Wherefore , as I live , saith the Lord  God   ; Surely , because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things , and with all thine abominations , therefore will I also diminish thee  ; neither shall mine eye spare , neither will I have any pity .
And he did wash the inwards and the legs , and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar .
translation.kha: Nangta u sait ïa ki doh jem bad ïa ki kjat-dien bad u thang lang ïa ki ha ka duwan halor kita kiwei pat ki jingkñia ainguh thang .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when all Israel heard that Jeroboam was come again , that they sent and called him unto the congregation , and made him king over all Israel : there was none that followed the house of David , but the tribe of Judah only .
translation.kha: Haba ki paid Israel ki ïohsngew ba u Jeroboam u la wan phai na Ijipt , ki khot sngewbha ïa u sha ka jingïalang paidbah bad ki pynlong ïa u , u syiem ki Israel . Tang ka jait Judah kaba ïaisah ban ïaineh bad kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid .

translation.en: Thou hast heard , see all this  ; and will not ye declare it ? I have shewed thee new things from this time , even hidden things , and thou didst not know them .
translation.kha: Baroh kiba nga la ïathuh lypa , mynta ki la urlong ; phi hap ban pdiang ba ki jingïathuh lypa jong nga ki long kiba dei . Mynta ngan ong ïa phi ïa kiei kiei kiba thymmai ki ban wan , ki jingjia kiba ngam shym la pynpaw mynshuwa .
Mynba ki Israel ki la shong dara ha ka Them Akasia , ki ïabah ki la sdang ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki kynthei Moab kiba don hangta .
translation.en: And Israel abode in Shittim , and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab .

translation.kha: Ka dohnud maïan jong u kam ju don jingsheptieng , katba eh thab kum u mawtylliat .
translation.en: His heart is as firm as a stone  ; yea , as hard as a piece of the nether millstone .
And Paul chose Silas , and departed , being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God .
translation.kha: katba u Paul u la jied ïa u Silas bad u la leit noh , la aiti ïa ki da ki riewngeit ha ka jingïada jong ka jingaiei jong U Trai .
Lada u nongwei uba shong bad phi! u kylla riewspah , katba u para Israel u hylla duk bad u thaw mraw nong ïa lade ha uta u nongwei ne ha u dkhot ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee , and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor , and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee , or to the stock of the stranger s family :

translation.kha: Ki diengsoh Olib kin mih kyrhai ha ka ri jong phi , hynrei phin ym ïoh jingman , naba ki soh Olib kin hap khlem por .
translation.en: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts , but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil  ; for thine olive shall cast his fruit .

translation.kha: U la lah pynkhia ïa Kiba babe ki briew’ , bad baroh kito kaba pynpang ki la ïai kyntoit sha u khnang ba ïohktah ïa u .
translation.en: For he had healed many  ; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him , as many as had plagues .

translation.kha: Nga la noh ha phi ba at longkmie U Trai U Blei jong phi bad ba phim dei ban mane ïa ki blei jong ki Lemuel , ha ka ri jong ki ba phi ïashong mynta . Hynrei phim shym la shahshkor ïa nga .
translation.en: And I said unto you , I am the  Lord  your God  ; fear not the gods of the Amorites , in whose land ye dwell : but ye have not obeyed my voice .
And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead , he fell likewise upon his sword , and died with him .
translation.kha: Haba uta u samla u ïohi ba u Saul u la ïap , u ruh u rynsied ïa lade ha la ka waitlam bad u ïap lem bad u Saul .
To jaiñjot ïa U Trai , naba u long uba bha ; bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymsngewnguh .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Ka jingbishar thok kad long u sai-thew na ka boitha ka nongrim , bad ka jinglehhok kan lama u sai-sawar jong ka . U phla un sar ne ïa baroh ki jingshukor ha kiba phi shaniah , bad ki jingshlei kin pynjot ïa ki jingsngewbiang Jong phi .
translation.en: Judgment also will I lay to the line , and righteousness to the plummet : and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies , and the waters shall overflow the hiding place .
Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood , whether it be of fowl or of beast , in any of your dwellings .
translation.kha: Kam pher la hangno hangno ki Israel ki shong ki sah , kim dei da lei lei ban pyndonkam ïa ka snam jong ki sim ne ki mrad kum ka jingbam .

translation.en: Who needeth not daily , as those high priests , to offer up sacrifice , first for his own sins , and then for the people s : for this he did once , when he offered up himself .
translation.kha: Um long kum kiwei pat ki rangbah lyngdoh ; um da donkam ban da ai jingkñia man ka sngi na ka bynta ki pop jong u hi nyngkong ïa lade bad nangta na ka bynta ki pop jong ki briew . U ai kawei ka jingkñia , tang shisien hi , haba u la kñia noh ïa lade .
Un sa long wahbah khuid hawei ba ka sngi ka la sep , bad nongtuh u lah ban bam ïa kita ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang , kiba dei ka jingbam jong u .
translation.en: And when the sun is down , he shall be clean , and shall afterward eat of the holy things  ; because it is his food .

translation.kha: Phi sngewtynnat ba thaw ïa ki jingsngew , kumba u Dabid u la thaw , bad tei ïa ki ha ki duitara .
translation.en: That chant to the sound of the viol , and invent to themselves instruments of musick , like David  ;
I have raised up one from the north , and he shall come : from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name : and he shall come upon princes as upon mortar , and as the potter treadeth clay .
translation.kha: Nga la jied ïa u briew uba shong basah shaphang mihngi ; ngan wallam ïa u ban tur ïaleh na shaphang shatei . Un ïuh halor ki nongsynshar la kumba dei ka ktieh , kum u nongthaw khiew uba ïuh ïa ka dewbyrtha .
Lada ki ne sanphew ngut Kiba thok ha kata ka nongbah , hato men pynngat noh ïa ka nongbah borbah kawei ? Men ym pyllait ïa ka ba ki sahkynmaw ngut kin lait im ?
translation.en: Peradventure there be fifty righteous within the city : wilt thou also destroy and not spare the place for the fifty righteous that are therein ?
Put on therefore , as the elect of God , holy and beloved , bowels of mercies , kindness , humbleness of mind , meekness , longsuffering ;
translation.kha: Kumta te , dei ban kup ïa lade , naba phi long ki briew jong U Blei ; u la ieit bad jied ïa phi na ka bynta jong u hi , da ka jingsngewsynei , ka jingbhasbun , ka jingsngewrit , ka jingjemnud , bad ka jingïaishah .
Ka jingpynjot kaba la wan ha ki briew jong nga ka wallam ka jingsngew shyrkhei ; ki kmie ibha ieit ki shet ïa la ki khunlung ban long jingbam .
translation.en: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children : they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people .

translation.kha: Bad wat la u ieit eh ïa ka Kanah , u ai ïa ka tang shiah bynta namar ba U Trai u la pynlyngki ïa ka .
translation.en: But unto Hannah he gave a worthy portion  ; for he loved Hannah : but the  Lord  had shut up her womb .
Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah , I prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la ai ïa ka dulir thied jaka ha u Barukh , nga la duwai ,

To ai ba ki jaitbynriew kin long ki shakri jong me , bad ki briew kin dem kherub ha khmat jongu me . To men synshar halor ki kur ki jait jong me baroh , bad to ai ba ki khunlung ki ksiew ka kmie jong me ktang dem khrup ha khmat jong me . Ai ba kito kiba tim ïa me kin long naba la tim bad ai ba kito kiba me kyrkhu kin long kiba la kyrkhu .
translation.en: Let people serve thee , and nations bow down to thee : be lord over thy brethren , and let thy mother s sons bow down to thee : cursed be every one that curseth thee , and blessed be he that blesseth thee .
Yet if any man suffer as a Christian , let him not be ashamed  ; but let him glorify God on this behalf .
translation.kha: Pynban , lada phi shahshitom namar ba phi long u Khristan , wat sngewlehrain ïa kata , hynrei ainguh ïa U Blei ba phi kup ïa ka kyrteng U Khrist .

translation.en: So Hanameel mine uncle s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the  Lord  , and said unto me , Buy my field , I pray thee , that is in Anathoth , which is in the country of Benjamin : for the right of inheritance is thine , and the redemption is thine  ; buy it for thyself . Then I knew that this was the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te kumba U  Trai  u la ong , u Hanamel u la wan sha nga hangta ha ka phyllaw bad u la ong ïa nga ba ngan thied ïa ka lyngkha . Kumta nga sngewthuh ba U  Trai  u la kren shisha ha nga .
A Trai , U Blei! jong im , me la jubab ïa la ki briew ; me la pynkhaw-eit ïa ki ba me long U Blei uba map ei , wat la me pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop jong ki .
translation.en: Thou answeredst them , O  Lord  our God : thou wast a God that forgavest them , though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions .
So when they had rowed about five and twenty or thirty furlongs , they see Jesus walking on the sea , and drawing nigh unto the ship : and they were afraid .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la king kumba san ne hynriew kilomitar haba ki la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u ïaid halor ka um , u la nang wan sha jan ka lieng , bad ki la sngewtriem .
Kumta la wan ïalam biang ïa u Moses bad u Aaron sha u Pharaoh , malade u ainong ha ki , Phi lah ban leit mala mane ïa U Trai U Blei jngai Phi . Hynrei pynthikna mynno ban leit ?
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh : and he said unto them , Go , serve the  Lord  your God : but who are they that shall go ?
And that ye put on the new man , which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness .
translation.kha: bad phi dei ban kup ïa u briew uba thymmai ïa uba la thaw ha ka dur U Blei kaba pynpaw ïa lade ha ka jingim kaba shisha kaba long kaba beit bad kaba khuid .
Nangta ki rangbah ka Judith ki la wan sha Hesron bad ki la pynsleh ïa u Dabid kumto u syiem ka Judah . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ba ki briew ka Jabesh ha Gilead ki la tep ïa u Samuel ,
translation.en: And the men of Judah came , and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah . And they told David , saying , That the men of Jabesh–gilead were they that buried Saul .

translation.kha: Hynrei Lada u briew u shun ïa la u paramarjan bad u iap ïa u , bad u Saw pynlang pynmynsaw ïa u ïaheh ba un da ïap , bun nangta u phet sha kamai na kita ki shnong don ïoh jingïada ,
translation.en: But if any man hate his neighbour , and lie in wait for him , and rise up against him , and smite him mortally that he die , and fleeth into one of these cities :

translation.kha: Ka Long kaba kham bha ban long u riewmadan uba trei ban ïoh bam ban kaba leh mynleh kum uba khraw hynrei bad ka shahthngan .
translation.en: He that is despised , and hath a servant , is better than he that honoureth himself , and lacketh bread .

translation.kha: Haba pa’ pynïap ïa u mutdur ban pynlong ka jingtah ïasyllok , bud beit ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih Ibbah nga la ai ha phi , bad ngan pdiang ïa kata ka jingainguh .
translation.en: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the  Lord  , ye shall offer it at your own will .

translation.kha: Ka mon jong phi ban im Kan kyrshan ïa phi ibha phi pang , hynrei ïada phi duh ïa ka , ka jingmane jong Phi kaba sah ka la bai nong .
translation.en: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity  ; but a wounded spirit who can bear ?

translation.kha: U Trei u ong , ‘ Haba ki hynñiewphew sner jong ka Babilonia ki la kut , ngan pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewkhia jong nga na ka bynta jong Phi bun bat ïa ka kulmar jong nga banbeiñ wallam pat ïa phi sha ïng .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , That after seventy years be accomplished at Babylon I will visit you , and perform my good word toward you , in causing you to return to this place .
Watch therefore : for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come .
translation.kha: To sumar , te , namar ba phim tip ha kano ka sngi ba U Trai jong phi un wan .
To long shlur ! Mynta pa ïohsngew ïa kijuh ki kynti ba ki nongshetkylla ki la kren ha ka jer ba la buh nongrim na ka bynta don tei pat ïa ka Templ jong nga .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Let your hands be strong , ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets , which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the  Lord  of hosts was laid , that the temple might be built .

translation.kha: Ki maji lad pha ki long na ki nongbah ka shisyndon bad Arbad . Ki rangbah batbit jong pha hi ki la long ki maji .
translation.en: The inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad were thy mariners : thy wise men , O Tyre , that were in thee , were thy pilots .

translation.kha: Em! Kaei kaba nga ïa-ong ka longkmie ba ïa kaei kaba la kñia ha ki duwan jong ki bymngeit ka long kaba la kñia sha ki ksuid , ym sha U Blei . Bad nam kwah ïa phi ban long kiba ïatei lem bad ki ksuid .
translation.en: But I say , that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice , they sacrifice to devils , and not to God : and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils .
At midday , O king , I saw in the way a light from heaven , above the brightness of the sun , shining round about me and them which journeyed with me .
translation.kha: Ka dei ha ka lynti ha ka por shiteng sngi , ko Syiem Kynrad , ba nga la ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba kham phyrnai ban ïa ka sngi , kaba wan na sahit bneng bad kaba tyngshaiñ baroh sawdong ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah kiba la ïaleit lang bad nga .

translation.en: Thou hidest thy face , they are troubled : thou takest away their breath , they die , and return to their dust .
translation.kha: Haba me phai noh na ki , ki sheptieng , haba me pynphai noh ïa ka jingpyrsad jong me , ki ïap bad ki phai pat sha ka khyndew na kaba ki la wan .

Da ki jingkhroh bym don jinglehisynei , ki Long ka jingthohbria ha ki jingkhawai ïasyllok jong phi . Ki kitkhia tang na ka bynda ïa lade . Ki long kum ki liewlong ba rah ka lyer , hynrei khlem ïarah slap . Ki long kum ki tieng ba khlem soh , wat ha ka synrai , ki dieng ba la rat narud ki dulir bad kiba la ïap noh .
translation.en: These are spots in your feasts of charity , when they feast with you , feeding themselves without fear : clouds they are without water , carried about of winds  ; trees whose fruit withereth , without fruit , twice dead , plucked up by the roots  ;

Yea , and what have ye to do with me , O Tyre , and Zidon , and all the coasts of Philistia ? will ye render me a recompence ? and if ye recompense me , swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head  ;
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi pyrshang ban leh ïa nga , ko Tyros bad Sidon , bad baroh ki jaka jong ka Philistia ? Hato phi pyrshang ban siew pat ïa nga na ka bynta kaei kaei ? Lada phi leh kumta , ngan siew kylliang kloi kloi pat ïa phi !

Kumta nga la shim ïa ka kur Rekhab baroh khwai — u Josaïah ( u khuid jong uwei pat u Jeremaïah , naba dei u khun jong u Habassinaïah ) pynlang ïa baroh ki shynrang ibha shi para pynlang u sad ki khun shynrang jong u — bad wallam ïa ki sha ka Templ .
translation.en: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah , the son of Habaziniah , and his brethren , and all his sons , and the whole house of the Rechabites  ;

translation.kha: Ki kñia ïa ki khun shynrang bad kyntur kum ki jingainguh Thang shad ki blei thala ; ki wad jingot na ki nongleh byrtong bad ki nongpeit kti , bun ki aiti lut ïa lade ban bor ïa kaei naba rumal ha khmat U Trai , bad kumta ki pynkhih bitar ïa U .
translation.en: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire , and used divination and enchantments , and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .

translation.kha: Uta u bymman u ïohi ha madan shang ïa uta u nongleit jingleit bad u kylluid ïa u , Na-ei phi ïan ? shnong phin leit ?
translation.en: And when he had lifted up his eyes , he saw a wayfaring man in the street of the city : and the old man said , Whither goest thou ? and whence comest thou ?

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u ong , Ngan tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilon bad wallam ïa ka sha ka jingjot jingïarap . Ngan ym pynsah ei ei — yn ym don khynnah , yn ym don mian mano ba laitluid im . Nga , U Trai nga la kren .
translation.en: For I will rise up against them , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and cut off from Babylon the name , and remnant , and son , and nephew , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki la sngewkmen ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u don ba ong , bad ki la kular shun ai pisa ïa u . Kumta u Judas u la sdang ban wad ïa ka lad kaba biang ban aiti noh ïa U Jisu sha ki .
translation.en: And when they heard it , they were glad , and promised to give him money . And he sought how he might conveniently betray him .

translation.kha: Nangta u Eli u ju kyrkhu ïa u Elkanah badno ka tnga jong u , bad u ong ha u Elkanah , To U Tiras un ai Shu ki khwan ïa phira na kano ka briew ha ka khang uta uba ph la aiti sha u . Hadien katai ki sa leit phai shiah la ïohnang .
translation.en: And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife , and said , The  Lord  give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the  Lord . And they went unto their own home .

translation.kha: hynriew phin ong , Ho-oid , ïa ki tnat la pynkheiñ noh! ban ai jaka na ka bynta jong por .
translation.en: Thou wilt say then , The branches were broken off , that I might be grafted in .

translation.kha: “lada ngi shahshitom , ka long na ka bynta ka jingaibor bad ka jingpynnang jong phi ; lada la ïarap ïa ngi , te la ïarap ïa phi ruh bad la ai ïa ka bor baneh ïaineh lem da ka jingïaishah ha kita kijuh ki jingshahshitom ba sem umdih ngi la ïaineh .
translation.en: And whether we be afflicted , it is for your consolation and salvation , which is effectual in the enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer : or whether we be comforted , it is for your consolation and salvation .

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Abimelekh , u Tola u khun jong u Puah bad u ksiew jong u Dodo , u la wan ban pyllait ïa ki Israel . U dei na ka jaiñ-da Issakhar bad u shong ha Shamir ha ka ri lum Ephraim .
translation.en: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Israel Tola the son of Puah , the son of Dodo , a man of Issachar  ; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim .

translation.kha: U Blei u ong , To sngap jar bad to shahshkor! ïa nga , phi ki ri sha jngai bah ! To pynkhreh shun wanrah ïa ka jingmudui jong phi ha ka ïingbishar ; phin ïoh ïa ka lad jong phi ban kren . To ngin ïawanlang ban ïa-rai mano ba dei .
translation.en: Keep silence before me , O islands  ; and let the people renew their strength : let them come near  ; then let them speak : let us come near together to judgment .
Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom  ; but will give one tribe to thy son for David my servant s sake , and for Jerusalem s sake which I have chosen .
translation.kha: Bad ngan ym shim na u ïa ka hima baroh kawei , pynban ngan ai ha u ïa kawei ka jait na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba nga la pynlong ka jong nga .

Kumta mynta to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma at , U Trai Nongsynshar , la ong ha phi ki lumbah Bad ki lumrit , ha Phi ki wahduid bad ki khak them , bad ha phi ki jaka kiba sah ha ki jingjngem jingpra , bad ha Phin ki nongbah ba la iehnoh kynjah kiba la shad lieh bad shah rkhiebeiñ da baroh ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong .
translation.en: Therefore , ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord  God   ; Thus saith the Lord  God  to the mountains , and to the hills , to the rivers , and to the valleys , to the desolate wastes , and to the cities that are forsaken , which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about  ;
The land shall be utterly emptied , and utterly spoiled : for the  Lord  hath spoken this word .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kan ka pra bad kan jot . U  Trai  u la kren bad ïa kata yn pyndep .

translation.en: The simple inherit folly : but the prudent are crowned with knowledge .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duna ka jingtip ki ïoh ïa kaei kaba ka jingbieit jong ki ka dei ban ïoh , hynrei ha kiba sian la ainong da ka jingtip .

translation.en: Ye have heard how I said unto you , I go away , and come again unto you . If ye loved me , ye would rejoice , because I said , I go unto the Father : for my Father is greater than I .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ïa nga ba nga ong ha phi , ‘ Ngan sa leit noh , hynrei ngan sa wan pat sha phi .’ Lada phi la ieit ïa nga , phin kmen namar ba ngan sa leit sha U Kpa ; naba u long kham khraw ban ïa nga .
Naduh mynstep hajuh mynmiet ki ïakheiñ ïa nga .
translation.en: Behold their sitting down , and their rising up  ; I am their musick .
Let , I pray thee , thy merciful kindness be for my comfort , according to thy word unto thy servant .
translation.kha: Ai ba ka jingieit baneh jong me kan pyntngen ïa nga , kumba me la kular ïa nga , u shakri jong me .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the mean while , that the heaven was black with clouds and wind , and there was a great rain . And Ahab rode , and went to Jezreel .
translation.kha: Tang hadien khyndiat por , ki lyoh dum ki la tap ïa ka suiñbneng , ka lyer ka sdang ban beh bad u slap bajur u sdang ban hap . U Ahab u shong ha ka kali ïapom bad u sdang ban leit phai sha Jesreel .

translation.en: They have built also the high places of Baal , to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal , which I commanded not , nor spake it , neither came it into my mind :
translation.kha: bad ki la tei ki duwan ïa u Baal khnang ban thang ïa ki khun jong ki ha ka ding kum ki jingkñia . Ngam ju hukum ïa ki ban leh ïa kane ; kam shym rung hi ruh ha ka jingpyrkhat jong nga .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts , that they may come up upon the land of Egypt , and eat every herb of the land , even all that the hail hath left .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Rah ïa la ka kti halor ka ri Ijipt ban wallam ïa ki puit . Kin wan bad bam ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba mih , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba lait na u phria .

translation.en: And they began to enquire among themselves , which of them it was that should do this thing .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la sdang ban kylli para ma ki uno napdeng jong ki uba lah ban long u ban sa leh ïa kane .

U Trai u ong , Nga la ai ha ki Lebi ïa ka bynta kaba shiphew baroh ba ki Israel ki wanrah shiah nga . Kane ka Long ka jingsiew ïa ka jingshakri jong ki ha naba sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga .
