translation.en: And , behold , I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance , for their service which they serve , even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Un bhah ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong u bad un pynïap ïa u ha ka phang kaba shait jong ka duwan , ha ka jaka ba ki ju pynjop ïa ki mrad na ka pynbha ki jingkñia ainguh thang . Kane ka long ka jingkñia ainguh ban map noh ïa ka pop .
translation.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat , and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the  Lord  : it is a sin offering .

translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ka jingstad jong U blang la pyn-i ba ka long kaba shisha da baroh kiba pdiang ïa ka .
translation.en: But wisdom is justified of all her children .

And this is the blessing of Judah : and he said , Hear ,  Lord  , the voice of Judah , and bring him unto his people : let his hands be sufficient for him  ; and be thou an help to him from his enemies .
translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Judah u ong ,  Ko  Trai  , to shahshkor haba ki kyrpad ban ïoh jingïarap ; Tehsong ïa ki kawei bad la ki para jait . Ïaleh na ka bynta jong ki , ko  Trai  , Bad ïarap ïa ki pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong ki .
Shim ïa ki jaka shong jong phi ha ka Templ Sei kur shi kur , katne kum ki jingkitkhlieh ba la aiti ha phi! da u syiem Dabid bad u syiem Solomon u khuid jong u ,
translation.en: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers , after your courses , according to the writing of David king of Israel , and according to the writing of Solomon his son .

translation.kha: Ïaineh skhem ha U Trai .
translation.en: Thou shalt be perfect with the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Lymda une u briew u la wan na U Blei , un ym lah ban bor ïa kaba kum kane .
translation.en: If this man were not of God , he could do nothing .
Then he answered and spake unto me , saying , This is the word of the  Lord  unto Zerubbabel , saying , Not by might , nor by power , but by my spirit , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: U angel u la bthah ïa nga ban ai ha u Serubbabel ïa kane ka khubor na U  Trai  :  Men jop , ym da ka bor shipai lymne da ka bor ka jingkhlaiñ jong me , hynrei da U Mynsiem jong nga .

Wat sheptieng , ko ki briew jong sa ! Phi tip ba naduh ki por mynbarim haduh mynta por la ïathuhlypa ïa barabor ka shun sa jat , bad phi long ki shithi jong nga . Hato don uno une uwei paw U blei ? Hato don kiwei pat ki blei badonbor ba ïam shym ïohsngew ?
translation.en: Fear ye not , neither be afraid : have not I told thee from that time , and have declared it ? ye are even my witnesses . Is there a God beside me ? yea , there is no God  ; I know not any .

And likewise also the men , leaving the natural use of the woman , burned in their lust one toward another ; men with men working that which is unseemly , and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom ki shynrang , ki la iehnoh ïa ka jingshongkurim bad ki kynthei kat kum ba dei ka rukom bad ki la ïa ing da ka jingkwah brai para ma ki hi . Ki shynrang ki leh kiei kiei kiba khlemrain para ma ki , bad ka jingmih ka long ba ki wallam halor lade hi ïa ka jingpynshitom kaba ki don hok ban ïoh na ka bynta ka jingleh bym dei jong ki .

translation.en: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren : the  Lord  is their inheritance , as he hath said unto them .
translation.kha: Kim dei ban don bynta na ka khyndew ka shyiap kum kiwei pat ki para jait jong ki ; ka bynta jong ki ka long ka kabu ka jinglong ki lyngdoh jong U  Trai  , kumba u la kular .

Naba la thoh , Suk , phad ka kynthei kaweh lyngki ! To risa bun kyang da ka jingtim , Pha ka i ju la ïohmad ïa ki jingpang jngai ka jingsuh kha ! Naba kata ka kynthei kaba la shah iehnoh kan ïoh kham bun ki khun ban ïa ka kynthei kaba u tnga um ju iehnoh ïa ka .
translation.en: For it is written , Rejoice , thou barren that bearest not ; break forth and cry , thou that travailest not : for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband .

translation.kha: Ban im slem ka long ka bainong jong Kiba hok ; u ñiuhlieh u Long ka pansngiat budnam .
translation.en: The hoary head is a crown of glory , if it be found in the way of righteousness .
In time , you may qualify to begin preaching with the local congregation of Jehovah’s Witnesses .
translation.kha: Shen phin sa lah ban leit ïalap ryngkat bad kiwei pat ki para bangeit jong Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ha ka shnong jong phi .

translation.en: Just as a shepherd diligently cares for each one of his sheep , the elders try to get to know every member of the congregation individually . —Proverbs 27 :23 .
translation.kha: Kumba u nongap langbrot u shim khia ban sumar ïa la ki langbrot , ki rangbah balang ruh ki pyrshang ban tip ïa iwei pa iwei i dkhot ka balang .

translation.en: Yet there shall be a space between you and it , about two thousand cubits by measure : come not near unto it , that ye may know the way by which ye must go : for ye have not passed this way heretofore .
translation.kha: Phim pat ju poi hangta mynshuwa , kumta kin pyn-i ha phi ka lynti ba phin leit . Hynrei wat leit sha jan ka Synduk ka Jutang ; pynjngai kumba shi kilomitar nadien jong ka .

translation.en: All go unto one place  ; all are of the dust , and all turn to dust again .
translation.kha: Baroh ar ki leit sha kajuh ka jaka — ka khyndew . Baroh ar ki la wan na ka bad baroh ar kin leit phai pat sha ka .

translation.en: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely , he was afraid of him .
translation.kha: U Saul u ïohi ïa ka jingjop u Dabid bad u nang sheptieng shuh shuh ïa u .
Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ba U Messaïah un long uba hiarpateng na u Syiem Dabid bad yn kha ïa u ha Bethlehem , ka shnong ha katba u Dabid u la im .
translation.en: Hath not the scripture said , That Christ cometh of the seed of David , and out of the town of Bethlehem , where David was ?

translation.kha: Ïeng Haneng , u syiem u ong ha u ; bad u la leit shajrong bad ïeng hangta .
translation.en: And the king said unto him , Turn aside , and stand here . And he turned aside , and stood still .
Dearly beloved , avenge not yourselves , but rather give place unto wrath : for it is written , Vengeance is mine ; I will repay , saith the Lord .
translation.kha: Wat ju pynhiarkput , ko ki paralok jong nga , hynrei pynban , to ai ba ka jingbitar jong U Blei kan leh ïa kata . Namar ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ngan pynhiarkput , ngan siew kylliang , ong U Trai .

translation.en: And said ,  Verily I say unto you , Except ye be converted , and become as little children , ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: bad u la ong ,  Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba lymda phi kylla bad long kum ki khynnah , phin ym ïohrung da lei lei shapoh ka Hima ki bneng .
Pha bud ha ki dien lah ka hynmen jong pha , bad kumne ngan ai ha phad ïa kajuh ka khuri jong ka Jingpynshitom ban dih .
translation.en: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister  ; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand .

translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba ka jingsynshar jong nga Kan pyllait im ïa nga , namar yn ym don u riewsniew u ngab nud ban ïakynduh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: He also shall be my salvation : for an hypocrite shall not come before him .

translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha u , Ko khun shynrang jong nga , ïathuh ïa ka jingbishar hangne ha khmat U tharai , U Blei ki Israel , bad phla . Ïathuh ha nga mynta ïa Kaei kob me la leh . Wat pyrshang ban buhrieh ïa ka na nga .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto Achan , My son , give , I pray thee , glory to the  Lord  God of Israel , and make confession unto him  ; and tell me now what thou hast done  ; hide it not from me .

translation.kha: Ko Syiem , kaei kaba kine ki briew ki la leh ka long ka bym dei . Ki la Thep ïa u Jeremaïah ha ka pungsum , ha kaba , da shisha , un sa ïarep ha ka jingïapthngan , namar ym don jingbam shuh ha ka nongbah .
translation.en: My lord the king , these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet , whom they have cast into the dungeon  ; and he is like to die for hunger in the place where he is : for there is no more bread in the city .
Then said he unto me , Son of man , these are the men that devise mischief , and give wicked counsel in this city :
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , kine ki rangbah ki thaw ki jingthmu basniew bad ki ai ïa ka jingai jingmut bym long hapoh kane ka nongbah .
kim don ka jingïatylli ; Kim ba-bang ïa la ki kylluid , bad ktien pyn-i jingbang lane jingisynei ïa Kiwei pah .
translation.en: Without understanding , covenantbreakers , without natural affection , implacable , unmerciful :

translation.kha: Ngam to tnga , ka la jubab . U Jisu u la phai ktien , Ka long kaba dei haba phah ong ba pham don tnga .
translation.en: The woman answered and said , I have no husband . Jesus said unto her ,  Thou hast well said , I have no husband :
And all the people of the land rejoiced : and the city was quiet , after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword .
translation.kha: La pyndap da ka jingkmen ïa ki briew baroh , bad ka nongbah ka la shongsuk , mynta ba la pynïap ïa ka Athalaïah .
U Moses u la ïa-ong ha u Aaron , Shim uwei u khiew , ngap ar kilo ka manna ha u , nangta buh ïa u ha khmat U Trai , na ka bynta ki khun ki ksiew jong me .
translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Take a pot , and put an omer full of manna therein , and lay it up before the  Lord  , to be kept for your generations .
For we have found this man a pestilent fellow , and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world , and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes :
translation.kha: Ngi la shem ïa une u briew ba u long ka jingpynwit kaba shyrkhei ; u sdang ïa ka jingkhihwin hapdeng ki Jiw ha kylleng jong ka pyrthei bad u long u nongïalam jong ka kynhun kaba na Nasareth .
Ngan kohnguh da kaba nadong eh ïa ki hukum jong me , namar men ai shuh shuh ka jingshemphang ïa nga .
translation.en: I will run the way of thy commandments , when thou shalt enlarge my heart .
Verily I say unto you , Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached throughout the whole world , this also that she hath done shall be spoken of for a memorial of her .
translation.kha: Mynta , nga ong skhem ha phi , ba shano shano ba yn ïalap ïa ka Gospel ha kylleng ka pyrthei , ïa kaei kaba ka la leh yn ïathuh ban kynmaw ïa ka .

translation.en: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king , he removed her from being queen , because she had made an idol in a grove : and Asa cut down her idol , and stamped it , and burnt it at the brook Kidron .
translation.kha: U Syiem Asa u pynkynriah ïa ka Maakah ka kmierad jong u na ka kyrdan kum ka syiemsad , namar ka la thaw ka bleithaw kynsha jong ka Asherah ka blei jingseisoh . U Asa u pynpra ïa ka bleithaw , u pyndkut ïa ka , bad u thang ïa ki lyngkhot ha ka them Kidron .

Pynban , um shym pynïap ïa ki khun jong ki hynrei u kohnguh ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la Hukum ha ka Aïu u Mesha : Ki kmie ki kpa kim dei ban shah pynïap na ka bynta ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki khun jong ki , bad ki khun ki dien ban shah pynïap na ka bynta ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki Kmen ki kpa jong ki ; ïa u brisoh dih banbeiñ pynïap tang namsop ka kam sniew kaba u hi u la leh .
translation.en: But the children of the murderers he slew not : according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses , wherein the  Lord  commanded , saying , The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , nor the children be put to death for the fathers  ; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin .

translation.kha: Nangta nga phah ïa ki nonglamktien na ka ri shahjop Jeremoth sha u Sihon u syiem Heshbon ban tyrwa ïa ka jingïaseng , da kaba ong ,
translation.en: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace , saying ,

translation.kha: Ki shah ïa ki ktung jong ki ban ïap ha ka jingthngan bad jingsliang ; ki khynnah ki khrong jingbam kaban ym don mano mano ban ai ha ki .
translation.en: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst : the young children ask bread , and no man breaketh it unto them .

translation.kha: U la ïap malu la tep ïa u ha Syria , bad u khun jngai u , u Jehoash u long skhem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him in Samaria : and Joash his son reigned in his stead .
And when Elisha was come into the house , behold , the child was dead , and laid upon his bed .
translation.kha: Haba u Elisha u la poi , u la leit marwei shapoh ka kamra bad u la ïohi ïa u khynnah ba u thiah ïap halor ka jingthiah .
U Terah u long u syiem ! Ko pyrthei , to lehbor ! To shadkmen , ko ki dewlynnong ha ki duriaw !
translation.en: The  Lord  reigneth  ; let the earth rejoice  ; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof .

translation.kha: Sngewbha , wat pynshongdor jingmut ei ei ïa u Nabal , uta u bym long ei ei ! U dei hi thik kumba ka kyrteng jong u ka mut — u bieit ! Kynrad , nam khim don hangno haba ki shakri jong phi ki wan poi .
translation.en: Let not my lord , I pray thee , regard this man of Belial , even Nabal : for as his name is , so is he  ; Nabal is his name , and folly is with him : but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord , whom thou didst send .

translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Nalor kane ka daw , u briew’ un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmiesan bad un ïalong kawei bad la ka tnga , mala ki ar ngut kin ïalong kawei .
translation.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother , and shall be joined unto his wife , and they two shall be one flesh .

translation.kha: Ïa ïeng ïaleit shaei ki bri , u Jonathan u jubab . Kut ki ïaleit lang .
translation.en: And Jonathan said unto David , Come , and let us go out into the field . And they went out both of them into the field .

translation.kha: bad phin long kiba kmen lada phin kynduh ïa ki bad pa’ lah ban kren ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee  ; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips .

translation.kha: Marah ïadem kren ïa kane , ki khun Shynrang jong u Dabid ki wan rung ; ki la shang ban ïam , bad u Dabid lem bad ki rangbah synsar jong u ruh ki la ïa-ïam khnang .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as he had made an end of speaking , that , behold , the king s sons came , and lifted up their voice and wept : and the king also and all his servants wept very sore .

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Dedan ki ïakylli ïa ki jaiñ-jin na ka bynta ki mar jong phan .
translation.en: Dedan was thy merchant in precious clothes for chariots .

translation.kha: Sa shikyntien pat U TRAI’ u la klun ha u Jonah .
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came unto Jonah the second time , saying ,
And behold at eveningtide trouble  ; and before the morning he is not . This is the portion of them that spoil us , and the lot of them that rob us .
translation.kha: Ha ka por janmiet ki pynlong ka jingpyntriem , hynrei kat ban da step ki la jah noh . Kata ka dei ka kupar jong uwei uwei uba lute ïa ka ri jong ngi .

translation.en: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book , that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name , THE  Lord  THY GOD  ;
translation.kha: Lada phim kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai U Blei ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab , bad lada phim ñiewburom ïa ka kyrteng kaba phylla bad kaba khraw jong U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ,

translation.en: So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city , which was before the king s gate .
translation.kha: U Hathakh u leit sha u Mordekai ha ka phyllaw ka nongbah ha ka khyrdop ka ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes , O God  ; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant s house for a great while to come , and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree , O  Lord  God .
translation.kha: Pynban mynta me ïai leh shuh shuh ; me la pynlong ki kular na ka bynta ki khun ki ksiew jong nga ha ki snem ki ban wan , bad me , ko  Trai  U Blei , me la lah pynlong ïa nga kum u briew uba khraw .
Phi pyrthat kumno shaïong u Messaïah ? U dadien u nonghiarpateng jongno ? U dien kiba hiarpateng na u Dabid , ki la jubab .
translation.en: Saying ,  What think ye of Christ ? whose son is he ?  They say unto him , The Son of David .

translation.kha: Hato ki kulai ki ju mareh halor ki mawsiang ? Hato ki briew ki ju lur ïa ka duriaw da ki masi dab ? Pynban phi la pynkylla ïa ka jingbishar hok sha ka bih , bad ïa kaba dei shaw ka bymdei .
translation.en: Shall horses run upon the rock ? will one plow there with oxen ? for ye have turned judgment into gall , and the fruit of righteousness into hemlock :
What if God , willing to shew his wrath , and to make his power known , endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction :
translation.kha: Bad kane ka long kumjuh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh . U la kwah ban pynpaw ïa ka jingbitar jong u bad ban pynpaw ïa ka bor jong u . Hynrei u la long uba ïaishah haduh katta katta ïa kito kiba long ka daw jong ka jingbitar jong u , kiba la don ha ka lynti sha ka jingshah pynjot .
Ym don ba ïaroh ïa U Blei ban pynïar ïa ki bneng lane ïuh halor ka met ki mrad kynsha ka duriaw .
translation.en: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens , and treadeth upon the waves of the sea .
And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand , and look how thy brethren fare , and take their pledge .
translation.kha: Bad shim kine ki ktung dud    shiphew tylli sha u nongïalam rangbah . Wad jingtip kumno ki hynmen jong phi ki long bad wanrah dak ei ei ban pyn-i ba phi la ïohi ïa ki bad ba ki koit ki khiah .
Ka la ni ka jingïa-pasiaw kaba jur shaphang jong u hapdeng u Baïap . U longkmie u briew babha bol , don kiba la ong . Em , kiwei ki la ong , u ïalam bakla ïa ki briew .
translation.en: And there was much murmuring among the people concerning him : for some said , He is a good man : others said , Nay  ; but he deceiveth the people .
And they found written in the law which the  Lord  had commanded by Moses , that the children of Israel should dwell in booths in the feast of the seventh month :
translation.kha: Ki shem ha ka Hukum kaba U  Trai  u la ai lyngba u Moses , ba ka la hukum ïa ki Israel ban shong ban sah ha ki jakarieh bashipor ha ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
U Jisu u la jubab da ka jingkylli , Kaei kaba ka hukum u Moses ka ai ha phi ?
translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  What did Moses command you ?

translation.kha: U la ong ba un pyn-i jingtei ïa ki kpa tymmen jong sem bad kynthup ïa ka jutang bakyntang jong u .
translation.en: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers , and to remember his holy covenant  ;

translation.kha: Ki briew kin shah pynïap kylleng , bad kito kiba lait im kin sa sngewhun ba nga long U Trei .
translation.en: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you , and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Man ka sngaid , U Jisu u la shithi ha ka Templ . Ki ïabah lyngdoh , ki Nonghikai ka Hukum , bad ki nongïalam jong ki paidbah ki la kwah ban pynïap ïa u ,
translation.en: And he taught daily in the temple . But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him ,

translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi! , ko parabangeit jong nga , ban shahskhor bha ïa kane ka kyrhuh ka jingpynhiarkput ; naba kane ka shiah kaba nga la thoh sha phi kam da long naba jrop eh .
translation.en: And I beseech you , brethren , suffer the word of exhortation : for I have written a letter unto you in few words .

translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Daberath Pha khet ïa u Sadok , u Mattan , bad u Benaïah . Haba ki la rung shapoh ,
translation.en: And king David said , Call me Zadok the priest , and Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada . And they came before the king .
Saying , The prison truly found we shut with all safety , and the keepers standing without before the doors : but when we had opened , we found no man within .
translation.kha: Haba ngi la poi ha phatok , ngi la shem ba la khang pynskhem ïa ka bad baroh ki nongap phira kiba ap ki don ha ka khyrdop ; hynrei haba ngi la plie ïa ki khyrdop , ngim shem ïano ïano ruh hapoh !
Ym ni uwei umdih na ki nongsynshar jong kane ka pyrthuh , umbiah la tip ïa kane ka jingtied . Lada ki la thup ïa ka , ktang ym da la sahnarphna ïa U TRAI’ ka burom .
translation.en: Which none of the princes of this world knew : for had they known it , they would not have crucified the Lord of glory .

translation.kha: Me don u ksuid hapoh jong me ! u paidbah u la jubab . Mano ba pyrshang ban pynïap ïa me ?
translation.en: The people answered and said , Thou hast a devil : who goeth about to kill thee ?
If these men die the common death of all men , or if they be visited after the visitation of all men  ; then the  Lord  hath not sent me .
translation.kha: Lada kine ki briew ki ïap kumba ïap ki parabriew khlem da hap ha kano kano ka jingpynshitom na U Blei , te shisha U  Trai  um shym la phah ïa nga .

U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa ka bynta kaba khatsaw jong ka jingim u Job kham ngai ban ïa kaba u la kyrkhu ha katba mynnyngkong . U Job u long trai ïa ki khatsaw hajar tylli ki lanot , hynriew hajar tylli ki ut , ar hajar tylli ki musli , bad shihajar tylli ki kada .
translation.en: So the  Lord  blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning : for he had fourteen thousand sheep , and six thousand camels , and a thousand yoke of oxen , and a thousand she asses .

translation.kha: Ki lah ban shait ban khlaiñ haba ngi lap ïa ki , hynriewphew kin ïap haba ngi ïoh leh Dumah ïa ki !
translation.en: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave  ; and whole , as those that go down into the pit :
Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in , and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa kaei kaei baroh kat kaba phi leh .
U pynleh ki pung-um ïa ki ri shyiap bad pynmih ñiuhlieh ha ki jaka ba-rkhiang .
translation.en: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water , and dry ground into watersprings .
And he gathered together all the princes of Israel , with the priests and the Levites .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u lumlang ïa ki nongïalam baroh jong ki Israel , bad ïa baroh ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi .
Babha U Jisu u la ïohi haduh katno ka jingngeit ki la don , u la ong ha uta u briew’ , La map ïa ki jop jong me , ko paralok jong de .
translation.en: And when he saw their faith , he said unto him ,  Man , thy sins are forgiven thee .
Then came together unto him the Pharisees , and certain of the scribes , which came from Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum kiba la lah wan na Jerusalem ki la ïalum sawdong ïa U Jisu .
Kaei kaba nga mut ka long ba ma phi bad ma la ngin ïoh ka jingïarap ha kajuh ka por , ma phi da ka jingngeit jong per bad ma nga da ka jong phi .
translation.en: That is , that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me .

translation.kha: U TRAI’ u la kulmar ha u Arbad ba un shim noh ïa ka hima na u Saul bad ki khun ki kyiuh jong u , bad un thring ïa u dab kum u syiem jong ki Israhaïah mala ki Judah , nguh na kawei ka tduh sha katai pat ka tduh jong ka ri . Mynta to U Blei un shoh ïap ïa at ïada ngam pynurlong shisha ïa kane !
translation.en: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul , and to set up the throne of David over Israel and over Judah , from Dan even to Beer–sheba .
Moreover I have given to thee one portion above thy brethren , which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow .
translation.kha: Dei ha me , ym ha ki hynmen jong me , ba nga ai ïa ka Shekhem , kata ka jaka kaba seisoh ba nga la ïohknieh na ki Amor da ka waitlam bad ka ryntieh jong nga .
Kumta , ym don jingïapher hapdeng ki jia bad ki Jentil , hapdeng ki mraw bad kiba lalot , hapdeng ki shynrang bad ki kynthei ; phi baïar phi ïalong kaweh ha U Khrist Jisu .
translation.en: There is neither Jew nor Greek , there is neither bond nor free , there is neither male nor female : for ye are all one in Christ Jesus .

translation.kha: Ka jait Reuben nabar ka jait Gad , bad kawei pat ka shiteng na ka jait Manasseh ki la nongpdiang lypa ïa ka ri kaban u Moses , u Shakri U Trai , u la ai ha ki ; ka don ha ka liang mihngi jong ka wah Jordan .
translation.en: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance , which Moses gave them , beyond Jordan eastward , even as Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave them  ;

translation.kha: Ka bha tang ban thang ngin . Haba ki tduh ki la ing lut khoit bad ba ka pdeng ka la kila rnga , Hato phi lah shun shna ei ei na ka ?
translation.en: Behold , it is cast into the fire for fuel  ; the fire devoureth both the ends of it , and the midst of it is burned . Is it meet for any work ?

translation.kha: Naba ka dohnud jong Phin kan ïadei don hangta ha kaba don ka spah jong phi .
translation.en: For where your treasure is , there will your heart be also .

And he thought scorn to lay hands on Mordecai alone  ; for they had shewed him the people of Mordecai : wherefore Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus , even the people of Mordecai .
translation.kha: bad haba u tip ba u Mordekai u dei u Jiw , u la rai ban pynshitom ym tang ïa u Mordekai marwei . U la don ka jingthmu ban pynïap ïa baroh ki Jiw ha ka hima Persia baroh kawei .

U Isaïah u ngin hangtei hapoh ka Templ harud ka duwan step jingbuaid , bad u bat ïa ka pliang thang jingiwbih . U la bitar ïa kita ki lyngkdong , dara mar kumta ka jingpangnud ñiangthohlieh ka mih ha ka shalyntem jong u .
translation.en: Then Uzziah was wroth , and had a censer in his hand to burn incense : and while he was wroth with the priests , the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the  Lord  , from beside the incense altar .

translation.kha: Katno ka jing-jngai ngi hap leit ?
translation.en: How much distance to go ?

translation.kha: Ki rangbah ïalang ki pyneh ïa ngi na ka Baibl malade ki ïarap ïa ka balang ban kham jan sha U Blei .
translation.en: The elders guide and help to protect the congregation spiritually .
But if thou wilt not send him , we will not go down : for the man said unto us , Ye shall not see my face , except your brother be with you .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim treh ban phah ïa u , ngin ym leit , namar uta u briew u la ong ha ngi ba ngin ym lah shuh ban ïakynduh ïa u lymda u para jong ngi u don ryngkat lem bad ngi .
“Nga la thoh sha phi ïa kato ka shithi namar nga la khiew eh ban tip haduh katto-katne Phin la ïeng ha kata ka jingtynjuh mala la phi la kloi borabor don nongshong ïa ki jingbthah jongki nga .
translation.en: For to this end also did I write , that I might know the proof of you , whether ye be obedient in all things .
And a certain Jew named Apollos , born at Alexandria , an eloquent man , and mighty in the scriptures , came to Ephesus .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por uwei u Jiw uba kyrteng u Apollos ïa uba la kha ha Aleksandria , u la wan poi sha Ephesos . U long u nongkren uba pnah bad uba don ka jingtip babniah ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid .
Bad la don ka riewkynthei ha kata kwah ka shnong kaba ïai wan sha u bad kyrpad na ka bynta ki hok Jong ka , da kaba ong , ‘ To ïarap ïa nga pyrshah ïa u nongïaleh pynshah jyllang nga !’
translation.en: And there was a widow in that city  ; and she came unto him , saying , Avenge me of mine adversary .
And the children of Israel fled before Judah : and God delivered them into their hand .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki phet ïap na ki Judia , bad U Blei u shah ïa ki Judia ban thombor ïa ki .
mala haba ki jingïohknieh ba u Simri u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem bad pynïap ïa u , hangta hi ki baroh ki pynbha ba u nongai lawlynnong jong ki , u Omri , u long u syiem ka Israel .
translation.en: And the people that were encamped heard say , Zimri hath conspired , and hath also slain the king : wherefore all Israel made Omri , the captain of the host , king over Israel that day in the camp .
And the word of the  Lord  came unto me the second time , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la kren biang ha nga , bad u la ong ,

translation.en: And as the toes of the feet were part of iron , and part of clay , so the kingdom shall be partly strong , and partly broken .
translation.kha: Ki shympriah kjat — shi bynta da ka nar bad shi bynta da ka dewbyrtha — ki mut ba shi bynta jong ka hima kan long kaba khlaiñ bad shi bynta jong ka kaba tlot .
Kumne U TRAI’ u kylli ïa u , Aïu me bat ha la ka kti ? U diengthang , u jubab .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , What is that in thine hand ? And he said , A rod .

translation.kha: U Mordekai u mih na ka ïinglieng , ha ki jingphong syiem kiba jngum prong bad balieh , ka barandi linen ba ïathaw bad ka pansngiat ksiar baïaineh . Nangta ki lynti bah ka Susa ki sawa da ki jingpyrta ïaroh jong ka jingman .
translation.en: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white , and with a great crown of gold , and with a garment of fine linen and purple : and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad .

translation.kha: shna ïa ka jingdeng shadem na ka boitha u Rangbah Lyngdoh ban pyndonkam ha kaba sngewthuh ïa ka myn jong U Blei . Shna ïa ka da kijuh ki tiar kiba la pyndonkam ha kaba suh ïa ka ephod , bad da kijuh ki jingsuh pynpur itynnat .
translation.en: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work  ; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it  ; of gold , of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine twined linen , shalt thou make it .

translation.kha: Ko Trai , ym don uwei patan kumto ma me ; ngi tip borabor ba me long tang ma me marwei U blem .
translation.en: O  Lord  , there is none like thee , neither is there any God beside thee , according to all that we have heard with our ears .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ban tynjuh ïa ki Israel , ban lap la kin kohnguh ne em ïa ki hukum ba U Tharai u la ai ha ki kpa tmier jong ki da u Moses .
translation.en: And they were to prove Israel by them , to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the  Lord  , which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses .

translation.kha: U Solomon u la pynjyrngam ïa kine ki dieng ha kaba shna jingker ha ka Templ malade ha ka ïinglieng , bad ha kaba shniah duitara badno jingmut kiei ïa ki nongkit nongtem . Ki long ki dieng Kseh-Juniper kiba kynsai tam ïa kiba la ïawer sha Israel , ym don shuh kum kita ban Dang lah ban ïuh babiang . )
translation.en: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of the  Lord  , and for the king s house , harps also and psalteries for singers : there came no such almug trees , nor were seen unto this day .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba bam ei ei ha kata ka sngi yn ñiew uba la shah tait na ki bynriew U Blei .
translation.en: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day , he shall be cut off from among his people .

translation.kha: U lumlang ïa baroh ki duriaw-rit ha kawei ka jaka ; u ktang ïa ki jingjylliew ka ïaboi ha ki ïinglieng jingkynshew .
translation.en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap : he layeth up the depth in storehouses .

translation.kha: Ki ieit ïa ka jingpynksan u bri shun ïa ka jingpynksan na U Blei .
translation.en: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God .

translation.kha: Ngim shym la pdiang ïa ka jingpynksan jongno jongno Khlem da siewdor ïa ka . Pynban , ngi la twa pynlang minot thop ; ngi ïai trei mynsngi bad mynmiet khnang ban ym long ka jingbankhia ïano ïano na phi .
translation.en: Neither did we eat any man s bread for nought ; but wrought with labour and travail night and day , that we might not be chargeable to any of you :

But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this , he fled by the way of the garden house . And Jehu followed after him , and said , Smite him also in the chariot . And they did so at the going up to Gur , which is by Ibleam . And he fled to Megiddo , and died there .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem Ahasaïah u ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , kumta u phet ïap ha la ka kali ïapom sha ka shnong Beth Haggan , ba la beh kthong da u Jehu .  Pynïap ïa u ruh !  U Jehu u la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u , bad ki la pynmynsaw ïa u katba u dang ñiah ïa ka kali ïapom jong u ha ka lynti kaba kiew sha Gur kaba hajan ka shnong Ibleam . Hynrei u la ïohlad ban nang leit tad haduh ba un da poi ha ka nongbah Megiddo , ha kaba u ïap .

translation.en: Behold , the Lord will cast her out , and he will smite her power in the sea  ; and she shall be devoured with fire .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai un shim noh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ka don . Un kynting ïa ka spah jong ka sha ka duriaw , bad ïa ka nongbah yn thang haduh khyndew .

translation.en: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon , and Elealeh , and Kiriathaim ,
translation.kha: Ka jait Reuben ka tei biang ïa ka Heshbon , ka Elealeh , ka Kiriathaim ,

translation.en: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass .
translation.kha: U Jisu te u la ong ïa ki synran jong u ba baroh ki briew kin phiah ha ki kynhun kynhun bad shong halor u phlang bajyrngam .

Dei ka jingngeit kaba la Pynlong ïa u Moses ban mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt khlem da sheptieng ïa ka jingbitar u Pharaoh . Ka la long kumba u la ïohi ïa U Blei u bym la ban ïohi , u la kyntait ban phai dien .
translation.en: By faith he forsook Egypt , not fearing the wrath of the king : for he endured , as seeing him who is invisible .

Thou hast indeed smitten Edom , and thine heart hath lifted thee up : glory of this , and tarry at home : for why shouldest thou meddle to thy hurt , that thou shouldest fall , even thou , and Judah with thee ?
translation.kha: Mynta ko Amasaïah , me la jop ïa ki Edom , bad me dap da ka jingsarong . To sngewhun bad la ka nam bad shong khop ha ïing . Balei me pynkynroi jingkulmar ka ban wanrah tang ïa ka jingpynjot ha me bad ha ki briew jong me ?

Hynrei ngi , ngi long ki jong U Blei . Uno uno uba ithuh ïa U Blei , u shahshkor ïa Ngi ; uno uno u bym long u Jong U Blei , um shahshkor ïa Ngi . Kane te , ka long kumno im’ lah ban ïathuh ïa ka jingïapher phangpdeng U Mynhyndai ka jingshisha mala u mynsiem ka jinglamler .
translation.en: We are of God : he that knoweth God heareth us  ; he that is not of God heareth not us . Hereby know we the spirit of truth , and the spirit of error .

translation.kha: Nga la hikai ïa phi ïa ki hukum , kumba U Trai U Blei jong nga u la hukum ïa nga . Sumar bad leh ïa ki ha kata ka ri sha kiba phin sa kitei bad ïohkynti .
translation.en: Behold , I have taught you statutes and judgments , even as the  Lord  my God commanded me , that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it .

translation.kha: Pi shahshitom lym bad ki koidi , bad haba ki jingdon jingem jong phi baroh ki la shah kurup , pa’ la shah ïa la ka jingduh da kaba kmen , namar phi la tip ba phiah la ïoh ki kynti shikhung kiei kiei kiba kham bha , kiba neh junom .
translation.en: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds , and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods , knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance .

translation.kha: Ym pat ju don ka Jingkhawai Anam Ka Jinglait kumno kane ïa Kaba la rakhe da uno uno na ki sahmiet Israel ne Judah , naduh ka por mynba ki nongsah ki nongsynshar ïa ka ri .
translation.en: Surely there was not holden such a passover from the days of the judges that judged Israel , nor in all the days of the kings of Israel , nor of the kings of Judah  ;
For he is not a Jew , which is one outwardly ; neither is that circumcision , which is outward in the flesh :
translation.kha: Haba kumta , uei uba dei u Jiw bashisha , ba la otsher shisha ? Ym dei uta u briew uba dei u Jiw ha kaba shabar , uba ka jingotsher ka long ha ka doh .
Namar u hi u long uba tlot ha kiba bun mano , u lah ban long uba jemnud bad iba ki bym don ka jingtip mala kiba leh bakla .
translation.en: Who can have compassion on the ignorant , and on them that are out of the way  ; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity .
Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips  ; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food .
translation.kha: Nga leh borabor ïa kaei kaba U Blei u hukum ; nga bud ïa ka mon jong u , ym ïa ki jingkwah jong nga hi .

translation.en: As for you , O house of Israel , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Go ye , serve ye every one his idols , and hereafter also , if ye will not hearken unto me : but pollute ye my holy name no more with your gifts , and with your idols .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Bad mynta , ma phi ki Israel baroh , to pynsngewbha ïa lade ! To khie bad to shakri ïa ki bleithaw jong phi ! Hynrei nga maham ïa phi ba hadien kane , phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga bad sangeh ban pynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga da kaba ai ki jingai sngewbha ha ki bleithaw jong phi .
U ong , Pyntyllun katto katne ki mawthew kiba heh ha khmat sier ka krem . Buh katto katne ki nongbah phira hangta ,
translation.en: And Joshua said , Roll great stones upon the mouth of the cave , and set men by it for to keep them :

translation.kha: Ïa ka ksiar bad ïa ka shoh la phrang ha ka ding , bad ïa ka dohnud jong u bhabriew la phrang da U Trai .
translation.en: The fining pot is for silver , and the furnace for gold : but the  Lord  trieth the hearts .

And the  Lord  thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand , in the fruit of thy body , and in the fruit of thy cattle , and in the fruit of thy land , for good : for the  Lord  will again rejoice over thee for good , as he rejoiced over thy fathers :
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynroi kyrhai ïa phi kat ha kaba phi leh ; phin ïoh kyrhai ki khun ki kti bad kyrhai ki jingri , bad ki lyngkha jong phi ruh kin pynmih kyrhai . Un da sngewbha eh ban pynmanbha ïa phi kumba u la sngewbha ban pynmanbha ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ;

translation.en: When a man hath taken a wife , and married her , and it come to pass that she find no favour in his eyes , because he hath found some uncleanness in her : then let him write her a bill of divorcement , and give it in her hand , and send her out of his house .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u shongkurim ïa ka briew , bad hadien u shem ha ka ïa kaei kaei ha kaba um sngewbha ; u rai ba um mon shuh ïa ka , kumta u thoh ïa ki kot ïapyllait tnga bad u ai ïa ki ha ka , bad u phah mihnoh ïa ka na ka ïing jong u ,

translation.en: And Tilgath–pilneser king of Assyria came unto him , and distressed him , but strengthened him not .
translation.kha: U patsha jong ka Assyria , ha ka jaka ban ïarap ïa u Ahas , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u bad thaw jingeh ïa u .
Nga ong ha phi , un bishar ha ka liang jong ki bad un leh kloi ïa ka . Hynrei hato U Khun U Briew un shem mo ïa ka jingngeit ha ka pyrthei haba u wan ?
translation.en: I tell you that he will avenge them speedily . Nevertheless when the Son of man cometh , shall he find faith on the earth ?

translation.kha: Me shem ba u ïadih ha me , bad me pynlong ka jingïateh kular bad u . Me klun ban ai ha u ïa ka ri ki Kanah , ka ri jyllang ki Hit bad ki Amor , ka ri ki pyrsa , ki Jebus bad ki Girgash , kan hir ka ri ha kaba ki khup ki ksiew jong u kin shong ktang Hukum . Me bat ïa la ka Kular , namar me long uba ïaineh .
translation.en: And foundest his heart faithful before thee , and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites , the Hittites , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Jebusites , and the Girgashites , to give it , I say , to his seed , and hast performed thy words  ; for thou art righteous :

translation.kha: Phi lah ban ong ïa aiwai na Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ban ïarap ïa phi ban sngewthuh ïa ki jingtim jong ki dkhot Baal .—Pule Loukas 24 :32 , 45 .
translation.en: Any one of Jehovah’s Witnesses will be pleased to help you to reason on the meaning of the Scriptures . —Read Luke 24 :32 , 45 .

translation.kha: U Araunah mar ïa-ïohi ba u Syiem Dabid u wan , u la iehnoh ïa ka jaka shoh kew bun u dem rit , bad la ka khlieh kaba kynhun ha ïan .
translation.en: And as David came to Ornan , Ornan looked and saw David , and went out of the threshingfloor , and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground .

translation.kha: Nangta u leit ïakren bad —kata ka kynhied , bad u la itynnat ïa ka .
translation.en: And he went down , and talked with the woman  ; and she pleased Samson well .

translation.kha: namar ka paw kaba phi la ïarap ïa nga ha ka kam jong ka gospel sha kiwei pateng naduh ka sngi kaba sdang hapoh mynta .
translation.en: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now ;

translation.kha: Pynbiang , ngan beh noh! ïa ki kyndiah pa khynñiat , tad haduh ba phin da ïabam paid ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri .
translation.en: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee , until thou be increased , and inherit the land .

translation.kha: U Potiphar u la sngewbha eh ïa u bad u la pynlong ïa u kum u shakri ïa u shimet hi ; kumta u buh ïa u ban long u nongjop ïa ka Ïing ka sem jong u , mala ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba u don .
translation.en: And Joseph found grace in his sight , and he served him : and he made him overseer over his house , and all that he had he put into his hand .

translation.kha: Ko phi kiba hok baroh to lehkmen namar kawei kaba U Trai u la leh ! To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba U Blei uba khuid u la leh , badno to ainguh ïa u .
translation.en: Rejoice in the  Lord  , ye righteous  ; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness .

translation.kha: Kin sa manbha pat , bad ïa pha bad ki nongrit jong pha duh yn sa pynneh .
translation.en: When thy sisters , Sodom and her daughters , shall return to their former estate , and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate , then thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate .
If I whet my glittering sword , and mine hand take hold on judgment  ; I will render vengeance to mine enemies , and will reward them that hate me .
translation.kha: ba ngan shut pynnep ïa ka waitlam kaba phalang jong nga , bad ai ïa ka jingbishar bahok , ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki nongshun jong nga bad pynshitom ïa kito kiba isih ïa nga .

translation.en: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed , his anger was kindled .
translation.kha: U Sebul , u nongsynshar jong ka nongbah , u bitar lep haba u ïohsngew aïu u Gaal u ong .

translation.en: But after that our fathers had provoked the God of heaven unto wrath , he gave them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , the Chaldean , who destroyed this house , and carried the people away into Babylon .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la pynbitar ïa U Blei ka Bneng , u la shah ba yn jop noh ïa ki da u syiem Nebukhadnessar jong ka Babilonia , u syiem na ka longïing syiem Khaldi . Ïa ka Templ la pynjot bad ïa ki briew la ringmraw sha Babilonia .

Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , ïa ka miej , ïa u diengpynïeng shrah , ïa ki duwan , ïa ki khiew ki pliang ba ki lyngdoh ki pyndonkam ha ka Jaka Kyrteng , bad ïa ka pyrda ha ka jingkhang sha ka Jaka kaba Kyntang Tam . Kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïada bad ktien tiar ki tar .
translation.en: As for the sons of Merari , thou shalt number them after their families , by the house of their fathers  ;

translation.kha: U la rupa lyngba kito ki thain bad u la pynshlur ïa ki bynriew da ki khubor Ibbah pung .
translation.en: And when he had gone over those parts , and had given them much exhortation , he came into Greece ,

translation.kha: Em ! Ngin leit bad pa’ shat ki briew jong Phin .
translation.en: And they said unto her , Surely we will return with thee unto thy people .
Also their love , and their hatred , and their envy , is now perished  ; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun .
translation.kha: Ki jingieit jong ki , ki jingisih jong ki , ki jingkwah jong ki , baroh ki ïap lem bad ki . Kin ym lah shuh da lei lei ban ïashim bynta ha kano kano kaba jia ha kane ka pyrthei .

translation.en: When you meet members of our local congregation , try to get to know them better .
translation.kha: Lada phi ïakynduh ïa ki dkhot ka balang jong ngi , pyrshang ban tip kham bha ïa ki .

Ko Kynhun u briew , u ong , pruid dak ar tylli ki lynti na kiba u syiem ka Babilonia u lah ban wan lem pynlang la ka waitlam . Baroh ar tylli ki dei ban sdang na kajuh ka ri . bsuh ïa ka dak jingkdew shano ba ki lynti ki ïakhlad .
translation.en: Also , thou son of man , appoint thee two ways , that the sword of the king of Babylon may come : both twain shall come forth out of one land : and choose thou a place , choose it at the head of the way to the city .

And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones . The first foundation was jasper  ; the second , sapphire  ; the third , a chalcedony  ; the fourth , an emerald  ;
translation.kha: Ïa ki maw nongrim jong ka kynroh ka nongbah la pynkup itynnat da ki jait maw bakordor baroh . U maw nongrim uba nyngkong u la long u maw Jasper , uba ar u maw Sapphir , uba lai u maw Agate , uba saw u maw Emerald ,
Hato ka jingtem jong me ka lyngkot kumto ka jong ngi ?
translation.en: Are thy days as the days of man ? are thy years as man s days ,

translation.kha: Ka la don ka jingpynïap briew ha ka nongbah , hynrei ka snam ki shym bashatei ha ka khyndew ha kaba ka khyndew kur lah ban baheh ïa ka ; ka la bashatei ha u mawsiang bastem .
translation.en: For her blood is in the midst of her  ; she set it upon the top of a rock  ; she poured it not upon the ground , to cover it with dust  ;

translation.kha: Khmut Phon long kiba nyngkong ban wait shad ka jinglongmraw . Ki jingkhawai bad ki jingïadih ïabam sngewbha jong phi kin khun noh .
translation.en: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive , and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed .
And when Jesus was come into Peter s house , he saw his wife s mother laid , and sick of a fever .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit sha ka ïing jong u Petros bad hangta u la ïohi ïa ka kiaw kurim u Petros ba ka thiah pang lem bad ka jingshit .
Ma ka , ka longkmie sha ka para jong nga . Ka dei ka khun jong u kpa jong nga , hynrei ym ka khun jong ka kmie jong nga ; bad nga la shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: And yet indeed she is my sister  ; she is the daughter of my father , but not the daughter of my mother  ; and she became my wife .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la ong ïa ki ban mihnoh na ka kamra ka Dorbar , bad nangta ki la sdang ïaphylliew jingmut para ma ki .
translation.en: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council , they conferred among themselves ,
For the love of Christ constraineth us ; because we thus judge , that if one died for all , then were all dead :
translation.kha: La synshar ïa ngi da ka jingieit U Khrist , mynta ba ngi tip ba uwei u briew u la ïap na ka bynta jong uwei pa uwei , kaba mut ba baroh ki ïoh bynta lang ha ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , ha U Khrist Jisu , ïa phi kiba la ju long jngai la wallam hajan da ka jingïap kaba long ka jingkñia U Khrist .
A katno Phah long kaba kmen ban ngeit ba ka khubor jong U Trai ha pha kan ainong shisha !
translation.en: And blessed is she that believed : for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord .

translation.kha: bad baroh ki jingthung ba la bet ha ki radbah jong ka Nile kin tyrkhong bad yn sa rong noh! .
translation.en: The paper reeds by the brooks , by the mouth of the brooks , and every thing sown by the brooks , shall wither , be driven away , and be no more .

translation.kha: Kane ka jingieit kaba nga kriah ka mut ba ngin ïaid ha ka jingïohnong ïa ki hukum jong U Blei . Ka law , kitab phi baroh pa la sngewkyiuh naduh mynnyngkong , ka long ba borbah phi dei shun ïa-ïaid ha ka jingngeit .
translation.en: And this is love , that we walk after his commandments . This is the commandment , That , as ye have heard from the beginning , ye should walk in it .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem! u la ong shai ba yn don ki briew ki ban iehnoh ïa ka jingtah ha ki Ïa kiba khatduh : Kin kohnguh ïa ki mynsiem bashukor bun kin bud ïa ki jinghikai jyllang ki ksuid .
translation.en: Now the Spirit speaketh expressly , that in the latter times some shall depart from the faith , giving heed to seducing spirits , and doctrines of devils ;
Therefore shall her plagues come in one day , death , and mourning , and famine  ; and she shall be utterly burned with fire : for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her .
translation.kha: Namar kane , ha ka shi sngi yn sa shoh ïa ka da ki khlam — ka jingpang , ka jingsngewsih bad ka  nemsniew . Bad yn thang ïa ka da ka ding , namar ba U Trai uba U Blei , uba bishar ïa ka , u long uba khlaiñbor .

Ha khmih , ko pa jong nga , khmih ïa ka lyngkhot ka jaiñjot jong phi ka nga bat ! Ngan jingai da la pynïap ïa phi , hynrei pynban sa shu ot noh tang ïa kane . Kane ka dei ban pynneh ïa phi ba mem don jingmut ei ei ban ïalang pyrshah ne pynmynsaw ïa phi . Phi la beh mutdur ïa nga ba-bang pynap ïa nga , wat la nam shem leh kano kano kaba bakla ïa phi .
translation.en: Moreover , my father , see , yea , see the skirt of thy robe in my hand : for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe , and killed thee not , know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand , and I have not sinned against thee  ; yet thou huntest my soul to take it .
So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom , ka ktien jong U Trai ka la ïai saphriang bad nang khlaiñ .

Ki nongwei barunar ki khet noh ïa u bad Iehnoh ïa u . Ki tnat dieng ba la khia jong u kin haduh ha Man la u lymbung bad ka them ha ka ri . Ki jaitbynriew barhem kiba im ha ki jingkah syrngiew jong u kan phet nep .
translation.en: And strangers , the terrible of the nations , have cut him off , and have left him : upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen , and his boughs are broken by all the rivers of the land  ; and all the people of the earth are gone down from his shadow , and have left him .

translation.kha: Ha ka por mynba U Herod u long u syiem ka Judia , la don u lyngdoh Uba kyrteng u Sekharaïah , uba dei na ka pateng lyngdoh jong u Abijah . Ka kyrteng jrong ka tngit jong u , ka long ka Elisabeth ; ma ka ruh ka la long na ka longïing lyngkhot .
translation.en: There was in the days of Herod , the king of Judaea , a certain priest named Zacharias , of the course of Abia : and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron , and her name was Elisabeth .

translation.kha: Long nur-um tap ?
translation.en: Can I make a phone call ?

translation.en: And the king talked with Gehazi the servant of the man of God , saying , Tell me , I pray thee , all the great things that Elisha hath done .

translation.en: If a woman also vow a vow unto the  Lord  , and bind herself by a bond , being in her father s house in her youth  ;

translation.en: Behold now , I have ordered my cause  ; I know that I shall be justified .

translation.kha: Ngam lah shat hajuh ïa ki lai ngut kiwei patar ki nongaplangbrot , babha la isih ïa nga , bad nga la beh noh ïa ki Baroh hapoh shi bniat .
translation.en: Three shepherds also I cut off in one month  ; and my soul lothed them , and their soul also abhorred me .

translation.en: No servant can serve two masters : for either he will hate the one , and love the other  ; or else he will hold to the one , and despise the other . Ye cannot serve God and mammon .

translation.en: By Silvanus , a faithful brother unto you , as I suppose , I have written briefly , exhorting , and testifying that this is the true grace of God wherein ye stand .

translation.en: And see , and , behold , if the daughters of Shiloh come out to dance in dances , then come ye out of the vineyards , and catch you every man his wife of the daughters of Shiloh , and go to the land of Benjamin .
