translation.kha: U Jehu u wiat ïa la ka riewngeit nabar katba don la ka bor u siat ïa u khnam bad u dei ïa u Joram na shadkmen bad u ngam haduh u klongsnam jong u . U Joram u kyllon ïap ha ka kad ïapom jngai u ,
translation.en: And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength , and smote Jehoram between his arms , and the arrow went out at his heart , and he sunk down in his chariot .

translation.kha: ibha dat ka para ka wan , U Trai un siaw kum ka dak ïa ki Ijipt ban wan kumto ki ksaiñ na ki shniah kiba jngai eh jong ka wah Nile , malade ïa ki Assyria banbeiñ wan kum ki ngap na ka ri jngai ki .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the  Lord  shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt , and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria .

translation.kha: Namar U Mynsiem uba U Blei u la ai ïa phi um pynong ïa Phin ki mraw bad pynlong ïa phi shun shaphang ; pynnep U Mynsiem u pynlong ïa phoi ki khun jong U Blei , bad da ka bor U Mynsiem ngi pyrta sha U Blei jong ngi , Ko Kpa ! Ko Kpa jong nga !
translation.en: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear ; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption , whereby we cry , Abba , Father .
In the visions of God brought he me into the land of Israel , and set me upon a very high mountain , by which was as the frame of a city on the south .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw , U Blei u la rah ïa nga sha ka ri Israel , bad u la pynshong ïa nga halor uwei u lumbah uba jrong . Nga la ïohi ha khmat jong nga shi kynhun ki jingtei kiba i kum ka nongbah .
Haba ka waiñ ka la loit noh , ka kmie U Jisu ka la ong ïa u , Kim khong aiñ shiah .
translation.en: And when they wanted wine , the mother of Jesus saith unto him , They have no wine .

translation.kha: Ulla u brup u la ïalam ïa ang lyngba ka khyrdop ba shata mihngi sha ka phyllaw bashapoh . U la thew ïa ka khyrdop bad ka la heh katei kum kiwei pat .
translation.en: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east : and he measured the gate according to these measures .
And the rest of the acts of Shallum , and his conspiracy which he made , behold , they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Shallum u la leh , kynthup ïa ka jingïathuh ïa ka jingïasylla jong u , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

Ngan pynshitom ïa ka namar kito ki Por kiba ka la klet ïa nga mynba ka trep ki jingbeit ïa u Baal bad ka la pynkhap pynphai ïa lade da ki jingdeng bakordor haba ka leit bud nadien ïa kiba ieit jong ka . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim , wherein she burned incense to them , and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels , and she went after her lovers , and forgat me , saith the  Lord .
But he , whom God raised again , saw no corruption .
translation.kha: Hynrei kane kam shym la jia ha uta ïa uba U Blei u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: That they may keep thee from the strange woman , from the stranger which flattereth with her words .
translation.kha: Kin pyllait ïa phi na ki tnga jong kiwei pat ki briew , na ki kynthei kiba nang ban kren ïa ki ktien kiba pynshohbieit .

translation.en: And Jesus rebuked the devil  ; and he departed out of him : and the child was cured from that very hour .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u ksuid , bad u la mihnoh shabar jong u khynnah , bad ha kata ka khyllipmat la pynkhiah ïa u .
Kam myntor ïa me shun Shua ïai kren ; ka longkmie kaba shai kdar ba mem sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba me kren .
translation.en: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain  ; he multiplieth words without knowledge .

translation.kha: Kumta u Samuel u leit phai ryngkat bad u , pynlang u Saul u la mane ïa U Trai .
translation.en: So Samuel turned again after Saul  ; and Saul worshipped the  Lord .

translation.kha: U la ïap , bad la tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah u Dedan , nabar u Aïah u khuid jongki u , u long syiemsad ha ka Jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Jotham slept with his fathers , and they buried him in the city of David : and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Ka jingtied ka la tei ïa la ka ïing , bad ka la pynïeng hynñiew tylli ki rishot ïa ka .
translation.en: Wisdom hath builded her house , she hath hewn out her seven pillars :

translation.kha: U buh ïa kita ki kyrwoh hajan ka rmiang ba kyang bat ïa ki diengthang jingbah lehbha rieh ïa ka .
translation.en: Over against the border were the rings , the places for the staves to bear the table .

translation.kha: Kane ka jingïohipaw shngain ki jingkñia ha ka por janmiet bad mynhynne ïa kaba la batai ha me tud urlong shisha . Hynrei buhrieh ïa ka mynta , namar kan shim por shibun ha shuwa ban kan urlong shisha .
translation.en: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true : wherefore shut thou up the vision  ; for it shall be for many days .

translation.kha: U Trai u la nguh , To rue da ka jingkmen , ko ki paid ka Jerusalem ! Nga Wan shun shong ban Hukum hapdeng jong pa’ !
translation.en: Sing and rejoice , O daughter of Zion : for , lo , I come , and I will dwell in the midst of thee , saith the  Lord .
The  Lord  spake also unto me again , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren pat ha nga .
U shah ïa ki bariew kiba thngan banbeiñ shongduh hangto , Bad tei ki nongbah ban shong ban sah ha ki .
translation.en: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell , that they may prepare a city for habitation  ;

translation.kha: hynñiew me , me ïohi ; me khmih’ ïa ka jingjynjar bad ka jingshah shitom , bad me ïailong uba la kloi ban ïarep . U brup u bym don nongiarap u aiti ïa lade ha me ; me la ju ïarap ïa uba kyrduh .
translation.en: Thou hast seen it  ; for thou beholdest mischief and spite , to requite it with thy hand : the poor committeth himself unto thee  ; thou art the helper of the fatherless .

translation.kha: U Tom u hap na lybong kmie jong u .
translation.en: Tom fell off his mother's lap .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Amasaïah u kynti ban shahshkor . Ka dei ka ma U Bela ba U Amasaïah un shahjop , namar ba u la mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki nongot Edom .
translation.en: But Amaziah would not hear  ; for it came of God , that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies , because they sought after the gods of Edom .

translation.kha: U Hasael u syiem ka Syria u thoin beiñ ïa ki Israel baroh shi lyntang ka jingsynshar u Jehoahas ,
translation.en: But Hazael king of Syria oppressed Israel all the days of Jehoahaz .
But in all Israel there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty : from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ha Israel uba pawnam ha ka jingbhabriew kat u Absalom ; um don kano kano ka jingduna naduh khlieh haduh sla jat .

translation.en: And when the king s decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire , ( for it is great , ) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour , both to great and small .
translation.kha: Haba ïa ka jingpynbna jong phi la pynphriang sha kylleng sawdong jong kane ka hima baïar , kawei pa kawei ka kynthei kan ai ha ki tnga jong ki ïa ka burom ba dei , la u riewspah ne duk .
Balei beiñ ba ngam peiphang ? Balei keiñ ba ïam sha ba kiaw kin pynbeit ïa nga ?
translation.en: And say , How have I hated instruction , and my heart despised reproof  ;
And a voice came out of the throne , saying , Praise our God , all ye his servants , and ye that fear him , both small and great .
translation.kha: Nangta , ka jingsawa jong ka sur ka la wan na ka khet , ka da ong ,  To ïaroh ïa U Blei jong ngi , phi baroh ki shakri bad ki briew jong u , kiba rit bad kiba khraw kumjuh , kiba ñiewburom ïa u !
Pha bud ha ki dien jat ka Ahiman jong pha , bad kumta ngan ai ha pha ïa kajuh ka khuri jong ka jingpyndem ïa-ban dih .
translation.en: Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister  ; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand .

translation.kha: Namar ba phi kwah un-long hir ïa ki jingai jong U Mynsiem , phi dei ban pyrshang nalor kiwei kiei barieh ban hasem pyndonkam ïa kito Ibbah long jingïarap ban tei ïa ka balang .
translation.en: Even so ye , forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts , seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church .

translation.kha: U bri naba shylliah u pyrkhat ba u kham stad ban ïa hynriewphew ngut ki briew kiba lah ban ai ki nia kiba ibha na ka bynta ka jingmut jong ki .
translation.en: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason .
And he said unto them ,  Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel , or under a bed ? and not to be set on a candlestick ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la bteng ,  Hato ju don uno uno uba wallam ïa ka sharak bad buh ïa ka hapoh ka shang lane ha khrum jingthiah ? Hato um buh ïa ka ha u diengpynïeng sharak ?

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Cast the net on the right side of the ship , and ye shall find .  They cast therefore , and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes .
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Bret ïa ka jar shaphang kamon jong ka lieng , bad phin sa ngat katto katne .  Kumta ki la bret ïa ka jar bad kim lah tan shuh ïa ka , namar ba ki la ngat bun eh ki dohkha .
U la ai ka jingshongthait dara ka jingjahthait ïa phi baïar , hynrei phi kyntait ngab shahshkor ïa u .
translation.en: To whom he said , This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest  ; and this is the refreshing : yet they would not hear .

translation.kha: Te mynta por hukum ba lada uno uno na Kane kano ka hima , ka jingïohipaw , lane ka ktien uba kren khlem bur ïa U Blei jong u shahshkor , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego , dei Ban tait ïa u na ka kti bad kjat , bad ïa ka ïing jong u dei ban pynlong ka kynton ki jingpra . Ym ne uno uno u blei uba lah ban pyllait im kumne .
translation.en: Therefore I make a decree , That every people , nation , and language , which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , shall be cut in pieces , and their houses shall be made a dunghill : because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort .

translation.kha: hynñiew u Paul u la ong ha u rangbah shipai malade ha ki shipai , Lydda ki maji kim don ha ka lieng , phim to jingkyrmen shuh ban lait im .
translation.en: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers , Except these abide in the ship , ye cannot be saved .

translation.kha: Tikbah hok ki ïohi ïa kane bad ki kmen , hynrei ïa baroh kiba bymman la pynsngap jar .
translation.en: The righteous shall see it , and rejoice : and all iniquity shall stop her mouth .

translation.kha: to tim ïa ki bad pyndap ïa ki da ka jingdup jingkyrmen !
translation.en: Give them sorrow of heart , thy curse unto them .
A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me , because I go to the Father .
translation.kha: Sa tang shipor phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga , bad nangta sa shipor hadien phin sa ïohi ïa nga .
To kren pyrshah ïa u , bad ïathuh ha u ba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga long u nongshun jong u .
translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Gog , the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal :

translation.kha: bad mar kumta hi u la kiew halor ka lieng ryngkat bad ki synran jong u bad u la leit shata ka distrik Dalmanutha .
translation.en: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples , and came into the parts of Dalmanutha .
That thou enquirest after mine iniquity , and searchest after my sin ?
translation.kha: Te balei ba me wad bniah ïa baroh ki pop jong nga bad ïit lut ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingduna ba nga don ?

Mynta , ko Kynhun u briew , to teh ïa ka Lied kumba u nongpynkren u leh bad Mynno ha shuwa ba wan ka Die . Ai ba utai uwei baroh un ioh ba me mihnoh bad leit sha kawei pat ka jaka . Lehse kito kiba ainong ïaleh pynshisha kin ïohi ïa me .
translation.en: Therefore , thou son of man , prepare thee stuff for removing , and remove by day in their sight  ; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight : it may be they will consider , though they be a rebellious house .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki bhabriew ibha la shong la sah ha Samaria ki ïai bteng ban thaw ïa la ki bleithaw , bad ki buh ïa ki ha ki jaka mane kiba ki Israel ki la tei . Kwah pa kawei ka kynhun ka la thaw ïa ki bleithaw ha ki nongjop ha kiba ki shong ki sah :
translation.en: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own , and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made , every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt .

Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates , whatsoever thy soul lusteth after , according to the blessing of the  Lord  thy God which he hath given thee : the unclean and the clean may eat thereof , as of the roebuck , and as of the hart .
translation.kha: La katta ruh , phi lah ban pynïap bad bam ïa ki jingri jong phi kat shaba phi shong phi sah . Phi lah ban bam kat kumba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa phi . Baroh na phi , kiba khuid ne ki bymkhuid , phi lah ban bam ïa ki , kumba bam ïa ka doh skei ne ka doh sier .
U Trai u khmih ba ïa ka jingshisha la ri kyndong da kaba pynpulom ïa ki ktien jong ki nonglamler .
translation.en: The eyes of the  Lord  preserve knowledge , and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor .
Sihon king of the Amorites : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: ïa u Sihon , u syiem ki Amor ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;

translation.en: Wherefore I perceive that there is nothing better , than that a man should rejoice in his own works  ; for that is his portion : for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him ?
translation.kha: Kumta nga la sngewthuh te ba kaba bha tam kaba ngi lah ban leh ka long ban lehkmen ïa kaei kaba ngi la trei . Ym don kano kano kawei pat kaba ngi lah ban leh . Ym don kano kano ka lynti ïa ngi ban tip kaei ka ban jia ynda ngi ïap .

translation.en: Having yet therefore one son , his wellbeloved , he sent him also last unto them , saying , They will reverence my son .
translation.kha: Uba dang sah ïa uba yn phah u long u khun ba-ieit jong u trai hi . Ha kaba khatduh , te , u la phah ïa la u khun sha ki nongshimwai . ‘ Nga ngeit skhem kin burom ïa u khun jong nga ,’ u la ong .

translation.en: But they , when they were departed , spread abroad his fame in all that country .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la leit noh bad pynphriang ïa ka khubor shaphang U Jisu ha kylleng jong kata ka bynta jong ka ri .

translation.en: And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal , and , lo , there was a great earthquake  ; and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair , and the moon became as blood  ;
translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohi ïa U Khunlangbrot ba u pynpait ïa ka jingpyndait kaba hynriew . Ka la don ka jingkhynñiuh jumai kaba jur , bad ka sngi ka la kylla rong ïong kum ka jaiñ ïong kaba khain , bad u bnai u la kylla rong saw kum ka snam .
Haba ki Israel ki la ïohsngew ïa ka hukum ba la pule , ki la kyntait noh ïa ki nongwei na ka imlang sahlang .
translation.en: Now it came to pass , when they had heard the law , that they separated from Israel all the mixed multitude .

translation.kha: To buh ïa u maw jingtip na ka bynta ka Moab ; shen yn pynjot ïa ka . Ïa ki shnong jong ka yn ieh ha ka jingjot , bad yn ym don Shua uwei ruh u ban shongsah ban sah pat hangta .
translation.en: Give wings unto Moab , that it may flee and get away : for the cities thereof shall be desolate , without any to dwell therein .
If a ruler hearken to lies , all his servants are wicked .
translation.kha: Lada u nongsynshar u shahshkor ïa ka jingai jingtip balamler , baroh ki rangbah synshar kin kylla long ki riewlamler .
Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aram ki long ki briew jong ka Us , ka Hul , ka Gether , bad ka Meshek .
translation.en: And the children of Aram  ; Uz , and Hul , and Gether , and Mash .
Examine yourselves , whether ye be in the faith ; prove your own selves . Know ye not your own selves , how that Jesus Christ is in you , except ye be reprobates ?
translation.kha: To tynjuh ïa lade bad bishar hi da lade , ban shem la phi im ne em ha ka jingngeit . Hato da shisha phi tip ba U Khrist Jisu u don ha phi ? — lymda phi la long kiba la shahjop noh .

U Elisha u phai sha u Gehasi bad u ong , Pynkloi ! Shim ïa u diengduh jong nga bad khie lytar . Wat sangeh ban khublei nangno ïano ba me ïakynton , malu lada uno uno u khublei ïa me , kdew shim por don jubab . Leit beit sha ka ïing pynlang buh ïa u diengduh jong nga hajir jong u khynnah .
translation.en: Then he said to Gehazi , Gird up thy loins , and take my staff in thine hand , and go thy way : if thou meet any man , salute him not  ; and if any salute thee , answer him not again : and lay my staff upon the face of the child .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta jongngi ki nga kwah ba kun jin da la don hapoh ka jingtim U Blei ba la pynïakhlad na U Khrist .
translation.en: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren , my kinsmen according to the flesh :

translation.kha: U Joseph u buh ïa u Ephraim ha ka jar kadiang jong u Jakob bun ïa u Mahanaim ha ka balang khambun jong u .
translation.en: And Joseph took them both , Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel s left hand , and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel s right hand , and brought them near unto him .

translation.kha: Haba u Saul bad u shakuriaw jong u ki poi ha Gibeah , shuh kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïakynduh ïa u . Kynsan kynja U Mynsiem jong U blei u wiang da ka ba ha u , dara u ïasoh lang bad ki ha ka jingïashad bashongshit bad ha ka jingïarisa .
translation.en: And when they came thither to the hill , behold , a company of prophets met him  ; and the Spirit of God came upon him , and he prophesied among them .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta jong nga , U Kpa u la jied ïa por bad u la phah ïa nga sha ka pyrthei . Kumno , te , phi lah ban ong ba nga krenbeiñ blei namar ba nga la ong ba nga long U Te U Blei ?
translation.en: Say ye of him , whom the Father hath sanctified , and sent into the world , Thou blasphemest  ; because I said , I am the Son of God ?

translation.kha: Ha kano kano ka por ba phi ïew ka kaweh , ni ïa kob bha ïa kito kiba donkam ïa ka .
translation.en: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due , when it is in the power of thine hand to do it .

translation.kha: Kumta wat khuslai : ‘ Nangno ka jingbam jong nga kad wan ? lane ka jingdih jong sa ? lane ki jaiñ jong nga ?’
translation.en: Therefore take no thought , saying , What shall we eat ? or , What shall we drink ? or , Wherewithal shall we be clothed ?

translation.kha: Ki radbah synshar jongki u Amon ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa u bad ki pynap ïa u ha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And his servants conspired against him , and slew him in his own house .

translation.kha: Hato u masi prut un trei na ka bynta jong me ? Hammoth u mon ban pynliat ïa ka miej ha ka ma jong me ?
translation.en: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee , or abide by thy crib ?

translation.kha: Ka jingsarong jong pha ka la shukor ïa pha . Ka nongbah jong pha ka long ka kut myrsiang baskhem ; ka ïing jong pha ka don ha kliar ki lumbah , bad kumta phi ong ha lade , ‘ Uei uba eh ba-bang pynhiar ïa at sha tbian ?’
translation.en: The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee , thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock , whose habitation is high  ; that saith in his heart , Who shall bring me down to the ground ?

translation.kha: U syiem Ahab , u la khah sha madan , u la knieh ïa ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom , bad u jop thiaw ïa ki nongai Syria .
translation.en: And the king of Israel went out , and smote the horses and chariots , and slew the Syrians with a great slaughter .

translation.kha: jynreiñ uwei na ki rangbah u ong ha u , Ngi barieh ngi la tlot na ka jingthngan , hynrei i pa jong phi i la byrngem ïa ngi bad nong , ‘ Ka jingtim kan lama ha Un un uba bam ei ei mynta ka sngi .’
translation.en: Then answered one of the people , and said , Thy father straitly charged the people with an oath , saying , Cursed be the man that eateth any food this day . And the people were faint .

translation.kha: Ka sien bran bran ban ïathuh ha la u kpa ; bad Haba u la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang u pyrsa lad u , u Jakob , mar mar u leit shun ïashitom ïa u ; u la kdup malu u doh ïa u , bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ïing .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister s son , that he ran to meet him , and embraced him , and kissed him , and brought him to his house . And he told Laban all these things .

translation.kha: Ki apostol ha Jerusalem ki la ïohsngew ba ki nong Sarai ki la pdiang ïa ka ktien U Blei , kumta ki la phah ïa u Paul bad u Ïoannis sha ki .
translation.en: Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God , they sent unto them Peter and John :
And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak , and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech , the gods of Sepharvaim .
translation.kha: Ki bleithaw jong ka Nibhas bad Tartak ; bad ki briew ka Sepharbaim ki kñia ïa la ki khun kum ki jingainguh thang ïa ki blei Adrammelekh bad Anammelekh .
Wat thmu ïa ki rukom pynspong iwei ïa uei pat . Waw ai ïa ka jingsakhi lamler ha kaba jingsmai . Nga isih ïa ka jinglamler , ka jingbymlehhok bad ka jinglehbor .
translation.en: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour  ; and love no false oath : for all these are things that I hate , saith the  Lord .
And will be a Father unto you , and ye shall be my sons and daughters , saith the Lord Almighty .
translation.kha: Ngan long U Kpa jong phi , bad phin long ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong nga , ong U Trai Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine , which shall be for their destruction , and which I will send to destroy you : and I will increase the famine upon you , and will break your staff of bread :
translation.kha: Ngan pynsangeh noh ïa ka jingwanrah bam ïa pha bad ngan pynshahthngan ïa pha . Phan sa sngew ïa ka jingtynrah ka jingthngan kum ki khnam banep ba la siat ban pynjot ïa pha .
Ha kajuh ka pa u Elisha u nongïathuhlypa u la khot ïa uwei na ki nonghiarpateng samla , bad u ong ha u , khreh bad leit sha Ramoth ha Gilead . rahah ïa une u khiew umphniang Olib bad me ,
translation.en: And Elisha the prophet called one of the children of the prophets , and said unto him , Gird up thy loins , and take this box of oil in thine hand , and go to Ramoth–gilead :
Then came the children of Israel , even the whole congregation , into the desert of Zin in the first month : and the people abode in Kadesh  ; and Miriam died there , and was buried there .
translation.kha: Ha u bnai uba nyngkong , u paid Israel baroh u wan poi ha ka ri khlaw Sin bad u shong dara ha Kadesh . Hangta ka Miriam ka la ïap bad la tep ïa ka .
Ha Kaba ïadei bad ang , nga khong ha ka bor jong phi ! To ar ïa nga ïa kano ïano kaba phira pyrkhat ba ka long kaba biang dara kaba dei .
translation.en: As for me , behold , I am in your hand : do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you .
What say I then ? that the idol is any thing , or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing ?
translation.kha: Hato nga thew , te , ba ka bleithaw ne ka jingbam ba la kñia ha ka , ka long ei ei ?
U Moses u pynïap ïa u , badno u theh ïa ka snam ha baroh sawdong jong ka duwan .
translation.en: And he killed it  ; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about .
Neither is there any daysman betwixt us , that might lay his hand upon us both .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym don uno uno uba wan hapdeng jong ngi — ym don u ban bishar ïa U Blei bad ïa nga .

Ki jingkñia ainguh , ki jingkylla pop bad ki jingkñia na ka bynta ngab siew paw , kin long ki jingbymman jong ki lyngdoh , malade ki kin ïoh ïa kiei kiei barhem ha Israel ïa kiba la pynkyrpang na ka bynta jong nga .
translation.en: They shall eat the meat offering , and the sin offering , and the trespass offering  ; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs .

translation.kha: U briew uba stad , uba rangbah jingot u long uba paw ha ka jingpyntieng jong u . Kat nang sngewtynnat ki ktien ba u kren , mawria u on lah ban pynkohnguh .
translation.en: The wise in heart shall be called prudent : and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynba u shem Nebusaradan u la hiarthma ïa ka ri , ngi la rai ban wan sha Jerusalem ban lait na ki kynhun shipai ka Babilonia bad ka Syria . Dei na kano ka daw balei ba ngi ïasnohlang ïasah ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: But it came to pass , when Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon came up into the land , that we said , Come , and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans , and for fear of the army of the Syrians : so we dwell at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ym don ei ei ha Ngi kaba ngi haw Ban dawa ba i long kiba bit ban leh ïa kane ka kim . Ka jinglah jong ngi ka wan na U Blei ;
translation.en: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves ; but our sufficiency is of God ;

translation.kha: Kine hynñiew ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew ba u Jakob u ïoh na ka Bilhah kaba u Laban u ai ha ka Barakel ka khun jong u ban Long ka mraw jong ka .
translation.en: These are the sons of Bilhah , which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter , and she bare these unto Jacob : all the souls were seven .

translation.kha: Namar kan , uwei pa uwei ha ka pyrthei un tipbriew haduh Katto ka bor jong U Trai ka longïing naba khraw , bad ba phin burom ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi junom .
translation.en: That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the  Lord  , that it is mighty : that ye might fear the  Lord  your God for ever .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Yn ym don na ki song ba-marjan bakha la ñiewbeiñ ïa ka Israel da ka jingkrenbeiñ , ki ban long pat kum ki shiah malu ki shiah buid ban pynmong ïa ki Israel . Bad kin tip ba ma nga , nga long U Trai nongsynshar .
translation.en: And there shall be no more a pricking brier unto the house of Israel , nor any grieving thorn of all that are round about them , that despised them  ; and they shall know that I am the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ngi don u lyngdoh Uba khraw ibha peit ïa ka ïing U Blei .
translation.en: And having an high priest over the house of God  ;

And thou , Ezra , after the wisdom of thy God , that is in thine hand , set magistrates and judges , which may judge all the people that are beyond the river , all such as know the laws of thy God  ; and teach ye them that know them not .
translation.kha: Ma me , ko Esra , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingstad kaba U Blei jong me u la ai ha me , men thung ki nongsynshar bad ki nongbishar ki ban synshar ïa ki briew baroh jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi kiba im da ka Hukum jong U Blei jong me . Me dei ban hikai ïa kato ka Hukum ha uno uno u bymtip ïa ka .
kim lah don peit ïa ka jingbam bad ki la jaiñ ban ïap .
translation.en: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat  ; and they draw near unto the gates of death .
Though a sinner do evil an hundred times , and his days be prolonged , yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God , which fear before him :
translation.kha: U nongpop u lah ban leh shispah tylli ki kam runar bad u dang im . O ! ho-oid , nga tip ïa kaei ba ki ong :  Lada phi kohnguh ïa U Blei , kiei kiei baroh kin bit kin biang ,
U la pynbor ïa nga ban shong ha ka jingdum babniah kajuh jyllang ka jingïapan .
translation.en: He hath set me in dark places , as they that be dead of old .
Judah is a lion s whelp : from the prey , my son , thou art gone up : he stooped down , he couched as a lion , and as an old lion  ; who shall rouse him up ?
translation.kha: U Judah u long kum u sing , Haba u la pynïap ïa uba u thmu u leit phai sha la krem ; Hangta u dem , bad u thiah . Uei uba nud ban pynthut ïa u ?

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Azariah , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Ussaïah u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

translation.en: Ye that fear the  Lord  , trust in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .
translation.kha: To shaniah ha U  Trai  , phi baroh kiba mane ïa u . U ïarap ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi .
Kumba U Trai u pynmanbha mala pynluin ïa phi da kaba kmen , kumta ruh da kaba kmen un pynjot bad pynduh pyndam ïa phin . Yn sa rat jingkhang ïa phi na kata ka ri ba phin ïohkynti .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that as the  Lord  rejoiced over you to do you good , and to multiply you  ; so the  Lord  will rejoice over you to destroy you , and to bring you to nought  ; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it .
Wherefore I have not sinned against thee , but thou doest me wrong to war against me : the  Lord  the Judge be judge this day between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: Em , ngam shym leh bymdei ei ei ïa me . Ma me uba leh bymdei ïa nga da kaba ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa nga . U  Trai  u long u Nongbishar . Un rai mynta ka sngi hapdeng ki Israel bad ki Ammon .
“Men la ka ïing , ha ka jingshim , la tei da uno Uno — Bad uta uba la thaw ïa kiei kiwei baroh erlangthari U Balei kiew .
translation.en: For every house is builded by some man  ; but he that built all things is God .

translation.kha: pynjahburom ïa U Tharai U Blei jong phin da kaweh pa’ rakhe hynñiew sngi ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha kata ka jaka mane Blei . To lehkmen , namar U Trai u la kyrshut ïa ki jingmih baroh ba phi la ïoh ot bad ïa ka ki Jong phi baroh .
translation.en: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the  Lord  thy God in the place which the  Lord  shall choose : because the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase , and in all the works of thine hands , therefore thou shalt surely rejoice .

And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem , that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way  ; and he had clad himself with a new garment  ; and they two were alone in the field :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , katba u Jeroboam u dang mih na Jerusalem , u Ahijah u nongïathuhlypa uba na Shiloh , u ïakynduh ïa u marwei ha lynti kaba ha rudnong .

translation.en: Did not Moses give you the law , and yet none of you keepeth the law ? Why go ye about to kill me ?
translation.kha: U Moses u la ai ha phi ïa ka Hukum , hato ym dei kumta ? Hynrei ym don uwei na phi uba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum . Balei ba phi pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ?
Ha ki bet ïa ka lyer , kin ïoh ot ïa ka erlangthari ! U kew baroh shi pynthor u bym pat ih un ym lah ban pynmih kpu . Hynrei wat lada u pynmareh ruh , ki nongwei kin bam ei ïa u .
translation.en: For they have sown the wind , and they shall reap the whirlwind : it hath no stalk : the bud shall yield no meal : if so be it yield , the strangers shall swallow it up .

Moreover he said unto me , Son of man , behold , I will break the staff of bread in Jerusalem : and they shall eat bread by weight , and with care  ; and they shall drink water by measure , and with astonishment :
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ruh ,  Ko khun u briew , ngan sa pynduna bam ïa ka Jerusalem . Ki briew hangto kin da sa shem jynjar bad sngewkhuslai namar ba ki hap ban da thew ïa ka jingbam ba ki bam bad ïa ka um ba ki dih .
Kumta u kylli na U Trai , Hato ngan leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia ? Ho-oid U Trai u jubab . Tur ïaleh ïa ki bad pyllait im ïa ka Keilah .
translation.en: Therefore David enquired of the  Lord  , saying , Shall I go and smite these Philistines ? And the  Lord  said unto David , Go , and smite the Philistines , and save Keilah .

translation.kha: Ngi ngeit ba U Jisu u la ïap bad u la mihpat , bad kumno ngi ngeit ba U Blei un Shim pat bad U Jisu ïa kito kiba la ïarap da kaba jingkit ha u .
translation.en: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again , even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him .

translation.kha: Ha ka sien ïathied tawiar kaba hynñiew , hamar ba ki lyngdoh kin put ïa ki turoi , u Joshua u hukum ïa u paidbah ban risa , bad u nguh , U Tiras u la ai ha phi ïa ka nongjop !
translation.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time , when the priests blew with the trumpets , Joshua said unto the people , Shout  ; for the  Lord  hath given you the city .
And they killed the passover , and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands , and the Levites flayed them .
translation.kha: Hadien ba la pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang , ki Lebi ki khoh snieh ïa ki , bad ki lyngdoh ki synreit snam ha ka duwan .
Ong ïa ki paid Israel ban wan ai ha me khat-ar tylli ki diengïap , uwei uwei u diengkhap na u nongïalam jong kawei Kaei ka jait . Thoh ïa ka kyrteng uta u briew ha u diengduh jongno u ,
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers , of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods : write thou every man s name upon his rod .

translation.kha: U Meremoth , u khun jong u Uriah bad u ksiew jong u Hakkos u twa ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Meshullam , u khun jong u Berekhaïah dara u ksiew lad u Meshesabel u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud . U Sekakah , u khwan jongu u Baana u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .
translation.en: And next unto them repaired Meremoth the son of Uriah , the son of Koz . And next unto them repaired Meshullam the son of Berechiah , the son of Meshezabeel . And next unto them repaired Zadok the son of Baanah .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba la ïohsngew ïa kane ki la kylli , Mano , te , uba lah ban lait im ?
translation.en: And they that heard it said , Who then can be saved ?
And he came into all the country about Jordan , preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins  ;
translation.kha: Kumta u Ïoannis u la leit kylleng ka thain baroh jong ka wah Jordan , u da ïalap ,  To phai noh na ki pop jong phi bad to shah ba yn pynbaptis , bad U Blei un map ïa ki pop jong phi .
‘ Khie leit ,’ U Trai u la ong ha nga , ‘ naba ngan phah ïa me sha jngai sha ki Jentil .’
translation.en: And he said unto me ,  Depart : for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles .

translation.kha: Ngan ym randien lano lano ruh na ka jingdawa ba ngam shym bakla ; ka jingïalam jongki nga ka beit .
translation.en: My righteousness I hold fast , and will not let it go : my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live .

translation.kha: Nangta u Haggai u kylli , Tharai ïa uno uno la pyntngit nalor ba u la ktang ïa ka mihpat . Te lada u ktien ïa kano kano na kine ki jingbam , hato kata kan pynlong ïa ki ruh ba la pyntngit ? Ki lyngkhot ki Joab , Ho-oid .
translation.en: Then said Haggai , If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these , shall it be unclean ? And the priests answered and said , It shall be unclean .

translation.kha: ban pyrkhat ïa ki dur kiba itynnat bad ban saiñ ïa ki ha ka ksiar , ha ka reng , bad ha ka rnong ;
translation.en: And to devise curious works , to work in gold , and in silver , and in brass ,

translation.kha: Ïa ki briew lad nga la pynshitom wat kham jur ban ïa ki nongshong shnong jong ka Sidon , bakha la ïadem da ka jingkyllon kaba kynsan ha ki kti jyllang U Blei .
translation.en: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom , that was overthrown as in a moment , and no hands stayed on her .

translation.kha: Me tip ïa ki Hukum : ‘ Wat klim ; wat pynïap briew ; wat tuh ; wat mudui lamler ïano ïano ; burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie .’
translation.en: Thou knowest the commandments , Do not commit adultery , Do not kill , Do not steal , Do not bear false witness , Honour thy father and thy mother .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Ahab u syiem Israel bad u Jehoshaphat u syep Jehudi ki leit tam ïabah ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .
translation.en: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth–gilead .

And after this Joseph of Arimathaea , being a disciple of Jesus , but secretly for fear of the Jews , besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus : and Pilate gave him leave . He came therefore , and took the body of Jesus .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joseph , uba na ka shnong Arimathaïa , u la pan na u Pilat lada un shah ban rah ïa ka met U Jisu . ( U Joseph u la long u nongbud jong U Jisu , hynrei ym ha kaba paw , namar ba u la sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw . ) U Pilat u la ong ïa u ba u lah ban rah ïa ka met , kumta u Joseph u la leit bad rah noh ïa ka .
U Trai u pynlong ïa ki hima kiba don sawdong ban sheptieng ban leit ïaleh thma pyrsa ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat .
translation.en: And the fear of the  Lord  fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Judah , so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat .

translation.kha: Kumta u Syiem Dabid u phah sha ïa u .
translation.en: Then king David sent , and fetched him out of the house of Machir , the son of Ammiel , from Lo–debar .

translation.kha: Kumta ki sait ïa la ki jaiñkup , bad u Moses u ong ha ki , La shi sngi , phi dei baneh Long kiba la pynkhreh malade ha kajuh ka por tv dei ban ïaheh shongkha .
translation.en: And he said unto the people , Be ready against the third day : come not at your wives .

translation.kha: u la ong ha u Moses , Sngewbha , ko kynrad , wat pynlong ïa ngi ban shah pynshitom namar ka jingleh pop ha ka jingbieit .
translation.en: And Aaron said unto Moses , Alas , my lord , I beseech thee , lay not the sin upon us , wherein we have done foolishly , and wherein we have sinned .

translation.kha: U ïakob u kyrkhu khublei bad u leit nala .
translation.en: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh , and went out from before Pharaoh .

translation.kha: Te uwei na ki Serah u la her sha tbian sha ang , da kaba rieh ïa u rnga uba rhem umbiah u la khap da ka nap na ka dil .
translation.en: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me , having a live coal in his hand , which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar :
And , behold , there are last which shall be first , and there are first which shall be last .
translation.kha: Nangta kito kiba mynta ki long kiba khatduh kin long nyngkong , bad kito kiba mynta ki long nyngkong kin long khatduh .

Ngan pynlong ha kito na phi kiba dang sah ha ka jinglongmraw ka jingsuhsieng kaba khraw kat haduh ba ka jingriew ka salia dieng ha ka jingbeh ka lawar kan pynher krad ïa phi . Phon her ïap la bania shah Bah ha madan thma , bad phin kyllon ibha u nongshun um pah don hajan .
translation.en: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies  ; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them  ; and they shall flee , as fleeing from a sword  ; and they shall fall when none pursueth .
The range of the mountains is his pasture , and he searcheth after every green thing .
translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki long ki jaka phlang ha kaba la bsa ïa ki , ha kaba ki wad ïa kano kano kaba jyrngam ban bam .

translation.en: Against whom do ye sport yourselves ? against whom make ye a wide mouth , and draw out the tongue ? are ye not children of transgression , a seed of falsehood ,
translation.kha: Ïano phi leh biria ? Ïano phi ki nongshukor phi rkhiebeiñ ?
Ki long ki briew ba nga la pynlong na ka bynta ïa lade , Bad ki rwai ïa ka jingïaroh jong nga !
translation.en: This people have I formed for myself  ; they shall shew forth my praise .
So Ahab went up to eat and to drink . And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel  ; and he cast himself down upon the earth , and put his face between his knees ,
translation.kha: Katba u Ahab u dang leit ban bam , u Elijah u kiew sha u lum Karmel , u dem khrup ha khyndew , u da buh ïa la ka khlieh hapdeng ki khohsiew jong u .

translation.en: As newborn babes , desire the sincere milk of the word , that ye may grow thereby :
translation.kha: To long kum ki khunlung kiba dang shu kha , kiba kwah hir hir borabor ïa ka dud bakhuid ba kynja mynsiem , khnang ba da kaba dih ïa ka phin san bad yn pynim ïa phi .
U Blei un pynjot ïa kito Ibbah kren sner ïa kiwei , kito kiba khanglad ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa ki riewmadan , bad kito kiba krai lamler! don khang ïa ki bri kiba hok ban Ïohi ïa ka jingbishar hok .
translation.en: That make a man an offender for a word , and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate , and turn aside the just for a thing of nought .
And Jesus said unto them ,  Can the children of the bridechamber fast , while the bridegroom is with them ? as long as they have the bridegroom with them , they cannot fast .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato phi khmih lynti ba ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha ka jingshongkurim ban leit khlem jingbam ? Ym kumta ! Katba u nongleitkurim u don ryngkat bad ki , kin ym shahthngan .

translation.en: And they took their journey from Elim , and all the congregation of the children of Israel came unto the wilderness of Sin , which is between Elim and Sinai , on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun Israel baroh ka la mihnoh na Elim , bad ha ka sngi kaba khatsan jong u bnai uba ar naduh ba ki mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt , ki la wan poi ha ka ri shyiap Sin , kaba don hapdeng ka Elim bad ka Sinai .
U la pyrkhat , Lada u Iso u wan ïaleh ïa kawei ka kynruh bad u pynjot ïa ka , kata kawei paw ka kynha ka kah ban lait im .
translation.en: And said , If Esau come to the one company , and smite it , then the other company which is left shall escape .
The counsel of the  Lord  standeth for ever , the thoughts of his heart to all generations .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki jingthmu jong u ki neh junom , ki jingthmu jong u ki long pateng la pateng .

translation.en: I was in the Spirit on the Lord s day , and heard behind me a great voice , as of a trumpet ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi U Trai , U Mynsiem u la shim ïa nga , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur bajam , kaba sawa kum ka turoi , kaba kren na shadien jong nga .
ishyrkhei , U Jisu u la khot ïa ki khynnah sha u bad u la Ong , Shah ïa ki khynñiat ban wiang shai nga bad wat khang ïa ki , ñiar ka Hiram U Blei ka long ïa kiba khem kine .
translation.en: But Jesus called them unto him , and said ,  Suffer little children to come unto me , and forbid them not : for of such is the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: Lada me maham ïa u brisoh Uba bha ba un ym har pop , dara u shahshkor ïa me bad um har pop , un im da shisha , malu ïa ka jingïam jong me ruh yn pyllait .
translation.en: Nevertheless if thou warn the righteous man , that the righteous sin not , and he doth not sin , he shall surely live , because he is warned  ; also thou hast delivered thy soul .

translation.kha: Kumta U Blei’ u la ong , Ka bha shibun . Ngan shahïap ïa me ba men pyndonkam noh da ka ut masi pynban , bad me lah Ban sahit ïa la u kpu ha ka .
translation.en: Then he said unto me , Lo , I have given thee cow s dung for man s dung , and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïoh ïa uwei u mradkhlaw babha wan mihnoh na duriaw . U la don shiphew tyrnem ki reng bad hynñiew tylli ki khlem ; halor kawei pa kawei jongno ki reng jngai ka , la don ka pansngiat , sad hajar kawei pa kawei jong ki khleh jong ka la ne ka ktang kaba jingrben Blei .
translation.en: And I stood upon the sand of the sea , and saw a beast rise up out of the sea , having seven heads and ten horns , and upon his horns ten crowns , and upon his heads the name of blasphemy .

translation.kha: Nga pynshah da ka met sha kito kiba shoh ïa nga . Ngam shym pynsangeh ïa ki hato ki kyrni ïa nga , haba ki patrong ïa ki shñiuh na u ñiuhtmoh jong nga bad bynthiew ha ka khmat jong nga .
translation.en: I gave my back to the smiters , and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair : I hid not my face from shame and spitting .

translation.kha: Mar ïa ïohsngew ïa kane , u Anakim u la kyllon ïap ; bad baroh kiba la jingïashoh shaphang kane , ki la sngewshyrkhei .
translation.en: And Ananias hearing these words fell down , and gave up the ghost : and great fear came on all them that heard these things .

translation.kha: U la ong ha ki , Phi hi phiah tip bha ba la kyang ïa u Jiw da ka niam jong u ban leit jngoh lane ïajan bad ki Jentil . Hynriew U Blei u la pyn-i ha nga ba ngam dei ban ñiew bymkhuid ne basang kat kum ka jinglehniam ïa uno uno u brai .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Ye know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company , or come unto one of another nation  ; but God hath shewed me that I should not call any man common or unclean .

translation.kha: Bad haba nga la kyrpad ïa me baneh shakor ïa ka jingkyang jong nga , me la ïohsngew .
translation.en: Thou hast heard my voice : hide not thine ear at my breathing , at my cry .

translation.kha: U Blei u long borabor bad nga ha kata ka pa malade u ai jingïakhaïi ïa na katba nga ïaid lyngraw ïa ka jingdum .
translation.en: When his candle shined upon my head , and when by his light I walked through darkness  ;

translation.kha: Phi kyntait ban ai um ïa iba kiba la thait , bad phi kyntait ban bsein ïa kito kiba thynrang .
translation.en: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink , and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry .
And I brought your fathers out of Egypt : and ye came unto the sea  ; and the Egyptians pursued after your fathers with chariots and horsemen unto the Red sea .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ïalam noh ïa phi ; nga la wallam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi na Ijipt , bad ki nong Ijipt ki la beh kthong nadien jong ki da ki kali ïapom bad ki nongshong kulai .
Ki thied bad ki tnat jong u ki la stait bad ba-tyrkhong .
translation.en: His roots shall be dried up beneath , and above shall his branch be cut off .

translation.kha: Ka jingim briew ka longïing kum ka jingri u shipai ba shu pynbor , kum ka jingim u nongïathuhlypa sngi uba hap ban trei shitom ,
translation.en: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth ? are not his days also like the days of an hireling ?

translation.kha: lehse ïa kaei kambah nga ong , bad phin ïoh im . Da sumar bha ban bud ïa ki jingkhaïi jongnga nga kumba phi sumar ïa la ki khmat ;
translation.en: Keep my commandments , and live  ; and my law as the apple of thine eye .

translation.kha: Naba ka bor jong ki khlei ka don ha ki shylluit jyllang ki bad ruh ha ki tdong jong ki . Ki tdong jong ki , ki long kum ki bseiñ ba don ki khlieh , bun ki pyndonkam ïa ki ban pynmynsaw ïa ki briew .
translation.en: For their power is in their mouth , and in their tails : for their tails were like unto serpents , and had heads , and with them they do hurt .
And he took Agag the king of the Amalekites alive , and utterly destroyed all the people with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: u la kem im ïa u Agag , u syiem Amalek bad u la pynïap ïa ki briew baroh .
Bad ibha nga la sdang ban kren , U Mynsiem bakhuid u la woh hiar halor jong ki kumba ka la long halor jong ngi ha kob sdang .
translation.en: And as I began to speak , the Holy Ghost fell on them , as on us at the beginning .

And he took thereof in his hands , and went on eating , and came to his father and mother , and he gave them , and they did eat : but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion .
translation.kha: U khur ïa kata ka ngap ha la ka kti bad u da bam ïa ka katba u dang ïaid ha la ka lynti . Nangta u leit sha la u kpa bad sha la ka kmie bad u ai ïa ki mar khyndiat . Ki bam ïa ka , hynrei u Samson um shym ïathuh ha ki ba u la shim ïa kata ka ngap na ka metïap u sing .

translation.en: And I have consumed them , and wounded them , that they could not arise : yea , they are fallen under my feet .
translation.kha: Nga shoh pynkyllon ïa ki , bad kim lah khie shuh ki thiah ha ka jingshahjop ha khmat jong nga .
Da pyrkhat shuwa ba phin kren , bad wat pynlong kino kino ki jingkular kyrkieh ha U Blei . U don ha bneng bad ma phi ha khyndew , kumta wat ong ei ei palat ban ïa kaba phiah dei ban ong .
translation.en: Be not rash with thy mouth , and let not thine heart be hasty to utter any thing before God : for God is in heaven , and thou upon earth : therefore let thy words be few .

translation.kha: Mynta te , ko khunlung u briew , ïaheh ïa ki Israel ïa katei kaba ma nga , U Trei Nongsynshar , nga nguh ïa ki . Kane ka dei kawei pat ka mano kaba ki kparad jong ki , ki la ibeiñ ïa to da ka jingbymïaineh jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore , son of man , speak unto the house of Israel , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Yet in this your fathers have blasphemed me , in that they have committed a trespass against me .

translation.kha: Hato me tip ïa ki ngaiñ babha synshar ïa ki suiñbneng , badno hapoh me lah ban pyndei ïa ki ha ka pyrthei ?
translation.en: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven ? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth ?

By the multitude of thy merchandise they have filled the midst of thee with violence , and thou hast sinned : therefore I will cast thee as profane out of the mountain of God : and I will destroy thee , O covering cherub , from the midst of the stones of fire .
translation.kha: Me la bunkam ha kaba thied bad kaba die , bad kane ka la ïalam ïa me sha ka jingleh jubor bad ka pop . Te nga pynbor ïa me ban ieh ïa u lumbah bakhuid jong nga , bad u angel uba ap phira ïa me u la beh noh ïa me na ki mawlynnai batyngshaiñ .

Wai la ki dieng Dumbur kim don soh bad ym don shohbeiñ ba mihngi ha ki ngin sohwaiñ , wat la u dieng Olib um sei ei ei badno ki lyngkha kim pynmih kwah , wat la ki Langbrot baroh ki ïarap bad ki sem mai ki thylli ,
translation.en: Although the fig tree shall not blossom , neither shall fruit be in the vines  ; the labour of the olive shall fail , and the fields shall yield no meat  ; the flock shall be cut off from the fold , and there shall be no herd in the stalls :

translation.kha: Baroh kin isih ïa phi namarba jong nga . Hynriew Uno uno uba ïeng skhem haduh kaba kut un lait im .
translation.en: And ye shall be hated of all men for my name s sake : but he that endureth to the end shall be saved .

translation.kha: U jingdon u jubab , Hynrei TRAI’ , Kamon ngan da ban pyllew ïa ki Israel ? Ka kur jong nga ka long kaba tlot hano hapoh ka jait Manasseh , bad nga longsyiem uba rieh tur na ki dkhot ka longïing jong nga .
translation.en: And he said unto him , Oh my Lord , wherewith shall I save Israel ? behold , my family is poor in Manasseh , and I am the least in my father s house .
And he shall take of the blood of the bullock , and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward  ; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times .
translation.kha: Un shim khyndiat ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw bad un synreit ïa ka da la ka shynriah ti ha khmat kata ka jingtap , bad nangta un synreit ïa ka hynñiew sien ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang .
Hadien ba ki la dih shibun ka waiñ , ki ïaleh sngewbha ha ki kam nuti jong ki , ki jied ïa ka jingjahburom Ban ïa ka burom .
translation.en: Their drink is sour : they have committed whoredom continually : her rulers with shame do love , Give ye .

translation.kha: Ïa ka bakwah rung jong ka ïingjaiñ , ki shna ka pyrda katba da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw , bad ha kaba la suh pynnep itynnat bha .
translation.en: And he made an hanging for the tabernacle door of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen , of needlework  ;

And the children of Joseph said , The hill is not enough for us : and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron , both they who are of Beth–shean and her towns , and they who are of the valley of Jezreel .
translation.kha: Ki jubab ,  Ka ri lum kam biang ïa ngi ; hynrei ki Kanaan ha ki ri thor ki don ki kali ïapom da ka nar , na ka bynta kito kiba shong ha Beth Shan bad ïa ki nongrit kiba sawdong jong ka bad na ka bynta kito kiba shong ha ka Them Jesreel .
Nangta kito naba mynba ki long kaba khatduh kin long nyngkong , bad kito kiba mynta ki long nyngkong kin long khatduh .
translation.en: And , behold , there are last which shall be first , and there are first which shall be last .

translation.kha: Hib u la ïashem ïa ngi ha Assos , ngi la kyntiew ïa u ha ka lieng dara ngi la leit sha Mitylene .
translation.en: And when he met with us at Assos , we took him in , and came to Mitylene .

translation.kha: Bad u nongïathuhlypa u ïai krai ban ong , Kane ka duwan kan preg phum bad ïa u dpei yn pynseisoh . Te phin tip ba U Trai u la kren lyngba jong nga .
translation.en: And he gave a sign the same day , saying , This is the sign which the  Lord  hath spoken  ; Behold , the altar shall be rent , and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out .
And all the days of Noah were nine hundred and fifty years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap noh ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah sanphew snem .

translation.en: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord , when he will return from the wedding  ; that when he cometh and knocketh , they may open unto him immediately .
translation.kha: kum ki shakri kiba ap khmih ïa u kynrad jong ki ban wan phai pat na ka jingkhawai shongkurim . Haba u wan bad u tied jingkhang , mar kumta hi , kin plie ïa ka jingkhang na ka bynta jong u .
nangta ki la shoh pynmatlah ïa Us ki shynrang baroh katba don habar khnang ba kin ym shym ïa ka jingkhang .
translation.en: And they smote the men that were at the door of the house with blindness , both small and great : so that they wearied themselves to find the door .

translation.kha: U para ba-ieit jngai ngi u Tukhikos , u nongtrei uba lah ban shaniah bad u lai shakri ha ka kam jong U Trai , un sa ai ïa phi ka khubor baroh shaphang jngai nga .
translation.en: All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you , who is a beloved brother , and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord :
And said unto him , Dost thou certainly know that Baalis the king of the Ammonites hath sent Ishmael the son of Nethaniah to slay thee ? But Gedaliah the son of Ahikam believed them not .
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba u syiem Baalis jong ki Ammon u la phah ïa u Ishmael ban pynïap ïa phi ?  Hynrei u Gedalaïah um shym ngeit ïa kata .

translation.en: In that day shall he swear , saying , I will not be an healer  ; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing : make me not a ruler of the people .
translation.kha: Hynrei un jubab ,  Ym ma nga ! Ngam lah ban ïarap ïa phi . Ngam don jingbam ei ei lane ki jaiñ ruh kumjuh . Wat pynlong ïa nga u nongïalam jong phi !

translation.en: And David said unto Michal , It was before the  Lord  , which chose me before thy father , and before all his house , to appoint me ruler over the people of the  Lord  , over Israel : therefore will I play before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga la shad ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  , uba la jied ïa nga ha ka jaka u kpa jong pha bad ka longïing jong u , ban pynlong ïa nga u nongïalam jong ki briew jong u ki Israel . Bad ngan ïai shad ban pyndonburom ïa U  Trai  ,
Ka la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu , kumta ka la wan ryngkat bad u paidbah nongsaiñ jong u ,
translation.en: When she had heard of Jesus , came in the press behind , and touched his garment .
And his brethren by Eliezer  ; Rehabiah his son , and Jeshaiah his son , and Joram his son , and Zichri his son , and Shelomith his son .
translation.kha: Lyngba u Elieser u para jong u Gershom u don ka jingïadei bad u Shelomith . U Elieser u dei u kpa jong u Rehabaïah , uba dei u kpa jong u Jeshaïah , u kpa jong u Joram , u kpa jong u Sikhri , u kpa jong u Shelomith .
Kum u lyoh uba mih bad u jah noh , u bri u ïarap bad um wanrah phai shuh ; la klet ino da baroh kiba ithuh ïa u .
translation.en: He shall return no more to his house , neither shall his place know him any more .

translation.kha: ‘ Nga , U Trai nga long uba sut ngab kutlad , bad ar pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad ka jingïaineh bad map ïa ka pop bad ïa ka jingïaleh pyrshah . Nalorkata , ngam pep ban pynshitom ïa ki kynhun bad ki kseh haduh kaweh lai bad kaba saw pateng namar ki pop jong ki kmie ki kpa lad ki .’
translation.en: The  Lord  is longsuffering , and of great mercy , forgiving iniquity and transgression , and by no means clearing the guilty , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation .

translation.kha: Uta sngewskhem ha lade um kren ha ki por baroh . Ki briew kiba hir janai jai ki don ka jingïakhaïi jngai da shisha .
translation.en: He that hath knowledge spareth his words : and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit .

And Absalom rose up early , and stood beside the way of the gate : and it was so , that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment , then Absalom called unto him , and said , Of what city art thou ? And he said , Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel .
translation.kha: U ju khie dang step phyrngab bad u ju leit ïeng harud lynti ha ka khyrdop shnong . Haba uno uno u briew u wan hangta bad ka jingïakajia kaba u kwah ïa u syiem ban pynbeit , u Absalom u ju khot ïa u , bad kylli ïa u , u dei uba nangno . Bad hadien ba u briew u la ïathuh ïa u na kano ka jait u dei ,

translation.en: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day .
translation.kha: namar U Khun U Briew u long U Trai jong ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: To me belongeth vengeance , and recompence  ; their foot shall slide in due time : for the day of their calamity is at hand , and the things that shall come upon them make haste .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynhiarkput bad pynshitom ïa ki ; ka por kan poi haba kin kyllon ; ka sngi ka jingjot jong ki ka la jan .

Ibbah u Jehoïakhin u long u syiem , u Nebukhadnessar u syiem Babilonia u la hiarthma ïa ka Judah , bad sa snem la pynbor ïa u Jehoïakim ban pyndem ha ka jingsynshar jong u ; nangta u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah .
translation.en: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up , and Jehoiakim became his servant three years : then he turned and rebelled against him .

translation.kha: Nangta u Gaal u khun jong u Ebed u wanlam shad Shammah lem bad la ki hynmen ki para shynrang , bad ki rangbah ka Shekhem ki buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha u .
translation.en: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren , and went over to Shechem : and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him .
And when Esau heard the words of his father , he cried with a great and exceeding bitter cry , and said unto his father , Bless me , even me also , O my father .
translation.kha: Haba u Iso u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u lynñiar jam bad ïamkthang ruh , bad u ong ,  Ko Pa ! to ai ha nga ruh ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong me .

translation.en: Then went the Pharisees , and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk .
translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la leit noh bad ki la pynlong ka jingthmu ban riam ïa U Jisu da ki jingkylli .
Hynrei ki la leit noh Bad pynphriang ïa ka khubor shaphang U Jisu ha kylleng jrong kata ka bynta jong ka ri .
translation.en: But they , when they were departed , spread abroad his fame in all that country .
Thus will I do unto this place , saith the  Lord  , and to the inhabitants thereof , and even make this city as Topheth :
translation.kha: Nga kular ba ngan pynlong ïa kane ka nongbah bad ïa kiba shong ha ka kum ka Topheth .

Ïa Aner kiba ïoh ka jingjop yn pynkup ïa ki kumne ha ki jaiñkup balieh , bad ngan ym weng noh ïa ki kyrthat jong ki na ka Kitab jong naba im . Ha ka jingdon jingset jongno U Kpa jong nga bad ki angel jong u , ngan Pynbna paidbah ba ki long ki jong nga .
translation.en: He that overcometh , the same shall be clothed in white raiment  ; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life , but I will confess his name before my Father , and before his angels .
Walk in wisdom toward them that are without , redeeming the time .
translation.kha: To long kiba stad ha ka rukom kaba phi leh ïa kiwei ki bym pat ngeit , da kaba pyndonkam ha ka rukom kaba dei ïa kawei pa kawei ka kabu kaba phi ïoh .
Nalor jong ka Hebron ( khawai na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , la ai ïa kine ki nongbah harum ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron u lyngdoh : Ka Libnah ,
translation.en: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Libnah with her suburbs ,

translation.kha: Ngan tei ïa ki kut jrong pha da ki maw Rubi , ïa ki khrud jong pha da ki maw kba rhem kum ka ding , bad ki kynroh sawdong jong pha da ki mawlynnai .
translation.en: And I will make thy windows of agates , and thy gates of carbuncles , and all thy borders of pleasant stones .

John answered , saying unto them all , I indeed baptize you with water  ; but one mightier than I cometh , the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose : he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire :
translation.kha: Kumta u Ïoannis u la ong ha ki baroh ,  Nga pynbaptis ïa phi da ka um , hynrei don uwei pat uba wan uba kham khraw ban ïa nga . Ngam long uba bit wat ban loit ïa ki juti jong u . Un pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad da ka ding .

U ong ha u sumar uba rah atiar jongnga u , Sei ïa la ka waitlam bad dung ïap ïa at , kumta ba ktien ki Pamphylia bajylliew kin ym ïoh dung bad pynïap ïa nga . Hynriew uta u samla u la sheptieng eh ban leh ïa —kata . Kumta u Saul u shim ïa la ka waitlam bad u lyndet ïa lade ha ka .
translation.en: Then said Saul unto his armourbearer , Draw thy sword , and thrust me through therewith  ; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through , and abuse me . But his armourbearer would not  ; for he was sore afraid . Therefore Saul took a sword , and fell upon it .
And the people shall be oppressed , every one by another , and every one by his neighbour : the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient , and the base against the honourable .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un shim kabu ïa uwei pat . Ki samla kin ym burom ïa ki rangbah , bad ki riewpoh kin ym burom ïa kiba halor jong ki .
Kumta u Elimelekh u la leit bad ki rangbah sha ka kamra buh jingbabe ha ka ïingsyiem bad la ïoh katto katne ki jaiñphong ba la riam kiba u la pynhiar sha nga da ki tyllai .
translation.en: So Ebed–melech took the men with him , and went into the house of the king under the treasury , and took thence old cast clouts and old rotten rags , and let them down by cords into the dungeon to Jeremiah .
And when she had done giving him drink , she said , I will draw water for thy camels also , until they have done drinking .
translation.kha: Haba u la dep dih , ka ong ,  Ngan leit tong um sa ïa ki ut jong phi de bad to ai ba kin ïoh dih katba ki kwah .

translation.en: So shall it be at the end of the world : the angels shall come forth , and sever the wicked from among the just ,
translation.kha: Kan long kumne ha kaba kut ka Ïa : ki angel kin mihnoh ban lumlang ïa ki briew kiba sniew napdeng kiba bha
Lada phi dong ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad phim ba-thurmur shun kohnguh ïa nga , kan pynshitom shuh shuh ïa phiah sa hynñiew shah .
translation.en: And if ye walk contrary unto me , and will not hearken unto me  ; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins .
And she conceived , and bare a son  ; and said , God hath taken away my reproach :
translation.kha: Kumta ka la punkhun bad kha khun shynrang . Ka ong ,  U Blei u la shim noh ïa ka jahburom jong nga da kaba ai khun shynrang ïa nga .
U Trai U blei jongnga phi u khmih sumar ïa kane ka ri bad u ap sumar ïa ka baroh shisnem .
translation.en: A land which the  Lord  thy God careth for : the eyes of the  Lord  thy God are always upon it , from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year .
When he gave to the sea his decree , that the waters should not pass his commandment : when he appointed the foundations of the earth :
translation.kha: bad pynbeit ïa ki um ka duriaw ba kin ym kiew palat ban ïa kaba u la ong . Nga la don hangta mynba u buh ïa ki nongrim ka pyrthei .
Ngan bat ïa ka kulmar jong per bad nga pynlong ïa pha ka jyllang nga , bad phan sa Pdiang ïa nga kum U Trai .
translation.en: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness : and thou shalt know the  Lord .

translation.kha: Bad ïa ka pynleit ka jingrkhie jong uwei pa utai u bhabriew yn sa ïohi haba ka Sngi U Khrist kan pynpaw ïa ka . Naba ha kata ka Sngi , ka ding kan pynpaw ïa ka jingtrei jongki uwei pa uwei ; ka tdong kan tynjuh ïa ka bad kan pyn-ap ïa ka dor bashisha .
translation.en: Every man s work shall be made manifest : for the day shall declare it , because it shall be revealed by fire ; and the fire shall try every man s work of what sort it is .

translation.kha: Un hap shaniah ha u Elishah u lyngdoh , ban wad ïa ka mon jongu nga da kaba pyndonkam ïa u Urim bad u Thummim . Da Kumno u Eleasar un kdew ïa u Joshua bad u pangnud Israel ha ki kam jong ki baroh .
translation.en: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest , who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the  Lord  : at his word shall they go out , and at his word they shall come in , both he , and all the children of Israel with him , even all the congregation .

translation.kha: Pleng la pateng , kijuh ki jingbeit ryntih ki teh ïa phi bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shongsuk basah bad phi . Ma phi bad ma ki phi ïalong kumjuh ha khmat U Trei .
translation.en: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation , and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you , an ordinance for ever in your generations : as ye are , so shall the stranger be before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki briew na ka Judah bashathie kin ïoh ïa ka Edom ; kito kiba na ki kjat lumlang shaneng sepngi kin knieh ïa ka Philistia ; ki Israel kin ïoh ïa ka ri Ephraim bun Seraïah ; ki bhabriew jong ka bymïaineh kin rim ïa ka Gilead .
translation.en: And they of the south shall possess the mount of Esau  ; and they of the plain the Philistines : and they shall possess the fields of Ephraim , and the fields of Samaria : and Benjamin shall possess Gilead .
Not for your sakes do I this , saith the Lord  God  , be it known unto you : be ashamed and confounded for your own ways , O house of Israel .
translation.kha: Ko Israel , nga kwah ba phin tip ba ngam shym leh ïa kane baroh namar jong phi . Nga kwah ba phin da sngewlehrain bad sngewjahburom ïa kaei kaba phi la leh . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

U dei ban da ïapynbeit bad uta uba thied ïa u , bad ïakheiñ ïa ki sniew naduh ka por ba u la die ïa lade haduh ka Snem ka jingpynphai pat ka ban wan bad ïa ka Da-ei pyllait kin buh dor kat kumno ka jingdon jong kita ki snep , ha ka nongmareh jong ka bainong u nongbylla .
translation.en: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubilee : and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years , according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him .

translation.kha: kato thylliej ki kput phi don ? U Jisu u la kylli . jynhaw tylli ki kpu , ki la jubab , badno khyndiat ki dohkha rit .
translation.en: And Jesus saith unto them ,  How many loaves have ye ?  And they said , Seven , and a few little fishes .
And I will fetch a morsel of bread , and comfort ye your hearts  ; after that ye shall pass on : for therefore are ye come to your servant . And they said , So do , as thou hast said .
translation.kha: Ngan wanrah ruh khyndiat ka jingbam ; kan ai bor ïa phi katba phi nang bteng ïa ka jingïaid lynti jong phi . Phi la pyndonburom ïa nga haba phi wan rung ha ïing jong nga , kumta shah ngan shakri ïa phi .  Ki jubab ,  Khublei shibun ; ngi pdiang sngewbha ïa kata .

translation.en: For all that is in the world , the lust of the flesh , and the lust of the eyes , and the pride of life , is not of the Father , but is of the world .
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba dei jong ka pyrthei — kaei kaba ka malade bapop ka brai , kaei kaba ki briew ki ïohi bad kwah , bad baroh kiei kiei kiba ha ka pyrthei kiba ki briew ki sngewsarong — ym don na kane kaba wan na U Kpa ; baroh ka wan na ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And the king lamented over Abner , and said , Died Abner as a fool dieth ?
translation.kha: U Dabid u rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ïambriew na ka bynta u Abner :  Balei u Abner u dei ban ïap kum u bieit ?

U Jisu , te , u long U Rangbah Lyngdoh uba pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jongngi ngi . U long uba khuid ; um shym don kano kano kaba bakla lane ka pop ha u ; la pynkyrpang ïa u na ki nongpop bad la kyntiew ïa u sha ki bneng .
translation.en: For such an high priest became us , who is holy , harmless , undefiled , separate from sinners , and made higher than the heavens  ;

translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ka khyndew basboh ban hylla ri khlaw mluh nalor ka jingbymdon jong kito kiba shong hangta .
translation.en: A fruitful land into barrenness , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein .

translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhoit ïa phi bad tun ai ha phiah shibun ki khun ; ngan pynskhem ïa ka bynta ka jinghun jong nga kaba nga la pynlong Bad phi .
translation.en: For I will have respect unto you , and make you fruitful , and multiply you , and establish my covenant with you .
For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate , and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery .
translation.kha: Yn ym don ki ban hiarpateng ïa ki briew kiba khlem blei , bad ka ding kan bam duh ïa ki ïing ba la tei da ka jingbamsap .

translation.en: But if they obey not , they shall perish by the sword , and they shall die without knowledge .
translation.kha: Hynrei lymda kumta , kin ïap ha ka jingbymtip bad ryngkang ïa ka wah sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
Ki jingbynta , Ïa ka hima jong phi la pynbynta nabar la ai ha ki Mid bad ki pharia .
translation.en: PERES  ; Thy kingdom is divided , and given to the Medes and Persians .
Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phoenicia , and Cyprus , and Antioch , preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki parabangeit ïa kiba la pynsakma da ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ kaba la jia myn haba la pynïap ïa u Stephan , ka la pur shaduh sha Phoenisia , Sypros , bad Antiokh , da kaba ïathuh ïa ka khubor tang ha ki Jiw .
U pynbunkam kumba laiphew san kilo ka ksiar nangta ban shna ïa uta u diengpynïeng sharak malade ïa ki jingpait jong u baroh .
translation.en: Of a talent of pure gold made he it , and all the vessels thereof .

translation.kha: u la phah khot ïa u bad u ong , Nga la pynhieng ïa me ban smai ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ban ym mihnoh na Jerusalem . Bad nga la mawjam ïa me ba lada me leh kamet , men ïap da shispah . ithuh mem shym la mynjur ïa ka bad ong ba men kohnguh ïa nga ?
translation.en: And the king sent and called for Shimei , and said unto him , Did I not make thee to swear by the  Lord  , and protested unto thee , saying , Know for a certain , on the day thou goest out , and walkest abroad any whither , that thou shalt surely die ? and thou saidst unto me , The word that I have heard is good .
O Ephraim , what shall I do unto thee ? O Judah , what shall I do unto thee ? for your goodness is as a morning cloud , and as the early dew it goeth away .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko Israel bad Judah , Kaei kaba ngan leh ïa phi ? Ka jingieit jong phi ïa nga ka jah noh shen kum u slap mynstep ; ka long kum ka umjer , kaba jah noh shen ha ka sngi .

translation.en: As for me , behold , my covenant is with thee , and thou shalt be a father of many nations .
translation.kha: Nga pynlong ïa kane ka jutang bad me : Nga kular ba men long u kpa tymmen jong ki jaitbynriew kiba bun .
Hangta U Trai u ong ha u Messaïah , Sa katno shuh phi ki briew phin ïan kyntait ba-bang kohnguh ïa ki hukum jyllang nga ?
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , How long refuse ye to keep my commandments and my laws ?

And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh : and when the hair in the plague is turned white , and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh , it is a plague of leprosy : and the priest shall look on him , and pronounce him unclean .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa kata ka prum , bad lada u shñiuh hangta u la kylla lieh bad kata ka prum ka i kumba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid .
U Trai u jyllop ïa ka jinglui u Elisha ; u Khynnah u ïasdang ban ring mynsiem baklang dara u la im pud .
translation.en: And the  Lord  heard the voice of Elijah  ; and the soul of the child came into him again , and he revived .

translation.kha: Lada ar ngut ki Eliel ki ïakajia , bad ki leit sha ka ïingbishar , ki nongbishar kin rai pynkieng ïa uba hok dara pynrem ïa uba leh palat .
translation.en: If there be a controversy between men , and they come unto judgment , that the judges may judge them  ; then they shall justify the righteous , and condemn the wicked .
And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought , in that they are turned unto other gods .
translation.kha: Te ngan kyntait ban ïarap ïa ki namar ba ki la leh bymman bad mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei .

translation.en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood : and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls : for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul .
translation.kha: Ka jingim ki kynja ba-im baroh ka don ha ka snam , bad dei namar kata ba U  Trai  u la hukum ba dei ban theh ïa baroh ka snam ha ka duwan ban weng noh ïa ki pop ki briew . Ka snam , kaba long ka jingim , ka weng noh ïa ki pop .

translation.en: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received , how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures ;
translation.kha: Nga la aiti ha phi ïa kaei kaba nga la ïohpdiang , kaba long kaba donkam tam : Ba U Khrist u la ïap na ka bynta ki pop jong ngi , kumba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ;

Uno Une uba pyrshang ban lehse na ka jingshyrkhei un hap hapoh ki liewlep , malade Uno uno babha kiew na ki liewlep un nongot ha ki jingriew , namar U Trai u la buh por na ka bynta ka jingpynjot ïa ka Moab .
translation.en: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit  ; and he that getteth up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare : for I will bring upon it , even upon Moab , the year of their visitation , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Leit ba Phin leit sha ka Ïing Hima , pyrshang ban ithuh ïa iwei na ki rangïapom balang ne nongïarap balang haduh ba phin da thuh lut ïa ki bad ïa ka ïing ka sem jong ki .
translation.en: Each time you go to the Kingdom Hall , become acquainted with one of the elders or ministerial servants until you get to know all of them and their families .
But they rebelled , and vexed his holy Spirit : therefore he was turned to be their enemy , and he fought against them .
translation.kha: hynrei ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u bad ki la pynsngewsih ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid jong u . Namar kata U  Trai  u la kylla long u nongshun jong ki bad u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .
Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiewphew , un leit biang bad khmih bha ïa kata ka jingbthuh .
translation.en: And the priest shall come again the seventh day , and shall look : and , behold , if the plague be spread in the walls of the house  ;

translation.kha: Ki apostol ki la sah salm hangta , ki da kren shlur shaphang U Trai , uba la pynsawa ba ka khubor jong ki shang ka jingaiei ka long kaba shisha da kaba ai ha ki ka bor ban leh ki kambah mala ki kamphylla .
translation.en: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord , which gave testimony unto the word of his grace , and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand over the sea , that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians , upon their chariots , and upon their horsemen .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  Kner ïa la ka kti halor ka duriaw khnang ba ki um kin ïadait biang bad tyllep ïa ki nong Ijipt bad ïa ki kali ïapom jong ki , bad ïa ki nongñiah .
Ma me , ko Trai , me longsem ka jingshai jong na , me beh noh ïa ka jingdum jong nga .
translation.en: For thou art my lamp , O  Lord  : and the  Lord  will lighten my darkness .
But I know thy abode , and thy going out , and thy coming in , and thy rage against me .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga tip lut shaphang jong me , kaei ba me leh bad shano me leit , bad nga tip kumno ba me bitar shla pyrshah ïa nga .
U la don saw ngut ki khun kynthei ki i pat shongkurim kiba la pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Blei .
translation.en: And the same man had four daughters , virgins , which did prophesy .

And the messenger answered and said , Israel is fled before the Philistines , and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people , and thy two sons also , Hophni and Phinehas , are dead , and the ark of God is taken .
translation.kha: U nonglamktien u jubab ,  Ki Israel ki la phet ïap na ki Philistia ; ka la long ka jingshahjop kaba shyrkhei ïa ngi ; bad nalor kata ki khun jong phi , u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki la shah pynïap , bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei la shah knieh noh !

translation.en: After my words they spake not again  ; and my speech dropped upon them .
translation.kha: kim don ei ei shuh ban ai jingmut haba nga la dep kren . Ki ktien jong nga ki ngam kum ki jingjaw jong u slap ;

ngi kwah ba pien kular ba phin ym pynmynsaw ïa ngi , kumba ngi ruh ngim shym la pynsmieij ïa phiah . Me la lehsbun ïa phi bad ngi la shah ba phin leit da katba suk . Mynta ka kynsi shai ba U Trai u la kyrkieh ïa phi! .
translation.en: That thou wilt do us no hurt , as we have not touched thee , and as we have done unto thee nothing but good , and have sent thee away in peace : thou art now the blessed of the  Lord .
He came unto his own , and his own received him not .
translation.kha: U la wan sha la ka jong ka ri , hynrei ki briew jong u hi kim shym la pdiang ïa u .
Suh ki jaiñphong lyngdoh ïa u Aaron u hynmen jong me khnang ba un ishongkun shongneh bad idonburom .
translation.en: And thou shalt make holy garments for Aaron thy brother for glory and for beauty .

translation.kha: Ka Naomi ka don u ïa-ïeng uba kyrteng u Boanerjes , u briew uba riewsaid bad ïa uba la ñiewkor shibun uba na ka longïing jong u tnga jong ka , u Elimelekh .
translation.en: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband s , a mighty man of wealth , of the family of Elimelech  ; and his name was Boaz .

translation.kha: Kaei ba ki la ïohi ha ka ïing syiem ? Ki la ïohi ïa baroh . Ym don kaba ngam shym la pyn-i ha ki ha ki ïohnong jingmynsaw .
translation.en: Then said he , What have they seen in thine house ? And Hezekiah answered , All that is in mine house have they seen : there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them .
Clouds and darkness are round about him : righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne .
translation.kha: Ki lyoh bad ka jingdum ki ker sawdong ïa u ; u synshar da ka hok bad ka jingbishar hok .
Kñia ïa ka jingainguh bam ha U Trai , bad wat triang ei ei kumba phin ju trei man la ka sngi .
translation.en: Ye shall do no servile work therein : but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Haba phi leit khlem bam ei ei , bta ïa ka khmat jong phiah bad sad ïa u shñiuh jong phi ,
translation.en: But thou , when thou fastest , anoint thine head , and wash thy face  ;
