translation.kha: Kaba dap da ka jingkmen ka pynlong ïa ph ban shata ban khlaiñ . Ban sngewdiaw man ka por ka long ka jingap suki pa Suki .
translation.en: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine : but a broken spirit drieth the bones .
And I will feed the flock of slaughter , even you , O poor of the flock . And I took unto me two staves  ; the one I called Beauty , and the other I called Bands  ; and I fed the flock .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la thied bad die ïa ki langbrot ki la wai ïa nga , bad nga la long u nongaplangbrot jong ki langbrot kiba la dei ban shah shohdoh . Nga la shim ar tylli ki dieng : Ïa uwei nga la khot  U Jingsngewbha  bad ïa uwei pat  U Jingtylli .  Bad nga la sumar ïa ki langbrot .

translation.en: If it be so , our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace , and he will deliver us out of thine hand , O king .
translation.kha: Lada U Blei uba ngi shakri u lah ban pyllait im ïa ngi na ka lawar ding baklang bad na ka bor jong phi , te un leh .
Ka kham kordor ban ïa ka ksiar , ban ïa u khie ksiar lane ïa ka ïit babha tam .
translation.en: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it : and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold .

translation.kha: Ki da sngewsih kthang eh nongmareh u la lah ong ba kin ym ïoh shuh ïa u . Bad kumta ki la ïaleit bad u sha ka lieng .
translation.en: Sorrowing most of all for the words which he spake , that they should see his face no more . And they accompanied him unto the ship .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba na ka jai bashaphang shatei ki phah khot ïa u ; bad baroh ki ïaleit lang sha u Rehoboam , bad ki nguh ha u ,
translation.en: And they sent and called him . So Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake to Rehoboam , saying ,

translation.kha: Shim khyndiat ka snam katba dat ha kata ka jingset bad khyndiat ka umphniang pynsep , malu synreit ha u Aaron bad ha ki jingïap jong u , bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u bad ha ki jaiñkup jong ki . Ma ki bad ki jaiñkup jong ki kin long kiba la pynkyntang khup sha nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt take of the blood that is upon the altar , and of the anointing oil , and sprinkle it upon Aaron , and upon his garments , and upon his sons , and upon the garments of his sons with him : and he shall be hallowed , and his garments , and his sons , and his sons  garments with him .
All things are lawful for me , but all things are not expedient : all things are lawful for me , but all things edify not .
translation.kha: Ïa ngi la shah ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh ,  kumta ki ong . Kata ka long kaba shisha , hynrei ym kiei kiei baroh ki long kiba bha .  Ïa ngi la shah ban leh ïa kaei kaei baroh  — hynrei ym baroh ka long kaba myntoi .
Nangne , ngi kylli ïa ki nongñiah jong ki ban ïathuh ïa ngi mane ba la ai bor ïa ki ban tei biang ïa ka Templ bad pynbiang ïa ki jingbuh jingsat jyllang ka .
translation.en: Then asked we those elders , and said unto them thus , Who commanded you to build this house , and to make up these walls ?
The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him , and at an hour when he is not aware , and will cut him in sunder , and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers .
translation.kha: nangta u kynrad un wan phai pat ha kawei ka sngi haba u shakri um shym khmih lynti ïa u bad ha ka por kaba um tip . U kynrad un ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u bad un pynlong ïa u ban ïoh bynta ïa ka kupar jong ki bymkohnguh .
Nangta , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba phi leh ne phi nguh , dei ban leh ha ka kyrthat jong U Trai Jisu , ha kaba phi ainguh da u ïa U Blei uba U Kpa .
translation.en: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed , do all in the name of the Lord Jesus , giving thanks to God and the Father by him .

translation.kha: bad u la ong ha ki , Ka jingsngewsih ioh ka dohnud Jong nga ka long kaba khraw katta kata kat haduh ba ka jan pynlwet ïa sa . To sah hangne bad ïa-ap lem bad nga .
translation.en: Then saith he unto them ,  My soul is exceeding sorrowful , even unto death : tarry ye here , and watch with me .
And all nations shall serve him , and his son , and his son s son , until the very time of his land come : and then many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of him .
translation.kha: Baroh ki jaitbynriew kin shakri ïa u , bad kin shakri ïa u khun bad u khun ksiew jong u tad haduh ba ka por kan wan ïa ka hima jong u hi ban kyllon . Te ka jaitbynriew jong u kan shakri ïa ki jaitbynriew badonbor bad ïa ki syiem bakhraw .

U nongsumar ïa u syiem Sedekaïah u dei u Seruïah , u khun lad u Naarah malu u ksiew jong u Mahseïah . Ha ka snem kambah saw ba u Sedekaïah u long u syiem ka Jehudi , u Sarai u dang leit sha Babilonia bad u , bad nga la ai ha u kato katno ki jingbthah .
translation.en: The word which Jeremiah the prophet commanded Seraiah the son of Neriah , the son of Maaseiah , when he went with Zedekiah the king of Judah into Babylon in the fourth year of his reign . And this Seraiah was a quiet prince .

translation.kha: Nga lah baneh sahit katto katne por malu phi , lehse barabor shi tlang , badno nangta phi lah pun ïalap ïa nga ha ka baneh bteng ïa ka jingleit jong nga , kat shano sha ba ngan leit .
translation.en: And it may be that I will abide , yea , and winter with you , that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go .

translation.kha: Khlem da don ba ïathuh , U Jisu u la Tip ba ki ïakhñium shaphang kane , kumne u la ong ha ki , Hato kane ka pynlong ïa phi ba phin kwah iehnoh ?
translation.en: When Jesus knew in himself that his disciples murmured at it , he said unto them ,  Doth this offend you ?

translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa u Joram , u khur jong u ban khublei ïa u Susim Dabid badno ban ai khublei ïa u namar ka jingjop jong u ïa u Hadadeser , ïa uba u Toi u la ïaleh pynshah la bunsien . U Joram u rah na ka bynda u Dabid ki jingai sngewbha kiba la thaw da ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad ka rnong .
translation.en: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David , to salute him , and to bless him , because he had fought against Hadadezer , and smitten him : for Hadadezer had wars with Toi . And Joram brought with him vessels of silver , and vessels of gold , and vessels of brass :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la bitar katba u la dabor sawdong ïa ki , hynrei ha ka kajuh ka por u la sngewsih na ka bynta jong ki , namar ba ki eh mynsiem bad leh bymdei . Te u la ong ha uta u briew , Rah ïa la ka kti . U la rah ïa ka , bad ka la khiah bha pait .
translation.en: And when he had looked round about on them with anger , being grieved for the hardness of their hearts , he saith unto the man ,  Stretch forth thine hand .  And he stretched it out : and his hand was restored whole as the other .
Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister , to vex her , to uncover her nakedness , beside the other in her life time .
translation.kha: Wat shim ïa la ka para ne hynmen kynsi kum kawei na ki tnga jong me katba ka tnga jong me , ka dang im .

Ko ki briew jong nga , wat ym sheptieng ; ko ki paid Israel , kdew ym sngewshyrkhei . Ngan pyllait im ïa phi na kata ka ri bajngai , na ka ri ha kaba phi long ki koidi . Phin wan phai pat shwa ïing bad im ha ka jingsuk ; phin shngain , bad yn ym don mano mano ïa-ban pynsheptieng ïa phi .
translation.en: Therefore fear thou not , O my servant Jacob , saith the  Lord   ; neither be dismayed , O Israel : for , lo , I will save thee from afar , and thy seed from the land of their captivity  ; and Jacob shall return , and shall be in rest , and be quiet , and none shall make him afraid .

translation.kha: U sah” ïa la ki ïabah synshar ban ïakren jar jar bad u Sabad bad ban ïathuh ha u , U syiem u shem Sngewbha ïa phi bad ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ki sngewtynnat ïa phi! ; myntor ka dei ka por kambah biang ba phin shongkurim ïa ka khunlung jong u .
translation.en: And Saul commanded his servants , saying , Commune with David secretly , and say , Behold , the king hath delight in thee , and all his servants love thee : now therefore be the king s son in law .

When he uttereth his voice , there is a multitude of waters in the heavens , and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth  ; he maketh lightnings with rain , and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum jong u ki um shalor jong ka suiñbneng ki kyrhuh ; u wallam ïa ki lyoh na kiba kut jong ka pyrthei . U pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ha u slap bad u phah ïa ka lyer na ka kamra buh tiar jong u .

ainong ïa ka khlaw bashaphang shatai ban shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Trai Nongbishar u jong : Ha khmih ! Nga pynmeh ïa ka ding , bad kan thang khoit ïa uwei pa uwei u dieng ha Phin , la uba jyrngam ne uba tyrkhong . Yn ym don mano mano ba lah pun pynlip ïa ka . Kin pur na shathie haduh shatei , bad uwei nawei baroh un sngewdiaw ïa ka jingkhluit ki thyllah ding .
translation.en: And say to the forest of the south , Hear the word of the  Lord   ; Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will kindle a fire in thee , and it shall devour every green tree in thee , and every dry tree : the flaming flame shall not be quenched , and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka por u la long bymmyntoi sha ïa me , hynrei mynta u long uba myntoi ïa me bad ïa por .
translation.en: Which in time past was to thee unprofitable , but now profitable to thee and to me :

translation.kha: La shi Sngi , ka jingbymdon jong phi kan kham paw Shuh shuh ; te leit hiar shaw kato ka khang ha kaba phi rieh mynhynne ; bad rieh ha lyndet ka kynton maw hangto .
translation.en: And when thou hast stayed three days , then thou shalt go down quickly , and come to the place where thou didst hide thyself when the business was in hand , and shalt remain by the stone Ezel .

translation.kha: Haba ki jingsah kha ki la thar eh , ka nongpynkha khun ka ong ïa ka , Waw sheptieng , ko Rakhel ; u daiñ sa uwei pat u shynrang .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when she was in hard labour , that the midwife said unto her , Fear not  ; thou shalt have this son also .

translation.kha: Lada ïa phi! ym shyiap la pynshitom , kumba shah ki khun jongno u Baroh , ka mut ba kine dei ki khur bashisha jong u , hynrei ki khwan khlem kpa .
translation.en: But if ye be without chastisement , whereof all are partakers , then are ye bastards , and not sons .

translation.kha: Habor phi pyllait ïa ki , wat phah noh tyllep ïa ki .
translation.en: And when thou sendest him out free from thee , thou shalt not let him go away empty :
And it came to pass , as he sowed , some fell by the way side , and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up .
translation.kha: Katba u bet ïa u symbai ha ka lyngkha , katto katne na u , u la hap ha ka lynti ïaid , bad ki sim ki la wan bad bam ïa u .

translation.en: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the  Lord  , offer it at your own will .
translation.kha: Haba phi pynlong ïa ka jingkñia ainguh sngewbha sha U  Trai  , bud beit ïa ki rukom lehniam khnang ba yn pdiang hun ïa phi .

U Lebiathan u ong shuh hajuh , Lada phi! lehbeiñ ïa ki ïakhun kynthei jong at Lane lada phi shongkurim ïa kiwei pat ki kynthei , wat la ngam da ban tip shaphang kata , to kynmaw ba U Blei u khum ïa im .
translation.en: If thou shalt afflict my daughters , or if thou shalt take other wives beside my daughters , no man is with us  ; see , God is witness betwixt me and thee .

translation.kha: Phi leit sha ki lum kiba jrong ban kñia ainguh bad ïathiah shongkha .
translation.en: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed : even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice .

translation.kha: Haba ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai jong ka pyrthei baroh kin ïuh ïa la ki kjat ha um , ka Jordan kan sangeh ban tuid , bad ka um kiba wan tuid na shaneng kan lang shi jaka .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , as soon as the soles of the feet of the priests that bear the ark of the  Lord  , the Lord of all the earth , shall rest in the waters of Jordan , that the waters of Jordan shall be cut off from the waters that come down from above  ; and they shall stand upon an heap .

I prayed therefore unto the  Lord  , and said , O Lord  God  , destroy not thy people and thine inheritance , which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness , which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand .
translation.kha: Bad nga la duwai , ‘ A  Trai  Nongsynshar , wat pynjot ïa la ki briew , ki briew kiba me la pyllait bad ïalam na Ijipt da ka jingkhlaiñ bad ka borbah jong me .
Ai ba kiwei pud ki briew kin ïaroh ïa phi — wat ki nongwei ; ym den ban leh ïa ka na lade .
translation.en: Let another man praise thee , and not thine own mouth  ; a stranger , and not thine own lips .

And I will bring again the captivity of my people of Israel , and they shall build the waste cities , and inhabit them  ; and they shall plant vineyards , and drink the wine thereof  ; they shall also make gardens , and eat the fruit of them .
translation.kha: Ngan wan ïalam pat ïa ki briew jong nga sha la ka ri . Kin sa tei pat ïa ki shnong ba la jot bad kin shong hangta ; kin thung ki bri sohwaiñ bad kin dih ïa ka waiñ ; kin thung jingthung ha ki kper , bad kin bam na kaei kaba mih .
Ha ka step kaba buid , hab nga la khie thiah bad sa ban ai buiñ ïa la u khulom , ang ïohi ba u la ïap . Nga la khmih bniah hajan bad nga shadem pynban ba um dei u khuid jong nga .
translation.en: And when I rose in the morning to give my child suck , behold , it was dead : but when I had considered it in the morning , behold , it was not my son , which I did bear .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kambah khanatang jong u bnai uba nyngkong jongki ka snem kaba khat-ar jong ka jinglongmraw jongno Ngi , U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: It came to pass also in the twelfth year , in the fifteenth day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Kiei khie barieh kiba u Manasseh u la ni , ka jingjai ba u pynlong sha U Blei , bad ki khubor jong ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la kren ha u ha ka kyrtong Jong U Trei , U Blei ki Israel , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh , and his prayer unto his God , and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the  Lord  God of Israel , behold , they are written in the book of the kings of Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la long u lyngdoh da ka jingsmai haba U blei u la nong ha u , U Trai u la pynlong ka jingsmai bakyntang bad un ym kylla Shuah : ‘ Me , me longkmie u lyngdoh jingkhum .’
translation.en: ( For those priests were made without an oath  ; but this with an oath by him that said unto him , The Lord sware and will not repent , Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec : )
Then they cry unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he saveth them out of their distresses .
translation.kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pyllait ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .
Kumta ïa ka kam Merari la ai khadar thylliej ki nongkhap .
translation.en: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families , which were remaining of the families of the Levites , were by their lot twelve cities .
And Abimelech chased him , and he fled before him , and many were overthrown and wounded , even unto the entering of the gate .
translation.kha: U Gaal u la phet ïap bad u Abimelekh u la beh kthong ïa u . Bun ngut ki la mynsaw , wat haduh khyrdop shnong .
Haba u Petros u la leit sha Jerusalem , kito kiba ïashah ba Dei ban otsher ïa ki Jentil ki la wohnia ïa u , da kaba ong ,
translation.en: And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem , they that were of the circumcision contended with him ,
The  Lord  therefore be judge , and judge between me and thee , and see , and plead my cause , and deliver me out of thine hand .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un bishar bad un rai mano ba bakla napdeng jong ngi . To un khmih ïa kane ka kam , un ïada ïa nga , bad un pyllait im ïa nga na phi .
U sangeh jong nga un wait ha shuwa jrong Phin nabar un ïalam ïa phi shwa ka ri jong ki Amor , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Kanaan , ki Hobah , bad ki Jebus ; bad Ngan pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: For mine Angel shall go before thee , and bring thee in unto the Amorites , and the Hittites , and the Perizzites , and the Canaanites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites : and I will cut them off .

translation.kha: Hynrei ynda ki la waiñ sha kane ka ri bad shimti ïa ka , kim shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me lane im kat kum ka jinghikai jong me ; ktem shitrhem la leh ïa kaba me la hukum ïa ki ban leh . Bad kumta me la ïalamwir ïa kane ka jingpynjot baroh ha ki .
translation.en: And they came in , and possessed it  ; but they obeyed not thy voice , neither walked in thy law  ; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do : therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them :

translation.kha: Mem don bynta litar eh bynta ha ka kam jong ngi , Naaman ka dohnud jong me kam long kambah beit ha khmat U Blei .
translation.en: Thou hast neither part nor lot in this matter : for thy heart is not right in the sight of God .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la ngeit ïa ka khublei jong u Philip shaphang ka khubor babha jong ka Hima U Blei bad shaphang U Jisu Khrist , la pynbaptis ïa ki , shynrang bad kynthei .
translation.en: But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God , and the name of Jesus Christ , they were baptized , both men and women .

translation.kha: ka ri kaba pynmih ïa u kew bad u barli , u dieng sohwaiñ bad u diengsoh Dumbur , u dieng Pomkranet bad u diengsoh Olib , bun ka ngap .
translation.en: A land of wheat , and barley , and vines , and fig trees , and pomegranates  ; a land of oil olive , and honey  ;

translation.kha: Ynda haba ki shipai ki la lah sahnarphna ïa U Jisu , ki la ïashim ïa ki jaiñ jongnga u bad ki la ïabynta ha ki saw bna , kawei ka pyntwa ïa ti uwei u shipai . Ki la ïashim ruh ïa ka jaiñkup , ïa kaba la pynlong tang na kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñjot ba la thynrang khlup kano Kanah ka jingsuh ha ka .
translation.en: Then the soldiers , when they had crucified Jesus , took his garments , and made four parts , to every soldier a part  ; and also his coat : now the coat was without seam , woven from the top throughout .

translation.kha: U shnong hynñiew tylli ki sharak na ka bynta uta u diengpynïeng sharak , bad u thaw ruh ïa ki nap bad ki jingdiang jong u da ka ksiar nylla .
translation.en: And he made his seven lamps , and his snuffers , and his snuffdishes , of pure gold .

translation.kha: Lydda u briew uba riewspah u ïohi ïa la u tipbriew ha ka jingkyrduh , pynban , u shang khyrdep ïa la ka dohnud pyrshah ïa la u tipbriew , kumno u lah ban kam ba u ieit ïa U Blei ?
translation.en: But whoso hath this world s good , and seeth his brother have need , and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him , how dwelleth the love of God in him ?

And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters : they came to the pits , and found no water  ; they returned with their vessels empty  ; they were ashamed and confounded , and covered their heads .
translation.kha: Ki briew bariewspah ki phah ïa la ki shakri ban tong um ; ki leit sha ki thliew pynlang um , hynrei kim shem um ; ki wan phai pat bad ki khra thylli . Ki la noh mynsiem bad shaïong jingmut , ki buhrieh ïa la ki durkhmat .

U Arbad u jubab , Nga la shad ban pyndonburom ïa U Trai , uba la jied ïa nga ha ka jaka u kpa jong pha bad ka longïing jong u , ban pynlong ïa nga u nongïalam jong ki brisoh jong u ki Israel . Bad ngan ïadie shad ban pyndonburom ïa U Trai’ ,
translation.en: And David said unto Michal , It was before the  Lord  , which chose me before thy father , and before all his house , to appoint me ruler over the people of the  Lord  , over Israel : therefore will I play before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba leh riewspah , hynrei kim don ei ei . Kiwei ki kuna duk , Hynrei ki don ka shad bah .
translation.en: There is that maketh himself rich , yet hath nothing : there is that maketh himself poor , yet hath great riches .

translation.kha: balieh ba ki nongot Ijipt kin ïoh ong ba me la ïalum ïa la ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , da kaba me thmu shun pynïap ïa ki ha ki lum , bad shun pynjot thiaw ïa ki ? shang baneh bitar ; pynkylla noh ïa ka jingdam jong me , dara wat ai ba kane ka jingpynjot kan ngat ha ki briew’ jong me .
translation.en: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak , and say , For mischief did he bring them out , to slay them in the mountains , and to consume them from the face of the earth ? Turn from thy fierce wrath , and repent of this evil against thy people .

translation.kha: Na u Paul , uba da ka mon U Blei u long u Apostol jong U Khrist Jisu — Sha ki brai jong U Blei ha Eliphas , kiba ainong skhem ha ka jingjam jong ki ha U Khrist Jisu :
translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , to the saints which are at Ephesus , and to the faithful in Christ Jesus :

translation.kha: Haba u Asnoth u la dap khyndaiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh Kynhun shynrang , u Kenan ,
translation.en: And Enos lived ninety years , and begat Cainan :

translation.kha: A katno nga long u briew u bym don jingsuk! Uei u ban pyllait neh ïa nga na kane ka met kabu ïalam ïa nga shiah ka jingïarap ?
translation.en: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death ?
Where thou diest , will I die , and there will I be buried : the  Lord  do so to me , and more also , if ought but death part thee and me .
translation.kha: Hangno hangno ba phi ïap , hangta ngan ïap , bad dei hangta ba yn tep ïa nga . Ai ba ka jingpynshitom bashyrkhei eh jong U  Trai  kan wan hap halor jong nga lada nga shah ïa kaei kaei lait noh ka jingïap hi ka ban pynïakhlad ïa nga na phi !

U Trai un pynpaw ïa lade ha ki nong Ijipt , bad nangta kin kop bad kin mane ïa u , bad kin wallam ha u ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh . Kin pynphong ki jingjur kyntang ha u nabar kin pyndep ïa kaei kaba ki kular .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall be known to Egypt , and the Egyptians shall know the  Lord  in that day , and shall do sacrifice and oblation  ; yea , they shall vow a vow unto the  Lord  , and perform it .

translation.kha: To pyn-i hangne ïa ka sbai rupa . Ka khatduh bad ka kyrngah jongno long kyang kiba don ha ka ? Jong u Patsha , ki la jubab .
translation.en: Shew me a penny . Whose image and superscription hath it ?  They answered and said , Caesar s .

translation.kha: U Reuben u ong ha la u kpu , Lada ngam wang ïalam biang sha phi ïa u bymman , phira ia ban pynïap ïa ki khun shaneng jong nga baroh ar ngut . buh ïa u ha ka jingsumar jong nga , pynlang Ngan wan ïalam biang ïa u .
translation.en: And Reuben spake unto his father , saying , Slay my two sons , if I bring him not to thee : deliver him into my hand , and I will bring him to thee again .
He hath swallowed down riches , and he shall vomit them up again : God shall cast them out of his belly .
translation.kha: U briew uba sniew u prie noh ïa ka spah ba u la tuh ; U Blei u shim pat ïa ka , wat na ka kpoh jong u .
U Nathan u jubab , Lehi ïa kano kano kaba phi pyrkhat , namar U Trai u don ryngkat bad phi .
translation.en: And Nathan said to the king , Go , do all that is in thine heart  ; for the  Lord  is with thee .

translation.kha: man kaba ki rung shabi ka Ïingjaiñ ne ki leit sha jan kata ka duwan , kumba U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: When they went into the tent of the congregation , and when they came near unto the altar , they washed  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw jong u , u ïohi ïa ki Ken , Bad u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa : Ka jaka kaba phi shong ka longkmie kaba snem , katba shaneng kum ka skum ba la shna jingkhroh hiar ka synran ;
translation.en: And he looked on the Kenites , and took up his parable , and said , Strong is thy dwellingplace , and thou puttest thy nest in a rock .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la kren ha ki paid Israel ïa kaei kai baroh ba U Trai u la hukum ïa u .
translation.en: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa me baneh pynlong ka jingsmai ha ka kyrteng U Trai , U Blei jong ka bneng bad ka khyndew , ba men ym jied ka tnga ïa u khun jong nga na ki briew hangne ha ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And I will make thee swear by the  Lord  , the God of heaven , and the God of the earth , that thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites , among whom I dwell :

translation.kha: U angel U Trai u wanpaw ha ka bad u ong , Pham shym la lah ban Ïoh khun , hynrei shen phan sa punkhun malade phar ïoh ïa u khun shynrang .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  appeared unto the woman , and said unto her , Behold now , thou art barren , and bearest not : but thou shalt conceive , and bear a son .

translation.kha: u khun jong u Enshemesh , u khur jong u Seth , u khur jong u Adam , u khun jong U Balei .
translation.en: Which was the son of Enos , which was the son of Seth , which was the son of Adam , which was the son of God .

translation.kha: Dei ban pynsangeh ïa u namar u la ong ïa ki briew ha Babel ba Kin long ki koidi lem bah hangthie bad ba kin thew ïa ki ïing , ktien shongduh , kin jingaiti ki kper , sad bam ïa kaei kaba ki thung .
translation.en: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon , saying , This captivity is long : build ye houses , and dwell in them  ; and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them .

translation.kha: un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti kamon hangta , bad un synreit khyndiat na ka , hynñiew sien hangta ha khmat U Trai .
translation.en: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand , and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Katba u sdang krung ïa ki , u la otsher noh na ki bad la shym nep ïa u sha bneng .
translation.en: And it came to pass , while he blessed them , he was parted from them , and carried up into heaven .

translation.kha: Hynrei da ka jingaiei U Blei , ïa baroh la pynlong ka hok bad u lyntang U Khrist Jisu , uba pyllaitluid ïa ki .
translation.en: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus :

translation.kha: Nangta u la wanpaw pat sha ki synran bad u la shem ba ki ïohthiah ; kim shngiam la eh ban khyllie ïa la ki khmat . Bad kiei shyiap la tip ïa kaei ban ong ïa u .
translation.en: And when he returned , he found them asleep again , ( for their eyes were heavy , ) neither wist they what to answer him .

translation.kha: Ha kylleng ki pum jong ka Moab la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkynnoh . La ïohsngew ha ki shnong jong ka Eglaim malu Beerelim .
translation.en: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab  ; the howling thereof unto Eglaim , and the howling thereof unto Beer–elim .

translation.kha: Phi tipthuh ba U Kynther u long uba hok ; phi dei ban ïatip , namarba , ba uei uei baroh uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei u long u khum U Balei .
translation.en: If ye know that he is righteous , ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him .

translation.kha: bad uba u jin u la bthah ïa nga ban pynbna ïa kaei kaban U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong : Nga la don ka jingieit phylliew bad jingsngewkhia ïa ka Jerusalem ka nongbah bakhuid jong nga ,
translation.en: So the angel that communed with me said unto me , Cry thou , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy .
Jesus saith unto her ,  Woman , what have I to do with thee ? mine hour is not yet come .
translation.kha: Phim dei ban ong ïa nga ïa kaei ba ngan leh ,  U Jisu u la jubab .  Ka por jong nga kam pat poi .
mynba nga mihnoh nangne , nga don kyrhai , hynrei U Troas u la wallam thylli ïa nga . Balei yn khot ïa ang ka Nahum haba U thri Uba Khrawbor u la pynrem bad phah jingjynjar ha per ?
translation.en: I went out full , and the  Lord  hath brought me home again empty : why then call ye me Naomi , seeing the  Lord  hath testified against me , and the Almighty hath afflicted me ?

translation.kha: wah ka jingim jong i khyllung i bym pat kha i ba don hakpoh jong ka kmie ruh i long iba kordor khamtam U Jehobah .
translation.en: Even the life of an unborn child inside its mother is precious to Jehovah .

translation.kha: Haba u la pei , u pyndem khohsiew ïa kita ki ut harud ka puk kaba don shaba jongno ka nongbah . Ka dei haba la jingïateh bha , ka por ha kaba ki kynthei ki ju wang tong um .
translation.en: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening , even the time that women go out to draw water .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohi ïa kane , ki rangbah ki sngewnguh thup pynlang kim sngewthuh ei ei ; kito kiba Shna bleithaw ki shah pynthame , namar ki blei naba ki shna ki long kiba kynroh bad kim don jingim .
translation.en: Every man is brutish in his knowledge : every founder is confounded by the graven image : for his molten image is falsehood , and there is no breath in them .

translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la sha pynbaptis , u la wan kiew noh na ka um . Nangta ïa ka bnai la plie ha u , bad u la ïohi ïa U Mynsiem jong U Blei! uba wan hiar kum ka paro bad ka da wan shong halor jong u .
translation.en: And Jesus , when he was baptized , went up straightway out of the water : and , lo , the heavens were opened unto him , and he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove , and lighting upon him :

translation.kha: Marah kumto hi , U Trai u pynhap ïa u kyndok ding ha ki nongbah Sodom bad Gomorrah ,
translation.en: Then the  Lord  rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the  Lord  out of heaven  ;

translation.kha: Uta un kaweh ïa kata ka song kum ka jingangnud katba kyrpang sha U Trai , khnang ba yn pyngkiang ïa phi . uto u lyngkhuit un ai ïa ka ha ka sngi kaba bud ïa ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: And he shall wave the sheaf before the  Lord  , to be accepted for you : on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it .

translation.kha: U Blei u la ieid ïa ki nong Jesreel ban long ki nongsakhi jyllang u .
translation.en: God chose the Israelites to be his witnesses .

translation.kha: Te lada kino mon ban Sikhri ïa u , jied ha kane hi ka sngi ïasnoh phin shakri , ïa ki blei ba ki kparad tymmen jong phi ki la mane ha Mesopotamia , ne ïa ki blei jong ki Amor , kiba ha ka ri jongnga ki phi shong phi sah mynta . Hynrei ma nga bad ka ïing jong nga , ngin shakri ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And if it seem evil unto you to serve the  Lord  , choose you this day whom ye will serve  ; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood , or the gods of the Amorites , in whose land ye dwell : but as for me and my house , we will serve the  Lord .

translation.kha: Bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ki jingthoh baroh ha bneng , ha khiew , ha ka pyrthei shapoh , bad ha ka duriaw — baroh ki kiei kiba im ha ka pyrthei — bad ki ïarwai : Ha uta uba shong halor ka khet bad ha U Khunlangbrot , long ka jingïaroh bad ka jingpyndonburom , ka burom bad ka ba , junom la junom !
translation.en: And every creature which is in heaven , and on the earth , and under the earth , and such as are in the sea , and all that are in them , heard I saying , Blessing , and honour , and glory , and power , be unto him that sitteth upon the throne , and unto the Lamb for ever and ever .
And it came to pass , that , as he was praying in a certain place , when he ceased , one of his disciples said unto him , Lord , teach us to pray , as John also taught his disciples .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi U Jisu u dang duwai ha kawei ka jaka . Haba u la dep , uwei na ki synran jong u , u la ong ha u ,  Ko Trai , to hikai ïa ngi ban duwai , kumba u Ïoannis u la hikai ïa ki synran jong u .

translation.en: As for me , behold , I am in your hand : do with me as seemeth good and meet unto you .
translation.kha: Ha kaba ïadei bad nga , nga don ha ka bor jong phi ! To leh ïa nga ïa kano kano kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long kaba biang bad kaba dei .
Kam pher sha kano ka liang u dieng u khyllem , un don ha ka jaka kaba u la kyllon . Haba ki lyoh ki ïalap , ka slap .
translation.en: If the clouds be full of rain , they empty themselves upon the earth : and if the tree fall toward the south , or toward the north , in the place where the tree falleth , there it shall be .

translation.kha: U Jisu pat , u la sngewthuh ïa ka jingthmu basniew jong ki , mala kumta u la ainong , Phi kiba arsap ! balei phi ïapyrshang ban riam ïa nga ?
translation.en: But Jesus perceived their wickedness , and said ,  Why tempt ye me , ye hypocrites ?

translation.kha: Ka jingïoh ïa ka spah da kaba Suk eh , ka jinglut noh lad ka ruh ka longsyiem kaba kloi eh . Kaba kham eh ban ïoh ïa ka , kaba khnam roi ruh ka jingïoh ïa ka .
translation.en: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished : but he that gathereth by labour shall increase .

translation.kha: thaba u Judah bad ki hynmen ki por jong u ki la wan sha ïing u Joseph , ki syiem ba u dang don hi hangta .
translation.en: And Judah and his brethren came to Joseph s house  ; for he was yet there : and they fell before him on the ground .
If I justify myself , mine own mouth shall condemn me : if I say , I am perfect , it shall also prove me perverse .
translation.kha: Nga long uba lui lui , bad uba shaniah hok , hynrei ki ktien jong nga ki pynsngewrem , bad baroh kaba nga ong ka i kumba ka pynrem ïa nga .
bad u la kyllut ïa ki , Kane ka dur bad ka kyrtong ki dei ki jongno ?
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Whose is this image and superscription ?

translation.kha: U Khun U Beeroth un pham ïa la ki angel ba lumlang napoh ka Hima jong u ïa kito baroh kiba pynlong ïa ki briew jong u ba leh pop bad ïa baroh Kiwei pat kaba leh ïa kiwei kiei kiba sniew ,
translation.en: The Son of man shall send forth his angels , and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend , and them which do iniquity  ;
A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth : but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha kin ïoh bainong na ka bynta kaei kaba ki ong , hynrei kito kiba shukor ki thrang tang ban leh jubor .

translation.en: Your kerchiefs also will I tear , and deliver my people out of your hand , and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan sloit ïa ki jaiñ teh khlieh jong phi bad ngan shah ïa ki briew jong nga ban lait shisyndon na ka bor jong phi . Te phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
Shahshkor ! ong U Jisu . Nga wan kloi ! Ngan wallam ïa ki bainong lad sa , ban ai ha uwei pa uwei kat kum kaei kaba u la leh .
translation.en: And , behold , I come quickly  ; and my reward is with me , to give every man according as his work shall be .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki shiphew ngut ki rangbah ha Jesreel kin wanrah jingbam ïa ka kynhun shipai , bad kiwei patar kmen otsher pun pynshitom ïa ka Gibeah namar kaei ka kam khlemrain ba ki la leh ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And we will take ten men of an hundred throughout all the tribes of Israel , and an hundred of a thousand , and a thousand out of ten thousand , to fetch victual for the people , that they may do , when they come to Gibeah of Benjamin , according to all the folly that they have wrought in Israel .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , La don Kishion uwei u briew uba la khreh ka jingkhawai kaba khraw ha kaba u la khoit sngewbha bun ki biria .
translation.en: Then said he unto him ,  A certain man made a great supper , and bade many :
Who are these that fly as a cloud , and as the doves to their windows ?
translation.kha: Kiei kine ki liengbah kiba per kum u lyoh , kum ki paro ki wan phai sha la ki sem ?
Ïa Kane kano ka jingïohi jingmut ba u Ahithophel u la ai ha kito ki sngi , la pyngkiang kumba ka long hi ka ktien jong U Blei ; u Dabid dara u Abram baroh ar ngut ki bud ïa ka .
translation.en: And the counsel of Ahithophel , which he counselled in those days , was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God : so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom .

translation.kha: Katno u siew ia phi ?
translation.en: How much did he pay you ?

translation.kha: Nga thoh ïa ken sha phi shaphang kito kiba pyrshang ban shukor ïa phi .
translation.en: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you .

translation.kha: Ka jingpang bashyrkhei ka par baroh kawei ka set jong u bad ka pynlong ïa ki kti bad ki kjit jongnga u ban pyut .
translation.en: It shall devour the strength of his skin : even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength .
Have not I commanded thee ? Be strong and of a good courage  ; be not afraid , neither be thou dismayed : for the  Lord  thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba nga la hukum ïa me ban long uba kut jingmut triang bad uba skhem ! Wat sheptieng lane noh mynsiem , namar nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong me , nga long ryngkat lem bad me kat shaba me leit .

translation.en: Dead things are formed from under the waters , and the inhabitants thereof .
translation.kha: Ki mynsiem jong kiba la ïap ki khynñiuh ha ki um hapoh ka pyrthei .
U Hesekaïah u phai ïa la ka khmat sha ka kynroh bad u duwai :
translation.en: Then he turned his face to the wall , and prayed unto the  Lord  , saying ,
And if a man take a wife and her mother , it is wickedness : they shall be burnt with fire , both he and they  ; that there be no wickedness among you .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u shongkurim ïa ka briew bad sa ïa ka kmie jong ka , dei ban thang im ïa ki baroh lai ngut , ba kan duh kan dam ka kam sniew hapdeng jong phi .
U ong , Ngan pynap ïa ki nongsiatkhnam kiba la pynlong ïa ka Elam ban long kaba khrawbor .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will break the bow of Elam , the chief of their might .

translation.kha: (Nga la tip ba phin pynshisha ba Phin long kiba mutlop , kiba pynkheiñ kum ka nar bad ka rnong bym haka ban pynkdor .
translation.en: Because I knew that thou art obstinate , and thy neck is an iron sinew , and thy brow brass  ;
I will heap mischiefs upon them  ; I will spend mine arrows upon them .
translation.kha: ‘ Ha ki ngan pynngat ïa ki jingpynjot bymkut shuh , ngan siat lut la ki khnam ha ki .
Ki lyngkha ba sah shrak ki lah ba-bang pynmih shibun ka jingbam ïa kiba duk , hynrei ki bymhok kin Shi jhieh ïa kine khlem rep .
translation.en: Much food is in the tillage of the poor : but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment .
For their feet run to evil , and make haste to shed blood .
translation.kha: Kim lah ap ban leh ïa kaei kaei kaba sniew . Ki long borabor kiba kloi ban pynïap .
thaw ruh ïa ki diengkhap da ka diengsoh akasia , san tylli ïa ki jingker Ibbah ha kawei ka liang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translation.en: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood  ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,

translation.kha: NGA pynlong ïa kan ka jutang bad me : Ngi kular ba men longkmie u kput tymmen jong ki jaitbynriew kba bun .
translation.en: As for me , behold , my covenant is with thee , and thou shalt be a father of many nations .
And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory .
translation.kha: Nangta U Khun U Briew un paw , u da wan ha ki lyoh lem bad ka bor bad ka burom bakhraw .
Hynrei me — me pyntriem ïa por da ki jingphohsniew ; me phuh ha nga da ki jingïohipaw bad ki jingphohsniew kynsha
translation.en: Then thou scarest me with dreams , and terrifiest me through visions :
To receive the instruction of wisdom , justice , and judgment , and equity  ;
translation.kha: Ki lah ban hikai ïa phi kumno ban im kum kiba stad bad kumno ban long uba hok , uba lehhok , bad uba ïaid beit .
U Daniel shisyndon u la leit bad u la ïoh por da ka jingai jingbit jong u syiem , khnang ba u lah pun ïathuh ïa u syiem aïu ka jingphohsniew ka kit jingmut .
translation.en: Then Daniel went in , and desired of the king that he would give him time , and that he would shew the king the interpretation .

translation.kha: Wat pyntud shun sneng pynpyut ïa u khynnah . Ka jingsympat kaba dei kan ym pynkup ïa u .
translation.en: Withhold not correction from the child : for if thou beatest him with the rod , he shall not die .
He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul : but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding .
translation.kha: Lada phi kyntait ban shah hikai , phi ñiewbeiñ ïa lade . Lada phi pdiang ïa ka jingpynbeit , phin long kiba kham stad .
Kane ka la pynkmen saihon ïa u lyngdoh , kumta u shim ïa ki thiaw mawkyntang bad u leit lema bad ki .
translation.en: And the priest s heart was glad , and he took the ephod , and the teraphim , and the graven image , and went in the midst of the people .

translation.kha: * Ka kam kambah nyngkong eh kaweh u Jisu u la leh ka long ban shna ïa u Soitan bad ïa ki ksuid jong u sha ka pyiar .
translation.en: * Jesus’ first action as King was to throw Satan and his demons down to the earth .

translation.kha: Ka kun jongnga u ka ju long kaweh samla sad kaba khlong , hynrei shen kan sa kylli pui pui .
translation.en: His bones are full of the sin of his youth , which shall lie down with him in the dust .

translation.kha: Nga tip , kynhied , ba nga la leh pop , bad dei kane ken bapli ba nga longïing kaba nyngkong na ki jait bashaphang shatai ban wan bad ïakynduh ïa U Syiem Kynrad ha kane ka Sngi .
translation.en: For thy servant doth know that I have sinned : therefore , behold , I am come the first this day of all the house of Joseph to go down to meet my lord the king .
According to all these words , and according to all this vision , so did Nathan speak unto David .
translation.kha: U Nathan u ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa baroh kaba U Blei u la pynpaw ha u .

translation.en: And the work of righteousness shall be peace  ; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever .
translation.kha: Namar ba uwei pa uwei un leh ïa kaei kaba dei , kan don ka jingsuk bad ka jingshongshngain junom .
Ka long bieit ban krenbeiñ ïa kiwei . Lada phi long Uba sngewthuh , phin Shua sngap jar jar .
translation.en: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour : but a man of understanding holdeth his peace .
Then Nathan said unto David , Do all that is in thine heart  ; for God is with thee .
translation.kha: U Nathan u jubab ,  Leh kat kaba don ha ka jingmut jong phi , namar U Blei u long ryngkat bad phi .

Haba kata ka kada ka la ïohi ïa u angel ba u ïeng hangta ba u da bat ïa ka wallam , ka phet noh na surok bad ka la phai shiah ki lyngkha . U Balah u sympat ïa kata ka khi bad u wan ïalap pat ïa ka sha surok .
translation.en: And the ass saw the angel of the  Lord  standing in the way , and his sword drawn in his hand : and the ass turned aside out of the way , and went into the field : and Balaam smote the ass , to turn her into the way .
And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer , and they took the villages thereof , and drove out the Amorites that were there .
translation.kha: bad u Moses u phah ïa ki briew ban shem ka lynti babha tam kumno ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Jaser ; ki Israel ki la ïohknieh ïa ka bad ki shnong kiba sawdong jong ka , bad ki la beh noh ïa ki Amor kiba shong hangta .
U para jrong u , u dei u Jubal , u kpa tymmen jong ki nongtem jingtem baroh kiba tem ïa ka duitara bad put tangmuri .
translation.en: And his brother s name was Jubal : he was the father of all such as handle the harp and organ .

translation.kha: Nga tip aïu kito ki ïathuhlypa ki la ïa-ong , ki da kren lamler ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad kam ba at la ai ha ki ïa ki khubor jong nga ha ki jingpynïasoh jongngi ki .
translation.en: I have heard what the prophets said , that prophesy lies in my name , saying , I have dreamed , I have dreamed .

And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth , and shall set on fire and burn the weapons , both the shields and the bucklers , the bows and the arrows , and the handstaves , and the spears , and they shall burn them with fire seven years :
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah ki Israel kin ïamih shabar bad khar ïa ki tiar ïapom ba la iehnoh ïa ka ban thang diengïap . Kin sliew ding da ki stieh , ki ryntieh , ki khnam , ki sum bad ki dieng tangon , bad kin biang haduh hynñiew snem .

Mynta , sakhrai ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi ïa ka dohnud dara ka mynsiem jongki phi Baroh . Sdang noh ban tei ïa ka Templ , khnang ba phi la don shuh ha ka ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai dara ïa baroh kiwei pat ki tiar bakyntang ba ju pyndonkam ha kaba mane ïa u .
translation.en: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the  Lord  your God  ; arise therefore , and build ye the sanctuary of the  Lord  God , to bring the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and the holy vessels of God , into the house that is to be built to the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: 20 Hangno ka Pharpar Ko Wai ?
translation.en: 20 When Will Paradise Come ?

translation.kha: Phibi kynmaw aïu u la leh ïa u Dathan bad u Abiram , ki khun u Eliab uba na ka khait Reuben . Hangta ha khmat jongki phi baroh , ka khynwin ka ang bad ka nguid ïa ki lem bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong ki , ïa ki ïingjaiñ , ki shakri , bad ki jingri jong ki baroh .
translation.en: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram , the sons of Eliab , the son of Reuben : how the earth opened her mouth , and swallowed them up , and their households , and their tents , and all the substance that was in their possession , in the midst of all Israel :

translation.kha: Ki tur pyrshah ïa ki Benjamin ha ka sien kaba ar .
translation.en: And the children of Israel came near against the children of Benjamin the second day .

translation.kha: U leh ïa kaei kaba Sniew , namar ba um shym pyrshang ban wad ïa ka mon U Trai .
translation.en: And he did evil , because he prepared not his heart to seek the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kaei ka jingdonkam jong ka bleithaw ? Ka long tang Kaei kaei kaba la thaw da u briew , bad kad kren ei ei hynrei ka shukor . kadei kaba bha ba ka har ïa u nongthaw ba un shaniah ha ka — U Blei u bym lah woh ban klun !
translation.en: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it  ; the molten image , and a teacher of lies , that the maker of his work trusteth therein , to make dumb idols ?

translation.kha: jynreiñ lada ngi kyrmen ïa kaei kaba ngim ïohi , ngi ap ïa kata da ka jingïaishah .
translation.en: But if we hope for that we see not , then do we with patience wait for it .

translation.kha: U ong ha nga , To khmih , ko khun u briew , shahshkor kyndiang bad pynseisoh jingmut bha ïa kata baroh kaban nga pyn-i ha me ; namar ba na ka bynta kane la ïalam ïa me hangne . Me dei ban ïathuh ïa kata baroh ba me ïuh sha ki briew ka Jerusalem’ .
translation.en: And the man said unto me , Son of man , behold with thine eyes , and hear with thine ears , and set thine heart upon all that I shall shew thee  ; for to the intent that I might shew them unto thee art thou brought hither : declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel .

translation.kha: Ka ri ka jingdum , ki syrngiew bad jingkulmar , ha naba ka jingshai hi ka long ka jingdum .
translation.en: A land of darkness , as darkness itself  ; and of the shadow of death , without any order , and where the light is as darkness .
Which was with the deputy of the country , Sergius Paulus , a prudent man  ; who called for Barnabas and Saul , and desired to hear the word of God .
translation.kha: U la long u paralok jong u lyngskor jong kata ka dewlynnong , u Sergius Paulos uba la long u briew uba shemphang bha . Uta u lyngskor u la phah khot ïa u Barnabas bad u Saul ha khmat jong u namar u la kwah ban ïohsngew ïa ka ktien U Blei .

translation.en: That we may buy the poor for silver , and the needy for a pair of shoes  ; yea , and sell the refuse of the wheat ?
translation.kha: Ngi lah ban die ïa u kew u bymdondor ha ka dor kaba heh . Ngin shem ïa u briew uba duk u bym lah siew ïa ki ram jong u , wat ym ïa ka dor jong shi jur ki juti , bad ngin thied ïa u kum u mraw .

translation.en: He cried aloud , and said thus , Hew down the tree , and cut off his branches , shake off his leaves , and scatter his fruit : let the beasts get away from under it , and the fowls from his branches :
translation.kha: U la pynbna ha ka sur bajam , ‘ Pom ïa u dieng bad khet noh ïa ki tnat jong u ; sloit ïa ki sla jong u bad pynsaphriang ïa ki soh jong u . Beh noh ïa ki mrad napoh jong u bad ïa ki sim na ki tnat jong u .

To ngaiñ leh donakor , kum ki bariew kiba im ha ka jingshai jongnga ka sngi — khulom ki jingsngewma thad bakhynwin ne ka jingïabuaid , khyllem ka jingleh ïarah jlan ka jingleh khlem akor , khlem ka jingïashoh ïadat dawai ka jingbishni .
translation.en: Let us walk honestly , as in the day ; not in rioting and drunkenness , not in chambering and wantonness , not in strife and envying .

translation.kha: u phiah ïa ki nongshet , bad u shym ba u Sarah u la wan shisha hangtei .
translation.en: David therefore sent out spies , and understood that Saul was come in very deed .
With whomsoever of thy servants it be found , both let him die , and we also will be my lord s bondmen .
translation.kha: Bah , lada yn shem ïa ka ha uno uno na ngi , uta u dei ban ïap , bad kiba sah na ngi kin long noh ki mraw jong phi .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day , that they watched him .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi Sabbaton , U Jisu u la leit ban bam ha ka ïing jong uwei na ki Pharisi kiba kham pawkhmat ; bad ki briew ki la khmih bha ïa U Jisu .

Wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki brup bha bad ki ïaid sheng Shaneng . Ki la dih waiñ bad theh kyiad haduh katta katta haduh ba ki jynthut kulmar . Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïabuaid haduh katta katta ba kim sngewthuh shuh ïa ki jingphohsniew ba U Blei u phah , bad ki lyngdoh ki buaid haduh ba kim lah Shuah ban ai jingrai ïa ki kam ba la wanrah ha ki .
translation.en: But they also have erred through wine , and through strong drink are out of the way  ; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink , they are swallowed up of wine , they are out of the way through strong drink  ; they err in vision , they stumble in judgment .

translation.kha: Ki ktien jong u briew ki lah ban erlangthari ka mohkhiew ka jingstad , kaba jylliew kat ki duriaw-bah , kaba sngur kum ki wahduid batuid .
translation.en: The words of a man s mouth are as deep waters , and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook .
And said unto them , Ye men of Israel , take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men .
translation.kha: bad nangta u la ong ha ka Dorbar ,  Ko para Israel , da sumar ïa kaei kaba phi leh ïa kine ki briew .
U Blang hi da lade u la nguh lang ïa ka met ha kata ka rukom ban khamtam ai burom ïa kito ki dkhot met kiba donkam ïa ka .
translation.en: For our comely parts have no need : but God hath tempered the body together , having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked :

translation.kha: namarba ba phi la sngewtriem , ngan shait ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka ri shyiap ba na mihngi ban jop ïa phi . Kynton sher ïa ki dara jong ki ha ka ri jong phi bad shongduh hangta . Kin bam ïa u soh pynlang kin dih ïa ka dup kiba dei ki jong phi .
translation.en: Behold , therefore I will deliver thee to the men of the east for a possession , and they shall set their palaces in thee , and make their dwellings in thee : they shall eat thy fruit , and they shall drink thy milk .
Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts , their conscience also bearing witness , and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another ; )
translation.kha: Ka jingleh jong ki ka pyn-i ba ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa , la thoh ha ki dohnud jong ki . Ki jingïatiplem jong ki ruh ki pyn-i ba kane ka long kaba shisha , namar ki jingpyrkhat jong ki teng teng ki pynrem ïa ki bad teng teng ki kyrshan ïa ki .
phin ïew shong slem ruh ha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka bud bad ka ngap kaba U Trai u la kular ba ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi! bad ha ki khun ki ksew jong ki .
translation.en: And that ye may prolong your days in the land , which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed , a land that floweth with milk and honey .

translation.kha: ki syiem ktien shem dara hangta lem bun ki kynhun shipai jong ki . Kin pynïeng ïa la ki ïingjaiñ sawdong ka nongbah , malade uwei uwei un sher dara hangno hangno ba u kwah .
translation.en: The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her  ; they shall pitch their tents against her round about  ; they shall feed every one in his place .

translation.kha: Namar ba ïa ka snam jyllang u langsohmoh ym shym la wan shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ bakyntang , pa’ la dei ban bam ïa ka jingkñia hangta , kumba nga la hukum .
translation.en: Behold , the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place : ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place , as I commanded .
The  Lord  by wisdom hath founded the earth  ; by understanding hath he established the heavens .
translation.kha: U Trai u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei da ka jingstad jong u ; da ka jingshemphang jong u , u la buh beit ïa ka sahit bneng ha la ka jaka .
Ki ong , Ngi la wan hangne ban khum ïa me , khring ba ngin ïoh aiti ïa me ha ki . U Samson u ong , Kular ha nga da ka kiei ba phin ym pynïap ïa nga da pa hi .
translation.en: And they said unto him , We are come down to bind thee , that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines . And Samson said unto them , Swear unto me , that ye will not fall upon me yourselves .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Petros u la Jubab ïa u , Ai ba ïa me bad ka pisa jong me yn bret sha ka dujok , nia me pyrkhat ba me lah ïa-ban thied ïa ka jingai jong U Blei da ka pisa !
translation.en: But Peter said unto him , Thy money perish with thee , because thou hast thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money .
Who said unto his father and to his mother , I have not seen him  ; neither did he acknowledge his brethren , nor knew his own children : for they have observed thy word , and kept thy covenant .
translation.kha: Ki kham shaniah ïa me Ban ïa la ki kmie ki kpa , ki hynmen ki para , ne ki khun ki kti . Ki kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me Bad ki ïaineh ha ka jutang jong me .

Ngan ïam na ka bynta ki briew ka Sibmah , wat kham palat ban ïa ki briew ka Josakar . Ko ka nongbah Sibmah , pha long kum u diengkhap sohwaiñ uba ki tnat jong u ki poi shapoh sha arliang ka Duriaw Baïap bad jngai shaduh Jaser . Hynrei mynta ïa ki soh lyoh jong pha bad ïa ki sohwaiñ jong pha la pynjot .
translation.en: O vine of Sibmah , I will weep for thee with the weeping of Jazer : thy plants are gone over the sea , they reach even to the sea of Jazer : the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la sngewbha ïa “kata ka jingai jingot mala ki la ïamynjur .
translation.en: And all the congregation said that they would do so : for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people .

translation.kha: Hynñiew u ïohi ba ka jaka shongthait ka long kaba bha , Bad ba ka khyndew ka long kaba itynnat . Kumta u pyndem la ka met shun kit ïa ka jingkit , Bad la pynbor ba trei kum u mraw .
translation.en: And he saw that rest was good , and the land that it was pleasant  ; and bowed his shoulder to bear , and became a servant unto tribute .

translation.kha: U Jonah u la mih bad leit shaphang mangi jong ka nongbah bad u la shong hangta . U la shna ka kyrhai tnen ïa lade bad shong ha ka syrngiew jyllang ka , da kaba ap ban khmih kaei ka ban jia ïa ka Nebaïoth .
translation.en: So Jonah went out of the city , and sat on the east side of the city , and there made him a booth , and sat under it in the shadow , till he might see what would become of the city .

And he told it to his father , and to his brethren : and his father rebuked him , and said unto him , What is this dream that thou hast dreamed ? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth ?
translation.kha: U la ïathuh ruh ïa ka jingphohsniew ha la u kpa , bad u kpa jong u , u la mai ïa u ,  Ka jingphohsniew aïu kaba kum kata ? Hato me pyrkhat ba ka kmie jong me , ki hynmen shynrang jong me , bad ma nga ngin ïawan bad nguh ïa me ?

Ngan ym shim ei ei na ka byndi ïa lade ; ngan pdiang tang ïa kata kaba ki briew jong nga ki la pyndonkam . Hynrei shah ba ki pakor jongno sa , u Aner , u Iskah , bad u Mamre ba kin shim ïa la ka bynta .
translation.en: Save only that which the young men have eaten , and the portion of the men which went with me , Aner , Eshcol , and Mamre  ; let them take their portion .

translation.kha: Kita ki ar nongput ki riewrunar ki kynnoh byrsha ïa u ha khmat u paidbah ba u la thlim ïa U Blei sad ïa u syiem . Bad kumta la sei ïa u shabar ka nongbah bad lynthem maw ha ban da ïap .
translation.en: And there came in two men , children of Belial , and sat before him : and the men of Belial witnessed against him , even against Naboth , in the presence of the people , saying , Naboth did blaspheme God and the king . Then they carried him forth out of the city , and stoned him with stones , that he died .

translation.kha: Dang pha phyrngab ha ka sngap kaba san u khreh ban mihnoh , hynrei u kpa kata ka kynthei u nong , Da bim shuwa , bad ap haduh shun da noh ka sner . Kumta kita baroh’ ar ngut ki ïabam ïadih pur .
translation.en: And he arose early in the morning on the fifth day to depart : and the damsel s father said , Comfort thine heart , I pray thee . And they tarried until afternoon , and they did eat both of them .

translation.kha: U Blei u ong , Em . Ka Seraïah , ka tnga lad me kan sa khap khun shynrang ïa me , bad men khot kylleng ïa u , u Issakhar . Ngan bat ïa ka jingmut jong nga bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u . Ka daym ka jutang baïaineh jingkhum .
translation.en: And God said , Sarah thy wife shall bear thee a son indeed  ; and thou shalt call his name Isaac : and I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant , and with his seed after him .
That ye be not soon shaken in mind , or be troubled , neither by spirit , nor by word , nor by letter as from us , as that the day of Christ is at hand .
translation.kha: ban ym shah pynshaïong jingmut da kaba suk ha ka jingpyrkhat jong phi lane ban shah pynkhuslai da ka jingkam ba ka Sngi jong U Trai ka la lah wan . Lehse ka long ba la mut ba ngi la ong ïa kane katba ngi dang ïathuhlypa lane ïalap , lane ba ngi la thoh ïa ka ha ka shithi .

Keiñ ka thain ba U Trai u la ïarap ïa ki Israel ban ïohkynti — ki shnong Haseroth , Dibon , Jaser , Nimrah , Heshbon , Elead , Sibmah , Nebo bad Beon — ka longsem ka jaka kaba Bha na ka bynta ki jingri , bad ngi don shibun bah ki jingri .
translation.en: Even the country which the  Lord  smote before the congregation of Israel , is a land for cattle , and thy servants have cattle :

translation.kha: nur pynlong ïa pha ka nuksa ba-itriem , bad kata kan long kaba kut jongki pha . Ki bri ki lah Ban wad ïa pha , hynrei kin ym lap ïa pham . U Trai Nongsynshar u la krai .
translation.en: I will make thee a terror , and thou shalt be no more : though thou be sought for , yet shalt thou never be found again , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïa-ong ha ki barieh , Ka Kmen mala ki para shynrang jong nga ki long re kiba iohnong ïa ka ktien U blei bad kiba kohnguh ïa ka .
translation.en: And he answered and said unto them ,  My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of God , and do it .

translation.kha: Namar ba pha loit bad pynïap ïa la ki hynmen ki para shynrang , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , ïa pha yn pynjot mala pynkhlaiñbor jyrngam .
translation.en: For thy violence against thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee , and thou shalt be cut off for ever .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton u la sdang banbeiñ hikai ha ka synagog . Bun ki briew ki la don hangta ; bad haba ki la ïohsngew ïa u , baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh . Nangne u la ïoh ïa kan baroh ? ki la kylla . Ka jingtied aiu kaei ba la ai ha u ? Kumne u leh ïa ki kambah ?
translation.en: And when the sabbath day was come , he began to teach in the synagogue : and many hearing him were astonished , saying , From whence hath this man these things ? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him , that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands ?

translation.kha: Wat lada ki tih ïa ka lynti jong ki Shabeh ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ngan kem ïa ki . Wat lada ki kiew sha Bteng , ngan Pateng ïa ki shapoh .
translation.en: Though they dig into hell , thence shall mine hand take them  ; though they climb up to heaven , thence will I bring them down :

translation.kha: Un jop ïa ki bad un pynïap ïa ki , bad ki metïap jong ki kin shuki tama ha ka thring bah jong kata ka nongbah bakhraw , ha kaba ïa U Trai jong ki la sahnarphna . Ka kyrteng Persia jong —kata ka nongbam ka long ka Sodom , lane ka Ijipt .
translation.en: And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city , which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt , where also our Lord was crucified .

translation.kha: To ngeit ïa nga haba nga ong ba nga long ha U Kpa bad U kba u long ha la . Lymda kumta , to ngeit namar kai kiei Kiba nga leh .
translation.en: Believe me that I am in the Father , and the Father in me : or else believe me for the very works  sake .

And when we had accomplished those days , we departed and went our way  ; and they all brought us on our way , with wives and children , till we were out of the city : and we kneeled down on the shore , and prayed .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ka por jong ngi bad ki ka la kut , ngi la mihnoh bad ngi la nang leit ha ka jingleit jong ngi . Ma ki baroh , lem bad ki tnga bad ki khun jong ki , ki la ïaleit lem bad ngi na ka nongbah sha ka rud duriaw , ha kaba ngi la ïadem khohsiew bad duwai .
La pynmeh ïa ka ding hapdeng jong ka pyllew , nabar u Petros u la ïasuk lem bad kito naba ïashong sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall , and were set down together , Peter sat down among them .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïakhreh ïa U Trai bad shahjingit , U Mynsiem Bakhuid u la ong ha ki , Pynkyrpang na ka bynta jong nga ïa u Barnabas bad u saiwul , ban trei ïa ka kam sha ka ang la khot ïa ki .
translation.en: As they ministered to the Lord , and fasted , the Holy Ghost said , Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them .

translation.kha: Ki ong ha u , Kainan ka dei ka kabu jong phi ! U Trai u la ïathuh ïa phi ba un buh ïa u nongshun ha ka bor jong phoi dara phiah lah ban leh ïa u kat kaba phi kwah . U Dabid u par sor sor bad u ot shi lyngkhot na ka jaiñkup u Saul khlem ka jingmihpat u Saul .
translation.en: And the men of David said unto him , Behold the day of which the  Lord  said unto thee , Behold , I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand , that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee . Then David arose , and cut off the skirt of Saul s robe privily .

translation.kha: Hynrei wahbah ïingjaiñ hajan hangta uba kyrteng u Elihu um lah kun hajuh ïa la ka jingbitar , namar u Hobab u pynksan ïa put bad u kynnoh ïa U Blei . ( U Elihu u dadien u khun jong u Barakel , umbiah hiarpateng na u Bus , bad u dei na ka kur jongki u Ram . )
translation.en: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite , of the kindred of Ram : against Job was his wrath kindled , because he justified himself rather than God .

translation.kha: U Trai un buh ïa u syiem halor ki Israel u ban pynduh syndon ïa ka longïing shem jongu u Joab .
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  shall raise him up a king over Israel , who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day : but what ? even now .

translation.kha: wang noh ïa ki jingbymlongkhuid na ka rupa , bad u nong-ohdur un pynim ïa kamai kaei kaba itynnat .
translation.en: Take away the dross from the silver , and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer .

translation.kha: Ki thoh ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jongno U Blei , ym ïa la ki jyllang .
translation.en: They wrote his thoughts, not their own .
The  Lord  was ready to save me : therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me la pynkhiah ïa nga . Ngin tem ki duitara bad rwai ka jingïaroh ïa me , ngin rwai ïaroh ha ka Templ jong me katba ngi dang im .

wahbah u Saul u ïohi ïa u Dabid ba u leit ban ïaleh bad u Golgotha , u kylli ïa u Abner , u rangbah Shiphew jong u , Abner , u dei u khun jongno mo ? Ngam don jingtip , syiem Kynrad , u Abner u jubab .
translation.en: And when Saul saw David go forth against the Philistine , he said unto Abner , the captain of the host , Abner , whose son is this youth ? And Abner said , As thy soul liveth , O king , I cannot tell .
And all the devils besought him , saying , Send us into the swine , that we may enter into them .
translation.kha: Kumta kita ki mynsiem bymkhuid ki la ïakyrpad ïa U Jisu ,  Phah ïa ngi ha kitei ki sniang , bad shah ïa ngi ban rung hapoh jong ki .
ka Tappuah , ka Hepher ,
translation.en: The king of Tappuah , one  ; the king of Hepher , one  ;
For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest , into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated :
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan aiti ïa pha ha ki briew kiba pha isih bad pha ijli .

translation.en: And of Zebulun he said , Rejoice , Zebulun , in thy going out  ; and , Issachar , in thy tents .
translation.kha: Shaphang ki jait Sebulun bad Issakhar u ong ,  Kiba na ka jait Sebulun to kin manbha ha ki jingkhaïi pateng ha duriaw ; Bad to ka spah jong ka jait Issakhar kan nang roi ha la ka ri .

translation.en: And they shall teach no more every man his neighbour , and every man his brother , saying , Know the  Lord  : for they shall all know me , from the least of them unto the greatest of them , saith the  Lord  : for I will forgive their iniquity , and I will remember their sin no more .
translation.kha: Yn ym don uwei ruh na ki u ban hap hikai ïa la u para ri ban tip ïa U  Trai  , namar baroh kin tip ïa nga , naduh uba rit tam haduh uba khraw tam . Ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki bad ngan ym kynmaw shuh ïa ki jingbakla jong ki . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses bad ïa u Aaron ; Ïathuh ha ki Isaia bad ha u Pharaoh ba nga la hukum ïa phi ban ïalam noh ïa ki Israel na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , and gave them a charge unto the children of Israel , and unto Pharaoh king of Egypt , to bring the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Wat premmiet .’
translation.en: Ye have heard that it was said by them of old time , Thou shalt not commit adultery :

translation.kha: U Trai u la ïapyllait im ïa nga na ka jingïapan , u la pynsangeh ïa ki sum jong per , pynlang u la sumar ïa por na ka jingshahjop .
translation.en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death , mine eyes from tears , and my feet from falling .

translation.kha: Ka jingkhuid ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat : Lada ngi pyndih ïa ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ngi da kiei kiwei kiba khuid , ka jingrang jong ngi ruh kan long Kaba khup .
translation.en: Mental Cleanness : If we fill our minds with clean , pure thoughts , our conduct will also be clean .

translation.kha: Ym ba-don mano mano ruh ba lah ban pyllait ïa lade na ka ban ïap lane pynslem ïa ka sngi ka jingap jongu u . Kata ka dei ka thma kaba ngim lah ban lait ; ngim lah ban pyllaitluid ïa lade da ka jingshukor .
translation.en: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit  ; neither hath he power in the day of death : and there is no discharge in that war  ; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it .

translation.kha: Kito kiba don ki mawkynroh ki la ai ïa ki sha ka jingsngew jong ka Templ , kaba la khmih da u Jehiel jong ka kur Lebi jong u Gershon .
translation.en: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the  Lord  , by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite .

translation.kha: Ki shakri jong u ki ong ha u , Ngi tip ba u mynsiem bymdon ba la phah U Blei u pynjynjar ïa phin .
translation.en: And Saul s servants said unto him , Behold now , an evil spirit from God troubleth thee .
A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame , and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren .
translation.kha: U shakri uba sian un ïoh long khlieh halor u khun bymlarkam jong u kynrad bad ïohpdiang shi bynta na ka jingïohpateng .
Mynta , A Trei , kham ïa katai naba jied ha im’ . Shahshkor ïa barhem kiei kiei kiba u Sennakherib u ong ban jingibeiñ ïa me , U Blei uba im .
translation.en: Lord  , bow down thine ear , and hear : open ,  Lord  , thine eyes , and see : and hear the words of Sennacherib , which hath sent him to reproach the living God .

translation.kha: Namar kane , u Moses um shym haka ban leit rung shapoh kata ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation , because the cloud abode thereon , and the glory of the  Lord  filled the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Nga la khmih shajrong bad ïohi ïa ki ar ngut ki kynthei kiba her sha nga blem bad ki thapniang bakhlaiñbor kum kito ki lad ka thring . Ki la shim ïa ka shang bad ki her noh lam bad ka .
translation.en: Then lifted I up mine eyes , and looked , and , behold , there came out two women , and the wind was in their wings  ; for they had wings like the wings of a stork : and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven .

translation.kha: haba to ong katno ka jingsniew jong nga , katno ka jingpang ba khlem kut jong ka dohnud jongngi nga na ka bynta ki briew jong nga , kiba long ka doh ka snam jong nga!
translation.en: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart .
And David said unto the young man that told him , How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead ?
translation.kha: Kumno me tip ba u Saul bad u Jonathan ki la ïap ?  u Dabid u la kylli ïa u .

U Trai u la ong , Ki briew ki ïa-ong ba khnai ka jaka ka erlangthari kum ka ri shyiap , ba kam don ki briew ne ki mrad kiba im ha ka . badno ki ong ïa kaba dei ; ki shnong ka Judah bad ki surok biah ka Jerusalem ki long thylli ; ym don ki briew ne ki mrad kiba im hangta .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Again there shall be heard in this place , which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast , even in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem , that are desolate , without man , and without inhabitant , and without beast ,

translation.kha: U nongshong basaw ne u nongbylla um bit ban bam ïa ka .
translation.en: A foreigner and an hired servant shall not eat thereof .

translation.kha: Hynrei ine dei ki jong ka sner , bad ngi dei ban pynkad . Ngi dei ban samla ïa ka jingneit bad ïa ka jingieit kum ka jingduk syiad , mala ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ïa ka jingpynim kum ka jingda khlieh .
translation.en: But let us , who are of the day , be sober , putting on the breastplate of faith and love ; and for an helmet , the hope of salvation .
To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth ,
translation.kha: U Trai u tip mynno ki mynsiem jong ngi ki shah pynlwet ha ka byndi ;

Ki rangbah jong nga kin pynpoi ïa ki dieng tylli na Lebanon shathie shuh ka duriaw sad kin teh pur ïa ki ha ki bur ban pynpoi ïa ki sharum jongki ka rud duriaw Sha ka jaka kaba me lngaid . Hangta ki rangbah jong nga kin law ïa ki jingteh , badno ki pynrangbah lad me kin shimti ïa ki . Na ka liang jong me , nga kwah ïa me don pynbiang jingbam ïa ki rangbah jong nga .
translation.en: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea : and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me , and will cause them to be discharged there , and thou shalt receive them : and thou shalt accomplish my desire , in giving food for my household .
The morning is come unto thee , O thou that dwellest in the land : the time is come , the day of trouble is near , and not the sounding again of the mountains .
translation.kha: Kaba kut ka la wan ha phi ki briew kiba shong ha ka ri . Ka por ka la jan ha kaba yn ym don shuh ka jingïaleh kmen ha ki jaka mane ha ki lumbah , tang ka jingkulmar suda .

translation.en: If a bird s nest chance to be before thee in the way in any tree , or on the ground , whether they be young ones , or eggs , and the dam sitting upon the young , or upon the eggs , thou shalt not take the dam with the young :
translation.kha: Lada jia ba phi lap ïa ka skum sim ha u dieng ne ha khyndew lem bad ïa ka sim kmie kaba pdem ïa ki pylleng lane kaba kdup ïa la ki khun , phim dei ban kem ïa ka sim kmie .
Haduh lai sngi um shym ia ban ïohi , bad ha katai ka por um shym la bam ne dih ei ei .
translation.en: And he was three days without sight , and neither did eat nor drink .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi ïoh da jingkem phi lah ban lehrain kum ka jingbabe babha tam , hynñiew shen kan longsem kum u shyiap ba-dap ha ka shyntur .
translation.en: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man  ; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel .

Their horses also are swifter than the leopards , and are more fierce than the evening wolves : and their horsemen shall spread themselves , and their horsemen shall come from far  ; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat .
translation.kha: Ki kulai jong ki , ki kham stet ban ïa ki  labasa , kham shyrkhei ban ïa ki suri bathngan . Ki nongshong kulai jong ki , ki wan tur na ki jaka ba sha jngai ; ki kulai jong ki , ki trud ïa ka khyndew . Ki wan suh wia kum ki pukni kiba tur ha ka jingbam .

translation.en: He walked also after their counsel , and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth–gilead : and the Syrians smote Joram .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki jingai jingmut jong ki , u la ïasoh bad u Joram u syiem ka Israel ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Syria . Ki kynhun shipai ki la ïaleh ha Ramoth ha Gilead , bad u Joram u la mynsaw ha ka thma .
ka jingai khlei ïa ka Priskila bad u Akwila bad ïa ka ïing u Onesiphoros .
translation.en: Salute Priscilla and Aquila , and the household of Onesiphorus .
In the  Lord  shall all the seed of Israel be justified , and shall glory .
translation.kha: Nga , U  Trai  , ngan pyllait im ïa baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , bad kin ai ka jingïaroh ïa nga .

U la don ka jinglah kaba kham pher bad u long uba stad bad umbah tbit ha Kaba batai ïa ki jingsngewdiaw , umbah ai jubab ïa ki jingkyntip , bad batai ïa ki jingmaïan ; kumta to phah khot ïa eit u brisoh , u Daniel , ïa uba u syiem u la ai kyrteng u Belteshassar , bad un ïathuh ïa phi aïu kane barhem ka put jingmut .
translation.en: Forasmuch as an excellent spirit , and knowledge , and understanding , interpreting of dreams , and shewing of hard sentences , and dissolving of doubts , were found in the same Daniel , whom the king named Belteshazzar : now let Daniel be called , and he will shew the interpretation .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba ngeit ïa la u hynmen u lai u ïaid ha ka jingshai , bad kumta ym don kaei kaei ha u ka ban pyntong ïano ïano paw ban leh pop .
translation.en: He that loveth his brother abideth in the light , and there is none occasion of stumbling in him .

translation.kha: Phi dei borabor ban kohnguh ïa ki shaiñ bad ki hukum kiba to la thoh na ka bynta jong phi . Phim dei ban ïanguh ïa kiwei ki blei ,
translation.en: And the statutes , and the ordinances , and the law , and the commandment , which he wrote for you , ye shall observe to do for evermore  ; and ye shall not fear other gods .

translation.kha: mala un mih shabar ban shukor ïa ki jaitbynriew ïa kiba la pynbunkam kylleng ka Pyrthei , Katai ka Doeg bad ka Magog . U Soitan un wallam lang ïa ki na ka bynshet ka jingïaleh thma , kiba bhor kat ki shimet shyiap Harod ka duriaw .
translation.en: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth , Gog and Magog , to gather them together to battle : the number of whom is as the sand of the sea .
Thanks a lot
translation.kha: Khublei shibun

translation.en: No man , when he hath lighted a candle , covereth it with a vessel , or putteth it under a bed  ; but setteth it on a candlestick , that they which enter in may see the light .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba thang ïa ka sharak bad tap ïa ka da ka shang lane buh ïa ka ha khrum jingthiah . Pynban , u buh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharak , khnang ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai katba ki dang wan rung .

Ha ka sngi kaba bud katba long ka sngap Kaba Nepheg lai jong u bnai uba hynñiew , u Salome u phiah noh ïa ki briew sha la ïing . Ki la kmang ïa baroh ki jingkyrkhu ba U Trai u la ai ha ki brisoh jong u ki Israel , ha u Dabid pynlang ha u Samson .
translation.en: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents , glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the  Lord  had shewed unto David , and to Solomon , and to Israel his people .
So then death worketh in us , but life in you .
translation.kha: Kane ka mut ba ka jingïap ka trei hapoh jong ngi , hynrei , ka jingim ka trei hapoh jong phi .
to shahshkor ïa ki jingaiei jong ki . To sngur ïa ki na bneng bad to ai ha ki ïa ka jingjop .
translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication , and maintain their cause .

translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ka jingthngan bad ki mradkhlaw ba kin pynpaw ïa ki khun jong phai , bad ngan phah ïa ka jingpang , ka jingleh thombor , bad ka thma ban pynjop ïa pha . Ma nga , U Trai , to la krai .
translation.en: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts , and they shall bereave thee  ; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee  ; and I will bring the sword upon thee . I the  Lord  have spoken it .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ka por kan wang haba ïa kane ka jaka yn ym khot shu ka Topheth lane ka Them Hinnom . Pynban yn tip ïa ka kumne ka Them ka Jingpynïap .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that this place shall no more be called Topheth , nor The valley of the son of Hinnom , but The valley of slaughter .

translation.kha: Ki kur u Gershon ki dei shun shong dara shaphang syngkai shajan ka Ïing ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka ding ka dat ban ïai meh lynter halor ka dil bad ym dei ban shah ba kan lip nala .
translation.en: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar  ; it shall never go out .

translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa , u Jehu u khun jongu u Hanani , u wait ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem bad ïa-ong ha u , Hattush ka long kaba dei ban ïarap ïa kito ki briew kba sniew bad ban ïathiah bad kito kiba kito ïa U Troas ? Kaei kambah phi la leh ka la wallam ïa ka jingbitar U Trai halor jong phi .
translation.en: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him , and said to king Jehoshaphat , Shouldest thou help the ungodly , and love them that hate the  Lord  ? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the  Lord .

translation.kha: ngan sdien ïa kita ha la ka tyrpeng da kaba sngewsarong malade ngan buh ïa ki ha ka khlem kum ka pansngiat .
translation.en: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder , and bind it as a crown to me .
