translation.kha: Phi la ïohi ruh ba ki kjat bad ki shympriah kjat ki long shi bynta da ka dewbyrtha pynlang shi boitha da ka nar . Kanaan ka mut ba kan long ka hima kaba la pynkhleh . Kan don kai kaei kaba eh kum ka nar , namar la don ka nar kaba la khleh bad ka dewbyrtha .
translation.en: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes , part of potters  clay , and part of iron , the kingdom shall be divided  ; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron , forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay .

translation.kha: Kumta u Josaïah u la shim ïa ka , u la spaiñ da ka jaiñ linen kaba thymmai ,
translation.en: And when Joseph had taken the body , he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth ,

translation.kha: U Trai u ïathuh ha phi ban ym shad ba ki Assyria kin pynkhaw-eit ïa phi da ki jingkob lad ki ba um lah ban pyllait ïa phi .
translation.en: And Isaiah said unto them , Thus shall ye say unto your master , Thus saith the  Lord  , Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard , wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me .

translation.kha: Uta u rangbah synshar u la kylli ïa u Philip , To ïathuh ïa nga , shaphang Jong u nongïathuhlypa u Kren ïa kano ? shaphang ïa lade ne shaphang uwei paw ?
translation.en: And the eunuch answered Philip , and said , I pray thee , of whom speaketh the prophet this ? of himself , or of some other man ?

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki la don hangta bun sngi , u Phestos u la tuklar ïa ka jinglong jingman jong u Paul ha u syiem . Don u briew hangne ïa wahbah la ioh kiei da u Pheliks ;
translation.en: And when they had been there many days , Festus declared Paul s cause unto the king , saying , There is a certain man left in bonds by Felix :
And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Simon , I have somewhat to say unto thee .  And he saith , Master , say on .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kren bad u la ong ha u ,  Ko Simon , nga don ei ei ban ong ha me .   Ko Nonghikai ,  u la ong ,  to ïathuh ïa nga .

translation.en: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote unto you with many tears ; not that ye should be grieved , but that ye might know the love which I have more abundantly unto you .
translation.kha: Nga la thoh sha phi da ka dohnud kaba sngewkhia bad sngewkhuslai ryngkat bad ki ummat kiba bun ; ka jingthmu jong nga kam shym long ban pynsngewsih ïa phi , hynrei ban pynsngewthuh ïa phi haduh katno nga ieit ïa phi baroh .
U Nongshun u la ap khem ïa sem ; ngim lah wat ban ïaid ha ki lynti bthah . Ki sngi jong ngi ki la kut ; kaba kut ka la wanlam .
translation.en: They hunt our steps , that we cannot go in our streets : our end is near , our days are fulfilled  ; for our end is come .

translation.kha: Kin ym lah shuh ban bam ïa ka doh lem bad ka snam ha ka , lieng ïa kiwei pat ki jingbam ba la mana . Beor babha laitim im kyang long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga bad kin long kumno ka kur ha ka jat Judah . Ka Ekron kan sylla longïing ka bynta jongnga ki bariew jong nga , kumba ki Jebus ki la long .
translation.en: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth , and his abominations from between his teeth : but he that remaineth , even he , shall be for our God , and he shall be as a governor in Judah , and Ekron as a Jebusite .

translation.kha: Nga la bteng ban duwai , da kaba phla ïa ki pop jongnga nga bad ïa ki thup jong ki bynriew jong nga ki Israel , bad da kaba ïasaid bad U Trai U Blei jongnga nga ban pynbha pud ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong u ,
translation.en: And whiles I was speaking , and praying , and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel , and presenting my supplication before the  Lord  my God for the holy mountain of my God  ;

translation.kha: Ka khyndew hi ka pynong ïa u jingthung ban san bad ban seisoh ; nyngkong u speh balung u mih , hadien ka kop , nabar Khatduh ka kop ba-dap da u symboh kaweh .
translation.en: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself  ; first the blade , then the ear , after that the full corn in the ear .
For my sword shall be bathed in heaven : behold , it shall come down upon Edom , and upon the people of my curse , to judgment .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynkhreh ïa ka waitlam jong u ha bneng , bad mynta kan mait ïa ki Edom , kita ki briew ïa kiba u la pynrem sha ka jingjot .

translation.en: And I will set a sign among them , and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations , to Tarshish , Pul , and Lud , that draw the bow , to Tubal , and Javan , to the isles afar off , that have not heard my fame , neither have seen my glory  ; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynsah katto katne na ki bad phah ïa ki sha ki jaitbynriew bad sha ki ri kiba jngai ki bym pat shym la ïohsngew ïa ka nam jong nga lymne ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw bad ka bor jong nga : sha Spain , sha Libya bad sha Lydia , ryngkat bad ki nongrah ryntieh kiba tbit , bad sha Tubal bad sha Gris . Hapdeng kine ki jaitbynriew kin pynbna ïa ka jingkhrawbor jong nga .

translation.en: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city , and the people not be afraid ? shall there be evil in a city , and the  Lord  hath not done it ?
translation.kha: Hato ka turoi thma ka ju sawa ha ka nongbah khlem da pynlong ïa ki briew ban sheptieng ? Hato ka jingjynjar ka ju ngat ha ka nongbah lymda U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ?
phiah ïa kata ka ri ha ki lai bynta . Kawei ka bynshet kad don kadei ka shnong ha kaba yn don ruh ka lynti ka syngkien . Te u briew Uba pynïap ïano ïano u lah ban pher Rieh sha kawei na ki .
translation.en: Thou shalt prepare thee a way , and divide the coasts of thy land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee to inherit , into three parts , that every slayer may flee thither .
If ye shall ask any thing in my name , I will do it .
translation.kha: Lada phi pan na nga ïa kano kano ha ka kyrteng jong nga , ngan leh ïa kata .

translation.en: And it was told Solomon , saying , Behold , Adonijah feareth king Solomon : for , lo , he hath caught hold on the horns of the altar , saying , Let king Solomon swear unto me to day that he will not slay his servant with the sword .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Syiem Solomon ba u Adonijah u la sheptieng ïa u , bad ba u bat sah ïa ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong ka duwan , u da ong ,  Nyngkong eh , nga kwah ba u Syiem Solomon un smai ha nga ba un ym phah pynïap ïa nga .
Te haba ki la khmied badno kim shym la ïohi ïano ïasnoh ruh Haneng hynrei tang ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And when they had lifted up their eyes , they saw no man , save Jesus only .

translation.kha: Ki briew jongngi nga ki la bet ïa u kew , hynrei ki la lum ïa ki ñiew ; ki la trei shitom , hynrei kim shym ïoh ei ei na ka bynta kata . Namar ka jingbitar shla jongno nga ki jingthung jong ki kim shym long .
translation.en: They have sown wheat , but shall reap thorns : they have put themselves to pain , but shall not profit : and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka Maakah , ka tnga u Makhir , ka kha ar nud ki khun shngain , kiba ka ai kyrteng ïa ki u Peresh bad u Teresh . U Peresh u ei ar ngut ki khun Shaneng , u Ulam bad u Rakem ,
translation.en: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son , and she called his name Peresh  ; and the name of his brother was Sheresh  ; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem .
That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever !
translation.kha: Lane da u shniah ban shniah ïa ki ktien jong nga ha u maw bad ban thoh ïa ki khnang ba kin sah junom .
Bad khie ka jingmut jong ki ar tylli ki tnat tieng Olib hajan ki ar tylli ki tyndong ksiar na kaba la phylliew ïa ka umphniang Olib ?
translation.en: And I answered again , and said unto him , What be these two olive branches which through the two golden pipes empty the golden oil out of themselves ?

And it came to pass on the morrow , which was the second day of the month , that David s place was empty : and Saul said unto Jonathan his son , Wherefore cometh not the son of Jesse to meat , neither yesterday , nor to day ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ka sngi hadien ka jingkhawai mih bnai thymmai , ka jaka shong bam u Dabid ka dang thylli hi , bad u Saul u kylli ïa u Jonathan ,  Balei u Dabid um shym wan sha ka jingkhawai mynhynnin bad mynta ka sngi ruh ?
bad yn pynïap ïa phiah ha ka thma ha ka ri jong phi hi . Te uwei pa uwei un tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Ye shall fall by the sword  ; I will judge you in the border of Israel  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

And the fourth angel sounded , and the third part of the sun was smitten , and the third part of the moon , and the third part of the stars  ; so as the third part of them was darkened , and the day shone not for a third part of it , and the night likewise .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba saw u la put ïa la ka turoi . Shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka sngi la shoh , bad shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong u bnai , bad shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ki khlur , ba ka jingshai jong ki ka la jah noh shi bynta na ka lai bynta ka jingtyngshaiñ ; ym shym la don jingshai ha ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka sngi bad ïa ka shi bynta na ka lai bynta jong ka miet .

Haba la poi u bnai uba ingiew , ki briew ka Israel ki la ïashong ïasah ha ki Shong . Ha ka sngaid bathngan jong uta u bnai , ki la ïalumlang ha Jeremaïah , ha ka jakarieh basawdong Hapoh ka Khyrdop Um . Ki ong ïa u Esra , u lyngdoh malade u riewstad ka Hukum ïa kaba U Trai u la ai ha ki Israel lyngba u Moses , ban wanrah ïa ka kitab jong ka Hukum .
translation.en: And all the people gathered themselves together as one man into the street that was before the water gate  ; and they spake unto Ezra the scribe to bring the book of the law of Moses , which the  Lord  had commanded to Israel .
Hast thou given the horse strength ? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder ?
translation.kha: Hato dei ma me , ko Job , uba pynkhlaiñ haduh katta katta ïa ki kulai bad ai ha ki ïa ki treng kiba noh rymphum ?

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if they will not believe thee , neither hearken to the voice of the first sign , that they will believe the voice of the latter sign .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Lada kim ngeit ïa me lane kim lah pdiang ïa ka kambah kaba nyngkong , te kane kan pynngeit ïa ki .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Go in , and behold the wicked abominations that they do here .
translation.kha: U la ong ha nga ,  Rung shapoh , bad peit ïa kaba sniew , ïa kiei kiei kiba ijli ba ki ïaleh hangta .

translation.en: And the leper in whom the plague is , his clothes shall be rent , and his head bare , and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip , and shall cry , Unclean , unclean .
translation.kha: U briew uba la ïoh ïa ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh u dei ban phong da ki jaiñjot , un ieh khlem sad ïa la u shñiuh , un tap ïa la ka khmat naduh ki rmiang shyntur sharum , bad un pyrta ,  U bymkhuid , u bymkhuid !

translation.en: For all the gods of the people are idols : but the  Lord  made the heavens .
translation.kha: Ki blei jong kiwei ki jaitbynriew baroh ki long tang ki bleithaw , hynrei U  Trai  u thaw ïa ki bneng .

translation.en: Thou shalt not kill .
translation.kha: Wat pynïap briew .
Bad Hadien ba ki la lah pyndep ïa kaei katei baroh kiba ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ïai-ong shaphang jong u , ki la pynhiar noh! ïa u na ka diengphna malade ki la buh ïa u ha ka jingtep .
translation.en: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him , they took him down from the tree , and laid him in a sepulchre .

translation.kha: Te nga la dep sdang ïa ka jingpynjot bad jingpynpra ïa phi namar ki pop jongnga phi .
translation.en: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee , in making thee desolate because of thy sins .
And the chief of all the people , even of all the tribes of Israel , presented themselves in the assembly of the people of God , four hundred thousand footmen that drew sword .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam na ki jait Israel baroh ki ïadon ryngkat ha kata ka jingïalang jong ki briew U Blei , bad ki ïadon saw lakh ngut ki shipai hangta .

translation.en: Therefore it is of faith , that it might be by grace ; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed ; not to that only which is of the law , but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham ; who is the father of us all ,
translation.kha: Bad kumta ïa ka kular la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingngeit , khnang ba ïa ka jingngeit yn pynthikna kum ka jingai sngewbha jong U Blei ïa baroh kiba hiarpateng na u Abraham — ym tang ïa kito kiba ngeit ïa ka Hukum , hynrei ïa kito ruh kiba ngeit kumba u Abraham u la leh . Namar u Abraham u long u kpa ba kynja mynsiem jong ngi baroh ;
Ki ktien jong u briew ki lah ban long ka ñiuhtmoh ka jingwad , kaba jylliew kat ki duriaw-bah , kaba snoh kum ki shawkad batuid .
translation.en: The words of a man s mouth are as deep waters , and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook .

translation.kha: phin thied iohi ianga ?
translation.en: Did you buy me anything ?

translation.kha: nangne ka hok jongu u Ïoannis ban pynbaptis ka wan : hato ka long na U Blei ne na u Briew ? Ki la sdang ban ïasaidnia para ma ki , Aiñ ngin ïa-ong ? Lymda i jubab ‘ Na U blei ,’ un ong ha ngi , ‘ Balei , te , drama ngeit ïa u Ïoannis ?’
translation.en: The baptism of John , whence was it ? from heaven , or of men ?  And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven  ; he will say unto us , Why did ye not then believe him ?
Moreover as for me , God forbid that I should sin against the  Lord  in ceasing to pray for you : but I will teach you the good and the right way :
translation.kha: Ïa nga shimet , U  Trai  um shah da lei lei ba ngan leh pop pyrshah ïa u da kaba sangeh noh ban duwai na ka bynta jong phi . Pynban ngan hikai ïa phi ïa kaei kaba bha bad kaba dei ïa phi ban leh .

translation.en: Rather , God’s Word teaches that you are a soul , that your soul is really you , with all your physical and mental qualities .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka ktien u Blei ka hikai ba mangi ngi long ka mynsiem , ba ka mynsiem ka dei shisha mangi , ha ka met bad ha ka jingmut jingpyrkhat bad baroh ka jinglong jongngi hi .

Ha kane ka jingthmu , hapoh nga i kum u bymneh jingmut ? Haba nga pynlong ïa ki jingthmu jong nga , hato nga leh ïa ki da ki jingrem ba khan myntoi , kum Uba la kloi ban ong Ho-oid , ha-ei badno Em , em ha kajuh ka por ?
translation.en: When I therefore was thus minded , did I use lightness ? or the things that I purpose , do I purpose according to the flesh , that with me there should be yea yea , and nay nay ?

translation.kha: To khem ïa ka jingïaishah slem U Trai jong ngi kum ka lad ba u ai ha phi ban ïoh im , kumba u Paul u para ba-ima jong ngi u la tah ha phi , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingstad kaba U Blei u la ai ha u .
translation.en: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation  ; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him hath written unto you  ;

translation.kha: Namar ba la rai pynrem ïa nga , balei te ngan salia shuh ?
translation.en: If I be wicked , why then labour I in vain ?

When Saul heard that David was discovered , and the men that were with him , ( now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah , having his spear in his hand , and all his servants were standing about him  ; )
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Saul u don ha Gibeah , u da shong ha trai u dieng Tamarisk halor u lum , lem bad la u sum ha ka kti , bad baroh ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ki don sawdong jong u .
Ha kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don sha ka jingkhriat lane u thah ,
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the light shall not be clear , nor dark :

translation.kha: Uno Uno uba sniew u dei ban ïai leh sniew , nabar uno uno uba jaboh u dei ban ïai jop ; uno uno kaba bha u dei ban ïa lehbha , bad uno uno babha khuid u dei ban ïailong khuid .
translation.en: He that is unjust , let him be unjust still : and he which is filthy , let him be filthy still : and he that is righteous , let him be righteous still : and he that is holy , let him be holy still .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi don ei ei ban ong , to ai ba ngan sngew ïa kata ; ngan pdiang da kaba sngewbha lada kambah phi ong ka long kaba dei .
translation.en: If thou hast any thing to say , answer me : speak , for I desire to justify thee .

translation.kha: Dang ka jingngeit kaba ïada ïa u Enokh na ka jingïap . Pynbna , la rah ïa u sha U Blei , bad ym don uno uno uba lah ban shem ïa u , namar U Blei u la phah ïa u shajrong . Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka nong ba shuwa ba rah ïa u Emek shajrong , u la pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
translation.en: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death  ; and was not found , because God had translated him : for before his translation he had this testimony , that he pleased God .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kyntait biah ban ong ei ei , bad u Paltiel u la sngewlyngngoh .
translation.en: But Jesus yet answered nothing  ; so that Pilate marvelled .
The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers , and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt , and with an high arm brought he them out of it .
translation.kha: U Blei jong ki paid Israel u la jied ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad u la pynlong ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw ïa une u paid ha ka por ba ki la im kum ki nongwei ha ka ri Ijipt . U Blei u la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt da ka bor bakhraw jong u ,

Uwei uwei baroh u ïai ïabam bad ïadih , mala ki shngain bad ki kynthei ki jingjahburom , haduh ka sngi kaba u Noah u la leit rung Shobab ka lieng bad ka jingshlei um ka la wan bad ka la pynïap ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: They did eat , they drank , they married wives , they were given in marriage , until the day that Noah entered into the ark , and the flood came , and destroyed them all .
These were more noble than those in Thessalonica , in that they received the word with all readiness of mind , and searched the scriptures daily , whether those things were so .
translation.kha: Ki briew hangta ki long kiba kham ïar jingmut ban ïa ki briew kiba ha Thessaloni . Ki la shahshkor ïa ka khubor da ka jingangnud bakhraw , bad man ka sngi ki ju pule bniah ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ban khmih lada kaei kaba u Paul u ong ka long kaba shisha .

Ki khnam jong ki , ki long kba nep , bad ki ryntieh jong ki , ki un-long ibha la pynkhiah ban siat . Ki poh jat jong ki kulai jong ki , ki eh kum ki mawshamok bad ki shaka jong ki puta ïapom jong ki , ki kyllum un-long kumto ka erlangthari .
translation.en: Whose arrows are sharp , and all their bows bent , their horses  hoofs shall be counted like flint , and their wheels like a whirlwind :

translation.kha: Ki nongleh myntor Kam ha ïeng shuh ha khmat u Moses namar ki la ïa-ïoh tohjaw lut kumba long lem kiwei pat ki nong Ijipt .
translation.en: And the magicians could not stand before Moses because of the boils  ; for the boil was upon the magicians , and upon all the Egyptians .

translation.kha: Ko Syiem bakhlaiñbor , me ieit ïa kaei kaba dei ; me la pynskhem ïa ka jingbishar khih ha Israel ; me la ïarah ïa ka hok bad ka jinglehhok .
translation.en: The king s strength also loveth judgment  ; thou dost establish equity , thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob .

translation.kha: Nangta , ngi kylli ïa ki nongïalam jong ki ban ïathuh ïa Ngi mano ba la ai bor ïa ki pun tei biang ïa ka Templ bad pynphriang ïa ki jingbah jingsat jong ka .
translation.en: Then asked we those elders , and said unto them thus , Who commanded you to build this house , and to make up these walls ?

translation.kha: Ktien ki long ki proberb u Solomon : U khulom uba stad u pynsngew sarong ïa la u jongngi u kpa ; uba beiñ u wallam ka jingsngewsih ïa la ka kmie .
translation.en: The proverbs of Solomon . A wise son maketh a glad father : but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother .

translation.kha: Ha ka rang aiu ka para ka jong phi ka pule ?
translation.en: In which class is your sister studying ?

translation.kha: Mynta pat , ïa kata ka jingshisha la pynmih ha kaba paw lymbung ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa ; bad da ka hukum jong U Blei bymkut , ïa ka la pyntip sha baroh ki jaitbynriew , khnang ba baroh ki da ban beit bad kohnguh .
translation.en: But now is made manifest , and by the scriptures of the prophets , according to the commandment of the everlasting God , made known to all nations for the obedience of faith :
Will he delight himself in the Almighty ? will he always call upon God ?
translation.kha: Kin jin da la dei ban kwah ïa ka jingkmen ba u ai ; kin jin da la dei ban duwai borabor ïa u .
U la leit pat shapoh ïing , bad u Elisha u kylli ïa u , Shano me leit ? ngim shym leit hangto saihon , kynrad , u jubab .
translation.en: But he went in , and stood before his master . And Elisha said unto him , Whence comest thou , Gehazi ? And he said , Thy servant went no whither .

translation.kha: Ka nongbeh kam donkam ïa ka sngi rue ïa u bnai ban tyngshaiñ hiar jong ka , namar ba ka burom jong U Terah ka tyngam ba-halor jong ka , bad U Khunlangbrot u Long ka shrah jong ka .
translation.en: And the city had no need of the sun , neither of the moon , to shine in it : for the glory of God did lighten it , and the Lamb is the light thereof .
And they said unto him , Sit down now , and read it in our ears . So Baruch read it in their ears .
translation.kha: To shong ,  ki la ong ,  bad to pule na ka kot kli ha ngi .  Te u Barukh u la leh kumta .
Hangta ki la ïahap ïa ka khubor ha pyrsa pynlang nangta ki la leit sha Attalia ,
translation.en: And when they had preached the word in Perga , they went down into Attalia :
It is better to dwell in the wilderness , than with a contentious and an angry woman .
translation.kha: Ka kham bha bashong ha ka ri shyiap ban ïa kaba bad ka tnga kaba bunktien bad ïai thnum .
U la bat ïa ka jingkulmar kaba u la pynlong ha ki kpa tmier jong i'u , bad u la ïan ban ïarap ïa u shakri jong u , u Jeraïah .
translation.en: He hath holpen his servant Israel , in remembrance of his mercy  ;

translation.kha: Ka lama kaba dei eh ba U Blei , umbiah thaw bad pynni ïa kiei kaei baher , un pynlong ïa U Jisu uba janai lyntang ka jingshah khim , khnang baneh pynwan ïa kiba bun ki khun ban ïoh pynbha ha ka burom jong u . Namar U Jisu u long uta uba ïalam ïa ki shai ka jingpynim .
translation.en: For it became him , for whom are all things , and by whom are all things , in bringing many sons unto glory , to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings .

translation.kha: Nangta u Isaïah u ong ha kiba synñiang ïa u syiem ban thoh ha u tohjaw da i symboh ba la shna na ki soh Dumbur , bad un ïitkhmih .
translation.en: And Isaiah said , Take a lump of figs . And they took and laid it on the boil , and he recovered .

translation.kha: U Trai um shym la don shuh ka jingsngewkhia na ka bynta jong ki ; u la pynsakma ïa ki da lade hi . Um shym pyn-i jingïakren ei ei ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam jong im’ .
translation.en: The anger of the  Lord  hath divided them  ; he will no more regard them : they respected not the persons of the priests , they favoured not the elders .
Whether any do enquire of Titus , he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you : or our brethren be enquired of , they are the messengers of the churches , and the glory of Christ .
translation.kha: Hato don ba kylli shaphang u Titos , u long u nongïatrei lang bad nga ban ïarap ïa phi ; bad shaphang kiwei pat ki parabangeit kiba ïaleit lang bad u , ki mihkhmat ïa ki balang bad ki wallam ka burom ïa U Khrist .
Uba phylla tam na ki jingthaw jong nga baroh ! thiang u Nongthaw jong u , umbiah lah ban jop ïa u .
translation.en: He is the chief of the ways of God : he that made him can make his sword to approach unto him .

translation.kha: Uno uno u briew , la u dei u Jeraïah ne u nongwei , uba smam ïa ka doh jong uno uno u parad uba shu ïap hi , ne uba shah pyndap ha ki mawdong , u dei ban saitlah ïa la ki jaiñkup , bad un sum , bad ap haduh janmiet shuwa ba yn ñiuhtmoh ïa u ba u long uba khuid .
translation.en: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself , or that which was torn with beasts , whether it be one of your own country , or a stranger , he shall both wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the even : then shall he be clean .

translation.kha: Hynrei kitab bieit ban bim ïa ka snam jong ki ; phiah dei ban tah ïa ka ha ka khyndew Rumah theh ïa ka um .
translation.en: Only ye shall not eat the blood  ; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water .
The  Lord  on high is mightier than the noise of many waters , yea , than the mighty waves of the sea .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u synshar hakhlieh eh ha bneng , kham khraw ban ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong ka duriaw-bah , kham donbor ban ïa ki jingat phyllung jong ka duriaw .
Bad u paidbah u la ïasoh lang ha kob tur pyrshah ïa u Paulos bad u Siloam . Ki rangbah synshar ki la tait ïa ki jaiñ-jin jong u Paul sad u Silas , bad ki la ai hukum ban sympat ïa ki .
translation.en: And the multitude rose up together against them : and the magistrates rent off their clothes , and commanded to beat them .

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynlong ka jutang bad u Jakob , ka jutang ka ba-bang neh junom .
translation.en: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law , and to Israel for an everlasting covenant ,
The hope of the righteous shall be gladness : but the expectation of the wicked shall perish .
translation.kha: Ki jingkyrmen jong ki briew kiba bha ki lam sha ka jingkmen , hynrei ka jingkhmih lynti ki riewbymman kam lam shano shano .
( Salm 104 :15 ; 1 Korinth 6 :10 ) Ki Aiñ jong U Blei ki pynmyntoi ïa ngi da kaba hikai ïa ngi ba-bang Phikol ïa ki jingleh pynlang ki jingpyrkhat jong im .
translation.en: ( Psalm 104 :15  ; 1 Corinthians 6 :10 ) Godly principles benefit us by teaching us to guard not just our actions but also our thoughts .

translation.kha: Ïa ka khlieh la wallam shapoh ha ka pliang bad la ai ha ka khynnah , kaba la rah ïa ka shai la ka kmie .
translation.en: And his head was brought in a charger , and given to the damsel : and she brought it to her mother .

translation.kha: bad haduh sawphew snem u la ïaishah bad ki ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Te U Tlai u la ong ha de , Ko Jeremaïah , me ïohi aïu ? Nga jubab , Ki soh Dumbur . Kiwei kiba beh ki da bha shisha , bad kiwei Ibbah sniew ki da sngewieit shisha , haduh ba ym long ba-ima shuh .
translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto me , What seest thou , Jeremiah ? And I said , Figs  ; the good figs , very good  ; and the evil , very evil , that cannot be eaten , they are so evil .

translation.kha: Nangta ki samla kynthei kin shad bad ktien kmen , bad ki shynrang , Kiba samla bad kiba tymmen , kin shadkmen . Ngan pyntngen ïa ki bad pynkylla ïa ka jingïamareh sha ka jingkmen , ïa ka jingsngewsih jong ki sha ka jingsngewbha .
translation.en: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance , both young men and old together : for I will turn their mourning into joy , and will comfort them , and make them rejoice from their sorrow .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Mynba u Jerusalem u dang khynnah , nga la Ieit ïa u , bad nga la khot noh ïa u na Ijipt kum u khun jong to .
translation.en: When Israel was a child , then I loved him , and called my son out of Egypt .

translation.kha: Pha long ba la dem ! Phi la buh nongrim ïa ka nongbah halor ka kam runar sad la tei ïa ka da ka kam pynïap briew .
translation.en: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood , and stablisheth a city by iniquity !

translation.kha: Iehnoh ïa kabu sniew bad ka daym na ka ïing jong me .
translation.en: If iniquity be in thine hand , put it far away , and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles .

translation.kha: To U Blei uba U Kpa jong ine bad U Jehu Khrist umbiah U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khathynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah kum u syiem ka Ishmael , u Ahas u khun jngai u Jotham u long u syiem ka Judah ha ka ita kob arphew snem , bad u synshar ha Jerusalem khathynriew snem .
translation.en: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Judah began to reign .

translation.kha: kane baroh ka la shimet por kumba seraph sanphew snem . Hadien kane u la ai ha ki ïa ki nongbishar haduh ka por jong u Samuel u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years , until Samuel the prophet .

translation.kha: U rangbah synshar ki Assyria u la Tip ba u patsha u la kitei sha Lakhish bad u tang ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Libnah ka nongbah ba-marjan ; kumta u leit shata ban ïasyllok nabar u .
translation.en: So Rabshakeh returned , and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah : for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish .

translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la riat ha ki jaiñsem ba sawbthuh bad basaw hain hadien , bad ba la thop da ki jingdeng ksiar , ki mawkordor , bad ki paila . Ha ka kti jong ka , ka la bat ïa ka khuri ksiar kaba dap da kiei kiei naba isaitmet bad ijakhlia , kiba mih na ka jingawria jong ka .
translation.en: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour , and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls , having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication :
With whom the  Lord  had made a covenant , and charged them , saying , Ye shall not fear other gods , nor bow yourselves to them , nor serve them , nor sacrifice to them :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynlong ka jutang bad ki bad u la hukum ïa ki :  Wat mane ïa kiwei ki blei ; wat dem khrup ha ki lane shakri ïa ki lane ai ki jingkñia ïa ki .

U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la poi sha ka jingïasaid kita kaba jur malu ki shaphang kane , kumta la ïakut ba u Paul bad u Barnabas bad katto katne ngut kiwei pat ha Antiokh ki dei ban leit sha Jerusalem bad ïakynduh ïa ki apostol bad ki nongsharai bujli shaphang kane ka kam .
translation.en: When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them , they determined that Paul and Barnabas , and certain other of them , should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question .

translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa ki , u ong , Kane ka dat ka jaka sher dara jong U blei ; kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka ka Mahanaim .
translation.en: And when Jacob saw them , he said , This is God s host : and he called the name of that place Mahanaim .

translation.kha: Me pynshitom ïa la ki brai , A Trai malu ha ka jinglyng-a ki duwai ha me .
translation.en: Lord  , in trouble have they visited thee , they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them .

translation.kha: Akaba ar na ki hukum bakthang tad ka dei kaei : ‘ Men ieit ïa la u patar kumba me ieit ïa lade .’ Ym don kawei pat ka hukum kaba kham kongsan ban ïa kine ar tyllep .
translation.en: And the second is like , namely this , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself . There is none other commandment greater than these .

translation.kha: U jop ruh ïa ki Moab kiba kylla longïng ki rieh jyllang u bad sieb khajna sha u .
translation.en: And he smote Moab  ; and the Moabites became David s servants , and brought gifts .

translation.kha: Ïaid shaphrang bad rah ïa u kpu jongnga phi kum ka jingainguh sha U Blei , bad to sngewbang shaphang ki jingainguh ba tam ba ph Wallam ! Kane ka long ka rukom ïa katei khie kaba phi ieit ban leh .
translation.en: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven , and proclaim and publish the free offerings : for this liketh you , O ye children of Israel , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ki ai ïa kata ka khlieh ha u syiem Dabid ha Hebron , bad ki ong ha u , Kane hangne ka dei ka khlieh u Ishbosheth , u khun jong u Sillah , u nongshun jong phi , uba la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa phi . Ha kane ka sngi U Trai u la shah ïa u Syiem Kynrad ban pynmutlop ïa u Saul bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translation.en: And they brought the head of Ish–bosheth unto David to Hebron , and said to the king , Behold the head of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul thine enemy , which sought thy life  ; and the  Lord  hath avenged my lord the king this day of Saul , and of his seed .

translation.kha: Hato me la peit-thuh ïa u Job u shakri jong nga ? U Trai u kylli . Ym don uno une ha ka pyiar uba ïaineh bad uba bha kat ma u . U manna ïa ang bad u kiar ban ym leh ïa kano kano katba sniew . Me kynshuit ïa nga ban Shah ïa me ban tur pyrshah ïa u khlem don nangno kano ka daw , hynrei u Job u ïailong hi naba ïaineh kumba u ju long .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ? and still he holdeth fast his integrity , although thou movedst me against him , to destroy him without cause .

translation.kha: Eliada u rieh pynrem ïa u Briew uba lui lui , un long suba la tim bad Isih da baroh .
translation.en: He that saith unto the wicked , Thou art righteous  ; him shall the people curse , nations shall abhor him :

translation.kha: Ki pynïeng ruh halor jong u ïa ka kynton maw kaba heh , kaba dang don haduh mynta . Dem namar “kata ba ïa sier jaka la dang ïai khot ka Them Jingjynjar . Da kumta U Terah um shym da bitar shla shuh .
translation.en: And they raised over him a great heap of stones unto this day . So the  Lord  turned from the fierceness of his anger . Wherefore the name of that place was called , The valley of Achor , unto this day .
For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now .
translation.kha: Naba ngi tip ba haduh ka por ba mynta , ki jingthaw baroh ki ud da ka jingpang , kum ka jingpang jong ka jingsuh kha .

translation.en: Rather , he told his disciples to memorialize , or remember , his death .
translation.kha: Hynrei , u ong ïa la ki synran ban iai-kynmaw , lane ban kynmaw ïa ka jingïap jong u .

Kut kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang ka Hima hynrei ki bymshemphang ïa ka , ki longkmie koum ki symbai kiba la hap ha shi lynter ka lynter ïaid kjat . utai u Basniew u wan bad u knieh khong ïa kaei kaba la bet hapoh jong ki .
translation.en: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom , and understandeth it not , then cometh the wicked one , and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart . This is he which received seed by the way side .
On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly : ye shall do no servile work therein :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba phra , ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad wat trei kano kano ka kam .

te ma Phin barben phi dei ban pyntip , sad baroh’ ki pangnud Israel ki Dei ban tip , ba une u Briew u ïeng hangtei ha khmat jong phi uba la khiah kran da ka bor jong ka kyrteng U Jisu! Khrist uba na Nasareth — ïa uba phi la sahnarphna bad ïa uba U Blei u la pynmihpat na ka jingïalap .
translation.en: Be it known unto you all , and to all the people of Israel , that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth , whom ye crucified , whom God raised from the dead , even by him doth this man stand here before you whole .
Thy hands have made me and fashioned me : give me understanding , that I may learn thy commandments .
translation.kha: Me la thaw ïa nga , bad me sumar ïa nga ; to ai ha nga ka jingshemphang , khnang ba ngan lah ban nang ïa ki aiñ jong me .

translation.en: Even after a certain rate every day , offering according to the commandment of Moses , on the sabbaths , and on the new moons , and on the solemn feasts , three times in the year , even in the feast of unleavened bread , and in the feast of weeks , and in the feast of tabernacles .
translation.kha: u la kñia ki jingainguh thang kat kum ka jingdawa jong ka Hukum u Moses na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka sngi kaba khuid : ki Sabbaton , ki Jingkhawai Niam Bnai Thymmai , bad ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam kiba man ka snem — ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ka Jingkhawai Niam ka Jingot , bad ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .

translation.en: If any man speak in an unknown tongue , let it be by two , or at the most by three , and that by course ; and let one interpret .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u mut ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher , la kumno kumno ar ne lai ngut ki dei ban kren , uwei hadien uwei pat , bad uwei pat u dei ban batai ïa kaei kaba la kren .

translation.en: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus :
translation.kha: Bad to U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingïaishah bad ka jingpynshlur , un pynlah ïa phi ban don kajuh ka jingmut hapdeng jong phi da kaba bud ïa ka nuksa U Khrist Jisu ,
uba hapoh jong u ha ka jingïalam ïa ki swai u dei u Jehosabad suba long ba-halor ki shi lakh phraphew hajar ngut ki rangbah , kiba la kpieng Ataroth bha na ka bniat ka tmoh .
translation.en: And next him was Jehozabad , and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war .
So Joshua took all that land , the hills , and all the south country , and all the land of Goshen , and the valley , and the plain , and the mountain of Israel , and the valley of the same  ;
translation.kha: U Joshua u la kurup ïa ka ri baroh — ka ri lum bad ki kjat lum , ïa kaba shatei bad shathie , ka jaka jong ka Goshen baroh , bad ki ri ryngkhiang ha ka phang shathie jong ka , kumjuh ruh ïa ka Them Jordan .

translation.en: Woe is me for my hurt ! my wound is grievous : but I said , Truly this is a grief , and I must bear it .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka Jerusalem ki kyang jam ,  Haduh katno la pynmong jur ïa ngi ! Ki jingmong jong ngi kin ym koit . Bad ngi la pyrkhat ba kane ka dei kaei kaei kaba ngi lah ban shah !
umbah lah ban ïohsngew aïu U Blei u kren , Da ki khmat naba shut nga ïor ha ka jingïohi rngai Ka jingïohipaw na U Blei Badonbor .
translation.en: He hath said , which heard the words of God , which saw the vision of the Almighty , falling into a trance , but having his eyes open :

translation.kha: Te mynta ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki ba ki long bymmyntoi ei ei kum Kata hi . Neng wallam lang ïa ki baroh’ ha Jerusalem
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye are all become dross , behold , therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U Trai un pynsakma ïa pha kum ïa u phlangïap Uba la beh noh da ka lyer ri shyiap .
translation.en: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness .

translation.kha: jynreiñ ki paid Jeriel ki ong ha U Trai , Ngin la ni pop . Leh ïa ngi kat me mo ; hynrei sngewlah , pyllait im ïa ngi ha kano ka snoh .
translation.en: And the children of Israel said unto the  Lord  , We have sinned : do thou unto us whatsoever seemeth good unto thee  ; deliver us only , we pray thee , this day .
The first shall say to Zion , Behold , behold them : and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings .
translation.kha: Nga , U  Trai  , nga long uba nyngkong ban ïathuh ïa ka Seïon ïa ka khubor ; nga phah ïa u nonglamktien sha Jerusalem ban ong , ‘ Ki briew jong phi ki wan ! Ki wan sha ïing !’

Kumta phah ïa ki rangbah jong me sha Lebanon ban pynngat ïa ki dieng Kedar na ka bynta jong nga . Ki rangbah jong sa kin ïatreilang bad ki , bad sam siew ïa ki radbah jong me kat kaba me pynpait . Kumba me tip bha , ki Rangbah jong ang kim tip kumno ban pynngat ïa ki dieng kumba ki Jong me ki tap .
translation.en: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon  ; and my servants shall be with thy servants : and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint : for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pop ki ïaid ka lynter kyllaiñ ; hynrei kiba jaijai lui ki ïaid ha kaba beit .
translation.en: The way of man is froward and strange : but as for the pure , his work is right .

translation.kha: Ka rnga jong u ka dadien ka Ahinoam , ka khun Jong u Ahisamakh ; u rangbah ai hukum ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u , u daiñ u Abner , u bakha jong u , u khun jong u Ner u kñi jongnga u .
translation.en: And the name of Saul s wife was Ahinoam , the daughter of Ahimaaz : and the name of the captain of his host was Abner , the son of Ner , Saul s uncle .

translation.kha: U Trai u long U Blei ; u la long uba ibha ïa ngi . Lem bad ki tnaw dieng ha ki ktien jong phi , to sdang ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam badno ïaid sawdong ïa ka duwan .
translation.en: God is the  Lord  , which hath shewed us light : bind the sacrifice with cords , even unto the horns of the altar .
And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight  ; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims , that spread out their wings , and covered the ark of the covenant of the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad katno ka ksiar nylla ha kaba shna ïa ka duwan ha kaba yn thang jingiwbih , bad ha kaba shna ïa ka kali ïapom na ka bynta ki Kherub kiba pyiar la ki thapniang halor Ka Synduk Ka Jutang U  Trai .
Don shibit kiei kiei ba ngi hap ban ong shaphang kane ka bynta , hynrei ka long kaba eh Ban batai ïa phi , namar pa long Ibbah suki katta katta ïa ka ban sngewthuh .
translation.en: Of whom we have many things to say , and hard to be uttered , seeing ye are dull of hearing .
Speak not in the ears of a fool : for he will despise the wisdom of thy words .
translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban kren tipbriew ha uba bieit ; um lah ban ïaroh ïa ka .
Ki la sngewkynjah , da kaba pyrkhat ba ki ïohi ïa ka rngai .
translation.en: But they were terrified and affrighted , and supposed that they had seen a spirit .

translation.kha: Ka jubab kaba jem ka tem ïa ka jingaibor , hynrei kaba khor ka pynkhynñiuh bitar .
translation.en: A soft answer turneth away wrath : but grievous words stir up anger .

translation.kha: To long ka jakarieh Kaba skhem Jong nga , ka kut bakhlaiñ ban ïada ïa nga ; me long ka jakarieh bad ka jingsuhsieng jngai nga .
translation.en: Be thou my strong habitation , whereunto I may continually resort : thou hast given commandment to save me  ; for thou art my rock and my fortress .
And from thence to Philippi , which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia , and a colony : and we were in that city abiding certain days .
translation.kha: Nangta ngi la leit na ryngkew sha Philippi , ka nongbah jong ka distrik banyngkong jong ka Makedonia ; kaba long ruh ka kyntoit shnong jong ki nong Rom . Ngi la pynlut bun sngi hangta .
Baana ngim ïaheh pyrshah ïa ki briew hynrei ïa-pyrshah ïa ki bor bymneh ba kynja mynsiem ha ka pyrthei ba kynja bneng , ki nongsynshar , ki bol synshar , bad ki bor pyrthei jong kane ka juk ba-dum .
translation.en: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood , but against principalities , against powers , against the rulers of the darkness of this world , against spiritual wickedness in high places .

For by him were all things created , that are in heaven , and that are in earth , visible and invisible , whether they be thrones , or dominions , or principalities , or powers : all things were created by him , and for him :
translation.kha: Namar da u , U Blei u la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh ha bneng bad ha khyndew , kiei kiei kiba lah ban ïohi bad kiei kiei ki bym lah ban ïohi , kynthup ïa ki bor ba kynja mynsiem , ki kynrad , ki nongsynshar , bad ki bor synshar . U Blei u la thaw ïa ka jingpynlong baroh kawei da u na ka bynta jong u .
U Blei bakhraw jong ki Isaia um ju lamler lane kyllaiñ la ka jingman . Um dei u Briew — um ju kylla la ka jingmut .
translation.en: And also the Strength of Israel will not lie nor repent : for he is not a man , that he should repent .
I saw by night , and behold a man riding upon a red horse , and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom  ; and behind him were there red horses , speckled , and white .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa uwei u angel jong U  Trai  uba shong halor u kulai basaw . U la sangeh hapdeng katto katne tylli ki dieng Martl ha ka them , bad hadien jong u la don sa kiwei pat ki kulai — kiba saw , kiba thohbroin , bad kiba lieh .

translation.en: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity , or for any sin , in any sin that he sinneth : at the mouth of two witnesses , or at the mouth of three witnesses , shall the matter be established .
translation.kha: Kam biang tang uwei u sakhi ban rai pynrem ïa u briew na ka bynta kano kano ka kam palat ; la kumno kumno , ar ngut ki sakhi ki dei ban pynsabut ba u briew u leh kam sniew .

translation.en: What man is like Job , who drinketh up scorning like water ?
translation.kha: Hato phi la ïohi ïa uno uno u briew kum u Job ? Um ju pyn-i jingburom ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab : and he said unto the king of Moab , Let my father and my mother , I pray thee , come forth , and be with you , till I know what God will do for me .
translation.kha: U Dabid u leit noh na kata ka jaka sha Mispah ha Moab bad u ong ha u syiem Moab ,  Sngewbha shah ïa i pa bad i mei jong nga ban wan bad sah bad phi haduh ba ngan da tip aïu U Blei un leh na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: Light is sown for the righteous , and gladness for the upright in heart .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ka tyngshaiñ ha kiba hok , bad ka jingkmen ha kiba bha .
Kin ym shahtehmraw lane sliang shuh . Ka jingshit jyllang ka sneng pynlang ka ri shyiap kin ym pynjynjar ïa ki , namar yn ïalam ïa ki da uta uba ieit ïa ki . Un ïalam ïa ki sha ki umpohliew .
translation.en: They shall not hunger nor thirst  ; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them : for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them , even by the springs of water shall he guide them .

translation.kha: To ïalam ïa ki nongap phira , u Pilat u la ong ïa ki , Khie leit bad to pynskhem ïa ka jingtep kat kaba phi lah .
translation.en: Pilate said unto them , Ye have a watch : go your way , make it as sure as ye can .

translation.kha: kiew pah ki la ong , U dei U Messaïah ! Hynrei kiwei ki la ong , U Messaïah un ym wan na Galilaïa ?
translation.en: Others said , This is the Christ . But some said , Shall Christ come out of Galilee ?

translation.kha: Ka erïong , ka pynlong ïa ka dohkha jong nga ban kyndeh sting .
translation.en: At this also my heart trembleth , and is moved out of his place .

translation.kha: Hadien khathynñiew por , u Aram u la tip ba ka Milkah ka la khia phra ngut ki khun ïa u Nahor u Para jong u :
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that it was told Abraham , saying , Behold , Milcah , she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor  ;
Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men , as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit ;
translation.kha: Ha ki por ba-mynshuwa ïa u khunbynriew ym shym la ïathuh ïa kane ka jingmaïan , hynrei , U Blei u la pynpaw ïa ka mynta da U Mynsiem ha ki apostol bad ki nongïathuhlypa bakhuid jong u .
U Elisheba u pan khyndiat u purew , u para ïa u ha uta u khieshoh , bad u ong , To theh kham bun ka syrwa na ka bynta jong ki . Bad kam Shimham kein kano kano kaba sniew ha ka .
translation.en: But he said , Then bring meal . And he cast it into the pot  ; and he said , Pour out for the people , that they may eat . And there was no harm in the pot .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada , kumba im pyrshang ban pynksan ha U Blei da ka jingpynïasuk jong Ngi bad U Khrist , yn shadem ïa ngi ba i long ki nongpop kumba long hi ki Jentil — hato kane ka mut ba U Khrist u pynlong ka daw ïa ka pop ? Da lei lei ruh em !
translation.en: But if , while we seek to be justified by Christ , we ourselves also are found sinners , is therefore Christ the minister of sin ? God forbid .

translation.kha: U Stad saiñpyrkhat u la pyrshah ban shem ïa ki kyntu pynïapthngan , hynrei ki ktah kiba u thoh ki long uba lah Ban shaniah .
translation.en: The preacher sought to find out acceptable words : and that which was written was upright , even words of truth .

translation.kha: Hobah ki kylli ïa me shane ki dei ban leit , ïathuh ïa ki ba nga la lah ong : Ïa ki katto katne ngut la tei ban ïap da ka jingpang — kata ka den sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa kiwei patiaw la tim shun ïap ha ka tdam — kata ka dei sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa ki katto katne nguid la tim banbeiñ ïap na ka jingïapthngan — Katai ka dei sha kaba kin leit ! Ïa khawai pat la tei ban shahskhor ring noh kum ki kaei — sier ka dei sha kaba kin leit !
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if they say unto thee , Whither shall we go forth ? then thou shalt tell them , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Such as are for death , to death  ; and such as are for the sword , to the sword  ; and such as are for the famine , to the famine  ; and such as are for the captivity , to the captivity .

translation.kha: U Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah u la phah ïa u Asshur , u khun jong u Malkhaïah , bad ïa u Sephanaïah u lyngdoh , u khun jongno u Maaseïah , sha nga lem bad kane ka jingpynkut :
translation.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Malchijah , and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest , saying ,
And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold : three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield . And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon .
translation.kha: bad laispah tylli ki stieh kiba kham rit , ïa kawei pa kawei la sop da ka ksiar ba la shoh kaba khia kumba lai kilo . U phah buh ïa ki baroh ha ka Kamra Heh jong ka Khlaw Lebanon   .
Ki paidbah ki la sngewbha ïa kata ka jingai jingmut bad ki la ïamynjur .
translation.en: And all the congregation said that they would do so : for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people .

Be it known unto the king , that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem , building the rebellious and the bad city , and have set up the walls thereof , and joined the foundations .
translation.kha: Ngi kwah ba u syiem un tip ba ki Jiw kiba la wan hangne na kiwei ki ri , ki la shong la sah ha Jerusalem bad ki dang tei pat ïa kato ka nongbah kaba sniew bad kaba ïaleh pyrshah . Ki la sdang ban tei pat ïa ki kynroh bad shen kin sa pyndep ïa ki .

translation.en: And they , whether they will hear , or whether they will forbear , ( for they are a rebellious house , ) yet shall know that there hath been a prophet among them .
translation.kha: La kito kiba ïaleh pyrshah kin shahshkor ïa me ne kim shahshkor , kin tip ba don u nongïathuhlypa hapdeng jong ki .

U patsha ka Assyria u wallam ïa ki briew na ki nongbah bamaïan , Kuth , Ibbah , Hamath , bad Sepharbaim , bad pynshongduh ïa ki ha ki nongbah ka Semar , ha ka jaka jong ki Isaia ba la shah ringmraw . Ki shimti ha lade ïa kine ki nongpang bad ki sah hangta .
translation.en: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon , and from Cuthah , and from Ava , and from Hamath , and from Sepharvaim , and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel : and they possessed Samaria , and dwelt in the cities thereof .

translation.kha: Katba ki Amor ki ïan phet arsut na ka khim lum na ki shaei Israel , U Trai’ u pynhap halor jong ki ïa u phria uba heh barabor shi lynter lynti haduh Asekah . Kham bun ki la ïap na u phria ban na kaba ki shah pynïap ha ki Israel .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as they fled from before Israel , and were in the going down to Beth–horon , that the  Lord  cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah , and they died : they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword .

translation.kha: U ijuh u la ong ha ka , Ko khun jong nga , ka jingtah jong phad ka la pynkhiah ïa pha . Khie leit ha kaba suk .
translation.en: And he said unto her ,  Daughter , be of good comfort : thy faith hath made thee whole  ; go in peace .
And the second is like unto it , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .
translation.kha: Kaba ar ka hukum kaba donkam tam ka long kum katei : ‘ Ieit ïa u paramarjan jong me kumba me ieit ïa lade .’
Ngi bud ïa ka nuksa jong u Jisu .
translation.en: We are imitating Jesus .

translation.kha: Ki la pynkthang ïa u haduh katta long haduh ba u la kren-ïa khlem da ap ban kyrkhoit .
translation.en: Because they provoked his spirit , so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips .
Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany , where Lazarus was which had been dead , whom he raised from the dead .
translation.kha: Hynriew sngi shuwa ka Niam Ka Jinglait , U Jisu u la leit sha Bethania , ka shnong u Lasaros , u briew ïa uba U Jisu u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .

translation.en: And it came to pass after two full years , that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baal–hazor , which is beside Ephraim : and Absalom invited all the king s sons .
translation.kha: Hadien ar snem , u Absalom u la ai pynkhap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot ha Baal Hasor , hajan ka shnong Ephraim , bad u la khot sngewbha ïa baroh ki khun shynrang jong u syiem ban ïadon hangta .

Ha kawei ka sngi U ijuh u dang duwai ha kawei ka Jaka . Haba u la dep , imat na ki synreit jong u , u la ong ha u , Ko Trai , to hikai ïa i'u ban duwai , kumba u Ïoannis u la hikai ïa ki synran jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as he was praying in a certain place , when he ceased , one of his disciples said unto him , Lord , teach us to pray , as John also taught his disciples .
I charge you , O ye daughters of Jerusalem , by the roes , and by the hinds of the field , that ye stir not up , nor awake my love , till he please .
translation.kha: To ïathuh ïa nga , ko ba-ieit jong nga , shano phin ïalam pynbamphlang ïa ka kynhun langbrot jong phi ? Hangno kin pynjahthait na ka jingshit ka shiteng sngi ? Balei nga donkam ban wad ïa phi hapdeng ki kynhun langbrot jong kiwei pat ki nongap langbrot ?
To sumar bha , te , ba kai kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ong kan ym jia ha phi! :
translation.en: Beware therefore , lest that come upon you , which is spoken of in the prophets  ;
And Saul said unto Samuel , I have sinned : for I have transgressed the commandment of the  Lord  , and thy words : because I feared the people , and obeyed their voice .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , nga la leh pop ,  u Saul u jubab .  Ngam shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad ïa ki jingsneng pyn-i jong phi . Nga la sheptieng ïa ki rangbah jong nga bad nga la leh ïa kaei kaba ki kwah .

translation.en: And the lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds , and by thousands : but David and his men passed on in the rearward with Achish .
translation.kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki ïaid sha khmat ryngkat bad la ki kynhun kiba shispah ngut bad kiba shihajar ngut , u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki ïaid nadien bad u syiem Akhish .
hynne ïa ki kajuh phan naba don sawdong ki shnong jong kito kiba na ka jai Lebi , ym dei ban die ïa ki , namar ki long ka hok kynti jong ki shi junom .
translation.en: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold  ; for it is their perpetual possession .

translation.kha: Haba ki kherub ki khih , ki eh ban lytar sha kano kano ka Hul khlem da hap phai . Baroh len ki sien sha ka dong kob ki ïaheh leit , khlem da hap phai sawdong .
translation.en: When they went , they went upon their four sides  ; they turned not as they went , but to the place whither the head looked they followed it  ; they turned not as they went .

translation.kha: Ka jingsiew ba ki briew ki la leh , ka khanglad ïa ki Ban woh phai sha U Blei jong ki . Ka jingmane thliew ka don ka jingbat bakhlaiñbor ïa ki bad kim pdiang ïa U Tharai .
translation.en: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God : for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them , and they have not known the  Lord .
Then the king commanded Ebed–melech the Ethiopian , saying , Take from hence thirty men with thee , and take up Jeremiah the prophet out of the dungeon , before he die .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u la hukum ïa u Ebedmelekh ban shim bad u lai ngut ki rangbah bad ban tan noh ïa nga na ka pung shuwa ba ngan ïap .
Ha khmih ! u la ong . Nga ïohi ïa ka bneng ba la plie bad ïa U ka U Beeri ba u ïeng ha ka liang kamon jong U Blang !
translation.en: And said , Behold , I see the heavens opened , and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God .

translation.kha: Uno uno ïa uba la kha nyngkong , la u dei u Briew ne u jingri , ba ki Israel ki wanrah shat nga u longkmie u jong me . Hynrei me den ban pdiang ïa ka jingsniew ban thab pat ïa imat pa uwei u khuid ba la khia nyngkong , bad uwei pa uwei u jingriew ba la khaïi nyngkong , ïa suba la ñiat ba u long u jingbymkhuid .
translation.en: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh , which they bring unto the  Lord  , whether it be of men or beasts , shall be thine : nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem , and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem .

translation.kha: Ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa Utai u langbrot , sait ïa ki snier bad ki kjat-dien jong u , nangta sa buh lang ïa ki halor kita ki lynghoh doh sad ka khlieh jong u .
translation.en: And thou shalt cut the ram in pieces , and wash the inwards of him , and his legs , and put them unto his pieces , and unto his head .
For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did  ; they departed not from them  ;
translation.kha: Ki bud ïa u Jeroboam bad ki ïai bteng ban leh ïa ki pop baroh ba u la leh ,
Neng la Ïohi ïa kane baher lehbha ang pyrkhat ïa kiei kiei kiba la leh ha kane ka pyrta , ka pyrthei ha kaba katto katne ki briew ki dat ka bor bad kiwei pat ki dei ban shisnem hapoh jong ki .
translation.en: All this have I seen , and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun : there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt .
Now he which stablisheth us with you in Christ , and hath anointed us , is God ;
translation.kha: U dei U Blei hi uba pynlong ïa ngi , ryngkat bad phi , ka jingpynthikna ïa ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist ; u dei U Blei hi da lade uba la pynkyrpang ïa ngi ,

translation.en: Then said Paul , John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance , saying unto the people , that they should believe on him which should come after him , that is , on Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: U Paul u la ong ,  Ka jingpynbaptis u Ïoannis ka long na ka bynta kito kiba la phai noh na ki pop jong ki ; bad u la ïathuh ha ki paid Israel ban ngeit ha uta u ban sa wan hadien jong u — kata , ha U Jisu .

Dedan uwei pat u baneh ong , Ka jingbam ka daym na ka bynta ka kpoh , bad ka kpoh na ka bynta ka jingbang . Ho-oid , hynñiew U Blei un sa pynduh ïa baroh ar . Ïa ka met ym dei ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ka ki awria , hynrei ïa ka ban Shakri ïa U Trai ; bad U Trai u bsa ïa ka met .
translation.en: Meats for the belly , and the belly for meats : but God shall destroy both it and them . Now the body is not for fornication , but for the Lord ; and the Lord for the body .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jingjubab , Naba la slem nga la to bad phi Baroh ; pynban mem ithuh ïa nga , ko Philip ? Uno uno uba la ïohi ïa nga u la ïohi ïa U Kpa . Balei , te , me ong , ‘ To pyn-i ha ngi ïa U Kpa ?’
translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Have I been so long time with you , and yet hast thou not known me , Philip ? he that hath seen me hath seen the Father  ; and how sayest thou then , Shew us the Father ?

translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ngi la iehnoh ïa ka jingïap bad ngi la wan noh sha ka jingim ; ngi thup ïa ka namar ba I ieit ïa la ki hynmen ki para . Uno a u bym ngeit , u dang don hi hapoh ka bor jong ka jingïap .
translation.en: We know that we have passed from death unto life , because we love the brethren . He that loveth not his brother abideth in death .
Breach for breach , eye for eye , tooth for tooth : as he hath caused a blemish in a man , so shall it be done to him again .
translation.kha: Lada u pynkheiñ ïa ka shyieng , yn pynkheiñ kylliang ïa kawei na ki shyieng jong u ; lada u pynmatlah ïa u na kawei ka khmat , yn pynmatlah kylliang ïa kawei na ki khmat jong u ; lada u lop ïa kawei ka bniat , yn lop kylliang ïa kawei na ki bniat jong u . Kumba u la pynmynsaw ïa uno uno u briew , kumta ruh yn pynmynsaw kylliang ïa u .

translation.en: And saying , If thou be the king of the Jews , save thyself .
translation.kha: To pynim ïa lade lada me long u syiem ki Jiw !
Te kumba U Trai u la ong , u Hanamel u la waiñ sha to hangta ha ka phyllaw bad u la nong ïa nga ba len thab ïa ka lyngba . Kuth per sngewthuh ba U Trai u la kren shisha ha nga .
translation.en: So Hanameel mine uncle s son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the  Lord  , and said unto me , Buy my field , I pray thee , that is in Anathoth , which is in the country of Benjamin : for the right of inheritance is thine , and the redemption is thine  ; buy it for thyself . Then I knew that this was the word of the  Lord .
And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab . And there was a sore famine in Samaria .
translation.kha: Kumta u Elijah u la leit . Ka  nemsniew ha Samaria ka la don ha ka por kaba jur bha ,
Hynrei u dieng Dorbar u ong , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa phi , ngan hap Ban sheng ba-bang pynmih ki soi thiang babha .’
translation.en: But the fig tree said unto them , Should I forsake my sweetness , and my good fruit , and go to be promoted over the trees ?
And the  Lord  God prepared a gourd , and made it to come up over Jonah , that it might be a shadow over his head , to deliver him from his grief . So Jonah was exceeding glad of the gourd .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  U Blei u la pynlong ïa u jingthung ban san kham jrong ïa u Jonah khnang ban ai ïa u katto katne ka jingkah syrngiew , khnang ba un kham tngen . U Jonah u la sngewkmen shibun ïa u jingthung .

translation.en: And the land shall tremble and sorrow : for every purpose of the  Lord  shall be performed against Babylon , to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant .
translation.kha: Ka khyndew ka kyiuh bad ka khynñiuh namar ba U  Trai  u pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong u ban pynlong ïa ka Babilonia ka ri shyiap , ha kaba yn ym don mano mano ban shong ban sah .
U jong ha u Abraham , Kane baroh ka dien ka ri jong nga ; to shong to sai kat ha ka me kiaw .
translation.en: And Abimelech said , Behold , my land is before thee : dwell where it pleaseth thee .
Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering , and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house , without the sanctuary .
translation.kha: Me dei ban shim ïa u masi lyngraw ïa uba la ai kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop bad thang ïa u ha ka jaka ba la pynkhreh khnang shabar ka Templ .
Haba phira ai kylliang ei ei ïa uno uno u briew , ki leit rung sha ïing jong u ban shim ïa ka jaiñkup ban buh bynda ha phi ;
translation.en: When thou dost lend thy brother any thing , thou shalt not go into his house to fetch his pledge .

translation.kha: Ha ki shnong jyllang ka ri lum , ha ki kjat lym , bad ha ka Judah bashaphang shathie , ha ka ri ki Benjamin , ha ki shnong sawdong ka Jerusalem bad ha ki shnong ka Judah , ki nongaplangbrot sa shisien kin ñiew biang ïa la ki langbrot . Ma nga , U TRAI’ , de la kruiñ .
translation.en: In the cities of the mountains , in the cities of the vale , and in the cities of the south , and in the land of Benjamin , and in the places about Jerusalem , and in the cities of Judah , shall the flocks pass again under the hands of him that telleth them , saith the  Lord .
After this there was a feast of the Jews  ; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu u la leit sha Jerusalem na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam .

Katba u dang leh kumta , kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im bad ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang ki la dem khep ha khmat U Khunlangbrot . uwei pa uwei u la don ka duitara bad ki pliang ksiar ba la pyndap da ka jingiwbih , kiba erlangthari ki jingduwai jong ki bariew jong U Blei .
translation.en: And when he had taken the book , the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb , having every one of them harps , and golden vials full of odours , which are the prayers of saints .

translation.kha: Ka jingshyrkhei kaba ar ka la kut , hynrei ka jingshyrkhei kaba lai kan sa wan shen !
translation.en: The second woe is past  ; and , behold , the third woe cometh quickly .

translation.kha: Katba ka na ka na marjan long ïa U Jisu yn shim noh sha bneng , u la pynbeit ïa ka jingmut malade u la lytar ha la ka lynti sha Jerusha .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the time was come that he should be received up , he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem ,

translation.kha: Kaba kum sier kaba da sang eh ka dei ban shah pynshitom da ka jingïap .
translation.en: For this is an heinous crime  ; yea , it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges .

translation.kha: Hobah U Jehu u la dep hikai ïa kine kiei kiei baroh , u la ong ha la ki synran .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had finished all these sayings , he said unto his disciples ,

translation.kha: U shakri u pynmih ïa ka shalor bad u khang ïa ka jingkyang . Ka Tamar ka kup ïa ka sopti jynsur kaba jrong kti , ka jait jaiñ ba ju phong da ki khunlung syiem kynthei ki bym pud shongkurim ha Aner ki sngi .
translation.en: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her : for with such robes were the king s daughters that were virgins apparelled . Then his servant brought her out , and bolted the door after her .

translation.kha: Kata ka long kaei ka ban jia ha phi , ki briew ka Beten , Naamah ka ngop bashyrkhei kaba pa la leh . Mar ïasdang ka thma , u syiem Israel un ïap .
translation.en: So shall Beth–el do unto you because of your great wickedness : in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off .

translation.kha: Ang longkmie U Trai , bad ngam ju kylla . Bad kumta ma phi , ki khulom ki ksiew u Jakob , phim pat shym la jah noh khuid .
translation.en: For I am the  Lord  , I change not  ; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed .

translation.kha: Ngan pynsangeh noh ïa ka jingwanrah bam ïa pha bad nur pynshahthngan ïa pha . Phah sa sngew ïa ka jingtynrah ka jingshngain kum ki khnap banep ba la siat baneh pynjot ïa pha .
translation.en: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine , which shall be for their destruction , and which I will send to destroy you : and I will increase the famine upon you , and will break your staff of bread :

translation.kha: U Trai un pynsakma ïa pa hapdeng kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew , bad hangta tong kyndiah eh na phi phin lait im .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall scatter you among the nations , and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen , whither the  Lord  shall lead you .

translation.kha: Haba ki syiem kiba hap haduh u Hadadeser ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , ki pynlong ka jingïasuk bad u Dabid bad ki kila long ki rit jong u . Ki syriem kim ju myn shuh ban ïaphah ïa ki Ammon .
translation.en: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they made peace with David , and became his servants : neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more .
Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord , and the cup of devils : ye cannot be partakers of the Lord s table , and of the table of devils .
translation.kha: Phim lah ban dih na ka khuri U Trai bad ruh na ka khuri ki ksuid ; phim lah ban ïabam na ka miej U Trai bad ruh na ka miej ki ksuid .

translation.en: Having damnation , because they have cast off their first faith .
translation.kha: Hynrei to wat kynthup ïa ki riewkynthei kiba dang kham samla ha ka thup ; namar haba ki jingkwah ka doh jong ki ban shongkurim , ki phai noh na U Khrist , bad kumta ki don ka jingpynrem ba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jingtehkular bad u kaba mynshuwa .
Hynrei sa shisien pat U Blei un phiah ha i'u ïa U Mynhyndai jong u . Ka jaka shrah kan sa kylla seisoh , bad ki lyngkha kin sa pynmih ki jingbam karai .
translation.en: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high , and the wilderness be a fruitful field , and the fruitful field be counted for a forest .
Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear , and the horse that the king rideth upon , and the crown royal which is set upon his head :
translation.kha: Kumta u jubab ïa u syiem ,  Ai hukum ban wanrah ïa ki jaiñphong syiem na ka bynta une u briew — ki jaiñphong kiba ma phi , phi phong . Hukum ïa ki jingdeng syiem ban pyndeng ha u kulai jong phi .
Ki lah ban hikai ïa phi kumno ban im kum kiba sngewstad bad kumno ban long uba khak , Uba lehhok , bad uba ïaid beit .
translation.en: To receive the instruction of wisdom , justice , and judgment , and equity  ;

translation.kha: Ma me , ko Esra , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingstad kaba U Blei jong me u la ai ha me , men thum ki nongsynshar bun ki nongbishar ki ban synshar ïa ki briew baroh jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi kiba im da ka Judia jong U blang jong me . Me dei ban hikai ïa kato ka Law ha uno uno u bymtip ïa ka .
translation.en: And thou , Ezra , after the wisdom of thy God , that is in thine hand , set magistrates and judges , which may judge all the people that are beyond the river , all such as know the laws of thy God  ; and teach ye them that know them not .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki synran jong u bad u la ai ha ki ka lytar pun beh neh ïa ki mynhyndai bymman malu banbeiñ pynkhiah ïa kaweh pa kawei ka jingong bad ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingshitom .
translation.en: And when he had called unto him his twelve disciples , he gave them power against unclean spirits , to cast them out , and to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease .
And the  Lord  was with Joseph , and he was a prosperous man  ; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la don ryngkat lem bad u Joseph bad u la pynmanbha ïa u .

U kpa jong ki u ong ha ki , Phi kwah ba ngan duh lut ïa la ki jngai ki khun ? U Joseph um don shuh , u Simeon hajuh um Don , badno mynba pat phi kwah ban shim noh sa ïa u Benjamin . Dei ma nga kñi uba shahskhor jynjar !
translation.en: And Jacob their father said unto them , Me have ye bereaved of my children : Joseph is not , and Simeon is not , and ye will take Benjamin away : all these things are against me .

translation.kha: Hynrei Ladan u mraw u pynbna ba u ieit ïa la u kyndiang , ïa la ka tnga , bad ïa la ki ïakhun , bad um kwah ba oh laitluid ,
translation.en: And if the servant shall plainly say , I love my master , my wife , and my children  ; I will not go out free :

translation.kha: Khot hajir ïa ki jaitbynriew don wan sha ka jingbishar . Kino na ki balieh jong ki ibha ia ba ïathuhlypa ïa ka lawei ? Kino na ki kiba la ïong lehbha kaei ka ban jia mynta ? Ai ba kine ki blei kin wanrah ïa ki sakhi jong ki ban pynsaja ba ki long kiba Dei , ban phla ïa ka jingjyrsieh jong ki ktien jngai ki .
translation.en: Let all the nations be gathered together , and let the people be assembled : who among them can declare this , and shew us former things ? let them bring forth their witnesses , that they may be justified : or let them hear , and say , It is truth .
Eat not of it raw , nor sodden at all with water , but roast with fire  ; his head with his legs , and with the purtenance thereof .
translation.kha: Ym dei ban bam im ne phon ïa ka , hynrei bam ïa ka da kaba shu syang tylli kynthup ïa ka khlieh , ki kjat bad ki doh jem .
Ki buh ïa ki atiar jong u ha Kawei na ki paila jong ki bad wah ïa ka khlaiñ jong u ha ka templ jongu u Dagon u blang jongno ki .
translation.en: And they put his armour in the house of their gods , and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Kumno lada uwei na phi u ni kaweh ka langbrot badno ka hap hapoh ka thliew bajylliew ha ka sngi Sabbaton ? Hato Phon ym bat ïa ka malu kyndiah ïa ka shabar ?
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What man shall there be among you , that shall have one sheep , and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day , will he not lay hold on it , and lift it out ?
Behold their sitting down , and their rising up  ; I am their musick .
translation.kha: Naduh mynstep haduh mynmiet ki rkhiebeiñ ïa nga .
U Jakob u la leit shaei u iaisah u kpa jong u ha Mamre , Hajan Khroh , ha kaba u Abraham bad u Isaak ki la ju shong ju sah” .
translation.en: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre , unto the city of Arbah , which is Hebron , where Abraham and Isaac sojourned .

translation.kha: Tahan u Joshua u pynïeng ïa ki khat-ar tylli ki maw ba la shim na ka Jordan .
translation.en: And those twelve stones , which they took out of Jordan , did Joshua pitch in Gilgal .

translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ba la ong , ‘ Ka khmut namar ka khmat , bad ka bniat namar ka bniat .’
translation.en: Ye have heard that it hath been said , An eye for an eye , and a tooth for a tooth :
Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year .
translation.kha: Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha ka por ba la buh man ka snem .
Haba ki lumbah ki la ïohi ïa me , ki kyiuh ; ka um ka hap na ki shait bneng . Ki um hapoh ka khyndew ki khohruh , bad ki jingot phyllung jong ki , ki kiew shalor .
translation.en: The mountains saw thee , and they trembled : the overflowing of the water passed by : the deep uttered his voice , and lifted up his hands on high .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka nga U Terah u la sdang ban pynrit ïa ka jingheh jong ka ri Jesreel . U Hasael u syiem ka Seruïah u la hiarthma ïa baroh ka ri Israel ka sha mihngi jongnga ka Jordan
translation.en: In those days the  Lord  began to cut Israel short : and Hazael smote them in all the coasts of Israel  ;
And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Judah , and set garrisons in the land of Judah , and in the cities of Ephraim , which Asa his father had taken .
translation.kha: U pynap shipai ha ki nongbah ba la tei kut ka Judah , ha ki rudnong Judah , bad ha ki nongbah kiba u Asa u la jop ha ka ri ki Ephraim .
Phi baroh kiba don hangne phi dei ki Israel . Kaei ngin sa ha kaba ïaid bad kane ?
translation.en: Behold , ye are all children of Israel  ; give here your advice and counsel .

translation.kha: Te u Daniel u la wan shapoh . ( La khot ruh ïa u , u Belteshassar , ha ka kyrteng u blei jong nga . ) U mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jyllang u , kumta nga la ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kambah por la pynsngewsih . Nga la ong ha u :
translation.en: But at the last Daniel came in before me , whose name was Belteshazzar , according to the name of my god , and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods : and before him I told the dream , saying ,
Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass , when they eat their holy things : for I the  Lord  do sanctify them .
translation.kha: da kaba shah ïa uno uno u briew u bym dei hok ban bam ïa ki ; kata kan pynhap ïa uta u briew ha ka pop , bad un shah pynshitom . Nga long U  Trai  uba pynkyntang ïa ki jingainguh .

Kiba riewspah bad kiba duk kin ïap ha kane ka ri , hynrei ym don mano mano ngab tep ïa ki lane ban ïambriew na ka bynta jong ki . Ym don me mano u ban ot ïa lade lane u ban khi ïa la ka khlaw ban pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewsih jong u .
translation.en: Both the great and the small shall die in this land : they shall not be buried , neither shall men lament for them , nor cut themselves , nor make themselves bald for them :
And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled , behold , there were twins in her womb .
translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi ïa ka ba kan kha , bad ka la ïoh ar ngut ki khun synrap shynrang .

translation.en: Now therefore go to , speak to the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Behold , I frame evil against you , and devise a device against you : return ye now every one from his evil way , and make your ways and your doings good .
translation.kha: Mynta te , to ïathuh ïa ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ba nga thaw ki jingthmu bathymmai pyrshah ïa ki bad nga khreh ban pynshitom ïa ki . Ïathuh ïa ki ban sangeh ban im ka jingim ba-dap da ka pop — ban pynkylla ïa ki rukom im jong ki bad ïa kiei kiei kiba ki leh .

translation.en: What shall we say then that Abraham our father , as pertaining to the flesh , hath found ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngin ïa-ong te , ba u Abraham u kpa , jong ka jaitbynriew jong ngi , Kaei ka jingshem jong u ?

U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la kren shaphang u Ahab u khun jongnga u Kolaïah bad u Sedekaïah u khum jong u Maaseïah , kiba ïathuh ki jinglamler ha ka kirteng jong U . U la ong ba un aiti ïa ki ha ka leh jong u Nebukhadnessar u syiem ka Babilonia , u ban pynïap ïa ki ha khmat jongno phiah .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , of Ahab the son of Kolaiah , and of Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah , which prophesy a lie unto you in my name  ; Behold , I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon  ; and he shall slay them before your eyes  ;

And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatsoever she asked , beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty . So she turned and went to her own country , she and her servants .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u ai ïa ka syiem jong ka ri Sheba ïa baroh kaba ka pan , nalor kiwei pat ki jingai sngewbha kat kum ka dustur ïa kiba u la lah ai ha ka na ka jingjynsur mynsiem . Nangta ma ka bad ki nongbud jong ka ki leit phai sha ka ri Sheba .

translation.en: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together , and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock : and dust shall be the serpent s meat . They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki suri bad ki khunlangbrot kin ïabam lang , ki sing kin bam phlang , kumba bam ki masi , bad ki bseiñ kin ym long shuh ka jingma . Ha Seïon , u lum bakyntang jong nga yn ym don shuh ka jingma ne kaba sniew .

translation.en: Behold , they are all vanity  ; their works are nothing : their molten images are wind and confusion .
translation.kha: Baroh kine ki blei ki long ki bymlarkam ; Kim lah ban leh ei ei ruh em — Kine ki bleithaw ki long kiba tlot bad ki bymdonbor .

translation.en: For the transgression of Jacob is all this , and for the sins of the house of Israel . What is the transgression of Jacob ? is it not Samaria ? and what are the high places of Judah ? are they not Jerusalem ?
translation.kha: Kane baroh kan jia namar ba ki paid Israel ki la leh pop bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Blei . Ïano yn kynnoh na ka bynta ka jingïaleh pyrshah ki Israel ? Ka Samaria hi , ka nongbah ! Mano ba shah kynnoh ïa ka jingmane bleithaw ha Judah ? Ka Jerusalem hi !

translation.en: Deliver me in thy righteousness , and cause me to escape : incline thine ear unto me , and save me .
translation.kha: Namar me long uba hok , to ïarap ïa nga bad to pyllait ïa nga . To shahshkor ïa nga , bad to pynim ïa nga !
U kulai nga dei uei , dara nga la ïathuh ïa u ba nga dei u Amalek .
translation.en: And he said unto me , Who art thou ? And I answered him , I am an Amalekite .

translation.kha: Haba u la dep kren , u la ong ha u Simon , To ñiut ïa ka lieng kham jngai sha ka um bajylliew , bad ma me slem bad ki paralok jong me to pynkhap ïa ki buid ban tong shongkha .
translation.en: Now when he had left speaking , he said unto Simon ,  Launch out into the deep , and let down your nets for a draught .
