translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi! ba ngon ki nongïathuhlypa bad bun ki briew ki jong U Blei ki la kaweh shikatdei eh ban Ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi ïohi , hyndai kim haw ïohi , dara ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba phi jingïohknieh , hynrei kim shym la lah ïohsngew .
translation.en: For verily I say unto you , That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see , and have not seen them  ; and to hear those things which ye hear , and have not heard them .

translation.kha: Kumne kita ki briew ki ïakem iar khiar baroh shi sngi ha kata ka sngi , baroh shi miet , bad baroh shi sngi ha kawei pang ka sngi ; ym don nawei hima uba lum duna ïa ka shihajar lko . Nangta ki thad ïa ki sawdong tala ka jaka shong tama .
translation.en: And the people stood up all that day , and all that night , and all the next day , and they gathered the quails : he that gathered least gathered ten homers : and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp .

translation.kha: Ki nongrep balang ki dien ki bhabriew kiba kumno ?
translation.en: What sort of men are the ministerial servants ?

translation.kha: Hynrei lada nga leh ïa ki , wat lada phim ngeit ïa nga , phi la dei ban ngeit ïa ki kam jongnga nga , khñiang ba pa’ lah ban tip shi synran tip ba U Kpa u long ha nga bad ba nga long ha U kper .
translation.en: But if I do , though ye believe not me , believe the works : that ye may know , and believe , that the Father is in me , and I in him .

translation.kha: Hangta nga la ïohi ïa U Khunlangbrot ba u pynpait noh ïa kawei na ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndait , bad sa la ïohsngew ïa uwei na ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ba u ong ha ka sur kaba sawa kum u pyrthat , To wan !
translation.en: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals , and I heard , as it were the noise of thunder , one of the four beasts saying , Come and see .

And the  Lord  said unto me , Distress not the Moabites , neither contend with them in battle : for I will not give thee of their land for a possession  ; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha nga , ‘ Wat pynjynjar ïa ki briew jong ka ri Moab , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lot , lane wat ïaleh thma bad ki . Nga la ai ha ki ïa ka shnong Ar , bad ngan ym ai ei ei ïa phi na ka ri jong ki .’
Ka pyrthei kam lah don shun ïa phi , hynrei ka shun ïa nga , namar ba nga ïai-ong ba ki lynti jong ka ki long naba sniew .
translation.en: The world cannot hate you  ; but me it hateth , because I testify of it , that the works thereof are evil .

translation.kha: Don tang uwei U Trai , kawei ka jingngeit , kawei ka jingpynbaptis ;
translation.en: One Lord , one faith , one baptism ,

translation.kha: Hynrei hangno lah ban shem ïa ka jingstad ? Hangno ngi lah ban ïoh jinghikai ban shemphang ?
translation.en: But where shall wisdom be found ? and where is the place of understanding ?

translation.kha: Nangta ki la pynïap uwei langsohmoh bad ki wieh ïa kata ka sopti jong u Jakob ha ka snam jongngi u .
translation.en: And they took Joseph s coat , and killed a kid of the goats , and dipped the coat in the blood  ;

translation.kha: U lyoh noh ïa la ki jaiñ bad u shad bad riat ha khmat u Samuel , bad u thiah lyngkhuit ha said ka sngi barben shi sngi bad ha kata ka miet baroh’ shi miet . ( Ha kane ka stang la mih ka jingong , Hato wat u Saul ruh u la kyllaiñ long u jingïathuhlypa ? )
translation.en: And he stripped off his clothes also , and prophesied before Samuel in like manner , and lay down naked all that day and all that night . Wherefore they say , Is Saul also among the prophets ?
Before I go whence I shall not return , even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death  ;
translation.kha: Ngan sa leit noh shen bad ngan ym wan phai shuh — ban leit sha ka ri kaba dum bad kaba bym don jingkyrmen ,

translation.en: All the saints salute you , chiefly they that are of Caesar s household .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew U Blei hangne ki phah ïa ki jingai khublei , khamtam kito kiba na ka ïingsyiem jong u Patsha .

U bnai un sa shai phyrnai kat ka sngi , bad ka sngi kan shai phyrnai hynñiew shah ban ïa kiba ju long , kum ka jingshai jong ki hynñiew sngi ha kawei ka sngi . Kane baroh kan jat haba U Tharai un sop spaiñ bad pynkhiah ïa ki jingmong uba u la ai ha ki briew jong u .
translation.en: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun , and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold , as the light of seven days , in the day that the  Lord  bindeth up the breach of his people , and healeth the stroke of their wound .
Then said they unto him , Who art thou ? that we may give an answer to them that sent us . What sayest thou of thyself ?
translation.kha: Te ïathuh ïa ngi me dei uei ,  ki la ong .  Ngi hap ban rah ïa ka jubab sha kito kiba la phah ïa ngi . Kumno me ong shaphang ïa lade ?

malade u la leit sha ka umpohliew , u la bret ïa ka muhor ha ka um , bad u ong , Kane ka dei kaba U Trai u ong : ‘ Nga pynkhuid ïa kane ka um , bad kun ym pynjia Shu kano kano ka jingïap lane ki jinghap khun .’
translation.en: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters , and cast the salt in there , and said , Thus saith the  Lord  , I have healed these waters  ; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land .

translation.kha: Hynrei em , ha ka jingshisha , phi la Iohi hi da lade ; te kamet balei ba phi kren ïa kum kata ka jingkren bieit ?
translation.en: Behold , all ye yourselves have seen it  ; why then are ye thus altogether vain ?

translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba san u la ieit ïa ka turoi . (Nga la ïohi ïa u khlur uba la hap shad ka khyndew , bad la ai ha u ïa u shabi jong ka liewlong ba khlem trai .
translation.en: And the fifth angel sounded , and I saw a star fall from heaven unto the earth : and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit .

translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba arphew san snem , bad u synshar arphew khyndai snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jehonathan , kaba na Jerusalem .
translation.en: He was twenty and five years old when he began to reign , and reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem .
Ye are witnesses , and God also , how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe :
translation.kha: Phi long ki sakhi jong ngi , bad kumta U Blei ruh , ba ka jingleh jong ngi ïa phi kiba ngeit ka long kaba sngur , kaba dei bad kaba khlem jingbakla .

translation.en: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated , and the things which himself had dedicated , into the house of the  Lord  , silver , and gold , and vessels .
translation.kha: U buh ha ka templ ïa ki tiar ki tar baroh ïa kiba u kpa jong u , u la pynkyntang sha U Blei , lem bad ïa ki mar ksiar bad mar rupa ïa kiba u hi u la pynkyntang .

translation.en: And I said , Lord , they know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue them that believed on thee :
translation.kha: ‘ Ko Kynrad ,’ nga la jubab , ‘ ki ïatip bha ba nga la leit sha ki synagog bad nga la kem bad shoh ïa kito kiba ngeit ha me .
Kiba dkoh kin rynsied nabar shaduh , bad iba ki bym lah ban kren kin pyrta da ka jingkmen . Ki wahduid kin tuid lyngba ka ri shylliah ;
translation.en: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart , and the tongue of the dumb sing : for in the wilderness shall waters break out , and streams in the desert .

And it came to pass , when Laban heard the tidings of Jacob his sister s son , that he ran to meet him , and embraced him , and kissed him , and brought him to his house . And he told Laban all these things .
translation.kha: Ka leit bran bran ban ïathuh ha la u kpa ; bad haba u la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor shaphang u pyrsa jong u , u Jakob , mar mar u leit ban ïashem ïa u ; u la kdup bad u doh ïa u , bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ïing .
U Blei u la thied ïa phi da ka pynlang ; kumta to wat lama ki mraw jong ki briew .
translation.en: Ye are bought with a price ; be not ye the servants of men .

translation.kha: Ïa per la set ha ka kamra kaba shapoh khynraw bad la set slem ïa nga hangta .
translation.en: When Jeremiah was entered into the dungeon , and into the cabins , and Jeremiah had remained there many days  ;

As Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded the children of Israel , as it is written in the book of the law of Moses , an altar of whole stones , over which no man hath lift up any iron : and they offered thereon burnt offerings unto the  Lord  , and sacrificed peace offerings .
translation.kha: U la tei ïa ka kat kum ki jingbthah ba u Moses , u shakri jong U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel , kumba la thoh ha ka Hukum u Moses :  Ka duwan ba la tei da ki maw ki bym shym la shtah da ki tiar nar .  Halor jong ka ki la thang ïa ki jingkñia ha U  Trai  , bad ki la ainguh ruh ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok .

translation.en: And if I also ask you , ye will not answer me , nor let me go .
translation.kha: bad lada nga kylli ïa phi ka jingkylli , phin ym jubab .

katba ong ïa ki ba ki dei ban peiñ pateng sha me . Ki la ñiew ïa me na ka por sha ka por , ba kumta me shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jlop malade synshar ïa ki . Ha ka jingeh jong ki , ki khot ïa me na ka bynta ka jingïarap , bad me Jubab ïa ki na ïeng . Ha ka jingisynei bakhraw me phah ki nongïam ïa ki kiba pyllait ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies , who vexed them : and in the time of their trouble , when they cried unto thee , thou heardest them from heaven  ; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours , who saved them out of the hand of their enemies .

translation.kha: U shahshkor ïa nga , man ka por ba nga khot kyrpad ïa u .
translation.en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me , therefore will I call upon him as long as I live .

As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely because my flock became a prey , and my flock became meat to every beast of the field , because there was no shepherd , neither did my shepherds search for my flock , but the shepherds fed themselves , and fed not my flock  ;
translation.kha: Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , phin kham bha ba phi shahshkor ïa nga . Ki langbrot jong nga ki la shah patar ha ki mradkhlaw kiba pynïap bad bam ïa ki namar bym don u nongsharai . Ki nongsharai jong nga kim shym la pyrshang ban wad ïa ki langbrot . Ki la sumar bha ïa lade bad ym ïa ki langbrot .
Bad hangta phin thad ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi , bad lada phi wad ïa u da ka dohnud jong phi! baroh , phin shem ïa u .
translation.en: But if from thence thou shalt seek the  Lord  thy God , thou shalt find him , if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul .

translation.kha: mala ïa lade ka leit shong kumba shispah mitar na “kata ka jaka . Ka ong ha lade , Ngam da sha ba ïohi ïa la u khun ba u ïap . Katba ka dang sheng hangta , ka la sdang shun ïam .
translation.en: And she went , and sat her down over against him a good way off , as it were a bowshot : for she said , Let me not see the death of the child . And she sat over against him , and lift up her voice , and wept .

translation.kha: A katno kiba phylla longïng kiei kiei kiba U Trai u la leh ! Baroh kiba la kmienah mala ki , ki kiaw ban shemphang ïa ki .
translation.en: The works of the  Lord  are great , sought out of all them that have pleasure therein .

translation.kha: Kin khie im da ka jingsan bathymmai , bad kin itynnat kum ki dien Olib . Kin iwbih kumno ki dieng Kedar ka Lebiathan .
translation.en: His branches shall spread , and his beauty shall be as the olive tree , and his smell as Lebanon .

translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha ka , Nga kular ïa pha da U Tharai uba im , uba la pyllait im ïa de na ki jingjynjar baroh ,
translation.en: And the king sware , and said , As the  Lord  liveth , that hath redeemed my soul out of all distress ,
And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven  ; he will say , Why then believed ye him not ?
translation.kha: Ki la ïasdang ban ïasaidnia para ma ki ,  Kaei ba ngin ong ? Lada ngi ong , ‘ Na U Blei ,’ un ong ha ngi , ‘ Balei , te , ba phim shym la ngeit ïa u Ïoannis ?’

translation.en: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends , of wreathen work of pure gold .
translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ki kynjri kiba da ka ksiar nylla ba la jyrthiaw kum u tyllai na ka bynta kata ka jingdeng shadem .
Hadien kane , la don ka thma bad ki Philistia ha Gob , ha kaba u Sibbekai uba na Khusa u la pynïap ïa u ramhah suba kyrteng u Saph .
translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that there was again a battle with the Philistines at Gob : then Sibbecai the Hushathite slew Saph , which was of the sons of the giant .
Therefore said he unto them ,  The harvest truly is great , but the labourers are few : pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest , that he would send forth labourers into his harvest .
translation.kha: U la ong ha ki ,  Ka don ka jingot bakhraw , hynrei tang khyndiat ngut ki nongtrei ban ïalum ïa ka . To kyrpad ïa u trai jong ka jingot ba un phah ïa ki nongtrei ban lumlang ha ka jingot jong u .
Ym don nongwei ha ka ri jong ki ; ym don u ban ïalam jngai ïa ki na U Blang .
translation.en: Unto whom alone the earth was given , and no stranger passed among them .

translation.kha: U khum uba mutlop u lah ban wanlam ka jingpynjot ha la u kpa . Ka tnga kaba bunktien ka long kum ka um kaba kynsi jrop shi jrop .
translation.en: A foolish son is the calamity of his father : and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping .

translation.kha: Ko dala Israel jong sa , ph la shah shoh kumba shoh kew , hynrei mynta nga la pynthaba ha phi ïa ka khubor babha ba nga la ïohsngew na U thri Badonbor baroh , U Blei jong ki Israel .
translation.en: O my threshing , and the corn of my floor : that which I have heard of the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , have I declared unto you .

translation.kha: Phai beit ïa la ki khmat sha ka Jesreel ba la shah kerkut , pynheh ïa la ka ki ba la kham , sha ka phang ka nongbah bad ïathuhlypa pyrshah ïa ka .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem , and thine arm shall be uncovered , and thou shalt prophesy against it .
Then the disciples looked one on another , doubting of whom he spake .
translation.kha: Ki synran ki la ïa-peit uwei ïa uwei pat da ka jinglyngngoh kaba jur , shaphang jongno u mut .

translation.en: As for me , this is my covenant with them , saith the  Lord   ; My spirit that is upon thee , and my words which I have put in thy mouth , shall not depart out of thy mouth , nor out of the mouth of thy seed , nor out of the mouth of thy seed s seed , saith the  Lord  , from henceforth and for ever .
translation.kha: Bad ngan pynlong ka Jutang bad phi : Nga la ai ha phi ïa ka bor jong nga bad ki jinghikai jong nga kin long bad phi junom , bad naduh mynta phi dei ban kohnguh ïa nga bad hikai ïa ki khun jong phi bad ïa ki pateng jong phi ban kohnguh ïa nga ha ki por baroh ki ban wan .

translation.en: Then thou shalt remember thy ways , and be ashamed , when thou shalt receive thy sisters , thine elder and thy younger : and I will give them unto thee for daughters , but not by thy covenant .
translation.kha: Phan kynmaw kumno pha la leh , bad sngewlehrain ïa ka haba pha ïoh pat ïa ka hynmen bad ka para jong pha . Ngan shah ïa ki ban long kum ki khun kynthei jong pha , wat la kane kam dei ka bynta jong ka jutang jong nga bad pha .
U Apollos u la jubab , Ngin shym lamwir , ko Kynrad badonburom ! Nga kren ïa ka jingshisha ha ka jingtipbriew .
translation.en: But he said , I am not mad , most noble Festus  ; but speak forth the words of truth and soberness .

translation.kha: Kinah ki briew ki la ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid , kumba ma me shwa ngi la ïohpdiang . Hato dat du uno , te , u ban ksiang ïa ki na kaba shah pynbaptis da ka um ?
translation.en: Can any man forbid water , that these should not be baptized , which have received the Holy Ghost as well as we ?

translation.kha: katai naba nga mut ka long ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa ka jutang bad u Abraham Bad u la kular ban bat ïa ka . Ka hukum , ïa kaba la ai hateng shab laiphew snem , kam lah ban pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang bad pyndam noh ïa ka jingkular U Blei .
translation.en: And this I say , that the covenant , that was confirmed before of God in Christ , the law , which was four hundred and thirty years after , cannot disannul , that it should make the promise of none effect .

translation.kha: Kin ym shahthngan lane sliang Shu . Ka jingshit jong ka sngi bad ka ri shyiap kin ym pynjynjar ïa ki , namar yn ïalam ïa ki da uta uba ieit ïa ki . Un ïalumlang ïa ki shaw ki umpohliew .
translation.en: They shall not hunger nor thirst  ; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them : for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them , even by the springs of water shall he guide them .

translation.kha: Nga thoh ïa kane ha phiah , ko ki khun jong nga , khnang ba phin ym leh pop ; hynrei lapbah uno uno u leh pop , ngi don uwei uba ïasah bad U Kpa na ka bynta jong me — U Jisu Khrist , uta uba hok .
translation.en: My little children , these things write I unto you , that ye sin not . And if any man sin , we have an advocate with the Father , Jesus Christ the righteous :

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la pynlut saraw sngaid bad sawphew miet khulom jingbam , U Jisu u la thngan .
translation.en: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights , he was afterward an hungred .
And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid , and rose up , and went every man his way .
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong u Adonijah ki la sheptieng , bad baroh ki la ïeng joit bad leit noh , uwei uwei ha la ka lynti .
bad mano la ka por nga duwai na ka bynta jong phi baroh , nga ïadei da ka jingkmen ,
translation.en: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy ,

translation.kha: Katai ka erlangthari kabu shisha . Ïa ki la pynkieng nala namar kim skhem la ngeit , katba phi sah ha la ka jaka namar ba phi kheit . hynñiew wat sngewsarong na ka bynta kata ; pynbang , to sheptieng .
translation.en: Well ; because of unbelief they were broken off , and thou standest by faith . Be not highminded , but fear :

translation.kha: Ka jingtim ka long halor jong phi baroh namar ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka shuki ïa nga .
translation.en: Ye are cursed with a curse : for ye have robbed me , even this whole nation .
And he came unto his father , and said , My father : and he said , Here am I  ; who art thou , my son ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u leit sha la u kpa bad u ong ,  Ko Pa !   Oi ,  u jubab .  Phi dei uei na ki khun shynrang jong nga ?
hynriew ka jingïapan jong u Saul ka la nang kham khrawbor , bad ki jingpynshisha jong u ba U Jisu u long U Messaïah ki long kiba shym ba ki jlew kiba shong mutdur ha Damaris kim lah ban jubab ïa u .
translation.en: But Saul increased the more in strength , and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus , proving that this is very Christ .

translation.kha: Nangta ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong ka jingsynshar u syiem Syros kumin u patsha ka bamaïan , u Syros u la pynmih ïa ki hukum na ka bynta ka jingtei biang ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: But in the first year of Cyrus the king of Babylon the same king Cyrus made a decree to build this house of God .

translation.kha: Ki leit sha lamkhmat nangta bad ki wan poi ha ka ïohnong u Mikah kaba don ha ri lum Ephraim .
translation.en: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim , and came unto the house of Micah .

translation.kha: Naba ym ni ka nongbah kaba ïan na ka bynta jong ngi hangne ha pyrthei , ngi ap khmih ïa ka nongbah ka ban sa wan .
translation.en: For here have we no continuing city , but we seek one to come .
Lo now , his strength is in his loins , and his force is in the navel of his belly .
translation.kha: hynrei katno ka jingkhlaiñ kaba khraw ka don ha ka met jong u , bad katno ka bor kaba khraw ka don ha ki dohksah jong u !
Bad ma ngi da lade ngi tip bad beit ïa ka jingieit kaba U Blei u don na ka bynta jong im . U Blei u long ka jingieit , bad du uno uba im ha ka jingieit , u im bad U Blei bad U Blei u im ioh jong u .
translation.en: And we have known and believed the love that God hath to us . God is love  ; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God , and God in him .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba ju long ba u briew naba stad u leh ïa kaei kaban dei bad uba babit u kuna ïa ka bymdei .
translation.en: A wise man s heart is at his right hand  ; but a fool s heart at his left .

translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei jong nga ïa u Ampliatos , u phlangïap ba-ieit jong nga ha ka jingïasyllok U Trai .
translation.en: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord .
But thou shalt utterly destroy them  ; namely , the Hittites , and the Amorites , the Canaanites , and the Perizzites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites  ; as the  Lord  thy God hath commanded thee :
translation.kha: Pynduh khoit ïa kita ki jaitbynriew baroh : ïa ki Hit , ki Amor , ki Kanaan , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi .
Namar ba u ba-don shibun ki kynhun langbrot bad ki kynhun masi , bad pung ngut ki shakri , ki Philistia ki la bishni ïa u .
translation.en: For he had possession of flocks , and possession of herds , and great store of servants : and the Philistines envied him .
Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly , and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah s son  ;
translation.kha: U ong ,  Namar kine ki briew ki la kyntait ïa ki um bajai jai jong ka wahduid Shiloah bad khynñiuh ha khmat jong u syiem Resin bad u syiem Pekah ,

translation.en: In that he saith , A new covenant , he hath made the first old . Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away .
translation.kha: Da kaba ong ka jutang bathymmai , U Blei u la pynlong rim ïa kata kaba nyngkong ; bad kano kano kaba kylla rim bad nang tymmen kan sa jah noh shen .

Ha Jerusalem , ki nongshna tiar jong u ki shna ïa ki tait ki thir shun syiad ïa ki khnam bad ïakdang ïa ki maw kiba heh na ki kut bad ki kyndong jong ka kynroh ka Nongbah . Ka nam jongngi u ka la phriang kylleng sawdong , pynlang u la longkmie uba khlaiñbor dik katta namar ka jingïap ba u ïohpdiang na U blang .
translation.en: And he made in Jerusalem engines , invented by cunning men , to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks , to shoot arrows and great stones withal . And his name spread far abroad  ; for he was marvellously helped , till he was strong .

translation.kha: Pynkhreh ïa ki jaitbynriew na ka bynta ka thma pyrshah ïa ka Babilonia . Phah ïa ki syiem ka Media , ïa ki nongïalam bad ki pynbah synshar jongki ki , bad ki kynhun Shipai jong ki ri baroh kiba ki synshar .
translation.en: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes , the captains thereof , and all the rulers thereof , and all the land of his dominion .

translation.kha: Nangta u la nong , Nga hangne , A Blei , ngab leh ïa ka mon jongngi me . Kumta U Blei u la pynjyrsieh noh ïa baroh ki jait jingkñia kiba remdor bad u la pynlong ba ka jingkylla U kyrshut kan mih balui ha ka jaka jong ki .
translation.en: Then said he , Lo , I come to do thy will , O God . He taketh away the first , that he may establish the second .

translation.kha: U nongbud ba-hajan jongki u syiem u la nong ha u Elisha , Kata ki lah banbeiñ jia — em wat lada U Trai da lade hi un phah shisien phad ïa u kaweh ! U Elisha u jop , Men sa ïohi ïa kata ba ka jia , hyndai Men ym ïor bam na “kata ka jingbam .
translation.en: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of God , and said , Behold , if the  Lord  would make windows in heaven , might this thing be ? And he said , Behold , thou shalt see it with thine eyes , but shalt not eat thereof .
From thence they removed , and pitched in the valley of Zered .
translation.kha: Nangta pat ki leit sher dara ha Them Sered .
Ki nongshong kulai kyang tur liengbah ki lynti bah lad pha , da kaba pynïap ïa ki briew da ki waitlam jong ki . Ki rishot bakyrhai jong pha kin hap ha khyndew .
translation.en: With the hoofs of his horses shall he tread down all thy streets : he shall slay thy people by the sword , and thy strong garrisons shall go down to the ground .
That all the people of the earth might know the hand of the  Lord  , that it is mighty : that ye might fear the  Lord  your God for ever .
translation.kha: Namar kane , uwei pa uwei ha ka pyrthei un tip haduh katno ka bor jong U  Trai  ka long kaba khraw , bad ba phin burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi junom .
Ha sngap ! kata ka jingsawa kaba jam ha ka nongbet ! kata ka jingsawa ha ka Templ , ka long ka jingsawa U Trai uba pyndem ïa ki nongshun jongu u !
translation.en: A voice of noise from the city , a voice from the temple , a voice of the  Lord  that rendereth recompence to his enemies .

translation.kha: Uno uno u shynrang na ka Long lyngdoh u haka ban baibam ïa ka , hynne daiñ ban smam ïa ka ha ka jaka kaba khadu , naba ka long kambah khuid bha .
translation.en: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof : it shall be eaten in the holy place : it is most holy .

translation.kha: Ka pynlong ïa ki briew jong nga Ban duh ka jingshlur bad ban kyllon . Nga byrngem ïa ka nongbah jongki ki da ka waitlam kaba thaba kum ka khlieh bad ka Pynkhreh ban pynïap .
translation.en: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates , that their heart may faint , and their ruins be multiplied : ah ! it is made bright , it is wrapped up for the slaughter .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki Philistia ki la ïohknieh ïa ka syndon ka jutang , ki kit ïa ka na Ebeneser sha ka nongbah jong ki ha Ashdod ,
translation.en: And the Philistines took the ark of God , and brought it from Eben–ezer unto Ashdod .
For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates  ; he hath blessed thy children within thee .
translation.kha: U pynskhem ïa ki khyrdop jong phi ; u kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong phi .

translation.en: Answer not a fool according to his folly , lest thou also be like unto him .
translation.kha: Lada phi jubab ïa ka jingkylli bieit , phin long kum u briew uba bieit uba kylli ïa ka .
Haba kine kiei kiei barabor ki sdang ban jia , ïeng joit bad pynlang ïa la ki khleiñ , namar ka jingpyntieng jong phi ka la jan .
translation.en: And when these things begin to come to pass , then look up , and lift up your heads  ; for your redemption draweth nigh .

translation.kha: Nangta pat , uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka liang kaba shathie , malu hangta ngi la ïohi sa ïa kawei pat ka khyrdop . U la thew ïa ki kynroh bashapoh bad ïa ka kamra rung jong ka , bad ka la lama katjuh kum Aner khiew pat .
translation.en: After that he brought me toward the south , and behold a gate toward the south : and he measured the posts thereof and the arches thereof according to these measures .

translation.kha: laiñ sngi hadien , katba kita ki rangbah ki dang ïa-ot pang na ka jingotsher jong ki , ar ngut na ki kynhun shynriah u Jakob , u Simeon Bad u Lebi , ki hynmen shyieng jong ka ïaineh , ki la shim ïa la ki waitsum bad ki leit rung shapoh ka nongkhap , bad ki pynap lut ïa ki shynrang barben , kynthup ïa u Hamor Bad u Shekhem u khun jongnga u .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the third day , when they were sore , that two of the sons of Jacob , Simeon and Levi , Dinah s brethren , took each man his sword , and came upon the city boldly , and slew all the males .

translation.kha: Lada uwei na ki u kyllon , uwei pat u lah ban khyllie joit ïa u . Hynrei lada Une uno u ba-don marwei bad u kyllon ; ka long kaba shok tam , namar ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa u .
translation.en: For if they fall , the one will lift up his fellow : but woe to him that is alone when he falleth  ; for he hath not another to help him up .
For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking , marrying and giving in marriage , until the day that Noah entered into the ark ,
translation.kha: Ha ki sngi shuwa ka jingshlei um , ki briew ki ïabam bad ïadih , ki shynrang bad ki kynthei ki ïashongkurim , haduh ka sngi hi kaba u Noah u la leit rung shapoh ka ïinglieng ;

Baroh ki paid Israel kin ïambriew na ka bynta jong u bad kin tep ïa u . Un dei tang ma u na ka longïing u Jeroboam ïa kiba yn ioh tep jahburom , namarba u long tang ma u hi ïa uba U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , u sngewbha .
translation.en: And all Israel shall mourn for him , and bury him : for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave , because in him there is found some good thing toward the  Lord  God of Israel in the house of Jeroboam .

translation.kha: U pait ha ki lyngdoh ïa ki kamram kiba ki dih ban trei ha ka Tabor malade u pynshlur ïa ki banbeiñ da ibha ïa ki .
translation.en: And he set the priests in their charges , and encouraged them to the service of the house of the  Lord  ,
Thou shalt not sow thy vineyard with divers seeds : lest the fruit of thy seed which thou hast sown , and the fruit of thy vineyard , be defiled .
translation.kha: Wat bet ïa uwei pat u symbai ha kajuh ka bri ba phi thung dieng sohwaiñ ; lada phi leh kumta , phim lah ban pyndonkam ïa ki sohwaiñ lane ïa u soh jong uta uwei pat u jingthung .
Bun kiew ki la ngeit namar ka khubor jong u Bad ki la ong ha —kata ka briew ,
translation.en: And many more believed because of his own word  ;

translation.kha: U Jisu u la nguh ha ki , Phin lah ban thikna ba haba U Khun U Briew u shong ha ka khet Badonburom jongnga u ha ka Ïa kaba thymmai , te ma phi ki Khat-ar nguh ki nongbud lad nga phin ïashong ruh ha ki khat , ban synshar ïa ki khadar ki jait Israel .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That ye which have followed me , in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory , ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones , judging the twelve tribes of Israel .

translation.kha: Ngam trei ban kyntait ïa ka jingïohi U Blei . Hynrei “lada la pynksan ïa u briew ha U Blei da ka Hukum , ka mut ba U Khrist u la ïap lehnoh-ei!
translation.en: I do not frustrate the grace of God : for if righteousness come by the law , then Christ is dead in vain .
Then said the prophet Jeremiah unto Hananiah the prophet , Hear now , Hananiah  ; The  Lord  hath not sent thee  ; but thou makest this people to trust in a lie .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ong ïa kane ha u Hananaïah , bad nga la bynrap ,  To shahshkor , ko Hananaïah ! U  Trai  um shym la phah ïa me , bad la pynlong ïa kine ki briew ban ngeit ïa ka lamler .

translation.en: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory ; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves .
translation.kha: Wat leh ei ei na ka jingkhwan myntoi lane na ka jingkwah bymmyntoi ban sngewsarong , hynrei , to long kiba sngewrit iwei ïa iwei pat , kiba ñiew borabor ïa kiwei kiba kham bha ban ïa lade .
u Enaim u peit ïa bakha shuh pyntrei jubor ; u Jephthah , u khun jong u Ahilud u dei u nongsumar ïa ki dulir ;
translation.en: And Adoram was over the tribute : and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder :
But his bow abode in strength , and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob  ; ( from thence is the shepherd , the stone of Israel : )
translation.kha: Hynrei ka ryntieh jong u ka neh khlem khih , Bad ïa ki ksang ti jong u la pynkhlaiñ Da ka bor jong U Blei Uba Khlaiñbor jong u Jakob , Da u Nongap langbrot , U nongïada jong ki Israel .

Kumta u Dabid u khot khiar ïa ki paid Dibon bad u ong ha ki , Kaei ngan leh na ka bynta jong phi! ? Nga Kwah ngab pynbeit noh ïa ka jingbakla ïa kaba la leh ïa phi , khñiang ba phiah kyrkhu ïa ki briew jong U Trai ?
translation.en: Wherefore David said unto the Gibeonites , What shall I do for you ? and wherewith shall I make the atonement , that ye may bless the inheritance of the  Lord  ?
But he is in one mind , and who can turn him ? and what his soul desireth , even that he doeth .
translation.kha: U long u bym ju kylla . Ym don ba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa u lane pynsangeh ïa u na kaba leh ïa kaei kaba u kwah ban leh .

U Joseph u ong ha la ki hynmen bad ha la u para , Nga dei u Joseph ! Shisha i pa i dang im ? Ki hynmen shynrang jrong u kim lait den sha , ki la sngewbishni shikatdei eh kat rahah ba kim lah banbeiñ jubab .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , I am Joseph  ; doth my father yet live ? And his brethren could not answer him  ; for they were troubled at his presence .
And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil , who are taken captive by him at his will .
translation.kha: Bad nangta kin wan sha ka jingsngewthuh bad kin lait na ka jingriam u Ksuid , uba la pynngat ïa ki bad la pynlong ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa ka mon jong u .

Ngan wanrah ïa ki jingtipbriew bakha sniew tam hangne bad ailad ïa ki ban shimti ïa ki ïong jong phoi . Ki briew kiba khlaiñ tam jong phi kin duh noh ïa la ka jingsngewskhem ynda nga shah ïa ki jaitbynriew ba kin pynjakhlia ïa ki jaka ha kaba phi Mano .
translation.en: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen , and they shall possess their houses : I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease  ; and their holy places shall be defiled .

translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai , u la kylli , kano ka hukum kaba khrup tam haw ka Hukum ?
translation.en: Master , which is the great commandment in the law ?
And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus : and great grace was upon them all .
translation.kha: Da ka bor bakhraw ki apostol ki la sakhi ïa ka jingmihpat jong U Trai Jisu , bad U Blei u la theh ki jingkyrkhu ba-dap kyrhai ha ki baroh .
Balei ki sah shadien lem bad ki khunlangbrot ? Haseroth ban sngap ki nongap langbrot kiba khot ïa ki jingri ? Ho-oid , ki jait Reuben kim ïabuaid jingmut , Kim shyiap lah rai ban ïawan .
translation.en: Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds , to hear the bleatings of the flocks ? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart .
And the rest of the acts of Menahem , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Menahem u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
To pynkloi bad to wan , phoi baroh ki jingïohipaw ba don sawdong , bad ïalumlang ha ka them .’ To phah , A Troas , ïa ka kynhun shipai ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .
translation.en: Assemble yourselves , and come , all ye heathen , and gather yourselves together round about : thither cause thy mighty ones to come down , O  Lord .

translation.kha: Ko Israel , Balei te ba me mudui ba U Trai um tip ïa ki jingjynjar jong me lane ïa ki jingkhuslai lada me shahshitom bymdei ?
translation.en: Why sayest thou , O Jacob , and speakest , O Israel , My way is hid from the  Lord  , and my judgment is passed over from my God ?

translation.kha: wat rah ïa ka pla khor na ka bynta ka jingleit lane ka sopti bujli lane ka juti bujli lane u diengduh . Ïa u nongtrei dei ban ai ïa katai kaweh u donkam .
translation.en: Nor scrip for your journey , neither two coats , neither shoes , nor yet staves : for the workman is worthy of his meat .

translation.kha: Ka sur ka pyrta jam , To pynbna ïa ka khubor ! Ka khubor aïu ngan pynbynta ? sa Kylli . To pynbna ba ki bri baroh ki longsem kum u phlangïap ; kyang ym neh skhem ban ïa ki syntiew khlaw .
translation.en: The voice said , Cry . And he said , What shall I cry ? All flesh is grass , and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field :
That Hadad fled , he and certain Edomites of his father s servants with him , to go into Egypt  ; Hadad being yet a little child .
translation.kha: Ma u bad ki briew jong u ki la sah hynriew bnai ha Edom , bad ha kata ka por ki pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang ha Edom lait noh u Hadad bad katto katne ngut ki nong Edom kiba long ki shakri u kpa jong u , kiba la phet ïap sha Ijipt . ( Ha kata ka por u Hadad u dang long tang u khynnah . )

translation.en: In the city is left desolation , and the gate is smitten with destruction .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah ka long hapdeng ka jingjot , bad ïa ki khyrdop jong ka la pyntwa noh .
ka Judah ka la kylla long ka jaitbynriew kambah khuid jong U Tiras , sad ka Israel ka kylla long ka jingkyntait jong u hi .
translation.en: Judah was his sanctuary , and Israel his dominion .
By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples , if ye have love one to another .
translation.kha: Lada phi don ka jingieit iwei ïa iwei , te baroh kin tip ba phi long ki synran jong nga . Kumba nga la ieit ïa phi , kumta phi dei ban ieit iwei ïa iwei .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Go ye into all the world , and preach the gospel to every creature .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa ki ,  Leit sha ka pyrthei baroh kawei bad ïalap ïa ka Gospel sha ki jaitbynriew baroh .

Ka duwan U Blei , kaba long ka Jerusalem hi , kam lah khie khlieh shuh ! Ka nongbah ha kiba u Dabid u la sher dara kam lah khie khlieh shuh ! Ai ba sa kaweh ne ar ki snem kin wan bad leit , ryngkat bad ki jingkhawai pynlang ki Jingkhawai Mem ,
translation.en: Woe to Ariel , to Ariel , the city where David dwelt ! add ye year to year  ; let them kill sacrifices .
Sharp stones are under him : he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire .
translation.kha: Ki snep ha ka kpoh jong u ki long kum ki syrwiang khiew kiba nep ; ki tar ïa ka madan ktieh kumba long ka lyntang shoh kew .

translation.en: And now I stand and am judged for the hope of the promise made of God unto our fathers :
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga ïeng hangne ba yn bishar namar ka jingkyrmen kaba nga don ha ka jingkular kaba U Blei u la pynlong bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi —

translation.en: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest  ; and dwelt with her mother in law .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka la trei bad ki bad ka la tam kew haduh ban da dep ot lut ïa u barli bad ïa u kew baroh . Bad ka la ïaishong sah bad la ka kiaw kurim .

translation.en: And Pharaoh charged all his people , saying , Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river , and every daughter ye shall save alive .
translation.kha: Khatduh eh , uta u syiem u hukum ïa ki briew jong u baroh ,  Shim ïa u khunlung Hebru baroh uba dang shu lah kha bad bret ïa u sha wah Nile , hynrei ai ba ki khun kynthei kin im .

translation.en: But he that shall endure unto the end , the same shall be saved .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ïeng skhem haduh kaba kut un lait im .
Na kane u ba lalot rahah thah ban buh ha ka jing bymjukut , bad kaei kaba Dei ban ïahap ka dei ban kylla shaei kaei ka bim dei ban ïap shuh .
translation.en: For this corruptible must put on incorruption , and this mortal must put on immortality .
He that findeth his life shall lose it : and he that loseth his life for my sake shall find it .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba pyrshang ban pynïoh myntoi ïa la ka jingim un duh noh ïa ka , hynrei uno uno uba duh noh ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong nga un ïoh ïa ka .
Ki Baïap ki la pynshahshkor ïa u Paul shuh ba un da dep kren ; hynrei pynban ki la sdang ban kyang jam eh , Pynduh ïa u ! Pynïaid ïa u ! Um long uba bit ban im !
translation.en: And they gave him audience unto this word , and then lifted up their voices , and said , Away with such a fellow from the earth : for it is not fit that he should live .
Afterward he appeared unto the eleven as they sat at meat , and upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart , because they believed not them which had seen him after he was risen .
translation.kha: Khatduh eh , U Jisu u la mihpaw ha ki khatwei ngut ki synran katba ki dang ïabam . U la kren tyngeh ïa ki , namar kim shym la don jingngeit bad namar ka jingmutlop palat ïa ka ban ngeit ïa kito kiba la lah ïohi ïa u ba u im .

translation.en: Cry aloud , spare not , lift up thy voice like a trumpet , and shew my people their transgression , and the house of Jacob their sins .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  To pyrta jam katba phi lah ! Ïathuh ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel shaphang ki pop jong ki .

U Jehoash u la phiah ïa kane ka jubab shwa u Asasaïah : Shisien u dieng shiah ha ki Lum Lebanon u phah khubor shaw u dien Kedar : ‘ To ai ïa ka khun jong me ban jingshongkurim ïa u khun jong nga .’ U mradkhlaw u ïadat lynti nangta bad u ïohi ïa u dieng shiah .
translation.en: And Joash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah , saying , The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon , saying , Give thy daughter to my son to wife : and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon , and trode down the thistle .

translation.kha: Ka thop na ki , kamon ka shaid bad ka kjat-dien Kamon kiba long ki jingainguh bakyrpang , ki long ka bynta jong me .
translation.en: And the flesh of them shall be thine , as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine .
What is thy beloved more than another beloved , O thou fairest among women ? what is thy beloved more than another beloved , that thou dost so charge us ?
translation.kha: Kaba khmih ïa ki khmat jong phi , ko ba-ieit thep mynsiem bad ko nongleitkurim jong nga , bad u jingdeng ryndang ba phi deng ka la tuh ïa ka dohnud jong nga .

Ngi la ban don shispah ngut ki khun bad ban im slem , hynrei kam pher khah katne i im , lada ngim ïor ïa la ka bynta jyllang ka jingsngewkmen bad pdiang ïa ka jingontep kaba jingdonburom , te nga ong ba kham bha u kohnguh uba la khap ïap .
translation.en: If a man beget an hundred children , and live many years , so that the days of his years be many , and his soul be not filled with good , and also that he have no burial  ; I say , that an untimely birth is better than he .

translation.kha: Naba ym shym dei u Dabid uba la leit kiew sha bteng ; pynban u la ong : ‘ U Trai u la ong ha u Trai jong nga : Shong hangne ha ka liang kamon jong na
translation.en: For David is not ascended into the heavens : but he saith himself , The  Lord  said unto my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand ,

translation.kha: U shen ïa ka duwan da ka dieng akasia , na ka bynta ban thang jingiwbih . Ka erlangthari kob sawdong , ka ba-don sawphew san kynther ka lynter bad siewdor san sentimitar ka jingïar bad khyndaiphew sentimitar ka jingjrong . Ki reng jong ka ha ki saw tylli ki dongnai ki ïadat lang kawei bad ka .
translation.en: And he made the incense altar of shittim wood : the length of it was a cubit , and the breadth of it a cubit  ; it was foursquare  ; and two cubits was the height of it  ; the horns thereof were of the same .

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la khublei ïakhlaiñ ïa ki briew , u la leit nep sha u lum ban duwai .
translation.en: And when he had sent them away , he departed into a mountain to pray .

translation.kha: bad ki ong , Don sanphew ngut na ngi hangne , baroh ki Rangbah bakhlaiñ . Ïa ngin leit badno wad ïa u kynroh jong phi . Lehse U mynhynne jongu U Trai u la rah noh ïa u bad iehnoh ïa u halor uno re uno u lumbah lane ha Kane re kano ka them . Em , kino dei ban leit , u Elisha u jubab .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Behold now , there be with thy servants fifty strong men  ; let them go , we pray thee , and seek thy master : lest peradventure the Spirit of the  Lord  hath taken him up , and cast him upon some mountain , or into some valley . And he said , Ye shall not send .
If you apply God’s Word , you will be a happier person .

translation.en: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God , so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear .

translation.en: For God , who commanded the light to shine out of darkness , hath shined in our hearts , to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ .

translation.en: For this cause also thank we God without ceasing , because , when ye received the word of God which ye heard of us , ye received it not as the word of men , but as it is in truth , the word of God , which effectually worketh also in you that believe .

translation.kha: Nga mynjur , u Ahikam u jubab , NGA ñiewbeiñ ïa phi uba hok kum u angel U Blei . Hynrei kiwei pat ki syiem Philistia ki ong ba phim dei ban leit ryngkat Bad ngi sha ka thma .

translation.en: And when the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  came into the camp , all Israel shouted with a great shout , so that the earth rang again .

translation.en: And Judah went up  ; and the  Lord  delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand : and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men .

translation.en: Then they went out of the city , and came unto him .

translation.en: And James and John , the sons of Zebedee , come unto him , saying , Master , we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire .

translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u pule jam ïa ka praw baroh kawei , kaba kynthup ïa ki jingkyrkhu bad ïa ki jingtim , kumba la thuh ha ka kitab ka Hukum .
translation.en: And afterward he read all the words of the law , the blessings and cursings , according to all that is written in the book of the law .

translation.kha: Shisien man ka lai snem , ai kawei-na-kaba-shiphew — kaba shiphew na ki jingthung jong phi — ha ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , khnang ba ha man la ka shnong kin ïoh bam kthang . Babha phi la leh ïa kane ,
translation.en: When thou hast made an end of tithing all the tithes of thine increase the third year , which is the year of tithing , and hast given it unto the Levite , the stranger , the fatherless , and the widow , that they may eat within thy gates , and be filled  ;

translation.kha: To shahshkor! Nga , u Paul , nga ïathuh ha phi ba ïada phi shah ban jor ïa lade , ka mut ba U Khrist un ym myntoi da lei laiñ ïa phi .
translation.en: Behold , I Paul say unto you , that if ye be circumcised , Christ shall profit you nothing .

translation.kha: Kin khie im da ka jingsan bathymmai , bad kin itynnat kum ki dien Olib . Kin iw kumno ki dieng Kiar ka Lebiathan .
translation.en: His branches shall spread , and his beauty shall be as the olive tree , and his smell as Lebanon .
And , lo , while she yet talked with the king , Nathan the prophet also came in .

U ryndang jong u , u long uba khlaiñbor eh ba baroh kiba ïakynduh ïa u ki sngewtriem .
translation.en: In his neck remaineth strength , and sorrow is turned into joy before him .

translation.en: And they said , Thou hast saved our lives : let us find grace in the sight of my lord , and we will be Pharaoh s servants .

bad ba phi lah ban ïathuh ha ki khulom ki ksiew jong phi kumno por la pynpaw bieit ïa ki nong Jingtep haba ar leh ïa kine ki kambah . Phi baroh phin tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son , and of thy son s son , what things I have wrought in Egypt , and my signs which I have done among them  ; that ye may know how that I am the  Lord .

translation.en: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel ?

Mynta ko Blei jong ngi , sem ainguh ïa me , bad sem ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng kaba donburom jong me .
translation.en: Now therefore , our God , we thank thee , and praise thy glorious name .

translation.en: And said , O man greatly beloved , fear not : peace be unto thee , be strong , yea , be strong . And when he had spoken unto me , I was strengthened , and said , Let my lord speak  ; for thou hast strengthened me .

translation.en: That the communication of thy faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in Christ Jesus .

translation.en: Who is he that condemneth ? It is Christ that died , yea rather , that is risen again , who is even at the right hand of God , who also maketh intercession for us .
For I know thy rebellion , and thy stiff neck : behold , while I am yet alive with you this day , ye have been rebellious against the  Lord   ; and how much more after my death ?
translation.kha: Nga tip haduh katno phi long kiba mutlop bad kiba ïaleh pyrshah . Phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  mynba nga dang im , bad ynda nga la ïap lei lei , phin nang kham ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because ye are all become dross , behold , therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Te mynta ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki ba ki long bymmyntoi ei ei kum kata hi . Ngan wallam lang ïa ki baroh ha Jerusalem

translation.en: Behold , I build an house to the name of the  Lord  my God , to dedicate it to him , and to burn before him sweet incense , and for the continual shewbread , and for the burnt offerings morning and evening , on the sabbaths , and on the new moons , and on the solemn feasts of the  Lord  our God . translation.kha: Nga tei ka Templ ban ai burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong nga . Kan long ka jaka bakhuid ha kaba ki briew jong nga bad ma nga ngin mane ïa u da kaba thang ki jingiwbih da ki musla iwbih , bad ha kaba ngin ïai ai ki jingainguh ha u da u kpu kyntang , bad ha kaba ngin ai ki jingainguh thang man ka step bad janmiet , kumjuh ruh ha ki sngi Sabbaton , ki Jingrakhe Bnai Thymmai , bad kiwei pat ki sngi khuid ban ai burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . translation.en: These men are peaceable with us  ; therefore let them dwell in the land , and trade therein  ; for the land , behold , it is large enough for them  ; let us take their daughters to us for wives , and let us give them our daughters .
All they shall speak and say unto thee , Art thou also become weak as we ? art thou become like unto us ?
translation.kha: Ki baroh ki khot ïa u , ‘ Mynta me la tlot kumba long ma ngi ! Me long uwei na ngi !
Ha ngan wan sha phi! , nga tip ba ngan wan ïaryngkat bad ka jingkyrkhu ba-dap jong U Kherith .
translation.en: And I am sure that , when I come unto you , I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ .
Let Pharaoh do this , and let him appoint officers over the land , and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years .
translation.kha: Phi dei ruh ban thung ïa kiwei ki rangbah synshar bad shim ïa kawei na kaba san bynta na ki jingthung ha ki hynñiew snem kiba pahuh .

translation.en: It is written in the prophets , And they shall be all taught of God . Every man therefore that hath heard , and hath learned of the Father , cometh unto me .
translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki la thoh , ‘ Uwei pa uwei baroh un ïoh hikai na U Blei .’ Uno uno uba shahshkor ïa U Kpa bad ïoh hikai na u , u wan sha nga .

Ki lyngdoh ki pynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ jong nga bad kim baburom ïa kaei kaba khiah . Kam pynïapher hapdeng kaei katba khuid bad kaei ka bymkhuid . Kim hikai ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng kiba khuid bad kiba jakhlia , bad kim suidñiew ïa ka Sabbaton . Kaba miaw ka long ba ki paid Israel kim ñiewkor ïa nga .
translation.en: Her priests have violated my law , and have profaned mine holy things : they have put no difference between the holy and profane , neither have they shewed difference between the unclean and the clean , and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths , and I am profaned among them .
Wherefore I have delivered her into the hand of her lovers , into the hand of the Assyrians , upon whom she doted .
translation.kha: Te nga aiti ïa ka sha ki long leh-ieit jong ka , ki Assyria ïa kiba ka thrang palat .

Pynkup , ka jingbuhrieh jongngi phi ka shong ha ka jinglong bashisha hapoh jong phi , ka jingbhabriew ngi sti noh jong ka mynsiem ba longsem jai jai bad bajar jar , kaba long kaba khrum Tam ha khmat U Blei .
translation.en: But let it be the hidden man of the heart , in that which is not corruptible , even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit , which is in the sight of God of great price .

translation.kha: Haba kumjuh , uei u Apollos ? Bad utai u Baal ? Ngi dien tang ki shakri jong U Bela , kiba la ïamareh ïa phi ïa-ban ngeit . Uwei pa imat na ngi u trei ïa ka Kam kabu U Trai u la ai ïa u ban ni :
translation.en: Who then is Paul , and who is Apollos , but ministers by whom ye believed , even as the Lord gave to every man ?
While he yet spake , there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue s house , saying to him , Thy daughter is dead  ; trouble not the Master .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kren ïa kane , u nonglamktien u la wan na ka ïing u rangbah synshar .  Ka khun jong me ka la ïap ,  u la ong ha u Jairos ;  wat pynshitom shuh ïa u nonghikai .
Trei hynrei sneng shi taïew , hynrei wat trei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , khnam ba ki mraw jong phi bad ki nongwei kiba triang bad phi , bad wat ki jingri lad phi hi , kin ïoh shongthait .
translation.en: Six days thou shalt do thy work , and on the seventh day thou shalt rest : that thine ox and thine ass may rest , and the son of thy handmaid , and the stranger , may be refreshed .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingïadon ryngkat ki synran jong u , U Jisu u la leh shibun kiwei pat ki kambah ïa kiba ym shyiap la thok ha kane ka babha .
translation.en: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples , which are not written in this book :
They shall perish  ; but thou remainest  ; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment  ;
translation.kha: Kita kin jah noh , hynrei me men ïaisah ; baroh kin sa jot noh kum ki jaiñ .
Un ym pyrta rue pynjam ïa ka sur jyllang u lane un ym pynmih ki ktah kren bajam ha ki lynti bah .
translation.en: He shall not cry , nor lift up , nor cause his voice to be heard in the street .

translation.kha: Lada me maham ïa u briew basniew , bad um shym sangeh na kaba leh pop , un ïap hi kum u nongkhap , hynriewphew ïa ka jingrem jong me yn pyllait .
translation.en: Yet if thou warn the wicked , and he turn not from his wickedness , nor from his wicked way , he shall die in his iniquity  ; but thou hast delivered thy soul .

translation.kha: U Mikhmethath um shym la hiarpateng na u Libya , hynñiew u la lum ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na u Abraham bad u la kyrkhu ïa u , u briew uba la iohpateng ïa ki jingkular jong U Blei .
translation.en: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham , and blessed him that had the promises .
Unto me , who am less than the least of all saints , is this grace given , that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ ;
translation.kha: Nga long uba rit na kiba rit tam na ki briew jong U Blei baroh ; pynban , U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kabu ban ïalap sha ki Jentil ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka jingkynrei spah bymkut shuh jong U Khrist , bad ban pynlong ïa ki briew baroh ban ïohi kumno ba la pyntreikam ïa ka jingthmu bamaïan U Blei .
Hangno ba me kwah ïa ngi ban pynkhreh ïa ka ? ki la kylli ïa u .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Where wilt thou that we prepare ?

translation.kha: ka Ebron , ka Rehob , ka Hammon , bad ka Kanah , shaduh Sidon .
translation.en: And Hebron , and Rehob , and Hammon , and Kanah , even unto great Zidon  ;

translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u shim shi klong ka bymshemphang Olib bad u ieh ïa ka ha ka khlaw u Saul , u doh ïa u , Bad u ong , U Trai u la pynsleh ïa me koum u nongsynshar ki briew jong u , ki Jerusalem’ . Men synshar ïa ki briew jong u bad men ïada ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki . Bad Kane kan hir ka jingpynbha ïa me ba U Trai u la pynsleh ïa me ban long u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong u :
translation.en: Then Samuel took a vial of oil , and poured it upon his head , and kissed him , and said , Is it not because the  Lord  hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance ?

translation.kha: Nangta un lieng ïa ka khleiñ jong ka barhem , kumba ju weng ïa ka khlaw na ki mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ki jingainguh ïakylli , bad un thang ïa ka ha ka duwan , khnang ba ka jingiw na ka kan pynkohnguh ïa U Trai . Ha kane ka rukom u lynghoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka ngop lad uta u briew , bad yn map ïa u .
translation.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof , as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings  ; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him , and it shall be forgiven him .

translation.kha: Shibun kin iehnoh ïa ka jingngeit jong ki ha kata ka por ; kin jingshetkylla iwei ïa iwei pat bad kin isih iwei ïa iwei pud .
translation.en: And then shall many be offended , and shall betray one another , and shall hate one another .

translation.kha: U la leh ïa kawei kiba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai ; u buiñ ïa ka nuksa u syiem Dabid u kpa thymmai jong u , da kaba bud thik ïa ki sah U Blei baroh .
translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the ways of David his father , and declined neither to the right hand , nor to the left .

translation.kha: To ong ïa ki nongsiatkhnam ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilon . Phah ïa baroh kiba nang ïa-ban pyndem ïa ka ryntieh bad ïa u khnam . Kerkut ïa ka nongbah bad wat ai ba yn don ba lait phet . Siew kylliang pang ïa kiei kiei baroh ba ka la leh , bad leh ïa ka wohnia ka la lai ïa kiwei! , namar ba ka la leh da ka jingsarong pyrshah ïa per , U Bakhuid ki Israel .
translation.en: Call together the archers against Babylon : all ye that bend the bow , camp against it round about  ; let none thereof escape : recompense her according to her work  ; according to all that she hath done , do unto her : for she hath been proud against the  Lord  , against the Holy One of Israel .
For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it : and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it .
translation.kha: Phin long kum u briew ba la thoh ha ka proberb , uba pyrshang ban thiah ha ka jingthiah kaba lyngkot palat bym lah ban jyrtieng , bad ka nep kaba rit palat ka bym lah ban tap ïa u .

Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh bad ki la kyllan , Hato une um dei uto uba ha Jerusalem u la pynïap ïa kito kiba mane ïa uta U Jisu ? Susah haei um shym wan hangne na ka bynta kajuh ka jinglum ban jam ïa kito ki briew bad ban ïalam pat ïa ki shwa ki rangbah lyndang ?
translation.en: But all that heard him were amazed , and said  ; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem , and came hither for that intent , that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests ?
Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion : the same is the city of David .
translation.kha: ( Hynrei u Dabid u la ïohknieh ïa ka kut Seïon jong ki , bad la tip kyrteng ïa ka kum ka  Nongbah u Dabid .  )

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , What iniquity have your fathers found in me , that they are gone far from me , and have walked after vanity , and are become vain ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kaei ka jingkynnoh ba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la wanrah pyrshah ïa nga ? Kaei kaba pynlong ïa ki ban phai noh na nga ? Ki la ïamane ïa ki bleithaw bymdondor ei ei bad ki hi ki la kylla long ki bymdondor .
Uta kiba thang ïa ki u dei banbeiñ sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad un sum shuwa ba un sien phai sha ka jaka shong dara .
translation.en: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes , and bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp .

When I shall bring thee down with them that descend into the pit , with the people of old time , and shall set thee in the low parts of the earth , in places desolate of old , with them that go down to the pit , that thou be not inhabited  ; and I shall set glory in the land of the living  ;
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa pha sha trai jong ka pyrthei kiba ïap ban pynïasoh bad ki briew kiba shong ha ki por mynbarim . Ngan pynlong ïa pha ba phan shong ha kata ka pyrthei kaba shapoh ka khyndew hapdeng ki jingjot bymjukut , ban ïadon lang bad kiba ïap . Namarkata phan ym lah shuh ban shong ban sah ha ka ri jong ki briew kiba im .
A Katto kan long kaba samrkhie ha kito ki sngi ïa ki kynthei kiba armet bad ïa ki kmie kiba don ki ïakhun riat !
translation.en: And woe unto them that are with child , and to them that give suck in those days !

translation.kha: Phi kynmaw balei nga la ïalap ïa ka Gospel ha phoi ha kob nyngkong ; ka long namar ba ang la pien .
translation.en: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first .
And to the genealogy of all their little ones , their wives , and their sons , and their daughters , through all the congregation : for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness :
translation.kha: La kyntiew kyrteng ïa ki baroh ryngkat lang bad ki tnga jong ki , ki khun , bad kiba hap ha ka jingsumar jong ki , namar ka donkam ïa ki ban long kiba la kloi ban leh ïa ki kam bakyntang ha kano kano ka por .
U Balaam u jubab , Ngam la ïathuh ha kito ki nonglamktien ba phi la phah sha nga ,
translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me , saying ,
The gold and the crystal cannot equal it : and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold .
translation.kha: Ka kham kordor ban ïa ka ksiar , ban ïa u khiew ksiar lane ïa ka ïit babha tam .
Don ki briew kiba da jaipdeh wat ban tian jingbam ha la ki jong ki shyntur .
translation.en: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom , and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again .

translation.kha: U la ong ba un pyn-i jingisynei ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad kynmaw ïa ka jutang bakmen jong u .
translation.en: To perform the mercy promised to our fathers , and to remember his holy covenant  ;

translation.kha: Bad ki paidbhur ki la wan na ki shnong kiba sawdong ka Jerusalem , ki da wallam ïa iar Kiba phang lane uba don mynjur bymngeit hapoh jong ki ; bad la pynkhiah ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem , bringing sick folks , and them which were vexed with unclean spirits : and they were healed every one .
But ye that did cleave unto the  Lord  your God are alive every one of you this day .
translation.kha: hynrei kito na phi kiba ïaineh ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ki dang im haduh mynta .

Baroh ki hynmen ki prie jong u Job , kynthei bad shynrang , bad ki lap barim jong u , ki la wan jngoh ïa u bad ïabam sngewbha bun u ha ka ïing jongno u . Ki la pynpaw ïa ka jingsngewlem jong ki dara ki pynkieng ïa u namar ki jingjynjar baroh ba U Trai u la wallam halor jong u . Uwei pa aiwai na ki u la ai katto katne ka pisa bad ka sati ksiar .
translation.en: Then came there unto him all his brethren , and all his sisters , and all they that had been of his acquaintance before , and did eat bread with him in his house : and they bemoaned him , and comforted him over all the evil that the  Lord  had brought upon him : every man also gave him a piece of money , and every one an earring of gold .

translation.kha: la kum ba leh ïa u nongïalap wahbah trei snem . U kynrad jong u , um dei ban pyndem beiñ ïa u .
translation.en: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him : and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight .

translation.kha: u la ong ha ki , Nga la khuslai shaphang ka jingpyniwbih kaba nga la ïoh . Nga khah ban tip kaei ka jingmut jngai ka .
translation.en: And the king said unto them , I have dreamed a dream , and my spirit was troubled to know the dream .

translation.kha: Nangta lumlang ïa u paidbah baher hangta .
translation.en: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: To Duwai ha U Trai ! Ngi la shah la biang ïa une u pyrthat bad u phla ! Nga kular ban pyllait ïa phi ; phim donhok ban dang sah shuh hangtai .
translation.en: Entreat the  Lord  ( for it is enough ) that there be no more mighty thunderings and hail  ; and I will let you go , and ye shall stay no longer .

translation.kha: U Jisu te u la phah ïa u shwa ïing ryngkat bad ka lawlynnong , wai leit phai pat sha ka nongrit .
translation.en: And he sent him away to his house , saying ,  Neither go into the town , nor tell it to any in the town .
And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven , and will scatter them toward all those winds  ; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa ki lyer ban beh pyrshah ïa ka Elam na ki liang baroh , bad ngan pynsakma ïa ki briew jong ka kylleng , haduh ba yn ym don ki ri ha kiba ki nongphetwir na ka kim shym poi .
Ïathuh ha u Pharaoh ïa kiei kaei barieh kiba nga la ong ha me .
translation.en: That the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying , I am the  Lord  : speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ïa u syiem uba kum u shakuriaw jong nga u Dabid ba un long uwei u nongsharai jongno ki , bad un samla bha ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will set up one shepherd over them , and he shall feed them , even my servant David  ; he shall feed them , and he shall be their shepherd .

translation.kha: kumin phiah ïoh jingmyntoi na ka jingwan jong ki ?
translation.en: How can you benefit from their visits ?

translation.kha: bad u Petros u la kynmaw ïa kaei kaba U Josis u la lah ïathuh ha u : Shuwa ba u syiar un kynoi , men ïong lai sien ba ngam ithuh ïa at . U la Mihnoh bad u la ïakhmih .
translation.en: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus , which said unto him ,  Before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .  And he went out , and wept bitterly .

translation.kha: khawai kawei ka lyngkot jaiñ kan long khaw-eit mitar ka lynter sad ar mitar ka kynjoh . Baroh kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki dei ban long katne ka jingheh .
translation.en: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : and every one of the curtains shall have one measure .

translation.kha: U jingbabe ai hukum u la ino , Nga la long u traishnong da kaba siew Shibun ka pisa . Hynrei nga long traishnong naduh dang kha , u Paul u la jubab .
translation.en: And the chief captain answered , With a great sum obtained I this freedom . And Paul said , But I was free born .

translation.kha: Wad ïa u bania uba tbit ba un ohdur ha kita ki ar tylli ki mawkordor ïa ki kthang jong ki khun shynrang Jong u Jakob nabar pynïashong ïa ki ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar .
translation.en: With the work of an engraver in stone , like the engravings of a signet , shalt thou engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Israel : thou shalt make them to be set in ouches of gold .
And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , as his fathers had done : he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .
translation.kha: Ma u , kum kiba ha shuwa jong u , u leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai . U bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop .
Phim shym ïoh kpu ban bam , dara phim shym ïoh waiñ lane kyiad ban dih , hynrei U Trai u pyndih ïa ki jingdonkam Jong phi khñiang ba phin tip ba u long U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Ye have not eaten bread , neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink : that ye might know that I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada , kumba ngi pyrshang ban pynkhun ha U Blei da ka jingpynïasoh jong I bad U Khrist , yn shem ïa im ba im long ki nongpop kumba long hi ki Jentil — thah kane ka mut ba U Khrist u pynlong ka daw ïa ka pop ? Da law lei ruh em !
translation.en: But if , while we seek to be justified by Christ , we ourselves also are found sinners , is therefore Christ the minister of sin ? God forbid .
And of thy sons that shall issue from thee , which thou shalt beget , shall they take away  ; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: Katto katne na kiba hiarpateng na me hi kin shah ïalam noh bad kin long ki ïunukh ban shakri ha ka ïingsyiem jong u syiem ka Babilonia .
Hynrei U Khrist u la ainguh shisien kñia namar ki pop , ka jingainguh kaba dap ibiang junom , bad dadien u la shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .
translation.en: But this man , after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever , sat down on the right hand of God  ;
And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom , which is by the entry of the east gate , and proclaim there the words that I shall tell thee ,
translation.kha: bad ban leit lyngba ka Khyrdop Khra-pait shabar sha ka Them Hinnom . Hangta nga dei ban pynbna ïa ka khubor kaba un ai ha nga .
Habor phin ïohi ïa ki khuid Kiba sam ai ha phi! , te phin sa pdiang ba nga long U Blei bakylluid ki Israel . Phira sa burom ïa de bad phin ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa nga .
translation.en: But when he seeth his children , the work of mine hands , in the midst of him , they shall sanctify my name , and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob , and shall fear the God of Israel .
And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin , saying , What wickedness is this that is done among you ?
translation.kha: Ki jait Israel ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha baroh ka ri jong ka jait Benjamin , ban ong ,  Ka kam bymman aïu kane kaba phi la leh ?

translation.en: Behold , my servant shall deal prudently , he shall be exalted and extolled , and be very high .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  U shakri jong nga un jop ha ka kam jong u ; un ïoh ka burom bakhraw .

translation.en: I have manifested thy name unto the men which thou gavest me out of the world : thine they were , and thou gavest them me  ; and they have kept thy word .
translation.kha: Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha kito ïa kiba me la ai ha nga na ka pyrthei . Ki la long ki jong me , bad me la ai ïa ki ha nga .

translation.en: Then Tatnai , governor on this side the river , Shethar–bozenai , and their companions , according to that which Darius the king had sent , so they did speedily .
translation.kha: Nangta u Tattenai , u lat , u Shethar Bosenai bad ki paralok jong ki , ki la leh thik kumba u patsha u la hukum .

Ki synran ki la leit sha U Jehu bad ki la kyrsiew ïa u , da kaba ong , Kynrad , Kynrad ! Ngi la jan ïap ! U Jisu u la khie joit bad u la hukum ïa ka lyer bad ïa ka um ba khie erïong ; ki la sangeh bad ka la don ka jingjai jaijai kaba khraw .
translation.en: And they came to him , and awoke him , saying , Master , master , we perish . Then he arose , and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water : and they ceased , and there was a calm .

translation.kha: Ynda poi kata ka por , phin sa lynñiar kthang nabar u Shimiet jong phi , babha phi hi da lade phi la jied , hynriew U Trai un ym sngap ïa ki jingud jong phi .
translation.en: And ye shall cry out in that day because of your king which ye shall have chosen you  ; and the  Lord  will not hear you in that day .

translation.kha: Ka jingshem briew ka long koum ka jingshakri u Shipai ba shu pynbor , kum ka jingim u nongbylla sngaid naba hap ban trei shitom ,
translation.en: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth ? are not his days also like the days of an hireling ?

translation.kha: lymda ka thma ka khie , ki lah ban leit ïasoh bad ki nongshun jong ngi ïa-ban ïaleh pyrsad ïa ngi , bad Ban ïohphet noh na kane ka ri . To iing khim ïaleh sian ban ym shah ïa ki ba kin nang ïaroi shuh shuh .
translation.en: Come on , let us deal wisely with them  ; lest they multiply , and it come to pass , that , when there falleth out any war , they join also unto our enemies , and fight against us , and so get them up out of the land .

translation.kha: hyndai ma phi pat wat sah hangta . Ïai beh ïa ki nongshun jong phi! , bad tur ïakhleh ïa ki na shadien ; wat lap ba kin ïohrung sha la ki jong ki nongbah ! U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ka jingkup halor jong ki .
translation.en: And stay ye not , but pursue after your enemies , and smite the hindmost of them  ; suffer them not to enter into their cities : for the  Lord  your God hath delivered them into your hand .
And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake , hearing and seeing the miracles which he did .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la pynleit jingmut bha ïa kaei kaba u Philip u la ong , haba ki la shahshkor ïa u bad ïohi ïa ki kambah kiba u la leh .

translation.en: Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron , and said , Entreat the  Lord  , that he may take away the frogs from me , and from my people  ; and I will let the people go , that they may do sacrifice unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad ïa u Aaron , bad u ong ,  To kyrpad ïa U  Trai  ba un shim noh ïa kine ki jakoid , bad ngan sa pyllait ïa ki briew jong phi ba kin ïoh kñia ainguh ha U  Trai .

translation.en: For our exhortation was not of deceit , nor of uncleanness , nor in guile :
translation.kha: Ka jingkyrpad jong ngi ïa phi kam dei kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingbakla lane ha ki jingthmu bymkhuid , lymne ba ngi pyrshang ban shukor ïano ïano .

Sdang tyngkan khyndiat sngi mynshuwa phi la kylla jingmut bad phi la leh ïa kaei kaba pynkohnguh ïa nga . Baroh na phi , phi la ïamynjur ban pyllaitluid noh ïa la ki por Jerusalem , bad phi la pynlong ïa ka jutang ha ka jingdon shrong jong nga , ha ka Templ ha kaba la mane ïa nga .
translation.en: And ye were now turned , and had done right in my sight , in proclaiming liberty every man to his neighbour  ; and ye had made a covenant before me in the house which is called by my name :
I said , I will go up to the palm tree , I will take hold of the boughs thereof : now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine , and the smell of thy nose like apples  ;
translation.kha: Ai ba u syiem un don hynriewphew ngut ki mahadei , phraphew ngut ki tnga kliar , ki kynthei ba dang samla khlem ka jingkheiñ ïa ka jingdon jong ki !
to lehkmen ko ki lyngkha bad baroh keiñ kiei kiba don ha pha ! Ki dieng ha ki khlaw kin risa da ka jingkmen ,
translation.en: Let the field be joyful , and all that is therein : then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

translation.kha: Hato ki long ki shakri U Khrist ?(Nga kren kum uba lamwir) — hynriewphew la long u shakri uba kham palat ban ïa ki ! Nga la trei kham shitom palat , nga la don bunsien ha byndi , per la Shah sympat khnam bun , bad nga la jan sha ka jingïarap kham bunsien .
translation.en: Are they ministers of Christ ? (I speak as a fool) I am more ; in labours more abundant , in stripes above measure , in prisons more frequent , in deaths oft .
That the  Lord  appeared to Solomon the second time , as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u paw biang ha u kumba u la paw ha Gibeon .
Waw hadien ba ngi la poi ha Makedonia , ngim shym la ïoh shongshit . Ki la don ki jingjynjar ha kylleng sdang , ki jingïakajia bad kiwei pat , ki jingpyntieng ha ki dohnud jong ngi .
translation.en: For , when we were come into Macedonia , our flesh had no rest , but we were troubled on every side ; without were fightings , within were fears .

translation.kha: Kinah ki nongbah malu ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Dan ki la ïohpang kumin ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Dan according to their families , these cities with their villages .

translation.kha: Adonijah , ar snem ki la lytar , u Porsius Phestos u la shim ïa ka iaki jongngi u Pynkloi kum u lyngskor . U Pheliks u la khah ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong ki jlew , kumta u la iehnoh ïa u Paul ha ka byndi .
translation.en: But after two years Porcius Festus came into Felix  room : and Felix , willing to shew the Jews a pleasure , left Paul bound .
And Micaiah said , As the  Lord  liveth , what the  Lord  saith unto me , that will I speak .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Mikaïah u jubab ,  Katba im U  Trai  , nga kular ban ong ïa kaei kaba u ïathuh ïa nga !

translation.en: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun , and it is common among men :
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ba ha kane ka pyrthei la leh ïa ka jingbymlehhok kaba shyrkhei .

translation.en: And two olive trees by it , one upon the right side of the bowl , and the other upon the left side thereof .
translation.kha: Don ar tylli ki dieng Olib hajan u diengpynïeng sharak , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang jong u .

translation.en: Thou shalt make no covenant with them , nor with their gods .
translation.kha: Wat ïateh kano kano ka jutang bad ki lane bad ki blei jong ki .
Na u Paul , u apostol U Khrist Jehu da ka mon U Blei , ha uba la phah pynbna ïa ka jingim ba la pynkulmar kaba ngi don ha U Khrist Jisu —
translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus ,

translation.kha: To wat ieit ïa ka pyrthei , liam ïa kaei kaei kaba dei jngai ka pyrthei . Lymda phi imat ïa ka pyrthei , Kata ka long ba phim ieit ïa U KA .
translation.en: Love not the world , neither the things that are in the world . If any man love the world , the love of the Father is not in him .
Bread corn is bruised  ; because he will not ever be threshing it , nor break it with the wheel of his cart , nor bruise it with his horsemen .
translation.kha: Um pynsniew noh ïa u kew da kaba peh palat ïa u , bad u tip kumno ban ïuh ïa u da kaba pynïaid ïa ka kali dieng halor jong u khlem pynkhlur noh ïa ki symbai .
Ym don uno uno uba kum U Trei U Bel Jong ngi . U shong ha kiba kynjang shajrong ,
translation.en: Who is like unto the  Lord  our God , who dwelleth on high ,

translation.kha: Ban long u paralok jrong U Blei , phi dei ban tip bha shaphang ka jingjyrsieh jong ka Baibl ( 1 thymmei 2 :3 , 4 ) , ieit ïa ki kai kiba pa’ la tip ( Hebru 11 :6 ) , kylla ka dambit na ki pop jong phi ( Kam 17 :33 , 31 ) , bad pynkylla noh ïa la ka rukom im .
translation.en: To become a friend of God , you must obtain a good knowledge of Bible truth ( 1 Timothy 2 :3 , 4 ) , put faith in the things you have learned ( Hebrews 11 :6 ) , repent of your sins ( Acts 17 :30 , 31 ) , and turn around in your course of life .

translation.kha: Kumba ka den ba-bang long , ko ki parabangeit jong ang , ngim shym lah ban kren ha phi kumba per kren ha ki briew kiba don U Mynsiem ; nga hap ban kren ha phi la kumba phi dat ki jongki ken ka pyrthei , kum kiba dang khynnah ha ka jingngeit Khristan .
translation.en: And I , brethren , could not speak unto you as unto spiritual , but as unto carnal , even as unto babes in Christ .
And if he smite out his manservant s tooth , or his maidservant s tooth  ; he shall let him go free for his tooth s sake .
translation.kha: Lada u lop ïa ka bniat jong u mraw , shynrang ne kynthei , u dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uta u mraw kum ka jingsiew namar kata ka bniat .

translation.en: So the young man , even the young man the prophet , went to Ramoth–gilead .
translation.kha: Kumta u nongïathuhlypa samla u leit sha Ramoth ,
Ki Jisu ki ei ki daiñ shaphang ka jinglehmeng haba set pynkhuid , bad na ka pyntwa kane ka jinglum la to hynriew tylli ki mraw buh um , uwei uwei u ngiam kumba shispah litar ka um .
translation.en: And there were set there six waterpots of stone , after the manner of the purifying of the Jews , containing two or three firkins apiece .
But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us , for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans , that they might put us to death , and carry us away captives into Babylon .
translation.kha: U Barukh u khun jong u Neraïah u la pynkhih ïa phi pyrshah ïa ngi , kumta ki nong Babilonia kin ïa-ïohbor halor jong ngi bad ki lah ban pynïap ïa ngi ne ïalam noh ïa ngi sha Babilonia .

Ha ka sngi Sabbaton u la sdang ban hikai ha ka synagog . Bah ki briew’ ki la dat hangta ; bad haba ki la iohnong ïa u , baroh ki la sngewlyngngoh . nangno u la ïoh ïa kane baroh ? ki la kylla . Ka jingstet eiei kane ba la ai ha u ? kumne u leh ïa ki khap ?
