translation.en: And when the sabbath day was come , he began to teach in the synagogue : and many hearing him were astonished , saying , From whence hath this man these things ? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him , that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands ?

translation.kha: Em , U Trai u la ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba bha . Kaei kaba u dawa na ngi ka long kane : Ban leh ïa kaei kaba hok , ban pyn-i ïa ka jingieit baneh , bad ban im ha ka jingpynïasoh basngewrit bad U Blei jong I .
translation.en: He hath shewed thee , O man , what is good  ; and what doth the  Lord  require of thee , but to do justly , and to love mercy , and to walk humbly with thy God ?

translation.kha: Hynrei u Joshua u la pyllait im ïa ka Rekhab ka nuti bad ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ka baroh , namar ba ka la pynrieh ïa ki ar ngut ki nongsyntiat kiba u la phah sha Jerikho . ( Ki khwan ki ksiew jong ka ki shong ki sah ha Israel haduh kane ka sneng . )
translation.en: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive , and her father s household , and all that she had  ; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day  ; because she hid the messengers , which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho .

translation.kha: ha ka rta kaba synreit san snem , bad u synshar khihwin snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Jerusha ka Kynhun jong u Sorek .
translation.en: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign , and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Jerusha , the daughter of Zadok .
And it was told Joshua , saying , The five kings are found hid in a cave at Makkedah .
translation.kha: Don kiba lap ïa ki , bad la ïathuh ha u Joshua ha-ei ba ki ïarieh .

Hynrei ngim kwah ban pynmong ïa kine ki briew . Kumta khiar leit sha ka pung bad bret ïa u khwai . Shim ïa ka dohkha ba la ngat nyngkong , bad hapoh ka jingairam jong ka men shem ïa ka pisa kaba shongdor biang na ka bna ka khiah Templ ïa nga bad ïa me . To shim ïa ka bun siew ïa ki khyndai jongu ngi .
translation.en: Notwithstanding , lest we should offend them , go thou to the sea , and cast an hook , and take up the fish that first cometh up  ; and when thou hast opened his mouth , thou shalt find a piece of money : that take , and give unto them for me and thee .
And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone , thou shalt not build it of hewn stone : for if thou lift up thy tool upon it , thou hast polluted it .
translation.kha: Lada phi tei ïa nga ka duwan kaba da u maw , wat tei ïa ka da ki maw ba la shniah , namar lada phi pyndei nar ha kita ki maw , kim long kiba bit ba ngan pyndonkam .

translation.en: And Heshbon shall cry , and Elealeh : their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz : therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out  ; his life shall be grievous unto him .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Heshbon bad ka Elealeh ki kyang jam , bad ïa ka jingkyang jong ki lah ban ïohsngew kat shaduh Jahas . Wat ki shipai ki khynñiuh ; ka jingshlur jong ki ka duh noh .
Haduh u shait u khlaiñ ? u kyrmen biang . U shait u khlaiñ , ki jubab . Khmih , hangne ka Rakhe ka khun jong u ka wiang Lem bad ki kynhun langbrot jong u .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Is he well ? And they said , He is well : and , behold , Rachel his daughter cometh with the sheep .
And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you , and a perpetual shame , which shall not be forgotten .
translation.kha: Ngan sa wanrah ha ki ïa ka jinglehrain bad ka jingjahburom junom ïa kaba yn ym klet shuh .

Ka kynhun shipai jingïap , lem nabar ki kulai baroh , ki kila ïapom , bad ki nongñiah , ki la beh kthong ïa ki bad ki la lap ïa ki ha ka jaka ha kaba ki la sher dara harud ka Duriaw Basaw , hajan ka Pi Hahiroth malade ka Baal Sephon .
translation.en: But the Egyptians pursued after them , all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh , and his horsemen , and his army , and overtook them encamping by the sea , beside Pi–hahiroth , before Baal–zephon .
And he that reapeth receiveth wages , and gathereth fruit unto life eternal : that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together .
translation.kha: Uta uba ot u ïoh la ka bainong bad u lum ïa ka jingmih na ka bynta ka jingim bymjukut ; ba uta uba bet bad uta uba ot kin ïakmen lang .

Ynda phi la dep lum ïa ki jingmih na ki lyngkha jong phira , rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam hynñiew sngi naduh ka sngaid kaba khatsan Jong u bnai uba hynñiew . Ka sngi nongdih ka dei ka sngem shongthait , bad kumjuh ruh ka snoh kaba phra .
translation.en: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month , when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land , ye shall keep a feast unto the  Lord  seven days : on the first day shall be a sabbath , and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath .
My son , if thou wilt receive my words , and hide my commandments with thee  ;
translation.kha: Ko khun , to sngewthuh ïa kaei ba nga hikai ïa phi , bad wat klet ïa kaei kaba nga ïathuh ïa phi ban leh .

translation.en: Remember ye not the former things , neither consider the things of old .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ,  Wat snoh ha ki jingjia jong ka mynnor ne shongsah ha kaei kaba la jia slem mynshuwa .
U Amon u la don arphew ar sngem ka rta mynba u la long u syiem ka Judah bad u la synshar ar snem ha Jerusha .
translation.en: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned two years in Jerusalem .
Put ye in the sickle , for the harvest is ripe : come , get you down  ; for the press is full , the fats overflow  ; for their wickedness is great .
translation.kha: Ki long kiba bymman haduh katta katta ; ot ïa ki kum ïa u kew ha ka aïom ot ; pynlwet ïa ki kum ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ka jaka pynmih umsoh haduh ba ka umsoh ka shlei .

translation.en: What will be the answer ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka ban dei ka Jubab ?
U Blei u la ai ïa ka hukum lyngngai u Moses , hynrei ka jingaiei bad ka jingshisha ki la wanpaw lyngba U Jisu Khrist .
translation.en: For the law was given by Moses , but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: U Tlai u la ai ha at ïa ka jingshemphang , bad nga shym la ïaleh pynshah litar phai noh na u .
translation.en: The Lord  God  hath opened mine ear , and I was not rebellious , neither turned away back .

translation.kha: Ka biang ! u Dabid u la jubab . Dang ïasaid sha khmat ! Kumta u Ittai u la ïaid shata khmat bad la ki rangbah jong u Lem bad ki ba-ha-ïing ïa-im jong ki baroh .
translation.en: And David said to Ittai , Go and pass over . And Ittai the Gittite passed over , and all his men , and all the little ones that were with him .
Not now as a servant , but above a servant , a brother beloved , specially to me , but how much more unto thee , both in the flesh , and in the Lord ?
translation.kha: Bad mynta um long shuh tang kum u mraw , hynrei kham palat ban ïa u mraw : u long u para ba-ieit ha U Khrist . Katno u long uba kordor ïa nga ! Bad katno khraw un long uba kordor ïa me , kum u mraw bad kum u para ha u Trai !
U Trai u la Hukum ïa u Mosah bad u Aaron
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,

translation.kha: Nga la kren kum u bieit , ko Trai . Aïu sam jubab ? Ngan ym pyrshang ban ong ei ei shu .
translation.en: Behold , I am vile  ; what shall I answer thee ? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth .

translation.kha: U syiem ka babniah u la pynkut ïa ka Jerusalem bad bam ïa ka . U pynthylli ïa ka nongbah Kum ïa u khra ; kum u mrad kynsai u la nguh ïa ka . U la shim kat ïa kaba u kwah bun bret noh ïa kiba sah .
translation.en: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me , he hath crushed me , he hath made me an empty vessel , he hath swallowed me up like a dragon , he hath filled his belly with my delicates , he hath cast me out .
Who hate the good , and love the evil  ; who pluck off their skin from off them , and their flesh from off their bones  ;
translation.kha: pynban phi isih ïa kaei kaba bha bad phi ieit ïa kaei kaba sniew . Phi khoh snieh im ïa ki briew jong nga bad phi tar ïa ka doh na ki shyieng jong ki .
Bad Kumta ngan wan shata Phin da ka jingkren kambah dap , “lada ka long ka mon jong U Blei , bad ngan dap da ka jingnoh ba pynpyngngad haba ngan wan khmih ïa phiah .
translation.en: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God , and may with you be refreshed .

translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U Trai U Blei jong phi ! U la pynpaw kaban katno u sngewngiah ïa phi da kaba pynphong ïa phi! u syiem u ngab synran ha ka kyrteng jong u . Namar ba u ieit ïa ki briew jongno u , ki Israel , mala u kwah ban pynrieh ïa ki jrong , u la pynlong ïa phi! u syiem jong ki haneng ban pynneh ïa ka hukum bad ka jingbishar khot .
translation.en: Blessed be the  Lord  thy God , which delighted in thee to set thee on his throne , to be king for the  Lord  thy God : because thy God loved Israel , to establish them for ever , therefore made he thee king over them , to do judgment and justice .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jeshua u shu sngap . Sa shisien pat u Rangbah lyngdoh u la klun ha u , Ha ka kyrteng jong U Blei uba im , mynta nga nguh ïa me ha ka jingsmai : Ïathuh ïa ngi lapbah me dei u Messaïah , U u U Bel .
translation.en: But Jesus held his peace . And the high priest answered and said unto him , I adjure thee by the living God , that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ , the Son of God .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kob kut jong Kita ki sawspah laiphew snem , baroh ki paid U Trai ki mih na Ijipt .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years , even the selfsame day it came to pass , that all the hosts of the  Lord  went out from the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Nalor kine baïar , ko parabangeit jong nga , wat pyndonkam da ka jingshem haba phi pynlong ka jingkular . Wat symbai da ka bneng ne da ka khyndew ne da kaei kaei pat . Shu ong Ho-oid hajuh phi mut ho-oid , bad Em haba phi mut em , bad phin ym hap hapoh ka jingbishar U Blei .
translation.en: But above all things , my brethren , swear not , neither by heaven , neither by the earth , neither by any other oath : but let your yea be yea  ; and your nay , nay  ; lest ye fall into condemnation .
I have confidence in you through the Lord , that ye will be none otherwise minded : but he that troubleth you shall bear his judgment , whosoever he be .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga dang sngew shaniah ïa phi . Ka jingim jong ngi ha U Trai , ka pynlong ïa nga ban sngewskhem ba phin ym shim da kumwei pat bad uta u briew uba pynkulmar ïa phi , la u long uei uei , un shah pynshitom ha U Blei .
Man ba phi leit sha ka Ïing Hima , pyrshang ban ithuh ïa iwei na ki rangbah balang ne nongïarap balang haduh ba phin da thah lut ïa ki bad ïa ka ïohnang ka sem jong ki .
translation.en: Each time you go to the Kingdom Hall , become acquainted with one of the elders or ministerial servants until you get to know all of them and their families .
And they turned aside thither , to go in and to lodge in Gibeah : and when he went in , he sat him down in a street of the city : for there was no man that took them into his house to lodging .
translation.kha: Ki phai noh na ka lynti bah ban leit sahmiet hangta . Ki rung shapoh ka nongbah bad ki shong ha madan shnong , hynrei ym don ba khot basa ïa ki ha kata ka miet .
Nangta ki briew ki mih shabar ba trei ïa ki kam jong ki bad ki twa hajuh iada la janmiet .
translation.en: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening .
Also they reported his good deeds before me , and uttered my words to him . And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïakren ha khmat jong nga shaphang baroh ki kam babha kiba u Tobiah u la leh bad ki ïathuh ha u ïa kiei kiei baroh ba nga la kren . Bad u ïai phah ïa nga ki shithi ban pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa nga .

U Trai nongshoh-nar u la pyndap ïa nga da U Mynsiem lad u . U la jied ïa nga bad phah ïa nga ban Wanlam ïa ka khubor bakha sha kiba duk , ban pynkhiah ïa kiba la pait dohnud , ban pynbna ka jingpyllait ïa ki saraw bad ka jinglaitluid ïa kito kiba ha ka byndi .
translation.en: The Spirit of the Lord  God  is upon me  ; because the  Lord  hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek  ; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted , to proclaim liberty to the captives , and the opening of the prison to them that are bound  ;
And he said ,  The things which are impossible with men are possible with God .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei ka bym lah ha u briew ka long kaba lah ha U Blei .

translation.en: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the  Lord  your God ,
translation.kha: Pynban haba nga la kren haduh katta ruh , phim shym shaniah ha U  Trai  ,
Ha ki bariew jong U blang ha Kolossai katba long ki parabangeit bashaniah ha U Khrist : Ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi un ai ha Phi ka jingaiei dara ka jingsuk .
translation.en: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse : Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Ïa ki bleithaw jong ki la sop da ka rupa na Spain mala da ka ksiar na Uphas baroh ki jingtrei jongno ki nongtrei ; la pynbang jaiñ-da ïa ki ha ki jaiñ ïongjngum bad sawbthuh ba la thain da ki nongñiah jaiñ batbit .
translation.en: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish , and gold from Uphaz , the work of the workman , and of the hands of the founder : blue and purple is their clothing : they are all the work of cunning men .

translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa u nonglamktien jong u , u briew babha kyrteng u Ïoannis , uba la wan ban ïathuh ïa ki bariew shaphang ka jingshai , ba barabor ki dei ban shahshkor ïa ka khubor bad don ngeit .
translation.en: The same came for a witness , to bear witness of the Light , that all men through him might believe .

translation.kha: Nga Kyrpad ïa ph , ki parabangeit jong nga , ba phin un-long kum ma nga . La shisha , nga long hi kum ma phi . Phim shym la leh sniew ei ei ïa nga .
translation.en: Brethren , I beseech you , be as I am ; for I am as ye are : ye have not injured me at all .

translation.kha: Ka jer jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ka la jan , kumta ki para shynrang jyllang U Jisu ki la noh ïa u , To mihnoh na Kane ka dik bad leit Sha Judia , ba ki nongbud jong me kin ïohi ïa kiwei kiei kiba me kuna .
translation.en: His brethren therefore said unto him , Depart hence , and go into Judaea , that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest .
Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks ? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich ?
translation.kha: Haduh katno ki thapniang jong ka Ostrit ki kaweh stet ! Hynrei ym don kano kano ka Ostrit kaba lah ban her kum ka thring .
Ym don u ba mynjur ïa Katai ka jingong jong phi ! Baroh daiñ baneh ïasam kumjuh : uta umbiah sah shad nabar ki jingkit jinghap un ïoh bynta mar katjuh kum uta uba leit sha ka thma .
translation.en: For who will hearken unto you in this matter ? but as his part is that goeth down to the battle , so shall his part be that tarrieth by the stuff : they shall part alike .

translation.kha: U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la poi sha shiliang ka duriaw Galilaïa , ha ka ri Gerasa .
translation.en: And they came over unto the other side of the sea , into the country of the Gadarenes .

translation.kha: U pham ïa ka leilieh kylleng ka suiñbneng hynrei ki jingjylliew jong ka duriaw ka ïailong kaba dum .
translation.en: Behold , he spreadeth his light upon it , and covereth the bottom of the sea .
Woe unto you , lawyers ! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge : ye entered not in yourselves , and them that were entering in ye hindered .
translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum ! Phi la bat noh ïa u shabi uba plie ïa ka khyrdop sha ka ïing jong ka jingtip ; phi hi phim leit rung shapoh , bad phi khang ïa kito kiba pyrshang ban rung shapoh !

translation.en: Then they took all the men , and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit nadien jong u ryngkat bad ki briew jong ki bad lap ïa u hajan ka pung kaba heh ha Gibeon .
Wat ailad ïa u Soitan .
translation.en: Neither give place to the devil .

translation.kha: Phim ïaryngkat ni wat tong bad wahbah don ha kyrdoh ba hapoh eh jong ki rangbah synsar jongki ki Assyria , bad pynban phi khmih lynti ba ki nong Ijipt ngin phah kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai !
translation.en: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master s servants , and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?

translation.kha: Ai ïa kine ki jingbthah ha u paid Israel baroh : ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong a u bnai , uwei pa uwei u rangbah un jied ïa u Langbrot lane ïa u khongpong na ka bynda la ka jongno ka ïing .
translation.en: Speak ye unto all the congregation of Israel , saying , In the tenth day of this month they shall take to them every man a lamb , according to the house of their fathers , a lamb for an house :

translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ka ban saitlah ïa U Blei da ki ktien lamler jrong u .
translation.en: By telling her lies , he got her to disobey God .
But the olive tree said unto them , Should I leave my fatness , wherewith by me they honour God and man , and go to be promoted over the trees ?
translation.kha: U dieng Olib u jubab , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa phi , ngan hap sangeh ban pynmih umphniang , ïa kaba la pyndonkam ban pyndonburom ïa ki blei jong ngi bad ïa ki khunbynriew .’
U parabangeit uba duk u dei ban kmen haba U Blei u kyntiew ïa u , bad u parabangeit uba riewspah u dei pun kum haba U Blei u pynhiar ïa u .
translation.en: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted :

translation.kha: Hynrei wat kmen namsop ba ki mynhynnin pyrman ki kohnguh ïa phi ; pynban , to kmen namar ba ïa ki kyrngah jong phi la thoh ha bneng .
translation.en: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not , that the spirits are subject unto you  ; but rather rejoice , because your names are written in heaven .

translation.kha: Heth me la dep ka jingkren jong me kaba kum ka lyer ?
translation.en: How long wilt thou speak these things ? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind ?
If a man be found stealing any of his brethren of the children of Israel , and maketh merchandise of him , or selleth him  ; then that thief shall die  ; and thou shalt put evil away from among you .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba rong jubor ïa la u para Israel bad u pynlong mraw lane die mraw ïa u , u dei ban shah pynïap . Da kumta phin pynduh noh ïa kane ka jingbymman napdeng jong phi .
‘ Sin na kane ka daw , u brup un iehnoh ïa la u kpa bad ka kmie malade ïaineh bad la ka rnga ,
translation.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother , and cleave to his wife  ;
Withhold thy foot from being unshod , and thy throat from thirst : but thou saidst , There is no hope : no  ; for I have loved strangers , and after them will I go .
translation.kha: Ko Israel wat pynlwait ïa ki kjat jong me , lane shah ïa u pdot jong me ban tyrkhong na kaba beh ïa kiwei pat ki blei . Hynrei me ong , ‘ Em ! Ngam lah ban phai dien . Nga la ieit ïa ki blei nongwei bad ngan leit hadien jong ki .’
‘Kaba sah jong ka histori u Abijah , Kiei naba u ong bad kaei kaba u leh , la thoh ha Ka Histori jongno u Iddo u Nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Abijah , and his ways , and his sayings , are written in the story of the prophet Iddo .

translation.kha: Nangta ki paidbah ki leit sha ka templ u Baal bad ki pynkyllon ïa ka ; ki pynpra ïa ki duwan bad ïa ki lynthaw , bad ki pynpyut ïa u Mattan , u lyngdoh jongno u Baal , ha khmied ki duwan . U Jehoïada u buh ïa ki nongap phira kiba dei trei ha ka Templ ,
translation.en: And all the people of the land went into the house of Baal , and brake it down  ; his altars and his images brake they in pieces thoroughly , and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars . And the priest appointed officers over the house of the  Lord .
And great fear came upon all the church , and upon as many as heard these things .
translation.kha: Ka balang baroh kawei bad baroh kiwei pat kiba la ïohsngew ïa kane ki la sngewshyrkhei .

U Trai u ino , Pynsawa ïa ka jingmaham ! Ki nongshun ki hiar kynsan shapoh ha ka ri jong nga kum ki pukni ! Ki briew jrong nga ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka million kaba nga la ïateh bad ki , bad ki la ïaleh pyrsad ïa ka jingaiei jong nga .
translation.en: Set the trumpet to thy mouth . He shall come as an eagle against the house of the  Lord  , because they have transgressed my covenant , and trespassed against my law .

translation.kha: U la shong hangtai nabar u la pynshahthngan ïa ki ktien jongki u Paul . U Paul u la ïohi ba u la kjit bun ba u lah ban ïohkhiah , kumta u la khmih shlip sha u bad u la ong ha ka sur kaba jam ,
translation.en: The same heard Paul speak : who stedfastly beholding him , and perceiving that he had faith to be healed ,
And they straightway left their nets , and followed him .
translation.kha: Shisyndon ki la iehnoh ïa la ki jar bad ki la ïaleit bad u .

translation.en: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage , and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time : and ye shall eat your bread to the full , and dwell in your land safely .
translation.kha: Ki jingmih kin long kiba bun katta katta ba phin dang ot hi ïa u kew wat haba ka la dei ka por kheit sohwaiñ , bad phin dang kheit hi ïa kita ki soh wat haba ka la dei ka por bet kew . Phin ïoh bam kat kaba phi kwah , bad phin ïoh im suk im saiñ ha la ka ri .
Ki la beh noh bun ki ksuid , bad ki la tah umphniang Olib ha kiba bun ki briew kiba pang mala ki la pynkhiah ïa ki .
translation.en: And they cast out many devils , and anointed with oil many that were sick , and healed them .
And there came out of the smoke locusts upon the earth : and unto them was given power , as the scorpions of the earth have power .
translation.kha: Ki puit ki la mih na kata ka tdem sha ka khyndew , bad la ai ha ki ïa kajuh ka bor kaba ki  ñianglartham ki don .

Kumta u Petros u la ong ha ka , Balei ba ma pha bad u tnga jong pha , Phin khun jingmut ban tyngkong ïa U Mynsiem jong U Trai ? Ki samla kiba la ter ïa u thngan jong pha ki la don myntan ha ka jingkhang , bun Kin bah noh ïa pha ruh shaba !
translation.en: Then Peter said unto her , How is it that ye have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord ? behold , the feet of them which have buried thy husband are at the door , and shall carry thee out .

translation.kha: hynrei u sngewbha ha kito uba pyndonburom ïa u , ha kito kiba shaniah ha ka jingieit baneh jong u .
translation.en: The  Lord  taketh pleasure in them that fear him , in those that hope in his mercy .
But Saul increased the more in strength , and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus , proving that this is very Christ .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingïalap jong u Saul ka la nang kham khrawbor , bad ki jingpynshisha jong u ba U Jisu u long U Messaïah ki long kiba skhem ba ki Jiw kiba shong basah ha Damaskos kim lah ban jubab ïa u .

Ahian ba u syiem Josaïah u la leh ïa Kanneh baroh na ka boitha ka Templ , u Neko u sahmiet ka Ijipt u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai ban ïaleh ïa-pyrshah ha Karkhemish ha ka wah Ïuphratis . U Josaïah u la pyrkhing ban pynsangeh ïa u , hynrei u Neko u phah sha u Josaïah ïa kan ka khubor :
translation.en: After all this , when Josiah had prepared the temple , Neco king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates : and Josiah went out against him .

translation.kha: Nga la ïapom khah ba ka ïathmu jong nga ka la sawjngum , bad ki khmat jongno nga ki la sieb bad la paw syrngiew sawdong jong ki ,
translation.en: My face is foul with weeping , and on my eyelids is the shadow of death  ;

translation.kha: U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha at ïa kaei khie baroh . Ym don mano mano ba ithuh ïa U Khun lait tang U Kpa , bad ym don mano me ba ithuh ïa U Kpa lehse tang U Khun badno kito ha kiba U Khun u jied ban pynpoh ïa u .
translation.en: All things are delivered unto me of my Father : and no man knoweth the Son , but the Father  ; neither knoweth any man the Father , save the Son , and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him .

translation.kha: lane ngam shym la leit sha Jerusalem ban ïakynduh ïa kito kiba long ki apostol shuwa jong nga . Pynban syndon nga la leit sha Arabia , nangta nga la wan phalang patan sha badonkam .
translation.en: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me ; but I went into Arabia , and returned again unto Damascus .
Glory ye in his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the  Lord .
translation.kha: To kmen ba ngi long ki jong u ; ai ba baroh kiba mane ïa u kin shadkmen .
Hynrei U Blei u la ong ha u , ‘ A me umbah bieit ! Ha kane hi ka miet men tap ban iehnoh ïa la ka jingim ; te moi ban ïoh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh kiba me la buh na ka bynta ïa lade ?’
translation.en: But God said unto him , Thou fool , this night thy soul shall be required of thee : then whose shall those things be , which thou hast provided ?

translation.kha: Ka la da shiteng syntiew haba ka jingpyrta ka la sawa jam , ‘ U nongleitkurim u la don hangne ! To wan bad ïashah ïa u !’
translation.en: And at midnight there was a cry made , Behold , the bridegroom cometh  ; go ye out to meet him .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah balang ki pyni ïa im na ka Baibl bad ki ïarap ïa ka balang ban kham jan sha U Blei .
translation.en: The elders guide and help to protect the congregation spiritually .

translation.kha: Ki met jong ngi kin kylla shiah u kjit pui khynwin , bad ka jingpyrsad ka jingim kan leit phai pat sha U blem , uba la ai ïa ka ha sem .
translation.en: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was : and the spirit shall return unto God who gave it .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , mynsiem nga kylli ba balui phi leh kum kata ka kam kaba snier ïa lade . Hattush phi kwah ban wallam ïa ka jingpynjot ha ki rangbah bad ki kynthei , ki khynnah mala ki khunlung , kthang ba yn ym don na ki briew jong phi ban dang sah ?
translation.en: Therefore now thus saith the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Wherefore commit ye this great evil against your souls , to cut off from you man and woman , child and suckling , out of Judah , to leave you none to remain  ;
I will praise thee with uprightness of heart , when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments .
translation.kha: Kumba nga la ïoh jinghikai ïa ki jingbishar bahok jong me , ngan ïaroh ïa me da ka dohnud kaba sngur .
Ai ba kin wan ïalam shane ïa u kpa jong phi ryngkat bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki . ngam ai ïa ki ka jaka kaba bha tam ha ibieit , bad kin ïoh palat ïa kob ki donkam .
translation.en: And take your father and your households , and come unto me : and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt , and ye shall eat the fat of the land .

translation.kha: Me lama U Blei jong ngi ! Pynshitom ïa ki , naba ngim lah leh ei ei ruh em ha khmat jongu kane ka kynhun shipai babun paidbah kaba tur ïaleh ïa I . Ngim tip kumno ngin leh , hynrei ngi phai sha me na ka bynta ka jingïarap .
translation.en: O our God , wilt thou not judge them ? for we have no might against this great company that cometh against us  ; neither know we what to do : but our eyes are upon thee .
When he had heard therefore that he was sick , he abode two days still in the same place where he was .
translation.kha: Pynban haba u la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor ba u Lasaros u la pang , U la nang sah sa ar sngi ha ka jaka kaba U la don .
Ai ba ki nongriam jong phi kin ithuh sha Kaisaria lem mala nga bad mudui ïa uta u briew lada u leh ïa kano Kanaan ka bymdei .
translation.en: Let them therefore , said he , which among you are able , go down with me , and accuse this man , if there be any wickedness in him .
But ye know the proof of him , that , as a son with the father , he hath served with me in the gospel .
translation.kha: Bad phi hi phi tip , kumno u la pynshisha ïa ka jingkordor jong u , kumno ma u bad ma nga , kum u khun bad u kpa jong u , ngi la ïatreilang na ka bynta ka gospel .
Nga la shahshkor bha bad shem ba phi la bakla ; phim shym lah ban pynduh nia ïa kaei kaba u Job u la ong .
translation.en: Yea , I attended unto you , and , behold , there was none of you that convinced Job , or that answered his words :

translation.kha: ( Ha kata ka por u Eli u la ba-dap hynñiewphew phra snem badno u la ju matlah ) .
translation.en: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old  ; and his eyes were dim , that he could not see .

translation.kha: Suk ma phi kiba thngan myntoi ; yn pyndep ïa phi ! Suk ma phi kiba ïam mynta ; phin rkhie !
translation.en: Blessed are ye that hunger now : for ye shall be filled . Blessed are ye that weep now : for ye shall laugh .
And he rode upon a cherub , and did fly : and he was seen upon the wings of the wind .
translation.kha: U her stet halor ki Kherub u ïaid halor ki thapniang jong ka lyer .
U la ïathuh ha u kumno ba u Saul u la pynïap ïa ki lyngdoh jong U Trai’ .
translation.en: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the  Lord s  priests .

translation.kha: Hynrei katto katne nongput na ki , ki la leit sha ki Pharisi bad ki la ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh .
translation.en: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees , and told them what things Jesus had done .

And I will turn thee back , and put hooks into thy jaws , and I will bring thee forth , and all thine army , horses and horsemen , all of them clothed with all sorts of armour , even a great company with bucklers and shields , all of them handling swords :
translation.kha: Ngan pynphai sawdong ïa u , ngan buh ki khwai ha ki tyngam jong u bad ngan patan noh ïa u bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u baroh . Ka kynhun shipai jong u ka long kaba khraw , lem bad ki kulai bad ki nongshong kulai kiba riam ryntih , bad man la u shipai uba rah ka stieh bad kieng ka waitlam .

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  I have told you that I am he : if therefore ye seek me , let these go their way :
translation.kha: Nga la lah ïathuh ha phi ba dei ma nga uta ,  U Jisu u la ong .  Te , lada phi ïawad ïa nga , shah ba kine kiwei kin leit noh .
Ha khmat jong ka Ïingjaiñ , u syiem u la maïan ïa U Trai da kaba ai ki jingïania ha ka duwan rnong ; u la Phah pynïap shihajar tylli ki jingri bad thang tylli ba-halor jong ka .
translation.en: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before the  Lord  , which was at the tabernacle of the congregation , and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it .
As for us , our eyes as yet failed for our vain help : in our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us .
translation.kha: Ngi la khmih tad haduh ba ngim lah shuh ban khmih ïa ka jingïarap ka bym ju wan . Ngi la ïai ap ïa ka jingïarap na ka hima ka bym don ei ei ban ai .

Kiba duk bad ki bym don jingïarap ki phet sha me bad ki shongshngain ha ki por ka jingjynjar . Me ai jakarieh ïa ki na ki erïong bad ka jakarieh tngen na ka jingshit kyr-ang . Ki riewrunar ki tur ïaleh kum ka erïong nongleh ,
translation.en: For thou hast been a strength to the poor , a strength to the needy in his distress , a refuge from the storm , a shadow from the heat , when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall .
And I will give unto thee the keys of the kingdom of heaven : and whatsoever thou shalt bind on earth shall be bound in heaven : and whatsoever thou shalt loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ïa ki shabi jong ka Hima ki bneng , kaei kaba me khang ha ka pyrthei yn khang ïa ka ha bneng , bad kaei kaba me shah ha ka pyrthei yn shah ïa ka ha bneng .
Hynrei waiñ ha kane ka kynti ruh , u Pharoah u la kylla longsyiem mutlop , bad um Shim shah ïa u paidbah ban leit .
translation.en: And Pharaoh hardened his heart at this time also , neither would he let the people go .
And when David heard of it , he sent Joab , and all the host of the mighty men .
translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u phah ïa u Joab ryngkat bad ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei .
Ha kaei ka suri , baroh ar ngut ngi la phohsniew mar la ka jingpyniwbih kaba don la ka jong ka jong ka jingmut .
translation.en: And we dreamed a dream in one night , I and he  ; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream .

translation.kha: sad Tirsah — bhor ki long shiphew wei lwet ki shym .
translation.en: The king of Tirzah , one : all the kings thirty and one .
For he is cast into a net by his own feet , and he walketh upon a snare .
translation.kha: U ïaid sha ka jar , bad ki kjat jong u ki ngat hangta ;
Na mihngi sha sepngi , baroh kiba ïohsngew ïa ka kupar jong u ki suhjer ka met bad ki khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: They that come after him shall be astonished at his day , as they that went before were affrighted .
That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again .
translation.kha: khnang ba haba nga don pat bad phi , phin don wat kham bun ka daw ban sngewsarong ïa nga ha ka jingim jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: When Jesus saw their faith , he said unto the sick of the palsy ,  Son , thy sins be forgiven thee .
translation.kha: Haba U la ïohi haduh katno ba ki don ka jingngeit , U Jisu u ong ha uta uba pang ïapshiliang ,  Ko khun jong nga , ïa ki pop jong me la map .

translation.en: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you : and , lo , I am with you alway , even unto the end of the world . Amen .
translation.kha: bad hikai ïa ki ban kohnguh ha kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la hukum ïa phi . Bad ngan ïai don ryngkat lem bad phi , haduh kaba kut ka Ïa .
( Hynrei u Dabid u la ïohknieh ïa ka kut Seïon jong ki , Bad la kop kyrtong ïa ka kum ka nongbet u Dabid . )
translation.en: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion : the same is the city of David .

translation.kha: khnang ba ha ka pa ba mynta lyngngoh ka Balang , ki angel nongsynshar sad ki bor ha ka pyrthei ba kynjri bneng ki lah pun tip ïa ka jingstad jong u ha baroh ki rukom ba-ïapher jong ki .
translation.en: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God ,

translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba u Moses u la phah swar ïa ka ri , ki la Wanlam ïa ka kaiphod ïa-lamler kaba la pynphong ïa u paidbah ban khñium pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And the men , which Moses sent to search the land , who returned , and made all the congregation to murmur against him , by bringing up a slander upon the land ,

translation.kha: U Jisu u dang ïaid lyngba ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabbaton . Ki synran jong u ki la sdang ba kheit ïa ki kop kew , ki kyrjaw ïa ki ha ki kti jong ki , bad ki bam ïa ki symboh kew .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first , that he went through the corn fields  ; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn , and did eat , rubbing them in their hands .

translation.kha: Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Syria yn sa ingiew junom . Kin longïng ka jaka pynbamphlang ïa ki langbrot pynlang ki masi , bad ym don mano mano ba beh noh ïa ki .
translation.en: The cities of Aroer are forsaken : they shall be for flocks , which shall lie down , and none shall make them afraid .

translation.kha: Ngi la kyrmen ïa ka jingsuk bad ka por ka jingpynkhiah , hynrei kam shym la myntoi ei ei ; ka jingtriem ka wan pynban .
translation.en: We looked for peace , but no good came  ; and for a time of health , and behold trouble !
Now the rest of the acts of Nadab , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Nadab u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

translation.en: And she brought forth her firstborn son , and wrapped him in swaddling clothes , and laid him in a manger  ; because there was no room for them in the inn .
translation.kha: Ka la kha ïa u khun nyngkong jong ka bad ka la sop ïa u da ki jaiñsop , bad ka la pynthiah ïa u ha ka shyngoid — ym shym don jaka ïa ki ha ka kamra sah   .

translation.en: Remember the former things of old : for I am God , and there is none else  ; I am God , and there is none like me ,
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa kaei kaba la jia la slem bah ; to pdiang ba tang ma nga , nga long U Blei bad ym don uwei pat kum ma nga .
U Blei u ong , La slem bah ang la sngewdap lade ; ngam shym la ïajubab ïa ki briew jong nga . Hynrei mynta ka por banbeiñ leh ka la wan ; nga kyang jar kum ka kynthei kaba suh ha .
translation.en: I have long time holden my peace  ; I have been still , and refrained myself : now will I cry like a travailing woman  ; I will destroy and devour at once .

translation.kha: Haba shem ïa ka tnga , Phin shem ïa kaei kaba bha ; ka pynap ba U Trai u lehbha ïa phi .
translation.en: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing , and obtaineth favour of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha ka jinglyng-a kaba khraw u la duwai kham jur shuh Shuh ; ka syep jong u ka la long kum ki jingjaw ka snam kaba tap ha mawdong .
translation.en: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly : and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground .

translation.kha: Lai ngut na ki paralok u Job ki long u Eliphas na ka nongbah Teman , u Bildad na ka ri Shuah , bad u Sophar na ka ri namarba . Ynda ki la ïohsngew katno ba u Tob u sha jynjar , ki ïakut ba ithuh bad pyntngen ïa u .
translation.en: Now when Job s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him , they came every one from his own place  ; Eliphaz the Temanite , and Bildad the Shuhite , and Zophar the Naamathite : for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him .

translation.kha: kumto te , ngim dei ïa-ban ïohthiah kum kiwei pat ; ngi de ba-bang dabor bad pyngngad .
translation.en: Therefore let us not sleep , as do others ; but let us watch and be sober .

translation.kha: Ki phai bad ki leit napoh , bad ki khynnah , ki jingri jingduk , malade ki jingdon jingem jong ki , ki wait ha shuwa .
translation.en: So they turned and departed , and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them .

translation.kha: Bad ka leh U Trai ka la sdang ban pynkhlaiñ ïa u katba u dang don pynpdang Sorah bad Eshtaol ha ka jaka sher dara jong ki Dan .
translation.en: And the Spirit of the  Lord  began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hajuh ïa u mynshuwa haba ki ïohi ïa u ba u leh ïa Kanah ki ïakylli para ma ki , Kaei kane kabu la wan jia ïa u khun jong u Kish ? Hammoth , u Saul ruh u la long nongïathuh ?
translation.en: And it came to pass , when all that knew him beforetime saw that , behold , he prophesied among the prophets , then the people said one to another , What is this that is come unto the son of Kish ? Is Saul also among the prophets ?

Who is this that cometh from Edom , with dyed garments from Bozrah ? this that is glorious in his apparel , travelling in the greatness of his strength ? I that speak in righteousness , mighty to save .
translation.kha: Uei une uba wan na ka nongbah Bosrah ha Edom ? Uei une uba riam itynnat ha ki jaiñkup rong saw u da ïaid ryngkat ha ka bor bad jingkhlaiñ ?   U dei U Trai , uba donbor ban pyllait im , u wan ban pynbna ïa ka jingjop jong u .
kawei ka leit shaïong Beth Horon , bad kawei pat ka leit shaphang ka khampoh na kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Seboim bad ïa ka ri khlad .
translation.en: And another company turned the way to Beth–horon : and another company turned to the way of the border that looketh to the valley of Zeboim toward the wilderness .

translation.kha: U thri u la pyntip ha per ïa ki jingthmu sniew kiba ki nongshun jong nga ki la thaw pyrshah ïa per .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath given me knowledge of it , and I know it : then thou shewedst me their doings .
And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim , from the rock , and upward .
translation.kha: Shatei na Sela , u pud ka Edom u ïaid lyngba ka Khim Akrabbim .
U rangbah ai lei jong ka kynhun shipai jongki u Saul , u Abner u khunlung jong u Ner , u la phet bad u Ishbosheth , u khun jong u Saul shai Mahanaim .
translation.en: But Abner the son of Ner , captain of Saul s host , took Ish–bosheth the son of Saul , and brought him over to Mahanaim  ;

translation.kha: Bad kumta ha kata ka sngi , kata ka jingkmen ïa ka jingkup ka la kylla sha ka jingsniew ïa baroh ki shipai jong u Dabid , namar ki la ïohsngew ba u syier u ïambriew na ka bynta la u khun .
translation.en: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people : for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son .

translation.kha: U mynsiem u jubab , ‘ Ngin sien bad ngan pynlong ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa u Hapoh ban kren lam .’ U Trai u ong , ‘ Khie lytar bad shukor ïa u . Phin jop .’
translation.en: And he said , I will go out , and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . And the  Lord  said , Thou shalt entice him , and thou shalt also prevail : go out , and do even so .

translation.kha: Baroh kaba nga sheptieng bad sngewtynnad ka wan jylla shisha .
translation.en: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me , and that which I was afraid of is come unto me .

translation.kha: Lada ka mynnor bad tyrwa ruh ban wanrah um ïa ki ut jong nga , to ai ba kata kan long kob me la jied kum ka tnga ïa u khun jong u kynrad jong nga .’
translation.en: And she say to me , Both drink thou , and I will also draw for thy camels : let the same be the woman whom the  Lord  hath appointed out for my master s son .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ka por kan wan lehbha ngan long U Blei jong ki jait Israel baroh , bad kin longsem ki briew jongngi nga .
translation.en: At the same time , saith the  Lord  , will I be the God of all the families of Israel , and they shall be my people .

translation.kha: kam phar la hangno hangtei ki Israel ki shong ki sawa , kim dei da lei lei ban pyndonkam ïa ka snam jong ki sim ne ki mirr khim ka jingbam .
translation.en: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood , whether it be of fowl or of beast , in any of your dwellings .

translation.kha: Phin ïoh kun sngewbit ha ka jingdap kyrhai jong ka , kum i khunlung ha ka shadem ka kmie jong i .
translation.en: That ye may suck , and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations  ; that ye may milk out , and be delighted with the abundance of her glory .

translation.kha: Te ki la phyrngab ban Kem ïa u , hynrei ym don uba la ktah kti ïa u , namar ba ka kynta jong u mana pait poh .
translation.en: Then they sought to take him : but no man laid hands on him , because his hour was not yet come .
And they say unto her , Woman , why weepest thou ? She saith unto them , Because they have taken away my Lord , and I know not where they have laid him .
translation.kha: Ko kynthei , balei pha ïam ?  ki la ïakylli ïa ka . Ka la jubab ,  Ki la rah noh ïa U Trai jong nga , bad ngam tip shano ki la buh ïa u !

translation.en: He shall pray unto God , and he will be favourable unto him : and he shall see his face with joy : for he will render unto man his righteousness .
translation.kha: Haba u duwai , U Blei un jubab ïa u ; un mane ïa U Blei da kaba kmen ; U Blei un buh beit sa shisien pat ïa kiei kiei na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: And the waters shall fail from the sea , and the river shall be wasted and dried up .
translation.kha: Ka um kan rit ha ka Nile , bad ka wah kan sdang ban rngad .

translation.en: A fool despiseth his father s instruction : but he that regardeth reproof is prudent .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba ibieit ban ym suidñiew ïa kaei kaba ki kmie ki kpa jong phi ki hikai ; ka long kaba jingstad ban pdiang ïa ka jingsneng jong ki .
hynrei ki shynrang badno ki kynthei Kiba bit ban mih na ka jingïap bad ban im ha ki pynpang ban wan kin ym sngewjahburom Shua .
translation.en: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world , and the resurrection from the dead , neither marry , nor are given in marriage :

translation.kha: Naba katto katne ngut ki briew na ka erlangthari jongngi ka Khloi ki la ïatih ïa na da kaba shai kyrdan , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba to ki jingïania hapdeng jong phi .
translation.en: For it hath been declared unto me of you , my brethren , by them which are of the house of Chloe , that there are contentions among you .

translation.kha: U Kpa bad ma nga ngi longsem kawei .
translation.en: I and my Father are one .
For thus saith the  Lord  , Behold , I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once , and will distress them , that they may find it so .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un kynting ïa phi shabar jong kane ka ri ; un pynlwet ïa phi tad haduh ba yn ym don uno uno ruh na phi uba dang sah . U  Trai  u la kren .

Ka la long ka sngi kaba shiphew jong ka snieh thymmai , kabu long ka sneng kaba arphew san hadien ba la ringmraw ïa ngi bad khatsaw sneng hadien ba la jrop ïa ka Jerusalem . Ha kata ka sngi nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon jingset badonbor jong U Trai , bad u la rah noh ïa nga .
translation.en: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity , in the beginning of the year , in the tenth day of the month , in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten , in the selfsame day the hand of the  Lord  was upon me , and brought me thither .

translation.kha: Kin pynkad ïa ki jaiñ jong Phah bad kin shem ïa ki mawlynnai jong pha .
translation.en: They shall also strip thee out of thy clothes , and take away thy fair jewels .

Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests , and they builded the sheep gate  ; they sanctified it , and set up the doors of it  ; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it , unto the tower of Hananeel .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ba la tei pat ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah . U Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad ki para lyngdoh jong u ki la tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Langbrot , ki pynkyntang ïa ka , bad pynïeng ïa ki khyrdop . Ki la pynkyntang ïa ka kynroh haduh u Mot ki Shispah bad u Mot Hananel .
mian ba tih nur na ka bynta u slap uba hap malade ba pynkhuid ïa ka lynti na ka bynta ka erïong malade u pyrthat ?
translation.en: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters , or a way for the lightning of thunder  ;
And God Almighty bless thee , and make thee fruitful , and multiply thee , that thou mayest be a multitude of people  ;
translation.kha: To U Blei Badonbor Baroh un kyrkhu ïa ka shongkha shongman jong me bad un ai ïa me bun ki khun ki kti , ba men ïoh long u kpa jong kiba bun ki jaitbynriew .
Ki rangbah pynïaidkam jyllang ka ki long kum ki sing bakyrhuh ; ki nongbishar jong ka ki longïng kamon ki suri bathngan , kiba lalot eh kat ban pynsah sa tang ka shyieng Haduh mynstep .
translation.en: Her princes within her are roaring lions  ; her judges are evening wolves  ; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow .

translation.kha: Hadien u jumai , la wan ka ding — hynrei U Trai um shym don ha ka jing . Sin hadien ka ding , la wan ka prie katba sawa jem jia jai .
translation.en: And after the earthquake a fire  ; but the  Lord  was not in the fire : and after the fire a still small voice .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong me ki ni pum pyrshah ïa me — pynlang ba ym ni imat ruh u brai Uba khlem leh pop — bad ha la ka jingbit me shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jop ïa ki bad ban ring koidi ïa ki sha kawei pat ka ri , wat la kata ka ri ka long kaba jngai , to shahshkor! ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong me .
translation.en: If they sin against thee , ( for there is no man that sinneth not , ) and thou be angry with them , and deliver them to the enemy , so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy , far or near  ;

translation.kha: hangtei ki la sahnarphna ïa u ; sad ki la sabakhthani ruh ïa ki ar ngut kiwei pat ki rangbah , uwei ha kawei kawei ka jar bad U Jisu hapdeng jongngi ki .
translation.en: Where they crucified him , and two other with him , on either side one , and Jesus in the midst .

translation.kha: Anab U Bel ha ka jingstad jong u , um shym la pynlah ïa ki briew ban ithuh ïa u da ka jingstad jong ki hi . Pynban da kata kaba la Khot ka khubor ba-ibieit kiba ngi ïalap , U Blei u la ibit ban pynim ïa tun kiba ngeit ïa ka .
translation.en: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God , it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe .

translation.kha: Haduh kane hi ka khyllipmat ngi shahthngan bad ngi sliang ; la pynkup ha Ngi da ki jaiñjot ; la shohdab ïa ngi ; ngi ïaidwir na kawei ka jaka sha kawei pat ; ngi la thait la jrem ïa lade na ka jingtrei shitom .
translation.en: Even unto this present hour we both hunger , and thirst , and are naked , and are buffeted , and have no certain dwellingplace ;

translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki briew na kata ka thain ki la kyrpad ïa U Jisu ban leit nong , namar ba ki la sngewbishni shikatdei eh . Kumta U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la leit ei .
translation.en: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them  ; for they were taken with great fear : and he went up into the ship , and returned back again .

translation.kha: Jaban kumta la khanglad ïa nga bishni na kaba wan sha phi .
translation.en: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you .

translation.kha: Ki jait Gad ki shongduh sha mihngi jong ka Jordan , Susah ki jait Dan ki ïai ba-don ha ki lieng . Ki jait Asher ki shongduh harud ka duriaw , Ki ïai don hadien ka duriaw .
translation.en: Gilead abode beyond Jordan : and why did Dan remain in ships ? Asher continued on the sea shore , and abode in his breaches .
How fair and how pleasant art thou , O love , for delights !
translation.kha: Ki bniat jong phi ki long kiba lieh kum ka kynhun jong ki langbrot ba dang shu dep pynsum . Ym don kawei ruh na ki kaba jah ; baroh ki long kiba ïaryntih bha .

Ha kawei ka Sngi , U Adonijah u ai ka jingkñia da ki langbrot , ki masi dab , bad ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid ha u Mawsiang Bseiñ , hajan ka umpohliew Enrogel . U la khot sngewbha ïa kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong U Syiem ïabuaid bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem kiba dei na Judah pun wan sha kane ka jingkhawai ai jingkynha ,
translation.en: And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth , which is by En–rogel , and called all his brethren the king s sons , and all the men of Judah the king s servants :

translation.kha: Nangta ki la tian pansngiat na ki tnat ba don shiah bad ki la buh ïa ka halor ka khleh jong u , bad ki la buh ïa u dieng ha ka kti kamon jong u ; nongbat ki la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u bad ki la kren ibeiñ ïa u . Im slem u Ngim ki Jiw ! ki la ong .
translation.en: And when they had platted a crown of thorns , they put it upon his head , and a reed in his right hand : and they bowed the knee before him , and mocked him , saying , Hail , King of the Jews !
But in the eighteenth year of king Josiah , wherein this passover was holden to the  Lord  in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Mynta ha kaba khatduh , ha ka snem kaba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar u Josaïah , la rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha Jerusalem .
U Blei u ong ha u Abraham , Men ym khot shuh ïa ka tnga jong me — ka Sarai ; naduh mynta ka kyrteng Jong ka kan hir noh — ka Sarah .
translation.en: And God said unto Abraham , As for Sarai thy wife , thou shalt not call her name Sarai , but Sarah shall her name be .
Also Hosah , of the children of Merari , had sons  ; Simri the chief , ( for though he was not the firstborn , yet his father made him the chief  ; )
translation.kha: Na ka kur jong u Merari la don u Hosah , uba don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Shimri , ( u kpa jong u , u la pynlong nongïalam ïa u wat la um dei u khun nyngkong ) ,

Kumta ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la kylli ïa U Jisu , Balei ba ki synran jong me Kam bud ïa ka jinghikai ba la ai nongpang da ki kpa tymmen jyllang ngi , hynrei pynban ki smam da ki kti bym khuid kat kum ka jingim ?
translation.en: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him , Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders , but eat bread with unwashen hands ?

translation.kha: Kynsan hynñiew ngut ki long ki khun ki ksiew ba u Jakob u ïoh na ka Bilhah kaba u Laban u ai ha ka Hillel ka kynhun jong u ban long ka mraw jong ka .
translation.en: These are the sons of Bilhah , which Laban gave unto Rachel his daughter , and she bare these unto Jacob : all the souls were seven .

translation.kha: Phi dih ïa ka twad , phi kup ki jaiñ ba la thain na u saiwul , ph pynïap malu bam na ki langbrot kiba kynsai tam . Hynrei phim ju sumar ba ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: Ye eat the fat , and ye clothe you with the wool , ye kill them that are fed : but ye feed not the flock .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong na kita ki snieh , ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad wat trei ei ei dom phi ju trei mano la ka sngi .
translation.en: On the first day shall be an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .

translation.kha: Yn khot ïa ki , ka eitnar bymdondor , namar ma nga , U Trai , nga la kyntait ïa ki .
translation.en: Reprobate silver shall men call them , because the  Lord  hath rejected them .

translation.kha: Nga la ïahap sha madan bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba ong ha per , ‘ Saul , Saul ! Balei me pynshitom pien ïa nga ?’
translation.en: And I fell unto the ground , and heard a voice saying unto me ,  Saul , Saul , why persecutest thou me ?
And one went in , and told his lord , saying , Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel .
translation.kha: Haba u Naaman u ïohsngew ïa kane , u la leit sha u syiem bad u ïathuh ha u ïa kaei ba ka khynnah ka la ong .

translation.en: But they had heard only , That he which persecuted us in times past now preacheth the faith which once he destroyed .
translation.kha: Ki la tip tang ïa kaei ba kiwei pat ki ong :  U briew uba la ju pynshitom beiñ ïa ngi mynta pat u ïalap ïa ka jingngeit ïa kaba shisien u la pyrshang ban pynduh !

translation.en: And if by grace , then is it no more of works : otherwise grace is no more grace . But if it be of works , then is it no more grace : otherwise work is no more work .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jingjied jong u la pynshong nongrim ha ka jingaiei jong u , ym ha kaei kaba ki la leh . Namar lada ïa ka jingjied U Blei la pynshong nongrim ha kaei kaba ki briew ki leh , te ka jingaiei jong u kan ym long ka jingaiei bashisha .
hynrei U Trai u long uba Bha bad leh-ieit ïa ki . Um shah ba yn pynïoh ïa ki , hynrei u ïarap ïa ki , namar ka jutang jong u bad u Absalom , u Isaïah , bad u Jakob . Um pah ju khot ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: And the  Lord  was gracious unto them , and had compassion on them , and had respect unto them , because of his covenant with Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , and would not destroy them , neither cast he them from his presence as yet .

translation.kha: Ka Jingbymman Bamaïan ka la da trei , hynrei , katei ka ban jia , kan ym jhieh tad bynda ïa uta uba bat ïa ka la phang noh na ka lynti .
translation.en: For the mystery of iniquity doth already work : only he who now letteth will let , until he be taken out of the way .

translation.kha: Kumta uwei na ki briew hangta u la ong ha u , Ha khmied , ka kmie pynlang ki para shynrang jong me ki ïa-ïeng shabar bad ki kwah ban ïakren mala me .
translation.en: Then one said unto him , Behold , thy mother and thy brethren stand without , desiring to speak with thee .

translation.kha: Ngi pyndonkam ïa u ban ainguh ïa U Trai nabar U kpu jong ngi bad ban tim pajut ïa la u parabriew , ïa uba la thaw ha ka dur U Blei! .
translation.en: Therewith bless we God , even the Father  ; and therewith curse we men , which are made after the similitude of God .
They that swear by the sin of Samaria , and say , Thy god , O Dan , liveth  ; and , The manner of Beer–sheba liveth  ; even they shall fall , and never rise up again .
translation.kha: Kito kiba smai ha ki bleithaw jong ka Samaria , kiba ong , ‘ Da u blei jong ki Dan ,’ lane , ‘ Da u blei jong ki Beersheba ,’ — kito ki briew kin kyllon , bad kin ym khie pat .
Ka sur ka la kren na u lehhok , Une u long U Khun jongngi nga , umbah nga la jied — shahshkor ïa u !
translation.en: And there came a voice out of the cloud , saying , This is my beloved Son : hear him .

translation.kha: Ngam buh ïa kine kino ki aiñ . Hynrei da kaba pyn-ap kumno kiwei ki kloi ban ïarap , nga pyrshang ban wad Katto ka jingieit jong phi hi ka long kaba shisha .
translation.en: I speak not by commandment , but by occasion of the forwardness of others , and to prove the sincerity of your love .
And he returned unto his brethren , and said , The child is not  ; and I , whither shall I go ?
translation.kha: U leit phai pat sha la ki para , bad u ong ,  U para um don shuh hangta ! Ngam tip shuh ngan leh kumno .

La Katta shwa , phi haka ban pynjop bad bam ïa ki jingrai jong phi kato shaba phi shong phi law . Phi haka ban bam kat kumba U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa phi . Baroh na phi , babha khuid ne ki bymkhuid , phi lah ban bam ïa ki , wohnia bam ïa ka doh shrieh ne ka doh sier .
translation.en: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates , whatsoever thy soul lusteth after , according to the blessing of the  Lord  thy God which he hath given thee : the unclean and the clean may eat thereof , as of the roebuck , and as of the hart .
Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord , the veil shall be taken away .
translation.kha: Hynrei lah ban weng noh ïa ka , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shaphang u Moses :  Ïa ka jingkah jong u la weng noh mynba u la phai sha U Trai .

translation.en: And Samuel said unto all Israel , Behold , I have hearkened unto your voice in all that ye said unto me , and have made a king over you .
translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Nga la leh ïa kaba phi la ong ïa nga ban leh . Nga la ai ïa phi u syiem ban synshar ïa phi ,
kiba sah na ki blang kin ai ka dud na ka bynta jong phi malade ki ba-ha-ïing jong pa’ , bad ïa ki shakri kyntur jongu phi kumjuh .
translation.en: And thou shalt have goats  milk enough for thy food , for the food of thy household , and for the maintenance for thy maidens .
And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath , from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering  ; seven sabbaths shall be complete :
translation.kha: Kheiñ hynñiew taïew naduh kata ka sngi kaba bud ïa ka Sabbaton ha kaba phi wallam ïa ka song kew ban ainguh sha U  Trai .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel  ; Thus shall ye say to the king of Judah , that sent you unto me to enquire of me  ; Behold , Pharaoh s army , which is come forth to help you , shall return to Egypt into their own land .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai Ijipt ka don ha ka lynti ban ïarap ïa me , hynrei kan leit phai noh sha la ka ri .
U Trai u wanpaw ha u Solomon mynnin . U ong ha u , Nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong me , bad por la pdiang ïa khie ka templ kum ka jaka ha kiba yn ai ïa ki jingkñia ha nga .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared to Solomon by night , and said unto him , I have heard thy prayer , and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice .

translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong me ki la shahjop ! Ki la lute bad shetkylla , wat la ym shym don kiba la lute ne shetkylla ïa ki . Hynrei ka por Ban lute bad shetkylla kan kut , bad ma ki hi kin sa long kiba shah loit bad kiba shah shekel .
translation.en: Woe to thee that spoilest , and thou wast not spoiled  ; and dealest treacherously , and they dealt not treacherously with thee ! when thou shalt cease to spoil , thou shalt be spoiled  ; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously , they shall deal treacherously with thee .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la ong , ïathuh ïa ki Israel ba ka ri jong ki kam long kaba khuid , dara kumta lang! pynshitom ïa ka ha ka jingbitar jong nga .
translation.en: Son of man , say unto her , Thou art the land that is not cleansed , nor rained upon in the day of indignation .

translation.kha: Dei namar lad pa’ ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la kutlad ïa nga malu u la kren da kaba shai ba kan ym ïoh jam ïa ka oh Jadon ïa-ban leit sha kata ka ri kaba seisoh Kaba u ai kum ka jingïohkynti jongu phi .
translation.en: Furthermore the  Lord  was angry with me for your sakes , and sware that I should not go over Jordan , and that I should not go in unto that good land , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance :
And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub , named Abiathar , escaped , and fled after David .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Abiathar , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Ahimelekh , u la lait im , bad u leit ïasoh bad u Dabid .

Hangta u Jephthah u lumlang ïa ki rangbah Gilead baroh , ki ïaleh ïa ki rangïapom Ephraim , bad u jop ïa ki . ( Naba ki Abram ki nguh , Phi ki Gilead kaba ha Ephraim bad Manasseh phi dei ki nongrep na Epher ! )
translation.en: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead , and fought with Ephraim : and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim , because they said , Ye Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites , and among the Manassites .

Then the woman came and told her husband , saying , A man of God came unto me , and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of God , very terrible : but I asked him not whence he was , neither told he me his name :
translation.kha: Te kata ka briew ka leit ïathuh ha la u tnga ,  U briew jong U Blei u la wan ha nga , bad ka durkhmat jong u ka iphieng kum u angel U Blei . Ngam shym kylli ba u wan na-ei , bad u ruh um shym ïathuh ïa la ka kyrteng .
‘ Adonijah kane ngan wan phai bapaw , ong U Trai , bad ngan pynjngut pat ïa ka hima lad u Dabid . Ngan tei pat ïa kaba la jot jong ka dara ngan pynjlan pat ïa ka .
translation.en: After this I will return , and will build again the tabernacle of David , which is fallen down  ; and I will build again the ruins thereof , and I will set it up :

translation.kha: To pynkhuid ban wan noh sha ang .
translation.en: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me :

translation.kha: Pynban , nur-um beh ei ïa ki khyndiat pa khyndiat , tad haduh ba phin da ïabun paid ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri .
translation.en: By little and little I will drive them out from before thee , until thou be increased , and inherit the land .
I have seen his ways , and will heal him : I will lead him also , and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi kumno ki im , hynrei ngan pynkhiah pat ïa ki . Ngan ïalam ïa ki bad ïarap ïa ki , bad ngan pyntngen ïa kito kiba ïam sngewsih .

Yn ym don na ki briew jong ka Judah kiba la iehnoh shadien bad uba la wan shwa Ijipt ban shong ban sah ken lait pui ne lait ïaw . Yn ym don uwei ruh na ki u ban leit phai shad Judah , sha kaba ki sliang ban shongkha pun sah sa shisien pat . Yn ym don ba ïoh wan phai lait noh katto katne ki nongphetwir .
translation.en: So that none of the remnant of Judah , which are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there , shall escape or remain , that they should return into the land of Judah , to the which they have a desire to return to dwell there : for none shall return but such as shall escape .

translation.kha: hynrei haba kiei shym lup ïa ki , ki la paring ïa u Jason bad ïa ki katto katne ngut kiaw pat ki parabangeit ha khmat ki bor synshar jongki ka nongbah bad ki la pyrta , Kine ki briew ki la thaw jingkulmar kylleng kylleng ! Mynta ki la wan sha ka nongbah jong ngi , bad u Johanan u la pynsah ïa ki ha ka ïing jong u .
translation.en: And when they found them not , they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city , crying , These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also  ;
And it came to pass after these things , that one told Joseph , Behold , thy father is sick : and he took with him his two sons , Manasseh and Ephraim .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por , la ïathuh ha u Joseph ba u kpa jong u , u pang . Kumta u ïalam ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ar ngut , u Manasseh bad u Ephraim , ban ïaleit khmih ïa u Jakob .

Uwei pa uwei u la baibam ha ban da kdang — la don kumba saw khar ngut ki briew . Nangta ki synreit ki la ïalum Hynñiew tukri kiba la dep da ki lyngkhot lyngkhai ba la sah tam . U Jisu u la phah noh ïa ki briew
translation.en: And they that had eaten were about four thousand : and he sent them away .

translation.kha: U Troas u ong ha ki Briew lad u kiba don ha Babilonia : Phi la lait na ka jingïap ! Mynta to leit ! Wat ap ! Wat la phi don jngai na ïing , pyrkhat shaphang jrong nga , U Trai Jong phi , bad kynmaw ïa ka Jerahmeel .
translation.en: Ye that have escaped the sword , go away , stand not still : remember the  Lord  afar off , and let Jerusalem come into your mind .

translation.kha: Ko Israel , phi la ïohi shibun bha , hynrei ka don jingtim aïu ïa phin ? Phi don ki shkor ban sngew , Hynrei phi ïohsngew aïu da shisha ?
translation.en: Seeing many things , but thou observest not  ; opening the ears , but he heareth not .

translation.kha: lymda phi kular ba siew ïa ka ram u nongwei , pher babe ïa sakma . Kana khim bha lada phi khiar na kata .
translation.en: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it : and he that hateth suretiship is sure .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la pynleit jingmut bha ïa kaei kabu u Philip u la ong , haba ki la shahshkor ïa u bad ïohi ïa ki khambun kiba u la kun .
translation.en: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake , hearing and seeing the miracles which he did .
But sin , taking occasion by the commandment , wrought in me all manner of concupiscence . For without the law sin was dead .
translation.kha: Hynrei da kata ka hukum , ka pop ka la ïoh ka lad ban pynkhih ïa baroh ki jait jingkwah khwan myntoi kiba ha nga . Ha bym don ka hukum , ka pop ka long kaei kaei kaba ïap .
Bad u la ong ha ki baroh , Lada isangsot uno u khah ban wei bad nga , u dei ban klet ïa put , un bah ïa la ka diengphna man ka sngew , bad bud ïa nga .
translation.en: And he said to them all ,  If any man will come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross daily , and follow me .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , to kriah pyrshah ïa ka nongbat Sidon .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face against Zidon , and prophesy against it ,

translation.kha: U la ïa-ong ha u Mushi , Mihnoh nangne ! Ngam kwah shuh ban ïohthiah ïa me ! Ha ka sngew ba at ïohi ïa me , man ïap !
translation.en: And Pharaoh said unto him , Get thee from me , take heed to thyself , see my face no more  ; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die .

translation.kha: Ka Jerusalem ka long kiba la tim , kata ka nongbah kaba ijli , kaba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , kaba banbeiñ ïa la ki jong ki bynriew .
translation.en: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted , to the oppressing city !

translation.kha: To pan na U Jehobah ban ïarap ïa phin baneh leh ïa kaba dei .
translation.en: Ask Jehovah to help you do what is good .
And the skin of the bullock , and all his flesh , with his head , and with his legs , and his inwards , and his dung ,
translation.kha: Hynrei un shim ïa ka snieh , ïa ka doh met , ïa ka khlieh , ïa ki kjat , bad ïa ki doh jem ba kynthup ïa ki snier ,
lait tang u Kabul u khun jong u Jephunneh . U te u ïaineh ha nga , kumta lang! ai ha u bad ha ki khum ki kiaw jong u ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba u la saw syntiat .’
translation.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh  ; he shall see it , and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon , and to his children , because he hath wholly followed the  Lord .

translation.kha: Da ka jingngeit , ki kyntur ki la ïohpdiang ïa ki ba-ha-ïing babha la ïap ïa babha la pynim pat . Kiwei pat , kiba kyntait banbeiñ pdiang ïa ka jinglaitluid , ki la ïap ha ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ Khnang ba yn pynmihpat sha ka jingtem kaba kham bha .
translation.en: Women received their dead raised to life again : and others were tortured , not accepting deliverance  ; that they might obtain a better resurrection :

translation.kha: U Benhadad u ong ïa u , Ngan ai patar ha phi ïa ki shnong ba u kpa jngai nga u la shngiam na u kpa jongki phi , bad Phin lah ban tei ka khang ïakhaïi na ka bynta ïa laiñ ha Damaris , kumba u Kpa jong nga u leh ha Samaria . U Ahab u jubab , Halor kine ki kyndon , te sam pyllait ïa phi . U ïateh kular bad u malade u pyllait noh ïa u ban leit .
translation.en: And Ben–hadad said unto him , The cities , which my father took from thy father , I will restore  ; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus , as my father made in Samaria . Then said Ahab , I will send thee away with this covenant . So he made a covenant with him , and sent him away .

translation.kha: Namar kaei kaba la jia ha ka Sarah , ka tnga jong u Abraham , U Trai u la pynlyngki ïa ki kynthei baroh ha ka ïingsyiem jong u Amraphel . Kumta u Abraham u ïarwai na ka bynta u Abimelekh , bad U Blei u la pynkhiah ïa u . U la pynkhiah ruh ïa ka tnga jong u , bad ïa ki mraw kyntur jong u , ba kumta ki hima ki lah ban ïoh khwan .
translation.en: For the  Lord  had fast closed up all the wombs of the house of Abimelech , because of Sarah Abraham s wife .

translation.kha: Kabbon u dang kyrkhu ïa ki , u la kitei ino na ki bad la shim noh ïa u sha bneng .
translation.en: And it came to pass , while he blessed them , he was parted from them , and carried up into heaven .

translation.kha: Nga thup ba me shahshkor ïa nga borabor , hynrei nga nong ïa kane na ka bynta u paidbhur hangne , ba kumin kin ngeit ba me la phah ïa por .
translation.en: And I knew that thou hearest me always : but because of the people which stand by I said it , that they may believe that thou hast sent me .

translation.kha: Da ki jingkyrkhu jong me , ki syiem ki la synshar ïa ki brisoh jong me haba ki shong ki sah ha ka ri kaba ïar bad kaba seisoh ba me la ai ïa ki ; hynrei kim shym la phai noh na ka pop ban Sikhri ïa me .
translation.en: For they have not served thee in their kingdom , and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them , and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them , neither turned they from their wicked works .

translation.kha: Shah kyang dih mala kin klet ïa la ka jingduk , bad ïa ka jingsngewsih .
translation.en: Let him drink , and forget his poverty , and remember his misery no more .

translation.kha: Nga sngewtriem shaphang ka jingwan u Tahpanhes , u Phortunatos , bad u Akhaikos ; ki la bujli ïa ka jingbymman jong phi bad ki la pynsngewbha ïa nga , Rumah ki la pynsngewbha ïa phi! .
translation.en: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus : for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied .
Yea , better is he than both they , which hath not yet been , who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun .
translation.kha: Hynrei kham bha ban ïa kine baroh ar long kito ki bym pat shym la kha , ki bym pat ïohi ïa ka jingbymlehhok kaba trei ha ka pyrthei .
Ka shadem jong phi ka long khem ki khiat , ki ar thylli ki skei synrap katba bam jingbam hapdeng ki tiew lili .
translation.en: I rose up to open to my beloved  ; and my hands dropped with myrrh , and my fingers with sweet smelling myrrh , upon the handles of the lock .

translation.kha: Ki ktien u briew uba bha ki long kum ka rupa kaba kynsai ; ka jingai jingmut jong u riewbymman kim dondor ei ei .
translation.en: The tongue of the just is as choice silver : the heart of the wicked is little worth .

translation.kha: Don ki brup kba tyllai ba ki Long kiba khuid hynrei kiba dap da ka tngit suda .
translation.en: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes , and yet is not washed from their filthiness .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Timon mala ki paralok jong u ki la leit wad ïa u ,
translation.en: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him .
And there are diversities of operations , but it is the same God which worketh all in all .
translation.kha: Don bun ki jinglah ban shakri kiba ïapher , hynrei ujuh U Blei uba pynlah ïa baroh na ka bynta ka jingshakri bakyrpang jong ki .
U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai , da kaba bud ïa ka jingleh basniew jong u Hapoh u kpa jong u , ka Jehiel ka kmie jong u , bad jong u syiem Jeroboam , kiba la ïalang ïa ki Israel ban leh pep .
translation.en: And he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the way of his father , and in the way of his mother , and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin :

translation.kha: ka Kabbon , ka Lahmam , ka Shitlish ,
translation.en: And Cabbon , and Lahmam , and Kithlish ,
And when he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him .
translation.kha: U la beiñ ïa ki Israel , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Shammah , u hynmen jong u Dabid , u la pynïap ïa u .

translation.en: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures . And this was their appearance  ; they had the likeness of a man .
translation.kha: Hamar pdeng jong kata ka  erïong , nga ïohi ïa kaei kaei kaba i kum ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im ha ka dur ki briew ,

translation.en: And he answered and said ,  He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish , the same shall betray me .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Uta uba wieh ïa u kpu ha ka pliang lem bad nga , un shetkylla ïa nga .
Ha kawei ka mem hangta ha ka ïingbyndi , iathuh u nongrah khuri bad u nongshet kpu rangbah ki la phohsniew mar la ka jong ka jingphohsniew kaba don la ka jrong ka jong ka jingmut .
translation.en: And they dreamed a dream both of them , each man his dream in one night , each man according to the interpretation of his dream , the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt , which were bound in the prison .

translation.kha: Nangta u pyndap , Nga don hangne ka kitab kaba u Hilkaïah u la ai ha nga . Doeg u pule jam ïa ka ha u syiem .
translation.en: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king , saying , Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book . And Shaphan read it before the king .

translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u kylli , Kaei ka nang ban pynshisha ba U Trai un pynkhiah ïa nga bad ba hadien sa sngi ngan sa lah ban leit sha ka thalab ?
translation.en: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah , What shall be the sign that the  Lord  will heal me , and that I shall go up into the house of the  Lord  the third day ?

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba satang jong ka jingsynshar u Rehoboam , u syiem Shishak jong ka Ijipt u la leit tur ïaleit ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam , that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem :

translation.kha: Nalorkata ki pyrta ïa u Jonathan bad ïa uta u samla , Ale shane ! neng don ei ei ban ong ïa phi ! U Jonathan u ong ïa uta u samla , Bud ïa ang . U Trai u la ai ha ki Israel ka jingap halor jong ki .
translation.en: And the men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armourbearer , and said , Come up to us , and we will shew you a thing . And Jonathan said unto his armourbearer , Come up after me : for the  Lord  hath delivered them into the hand of Israel .
Nay , my lord , hear me : the field give I thee , and the cave that is therein , I give it thee  ; in the presence of the sons of my people give I it thee : bury thy dead .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko rangbah , ngan ai ha phi ïa ka lyngkha baroh kawei , bad ïa kata ka krem kaba don hangta . Hangne ha ka jingdon ryngkat ki para jait jong nga , ngan ai ïa ka ha phi khnang ba phin ïoh tep ïa la ka tnga .

baroh na ki , ki la ïaleit lang sha u syiem shun mluh ïa u Daniel . Ki la ong , Ko Syiem Kynrad , Phin la soi ïa ka hukum ba na ka bynta ki laiphew sngi kiba bud ïa uno Un uba kyrpad ïa kano kano na uno a u blei lane na uno Un u brai lait Tang na phira , yn briew ïa u khoh ka thliew ba-dap da ki sing . U syiem u la jubab , Ho-oid , ka sah” kaba pyrkhing , ka aiñ jong ki Medan pynlang ki Persia , ka bym lah ban pynkylla .
translation.en: Then they came near , and spake before the king concerning the king s decree  ; Hast thou not signed a decree , that every man that shall ask a petition of any God or man within thirty days , save of thee , O king , shall be cast into the den of lions ? The king answered and said , The thing is true , according to the law of the Medes and Persians , which altereth not .

translation.kha: Mynta , nga la ïathuh ïa phi ba phin la ieh ïa nga hynrei phin ym ngat .
translation.en: But I said unto you , That ye also have seen me , and believe not .
As silver is melted in the midst of the furnace , so shall ye be melted in the midst thereof  ; and ye shall know that I the  Lord  have poured out my fury upon you .
translation.kha: Yn pynum ïa ki ha Jerusalem kumba pynum ïa ka rupa ha ka lawar ding , bad nangta kin tip ba ki mad ïa ka jingbitar jong U  Trai .

translation.en: Now therefore be content , look upon me  ; for it is evident unto you if I lie .
translation.kha: Khmih ïa ka durkhmat jong nga . Ngam shukor .
bad u ong , Ko Shimei kynrad , to klet noh ïa ka jingbakla kaba nga la kuna ha kot ka sngi kaba phi la ingiew ïa ka Jerusalem . Wat buhnud ei ei pyrshah ïa nga lane pyrkhat shuh shaphang jong ka .
translation.en: And said unto the king , Let not my lord impute iniquity unto me , neither do thou remember that which thy servant did perversely the day that my lord the king went out of Jerusalem , that the king should take it to his heart .

translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la kren , Ko Kynrad , ngi la ïohi ïa u briew uba beh ne ïa ki ksuid ha ka kyrteng jngai me , pynlang ngi la Ong ïa u ban sangeh , namarba um Shimham Long u jong ka kynha jong ngi .
translation.en: And John answered and said , Master , we saw one casting out devils in thy name  ; and we forbad him , because he followeth not with us .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Asaïah , To shim ïa u Shear Jashub u khun jong me , mala khie leit ban ïaknieh ïa u Syiem Ahas . Man shem ïa u ha ka lyntang ha kaba ki nongthain jaiñ ki treikam , ha kaba kut ka nala kaba wallam um na ka pung kaba haneng .
translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto Isaiah , Go forth now to meet Ahaz , thou , and Shear–jashub thy son , at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller s field  ;

translation.kha: Balei ? u syiem u kylli . Hato ngam shym lah ban ai ei ei ïa me ? Hangto dei kata balei ba me da kwah ban kitei phad sha ïing ? Shu shad ïa nga ba leit , u Hadad u jubor ïa u syiem . Bad u leit phai sha la ka ri . Kum u syiem Ephod , u Hadad u longïing uba pyrman , u nongshun babha pynkthang ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: Then Pharaoh said unto him , But what hast thou lacked with me , that , behold , thou seekest to go to thine own country ? And he answered , Nothing : howbeit let me go in any wise .

translation.kha: lada ki sping ïa ki bseiñ lane dih kano kano ka bih , kin ym mynsaw ; ngin buh ïa la ki kti ha kiba pang , ki ban ïoh ka jingkhiah .
translation.en: They shall take up serpents  ; and if they drink any deadly thing , it shall not hurt them  ; they shall lay hands on the sick , and they shall recover .

translation.kha: Ki tymmen ki don ka jingstad , hynriew U Blei u don ka jingstad bad ka bor . Ki riewtymmen ki ni ka jingïohi jingjia ; U Blei u don ka jingïohi jingaiei bad ka bor ban pyntreikam .
translation.en: With him is wisdom and strength , he hath counsel and understanding .
But if ye shew the dream , and the interpretation thereof , ye shall receive of me gifts and rewards and great honour : therefore shew me the dream , and the interpretation thereof .
