translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi lah ban ïathuh ha nga ïa baroh ar , ka jingphohsniew bad ïa ka jingmut jong ka , ngan ainong ïa phi da ki jingai sngewbha bad ka jingpyndonburom kaba khraw . Te mynta , ïathuh ha nga ïa ka jingphohsniew bad kaei ka jingmut jong ka .
Mynta ki la ïap noh bad kin ym im shuh ; ki sna-ïap jongu ki kin ym mih , namar me la pynshitom bad pyndait ïa ki . Ym don uwei hajuh u ban kynram shuh ïa ki .
translation.en: They are dead , they shall not live  ; they are deceased , they shall not rise : therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them , and made all their memory to perish .

translation.kha: Mynba phi la mihnoh na ri Ijipt , nga la Kular ba ngan long lem bad phi borabor . Nga dang long lem bad pa’ , kumta wat sheptieng .
translation.en: According to the word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt , so my spirit remaineth among you : fear ye not .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha sa , Nga don ka kam kaba kham khraw ïa me , ko shakri jong nga . Ym tang ba men rah pat sha ka jingkhraw ïa ki paid Israel kiba la lait im , hynrei ngan pynlong ruh ïa me ka jingshai sha ki jaitbynriew — khnang ba ka pyrthei baroh kan ïohlait im .
translation.en: And he said , It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob , and to restore the preserved of Israel : I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles , that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth .
And now I have heard that thou hast shearers : now thy shepherds which were with us , we hurt them not , neither was there ought missing unto them , all the while they were in Carmel .
translation.kha: U la ïohsngew ba phi dang ot shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot , bad u kwah ïa phi ban tip ba ki nongap langbrot jong phi ki don bad ngi bad ngim shym pynmynsaw ïa ki . Ym shym la tuh ïa kano kano kaba dei ka jong ki ha ki por baroh haba ki don ha Karmel .

hynne ka tnga jong u ka jubab , Lada U Trai’ u la thuh ba-bang pynïap ïa moi , un ym jin da la pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jrong ine ; un ym jin da la pyn-i ha i'u ïa kine baroh lane ïathuh ha ngi ïa kita kiei kiwei mynta .
translation.en: But his wife said unto him , If the  Lord  were pleased to kill us , he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands , neither would he have shewed us all these things , nor would as at this time have told us such things as these .
And when the devil was cast out , the dumb spake : and the multitudes marvelled , saying , It was never so seen in Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei mar syn beh noh ïa u ksuid , u briew u la sdang ban kren , bad uwei uwei baroh u la lyngngoh ,  Ngim pat ju ïohi mynno mynno ruh kum kane ha Israel !  ki la ong .
Phi tip) ïa ka lynti kaba ïamareh Sha kata ka jaka shano sha ba nga leit .
translation.en: And whither I go ye know , and the way ye know .
Saying , God hath forsaken him : persecute and take him  ; for there is none to deliver him .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  U Blei u la iehnoh ïa u ; ïa ngin ïabeh bad kem ïa u ; ym don mano mano ban pyllait im ïa u .
To jingeh ïa U Blei jong ka bnai ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the God of heaven : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: U Nehemaïah , u khun jong u Asbuk , u nongshong ïa shiteng jong ka Bethbarah bajar , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud haduh ka jingtep u Dedan , ka pungsum bad jaka sah shipai .
translation.en: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk , the ruler of the half part of Beth–zur , unto the place over against the sepulchres of David , and to the pool that was made , and unto the house of the mighty .

translation.kha: U Blei u kwah ba ngin pynmyntoi ïalade .
translation.en: God wants us to benefit ourselves .

translation.kha: Ka turoi ka riewhok bad baroh ki la pynkhreh . Hynrei ym Don uwei ruh uba leit sha ka thma , naba ka jingbitar jong U Blei ka long halor baroh kumwei .
translation.en: They have blown the trumpet , even to make all ready  ; but none goeth to the battle : for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof .
And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation .
translation.kha: na kawei ka pateng bynriew sha kawei pat u pyn-i ka jingisynei ha kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u .
Wat la ïa ka jingwoh shiliang la barieh , un pynrem ïa me ,
translation.en: He will surely reprove you , if ye do secretly accept persons .

translation.kha: naba ka jingai sngewbha da ka jingkhih kam don jingmut ei ei katba u briew uba ai ïa ka u dang im ; ka thliem tang hadien ka jingdap jong u .
translation.en: For a testament is of force after men are dead : otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth .
And , behold , I will lay bands upon thee , and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another , till thou hast ended the days of thy siege .
translation.kha: Ngan teh ngan khum ïa me kumta ba men ym lah ban phai na kawei ka liang sha kawei pat , tad ynda la pynkut ïa ka jingshah kerkut .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as Jesus sat at meat in the house , behold , many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang bam ha ka ïing u Matthaïos , shibun ki nonglum khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah kyntait ki la ïawan bad shong bad U Jisu lem bad ki synran jong u ha ka miej bam .
U Joseph u iehnoh ïa ki malade u sdang ban ïam . Haba u la lah don kren bajrong , u la wan pat , u shim ïa u Simeon bad u phah tei ïa u ha khmat jong ki .
translation.en: And he turned himself about from them , and wept  ; and returned to them again , and communed with them , and took from them Simeon , and bound him before their eyes .

translation.kha: U Tom u kylli ngiah bun ki jingkylli kiba ngam lai jubab .
translation.en: Tom asked me a lot of questions that I couldn't answer .

translation.kha: Nga ïaid lyngba ki lyngki bad ki bri sohwaiñ jong u bynriew uba alhia , uba mutlop .
translation.en: I went by the field of the slothful , and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding  ;

translation.kha: U paidbhur u la pyrshang ban pynpei ïa u Paul , haba la phah ïa ka khubor sha u rangbah ai lei jong ka kynthup shiphew Rom ba ka Jeremaïah baroh ka la khihwin .
translation.en: And as they went about to kill him , tidings came unto the chief captain of the band , that all Jerusalem was in an uproar .

translation.kha: Lada phi leh ïa kane , kumba U Blei u hukum , pher ym pynthait ïa laiñ , bad kine ki briew baroh ki lah ban leit sha ïing hadien ba la bishar ïa ki jingkñia jyllang ki .
translation.en: If thou shalt do this thing , and God command thee so , then thou shalt be able to endure , and all this people shall also go to their place in peace .

translation.kha: Ha ki jingïaid lynti jong ki baher shiah lynter , ki lah ban ïohi mynsngi ïa ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai ha uta u jlih halor ka Ïingjaiñ , bad mynshem pat ha ka ding kaba mai halor jong ka .
translation.en: For the cloud of the  Lord  was upon the tabernacle by day , and fire was on it by night , in the sight of all the house of Israel , throughout all their journeys .

translation.kha: Ki sher dara ha ka ri bad ki pynïong ïa ki jingthung baroh shah ka jaka bashaphang shathie sawdong ïa ka Gasa . Ki shem ïa baroh ki langbrot , ki jingri , nabar ki kada , bad ktieh skhem pynsah ei ei shuh ïa ki Israel ban bam .
translation.en: And they encamped against them , and destroyed the increase of the earth , till thou come unto Gaza , and left no sustenance for Israel , neither sheep , nor ox , nor ass .
Then ye shall let your children know , saying , Israel came over this Jordan on dry land .
translation.kha: phin ïathuh ha ki shaphang ka por mynba ki Israel ki la jam ïa ka Jordan halor ka dewryngkhiang .
Nangta u trai u la phah ïa iwei pat u mraw ; ki nongshimwai ki la pyntud ïa u na ka khlieh bad ki la leh khlem akor ïa u .
translation.en: And again he sent unto them another servant  ; and at him they cast stones , and wounded him in the head , and sent him away shamefully handled .

translation.kha: Khie leit baïong , ko Moses , bad shahshkor ïa kaei kaei Baroh kat kaba U Trai U Blei jong I u don ban ong . Nangta wang phai pah sad ïathuh ha ngi aïu u la krenbeiñ ha phi . Ngin shahshkor bad kohnguh ïa ka .’
translation.en: Go thou near , and hear all that the  Lord  our God shall say : and speak thou unto us all that the  Lord  our God shall speak unto thee  ; and we will hear it , and do it .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Moab kan lynñiar namar ki jingjynjar ba ki Shah . Baroh kin ïapom haba ki kynmaw ïa ka jingbam uba kaba ki ju bam ha ka nongbah jongu ka Kir Heres . Yn beh ïa ki Baroh shat ka jingduh jingkyrmen .
translation.en: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab , every one shall howl : for the foundations of Kir–hareseth shall ye mourn  ; surely they are stricken .

translation.kha: U khoh u to saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Amram , u Ishar , u Hebru , mala u Ussiel . U Kohath u la im ïathuh shispah laiphew lai snem ka rta .
translation.en: And the sons of Kohath  ; Amram , and Izhar , and Hebron , and Uzziel : and the years of the life of Kohath were an hundred thirty and three years .
And Joseph was the governor over the land , and he it was that sold to all the people of the land : and Joseph s brethren came , and bowed down themselves before him with their faces to the earth .
translation.kha: U Joseph kum u lat jong ka ri Ijipt u die kew ha ki briew kiba wan na kylleng ka pyrthei . Kumta ki hynmen shynrang jong u Joseph ki la ïawan bad nguh ngon ha khmat jong u , ki da pyndem la ki khmat sha khyndew .
Ko ki ba-bieit bymlalot ! kano kaba kham donkam , ka ksiar lane ka Tep kaba pynlong khuid ïa ka ksiar ?
translation.en: Ye fools and blind : for whether is greater , the gold , or the temple that sanctifieth the gold ?

translation.kha: U Solomon u jubab , Me la ju ïan pynpaw ka jingieit bakyrhai ïa u Dabid , u kpa jong nga , u shakri jong me , bad u la long uba bha , uba ïajan , bad uba hok ha ka jingïadei lad u bun me . Bad me la ïai bthei ban pyn-i ha u ïa ka jingtieng bakhraw bun baneh skhem da kaba ai ha u ïa u khunlung uba mynta u synshar ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Solomon said , Thou hast shewed unto thy servant David my father great mercy , according as he walked before thee in truth , and in righteousness , and in uprightness of heart with thee  ; and thou hast kept for him this great kindness , that thou hast given him a son to sit on his throne , as it is this day .

translation.kha: Ka sngi kiba shyrkhei ka wan ; ym don kano katno kadei pat ka sngi kaba lah ban nujor bad ka — ka por ka jingnoh mynsiem na ka bynta ki briew jngai por , hynrei kin lait im .
translation.en: Alas ! for that day is great , so that none is like it : it is even the time of Jacob s trouble  ; but he shall be saved out of it .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u pynbna ha kaba paw ba u long u jong nga , ngan leh kumjuh ha khmat U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .
translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall confess me before men , him will I confess also before my Father which is in heaven .
Then shall they know that I am the  Lord  , when I have laid the land most desolate because of all their abominations which they have committed .
translation.kha: Ynda haba nga pynshitom ïa ki briew namar ki pop jong ki bad pynlong ïa ka ri ka jaka kynjah , te kin sa tip ba nga long U  Trai .
Yn don ka jingseisoh kaba khraw ha ki hynñiew snem ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .
translation.en: Behold , there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt :

translation.kha: Ngan pyrta da kaba kmienah katba na dang tem na ka bynta jyllang me ; da ka long Jong nga barieh kawei nur-um rwai namar ba me la pyni ïa nga .
translation.en: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee  ; and my soul , which thou hast redeemed .

translation.kha: To ngeit ïa de haba nga ong ba nga long ha U Kpa bad U Kpa u long ha nga . Lymda Kumta , to ngeit namar kiei kiei kiba nga leh .
translation.en: Believe me that I am in the Father , and the Father in me : or else believe me for the very works  sake .

translation.kha: U jubab , Nga lah shun kren tang ïa kiei kob U Trai u ong ïa na ban kren .
translation.en: And he answered and said , Must I not take heed to speak that which the  Lord  hath put in my mouth ?
He that dasheth in pieces is come up before thy face : keep the munition , watch the way , make thy loins strong , fortify thy power mightily .
translation.kha: Ko Ninebeh , pha don ha ka jingshah tur ïaleh ! Ka bor ka ban kynther ïa pha ka la wan . To buh briew ha ki jingïada ! To phira ïa ka lynti bah ! To pynkhreh ïa ka thma !

translation.en: What are you doing ?
translation.kha: Dang leh aiu ?
Ai ïa per ka lad ba ngan kren bad ngat , haba nga la ngap kren , briew lada phiah kwah .
translation.en: Suffer me that I may speak  ; and after that I have spoken , mock on .
Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed : even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice .
translation.kha: Phi leit sha ki lum kiba jrong ban kñia ainguh bad ïathiah shongkha .

translation.en: And they passed over Jordan , and pitched in Aroer , on the right side of the city that lieth in the midst of the river of Gad , and toward Jazer :
translation.kha: Ki la jam ïa ka Jordan bad ki la sher dara ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Aroer , ka nongbah kaba don hapdeng jong ka them , ha ka ri ki Gad . Na kata ka jaka ki la leit shaphang shatei sha Jaser ;
Ai ba U Trai , U blei ki kpa tymmen jong ph un nang pynroi shuh shuh ïa phi bun hajar shah bad un pynmanbha ïa phira , wohnia u la kli !
translation.en: ( The  Lord  God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are , and bless you , as he hath promised you ! )
All we like sheep have gone astray  ; we have turned every one to his own way  ; and the  Lord  hath laid on him the iniquity of us all .
translation.kha: Ngi baroh ngi la long kum ki langbrot ba la sakma , uwei pa uwei na ngi u leit ha la ka jong ka lynti . Hynrei U  Trai  u la pynlong ba ka jingpynshitom kan hap halor jong u , ka jingpynshitom kaba baroh ngi dei hok ban ïoh .

translation.en: When Pilate therefore heard that saying , he was the more afraid  ;
translation.kha: Haba u Pilat u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la kham sheptieng shuh shuh .
Wat ïashongkha khleh bad ki , bad khang ïa ki khum ki kti jong phi ban ïakhana khlup nabar ki ,
translation.en: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them  ; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son , nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son .

translation.kha: Ka ryntieh u Jonathan ka long kaba shyrkhei Ka waitlam u Saul ka long ka sem ni jingisynei , Ka pynshitom ïa kiba khlaiñbor , ka da pynïap ïa ki nongshniah .
translation.en: From the blood of the slain , from the fat of the mighty , the bow of Jonathan turned not back , and the sword of Saul returned not empty .

translation.kha: Ïa film ki jingkylli baroh la pynlong na ka bynta jyllang ngi , ko ki Paralok ba-ima jong nga . Te namarkata , to ngin pynkhuid ïa lade na kaei kaei baroh kaba pynjngut ïa ka met bad mynsiem , bad to ai ba ngin im ka jingim kaba khuid da kaba im ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Having therefore these promises , dearly beloved , let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit , perfecting holiness in the fear of God .
For not he that commendeth himself is approved , but whom the Lord commendeth .
translation.kha: Naba ka long haba U Trai u pyrkhat bha ïa u briew , ba u briew u long uba la pdiang hun , bad ym haba u briew u pyrkhat bha shaphang ïa lade .

translation.en: And it shall be , when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom , that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of that which is before the priests the Levites :
translation.kha: Ynda u long syiem , u dei ban don kopi ïa ka kitab jong ki aiñ U Blei bad ki jinghikai kaba la shna na ka kot aiñ kaba ki lyngdoh Lebi ki bat .
Wat lada me la sait da ka sabon kaba khlieh , ngan dang ïai ïohi ïa ka jingkhah jaboh jong ka jingpalat jong me .
translation.en: For though thou wash thee with nitre , and take thee much soap , yet thine iniquity is marked before me , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ki synran ki la kylli ïa u , Nangno ngaiñ ïoh bam kaba biang ha kane ka ri shyiap ban bsa ïa une u paidbah ?
translation.en: And his disciples say unto him , Whence should we have so much bread in the wilderness , as to fill so great a multitude ?

translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha u , dih lyngba u Isaak ba men ïoh ïa ki khun ki ksiew kba nga la Kular .
translation.en: Of whom it was said , That in Isaac shall thy seed be called :

translation.kha: bad ki la ong ha uta u bajaipdeh , Kata ka ri kaba i la leit swar ka long kaba bha shikatdei eh .
translation.en: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel , saying , The land , which we passed through to search it , is an exceeding good land .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba nyngkong jong ka jingsynshar jong u , nga la pule bniah ïa ki kitab bakyntang bad pyllait shaphang ki hynñiewphew snem kiba ka Jerusalem kan anna ha ki jingpra , kat Kum kaei kaba U Trai u la lah ïatyngkhuh ha u Jeremaïah u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years , whereof the word of the  Lord  came to Jeremiah the prophet , that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ki ar ngat ki synran ki la ïasngew ïa u ba u ong ïa kane bad ki la leit slem bun U jongu .
translation.en: And the two disciples heard him speak , and they followed Jesus .

translation.kha: Shim ruh ïa barabor ki jaitniam jingbam kiba donkam na ka bynta jyllang me bad na ka boitha jongu ki .
translation.en: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten , and thou shalt gather it to thee  ; and it shall be for food for thee , and for them .

translation.kha: Ko Joab , phi la pynbitar ïa nga . Mynta ngam lah ap shuh ban jubab .
translation.en: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer , and for this I make haste .
And Joram slept with his fathers , and was buried with his fathers in the city of David : and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jehoram u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Ahasaïah u khun jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

Te ka Sarai ka nguh ha u Abram , dien namar jong me ba ka Hagar ka ibeiñ ïa nga ! Nga hi nga la ai ïa ka ha me , bad Naduh ba ka tip ba ka la punkhun , ka ibeiñ ïa nga . Ai ba U Trai un bishar mane ba de napdeng jong moi , ma me lane ma nga !
translation.en: And Sarai said unto Abram , My wrong be upon thee : I have given my maid into thy bosom  ; and when she saw that she had conceived , I was despised in her eyes : the  Lord  judge between me and thee .

translation.kha: Nangta U Khunlangbrot u la pynpyut ïa ka jingpyndait kaba lai ; bad nga la ïohsngew ïa u jingthaw ba-im uba lai babha ong , To wan ! Nga la khmih , bad hangamei la don u kulai uba ïong . U nongshong kulai u la bat ïa ka tynrah ha la ka Ki .
translation.en: And when he had opened the third seal , I heard the third beast say , Come and see . And I beheld , and lo a black horse  ; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand .
Remember , I beseech thee , that thou hast made me as the clay  ; and wilt thou bring me into dust again ?
translation.kha: Kynmaw ba me thaw ïa nga na ka dewbyrtha ; Hato men pynlwet pat ïa nga sha u pui pui ?

translation.en: Then Samuel went to Ramah  ; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul .
translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u leit sha Ramah , bad u syiem Saul u leit sha la ïing ha Gibeah .
U Jisu lema bad ki 1 ,44 ,000 ngut kin seng ïa ka hima ha bneng . Kata ka dei ka Hima jong U Blei .—Ioannis 14 :1-3 .
translation.en: Jesus and the 144 ,000 form a righteous heavenly government —God’s Kingdom . —Revelation 14 :1-3 .

translation.kha: 11 kumno ki Aiñ jong U Blei ki ai Jingmyntoi ïa ngi ?
translation.en: 11 How Do Bible Principles Benefit Us ?

translation.kha: Hynñiew mynta phi sngewsarong bad phi kyr-eit ; baroh kata kaba phi kyr-eit ka long kaba bakla .
translation.en: But now ye rejoice in your boastings : all such rejoicing is evil .

translation.kha: Ngin long uba riat na kiba rit tam na ki briew jong U blang baroh ; pynban , U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kabu ban ïalap sha ki jingtylliat ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka jingkynrei spah bymkut shuh jyllang U Khristan , bad ban pynlong ïa ki briew barben ban ïohi kumno ba la pyntreikam ïa ka jingthmu babniah U Blei .
translation.en: Unto me , who am less than the least of all saints , is this grace given , that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ ;

translation.kha: Mynba u Hesekaïah u long u syier ka Judah , u Maki u nongïathuhlypa na Moresheth u la bthah ïa baroh ki briew ba U Trai Badonbor Berakah u la lah ïai-ong , ‘ Ïa ka Seïon yn mluh kum ka lyngkha , ka Jerusha ka kylla ka kynton ki jingpra , bad u lum ka Templ un kylla khlaw .’
translation.en: Micah the Morasthite prophesied in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah , and spake to all the people of Judah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Zion shall be plowed like a field , and Jerusalem shall become heaps , and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest .

translation.kha: Lada uno ine u Israel u kylla duk malu u hap ban die ïa la ka khyndew , u ba-ha-ïing bajan eh jong u , un sleit pat ïa ka .
translation.en: If thy brother be waxen poor , and hath sold away some of his possession , and if any of his kin come to redeem it , then shall he redeem that which his brother sold .
And I will make with them a covenant of peace , and will cause the evil beasts to cease out of the land : and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness , and sleep in the woods .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jutang bad ki kaba pynskhem ïa ka jingshongshngain jong ki . Ngan beh noh ïa ki mrad kynsha baroh na ka ri , khnang ba ki langbrot jong nga kin im ha ka jingshngain ha ki jaka phlang bad thiah ha ki khlaw .
Ka Long kiba kham eh ïa u riewspah ban rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei ban ïa ka ut ban leit Lyngba ka thliew thyrnia .
translation.en: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle s eye , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: Nga thoh ïa kane ha phi , ko ki khun jong nga , khnang ba phi ym leh pop ; hynrei lada uno uno u leh pop , i don Uei uba ïasah bad U Kpa na ka bynta jong ngi — U Jisu Khrist , uta uba hok .
translation.en: My little children , these things write I unto you , that ye sin not . And if any man sin , we have an advocate with the Father , Jesus Christ the righteous :
And thou wentest to the king with ointment , and didst increase thy perfumes , and didst send thy messengers far off , and didst debase thyself even unto hell .
translation.kha: Phi sleh ïa ki jingiwbih bad ki kynja jingsleh , bad leit ban mane ïa u blei Molekh . Ban lap ïa ki blei ban mane phi la phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha jngai bah , wat shaduh ka pyrthei kiba ïap .
U peit-thuh ïa ki sien jam ba ki briew ki jam .
translation.en: For his eyes are upon the ways of man , and he seeth all his goings .
But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver , and over all the precious things of Egypt : and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps .
translation.kha: Un shim noh ïa ki jingkynshew ksiar bad rupa ba la buhrieh jong ka Ijipt bad ïa kiwei kiwei ki jingdon jingem jong ka kiba la ñiewkordor eh . Un hiarthma ïa ka Libya bad ka Sudan .

Mynsngi , U Trai u ïadie ha shuwa jong ki ha u rishot lyoh ban kdew lynti ïa ki , bad mynhyndai pat u ïaid ha shuwa jong ki ha u riew ding ban ai jingshai ïa ki , khnang ba ki haka ban ïadie mynsngi sad mynmiet .
translation.en: And the  Lord  went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud , to lead them the way  ; and by night in a pillar of fire , to give them light  ; to go by day and night :
And he stood between the dead and the living  ; and the plague was stayed .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pynsangeh ïa ka khlam bad u la shu ïeng hapdeng kiba im bad kiba ïap .
Ki ong , U Blei! u la iehnoh ïa u ; ïa ngin ïaphah bad kem ïa u ; ym don mano moi ban pyllut im ïa u .
translation.en: Saying , God hath forsaken him : persecute and take him  ; for there is none to deliver him .

translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong nga badno u bymkohnguh ïa ki u long Kum u briew’ uba la tei ïa la ka ïing khlem da pynshong nongmih ; haba ka jingshlei um ka lynshop ïa kata ka ïing , ka khyllem shisyndon — bad katno ka jingpyndem kaba shyrkhei kata ka la long !
translation.en: But he that heareth , and doeth not , is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth  ; against which the stream did beat vehemently , and immediately it fell  ; and the ruin of that house was great .
And they set them up Micah s graven image , which he made , all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh .
translation.kha: Ka bleithaw u Mikah ka ïaisah hangta ha kaba ka Ïingjaiñ ba mane ïa U Blei ka dang sah ha Shiloh .

translation.en: And when the king came in to see the guests , he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment :
translation.kha: U syiem u la leit rung shapoh ban khmih ïa kiba shah khot sngewbha bad u la ïohi ïa u briew uba khlem phong ki jaiñ shongkurim .
Hangta ki la ïahap ïa ka khubor ha Perga bad nangta ki la leit sha Attalia ,
translation.en: And when they had preached the word in Perga , they went down into Attalia :

translation.kha: Ki jubor , Kane ka de kaei ba phin ong ha ki : ‘ Ka tiduh lad ang ka kham rben ban ïa ka syngkai i pa jong nga .’
translation.en: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him , saying , Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee , saying , Thy father made our yoke heavy , but make thou it somewhat lighter for us  ; thus shalt thou say unto them , My little finger shall be thicker than my father s loins .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u la leh bymdei ïa phi , to wat siew kylliang ïa u da ka bymdei . To pyrshing banbeiñ leh ïa kaei kaba baher ki ñiew ba ka long kaba bha .
translation.en: Recompense to no man evil for evil . Provide things honest in the sight of all men .

The  Lord  also shall roar out of Zion , and utter his voice from Jerusalem  ; and the heavens and the earth shall shake : but the  Lord  will be the hope of his people , and the strength of the children of Israel .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kyrhuh na u lum Seïon ; ka sur jong u ka byrthen na Jerusalem ; ka khyndew bad ka suiñbneng ki khynñiuh . Hynrei un ïada ïa la ki briew .
Suk kita ïa kiba la ïohmap noh ïa ki jingleh bymdei , kiba ïa ki pop la map noh!
translation.en: Saying , Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven , and whose sins are covered .
Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king , and stand not in the place of great men :
translation.kha: Haba phi ïeng ha khmat u syiem , wat pyrshang ban shon jur ïa u bad leh mynleh kum uba pawkhmat .
Nangta u gospel uba saw u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha ka sngi , bad la shah ïa ka ban thang ïa ki briew da jingshit tyrha bajur jong ka .
translation.en: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun  ; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire .

translation.kha: Te u Tel u la wan ha U bad u la ong , Lada me lama U Khun U Blei , lei ïa kine ki maw shun kylla kpu .
translation.en: And when the tempter came to him , he said , If thou be the Son of God , command that these stones be made bread .

translation.kha: Ki kyntien ki wan urlong shisha marjan kumta hi . Ïa u Benabinadab la beh noh na ka imlang ka sangeh u bynriew malade u la bam phlang kum u masi dab . Ka kamar ka la hap halor ka saw jong u , bad u shñiuh jong u , u la san jrong kum ki sner jngai ki pukni bad ki tyrsim jong u ki jrong kumin ki tnaw jong ki sih .
translation.en: The same hour was the thing fulfilled upon Nebuchadnezzar : and he was driven from men , and did eat grass as oxen , and his body was wet with the dew of heaven , till his hairs were grown like eagles  feathers , and his nails like birds  claws .

translation.kha: U phah ïa ka leilieh khyllung ka suiñbneng hynrei ki jingtynjuh jong ka duriaw ka ïaishong kaba dum .
translation.en: Behold , he spreadeth his light upon it , and covereth the bottom of the sea .

translation.kha: sumar ïa ka jutang jong phi bad nga , U Trai jngai phi , bad pynkyntang ïa lai ha nga , phi ki briew jong ka Jehudi malade Jerusalem . Lymda katkum , ka jingbitar jong nga kan ing kum ka ding namarba kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba Phi la ar . Kan pluh , dara yn ym don mano mano ba pynlip ïa ka .
translation.en: Circumcise yourselves to the  Lord  , and take away the foreskins of your heart , ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem : lest my fury come forth like fire , and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings .

translation.kha: Wat shukor ïa la u para Israel , hynrei kohnguh ïa U Trai uba U Blei’ jongu phi .
translation.en: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another  ; but thou shalt fear thy God : for I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Ngi pynhiar ïa ki pud jong ka ri jongu phi naduh ka khmut duriaw Akaba haduh ka ïarwai Mediterranian bad naduh ka ri shyiap haduh ka wah Ïuphratis . Ngan ai ha phi ka bor halor ki nongshong shnong jong kata ka ri , bad phin beh noh ïa ki kabu phi nang tur sha khmat .
translation.en: And I will set thy bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines , and from the desert unto the river : for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand  ; and thou shalt drive them out before thee .

translation.kha: Ahian ba la ïohsngew ïa u , ki baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei . Nangta ki la ino , Ko Paul , phi lah ban ïohi katai khadar ngut ki Jiw ki la kylla long ki parabangeit , bun katno ma ki baroh ki bat pyrkhing ïa ka Hukum .
translation.en: And when they heard it , they glorified the Lord , and said unto him , Thou seest , brother , how many thousands of Jews there are which believe  ; and they are all zealous of the law :

translation.kha: A katno ka erlangthari kaba shyrkhei ïa phin ki nonghikai ka praw bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kba arsap ! Phi longsyiem khim ki jingtep ba la pushara sleh , kiba itynnat ha kaba shabar hynrei kiba dap da ki shyieng bad ki metïap bapyut ha kaba shapoh .
translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres , which indeed appear beautiful outward , but are within full of dead men s bones , and of all uncleanness .
Give thanks unto the  Lord  , call upon his name , make known his deeds among the people .
translation.kha: Ai ki jingnguh sha U  Trai  , pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u ; Ïathuh ha ki jaitbynriew ïa kaei kaba u la leh .

translation.en: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed , he went into his house  ; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem , he kneeled upon his knees three times a day , and prayed , and gave thanks before his God , as he did aforetime .
translation.kha: Haba u Daniel u la tip ba ïa ka hukum la lah soi , u la leit sha ïing . Ha ka kamra kaba haneng jong ka ïing jong u la don ki jingkhangïit kiba phai sha Jerusalem . Hangta , kumba u la ju ïai leh , u la dem khohsiew ha ki jingkhangïit ba la plie bad u duwai sha U Blei lai sien shi sngi .
Ym shym la don shem ha Israel ha kata ka por . Uwei pa uwei u leh katba u sngewbha .
translation.en: In those days there was no king in Israel : every man did that which was right in his own eyes .

translation.kha: Kumta , kumba u Jehoahas u la hukum , ka kynhun shipai ka la ïaid ha shuwa ki lyngdoh kiba put ïa ki turoi ; hadien jong Kinah dud sa ki lyngngoh katba bah ïa ka syndah ka Jutang U Trai , uba la burom pat da ka kynhun shipai na shadien . Ha ki prie barhem la put ïa ki turoi .
translation.en: And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets , and the rearward came after the ark , the priests going on , and blowing with the trumpets .

translation.kha: bad ïa ka tnga jong u la ai sha u briew uba la shong synlar ïa u ha ka jingïakynduh kurim .
translation.en: But Samson s wife was given to his companion , whom he had used as his friend .

translation.kha: Ngan map ïa ki pop jong ki bad ngan ym kynmaw haw ïa ki jingleh bymdei jong ki .
translation.en: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness , and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more .

translation.kha: Kim shym la duwai ha nga naduh la ka dohnud , hynrei pynban ki bret ïa lade ha madan bad ïam pangnud kumba leh kiba mane Blei’ thala . haba ki duwai ban ïoh ïa u kew bad ka waiñ , ki ot pynbam ïa lade kum kiba mano blei thala . A haduh katai ki long katba ïabah pyrshah !
translation.en: And they have not cried unto me with their heart , when they howled upon their beds : they assemble themselves for corn and wine , and they rebel against me .

translation.kha: Ka jingiw jong kane ka jingkñia ka long kaba ïasngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine , for an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai un pynïapmat ïa u Joab na ka bynta kito ki jingpynnang , kiba u la leh khleiñ ka jingtip u ïabuaid u kjap jong nga . U Joab u la pynïap ar ngut ki rangbah balieh lui kiba kham bha ban ïa u — u Abner , u rangbah ai sah jong ka kynhun shipai Israel , bad u Amasa , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipor Judah .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall return his blood upon his own head , who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he , and slew them with the sword , my father David not knowing thereof , to wit , Abner the son of Ner , captain of the host of Israel , and Amasa the son of Jether , captain of the host of Judah .

translation.kha: Me long uba khrum bad babha donbor , uba donbor , uba ibit bad uba jingpynnang . Kiei kiei baroh ha Bneng bad ha khyndew ki dei ki jong me ; me dei u syiem , u nongsynshar bahakhlieh duh halor baroh .
translation.en: Thine , O  Lord  , is the greatness , and the power , and the glory , and the victory , and the majesty : for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is thine  ; thine is the kingdom , O  Lord  , and thou art exalted as head above all .
Hear my words , O ye wise men  ; and give ear unto me , ye that have knowledge .
translation.kha: Phi ki rangbah phi long kiba da stad , kiba sian bha , to shahshkor mynta ïa kaei kaba nga ong .

Ka jubab , Nga shaei ha ka Kyrteng U Trai kaba im , U Blei jong Phi , ba ngam don kpieng ei ei . Balah kaban nga dat ka long tang Sei kham u purew ha ka pliang badno shi jaw ka umphniang Olib ha u klun . Nga wan hangne shun lum khyndiat ki diengïap ban ramhah sha ïing bad ban pynkhreh na Kaba khyndiat kaba nga don na ka bynta u khuid jong nga bad ïa lade . Kata kan dei ka jingbam ïathaw jong ngi , bad nangta ngin sa ïapthngan .
translation.en: And she said , As the  Lord  thy God liveth , I have not a cake , but an handful of meal in a barrel , and a little oil in a cruse : and , behold , I am gathering two sticks , that I may go in and dress it for me and my son , that we may eat it , and die .

translation.kha: U tharai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
So these young men of the princes of the provinces came out of the city , and the army which followed them .
translation.kha: Ki shipai samla kiba la ïalam ïa ka jingtur ïaleh , ïa kiba la bud da ka kynhun shipai Israel ,
El lang bad sngi , phi ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob , shahshkor ïa u Israel u kpa lad pa’ .
translation.en: Gather yourselves together , and hear , ye sons of Jacob  ; and hearken unto Israel your father .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la mihnoh na kata ka jaka bad u la leit phai pat Sha la shnong ; ki synran ki dud ïa u .
translation.en: And he went out from thence , and came into his own country  ; and his disciples follow him .
How long wilt thou not depart from me , nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle ?
translation.kha: Balei mem shu phai noh shawei tang shipor , ba ngan ïoh nguid ïa la ka umbiah ?

translation.en: A window shalt thou make to the ark , and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above  ; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof  ; with lower , second , and third stories shalt thou make it .
translation.kha: Thaw ruh ka tnum ïa kata ka lieng bad pyllait jaka kumba sawphew saw sentimitar hapdeng ka tnum bad ki krung . Shna ïa ka lai mala bad buh ïa ka jingkhang ha krung jong ka .
Wat pynriam ïa por , A Bel , Ïathuh ïa nga ! Kaei ka jingmudui pyrthuh ïa nga ?
translation.en: I will say unto God , Do not condemn me  ; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me .

translation.kha: U jaboh u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih bad u kup da ka jait khain . U la ïam sngewsih bun sngi na ka bynda u khun lad u .
translation.en: And Jacob rent his clothes , and put sackcloth upon his loins , and mourned for his son many days .

translation.kha: A Trai , me long uta uba ïadei ïa nga bad uba ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ; me ïarap ïa nga ha ki por jingjynjar . Ki jingïohipaw kmen wan sha me na kiba kut jong ka pyrthei bad ong , Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kim shym la don ei ei hynriew tang ki blei thala , ym don ei ei hynrei tang ki bleithaw bymmyntoi .
translation.en: O  Lord  , my strength , and my fortress , and my refuge in the day of affliction , the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth , and shall say , Surely our fathers have inherited lies , vanity , and things wherein there is no profit .
Who hath enjoined him his way ? or who can say , Thou hast wrought iniquity ?
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba lah ban ong ïa U Blei aïu un leh lane kynnoh ïa u ba u leh bymman .
Pynbna , un pynjyrngam ïa u blei uba ïaduna ïa ki kut . Un ai ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki maïan , bad kiwei kiwei ki jingtieng babha sha u blei naba ki kpa tymmen jong u kam shngiam la ju mane .
translation.en: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces : and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold , and silver , and with precious stones , and pleasant things .

translation.kha: Ka Synduk ka Jingthoh U Blei ka khong hangta ha Bethel ha kito ki sngi , bad u Nibhas , u khun jong u Eleasar bad u khun ksiew jong u Haron , u khmih ïa ka , ki briew ki kylli ïa U tharai , Hato ngin leit ïaleh pyrshah biang ïa ki Benjamin , ki per jait jong ngi , ne ngin keiñ nala ? U Tiras u jubab , Ïaleit pyrshah ïa ki . Lashai ka sngi ngan ai ïa ka jingjop ha phi .
translation.en: And Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron , stood before it in those days , ) saying , Shall I yet again go out to battle against the children of Benjamin my brother , or shall I cease ? And the  Lord  said , Go up  ; for to morrow I will deliver them into thine hand .

translation.kha: U Sephanaïah u khulom jong u Mattan , u Gedalaïah u khun jong u bashukor , u Jehukal u khun jong u Shelemaïah , bad u Pashhur u khwan jong u Malkhaïah ki la ïohsngew ba at la nguh ïa ki paidbah ba
translation.en: Then Shephatiah the son of Mattan , and Gedaliah the son of Pashur , and Jucal the son of Shelemiah , and Pashur the son of Malchijah , heard the words that Jeremiah had spoken unto all the people , saying ,

translation.kha: Kumta u la mareh ha shuwa jong ki paidbah bad u la kiew ïa u dieng Sykomore ban ïohi ïa U Jisu , uba dih ba-bang ïasaid lyngba sakma ka lynti .
translation.en: And he ran before , and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him : for he was to pass that way .
Thou believest that there is one God  ; thou doest well : the devils also believe , and tremble .
translation.kha: Hato phi ngeit ba don tang uwei U Blei ? Kata ka bha ! Ki ksuid ruh ki ngeit — bad ki kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng !

translation.en: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon , throughout their families , and by the house of their fathers ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Buh jingthoh ïa ki shynrang ba la kha nyngkong baroh jong ki Israel naduh kiba shi bnai lane kham heh , bad ñiew ïa ki kyrteng jong ki .

translation.en: Then they suborned men , which said , We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses , and against God .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la pynbam pisa ïa ki katto katne ki rangbah ban ong ,  Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u ba u da kren pyrshah ïa u Moses bad pyrshah ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them , and shewed them all the house of his precious things , the silver , and the gold , and the spices , and the precious ointment , and all the house of his armour , and all that was found in his treasures : there was nothing in his house , nor in all his dominion , that Hezekiah shewed them not .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nonglamktien bad u pyn-i ha ki ïa ka spah ka phew jong u — ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong u , ki musli musla bad ki jingiwbih jong u , bad baroh ki tiar thma ki jong u . Ym don shuh kano kano kaba don ha ki jaka buh tiar jong u lane hangno hangno ha ka hima jong u kaba um shym la pyn-i ha ki .

U Trei u la thaw ïa ki khlur , ki Pleïades bad Ephron , u pynkylla ïa ka jingdum sha ka jingiaseng mynsngi , bad ïa ka sngi sha ka miet . U khiat na ka bynta ki um jong ka duriaw bad theh ïa ki ha sla khyndew . Ka kyrteng jong u ka dei U Trai .
translation.en: Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion , and turneth the shadow of death into the morning , and maketh the day dark with night : that calleth for the waters of the sea , and poureth them out upon the face of the earth : The  Lord  is his name :

translation.kha: Kumba u ju leh , u Paul u la saw sha ka synagog . Hangne , ha ki lai tylli ki sngi Sabbaton u la ïatainia bad ki paidbah ,
translation.en: And Paul , as his manner was , went in unto them , and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures ,

translation.kha: ka Nibshan , ka nongbah Mluh , bad ka jingïadei : hynriew tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongri sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: And Nibshan , and the city of Salt , and En–gedi  ; six cities with their villages .

translation.kha: kaba pynkylla maw ïa ka um , mala kaba pynkhriat ïa ka sla duriaw ?
translation.en: The waters are hid as with a stone , and the face of the deep is frozen .

translation.kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka la trei bad ki bad ka la kad kew haduh ban da dem ot loit ïa u barli bad ïa u kew baroh . Sin ka la ïasdang sah malade la ka kiaw khrum .
translation.en: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest  ; and dwelt with her mother in law .

translation.kha: Khie kitei wad ha-ei u dat , u syiem u Hukum , bad ngan sa Phah skum ïa u . Haba la ïaheh ba u Elisha u don ha Dothan ,
translation.en: And he said , Go and spy where he is , that I may send and fetch him . And it was told him , saying , Behold , he is in Dothan .
They are new every morning : great is thy faithfulness .
translation.kha: Ka pyngngad kum ka step , ka thikna kum ka jingmih ka sngi .
Baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka ktang katba khraw bad kaba kynja syiem jong u . Uba Khuid longkmie ma u !
translation.en: Let them praise thy great and terrible name  ; for it is holy .

translation.kha: Ka la don hangta lai bnai , bad U Trai u kyrkhu ïa u Obed Edom bad ïa ka longïing jongngi u .
translation.en: And the ark of the  Lord  continued in the house of Obed–edom the Gittite three months : and the  Lord  blessed Obed–edom , and all his household .

translation.kha: ( .—Salm 26 :12 ; 119 :1 ) Kine ki jingïalang ki plie lad pun ïakynduh bad ban ïa kren-ïa khana bad ki Nongsakhi ibha na kiwei ki balang ne na kiwei pat ki jaka .
translation.en: ( Psalm 26 :12 , footnote  ; 111 :1 ) These gatherings create an opportunity to meet and associate with Witnesses from other congregations or even from other lands .
A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment .
translation.kha: Ki nongbishar kiba bamsap ki pdiang ïa ki jingai ha kaba rieh , bad nangta kam don ka jingbishar hok .

Pynban um shym la pynpei ïa ki khun ki kiei jongu ki , hynrei u la bud ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la hukum ha Ka sah” u Moses : Ïa ki kmie ki kpa ym dei ban pynïap nalor ki kad sniew ba la leh da ki khun jong ki , bad ïa ki khwan ym dei ban pynïap namar ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki kmie ki Kpa jong ki ; ïa u briew dei shun pynïap tang Namarba ka kam snem ka ma u hi u la leh .
translation.en: But he slew not their children , but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses , where the  Lord  commanded , saying , The fathers shall not die for the children , neither shall the children die for the fathers , but every man shall die for his own sin .
But what went ye out for to see ? A man clothed in soft raiment ? behold , they that wear soft clothing are in kings  houses .
translation.kha: Ïa kaei phi ïaleit ban peit ? Ïa u briew uba la kup da ki jaiñ ba-itynnat ? Ki briew kiba riam kumta ki shong ki sah ha ki ïingsyiem !
Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , mluh ïa la u bastad ! Ngi lah shuh kerkut ! Ki ïatur ïaleh ïa u Nongïalam ki Israel !
translation.en: Now gather thyself in troops , O daughter of troops : he hath laid siege against us : they shall smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek .
Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled , and his countenance was changed in him , and his lords were astonished .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingjynjar jingmut u syiem Belshassar u la nang kham lieh blaid blaid , bad ki rangbah donburom jong u kim tip shuh kumno yn leh .

Nga la leh ïa kane namsop ba ki la la kyntait ïa ki hukum jong nga , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ki Aiñ Jong nga , ki la pyntngit ïa ka Sabbaton , bad mane ïa kynsi ki bleithaw kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki la shakuriaw .
translation.en: Because they had not executed my judgments , but had despised my statutes , and had polluted my sabbaths , and their eyes were after their fathers  idols .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ïajubab , Abner , hato mem dei u briew uba khraw tad ha Israel ? Haba kumta , barli mem ïadait ïa u syiem , u kynrad jong me ? Myntan uwei u briew u la ïohrung ha ka ïohnang bad ban pynïap ïa u syiad kynrad jong me .
translation.en: And David said to Abner , Art not thou a valiant man ? and who is like to thee in Israel ? wherefore then hast thou not kept thy lord the king ? for there came one of the people in to destroy the king thy lord .
A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you : ye shall not sow , neither reap that which groweth of itself in it , nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed .
translation.kha: Phim dei ban bet ha ki lyngkha jong phi lane ot ïa u kew uba shu mih hi lane kheit ïa ki soh na ki brisoh jong phi kiba phim shym la khyllad .
Khie leit ! Nga phah ïa phi kum ki khunlangbrot hapdeng ki suri .
translation.en: Go your ways : behold , I send you forth as lambs among wolves .
And the guard stood , every man with his weapons in his hand , round about the king , from the right corner of the temple to the left corner of the temple , along by the altar and the temple .
translation.kha: bad u pynïeng ïa ki rangbah kiba don ki waitlam ba la sei lypa ha baroh ki bynta ba sha khmat ka Templ , ban ïada ïa u syiem .

translation.en: Then they cried out with a loud voice , and stopped their ears , and ran upon him with one accord ,
translation.kha: Da ka jingpyrta bajam ki dkhot jong ka Dorbar ki la set ïa la ki shkor da la ki kti . Nangta baroh ki la tur sha u hangta hi , ki la bret ïa u shabar ka nongbah , bad ki la lynthem maw ïa u .

U Trai u jubab , Phi tur ïaleh ïa ki briew lad nga kum ki nongshniah . Ki rangbah ki wan blei na ka thma , da kaban pyrkhat ba kin Shaneng ha ïing , hynrei hangta ki shem , ïa kiba ap ban tuh noh ïa ki jaiñphong na ka met jong ki .
translation.en: Even of late my people is risen up as an enemy : ye pull off the robe with the garment from them that pass by securely as men averse from war .

translation.kha: Ka ba-ieit tep mynsiem jong nga , ka nongleitkurim jong nga , ka longkmie ka ksar barieh , ka kper ba la ker kynroh , ka nongpule bymïap dei paidbah ;
translation.en: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters , washed with milk , and fitly set .
And when all these kings were met together , they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom , to fight against Israel .
translation.kha: Kine ki syiem baroh ki la ïasoh lang kawei bad ki la wan lang ban sher dara harud ka Wahduid Meron ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
U Dabid u ong ha u Saul , Syiem Kynrad , mano mano ruh kim dei ban tieng ïa une u Phrygia ! Ngan leit shun ïabah ïa u .
translation.en: And David said to Saul , Let no man s heart fail because of him  ; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine .

translation.kha: Hangno hangno ha kaba la pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , to sah ha kajuh ka ïing tad haduh ba phin da mihnoh na kata ka shnong ;
translation.en: And whatsoever house ye enter into , there abide , and thence depart .

translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngaid u Gad u la leit sha u Dabid , bad u ong ha u , Khie leit Shaei sha ka jaka shoh kew jong u Araunah dara tei ka dil ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And Gad came that day to David , and said unto him , Go up , rear an altar unto the  Lord  in the threshingfloor of Araunah the Jebusite .

And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat , and Jehoram , and Ahaziah , his fathers , kings of Judah , had dedicated , and his own hallowed things , and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and in the king s house , and sent it to Hazael king of Syria : and he went away from Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Joash u syiem ka Judah u shim lut ïa baroh ki jingai ba kiba ha shuwa jong u , u Jehoshaphat , u Jehoram , bad u Ahasaïah ki la pynkyntang sha U  Trai  , u kynthup lang ïa ki jingai jong u bad ka ksiar baroh kaba ha ki ïing jingkynshew jong ka Templ bad ka ïingsyiem , bad u phah ïa kita baroh kum ka jingai sngewbha sha u syiem Hasael , uba ïalam noh ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u na Jerusalem .

translation.en: Few things are as fascinating as the good news from God .
translation.kha: Ïa kane ka khubor ka babha na U Blei ym lah ban ïanujor bad kaei kaei ruh .

translation.en: So they came into the land of Egypt : for they obeyed not the voice of the  Lord  : thus came they even to Tahpanhes .
translation.kha: Kim shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum U  Trai  bad ki la leit sha Ijipt jngai shaduh ka nongbah Tahpanhes .
To ïakylli iwei ïa iwei pat da ka jingïadoh jong ka jingieit Khrismas . To ka jingsuk kan un-long ïa phi baroh kba dei ki jong U Khrist .
translation.en: Greet ye one another with a kiss of charity . Peace be with you all that are in Christ Jesus . Amen .

translation.kha: Ai ha u kyndiang ka iktiar jong me , khnai ba u paidbah un kohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him , that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient .
And it came to pass , as he went to Jerusalem , that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u don ha la ka lynti sha Jerusalem , u la leit na ka pud hapdeng ka Samaria bad ka Galilaïa .

Ibbah ïateh lakam bad phi ki la shukor ïa phi ; ki la beh noh ïa phi na la ka ri . Ki briew babha ïasuk malade phi , mynta ki la ioh ïa phi . Kito ki paralok kiba ju ïabam lang bad phiah , ki la pynap jingrisa ïa phira ; ki ong shaphang jong phi , ‘ shano kato ka jingïa-ïaid baroh’ ba u don ?’
translation.en: All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border : the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee , and prevailed against thee  ; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee : there is none understanding in him .

translation.kha: Ka jingkraw bymshisha kaba bahkhlieh ïa kaei ba phi pyrkhat shuwa ka long kum ka jingsop ïit ha u khiew khyndew ibha tat-dor .
translation.en: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross .
And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt , and out of all lands .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kulai na ka bynta u Solomon la wan kit na Musri bad na kiwei pat ki ri .
Me hi manna ïoh ka jingpang bajur ha ki snier ka ban kham jur na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat .
translation.en: And thou shalt have great sickness by disease of thy bowels , until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day .

translation.kha: U ïingjaiñ ha ka jaka ïeng jong ki syiem , bad pynlong ka jutang bad U Tiras ban kohnguh ïa u , ban Sumar ïa ki Aïah bad ki hukum jrong u , da ka dohnud malu mynsiem jong u baroh bad ban leh ïa ki jingdawa kiba ïadat bad ka jutang kumba la thoin ha ka Bokhim . Sin baroh ki briew ki kular ba-bang ba-bang ïa ka jutang .
translation.en: And the king stood by a pillar , and made a covenant before the  Lord  , to walk after the  Lord  , and to keep his commandments and his testimonies and his statutes with all their heart and all their soul , to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book . And all the people stood to the covenant .

translation.kha: Kam long ka phylla , te , ba uwei pa uwei u ïeng ha ka jingtiengburom ïa u , bad ba um ñiew ïa kito kiba kam ba ki long kiba stad .
translation.en: Men do therefore fear him : he respecteth not any that are wise of heart .

And the  Lord  was gracious unto them , and had compassion on them , and had respect unto them , because of his covenant with Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob , and would not destroy them , neither cast he them from his presence as yet .
translation.kha: hynrei U  Trai  u long uba bha bad leh-isynei ïa ki . Um shah ba yn pynjot ïa ki , hynrei u ïarap ïa ki , namar ka jutang jong u bad u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob . Um pat ju klet ïa la ki briew .
Te lada uno uno u pynjot ïa ka templ jong U Blei , U Blei un pynïong ïa u . Naba ka templ jong U Blei ka long kiba khur , bad phin hi Phin long ka templ jong u .
translation.en: If any man defile the temple of God , him shall God destroy ; for the temple of God is holy , which temple ye are .
And the children of Israel spake unto Moses , saying , Behold , we die , we perish , we all perish .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki ong ha u Moses ,  Te kata ka dei kaba kut ïa ngi !
Kita kiba bieit ki la rah ïa la ki sharak hynne kim shym la ramhah tam ïa ka umphniang nabar ki ,
translation.en: They that were foolish took their lamps , and took no oil with them :

translation.kha: Da Shisha phi tip ba naduh ki por mynhyndai , mynba ïa u briew la thuh nyngkong ha ka pyrthei ,
translation.en: Knowest thou not this of old , since man was placed upon earth ,
In time , God’s Kingdom will even restore the peaceful relations that existed in the garden of Eden between animals , and between animals and humans .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ka Hima jong u Blei kan pynïoh pat ka jingsuk kaba ïadei bad kato kaba don ha ka Kper Eden hapdeng ki mrad , bad hapdeng ki mrad bad ki briew .

translation.en: And he said , I may not return with thee , nor go in with thee : neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place :
translation.kha: Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa uba na Judah u jubab ,  Ngam lah ban leit sha ïing bad phi lane pdiang ïa ka jinglehbha jong phi .
Men ïoh im uba skhem bad uba dap da ka jingkyrmen ; U Blei un ïada badno un ai jingthiah ïa me .
translation.en: And thou shalt be secure , because there is hope  ; yea , thou shalt dig about thee , and thou shalt take thy rest in safety .
Then said he unto him ,  A certain man made a great supper , and bade many :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  La don shisien uwei u briew uba la khreh ka jingkhawai kaba khraw ha kaba u la khot sngewbha bun ki briew .
Kumta uwei pa uwei na ki u la shim ïa la u khiew buhai dieng , u buh hangta ïa u rnga ding uba rhem bad ka jingiwbih , bad u ïeng ha ka jingthang ka Ïingjaiñ lem bad u Moses bad u Aaron .
translation.en: And they took every man his censer , and put fire in them , and laid incense thereon , and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron .

translation.kha: U kpa u dei ruh ban pynbiang ha la ïing ïa ki jingpyndem ba kynja mynsiem .
translation.en: A father must also provide for his family’s spiritual needs .
The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses  ; and as horsemen , so shall they run .
translation.kha: Ki i kum ki kulai ; ki mareh kum ki kulai thma .
Ki jaitbynriew kim long ei ei satia ha u .
translation.en: All nations before him are as nothing  ; and they are counted to him less than nothing , and vanity .

translation.kha: Kumba da shisha sa long U Blei naba im , phin kham bha ba phi shahshkor ïa nga . Ki langbrot jong nga ki la shah patar ha ki mradkhlaw kiba pynïap bad bam ïa ki namar bym don u nongsharai . Ki nongsharai jong to kim shym la pyrshang ba-bang wad ïa ki langbrot . Ki la sumar bha ïa lade bad ym ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely because my flock became a prey , and my flock became meat to every beast of the field , because there was no shepherd , neither did my shepherds search for my flock , but the shepherds fed themselves , and fed not my flock  ;
Thou shalt not oppress an hired servant that is poor and needy , whether he be of thy brethren , or of thy strangers that are in thy land within thy gates :
translation.kha: Wat shukor ïa u shakri uba bylla , uba duk bad uba kyrduh , la u dei u para Israel lane u nongwei uba shong ha ki shnong jong phi .
U Jisu u la jubab , Uno uno uba dih na kane ka um un sliang bapaw , hynne uno uno uba dih na ka um kaba ngan ai ha u un ym sneng shuh .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto her ,  Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again :

translation.kha: Ko bangeit jong por , to ñiew ïa lade ba phi long kiba donbok eh haba phi ïakynduh ïa ki jingtynjuh kiba bun ha ka lynti ka jingim jong phi , naba phi thop ba haba ka jingngeit jong Phi ka jop haba ïashem kum kita ki jingtynjuh , ka jingmeng ka long ka jinglah don ïakhih .
translation.en: Knowing this , that the trying of your faith worketh patience .
There the wicked cease from troubling  ; and there the weary be at rest .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingtep , ki riewbymman ki sangeh noh ban leh ki kam bymman , bad ki nongtrei ba la thait , khatduh ki ïoh jingjahthait .

Ki dieng sai-sawar kin san ha ka kajuh kaba Mynta ki don ki dieng shynraiñ ; ki diengthang Martl kin mih ha ka bakwah ki shiah . Kane kan longkmie ka dak ka ban neh junom , ka jingpynkynmaw ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai , nga la leh .
translation.en: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree , and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree : and it shall be to the  Lord  for a name , for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off .

translation.kha: da u lyoh jong ka jingbit shla jong me umbah rben katta katta ïa ki jingduwai jong ine ban ksam lyngba .
translation.en: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud , that our prayer should not pass through .
And that no man might buy or sell , save he that had the mark , or the name of the beast , or the number of his name .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ba lah ban thied ne die khlem don kane ka shab , kaba long , ka kyrteng jong u mradkhlaw lane u dak jingkheiñ uba ïeng na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u .

translation.en: And Achish believed David , saying , He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him  ; therefore he shall be my servant for ever .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Akhish u shaniah ïa u Dabid , u da ong ha lade ,  U la long uba la isih haduh katta katta da ki briew jong u hi ki Israel ba kumta un hap long u shakri ïa nga baroh shi rta .

U Isaak u Joab , Nga la pynlong ïa u , u kynrad halor jong me , bad nga la pynlong ïa ki kur ki jait jongu u ban hir ki mraw jong u . Nga la ai ha u ïa u khiew bad ka wieh . Mynta ngiam don ei ei shuh ba nga lah Ban leh na ka bynta jong me , ko khun ?
translation.en: And Isaac answered and said unto Esau , Behold , I have made him thy lord , and all his brethren have I given to him for servants  ; and with corn and wine have I sustained him : and what shall I do now unto thee , my son ?

translation.kha: Ka Templ ka long mynta kaba ïoh barim saihon , hynne kat uba ïaid najan jong ka un lyngngoh bad un kylliang , ‘ Balei ba U Trai u la leh kumne ïa Kane ka ri bad ïa kane ka Templ ?’
translation.en: And this house , which is high , shall be an astonishment to every one that passeth by it  ; so that he shall say , Why hath the  Lord  done thus unto this land , and unto this house ?

translation.kha: Bad kumta u Dabid u sngewthuh ba U Trei u la pynskhem ïa u kum u syiem ki Israel bad u la kyntiew ïa ka hima jyllang u na ka bynta ki brup jong u .
translation.en: And David perceived that the  Lord  had established him king over Israel , and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel s sake .
They that observe lying vanities forsake their own mercy .
translation.kha: Kito kiba mane ïa ki bleithaw bym don jingmyntoi ki la iehnoh na kaba ïaineh ha me .
U Trai un tdem ïa ki shnong bad ki lyngkhot jong phi .
translation.en: Cursed shalt thou be in the city , and cursed shalt thou be in the field .

translation.kha: Katto ka dang shahskhor seiñ kumta , ka la phah kti sha la u khot kurim : Nga la punkhun na uta u briew uba long u trai kine ki tiar . Peit ïa ki bad khmih ki dei ki jongno — kane ka muhor bad u ksai jong ka bad ine u jingdoh .
translation.en: When she was brought forth , she sent to her father in law , saying , By the man , whose these are , am I with child : and she said , Discern , I pray thee , whose are these , the signet , and bracelets , and staff .

translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi phim dei ban mih na ka jingkhan ka ïingjaiñ , tat ynda la pyndep lut ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkyntang .
translation.en: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days , until the days of your consecration be at an end : for seven days shall he consecrate you .

But because the  Lord  loved you , and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers , hath the  Lord  brought you out with a mighty hand , and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen , from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka long namar ba U  Trai  u ieit ïa phi bad u bat ïa la ka kular kaba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , bad namar kata u la ïalam noh ïa phi da ka borbah jong u bad u la pyllait na ka jinglongmraw ïa phi na u Pharaoh u syiem ka Ijipt .

Yn sa pynjot ïa ki kumno ïa ki mradkhlaw , bad kin iphuh shah ïa ka jingshahshitom kaba ki la pynlong . Ka jinglehbha ha ki ka long ban leh ïa kaei kaei ha kaba shai ka sngi ka ban pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai ka doh ; ki un-long ka jinglehrain bad ka jingïabam haba ki ïashun bam bad phi , katba ki nang leh sngewbha ha la ki lyntang bashlur !
translation.en: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness , as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time . Spots they are and blemishes , sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you  ;
Blessed is the man that doeth this , and the son of man that layeth hold on it  ; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it , and keepeth his hand from doing any evil .
translation.kha: Ngan kyrkhu ïa kito kiba ïai sumar ïa ka Sabbaton bad ki bym pyndonkam bakla ïa ka . Ngan kyrkhu ïa kito ki bym leh ïa kaei kaei kaba sniew .

translation.en: Night and day praying exceedingly that we might see your face , and might perfect that which is lacking in your faith ?
translation.kha: Mynsngi bad mynmiet ngi kyrpad ïa u da ka dohnud jong ngi baroh ban shah ïa ngi ban ïohi ïa phi markhmat bad ban pyndap ïa kaei kaba donkam ha ka jingngeit jong phi .
shaphang ka jait Naphtali u ong , U Naphtali u long uba la ïoh kyrhai ki jingkynnoh da ka jingsngewbha U Trai ; Ka ri jong ki shaphang shathie ka kot haduh duriaw Galilaïa .
translation.en: And of Naphtali he said , O Naphtali , satisfied with favour , and full with the blessing of the  Lord  : possess thou the west and the south .

translation.kha: hynrei u Jakob um shym phah ïa u Benjamin , u para trai jong u Joseph ba un kitei lak bad ki , namar u shemphang ïoh jia ei ei ïa u .
translation.en: But Benjamin , Joseph s brother , Jacob sent not with his brethren  ; for he said , Lest peradventure mischief befall him .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la kren ha ki Israel , bad uwei pa ti na ki jingïalam jong ki , ki la ai ha u mar uwei u diengkhap , uwei na ka bynta kawei Kawei ka jait , baroh ki long khat-ar tylli , badno ïa u jingdoh jong u Horon la buh slem bad ki .
translation.en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel , and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece , for each prince one , according to their fathers  houses , even twelve rods : and the rod of Aaron was among their rods .

translation.kha: U khleh ianga da ki khmat jongu .
translation.en: He thanked me with his eyes .

Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth , and the blood of his sons , saith the  Lord   ; and I will requite thee in this plat , saith the  Lord . Now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground , according to the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: ‘ Nga la ïohi mynhynnin ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u Naboth bad ki khun shynrang jong u . Bad nga kular ba ngan pynshitom kylliang ïa me ha kane hi ka jaka .’ Kumta shim ïa ka met jong u Joram ,  u Jehu u hukum ïa u nongbud jong u ,  bad leit bret ïa ka ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Naboth , khnang ban pyndep ïa ka jingkular jong U  Trai .

Khroh ïa U Trai U Blei ki Israel , u Nongthaw ïa ka bneng bad ka khynñiuh ! U la ai ha u symboh Dabid , ïa u khun uba stad , uba dap da ka jingshemphang badno ka jingtbit , uba mandriek u thma ban tei ka Templ na ka bynta U Trai bun ka ïingsyiem na ka bynta ïa lade .
translation.en: Huram said moreover , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , that made heaven and earth , who hath given to David the king a wise son , endued with prudence and understanding , that might build an house for the  Lord  , and an house for his kingdom .

translation.kha: Ka duriaw ka la tyllep ïa ka Babilon bad tap da ki jingit phyllung bakyrhuh .
translation.en: The sea is come up upon Babylon : she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof .
O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : because his mercy endureth for ever .
translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U  Trai  , naba u long uba bha ; bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
Nga ïohi ïa kaei kaei baïar kiba ki leh . Ym don kano kano kaba la ibhabriew na nga ; ki nongpop jong ki kim lait pher na ka jingïohi jong to .
translation.en: For mine eyes are upon all their ways : they are not hid from my face , neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai’ , de wad ïa ki jingmut bad nga tynjuh ïa ki dohnud jong ki briew . Nga leh ïa nawei pa nawei katai khem ka lynti ba u im , kato kum kaei kaba u leh .
translation.en: I the  Lord  search the heart , I try the reins , even to give every man according to his ways , and according to the fruit of his doings .

translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut , Ïa ka Sabbaton la thaw na ka boitha ka jingkha u briew ; ïa u briew ym shym la thaw na ka bynta ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  The sabbath was made for man , and not man for the sabbath :
Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing , and obtaineth favour of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Haba shem ïa ka tnga , phi shem ïa kaei kaba bha ; ka pynpaw ba U  Trai  u lehbha ïa phi .

La pynphai pat ïa ki pisa jong nga , u la khot ïa la ki hynmen shynrang . Kane hangne ha ka byrni jong nga ! Mar kumta ki rit mynsiem ria , bad da kambah bymsheptieng ki ïakylli la ma ki , Kawei kew kane kaba U Blei u la leh ïa ngi ?
translation.en: And he said unto his brethren , My money is restored  ; and , lo , it is even in my sack : and their heart failed them , and they were afraid , saying one to another , What is this that God hath done unto us ?

translation.kha: Hadad kane ka por baroh , ki nongïalam ki Jiw ki la ïadon hateng ka jingteh shithi bad u Tobiah .
translation.en: Moreover in those days the nobles of Judah sent many letters unto Tobiah , and the letters of Tobiah came unto them .

translation.kha: Lada phan jin da la pyntip mynta ïa kaei kaba donkam na ka bynta ka jingsuk ! Hynrei mynta pham lah ban ïoh ïa ka !
translation.en: Saying ,  If thou hadst known , even thou , at least in this thy day , the things which belong unto thy peace ! but now they are hid from thine eyes .

translation.kha: Phi tap ba ngi la wahbah biang sha phi na Kanaan ïa kito ki pisa ba ngi lap ha khlieh ki byrni jrong ngi . Balei keiñ ngin lytar tuh kat ïa ka rupa ne ksiar na ka ïohnong u kynrad jong phi ?
translation.en: Behold , the money , which we found in our sacks  mouths , we brought again unto thee out of the land of Canaan : how then should we steal out of thy lord s house silver or gold ?

translation.kha: U Tom u sei ia u shabi pynlang u plie ia ka jingkhang .
translation.en: Tom pulled out his key and opened the door .
And when the thousand years are expired , Satan shall be loosed out of his prison ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki shihajar snem ki la kut , yn pyllait ïa u Soitan na ka byndi jong u ,
hynrei kita kiei kiei baroh kaba nga da ban ñiew kum ka jingpynkoit ; ïa kine , nga la ñiew mynta ka jingduh na ka bynta U Khrist .
translation.en: But what things were gain to me , those I counted loss for Christ .
And Atroth Shophan , and Jaazer , and Jogbehah ,
translation.kha: Atroth Shophan , Jaser , Jogbehah ,
Ko ki khun jong nga , to phin ri kyndong ïa lade” na ki blei ba-thala !
translation.en: Little children , keep yourselves from idols . Amen .

translation.kha: Kumta te , une uno uba ïohpdiang ïa Kine ki ktien jngai nga bad uba kohnguh ïa ki u long kumta u briew uba stad uba la tei ïa la ka ïing halor u mawsiang .
translation.en: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them , I will liken him unto a wise man , which built his house upon a rock :

translation.kha: Ka kmie jongki u Sisera ka la khmih na ka jingkhangïit ; Ka la phngoid na shadien ka jingker . Balei ka kali ïamih jong u ka slem ban wan ? ka la ong . Balei ki kulai jong u ki tud ïa-ban wan phai ?
translation.en: The mother of Sisera looked out at a window , and cried through the lattice , Why is his chariot so long in coming ? why tarry the wheels of his chariots ?

translation.kha: U Bel u la ai ha u Solomon ïa ka jingwad bad ka jingsngewthuh kiba kham phah , bad ïa ka jingot kaba khraw palat ïa ka ban thew .
translation.en: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much , and largeness of heart , even as the sand that is on the sea shore .
And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry : and I will multiply them , and they shall not be few  ; I will also glorify them , and they shall not be small .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sah hangta kin rwai ïaroh ; kin pyrta jam da ka jingkmen . Da ka jingkyrkhu jong nga kin roi ha ka jingbun paid ; ka jingkyrkhu jong nga kan wallam ha ki ka burom .

Nangta uwei na ki suba kyrteng u Harbonah , u ong , U Hammon u la dep ïaid shaphrang ha kiba u la sha ïa ka diengphasi ha ka ïing jong u khnang ba un phasi ïa u marwei , umbiah pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi , ko syiem . Bad ka long kaba jrong arphew ar mirr ! Sdien phasi ïa u Haman ha ka ! u syiem u Hukum .
translation.en: And Harbona , one of the chamberlains , said before the king , Behold also , the gallows fifty cubits high , which Haman had made for Mordecai , who had spoken good for the king , standeth in the house of Haman . Then the king said , Hang him thereon .

translation.kha: U Petros , uba la dap da U Mynsiem bakhia , u la jubab ïa ki , Ko nongïalap jong ki paidbah bad ko ki tymmen ki san :
translation.en: Then Peter , filled with the Holy Ghost , said unto them , Ye rulers of the people , and elders of Israel ,

translation.kha: Kin jin da la dei ngab kwah ïa ka jingkmen ba u ai ; kin jin da la dem ban duli borabor ïa u .
translation.en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty ? will he always call upon God ?
Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever , and forsake us so long time ?
translation.kha: Balei ba me la iehnoh ïa ngi slem katta katta ? Hato men dang kynmaw biang ïa ngi ?
bad U Blei , uba kop ïa ki jingpyrkhat jrong uwei pa uwei , u la pyn-i ïa ka jingmynjur ïa ki jingtylli da kaba ai ïa U mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki , Rumah u la leh ha I .
translation.en: And God , which knoweth the hearts , bare them witness , giving them the Holy Ghost , even as he did unto us  ;

translation.kha: ki la wan ban shahshkor ïa u bad ban ïoh jingkhiah na ki jingpang jong ki . Kito kiba la shah pynhiar da ki mynsiem bymman ruh ki la wan bad la pynkhiah ïa ki .
translation.en: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits : and they were healed .
And these are the years of the life of Ishmael , an hundred and thirty and seven years : and he gave up the ghost and died  ; and was gathered unto his people .
translation.kha: U Ishmael u ïap haba u la dap shispah laiphew hynñiew snem ka rta .

translation.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul , Thou art permitted to speak for thyself . Then Paul stretched forth the hand , and answered for himself :
translation.kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Paul ,  La shah ïa me ban kren na ka bynta ïa lade .  U Paul u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ïasaid da ïa lade kumne :
Ka longïing kaba khlaiñ bun ïoh burom , dara kam sheptieng ïa ka lawei .
translation.en: Strength and honour are her clothing  ; and she shall rejoice in time to come .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga kular skhem ba kumba at longkmie uba im bad kumba ka jingdon jong nga ka dap ïa ka pyrthei baroh ,
translation.en: But as truly as I live , all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the  Lord .
And Joseph was brought down to Egypt  ; and Potiphar , an officer of Pharaoh , captain of the guard , an Egyptian , bought him of the hands of the Ishmaelites , which had brought him down thither .
translation.kha: Mynta ki nong Ishmael ki la ïalam ïa u Joseph sha ka ri Ijipt bad ki die ïa u ha u Potiphar , uwei na ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem , uba long u kapten jong kiba ap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem .
‘ Ngim dei ki nongsyntiat ,’ ngi la jubab , ‘ Ngi dei kaba probins .
translation.en: And we said unto him , We are true men  ; we are no spies :
And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him  ; and they feared the people : for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them .
translation.kha: Ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa U Jisu hangta hi , namar ki la tip ba u la ïathuh ïa kane ka pharshi pyrshah ïa ki ; hynrei ki la ïasheptieng ïa ki paidbah .
sheng hadien ba u Sedekaïah u la long u skhem ka Judah , U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la kren ha por shaphang ka ri Elam .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah , saying ,

translation.kha: Hato men ym khmih ïa nga , A Blei , lane buh ïa nga ha ka jingbynrap sad jingtian bishar ?
translation.en: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one , and bringest me into judgment with thee ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong shuh shuh , Ka Hima U Bel ka ong kumne . U Briew u bet symbai ha la ka lyngka .
translation.en: And he said ,  So is the kingdom of God , as if a man should cast seed into the ground  ;
This is the bread which cometh down from heaven , that a man may eat thereof , and not die .
translation.kha: Hynrei u kpu uba wan hiar na bneng u long uta ïa uba uno uno uba bam ïa u un ym ïap .
U Rephah u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah jongki u Dabid badno u khun lad u , u Abijah u long syiemsad ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers , and was buried in the city of David : and Abijah his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Lada ki mraw uba phut na la u kynrad ki wan wan jingïada na phi , thew phah pat ïa ki sha u kynrad jong ki .
translation.en: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee :

translation.kha: Henadad ar bnai ka wan phai Sha la u kpa . U leh kumba u la kular ha U Trai , bad ka la ïap haba ka dang sotti . Ken ka la long ka thymmei ïa ka ban bud kumto ka rukom ha Israhaïah
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of two months , that she returned unto her father , who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed : and she knew no man . And it was a custom in Israel ,

translation.kha: U kput jong u , u ithuh shai ïing kata ka kynthei , bad u Samson u pynlong ka jingkhawai hangno . “Kane ka lama kaba ki ju leh hapdeng ki na samla shynrang .
translation.en: So his father went down unto the woman : and Samson made there a feast  ; for so used the young men to do .

And all these thy servants shall come down unto me , and bow down themselves unto me , saying , Get thee out , and all the people that follow thee : and after that I will go out . And he went out from Pharaoh in a great anger .
translation.kha: U Moses u pynkut da kaba ong ,  Ki rangbah synshar jong phi baroh kin sa wan sha nga bad dem khrup ha khmat jong nga , bad kin sa kyrpad ïa nga ban ïalam noh ïa ki briew jong nga baroh bad ban mihnoh . Hadien kata ngan sa leit .  Nangta u Moses u mihnoh na u Pharaoh da ka jingbitar bakhraw .

translation.en: Ephraim feedeth on wind , and followeth after the east wind : he daily increaseth lies and desolation  ; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians , and oil is carried into Egypt .
translation.kha: Kaei kaei baroh ba ki paid Israel ki leh naduh mynstep haduh da miet ka long ka bymmyntoi bad kaba pynjot . Ka jingshetkylla bad ki jingleh jubor ki nang jyllei hapdeng jong ki . Ki ïateh jutang bad ka Assyria , bad ki ïakhaïi bad ka Ijipt .
Ki briew naba sniew ki pyningkhong miaw ïa ki khunswet ba ïan riew bad ki shim ïa ki khun jong u briew uba duk kum ka jingseisoh ïa ki ram .
translation.en: They pluck the fatherless from the breast , and take a pledge of the poor .

translation.kha: Kata ka longsem balei ba ki khmat jong nga ki shlei da ki ummat . Ym don mano Mano ba lah ban pyntngen ïa sa ; ym don mano mano ba lah ba-bang ai jingshlur ïa nga . U nongshun u la jop ïa sa ; ki brup jong nga kim don ei ei shuh kaba sah .
translation.en: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee : they hiss and gnash the teeth : they say , We have swallowed her up : certainly this is the day that we looked for  ; we have found , we have seen it .

translation.kha: U ïaleh da kaweh shlur nabar u jop wat ïa ki paid Elimelekh . U la pyllait im ïa ki Jeriel na baroh’ ki jingtur ïaleh .
translation.en: And he gathered an host , and smote the Amalekites , and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them .

translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun , leh kumba nga ong .
translation.en: Now therefore , my son , obey my voice  ; and arise , flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran  ;
And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite , whose name was Shua  ; and he took her , and went in unto her .
translation.kha: Hangta u Judah u la ïakynduh ïa ka samla nong Kanaan uba u kpa jong ka u kyrteng u Shua .
Shaphang ka jai Dan u ong , U dat u dadien u sing samla ; Na Bashan u mih kynshoit .
translation.en: And of Dan he said , Dan is a lion s whelp : he shall leap from Bashan .
And the land had rest forty years . And Othniel the son of Kenaz died .
translation.kha: La don ka jingsuk ha ka ri haduh sawphew snem , bad nangta u Othniel u la ïap .
