Naba thiang shi pisa phira lah ban thied ar tylli ki ja-um ïing , pynban ym don kawei ka sim ïing kaban hap ha ka khyndew khlem ka jingshah U kpu jong phi .
translation.en: Are not two sparrows sold for a farthing ? and one of them shall not fall on the ground without your Father .

translation.kha: Nga la jingïohknieh ïa ka sur kaba pyrta na shiliang ka wah Ulai , Ko Gabriel , to batai ïa u ïa ka jingmut jong kadei kaba u la ïohi .
translation.en: And I heard a man s voice between the banks of Ulai , which called , and said , Gabriel , make this man to understand the vision .

And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king , saying , Two measures of barley for a shekel , and a measure of fine flour for a shekel , shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria :
translation.kha: U Elisha u la ïathuh ha u syiem ba ha kaba kum kata ka por ha ka sngi kaba bud lai kilo u kew uba bha tam lane hynriew kilo u barli yn die ha Samaria ha ka dor shi sbai rupa ,
Hynrei ka Hukum kam don ei ei ban leh bad ka jingngeit . Pynban kumba ka Jingthoh bakthang ka ong , Jar uba leh ïa baroh ïa kaweh ka hukum ka dawa un ïoh im .
translation.en: And the law is not of faith : but , The man that doeth them shall live in them .

translation.kha: Kin nang ïai ar pop shuh shuh da kaba saiñ ïa ki durblei ban mane — ki bleithaw naba da ka rupa , kiba la saiñdur da ka jingpyut briew , ba la shna da ki kti briew . Bad nangta ki ong , Ai ki jingkylla shata ki ! Kumno ki briew kin doh ïa kito ki bleithaw — ki bleithaw ha ka dur ki masi kyrtong !
translation.en: And now they sin more and more , and have made them molten images of their silver , and idols according to their own understanding , all of it the work of the craftsmen : they say of them , Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves .
And they entered in , and found not the body of the Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: hynrei kim shym shem ïa ka met jong U Trai Jisu .

translation.en: But since ye say , The burden of the  Lord   ; therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Because ye say this word , The burden of the  Lord  , and I have sent unto you , saying , Ye shall not say , The burden of the  Lord   ;
translation.kha: Bad lada kim kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga bad pyndonkam ïa ki ktien , ‘ Ka jingkit U  Trai  ,’
A Trai U Blei , me la shah ïa por ban long syiem hadien i pa jong nga , wat la nga dang khynnah bad ngam tip kumno ban synshar .
translation.en: And now , O  Lord  my God , thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father : and I am but a little child : I know not how to go out or come in .

translation.kha: Ai shaw nga u khlup .
translation.en: Pass me the pen .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , ki khluit kum ka tyndur da ki jingïasylla jong ki . Baroh shi miet , ka jingbitar jong ki ka at ing , sad mynstep ka mih kynsan kum ki thylliej jing .
translation.en: For they have made ready their heart like an oven , whiles they lie in wait : their baker sleepeth all the night  ; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire .

translation.kha: U Shallum , u khun jong u Kolhoseh , u nongsynshar ïa ka Mispah distrik , u tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Umpohliew . U siang ïa ka lyndet kiba poi shai ka khrawbor , u pynïeng ïa ka khyrdop , bad pyndait ïa ki khang Bad ïa ki jingkhang ka khyrdep . Ha ka Pungsum Shelah , u tei ïa ka khyrdop marbud ïa ka kper syiem , haduh ki mawjam kiba hiar sha ka Nongbah u Dabid .
translation.en: But the gate of the fountain repaired Shallun the son of Col–hozeh , the ruler of part of Mizpah  ; he built it , and covered it , and set up the doors thereof , the locks thereof , and the bars thereof , and the wall of the pool of Siloah by the king s garden , and unto the stairs that go down from the city of David .
And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Seest thou these great buildings ? there shall not be left one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab  Phi ïoh kine ki jingtei bakhraw ? Ïa uwei u maw ruh yn ym iehnoh ha ka jaka jong u ; ïa uwei pa uwei na ki yn sa pynkhyllem noh .

translation.en: And they came to the chief priests and elders , and said , We have bound ourselves under a great curse , that we will eat nothing until we have slain Paul .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad sha ki tymmen ki san bad ki la ong ,  Ngi la pynlong lang ka jingsmai ba sngewkhia ban ym bam kano kano tad ynda ngi la pynïap ïa u Paul .

Kumta ki la ot noh ïa ki angkor badno ki la shah ïa ki ba kin ngam ha ka duriaw , badno ha kajuh ka por ki la pynkylluid ïa ki tyllai kiba la bat ïa ki boitha . Nangta ki la kynthei ïa ka jaiñ pynshah reng ha ka bynta ba sha khmat jong ka lieng khnang ba ka lyer ka lah ban beh ïa ka lynti sha khmat , bad ngi la ïadih pait shaw ka jingkraw .
translation.en: And when they had taken up the anchors , they committed themselves unto the sea , and loosed the rudder bands , and hoisted up the mainsail to the wind , and made toward shore .
For we commend not ourselves again unto you , but give you occasion to glory on our behalf , that ye may have somewhat to answer them which glory in appearance , and not in heart .
translation.kha: Ngim pyrshang biang ban ïaroh ïa lade ha khmat jong phi ; pynban , ngi pyrshang ban ai ha phi ïa ka daw kaba biang ba phin sngewsarong shaphang jong ngi , khnang ba phin lah ban ai jubab sha kito kiba sngewsarong shaphang kata kaba paw shabar jong u briew bad ym ha ka jinglong jingim jong u .

translation.en: For she doted upon their paramours , whose flesh is as the flesh of asses , and whose issue is like the issue of horses .
translation.kha: Ka la dap da ka jingkwah brai ïa ki rangbah ba-dap da ka jingbrai kiba don ka jingthrew jakhlia la kum ki kada bad ki khashor .
Ngi eh ïa ka jingstad na ki bynriew ba la phah ñiewshiliang — kito ïa ibha la kha ha shuwa u kpa jong me .
translation.en: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men , much elder than thy father .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Bel u peit khlur ki Nongïalam jong ki jlew , bad ki rangbah synrai ki Persia ki rai ban ym kuna ei ei haduh ba ngin da lah thoh shaei u Darius bad ïoh ïa ka jubab .
translation.en: But the eye of their God was upon the elders of the Jews , that they could not cause them to cease , till the matter came to Darius : and then they returned answer by letter concerning this matter .
Now we exhort you , brethren , warn them that are unruly , comfort the feebleminded , support the weak , be patient toward all men .
translation.kha: Ngi kyntu ïa phi , ko parabangeit jong ngi , ban maham ïa kiba jaipdeh , ban pynshlur ïa kiba khawpud , ban ïarap ïa kiba tlot , ban ïaishah ïa baroh .

translation.en: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool , and rewardeth transgressors .
translation.kha: U nongaikam uba khot bylla ïa uno uno uba bieit uba u ïakynduh , u long tang ban pynmynsaw kat ïa kiba ïatreilang .
Rakhe ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha ka por ba la buh man ka snem .
translation.en: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year .

translation.kha: ban kitkhlieh ha Kaba peit ïa u kpu ba la ieit sha U Blei , ïa u purew ba la ju pynmong ha ki jingainguh , ïa ki kpu stang kiba la shet khlem thiat , ïa ki jingainguh kiba shu syang , ïa u purew ba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang Olib , don tnaw ban woh ïa ki jingainguh ha ka Templ .
translation.en: Both for the shewbread , and for the fine flour for meat offering , and for the unleavened cakes , and for that which is baked in the pan , and for that which is fried , and for all manner of measure and size  ;

translation.kha: Me ong ïa nga pun shahshkor katba me dang kren bad ngab pyrshang ban jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong me .
translation.en: Hear , I beseech thee , and I will speak : I will demand of thee , and declare thou unto me .

And the golden mice , according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords , both of fenced cities , and of country villages , even unto the great stone of Abel , whereon they set down the ark of the  Lord  : which stone remaineth unto this day in the field of Joshua , the Beth–shemite .
translation.kha: Ki phah ruh ïa ki dur khnai kiba da ka ksiar , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka nongbah ba la synshar da ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia , ki shnong ba la ker kynroh bad ki bym shym la ker kynroh . Uta u mawbah ha ka lyngkha u Joshua uba ha Beth Shemesh , ha uba ki buh ïa ka synduk ka Jutang , u dang don hangta kum u sakhi haduh kane ka sngi ïa kaei kaba la jia .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Come up to me into the mount , and be there : and I will give thee tables of stone , and a law , and commandments which I have written  ; that thou mayest teach them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Wan kiew sha nga ha une u lum , bad katba me dang don hangne , ngan ai ha me ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kiba don ïa ki hukum baroh kiba nga la thoh na ka bynta ban hikai ïa ki briew .

translation.en: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son , whom he hath appointed heir of all things , by whom also he made the worlds  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kine ki sngi kiba khatduh u la kren ha ngi lyngba U Khun jong u . U la long uta da uba U Blei u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , uta ïa uba U Blei u la jied ban long u nongïoh kynti ïa kiei kiei baroh ha kaba kut .

translation.en: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon , and all Israel with him  ; and they encamped against it , and fought against it :
translation.kha: Nangta pat , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit na Lakhish sha Eglon , ki kerkut ïa ka , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
U Jisu u la ïa-ong pat ha ki , To ka jingkem kan long lem bad phi . Kumba U Kpa u la phah ïa nga , kumta ruh nga phah ïa phi .
translation.en: Then said Jesus to them again ,  Peace be unto you : as my Father hath sent me , even so send I you .
And they were glad , and covenanted to give him money .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewbha bad ki la tyrwa ban siew pisa ïa u .

translation.en: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country : there shalt thou die , and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord s house .
translation.kha: Un shim ïa me kum ïa ka bol bad un kynting sha ka ri kaba kham khraw . Men ïap hangta hajan ki kali ïapom kiba me , me la sngewsarong . Me long ka jingjahburom ïa ka longïing jong u kynrad jong me .
Nga la khmih bniap shapoh bad nga la ïohi ïa ki jingri bad ki mradkhlaw , ki kynjai bapar , bun ki sim khlaw .
translation.en: Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes , I considered , and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth , and wild beasts , and creeping things , and fowls of the air .

translation.kha: Nga la shen ïa une u bynriew ba u long ka jingpynwit kaba shyrkhei ; u sdang ïa ka jingkhihwin hapdeng ki ïew ha kylleng jong ka pyrthei bad u long u nongïalam jong ka kynha Kaba na Nasareth .
translation.en: For we have found this man a pestilent fellow , and a mover of sedition among all the Jews throughout the world , and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes :

translation.kha: Ma phi baroh kiba nga la phah shwa ka jinglongmraw ha Babilonia , to shakor ïa Kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai , la ong .’
translation.en: Hear ye therefore the word of the  Lord  , all ye of the captivity , whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon :

translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai kiba hap ha ka khyndew ba long maw . Ki tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki pdiang ïa ka da kaba kmiesan .
translation.en: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground  ; who , when they have heard the word , immediately receive it with gladness  ;

translation.kha: Ai ha u khyndiat ka iktiar jong me , Haneng ba u paidlang un nongshong ïa u .
translation.en: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him , that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient .

translation.kha: Ki pynliat ïa ki briew jyllang me , A tharai ; ki banbeiñ ïa kito Ibbah long ki jong me .
translation.en: They break in pieces thy people , O  Lord  , and afflict thine heritage .

translation.kha: Kynmaw aïom U Trai U Blei jongnga phi u la ai ïa ka Miriam manbha phi wan na Ijipt .
translation.en: Remember what the  Lord  thy God did unto Miriam by the way , after that ye were come forth out of Egypt .
Give wings unto Moab , that it may flee and get away : for the cities thereof shall be desolate , without any to dwell therein .
translation.kha: To buh ïa u maw jingtep na ka bynta ka Moab ; shen yn pynjot ïa ka . Ïa ki shnong jong ka yn ieh ha ka jingjot , bad yn ym don shuh uwei ruh u ban shong ban sah pat hangta .
Ma phiah bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi , phi lah ban bam ïa kata kaba dang tama ha kano kano ka jaka , namar ka long ka bainong ïa ka jingshakri jrong phi ha ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And ye shall eat it in every place , ye and your households : for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation .
His remembrance shall perish from the earth , and he shall have no name in the street .
translation.kha: Ka nam jong u ka la kut ha ïing bad shabar ; ym don ba kynmaw shuh ïa u .
U Aleksandar , u sawa u la pynkhuid eh ïa nga ; U Trai un sa ainong ïa u kato kum ki kam jong u .
translation.en: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil : the Lord reward him according to his works :
When the Son of man shall come in his glory , and all the holy angels with him , then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory :
translation.kha: Haba U Khun U Briew un wan kum u Syiem bad ki angel baroh lem bad u , un shong halor ka khet syiem jong u ,
Nga dei u shakri jong u Abraham , u la sdang .
translation.en: And he said , I am Abraham s servant .

translation.kha: Nga la Wan ïalam noh ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt ; nga la pyllait ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ; nga la pha ïa u Moses , u Amon , bad ka Miriam ban ïam ïa phi .
translation.en: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt , and redeemed thee out of the house of servants  ; and I sent before thee Moses , Aaron , and Miriam .

translation.kha: Ka kti U Trai kan sa wan ha me mynta ; men sa matlah bad men ym ïohi ïa ka jingjai jong ka sngi shipor . Mar kumta hi u Elumas u la sngew ba u lyoh khyndew umbiah ïong u la tap ïa ki khmat jong u , bad u la ïaid kylleng da kaba pyrshang ban ïada ïano ïano ban ïalam ïa u na ka kti .
translation.en: And now , behold , the hand of the Lord is upon thee , and thou shalt be blind , not seeing the sun for a season . And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness  ; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand .

translation.kha: Haba la kruiñ ïa u , um shym pynphai keiñ kylliang da kaweh kren ; haba u ïashim , um shym la byrngem , hynrei u la buh ïa la ki jingkulmar ha U Blei , u Nongbishar baklang .
translation.en: Who , when he was reviled , reviled not again  ; when he suffered , he threatened not  ; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously :
And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of the  Lord  , by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite .
translation.kha: Kito kiba don ki mawkordor ki la ai ïa ki sha ka jingkynshew jong ka Templ , kaba la khmih da u Jehiel jong ka kur Lebi jong u Gershon .

translation.en: Take great stones in thine hand , and hide them in the clay in the brickkiln , which is at the entry of Pharaoh s house in Tahpanhes , in the sight of the men of Judah  ;
translation.kha: Hangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  To pynïoh ïa ki mawbah bad tep ïa ki ha ka sorki jong ka jingsiang ha khmat ka khyrdop sha ka ïing sorkar kaba don ha ka nongbah , bad to ai ba katto katne ngut ki Israel kin ïohi ïa me ba me leh ïa kata .
Ha ka hukum jong U Blei kiei kaei ibha khraw ki jia , kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba ngim lah ban sngewthuh .
translation.en: God thundereth marvellously with his voice  ; great things doeth he , which we cannot comprehend .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnoh . . . ha ka snem kaba khatwei jong ka jingshah riewrangbah , U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the eleventh year , in the first day of the month , that the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Fear him not : for I have delivered him into thy hand , and all his people , and his land  ; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Wat sheptieng ïa u . Ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor jong u , ïa ki briew jong u baroh , bad ïa ka ri jong u . Leh ïa u kumba me la leh ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor uba synshar ha Heshbon .
Kumta lang phah ka ding ha nongbah Teman , bad kan thang ruh ïa ki kut ka Bosrah .
translation.en: But I will send a fire upon Teman , which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah .

translation.kha: Mynta , phi pyrkhat aïu ? La don shisien nawei u briew uba la don ar ñiut ki khun shynrang . U la leit sha uba kham san nabar u la ong , ‘ Ko khunlung , Khie leit bad trei ha ka bri swai myntoi ka sngi .’
translation.en: But what think ye ? A certain man had two sons  ; and he came to the first , and said , Son , go work to day in my vineyard .

translation.kha: lang pynurlong ïa ki ba kin bam phlang da ka jingsngewshngain ha ki jaka phlang u lumbah bad ki them bad ha ki jaka phlang bajyrngam Jong ka ri Israel .
translation.en: I will feed them in a good pasture , and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be : there shall they lie in a good fold , and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel .

translation.kha: Em , kynrad , ki jubab . Ngi la ïatan kum ki mraw jong Phin ban thied jingbam .
translation.en: And they said unto him , Nay , my lord , but to buy food are thy servants come .

translation.kha: un phah ha phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ïa ki jingpang bym lah pynïoh bun ïa ki jingïapthem kiba sngewtriem bad kiba neh slem .
translation.en: Then the  Lord  will make thy plagues wonderful , and the plagues of thy seed , even great plagues , and of long continuance , and sore sicknesses , and of long continuance .

translation.kha: Ki khulom shynrang jong u Goiim ki long ki briew jong ka Ashkenas , ka Riphath , bad ka Tirhakah .
translation.en: And the sons of Gomer  ; Ashkenaz , and Riphath , and Togarmah .

translation.kha: To kiar noh na ki jingïakren ba-thala bad ba-bieit , tang ban ïalam ïa ki briew kham jngai na U Blei’ .
translation.en: But shun profane and vain babblings : for they will increase unto more ungodliness .

translation.kha: da ki Law jong u ïa ki la pynneh ha ki jaka jong ki junom , bad kim Lah khlem kohnguh .
translation.en: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever : he hath made a decree which shall not pass .

translation.kha: Nga long U Balei bad ngan ïailong . Ym don u ban lait im na ka kun jong nga ; ym anna uba lah ban pynkylla ïa kaei ba nga kun .
translation.en: Yea , before the day was I am he  ; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand : I will work , and who shall let it ?

translation.kha: Nangta napdeng ka erïong U Trai u la kren ha u Job .
translation.en: Then the  Lord  answered Job out of the whirlwind , and said ,
And he lifted up his face to the window , and said , Who is on my side ? who ? And there looked out to him two or three eunuchs .
translation.kha: U Jehu u khmied shajrong bad u pyrta ,  Uei uba don ha ka liang jong nga ?  Ar ne lai ngut ki rangbah synshar ha ka ïingsyiem ki peit sha u na ka jingkhangïit ,

Uba nyngkong u la kren ha utai iwei pat , Haei mareh bad ong ha u samla uba ni u kaei thew ba yn sa don Bun byllien ki briew bad shibun bah ki jingrem ha Jerusalem , ba kan longsyiem kaba heh katta katta ban ne ki kynroh .
translation.en: And said unto him , Run , speak to this young man , saying , Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein :

translation.kha: Bad la don ka riewkynthei ha sakma Kajuh ka shaneng kaba ïai wang sha u bad kyrpad na ka bna ki hok jong ka , da kaba ong , ‘ To ïap ïa nga pyrshah ïa u nongïalam pyrshah jong nga !’
translation.en: And there was a widow in that city  ; and she came unto him , saying , Avenge me of mine adversary .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kob ki la pyrkhat , Kumta u la ong ha ki , Kano kano ka ri kaweh phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kiwei pat lai ym neh slem ; ka longïing kaba ïa-pait pyrshah ïa lade kan kyllon la ka jong ka jong .
translation.en: But he , knowing their thoughts , said unto them ,  Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation  ; and a house divided against a house falleth .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki la pyntngit ïa ka pyrthei da kaba pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong U Blei bad da kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong ban Neah jingkhum .
translation.en: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof  ; because they have transgressed the laws , changed the ordinance , broken the everlasting covenant .

translation.kha: Men ym sheptieng na ki jingma mynmiet ne na ki jingat ïaleh ha ka por mynnin ,
translation.en: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night  ; nor for the arrow that flieth by day  ;

translation.kha: Lumlang ïa ki jingdon jingem jongki ki briew’ baroh kiba shong hangtei badno kynton ïa ki ha ka madan shynrong . Nangta ryngkat ïa “kata ka shynrong bad ïa kata ka shtah ka phew baroh kumne ka jingainguh thang shaei U Trai U blang jongki phira . Ka de ba-bang sah jrong ha ka jingjot bad ym dei ban tei pat .
translation.en: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof , and shalt burn with fire the city , and all the spoil thereof every whit , for the  Lord  thy God : and it shall be an heap for ever  ; it shall not be built again .

translation.kha: Kamon pher kattne Saw uba hok u kyllon , borabor un khie pud ; hawei ka jingjot ka pynjot ïa ki bymman .
translation.en: For a just man falleth seven times , and riseth up again : but the wicked shall fall into mischief .
Thy testimonies are very sure : holiness becometh thine house , O  Lord  , for ever .
translation.kha: Ki aiñ jong me ki neh bymjukut , A  Trai  , bad ka Templ jong me ka long kaba khuid da shisha , junom la junom .

Kinah ki long ki jingthew jingthoh jong ka duwan , kiba long ha Kajuh ka rukom kumba thew ïa ka Templ . Ha barieh sawdong ka trai jyllang ka kharai ka don ka nur kaba sanphew sentimitar ka jingjylliew pynlang sanphew sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad ka jingman ha ka tduh kaba shabar kaba long arphew sa sentimitar ka jingjrong .
translation.en: And these are the measures of the altar after the cubits : The cubit is a cubit and an hand breadth  ; even the bottom shall be a cubit , and the breadth a cubit , and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about shall be a span : and this shall be the higher place of the altar .

translation.kha: U Trai u jubab ïa ka jingmudui u Elijah ; u khynnah u sdang ba ring mynhynne wiang bad u la im pat .
translation.en: And the  Lord  heard the voice of Elijah  ; and the soul of the child came into him again , and he revived .

translation.kha: bad ma ki malu ki bhabriew ka Jerusalem ki lumlang ha ka phyllaw bathymmai jong ka thalab . U syiem Jehoshaphat u saw bad u ïeng ha khmat jongnga ki bad duwai jam ,
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem , in the house of the  Lord  , before the new court ,

translation.kha: Ngam leh ïa kaba bha kaba ar kwah ban leh ; pynban , nga leh ïa kaba sniew kaba ngam kwah ban leh .
translation.en: For the good that I would I do not : but the evil which I would not , that I do .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi ki pyntud Israel , phi kiba hiarpateng na u Judah : Phai smai da ka kyrteng jongngi U Trai bad kam ba phi mane ïa U Blei ki Israel — hynrei phim shym buh jingmut ïa kawei ruh ka ktien kaba phi nong .
translation.en: Hear ye this , O house of Jacob , which are called by the name of Israel , and are come forth out of the waters of Judah , which swear by the name of the  Lord  , and make mention of the God of Israel , but not in truth , nor in righteousness .

translation.kha: Nangta sam pynlur ïa ki briew jong ki shiah , mala kin duwai tang sha nga bad ym sha kiwei pud ki blei . Ki baroh kin khongdong ïa nga .
translation.en: For then will I turn to the people a pure language , that they may all call upon the name of the  Lord  , to serve him with one consent .

translation.kha: Bud ïa u sha ka ïing ba un rung bad ong ïa u trai jong ka ïing : ‘ U Nonghikai u ino , Hangno ka kamra ha kaba ki synran jongki nga bad ma at ngin ïabam na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ? ’
translation.en: And wheresoever he shall go in , say ye to the goodman of the house , The Master saith , Where is the guestchamber , where I shall eat the passover with my disciples ?

translation.kha: Ban sheng ïa ka jingbymkhuid , shimti kyndiah u dpei na “kata ka masi rong saw ïa kaba la ïaryngkat ban weng neh ïa ka pop bad buh ïa ka ha u khiew , badno theh hangta ïa ka um ba dang shu wan tong .
translation.en: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin , and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel :

Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel , thou , and all thy bands , and the people that is with thee : I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort , and to the beasts of the field to be devoured .
translation.kha: U Gog bad ka kynhun shipai jong u bad kiba ïateh lok bad u kin kyllon ïap ha ki lumbah ka Israel , bad ngan ai ïa ki met jong ki ba kin long ka jingbam ïa baroh ki sim bad ki mradkhlaw .

translation.en: And he that smiteth his father , or his mother , shall be surely put to death .
translation.kha: Uta uba shoh ïa la u kpa ne ïa la ka kmie u dei ban shah pynïap .
U riewbymman um salia shaphrang U Tlai ; ha ka jingrang jong u , u pyrkhat ba U balui um da donkam .
translation.en: The wicked , through the pride of his countenance , will not seek after God : God is not in all his thoughts .

For when I had brought them into the land , for the which I lifted up mine hand to give it to them , then they saw every high hill , and all the thick trees , and they offered there their sacrifices , and there they presented the provocation of their offering : there also they made their sweet savour , and poured out there their drink offerings .
translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la kular ban ai ha ki . Haba ki la ïohi ïa ki lum bajrong bad ïa ki dieng bajyrngam , ki la ai jingkñia ha ki baroh . Ki la pynbitar ïa nga da ki jingkñia kiba ki la thang bad da ka waiñ kaba ki la wallam kum ki jingainguh .

Yn sa pynjot ïa ki kum ïa ki mradkhlaw , bad kin hap shah ïa ka jingshahshitom kaba ki la pyntong . Ka jingsngewbha ha ki ka long ban leh ïa kaei kaei ha kaba shai ka sngi ka ban pynhieng ïa ki jingkwah brai ka doh ; ki long ka jinglehrain bad ka jingjahburom ibha ki ïashong bam bad phi , katba ki nang leh sngewbha ha la ki lynti bashukor !
translation.en: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness , as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time . Spots they are and blemishes , sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you  ;

translation.kha: U la thaw ki durblei nar jong u Baal ,
translation.en: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel , and made also molten images for Baalim .
But David could not go before it to enquire of God : for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the  Lord .
translation.kha: hynrei u Dabid um shym lah ban leit shata ban mane ïa U Blei , namar u la sheptieng ïa ka waitlam jong u angel jong U  Trai .
U Trai u long U Blei jong ngi ; ki hukum jong u ki un-long na ka bna ka pyrthei baroh .
translation.en: He is the  Lord  our God  ; his judgments are in all the earth .

translation.kha: Nangta uta uba shong ha ka khet u la ong , Gera mynta nga thaw thylli ïa kiei kiei baroh ! U la nguh ruh ïa nga , Thoh ïa kan , namar kine ki ktien ki long kiba shisha bad kiba lah ban shaniah .
translation.en: And he that sat upon the throne said , Behold , I make all things new . And he said unto me , Write : for these words are true and faithful .
Bless ,  Lord  , his substance , and accept the work of his hands : smite through the loins of them that rise against him , and of them that hate him , that they rise not again .
translation.kha: Ko  Trai  , to ïarap ïa ka jait jong ki ba kan nang khlaiñ ; To pdiang sngewbha kat ïa kaba ki pyndep , To pynlwet ïa ki nongshun jong ki , Ba kin ym khie khlieh shuh lano lano .
Bunsien nga shahshitom na ka jingshit mynsngi bad na ka jingkhriat mynmiet . Ngam ju ïohthiah satia .
translation.en: Thus I was  ; in the day the drought consumed me , and the frost by night  ; and my sleep departed from mine eyes .

translation.kha: To nang ïadih , bad pyndep ïa Kiei kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la sdang !
translation.en: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers .

translation.kha: ithuh uno uno na phi un sngap ïa kane ? Naduh mynta hato phin shahshkor bha ?
translation.en: Who among you will give ear to this ? who will hearken and hear for the time to come ?
For there is hope of a tree , if it be cut down , that it will sprout again , and that the tender branch thereof will not cease .
translation.kha: Ka don ka jingkyrmen ïa u dieng uba la khet ; u lah ban im pat bad un khie lung .
Wat sheptieng , u la ong . Ang tip ba phi ïawad ïa U Jisu uba na Nasareth , ïa kiba la sahnarphna . Um don hangne — u la mihpat ! Ha khmih , hangne ka jaka ha ka ki la buh ïa u .
translation.en: And he saith unto them , Be not affrighted : Ye seek Jesus of Nazareth , which was crucified : he is risen  ; he is not here : behold the place where they laid him .

translation.kha: Ki ia ban shongduh bad Phin ha ïano kano ka shnong ba ki mon , mala kine dem ban lehbeiñ ïa ki .
translation.en: He shall dwell with thee , even among you , in that place which he shall choose in one of thy gates , where it liketh him best : thou shalt not oppress him .
Namely , of the gods of the people which are round about you , nigh unto thee , or far off from thee , from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth  ;
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , u lah ban pynshoi ïa phi ban mane ïa ki blei jong kita ki briew kiba shong marjan bad phi , lane kiba shong sha jngai na phi .
Ang kyrpad ïa me da la ka dohnud baroh ; ban iwei ïa nga , kumba me la kular !
translation.en: I entreated thy favour with my whole heart : be merciful unto me according to thy word .

translation.kha: Te ka la jia kumta ïa u ; u la ïap , da kaba shah ïuh ha ban da ïap ha u paidbah ha kata ka khyrdop shnong .
translation.en: And so it fell out unto him : for the people trode upon him in the gate , and he died .

And , behold , I am with thee , and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest , and will bring thee again into this land  ; for I will not leave thee , until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of .
translation.kha: To kynmaw , ba ngan long ryngkat bad me bad ïada ïa me kat shaba me leit , bad ngan wallam pat ïa me sha kane ka ri . Ngan ym iehnoh ïa me tad haduh ba ngan da pyndep ïa kata baroh ïa kaba nga la kular ha me .

translation.en: God , who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets ,
translation.kha: Ha ki por mynbarim , U Blei u la kren ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bunsien bad ha ki rukom kiba bun lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa .

wahbah ki nongtuh ki wanpaw mynmiet , ki rhah tangba ïa kaei kabu ki kwah . Haba ki briew ki lum ïa ki swai , borabor ki pynsah khyrdong kyndiang . hynriew ki nongshoh-nar jong Phah ki la pyndam noh khoit ïa pha .
translation.en: If thieves came to thee , if robbers by night , ( how art thou cut off ! ) would they not have stolen till they had enough ? if the grapegatherers came to thee , would they not leave some grapes ?

translation.kha: Ha ka ri shyiap don ka Beth Asaraïah , ka Middin , ka Sekakah ,
translation.en: In the wilderness , Beth–arabah , Middin , and Secacah ,

translation.kha: U thri u ïaid na khmat jngai u , bad u pynbna , Ma nga , U Troas , sa long U Blei uba ïalap da ka jinglehsbun bad jinglehisynei , uba suki pun bitar bad uba pyn-i ïa ka jingieit bakhraw bad ïa ka jingïaineh skhem .
translation.en: And the  Lord  passed by before him , and proclaimed , The  Lord  , The  Lord  God , merciful and gracious , longsuffering , and abundant in goodness and truth ,
And said unto him , Take these vessels , go , carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem , and let the house of God be builded in his place .
translation.kha: U patsha u ong ïa u ban rah ïa ki bad pynphai sha ka Templ ha Jerusalem bad ban tei pat ïa ka Templ ha ka jaka ba ka la ïeng mynshuwa .

Ha kawei pat ka por u syiem Sedekaïah u la phah ïalam ïa sa sha u ha ka khyrdop kaba lai sha ka Templ , bad u la ong , Ngan kylli ïa phi ka jingkylli , bad nga kwah ba phin ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingsuki baroh .
translation.en: Then Zedekiah the king sent , and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that is in the house of the  Lord  : and the king said unto Jeremiah , I will ask thee a thing  ; hide nothing from me .
By thee have I been holden up from the womb : thou art he that took me out of my mother s bowels : my praise shall be continually of thee .
translation.kha: Nga la shaniah ha me shi lynter ka jingim jong nga ; me la ïada ïa nga naduh ka sngi ba la kha ïa nga . Ngan ïai ïaroh ïa me .
U briew uba shong Hangne u jubab , Kumno shaphang kine kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa — ki kpa Jong ki , ki dei kiei ? Dei kumta ba la ñiah ka jingong , Hato wat u saraw ruh u la long u Nongïathuhlypa ?
translation.en: And one of the same place answered and said , But who is their father ? Therefore it became a proverb , Is Saul also among the prophets ?

translation.kha: Tei ïa ka rangli hangta da ki maw ïa kiba ym pat pyndei shniah .
translation.en: And there shalt thou build an altar unto the  Lord  thy God , an altar of stones : thou shalt not lift up any iron tool upon them .

translation.kha: Hynriew ym baroh ki la pdiang ïa ka Khubor Baasha . U Isaïah da lade hi u la ong , A Trei , utai kiba la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong ngi ?
translation.en: But they have not all obeyed the gospel . For Esaias saith , Lord , who hath believed our report ?
Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance  ; the sacrifices of the  Lord  God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance , as he said unto them .
translation.kha: U Moses um shym la ai kano kano ka jaka ha ka jait Lebi . Kumba U  Trai  u la bthah ha u Moses , ki dei ban pdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki , ïa ka bhah jong ki jingainguh ba la thang ha ka duwan sha U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: Hast thou not heard long ago , how I have done it  ; and of ancient times , that I have formed it ? now have I brought it to pass , that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps .
translation.kha: Hato mem pat ju ïohsngew ba nga la thmu ïa kane baroh slem mynshuwa ? Bad mynta nga pynurlong ïa ka . Nga ai ha me ka bor ban pynkylla ïa ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh sha ki kynton theh ñiut .
( Hynrei u Dabid u la jingïohknieh ïa ka kut Sephon jngai ki , bad la tip kyrteng ïa ka kum ka Nongbah u Abda . )
translation.en: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion : the same is the city of David .

translation.kha: phira lah ban sngewskhem ba ka jingstad ka long kaba bah ïa ka mynsiem . To ïoh ïa ka jingstad bad ka lawei jong phi kan long kaba phyrnai .
translation.en: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul : when thou hast found it , then there shall be a reward , and thy expectation shall not be cut off .

translation.kha: Ka dohnud jyllang nga ka la sngewsih haba nga Iohi ïa kaei kaba la jhieh ha ki kynthei jong ka nongbah .
translation.en: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city .
And when the men of Israel turned again , the men of Benjamin were amazed : for they saw that evil was come upon them .
translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki phai kylla , bad ki Benjamin ki la kulmar hi thlim namar ki sngewthuh ba kin sa shah pynjot .

translation.en: A light to lighten the Gentiles , and the glory of thy people Israel .
translation.kha: Ka jingshai ban pynpaw ïa ka mon jong me ha ki Jentil bad ban wallam ka burom ha ki briew jong me , ki Israel .

translation.en: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you , and not to boast in another man s line of things made ready to our hand .
translation.kha: Te ngi lah ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha ha kiwei pat ki ri jngai na phi bad yn ym donkam ban leh sarong shaphang ka jingtrei ïa kaba la lah leh lypa ha ka lyngkha jong uwei pat u briew .
Ka Assyria ka don hangtai , lem bad ki jingtep jong ki shipai jong ka ha baroh sarong .
translation.en: Asshur is there and all her company : his graves are about him : all of them slain , fallen by the sword :

Understand therefore this day , that the  Lord  thy God is he which goeth over before thee  ; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them , and he shall bring them down before thy face : so shalt thou drive them out , and destroy them quickly , as the  Lord  hath said unto thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei to tip mynta ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïaid ha shuwa jong phi kum ka ding kaba bam duh . Un jop bad pyndem ïa ki katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , ba phi lah ban beh krad bad pynjot ïa ki kloi kloi , kumba u la kular .
U Salmone u jubab , Me ju ïai pynpaw ka jingieit bakhraw ïa u dabi u kput jong nga , bad mynta ba me la shah ïa nga ban long symboh hadien jong u .
translation.en: And Solomon said unto God , Thou hast shewed great mercy unto David my father , and hast made me to reign in his stead .

translation.kha: Nangta , u syiem bathymmai u bymtip ei ei shaphang u Joseph , u la synran ha Ijipt .
translation.en: Now there arose up a new king over Egypt , which knew not Joseph .
Happy is the man that findeth wisdom , and the man that getteth understanding .
translation.kha: Suk uta u briew uba long stad — uba ïoh ka jingshemphang .
Kim sa tip ruh ba nga lama U Trai U Blei jongki ki , uba la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt khnang ba ngan ïoh shongsuk hapdeng jong ki . Ngam long U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  their God , that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , that I may dwell among them : I am the  Lord  their God .

translation.kha: U la pynlong ïa ki kti jong la kiba nep kum ka waitlam . Da la ka kti u ïada ïa nga . U la pynlong ïa la kum u khnam , uba pa bad ba la biang ban pyndonkam .
translation.en: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword  ; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me , and made me a polished shaft  ; in his quiver hath he hid me  ;

translation.kha: Tang mai shwa ïohi ïa ki , u mareh don leit ïashem ïa ki . Da kambah u nguh ngon khah khyndew , u ong ,
translation.en: And he lift up his eyes and looked , and , lo , three men stood by him : and when he saw them , he ran to meet them from the tent door , and bowed himself toward the ground ,
I have made the earth , the man and the beast that are upon the ground , by my great power and by my outstretched arm , and have given it unto whom it seemed meet unto me .
translation.kha: Da ka bor bakhraw bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , nga la thaw ïa ka pyrthei , ïa u khunbynriew , bad ïa baroh ki mrad kiba im ha ka khyndew ; bad nga ai ïa ka ha uno uno uba nga jied .

translation.en: By the rivers of Babylon , there we sat down , yea , we wept , when we remembered Zion .
translation.kha: Harud ki wah ka Babilon ngi la shong ; hangta ngi ïam haba ngi kynmaw ïa ka Seïon .

translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Woe to the women that sew pillows to all armholes , and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls ! Will ye hunt the souls of my people , and will ye save the souls alive that come unto you ?
translation.kha: bad ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ïa ki :  Ma phi ki kynthei phi long kiba la tim ! Phi suh ki jingteh kti myntor na ka bynta uwei uwei baroh bad phi thaw ki jaiñ teh khlieh myntor na ka bynta uwei uwei ban phong ha ki khlieh jong ki , khnang ba ki lah ban don ka bor halor ka jingim jong kiwei pat ki briew . Phi kwah ban don ka bor jong ka jingim bad jingïap halor ki briew jong nga bad ban pyndonkam ïa ka na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi ïa lade hi .

translation.en: A fool also is full of words : a man cannot tell what shall be  ; and what shall be after him , who can tell him ?
translation.kha: U bieit u kren bad ïai kren . Ym don mano mano batip kaei ka ban jia marbud , bad ym don mano mano ba lah ban ïathuh kan jia aïu hadien ba ngi ïap .
Nga la ïohi ïa ki mraw ba ki shong da ki kulai katba ki riewdonburom ki ïaid da ka kjat kum ki mraw .
translation.en: I have seen servants upon horses , and princes walking as servants upon the earth .

translation.kha: Ka Komentari halor ka Kitab ki Syiem ka don ki jingïohkynti shngain ki khun shynrang jong u Joash , ki jingpynjia kiba la kren pyrshah ïa u , bad ka jingbeh jingthoh kumno ba u la tei pat ïa ka Templ . U Amasaïah u khun jyllang u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: Now concerning his sons , and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him , and the repairing of the house of God , behold , they are written in the story of the book of the kings . And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Katto katto-katne ki Philistia ki wallam sha u Jehoshaphat shibun buh ka ayu dara kiwei ki jingai sngewbha , bad katno kattne ki Arabia ki khulom hynñiew hajar hynñiewspah tylli ki langbrot bad Hynñiew hajar hynriewspah tylli ki blang .
translation.en: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents , and tribute silver  ; and the Arabians brought him flocks , seven thousand and seven hundred rams , and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats .
And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge , God gave them over to a reprobate mind , to do those things which are not convenient ;
translation.kha: Namar ba kita ki briew ki la kyntait ban bat ha ka jingmut ïa ka jingtip bashisha shaphang U Blei , u la ai noh ïa ki sha ki jingmut bajakhlia , ba kumta ki leh ïa kiei kiei kiba kim dei ban leh .

U Trai u ong shapoh kine ki bri , Ki ieit ban pait noh na nga , badno kin ym lah ban bat synshar ïa lade . Kumta ngim shym la sngewbha bad ki . Ngan kynmaw ïa ki jingbakla kiba ki la ni bad nur-um pynshitom ïa ki ñiar ki pop jong ki .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  unto this people , Thus have they loved to wander , they have not refrained their feet , therefore the  Lord  doth not accept them  ; he will now remember their iniquity , and visit their sins .

translation.kha: wat lada kito ki lai ngut ki rangbah , u Nun , u Daniel badno u Job ki don hangta , ka jingbha jong ki kan pynim tyngkan ïa ka jingim jong ki hi . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: Though these three men , Noah , Daniel , and Job , were in it , they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jongki phi kin lah ba-bang shongkurim bad ki khun kynthei jong ki , ki ban ïalam ïa ki banbeiñ ym ïaineh shuh ha nga dara ba-bang mane ïa ki blei thala jong ki .
translation.en: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons , and their daughters go a whoring after their gods , and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , to pynkhreh ïa ka kamra na ka bynta jong nga , namar nga kyrmen ba U Blei un jubab ïa ki jingduwai jongngi phoi baroh bad ban ai pat ïa nga ha me .
translation.en: But withal prepare me also a lodging : for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you .
And whosoever doth not bear his cross , and come after me , cannot be my disciple .
translation.kha: Uno uno u bym bah ïa la ka diengphna bad wan nadien jong nga , um lah ban long u synran jong nga .

translation.en: For he rent Israel from the house of David  ; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king : and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the  Lord  , and made them sin a great sin .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U  Trai  u la pynkyrpang ïa ka Israel na ka Judah , ki Israel ki pynlong ïa u Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat kum u syiem jong ki . U Jeroboam u pynlong ïa ki ban iehnoh noh ïa U  Trai  bad u la ïalam ïa ki ban leh ïa ki pop kiba shyrkhei .
To U Blei uba U Kpa bad U Jisu Khrismas uba U Trai un ai ha ki parabangeit baroh ïa ka jinglah bad ka jingieit da ka jingneh .
translation.en: Peace be to the brethren , and love with faith , from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Ki Khristan bashisha ki longsem kiba peitngor .
translation.en: True Christians are safety conscious .

translation.kha: Nga khmih lynti Borabor ban im slem bad ban ïap ha la ïing ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Then I said , I shall die in my nest , and I shall multiply my days as the sand .

translation.kha: U Lebi u don sa ngut ki khun shynrang , u Gershon , u Kohath , dara u Merari , kiba long ki kpa tymmen jongngi kita ki kur kiba don ïa ki kyrteng jongngi ki . U Gershon u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : U Libni bad u Shimei ; u khohwah u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Amam , u Ishar , u Khroh , bad u Ussiel ; bad u Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shynrang : u Mahli bad u Mushi . Kine ki long ki kpa tymmen jong kito ki ïing kiba don ïa ki Kyrteng jong ki .
translation.en: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites :

translation.kha: Ka la lama ha khie ka par ba la kha ïa u Moserah , u khunblang uba bhabriew haduh katta katta .
translation.en: In which time Moses was born , and was exceeding fair , and nourished up in his father s house three months :

translation.kha: Katto katne ngat ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa U Jisu lano ka Hima U Blei kan wan . Ka jubab jong u ka long , Ka Hima U Blei kam wan ha ka manna kum kaba lah ban ïohi .
translation.en: And when he was demanded of the Pharisees , when the kingdom of God should come , he answered them and said ,  The kingdom of God cometh not with observation :

translation.kha: Ka por kaba dei ka la poi , u ong , malu ka Khmih U Blei ka la hajan ! To phai noh na ki pep jong phi bad ngeit ïa ka Khubor Babha !
translation.en: And saying ,  The time is fulfilled , and the kingdom of God is at hand : repent ye , and believe the gospel .

translation.kha: hynriew ki briew jong me ki ïaleh pyrshah bad leh bymkohnguh ïa me ; ki phai dien noh na ka sah jong me . Ki pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba maham ïa ki ,
translation.en: Nevertheless they were disobedient , and rebelled against thee , and cast thy law behind their backs , and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee , and they wrought great provocations .

translation.kha: To ai ba ka jingkyrmen jong phi lai pynkmen ïa phi , to long kiba ïaishah ha ki jingjynjar jong phi , bad to duwai ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: Rejoicing in hope ; patient in tribulation ; continuing instant in prayer ;

translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jongu u Baal , Namar ba phi kham ïabun , shim shuwa ma phin ïa u smai dab . ïamudui ha u phai jngai phi , tangba phim dei ban ai ding ïa ki diengthang .
translation.en: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal , Choose you one bullock for yourselves , and dress it first  ; for ye are many  ; and call on the name of your gods , but put no fire under .
How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master s servants , and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen ?
translation.kha: Phim ïaryngkat bad wat uwei u rangbah synshar uba rit tam jong ki Assyria bad pynban phi khmih lynti ba ki Ijipt ba kin phah ha phi ïa ki kali ïapom bad ki shipai shong kulai .

translation.en: And daily in the temple , and in every house , they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Bad man ka sngi hapoh ka Templ bad ha ki ïing jong ki briew ki ïai bteng ban hikai bad ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Jisu U Messaïah .

U Pilat u la ong ha ki ha ka shoh kaba lai , Khenani kaei ka kam runar kaba u la leh ? Ngam lah ban shem ïa kano kano katba u la leh katba u dei ban ïahap ! Ngan phah sympat ïa u bad pyllait noh ïa u .
translation.en: And he said unto them the third time , Why , what evil hath he done ? I have found no cause of death in him : I will therefore chastise him , and let him go .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ki paidbah ki la ïa-ap ïa u Sekharaïah dara ki da sngewlyngngoh balei ba u pyntyllun badno por shapoh ka Templ .
translation.en: And the people waited for Zacharias , and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple .
Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp , and said , Who is on the  Lord s  side ? let him come unto me . And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him .
translation.kha: Kumta u ïeng ha ka khyrdop jong ka jaka sher dara , bad u la pyrta ,  Kat uba don ha ka liang jong U  Trai  , wan shane !  Kumta baroh kiba na ka jait Lebi ki ïalumlang ha u ,
U Lebi u ïeng joit ban leit noh , isynei u kpa u pynbor ïa u ba-bang sah shuwa , kumta u sah sa shi miet hangtei .
translation.en: And when the man rose up to depart , his father in law urged him : therefore he lodged there again .

translation.en: And the prophet came to the king of Israel , and said unto him , Go , strengthen thyself , and mark , and see what thou doest : for at the return of the year the king of Syria will come up against thee .

translation.kha: Leit sha U Trai na ka bynta ka jingïarap , bad mane khlem kut .
translation.en: Seek the  Lord  and his strength , seek his face continually .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki , Phi lah ban thikna ba haba U Khun U Briew u shongsuk ha ka klet badonburom jong u ha ka Ïa kaba thymmai , te ma phi ki khat-ar nguh ki nongot jong nga phin ïashong shiah ha ki khet , ban synshar ïa ki khat-ar ki jait Israel .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That ye which have followed me , in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory , ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones , judging the twelve tribes of Israel .

translation.kha: Ha ka por lai baje U Jisu u la pyrthat da ka sur kaba ïam , iohi , Eloi , lema sabakhthani ? kaba mut , A Blei jong ar , A Bela jong nga , balei ba me iehnoh ïa nga ?
translation.en: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice , saying ,  Eloi , Eloi , lama sabachthani ?  which is , being interpreted ,  My God , my God , why hast thou forsaken me ?

Turn again , and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people , Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of David thy father , I have heard thy prayer , I have seen thy tears : behold , I will heal thee : on the third day thou shalt go up unto the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: ban leit phai pat sha u Hesekaïah , u nongsynshar jong ki briew U  Trai  , bad ban ong ha u ,  Nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong me , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingduwai jong me bad nga la ïohi ïa ki ummat jong me . Ngan pynkhiah ïa me , bad hadien lai sngi men leit sha ka Templ .
Pynïap ïa uta u maw lyngraw hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong por ha ka jaka krong jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And thou shalt kill the bullock before the  Lord  , by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Ko Kynrad , ki la jubab , ngi khah ïa me ban ai ha ngi ka jinglah ban ïoh !
translation.en: They say unto him , Lord , that our eyes may be opened .

For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night , and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both man and beast  ; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet ngan ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri Ijipt , da kaba pynïap ïa u khun nyngkong baroh , la u dei u briew ne u mrad , bad ngan pynshitom ïa ki blei ka ri Ijipt baroh . Nga long U  Trai .
Ia ki jingartatiend ; nga ñiew ïa kiei kiei baroh kum ka jingduh babha na ka byndi kata kaba khem kor palat , ka jingtip ïa U Jingsuk Khrismas uba U Trai jong per .
translation.en: Yea doubtless , and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord : for whom I have suffered the loss of all things , and do count them but dung , that I may win Christ ,

translation.kha: Ïa kine kiei kiei lah ban sngewthuh tang kum ka jingjynjar : Ki ar ngut ki kynthei ki ïeng ïa ki ar tylli ki jutang ; kawei ïa kaba ki khulom la Kha ha ka jinglongmraw ka long ka Hagar , bad ka ngin na ka bynta ka jutang ba la Pynlong ba-halor u lum Sinai .
translation.en: Which things are an allegory : for these are the two covenants ; the one from the mount Sinai , which gendereth to bondage , which is Agar .
( As it is written in the law of the Lord , Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord  ; )
translation.kha: kumba la thoh ha ka aiñ jong U Trai :  Ïa uwei pa uwei u khun nyngkong dei ban pynkyntang sha U Trai .
Kumta Ki ïalong shuh ar ngut , isynei kawei . Uno uno u briew um dem ban pynïakhlad , te , ïa kaei kaba U Blei! u la pynïasoh pur .
translation.en: Wherefore they are no more twain , but one flesh . What therefore God hath joined together , let not man put asunder .
And , behold , two blind men sitting by the way side , when they heard that Jesus passed by , cried out , saying , Have mercy on us , O Lord , thou Son of David .
translation.kha: Bad ar ngut ki rangbah bamatlah kiba shong harud lynti ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u ïaid nangta , kumta ki la sdang ban pyrta ,  Ko Khun u Dabid ! To sngewsynei ïa ngi , ko Kynrad !

U Shelomith bad ka longïing jongki u , ki dei peit ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba la pynkyntang ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ , kynthup ruh ïa ki jingai Sngewbha kiba la wanlam da u Samuel , u nongïathuhlypa , da u syiem Saul , da u Abner u khun jongki u Ner , bad da u Joab u khun jongki ka Seruïah .
translation.en: And all that Samuel the seer , and Saul the son of Kish , and Abner the son of Ner , and Joab the son of Zeruiah , had dedicated  ; and whosoever had dedicated any thing , it was under the hand of Shelomith , and of his brethren .

translation.kha: U Khloi , Kumno nur lah pun shukor bad nguh ba nga la bakla ? Nga la mynsaw jur palat , hynrei nga un-long umbah khlem pop .
translation.en: Should I lie against my right ? my wound is incurable without transgression .

translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la wallam ïa phi na ki ri sha kiba la pynsakma ïa phi bad nga lumlang ïa phi , ngan pdiang ïa ki jingkñia kiba phi thang , bad ki jingïambriew kin ïohi ba nga long uba khiah .
translation.en: I will accept you with your sweet savour , when I bring you out from the people , and gather you out of the countries wherein ye have been scattered  ; and I will be sanctified in you before the heathen .

translation.kha: Baroh ki ryñiot ki la ïadait nur ha ka jingïasyllok bajan bad ki la ïadem ïa la ki jingdon jingem iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: And all that believed were together , and had all things common  ;

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba don hapoh ïing bun ka Mari , ban pyntngen ïa ka , ki la ïabud ïa ka hajan ki la ïoh ba ka la ïeng tohtit bad mih kyrkieh . Ki la pyrkhing ba ka leit sha ka jingap ban ïam hangta .
translation.en: The Jews then which were with her in the house , and comforted her , when they saw Mary , that she rose up hastily and went out , followed her , saying , She goeth unto the grave to weep there .

translation.kha: pynlang u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah hynriewphew ar snem .
translation.en: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years : and he died .

translation.en: Therefore be ye also ready : for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh .
And God said unto Noah , This is the token of the covenant , which I have established between me and all flesh that is upon the earth .
translation.kha: Kata ka long ka dak jong ka jingkular kaba nga la pynlong ha ki jingthaw ba-im baroh .

Nga shat ïa ki ban pyntngit ïa lade da ki jingainguh Jong ki hi , bad nga shah ïa ki ban ktien ïa ki khun shynrang banyngkong jong ki . Kane ka la long ban pynkhamti ïa ki sad pyn-i ha ki ba nga Long U Trai .
translation.en: And I polluted them in their own gifts , in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb , that I might make them desolate , to the end that they might know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hato ym don u ban jubab ïa kane ka jingkren bieit baroh ? Hato kob kren bunktien ka pynksan ïa u briew ?
translation.en: Should not the multitude of words be answered ? and should a man full of talk be justified ?
Therefore many of them believed  ; also of honourable women which were Greeks , and of men , not a few .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Who shall entice Ahab king of Israel , that he may go up and fall at Ramoth–gilead ? And one spake saying after this manner , and another saying after that manner .
And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers  skins , and shall put it upon a bar .
translation.kha: Phin thung ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ban pyndep ïa ki kamram ka jinglong lyngdoh ; uno uno uwei pat uba pyrshang ban leh kumta un shah pynïap .

translation.en: And Jonathan , Saul s son , had a son that was lame of his feet . He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel , and his nurse took him up , and fled : and it came to pass , as she made haste to flee , that he fell , and became lame . And his name was Mephibosheth .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u nonghiarpateng jong u Saul , u dei u Mephibosheth , u khun jong u Jonathan , uba la dap san snem ka rta mynba u Saul bad u Jonathan ki la shah pynïap . Haba ka khubor shaphang ka jingïap jong ki ka la wan poi na ka nongbah Jesreel , ka nongsumar jong u ka la rah ïa u bad ka phet krad ; hynrei namar ka jingkyrkieh palat ka la pynhap ïa u , bad u la kylla long uba dkoh .

translation.en: And I saw , and behold a white horse : and he that sat on him had a bow  ; and a crown was given unto him : and he went forth conquering , and to conquer .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih , bad hangta la don u kulai balieh . Halor jong u , u nongshong kulai u la bat ïa ka ryntieh , bad ha u la ai ïa ka pansngiat . U la shong halor jong u kum u nongjop ban jop .
Ki jubab , Kane ka dei kaei ba phin ong ha ki : ‘ Ka tiduh jong nga ka kham rben ban ïa ka syngkai i pa jong nga .’
translation.en: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him , saying , Thus shalt thou answer the people that spake unto thee , saying , Thy father made our yoke heavy , but make thou it somewhat lighter for us  ; thus shalt thou say unto them , My little finger shall be thicker than my father s loins .

translation.kha: Te ithuh u Briew u la leit noh bad u la ïathuh ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki ïew ba dei U Jisu uba la pynkhiah ïa u .
translation.en: The man departed , and told the Jews that it was Jesus , which had made him whole .
Thus the Bible explains : “ Abraham reckoned that God was able to raise [his son Isaac] up even from the dead . ”
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom ka Baibl ka pynshai : “ U Abraham da ka jingngeit-ba U Blei u lah ban pynmih-pat ia u khun jong u u Isak wat na ka jing iap . ”

translation.en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion ? or fill the appetite of the young lions ,

translation.en: What is my reward then ? Verily that , when I preach the gospel , I may make the gospel of Christ without charge , that I abuse not my power in the gospel .
The rings , and nose jewels ,

translation.en: And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed , he called two of his household servants , and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually  ;

translation.en: And their coast was from Aroer , that is on the bank of the river Arnon , and the city that is in the midst of the river , and all the plain by Medeba  ;

translation.en: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance , hewers and workers of stone and timber , and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work .

translation.kha: Naba U Bel un ym pyn-i jingsngewsynei haba u habar ïa u briew u bym shym la leh-isynei ; hynne ka jinglehisynei ka ioh noh halor ka jingbishar .
translation.en: For he shall have judgment without mercy , that hath shewed no mercy  ; and mercy rejoiceth against judgment .

translation.en: And they also , if they abide not still in unbelief , shall be grafted in : for God is able to graft them in again .

translation.en: And the man increased exceedingly , and had much cattle , and maidservants , and menservants , and camels , and asses .

And he hath confirmed his words , which he spake against us , and against our judges that judged us , by bringing upon us a great evil : for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem .

translation.en: Therefore prophesy and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , O my people , I will open your graves , and cause you to come up out of your graves , and bring you into the land of Israel .

translation.en: And another came , saying , Lord , behold , here is thy pound , which I have kept laid up in a napkin :

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will deliver thee into the hand of them whom thou hatest , into the hand of them from whom thy mind is alienated :

translation.en: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet , What hath the  Lord  answered thee ? and , What hath the  Lord  spoken ?

translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u kren ha u Shemaïah u nongïathuhlypa

translation.en: The  Lord  looketh from heaven  ; he beholdeth all the sons of men .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u khmih sha tbian na bneng , bad u ïohi ïa u khunbynriew baroh .
Phan sa pynïar ïa ki pud sawdong na baroh ki liang ; ki briew jngai pha kin ïew pat ïa la ka ri ïa kaba kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ki la smat . Ki nongbah kiba la ieh kynjah yn pyndap pat da ki briew .
translation.en: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left  ; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles , and make the desolate cities to be inhabited .
So the ark of the  Lord  compassed the city , going about it once : and they came into the camp , and lodged in the camp .
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa kane ka kynhun ki rangbah ban rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sawdong ka nongbah shisien . Nangta ki wan phai pat sha ka jaka shong dara bad ki sahmiet hangta .

Kaei te , ka jingthmu jong ka Hukum ? La bynrap khnang ban pyn-i ïa kaei ba ka long ka jingpalat , bad la thmu ba kan neh haduh ka jingwan uta u nonghiarpateng jong u Abraham , ha uba la pynurlong ïa ka jinglorni . Ïa ka Hukum la aiti da ki angel , lem malu u briew uba ïeng kum u ksiang .
translation.en: Wherefore then serveth the law ? It was added because of transgressions , till the seed should come to whom the promise was made ; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator .

translation.kha: Utai uba lah ban jop ïa ka pyrthiew ? Tangba u briew uba jait ba U Jisu u long U u U Blei .
translation.en: Who is he that overcometh the world , but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God ?
Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Rehoboam u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .
da kaba ino ha u , Wat sheptieng . I pa jong nga in ym lah ban pynsep ïa phin . I tip bha ba phi dei uta u ban sa long u syiem jong ki Israel bad ba ma nga , nga dei uba ar ha ka kyrdan .
translation.en: And he said unto him , Fear not : for the hand of Saul my father shall not find thee  ; and thou shalt be king over Israel , and I shall be next unto thee  ; and that also Saul my father knoweth .

translation.kha: Katto kattne ngut ki lapbah ki jingïohknieh ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la ong , bad ki sien ïathaw ha u Saul , bad u phah ïakhot ïa u .
translation.en: And when the words were heard which David spake , they rehearsed them before Saul : and he sent for him .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , kata ka longsem baroh ka jingkmen ba ki riewbymman ki ïoh , kiwei pat mynta ki wan bad ki shim ïa ki jaka jong ki .
translation.en: Behold , this is the joy of his way , and out of the earth shall others grow .

translation.kha: Wat beiñ ïa ki Edom ; ki long hi ki para jong phi . Sin wat ibeiñ ïa ki Ijipt ; phi la shong shipor ha ka ri jong ki .
translation.en: Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite  ; for he is thy brother : thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian  ; because thou wast a stranger in his land .
For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer : now the  Lord  will feed them as a lamb in a large place .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki long mutlop kum ki khashor . Kumno ngan bsa ïa ki kum ïa ki langbrot ha ki pyntha phlang ?
Nangta u Balaam u la ïeng joit bad leit phai noh shuh la ïing , bad u Balak hajuh u la leit phai ha la ka lyngki .
translation.en: And Balaam rose up , and went and returned to his place : and Balak also went his way .
( Now that he ascended , what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth ?
