translation.en: And all Naphtali , and the land of Ephraim , and Manasseh , and all the land of Judah , unto the utmost sea ,
translation.kha: ka ri Naphtali baroh kawei ; ki ri Ephraim bad Manasseh ; ka ri Judah shaduh ka Duriaw Mediterranian shaphang sepngi ;

Na ka bynta ka jingpynsah , ki ai shispah tylliat ki masi kyrtong , arspah ki langbrot , bad sawspah tyllai ki khunlangbrot kum ki jingainguh tdong , bad khat-ar tylli ki blang kumin ki jingainguh ïa ka pop , uwei na ka bynta kawei ka jait ki Israel .
translation.en: And offered at the dedication of this house of God an hundred bullocks , two hundred rams , four hundred lambs  ; and for a sin offering for all Israel , twelve he goats , according to the number of the tribes of Israel .

translation.kha: Ki la ïashongkha khleh sad ki , pynlang ki la mane ïa ki blei jong ki .
translation.en: And they took their daughters to be their wives , and gave their daughters to their sons , and served their gods .

translation.kha: Ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongsynshar jong ngi , bad ki kjap tymmen jong ngi ki la pynlehrain bad ki la ar pop pyrshah ïa me a Trai .
translation.en: O Lord , to us belongeth confusion of face , to our kings , to our princes , and to our fathers , because we have sinned against thee .
That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither : and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno na phi da ka jingjia ryngkhat u pynïap ïano ïano , u lah ban leit shata bad lait na uta uba wad kput .
U la sping ruh shibun ka rnong na Betah sad na Berothai , ki nongbah kiba la synrai da u Hadadeser .
translation.en: And from Betah , and from Berothai , cities of Hadadezer , king David took exceeding much brass .

translation.kha: Namarba U Jehobah u “mon ba ki briew baroh ktien ioh laitluid im , bad ba kin poi sha ka jingap ia ka jingshisha .” —1 Timothi 2 :3 , 4 .
translation.en: Because it is Jehovah’s will that “all sorts of people should be saved and come to an accurate knowledge of truth .” —1 Timothy 2 :3 , 4 .

translation.kha: Haba u Anam u la dap shispah laiphew Snem ka ther , u la ïoh khun shynrang uba Sirion ïa u mala u la kyrteng ïa u , u Seth .
translation.en: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years , and begat a son in his own likeness , after his image  ; and called his name Seth :
And while he yet spake , behold a multitude , and he that was called Judas , one of the twelve , went before them , and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang kren mynba ka kynhun ki briew ka la wan poi , ïa kaba la ïalam da u Judas , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran . U la wan sha U Jisu ban doh ïa u .
U la ap sa hynñiew sngap , bad u pyllait biang ïa kata ka paro .
translation.en: And he stayed yet other seven days  ; and again he sent forth the dove out of the ark  ;

translation.kha: ka ding ka la hap halor ki nongbud jong ki bad thang duh ïa kito ki briew kaba bymman .
translation.en: And a fire was kindled in their company  ; the flame burned up the wicked .

translation.kha: U Terah Badonbor Baroh u ong , Nga la ïohsngew ba ki briew jong ka Moab nabar Ammon ki jingkrenbeiñ bad ki pynsaja ïa ki briew jong nga , bad ki kren khraw ba kin kurup ïa ka ri lad ki .
translation.en: I have heard the reproach of Moab , and the revilings of the children of Ammon , whereby they have reproached my people , and magnified themselves against their border .

Therefore said some of the Pharisees , This man is not of God , because he keepeth not the sabbath day . Others said , How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles ? And there was a division among them .
translation.kha: Don ki Pharisi kiba la ong ,  Uta u briew uba la leh ïa kane um lah ban long na U Blei , naba um shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum Sabbaton .  Hynrei , kiwei pat , ki la ong ,  Kumno u briew uba long u nongpop u lah ban leh kum kita ki kambah kat kine ?  Bad ka la don ka jingïapait hapdeng jong ki .

U Saul u la phah pynïap ïa baroh kiwei pat ki nongshong shnongrit ha Nob , ka nongbah jongno ki lyngdoh : ki shynrang bad ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung , ki masi , ki kada , bad ki langbrot — ki la shah pynïap lut khoit .
translation.en: And Nob , the city of the priests , smote he with the edge of the sword , both men and women , children and sucklings , and oxen , and asses , and sheep , with the edge of the sword .
But he answered and said unto him that told him ,  Who is my mother ? and who are my brethren ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kaei ka kmie jong nga , bad kiei ki para shynrang jong nga ?

Ale malade ai ïa ka kam jong phi ha ka ïabishar ; ai ba ki nongïasaid keiñ ïasyllok uwei ïa uwei bapaw . Mano ba la ïathuhlypa slem mynshuwa kaei ban jia ? Hato ym dei ma nga , U Tlai , U Blei uba pynjam ïa la ki briew ? Ym Don uwei pat U Blei .
translation.en: Tell ye , and bring them near  ; yea , let them take counsel together : who hath declared this from ancient time ? who hath told it from that time ? have not I the  Lord  ? and there is no God else beside me  ; a just God and a Saviour  ; there is none beside me .

translation.kha: U Judia u long kum u sing , Haba u la pynïap ïa uba u thmu u kitei phai sha la krem ; hangta u dem , bad u taïew . Uei uba nud ban pynthut ïa u ?
translation.en: Judah is a lion s whelp : from the prey , my son , thou art gone up : he stooped down , he couched as a lion , and as an old lion  ; who shall rouse him up ?

translation.kha: Hato me jingïohknieh pateng ïa ki jingmut U Blei ïa kiba u la thaw ? Heth ka jingsdang bariew ka dei ka jong me marwei ?
translation.en: Hast thou heard the secret of God ? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself ?

Then will I leave thee upon the land , I will cast thee forth upon the open field , and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee , and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee .
translation.kha: Ngan lyngngeit ïa me ha khyndew bad ngan wanrah ïa ki sim bad ki mrad baroh jong ka pyrthei ba kin ïabam ïa ka doh jong me .
Wallam shuh shuh ki dieng ! Pynrhem ïa ka jing ! Shet ïa ka dohnud ! Phon ïa ka syrwa ! Thang noh ïa ki shyieng !
translation.en: Heap on wood , kindle the fire , consume the flesh , and spice it well , and let the bones be burned .
Then saith he unto me , See thou do it not : for I am thy fellowservant , and of thy brethren the prophets , and of them which keep the sayings of this book : worship God .
translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha nga ,  Wat leh kumne ! Nga long u shakri ryngkat bad me lem bad ki nongïathuhlypa ki para jong me bad jong kito baroh kiba kohnguh ïa ki ktien hapoh jong kane ka kitab . To mane ïa U Blei !

Ha kane ka kamra rung , la don saw tylli ki miej , ar thlia ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka kamra . Dei halor kine ki miej ba la pynïap ïa ki mrad ba dei ban ai kum ki jingkñia , lane ngab thang tylli , lane ban long ki jingkñia sait pop ne kum ki jingtyrwa siew kylliang .
translation.en: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side , and two tables on that side , to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering .

translation.kha: Nga da lade ngan hikai ïa ki briew jong pha , bad ngan ai ha ki ïa ka jingmap bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: And all thy children shall be taught of the  Lord   ; and great shall be the peace of thy children .

translation.kha: Ïa kane la pyn-i lyngba ka jingshisha ba U Blei u la buh ïa kawei pat ka sngi , ïa kaba la khot Ha kane ka sngi . Bun snem hadien u la kren lyngba u Dabid ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ïa kob la lah kdew : Lada phiah ïohsngew ïa ka sur jongki U Blei ha khnai ka snieh , wat pyneh ïa la ki dohnud .
translation.en: Again , he limiteth a certain day , saying in David , To day , after so long a time  ; as it is said , To day if ye will hear his voice , harden not your hearts .

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipor jong u ki leit phai pat sha ka jaka shong dara ha Gilgal .
translation.en: And Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , unto the camp to Gilgal .
And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels , and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkylla ïa ka nongbah Rabbah sha ka jaka ba ri ïa ki ut , bad ïa ka ri ki Ammon baroh kawei sha ka jaka ban ri ïa ki langbrot , khnang ba phin tip ba nga long U  Trai .
Khynñiuh ïaheh kane ka sngew phim shym la pynjot ïa lade . Phim shym la pynjahburom ïa ar lane im katba khem ki ai barabor kiba nga la ai ha phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translation.en: They are not humbled even unto this day , neither have they feared , nor walked in my law , nor in my statutes , that I set before you and before your fathers .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba ngan kuna ,’ u la nong ha lade ; ‘ kun pynpra ïa ki thiar jong nga bad shna ïa kiba kham heh , ha kaba ngan kynshew ïa u kew jong por bad ïa kiei kiwei de ki miej jong nga .
translation.en: And he said , This will I do : I will pull down my barns , and build greater  ; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods .

translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar ki briew jong ka Nebaïoth kin ïeng joit bad mudui ïa phi , namar ki la phai noh na ki pop jrong ki mynba ki la ïohsngew ba u Jonah u ïalap ; bad nga ong ha phi ba don hangne kaba khah khraw ban ïa u Jona !
translation.en: The men of Nineveh shall rise in judgment with this generation , and shall condemn it : because they repented at the preaching of Jonas  ; and , behold , a greater than Jonas is here .
Likewise at the same time said I unto the people , Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem , that in the night they may be a guard to us , and labour on the day .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka por nga ong ïa ki rangbah kiba khmih ïa ka kam , ba ma ki bad ki nongïarap jong ki , ki hap ban sah ha Jerusalem ha ka por mynmiet , khnang ba ngi lah ban ap phira ïa ka nongbah mynmiet bad kumjuh ruh ban trei ha ka por mynsngi .
Yn ym don ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ka ban ïoh kat kine ki jingkyrkhu . Yn ym don mano mano u ban lyngki napdeng jngai phi , lane napdeng ki jingri jong phi .
translation.en: Thou shalt be blessed above all people : there shall not be male or female barren among you , or among your cattle .
And when it was day , he departed and went into a desert place : and the people sought him , and came unto him , and stayed him , that he should not depart from them .
translation.kha: Tang shu kynjat shai , U Jisu u la mihnoh na shnong bad u la leit sha ka jaka bakynjah . Ki paidbah ki la sdang ban wad ïa u , bad haba ki la shem ïa u , ki la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u na kaba leit noh .

translation.en: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do , that ye may live , and multiply , and go in and possess the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers .
translation.kha: Da kohnguh hok ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , ba phin ïoh im , phin roi , bad phin ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba U  Trai  u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
U angel jong U Trai u la paw ha u , u da ïeng ha ka liang kamon jong ka Eri ha kaba la thang ïa ka jingiwbih .
translation.en: And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense .

translation.kha: Khie ka kamram jong ki nongïarap ?
translation.en: What work do the ministerial servants perform for our benefit ?

translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la long ka Jentil , ba la khiah ha ka thain Phoenisia ha Seruïah . Ka la kyrdoh ïa U ju ban beh noh ïa u kynhied na ka khun jong ka .
translation.en: The woman was a Greek , a Syrophenician by nation  ; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter .

translation.kha: namar u longkmie u shatri jongngi U Balei uba trei na ka bynta ka jingbha jong phi hi . Hynrei lada phi leh ïa kaweh sniew , te to sheptieng ïa u , namar ka bor jong u ban pynshitom ka long kaba dei . U long u shakri jong U blem Bad u pyntreikam ïa ka jingpynshitom U Blei halor kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew .
translation.en: For he is the minister of God to thee for good . But if thou do that which is evil , be afraid ; for he beareth not the sword in vain : for he is the minister of God , a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha nga ïa kaba la jia , u Dabid u la ong . Ka kynhun shipai jong ngi ka la phet krad na ka madan sma , u la jubab , bad bun na ki rangdajied jong sem ki la shah pynpei . U Saul bad u Jonathan u khum jong u ruh ki la shah pynïap .
translation.en: And David said unto him , How went the matter ? I pray thee , tell me . And he answered , That the people are fled from the battle , and many of the people also are fallen and dead  ; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also .

translation.kha: U Balak u ong , Ale bad ar , bad nur ïalam ïa phin sha kawei paw ka tare . Lehse U Blei un shah ïa phi ban tim ïa ki na ka bynta jyllang at nangta .
translation.en: And Balak said unto Balaam , Come , I pray thee , I will bring thee unto another place  ; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar ka Judia bad ka Jerusalem , ryngkat bad ki rangbah synshar ka ïingsyiem , ki lyngdoh , bad baroh ki nongïalam , ki la pynpang ïa ka jutang bad nga da kaba ïadih hapdeng ar tylli ki shiteng jong u masi kyrtong ïa uba ki la ot ha ki ar bynta . hynne ki la pynkhynñiuh ïa ka jutang bad Kim shym la bat ïa ki kyndon Jong ka . Kumba ngan ai ïa kine ki briew ïa kaei kaba ki la leh ïa u masi kyrtong .
translation.en: The princes of Judah , and the princes of Jerusalem , the eunuchs , and the priests , and all the people of the land , which passed between the parts of the calf  ;

translation.kha: U Ladan , utai na ki khun shynrang jong u Gershon , u dei u kpa tymmen jong shikhung ki kynhun long-briew , kynthup ïa ka longïing jong u Jehiel u khun jong u .
translation.en: As concerning the sons of Laadan  ; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan , chief fathers , even of Laadan the Gershonite , were Jehieli .
Jesus therefore , knowing all things that should come upon him , went forth , and said unto them ,  Whom seek ye ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaei baroh ka ban sa jia ïa u , kumta u la tur sha khmat bad u la kylli ïa ki ,  Ïano phi ïawad ?
Nga da kwah ba pher ïaishah bun por , wat haba nga leh bieit khyndiat . Sngewbha sa kumta!
translation.en: Would to God ye could bear with me a little in my folly : and indeed bear with me .
They grope in the dark without light , and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man .
translation.kha: ki tare ha ka jingdum bad ïaid sheng sheng kum ki nongbuaid .

translation.en: The whole city shall flee for the noise of the horsemen and bowmen  ; they shall go into thickets , and climb up upon the rocks : every city shall be forsaken , and not a man dwell therein .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingsawa jong ki shipai shong kulai bad jong ki nongsiatkhnam , uwei uwei baroh u phet krad . Katto katne kin phet sha khlaw , kiwei kin ïakiew shajrong hapdeng ki mawsiang . Ïa kawei pa kawei ka shnong yn iehnoh thylli , bad yn ym don uno uno u ban shong ban sah pat ha ki .
U Trai u jop ïa ka kynhun shipai Sudan mynjur u Asa bad ki kynhun shipai jong ka Judia ki uta ïabeh ïa ki .
translation.en: So the  Lord  smote the Ethiopians before Asa , and before Judah  ; and the Ethiopians fled .
Get thee up into the top of Pisgah , and lift up thine eyes westward , and northward , and southward , and eastward , and behold it with thine eyes : for thou shalt not go over this Jordan .
translation.kha: Khie leit sha kliar u Lum Pisgah , bad peit baroh sawdong , shatei , shathie , sha mihngi , bad sha sepngi . Peit bha ïa kaei kaba me ïohi , namar lano lano ruh men ym ïoh leit sha shiliang ka Jordan .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will yet for this be enquired of by the house of Israel , to do it for them  ; I will increase them with men like a flock .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Sa shisien pat ngan shah ïa ki Israel ba kin pan jingïarap na nga bad ngan shah ïa ki ba kin roi ha ka jingbun briew kum ka kynhun langbrot .
U Ussaïah u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki shym ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u Jotham u khulom jongnga u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: So Azariah slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David : and Jotham his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Phi don hynriew sngi ban thir bad ban leh ïa ki kam jong phoi ,
translation.en: Six days shalt thou labour , and do all thy work :

translation.kha: Hib nga dem ban thiah , ki kynti ki ïaid suki nga khih pisa barieh shi miet dara ka slem ban kynjat shai .
translation.en: When I lie down , I say , When shall I arise , and the night be gone ? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki radbah nongsynshar ki la poi , kim shym smam ïa ki baphylla ha byndi , kumta ki la wan pei noh sha ka Borabor Bad ki la ïathuh ,
translation.en: But when the officers came , and found them not in the prison , they returned , and told ,

translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem u jubab , Em , ngan da siewdor ïa ka . Ngan ym ai ha U Trai U Blei Jong sa ïa ki jingkñia naba nga khlam da sieh ei ei . Bad u la thied ïa ka jaka shoh kew bad ïa ki basa dab ha ka dor sanphew tylli ki sbai rupa .
translation.en: And the king said unto Araunah , Nay  ; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price : neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord  my God of that which doth cost me nothing . So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver .

translation.kha: U Bani , u khun jong u Hosia : ka thiang Asher bad ka shnong Bealoth
translation.en: Baanah the son of Hushai was in Asher and in Aloth :

translation.kha: Hynrei ngi ap ïa kaei kambah U Blei u la kular : Ïa ki bneng kiba thymmai bad ïa ka Khynñiuh kaba thymmai , ha kaba ka hok kan don .
translation.en: Nevertheless we , according to his promise , look for new heavens and a new earth , wherein dwelleth righteousness .

translation.kha: Ma phi ïa lade hi phi dei ban long kiba sumar bha . Phin sha kem bad shah ïalam shaw ka ïingbishar . Ïa ph yn sa shohbeiñ ha ki synrang ; phin sa ïeng ha khmat ki nongsynshar bad ki symboh na ka byndi jong nga ban ïathuh ha ki ïa ka Khubor Babha .
translation.en: But take heed to yourselves : for they shall deliver you up to councils  ; and in the synagogues ye shall be beaten : and ye shall be brought before rulers and kings for my sake , for a testimony against them .
And the child grew , and she brought him unto Pharaoh s daughter , and he became her son . And she called his name Moses : and she said , Because I drew him out of the water .
translation.kha: Ynda uta u khunlung u la san , ka leit ïalam ïa u sha ka khun u Pharaoh ; ka ruh ka ri ïa u kum la u khun , bad ka khot kyrteng ïa u , u Moses ,  Namar ,  ka ong ,  nga la sei ïa u na ka um .
Ïa ka Samaria yn pynshitom namar ka ïabah pyrshah ïa nga . Ki briew jong ka ngin ïap ha ka thma ; ïa ki khunlung yn bret sha madan , ïa ki kynthei kiba punkhun yn patar .
translation.en: Samaria shall become desolate  ; for she hath rebelled against her God : they shall fall by the sword : their infants shall be dashed in pieces , and their women with child shall be ripped up .

translation.kha: Naba ka doh jong nga ka long ka jingbam bashisha ; ka snam jong nga ka long ka jingdoh bashisha .
translation.en: For my flesh is meat indeed , and my blood is drink indeed .
And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away : and David rescued his two wives .
translation.kha: U Dabid u la pyllait im ïa baroh bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki Amalek ki la knieh kynthup ïa ki tnga jong u ar ngut .

translation.en: Yet ye have forsaken me , and served other gods : wherefore I will deliver you no more .
translation.kha: Pynban phi dang iehnoh ïa nga bad mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ; kumta ngan ym pyllait ïa phi sa shisien pat .

translation.en: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms , The Lord said unto my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand ,
translation.kha: Naba u Dabid hi u ong ha ka kitab Ki Salm ,   ‘ U Trai u la ong ha u Trai jong nga : to shong hangne ha ka liang kamon jong nga
naba ka jingai sngewbha da ka jingthoh kad don jingmut ei ei kabu u briew uba ai ïa ka u dang im ; ka treikam tang hadien ka jingïap jongnga u .
translation.en: For a testament is of force after men are dead : otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth .
Ye have condemned and killed the just  ; and he doth not resist you .
translation.kha: Phi la pynrem bad phi la pynïap ïa ki briew kiba lui lui , bad kim shym pyneh ïa phi .

translation.en: Thou shalt also decree a thing , and it shall be established unto thee : and the light shall shine upon thy ways .
translation.kha: Phin ïoh jingjop ha baroh kiei kiei kiba phi leh , bad ka jingshai kan shai ha ka lynti ïaid jong phi .

Hadien ba ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la kut , baroh’ ki pyllut Israel ki leit sha kawei pa kaweh ka nongbah ha Judah bad ki pynpra ïa ki rishot mawjam , ki pyndkut ïa ki dur ka blei Asherah , bad ki pynjot ïa ki duwan malade ki jaka mane blei thala . Ki leh ïa kajuh ha baroh ki bynta basah jong ka Judah , bad ïa ki ri jong ki bymman , Ephraim bad Manasseh ; nangta baroh na ki , ki leit phad sha ïing .
translation.en: Now when all this was finished , all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah , and brake the images in pieces , and cut down the groves , and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin , in Ephraim also and Manasseh , until they had utterly destroyed them all . Then all the children of Israel returned , every man to his possession , into their own cities .

translation.kha: (Nga la sngewdei ïa kata ka jingai jingmut ; kumta nga la jingduh khat-ar ngut ki rangbah , uwei na kawei kawei ka jait .
translation.en: And the saying pleased me well : and I took twelve men of you , one of a tribe :
And as they went through the cities , they delivered them the decrees for to keep , that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang leit lyngba ïa ki shnong , ki la ai ha ki parabangeit ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ba ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang ha Jerusalem ki la rai , bad ki la bthah ïa ki ban kohnguh ïa kita ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .

translation.en: Woe unto him that saith to the wood , Awake  ; to the dumb stone , Arise , it shall teach ! Behold , it is laid over with gold and silver , and there is no breath at all in the midst of it .
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi ong ha ka lyngkhot dieng ,  Khie noh !  ne ïa u maw ,  Ïeng joit !  Hato ka bleithaw ka lah ban pynpaw ei ei ïa phi ? Lah ban suit ïa ka da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , hynrei ym don jingim ha ka .
( Ki long kijuh ki jingthaw katba nga ïohi harud ka wah Khebar ) .
translation.en: And the cherubims were lifted up . This is the living creature that I saw by the river of Chebar .
How can ye believe , which receive honour one of another , and seek not the honour that cometh from God only ?
translation.kha: Phi sngewtynnat ban ïohpdiang jingïaroh uwei na uwei pat , hynrei phim pyrshang ban ïoh ïa ka jingïaroh na uta uba ma u hi u long U Blei ; kumno , te , phi lah ban ngeit ha nga ?

translation.en: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father , saying , A man child is born unto thee  ; making him very glad .
translation.kha: Long ba la tim uta u briew uba la pynkmen ïa i pa jong nga mynba u la wallam ha i ka khubor ,  I dei u shynrang ! Phi la don khun shynrang !

translation.en: And the gospel must first be published among all nations .
translation.kha: Hynrei shuwa ba ka jingkut kan wan , ïa ka Gospel yn ïalap ha ki jaitbynriew baroh .

translation.en: And when he cometh , he shall smite the land of Egypt , and deliver such as are for death to death  ; and such as are for captivity to captivity  ; and such as are for the sword to the sword .
translation.kha: U Nebukhadnessar un wan bad jop ïa ka Ijipt . Kito ki briew kiba la dei ban ïap na ka jingpang kin ïap ha ka jingpang , kito kiba dei ba yn ïalam kum ki koidi yn ïalam ïa ki kum ki koidi , bad kito kiba la dei ban sha pynïap ha ka thma kin ïap ha ka thma .
Lydda nga phah ïa ki sha ïing khlem bsa ïa ki , kin ïapler katba ki daiñ ïaid , namar katto katne ngut na ki , ki la wan na ka lynti bajngai .
translation.en: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses , they will faint by the way : for divers of them came from far .

translation.kha: Ai ba kiwei pah ki briew kin ïarap ïa Phin — wat ki nongwei ; ym dei ban leh ïa ka na lade .
translation.en: Let another man praise thee , and not thine own mouth  ; a stranger , and not thine own lips .

translation.kha: nur tap ïa ki lumbah bad ïa ki them da ka metïap bapyut jong me .
translation.en: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains , and fill the valleys with thy height .

translation.kha: U Samuel u khot pur ïa ki briew sha ka jingïalang niam ha Mispah ,
translation.en: And Samuel called the people together unto the  Lord  to Mizpah  ;

translation.kha: Ha kane ka por nga ong ïa ki rangbah kiba khmih ïa ka kam , ba ma ki bad ki nongïarap jong ki , ki hap ban sah ha Jerusalem ha ka por mynmiet , khnang ba i'u lah ban ap pyrsa ïa ka nongbah mynleh bad kumjuh ruh ban trei ha ka por mynsngi .
translation.en: Likewise at the same time said I unto the people , Let every one with his servant lodge within Jerusalem , that in the night they may be a guard to us , and labour on the day .

translation.kha: Wat shah ïa lade ban shad pynrem da uno Une umbiah kam ba u long uba khim hakhlieh namar ki jingïohipaw kiba kyrpang bad uba ïa banbeiñ ha ka jingsngewrit bymdei bad ha kaba myn ïa ki bishar . Naba khyllem Kanaan kano ka daw , ïa Kiba kum kine ki briew la pynmeng shikatdei da ka lap pyrkhat briew bad ki la syngkhlieh ban batskhem ha U Khrist , uba long u khlieh jong ka met .
translation.en: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels , intruding into those things which he hath not seen , vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind ,

translation.kha: Ha jan dei por ban Jobab iaka shithi jngai u .
translation.en: It'd be about time to reply to his letter .

translation.kha: Un pynngat kylla ïa ktien ki jingtim borbah ha ki nongshniah jong phi , Kiba isih bad banbeiñ ïa phi ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies , and on them that hate thee , which persecuted thee .

translation.kha: Ka la ktah ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , dara ka jingmihsnam jongki ka , ka la sangeh shisyndon ; bad ka la don ka jingsngewthuh hapoh jong ka ba ka ïoh na ka jingshitom jong ka .
translation.en: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up  ; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague .

translation.kha: Khlemlait lada u bynriew , daym pynbor ban leh kum , u la kut jingmut skhem ban ym shongkurim , bad ïada ïa la ka mon u lah ba synshar bad ba u la rai kut ha ka jingmut jong u ïa kaei kob un leh — te u kuna ïa kaba dei ban ym shongdor —kata ka theisotti .
translation.en: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart , having no necessity , but hath power over his own will , and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin , doeth well .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ai ha u ïa ka burom , ka jaka hapdeng kiba khraw bad kiba nongbanbor . U la aiti mon sngewbha ïa la ka jingim bad u la shim bynta lem malu ki riewhadem . U la shim ïa ka jaka jong ki nongsngap kiba bun bad u la duwai ba ki kin ïuh ïa ka jingïohmap .
translation.en: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great , and he shall divide the spoil with the strong  ; because he hath poured out his soul unto death : and he was numbered with the transgressors  ; and he bare the sin of many , and made intercession for the transgressors .

translation.kha: Nga la krong palat ïa kaba nga dei ban kren .
translation.en: Once have I spoken  ; but I will not answer : yea , twice  ; but I will proceed no further .

translation.kha: Tang Khyndiat ki briew kin lait im , badno ka Israel kan erlangthari kum u tieng Olib na kaba la kheit lut ïa ki shuh Olib lait noh ar ne prie tylli kiba ha kliar eh , lane khyndiat kiba la iehnoh ha ki tnat bakha shapoh . Nga , U Trai U Blei jong ki Israel , nga la kren .
translation.en: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it , as the shaking of an olive tree , two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough , four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof , saith the  Lord  God of Israel .

translation.kha: Mynta uno uno u da ban sheng ha ka ïingjaiñ jong u — hadien ba la ber da u kyndok ban pynnep ïa ki khñiang jingpang !
translation.en: It shall dwell in his tabernacle , because it is none of his : brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation .
Woe unto you that desire the day of the  Lord  ! to what end is it for you ? the day of the  Lord  is darkness , and not light .
translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi kiba angnud ïa ka sngi U  Trai  ! Kaei kaba bha ba kata ka sngi kan long ïa phi ? Na ka bynta jong phi kan long tang ka sngi jong ka jingdum , bad ym jong ka jingshai .
Don tang ki kot ha duli .
translation.en: There are only books on the shelf .
And entered into a ship , and went over the sea toward Capernaum . And it was now dark , and Jesus was not come to them .
translation.kha: Haba ka janmiet ka la poi , ki synran U Jisu ki la leit hiar sha ka duriaw , ki la kiew ha ka lieng , bad ki la leit phai pat sha shiliang ka duriaw shaphang Kapernam . Ka miet ka la poi bad U Jisu um pat wan satia sha ki .

translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , Now let me die , since I have seen thy face , because thou art yet alive .
translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph ,  Mynta nga la kloi lada ïap noh ruh , namar ba nga la ïohi ïa me bad tip ba me dang im .

Ïa ka Templ U Blei ha bneng la plie , bad ïa ka Synduk ka million la ïor hangta . Nangta la don ki jingthaba leilieh , ki jingkyrhuh bad ki jingsawa u pyrthat , ka jingkhynñiuh jumai badno ka jinghap phria kaba jur .
translation.en: And the temple of God was opened in heaven , and there was seen in his temple the ark of his testament : and there were lightnings , and voices , and thunderings , and an earthquake , and great hail .

translation.kha: Kaba ar na ki hukum bakthang tam ka dei kane : ‘ lad ainguh ïa la u paramarjan kumba me ieit ïa biar .’ Ym don kawei pat ka Law kaba kham kongsan ban ïa kine ar tylli .
translation.en: And the second is like , namely this , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself . There is none other commandment greater than these .

translation.kha: U riewpoh u buhrieh ïa la ka jingshun ha lyndet ki ktieh pynkhyllew .
translation.en: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips , and layeth up deceit within him  ;

translation.kha: Katno kan longkmie kaba kmen hato uwei pa uwei un ïoh kyrhai ka um na ka bynta ki jingthung nabar ki jaka pynbamphlang bahaïing ha kyllan na ka bynta ki kada bad ki masi .
translation.en: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters , that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass .

For if ye do this thing indeed , then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David , riding in chariots and on horses , he , and his servants , and his people .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh shisha kumba nga la hukum , te ki khun ki ksiew u Dabid kin ïailong syiem . Bad ma ki , lem bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki bad ki briew jong ki , kin ïai bteng ban ïaid lyngba ïa ki khyrdop jong kane ka ïingsyiem ha ki kali ïapom bad halor ki kulai .
Kumta nga pynbna skhem ha phi ha kane hi ka sngi : Lada uno uno na phi u dei ban jot noh , ngam don ka jingïakhih .
translation.en: Wherefore I take you to record this day , that I am pure from the blood of all men .

translation.kha: U ainong ïa ki paid Judah , To ngin pynskhem ïa ki nongbah da kaba tei ïa ki kynroh bad ki kut , malade ki khyrdop kiba lai ban khang khyrdep . Ngi long trai ïa ka ri Namar ba im la leh ïa ka mon U Trai U Blei jong ngi . U la ïadih ïa ngi bad u la ai jingshngain na ki balang borbah . Bad kumta ki tei badno ki manbha .
translation.en: Therefore he said unto Judah , Let us build these cities , and make about them walls , and towers , gates , and bars , while the land is yet before us  ; because we have sought the  Lord  our God , we have sought him , and he hath given us rest on every side . So they built and prospered .
Upon man s flesh shall it not be poured , neither shall ye make any other like it , after the composition of it : it is holy , and it shall be holy unto you .
translation.kha: Wat theh ïa ka ha ka met jong uno uno u riewpaidbah bad wat pyndonkam ïa kajuh ka rukom khleh ban shna ïa kawei pat ka jait umphniang kaba kum kane . Kane ka long kaba kyntang , bad phi dei ban kheiñ kyntang ïa ka .
Ngi kylli ruh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khnang ba ngi lah ban pyntip sha phi mano ki nongïalam jngai kane ka kam ki dei .
translation.en: We asked their names also , to certify thee , that we might write the names of the men that were the chief of them .

For John came unto you in the way of righteousness , and ye believed him not : but the publicans and the harlots believed him : and ye , when ye had seen it , repented not afterward , that ye might believe him .
translation.kha: Naba u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la wan ha phi da kaba pyn-i ha phi ïa ka lynti ïaid kaba dei , bad phim shym la ngeit ïa u ; hynrei ki nonglum khajna bad ki nuti ki la ngeit ïa u . Wat haba phi la ïohi ïa kane , phim shym la kylla ïa la ki jingmut hadien bad ngeit ïa u .

translation.en: Then men shall say , Because they have forsaken the covenant of the  Lord  God of their fathers , which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt :
translation.kha: Bad ka jubab kan long , ‘ Dei namar ba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang ba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , u la pynlong bad ki mynba u wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt .

Ngan wad ïa kito kiba la jah , nur-um wallam pat ïa kito kiba la sakma , ngan sap spaiñ ïa iba kiba la mong , mala ngan pynkhiah ïa kito kiba pang , hynrei ïa kito kiba sngaid Bad kiba khleiñ nur sa pynjot , namar nga long u nongaplangbrot kaba har ïa kaei kaba dei .
translation.en: I will seek that which was lost , and bring again that which was driven away , and will bind up that which was broken , and will strengthen that which was sick : but I will destroy the fat and the strong  ; I will feed them with judgment .

translation.kha: Wat sheptieng , ko kynhun barit , naba U Kpa jong phi u la sngewbha ban ai ha phi ïa ka Hima .
translation.en: Fear not , little flock  ; for it is your Father s good pleasure to give you the kingdom .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh ïa u nongïathuhlypa uba ïathuh lypa ïa ka jinglah lah ban ithuh ïa u kum u nongïathuhlypa wahbah U Trai u la phah shisha haba ki jingïathuhlypa jong uta u nongïathuhlypa kin urlong shisha .
translation.en: The prophet which prophesieth of peace , when the word of the prophet shall come to pass , then shall the prophet be known , that the  Lord  hath truly sent him .

translation.kha: To ïaishah iwei ïa iwei pat , bad ïamap iwei ïa kiei pateng ha man ba uno uno na phi u don ka jingmudui pyrshah ïa uno uno uwei pat . Phi dei ban ïamap iwei ïa iwei pat kitab U Trai u la map ïa phi .
translation.en: Forbearing one another , and forgiving one another , if any man have a quarrel against any : even as Christ forgave you , so also do ye .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngi dei ki jong ka sngi , bad ngi dei ban pynrngad . Ngi dei ban kput ïa ka jingngeit bad ïa ka jingieit kum ka jingda shadem , bad ka jingkyrmen jngai ngi ïa ka jingpynim kum ka jingda khlieh .
translation.en: But let us , who are of the day , be sober , putting on the breastplate of faith and love ; and for an helmet , the hope of salvation .
And , behold , thou shalt be dumb , and not able to speak , until the day that these things shall be performed , because thou believest not my words , which shall be fulfilled in their season .
translation.kha: Hynrei mem shym ngeit ïa ka khubor jong nga , ka ban urlong shisha ha ka por kaba dei . Namar ba mem shym la ngeit , men ym lah ban kren , men ïailong uba jar jar tad ynda ka sngi ha kaba ka jingkular jong nga ha me ka urlong shisha .

translation.en: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering  ; the fat that covereth the inwards , and all the fat that is upon the inwards ,
translation.kha: Na uta u masi un shim noh ïa ka khleiñ baroh , ïa ka khleiñ kaba sop ïa ki snier ,

translation.en: Thy righteousness also , O God , is very high , who hast done great things : O God , who is like unto thee !
translation.kha: Ka hok jong me , A Blei , ka kot ïa ki sahit bneng . Me la leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw , ym don mano mano uba kum ma me .
U langsohmoh uba hap ha u Asasel yn wallam im ha khmat U Trai bad nangta yn pyllait ïa u sha ka ri shyiap sha u Asasel , khnap ba un kit noh ïa ki pop u babha .
translation.en: But the goat , on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat , shall be presented alive before the  Lord  , to make an atonement with him , and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness .

translation.kha: bad u pynpeit pat ïa kiba matlah . U khyllie ïa kito kiba la kyllon khong ; u ieit ïa ki briew kiba hok jong u .
translation.en: The  Lord  openeth the eyes of the blind : the  Lord  raiseth them that are bowed down : the  Lord  loveth the righteous :

And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Hast thou considered my servant Job , that there is none like him in the earth , a perfect and an upright man , one that feareth God , and escheweth evil ? and still he holdeth fast his integrity , although thou movedst me against him , to destroy him without cause .
translation.kha: Hato me la peit-thuh ïa u Job u shakri jong nga ?  U  Trai  u kylli .  Ym don uno uno ha ka pyrthei uba ïaineh bad uba bha kat ma u . U mane ïa nga bad u kiar ban ym leh ïa kano kano kaba sniew . Me kynshuit ïa nga ban shah ïa me ban tur pyrshah ïa u khlem don kano kano ka daw , hynrei u Job u ïailong hi uba ïaineh kumba u ju long .

translation.en: And Abner said unto David , I will arise and go , and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king , that they may make a league with thee , and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth . And David sent Abner away  ; and he went in peace .
translation.kha: U Abner u ong ha u Dabid ,  Ngan leit noh mynta , bad ngan pynwan ïa ki Israel baroh sha phi ko Syiem Bakhraw . Kin pdiang ïa phi kum u syiem , bad nangta phin ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi la kwah bad phin synshar halor ka ri baroh kawei .  U Dabid u ai ka jingkular jingshngain ïa u Abner bad u phah noh ïa u .

translation.en: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples , which are not written in this book :
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïadon ryngkat ki synran jong u , U Jisu u la leh shibun kiwei pat ki kambah ïa kiba ym shym la thoh ha kane ka kitab .

bad ka kamram kaba phai shaphang shatei ka la un-long na ka bynta ki lyngdoh kiba shrak ha ka duwan . Baroh ki dei ki lyngdoh kiba la jingartatiend na u Sadok ; dei tang ïa ktien ki dkhot jong ka jait Lebi ba la shah ban leit ha kham ka jingdiang ryngkat U Tharai ban sharai ïa U .
translation.en: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests , the keepers of the charge of the altar : these are the sons of Zadok among the sons of Levi , which come near to the  Lord  to minister unto him .

translation.kha: Ngan nym noh ruh ba ma phi ki briew phim shym bakla ; ngan ïai ba ïa ka jinglui lui jong na haduh ka sngi ba ngan sa ïap .
translation.en: God forbid that I should justify you : till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me .
They that dwell in mine house , and my maids , count me for a stranger : I am an alien in their sight .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ju long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha ka ïing jong nga ki la klet noh ïa nga ; ki shakri kynthei ki leh ïa nga kum ïa uba kim ithuh bad u nongwei .
Ka dei ka jingshetkylla , ko Ahasaïah ! U Joram u kyang jam , katba u dang pynphai sawdong ïa ka khi ïapom jong u bad u phet ïap .
translation.en: And Joram turned his hands , and fled , and said to Ahaziah , There is treachery , O Ahaziah .

translation.kha: Phim ju pyrkhat da lei lei ban pyndonburom ïa ar , wat la nga phah ïa u slap synrai bad ïa u slap prum bad ai ha pa’ ïa ka ngiam ot man la ka snem .
translation.en: Neither say they in their heart , Let us now fear the  Lord  our God , that giveth rain , both the former and the latter , in his season : he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest .

translation.kha: Ka jingiw U Khun U bynriew kan long kum kaei kaba la jia ha ka por u Neah .
translation.en: But as the days of Noah were , so shall also the coming of the Son of man be .
And he taught in their synagogues , being glorified of all .
translation.kha: U la hikai ha ki synagog bad uwei pa uwei u la ïaroh ïa u .

translation.en: The mighty man , and the man of war , the judge , and the prophet , and the prudent , and the ancient ,
translation.kha: ïa ki riewshlur bad ki shipai jong ki , ïa ki nongbishar bad ki nongïathuhlypa jong ki , ïa ki nongbatai kupar bad ki nongsaiñ hima jong ki ,

Ha shuwa ba men die ïa ka dik , ka dei ka jong me ; bad hadien ba me la die ïa ka , ka pisa ka la long ka jong me . Balei , te , ba me la kut jingdum ba leh ïa kane ? Mem shym la shukor ïa ki briew — me la shukor ïa U Bela !
translation.en: Whiles it remained , was it not thine own ? and after it was sold , was it not in thine own power ? why hast thou conceived this thing in thine heart ? thou hast not lied unto men , but unto God .
And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long , and waxed louder and louder , Moses spake , and God answered him by a voice .
translation.kha: Ka jingsawa ka turoi ruh ka nang jam nang jam . U Moses u la kren , bad U Blei u jubab ïa u ha ka sur u pyrthat .
Ki bania bun ki nongkhaïi , ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba kut eh , na ka kamra ha ka dong haduh ka Khyrdop Langbrot .
translation.en: And between the going up of the corner unto the sheep gate repaired the goldsmiths and the merchants .
And while he yet spake , lo , Judas , one of the twelve , came , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and elders of the people .
translation.kha: U Jisu u dang kren haba u Judas , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , u la wan poi . Ryngkat bad u , la don u paidbah babun uba la kieng atiar da ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , ïa kiba la phah da ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san .

U Elijah u jingïathuhlypa u la phiah shithi sha u Jehoram , kambah ong kumne harum : U Trai , U Blei jong u Sabad , u kpa tymmen jyllang me , u pynrem ïa me , namar mem Shim bud ïa ki nuksa u syiem Jehoshaphat , u kpa jong me lane ïa ka jong u syiem Asa , u ïarap jong me .
translation.en: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of David thy father , Because thou hast not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat thy father , nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah ,

translation.kha: Te U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ïa sa ban leit bad ong ha ki pyntud Judah bad ka Jerusalem , Ma nga , U Trai , nga kylli ïa phi balei ba phi kyntait Ban shahshkor ïa ar bad ban kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong nga .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem , Will ye not receive instruction to hearken to my words ? saith the  Lord .
In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah king of Judah Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria , and reigned seventeen years .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba arphew lai jong ka jingsynshar u Joash u khun jong u Ahasaïah kum u syiem ka Judah , u Jehoahas u khun jong u Jehu u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u synshar khathynñiew snem ha Samaria .
U Joshua u jubab , Lada phoi ïabun paid hajuh katta katta bad ba ka ri lum Ephraim ka rit than ïa phoi , te khie leit sha ki khlaw malu prat na ka bynta ïa lade ha ka ri ki Peris bad ki Rephaim .
translation.en: And Joshua answered them , If thou be a great people , then get thee up to the wood country , and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants , if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka Jerusalem ka la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki hukum jong nga , ka da pynpaw ba ka long kaba kham sniew ban ïa kiwei pat ki ri , ka la hir bymkohnguh kham palat ïa ki ri kiba don sawdong jong ka . Ka Jerusalem ka la kyntait ïa ki hukum jong to bad Kam kohnguh satia ïa ki aiñ jong nga .
translation.en: And she hath changed my judgments into wickedness more than the nations , and my statutes more than the countries that are round about her : for they have refused my judgments and my statutes , they have not walked in them .

translation.kha: Nga la khmih ha ka pyrthei — ka la long ka jingïap ei suda , ha ka sahit bna — ym don nangno kano ka jingshai .
translation.en: I beheld the earth , and , lo , it was without form , and void  ; and the heavens , and they had no light .

translation.kha: Ngan pham ïa ki mradkhlaw kiba shympriah ba kin leh dulir halor jong phi ; kine kin pynïap ïa ki khun ki ktha jong phi , kin pynjot ïa ki jingri jingdup jong phi , bad kin sah sa tang khyndiat eh na phi , ba kumta ki lynti bah jong phi kin kynjah .
translation.en: I will also send wild beasts among you , which shall rob you of your children , and destroy your cattle , and make you few in number  ; and your high ways shall be desolate .
And certain of the chief of Asia , which were his friends , sent unto him , desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki bor synshar ka probins , kiba long ki paralok jong u , ki la phah ruh ka khubor sha u da kaba kyrpad ïa u ban ym pyn-i khmat ïa lade ha ka jaka leh tamasa .
Wan kiew sha nga ha uta u lum , bad ngan thoh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa kito ki kiei kiba nga la thoh ha ki mawlyngkniap ïa kiba me la lynthaw , bad nangta man buh ïa ki ha sier ka pynkut .’
translation.en: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest , and thou shalt put them in the ark .

translation.kha: Lada phi siew kylliang ïa kaba bha da naba sniew , da lei lei phira ym lah ban beh ïa kaba sngew na ka ïing jong phi .
translation.en: Whoso rewardeth evil for good , evil shall not depart from his house .

translation.kha: to pyllait im ïa kiwei , da kob knieh kynthih ïa ki na ka ding ; bad ïa kiwei pat , to hynne da ka jingsheptieng , hynrei to da isih ïa ki jingpynnang jong ki hi , kiba la bat tngit da ki jingkwah brai bapop .
translation.en: And others save with fear , pulling them out of the fire  ; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh .

translation.kha: Haba uno uno u sleit , te nga ruh la lalot ; Haba uno ine u hap ha ka pop , la pyndap ïa la da ka jingkthang mynsaw .
translation.en: Who is weak , and I am not weak ? who is offended , and I burn not ?

translation.kha: Ka khim bakha ban bam ïa ki jhur bad ki briew kiba ieit ïa phi ban ïa kaba baibam ïa ka doh kaba ba tam ha kambah don ka jingpdiang .
translation.en: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is , than a stalled ox and hatred therewith .

translation.kha: Nangta u Moserah u la wan hiar na u Lum Bad u ong ïa ki paidbah ba kin Pynkhreh ïa lade na ka bynta ka jingmane .
translation.en: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people , and sanctified the people  ; and they washed their clothes .

translation.kha: khnang ba ma phi lem bad ki briew jong U Blei barabor , phna ia ban ïoh ka kun pun sngewkwah katno ka jingïar bad ka lynter , katno ka jingjrong bad ka jingjylliew , ka long ka jingieit U Khrist .
translation.en: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth , and length , and depth , and height ;

translation.kha: U la thum ïa nga ha ki kynjri ; nga un-long u koidi u bym don kano kano ka jingkyrmen don lait phet .
translation.en: He hath hedged me about , that I cannot get out : he hath made my chain heavy .

translation.kha: La don hynñiew tylli ki mawkyrdon ban kiew sha ka , sad ka kamra rung jong ka , ka la don ha kaba kut marpyrshah ïa ka phyllaw . La don ki dieng Tlai ba la oh-shrong ha ki khashor ki kynroh bashapoh kiba phai khmat shai ka lynti ïaid .
translation.en: And there were seven steps to go up to it , and the arches thereof were before them : and it had palm trees , one on this side , and another on that side , upon the posts thereof .

And he spake before his brethren and the army of Samaria , and said , What do these feeble Jews ? will they fortify themselves ? will they sacrifice ? will they make an end in a day ? will they revive the stones out of the heaps of the rubbish which are burned ?
translation.kha: Ha khmat ki paralok jong u bad ki shipai Samaria u ong ,  Kaei , kine ki Jiw shem-lanot , ki tharai ba ki leh ? Hato ki pyrkhat ba da ka jingkñia jingainguh ki lah ban pyndep ïa ka kam ha ka shi sngi ? Hato ki lah ban pynlong ïa ki maw jingtei na ki kynton jong ki synrum ba la ing ?

Ki paid Israel kiba lait im kmen long kum ka tmier ba pynpyngngad ba la phiah da U Trai na ka bynta ki jaitbynriew ba bun , kum ki um slap ha ki jingthung ba dang mih . Kin shynna ha U Blei , ym ha u briew .
translation.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many people as a dew from the  Lord  , as the showers upon the grass , that tarrieth not for man , nor waiteth for the sons of men .
In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months : and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah .
translation.kha: U la synshar ha Hebron halor ka Judah haduh hynñiew snem shiteng , bad ha Jerusalem halor ki Israel bad Judah baroh haduh laiphew lai snem .
Ngan pynjot ïa ki bleithaw malade ki rishot maw bakynjang jong phi ; pher ym mane haw ïa kiei kiei kiba phi hi phi la thaw .
translation.en: Thy graven images also will I cut off , and thy standing images out of the midst of thee  ; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands .
What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant ? for thou knowest thy servant .
translation.kha: Aïu ngan ong shuh ha me ! Me tip bha ïa nga , bad pynban me pyndonburom ïa nga , u shakri jong me .
Hato phi kynmaw haei u tmoh u ieh ka shatri ?
translation.en: Do you remember where Tom left his umbrella ?

translation.kha: Hynrei na ni ka jingphla na ka bniat jong nga kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka jingphla kaba u Ïaineh u la ai : Kaei kaba nga leh , kata ka long , ki kim kiba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ïa nga ban leh , kine ki klun na ka bynta jong nga bun ki pyn-i ba U Kpa u la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: But I have greater witness than that of John : for the works which the Father hath given me to finish , the same works that I do , bear witness of me , that the Father hath sent me .

translation.kha: Lehse U Blei un kylla ka jingmut jong u ; lehse un sangeh ei na kaba bitar , bad ngin ym ïap !
translation.en: Who can tell if God will turn and repent , and turn away from his fierce anger , that we perish not ?

translation.kha: Pynkyntang khuid ïa lade , naba nga longïng U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Sanctify yourselves therefore , and be ye holy : for I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jongki nga , ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad ïa ka jingtip jong ka , ïa ki jingpynriam borbah jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translation.en: The tabernacle of the congregation , and the ark of the testimony , and the mercy seat that is thereupon , and all the furniture of the tabernacle ,

translation.kha: Ho-oid , ko Trai ! ka la jubab . Nga bieit ba me longsyiem U Messaïah , U Khun U Blei , u ban sa wan sha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: She saith unto him , Yea , Lord : I believe that thou art the Christ , the Son of God , which should come into the world .

translation.kha: Kata ka long balei ba nga thoh ïa kane kat nga dang don jingjai na phi ; ka long kumta ba haba nga poi sam ym hap ban leh tyngeh ha kaba pyndonkam ïa ka ieit ïa kaba U Tlai u la ai ha nga — ka bor ïa ka pun tei ïa phi , ym ïa ka ban pynpra .
translation.en: Therefore I write these things being absent , lest being present I should use sharpness , according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification , and not to destruction .

translation.kha: Baroh ki bat ïa ki duma ha la ki kti kadiang , ïa ki tharai ha la ki kti kum , bad ki pyrta , Ka thliem ïa U thri bad ïa u Gideon !
translation.en: And the three companies blew the trumpets , and brake the pitchers , and held the lamps in their left hands , and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal : and they cried , The sword of the  Lord  , and of Gideon .

translation.kha: Ym don shuh katno kano kaba dang sah na baroh katba ngi la ju sngewtieng . Ngi la leh pop bad mynta ngi erlangthari kiba la tim .
translation.en: The crown is fallen from our head : woe unto us , that we have sinned !

If they sin against thee , ( for there is no man that sinneth not , ) and thou be angry with them , and deliver them to the enemy , so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy , far or near  ;
translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong me ki leh pop pyrshah ïa me — bad ba ym don uwei ruh u briew uba khlem leh pop — bad ha la ka jingbitar me shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jop ïa ki bad ban ring koidi ïa ki sha kawei pat ka ri , wat la kata ka ri ka long kaba jngai , to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong me .
( Naba babha mane blei thala jngai kane ka pyrthei ki ïai pyrkhat shaphang kine kiei kiei baroh . ) U Kpa jong phi u pyntip ba phi donkam ïa kine kiei Kiei .
translation.en: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after : and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por tun weng noh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki thliew na ka ri , bad ym don me mano ban kynroh shuh ïa ki . Ngan weng napoh ïa uno un uba kur ba u long u nongïathuhlypa bad ngan shim nala ïa ka jingkwah pun Mane ïa ki bleithaw .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land , and they shall no more be remembered : and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land .

translation.kha: Phi la wan sha U Jisu , uba la pynlong ïa ka jutang bathymmai , bad sha ka snam ba la synreit , kaba kutlad bun kiei kiei babha kham bha ban ïa ka snam u Abel .
translation.en: And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant , and to the blood of sprinkling , that speaketh better things than that of Abel .
But he answered and said ,  It is not meet to take the children s bread , and to cast it to dogs .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kam long kaba dei ban shim ïa ka jingbam jong ki khun bad bret ïa ka sha ki ksew .
To U Blei uba un-long U Kpa jong sem nabar U Ujuh Khereth uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingtei bad ïa ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .
Nor by the earth  ; for it is his footstool : neither by Jerusalem  ; for it is the city of the great King .
translation.kha: lymne da ka khyndew , naba ka long ka jingïuhkjat jong u ; lymne da ka Jerusalem , naba ka long ka nongbah jong U Syiem uba khraw .
Suk kito kiba shah pynshitom beiñ namar ba ki leh ïa katei kaba U Blei u dawa ; ka Hima ki bneng ka lama ka jong ki !
translation.en: Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness  sake : for theirs is the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: Haba ki la ïa-pyrshah ïa u bad ki la ainong kiei kiei kiba sniew shaphrang jong u , u la pynpaw ïa ka jingsngew pyrshah da kaba kynther ïa u pui pui na ki jaiñ jong u bad ong ha ki , Lada phi hir kiba la sim noh , Phin hi da lade phi dei banbeiñ Shim ka jingkyiuh na ka bynta jngai ka ! Ngam don jingpynkhiah . Naduh mynta kan leit sha ki Jentil .
translation.en: And when they opposed themselves , and blasphemed , he shook his raiment , and said unto them , Your blood be upon your own heads  ; I am clean : from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles .

translation.kha: ( 1 Korinth 15 :24 ) Te balei phim ïathuh lem ha la ki paralok bad Kiba ieit ba thoiñ shaphang aiu ka Hima U Blei kan leh ?
translation.en: ( 1 Corinthians 15 :24 ) Why not tell your friends and loved ones about what God’s Kingdom will do ?
And king David said to Ornan , Nay  ; but I will verily buy it for the full price : for I will not take that which is thine for the  Lord  , nor offer burnt offerings without cost .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Syiem u jubab ,  Em , ngan siew ha me ïa ka dor ba-pura . Ngan ym ai kum ka jingainguh ha U  Trai  ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong me , da kaei kaba shu ïoh ei .

Te ki briew jong nga kin Tip ba nga long U Trai U Blei jong ki . Kin sa tip ïa kane , Namar nga la phah ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw malu mynta nga lumlang ïa ki bad wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri jong ki hi , khlem da ieh wat uwei na ki shadien .
translation.en: Then shall they know that I am the  Lord  their God , which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen : but I have gathered them unto their own land , and have left none of them any more there .

translation.kha: U Trai u ïathuh ha u mawshun , ban ong ha ki kynhun Israel ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: U kpa jongnga phi u la buh ki jingduk kiba khia ïa ngi . Lada phi pynsting ïa Kin ki jingsuh bad pynlong ïa ka jingimat jong ngi naba khampoh suk te ngin longkmie ki khun ki raïot uba shakri hok ïa phi .
translation.en: Thy father made our yoke grievous : now therefore ease thou somewhat the grievous servitude of thy father , and his heavy yoke that he put upon us , and we will serve thee .
His countenance was like lightning , and his raiment white as snow :
translation.kha: Ka durkhmat jong u ka la long kum ka leilieh , bad ki jaiñ jong u ki lieh kum ka ïor .

U Syiem Dabid u ïohsngew ba namar ka Synduk ka Jutang , U Trai u la kyrkieh ïa ka longïing jong u Obed Edom sad barben kat kiba u don ; kumta u leit shimti noh ïa ka synduk ka Jutang na ka ïing jong u Obadaïah ban ithuh rhah ïa ka sha Jerusalem ryngkat bad ka jinglehkmen kaba khrawbor .
translation.en: And it was told king David , saying , The  Lord  hath blessed the house of Obed–edom , and all that pertaineth unto him , because of the ark of God . So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed–edom into the city of David with gladness .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ka jingai ba lah ngab kren ha ki thylliej bapher ka long ka jingpynshisha ha ki bymngeit , ym ha kiba ngeit , kaban ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khohruh U Blei ka long ka jingpynshisha ïa babha ngeit , ym ïa ki bymngeit .
translation.en: Wherefore tongues are for a sign , not to them that believe , but to them that believe not : but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not , but for them which believe .

translation.kha: Haba u la poi ha ïing , um khim shah ïano ïano ban rung shapoh nabar u lehse noh u Petros , u Ïoannis badno u Jakob , bad u kpa bad ka kmie jong ka khynnah .
translation.en: And when he came into the house , he suffered no man to go in , save Peter , and James , and John , and the father and the mother of the maiden .

translation.kha: ibha u pyllew u la dep kren , u la dem khohsiew bad ki bad u la duwai .
translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he kneeled down , and prayed with them all .
Be not thou envious against evil men , neither desire to be with them .
translation.kha: Wat bishni ïa ki riewsniew , bad wat pyrshang ban ïalang paralok bad ki .

translation.en: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour  ; as he hath done , so shall it be done to him  ;
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u pynmynsaw ïa uwei pat u briew , kumba u la leh ïa uta , kumta ruh yn leh kylliang ïa u .
Hynrei nga iathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Ka hasem bha ïa phi ba sa leit khong , namar lada ngam leit noh , U Nongïarap un ym wan sha phi . Hynrei lada nga leit noh , te ngan phah ïa u Sha phira .
translation.en: Nevertheless I tell you the truth  ; It is expedient for you that I go away : for if I go not away , the Comforter will not come unto you  ; but if I depart , I will send him unto you .

translation.kha: * Ka kam katba nyngkong eh kaba u ijuh u la leh ka long ban shop ïa u Soitan bad ïa ki kynduh jong u sha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: * Jesus’ first action as King was to throw Satan and his demons down to the earth .

translation.kha: Kin tei pat ïa ki nongbah ba la jot la pra .
translation.en: And they shall build the old wastes , they shall raise up the former desolations , and they shall repair the waste cities , the desolations of many generations .
When they heard these things , they held their peace , and glorified God , saying , Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life .
translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sangeh ïa ka jingwoh nia jong ki bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei , da kaba ong ,  Te U Blei u la ai ruh ha ki Jentil ïa la lad ban kylla-kaba-mut bad ban lait im !

translation.en: So they cast him out of the vineyard , and killed him . What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki la bret ïa u shabar jong ka bri sohwaiñ bad ki la pynïap ïa u .  Kaei , te , ba u trai jong ka bri sohwaiñ un leh ïa ki nongshimwai ?  U Jisu u la kylli .
Phi kiba bieit ! Hato phin kwah ban da pyn-i ba ka jingngeit khlem ki kdew ka Long ka bymneh ?
translation.en: But wilt thou know , O vain man , that faith without works is dead ?

translation.kha: Mar ïapoi ka miet , ki parabangeit ki la phah ïa u Paul bad u Silas sha Beria . Haba ki la poh hangta , ki la leit sha ka synagog .
translation.en: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea : who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews .

translation.kha: U Trai u wer ïa ki jingpyrkhat kiba sngewieit , hynrei u sngewbha ha ki ktien kiba sngur jingmut .
translation.en: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the  Lord  : but the words of the pure are pleasant words .
And she said unto him , My lord , thou swarest by the  Lord  thy God unto thine handmaid , saying , Assuredly Solomon thy son shall reign after me , and he shall sit upon my throne .
translation.kha: Ka jubab ,  Syiem Kynrad , phi la pynlong ka jingsmai bakyntang ha nga ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ba u Solomon , u khun jong nga un long syiem hadien jong phi .

translation.en: And Ahab spake unto Naboth , saying , Give me thy vineyard , that I may have it for a garden of herbs , because it is near unto my house : and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it  ; or , if it seem good to thee , I will give thee the worth of it in money .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Ahab u ong ha u Naboth ,  Ai noh ïa kane ka bri sohwaiñ jong me ha nga ba ngan pynlong ka kper jhur ïa ka , namar ka don harud ka ïingsyiem jong nga . Ngan ai pli ïa me da ka bri sohwaiñ kaba kham bha ha ka jaka jong ka , lane , lada me sngewdei , ngan da siewdor kaba biang ïa ka .
Katto katne ngut ki rangbah bariewblei kiba la tep ïa u Saphon , ki la ïambriew na ka bynta jrong u da ka jingshim kaba jam .
translation.en: And devout men carried Stephen to his burial , and made great lamentation over him .

translation.kha: To bat ha ka kti jong me ïa kito ki lyngkhot dieng ar tylli sad ai ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa ki .
translation.en: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes .

translation.kha: Wat long kamon ki kpa Thummim jong phi . La slem bah ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ai ha ki ïa ka khubor jong nga , da kaba ïatih ha ki ban ym im bymman , ban ym im shuh ka jingim bapop . Hynrei kim shym la shahshkor ïa per litar kohnguh ïa de .
translation.en: Be ye not as your fathers , unto whom the former prophets have cried , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Turn ye now from your evil ways , and from your evil doings : but they did not hear , nor hearken unto me , saith the  Lord .
The way of man is froward and strange : but as for the pure , his work is right .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba pop ki ïaid ka lynti kyllaiñ ; hynrei kiba lui lui ki ïaid ha kaba beit .

translation.en: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul , and a sword , and a sharp arrow .
translation.kha: Ka jingsakhi lamler ka long kaba ma kum ka waitlam , u dieng tangon ne u khnam banep .

translation.en: Go up against the land of Merathaim , even against it , and against the inhabitants of Pekod : waste and utterly destroy after them , saith the  Lord  , and do according to all that I have commanded thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Tur ïaleh ïa ki briew jong ka Merathaim bad jong ka Pekod . Pynïap bad pynjot ïa ki . Leh ïa kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba nga hukum ïa phi . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

U Shelomith bad ka longïing jong u , ki dei peiñ ïa barhem kiei keiñ kiba la pynkyntang ban pyndonkam ha ka Templ , kynthup jin ïa ki jingai jingsngewbha kiba la wanlam da u Samuel , u nongïathuhlypa , da u syiem Saul , da u Abner u khur jongu u Ner , bad da u Jobab u khun jong ka Seruïah .
translation.en: And all that Samuel the seer , and Saul the son of Kish , and Abner the son of Ner , and Joab the son of Zeruiah , had dedicated  ; and whosoever had dedicated any thing , it was under the hand of Shelomith , and of his brethren .
For they have sown the wind , and they shall reap the whirlwind : it hath no stalk : the bud shall yield no meal : if so be it yield , the strangers shall swallow it up .
translation.kha: Haba ki bet ïa ka lyer , kin ïoh ot ïa ka  erlangthari ! U kew baroh shi pynthor u bym pat ih un ym lah ban pynmih kpu . Hynrei wat lada u pynmih ruh , ki nongwei kin bam ei ïa u .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the sun did arise , that God prepared a vehement east wind  ; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah , that he fainted , and wished in himself to die , and said , It is better for me to die than to live .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka sngi ka la mih , U Blei u la phah ïa ka lyer mihngi kaba shit , bad u Jonah u la jan ïapler na ka jingshit jong ka sngi kaba shoh halor ka khlieh jong u . Kumta u la kwah ban ïap noh .  Ka kham bha ïa nga ban ïap noh ban ïa kaba im ,  u la ong .
Balei me khot babha ïa nga ? U Jisu u la kylli ïa u . Ym anna uba bha lait noh tang U Blei hi .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Why callest thou me good ? there is none good but one , that is , God .

translation.kha: Ïa ki metïap jong ki shiphang jong ki yn iehnoh ha ki sim malu ki mrad . Ha ka lyiur ki sim ngin bam ïa ki , Bad ha ka tlang ki mrad .
translation.en: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains , and to the beasts of the earth : and the fowls shall summer upon them , and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them .

translation.kha: mynba , A Trai , to sngap ïa ngi malade to peit ïa kaei kaba la jylla ha ngi . To shahshkor ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba u Sennakherib u la ainong ban ñiewbeiñ ïa me , U Blei ba-im .
translation.en: Incline thine ear , O  Lord  , and hear  ; open thine eyes , O  Lord  , and see : and hear all the words of Sennacherib , which hath sent to reproach the living God .

translation.kha: Nangta u Paulos u la ong , Nga smat ba nga kren ïa ka jingshisha ! Ai ba U Blei un pynshitom ïa na lada ngam long kumta ! Ngam tip shaphang uta u briew uba phi kren !
translation.en: But he began to curse and to swear , saying , I know not this man of whom ye speak .

translation.kha: Ki pynkylla khongpong ïa kiei kiei baroh . Kano kaba kham donkam , u nongthaw khiew ne ka dewbyrtha ? Hato lai mo ba kaei kaei katba u briew u la thab kan ong ha u , Phim shym la thaw ïa nga ? Lane hato ka lah ban ong ha u , Phim tip ïa kaei kaba phira leh ?
translation.en: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter s clay : for shall the work say of him that made it , He made me not ? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it , He had no understanding ?

translation.kha: Pyndem da ki Ktien kiba shongnia ïa kiba yn ym don ba wad sier , khnang ba yn eh pynlehrain ïa ki nongshun jong me da ka bym don ei ei kaba sniew ïa-ban ïoh kren pyrshah shaphang jong ngi .
translation.en: Sound speech , that cannot be condemned ; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed , having no evil thing to say of you .

translation.kha: Ngin la Shim ïa kaei kaei kaweh kham kthang ban ïa ka jingtep — ka kynoi kaba long kum ka jingriam . Ka jingtei ba ka ai ïa phi kan krem ïa phi kumta ka jam , bad ki kti jong ka sawdong jong phi kin bat ïa phi kum u kynjri . U briew ibha pynsngewbha ïa U Blei u lah ban lait , hynrei kan kem ïa u nongpop .
translation.en: And I find more bitter than death the woman , whose heart is snares and nets , and her hands as bands : whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her  ; but the sinner shall be taken by her .

translation.kha: Ki bteng lang san tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba kin long tang kawei Sei suk jingtap , bad ki leh kumjuh ïa ki hynriew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba Hukum .
translation.en: And he coupled five curtains by themselves , and six curtains by themselves .
Many days and years shall ye be troubled , ye careless women : for the vintage shall fail , the gathering shall not come .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban sngewhun mynta , hynrei kum ha kane ka por ha ka snem ka ban wan , phin long ha ka jingduh jingkyrmen namar yn ym don sohwaiñ ba phin ïohlum .
A Trai , ym khong uno uno uba kum ma me ; me long kaba khrawbor , bad ka kyr-ang jong me ka long kaba khraw bad kaba nongbanbor .
translation.en: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee , O  Lord   ; thou art great , and thy name is great in might .
All the words of my mouth are in righteousness  ; there is nothing froward or perverse in them .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei baroh kiba nga kren ki long kiba shisha ; ym don ei ei ha ki kaba lamler lane ïalam bakla .

U Trai u ong , Lada u briew u pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga , bad ka ieh ïa u bad ka long noh ka tnga jong uwei patar u briew , um dei ban shim paw ïa ka . Kane kan pyntngit lut ïa ka ri . hynriew , ko Israel , pha la lah anna shibun ki nongrit , bad mynta pha kwah ban waiñ phai sha nga !
