translation.kha: U Elisha u khet ïa u Gehasi , bad u ong ïa u ban khot ïa ka kamai jong u khynnah . Haba ka la waiñ Shabeh , u ong ha ka , Une u khun jongngi phi .
translation.en: And he called Gehazi , and said , Call this Shunammite . So he called her . And when she was come in unto him , he said , Take up thy son .
For the mystery of iniquity doth already work : only he who now letteth will let , until he be taken out of the way .
translation.kha: Ka Jingbymman Bamaïan ka la da trei , hynrei , kaei ka ban jia , kan ym jia tad ynda ïa uta uba bat ïa ka la weng noh na ka lynti .

translation.en: Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive , and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed .
translation.kha: Kumta phin long kiba nyngkong ban leit sha ka jinglongmraw . Ki jingkhawai bad ki jingïadih ïabam sngewbha jong phi kin kut noh .
Khie leit wad ïa u Jeremaïah bad satia bha ïa u . Wat pynïashong ïa u , ishyrkhei leh ïa katei kaei barieh kob u kwah .
translation.en: Take him , and look well to him , and do him no harm  ; but do unto him even as he shall say unto thee .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ïa u Moses ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,

translation.kha: U Petros u la jubab , Nga long u Siew , ïa uba la kwah ha Tarsos ha Kilikia , u traishnong ka nongbah ba-ïashun . Sngewbha shah ïa nga ban kren ha u paidbah .
translation.en: But Paul said , I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus , a city in Cilicia , a citizen of no mean city : and , I beseech thee , suffer me to speak unto the people .
O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments ! then had thy peace been as a river , and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea :
translation.kha: Tang lada phi la sngap ïa ki hukum jong nga ! Te ki jingkyrkhu kin jin da la tuid ha phi kum ka wahduid ka bym ju rngad ! Ka jingjop kan jin da la wan ha phi kum ki jingat phyllung kiba phaloh ha ka rud duriaw .
Kumne te ba phim shemphang ba ngam shitrhem kren ha phi Shaphang u kpu ? To sumar ïa lade” na u thiat ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi !
translation.en: How is it that ye do not understand that I spake it not to you concerning bread , that ye should beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees ?

translation.kha: shaneng ka jinglong Blei bakhuid jong u , la pyn-i shynna da ka bor bakhraw ban un-long U Khun jong U Blei da kaba pynïap na ka jingïap .
translation.en: And declared to be the Son of God with power , according to the spirit of holiness , by the resurrection from the dead :

translation.kha: Te u Samuel u ong , Kaei kaba U Trai u kham sngewbha : ka jingkohnguh ne ki jingainguh bad ki jingkha ? Ka kham bha ban kohnguh ïa u ban ïa kaba kñia ha u ïa ka langbrot kaba kynsai tam .
translation.en: And Samuel said , Hath the  Lord  as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices , as in obeying the voice of the  Lord  ? Behold , to obey is better than sacrifice , and to hearken than the fat of rams .

And ye came near unto me every one of you , and said , We will send men before us , and they shall search us out the land , and bring us word again by what way we must go up , and into what cities we shall come .
translation.kha: Hynrei phi ïawan sha nga , bad phi ïa-ong , ‘ To ngin ïaphah shuwa ïa ki rangbah ban leit syntiat ïa kata ka ri , khnang ba ki lah ban wan ïathuh ha ngi na kano ka lynti kaba biang eh ba ngin leit kiew bad kiba kumno ki jait shnong kiba don hangta .’

translation.en: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee , the fir tree , the pine tree , and the box together , to beautify the place of my sanctuary  ; and I will make the place of my feet glorious .
translation.kha: Ïa ki dieng jong u dieng Kseh , u dieng Kseh-Juniper , bad u dieng Kseh-Sypress , ki dieng kiba kynsai tam jong ka khlaw Lebanon yn wallam ban tei biang ïa pha , ko Jerusalem , ban pynitynnat ïa ka Templ jong nga , ban pyndonburom ïa ka nongbah jong nga .

translation.en: His fart smelled .
translation.kha: Ka ksem jong u ka sma .
Haba map , dem Ban leh kumne . Uwei pa iwei uba ai riam ha la u para Israel u dei ban map ïa tala ka ram ; um dei ban dawa thuh ïa ka , namar ba U Trai’ hi u la ticket ïa ka .
translation.en: And this is the manner of the release : Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it  ; he shall not exact it of his neighbour , or of his brother  ; because it is called the  Lord s  release .

Then wrought Bezaleel and Aholiab , and every wise hearted man , in whom the  Lord  put wisdom and understanding to know how to work all manner of work for the service of the sanctuary , according to all that the  Lord  had commanded .
translation.kha: U Besalel , u Oholiab , bad kiwei pat ki nongtrei ïa kiba U  Trai  u la ai ka jingtbit bad ka jingshemphang , kiba tip ban trei ïa ka kam baroh kaba ïadei bad ka jingtrei ïa ka Ïingjaiñ kaba kyntang , ki dei ban shna ïa kaei kaei baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: And he turned him unto his disciples , and said privately ,  Blessed are the eyes which see the things that ye see :
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la phai sha ki synran bad u la ong ha ki ha kaba rieh ,  A katno phi long kiba donbok ban ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba phi ïohi !
Hadien kane nga la ïohi ïa uwei bapaw u angel naba wan hajir na bneng . U la don ka bor barabor , bad ka jingphyrnai jong u ka la pynthaba ïa ka pyrthei baroh kamai .
translation.en: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven , having great power  ; and the earth was lightened with his glory .
And it was so : for he rose up early on the morrow , and thrust the fleece together , and wringed the dew out of the fleece , a bowl full of water .
translation.kha: Ka la long thik kumta . Haba u Gideon u la khie dang step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bud , u la khem ïa u shñiuh langbrot bad u la khyrwait ïa ka umjer na u ban pyndap ïa ka pliang da ka um .
Man la u lyngdoh Jiw , u treh ïa la ka kam man ka sngi bad ai kijuh ki jingkñia man ka por ; hawei kine ki jingkñia Kim lah ban Suit noh ïa ki pop .
translation.en: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices , which can never take away sins :

translation.kha: Naduh mynstep haduh mynmiet ki rkhiebeiñ ïa nga .
translation.en: Behold their sitting down , and their rising up  ; I am their musick .
And Joshua said unto them , Fear not , nor be dismayed , be strong and of good courage : for thus shall the  Lord  do to all your enemies against whom ye fight .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u ong ha ki rangbah shipai ,  Wat sheptieng lane khaw-eit . Long uba kut jingmut triang uba skhem namar kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  un leh ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh .
Haba uta u briew u la ïohsngew ïa kane , ka jingjaw ka la Tap ïa ka khmat jong u baroh kawei , bad u la sien noh da ka jingsngewsih , namar u la long ibha riewspah ïaheh katta long .
translation.en: And he was sad at that saying , and went away grieved : for he had great possessions .

translation.kha: u khuid jong u Jesse , u khun jong u Obed , u khun jong u boi , u khun jong u Salmon , u khun jong u ïasnoh ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Jesse , which was the son of Obed , which was the son of Booz , which was the son of Salmon , which was the son of Naasson ,

translation.kha: Da ka jingjop bakhraw me pynlut ïa ki nongshun jong me ; ka jingbitar jongno me ka meh mala ka bam heh ïa ki kum ïa u pynïap .
translation.en: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee : thou sentest forth thy wrath , which consumed them as stubble .
And upon this came his disciples , and marvelled that he talked with the woman : yet no man said , What seekest thou ? or , Why talkest thou with her ?
translation.kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat ki synran jong u Jisu ki la wan phai , bad ki la lyngngoh shikatdei eh ban lap ïa u ba u ïakren bad kata ka briew . Hynrei ym don na ki uba la ong ïa ka ,  Pha kwah aïu ?  lane uba la kylli ïa u ,  Balei ba me ïakren bad ka ?

translation.en: Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance , both young men and old together : for I will turn their mourning into joy , and will comfort them , and make them rejoice from their sorrow .
translation.kha: Nangta ki samla kynthei kin shad bad kin kmen , bad ki shynrang , kiba samla bad kiba tymmen , kin shadkmen . Ngan pyntngen ïa ki bad pynkylla ïa ka jingïambriew sha ka jingkmen , ïa ka jingsngewsih jong ki sha ka jingsngewbha .
Ngan lum ïa kiba sah na ki briew jong por na ki ri kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ngan wallam pah ïa ki shat la ka jong ka ri . Kin Ïoh bun ki khun bad kin nang roi ha ka jingbun briew .
translation.en: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them , and will bring them again to their folds  ; and they shall be fruitful and increase .

translation.kha: Haba uwei na ki , u la ïohi ba u la ïohkhiah , u la wanlam phai pat , da kaba ïaroh ïa U Blei ha ka sur bajam .
translation.en: And one of them , when he saw that he was healed , turned back , and with a loud voice glorified God ,
So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul : when thou hast found it , then there shall be a reward , and thy expectation shall not be cut off .
translation.kha: phi lah ban sngewskhem ba ka jingstad ka long kaba bha ïa ka mynsiem . To ïoh ïa ka jingstad bad ka lawei jong phi kan long kaba phyrnai .

Adonijah katto katto-katne por , katba u Sennakherib dara ka kynha shipai jongngi u ki ïangat don ha Lakhish , u phah ïa kane ka khubor sha u Hesekaïah bad sha ki paid Judah kaba dang don bad u ha Jerusalem’ :
translation.en: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem , ( but he himself laid siege against Lachish , and all his power with him , ) unto Hezekiah king of Judah , and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem , saying ,

translation.kha: Nangta ïa kane ka pisa la pynkhamti ha ki sa ngut ki ïabah kiba Peit halor ka jingbthei pynbuh ïa ka Tabeel ,
translation.en: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the  Lord  , and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the  Lord  , to repair and amend the house :

translation.kha: Pha thup ïa ka jingjia kaba khraw kaba la jia ha kylleng ka ri Israel , kaba sdang ha Galilaïa hadien ba u Ïoannis u la ïarep ïa ka khubor jong u shaïong ka jingpynbaptis .
translation.en: That word , I say , ye know , which was published throughout all Judaea , and began from Galilee , after the baptism which John preached  ;
And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague : and , behold , if the scall spread not , and there be in it no yellow hair , and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin  ;
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih biang ïa kata ka prum ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , bad lada kam pat pur lane ym don u shñiuh uba lam stem ha ka , bad kam paw ruh ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka ,

translation.en: So the Levites stilled all the people , saying , Hold your peace , for the day is holy  ; neither be ye grieved .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi ki la pynjai jai ïa u paidbah bad ong ha ki ban ym sngewsih ha kum kata ka sngi kaba khuid .
Kumta u la phah ïa kane ka kynjoh ki rangbah ban rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang sawdong ka nongbah shisien . Nangta ki wan phai pat sha ka jaka shong dara bad ki sahmiet hangta .
translation.en: So the ark of the  Lord  compassed the city , going about it once : and they came into the camp , and lodged in the camp .

translation.kha: hangta hajir u Lum Shinab ha ka ri shyiap , U Trai u la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha u Moses ha kata ka sngi ba u la ïong ïa ki paid Israel ban wallam ïa ki jingainguh jong ki .
translation.en: Which the  Lord  commanded Moses in mount Sinai , in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the  Lord  , in the wilderness of Sinai .
And he made darkness pavilions round about him , dark waters , and thick clouds of the skies .
translation.kha: U kah ïa lade da ka jingdum ; ki lyoh barben , kiba dap da ka um , ki ker sawdong ïa u ;

translation.en: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe , that observe and do  ; but do not ye after their works : for they say , and do not .
translation.kha: Kumta phi dei ban kohnguh bad leh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ki ong ïa phi ban leh ; pynban , wat pyrthuh bud ïa ki jingleh jong ki ; namar ba kim leh ïa kaei kaba ki ïalap .

translation.en: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the  Lord   ; but they shall not find him  ; he hath withdrawn himself from them .
translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ki langbrot bad ki jingri jong ki ban ai kum ki jingkñia sha U  Trai  hynrei kane kan ym wanrah jingbha ei ei ïa ki . Kin ym shem ïa u namar u la iehnoh ïa ki .

U Trei un ym map khim ïa uta u briew . Hynrei ka jingbitar Shelah jong u kan meh lep pyrshah ïa u , bad ki jingjynjar baroh ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka kitab kin ngat ha u ïaheh ba U Trai un da pynjot thiaw ïa u .
translation.en: The  Lord  will not spare him , but then the anger of the  Lord  and his jealousy shall smoke against that man , and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him , and the  Lord  shall blot out his name from under heaven .
And they wrote letters by them after this manner  ; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia :
translation.kha: bad ki la phah ïa kane ka shithi harum lyngba jong ki :  Ma ngi , ki apostol bad ki nongsharai balang , ki hynmen ki para jong phi , ngi phah ki jingkhublei ïa ki hynmen ki para jong ngi kiba la kha na ki Jentil kiba shong basah ha Antiokh , ha Syria bad ha Kilikia .
Haba la pynlong janai ïa u , u la jia long ka tyngkreiñ jong ka jingim bymhok na ka boitha kito baroh kiba kohnguh ïa u ,
translation.en: And being made perfect , he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him  ;

translation.kha: U la pdang ban kren shlur ha ka synagog . Haba ka Priskila bad u Akwila ki la sngewkwah ïa u , ki la ïalam ïa u shuh la ïing malu ki la bato ha u kham bniah ïa ka Lynti jong U Blei .
translation.en: And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue : whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard , they took him unto them , and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly .
But I say unto you , That Elias is come already , and they knew him not , but have done unto him whatsoever they listed . Likewise shall also the Son of man suffer of them .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga ong ha phi ba u Elijah u lah da wan bad ki briew kim shym la ithuh ïa u , hynrei ki la leh ïa u katba ki sngewbit . Ha kajuh ka rukom kin lehbeiñ ruh ïa U Khun U Briew .
To shahshkor ïa ka khubor jong U Trai , pa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jehoba , phira ki jait jong ka Israel .
translation.en: Hear ye the word of the  Lord  , O house of Jacob , and all the families of the house of Israel :

translation.kha: Ki Israel kiba hapoh ka nongbah mynnin ki wang thir ban ïasoh lem ha ka thmu . Kumta ki rangbah jong ka Ai ki shem ïa lai ba ki la shah kerkut ha ki Israel , bad ba ki la shah pynïap lut . Ym don uwei ruh uba lehse im , bad ym don utai ruh uba lait na kata lait tang u syiem jong ka Ai .
translation.en: And the other issued out of the city against them  ; so they were in the midst of Israel , some on this side , and some on that side : and they smote them , so that they let none of them remain or escape .
And Hushai said unto Absalom , Nay  ; but whom the  Lord  , and this people , and all the men of Israel , choose , his will I be , and with him will I abide .
translation.kha: U Hushai u jubab ,  Balei ngan leh kumta ? Nga dei ha ka liang jong uta uba la jied da U  Trai  , da kine ki briew , bad da ki Israel baroh . Ngan sah bad phi .

Pynthikna ba yn ym don napdeng jongno phi u shynrang , lane ka kyntiap , lane ka longïing , lap ka khait , ki ban pha noh na U Trai U Blei jong phi ban mane ïa ki blem jong kiwei pateng ki jaitbynriew . Kim uta , un long kum u thied kaba pynmih u seh kiba kthang malu uba don bih .
translation.en: Lest there should be among you man , or woman , or family , or tribe , whose heart turneth away this day from the  Lord  our God , to go and serve the gods of these nations  ; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood  ;

translation.kha: Don ruh ki met kiba kynja banyngkong bad ki met Ibbah kyntu doh ; ka jingtied lad kita ki sien kiba kynja bneng ka ïapher na ka jingitynnat jong kita naba kynja doh .
translation.en: There are also celestial bodies , and bodies terrestrial : but the glory of the celestial is one , and the glory of the terrestrial is another .

translation.kha: Bad kumta U Trai u bitar lep ïa ki Israel bad u la shah ïa ki nonglute ban tun ïaleh bad lute ïa ki . U shah ïa ki nongshun kiba sawdong jong ki ban thombor ïa ki , bad ki Israel kim lah Shu ban ïada ïa lade .
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them , and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about , so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies .

translation.kha: Ka la don ka kper ha said ka jaka ha kaba la pynïap ïa U Jisu , bad ha kata ka kper la anna ka jingtep kaba thymmai ha kaba ym pat shym la tep ïano ïano .
translation.en: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden  ; and in the garden a new sepulchre , wherein was never man yet laid .

translation.kha: U langbrot uba me ïohi uba la don ar tylli ki tan u ïeng na ka bynta ki hima jong ka Media bad Persia .
translation.en: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia .

translation.kha: Mynmiet nga kynmaw ïa me , A Tlai , bad nga pyrkhat shang ka aïu jong me .
translation.en: I have remembered thy name , O  Lord  , in the night , and have kept thy law .
To perform the mercy promised to our fathers , and to remember his holy covenant  ;
translation.kha: U la ong ba un pyn-i jingisynei ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad kynmaw ïa ka jutang bakyntang jong u .

translation.en: I will hiss for them , and gather them  ; for I have redeemed them : and they shall increase as they have increased .
translation.kha: Ngan khot ïa ki briew jong nga bad ngan lumlang ïa ki . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki bad pynlong ïa ki , kiba bun paid kumba ki ju long .

translation.en: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear : but now mine eye seeth thee .
translation.kha: Mynshuwa nga la tip tang ïa kaei kaba kiwei ki la ïathuh ïa nga , da kaba nga ïohsngew pateng na kiwei ; hynrei mynta nga la ïohi ïa me da la ki jong ki khmat .

Ngan leh ïa Kanneh ban da ïa ki Israel na kaba khet noh! ïa nga bad pynjakhlia ïa lade da ki pop jongu ki . Ki dei ban long ki biria Jong nga , malu kun long U Blei jong ki . U TRAI’ Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me , neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions  ; but that they may be my people , and I may be their God , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Katto kattne ki rangbah na Jerikho ki la leit sha u Elisha , bad ki jong , Kumba phi tip , ko kynrad , kane ka dei ka nongbeh kaba itynnat , isynei ka um ka sniew bad ka wanrah ki jingpah khun .
translation.en: And the men of the city said unto Elisha , Behold , I pray thee , the situation of this city is pleasant , as my lord seeth : but the water is naught , and the ground barren .

translation.kha: Ki buh ïa u hajuh ka shiah bad ki la rah ïa u shat u syiem ka Babilonia . Ki la buh ïa u hapoh ki nongpang , ba kumta ïa ka jingkyrhuh jong u yn ym ïohsngew pat halor ki lum jong ka Israel .
translation.en: And they put him in ward in chains , and brought him to the king of Babylon : they brought him into holds , that his voice should no more be heard upon the mountains of Israel .

translation.kha: te phim donkam ban sngewnguh babe lane bynñiaw , ko kynroh , ba phi la pynïap khlem daw lane ba ph la pynkulmar da lade hi . Bad haba U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa phi , ko kynrad , sngewbha wat klet ïa nga .
translation.en: That this shall be no grief unto thee , nor offence of heart unto my lord , either that thou hast shed blood causeless , or that my lord hath avenged himself : but when the  Lord  shall have dealt well with my lord , then remember thine handmaid .

translation.kha: U Joshua bad ki paid Eliel ki la jop ïa ki syiem baroh kiba ha ka ri kaba sha sepngi jong ka Jehoaddin , naduh bakhadduh ha Them Lehab haw u Lum Halak ha ka phang shathie hajan Ehud . U Joshua u pynïabynta ïa kane ka ri hapdeng ki jat Israel bad u ai ïa ka ha ki koum ka jingïohkynti bameh junom .
translation.en: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west , from Baal–gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak , that goeth up to Seir  ; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions  ;

translation.kha: Bud biang ïa u shane haba u wan ban shong ha ka khet jong at . Un long syiem hadien jong nga , namar u dei ma u , uta uba nga la jia ban long u nongsynshar jong ka Israel bad ka Judah .
translation.en: Then ye shall come up after him , that he may come and sit upon my throne  ; for he shall be king in my stead : and I have appointed him to be ruler over Israel and over Judah .

translation.kha: ka Bishlam , ka Aijalon , ka Ithlah ,
translation.en: And Shaalabbin , and Aijalon , and Jethlah ,

And the  Lord  shall scatter thee among all people , from the one end of the earth even unto the other  ; and there thou shalt serve other gods , which neither thou nor thy fathers have known , even wood and stone .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynsakma ïa phi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh , kylleng sawdong ka pyrthei , bad hangta phin shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei kiba da ka dieng bad da u maw , ki blei kiba ma phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi phim pat ju mane mynshuwa .

Ha ka sngi ka khatduh bad kaba khraw tam eh jong ka Jingkhawai Niam , U Jisu u la ïeng kjit bad u la ong ha ka sur ka skum , Uno uno uba syrwiang u dei ban wan sha nga , bad uno uno uba ngeit ha nga u dei ban dih .
translation.en: In the last day , that great day of the feast , Jesus stood and cried , saying ,  If any man thirst , let him come unto me , and drink .

translation.kha: Haba nga pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa nga , ngam sngewlah pyllait shuh , nga kyiuh bad nga kyrngah .
translation.en: Even when I remember I am afraid , and trembling taketh hold on my flesh .
And the mountains shall be molten under him , and the valleys shall be cleft , as wax before the fire , and as the waters that are poured down a steep place .
translation.kha: Te ki lum kin um hapoh jong u kum ka bthing ha ka ding , kin noh sha ki jaka them kum ka um batuid arsut ïa u lumrit .
Nangta u kynruh jong uta u shakri un wan pat ha kawei ka sngi haba u sharak um shym khmied lynti ïa u bad ha ka por kaba um ïatip .
translation.en: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looketh not for him , and in an hour that he is not aware of ,
For I will cast out the nations before thee , and enlarge thy borders : neither shall any man desire thy land , when thou shalt go up to appear before the  Lord  thy God thrice in the year .
translation.kha: Hadien ba nga la beh noh ïa kita ki jaitbynriew na khmat jong phi , bad pynïar ruh ïa ki pud jong phi , yn ym don mano mano u ban pyrshang ban jop ïa ka ri jong phi haba phi rakhe ïa kita ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam .
U saihon mala u barli ki la duh khoit , ñiar u barli u la ih bad u saihon pat u dang shylluit .
translation.en: And the flax and the barley was smitten : for the barley was in the ear , and the flax was bolled .

translation.kha: Haba u wanrah , un sa synshar ïa la ki briew da ka jingkhlaiñ kaba wan na U Trai bad da ka burom jongnga U Trai U Blei hi . Ki briew jrong u kin sheng ha ka jingshngain Naaman ki briew na kylleng ka pyrthiew kin ithuh ïa ka jingkhraw jong u , bad un wanrah ïa ka jingsuk .
translation.en: And he shall stand and feed in the strength of the  Lord  , in the majesty of the name of the  Lord  his God  ; and they shall abide : for now shall he be great unto the ends of the earth .
But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth , and cry mightily unto God : yea , let them turn every one from his evil way , and from the violence that is in their hands .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew bad ki mrad ki dei ban phong ki jaiñ khain . Uwei pa uwei u dei ban duwai jur ha U Blei bad u dei ban iehnoh ïa ka jingleh bymman bad ki kam sniew jong u .

translation.en: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta nga phah ïa ki nonglamktien na ka ri shyiap Kedemoth sha u Sihon u syiem Heshbon ban tyrwa ïa ka jingïasuk , da kaba ong ,

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jezebel heard that Naboth was stoned , and was dead , that Jezebel said to Ahab , Arise , take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite , which he refused to give thee for money : for Naboth is not alive , but dead .
translation.kha: Ka Jesebel mar ïa-ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor , ka ong ïa u Ahab ,  U Naboth u la ïap . To khie leit mynta bad shimti noh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ kaba um shym treh ban die ha phi .

translation.en: And he took him aside from the multitude , and put his fingers into his ears , and he spit , and touched his tongue  ;
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la shim ïa u tang marwei na u paidbah , U la buh ïa la ki shympriah kti ha ki shkor jong uta u briew , U la biah , bad U la ktah ïa u thylliej jong uta u briew .
Ki anna bun jait ki jingai ba kyntu Mynsiem , isynei ujuh U mynhynne u ai ïa ki .
translation.en: Now there are diversities of gifts , but the same Spirit .

translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ba phin nguh ïa ka jingshaniah jong phi ha U Tlai ; kata ka long balei ba nga ïadie ïathuh ïa ki ha phi mynta .
translation.en: That thy trust may be in the  Lord  , I have made known to thee this day , even to thee .

translation.kha: Ki ai ha u ïa ka khlieh bad ïa kiwei pat ki lyngkhot doh , bad u thang ïa ki ha ka Eri .
translation.en: And they presented the burnt offering unto him , with the pieces thereof , and the head : and he burnt them upon the altar .

translation.kha: Khmut la Wad ïa ka samla bhabriew ha kylleng ka ri Israel , bad ki lap ha Shunem ïa kaba kum kata ka kynthei kaba kyrngah ka Abishag , nabar ki la wallam ïa ka sha u syiem .
translation.en: So they sought for a fair damsel throughout all the coasts of Israel , and found Abishag a Shunammite , and brought her to the king .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki Israel ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka duriaw ha ka khynraw kabu rmiang , katba ki um ki ïeng kumno ki kynroh na baroh arliang .
translation.en: But the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea  ; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand , and on their left .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Rehoboam u phah ïa u Adoniram , uba peit ïa ki nongtrei ba shu pynbor , ban leit sha ki Jeruel , hynrei ki lynthem maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap . Mar kumta , u Rehoboam u kiew pynstet ha la ka krat ïapom bad u phet rieh sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram , who was over the tribute  ; and all Israel stoned him with stones , that he died . Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot , to flee to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ynda u Saul u la dat kata ka jingïashad shongshit bad ka jingrisa , u leit kiew sha ka dil ka ha uta u lam .
translation.en: And when he had made an end of prophesying , he came to the high place .

translation.kha: ka jingkren jong ki ka dap da ki jingtim Bakyntang .
translation.en: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness :

Thus saith the  Lord   ; Stand in the court of the  Lord s  house , and speak unto all the cities of Judah , which come to worship in the  Lord s  house , all the words that I command thee to speak unto them  ; diminish not a word :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  To ïeng ha ka ïingbishar jong ka Templ bad to pynbna ïa baroh kaba nga la hukum ïa me ban ong ha ki briew kiba wan na ki shnong jong ka Judah ban mane hangta . Wat ym iehnoh ei ei ruh em .
Phim dei ban ithuh rah ïa la ki jingainguh kat shaba phi ibit ;
translation.en: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest :

translation.kha: khnang ba , ‘ Kin khmih bad ïai ïitkhmih , pynnep kin ym ïohi ; Ki sngap bad ïai sngap , pynban kin ym sngwthuh . Namar lada ki ïohi lane sngewthuh , kin phai sha U Bel , bad un map ïa ki .’
translation.en: That seeing they may see , and not perceive  ; and hearing they may hear , and not understand  ; lest at any time they should be converted , and their sins should be forgiven them .

translation.kha: Ngin la leh ïa ki aiñ jong u barieh ; Ngam shym la lyndet ïa ki hukum jongngi u .
translation.en: For all his judgments were before me : and as for his statutes , I did not depart from them .

translation.kha: U Barsillai u long uba la tymmen bha , u la phraphew snem ka rta . U long uba riewspah bha , bad u la pynbiang jingbam ïa u Syiem mynhynnin u sdang sah ha Mahanaim .
translation.en: Now Barzillai was a very aged man , even fourscore years old : and he had provided the king of sustenance while he lay at Mahanaim  ; for he was a very great man .

How long shall the land mourn , and the herbs of every field wither , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein ? the beasts are consumed , and the birds  ; because they said , He shall not see our last end .
translation.kha: Sa katno ba ka ri jong ngi kan tyrkhong , bad ba u phlang ha kawei pa kawei ka pyntha un ïapstai ? Ki mrad bad ki sim ki ïap namar ka jingbymman jong ki briew jong ngi , ki briew kiba ong , ‘ U Blei um ïohi ïa kaei kaba ngi leh .’

translation.en: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath : for they had sworn with all their heart , and sought him with their whole desire  ; and he was found of them : and the  Lord  gave them rest round about .
translation.kha: Baroh ki paid ka Judah ki la kmen namar ki la pynlong ïa kane ka jutang da ka dohnud baroh . Ki shem sngewbha ha ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  , bad u pdiang ïa ki bad u ai ha ki ka jingsuk na ki liang baroh .

translation.en: And after him repaired the priests , the men of the plain .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki lyngdoh kiba tei pat ïa kiba bun ki bynta kiba bud jong ka kynroh : Ki lyngdoh kiba dei na ka jaka sawdong ka Jerusalem ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud ;
Ka jingieit ka dei ban long kaba sngur . To isih ïa kaei kaba sniew , to batskhem ïa katei kaba bha .
translation.en: Let love be without dissimulation . Abhor that which is evil ; cleave to that which is good .

translation.kha: U hukum , bad ka lyer bah ka sdang ban beh bad pynmih ki jingat phyllung .
translation.en: For he commandeth , and raiseth the stormy wind , which lifteth up the waves thereof .

translation.kha: Haba u la Ïohi ïa ki paidbah , la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong u da ka jingsngewpihuiñ na ka bynta jongnga ki , namar ki la khuslai Bad kim haka ban imat ei ei , kum ki langbrot khlem u nongsharai .
translation.en: But when he saw the multitudes , he was moved with compassion on them , because they fainted , and were scattered abroad , as sheep having no shepherd .

translation.kha: Katto katne kiei kiei kaba me ïohsngew ba me kren ki long kiba sngewlehrain ïa ngi , bad ngi kwah ban tip aïu ki kit jingmut .
translation.en: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears : we would know therefore what these things mean .

translation.kha: U phah ïa ka reng ha shuwa jong u kum ka jingshlei kaba kit lum ïa kiei kiei baroh . Ka sar ïa ki hylla shat ka jingjot bad u pynkut ïa ki jingshem basniew jongno ki .
translation.en: And his breath , as an overflowing stream , shall reach to the midst of the neck , to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity : and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people , causing them to err .
But Peter , standing up with the eleven , lifted up his voice , and said unto them , Ye men of Judaea , and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem , be this known unto you , and hearken to my words :
translation.kha: Nangta u Petros u la ïeng joit lem bad kiwei pat ki khatwei ngut ki apostol bad ha ka sur bajam u la sdang ban kren ha u paidbah :  Ko para Jiw bad phi baroh kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem , to shahshkor ïa nga bad shah ïa nga ban ïathuh ha phi aïu kane ka kit jingmut .

translation.en: Is there no balm in Gilead  ; is there no physician there ? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered ?
translation.kha: Hato ym don dawai ha Gilead ? Hato ym don doktor hangta ? Balei te ba ïa ki briew jong nga ym shym la pynkhiah ?

translation.en: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus  ; and fear fell on them all , and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified .
translation.kha: Baroh ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kiba shong basah ha Ephesos ki la ïohsngew ïa kane ; la pyndap ïa ki baroh da ka jingsheptieng , bad ïa ka kyrteng jong U Trai Jisu la ai ka burom kaba kham khraw .

Kun shym por saw pateng bynriew shuwa ba ki khuid ki ksiew Jong me kyang wan pha pat shane ; Naaman ngan ym pat beh khong ïa ki Amor tad ynda ki la Long bymman haduh katta katta katno khah ba ki dei ban shah pynshitom .
translation.en: But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again : for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full .

And it shall be upon Aaron s forehead , that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things , which the children of Israel shall hallow in all their holy gifts  ; and it shall be always upon his forehead , that they may be accepted before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Aaron u dei ban teh ïa u ha ka shyllangmat jong u , khnang ba ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pdiang ïa ki jingainguh ba ki Israel ki pynkyntang sha nga , wat la ki briew ki bakla haba ki ai ïa ki .

translation.en: Likewise greet the church that is in their house . Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus , who is the firstfruits of Asia unto Christ .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei ruh ïa ka balang kaba ïaseng ha ka ïing jong ki . Ki jingkhublei ïa u paralok ba-ieit jong nga u Epainetos , uba long u rangbah uba nyngkong ha ka probins    jong ka Asia ban ngeit ha U Khrist .

Ngim dei ban long kum u Kain ; u la long jong u Basniew bad u la pynïap ïa u Abel , u prie Jong u . balui u Kain u la pynïap ïa u ? Namar kiei kiei kiba u la leh da lade hi ki la long ki bim dei , hynñiew kiei kiei kiba u para jong u , u la ar ki la longïng Ibbah dei .
translation.en: Not as Cain , who was of that wicked one , and slew his brother . And wherefore slew he him ? Because his own works were evil , and his brother s righteous .

translation.kha: Hato me lah ban kdew lynnong ïa ki khlur na kawei ka aïom sha kawei pud bad me pynïaid ïa ka thup khlur bahkhlieh pynlang barit ?
translation.en: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season ? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons ?

translation.kha: U Joseph u dem kynsan ha ka met u kpa , u da ïam , bad doh ïa u .
translation.en: And Joseph fell upon his father s face , and wept upon him , and kissed him .

translation.kha: Sa shisien la ka pung-um biang bad ka kha sa uwei u khun shynrang . Ka ong , Mynta u tnga jong nga un sa khamtam jin Sha ar , namar nga la kha para ngut ki khup shyieng ïa u ; katkum ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Lebi .
translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and said , Now this time will my husband be joined unto me , because I have born him three sons : therefore was his name called Levi .
This day came ye out in the month Abib .
translation.kha: Phi ïamihnoh na ka ri Ijipt ha kane ka sngi jong u bnai uba nyngkong , u bnai Abib .
Ngam u Paul , nga pynpang ka jingpyndait ïa phi — ïa nga ïa kaba la ainong ba nga long uba ingmane bad jai jai haba to don bad phi , hynrei uba eh haba nga don jngai na phi .
translation.en: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ , who in presence am base among you , but being absent am bold toward you :
If ye know that he is righteous , ye know that every one that doeth righteousness is born of him .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba U Khrist u long uba hok ; phi dei ban tip , namarkata , ba uei uei baroh uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei u long u khun U Blei .
Nga la ainong hapdeng jong phi bad U Trai ha kata ka to ban ïathuh ha phi aïu u ong , namar ba ph sheptieng ïa kata ka ding bad phim shym leit keiñ sha uta u lum . U Trai u la ïai-ong ,
translation.en: ( I stood between the  Lord  and you at that time , to shew you the word of the  Lord  : for ye were afraid by reason of the fire , and went not up into the mount  ; ) saying ,

translation.kha: bad ban pynlah wat ïa ki Jentil ba-bang ïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta ka jingsiew jong u . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Bun kum ngin ïaroh ïa me hapdeng ki Jentil ; ngan rwai ki jingïaroh ïa me .
translation.en: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy ; as it is written , For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles , and sing unto thy name .

translation.kha: ha u lyngkhot uba kñia ïa ka snam bad ïa ka khleiñ jong ka jingainguh ïasyllok .
translation.en: He among the sons of Aaron , that offereth the blood of the peace offerings , and the fat , shall have the right shoulder for his part .

translation.kha: Me maham ïa ki ïa-ban khunlung ïa ki jinghikai jong me , hynrei ha ka jingsarong ki kyntait ïa ki hukum jong me , wat la kaba sorkar ïa ka Hukum ka long ka lynti sha ka jingim . Kiba thup bad kiba ehrang , ki kynjai ïa-ban kthong .
translation.en: And testifiedst against them , that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law : yet they dealt proudly , and hearkened not unto thy commandments , but sinned against thy judgments , ( which if a man do , he shall live in them  ; ) and withdrew the shoulder , and hardened their neck , and would not hear .
And Moses said , Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the  Lord  ? but it shall not prosper .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u ong ,  Te balei phi dang ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  mynta ? Phin ym jop !
Ïathuh ha u Araunah ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba na hukum ïa me , bad un ïakhot ha u Pharaoh ba un shah ïa ki Jesreel ban mihnoh na ka ri jong u .
translation.en: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee : and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh , that he send the children of Israel out of his land .

translation.kha: Hobah Phin ïohi ba la kerkut ïa ka Jerusha da ki kynhun shipai , te phin tip ba shen yn sa pynjot noh ïa ka .
translation.en: And when ye shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies , then know that the desolation thereof is nigh .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei ibha U Trai u la thaw ki don la ki jingkut ; bad ka jingkaw jong u bymman ka long ka jingjot .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath made all things for himself : yea , even the wicked for the day of evil .
And Joshua the son of Nun , and Caleb the son of Jephunneh , which were of them that searched the land , rent their clothes :
translation.kha: Bad u Joshua u khun jong u Nun bad u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh , ar ngut na kita ki nongsyntiat , ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ da ka jingsngewsih ,
Kan ym don ka met salia baroh ki long tang kawei ka dkhot met!
translation.en: And if they were all one member , where were the body ?
And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil  ; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering .
translation.kha: Ryngkat bad uta u khunlangbrot uba nyngkong , ainguh kumba shi kilo u kew ba la tylliat ni bha ba la khleh lang bad shi litar ka umphniang Olib kaba bha . Theh ruh shi litar ka waiñ kum ka jingainguh .
Nalor kata baroh , ïano pat ngan shakor , lada ym dih ïa u khun jong u kynrad jongno nga ? Kumba nga la shakri ïa i pa Jong phi , kumno mynta ngan sharai ïa phi .
translation.en: And again , whom should I serve ? should I not serve in the presence of his son ? as I have served in thy father s presence , so will I be in thy presence .

translation.kha: u ainong ha ki , Ïalam bad phi ïa ki rangbah synshar ka ïingbishar jngai nga ; pynshongdor ïa u Solomon , u khun jong at halor u khashor jong nga , bad synran ïa u shathie sha ka Umpohliew Kynhun ,
translation.en: The king also said unto them , Take with you the servants of your lord , and cause Solomon my son to ride upon mine own mule , and bring him down to Gihon :

translation.kha: Tang khat-ar bnai hadien , kabu u dang ïaid khlur ka tnum jongnga ka ïingsyiem jong u ha Babilon ,
translation.en: At the end of twelve months he walked in the palace of the kingdom of Babylon .
And God said unto him in a dream , Yea , I know that thou didst this in the integrity of thy heart  ; for I also withheld thee from sinning against me : therefore suffered I thee not to touch her .
translation.kha: U Blei u jubab ïa u ha kata ka jingphohsniew ,  Ho-oid , nga tip ba me la leh ïa kane da ka jingïatiplem kaba sngur ; kumta nga la khang ïa me ban leh pop pyrshah ïa nga , bad ngam shym la shah ïa me ban ktah ïa ka .
Hynrei U Terah u la nguh ha nga , ‘ Maham ïa ki ban ym leit tur , nia lang ym long ryngkat bad ki , bad ki nongshun jong ki kin sa jop ïa ki .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Say unto them , Go not up , neither fight  ; for I am not among you  ; lest ye be smitten before your enemies .
The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous , and the transgressor for the upright .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki wallam ha lade ka jingjynjar ïa kaba ki pyrshang ban pynjia ha ki briew kiba bha .
Kajuh ka la khia ha baroh hynñiew ngut — ki la ïap khlem don khun .
translation.en: And the third took her  ; and in like manner the seven also : and they left no children , and died .

translation.kha: Lada nga la rhah ïa la ka kti bad shoh ïa me bad ki briew jong me da ka jingpang , phin jaiñ-jin da la ïap lut khoit .
translation.en: For now I will stretch out my hand , that I may smite thee and thy people with pestilence  ; and thou shalt be cut off from the earth .
As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you , as a father doth his children ,
translation.kha: Kumba phi tip kumno ba ngi ioh jingkyrmen bad jingaimynsiem bad jingsiew ïa baroh na phi , kumba u kpa u leh ïa la ki khun .
U Saul u kylli ïa ka Mahalalel , Areli pha stet shukor ïa nga Kum bad shah ïa u nongshoh-nar jong nga baneh lait phet ? Ka jubab , U byrngem ban pynïap ïa nga lymda nga ïarap ïa u ban lait phet .
translation.en: And Saul said unto Michal , Why hast thou deceived me so , and sent away mine enemy , that he is escaped ? And Michal answered Saul , He said unto me , Let me go  ; why should I kill thee ?

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U Blei u la wan ha u Baaltamar bad u ong , Lada kine ki brisoh ki la wan khot ïa me ba leit bad ki , to khreh ban leit ; hynrei leh tang ïa dat kaba nga ong ha me .
translation.en: And God came unto Balaam at night , and said unto him , If the men come to call thee , rise up , and go with them  ; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee , that shalt thou do .

translation.kha: Kumta u paidbah um shym leh Kanah Kane ka kdew ha ka sngi kaba Hynñiew .
translation.en: So the people rested on the seventh day .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jong ngi , to ïeng skhem bad batskhem ha kito ki jingshisha kiba i la lehkai ïa phi , ha ka jingïalap jong ngi bad ha ka shithi jong ngi .
translation.en: Therefore , brethren , stand fast , and hold the traditions which ye have been taught , whether by word , or our epistle .

translation.kha: Neng ïalam ïa ki ban shah pynïap , koum ki jingkhapnap , ki blang , nabar ki langbrot shajrong . Ma nga , U Trai la la kren .
translation.en: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter , like rams with he goats .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa U Khunlangbrot ba u pynpait noh ïa kawei na ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndait , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa uwei na ki synsar tukri ki jingïathuh ba-im ba u ong ha ka sur kaba sawa kum u pyrthat , To wan !
translation.en: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals , and I heard , as it were the noise of thunder , one of the four beasts saying , Come and see .

translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka miet ba U Trai u ap miet ban ïalang noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt . Ïa kane khiew ka miet la pyniwtung shad U Trai pateng la pateng kum ka miet ha kaba ki Israel ki dei ban ap miet .
translation.en: It is a night to be much observed unto the  Lord  for bringing them out from the land of Egypt : this is that night of the  Lord  to be observed of all the children of Israel in their generations .

translation.kha: Haba u Judah u ïuh ïa ka , u la pyrkhat ba ka dei ka nuti , namar ba ka la kah ïa la ka durkhmat .
translation.en: When Judah saw her , he thought her to be an harlot  ; because she had covered her face .

translation.kha: Sangeh shipor , ko Job , bad shahshkor ; pyrkhat ïa kiew kiei kiba phylla kiba U Blei’ u leh .
translation.en: Hearken unto this , O Job : stand still , and consider the wondrous works of God .
Then Jeremiah went forth out of Jerusalem to go into the land of Benjamin , to separate himself thence in the midst of the people .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la sdang ban mihnoh na Jerusalem bad ban leit sha ka thain Benjamin ban leit shim ïa ka bynta jong nga na ka nongkynti ka longïing .
bad u lyngkdong un ïalaw ïa u shabar ka tare shong dara , pynlang un khmih bha ïa u .
translation.en: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp  ; and the priest shall look , and , behold , if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper  ;
Little children , let no man deceive you : he that doeth righteousness is righteous , even as he is righteous .
translation.kha: To wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ïa phi , ko ki khun jong nga ! Uno uno uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei , u long uba hok , kumba U Khrist u long uba hok .
Khmut te ki dieng ki ong ha u Dieng sohwaiñ , ‘ Ale wan bad long u syiem jong ngi .’
translation.en: Then said the trees unto the vine , Come thou , and reign over us .

translation.kha: U syiem Asa u don ka kynhun shipai kaba lai lakh ngut ki rangbah na Judah , ibha kieng atiar da ki shtah bad ki sum , malade ar lieh phraphew jngut ki rangbah na Benjamin , kiba kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki ryntieh . Baroh na ki , ki lama kiba shlur , ki rangbah ba la pyntbit bha .
translation.en: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears , out of Judah three hundred thousand  ; and out of Benjamin , that bare shields and drew bows , two hundred and fourscore thousand : all these were mighty men of valour .

translation.kha: Ko Joppa , Kim don kyntien ïa phi ; kim don jubab ban ai ha phi! .
translation.en: They were amazed , they answered no more : they left off speaking .
Be ye afraid of the sword : for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword , that ye may know there is a judgment .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , to sheptieng ïa ka waitlam — ka waitlam kaba wanrah ïa ka jingbitar U Blei halor ka pop , khnang ba phin tip ba don uwei uba bishar .
Ka long kaba kham eh ïa u riewspah ban rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei shun ïa ka ut pun leit lyngba ka thliew thyrnia .
translation.en: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle s eye , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud : he scattereth his bright cloud :
translation.kha: Ka leilieh ka thaba na ki lyoh ,

translation.en: And their forty sockets of silver  ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .
translation.kha: lem bad sawphew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei ka jingker .
U biria um dei ban pynïakhlad , te , ïa Kaei kaba U Blei u la pynïasoh lang .
translation.en: What therefore God hath joined together , let not man put asunder .
God brought them out of Egypt  ; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn .
translation.kha: U Blei u la wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt ; U ïaleh na ka bynta jong ki la kum u masi prut .
Phah ïa ka jingkhaïi jong me bad ka jingshisha jong me ; to ai ba kin ïalamwir ïa nga bad wallam pat ïa nga sha Seïon , u lum bathngan jong me , bad sha ka Templ jong me , ha kaba me shong .
translation.en: O send out thy light and thy truth : let them lead me  ; let them bring me unto thy holy hill , and to thy tabernacles .

translation.kha: ngat u syiem u la ai ki hukum ban kem ïa baroh ki rangbah kiba la lah mudui ïa u Daniel , bun la phret ïa ki , lem bad ki tnga jong ki bad ki khun jong ki , shapoh ka thliew kaba dap da ki sing . Ha shuwa ban keiñ poi sha tbian jong ka Thliew , ki sing ki la kynrup ïa ki pynlang pynkyllaiñ ïa ki Shaneng jong ki baïar .
translation.en: And the king commanded , and they brought those men which had accused Daniel , and they cast them into the den of lions , them , their children , and their wives  ; and the lions had the mastery of them , and brake all their bones in pieces or ever they came at the bottom of the den .

translation.kha: Ha ka shang Kaba halor eh , don bun ki jait jingbam ba la dep shet na ka bynta u syiem , dara ki sim ki la wan bam ïa ki .
translation.en: And in the uppermost basket there was of all manner of bakemeats for Pharaoh  ; and the birds did eat them out of the basket upon my head .

translation.kha: Bad ym don uno uno uba kwah ïa ka waiñ bathymmai hain ba u la dih ïa ka waiñ barim . ‘ Kaba rim ka kham bha ,’ u ong .
translation.en: No man also having drunk old wine straightway desireth new : for he saith , The old is better .
Or I only and Barnabas , have not we power to forbear working ?
translation.kha: Lane hato tang u Barnabas bad ma nga mo kiba dei ban trei na ka bynta ban im ?
U angel u la Jobab , U Mynsiem Bakhuid un sa wiang ha pha , Bad ka bor jngai U Blei kan shnong shalor jong phar . Na kane ka dak , ïa i khunlung bakhuid yn khot U Khun U Blei .
translation.en: And the angel answered and said unto her , The Holy Ghost shall come upon thee , and the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee : therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of thee shall be called the Son of God .
How much more , when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed ? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand , and take you away from the earth ?
translation.kha: Katno kaba kham sniew kan long ïa ki riewbymman kiba pynïap ïa u briew uba lui lui uba dang ïohthiah ha la ka jong ka ïing ! Mynta ngan pynhiarkput ïa phi namar ka jingpynïap ïa u bad ngan pyndam ïa phi na sla khyndew !

translation.en: Verily I say unto thee , Thou shalt by no means come out thence , till thou hast paid the uttermost farthing .
translation.kha: Hangta phin shong , nga ong ïa phi , tad haduh ba phin da siew dep ïa ka pisa bakhatduh jong ka jingshahdaiñ kuna .
Namar kaei , ma nga U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , Ngan pynshitom ïa u syiem Nebukhadnessar bad ïa ka ri jongu u , kam nga la pynshitom ïa u pashat ka Assyria .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Behold , I will punish the king of Babylon and his land , as I have punished the king of Assyria .

translation.kha: Ki shiphew Israel kiba kham ha khmat bad ki rangbah Ibbah don ha ka jakarieh ki la ïapynbeit ïa ka dak .
translation.en: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait , that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city .
And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt , to be a reproach and a proverb , a taunt and a curse , in all places whither I shall drive them .
translation.kha: Ngan sa pynngat ha ki ka jinglanot ha kaba ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthei baroh kin da sngewshyrkhei , ki briew kin rkhiebeiñ ïa ki ; kin ïakren kai ïa ki , kin ïakynshi ïa ki , bad kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim kylleng kat shaba nga pynsakma ïa ki .
Kaba kum kata ka jingïohi ka long kum ka prum kaba bam noh ïa ka dohthang . Ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la hikai kum ïa Us kiei kiei ki dei u Hymenaïos badno u Philetos .
translation.en: And their word will eat as doth a canker : of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus ;
Jesus answered and said unto him ,  What I do thou knowest not now  ; but thou shalt know hereafter .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Mem sngewthuh satia mynta ïa kaei kaba nga leh , hynrei men sa sngewthuh hadien .
Hynrei U Trai u la pynim ïa nga bad u la ai ni ïa at , ba nga la lah ban ïalap ïa ka gospel , Bad ba ki Jentil baroh kin ïohsngew ; U Blei u la pyllait ïa por na ka jingïap .
translation.en: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me , and strengthened me ; that by me the preaching might be fully known , and that all the Gentiles might hear : and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion .

translation.kha: Judah , ki hynmen ki para jong me kin ïaroh ïa me ; Me shim na ka ryndang ïa ki nongshun jong me ; Ki hynmen ki para jong me kin naduh kan dem ïa phi .
translation.en: Judah , thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise : thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies  ; thy father s children shall bow down before thee .

translation.kha: Ki khunlung shynrang jrong u Kanaan — u Sidon , u khun nyngkong jong u , bad u Heth — kiba longïing ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ joit na ki .
translation.en: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn , and Heth ,

translation.kha: u Jubab Bad u para jong u , u Ijon , ki ïakhun jong u Sebedi ( U Jisu u la ai kyrteng ïa ki , Boanerjes , kiba ñiut ki Khun u pyrthei ) ;
translation.en: And James the son of Zebedee , and John the brother of James  ; and he surnamed them Boanerges , which is , The sons of thunder :

translation.kha: U Trai u sngewbha hato ki briew kiba bha ki duwai , hynrei u isih ïa ki jingïania kiba ki bymdonkam ki wallam ha u .
translation.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the  Lord  : but the prayer of the upright is his delight .

translation.kha: Hadien kata , ki Israel ki ainong ha u Gideon , To long u nongsynshar jong ngi — ma me sad ki Kynhun ki ksiew hadien jong me . Me la pyllait im ïa sem na ki Midian .
translation.en: Then the men of Israel said unto Gideon , Rule thou over us , both thou , and thy son , and thy son s son also : for thou hast delivered us from the hand of Midian .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kba u Solomon u la leh , ka jingtrei jong u bun ka jingstad jong u , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori U Solomon .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Solomon , and all that he did , and his wisdom , are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon ?

translation.kha: Nga tip ïa ki jingkit bakwah kiba U Blei u la buh halor jong ngi .
translation.en: I have seen the travail , which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it .

translation.kha: Phi la ïohi shiah ba ïa ka nar la khleh bad ka dewbyrtha . Ken ka mut ba ki nongsynshar jongnga kata ka hima kin pyrshang baneh pynïatylli ïa ki longïing jong ki da ka jingïashongkha khlieh , hynrei kin ym lah , kumba ka nar kam lah ban ïakhleh bad ka dewlynnong .
translation.en: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay , they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men : but they shall not cleave one to another , even as iron is not mixed with clay .

translation.kha: phiah sa lalot kum ki mraw ba la thang ba-bang pynlong mynshuwa , khem ki shiah ba la thang haduh ba ki la kylla dpei .
translation.en: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime : as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire .
That in those days , when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom , which was in Shushan the palace ,
translation.kha: Na ka khet syiem ha ka nongbah Susa jong ka Persia , u syiem Serksis u synshar halor ki shispah arphew hynñiew tylli ki jylla , naduh India haduh Sudan .

translation.en: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt , which thou wast afraid of  ; and they shall cleave unto thee .
translation.kha: Un pynngat ha phi sa shisien ïa ki jingpang kiba sngewshyrkhei , kiba phi la mad ha Ijipt , bad phin ym ïohkhiah .

translation.en: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son , and to all his servants , that they should kill David .
translation.kha: U Saul u ïathuh ha u Jonathan u khun jong u bad ha ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh ba u thmu ban pynïap ïa u Dabid . Hynrei u Jonathan u sngew jan eh ïa u Dabid ,
Ha ki kynduh jong ka ki sngewthuh ba ka lad thab pait jong ki ka la duh noh , ki la kem ïa u Paulos bad u Silas bad ki la tan ïa ki shad ki tam synshar ha ka jaka ïew .
translation.en: And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone , they caught Paul and Silas , and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers ,

translation.kha: hynrei um shym la khot ïa u Solomon , u para jong u na ujuh u kpa lane ïa u Nathan u nongïathuhlypa , lane ïa u Benaïah , lane ïa ki nongïada jong u syiem .
translation.en: But Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah , and the mighty men , and Solomon his brother , he called not .

translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , khnai mynta ka longsyiem ka shithi kaba ar ba nga thoh Sha phoi . Ha baroh ar tylli ki shithi nga la pyrshang ba-bang pynkheiñ ïa ki jingpyrkhat bakhuid ha ki jingmut jong phi da kaba pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa kino kiei kiei .
translation.en: This second epistle , beloved , I now write unto you  ; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance :

translation.kha: Un pynriewspah ïa phiah borabor kat banbeiñ biang ngab lehsbun ha ki por baroh , Haneng kiba bun kin ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bna ki jingai jong phi ïa kiba ki la ïohpdiang na moi .
translation.en: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness , which causeth through us thanksgiving to God .

translation.kha: Na ka bynta ki mar jong pha ki nongkhaïi ka Shebna pynlang Raamah ki ai kylliang da ki mawkordor , ka ksiar , bad ki musli mawshun bakynsai tam .
translation.en: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah , they were thy merchants : they occupied in thy fairs with chief of all spices , and with all precious stones , and gold .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la kem ïa uta u khun bad ki la pynïap ïa u bad thret ïa ka met jong u shabar ka bri sohwaiñ .
translation.en: And they took him , and killed him , and cast him out of the vineyard .

translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la pynbaptis da ka um , hynrei ha ki khyndiat sngi yn sa pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: For John truly baptized with water  ; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence .

translation.kha: kane ka jingieit kaba nga kriah ka mut ba ngin ïada ha ka jingkohnguh ïa ki hukum jyllang U Bela . Ka hukum , kumba phi baroh phi la ïohsngew Naduh mynnyngkong , ka long ba baroh phi dei banbeiñ ïa-ïaid ha ka jingieit .
translation.en: And this is love , that we walk after his commandments . This is the commandment , That , as ye have heard from the beginning , ye should walk in it .

translation.kha: Ai ba U Trai un ïalam ïa phi sha ka jingpynshong ba kham khraw jong ka jingieit U Blei bad sha ka jingïaishah kabu la ai da U Khrist .
translation.en: And the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God , and into the patient waiting for Christ .

translation.kha: U Moses u pynïap ïa u , bad u theh ïa ka sner ha baroh Sidon jong ka duwan .
translation.en: And he killed it  ; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about .

translation.kha: Don kiba la Ong , U dei ma u , hynriew kiwei ki la ong , Em , um dei ma u , u shu ïasyriem ïa u . Kumta uta u briew’ hi u la ong , Dei ma nga uta u brisoh !
translation.en: Some said , This is he : others said , He is like him : but he said , I am he .

The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan , and his father was a man of Tyre , skilful to work in gold , and in silver , in brass , in iron , in stone , and in timber , in purple , in blue , and in fine linen , and in crimson  ; also to grave any manner of graving , and to find out every device which shall be put to him , with thy cunning men , and with the cunning men of my lord David thy father .
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka dkhot na ka jait Dan , bad u kpa jong u , u dei u traishnong jong ka Tyros . U tip kumno ban thaw ïa kiei kiei na ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , u maw bad ka dieng . U lah ruh ban trei bad ki jaiñ kiba jngum , sawbthuh , bad kiba rong saw , bad ka linen . U lah ban trei ïa bun jait ki jingohdur bad u lah ban bud ïa kano kano ka jingsaiñ dur kumba la ai jingmut ïa u . Shah ïa u ban trei bad ki nongtrei jong phi kiba tbit bad kito kiba la trei na ka bynta u syiem Dabid , u kpa jong phi .

translation.en: And Isaac loved Esau , because he did eat of his venison : but Rebekah loved Jacob .
translation.kha: U Isaak u kham jied ïa u Iso , namar u bang bha ban bam ïa ki mrad kiba u Iso u pynïap , hynrei ka Rebekka ka kham jied ïa u Jakob .
Ym don shuh ka jingrkhie bakhain ha ka por ba dih waiñ ; ym don basngewtynnat shuh ïa ka jingmad jong ka .
translation.en: They shall not drink wine with a song  ; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it .
For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections : for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature :
translation.kha: Namar ba ki leh ïa kane , U Blei u la ai noh ïa ki sha ki jingkwah brai bakhlemrain . Wat ki kynthei ki la pynbakla noh ïa ka jingpyndonkam kaba dei kat kum ka rukom ha ka jingshongkurim da ki jingleh ki bym dei kat kum ka rukom .
Ko paid Israel lad nga , phi la shah shoh kumba shoh kew , hynrei mynta nga la pynbna ha phi ïa ka nongrah-khubor babha ba nga la ïohsngew na U Trai Badonbor Ïaroh , U Blei jrong ki Israel .
translation.en: O my threshing , and the corn of my floor : that which I have heard of the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , have I declared unto you .

translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u sien shalor u Lum ki Olib da kaba ïam ; u ïaid da ka khet suda badno u tap ïa la ka khlieh kum ka dak ka jingsngewsih . Baroh uba bud ïa u ki la tap ïa la ki khlieh pynlang ki la ïam ruh .
translation.en: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet , and wept as he went up , and had his head covered , and he went barefoot : and all the people that was with him covered every man his head , and they went up , weeping as they went up .
I have pursued mine enemies , and destroyed them  ; and turned not again until I had consumed them .
translation.kha: Nga beh kthong ïa ki nongshun jong nga , bad nga jop ïa ki ; ngam shym sangeh tad haduh ba ngan da pynjot ïa ki .
Ngi tip ba ngi long ki jong U Blei , wat la ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka to hapoh ka jingsuhsieng jong u Basniew .
translation.en: And we know that we are of God , and the whole world lieth in wickedness .
Wherefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will do judgment upon her graven images : and through all her land the wounded shall groan .
translation.kha: Te nangta , nga ong ba ka por ka poi ba ngan leh ei ei ïa ki bleithaw jong ka Babilon , bad kiba mynsaw kin ud ha ka ri baroh kawei .
Ngin la thoh laiphew tylli ki jingkren na ka bynta jong phi . Ki kynthup ïa ka jingtip bad ka jingkyntu babha ,
translation.en: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge ,
For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God , it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe .
translation.kha: Naba U Blei ha ka jingstad jong u , um shym la pynlah ïa ki briew ban ithuh ïa u da ka jingstad jong ki hi . Pynban da kata kaba la khot ka khubor  ba-ibieit  kaba ngi ïalap , U Blei u la ibit ban pynim ïa kito kiba ngeit ïa ka .

translation.en: And his father Isaac said unto him , Come near now , and kiss me , my son .
translation.kha: Nangta u kpa jong u , u ong ha u ,  Ale kham hajan ko khun bad to doh ïa nga .
Nangta at la ïohi ïa u ruh uba ïeng ha ka sngi . U la pyrsad da ka sur kaba jam ïa ki sim baher kiba her ha shngain suiñ : Ale bad ïalumlang na ka bynta ka jingkhawai kaweh khraw jong U Blei !
translation.en: And I saw an angel standing in the sun  ; and he cried with a loud voice , saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven , Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great God  ;

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïajubab , Kata te kaba da phylla ! Phim tip nala u wiang , hynrei u la pynkoit ïa la na ka jingmatlah jong nga !
translation.en: The man answered and said unto them , Why herein is a marvellous thing , that ye know not from whence he is , and yet he hath opened mine eyes .

translation.kha: Ïa tur u khun la kha ha ka por ba U Blei u la buh ba yn sa kha ïa u .
translation.en: For Sarah conceived , and bare Abraham a son in his old age , at the set time of which God had spoken to him .
And Ephraim said , Yet I am become rich , I have found me out substance : in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin .
translation.kha: ‘ Ngi long kiba riewspah’ ki ong . ‘ Ngi lah lum kyrhai ka spah . Bad ym don uwei ruh ban mudui ïa ngi ba ngi ïoh spah da ka lynti bymhok .’

Ka jingthmu jngai U Blei ka long ban pyntip ïa ka jingmaïan jong u ha ki biria jong u , ïa kane ka jingïaineh basngewtynnat bad badonburom kaba u don na ka bynta ki briew baroh’ . Bad ka jingmaïan ka long , ba U Khrist u don hapoh jong phi , kaba mut , ba phin ïoh bynta ha ka burom jong U Blei’ .
translation.en: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles ; which is Christ in you , the hope of glory :
And the young man deferred not to do the thing , because he had delight in Jacob s daughter : and he was more honourable than all the house of his father .
translation.kha: bad uta u samla ruh um shym la pynslem ban leh ïa kata kaba la ai jingmut , namar ba u la ibha eh ïa ka khun jong u Jakob . U long ruh uba donburom tam na ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u baroh .
U syiem u kaweh ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingshisha dara u sngewbha ïa iar kiba kruiñ ïa ka .
translation.en: Righteous lips are the delight of kings  ; and they love him that speaketh right .

translation.kha: Ngi dap da ka jingshlur bad moi kham kwah ban iehnoh ïa kane ka ïing jngai ngi ha ka met bad ban ïew long ha ka ïing malu U Troas .
translation.en: We are confident , I say , and willing rather to be absent from the body , and to be present with the Lord .
Again he said , Therefore hear the word of the  Lord   ; I saw the  Lord  sitting upon his throne , and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left .
translation.kha: U Mikaïah u ong shuh :  Mynta sngap ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ! Nga ïohi ïa U  Trai  ba u shong halor ka khet jong u ha bneng , ryngkat bad baroh ki angel jong u kiba ïeng harud jong u .

Kumta kita shi para ki ïashong ha khmat jong u , ha ka mian marpyrshah ïa u Joseph kat kum ka rta jong ki nguid uba nyngkong haduh uba khatduh . Haba ki ïohi kumno ki ïashongsuk bam , ki Shua ïa-pasiaw lyngngoh Para ma ki .
translation.en: And they sat before him , the firstborn according to his birthright , and the youngest according to his youth : and the men marvelled one at another .
Thou shalt fear the  Lord  thy God  ; him shalt thou serve , and to him shalt thou cleave , and swear by his name .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi bad mane ruh tang ïa u . Ïaineh ha u bad kular skhem tang ha ka kyrteng jong u .
To sngew ïa Kane , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh ; to sngap ïa kane , ko phi kiba im ha ka pyrthei ! U Trai Nongsynshar un shuki pyrshah ïa phi . To shahshkor ! U kren na ka templ ba kyntoit bneng .
translation.en: Hear , all ye people  ; hearken , O earth , and all that therein is : and let the Lord  God  be witness against you , the Lord from his holy temple .

translation.kha: A katto nga kyrmen ba ngan longsyiem wahbah ïanguh ha kiba sumar ïa ki jingbthah jong me !
translation.en: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes !
By thy great wisdom and by thy traffick hast thou increased thy riches , and thine heart is lifted up because of thy riches :
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ka jingkhaïi bastad bad me ïai pynïohnong . Katno uba sarong me long ïa ka spah jong me !

translation.en: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom , and the  Lord  his God was with him , and magnified him exceedingly .
translation.kha: U Solomon u khun jong u syiem Dabid u la pynskhem ïa ka jingsynshar ïa ka hima Israel , bad U  Trai  U Blei jong u , u la kyrkhu ïa u bad pynlong ïa u uba khlaiñbor shikatdei eh .
Lada u briew u shoh na ka pyllew khmat ïa la u mraw , shajrong ne kynthei , bad kata ka khmat ka sep-ei noh , u dei baneh pyllaitluid ïa uta u miaw kum ka jingsiew namarba kata ka khmat .
translation.en: And if a man smite the eye of his servant , or the eye of his maid , that it perish  ; he shall let him go free for his eye s sake .

translation.kha: Haduh katno ki thapniang jong ka Ostrit ki kaweh stet ! Hynrei ym don kano Kano ka Ostrit kaba lah ban her khim ka thring .
translation.en: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks ? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich ?

translation.kha: Hynrei ki nongïalam jong ki Philistia ki bitar ïa u Ahishar , malu ki ong ha u , Phah un leit noh sha ka jaka kaba phi la ai ïa u . Wat shahïap ba un leit bad ngi shat ka thma , oh u phai pyrshah ïa ngi katba ngi dang ïaleh . Naba na-ei un ïoh ka lad kaba kham bha shun pynsngewbha baïong ïa la u kynrad ? Hato ym dien da ka jingïap ki briew jong ngi ?
translation.en: And the princes of the Philistines were wroth with him  ; and the princes of the Philistines said unto him , Make this fellow return , that he may go again to his place which thou hast appointed him , and let him not go down with us to battle , lest in the battle he be an adversary to us : for wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his master ? should it not be with the heads of these men ?

translation.kha: La buh ïa me hapoh ka jingtim bad men ym lah shuh ban rep ha ka khyndew . Ka la kjit noh ïa ka slem u para jrong me , i kumba ka la ang ïa la ka shyntur ban pdiang ïa kata mynba me la pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And now art thou cursed from the earth , which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother s blood from thy hand  ;

translation.en: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers , wherewith they that were burnt had offered  ; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar :
And in those days shall men seek death , and shall not find it  ; and shall desire to die , and death shall flee from them .
translation.kha: Ha kine ki san bnai kin wad ïa ka jingïap , hynrei kin ym shem ïa ka ; kin kwah ban ïap noh , hynrei ka jingïap kan phet na ki .

translation.en: And every one had four faces , and every one had four wings .
translation.kha: hynrei uwei uwei na ki u don saw tylli ki durkhmat bad saw tylli ki thapniang .
bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah shiphew snem .
translation.en: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years : and he died .

translation.kha: Uno eit u briew uba pyllait noh! ïa ka tnat jong u bad shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew u klim ; bad u briew uba shongkurim ïa ka briew kaba la sha pyllew tnga u klim .
translation.en: Whosoever putteth away his wife , and marrieth another , committeth adultery : and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery .

translation.kha: Ki la waiñ ïathuh ha u ruh : Ngi la leit shwa kylleng ka pyrthei bad ngi la shem ba ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ne hapdeng ka jingbymlah ban leh ei ei sad ha ka jingshah pynjam .
translation.en: And they answered the angel of the  Lord  that stood among the myrtle trees , and said , We have walked to and fro through the earth , and , behold , all the earth sitteth still , and is at rest .

translation.kha: Ki wanlam ban pynshlur ïa ngi .
translation.en: They come to encourage us .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah ap phira jongnga u Saul ha Gibeah ha ri Benjamin ki ïohi ïa ki Pamphylia ba ki phet ha ka jingkulmar .
translation.en: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked  ; and , behold , the multitude melted away , and they went on beating down one another .

translation.kha: Kumta khot ïa ki la Israel Ki brai jong U Blei bad ibha ieit da U Troas .
translation.en: Say ye unto your brethren , Ammi  ; and to your sisters , Ru–hamah .

translation.kha: Da khmih bha , te , ba uno uno un ym teh mraw ïa phi da ki buit shukor bymmyntoi jngai ka jingstad ba kynja briew , kaba wan na ki jinghikai ba la ai pateng da ki briew bad na ki mynsiem kiba synshar ïa ka jingpyntieng , bad ym na U Khrismas .
translation.en: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit , after the tradition of men , after the rudiments of the world , and not after Christ .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por u san bad u long suba kah tam na ki jingthung baroh . U pynmih ki tnat kiba heh haw ba ki sim ki woh bun thaw skum ha ka jingtap syrngiew jong u .
translation.en: But when it is sown , it groweth up , and becometh greater than all herbs , and shooteth out great branches  ; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it .
Hearken unto me , ye that know righteousness , the people in whose heart is my law  ; fear ye not the reproach of men , neither be ye afraid of their revilings .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi kiba tip ïa kaei kaba dei , kiba don ka jinghikai jong nga kaba neh ha la ki dohnud . Wat sheptieng haba ki briew ki pynsalia bad krenbeiñ ïa phi ;

Ban long u paralok jong U Blei , phi den ban kop bha shaphang ka jingshisha jngai ka Baibl ( 1 tikmie 2 :3 , 4 ) , ngeit ïa kiei kiei kiba phi la tip ( Hebru 11 :6 ) , kylla ka bamut na ki pop jong phi ( Kam 17 :30 , 31 ) , bad pynkylla noh ïa la ka rukom im .
translation.en: To become a friend of God , you must obtain a good knowledge of Bible truth ( 1 Timothy 2 :3 , 4 ) , put faith in the things you have learned ( Hebrews 11 :6 ) , repent of your sins ( Acts 17 :30 , 31 ) , and turn around in your course of life .

translation.kha: U Terah u shim ïa u Abram u khun jongki u , ïa u lat u ksiew jong u , umbiah long u khun jongki u Haman , bad ïa ka pyrsa kurim jong u ka Sarai , ka tnga jong u Abram , nabar ki ïamih lang noh na ka shnong Ur kaba ha ka ri Babilonia ïa-ban leit sha ka ri Kanaan . Ki la leit haduh ha Horon bad ki la ïashong ïasah noh hangta .
translation.en: And Terah took Abram his son , and Lot the son of Haran his son s son , and Sarai his daughter in law , his son Abram s wife  ; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldeans , to go into the land of Canaan  ; and they came unto Haran , and dwelt there .
Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul , and besought him ,
translation.kha: ha kaba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki la wallam ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u Paul .

translation.en: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle , twenty boards on the south side southward .
translation.kha: Thaw arphew tylli ki jingker ïa ka liang kaba shaphang shathie ,
Ha Kawei pah ka jingïohipaw nga la ïohi ïa u bhabriew Uba don u ksan thew ha ka kti jong u .
translation.en: I lifted up mine eyes again , and looked , and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand .
Then the king answered and said , Give her the living child , and in no wise slay it : she is the mother thereof .
translation.kha: Nangta u Solomon u ong ,  Wat pynïap ïa u khunlung ! Ai ïa u ha ka kynthei kaba nyngkong — ka dei ka kmie bashisha jong u .

translation.en: Howl , ye inhabitants of Maktesh , for all the merchant people are cut down  ; all they that bear silver are cut off .
translation.kha: To ïam bad to kyang haba phi ïohsngew ïa kane . Phi kiba shong basah ha ki bynta ba ha trai jong ka nongbah , namar baroh ki nongkhaïi kin ïap !

translation.en: For their calamity shall rise suddenly  ; and who knoweth the ruin of them both ?
translation.kha: kum kita ki briew kin shah pynjot ha ka shikhyllipmat . Hato phi sngewthuh ba ka jingjot kaba kumno kan lah ban jia na U Blei ne na u syiem ?

translation.en: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom , and stretch her wings toward the south ?
translation.kha: Hato u kbeit u nang na me kumno ban her , haba u pyiar la ki thapniang shaphang shathie ?
Ki shiphew lwet ki theisotti ki la khie joit bad ki la pynkhih ïa la ki sharak .
translation.en: Then all those virgins arose , and trimmed their lamps .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka jingaiei kaba U Blei u ai ka long kaba kham khlaiñ shiah shuh . Kumba ka Jingot Bakhuid ka ong , U Blei u pyrshah ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u ai ïa ka jingaiei ha kaba sngewrit .
translation.en: But he giveth more grace . Wherefore he saith , God resisteth the proud , but giveth grace unto the humble .

translation.kha: “Phi tip ba namar ki thma ba ïai khie , u Dabid , u kpa jong nga u la dei pun ïaleh pyrsa ïa ki ri jong ki nongshun kiba sarong jrong u , um skhem la lah ba tei ka templ na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa U Trai U Blei jong u tad haduh ba u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jyllang u baroh .
translation.en: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the  Lord  his God for the wars which were about him on every side , until the  Lord  put them under the soles of his feet .

translation.kha: Bad lada me kohnguh ïa nga bad sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jongnga nga , kumba u Dabid u kpa jong me u la leh , ngan ai ha me ka jingjam kaban jlan .
translation.en: And if thou wilt walk in my ways , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as thy father David did walk , then I will lengthen thy days .

And when they forgat the  Lord  their God , he sold them into the hand of Sisera , captain of the host of Hazor , and into the hand of the Philistines , and into the hand of the king of Moab , and they fought against them .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew ki la klet noh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki , bad kumta u la shah ïa ki Philistia bad ïa u syiem Moab bad ïa u Sisera , u rangbah ka kynhun shipai ka nongbah Hasor , ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi bad ban jop ïa ki .

Naba U Khrist u la ïatip na ka pyntwa ki pop tang shisien pynlang na ka bynta ki por baroh , u briew uba bha na ka bynta ki nongpop , ba un ïoh ïalam ïa phi Sha U Blei . La pynïap ïa u ha ka doh , hynrei la pyntam pat ïa u ha ka mynsiem ,
translation.en: For Christ also hath once suffered for sins , the just for the unjust , that he might bring us to God , being put to death in the flesh , but quickened by the Spirit :
The tabernacle of the congregation , and the ark of the testimony , and the mercy seat that is thereupon , and all the furniture of the tabernacle ,
translation.kha: ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga , ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang bad ïa ka jingtap jong ka , ïa ki jingpynriam baroh jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,

translation.en: He delivered me from my strong enemy , and from them that hated me : for they were too strong for me .
translation.kha: U la pyllait im ïa nga na ki nongshun bakhlaiñbor jong nga bad na kito baroh kiba shun ïa nga — Ki long kiba khlaiñbor eh ban ïa nga .
Mynta , lumlang ïa kiba sah jngai ki shipai jong ph , tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , pynlang knieh ïa ka da lade hi . Ngam kwah ban ïoh ka burom ïa ka jingïohknieh ïa ka .
translation.en: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together , and encamp against the city , and take it : lest I take the city , and it be called after my name .

translation.kha: U la ïohthiah biang bad u phohsniew sa kawei pud ka jingphohsniew . Hynñiew tylli ki kop kew uba met bad ba ih , ba ki sanphew ha uwei u jyntang .
translation.en: And he slept and dreamed the second time : and , behold , seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk , rank and good .
