translation.kha: ianga la iap shitom sngur u Elijah u la sdang pun kren biria ïa ki : Duwai kham jam ! U dei u blei ! Leh u dang phohsniew lane u dang leit shabar lane lehse u dang loit jingleit ! Lane lieh u dang ïohthiah , phin hap ban kyrsiew ïa u !
translation.en: And it came to pass at noon , that Elijah mocked them , and said , Cry aloud : for he is a god  ; either he is talking , or he is pursuing , or he is in a journey , or peradventure he sleepeth , and must be awaked .

translation.kha: Ki la shim la ka bainong bad ki la khñium pynshisha ïa u nongaikam .
translation.en: And when they had received it , they murmured against the goodman of the house ,

translation.kha: Ïa ka bor bad ka jingkhraw Jong baroh ki ha-sem ha ka pyrthei yn ai ha ki briew jong U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh . Ka bor ba kynja syiem jong ki kane ym kut shuh bad ki nongshong baroh ha ka pyrthei kin shakor bad kohnguh ïa ki .
translation.en: And the kingdom and dominion , and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven , shall be given to the people of the saints of the most High , whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom , and all dominions shall serve and obey him .

translation.kha: Ki khyrdop ka nongbah kin ïambriew pynlang kin Kieng , bad ka nongbah hi kan long kum ka kynthei kaba shang ha madan kaba la shah sloit lyngkhuit .
translation.en: And her gates shall lament and mourn  ; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground .

translation.kha: Me dih ban hikai ïa ki paid Israel ïa ki aiñ barben kiba nga la ai ha me lyngba u Moses .
translation.en: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the  Lord  hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses .
If the whole body were an eye , where were the hearing ? If the whole were hearing , where were the smelling ?
translation.kha: Lada ka met baroh kawei ka long tang ka khmat , da kumno yn ïohsngew ? Bad lada ka long tang ka shkor , da kumno yn iw ?

Na ka bynta jong u , nga la bret noh ïa kiei kiei baroh’ ; sa ñiew ïa ka baroh tang Kum ka synrum , khnang ba ngan ïoh ïa U Khrist , bad ba yn pynïasoh pura bad u . Ngam long haw uba don ka hok ka jong nga hi , ka bynta kaba la ïoh da kaba ïanguh ïa ka lawlynnong . Nga mynta , nga ïoh ïa ka dkhoh kob la ai da ka jingneh ha U Khrist , ka hok kabu wan na U Balei bad kaba pynshong nongïam ha ka jingngeit .
translation.en: And be found in him , not having mine own righteousness , which is of the law , but that which is through the faith of Christ , the righteousness which is of God by faith :

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la pynshahshkor ïa u Paul haw ba un da dep krensih ; hynrei pynban ki la sdang ban kyang ngim eh , Pynduh ïa u ! Pynïap ïa u ! Um long uba bit ban im !
translation.en: And they gave him audience unto this word , and then lifted up their voices , and said , Away with such a fellow from the earth : for it is not fit that he should live .

translation.kha: Ïa ki briew kiba bha yn ïai kynmaw kum ka jingkyrkhu ; hynrei ïa ki riewbymman yn klet noh .
translation.en: The memory of the just is blessed : but the name of the wicked shall rot .

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la pynlut katto katne por hangta , u la mihnoh bad u la ithuh lyngba ka thain jong ka Galatia bad Phrygia , da kambah pynkhlaiñ ïa ki parabangeit baroh .
translation.en: And after he had spent some time there , he departed , and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order , strengthening all the disciples .

And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Behold , thy days approach that thou must die : call Joshua , and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation , that I may give him a charge . And Moses and Joshua went , and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Me te , men ym im slem shuh . Khot ïa u Joshua bad wan ïalam ïa u sha ka Ïingjaiñ khnang ba ngan ai hukum ïa u .
Un ïaisah u bymkhuid katba kata ka jingpang ka ïan don , bad u dei ban Hukum kyrpang shabar ka tare shong dara , jngai na kiwei pat .
translation.en: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled  ; he is unclean : he shall dwell alone  ; without the camp shall his habitation be .

translation.kha: Katba moi dang pynper ïa ki lyngkha da ki masi lur , u la ong , bad ki kada ki dang ïabam phalang marjan .
translation.en: And there came a messenger unto Job , and said , The oxen were plowing , and the asses feeding beside them :

translation.kha: U Trai u long kumin ka kut baskhem , sha kaba kiba khah ki lah ban leit pynlang sngewshngain .
translation.en: The name of the  Lord  is a strong tower : the righteous runneth into it , and is safe .

translation.kha: U Trei un kyrkhu ïa u kew jong phi , bad ïa ka jingbam ba phi khreh da u .
translation.en: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store .
The shepherds with their flocks shall come unto her  ; they shall pitch their tents against her round about  ; they shall feed every one in his place .
translation.kha: ki syiem kin sher dara hangta lem bad ki kynhun shipai jong ki . Kin pynïeng ïa la ki ïingjaiñ sawdong ka nongbah , bad uwei uwei un sher dara hangno hangno ba u kwah .

translation.en: Then Jesus said unto them ,  My time is not yet come : but your time is alway ready .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Ka por kaba biang na ka bynta jong nga kam pat poi . Kano kano ka por na ka bynta ïa phi ka biang .
Kat kum ki jingbthah kiba khatduh jong u Dabid , ïa baroh ki Lebi la buh jingthoh ba ken shakri hir ki la dap arphew snem ka rta ,
translation.en: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above :

translation.kha: Kaei ka kyrteng jngai me ? utai u briew u kylli . U Jakob , u jubab .
translation.en: And he said unto him , What is thy name ? And he said , Jacob .

translation.kha: Wallam ka jingainguh sha U Trai . Kat umbiah kwah ban leh ïa sier un wanrah ïa kata ka jingainguh da ka ksiar , ka shoh , sad ka ïohnong ;
translation.en: Take ye from among you an offering unto the  Lord  : whosoever is of a willing heart , let him bring it , an offering of the  Lord   ; gold , and silver , and brass ,

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba phi dei ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh kiba u la ai ha phi .
translation.en: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the  Lord  your God , and his testimonies , and his statutes , which he hath commanded thee .
Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel :
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa U Jisu Khrist , uba la mihpat na ka jingïap , uba la hiarpateng na u Dabid , kumba la hikai ha ka Khubor Babha kaba nga ïalap .
U Arnon u ong ha ki , Law noh ïa ki sohshkor ksiar ba ki tnga jong phi , ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi ki deng , bad wallam ïa ki sha nga .
translation.en: And Aaron said unto them , Break off the golden earrings , which are in the ears of your wives , of your sons , and of your daughters , and bring them unto me .
So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , and went and returned , and dwelt at Nineveh .
translation.kha: Nangta u Sennakherib , u patsha ka Assyria u kylla dien bad phai noh sha Ninebeh .
To ai ha im’ men ka sngi ïa ka jingbam kaba me donkam .
translation.en: Give us day by day our daily bread .
Which when Jesus perceived , he said unto them ,  O ye of little faith , why reason ye among yourselves , because ye have brought no bread ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki la ïakren , kumta u la kylli ïa ki ,  Balei ba phi ïakren para ma phi shaphang ka jingbymdon jingbam ei ei ? Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !

ban wallam ïa ka jingbishar ha baher , ban pynrem ïa ki baroh na ka bynta ki ki bymriewblei ba ki la leh bad na ka bynta ki ktien ba sngewtriem Ibbah ki nongpop ba khlem blei ki la kren pyrshah ïa u !
translation.en: To execute judgment upon all , and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed , and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him .
The copy of the letter that Tatnai , governor on this side the river , and Shethar–bozenai , and his companions the Apharsachites , which were on this side the river , sent unto Darius the king :
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka jingïathuh ba ki la phah sha u patsha :
u Adoniram u peit ïa kiba shah pyntrei jur ; u Jehoshaphat , u khun jong u Ahilud u daym u nongsumar ïa ki dulir ;
translation.en: And Adoram was over the tribute : and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder :

translation.kha: Ïa kiba bun ki briew yn pynkhuid . Kito kiba bymman kin ym sngewthuh hynrei ken ïailong bymman ; tang kito kiba stad kin shemphang .
translation.en: Many shall be purified , and made white , and tried  ; but the wicked shall do wickedly : and none of the wicked shall understand  ; but the wise shall understand .

translation.kha: Lada ki kjap lane ki hynmen shynna jyllang ki , ki wang ban ïeng pyrshah ïa phi , phi lah baneh ong , ‘ sngewbiang shah ba kin don bad i , namar ngim shym shim ïa ki na phi ha ka madan thma ban long ki tnga jong ngi . Bad haba phim khim la ai ïa ki ha ngi , Kino long kiba la pynrem ba phi la pynheh ïa la ka kular .’
translation.en: And it shall be , when their fathers or their brethren come unto us to complain , that we will say unto them , Be favourable unto them for our sakes : because we reserved not to each man his wife in the war : for ye did not give unto them at this time , that ye should be guilty .
And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah , and smote the host : for the host was secure .
translation.kha: U Gideon u ïaid na ka lynti na ki tduh jong ka ri shyiap , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Nobah bad ka Jogbehah , bad u la tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai ha kaba kim shym poi pyrkhat .
U Jisu u la leit phai pat sha shiliang ka duriaw . Hangta harud ka duriaw , u paidbah babun u la ïalumlang sawdong jongki u .
translation.en: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side , much people gathered unto him : and he was nigh unto the sea .

translation.kha: U kpa mar kumta hi u la pyrta , ?(Nga don ka jingneit , hynrei kam da biah . To ïarap ïa nga ba ngan don haw shiah !
translation.en: And straightway the father of the child cried out , and said with tears , Lord , I believe  ; help thou mine unbelief .
Ponder the path of thy feet , and let all thy ways be established .
translation.kha: Da pyrkhat bha aïu phi leh , bad kat kaba phi leh kan long bha .
Haba u briew’ u smai , u pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong uno Uno uba kham khraw ban ïa u , bad ka jingsmai ka pynbeit ïa baroh ki jingkñia .
translation.en: For men verily swear by the greater : and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife .
And unleavened bread , and cakes unleavened tempered with oil , and wafers unleavened anointed with oil : of wheaten flour shalt thou make them .
translation.kha: Shim ïa u kew ba la tylliat ni bha , u bym pat khleh thiat , bad shet katto katne ki kpu ba la khleh bad ka umphniang Olib , bad katto katne khlem umphniang bad katto katne ki kpu lyngkniap ba la shu kyllan da ka umphniang .

translation.en: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me , having a live coal in his hand , which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar :
translation.kha: Te uwei na ki seraph u la her sha tbian sha nga , da kaba rah ïa u rnga uba rhem uba u la khap da ka nap na ka duwan .

Pynban , kin smai da nga kum U Blei uba im uba la wallam ïa ki paid Israel na ka ri bashatei bad na baher kiwei pat ki ri ha kaba nga la pynsakma ïa ki . Ngan wallam bapaw ïa ki sha ka ri ka jong ki hi , sha ka ri kaba sa la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki . Ma nga , U Trai , de la kren .
translation.en: But , The  Lord  liveth , that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north , and from all the lands whither he had driven them : and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers .
And the famine was over all the face of the earth : And Joseph opened all the storehouses , and sold unto the Egyptians  ; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ka  nemsniew ka la kham jur , bad ka la saphriang ïa ka ri baroh kawei , u Joseph u la plie ïa kita ki ïing kynshew jingbam baroh , bad u la die kew ha ki nong Ijipt .

translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,
Lada phim kohnguh ïa ki jinghikai U Blei ïa kiba la thoh ha kane ka phim , pynlang lada phim ñiewburom ïa ka ktung kaba phylla bad kaba khraw jong U Tlai U Blei jngai phi ,
translation.en: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book , that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name , THE  Lord  THY GOD  ;

translation.kha: Bad u Ïing u la ai ïa Kanah ka jingphla : Nga la ïoh ïa U Mynsiem ba u hiar kum ka paro na bneng , bad u shongsah halor jong u .
translation.en: And John bare record , saying , I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove , and it abode upon him .

translation.kha: U la mynshuwa ju , bad haba ki nongshniah ki la leit nala , ar ngut ki ngab synshar jong u ki la ïaishah pyrthuh ïa u bad ki la pynïap ïa u ha ka jingthiah jyllang u ban pynmutlop ïa ka jingpynïap ïa u ïakhun jong u Jedidah , u lynghoh . La tep ïa u ha ka Nongbah jong u Dabid , hynrei ym ha ka jingtep ki syiem .
translation.en: And when they were departed from him , ( for they left him in great diseases , ) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest , and slew him on his bed , and he died : and they buried him in the city of David , but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings .
For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness , than , after they have known it , to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them .
translation.kha: Kan jin da la kham bha ïa ki ba kin ym jin da la tip ïa ka lynti ka hok ban ïa kaba tip ïa ka bad nangta pat ban phai dien noh na ka hukum bakyntang ïa kaba la ai ha ki .

Balei ba phi wan ïalam ïa ngi na ibieit sha ka Jaka kaba sniew kum kane ha kaba u jingthung ei ei umdih um mih ? Kane ka dei ka jaka ha kaba u kew ruh um un-long , u soh thurmur ruh um long , u sohwaiñ shwa um Long , bad u soh Pomkranet ruh um long . Wat ka umdih ruh kam don !
translation.en: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt , to bring us in unto this evil place ? it is no place of seed , or of figs , or of vines , or of pomegranates  ; neither is there any water to drink .

But there is a God in heaven that revealeth secrets , and maketh known to the king Nebuchadnezzar what shall be in the latter days . Thy dream , and the visions of thy head upon thy bed , are these  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei don U Blei ha bneng , uba pynpaw ïa ki jingmaïan . U la pyntip ïa u Syiem Kynrad kaei ka ban jia ha ka lawei . Mynta ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingphohsniew , ka jingïohipaw kaba phi lah ïoh mynba phi dang ïohthiah .

translation.en: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men , saying , My father made your yoke heavy , and I will add to your yoke : my father also chastised you with whips , but I will chastise you with scorpions .
translation.kha: U ong ,  I pa i la buh ha phi ïa ka jingkit kaba khia ; nga ngan kham pynkhia shuh shuh ïa kita . I pa i la shoh ïa phi da u riphin ; nga ngan sympat ïa phi da u shabuk !
Nga em khrup da pynpluh ha madan , hynrei U Mynsiem jong U Blei u sping hapoh jyllang nga bad u pynïeng ïa nga . U Trai u la ong ha nga : Khie leit sha ïing bad set khop ïa lade shiah ïit .
translation.en: Then the spirit entered into me , and set me upon my feet , and spake with me , and said unto me , Go , shut thyself within thine house .

translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi haba U Trai un pyn-i ïa ka jingbitar shla jrong u , wat ka rupa Bad ka ksiar jong ki baroh kan ym lah ban pyndem ïa ki . Ïa ka pyrthei baher kawei yn pynjot da ka ding ka jingbieit jong u . Un pynkut — ka jingkut kaba kynsha — ïa uwei pa uwei ibha im ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the  Lord s  wrath  ; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy : for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada isangsot uno na phi u ïaduna ïa ka jingstad , u dei ban duwai ha U Blei , u ban ai ïa ka ha u ; namar U Balei u ai kylluid nabar ai ei ïa baroh .
translation.en: If any of you lack wisdom , let him ask of God , that giveth to all men liberally , and upbraideth not  ; and it shall be given him .

translation.kha: U Jehonathan , u kynhun jong u Anaharath , bad u Ahimaas , u khun jongno u Sadok , ki ïalang ap hajan ka umpohliew Enrogel , kaba ha rudnong jongki ka Jerusalem , namar kim nud ban rung shapoh ka nongbah ïoh don ba ïohi ïa ki . khawai ka sharati kynthei ka ju leit ïatih ha ki ïa kiei kaba jia , bad ki pat ki ju leit ïathuh ha u Syiem Dabid .
translation.en: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by En–rogel  ; for they might not be seen to come into the city : and a wench went and told them  ; and they went and told king David .

translation.kha: Ki kmie ki Kpa jong u kim tip shaphang kane ; ki dang pyrkhat ba u la don lang bad ka kynhun , kumta ki la ïaleit lyndang baroh shi sngi , bad nangne , ki la sdang ban wad ïa u hapdeng ki ba-ha-ïing bad ki paralok .
translation.en: But they , supposing him to have been in the company , went a day s journey  ; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance .

translation.kha: Bad U Tiras u ong ha eit ki nongwei kiba la pynïasoh bad ki bynriew jong u , kiba ieit ïa u nabar Kiba shakri ïa u , kiba satar ïa ka Sabbaton bad kiba batskhem ïa ka jutang jongno u .
translation.en: Also the sons of the stranger , that join themselves to the  Lord  , to serve him , and to love the name of the  Lord  , to be his servants , every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it , and taketh hold of my covenant  ;

translation.kha: Nga sngewthuh kumno ka long ïahap kyrduh , bad kumno ka long ban don pahuh kyrngah . Nga la nang ïa kane ka buit bariew , ba hangno hangno ha kano kano ka por , nga sngewhun haba lada nga sngewdap kyrkieh ne sngew kyrduh lane haba nga don palat than eh ne don khyndiat eh .
translation.en: I know both how to be abased , and I know how to abound : every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry , both to abound and to suffer need .

translation.kha: Te ngi kyang shaw U Tharai , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ban ïarap ïa ngi . U la shahshkor ïa ngi , bad u la ïohi ba ngi shahskhor jynjar , ngi hap trei shitom , nabar ngi shah lehbeiñ .
translation.en: And when we cried unto the  Lord  God of our fathers , the  Lord  heard our voice , and looked on our affliction , and our labour , and our oppression :
It is like a letter to us from a loving father .
translation.kha: Ka long kum ka shithi na u kpa ba ieit sha la ki khun .

Hynrei naduh ba ngi sangeh ban ai jingkñia ha ka Syiem jong ka Bneng bad ngi shiteng ban theh ïa ki jingainguh waiñ ha ka , ngiah shym don ei ei shuh , bad ki brup jong ngi ki ïap ha ka thma sad na ka jingïapthngan .
translation.en: But since we left off to burn incense to the queen of heaven , and to pour out drink offerings unto her , we have wanted all things , and have been consumed by the sword and by the famine .

translation.kha: Uta u briew pat un sait ïa la ki jaiñ-da , un puta lut ïa la u shñiuh , bad un sum un sleh ; te un sa long uba khuid . U lah banbeiñ wan rung sha ka jaka shong dara , hynrei u dei ban shongsuk shabi ka ïingjaiñ jong u hynñiew sngi lynter .
translation.en: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes , and shave off all his hair , and wash himself in water , that he may be clean : and after that he shall come into the camp , and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days .

translation.kha: nadong mynta me dei ban otsher ïa u khunlung baroh haba u la dap phra sngi , kynduh ruh ïa ki mraw kiba la kha ha ki longïing longsem jong me bad ïa ki saraw kba me la thied na ki nongwei . Kane kuna pyn-i ba ka don ka jutang hapdeng jong nga malu me .
translation.en: And he that is eight days old shall be circumcised among you , every man child in your generations , he that is born in the house , or bought with money of any stranger , which is not of thy seed .

translation.kha: Ka jingkordit Kaba sneng ka la kut ; hadien kano ka to sa ar tylli ki jingkordit ki ban wan .
translation.en: One woe is past  ; and , behold , there come two woes more hereafter .
So the angel that communed with me said unto me , Cry thou , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy .
translation.kha: bad uta u angel u la bthah ïa nga ban pynbna ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la lah ong :  Nga la don ka jingieit bajylliew bad jingsngewkhia ïa ka Jerusalem ka nongbah bakhuid jong nga ,
Uno uno u shynrang uba na ka longïing u lyngdoh u lah ban bam ïa kane ka jingainguh ; ka dei kaba khuid bha .
translation.en: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof : it is most holy .

translation.kha: Nga longsem u jong me — A pynim ïa nga ! nga la pyrshang ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .
translation.en: I am thine , save me  ; for I have sought thy precepts .

translation.kha: Ha katba ïatei sad ka jingwan pat ka jong U Jisu Khreh U Tiras jong ngi bad ka jinglum lang ïa im’ ban long lem bad u : Nga kyrpad ïa phi , ki parabangeit jongu nga ,
translation.en: Now we beseech you , brethren , by the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ , and by our gathering together unto him ,

translation.kha: Phim dei u briew uba na mut ba phi den .
translation.en: You're just not the person I thought you were .
Which knew me from the beginning , if they would testify , that after the most straitest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee .
translation.kha: Ki la tip borabor , lada ki mon ban phla , ba naduh kaba nyngkong nga la im kum u dkhot jong ka seng kaba pyrkhing tam jong ka niam jong ngi , ki Pharisi .

translation.en: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen  ; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit , and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver : and they brought Joseph into Egypt .
translation.kha: Ki hynmen jong u ki ïamynjur , bad haba katto katne ki nongkhaïi na Midian ki ïaid lynti nangta , ki hynmen ki la sei noh ïa u Joseph na kata ka pukri bad ki la die noh ïa u ha kita ki nong Ishmael arphew tylli ki sbai rupa , bad ki ruh ki la ïalam noh ïa u sha Ijipt .

translation.en: Do we then make void the law through faith ? God forbid : yea , we establish the law .
translation.kha: Hato kane ka mut ba da kane ka jingngeit ngi kyntait noh ïa ka Hukum ? Em , ym kumta ; pynban , ngi pynskhem ïa ka Hukum .

translation.en: No doubt but ye are the people , and wisdom shall die with you .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , me long ka sur jong u paidbah . Ynda men ïap , ka jingstad jong me kan ïap lang bad me .

translation.en: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath , and vex them in his sore displeasure .
translation.kha: Nangta u maham ïa ki ha ka jingbitar bad u pyntriem ïa ki da ka jingbitar shla jong u .
Bahok ki jingïada jongno ka Judah ki la khyllem . Ha kata ka la jia , phi la wallam ïa ki tiar ïaleh na ka jaka buh .
translation.en: And he discovered the covering of Judah , and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest .
So the messenger went , and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for .
translation.kha: Kumta uta u nonglamktien u la leit sha u Dabid bad u la ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kaba u Joab u la hukum ïa u ban ong .
ngan sdien ïa kita ha la ka tyrpeng da kaba sngewsarong malu nur-um buh ïa ki ha ka khlieh kum ka pansngiat .
translation.en: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder , and bind it as a crown to me .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Petros u la wan sha Enokh , to la pyrshah ïa u ha kaba paw , namar ba u la bakla shai .
translation.en: But when Peter was come to Antioch , I withstood him to the face , because he was to be blamed .

translation.kha: Ha ka pa ka jingpyrshah jongu u Dabid , la ne ka nemsniew kaweh jur naba la neh haduh lai snem lynter . Khmut u ïaiban u kylli na U Trai shaphang kata bad U Trai u ong , U Saul bad ka long-briew jong u ki long uba rem ha ka jingpynkheiñ briew ; u la pynïap ïa ki paid Gibeon .
translation.en: Then there was a famine in the days of David three years , year after year  ; and David enquired of the  Lord . And the  Lord  answered , It is for Saul , and for his bloody house , because he slew the Gibeonites .

translation.kha: Lada ïa ph ym shym la pynshitom , kumba shah ki khun jong u baroh , ka mutlop ba phim Dei ki khun bashisha lad u , hynrei ki khun khlem kpa .
translation.en: But if ye be without chastisement , whereof all are partakers , then are ye bastards , and not sons .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingieit la pynneh noh ha ngi , ba ngin don ka jingshlur ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar ; dara ngin don ïa ka namar ka jingim jong ngi ha kane ka pyrthei ka long kumjuh kum ka jong U Khrist .
translation.en: Herein is our love made perfect , that we may have boldness in the day of judgment : because as he is , so are we in this world .

translation.kha: U Mynhyndai jngai U Blei u pynïasoh lang! ïa lade bun ki mynsiem jong ngi ban pynbang ba ngi long ki khun jong U Blei .
translation.en: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit , that we are the children of God :
Then they that gladly received his word were baptized : and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls .
translation.kha: Kiba bun na ki , ki la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong u bad la pynbaptis ïa ki , bad kumba lai hajar ngut ki briew la pynïasoh sha ka kynhun ha kata ka sngi .

translation.en: And Moses told Aaron all the words of the  Lord  who had sent him , and all the signs which he had commanded him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ïathuh ha u Aaron ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba U  Trai  u la ong mynba u phah ïa u ban leit phai sha Ijipt ; u ïathuh ruh ha u shaphang ki kambah kiba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u ban leh .

translation.en: Ye shall not eat one day , nor two days , nor five days , neither ten days , nor twenty days  ;
translation.kha: Phi dei ban bam ïa ka ym tang shi sngi ne ar sngi , ne san sngi , ne shiphew sngi , ne wat arphew sngi ruh ,

Balei ? Namar ba ka Syria kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa ka Damaskos , ka nongbah jong ka , bad ka Dammim kam long kaba kham khlaiñ ban ïa u Syiem Resin . Katba ïa ka Israel , hapoh ki hynriewphew satang snem yn sa pynkyiuh ïa ka hima ban lait im khim ka jaitbynriew .
translation.en: For the head of Syria is Damascus , and the head of Damascus is Rezin  ; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken , that it be not a people .
And Noah went forth , and his sons , and his wife , and his sons  wives with him :
translation.kha: Kumta u Noah lem bad la ka tnga , bad ki khun shynrang jong u bad ki tnga jong ki , ki la ïamih shabar na kata ka lieng .
Ka turoi bakhlaiñbor kan sawa , bad un phah ïa ki angel jong u sha ki sawlyer jong ka pyrthei , don kin lumlang ïa ki briew kiba la jied jyllang u na kawei ka tduh jrong ka pyrthei sha kawei pat .
translation.en: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet , and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds , from one end of heaven to the other .

translation.kha: U Samson u bat ïa kita ki ryntih bneng ar tylli kiba kyrshan ïa kata ka ïing . Da kaba buh ïa kawei ka kti ha uwei u rishot bad kawei pat ha uwei u rishot , u khyndew pyrshah ïa ki
translation.en: And Samson took hold of the two middle pillars upon which the house stood , and on which it was borne up , of the one with his right hand , and of the other with his left .
The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,

translation.en: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full , and hast built goodly houses , and dwelt therein  ;
translation.kha: Wat ynda phi la ïoh ban bam kat ïa kaba phi kwah bad tei la ki ïing kiba itynnat ban shong ,
To pynkloi ban Wan noh sha nga .
translation.en: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me :
And the angel said unto me , Wherefore didst thou marvel ? I will tell thee the mystery of the woman , and of the beast that carrieth her , which hath the seven heads and ten horns .
translation.kha: Balei ba me la sngewkyndit ?  u angel u la kylli ïa nga .  Ngan ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingmut barieh jong kata ka briew , bad jong u mradkhlaw uba kit ïa ka , uta u mradkhlaw uba don hynñiew tylli ki khlieh bad shiphew tylli ki reng .

Ha uwei pa uei na ki la ai ïa ka jaiñkup balieh , bad la ong ïa ki ba kmen shongthait sa shipor , tad ieid la dep kheiñ lut ïa ki para shakri bad parabangeit kiba la shah pynïap , kumba la leh ïa ki .
translation.en: And white robes were given unto every one of them  ; and it was said unto them , that they should rest yet for a little season , until their fellowservants also and their brethren , that should be killed as they were , should be fulfilled .

And , behold , there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Israel , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , Hast thou seen all this great multitude ? behold , I will deliver it into thine hand this day  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , u nongïathuhlypa u leit sha u syiem Ahab , bad u la ong ,  U  Trai  u ong , ‘ Wat sheptieng ïa katai ka kynhun shipai kaba heh ! Ngan ai jingjop ïa me halor jong ka mynta ka sngi , bad men ïoh tip ba nga dei U  Trai .’
Ha u Shim bymhok , u bymkut shuh bad u bym lah ban ïohthiah , uba tang ma u hi U Blei — ha u to long ka jingpyndonburom bad ka burom junom la junom ! Adummim .
translation.en: Now unto the King eternal , immortal , invisible , the only wise God , be honour and glory for ever and ever . Amen .

translation.kha: Ko nongsakhi , uta u briew u la ong , naduh ba sa tang khynnah , nga la kohnguh ïa kine ki hukum baroh .
translation.en: And he answered and said unto him , Master , all these have I observed from my youth .
The tree grew , and was strong , and the height thereof reached unto heaven , and the sight thereof to the end of all the earth :
translation.kha: U la nang san nang san tad haduh ba u la kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng bad ba lah ban ïohi da baroh kiba don ha ka pyrthei .
U pynim wat ïa kiba la ïap .
translation.en: He even raised the dead .
And now , O inhabitants of Jerusalem , and men of Judah , judge , I pray you , betwixt me and my vineyard .
translation.kha: Kumta mynta u paralok jong nga u ong :  Ma phi ki briew kiba shong ha Jerusalem bad Judah , to bishar hapdeng jong nga bad ka bri sohwaiñ jong nga .
Kan ym da bunkam ïa phi ban da ong , namar ktien ïohi kano pa’ long kiba sngur dara ba donburom ha ka jinglong jingim jong phi .
translation.en: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear .

translation.kha: Hynrei tharai mynta me pynmong ïa ka met Jong u — un tim ïa me markhmat !
translation.en: But put forth thine hand now , and touch his bone and his flesh , and he will curse thee to thy face .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongap ki Israel kyang ïashem shabar bad khar ïa ki tiar ïapom ba la iehnoh ïa ka ban thang diengïap . Kin sliew ding da ki stieh , ki ryntieh , ki khnam , ki sum bad ki ngin tangon , bad kin biang ïaheh hynñiew snem .
translation.en: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth , and shall set on fire and burn the weapons , both the shields and the bucklers , the bows and the arrows , and the handstaves , and the spears , and they shall burn them with fire seven years :

translation.kha: Nangta u la leit shad ka khyrdop kaba pait sha mihngi . U la kew ïa ki mawkyrdon , bad ha kliar u la thew ïa ka tyngkong ; ka la longïng lai mitar shapoh ha ka jingjylliew .
translation.en: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east , and went up the stairs thereof , and measured the threshold of the gate , which was one reed broad  ; and the other threshold of the gate , which was one reed broad .

translation.kha: Kine harum ki longïing ki khun jongnga u ïa kiba la kha ha Jerusalem : U Shammua , u Sobah , u Nathan , u Solomon ,
translation.en: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem  ; Shammua , and Shobab , and Nathan , and Solomon ,

translation.kha: Ka jingmaham ba ai da u briew uba shemphang bha ha uno uno uba mon don sngap ka long kaba kham kordor ba ïa ki sati ksiar ne ki jingdeng mawlynnai ba la sai na ka ksiar banylla .
translation.en: As an earring of gold , and an ornament of fine gold , so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear .

translation.kha: Kane ka dih ka sngi jong ka jingpar jongki U Troas ; to ngin ïakmen , to ngin ïalehkmen !
translation.en: This is the day which the  Lord  hath made  ; we will rejoice and be glad in it .
But new wine must be put into new bottles  ; and both are preserved .
translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ka waiñ bathymmai dei ban theh ha ki lwa snieh bathymmai !

translation.en: But Jesus said unto him ,  Follow me  ; and let the dead bury their dead .
translation.kha: Bud ïa nga ,  U Jisu u la jubab ,  bad ai kiba ïap kin tep ïa kiba ïap jong ki .
Ïathuh ïa nga , hato ka hok jong u Ïoannis ïa-ban pynbaptis ka wan na U blei ne na u briew ?
translation.en: The baptism of John , was it from heaven , or of men ?

translation.kha: Kin ibeiñ ïa phi bad kmen kulai , U la kular ban ïan , hato um shym la klun kumta ? Hangno u don ? Ki kparad tymmen ki la lah ïa-ïap , hynrei kiei kiei baroh ki dang ïashoh kumjuh kum mynba la pynbang ïa ka pyrthei !
translation.en: And saying , Where is the promise of his coming ? for since the fathers fell asleep , all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation .

translation.kha: Ïeng joit ! Pynkhuid ïa u paidbah bad Pynkhreh ban wan ha khmat jong de . Bthah ïa ki ban long kiba la kloi Laish ka sngi , namar ma nga , U Trai U Blei ki Israel nga don kane ban noh : ‘ Israel , phiah don ha ki jingsdang jingbam jong phi katto katne kiba nga la law ïa phi ban pynjot ! Phim lah ban ïong pyrda ïa ki nongshun jong phi tad haduh ba phin da lait na kine kiei kiei !’
translation.en: Up , sanctify the people , and say , Sanctify yourselves against to morrow : for thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , There is an accursed thing in the midst of thee , O Israel : thou canst not stand before thine enemies , until ye take away the accursed thing from among you .

translation.kha: Mem shym la ai khun ïa nga , bad uwei na ki mraw jong nga un ïohpateng ïa ka spah ka phew jong nga .
translation.en: And Abram said , Behold , to me thou hast given no seed : and , lo , one born in my house is mine heir .
For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard .
translation.kha: Naba men long u sakhi na ka bynta jong u ban ïathuh ha uwei pa uwei ïa kaei kaba me la ïohi bad ïohsngew .

translation.en: And they said unto him , We can . And Jesus said unto them ,  Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of  ; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized :
translation.kha: Ngi lah ,  ki la jubab . U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Da shisha phin sa dih na ka khuri kaba nga dei ban dih bad ban shah pynbaptis ha ka rukom ba dei ban pynbaptis ïa nga .

translation.en: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land , which they shall bring unto the  Lord  , shall be thine  ; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it .
translation.kha: Baroh ki long ki jong me . Uwei pa uwei na ka ïing jong me uba khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam u lah ban bam ïa ki .

U la pyrta ha ka sur kaba jam : Ka la kyllon ! Ka Babilon Bakhraw ka la kyllon ! Mynta ka la long ka jaka shong ki ksuid bad ki mynsiem bymkhuid ; baher ki jait sim kiba jakhlia bad Ibbah irmat ki shong ha ka .
translation.en: And he cried mightily with a strong voice , saying , Babylon the great is fallen , is fallen , and is become the habitation of devils , and the hold of every foul spirit , and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird .

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit Sha u Pharaoh bad ki kuna kumba U Trai u la hukum . U Onan u bret ïa la u diengduh ha khmat u Pharaoh bad ha khmat ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , bad u kylla bseiñ .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh , and they did so as the  Lord  had commanded : and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh , and before his servants , and it became a serpent .
And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel , saying , This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded .
translation.kha: U Moses u ai ïa kine ki jingbthah ha ki nongïalam na ki jait Israel .
Bad ïa kan ka Khubor Babha Shaphang ka Hima yn ïalap ha Kylleng ka pyrthei na ka bynta ka jingsait sha ki jingtipbriew baroh ; badno nangta kaba kput Kan wan .
translation.en: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations  ; and then shall the end come .
He is ‘ the god of this world .’—2 Corinthians 4 :4 .
translation.kha: U dei ‘ u blei jong kane ka pyrthei .’—2 Korinth 4 :4 .
U Jotham u la don arphew san snem ka ter mynba u long syiem bad u synshar khathynriew snem ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Kumta ki khun shynrang u Jakob ki kun kumba u la hukum ïa ki ;
translation.en: And his sons did unto him according as he commanded them :
And be not conformed to this world : but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind , that ye may prove what is that good , and acceptable , and perfect , will of God .
translation.kha: To wat pynïasyriem ïa lade bad ki rukom jong kane ka pyrthei , hynrei to ai ba U Blei un pynkylla dur ïa kaba shapoh jong phi da ka jingpynkylla ïa ka jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi baroh . Te phin lah ban tip ïa ka mon U Blei — kaei kaba bha bad kaba pynsngewbha ïa u bad kaba janai .

Nga longkmie uba rit na ibha rit tam na ki briew jong U Blei baroh ; pynban , U Blei u la ai ha nga ïa kane ka kabu ban ïalap sha ki Jentil ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka jingkynrei spah bymkut shuh jong U Khrist , badno pun pynlong ïa ki briew baroh ban ïohi kumin ba la pyntreikam ïa ka jingimat bamaïan U Blei .
translation.en: Unto me , who am less than the least of all saints , is this grace given , that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ ;
He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man : he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich .
translation.kha: Kaba byrngia ha ki jingim pahuh , ka waiñ bad ka jingbam lutphut kin ym pynlong ïa phi uba riewspah .
Dem ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Ahab ban ïoh long u kpa , wat haba u la tymmen bha bad ka Sarah hi kam lah ban ïoh khun . U la shaniah ba U Blei un bat ïa la ka kular .
translation.en: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed , and was delivered of a child when she was past age , because she judged him faithful who had promised .

translation.kha: da kaba ïaroh ïa U Blei , bad lehkmen ha ka jingbhasbun jong ki briew baroh . Bad men ka sngi U Trai u kad pynshah ha ka kynhun jong ki ïa kito kiba la pynim .
translation.en: Praising God , and having favour with all the people . And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar Badonbor Berakah u ktah ïa ka pyrthei , bad ka khynñiuh baroh kiba shong ha ka ki jingïambriew , ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka ktieh ka hiar kum ka wieh Nile .
translation.en: And the Lord  God  of hosts is he that toucheth the land , and it shall melt , and all that dwell therein shall mourn : and it shall rise up wholly like a flood  ; and shall be drowned , as by the flood of Egypt .

translation.kha: pynlang ka jingpynïasoh , ki tupia , ki pyllun ,
translation.en: And a mitre of fine linen , and goodly bonnets of fine linen , and linen breeches of fine twined linen ,

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong , Ngin la wan sha kane ka pyrthei ban bishar , khñiang ba kiba matlah kyang ïohi bad kito kiba ïohi kin long bamatlah .
translation.en: And Jesus said ,  For judgment I am come into this world , that they which see not might see  ; and that they which see might be made blind .

translation.kha: Hynriew ngan ap khmih ïa U Trai ; ngan ap skhem ïa U Blei , u ban pyllait im ïa ar . U Blei jongnga nga un sngewrem ïa nga .
translation.en: Therefore I will look unto the  Lord   ; I will wait for the God of my salvation : my God will hear me .

translation.kha: hadien kata u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Pirathon ha ka ri ki Ephraim ha ka ri lum jong ki Amalek .
translation.en: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died , and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim , in the mount of the Amalekites .

translation.kha: Nabal katba nga dang ïathied lyndang ka nongbah jong phi bad kham ïa ki khak ha kiba phi mane , nga la lade ïa ka duwan ha kaba la thoh , ‘ Ha U Blang ibha ngim tip .’ Te ïa Utai ïa uba phiah mane , wat haba phim tip ïa u , ïa une keiñ nga pynbna mynta ha phi .
translation.en: For as I passed by , and beheld your devotions , I found an altar with this inscription , TO THE UNKNOWN GOD . Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship , him declare I unto you .
And as thy servant was busy here and there , he was gone . And the king of Israel said unto him , So shall thy judgment be  ; thyself hast decided it .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga la bunkam bad kiwei pat ki kam , kumta uta u briew u lait noh .  U syiem u jubab ,  Phi la pynbna hi ïa ka rai , bad phin hap siew ïa ka kuna .

translation.en: And Pharaoh called Abram , and said , What is this that thou hast done unto me ? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife ?
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u la khot ïa u Abram , bad u kylli ïa u ,  Me leh aïu ïa nga ? Balei mem shym la ïathuh ïa nga ba ka dei ka tnga jong me ?
bad ka la smat ïa ki na u khiew shimet na ka bynta jong u ïa-ban bam , hynrei um treh . U ong , Phah neh shabar ïa iwei pa iwei baïar — bad baher ki la mihnoh .
translation.en: And she took a pan , and poured them out before him  ; but he refused to eat . And Amnon said , Have out all men from me . And they went out every man from him .
I pray for them : I pray not for the world , but for them which thou hast given me  ; for they are thine .
translation.kha: Nga duwai na ka bynta jong ki . Ngam duwai na ka bynta ka pyrthei hynrei na ka bynta kito ïa kiba me la ai ha nga , namar ki long ki jong me .

U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Ong ïa u Aaron ban shim ïa la u diengduh bad ïa-ban rah ïa u hajir ki wahbah , ki nur-um , bad ki pukri um baroh ha ka ri Ijipt . Ka um kan kylla snur , bad ha ka ri baroh kawei kan don ka sner , wat ha ki khiew dieng nabar ki khiew maïan ruh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Take thy rod , and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt , upon their streams , upon their rivers , and upon their ponds , and upon all their pools of water , that they may become blood  ; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt , both in vessels of wood , and in vessels of stone .

translation.kha: U Solomon u phah khubor sha u Hiram u syiem ka Tyros : To ïakhaïi bad to kumba phi la leh bad u syiem Abda , u kpa jong nga , mynba phi la dei ïa u ki dieng Kedar tylli na ka bynda ban tei ïa ka ïingsyiem jong u .
translation.en: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre , saying , As thou didst deal with David my father , and didst send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein , even so deal with me .
When ye were but few , even a few , and strangers in it .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong U Blei ki long khyndiat , ki long ki nongwei ha ka ri Kanaan .
Kane ka la jia Naamah ki pop jong u pyrshah ïa U Trai . kumin u Jeroboam wahbah ha shuwa jong u , u la pynsngewsih ïa U Trai da ki pop jngai u hi bad da kaba ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh ngop .
translation.en: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the  Lord  , in walking in the way of Jeroboam , and in his sin which he did , to make Israel to sin .

translation.kha: Uba khraw bad uba donbor long U Trai jong ngi ; ïa ka jingstad jong u ym lah pun thiaw .
translation.en: Great is our Lord , and of great power : his understanding is infinite .

translation.kha: Kumta to kular skhem hangne ha kham U Blei ba men ym shahskhor ïa nga , ïa ki khum ki kti jong nga , lane ïa ki nonghiarpateng jong nga . Nga la ju lehhok ïa me , kumta to kular ba men lehhok kylliang ïa nga bad ïa kane ka ri ha kob me shong me sah .
translation.en: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me , nor with my son , nor with my son s son : but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee , thou shalt do unto me , and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned .

translation.kha: Nga kren mynta ha phi ki Jentil : Katba to ïalang un-long u apostol sha ki Jentil , kun sngewtieng ha ka kada jong nga .
translation.en: For I speak to you Gentiles , inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles , I magnify mine office :

translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno babha len ïa kane shaphang U Jehu , um ni U Mynsiem na U Blei . U mynsiem ba u anna , u long na u Nongshun jong U Khrist ; phi! la ïohsngew ba un wanlam , bad mynta u la da don hangne ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God : and this is that spirit of antichrist , whereof ye have heard that it should come  ; and even now already is it in the world .

translation.kha: ibha don kano kano ka jingïakajia hapdeng ar ngut , ki wan shaw nga , nga hap ban bishar bad rah mano na ki uba dem , bad ang ïathuh ha ki ïa ki law bad ki shaiñ U Blei ki ong .
translation.en: When they have a matter , they come unto me  ; and I judge between one and another , and I do make them know the statutes of God , and his laws .

translation.kha: Bad to pdiang ïa ka jingpynrem kum ka jingïada khlaiñ , bad ka ktien U Blei kum ka waitlam kaweh U mynhynne u ai ha ph .
translation.en: And take the helmet of salvation , and the sword of the Spirit , which is the word of God :

translation.kha: dien ka Kiriath Baal ( lane ka Kiriath Jearim ) bad ka Rabbah : ar tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jongno ki .
translation.en: Kirjath–baal , which is Kirjath–jearim , and Rabbah  ; two cities with their villages :

translation.kha: Baroh kaba u leh ki dap da ka jingpyndonburom bad kaba iphieng ; ka hok jong u ka neh junom .
translation.en: His work is honourable and glorious : and his righteousness endureth for ever .
And now , behold , I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem , not knowing the things that shall befall me there :
translation.kha: Bad mynta , da kaba kohnguh ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ngan leit sha Jerusalem , khlem da tip aïu kan jia ïa nga hangta .
U Trai u phah ïa ka ding nongring , bad ka thang duh ïa ka jingkñia , ïa ki diengthang bad ïa ki maw ; ka pyningkhong ïa ka khyndew bad pynkad lut ïa ka um ha ka kharai .
translation.en: Then the fire of the  Lord  fell , and consumed the burnt sacrifice , and the wood , and the stones , and the dust , and licked up the water that was in the trench .
But , O  Lord  of hosts , that triest the righteous , and seest the reins and the heart , let me see thy vengeance on them : for unto thee have I opened my cause .
translation.kha: Hynrei , ko  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , me tynjuh hok ïa ki briew ; me tip kaei kaba don hapoh ki dohnud bad ka jingmut jong ki . Kumta shah ngan ïohi ba me pynhiarkput halor ki nongshun jong nga , namar nga la buh ïa ka kam jong nga ha ki kti jong me .
Man ka snem ki kmie ki kpa jong U Ujuh ki kitei shaei Jerusalem na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka jingialang .
translation.en: Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover .

translation.kha: U Tlai Badonbor Baroh u jong ba un phah shabar ïa kane ka jingtim , bad kan rung shapoh ka ïing jong ti pa uwei u nongtuh bad sha ka ïing jong uwei pa uwei babha ïaheh lamler hapoh ka jingsmai . Kan ïaineh ha ki ïing jong ki bad ieh ïa ki ha ka jingjot .
translation.en: I will bring it forth , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and it shall enter into the house of the thief , and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by my name : and it shall remain in the midst of his house , and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof .

translation.kha: Katba kane ka dang long kumne , ngam shym la don ha Jerusalem , namar ha ka Snem kaba laiphew ar ba u Artakserksis u long u syiem ka Babilon , nga la dei ban leit phai ban ai jingtap sha u . Hadien katto katei por , nga la ïoh jingbit
translation.en: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem : for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king , and after certain days obtained I leave of the king :

translation.kha: U Khristan u long ka dur babud jong U Blei u sem lah ban ïuh . U Long U Khun ba la ha nyngkong , uba ñiuhkhlieh duh jong kiwei kiei barhem kiba la thaw .
translation.en: Who is the image of the invisible God , the firstborn of every creature :

translation.kha: hynrei jingim lah pat ban shait ba kin shongkurim ïa ki khun kynthei jongngi ngi , namar ngi la buh ïa ka jingtim ha uno uno na ngi uba shah ïa u Benjamin ban shongkurim ïa kawei na ki khun kynthei jong ngi .
translation.en: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters : for the children of Israel have sworn , saying , Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin .

translation.kha: I ju ong , Kynmaw bha ïa kaba nga ong bad wat kli ïa ka lano lano ruh . lehhok kumba nga ong ïa phira , bad phin im .
translation.en: He taught me also , and said unto me , Let thine heart retain my words : keep my commandments , and live .

translation.kha: U un long u nongpynkren lem jong me nabar un kren ha u Paidbah na ka bynta jongu me . Hangta me pat men long kum U blei , da kiba ïathuh ha u aïu un ong .
translation.en: And he shall be thy spokesman unto the people : and he shall be , even he shall be to thee instead of a mouth , and thou shalt be to him instead of God .

translation.kha: Khie wait bad da pynthikna bha sa shisien pateng ; wan biang beiñ ha-ei u don , bad u uba la ïohi ïa u hangta . Nga tip ba u long uba satia bha’ .
translation.en: Go , I pray you , prepare yet , and know and see his place where his haunt is , and who hath seen him there : for it is told me that he dealeth very subtilly .

translation.kha: Ki nongïam jong ka Ephod ki la sngewshyrkhei ; ki rangbah bakhlaiñbor jong ka Moab ki sngewkyiuh ; ki briew ka Kanaan ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur jong ki .
translation.en: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed  ; the mighty men of Moab , trembling shall take hold upon them  ; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away .

translation.kha: Bud ïa ki rukom lai bad ki law kiba nga ai ha phi ; da kaba leh kumjuh , phin ïoh im . Ngi long U Trai .
translation.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes , and my judgments : which if a man do , he shall live in them : I am the  Lord .
And Adonijah slew sheep and oxen and fat cattle by the stone of Zoheleth , which is by En–rogel , and called all his brethren the king s sons , and all the men of Judah the king s servants :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , U Adonijah u ai ka jingkñia da ki langbrot , ki masi dab , bad ki khun masi ba la pynsngaid ha u Mawsiang Bseiñ , hajan ka umpohliew Enrogel . U la khot sngewbha ïa kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong U Syiem Dabid bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem kiba dei na Judah ban wan sha kane ka jingkhawai ai jingkñia ,

Shahshkor ! Ha kylleng ka ri nga ïohsngew ba ki briew lad nga ki kyang jam , Hato U Trai um don shuh ha Seïon ? Hato u syiem ka Seïon um don shuh hangta ? U Trai , u skhem jong ki , u jubab , Balei phi la pynbitar ïa nga da kaba mane ïa ki bleithaw jong phi mala da Kaba nguh dem ïa ki blei nongwei bymmyntoi ?
translation.en: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country : Is not the  Lord  in Zion ? is not her king in her ? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images , and with strange vanities ?

translation.kha: Kynsan kynsan ka erïong kaba jur ka la beh halor ka duriaw , bad ka lieng ka la ni ha ka jingma ngab sa ngap . Hynrei u Jisu u la ïohkhiah .
translation.en: And , behold , there arose a great tempest in the sea , insomuch that the ship was covered with the waves : but he was asleep .
And she hasted , and emptied her pitcher into the trough , and ran again unto the well to draw water , and drew for all his camels .
translation.kha: Ka pynstet ban phylliew ïa ka um na u khiew jong ka ha ka shyngoid ai um ïa ki jingri bad ka mareh sha kata ka pukri ban leit tong um shuh , haduh ba kan da dep ban ai um ïa ki ut jong u baroh .
Ko khun jong nga , don sa kawei pat kaba phi hap ban ap khum lyntang . Ym don jingidiaw ïa ka jingthoh kot bad ka jingpule bniah shaba palat kun pynngeit ïa Phi .
translation.en: And further , by these , my son , be admonished : of making many books there is no end  ; and much study is a weariness of the flesh .
By the breath of God frost is given : and the breadth of the waters is straitened .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynhiar mynsiem jong U Blei ka pyndait thah ïa ki um , bad ka pynkylla thah ïa ki .

translation.en: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction , and would root out all mine increase .
translation.kha: Kan long kum ka jingpynjot , ka ding bashyrkhei , ka ban bam duh ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga don .
Me dei ïa-ban jubab , ‘ Ki Dei ki jong u Jakob u Sikhri jongu phi . U Phah ïa ki kum ka jingai sngewma sha u kynrad jong u , u Iso . U Jakob hi u hadien jong ngi .’
translation.en: Then thou shalt say , They be thy servant Jacob s  ; it is a present sent unto my lord Esau : and , behold , also he is behind us .

Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen , and against all Edom , which have appointed my land into their possession with the joy of all their heart , with despiteful minds , to cast it out for a prey .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren ha ka jingbitar lep jong nga pyrshah ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong bad khamtam pyrshah ïa ka Edom . Da kaba shadkmen bad da kaba leh ibeiñ , ki kurup ïa ka ri jong nga bad shim kynti ïa ki jaka phlang jong ka .

translation.en: Then the  Lord  will make thy plagues wonderful , and the plagues of thy seed , even great plagues , and of long continuance , and sore sicknesses , and of long continuance .
translation.kha: un phah ha phi bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ïa ki jingpang bym lah pynkoit bad ïa ki jingïapthem kiba sngewtriem bad kiba neh slem .

translation.en: And he judged Israel twenty and three years , and died , and was buried in Shamir .
translation.kha: U la long u nongïalam jong ki Israel haduh arphew lai snem . Nangta u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Shamir .
U Amram u shongkurim ïa ka Jokhebed , ka para jong u kpa jong u , bad ka la khiah ïa u Aaron bad u Moses . U Elmadam u la im shuh shispah laiphew hynñiew snem ka rta .
translation.en: And Amram took him Jochebed his father s sister to wife  ; and she bare him Aaron and Moses : and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years .

translation.kha: Wat ha shuwa ba kata ka por kan wanpaw , ïa ki ri jong kito ki ar nud ki syep kiba la pynshyrkhei ïa phi yn iehnoh .
translation.en: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil , and choose the good , the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa u Jehoshaphat namar u la bud ïa ka nuksa ba-mynshuwa jong ka jingim u kpa jong u bad um shym mane ïa u Baal .
translation.en: And the  Lord  was with Jehoshaphat , because he walked in the first ways of his father David , and sought not unto Baalim  ;

translation.kha: dih ban don uei u shylluit syntiew hapoh , ha trai jong ki lai jur ki tnen .
translation.en: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick .

translation.kha: Bad u la ai ha U Khun ïa ka hok ban bishar , namar u long U Khun U Briew .
translation.en: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also , because he is the Son of man .
But one in a certain place testified , saying , What is man , that thou art mindful of him ? or the son of man , that thou visitest him ?
translation.kha: Pynban , kumba la ong ha katto katne ki jaka ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid :  U briew u long aïu , A Blei , ba men pyrkhat ïa u , tang uba kynja briew , ba men suidñiew ïa u ?
Baroh ki long ki jong me . Uwei pa uwei na ka ïing jong me uba khum katto kum ka jinglum u lah ban bam-im ïa ki .
translation.en: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land , which they shall bring unto the  Lord  , shall be thine  ; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it .

translation.kha: Te u Shemeber u patsha ka Arsa u iehnoh dara leit pha sha Ninebeh .
translation.en: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed , and went and returned , and dwelt at Nineveh .
And the armed men went before the priests that blew with the trumpets , and the rearward came after the ark , the priests going on , and blowing with the trumpets .
translation.kha: Kumta , kumba u Joshua u la hukum , ka kynhun shipai ka la ïaid ha shuwa ki lyngdoh kiba put ïa ki turoi ; hadien jong kine bud sa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  , kiba la bud pat da ka kynhun shipai na shadien . Ha ki por baroh la put ïa ki turoi .
Namar ki Messaïah balamler sad ki nongïathuhlypa bakhlem Kin miaw . Kin leh ïa ki kambah Bad ki jingphylla khnang ban shukor wat ïa ki briew ba la jingduh jong U Blei , lada long kaba lah .
translation.en: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise , and shall shew signs and wonders , to seduce , if it were possible , even the elect .

translation.kha: Hynrei mar syn beh noh ïa u ksuid , u briew u la sdang ngab kren , bad uwei aiwai baroh u la lyngngoh , Ngim patan ju ïohi mynno mynno ruh kum khnai ha Israel ! ki la ong .
translation.en: And when the devil was cast out , the dumb spake : and the multitudes marvelled , saying , It was never so seen in Israel .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la kylli ïa u , Kaei ka jingmut jong ki ar tylli ki dieng Olib ha kawei kawei ka liang jong u diengpynïeng sharak ?
translation.en: Then answered I , and said unto him , What are these two olive trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof ?
And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king , she fell on her face to the ground , and did obeisance , and said , Help , O king .
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka leit sha u syiem , ka dem ngon haduh khyndew ha ka jingñiewburom bad ka ong ,  Ïarap ïa nga , ko Syiem Kynrad !

translation.en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth : and the recompence of a man s hands shall be rendered unto him .
translation.kha: Ka bainong jong phi ka shong ha kaei kaba phi ong bad kaei kaba phi leh ; phin ïoh ïa kaei kaba phi dei hok .

Bad katto katno ki symbai ki la hap ha ka khyndew babha ; ki jingthung ki la san bad ki la pynmih syep , da ki spah symboh iwei uwei . bad U Jisu u la pynkut , Shahshkor , te , lada phi Don ki shrak !
translation.en: And other fell on good ground , and sprang up , and bare fruit an hundredfold .  And when he had said these things , he cried ,  He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
Suffer me that I may speak  ; and after that I have spoken , mock on .
translation.kha: Ai ïa nga ka lad ba ngan kren bad nangta , haba nga la dep kren , krenbeiñ lada phi kwah .
U Trai u ong , Neng pynlong ïa ka Jerusalem ka thup ki jingproh , ka jaka ha kaba ki myrsiang ki shong ; ki nongbeh ka Judia kin kylla ri shyiap , ka khang ha kob ym don Mano mano bashong ba sah .
translation.en: And I will make Jerusalem heaps , and a den of dragons  ; and I will make the cities of Judah desolate , without an inhabitant .

translation.kha: Kan leit hangta ha ka jer janmiet , bad ha ka step bapaw yn ïalam ïa ka sha kawei pat ka ïing ki kynthei bad yn buh hapoh ka jingpeit jong u ïashah , u ïunukh uba khmih ïa ka ïing ki tnga kliar u syiem . Na ym leit shuh sha u syiem lymda u sngewkyndit eh ïa ka ba un phah Khot ïa ka da ka kthang .
translation.en: In the evening she went , and on the morrow she returned into the second house of the women , to the custody of Shaashgaz , the king s chamberlain , which kept the concubines : she came in unto the king no more , except the king delighted in her , and that she were called by name .

translation.kha: bad lade ka ïapoi shongkurim bad uwei pat u briew ,
translation.en: And when she is departed out of his house , she may go and be another man s wife .
For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness , and in the bond of iniquity .
translation.kha: Naba nga ïohi ba me dap da ka jingbishni bajur bad me long u koidi jong ka pop .
U Rehoboam u longing sha Shekhem , ha kob baroh ki briew na shaphang Shaei ka Israel ki la ïalumlang ban thung syiem ïa u .
translation.en: And Rehoboam went to Shechem : for to Shechem were all Israel come to make him king .

translation.kha: Haba u Abilene u la wan poi ha Hebron , u Joab u ïalam ïa u khem sharud ha ka khyrdop , kumba u kwah ban ïakren jar jar bad u , bun hangta u la dung ïa u na ka kpoh . Badno kumta la pynïap ïa u Abner namar ba u la pynkup ïa u Asahel , u para u Jehoba .
translation.en: And when Abner was returned to Hebron , Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly , and smote him there under the fifth rib , that he died , for the blood of Asahel his brother .

translation.kha: La don hynñiew tyrnem ki mawkyrdon ban kyiuh shad ka , sad ka kamram ryndang jong ka , ka la don ha kaba khun marpyrshah ïa ka phyllaw . La ni ki dieng Tlai ba la oh-shrong ha ki halor ki kynruh bashapoh kiba pait khmat sha ka lynter ïaid .
translation.en: And there were seven steps to go up to it , and the arches thereof were before them : and it had palm trees , one on this side , and another on that side , upon the posts thereof .

translation.kha: Kita shi para ki la pynkit ïa u kew ba ki la thied ha ki kada jong ki , bad ki ïamihnoh nangta .
translation.en: And they laded their asses with the corn , and departed thence .
For thy word s sake , and according to thine own heart , hast thou done all these great things , to make thy servant know them .
translation.kha: Ka la long ka mon jong me bad ka jingthmu jong me , ban leh ïa kane ; me la leh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba khraw khnang ban hikai ïa nga .
Ho-oid , ka por kan wan haba ki nongap kin khat ha ki lat ka Ephraim , ‘ Ïa ngin ïaleit haduh Seïon , sha U Trai U Blei jong ine .’
translation.en: For there shall be a day , that the watchmen upon the mount Ephraim shall cry , Arise ye , and let us go up to Zion unto the  Lord  our God .

translation.kha: Hynrei phi don ka dohthang kaba eh bad kob probins , sad kumta pa’ pynbang ka jingpynshitom ïa lade hi wat kham khraw ha ka Sngi ha kaba ïa ka jingbitar U Blei bad ki jingbishar bakha yn pynsep .
translation.en: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God ;

Then thou shalt say before the  Lord  thy God , I have brought away the hallowed things out of mine house , and also have given them unto the Levite , and unto the stranger , to the fatherless , and to the widow , according to all thy commandments which thou hast commanded me : I have not transgressed thy commandments , neither have I forgotten them :
translation.kha: phin ong ha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , ‘ Ngam shym pynsah ei ei shuh ha ïing na kata kaba nga la lum kyrpang ; nga la ai ïa ka ha ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bad ki riewkynthei , kumba me la hukum ïa nga . Ngam shym la leh palat lane leh klet ïa ki hukum jong me kiba ïadei bad kawei na ki shiphew .
To shahjop ïa ka jingmudui U Tharai pyrshah ïa ki Jesreel . To khie , A Trai , bad wan ïa ka jingmudui jongki me ; to ai ba ki lumbah bad ki lumrit kin ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba me ong .
translation.en: Hear ye now what the  Lord  saith  ; Arise , contend thou before the mountains , and let the hills hear thy voice .

translation.kha: Da kumno te ngin lehse , salia ngi leh bymsuidñiew ïa ka jingpyndonkam kaba khrup katta! long ? U Trai hi u la pynbna nyngkong ïa kane ka jingpynim , bad kita kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki pynshisha ha ngi ba ka longïing kaba shisha .
translation.en: How shall we escape , if we neglect so great salvation  ; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord , and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him  ;

translation.kha: Haba la tad ktien ha ki Asher ba ki ba-shiphew Ijipt , ba la ïalam da u syep Tirhakah jongngi ka Sudan , u daiñ waiñ ïa-ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .
translation.en: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia , He is come forth to make war with thee . And when he heard it , he sent messengers to Hezekiah , saying ,

translation.kha: Ngi ïohpdiang na u ïa kano kano kaba ngi pan , namar ba ngi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u badno ngi leh ïa kaei Kaba pynsngewbha ïa u .
translation.en: And whatsoever we ask , we receive of him , because we keep his commandments , and do those things that are pleasing in his sight .
And the  Lord  repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la kylla noh ïa la ka jingmut bad um shym wallam ha ki briew jong u ïa ka jingpynjot kaba u la byrngem .

Nangta u Shem bad u Japheth ki la shim khawai ka jaiñkup bad ki tawah ïa ka haduh jyllang ki ha la ka tyndong . Ki ïawad dadien shabi ka ïingjaiñ bad ki tap ïa la u kpa , ki da pah daym khnang ba kin ym ïoh ïa u , ba u lyngkhuit .
translation.en: And Shem and Japheth took a garment , and laid it upon both their shoulders , and went backward , and covered the nakedness of their father  ; and their faces were backward , and they saw not their father s nakedness .

translation.kha: Ha kaei ka ïing , nga don kajuh ka ieit kumba u don , bad um shym la tyngkai ei ei shiah na nga lait noh tang ïa phi . Kumno keiñ nga la ban leh kat ïa kata ka kam runar , bad ban ai pop pyrshah ïa U blang ?
translation.en: There is none greater in this house than I  ; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee , because thou art his wife : how then can I do this great wickedness , and sin against God ?
And the  Lord  said unto David my father , Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name , thou didst well that it was in thine heart .
translation.kha: hynrei U  Trai  u la ong ha u , ‘ Me la leh ïa kaba dei ba me kwah ban tei ïa ka Templ ïa nga ,
Ki ni kumba ki jingmong jong ki briew lad na ki long tieng ki jingtrud . ‘ Baroh ka bit ka biang ,’ ki ong , haba baroh kam bit kam baklang .
translation.en: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly , saying , Peace , peace  ; when there is no peace .

translation.kha: Nangta u Josaïah u peit barben sawdong , bad ïohi katto katto ki jingtep Haneng halor lum ; u sei shabar ïa ki shyieng na ki bad u thang ha ka duwan . Ha khie ka rukom u ñiewsang ïa ka jingnguh , u leh ïa kaei Kaba u nongïathuhlypa u la ïathuh lypa mynshuwa eh ha ka por ka jingleh katba u syiem Jeroboam u dang ïeng hajan ka duwan . U syiem Josaïah u peit sawdong bad ïohi ïa ka jingpait jyllang u nongïathuhlypa uba la ïathuh ïa kane .
translation.en: And as Josiah turned himself , he spied the sepulchres that were there in the mount , and sent , and took the bones out of the sepulchres , and burned them upon the altar , and polluted it , according to the word of the  Lord  which the man of God proclaimed , who proclaimed these words .
And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , and walked in the ways of David his father , and declined neither to the right hand , nor to the left .
translation.kha: U la leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  ; u bud ïa ka nuksa u syiem Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u , da kaba bud thik ïa ki hukum U Blei baroh .

translation.en: He hath blinded their eyes , and hardened their heart  ; that they should not see with their eyes , nor understand with their heart , and be converted , and I should heal them .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynmatlah ïa ki khmat jong ki bad u la khang khyrdep ïa ki jingmut jong ki , ba ki khmat jong ki kin ym ïohi , bad ba ki jingmut jong ki kin ym shemphang , bad kin ym phai sha nga , ong U Blei , ïa nga ba ngan pynkhiah ïa ki .

translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you .
translation.kha: Ka jingaiei U Trai Jisu to kan long lem bad phi .

Hynrei U Trai u la jubab , Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïathuh ïa ki jinglamler ha ka kyrteng jrong ang ; ngam Shimham phiah ïa ki , lymne ngam shym la ai kino kino ki hukum lane kren shikyntien ha ki . Ki jingïohipaw ibha ki ïakren kim shem ïan na nga ; ki jingïathuh lypa ki long kiei kiei ki bymdondor kiba ki la mutdur .
translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , The prophets prophesy lies in my name : I sent them not , neither have I commanded them , neither spake unto them : they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination , and a thing of nought , and the deceit of their heart .

translation.kha: Kumta u syiem ka Israel u la ramhah ïa ki briew kiba shong hangta , bad ki la long phikir ïa lade . Kane ka jia bun bunsien .
translation.en: And the king of Israel sent to the place which the man of God told him and warned him of , and saved himself there , not once nor twice .
Whereunto I am appointed a preacher , and an apostle , and a teacher of the Gentiles .
translation.kha: U Blei u la thung ïa nga kum u apostol bad u nonghikai ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha , bad dei na kane ka daw ba nga shahshitom ïa kine kiei kiei .

translation.en: Again in the ninth year , in the tenth month , in the tenth day of the month , the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba shiphew ha ka snem kaba khyndai jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .
ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ki nong Kiriath Jearim pun ong , Ki Philistia ki la pynphai ïa ka Synñia Ka Jutang U Trai . Ale wan shim noh ïa ka .
translation.en: And they sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kirjath–jearim , saying , The Philistines have brought again the ark of the  Lord   ; come ye down , and fetch it up to you .

translation.kha: Ïa ithuh u briew la snar syiem nabar u la wan phai pat . Mar kumta hi , u la hukum ïa ki Shakri pun wan miaw ha lamkhmat jong u , khnai ban Shem haduh katno ki la kamai .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when he was returned , having received the kingdom , then he commanded these servants to be called unto him , to whom he had given the money , that he might know how much every man had gained by trading .

translation.kha: Mynta ka sngap ka dei ka sngur kaba arphew saw jong u bnai uba khyndai , ka sneng ha kaba la pyndep ïa ka nongrim jong ka Templ . Ha khmih kaei ka ban sa jia naduh mynta .
translation.en: Consider now from this day and upward , from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month , even from the day that the foundation of the  Lord s  temple was laid , consider it .

translation.kha: Mynba pat , sngewlah leh ïa kambah nga ong . Shah ngan ïawer bam ïa phi! . Phi dei ban smam ba phin dup ïohbor ynda phi leit sha la ka jingleit .
translation.en: Now therefore , I pray thee , hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid , and let me set a morsel of bread before thee  ; and eat , that thou mayest have strength , when thou goest on thy way .
Behold my hands and my feet , that it is I myself : handle me , and see  ; for a spirit hath not flesh and bones , as ye see me have .
translation.kha: Khmih ïa ki kti jong nga bad ki kjat jong nga , bad peit ba dei ma nga hi . Tba ïa nga , bad phin tip , naba ka rngai kam don ka doh bad ki shyieng , kumba phi ïohi ba nga don .
u la kynthih , u la ïeng ha la ki kjat , malu u la shang ban ïaid kylleng sawdong . Nangta u la leit shapoh ka baphylla lym bad ki , u da ïaid bad kynthih bad ïaroh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And he leaping up stood , and walked , and entered with them into the temple , walking , and leaping , and praising God .

translation.kha: Na u Baal , u nongsah byndi na ka bynta U Khrist Jisu , bad na u Timothi u para jong ngi — Ha u Philemon , u paralok jong ngi bad u para ïa-bta nur ,
translation.en: Paul , a prisoner of Jesus Christ , and Timothy our brother , unto Philemon our dearly beloved , and fellowlabourer ,

translation.kha: Ktien baroh ki long ki khun ki ksiew jong u Asher . Ki dei ki khlieh jong ki longïing , ki riewïaleh bapar , ki nongïalam kiba pawkhmat . Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Asher ki kynthih ïa ki arphew hynriew hajar ngut ki pynrangbah kiba bit na ka bynta ka kdew shipai .
translation.en: All these were the children of Asher , heads of their father s house , choice and mighty men of valour , chief of the princes . And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa pha ka nongshna ba-itriem , bad kata kan long kambah kut jong pha . Ki briew ki lah ban wad ïa pha , Hynrei kin ym tap ïa pha . U Trai’ Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: I will make thee a terror , and thou shalt be no more : though thou be sought for , yet shalt thou never be found again , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ïa khnai dei ban leh khnang ba ki lah ïa-ban ai ki jingkha ba pdiang hun ha U Blei jongki ka Bneng bad duwai ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u shalor jong nga bad ki khun shynrang jong nga .
translation.en: That they may offer sacrifices of sweet savours unto the God of heaven , and pray for the life of the king , and of his sons .

translation.kha: Ka don ka jingmaïan kaba la pynpaw ha ka Jingthoh bakhatduh , kaba nga sngewthuh ka thew ïa U Khrist bad ïa ka balang .
translation.en: This is a great mystery : but I speak concerning Christ and the church .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel kin ym ïoh shonshab ha ka ri U Trai ; hynrei kin hap leit phai sha Ijipt , bad ki hap ban Bam ka jingbam ba la kheiñ sang ha Assyria .
translation.en: They shall not dwell in the  Lord s  land  ; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt , and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria .

translation.kha: Phin ïoh ïa ka jingïaishah bad jingñiewkor na khiew lada phoi trei na ka bynta kabu bha ; lada Phin 3 na ka bynta kaba sniew , phi leh ïa Kaba bakla .
translation.en: Do they not err that devise evil ? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good .

translation.kha: Lada pa’ mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei , ka jingbitar U Trai kan wei bad thang ïa phi kum ka ding bad lai pynjot thiaw ïa phi , namar U Trai U Blei jong phi , uba don ryngkat bad phi , um lah shah ba phin shakri ïa kiwei pat ki blei .
translation.en: ( For the  Lord  thy God is a jealous God among you ) lest the anger of the  Lord  thy God be kindled against thee , and destroy thee from off the face of the earth .

And he said unto them ,  These are the words which I spake unto you , while I was yet with you , that all things must be fulfilled , which were written in the law of Moses , and in the prophets , and in the psalms , concerning me .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha ki ,  Kine ki long kita kiei kiei kiba nga la ïathuh ha phi mynba nga dang don lem bad phi : Kaei kaei baroh kaba la thoh shaphang jong nga ha ka Hukum u Moses , ha ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ha Ki Salm ka dei ban urlong shisha .

“Wat nym kjat ïa la ki paralok lane ïa ki paralok u kpa jong phi . Lada phi ne ha ka jingjynjar , wat jong ïa u hynmen ne para jong phi ban ïar ; u paramarjan uba hajan u kah ban ïarap ïa phin kham bha ban ïa u hynmen ne para uba sha jngai .
translation.en: Thine own friend , and thy father s friend , forsake not  ; neither go into thy brother s house in the day of thy calamity : for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off .

translation.kha: Kane bhor ka la jia ïa u syiem Nebaïoth .
translation.en: All this came upon the king Nebuchadnezzar .

And it shall come to pass , that when they make a long blast with the ram s horn , and when ye hear the sound of the trumpet , all the people shall shout with a great shout  ; and the wall of the city shall fall down flat , and the people shall ascend up every man straight before him .
translation.kha: Nangta ki dei ban pynsawa ïa kawei ka sur kaba jlan . Tang mar shu ïohsngew ïa kata , ki briew baroh ki dei ban risa jam , bad ki kynroh jong ka nongbah kin khyllem . Nangta ka kynhun shipai baroh kawei kan leit beit beit shapoh ka nongbah .
Ki briew kyang shong kin sah ha Judas bad ha baroh ki shnong jong ka , bad kin don ki nongrep , bad ki nongap nongaplangbrot ryngkat bad ki kynhun langbrot jong ki .
translation.en: And there shall dwell in Judah itself , and in all the cities thereof together , husbandmen , and they that go forth with flocks .
The  Lord  made not this covenant with our fathers , but with us , even us , who are all of us here alive this day .
translation.kha: ym tang bad ki kpa jong ngi , hynrei bad ngi baroh ruh kiba dang im haduh mynta ka sngi .
Haba u Abram u la ïan phai na ka jingjop ïa u Khedorlaomer bad ïa kita kiwei pat ki syiemsad , u syiem jong ka Sodom u leit ban ïashem ïa u ha ka them Shabeh ( ïa kiba la khot ruh ka Toi u Syiem ) .
translation.en: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer , and of the kings that were with him , at the valley of Shaveh , which is the king s dale .

translation.kha: Wallam ïa ka jingrang ryngkhiang ha ka ri jong ka bad pynrngad lut ïa ki wah jong ka . Ka Babilonia ka long ka ri jong ki bleithaw ba-ishyrkhei , kiba la pynkylla bieit ïa ki briew .
translation.en: A drought is upon her waters  ; and they shall be dried up : for it is the land of graven images , and they are mad upon their idols .

translation.kha: Doeg u la Ong ïa ki , To synrum bad to duwai ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynshoi . Ka mynhyndai ka kwah hynrei ka dohkha ka tlot .
translation.en: Watch ye and pray , lest ye enter into temptation . The spirit truly is ready , but the flesh is weak .

translation.kha: Ka Balang kaba ha Babilon , ïa kaba la jied duh da U Blei , ka phah ïa ki jingai khublei shwa phi , bad kumjuh ruh u Markos u khup jong por .
translation.en: The church that is at Babylon , elected together with you , saluteth you  ; and so doth Mark my son .
And Joshua made them that day hewers of wood and drawers of water for the congregation , and for the altar of the  Lord  , even unto this day , in the place which he should choose .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha kajuh ka por u la pynlong mraw ïa ki ban thoh dieng bad kit um ïa ki paid Israel bad ïa ka duwan U  Trai . Haduh kane ka sngi ki la ïai bteng ïa kane ka kam ha ka jaka kaba u Trai u la jied ban mane ïa u .
U bam ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ainguh ha ki jaka mane ba la tam malade u khroh pynbieit ïa ki tnaw jyllang kiwei pat ki rangbah .
translation.en: And that doeth not any of those duties , but even hath eaten upon the mountains , and defiled his neighbour s wife ,
( 2 Corinthians 1 :24 ) Just as a shepherd diligently cares for each one of his sheep , the elders try to get to know every member of the congregation individually . —Proverbs 27 :23 .
