translation.kha: ( 2 Korinth 1 :24 ) Kumba u nongap langbrot u shim khia ban sumar ïa la ki langbrot , ki rangbah balang ruh ki pyrshang ban tip ïa iwei pa iwei i dkhot ka balang . —Proberb 27 :23 .

translation.en: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved , what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness ,
translation.kha: Namar ba ïa kine kiei kiei baroh yn pynjot ha kane ka rukom , ki briew kiba kumno phi dei ban long ?

translation.en: Tarshish was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of all kind of riches  ; with silver , iron , tin , and lead , they traded in thy fairs .
translation.kha: Pha ïakhaïi pateng ha Spain bad pha la shim ïa ka rupa , ka nar , ka tin , bad ka sisa da kaba siewdor na ka bynta ki tiar ba-dap kyrhai jong pha .
Ha ka sngi kaba ar , kñia kharai tyllai ki mar lyngngai , ar tylli ki langbrot shaneng , pynlang khatsaw tylli ki Langbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym to kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks , two rams , fourteen lambs of the first year without spot :

translation.kha: U Solomon u pah ïa kane ka khubor shai u Harim :
translation.en: And Solomon sent to Hiram , saying ,
And the people shall be as the burnings of lime : as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire .
translation.kha: Phin sa lwet kum ki maw ba la thang ban pynlong mawshun , kum ki shiah ba la thang haduh ba ki la kylla dpei .

translation.en: But of him are ye in Christ Jesus , who of God is made unto us wisdom , and righteousness , and sanctification , and redemption :
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la wallam ïa phi ha U Khrist Jisu , bad U Blei u la pynlong ïa U Khrist ban long ka jingstad jong ngi . Da u , la pynïasuk ïa ngi bad U Blei ; ngi long ki briew bakhuid jong U Blei bad la pyllaitluid ïa ngi .

translation.en: Behold , now I have opened my mouth , my tongue hath spoken in my mouth .
translation.kha: Nga kloi ban ong ïa kaba don ha ka jingmut jong nga .

Hynñiew ka jubab jong u ka la longkmie : Ka jinghikai jongki nga ka long baroh kaba me donkam , naba ka bor jong nga ka khraw tam dat haba me tlot . Nga kmen eh , namarkata , ban sngewbang ha ki jingtlot jrong at , khnang ban mad ïa ka jingïada ka hab jong U Khrist halor jongngi nga .
translation.en: And he said unto me ,  My grace is sufficient for thee : for my strength is made perfect in weakness .  Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities , that the power of Christ may rest upon me .

translation.kha: Wat ka syrngiew jong u kan jah noh , bad un ym lait na ka jingdum . Un hir kum u dieng ïa kiba ki tat la thang da ka ding , uba ki shylluit la rong noh da ka lyer .
translation.en: He shall not depart out of darkness  ; the flame shall dry up his branches , and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away .

translation.kha: Wat ki lyngdoh kiba wan sha jat jong nga ki dei don pynkdor ïa lade , lymda kumta ngan pynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: And let the priests also , which come near to the  Lord  , sanctify themselves , lest the  Lord  break forth upon them .
And passed along toward the side over against Arabah northward , and went down unto Arabah :
translation.kha: bad u ïaid lyngba na shatei jong ka sharing lum na kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Jordan . Nangta u hiar arsut sha ka them ,
U Saul u la khie joit na madan bad u la peit , hynrei um lah ban ïohi ei ei . Kumta ki la shym ïa u na ka kti dara ki la ïalam ïa u sha Damaskos .
translation.en: And Saul arose from the earth  ; and when his eyes were opened , he saw no man : but they led him by the hand , and brought him into Damascus .

translation.kha: Ki khrai ïa ka khlaw u Saul , ki loit noh ïa ki atiar jong u , bad ki phah ïa ki nonglamktien kylleng ka ri Philistia ban pynbna ïa kata ka khubor baïap sha ki blei jong ki bad ha ki briew jong ki .
translation.en: And they cut off his head , and stripped off his armour , and sent into the land of the Philistines round about , to publish it in the house of their idols , and among the people .
And Saul also went home to Gibeah  ; and there went with him a band of men , whose hearts God had touched .
translation.kha: U Saul ruh u leit phai sha la ïing ha Gibeah . Katto katne ki rangbah kiba khlaiñ ryngkat bad ki nongïapom kiba U Blei u la ktah ïa ki dohnud jong ki , ki la leit lang bad u .
U shajan u ai ïa ka hukum syiem ha u Malkhaïah bad u khyllah u ïathuh ïa u ba u la shem ïa ka kiba ka hukum ha ka baphylla . U Hilkaïah u la ai ha u ïa ka Kitab , bad u Shan u pule ïa ka .
translation.en: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe , I have found the book of the law in the house of the  Lord . And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan , and he read it .

translation.kha: Ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba U Trai u haw ban leh , ki Kam baphylla jong u ha ki duriaw-rit .
translation.en: These see the works of the  Lord  , and his wonders in the deep .

translation.kha: U nonghiarthma uba ïoh ka jingpyniwbih u de ban ong ïa ka ba ka long tang ka jingphohsniew , hynrei u nongïathuhlypa uba la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor jongngi nga u dei ban pynbynta hok ïa sakma ka khubor . Kaei ka jingbha u jyntang ba-bang ïasngew bad u kew ?
translation.en: The prophet that hath a dream , let him tell a dream  ; and he that hath my word , let him speak my word faithfully . What is the chaff to the wheat ? saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai u khot , ïa u Samuel . U ruh u jubor , Oi , Kynrad !
translation.en: That the  Lord  called Samuel : and he answered , Here am I .

translation.kha: Ka la da shngain synñia hab ka jingpyrta ka la da jam , ‘ U nongleitkurim u la don shnat ! To wan bad ïashem ïa u !’
translation.en: And at midnight there was a cry made , Behold , the bridegroom cometh  ; go ye out to meet him .

Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved saith unto Peter , It is the Lord . Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord , he girt his fisher s coat unto him , ( for he was naked , ) and did cast himself into the sea .
translation.kha: U synran ïa uba U Jisu u ieit u la ong ha u Petros ,  U dei U Trai !  Haba u Petros u la ïohsngew ba dei U Trai , u tap da ka jaiñ ïa la ka met ( naba u la loit noh ïa la ki jaiñphong ) bad u la ryngkoh shapoh um .

Shim ïa ka kot kli bad thoh ha ka ïa baroh kaba nga la ong ha me shaphang ka Israel bad ka —Judah dara baroh ki jaitbynriew . Thoh lut ïa baroh kaba nga la ong ha me naduh ka por ba nga la kren nyngkong ha me , mynba u Jehoash u longïing syiem , haduh mynta .
translation.en: Take thee a roll of a book , and write therein all the words that I have spoken unto thee against Israel , and against Judah , and against all the nations , from the day I spake unto thee , from the days of Josiah , even unto this day .

translation.kha: Ïa nga shimet , U Trai um shah da lei lei ba ngan bor thup pyrshah ïa u da kaba sangeh nong ban duwai na ka bynta jongno phoi . Pynban ngan hikai ïa phi ïa kaei kaba bhah bad kaba dei ïa phi ban leh .
translation.en: Moreover as for me , God forbid that I should sin against the  Lord  in ceasing to pray for you : but I will teach you the good and the right way :

When a prophet speaketh in the name of the  Lord  , if the thing follow not , nor come to pass , that is the thing which the  Lord  hath not spoken , but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously : thou shalt not be afraid of him .
translation.kha: Lada u nongïathuhlypa u kren ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  bad kata kaba u kren kam shym urlong , kata kam dei ka khubor U  Trai . Uta u nongïathuhlypa u la kren na lade hi , bad phim dei ban sheptieng ïa u .
U Blei u trei ha ka kam shaphang shai bun shathie , hynrei pynbun Ngam shym ïohi ïa u .
translation.en: On the left hand , where he doth work , but I cannot behold him : he hideth himself on the right hand , that I cannot see him :
But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give  ; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam don satia ka hok ban jied mano u ban shong sha kamon jong nga bad sha kadiang jong nga . Dei U Blei u ban ai ïa kine ki jaka ha kito ïa kiba u la pynkhreh ïa ki .
U Blei u la kyntiew ïa u sha ka Hul kamon jong u kum u Nongrim nabar u Nongpynim , banbeiñ ai ha ki paid Israel ka kabu ban kylla-kaba-mut bad ban ïohi ka jingmap ïa ki pop jong ki .
translation.en: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour , for to give repentance to Israel , and forgiveness of sins .

translation.kha: bad ha ki ryndang-kti jong ki . Un sping nong ïa ka jaiñtapkhmat jongngi ki
translation.en: The chains , and the bracelets , and the mufflers ,
His breasts are full of milk , and his bones are moistened with marrow .
translation.kha: Katto katne ki briew ki koit ki khiah haduh ka sngi ka jingïap ; ki ïap suk bad khlem shitom , ki met jong ki kiba la ïoh jingbsa bha .
Phi eh umdih ban print katto katne sla ban sam ïa ki briew bakha kwah ban tip ha ka ktien jong ki !
translation.en: You can even print out a few pages to share with an interested person in his own language !

translation.kha: Ka jingdum kan tap ïa ka Tahpanhes haba ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong ka Ijipt bad ngan pynkit ïa ka jingkhlaiñ kaba ki sngewsarong palat . U lyoh un kah ïa ka Ijipt , sad ki briew’ jongu ki nongbah Jong ka baroh kin shah ïalam kum ki koidi .
translation.en: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened , when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt : and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her : as for her , a cloud shall cover her , and her daughters shall go into captivity .

translation.kha: Nangta katto katne ki Pharisi bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la wan sha U Jisu na Israel bad ki la kylli ïa u ,
translation.en: Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees , which were of Jerusalem , saying ,

translation.kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki reng kiba me la ïohi ki long ki shiphew ngut ki syiem ki bym pat shym la dang ban synshar , Hynrei ki ban sa ïoh ka iktiar ban synshar kumta ki syiem tang Shi kynta sad u mradkhlaw .
translation.en: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings , which have received no kingdom as yet  ; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast .

translation.kha: Ko ki parabangeit jong nga , katno nga kwah da ka dohnud jong nga baroh ba ki bynriew jong nga hi kin hir ïa kiba la pynim ! Kat nga duwai ïa U Blei’ na ka bynta jong ki !
translation.en: Brethren , my heart s desire and prayer to God for Israel is , that they might be saved .

translation.kha: Kim tip ïa ka jingmut jngai ka jingsheptieng , bad ym don waitlam kaba lah ban pynphai daiñ ïa ki .
translation.en: He mocketh at fear , and is not affrighted  ; neither turneth he back from the sword .

translation.kha: Khatduh ha u phar ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga la ong ha me .
translation.en: That the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying , I am the  Lord  : speak thou unto Pharaoh king of Egypt all that I say unto thee .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew kum kita ki ktien mynshuwa ; ka jingpynksan kaba phi ai ka longïing tang ka jingpynshitom .
translation.en: I have heard many such things : miserable comforters are ye all .

translation.kha: Nalor da u , U Blei u la thaw ïa kiew kiei baroh ha bneng bad ha khyndew , kiei kiei kiba lah ban ïoh sad kiei kiei ki bym lah ban Ïohi , kynjoh ïa ki bor ba kynja mynsiem , ki kynrad , ki nongsynshar , bad ki bor synshar . U Blei u la thaw ïa ka jingpynlong baroh kaei da u na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: For by him were all things created , that are in heaven , and that are in earth , visible and invisible , whether they be thrones , or dominions , or principalities , or powers : all things were created by him , and for him :

translation.kha: Katba u dang bor kumta , Kita ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im bad ki arphew saw ngat ki nongsharai balang ki la dem khrup ha khmat U Khunlangbrot . Uwei pa utai u la don ka duitara badno ki pliang ksiar ba la pyndap da ka jingiw , kiba long ki jingïarwai jong ki briew jong U Blei .
translation.en: And when he had taken the book , the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb , having every one of them harps , and golden vials full of odours , which are the prayers of saints .

translation.kha: Ki long ka jingim bad ka jingkoit jingkhiah ïa uno uno uba sngewthuh ïa ki .
translation.en: For they are life unto those that find them , and health to all their flesh .

translation.kha: Te ïathuh ïa me me dei uei , ki la ong . Ngi hap ban rah ïa ka jubab shiah kito kiba la phah ïa ngi . Kumno me ong shaphang ïa lade! ?
translation.en: Then said they unto him , Who art thou ? that we may give an answer to them that sent us . What sayest thou of thyself ?
Some fell upon stony places , where they had not much earth : and forthwith they sprung up , because they had no deepness of earth :
translation.kha: Khyndiat pat u la hap halor ka jaka maw ha kaba don tang khyndiat ka khyndew . Shen ki symbai ki la speh , namar ka khyndew kam da jylliew .
Lymda shiphew ngut ki sdang sah ha kawei ka ïing , kin ïahap .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if there remain ten men in one house , that they shall die .

translation.kha: Kumta don phria tylli ki jingker bad khathynriew tylli ki thliew tnat sien , ar ar tyrnem hapoh kawei khawai ka jingker .
translation.en: And there were eight boards  ; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver , under every board two sockets .

translation.kha: U Dinah u la jubab , Buh ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong phi na ka pynbha ïa lade lane ai ïa ki hano Hano ha uwei pat . Ngan pluh na ka bynta u Syiem Kynrad ïa kaei kaba la tah bad ïathuh ha phoi ïa ka jingmut jong ka .
translation.en: Then Daniel answered and said before the king , Let thy gifts be to thyself , and give thy rewards to another  ; yet I will read the writing unto the king , and make known to him the interpretation .

translation.kha: 20 Lano ka Paradais Kan Wan ?
translation.en: 20 When Will Paradise Come ?

translation.kha: Suh ïa ka sopti u Aaron da ka linen bani , bad ïa ka jaiñspong ruh da ka linen bani ; bad ïa u pynpoi ruh kiba la suh pynpur itynnat .
translation.en: And thou shalt embroider the coat of fine linen , and thou shalt make the mitre of fine linen , and thou shalt make the girdle of needlework .

translation.kha: Kane ka longïing kaei kaba u ong , ‘ U Jeroboam un ïap ha ka thma , bad ki Briew ka Israel kin shah ringmraw na la ka ri .’
translation.en: For thus Amos saith , Jeroboam shall die by the sword , and Israel shall surely be led away captive out of their own land .
And I will make this city desolate , and an hissing  ; every one that passeth thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa ka jingpynjot kaba shyrkhei kum kane ha kane ka nongbah ha kaba uwei pa uwei uba ïaid lyngba un kyndit bad lyngngoh .
Ynda phi rung ha kata ka ri kaba U Trai u ai ha phi , Phin Burom ïa U Trai da kaba Phin ym rep ïa ka khyndew ha man la ka snem kaba hynñiew .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye come into the land which I give you , then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong kumne ha ki pyntud Israel , Wan Sha nga , dara phin ïoh im .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  unto the house of Israel , Seek ye me , and ye shall live :
Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood , planted by the waters : she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters .
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong me ka la long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba la thung hajan ka wahduid . Namar ba la don kyrhai ka um , ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la tap da ki sla bad u soh .

translation.en: There shall be no more praise of Moab : in Heshbon they have devised evil against it  ; come , and let us cut it off from being a nation . Also thou shalt be cut down , O Madmen  ; the sword shall pursue thee .
translation.kha: Ki nongshun ki la knieh ïa ka Heshbon bad ki ïasylla ban pynjot ïa ka hima ki Moab . Ïa ka shnong Madmen yn pynsngap jar ; ki shipai kin tur pyrshah ïa ka .
Ki khun U Jakob ki leh kumta kumba la bthah ïa ki . U Jehoba u ai kali ïa ki , kumba u syiem u la hukum , bad u ai jingmap ïa ki ba kin bam ha lynti .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did so : and Joseph gave them wagons , according to the commandment of Pharaoh , and gave them provision for the way .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , phi long ka kynjri ba la jied , ki lyngdoh jong U Syiem , ka jaitbynriew bakhuid , ki briew kiba dei jong U Blei hi , ba la jied ban pynthaba ïa ki kam baphylla jong U Blei , uba la khot noh ïa phi na ka jingdum sha ka jingshai iphylla jongki u hi .
translation.en: But ye are a chosen generation , a royal priesthood , an holy nation , a peculiar people  ; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light :

translation.kha: Wat lada kiwei kim pdiang ïa nga kum u Paul , da sha ma phi , phi pdiang! namarba ka jingim jongu phi ha U Trai , ma phi hi phi long ka jingpynskhem ïa ka jingsma ba nga long u apostol .
translation.en: If I be not an apostle unto others , yet doubtless I am to you : for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord .
For how shall I go up to my father , and the lad be not with me ? lest peradventure I see the evil that shall come on my father .
translation.kha: Kumno keiñ nga lah ban leit phai sha i pa lada u para um don ryngkat bad nga ? Ngan ym lah shah ban ïohi kum ïa kata ka apot ba kan wan jia ha i pa .
U syiem Hoshaïah u hukum ïa ki briew ban radbah ïa ka Jingkhawai Mamre Ka Jinglait kum ka jinglehburom ïa U Trai U blei jongngi ki , kumba la thoh ha ka ïingbasa ka Jutang .
translation.en: And the king commanded all the people , saying , Keep the passover unto the  Lord  your God , as it is written in the book of this covenant .

translation.kha: Hynñiew hadien kata ki ïa-ong para ma ki , Ngim Dei shun lai kumne ! Ngim don ka khubor ba-pnah , bad ngim dei ban buh ïa ka tang ha lade hi . lymda ngi ap haduh mynsaw ba-bang ïathuh ïa ka , ngi thikna ba ngin shad pynshitom . Ïa ngim ïapyllait noh shisyndon ban ïathuh ha ki nongbah pynïaidkam jongnga u syiem !
translation.en: Then they said one to another , We do not well : this day is a day of good tidings , and we hold our peace : if we tarry till the morning light , some mischief will come upon us : now therefore come , that we may go and tell the king s household .

translation.kha: La pynkhreh ïa ki skul bakyrpang na ka bynta kito kiba trei pura ïa ka kam ïalap khnang ba ngin Lah ban “pyndep ïa la ka kam nongïalam .”—2 tikmie ( thymmai ) 4 :5 , balieh Khasi Katholik .
translation.en: Special schooling is provided for those who devote their full time to the Kingdom-preaching work so that they can ‘ fully accomplish their ministry .’ —2 Timothy 4 :5 .

translation.kha: Ki la ïai duwai lynñiar bad kumba lamwir haduh palat shiteng sngi ; hynrei ym shym don jingjubab , ne sngewkwah ïa kano kano ka at .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when midday was past , and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice , that there was neither voice , nor any to answer , nor any that regarded .

translation.kha: Kato katne ngut ki nonglum khajna ki la wan ban shah pynbuaid , bad ki la kylli ïa u , Ko nonghikai , kai ba ngi dei Ban imat ?
translation.en: Then came also publicans to be baptized , and said unto him , Master , what shall we do ?

translation.kha: Thaw ruh sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka rngad , pyndait ïa ki ha kita ki kyrwoh , bad suh lang! ïa ngi ki jaiñ jingtap ar tylli ba kin long kawei ka jingtap .
translation.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass , and put the taches into the loops , and couple the tent together , that it may be one .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un khmih bniah ïa u , bad lada u ïohi ïa ka prum , un pynbna ba uta u bhabriew u long u bymkhuid . Ka prum ka pynkhaw-eit ba ka dei ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh , bad uta u brisoh u un-long u bymjukut .
translation.en: And the priest shall see the raw flesh , and pronounce him to be unclean : for the raw flesh is unclean : it is a leprosy .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u phah ktien shai ka Tamar ha ka jingmih : Khie leit sha ka ïing u Amnon bad khrai katto katne ka jingbam ïa u .
translation.en: Then David sent home to Tamar , saying , Go now to thy brother Amnon s house , and dress him meat .

Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces , and they were two hundred and thirty two : and after them he numbered all the people , even all the children of Israel , being seven thousand .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u la khot ïa kita ki shipai samla kiba long hapoh ki nongai hukum jong ki distrik , kiba don arspah laiphew ar ngut baroh . Nangta u la khot ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel , kaba don hynñiew hajar ngut ki rangbah .
Hato ngim don ber ban bam bad ba dih ?
translation.en: Have we not power to eat and to drink ?

translation.kha: Phin tip ba jar uba imat ïa kano Kano na kine ki kam kiba ijli yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki brup jong U Blei .
translation.en: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations , even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people .

translation.kha: Ki kulai thma kim lah ban ai jingjop ; ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki kam lah ban pyllait im .
translation.en: An horse is a vain thing for safety : neither shall he deliver any by his great strength .
And he said , The Jews have agreed to desire thee that thou wouldest bring down Paul to morrow into the council , as though they would enquire somewhat of him more perfectly .
translation.kha: U la ong ,  Ki rangbah Jiw ki la ïakut ban kyrpad ïa me lashai ka sngi ban ïalam ïa u Paul sha ka Dorbar , da kaba leh mynleh ba ka Dorbar ka kwah ban ïoh ka jingtip kaba kham thikna shaphang jong u .

Bad mynta nga wan noh Sha me ; ngam ne shuh ha kane ka pyrthei , hynrei ma ki , ki don ha ka pyrthei . Ko Pa Bakhuid ! To ri kyndong ïa ki da ka bor ka kyrteng jong me , ka kyrteng naba me la ai ha nga , ba ngin ïoh long kawei kumba ma me bad ar ngi ïalong kawei .
translation.en: And now I am no more in the world , but these are in the world , and I come to thee . Holy Father , keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me , that they may be one , as we are .

translation.kha: Lada phi tei ïa nga ka duwan kabu da u maw , Wat theh ïa ka da ki miaw ba la shniah , namar lada phi pyndei namar ha kita ki maw , kim longïing kiba bit ba tun pyndonkam .
translation.en: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone , thou shalt not build it of hewn stone : for if thou lift up thy tool upon it , thou hast polluted it .

translation.kha: Ki bynriew kin ïohi ïa kane bad kin tip ba ar , U Tiras , nga la leh ïa ka . Kin wan ban tip ba U blei bakhuid ki Israel u la pynlong ïa ka ban jhieh .
translation.en: That they may see , and know , and consider , and understand together , that the hand of the  Lord  hath done this , and the Holy One of Israel hath created it .
But I say , Have they not heard ? Yes verily , their sound went into all the earth , and their words unto the ends of the world .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga kylli : Hato ka long kaba shisha ba kim shym la ïohsngew ïa ka khubor ? Da shisha ki la ïohsngew — naba kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Ka jingsawa jong ka sur jong ki ka la leit sha ka pyrthei baroh ; ki ktien jong ki , ki la poi shaduh kiba kut ka pyrthei .

Te mynta , tang mar shu ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong ki turoi , ki tangmuri , ki jingtem ksai , ki marynthing , ki duitara , bad baroh kiwei pat ki tiar lade tiar tat , to ih ngon dara mane ïa ka durbriew . Lada phim leh kumta , yn bret kloi lan ïa phi ha ka lawar ding baklang . Hato phi pyrkhat ba Don uno uno u bleithaw uba ha ban pyllait im ïa phi ?
translation.en: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and dulcimer , and all kinds of musick , ye fall down and worship the image which I have made  ; well : but if ye worship not , ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace  ; and who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands ?

translation.kha: Gaal kine ki khait kin ïeng ha u lum Ebal katba dang pynbna ïa ki jingtim : ka jait Reuben , ka jait phad , ka jait Asher , ka jait Sebulun , ka jat Dan , bad ka jait Naphtuh .
translation.en: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse  ; Reuben , Gad , and Asher , and Zebulun , Dan , and Naphtali .

translation.kha: Nga la kyrpad ïa u Titos ban leit , bad nga la phah ïa uwei pang u parabangeit bad u . Hato phi! lah ban ong ba u Titos u la shim kabu ïa phi ? Hato ma u badno ma nga Ngim shym la leh na kijuh hi ki jingthmu bad leh ha kiaw ka rukom ?
translation.en: I desired Titus , and with him I sent a brother . Did Titus make a gain of you ? walked we not in the same spirit ? walked we not in the same steps ?

In any case thou shalt deliver him the pledge again when the sun goeth down , that he may sleep in his own raiment , and bless thee : and it shall be righteousness unto thee before the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: pynphai pat ïa ka sha u man la ka janmiet ba un ïoh kup thiah da ka . Te un sngewnguh ïa phi , bad U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un sngewbha ïa phi .

translation.en: Hear this , O ye that swallow up the needy , even to make the poor of the land to fail ,
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane , phi kiba ïuhroit ïa kiba kyrduh bad kiba pyrshang ban pynjot ïa kiba duk ha ka ri .

translation.en: And he went a little further , and fell on his face , and prayed , saying ,  O my Father , if it be possible , let this cup pass from me : nevertheless not as I will , but as thou wilt .
translation.kha: U la leit kham jngai sa katto katne , u la dem khrup ïa lade bad ka khmat sha khyndew , bad u la duwai ,  Ko Kpa jong nga , lada ka long kaba lah , to shim noh ïa kane ka khuri ka jingshah shitom na nga ! Pynban , ym ïa kaei kaba nga mon , hynrei ïa kaei kaba me mon .
Ha kata ka nongbah la don u bri kaba Kyrteng u Ananias , u briew uba riewblei uba la kohnguh ïa ka Hukum jong ngi bad ïa ibha la ñiewburom shikatdei eh da ki Jiw baroh kiba shong basah hangta .
translation.en: And one Ananias , a devout man according to the law , having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt there ,

translation.kha: Ym ni moi moi ba wan shaei ka Thep mynta ban mane ha ki sngi bakhuid . Ki kyntur samla kiba rwai hangta ki shahshitom , bad ki lyngdoh ki lah dang ban shu ud . Ki khyrdop ka nongjop ki ïing thylli , bad ka Seïon ka don ha ka jingkordit .
translation.en: He hath bent his bow like an enemy : he stood with his right hand as an adversary , and slew all that were pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion : he poured out his fury like fire .

translation.kha: U la kynmaw ïa ki jingphohsniew ba u la phohsniew shaphang lad ki , bad u ong , Phi dei ki nongpynïaid ; phi ïawan ban khmih ha-ei ka ri jong ngi ka shong tlot .
translation.en: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them , and said unto them , Ye are spies  ; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come .

translation.kha: Phi sngewtynnat ban jingaiti ïa ki jingrwai , kumba u Dabid u la thret , bad tim ïa ki ha ki duitara .
translation.en: That chant to the sound of the viol , and invent to themselves instruments of musick , like David  ;

translation.kha: Nangta wat ki rangbah kiba shlur tam , ki bym ju tieng Kum ki sing , ngin sheptieng nabar uwei pa uwei ha Israel u tip ba u kpa jongno phi u dei u shipai bhabriew bad ba ki rangbah jong u ki dei ki nongïaleh kiba satar .
translation.en: And he also that is valiant , whose heart is as the heart of a lion , shall utterly melt : for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man , and they which be with him are valiant men .

translation.kha: Nga beh kthong ïa ki nongshun jong per , bad nga jop ïa ki ; ngam shym sangeh nang haduh ba ngan da pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: I have pursued mine enemies , and destroyed them  ; and turned not again until I had consumed them .
And the soldiers  counsel was to kill the prisoners , lest any of them should swim out , and escape .
translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la thmu ban pynïap ïa ki koidi baroh , khnang ban da ïa ki na kaba jngi sha rud duriaw bad ban lait phet .
Phin sa ïohi ïa kane bad yn pyndap da ka jingkmen . Phin khynñiuh da ka jingsngewkmen . Ki spah jong ki jaitbynriew yn wallam sha pha ; na shiliang ka duriaw ki spah lad ki kin wan .
translation.en: Then thou shalt see , and flow together , and thine heart shall fear , and be enlarged  ; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee , the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee .

translation.kha: Une u mradkhlaw uba ar , u la leh ki kambah kiba khrud ; u la pynlong ïa ka ding ban Wan khah na bneng sha ka pyrthei ha ka jingïohi jong uwei pa uwei barben .
translation.en: And he doeth great wonders , so that he maketh fire come down from heaven on the earth in the sight of men ,

translation.kha: Kane ka la jia namar ki pop jongki u pyrshah ïa U Trai . Kum u Jeroboam uba ha shuwa jong u , u la pynsngewsih ïa U Trai da ki pop jong u hi malu da kaba ïalam ïa ki Jerusalem’ ban leh pop .
translation.en: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of the  Lord  , in walking in the way of Jeroboam , and in his sin which he did , to make Israel to sin .

translation.kha: Ka nongbah kaba la ïasuk badno ki paid Israel ka dei ka Gibeon , ha kaba katto katne ki Hib ki shnong . Baroh kiwei pat ki la shahjop ha ka thma .
translation.en: There was not a city that made peace with the children of Israel , save the Hivites the inhabitants of Gibeon : all other they took in battle .
If I had not done among them the works which none other man did , they had not had sin : but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father .
translation.kha: Kin ym da la sngewrem ïa ka pop lada ngam shym la leh hapdeng jong ki ïa kiei kiei kiba ym don uno uno uwei pat uba la ju leh ; kumba ka long , ki la ïohi ïa kaei kaba nga la leh , bad ki shun ïa nga bad ïa U Kpa jong nga .

translation.en: And forgive us our debts , as we forgive our debtors .
translation.kha: To map ïa ngi ïa ki jingpalat kiba ngi la leh , kumba ngi map ïa ki jingpalat kiba kiwei ki la leh ïa ngi .

translation.en: Then he said , God do so and more also to me , if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day .
translation.kha: U kyang ,  Ai ba U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada u Elisha um shah khrai khlieh shuwa ba ka sngi kan kut !

translation.en: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus , namely , upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingpynbna kan treikam ha baroh ka hima Persia ha ka sngi ba la buh na ka bynta ka jingpynïap ïa ki Jiw , ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , u bnai uba khat-ar .
Namar kane , kiba bun na ki nongbeh jong U Jisu ki la phai daym noh bad kiei leit Shua bad u .
translation.en: From that time many of his disciples went back , and walked no more with him .
That thou wilt do us no hurt , as we have not touched thee , and as we have done unto thee nothing but good , and have sent thee away in peace : thou art now the blessed of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngi kwah ba phin kular ba phin ym pynmynsaw ïa ngi , kumba ngi ruh ngim shym la pynmynsaw ïa phi . Ngi la lehsbun ïa phi bad ngi la shah ba phin leit da kaba suk . Mynta ka paw shai ba U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa phi .

Nalor kata baroh’ , ka anna ka kharai kaban jyllang hapdeng jong ngi , khnang ba kito kiba kwah ban jam sha Shillong nangne shata me kim lah ban leh katkum , lymne uno uno un lah ban jam sha shiliang sha ngi na ka iaka kaba me don .’
translation.en: And beside all this , between us and you there is a great gulf fixed : so that they which would pass from hence to you cannot  ; neither can they pass to us , that would come from thence .
And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ïai peit sawdong ban ïohi mano ba la leh ïa kata .
Te U thri u ong ha u Mysia , Rah ïa la ka kti halor ka ri Ijipt ban wallam ïa ki puit . Kin wan nabar bam ïa katai kiei baroh kaba mih , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba lait na u phria .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Stretch out thine hand over the land of Egypt for the locusts , that they may come up upon the land of Egypt , and eat every herb of the land , even all that the hail hath left .
And thou shalt put it before the veil that is by the ark of the testimony , before the mercy seat that is over the testimony , where I will meet with thee .
translation.kha: Buh ïa kane ka duwan shabar ka pyrda kaba la wah ha khmat jong ka Synduk Ka Jutang . Kata ka dei ka jaka ha kaba ngan ïashem bad me .

translation.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the  Lord   ; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance .
translation.kha: Suk kata ka jaitbynriew kaba U Blei jong ka U long U  Trai  ; suk kita ki briew kiba u la jied ban long ka jingïohkynti jong u .
( U Philippi u dei na Bethsaida , ka shnongrit ha kaba u Andriw badno u Petros ki sah . )
translation.en: Now Philip was of Bethsaida , the city of Andrew and Peter .

And he shall take of it his handful , of the flour of the meat offering , and of the oil thereof , and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering , and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour , even the memorial of it , unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta un shim shi kham u  purew bad ka umphniang , bad ïa ka jingiwbih halor jong ka , bad un thang ha ka duwan kum ka dak ba ïa kata baroh la kñia ainguh ha U  Trai . Ka jingiw na kane ka jingainguh ka long kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: After this manner therefore pray ye : Our Father which art in heaven , Hallowed be thy name .
translation.kha: Kane keiñ , ka long kumno phi dei ban duwai :   ‘ Ko Kpa jong ngi uba ha bneng : Ai ba ka kyrteng bakhuid jong me kan long kaba la pyndonburom ;
Te U Trai u ong ha u Abraham , Ki don ki jingkynnoh pynshisha kiba umjer ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah , bad ka pop jong ki ka long kaba khraw katta katta .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great , and because their sin is very grievous  ;
Discretion shall preserve thee , understanding shall keep thee :
translation.kha: Ka jingsian bad ka jingshemphang jong phi kin ïada ïa phi
U ïai-ong , La kha ïa nga lynghoh khlem don ei ei bad ngan ïarap lyngkien khlem dat ei ei . U Trai u la ai , bad myntoi u la Shim noh . To ai ba yn ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u !
translation.en: And said , Naked came I out of my mother s womb , and naked shall I return thither : the  Lord  gave , and the  Lord  hath taken away  ; blessed be the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Gaal u mawkyrdon uba la ju im shisien , hynrei u bym shym im shuh , u dei hi u syiem ibha phra uba long uwei na ki hynñiew ngut pynlang u mihnoh Ban shah pynjot .
translation.en: And the beast that was , and is not , even he is the eighth , and is of the seven , and goeth into perdition .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga la sloit lut ïa ki khun ki ksiew u Iso bad pynsep ïa ki jakarieh jong ki , te ba ken ym lah buhrieh shuh . Ïa baroh ki briew ka Edom la pynjot . Khlem pynsah shuh ïa uwei ruh .
translation.en: But I have made Esau bare , I have uncovered his secret places , and he shall not be able to hide himself : his seed is spoiled , and his brethren , and his neighbours , and he is not .
And in this mountain shall the  Lord  of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things , a feast of wines on the lees , of fat things full of marrow , of wines on the lees well refined .
translation.kha: Hangne halor u Lum Seïon , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh un pynkhreh ka jingkhawai bah na ka bynta ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei — ka jingkhawai bah da ki jingbam bakyrhai eh bad ka waiñ bakynsai tam .
Ka riewkynthei ka leit bad ka leh kumba u Elijah u la ong ïa ka , bad baroh na ki , ki ba-dap jingbam na ka bynta bun sngi .
translation.en: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah : and she , and he , and her house , did eat many days .
The breaker is come up before them : they have broken up , and have passed through the gate , and are gone out by it : and their king shall pass before them , and the  Lord  on the head of them .
translation.kha: U Blei un plie ïa ka lynti na ka bynta jong ki bad un ïalam noh ïa ki na ka jingshah ringmraw . Kin mih bran na ki khyrdop ka nongbah bad kin long kiba laitluid . U syiem jong ki , U  Trai  da lade hi , un ïalam ïa ki shabar .
U Paul bad ki Paralok jong u ki la ïohkhiah lyngkhai , hynriew ki la kyndit thiah mala ki la ïohi ïa ka burom jong U Jisu bad ïa kita ki ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la Ïeng lem bad u .
translation.en: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep : and when they were awake , they saw his glory , and the two men that stood with him .
For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory ; why yet am I also judged as a sinner ?
translation.kha: Hynrei kaei ka ban long lada ka jingbymshisha jong nga ka pynlong ïa ka burom U Blei da kaba pynlong ïa ka jingshisha jong u ban kham paw shai ? Balei yn dang ïai pynrem ïa nga kum u nongpop ?

translation.en: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites , and the houses of the cities of their possession , may the Levites redeem at any time .
translation.kha: La katta ruh , kiba na ka jait Lebi ki don ka hok ban thied pat ha kano kano ka por ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki , kiba don ha ki shnong ba la ai ha ki .

translation.en: And Jesus stood , and commanded him to be brought unto him : and when he was come near , he asked him ,
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la sangeh bad u la hukum ban wallam sha u ïa u briew uba matlah . Haba u la wan hajan , U Jisu u la kylli ïa u ,
Haba nga pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng kiwei pat ki jingkheiñbriew dara ha ki ri nongwei , kin tipthuh ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall scatter them among the nations , and disperse them in the countries .
And when we cried unto the  Lord  , he heard our voice , and sent an angel , and hath brought us forth out of Egypt : and , behold , we are in Kadesh , a city in the uttermost of thy border :
translation.kha: bad ngi la lynñiar sha U  Trai  ban ïoh jingïarap . U la ïohsngew ïa ka jinglynñiar jong ngi bad u la phah ïa u angel , uba la ïalam noh ïa ngi na Ijipt . Mynta ngi don ha Kadesh , ka shnong kaba ha khappud ka hima jong phi .

translation.en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked : he covereth the faces of the judges thereof  ; if not , where , and who is he ?
translation.kha: U Blei u ai ïa ka pyrthei ha ki bymman . U pynlong ïa baroh ki nongbishar kiba matlah . Bad lada ym dei U Blei uba leh ïa kata , uei uba leh ?

translation.en: I indeed have baptized you with water : but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Nga pynbaptis ïa phi da ka um , hynrei un pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

Shihajar ngut na phoi kin ïabeh krad haba phi ïohi ïa uwei u Shipai nongshun , bad san ngut ki shipai ki la biang ban pynlong ïa phi baroh ban phet kriah . Yn ym ni Shu ka kynhun shipai jong pa’ ka ban dang sah , lait noh sa tang u dieng lama ba sah marwei ha kliar jongu u lum !
translation.en: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one  ; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee : till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain , and as an ensign on an hill .

translation.kha: Uwei pat u nonghiarpateng jong u Saul , u dei u Mephibosheth , u khun jong u Jonathan , uba la dap san snam ka Mid mynba u Saul bad u Jonathan ki la shah pynïap . Haba ka khur shaphang ka jingïap jong ki ka la wan poi na ka nongbah Jeruel , ka nongsumar jong u ka la rah ïa u bad ka pui krad ; hynrei namar ka jingkyrkieh phlait ka la pynhap ïa u , bad u la kylla long kiba dkoh .
translation.en: And Jonathan , Saul s son , had a son that was lame of his feet . He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel , and his nurse took him up , and fled : and it came to pass , as she made haste to flee , that he fell , and became lame . And his name was Mephibosheth .

translation.kha: U Jeshua u la jubab , Me don ka leh halor jong nga tang namar ba la ai ha me da U Blei’ . Kut u briew uba aiti khong ïa nga ha me u long uba la rem na ka pop kaba kham khraw .
translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Thou couldest have no power at all against me , except it were given thee from above : therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin .

translation.kha: Phi kiba snep eh , phi! tip kynum ban ai kiei kiei kiba bha ïa ki khulom jong phi . Kaba katno tam keiñ , ba U Kpa jong phoi uba ha bneng un ai kiei kiei kiba bakha ha kito ibha pan na u !
translation.en: If ye then , being evil , know how to give good gifts unto your children , how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him ?

translation.kha: Uwei na ki u ong , Ngan sa wanlam biang sha me hadien khyndai bnai , bad ka Sarah ka tnaw jong me kan sa ïoh Kynhun shynrang . Ka Sarah kaba ainong hadien jong u ha ka jingkha ka ïingjaiñ , ka pynshahshkor .
translation.en: And he said , I will certainly return unto thee according to the time of life  ; and , lo , Sarah thy wife shall have a son . And Sarah heard it in the tent door , which was behind him .

translation.kha: Me thom Syndong ka pyrthei ha ka jingbitar ; ha ka jingbitar shla me ïuh halor ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Thou didst march through the land in indignation , thou didst thresh the heathen in anger .

translation.kha: U Judas bad ki khun shajrong jong u : u Shelah , u Peres , bad u Serah . ( Kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Judah : u Er bad u Onan ki la ïa-ïap noh ha Kanaan ) ; ki khun shynrang jong u Peris ki longkmie u Hesron malu u Hamul .
translation.en: And the sons of Judah  ; Er , and Onan , and Shelah , and Pharez , and Zerah : but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan . And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul .

translation.kha: Hadien saw snem , u Absalom u ong ha u syiem Dabid , Kynrad , shah ngan saw sha Hebron ban pyndep ïa la ka kular ba nga la ai ha U thri .
translation.en: And it came to pass after forty years , that Absalom said unto the king , I pray thee , let me go and pay my vow , which I have vowed unto the  Lord  , in Hebron .

translation.kha: Ban buh bujli ïa ki , u syiem Rehoboth u thaw da ki stet rnong bad u aiti ïa ki ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba kitkhlieh ban ïada ïa ki khyrdop jong ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields , and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard , which kept the door of the king s house .
My son , attend to my words  ; incline thine ear unto my sayings .
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ; sngap ïa ki ktien jong nga .

Phi ong ha lade , Ngim lah ap slem ïa ki sngi bakhuid ba kin khot noh khnang ba i lah pun die ïa u kew jong ngi . Lano ka sngi Sabad kan kut , khnang ba ngin ïoh sdang ban sla babiang ? Nangta ngi ha ban oh dor ram , pynmong da ki jingthew bymhok , malu pynkupbor ïa ki tarajur ban thok ïa ki nongthied jrong ngi .
translation.en: Saying , When will the new moon be gone , that we may sell corn ? and the sabbath , that we may set forth wheat , making the ephah small , and the shekel great , and falsifying the balances by deceit ?
( For they shall hear of thy great name , and of thy strong hand , and of thy stretched out arm  ; ) when he shall come and pray toward this house  ;
translation.kha: Haba u nongwei uba shong jngai na ka ri u ïohsngew shaphang ka nam jong me bad ïa kiei kiei kiba khraw kiba me la leh na ka bynta ki briew jong me , bad un wan ban mane ïa me bad duwai ha kane ka Templ , to shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong u .

translation.en: But this people who knoweth not the law are cursed .
translation.kha: Une u paidbah um tip ïa ka Hukum u Moses , te ki long hapoh ka jingtim jong U Blei !
U Asa u leh ïa kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai , kumba u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u , u la leh .
translation.en: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  , as did David his father .
He shall pour the water out of his buckets , and his seed shall be in many waters , and his king shall be higher than Agag , and his kingdom shall be exalted .
translation.kha: Kin ïoh kyrhai u slap Bad kin thung ïa la u symbai ha ki lyngkha ba ïoh um bha . U syiem jong ki un kham khraw ïa u Agag , Bad ka bor synshar jong u kan ïar kylleng sawdong .
Hynrei U Jisu u la ino ha kata ka briew , Ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynim ïa pham ; khie leit ha kaba suk .
translation.en: And he said to the woman ,  Thy faith hath saved thee  ; go in peace .

translation.kha: Ka jaitbynriew Israel baroh ka dei pun rakhe ïa khnai ka jingkhaïi Niam , hynrei uno uno u bym shym otsher um lah ban bam ïa ka .
translation.en: All the congregation of Israel shall keep it .

translation.kha: U Lehab u la leit shun khap shñiuh ïa la ki langbrot , bad ha ka por ba um don ka Hakhlieh ka la tuh ïa ki blei ïing kiba longïng ki jong u khop jong ka .
translation.en: And Laban went to shear his sheep : and Rachel had stolen the images that were her father s .

translation.kha: Wat ki sim bad ki mrad ki ei sbun banbeiñ hikai ïa me ;
translation.en: But ask now the beasts , and they shall teach thee  ; and the fowls of the air , and they shall tell thee :
And let them make haste , and take up a wailing for us , that our eyes may run down with tears , and our eyelids gush out with waters .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la ong ,  Ïathuh ïa ki ban pynkloi bad rwai ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka bynta jong ngi , tad haduh ba ki khmat jong ngi kin dap da ki ummat , bad ba ki irmat jong ngi ki jhieh na kaba ïam .

translation.en: For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles , and shall be mocked , and spitefully entreated , and spitted on :
translation.kha: Ïa u yn sa aiti noh ha ki Jentil , ki ban ibeiñ ïa u , krenbeiñ ïa u bad bynthiew ïa u .

translation.en: But the thing displeased Samuel , when they said , Give us a king to judge us . And Samuel prayed unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Samuel u sngewsih ïa ka jingkyrpad jong ki ban ïoh syiem ; kumta u duwai ha U  Trai  ,

translation.en: What thing shall I take to witness for thee ? what thing shall I liken to thee , O daughter of Jerusalem ? what shall I equal to thee , that I may comfort thee , O virgin daughter of Zion ? for thy breach is great like the sea : who can heal thee ?
translation.kha: U la phah ïa ka ding nalor , ka ding kaba thang hapoh jong nga . U la buh ka jingriam na ka bynta jong nga bad u la wanrah ïa nga sha khyndew . Nangta u la iehnoh ïa nga bad ieh ïa nga ha ka jingpang baneh .
Nangta ka punkhun biang bad ka kha sa uwei pat u khun shynrang . Ka ong , Ha kane ka sien ngan ïaroh ïa U tharai ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Judah . Nangta ka la wai noh ïa-ban ïoh khun .
translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son : and she said , Now will I praise the  Lord  : therefore she called his name Judah  ; and left bearing .

translation.kha: ‘ Ko Kore ! U Blei u la ïohsngew ïa ki jinglui jong me bad u la kynmaw ïa ki kam leh-isynei jong me .
translation.en: And said , Cornelius , thy prayer is heard , and thine alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God .

translation.kha: Namarkata kata , kynmaw ïa kane ka sngi , bad wat klet ïa ka lano lano : U Trai u long U Blei ha bneng mala ha pyrthei . Ym don blei da uwei pat .
translation.en: Know therefore this day , and consider it in thine heart , that the  Lord  he is God in heaven above , and upon the earth beneath : there is none else .

translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah tang mar ïohsngew ïa kob la ïathmu , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , u phong da ka jaiñ khain , bad u leit shad ka Templ jong U Trai .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes , and covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: katba u Dabid bad ki paidbah baroh ki ïashad da ka bor baroh ban ainguh ïa U Blei . Ki rwai bad ki tem ïa ki jingtem — ki ïahiar , ki ksing , ki shakuriaw , bad ki tyrso .
translation.en: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might , and with singing , and with harps , and with psalteries , and with timbrels , and with cymbals , and with trumpets .

translation.kha: utai u lyngdoh un shim ïa kata ka shang na phin bad buh ïa ka ha kham ka iba U TRAI’ U Blei jong phi ;
translation.en: And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand , and set it down before the altar of the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: U Trai u la Phah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki ïa-ban phai pat sha u , isynei ki paidbah ki kyntien don shahshkor .
translation.en: Yet he sent prophets to them , to bring them again unto the  Lord   ; and they testified against them : but they would not give ear .

translation.kha: lymda u briew u shim tnga sa kawei , u dei ban ai ïa ka tnga bneng jong u khatduh ka bam bad ka jaiñkup jingshim , bad ïa kijuh ki hok , kumba ka ju ïoh .
translation.en: If he take him another wife  ; her food , her raiment , and her duty of marriage , shall he not diminish .

translation.kha: Nga ïong ha u Syros , ‘ Me long uta u ban nongsynshar na ka bynta jong nga ; men bor ïa kaei kaba per kwah ïa phi ban leh ; trai hukum ïa ka Jerusalem ban teh biang bad ïa ki nongrep jong ka Templ ban seng pang .’
translation.en: That saith of Cyrus , He is my shepherd , and shall perform all my pleasure : even saying to Jerusalem , Thou shalt be built  ; and to the temple , Thy foundation shall be laid .
And the children of Israel went away , and did as the  Lord  had commanded Moses and Aaron , so did they .
translation.kha: Nangta ki la leit bad leh kumta kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses bad u Aaron .
U pynbeit ïa ki briew ka Tyros bad Shisyndon ban wanlam sha u shibun ki dieng Gaddah tyllun .
translation.en: Also cedar trees in abundance : for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David .

translation.kha: Don ka Arab , ka Dumah , ka Ashan ,
translation.en: Arab , and Dumah , and Eshean ,

translation.kha: Jamynrei lada um thied pat ïa ka hapoh kata ka snem , u duh noh ïa kata ka thok ban thied biang , bad “kata ka ïing ka sah mad ha uta u nongdie bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u pateng la pateng ; yn ym pyrsad ïa ka ha ka Sning ka Jingpynphai pat .
translation.en: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year , then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations : it shall not go out in the jubilee .

translation.kha: Ym pat ju don u nongïathuhlypa ha Israel uba kum u Mysia ; U Trai u ïakren bad u markhmat .
translation.en: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses , whom the  Lord  knew face to face ,

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki synran jong u ki la ïakylli para ma ki , Ka mudui aïu kane ? U ïathiah ïa ngi ba sa tang shipor ngin ym ïohi shuh ïa u ; badno nangta sa shipor hadien ngin sa ïohi ïa u ; bad u Ong ruh , ‘ Ka long Namar ba nur sa leit noh sha U Kpa .’
translation.en: Then said some of his disciples among themselves , What is this that he saith unto us ,  A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me : and , Because I go to the Father ?
And Thomas answered and said unto him , My Lord and my God .
translation.kha: U Thomas u la jubab ïa u ,  U Trai jong nga bad U Blei jong nga !
Ha kajuh ka rukom , baroh na ngi , la sem Long ki Jiw ne ki Jentil , ki mraw ne Kiba laitluid , la pynbaptis ha kawei ka met da ujuh U Mynsiem , bad la ai ha ngi ïa ujuh U Mynsiem ban ïoh dih .
translation.en: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body , whether we be Jews or Gentiles , whether we be bond or free ; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit .

translation.kha: Ha ka jaka ba kin sleh jingiwbih kan sma iwkhong ; ha ka jaka ki panpoh ba-itynnat ktang teh da ki tyllai barew ; ha ka jaka ban don u jingkhynñiuh ba-itynnat kin erlangthari kiba lyndet ; ha ka jaka ki jaiñ ba-itynnat kin phong ki jaiñ ; ka jingbhabriew jong ki kan kyllum sha ka jinglehrain .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink  ; and instead of a girdle a rent  ; and instead of well set hair baldness  ; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth  ; and burning instead of beauty .

translation.kha: bad haduh sawphew snem u la ïaishah bad ki ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness .
Then the elders of his city shall call him , and speak unto him : and if he stand to it , and say , I like not to take her  ;
translation.kha: Te ki nongïalam shnong kin khot ïa u bad ïakren bad u . Lada u dang kyntait ban shongkurim ïa ka ,
Wat sheptieng ïa ki nongshna jrong phi ; long borabor kiba shlur , dara kane hi kan pynshisha ha ki , ba kin shah rem bun ba phin jop , namar dem U Blei uba ai ïa phi ka jingjop .
translation.en: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries : which is to them an evident token of perdition , but to you of salvation , and that of God .
I will also vex the hearts of many people , when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations , into the countries which thou hast not known .
translation.kha: Shibun ki jaitbynriew kin shah pynshitom haba ngan pynphriang ïa ka khubor jingpynjot ïa me lyngba ki ri kiba mem pat ju ïohsngew .

Ki nongwei kiba tama hangta ki ong , ‘ Ngi la pyrshang ban ïarap ïa ka Babilonia , hynrei ka la dier palat . To ngin ieh ïa ka myntri bad ngin leit phai noh sha ïingjaiñ . U Blei u la pynshitom ïa ka Babilonia da ka bor jong u barabor bad u la pynjot thiaw ïa ka .’
translation.en: We would have healed Babylon , but she is not healed : forsake her , and let us go every one into his own country : for her judgment reacheth unto heaven , and is lifted up even to the skies .
And for the sides of the tabernacle westward he made six boards .
translation.kha: Ïa ka liang kaba shaphang sepngi jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ki shna hynriew tylli ki jingker ,
Me la sakhi ïa nga naduh ba per dang samla , pynlang nga daiñ ïai ïathuh ïa ki Kam kiba phyllung jong me .
translation.en: O God , thou hast taught me from my youth : and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works .

translation.kha: Um lah ban shah ïa kiwei pah bakha ïaleit byrsha bad u , bad lade phi iehnoh ïa u ban shakri ïa ki blei nongwei , un phai pyrthuh ïa phi bad un pynkhamti ïa phi . Un pynjot thiaw ïa pa’ , wat la u long uba bha ïa phi Mynshuwa .
translation.en: If ye forsake the  Lord  , and serve strange gods , then he will turn and do you hurt , and consume you , after that he hath done you good .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la kylla noh ïa la ka jingmut bad um shym Wanlam ha ki briew jong u ïa ka jingpynduh kaba u la byrngem .
translation.en: And the  Lord  repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people .

translation.kha: u bseiñ lane ka dohkha .
translation.en: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground , the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth :

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingim jong nga la ot noh bad ka la kut , kumin ka ïingjaiñ ba la pynkhyllem , khem ka jaiñ ba la khapnoh na ka khor thain jaiñ . NGA pyrkhat ba U Blei u la pynkut ïa ka jingim jong na .
translation.en: Mine age is departed , and is removed from me as a shepherd s tent : I have cut off like a weaver my life : he will cut me off with pining sickness : from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me .

translation.kha: Khyndiat na ki khun ki ksiew jyllang me hi yn sa ïabam noh bad ban pynlong ki ïunukh Ban shakri ha ka ïingsyiem jyllang u syiem ka Bithynia .
translation.en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee , which thou shalt beget , shall they take away  ; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .

translation.kha: Haba u la poi ha kata ka jaka , u la ong ha ki , duli ba phin ym hap ha ka jingpynduh .
translation.en: And when he was at the place , he said unto them ,  Pray that ye enter not into temptation .

translation.kha: Lada uno uno u pyrshang ba pynmynsaw ïa ki , ka ding kan mih na ki shimet jong ki bad kan bam duh ïa ki nongshun jong ki ; bad ha kane ka rukom , uno ine uba pyrshang pun pynmynsaw ïa ki un shah pynïap .
translation.en: And if any man will hurt them , fire proceedeth out of their mouth , and devoureth their enemies : and if any man will hurt them , he must in this manner be killed .
And the channels of the sea appeared , the foundations of the world were discovered , at the rebuking of the  Lord  , at the blast of the breath of his nostrils .
translation.kha: Ka trai duriaw ka paw tyngkreiñ bad ïa ki nongrim jong ka pyrthei ruh la pynpaw , haba U  Trai  u kynteit ïa ki nongshun jong u , bad u kyrhuh ïa ki ha ka jingbitar .
Kaei kaba nga la leh na ka bynshet jong nga hi — Ngan ym shahïap ba ïa ka kyrteng jong nga yn pynjahburom lane mano mano ban ïadon bynta lang ïa ka burom kaba de ka jong nga badno ka jong nga hi .
translation.en: For mine own sake , even for mine own sake , will I do it : for how should my name be polluted ? and I will not give my glory unto another .

translation.kha: Ka hima u Solomon ka kynthup ïa baroh ki ri naduh ka wah Ïuphratis khah ka ri ki Philistia bad ka pud Ijipt . Ki la siew Khynnah ïa u bad ki la hap hapoh jong u katba u tdong im .
translation.en: And Solomon reigned over all kingdoms from the river unto the land of the Philistines , and unto the border of Egypt : they brought presents , and served Solomon all the days of his life .
And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning , and bread and flesh in the evening  ; and he drank of the brook .
translation.kha: U la dih um na ka wahduid bad ki tyngab ki wanrah kpu bad wanrah doh ïa u man la ka step bad man la ka janmiet .
bad ynda phi la poi sha shiliang ka Jordan , pynïeng ïa ine ki mraw ha u lum Ebal , kumba de la sah ïa phi mynta ka Sngi , bad ñiad astor ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore it shall be when ye be gone over Jordan , that ye shall set up these stones , which I command you this day , in mount Ebal , and thou shalt plaster them with plaster .
And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah , David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .
translation.kha: Haba ki Syria na Damaskos ki la phah ka kynhun shipai ban ïarap ïa u Hadadeser , u Dabid u la tur ïaleh ïa ka bad u la pynïap arphew ar hajar ngut ki rangbah .
Ki ïa-ong , Ngim lah ban ai ïa la ka jongu ka para ba kan ïashongkurim malu u briew u bym shym la otsher ; kata kan un-long ka jingjahburom ïa ngi .
translation.en: And they said unto them , We cannot do this thing , to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised  ; for that were a reproach unto us :
For the sins of her prophets , and the iniquities of her priests , that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her ,
translation.kha: Hynrei ka la jia namar ba ki nongïathuhlypa jong ka ki la leh pop bad ki lyngdoh jong ka ki long kiba la rem namar ka jingpynjia ïa ka jingïap jong ki briew balui lui .
Wat lada kito ki para ngut ki rangbah , u Noah , u Daniel bad u Hobah ki ni hangta , ka jingbit jong ki kan pynim dang ïa ka jingim jong ki hi . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: Though these three men , Noah , Daniel , and Job , were in it , they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Dor kawei ka shata syntiew harum ki lai jur ki tnat kiba mih na u jingpynïaid sharak .
translation.en: And a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , according to the six branches going out of it .

translation.kha: U rangbah Shipai u la ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , bad u la ïaroh ïa U Blei , da kaba ong , Da shaid u la long u briew uba bha !
translation.en: Now when the centurion saw what was done , he glorified God , saying , Certainly this was a righteous man .

translation.kha: Hato phin pyllait ba ki paid Israel ki anna hapoh ka jingim ? Hato U Trai u la duh ne ïa la ka jingïaishah ? Hato un da leh shisha ïa kine kiei kiei ? Kato um shym kren bha ïa kito kiba leh ïa kaba dei ?
translation.en: O thou that art named the house of Jacob , is the spirit of the  Lord  straitened ? are these his doings ? do not my words do good to him that walketh uprightly ?

translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba u ong ha ki shithi jong u baroh haba u thoh halor kane ka phang . Don Katto katba kiei kiei katba eh ha ki shithi jong u ha uba ki bym da shemphang bad ki briew ki bymïaineh jingjam ki batai bakla , kumba ki leh ïa kiwei! pat ki bynta ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid . Kumne ki wahbah hi ïa la ka jingjot .
translation.en: As also in all his epistles , speaking in them of these things  ; in which are some things hard to be understood , which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest , as they do also the other scriptures , unto their own destruction .

translation.kha: Ha shi lynter ka jingjam , ngi don ha tmier jong ka jingïap na ka bynta U Jingsuk , khnang ba yn ïohi ïa ka jingim jong u ha kane ka met baïap jong ngi .
translation.en: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus  sake , that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh .

translation.kha: U la pynpait ïa ki jingnang rnong bad pynpra ïa ki nar kiba ker .
translation.en: For he hath broken the gates of brass , and cut the bars of iron in sunder .

translation.kha: Nangta u Daniel u la leit sha u Ariokh , u rangbah ai Hukum jong ka kynhun ai jingïada jong u syiem , uba la ïoh hukum ïa-ban pyndep ïa ka jingpanpoh . Da kaba jied biang biang ïa ki kyntien jong u ,
translation.en: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king s guard , which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon :

translation.kha: San mata la shoh ïa nga Nepheg khatkhyndai thri da ki Jiw ; lai sien la sympat ïa nga da ki nong Rom ; bad shikhung nga la shah lyntait maw .
translation.en: Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one .

And they made two other golden rings , and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath , toward the forepart of it , over against the other coupling thereof , above the curious girdle of the ephod .
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh sa ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad ki pyndait ïa ki ha trai jong kita ki tyllai tawah tyrpeng kiba sha khmat jong ka ephod , hamar ka jaka suh pyndait , bad haneng ka jingpanpoh ba la thain itynnat bha .
Kumta U blei u la ong , Ka bha shibun . nur shait ïa me ba Leit pyndonkam noh da ka na-ei masi pynïap , bad me lah ban shet ïa la u khup ha ka .
translation.en: Then he said unto me , Lo , I have given thee cow s dung for man s dung , and thou shalt prepare thy bread therewith .

For he sent letters into all the king s provinces , into every province according to the writing thereof , and to every people after their language , that every man should bear rule in his own house , and that it should be published according to the language of every people .
translation.kha: U la phah ïa ka khubor sha kawei pa kawei ka jylla jong u syiem ha ka ktien bad ka rukom thoh jong kata ka probins    , kaba ong ba uwei pa uwei u tnga u long u kynrad jong ka ïing jong u bad kaba u kren kan long ka bor kaba kut .

Balei ba phi pan na nga ban ai ïa ka Abishag ha u ? u syiem u kylli . “Phi lah ban sa pan ruh na nga ban ai ha u ïa ka khet ruh . Nalor —kata , u dei u hynmen ba kham heh jong to , bad ba u Abiathar u lyngdoh bad u Joab ki don ha ka liang jong u !
translation.en: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother , And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah ? ask for him the kingdom also  ; for he is mine elder brother  ; even for him , and for Abiathar the priest , and for Joab the son of Zeruiah .

translation.kha: Thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad pynpait ïa ki harum kata ka jingpynnang ha ki ar tylli ki khrong kiba marpyrshah , ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah da uba yn bah ïa ka .
translation.en: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it , by the two corners thereof , upon the two sides of it shalt thou make it  ; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal .
And the multitudes that went before , and that followed , cried , saying , Hosanna to the Son of David : Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord  ; Hosanna in the highest .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah kiba la ïaid ha khmat jong U Jisu bad kito kiba la bud nadien ki la sdang ban pyrta ,  To ïaroh ïa U khun u Dabid ! U Blei u kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ! To ïaroh ïa U Blei !

translation.en: Wherefore it shall come to pass , if ye hearken to these judgments , and keep , and do them , that the  Lord  thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers :
translation.kha: Lada phi shahshkor ïa kine ki hukum bad kohnguh hok ïa ki , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ïai bat ïa la ka jutang bad phi bad un pynpaw ha phi ïa ka jingieit jong u kaba ïaineh , kumba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
Nangta u Rangbah Lyngdoh un shym khyndiat ka snam jong uta u masi nabar Rah ïa ka shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock s blood , and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation :

translation.kha: Haba ki la wan kiew na kata ka um , U Mynsiem jong U Trai u la rah nep ïa u phyllaw . U rangbah synshar um shym la ïohi shu ïa u , hynrei u la bteng ïa la ka jingleit , suba dap da ka jingkren .
translation.en: And when they were come up out of the water , the Spirit of the Lord caught away Philip , that the eunuch saw him no more : and he went on his way rejoicing .
They , and all that appertained to them , went down alive into the pit , and the earth closed upon them : and they perished from among the congregation .
translation.kha: Da kumta ki la hap sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ryngkat bad ki jingdon jingem jong ki . Ka khyndew ka tap ïa ki , bad ki la jah jar .
Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa u Abraham ban kohnguh haba U blem u la khot ïa u ban leit shaw ka ri kaba U Blei u la kular shun ai ha u . U la mihnoh na la ka ri khlem ïatip shano ba un leit .
translation.en: By faith Abraham , when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance , obeyed  ; and he went out , not knowing whither he went .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la don ha ka jingjynjar ibha la bthah ba ki daiñ ban shna katjuh ki maw-it man ka sngi kumba ki la ju shna mihnoh .
translation.en: And the officers of the children of Israel did see that they were in evil case , after it was said , Ye shall not minish ought from your bricks of your daily task .

translation.kha: namarba u la banbeiñ bad leh bymsuidñiew ïa kiba duk bad ba u knieh noh ïa ki ïit Ibbah kiaw ki la thaw ,
translation.en: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor  ; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not  ;

Foretelling a key part of the sign of “the last days ,” Jesus said : “This good news of the kingdom will be preached in all the inhabited earth for a witness to all the nations  ; and then the end will come .” —Matthew 24 :14 .
translation.kha: Ka jingiathuhlypa ia ka jinglong bakongsan shaphang ki dak jong “Ki sngi bakhadduh ,” U Jisu u la ong : “Te ia kane ka gospel jong ka hima yn ialap ha ka pyrthei baroh , ia kaban long ka jingphla ha ki kynja bynriew baroh ; ynda kumta kein kan jia kata kaba kut .” —Mathaios 24 :14 .
kumta la la pyrkhat , ‘ Ki Philistia kin wiang puta ïaleh ïa ar hangne ha Gilgal , bad Ngam shym la pyrshang ïa-ban ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jong U Trai .’ Kumta nga sngur ba to dei ban ai ka jingjia .
translation.en: Therefore said I , The Philistines will come down now upon me to Gilgal , and I have not made supplication unto the  Lord  : I forced myself therefore , and offered a burnt offering .

translation.kha: Ki riewbymman ki apthap ban pynïap ïa nga , hynrei tun pun ïa ki aiñ jongnga me .
translation.en: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me : but I will consider thy testimonies .
Then they brought out the king s son , and put upon him the crown , and gave him the testimony , and made him king . And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him , and said , God save the king .
translation.kha: Nangta u Jehoïada u ïalam shabar ïa u Joash , u buh ïa ka pansngiat halor ka khlieh jong u , bad u ai ha u ïa ka kopi jong ki aiñ kiba ïadei bad ka jingsynshar . U Jehoïada u lyngdoh bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki pynsleh ïa u Joash , bad uwei pa uwei u pyrta :  To un im slem u syiem .
U leh kumjuh ha ki nongbah bad ki iaki ba la iehnoh kynjah jong ki Manasseh , Ephraim , bad Simeon , bad jngai shaduh shatei haduh Naphtali .
translation.en: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh , and Ephraim , and Simeon , even unto Naphtali , with their mattocks round about .

translation.kha: Kumno me da ban nong ba mem shym la pyntngit ïa lade , ba mem pat ju mane ïa u Baalis ? Ha khih kumto me la leh pop ha ka jaijai ; ha peit kaei me la leh . Me long kumno ka ut khlaw ha ka prie jingkiew shongkha jong ka , kaba mareh lalot kylleng ,
translation.en: How canst thou say , I am not polluted , I have not gone after Baalim ? see thy way in the valley , know what thou hast done : thou art a swift dromedary traversing her ways  ;

translation.kha: U briew uba la ïohi ïa ka jingdap pynkitkhlieh u dei banbeiñ phong da ki jaiñjot , un jhieh khlem sad ïa la u shñiuh , un tap ïa la ka khmat nguid ki rmiang shym sharum , malade un pyrta , U bymhok , u bymkhuid !
translation.en: And the leper in whom the plague is , his clothes shall be rent , and his head bare , and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip , and shall cry , Unclean , unclean .

translation.kha: Ka hima jong u ka kynthup ïa u Lum Hermon , ka Salekah , malu ka Bashan barhem haduh ki pudina jong ka Geshur bad ka Mikah , bad shiteng jong ka Gilead ïathuh ka ri jyllang u Gihon u syiem ka lehsbun .
translation.en: And reigned in mount Hermon , and in Salecah , and in all Bashan , unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites , and half Gilead , the border of Sihon king of Heshbon .

translation.kha: Ngan lum ïa ibha sah na ki briew jong nga na ki ri kiba to la pynsakma ïa ki , bad kun salm pat ïa ki sha la ka jongno ka ri . kin ïoh bun ki khun bad kin nang roi ha ka jingbun brai .
translation.en: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them , and will bring them again to their folds  ; and they shall be fruitful and increase .

translation.kha: Phin shem ïa kata ynda phin rupa sha ka kamra ba shadkmen baneh rakhe , u Mikaïah u jubab .
translation.en: And Micaiah said , Behold , thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself .

translation.kha: U Heber u don lai nguh ki khun shynrang : u Japhlet , u Shomer , bad u Humtah , bad kawei ka ïakhun , ka shu .
translation.en: And Heber begat Japhlet , and Shomer , and Hotham , and Shua their sister .

They say still unto them that despise me , The  Lord  hath said , Ye shall have peace  ; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart , No evil shall come upon you .
translation.kha: Ha ki briew kiba kyntait ban sngap ïa kaei kaba nga la ong , ki ïai-ong ba baroh ka long bha bad ki . Bad ki ïathuh ïa uwei uwei baroh uba mutlop ba ka jingjot kan ym ktah ïa u .

Kumta , kam la ang la thah ïa kato ka shithi , ka la erlangthari ym namar jong uta uba la leh bymdei litar na ka pynbha Utai uba la shah leh bymdei . Pynban , nga la tah ïa ka khnang ban pynshai ha phi , ha khmat jong U Blei , katno ka long da shisha kambah jylliew ka jingaiti jong phi sha ngi .
translation.en: Wherefore , though I wrote unto you , I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong , nor for his cause that suffered wrong , but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you .
And one of them that stood by drew a sword , and smote a servant of the high priest , and cut off his ear .
translation.kha: Hynrei uwei na kita kiba ïa-ïeng hangta u la sei ïa ka waitlam bad u la pom ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , bad ïoh mait ïa ka shkor jong u .
Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Jehoahas u la leh la buh jingshoh ha Ka Politics Jong Ki Syiem Ka Joïada .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Joash , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?

translation.kha: Ka jingkhuslai kan lute ïa ka jingkmen na phi , hynrei ki ktien sbun kin pynkmen ïa phi .
translation.en: Heaviness in the heart of man maketh it stoop : but a good word maketh it glad .

translation.kha: Uwei u samla u la mareh ban leit ïathuh ha u Moses shaphang kaei ba u Eldad bad u Medad ki leh .
translation.en: And there ran a young man , and told Moses , and said , Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp .

translation.kha: U Blei u la hukum , nabar ki skain bad ki mait ki la dap kylleng ïa ka ri baroh kawei .
translation.en: He spake , and there came divers sorts of flies , and lice in all their coasts .

translation.kha: Sa shisnem pat u Nathan u pynphong ïa u Dabid ban kular ban ieid ïa u , naba u Jonathan u ieit ïa u Dabid wohnia u ieit ïa lade hi .
translation.en: And Jonathan caused David to swear again , because he loved him : for he loved him as he loved his own soul .
Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me , Knowest thou not what these be ? And I said , No , my lord .
translation.kha: Hato mem tip ?  U la kylli ïa nga .  Em , ngam tip , ko rangbah ,  nga la jubab .
bad u la ong , To ai ïa kane ka bor ha nga ruh , khnang ba uno uno ha uba nga bhah ïa la ki kti un nongpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: Saying , Give me also this power , that on whomsoever I lay hands , he may receive the Holy Ghost .

According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Egypt even unto this day , wherewith they have forsaken me , and served other gods , so do they also unto thee .
translation.kha: Naduh ba nga la wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt , ki la phai noh na nga bad ki la mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ; bad mynta ki leh ïa me kumba ki la ju leh ïa nga .
Ka la ïa-ïap ha Hebron ha ka ri Kano , bad u Abraham u ïasam sngewsih Naamah jong ka .
translation.en: And Sarah died in Kirjath–arba  ; the same is Hebron in the land of Canaan : and Abraham came to mourn for Sarah , and to weep for her .

translation.kha: Na ka Jaka jong ka jait Naphtali ki la pdiang ut tylli ki nongbet : ka Kedesh ha Galilaïa , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ka ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , ka Hamath Dor , bad ka Kartan , lem nabar ki pyntha phlang jong ki .
translation.en: And out of the tribe of Naphtali , Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Hammoth–dor with her suburbs , and Kartan with her suburbs  ; three cities .
