translation.en: Come unto me , all ye that labour and are heavy laden , and I will give you rest .

translation.kha: hato phi da hi ban ap haduh ba kin da san ? Hato kaei kan khanglad ïa phi na kaba shongman ïano ïasnoh ? Em , ko khun kynthei jongno ar , phi tip ba kata Kam lah ban un-long . U Trai u la phai pyrshah ïa nga , mala nga sngewsih shikatdei eh ïa phi .
translation.en: Would ye tarry for them till they were grown ? would ye stay for them from having husbands ? nay , my daughters  ; for it grieveth me much for your sakes that the hand of the  Lord  is gone out against me .
( I stood between the  Lord  and you at that time , to shew you the word of the  Lord  : for ye were afraid by reason of the fire , and went not up into the mount  ; ) saying ,
translation.kha: Nga la ïeng hapdeng jong phi bad U  Trai  ha kata ka por ban ïathuh ha phi aïu u ong , namar ba phi sheptieng ïa kata ka ding bad phim shym leit kiew sha uta u lum .  U  Trai  u la ong ,
Hamar ba ki la krensih , nga la shadong ban thuh . Hynrei nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba kren na bnai , To buhrieh ïa kiei kaba ki hynñiew tylli ki pyrthat ki la ïa-ong ; wat thoh ïa ka !
translation.en: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices , I was about to write : and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me , Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered , and write them not .

translation.kha: wat ñiewbeiñ ïa ki khubor ba la pyrsad mynsiem .
translation.en: Despise not prophesyings .

translation.kha: Wat ïalang lok bad ki brup kiba kyrni dkoh waiñ lane bad kiba lwait jingbam .
translation.en: Be not among winebibbers  ; among riotous eaters of flesh :

translation.kha: Ussaïah na kita ki kherub u buh ïa la ka kti ha ka ding kaba to hangta hapdeng jongnga ki , u la shim kyndiang ki rnga ngin , bad u la buh ïa ki ha ki ktien u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen . Uta u briew u la shim ïa kita ki rnga ding nabar u la mihnoh .
translation.en: And one cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubims unto the fire that was between the cherubims , and took thereof , and put it into the hands of him that was clothed with linen : who took it , and went out .

translation.kha: Dei ban ryngkat ïa kata ka masi lem bad ka snieh , ka doh , ka snam , bad ki snier jong ka ha khmat jongu u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight  ; her skin , and her flesh , and her blood , with her dung , shall he burn :

translation.kha: Ko Job , ha baroh ka jingrem jongngi me , hato me la hukum ïa ka sngi haduh ka step ?
translation.en: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days  ; and caused the dayspring to know his place  ;
Let them not depart from thine eyes  ; keep them in the midst of thine heart .
translation.kha: Wat shah ba kin phet noh na phi ; kynmaw bad ri kyndong ïa ki ha ka dohnud jong phi .

translation.en: For brass I will bring gold , and for iron I will bring silver , and for wood brass , and for stones iron : I will also make thy officers peace , and thine exactors righteousness .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam ïa pha ïa ka ksiar ha ka jaka ka rnong , ka rupa bad ka tama ha ka jaka u nar bad ka dieng , bad u nar ha ka jaka u maw . Ki nongsynshar jong pha kin ym banbeiñ shuh ïa pha ; ngan pynlong ïa ki ban synshar da ka hok bad ka jingsuk .
Neng la kwah ban tip ïa kaei kaba ki la mudui ïa u , kumta nga la ïalumlang ïa u sha ka Dorbar jong ki .
translation.en: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him , I brought him forth into their council :

translation.kha: Nga la Lah iathuh ha phi ba dei ma nga uta , U Jisu u la ong . Te , lada phi ïadoh ïa ang , shah ba kine kiwei kin loit noh .
translation.en: Jesus answered ,  I have told you that I am he : if therefore ye seek me , let these go their way :

translation.kha: Ym dat kano Kane kawei pat ka jaitbynriew kaba kylla ïa la ki beit , wat la kim dat kiba pahara . Hynrei ki briew jong nga ki la bujli ïa na , U Blei uba la wahbah ha ki ka jingpynrem , da ki blei ki me lah ba-bang lai ei ei ïa ki .
translation.en: Hath a nation changed their gods , which are yet no gods ? but my people have changed their glory for that which doth not profit .
That led them through the deep , as an horse in the wilderness , that they should not stumble ?
translation.kha: Hangno u don U  Trai  , uba da ka bor jong u , u la leh ki kam bakhraw lyngba u Moses , u da kad arliang ïa ki um ka duriaw bad ïalam ïa ki briew jong u lyngba ki um kiba jylliew , ban ïoh ïa ka nam baneh junom na ka bynta ïa lade ?  Ha ka jingïalam U  Trai  , ki kjat jong ki , ki long skhem kum ki kulai khlaw , bad kim ju jynthut .
Hynrei lada u ïada ha ka por mynmiet u jynthut , namar um don ka jingshai .
translation.en: But if a man walk in the night , he stumbleth , because there is no light in him .
And they found an Egyptian in the field , and brought him to David , and gave him bread , and he did eat  ; and they made him drink water  ;
translation.kha: Kita ki briew kiba leit bad u Dabid ki lap ïa uwei u khynnah Ijipt ha lum , bad ki wan ïalam ïa u ha u Dabid . Ki ai ha u ïa u kpu ban bam bad ka um ban dih ;

translation.en: And the king said , What have I to do with you , ye sons of Zeruiah ? so let him curse , because the  Lord  hath said unto him , Curse David . Who shall then say , Wherefore hast thou done so ?
translation.kha: Kane kam dei ka kam jong me ,  u syiem u ong ïa u Abishai bad ïa u Joab , u para jong u .  Lada u tim ïa nga namar ba U  Trai  u la ong ïa u , mano ba don hok ban kylli balei u leh ïa ka ?

translation.en: So he sent his brethren away , and they departed : and he said unto them , See that ye fall not out by the way .
translation.kha: Nangta u phah noh ïa la ki hynmen , bad katba ki dang ïakhreh mih , u ong ,  Wat ïakajia ha lynti .
a u sah” shipor ha ka Ïing u nongpdem sneng uba kyrteng u Simon , suba shong basah Harhas durblei .
translation.en: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner , whose house is by the sea side : he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do .
And he repaired the altar of the  Lord  , and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings , and commanded Judah to serve the  Lord  God of Israel .
translation.kha: U tei pynbha ïa ka duwan ha kaba ïa U  Trai  la mane , bad u kñia ïa ki jingainguh ïasyllok bad ki jingainguh thang ha ka . U hukum ïa ki paid Judah baroh ban mane ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .
Ngim dap da ka jingsleh bad ngi kham kwah ban iehnoh ïa khnai ka ïing jong ngi ha ka met bad don ioh long ha ka ïinglieng nabar U Trai .
translation.en: We are confident , I say , and willing rather to be absent from the body , and to be present with the Lord .

translation.kha: Ka um ba shu tuh ka kham sngem , ka jingbam ba Shi tuh ka kham slap .
translation.en: Stolen waters are sweet , and bread eaten in secret is pleasant .
For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you , as it is written .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Na ka daw jong phi ki Jiw , ki Jentil ki kren sniew ïa U Blei .
Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew ba yn ym don Mano mano ba lah ban ñiew ïa ki baroh ; kan hasem jem ban ñiew ïa ki phngit pui pui ha ka khyndew !
translation.en: And I will make thy seed as the dust of the earth : so that if a man can number the dust of the earth , then shall thy seed also be numbered .

translation.kha: Don ka Arab , ka Dumah , ka Eshan ,
translation.en: Arab , and Dumah , and Eshean ,
And they that passed by reviled him , wagging their heads ,
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ïaid lynti nangta ki pynkhih ïa la ki khlieh bad ki da ther ki jingkrenbeiñ ïa U Jisu :

translation.en: Whereupon the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves  ; and they said , The  Lord  is righteous .
translation.kha: U syiem bad ki nongïalam ki phla ba ki la leh pop , bad ki ong ,  Kaei kaba U  Trai  u leh ka long kaba shongnia .
Na noh ha phi baroh ba ym don na kito ki rangbah kiba la shah khot sngewbha ki ban ïohmad ïa ka jingbam miet jong sa !’
translation.en: For I say unto you , That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper .
Let no man deceive you with vain words : for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience .
translation.kha: Wat shah ïano ïano ban shukor ïa phi da ki ktien bieit , namar dei na kine kiei kiei ba ka jingbitar U Blei kan wan ha kito ki bymkohnguh ïa u .

translation.en: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him , and he shall hear thee , and thou shalt pay thy vows .
translation.kha: Haba phi duwai , un jubab ïa phi , bad phin bat ïa ki kular ba phi la pynlong .

translation.en: For Moses said , Honour thy father and thy mother  ; and , Whoso curseth father or mother , let him die the death :
translation.kha: Naba u Moses u la hukum , ‘ Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie ,’ bad , ‘ uno uno uba tim ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie yn pynïap .’

translation.en: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you , and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles , that one should have his father s wife .
translation.kha: Mynta , la don ka jingong kaba thikna ba ka don ka jingïaleh awria hapdeng jong phi kaba shyrkhei haduh katta katta ba wat ki bymngeit kin sngewrem ïa kata . La ïathuh ïa nga ba uwei u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad la ka meinah!

translation.en: Is not this laid up in store with me , and sealed up among my treasures ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kynmaw aïu ki nongshun jong ki , ki la leh ; u ap ïa ka por kaba biang ban pynshitom ïa ki .
Yn to ki jingkhynñiuh jyrmi kiba shyieng , ki nemsniew , dara ki khlad ha kylleng kylleng ; kin don ki kiei kiba phylla bad kiba pyntriem kiba wei na sahmiet bneng .
translation.en: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places , and famines , and pestilences  ; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven .
And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled , that is to say , with unwashen , hands , they found fault .
translation.kha: Ki la ïohi ba katto katne ngut ki synran jong u ki dang ïabam ïa la ki jingbam da ki kti ki bym khuid kat kum ka jinglehniam — kata , kim pat sait ha kata ka rukom kaba ki Pharisi ki ong ba ki briew ki dei ban leh .
Baroh kaba ki kyntu ka longsem ba ngin kynmaw ïa kiba kyrduh ha ka kynjoh jong ki , kaba nga hi ruh nga da khiew eh ban sa .
translation.en: Only they would that we should remember the poor ; the same which I also was forward to do .
The word of the  Lord  that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ba u Jotham , u Ahas , bad u Hesekaïah ki la long ki syiem ka Judah , U  Trai  u la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Mikah , uba na ka shnong Moresheth . U  Trai  u la pynpaw ha u Mikah ïa kine kiei kiei baroh shaphang ka Samaria bad ka Jerusalem .

U phah khot ïa u Eliakim , u rangbah synshar uba dih peit ïa ka ïingsyiem , u Shebna , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad ki lyngdoh kiba ha shuwa jong u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khwan Jong u Amos . Ki ruh ki phong da ki jaiñ khih .
translation.en: And he sent Eliakim , which was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and the elders of the priests , covered with sackcloth , to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz .

translation.kha: Pynbna ïa ka burom jong u ha ki jingñiewbeiñ , ïa ki kam bakhrawbor ha ki briew .
translation.en: Declare his glory among the heathen  ; his marvellous works among all nations .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , Ki myrsiang ki don ki thliew , bad ki sim ki don ki skum , hynrei U Khun U Briew um don Hangne hangno ban thiah bad pynjahthait .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Foxes have holes , and birds of the air have nests  ; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head .
And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary , unto the inner court , to minister in the sanctuary , he shall offer his sin offering , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la long khuid biang , u dei ban ap hynñiew sngi bad nangta un leit sha ka phyllaw kaba kham shapoh jong ka Templ bad ai ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka jingpynkhuid ïa u , khnang ba un lah ban shakri biang ha ka Templ . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
Ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki la pynïap laispah hynriewphew ngut ki rangbah jong u Abner kba na ka jat Benjamin .
translation.en: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin , and of Abner s men , so that three hundred and threescore men died .
I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman .
translation.kha: Ka nongbah Seïon ka long kaba itynnat , hynrei ïa ka yn sa pynjot ;
hangno anna kiba stad ? hangno don ki riewshemphang ? hangno Don ki nongïatainia batbit jong kane ka pyrthei ? U Balei u la pyn-i ba ka jingstet jong kane ka pyrthei ka un-long ka jingibieit !
translation.en: Where is the wise ? where is the scribe ? where is the disputer of this world ? hath not God made foolish the wisdom of this world ?

translation.kha: Ki la pyrta bad kylli , Don mo u nongshong basaw hangne uba kyrteng u Sihon Petros ?
translation.en: And called , and asked whether Simon , which was surnamed Peter , were lodged there .
To hearken to the words of my servants the prophets , whom I sent unto you , both rising up early , and sending them , but ye have not hearkened  ;
translation.kha: bad da kaba pynshahshkor ïa ki kyntien jong ki nongïathuhlypa , ki shakri jong nga , kiba nga la ju ïai phah sha phi . Phim pat ju kohnguh ïa kaei kaba ki la ong .

translation.en: And the servant ran to meet her , and said , Let me , I pray thee , drink a little water of thy pitcher .
translation.kha: Uta u shakri u leit bran bran ban ïashem ïa ka bad u ong ,  To ai um ba ngan dih na uto u khiew um jong phi .

translation.en: But if ye shall at all turn from following me , ye or your children , and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you , but go and serve other gods , and worship them :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ma me lane ki khun ki ksiew jong me phi phai dien noh na nga , bad phim kohnguh ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi , hynrei phi leit mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ,

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Israel , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they sold the righteous for silver , and the poor for a pair of shoes  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki die sha ka jinglongmraw ïa ki briew kiba hok ki bym lah siew pat ïa ki ram jong ki , ki briew kiba duk ki bym lah siew pat wat ïa ka dor shi jur ki juti .

translation.en: They said therefore , What is this that he saith ,  A little while ?  we cannot tell what he saith .
translation.kha: Ka mut aïu kane ‘ sa tang shipor ?’ Ngim tip ba u kren shaphang kaei !
Kine ki long ki ki shongkhia kiba ka kmie u syiem Lymne ka kren ha u :
translation.en: The words of king Lemuel , the prophecy that his mother taught him .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Bel u la ong ha u , Me don khop aïu ban skei ïa u jingthung ? U Jonah u la jubab , Ngi don ka hok baroh ban bitar — ban bitar eh ban ïap !
translation.en: And God said to Jonah , Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd ? And he said , I do well to be angry , even unto death .
But as it is written , Eye hath not seen , nor ear heard , neither have entered into the heart of man , the things which God hath prepared for them that love him .
translation.kha: Pynban , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  Ïa kaei kaba ym pat don mano mano ba la ïohi ne ïohsngew , ïa kaei kaba ym pat don mano mano ba la pyrkhat ba lah ban jia , ka long kata hi kaei kaei kaba U Blei u la pynkhreh ïa kito kiba ieit ïa u .

translation.en: My God , think thou upon Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works , and on the prophetess Noadiah , and the rest of the prophets , that would have put me in fear .
translation.kha: Nga duwai ,  A Blei , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Tobiah bad u Sanballat ki la leh bad to pynshitom ïa ki . To kynmaw ïa kato ka kynthei , ka Noadaïah , bad baroh kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la pyrshang ban pyntieng ïa nga .
Nga long u kpu ka jingshim .
translation.en: I am that bread of life .

translation.kha: ïalam ïa ka sha ïing lad pa , bad hangta kan khi ïa la ka khlieh , kan ot ïa la ki tyrsim ,
translation.en: Then thou shalt bring her home to thine house  ; and she shall shave her head , and pare her nails  ;

translation.kha: Ki la poi biang sa shisien ha Jesreel . Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid ha ka Templ , ki ngab Lyngdoh , ki nongai ka Hukum , bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wan ha u
translation.en: And they come again to Jerusalem : and as he was walking in the temple , there come to him the chief priests , and the scribes , and the elders ,

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , To ïeng joit , to rah ïa la ka jingthiah , malu to ïadei .
translation.en: Jesus saith unto him ,  Rise , take up thy bed , and walk .

translation.kha: U Trai u jubab , Ka jait Judah kan leit nyngkong . (Nga ai ha ki ban bat synshar ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , Judah shall go up : behold , I have delivered the land into his hand .

translation.kha: U Jubab , tala ruh ka biang hi . Ngan nym pynjot ïa kata ka nongrit .
translation.en: And he said unto him , See , I have accepted thee concerning this thing also , that I will not overthrow this city , for the which thou hast spoken .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka por kan wan , ki briew kin ym ong shuh , ‘ Ki kmie ki kput ki la bam ïa u sohwaiñ bajew , hynrei ki Kynhun ki ïoh ïa ka jingmad kaba jew .’
translation.en: In those days they shall say no more , The fathers have eaten a sour grape , and the children s teeth are set on edge .
But when a stronger than he shall come upon him , and overcome him , he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted , and divideth his spoils .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u briew uba kham khlaiñ u tur ïaleh ïa u bad jop ïa u , u kit noh ïa baroh ki tiar ïaleh kiba u trai u la shaniah bad u ïasam ïa kaei kaba u la lute .

translation.en: Howbeit no man spake openly of him for fear of the Jews .
translation.kha: Hynrei ym don ba ïakren ha kaba paw , namar ba ki sheptieng ïa ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw .

translation.en: ( Ecclesiastes 9 :5 ) Jesus taught that the dead will be resurrected —an unnecessary action if humans had an immortal soul .
translation.kha: ( Ekesiastis 9 :5 ) U Jisu u la hikai ba ia kiba iap yn sa pynmihpatlada ka mynsiem u briew ka im junom , yn ym donkam ban pynmihpat ia u .
Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kabu bud , uwei pa uwei u la kular Bad pynskhem da kaba shim smai . U Asaïah u khublei khatwei ïa ki , mala ki ïakhlad kum ki paralok .
translation.en: And they rose up betimes in the morning , and sware one to another : and Isaac sent them away , and they departed from him in peace .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai U Blei jong phi un ym sngap ïa u Balaam ; u pynkylla pynban ïa kata ka jingim sha ka jingkyrkhu , namar ba u ieit ïa Phi .
translation.en: Nevertheless the  Lord  thy God would not hearken unto Balaam  ; but the  Lord  thy God turned the curse into a blessing unto thee , because the  Lord  thy God loved thee .

translation.kha: Ïa u , u dieng tangon u long u lyngkhot phlangïap bad u rkhie haba ki briew ki kawang sum ïa u ,
translation.en: Darts are counted as stubble : he laugheth at the shaking of a spear .
And Judah gathered themselves together , to ask help of the  Lord  : even out of all the cities of Judah they came to seek the  Lord .
translation.kha: Na kawei pat kawei ka nongbah jong ka Judah ki briew ki leit kloi kloi sha Jerusalem ban pan na U  Trai  ïa ka jingïalam ,

translation.en: Son of man , set thy face toward the mountains of Israel , and prophesy against them ,
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew  u la ong ,  phai khmat sha ki lum ka Israel , bad to ai ïa ka khubor jong nga ha ki .

translation.en: And he said , How can I , except some man should guide me ? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him .
translation.kha: U rangbah synshar u la jubab ,  Kumno ngan lah ban sngewthuh lymda don mano mano ba batai ïa ka ha nga ?  Bad u la khot sngewbha ïa u Philip ban wan kiew bad shong ha ka kali kulai ryngkat bad u .

U Joseph hajuh u la leit na ka shnong Nasareth , kaba ha Galilaïa sha ka shnong Bethesel ha Judia , ka jaka ha naba la khah ïa Syiem Dabid . U Joseph u la leit shata namar u la long suba hiarpateng na u ïaiban .
translation.en: And Joseph also went up from Galilee , out of the city of Nazareth , into Judaea , unto the city of David , which is called Bethlehem  ; ( because he was of the house and lineage of David : )
And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves , he came , if haply he might find any thing thereon : and when he came to it , he found nothing but leaves  ; for the time of figs was not yet .
translation.kha: U la ïohi na jngai ïa u dieng Dumbur ba la tap da ki sla , kumta u la leit ban peit la u lah ban shem ki soh ha u . Hynrei haba u la wan sha uta u dieng , u la shem tang ki sla , namar kam pat dei ka por ban mih soh .
bad ki briew kiba sniew bad kiba shukor kin nang ïaid na kaba sniew sha kaba kham sniew , da kaba shukor ïa kiwei bad shah shijur ïa lade .
translation.en: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse , deceiving , and being deceived .

translation.kha: bad kano ka dei ka khana shaphang ka longïing longsem jongki u Jakob . U Joseph , u samla uba la khathynñiew snam ka mar , u ap satar ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang lem bad la ki hynmen shynrang jongno u , ki khun shynrang jong ka Bilhah bad ka Silpah , ki tnga kliar jongnga u kpa jong u . U Joseph u wanrah ki jingïathuh bymsngewtynnat ha la u kpa shaphang Kaei ba ki Ahiman jong u ki bor .
translation.en: These are the generations of Jacob . Joseph , being seventeen years old , was feeding the flock with his brethren  ; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah , and with the sons of Zilpah , his father s wives : and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report .

translation.kha: Ki wanlam sha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ ïa kaei Kaei barhem kaba u Moses u la hukum , Bad ki paidbah baroh ki ïalong ban mane ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation : and all the congregation drew near and stood before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Te kumta , kumba ka pop ka synshar da ka jingïapan , kumin ruh ka jingaiei U Blei ka synshar da ka hok , ka ïalam ïa ngi shad ka jingïam bymjukut lyngba U Jisu Khrist U Trei jong ngi .
translation.en: That as sin hath reigned unto death , even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka Khubor Baanah shaphang U Jisu Khrist , U ti U Balei .
translation.en: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ , the Son of God  ;

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa me kum ka kor khlur-kba , lem bad ki bniat kiba thymmai pynbna . Men tylliat ïa ki lumbah bad pynstet ïa ki ; ki lumrit kin lwet kum u pui pui .
translation.en: Behold , I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth : thou shalt thresh the mountains , and beat them small , and shalt make the hills as chaff .

translation.kha: Ha ka jinglyng-a kaba khraw u la duwai kham jur shuh shuh ; ka syep jong u ka la long kum ki jingiw ka snam kaba hap ha Madon .
translation.en: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly : and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , ma phi , ki bhabriew jongnga nga phim donkam thuh ban lehrain ba phin la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ngan weng noh ïa uno uno baroh uba sawdong malu uba sngewmeng , nabar phin ym ïeng ïaleh pyrshah shuh da lei leilieh ïa sa ha u lum bakyntang jong nga .
translation.en: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings , wherein thou hast transgressed against me : for then I will take away out of the midst of thee them that rejoice in thy pride , and thou shalt no more be haughty because of my holy mountain .

translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh kiba por la ai ha phi mynta ka sngew , khnang ba ma phi dara ki khun ki khiew jong phi phin manbha . Phin ïaishong sah ha kata ka ri ïa kambah U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ba kan lama ka nongkynti jong phi junom .
translation.en: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes , and his commandments , which I command thee this day , that it may go well with thee , and with thy children after thee , and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , for ever .

translation.kha: Kumta ki nong Ijipt ki thung ïa ki nongpyntrei mraw kiba pynsaja ïa ki da kaba pynbor ba kin trei ïa ki kam kiba shitom sat . Ki Israel ki thew ïa ki nongbah Pithom Bad Rameses ba kan long ki jaka kynshew jingbam u Pharaoh .
translation.en: Therefore they did set over them taskmasters to afflict them with their burdens . And they built for Pharaoh treasure cities , Pithom and Rameses .
When thou art bidden of any man to a wedding , sit not down in the highest room  ; lest a more honourable man than thou be bidden of him  ;
translation.kha: Haba uno uno u khot sngewbha ïa phi sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim , wat shong ha ki jaka bakyrpang . Ka lah ban jia ba uno uno uba kham donkam ban ïa phi u la shah khot sngewbha ,

U Tlai Badonbor Baroh u la law ïa kine ki syiem Ban khait ïa ki Dieng bad shun shna ki kynton khnang Ban kerkut ïa ka Jerusalem . U la ong , Ngi pynshitom ïa kane ka nongbah namar ka la dap da ka jingbanbeiñ .
translation.en: For thus hath the  Lord  of hosts said , Hew ye down trees , and cast a mount against Jerusalem : this is the city to be visited  ; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her .

translation.kha: Kito kiba wanrah jingeh ha la ki longïing kin ym don ei ei ha kaba kut . Ki briew Kiba bieit kin long borabor ki shakri jyllang kiba riewstad .
translation.en: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind : and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart .

translation.kha: U Hadad u ïoh ïa ka jingieid paralok bad u syiem u ai ïa ka para kynsi , ka para lad ka Syiem Tahpenes ha u Hadad ban shongkurim ïa ka .
translation.en: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh , so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife , the sister of Tahpenes the queen .

translation.kha: phangpdeng jong ki , ki long ka Mari ka nongthain Magdala , ka Mari ka kmie u Jakob bad u Josis mala ka tnga u Sebedi .
translation.en: Among which was Mary Magdalene , and Mary the mother of James and Joses , and the mother of Zebedee s children .

translation.en: Then touched he their eyes , saying ,  According to your faith be it unto you .
And whatsoever ye shall ask in my name , that will I do , that the Father may be glorified in the Son .
translation.kha: Bad ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba phi pan ha ka kyrteng jong nga , khnang ba ïa ka burom U Kpa yn ïoh pynpaw lyngba U Khun .

translation.en: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him , and fought with Amalek : and Moses , Aaron , and Hur went up to the top of the hill .

translation.kha: ktieh kiba la ju un-long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha ha ka ïit jong nga ki la klet noh ïa na ; ki shakri kynthei ki leh ïa nga kumto ïa uba kim tohjaw bad u nongwei .
translation.en: They that dwell in mine house , and my maids , count me for a stranger : I am an alien in their sight .

Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab , and upon the head of his seed for ever : but upon David , and upon his seed , and upon his house , and upon his throne , shall there be peace for ever from the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynshitom ïa ka jingshah pynïap jong ki kan hap ha u Joab bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u shi junom . Hynrei U  Trai  un ïai ai ka jingjop ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid kiba shong ha ka khet jong u .

Kumta kita ki briew ki ïam lan khiar baroh shai Sngi ha kata ka sngi , baroh shi mem , badno borbah shi sngi ha kawei pud ka sngi ; ym don uwei jin uba lum duna ïa ka shihajar kilo . Nalorkata ki thad ïa ki sawdong kata ka jaka shongsah dara .
translation.en: And the people stood up all that day , and all that night , and all the next day , and they gathered the quails : he that gathered least gathered ten homers : and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp .

translation.kha: Hynrei wir ki nongpynkha khun ki dei Ibbah sheptieng ïa U Blei ; kumta kim shym kohnguh ïa u , hynrei ki shah ba ki ïakhun shynrang kin im .
translation.en: But the midwives feared God , and did not as the king of Egypt commanded them , but saved the men children alive .
Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness , unto the mount of the daughter of Zion .
translation.kha: Na ka nongbah jong ka Sela ha ka ri shyiap , ki briew jong ka Moab ki phah u khunlangbrot kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa uta uba synshar ha Jerusalem .

translation.en: Which also king David did dedicate unto the  Lord  , with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued  ;
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u la pynkyntang ïa ki na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka jingmane , lem bad ka rupa bad ka ksiar kaba u la kurup na ki jaitbynriew kiba u la jop —
Nga don ka jingpyrkhat ba ka donhok ban Pha sha phi ïa u para jong ngi u Epaphroditos , uba la trei bad ïaleh ha syndah jong nga bad wahbah la shakri kum u nonglamktien jong phi ha kaba ïarap ïa sa .
translation.en: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus , my brother , and companion in labour , and fellowsoldier , but your messenger , and he that ministered to my wants .

translation.kha: Weng noh ïa ki nongai jingmut bymman na iitkhmat u syep , bad ïa ka jingsynshar jong u yn tip na ka pyntwa ka jingsyier hok jongnga ka .
translation.en: Take away the wicked from before the king , and his throne shall be established in righteousness .

translation.kha: Dei tang ma ki , ki ban krong ha ka Tubal lad nga , ban shakri ha ka duwan jong nga , bad ban pynïaid ïa ka jingmane ha ka Thymmai .
translation.en: They shall enter into my sanctuary , and they shall come near to my table , to minister unto me , and they shall keep my charge .

translation.kha: Na u ruh manna kiar , ñiar u la kren pyrshah ïa ka jingïalap jong ngi .
translation.en: Of whom be thou ware also ; for he hath greatly withstood our words .
For when they shall say , Peace and safety ; then sudden destruction cometh upon them , as travail upon a woman with child ; and they shall not escape .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki ong ,  Kaei kaei baroh ka jar jar bad ka shngain ,  te kynsan ka jingpynjot kan lynshop ïa ki! Kan wan kyndit kum ki jingpang kiba wan ha ka briew kaba suh kha , bad ki briew kin ym lait phet .
Un sumar ïa ka kynhun jong u kum u nongaplangbrot ; un lumlang ïa ki khunlangbrot bad un rah ïa ki ha ki ksang ti jong u ; un ïasam jai jai ïa ki kmie jong ki .
translation.en: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd : he shall gather the lambs with his arm , and carry them in his bosom , and shall gently lead those that are with young .

translation.kha: Kan long ka lynti bah hangta , ba la khot Ka lynti jong ka Jingkhuid . Yn ym don nongpdem u ban ïaid ha kata ka lynñiar ; ym don ki riewblei ki ban ïalam bakla ïa kito kba bud ïa ka .
translation.en: And an highway shall be there , and a way , and it shall be called The way of holiness  ; the unclean shall not pass over it  ; but it shall be for those : the wayfaring men , though fools , shall not err therein .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi Sabbaton ainguh ar tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang babha shisnem ka rta bad ki bym don kano kano ka jingïadon lem bad ar kilo u purew ba la khleh bad ka jingbymman Olib kum ka jingiw bam , bad ka jingainguh da ka waiñ .
translation.en: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot , and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering , mingled with oil , and the drink offering thereof :

translation.kha: U Blei u tyrwa ha me ïa ka jingpyntngen ; balei ba me tang kyntoit ïa ka ? Ngi la ïakren bad u ha ki ktien bajai jai .
translation.en: Are the consolations of God small with thee ? is there any secret thing with thee ?

translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba ai khublei da ka jingsuk , u kyllan lama uba ïatreilang ha ki kam sniew ba u ni .
translation.en: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds .

translation.en: And Rekem , and Irpeel , and Taralah ,
And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things . Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown ; but we an incorruptible .
translation.kha: Bad man uwei pa uwei u nongïamareh uba don ha ka jingshah hikai , u pyndem ha ka jinghikai kaba pyrkhing , khnang ba yn pynphong da ka pansngiat sla dieng ka bymneh ; hynrei ma ngi pat ngi ïaleh na ka bynta kata ka ban neh junom la junom .
Wah ïabam ha ka miej u briew suba khapnap lane uba kwah lalot ïa ki jingdam bang ba u pynkhreh .
translation.en: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye , neither desire thou his dainty meats :

translation.kha: dalade phi lamler ha ka ïingbishar , phin shahskhor pynshitom — yn ym dat jingpyllait .
translation.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished , and he that speaketh lies shall not escape .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba ki khur jong u Job ki dang ïathaw sngewbha ha ïing jong u hynmen lapbah dih , u nonglamktien u la wan mareh sha u Job .
translation.en: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :
And he saw that there was no man , and wondered that there was no intercessor : therefore his arm brought salvation unto him  ; and his righteousness , it sustained him .
translation.kha: U lyngngoh ban ïohi ba ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa kiba shah banbeiñ . Kumta un pyndonkam ïa la ka jong ka bor ban pyllait im ïa ki bad wanrah ïa ka jingjop .
Man ka por , nga ai jingbam ha ka miej jong nga ïa shispah basanphew ngut ki Ïwei bad ki nongïalam jong ki , namar ki biria Kiba wan sha nga na ki jaitbynriew uba don sawdong .
translation.en: Moreover there were at my table an hundred and fifty of the Jews and rulers , beside those that came unto us from among the heathen that are about us .

Now therefore , I pray thee , hearken thou also unto the voice of thine handmaid , and let me set a morsel of bread before thee  ; and eat , that thou mayest have strength , when thou goest on thy way .
translation.kha: Mynta pat , sngewbha leh ïa kaba nga ong . Shah ngan wanrah bam ïa phi . Phi dei ban bam ba phin dup ïohbor ynda phi leit sha la ka jingleit .
Ha kaba khatsaw u la kyndit bahynriew malade u la nguh , ‘ Baroh ki nongleit wai jong i pa jongu ar ki don kyrhai ba ïa kaba ki lah ban bam , pynlang nga pat hangne ngan sa ïapthngan !
translation.en: And when he came to himself , he said , How many hired servants of my father s have bread enough and to spare , and I perish with hunger !

translation.kha: U Hotham u para jong u , u don saw ngut ki khun shynrang : u Shaphat , u Imna , u Shelesh , malade u Amam .
translation.en: And the sons of his brother Helem  ; Zophah , and Imna , and Shelesh , and Amal .

translation.kha: Na ka khet la mih ki jingpeitbha leilieh , ki jingkyrhuh , ki jingsawa u pyrthat . Ha khmih jong ka khet , la kein hynrei tylli ki dongmusa bameh , kiba long ki iehnoh ki mynsiem jong U Blei .
translation.en: And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices : and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne , which are the seven Spirits of God .

translation.kha: ( Salm 119 :97-100 ) Ki Khristan bashisha ki burom ïa ki aiñ jong U blang ym namarba ki ïoh jingmyntoi ïadait .
translation.en: ( Psalm 119 :97-100 ) Yet , true Christians do not respect God’s standards merely to benefit themselves .

translation.kha: Ki sngi ki la poi , ong U Trai , haba u kew un san stet ban ïa kaba ha ban ot , bad ki sohwaiñ kan san stet baneh ïa ka waiñ ba lah shun shniah . Ki lumbah kin lip da ka waiñ kaba thiang , bad ki lumrit kin tuid da ka .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that the plowman shall overtake the reaper , and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed  ; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine , and all the hills shall melt .

translation.kha: Nga ngan ïeng ha khmat jong me ha u mawlynnai ha u Lum synñiang . Tied ïa u mawsiang ; te ka um kan sa mih na u ba u paidbah un ïoh dih . U Moses u leh kumta ha ka jingainong jingkad ki jingïalam jong ki Israel .
translation.en: Behold , I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb  ; and thou shalt smite the rock , and there shall come water out of it , that the people may drink . And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba ki khun lad u Job ki dang ïakhawai sngewbha ha ïit jong u hynmen rangbah duh , u nonglamktien u la wan mareh sha u Job .
translation.en: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :
And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about .
translation.kha: Bad ka jingïathuh shaphang U Jisu ka la phriang kylleng ha kata ka thain .
U Moses u la bteng ban kren ha u Khroh , Da sngap bha , phi ki Lebi !
translation.en: And Moses said unto Korah , Hear , I pray you , ye sons of Levi :

translation.en: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar , as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings : and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin , and it shall be forgiven him .
But beware of men : for they will deliver you up to the councils , and they will scourge you in their synagogues  ;

translation.en: Thus were both the daughters of Lot with child by their father .

translation.en: All the valiant men arose , and went all night , and took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth–shan , and came to Jabesh , and burnt them there .

translation.en: And it came to pass , as they sat at the table , that the word of the  Lord  came unto the prophet that brought him back :

translation.en: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days  ; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee , neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters .

translation.kha: Kumba nga la pyllait im ïa ka jingtem jong phiah ha khie ka snieh , ai ba U Trai un leh kumjuh ïa nga bad pyllait ïa nga na ki jingjynjar jong ar baroh !
translation.en: And , behold , as thy life was much set by this day in mine eyes , so let my life be much set by in the eyes of the  Lord  , and let him deliver me out of all tribulation .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei un ïakynduh ïa kajuh ka kupar — ki lyngkhuh sad ki briew , ki mraw bad ki kynrad , Ibbah thied bad kiba die , kiba ai kylliang bad naba shim kylliang , kiba riewspah bad kiba duk .
translation.en: And it shall be , as with the people , so with the priest  ; as with the servant , so with his master  ; as with the maid , so with her mistress  ; as with the buyer , so with the seller  ; as with the lender , so with the borrower  ; as with the taker of usury , so with the giver of usury to him .

translation.kha: Kumba ki la kylli ïa U Jisu , Me ïohsngew ïa Kaei kaba ki ong ? Ho-oid nga ïohsngew , la jubab U Ujuh . Phim pat la ju pule ïa kane ka jingthiah Bakhuid ? ‘ Me la hikai ïa ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ban ai ki jingïar bajanai .’
translation.en: And said unto him , Hearest thou what these say ? And Jesus saith unto them ,  Yea  ; have ye never read , Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise ?

translation.kha: Sharum ban ym dih wat lane dih kyiad , lane bam ïa Kanaan kano ka bymkhuid ;
translation.en: Now therefore beware , I pray thee , and drink not wine nor strong drink , and eat not any unclean thing :

translation.en: In your patience possess ye your souls .

translation.kha: Ka por kan poi haba phin kyang sha U  Trai  , hynrei un ym jubab ïa phi . Un ym sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong phi , naba phi la leh ïa kaba sniew .
U shna hynñiew tylli ki sharak na ka bynta uta u diengpynïeng sharak , bad u thaw shiah ïa ki nap mala ki jingdiang jong u da ka ksiang nylla .
translation.en: And he made his seven lamps , and his snuffers , and his snuffdishes , of pure gold .

hynrei pa dei ban kohnguh ïa u bad sumar ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh ïa kiba la thom ha kane ka kitab jong ki jinghikai jong u . Pha dei ban phai sha u da ka dohnud bad ka mynsiem jong phi baroh .
translation.en: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God , to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law , and if thou turn unto the  Lord  thy God with all thine heart , and with all thy soul .

translation.kha: Baalah ba ki synran jong me kim kohnguh ïa ka jinghikai ba la ai pateng da ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ? Kim ju thet ïa la ki kti ha ka rukom kaban dei ha suk ba kin bam !
translation.en: Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders ? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread .
By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry : they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty .

translation.en: And we dreamed a dream in one night , I and he  ; we dreamed each man according to the interpretation of his dream .

translation.en: If any of you lack wisdom , let him ask of God , that giveth to all men liberally , and upbraideth not  ; and it shall be given him .

translation.en: And he said , Thou canst not see my face : for there shall no man see me , and live .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngi , ngi long ki jong U Blei . Uno uno uba ithuh ïa U Blei , u shahshkor ïa ngi ; uno Une u i long u jong U Blei , um shahshkor ïa ngi . Kane te , ka long kum i lah ban ïathuh ïa ka jingïapher hapdeng U Mynsiem ka jingriam bad u mynsaw ka jinglamler .
translation.en: We are of God : he that knoweth God heareth us  ; he that is not of God heareth not us . Hereby know we the spirit of truth , and the spirit of error .

translation.en: And the king , and all the people that were with him , came weary , and refreshed themselves there .

translation.en: The bonnets , and the ornaments of the legs , and the headbands , and the tablets , and the earrings ,

translation.kha: Ulla uba ot u ïoh la ka tieng bad u Lum ïa ka jingmih na ka pyntwa ka jingim bymjukut ; ba ithuh uba set pynlang uta uba ot kin ïaskhem lang .
translation.en: And he that reapeth receiveth wages , and gathereth fruit unto life eternal : that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together .

translation.kha: Ai ha ki Israel ïa kine ki hukum ngon :
translation.en: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them .

translation.kha: khñiang ba phin ïoh kad kynti biang ïa kata ka ri ha kob ki kpa tymmen jrong phi ki la shong shiliang . Un pynmanbha bad un pynroi ïa phi khem bun shah ban ïa kaba u la leh ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
translation.en: And the  Lord  thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed , and thou shalt possess it  ; and he will do thee good , and multiply thee above thy fathers .

translation.kha: Ki Briew jong kane ka nongbat ki la pynbitar bad pynbitar sleh ïa nga naduh ka sngew ba la thaw ïa ka .
translation.en: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day  ; that I should remove it from before my face ,

translation.kha: Te u Shadrakh , u Meshekh , bad u Abednego , kaba dang sha khum , ki la hap sha ka pdeng jong ka ding baklang .
translation.en: And these three men , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace .

translation.kha: Nangta u Suah u pah khubor sha u Jesse : Nga sngewbha eh ïa u dabi . Ieh un sah hangne ha ka jingtrei bad nga .
translation.en: And Saul sent to Jesse , saying , Let David , I pray thee , stand before me  ; for he hath found favour in my sight .
Of the Izharites , Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel , for officers and judges .
translation.kha: Napdeng kiba hiarpateng na u Ishar , ïa u Khenanaïah bad ki khun shynrang jong u la buh ban peit ïa ki kam synshar khadar : Kaba buh jingthoh bad kaba bishar ïa ki paid Israel .

translation.en: But he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , as did Manasseh his father : for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made , and served them  ;
translation.kha: Kum u Manasseh u kpa jong u , u la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , bad u la mane ïa ki bleithaw kiba u kpa jong u , u la mane .
ba un pynum ïa ngi na ki nongshna jong ngi , na ka bor jong kito baroh kiba tun ïa ngi .
translation.en: That we should be saved from our enemies , and from the hand of all that hate us  ;

translation.kha: Nga pdiang jingsngewbha ïa Kane ha kylleng kylleng bad ha ki por baroh , Bad moi da sngewnguh eh ïa me .
translation.en: We accept it always , and in all places , most noble Felix , with all thankfulness .

translation.kha: Kawei ka dak kan pyn-i ïa u Syiem ïa ka lynti sha Rabbah ka nongbah ki Ammon , bad kawei pah ka lynti sha Judah , sha Jerusalem ka nongbah ba la ker kynroh .
translation.en: Appoint a way , that the sword may come to Rabbah of the Ammonites , and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced .

translation.kha: Pynban , ki dat ban pyn-i ba ki long borabor kiba bha bad ba lah ban shaniah , khnang ban pynshah ïa ka jingïakhih shaphang U balui U Nongpynim jong ngi ha baroh ba ki leh .
translation.en: Not purloining , but shewing all good fidelity ; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things .

translation.kha: Ka jingmane bleithaw jong ki ka pynlong ïa U Trai ban ym lah shah , ki kam bymman jrong ki , ki la pynlong ïa u ban skei .
translation.en: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods , with abominations provoked they him to anger .

translation.kha: Waw ïa iwei u diengphasi sharak da ka ksiew nylla . Shna ïa ka trai malade ka met lad u da ka ksiar ba la shu shoh . Ki syntiew ba la oh-shrong lad u kiba kynthup ïa ki shylluit bad ki sla syntiew jong ki , ktien ïasoh lang kawei bad u .
translation.en: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold : of beaten work shall the candlestick be made : his shaft , and his branches , his bowls , his knops , and his flowers , shall be of the same .

And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God , and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God , and shut up the doors of the house of the  Lord  , and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nalor kata u shim ïa baroh ïa ki khiew ki pliang jong ka Templ , bad u pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki ; u khang noh ïa ka Templ , bad u tei ki duwan ha man la ki dong jong ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , and Shebna , and Joah , unto Rab–shakeh , Speak , I pray thee , to thy servants in the Syrian language  ; for we understand it : and talk not with us in the Jews  language in the ears of the people that are on the wall .
translation.kha: Nangta u Eliakim , u Shebna , bad u Joah ki ïathuh ïa u rangbah synshar ,  Kren ha ka ktien Aramaik ïa ngi , ko kynrad . Ngi sngewthuh ïa ka . Wat kren ha ka ktien Hebru ; baroh ki briew ha ka kynroh ki ïasngap .
Ki khum shynrang jong u syiem ka Syria kin pynkhreh ïa ka thma bad ki ïalum ka kynhun shipai bakhlaiñbor . Kawei na ki ka sorkar khem ka jingshlei um bad kan tur ïaleh ïa ka kut jong u nongshun .
translation.en: But his sons shall be stirred up , and shall assemble a multitude of great forces : and one shall certainly come , and overflow , and pass through : then shall he return , and be stirred up , even to his fortress .
And they put his armour in the house of Ashtoreth : and they fastened his body to the wall of Beth–shan .
translation.kha: Nangta ki buh ïa ki tiar ïapom jong u ha ka ïing mane jong ka blei Astarte , bad ki sahnar ïa ka met jong u ha ka kynroh jong ka nongbah Beth Shan .
Baroh la pyndonkam ban siew ïa ki nongdie bad ban thied ïa ki tiar ha kaba shna pynbha .
translation.en: But they gave that to the workmen , and repaired therewith the house of the  Lord .
Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird , the birds round about are against her  ; come ye , assemble all the beasts of the field , come to devour .
translation.kha: Ki briew ba la jied jong nga ki long kum ka sim kaba la shah tur ïaleh ha ki kbeit na baroh ki liang . To khot ïa ki mradkhlaw ban wan bad ïashim bynta ha ka jingkhawai !
Bad lada phi lehbha tyngka ïa kito kiba lehbha ïa phi , balei phoi dei ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongpop ki kuna kumta !
translation.en: And if ye do good to them which do good to you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also do even the same .

translation.kha: U jubab , Sngewbha kylli ïa u Syiem Salome — nga tip un ym kyrjaw ïa Phi — ban shat ïa na ban ïoh ïa ka Abishag , ka theisamla na Shunem , kum ka tnga jong nga .
translation.en: And he said , Speak , I pray thee , unto Solomon the king , ( for he will not say thee nay , ) that he give me Abishag the Shunammite to wife .

translation.kha: U dei ban long uba batskhem ïa ka Khubor kaba lah ba shaniah bad kaba ïadei Bad ka jinghikai shongtynrai . Ha kane ka rukom un lah ban ai mynsiem ïa khiew da ka jinghikai bashisha bad ban pyn-i ruh ïa ka jingijli jong iar kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa ka .
translation.en: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught , that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers .

translation.kha: utai u briew u la jubab , ‘ Ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jong me da la ka dohnud baroh , bad da la ka mynsiem baroh , da la ka jingkhlaiñ borbah , bad da la ka jingmut Borbah’ ; bad ‘ Ieit ïa la u paramarjan kumba me ieid ïa lade .’
translation.en: And he answering said , Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy strength , and with all thy mind  ; and thy neighbour as thyself .
And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore .
translation.kha: Ïa kane la kynmaw kum ka kam babha jong u naduh kata ka por bad yn ïai kynmaw ha ki por baroh ki ban wan .
Naduh myntoi ïa ka longïing kaba don san ngut yn phiah , ki lai ngut pyrshah ïa ki ar ngut bun ki ar nongput pyrshah ïa ki lah ngut .
translation.en: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided , three against two , and two against three .

translation.kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u sha khmat ka jingthang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong sa malu wanrah ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh , ka umphniang pynsleh , u masi lyngraw ban long ka jingkñia namar ka pop , ar tylli ki blang shynrang , bad ka shang ba bah ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat .
translation.en: Take Aaron and his sons with him , and the garments , and the anointing oil , and a bullock for the sin offering , and two rams , and a basket of unleavened bread  ;

translation.kha: Kumta baroh ki nongïalam jong ki Israel ki la wan sha u Syiem Dabid ha Hebron . U la pynpang ïa jingïateh lok bakyntang bad ki , ki la pynsleh ïa u , bad u la long u syep ki Israel .
translation.en: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron  ; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before the  Lord  : and they anointed David king over Israel .

translation.kha: Nangta u angel uba hynñiew u la theh noh ïa ka pliang jong u ha saiñ . Ka sur kaba jam ka la wan na ka khet kaba ha ka templ , ka da ong , La pyndep !
translation.en: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air  ; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven , from the throne , saying , It is done .

translation.kha: Nangta uta u angel u la shim ïa kata ka pliang Thang jingpyniwbih , u la pyndap ïa ka da ki rnga ding barhem na ka duwan , bad u la bret ïa ka hajir ka khyndew . La don ki jingkyrhuh bad ki jingsawa u pyrkhat , ki jingthaba leilieh , bad u jumai .
translation.en: And the angel took the censer , and filled it with fire of the altar , and cast it into the earth : and there were voices , and thunderings , and lightnings , and an earthquake .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka sngi phi la pyn-i haduh katno phi long uba bha ïa por , ibha phim shym la pynïap ïa to , wat la U Trai u la buh ïa nga ha ka bor jong phi .
translation.en: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me : forasmuch as when the  Lord  had delivered me into thine hand , thou killedst me not .

translation.kha: Ha nga , ka ïingsyiem Judah ka long kaba itynnat kum ka ri Gilead , bad kum ki lumbah Lebanon ; hynrei ngan pynlong ïa ka , ka jaka kynjah ha Kaba yn ym to bashong basah .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  unto the king s house of Judah  ; Thou art Gilead unto me , and the head of Lebanon : yet surely I will make thee a wilderness , and cities which are not inhabited .

translation.kha: Ka jinghikai jong nga kun hap kum ki jingjaw shok , mala kane jreiñ ha khyndew kum ka umjer . Ki ktien jong nga kin hap kum u lap praw ha ki jingthung ba dang lung , khem u slap ñiup ñiup ha u phlang ba dang lung .
translation.en: My doctrine shall drop as the rain , my speech shall distil as the dew , as the small rain upon the tender herb , and as the showers upon the grass :

translation.kha: bad kum ka bainong namar ka pop jongno u , u dei ban ïam sha U Trai’ ïa ka langbrot ne ka bneng kynthei kum ka jingainguh . U Lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop Jong uta u briew .
translation.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  for his sin which he hath sinned , a female from the flock , a lamb or a kid of the goats , for a sin offering  ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin .

translation.kha: Nangta ïa u Khuid , uba la shukor ïa ki , la bret sha ka pung ka ding malade u kyndok , ha kaba la lah briew ïa u mradkhlaw bad ïa u nongïathuhlypa lamler , bad kin shah pynkordit mynhynne bad mynmiet junom la junom .
translation.en: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone , where the beast and the false prophet are , and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever .

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynlong ka jutang malu ki bad u la hukum ïa ki : Wat mane ïa Kiwei ki blei ; wat dem khrup ha ki lin shakri ïa ki lane ai ki jingkñia ïa ki .
translation.en: With whom the  Lord  had made a covenant , and charged them , saying , Ye shall not fear other gods , nor bow yourselves to them , nor serve them , nor sacrifice to them :

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew ki la thynrang palat bad ki la ïai khñium ha u Moses . Ki la ong , Balei keiñ ba Phin wan ïabam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt ? Hato phi mut ban pynïap da ka jingsuhsieng ïa ngi bad ïa ki khun ki kti jong ngi , bad ïa ki jingri jong ngi ?
translation.en: And the people thirsted there for water  ; and the people murmured against Moses , and said , Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt , to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst ?

translation.kha: U shatri uba ar u la wan bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga la kamai san tylli ki sbai ksiar na kawei kaba me la ai ha nga .’
translation.en: And the second came , saying , Lord , thy pound hath gained five pounds .

Who hath ascended up into heaven , or descended ? who hath gathered the wind in his fists ? who hath bound the waters in a garment ? who hath established all the ends of the earth ? what is his name , and what is his son s name , if thou canst tell ?
translation.kha: Uei uba la ju long kynrad ïa ka jingtip ba kynja bneng ? Uei uba la ju kham ïa ka lyer ha la ka kti ? Lane uba la tehsong ïa ka um ha ka jaiñ lyngkhot ? Lane uba la pynskhem ïa ki pud jong ka pyrthei ? U dei uei lada phi tip ? Uei u khun jong u ?
Phi wat sngewlyngngoh , ko ki para jyllang nga , ïada ki briew’ jong ka pyrthei ki isih ïa phi .
translation.en: Marvel not , my brethren , if the world hate you .

Let them therefore give us two bullocks  ; and let them choose one bullock for themselves , and cut it in pieces , and lay it on wood , and put no fire under : and I will dress the other bullock , and lay it on wood , and put no fire under :
translation.kha: Wallam ar tylli ki masi dab ; ai ba ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal kin shim uwei , pynïap ïa u , ot lyngkhot lyngkhot ïa u bad buh halor ki diengthang — hynrei wat pynmeh ding . Nga ruh ngan leh kumjuh ïa uwei pat u masi dab .

translation.en: If any man among you seem to be religious , and bridleth not his tongue , but deceiveth his own heart , this man s religion is vain .
translation.kha: Hato don uno uno uba pyrkhat ba u long uba riewblei ? Lada um synshar ïa la u thylliej , ka jinglong riewblei jong u kam myntoi bad u shukor ïa lade .
Te phin ïong , ‘ Lymda u para khaweh jong phi! u wan ngan bad phi , yn ym shah shuh ïa Phin ban wan ha khmat Jong nga .’
translation.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants , Except your youngest brother come down with you , ye shall see my face no more .

translation.kha: Ki tuh ïateh kum ki khla-ka-wait ; ki kiew ïa ki kynran kum ki shipai . Ki baroh ki ïadait beit sha khmat bad Kim phai sha kadiang ne kamon
translation.en: They shall run like mighty men  ; they shall climb the wall like men of war  ; and they shall march every one on his ways , and they shall not break their ranks :

translation.kha: Nga la kwah ban lum ïa ki briew jong nga , kumba u briew u lumlang ïa ka jingot jong u ; hynrei ki longïng kum u dieng sohwaiñ khlem ki sohwaiñ , kum u diengsoh Dumbur khlem ki soi Dumbur ; ki ki sla ki la jyllop . Namar kata , nga la shah ïa kiba nabar ban shim ne ïa ka ri .
translation.en: I will surely consume them , saith the  Lord  : there shall be no grapes on the vine , nor figs on the fig tree , and the leaf shall fade  ; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them .

translation.kha: Don synsar jait ki mrad kiba rit ha ka pyrthei , hynrei kiba sian shikatdei eh :
translation.en: There be four things which are little upon the earth , but they are exceeding wise :

translation.kha: “Nga sah” ïa baroh ki lapbah synshar ka ïit jingkynshew ha ka proberb jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi ban pynbiang khlem pynslem ïa u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad ha ka Hukum jong U Blei ka Bneng , ïa kaei Kaei baroh kaba u pan ,
translation.en: And I , even I Artaxerxes the king , do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river , that whatsoever Ezra the priest , the scribe of the law of the God of heaven , shall require of you , it be done speedily ,

translation.kha: Kumta ka Miriam ka shah khangkdong Shabar ka jaka syier dara ingiew sngi , bad kita ki briew kim shym la mihnoh haka ynda la wan ïalumlang pat ïa ka shaphang .
translation.en: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days : and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingbymman ki Israel bad ki pop jong ki la buh jingthoh , malu ïa ki jingthoh la buh bha khap .
translation.en: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up  ; his sin is hid .

translation.kha: Ka jingpyndem ïa ka jingshah pynïap jong ki kan hap ha u Joab bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u shi junom . Hynrei U Trai un ïai ai ka jingjop ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid Kiba shong ha ka khait jong u .
translation.en: Their blood shall therefore return upon the head of Joab , and upon the head of his seed for ever : but upon David , and upon his seed , and upon his house , and upon his throne , shall there be peace for ever from the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Bela u ïai-ong ha u Abraham , Me ruh me dei ban mynjur ban bat ïa ka jutang bun nga , ma me bad ki khun ki ktieh jngai me ha ki pateng ban wan .
translation.en: And God said unto Abraham , Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore , thou , and thy seed after thee in their generations .

And Elisha came again to Gilgal : and there was a dearth in the land  ; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him : and he said unto his servant , Set on the great pot , and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets .
translation.kha: Shisien , haba la don ka  nemsniew ha kylleng ka ri , u Elisha u la leit phai sha Gilgal . Katba u dang hikai ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa , u la ong ïa u shakri jong u ban tiew ïa u khiew uba heh ha ding bad shet syrwa na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God : on them which fell , severity ; but toward thee , goodness , if thou continue in his goodness : otherwise thou also shalt be cut off .
translation.kha: Hangne ngi ïohi katno U Blei u long uba sbun bad katno u long uba eh . U long uba eh ïa kito kiba la kyllon , hynrei uba sbun ïa phi — lada phi ïaineh ha ka jingsbun jong u . Hynrei lada phim leh kumta , ma phi ruh phin sa shah pynkheiñ .
Shim umdih ïa baroh ki jait jingbam kiba donkam na ka bynta jngai me bad na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: And take thou unto thee of all food that is eaten , and thou shalt gather it to thee  ; and it shall be for food for thee , and for them .

translation.kha: Bad la to bun ki briew kiba pang ñiewshiliang Kiba la im ha Israel ha ka por jong u Elisha u nongïathuhlypa ; pynban ym shym la pynkhiah ïa uno uno na ki , hynrei , tang ïa u Naaman u nong Sarai .
translation.en: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet  ; and none of them was cleansed , saving Naaman the Syrian .

translation.kha: Wat bam na uta u kew thymmai , la uba dang im , ne uba la sdieh pyrthiew , ne uba la pynlong kpu , tad haduh ba phi la wallam ïa kane ka jingkñia ainguh sha U Blei! . Kanneh ka long ka hukum kaba ki Kynhun ki kyrsiew jong phoi ki dem ban leh pateng la pateng .
translation.en: And ye shall eat neither bread , nor parched corn , nor green ears , until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings .
A dreadful sound is in his ears : in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him .
translation.kha: Ki jingsawa ba-sngewtriem kin pah ha ki shkor jong ki , bad ki nonglute kin wan kurup ïa ki haba ki dang pyrkhat ba ki shngain .

translation.en: These are the inheritances , which Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel , divided for an inheritance by lot in Shiloh before the  Lord  , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation . So they made an end of dividing the country .
translation.kha: U Eleasar u lyngdoh , u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , bad ki nongïalam jong ki jait Israel ki la ai ïa kine ki bynta jong ka ri da kaba kynting sbai ban ïakren ïa U  Trai  ha Shiloh , ha ka jaka rung sha ka Ïingjaiñ ka jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ha kane ka rukom ki la pyndep ka jingpynbynta ïa ka ri .

translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; When I shall make thee a desolate city , like the cities that are not inhabited  ; when I shall bring up the deep upon thee , and great waters shall cover thee  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong :  Ngan pynlong ïa pha kaba shah iehnoh kum ki nongbah ba la pynjot ha kaba ym don mano mano ban shong hangta . Ngan tap ïa pha da ka um jong ki jingjylliew ka duriaw-bah .

translation.en: And they all forsook him , and fled .
translation.kha: Te baroh ki synran ki la iehnoh ïa u bad ki la ïaphet noh .
Hynrei U Blei u kren ha u Shemaïah u nonghiarpateng
translation.en: But the word of God came unto Shemaiah the man of God , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka la ong ha lade , Lada nga tang shu ïohktah ïa ka jaiñkup jong u , ngan sa koit .
translation.en: For she said within herself , If I may but touch his garment , I shall be whole .

translation.kha: dondor ka Kiriath Abel ( lane ka Kherith Jearim ) bun ka Rabbah : ar tylli ki Nongbah lem bad ki nongrit Sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: Kirjath–baal , which is Kirjath–jearim , and Rabbah  ; two cities with their villages :

Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies , who vexed them : and in the time of their trouble , when they cried unto thee , thou heardest them from heaven  ; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours , who saved them out of the hand of their enemies .
translation.kha: kiba ong ïa ki ba ki dei ban phai pat sha me . Ki la ñiewbeiñ ïa me na ka por sha ka por , ba kumta me shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban jop bad synshar ïa ki . Ha ka jingeh jong ki , ki khot ïa me na ka bynta ka jingïarap , bad me jubab ïa ki na bneng . Ha ka jingisynei bakhraw me phah ki nongïalam ïa ki kiba pyllait ïa ki na ki nongshun jong ki .

translation.en: So man lieth down , and riseth not : till the heavens be no more , they shall not awake , nor be raised out of their sleep .
translation.kha: kumta ki briew ki ïap , khlem lah shuh ban khie . Kin ym lah ban kyndit shuh katba ka sahit bneng ka dang ïaishah ; kin ym lah ban khih shuh lano lano na ka jingïohthiah jong ki .

translation.en: And thy issue , which thou begettest after them , shall be thine , and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance .
translation.kha: Lada men dang ïoh khun shuh nalor jong ki , kita kin ym dei ki jong nga ; kano kano ka bynta kaba kin ïohpateng kan wan na u Ephraim bad u Manasseh .

translation.en: Then the king , when he heard these words , was sore displeased with himself , and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him : and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him .
translation.kha: Haba u syiem u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la sngewsih eh bad u la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban shem lad ban pyllait im ïa u Daniel . U la ïai pyrshang haduh ban da sep sngi .
Hadien ka jingïap u Saul , u ïaiban u wan phai na ka jingjop jong u ïa ki Amalek bad u kamar-tama ar sngi ha Siklag .
translation.en: Now it came to pass after the death of Saul , when David was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites , and David had abode two days in Ziklag  ;

translation.kha: Tang ma me bad ki khun shynrang jong me ki dien ban pynmihpat ïa ki jingbahkhlieh na ka bynta ka Jaka Kyntang bad ka duwan , khnang ba ngan ym khie kutlad shuh ïa ki paid Israel .
translation.en: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary , and the charge of the altar : that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Ka pynrieh kam shym long kaba bha na ka bynta jong ki ! Kum ki nongphetwir ki shang kylleng ha ki ri shyiap bad sha ki lam , ki da shongneh ha ki Keramim bad ha ki thliew kiba to ha ka khihwin .
translation.en: ( Of whom the world was not worthy : ) they wandered in deserts , and in mountains , and in dens and caves of the earth .

translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong I ki la da don shapoh ka nongpang Dan ; ngi ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa pynhiar mynsiem jong ki Kulai jong ki . Ka ri baroh kadei ka khynñiuh haba ki kulai jongu ki , ki pah . Ki nongshun jong ngi ki la wan ban pynjot ïa ka ri jong ine bad ïa kiwei kiei baroh kiba ha ka , ka nongbah jong ngi bad baroh ki briew jong ka .
translation.en: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan : the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones  ; for they are come , and have devoured the land , and all that is in it  ; the city , and those that dwell therein .
And it shall be Aaron s and his sons   ; and they shall eat it in the holy place : for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire by a perpetual statute .
translation.kha: Uta u kpu u dei na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u . Ki dei ban bam ïa u ha ka jaka kaba kyntang , naba uta u long ka bynta kaba kyntang eh na ki jingainguh bam ba la kñia sha U  Trai  na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh  ; he shall see it , and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon , and to his children , because he hath wholly followed the  Lord .
translation.kha: lait tang u Kaleb u khun jong u Jephunneh . U te u ïaineh ha nga , kumta ngan ai ha u bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba u la leit syntiat .’
Hato don uno uno wahbah kham matlah ban ïa u shakri jong nga , uba kham kyllut ban ïa u nongpynim ba nga phah ?
translation.en: Who is blind , but my servant ? or deaf , as my messenger that I sent ? who is blind as he that is perfect , and blind as the  Lord s  servant ?

translation.kha: U Pilat u la kren biang ha u paidbah , Kaei te , phi kwah ïa nga ban leh ïa Uta uba phin khot u syiem jong ki Jiw ?
translation.en: And Pilate answered and said again unto them , What will ye then that I shall do unto him whom ye call the King of the Jews ?

And I will punish him and his seed and his servants for their iniquity  ; and I will bring upon them , and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and upon the men of Judah , all the evil that I have pronounced against them  ; but they hearkened not .
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa me , ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me , bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong me namar ki pop kiba ma phi baroh phi la leh . Ma me lymne ki briew ka Jerusalem bad Judah ki la sngap ïa ki jingmaham jong nga , bad kumta ngan wallam halor baroh ïa ka jingpynjot ïa kaba nga la dep kren pyrshah .

Nga kwah ïa me ba men sah ha Ephesos , kumba nga la bthah ïa me mynbarim por la don ha ka lynti sha Makedonia . Don na ki briew hangamei kiba la ai ïa ki jinghikai lamler , bad me dei ban maham ïa ki banbeiñ sangeh .
translation.en: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus , when I went into Macedonia , that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine ,
Every Kingdom Hall of Jehovah’s Witnesses bears God’s holy name .
translation.kha: Man la ka Ïing Hima jong ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong U Blei .
To ïabah shithi ban pynneh ïa ka jingurlong shi tylli ïa kaba U Mynsiem u ai lyngba ka jingsuk kaba tehsong lang ïa phi .
translation.en: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace .

translation.kha: Ïa u Asaph la thung Nongïalam bad ïa u Sekharaïah kum u nongïarap . La thung ïa u Jeiel , u Shemiramoth , u Jehiel , u Mattithaïah , u Elisheba , u Benaïah , u Obed ephod bad u Jeiel ban tem ki tiduh . U Asaph un pynsawa ki shakuriaw ,
translation.en: Asaph the chief , and next to him Zechariah , Jeiel , and Shemiramoth , and Jehiel , and Mattithiah , and Eliab , and Benaiah , and Obed–edom : and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps  ; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals  ;

translation.kha: u khlong ïa ka kiar na ki jingkhang ka templ mala ïa ka ksiar kaba u hi u la thop ïa ki sohkew jingkyang , bad u pah lut ïa ka sha u Sennakherib .
translation.en: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of the  Lord  , and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Judah had overlaid , and gave it to the king of Assyria .
As also ye have acknowledged us in part , that we are your rejoicing , even as ye also are ours in the day of the Lord Jesus .
translation.kha: Ngi thoh sha phi tang ïa kaba phi lah ban pule bad sngewthuh . Hynrei wat lada phi sngewthuh ïa ngi mynta tang katto katne , nga kyrmen ba phin poi sha kata ka jingsngewthuh kaba pura , khnang ba ha ka Sngi jong U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi phin ïoh sngewsarong ïa ngi kumba ngi sngewsarong ïa phi .

U Dabid u la duwai , A Blei , nga long ma nga uta Uba la ai bakla . Ngam dei uta uba la hukum ban khep briew . Kine ki paidbah bapop ki la leh aïu ? A Trai , U Blei’ jong nga , pynshitom ïa per bad ïa ka longsyiem jong nga , bad Pyllait ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: And David said unto God , Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered ? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed  ; but as for these sheep , what have they done ? let thine hand , I pray thee , O  Lord  my God , be on me , and on my father s house  ; but not on thy people , that they should be plagued .
And it shall come to pass in that day , that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision , when he hath prophesied  ; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive :
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don nongïathuhlypa u ban sngewsarong ïa ki jingïohipaw jong u lane leh kum u nongïathuhlypa lane kup ïa ka jaiñkup bakhain jong u nongïathuhlypa khnang ban shukor ïa ki briew .
Hato me ïohsngew pateng ïa ki jingthmu U Blei ïa kiba u la jingaiti ? Hattush ka jingstad briew ka dei ka jong me marwei ?
translation.en: Hast thou heard the secret of God ? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself ?

translation.kha: ?(Nga la ioh ka jingïohipaw jong ki jingjai ba-ishyrkhei , ka jingïohipaw ïa ka jingkylla malade ka jingpynjot . Ko kynhun shipai lad ka Elam , to tur ïaleh ! Ko kynhun shipai jong ka Media , to kerkut ïa ki nongbah ! U Balei un pynkut ïa ka jingshitom kaba la wanrah da ka Babilon .
translation.en: A grievous vision is declared unto me  ; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously , and the spoiler spoileth . Go up , O Elam : besiege , O Media  ; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease .

translation.kha: Don ka Maon , ka Karmel , ka Siph , ka Juttah ,
translation.en: Maon , Carmel , and Ziph , and Juttah ,
But if they will not obey , I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew kam kohnguh , te ngan rat lut khoit bad pynjot ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Nangta ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ïakynduh lang ha ka ïing paki dulan jong u ïaphai , u Rangbah Lyngdoh ,
translation.en: Then assembled together the chief priests , and the scribes , and the elders of the people , unto the palace of the high priest , who was called Caiaphas ,

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u la mane ïa u Ïakjakor namar ba u la ai ïa la ka bor synshar ha uta u mradkhlaw . Ki la mane duh ïa Utai u mradkhlaw , bad ki la ino , utai wahbah kum u mradkhlaw ? Uei uba lah ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa u ?
translation.en: And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast : and they worshipped the beast , saying , Who is like unto the beast ? who is able to make war with him ?

translation.kha: Lada u kynran diengtied sha ka nongbah , ki briew jong ngi baroh kin ïalam ïa ki thyllah pynlang kin shu tan ïa ka nongbah shapoh ka ih . Yn ym ne uwei hajuh u maw ïa uba yn iehnoh ha kliar lut .
translation.en: Moreover , if he be gotten into a city , then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city , and we will draw it into the river , until there be not one small stone found there .

translation.kha: naduh ka jingpynïap ïa u Abel haduh ka jingpynïap ïa u Sekharaïah , Uba la shahïap pynïap hapdeng ka jingnguh bad ka jongka Bakyntang . Ho-oid , de ong ha phi , ba ïa ki briew jong kane ka juk yn pynshitom na ka bynta jyllang ki baroh !
translation.en: From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias , which perished between the altar and the temple : verily I say unto you , It shall be required of this generation .
The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon , shall the inhabitant of Zion say  ; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea , shall Jerusalem say .
translation.kha: To ai ba ki briew ka Seïon kin ong ,  To ai ba ka Babilonia kan kitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jinglehbor halor jong ngi !  To ai ba ki briew ka Jerusalem kin ong ,  To ai ba ka Babilonia kan kitkhlieh na ka bynta kaei kaba ngi la shahshitom !
To ngin ïai pyrshang ban tip ïa U Terah . Da shisha un sa wiang shata ngi kum ka step phyrngab , shisha kum u slap pyrem uba ai um ïa ka khyndew .
translation.en: Then shall we know , if we follow on to know the  Lord  : his going forth is prepared as the morning  ; and he shall come unto us as the rain , as the latter and former rain unto the earth .

translation.kha: Mynno napdeng ki blei jong kito ki ri Baroh , kiba lah ban pyllait ïa la ka ri na ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U Blei jong ph un pynim ïa phi ?
translation.en: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed , that could deliver his people out of mine hand , that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand ?
And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars , and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U thang ïa ki shyieng jong ki lyngdoh ba-thala ha ki duwan ba ki la mane . Da kaba leh ïa kane baroh , u pynlong ïa ka Judah bad ïa ka Jerusalem ba la pynkhuid pat kat kum ka jinglehniam .

Mynta , phi lah ba ïohi sad ïohsngew da lade aïu une u Paul u leh . U ong ba ki blang kiba la shniah da ki kti jong ki briew kim long da shisha ki Blei , bad u la jop ha kaba pynkohnguh ïa kiba bun ki biria , hangne ha Ephesos bad hajan baroh kawei jrong ka probins lad ka Asia .
translation.en: Moreover ye see and hear , that not alone at Ephesus , but almost throughout all Asia , this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people , saying that they be no gods , which are made with hands :

translation.kha: Kine ki dei ki briew kiba la kynja ïa U Blei bad uba ngeit ba um lah ban leh ei ei ïa ki .
translation.en: Which said unto God , Depart from us : and what can the Almighty do for them ?

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la ïohsngew ïa khnai , kumta ki la sdang ban ïawad da kano ka lad Ban pynsep ne ïa U Jisu . Ki la sheptieng ïa u , namar uta u paidbah baroh u la sngewphylla ïa ka jinghikai jong u .
translation.en: And the scribes and chief priests heard it , and sought how they might destroy him : for they feared him , because all the people was astonished at his doctrine .

translation.kha: U Jehosheba u la ïeng hangta , u da pha ki jaiñ bajakhlia .
translation.en: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments , and stood before the angel .
Then shall two be in the field  ; the one shall be taken , and the other left .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ar ngut ki rangbah kin ïatrei ha ka lyngkha : Ïa uwei yn shim noh , ïa uwei pat yn iehnoh shadien .
U Jediael u don wai u khun , u Bilhan , bad u byllien u don hynñiew ngut ki khur shynrang : u Jeush , u bamaïan , u Ehud , u Khenaanah , u Sethan , u Tarshish , bad u Ahishahar .
translation.en: The sons also of Jediael  ; Bilhan : and the sons of Bilhan  ; Jeush , and Benjamin , and Ehud , and Chenaanah , and Zethan , and Tharshish , and Ahishahar .
A father must also provide for his family’s spiritual needs .
translation.kha: U kpa u dei ruh ban pynbiang  ha la ïing ïa ki jingdonkam ba kynja mynsiem .

Kumta uba shah hikai u dei ban sngewmong ban long kum u nonghikai jngai u , pynlang u mraw khim u kynrad jongu u . Lada ïa u khlieh jong ka longïing la khot u Beelsebul , ïa ki dkhot jongnga ka longïing yn khot da ki kyrteng kiba kham sniew !
translation.en: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master , and the servant as his lord . If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub , how much more shall they call them of his household ?
Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah , and the trumpet in Ramah : cry aloud at Beth–aven , after thee , O Benjamin .
translation.kha: To put ïa ki turoi thma ha Gibeah ! Pynsawa ïa ka jingkyrsiew ha Ramah ! Pyrta jam shaphang ka thma ha Bethaben ! Tur sha ka thma , ko ki rangbah Benjamin !

translation.en: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart : they call to Egypt , they go to Assyria .
translation.kha: Ka Israel ka her kum ka paro kaba bieit ; nyngkong ki briew jong ka ki wad jingïarap na Ijipt , bad nangta ki mareh sha Assyria !

kumta haba pa’ ai ei ei ha u briew uba kyrduh , Wat pynsawa jam ïa ka , kumba ki riewarsap ki leh ha ki synagog bad ha ki lynti beh . Ki leh ïa ka khnang ba ki brup kin ïaroh ïa ki . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ba ki la da ïoh ka jingsiew ba-pura .
