translation.en: Therefore when thou doest thine alms , do not sound a trumpet before thee , as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets , that they may have glory of men . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .

translation.kha: U Trei , U Blei ki Israel , u la shaei , Ngan ym klet lano lano ïa ki mana sniew Jong ki .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath sworn by the excellency of Jacob , Surely I will never forget any of their works .
But the flesh of the bullock , and his skin , and his dung , shalt thou burn with fire without the camp : it is a sin offering .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ka doh jong uta u masi lyngraw , ïa ka snieh jong u , bad ïa ki  nierlang jong u , dei ban thang ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara . Kane ka long ka jingainguh ban sait ïa ki pop jong ki lyngdoh .
Lada phim shukor ïa nga , te U Blei un pyndonkam da ki nongwei naba kren da kawei pat ka prie ktien ba sniew khyllah ban hikai ïa phi .
translation.en: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people .

translation.kha: lait tang kawei kaba nga la pyrta jam haba nga ïeng ha khmat jong ki : ‘ Ïa ar la bishar da ma phi ha kane ka sngi naba nga ngeit ba katba ïap kin sa mihpat .’
translation.en: Except it be for this one voice , that I cried standing among them , Touching the resurrection of the dead I am called in question by you this day .

translation.kha: U tei ruh ki khup kiba skhem ha ki rudnong , bad u tih shibun ki pukni , naba u don ki kynhun jingri kiba bun ha mait ki lum bashaphang sepngi bad ha ki pynthait . Namarba ba u ieit ïa ka rep ka riang , u pynsngewrem ïa ki briew ban thung dieng sohwaiñ ha ki jaka lum bad ban re ha ki jaka kiba seisoh .
translation.en: Also he built towers in the desert , and digged many wells : for he had much cattle , both in the low country , and in the plains : husbandmen also , and vine dressers in the mountains , and in Carmel : for he loved husbandry .

translation.kha: ( Ka jingthew ha kata ka por ka ïaryngkat badno arphew kilo . )
translation.en: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah .

translation.kha: Katno babha sut bad kiba la ïoh jingkynduh shikatdei eh ki long kito kiba la kynthah ha khie ka jingpynmihpat banyngkong ïa babha ïap . Ka jinghap kaba ar kam donbor halor jong ki ; kin long ki lyngkdong jong U Blei bad jong U Khrist , bad kin synshar bad u shihajar snem .
translation.en: Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection : on such the second death hath no power , but they shall be priests of God and of Christ , and shall reign with him a thousand years .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem jong ka Jingpynïoh pat , ynda haba baroh ka beiñ ka khyndew ïa kaweh la die la pynïoh pat sha ki trai khyndew , ïa ka jingkhangïit jong ki khunlung kynthei jong u Selophehad yn kynthup lang junom ha kata ka jait kaba ki ïashongduh bad kan Long ka jingduh ïa ka jat jong Ngi .
translation.en: And when the jubilee of the children of Israel shall be , then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received : so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers .

translation.kha: Eliada uno uno u pynbna ba U Jisu u long U ka U Blei , u im ha U Blei bad U Blei u im hapoh jong u .
translation.en: Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God , God dwelleth in him , and he in God .

translation.kha: Ha kane U Trai u la bit ïa u Moses , bad u ong , Kumno shaphang u para jong me U Aaron , u Lebi ? Nga tip u tbit bha ban kren-ïa . Ha ka jingshisha , mynta u dang wan ban ïakynduh ïa me malade un Kmen ba-bang ïohi ïa me .
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against Moses , and he said , Is not Aaron the Levite thy brother ? I know that he can speak well . And also , behold , he cometh forth to meet thee : and when he seeth thee , he will be glad in his heart .

translation.kha: Phim pat pyrshang hi .
translation.en: You haven't even tried .

translation.kha: Ïa ki la pyndap da ki jingkwah bymdei ha ka ri shyiap bad tynjuh ïa U blei ;
translation.en: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness , and tempted God in the desert .

translation.kha: Un khmih bha pat ïa ka ha ka snoh kaba hynñiew , bad lada kata ka jingbthuh ka la pur , kata ka long ka bymkhuid .
translation.en: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day : if the plague be spread in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in a skin , or in any work that is made of skin  ; the plague is a fretting leprosy  ; it is unclean .
And the multitude cometh together again , so that they could not so much as eat bread .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit sha ïing . U paidbah babun u la ïalum biang kat haduh ba U Jisu bad ki synran jong u kim don por shuh ban bam .

translation.en: But shew kindness unto the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite , and let them be of those that eat at thy table : for so they came to me when I fled because of Absalom thy brother .
translation.kha: Hynrei pyn-i ka jinglehsbun ïa ki khun shynrang jong u Barsillai uba na Gilead bad ri sumar ïa ki , namar ki la lehsbun ïa nga mynba nga la phet krad na u Absalom , u hynmen jong me .

translation.en: * Jesus’ first action as King was to throw Satan and his demons down to the earth .
translation.kha: * Ka kam kaba nyngkong eh kaba u Jisu u la leh ka long ban shop ïa u Soitan bad ïa ki ksuid jong u sha ka pyrthei .
U Jisu u la jubab , Hato phim ju pule ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh ha kata ka Por mynba u la donkam ei ei ban bam ? Ma u bad ki rangbah kiba bad u ki la ïa-thngan ,
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Have ye never read what David did , when he had need , and was an hungred , he , and they that were with him ?

translation.kha: To ai kan im , hawei keiñ de ban longsyiem ki Nongthaw dieng bad ki nongkyndong um na ka bynta jongki ngi . Kenan ka longsyiem kaei kaba ki nongïalam ki la ai jingmut .
translation.en: And the princes said unto them , Let them live  ; but let them be hewers of wood and drawers of water unto all the congregation  ; as the princes had promised them .
I will meditate in thy precepts , and have respect unto thy ways .
translation.kha: Nga pule bniah ïa ki jingbthah jong me , nga bishar bniah ïa ki jinghikai jong me .

U briew uba ktung u Oded , u Nongïathuhlypa jong U Trai ; u shong ha ka nongbeh Samaria . U ïakynduh ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel kaba wan phai bad ki koidi Judia hamar ba kin rung sha ka nongbah bad u nong : U Trai U Blei! ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u la kutlad ïa ki Judah , bad u la shah ïa phi ngab jlop ; hynrei mynta u la ïohsngew ïa ka jinglehbeiñ palat jong phiah ba Phin pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: But a prophet of the  Lord  was there , whose name was Oded : and he went out before the host that came to Samaria , and said unto them , Behold , because the  Lord  God of your fathers was wroth with Judah , he hath delivered them into your hand , and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven .
Are they not on the other side Jordan , by the way where the sun goeth down , in the land of the Canaanites , which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal , beside the plains of Moreh ?
translation.kha: ( Kine ki lum ar tylli ki don sha sepngi ka wah Jordan ha ka ri ki Kanaan kiba shong ha ka Them Jordan . Ki don shaphang sepngi , ym da jngai na ki dieng kyntang ha Moreh hajan ka shnong Gilgal . )

translation.en: Then again the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight . He said unto them , He put clay upon mine eyes , and I washed , and do see .
translation.kha: Ki Pharisi , te , ki la kylli biang ïa uta u briew kumno u la ïoh imat pat . U la ïathuh ïa ki ,  U la tah khyndiat ka ktieh ha ki khmat jong nga ; nga la bta khmat , bad mynta nga la imat .
U la ap ïa nga kum ka dngiem ; u kynhun ïa nga kum u sing .
translation.en: He was unto me as a bear lying in wait , and as a lion in secret places .
There was a little city , and few men within it  ; and there came a great king against it , and besieged it , and built great bulwarks against it :
translation.kha: La don kawei ka shnong kaba rit ka bym da don bun ngut ki briew hapoh jong ka . U syiem uba khlaiñ u la tur ïaleh ïa ka . U la kerkut ïa ka bad u la pynkhreh ban pynpra lyngba ïa ki kynroh .

Kut u Katta u ong , Te kumta , shah ngan ieh katba katne ngut ki briew jong nga bun phi . Hynrei u Jakob u ino , Ym da donkam ban leh kumta namar to kaweh tang ban Ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha jyllang pa’ .
translation.en: And Esau said , Let me now leave with thee some of the folk that are with me . And he said , What needeth it ? let me find grace in the sight of my lord .

translation.kha: U thri u paw bajngum ha u kumba u la paw ha Gibeon .
translation.en: That the  Lord  appeared to Solomon the second time , as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon .
Will a lion roar in the forest , when he hath no prey ? will a young lion cry out of his den , if he have taken nothing ?
translation.kha: Hato u sing u ju kyrhuh ha khlaw lymda u la lap ei ei ban kynrup ? Hato u sing samla u ju byrngem ha la krem lymda u la ïohkem ei ei ?

translation.en: But the poor man had nothing , save one little ewe lamb , which he had bought and nourished up : and it grew up together with him , and with his children  ; it did eat of his own meat , and drank of his own cup , and lay in his bosom , and was unto him as a daughter .
translation.kha: katba uba duk pat u don tang iwei i khunlangbrot , iba u la thied . U sumar ïa i , bad i heh i san ha ïing jong u lem bad ki khun ki kti jong u . U ju bsa ïa i na ka jingbam jong u hi , bad shah ïa i ban dih na ka khuri jong u , bad u thum ïa i ha ka pneh jong u . Ita i khunlangbrot i la long kum ka khun kynthei ïa u .
Haba u Araunah u la khmih shakor bad u ïew ïa u syiem bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u ba ki ïawan kiew sha u . U rynsied ïa lade ha madan ha khmat jngai u dab
translation.en: And Araunah looked , and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him : and Araunah went out , and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground .

translation.kha: Hangta pat , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki la leit na Lakhish sha Eglon , ki kyrthat ïa ka , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
translation.en: And from Lachish Joshua passed unto Eglon , and all Israel with him  ; and they encamped against it , and fought against it :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la khmih shaiñ ha ki bad u la jubab , Kane ka long ka bym lah ïa u briew , hynriewphew ym ïa U Blei ; kiei ki baïar ki long kiba eh ïa U Blang .
translation.en: And Jesus looking upon them saith ,  With men it is impossible , but not with God : for with God all things are possible .

translation.kha: Bad kumta to kyrpad ïa Phin ban shah ïa u ban tip ba phi ieit ïa u da shisha .
translation.en: Wherefore I beseech you that ye would confirm your love toward him .

translation.kha: Uno uno babha sniew u dei ban ïai leh sniew , bad uno uno uba jaboh u dien ban ïai jaboh ; uno uno uba bha u dei ban ïai lehbha , bad uno uno ibha khuid u dei ban ïailong khuid .
translation.en: He that is unjust , let him be unjust still : and he which is filthy , let him be filthy still : and he that is righteous , let him be righteous still : and he that is holy , let him be holy still .

Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth–shemesh , nor the inhabitants of Beth–anath  ; but he dwelt among the Canaanites , the inhabitants of the land : nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth–shemesh and of Beth–anath became tributaries unto them .
translation.kha: Ki jait Naphtali kim shym la beh ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah Beth Shemesh bad ha Bethanath . Ki paid Naphtali ki shong bad ki Kanaan kiba ha kita ki jaka , hynrei ki la pynbor ïa ki ban trei na ka bynta jong ki .

Phi la banbeiñ ïa kiba nur pynlang la shim jubor na ki ïa u kew jong ki . Bad kumta pher ym ïoh sah ha ki ïing maïan ba-itynnat ba phi la tei lane dih waiñ na ki bri sohwaiñ kiba itynnat ba phiah la thung .
translation.en: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor , and ye take from him burdens of wheat : ye have built houses of hewn stone , but ye shall not dwell in them  ; ye have planted pleasant vineyards , but ye shall not drink wine of them .
Neither shalt thou set thee up any image  ; which the  Lord  thy God hateth .
translation.kha: Wat pynïeng ruh ïa uno uno u païa maw na ka bynta ka jingmane bleithaw ; U  Trai  u isih ïa kita .
Kumta nga la wan phai pat shaei Jerusalem ban pyn-i jingjngai ïa ka nongbah . Yn pynïeng bapaw ïa ka Thymmai jong nga , bad ïa ka nongbah yn theh paw .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies : my house shall be built in it , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka duriaw ha ka khyndew kaba rkhiang . Hynñiew hato ki kali ïapom jong ki nongot Ijipt lem bad ki kulai bad nongñiah ki leit shapoh ka duriaw-rit , U Trai u pynïadait pat ïa ka um bad ka la tyllep ïa ki .
translation.en: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea , and the  Lord  brought again the waters of the sea upon them  ; but the children of Israel went on dry land in the midst of the sea .
And turn ye not aside : for then should ye go after vain things , which cannot profit nor deliver  ; for they are vain .
translation.kha: Wat ïabeh ïa ki blei thala ; kim lah ïarap ïa phi ne pynim ïa phi namar kim dei kiba shisha .
Ngan shah ïa ki um jong me pun long jai ia bad ngan pynlong sngur mala ngan shah ïa ki wah jong me ba kyang tuid jai jai . Ma nga , U Trei Nongsynshar , nga la kren .
translation.en: Then will I make their waters deep , and cause their rivers to run like oil , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ka ri ka don ha ka jingjynjar haba u sahmiet jong ka u dei u kup bad ki nongïalam jong ka ki ïakhawai baroh shi miet .
translation.en: Woe to thee , O land , when thy king is a child , and thy princes eat in the morning !

translation.kha: U la pyllait ïa ngi na ka bor jong ka jingdum bad u la ïalam ha ka jingsuk ïa im’ sha ka hima jyllang U Khun ba-ieit jong u .
translation.en: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness , and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son .
And he could there do no mighty work , save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk , and healed them .
translation.kha: Um shym la lah ban leh kino kino ki kambah hangta , lait noh tang kaba buh ïa ki kti jong u ha ki khyndiat ngut ki briew kiba pang bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Which of you shall have a friend , and shall go unto him at midnight , and say unto him , Friend , lend me three loaves  ;
translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran ,  Tharai uwei na phi un leit sha ka ïing u paralok jong phi ha ka por shiteng synñia bad ong ha u , ‘ Ko paralok , ai kylliang ïa nga lai tylli ki lyngkhot kpu .

translation.en: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world , how he may please his wife .
translation.kha: Hynrei u briew uba la shongkurim u pyrkhat kiei kiei kiba kynja pyrthei , kumno ba un pynsngewbha ïa la ka tnga .
Ko ki Briew jong nga , ki nongwei kin shakri ïa phi , Kin sumar ïa ki jingri jong phi kin lur ïa ki lyngkha jong phi , bad sumar ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jrong phi ,
translation.en: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks , and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers .

translation.kha: Un leh kumjuh ïa une u masi lyngraw kumba u ju leh ïa u masi lyngraw jong ka jingkñia ainguh namar ka pop , bad ha kane ka rukom un pyndep ïa ka jingjia namar ka pop jong uta u paidlang , bad yn map ïa ki .
translation.en: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering , so shall he do with this : and the priest shall make an atonement for them , and it shall be forgiven them .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada um kotbor ban thied bapaw ïa ka , lai ïaisah hi ha ka kti uta u nongpeit hajuh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat . Ha kata ka snem yn sa pynpei pat ïa ka sha u jong uba nyngkong .
translation.en: But if he be not able to restore it to him , then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubilee : and in the jubilee it shall go out , and he shall return unto his possession .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga khmih ïa khie ka hima Jerusalem kaba jop , bad ngan pynjot ïa ka na sla khyndew . Hynrei ngan ym pynstet ïa borbah ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob .
translation.en: Behold , the eyes of the Lord  God  are upon the sinful kingdom , and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth  ; saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U briew uba shahshkor ïa nga un suk — u briew uba ap man ka sneng ha jingkhang jong nga , uba ap ha bakwah krong ka ïing jong nga .
translation.en: Blessed is the man that heareth me , watching daily at my gates , waiting at the posts of my doors .

translation.kha: U Trai u nong , Leit phai noh sha ka ri khlaw kaba hadien Damaskos , pynlang nangta rung shapoh ka nongbah bad pynsleh ïa u Hasael kum u syier ka Syria ;
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Go , return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus : and when thou comest , anoint Hazael to be king over Syria :

translation.kha: U Jehoïada u jied ar ngut ki tngen na ka bynta u syiad Joash , sad ki kha ïa u , ki khun shynrang nabar ki khun kynthei .
translation.en: And Jehoiada took for him two wives  ; and he begat sons and daughters .

translation.kha: Ki shwa ïa ki jingker ïa ka Ïingjaiñ da ka dieng akasia .
translation.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood , standing up .

translation.kha: Khie leit sha ki dkhot jongno ka kur Rekhab bun ïakren bad ki . Nangta wallam ïa ki sha Kaei na ki kamram ha ka Templ bad tyrwa wiang ïa ki khyndiat .
translation.en: Go unto the house of the Rechabites , and speak unto them , and bring them into the house of the  Lord  , into one of the chambers , and give them wine to drink .

translation.kha: Phi pyrshah ïa kito kaba ieit ïa phoi bad kyrshan ïa kito kiba iba ïa phi ! Phi la pynjop shai ba ki nongpynïaidkam bad ki rangïapom jong phi kim longkmie ei ei ïa phi . Nga lah ban ïohi ba phin jin da la sngewdiaw “lada u Absalom u dang im mynta bad ba ngi baroh ngin ïap .
translation.en: In that thou lovest thine enemies , and hatest thy friends . For thou hast declared this day , that thou regardest neither princes nor servants : for this day I perceive , that if Absalom had lived , and all we had died this day , then it had pleased thee well .

Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand , and meted out heaven with the span , and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure , and weighed the mountains in scales , and the hills in a balance ?
translation.kha: Don uno uno uba lah ban thew ïa ka duriaw-bah da ki lynghoh kti lane ban thew ïa ka sahit bneng da ki kti jong u ? Don uno uno uba lah ban bat ïa ka khyndew jong ka pyrthei ha ka khuri lane thew ïa ki lumbah bad lumrit ha ki tarajur ?

translation.en: The Spirit of the Lord  God  is upon me  ; because the  Lord  hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek  ; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted , to proclaim liberty to the captives , and the opening of the prison to them that are bound  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la pyndap ïa nga da U Mynsiem jong u . U la jied ïa nga bad phah ïa nga ban wallam ïa ka khubor babha sha kiba duk , ban pynkhiah ïa kiba la pait dohnud , ban pynbna ka jingpyllait ïa ki mraw bad ka jinglaitluid ïa kito kiba ha ka byndi .
Hadien katei katne por , Kaba ki rangbah kiba ïeng Hangta ki la ïawad sha u Petros . Da shisha me longïing uwei na ki , ki la ong . Nalor baroh , ka rukom kren jong me ka pynpaw ïa kata !
translation.en: And after a while came unto him they that stood by , and said to Peter , Surely thou also art one of them  ; for thy speech bewrayeth thee .

translation.kha: Kam long kaba dei ban pynksan ïa babha la rem bad ban khan ïa uba lui lui na kaba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingbishar hok .
translation.en: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked , to overthrow the righteous in judgment .

translation.kha: U mradkhlaw uba ar u syriem kum ka dngiem kaba ïeng ha ki kjat-dien jong ka . Ka la bat lai tylli ki shyngoid krung hapdeng ki bniat jong ka , bad ka sur ka la ong ha ka , Khie rupa , bam shibun ka doh katba pham lah !
translation.en: And behold another beast , a second , like to a bear , and it raised up itself on one side , and it had three ribs in the mouth of it between the teeth of it : and they said thus unto it , Arise , devour much flesh .
Meddle not with them  ; for I will not give you of their land , no , not so much as a foot breadth  ; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession .
translation.kha: Kin tieng ïa phi , hynrei phim dei ban ïaknieh jaka bad ki , namar ngan ym ai ha phi wat tang khyndiat ruh na kata ka ri jong ki . Nga la ai ïa ka Edom ha ki khun ki ksiew u Iso .

Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew u lyngdoh un peit biang ïa kata ka prum , bad lada kam pat pur Bad kam kham jylliew ban ïa ka snier sawdong jong ka , un pynbna ba uta u long uba khuid . Uta u briew un sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad un long uba khuid .
translation.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall : and , behold , if the scall be not spread in the skin , nor be in sight deeper than the skin  ; then the priest shall pronounce him clean : and he shall wash his clothes , and be clean .

translation.kha: Katto katne ki la longkmie kiba bieit , ki shahshitom namar ki pop jong ki bad namar ka jingsniew jongki ki ;
translation.en: Fools because of their transgression , and because of their iniquities , are afflicted .
And they sware unto the  Lord  with a loud voice , and with shouting , and with trumpets , and with cornets .
translation.kha: Ha ka sur kaba jam ki shim ïa ka jingsmai ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ba kin bat ïa ka jutang , bad nangta ki pyrta bad ki put ïa ki turoi .
U thang ïa ki shyieng jong ki lyngdoh ba-thala ha ki duwan ba ki la mane . Da kaba leh ïa kane barhem , u pynlong ïa ka Judah bad ïa ka Jerusalem ba la pynkhuid pat kat kum ka jinglehniam .
translation.en: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars , and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Dang leh aiu ?
translation.en: What are you doing ?
He created the first human pair Adam and Eve , placed them in an earthly paradise called Eden , and instructed them to have children and extend their Paradise home earth wide .
translation.kha: U la thaw nynkong ia ki shijur ki briew U Adam bad ka Im , bad u la buh ia ki haka kper Eden , bad u la hukum ia ki , ba kin ioh khun ioh kti , bad ban pyniar ia ka pyrthei baroh kawei kum ka kper Eden .
Ho-oid , Ko Kpa , kaei ka la longkmie kumno me la kwah ïa ka ba kan jied .
translation.en: Even so , Father : for so it seemed good in thy sight .

translation.kha: Em ! Ieit ïa ki nongshun jong phin bad lehbha ïa ki ; to ai kyllan bad wat khmih lynti ban ïoh ei ei pat . Te phin ïoh ka bainong kaba khraw , bad phin long ki khun jong U Blei Uba Hakhlieh Tam Eh . Naba u long uba bha ïa u bymsngewsynei bad ïa kiba bymman .
translation.en: But love ye your enemies , and do good , and lend , hoping for nothing again  ; and your reward shall be great , and ye shall be the children of the Highest : for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil .

translation.kha: Lada me wan phai da kaba suk , u Mikaïah u pyrsa , te U Trai um shym la kren keiñ da nga ! bad u la bynrap , Shahshkor , uwei pa uwei ïa kaei kaba nga la kren !
translation.en: And Micaiah said , If thou return at all in peace , the  Lord  hath not spoken by me . And he said , Hearken , O people , every one of you .
Since Gilead’s founding in 1943 , more than 8 ,000 graduates of this school have been sent out as missionaries to give a witness “to the ends of the earth” with great success .
translation.kha: Naduh ba la sdang ïa ka Gilead ha u snem 1943 , palat 8 ,000 ngut ki la wan sha kane ka skul bad la phah ïa ki kum ki mishoneri ban sakhi “shaduh kaba kut ka pyrthei .”
U shim kaei kaba u kwah , nabar ym don ba lah ban khang ïa u . Ym don uba nud ïa-ban Kylli ïa u , Me leh aïu ?
translation.en: Behold , he taketh away , who can hinder him ? who will say unto him , What doest thou ?

translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kad khep ha tur u briew uba pdiang pisa ban pynap ïa u briew umbah jaijai lui .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that taketh reward to slay an innocent person . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka don ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki briew kiba Stad ; kiba bieit ktien tip ei ei shaphang ka jingwad .
translation.en: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding : but that which is in the midst of fools is made known .

translation.kha: U Jiw u la ong ha u Petros , To bsuh noh ïa ka waitlam ha ka jingsop jongno ka ! Me tharai ba ngan ym dih ïa ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ïa kaba U Kpa jong na u la ai ha nga ?
translation.en: Then said Jesus unto Peter ,  Put up thy sword into the sheath : the cup which my Father hath given me , shall I not drink it ?

translation.kha: lymne da ka khyndew , naba ka long ka jingïuhkjat jong u ; lymne da ka Jeruel , naba ka long ka nongbah jongki U Syiem uba khraw .
translation.en: Nor by the earth  ; for it is his footstool : neither by Jerusalem  ; for it is the city of the great King .

translation.kha: Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh bad ki la kylli , Hato a um dei uto umbah ha Jerusalem u la pynïap ïa kito kiba mane ïa uta U Jisu ? Bad hato um shym wan Hangne na ka bynta kajuh ka jingthmu ban kem ïa kito ki briew bad ban ïalam bapaw ïa ki shwa ki rangbah lyngdoh ?
translation.en: But all that heard him were amazed , and said  ; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem , and came hither for that intent , that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests ?

translation.kha: wahbah u ïingjaiñ ha khmat u Syiem Ibbah , u syiem u kylli ïa u , Ko Mikaïah , hato u syiem Jehoshaphat bad nga ngin leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth , ne em ? Tur ! u Mikaïah u ïai-ong . Da shaid phin jop . U Trai un ai ïa ph ka jingjop .
translation.en: And when he was come to the king , the king said unto him , Micaiah , shall we go to Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And he said , Go ye up , and prosper , and they shall be delivered into your hand .

translation.kha: Ha ka por mynmiet ki nongtuh ki thring Shabeh ki ïing , hynriewphew mynsngi ki rieh bad ki kiar ïa ka jingshai .
translation.en: In the dark they dig through houses , which they had marked for themselves in the daytime : they know not the light .

translation.kha: Kim shym la im sngap ban pyrkhing ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba ki la iehnoh ; lada ki leh kumta , kin jin da la ieh ka kabu ban longing phai pat .
translation.en: And truly , if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out , they might have had opportunity to have returned .

translation.kha: Ki la pyrta kylla , Sahnarphna ïa u !
translation.en: And they cried out again , Crucify him .

translation.kha: Mynta te , kane ka un-long kaei kaba ma ang , U tharai Nongsharai nga ong : namar me mut ba me stad kum U balui ,
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God  ;
All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables  ; and without a parable spake he not unto them :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la pyndonkam ïa ki pharshi ban ïathuh ïa kine kiei kiei baroh ha ki paidbah ; um ju ong ïa kano kano ha ki khlem da pyndonkam ïa ka pharshi .

‘ Kane ka long kaei katba ngan leh ha ki sngi bakhatduh , U Blei u ong : Ngan ha noh ïa U Mynsiem jong nga halor uwei pa uwei baroh . Ki khun shynrang badno ki khwan kynthei jong phi kin pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga ; ki samla shynrang jong phi kmen ïohi ki jingïohipaw , bad ki rangbah ba la tmier jong phi kin ïoh ki jingphohsniew .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in the last days , saith God , I will pour out of my Spirit upon all flesh : and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy , and your young men shall see visions , and your old men shall dream dreams :

translation.kha: Ngam pat ju leh pop da kaba duli ba kin ïap .
translation.en: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul .

translation.kha: Phin ym ïohi ïa ki dik , ki dieng , lane kum kine kiei kiei hapoh ka Kingdom Hall .
translation.en: You will not see any images , crucifixes , or things like these at the Kingdom Hall .

translation.kha: U Sakharaïah u la don arphew wei snem ka rta mynba u longsem u syiem ka Judah , bad u la pynsynjor khatwei snem ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ka Balang kaba ha Babilon , ïa kaba la jied ruh da U Blei , ka phah ïa ki jingai jingkhublei sha phi , bad Kumjuh ruh u markhmat u khun jong nga .
translation.en: The church that is at Babylon , elected together with you , saluteth you  ; and so doth Mark my son .

And the Israelite woman s son blasphemed the name of the  Lord  , and cursed . And they brought him unto Moses : ( and his mother s name was Shelomith , the daughter of Dibri , of the tribe of Dan : )
translation.kha: Don uwei u briew uba u kpa jong u , u dei u nong Ijipt bad ka kmie jong u pat ka dei ka Israel kaba kyrteng ka Shelomith , ka khun u Dibri uba na ka jait Dan . Une u briew u ïakajia bad uwei u Israel hapoh ka jaka shong dara . Katba ki dang ïakajia kumta , une u briew u krenbeiñ ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai  : kumta ki wan ïalam ïa u ha u Moses .
Tam pher , U Tlai u ong ïa u Soitan , baroh kaba u don ki long hapoh ka bor jong me , hynrei men ym pynthnam ïa u Job hi . Te u Soitan u la leit noh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Behold , all that he hath is in thy power  ; only upon himself put not forth thine hand . So Satan went forth from the presence of the  Lord .
And when he had thus spoken , the king rose up , and the governor , and Bernice , and they that sat with them :
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem , u lyngskor , bad ka Berniki , bad baroh kiwei pat ki la ïeng joit ,

translation.en: In the resurrection therefore , when they shall rise , whose wife shall she be of them ? for the seven had her to wife .
translation.kha: Mynta , haba baroh kiba la ïap , kin sa mihpat ha kata ka sngi ka jingmihpat , ka tnga jongno kan long ? Baroh kita ki hynñiew ngut ki la lah shongkurim ïa ka .
Peit beit sha khmat da ka jingsngewskhem kaba hok ; wat pyndem ïa la ka khlieh ha ka jinglynñiar .
translation.en: Let thine eyes look right on , and let thine eyelids look straight before thee .

translation.kha: Khmih ïa u kpu jong ngi . Mynba ngi mihnoh na ïing bad u bad wan ban ïakynduh ïa phi , u dang syiad . Hynrei ha khmih ! Mynta u la tyrkhong pynlang la bthuh .
translation.en: This our bread we took hot for our provision out of our houses on the day we came forth to go unto you  ; but now , behold , it is dry , and it is mouldy :

Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Let your hands be strong , ye that hear in these days these words by the mouth of the prophets , which were in the day that the foundation of the house of the  Lord  of hosts was laid , that the temple might be built .
translation.kha: To long shlur ! Mynta phi ïohsngew ïa kijuh ki kyntien ba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren ha ka por ba la buh nongrim na ka bynta ban tei pat ïa ka Templ jong nga .
Nangta U tharai u la bthah ïa nga ban pynpait ïa u khra ha khamtam jong ki rangbah kiba la ïaleit bad ang
translation.en: Then shalt thou break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with thee ,

translation.kha: Kum ïa ka kur Merari la ai khat-ar tylli ki nongbat .
translation.en: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families , which were remaining of the families of the Levites , were by their lot twelve cities .
And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Balaam , Go with the men : but only the word that I shall speak unto thee , that thou shalt speak . So Balaam went with the princes of Balak .
translation.kha: Hynrei u angel u ong ,  Khie leit bad kine ki briew , hynrei kren tang ïa kaba nga ong ha me ban kren .  Kumta u Balaam u la leit ryngkat bad ki .
To long bhor kiba sngewrit , kiba jemnud , bad kiba ïaishah . To pyn-i ïa ka jingieit jong phi da kaba ïaishah iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: With all lowliness and meekness , with longsuffering , forbearing one another in love ;
How forcible are right words ! but what doth your arguing reprove ?
translation.kha: Ki ktien hok ki long kiba lah ban pynngeit , hynrei phi kren khlem don jingmut .
Ki longïng kum ki ksew kiba jlawnguid , ki bym ju ïoh bam ïakdang . Kieng nongïalam ruh kim don ka jingshemphang . Erastos pa uwei na ki u kun katba u sngewbit , bad wad ïa la ka jong ka jingmyntoi .
translation.en: Yea , they are greedy dogs which can never have enough , and they are shepherds that cannot understand : they all look to their own way , every one for his gain , from his quarter .

translation.kha: dalade phi wan phai khlem shah pynkup , u Mikaïah u pyrta , te U Trai um shym la kren lyngngoh jong nga ! Bad u ong shuh , Sngap ïa nga phi baroh , ïa kaei kaba nga la ong !
translation.en: And Micaiah said , If thou certainly return in peace , then hath not the  Lord  spoken by me . And he said , Hearken , all ye people .
If thou wilt send our brother with us , we will go down and buy thee food :
translation.kha: Lada phi kloi ban phah ïa u para jong ngi bad ngi , ngin leit thied bam ïa phi .
Hato U Blei un pyndonkam ïa ka kuna jong u baher pyrshah ïa nga ? Em , un sngap ïa at katba nga dang kren .
translation.en: Will he plead against me with his great power ? No  ; but he would put strength in me .

For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants  ; behold , his bedstead was a bedstead of iron  ; is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon ? nine cubits was the length thereof , and four cubits the breadth of it , after the cubit of a man .
translation.kha: ( U Og u long u syiem uba khatduh na ki Rephaim . Ka jingthiah jong u , kaba la shna da u nar , ka long saw mitar ka lynter bad ar mitar ka pyngkiang , kat kum ka jingthew ba dei rukom . Dang lah ban ïohi ïa ka ha ka nongbah Rabbah jong ki Ammon . )
Katno ka lama kaba shyrkhei ka jingbynrap U Trai ïa kita ki nongsynshar kiba pynjot bad pynsakma ïa ki briew jong u !
translation.en: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture ! saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Da kumwei pat , ki la ïohi ba U Blei u la ai ha sa ïa ka kam ka jingïalap ïa ka Gospel ha ki Jentil , kumba u la ai ha u Petros ïa ka kam ka jingïalap ïa ka jingialam ha ki Jiw .
translation.en: But contrariwise , when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me , as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter ;

For this , Thou shalt not commit adultery , Thou shalt not kill , Thou shalt not steal , Thou shalt not bear false witness , Thou shalt not covet ; and if there be any other commandment , it is briefly comprehended in this saying , namely , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .
translation.kha: Ki hukum ,  Wat klim ; wat pynïap briew ; wat tuh ; wat ikwah ïa kaei kaba dei jong kiwei pat  — ïa kine baroh , bad kino kino kiwei pat , la kynthup lang ha kawei ka hukum ,  Ieit ïa u paramarjan jong me kumba ïa lade .
A Blei , to shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai bad ka jingkyrpad jong nga . To pynbha pat ïa ka Telem jong me , ïa kaba la pynjot ; to pynbha ïa ka khnang ba uwei pa iwei baroh un tip ba me long U Blei .
translation.en: Now therefore , O our God , hear the prayer of thy servant , and his supplications , and cause thy face to shine upon thy sanctuary that is desolate , for the Lord s sake .
For the  Lord  is great , and greatly to be praised : he is to be feared above all gods .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long uba khraw bad uba dei eh ban ïaroh ; u long uba dei ban shah pyndonburom kham palat ïa ki blei baroh .

Ki briew jong ka Judah ki ong , Ngi la ïohsngew katno ki briew jong ka Moab ki long kiba sarong . Ngi tip ba ki long kiba sngewmeng dara kiba sarong palat , hynrei ka jingkob jong ki ka long kaba thylli .
translation.en: We have heard of the pride of Moab  ; he is very proud : even of his haughtiness , and his pride , and his wrath : but his lies shall not be so .
I speak as concerning reproach , as though we had been weak . Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold , ( I speak foolishly , ) I am bold also .
translation.kha: Nga sngewlehrain ban phla ba phim shym la long kiba shlur ban leh ïa kito kiei kiei! Hynrei lada uno uno ud nud ban sngewsarong shaphang kaei kaei — nga kren kum uba bieit — ngan shu long uba shlur .

U ïarap ïa ngi ha ki jingjied jong ngi baïar , khnang ba ngi lah ban ïarap ïa kiwei kiba don ki jingjynjar babun jai , da kaba pyndonnam ïa kiaw ka lad jingïarap kaba Ngi hi ngi la ïohpdiang na U Blei .
translation.en: Who comforteth us in all our tribulation , that we may be able to comfort them which are in any trouble , by the comfort wherewith we ourselves are comforted of God .

And ye shall eat neither bread , nor parched corn , nor green ears , until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings .
translation.kha: Wat bam na uta u kew thymmai , la uba dang im , ne uba la sdieh pyrthiew , ne uba la pynlong kpu , tad haduh ba phi la wallam ïa kane ka jingkñia ainguh sha U Blei . Kane ka long ka hukum kaba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ki dei ban leh pateng la pateng .
Hynrei u Abiram u ïong , Lada kumta te , phin shah mo la kynum kumno ïa u Amnon , u para jong nga ban wan ? Balei un longing ? u syiem u kylli .
translation.en: Then said Absalom , If not , I pray thee , let my brother Amnon go with us . And the king said unto him , Why should he go with thee ?

translation.kha: ïa u Sihon , u syiem ki Lemuel ; ka jingieit jong u ka kein bymjukut ;
translation.en: Sihon king of the Amorites : for his mercy endureth for ever :

And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him : and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind , with chariots , and with horsemen , and with many ships  ; and he shall enter into the countries , and shall overflow and pass over .
translation.kha: Haba ka kynta kaba khatduh jong u syiem ka Syria ka la jan wan artat , u syiem ka Ijipt un tur ïaleh ïa u , bad u syiem ka Syria un ïaleh pyrshah da la ka bor baroh , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ki kali ïapom , ki kulai , bad ki liengbah kiba bun . Un hiarthma ïa kiba bun ki ri , kum ka jingshlei ki um .

Kumta myntan to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma sa , U Trai’ Nongsynshar , nga ong ha phi ki lumbah bad ki lumrit , ha phi ki twad bad ki jaka them , bad ha phi ki jaka kiba sah ha ki jingjot jingpra , bad ha phi ki nongbah ba la iehnoh kynjah kiba la shah lute bad sha rkhiebeiñ da baroh ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong .
translation.en: Therefore , ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord  God   ; Thus saith the Lord  God  to the mountains , and to the hills , to the rivers , and to the valleys , to the desolate wastes , and to the cities that are forsaken , which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about  ;
Behold , for peace I had great bitterness : but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption : for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back .
translation.kha: Ka jingkthang jong nga ka kylla sha ka jingsuk . Me pyllait ïa ka jingim jong nga na ka jingma baroh ; me map ïa ki pop jong nga baroh .

translation.en: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the  Lord  at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Uta u lyngdoh un synreit ïa ka snam ha baroh sawdong ka duwan ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ bad un thang ïa ka khleiñ ban pynmih ïa ka jingiwbih kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water , and bathe his flesh in water , and shall be unclean until the even .
translation.kha: Uta uba thang ïa kata ka masi ruh u dei ban sait ïa la ki jaiñ bad theh um ïa lade , hynrei u ruh u ïailong u bymkhuid haduh janmiet .

translation.en: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife , and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband : else were your children unclean ; but now are they holy .
translation.kha: Naba ïa u tnga u bymngeit la pynlong uba la pdiang ha U Blei da kaba pynïasoh ha ka tnga jong u , bad ïa ka tnga ka bymngeit la pynlong kaba la pdiang ha U Blei da kaba pynïasoh ha la u tnga uba ngeit . Lada kane kam long kumta , ki khun jong ki kin long kum ki khun jong ki bymngeit ; hynrei kumba ka long , la pynlong ïa ki kiba la pdiang da U Blei .
Pyndonkam ïa ka , ban pynsleh ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Syndong ryngkat jong nga , ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ,
translation.en: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith , and the ark of the testimony ,

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la don pyllut lem pynlang u Judas , badno ka na jong u ka saphriang kylleng kata ka ri .
translation.en: So the  Lord  was with Joshua  ; and his fame was noised throughout all the country .

translation.kha: shadien shi thiat u khunlung u la ïarep bad ki radbah synshar jong u Nadab ki la sheptieng ban ïathuh ha u ïa ka khubor . Ki ong , Myntan i khunlung i ïalang im , u Dabid um ju Jubab ïa ngi haba me Kren ïa u . Kumno ngin lah ban ïakhot ïa u ba i khun jongno u i la ïap ? U lah ban pynmynsaw ïa ailad !
translation.en: And it came to pass on the seventh day , that the child died . And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead : for they said , Behold , while the child was yet alive , we spake unto him , and he would not hearken unto our voice : how will he then vex himself , if we tell him that the child is dead ?

translation.kha: U la bam .
translation.en: He had eaten .

translation.kha: La kyntiew ïa u shaw ka liang kamon jong U Blei , U KA jong u , bad u la ïohpdiang na u ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid , kumba u la lah kliar . Kaei kaba phi ïohthiah badno ïohsngew mynta ka long ka jingai sngewbit kambah u la theh noh ha ngi .
translation.en: Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted , and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Ghost , he hath shed forth this , which ye now see and hear .

translation.kha: Lada phin leh ïa kaei ka bymdei , yn pynshitom sat ïa phi ; pien ïap lada kitab atiar ba-bang pynbeit ïa phi .
translation.en: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way : and he that hateth reproof shall die .

translation.kha: Nahath ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ïakynduh lang ha ka ïing pait dulan jong u Kaïaphas , u Rangbah lyngngoh ,
translation.en: Then assembled together the chief priests , and the scribes , and the elders of the people , unto the palace of the high priest , who was called Caiaphas ,

translation.kha: Te , baïar na I , ngi phalang ïa ka burom jong U Trai da ki durkhmat ba khlem tap , bad kata kajuh ka burom , kaba wan na U Trai , uba long U Mynsiem , ka pynlip dur ïa ngi sha ka jingïasyriem ïa u ha kata ka kyrdan kaba kham khraw jong ka burom .
translation.en: But we all , with open face beholding as in a glass the glory of the Lord , are changed into the same image from glory to glory , even as by the Spirit of the Lord .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , wat ha ki shakri jong ar , barhem shynrang bad kynthah , nur theh ïa U Mynhyndai jong na ha nia ki sngi , bad kin pynbna ïa ka khubor jong nga .
translation.en: And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit  ; and they shall prophesy :
But he , being full of the Holy Ghost , looked up stedfastly into heaven , and saw the glory of God , and Jesus standing on the right hand of God ,
translation.kha: Hynrei u Stephan , uba dap da U Mynsiem Bakhuid , u la khmied sha bneng bad u la ïohi ïa ka burom jong U Blei bad ïa U Jisu uba ïeng sha ka liang kamon jong U Blei .

translation.en: My little children , let us not love in word , neither in tongue  ; but in deed and in truth .
translation.kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , ka jingieit jong ngi kam dei ban long tang da ki ktien bad ka jingkren ; ka dei ban long ka jingieit kaba shisha , kaba pynpaw ïa lade da ka kam .
Kumta u —Joshua u phad katto katjuh ngut ki rangbah babha mareh sha ka ïingjaiñ bad ki shem ba kita ki mar ba la shah kyntait la tep shisha hangta , bad ka phong ha trai .
translation.en: So Joshua sent messengers , and they ran unto the tent  ; and , behold , it was hid in his tent , and the silver under it .

So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots , and the king of Maacah and his people  ; who came and pitched before Medeba . And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities , and came to battle .
translation.kha: Ki laiphew ar hajar tylli ki kali ïapom kiba ki wai bad ka kynhun shipai u syiem Maakah ki wan sher dara hajan ka Medeba . Ki Ammon ruh ki wan na baroh ki nongbah jong ki bad ki long kiba la kloi ban ïaleh .
Nga kwah ba phin tep ïa nga bad la ki kpa tmain ; rah ïa nga na Ijipt , bad tep ïa nga ha ka jaka ba la thep ïa ki . U Joseph u jubab , Ngan kun Rumah phi ong .
translation.en: But I will lie with my fathers , and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt , and bury me in their buryingplace . And he said , I will do as thou hast said .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , To pyrta jam katba pa lah ! Haduh ïa ki briew’ jong nga ki Israel shaphang ki pop jong ki .
translation.en: Cry aloud , spare not , lift up thy voice like a trumpet , and shew my people their transgression , and the house of Jacob their sins .

translation.kha: Khenani lada phim treh ban Pha ïa u , ngin ym leit , namar ita u bynriew u la ong ha me ba ngin ym lah shuh ban ïakynduh ïa u lymda u para jong ngi u don rynsied lem malade moi .
translation.en: But if thou wilt not send him , we will not go down : for the man said unto us , Ye shall not see my face , except your brother be with you .

translation.kha: Don mad ka Libnah , ka Ether , ka Ashan ,
translation.en: Libnah , and Ether , and Ashan ,

translation.kha: U riewshlur um don ïa ka olib — ym don ei ei ba un peit shwa khmat .
translation.en: For there shall be no reward to the evil man  ; the candle of the wicked shall be put out .

And I will bring a sword upon you , that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant : and when ye are gathered together within your cities , I will send the pestilence among you  ; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhie da ka thma ban pynshitom ïa phi namar ka jingpynkheiñ jutang jong phi , bad lada phi wad jingïada da kaba ïalumlang ha la ki shnong , ngan phah ïa ki jingpang bym lah pynkhiah hapdeng jong phi bad phin hap pyndem ha ki nongshun jong phi .

translation.en: He went to Pilate , and begged the body of Jesus . Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered .
translation.kha: U la leit sha u Pilat bad u la pan ïa ka met U Jisu . U Pilat u la hukum ban ai ïa ka met ha u Joseph .

translation.en: O Lord , by these things men live , and in all these things is the life of my spirit : so wilt thou recover me , and make me to live .
translation.kha: A Trai , ngan im na ka bynta jong me , bad tang ïa me hi ; to pynkhiah ïa nga bad ai ngan im .

Kaba bha ïa me , ko Simon u khunlung jong u Jonah ! la jubab U Josis . naba kane ka jingshisha ki shym la ïan ha me na uno uno u briew , hynmen la ai ïa ka ha me beit beit da U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .
translation.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Blessed art thou , Simon Bar–jona : for flesh and blood hath not revealed it unto thee , but my Father which is in heaven .

translation.kha: Nangta ar ngut na ki , ki ithuh rung hakpoh ïng , bad u nongïathuhlypa meeting u theh ïa ka umphniang Olib ha ka khlieh u Jehu , mala u ong ha u , U Trei , U Blei ki Isaia u pynbna , ‘ Nga pynslem ïa me baneh long u syiem jong ki briew jong nga , ki Israel .
translation.en: And he arose , and went into the house  ; and he poured the oil on his head , and said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , I have anointed thee king over the people of the  Lord  , even over Israel .

translation.kha: To lehkmen , ko ki briew ka Seïon , to shadkmen ha kaei kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la leh ïa phi . U la ai ïa phi ïa u slap synrai uba bneng ; u la theh ïa u slap tlang na ka bynta jong phi bun ïa u skud pynum kumba mynshuwa .
translation.en: Be glad then , ye children of Zion , and rejoice in the  Lord  your God : for he hath given you the former rain moderately , and he will cause to come down for you the rain , the former rain , and the latter rain in the first month .

translation.kha: Ha ka pyrem kaba bud u la khot ïa ki rangbah bad u ithuh bad ki sha ka nongbah Apphia ïa-ban Tur ïaleh ïa ki Jesreel .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the return of the year , that Ben–hadad numbered the Syrians , and went up to Aphek , to fight against Israel .

translation.kha: Phin sa hir uba stad , bad ka jingtip jngai phi kan ai jingkmen ïa phi .
translation.en: When wisdom entereth into thine heart , and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul  ;
And David said to Saul , Let no man s heart fail because of him  ; thy servant will go and fight with this Philistine .
translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u Saul ,  Syiem Kynrad , mano mano ruh kim dei ban tieng ïa une u Philistia ! Ngan leit ban ïaleh ïa u .

Nga kyntur ïa phi ban long ki nongsharai ïa ka kynhun ïa kiba U Blei u la ai ha phi bad ngab sumar ïa ka da ka mon sngewbha , kumba U Blei u kwah ïa phi , bad ym da kaba shu pynbor . Trei ïa la ka kam , ym tang na ka bynta ka bainong , hynrei na ka jingthrang ban shakri .
translation.en: Feed the flock of God which is among you , taking the oversight thereof , not by constraint , but willingly  ; not for filthy lucre , but of a ready mind  ;

translation.kha: Katno ka long kaba jingshyrkhei ka jingbishar U Trai ïa kita ki nongsynshar kiba pynjot bad pynsakma ïa ki briew jong u !
translation.en: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture ! saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumta u la ïakhot ïa uwei na ki shakri bad u la kylli ïa u , ‘ Ka jia aïu ?’
translation.en: And he called one of the servants , and asked what these things meant .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , kylluid ïa Kawei pa kamai ka jaitbynriew la kaba kum khnai kaei kadei ka la ju jia mynshuwa . Ki paid Israel ki la leh ïa kaei kambah shyrkhei !
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Ask ye now among the heathen , who hath heard such things : the virgin of Israel hath done a very horrible thing .

translation.kha: Baroh kito kiba shna bleithaw kim long ei ei , bad u blei ba ki ñiewkor shibun um long ibha larkam . Ktah kiba mian ïa kine ki blei ki long kiba matlah bad kiba bieit bad kin shah pynjahburom .
translation.en: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity  ; and their delectable things shall not profit  ; and they are their own witnesses  ; they see not , nor know  ; that they may be ashamed .

translation.kha: Ngan tur ïaleh ïa kine ki briew bymnang bun ngan pynbudnam ïa ki . Ki jaitbynriew kin ïalumlang pyrshah ïa ki , sad yn pynshitom ïa ki namar ki pop kiba bun ki jong ki .
translation.en: It is in my desire that I should chastise them  ; and the people shall be gathered against them , when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows .

translation.kha: Wat ki thring ki pyntip lano ka dei ka por ban wan phai ; ki lyngdkhur , ki lyntait , bad ki throsh ki tip lano ka de ka por Ban leit napoh sharai . Hynrei , ko ki briew jongu nga , phim shym tip ïa ki aiñ da uba na shihajar ïa pa .
translation.en: Yea , the stork in the heaven knoweth her appointed times  ; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming  ; but my people know not the judgment of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Nongthaw jong phah un un-long kum u tnga ïa pha — U Trai Badonbor Baroh longïing ka kyrteng jong u . U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel un pyni ïa pha — u erlangthari u nongsynshar jong ka pyiar baroh .
translation.en: For thy Maker is thine husband  ; the  Lord  of hosts is his name  ; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel  ; The God of the whole earth shall he be called .

translation.kha: Bah , lada yn shem ïa ka ha uno uno na ngi , utai u dei ban ïap , dara kiba sah na ngi kmen long nong ki mraw jong phi .
translation.en: With whomsoever of thy servants it be found , both let him die , and we also will be my lord s bondmen .

translation.kha: namar men ym iehnoh ïa at ha ka pyrthei kiba ïap ; men ym shat ïa u shakri baïaineh jong me ban pyut hapoh ka jingtep .
translation.en: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell , neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption .
And when all the people saw it , they fell on their faces : and they said , The  Lord  , he is the God  ; the  Lord  , he is the God .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki ïohi ïa kane , ki ïadem khrup ha khyndew bad ki ïa-pyrta jam ,  U  Trai  u long U Blei ; U  Trai  tang ma u , u long U Blei !

Kam pher kaei ka jinglehkai ba u syiem u la kylli , lane kano ka jinglah kaba u pynpaw , kine ki Saw ngut ki la Kham tip shiphew shah Ban ïa uno a u nongbatai pan lane u nongleh myntor ha ka hima jong u baroh kawei .
translation.en: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding , that the king enquired of them , he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers that were in all his realm .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dap khwai ïa kine kiew kiei baroh , u la ong ha la ki synran .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Jesus had finished all these sayings , he said unto his disciples ,
And the servants and officers stood there , who had made a fire of coals  ; for it was cold : and they warmed themselves : and Peter stood with them , and warmed himself .
translation.kha: Ka la long kaba khriat , kumta ki shakri bad ki nongap phira ki la thang ding da u rnga bad ki la ïeng sawdong jong ka , ban pynsyaid ïa lade . Te u Petros u la leit shata bad u la ïa-ïeng bad ki , ban pynsyaid ïa lade .

translation.en: Then they said , Behold , there is a feast of the  Lord  in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth–el , on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth–el to Shechem , and on the south of Lebonah .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ïa-pyrkhat ,  Ka Jingkhawai Niam kaba shisien shisnem ha U  Trai  ha Shiloh shen ka la wan poi .  ( Ka Shiloh ka don shatei na Bethel , shathie na Lebonah , bad sha mihngi na ka lynti bah hapdeng ka Bethel bad ka Shekhem . )

translation.en: Even him , whose coming is after the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders ,
translation.kha: Uta u Basniew un wan ha ka bor u Soitan bad un leh shibun ki kambah bad ki kamphylla kiba bakla ,
U syiem Hiram jrong ka tyrtho u phah ka kynjoh ki nongkhaïi sha u Dabid ; u pynbiang ïa u ki dieng sawdong Kedesh bad ki misteri dieng bad ki misteri mut pun tei iing ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David , and cedar trees , and carpenters , and masons : and they built David an house .

translation.kha: Nangta nga la iehnoh ïa ka Topheth , ha kaba U Trai u la pah ïa de Ban pynbna ïa ka khubor jong u . Nga la leit bad ïeng hapoh ka phla Jong ka Tubal bad ïathuh ha ki brai baroh
translation.en: Then came Jeremiah from Topheth , whither the  Lord  had sent him to prophesy  ; and he stood in the court of the  Lord s  house  ; and said to all the people ,

translation.kha: Ka Jobab ka sarong palat ! Nga la ïohsngew katno ka jingsarong , ka jingsngewbiang ki briew ki long , kattne ki pyrkhat shaphang ïa lade .
translation.en: We have heard the pride of Moab , ( he is exceeding proud ) his loftiness , and his arrogancy , and his pride , and the haughtiness of his heart .

translation.kha: kita kiba ïa-ïam , kumba kim smam la sngewsih ; kito kiba rkhie , kumba kim shym la don ka jingkmen ; bad re babha ïathied , kumba kim shem long trai ïa kaei kaba ki la thab ;
translation.en: And they that weep , as though they wept not ; and they that rejoice , as though they rejoiced not ; and they that buy , as though they possessed not ;

And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day , it shall not be accepted , neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it : it shall be an abomination , and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity .
translation.kha: Lada la bam ïa ka ha ka sngi kaba lai , U Blei un ym pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jong uta u briew . Ïa kata ka jingainguh yn ym ñiew kum ka jingainguh jong u hynrei yn kheiñ ba ka long ka bymkhuid , bad uno uno uba bam ïa ka un kit hi ïa la ka pop .

Mynta , shaphang kaei kaba phi la thoh ïa ka jingbam ba la kñia sha ki bleithaw . Ka long kaba shisha , te , ba ma ngi baroh Ngi Don ka jingtip , wohnia ki ong . Pynban , kum kata ka jingtip , ka pynmeng ïa u briew da ka jingsarong ; hynrei ka jingieit ka ter keiñ .
translation.en: Now as touching things offered unto idols , we know that we all have knowledge . Knowledge puffeth up , but charity edifieth .
To the law and to the testimony : if they speak not according to this word , it is because there is no light in them .
translation.kha: Me dei ban jubab ïa ki ,  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u hikai ïa phi ! Wat shahshkor ïa ki nongkren byrtong — kaei kaba ki ong ïa phi kan ym weng ïa ka jingjynjar .

translation.en: But thou , O  Lord  , knowest me : thou hast seen me , and tried mine heart toward thee : pull them out like sheep for the slaughter , and prepare them for the day of slaughter .
translation.kha: Hynrei , A  Trai  , me ithuh ïa nga ; me ïohi kaei ba nga leh , bad kumno nga la ieit ïa me . To paring sharud ïa kine ki rangbah basniew kum ïa ki langbrot ki ban shah ot doh ; to sumar ïa ki tad haduh ba ka dei ka por ïa ki ban shah pynïap .
U la mano nabar shakri ïa u Baal , sad kumta u kpa jong u ha shuwa jyllang u , u la pynkhih pisa ïa U Trai , U Blei jong ki Israel .
translation.en: For he served Baal , and worshipped him , and provoked to anger the  Lord  God of Israel , according to all that his father had done .
There are not found that returned to give glory to God , save this stranger .

translation.en: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well ; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better .
translation.kha: Kumta u briew uba shongkurim u leh ïa kaba dei , hynrei uta u bym shongkurim u leh ïa kaba kham bha .

Phin shim ïa ki bleithaw jong phi ba la sop da ka rupa bad ïa ki bleithaw jong phi ba la tap da ka ksiar , mala phin bret napoh ïa ki kum ïa ka jakhlia , bad phin pyrta , Wat don shuh ha khmat jong nga !
translation.en: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver , and the ornament of thy molten images of gold : thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth  ; thou shalt say unto it , Get thee hence .

translation.kha: Kynton tur byrsha ïa ki shnong jong phi baroh ha kata ka ri ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi , bad ki kynriah naba jrong bad kiba skhem ha kiba ai jingshngain ïa phi kin kyllon .
translation.en: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates , until thy high and fenced walls come down , wherein thou trustedst , throughout all thy land : and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land , which the  Lord  thy God hath given thee .

translation.kha: Um ei ki nonghiarpateng , ym don kiba lait im .
translation.en: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people , nor any remaining in his dwellings .

translation.kha: Haba u nongpeit phatok u la ïoh ïa kan ka hukum , u la buh ïa ki sha ka kamra set kaba shapoh duh bad u la teh ïa ki kjat jong ki hapdeng ki dieng tari kiba khia .
translation.en: Who , having received such a charge , thrust them into the inner prison , and made their feet fast in the stocks .

translation.kha: Hynrei , haba ki nongshimwai ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la kren para ma ki , ‘ Une u dei u khun jong u trai . To jing ïa-pynïap ïa u , bad ka jingdon jingem jong u kan Long ka jong ngi !’
translation.en: But when the husbandmen saw him , they reasoned among themselves , saying , This is the heir : come , let us kill him , that the inheritance may be ours .

translation.kha: To nguh ïa u maw jingtep na ka bynta ka Joab ; shen yn pynjot ïa ka . Ïa ki shnong jong ka yn ieh ha ka jingjot , bad yn ym don shuh aiwai ruh u ban shong ban sah pat hangta .
translation.en: Give wings unto Moab , that it may flee and get away : for the cities thereof shall be desolate , without any to dwell therein .

translation.kha: Hangta ki la tyrwa ïa U Jisu ka waiñ ba la khleh bad ka kyntang bakthang ; hynrei hadien ba u la mad ïa ka , um Tertios dih .
translation.en: They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall : and when he had tasted thereof , he would not drink .

And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning , it was told Samuel , saying , Saul came to Carmel , and , behold , he set him up a place , and is gone about , and passed on , and gone down to Gilgal .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka step kaba bud u leit wad ïa u Saul . U ïohsngew ba u Saul u la leit sha ka nongrit Karmel , ha kaba u la tei mot ïa lade , bad nangta u la leit sha Gilgal .
Ha kaba pynïeng ïa ka , u Moses u pynskhem ïa ki tliew tnaw jong ka , u pynïeng ïa ki jingker jong ka , u pyndait ïa ki diengkhap jong ka , bad u pynïeng ïa ki rishot jong ka .
translation.en: And Moses reared up the tabernacle , and fastened his sockets , and set up the boards thereof , and put in the bars thereof , and reared up his pillars .

translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki la pynkhlaiñ ïa ki aiñ jong u Patsha , da katba nguh ba don uwei pait u syiem , uba kyrteng U Jisu .
translation.en: Whom Jason hath received : and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar , saying that there is another king , one Jesus .

translation.kha: Don kiba bapher lyngba ka telephone .
translation.en: Some even study over the telephone .

translation.kha: Ngam tip la u dem u nongpop ne um dei , uta u briew u la phai ktien . Dang ïa kan kawei nga tip : Nga la long kiba matlah , bad mynta nga la imat .
translation.en: He answered and said , Whether he be a sinner or no , I know not : one thing I know , that , whereas I was blind , now I see .

translation.kha: Nga la Ïoh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U Trai . Ha ka , nga ïohi ïa u ba u dang ïeng marsyndah ka kynroh ïa kob la tei da ka jingïarap u sawar , bad la don u sawar ha ka kti jongu u .
translation.en: Thus he shewed me : and , behold , the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline , with a plumbline in his hand .
Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith  ; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross , despising the shame , and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God .
translation.kha: To ngin ïakhmih shaiñ sha U Jisu , ha uba ka jingngeit jong ngi ka don naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut . U bym shym la kynran dien namar ka diengphna ! Pynban , namar ka jingkmen kaba la ap ïa u , um shym pyrkhat ei ei ïa ka jingjahburom ban shahïap halor ka diengphna , bad mynta u la shong ha ka liang ka mon jong ka khet U Blei .

translation.en: Ephraim , he hath mixed himself among the people  ; Ephraim is a cake not turned .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki long kum u kpu bym pat ih bha .

translation.en: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest , the son of Ahitub , and all his father s house , the priests that were in Nob : and they came all of them to the king .
translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Saul u phah khot ïa u Ahimelekh u lyngdoh bad ïa baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong u , kiba la long ruh ki lyngdoh ha Nob , bad ki la ïawan sha u .
Kumta nga ong ïa Phi mynta ba ngan ym beh noh ïa film ki briew katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat . Kin long ki nongshukor jong Phin , bad phin shah riam da ka jingma ïa ki blei jong ki .
translation.en: Wherefore I also said , I will not drive them out from before you  ; but they shall be as thorns in your sides , and their gods shall be a snare unto you .
And he said , Take them alive . And they took them alive , and slew them at the pit of the shearing house , even two and forty men  ; neither left he any of them .
translation.kha: U Jehu u la hukum ïa la ki briew ,  Kem im ïa ki .  Ki la kem ïa ki , bad u pynïap ïa ki hajan kawei ka thliew hangta . Baroh ki ïadon sawphew ar ngut , bad ym shym la pyllait im ïa uwei ruh na ki .
ngam khot ïa ki briew jong nga bad ngan lumlang ïa ki . ngan pyllait im ïa ki bad pynlong ïa ki , kiba lep paid kumba ki ju long .
translation.en: I will hiss for them , and gather them  ; for I have redeemed them : and they shall increase as they have increased .

translation.kha: Bad haba la pyntip ha per ba ka la don ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u , shisyndon nga la rai ban phah ïa u sha phin . Nga la ong ïa ki nongmudui jong u ban ai ki jinglui jong ki pynshah ïa u ha khmat jong pa’ .
translation.en: And when it was told me how that the Jews laid wait for the man , I sent straightway to thee , and gave commandment to his accusers also to say before thee what they had against him . Farewell .
And they brought him on horses : and he was buried at Jerusalem with his fathers in the city of David .
translation.kha: Ïa ka metïap jong u la rah biang sha Jerusalem halor u kulai bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid .

translation.en: He is swift as the waters  ; their portion is cursed in the earth : he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards .
translation.kha: Ïa u briew uba sniew la rong noh ha ka jingshlei , bad ka jaka kaba u long trai ka don hapoh ka jingtim U Blei ; um leit shuh ban trei ha la ki bri sohwaiñ .

Nga noh biang , nga tip ba ïa une u briew la rudnong noh sha ka parad (Nga shisien , ngam tip) la kane ka da jia shisha ne ka la long tang ka jingïohipaw — tang U Blei uba Tip , bad hangta u la ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba ym lah ban buh ha ki kyntien , kiei ki kiba ki rmiang shyntur briew kim lah ban kren .
translation.en: How that he was caught up into paradise , and heard unspeakable words , which it is not lawful for a man to utter .
And why call ye me , Lord , Lord , and do not the things which I say ?

Kohnguh ïa ki baroh , khnang ba phin manbha , bad ba phin im slem ha kata ka ri kaba phin sa ïakyndit .
translation.en: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the  Lord  your God hath commanded you , that ye may live , and that it may be well with you , and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess .

translation.kha: Te , ïa kine , yn phah noh sha ka jingpynriam bymjukut , hynrei kiba hok Kin leit sha ka jingshim bymjukut .
translation.en: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment : but the righteous into life eternal .
Every way of a man is right in his own eyes : but the  Lord  pondereth the hearts .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban tharai ba baroh kat kaba phi leh ka long kaba dei , hynrei kynmaw ba U  Trai  u bishar ïa ki jingthmu jong phi .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , your redeemer , the Holy One of Israel  ; For your sake I have sent to Babylon , and have brought down all their nobles , and the Chaldeans , whose cry is in the ships .

translation.en: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword , not of a mighty man  ; and the sword , not of a mean man , shall devour him : but he shall flee from the sword , and his young men shall be discomfited .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Depart , and go up hence , thou and the people which thou hast brought up out of the land of Egypt , unto the land which I sware unto Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , saying , Unto thy seed will I give it :

translation.en: There were together Simon Peter , and Thomas called Didymus , and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee , and the sons of Zebedee , and two other of his disciples .

As unknown , and yet well known ; as dying , and , behold , we live ; as chastened , and not killed ;

translation.en: I am thine , save me  ; for I have sought thy precepts .

translation.en: Of whom be thou ware also ; for he hath greatly withstood our words .
