translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba leh ïa katai kaba sha u woh sha ka jingshai khnang ba ka jingshai kan pynpaw ïa kaei kambah u la leh ka long da kaba kumjuh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light , that his deeds may be made manifest , that they are wrought in God .

translation.kha: Hangta nga la ïohsngew ïa uwei u angel umbah kylli ïa uwei pat , Haduh katno kine kiew kiei kiba la ïor ha ka jingïohipaw kan ïalang ? Haduh katno ka pop ijli ka bujli ïa ki jingkñia ba man ka sngi ? Haduh katai ïa ka kynhun shipai ba kynja bneng bad ïa ka Templ yn kordit ?
translation.en: Then I heard one saint speaking , and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake , How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice , and the transgression of desolation , to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot ?
By faith Abraham , when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance , obeyed  ; and he went out , not knowing whither he went .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa u Abraham ban kohnguh haba U Blei u la khot ïa u ban leit sha ka ri kaba U Blei u la kular ban ai ha u . U la mihnoh na la ka ri khlem tip shano ba un leit .
bad phin kthong biang ïa u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .
translation.en: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the  Lord  , and do all his commandments which I command thee this day .
And when even was come , he went out of the city .
translation.kha: Haba la janmiet , U Jisu bad ki synran jong u ki la mihnoh na ka nongbah .

translation.en: But I have used none of these things : neither have I written these things , that it should be so done unto me : for it were better for me to die , than that any man should make my glorying void .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la pyndonkam ïa kano kano na kine ki jingmyntoi , lymne ngam shym la thoh ïa kane mynta khnang ban dawa ïa kiba kum kine ki hok na ka bynta ïa lade . Kan kham bha ïa nga ba ngan ïap shuwa ! Ym don mano mano ban pynkylla ïa ka jingkob badei hok jong nga sha ki kyntien ba thylli !
La ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingdon jrong ki shipai shong khwai : Ki la long ahor lakh ngut .
translation.en: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand : and I heard the number of them .

translation.kha: Ïa ki kjat jong u la sop da ka rnong , bad u kiew ïa u sum rnong ba tawah ha ka tynneng .
translation.en: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs , and a target of brass between his shoulders .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong U Blei! ki la mane ïa ki bleithaw , bad kano ka la pynlong ïa ki ba kin shah pynjot .
translation.en: And they served their idols : which were a snare unto them .

translation.kha: Ngin sngewhun ha ki jingtlot , ki jingkrenbeiñ , ki jingjynjar , ki jingshah pynmih , bad ki jingeh na ka bynta U Khrist . Naba haba nga tlot , daiñ Haneng ba nga khlaiñ .
translation.en: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities , in reproaches , in necessities , in persecutions , in distresses for Christ s sake : for when I am weak , then am I strong .

translation.kha: U Ussiel ruh u don lai ngut ki khun shngain : u Mishael , u Elisaphan , bad u Sithri .
translation.en: And the sons of Uzziel  ; Mishael , and Elzaphan , and Zithri .

translation.kha: U Amraphel u khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka U Trai U Pynbiang . Bad haduh kane ka sngi ruh , ki briew ki dang ong , Ha u lum jong U Trai u pynpang .
translation.en: And Abraham called the name of that place Jehovah–jireh : as it is said to this day , In the mount of the  Lord  it shall be seen .
For the customs of the people are vain : for one cutteth a tree out of the forest , the work of the hands of the workman , with the axe .
translation.kha: Ka niam jong kine ki briew ka long ka bymdondor ei ei . La khet ïa u dieng ha khlaw ; la ohdur da ki tiar u nong-ohdieng ,

translation.en: On the first day shall be an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong na kita ki sngi , ïalumlang ban mane Blei , bad wat trei ei ei kumba phi ju trei man la ka sngi .

translation.en: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ , happy are ye  ; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you : on their part he is evil spoken of , but on your part he is glorified .
translation.kha: Suk ma phi haba phi shah krenbeiñ namar ba phi long ki nongbud jong U Khrist ; kane ka mut ba U Mynsiem ka burom , U Mynsiem jong U Blei , u don ha phi .
Ki la ap haduh ba ki ïangat ia ban ap , hynrei haba um shym la pli ïa ka jingkhang , ki la shim ïa u Shabeh bad plie ïa ka . bad hangta u don u kynrad lad ki , u da thiah ïap ha madan .
translation.en: And they tarried till they were ashamed : and , behold , he opened not the doors of the parlour  ; therefore they took a key , and opened them : and , behold , their lord was fallen down dead on the earth .

translation.kha: Naba ïa u Adam la thaw nyngkong , nangta ïa ka Im .
translation.en: For Adam was first formed , then Eve .
When his disciples heard it , they were exceedingly amazed , saying , Who then can be saved ?
translation.kha: Haba ki synran ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la kyndit thret .  Uei te uba lah ban lait im ?  ki la kylli .
Ahian ka jingkha ïa u Joseph , u Jakob u ïa-ong ha u Laban , Pyllait noh ïa nga , ba ngan ïoh leit phai noh sha la ïing .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Rachel had born Joseph , that Jacob said unto Laban , Send me away , that I may go unto mine own place , and to my country .

translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la ong ha u , Nga tip ba U Messaïah un sa wan , bad haba u wan , un sa ïathuh ha ngi ïa kiei keiñ baroh .
translation.en: The woman saith unto him , I know that Messias cometh , which is called Christ : when he is come , he will tell us all things .
And Moses was content to dwell with the man : and he gave Moses Zipporah his daughter .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la mynjur ban shong ban sah noh hangta , bad u Jethro ruh u pynshongkurim ïa u bad ka Sipporah ka khun jong u kaba la kha khun shynrang ïa u Moses .

translation.en: And he received them at their hand , and fashioned it with a graving tool , after he had made it a molten calf : and they said , These be thy gods , O Israel , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: U la shim ïa kita ki sohshkor , u thang pynum ïa ki , u theh ïa ka ksiar ha ka tiar saiñdur , bad u thaw ïa ka dur u khun masi . Ki paidbah ki ïa-ong ,  Ko Israel , une u long u blei jong ngi , uba la ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt !

Bad man uwei pa uwei u nongïamareh uba khong ha ka jingshah hikai , u pyndem ha ka jinghikai kaba pyrkhing , khnang ba yn pynbang da ka pynngat sla dieng ka bymneh ; hynrei ma ngi pat ngi ïaleh na ka bynta —kata ka ban neh jrong la junom .
translation.en: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things . Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown ; but we an incorruptible .
And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed , saying , Of a truth this fellow also was with him : for he is a Galilaean .
translation.kha: Bad kumba shi kynta hadien , sa uwei pat u briew u la ban jur ,  Ym don kano kano ka jingartatien ba une u briew u la don lem bad U Jisu , naba ma u hi ruh u long u nong Galilaïa !
U la ïalap na ka bynta baroh , khnang ba kito kiba im kim dih shuh Ban im na ka bynshet ïa lade , hyndai tang na ka bynta jong uta uba la ïap bun ba la pynmihpat na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: And that he died for all , that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves , but unto him which died for them , and rose again .
The inhabitants of the villages ceased , they ceased in Israel , until that I Deborah arose , that I arose a mother in Israel .
translation.kha: Deborah , ki nongrit jong ka Israel ki sah kynjah , Ki ïeng thylli tad ynda pha wan , Pha wan kum ka kmie ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: O how love I thy law ! it is my meditation all the day .
translation.kha: A katno nga ieit ïa ka aiñ jong me ! Nga pyrkhat ïa ka baroh shi sngi .
Baroh ki briew bad ki mrad ki dei ban phong ki daiñ ïajan . Uwei pa iwei u dei ban ïadie jur ha U Blei bad u dadien ban iehnoh ïa ka jingleh bymman bad ki kam sniew jong u .
translation.en: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth , and cry mightily unto God : yea , let them turn every one from his evil way , and from the violence that is in their hands .

translation.kha: U la kham jied ban sohkhram bad ki briew jong U blang ban ïa Kaba lehkmen ha ka pep katno katne na .
translation.en: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of God , than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season  ;
He sheweth his word unto Jacob , his statutes and his judgments unto Israel .
translation.kha: U ai ïa ka khubor jong u sha ki briew jong u , ki jingbthah bad ki aiñ jong u ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And thou shalt sanctify them , that they may be most holy : whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy .
translation.kha: Pynkyntang ïa ki kumne ba kin dup long kiba khuid janai bad ïa uno uno ne kaei kaei kaba pyndei ïa ki yn pynmynsaw da ka bor ka jingkhuid jong ki .

translation.en: And I took your sin , the calf which ye had made , and burnt it with fire , and stamped it , and ground it very small , even until it was as small as dust : and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount .
translation.kha: Nga shim ïa kata kaei kaei kaba long hi ka pop — kata ka dur khun masi keiñ kaba phi la thaw bad nga bret ïa ka ha ka ding . Nangta nga pynpait pharia ïa ka , nga tylliat ni ïa ka haduh ba kan da long kum u pui pui , bad nga bret ïa kata ha ka wah kaba tuid na uta u lum .
bad ka Shareser jong ki them kiba kot shaduh ka shnong Ar badno shaduh u pud ka ri Moab .
translation.en: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar , and lieth upon the border of Moab .

translation.kha: Baalah ki briew ki stet haduh katta katta ban leh ïa ki kam sniew ? Namar ïa ka kam sniew ym ju kham pynshitom Kloi .
translation.en: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily , therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil .

translation.kha: U Joseph u ong , Kane ka mut kumne : kita ki tnat lai tylli ki long lah tylli ki sngi .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto him , This is the interpretation of it : The three branches are three days :

translation.kha: Kumta nga la rung shahjop bad ang khmih . Ïa ka kynroh la tap da ki jingdro ïa ki dur bseiñ , badno ïa kiwei pat ki mrad bymkhuid , bad ïa kiwei patan kiei kiei kiba ki Jeraïah ki ïamane .
translation.en: So I went in and saw  ; and behold every form of creeping things , and abominable beasts , and all the idols of the house of Israel , portrayed upon the wall round about .

Thus saith the  Lord  , Stand ye in the ways , and see , and ask for the old paths , where is the good way , and walk therein , and ye shall find rest for your souls . But they said , We will not walk therein .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  To ïeng ha ka jaka ba ïashem ki lad bad to khmih . Kylli shaphang ki lynti ïaid kiba mynbarim bad hangno ka don ka surok babha tam . To ïaid ha ka , bad phin im ha ka jingsuk .  Hynrei ki ong ,  Em , ngin ym leh !
Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ka khet balieh kabu khraw bad ïa uta uba shong ha ka . Ka pyrthei bad ka bneng ki la kjat na khmat jong u bad ym shym la ïohi shuh ïa ki .
translation.en: And I saw a great white throne , and him that sat on it , from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away  ; and there was found no place for them .
And he tarried seven days , according to the set time that Samuel had appointed : but Samuel came not to Gilgal  ; and the people were scattered from him .
translation.kha: U la ap hynñiew sngi ïa u Samuel , kumba u Samuel u la bthah ïa u ban leh , hynrei u Samuel um pat shym wan poi sha Gilgal .

translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that the nation and kingdom which will not serve the same Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon , and that will not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon , that nation will I punish , saith the  Lord  , with the sword , and with the famine , and with the pestilence , until I have consumed them by his hand .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada kano kano ka jaitbynriew lane ka hima kam pyndem ha ka jingsynshar jong u , te ngan pynshitom ïa kata ka jaitbynriew da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad da ka jingpang tad haduh ba ngan da shah ïa u Nebukhadnessar ban pynjot khoit ïa ka .
Lada phi ieit ïa la ka jingim , phet krad na ki jingriam Kaba pynngat ïa u bymman ha ka lynti ïaid .
translation.en: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward : he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them .

Yea , every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the  Lord  of hosts : and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them , and seethe therein : and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei u khiew shet ha Jerusalem bad ha baroh ka Judah yn pynkyrpang na ka bynta ban pyndonkam ha ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh . Ki briew kiba ai ïa ki jingkñia kin pyndonkam ïa ki ban phon ïa ka doh jong ki jingkñia . Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don shuh uno uno u nongkhaïi ha ka Templ jong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh .

translation.en: The noise of a whip , and the noise of the rattling of the wheels , and of the pransing horses , and of the jumping chariots .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ! Ka jingsawa u shabuk , ka jingriew ki shalyntem , ka jingsawa ka jingïaid ki kulai , ka jingkynthih jong ki kali ïapom !

translation.en: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines , and to the border of Egypt .
translation.kha: U long u nongsynshar uba hakhlieh tam na ki syiem baroh ha ka thain naduh ka wah Ïuphratis haduh ka ri Philistia bad haduh khappud ka Ijipt .
Ko phi ki kynthah kiba im suk , ki ngi don ki jingkhuslai , to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba nga ong .
translation.en: Rise up , ye women that are at ease  ; hear my voice , ye careless daughters  ; give ear unto my speech .

translation.kha: Naba ka khun jrong kaba la 12 snem karta ka la iap .
translation.en: His 12-year-old daughter had died .
Of course , there are requirements to be met if we are to live forever in the coming Paradise on earth .
translation.kha: Hooid , ki don ki jingdawa kiba ngi hap ban pynbiang lada ngi kwah ban im junom la junom ha ka Paradais ban sa wan ha ka Pyrthei .

translation.en: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart  ; they are revolted and gone .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi ki briew ! Phi long kiba eh ryndang bad kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ; phi la phai noh sharud bad iehnoh ïa nga .
Ka jingjynjar ka wan . Phin wad ïa ka jingsuk , hynrei Phon ym shem ïa ka .
translation.en: Destruction cometh  ; and they shall seek peace , and there shall be none .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh ha ka Sngi kaba bud , u Hasael u shim ïa ka jaiñsop thiah , u wieh ïa ka ha ka um , bad u tap khlaiñ ïa u syiem haduh ba un da ïap op . Bad u Hasael u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that he took a thick cloth , and dipped it in water , and spread it on his face , so that he died : and Hazael reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Wat sheptieng , ko kynhun barit , naba U Kpa jong phi u la sngewbha ban ai ha phiah ïa ka Hima .
translation.en: Fear not , little flock  ; for it is your Father s good pleasure to give you the kingdom .
For many shall come in my name , saying , I am Christ  ; and shall deceive many .
translation.kha: Shibun ki briew , ki ban kam ba ki kren na ka bynta jong nga , kin wan bad ong , ‘ Nga long ma u !’ bad kin shukor ïa kiba bun ki briew .

translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  : he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done .
translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki nuksa jong u kpa jong u , u Ussaïah , u Jotham u la leh hi ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
Yn ba-don ki jingkhynñiuh jumai babha shyrkhei , ki nemsniew , malade ki khohram ha kylleng kylleng ; kin don kiei kiei ibha phylliew dara kiba pynliem kiba wan na sahit bneng .
translation.en: And great earthquakes shall be in divers places , and famines , and pestilences  ; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Ki briew ki ïa-ong ba khnai ka jaka ka long kum ka ri shyiap , ba kam don ki biria ne ki mrad kiba im ha ka . Bad ki ino ïa kaba daiñ ; ki shnong ka Judah bad ki surok bah ka Jerusalem ki long thylli ; ym don ki briew ne ki mrad kiba im hangamei .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Again there shall be heard in this place , which ye say shall be desolate without man and without beast , even in the cities of Judah , and in the streets of Jerusalem , that are desolate , without man , and without inhabitant , and without beast ,

translation.kha: Ngin kohnguh ïa me kumba ngi la ju kohnguh ïa u Moses , bad ai ba U Trai U Blei jrong me un longïng ryngkat bad me kumba u la long badno u Moses !
translation.en: According as we hearkened unto Moses in all things , so will we hearken unto thee : only the  Lord  thy God be with thee , as he was with Moses .
Nevertheless in those days , saith the  Lord  , I will not make a full end with you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Wat ha kito ki sngi ngan ym pynjot khoit ïa ki briew jong nga .

Katno Kaba kynjah long ka Jerusalem , kaba syier ka long kaba dap da ki briew ! Shisien la pyndonburom da ka pyrthei , mynta ka Long kum ka riewkynthei ; kob donburom tam na ki nongbah ka la kyllon sha ka jinglongmraw .
translation.en: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger , and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel , and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger !

translation.kha: Kito kiba smai ha ki balaitluid jyllang ka Seraïah , kiba ïong , ‘ Da u blei jong ki Dan ,’ lane , ‘ Da u blei jongki ki Beersheba ,’ — kito ki briew kin kyllon , bad ktien ym khie pat .
translation.en: They that swear by the sin of Samaria , and say , Thy god , O Dan , liveth  ; and , The manner of Beer–sheba liveth  ; even they shall fall , and never rise up again .

translation.kha: ki ñiewkordor Karnelian , bad kiwei pat ki mawlynnai ïa-ban buh ha ka ohdur jong u Rangbah lyngkdong bun ha ka jingdeng shadem jong u .
translation.en: Onyx stones , and stones to be set in the ephod , and in the breastplate .

translation.kha: U pynïeng ïa ka duwan hangta , bad u la khet kyrteng ïa ka da ka kyrteng El , U Blei jong ki Israel .
translation.en: And he erected there an altar , and called it El–elohe–Israel .

And the people thirsted there for water  ; and the people murmured against Moses , and said , Wherefore is this that thou hast brought us up out of Egypt , to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew ki la thynrang palat bad ki la ïai khñium ha u Moses . Ki la ong ,  Balei keiñ ba phi wan ïalam noh ïa ngi na ka ri Ijipt ? Hato phi mut ban pynïap da ka jingsliang ïa ngi bad ïa ki khun ki kti jong ngi , bad ïa ki jingri jong ngi ?
Ha kata ka por U Jisu u la ong , Ko Kpa , U Trai ka bneng bad ka pyrthei ! Nga jingsakhi ïa me ñiar ba me la pynum ha ki stad ïa Kiei kaba me la buhrieh na kiba stad bad kiba la ïoh jinghikai .
translation.en: At that time Jesus answered and said ,  I thank thee , O Father , Lord of heaven and earth , because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent , and hast revealed them unto babes .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jutang jong nga bad me , bad nur-um ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew .
translation.en: And I will make my covenant between me and thee , and will multiply thee exceedingly .

translation.kha: Ngi duwai ha U Blei ba phin ym leh ïa ka bymdei — ym ban pynpaw ba ngi erlangthari kiba la jop , te hynrei ba phin ïoh leh ïa kaba daiñ , wat la ka i kumba ine lama kiba la shahjop .
translation.en: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil ; not that we should appear approved , but that ye should do that which is honest , though we be as reprobates .
And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time , and numbered all Israel .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , u syiem Joram u mihnoh na Samaria bad u lumlang ïa ki kynhun shipai jong u baroh .

translation.en: Conscience , I say , not thine own , but of the other : for why is my liberty judged of another man s conscience ?
translation.kha: kata ka long , ym ka jingïatiplem jong phi , hynrei ka jingïatiplem jong uta uwei pat u briew .  Kumta , te ,  don u ban kylli ,  balei ba ïa ka jinglaitluid jong nga ban leh ïa kaei kaei la buh pud da ka jingïatiplem jong uwei pat ?
To duwai ha U Bel ba phim khie kiei keiñ ym jia ha ka por tlang !
translation.en: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter .
For he had healed many  ; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him , as many as had plagues .
translation.kha: U la lah pynkhiah ïa kiba bun ki briew , bad baroh kito kiba pang ki la ïai kyntur sha u khnang ba ïohktah ïa u .

To kynmaw ïa ki angel ki me shym la ri ïa ka burom hapoh ki buid ka bor synshar jong ki , hynrei ki la iohnong ïa ki jaka shong jong ki hi : Ki shahïap khum da ki kynjri bymjukut hapoh kaba puta tliw tliw , ha kaba U Blei u buh ïa ki na ka bynta kata ka Snem kaba khraw ha kaba yn pynrem ïa ki .
translation.en: And the angels which kept not their first estate , but left their own habitation , he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day .
And the staff of his spear was like a weaver s beam  ; and his spear s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron : and one bearing a shield went before him .
translation.kha: U sum jong u , u rben kat u khung ha ka kor u nongthain jaiñ ; bad tang u sop nar jong u , u khia kumba hynñiew kilo . U shipai u ïaid ha shuwa jong u da kaba rah ïa ka stieh .
Kumta ka Ruth ka leit sha ka jaka kop kew bad ka la lai ïa kaei kaba ka kiaw kurim jongno ka , ka la bthah ïa ka .
translation.en: And she went down unto the floor , and did according to all that her mother in law bade her .

translation.kha: Ïa ka kali ïapom kaba nyngkong la tan da ki kulai rong saw , ïa kaba ar da ki kulai rong ïong ,
translation.en: In the first chariot were red horses  ; and in the second chariot black horses  ;
In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering : and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar .
translation.kha: Ïa u mrad na ka bynta kane ka jingkñia dei ban pynïap ha ka bynta bashatei jong ka duwan , ha kaba ju pynïap ïa ki mrad ba la wallam kum ki jingainguh thang , bad ïa ka snam jong u dei ban synreit ha baroh sawdong jong ka duwan .
Naba u la ong ha u Moses , Ngan ïa-ïohi ha uno uno uba nga kwah ; sam sngewsynei ïa Uno isangsot uba nga kwah .
translation.en: For he saith to Moses , I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy , and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga pynshitom ïa ki paid Jerusalem na ka bynta ki pop jong ki , ngan pynjot ïa ki kito ka Bethel . Ïa ki dong jong kawei pa kawei ka reng yn pom noh bad kin hap ha madan .
translation.en: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth–el : and the horns of the altar shall be cut off , and fall to the ground .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,

Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation , and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength , therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants , and shalt set it with strange slips :
translation.kha: Ko Israel , pha la klet noh ïa U Blei uba la pyllait ïa pha bad uba la ïada ïa pha kum u mawsiang bah . Pynban , pha la thung ki kper bakyntang khnang ban mane ïa u blei nongwei .
wahbah katai ka por ka wan , ïa ka Israel yn kdar pur bad ka Ijipt bad ka Assyria , bad ktien ki lai tylli ki ri kmen long ka jingkyrkhu ïa ka pyllait baïar .
translation.en: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria , even a blessing in the midst of the land :

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u nongpdem ïa u , Haba me ai ïa ka ïam step ne ka smam miet , wat khot sngewbha ïa ki paralok jong me lane ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong me lane ïa ki ba-ha-ïing jongnga me lane ki paramarjan kiba riewspah jong me — nia keiñ khot sngewbha kylliang ïa me , bad ha kane ka stang yn sa siew ïa me na ka bynshet kaei kaba me la imat .
translation.en: Then said he also to him that bade him ,  When thou makest a dinner or a supper , call not thy friends , nor thy brethren , neither thy kinsmen , nor thy rich neighbours  ; lest they also bid thee again , and a recompence be made thee .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong , Nga noh ha phin ïa ka jingshisha : U briew u bym rang sha ka sem ki longïng na ka jingkhang , hynrei uba shu kiew nongai pat , u long u nongleh bad u riewlamwir .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that entereth not by the door into the sheepfold , but climbeth up some other way , the same is a thief and a robber .

translation.kha: Katba kane ka dang long kumne , meng shym la don ha Jerusalem , namar ha ka snem kaba laiphew ar ba u Artakserksis u long u Syiem ka Babilon , nga la dei ban leit phai ban ai jingtip sha u . Ahian katto katne por , nga la ïoh jingbit
translation.en: But in all this time was not I at Jerusalem : for in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon came I unto the king , and after certain days obtained I leave of the king :

translation.kha: La pynïadait skhem haduh kor katta ïa ki baroh ba ym don kano kano kaba lah ba-bang pynïakhlad ïa ki .
translation.en: They are joined one to another , they stick together , that they cannot be sundered .
And he said , What have they seen in thine house ? And Hezekiah answered , All the things that are in mine house have they seen : there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them .
translation.kha: Ki la ïohi aïu ha ka ïingsyiem ?   Ki la ïohi lut ïa kiei kiei . Ym don kano kano ha ki jaka buh tiar ïa kaba ngam shym la pyn-i ha ki .

translation.en: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire , and used divination and enchantments , and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
translation.kha: Ki kñia ïa ki khun shynrang bad kynthei kum ki jingainguh thang sha ki blei thala ; ki wad jingmut na ki nongleh byrtong bad ki nongpeit kti , bad ki aiti lut ïa lade ban leh ïa kaei kaba bakla ha khmat U  Trai  , bad kumta ki pynkhih bitar ïa U .
Ha shuwa ban rim noh shajrong ïa u , u la ai ki jingbthah da ka bor U mynsngi Bakhuid ha ki rangbah kiba u la jied kum ki apostol jong u .
translation.en: Until the day in which he was taken up , after that he through the Holy Ghost had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen :

translation.kha: Ka Abigail ka la pynstet baneh lum arspah tylli ki kpu , ar tyllai ki pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ , san tylli ki langbrot kiba la syang , khathynñiew kilo u kew ba la syiad ; shispah tukri ki rynjup soh kmiesan , bad arspah tylli ki thut soh Dumbur tyrkhong , bad ka pynkit ïa ki halor ki kada .
translation.en: Then Abigail made haste , and took two hundred loaves , and two bottles of wine , and five sheep ready dressed , and five measures of parched corn , and an hundred clusters of raisins , and two hundred cakes of figs , and laid them on asses .
But ye believe not , because ye are not of my sheep , as I said unto you .
translation.kha: hynrei phin ym ngeit , naba phim dei ki langbrot jong nga .
Nga lah Ban ïohi ïa kamai kiei kaba ïeng hangta ; nga peit lyngdoh , hynrei ngam la Ban ong ka dei kaei .
translation.en: It stood still , but I could not discern the form thereof : an image was before mine eyes , there was silence , and I heard a voice , saying ,
So the  Lord  alone did lead him , and there was no strange god with him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  da lade hi u ïalam ïa la ki briew , ym don u blei nongwei uba ïarap ïa u .

translation.en: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind , and the ointment of his right hand , which bewrayeth itself .
translation.kha: Kumno phi lah ban pynsngap jar ïa ka ? Hato phi la ju pyrshang ban khang ïa ka lyer lane phi la ju pyrshang ban kham ha ka kti ïa ka umphniang ?
U kñia arphew ar hiar tylli ki masi malu shi lakh arphew hajar tylli ki langbrot kum ki jingainguh ïasyllok . Bad kumta ma u bad uta u paidbah baroh ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen , and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep : so the king and all the people dedicated the house of God .

translation.kha: Phi bieit ïa la ki khnam sha ka Jerusalem ba la shah kerkut , pynkhih ïa la ka ki ba la kham , sha ka pdeng ka nongbah bad ïathuhlypa pyrshah ïa ka .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem , and thine arm shall be uncovered , and thou shalt prophesy against it .
Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh , which is called the Passover .
translation.kha: Ka por ka la jan na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat , ïa kaba la khot ka Niam Ka Jinglait .

translation.en: Let it rest on the head of Joab , and on all his father s house  ; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that hath an issue , or that is a leper , or that leaneth on a staff , or that falleth on the sword , or that lacketh bread .
translation.kha: To ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta kane kan hap halor u Joab bad ka longïing jong u baroh ! Ha kawei pa kawei ka pateng to yn don u shynrang ha ka longïing jong u , uba don ka jingpang  ñiangkulia lane ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh kaba shyrkhei lane uba hap ban trei tang ïa ka kam ba trei ki kynthei lane uba shah pynïap ha ka thma lane uba kyrduh bam !
U Blei u la wallam noh ïa phi na ka jingjynsur bad u shah ïa phi Ban kmen ha ka jingshngain ; ka meng jong phi ka shlei da ka jingbam .
translation.en: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place , where there is no straitness  ; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh , U blem ki Jeruel , u ong , Ngan pynshitom ïa u Ammon , u blei jong ki Thebes , ryngkat ngan bad ka Ijipt bad ki blang bad ki syiem jong ka . Ngan shim noh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt bad ïa baroh kiba buh ïa ka jingshaniah ha u ,
translation.en: The  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saith  ; Behold , I will punish the multitude of No , and Pharaoh , and Egypt , with their gods , and their kings  ; even Pharaoh , and all them that trust in him :

translation.kha: Ko ki parabangeit jongnga ngi , ngi kwah ïa phi ban tip ïa kaei kaba ka jingaiei U Blei ka la pynpaw ha ki balang ha Midian .
translation.en: Moreover , brethren , we do you to wit of the grace of God bestowed on the churches of Macedonia ;

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha u Aaron ïa khie kaei bhor kaba nga hukum ïa me , bad un ïathuh ha u Pharaoh ba un shah ïa ki Israel ïa-ban mihnoh na ka ri jong u .
translation.en: Thou shalt speak all that I command thee : and Aaron thy brother shall speak unto Pharaoh , that he send the children of Israel out of his land .

translation.kha: U Troas u la bitar lep ïa u Aaron ruh kat ban pynïap ïa u ; kumta ha kajuh ka nga nga duwai na ka bynta jong u ruh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him : and I prayed for Aaron also the same time .
Now the acts of David the king , first and last , behold , they are written in the book of Samuel the seer , and in the book of Nathan the prophet , and in the book of Gad the seer ,
translation.kha: Ïa ka histori jong u syiem Dabid naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut la buh jingthoh ha ki kot buh jingkynmaw jong ki lai ngut ki nongïathuhlypa , u Samuel , u Nathan , bad u Gad .
Nangta u Elijah u dem lai sien halor uta u khynnah bad u duwai , Ko Trai U Blei jong nga , pynwan biang ïa ka jingtem ha une u khynnah !
translation.en: And he stretched himself upon the child three times , and cried unto the  Lord  , and said , O  Lord  my God , I pray thee , let this child s soul come into him again .

translation.kha: U Trai u kylli , Ko Amos , me ïohi aïu ? Shi shang ki soh , at la jyllop . Nangta U Trai u la ong ha nga , Kaba kut ka la woh ha ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan ym kylla shuh la ka jingmut shaphang kaba pynsum ïa ki .
translation.en: And he said , Amos , what seest thou ? And I said , A basket of summer fruit . Then said the  Lord  unto me , The end is come upon my people of Israel  ; I will not again pass by them any more .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses bad u Aaron

translation.en: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding  ; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: U briew uba shemphang u thew ban leh ïa ka kam bastad , hynrei uba bieit u sdang shisien sdang na ki liang baroh .

Wat sheptieng , u Dabid u jubab . Ngan lehbha ïa phi na ka bynta u Jonathan , u kpa jong phi . Ngan ai pat ha phi ïa ka khiew ka shyieng baroh kaba dei ka jong u Saul , u kparad jong Phin , bad phin long uba la pdiang sngewbha borabor ha ka miej bam jong nga .
translation.en: And David said unto him , Fear not : for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father s sake , and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father  ; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually .

translation.kha: Ka jingsngewmeng kan wanrah ïa ka jinghap jong Phi , hawei lama phi long kiba sngewrit , yn burom ïa phi .
translation.en: A man s pride shall bring him low : but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit .

translation.kha: Naba baïar na ngi jing paw ha khmih U Khrist , ba yn habar ïa ngi da u . Ngin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba ngi dei hok , kat kum kiei ki baroh kiba im’ la leh , la babha ne la sniew , ha Kane ka jingim ha ka met jong ngi .
translation.en: For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ ; that every one may receive the things done in his body , according to that he hath done , whether it be good or bad .
These are also proverbs of Solomon , which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out .
translation.kha: Hangne ki don shuh ki proberb u Solomon , ba la thoh da ki briew ha ka ïingbishar u Hesekaïah u syiem Judah .
Mynta phin don khrai ban bam , bad phin sngewhun . Phibi ïaroh ïa U Tlai U Blei jongki phin , uba la leh kiei kiei kiba phylla na ka bynta jong phi ki brisoh jngai nga kin ym shah ñiangapïing sha .
translation.en: And ye shall eat in plenty , and be satisfied , and praise the name of the  Lord  your God , that hath dealt wondrously with you : and my people shall never be ashamed .

translation.kha: U long U Blei uba pynkup ïa u phlang khlaw — u phlang uba don hangtei mynta bad u bym don shuh lashai , uba la thang duh ha ka lawar ding . Hato un ym da la kham leh thikna ban pynkup jaiñ ïa phi ? Katno kaba ryntih ka jingngeit phi Don !
translation.en: Wherefore , if God so clothe the grass of the field , which to day is , and to morrow is cast into the oven , shall he not much more clothe you , O ye of little faith ?

And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp , they went into one tent , and did eat and drink , and carried thence silver , and gold , and raiment , and went and hid it  ; and came again , and entered into another tent , and carried thence also , and went and hid it .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah saw ngut ki poi harud kata ka jaka shong dara , ki leit rung shapoh ka ïingjaiñ , ki bam ki dih kat kaba don , ki la rah noh ïa ka rupa , ka ksiar , bad ki jaiñ ba ki shem bad ki leit noh bad buhrieh ïa ki ; nangta ki wan phai , ki la rung ha kawei pat ka ïingjaiñ bad ki leh kumjuh .

translation.en: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest , who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the  Lord  : at his word shall they go out , and at his word they shall come in , both he , and all the children of Israel with him , even all the congregation .
translation.kha: Un hap shaniah ha u Eleasar u lyngdoh , ban wad ïa ka mon jong nga da kaba pyndonkam ïa u Urim bad u Thummim   . Da kumne u Eleasar un kdew ïa u Joshua bad u paid Israel ha ki kam jong ki baroh .

Pynban ïa ki briew jong ka Thebes la rah noh shai ka jinglongbriew . Ha katai pa kawei ka kyndong jong ka lynti bah ïa ki khun jong ki la tied pynïap . Ïa ki rangbah riewpawkhmat jngai ki la ïamareh noh ha ki kynjri bad la pynïabynta hapdeng ki nongkurup .
translation.en: Yet was she carried away , she went into captivity : her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets : and they cast lots for her honourable men , and all her great men were bound in chains .

translation.kha: Kumta ki synran ki la sdang ban ïakylli por ma ki hi , Hato la don mei mano ba la wanrah jingbam ïa u ?
translation.en: Therefore said the disciples one to another , Hath any man brought him ought to eat ?

translation.kha: Ngan pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng ki jyrthiaw kiba ma ki lymne ki kpa tymmen jongu ki , ki la ïohsngew , bad ngan phah ki kynhun shipai pynshah ïa ki tad haduh ba ngan da pynjot khoh ïa ki .
translation.en: I will scatter them also among the heathen , whom neither they nor their fathers have known : and I will send a sword after them , till I have consumed them .

translation.kha: Kumba u Hadien u la otsher sha la ïing dara u shet uwei u khunlangbrot bad u la pyndonkam shipa kilo u purew shun shet ïa u kpu khlem Thiat . U buh ïa ka doh ha ka shang bad ïa ka syrti ioh u ksew , u la wallam ïa ki shad u angel jongno U Trai ha trai u dieng Sning , bad u ai ïa ki ha u .
translation.en: And Gideon went in , and made ready a kid , and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour : the flesh he put in a basket , and he put the broth in a pot , and brought it out unto him under the oak , and presented it .

translation.kha: Me dei ban da kut jingdam triang , ban long skhem bad ban pynthikna ba Man kohnguh ïa ka Hukum baroh kaba u shakri jongno nga , u Moses u la ai ha me . Wat leh klet ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka , bad men sa jop kat shaba me rupa .
translation.en: Only be thou strong and very courageous , that thou mayest observe to do according to all the law , which Moses my servant commanded thee : turn not from it to the right hand or to the left , that thou mayest prosper whithersoever thou goest .

translation.kha: U briew uba mutlop u long uba sniew pynlang u leh ïa ki kam kiba snieh ; u ïasylla ban pynsniew ïa kiba duk da ki jingshukor bad shun khanglad ïa ki ba eh ïa ki khor jong ki .
translation.en: The instruments also of the churl are evil : he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words , even when the needy speaketh right .

translation.kha: ha Makhpelah kaba sha mynhyndai na Mamre ha ka ri Kanaan . U Abraham u la thied ïa Kanah ka krem lem bad ka lyngkha u Ephron ban pynphong jaka tep ïa ka .
translation.en: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah , which is before Mamre , in the land of Canaan , which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace .
Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea ? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth ?
translation.kha: Hato me la ju poi sha ki umpohliew ha ki jingjylliew jong ka duriaw ? Hato me la ju ïaid ha ki madan jong ka duriaw-bah ?
Ki pan , bad u phah ïa ki syiar khlaw ; u ai ïa ki ka jingbam na bnoh ban pynhun ïa ki .
translation.en: The people asked , and he brought quails , and satisfied them with the bread of heaven .

translation.kha: Nangta u Barnabas u la ïarap ïa u bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ki apostol . U la batai ha ki kumno u Saul u la ïohi ïa U thri ha ka lynti bad ba U Trai u la lah kren bad u Saul . U la ïathuh ruh kumin u Saul u la ïalap da ka jingshlur ha Damaskos ha ka kyr-ang U Jisu .
translation.en: But Barnabas took him , and brought him to the apostles , and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way , and that he had spoken to him , and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus .
Ye have been rebellious against the  Lord  from the day that I knew you .
translation.kha: Naduh ba nga la ithuh ïa phi , phi shait ïaleh pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
U Amasaïah u pynïap shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Sodom ha ka Them Mluh ; u kurup ïa ka nongbah Sela ha ka thma bad u khot ïa ka , ka Joktheel , ka kyrteng kaba dang ïaisah .
translation.en: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand , and took Sela by war , and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day .

And he will love thee , and bless thee , and multiply thee : he will also bless the fruit of thy womb , and the fruit of thy land , thy corn , and thy wine , and thine oil , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep , in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee .
translation.kha: Un ieit bad kyrkhu ïa phi , ba phin nang roi kyrhai . Un kyrkhu ruh ba phin ïoh shibun ki khun ki kti ; un kyrkhu ïa ki lyngkha jong phi ba phin ïoh u kew , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ; bad un kyrkhu ruh ïa phi da kaba ai ha phi shibun ki masi bad ki langbrot , ha kata ka ri ïa kaba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi ban ai ha phi .
Sorah ïa U TRAI’ ! Ki Israel ki la kput jingman ban ïaleh ; U paidbah da kaba kmen u tyrwa mon sngewbha .
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord  for the avenging of Israel , when the people willingly offered themselves .
And the  Lord  appointed a set time , saying , To morrow the  Lord  shall do this thing in the land .
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la buh ïa ka sngi kaba la shai kum ka por ha kaba ngan leh ïa kane .’
Rwai ka jingïaroh ïa U Tiras ; ïathuh ïa ki jingphylla kiba u la ai .
translation.en: Sing unto him , sing psalms unto him , talk ye of all his wondrous works .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki la sdang shun iehnoh noh ïa u Saul , kumta u ong ha ki , Hamul ha na ïa ki jingainguh thang bun ki jingainguh ïasyllok .
translation.en: And Saul said , Bring hither a burnt offering to me , and peace offerings . And he offered the burnt offering .
The works of the  Lord  are great , sought out of all them that have pleasure therein .
translation.kha: A katno kiba phylla long kiei kiei kiba U  Trai  u la leh ! Baroh kiba la kmen bad ki , ki kwah ban shemphang ïa ki .
Hynñiew sngaid lyntait ym bit ïa uno uno ha kata ka ri ban don thiat ha ïing jong u ; bad ïa ka donhok ba phi! kñia ha ka janmiet jong ka sngi ka nyngkong dei ban bam lut ha kajuh hi ka miet .
translation.en: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days  ; neither shall there any thing of the flesh , which thou sacrificedst the first day at even , remain all night until the morning .

translation.kha: Balei la khot ïa ka jaka mane jong ngi ka Ïing Hima ?
translation.en: Why are our places of worship called Kingdom Halls ?
To overthrow their seed also among the nations , and to scatter them in the lands .
translation.kha: bad pynsakma ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki hapdeng ki nongmane bleithaw , ban iehnoh ïa ki ba kin ïap ha ki ri nongwei .
shon hadien ka jingjynjar jong kito ki sngi , ka sngi kan dum , u bnai un ym tyngshaiñ shuh , ki khlur kin hap na bneng , bad ki har ha ka haw haw ktang shah beh na ki lynti jong ki .
translation.en: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened , and the moon shall not give her light , and the stars shall fall from heaven , and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken :

translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na bneng kaba nong , To thoh ïa kane : Suk kito kiba naduh mynta ki ïap ha kaba shakri ïa U Trai ! Ho-oid shisha ! U Mynsiem u jubor . Kin ïoh shongthait na ki jingtrei snoh jong ki , namar ki soh ka jingrkhie jong ki , ki leit lem sad ki .
translation.en: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me , Write , Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth : Yea , saith the Spirit , that they may rest from their labours  ; and their works do follow them .

translation.kha: U Pharaoh u la jubab , Phi kiba jaipdeh bad phim kwah ban treikam , Bad dei “kata balei ba phi kyrpad ïa at don shat ïa phi ban leit bad ai ki jingkñia sha U Trai .
translation.en: But he said , Ye are idle , ye are idle : therefore ye say , Let us go and do sacrifice to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Katto kiba suk ki long kito ki bymlah don jingartatien shaphang jngai sa !
translation.en: And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me .
And as he talked with him , he went in , and found many that were come together .
translation.kha: U Petros u la ïai kren ïa u Kornelios katba u dang leit shapoh ïing , ha kaba u la shem bun ki briew kiba la ïalumlang .

translation.en: Moreover thou shalt provide out of all the people able men , such as fear God , men of truth , hating covetousness  ; and place such over them , to be rulers of thousands , and rulers of hundreds , rulers of fifties , and rulers of tens :
translation.kha: Hynrei nalor kata , phi dei ban jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit , bad thung ïa ki kum ki nongïalam jong u paidbah : ki nongïalam ïa ki hajar , ïa ki spah , ïa ki sanphew , bad ïa ki phew . Ki dei ban long ki briew kiba sheptieng ïa U Blei , kiba lah ban shaniah , bad kiba ym lah ban pynbam sap .
Kumta u Isaak u la shongsuk la Hukum ha Gerar .
translation.en: And Isaac dwelt in Gerar :

translation.kha: U la leit khnam katto katjuh nangta badno u la ïohi ar ngut kiwei! pat shi para , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki khun jong u Sebedi . Ki don halor ka lyngba jong ki ba ki dang ïapynbiang ïa ki jar jong ki .
translation.en: And when he had gone a little further thence , he saw James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother , who also were in the ship mending their nets .

translation.kha: ) . Nangta u Paul u thoh kham shai shuh ïa kane ka phangpdeng . Baroh ki jaitbynriew , ki Jiw malu ki Jentil , ki donkam ban dat ka jinglonghok bad U Blei , naba baïar ki don shiah ka bor jong ka pop . Ka jinglonghok ki briew pynlang U Blei ka long lyngkha ka jingngeit ha U Josis Khrist . Nangta u Paul u batai ïa ka jingim bathymmai ha U Khrist kaba mih na kane ka jingdih bathymmai bad U Blei . Uba ngeit u Don ka jingïakhih bad U blang pynlang ïa u la pyllait da U Mynsiem jongu U Blei na ka bor jong ka pop bad ka jinghap . Ha ki lynnong
translation.en: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks , and laid them on the fire , there came a viper out of the heat , and fastened on his hand .

translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang Kum ka jingweng bim ha U Trai : ar tylli ki masi lyngba , uwei u langbrot , bad hynriewphew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang babha shisnem ka rta , ki bih dat Kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , and one ram , and seven lambs of the first year : they shall be unto you without blemish :

translation.kha: Ïathuh ha por ïa kaba la jia , u Dabid u la ong . Ka kynhun shipai jong ngi ka la phet krong na ka madan tdem , u la jubab , bad bun na ki rangïapom jong ngi ki la shah pynnep . U Saul bad u Jonathan u khun jong u ruh ki la shah pynïap .
translation.en: And David said unto him , How went the matter ? I pray thee , tell me . And he answered , That the people are fled from the battle , and many of the people also are fallen and dead  ; and Saul and Jonathan his son are dead also .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ba la la pyndep ïa ka jingtrei ha kine ki thoin bad Naaman ba nga la ju khoh la bun snem ban wan khmih ïa phi , sa kyllan ban ai kumta mynta .
translation.en: But now having no more place in these parts , and having a great desire these many years to come unto you ;

translation.kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah sawphew snem . U la ïoh ruh kiew pat ki khun
translation.en: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years , and begat sons and daughters :

translation.kha: U Balaam u ong ha u Balak , Ïeng hangne harud ka jingainguh thang jong phi , kabu ar nang leit ïakynduh ïa U Blei’ hangtai .
translation.en: And he said unto Balak , Stand here by thy burnt offering , while I meet the  Lord  yonder .
And David laid up these words in his heart , and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath .
translation.kha: Ki ktien jong ki , ki la shon jur ha u Dabid , bad u sheptieng shikatdei eh ïa u syiem Akhish .

Ïaroh ïa U Trai U Blei’ ki Israel , u Nahath ïa ka bneng bad ka khyndew ! U la ai ha u syiem Dabid , ïa u khun uba bajar , ibha dap da ka jingshemphang bad ka jingtbit , uba mynta u thmu ban tei ka Templ na ka bynshet U Trai bad ka jingmihsnam na ka bynta ïa lade .
translation.en: Huram said moreover , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , that made heaven and earth , who hath given to David the king a wise son , endued with prudence and understanding , that might build an house for the  Lord  , and an house for his kingdom .

translation.kha: U shah ïa u Tobiah ban pyndonkam ïa ka kamra kaba heh ïa kaba la thmu tang ba-bang buh ïa u kew jingkñia bad ka jingiwbih , ki tiar ki tar ba pyndonkam ha ka Templ , ki jingainguh na ka bynta ki lyngdoh , bad Ibbah Shipai na u kew , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ba ai sha ki Likhi , ki nongtem nongput ka Templ , dara ki nongap phira ka Templ .
translation.en: And he had prepared for him a great chamber , where aforetime they laid the meat offerings , the frankincense , and the vessels , and the tithes of the corn , the new wine , and the oil , which was commanded to be given to the Levites , and the singers , and the porters  ; and the offerings of the priests .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto me , saying ,
Why abodest thou among the sheepfolds , to hear the bleatings of the flocks ? For the divisions of Reuben there were great searchings of heart .
translation.kha: Balei ki sah shadien lem bad ki langbrot ? Hato ban sngap ki nongap langbrot kiba khot ïa ki jingri ? Ho-oid , ki jait Reuben kim ïabeit jingmut , Kim shym lah rai ban ïawan .
Susah ka jubab kan long , ‘ Dei namar ba ki la pyneh ïa ka ïong ba U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , u la pynlong bad ki mynba u wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt .
translation.en: Then men shall say , Because they have forsaken the covenant of the  Lord  God of their fathers , which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt :

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duk ki long khlem jingïapan ha khmat u nongsynshar uba sniew ; u long uba shyrkhei khem u sing uba kyrhuh ne ka dngiem kaba tur .
translation.en: As a roaring lion , and a ranging bear  ; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people .

translation.kha: Nga ngeit ba phira ïoh tip ba ngim long kiba la shahjop .
translation.en: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba men pynshitom ïa nga , nga la ju ïaid sakma ; isynei mynta ar tyngkhuh ïa ka ktien jong me .
translation.en: Before I was afflicted I went astray : but now have I kept thy word .

translation.kha: U la kurup ïa ka bad ïa u syiem jong ka , bad ïa baroh ki shnong kiba markhap . Ki pynkup lut ïa uwei pa uwei hangta . U Joshua u la leh ïa ka Debir bad ïa u syiem jong ka kumba u la leh ïa ka Ebron malade ïa ka lehbha bad u syiem jrong ka .
translation.en: And he took it , and the king thereof , and all the cities thereof  ; and they smote them with the edge of the sword , and utterly destroyed all the souls that were therein  ; he left none remaining : as he had done to Hebron , so he did to Debir , and to the king thereof  ; as he had done also to Libnah , and to her king .

translation.kha: ha ka jingmane bleithaw bad ka jingai ksuid . Ki briew ki kylla long nongshun bad ki ïashoh ; ki ïa-bishni , bitar , bad ki kwah eh . Ki ïa-pait ha ki seng bad ki kynhun ;
translation.en: Idolatry , witchcraft , hatred , variance , emulations , wrath , strife , seditions , heresies ,

translation.kha: Ka Ijipt ka long kumta ka masi baphyrnai , ba la tur ïaleh da u skain ba kynthah na shatei .
translation.en: Egypt is like a very fair heifer , but destruction cometh  ; it cometh out of the north .
Sanctify unto me all the firstborn , whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel , both of man and of beast : it is mine .
translation.kha: Pynkyntang ha nga ïa uba la kha nyngkong baroh , namar kat uba la kha nyngkong napdeng ki Israel , la u briew ne u mrad , u long u jong nga .
Kaba ar ka hukum kaba donkam tam ka erlangthari kumta katei : ‘ Iri ïa u paramarjan jongki me kumba me ieit ïa lade .’
translation.en: And the second is like unto it , Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself .

translation.kha: un rah ïa ki shabar ka jaka shong dara sha ka dik lehniam bakhuid ha kaba yn theh ïa u dpei , bad hangta un thang ha ka kynton diengïap .
translation.en: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place , where the ashes are poured out , and burn him on the wood with fire : where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt .

translation.kha: ( Salm 26 :12 ; 111 :1 ) Kine ki jingïailong ki pla lad don ïakynduh bad ban ïa kren-ïa khana bad ki Nonghikai bakha na kiwei ki balang ne na kiwei! patar ki khang .
translation.en: ( Psalm 26 :12 , footnote  ; 111 :1 ) These gatherings create an opportunity to meet and associate with Witnesses from other congregations or even from other lands .

translation.kha: Hynrei katto katai ngat na ki , ki la leit sha ki Pharisi bad ki la ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh .
translation.en: But some of them went their ways to the Pharisees , and told them what things Jesus had done .

translation.kha: U Hilkaïah , u Tebalaïah , bad u Sekharaïah . Ha baroh ki ïadon khatlai ngut ki dkhot jong ka longïing jong u Hosah kiba dei ki nongap phira ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: Hilkiah the second , Tebaliah the third , Zechariah the fourth : all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen .

translation.kha: ha kaba ki jingbabe lyngdoh bad ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki la wallam ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u Paul .
translation.en: Then the high priest and the chief of the Jews informed him against Paul , and besought him ,

translation.kha: U phaloh u la phah khot ïa u Moses bad u Aaron , bad u ong ha ki , Ha kane ka sien nga la lai pop ; U Terah u leh ïa kaba dei ; ma ar bad ki briew jong nga me la leh bakla .
translation.en: And Pharaoh sent , and called for Moses and Aaron , and said unto them , I have sinned this time : the  Lord  is righteous , and I and my people are wicked .

translation.kha: Ki jingïohipaw ba phoi ïohi ki long ki bymdei , bad ki jingïathuh lypa ba phi! pynlong ki long kiba shkor . Phi long katba bymdonkam sad kiba sniew , bad ka sngi jong phi ka la wan , ka sngi jongno ka jingpynjot kiba kut . Ka waitlam kan hap ha ki jingrang jong phi .
translation.en: Whiles they see vanity unto thee , whiles they divine a lie unto thee , to bring thee upon the necks of them that are slain , of the wicked , whose day is come , when their iniquity shall have an end .

translation.kha: U Ahiman , uba shongkurim ïa ka Basemath , kawei pat na ki khun kynthei jong u Solomon : ka ri Naphtali
translation.en: Ahimaaz was in Naphtali  ; he also took Basmath the daughter of Solomon to wife :

translation.kha: nongthaw , ka jingsawa jong ka per ka la wan na ka khet , ka da ong , To ïaroi ïa U Blei jong ngi , phi baroh ki shakri bad ki brup jong u , kiba rit bad Ibbah khrup kohnguh , kiba ñiewburom ïa u !
translation.en: And a voice came out of the throne , saying , Praise our God , all ye his servants , and ye that fear him , both small and great .

translation.kha: Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ki tiar pynïeng ïingjah , ïa ki diengkhap , ïa ki rijied , ïa ki thliew tnaw , bad ïa ki tiar pyndait jong ka baroh . Kin kitkhlieh ruh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïadei bad kino ki tiar ki tar .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families , and after the house of their fathers ,

translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Uba U Trai Jong ngi kan ïohpdiang ïa ka burom na phi , bad ma phi na u , da ka jingaiei jong U Blei jong ngi bad jongno U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai .
translation.en: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you , and ye in him , according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la smat ïa ka shakri , u la jingsakhi ha U Blei , bad u la nong , Shim ïa kane bad sam ïa ka hapdeng jong phi .
translation.en: And he took the cup , and gave thanks , and said ,  Take this , and divide it among yourselves :

Now , behold , in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the  Lord  an hundred thousand talents of gold , and a thousand thousand talents of silver  ; and of brass and iron without weight  ; for it is in abundance : timber also and stone have I prepared  ; and thou mayest add thereto .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka Templ , da ki jingpyrshang jong nga , nga la lum palat ïa lai hajar sawspah ton ka ksiar bad palat ïa laiphew saw hajar ton ka rupa ban pyndonkam ha kaba tei ïa ka . Nalor kata , la don bun bah ka rnong bad ka nar . Nga la pynkhreh ruh ïa ka dieng bad u maw , hynrei me dei ban pynïoh shuh shuh .

U long ma u , u ba-bang tei ïa ka bad pdiang ïa ka burom kaba dei ïa u syiad malu un synshar ïa ki briew jong u . U Lyngdoh un ïeng hajan ka khet jong u , bad kin ïatreilang ha ka jingsuk bad ha ka jingïasngewtynnat .’
translation.en: Even he shall build the temple of the  Lord   ; and he shall bear the glory , and shall sit and rule upon his throne  ; and he shall be a priest upon his throne : and the counsel of peace shall be between them both .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la pyllait im ïa baroh bad ïa khie kiei baroh kiba ki Amalek ki la knieh kynthup ïa ki tnga jongnga u ar nongput .
translation.en: And David recovered all that the Amalekites had carried away : and David rescued his two wives .

translation.kha: U Araunah u jubab , Wat bitar ïa nga . Phi thup ba kine ki briew ki erlangthari kiba im sngi tang ïa-ban leh ïa ka sniew .
translation.en: And Aaron said , Let not the anger of my lord wax hot : thou knowest the people , that they are set on mischief .
Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham , and of his oath unto Isaac  ;
translation.kha: ka jutang kaba u la pynlong bad u Abraham , ka jingkular kaba u la pynlong bad u Isaak .

translation.en: Even the  Lord  God of hosts  ; the  Lord  is his memorial .
translation.kha: Une u dei U  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh — U  Trai  long ka kyrteng ha uba dei ban mane .

translation.en: For it shall be , that , as a wandering bird cast out of the nest , so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon .
translation.kha: Ki ap ha ki rudwah jong ka wah Arnon bad ki ïaid khlem jingmut shane shatai , kum ki sim kiba la shah beh noh na ki skum jong ki .

translation.en: But why dost thou judge thy brother ? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother ? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ .
translation.kha: Ma phi te , kiba bam tang ki jhur — balei phi bishar ïa la u parabangeit ? Bad ma phi kiba bam ïa kiei kiei baroh — balei phi peitbeiñ ïa la u parabangeit ? Baroh na ngi , ngin hap ban ïeng ha khmat U Blei ban shah bishar da u .
Mynba u dat ha ka pyrthei , u Jisu u la pyndeng ïa kiba thngan , pynkhiah ïa kiba pung bad pynmihpat ïa Kiba la ïap !
translation.en: While on earth , Jesus fed the hungry , healed the sick , and restored life to the dead !

translation.kha: Nga Iohi ia ka film mynshem taiew .
translation.en: I saw the film last week .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki rangbah ki la ïasoh bad u , napdeng jong ki , u Dei u Ioannis , u dkhot jongnga ka dorbar ; la ni ruh ka briew Kaba kyrteng ka Tamarisk , bad kiwei pat ki briew .
translation.en: Howbeit certain men clave unto him , and believed : among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite , and a woman named Damaris , and others with them .

translation.kha: Ka Jerusalem ka long kaweh la tim , sakma ka nongbah kambah ijli , katba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , kaba banbeiñ ïa la ki jong ki briew .
translation.en: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted , to the oppressing city !

translation.kha: bad U Blei u ïakhun ïa u . U Balaam u ong ha u , Nga la tei hynñiew tyrnem ki duwan bad nga la kñia uwei u masi kyrtong bun uwei u langbrot ha kawei kawei na ki .
translation.en: And God met Balaam : and he said unto him , I have prepared seven altars , and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram .

translation.kha: Te phi ong , ‘ Lymda u para khatduh jong phi u wan lang bad phi , yn ym shah shuh ïa Phi ban wang ha khmat jong nga .’
translation.en: And thou saidst unto thy servants , Except your youngest brother come down with you , ye shall see my face no more .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ba ki ïap , bad ym don uba sngewthuh dawai wat ban suidñiew . Hynrei haba ki ïap , yn ym ba-don jingjynjar shuh ki ban ktah ïa ki .
translation.en: The righteous perisheth , and no man layeth it to heart : and merciful men are taken away , none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom u Moses ruh u la synreit ïa ka snam halor kata ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jutang bad halor kiei kiei baroh ïa kiba la pyndonkam ha ka jingmane .
translation.en: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle , and all the vessels of the ministry .

translation.kha: Nangta u Isaiah u ong ha ki rangbah shipai , Wat shaphang jlan khaw-eit . longsyiem uba kut jingmut triang babha skhem namar kane ka dei kaei katba U Trai un leh ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto them , Fear not , nor be dismayed , be strong and of good courage : for thus shall the  Lord  do to all your enemies against whom ye fight .

translation.kha: Pynshong ïa ki bariew ha madan , U Jisu u la ong ha ki . ( La don suiñ u phrung hangta . ) Kumta ki bhabriew baroh ki la shong ha madan ; ki la ni kumba sian hajar ngut ki rangbah .
translation.en: And Jesus said ,  Make the men sit down .  Now there was much grass in the place . So the men sat down , in number about five thousand .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit nadien jrong u ryngkat sad ki bri jong ki bad lap ïa u Hajan ka pung kaba heh ha jingbeiñ .
translation.en: Then they took all the men , and went to fight with Ishmael the son of Nethaniah , and found him by the great waters that are in Gibeon .

translation.kha: “Wat shngiam ha lade ba siew kadlieng ïa kaba sniew . Shaniah ha U Trai’ bad un pynlong ïa ka kaba dei .
translation.en: Say not thou , I will recompense evil  ; but wait on the  Lord  , and he shall save thee .
After this lived Job an hundred and forty years , and saw his sons , and his sons  sons , even four generations .
translation.kha: U Job u la im shispah sawphew snem hadien kane , ka jingim kaba la jlan bha kat ban ïohi ïa ki ksiew bad ïa ki ksiew tun .
Bteng lang san tylli na ki ba kin long kawei ka jingtah , bad leh kumjuh ïa ki san tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah .
translation.en: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another  ; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another .

translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la ïathuh ha ki Israel ïa naba U Trai u la kren , ki kthang .
translation.en: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel : and the people mourned greatly .
But all the congregation bade stone them with stones . And the glory of the  Lord  appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun baroh kawei ka la byrngem ban lynthem maw ïa ki , hynrei kynsan ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ba ka paw halor ka Ïingjaiñ .
ki bakla shaphang kai kaba dei , namar ba ngan sien sha U Kaba bad phan ym ïohi shuh ïa nga ;
translation.en: Of righteousness , because I go to my Father , and ye see me no more  ;

translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U Tharai , nabar u long uba bha ; bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : because his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Nahath uta u briew u la theh ïa ka khyrdop kambah shaphang shatei , kaba lam sha ka phyllaw bashabar .
translation.en: And the gate of the outward court that looked toward the north , he measured the length thereof , and the breadth thereof .

translation.kha: Hynrei wat la ka jinglong ka jemnud jong nga ka la long ka jingtynjuh Bakhrawbor ïa phi , phim shym la ibeiñ ne kynta ïa nga . Pynban phi la pdiang ïa nga kitab phi pdiang ïa u angel na bneng ; phi la pdiang ïa nga kumba phi pdiang ïa U Khrist Jingsuk hi .
translation.en: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not , nor rejected ; but received me as an angel of God , even as Christ Jesus .
And they asked them , saying , Is this your son , who ye say was born blind ? how then doth he now see ?
translation.kha: Hato une u dei u khun jong phi ? Phi ong ba la kha matlah ïa u ; te kumno pat mynta u la imat ?

translation.en: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin , and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel :
translation.kha: Ban weng ïa ka jingbymkhuid , shim khyndiat u dpei na kata ka masi rong saw ïa kaba la thang ban weng noh ïa ka pop bad buh ïa ka ha u khiew , bad theh hangta ïa ka um ba dang shu wan tong .
Mynba u Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan ba-bang tur ïaleit ïa ka Ijipt , U Trai U la kren ha to . U ong ,
translation.en: The word that the  Lord  spake to Jeremiah the prophet , how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt .

Remember , and forget not , how thou provokedst the  Lord  thy God to wrath in the wilderness : from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt , until ye came unto this place , ye have been rebellious against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat ju klet kumno phi la pynbitar lep ïa U  Trai  ha ka ri shyiap . Naduh ka sngi ba phi mih na Ijipt haduh ba phi poi hangne , phi la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
Ki Jiw kiba la ngeit kaba la wan na Jehosheba lem bad u Phestos ki la sngewlyngngoh ba U Bela u la tbeh ïa ka jingai ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid ha ki Jentil ruh .
translation.en: And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished , as many as came with Peter , because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Ghost .
Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree , slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks ?
translation.kha: Phi mane ïa ki blei pynkharoi da kaba ïathiah shongkha hapoh ki dieng bakyntang jong phi ; phi ai ïa la ki khun kum ki jingkñia hapoh ki synrang mawsiang harud ki phud wahduid .
Te uwei pa ti un sa ïohsngew ïa kata Bad un sngewkynjah , sad yn ym don shuh uba nud ba-bang leh kumta .
translation.en: And all the people shall hear , and fear , and do no more presumptuously .
When the waves of death compassed me , the floods of ungodly men made me afraid  ;
translation.kha: Ki jingat phyllung ka jingïap ki don sawdong jong nga , ki jingat phyllung ka jingpynjot ki tyllun halor jong nga ;

translation.en: The  Lord  shall smite thee with madness , and blindness , and astonishment of heart :
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pynlamwir ïa phi , un pynmatlah ïa phi , bad un pynshaïong ïa phi .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will therefore spread out my net over thee with a company of many people  ; and they shall bring thee up in my net .
translation.kha: Ynda ki jaitbynriew ki ïalumlang , ngan pynngat ïa me ha ka jar jong nga bad ngan shah ïa ki ban tan ïa ka jar sha ryngkew .
Nangta ki la sdang ban kylli para ma ki uno napdeng jong ki uba lah ban hir u ban sa leh ïa kane .
translation.en: And they began to enquire among themselves , which of them it was that should do this thing .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la kutlad lep ïa ki Israel bad u shahïap ïa u Kushan Rishathaim u syiem ka Mesopotamia ban jop ïa ki . Bad u synshar halor jong ki haduh phra snem .
translation.en: Therefore the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he sold them into the hand of Chushan–rishathaim king of Mesopotamia : and the children of Israel served Chushan–rishathaim eight years .

translation.kha: Ki bud ïa u Jeroboam Bad ki ïai bteng ban leh ïa ki pop baroh ba u la leh ,
translation.en: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did  ; they departed not from them  ;

translation.kha: Haba phira sien ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jongnga phi malu phi ïohi ba ki kali ïaleh tdam , ki kulai , bad ki shipai jong ki , ki kham bun ïa-ban ïa ki jong phi , Wat sheptieng ïa ki . U Trai U Blei jong phi , umbah la pyllait ïa phi na Ijipt , un don ryngkat badno phi .
translation.en: When thou goest out to battle against thine enemies , and seest horses , and chariots , and a people more than thou , be not afraid of them : for the  Lord  thy God is with thee , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
With him is an arm of flesh  ; but with us is the  Lord  our God to help us , and to fight our battles . And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah .
translation.kha: U don ka bor briew , hynrei ngi don U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u ban ïarap ïa ngi ban ïaleh ïa ki thma jong ngi .  Ki briew ki ïoh ïa ka jingpynshlur da kine ki ktien jong u syiem jong ki .

translation.en: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard . My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill :
translation.kha: To pynshahshkor katba nga rwai ha phi ïa kane ka jingrwai , ka jingrwai u paralok jong nga bad ka bri sohwaiñ jong u : U paralok jong nga u don ka bri sohwaiñ ha u lumrit uba seisoh bha .

translation.en: For so hath the Lord commanded us , saying , I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles , that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth .
translation.kha: Naba kane ka long ka hukum kaba U Trai u la ai ha ngi :   ‘ Nga la pynlong ïa phi ka jingshai na ka bynta ki Jentil , khnang ba baroh ka pyrthei ka lah ban lait im .’

translation.en: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba ki khun jong u Job ki dang ïakhawai sngewbha ha ïing jong u hynmen rangbah duh , u nonglamktien u la wan mareh sha u Job .
La donkam ïa ka Baibl ka suk ban sngewtmang .
translation.en: A Bible was needed that was easy to understand .
For , lo , as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears , the babe leaped in my womb for joy .
translation.kha: Naba tang mar ïa ïohsngew ïa ka jingkhublei jong pha , i khunlung hapoh jong nga i la kynthih da ka jingkmen .

translation.en: My tabernacle is spoiled , and all my cords are broken : my children are gone forth of me , and they are not : there is none to stretch forth my tent any more , and to set up my curtains .
translation.kha: La pynjot ïa ki ïingjaiñ jong ngi ; ïa ki tyllai ba pynskhem ïa ki la pyndkut . Ki khun jong ngi ki la leit noh baroh ; ym don shuh mano mano ba dang sah ban pynïeng pat ïa ki ïingjaiñ jong ngi ; ym don shuh mano mano ban wah ïa ki pyrda jong ki .

translation.en: And Caleb said , He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher , and taketh it , to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife .
translation.kha: U Kaleb u ong ,  Ngan ai ïa ka khun jong nga , ka Akhsah ban shongkurim ïa u briew uba jop ha kaba ïohknieh ïa ka Kiriath Sepher .
A Trai , U Blei lad ngi , ïa i'u la synshar da kiwei pait , hynrei tang ma me , me longïing U Trai jongu ngi .
translation.en: O  Lord  our God , other lords beside thee have had dominion over us : but by thee only will we make mention of thy name .
Hear the word of the  Lord  , ye children of Israel : for the  Lord  hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land , because there is no truth , nor mercy , nor knowledge of God in the land .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u don ka jingkynnoh pyrshah ïa ki briew kiba shong ha ka ri . To sngap , ko Israel , ïa kaei kaba u ong :  Ym don jingïaineh ne ka jingieit ha ka ri , Bad ki briew kim pdiang ïa nga kum U Blei .

translation.en: Moreover his mother made him a little coat , and brought it to him from year to year , when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice .
translation.kha: Man ka snem ka kmie jong u ka ju thain ïa u ka jaiñkup kaba rit , bad ka ju leit rah ïa ka haba ka leit lang bad la u tnga ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh kaba man ka snem .

translation.en: For the kingdom of God is not in word , but in power .
translation.kha: Naba ka Hima U Blei kam long tang ha kaba kren hynrei ha ka bor .
U dei u nongshun jyllang ki Israel baroh shi lynter jingim u Solomon .
translation.en: And he was an adversary to Israel all the days of Solomon , beside the mischief that Hadad did : and he abhorred Israel , and reigned over Syria .

translation.kha: Lada phi leh ïa kaba sniew bad kyntait ïa U Trai , un Wallam ha Phi ka jingpynjot , ka jingkulmar , bad ka jingjot ha kaei kaei baïar kaba phi leh , haduh ba phin da jot thiaw badno ïap syndon .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall send upon thee cursing , vexation , and rebuke , in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do , until thou be destroyed , and until thou perish quickly  ; because of the wickedness of thy doings , whereby thou hast forsaken me .

translation.kha: Mynta , na ka pyntwa kita kiba la ïap ki shun sa mihpat : Katto phim pat ju pule ha ka Kitab u Moses ïa ka bynta kaba dei shaphang ka lyngkhuh naba ing ? Hangto la thoh ba U Blei u la ong ïa u Moses , ‘ Nga un-long U Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei jong u Isak nabar U Blei jong u Jakob .’
translation.en: And as touching the dead , that they rise : have ye not read in the book of Moses , how in the bush God spake unto him , saying , I am the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob ?
For what nation is there so great , who hath God so nigh unto them , as the  Lord  our God is in all things that we call upon him for ?
translation.kha: Ym don kawei pat ka jaitbynriew , la ka khraw katno katno , kaba don u blei uba hajan kum U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , haba ki donkam ïa u . Man ka por ba ngi khot kyrpad ïa u , u jubab ïa ngi .

Katba ki briew’ ki ïan ïalum sawdong ïa U Jisu , u la bneng ban kren , A katno kiba sniew long ki briew jong kane ka jhur ! Ki dala ïa ka kambah , hynrei yn ym ai kano kano ha ki , lait Teng ka kaban u Jonah .
translation.en: And when the people were gathered thick together , he began to say ,  This is an evil generation : they seek a sign  ; and there shall no sign be given it , but the sign of Jonas the prophet .

translation.kha: Namar kane ka daw , hab U Khrist u la dei ban wan sha kane ka pyrthei u la ong ha U Blei : Mem khoh ïa ki jingkñia bad ïa ki jingainguh , hynrei me la pynkhreh ka met na ka bynta jong por .
translation.en: Wherefore when he cometh into the world , he saith , Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not , but a body hast thou prepared me :
And great multitudes were gathered together unto him , so that he went into a ship , and sat  ; and the whole multitude stood on the shore .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah kiba la ïalum sawdong ïa u , ki la bun katta katta haduh ba u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la shong ha ka , katba ki paidbah ki la ïeng harud duriaw .
Te U Trai u la ong ha nga , ‘ Shtah ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kum kito kiba nyngkong bad shna ruh kawei ka Synduk ngin ban bsuh ïa ki .
translation.en: At that time the  Lord  said unto me , Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first , and come up unto me into the mount , and make thee an ark of wood .

translation.kha: Buh ïa ka duwan ksiar ban thang jingiwbih ha kham ka Synñia ka Jutang , bad wah ïa ka pyrda ha ka Jaka thung jong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And thou shalt set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony , and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle .
They proclaimed a fast , and set Naboth on high among the people .
translation.kha: Ki pynbna ïa ka sngi shahjingit , khot lang ïa ki paidbah , bad ai ha u Naboth ka jaka shong badonburom .
U Trai u khmih sha tbian na bneng , bad u ïohi ïa u khunbynriew barabor .
translation.en: The  Lord  looketh from heaven  ; he beholdeth all the sons of men .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada u paidbah u kuna bymjukut ïa kata kaba u la leh bad kim pynïap ïa u ,
translation.en: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man , when he giveth of his seed unto Molech , and kill him not :
And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean , and those things , before the  Lord  , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation :
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un ïalam ïa uta u briew lem bad ïa kita ki jingainguh jong u ha khmat ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

translation.en: Moreover when ye fast , be not , as the hypocrites , of a sad countenance : for they disfigure their faces , that they may appear unto men to fast . Verily I say unto you , They have their reward .
translation.kha: Bad haba phi shahjingit , wat leh  mat sngewsih kumba ki riewarsap ki leh . Kim kheiñ ïa kaba paw shabar jong ki khnang ba baroh kin ïohi ba ki shahjingit . Nga pynthikna ïa phi , ki la ïoh lypa ïa ka jingsiew kaba pura .

translation.en: And sent messengers before his face : and they went , and entered into a village of the Samaritans , to make ready for him .
translation.kha: U la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ha shuwa jong u , kiba la leit sha ka nongrit ha Samaria ban pynkhreh ïa kaei kaei baroh na ka bynta jong u .
Khynñiuh lada me sheptieng ban tur ïaleh , leit hiar sha ka jaka sher sawa lem bad u ba-pura u shakri jongngi me .
translation.en: But if thou fear to go down , go thou with Phurah thy servant down to the host :

translation.kha: Ki jingkñia ainguh , ki jingkñia pop bad ki jingkñia na ka bynta ban siew pat , ken long ki jingbam jong ki lyngdoh , bad ki kin Ïohi ïa kiei kiei baroh ha Israel ïa kiba la pynkyrpang na ka bynta jong la .
translation.en: They shall eat the meat offering , and the sin offering , and the trespass offering  ; and every dedicated thing in Israel shall be theirs .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ba ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Barukh , nga long uba khuid , nga long uta uba phi dei ban sheptieng .
translation.en: Sanctify the  Lord  of hosts himself  ; and let him be your fear , and let him be your dread .
But it came to pass , that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall , he was wroth , and took great indignation , and mocked the Jews .
translation.kha: Haba u Sanballat u ïohsngew ba ki Jiw ki la sdang ïa ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh , u la bitar bad u sdang ban krenbeiñ ïa ngi .
Naba ka dang don ka sngi , ngi dei ba-bang Tertios ïa ka kada jong uta babha la phah ïa nga ; ka miet ka wan haba ym don uba lah ngab Tertios .
translation.en: I must work the works of him that sent me , while it is day : the night cometh , when no man can work .
For if the ministration of condemnation be glory , much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory .
translation.kha: Ka rukom pynïaid kaba wanrah ïa ka jingpynrem ka la long kaba donburom ; kaba katno tam kaba kham donburom kata ka jingtrei kaba wanrah ïa ka jingpynim!
