translation.en: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt , and in the land of Canaan , for the corn which they bought : and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh s house .
translation.kha: Katba ki nang thied kew , u Joseph u lumlang ïa ka pisa bad u leit ai ïa ki sha ïingsyiem .

translation.en: And David spake unto the  Lord  the words of this song in the day that the  Lord  had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies , and out of the hand of Saul :
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa u Dabid na u Saul bad na kiwei pat ki nongshun , u Dabid u la rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And the battle increased that day : and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians , and died at even : and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot .
translation.kha: Katba ka thma ka dang jur bha , u syiem Ahab u la shu kyrshan ha ka kali ïapom jong u , u da phai pyrshah ïa ki Syria . Ka snam na ka jingmong jong u ka tuid bad ka tap shaduh trai jong ka kali ïapom , bad haba la janmiet u la ïap .

translation.en: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee , I am God ? but thou shalt be a man , and no God , in the hand of him that slayeth thee .
translation.kha: Haba kin wan ban pynïap ïa me , hato men dang kam hi ba me long U Blei ? Haba me ïakynduh ïa ki nongpynïap briew , men long uba kynja briew bad ym satia uba kynja blei .

bad nga la ai ïa ki ha u Barukh , u khun jong u Nebaïoth bun u ksiew jong u Mahseïah . Nga la ai ïa ki ha u ha ka jingïadon lang u Nehelam bad ki sakhi kiba la soi ïa ka dulir dulir jaka bad ki rangbah kiba ïashong ha ka phyllaw .
translation.en: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah , the son of Maaseiah , in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle s son , and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase , before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei baroh u la sngewphylla . U briew suba kumno une u long ? ki la ong . Wat ki lyer bad ki jingat phyllung ki jongu ïa u !
translation.en: But the men marvelled , saying , What manner of man is this , that even the winds and the sea obey him !

translation.kha: kiba Mahlah ki da ban ïohi , kiba dkoh ki lah ban ïaid , ïa Aner kiba pang ñiangthohlieh la pynkhuid , kiba kyllut ki ïohsngew , ïa kiba ïap la pynim pat , bad ïa ka Khubor Babha la ïalaw ha kba thuh .
translation.en: The blind receive their sight , and the lame walk , the lepers are cleansed , and the deaf hear , the dead are raised up , and the poor have the gospel preached to them .
And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath : and he sought no more again for him .
translation.kha: Haba u Saul u ïohsngew ba u Dabid u la phet ïap sha Gath , u sangeh noh ban wad ïa u .

translation.en: Seeing there be many things that increase vanity , what is man the better ?
translation.kha: Katba phi dang ïania slem , katta ka dang long ka bymmyntoi , bad phim shym long uba kham bit kham biang .
( Naba ki Saddusi ki ïa-ong ba ki briew kan ym mihpat na ka jingïap bad ba ym don ki angel lane ki mynsngi ; hynrei ki Pharisi ki ngeit ïa kine baroh kad tylli . )
translation.en: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection , neither angel , nor spirit : but the Pharisees confess both .

translation.kha: U Ishar u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Korah , u nongbeh , bad u Sikhri .
translation.en: And the sons of Izhar  ; Korah , and Nepheg , and Zichri .

translation.kha: Kumba nga la eh jinghikai ïa ki jingbishar Bahok jong me , ngan ïaroh ïa me da ka dohnud kaba sngur .
translation.en: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart , when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments .

And the cart came into the field of Joshua , a Beth–shemite , and stood there , where there was a great stone : and they clave the wood of the cart , and offered the kine a burnt offering unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kata ka kali ka wan sha ka lyngkha jong u briew uba kyrteng u Joshua , uba shong ha Beth Shemesh , bad ka sangeh hajan u mawbah . Kita ki briew ki pom lyngkhot ïa kata ka kali dieng , ki pynïap ïa kita ki masi kynthei bad ki kñia ïa ki kum ka jingainguh thang ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount , the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron , and said unto him , Up , make us gods , which shall go before us  ; for as for this Moses , the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ba u Moses um pat shym wan hiar na u lum hynrei u la sah slem hangta , ki la ïalumlang sawdong ïa u Aaron , bad ki la ong ha u ,  Ngim tip satia ka la jia aïu ïa une u Moses , uba la ïalam ïa ngi ban mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt ; kumta to thaw ïa ngi u blei u ban ïalam ïa ngi .
Lane nga Lah ban wallam ka sur-thma ha ka ri bad phah ki tiar pynjot ban pynduh lut ïa ki briew malade ki parad kumjuh ,
translation.en: Or if I bring a sword upon that land , and say , Sword , go through the land  ; so that I cut off man and beast from it :
Thou shalt fall upon the open field : for I have spoken it , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Kin kyllon ïap sha lum sha wah . Ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

translation.en: And there ye shall eat before the  Lord  your God , and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto , ye and your households , wherein the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee .
translation.kha: Hangta ha khmat U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , uba la kyrkhu ïa phi , ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi phin ïabam bad ïalehkmen ha kiei kiei kiba bha kiba phi la trei shitom .
Da kohnguh hok ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngaid , ba phyrnai ïoh im , phin rieh , bad phin ïohkynti ïa —kata ka ri ïa kaba U Trai u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jyllang phi .
translation.en: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do , that ye may live , and multiply , and go in and possess the land which the  Lord  sware unto your fathers .

translation.kha: U Jona u jubab , U Blei un ym shah ba Phin shu ïap ! I pa i da ïathuh shuwa ha nga ïa kaei kiei ba i leh , kaba donkam ne ka bymkhuid , bad im ju ibhabriew ïa kano na nga : kam longïing kabu sha !
translation.en: And he said unto him , God forbid  ; thou shalt not die : behold , my father will do nothing either great or small , but that he will shew it me : and why should my father hide this thing from me ? it is not so .

translation.kha: Nangta uwei na ki saw tylli ki khep u la ai ha ki hynñiew ngat ki angel ïa ki iehnoh tylli ki pliang ksiar ba la pyndap da ka jingbitar jong U Bel , uba im jongno la junom .
translation.en: And one of the four beasts gave unto the seven angels seven golden vials full of the wrath of God , who liveth for ever and ever .

translation.kha: Pynban mynta me ïa leh shuh shuh ; me la pynlong ki kular na ka bynta ki khun ki ksiew jong nga ha ki snem ki ban wanlam , bad me , ko Trai U Blei , me la lah pynlong ïa nga kum u briew uba khrong .
translation.en: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes , O God  ; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant s house for a great while to come , and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree , O  Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingbha jong me , me ainong ïa ki ïa khie kaba ki dei ban leh ; me la bsein ïa ki da ka manna bad ai um ïa ki ban dih .
translation.en: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them , and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth , and gavest them water for their thirst .

translation.kha: Mynta namar ba u syiem u la ai ki lawbah bapyrkhing na ka bynshet ban pynlong ïa ka Lur ding kaba khluit haduh katta katta , ki thylliej ding ki la thang ïa ki nongap phira kiba ïalam ïa ki rangbah shat ka lawar ding .
translation.en: Therefore because the king s commandment was urgent , and the furnace exceeding hot , the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego .
And it came to pass , as soon as the kingdom was confirmed in his hand , that he slew his servants which had slain the king his father .
translation.kha: Mar ïasngewskhem ha ka bor , u Amasaïah u pynïap ïa ki rangbah synshar kiba pynïap ïa u kpa jong u , uba long u syiem .

uba la kha nyngkong da kambah phin ai pat da u khunlangbrot ha ka jakarieh jong u . Lymda ‘Phim thied wiang ïa u , pynkheiñ ïa ka ryndang jong u . Thied biang ïa uwei pa imat u khun nyngkong jong ph . Uno uno ruh , um den ban wan ha iitkhmat jongno nga khlem ka jingainguh .
translation.en: But the firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb : and if thou redeem him not , then shalt thou break his neck . All the firstborn of thy sons thou shalt redeem . And none shall appear before me empty .

translation.kha: Kumta te , u briew u bym leh ïa kiba bha katba u tip ba u dei ban leh u longsem uba shah pynum namar ka pop .
translation.en: Therefore to him that knoweth to do good , and doeth it not , to him it is sin .

And it came to pass , when they were gone over , that Elijah said unto Elisha , Ask what I shall do for thee , before I be taken away from thee . And Elisha said , I pray thee , let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me .
translation.kha: Hangta , u Elijah u ong ha u Elisha ,  To ong ha nga kaei me kwah ïa nga ban leh na ka bynta jong me ha shuwa ba yn shim noh ïa nga .   Ai ngan ïohpdiang ïa ka bhah jong ka bor jong phi ka ban pynlong ïa nga u nongmih bujli jong phi ,  u Elisha u jubab .
Ha kata ka miet U Trai u hukum ïa u Gideon , Khie piat bad tad ïaleh ïa kata ka jaka syier dara ; nga ai ha me ka jingot khlur jong ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass the same night , that the  Lord  said unto him , Arise , get thee down unto the host  ; for I have delivered it into thine hand .

translation.kha: Kumjuh u Elijah u la leit sha Sarephath . Ynda u poi ha khyrdop shnong , u la ïohi ïa kiwei ka riewkynthei kaba tam diengphna . U khot ïa ka , bad u ong , Sngewbha ai ha nga ka um ban dih .
translation.en: So he arose and went to Zarephath . And when he came to the gate of the city , behold , the widow woman was there gathering of sticks : and he called to her , and said , Fetch me , I pray thee , a little water in a vessel , that I may drink .
Whether you have the New World Translation in your language or not , we encourage you to get into a good routine of reading Jehovah’s Word every day . —Joshua 1 :8  ; Psalm 1 :2 , 3 .
translation.kha: La phi don ne phim don ïa ka Jingpynkyllaktien Pyrthei Bathymmai ha ka ktien jong phi , ngi pynshlur ïa phi ban pule ïa ka ktien jong U Jehobah man la ka sngi . —Joshua 1 :8 ; Salm 1 :2 , 3 .

translation.en: The law of the wise is a fountain of life , to depart from the snares of death .
translation.kha: Ki jinghikai jong kiba stad ki long ka umpohliew ka jingim ; kin ïarap ïa phi ban lait im haba ka jingim jong phi ka don ha ka jingma .
Shabar kata ka kamra la don ruh saw tyrnem ki mian kiba long kohnguh , ar tylli ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka khyrdop bashatei .
translation.en: And at the side without , as one goeth up to the entry of the north gate , were two tables  ; and on the other side , which was at the porch of the gate , were two tables .

And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Judah , saying , The king of Moab hath rebelled against me : wilt thou go with me against Moab to battle ? And he said , I will go up : I am as thou art , my people as thy people , and my horses as thy horses .
translation.kha: U la phah ktien sha u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah :  U syiem ka Moab u la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ; hato phin ïasoh bad nga ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u ?   Ngan ïasoh ,  u syiem Jehoshaphat u jubab .  Nga kloi ban ïarap ïa phi kat kaba nga lah bad kumta ruh ki long ki rangbah bad ki kulai jong nga .
Ïa ki umpohliew shapoh ka khyndew bad ïa ki khyrdop um jong ka synñiang la khang noh .
translation.en: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped , and the rain from heaven was restrained  ;

translation.kha: Ngan pynphong ïa ki ban siew ar shah na ka bynta ki pop bad ka jingbymdon jong ki , namar ki la pynsngaid ïa ka ri jong nga da ki bleithaw ki im don jingim kumin ki metïap , bad ki la pyndap ïa ka da ki blei thala jong ki .
translation.en: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double  ; because they have defiled my land , they have filled mine inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things .

translation.kha: “Nga kwah ba Don u ban ïasaid pynlang U Blang na ka bynta jongnga nga , kumba u briew u ïasaid na ka bynta u paidlang jong u .
translation.en: O that one might plead for a man with God , as a man pleadeth for his neighbour !
That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers , to give them a land flowing with milk and honey , as it is this day . Then answered I , and said , So be it , O  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta ngan bat ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki ba ngan ai ha ki ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap kaba ki don mynta .  Nga la ong ,  Ho-oid , ko  Trai .

Kane ka dadien ka daw balei ba U Blei u la pynshitom ïa ki kpa tymmen jongngi ph Mynba u wanrah ka jingjot halor kane ka Nongbah . Bad pynban , phi pan kwah ba U Blei un phah shuh shuh ka jingbitar halor ka Israel da kaba pyntngit ïa ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: Did not your fathers thus , and did not our God bring all this evil upon us , and upon this city ? yet ye bring more wrath upon Israel by profaning the sabbath .

translation.kha: Khatduh pat u Shekanaïah bad ki bariew ka Jeroboam ki pynrit ïa latai , bad kumne U Trai um shym pynshitom ïa ki briew khah hadien ka jingïap u Hesekaïah .
translation.en: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart , both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem , so that the wrath of the  Lord  came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah .
Assemble yourselves and come  ; draw near together , ye that are escaped of the nations : they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image , and pray unto a god that cannot save .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ale lang , ko ki briew jong ki hima , baroh kiba lait im na ka jingkyllon ka hima-patsha ; ai ïa lade na ka bynta ka jingbishar ! Ki briew kiba ïaid bad la ki bleithaw kiba da ki dieng bad duwai sha ki blei ki bym lah ban pynim ïa ki — kito ki briew ki bymtip ei ei satia !
Shion shen hadien ba u Jehoïakim u khun jongngi u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah ,
translation.en: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah came this word from the  Lord  , saying ,
Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king s guard , which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon :
translation.kha: Nangta u Daniel u la leit sha u Ariokh , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun ai jingïada jong u syiem , uba la ïoh hukum ban pyndep ïa ka jingpynïap . Da kaba jied biang biang ïa ki kyntien jong u ,
Sin da ka jingmynjur lad ka tnga jrong u , u la pahuh kato katne ka pisa na ka boitha ïa lade sad u la ai ïa kaba hukum barabor ha ki apostol .
translation.en: And kept back part of the price , his wife also being privy to it , and brought a certain part , and laid it at the apostles  feet .
But I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment , than for you .
translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , U Blei un pyn-i kham bun ka jingisynei ïa ki briew ka Tyros bad Sidon ban ïa phi !
Kat baje mynta ?
translation.en: What is the time now ?

I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing : they commit adultery , and walk in lies : they strengthen also the hands of evildoers , that none doth return from his wickedness : they are all of them unto me as Sodom , and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah .
translation.kha: Hynrei ha ki nongïathuhlypa ka Jerusalem nga la ïohi ba ki leh kaba kham sniew : ki klim bad ki kren lamler ; ki pynshlur ïa ki briew ban leh ïa ka bymdei , kumta ba ym don ba sangeh noh ïa kaei kaba sniew . Ha nga , ki long baroh kiba sniew kum ki briew ka Sodom , bad ka Gomorrah .
Nangta u la phah ïa u mraw uba lai ; ki nongshimwai ki la pynmynsaw ïa u pajut , bad ki la bret ïa u shabar .
translation.en: And again he sent a third : and they wounded him also , and cast him out .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohpdiang nga la shem kynsan ïa lade ha ka nongbah Susa ba la ker kynroh ha ka proberb jong ka Elam . Nga la ïeng khrud ka oh Ulai ,
translation.en: And I saw in a vision  ; and it came to pass , when I saw , that I was at Shushan in the palace , which is in the province of Elam  ; and I saw in a vision , and I was by the river of Ulai .
And next to him repaired Ezer the son of Jeshua , the ruler of Mizpah , another piece over against the going up to the armoury at the turning of the wall .
translation.kha: U Eser , u khun jong u Jeshua , u nongsynshar jong ka Mispah , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud kaba long ha khmat ka jaka buh tiar ïapom , haduh ka jaka ha kaba ka kynroh ka phai ;

translation.en: And this is the law of the meat offering : the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the  Lord  , before the altar .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki jingainguh bam . U lyngdoh na ki khun shynrang u Aaron un wallam ïa ka jingainguh bam sha U  Trai  ha khmat ka duwan .
Te U Trai u la ong ha nga ,
translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  unto Jeremiah , saying ,

translation.kha: Hynrei u Abraham u nguh ha khmat kita ki Hit
translation.en: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land .

translation.kha: Naba lada phi im kat kum ka jinglong ba kynoi doh , phin sa ïap ; hynrei lade da U Mynsiem phi pynïap noh ïa ki jingleh ka pop , phin im .
translation.en: For if ye live after the flesh , ye shall die : but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body , ye shall live .

translation.kha: U Rangbah lyngdoh ha uba ïa ka umphniang pynsleh la theh ha ka khlieh jong u , bad ïa uba la pynkyntang ban phrung ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh , um dei ban Ieh ra-ngiep ïa la u shñiuh lane kad ïa la ki jaiñjot .
translation.en: And he that is the high priest among his brethren , upon whose head the anointing oil was poured , and that is consecrated to put on the garments , shall not uncover his head , nor rend his clothes  ;

translation.kha: Ki pynbiang ïa ki syiem jong ka bat bad ka Syria da ki kulai bad ki katai ïapom , da Kaba die ïa ki kali ïapom ha ka dor hynriewspah ki sbai rupa kawei bad ïa ki kulai ha ka dor shispah sanphew ki sboh rupa uwei .
translation.en: And they fetched up , and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver , and an horse for an hundred and fifty : and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites , and for the kings of Syria , by their means .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ngan shim ïa ka sharak bad wad ïa ka Jeroboam . Ngan pynkhamti ïa ki briew katba sngewhun ha lade bad kiba sngewskhem , naba ong ha ailad , ‘ U Trai um ju leh ei ei , kumne lane katai .’
translation.en: And it shall come to pass at that time , that I will search Jerusalem with candles , and punish the men that are settled on their lees : that say in their heart , The  Lord  will not do good , neither will he do evil .

translation.kha: Kaba pynrem ïa kiba her lui lane kaba pynksan ïa ki bymman — baïar ar ki long ka jingijli ha U Trai .
translation.en: He that justifieth the wicked , and he that condemneth the just , even they both are abomination to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hangta u Judah u la ïakynduh ïa ka samla nong Kaiwan uba u kpa jong ka u kyrteng u Shua .
translation.en: And Judah saw there a daughter of a certain Canaanite , whose name was Shua  ; and he took her , and went in unto her .
Where is the king of Hamath , and the king of Arpad , and the king of the city of Sepharvaim , Hena , and Ivah ?
translation.kha: Hangno don na ki syiem jong ki nongbah ka Hamath , Arpad , Sepharbaim , Hena bad Ibbah ?
Ngan Tap ïa ki lumlang bad ïa ki ih da ka metbneng ïabeit jong me .
translation.en: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains , and fill the valleys with thy height .

translation.kha: To ïam dara to kyang haba phin ïohsngew ïa kane . Phi kiba shong basah ha ki bynta ba ha trai jong ka nongbah , namar baroh ki nongkhaïi kin ïap !
translation.en: Howl , ye inhabitants of Maktesh , for all the merchant people are cut down  ; all they that bear silver are cut off .

translation.kha: Wat la ka kyrpad ïa u Joseph man la ka sngi , um treh ban leit thiah bad ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as she spake to Joseph day by day , that he hearkened not unto her , to lie by her , or to be with her .
A new heart also will I give you , and a new spirit will I put within you : and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh , and I will give you an heart of flesh .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ka dohnud kaba thymmai bad ïa ka jingmut kaba thymmai . Ngan khlaw noh na phi ïa ka dohnud maw ba-eh rang jong phi , bad ngan ai ha phi ka dohnud kaba kohnguh .
U Mesha u la shim ïa kita ki dieng baroh sad u la pynjam ïa ki ha ki Israel . Ki la ïohi ïa kaba la jylla , bad uwei pa uwei u nongïalam u la shim noh ïa la u jong u diengkhap .
translation.en: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the  Lord  unto all the children of Israel : and they looked , and took every man his rod .
It is neither fit for the land , nor yet for the dunghill  ; but men cast it out . He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
translation.kha: Kam long kaba bha ïa ka khyndew lane ïa ka kynton sboh ; la bret noh ïa ka . Shahshkor , te , lada phi don ki shkor !

translation.en: Yea , though he live a thousand years twice told , yet hath he seen no good : do not all go to one place ?
translation.kha: kham palat ban ïa u briew u bym ïoh lehkmen ha ka jingim , la u lah ban im ar hajar snem . Nalorkata , baroh ar ki leit sha kajuh ka jaka .
Ha ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha , ha ka sngi kaba sawphew saw jong u bnai uba khatwei ( u bniap Shebat ) , U Trai u la ai ha nga ka kyrhuh ha ka jingïohipaw ha ka jer mynmiet .
translation.en: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month , which is the month Sebat , in the second year of Darius , came the word of the  Lord  unto Zechariah , the son of Berechiah , the son of Iddo the prophet , saying ,

translation.kha: bud ïa U Trai bad tiengburom ïa u ; kohnguh ïa u bad sumar ïa ki hukum jong u ; mane ïa u bad ïaineh ha u .
translation.en: Ye shall walk after the  Lord  your God , and fear him , and keep his commandments , and obey his voice , and ye shall serve him , and cleave unto him .

And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel , Because the king is near of kin to us : wherefore then be ye angry for this matter ? have we eaten at all of the king s cost ? or hath he given us any gift ?
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Judah ki jubab ,  Ngi leh ïa kata namar ba u syiem u long uwei na ngi . Balei kane kan pynbitar ïa phi ? Um shym la siew na ka bynta ka bam jong ngi lane um shym la ai ei ei ïa ngi .

translation.en: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you , neither shall ye diminish ought from it , that ye may keep the commandments of the  Lord  your God which I command you .
translation.kha: Wat pyntam ei ei nalor kaba nga hukum ïa phi , lane pynduna ei ei na ka . Kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ïa kiba nga la ai ha phi .

translation.en: O daughter of my people , gird thee with sackcloth , and wallow thyself in ashes : make thee mourning , as for an only son , most bitter lamentation : for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  To kup jaiñ khain bad to tyllun ha u dpei . To ïam sngewsih lem bad ki ummat kthang kumba phin ïam ïa u khun marwei , namar uta uba wan ban pynjot ïa phi un tur ïaleh kynsan .

Kane ka kynthup ïa Baroh ki nongrit sawdong kine ki nongbah haduh ka Baalath Beerelim ( lane ka Ramah ) , ha ka phalang bashathie . Kane ka dei ka ri kaba ki longïing na ka jait Simeon ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: And all the villages that were round about these cities to Baalath–beer , Ramath of the south . This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Simeon according to their families .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa U Trai , phira ki song baroh ! A to ïaroh ïa u , phi ki jingtipbriew baroh !
translation.en: O praise the  Lord  , all ye nations : praise him , all ye people .

translation.kha: Lada mano mano , u briew ne ka briew , u ba-bang leit sha ka iaka ba khah shapoh ka phaloh u syiem bad leit ïakynduh ïa u khlem shait khot , un ïan . Kata ka dei ka aiñ ; nguh ki nong jingmut u syiem haduh ki riewbieit jong ki jylla , ki tip ïa kata . Ka don tang kawei ka lynti ban lait na kane ka aiñ : lada u syiem u pyn-i ïa u diengsoh ksiar ïano ïasnoh , tang kata ka ban pyllait im ïa uta u briew . Hynrei ka la long mynta shi bnai ba u syiem u la phah khot ïa de .
translation.en: All the king s servants , and the people of the king s provinces , do know , that whosoever , whether man or woman , shall come unto the king into the inner court , who is not called , there is one law of his to put him to death , except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre , that he may live : but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohsngew ïa kadei kaba sawa kum ka sur Kaba wan napdeng ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ba-im naba la nong , Shi kilo u kew na ka bynta ka bainong shi sngi , bad lai kli u barli na ka bynta ka pli shi sngi . Hynrei wat pynjot napoh ïa ki dieng Olib bad ïa ki bri shitaiew !
translation.en: And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say , A measure of wheat for a penny , and three measures of barley for a penny  ; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine .
For a voice declareth from Dan , and publisheth affliction from mount Ephraim .
translation.kha: Ki nonglamktien na ka nongbah Dan bad na ki lum Ephraim ki pynbna ïa ka khubor basniew .
U sing u pynïap ïa ka jingbam jong u bad u tar ïa ka lynghoh lyngkhot na ka bynta ka sing jong u nabar ki khun jong ka ; u la pyndap ïa ka krem jong u da ka doh ba la patar .
translation.en: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps , and strangled for his lionesses , and filled his holes with prey , and his dens with ravin .
And , behold , they brought to him a man sick of the palsy , lying on a bed : and Jesus seeing their faith said unto the sick of the palsy  ;  Son , be of good cheer  ; thy sins be forgiven thee .
translation.kha: ha kaba katto katne ki briew ki la wallam sha u ïa u briew uba ïapshiliang , uba thiah ha ka jingthiah . Haba U Jisu u la ïohi haduh katno ka jingngeit ki don , u la ong ha u briew uba ïapshiliang ,  To long shlur , ko khun jong nga ! Ïa ki pop jong me la map .

translation.en: So that all which fell that day of Benjamin were twenty and five thousand men that drew the sword  ; all these were men of valour .
translation.kha: Baroh ki Benjamin kiba shah pynïap ha kata ka sngi ki long arphew san hajar ngut — baroh na ki , ki dei ki shipai bashlur .

translation.en: Men and brethren , children of the stock of Abraham , and whosoever among you feareth God , to you is the word of this salvation sent .
translation.kha: Ko para Israel jong nga , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham , bad baroh ki Jentil hangne kiba mane ïa U Blei : Ka long ha ngi , ba la phah ïa kane ka khubor ka jingpynim !

translation.en: If ye forsake the  Lord  , and serve strange gods , then he will turn and do you hurt , and consume you , after that he hath done you good .
translation.kha: Um lah ban shah ïa kiwei pat kiba ïaleh pyrshah bad u , bad lada phi iehnoh ïa u ban shakri ïa ki blei nongwei , un phai pyrshah ïa phi bad un pynshitom ïa phi . Un pynjot thiaw ïa phi , wat la u long uba bha ïa phi mynshuwa .

A Trai , to sngewnguh ïa ngi . A Trai , to map ïa ngi . A Trai , to shahshkor ïa ngi , sad to trei ! Khnang ba uwei iwei baroh un tip ba me lama U blang , wat ym pynslem ! Kane ka nongpang bad kine ki brup ki long ki jong me .
translation.en: O Lord , hear  ; O Lord , forgive  ; O Lord , hearken and do  ; defer not , for thine own sake , O my God : for thy city and thy people are called by thy name .

translation.kha: Ban nguh buhnud ïa ki , u syiem Lo-Ruhamah u thaw da ki stieh rnong bad u atiar ïa ki ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam kiba kheit shun ïada ïa ki khyrdop lad ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields , and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard , which kept the door of the king s house .

translation.kha: Lada phi shad ba uba bieit un sam ïa ka nongrah-khubor , ka long kam ot ïa la ki jong ki kjat ; Phin pan ïa ka jingjop .
translation.en: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet , and drinketh damage .

translation.kha: Mynta to khie leit sha ki surok bah nabar khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai ïa ki briew kat phi lah ban ïashem .’
translation.en: Go ye therefore into the highways , and as many as ye shall find , bid to the marriage .
And they put him in ward , that the mind of the  Lord  might be shewed them .
translation.kha: Ki set ïa u , bad ki ap haduh ba U  Trai  un ïathuh ïa ki kumno yn leh ïa u .
U Terah u phah ha ki Israel ïa u nongïalam , uba pyllaitluid ïa ki na ki Syria , bad kumta ki Israel ki im ha ka jingsuk , kumba mynshuwa .
translation.en: ( And the  Lord  gave Israel a saviour , so that they went out from under the hand of the Syrians : and the children of Israel dwelt in their tents , as beforetime .

translation.kha: nongthaw uwei na kita ki hynñiew ngut ki angel kiba la don ïa ki hynñiew tukri ki pliang , u la wiang sha nga Bad u la ong , Abel , nur-um pynum ha me ba kumno yn pynshitom ïa ka nuti bapawnam , kata ka nongbah bakhraw ïa kaba la tei hajan ki wieh basbun .
translation.en: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials , and talked with me , saying unto me , Come hither  ; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters :

translation.kha: ka khmat namar ka khmat , ka bniat namar ka bniat , ka kti namar ka kti , ka kjat ñiar ka kjat ,
translation.en: Eye for eye , tooth for tooth , hand for hand , foot for foot ,
Lay hands suddenly on no man , neither be partaker of other men s sins : keep thyself pure .
translation.kha: To wat leh kyrkieh ha kaba buh ïa ki kti halor jongno jongno ban pynkyntang ïa u sha ka kam U Trai . To wat ïadon bynta ha ki pop jong kiwei ; to ri ïa lade uba sngur .

translation.en: Now therefore arise , go forth , and speak comfortably unto thy servants : for I swear by the  Lord  , if thou go not forth , there will not tarry one with thee this night : and that will be worse unto thee than all the evil that befell thee from thy youth until now .
translation.kha: Mynta , to leit ban pynskhem biang ïa ki rangbah jong phi . Nga smai ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  ba lada phim leh kumta , yn ym don shuh uwei ruh na ki u ban don bad phi lashai mynstep . Kata kan long ka jingjynjar kaba sniew tam kaba phin shah ha ka jingim jong phi baroh .

translation.en: They reap every one his corn in the field : and they gather the vintage of the wicked .
translation.kha: Ki hap ban ot ha ki lyngkha ki bym dei la ki jong , bad lum ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ki bri sohwaiñ jong ki briew kiba sniew .

translation.en: Now Sarai Abram s wife bare him no children : and she had an handmaid , an Egyptian , whose name was Hagar .
translation.kha: Ka tnga u Abram ka Sarai , kam shym la ïoh khun satia . Hynrei ka la don bad ka , kawei ka mraw na Ijipt kaba kyrteng ka Hagar , bad kumta ka ong ha u Abram ,  U  Trai  u la khang ïa nga ban ïoh khun .
Te ki briew jongnga ki shem baroh kmen khot ïa pa’ kiba suk , Namarba ka ri jong phi tud long ka jaka kaweh bha shun shong ban sai .
translation.en: And all nations shall call you blessed : for ye shall be a delightsome land , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ainong ha u Paulos , To bsuh noh ïa ka waitlam ha ka jingsop jong ka ! Me turoi ba tun ym dih ïa ka khuri ka jingshah shitom ïa kaba U Kpa jong nga u la ai ha nga ?
translation.en: Then said Jesus unto Peter ,  Put up thy sword into the sheath : the cup which my Father hath given me , shall I not drink it ?
Jesus answered and said ,  This voice came not because of me , but for your sakes .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Kam dei na ka bynta jong nga ba kane ka sur ka la kren , hynrei na ka bynta jong phi .

translation.en: And she wrote in the letters , saying , Proclaim a fast , and set Naboth on high among the people :
translation.kha: Ki shithi ki ong :  Pynbna ïa ka sngi ban shahjingit , khot lang ïa ki paidbah baroh bad ai ïa u Naboth ka jaka kaba donburom .

Shisien , haba la don ka nemsniew ha kylleng ka ri , u Elisha u la leit phai sha jingïalam . katsha u dang hikai ïa ka kynhun ki nongïathuhlypa , u la ong ïa u shakri jyllang u ban taïew ïa u khih uba heh ha ding bad shet syrwa na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: And Elisha came again to Gilgal : and there was a dearth in the land  ; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him : and he said unto his servant , Set on the great pot , and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets .

translation.kha: Hynrei kam shym ngam jylliew thah jong ki , bad kim shym neh sleit . Kumta haba ka jingjynjar lane ka jingshah pynshitom beiñ ka wan namar ka khohruh , ki ioh shisyndon .
translation.en: Yet hath he not root in himself , but dureth for a while : for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word , by and by he is offended .

translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la ai ha u Abraham ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingotsher koum ka dak jong ka jutang . Kuth u Abraham u la otsher ïa u Isaak hadien shi taïew naduh ba la kha ïa u ; u Isaak u la otsher ïa u Jubab u khwan jong u bad u Jakob u la otsher ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u , ki khop tymmen uba jingpawnam jongngi ka jaitbynriew jngai ngi .
translation.en: And he gave him the covenant of circumcision : and so Abraham begat Isaac , and circumcised him the eighth day  ; and Isaac begat Jacob  ; and Jacob begat the twelve patriarchs .

translation.kha: Da ka ding bad ka waitlam un pynum ïa ki briew baroh lad ka pyrthei kiba u shem ba la pynrem — bad shibun kin shah pynïap .
translation.en: For by fire and by his sword will the  Lord  plead with all flesh : and the slain of the  Lord  shall be many .

translation.kha: Pynkyntang ïa ki kumne ba kin dup long katba kyrduh janai bad ïa du uno ne kiei kaei kaba pyndei ïa ki yn pynmynsaw da ka bor ka jingkhuid jong ki .
translation.en: And thou shalt sanctify them , that they may be most holy : whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy .
For he shall be like the heath in the desert , and shall not see when good cometh  ; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness , in a salt land and not inhabited .
translation.kha: U long kum ka bniap ha ka ri shyiap , kaba mih ha ka ri khlaw baryngkhiang , halor ka khyndew mluh ha kaba ym don kaei kaei kaba mih . Ym don kano kano kaba bha kaba la ju jia ha u .
Kita baroh ar ngut ki la pynlong ka jingïateh kular bakynja iwei ïa iwei pat . U Dabid u sah ha Horesh , bad u Jonathan u leit noh sha ïing .
translation.en: And they two made a covenant before the  Lord  : and David abode in the wood , and Jonathan went to his house .
Thou hast loved righteousness , and hated iniquity  ; therefore God , even thy God , hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows .
translation.kha: Me ieit ïa kaei kaba dei bad me isih ïa ka bymdei . Namarkata U Blei , U Blei jong me , u la jied ïa me bad u la ai ha me ïa ka jingkmen ka jingpyndonburom kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaba u ai ïa ki paralok jong me .
bad nga la ïohi shibun ki samla shynrang kiba shida jingmut , hynrei nga la ïohi kyrpang ïa uwei u samla kaba duna ka jingsngewthuh .
translation.en: And beheld among the simple ones , I discerned among the youths , a young man void of understanding ,

So I stood upon him , and slew him , because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen : and I took the crown that was upon his head , and the bracelet that was on his arm , and have brought them hither unto my lord .
translation.kha: Kumta nga leit sha u bad nga pynïap ïa u , namar nga tip ba un sa ïap hi la kumno kumno un tang shu kyllon . Nangta nga shim ïa ka pansngiat na ka khlieh jong u bad ïa ka jingdeng na ka ksang ti jong u , bad nga la wallam ïa ki sha phi , ko kynrad .
“Kane ka la pynbitar ïa u Elisha , bad u ong ïa u syier , Me la dei ban pduh san ne hynriew sien , bad nangta men jin da la jop pura halor ki Syria ; hynrei mynta men jop ïa ki tang lai sien .
translation.en: And the man of God was wroth with him , and said , Thou shouldest have smitten five or six times  ; then hadst thou smitten Syria till thou hadst consumed it : whereas now thou shalt smite Syria but thrice .
Take Aaron and his sons with him , and the garments , and the anointing oil , and a bullock for the sin offering , and two rams , and a basket of unleavened bread  ;
translation.kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u sha khmat ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad wanrah ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh , ka umphniang pynsleh , u masi lyngraw ban long ka jingkñia namar ka pop , ar tylli ki blang shynrang , bad ka shang ba buh ïa u kpu bakhlem thiat .

translation.en: For if I pray in an unknown tongue , my spirit prayeth , but my understanding is unfruitful .
translation.kha: Naba lada nga duwai ha kane ka rukom , ka mynsiem jong nga ka duwai da shisha , hynrei ka jingmut jong nga kam don bynta ha ka .
U syiem Salmunna u shna arspah tylli ki stieh kiba heh , ïa kawei pa kawei la sop da ka ksaiñ ba la shoh kaba khia kumba hynriew lko ,
translation.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold : six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh ka Snem jong U Trai kan wan kum u nongtuh . Ha kata ka Sngi , ki bneng kyang jah noh lakam malu ka jingsawa kaba jam , ki metbneng kin ing duh bad yn pynjot , bad ka pyrthei lem bad ktien kiei barabor kiba Don ha ka kin jah rngai .
translation.en: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night  ; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise , and the elements shall melt with fervent heat , the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up .

translation.kha: namar u la bajanai badno leh bymsuidñiew ïa katba duk bad ba u knieh noh ïa ki ïing Kiba kiwei! ki la thaw ,
translation.en: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor  ; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not  ;

translation.kha: Naba U Trai u la ai ha ki Israel ïa ki nongïalap kiba la pyllait im ïa ki na ki nonglute .
translation.en: Nevertheless the  Lord  raised up judges , which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them .

translation.kha: Haseroth me la ju poi sha ka iaka ha kaba ka sngi ka wang mih , lane shaei ka jaka na Kaba ka lyer Mihngi ka beh ?
translation.en: By what way is the light parted , which scattereth the east wind upon the earth ?

translation.kha: Bad lada uno isangsot u kyllaiñ ïa ph Balei phi! leh ïa kata , ong ïa u ba U Kyntait u donkam ïa u bad pun pynphai mar mar pat ïa u .
translation.en: And if any man say unto you , Why do ye this ? say ye that the Lord hath need of him  ; and straightway he will send him hither .

translation.kha: U kwah eh ban ïohi ïa Phi baroh’ , bad u la sngew pisa shibun Namar ba Phin la ïohsngew ba u la pang .
translation.en: For he longed after you all , and was full of heaviness , because that ye had heard that he had been sick .

translation.kha: U Massah u jubab , Ang daiñ ba leh ïa kane namar ki bynriew ki ïawan sha nga ban tip ïa ka mon U blem .
translation.en: And Moses said unto his father in law , Because the people come unto me to enquire of God :
And he said , It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery , neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome : but the noise of them that sing do I hear .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ,  Kata kam shym sawa kum ka jingrisa jop thma , lane kum ka jinglynñiar kiba shahjop ; hynrei ka dei ka jingsawa jong ka jingïarwai .

U Elijah u leit shat u paidbah bad ong , Sa katno slem ba phin pynmihpat ïa ki jingmut jong phi ? dalade U Trai u Dei U Blei , mane ïa u ; hynrei lada u Baibl u dei U Blei , mane ïa u ! Hynrei u paidbah u la shu sngap shkor .
translation.en: And Elijah came unto all the people , and said , How long halt ye between two opinions ? if the  Lord  be God , follow him : but if Baal , then follow him . And the people answered him not a word .

translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ngi ki pyrkhat ba ngin ym ïohi ïa ki ne tip ïa kaei kaba jia haduh ba ki la long halor jong ngi , ban pynïap ïa ngi mala ban pynduh pyndam ïa ka jingtrei jong ngi .
translation.en: And our adversaries said , They shall not know , neither see , till we come in the midst among them , and slay them , and cause the work to cease .

translation.kha: Ka Gomer ka la kha ïa i khun ba ar — ha kane ka por da i kyntur . U Trai u la ong ha u Hosia , Pynkyrteng ïa ka , ‘ ka Lo-Ruhamah’ namar Ngan ym pyn-i jingbeit shuh ïa ki briew ka Israel , lane map ïa ki .
translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a daughter . And God said unto him , Call her name Lo–ruhamah : for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel  ; but I will utterly take them away .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un shim ïa uta u khunlangbrot bad ïa kata ka umphniang Olib bad un ai ïa ki kumno ka jingai kaba jingkyrpang ha U Trei na ka bynta u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering , and the log of oil , and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Namar ba ki Oded kim khim la shiah ïa ki Israel banbeiñ ïaid lyngba ïa ka hima jong ki , ki Israel ki la phalang noh bad ïaid na kawei pat ka lynter .
translation.en: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border : wherefore Israel turned away from him .
And if any soul sin through ignorance , then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering .
translation.kha: Lada mano mano na phi , phi leh pop khlem da mut khnang , phi dei ban wanrah kawei ka blang kaba shisnem ka rta kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop .
Bad U jongu u la pynkut , Ha ka jingsngew jrong me , uei na keiñ lah ngut uba la kuna kum u paramarjan ïa u bynriew uba la shah tur ïaleh ha ki nonglute ?
translation.en: Which now of these three , thinkest thou , was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves ?

translation.kha: Don mo jingeh umbah dang shu dep rep bri sohwaiñ , hynrei u bym pat ïohlad ban kheit ïa ki soh jongngi ka ? “lada don , ai un rupa phai sha la Ïing , ïoh ba u ïap ha madan thnum , dara ba uwei pat un ïoh bam ïa ki soh jongngi ka .
translation.en: And what man is he that hath planted a vineyard , and hath not yet eaten of it ? let him also go and return unto his house , lest he die in the battle , and another man eat of it .

translation.kha: hynne U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , da kaba pyllaitluid ïa u na ka bor Jong ka , Naaman ka long ka ngi lah long ba ka jingpynïap kan ba-bang ïa u .
translation.en: Whom God hath raised up , having loosed the pains of death : because it was not possible that he should be holden of it .

translation.kha: Ka Bneng ka pynpaw ïa ka bapop jong une u briew , bad ka pyrthei ka phla pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity  ; and the earth shall rise up against him .

translation.kha: U Joshua u ong ha ki jait Ephai bad Manasseh ba shaei Sepngi , Da shisha Phin ïabun paid , bad phi long kiba khlaiñbor . Pha ïoh shuh shuh nalor ka shi bynta .
translation.en: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph , even to Ephraim and to Manasseh , saying , Thou art a great people , and hast great power : thou shalt not have one lot only :

translation.kha: Wat ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Trai bad wat suiñbneng ïa ki briew’ kiba shong hangta . Ngin jop da kaba suk ïa ki . U thri u don lem bad ngi bad u la jop ïa ki beit kiba ïada ïa ki ; kumta te woh sheptieng .
translation.en: Only rebel not ye against the  Lord  , neither fear ye the people of the land  ; for they are bread for us : their defence is departed from them , and the  Lord  is with us : fear them not .
That they may know from the rising of the sun , and from the west , that there is none beside me . I am the  Lord  , and there is none else .
translation.kha: Nga leh ïa kane khnang ba baroh na kawei ka tduh jong ka pyrthei shaduh kawei pat ka tduh kan tip ba nga long U  Trai bad ym don uwei pat U Blei .

Haba ki la poi ha Antiokh , ki la lumlang ïa ki briew jongu ka bajan bad ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la leh bad ki , bun kumno u la pli ka lynti na ka bynta ki Jentil ban ngeit .
translation.en: And when they were come , and had gathered the church together , they rehearsed all that God had done with them , and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles .
Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob , and the mercy to Abraham , which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old .
translation.kha: Men pyn-i ïa ka jingïaineh jong me bad ka jingieit baneh ha la ki briew , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham bad jong u Jakob , kumba me la kular ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi la slem bah .
Ïaid shaphrang bad rhah ïa u kpu jong phi kum ka jingainguh sha U Blei , bad to sngewbang shaphang ki jingainguh ba tam ba phi wallam ! Kainan ka long ka lap ïa kaei kaei kaba phi ieit ban leh .
translation.en: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven , and proclaim and publish the free offerings : for this liketh you , O ye children of Israel , saith the Lord  God .
And he shall have it , and his seed after him , even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood  ; because he was zealous for his God , and made an atonement for the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ma u bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin bat ïa ka kam lyngdoh junom , namar ba um shym la shah ïa kiba ïakob bor bad nga bad ba u la wallam ka jingïohmap na ka bynta ka pop jong ki briew .

translation.en: Yet it pleased the  Lord  to bruise him  ; he hath put him to grief : when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin , he shall see his seed , he shall prolong his days , and the pleasure of the  Lord  shall prosper in his hand .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ka dei ka mon jong nga ba un shah pynshitom ; ka jingïap jong u ka long ka jingkñia ban wanrah ïa ka jingmap-ei . Bad kumta un ïohi ïa la ki khun ki ksiew ; un ïoh ïa ka jingim kaba jlan , bad lyngba jong u ïa ka jingthmu jong nga yn pyndep .

translation.en: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations , there was given to me a thorn in the flesh , the messenger of Satan to buffet me , lest I should be exalted above measure .
translation.kha: Hynrei ban pyllait ïa nga na kaba dap da ka jingsarong namar kiei kiei kiba bun kiba phylla ba nga la ïohi , la buh ha nga ïa ka jingpang kaba jur ha ka met , kaba long kum u nonglamktien jong u Soitan ban pynshitom ïa nga bad ban pyllait ïa nga na ka jingsngew sarong .
Ka kham Bha ban ïakynduh ïa ka dngiem kaba la duh noh ïa la ki khup ban ïa kaba ïakohnguh ïa uno uno uba bieit uba bunkam ha ka kam mutlop .
translation.en: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man , rather than a fool in his folly .

translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la shemphang ba um shym la maham ïa ki ban sumar ïa lai na u thiat uba pyndonkam ha u kpu , hynriewphew na ka jinghikai ki Pharisi bad ki Sadok .
translation.en: Then understood they how that he bade them not beware of the leaven of bread , but of the doctrine of the Pharisees and of the Sadducees .

translation.kha: Ka kynhun barben kawei ka la sngewbha ïa ka jingïaroh jong ki apostol , kumta ki la jied ïa u Stephan , u Briew uba ïadep da ka jingngeit bad da U Mynhynnin bakhia , badno u Philip , u proh , u Nikanor , u tymmen , u Perasim , pynlang u Nikolas , u Jentil uba na Antiokh uba mynshuwa u la kylla sha ka niam Jiw .
translation.en: And the saying pleased the whole multitude : and they chose Stephen , a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost , and Philip , and Prochorus , and Nicanor , and Timon , and Parmenas , and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch :

translation.kha: Hadad kata , haba u ïabuaid u la leit sha ïing ban khleh ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing , ka Mikhal ka wan mih ban ïakynduh ïa u . U shym ki Israel u la pynkhraw ngam ïa biar ha kane ka sngi ! ka ong . U la pynlyngkhuit ïa lade kum u bieit ha khmat ki shakri kynthei jong ki rangbah synshar jong u .
translation.en: Then David returned to bless his household . And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David , and said , How glorious was the king of Israel to day , who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants , as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself !

translation.kha: Kaba rwai jingrwai ha u Briew uba kulai mynsiem ka long kumba loit noh ïa ki jaiñ jong u ha ka por khiat lane kamon kaba kyllan mut ha ka jingmong .
translation.en: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather , and as vinegar upon nitre , so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart .
Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe  ; let her breasts satisfy thee at all times  ; and be thou ravished always with her love .
translation.kha: kaba itynnat bad shongkhia kum ka skei . Ai ba ki jingitynnat jong ka kin pynkmen ïa phi ; ai ba kan ker sawdong ïa phi da ka jingieit jong ka .

Wan ïalam ruh ïa u para khatduh jongnga phi Sha nga . Da kum ngan tip ba phim dei ki nongïasaid , hynrei ki briew kaba hok ; ngan ai patar ha phi ïa u hynmen u para jong phi , bad phi lah ban sah hangne bad khaïi ruh .’
translation.en: And bring your youngest brother unto me : then shall I know that ye are no spies , but that ye are true men : so will I deliver you your brother , and ye shall traffick in the land .

translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa uno uno ibha leit kiew sha tnga ïong dara mane ïa ka sngi , u bnai , bad ïa ki khulom . NGA pynjot ruh ïa kito ibha mane ïa nga Bad kiba smai ïa-ban ïaineh ha nga , hynrei pynban ki shim smai ha ka kyrteng jong u Blei’ Molekh .
translation.en: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops  ; and them that worship and that swear by the  Lord  , and that swear by Malcham  ;
And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony , where I will meet with you .
translation.kha: Nangta rah ïa ki shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad buh ïa ki ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang , ha kaba nga ïashem bad me .
hynne u Syiem u jubab , Em , ngan siew ha me ïa ka dor ba-pura . Ngan ym ai kum ka jingainguh ha U Trai ïa kaei kaba daym ka jong me , da kaei naba shu ïoh ei .
translation.en: And king David said to Ornan , Nay  ; but I will verily buy it for the full price : for I will not take that which is thine for the  Lord  , nor offer burnt offerings without cost .
And it was so , that when he had turned his back to go from Samuel , God gave him another heart : and all those signs came to pass that day .
translation.kha: Ynda u Saul u phai ban leit noh na u Samuel , U Blei u buh ha u ka jinglong kaba thymmai . Bad kita baroh kiba u Samuel u la ïathuh ha u ki wan jia long ha kata ka sngi .
Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai nongsumar u ong : Wallam ïa u paidïapom ban pynshyrkhei ïa ki bad shun lute ïa ki .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will bring up a company upon them , and will give them to be removed and spoiled .
Jesus answered and said unto him ,  If a man love me , he will keep my words : and my Father will love him , and we will come unto him , and make our abode with him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Uno uno uba ieit ïa nga un kohnguh ïa ka jinghikai jong nga . U Kpa jong nga un ieit ïa u , bad U Kpa jong nga bad ma nga ngin wan ha u bad sah hapoh jong u .

Haba ki briew ki ainong , Kaei kaei baroh ka jar jar bad ka shngain , te kynsan ka jingpynjot kan lynshop ïa ki! kan wan kyndit kum ki jingpang kiba wan ha ka briew kaba suh kha , bad ki briew kin ym lait phet .
translation.en: For when they shall say , Peace and safety ; then sudden destruction cometh upon them , as travail upon a woman with child ; and they shall not escape .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ong ha u , Haba to ïohi ïa u Doeg hangta ha kato ka sngi , to la tip ïakem ba un sa ïaheh ha u Sarah . Kumta nga jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki ba-ha-ïing ba-eh jongki phi baroh .
translation.en: And David said unto Abiathar , I knew it that day , when Doeg the Edomite was there , that he would surely tell Saul : I have occasioned the death of all the persons of thy father s house .

translation.kha: Nga la shahshkor bha bad shem ba phi! la rumal ; phim shym lah ban pyndih nia ïa kadei kaba u Joab u la ong .
translation.en: Yea , I attended unto you , and , behold , there was none of you that convinced Job , or that answered his words :

translation.kha: Ki briew bariewspah ki phah ïa la ki shrak ban tong um ; ki leit shaw ki Thliew pynlang um , ishyrkhei kim shem um ; ki wan blei pat bad ki khra thylli . Ki la noh mynsiem badno shynrang jingmut , ki buhrieh ïa la ki durkhmat .
translation.en: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters : they came to the pits , and found no water  ; they returned with their vessels empty  ; they were ashamed and confounded , and covered their heads .
God brought him forth out of Egypt  ; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn : he shall eat up the nations his enemies , and shall break their bones , and pierce them through with his arrows .
translation.kha: U Blei u la wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt ; U ïaleh namar jong ki la kum u masi prut . Ki bam duh ïa ki nongshun jong ki , Ki pynlwet ïa ki shyieng jong ki , ki pynkheiñ ïa ki khnam jong ki .

translation.en: He should be self-sacrificing in his love for his wife .
translation.kha: U dei ban kham ieit ïa la ka lok ban ïalade .
ryngkat bad ki mraw barben jong u Abraham .
translation.en: And all the men of his house , born in the house , and bought with money of the stranger , were circumcised with him .

translation.kha: badno kin bret ïa ki shapoh ka lawar dong baklang , ha kiba kan lynñiar mala kyr-iat bniat .
translation.en: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire : there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth .

translation.kha: Ha Katto ka sngem mynba phi ïalam ha u Lum Sinai , phi la kyrpad ba phim kwah shun ïohsngew shuh ïa ka sur U Trai , lymne ïohi shuh ïa ka ding ha kaba u khong , namar ba Phin sheptieng ïoh Phin ïap .
translation.en: According to all that thou desiredst of the  Lord  thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly , saying , Let me not hear again the voice of the  Lord  my God , neither let me see this great fire any more , that I die not .
For to him that is joined to all the living there is hope : for a living dog is better than a dead lion .
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba im ha ka pyrthei kiba im u don katto katne ka jingkyrmen ; u ksew uba im u kham bha ban ïa u sing ba la ïap .

U Moses u la nguh ha ki Lebi , Mynta ka sngi phi la pynkyntang ïa lai kum ki lyngdoh ha ka jingshakri ïa U Trai da kaba pynsep ïa la ki khun shynrang bad ïa ki hynmen ki para shynrang , kumta U Troas u la ha phi ïa ki jingkyrkhu jong u .
translation.en: For Moses had said , Consecrate yourselves to day to the  Lord  , even every man upon his son , and upon his brother  ; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day .

translation.kha: Kumta mandriek ki don ki jingriam baroh sawdong jong phi , bad kynsan kynsan ph dap da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: Therefore snares are round about thee , and sudden fear troubleth thee  ;

translation.kha: Ka spah lai ym lah ban leh ïa kaei kaei kiba bha ha ka sngi ba phi ïatim ïa ka jingïap , hynrei ka jinglehhok kan pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi .
translation.en: Riches profit not in the day of wrath : but righteousness delivereth from death .

translation.kha: Ka bneng Bad ka pyrthei kin leit nep , hynrei ki ktien jong de kin ym leit noh lano lano ruh .
translation.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away : but my words shall not pass away .

translation.kha: Pynbna ïa ka ha ki shnong jong ka Ijipt , ha Migdol , Memphis , sad Tahpanhes : ‘ To pynrieh ban ïada ïa lade ; ïa ktieh kiei kiba phi don yn pynjot ha ka thma !
translation.en: Declare ye in Egypt , and publish in Migdol , and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes : say ye , Stand fast , and prepare thee  ; for the sword shall devour round about thee .
For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion , How are we spoiled ! we are greatly confounded , because we have forsaken the land , because our dwellings have cast us out .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ka jingsawa ka jingïam ha Seïon ,  La pynjot ïa ngi ! La pynlehrain khoit ïa ngi ! Ngi dei ban iehnoh ïa ka ri jong ngi ; ïa ki ïing jong ngi la pynkhyllem .
Nangta U Terah u la ïathuh ha ang
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: A katno phira long kiba eh ryndang ! u Stephan u bteng ban kren-ïa . A katto ki dohnud jyllang phi ki long kum kiba miej Blei’ thala , katno phi leh khyllied ïa ka khubor jong U Blei ! Phi longsem kum ki kpa tymmen jong phi : Phi ruh phi la ïaid ïabeh pyrshah ïa U Mynsiem! Bakhuid !
translation.en: Ye stiffnecked and uncircumcised in heart and ears , ye do always resist the Holy Ghost : as your fathers did , so do ye .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u ong ha nga , ‘ Wah tieng ïa u . Ngan aiti ïa u , ïa ki briew jong u , bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh ha phi . Lai ïa u kumba phi la leh ïa u Sihon u syiem Amor uba synshar ha Hebron .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Fear him not : for I will deliver him , and all his people , and his land , into thy hand  ; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites , which dwelt at Heshbon .
But draw near hither , ye sons of the sorceress , the seed of the adulterer and the whore .
translation.kha: Ale hangne ban shah bishar , a phi ki nongpop ! Phim long kham bha ban ïa ki nongleh byrtong , kiba klim bad ki nuti .
Kane ka long ka durblei Kaba kdew sha ka por kaba mynta . Ka mut ba ka jingainguh badno ki jingbna da ki mrad ïa kiba la ai sha U Blei kim ia satia ban pynjanai ïa ka dohnud jong uta babha mane ,
translation.en: Which was a figure for the time then present , in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices , that could not make him that did the service perfect , as pertaining to the conscience  ;
And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine , which shall be in the land of Egypt  ; that the land perish not through the famine .
translation.kha: Kata ka jingbam kan long kum ka jingbuh pynap ïa ka ri ha kita ki hynñiew snem jong ka  nemsniew ki ban sa wan ha ka ri Ijipt . Da kane ka rukom ki briew kin ym ïapthngan .
U patsha u ong ïa u ban rhah ïa ki bad pynphai sha ka Templ ha Jerusalem bad pun tei pah ïa ka Templ ha ka khak ba ka la ïohnong mynshuwa .
translation.en: And said unto him , Take these vessels , go , carry them into the temple that is in Jerusalem , and let the house of God be builded in his place .

translation.kha: U Syiem ïabuaid mynba u la tymmen babha , mala wat la ki shakri jong u ki tap ïa u da ki nep-syiad , um Shim syaid satia .
translation.en: Now king David was old and stricken in years  ; and they covered him with clothes , but he gat no heat .

translation.kha: Thaw ruh sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka ksiar , bad pynïasoh ïa ki jingkah da wir ki jingpyndait ba kin long tang Kawei .
translation.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold , and couple the curtains together with the taches : and it shall be one tabernacle .

translation.kha: U Jotham u la ne arphew san snem ka rta mynba u long syiem mala u synshar khathynriew snem ha Jeroboam .
translation.en: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Kaei phiah ïa-pyrkhat ? Ki la jubab , U long naba shah pynrem nabar u dei ban ïaw .
translation.en: What think ye ? They answered and said , He is guilty of death .

translation.kha: Kumba da Shishak nga long U Balei uba im , U Trai Nongsynshar u la ong , une u syiem un ïap ha Babilonia namar u la pynkheiñ ïa la ka jingsmai bad ka jingïateh lok bad u syiem ka Babilonia , umbah la buh ïa u ba-halor ka khet .
translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king , whose oath he despised , and whose covenant he brake , even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die .

translation.kha: To nguh ha ki jaitbynriew baroh , U Trei u lama u syiem ! Ïa ka pyrthei la pynshong skhem ha la ka jaka bad ym da ban pynkhih ; un bishar ïa ki jaitbynriew da ka hok .
translation.en: Say among the heathen that the  Lord  reigneth : the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved : he shall judge the people righteously .

translation.kha: Ngan wan kulai . Sumar kyndong ïa kaei kaba pha don , khnang ba yn ym don uno uno u ban lwet na pha ïa ka bainong jong ka jingjop .
translation.en: Behold , I come quickly : hold that fast which thou hast , that no man take thy crown .
And when Zebah and Zalmunna fled , he pursued after them , and took the two kings of Midian , Zebah and Zalmunna , and discomfited all the host .
translation.kha: Ki ar ngut ki syiem Midian , u Sebah bad u Salmunna , ki her ïap , hynrei u beh kthong ïa ki bad u ïohkem ïa ki , bad u pynkulmar thlim ïa ka kynhun shipai jong ki baroh kawei .
Hobab phi la Shong slem ha kata ka ri bad phi la ieh khun ïoh ksiew , wat leh pop da kaba thaw blei ïa lap da kano kano ka trud . Kata ka long ka kam bymman ha khmat U Trai , bad kan pynbuaid ïa u .
translation.en: When thou shalt beget children , and children s children , and ye shall have remained long in the land , and shall corrupt yourselves , and make a graven image , or the likeness of any thing , and shall do evil in the sight of the  Lord  thy God , to provoke him to anger :

translation.kha: Bad U Jisu! u la pait ha ki ïa kaei kaba la ong shaphang jong u hi ha baroh ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , da kiba tdong da ki kitab u Moses bad ki jingthoh jong ki nongïathuhlypa baroh .
translation.en: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets , he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself .
And they stood every man in his place round about the camp : and all the host ran , and cried , and fled .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u ïeng ha la ka jaka sawdong ka jaka sher dara , bad ka kynhun shipai jong ki nongshun baroh ki phet ïap da kaba lynñiar .

translation.en: Then said Boaz unto his servant that was set over the reapers , Whose damsel is this ?
translation.kha: U Boas u kylli ïa u briew uba pynïaidkam ,  Katai ka theisamla ka dei mano ?

translation.en: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all .
translation.kha: Namar ba U Jisu Khrist u la leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa u ban leh , ïa ngi baroh la pynkhuid na ka pop da ka jingainguh kaba u la aiti ïa la ka jong ka met tang shisien hi .

translation.en: And he looked up , and said , I see men as trees , walking .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la khmied bad ong ,  Ho-oid , nga lah ban ïohi ïa ki briew , hynrei nga ïohi kum ki dieng kiba ïa-ïaid .
La ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingdon jong ki shipai shong kulai : Ki la long arphew jutang ngut .
translation.en: And the number of the army of the horsemen were two hundred thousand thousand : and I heard the number of them .

translation.kha: Ieh ! Kaei me kwah bad ngi , ko Jisu uba na Nasareth ? Hato me la wan hangne ban pynjot ïa ngi ? Nga thuh me Long uei : Me long u nonglamktien Bakhuid jongki U Blei !
translation.en: Saying , Let us alone  ; what have we to do with thee , thou Jesus of Nazareth ? art thou come to destroy us ? I know thee who thou art  ; the Holy One of God .

translation.kha: Hadien kata un tur ïaleh ïa ki hima kiba sharud duriaw bad u jop ïa kiba bun na ki . hynrei u nongïalam nongwei un jop ïa u bad un pynkut ïa ka jinglehmeng Jong u ; da shisha un pynphai pat ïa ka jinglehmeng jong u syiem ka Syria sha u .
translation.en: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles , and shall take many : but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease  ; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him .
When he established the clouds above : when he strengthened the fountains of the deep :
translation.kha: mynba u buh ïa ki lyoh ha sahit bneng , mynba u seng ïa ki umpohliew ka duriaw-bah ,
U thaw ïa ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia , u bajur ïa ki da ka ksiar ,
translation.en: And he made staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold .

translation.kha: bad u la maw shiah u Eliel , mala u ong , phiah khot ïa to , bad nga hangno . Khynñiuh u Eli u jubor , Ngam shym Khot ïa phi ; khie longing thiah biang . kumta u Samuel u leit thiah biang .
translation.en: And he ran unto Eli , and said , Here am I  ; for thou calledst me . And he said , I called not  ; lie down again . And he went and lay down .
And he said unto him ,  Thou hast answered right : this do , and thou shalt live .
translation.kha: Me ong kaba dei ,  U Jisu u la jubab ;  to leh ïa kane bad men im .
U la dang shu sdang Ban leh kumta haba la wallam ïa uwei suba la kit Rakem bun tyngka .
translation.en: And when he had begun to reckon , one was brought unto him , which owed him ten thousand talents .

translation.kha: phyrnai sa ioh ïa kane bad yn pyndap da ka jingkmen . Phin khynñiuh da ka jingsngewkmen . Ki sleh jong ki jaitbynriew yn wallam sha pha ; na shiliang ka duriaw ki spah jong ki kin wan .
translation.en: Then thou shalt see , and flow together , and thine heart shall fear , and be enlarged  ; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee , the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee .
Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world ? and if the world shall be judged by you , are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba ki briew U Blei kin sa bishar ïa ka pyrthei ? Te , namarkata , lada phi long ki ban bishar ïa ka pyrthei , hato phim long kiba lah ban bishar ïa kiei kiei kiba rit ?
Ngan Sa Wan
translation.en: I will come

translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka kyrdoh shata ka phyllaw bashabar . La don laiphew tyrnem ki kamra ba la Tei ha syndah ka kynroh bashabar bad ha khmat jong ki , la ne ka jaka ba la siang maw kaba poi shadong ka phyllaw .
translation.en: Then brought he me into the outward court , and , lo , there were chambers , and a pavement made for the court round about : thirty chambers were upon the pavement .

translation.kha: Phim pat siew bainong ei ei ïa ki briew kiba trei ha ki lyngkha jong phi . To shahshkor ïa ki jingduh jyllang ki ! Ki jingkyang jong iba kiba la lum ïa ki jingot ki la tad sha ki shkor jongno U blang , U Trai Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Behold , the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields , which is of you kept back by fraud , crieth : and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth .

And there I will meet with thee , and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat , from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony , of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan sa ïakynduh ïa me hangta , bad najrong jong ka jingtap kaba hapdeng kita ki kherub ar tylli , ngan ai ha me ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh na ka bynta ki Israel .

translation.en: And Laban said , It must not be so done in our country , to give the younger before the firstborn .
translation.kha: U Laban u jubab ,  Kam ju dei ka dustur hangne ban ai shuwa ïa ka khun khatduh ban shongkurim ha shuwa ka hynmen .
Balei U Blei u Don la ka jongno ka Seng ?
translation.en: Why Does God Have an Organization ?

translation.kha: U Elishah u hukum bad ong , Kem ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal ; Wat ai ba uno uno na ki un lehse phet ! Ki paidbah ki la kem ïa ki baroh , bad u Elijah u la ïalam ïa ki sha ka Wah Kushan bad pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: And Elijah said unto them , Take the prophets of Baal  ; let not one of them escape . And they took them : and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon , and slew them there .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ai ïa ka Hukum ba Ladan du uno u tip Hangne ba U Jisu u don , u dei ban wanrah shukor , khnang ba kin ïohkem ïa u .
translation.en: Now both the chief priests and the Pharisees had given a commandment , that , if any man knew where he were , he should shew it , that they might take him .
But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence , they were gathered together .
translation.kha: Haba ki Pharisi ki la ïohsngew ba U Jisu u la pynsngap jar ïa ki Saddusi , ki la ïawanlang ,
Dang step eh ha ka Sneng U Trai , hamar ba dang shu mih ka sngi , ki la leit sha ka jingtep .
translation.en: And very early in the morning the first day of the week , they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun .

translation.kha: U long ma u , uta kiba bat ïa ka jingtei barabor kawei , bad uba pynlong ïa ka ba Kan san ha ka Templ kaba kynoi ïa kaba la pynkyntang shat U Trai .
translation.en: In whom all the building fitly framed together groweth unto an holy temple in the Lord :
Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof : so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured .
translation.kha: Sumar bha ïa u dieng Dumbur bad phin ïoh ïa ki soh ban bam . U shakri uba sumar bha ïa la u kynrad un ïoh burom .
U la sngew thngan , malu u la kwah ban bam ei ei ; katba tdong pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam , u la ïoh ka jingïohipaw .
translation.en: And he became very hungry , and would have eaten : but while they made ready , he fell into a trance ,

And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Speak unto Aaron thy brother , that he come not at all times into the holy place within the veil before the mercy seat , which is upon the ark  ; that he die not : for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Ïathuh ha u hynmen jong me u Aaron ba dei tang ha ka por kaba dei ba un leit shadien ka jingkah jong ka jaka kaba khuid tam , namar ba dei hangta ba nga mihpaw ha u lyoh halor ka jingtap ka Synduk ka Jutang . Lada um kohnguh , un shah pynïap .
ba U Messaïah u dei ban shahshitom bad ban long uba nyngkong ïa-ban iathuh na ka jingïap , ban pynbna ïa ka jingshai jong ka jingpynim ha ki jia bad ha ki Jentil .
translation.en: That Christ should suffer , and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead , and should shew light unto the people , and to the Gentiles .
All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs .
translation.kha: Ki longïing babun jong ka kur Gershon ki la ïohpdiang baroh khatlai tylli ki nongbah lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

translation.en: And as he prayed , the fashion of his countenance was altered , and his raiment was white and glistering .
translation.kha: Katba u dang duwai , ka durkhmat jong u ka la kylla dur , bad ki jaiñ jong u ki la kylla lieh phyrnai .
Ka shithi kaba u rah ka ong : Kane ka shithi kan pynithuh ïa u Naaman , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong nga . NGA kajuh ïa phi ban pynkhiah ïa u na ka jingpang jong u .
translation.en: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel , saying , Now when this letter is come unto thee , behold , I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to thee , that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy .

translation.kha: Kat ka para ka nang ïaid u Joseph , ki hynmen jong u , bad sa kiwei pat ruh jong kata ka pateng , ki la ïap noh ,
translation.en: And Joseph died , and all his brethren , and all that generation .
And he brought into the house of God the things that his father had dedicated , and that he himself had dedicated , silver , and gold , and vessels .
translation.kha: U buh ha ka Templ ïa baroh ki tiar kiba u Abijah u kpa jong u , u la pynkyntang sha U Blei , kumjuh ruh ïa ki tiar ba la shna da ka ksiar bad ka rupa kaba u hi u la pynkyntang .
To pynkhreh ban shah kem koidi , phi ki briew ka Jephthah ! Ïa ka mem yn sa pynlong ka ri shyiap , ka jingjot ha kaba yn ym don ban sheng ban sah .
translation.en: O thou daughter dwelling in Egypt , furnish thyself to go into captivity : for Memphis shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant .
Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters : I will give them an everlasting name , that shall not be cut off .
translation.kha: te ïa ka kyrteng jong me yn ïai kynmaw ha ka templ jong nga bad hapdeng ki briew jong nga kham slem ban ïa kaba me don ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei . Yn ym klet ïa me lano lano ruh .

nangta u la duwai , Ko Trai , to pynpeit ïa ki kham jrong u bad ai un ïohi . U Trai u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad u shakri jyllang u Elisha haba u peit shajrong bad u la ïohi ïa ka sharing lwa ba la dap da ki kulai Bad ki kali ïapom kiba da ka ding barieh sawdong jong u Elisha .
translation.en: And Elisha prayed , and said ,  Lord  , I pray thee , open his eyes , that he may see . And the  Lord  opened the eyes of the young man  ; and he saw : and , behold , the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha .

translation.kha: U Petros u la bud ïa u shabar jong ka byndi , khlem da tipthuh , la kaei kaba u angel u la ai ka long kaba shisha ; u la pyrkhat ba u la ïew ka jingïohipaw .
translation.en: And he went out , and followed him  ; and wist not that it was true which was done by the angel  ; but thought he saw a vision .

translation.kha: Kumta hi u Ariokh u la ïalam ïa u Daniel sha u syiem Benabinadab bad u la ïathuh ha u syiem , Nga la shem uwei na ki Jiw babha la shah ringmraw , babha lah pun ïathuh ha u Syiem Kynrad ïa ka jingmut jong ka jingphohsniew jongngi phi .
translation.en: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste , and said thus unto him , I have found a man of the captives of Judah , that will make known unto the king the interpretation .

translation.kha: ban sien bad ïa-ong ha u Hananaïah : U tharai u la ong ba me lah Ban pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor dieng , hynrei un bujli ïa ka da ka lyngkdong nar .
translation.en: Go and tell Hananiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; Thou hast broken the yokes of wood  ; but thou shalt make for them yokes of iron .

translation.kha: Haba u Joab u la keiñ noh ïa ka jingbeh kthong , u la lumlang ïa ki rangbah jong u baroh , bad u la Shem ba khatkhyndai ngut na ki , ki la Da-ei , nalor u Hasiel .
translation.en: And Joab returned from following Abner : and when he had gathered all the people together , there lacked of David s servants nineteen men and Asahel .

translation.kha: Mynta nga tip ba U Trai u kham khroh ban ïa ki phai baroh , namar u la leh ïa kane mynsaw ki nong Ijipt ki la lehrain shaba palat ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: Now I know that the  Lord  is greater than all gods : for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them .
The  Lord  of hosts hath sworn , saying , Surely as I have thought , so shall it come to pass  ; and as I have purposed , so shall it stand :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la smai ka jingsmai :  Kaei kaba nga la thmu kan jia . Kaei kaba nga la kut jingmut ban leh yn pyndep .
Ki la shim ïa ka jingsawa jongu u Absalom , ki la bret ïa ka ha ka thliew bajylliew hapoh ka khlaw , bad ki la tep ïa ka da ka kynton maw kaba khraw . Baroh ki Israel ki phet krad sha la shnong .
translation.en: And they took Absalom , and cast him into a great pit in the wood , and laid a very great heap of stones upon him : and all Israel fled every one to his tent .

translation.kha: Na ka jingjylliew haw u dohkha u Jonah u la duwai sha U Trai U Blei jong u :
translation.en: Then Jonah prayed unto the  Lord  his God out of the fish s belly ,

translation.kha: Ki la don ha byndi la kham slem , bad u kapten u la buh ïa u Joseph ban peit ïa ki .
translation.en: And the captain of the guard charged Joseph with them , and he served them : and they continued a season in ward .

translation.kha: Nahath U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Me te , men ym im sloit shuh . Khot ïa u Joshua bad Wan ïalam ïa u sha ka Ïingjaiñ kthang ba ngan ai lei ïa u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Behold , thy days approach that thou must die : call Joshua , and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation , that I may give him a charge . And Moses and Joshua went , and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba la shahshkor kynthup ha ka jingkheiñbriew u dei pun siew ïa ka dor ba la buh , kat kum ka jingthew ha ka jaka kyntang , wai pa uwei un siew ïa kane kum ka jingainguh sha nga .
translation.en: This they shall give , every one that passeth among them that are numbered , half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary : ( a shekel is twenty gerahs : ) an half shekel shall be the offering of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka jingïaiban ïa ka jingphohsniew jong pa ka mut ba ïa kane la pynskhem da U blem nabar ba un pynurlong shen ïa ka .
translation.en: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice  ; it is because the thing is established by God , and God will shortly bring it to pass .
The lot is cast into the lap  ; but the whole disposing thereof is of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïakynting sbai ban tip ïa ka mon U Blei , hynrei U Blei da lade hi u ai ïa ka jubab .
Jaban kumta , u nongshun un kerkut ïa ka ri , un pynthiah ïa ki jingker jong ki , bad un lumrit ïa ki ïohnong paki daiñ jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; An adversary there shall be even round about the land  ; and he shall bring down thy strength from thee , and thy palaces shall be spoiled .
And he went forward a little , and fell on the ground , and prayed that , if it were possible , the hour might pass from him .
translation.kha: U la leit kham ha pajih , u la dem pyllup ha khyndew , bad u la duwai ba lada don ka lad , un ym hap ban ïaid lyngba ïa kata ka por jong ka jingshah shitom .

translation.en: O my people , what have I done unto thee ? and wherein have I wearied thee ? testify against me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki briew jong nga , nga la leh aïu ïa phi ? Kumno nga la long ka jingkit ïa phi ? To jubab ïa nga .
Te U Trai u nguh ha u , Nga long U Trai , uba la wanpaw ïalam ïa me na ka shnong Ur kaba ha ka ri Babilonia , ban ai ha me ïa kane ka ri kum ka jong me hi .
translation.en: And he said unto him , I am the  Lord  that brought thee out of Ur of the Chaldeans , to give thee this land to inherit it .

translation.kha: U Trai’ u ong ha u Joshua , Ïalap len bad me ïa ki shipai baroh nabar leit kew sha Ai . Wat sheptieng lane khaw-eit . Ngan ai ha me ka jingjop ïa u shym ka Ai ; ki briew jong u , ka nongbah jong u , bun ka ri kan long ka jong me .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Fear not , neither be thou dismayed : take all the people of war with thee , and arise , go up to Ai : see , I have given into thy hand the king of Ai , and his people , and his city , and his land :
