translation.kha: U Joshua u la kaei dang trep phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , pynlang ha ka sien kambah ar ki lyngdoh bad ki shipai ki la ïaid tawiar ïa ka nongbah ha kajuh ka rukom kumba ki la sa ha ka sngi kaba la dep : nyngkong , ka kynhun shipai na shata khmat ; hadien kata , ki hynñiew ngut ki lyngdoh kiba put ïa ki hynriew tylli ki turoi ; nangta , ki lyndum kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai ; bad khatduh , ka kynjah shipai na shadien . Ha ki por baroh la put ïa ki turoi .
translation.en: And seven priests bearing seven trumpets of rams  horns before the ark of the  Lord  went on continually , and blew with the trumpets : and the armed men went before them  ; but the rearward came after the ark of the  Lord  , the priests going on , and blowing with the trumpets .

translation.kha: Nga thiah ha ka jingshahjop ha ka khyndew ; to pynkhie im biang ïa nga , kumba me la kular .
translation.en: My soul cleaveth unto the dust : quicken thou me according to thy word .
And he departed thence , and entered into a certain man s house , named Justus , one that worshipped God , whose house joined hard to the synagogue .
translation.kha: Kumta u la iehnoh ïa ki bad u la leit sah noh ha ka ïing jong u Jentil uba kyrteng u Titius Justos , uba mane ïa U Blei ; ka ïing jong u ka don ha syndah jong ka synagog .

Nangne ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap , ki da ïaid tawiar ïa ka ri Edom bad ka ri Moab khah ba kin da pei ha ka deng mihngi jong ka ri Moab , sha shiliang ka oh Arnon . Ki sher dara hangta , hynrei kim shym jam ïa ka arsien namar u dei u pud ki maw .
translation.en: Then they went along through the wilderness , and compassed the land of Edom , and the land of Moab , and came by the east side of the land of Moab , and pitched on the other side of Arnon , but came not within the border of Moab : for Arnon was the border of Moab .
And it was told him by certain which said , Thy mother and thy brethren stand without , desiring to see thee .
translation.kha: Don uwei uba la ong ha U Jisu ,  Ka kmie bad ki para shynrang jong me ki ïeng shabar bad ki kwah ban ïohi ïa me .

translation.en: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked : but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness .
translation.kha: U Blei , uta uba hok , u tip ïa kaei kaba jia ha ki longïing ki riewbymman , bad un wallam ïa ki bymman sha ka jingjot jingpra .
U tikmie ruh ïa ki nongbah ba u syiem Hiram u la ai ïa u , bad u phah ïa ki Israel ba-bang shongduh ha ki .
translation.en: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon , Solomon built them , and caused the children of Israel to dwell there .

translation.kha: Uta un kaweh ïa kata ka tari kum ka jingainguh kaba kyrpang sha U Tlai , khnang ba yn pdiang ïa phi . Uta u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka ha ka sngi kaba buid ïa ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: And he shall wave the sheaf before the  Lord  , to be accepted for you : on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it .

translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko ki paid Israel , ïa khie ka jingrwai loit ontep kaba nga rwai ha phi :
translation.en: Hear ye this word which I take up against you , even a lamentation , O house of Israel .
So we laboured in the work : and half of them held the spears from the rising of the morning till the stars appeared .
translation.kha: Kumta , man ka sngi , naduh dang step phyrngab haduh ka por ba la mih ki khlur mynmiet , shiteng na ngi , ngi trei ha ka kynroh , katba shiteng kiwei pat , ki ïeng ap phira bad ki sum .
Na ka bynta kaba shadien jong ka Ïingjaiñ ha ka phang sepngi , shna hynriew tylli ki jingker
translation.en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards .
And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years : and he slept with his fathers , and Nadab his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam u la synshar kum u syiem arphew ar snem . U la ïap bad la tep ïa u , bad u khun jong u , u Nadab u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .

translation.en: And they were all amazed and marvelled , saying one to another , Behold , are not all these which speak Galilaeans ?
translation.kha: Ha ka jinglyngngoh bad jingphylla ki la pynbna ,  Kine ki briew kiba kren kumne ki long ki nong Galilaïa !

U Simeon u la kyrkhu ïa ki dara u la ong ha ka Mari , ka kmierad jyllang u , Ïa une u khunlung la lngaid da U Blei na ka bynta ka jingpynjot bad ka jingpynriam ïa kiba bun ha Jeriel . Un long ka dak na U Blei ïa kaba kiba bun ki briew kin kren pyrshah bad kumin un pynpaw ïa ki jingpyrkhat barieh jong ki .
translation.en: And Simeon blessed them , and said unto Mary his mother , Behold , this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel  ; and for a sign which shall be spoken against  ;

translation.kha: bad un synreit khyndiat ïa ka snam jyllang ka ha ka krung lad ka duwan . Ïa ka snam kaba dang sah yn pjiar ha trai ka duwan . Kñia ka long ka jingkñia shun map ïa ka pop .
translation.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar  ; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar : it is a sin offering .

translation.kha: To ïeng joit bad khie leit shngiam ïa u , bad khroh ïa u . nur pynlong ka jaitbynriew kiba khraw na ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translation.en: Arise , lift up the lad , and hold him in thine hand  ; for I will make him a great nation .

translation.kha: Babha ka Naomi ka ïohi ba ka Ruth ka la khoit jingmut shem don leit bad ka , kim shym ainong ei ei sha .
translation.en: When she saw that she was stedfastly minded to go with her , then she left speaking unto her .

translation.kha: Ngam la pynpyiar ïa ki bneng bad pynïeng ïa ki nongrim ka pyrta ; nga ong ïa ka Jerusalem , ‘ phin long ki briew jong nga ! Nga la ai ha phira ïa ka jinghikai jong nga , bad nga ïada ïa phiah da ka ksang ti jong ar .’
translation.en: And I have put my words in thy mouth , and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand , that I may plant the heavens , and lay the foundations of the earth , and say unto Zion , Thou art my people .

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Saul ki long u Jonathan , u Ishbi , bad u Malkhijah . Ka khun kynthei baheh jong u ka kyrteng ka Merab , bad kaba khnam rishot ka Mikhal .
translation.en: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan , and Ishui , and Malchi–shua : and the names of his two daughters were these  ; the name of the firstborn Merab , and the name of the younger Michal :

translation.kha: Pi tip ïa ka khubor kiba u la phah sha ki paid Israel , da kaba Pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha jong ka jingsuk lyngkha U jongu Khrist , uba long U Tlai jong baroh .
translation.en: The word which God sent unto the children of Israel , preaching peace by Jesus Christ : ( he is Lord of all : )

translation.kha: U Aaron u shongkurim ïa ka Elisheba , ka khun jyllang u Amminadab bad ka para jngai u Nahshon . Ka la kah ïa u Nadab , u Abihu , u Elealeh , dara u Ithamar .
translation.en: And Aaron took him Elisheba , daughter of Amminadab , sister of Nahshon , to wife  ; and she bare him Nadab , and Abihu , Eleazar , and Ithamar .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la duwai , A Blei , nga long ma nga uta uba la leh bakla . Nga dei uta uba la hukum ban kheiñ briew . Kynsan ki paidbhur bapli ki la leh aïu ? A Trai , U Blei jong nga , pynshitom ïa nga badno ïa ka longïing jong ar , bad pyllait ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: And David said unto God , Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered ? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed  ; but as for these sheep , what have they done ? let thine hand , I pray thee , O  Lord  my God , be on me , and on my father s house  ; but not on thy people , that they should be plagued .

translation.kha: Ngan buh ïa u bnoh lyngba ka tyngam jong me bad ngan pynlong ïa ka dohkha ha ka wah jong me banbeiñ sahkut sbak ha me . ngat ngan tan ïa me na ka wah Nile pynlang ïa ki dohkha baroh kiba snoh ha me .
translation.en: But I will put hooks in thy jaws , and I will cause the fish of thy rivers to stick unto thy scales , and I will bring thee up out of the midst of thy rivers , and all the fish of thy rivers shall stick unto thy scales .
I will make waste mountains and hills , and dry up all their herbs  ; and I will make the rivers islands , and I will dry up the pools .
translation.kha: Nga pyntwa ïa ki lumrit bad ki lumbah ngan pyntyrkhong ïa u phlang bad ki dieng . Ngan pynkylla ïa ki them wah sha ki jaka shyiap bad pyntyrkhong ïa ki pukri um .
( 2 ) Ki kambah jong u ki pynshisha ba u long u ti U Blei .
translation.en: ( 2 ) His miracles proved that he was God’s Son .
Afterward came also the other virgins , saying , Lord , Lord , open to us .
translation.kha: Hadien la wan poi kita kiwei pat ki theisotti . ‘ Ko kynrad , ko Kynrad ! to plie ïa ngi !’ ki la pyrta jam .

translation.en: There was a man in the land of Uz , whose name was Job  ; and that man was perfect and upright , and one that feared God , and eschewed evil .
translation.kha: La don u briew uba kyrteng u Job , uba shong ba sah ha ka ri Us , uba mane ïa U Blei bad uba ïaineh ha u . U long u briew uba bha , uba kiar ban ym leh ïa kano kano kaba sniew .

Ko phi ki briew bym da shaniah ! Hato phim tip ba ka jingïaineh lok bad ka pyrthei ka long ka nongshun jong U Blei ? Uno Une uba kwah ba pynlong lok bad ka pyrthei u pynlong ïa biar u nongshun jong U Blei .
translation.en: Ye adulterers and adulteresses , know ye not that the friendship of the world is enmity with God ? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of God .

translation.kha: Ka tnga ka bymïaineh ka har kumne : ka kylla , ka sum , bad ka ong , Hynrei ngam syiem leh ei ei ka bymdei !
translation.en: Such is the way of an adulterous woman  ; she eateth , and wipeth her mouth , and saith , I have done no wickedness .

translation.kha: Ujuh U balui uba la thaw ïa por u la thaw ruh ïa ki shakri jong ang .
translation.en: Did not he that made me in the womb make him ? and did not one fashion us in the womb ?

translation.kha: Te , ïa kine , yn pha noh sha ka jingpynshitom bymjukut , hynrei kiba hok kin leit sha ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment : but the righteous into life eternal .

translation.kha: Ym anna Uei shwa uba pei shaw me ha ka jingduwai ; ym don uwei umdih uba leit sha me ban ïoh jingïarap . Me la buhrieh ïa lade na ngi sad iehnoh ïa ngi namar ki pop jongnga ngi .
translation.en: And there is none that calleth upon thy name , that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee : for thou hast hid thy face from us , and hast consumed us , because of our iniquities .
The harvest is past , the summer is ended , and we are not saved .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki kyang jam ,  Ka lyiur ka la leit , ka jingot ka la kut , hynrei ym shym la pynim ïa ngi .
Ïa baroh kiwei kiwei pat kiba u Maaseïah u la leh naduh Kaba sdang haduh kaba kut ka jingsynshar jong u , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israhaïah
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah , first and last , behold , are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel ?
That , according as it is written , He that glorieth , let him glory in the Lord .
translation.kha: Te kumta , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba kwah ban sngewsarong , u dei ban sngewsarong ha kaei kaba U Trai u la leh .
U angel jong U Trai u khop ïa u Abraham ha kaba ar sien na bneng ,
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time ,

translation.kha: Haba nga la don ha Damaskos , u lyngskor hapoh u syiem Asotos u la pynap phira ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah ban kem ïa ang .
translation.en: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison , desirous to apprehend me :

translation.kha: La ai ha ki ïa ka nongbah Arba ( u Arba u dei u khop jong u Anak ) , ïa kaba myntoi la khot ka Hebron , ha ka ri lum Judah , lem bad ki pynthiah phrang sawdong jong ka .
translation.en: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak , which city is Hebron , in the hill country of Judah , with the suburbs thereof round about it .

translation.kha: U kylli , Phi ithuh ïa u Laban u khun jong u Nahor ? Ho-oid , ngi ithuh , ki jubab .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Know ye Laban the son of Nahor ? And they said , We know him .

And Moses gave unto them , even to the children of Gad , and to the children of Reuben , and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph , the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites , and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan , the land , with the cities thereof in the coasts , even the cities of the country round about .
translation.kha: Kumta u Moses u la ai ha ki jait Gad bad Reuben , bad ha ka shiteng na ka jait Manasseh ïa ka hima jong u Syiem Sihon jong ki Amor bad ïa ka hima u syiem Og jong ka Bashan , kynthup ïa ki shnong bad ki jaka sawdong jong ki .
Phi ong ba U Trai u la ai ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ha phi ha Babilonia .
translation.en: Because ye have said , The  Lord  hath raised us up prophets in Babylon  ;

translation.kha: Pynban , lama phi shahshitom namar ba phi long u Khorasin , wat sngewlehrain ïa katai , hynrei ainguh ïa U Blei ba phi kup ïa ka kyrteng U Khrist .
translation.en: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian , let him not be ashamed  ; but let him glorify God on this behalf .

translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko Job , shahshkor bha ïa nga ïa baroh’ kaba nga don pun ong .
translation.en: Wherefore , Job , I pray thee , hear my speeches , and hearken to all my words .
One is so near to another , that no air can come between them .
translation.kha: Ïa kawei pa kawei la pynïadait skhem bad kawei pat , ba wat ka lyer ruh kam lah ban rung hapdeng .

translation.en: Wherefore he saith also in another psalm , Thou shalt not suffer thine Holy One to see corruption .
translation.kha: Kumba da shisha u ong ha kawei pat ka bynta :   ‘ Men ym shah ïa u shakri baneh jong me ban pyut hapoh ka jingtep .’

translation.en: And when they saw it , they all murmured , saying , That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner .
translation.kha: Baroh ki briew kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la sdang ban khñium ,  Une u briew u la leit kum uba shah khot sngewbha sha ka ïing jong u nongpop !

translation.en: They have hands , but they handle not : feet have they , but they walk not : neither speak they through their throat .
translation.kha: Ki don ki kti , hynrei kim lah ban tba , bad ki kjat , hynrei kim lah ban ïaid ; kim lah ban pynmih sur jingsawa .
U Jisu u la ong , Haduh me thwet tang namar ba nga la ïathuh ïa me ba nga la ïohi ïa me mynba me dang don ha trai u dieng Dumbur ? Men sa ïohi ïa khie kaei kiba kham khraw ban ïa kane !
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto him ,  Because I said unto thee , I saw thee under the fig tree , believest thou ? thou shalt see greater things than these .
Now I pray to God that ye do no evil ; not that we should appear approved , but that ye should do that which is honest , though we be as reprobates .
translation.kha: Ngi duwai ha U Blei ba phin ym leh ïa ka bymdei — ym ban pynpaw ba ngi long kiba la jop , te hynrei ba phin ïoh leh ïa kaba dei , wat la ka i kumba ngi long kiba la shahjop .
Badno haba u Hukum ïa phi na Kadesh Barnea ban leit kdew kyntiap ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba u la ai ha phi , phi ïaleh pyrshang pynban ïa u ; Kino shitrhem shaniah bad kohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: Likewise when the  Lord  sent you from Kadesh–barnea , saying , Go up and possess the land which I have given you  ; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the  Lord  your God , and ye believed him not , nor hearkened to his voice .

translation.kha: Nangta ang la ïor ïa ki khet bad ha kito kiba shong ha ki la ai ïa ka ber ban Bishar . Nga la ïohi ruh ïa ki mynsiem jong kito kiba la shahshkor pynïap namar ba ki la pynbna ïa ka jingshisha ïa kaba U Jisu u la pynpoi bad ïa ka ktien U Blei . Kim shym la mane ïa u mradkhlaw lane ïa ka dur jngai u , Lym ba ki la pdiang ïa ka shab jongngi u mradkhlaw ha ki shyllangmat jyllang ki rue ha ki kti jong ki . Ki la im pat bad ki la synshar kum ki syiem bad U Khrist shihajar snem .
translation.en: And I saw thrones , and they sat upon them , and judgment was given unto them : and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus , and for the word of God , and which had not worshipped the beast , neither his image , neither had received his mark upon their foreheads , or in their hands  ; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years .

translation.kha: Da u lyoh me ïalam ïa ki ha ka por mynsngi , bad mynmiet me pynshai ïa ka lynti jongnga ki da ka ding .
translation.en: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar  ; and in the night by a pillar of fire , to give them light in the way wherein they should go .

translation.kha: Wat ïateh jutang nabar ki bariew jong kata ka ri sha kaba phira leit , namar kata ka lah ngab hir ka jingriam ka ban pynïap ïa phira .
translation.en: Take heed to thyself , lest thou make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither thou goest , lest it be for a snare in the midst of thee :

translation.kha: wahbah ki paid Israel ki ïor ïa ka ding ba ka wan hiar na bneng bad ba ka jingshai ka dap ha ka Tubal , ki dem khrup ha lynti ba la siang maw , ki da mane ïa U Blei bad ïaroi ïa U namar ka jingbsa bad ka jingieit bymngeit jyllang u .
translation.en: And when all the children of Israel saw how the fire came down , and the glory of the  Lord  upon the house , they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement , and worshipped , and praised the  Lord  , saying , For he is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha Salamis , ki la ïalap ïa ka ktien U Balei ha ki synñiang . Ki la don lang bad ki u Ïoannis Markos ba-bang ïaroh ha ka kdew .
translation.en: And when they were at Salamis , they preached the word of God in the synagogues of the Jews : and they had also John to their minister .

translation.kha: bad kim shym la shakri shuh ïa U Trai U Bela jong ki , uba la pynim ïa ki na ki nongshun baroh kiba sawdong jong ki .
translation.en: And the children of Israel remembered not the  Lord  their God , who had delivered them out of the hands of all their enemies on every side :

translation.kha: La khang pyrshah ïa phi na kaba lum khajna na ki lyngdoh , ki Lebi , ki nongput nongïam , ki nongkhap phira , ki nongphetwir lap kino kino kiba don ka jingïadei malu kane ka Templ .
translation.en: Also we certify you , that touching any of the priests and Levites , singers , porters , Nethinims , or ministers of this house of God , it shall not be lawful to impose toll , tribute , or custom , upon them .

translation.kha: Lada ki rieh ha khlieh u lum Karmel , nur-um wad ïa ki bad kem ïa ki . Lada ki rieh na jong nga ha riej duriaw , ngan hukum ïa ki mrad duriaw bakynsha ban dait ïa ki .
translation.en: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel , I will search and take them out thence  ; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea , thence will I command the serpent , and he shall bite them :

translation.kha: Ha ka sner kaba bud u Moses u ong ha ki paidbah , Phibi la kun ïa ka pop kob shyrkhei eh . Mynta ngan leit kiew biang sha U Trai ; lehse nga lah ban pynïoh ïa ka jingmap ïa ka pah jong phi .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses said unto the people , Ye have sinned a great sin : and now I will go up unto the  Lord   ; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin .
Wives , submit yourselves unto your own husbands , as unto the Lord .
translation.kha: Ko ki kynthei , to pyndem ha la ki tnga , kumba ha U Trai .

translation.en: Again , when I say unto the wicked , Thou shalt surely die  ; if he turn from his sin , and do that which is lawful and right  ;
translation.kha: Nga lah ban maham ïa u briew uba sniew ba u dei ban ïap , hynrei lada u sangeh na kaba leh pop bad leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha —

translation.en: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother s brethren , and communed with them , and with all the family of the house of his mother s father , saying ,
translation.kha: U Abimelekh u khun jong u Gideon u leit sha ka nongrit Shekhem ha kaba ki ba-ha-ïing baroh jong ka kmie jong u ki shong ki sah , bad u ong ha ki
Nga pan na me , A Blei , ban shah ïa nga ba don ar tylli kiei kiei shuwa ba ngan ïap :
translation.en: Two things have I required of thee  ; deny me them not before I die :

translation.kha: U jubab , Em ! ym dei wat ïa ki shipai Kiba me la ïohkem ha ka jingïaleh mem dei ban pynïap . Ai ïa ki katto katne ban ïam bad dih , bad ieh kin leit phai sha la u syiem .
translation.en: And he answered , Thou shalt not smite them : wouldest thou smite those whom thou hast taken captive with thy sword and with thy bow ? set bread and water before them , that they may eat and drink , and go to their master .

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba me thret ïa nga na ka dewbyrtha ; Hato men pynlwet pat ïa ang sha u pui pui ?
translation.en: Remember , I beseech thee , that thou hast made me as the clay  ; and wilt thou bring me into dust again ?

translation.kha: kumba la thom ha ka aiñ jong U Trai’ : Ïa uei pa uwei u khun nyngkong dei ban pynkyntang shiah U Trai .
translation.en: ( As it is written in the law of the Lord , Every male that openeth the womb shall be called holy to the Lord  ; )
I am as a wonder unto many  ; but thou art my strong refuge .
translation.kha: Ka jingim jong nga ka la long ka nuksa ïa kiba bun , namar me la long ka jingïada bakhlaiñ jong nga .
Kumta don phra tylli ki jingker sad khathynriew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh Kaei kawei ka jingker .
translation.en: And there were eight boards  ; and their sockets were sixteen sockets of silver , under every board two sockets .

translation.kha: U long u bym ju kylla . Ym don ba lah baneh ïing pyrshah ïa u lane pynsangeh ïa u na kaba leh ïa kaei kaba u kajuh ban lai .
translation.en: But he is in one mind , and who can turn him ? and what his soul desireth , even that he doeth .

translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha u Saul , Balei me la pynthut ïa nga ? Balei me pynlong ïa ar ban wan pait ? U Saul u jubab , Ang la nang ha ka khim khait ! Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma ïa nga , bad U Blei! u la Iehnoh ïa nga . Um shym jubab shuh ïa nga , la da ki nongïathuhlypa , lane da ki jingphohsniew . Bad kumta nga la khot ïa pa ba phin ïathuh ïa nga Aiu nga dei ban leh .
translation.en: And Samuel said to Saul , Why hast thou disquieted me , to bring me up ? And Saul answered , I am sore distressed  ; for the Philistines make war against me , and God is departed from me , and answereth me no more , neither by prophets , nor by dreams : therefore I have called thee , that thou mayest make known unto me what I shall do .

translation.kha: Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga pynbang ba yn ym don a uno u nongwei bym shyiap la otsher , uno Un u bymkohnguh ïa nga , un rung ha ka Templ jong nga , wat u nongwei uba shnong basah hapdeng ki paid Israel .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; No stranger , uncircumcised in heart , nor uncircumcised in flesh , shall enter into my sanctuary , of any stranger that is among the children of Israel .
They are created now , and not from the beginning  ; even before the day when thou heardest them not  ; lest thou shouldest say , Behold , I knew them .
translation.kha: Dei tang mynta ba nga pynurlong ïa ki ; ym don ei ei kum kane kaba la jia mynshuwa . Lada ka la jia , phin jin da la kam ba phi la dep tip lut shaphang kane .
Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Moab . Ïa ki nongbah jong ka Ar bad ka Kir la pynim Tang ha kawei ka miet , bad ka jingkynjah ka thup ïa ka ri Moab .
translation.en: The burden of Moab . Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste , and brought to silence  ; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste , and brought to silence  ;

translation.kha: Hato me lah ban pyndap ïa ka sniew jongngi u da ki sum pynïap shongkha ? ne dung ïa ka khlieh da u proh dung dohkha ?
translation.en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons ? or his head with fish spears ?

translation.kha: Ka Naomi ka don u ba-ha-ïing uba kyrteng u Boas , u brup uba riewspah bad ïa uba la ñiewkor shibun uba na ka longïing jngai u tnga jong ka , u Elimelekh .
translation.en: And Naomi had a kinsman of her husband s , a mighty man of wealth , of the family of Elimelech  ; and his name was Boaz .

translation.kha: Haba u la ïohsngew ba u paidbah u ïaid najan , u la kyllut , Kaei kane ?
translation.en: And hearing the multitude pass by , he asked what it meant .

translation.kha: Sin u Moses u pynshisha da kob shai ba ïa kiba ïap la pynbit . Ha ka bna shaphang ka lawlynnong kaba ing u krong shaphang U Tlai kumta ‘ U Blei jong u Abraham , U Blei! jong u Isak , dara U Blei jong u Jakob .’
translation.en: Now that the dead are raised , even Moses shewed at the bush , when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham , and the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob .

translation.kha: ki Hib , ki Barak , ki Sin ,
translation.en: And the Hivite , and the Arkite , and the Sinite ,

translation.kha: te ki dei ban leit ïalam ïa kata ka briew ha khmat ka jingkhang ïing u kpa jong ka , bad ki rangbah jong kata ka shnong kin lynthem maw ïa ka hangta khah ba kan da ïarap . Ka la leh ïa katai kaei kabu jahburom ha Israel da kaba pynngat ïa la ka jingsotti shuwa ka jingbymlongkhuid . Da kumta phin pynpoh noh ïa kane ka jingbymman Napdeng lad phi .
translation.en: Then they shall bring out the damsel to the door of her father s house , and the men of her city shall stone her with stones that she die : because she hath wrought folly in Israel , to play the whore in her father s house : so shalt thou put evil away from among you .

translation.kha: Em , ngan ai ïa ka jubab jong nga hi mynta bad ngan ïathuh ïa phi kaei kaba nga pyrkhat .
translation.en: I said , I will answer also my part , I also will shew mine opinion .

translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u shim khong ïa ki na u , bad u nguh u em ïa u haduh madan .
translation.en: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees , and he bowed himself with his face to the earth .

translation.kha: U la ai jingkhaïi ha u Dabid ïa ka jingdon baher lang jong ki rangbah Ibbah bit ïa ka kam shipai : khathynñiew lakh ngut ha Jeriel , bad saw lakh hynñiewphew hajar ngut ha Judah .
translation.en: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David . And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword : and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword .
And ye shall be holy unto me : for I the  Lord  am holy , and have severed you from other people , that ye should be mine .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban long kiba khuid ïa nga , namar nga long U  Trai  bad nga long uba khuid . Nga la pynkyrpang ïa phi na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ba phin long ki jong nga .
Ngan ai ïa me ki jingkynshew na ki jaka ba-dum , bakynjah ; te men tip ba nga long U Trai , bad ba U Blei ki Jeraïah u la khot ïa me da ka kyrngah .
translation.en: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness , and hidden riches of secret places , that thou mayest know that I , the  Lord  , which call thee by thy name , am the God of Israel .

translation.kha: U la dem ïa lade ha ka jaka shon shaniah jong ka Esther ban Kyrpad na ka bynta ka jingisynei . Haba u syiem u wan phai pat shapoh kamra na ki kper , haba u ïohi ïa kan , u sahmiet u pyrta jam , Hato ine u bariew un leh be-ijot ïa ka mahadei hangtei hi ha khmat jong nga , ha ka ïingsyiem jong nga ? U syiem um pat ngut bol ka jingkren , ba ki ïunukh ki tap ïa ka khlieh u Haman .
translation.en: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine  ; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was . Then said the king , Will he force the queen also before me in the house ? As the word went out of the king s mouth , they covered Haman s face .
Wherefore thou art no more a servant , but a son ; and if a son , then an heir of God through Christ .
translation.kha: Kumta te , phim long shuh u mraw hynrei u khun . Bad naduh ba phi long u khun jong U , U Blei un ai ha phi baroh kat kaba u don na ka bynta la ki khun .
To kdew ieit ïa ka pyrthei , lyndum ïa kaei kaei kaba dei jong ka pyrthei . Lydda phi ieit ïa ka pynrieh , kata ka long ba phim ieit ïa U Kpa .
translation.en: Love not the world , neither the things that are in the world . If any man love the world , the love of the Father is not in him .

translation.kha: Kumta lada ka hima u Soitan ka phiah ha ki kynhun , kan ym lah ban neh , hynrei kan kyllon noh bad poi shuh ka jingkut .
translation.en: And if Satan rise up against himself , and be divided , he cannot stand , but hath an end .
Which removeth the mountains , and they know not : which overturneth them in his anger .
translation.kha: Khlem jingmaham u pynkynriah ïa ki lum , bad da ka jingbitar u pynjot ïa ki .

translation.en: And he discovered the covering of Judah , and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest .
translation.kha: Baroh ki jingïada jong ka Judah ki la khyllem . Haba kata ka la jia , phi la wallam ïa ki tiar ïaleh na ka jaka buh .
Kiar ïa barieh ar tylli ki tduh . Lada phi don ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei , la kumno kumno phin long kiba jop .
translation.en: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this  ; yea , also from this withdraw not thine hand : for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all .

translation.kha: Haba u Saul u jingphohsniew ba u Dabid u la phet ïap Sha Gath , u sangeh noh ban wad ïa u .
translation.en: And it was told Saul that David was fled to Gath : and he sought no more again for him .

translation.kha: Katno phi long katba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jongngi nga ; katno phi long kaba jaiñ !
translation.en: The watchmen that went about the city found me , they smote me , they wounded me  ; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me .

translation.kha: Ha kaba kum kane ka para u syiem Hesekaïah u la kem pang bad u la jan ïap . U duwai , Bad U Trai u ai ha u ïa ka ka ba un sa khiah pat .
translation.en: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death , and prayed unto the  Lord  : and he spake unto him , and he gave him a sign .

translation.kha: hynrei ma phi ki briew ! Pi long kiba eh ryndang bad kiba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ; phi la pah noh sharum bad iehnoh ïa nga .
translation.en: But this people hath a revolting and a rebellious heart  ; they are revolted and gone .
But of these who seemed to be somewhat , (whatsoever they were , it maketh no matter to me : God accepteth no man s person :) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me :
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa kito kiba idei ban long ki nongïalam — nga ong ïa kane namar kam pher ei ei ïa nga la ki long kiba kumno kumno ruh ; U Blei um bishar na ki durkhmat bashabar — kito ki nongïalam , nga ong , kim don ei ei ki jingai jingmut bathymmai na ka bynta jong nga .

translation.en: Marvel not , my brethren , if the world hate you .
translation.kha: Phi wat sngewlyngngoh , ko ki para jong nga , lada ki briew jong ka pyrthei ki isih ïa phi .
phi tip kaei kaba U Blei u kwah ïa phi ba-bang ai , bad phi ïoh jinghikai na ka Hukum ban jied ïa kaei kob dei ;
translation.en: And knowest his will , and approvest the things that are more excellent , being instructed out of the law ;

translation.kha: nongshong ïa ki praw jong u baroh kiba nga la ai ha phi mynta ka sngi , khnang ba ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jrong phi phin manbha . Phin ïailong sah ha kata ka ri ïa kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la ai ha phi ba ka long ka nongkynti jong pa junom .
translation.en: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes , and his commandments , which I command thee this day , that it may go well with thee , and with thy children after thee , and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , for ever .
As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken , he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue ,  Be not afraid , only believe .
translation.kha: U Jisu um shym la patiaw ïa kaei kaba ki la ong , hynrei u la ong ha u Jairos ,  Wat sheptieng , shu ngeit .

Haba ka khubor ka la pra ha u Ngim Solomon ba u Joab u la phet krad shata ka Ïingjaiñ bad ba u don harud ka duwan , u Solomon u la phah ïa u nonglamktien sha u Joab ban kylli ïa u balei ba u la phet shad ka duwan . U Jehubbah u jubab ba u la phet krad shai U Trai nabar ba u la ïasheptieng ïa u Solomon . Kumta u Syiem Solomon u la phah ïa u Benaïah ban pynïap ïa u Joab .
translation.en: And it was told king Solomon that Joab was fled unto the tabernacle of the  Lord   ; and , behold , he is by the altar . Then Solomon sent Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , saying , Go , fall upon him .

translation.kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te , ba U Khun U Briew u don ka bor ha ka pyrthei ban map ïa ki pop . Kumta u la ino ha u briew wahbah ïapshiliang , ?(Nga ong ha me , to khie joit , shim ïa la ka jingthiah , badno khie leit noh sha ïing !
translation.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins ,  ( he said unto the sick of the palsy , )  I say unto thee , Arise , and take up thy couch , and go into thine house .
For I will rise up against them , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and cut off from Babylon the name , and remnant , and son , and nephew , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ngan tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilon bad wallam ïa ka sha ka jingjot jingpra . Ngan ym pynsah ei ei — yn ym don khynnah , yn ym don mano mano ba lait im . Nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .
Haba u Elijah u la ïohsngew ïa ka , u tap ïa la ka khmat da la ka barandi bad u leit ban ïeng ha khmat sakma ka khlem . Ka thar Kaba kren ha u , Elijah , me leh aïu hangne ?
translation.en: And it was so , when Elijah heard it , that he wrapped his face in his mantle , and went out , and stood in the entering in of the cave . And , behold , there came a voice unto him , and said , What doest thou here , Elijah ?

translation.kha: Nongthaw nga la ong ha ka kynhun langbrot , lang ym long shuh u nongaplangbrot jong phi . Ai kin ïap kito ibha dei ban ïap . Ai ba yn pynjot kito kaba dei ban shah pynjot . Kito kiba dang sah kin pynjot iwei ïa iohi pat .
translation.en: Then said I , I will not feed you : that that dieth , let it die  ; and that that is to be cut off , let it be cut off  ; and let the rest eat every one the flesh of another .

And saying , Sirs , why do ye these things ? We also are men of like passions with you , and preach unto you that ye should turn from these vanities unto the living God , which made heaven , and earth , and the sea , and all things that are therein :
translation.kha: Balei phi leh ïa kane ? Ngi hi ngi long tang ki briew kiba kum ma phi ! Ngi don hangne ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha , ban pynphai noh ïa phi na kine kiei kiei ki bymmyntoi sha U Blei uba im , uba la thaw ïa ka bneng , ïa ka khyndew , ïa ka duriaw , bad ïa baroh kat kaba don ha ki .

translation.en: Fury is not in me : who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle ? I would go through them , I would burn them together .
translation.kha: Ngam bitar shuh ïa ka bri sohwaiñ . Tang lada ki don ki shiah bad ki shiah buid ban hap ban ïakhun pyrshah , te ngan thang ïa ki baroh .
Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ka ïingsyiem ba la tei da u syiemsad Hasael , bad kun thang duh ïa ki kut jong u syiem Benhadad .
translation.en: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael , which shall devour the palaces of Ben–hadad .

translation.kha: Nangta shibun ki nongïathuhlypa lamler ken mih badno ktang shukor ïa ki briew kiba bun .
translation.en: And many false prophets shall rise , and shall deceive many .

translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ki la don bad ki ïa ka Ïingjaiñ ka Kyndong Ryngkat U Blei , ha ka ri shyiap . La thaw ïa ka kat kumba U Blei u la jong ha u Moses ban thaw ïa ka , kat khem ka duriaw ïa kiba la pyn-i ha u Massah .
translation.en: Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness , as he had appointed , speaking unto Moses , that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen .

translation.kha: Nga ai ka jingimat ïa ki briew jong nga , badno ngan ym mudui sah ïa ki lane bitar ïa ki jingdum .
translation.en: For I will not contend for ever , neither will I be always wroth : for the spirit should fail before me , and the souls which I have made .

translation.kha: Jamynrei ma ang , U Trai U blei Jong phi uba la ïalam ïa phin na Ieit , ngan pynlong ïa phi ngab sah biang ha ki ïingjaiñ , kumba phi la ni mynsaw nga wan sha phi ha ka ri shahïap .
translation.en: And I that am the  Lord  thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles , as in the days of the solemn feast .

translation.kha: Te uno uno uba ha ka ri uba pan ïa ka jingkyiuh , un pan ban ïoh jingkyrkhu na U Blei uba ïaineh . Uno uno uba shem smai un smai ha ka kyrteng U Blei uba ïakheiñ ; Ki jingjynjar kiba mynshuwa kin loit noh bad yn klet noh .
translation.en: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth  ; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth  ; because the former troubles are forgotten , and because they are hid from mine eyes .

translation.kha: Kumta u rangbah pynjam u la leit noh bad ki rangbah jong u bad wallam pat ïa ki apostol . Kum shym la pynkdang ïa ka bor , namar ki la sheptieng ïoh ba ki bajaipdeh ki lah ba-bang lynthem maw ïa ki .
translation.en: Then went the captain with the officers , and brought them without violence : for they feared the people , lest they should have been stoned .

translation.kha: Hynrei u angel u ong , Khie otsher bad kine ki briew , hynrei kren tangba ïa kaba nga jong ha me ban kren . Kumta u Balaam u la saw ryngkat dara ki .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Balaam , Go with the men : but only the word that I shall speak unto thee , that thou shalt speak . So Balaam went with the princes of Balak .

translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki phah nonglamktien sha u Sihon , u syiem Lemuel ha Heshbon , ban pan jingbit ba kin ïaid lyngba ka ri jong u sha ka ri la jong .
translation.en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites , the king of Heshbon  ; and Israel said unto him , Let us pass , we pray thee , through thy land into my place .

translation.kha: Kumta ka lut ka leit shad ki lyngkha bad ka ïaid nadien jong ki nongot , ka da tam ïa u kew uba ki ieh . Ka leit jia ryngkhat ba ka don ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u bhah .
translation.en: And she went , and came , and gleaned in the field after the reapers : and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz , who was of the kindred of Elimelech .
Therefore now ,  Lord  , let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever , and do as thou hast said .
translation.kha: Bad mynta , ko  Trai  , to pyndep na ka bynta ka por baroh ïa ka kular jong me ïa nga bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga , bad to leh ïa kaei kaba me thmu ban leh .
Nga la kyrpad ïa ki synrai jongnga me ban baher noh ïa u , hynrei kim lah .
translation.en: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out  ; and they could not .

translation.kha: Bad la la pyndap ïa u da ka bor jong nga . Nga la ai ha u ka jingshemphang , ka jingtbit bad ka jingnang baneh trei ïa ki jait kam baher —
translation.en: And I have filled him with the spirit of God , in wisdom , and in understanding , and in knowledge , and in all manner of workmanship ,

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei jong nga u la nong ha nga , To leh ïa ka bynta Jong u nongpynjot jong ka kynhun langbrot kaba dei ban shah shohdoh .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  my God  ; Feed the flock of the slaughter  ;

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Buh biang ïa u diengduh jrong u Aaron ha Khmut ka Synduk ka Jutang . Dei shun buh ïa u khem ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel kiba ïaleh pyrshah ba kin ïap lymda ki sangeh noh ïa ki jingkmen khñium jong ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Bring Aaron s rod again before the testimony , to be kept for a token against the rebels  ; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me , that they die not .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren ha phi mynba phi dang manbha , hynrei phiah kyntait ban shahshkor! . Kauda ka long kaei kaba phi leh shi lynter ka jingim jong phin , phim ju ter ban kohnguh ïa U Trai .
translation.en: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity  ; but thou saidst , I will not hear . This hath been thy manner from thy youth , that thou obeyedst not my voice .

translation.kha: Nangta U Josis u la pynlong ïa ki synrai ban kiew ha ka lieng dara don nang leit shaw shiliang ka duriaw , katba u la nang phah noh ïa u paidbah .
translation.en: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship , and to go before him unto the other side , while he sent the multitudes away .
These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you .
translation.kha: Nga thoh ïa kane sha phi shaphang kito kiba pyrshang ban shukor ïa phi .
Ki la leh kumta , bad u ïa-ong , Leh babiang kumta — bad ki la ar biang kumta . U la ong , Leh biang sa shisien , bad ki la leh kamut .
translation.en: And he said , Do it the second time . And they did it the second time . And he said , Do it the third time . And they did it the third time .
Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created , till iniquity was found in thee .
translation.kha: Ka jingleh jong me ka la long kaba janai naduh ka sngi ba la thaw ïa me haduh ba me la sdang ban leh ïa kaba sniew .

Nalorkata u Balaam u ong ha u Balak , Ïeng hangne harud ka jingainguh thang jong phi , katba nga bapaw ngan leit klet la U Trai un ïakynduh ne em ïa nga . Ngan sa ïathuh ha phi kat ïa kaba u pynpaw ha nga . Kumta u la leit marwei sha kliar jong uwei u lum ,
translation.en: And Balaam said unto Balak , Stand by thy burnt offering , and I will go : peradventure the  Lord  will come to meet me : and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee . And he went to an high place .
I sent him therefore the more carefully , that , when ye see him again , ye may rejoice , and that I may be the less sorrowful .
translation.kha: Nga phah ia u kumta da jingpeitbha , khnang , ynda phi iohi biang ia u ,  phin shadkmen , bad ka jingsngewsih jong nga kan jah noh .
La jied ïa u da U Blei ha shuwa ka jingpynlong ïa ka pyrthei mala la pynpaw ha kine ki sngi kba khatduh na ka boitha jongno phi .
translation.en: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world , but was manifest in these last times for you ,
Buried with him in baptism , wherein also ye are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God , who hath raised him from the dead .
translation.kha: Naba haba la pynbaptis ïa phi , la tep ïa phi bad U Khrist , bad ha ka jingpynbaptis la pynmihpat ruh ïa phi bad U Khrist da ka jingngeit jong phi ha ka bor ba-ïaitrei jong U Blei , uba la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap .

Namar kata , ki rangbah synshar ka ïingbishar ki la leit malu ai ka jingpynjahburom jongno ki ïa u Syiem Kynrad , u Syiem Dabid bad ki jong , ‘ To U Blang jong phin un pynurlong ïa u Salmunna uba kham pawnam ban ïa phi , bad ai ba ka jingsynshar jongu u Solomon kan long kaba man roi shibun ban ïa ka jong phi .’
translation.en: And moreover the king s servants came to bless our lord king David , saying , God make the name of Solomon better than thy name , and make his throne greater than thy throne . And the king bowed himself upon the bed .
And Saul eyed David from that day and forward .
translation.kha: Kumta u la sdang bishni bad suba sniew ïa u Dabid naduh kata ka sngi .
U briew uba peiñ u duh noh ïa ka jingkwah ban bam , bad wat ka jingbam kaba bang tam ka pynkhaw-eit ngiah .
translation.en: So that his life abhorreth bread , and his soul dainty meat .
O that ye would altogether hold your peace ! and it should be your wisdom .
translation.kha: Wat ong ei ei , bad don ki ban pyrkhat ba me long uba stad !
Nangta ïa ka pyrda kaba la wah hapoh ka Templ la dak arliang nadong khlieh haduh tbian . Ka khyndew ka la khynñiuh , ki mawsiang ki pra la ka jong ka jyllang ,
translation.en: And , behold , the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom  ; and the earth did quake , and the rocks rent  ;
They are not humbled even unto this day , neither have they feared , nor walked in my law , nor in my statutes , that I set before you and before your fathers .
translation.kha: Hynrei haduh kane ka sngi phim shym la pynrit ïa lade . Phim shym la pyndonburom ïa nga lane im kat kum ki aiñ baroh kiba nga la ai ha phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi .
Ngan khmih halor kane ka Templ bad ngan kloi ban shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai barieh ba yn pynlong hangne ,
translation.en: Now mine eyes shall be open , and mine ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place .

translation.kha: Hynrei ym baroh uba tip ïa kñia ka jingshisha . Don ki briew Ibbah la ju myllen bad ki bleithaw ba haduh kane ka sngi haba ki bam kum ïa kata ka jingbam ki dang pyut hi ïa ka kumta ka jingbam kaba dei jongngi ka bleithaw ; ka jingïatiplem jong ki ka long kaba tlot , bad ki sngew ba la pynjakhlia ïa ki da kata ka jingbam .
translation.en: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge : for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol ; and their conscience being weak is defiled .
So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat the king of Judah went up to Ramoth–gilead .
translation.kha: Hadien kata , u Ahab u syiem Israel bad u Jehoshaphat u syiem Judah ki leit tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah Ramoth ha Gilead .
Ki maïan liengbah na Biblos ki long ki rangbah ba la ïoh jinghikai bha . Ki maji na baroh ki liengbah duriaw-bah ki la ïakhaïi pateng ha ki dukan jong pha .
translation.en: The ancients of Gebal and the wise men thereof were in thee thy calkers : all the ships of the sea with their mariners were in thee to occupy thy merchandise .
And another said , I have bought five yoke of oxen , and I go to prove them : I pray thee have me excused .
translation.kha: Uwei pat u la ong , ‘ Nga la thied san jur ki masi dab bad nga don ha ka lynti ban tynjuh ïa ki ; sngewbha pdiang ïa ka jingbymlah wan jong nga .’
U Abraham u kren beiñ , To ïohmap , ko Trai ïa ka jingshlur bieit jong nga ban kren ha me . Nga long tang u briew bad ngam khong hok ban ong ei ei .
translation.en: And Abraham answered and said , Behold now , I have taken upon me to speak unto the Lord , which am but dust and ashes :

translation.kha: Nga kwah Ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me ; to ai ha nga ka jingjam bathymmai , namar me long uba hok .
translation.en: Behold , I have longed after thy precepts : quicken me in thy righteousness .

translation.kha: Kaei kaweh at mut ka long ba phin ym ïakhleh pynlang u brup uba khot ïa lade” u pansngiat hawei uba awria ne uba lalot ne kaba mane bleithaw ne uba kren-ïa sniew ne uba buaid ne u nongtuh . To wat ïashong bam lem bad kum uta u brai .
translation.en: But now I have written unto you not to keep company , if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator , or covetous , or an idolater , or a railer , or a drunkard , or an extortioner ; with such an one no not to eat .

translation.kha: Ngam pynkut noh ïa baroh ki kam sngewbha jong ka — ki jingkhawai ba man ka snem bad man u bnai bad ki jingrakhe ïa ka Sabbaton — bad ïa ki jinglehniam jong ka baroh .
translation.en: I will also cause all her mirth to cease , her feast days , her new moons , and her sabbaths , and all her solemn feasts .

translation.kha: U Trai un shah ba ki nongshun kin jop ïa phi . Phin tur pyrshah ïa ki na kawei ka dong , hynrei phin sa lui ïap na kiba bun ki dong , pynlang ki briew ka pyrthei kine sngewsheptieng haba ki ïohi Aiu ka jia ïa phi .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies : thou shalt go out one way against them , and flee seven ways before them : and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth .
But all the princes said unto all the congregation , We have sworn unto them by the  Lord  God of Israel : now therefore we may not touch them .
translation.kha: hynrei ki jubab ,  Ngi la pynlong ka jingkular bakyntang jong ngi ha ki ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel . Mynta ngim lah ban pynmynsaw ïa ki .

translation.en: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the  Lord s  lot fell , and offer him for a sin offering .
translation.kha: U Aaron un kñia ïa u  langsohmoh uba hap ha U  Trai  da ka jingkynting sbai , bad un kñia ïa u kum ka jingkñia namar ka pop .

Lada ka kti lane ka phet jong phi ka pynlong ïa phi ba-bang haw ne ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , to ot napoh Bad bret napoh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa pa ban rang sha ka jingim khyllem ka katei lane ka kjat ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki ktem bad ki kjat bad ban shah bret shapoh ka ding bymjukut .
translation.en: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee , cut them off , and cast them from thee : it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed , rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u la ong ïa ki sharati jong u , ‘ To khum ïa u bad ktha bad kjat , badno bret ïa u shabar ha kiba dum . Hangta un lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .’
translation.en: Then said the king to the servants , Bind him hand and foot , and take him away , and cast him into outer darkness  ; there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .

translation.kha: La thang ïa ki da ka jingshit tyrha kaba jur , bad ki la dem ïa ka kyrteng jong U Bela , Uba khong ka hab halor kine ki kham . Hynrei kim shym phai noh na ki pop jyllang ki pynlang ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .
translation.en: And men were scorched with great heat , and blasphemed the name of God , which hath power over these plagues : and they repented not to give him glory .

translation.kha: U Jubab u jubab , To U Trai un pynroi bun ïa ki dala Israel shispah shuh ban ïa kaba ki long mynta ! Syiem Kynrad , ki baroh ki dei ki sakhrai jong phi . Balei Phin kwah ban leh ïa khnai bad pynkit pop ïa ka jaitbynriew bhor kiwei ?
translation.en: And Joab answered , The  Lord  make his people an hundred times so many more as they be : but , my lord the king , are they not all my lord s servants ? why then doth my lord require this thing ? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel ?

translation.kha: Ko ki bani Jerusalem’ , to phet noh nangta ! thret don lait im na ka jingbitar shla jong nga .
translation.en: My people , go ye out of the midst of her , and deliver ye every man his soul from the fierce anger of the  Lord .

For , lo , they are gone because of destruction : Egypt shall gather them up , Memphis shall bury them : the pleasant places for their silver , nettles shall possess them : thorns shall be in their tabernacles .
translation.kha: Haba ka jingjot ka wan bad ïa ki briew la pynsakma , ki nong Ijipt kin lumlang ïa ki — kin lumlang ïa ki ban tep hangta ha Memphis ! Ki jingdon jingem jong ki kum ka rupa bad ki jaka ha kaba ki ïing jong ki shisien ki la ïeng yn tap da ki ñiut bad ki bniap shiah .
Haba U balui u pynbynta , uwei naba haka ban tei pat , Bad uno uba lai ban pyllait ïa u briew uba U Blei u la set byndi ?
translation.en: Behold , he breaketh down , and it cannot be built again : he shutteth up a man , and there can be no opening .

translation.kha: ( Hynrei u phria un hap ha ki khlaw , bad ïa ka nongbah yn pynjot . )
translation.en: When it shall hail , coming down on the forest  ; and the city shall be low in a low place .

translation.kha: U Trai u la krong ha nga shaphang ki hima , da kaba sdang na ka ibit .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles  ;

translation.kha: U Tiras uba synshar bad uba ïawad ïa ki Israel , U Trai Benabinadab Berakah , u don ïa kane ban ong : Nga long uba nyngkong , kiba khatduh , tang ma nga hi U Blei! ; ym khong iwei pah U blem hynrei thrang ma nga .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  the King of Israel , and his redeemer the  Lord  of hosts  ; I am the first , and I am the last  ; and beside me there is no God .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , ïa ka doh dei pun syang , bad bam ïa ka lem bad u kpu khlem thiat dara ki jhur kthang .
translation.en: And they shall eat the flesh in that night , roast with fire , and unleavened bread  ; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it .

For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings , and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Ka shadem jong u mrad ka long ka jingai kaba kyrpang , bad ka kjat-dien kamon ka long ka jingai kaba kyrpang kaba U  Trai  u la shim na ki paid Israel bad ban ai ha ki lyngdoh . Kane ka long kaba ki paid Israel ki dei ban ai ha ki lyngdoh pateng la pateng .
U buh ha khat eh ïa ki tnga khlur bad ki khun jong ki , nangta sa ka Leah bad ki khun jong ka , bad khatduh ïa ka Rakhel bad u Joseph hadien duh .
translation.en: And he put the handmaids and their children foremost , and Leah and her children after , and Rachel and Joseph hindermost .

translation.kha: Lem bad u , u wan u Onesimos , uta u para ba-ieit bad uba lah ban shaniah , umbiah dei na ka kynhun jong Phi . Keiñ ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kamai baroh kaba la jliah hangne .
translation.en: With Onesimus , a faithful and beloved brother , who is one of you . They shall make known unto you all things which are done here .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la jop ïa ki syiem jong film ki nongbat : ka Jeriel , ka Ai ( hajan Bethel ) ,
translation.en: The king of Jericho , one  ; the king of Ai , which is beside Beth–el , one  ;
But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year .
translation.kha: Kumba ka long , namarkata , ki jingkñia ainguh ki don na kawei ka snem sha kawei pat ka snem ban pynkynmaw ïa ki briew shaphang ki pop jong ki .

translation.en: Now there was an appointed sign between the men of Israel and the liers in wait , that they should make a great flame with smoke rise up out of the city .
translation.kha: Ki shipai Israel kiba kham ha khmat bad ki rangbah kiba don ha ka jakarieh ki la ïapynbeit ïa ka dak .

translation.en: O the hope of Israel , the saviour thereof in time of trouble , why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land , and as a wayfaring man that turneth aside to tarry for a night ?
translation.kha: Tang ma me , me long ka jingkyrmen jong ka Israel ; me long uta uba la pyllait im ïa ngi na ka jingpynjot . Balei me long kum u nongwei ha ka ri jong ngi , kum u nongleit jingleit uba sah tang shi miet ?

Ha kane hi ka sngi ka ri jong phi kan sah ha ki jingjot bad ym don mano mano ban shong ba Hukum ha ka . Ka la long ka jingïohi ba-ieit , bad ki bariew ki pyndonkam ïa ka kyr-ang jong ka kum ka jingtim , nongmareh U Trai um lah shuh haw ïa ki kam ba-bymman bad basniew jong phi .
translation.en: So that the  Lord  could no longer bear , because of the evil of your doings , and because of the abominations which ye have committed  ; therefore is your land a desolation , and an astonishment , and a curse , without an inhabitant , as at this day .

translation.kha: Kumne u syiem u ong ha u Abishai , U Sheba un kham pynjynjar ïa ngi ban ïa u Absalom . Khim ïa ki nongbah jongnga de bad leit thwet ïa u , lym kumta u lah ban leit shong shnong ha ki Shong ba la ker kynroh , Bad laiñ phet na ngi .
translation.en: And David said to Abishai , Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom : take thou thy lord s servants , and pursue after him , lest he get him fenced cities , and escape us .
They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly , saying , Peace , peace  ; when there is no peace .
translation.kha: Ki leh kumba ki jingmong jong ki briew jong nga ki long tang ki jingtrud . ‘ Baroh ka bit ka biang ,’ ki ong , haba baroh kam bit kam biang .

translation.en: I came not to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la wan ban khot ïa ki riewdonburom ban kylla-kaba-mut , hynrei ïa kiba la shah kyntait .

translation.en: And Jehu gathered all the people together , and said unto them , Ahab served Baal a little  ; but Jehu shall serve him much .
translation.kha: U Jehu u khot lang ïa ki briew jong ka Samaria , bad u ong ,  U syiem Ahab u la shakri ïa u blei Baal khyndiat , hynrei nga ngan shakri ïa u kham bun .
bad u ai ïa kane ka hukum riang ha u Hilkaïah , u Ahikam u khun jong u Shaphan , u Abdon u Kynhun jong u Mikaïah , u Shaphan , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , bad u Asaïah , u nongbud jong u syiem :
translation.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah , and Ahikam the son of Shaphan , and Abdon the son of Micah , and Shaphan the scribe , and Asaiah a servant of the king s , saying ,

translation.kha: Hadien kane , U Jisu pynlang ka kmie jong u , ki para shynrang jong u , bad ki synran ki la leit shaw Kapernam bad ki la sah hangta katto katne sngi .
translation.en: After this he went down to Capernaum , he , and his mother , and his brethren , and his disciples : and they continued there not many days .

translation.kha: Wat shim thala ïa ka kyrthat bakha jong nga , hynrei to ai ban pynkyntang khuid ïa na pynpdang ki Israel ; Nga long U Trai babha pynkyntang ïa phi ,
translation.en: Neither shall ye profane my holy name  ; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel : I am the  Lord  which hallow you ,
Their children that were left after them in the land , whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy , upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day .
translation.kha: U Solomon u pyntrei jubor ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki nong Kanaan ki bym shym la shah pynïap ha ki Israel mynba ki knieh ïa ka ri jong ki . Kine ki kynthup ïa ki Amor , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus , kiba ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki dang long ki mraw haduh kane ka por .
Pynban ki briew jong nga bad ma nga ngim lah shisha ban ai ei ei ïa me , namar kaei kaei baroh ka dei ka jingai sngewbha jong me , bad ngi la ai biang shiah me ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong me hi .
translation.en: But who am I , and what is my people , that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort ? for all things come of thee , and of thine own have we given thee .
And the  Lord  said furthermore unto him , Put now thine hand into thy bosom . And he put his hand into his bosom : and when he took it out , behold , his hand was leprous as snow .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kren biang ha u Moses ,  Bsuh ïa la ka kti shapoh ka jaiñkup jong me .  U Moses u la kohnguh ; bad ynda u sei pat ïa la ka kti , ka la ïoh jingpang kaba la tap da ki jingthohlieh , kum ka ïor .
Bad phi hi Phi tip , kumno u la pynshisha ïa ka jingkordor jong u , kumno ma u bad ma nga , kum u khun bad u kpa jong u , ngi la ïatreilang na ka bynta ka gospel .
translation.en: But ye know the proof of him , that , as a son with the father , he hath served with me in the gospel .

translation.kha: ( Ki synran jong u ki la la leit sha shnong ban thied jingbam . )
translation.en: ( For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat . )
And when the virgins were gathered together the second time , then Mordecai sat in the king s gate .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u syiem u la thung ïa u Mordekai ha ka kam synshar khadar .

translation.en: And the God that hath caused his name to dwell there destroy all kings and people , that shall put to their hand to alter and to destroy this house of God which is at Jerusalem . I Darius have made a decree  ; let it be done with speed .
translation.kha: To U Blei uba la jied ïa ka Jerusalem kum ka jaka ba yn mane ïa u , un pynjot noh ïa uno uno u syiem lane ka hima kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa kane ka hukum bad uba pyrshang ban pynjot ïa ka Templ hangta . Ma nga , u Darius , nga la ai ïa kane ka hukum . Dei ban kohnguh lut ïa ka .

U Mikaïah u jubab , Nga ïohi ïa ka kynruh shipai jong ki Israel ba ki sakma ha ki lum kum ki lbong khlaw u nongsharai . Bad U Tlai u ong , ‘ Kine ki rangbah kim ei nongïalam ; ai kin leit phai noh sha ïing da kabu suk .’
translation.en: And he said , I saw all Israel scattered upon the hills , as sheep that have not a shepherd : and the  Lord  said , These have no master : let them return every man to his house in peace .

translation.kha: Phi lah ban sngewthikna ba uno uno ibha ai dih wat Shi tukri ka umkhriat ha uwei uba rit tam na kine ki nongbanbor jong ar namar ba u dei u nongbud jngai nga , un ïohpdiang da shisha ïa ka bainong .
translation.en: And whosoever shall give to drink unto one of these little ones a cup of cold water only in the name of a disciple , verily I say unto you , he shall in no wise lose his reward .
I was a stranger , and ye took me not in : naked , and ye clothed me not : sick , and in prison , and ye visited me not .
translation.kha: nga la long u nongwei , hynrei phim shym la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ha ki ïing jong phi , nga la lyngkhuit , hynrei phim shym la pynkup jaiñ ïa nga ; nga la pang bad nga la don ha ïingbyndi , hynrei phim shym la sumar ïa nga .’

Tang mar ïarung ha ka nongbah , u Elihu u duwai , Ko Tlai , to pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong ki bad ai ba ktang ïohi . U Trai u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jngai u , u pynïoh pat ïa ka jingteinam jong ki , bad ki la ïohi ba ki lah da don hapoh Samaria .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when they were come into Samaria , that Elisha said ,  Lord  , open the eyes of these men , that they may see . And the  Lord  opened their eyes , and they saw  ; and , behold , they were in the midst of Samaria .
Let them praise thy great and terrible name  ; for it is holy .
translation.kha: Baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng kaba khraw bad kaba kynja syiem jong u . Uba Khuid long ma u !
Da leh husiar ! Kynmaw ba katba Phin dang im phim dem ban klet ïa katai kaba phi la ïew da la ki khmat .
translation.en: Only take heed to thyself , and keep thy soul diligently , lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen , and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life : but teach them thy sons , and thy sons  sons  ;

translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem Solomon u ino , Kawei pa kawei na phi ka kam ba u khuid uba ïalang im u dei u jong ka bad ba u khun ba la ïap u dei jong kawei pat .
translation.en: Then said the king , The one saith , This is my son that liveth , and thy son is the dead : and the other saith , Nay  ; but thy son is the dead , and my son is the living .

translation.kha: U Trai U Blei jongngi Phin un wan ïabam ïa phoi sha “kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti , bad un beh nala nangta ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba bun . Katba phi neng ïaid sha khmat , un Bah noh ïa ki hynñiew ki jaitbynriew kiba khim bun dala bad khnam khrawbor ban ïa phi . Kita ki den ki Hit , ki Girgash , ki Amor , ki Kanah , ki Pyrthei , ki Hiel , bad ki Jebus .
translation.en: When the  Lord  thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it , and hath cast out many nations before thee , the Hittites , and the Girgashites , and the Amorites , and the Canaanites , and the Perizzites , and the Hivites , and the Jebusites , seven nations greater and mightier than thou  ;

translation.kha: Hynriew lada ngim sngewthuh ïa ka ktien kabu la kren , u briew uba pynbudnam ïa ka un lama u nongwei ha nga bad nur long u nongwei ha u .
translation.en: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice , I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian , and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me .

translation.kha: Kumjuh da shisha nga long U Blei uba im , U Trai Nongsynshar u jong , Ka syiemsad ka para jong phar bad ki nongrit jong ka ktieh ju leh ïa ka jingsniew kiba ma pha bad ki nongot jong phad phi la leh .
translation.en: As I live , saith the Lord  God  , Sodom thy sister hath not done , she nor her daughters , as thou hast done , thou and thy daughters .

translation.kha: Ki dei ban siat ïa la ki jaiñkup bad baneh longïing kiba la khreh la shi sngi . Ha kata ka sngi ngan wan hiar ha u Lum Sinai ; ha kaba ki briew baroh kin ïohi ïa nga .
translation.en: And be ready against the third day : for the third day the  Lord  will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai .

translation.kha: Wat ïathiah shongkha Bad la ka pyrsa kurim
translation.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law : she is thy son s wife  ; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness .

translation.kha: Kumta ki briew jong nga ki ïawan paidbah ban sngap aïom me don ban ong , hynriew Kim ai satia ïa kaei kaba me ong ïa ki ba kin leh . Ki ktien ieit ki erlangthari ha ki rymmiang shyntur jrong ki , hynrei ki ïai bteng ha ki rukom khwan myntoi jongu ki .
translation.en: And they come unto thee as the people cometh , and they sit before thee as my people , and they hear thy words , but they will not do them : for with their mouth they shew much love , but their heart goeth after their covetousness .

translation.kha: Ngan pyrsad da ka mynsiem jong nga ha ki , bad keiñ im biah , bad ngan sa shah ïa ki ban im ha ka ri jngai ki hi . Te kin sa tip) ba nga long U Tlai . Nga la kylluid ba ngan leh ïa ken — bad ngan leh . Ma nga , U Trai , per la klun .
translation.en: And shall put my spirit in you , and ye shall live , and I shall place you in your own land : then shall ye know that I the  Lord  have spoken it , and performed it , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki nongbah kiba dei jong ki longsem na ka jait Benjamin ki long ka Jerikho , ka bthah Goah , ka Emek Kesis ,
translation.en: Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho , and Beth–hoglah , and the valley of Keziz ,

translation.kha: Phi un-long ki sakhi jong ngi , bad kumta U Blei ruh , ba ka jingleh jong ngi ïa phi kiba ngeit ka long kaba sngur , kaba den bad kaban khulom jingbabe .
translation.en: Ye are witnesses , and God also , how holily and justly and unblameably we behaved ourselves among you that believe :
I have written to him the great things of my law , but they were counted as a strange thing .
translation.kha: Nga la thoh ki jinghikai bym lah ñiew shuh na ka bynta ki briew , hynrei ki kyntait ïa ki kum kaei kaei kaba khyllah bad long nongwei .
to shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki . To sngap ïa ki na bneng bad to ai ha ki ïa ka jingjop .
translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven their prayer and their supplication , and maintain their cause .

translation.kha: Baroh ki briew Kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la sdang ban khñium , un u briew u la leit kum ibha shahshkor Khot sngewbha sha ka ïing jong u nongpop !
translation.en: And when they saw it , they all murmured , saying , That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner .

translation.kha: Kumta nga wallam mynsiem sha U Trai ïa u soh nyngkong na ka jingot ba u la ai ha nga .’ Naba buh ïa ka shang ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai bad miej hangta .
translation.en: And now , behold , I have brought the firstfruits of the land , which thou , O  Lord  , hast given me . And thou shalt set it before the  Lord  thy God , and worship before the  Lord  thy God :

translation.kha: Ai ba ki paid Israel kin ong , Ka jingieit jong u ka napoh bymtip .
translation.en: Let Israel now say , that his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: U Trai u la pynpaw ha phi ïa khie , don pynshai ha phi ba tang ma u hi u longïng U Blei , bad ba ym kein uwei pat lait na u .
translation.en: Unto thee it was shewed , that thou mightest know that the  Lord  he is God  ; there is none else beside him .
And they shall be eight boards , and their sockets of silver , sixteen sockets  ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .
translation.kha: Kumta yn don phra tylli ki jingker bad khathynriew tylli ki thliew tnaw rupa , ar ar tylli hapoh kawei kawei ka jingker .

translation.en: I have seen the travail , which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it .
translation.kha: Nga tip ïa ki jingkit bakhia kiba U Blei u la buh halor jong ngi .
U Trai u la pynpoh samthiah ïa phiah , malu phi kdang baneh ngat ha ka jingïohthiah kaba jreiñ . Ki nongïathuhlypa ki dei ban hir ki khmat jong ki briew , hynrei U Blei u la pynsat ïa ki .
translation.en: For the  Lord  hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep , and hath closed your eyes : the prophets and your rulers , the seers hath he covered .
Be ye therefore ready also : for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not .
translation.kha: Bad ma phi , ruh , phi dei ban long kiba la kloi , namar ba U Khun U Briew un wan ha ka kynta haba phim shym khmih lynti ïa u .
Haba phi peit ïa ki dur ha ei i kot lyngkdop , hato phi la ïohi kumno ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki riam ki beit haba ki sien sha ki jingïalang jong ki ?
translation.en: Have you noticed in the pictures in this brochure how well-dressed Jehovah’s Witnesses are when attending their congregation meetings ?
And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Haba u la dep ai ki jingkñia , u la kyrkhu ïa u paidbah ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh

translation.en: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves , and six curtains by themselves , and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle .
translation.kha: Bteng lang san tylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba kin long kawei ka jaiñ jingtap , bad leh kumjuh ïa ki hynriew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah ba kin long kawei pat ka jaiñ jingtap . Khylliap ar syrtap ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ kaba hynriew kaba ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ .

Kawei pat ka sur-thma ka jia ha Gath , ha kaba don u ramhah uba ne hynriew tylli ki shympriah kti ha katai khawai ka kti bad hynne tylli ki shympriah kjat ha kawei kawei ka kjat . U long kiba hiarpateng na ki rhah mynhyndai .
translation.en: And yet again there was war at Gath , where was a man of great stature , whose fingers and toes were four and twenty , six on each hand , and six on each foot : and he also was the son of the giant .

translation.kha: Nga la ïoh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U Trai . Ha ka , de ïohi ïa u ba u dang ïeng marsyndah ka kynroh ïa kaba la tei da ka jingïarap u Sawar , bad la don u sawar ha ka kti jongngi u .
translation.en: Thus he shewed me : and , behold , the Lord stood upon a wall made by a plumbline , with a plumbline in his hand .
He is chastened also with pain upon his bed , and the multitude of his bones with strong pain :
translation.kha: U Blei u sneng ïa u briew da kaba phah ïa ka jingpang bad pyndap ïa ka met jong u da ka jingshitom .
Naba u syiem u phar khor ïa u Siba , u sharak jong u saiwul , bad u ong , Nga ai ha u Mephibosheth , u ksiar jong u kynrad jong me , ïa baher kaba dei ka jong u Saul bad ka Long jong u .
translation.en: Then the king called to Ziba , Saul s servant , and said unto him , I have given unto thy master s son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house .
Moreover the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .
U Shimei , u khun jong u Ela : ka ri Benjamin
translation.en: Shimei the son of Elah , in Benjamin :

translation.kha: U Omri bad ki shipai jongki u ki mihnoh na Gibbethon bad leit kerkut ïa ka Tiphsah .
translation.en: And Omri went up from Gibbethon , and all Israel with him , and they besieged Tirzah .

translation.kha: Ym don ka jingsheptieng ha ka jingieit ; ka jingieit kaba jngai ka Beh nala ïa ka jingsheptieng baroh . Kumta te , ïa ka jingteh ym shym la pynjanai ha uno uno uba ïasheptieng , namar ka jingsheptieng ka don jingïadei Bad ka jingpynshitom .
translation.en: There is no fear in love  ; but perfect love casteth out fear : because fear hath torment . He that feareth is not made perfect in love .

translation.kha: hangta ruh kñia bad bam ïa ki jingweng ïasyllok , pynlang lehkmen ha khmat U Trai U Blei jongki phi .
translation.en: And thou shalt offer peace offerings , and shalt eat there , and rejoice before the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: U dieng Seeb u jubab , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa Phi , ngan iphuh sangeh ba-bang pynmih bymshemphang , ïa kaba la pyndonkam Ban pyndonburom ïa ki blei jong ngi bad ïa ki khunbynriew .’
translation.en: But the olive tree said unto them , Should I leave my fatness , wherewith by me they honour God and man , and go to be promoted over the trees ?

translation.kha: Haba u nongbylla sner , u bym dei u nongaplangbrot bad u bym dei lad ïa ki langbrot , u ïohi ïa u suri ba u ïan , u iehnoh ïa ki langbrot bad u phet noh ; kumin u suri u kynrup ïa ki langbrot malu pynsaphred ïa ki .
translation.en: But he that is an hireling , and not the shepherd , whose own the sheep are not , seeth the wolf coming , and leaveth the sheep , and fleeth : and the wolf catcheth them , and scattereth the sheep .
For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth .
translation.kha: Naba U Khrist u la pynkut ïa ka Hukum , khnang ba uei uei baroh uba ngeit u don ka jingïadei bad U Blei .
Nga sngewsynei ïa kine ki briew , namar ki la don bad nga la lai sngi bad mynta kim don ei ei shuh ban ïam .
translation.en: I have compassion on the multitude , because they have now been with me three days , and have nothing to eat :

translation.kha: A Katto ka un-long kaba shyrkhei ïa phiah , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi smat kabu’ ïa ki riewkhlaw bad phi knieh noh ïa ki ïng jrong ki , bad nangta phi pyn-i ïa ka jingduwai bajlan ! Namar kane , ka jingpynshitom ïa phi kan long kaba kham sniew !
translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye devour widows  houses , and for a pretence make long prayer : therefore ye shall receive the greater damnation .

translation.kha: U Isaak u la thung jingthung ha kata ka jaka , bad ha kata ka snem u ïoh ot shispah shahïap ïa kaba u la bet , Namar U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa u .
translation.en: Then Isaac sowed in that land , and received in the same year an hundredfold : and the  Lord  blessed him .

translation.kha: To kyrpad ïa U Trai ka jingot ba un phah ïa ki nongtrei ban ïalumlang ha ka jingngeit jong u .
translation.en: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest , that he will send forth labourers into his harvest .
And those officers provided victual for king Solomon , and for all that came unto king Solomon s table , every man in his month : they lacked nothing .
translation.kha: Ki khat-ar ngut ki lat jong u , uwei uwei ha u bnai ba la buh ïa u , ki pynbiang ka jingbam ïa u Syiem Solomon kaba u donkam ïa lade bad ïa baroh kiba bam ha ka ïingsyiem ; ki ju ïai pynbiang ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba donkam .

Ai ba ngan buh ha kane ka rukom : Erastos pa uwei na pa u ong ïa kaei kaei kaba ïapher . Uwei u ong , Nga bud ïa u Paul ; uwei pat , Nga bujli ïa u Apollos ; wai pud , Nga bud ïa u Petros ; bad uwei pat , Nga bud ïa U Khrist .
translation.en: Now this I say , that every one of you saith , I am of Paul ; and I of Apollos ; and I of Cephas ; and I of Christ .

translation.kha: Ka Adah ka la kha ïa u Jabal , uba dei u kpa tymmen jong kito kiba ri jingri bad kiba shong ha ki ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And Adah bare Jabal : he was the father of such as dwell in tents , and of such as have cattle .
We know that whosoever is born of God sinneth not  ; but he that is begotten of God keepeth himself , and that wicked one toucheth him not .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ym don uno uno napdeng ki khun U Blei uba ïai leh pop , naba U Khun U Blei u sumar ïa u , bad u Basniew um lah ban pynmynsaw ïa u .

translation.en: And out of one of them came forth a little horn , which waxed exceeding great , toward the south , and toward the east , and toward the pleasant land .
translation.kha: Na kawei na kine ki saw tylli ki reng la mih kawei ka reng barit , kaba ka bor jong ka , ka ïar shaphang shathie bad sha mihngi bad sha ka Ri ka Jingkular .
Ki jingthaw ba-im ki la shadong ban her bad ki shalyntem ki la leit Lem bad ki . Ka jingshai batyngshaiñ Jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei ki Israel ka don halor jong ki .
translation.en: Then did the cherubims lift up their wings , and the wheels beside them  ; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above .

translation.kha: Ngi ïateh tyngeh bad trei shitom , ñiar ngi la bah ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha U Blei uba im , uba long U Nongpynim ïa baroh bad khamtam ïa kito kiba ngeit .
translation.en: For therefore we both labour and suffer reproach , because we trust in the living God , who is the Saviour of all men , specially of those that believe .

translation.kha: U shah ïa u Tobiah ban pynkdang ïa ka kamra kaba heh ïa kaba la thmu tang ban buh ïa u kew jingkha bad ka jingiwbih , ki tiar ki thad ba pyndonkam ha ka Templ , ki jingainguh na ka bynta ki lyngngeit , bad kiba ba-shiphew na u kew , ka waiñ , bad ka bymshemphang Olib ba ai sha ki Lehab , ki nongtem nongput ka Templ , bad ki nongap phira ka Thep .
translation.en: And he had prepared for him a great chamber , where aforetime they laid the meat offerings , the frankincense , and the vessels , and the tithes of the corn , the new wine , and the oil , which was commanded to be given to the Levites , and the singers , and the porters  ; and the offerings of the priests .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan pynshitom ïa ki — Ngan khi ïa ki khlieh jong ki bad ngan ieh lynter ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion , and the  Lord  will discover their secret parts .

translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u shim uwei u maw bad u pynïeng ïa u kum ka jingsah jingkynmaw .
translation.en: And Jacob took a stone , and set it up for a pillar .

translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la iohi ïa kane ka kambah kaba U Jisu u la leh , ki la ong , Da shisha une u Long u nongïathuhlypa , uba la dei ban wan sha ka pyrta !
translation.en: Then those men , when they had seen the miracle that Jesus did , said , This is of a truth that prophet that should come into the world .
Not rendering evil for evil , or railing for railing : but contrariwise blessing  ; knowing that ye are thereunto called , that ye should inherit a blessing .
translation.kha: Wat siew kylliang ïa kaba sniew da kaba sniew lane ïa ka jingtim da ka jingtim ; pynban , to siew kylliang da ka jingkyrkhu , namar ka jingkyrkhu ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la kular ban ai ïa phi mynba u la khot ïa phi .

translation.en: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual , but that which is natural ; and afterward that which is spiritual .
translation.kha: Kam shym long kaba kynja mynsiem kaba la wan shuwa , hynrei kaba kynja doh , bad nangta kaba kynja mynsiem .
U hukum ïa ki , Man kaba kut ka hynñiew snem , angnud poi ka snem ban pyllait noh ïa ki jingkit ram baroh , pule jam ïa kano ka hukum ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
translation.en: And Moses commanded them , saying , At the end of every seven years , in the solemnity of the year of release , in the feast of tabernacles ,

translation.kha: ?(Nga la ai ïa ka shithi ha u Elasah u khun jong u Shaphan bad ha u jingïamareh u khun jong u Malkhaïah , ïa uba u Sedekaïah u syiem ka Judah u phah sha u Nebukhadnessar u shem ka Babilonia . Ka ong :
translation.en: By the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan , and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah , ( whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon ) saying ,

translation.kha: U Asa u pynsngewbha ïa U Trai , U Blang jong u , da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba dei bad kaba bha .
