translation.en: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of the  Lord  his God :

translation.kha: A to ïaroh ïa U Trai ! Suk tur u briew uba pynbun ïa U Trai , suba shadem sngewbha ha kaba kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Blessed is the man that feareth the  Lord  , that delighteth greatly in his commandments .
But wisdom is justified of all her children .
translation.kha: Pynban , ïa ka jingstad jong U Blei la pyn-i ba ka long kaba shisha da baroh kiba pdiang ïa ka .

Ki Kynhun ki kyrsiew u Jonadab ki la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u ban ym daiñ waiñ , bad haduh kane hi ka sngi ym don uwei ruh na ki uba dih ïa kaba kumno kumto mad ka waiñ . Hynrei nga la ïai kriah ha phi , bad phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga .
translation.en: The words of Jehonadab the son of Rechab , that he commanded his sons not to drink wine , are performed  ; for unto this day they drink none , but obey their father s commandment : notwithstanding I have spoken unto you , rising early and speaking  ; but ye hearkened not unto me .

translation.kha: Ha uta u lyoh bad ha “kata ka Duriaw la pynbitar ïa ki borbah kum ki nongbud u Moses .
translation.en: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea ;

And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel , I will search and take them out thence  ; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea , thence will I command the serpent , and he shall bite them :
translation.kha: Lada ki rieh ha khlieh u lum Karmel , ngan wad ïa ki bad kem ïa ki . Lada ki rieh na jong nga ha trai duriaw , ngan hukum ïa ki mrad duriaw bakynsha ban dait ïa ki .
Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop ba sha mihngi sha ka phyllaw bashapoh . U la thew ïa ka khyrdong bad ka la heh katjuh kum kiew pat .
translation.en: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east : and he measured the gate according to these measures .

translation.kha: Kumba u la jubab , Keiñ ka smat , te , ba uwei pa uwei u Nonghikai Aiñ babha long u synran hapoh ka Hima ki bneng u long khim u man jong ka ïing uba la sei shabar ïa ktien kaei kiba thymmai bad kiba rim pnah ka kamra kynshew jngai u .
translation.en: Then said he unto them ,  Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder , which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old .

translation.kha: Lada kin pdiang da ka dohnud jong ki baroh ïa ka niam jong ki briew jong nga bad kin shai , ‘ Kiba U Trai u im’ — kumba shisien ki la hikai ïa ki briew lad nga ban smai da u Baal — nangto ki ruh kin long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga ban kin manbha .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if they will diligently learn the ways of my people , to swear by my name , The  Lord  liveth  ; as they taught my people to swear by Baal  ; then shall they be built in the midst of my people .

translation.kha: Keiñ ai ha phi ïa ka jingïam — ka jingim kaba sngewtynnat mala kaba kmen .
translation.en: So shall they be life unto thy soul , and grace to thy neck .
Now therefore why should we die ? for this great fire will consume us : if we hear the voice of the  Lord  our God any more , then we shall die .
translation.kha: Hynrei balei ngin shu ïap ei ? Kata ka ding kaba ishyrkhei kan thang duh ïa ngi . Khlem pep ngin ïap lada ngi ïohsngew biang ba U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u kren .

translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is to hate evil : pride , and arrogancy , and the evil way , and the froward mouth , do I hate .
translation.kha: Ban pyndonburom ïa U Blei ka long ban isih ïa kaba sniew ; nga isih ïa ka jingsarong bad ka jingsngewmeng , ïa ki lynti bymman bad ki ktien lamler .
Lada ki kwah ban tip ei ei shaphang kano kano , ki dei ban kylli ha la ki thngan ha ïing . Ka long kaba i jahburom ïa ka kyntiap ban kren ha ka jingïaseng .
translation.en: And if they will learn any thing , let them ask their husbands at home : for it is a shame for women to speak in the church .
And when they had eaten enough , they lightened the ship , and cast out the wheat into the sea .
translation.kha: Hadien ba uwei uwei baroh u la bam kdang , ki la pynsting ïa ka lieng da kaba bret noh ïa u kew baroh sha ka duriaw .
Ki briew kiba ïaid khoh ki shongshngain bad sngewskhem , hynrei uba u bym lehhok un shah kem .
translation.en: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely : but he that perverteth his ways shall be known .

translation.kha: “Kane kan hir ka kabu ïa Phin ban ïathuh ïa ka Khubor Baasha .
translation.en: And it shall turn to you for a testimony .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ka jingïathong bad ph ha ka kyrtong u patsha . Ngan ai ïa phoi ar hajar thlia ki kulai lada phi lah shun shen katta ngut ki rangbah ki ban shong ha ki .
translation.en: Now therefore give pledges , I pray thee , to my master the king of Assyria , and I will give thee two thousand horses , if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them .

translation.kha: U la nang Manla , bad u la kylla long uba riewspah eh .
translation.en: And the man waxed great , and went forward , and grew until he became very great :

translation.kha: U Blang u ong , La slem bah nga la sngap jar ; ngam shym la jubab ïa ki bariew Jong nga . Hynrei mynta ka por ban leh ka la wan ; nga kyang dam kum ka kynteit kaba suh kha .
translation.en: I have long time holden my peace  ; I have been still , and refrained myself : now will I cry like a travailing woman  ; I will destroy and devour at once .

translation.kha: Sa shisien bapaw ki Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Trai da kaba mian ïa ki Abel bad ïa ki Astarte , lam bad ïa ki Blei jong ki Syria , jong ki Sidon , jong ki Moab , jongnga ki Ammon , nabar jong ki Philistia . Ki la iehnoh ïa U Trai bad ki la sangeh ba mane ïa u .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the  Lord  , and served Baalim , and Ashtoreth , and the gods of Syria , and the gods of Zidon , and the gods of Moab , and the gods of the children of Ammon , and the gods of the Philistines , and forsook the  Lord  , and served not him .
Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy , lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely , and lest they should say , Our hand is high , and the  Lord  hath not done all this .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngan ym shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban kren kob ba ki dei ma ki kiba la pynjot ïa ki briew jong nga , haba dei ma nga hi uba la khñiot ïa ki .’

Gera nangta ki ong ïa Kawei pat , ‘ To ïeng jngai na ngi , uba ngi long kiba khuid shaba palat ym bit ban ktah ïa ngi !’ Ngam lah ban shah ïa ki briew kiba Kum kita — ka jingbitar jong na pyrshah ïa ki ka longsem kum ka ding ka bym ju lip shuh .
translation.en: Which say , Stand by thyself , come not near to me  ; for I am holier than thou . These are a smoke in my nose , a fire that burneth all the day .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem jongki U blang u la rah ïa nga shajrong bad u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop mihngi jong ka Templ . Hangta hajan jong ka Khyrdop ar la ïohi laiphew san thut ki rangbah kynhied ïa u Jaasanaïah u khun jong u Asher bad u Pelataïah u khum jong u Benaïah , ki ar ngut ki nongïalam jong ka jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Moreover the spirit lifted me up , and brought me unto the east gate of the  Lord s  house , which looketh eastward : and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men  ; among whom I saw Jaazaniah the son of Azur , and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah , princes of the people .
And Saul answered , God do so and more also : for thou shalt surely die , Jonathan .
translation.kha: U Saul u ong ha u ,  Ai ba U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga lada yn ym pynïap ïa me !
U Jehoïada u ai ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam ïa ki sum bad ki shet kaba dei ki jong u syier ïaiban bad kiba la buh ha ka Templ .
translation.en: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears , and bucklers , and shields , that had been king David s , which were in the house of God .

translation.kha: Ki la shong la sah stong bun tei ïa ka templ ban donburom ïa me , da kabu Tip
translation.en: And they dwelt therein , and have built thee a sanctuary therein for thy name , saying ,

translation.kha: Keiñ ki long ki jingkyrkhu ba u Mosah , u briew jong U balui , u ai ha ki Israel shuwa ba un ïap .
translation.en: And this is the blessing , wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death .

translation.kha: te ïathuh ïa ki ba da shisha ngan skhem prais ïa ki , bad kun brup noh ïa ki shaei jngai na nga , ïa ki bad ïa ka nongbah kiba nga la ai ha ki bad ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , I , even I , will utterly forget you , and I will forsake you , and the city that I gave you and your fathers , and cast you out of my presence :

translation.kha: bad to ri ïa lade! ha ka jingneit U Blei , da kaba ap khmih ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trei jong ngi ha ka jingisynei jong u ban ai ha phira ïa ka jingtem bymjukut .
translation.en: Keep yourselves in the love of God , looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life .

translation.kha: Nangne ka thoh katto katne ki shithi , bad ka soi ïa ki ha ka kyrteng u Ahab , ka shongshit ïa ki da ka muhor jong u , malu ka phah ïa ki sha ki rangbah synshar bad ki riewpawkhmat ka Jesreel .
translation.en: So she wrote letters in Ahab s name , and sealed them with his seal , and sent the letters unto the elders and to the nobles that were in his city , dwelling with Naboth .

translation.kha: Ko Israel , pha long tang ka jong nga hi ; pha long ka jingong bakyntang jong de . Nga la phah ka jingshitom bad ka jingpynjot ha uwei pa iwei uba pynmong ïa pha . Ma nga , U Trai nga la kren .
translation.en: Israel was holiness unto the  Lord  , and the firstfruits of his increase : all that devour him shall offend  ; evil shall come upon them , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Mar ïakren ïa Kanah , ki Pharisi bad ki Saddusi ki la sdang ban ïakajia , bad ka kynruh ka la ïa-pait arliang .
translation.en: And when he had so said , there arose a dissension between the Pharisees and the Sadducees : and the multitude was divided .

translation.kha: Te me dei baneh ong ha u ba ma nga , U Trai , nga ong , ‘ U Israel u longïing u khun nyngkong jong ang .
translation.en: And thou shalt say unto Pharaoh , Thus saith the  Lord  , Israel is my son , even my firstborn :

And the city shall be accursed , even it , and all that are therein , to the  Lord  : only Rahab the harlot shall live , she and all that are with her in the house , because she hid the messengers that we sent .
translation.kha: Ïa ka nongbah bad baroh kiba don ha ka dei ban pynjot thiaw kum ka jingainguh ha U  Trai . Tang ïa ka Rahab ka nuti bad ïa ka longïing longsem jong ka yn pyllait im , namar ka la pynrieh ïa ki nongsyntiat jong ngi .

Ha ka por sep sngi u Joshua u ai ka hukum , bad la pynher noh ïa kita ki metïap bad bret ha kajuh ka krem ha kaba ki la ïarieh mawshun . La buh ïa ki maw kiba eh ha ka jaka rung sha ka balsam , bad ki dang don hangta .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the time of the going down of the sun , that Joshua commanded , and they took them down off the trees , and cast them into the cave wherein they had been hid , and laid great stones in the cave s mouth , which remain until this very day .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong ha ngi baroh , ‘ Ki khunlung ki ki jongno phi , kiba dang lung palat ban tip ïa kaba bha na kaba sniew , kin rung sha kata ka ri — ki khun ki kti kiba phi ong kin shah kurup ha ki nongshun jong ph . Ngan ai ïa ka ri ha ki , ban kin ïohkynti ïa ka .
translation.en: Moreover your little ones , which ye said should be a prey , and your children , which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil , they shall go in thither , and unto them will I give it , and they shall possess it .

translation.kha: Ki la don sawdong jong nga ha ki liang borbah ; hynrei ar la pynjot ïa ki da ka bor jong U Trai !
translation.en: They compassed me about  ; yea , they compassed me about : but in the name of the  Lord  I will destroy them .

translation.kha: kamut u Abimelekh u phah khor ïa u Isaak , bad u ong , Pdeng , ka dei ka tnga jong me ! Balei pat me ong ba ka dei ka na jong me ? U jubab , Nalor nga pyrkhat ïohi ba nga shah pynïap lada nga ong ba ka dei ka tnga jongki per .
translation.en: And Abimelech called Isaac , and said , Behold , of a surety she is thy wife : and how saidst thou , She is my sister ? And Isaac said unto him , Because I said , Lest I die for her .

translation.kha: Shah ïa nga ban kyrmen ïa kito na phi! kiba kwah ban im khoh ka Hukum : Hato phim ïohsngew aïu ka Hukum ka ong ?
translation.en: Tell me , ye that desire to be under the law , do ye not hear the law ?
Take heed now that ye fail not to do this : why should damage grow to the hurt of the kings ?
translation.kha: Leh ïa kane shisyndon , khnang ba yn ym don shuh ka jingma ïa ki jingthmu jong nga .

Haba u Gideon u ïohsngew shaphang ka jingphohsniew jong uta u briew bun ba ka mut kumno , u dem khohwah khrup Bad u mane ïa U thri . Nangta u leit phai pat sha ka jaka syier dara ki Israel , nabar u ong , Khie joit ! U Trai u ai ha phi ka jingjop halor ka kynjah shipawa jong ki Midian !
translation.en: And it was so , when Gideon heard the telling of the dream , and the interpretation thereof , that he worshipped , and returned into the host of Israel , and said , Arise  ; for the  Lord  hath delivered into your hand the host of Midian .
Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in these days , should it also be marvellous in mine eyes ? saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Kane ka lah ban i kum ka bym lah long ha kito ki jaitbynriew kiba dang sah mynta , hynrei kam long ka bym lah ban long ïa nga .
To bat ïa kaei kaba phi! ngeit shaphang kano ka Kam , hapdeng jong phi bad U Blei . Suk uta u briew u bym sngew ïa ka jingpynrem haba u leh ïa kawei kaei kaba u bishar ba ka long kaba dei !
translation.en: Hast thou faith ? have it to thyself before God . Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth .

translation.kha: Ym da donkam ba U Blei un buh por ïa ki briew ban leit bad ba yn bishar ïa ki da u .
translation.en: For he will not lay upon man more than right  ; that he should enter into judgment with God .

Behold , therefore I will gather all thy lovers , with whom thou hast taken pleasure , and all them that thou hast loved , with all them that thou hast hated  ; I will even gather them round about against thee , and will discover thy nakedness unto them , that they may see all thy nakedness .
translation.kha: Namar kane ngan wallam lang ïa baroh ki nongleh-ieit jong pha kiba mynshuwa — kito kiba pha la sngewtynnat bad kito kiba pha la isih . Ngan wallam ïa ki sawdong jong pha ha ka jylli , bad nangta ngan law ïa ki jaiñ jong pha bad shah ïa ki ban ïohi ba pha lyngkhuit .

translation.en: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine .
translation.kha: Ka jingthngan ka la pynlong ïa ngi ban ing da ka jingshit , tad haduh ba ka sniehdoh jong ngi ka long kaba khluit kum ka pajwa .
U Tom u ai ia ka jakashong jong u ha I tymmen kynthei .
translation.en: Tom gave his seat to an elderly lady .

translation.kha: U Dabid u don mynta ha ka jingma kaba khraw , namar ki briew jong u kiba la sngewkthang hato ki la duh ïa la ki khun ki kti bad ki byrngem ban lyngkhot maw ïa u ; hynrei U Trai U Blei jong u , u ai ha u ka jingshlur .
translation.en: And David was greatly distressed  ; for the people spake of stoning him , because the soul of all the people was grieved , every man for his sons and for his daughters : but David encouraged himself in the  Lord  his God .

translation.kha: Wat longing ong ha la ka dohnud , kine ki jaitbynriew ki kham bun paid ba-bang ïa ngi , kumno ngi lah ban beh ïa ki .
translation.en: If thou shalt say in thine heart , These nations are more than I  ; how can I dispossess them ?
I am as one mocked of his neighbour , who calleth upon God , and he answereth him : the just upright man is laughed to scorn .
translation.kha: Wat ki paralok jong nga ki rkhie ïa nga mynta ; ki rkhie , wat la nga long uba hok bad u bym shah kynnoh pop ; hynrei ka don ka por mynba U Blei u jubab ïa ki jingduwai jong nga .

sad u Moses u nong ha u Aaron , Shim ïa u kiaw buh ding jong phi , buh hangta ïa u rnga uba rhem na ka Eri , mala buh kyndiang ka jingiwbih halor ki rnga . Nangta leit rah kloi kloi ïa ka sha u paidbah bad pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta jong ki . Pynkloi ! Ka jingbitar U tharai ka la mih , bad ka khlam hima ka la sheng .
translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Take a censer , and put fire therein from off the altar , and put on incense , and go quickly unto the congregation , and make an atonement for them : for there is wrath gone out from the  Lord   ; the plague is begun .
And thither were all the flocks gathered : and they rolled the stone from the well s mouth , and watered the sheep , and put the stone again upon the well s mouth in his place .
translation.kha: Ha man ba ki kynhun langbrot baroh ki la ïapoi lang hangta , ki nongap langbrot ki ju pyntyllun sharud ïa uta u maw bad ki ai um ïa ki . Nangta ki buh pat ïa uta u maw ha kajuh ka jaka .

Nga lah ban don ka jingai ban ïalap da ka jingpyrsad mynhynne ; nga lah ban don ïa ka jingtip baroh bad shemphang ha ki jingteinam baroh ; nga lah ban don ïa ka jingngeit baroh kaba donbok ban pynkynriah ïa ki lumbah — hynrei lada ngam to ka jingieit , ngam erlangthari ei ei .
translation.en: And though I have the gift of prophecy , and understand all mysteries , and all knowledge ; and though I have all faith , so that I could remove mountains , and have not charity , I am nothing .
Then he said unto them ,  O fools , and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken :
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Katno kiba bieit phi long , katno phi long kiba suki ban ngeit ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ong !
bad thoh ha ki ïa kine ki ai malu ki hukum borbah . Ynda phi la rung sha said ka ri kabu tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap ba U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi u la kular ha phi ,
translation.en: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law , when thou art passed over , that thou mayest go in unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , a land that floweth with milk and honey  ; as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath promised thee .
And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason , saying , Who is this which speaketh blasphemies ? Who can forgive sins , but God alone ?
translation.kha: Ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ki la sdang ban ïakren para ma ki ,  Uei une u briew uba kren kum kane ka jingkrenbeiñ Blei ! U Blei u long tang ma u hi uba lah ban map ïa ki pop !
Ki bymsngewsynei ki la kem ïa ki mraw jong u , ki shoh ïa uwei , ki pynpaw ïa uwei pat , malade ki la lyndet maw ïa Uei pat .
translation.en: And the husbandmen took his servants , and beat one , and killed another , and stoned another .

translation.kha: U Job u leit bad u shong ha ka kynton ñiut bad u shim da ki saraw khiew ba la pait ban trud ïa ki tohjaw kiba don ha u .
translation.en: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal  ; and he sat down among the ashes .

translation.kha: Lydia u briew u wallam ïa ka langbrot khim ka jingsuh namar ka pop! , ka dem ban long ka langbrot ka bymïap don Kana kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering , he shall bring it a female without blemish .

translation.kha: Kata ka dei ka lyngkha Kaba u Amraphel u la thad na ki Hit , daym hangta ba la trep ïa u Abraham bad ïa ka tngit jong u ka Sarah .
translation.en: The field which Abraham purchased of the sons of Heth : there was Abraham buried , and Sarah his wife .

translation.kha: Phi de ban thaw ïa ki dur jong u thung bad ki duli khnai kiba la pynjulor ïa ka ri jong phi , pynlang phi dei pun ai burom ïa U balui ki Israel . Lehab un sa sangeh noh na kaban pynshitom ïa phi , ïa ki phai jongno phiah , bad ïa ka ri jong phi .
translation.en: Wherefore ye shall make images of your emerods , and images of your mice that mar the land  ; and ye shall give glory unto the God of Israel : peradventure he will lighten his hand from off you , and from off your gods , and from off your land .
And it came to pass , as the camels had done drinking , that the man took a golden earring of half a shekel weight , and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold  ;
translation.kha: Haba ka la dep ai um , uta u briew u shim ïa ka sati ksiar kaba remdor bad u pyndait ha ka khmut jong ka , bad u pyndeng ruh ar tylli ki khadu ksiar kiba heh ha ki ryndang-kti jong ka .
Nga sngew ba kaei kaba ngi shahshitom ha kane ka por kaba mynta , ym lah ban ïanujor satia bad ka brup ïa kaba yn sa pynpaw ha ngi .
translation.en: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us .

translation.kha: U Dabid u synshar ha baroh’ ka Israel bad u pynthikna ba ïa ki biria jong u yn lehbha bad lehhok borabor .
translation.en: So David reigned over all Israel , and executed judgment and justice among all his people .

translation.kha: To pynpdang ïa ka ha ka kyrteng U Trai , kumba ki briew jong U Blei ki dei ban leh , bad to ai ha ka ïa kano kano ka jingïarap kaba ka lah ngab donkam na phi ; namar ma ka hi , da latai ka long ka paidlang babha ïa kiba bun ki briew bad ïa nga ruh .
translation.en: That ye receive her in the Lord , as becometh saints , and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you : for she hath been a succourer of many , and of myself also .

And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army  ; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army  ; but he shall not stand : for they shall forecast devices against him .
translation.kha: Un pynmih da ka jingshlur ïa ka kynhun shipai bakhraw ban tur ïaleh ïa u syiem ka Ijipt , u ban pynkhreh ban ïaleh pyrshah da ka kynhun shipai babun bad bakhrawbor . Hynrei ïa u syiem ka Ijipt yn shukor bad un ym jop .

hynriew U Balei u la leh-isynei ïa nga khnang ba U Khrist Jehu un ïoh pynpaw ïa ka jingïaishah slem jong u ha kaba ïadei bad nga , umbah sniew tam na kiba pop , kum ka nuksa ïa kito baroh ki ban sa ngeit ïa u hadien bad ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymtip .
translation.en: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy , that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering , for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting .

translation.kha: Na uta u masi un shim noh ïa ka khleiñ baroh , ïa ka khleiñ kiba sop ïa ki snier ,
translation.en: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering  ; the fat that covereth the inwards , and all the fat that is upon the inwards ,

translation.kha: Ko kynhun u briew u la ong , phai khmat sha ki lem ka Israel , bad to ai ïa ka shukor Jong nga ha ki .
translation.en: Son of man , set thy face toward the mountains of Israel , and prophesy against them ,
For thou art an holy people unto the  Lord  thy God : the  Lord  thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself , above all people that are upon the face of the earth .
translation.kha: Namar phi long kiba la pynkyntang khuid sha U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . U la jied ïa phi napdeng ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka pyrthei ba phin long ka jaitbynriew kaba kyrpang jong u .

translation.en: And he spake this parable unto them , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi :

Kito kiba dang sah napdeng ki jaitbynriew kin long kum u sing uba wad jingbam ha ka khlaw ne ha ka khak bam phlang : U rung hapdeng ki langbrot , u kynrup ïa ki , sad tah lyngkhot ïa ki — bad hangta ym don jingkyrmen ban lait im .
translation.en: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the Gentiles in the midst of many people as a lion among the beasts of the forest , as a young lion among the flocks of sheep : who , if he go through , both treadeth down , and teareth in pieces , and none can deliver .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong phi ki manna ha ki dil malade ïa ki dak kba la pynkdang na ka bynta ka blei Asherah harud jngai uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam , ha ki kliar lum
translation.en: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills .
Every man according as he purposeth in his heart , so let him give ; not grudgingly , or of necessity : for God loveth a cheerful giver .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u dei ban ai , namarkata , kumba phi la kut jingmut , ym da kaba bynñiaw ne da kaba sngew kum ka kamram ; naba U Blei u ieit ïa uta uba ai da kaba kmen .

translation.en: Behold , the Lord hath a mighty and strong one , which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm , as a flood of mighty waters overflowing , shall cast down to the earth with the hand .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u don ïa uta uba khlaiñ bad badonbor uba la kloi ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , uta u ban wan kum u phria bajur , kum u  lapbah , kum ka jingshlei um bakhlaiñbor , bad kan tap lup ïa ka ri .

U Dabid u la bthah ruh ïa ki ngab ong ha u Amasa , Phi dei u ba-bieit jong nga . Naduh mynta nga buh ïa phoi ban ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai ha ka jaka jong u Joab . To U Blei un shoh ïap ïa nga dalade ngam lai kumta !
translation.en: And say ye to Amasa , Art thou not of my bone , and of my flesh ? God do so to me , and more also , if thou be not captain of the host before me continually in the room of Joab .

translation.kha: bad nangta u thret ïa u lum ka Samaria da hynriew hajar ki sbai rupa na u briew umbiah kyrteng u Shemer . U Omri u la tei ka khup ïa u lum , u te ka shngain hangta , bad u khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka Samaria , da kaban pynbud ïa ka kyrteng u Shamgar , u trai ba-mynbarim jong uta u lem .
translation.en: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver , and built on the hill , and called the name of the city which he built , after the name of Shemer , owner of the hill , Samaria .
And the flax and the barley was smitten : for the barley was in the ear , and the flax was bolled .
translation.kha: U  saihon bad u barli ki la duh khoit , namar u barli u la ih bad u  saihon pat u dang shylluit .
U ban pyntylli ïa ki jemnud batlot jongno ngi bad pynlong ïa ki kum ka met ba-dap da ka burom jong u hi , da kata ka bor da kaba u haka ban wallam ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh ka jingsynshar jongno u .
translation.en: Who shall change our vile body , that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body , according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself .

translation.kha: kaba long ka snem kaban khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea , u patsha ka Assyria u kurup ïa ka Samaria , u rah ïa ki Israel sha Assyria kum ki koidi , dara pynsah katto Katno lwet na ki ha ka nongjop Halah , katto katne pang hajan ka wah Habor ha ka distrik Gosan , bad katto kattne ha ki nongbah jong ka Media .
translation.en: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria , and carried Israel away into Assyria , and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan , and in the cities of the Medes .
And they shall turn away their ears from the truth , and shall be turned unto fables .
translation.kha: Kin phai noh na kaba shahshkor ïa ka jingshisha bad kin pynleit jingmut ha ki puriskam kai .
U Kpa u ieid ïa la U Khun bad u la buh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha ka leh jong u .
translation.en: The Father loveth the Son , and hath given all things into his hand .
But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him , and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need , in that which he wanteth .
translation.kha: pynban , to long kiba kylluid mynsiem bad ai kylliang ïa u kat kaba u donkam .
Namar ba la palat ka jingthain , phin hap bam sa ïa la ki jongki ki khun .
translation.en: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons , and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi kohnguh ïa u , bad leh katba ïa kaba nga suda , ngan ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Nongshun jongnga phi baroh .
translation.en: But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice , and do all that I speak  ; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies , and an adversary unto thine adversaries .

translation.kha: Ki Pharisi ki la leit noh bad ki la pynlong ka jingshitom ban riam ïa U Jisu da ki jingkylli .
translation.en: Then went the Pharisees , and took counsel how they might entangle him in his talk .

translation.kha: Hib ka por ka la nang jan na ka bynta U Blei ban bat ïa ka kular kaba u la kular ha u Abraham , ka jingdon jong ki briew jongngi ngi ha Ijipt ka la roi bun shah .
translation.en: But when the time of the promise drew nigh , which God had sworn to Abraham , the people grew and multiplied in Egypt ,

translation.kha: U shimti ïa la u diengduh bad u tur syn tylli ki maw uba jlih na ka wahduid bad u thep ïa ki ha ka pla kieng jong u . Lem bad ka jingshat maw ha kti , u tur ban ïadih ïa u Goliath .
translation.en: And he took his staff in his hand , and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook , and put them in a shepherd s bag which he had , even in a scrip  ; and his sling was in his hand : and he drew near to the Philistine .

translation.kha: Hukum ïa ki ban lumrit ïa ka bam baroh ha kine ki snem Ibbah pahuh , bad ai kuna ïa ki ban jingkynshew ïa u kew ha ki nongbah bad ban da buh nongap ïa u .
translation.en: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come , and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh , and let them keep food in the cities .

translation.kha: Kane ka longkmie mynta ka sien kaba lai ba nga wan jngoh ïa phi . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Ïa kano kano ka jingmudui dei ban pynksan da ka jingpynshisha da ki ar ngut ki sakhi ne tam ïa kata .
translation.en: This is the third time I am coming to you . In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established .

translation.kha: U Blei un ai ha ngi ka spah , ka burom bad ka jingdonkam jingem , ho-oid baroh kaba ngi kwah , isynei un ym shahïap ïa ngi pun ïoh lehkmen ïa ka . Pynban uwei pah u nongrwai un ïoh lehkmen ïa ka . Ka long ka bymmyntoi , bad ka shu longïng ka bym dei .
translation.en: A man to whom God hath given riches , wealth , and honour , so that he wanteth nothing for his soul of all that he desireth , yet God giveth him not power to eat thereof , but a stranger eateth it : this is vanity , and it is an evil disease .

translation.kha: U phah khot ïa u Elishama , u rangbah synshar uba dat peit ïa ka ïingsyiem , u Shebna , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , mala ki lyngdoh kiba ha shuwa jong u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah u khun jongngi u Amaw . Ki ruh ki phong da ki jaiñ khihwin .
translation.en: And he sent Eliakim , which was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and the elders of the priests , covered with sackcloth , to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz .

translation.kha: Haba u syiem Solomon u la thep ban ïaboi , ka ding ka wan hiar na bteng Bad ka Thang duh ïa ki jingkñia kiba la ainguh , bad ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdeng ryngkat U Trai ka pyndap ïa ka Thep .
translation.en: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying , the fire came down from heaven , and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices  ; and the glory of the  Lord  filled the house .

translation.kha: Ki dohkha kin ïap , bad ka wah kan sa iwtung eh kat haduh ba ki nongïeng Ijipt kin ym nud ban ieh um na ka .’
translation.en: And the fish that is in the river shall die , and the river shall stink  ; and the Egyptians shall lothe to drink of the water of the river .

translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , batskhem ïa la ka jingstad bad ka jingsngewthuh . Wat shah lano lano ba kin lehse noh na phi .
translation.en: My son , let not them depart from thine eyes : keep sound wisdom and discretion :

translation.kha: Nangta ki la thain pansngiat na ki tnat ba kein shiah bad ki la buh ïa ka Hamor ka khlieh jong u , bad ki la buh ïa u dieng ha ka kti kamon jong u ; nangta ki la dem khohsiew ha khmat jong u bad ki la kren ibeiñ ïa u . Im sleit u Shimei ki Jehu ! ki la ong .
translation.en: And when they had platted a crown of thorns , they put it upon his head , and a reed in his right hand : and they bowed the knee before him , and mocked him , saying , Hail , King of the Jews !

translation.kha: Nangta ka jingshai bapynjot ka iehnoh ïa ka nongbah bad ka la rupa sha u lumbah ha ka phang mihngi jyllang ka .
translation.en: And the glory of the  Lord  went up from the midst of the city , and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngkhuh sad ki thnam ki synran ki la pynkohnguh ïa u paidbah ban kyrthep ïa u Pilat ban pyllait ïa u Barabbas bad ïa-ban pyndap ïa U Jehu .
translation.en: But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas , and destroy Jesus .

translation.kha: U Abraham u ong , A thri , wat bitar ba ngan kren biang . Kumba lama don tang laiphew ngut ? U nong , Ngan ym leh ei ei ïa ka dalade nga shem laiphew ngut hangta .
translation.en: And he said unto him , Oh let not the Lord be angry , and I will speak : Peradventure there shall thirty be found there . And he said , I will not do it , if I find thirty there .

translation.kha: Shadkmen ha khmat jong u Haneng , lem bad ki khun ki ktah jong phi , ki Sikhri shakor jong Phin , malade ki Lebi babha shong ha ki shang jong phi ; to kynmaw ba ki Loit kim Don bnai kein khihwin la ka jong .
translation.en: And ye shall rejoice before the  Lord  your God , ye , and your sons , and your daughters , and your menservants , and your maidservants , and the Levite that is within your gates  ; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you .
And when his servants told David these words , it pleased David well to be the king s son in law : and the days were not expired .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u Saul ki leit ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa kaba u Saul u la ong , bad u Dabid u sngewbha ïa ka jingpyrkhat ba un sa long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem . Ha ka sngi shuwa ka jingkyntiew kurim ,
Uwei bapaw u la nguh , ‘ Nga dang shu shongkurim , bad na kata ka daw ma lah ban wan .’
translation.en: And another said , I have married a wife , and therefore I cannot come .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la kyntait ïa ka ri kaba itynnat , namsop ba kim ngeit ïa ka soskular U Blei .
translation.en: Yea , they despised the pleasant land , they believed not his word :

translation.kha: Ka jingangnud kabu khraw tam jong ngi ka long ba uwei pa uwei na phi un don ka jingthrang kaba ïaineh shuh kaba kut , kumta ba kiei kiew Ibbah phi kyrmen kin wanlam urlong .
translation.en: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end :
The Lord said unto my Lord , Sit thou on my right hand , till I make thine enemies thy footstool ?
translation.kha: ‘ U Trai u la ong ha U Trai jong nga : To shong hangne ha ka liang ka mon jong nga tad haduh ba ngan buh ïa ki nongshun jong me hapoh ki kjat jong me .’
U Trai u nong ïa ka Jerusalem , Ngi pynlong ïa ki ban mane pat — ïa ka Sodom bad ki nongrit jong ka bad ka Samaria bad ki nongrit jong ka . Haoid tun pynbha ïa pha ruh .
translation.en: When I shall bring again their captivity , the captivity of Sodom and her daughters , and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters , then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them :

translation.kha: Ïa ki kynroh bakhlaiñ jong ka Babilon yn pyntwa haduh khyndew , bad ïa ki khyrdop bajngum Jong ka yn step noh . Ka jingtrei jong ki jaitbynriew Baroh kam longïing ei ei ; ki jingpyrshang jyllang ki , ki kut ha ka dang . Ma nga , U Trai Badonbor Berakah to la kren .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The broad walls of Babylon shall be utterly broken , and her high gates shall be burned with fire  ; and the people shall labour in vain , and the folk in the fire , and they shall be weary .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ki jingpyniwbih baroh jong ka pyrthei kin tip ba tang U Trai hi u longïing U Blei — ym ni uwei pat .
translation.en: That all the people of the earth may know that the  Lord  is God , and that there is none else .

translation.kha: Nangta la kha sa ïa u la jong u , kiba don saisaw ha ka kti jong u , bad la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Serah .
translation.en: And afterward came out his brother , that had the scarlet thread upon his hand : and his name was called Zerah .
Command the priests that bear the ark of the testimony , that they come up out of Jordan .
translation.kha: ban hukum ïa ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ban wan kiew noh na ka Jordan .
To ïaroh ïa U Trai’ ! To ïarieh ïa U Trai na bneng , phi kiba im ha ki jaka bakynjang shajrong .
translation.en: Praise ye the  Lord . Praise ye the  Lord  from the heavens : praise him in the heights .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Ahab u ong ha u Naboth , Ai noh ïa kane ka bri sohwaiñ jong me ha nga ba ngan pynlong ka kper jhur ïa ka , namar ka don harud ka ïingsyiem jong nga . Teng ai wer ïa me da ka bnai sohwaiñ kaba khap babha ha ka jaka jong ka , lane , lada me sngewdei , nur da siewdor Kaba biah ïa ka .
translation.en: And Ahab spake unto Naboth , saying , Give me thy vineyard , that I may have it for a garden of herbs , because it is near unto my house : and I will give thee for it a better vineyard than it  ; or , if it seem good to thee , I will give thee the worth of it in money .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , kaban dei ka sngi Sabbaton , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la ïakynduh ïa U Palat
translation.en: Now the next day , that followed the day of the preparation , the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate ,

translation.kha: Ka jingsawa ka tur hajuh ka nang jam na kum . U Moses u la kren , bad U Blei u jubab ïa u ha ka sur u pyrthat .
translation.en: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long , and waxed louder and louder , Moses spake , and God answered him by a voice .

translation.kha: Lada isangsot uno u ïalamwir ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa phi bad rah ïa phi shiah ka ïingbishar , to ni ïa kaba bha tam ban ïapynbeit ïa ka jingïakajia badno u ha shuwa ba phin poi sha ka ïingbishar . Lydia phim lai kumta , un tan ïa phoi ha khmat u nongbishar , u ban aiti ïa pa’ ha ki nongap phira , bad ïa phi yn buh ha ka bynriew .
translation.en: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate , as thou art in the way , give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him  ; lest he hale thee to the judge , and the judge deliver thee to the officer , and the officer cast thee into prison .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kaei naba nga ong ; pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba nga nong ha phi .
translation.en: Give ye ear , and hear my voice  ; hearken , and hear my speech .

translation.kha: Te uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop bashabar shatei khah ha khmat ka Templ . Katba sa dang khmih , nga la ïohi ba ïa ka Templ U Trai la pyndap da ka jingshai ba-thaba jong ka Jingdon ryngkat jyllang u .
translation.en: Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house : and I looked , and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  filled the house of the  Lord  : and I fell upon my face .
And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath , as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u tur ïaleh ïa u syiem Hadadeser jong ka jylla Sobah jong ka Syria , kaba hajan ka ri Hamath , namar u Hadadeser u la pyrshang ban jop ïa ka ri kaba shaphang shaneng ka Ïuphratis .

translation.en: And honour not his father or his mother , he shall be free . Thus have ye made the commandment of God of none effect by your tradition .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom phi ñiewbeiñ ïa ka hukum jong U Blei , khnang ban bud ïa la ka jong ka jinghikai .
To phai sha U Trai bad duwai ha u , mynta ba u don hajan .
translation.en: Seek ye the  Lord  while he may be found , call ye upon him while he is near :

translation.kha: Ka Neiel ka la kham jur , dara ka la saphriang ïa ka ri baroh kawei , u Jehoshaphat u la plie ïa kita ki ïing jingkynshew jingbam baroh , bad u la die kew ha ki nongïeng Ijipt .
translation.en: And the famine was over all the face of the earth : And Joseph opened all the storehouses , and sold unto the Egyptians  ; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Yn sa rong noh ïa ki kumba kit da ka lyer , mala kin sa Shah ka jinglehrain namar ba ki kñia ha ki beit thala .
translation.en: The wind hath bound her up in her wings , and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices .

translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , U Mynsiem u la shimti ïa nga . Hangta ha bneng la don ka khet bun la don uwei uba shong hiar jong ka .
translation.en: And immediately I was in the spirit : and , behold , a throne was set in heaven , and one sat on the throne .
When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him , they cried out , saying , Crucify him , crucify him . Pilate saith unto them , Take ye him , and crucify him : for I find no fault in him .
translation.kha: Haba ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongap phira jong ka Templ ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la pyrta jam ,  Sahnarphna ïa u ! Sahnarphna ïa u !  U Pilat u la ong ha ki ,  Shim noh ma phi ïa u , te , bad sahnarphna ïa u . Ngam lap daw ei ei ïa ka ban pynrem ïa u .
A Tharai , map ïa ki briew jong me , ki Israel , ïa kiba me la pyut na Ijipt . Map ïa ngi mala wat pynkit pop ha ngi namar ka jingpynïap ïa uta uba lui lui .’
translation.en: Be merciful , O  Lord  , unto thy people Israel , whom thou hast redeemed , and lay not innocent blood unto thy people of Israel s charge . And the blood shall be forgiven them .
And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies  ; and power was given unto him to continue forty and two months .
translation.kha: Ïa u mradkhlaw la shah ban pynlong ki jingkob sarong kiba long ki jingbeiñ ïa U Blei , bad la shah ïa u ban don ka bor synshar haduh sawphew ar bnai .

Nangta nga la ïasngew ïa kawei pat ka sur na bneng , ka da ong , To mihnoh , ko ki briew jong nga ! To mihnoh na ka ! Phim dei ba ïaishah bynta ha ki pop jong ka ; phim dei ban ïoh bynta ha ka jingshah pynïapmat jong ka !
translation.en: And I heard another voice from heaven , saying , Come out of her , my people , that ye be not partakers of her sins , and that ye receive not of her plagues .
And thou shalt take no gift : for the gift blindeth the wise , and perverteth the words of the righteous .
translation.kha: Wat bamsap , naba kaba bamsap ka pynmatlah ïa ki briew ban ym ïohi shuh ïa kata kaba dei , bad ka pynduh ïa ka nia jong kiba lui lui .

translation.en: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh , beside the land of Gilead and Bashan , which were on the other side Jordan  ;
translation.kha: Dei namar kata ba u Manasseh u ïoh shiphew bynta nalor ka Gilead bad ka Bashan ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan ,

translation.en: And Joseph said unto his father , They are my sons , whom God hath given me in this place . And he said , Bring them , I pray thee , unto me , and I will bless them .
translation.kha: U Joseph u jubab ,  Kine ki dei ki khun jong nga kiba U Blei u la ai ïa nga hangne ha Ijipt .  U Jakob u ong ,  Wan ïalam ïa ki sha nga ba ngan ïoh kyrkhu ïa ki .
Katba u pynrangbah pynsynjor u leit ban khot ïa u Mikaïah , u ong ha u , Baroh na kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïathuhlypa ba u syiem un jop bad phi ruh ka bha ba phin leh kumjuh .
translation.en: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him , saying , Behold now , the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth : let thy word , I pray thee , be like the word of one of them , and speak that which is good .
Therefore when they were gathered together , Pilate said unto them , Whom will ye that I release unto you ? Barabbas , or Jesus which is called Christ ?
translation.kha: Kumta haba u paidbah u la ïalumlang , u Pilat u la kylli ïa ki ,  Uno na kine phi kwah ïa nga ban pyllait na ka bynta jong phi ? Ïa u Jisu Barabbas ne ïa U Jisu uba la khot U Messaïah ?

translation.en: And their coast was from Aroer , that is on the bank of the river Arnon , and the city that is in the midst of the river , and all the plain by Medeba  ;
translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ki ka ïar shaduh Aroer ( ha ka tduh jong ka Them Arnon ) bad ka nongbah kaba hapdeng jong kata ka them bad kynthup ïa ka jaka padun baroh sawdong ka Medeba .
Hynrei ma me to da satia adkar ïa latai ha ki jingjia baroh ; to ïaishah shitom , trei ïa ka kam u nongïalap jong ka Khubor Babha , badno to pyndep ïa la ka kam baroh kum u shakri jong U Blei .
translation.en: But watch thou in all things , endure afflictions , do the work of an evangelist , make full proof of thy ministry .

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha ka jaka ba la khot Ka Maloi Khlieh , ki la sahnarphna ïa U Jisu hangta , bad ïa ki ar ngut ki nongleh mana runar , uwei sha kamai jong u bad uwei pat sha kadiang jong u .
translation.en: And when they were come to the place , which is called Calvary , there they crucified him , and the malefactors , one on the right hand , and the other on the left .

translation.kha: Mano ba la rai haduh katno kan heh ? Mano ba ring ksai halor jong ka ? Hato me tip ïa ki jubab Baroh ?
translation.en: Who hath laid the measures thereof , if thou knowest ? or who hath stretched the line upon it ?
But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon , and abode in the rock Rimmon four months .
translation.kha: Hynrei hynriewspah ngut na ki , ki lait bad ki phet ïap shaphang ri khlaw sha u Mawsiang Rimmon , bad ki sah hangta saw bnai .
wah ju kren ïa kano kano ka bymshisha . Kiar na kaba kren balamler bad na ki ktien kiba ïalam bakla .
translation.en: Put away from thee a froward mouth , and perverse lips put far from thee .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la sah” ïa u ksuid , malu u la mawkynroh shabar jong u khynnah , bad ha kata ka khyllipmat la pynkhiah ïa u .
translation.en: And Jesus rebuked the devil  ; and he departed out of him : and the child was cured from that very hour .
So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah .
translation.kha: Haba u Isaïah u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor jong u syiem Hesekaïah , u phah pat ïa kane ka jubab :

translation.en: I robbed other churches , taking wages of them , to do you service .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang trei hapdeng jong phi , la siew ïa nga da kiwei pat ki balang . Kum ban shu ong noh , nga la lute na ki khnang ban ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: How is the gold become dim ! how is the most fine gold changed ! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street .
translation.kha: Ka ksiar baphyrnai jong ngi ka la jngut ; ki maw jong ka Templ ki don ha ka jingsaphred ha ki lynti bah .

translation.en: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation : and thy gentleness hath made me great .
translation.kha: A Trai , Me ïada bad me pynim ïa nga , ka jingïarap jong me ka la pynkhraw ïa nga .

translation.en: Put me in remembrance : let us plead together : declare thou , that thou mayest be justified .
translation.kha: Ïa ngin ïaleit sha ïingbishar ; wallam ïa ka jingmudui jong phi ! Buh ïa ka kam jong phi ban pynshisha ba phi long ha kaba dei !
nalor ki khajna ba la sieh da ki nongsakhi , ki jingiehnoh na ka khaïi ka pateng , ka bai nguh syiem na ki syiem Arabia , bad na ki lat jrong ki dalade ha Israel .
translation.en: Beside that he had of the merchantmen , and of the traffick of the spice merchants , and of all the kings of Arabia , and of the governors of the country .

translation.kha: bad u Judas Iskariot , uba la kitkhia ïa U ijuh .
translation.en: And Judas Iscariot , which also betrayed him : and they went into an house .
And bring hither the fatted calf , and kill it  ; and let us eat , and be merry :
translation.kha: Nangta khie leit bad shim ïa u khun masi uba la pynsngaid bha bad pynïap ïa u , bad to ngin ïalehkmen da ka jingkhawai !

translation.en: Egypt riseth up like a flood , and his waters are moved like the rivers  ; and he saith , I will go up , and will cover the earth  ; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof .
translation.kha: Ka dei ka Ijipt , kaba shlei kum ka Nile , kum ka wah ba shlei ïa ki rud jong ka . Ka Ijipt ka ong , ‘ Ngan shlei bad ngan tyllep ïa ka pyrthei ; ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah bad ïa ki briew bashong hangta .

translation.en: The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus , when thou comest , bring with thee , and the books , but especially the parchments .
translation.kha: Haba me wan , to wanrah ïa ka jaiñkup ba nga la iehnoh ha Troas bad u Karpos ; wanrah ruh ïa ki kot , bad khamtam ïa ki kot ba la sop snieh .
U Solomon u shnong pyrshah tylli ki stieh kiba heh bun iehnoh kilo ka ksiang la pynbam ha kawei kawei ka stet .
translation.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold : six hundred shekels of gold went to one target .
So they turned and departed , and put the little ones and the cattle and the carriage before them .
translation.kha: Ki phai bad ki leit noh , bad ki khynnah , ki jingri jingdup , bad ki jingdon jingem jong ki , ki leit ha shuwa .

translation.en: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord  ; and a fierce king shall rule over them , saith the Lord , the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ngan aiti ïa ki nong Ijipt sha u nongsynshar lehbor , sha u syiem runar u ban synshar ïa ki . Nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .
Ki la ïa-ong per ma ki , Ngin ym syiem kano kano da kiba ngi lah ban kynnoh ïa u Daniel lymda dei kiei kaei kabu ïasoh bad ka niam jongnga u .
translation.en: Then said these men , We shall not find any occasion against this Daniel , except we find it against him concerning the law of his God .
Because Syria , Ephraim , and the son of Remaliah , have taken evil counsel against thee , saying ,
translation.kha: Ka Syria , lem bad ka Israel bad u syiem jong ka , ki la pynlong ka jingïasylla .
Ha ka por to baje U Jisu u la pyrta da ka jingpynjot bajam , Eli , Eli , lei Sabakhthani ? kambah mutlop U Blei jong nga , U Blei jong nga , balei ba me iehnoh ïa nga ?
translation.en: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice , saying ,  Eli , Eli , lama sabachthani ?  that is to say ,  My God , my God , why hast thou forsaken me ?
( Matthew 15 :30 , 31  ; John 5 :28 ) After Jesus died , God restored him to life as a spirit person .
translation.kha: ( Mathaios 15 :30 , 31 ; Ioannis 5 :28 ) Hadien ba u Jisu u la ïap , U Blei u la ai biang ha u ïa ka jingim ba kynja mynsiem .
Kam ju rung ha ki jingat jong ki ba ngan kynmaw ïa kane ka kam sniew bhor ; hynrei ki pop jong ki , ki jer sawdong ïa ki , bad ngam lah khlem da ïohi ïa ki .
translation.en: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness : now their own doings have beset them about  ; they are before my face .

translation.kha: U shim katto katne ka malai , ka dup , bad ka doh , mala u buh ïa kita ki jingbat ha khmat Jong i'u ki radbah . Hangta ha trai u diengthang u la pynbiang ïa ki da lade hi , bad ki la ïabam .
translation.en: And he took butter , and milk , and the calf which he had dressed , and set it before them  ; and he stood by them under the tree , and they did eat .
For I was an hungred , and ye gave me no meat : I was thirsty , and ye gave me no drink :
translation.kha: Nga la thngan , hynrei phim shym bsa ïa nga , nga la sliang , hynrei phim shym ai jingdih ïa nga ;

translation.en: When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba U Jisu un sdang ïa ka kam jong u , u Ïoannis u la ïalap ha ki paid Israel baroh ba ki dei ban phai noh na ki pop jong ki bad ban shah pynbaptis .

translation.en: And he made ready his chariot , and took his people with him :
translation.kha: Kumta u Pharaoh u pynkhreh ïa la ka kali thma bad ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong u ruh .
Hynrei u la phan ïa ki nonglamktien sha ki jait Israel barieh ban ong , Haba phi iohsngew ïa ka jingbhasbun ki turoi , pyrthuh jam , ‘ U Abiram u la long syiem ha Hebron !’
translation.en: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Israel , saying , As soon as ye hear the sound of the trumpet , then ye shall say , Absalom reigneth in Hebron .
Wherefore I beseech you , be ye followers of me .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , namarkata , ba phin pyrthuh bud ïa nga .

translation.en: And when they arose early on the morrow morning , behold , Dagon was fallen upon his face to the ground before the ark of the  Lord   ; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off upon the threshold  ; only the stump of Dagon was left to him .
translation.kha: Kum la shai dang step phyrngab ki ïohi ba u mot u la kyllon biang ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ha kane ka sien ka khlieh bad ki kti jong u baroh ar tylli ki la dkut bad ki don hamar ka jingkhang ; sah sa tang ka met .

translation.en: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge ,
translation.kha: Nga la thoh laiphew tylli ki jingkren na ka bynta jong phi . Ki kynthup ïa ka jingtip bad ka jingkyntu babha ,
Ym slem hadien , u paidbah uba pung u la ïawanlang . Haba ki briew kim don ei ei shuh ban bam , U Jeshua u la khot ïa ki synran sha u Bad u la ong ,
translation.en: In those days the multitude being very great , and having nothing to eat , Jesus called his disciples unto him , and saith unto them ,
And all the people saw the thunderings , and the lightnings , and the noise of the trumpet , and the mountain smoking : and when the people saw it , they removed , and stood afar off .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingtied u pyrthat bad ïa ka jingsawa ka turoi , bad ïohi ïa ka leilieh bad ïa uta u lum uba mih tdem , ki la kyiuh da ka jingsheptieng bad ki la ïeng noh sha jngai .
Ngi tip ba ka praw ka long naba kynja mynhyndai ; hynrei nga long u briew uba kynja doh , ba la dat kum u mraw ha ka pop .
translation.en: For we know that the law is spiritual : but I am carnal , sold under sin .
And not only so , but we glory in tribulations also : knowing that tribulation worketh patience ;
translation.kha: Ngi sngewsarong ruh ïa ki jingshah shitom jong ngi , namar ngi tip ba ka jingshah shitom ka pynmih ïa ka jingïaishah ,

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto thee , When thou wast young , thou girdedst thyself , and walkedst whither thou wouldest : but when thou shalt be old , thou shalt stretch forth thy hands , and another shall gird thee , and carry thee whither thou wouldest not .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Haba me dang samla , me ju long uba la pynkhreh bad me leit kat shaba me mon ; hynrei haba me la tymmen , men kner la ki jong ki kti bad uwei pat un teh un khum ïa me bad un ïalam ïa me sha kaba mem kwah ban leit .

translation.en: For they being ignorant of God s righteousness , and going about to establish their own righteousness , have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God .
translation.kha: Kim shym la tip ïa kata ka lynti kaba U Blei u pynlong ka jingïadei hapdeng ki briew bad ma u hi , bad pynban , ki la pyrshang ban thaw hi da la ka jong ka lynti ; bad kumta kim shym la pyndem ïa lade ha ka lynti U Blei ban pynlong ka jingïadei bad ki .
Ka burom bad ka main longsyiem ki ker sawdong ïa u ; ka bor bad ka jingit ki pyndap ïa ka Templ jong u .
translation.en: Honour and majesty are before him : strength and beauty are in his sanctuary .

translation.kha: Ki Briew ba la jied jong nga ki long kum ka sim kaba la shah puta ïaleh ha ki kbeit na baroh ki liang . To khot ïa ki mradkhlaw ban Wan bad ïasam boitha ha ka jingkhawai !
translation.en: Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird , the birds round about are against her  ; come ye , assemble all the beasts of the field , come to devour .

translation.kha: shna Kawei ka dabor rnga , kaba ka jingpynshong jong ka ruh dei da ka rnong . Buh ïa ka hapdeng ka Ïingjaiñ bad kata ka duwan , bad pyndap um ïa ka .
translation.en: Thou shalt also make a laver of brass , and his foot also of brass , to wash withal : and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar , and thou shalt put water therein .

translation.kha: U Jehosadak u la ïap sad la tep ha ka jingtap ki syiad ha Semaraim , bad u khun jong u , u Jeroboam Uba Ar u long skhem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Jehoash slept with his fathers , and was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel  ; and Jeroboam his son reigned in his stead .
Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing , that ye may abound in hope , through the power of the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: To U Blei , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingkyrmen , un pyndap ïa phi da ka jingkmen baroh bad ka jingsuk kaba long da ka jingngeit jong phi ha u , khnang ba ka jingkyrmen jong phi kan ïai san da ka bor jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: But thou , O man of God , flee these things ; and follow after righteousness , godliness , faith , love , patience , meekness .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , ko u briew jong U Blei , to kiar na kine kiei kiei . To ïaleh tyngeh ïa ka hok , ka jingriewblei , ka jingngeit , ka jingieit , ka jingïaishah , bad ka jingjemnud .
Kumta u Ibsam u ong ha u Lot , Ki bhabriew jngai me bad ki briew jongnga nga kim dei ban ïakajia , namar ngi ïalumlang shi ïing shi sem .
translation.en: And Abram said unto Lot , Let there be no strife , I pray thee , between me and thee , and between my herdmen and thy herdmen  ; for we be brethren .

translation.kha: Ki la ïadie pyrshah ïa ki Kanaan kiba shongneh basah ha ka nongbeh Hebron , ïa kaba la ju khot ka Kiriath Arba . Hangta ki la ïap ïa ki kur jongki u Jeshaïah , u Ahimaas bad u Talmai .
translation.en: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron : ( now the name of Hebron before was Kirjath–arba : ) and they slew Sheshai , and Ahiman , and Talmai .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba pha dei ka para jong sa ; Haneng ba na ka bynta jong pham kin shah ïa nga don im bad lehsbun ïa nga .
translation.en: Say , I pray thee , thou art my sister : that it may be well with me for thy sake  ; and my soul shall live because of thee .
But they made light of it , and went their ways , one to his farm , another to his merchandise :
translation.kha: Hynrei kiba la shah khot sngewbha kim suidñiew bad ki la leit sha la ki kam ki jam : Uwei sha ka lyngkha jong u , uwei pat sha ka dukan jong u ,
kane ka mut ba ki khun ba la kha kat kum ka rukom , kim dei ki khun jong U Blei ; hynrei , ïa ki khun ba la kha kat kum ka jingkular U Blei , la ñiew kum ki nonghiarpateng bashisha .
translation.en: That is , They which are the children of the flesh , these are not the children of God : but the children of the promise are counted for the seed .
And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban , and , behold , it was not toward him as before .
translation.kha: U la ïohi ruh ba u Laban um da leh jan shuh ïa u kumba mynshuwa .
Na u Simon Petros , u Shakri bad u Asaph jongngi U Jisu Kiriath — Sa kito ha kiba da ka hok jongngi U Blei jong ngi bad U ijuh Khrist U Nongpynim la ai ïa ka jingtieng kaba kordor kum ka jong ngi :
translation.en: Simon Peter , a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ , to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ :

translation.kha: Ha sngap ! kata ka jingsaiñ kaba jam ha ka nongbah ! kata ka jingbhasbun ha ka Templ , ka longkmie ka jingsawa U Trai uba pynshitom ïa ki nongshun jongno u !
translation.en: A voice of noise from the city , a voice from the temple , a voice of the  Lord  that rendereth recompence to his enemies .

translation.kha: U kynrad jong ka ïing un khie bad un khang ïa ka jingkhang ; nongtuh haba phi ïeng shabar bad sdang ban tied ha ka jingkhang bad ong , ‘ To pla ïa ka jingkhang na ka boitha jong I , ko kynrad !’ Un jubab ïa phi , ‘ Ngam ïa-ithuh ïa phi napoh phi ïawan !’
translation.en: When once the master of the house is risen up , and hath shut to the door , and ye begin to stand without , and to knock at the door , saying , Lord , Lord , open unto us  ; and he shall answer and say unto you , I know you not whence ye are :
And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain  ; yet he shall come to his end , and none shall help him .
translation.kha: Un pynïeng ruh ïa ki ïingjaiñ syiem kiba heh hapdeng ki duriaw bad ki lumbah ha kaba ka Templ ka ïeng . Hynrei un ïap , khlem don mano mano hangta ban ïarap ïa u .
Ha Ijipt u la pynïap ïa baroh kiba la kha nyngkong na ki briew bad na ki krad kumjuh .
translation.en: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt , both of man and beast .

translation.kha: Haba u briew u wan hajan u Absalom ban nguh ha khmat jong u , u Absalom u ju Kner la ki kti , u bat ïa u , bad u doh ïa u .
translation.en: And it was so , that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance , he put forth his hand , and took him , and kissed him .

translation.kha: Uwei uwei u kherub u don saw thylli ki ïathmu . Ka khmat ka nyngkong ka dei ka jong u masi kyrtong , kaba ar ka jong u briew , kaba lai ka jrong u sopti , bad kaba saw ka jngai u pukni .
translation.en: And every one had four faces : the first face was the face of a cherub , and the second face was the face of a man , and the third the face of a lion , and the fourth the face of an eagle .
Whom they set before the apostles : and when they had prayed , they laid their hands on them .
translation.kha: Ka kynhun ka la aiti ïa ki ha ki apostol , kiba la duwai bad buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki .

hynriew U Trai u tdong don ha ka nongbah ; u leh ïa kaei kaba Dei bad da lei lei mad em ïa kaei ka bymdei . Man ka thang khlem bakla , u wallam ka jinglehhok ha ki briew’ jong u . Bad pynban hangta ki briew bymhok ki ïai leh bymdei bad kim sngewlyngngoh .
translation.en: The just  Lord  is in the midst thereof  ; he will not do iniquity : every morning doth he bring his judgment to light , he faileth not  ; but the unjust knoweth no shame .
Laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come , that they may lay hold on eternal life .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom kin kynshew ïa lade ka spah ka ban long ka nongrim kaba skhem na ka bynta ka lawei . Bad nangta kin lah ban jop ïa ka jingim kaba long ka jingim kaba shisha .

translation.en: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned , it is the gall of asps within him .
translation.kha: Hynrei hapoh ka kpoh jong u ka jingbam ka kylla kthang , ka kthang kum ka bih .

To sumar bha ïa lade bun ïa ka kynhun barhem kawei ïa kaba U mynsaw Bakhuid u la buh ha ka jingsumar jong phi . To tharai ïa ka balang U blang , ïa kaba u la pynlong ka jong u hi lyngba ka jingïap ba aiti lut jongno u khun jong U .
translation.en: Take heed therefore unto yourselves , and to all the flock , over the which the Holy Ghost hath made you overseers , to feed the church of God , which he hath purchased with his own blood .

translation.kha: Ngan sngewsarong haba ngan ïohsngew ba phi kren ïa ki ktien ka jingstad .
translation.en: Yea , my reins shall rejoice , when thy lips speak right things .

translation.kha: Wat haba ki Israel ki la kham khlaiñ , kim shym la beh napoh ïa ki Kanaan baroh , hynrei ki la pynpyiar ïa ki ngab trei na ka bynda jong ki .
translation.en: Yet it came to pass , when the children of Israel were waxen strong , that they put the Canaanites to tribute  ; but did not utterly drive them out .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jingbabe Phibi ïoh kine ki jingtei bakhraw ? Ïa uwei u maw ruh yn ym iehnoh ha ka jaka jong u ; ïa uwei pa uwei na ki yn sa pynkitkhlieh noh .
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Seest thou these great buildings ? there shall not be left one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un wieh ïa la ka shynriah ti ha ka snam jong uta u mrad , un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka duwan , bad un theh ïa kaba sah , ha trai jong kata ka duwan .
translation.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger , and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering , and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering .

translation.kha: Te ha —kata kajuh ka miet ïa ka jingmaïan la pynpaw ha u Daniel ha ka jingïohipaw , bun u la ïaroh ïa U Blei ka bneng :
translation.en: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision . Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven .

translation.kha: Da shisha ym U Blei , u bym shem la tyngkai kam ïa la u jong U Khun hi , hynrei uba la ai sngewbha ïa u na ka bynta jong ngi baroh ! U la ai ha ngi ïa la U Khun — hato un ym ai sngewbha ïa kiei Kiei baroh ?
translation.en: He that spared not his own Son , but delivered him up for us all , how shall he not with him also freely give us all things ?

When I would have healed Israel , then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered , and the wickedness of Samaria : for they commit falsehood  ; and the thief cometh in , and the troop of robbers spoileth without .
translation.kha: Ha kano kano ka por ba nga kwah ban pynkhiah ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel bad pynlong ïa ki ban manbha sa shisien pat , baroh kaba nga lah ban ïohi ka long ka jingbymman jong ki bad ka kam sniew kaba ki leh . Ki shukor uwei ïa uwei pat ; ki rung jubor ha ki ïing bad ki tuh ; ki lute ïa ki briew ha ki lynti bah .

Ki jingsah jrong u ki long kiba shisha bad ibha hok ! U la pynrem ïa ka nuti kaban pynpyut ïa ka khyndew da ki jingawria jongnga ka . U Blei u la pynshitom ïa ka namar ba ka la pynïap ïa ki shakuriaw jong u .
translation.en: For true and righteous are his judgments : for he hath judged the great whore , which did corrupt the earth with her fornication , and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand .

translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki longïing ki sem don jingkitkhlieh bad kiba shetkylla ; ki lyngdoh ki pyntngit ïa kaei kaba kyntang , bad ki pynwan ïa ka aiñ jong U Blei sha ka jingmyntoi jong ki hi .
translation.en: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons : her priests have polluted the sanctuary , they have done violence to the law .

translation.kha: Shu ïong ïa ki ba me khappud ïa nga ban ym phah pat ïa me sha byndi ban ïap hangta .
translation.en: Then thou shalt say unto them , I presented my supplication before the king , that he would not cause me to return to Jonathan s house , to die there .

translation.kha: Myntan to sngap ïa ki ktien jingbatai jong nga .
translation.en: Hear diligently my speech , and my declaration with your ears .

translation.kha: U tei ka templ ïa u Baal ha Samaria , u shnong ka duwan na ka pyntha jongu u bad u nguh ïa ka ha ka templ .
translation.en: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal , which he had built in Samaria .
And the priest shall take the basket out of thine hand , and set it down before the altar of the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Uta u lyngdoh un shim ïa kata ka shang na phi bad buh ïa ka ha khmat ka duwan U  Trai  U Blei jong phi ;

Kumba ka dei ban erlangthari , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , mem shym lah ban kren ha phi wohnia nga kren ha ki brup kiba don U Mynsiem ; nga hap ban kren ha phi la kumba phi dei ki jongu kane ka pyrthei , kum kiba ïan khynnah ha ka jingngeit Khristan .
translation.en: And I , brethren , could not speak unto you as unto spiritual , but as unto carnal , even as unto babes in Christ .

translation.kha: Ha ki hynriew sngur , ma nga , U Trai , nga la thaw ïa ka bneng , ïa ka khyndew , ïa ka duriaw , bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ki , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew nga la shongthait . Namar kata , la U Trai , at la kyrkhu ïa ka Sabbaton , bad nga la Pynkyntang khuid ïa ka .
translation.en: For in six days the  Lord  made heaven and earth , the sea , and all that in them is , and rested the seventh day : wherefore the  Lord  blessed the sabbath day , and hallowed it .
Forbidding to marry , and commanding to abstain from meats , which God hath created to be received with thanksgiving of them which believe and know the truth .
translation.kha: Kiba kum kita ki briew ki hikai ba ka long ka bym dei ban shongkurim bad ban bam kyndiah ïa ki katto katne ki jait jingbam . Hynrei U Blei u la thaw ïa kito ki jingbam ban bam , hadien ka jingduwai sngewnguh , da kito kiba long kiba ngeit bad kiba la tip ïa ka jingshisha .
Dei shun ni uwei u shlur syntiew hapoh , ha trai jong ki lah jur ki tnat .
translation.en: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , and a knop under two branches of the same , according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick .

translation.kha: Nangta u Joab u la pham khubor sha u Dabid da kaba ïathuh ïa u shaphang ka thma ,
translation.en: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war  ;

translation.kha: Ki Bymman ki tei ki ïing kum ka snur thapbawa lane kum ka ïingtrep u mraw uba ap phira ïa ki lyngkha .
translation.en: He buildeth his house as a moth , and as a booth that the keeper maketh .

translation.kha: Hynrei haka ban weng noh ïa ka , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong shaphang u Moses : Ïa ka jingkah jong u la weng noh mynba u la phai sha U Trai .
translation.en: Nevertheless when it shall turn to the Lord , the veil shall be taken away .

translation.kha: Hato kane ka pynpaw kumba ngi pynsarong biang shaphrang ïa lade ? Hato ka lah ban long ba , kumba longïng lem kiwei ki briew ruh , ngi donkam ïa ki shithi pynithuh sha phi lane na phira ?
translation.en: Do we begin again to commend ourselves ? or need we , as some others , epistles of commendation to you , or letters of commendation from you ?
Or have ye not read in the law , how that on the sabbath days the priests in the temple profane the sabbath , and are blameless ?
translation.kha: Lane phim pat ju pule ha ka Hukum u Moses ba man la ka sngi Sabbaton ki lyngdoh hapoh ka Templ ki pynkheiñ shisha ïa ka aiñ sngi Sabbaton , pynban kim shah pynrem ?

translation.en: And thou shalt sanctify the breast of the wave offering , and the shoulder of the heave offering , which is waved , and which is heaved up , of the ram of the consecration , even of that which is for Aaron , and of that which is for his sons :
translation.kha: Haba la pynsleh ïa u lyngdoh , ïa ka shadem bad ka lbong jong uta u langbrot ïa uba la pyndonkam na ka bynta ka jingpynsleh dei ban pynkyntang sha nga kum ka jingai sngewbha bakyrpang bad kaba la buh kyrpang na ka bynta ki lyngdoh .
U Jakob u la kyndit thiah , bad u ong , U Trai u don hangne ! U don ha kane ka jaka , malu ngam shym tip ïa kata !
translation.en: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep , and he said , Surely the  Lord  is in this place  ; and I knew it not .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban peit bha baneh pynbiang ïa khie kaei baroh kaba U Blei jrong ka Bneng u dakmong na ka bynta ka Templ jong u , bad banbeiñ pynthikna un ym bitar ïa nga lane ïa pli ki banbeiñ synshar hadien jyllang por .
translation.en: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven , let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven : for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons ?
But and if thou marry , thou hast not sinned ; and if a virgin marry , she hath not sinned . Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh : but I spare you .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phin shongkurim ruh , phim shym la leh pop ; bad lada ka briew ka bym pat shongkurim ka shongkurim noh , kam shym la leh pop . Hynrei ngan jin da la kwah ban pyllait ïa phi na ki jingeh kiba man ka sngi ïa kiba kita kiba la shongkurim kin don .

Ïa uta u masi lyngkhot bad ïa uta nongshim ïa kiba la kñia kum ka jingkynjah namar ka pop , bad ïa kiba ka snam jong ki la leit rah shata ka Jaka Kaba Jehud Hano ban weng noh ïa ka pop , dei ban leit rah shabi ka jaka shong dara bad thang ïa ki hangta . Ïa ka snieh , ka doh , malu ki snier jong ki ruh dei ban thang lang hangtai .
translation.en: And the bullock for the sin offering , and the goat for the sin offering , whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place , shall one carry forth without the camp  ; and they shall burn in the fire their skins , and their flesh , and their dung .
Or speak to the earth , and it shall teach thee : and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee .
translation.kha: pan ïa ka jingstad na ki jingthaw ba-im ha khyndew bad ha duriaw .

translation.en: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases , and cast out many devils  ; and suffered not the devils to speak , because they knew him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la pynkhiah bun kiba pang na ki jait jingpang kiba bun bad beh noh ïa kiba bun ki ksuid . Um shah ba ki ksuid kin kren ei ei , namar ki la tip u long uei .
U Abner bad ki brai jongno u ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka To Jordan barieh shuh mut ; ki jam ïa ka oh Johanan , bad hadien ba ki la ïaid baroh shi step ha ka step kaba bud , ki la ïan poi biang ha Mahanaim .
translation.en: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain , and passed over Jordan , and went through all Bithron , and they came to Mahanaim .

translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba nga la phah ïa u Timothi . Ngam lah shah shuh , kamut nga la phah ïa u ban tip shapoh ka jingngeit jong phi . Da shisha kam lai ban long ba u Ksuid u la pynshoi ïa phi bad ba ka kam jongu ngi baroh ka la long kaba lehnoh-ei !
translation.en: For this cause , when I could no longer forbear , I sent to know your faith , lest by some means the tempter have tempted you , and our labour be in vain .
I saw the film last week .
translation.kha: Nga Iohi ia ka film mynshem taiew .
Keiñ ka lama kaei kaba nga ïong : Shah ïa U Mynsngi ba un pynïaid ïa ki jingim jong phi , bad phin ym pynhun ïa ki jingkwah krai jongno ka dohnud .
translation.en: This I say then , Walk in the Spirit , and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh .

translation.kha: Ïa ki jingdoh la sam ha ki khuri ksiar , kiba ïapher dur kawei na kawei patan , bad u syep u la ai pahuh ïa ka waiñ jong u .
translation.en: And they gave them drink in vessels of gold , ( the vessels being diverse one from another , ) and royal wine in abundance , according to the state of the king .
The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured , It is the sabbath day : it is not lawful for thee to carry thy bed .
translation.kha: Kane ka la jia ha ka sngi Sabbaton , kumta ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la ong ïa uta u briew uba la ïohkhiah ,  Kane ka dei ka sngi Sabbaton , bad ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ïa me ban rah ïa la ka jingthiah .

Ki nongaikam jong ka nongbah Soan ki dei ki bieit ! Ki briew kiba stad tam jong ka Ijipt ki ai ka jingshai jingot ba khlem pyrkhat Bha ! Kumno ki nud ban ïathuh ïa u syiem ba ki dei ki nongmih bujli ïa ki riewstad hyndai mala ïa ki sahmiet ?
translation.en: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools , the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish : how say ye unto Pharaoh , I am the son of the wise , the son of ancient kings ?

translation.kha: Ka jingtim ki kyntoit ja-um baroh ka don ha ka snam , bad dei ñiar kata ba U Trai u la hukum ba dei ban theh ïa baroh ka sngem ha ka skei ban weng noh ïa ki pop ki briew . Ka snam , kaba long ka jingim , ka weng noh ïa ki pop .
translation.en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood : and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls : for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul .

translation.kha: U pashat jongki ka Assyria , ha ka jaka ban ïarap ïa u Adah , u la ïaleh marpyrshah ïa u bad thaw jingtap ïa u .
translation.en: And Tilgath–pilneser king of Assyria came unto him , and distressed him , but strengthened him not .
Then said he , What have they seen in thine house ? And Hezekiah answered , All that is in mine house have they seen : there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them .
translation.kha: Kaei ba ki la ïohi ha ka ïing syiem ?   Ki la ïohi ïa baroh . Ym don kaba ngam shym la pyn-i ha ki ha ki ïing jingkynshew .
U Jisu u long u bhabriew u bajanai kum u Adam .
translation.en: Jesus was a perfect human just like Adam .

translation.kha: Da kaba bud ïa ki jinglah ba-ijli jongno ki hangamei kiba U Trai u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki bynriew jong u ki dang tur shaphrang , u Manasseh u la ai pop pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: But did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , like unto the abominations of the heathen , whom the  Lord  had cast out before the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Ha katba sdang jong ka Jingkhawai Niam , pynsngewthuh ha ki khun shynrang jong phi ba phi leh ïa kane baroh namar kaei kaba U Trai u la leh ha phi Mynba phi! mihpaw na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day , saying , This is done because of that which the  Lord  did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u mihnoh na Beersheba . Ki khun shynrang jong u ki pynshongduh ïa u , ïa ki khun rishot jong ki , bad ïa ki tnga jong ki , ha i'u ki kali kiba u syiem ka Ijipt u la phah ban kit ïa ki .
translation.en: And Jacob rose up from Beer–sheba : and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father , and their little ones , and their wives , in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him .

translation.kha: kumto u Samuel u ïathuh ha u nadong shadong ; um shym buhrieh ei ei shuh na u . U Eli u ïong , U long U TRAI’ ; ieh un leh katba u sngewbiang ïa u .
translation.en: And Samuel told him every whit , and hid nothing from him . And he said , It is the  Lord  : let him do what seemeth him good .
And the rest of the acts of Joash , and all that he did , and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoash u la leh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingshlur jong u ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Amasaïah u syiem ka Judah , la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

Hynrei ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga bad ki la kyntait ngab shahshkor . Kim shem la bret nala ïa ki bleithaw) ba-ijli jong ki lane iehnoh ïa ki blei jong ki nong Ijipt . Ang la kloi ban shad ïa ki ban sngew ïa ka bor ba-pura jong ka jingbitar jong nga hangta ha Ijipt .
translation.en: But they rebelled against me , and would not hearken unto me : they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes , neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt : then I said , I will pour out my fury upon them , to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt .
For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I , even I , will both search my sheep , and seek them out .
translation.kha: Ma nga U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ïathuh ha phi ba nga hi da lade ngan wad ïa ki langbrot jong nga bad sumar ïa ki .
Hato phi la un-long u mraw mynba U Blei u la khot ïa phi ? Kam pher , wat pynswai ei ei ; hynrei lada phira ïoh ïa ka lad ban long uba ïalade , pyndonkam ïa ka .
translation.en: Art thou called being a servant ? care not for it : but if thou mayest be made free , use it rather .
Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days , and all Israel with him , a very great congregation , from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt .
translation.kha: U Solomon bad baroh ki paid Israel ki la rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep hynñiew sngi . La don u paidbah uba bun naduh ka Khim Hamath na shatei haduh ka khappud Ijipt na shathie .
