translation.kha: Pynban ki la long kaba ibha shikatdei ïa sem ; kam ju pynthut ïa ngi , bad ha ki por baroh ba ngi don nabar ki ha ki lyngkha , ym shym ne kano kano ruh kaba dei ka jong ngi naba la shah tuh .
translation.en: But the men were very good unto us , and we were not hurt , neither missed we any thing , as long as we were conversant with them , when we were in the fields :
Then I testified against them , and said unto them , Why lodge ye about the wall ? if ye do so again , I will lay hands on you . From that time forth came they no more on the sabbath .
translation.kha: Nga maham ïa ki ,  Kam myntoi ban ap hangto habar ki kynroh ka nongbah na ka bynta ka step ka ban wan . Lada phi pyrshang biang ïa kane , ngan pyndonkam da ka bor pyrshah ïa phi .  Naduh kata , kim ju wan shuh ha ka sngi Sabbaton .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when they brought out those kings unto Joshua , that Joshua called for all the men of Israel , and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him , Come near , put your feet upon the necks of these kings . And they came near , and put their feet upon the necks of them .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u khot ïa ki rangbah ka Israel baroh bad u hukum ïa ki rangbah shipai kiba la leit ryngkat bad u ban wan bad buh ïa la ki kjat ha ki ryndang jong ki syiem . Ki la leh kumta .
Ka dei ïa kane ba U Blei u la khot ïa phi , ngab U Khrist hi u la shahshitom na ka bynta jong phi sad u la iehnoh ha phi ïa ka nuksa , khnai ba phin bud ha ki dadien jat jrong u .
translation.en: For even hereunto were ye called : because Christ also suffered for us , leaving us an example , that ye should follow his steps :

translation.kha: Lydda ka kynthei ka bym pat ïashongkurim ka pynlong ka jingkular , da Kaba mut khnang ne khlem da pyrkhat ban kynhied na kane kano bad nangta ka shongkurim ,
translation.en: And if she had at all an husband , when she vowed , or uttered ought out of her lips , wherewith she bound her soul  ;
My lord asked his servants , saying , Have ye a father , or a brother ?
translation.kha: Kynrad , phi la kylli ïa ngi , ‘ Phi dang don kpa ne phi dang don para shynrang shuh ?’

translation.en: Even a fool , when he holdeth his peace , is counted wise : and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding .
translation.kha: Nalor baroh , wat ïa uba bieit la pyrkhat ba u long uba stad bad shemphang lada u shu shong jar jar bad set ïa la ka shyntur .

Haba U Ujuh u la wan hiar na u lum lem bad ki apostol , u la ïeng ha ka jaka madan lem bad kiba bun ki synriah jong u . U paid byllien u la don hangta na kylleng ka Judia dara na Jeruel bad na ki nongbud tyrso bad Sdien kiba harud durbriew ;
translation.en: And he came down with them , and stood in the plain , and the company of his disciples , and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem , and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon , which came to hear him , and to be healed of their diseases  ;

translation.kha: Ïa ki ryntieh jrong ki shipai kiba khlaiñ la pynkheiñ , hynrei kiba sleit ki ïohbor .
translation.en: The bows of the mighty men are broken , and they that stumbled are girded with strength .

translation.kha: Kumba me haka ban shem hi da lade , ym pat palat khat sngi ba nga la leit shaei Jerusalem ban mane .
translation.en: Because that thou mayest understand , that there are yet but twelve days since I went up to Jerusalem for to worship .

translation.kha: Hynrei kiar na ki jingkylli ba-ïaitrei , na ka thup kyrteng ki kper Thummim , na ki jingïania bad ki jingïaleh shaneng ka Hukum . Kine ki long ki bymmyntoi bad kiba sep-ei .
translation.en: But avoid foolish questions , and genealogies , and contentions , and strivings about the law ; for they are unprofitable and vain .

translation.kha: Nga la don ryngkat bad me kat shabi me leit , bad nga la jlop ïa ki nongshun jong me baroh katba me nang ïaid shaphrang . Ngam pynlong ïa me uba pawnam kat ki nongïaleh Ibbah khraw tam ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And I was with thee whithersoever thou wentest , and have cut off all thine enemies out of thy sight , and have made thee a great name , like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth .
A good man obtaineth favour of the  Lord  : but a man of wicked devices will he condemn .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u sngewbha ïa ki briew kiba bha , hynrei u pynrem ïa kito kiba thmu sniew .

Ko Baasha ka Assyria , ki lat jongnga me ki la ïap , sad ki rangbah donburom jong me ki ïohthiah junom ! Ïa ki briew jong me la pynsakma halor ki lumbah , bad ym don shuh mano ma ban wallam pat ïa ki sha ïing .
translation.en: Thy shepherds slumber , O king of Assyria : thy nobles shall dwell in the dust : thy people is scattered upon the mountains , and no man gathereth them .

translation.kha: Mynta nga erlangthari kum u ban sa ïatip noh ; ym don jingngeit na ka jingjynjar jong nga .
translation.en: And now my soul is poured out upon me  ; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me .
A loving husband treats his wife with tenderness and understanding .
translation.kha: U tnga uba ieit u sumar bha ïa la ka tnga , da ka jingieit bad da ka jingsngewthuh .
Ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ki long kiba la pynkupbor ban batai ïa ka suda u Moses .
translation.en: Saying ,  The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses  seat :

translation.kha: Bad mynta U Trai u ong , Ha ki lai snem thik , ka spah bakyrhuh jong ka Moab kan bai noh . Na ki Briew kiba bun lad ka , tang khyndiat ki ban lait im , bad kin longsyiem kiba tlot .
translation.en: But now the  Lord  hath spoken , saying , Within three years , as the years of an hireling , and the glory of Moab shall be contemned , with all that great multitude  ; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble .

translation.kha: U la don ïa ka kot kli barim ba la plied ha ka kti jong u . U la bhah ïa ka kjat kamon jong u hajir ka duriaw bad ïa ka kjat kadiang jong u halor ka khynwin ,
translation.en: And he had in his hand a little book open : and he set his right foot upon the sea , and his left foot on the earth ,
But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon , and in Shaalbim : yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed , so that they became tributaries .
translation.kha: Ki Amor ki dang sah ha Aijalon , Shaalbim , bad ha u Lum Heres , hynrei ki jait Ephraim bad Manasseh ki buh hapoh ka jingsynshar jong ki bad ki pynbor ïa ki ban trei na ka bynta jong ki .
Hynrei lada phim kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , te nga smai ha phi ba kane ka ïingsyiem kan ngat ha ki jingjot . Ma at , U tharai , nga la kren .
translation.en: But if ye will not hear these words , I swear by myself , saith the  Lord  , that this house shall become a desolation .
That ye may remember , and do all my commandments , and be holy unto your God .
translation.kha: Ki ksai jyrthiaw kin pynkynmaw ïa phi ban sumar ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh bad phin long ki jong nga nadong shadong .
Ïa nga shimet , U Trai um shah da lei lei ba ngan leh pop pyrshah ïa u da kaba sangeh noh ban duwai na ka bynta Jong phi . Pynban ngan hikai ïa phi ïa kaei kaba bha bad ka dei ïa phi ban leh .
translation.en: Moreover as for me , God forbid that I should sin against the  Lord  in ceasing to pray for you : but I will teach you the good and the right way :

translation.kha: U long tang ma u marwei , uba sngewthuh ïa ki jingsngew jong nga , bad uba sngewlehrain shisha shaphang jong phi .
translation.en: For I have no man likeminded , who will naturally care for your state .
But he said unto them ,  All men cannot receive this saying , save they to whom it is given .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Kane ka jinghikai kam treikam ïa baroh , hynrei tang ha kito kiba U Blei u la ai ïa ka .
Kumta U Tharai u la bitar lep ïa la ki briew bad u la pynngat ha ka ri jrong ki ïa ki jingtim baroh ïa uba la thoh ha kane ka kitab .
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was kindled against this land , to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book :
Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand , and wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen , in whose sight I brought them forth .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la leh kumta , naba kata kan jin da la wallam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba la lah ïohi ïa nga ba nga ïalam ïa ki Israel shabar na ka Ijipt .
Hato phi lah ban pyndonkam ïa ka ha kaba shna ei ei ? Hato phi lah ban shna u sneng na ka , ban wah ïa ktieh kiei ha u ?
translation.en: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work ? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon ?

translation.kha: Khmih katno ba u la ieit ïa u ! ki briew ki la ïai-ong .
translation.en: Then said the Jews , Behold how he loved him !

translation.kha: Ar ngut ki kham bha’ ban ïa kaba mareh , namar ryngkat lang ki lah ban trei kham bha shibun .
translation.en: Two are better than one  ; because they have a good reward for their labour .

translation.kha: ‘ Me dei uei , A tharai ?’ nga la kylli . ‘ Nga long U Jisu uba na Naboth , ïa uba me pynshitom beiñ ,’ u la ong ha nga .
translation.en: And I answered , Who art thou , Lord ? And he said unto me ,  I am Jesus of Nazareth , whom thou persecutest .
And Jerubbaal the son of Joash went and dwelt in his own house .
translation.kha: U Gideon u leit phai pat sha la ïing bad u shongduh hangta .

translation.en: Ye see then how that by works a man is justified , and not by faith only .
translation.kha: Phi ïohi , namarkata , ka dei da ki kam jong u ba ïa u briew la pynksan ha U Blei , ym tang da ka jingngeit jong u hi .
U la pynkheiñ ïa la ka jingsmai Bad ïa ka jingïateh lur kaba u la lah pynlong . U la leh ïa kine kiei kiei , bun mynta un ym ïohlait ban phut .
translation.en: Seeing he despised the oath by breaking the covenant , when , lo , he had given his hand , and hath done all these things , he shall not escape .

translation.kha: Lada phi longïing wahbah shemphang , phin lah ban kan ïa la ka jingbitar . Haba Une uno u bor bakla ïa phiah , ka dei ka jinglong bakyrhuh ban leh klet ïa ka .
translation.en: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger  ; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression .
God having provided some better thing for us , that they without us should not be made perfect .
translation.kha: Namar ba U Blei u la pynkhreh lypa ïa kaei kaei kaba kham bha na ka bynta jong ngi . Ka jingthmu jong u ka la long ba tang ha ka jingïadon ryngkat bad ngi ba yn pynjanai ïa ki .

translation.en: Brethren , pray for us .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit , to duwai lem na ka bynta jong ngi .

Wai shah ba moi ki briew kin shong kin sah ha ka ri jong phi ; lada phi imat kumta , kin pynlong ïa phi banbeiñ leh pop pyrthuh ïa nga . Lada phin mane ïa ki blei jong ki , ka long ka jingriam ka ban pynïap duh ïa phi .
translation.en: They shall not dwell in thy land , lest they make thee sin against me : for if thou serve their gods , it will surely be a snare unto thee .

translation.kha: To pyrkhat ïa ka jingïashem u Abraham , kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , U la ngeit ha U Blei , bad namar ka jingngeit jong u , U Blei u la pdiang ïa u kamon uba hok .
translation.en: Even as Abraham believed God , and it was accounted to him for righteousness .

translation.kha: U la pynbeit hynñiewphew hajar ngut na ki ban kit ïa ki tiar ki thad bad phraphew hajar ngut ban shtah maw ha ki jaka lum , Bad u la thung lai hiar hynriewspah ngut ki nongpynim ki ban pynthikna ba yn pyndep ïa ka kam .
translation.en: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens , and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain , and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work .
He answered and said unto them ,  When it is evening , ye say , It will be fair weather : for the sky is red .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la jubab ,  Haba ka sngi ka sep , phi ong , ‘ Ngin sa ïoh ïa ka suiñbneng kaba bha , namar ka sahit bneng ka saw .’
Nga kular ha U Trai uba im , uba ai ha ki Israel ka jingjop , ba uta uba la kun un shah pynïap , Wat la u dei u Jonathan u kynhun jong nga . Khynñiuh ym don uwei umdih naba ong ei ei .
translation.en: For , as the  Lord  liveth , which saveth Israel , though it be in Jonathan my son , he shall surely die . But there was not a man among all the people that answered him .
Now while Paul waited for them at Athens , his spirit was stirred in him , when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry .
translation.kha: Katba u Paul u dang ap ha Athens ïa u Silas bad u Timothi , u sngew shitom jingmut shikatdei eh haba u la ïohi ba ka nongbah ka shlei da ki bleithaw .

bad ha lynti u Elijah u ong ïa u Elisha , Mynmiet ap hangne ; U Trai u la hukum ïa nga ban leit sha Bethel . hynñiew u Elisha u jingbabe , Nga smai da ka jingïaineh ïakem jong nga ha U Trai uba im bun ha pa’ ba ngan ym hynñiew ïa phi . Kumta ki la leit shat Bethpelet .
translation.en: And Elijah said unto Elisha , Tarry here , I pray thee  ; for the  Lord  hath sent me to Beth–el . And Elisha said unto him , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . So they went down to Beth–el .

translation.kha: Mynmiet , ha ka sngi ba ka kyllon noh , ki dewlynnong ki khynñiat , bad ki briew’ jong ki , ki kynjai ha kata ka jingpyntieng .
translation.en: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall  ; yea , the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure .

translation.kha: Ka sngi tud wan hato U Trai Badonbor Baroh un long kum ka pansngiat badonburom jong ki syntiew na ka bynta ki briew jong u bakha dang sah .
translation.en: In that day shall the  Lord  of hosts be for a crown of glory , and for a diadem of beauty , unto the residue of his people ,
That was the true Light , which lighteth every man that cometh into the world .
translation.kha: Kane ka la long ka jingshai kaba shisha — ka jingshai kaba wan sha ka pyrthei bad pynshai ha u bynriew baroh .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Though they be quiet , and likewise many , yet thus shall they be cut down , when he shall pass through . Though I have afflicted thee , I will afflict thee no more .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong u ki Israel :  Wat la ki nong Assyria ki khlaiñ bad ki kham bun paid , ïa ki yn pynjot thiaw bad kin jah noh . Ko ki briew jong nga , nga la pynlong ïa phi ban shahshitom , hynrei ngan ym leh shuh ïa ka .
Ki khun shynrang jong phi kin eh ban ïashongkurim bad ki khum kynthei jong ki , ki ban ïalam ïa ki ban ym ïan shuh ha nga bad shun mane ïa ki blem thala jong ki .
translation.en: And thou take of their daughters unto thy sons , and their daughters go a whoring after their gods , and make thy sons go a whoring after their gods .

And they tarried till they were ashamed : and , behold , he opened not the doors of the parlour  ; therefore they took a key , and opened them : and , behold , their lord was fallen down dead on the earth .
translation.kha: Ki la ap haduh ba ki dang lah ban ap , hynrei haba um shym la plie ïa ka jingkhang , ki la shim ïa u shabi bad plie ïa ka . Bad hangta u don u kynrad jong ki , u da thiah ïap ha madan .

U Moses u kren ha u babha , Khynñiuh ïa kane ka sngi — ka sngi ha kaba phi mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt , ka ri ha kaba phi Long ki miaw . Kane ka dei ka sngi ba U Trai u la ïam noh! ïa phin da ka borbah jong u . Wat ba-ima ïa u kpu ba la khlain thait .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the people , Remember this day , in which ye came out from Egypt , out of the house of bondage  ; for by strength of hand the  Lord  brought you out from this place : there shall no leavened bread be eaten .

translation.kha: Kane ka longsem ka jingkñia namar ka jingleh phlait ïa ka bapop pyrshah ïa U Trai .
translation.en: It is a trespass offering : he hath certainly trespassed against the  Lord .
And on the seventh day seven bullocks , two rams , and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish :
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ai hynñiew tylli ki masi lyngraw , ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang , bad khatsaw tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

Ki briew jong nga kin shahshkor ïa kaei kaba me ong ha ki . ngat me dei ban leit sad ki nongïalam jong ki Israel sha u Paran bad ong ha u , ‘ U Trai , U Balei jong ki Heber , u la pynpaw ïa lade ha ngi . Mynta shah ïa ngi Ban kitei lai sngi lynti sha ka ri shyiap ban ai jingkñia ha U Trai , U Blei jong ngi .’
translation.en: And they shall hearken to thy voice : and thou shalt come , thou and the elders of Israel , unto the king of Egypt , and ye shall say unto him , The  Lord  God of the Hebrews hath met with us : and now let us go , we beseech thee , three days  journey into the wilderness , that we may sacrifice to the  Lord  our God .

translation.kha: woh pynkynriah ïa u mawpud kaba rim lane knieh ïa ka khyndew ba long trai da ki khunswet .
translation.en: Remove not the old landmark  ; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless :

translation.kha: Phah ïano ïano sha Joppa ban Shem ïa u briew naba ka kyrteng pura ka long u Simon Petros . U shong basa ha ka ïing jong u Simon , u nongpdem snieh , babha shon basah harud duriaw .’
translation.en: Send therefore to Joppa , and call hither Simon , whose surname is Peter  ; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side : who , when he cometh , shall speak unto thee .

translation.kha: dara na Hammath sha ka yn ha ka ri Moab , harum ka kliar u Lum Pyrshang na wahbah lah ban Ïohi ïa said ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: And from Bamoth in the valley , that is in the country of Moab , to the top of Pisgah , which looketh toward Jeshimon .

translation.kha: Nga la klet noh kaba kumno ka jingkhiah bad ka jingkem bad ka jingkmen ki long .
translation.en: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace : I forgat prosperity .

translation.kha: Uno uno umbah leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew u isih ïa ka jingshai bad un ym wan sha ka jingïohi , namar um kwah ba ïa ki kam sngewieit jong u yn jaw .
translation.en: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light , neither cometh to the light , lest his deeds should be reproved .

translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la ïalam ïa U Jisu hakpoh shuh ka phyllaw jong ka ïingshong u lat bad ki la khot lang ïa baroh ki shipor ba dang sah jong ka kynhun .
translation.en: And the soldiers led him away into the hall , called Praetorium  ; and they call together the whole band .

translation.kha: Nangta sa khot bad pahuh da ka kynhun shipai kob ka jingbun paid ka long kat kato kaba la phai dien ei na Phin , buh katjuh ka jingbun ki kulai bad ki kali ïapmat . Ngin ïaleh ïa ki Jeraïah ha ki jaka madan , bad ha kane ka sien ngin jop ïa ki . U syiem Benhadad u la mynjur bad bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong ki .
translation.en: And number thee an army , like the army that thou hast lost , horse for horse , and chariot for chariot : and we will fight against them in the plain , and surely we shall be stronger than they . And he hearkened unto their voice , and did so .

translation.kha: Habor phira duwai , un jubab ïa phira , bad phin bat ïa ki kular ba phi la pynjrong .
translation.en: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him , and he shall hear thee , and thou shalt pay thy vows .

translation.kha: U syiem Joram u sah” , Pynkhreh ka kali ïapom jngai nga . Ynda la pynkheiñ , ma u bad u syiem Akhsah ki mih mar la ka kada ïalum don leit ïakynduh ïa u hajuh . Ki ïakynduh ïa u ha ka lyngkha naba la ju longsem ka jong u Naboth .
translation.en: And Joram said , Make ready . And his chariot was made ready . And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out , each in his chariot , and they went out against Jehu , and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite .
And Joseph said unto them , Fear not : for am I in the place of God ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Joseph u ong ha ki ,  Wat sheptieng ; ngam lah ban buh ïa lade ha ka jaka jong U Blei .
Hato don mano mano ba la leh ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ? Mano ba la ïathuh lypa ïa baroh ka ban sa jia naduh kaba mynnyngkong haduh kaba kut ka por ?
translation.en: And who , as I , shall call , and shall declare it , and set it in order for me , since I appointed the ancient people ? and the things that are coming , and shall come , let them shew unto them .
A fool s wrath is presently known : but a prudent man covereth shame .
translation.kha: Haba uba bieit u phoi , u pynpaw kumne kumne ba yn tip . Ki briew kiba sian kim patiaw ïa ka jingshah krenbeiñ .

translation.en: Speak to Zerubbabel , governor of Judah , saying , I will shake the heavens and the earth  ;
translation.kha: ïa u Serubbabel , u lat ka Judah :  Nga la jan ban pynkhih ïa ka bneng bad ka khyndew
Te U Trai u la ai bor ïa said ka kada ba-bang kren , bad ka ong ha u Balaam , Nga la leh aïu keiñ ïa pa’ ba Phi da sympat ïa ar ha kine lai sien ?
translation.en: And the  Lord  opened the mouth of the ass , and she said unto Balaam , What have I done unto thee , that thou hast smitten me these three times ?

translation.kha: Lada u lop ïa ka bniat jong u mrad , shajrong ne kynthei , u dei ban pyllaitluid ïa uta u mraw kum ka jingsiew namar kata ka bniat .
translation.en: And if he smite out his manservant s tooth , or his maidservant s tooth  ; he shall let him go free for his tooth s sake .
And Zadok the priest , and his brethren the priests , before the tabernacle of the  Lord  in the high place that was at Gibeon ,
translation.kha: U Sadok u lyngdoh bad ki para lyngdoh jong u pat , ki peit ïa ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  ha ka jaka mane kaba ha Gibeon .
Nangta u khun shaphang shatei sha Enshemesh bad nangta pud sha Geliloth , marpyrshah ïa ka khim Adummim . Nangta u hiar pyntud sha u Maw jong u Boas ( u Bohan u dei u khun jong u Reuben ) ,
translation.en: And was drawn from the north , and went forth to En–shemesh , and went forth toward Geliloth , which is over against the going up of Adummim , and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben ,

translation.kha: U Trai u nguh , Ngan pynrem ïa u briew uba phai noh na nga bad uba buh ïa ka jingshaniah jong u ha u briew , ha ka jingkhlaiñ jong u briew u bym im junom .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Cursed be the man that trusteth in man , and maketh flesh his arm , and whose heart departeth from the  Lord .

translation.kha: Un sa longsem naba khuid hadien ba ka sngew ka la sei , bad nangta u lah ban baibam ïa kita ki jingkñia baje Ibbah kyndok , kiba dei ka jingbam jongno u .
translation.en: And when the sun is down , he shall be clean , and shall afterward eat of the holy things  ; because it is his food .

translation.kha: Ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew baroh ki long tang ki bynthiew ; hawei U Trai u la thaw ïa ki bneng .
translation.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols : but the  Lord  made the heavens .
And Jacob went near unto Isaac his father  ; and he felt him , and said , The voice is Jacob s voice , but the hands are the hands of Esau .
translation.kha: U Jakob u tur kham sha jan u kpa jong u , uba la ktah ïa u bad u ong ,  Ka sur te kum ka sur jong u Jakob , hynrei ki kti jong me pat ki long kum ki kti jong u Iso .

Hynrei haba ki la lah khum ïa u ban sympat , u Paul u la Ong ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam uba ïeng hangta , Hato ka shong aiñ ïa me ban sympat ïa u traishnong ka Shemida Rom u bym shym la shah bashrah na ka byndi kano kane ka kam runar ?
translation.en: And as they bound him with thongs , Paul said unto the centurion that stood by , Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman , and uncondemned ?

translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u kylli ïa U Blei , Hato ngan ter ïaleh ïa ki Pheliks ? Hato men ai ha i ka jingjop ? Hynrei U Blei um shym jubab ha kata ka sngi .
translation.en: And Saul asked counsel of God , Shall I go down after the Philistines ? wilt thou deliver them into the hand of Israel ? But he answered him not that day .

translation.kha: Ka jingleh Jong me ka la long kaba janai naduh ka sngi ba la thaw ïa me haduh ba me la sdang ban leh ïa kambah sniew .
translation.en: Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created , till iniquity was found in thee .
And the liers in wait hasted , and rushed upon Gibeah  ; and the liers in wait drew themselves along , and smote all the city with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: Kine ki rangbah ki mareh kloi sha pyrshah ka Gibeah ; ki phet sha baroh ki liang ka nongbah bad ki pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei baroh hangta .
U don ka dakmong ha kjat kamon .
translation.en: He has a bruise on his right leg .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ka la long ba u Joseph , u Lebi uba la kha ha Sypros , ïa kiba ki alabastar ki khiat u Barnabas ( kaba mut Uta uba pynshlur ) ,
translation.en: And Joses , who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas , ( which is , being interpreted , The son of consolation , ) a Levite , and of the country of Cyprus ,
And this is his commandment , That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ , and love one another , as he gave us commandment .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba u hukum ka long ba ngi ngeit ha U Jisu Khrist , U Khun jong u bad ngi ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei , kumba U Khrist u la hukum ïa ngi .

translation.en: The sons of Zophah  ; Suah , and Harnepher , and Shual , and Beri , and Imrah ,
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Sophah ki long u Suah , u Harnepher , u Shual , u Beri , u Imrah ,
Da kaba ong ka jutang bamut , U Blei u la pynlong rim ïa kata kaba nyngkong ; bad katno kano kaba kliar rim bad nang tymmen kan sa sim noh shen .
translation.en: In that he saith , A new covenant , he hath made the first old . Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away .
And if a man lie not in wait , but God deliver him into his hand  ; then I will appoint thee a place whither he shall flee .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada ka long tang kaba shu jia ryngkhat , bad um shym da mut shisha ban pynïap ïa u , u lah ban phet sha ka jaka kaba ngan jied na ka bynta jong phi , bad hangta un shngain .

translation.en: Therefore now amend your ways and your doings , and obey the voice of the  Lord  your God  ; and the  Lord  will repent him of the evil that he hath pronounced against you .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban pynkylla ïa ka rukom kaba phi im bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba phi leh , bad phi dei ban kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Lada phi leh kumta , un kylla ïa la ka jingmut na ka jingpynjot kaba u la ong ba un wallam halor jong phi .

Ngan pynjot ïa uno uno uba sien kiew sha tnum ïing sad mane ïa ka sngi , u bnai , badno ïa ki khlur . Neng pynjot hima ïa kito kiba mane ïa nga bad kiba shimti ban ïaineh ha nga , ishyrkhei pynban ki shim smai ha ka kyrteng jong u blei Molekh .
translation.en: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops  ; and them that worship and that swear by the  Lord  , and that swear by Malcham  ;

translation.kha: U angel jong U Trai u la ong ha u Soitan , To U Trai un pynrem ïa me , ko Soitan ! To U Trai , uba ieit ïa ka Jerusalem , un pynrem ïa me . Une u bri u long kum u dieng ïa uba la sei noh na ka jing .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , The  Lord  rebuke thee , O Satan  ; even the  Lord  that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee : is not this a brand plucked out of the fire ?
And they brake down the image of Baal , and brake down the house of Baal , and made it a draught house unto this day .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la pynjot ïa u rishot bakyntang bad ïa kata ka templ , bad ki pynkylla jaka leit shabar ïa ka — kaba dang don haduh kane ka sngi .
Phi ïaishah ïa uno uno uba hukum ïa phi lane uba shim kabu ïa phi lane uba riam pah lane uba peit poh ïa ph lieng uba thab ïa phi ha ka nongbah .
translation.en: For ye suffer , if a man bring you into bondage , if a man devour you , if a man take of you , if a man exalt himself , if a man smite you on the face .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma nga , U Trai , nga la pyntwa noh ïa kaei kaba nga la tei bad rat noh ïa kaei kaba nga la thung . Ngan kun ïa kane ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translation.en: Thus shalt thou say unto him , The  Lord  saith thus  ; Behold , that which I have built will I break down , and that which I have planted I will pluck up , even this whole land .

translation.kha: Ka Silpah ka kha sa uwei patan u khun ïa u Jobab ,
translation.en: And Zilpah Leah s maid bare Jacob a second son .

translation.kha: U syiem un ïapom pynrngad , u khun syiem un duh jingkyrmen , bad ki briew kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ngan pynshitom ïa Phi na ka bynta baroh naba phi la leh , bad ngan bishar ïa phi ha kajuh ka man kumba phi la bishar ïa kawei . Kane kan pyn-i ha phi ba sa long U TRAI’ .
translation.en: The king shall mourn , and the prince shall be clothed with desolation , and the hands of the people of the land shall be troubled : I will do unto them after their way , and according to their deserts will I judge them  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .
They have mouths , but they speak not  ; eyes have they , but they see not  ;
translation.kha: Ki don ki shyntur , hynrei kim lah ban kren , bad ki khmat , hynrei kim lah ban ïohi .

Ngim shym la shaniah ha ki jingïapthngan ba shu thaw ha kaba ïathuh ha Phi ïa ka jingwan ha ka bor jong U Jisu Khrismas umbah U Trai jong me . Da la ki khmat jong ngi hi ngi la ïohi ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .
translation.en: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables , when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ , but were eyewitnesses of his majesty .
In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi ,  ong U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh ,  yn plie ïa ka umpohliew ban pynkhuid ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong u Dabid bad ïa ki briew jong ka Jerusalem na ka pop bad ka jingmane bleithaw jong ki .

Uta u brup um treh shuh ban sah ha kata ka miet , kumta ma u bad ka rnga kliar jong u ki sheng ïa ka jingleit jong ki , shlip bad u shakri jong ki bad kita ki puta ar tylli kiba kit jingkit ha ki jin . Ka sngi ka la jan sep haba ki wiang poi hajan Jebus ( kata ka den ka Jerusalem ) , kumta u shakri u ong ha la u kynrad , Balei ngim sangeh pun sahmiet ha kane ka nongpang ki Jebus ?
translation.en: And when they were by Jebus , the day was far spent  ; and the servant said unto his master , Come , I pray thee , and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites , and lodge in it .

translation.kha: Baroh ki riewkhuid ki ai jingkhublei ïa phiah .
translation.en: All the saints salute you .
Not by works of righteousness which we have done , but according to his mercy he saved us , by the washing of regeneration , and renewing of the Holy Ghost ;
translation.kha: Ym namar kano kano na ki kam babha kiba ma ngi hi ngi la leh , hynrei namar ka jingisynei jong u hi ba u la pynim ïa ngi , lyngba U Mynsiem Bakhuid , uba ai ïa ngi ka jingkha thymmai bad ka jingim kaba thymmai da kaba sait ïa ngi .
To ai ba U Trai hi , uba long ka tyllong jong ka jingsuk jong ngi , un ai ha phi ka jingsuk ha ki por baroh bad ha ka jingim jong phi baroh’ . U Trai un long lem bad phi baroh .
translation.en: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace always by all means . The Lord be with you all .

translation.kha: Ki dei ki lyngngai kiba Wan na ki ri kiba jngai , ki wallam ïa ki paidlang U Blei sha la ïohnong . Ki wanrah ïaryngkat bad ki ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , pun pyndonburom ïa ka kyrteng U Trai U Blang Bakhuid ka Ishmael , wahbah pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh pun pyndonburom ïa ki briew jong u .
translation.en: Surely the isles shall wait for me , and the ships of Tarshish first , to bring thy sons from far , their silver and their gold with them , unto the name of the  Lord  thy God , and to the Holy One of Israel , because he hath glorified thee .

translation.kha: Nangta haba phi la ïaroi bun ha kata ka ri , ki briew kin ym kynran shuh shaphang ka Synduk ka Jong jong de . Kin ym pyrkhat sha shaphang jrong ka lane kynmaw ïa ka ; kin ym donkam shuh ïa ka , lymne kin ym shna sa kaweh pat .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when ye be multiplied and increased in the land , in those days , saith the  Lord  , they shall say no more , The ark of the covenant of the  Lord  : neither shall it come to mind : neither shall they remember it  ; neither shall they visit it  ; neither shall that be done any more .

And Jethro said , Blessed be the  Lord  , who hath delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of Pharaoh , who hath delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  uba la pyllait im ïa phi na u Pharaoh bad na ki nong Ijipt ! Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  uba la pyllait im ïa une u paidbah na ka jinglongmraw !

translation.en: And I said , What shall I do , Lord ? And the Lord said unto me ,  Arise , and go into Damascus  ; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do .
translation.kha: Nga la kylli , ‘ Aïu ngan leh , A Trai ?’ bad U Trai u la ong ha nga , ‘ Ïeng joit bad leit sha Damaskos , bad hangta yn sa ïathuh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba U Blei u la thmu na ka bynta jong me ban leh .’
Jiw ïa ka jingbthah jong nga , ban ïa ka rupa ; jied ïa ka jingtip , ban ïa ka ksiar nylla .
translation.en: Receive my instruction , and not silver  ; and knowledge rather than choice gold .

translation.kha: Katba u paidbah u dang ïadie sha shiliang ha ka khñiot kaba ryngkoh , ki lyngdoh kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Troas ki ïeng ha ka dewryngkhiang hapdeng jong ka Joanan tad haduh ba uto u paidbah un da jam sha jingsliang .
translation.en: And the priests that bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  stood firm on dry ground in the midst of Jordan , and all the Israelites passed over on dry ground , until all the people were passed clean over Jordan .
Neither do men put new wine into old bottles : else the bottles break , and the wine runneth out , and the bottles perish : but they put new wine into new bottles , and both are preserved .
translation.kha: Lymne ym don uno uno u ban theh ïa ka waiñ bathymmai hapoh ki lwa snieh kiba la pyndonkam , namar ki snieh kin pdang bad ka waiñ kan tuid shabar , bad ïa ki lwa snieh yn pynsniew . Hynrei , ïa ka waiñ kaba thymmai la theh noh ha ki lwa snieh bym pat ju pyndonkam , bad baroh ar kin neh .
Wat ai ïa kaei kaba khuid ha ki ksuid — ngin shu phai pynban bad tur ban dait ïa ph . Wat bret ïa ki mawlynnai ha iitkhmat ki sniang — ktien shu ïuh pynban ïa ki hapoh ka kjat .
translation.en: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs , neither cast ye your pearls before swine , lest they trample them under their feet , and turn again and rend you .
For her wound is incurable  ; for it is come unto Judah  ; he is come unto the gate of my people , even to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ïa ki jingmong ka Samaria yn ym lah pynkhiah , bad ka Judah kan shahshitom ha kajuh ka rukom ; ka jingpynjot ka la poi haduh ki khyrdop ka Jerusalem hi , ha kaba ki briew jong nga ki shong .
Ngan ïeng joit bad leit sha i pa jong nga bad ong , Ko pa , nga la leh pop pyrshah ïa U Blei bad pyrshah ïa phira .
translation.en: I will arise and go to my father , and will say unto him , Father , I have sinned against heaven , and before thee ,

translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynkut da kaba ong , To shahshkor te , lada phin don ki shkor !
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .

translation.kha: U Ephraim u la long uba riewspah shibun , ha ka jingdon ïa ki langbrot bad ki blang , kumjuh shwa ha ka jingdon ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar .
translation.en: And Abram was very rich in cattle , in silver , and in gold .
But Jesus held his peace . And the high priest answered and said unto him , I adjure thee by the living God , that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ , the Son of God .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u shu sngap . Sa shisien pat u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la kren ha u ,  Ha ka kyrteng jong U Blei uba im , mynta nga buh ïa me ha ka jingsmai : Ïathuh ïa ngi lada me dei u Messaïah , U Khun U Blei .
Ki briew ka Jerusalem ki kyang jam , Haduh Katto la pynmong jur ïa im ! Ki jingmong jong ngi kin ym koit . Gera ngi la pyrkhat ba kane ka dei kiei kaei kaba ngi lah ban shah !
translation.en: Woe is me for my hurt ! my wound is grievous : but I said , Truly this is a grief , and I must bear it .
So Christ was once offered to bear the sins of many  ; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , U Khrist ruh u la kñia ainguh tang shisien ban bah noh ïa ki pop jong kiba bun . Un sa paw ha ka sien kaba ar , ym ban weng noh ïa ka pop , hynrei ban pynim ïa kita kiba ap khmih lynti ïa u .

translation.en: Or if the raw flesh turn again , and be changed unto white , he shall come unto the priest  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei haba kata ka prum ka la jem bad ka la kylla lieh biang , uta u briew u dei ban leit sha u lyngdoh , u ban khmih bniah biang ïa u .

Wallam ïa ka jingmih baroh jong kawei-na-kaba-shiphew shai ka Templ , khnang ba yn don ka bam kyrhai hangta . To tynjuh ïa ar bun phin sa ïohi ba ngan plie ïa ki jingkhangïit jong ka bneng bad theh noh ha phi kyrhai ïa kiei kiei kiba babha baroh .
translation.en: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse , that there may be meat in mine house , and prove me now herewith , saith the  Lord  of hosts , if I will not open you the windows of heaven , and pour you out a blessing , that there shall not be room enough to receive it .

translation.kha: Mynta , to shim noh ïa ka pisa na u bad ai ïa ka ha ithuh uba la ei shipai hajar tylli ki sbai .
translation.en: Take therefore the talent from him , and give it unto him which hath ten talents .

translation.kha: U Joseph u pa ha Shekhem bad Kaba u dang ïada sakma kylleng ïa ka shngain ha kaba uwei u briew u ïor ïa u bad u kylli , Phi ïada ïano ?
translation.en: And a certain man found him , and , behold , he was wandering in the field : and the man asked him , saying , What seekest thou ?

translation.kha: Ka jaitbynriew na shatei ka la wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Babilonia bad yn pynlong ri shyiap ïa ka . Ki briew bad ki mrad kin phet krad noh , bad yn ym ne bashong ba sah hangta .
translation.en: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her , which shall make her land desolate , and none shall dwell therein : they shall remove , they shall depart , both man and beast .

translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem u jubab , Em , ngan da siewdor ïa ka . Ngan ym ai ha U Tlai U Blei jongno nga ïa ki jingkñia kiba nga khlem da siewdor ei ei . Bad u la thied ïa ka jaka shoh kew bad ïa ki masi dab ha ka dor sanphew tylli ki Sabbai rupa .
translation.en: And the king said unto Araunah , Nay  ; but I will surely buy it of thee at a price : neither will I offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord  my God of that which doth cost me nothing . So David bought the threshingfloor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver .

translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kiba ïap ka thngan ïa ki , ka ang pynheh ïa la ka shyntur . Ka klun shapoh ïa ki riewdonburom jong ka Jerusalem badno ki paid ba kaw kaw jong ki riewpaidbah .
translation.en: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself , and opened her mouth without measure : and their glory , and their multitude , and their pomp , and he that rejoiceth , shall descend into it .

translation.kha: Ki la iehnoh ïa ka lynti kaba beit bad ki la jah lynti ; ki la bud ïa ka lynti jong u Balaam , u khun jong u Beor , uba ieit ïa ka pisa kaba u ïoh da ka kam bymhok
translation.en: Which have forsaken the right way , and are gone astray , following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor , who loved the wages of unrighteousness  ;

translation.kha: Khynñiuh u Moses bad u Aaron ki dem khrup ha khyndew malade ki ong , A Blei , me , me long ka thymmei jong ka jingim baroh . Haba uwei na ngi u leh pop , hato men shu bitar lep ïa ka kynhun baroh kawei ?
translation.en: And they fell upon their faces , and said , O God , the God of the spirits of all flesh , shall one man sin , and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation ?

translation.kha: A Trai U Blei jong ngi , me la pyn-i ïa ka bol jong me da kaba ïam napoh ïa ki briew jngai me na ri ibieit , badno ïa ka bor jong me la ïai kynum . Ngi la leh pop ; ngi la leh baklang .
translation.en: And now , O Lord our God , that hast brought thy people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand , and hast gotten thee renown , as at this day  ; we have sinned , we have done wickedly .

And the men of Israel and of Judah arose , and shouted , and pursued the Philistines , until thou come to the valley , and to the gates of Ekron . And the wounded of the Philistines fell down by the way to Shaaraim , even unto Gath , and unto Ekron .
translation.kha: Ki shipai Israel bad Judah ki risa shaid bad ki mareh nadien jong ki , ki beh kthong haduh Gath bad shaduh ki khyrdop ka Ekron . Ki Philistia ki la kyllon mynsaw baroh shi lynter lynti naduh Shaaraim , haduh Gath bad Ekron .
Lem bad u , u wan u Onesimos , uta u para ba-ieit bad uba lah shun shaniah , uba daiñ na ka kynthup jong phi . Kin ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kaei barabor naba la jia hangne .
translation.en: With Onesimus , a faithful and beloved brother , who is one of you . They shall make known unto you all things which are done here .
And another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven , he also having a sharp sickle .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa uwei pat u angel ba u wan mihnoh na ka Templ ha bneng , bad u ruh u la don ka rashi kaba nep .
u khun jong u Amminadab , u khun jong u Admin , u khun jong u Armoni , u khun jong u Khesalon , u Kynhun Jong u Peres , u khun jong u Judah ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Aminadab , which was the son of Aram , which was the son of Esrom , which was the son of Phares , which was the son of Judah ,

translation.kha: Khenani , ngan ym knieh ïa ka hima baroh kawei na u Siloam , bad ngan pynneh ïa u ha ka ni kabu u dang im . Kane sam leh na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga , ïa uba nga la jingdih bad uba khlong ïa ki aiu bad ki hukum jongu nga .
translation.en: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand : but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant s sake , whom I chose , because he kept my commandments and my statutes :

translation.kha: Uwei sad ujuh hi U Mynsiem u ai ïa ka jingngeit ha uwei , katba ha uwei pat , u ai ïa ka bor ban pynkhiah .
translation.en: To another faith by the same Spirit ; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit ;
Nevertheless he regarded their affliction , when he heard their cry :
translation.kha: Pynban U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ki haba ki kyang , bad u khmih ïa ki jingjynjar jong ki .

translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came to Jeremiah , after that the king had burned the roll , and the words which Baruch wrote at the mouth of Jeremiah , saying ,
translation.kha: Hadien ba u syiem Jehoïakim u la lah thang ïa ka kot kli kaba nga la ong ha u Barukh ban thoh ,

translation.en: And David came to Baal–perazim , and David smote them there , and said , The  Lord  hath broken forth upon mine enemies before me , as the breach of waters . Therefore he called the name of that place Baal–perazim .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u leit sha Baal Perasim bad hangta u la jop ïa ki Philistia . U ong ,  U  Trai  u la sar naphang lin ïa ki nongshun jong nga kum ka jingshlei um .  Bad kumta ïa kata ka jaka la khot Baal Perasim .

Ha ka sien kaba hynñiew u wan pei bad u ong , Nga ïohi khyndiat u lyoh u bym da heh paila ïa ka kti briew ba u kiew na ka duriaw . U Elijah u hukum ïa u shakri bad noh , Kiei leit sha u syiem Ibbah nabar ong ïa u ban shong ha ka kali ïapom bad ban leit phai noh sha ïing shuwa ba u slap un pynsangeh ïa u .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the seventh time , that he said , Behold , there ariseth a little cloud out of the sea , like a man s hand . And he said , Go up , say unto Ahab , Prepare thy chariot , and get thee down , that the rain stop thee not .

translation.kha: ‘ Ka bneng ka long ka khet jong nga , ong U Trai , bad ka khyndew ka long ka jingïuhkjat jong nga . Ka ïing kaba kumno te phin tei ïa nga ? Hangno ka jaka ba ngan shong ?
translation.en: Heaven is my throne , and earth is my footstool : what house will ye build me ? saith the Lord : or what is the place of my rest ?

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ka ba-ha-ïing jong pha , ka Elisabeth . Ïa kaba la ong ba kam lah ïa-ban ïoh khun , ishyrkhei mynnin ka la hynriew bnai ka jingpunkhun , wat la ka la long kaba la thom bha .
translation.en: And , behold , thy cousin Elisabeth , she hath also conceived a son in her old age : and this is the sixth month with her , who was called barren .

translation.kha: Hynñiew hab ki parabangeit ki la lumlang sawdong ïa u , u la ïeng jat bad u la kitei phalang pat sha shnong . Ha ka snoh kob bud ma u lem bad u Barnabas ki la sien sha Derbe .
translation.en: Howbeit , as the disciples stood round about him , he rose up , and came into the city : and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ki Briew kin ïong , ‘ Nga la leit thir sad la la kyndit ha ka jingthymmai bol .’
translation.en: Upon this I awaked , and beheld  ; and my sleep was sweet unto me .
And he said unto me ,  Depart : for I will send thee far hence unto the Gentiles .
translation.kha: ‘ Khie leit ,’ U Trai u la ong ha nga , ‘ naba ngan phah ïa me sha jngai sha ki Jentil .’
Nalor kata u shim ïa barieh ïa ki khiew ki pliang jong ka Templ , bad u pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki ; u khan ei ïa ka thalab , bad u tei ki duwan ha man la ki ïong jong ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of God , and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of God , and shut up the doors of the house of the  Lord  , and he made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U Lebi , uba ka tnga kli jong u ka la shah pynïap , u jubab , Ma at bad ka tnga kliar jong nga I leit sahmiet ha Gibeah kaba ha ka ri ki Benjamin .
translation.en: And the Levite , the husband of the woman that was slain , answered and said , I came into Gibeah that belongeth to Benjamin , I and my concubine , to lodge .
And he arose , and came to his father . But when he was yet a great way off , his father saw him , and had compassion , and ran , and fell on his neck , and kissed him .
translation.kha: Kumta u la ïeng joit bad u la leit phai pat sha la u kpa .  U dang kham pajih ha ka lynti na ïing haba u kpa jong u , u la ïohi ïa u ; ka dohnud jong u ka la dap da ka jingisynei , bad u la mareh , u la piam ïa la ki kti sawdong jong u , bad u la doh ïa u .
Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran , Lada isangsot uno u kwah ban ïan bad ang , u dei ban kjat ïa lade , ban bah ïa la ka diengphna , bad bud ïa nga .
translation.en: Then said Jesus unto his disciples ,  If any man will come after me , let him deny himself , and take up his cross , and follow me .

translation.kha: A Trai , lada nga ïasaid ïa ka kam jongngi per bad me , men pynsawa ba me long ha kaba dih . Pynbna nga dei pun kylli ïa me shaphang ki bynta ka jingbishar hok . Balah ba ki Rangbah basbun ki manbha thar katta ? Balei ba ki rangbah bymhok ki jop ?
translation.en: Righteous art thou , O  Lord  , when I plead with thee : yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments : Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper ? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously ?

translation.kha: Hamar pdeng jong tala ka erïong , ang ïohi ïa kai Kaei kaba i kum ki saw tylli ki jingthaw ïa-im ha ka dur ki briew ,
translation.en: Also out of the midst thereof came the likeness of four living creatures . And this was their appearance  ; they had the likeness of a man .

translation.kha: Ki nong Ram ken wan ha ki liengbah bad kin pyrshah ïa u , bad un sa shaphang . Te un leit phai pat ha ka jingbitar sylla bad un pynryngkang ban pynjot ïa ka niam lad ki briew jongu U Blei’ . Un bud ïa ka jingai jingmut jong kito kiba la ioh ïa kata ka niam .
translation.en: For the ships of Kittim shall come against him : therefore he shall be grieved , and return , and have indignation against the holy covenant : so shall he do  ; he shall even return , and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant .
The heart knoweth his own bitterness  ; and a stranger doth not intermeddle with his joy .
translation.kha: Ka jingkmen jong phi ka long ka jong phi hi ; ka jingkthang jong phi ka long ka jong phi hi . Ym don uba lah ban ïasam ïa ki bad phi .

translation.en: And there shall be no night there  ; and they need no candle , neither light of the sun  ; for the Lord God giveth them light : and they shall reign for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Yn ym don shuh kano kano ka miet , bad kin ym donkam ïa ki sharak lane ïa ka jingshai ka sngi , namar U Trai uba U Blei un long ka jingshai jong ki bad kin synshar kum ki syiem junom la junom .
Hynrei u Mikaïah u jubab , Da U Trai uba im , ngan ong ïa kaei kaba U Blei u ong ïa ar ban ong !
translation.en: And Micaiah said , As the  Lord  liveth , even what my God saith , that will I speak .
They that go down to the sea in ships , that do business in great waters  ;
translation.kha: Katto katne ki leit da ka liengbah halor ka duriaw-bah , ki trei na ka bynta ka jingim jong ki ha ki duriaw-rit .

translation.en: And the king said , Thou shalt surely die , Ahimelech , thou , and all thy father s house .
translation.kha: U syiem u ong ,  Ahimelekh , ma me bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong me baroh phi dei ban ïap .

translation.en: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart , both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem , so that the wrath of the  Lord  came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah .
translation.kha: Khatduh pat u Hesekaïah bad ki briew ka Jerusalem ki pynrit ïa lade , bad kumta U  Trai  um shym pynshitom ïa ki briew haduh hadien ka jingïap u Hesekaïah .
Yn sa beh noh ïa u na ka ri jong kiba im , yn sa beh noh na ka jingshai sha ka jingjam .
translation.en: He shall be driven from light into darkness , and chased out of the world .

But if the priest look on it , and , behold , there be no white hair in the bright spot , and it be no lower than the other skin , but be somewhat dark  ; then the priest shall shut him up seven days :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada u shñiuh ha kata ka dak um kylla lieh , bad kata ka dak kam long kaba kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , hynrei ka stang ha ka rong , u lyngdoh u dei ban pynkyrpang ïa u hynñiew sngi lynter .

U nonglamktien u jubab , Ki Israel ki la phet ïap na ki Philistia ; ka la erlangthari ka jingshahjop Kaba shyieng ïa ngi ; bad nalor kata ki ïakhun jong phi , u Hophni bad u Phinehas , ki la shahskhor pynïap , bad ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Blei la shah knieh noh !
translation.en: And the messenger answered and said , Israel is fled before the Philistines , and there hath been also a great slaughter among the people , and thy two sons also , Hophni and Phinehas , are dead , and the ark of God is taken .

translation.kha: Te u la pyndonkam da u bsiat shun kren ha ka Im ba ïada ka bam ïa u soh na uta u dieng , tista ym ïap , hynrei kun long kum U balui .
translation.en: So he used a serpent to tell Eve that if she ate the fruit from that tree , she would not die , but she would be like God .

translation.kha: Hynrei , A Trai , me ithuh ïa nga ; me ioh kaei ba la leh , bad kumno nga la ieit ïa me . To pynring sharud ïa kine ki rangbah basniew kum ïa ki langbrot ki ban shah ot doh ; to satia ïa ki tad Haduh ba ka dei ka por ïa ki ban shah pynïap .
translation.en: But thou , O  Lord  , knowest me : thou hast seen me , and tried mine heart toward thee : pull them out like sheep for the slaughter , and prepare them for the day of slaughter .

translation.kha: Shuah ngab kut ka jingduwai , ka Rebekka ka la wan poi bad u khiew um ha la ka tyrpeng . Ka dei ka khun jong u Bethuel , ibha long u Kynhun jong ka Milkah bad u Hiar , uba shi para dara u Abraham .
translation.en: And it came to pass , before he had done speaking , that , behold , Rebekah came out , who was born to Bethuel , son of Milcah , the wife of Nahor , Abraham s brother , with her pitcher upon her shoulder .

translation.kha: Wat ujuh Shu shaphang ki jingkynshew jong phira ; ym don kano kano ka jingpynkoit ïa phi . Nga la pynshitom ïa phi kumta Namarba ki pop jong phiah ki un-long ibha bun bad ka jingbymman jong phi ka Long kaba khraw .
translation.en: Why criest thou for thine affliction ? thy sorrow is incurable for the multitude of thine iniquity : because thy sins were increased , I have done these things unto thee .

translation.kha: Ym don uba kren ïa-lamler ha ka ïingbishar u ïa-ban jingtehkular na ka jingpynjahburom ; u la shah pynrem .
translation.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished , and he that speaketh lies shall perish .
They arose , all the valiant men , and took away the body of Saul , and the bodies of his sons , and brought them to Jabesh , and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh , and fasted seven days .
translation.kha: ki rangbah bashlur tam ki leit bad shim ïa ki metïap jong u Saul bad jong ki khun jong u , bad ki wanrah ïa ki sha Jabesh . Ki tep ïa ki hangta hapoh u dieng Sning , bad ki shahjingit hynñiew sngi lynter .
Te ka khubor kiba wan na mihngi bad na shait kan pynsheptieng ïa u , bad un ïaleh da jingbitar shla , da kaweh pynïap shibun ngut ki briew .
translation.en: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him : therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy , and utterly to make away many .

translation.kha: U nongaikam uba khot bylla ïa uno uno uba ibit uba u ïakynduh , u long tang Ban pynsngewrem kat ïa kiba ïatreilang .
translation.en: The great God that formed all things both rewardeth the fool , and rewardeth transgressors .

translation.kha: Ka Bathsheba ka dem ngon ha khmat u syiem , bad u ong , Phah kwah aïu ?
translation.en: And Bath–sheba bowed , and did obeisance unto the king . And the king said , What wouldest thou ?
And Benjamin came again at that time  ; and they gave them wives which they had saved alive of the women of Jabesh–gilead : and yet so they sufficed them not .
translation.kha: Ki Benjamin ki wan phai pat , bad kiwei ki Israel ki ai ha ki ïa kita ki theisotti na Jabesh ïa kiba kim shym la pynïap . Hynrei kita kim pat biang ïa ki .
Kaei ka briew , kaba ka khwan jong ka , ka don u mynsiem bymjukut hapoh jong ka , ka la ïohsngew shaphang U Jisu bad marbl kumta hi ka la wanlam sha u bad ka la ih ha ki phet jong u .
translation.en: For a certain woman , whose young daughter had an unclean spirit , heard of him , and came and fell at his feet :

And the  Lord  appeared unto him the same night , and said , I am the God of Abraham thy father : fear not , for I am with thee , and will bless thee , and multiply thy seed for my servant Abraham s sake .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u bad u ong ,  Nga long U Blei jong u kpa jong me u Abraham . Wat sheptieng , nga don ryngkat bad me . Ngan kyrkhu ïa me , bad ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew namar ka jingkular jong nga ïa u shakri jong nga u Abraham .

translation.en: He saith unto him , Which ? Jesus said ,  Thou shalt do no murder , Thou shalt not commit adultery , Thou shalt not steal , Thou shalt not bear false witness ,
translation.kha: Ki hukum kiba kumno ?  u la kylli . U Jisu u la jubab ,  Wat pynïap ; wat klim ; wat tuh ; wat kynnoh bymdei ïano ïano ;
Ngan tbeh dang ïa ka Ijipt , bad ka Ptolemais sa don ha ka jingtuid . Ki kynroh jong ka Thebes kin poi , badno ka nongbah tista shrieh da ka um .
translation.en: And I will set fire in Egypt : Sin shall have great pain , and No shall be rent asunder , and Memphis shall have distresses daily .

translation.kha: namar kam rung sha ka dohthang , ishyrkhei , shapoh ka kpoh jong u bad nongbat ka mih shabar na ka met . ( Ha kaba u ïa-ong ïa Kane , U Jiw u la pynbna ba baroh ki jingbam ki long kiba bit ban bam . )
translation.en: Because it entereth not into his heart , but into the belly , and goeth out into the draught , purging all meats ?

translation.kha: Uta u briew um treh shuh ban sah ha “kata ka moramot , kumta ma u bad ka tnga kliar jong u ki dang ïa ka jingleit jong ki , ryngkat bad u shakri jong ki bad kita ki kada ar tylli kiba kit jingkit ha ki jin . Ka Sngi ka la ju sep haba ki wiang poi hajan Jebus ( tala ka dei ka Jerusalem ) , kumto u shakri u ainong ha la u kynrad , Balei jingjam sangeh ban sahmiet ha kane ka nongbat ki Jebus ?
translation.en: And when they were by Jebus , the day was far spent  ; and the servant said unto his master , Come , I pray thee , and let us turn in into this city of the Jebusites , and lodge in it .
That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship , from which Judas by transgression fell , that he might go to his own place .
translation.kha: ban shakri kum u apostol ha ka jaka jong u Judas , uba la iehnoh ban leit sha ka jaka kaba u dei ban leit .

Hadien habud phin sa shem da kaba suk lada nga lah lehhok . Haba phin wan ban khmih ïa ka than jong nga , lada na don ki blang ki bym thohbria bad ki bym borabor , lane kino kino ki khunlangbrot ki bym ïingjaiñ , phin tap ba nga la tuh ïa ki .
translation.en: So shall my righteousness answer for me in time to come , when it shall come for my hire before thy face : every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats , and brown among the sheep , that shall be counted stolen with me .

translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat por , u Abraham u la tipbriew ba ka Milkah ka la kha phra ngut ki khum ïa u Nahor u la jong u :
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that it was told Abraham , saying , Behold , Milcah , she hath also born children unto thy brother Nahor  ;

translation.kha: Kine ki briew’ kim shym bakhor , kumba phi tharai ; ka dang khathynñiew baje mynstep .
translation.en: For these are not drunken , as ye suppose , seeing it is but the third hour of the day .

translation.kha: U leh pop pyrshang ïa U Trai , nongmareh haduh ka snoh ka jingïap jong u , u bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u syiem Jeroboam u khun jong u Nebat , wahbah la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh ngop haduh ka sngew ka jingdap jong u .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  : he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin .

translation.kha: U brisoh Uba don ha ka bor uba banbeiñ ïa kiba kun u Long kum u lapbah lapsan kiba pynjot thiaw ïa ki jingthung .
translation.en: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food .

translation.kha: Ong ha ki Israel , Ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u Bnai uba hynñiew , rakhe ïa ka kum ka sngem jingshongthait kaba kyrpang , bad ïahap ka tharai ka da , wan ïalumlang ban Mane Blei .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , In the seventh month , in the first day of the month , shall ye have a sabbath , a memorial of blowing of trumpets , an holy convocation .

translation.kha: Uno uno u bym hir na ka bynta jong nga , u ïaleh pyrshah shispah ïa nga ; uno uno u bym ïarap ïa ar ban lum ban lang u longïing shisha uba pynsaphred .
translation.en: He that is not with me is against me  ; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth abroad .

translation.kha: Hobah Uto u set u ïohi ba u Saul u la ïap , u ruh u rynsied ïa lade ha la ka waitlam bad u ïap slem bad u sarew .
translation.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead , he fell likewise upon his sword , and died with him .

translation.kha: Ha khmat jong u thew u bnai um long uba pyni , ne ki khlur kim long kiba khiah .
translation.en: Behold even to the moon , and it shineth not  ; yea , the stars are not pure in his sight .

translation.kha: Haba ki la iohnong ïa kane , ki la sangeh ïa ka jingwoh nia jongnga ki bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei , da kaba ong , Te U Blei u la ai umdih ha ki Jentil ïa la lad ban kylla-kaba-mut bad ban lait im !
translation.en: When they heard these things , they held their peace , and glorified God , saying , Then hath God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life .

translation.kha: To pan na U Trai U Bela jong me ba ai ka ki ha me . Ka lah ban long na kaba jylliew ha ka pyrthei kiba ïarep lane nang tei najrong eh jongu ka bneng .
translation.en: Ask thee a sign of the  Lord  thy God  ; ask it either in the depth , or in the height above .

translation.kha: Ka jingleit jngai ki ka pyn-i ba ïa kaei kaba ka Hukum ka dawa , la thoh ha ki dohnud jongnga ki . Ki jingïatiplem jong ki duh ki pynjam ba kane ka long kaba shisha , namar ki jingpyrkhat jong ki teng teng ki pynrem ïa ki badno teng teng ki kyrshan ïa ki .
translation.en: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts , their conscience also bearing witness , and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another ; )

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa U Trai ba u ïeng harud ka duwan . U la ai ka hukum : Tied tyngeh ïa ki khlieh rishot jong ka Templ haduh ba ka shyngkub baroh kawei kan da khih . Pynpait ïa ki bad ai ba kin hap halor ki khlieh jong ki briew . Ngan pynpei ha ka thma ïa ki briew kiba dang sah . Yn ym don u ban ïohi ; wat uwei ruh un ym lait im .
translation.en: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar : and he said , Smite the lintel of the door , that the posts may shake : and cut them in the head , all of them  ; and I will slay the last of them with the sword : he that fleeth of them shall not flee away , and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered .

translation.kha: U Meshillemoth u dem ngon sa shisien bad u ong , Ko Kynrad , ngiam long uba kham bha ban ïa u ksiew uba la ïap ! Balei ba phin da long kiba bha haduh kat ïa de ?
translation.en: And he bowed himself , and said , What is thy servant , that thou shouldest look upon such a dead dog as I am ?

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U Ïoannis u la ïohi ïa U Jisu ba u wan sha u , bad u la ong , Ha khmih , U jinglongbriew jong U Blei , ibha kup noh ïa ka pop jong ka pyrthei !
translation.en: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him , and saith , Behold the Lamb of God , which taketh away the sin of the world .
All darkness shall be hid in his secret places : a fire not blown shall consume him  ; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle .
translation.kha: Ïa baroh kaba u la kynshew yn pynjot ; ka ding ïa kaba ym shym la pynmeh da ki kti briew ka thang ïa u bad ïa baroh ka longïing jong u .

translation.en: As he did to the children of Esau , which dwelt in Seir , when he destroyed the Horims from before them  ; and they succeeded them , and dwelt in their stead even unto this day :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la leh kumjuh na ka bynta ki Edom , ki khun ki ksiew u Iso , kiba shong ha ri lum Edom . U pynjot ïa ki Hor , kumta ki Edom ki ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong ki bad ki shongsah hangta haduh mynta .

translation.en: Thine eye shall not pity him , but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel , that it may go well with thee .
translation.kha: Wat leh-isynei ïa u . Rat noh na Israel kum ïa uta u nongpynïap briew , khnang ba phin manbha .

translation.en: And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God .
translation.kha: bad un wallam pat ïa ki briew babun sha U Trai U Blei jong ki .

Ïa ki nongïaleh pyrshah ïa U tharai yn pynjot ; kum u pyrthat na bneng un tied marpyrshah ïa ki . U Trai un bishar ïa ka pyllait baroh kawei ; Un ai ka bor ha la u syiem , Un pynlong ïa u syier ba la jied jong u ban ïoh ïa ka jingjop .
translation.en: The adversaries of the  Lord  shall be broken to pieces  ; out of heaven shall he thunder upon them : the  Lord  shall judge the ends of the earth  ; and he shall give strength unto his king , and exalt the horn of his anointed .

translation.kha: Phi la ïohi ïa ki khlam kiba ishyrkhei , ïa ki khambun Bad ki kamphylla kiba khriat ba U Trai u la leh .
translation.en: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen , the signs , and those great miracles :

translation.kha: La thang shibun ki sharak ha ka kamra ba haneng ha kaba ki la ïalang .
translation.en: And there were many lights in the upper chamber , where they were gathered together .
And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him .
translation.kha: U Hamor u kpa jong u Shekhem u la leit ban ïakren bad u Jakob , hamar ba ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la wan phai na ki pyntha .

Ha ki Jingkhot bakhiah la thom : Da ki briew kiba kren ha ki ktah kiba pher ngan kren ha ki briew jong nga , ong U Tlai . Ngan Kren da ki rmiang shyntur jong ki nongwei , hynrei wat la katta ki briew jong per keiñ ym shahshkor ïa ar .
translation.en: In the law it is written , With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people ; and yet for all that will they not hear me , saith the Lord .
As sorrowful , yet alway rejoicing ; as poor , yet making many rich ; as having nothing , and yet possessing all things .
translation.kha: Wat haba la pynshitom , ym shym la pynïap ; wat haba la pynsngewsih , ngi long borabor kiba kmen ; ngi paw kum kiba duk , hynrei ngi pynriewspah ïa ki briew kiba bun ; ngi paw kum ki bym don ei ei , pynban ngi don lut ïa kiei kiei baroh .

Ale ïeng , ki pynphai ktien , Ïa ngaiñ leit tur ïaleh ïa ka Lasha . Ngi la ïohi ïa kata ka jaka , bad ka long kaba seisoh bha . Wat shong hangne khlem leh ei ei ; pynjulor ! ummat rung shapoh bad dakhol ïa ka !
translation.en: And they said , Arise , that we may go up against them : for we have seen the land , and , behold , it is very good : and are ye still ? be not slothful to go , and to enter to possess the land .

translation.kha: bad ki la phah ïa kane ka shuki harum lyngba jong ki : Ma im’ , ki angel malu ki nongsharai basngur , ki hynmen ki para jong phi , me phah ki jingkhublei ïa ki hynmen ki para jngai Ngi kiba la kha na ki jingtylli kiba shong dew ha Antiokh , ha Syria bad ha Kilikia .
translation.en: And they wrote letters by them after this manner  ; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia :
For then the king of Babylon s army besieged Jerusalem : and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison , which was in the king of Judah s house .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ka kynhun shipai jong u syiem ka Babilonia ka dang tur ïaleh ïa ka Jerusalem , bad ïa nga la set ha ka phyllaw ba la kerkut jong ka ïingsyiem .
Ka hajar ka kylli ïa lade , Hato nga da ïohi shiah ïa U Blei malade ba nga dang im ban iathuh ïa kata ? Kumta ka la khot ïa ka kirteng U Trai uba la klun ha ka , U Blei uba ieh .
translation.en: And she called the name of the  Lord  that spake unto her , Thou God seest me : for she said , Have I also here looked after him that seeth me ?

These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon , of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation , whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the  Lord .
translation.kha: kiba la dap shi bnai lane kham heh ; baroh ki long arphew ar hajar arspah hynñiewphew lai ngut .
Kum ka longïing , namarkata , ki jingkieng ingiew ki don na kawei ka snem sha kawei pat ka snem ban pynkynmaw ïa ki briew Shaphan ki bapop jong ki .
translation.en: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year .

translation.kha: Haba la dep pynbiang ïa kiei keiñ baroh na ka bynta ka jingïarwai niam Ka Jinglait , ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ki shim ïa la ki bynta , kumba la lei da u syiem .
translation.en: So the service was prepared , and the priests stood in their place , and the Levites in their courses , according to the king s commandment .

translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por U Jisu u la sdang ban ïalap ïa ka khubor lad u : To phai noh na ki pop jong phiah , nalor ka hima ki bneng ka la ju !
translation.en: From that time Jesus began to preach , and to say ,  Repent : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand .

translation.kha: U la ïalum ïa ki briew na ka ri Jingtep , u da leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla ha ka ri Ijipt pynlang ha ka Duriaw basang bad haduh sawphew sner ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: He brought them out , after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt , and in the Red sea , and in the wilderness forty years .

translation.kha: uba la duh bor ha ka ktien lane ka kjat ;
translation.en: Or a man that is brokenfooted , or brokenhanded ,

translation.kha: U Moses u ai ïa ki hukum bad ki jingjai jong U Blei ha ki Israel .
translation.en: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel :

translation.kha: Un shim noh ïa ki jingkynshew ksiar bad rupa ba la buhrieh jong ka Ijipt bad ïa kiew kiwei ki jingdon jingem jrong ka uba la ñiewkordor eh . Un hiarthma ïa ka lypa bad ka Sudan .
translation.en: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver , and over all the precious things of Egypt : and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps .

translation.kha: Nga burom bad nga ieit ïa ki Hukum jong me ; ngan puson ïa ki jingbthah jong me .
translation.en: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments , which I have loved  ; and I will meditate in thy statutes .

translation.kha: badno ha ka por ba na la don bad phi , mem skhem la pynkhleh ïa phi shun ïarap haba nga la donkam pisa ; ki nongaplangbrot kiba la wang na Makedonia ki la wanrah sha por ïa kiei kiei baroh kba nga la dumok . Kum ha kaba mynba , kumta ruh ha ka lawei : Da lei lili ngan ym bankhia ïa phi !
translation.en: And when I was present with you , and wanted , I was chargeable to no man : for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied : and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you , and so will I keep myself .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren ha nga .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,

translation.kha: Ki syiem jongno ka pyrthei Ibbah la ïashim bynta ha ka jingawria bad ka jingkwah brai jong ka kin lynñiar bad ïa-ïam na ka byndi ka nongbah haba ki ïoh ïa ka tdem na ki thylliej dang kiba bim duh ïa ka .
translation.en: And the kings of the earth , who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her , shall bewail her , and lament for her , when they shall see the smoke of her burning ,

translation.kha: U la iehnoh ïa ki ha ka bor jong ki nongmane bleithaw , bad ki nongshun jong ki , ki synshar halor jong ki .
translation.en: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen  ; and they that hated them ruled over them .

translation.kha: Phi khot ïa u , U Kpa , haba phiah ïai ha U Blei , naba baher ïa ki briew baroh da kajuh ka jingthew , katba kum kaei kaweh uwei pa uwei u la leh ; kumta te , to pynlut ïa kaba tama ka jingim jong phi hangne ha ka pyrthei ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U .
translation.en: And if ye call on the Father , who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man s work , pass the time of your sojourning here in fear :

translation.kha: Ka jait Reuben ka tei biang ïa ka Heshbon , ka Elealeh , ka Kiriathaim ,
translation.en: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon , and Elealeh , and Kiriathaim ,

translation.kha: bad mynta uno u syiemsad un ïalam ïa phi . Nga te nga la tymmen malade phuh ñiuhlieh , hynrei ki khun shynrang jngai sa ki don bad pa . Nga la Long u nongïalam jong phi naduh ba nga dang samla haduh mynta .
translation.en: And now , behold , the king walketh before you : and I am old and grayheaded  ; and , behold , my sons are with you : and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day .

translation.kha: Ha ka jinghukum u syiem , ki nongshong kulai ki kiew ha ki kulai shem bad ki pynmareh ha ka jingstet bajur . Ïa ka hukum la pynbna paidbah shiah ha Susa , ka nongkhap ka hima .
translation.en: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out , being hastened and pressed on by the king s commandment . And the decree was given at Shushan the palace .
Brethren , be followers together of me , and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an example .
translation.kha: To ïai pyrthuh bud ïa nga , ko ki parabangeit jong nga . To pynleit jingmut ïa kito kiba bud ïa ka nuksa kaba dei kaba ngi la buh na ka bynta jong phi .
Nangta nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba jam katba kren na ka Templ , ha ki hynñiew ngut ki angel : Haei leit bad thah noh! ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki pliang jong ka jingbitar U Blei ha ka pyrthei !
translation.en: And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels , Go your ways , and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth .

Then lifted I up mine eyes , and looked , and , behold , there came out two women , and the wind was in their wings  ; for they had wings like the wings of a stork : and they lifted up the ephah between the earth and the heaven .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih shajrong bad ïohi ïa ki ar ngut ki kynthei kiba her sha nga lem bad ki thapniang bakhlaiñbor kum kito ki jong ka thring . Ki la shim ïa ka shang bad ki her noh lem bad ka .
U Blei u la pynrem ïa ki nongpang ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah , da kaba pynjot ïa ki da ka ding , malade u la pynurlong ïa ki ka nongmuna jong kaei ka ban jia ha ki bymtip Blei .
translation.en: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow , making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly  ;

translation.kha: Nga tip phi don maphi kato .
translation.en: I know you have it with you .

Then came Eliakim , the son of Hilkiah , that was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah , the son of Asaph , the recorder , to Hezekiah with their clothes rent , and told him the words of Rabshakeh .
translation.kha: Te u Eliakim , u Shebna bad u Joah ki la tar ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih bad leit bad ïathuh ha u syiem ïa kaei kaba u rangbah synshar Assyria u la ong .
hynrei ki jingïakynduhlang jong kane ka jingim , ka jingieit ïa ka spah , badno Baroh kiwei ki jait jingkhih ki tap bad kjap noh ïa ka khubor , bad Ki seisoh satia .
translation.en: And the cares of this world , and the deceitfulness of riches , and the lusts of other things entering in , choke the word , and it becometh unfruitful .
But he passing through the midst of them went his way ,
translation.kha: hynrei , u la ïaid lyngba napdeng jong u paidbah bad u la leit ha la ka lynti .
Sumar bha ïa lade ! Nga la ïathuh ïa kiei kiei baroh ha phi Shuah ba ka por kan poh .
translation.en: But take ye heed : behold , I have foretold you all things .
For they eat the bread of wickedness , and drink the wine of violence .
translation.kha: Ka jingleh bymman bad ka jingleh jubor ki long kum ka bam ka dih ïa ki .

translation.en: Then said the trees unto the vine , Come thou , and reign over us .
translation.kha: Kumta te ki dieng ki ong ha u dieng sohwaiñ , ‘ Ale wan bad long u syiem jong ngi .’

Haba ka shukor ka poi ha u Adadah ha Ijipt ba u Dabid u la ïap bad ba u Jehubbah u jingbabe ai hukum jong ka kynïan shipai jong u ruh u la ïap , u Hadad u ong ha u syiem , Shah ba nur loit phai sha la ka ri .
translation.en: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers , and that Joab the captain of the host was dead , Hadad said to Pharaoh , Let me depart , that I may go to mine own country .

translation.kha: Katba ka pyrthei ka daiñ sah , kan don ka aïom bet Bad ka aïom ot . Kan anna ka jingkhriat bad ka jingshit , ka lyiur bad ka tlang , ka sngi bad ka miet .
translation.en: While the earth remaineth , seedtime and harvest , and cold and heat , and summer and winter , and day and night shall not cease .

translation.kha: Kin Sa Wan
translation.en: they will come
And they shall build the old wastes , they shall raise up the former desolations , and they shall repair the waste cities , the desolations of many generations .
translation.kha: Kin tei pat ïa ki nongbah ba la jot la pra .
A Trai , ïa me yn pynbna borabor kum U Blei ; ki pateng bynriew borbah kin kynduh ïa me .
translation.en: Thy name , O  Lord  , endureth for ever  ; and thy memorial , O  Lord  , throughout all generations .

translation.kha: bad u ong ha la ki rangbah , To U Trai un bat ïa nga na kaba pynmynsaw ïa u kynhied jong nga , ïa uba U Trai u la jied kum u syiad ! Ngam dei ban pynmynsaw ïa u , namarba u dei u shem ba la jied da U Trai !
translation.en: And he said unto his men , The  Lord  forbid that I should do this thing unto my master , the  Lord s  anointed , to stretch forth mine hand against him , seeing he is the anointed of the  Lord .
Thou hast walked in the way of thy sister  ; therefore will I give her cup into thine hand .
translation.kha: Pha bud ha ki dien jat ka hynmen jong pha , bad kumta ngan ai ha pha ïa kajuh ka khuri jong ka jingpynshitom ban dih .
( Ioannis 14 :28 ) U mynsiem bakynja um dei u jingthaw ka dei ka bor jong U Blei .—Jenesis 1 :2 ; Kam 2 :18 .
translation.en: ( John 14 :28 ) The holy spirit is not a person  ; it is God’s active force .—Genesis 1 :2  ; Acts 2 :18 .

translation.kha: Ïa ki katto katne la rkhiebeiñ bad sliew , bad ïa kiwei pat la teh ha ki kynthih bad la set phatok ïa ki .
translation.en: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings , yea , moreover of bonds and imprisonment :
So I opened my mouth , and he caused me to eat that roll .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la ang ïa la ka shyntur , bad u la ai ha nga ïa ka kot kli ban bam .

Ha ka jingtim ba dang sah jong u symboh Ussaïah , u la long u bymkhuid Kat kum ka jinglehmeng namar ka jingpang jong u . Namar ba um lah shuh ngab ring sha ka Templ u shongsah u sah ha la ka ïing , khlem da ni sha ïa la ki kamram , katba u Jotham u ïakhun jong u , u synshar ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death , and dwelt in a several house , being a leper  ; for he was cut off from the house of the  Lord  : and Jotham his son was over the king s house , judging the people of the land .

translation.kha: U Adam malade ka tnga jong u ki ka ïoh sa uwei pat u khun . Ka la ong , U Blei u la ai khun shynrang ïa nga ha ka jaka u Abel , ïa umbiah u Kain u la pynïap . Kut ka la kirteng ïa u , u Seth .
translation.en: And Adam knew his wife again  ; and she bare a son , and called his name Seth : For God , said she , hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel , whom Cain slew .
But as truly as I live , all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei nga kular skhem ba kumba nga long uba im bad kumba ka jingdon jong nga ka dap ïa ka pyrthei baroh ,

Ki kawei-na-kaba-shiphew tyllep ki reng kiba me la ieh , bad u mradkhlaw , kin isih ïa ka nuti ; kin sa knieh noh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ka don bad kin Iehnoh lyngkhuit ïa ka ; kin bam ïa ka doh jngai ka bad kin pynjop ïa ka da ka ding .
translation.en: And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast , these shall hate the whore , and shall make her desolate and naked , and shall eat her flesh , and burn her with fire .

translation.kha: Khot sngewbha ïa u Jesse sha kata ka jingkñia , bad len sa ïathuh ha me ïa kaei ba men leh . Men sa pynsleh kum u syiem ïa u briew uba ngan ïathuh ha me .
translation.en: And call Jesse to the sacrifice , and I will shew thee what thou shalt do : and thou shalt anoint unto me him whom I name unto thee .

translation.kha: Ngi long U Blei uba don ha ki jaka baroh bad ym thiang ha kawei ka jaka .
translation.en: Am I a God at hand , saith the  Lord  , and not a God afar off ?

translation.kha: Namar kane ka deng , nga u Paul , u nongsah byndi U Krit Jisu na ka bna jong phi ki Jentil , nga duwai ha U balui .
translation.en: For this cause I Paul , the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles ,
