So there went up thither of the people about three thousand men : and they fled before the men of Ai .
translation.kha: Kumta kumba lai hajar ngut ki rangbah Israel ki leit tur shata , hynrei ki hap ban phet ïap nangta .
Ki la duh kun noh na ka jingtrei shitom ; kumba kin kyllon noh , sad ym don ba ïarap .
translation.en: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour  ; they fell down , and there was none to help .

translation.kha: Ka sngi ka mih lem bad ka jingshit kyr-ang dara ka trep ïa u jingthung ; u syntiew jongu u , u hap noh , bad ka jingieit jong u ka jah neh . Ha Kajuh ka rukom ïa uba riewspah yn pynjot noh katba u dang don ha ka kim jong u ba u trei .
translation.en: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat , but it withereth the grass , and the flower thereof falleth , and the grace of the fashion of it perisheth : so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways .
Behold , the princes of Israel , every one were in thee to their power to shed blood .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam Israel baroh ki shaniah ha la ka jingkhlaiñ bad ki pynïap briew .

translation.en: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it , he spake within himself , saying , This man , if he were a prophet , would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him : for she is a sinner .
translation.kha: Haba u Pharisi u la ïohi ïa kane , u la ong ha lade ,  Lada une u briew u dei shisha u nongïathuhlypa , un da la tip kaba kumno kane ka briew ka long kaba ktah ïa u ; un da la tip ka jait jingim bapop kaba kumno ka la im !

translation.en: And , behold , the angel of the Lord came upon him , and a light shined in the prison : and he smote Peter on the side , and raised him up , saying , Arise up quickly . And his chains fell off from his hands .
translation.kha: Kynsan u angel jong U Trai u la ïeng hangta , bad ka jingshai ka la thaba hapoh ka kamra byndi . U angel u la pynkhih ïa u Petros na ka tyrpeng , u la kyrsiew ïa u , bad u la ong ,  Pynkloi ! Khie joit !  mar kumta hi ki kynjri ki la hap na ki kti jong u Petros .

translation.en: For true and righteous are his judgments : for he hath judged the great whore , which did corrupt the earth with her fornication , and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand .
translation.kha: Ki jingbishar jong u ki long kiba shisha bad kiba hok ! U la pynrem ïa ka nuti kaba pynpyut ïa ka khyndew da ki jingawria jong ka . U Blei u la pynshitom ïa ka namar ba ka la pynïap ïa ki shakri jong u .
Ka jingleit ka hir kaba bang bha ; a kat ngi ieit ban nguid ïa ka !
translation.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds , and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly .

translation.kha: U Blei um ju pynkyllaiñ ïa ka jingbishar hok , um ju pang ban sa ïa kaba dei .
translation.en: Doth God pervert judgment ? or doth the Almighty pervert justice ?

translation.kha: Ha ka sien kaba ar ki la khot biang ïa uta u briew ïa uba la ha tap-matlah , sad ki la ong ha u , To kular ha khmih U Blei ba men ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ! Ngi tip ba une u briew uba la pynkoit ïa me u dei u nongpop .
translation.en: Then again called they the man that was blind , and said unto him , Give God the praise : we know that this man is a sinner .

translation.kha: Ka la long palat ban ïa kaba me la khmih lynti! Nyngkong ki la kitei ïa lade ha U Trai ; bad nangta , da ka mon U Blei ki la aiti ïa lade ha ngi ruh .
translation.en: And this they did , not as we hoped , but first gave their own selves to the Lord , and unto us by the will of God .
And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki jingker kiba pynïeng ïa ka Ïingjaiñ da ka dieng akasia .
Ka ding ka ïada ha shwa jongnga u bad ka thang ïa ki nongshun kiba don sawdong jong u .
translation.en: A fire goeth before him , and burneth up his enemies round about .

translation.kha: Hapdeng kita ki jingtah ei kaei kaei kaba Simri kumto ka dongmusa bameh , kaba ïan khih . Ka ding ka klang bad pynmih ki jingbatai leilieh .
translation.en: As for the likeness of the living creatures , their appearance was like burning coals of fire , and like the appearance of lamps : it went up and down among the living creatures  ; and the fire was bright , and out of the fire went forth lightning .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh lada Kane kano ka nongaplangbrot ka don ki riewkynthei ha ka longïing jong ka , ka dei ban sumar ïa ki bad ban ym bankhia ïa ka balang , khnang ba ka eh ban satia ïa ki riewkynthei kiba long marwei .
translation.en: If any man or woman that believeth have widows , let them relieve them , and let not the church be charged ; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew Ibbah distrik ki kren , ki pynlong ïa ka jingdap kaba pdiang hun , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop ki khlaiñ ïa ka jingbieit .
translation.en: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright : but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness .

And when all the kings that were servants to Hadadezer saw that they were smitten before Israel , they made peace with Israel , and served them . So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more .
translation.kha: Haba ki syiem kiba shah synshar ha u Hadadeser ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , ki la pynlong ka jingïasuk bad ki bad ki kylla long ki raïot jong ki . Bad ki Syria ki la sheptieng ban ïarap biang ïa ki Ammon .
Ha kawei pa kaweh ka lynti bah pha la tei ki jaka ba-bang manla ïa ki bleithaw bad ban ïaleh sing . Hynrei pham shym beh ïa ka pisa kumba long kano kano ka nuti .
translation.en: In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way , and makest thine high place in every street  ; and hast not been as an harlot , in that thou scornest hire  ;

Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me , he hath crushed me , he hath made me an empty vessel , he hath swallowed me up like a dragon , he hath filled his belly with my delicates , he hath cast me out .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u la pynkut ïa ka Jerusalem bad bam ïa ka . U pynthylli ïa ka nongbah kum ïa u khra ; kum u mrad kynsha u la nguid ïa ka . U la shim kat ïa kaba u kwah bad bret noh ïa kiba sah .

Ha ka step kaba bud , hadien ba u Pashhur u la ïapyllait ïa nga na ki kynja , nga la ong ha u , U Trai um shym kyrthat ïa me u Pashhur . Ka ktung kaba u la lah ai ha me ka dei ‘ Ka Jingshyrkhei ha kylleng .’
translation.en: And it came to pass on the morrow , that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks . Then said Jeremiah unto him , The  Lord  hath not called thy name Pashur , but Magor–missabib .

translation.kha: U bhabriew uba ïalam bakla ïano ïano bad nangta u kam ba u shu biria u long kamon u Briew naba lamwir uba ïalehkai bad ka tiak kaba pynïap .
translation.en: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour , and saith , Am not I in sport ?

translation.kha: U la pyndap ïa katba thngan da kiei ktieh kiba ba , bad u la phah ei thylli ïa kiba riewspah .
translation.en: He hath filled the hungry with good things  ; and the rich he hath sent empty away .

translation.kha: Kaei ka jingkhlaiñ kabu por don ba lang! ïaphai im ? Balei ngan dang im haba ngam ba-don ka jingkyrmen ?
translation.en: What is my strength , that I should hope ? and what is mine end , that I should prolong my life ?

translation.kha: Haba ngi la poi ha phatok , ngi la shem ba la khang pynshong ïa ka bad baroh ki nongap pher kiba ap ki don ha ka khyrdop ; hynrei haba ngi la plie ïa ki khyrdop , ngim shem ïabun ïano ruh hapoh !
translation.en: Saying , The prison truly found we shut with all safety , and the keepers standing without before the doors : but when we had opened , we found no man within .

translation.kha: To khot kyrpad ïa nga , bad kan jubab ïa phi ; ngan ïathuh ïa phi kai kiei kiba phylla sad bakha sngewphylla ibha kino shym la tip ei ei shaneng jong ki .
translation.en: Call unto me , and I will answer thee , and shew thee great and mighty things , which thou knowest not .
Woe to them that are at ease in Zion , and trust in the mountain of Samaria , which are named chief of the nations , to whom the house of Israel came !
translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi kiba shongsuk ha Seïon , bad ïa phi kiba sngewshngain ha Samaria — phi ki briew kiba khraw jong kane ka jaitbynriew Israel kaba khraw , phi sha kaba ki briew ki ju leit ban ïoh jingïarap !
Hynrei to shakor ïa kaei kaba nga ong ha phoi bad ha ki paidbah .
translation.en: Nevertheless hear thou now this word that I speak in thine ears , and in the ears of all the people  ;

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , lymda phasi tieng shu la tip ïa kaei kaba U Blei u ai bad uei uta uba pait sip na pha , phan jin da la pait na u , dara u un Jin da la ai ha phar ïa ka um ka ai jingim .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto her ,  If thou knewest the gift of God , and who it is that saith to thee , Give me to drink  ; thou wouldest have asked of him , and he would have given thee living water .
By honour and dishonour , by evil report and good report : as deceivers , and yet true ;
translation.kha: Ïa ngi la pyndonburom bad la pynlehrain ; la krenbeiñ bad la ïaroh . La ñiew ïa ngi kum ki nongshukor , pynban ngi kren ïa ka jingshisha ;

Pynmih ïa uto u briew shabar ka jaka shong dara . Uno uno u bynriew uba la ïasngew ïa u ba u tim u tala un sakhi ïa kata da kambah u bsuh ïa la ki katei ha ka khlieh jong u , bad nongbat u pynbah baroh un lyntang maw ïa u haduh ba un da ïap .
translation.en: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp  ; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head , and let all the congregation stone him .

And Joash said unto all that stood against him , Will ye plead for Baal ? will ye save him ? he that will plead for him , let him be put to death whilst it is yet morning : if he be a god , let him plead for himself , because one hath cast down his altar .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Joash u ong ha kito baroh kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa u ,  Hato phi ïeng na ka bynta u Baal ? Hato phi ïasaid da ïa u ? Uno uno uba ïasaid na ka bynta jong u un shah pynïap ha shuwa ka step . Lada u Baal u dei u blei , ieh un ïada hi ïa lade . Ka dei ka duwan jong u ïa kaba la pynkhyllem .

Ka Sarah ka la ïohi ïa ki , badno ka ong ha u Abraham , Beh noh ïa kane ka mraw bad ïa u khun jong ka . U khun jong kane ka briew um dei ban ïoh bynta ei ei ïa ka spah ka phew jong me , kaba u khunlung jong nga , u Isaak u dei ban ïohpateng .
translation.en: Wherefore she said unto Abraham , Cast out this bondwoman and her son : for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son , even with Isaac .

translation.kha: Lada to u briew u bymkhuid da katba liat ksuit mynmiet , u dei ban leit sah sharak dat ka jaka shong bad .
translation.en: If there be among you any man , that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night , then shall he go abroad out of the camp , he shall not come within the camp :

translation.kha: U Herod bad ki ba-shiphew jongngi u ki la krenbeiñ ïa U Jisu Bad Kim jingñiewburom ïa u ; nangta ki la buh ka jaipdeh ba-itynnat Hamor jrong u bad u la phah pat ïa u sha u Pilat .
translation.en: And Herod with his men of war set him at nought , and mocked him , and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe , and sent him again to Pilate .

translation.kha: A Tharai , to shahshkor na bneng bad bishar ïa ki shakri jong me . Pynshitom ïa uta u nongleh palat kumba ka dei khor ïa u ïa-ban ïoh , bad pynksan ïa uta uba lui lui .
translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven , and do , and judge thy servants , condemning the wicked , to bring his way upon his head  ; and justifying the righteous , to give him according to his righteousness .

translation.kha: Phan long kum ka pynjot katba itynnat ïa U TRAI’ .
translation.en: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the  Lord  , and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la pdiang ba u briew u daym ban pynsngewbha ïa latai namar ka jingpynsngewbha kaba tang ma ka kaba u ïoh ha kane ka jingim ka long ka jingïabam bad ka jingïadih bad ka jinglehsngewbha ïa lade . U la la kumno kumno ban leh ïa kane katba u trei ha ka jingim kaweh U Blei u la ai ha u ha kane ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Then I commended mirth , because a man hath no better thing under the sun , than to eat , and to drink , and to be merry : for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life , which God giveth him under the sun .

translation.kha: Ki pyntud Israel ki long kum u jingthung uba ki tlot ki la tyrkhong bad um pynmih Soh ei ei shuh . Kin ym ïoh khun shuh , hynrei wat lada ki daiñ ïoh , ngan pynïap ïa ki khun thep mynsiem jong ki .
translation.en: Ephraim is smitten , their root is dried up , they shall bear no fruit : yea , though they bring forth , yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb .

translation.kha: ha Makhpelah kiba shai Mihngi na Mamre ha ka ri Kanaan . U Abraham u la thied ïa kane ka salm lem bad ka lyngkha u Yiron ban pynlong jaka tep ïa ka .
translation.en: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah , which is before Mamre , in the land of Canaan , which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace .

translation.kha: Phi la ïohsngew ruh ba la jong ïa ki briew ha ki por mynbarim , ‘ “Wat pynkheiñ ïa ka Kular jong phi , hynrei to leh ïa kaei kaba Phin la smai ha U Trai ban ai .’
translation.en: Again , ye have heard that it hath been said by them of old time , Thou shalt not forswear thyself , but shalt perform unto the Lord thine oaths :

translation.kha: U la longïing uba sngur bad u la ïaid ha ka lynti jong ka jingkohnguh baroh shi lynter lynti shaei ka jingïap — ka jingïap jong u halor ka jingpynbha .
translation.en: And being found in fashion as a man , he humbled himself , and became obedient unto death , even the death of the cross .

translation.kha: Ïa ki katto katne na ki tnat jong u dieng Elul ba la thung , la pynkheiñ noh , bad ba ïa u tnat jrong u ngin Olib khlaw la pynïasoh bad u . Ma phi ki Jentil ph long kum ki dieng Olib khlaw , bad mynta phi ïadem bynta ha ka jingim ba kynja mynsiem bakhlaiñ jong ki Siew .
translation.en: And if some of the branches be broken off , and thou , being a wild olive tree , wert grafted in among them , and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree ;
Charity never faileth : but whether there be prophecies , they shall fail ; whether there be tongues , they shall cease ; whether there be knowledge , it shall vanish away .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit ka neh bymjukut . Ki don ki khubor da ka jingpyrsad mynsiem , hynrei ki long tang shipor ; ki don ki jingai ban kren ha ki thylliej bapher , hynrei kin dam noh ; ka don ka jingtip , hynrei kan sa jah noh .
Ang pyrshah ïa kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba shim ktien uwei na uwei bad pynbna ïa ki kum ka khubor lad nga .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , I am against the prophets , saith the  Lord  , that steal my words every one from his neighbour .

translation.kha: Ngim shym ïohpdiang ïa u mynsiem jong kane ka pyrthei , pynbam , ngi lah ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem ba la Pha da U Blei , khring ba ïng lah ban tip ïa baroh kaba U Blei u la ai ha ngi .
translation.en: Now we have received , not the spirit of the world , but the spirit which is of God ; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God .

translation.kha: Hadien khyndiat sngi , ka la don ka jingïalang lad ki riewngeit , kumba shispah arphew lwet baroh , bad u Petros u la ïingjaiñ ban kren .
translation.en: And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples , and said , ( the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty , )
And he shall say , Where are their gods , their rock in whom they trusted ,
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  un ong ha la ki briew , ‘ Shaei kito ki blei khrawbor ha kiba phi shaniah ?
Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ba u Abimelekh u la ïap , baroh ki leit phai khong shad ïing .
translation.en: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead , they departed every man unto his place .

translation.kha: Ïa ki kam jong u Rehoboam naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut bad ki jingrem jingthoh ïa ka longïing jong u la shuh jingkhih ha Ka 1870 jong u Shemaïah u Nongïathuhlypa pynlang ha Ka Stad jong u iaid u Nongïathuhlypa . U Rehoboam bad u Joab ki ïai ïaleit thma uwei ïa uwei patar .
translation.en: Now the acts of Rehoboam , first and last , are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet , and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies ? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually .

translation.kha: Ka Rakhel ka ong , Nga la ïatyngkhuh ka jingïaleh kaba jot bad la ka hynmen , Hynrei nga la jop ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Naphtali .
translation.en: And Rachel said , With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister , and I have prevailed : and she called his name Naphtali .

translation.kha: Bad U Kpa , umbah la phar ïa por , u ruh u phler na ka bynta jong de .
translation.en: And the Father himself , which hath sent me , hath borne witness of me . Ye have neither heard his voice at any time , nor seen his shape .
And , behold , there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the  Lord  unto Beth–el : and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense .
translation.kha: Ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  , u nongïathuhlypa na Judah u leit sha Bethel bad u la poi hangta hamar ba u Jeroboam u ïeng ha ka duwan ban kñia jingainguh .

translation.en: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn , he espied his money  ; for , behold , it was in his sack s mouth .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka ba ki ïasah miet , uwei na ki u plied ïa la ka byrni ban ai bam ïa ka kada jong u , bad u lap ïa ka pisa jong u ha khlieh eh ka byrni .
Te naba ka la long ka sngi shuwa ka Sabbaton bad namar ba ka jingtap ka don ha syndah , ki la buh ïa ka met U Jisu hangta .
translation.en: There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews  preparation day  ; for the sepulchre was nigh at hand .
For they considered not the miracle of the loaves : for their heart was hardened .
translation.kha: namar kim pat shym la sngewthuh ïa ka jingmut bashisha jong ka jingbsa ïa ki san hajar ngut ; ki jingmut jong ki kim lah ban ïohkem ïa kata .
Wat thaw bad mane ïa kano kan ka dur ba la shoiñ da kano kano ka jait nong .
translation.en: Thou shalt make thee no molten gods .
Hear , I beseech thee , and I will speak : I will demand of thee , and declare thou unto me .
translation.kha: Me ong ïa nga ban shahshkor katba me dang kren bad ban pyrshang ban jubab ïa ki jingkylli jong me .

translation.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils , by whom do your children cast them out ? therefore they shall be your judges .
translation.kha: Phi ong ba nga beh noh ïa ki ksuid namar ba u Beelsebul u ai ha nga ka bor ban leh kumta . Ñiuma , te , mano ba ai ha ki briew jong phi ka bor ban beh noh ïa ki ? Kaei kaba ki briew jong phi hi ki leh ka pynshisha ba phi bakla !
Ha shuwa ba un pynkut ïa ka jingkren , u Jonathan , u khun jong u Anaharath u lyngdoh , u la wan poi . Ale rung , u Ahian u ong . Me long u briew uba bha — me dei ban wanrah ka khubor kaba bha .
translation.en: And while he yet spake , behold , Jonathan the son of Abiathar the priest came : and Adonijah said unto him , Come in  ; for thou art a valiant man , and bringest good tidings .

translation.kha: U jop thiaw da kaba pynïap ïa ki naduh Aroer haduh ka thain Minnith , baroh ki lama arphew tylli ki nongbah , malade haduh Babel Keramim . Ka la don ka jingpynïap Briew kaba jur , bad ki Ammon ki shahjop ha ki Israel .
translation.en: And he smote them from Aroer , even till thou come to Minnith , even twenty cities , and unto the plain of the vineyards , with a very great slaughter . Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Pynban don na phi ki bymngeit . ( U Jehu u la tipthuh naduh kaba mynnyngkong kino ki dien kita ki ban ym ngeit bad uno na ki u ban shetkylla ïa u . )
translation.en: But there are some of you that believe not .  For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not , and who should betray him .

translation.kha: Ki brai uba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa ka rukom ba u la hikai , namar um long kum ki nonghikai ka Hukum ; hynriewphew u la khwai da ka bor .
translation.en: And they were astonished at his doctrine : for he taught them as one that had authority , and not as the scribes .

translation.kha: ( Kiba sah na kiba ïap kim shym la im pat dat ynda ki shihajar snem ki la kut . ) Kane ka dei ka jingpynmihpat kaba nyngkong ïa kaba ïap .
translation.en: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished . This is the first resurrection .
And it came to pass , when he had been there a long time , that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window , and saw , and , behold , Isaac was sporting with Rebekah his wife .
translation.kha: Haba u Isaak u la don hangta katto katne por , u syiem Abimelekh u peit na ka jingkhangïit bad u ïohi ïa u Isaak bad ka Rebekka ba ki ïaleh ieit .
Ha man ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait u Pilat u la dat Ban pyllaitluid ïa uwei na ki koidi na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: ( For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast . )
If the iron be blunt , and he do not whet the edge , then must he put to more strength : but wisdom is profitable to direct .
translation.kha: Lada u sdie jong phi u luin bad phim shym shut pynnep ïa u , phi hap ban trei kham tyngeh ban pyndonkam ïa u . Ka long kaba kham don jingmut ban pynkhreh lypa .
Phi , phyrnai ïap ha kane ka ri khlaw .
translation.en: But as for you , your carcases , they shall fall in this wilderness .

translation.kha: Bun haba U Trai u la pyndep ïa keiñ kiei kiba bha baroh kiba u la kylluid ïa phi bad ba u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem ki Jerusalem’ ,
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when the  Lord  shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee , and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel  ;

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u Ong : Ka sngap ïa kabu sa la kren kuna wan da shisha .
translation.en: Behold , it is come , and it is done , saith the Lord  God   ; this is the day whereof I have spoken .

translation.kha: Kin ym lah shuh ban bam ïa ka doh lem bad ka snam ha ka , lane ïa kiwei pat ki jingbam ba la mana . Baroh kiba lait im kin long ka boitha jong ki briew jong nga bad kin long kumta ka kur ha ka jait Judah . Ka Ekron lai kylla long ka bynta jong ki briew jong nga , kumba ki Jebus ki la long .
translation.en: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth , and his abominations from between his teeth : but he that remaineth , even he , shall be for our God , and he shall be as a governor in Judah , and Ekron as a Jebusite .

translation.kha: dem kata keiñ balei ba ngi ïai duwai borabor na ka bynta jong phi . Ngi kyrpad ïa U Blei jong ngi ban pynlong ïa phi kba bit ïa ka jingim naba u la khot ïa phi ban im . Ai ba un pyndap da ka bor jong u ïa ka jingwoh jongki phi baroh na ka bynta ka jingtah bad ban pynïap ïa ka jingtrei ka jingngeit jong phira .
translation.en: Wherefore also we pray always for you , that our God would count you worthy of this calling , and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness , and the work of faith with power :

translation.kha: Da kaweh pyndonkam ïa ka jingai kaba U Bel u la ai ha nga , nga la trei ïa ka kam u Rangbah nongtei uba tbit bad na la seng ïa ka nongrim , bad uwei pat u tei halor jong ka . Hynrei uwei pa uwei u Dei ban sumar kynum u tei .
translation.en: According to the grace of God which is given unto me , as a wise masterbuilder , I have laid the foundation , and another buildeth thereon . But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon .

translation.kha: U Trai u Ong , Leit phad noh shiah ka ri khlaw naba hajan Tamarisk , bad nangta rung shapoh ka nongbah bad pynjlan ïa u Hasael kumno u syiem ka Syria ;
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Go , return on thy way to the wilderness of Damascus : and when thou comest , anoint Hazael to be king over Syria :
And they possessed his land , and the land of Og king of Bashan , two kings of the Amorites , which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising  ;
translation.kha: Ki la ïohknieh ïa ka ri jong u bad ïa ka ri u Og u syiem Bashan , uwei pat u syiem Amor uba shong sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan .

translation.en: And all these blessings shall come on thee , and overtake thee , if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the  Lord  thy God .
translation.kha: Kohnguh ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , te kine ki jingkyrkhu baroh kin wan ha phi .
Pha hikai ruh , ‘ Lada uno isangsot u syiem da ka duwan , ïa u ym shym la teh da ka jingaiei jong u ; hyndai lada u smai da ka jingai sngewbha Halor ka kharai , u erlangthari uba la shah teh .’
translation.en: And , Whosoever shall swear by the altar , it is nothing  ; but whosoever sweareth by the gift that is upon it , he is guilty .

translation.kha: katno katai snem hadien , ha ka aïom ot , u khynnah u la mih shabar ha kawei ka step ban leit sha la u kpa jong u , uba don ha lyngkha lymne bad ki nongot kew .
translation.en: And when the child was grown , it fell on a day , that he went out to his father to the reapers .

translation.kha: Haba ki pyllut Israel ki la dep bynta ïa ka ri , ki la ai ha u Joshua u khun jong u Nun shi bynta jongnga ka ri kum ka jingïohkynti jong u .
translation.en: When they had made an end of dividing the land for inheritance by their coasts , the children of Israel gave an inheritance to Joshua the son of Nun among them :

translation.kha: lane ha kano Kana ka lyngkhot jaiñ linen ne jaiñsem saiwul , litar ha ka snieh , lane ha kaei kaei kaba la shna da ka snieh ,
translation.en: Whether it be in the warp , or woof  ; of linen , or of woollen  ; whether in a skin , or in any thing made of skin  ;

translation.kha: U la nang pynbha , bad u la kylla long uba riewspah eh .
translation.en: And the man waxed great , and went forward , and grew until he became very great :
As the fining pot for silver , and the furnace for gold  ; so is a man to his praise .
translation.kha: Ka ding ka phrang ïa ka ksiar bad ka rupa ; ïa ka nam u briew lah ruh ban phrang .

translation.en: Out of that land went forth Asshur , and builded Nineveh , and the city Rehoboth , and Calah ,
translation.kha: Na kata ka ri u leit sa sha Assyria , bad u tei hangta ïa ki nongbah ka Ninebeh , ka Rehoboth Ir , ka Kalah ,
Ïwei uba lah ban pynjrong ïa u ban plie ïa ki tyngam jong u , katba la ker da kito ki bniat uba itriem ?
translation.en: Who can open the doors of his face ? his teeth are terrible round about .

translation.kha: Phi baroh ar nongput phi tip ba nga la trei na ka bynta i pa jong phin katba kot la ka bor .
translation.en: And ye know that with all my power I have served your father .

translation.kha: Ki ïaleh ban phai lyndet na la . Kane sa lyngktar namar ka lyngktop kaba ban ïa ki , Hynrei yn ym don ban sheng ïa ka na ki .
translation.en: And my people are bent to backsliding from me : though they called them to the most High , none at all would exalt him .
He hath builded against me , and compassed me with gall and travail .
translation.kha: U la set ïa nga ha ka ïingbyndi jong ka jingjynjar bad ka jinglyng-a .

translation.en: He couched , he lay down as a lion , and as a great lion : who shall stir him up ? Blessed is he that blesseth thee , and cursed is he that curseth thee .
translation.kha: Kane ka jaitbynriew ka long kum u sing uba khlaiñ ; Haba u thiah , ym don ba nud ban kyrsiew ïa u . Uta uba kyrkhu ïa ki Israel un ïoh jingkyrkhu , Bad uta uba tim ïa ki Israel un ïoh ka jingtim .

Haba me smat jingkheiñ ïa ka jingdon ki paid Israel , uwei pa uwei u briew u dei ban sieh ïa nga ïa ka dor na ka bynta la ka jingim , khnang ba kano kano kaba sniew kan ym wan ha u katba dang shim jingkheiñ .
translation.en: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number , then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the  Lord  , when thou numberest them  ; that there be no plague among them , when thou numberest them .
If there come any unto you , and bring not this doctrine , receive him not into your house , neither bid him God speed :
translation.kha: Te kumta , lada uno uno u wan ha phi khlem da wallam ïa kane ka jinghikai , to wat pdiang sngewbha ïa u ha ki ïing jong phi ; to wat da ong ,  To ka jingsuk kan long bad phi .
Kumta ki la phah khot ïa ki briew kiba pang ha baroh ki jaka sawdong jong ka ri bad ki la wallam ïa ki sha U Jisu .
translation.en: And when the men of that place had knowledge of him , they sent out into all that country round about , and brought unto him all that were diseased  ;

translation.kha: U Jisu u la bteng , Mynta bad kaei nga ia ban nujor ïa ki briew jong kane ka juk ? Ki long kiba kumno ?
translation.en: And the Lord said ,  Whereunto then shall I liken the men of this generation ? and to what are they like ?
And it shall come to pass , that all they that look upon thee shall flee from thee , and say , Nineveh is laid waste : who will bemoan her ? whence shall I seek comforters for thee ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiba ïohi ïa pha kin kynran dien . Kin ong , ‘ Ka Ninebeh ka don ha ki jingjot ! Mano ba don kano kano ka jingisynei ïa ka ? Mano ba kwah ban pyntngen ïa ka ?’

translation.en: And as soon as he had spoken , immediately the leprosy departed from him , and he was cleansed .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi ka jingpang ka iehnoh ïa uta u briew , bad u la long khuid .

translation.en: I was set up from everlasting , from the beginning , or ever the earth was .
translation.kha: Ïa nga la thaw ha kaba sdang eh , ha kaba nyngkong , shuwa ba ka pyrthei kan sdang .

Ka met jong u ka tyngshaiñ khim u mawlynnai . Ka durkhmat jong u ka thaba kum ka jingthaba ka leilieh , bad ki khmat jong u ki la meh kum ka ding . Ki ki bun ki kjat jong u ki tyngam kumto ka ïohnong ba la shut phin , bad ka sur jong u ka kamar-tama kamon ka jingkyrhuh u paidbah bhabriew .
translation.en: His body also was like the beryl , and his face as the appearance of lightning , and his eyes as lamps of fire , and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass , and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude .
Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies : my house shall be built in it , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la wan phai pat sha Jerusalem ban pyn-i jingisynei ïa ka nongbah . Yn pynïeng pat ïa ka Templ jong nga , bad ïa ka nongbah yn tei pat .
Haba u Hiram u leit jngoh ïa kita ki shnong , um mon ïa ki .
translation.en: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him  ; and they pleased him not .
And I will set my glory among the heathen , and all the heathen shall see my judgment that I have executed , and my hand that I have laid upon them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ngan shah ïa ki jaitbynriew ba kin ïohi ïa ka burom jong nga ; bad ngan pynpaw ha ki kumno nga pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong nga ban pyndep ïa ki jingrai bahok jong nga .
Kumta u briew uba shongkurim u kun ïa kiba dei , hynrei uta u bym shongkurim u ai ïa kaba kham bol .
translation.en: So then he that giveth her in marriage doeth well ; but he that giveth her not in marriage doeth better .
The wind hath bound her up in her wings , and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices .
translation.kha: Yn sa rong noh ïa ki kumba kit da ka lyer , bad kin sa shah ka jinglehrain namar ba ki kñia ha ki blei thala .

translation.en: And he sent messengers throughout all Manasseh  ; who also was gathered after him : and he sent messengers unto Asher , and unto Zebulun , and unto Naphtali  ; and they came up to meet them .
translation.kha: U phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha kylleng ki bynta jong ka jaka ki Manasseh ban khot ïa ki ban bud ïa u . U phah ïa ki nonglamktien sha ki jait Asher , Sebulun , bad ki Naphtali , bad ki ruh ki la wan ban ïasoh bad u .
To jingñiewburom ïa baroh , to ieit ïa la ki parabangeit , to tiengburom ïa U Blei , bun pynïohburom ïa u Patsha .
translation.en: Honour all men . Love the brotherhood . Fear God . Honour the king .
And they did all eat , and were filled : and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full .
translation.kha: Baroh ki la bam bad ki la kdang . Nangta ki synran ki la lum hynñiew tukri pura jong ki lyngkhot kiba sah tam .
Lada Une uno u turoi ïaleh ïa pha u leh ïa ka khlem ka jingïaroh jong nga ; uno du suba ïaleh pyrshah ïa pha un kyllon noh .
translation.en: Behold , they shall surely gather together , but not by me : whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake .
Then the man that lay with her shall give unto the damsel s father fifty shekels of silver , and she shall be his wife  ; because he hath humbled her , he may not put her away all his days .
translation.kha: uta u briew u dei ban siew ïa u kpa jong kata ka briew sanphew tylli ki sbai rupa , bad kata ka briew kan long ka tnga jong u , namar u la pynbor ïa ka ban ïathiah shongkha bad u . Katba u dang im um lah shuh ban pyllait ïa ka .
Da shisha , nga ong ha phi , u kynrad un buh ïa uta u shakri ba khmih ïa ka jingdon jingbam lad u baroh .
translation.en: Of a truth I say unto you , that he will make him ruler over all that he hath .

translation.kha: u la ong ha u Hasael , uwei na ki rangbah synran jong u , Khlieh leit rah ka jingai sngewbha ïa u nongïalap , bad kyrpang ïa u ban kylli na U Tiras la lang koit biang ne em .
translation.en: And the king said unto Hazael , Take a present in thine hand , and go , meet the man of God , and enquire of the  Lord  by him , saying , Shall I recover of this disease ?

translation.kha: Ha ka jingïap jong u , u Ahishahar u khunlung jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: So Ahab slept with his fathers  ; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead .
Surely I would take it upon my shoulder , and bind it as a crown to me .
translation.kha: ngan sdien ïa kita ha la ka tyrpeng da kaba sngewsarong bad ngan buh ïa ki ha ka khlieh kum ka pansngiat .

Ka khor shaphang U Khrist ka la shong skhem ha phi kat haduh ba kino shym duh noh ban pdiang wat tong ïa kaei ka jingkyrkhu , kat pa dang ap khmih lynti ba yn pynpaw ïa U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .
translation.en: So that ye come behind in no gift ; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ :

translation.kha: Bad u la bteng da kaba ong Shu Shuah ha u Sadok , Peit shane , khie ïalam noh ïa u Ahimaas , u khun jong me bad ïa u Jonathan u khun jong u Abiathar sha ka nongbah ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: The king said also unto Zadok the priest , Art not thou a seer ? return into the city in peace , and your two sons with you , Ahimaaz thy son , and Jonathan the son of Abiathar .
But I will lie with my fathers , and thou shalt carry me out of Egypt , and bury me in their buryingplace . And he said , I will do as thou hast said .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ba phin tep ïa nga bad la ki kpa tymmen ; rah ïa nga na Ijipt , bad tep ïa nga ha ka jaka ba la tep ïa ki .  U Joseph u jubab ,  Ngan leh kumba phi ong .

Katba u Josaïah u long syiem , u Neko u syiem ka Ijipt u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai sha ka wah Ïuphratis shun ïarap ïa u patsha ka Assyria . U syiem Josaïah u la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa ka kynhun shipai ki Ijipt ha Megiddo mala u la shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translation.en: In his days Pharaoh–neco king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates : and king Josiah went against him  ; and he slew him at Megiddo , when he had seen him .
Therefore thou shalt set thy face toward the siege of Jerusalem , and thine arm shall be uncovered , and thou shalt prophesy against it .
translation.kha: Phai beit ïa la ki khmat sha ka Jerusalem ba la shah kerkut , pynkhih ïa la ka kti ba la kham , sha ka phang ka nongbah bad ïathuhlypa pyrshah ïa ka .
U Ehud u la ïohbor katba ki dang ïa-ap . U la leit napdeng ki maw ba la thawdur bad u leit tad sha Seirah .
translation.en: And Ehud escaped while they tarried , and passed beyond the quarries , and escaped unto Seirath .

translation.kha: Me pyllait im ïa kito kiba sngewrit , hynrei me pynjynjar ïa kito kiba sarong .
translation.en: And the afflicted people thou wilt save : but thine eyes are upon the haughty , that thou mayest bring them down .
For if there be first a willing mind , it is accepted according to that a man hath , and not according to that he hath not .
translation.kha: Lada phi thrang ban ai , U Blei un pdiang ïa ka jingai jong phi ha ka nongrim jong kaei kaba phi dei ban ai , ym halor kaei kaba phim don .

translation.en: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; I remember thee , the kindness of thy youth , the love of thine espousals , when thou wentest after me in the wilderness , in a land that was not sown .
translation.kha: ban pynbna ïa kane ka khubor ha uwei pa uwei ha Jerusalem ,  Nga kynmaw kumno phi la long kiba ïaineh mynba phi dang khynnah , kumno phi la ieit ïa nga mynba ngi dang shongkurim nyngkong ; phi la bud ïa nga lyngba ka ri shyiap , lyngba ka ri ka bym pat shym la thung jingthung .

Kumta U Moses u ong , Ha kata ka ri kaba phin ïohkynti , ki briew ki shahshkor ïa Aner kiba shat kiba kheiñ bad naba wad ïa ki ki ki shin , hynrei U Trai U Blei jong phi u ksiang ïa phi Ban leh kumta .
translation.en: For these nations , which thou shalt possess , hearkened unto observers of times , and unto diviners : but as for thee , the  Lord  thy God hath not suffered thee so to do .
And as they came down from the mountain , he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen , till the Son of man were risen from the dead .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang wan hiar na u lum , U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohi , tad haduh ba U Khun U Briew u la mihpat na ka jingïap .
kiba la paw ha ka burom ba kynja banyngkong bad ki la ïakren bad U Jisu shaphrang ka rukom ha kaba shon un sa pyndep ïa ka jingïathmu jong U Blei da naba ïap ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: Who appeared in glory , and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Kim dei ban khuslai ei ei shaphang la ki jingdon jingem ba ki hap ieh , Namar kiba bha tam ha ka ri Joppa baroh kawei kin long ki lad ki .
translation.en: Also regard not your stuff  ; for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours .

translation.kha: Ka kynthup shiteng jong ka Gilead , lem ruh pynlang ka Ataroth bad Edrei , ki nongbah jong ka hima u Og ha Bashngain . Ïa Kanneh baroh la ai ha kaba shiteng jongki ki long kiba hiarpateng na u Makhir u khun jong u Manasseh .
translation.en: And half Gilead , and Ashtaroth , and Edrei , cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan , were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh , even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families .

translation.kha: Nga kloi don ong ïa kaba don ha ka jingmut jong nga .
translation.en: Behold , now I have opened my mouth , my tongue hath spoken in my mouth .

translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Abraham ban ïoh long u kpa , wat long u la tymmen bha bad ka sarew hi kam lah ban ïoh khun . U la shaniah ba U Blei un bangeit ïa la ka kular .
translation.en: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed , and was delivered of a child when she was past age , because she judged him faithful who had promised .

translation.kha: Ka praw ba nga ai ha Phin mandriek ka sngi kada dei kaba eh ban sngewthuh lane kaba sha palat ka bor jong phi .
translation.en: For this commandment which I command thee this day , it is not hidden from thee , neither is it far off .

translation.kha: Ka sngi tud wan ha kaba yn pynkut ïa ka jingsarong ba kynja briew bad yn pynjot thiaw ïa ka jinglehmeng ba kynja briew . Nangta tang ïa U thri hi yn kyntiew donburom .
translation.en: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled , and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down , and the  Lord  alone shall be exalted in that day .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Simon bad ki paralok jong u ki la leit wad ïa u ,
translation.en: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him .

translation.kha: Ki long ki shipor ha ka riam shipai ba rong jngum , ki riew kynsai bad ki rangbah shipai bahakhlieh ; baroh na ki , ki longsyiem ki samla shipai ba-bhabriew .
translation.en: Which were clothed with blue , captains and rulers , all of them desirable young men , horsemen riding upon horses .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor jong U Blei shaneng ki mrad jong ka ri shyiap bashathie : Ki nongkit tiensyiem ki ïaid lyngba ka ri bashyrkhei , ha kaba ki sing ki don bad ha kiba ki bseiñ kiba don bih bad ki Ïakjakor kiba her . Ki pynkit halor ki kada bad ki ut jong ki da ki jingai sngewbha baremdor na ka bynta ka hima ka bym lah ban ai ïa ki kano kano ka jingïarap .
translation.en: The burden of the beasts of the south : into the land of trouble and anguish , from whence come the young and old lion , the viper and fiery flying serpent , they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses , and their treasures upon the bunches of camels , to a people that shall not profit them .
And he said , Peace be to you , fear not : your God , and the God of your father , hath given you treasure in your sacks : I had your money . And he brought Simeon out unto them .
translation.kha: Uta u shakri u ong ,  Wat khuslai . Wat sheptieng ruh . Dei U Blei jong phi , U Blei jong u kpa jong phi , uba la thep ïa ki pisa ha ki byrni jong phi na ka bynta jong phi . Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka dor ba phi la siew .  Nangta u wan ïalam ïa u Simeon sha ki .
Ha ka hukum jong U Blei kiei Kiei kiba khraw ki jia , kiei kiwei kiba phylla kiba ngim eh ban sngewthuh .
translation.en: God thundereth marvellously with his voice  ; great things doeth he , which we cannot comprehend .
And a mighty king shall stand up , that shall rule with great dominion , and do according to his will .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem bashlur un mihpaw . Un synshar halor ka hima bakhraw bad un leh ïa kaei kaei kaba u kwah .

translation.en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar , and of the hazel and chesnut tree  ; and pilled white strakes in them , and made the white appear which was in the rods .
translation.kha: U Jakob u shim ïa ki tnat kiba dang im na ka dieng lieng , u diengsoh almond , bad u dieng Sning , bad u khoh snep ha katto katne jaka haduh ba ki tnat dieng kin da paw ka met lieh .

translation.en: And it came to pass about three months after , that it was told Judah , saying , Tamar thy daughter in law hath played the harlot  ; and also , behold , she is with child by whoredom . And Judah said , Bring her forth , and let her be burnt .
translation.kha: Kumba lai bnai hadien kane , don ba ïathuh ha u Judah ,  Ka pyrsa kurim jong phi ka la leh kum ka nuti , bad mynta ka la punkhun .   Sei shabar ïa ka , bad thang im ïa ka ,  ong u Judah .
( Loukas 23 :43 ) Shuh shuh yn sa pynmihpat ïa ki milian nud ki bri kiba la ïaw sha ka jingrem ha kane ka pyrthei .
translation.en: ( Luke 23 :43 ) Also , millions of dead ones will be resurrected to human life on the earth .

translation.kha: Pynbna ha u paidbah , ‘ Uno uno uba sheptieng u dei ïa-ban leit phai noh sha ïing , bad ngi ngin hukum hangne ha u lum Gilead .’ Kut phraphew ar hajar lwet ki otsher phai noh , bad shiphew hajar ngut ki sah .
translation.en: Now therefore go to , proclaim in the ears of the people , saying , Whosoever is fearful and afraid , let him return and depart early from mount Gilead . And there returned of the people twenty and two thousand  ; and there remained ten thousand .

translation.kha: Naba ka Hima U Blei kam long ha Kaba bam bad ka dih , hynrei ka long ka hok , ka jingsuk , bad ka jingmeng kiba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ai .
translation.en: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink ; but righteousness , and peace , and joy in the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U Trai un ong shaphang ka bri sohwaiñ ba-itynnat jong u ,
translation.en: In that day sing ye unto her , A vineyard of red wine .

And the coast descended unto the river Kanah , southward of the river : these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh : the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river , and the outgoings of it were at the sea :
translation.kha: Nangta u pud u hiar arsut sha ka wahduid Kanah . Ki nongbah kiba shathie jong ka wahduid ki dei jong ki jait Ephraim , wat la ki hap hapoh ka ri Manasseh . U pud ka Manasseh u suh ter ter na ka phud bashatei jong ka wahduid bad u kut ha ka Duriaw Mediterranian .
Katba U Jisu u dang shongkha hajan ka jaka lum jingkynshew ha ka Templ , u la khmih ïa ki briew kato ki ïalang pyneh ïa ka pisa jongno ki . Bun Ibbah riewspah ki la pynnoh shibun ka pisa ;
translation.en: And Jesus sat over against the treasury , and beheld how the people cast money into the treasury : and many that were rich cast in much .

translation.kha: Ki nongïathuhlypa ki ïam bakla ïa ki bynriew jngai nga da kaba ong ba baroh ka bit ka biang . Baroh kam erlangthari shisha katba kismis babiang ! Ki briew jong nga ki la pynïeng ka kynroh ki maw bym skhem , bad nangta ki nongïathuhlypa ki la wan bad ki klop ïa ka da ka jingpushara jlih .
translation.en: Because , even because they have seduced my people , saying , Peace  ; and there was no peace  ; and one built up a wall , and , lo , others daubed it with untempered mortar :

translation.kha: Ngan wallam bun ki lapbah ban pynjot ïa kane ka nongbah jong me bad ban rah mar shi kham ka khyndew ha ki kiei jong ki . Ai ba ki blei kin Saw ïap ïa nga lada ngam leh kumta !
translation.en: And Ben–hadad sent unto him , and said , The gods do so unto me , and more also , if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me .

translation.kha: U riewspah u la jubab , ‘ Kata mana pat biang , ko kpa Abraham ! Hynrei lada uno uno u mihpat na ka jingïap bad leit shata ki , te kin phai noh na ki thup jong ki .’
translation.en: And he said , Nay , father Abraham : but if one went unto them from the dead , they will repent .

translation.kha: U Trai u khmih sumar ïa iar kiba kohnguh ïa u , ïa iar kiba shongkhia ha ka jingieit baneh jong u ,
translation.en: Behold , the eye of the  Lord  is upon them that fear him , upon them that hope in his mercy  ;
After Armageddon , earth will be made into a paradise
translation.kha: Hadien ka Armagedon , yn sa pynlong ïa ka pyrthei ka Paradais

Wat ki shipai ba Shuh wai jong ka ki long khlem bor koum ki khun masi . Kim shym ïeng ban ïaleh ; baroh na ki , ki phai malade phet khong . Ka sngi jong ka jingshahjop ka la Nakon , ka por jong ka jingpynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks  ; for they also are turned back , and are fled away together : they did not stand , because the day of their calamity was come upon them , and the time of their visitation .

translation.kha: shisyndon mynba ki paidbah babun ki la ïalade lem bad U Jisu , u la phai sha ki sad u la ong ha ki ,
translation.en: And there went great multitudes with him : and he turned , and said unto them ,

translation.kha: Ngi la sheptieng bad kordit . Ngi thrang dik dik ba U Blei un pyllait ïa ngi na ka jingbanbeiñ bad jingleh bymkhuid hynrei kam shngiam jia long kumta .
translation.en: We roar all like bears , and mourn sore like doves : we look for judgment , but there is none  ; for salvation , but it is far off from us .
Or if his sin , which he hath sinned , come to his knowledge : then he shall bring his offering , a kid of the goats , a female without blemish , for his sin which he hath sinned .
translation.kha: te un tang shu tip ba u la leh pop kumta , un wallam kum ka jingainguh jong u ïa ka blang kynthei ka bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
Ha kata ka por ka Hima ki bteng kan longïing kumno . Shisien la anna u briew u ban sa leit jingleit ; u la khot ïa ki shakri jong u bad u la nguh ïa ki ba khmih ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u .
translation.en: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country , who called his own servants , and delivered unto them his goods .

translation.kha: Kumta te ki dieng ki ong ha u dieng sohwaiñ , ‘ Ai wan Bad long u syiem jong ngi .’
translation.en: Then said the trees unto the vine , Come thou , and reign over us .

translation.kha: U Abiram u shongkurim ïa ka Jokhebed , ka para jong u kpa jong u , bad ka la kha ïa u Aaron bad u Moses . U Amram u la im haduh shispah laiphew hynñiew snem ka rta .
translation.en: And Amram took him Jochebed his father s sister to wife  ; and she bare him Aaron and Moses : and the years of the life of Amram were an hundred and thirty and seven years .
Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish , of the beeves , of the sheep , or of the goats .
translation.kha: khnang ba yn pdiang hun ïa ka , ka dei ban long da u masi , ne da u langbrot , ne da u  langsohmoh u bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

translation.en: And God hath both raised up the Lord , and will also raise up us by his own power .
translation.kha: U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa U Trai na ka jingïap , bad un pynmihpat ruh ïa ngi da ka bor jong u .

translation.en: Now when all this was finished , all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah , and brake the images in pieces , and cut down the groves , and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin , in Ephraim also and Manasseh , until they had utterly destroyed them all . Then all the children of Israel returned , every man to his possession , into their own cities .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka Jingkhawai Niam ka la kut , baroh ki paid Israel ki leit sha kawei pa kawei ka nongbah ha Judah bad ki pynpra ïa ki rishot maw , ki pyndkut ïa ki dur ka blei Asherah , bad ki pynjot ïa ki duwan bad ki jaka mane blei thala . Ki leh ïa kajuh ha baroh ki bynta basah jong ka Judah , bad ïa ki ri jong ki Benjamin , Ephraim bad Manasseh ; nangta baroh na ki , ki leit phai sha ïing .

Hobab u Peris u la ïew ïa ki paidbah , u la ong ha ki , Ko para Israel , balei phi ïakyndit ha kñia , nabar balei ba phi peit seh ïa ngi ? Hato phi pynkoit ba ka dei da ka bor jyllang ngi hi lane da ka jingriewblei jong moi hi ba ngi la pynlong ïa une u briew ban ïaid ?
translation.en: And when Peter saw it , he answered unto the people , Ye men of Israel , why marvel ye at this ? or why look ye so earnestly on us , as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk ?
To whom we gave place by subjection , no , not for an hour ; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you .
translation.kha: Ki da kwah ban pynlong mraw ïa ngi , hynrei khnang ban pynneh ïa ka jingshisha ka Gospel na ka bynta jong phi , ngim shym la ailad ïa ki wat tang shi minit ruh .

Lada u pynkheiñ ïa ka shyiap , yn pynkheiñ kylliang ïa kiwei na ki shyieng jong u ; lada u pynmatlah ïa u na kawei ka khmat , yn pynmatlah ïakylliang ïa kawei na ki khmat jong u ; lada u lop ïa kawei ka bniat , yn lap kylliang ïa kawei na ki bniat jong u . Kumba u la pynmynsaw ïa uno uno u briew , kumta ruh yn pynstang kylliang ïa u .
translation.en: Breach for breach , eye for eye , tooth for tooth : as he hath caused a blemish in a man , so shall it be done to him again .
And Joshua returned , and all Israel with him , unto the camp to Gilgal .
translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Joshua bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki leit phai pat sha ka jaka shong dara ha Gilgal .

translation.en: For such are false apostles , deceitful workers , transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ .
translation.kha: Kito ki briew kim long ki apostol kiba shisha — ki long ki apostol lamler , kiba shukor shaphang ka jingtrei jong ki bad thawdur ïa lade ban i kum ki apostol bashisha jong U Khrist .
Ki rangbah sorkar ki lama kum ki suri kiba patar lyngkhot ïa ki mrad ba ki la pynpoh . Ki pyndap bynriew ba kin ïohi riewspah .
translation.en: Her princes in the midst thereof are like wolves ravening the prey , to shed blood , and to destroy souls , to get dishonest gain .

Yet was she carried away , she went into captivity : her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets : and they cast lots for her honourable men , and all her great men were bound in chains .
translation.kha: Pynban ïa ki briew jong ka Thebes la rah noh sha ka jinglongmraw . Ha kawei pa kawei ka kyndong jong ka lynti bah ïa ki khun jong ki la tied pynïap . Ïa ki rangbah bapawkhmat jong ki la ïalam noh ha ki kynjri bad la pynïabynta hapdeng ki nongkurup .
U Jehosabad u pynlong jingïasuk bad u syiem Israel .
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel .

translation.kha: Uno uno uba dang dih dud u dang long u khynnah , khlem pat don kano katno ka jingshemphang ïa kaei kaba dei bad ka bymdei .
translation.en: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness : for he is a babe .

translation.kha: U shim ïa la u diengduh bad u tam san tylli ki maw uba jlih na ka wahduid badno u thep ïa ki ha ka pla ksing jrong u . Lem bad ka jingshat maw ha kti , u tad ban ïakynduh ïa u Goliath .
translation.en: And he took his staff in his hand , and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook , and put them in a shepherd s bag which he had , even in a scrip  ; and his sling was in his hand : and he drew near to the Philistine .

translation.kha: Ngi pyntip ba ha kiei kiei baroh , U Blei u trei na ka bynta ka jingpynbha ïa kito uba ieit ïa u , ïa kito ïa kiba u la khot kat kumne ka jingthmu jong u .
translation.en: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God , to them who are the called according to his purpose .

translation.kha: U Shuppim Bad u Huppim ruh ki long na kane ka jait . U Dan u ba-don uwei u khun , u Hushim .
translation.en: Shuppim also , and Huppim , the children of Ir , and Hushim , the sons of Aher .
They say unto him , Because no man hath hired us . He saith unto them , Go ye also into the vineyard  ; and whatsoever is right , that shall ye receive .
translation.kha: ‘ Ym don mano mano ba khot bylla ïa ngi ,’ ki la jubab . ‘ Lada kumta , te , phi ruh khie leit bad trei ha ka bri sohwaiñ ,’ u la ong ha ki .
U Trai u khmih sumar ïa kito kiba kohnguh ïa u , ïa kito kiba shano ha ka jingieit banleh jong u ,
translation.en: Behold , the eye of the  Lord  is upon them that fear him , upon them that hope in his mercy  ;

translation.kha: Khmut U Jisu u la leit phai pat bad ki sha Naïoth , ha kaba u la kohnguh ïa ki . Ka kilomitar jong u ka la kynshew ïa kine kiei kiei baroh hapoh la ka dohnud .
translation.en: And he went down with them , and came to Nazareth , and was subject unto them : but his mother kept all these sayings in her heart .

translation.kha: To ïalam ïa ki nongap phira , u Pilat u la ong ïa ki , Khie otsher bad to pynskhem ïa ka jingtep kat kaba phi Lah .
translation.en: Pilate said unto them , Ye have a watch : go your way , make it as sure as ye can .

translation.kha: Nga la synreit ha ka ïa ka jingiwbih kaba da ka mirr , ka alos , bad ka siasia .
translation.en: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh , aloes , and cinnamon .

translation.kha: Ngan beh kthong ïa ki da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang , mala baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin sngewtriem ha kaei kaba ki ïohi . kadlieng ïakylliang na pynsakma ïa ki , ki biria kin kyntu pynlang sngewlehrain ha kaei kaba la jia ha ki . Ki briew kin jingkrenbeiñ ïa ki bad pyndonkam ïa ki kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingkem .
translation.en: And I will persecute them with the sword , with the famine , and with the pestilence , and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth , to be a curse , and an astonishment , and an hissing , and a reproach , among all the nations whither I have driven them :

translation.kha: Kumta te , uno du uba ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien jongngi nga bad uba kohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba stai uba la Tei ïa la ka ïing ba-halor u mawsiang .
translation.en: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them , I will liken him unto a wise man , which built his house upon a rock :

translation.kha: Ki la leit haduh ka Them Jehukal bad ki la ïohi ïa ka ri , ishyrkhei ynda ki la wan pei ki la pynnoh mynsiem ïa ki briew na kaba leit rung shad ka ri ïa kaba U Trai u la ai ha ki .
translation.en: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol , and saw the land , they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel , that they should not go into the land which the  Lord  had given them .

translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ki jingkhor ïa ka Ïingjaiñ da ka dieng akasia .
translation.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood , standing up .

translation.kha: Kuth u Hushai , u paralok jong u Sabad , u la leit phai sha ka nongbah hamar ba u Absalom u dang wan poi .
translation.en: So Hushai David s friend came into the city , and Absalom came into Jerusalem .

I will seek that which was lost , and bring again that which was driven away , and will bind up that which was broken , and will strengthen that which was sick : but I will destroy the fat and the strong  ; I will feed them with judgment .
translation.kha: Ngan wad ïa kito kiba la jah , ngan wallam pat ïa kito kiba la sakma , ngan sop spaiñ ïa kito kiba la mong , bad ngan pynkhiah ïa kito kiba pang , hynrei ïa kito kiba sngaid bad kiba khlaiñ ngan sa pynjot , namar nga long u nongaplangbrot uba leh ïa kaei kaba dei .

translation.en: And it was so on the morrow , that Saul put the people in three companies  ; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch , and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day : and it came to pass , that they which remained were scattered , so that two of them were not left together .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet u Saul u pynbynta ïa u paidïapom jong u ha ki lai kynhun , bad ynda mynstep ki tur sha ka jaka shong dara ki nongshun bad tur ïaleh ïa ki Ammon . Ha ka por shiteng sngi ki la lah pynïap ïa ki . Kiba lait im ki phet ïap , marwei marwei ha la ka lynti .

translation.en: But though we , or an angel from heaven , preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you , let him be accursed .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat lada ma ngi ne u angel na bneng kin ïalap ïa ka Gospel kaba pher na kata ïa kaba ngi la ïalap ha phi , to ai ban rai pynrem ïa u sha dujok!

translation.en: Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate , Write not , The King of the Jews  ; but that he said , I am King of the Jews .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la ong ha u Pilat ,  Wat ym thoh , ‘ U Syiem ki Jiw ,’ hynrei pynban , ‘ Une u briew u la ong , nga long u Syiem ki Jiw .’

translation.en: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it  ; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith , even the bread of affliction  ; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste : that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life .
translation.kha: Haba phi bam ïa kane ka jingbam , wat bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat . Hynñiew sngi phin bam ïa u kpu khlem thiat , kumba phi la bam mynba phi la dei ban mihnoh kyrkieh na Ijipt . Bam ïa une u kpu — yn khot ïa u , u kpu ka jingshah shitom — ba katba phi dang im phin ïai kynmaw ïa kata ka sngi mynba phi mihnoh na Ijipt , kata ka jaka ka jingshah shitom .
Ki la shahjingit bad ki la duwai , ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki , bad ki la phah noh ïa ki .
translation.en: And when they had fasted and prayed , and laid their hands on them , they sent them away .

translation.kha: U Moses u la ong ha ki , Uno uno ruh um dei ban pynsah ïa ka wat tang khyndiat ruh na ka bynta kaba la shai .
translation.en: And Moses said , Let no man leave of it till the morning .
Then Rabshakeh stood , and cried with a loud voice in the Jews  language , and said , Hear ye the words of the great king , the king of Assyria .
translation.kha: Te u rangbah synshar u ïeng joit bad u pyrta ha ka ktien Hebru ,  To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba u patsha ka Assyria u ïathuh ha phi .

translation.en: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour , then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand  ; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour s standing corn .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïaid lynti na ka lyngkha kew jongno jongno , phi lah ban sip    ïa u sohkew uba phi kheit da la ki kti , hynrei phim dei ban ot ïa u da ka rashi .
Kine baroh’ ki jingbthah bad ki jinghikai .
translation.en: These things command and teach .

translation.kha: phiah lai ban bud ïa ki jingmlien jong ki bad phin ym lah shuh ban kylla .
translation.en: Lest thou learn his ways , and get a snare to thy soul .

translation.kha: myntri hangne , kane ka briew kob hiarpateng na u Abraham ïa kaba u Soitan u la khum la khatphra snem ; thah ym dei ban pyllait ïa ka ha ka sngi Sabad ?
translation.en: And ought not this woman , being a daughter of Abraham , whom Satan hath bound , lo , these eighteen years , be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day ?

translation.kha: Ki la ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron , U Trai u la ïohi ïa kadei katba phi! la leh , bad un pynshitom ïa phi nongmareh ba phi pynlong ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ban isih ïa ngi . phin la ai daw ïa ki ban pynïap ïa ine .
translation.en: And they said unto them , The  Lord  look upon you , and judge  ; because ye have made our savour to be abhorred in the eyes of Pharaoh , and in the eyes of his servants , to put a sword in their hand to slay us .
And he made the middle bar to shoot through the boards from the one end to the other .
translation.kha: U diengkhap uba hapdeng , ïa uba la pynkhap hamar shiteng kita ki jingker , u kot naduh kawei ka tduh jong ka Ïingjaiñ sha kawei pat .
Sumar ïa ki hukum U Blei bad phin im slem ; lada phi ñiuhlieh ïa ki , phin ïap .
translation.en: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul  ; but he that despiseth his ways shall die .

translation.kha: Men sa ïap halor uta u lum kumba u Aaron u hynmen jong me u la ïap ha u Lum Hor ,
translation.en: And die in the mount whither thou goest up , and be gathered unto thy people  ; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor , and was gathered unto his people :

translation.kha: kata ka nongbah kaba ïeng ha tduh jong ka durbriew bad kambah ïashakri nongpang bad ki briew kiba shong ha mon ki rud duriaw . To ong ha ka ïa kaei kaban U Trai Nongsynshar u ong : Ko Tyros , phalang sngewsarong ïa ka jingbhabriew bajanai jongngi pha .
translation.en: And say unto Tyre , O thou that art situate at the entry of the sea , which art a merchant of the people for many isles , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; O Tyre , thou hast said , I am of perfect beauty .

translation.kha: Kaba khap sniew ïa baroh , ka Long ba anna ki shngain bad ki kynthei katba shakri kum ki nuti ha kita ki jaka mane blei thala . Ki paid Judah ki la leh ïa kine ki kam kiba ilehrain ba ju leh da Kito ki briew ïa kiba U Tharai u la biah ei na ka ri katba ki Israel ki dong lytar kurup ïa ka .
translation.en: And there were also sodomites in the land : and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the  Lord  cast out before the children of Israel .

translation.kha: ino Un u briew uba pyllait noh ïa ka tnga jngai u bad sohkhram ïa kawei pat ka briew u klim ; bad u briew uba shongkurim ïa ka brup kabu la shah pyrsad tnga u klim .
translation.en: Whosoever putteth away his wife , and marrieth another , committeth adultery : and whosoever marrieth her that is put away from her husband committeth adultery .

translation.kha: Hynrei ym kum u Kpa jong u , um shym long naba pynrit ïa lade bad phai sha U Trai ; u kham lama uba pop ban ïa kob long u kpa jong u .
translation.en: And humbled not himself before the  Lord  , as Manasseh his father had humbled himself  ; but Amon trespassed more and more .

translation.kha: Ym don ka jingsheptieng ha ka jingieit ; ka jingteh kaba janai ka beh nala ïa ka jingsheptieng baroh . Kumta te , ïa ka jingieit ym shym la pynjngai ha uno une uba sheptieng , namar ka jingsheptieng ka don jingïadei bad ka jingpynshitom .
translation.en: There is no fear in love  ; but perfect love casteth out fear : because fear hath torment . He that feareth is not made perfect in love .
Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth ? declare if thou knowest it all .
translation.kha: Hato me don jingtip haduh katno ka heh ka pyrthei ? To jubab ïa nga lada me tip .

translation.en: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin .
translation.kha: Suk u briew uba ïa ki pop jong u , U Trai un ym buh jingkynmaw shuh !

translation.en: But the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon Gideon , and he blew a trumpet  ; and Abi–ezer was gathered after him .
translation.kha: U mynsiem jong U  Trai  u bat synshar ïa u Gideon ; bad u put ïa ka turoi ban khot ïa ki rangbah na ka kur Abieser ban bud ïa u .
Ïa U Khun la pynlong uba Kham khraw ban ïa ki angel , kumba ka kthang kaba U Bel u la ai ha u ka longsem kaba kham khraw ban ïa ka jong ki .
translation.en: Being made so much better than the angels , as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they .

translation.kha: U Adonijah , ha ka jingsheptieng bakhraw ïa u Solomon , u la leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai bad u la bakut ïa ki reng kiba ha ki dohthang jong ka jingset .
translation.en: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon , and arose , and went , and caught hold on the horns of the altar .

translation.kha: Kumne ki la ong ïa u : Mynta te , ïathuh ïa ngi ! Mano uba long ka daw na ka bynta kan ? Me leh aiu hangne ? Me wan na kano ka ri ? Kaei ka jinglong traishnong jong me ?
translation.en: Then said they unto him , Tell us , we pray thee , for whose cause this evil is upon us  ; What is thine occupation ? and whence comest thou ? what is thy country ? and of what people art thou ?

translation.kha: Hodaïah u Aaron , u Abdon u ïakhun jong u Hillel uba na Pharaoh u ïalam ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel , a Pirathonite , judged Israel .
And all the wise men , that wrought all the work of the sanctuary , came every man from his work which they made  ;
translation.kha: Te ki rangbah kiba tbit kiba trei ïa ka kam ki mih na la ka jingtrei ,
To kheiñ ïa ka kyang jong me , bad ngan siew ïa ka .
translation.en: And he said , Appoint me thy wages , and I will give it .

translation.kha: lehniam U Kpa da lade hi um bishar ïano ïano . U la ai ha la U Khun ïa ka dkhoh baher ban bishar , ba baroh kin burom ïa U Khun kumba ki burom ïa U Kpa .
translation.en: For the Father judgeth no man , but hath committed all judgment unto the Son :
And Jacob said , Sell me this day thy birthright .
translation.kha: U Jakob u jubab ,  Ngan ai ïa ka lada phi ai shuwa ha nga ïa ki hok jong phi kum u khun nyngkong .
U Shimiet Salmone u la jied laiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah kum ki nongleit ba shah pynbor na kylleng ka ri Israel ,
translation.en: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel  ; and the levy was thirty thousand men .

translation.kha: Ha ka kajuh ba kin sleh jingiwbih kin sma iwkhong ; ha ka jaka ki panpoh ba-itynnat kin teh da ki tyllai barew ; ha ka jaka Ban don u shñiuh itynnat kin long kaba lyndum ; ha ka jaka ki jaiñ Ba-itynnat kin phong ki jaiñjot ; ka jingbeh jong ki kan kylla sha ka jinglehisynei .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink  ; and instead of a girdle a rent  ; and instead of well set hair baldness  ; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth  ; and burning instead of beauty .

translation.kha: Ka la phah khubor sha u Isaia : Ai ba ki blei kin pynïap ïa nga lashai kum ha kane ka por ïada ngam leh ïa kajuh kaba me la leh ïa ki jingïathuhlypa .
translation.en: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah , saying , So let the gods do to me , and more also , if I make not thy life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time .

translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka liang , u kpa jngai u , u la shukor malade lute bad u ïaw ar ïa ka sner ha uwei pa uwei baroh . Gera kumta u la ïap namar ki pop kiba ma u hi u la leh .
translation.en: As for his father , because he cruelly oppressed , spoiled his brother by violence , and did that which is not good among his people , lo , even he shall die in his iniquity .
I will also make it a possession for the bittern , and pools of water : and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkylla ïa ka Babilon sha ka ahor ktieh , bad ki dkhoh kin shong hangta . Ngan sar ïa ka Babilon da u synsar u ban sar lut khoit ïa kaei kaei baroh . Nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , nga la kren .
Kine ki long ki lyngdoh kiba te pat ïa kiba bun ki bynta kiba bud jong ka kynroh : Ki lyngdoh kiba dei na ka jaka sawdong ka Jerushah ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bujli ;
translation.en: And after him repaired the priests , the men of the plain .

translation.kha: U hap da ki khohsiew , U kyllon kram dara u thiah lyngktar ha ki kjat jong ka . Ha ki khet jong ka u thap da ki khohsiew bad u Khilion ; U Khilion kram ha madan , uba la ïap .
translation.en: At her feet he bowed , he fell , he lay down : at her feet he bowed , he fell : where he bowed , there he fell down dead .

translation.kha: Kiwei pat , ki la ong , U dei u Elijah . Kiwei ki ong , U dei u Nong ïathuhlypa , kum uwei na ki Nongïathuhlypa jongngi ki por ba-mynshuwa .
translation.en: Others said , That it is Elias . And others said , That it is a prophet , or as one of the prophets .

And the  Lord  will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion , and upon her assemblies , a cloud and smoke by day , and the shining of a flaming fire by night : for upon all the glory shall be a defence .
translation.kha: Nangta halor u Lum Seïon bad halor baroh kiba la ïalumlang hangta , U  Trai  un phah ïa u lyoh ha ka por mynsngi bad ka tdem bad ka thylliej ding baphyrnai ha ka por mynmiet . Ka burom U Blei kan tap bad da ïa ka nongbah baroh kawei .

U Moses u phai ktien , Ngan da sngewbha eh ban duwai na ka bynta jong phi . Buh da ka por lano nga dei ban kyrpad na ka bynta jong phoi , na ka bynta ki radbah pynïaidkam jong phi , badno na bynta ki briew jrong phi . Te Phon sa lait na kine ki jakoid , bad kin ym don shuh hangno hangno lait sa tyngka ha ka wah Nile .
translation.en: And Moses said unto Pharaoh , Glory over me : when shall I entreat for thee , and for thy servants , and for thy people , to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses , that they may remain in the river only ?
Daniel answered in the presence of the king , and said , The secret which the king hath demanded cannot the wise men , the astrologers , the magicians , the soothsayers , shew unto the king  ;
translation.kha: U Daniel u la jubab ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , ym don uno uno u nongleh byrtong , u nongleh myntor , u nongbatai kupar , lane u nongkhmih khlur uba lah ban ïathuh ha phi ïa kata .
La pynjahburom ïa u , bad ym shym la gospel hok ïa u . Ym don mano mano ba lah ban ïashoh shaphrang ki Kynhun ki ksiew jong u , namar ba ka jingim jong u ha ka pyrthei ka la kut .
translation.en: In his humiliation his judgment was taken away : and who shall declare his generation ? for his life is taken from the earth .
Hearken not unto them  ; serve the king of Babylon , and live : wherefore should this city be laid waste ?
translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa ki ! Pyndem ha u syiem ka Babilonia bad phin im ! Balei ba kane ka nongbah kan kylla ka kynton ki jingpra ?

translation.en: Yet he restored the money unto his mother  ; and his mother took two hundred shekels of silver , and gave them to the founder , who made thereof a graven image and a molten image : and they were in the house of Micah .
translation.kha: Kumta u pynphai pat ïa ki sha la ka kmie . Ka shim arspah tylli ki sbai rupa bad ka ai ïa ki ha u bania , uba la thaw ïa ka bleithaw , da kaba shniah ïa ka na ka dieng bad suit da ka rupa . La buh ïa ka ha ïing u Mikah .
Ki shithi ki la iehnoh ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsumar u sumar uba kyrteng u Saul .
translation.en: And cast him out of the city , and stoned him : and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man s feet , whose name was Saul .

translation.kha: lad im da ka waitlam , hynriew men long u maw jong u para jong me . Pynban haba me ïeng ban ïaleh pyrshah , Men lait na ka jingshan jong u .
translation.en: And by thy sword shalt thou live , and shalt serve thy brother  ; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion , that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck .

translation.kha: Nga un-long u Ïoannis , u pyniwbih jong phi , bad kum u nongbud jngai U Jisu nga long uba ïadon bynta lem bad phi ban ïaishah ïa ka jingjynjar kaba wan ha kito kiba long na ka Hima jong u . Ïa nga la buh ha ka dewlynnong Patmos namar nga la pynbna ïa ka Ktien U Balei bad ka jingshisha kaba U Jisu u la pynpoi .
translation.en: I John , who also am your brother , and companion in tribulation , and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ , was in the isle that is called Patmos , for the word of God , and for the testimony of Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Uta u khrawbor u ïasyriem ïa u labasa , bad ki phet kumne ki kjat dngiem bad ka jingairam u kum ka shyntur sing . U Ïakjakor u la ai ha u mradkhlaw ïa ka bor jong u hi , ïa ka khem jong u , bad ïa ka bor syier baïar jong u .
translation.en: And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard , and his feet were as the feet of a bear , and his mouth as the mouth of a lion : and the dragon gave him his power , and his seat , and great authority .

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , ngan pyndonkam ïa ka naki kaba ju long man ka sngi : Haba ar ngut ki briew ki ïamynjur phalor kano kano ka kam da kaba soi ïa ka soskular , ym don uno uno uba lah ban pynkieng ïa ka lane pynpdang ei ei ha ka .
translation.en: Brethren , I speak after the manner of men ; Though it be but a man s covenant , yet if it be confirmed , no man disannulleth , or addeth thereto .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , ibha u la pynrangbah , u Moses u otsher jngoh ïa la ki para jait , ki Hebru , bad u ïohi kumta la pynbor ïa ki ba-bang trei ïa ki kam kiba shitom sat . U ïohi ruh ïa uwei u nong Ijipt ba u pynïap ïa uwei u Hebru , u para jat Jong u Messaïah hi .
translation.en: And it came to pass in those days , when Moses was grown , that he went out unto his brethren , and looked on their burdens : and he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew , one of his brethren .

translation.kha: ( Rom 6 :19 ; 12 :1 ; 2 kyrteng 7 :1 ) Ka lah banbeiñ long kaba eh ban iehnoh ïa kine ki jingmlien .
translation.en: ( Romans 6 :19  ; 12 :1  ; 2 Corinthians 7 :1 ) It can be very hard to give up these habits .

translation.kha: U syiem Amnon u jingjubab ïa ki nonglamktien u Jotbathah , Mynba ki Jeriel ki mihnoh na Ijipt , ki la knieh ïa ka ri jong nga naduh ka wah Amnon haduh ka heh Jabbok dara ka wah Jordan . myntor me dei ban pynpoi noh ïa ka da kaba suk .
translation.en: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah , Because Israel took away my land , when they came up out of Egypt , from Arnon even unto Jabbok , and unto Jordan : now therefore restore those lands again peaceably .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shym la lai kamet , naba kata kan ïalamwir ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga , namar ha ka jingdon ryngkat jongngi ki briew ha kiba khappud jongu ki , ki shong ki sah nga la lah pynbna ha ki Israel ba nga ngan ïalam noh ïa ki na Ijipt .
translation.en: But I wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted before the heathen , among whom they were , in whose sight I made myself known unto them , in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U Trai u long wahbah khlaiñbor ha Shion ; U long uba hakhlieh tam halor ki jaitbynriew baroh .
translation.en: The  Lord  is great in Zion  ; and he is high above all the people .

translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kata , u lumlang ïa ki shipai Israel , u jam sha shiliang ka Jordan bad u buh ïa ki ha ka jakarieh ba phai khmat ïa ki Syria .
translation.en: And it was told David  ; and he gathered all Israel , and passed over Jordan , and came upon them , and set the battle in array against them . So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians , they fought with him .
What manner of saying is this that he said ,  Ye shall seek me , and shall not find me : and where I am , thither ye cannot come ?
translation.kha: U ong ba ngin wad ïa u hynrei ngin ym shem ïa u , bad ba ngim lah ban leit sha kaba un don . U mut aïu ?

translation.en: And when he looked on him , he was afraid , and said , What is it , Lord ? And he said unto him , Thy prayers and thine alms are come up for a memorial before God .
translation.kha: U la khmih shaiñ ïa u angel ha ka jingsheptieng bad u la ong ,  Ka dei kaei , ko Kynrad ?  U angel u la jubab ,  U Blei u la sngewbha ïa ki jingduwai jong me bad ïa ki kam leh-isynei jong me , bad u kloi ban jubab ïa me .
Pynban ki la long kiba bha shikatdei ïa ngi ; kim ju pynthut ïa ngi , bad ha ki para baroh ba ngi don bad ki ha ki lyngkha , ym shym don kano kano umdih kaba dei ka jong i kaba la shah tuh .
translation.en: But the men were very good unto us , and we were not hurt , neither missed we any thing , as long as we were conversant with them , when we were in the fields :
They also do no iniquity : they walk in his ways .
translation.kha: Ki bym ju leh ïa ka bymdei ; ki ïaid ha ki lynti U  Trai .
Pynjot ïa ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom jong ka ! Ka Jingpynïoh ïa ki shipai ba shu wai — Katno ki longkmie ibha tlot ! Pynjot ïa ki jingkynshew jong ka ; lute bad rong noh .
translation.en: A sword is upon their horses , and upon their chariots , and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her  ; and they shall become as women : a sword is upon her treasures  ; and they shall be robbed .
And the  Lord  hath given me knowledge of it , and I know it : then thou shewedst me their doings .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pyntip ha nga ïa ki jingthmu sniew kiba ki nongshun jong nga ki la thaw pyrshah ïa nga .
Haba u Menahem u iohsngew ïa kane , u la leit sha u syiem bad u ïathuh ha u ïa kaei ba ka khñiang ka la ong .
translation.en: And one went in , and told his lord , saying , Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Israel .

translation.kha: Mynba u dang im , u Absalom u la tei u mot na ka byndi ïa lade ha ka Them jong u Syiem , uba um don khun shngain u ban ri pynim ïa ka kyrteng jngai u . Kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa u da la ka jong ka kyr-ang , malu haduh Kanah ka sngi la tip ïa u kum u To jong u Absalom .
translation.en: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar , which is in the king s dale : for he said , I have no son to keep my name in remembrance : and he called the pillar after his own name : and it is called unto this day , Absalom s place .

translation.kha: Pynban me dang sngew hangamei , bad me kyntait ban pyllaitluid ïa ki briew jongki nga .
translation.en: As yet exaltest thou thyself against my people , that thou wilt not let them go ?

translation.kha: Ka Tyros ka la tei ki ngut na ka bynta ïa lade bad ka la kynton shibun eh ka phong bad ka ksiar ba ka la kynrei kum ka tngit .
translation.en: And Tyre did build herself a strong hold , and heaped up silver as the dust , and fine gold as the mire of the streets .
