Let not my lord , I pray thee , regard this man of Belial , even Nabal : for as his name is , so is he  ; Nabal is his name , and folly is with him : but I thine handmaid saw not the young men of my lord , whom thou didst send .
translation.kha: Sngewbha , wat pynleit jingmut ei ei ïa u Nabal , uto u bym long ei ei ! U dei hi thik kumba ka kyrteng jong u ka mut — u bieit ! Kynrad , ngam shym don hangta haba ki shakri jong phi ki wan poi .
phin ïathuh ïa ki ba ka um jong ka Jordan ka la sangeh ban tuid haba ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai ka jam ïa ka woh . Kine ki mut ken ïai pynkynmaw ïa ki paid Israel shaphang kaei kiba la jia hangne .
translation.en: Then ye shall answer them , That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord   ; when it passed over Jordan , the waters of Jordan were cut off : and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever .
Beareth all things , believeth all things , hopeth all things , endureth all things .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit kam sangeh noh shiteng ; bad ka jingngeit , ka jingkyrmen bad ka jingïaishah jong ka kim duh noh .
Nangno ha Peor , ki briew jong U Blei ki la ïasnohlang ha ka jingmane ïa u Baal , nabar bam ïa ki jingkynjah ba la ainguh ha ki blei bym don jingim .
translation.en: They joined themselves also unto Baal–peor , and ate the sacrifices of the dead .

translation.kha: Thoh ha u angel lad ka balang ha Laodikaïa : Kane ka longkmie ka khlur na U Amen , uba ïaineh bad u sakhi bashrah , uba long u jingsdang jong baroh kaba U Blei u la ïakit .
translation.en: And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write  ; These things saith the Amen , the faithful and true witness , the beginning of the creation of God  ;

translation.kha: Em , ngim tip ! ki la jingjubab . Ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei ba u ong ! U ïathuh ïa nga ba U Tharai u pynbna , ‘ Nga pynsleh ïa me ban long u syiem ka Israel .’
translation.en: And they said , It is false  ; tell us now . And he said , Thus and thus spake he to me , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , I have anointed thee king over Israel .

The Jews therefore , because it was the preparation , that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day , ( for that sabbath day was an high day , ) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken , and that they might be taken away .
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ki la pan na u Pilat ban shah ïa ki ban pynkheiñ ïa ki kjat jong kita ki briew kiba la shah sahnarphna , bad ban pynhiar noh ïa ki met jong ki na ki diengphna . Ki la kyrpad ïa kane namar ba ka la dei ka Sngi Thohdieng , bad kim kwah ba ki met kin sah kumta ha ki diengphna ha ka sngi Sabbaton , naba ka sngi Sabbaton ka long kyrpang kaba khuid .
Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrah jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Issakhar ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingtyngshaiñ jong ki .
translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Issachar according to their families , the cities and their villages .

translation.kha: Wat long kum ki khnai ha ka stang pyrthat jongno phi , ko parabangeit jong nga ; to Long khynnah ha kaba ïadat bad ka jingbam , hynrei to un-long rangbah ha ka rukom pyrkhat .
translation.en: Brethren , be not children in understanding : howbeit in malice be ye children , but in understanding be men .

translation.kha: lad leh ïa ka Ai bad ïa u syiem jrong ka kam me la leh ïa ka Jeriel nabar u syiem jongno ka , hynñiew ha kane ka sien me lah ban bat ha lade ïa ki mar ki mata bad ïa ki jingroi jong ka na ka bynta ïa lade . Pynkhreh ban ter ïaleh ïa ka nongbah da ka jingkyndit na lyndet jong ka .
translation.en: And thou shalt do to Ai and her king as thou didst unto Jericho and her king : only the spoil thereof , and the cattle thereof , shall ye take for a prey unto yourselves : lay thee an ambush for the city behind it .

translation.kha: Haba jubab ïa ka jinglakloi u sahmiet , ka pynthikna ïa ka jingshaniah u Gehasi , malade kumta u syiem u la ïakhot ïa u rangbah synshar bad Ong ha u ba un pynphai pat ha ka ïa baroh kaba dei ka jong ka , kynthup ïa ka dor jong ki jingmih na ki lyngkha baroh ha kita ki hynñiew snem kiba ka don shawei pat .
translation.en: And when the king asked the woman , she told him . So the king appointed unto her a certain officer , saying , Restore all that was hers , and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land , even until now .

Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle : and when they saw the land of Jazer , and the land of Gilead , that , behold , the place was a place for cattle  ;
translation.kha: Ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad ki la don shibun ki jingri . Haba ki la ïohi ba ka ri Jaser bad ka ri Gilead ka long kaba bit eh na ka bynta ki jingri ,
Ka Sarah ka la long kumta ; ka la kohnguh ïa u Abraham bad ka khot ïa u , u kynrad jong ka . Phi long ki Kynhun kynthei jong ka myntoi lada phi leh ïa kaban dei bad phim sheptieng ïa kano kano .
translation.en: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham , calling him lord : whose daughters ye are , as long as ye do well , and are not afraid with any amazement .

translation.kha: Bad u la ai ha U Khun ïa ka khih ban bishar , namar u long U U U bhabriew .
translation.en: And hath given him authority to execute judgment also , because he is the Son of man .

translation.kha: Namar —kata , ko kynran , u Judah u bteng , lada ngan leit phai sha i pa khlem u para , in tang shu ïohi ba u para um don bad nga , in sa ïap . I ieit thep mynsiem ïa u , bad namar ba i la tymmen eh , ka jingleh jong ngi kan pynïap sngewsih ïa i .
translation.en: It shall come to pass , when he seeth that the lad is not with us , that he will die : and thy servants shall bring down the gray hairs of thy servant our father with sorrow to the grave .

translation.kha: U Isaak u khot ïa u Jakob , u khlei ïa u , malu u ong ha u , Wat shongkurim ïa ka nong Kanaan .
translation.en: And Isaac called Jacob , and blessed him , and charged him , and said unto him , Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan .

translation.kha: Haba u Sisera u tip ba u Barak u la leit kyiuh shata u Lum Tabor ,
translation.en: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor .

translation.kha: Hynrei ma phi , ki briew jong U blei , phin long Kiba kmen bad phin rwai kumba ph leh ha ka miet jong ka Jingkhawai Niam bakyntang . Phin long uba kum kamon kito kiba ïaid ryngkat bad ki sur jongngi ki tangmuri sha ka Templ U Trai’ , u nongkyrshan jong ki Israel .
translation.en: Ye shall have a song , as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept  ; and gladness of heart , as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the  Lord  , to the mighty One of Israel .

translation.kha: Wat trei na ka bynta ka jingbam ka shun sa sniew ; pynban , trei na ka bynta ka jingman ka ban neh sha ka jingim bymjukut . Kane ka long ka jingbam kaba U ti U Briew un ai ha phi , namar ba U Blei umbiah U Kpa , u la sngewbha ban shonshab ha u .
translation.en: Labour not for the meat which perisheth , but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life , which the Son of man shall give unto you : for him hath God the Father sealed .

translation.kha: Hapdeng to bad hynriew baje mynstep U Jisu u la wan sha ki synran , da kaba ïaid halor ka um .
translation.en: And in the fourth watch of the night Jesus went unto them , walking on the sea .
And the crowns shall be to Helem , and to Tobijah , and to Jedaiah , and to Hen the son of Zephaniah , for a memorial in the temple of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka pansngiat kan long ka jingpynsah kynmaw ha ka Templ jong U  Trai  ha ka jingñiewburom ïa u Heldai , u Tobijah , u Jedaïah , bad u Josaïah .

translation.en: And many brought gifts unto the  Lord  to Jerusalem , and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah : so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth .
translation.kha: Bun ki briew ki la wan sha Jerusalem , da kaba wanrah ïa ki jingainguh sha U  Trai  bad ki jingai ïa u Hesekaïah , ba nangta sha khmat baroh ki jaitbynriew ki pyndonburom ïa u Hesekaïah .

translation.en: Then said Daniel unto the king , O king , live for ever .
translation.kha: U Daniel u la jubab ,  Ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un im junom !

translation.en: Here is wisdom . Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast : for it is the number of a man  ; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six .
translation.kha: Kane ka dawa ïa ka jingstad . Uno uno uba shemphang u lah ban batai ïa ka jingmut jong u dak jingkheiñ jong u mradkhlaw , namar u dak jingkheiñ u ïeng na ka bynta ka kyrteng jong u briew . U dak jingkheiñ jong kata ka kyrteng u long hynriewspah hynriewphew hynriew .

Ha ka por ba la leit , wat long u Saul u dang long u syep jong ngi , phira la ïalam ïa ki rangbah Jerusalem’ ha ka thma bad U Trai u la pynkulmar ïa phi ba phin ïalam ïa ki briew jrong u bad ban un-long u nongsynshar jong ki .
translation.en: Also in time past , when Saul was king over us , thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel : and the  Lord  said to thee , Thou shalt feed my people Israel , and thou shalt be a captain over Israel .

translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa u khynwin ryntih bad pynïeng ïa u ha khmat jong ki . U la buh ïa la ki kti sawdong jong u pynlang u la ïa-ong ïa ki ,
translation.en: And he took a child , and set him in the midst of them : and when he had taken him in his arms , he said unto them ,

translation.kha: Ka nongleitkurim ka dem ka jong u nongaikam ; hynrei u paralok jong u nongleitkurim , uba ïeng marsyndah bad shahshkor , u kmen haba u ïohsngew ïa ka on jong u nongleitkurim . Kane ka long kumno ba ïa ka jingkmen jongno nga la pyndap pahara .
translation.en: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom : but the friend of the bridegroom , which standeth and heareth him , rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom s voice : this my joy therefore is fulfilled .
Hezekiah also had said , What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Te u syiem Hesekaïah u kylli ,  Kaei ka dak ban pynshisha ba nga lah ban leit sha ka Templ ?
ka julam , ka Adullam , ka Sokoh , ka Asekah ,
translation.en: Jarmuth , and Adullam , Soco , and Azekah ,

translation.kha: ( haba la kurup ïa ka Jerusalem , baroh ki rangbah synshar bajhieh kyllan jong u syiem ka Babilonia ki la wan bad ki la ïeng ha la ki jakarieh ha ka Khyrdop Bteng , kob kynthah ïa ka Nergal Sareser , ka Semaraim Nebo , ka Sarsekhim , bad Kaei pat ka Nergal Sareser . )
translation.en: And all the princes of the king of Babylon came in , and sat in the middle gate , even Nergal–sharezer , Samgar–nebo , Sarsechim , Rab–saris , Nergal–sharezer , Rab–mag , with all the residue of the princes of the king of Babylon .

translation.kha: Kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Joshua , la ai shi bynta na ka jaka jong ka Judah ha u Lehab u khun jong u jynhaw , na ka jait Judah . U la jingpdiang ïa ka Hebron , ka nongbah kaba dei jong u Arba , u kpa jong u Anak .
translation.en: And unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh he gave a part among the children of Judah , according to the commandment of the  Lord  to Joshua , even the city of Arba the father of Anak , which city is Hebron .

translation.kha: U Blei u la theh noh kyrhai ïa U Mynhynnin Bakhuid ha ngi lyngba U Jisu Khrist U Nongpynim jyllang ngi ,
translation.en: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour ;

translation.kha: Te ngan sa phah shaw paw ïa me . Baalah ngan shu duh ei ïa ki khur shynrang jong nga baroh ar ngut ha kajuh ka sngi ?
translation.en: Until thy brother s anger turn away from thee , and he forget that which thou hast done to him : then I will send , and fetch thee from thence : why should I be deprived also of you both in one day ?

And it shall come to pass , when thou shalt shew this people all these words , and they shall say unto thee , Wherefore hath the  Lord  pronounced all this great evil against us ? or what is our iniquity ? or what is our sin that we have committed against the  Lord  our God ?
translation.kha: Haba me ïathuh ha ki ïa kane baroh , kin kylli ïa me balei ba nga la kut jingmut ban pynshitom tyngeh ïa ki . Kin kylli kaei ka kam runar kaba ki la shah pynrem bad kaei ka pop ba ki la leh pyrshah ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

translation.en: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night  ; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise , and the elements shall melt with fervent heat , the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka Sngi jong U Trai kan wan kum u nongtuh . Ha kata ka Sngi , ki bneng kin jah noh lem bad ka jingsawa kaba jam , ki metbneng kin ing duh bad yn pynjot , bad ka pyrthei lem bad kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha ka kin jah rngai .
Phin tip ba U Blei uba im u don hapdeng jong pa’ haba ka Synduk ka jrong U Tiras jong ka pyrthei baroh kan jam ïa ka Jordan ha shuwa jong phi .
translation.en: Behold , the ark of the covenant of the Lord of all the earth passeth over before you into Jordan .

translation.kha: Kiba bhor ki nongshun ki la ithuh sha ka pyrthei baroh , ki briew ki bym pdiang ba U Jisu Khrist u la wan kum u briew . Kum uta u briew , u long u nongshukor bad u Nongshun jong U Khrist .
translation.en: For many deceivers are entered into the world , who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh . This is a deceiver and an antichrist .
And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh : For God , said he , hath made me forget all my toil , and all my father s house .
translation.kha: U Joseph u ong ,  U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga ban klet ïa ki jingshah shitom baroh bad ïa baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong i pa jong nga  ; kumta u la khot kyrteng ïa uba nyngkong , u Manasseh .

translation.en: If thou wert pure and upright  ; surely now he would awake for thee , and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous .
translation.kha: lada me long uba hok bad uba khuid , te U Blei um wan ban ïarap ïa me bad pynïoh pat ïa ka ïing ka sem jong me kum ka bainong .

translation.en: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham s sight because of his son .
translation.kha: Kane ka la pyndiaw shibun eh ïa u Abraham , naba u Ishmael ruh u dei u khun jong u .
Ka un-long ka jingaibuit ban stem ïa la ki jong ki jingsngewthuh . To long shngain , bad bud ïa ki jinghikai jong ki briew kiba kham stad .
translation.en: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool : but whoso walketh wisely , he shall be delivered .

translation.kha: U briew uba ïong u lah mo ban pynkylla ïa ka rong jongki ka sniehdoh jong u , lane u labasa u lah mo ban weng ïa ki jingthoh ïongreiñ jong u ? Lada ki lah , te ma pha ka bym har ïa kano kano hynrei ka jingsniew pha ia pun tip ban leh ïa kaei kiba dei .
translation.en: Can the Ethiopian change his skin , or the leopard his spots ? then may ye also do good , that are accustomed to do evil .
For by fire and by his sword will the  Lord  plead with all flesh : and the slain of the  Lord  shall be many .
translation.kha: Da ka ding bad ka waitlam un pynshitom ïa ki briew baroh jong ka pyrthei kiba u shem ba la pynrem — bad shibun kin shah pynïap .

Kine kin kitkhlieh ïa ka Synduk ka Jingot , ïa ka miej , ïa u diengpynïeng sharak , ïa ki duwan , ïa ki kiew ki pliang ba ki lyngdoh ki pyndonkam ha ka Jaka Kyntang , bad ïa ka pyrda ha ka jingkhang Sha ka Jaka kaba Kyrteng Tam . Kin kitkhlieh ïa ki kam baroh kiba ïadei nabar Kin tiar ki tar .
translation.en: As for the sons of Merari , thou shalt number them after their families , by the house of their fathers  ;

Envyings , murders , drunkenness , revellings , and such like : of the which I tell you before , as I have also told you in time past , that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: ki ïa-pihuin , ïabuaid , ki don jingkhawai jingdih kyiad , bad leh ïa kiwei kiei kiei kiba kum kine . Nga maham ïa phi mynta kumba nga la maham mynshuwa ; ba kita kiba ïai leh ïa kine kiei kiei kin ym ïohkynti ïa ka hima U Blei .

translation.en: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth , and put my life in mine hand ?
translation.kha: Nga long uba kloi ban kheiñduh ïa la ka jingim .
U syiem Jephthah u shnong ïa ki liengbah ban ïaid ha duriaw sha ka ri Sipporah ban wad ksiar ; hyndai ki la paitlieng ha Esiongeber bun kim shym lah ïaid shuh .
translation.en: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tarshish to go to Ophir for gold : but they went not  ; for the ships were broken at Ezion–geber .

translation.kha: Nga , nga long u kpu ka jingim , U Jisu u la ïathuh ïa ki . Kito kiba wan sha nga da lei lei kin ym thngan ; kito kiba ngeit ha nga da lei leilieh kin ym sliang .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  I am the bread of life : he that cometh to me shall never hunger  ; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst .

translation.kha: Ngan sa lalot ïa ki briew na baroh ki ri na kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki ha ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla jong nga , bad ngan wallam paw ïa ki sha kane ka Jaka bad shah ïa ki ban shong ban sah hangne ha ka jingsngewsih .
translation.en: Behold , I will gather them out of all countries , whither I have driven them in mine anger , and in my fury , and in great wrath  ; and I will bring them again unto this place , and I will cause them to dwell safely :
When a strong man armed keepeth his palace , his goods are in peace :
translation.kha: Haba u briew uba khlaiñ , uba la khreh ïa la ki tiar ïaleh baroh , u ap phira ïa la ka jong ka ïing , baroh ki jingdon jingem jong u ki don ha ka jingshngain .

translation.en: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in , and danced , and pleased Herod and them that sat with him , the king said unto the damsel , Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt , and I will give it thee .
translation.kha: Ka khun jong ka Herodias ka la wan shapoh bad ka la shad , bad ka la pynsngewbha ïa u Herod bad ïa kiba u la khot sngewbha . Kumta u syiem u la ong ha kata ka khynnah ,  Kaei kaba pha kwah ban ïoh ? Ngan ai ïa pha ïa kano kano kaba pha kwah .
To ngin longkmie shlur , te , pynlang ong , U Trai u long u nongïalap jong nga , ngan ym sheptieng . Uei uba lah baneh leh ei ei ïa per ?
translation.en: So that we may boldly say , The Lord is my helper , and I will not fear what man shall do unto me .
He shall deliver the island of the innocent : and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands .
translation.kha: Un pyllait ïa phi lada phi long lui lui , lada kaei kaba phi leh ka long kaba dei .
U blang u la leh ïa kane khnang ba ïa ki jingdawa bahok jong ka Hukum yn pynbud nadong shadong ha im kiba im kat kum U mynhynne , dara ym kat kum ka jinglong ba kynjoh doh .
translation.en: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us , who walk not after the flesh , but after the Spirit .

translation.kha: Kynmaw kumno U Trei U Blei jong pa u la ïamareh ïa phi baroh shi lynter lynti lyngba ka ri shyiap ha kine ki sawphew snem kiba la ngap ba un pyndam ïa phi , u da tynjuh ïa phi ba un ïoh tip) aiwai phi thnam ban leh , dara la phin kohnguh ne em ïa ki hukum jong u .
translation.en: And thou shalt remember all the way which the  Lord  thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness , to humble thee , and to prove thee , to know what was in thine heart , whether thou wouldest keep his commandments , or no .

translation.kha: U Tom u dei u paralok jong u paralok jong nga .
translation.en: Tom is a friend of a friend of mine .

translation.kha: To tyngkan ïa lade bad bishar hi da lade , shun shet la phi im ne em ha ka jingtah . Hato da shisha phi tip ba U Khrist Jisu u don ha phin ? — lymda phi la long kiba la shoh-ïap noh .
translation.en: Examine yourselves , whether ye be in the faith ; prove your own selves . Know ye not your own selves , how that Jesus Christ is in you , except ye be reprobates ?

translation.kha: Hadien ka jingïap u Joshua , ki paid Israhaïah ki kylli ïa U Trai , mian na ki jait jong ngi kaba dei ban leit nyngkong ban tam ïaleh ïa ki Kainan ?
translation.en: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass , that the children of Israel asked the  Lord  , saying , Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first , to fight against them ?

translation.kha: U la ïarep na ka bynta baroh , kthang ba kito kiba im kim dei shuh ban im na ka bynta ïa lade , hynrei tieng na ka bynta jong uta umbiah la ïap bad ba la pynmihpat na ka beit jong ki .
translation.en: And that he died for all , that they which live should not henceforth live unto themselves , but unto him which died for them , and rose again .
But and if that servant say in his heart , My lord delayeth his coming  ; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens , and to eat and drink , and to be drunken  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uta u shakri u ong ha lade ba u kynrad jong u , u shim por slem ban wan phai bad lada u sdang ban shoh ïa kiwei pat ki shakri , shynrang bad kynthei , bad bam bad dih bad buaid ,
ka hajar sanphew shathie na ka Khlem Akrabbim mala ter thri shata Sin . Ka ïaid Shaphan shatai jong ka Kadesh Barnea , lyngba ïa ka Hesron bad shatei shaw Addar , ka da phai sha Karka ,
translation.en: And it went out to the south side to Maaleh–acrabbim , and passed along to Zin , and ascended up on the south side unto Kadesh–barnea , and passed along to Hezron , and went up to Adar , and fetched a compass to Karkaa :

translation.kha: Mynta kane ka dei kawei kaba nga sngewkyiuh ïa kaba phi la noh :
translation.en: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing , and I have heard the voice of thy words , saying ,
Say ye not , A confederacy , to all them to whom this people shall say , A confederacy  ; neither fear ye their fear , nor be afraid .
translation.kha: Wat ïasoh ha ki jingïathmu basniew jong ki briew bad wat sheptieng ïa kiei kiei kiba ki sheptieng .
Ha kane ka snieh kaba ar , ki ïaid tawiar biang ïa ka nongbah shisien bad nangta ki leit phai sha ka jaka sheng dara . Ki la har kumne haduh hynriew sngi .
translation.en: And the second day they compassed the city once , and returned into the camp : so they did six days .
And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him : for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel , saying , God will surely visit you  ; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you .
translation.kha: U Moses u la rah bad u ïa ka met u Joseph , kumba u Joseph u la pynsmai ïa ki Israel . U Joseph u la lah ong ,  Haba U Blei u wan pyllait ïa phi , phi dei ban kit noh ïa ka met jong nga na kane ka jaka .
Hadien kata , u bret noh ïa kata ka shyieng tyngam . Ka kajuh ha kaba kane ka la jia la ai kyrteng ka Ramath Lehi .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he had made an end of speaking , that he cast away the jawbone out of his hand , and called that place Ramath–lehi .

translation.kha: mynno na kine ki blei jong ki ri baroh kiba la ju pyllait im ïa ki ri lad ki na u patsha jong ngi ? Te kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba U Trai un pyllait im ïa ka Jerusalem ?
translation.en: Who are they among all the gods of the countries , that have delivered their country out of mine hand , that the  Lord  should deliver Jerusalem out of mine hand ?

translation.kha: U Dabid u ïajubab , ?(Nga la leh bakla aïu eh keiñ , kynrad ? Lada , main phi ïong , ba phim shym la shem jinglait ha nga naduh ka sngaid ba nga sdang shun shakri ïa phi , balei ba ngam dei ban leit bad phi , u kynrad bad u syiem jongngi nga bad ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong phi ?
translation.en: And David said unto Achish , But what have I done ? and what hast thou found in thy servant so long as I have been with thee unto this day , that I may not go fight against the enemies of my lord the king ?

translation.kha: U la kad arliang ïa ka Duriaw basaw , ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
translation.en: To him which divided the Red sea into parts : for his mercy endureth for ever :

translation.kha: Ka ong ha u syiem , kaei kaba nga la ïohsngew ha la ka jyllang ka ri shaphang jong phi malu ka jingstad jngai ph , ka long kaba shisha ,
translation.en: And she said to the king , It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts , and of thy wisdom :
Neither was there any among them that lacked : for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them , and brought the prices of the things that were sold ,
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano hapoh ka kynhun kiba don ka jingdonkam . Kito kiba long trai ïa ki lyngkha , ki wallam ïa ka pisa ba la ïohpdiang na ka jingdie ,
Ha khmat ka khet ruh la anna kaei kaba i kum ka ïit bakhlaiñbor , kaweh shai sngur bha . La ker ha bhor sawdong ka khet da saw tylli ki jingthaw bam kiba don ki khmat sha khmat bad shadien .
translation.en: And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal : and in the midst of the throne , and round about the throne , were four beasts full of eyes before and behind .
And he said unto them , Out of the eater came forth meat , and out of the strong came forth sweetness . And they could not in three days expound the riddle .
translation.kha: U ong ,  Na u nongbam wan mih ka jingbam ; Na uba khlaiñ wan mih kaba thiang .  Hadien lai sngi ruh kim shym lah ban batai ïa kata ka jingkyntip .
Naba nga long U Trai U Blei jongngi phi , U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel , umbah pynjam ïa phi . Neng kyntait ïa ka Ijipt ban pyllaitluid ïa phi ; ngan kyntait ïa ka suda bad ka Seba .
translation.en: For I am the  Lord  thy God , the Holy One of Israel , thy Saviour : I gave Egypt for thy ransom , Ethiopia and Seba for thee .

translation.kha: Naba u Mordekai u dang erlangthari u nongtrei ha ka ïingsyiem , u Bigthana bad u Teresh , kiba longïing ar ngut na ki ïohnang ka ïingshong kiba ap phira ïa ka khyrdop sha ki Hall u syiem , ki la shun ïa u syiem Serksis bad sylla ban pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: In those days , while Mordecai sat in the king s gate , two of the king s chamberlains , Bigthan and Teresh , of those which kept the door , were wroth , and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ngan ïathuh ïa phi ba kito kiba mane bad kohnguh ïa ang kin ïoh kyrhai ban bam ban daiñ , hynrei phi phin thngan bad phin sliang . Ma ki ken shadkmen hynrei ma phi phin jahburom .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God  , Behold , my servants shall eat , but ye shall be hungry : behold , my servants shall drink , but ye shall be thirsty : behold , my servants shall rejoice , but ye shall be ashamed :

translation.kha: Kumta hi ka pynhiar stet ïa u khiew um na la tyrpeng bad ka ïa-ong , ‘ To dih , pynlang kun ai um ruh ïa ki ut jong phi ba kin dih .’ kumto nga la dih , mala ka la ai um ruh ïa ki ut .
translation.en: And she made haste , and let down her pitcher from her shoulder , and said , Drink , and I will give thy camels drink also : so I drank , and she made the camels drink also .

translation.kha: Baroh ki ïaroh ïa nga borabor , bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong na kam ju duh noh na nga .
translation.en: My glory was fresh in me , and my bow was renewed in my hand .

Then shall his brother s wife come unto him in the presence of the elders , and loose his shoe from off his foot , and spit in his face , and shall answer and say , So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother s house .
translation.kha: kata ka hynmen kynsi jong u kan leit sha u ha khmat kita ki nongïalam shnong , kan loit kawei ka juti jong u , kan bynthiew ha ka khmat jong u , bad kan ong , ‘ Kumne yn leh ïa uta u briew u bym treh ban ai symbai ïa la u hynmen .’
U Blei u kwah ïa phi ban long kiba khuid bad kiba lait phah na ka jingjakhlia ka jingaibor .
translation.en: For this is the will of God , even your sanctification , that ye should abstain from fornication :

translation.kha: Ka la long ka erïong kaba umjer kur ba ka Ijipt ka la mad ha ka histori jong ka baroh .
translation.en: So there was hail , and fire mingled with the hail , very grievous , such as there was none like it in all the land of Egypt since it became a nation .
And Jesus said ,  Somebody hath touched me : for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Don mano mano ba la ktah ïa nga , naba nga tip ïa ka mynba ka bor ka la mihnoh na nga .

translation.en: For the  Lord  spake thus to me with a strong hand , and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people , saying ,
translation.kha: Da ka bor bakhraw jong u , U  Trai  u la maham ïa nga ban ym bud ïa ka lynti ba ki briew ki la bud . U ong ,
To wat ai ba uno uno un shukor ïa phoi , ko ki khun jong la ! Uno Une uba kun ïa kaei kabu dei , u long kaba hok , kumba U Khrist u long uba hok .
translation.en: Little children , let no man deceive you : he that doeth righteousness is righteous , even as he is righteous .

translation.kha: Hynrei , nyngkong u dei ban shahshitom shikatdei eh bad ban shah kynjai da ki briew jong Kanneh ka pateng .
translation.en: But first must he suffer many things , and be rejected of this generation .
Can the rush grow up without mire ? can the flag grow without water ?
translation.kha: Ki khah kim lah ban mih haba ym don um ; yn ym lah ban shem shabar ka jaka sngem .

Haba u Absalom u Heshmon jong ka u la ïohi ïa ka , u la kylluid , Hato u Amnon u la ktah kti ïa phi ? Sngewbha , ko hep , wat shah ba kata ka pynjngut shibun ïa phi! . U dei u ba ïalong shi para bad phin na ijuh i pa , kumno te kam ïathuh hano kuna shaphang kata . Kumta ka Tamar ka la sah ha ka ïing jong u Absalom , ka da sngewsih bad sngew marwei .
translation.en: And Absalom her brother said unto her , Hath Amnon thy brother been with thee ? but hold now thy peace , my sister : he is thy brother  ; regard not this thing . So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom s house .

translation.kha: Keiñ , te , ka long kaei ba ka mut , ko Syiem Kyndit , mala kane ka longsyiem kaei kaba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la pynbna ba kan jia ha phi .
translation.en: This is the interpretation , O king , and this is the decree of the most High , which is come upon my lord the king :

translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko Jeremaïah ! Uwei pa uwei ha kane ka ri — ki syep ka Jehoïada , ki rangbah synshar , ki lyngdoh , bad ki bhabriew — kin long pyrshah ïa me . hynriew ha kane ka sngi nga ai ha me ka jingkhlaiñ ban ïeng pyrshah ïa ki ; men long kum ka nongbah ba la ber kynran , u raïot nar , bad ka kynroh rnong . Kin ym lah ban jop ïa me , naba ngan don lem bad me ban ïada ïa me . Ma nga , U tharai nga la kren .
translation.en: And they shall fight against thee  ; but they shall not prevail against thee  ; for I am with thee , saith the  Lord  , to deliver thee .

Now the acts of Rehoboam , first and last , are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet , and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies ? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually .
translation.kha: Ïa ki kam jong u Rehoboam naduh kaba sdang haduh kaba kut bad ki jinglum jingthoh ïa ka longïing jong u la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori jong u Shemaïah u Nongïathuhlypa  bad ha  Ka Histori jong u Iddo u Nongïathuhlypa . U Rehoboam bad u Jeroboam ki ïai ïaleh thma uwei ïa uwei pat .

Naba ngi kynjoh ha khmat U Bel bad U kpu jong ngi ba kumno phi pyntreikam ïa ka jingngeit , kumta ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka pynlah ïa phi ban trei shitom , bad Kumno ka jingkyrmen jong phi ha U Jisu Khereth uba U Troas jong ngi ka long kaba skhem .
translation.en: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith , and labour of love , and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ , in the sight of God and our Father ;
And Joseph also went up from Galilee , out of the city of Nazareth , into Judaea , unto the city of David , which is called Bethlehem  ; ( because he was of the house and lineage of David : )
translation.kha: U Joseph ruh u la leit na ka shnong Nasareth , kaba ha Galilaïa sha ka shnong Bethlehem ha Judia , ka jaka ha kaba la kha ïa syiem Dabid . U Joseph u la leit shata namar u la long uba hiarpateng na u Dabid .

translation.en: Shall I not visit for these things ? saith the  Lord  : and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this ?
translation.kha: Hato ngan ym pynshitom ïa ki na ka bynta kine kiei kiei ? bad pynhiarkput ïa ka jaitbynriew kaba kum kane ?
Te , ynda U Trai U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi ïa kata ka shongneh , pynpei lut ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang .
translation.en: And when the  Lord  thy God hath delivered it into thine hands , thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword :
For I will not see you now by the way ; but I trust to tarry a while with you , if the Lord permit .
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban ïohi ïa phi kham palat ban ïa kaba shu wan jngoh ha ka jingïaid lynti ; nga kyrmen ban pynlut shibun ka por bad phi , lada U Trai u shah .

translation.en: If we say , We will enter into the city , then the famine is in the city , and we shall die there : and if we sit still here , we die also . Now therefore come , and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians : if they save us alive , we shall live  ; and if they kill us , we shall but die .
translation.kha: Kam long ka jingmyntoi ïa ngi ban leit shapoh ka nongbah namar ngin sa ïapthngan hangta , hynrei lada ngi shong hangne , ngin ïap kumjuh . Kumta , ïa ngin ïaleit noh sha ka jaka shong dara ki Syria ; kaba sniew tam ba ki lah ban leh ka long ba kin pynïap ïa ngi , hynrei lehse kin pyllait im ïa ngi .
Pynban , ki shem jingkmen ha kaba kohnguh ïa ka Hukum jong U Trai
translation.en: But his delight is in the law of the  Lord   ; and in his law doth he meditate day and night .
There is no darkness , nor shadow of death , where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves .
translation.kha: Ym don jingdum ka ban dum tliw palat ban buhrieh ïa u nongpop na U Blei .
Kumta u syiem Ahab u khoit shabi ïa u rangbah ka ïingsyiem dara ong ïa u ban leit bad wallam shisyndon ïa u Mikaïah .
translation.en: And the king of Israel called for one of his officers , and said , Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imlah .

translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u shim ïa ka shym bad u ai ïa ka kum ka jingai kiba kyrpang ha U Trai . Kata ka long ka bynta jong u Moses na u langbrot ka jingpynkyntang . U Moses u la leh ïa kiei kiei baroh ruma U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: And Moses took the breast , and waved it for a wave offering before the  Lord  : for of the ram of consecration it was Moses  part  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

But he slew not their children , but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses , where the  Lord  commanded , saying , The fathers shall not die for the children , neither shall the children die for the fathers , but every man shall die for his own sin .
translation.kha: Pynban um shym la pynïap ïa ki khun ki kti jong ki , hynrei u la bud ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ha Ka Hukum u Moses :  Ïa ki kmie ki kpa ym dei ban pynïap namar ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki khun jong ki , bad ïa ki khun ym dei ban pynïap namar ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki kmie ki kpa jong ki ; ïa u briew dei ban pynïap tang namar ka kam sniew kaba ma u hi u la leh .
Lada phi pynshitom ïa la ki khun , phim ieit ïa ki . Lada pa’ ieit ïa ki , phin sneng pynbeit ïa ki .
translation.en: He that spareth his rod hateth his son : but he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba kaei kaba me la leh ka dei ka dak jong kaei ka ban jia ha ki — kin long ki nongïambriew bad kiba Shah ring kyrdoh .
translation.en: Say , I am your sign : like as I have done , so shall it be done unto them : they shall remove and go into captivity .

translation.kha: kumba ym don ba la ithuh , pynban la ithuh ïa ine da baroh ; la kum katba la ïapom , hawei , kumba phi ioh , ngi dang ïai im .
translation.en: As unknown , and yet well known ; as dying , and , behold , we live ; as chastened , and not killed ;

translation.kha: Neng kiba ngeit , te , i'u ïohpdiang ïa sakma ka jingjahthait ïa kaba U balui u la kular . Ka la longsem kumba u la ong , ?(Nga la pita bun pynlong ka jingïalang kyntang : ‘ Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei sha ka ri ha kaba nur ai ha ki ka jingjahthait !’ U la kren ïa kane wat haba la pyndep ïa ka kam jong u naduh ka por ba u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: For we which have believed do enter into rest , as he said , As I have sworn in my wrath , if they shall enter into my rest : although the works were finished from the foundation of the world .
Take heed in the plague of leprosy , that thou observe diligently , and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you : as I commanded them , so ye shall observe to do .
translation.kha: Haba phi pang  ñiangthohlieh , phi dei ban leh thik kumba ki lyngdoh Lebi ki ong ïa phi , bad bud ïa ki jinghikai ïa kiba nga la ai ha ki .

translation.en: Neither say they in their heart , Let us now fear the  Lord  our God , that giveth rain , both the former and the latter , in his season : he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest .
translation.kha: Phim ju pyrkhat da lei lei ban pyndonburom ïa nga , wat la nga phah ïa u slap synrai bad ïa u slap pyrem bad ai ha phi ïa ka aïom ot man la ka snem .

translation.en: And David said unto Saul , Who am I ? and what is my life , or my father s family in Israel , that I should be son in law to the king ?
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ,  Nga dei uei keiñ bad kaei ka longïing jong nga ba ngan ïoh long u pyrsa kurim jong u syiem ?

Ban pynkhia ba phi long ki bynriew kiba hok , imat na phi un sawa ha ka ïingbyndi ha kaba la set ïa phira , kiwei! pat ki eh ban saw kit ïa u kew uba phi la thied sha ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong phi kiba shahthngan .
translation.en: If ye be true men , let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison : go ye , carry corn for the famine of your houses :

translation.kha: wat ñiewbeiñ ïa ki khubor ba la pyrsad mynsiem .
translation.en: Despise not prophesyings .

translation.kha: Khmih sha nga ! nga la dap phraphew san sner ka rta bad por dang shait dang khlaiñ mynta Rumah nga la long mynba u Moses u la phah ïa nga . Nga dang shait dang khlaiñ babha ban leit ïaleh thma ne na ka bynta kano Kanaan .
translation.en: As yet I am as strong this day as I was in the day that Moses sent me : as my strength was then , even so is my strength now , for war , both to go out , and to come in .

translation.kha: Hynrei kine baroh kim hir ei ei ïa nga katba nga dang ïohthiah ïa Utai u Jiw , u Mordekai ba u shong ha ka khyrdop sha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: Yet all this availeth me nothing , so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king s gate .

translation.kha: ( Jakob 1 :28 ; 4 :4 ) Phi eh mo ban hajuh ïa ka kynhun ha shnong jong phi kaba ne kum kine ki dak jong ka jinglong Khristan baseisoh ?
translation.en: ( James 1 :27  ; 4 :4 ) Can you identify a religious group in your community that has these marks of true Christianity ?
Then the chief captain came near , and took him , and commanded him to be bound with two chains  ; and demanded who he was , and what he had done .
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la leit sha u Paul , u la kem ïa u , bad u la hukum ban teh ïa u da ar tylli ki kynjri . Nangta u la kylli ,  Uei une u briew , bad u la leh aïu ?

translation.en: Brethren , let every man , wherein he is called , therein abide with God .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban ïaisah ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei ha kata kajuh kumba phi la long mynba la khot ïa phi .

Ki khñium jong ki , ki long kiba nep , bad ki ryntih jong ki , ki long kiba la pynkhreh ban siat . Ki peh jat jong ki kulai jong ki , ki eh kum ki mawshamok bad ki shaka jong ki kada ïalam jong ki , ki kylla long kum ka erlangthari .
translation.en: Whose arrows are sharp , and all their bows bent , their horses  hoofs shall be counted like flint , and their wheels like a whirlwind :

translation.kha: Tharai lada ki ong , Ale ngin leit apthap ïano ïabna don ïoh pynïap ! Ïa iing rupa tur ïaleh ïa ki briew kiba lui la tang ba shu Ïoh leh dusmon !
translation.en: If they say , Come with us , let us lay wait for blood , let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause :

translation.kha: Baroh ki paid Jerusalem , te , ki dat ban tip da Kaba thikna ba une U Jisu , uba phi la sahnarphna , u dei uta uba U Blang u la pyntong U Trai bad U Messaïah !
translation.en: Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly , that God hath made that same Jesus , whom ye have crucified , both Lord and Christ .

translation.kha: Kaba ki ïangat leit ha ka lieng , U Jisu u la ïohthiah . Kynsan ka lyer kaba jur ka la beh halor ka duriaw , bad ka lieng ka la sheng ban iap da ka um , ba kumta baroh ki la don ha ka jingma kaba khraw .
translation.en: But as they sailed he fell asleep : and there came down a storm of wind on the lake  ; and they were filled with water , and were in jeopardy .

translation.kha: Un buh ïa la ka ktem ha ka khlieh jong u bad un pynïap ïa u ha ka phang kaba shatei jngai ka duwan , ha ka jaka ba ki ju pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynta ki jingkñia ainguh thang . Kane ka longïng ka jingïania ainguh ban map noh ïa ka pop .
translation.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat , and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the  Lord  : it is a sin offering .

translation.kha: U Sekakah u syiem ka Judah u la phad ïa u Pashhur , u Kynhun jong u Malkhaïah , bad ïa u Sephanaïah u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Maaseïah , shiah nga lem malade kane ka jingkyrpad :
translation.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Malchijah , and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest , saying ,

translation.kha: Pynphai ïa ka jingat jong me halor ki jingñiewbeiñ ki bym mane ïa me bad Halor ki briew kiba kyntait ïa me . Ki la pynïap ïa ki briew jong me ; ki la pynjot khop ïa ngi bad iehnoh ïa ka ri jongngi ngi ha ka jingjot jingpynbha .
translation.en: Pour out thy fury upon the heathen that know thee not , and upon the families that call not on thy name : for they have eaten up Jacob , and devoured him , and consumed him , and have made his habitation desolate .

translation.kha: Ka khyndew ka kyiuh bad ka khynñiuh nongmareh ba U Trai u pyndep ïa ka jingthmu lad u ban pynurlong ïa ka Babilonia ka ri shyiap , ha kaba yn ym don mano mano don shong ban sah .
translation.en: And the land shall tremble and sorrow : for every purpose of the  Lord  shall be performed against Babylon , to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant .

Then Paul , after that the governor had beckoned unto him to speak , answered , Forasmuch as I know that thou hast been of many years a judge unto this nation , I do the more cheerfully answer for myself :
translation.kha: Te u lyngskor u la ai dak ïa u Paul ban kren , u Paul u la ong ,  Nga tip ba me la long u nongbishar halor kane ka jaitbynriew la bun snem , bad kumta da kaba sngewbha nga ïasaid da ïa lade ha khmat jong me .

translation.en: And the angels which kept not their first estate , but left their own habitation , he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ki angel ki bym shym la ri ïa ka burom hapoh ki pud ka bor synshar jong ki , hynrei ki la iehnoh ïa ki jaka shong jong ki hi : Ki shah khum da ki kynjri bymjukut hapoh kaba dum tliw tliw , ha kaba U Blei u buh ïa ki na ka bynta kata ka Sngi kaba khraw ha kaba yn pynrem ïa ki .
Ïa ka ri jong ki la pyndap da ki jakoid , wat ïa ka ïingsyiem la pyndap da ki .
translation.en: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance , in the chambers of their kings .
That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ , both which are in heaven , and which are on earth ; even in him :
translation.kha: Kane ka jingthmu , ïa kaba U Blei un sa pyndep ha ka ïa kaba biang , ka long ban lumlang ïa ka jingpynlong baroh , ha bneng bad ha khyndew , lem bad U Khrist kum u khlieh .

translation.en: And Miriam answered them , Sing ye to the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously  ; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .
translation.kha: Ka Miriam ka la rwai na ka bynta jong ki :  To rwai ha U  Trai namar ba u la jop ka jingjop badonburom ; u la bret ïa ki kulai bad ïa ki nongshong jong ki sha ka duriaw .
Hobah la poi kiei ha ki Assyria ba ki shipai Ijipt , ba la ïalam da u sahmiet Tirhakah jong ka Sudan , u dang wan ban tur ïaleh ïa ki .
translation.en: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia , He is come forth to make war with thee . And when he heard it , he sent messengers to Hezekiah , saying ,

translation.kha: To shahshkor , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga ! U Blei u la jied ïa ki bynriew ibha tun ha kane ka pyrthei ban long Kiba riewspah ha ka jingngeit bad ban kam kynti ïa ka hima kaba u la kular ha kito kiba ieit ïa u .
translation.en: Hearken , my beloved brethren , Hath not God chosen the poor of this world rich in faith , and heirs of the kingdom which he hath promised to them that love him ?

translation.kha: U Trai u ainong , Ki briew ka Oded ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ki la beh krad ïa la ki hynmen ki para , ïa ki Jeraïah bad khlem da pyn-i jingisynei ïa ki . Ka jingbitar jong ki nang Don pud sad kim shah ba kin ïap .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Edom , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because he did pursue his brother with the sword , and did cast off all pity , and his anger did tear perpetually , and he kept his wrath for ever :
And Samuel said unto Saul , I will not return with thee : for thou hast rejected the word of the  Lord  , and the  Lord  hath rejected thee from being king over Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan ym leit phai bad phi ,  u Samuel u jubab .  Phi la kyntait ïa ka hukum U  Trai  , bad u la kyntait ïa phi kum u syiem ki Israel .
Nangta ki la ap hangtei , bad u Nabal ha kaba khatduh u la jubab , U Dabid ? Uei uta ? Ngin pat ju ïohsngew ïa u ! Ha kine ki sngi ka ri ka dap da ki mraw kiba phet na la ki kynrad !
translation.en: And Nabal answered David s servants , and said , Who is David ? and who is the son of Jesse ? there be many servants now a days that break away every man from his master .

translation.kha: Kumta ngam hir shisha uta uba leh ïa kane kaei kaei ; pynbna , ka dei ka pop kaba im haduh jong nga .
translation.en: Now then it is no more I that do it , but sin that dwelleth in me .

translation.kha: Nga ïatei pyrkhat ïa ka bad ka mynsiem jong sa ka ino sngewsih .
translation.en: My soul hath them still in remembrance , and is humbled in me .

translation.kha: Hadien sier un tur ïaleh ïa ki Hima kiba harud duriaw bad u jop ïa kiba bun na ki . Hynrei u nongïalam nongrwai un jop ïa u bad un pynkut ïa ka jinglehmeng jong u ; da shisha un pynphai pat ïa ka jinglehmeng jong u skhem ka Syria sha u .
translation.en: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles , and shall take many : but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease  ; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him .
And in the morning , as they passed by , they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots .
translation.kha: Dang step bha ha ka step kaba bud , katba ki dang ïaid ha kata ka lynti , ki la ïohi ïa uta u dieng Dumbur . U la ïap baroh shi rynïeng haduh ki thied .
U jubab ïa ki baroh ; ym don kano kano kaba eh than kaba um lah ban batai .
translation.en: And Solomon told her all her questions : and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not .

translation.kha: U ïathuh ruh ha ngi shaphang ka jingthmu jong u bad kaei kaba u khoh ïa ngi ban leh .
translation.en: He also tells us about his purpose and what he wants us to do .
This is the inheritance of the children of Zebulun according to their families , these cities with their villages .
translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaba ki longïing na ka jait Sebulun ki la ïohpdiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
Kata ka ri ba phin sa ïohrung kam dei kum ka ri ibit ha kaba phi! sheng mynshuwa . Hangne , haba pa bet ïa u symbai , phi khup ban da trei shitom ban ai um ïa ki lyngkha ;
translation.en: For the land , whither thou goest in to possess it , is not as the land of Egypt , from whence ye came out , where thou sowedst thy seed , and wateredst it with thy foot , as a garden of herbs :

translation.kha: La shah ïa u mradkhlaw uba ar ban pyrsad jingim ha kata ka dur jong u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong , khnang ba ka durblei ka lah ban kren bad pynïap ïa pli baroh ki banbeiñ ym mane ïa ka .
translation.en: And he had power to give life unto the image of the beast , that the image of the beast should both speak , and cause that as many as would not worship the image of the beast should be killed .

And Josiah gave to the people , of the flock , lambs and kids , all for the passover offerings , for all that were present , to the number of thirty thousand , and three thousand bullocks : these were of the king s substance .
translation.kha: Na ka bynta ka jingpyndonkam ki briew ha ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , u syiem Josaïah u la ai sngewbha na ki kynhun jong ki jingri jong u laiphew hajar tylli ki blang , ki langbrot , bad ki khunblang , bad lai hajar tylli ki masi lyngraw .

translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoahaz , and all that he did , and his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoahas u la leh bad ki kam shlur jong u baroh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .

Ngan pynshisha ha phi , te , ba U Khun U Briew u Don ka bor ha ka pyrthei ban map ïa ki pop . Kumta u la ong ha u briew uba ïapshiliang , Nga ong ha me , to kaei joit , rim ïa la ka jingthiah , bad khie lytar noh shai ïit !
translation.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power upon earth to forgive sins ,  ( he said unto the sick of the palsy , )  I say unto thee , Arise , and take up thy couch , and go into thine house .

translation.kha: Kumta te , phiah ithuh ïa ki nongïathuhlypa balamler da kaei kaba ki leh .
translation.en: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them .

And David said unto him , Fear not : for I will surely shew thee kindness for Jonathan thy father s sake , and will restore thee all the land of Saul thy father  ; and thou shalt eat bread at my table continually .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ,  u Dabid u jubab .  Ngan lehbha ïa phi na ka bynta u Jonathan , u kpa jong phi . Ngan ai pat ha phi ïa ka khyndew ka shyiap baroh kaba dei ka jong u Saul , u kparad jong phi , bad phin long uba la pdiang sngewbha borabor ha ka miej bam jong nga .

translation.en: And I will strengthen them in the  Lord   ; and they shall walk up and down in his name , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkhlaiñ ïa ki briew jong nga ; kin ïamane bad kohnguh ïa nga .  U  Trai  u la kren .
Ko Trai , to ïarap ïa ka jait jyllang ki ba kan nang khlaiñ ; To pdiang sngewbha kat ïa kaba ki pyndep , To pynngeit ïa ki nongshun jong ki , Ba kin ym khie khliehduh hajuh lano lano .
translation.en: Bless ,  Lord  , his substance , and accept the work of his hands : smite through the loins of them that rise against him , and of them that hate him , that they rise not again .

translation.kha: U Moses u wan ïashoh ha u paidbah ïa ki Hukum baroh pynlang ïa ki aiñ baroh jong U Trai , bad ki briew barhem ki ïajubab lang , Ïa kita baroh kaba U Trei u ong , ngin leh .
translation.en: And Moses came and told the people all the words of the  Lord  , and all the judgments : and all the people answered with one voice , and said , All the words which the  Lord  hath said will we do .

translation.kha: Wat thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ki blei kiba da ka mata ne da ka ksaiñ ba-bang manna ïa ki nalor jngai nga .
translation.en: Ye shall not make with me gods of silver , neither shall ye make unto you gods of gold .

translation.kha: Ka khun kaba ar ruh ka la kha khuid shynrang ïa uba ka jer kyrteng u Ben-ammi . U la long u kpa tmier jong ki Ammon haduh kane ka snoh .
translation.en: And the younger , she also bare a son , and called his name Ben–ammi : the same is the father of the children of Ammon unto this day .
I have heard the reproach of Moab , and the revilings of the children of Ammon , whereby they have reproached my people , and magnified themselves against their border .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Nga la ïohsngew ba ki briew jong ka Moab bad Ammon ki krenbeiñ bad ki pynsalia ïa ki briew jong nga , bad ki kren khraw ba kin kurup ïa ka ri jong ki .

translation.en: And they reasoned among themselves , saying , It is because we have no bread .
translation.kha: Ki la ïasdang ban ïakren para ma ki :  U ong ïa kane namar ngim don kpu .

translation.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood , even the forgiveness of sins :
translation.kha: da uba la pyllaitluid ïa ngi , kata ka long , ba la map ïa ki pop jong ngi .

translation.en: And Jesus , which is called Justus , who are of the circumcision . These only are my fellowworkers unto the kingdom of God , which have been a comfort unto me .
translation.kha: U Joshua , ïa uba la khot ruh u Justos , u phah ruh ïa ki jingai khublei . Kine lai ngut ki long tang ma ki , ki parabangeit Jiw kiba trei bad nga na ka bynta Ka Hima U Blei , bad ki la long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa nga .
Ko parabangeit jong sa , to sumar ïoh ba uno uno na phi u don ka dohthang kaba sniew eh bad bymngeit katjuh haduh ba un da phai dien noh na U Blei uba im .
translation.en: Take heed , brethren , lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief , in departing from the living God .
And it came to pass , when she pressed him daily with her words , and urged him , so that his soul was vexed unto death  ;
translation.kha: Ka ïai kylli ïa u kawei ka sngi hadien kawei pat . U da ngiah hi shoiñ bad thait ïa ka jingthlia jong ka ïa u shaphang kata .

translation.en: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him , and shall be broken  ; yea , also the prince of the covenant .
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno uba pyrshah ïa u , wat u Rangbah Lyngdoh jong U Blei , un shah sar noh bad shah pynduh .
Nga la khmih , bad hangta la ne u kulai balieh . Halor jong u , u nongshong kulai u la bat ïa ka ryntih , bad ha u la ai ïa ka pansngiat . U la shong halor jong u Kum u nongap ban jop .
translation.en: And I saw , and behold a white horse : and he that sat on him had a bow  ; and a crown was given unto him : and he went forth conquering , and to conquer .

translation.kha: U Jakob u ong ha u Joseph , Ngin shym poi pyrkhat ba ngan dang ïohi biang ïa ka khmat jong me ; pynban U Blei u la shah ba ngan ïohi sa ïa ki khun jong me ruh .
translation.en: And Israel said unto Joseph , I had not thought to see thy face : and , lo , God hath shewed me also thy seed .

translation.kha: Me la mlien ban ïoh ka jingpyndonburom da ki sur jingjam ki duitara , hynrei Myntan hangtai me don ha ka pyrthei ibha ïap . Me thoh ha ka jingthiah jongnga ki ksah bad la tap nep da ki wieh .’
translation.en: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave , and the noise of thy viols : the worm is spread under thee , and the worms cover thee .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba duna ka jingtip ki ïoh ïa kaei kaweh ka jingbieit jong ki ka dei ban ïoh , hynrei ha kiba sian la ainong da ka jingmihpat .
translation.en: The simple inherit folly : but the prudent are crowned with knowledge .
And their word will eat as doth a canker : of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus ;
translation.kha: Kaba kum kata ka jinghikai ka long kum ka prum kaba bam noh ïa ka doh . Ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la hikai kum ïa kita kiei kiei ki dei u Hymenaïos bad u Philetos .

translation.en: Behold , he putteth no trust in his saints  ; yea , the heavens are not clean in his sight .
translation.kha: Balei , U Blei um shaniah wat ïa ki angel jong u ; wat ma ki kim long kiba khuid ha khmat jong u .
Bad haba ïa kiei kiei baroh la wallam sha ka jingïohi , te ïa ka jingjrong bashisha jongu ki la pynpaw shynna ; naba kaei kaei kaba la pynpaw shynriah ka kylla long ka jingkhaïi .
translation.en: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light : for whatsoever doth make manifest is light .
Flee , get you far off , dwell deep , O ye inhabitants of Hazor , saith the  Lord   ; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath taken counsel against you , and hath conceived a purpose against you .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Hasor , ma nga , U  Trai  , nga maham ïa phi ban phet noh bad ban leit rieh . U Nebukhadnessar , u syiem ka Babilonia u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa phi , bad kane ka dei kaei kaba u ong ,

translation.en: Now therefore restore the man his wife  ; for he is a prophet , and he shall pray for thee , and thou shalt live : and if thou restore her not , know thou that thou shalt surely die , thou , and all that are thine .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , to pynphai noh ïa kato ka briew ha u tnga jong ka . U dei u nongïathuhlypa , bad un sa duwai na ka bynta jong me , ba kumta men ym ïap . Hynrei lada mem pynphai pat ïa ka , nga maham ïa me ba men ïap , ma me bad ki briew jong me baroh .
Hynrei un jubab , Ym ma nga ! Ngam lah don ïarap ïa phin . Ngam don jingbam ei ei lane ki jaiñ ruh kumwei . Wat pynlong ïa nga u nongïalam jong phi !
translation.en: In that day shall he swear , saying , I will not be an healer  ; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing : make me not a ruler of the people .

translation.kha: U Joshua u la kurup ïa kine ki nongbah baroh malu ïa ki syiem jong ki , da ka pynïap ïa ti pa uwei , ruma u Moses , u shakri jong U Trai , u la hukum .
translation.en: And all the cities of those kings , and all the kings of them , did Joshua take , and smote them with the edge of the sword , and he utterly destroyed them , as Moses the servant of the  Lord  commanded .

translation.kha: Sa katno nga dei ban Ïohi ïa ka sur-thma kob nang jrong bad ïohsngew ïa ki jingshet jong ki turoi ?
translation.en: How long shall I see the standard , and hear the sound of the trumpet ?

translation.kha: To kheiñ ïa ka bainong jong me , bad ngan siew ïa ka .
translation.en: And he said , Appoint me thy wages , and I will give it .

translation.kha: Lano ka Paradais Kan Wan ?
translation.en: When Will Paradise Come ?
Jesus later appeared to his apostles .
translation.kha: U Jisu hadien  u la mih paw ha ki synran jong u .

translation.en: And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee , named Nazareth ,
translation.kha: Ha u bnai bahynriew jong ka jingpunkhun jong ka Elisabeth , U Blei u la phah ïa u angel Gabriel sha ka shong ha Galilaïa kaba kyrteng ka Nasareth .
Phi la lehsbun shikatdei eh mala phi la pyllait im ïa nga . Hynrei ki lum ki jngai palat ïa nga ; ka jingjynjar kan lap ïa nga , bad nga Lah ban ïap noh shuwa ban poi shata .
translation.en: Behold now , thy servant hath found grace in thy sight , and thou hast magnified thy mercy , which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life  ; and I cannot escape to the mountain , lest some evil take me , and I die :
Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head , and honour the face of the old man , and fear thy God : I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Pyni burom ïa ki briew ba la tymmen bad ai burom ïa ki . Da kaba tiengburom kohnguh ïa nga ; Nga long U  Trai .
U Moses u mihnoh na u Pharaoh , bad u Kyrpad ïa U Trai ,
translation.en: And Moses went out from Pharaoh , and entreated the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka la ber dpei ha la ka khlieh , ka la kad ïa la ka sopti jynsur , pynlang da kaba jingbuhrieh ïa la ka iitkhmat da katba tap da ki kti ka la leit noh da kaba ïam .
translation.en: And Tamar put ashes on her head , and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her , and laid her hand on her head , and went on crying .

translation.kha: Kiei kiei baroh kiba nga kren-ïa ki long kiba shisha ; ym don ei ei ha ki kaba lamler lane ïabam khrew .
translation.en: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness  ; there is nothing froward or perverse in them .
And God Almighty give you mercy before the man , that he may send away your other brother , and Benjamin . If I be bereaved of my children , I am bereaved .
translation.kha: To U Blei Badonbor Baroh un pynlong ïa uta u briew ba un isynei ïa phi , khnang ba un pynphai sha phi ïa u hynmen u para jong phi , bad ïa u Benjamin de . Ïa nga shimet te , lada nga dei ban duh ïa la ki khun , ieh ngan mat duh ïa ki .
U Tom u dang shu dep pynkhreh .
translation.en: Tom is just finishing setting up .
For I say unto you , That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi baroh ba ym don na kito ki rangbah kiba la shah khot sngewbha ki ban ïohmad ïa ka jingbam miet jong nga !’

translation.en: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia .
translation.kha: U langbrot uba me ïohi uba la don ar tylli ki reng u ïeng na ka bynta ki hima jong ka Media bad Persia .

Ang hap ban bsa ïa phi da ka dud , ym da ka jingbam kaba eh , namar phim pat shym kotbor ïa ka . badno wat haduh mynta phim bapaw long katba kotbor ïa ka , namsop phi ïan im Rumah im ki bariew jyllang kane ka pyrthei .
translation.en: I have fed you with milk , and not with meat : for hitherto ye were not able to bear it , neither yet now are ye able .

translation.kha: Hato u Syiem Kynrad u mynnin ïa kane baroh bad ym shym ïathaw kad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong phi mano ban long syiem hadien jongki phi ?
translation.en: Is this thing done by my lord the king , and thou hast not shewed it unto thy servant , who should sit on the throne of my lord the king after him ?

translation.kha: Ki jingpyrshang ban pyntieng ïa ngi ban pynsangeh ïa ka kam . Nga la ïaboi , Khynñiuh mynba , A Blei , pynlong khlei ïa nga !
translation.en: For they all made us afraid , saying , Their hands shall be weakened from the work , that it be not done . Now therefore , O God , strengthen my hands .

translation.kha: U Trai u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur bad mawthew bymhok .
translation.en: Divers weights , and divers measures , both of them are alike abomination to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ym don uba da ban wan sha nga lymda U Kpa uba la phah ïa at u pynwan ïa u Sha nga ; bad lang pynmihpat ïa u ha ka sngi kaba khatduh .
translation.en: No man can come to me , except the Father which hath sent me draw him : and I will raise him up at the last day .

translation.kha: Ha sha ban thaw ïa ka pyrthei , u Ktien u la lah don lapbah ; u la ba-don sad U Blei , bun u longïing kumjuh kum U Blei .
translation.en: In the beginning was the Word , and the Word was with God , and the Word was God .

translation.kha: Ïa u nud na ka bynta kaei ka jingkñia dei ban pynïap ha ka boitha pashait jong ka duwan , ha kaba ju pynïap ïa ki mrad ba la wallam kum ki jingainguh tdong , bad ïa ka snam jong u dei ban synreit ha baïar sawdong jong ka duwan .
translation.en: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering : and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar .

translation.kha: Ym namar ba nga kwah ban ïohpdiang ïa ki jingai sngewbha ; pynban , na kwah ban ïohi ba la pynlang ïa ka jingïohnong ha ka jingbuh jingkheiñ jong phi .
translation.en: Not because I desire a gift : but I desire fruit that may abound to your account .

translation.kha: U Tharai u ong , Ko khun u briew , to kren ha ki lawbah ki Israel nabar ong ïa ki ban shahshkor ïa ka khubor kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar de don na ka bynta jong ki :
translation.en: Also , thou son of man , prophesy unto the mountains of Israel , and say , Ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the  Lord  :
And they laded their asses with the corn , and departed thence .
translation.kha: Kita shi para ki la pynkit ïa u kew ba ki la thied ha ki kada jong ki , bad ki ïamihnoh nangta .

translation.en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the  Lord s  name is to be praised .
translation.kha: Naduh mihngi shaduh sepngi A to ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong U  Trai  !

Ha ka sngi kaba U thri u ai jingjop ïa ki Israel hajar ki Amor , u Joshua u kren ha U Trai . Ha iitkhmat ki Jeruel u ainong , Ko Sngi , to ïeng thik halor ka Gibeon , Ko bna , to Seneh ha ka Ang Aijalon .
translation.en: Then spake Joshua to the  Lord  in the day when the  Lord  delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel , and he said in the sight of Israel , Sun , stand thou still upon Gibeon  ; and thou , Moon , in the valley of Aijalon .

translation.kha: Ki la mane ïa kiwei ki balieh , ki bud ïa ki rukom jong ki briew kiba U Trai u la beh noh Kaba ki briew jong u ki dang tam shaphrang , bad ki pdiang ïa ki rukom ba la sdang da ki syiem ka Israel .
translation.en: And walked in the statutes of the heathen , whom the  Lord  cast out from before the children of Israel , and of the kings of Israel , which they had made .
The glory of the  Lord  shall endure for ever : the  Lord  shall rejoice in his works .
translation.kha: To ka burom jong U  Trai  kan neh junom ! To U  Trai  un kmen ïa kaei kaba u la thaw !
Kumta ïa i'u u shakri bymsngewtynnat — bret ïa u shabar ha kaba dum ; hangta un lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .’
translation.en: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .

translation.kha: U shna ruh ïa ka miej da ka Dieng Akhish , kaba phraphew phra sentimitar ka lynter , sawphew saw sentimitar ka pyngkiang , Bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .
translation.en: And he made the table of shittim wood : two cubits was the length thereof , and a cubit the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof :

translation.kha: Ka hynmen jong pha , ka dei ka Samaria ha ka phang bashatei , ryngkat bad ki nongrit jong ka . Ka para jong pha lem bad ki nongrit jong ka , ka dei ka Sodom ha ka phang bashathie .
translation.en: And thine elder sister is Samaria , she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand : and thy younger sister , that dwelleth at thy right hand , is Sodom and her daughters .

But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation , and they shall bear their iniquity : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations , that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance .
translation.kha: Naduh mynta dei tang ki Lebi ki ban sumar ïa ka Ïingjaiñ bad kin kitkhlieh nadong shadong ïa ka . Kane ka long ka hukum kaba ïaineh bad kaba teh ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi pateng la pateng .
hynriew lada ki nongshun jong ki bhabriew jong nga ki kwah ïa ka jingïada jong nga , ai ba ken ïasuk bad de . ho-oid , ai kin ïasuk malu nga .
translation.en: Or let him take hold of my strength , that he may make peace with me  ; and he shall make peace with me .

translation.kha: Namar baroh kata kaba la jia , ma I , ki Israel , hangne ngi pyntong ka jingïakut bakyntang da ka jingthoh , bad ki nongïalam jong ngi , ki Libya jong im , bad ki lyndang jong ngi ki buh ïa ki jingshon muhor ha ka .
translation.en: And because of all this we make a sure covenant , and write it  ; and our princes , Levites , and priests , seal unto it .

translation.kha: Ka don hangta Haduh lai bnai , bad U Tlai u kyrkhu ïa ka longïng u Obed Edom bad baroh kiei kiei kiba dei ki lad u .
translation.en: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed–edom in his house three months . And the  Lord  blessed the house of Obed–edom , and all that he had .

translation.kha: Shah ïa na ba ngan hawei ïa phin katno ka khraw ka leh U Blei! , bad ban batai kaei kaba U Blei Badonbor baroh u la thmu lypa .
translation.en: I will teach you by the hand of God : that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal .

translation.kha: Kumta phi phla shisha ba ph longsyiem ki khuid ki ksiew jong kito kiba la pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa !
translation.en: Wherefore ye be witnesses unto yourselves , that ye are the children of them which killed the prophets .

translation.kha: Ka jaka jong ka , ka kynjoh ïa ka Jesreel , ka Khesulloth , ka Shunem ,
translation.en: And their border was toward Jezreel , and Chesulloth , and Shunem ,

translation.kha: Lada ka khriat , ki ar jrut ki lah banbeiñ ïathiah lang bad ngab napoh ha ka jingsyiad , hynrei kumno phira pynneh jingsyiad tang ma phi da lade hi ?
translation.en: Again , if two lie together , then they have heat : but how can one be warm alone ?
And when Herod would have brought him forth , the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers , bound with two chains : and the keepers before the door kept the prison .
translation.kha: Ha ka miet shuwa ba u Herod un wallam ïa u sha u paidbah , u Petros u dang ïohthiah hapdeng ar ngut ki nongap phira . La teh ïa u da ar tylli ki kynjri , bad la don ki nongap phira kiba ap ha ka khyrdop jong ka byndi .
U pynkhiah ïa kiba la pait dohkha pynlang u sop spaiñ ïa ki jingmong jong ki .
translation.en: He healeth the broken in heart , and bindeth up their wounds .

translation.kha: Kine barabor ki kdew ïa ki kiei kiba long ki bymmyntoi shisien ba la dep pyndonkam ; ki longsyiem tang ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai u briew .
translation.en: Which all are to perish with the using ; ) after the commandments and doctrines of men ?

translation.kha: U Araunah u la ai lut ha u syiem bad u ong ha u , To U Trai U Blei jongno phi un pyngkiang ïa ka jingainguh jong phi .
translation.en: All these things did Araunah , as a king , give unto the king . And Araunah said unto the king , The  Lord  thy God accept thee .

translation.kha: Pha Pynmih bun ki nongkhaïi ban ïa ka jingbun ki khlur ha ka sahit pdeng ! Hynrei mynsiem ki sih noh , kum ki puit kiba pyiar la ki thapniang bad ki jaijai noh .
translation.en: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants above the stars of heaven : the cankerworm spoileth , and flieth away .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah ap phira jong u Salu ha Hephsibah ha ri Benjamin ki ïohi ïa ki Philistia ba ki phet ha ka jingkulmar .
translation.en: And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked  ; and , behold , the multitude melted away , and they went on beating down one another .

translation.kha: Ïa ngin ïaleh sha ïingbishar ; wallam ïa ka jingmudui jong phi ! Buh ïa ka kam jong Phin ban pynsaja ba phi long ha naba dei !
translation.en: Put me in remembrance : let us plead together : declare thou , that thou mayest be justified .
The mother of Sisera looked out at a window , and cried through the lattice , Why is his chariot so long in coming ? why tarry the wheels of his chariots ?
translation.kha: Ka kmie jong u Sisera ka la khmih na ka jingkhangïit ; Ka la phngoid na shadien ka jingker .  Balei ka kali ïapom jong u ka slem ban wan ?  ka la ong .  Balei ki kulai jong u ki tud ban wan phai ?
U Isaak u ainong , Me ïohi ba nga la tymmen bad shen ngan sa ïap noh .
translation.en: And he said , Behold now , I am old , I know not the day of my death :
Am I a God at hand , saith the  Lord  , and not a God afar off ?
translation.kha: Nga long U Blei uba don ha ki jaka baroh bad ym tang ha kawei ka jaka .
ngan pynneh junom ïa ka khet syiem jong me ha Jeraïah , kumba nga la kyllum ha u Dabid u kpa jngai me , da kaba ong , ‘ Men ym kyrduh u briew u ban shong ha ka khet Israel .’
translation.en: Then I will establish the throne of thy kingdom upon Israel for ever , as I promised to David thy father , saying , There shall not fail thee a man upon the throne of Israel .
Wherefore David blessed the  Lord  before all the congregation : and David said , Blessed be thou ,  Lord  God of Israel our father , for ever and ever .
translation.kha: Hangta ha khmat uta u paidbah baroh , u syiem Dabid u ïaroh ïa U  Trai . U ong  A  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ai ba yn ïaroh ïa me junom la junom !
ïa ka duwan ksiar , ïa ka umphniang pynsleh , ïa ka jingiwbih , ïa ka pyrsa ïa ka jaka rung sha ka jingïoh ;
translation.en: And the golden altar , and the anointing oil , and the sweet incense , and the hanging for the tabernacle door ,

translation.kha: phi ka lyoh bun u phylliah , ka ioh Bad ki liewlong , ki lyer bakhlaiñ kiba kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u .
translation.en: Fire , and hail  ; snow , and vapour  ; stormy wind fulfilling his word :

translation.kha: Bad U Trei jong ngi , ïa uba kine kiei kiei ki kren , u wan na kawei pat ka jait , malade ym ei uno uno u dkhot na ka jait Jong u , uba la shakri kum u lyngdoh .
translation.en: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe , of which no man gave attendance at the altar .

translation.kha: hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi , ‘ To wan pei sha de bad ngan wan phai sha phi .
translation.en: Therefore say thou unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Turn ye unto me , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will turn unto you , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Nangta jong ïa ki paid Jesreel shun wallam ïa uei u jingmihnoh ban pyntong ka jingkñia namar ka pop , uwei u khun masi uba shisnem , dara uwei u khunlangbrot uba jingmihsnam , ki bym don kano kane ka jingduna , ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh thang ,
translation.en: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak , saying , Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; and a calf and a lamb , both of the first year , without blemish , for a burnt offering  ;

translation.kha: U Joseph u long kiba ïadep shynrang bad uba bhabriew lymphuin , bad hadien Khyndiat jer , ka tnga Jong u kynrad jong u ka la sdang Ban ikwah ïa u Joseph , bad ka la ong ïa u ban rupa thiah bad ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass after these things , that his master s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph  ; and she said , Lie with me .

translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba ha ka Sniew ka Jingbishar , U Blei un pyn-i kham lep ka jingisynei ïa ki briew ka Tyros bad Sidon ban ïa ph !
translation.en: But I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the day of judgment , than for you .

translation.kha: mynno ba lah ban pynmatlah ïa ki khmat jong u bad kem ïa u ? lane mano ba lah ban kem ïa ka khmat jong u ha ka jingriam ?
translation.en: He taketh it with his eyes : his nose pierceth through snares .
Thy servant will go a little way over Jordan with the king : and why should the king recompense it me with such a reward ?
translation.kha: Ngam don hok ïa kaba kum kane ka bainong bakhraw . Kumta ngan shu leit on lynti ïa phi tang katto katne palat ïa ka Jordan .

translation.en: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David , to salute him , and to bless him , because he had fought against Hadadezer , and smitten him : for Hadadezer had wars with Toi . And Joram brought with him vessels of silver , and vessels of gold , and vessels of brass :
translation.kha: Kumta u la phah ïa u Joram , u khun jong u ban khublei ïa u Syiem Dabid bad ban ai khublei ïa u namar ka jingjop jong u ïa u Hadadeser , ïa uba u Toi u la ïaleh pyrshah la bunsien . U Joram u rah na ka bynta u Dabid ki jingai sngewbha kiba la thaw da ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad ka rnong .
mynsaw nga la thup tang ïa katai kaba khiew ki la ïathuh ïa nga , da kaba nga jingïohknieh pateng na kiwei ; hynrei mynta nga la ïohi ïa me da la ki jong ki khmat .
translation.en: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear : but now mine eye seeth thee .
And the barrel of meal wasted not , neither did the cruse of oil fail , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by Elijah .
translation.kha: Kumba U  Trai  u la kular lyngba u Elijah , ka pliang  purew kam shym la thylli lymne u klong um shym long khlem umphniang .
Yn sa pynjot noh thir ïa kiba sniew .—2 Petros 3 :7 .
translation.en: The wicked will be destroyed . —2 Peter 3 :7 .
Verily I say unto you , That he shall make him ruler over all his goods .
translation.kha: Da shisha , nga ong ha phi , u kynrad un buh ïa uta u shakri ban khmih ïa ka jingdon jingem jong u baroh .
Hynrei lep kiba long nyngkong mynta kin sa erlangthari khatduh , bad bun ibha longïng khatduh mynta kin sa hir nyngkong .
translation.en: But many that are first shall be last  ; and the last first .

translation.kha: Ma phi ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham , u shakri jongnga u ; ma phi ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob , u briew uba u la jied : Kynmaw ïa ki kambah ba U Blei u la leh bad ki jingbishar bakha u la ai .
translation.en: O ye seed of Abraham his servant , ye children of Jacob his chosen .

translation.kha: Ynda u la ong ïa Kane , u Paul u la rim katto katai u kpu , u la ainguh ïa U Bela ha khmat jongnga ki baroh , u la kdiah ïa u , pynlang u la sdang ban bam .
translation.en: And when he had thus spoken , he took bread , and gave thanks to God in presence of them all : and when he had broken it , he began to eat .

translation.kha: Ïa ki kyntien jong phi! yn sa pyndem ban bishar ïa Phi — ngab pynbna ïa phi la phi longsyiem uba lui lui ne kaba shah pynrem .
translation.en: For by thy words thou shalt be justified , and by thy words thou shalt be condemned .

But a prophet of the  Lord  was there , whose name was Oded : and he went out before the host that came to Samaria , and said unto them , Behold , because the  Lord  God of your fathers was wroth with Judah , he hath delivered them into your hand , and ye have slain them in a rage that reacheth up unto heaven .
translation.kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Oded , u nongïathuhlypa jong U  Trai  ; u shong ha ka nongbah Samaria . U ïakynduh ïa ka kynhun shipai Israel kaba wan phai bad ki koidi Judia hamar ba kin rung sha ka nongbah bad u ong :  U  Trai  U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u la bitar ïa ki Judah , bad u la shah ïa phi ban jop ; hynrei mynta u la ïohsngew ïa ka jinglehbeiñ palat jong phi ba phi pynïap ïa ki .
Kita ki saw ngut ki syiem ki la shim lut khoit kat kaba dat ha Sodom bad Joram , kaba kynduh ruh ïa ka jingbam bad ki la leit noh .
translation.en: And they took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah , and all their victuals , and went their way .

translation.kha: Nga ong pat : wat ai ba a Uno un ñiew ïa nga uba bieit . Hynrei lada phi pyllait kumta , la kumin kumno to pyndeng ïa na koum ibha bieit , khñiang ba sam don ei ei ban sngewsarong .
translation.en: I say again , Let no man think me a fool ; if otherwise , yet as a fool receive me , that I may boast myself a little .

translation.kha: Nangta u Shalman u tur ïaleh ïa ka Israel bad u kerkut ïa ka Samaria . Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingshah kerkut ,
translation.en: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land , and went up to Samaria , and besieged it three years .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba synreit saw jong u bthei uba nongdih jong ka snem , to la ïeng harud jong ka wah Tigris kaba khrawbor .
translation.en: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month , as I was by the side of the great river , which is Hiddekel  ;

translation.kha: Nga bishni ïa kito kiba la ïap bun Kiba la leit noh ; ki long kiba kham bha ban ïa kito kiba dong im .
translation.en: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïakylliang sbai ban ïaid napdeng ki ar ngut ki pynrangbah , bad uta uba la jied u la long u Matthias , ïa uba la pynïasoh sha ka kynhun ki khawai ngut ki apostol .
translation.en: And they gave forth their lots  ; and the lot fell upon Matthias  ; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles .

translation.kha: Hobab iathuh u rangïapom pynkular u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la saw sha u rangbah ai hukum bad u la kylli ïa u , Me leh aiu ? Utai u briew u dei u traishnong ka Hima Kamra ?
translation.en: When the centurion heard that , he went and told the chief captain , saying , Take heed what thou doest : for this man is a Roman .
