translation.kha: bad u la set ïa ki hapoh bymdei ha ka ïohnang jong u kapten jong ki nongap phira , ha kajuh ka jaka ha kaba la buh ïa u Joseph .
translation.en: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard , into the prison , the place where Joseph was bound .
And it shall come to pass , when I bring a cloud over the earth , that the bow shall be seen in the cloud :
translation.kha: Ha man ba nga tap ïa ka suiñbneng da u lyoh , bad ba u simpyllieng u paw ,

translation.en: Yet thus saith the Lord  God   ; At the end of forty years will I gather the Egyptians from the people whither they were scattered :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u ong ,  Hadien sawphew snem ngan wallam pat ïa ki nong Ijipt na ki ri sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki ,

U Solomon u pynrit julor ïa ki kynhun ki ksiar jong ki nong Kanaan ki bymïap shym la shah pynpoh ha ki Eliel mynba ki knieh ïa ka ri jong ki . Kine ki kyntiew ïa ki Amor , ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Hib , bad ki Jebus , kiba ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki dang lama ki maw haduh kane ka por .
translation.en: Their children that were left after them in the land , whom the children of Israel also were not able utterly to destroy , upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day .
And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim , and went over Jordan with the king , to conduct him over Jordan .
translation.kha: U Barsillai , uba na Gilead , u la wan hiar ruh na Rogelim ban synran ïa u syiem sha shiliang ka Jordan .

translation.en: It is thou , O king , that art grown and become strong : for thy greatness is grown , and reacheth unto heaven , and thy dominion to the end of the earth .
translation.kha: Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi long u dieng , uba jrong bad uba khlaiñ . Phi la long khraw haduh katta kat ban kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng , bad ka bor jong phi ka ïar halor ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
Ka ba-ieit thep mynsiem jong nga , ka nongleitkurim jong nga , ka long ka kper Beraïah , ka kper ba la ber kynroh , ka umpohliew bymïap Dei paidbah ;
translation.en: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters , washed with milk , and fitly set .
Because there is wrath , beware lest he take thee away with his stroke : then a great ransom cannot deliver thee .
translation.kha: Da sumar ban ym shah ïa ki jingbamsap ban shukor ïa phi , lane ka spah ban ïalam sakma ïa phi .

translation.en: Behold , the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon with fair branches , and with a shadowing shroud , and of an high stature  ; and his top was among the thick boughs .
translation.kha: Me long kum u dieng Kedar ka Lebanon , lem bad ki tnat kiba itynnat bad ba kah syrngiew , u dieng uba jrong katta katta uba kot haduh ki lyoh .
ki briew babha iehnoh ïa ka jingjam hok ban im ha ka jingdum ka pop ,
translation.en: Who leave the paths of uprightness , to walk in the ways of darkness  ;

translation.kha: “Nga longïing u dieng sohwaiñ , bad phi long ki tnat . U uno ibha ïaineh ha nga , bad ma nga ha u , un seisoh sian ; naba ‘Phim ia ban leh ei ei khlei ma nga .
translation.en: I am the vine , ye are the branches : He that abideth in me , and I in him , the same bringeth forth much fruit : for without me ye can do nothing .

translation.kha: bad ki buh ïa ki jingai baroh’ dara kawei-na-kaba-shiphew hangta ban shynrong . Ki thung ïa u Lebi uba kyrteng u Kanah ban peit bad ki pynlong ïa u para jong u , u Shimei kum u nongïapeiñ lem jong u .
translation.en: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully : over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler , and Shimei his brother was the next .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba phi duwai , ph dei ban jingkit bad ban ym artatien da laiñ lei . Uno uno uba pyrthat u long kum ka jingat phylliah ha ka duriaw ïa kaba la beh bad ba la pynshad kyntur da ka lyer .
translation.en: But let him ask in faith , nothing wavering . For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed .

translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la pdiang Katto katne ka jingbam na ki , hyndai kim shym kynjoh ktien na U Trai shaphang kata .
translation.en: And the men took of their victuals , and asked not counsel at the mouth of the  Lord .

translation.kha: To wat shah shukor , phi ki parabangeit ba-ieit jong nga !
translation.en: Do not err , my beloved brethren .

translation.kha: To wat ar kyrkieh ha kaba bah ïa ki kti halor jongno jongngi ban pynkyntang ïa u sha ka kam U Trai . To woh ïan bynta ha ki pop Jong kiwei ; to ri ïa latai uba sngur .
translation.en: Lay hands suddenly on no man , neither be partaker of other men s sins : keep thyself pure .
And Elijah said unto Ahab , Get thee up , eat and drink  ; for there is a sound of abundance of rain .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ha u syiem Ahab ,  Mynta , khie leit bad bam . Nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ba u slap u wan .

translation.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz , Caleb s younger brother , took it : and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife .
translation.kha: U Othniel , u khun jong u Kenas , u para jong u Kaleb , u la ïohknieh ïa ka nongbah ; kumta u Kaleb u la ai ha u ïa la ka khun kynthei ban shongkurim .

translation.en: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week , he appeared first to Mary Magdalene , out of whom he had cast seven devils .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Jisu u la mihpat na ka jingïap dang step phyrngab ha ka Sngi U Trai , u la mihpaw nyngkong ha ka Mari ka nong Magdala , na kaba u la pynmih noh ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki ksuid .
Ki shna ruh khanatang tylli ki diengkhap da ka dieng akasia , san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei ka liang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ,
translation.en: And he made bars of shittim wood  ; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle ,

translation.kha: Ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong ki naduh kambah lai pateng bynriew ter thri da ban kynthup hapdeng ki briew U Trai .
translation.en: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the  Lord  in their third generation .

translation.kha: Kumno ki Aiñ jong U Blei ki ai Jingmyntoi ïa ngi ?
translation.en: How Do Bible Principles Benefit Us ?

translation.kha: To wallam pat ïa ngi sha me , ko Trai ! To wallam pat ïa ngi ! To pynïoh pat ïa ka burom ba-mynbarim .
translation.en: Turn thou us unto thee , O  Lord  , and we shall be turned  ; renew our days as of old .

And the men of Israel turned again upon the children of Benjamin , and smote them with the edge of the sword , as well the men of every city , as the beast , and all that came to hand : also they set on fire all the cities that they came to .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki wan phai pat ban ïaleh sa ïa kiwei ki Benjamin kiba dang sah , bad ki pynïap lut ïa ki baroh — ki rangbah , ki kynthei , ki khynnah , bad ki jingri jingdup ruh . Ki thang lut khoit ïa ki shnong baroh kiba don ha kata ka thain .
Hynrei ki tang meng ïarung ïa ka ri ha Adam , ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang kaba nga la ïateh mala ki .
translation.en: But they like men have transgressed the covenant : there have they dealt treacherously against me .
And the sons of Noah , that went forth of the ark , were Shem , and Ham , and Japheth : and Ham is the father of Canaan .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang u Noah kiba la ïawan mih na kata ka lieng ki long u Shem , u Ham , bad u Japheth . ( U Ham u long u kpa jong u Kanaan . )

translation.en: Of the oaks of Bashan have they made thine oars  ; the company of the Ashurites have made thy benches of ivory , brought out of the isles of Kittim .
translation.kha: Ki shim ïa ki dieng Sning na Bashan ban shna boitha ; ki shna ïa ka rynsan jong pha na ki kseh ba na Sypros bad pyndait ha ka da ki bniat hati .

translation.en: And let none of you imagine evil in your hearts against his neighbour  ; and love no false oath : for all these are things that I hate , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Wat thmu ïa ki rukom pynmynsaw iwei ïa iwei pat . Wat ai ïa ka jingsakhi lamler ha kaba jingsmai . Nga isih ïa ka jinglamler , ka jingbymlehhok bad ka jinglehbor .

U la leh pop byrsha ïa U Trai , namar hadien ka jingïap u kput jong u kiwei pateng ki dkhot jong ka longïing u sahmiet Ahab ki la long ki nongai jingmut ïa u , bad ki la pynlong ïa ka jingkyllon noh jong u .
translation.en: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of the  Lord  like the house of Ahab : for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction .

translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ka hukum ka long kaba bha lada pyndonkam ïa ka kumba dei .
translation.en: But we know that the law is good , if a man use it lawfully ;
And the king said to him , How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the  Lord  ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Ahab u jubab ,  Haba phi ong ïa nga ha ka kyrteng U  Trai  , ong ïa ka jingshisha ! Katno sien ba nga hap ban ong ha phi ïa kata ?

translation.en: Make a chain : for the land is full of bloody crimes , and the city is full of violence .
translation.kha: Kiei kiei baroh ki kulmar lut — ka ri ka kynrei da ki jingïa-pynïap bad ki nongbah ki shlei da ka jingleh thombor .

translation.en: And the counsel of Ahithophel , which he counselled in those days , was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of God : so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom .
translation.kha: Ïa kano kano ka jingai jingmut ba u Ahithophel u la ai ha kito ki sngi , la pdiang kumba ka long hi ka ktien jong U Blei ; u Dabid bad u Absalom baroh ar ngut ki bud ïa ka .
Ka Abigail ka leit phai sha u Nabal , uba don ha ïing ha ka jingkhawai kaba kat ka jingkhawai u shem . U la buaid malade shongshit , kumta kam syiem ïathuh ei ei ïathuh ka step kaba bud .
translation.en: And Abigail came to Nabal  ; and , behold , he held a feast in his house , like the feast of a king  ; and Nabal s heart was merry within him , for he was very drunken : wherefore she told him nothing , less or more , until the morning light .

translation.kha: ban buh jingshoh ïa ki Lebi katno lwet ki don shi kur shi kur bad sia ïing shi ïing , da kaba thoh kyrtong ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang uba la dap shi bna ne kham heh ,
translation.en: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary , and all the vessels of the sanctuary , as the camp is to set forward  ; after that , the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it : but they shall not touch any holy thing , lest they die . These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation .
And I will bring them , and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem : and they shall be my people , and I will be their God , in truth and in righteousness .
translation.kha: bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki na mihngi bad na sepngi ban shong ban sah ha Jerusalem . Kin long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki , da kaba synshar ha ka jingïaineh bad ha ka jinglehhok .
dien kata keiñ baïar U Balei u la phah ïa ka kti ban thoh ïa kine ki kyntien .
translation.en: Then was the part of the hand sent from him  ; and this writing was written .
Beloved , if God so loved us , we ought also to love one another .
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit , lada kane ka long kumno U Blei u la ieit ïa ngi , te ma ngi , ngi dei ban ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei pat .
U Job u la im shispah arphew sniew hadien kane , ka jingim kaba la jlew bha kat ban ïor ïa ki ksiew bad ïa ki ksiew tun .
translation.en: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years , and saw his sons , and his sons  sons , even four generations .

Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me , and strengthened me ; that by me the preaching might be fully known , and that all the Gentiles might hear : and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la pynim ïa nga bad u la ai bor ïa nga , ba nga la lah ban ïalap ïa ka gospel , bad ba ki Jentil baroh kin ïohsngew ; U Blei u la pyllait ïa nga na ka jingïap .
U kpa tymmen jong ki u Jehoba u la ïaleit ïa u hynmen synrap jong u , u Iso , katba baroh ar ngut ki dang don hapoh ka kpoh ka kmie jong ki ; haba u Jakob u la nang san , u ïaleh pyrsad ïa U Blei —
translation.en: He took his brother by the heel in the womb , and by his strength he had power with God :

translation.kha: Ka jingkyrpad jong ngi ïa ph kam dei kaba pynsngewrem nongrim ha ka jingbankhia lane ha ki jingthmu bymkhuid , lymne ba ngi pyrshang ban shukor ïano ïano .
translation.en: For our exhortation was not of deceit , nor of uncleanness , nor in guile :

translation.kha: Baroh ki nongshong shnong jong said ka nongbah ki la ïamynjur ïa katei kob u Hamor bad u Shekhem ki ai jingmut , bad barben ki shynrang ki la shah otsher .
translation.en: And unto Hamor and unto Shechem his son hearkened all that went out of the gate of his city  ; and every male was circumcised , all that went out of the gate of his city .

translation.kha: Haba kine ki kiei borbah ki sdang ban ia , ïeng jot bad pynjngut ïa la ki khleiñ , namar ka jingpynim Jong phi ka la jan .
translation.en: And when these things begin to come to pass , then look up , and lift up your heads  ; for your redemption draweth nigh .

translation.kha: Ngam slem thuh ban im ; ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha U Trei ka la duh .
translation.en: And I said , My strength and my hope is perished from the  Lord  :
It shall be the basest of the kingdoms  ; neither shall it exalt itself any more above the nations : for I will diminish them , that they shall no more rule over the nations .
translation.kha: ka hima batlot tam na baroh , bad kin ym ïoh synshar pat halor kiwei ki hima . Ngan pynlong ïa ki , ki bymlarkam haduh ba kin ym lah ban pynlong ïa kano kano ka hima ban pyndem ha ka mon jong ki .
Ha kawei ka sngi ka ong ïa la ka kynrad , Nga kwah ba u kynrad jong nga un lah ban leit sha u nongïathuh uba shong ha Samaria ! Un pynkhiah ïa u na ka jingpang jong u .
translation.en: And she said unto her mistress , Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria ! for he would recover him of his leprosy .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ka khynraw kane khynñiuh , bad uwei pa uwei ha ka ri un longïng ha ka jingleh . Ka ri baroh kawei kan khynñiuh ; kane kiew bun kane hiar kum ka wah Nile .
translation.en: Shall not the land tremble for this , and every one mourn that dwelleth therein ? and it shall rise up wholly as a flood  ; and it shall be cast out and drowned , as by the flood of Egypt .
If a man vow a vow unto the  Lord  , or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond  ; he shall not break his word , he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u kular ban ai ei ei sha U  Trai  , lane u smai ban kyndiah na kaei re kaei , um dei ban pynkheiñ ïa la ka kular , hynrei u dei ban pyndep lut ïa baroh kaba u la ong ban pyndep .
Ki ri ba-marjan Bad ki ri ba hajngai ki krenbeiñ ïa pham namar ka jingbymdon waiñ ha pha .
translation.en: Those that be near , and those that be far from thee , shall mock thee , which art infamous and much vexed .
Woe to thee , O land , when thy king is a child , and thy princes eat in the morning !
translation.kha: Ka ri ka don ha ka jingjynjar haba u syiem jong ka u dei u samla bad ki nongïalam jong ka ki ïakhawai baroh shi miet .
Ngam donbor shuh ban pynrem ïa lade ; ym don hangno hangno kaba nga lah ban phai ban oh jingïarap .
translation.en: Is not my help in me ? and is wisdom driven quite from me ?

translation.kha: Keiñ hynñiew sien ki hynñiew snem , kata baroh kan long sawphew khyndai snem .
translation.en: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee , seven times seven years  ; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years .
With Chedorlaomer the king of Elam , and with Tidal king of nations , and Amraphel king of Shinar , and Arioch king of Ellasar  ; four kings with five .
translation.kha: ïa ki syiem jong ka Elam , ka Goiim , ka Babilonia bad ka Ellasar , ki san ngut ki syiem pyrshah ïa ki saw ngut ki syiem .
Nangne u la phah ïa ki ban ïalap ïa ka Hima U Blei malu shun pynkhiah ïa kiba pang ,
translation.en: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God , and to heal the sick .

translation.kha: Kumta ngan sngewsarong shapoh une u briew — hynrei lang! ym kob sarong shaphang ïa lade , lait noh ïa khie kiei babha pynpaw haduh kat at long uba tlot .
translation.en: Of such an one will I glory : yet of myself I will not glory , but in mine infirmities .

translation.kha: malu kawei patan ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , U Trai u tip ba ki jingpyrkhat lad kiba stad ki long ki bymotsher ei ei .
translation.en: And again , The Lord knoweth the thoughts of the wise , that they are vain .
And now art thou cursed from the earth , which hath opened her mouth to receive thy brother s blood from thy hand  ;
translation.kha: La buh ïa me hapoh ka jingtim bad men ym lah shuh ban rep ha ka khyndew . Ka la kjit noh ïa ka snam u para jong me , i kumba ka la ang ïa la ka shyntur ban pdiang ïa kata mynba me la pynïap ïa u .
Nangta ki baphylla ki la leit peiñ pat sha Jerusalem na u lum ki Eliab , uba jngai kumba shi kilomitar na ka nongbah .
translation.en: Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet , which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day s journey .
And the vine said unto them , Should I leave my wine , which cheereth God and man , and go to be promoted over the trees ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u dieng sohwaiñ u jubab , ‘ Na ka bynta ban synshar ïa phi , ngan hap sangeh ban pynmih ïa ka waiñ jong nga , kaba pynkmen ïa ki blei bad ïa ki khunbynriew .’
Ka jingkheiñ ki rangbah bakha la bam ka la long saw hajar ngut , khlem da ñiew ïa ki kynthei bad ki khynnah .
translation.en: And they that did eat were four thousand men , beside women and children .
Receive my instruction , and not silver  ; and knowledge rather than choice gold .
translation.kha: Jied ïa ka jingbthah jong nga , ban ïa ka rupa ; jied ïa ka jingtip , ban ïa ka ksiar nylla .
Kat tista long kaba kmen long aiwai pa uwei un ïoh khwai ka um na ka byndi ki jingweng sad ki jaka pynbamphlang bashngain ha kylleng na ka bynta ki kada Bad ki mai .
translation.en: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters , that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi banyngkong jong ka Jingkhawai niam U kpoh Bakhlem Thiat , ki synrap ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la kylli ïa u , Hangno me khiah ïa moi ban pynkhreh ïa ka jingbam ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait na ka bynda jong me ?
translation.en: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus , saying unto him , Where wilt thou that we prepare for thee to eat the passover ?

translation.kha: Lada phi ieit ïa la ka jingim , phet krad na ki jingriam Kaba pynngat ïa u bymman ha ka lynter ïaid .
translation.en: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward : he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them .

translation.kha: Ha khmih , A Trai , ha ka jingkordit jongnga nga , ha ka jingjynjar saiñdur ka mynsiem jyllang nga ! Ka dohnud jong nga ka pait ha ka jingsngewsih na ka beit ki pop jong nga . Ka don ka jingpynïap ha ki lynter bah ; wat hapoh ïing ka don ka jingïap .
translation.en: Behold , O  Lord  , and consider to whom thou hast done this . Shall the women eat their fruit , and children of a span long ? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord ?

translation.kha: Nangta katne katne ngut ki briew ki la ïeng bad ki la ïateh ïa kane ka jinglamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu ;
translation.en: And there arose certain , and bare false witness against him , saying ,
Having many things to write unto you , I would not write with paper and ink : but I trust to come unto you , and speak face to face , that our joy may be full .
translation.kha: Nga don shibun eh ban ïathuh ha phi , hynrei ngan ym leh ïa kata ha ka kot bad ka sia ; pynban , nga kyrmen ban da wan jngoh ïa phi bad ïakren markhmat bad phi , ba ka jingkmen jong ngi kan ïoh long kaba dap pura .
Ha kata khwai ka sngi , ar ngut na ki nongbud jong U Jisu ki dang leit shata ka shnong kaba kyrteng ka Emmaus , kumba khatwei kilomitar na Jerusalem ,
translation.en: And , behold , two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus , which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs .

translation.kha: Wat buh jingshaïong shuh ha ki brisoh ki bym lah ban im junom . Ki dondor ïathuh katno ?
translation.en: Cease ye from man , whose breath is in his nostrils : for wherein is he to be accounted of ?

translation.kha: Namar ka snam ki phasi kyrtong mala ki Blang kan ym haka ban kit noh ïa ki pop .
translation.en: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins .

translation.kha: Ale hangne bad ïathuhlypa ïa kaei ka ban sa jia , khñiang ba ngin tip ïa ka haba ka urlong . To batai ha ka ïingbishar ïa ki jingjia kba la dep bad ïathuh ïa ngi ka mut aïu .
translation.en: Let them bring them forth , and shew us what shall happen : let them shew the former things , what they be , that we may consider them , and know the latter end of them  ; or declare us things for to come .

translation.kha: U la ïohi ïa uwei na ki ba u la shah lehbeiñ ha u nongot Ijipt , kumta u la wait ban ïarap ïa u bad u la pynhiarkput ïa u nong Ijipt da kaba pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And seeing one of them suffer wrong , he defended him , and avenged him that was oppressed , and smote the Egyptian :

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un kut ka jingkren , sa uwei pat u sharak u la wan bad u ong , Ki khun jongnga phi! ki dang ïakhawai ha ïing u khun shynrang baheh duh jong phi , haba ka erïong na ri shyiap ka wan beh shapoh .
translation.en: While he was yet speaking , there came also another , and said , Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother s house :

translation.kha: Lada phi ïohi ïa ka masi ne ïa ka kada u nongshun jong phi ba ka ïaid sakma , otsher ïalam patar ïa ka Sha u .
translation.en: If thou meet thine enemy s ox or his ass going astray , thou shalt surely bring it back to him again .

translation.kha: Shisien man ka ut snem , ai kawei-na-kaba-shiphew — kaba shiphew na ki jingthung jong phi — ha ki Lebi , ki nongwei , ki khunswet , bun ki riewkynthei , khnang ba ha man la ka shnong kin ïoh ïam kdang . Ha Phin la leh ïa kane ,
translation.en: When thou hast made an end of tithing all the tithes of thine increase the third year , which is the year of tithing , and hast given it unto the Levite , the stranger , the fatherless , and the widow , that they may eat within thy gates , and be filled  ;

translation.kha: U Abraham u la shongkurim ïa khawai pud ka briew kaba kyrthat ka Keturah .
translation.en: Then again Abraham took a wife , and her name was Keturah .

translation.kha: Haduh I da lamwir shisha ? Ka long na ka bynta U Blei . Lane hato ngi longïng kiba tipbriew ? Te ka long na ka bynta jong phi .
translation.en: For whether we be beside ourselves , it is to God : or whether we be sober , it is for your cause .

translation.kha: Mynta ngi don shiah ka bor jong phi , leh ha ngi ïa kadei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long kaba dei .
translation.en: And now , behold , we are in thine hand : as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us , do .
But thine eyes and thine heart are not but for thy covetousness , and for to shed innocent blood , and for oppression , and for violence , to do it .
translation.kha: Hynrei me lah ban ïohi tang ïa la ki jingmyntoi shimet ; me pynïap ïa kiba lui lui , bad me banbeiñ tyngeh ïa la ki briew . U  Trai  u la kren .
Ha kawei ka sngi ka ong ïa la ka kynrad , ?(Nga kwah ba u kynrad lad nga un haka ban leit sha u nongïalap umbah shong ha Samaria ! Un pynkhiah ïa u na ka jingpang jong u .
translation.en: And she said unto her mistress , Would God my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria ! for he would recover him of his leprosy .
Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah , Shem , Ham , and Japheth : and unto them were sons born after the flood .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew na u Shem , u Ham , bad u Japheth , ki khun shynrang jong u Noah . Kine lai ngut ki la ïoh khun shynrang hadien kata ka jingshlei um .

Hadien ka jingïamai kaba snem u Porsius u la ïeng bad u la ong , Ko hynmen ko para jong nga , phi tip ba la kham slem mynshuwa U Blei’ u la jied ïa per napdeng jong phi ban ïalap ïa ka Khubor Babha sha ki Jentil , khnang ba ki lah pun ïohsngew bad ngeit .
translation.en: And when there had been much disputing , Peter rose up , and said unto them , Men and brethren , ye know how that a good while ago God made choice among us , that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word of the gospel , and believe .
Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper ? the glory of his nostrils is terrible .
translation.kha: Hato me pynlong ïa ki ban kynthih kum ki puit bad pynsheptieng ïa ki briew da ka jingpah jong ki ?
Uno uno u briew’ litar ka briew kiba ar byrtong ngin shah lynthem maw haduh ba kin da ïap ; eit uno u briew uba leh ïa kane u pan kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .
translation.en: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit , or that is a wizard , shall surely be put to death : they shall stone them with stones : their blood shall be upon them .

translation.kha: U Trai un kyrkhu ba phin roi kyrhai ha ki khun ki kti , ba ki jingkthang jong phi kin siaw shisien , bad ba ki maw bad ki khunlangbrot lad phi kan nang bun .
translation.en: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body , and the fruit of thy ground , and the fruit of thy cattle , the increase of thy kine , and the flocks of thy sheep .
Shew me the tribute money .  And they brought unto him a penny .
translation.kha: To pyn-i ha nga ïa ka pisa na ka bynta ban siew ïa ka khajna !  Ki la wanrah ha u ïa ka pisa ,
Shahshkor ! ong U Jiw . Nga wan kloi ! Ngan wallam ïa ki bainong jong nga , ban ai ha uwei pa imat kat kum kaei kaba u la leh .
translation.en: And , behold , I come quickly  ; and my reward is with me , to give every man according as his work shall be .

translation.kha: U Abraham u Joab , To da khmih bha ba men ym phah noh ïa u khuid jong nga sha !
translation.en: And Abraham said unto him , Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again .

translation.kha: Te ngan pynhap noh ïa ka ryntieh jong u na ka kti kaban jongki u bad ki khnam jong u kin hap noh na ka kti kamon jongu u .
translation.en: And I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand , and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand .

But all that heard him were amazed , and said  ; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem , and came hither for that intent , that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiba la ïohsngew ïa u ki la sngewlyngngoh bad ki la kylli ,  Hato une um dei uto uba ha Jerusalem u la pynïap ïa kito kiba mane ïa uta U Jisu ? Bad hato um shym wan hangne na ka bynta kajuh ka jingthmu ban kem ïa kito ki briew bad ban ïalam pat ïa ki sha ki rangbah lyngdoh ?
Nga kynmaw ïa ki jingïar jong me kiba mynbarim , bad ki wallam jingpyntngen ïa nga , A Trai .
translation.en: I remembered thy judgments of old , O  Lord   ; and have comforted myself .
And she said to the king , It was a true report which I heard in mine own land of thine acts , and of thy wisdom :
translation.kha: Ka ong ha u syiem ,  Kaei kaba nga la ïohsngew ha la ka jong ka ri shaphang jong phi bad ka jingstad jong phi , ka long kaba shisha ,
U Ïoannis u la jubab da kaba shim na u nongïathuhlypa Isaïah : Nga long ‘ ka sur jong uta uba pyrsa ha ka ri shyiap : To pynbeit ïa ka lynti ïaid jong U Trai ba un ïadat !’
translation.en: He said , I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness , Make straight the way of the Lord , as said the prophet Esaias .

translation.kha: Khmut , ko para jong nga , sngewbha ban kun ïa kane na ka bynshet U Trai ; kumne u para ha u Khrist , to pynkmen ïa nga !
translation.en: Yea , brother , let me have joy of thee in the Lord : refresh my bowels in the Lord .

translation.kha: Ngan ïai ban ha ka ar barhem ïa ki aiñ baroh kiba me la ai .
translation.en: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of thy mouth .

translation.kha: To khih leit shwa nawei u bri ha ka nongpang , u la ong ïa ki , bad ïathuh ha u : ‘ U Nonghikai u ong , ka por jong nga ka la pa ; ki synran jngai ang nabar ma nga ngim rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha ïing jong me !’
translation.en: And he said ,  Go into the city to such a man , and say unto him , The Master saith , My time is at hand  ; I will keep the passover at thy house with my disciples .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jesse u khot ïa u Abinoam u khun jong u bad u wan ïalam ïa u sha u Samuel . Hynñiew u Samuel u nong , Em , U TRAI’ um shym la jied ïa eit ruh .
translation.en: Then Jesse called Abinadab , and made him pass before Samuel . And he said , Neither hath the  Lord  chosen this .

translation.kha: Nga la kut jingmut lypa ban pynsum ïa ki , bad ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa ki la dep buh jingthoh . Ngan ym leh bym ieh ïa kaei kaba ki la leh , hynrei ngan siew kylliang ïa ki
translation.en: Behold , it is written before me : I will not keep silence , but will recompense , even recompense into their bosom ,

translation.kha: U mawshun u la jubab , Lada me hi men ym longing ryngkat bun ngi , wat ai ba ngin mihnoh na kane ka jaka .
translation.en: And he said unto him , If thy presence go not with me , carry us not up hence .

And it shall be , if thou wilt hearken unto all that I command thee , and wilt walk in my ways , and do that is right in my sight , to keep my statutes and my commandments , as David my servant did  ; that I will be with thee , and build thee a sure house , as I built for David , and will give Israel unto thee .
translation.kha: Lada me kohnguh tylli ïa nga , me im hapoh ki hukum jong nga , bad me ïoh ïa ka jingmynjur jong nga da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba nga hukum , kumba u Dabid u shakri jong nga u la leh , ngan ïai don ryngkat bad me . Ngan pynlong ïa me u syiem ki Israel bad ngan pynthikna ba kiba hiarpateng na me kin synshar hadien jong me , kumba nga la leh ïa u Dabid .
Mar ïasdang mih sla , ki syntiew ki la mih , mala ki shoiñ ki la ih .
translation.en: And in the vine were three branches : and it was as though it budded , and her blossoms shot forth  ; and the clusters thereof brought forth ripe grapes :
Lo , all these things worketh God oftentimes with man ,
translation.kha: U Blei u leh ïa kane baroh na kawei ka por sha kawei pat ;

translation.en: Tom is a couple of years older than me , I think .
translation.kha: U Tom u heh ia nga tang katto-katne snem .
Katba u dang khynnah , don ki briew ki ban sumar ïa u bad pynïaid ïa ki kam jong u tad haduh ban da poi ka por ba la buh da u kjap jong u .
translation.en: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father .
For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men .
translation.kha: Um don jingsngewbha ban pynlong ïa ngi ban sngewsih lane ban pang .
Uba ka Jingthoh bakynjah ka ong , Suit pa uwei uba khot Kyrpad ïa U TRAI’ ban Ïohi jingïarap , un ïohkynti im .
translation.en: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved .

translation.kha: Ynda nga la pynlong kynjah ïa ka Ijipt Bad pynpait noh ïa baroh uba shongkha ha ka , kan sa tip ba nga long U thri .
translation.en: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate , and the country shall be destitute of that whereof it was full , when I shall smite all them that dwell therein , then shall they know that I am the  Lord .

Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker ! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth . Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it , What makest thou ? or thy work , He hath no hands ?
translation.kha: Hato u khiew khyndew un nud ban ïatainia bad u nongthaw jong u , u khiew uba long kum baroh kiwei pat ? Hato ka dewbyrtha kan ong ïa u nongthaw khiew kaei ba u leh ? Hato u khiew un mudui ïa la u nongthaw khiew ba um don jingtbit ?

‘ Sngewbha , shah ba ngan leit ,’ u Ong , ‘ Namar ki ba-eh ha-sem jrong I ki pynlong ka jingkhawai jingkñia ha shnong , malade u Ahiman jong nga u la hukum ba nga dei ban don hangta . Te kumta , lada ph longïng u paralok jrong nga , shait ba ngan leit jngoh ïa la ki kur ki jai .’ dien namar kata ba um shym la don ha la ka jaka ha ka miej ba-im jong phi .
translation.en: And he said , Let me go , I pray thee  ; for our family hath a sacrifice in the city  ; and my brother , he hath commanded me to be there : and now , if I have found favour in thine eyes , let me get away , I pray thee , and see my brethren . Therefore he cometh not unto the king s table .

translation.kha: Thang noh ïa ka doh ne ïa u kpu ba sah baroh .
translation.en: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire .

translation.kha: Ki Lehbha mynta ki long ki jong nga . Mynba ang la pynpei ïa u khun nyngkong baroh jong ki nong jingtep , nga la pynshngain kum la u jong ïa u khun nongking na kawei pa kawei ka Ïing Israel bad ïa uba la kha nyngkong na uwei pa uwei u mrad . Mynta , nga ïoh noh da ki Lebi kum la ki jong ha ka jaka ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong jong ki Israel ; ki kin long ki jong nga . Nga longïng U Trai .
translation.en: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar , and spread a purple cloth thereon :

translation.kha: Ki biria kba pyrshang ban pynbud ïa phi ban umsoh ki dei kito kiba kwah ban pynpaw bad kob ïa ki ki kiba paw shabar . Ki leh ïa ka , la kumno kumno , tang ban lait na ka jingshan pynshitom peiñ na ka bynta ka diengphna U Khrist .
translation.en: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh , they constrain you to be circumcised ; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ .

translation.kha: Ka thadrong ïa lade bad ka alos ba baroh kin tip ba ka long ka nuti . Nga la sngewngiah ïa ka wohnia la la long ïa ka hynmen jong ka .
translation.en: So she discovered her whoredoms , and discovered her nakedness : then my mind was alienated from her , like as my mind was alienated from her sister .
But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council , they conferred among themselves ,
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ong ïa ki ban mihnoh na ka kamra ka Dorbar , bad nangta ki la sdang ïaphylliew jingmut para ma ki .

translation.en: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true : wherefore shut thou up the vision  ; for it shall be for many days .
translation.kha: Kane ka jingïohipaw shaphang ki jingkñia ha ka por janmiet bad mynstep ïa kaba la batai ha me kan urlong shisha . Hynrei buhrieh ïa ka mynta , namar kan shim por shibun ha shuwa ban kan urlong shisha .

translation.en: And I said unto my master , Peradventure the woman will not follow me .
translation.kha: Bad nga la kylli ha u kynrad jong nga , ‘ Kumno lada jia ba kata ka briew kam treh ban wan ryngkat bad nga ?’

To Kartah ïa ka pop jong u syiem bad jongu ki paid Israel . Hikai ïa ki ban kun ïa kaba dei . Nangta , A Trai to phah ïa u slap ha kane ka ri jong me , ïa kaba me la ai ha la ki jongno ki briew kumto ka jingïohkynti jong ki junom .
translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven , and forgive the sin of thy servants , and of thy people Israel , that thou teach them the good way wherein they should walk , and give rain upon thy land , which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance .

translation.kha: Nga ïohi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ki leh . Ym ne kano Kana kaweh la buhrieh na nga ; ki pop jong ki kam lait phet na ka jingïohi jong nga .
translation.en: For mine eyes are upon all their ways : they are not hid from my face , neither is their iniquity hid from mine eyes .

translation.kha: Shimri ïa ka shadem jong uta u langbrot bad pynkyntang ïa ka kamon ka jingiw bakyrpang sha to . Kanneh ka bynta jongno u mrad ba la kñia ka daiñ ka jong me .
translation.en: And thou shalt take the breast of the ram of Aaron s consecration , and wave it for a wave offering before the  Lord  : and it shall be thy part .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Leh ïa kane ban pynshisha ha ki Israel ba U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpa tmain jong ki , U Blei jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jobab , u la mawpud ha me .
translation.en: That they may believe that the  Lord  God of their fathers , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob , hath appeared unto thee .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïalang ïa ka kti U Trai ha u bad ha baroh kiwei pat kiba ha ka ïing jong u .
translation.en: And they spake unto him the word of the Lord , and to all that were in his house .

translation.kha: Da sorkar ban ym shah ïa ki jingbamsap ban shukor ïa phi , lane ka spah ban ïalam sakma ïa phi .
translation.en: Because there is wrath , beware lest he take thee away with his stroke : then a great ransom cannot deliver thee .
And Jesus answering them began to say ,  Take heed lest any man deceive you :
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  Sumar bha , bad wat ai ïano ïano ban shukor ïa phi .
U Mikaïah u ong shuh shuh : Mynta sngap ïa kaei ba U Trai u nguh ! Nga ïohi ïa U Trai ba u shongsah ha ka khep jong u ha bneng , lem nabar ki angel jong u kiba ïeng hajan jong u .
translation.en: And he said , Hear thou therefore the word of the  Lord  : I saw the  Lord  sitting on his throne , and all the host of heaven standing by him on his right hand and on his left .

translation.kha: Wat ka kynthei kob jem tam ka doh kaba wan na ka ïing kaba donburom , kiba riewpaidbah katta katta katba kam donbok banbeiñ ïadih shano shane , kan leh Kumjuh . Ynda u nongshun u kerkut ïa ka shnong jongu ka , tista sa kyrduh jingbam kat ban da smam buhrieh wiat ïa la i khun ba ka dang shu kha malu ïa kito la kha ruh . Kan ym ai ei ei ïa la u tnga uba ka ibit lane ïa la ki khun .
translation.en: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet , and toward her children which she shall bear : for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness , wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates .
And he sent , and brought him in . Now he was ruddy , and withal of a beautiful countenance , and goodly to look to . And the  Lord  said , Arise , anoint him : for this is he .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jesse u phah khot ïa u . U long uba bhabriew , u samla bakoit bakhiah bad ki khmat kiba phyrnai . U  Trai  u ong ha u Samuel ,  Dei une — pynsleh ïa u !
U la ïalam ïa ki briew na ka ri Ijipt , u da leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla ha ka ri Ijipt bad ha ka Duriaw Basaw bad haduh sawphew snem ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: He brought them out , after that he had shewed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt , and in the Red sea , and in the wilderness forty years .
And the Lord turned , and looked upon Peter . And Peter remembered the word of the Lord , how he had said unto him ,  Before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .
translation.kha: U Trai u la phai sawdong bad u la khmih shlip ha u Petros , bad u Petros u la kynmaw ba U Trai u la lah ong ha u ,  Ha shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih ha kane ka miet , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga .

Ka hima Israel ka la ngut ! Ka burom jong ka , ka la jah kum ki pansngiat syntiat ha ki khlieh jong ki nongïalam buaid . Ïa ki khliehduh bajrong jongngi ki la pyniwbih bha , hynrei Haneng ki ïathiah , ki buaid bhor .
translation.en: Woe to the crown of pride , to the drunkards of Ephraim , whose glorious beauty is a fading flower , which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine !

translation.kha: Ki rangbah ibha ap ïa ki sniang ki la phet noh bad ki la leit shapoh ka shnong , ha ka ki la ïatyngkhuh ïa ka jingjia baroh kawei bad ïa kaei kaba la jia ha ki rangïapom kaba shongksuid .
translation.en: And they that kept them fled , and went their ways into the city , and told every thing , and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils .

translation.kha: Baroh kin ïaroh ïa ka kyrthat kaba khraw bad kaba kynta syiem jong u . Naba Khuid Long ma u !
translation.en: Let them praise thy great and terrible name  ; for it is holy .

translation.kha: Me la Dei ban don jingïohi ïa la u para shakri , kumba nga la isynei ïa me .’
translation.en: Shouldest not thou also have had compassion on thy fellowservant , even as I had pity on thee ?
Then she said , Did I desire a son of my lord ? did I not say , Do not deceive me ?
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka ong ha u ,  Kynrad , hato nga pan khun shynrang na phi ? Hato ngam shym ïathuh ïa phi ban ym kyntiew ïa ki jingkyrmen jong nga ?
Kumno pat ma phi ? u la kylliang ïa ki . Phi ong ba nga long uei ? U Petros u la jubab , Me long U Messaïah jong U Blei .
translation.en: He said unto them ,  But whom say ye that I am ?  Peter answering said , The Christ of God .

translation.kha: U Elisha u leit sha Damaskos ha ka por ba u Betheden u syiem Syria u pang . Haba la ïathuh ha u syiem ba u Elisha u don hangta ,
translation.en: And Elisha came to Damascus  ; and Ben–hadad the king of Syria was sick  ; and it was told him , saying , The man of God is come hither .

translation.kha: Lada ka ïakhun lad u lyngdoh ka ïaid sleit , ka pynkheiñ prum ïa la u kpa ; yn thang ïa ka haduh ba kan da ïap .
translation.en: And the daughter of any priest , if she profane herself by playing the whore , she profaneth her father : she shall be burnt with fire .

translation.kha: To ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaweh ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga ong : Phi bam ïa ka doh naba dang bieit snam ha ka . Phi mane ïa ki bleithaw . Phi pynpei briew . Kaei kaba pynlong ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ka ri ka dei ka jong phi ?
translation.en: Wherefore say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Ye eat with the blood , and lift up your eyes toward your idols , and shed blood : and shall ye possess the land ?

translation.kha: phi dei ban isih ïa uno Uno uba kwah ban pynmynsaw ïa u da ka jinglamler . Ka jingkren bymshisha kam nongrah ei ei hynrei ka jingpynjot .
translation.en: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it  ; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , phi dei pun phai shat U Blei da ka jingsngewieit bad iehnoh ïa baroh kaba sngi ka don ha ka ïing Jong phi .
translation.en: If thou return to the Almighty , thou shalt be built up , thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki kjap tmain jong ki khat-ar jait , nabar da ki kyrteng jong ki la jer ïa ki shnong bad ïa ki jaka sher dara jong ki .
translation.en: These are the sons of Ishmael , and these are their names , by their towns , and by their castles  ; twelve princes according to their nations .

translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud u Balaam u la leit shat ki nongpruid jong u Balak bad u ong , Khie leit phalang sha la ïing ; U Trai um shahshkor ba ngan lytar bad phi .
translation.en: And Balaam rose up in the morning , and said unto the princes of Balak , Get you into your land : for the  Lord  refuseth to give me leave to go with you .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ruh ïa ki nong Ijipt ba ngin sngewburom ïa phi khnang ba ynda ki briew jong ang kin mih , ktang ym mihnoh thylli .
translation.en: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians : and it shall come to pass , that , when ye go , ye shall not go empty :

translation.kha: Ki khlaw ki la khep ha pyrthei , kum ki soh dud bym pat ih na u dieng haba kynther ka lyer kaba jur .
translation.en: And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth , even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs , when she is shaken of a mighty wind .

And it came to pass , when Israel had made an end of slaying all the inhabitants of Ai in the field , in the wilderness wherein they chased them , and when they were all fallen on the edge of the sword , until they were consumed , that all the Israelites returned unto Ai , and smote it with the edge of the sword .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u nongshun ha ka jaka bashrah ha kaba ki la beh ïa ki . Nangta ki la leit phai pat sha Ai bad ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei uba don hangta .
Un shongkurim ïa ka theisotti ,
translation.en: And he shall take a wife in her virginity .

translation.kha: Ki shipai ki la ong por ma ki , To iing ym tar pynkad ïa ka , to ngin ïakynting sbiak ban shem mano ba ïoh ïa ka . Kainan ka la jia khnang ba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kan pynurlong shiah : Ki la pynïabynta ïa ki janai jyllang nga sohpdung jong ki malade ki la ïakhalai ïa ka jaiñkup jong na . Kane ka long kaei kaba ki shipai ki la ni .
translation.en: They said therefore among themselves , Let us not rend it , but cast lots for it , whose it shall be : that the scripture might be fulfilled , which saith , They parted my raiment among them , and for my vesture they did cast lots . These things therefore the soldiers did .

translation.kha: Susah khnang ban pynsngewbha ïa u patsha ki Assyria , u Ahas u weng pajut na ka Tabeel ïa ka rynsan na ka bynta ka khet syiem bad u set noh ïa ka jaka rung bakyrpang jyllang u syiem sha ka Templ .
translation.en: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house , and the king s entry without , turned he from the house of the  Lord  for the king of Assyria .

And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the  Lord  , and make an atonement for it  ; and shall take of the blood of the bullock , and of the blood of the goat , and put it upon the horns of the altar round about .
translation.kha: un leit sha kata ka duwan ka jingainguh thang bad un pynkhuid ïa ka . U dei ban shim khyndiat na ka snam jong uta u masi lyngraw bad khyndiat na ka snam jong uta u  langsohmoh bad un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba ha ki dong jong kata ka duwan .
U Isaak u khot ïa u Jakob , u khublei ïa u , bad u ong ha u , Wat shongkurim ïa ka nong Kanaan .
translation.en: And Isaac called Jacob , and blessed him , and charged him , and said unto him , Thou shalt not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan .

translation.kha: Kumba U Trai u la kular lyngba u Isaia , ka pliang purew kam Shimham la tylli lymne u klongsnam um shym long khlem jingpawnam .
translation.en: And the barrel of meal wasted not , neither did the cruse of oil fail , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by Elijah .

translation.kha: U la ïapyllait ïa ngi na Ijipt ban woh ïalam ïa ngi shane sad don ai ha ngi ïa kane ka ri , kumba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi .
translation.en: And he brought us out from thence , that he might bring us in , to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers .
Fathers , provoke not your children to anger , lest they be discouraged .
translation.kha: Ko ki kmie ki kpa , to wat pynbitar ïa la ki khun , ïoh ba kin noh mynsiem .
U Trai Badonbor Baroh u ong , ‘ Nga wallam ka thma , ka jingïapan , bad ka jingpang ha ki , bad ngan pynlong ïa ki kumta ki soh Dumbur kiba la pyut eh ïa ka ban ba-ima .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will send upon them the sword , the famine , and the pestilence , and will make them like vile figs , that cannot be eaten , they are so evil .
Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah : and the  Lord  struck him , and he died .
translation.kha: U Jeroboam um shym lah khie khlieh shuh ha ka bor jong u ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u Abijah . Ha kaba khatduh U  Trai  u shoh ïap ïa u .
U Jisu u la kylli biang , Bad kaei ngan ïanujor ïa ka Hima U Blei ?
translation.en: And again he said ,  Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God ?

translation.kha: U Joshua u la khoit ïa ki lyngdoh bad ainong ha ki , Shim ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang , bad hynñiew ngut na phi kin leit ha suk jong phi , da kaba kieng ïa ki turoi .
translation.en: And Joshua the son of Nun called the priests , and said unto them , Take up the ark of the covenant , and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams  horns before the ark of the  Lord .
And will send unto Babylon fanners , that shall fan her , and shall empty her land : for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki nongwei ban pynjot ïa ka Babilonia kum ka lyer kaba pynher noh ïa u phlangïap . Haba kata ka sngi jong ka jingpynjot ka wan , kin tur ïaleh na baroh sawdong bad kin ieh syllen ïa ka ri .
Ki Kynhun shynrang jong ka Leah ki long u Reuben ( u khun nyngkong u Jakob ) , u Simeon , u Lebi , u Jehud , u Issakhar , bad u Sebulun .
translation.en: The sons of Leah  ; Reuben , Jacob s firstborn , and Simeon , and Levi , and Judah , and Issachar , and Zebulun :

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit ba-ieit jong ngi , ngi tip ba U Blei u ieit ïa phi bad ba u la jied ïa phiah ban long ki jngai u hi .
translation.en: Knowing , brethren beloved , your election of God .

translation.kha: U Petros u la pynmih ïa ki baroh shaba ka kamra , bad u la dem khohsiew bad duwai ; nangta u la phai sha ka met bad u la ong , Ko Tebah , khie joit ! Ka la plied ïa la ki Khmut , bad hab ka la ïohi ïa u Porsius , ka la khiew shong .
translation.en: But Peter put them all forth , and kneeled down , and prayed  ; and turning him to the body said , Tabitha , arise . And she opened her eyes : and when she saw Peter , she sat up .

translation.kha: Leh ïa ki kam jngai phi baroh da ka jingieit .
translation.en: Let all your things be done with charity .

translation.kha: Haba uta u khynnah u poi ha ka jaka ba uta u khnam u la hap , u Jonathan u pyrta ïa u , U khnam u don kham sha jngai na phoi !
translation.en: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot , Jonathan cried after the lad , and said , Is not the arrow beyond thee ?

translation.kha: Lada me shakri hok ïa nga kumba imat u Arbad u Kpa jong me , da kaba kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong nga bad leh kat ïa kaba nga hukum ïa me ,
translation.en: And as for thee , if thou wilt walk before me , as David thy father walked , and do according to all that I have commanded thee , and shalt observe my statutes and my judgments  ;

The Bible says : “The wolf will actually reside for a while with the male lamb , and with the kid the leopard itself will lie down , and the calf and the maned young lion and the well-fed animal all together  ; and a mere little boy will be leader over them .”—Isaiah 11 :6-9  ; Hosea 2 :18 .
translation.kha: Ka Baibl ka ong “Te u suri un shong lem bad u khun ‘ langbrot , u labasa ruh un dem bad u khun blang ; u khun masi bad u sing samla bad u masi sngaid lang bad u khynnah rit un ïalam ïa ki .” —Isaïah 11 :6-9 ; Hosea 2 :18 .
U Jisu u la ong ïa ki , Haduh katno phi hir ki Briew ki bymngeit ! Haduh katno ngan don bad pa ? Haduh katno tun ïakhih bad phi ? Shullam ïa u khynnah ha nga !
translation.en: He answereth him , and saith ,  O faithless generation , how long shall I be with you ? how long shall I suffer you ? bring him unto me .

translation.kha: Nangta u ruh u la ong ha nga , Keiñ ki ktien ki long kiba shisha pynlang katba lah ban shaniah . Bad U Trai umbiah U Blei , uba ai ïa U Minnith jong u ha ki nongïathuhlypa , u la phah ïa u angel jong u ban pyn-i ha ki shakri jong u ïa kaei kambah dei ban jhieh shen .
translation.en: And he said unto me , These sayings are faithful and true : and the Lord God of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done .
Behold , all his fellows shall be ashamed : and the workmen , they are of men : let them all be gathered together , let them stand up  ; yet they shall fear , and they shall be ashamed together .
translation.kha: Baroh uba mane ïa ka un shah ñiewbeiñ . Ki briew kiba shna ïa ki bleithaw ki long tang ki briew bad ym don shuh . Shah ïa ki ban wan bad ban ïeng ha ka jingbishar — kin khynñiuh bad kin shah pynjahburom .
Wat ïalang lok Bad ki briew kba kyrni dih waiñ litar bad kiba lalot jingbam .
translation.en: Be not among winebibbers  ; among riotous eaters of flesh :
Father , I will that they also , whom thou hast given me , be with me where I am  ; that they may behold my glory , which thou hast given me : for thou lovedst me before the foundation of the world .
translation.kha: Ko Pa ! Me la ai ïa ki ha nga , bad nga kwah ïa ki ba kin don bad nga ha kaba nga don , khnang ba ki lah ban ïohi ïa ka burom jong nga , ka burom ïa kaba me la ai ha nga ; naba me la ieit ïa nga ha shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
Ka jingsaiñ kaba lai la ai ha ki longïing na ka jait Sebulun . Ka iaki kaba ki la ïohpdiang ka kot haduh Sarid .
translation.en: And the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun according to their families : and the border of their inheritance was unto Sarid :

translation.kha: Ki ai ha u ïa ka khlieh bad ïa kiwei pah ki lyngkhot doh , bad u thang ïa ki ha ka duwan .
translation.en: And they presented the burnt offering unto him , with the pieces thereof , and the head : and he burnt them upon the altar .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Joseph u ong ha ki , Wat sheptieng ; ngam lah ban buh ïa lade ha ka khak jongngi U Bel .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto them , Fear not : for am I in the place of God ?
And the servant brought forth jewels of silver , and jewels of gold , and raiment , and gave them to Rebekah : he gave also to her brother and to her mother precious things .
translation.kha: Nangta u sei ïa ki jaiñ bad ki jingdeng rupa bad ksiar , bad u ai ïa ki ha ka Rebekka . U ai ruh ïa ki jingai kiba kordor ïa u hynmen bad ïa ka kmie jong ka .
Hynñiew u Jephthah u jubab , Phi la isih ïatip ïa nga kat haduh ba phi da beh ïa nga na ïing i pa . Balei phi wan shata nga mynta haba phi la shem jynjar ?
translation.en: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead , Did not ye hate me , and expel me out of my father s house ? and why are ye come unto me now when ye are in distress ?
And he stood , and blessed all the congregation of Israel with a loud voice , saying ,
translation.kha: Da ka sur kaba jam u pan ki jingkyrkhu na U Blei halor u paidbah baroh uba ïalumlang hangta .
Thaw ïa ka jingtap da ka ksiar jylla , kaban shispah shiphew sentimitar ka lyngkar bad hynriewphew hynriewphew sentimitar ka pyndeng .
translation.en: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold : two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof , and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof .
And as she was going to fetch it , he called to her , and said , Bring me , I pray thee , a morsel of bread in thine hand .
translation.kha: Katba ka dang leit shim ïa ka , u la ong ,  Bad sngewbha wanrah de khyndiat u kpu .
Ïakit markylliang ïa ki jingtip , bad ha kan ka rukom phin kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Khrist .
translation.en: Bear ye one another s burdens , and so fulfil the law of Christ .

translation.kha: Kylli ïa kine kiba ngin ïaleh pyrshah lada ki tip Aiu ka Parosh ka maw . Khatduh ïa ki ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la wan sha Jerusalem bad rah ïa u syiem bad ïa ki lapbah synshar lad u lem nabar u sha babniah .
translation.en: Say now to the rebellious house , Know ye not what these things mean ? tell them , Behold , the king of Babylon is come to Jerusalem , and hath taken the king thereof , and the princes thereof , and led them with him to Babylon  ;

translation.kha: Kut phi la kylla long ka nuksa ïa kaba ngeit bhor ha Makedonia bad ha Akhaïa .
translation.en: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia .

translation.kha: ino uno uba don U Khun , u khong ïa kane ka jingim ; Une uno u bym don U Khun U Blei , um don ka jingtim .
translation.en: He that hath the Son hath life  ; and he that hath not the Son of God hath not life .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kambah khatphra jong ka jingsynshar jongnga u , u syier Josaïah u phah ïa u Shaphat , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u khun jong u Asalaïah badno u ksiew jong u Meshullam , sha ka Templ bad ka hukum :
translation.en: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah , that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , the son of Meshullam , the scribe , to the house of the  Lord  , saying ,
Then cometh the end , when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God , even the Father ; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power .
translation.kha: Te kaba kut kan poi ; U Khrist un jop noh thiaw ïa ki bor mynsiem , ki nongsynshar , bad ki bor , bad un aiti ïa ka Hima ha U Blei uba U Kpa .
kumno ba ki kpa tymmen jongu ngi ki la wait sha Ijipt , ha kaba ngi la shong la sah hangta badno bun snoh . Ki nong Jephthah ki la lehbeiñ ïa ki kpa tymmen jyllang ngi bad ïa ngi shiah ,
translation.en: How our fathers went down into Egypt , and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time  ; and the Egyptians vexed us , and our fathers :

translation.kha: Neng tip aïu kito ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ong , ki da kren lamler ha ka kyrteng jong nga bad kam ba nga la ai ha ki ïa ki khubor jong nga ha ki jingphohsniew jongu ki .
translation.en: I have heard what the prophets said , that prophesy lies in my name , saying , I have dreamed , I have dreamed .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ki paidbah bad u la kiew shai u lum , ha uba u la shang . Ki synñiang jong u ki la ïabam sawdong ïa u ,
translation.en: And seeing the multitudes , he went up into a mountain : and when he was set , his disciples came unto him :

translation.kha: Wat ki hynmen ki para jong u briew uba duk kim long jingmyntoi ïa u ; kam pher ba um don phalang . Kam pher katno u pyrshang tyngeh , um lah ban eh paralok .
translation.en: All the brethren of the poor do hate him : how much more do his friends go far from him ? he pursueth them with words , yet they are wanting to him .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Ngan sa pynjot ïa kiei ktieh baroh ha ka pyrthei ,
translation.en: I will utterly consume all things from off the land , saith the  Lord .
But in the fourth generation they shall come hither again : for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full .
translation.kha: Kan shim por saw pateng bynriew shuwa ba ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin wan phai pat shane ; namar ngan ym pat beh noh ïa ki Amor tad ynda ki la long bymman haduh katta katta kat haduh ba ki dei ban shah pynshitom .
bad kaei kaban u la leh ïa ki ar ngut ki syiem Amor kiba ha ka phang mihngi jngai ka Jordan : u Sihon u syiem ka Heshbon bad u Og u syiem ka Bashan , uba shongsuk ba sah ha Ashtaroth .
translation.en: And all that he did to the two kings of the Amorites , that were beyond Jordan , to Sihon king of Heshbon , and to Og king of Bashan , which was at Ashtaroth .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ha kata ka briew , Ka jingngeit Jong pha ka la pynim ïa pha ; khie leit ha kaba suk .
translation.en: And he said to the woman ,  Thy faith hath saved thee  ; go in peace .

And , behold , all the men of Israel came to the king , and said unto the king , Why have our brethren the men of Judah stolen thee away , and have brought the king , and his household , and all David s men with him , over Jordan ?
translation.kha: Nangta baroh ki Israel ki la leit sha u syiem bad ki ong ha u ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong ngi , ki rangbah ka Judah , ki pyrkhat ba ki don ka hok ban rah noh ïa phi bad synran ïa phi , ïa ka longïing jong phi , bad ïa ki rangbah jong phi sha shiliang ka Jordan ?
katba kum ka jinglong hynmen Para jong ki , hynriew na ki kirteng jong ki ha uwei u markordor bad hynriew ha uwei pat u mawkordor .
translation.en: Six of their names on one stone , and the other six names of the rest on the other stone , according to their birth .
So neither I , nor my brethren , nor my servants , nor the men of the guard which followed me , none of us put off our clothes , saving that every one put them off for washing .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la kylliang sopti wat ha ka por miet , lymne mano mano na ki paralok jong nga , lymne ki shakri jong nga , lymne ki nongap phira jong nga . Bad ma ngi baroh ngi bat ïa ki tiar ïaleh ha ka kti .
Lydia u kynriang dien sha ka nongbah , ki briew jong ngi baroh kin wallam ïa ki tyllai bun kin shu tan ïa ka nongbah shapoh ka them . Yn ym don imat ruh u maw ïa uba yn iehnoh ha kliar lum .
translation.en: Moreover , if he be gotten into a city , then shall all Israel bring ropes to that city , and we will draw it into the river , until there be not one small stone found there .

translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi , te , ba uno uno u briew uba pyllait noh ïa la ka tnga na kano kano ka daw , lait noh na ka jingbymïaineh jong ka , u premmiet lada u shongkurim ïa kawei pat ka briew .
translation.en: And I say unto you , Whosoever shall put away his wife , except it be for fornication , and shall marry another , committeth adultery : and whoso marrieth her which is put away doth commit adultery .

translation.kha: Shahshkor , u la ong ïa ki , Ngi ïaleit kiaw shuh Jeremaïah , ha kaba yn niam ïa U Khun U Briew ha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum .
translation.en: Behold , we go up to Jerusalem  ; and the Son of man shall be betrayed unto the chief priests and unto the scribes , and they shall condemn him to death ,

translation.kha: to kiaw ha iitkhmat jngai u , ko ka pyrthei baroh ! Ïa ka Pyrthei la pynskhem ha la ka jaka bad ym lah pynkhih shuh .
translation.en: Fear before him , all the earth : the world also shall be stable , that it be not moved .

translation.kha: Hynrei u la ïai ai ka sakhi ïa ka jingdon jong u da kiei kiei kiba bha kiba u leh : U ai ha phi ïa u slap na sahit bneng bad ïa ki jingthung ha ki por babiang ; u ai ha phi ka jingbam bad u pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong phi da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Nevertheless he left not himself without witness , in that he did good , and gave us rain from heaven , and fruitful seasons , filling our hearts with food and gladness .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew jong me ki Israel ki shahjop ha ki nongshun jngai ki namar ba ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , nabar nangta ki phai pat shiah me bad wan sha kan ka Templ , ki da kyrpad da kaba sngewtynnat ha me na ka bynta ban ïoh jingmap , to shahshkor ïa ki na bneng .
translation.en: When thy people Israel be smitten down before the enemy , because they have sinned against thee , and shall turn again to thee , and confess thy name , and pray , and make supplication unto thee in this house :

translation.kha: Ngi ainguh borabor ïa U Blei , U Kpu jong U Jisu kyrshut uba U Trai Jong ngi , hab ngi duwai na ka bynta jongki phoi .
translation.en: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ , praying always for you ,

translation.kha: Phi den Ban ai sngewbha sha U Blei ha Jeruel ïa baroh ki khiew ki phlangïap ïa kiba la ai ha Phin ban pyndonkam ha ki jingshakri ha ka Templ .
translation.en: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God , those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem .
This is an international , nonprofit religious organization of people who willingly serve God .
translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka seng jong ki briew kiba shakri ïa U Blei da la ka mon sngewbha , ka bym don jingïohnong eiei bad ka don ha kylleng ka pyrthei .

NGA lah Ban Kular ha u brai uba bha , hyndai salia u sdang ban pyrkhat ba ka jingsuh babha jongu u kaba mynshuwa ka la biang bad u sdang ban leh pop , Ngi ym kynmaw ïa kano Kane kaba bha ba u la leh . Un ïap Naaman ki pop jong u .
translation.en: When I shall say to the righteous , that he shall surely live  ; if he trust to his own righteousness , and commit iniquity , all his righteousnesses shall not be remembered  ; but for his iniquity that he hath committed , he shall die for it .

Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them  ; and this house , which I have sanctified for my name , will I cast out of my sight , and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations .
translation.kha: te ngan weng noh ïa phi na kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha phi , bad ngan iehnoh ïa kane ka Templ ba nga la pynkyntang kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga . Ki briew kylleng kin krenbeiñ bad ñiewbeiñ ïa ka .
U ïai wan kham sha jan , bad haba u la ïohi shai ïa u Dabid , u la dap da ka jingbitar shla ïa u namar ba u hir tang u khynnah uba saw ngab , uba phyrnai khmat .
translation.en: And when the Philistine looked about , and saw David , he disdained him : for he was but a youth , and ruddy , and of a fair countenance .

translation.kha: To pdiang ïa u , te , da ka jingkyrmen , kum u para ha U Trai . To phin ñiewburom ïa kiba kum kita ki briew kum ma u ,
translation.en: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness ; and hold such in reputation :
But Festus answered , that Paul should be kept at Caesarea , and that he himself would depart shortly thither .
translation.kha: U Phestos u la jubab ,  Ïa u Paul la set kum u koidi ha Kaisaria , bad nga hi ngan sa leit pat shen shata .
Kumta ken la pyndem ïa ka jingtrei baroh ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai . Ki Israel ki la sloit ïa sier borbah kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished : and the children of Israel did according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses , so did they .

translation.kha: Phi la bitar ïa nga bad ïa u rangbah ki nongshet kpu , mala phi la buh ïa ngi ha phatok ha ka ïing jong u Kaphtorim jong ki Nongap phira .
translation.en: Pharaoh was wroth with his servants , and put me in ward in the captain of the guard s house , both me and the chief baker :

And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand  ; and he shall magnify himself in his heart , and by peace shall destroy many : he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes  ; but he shall be broken without hand .
translation.kha: Namar ba u long uba sianti , un jop ha ki rukom shukor jong u . Un sngewsarong ïa lade bad pynjot ïa shibun briew khlem ka jingmaham . Un len wat ïa U Syiem bakhraw jong baroh , hynrei ïa u yn pynjot khlem da pyndonkam ïa kano kano ka bor ba kynja briew .
Ynda me ïap bad tep ïa me bad ki kpa tymmen jong me , ngan pynlong syiem ïa uwei na ki khun jong me bad ngan pynurlong ïa ka hima jong u kaba khlaiñ .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers , that I will raise up thy seed after thee , which shall be of thy sons  ; and I will establish his kingdom .

translation.kha: U shakri ïa U Blei jong u kpa jong u , u kumjuh ïa ki hukum U Blei , mala um shym leh ha ka lap ba ki syiem Israel ki la leh .
translation.en: But sought to the  Lord  God of his father , and walked in his commandments , and not after the doings of Israel .

translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa u , phi ki syiem mala phi ki jaitbynriew Baroh , ki khun symboh shynrang bad baroh kiwei ki nongsynshar ;
translation.en: Kings of the earth , and all people  ; princes , and all judges of the earth :

translation.kha: Kaei ka jingkwah jong pha , ko Asher , ko mahadei ? u syiem u kylli . Ïathuh ïa nga kaei kaba pha kwah , bad phan ïoh ïa kata — wat la ka long shiteng na ka hangamei jong nga .
translation.en: Then said the king unto her , What wilt thou , queen Esther ? and what is thy request ? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom .
Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council , and said , What do we ? for this man doeth many miracles .
translation.kha: Kumta ki Pharisi bad ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la lum ïa ka dorbar bad ki la ong ,  Ngin ïaleh kumno ? Peit ïa ki kambah baroh kiba une u briew u la leh !

U Naaman , u ngab ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Syria , u long u briew ïa uba la burom shikatdei eh bad ñiewkor shibun da u syiad Sirion , namar lyngba u Naaman , U Trai u la ai ka jingjop ïa ki shipai Syria . U la long u shipai bakhraw , hynriewphew u don ka jingtap ñiangthohlieh .
translation.en: Now Naaman , captain of the host of the king of Syria , was a great man with his master , and honourable , because by him the  Lord  had given deliverance unto Syria : he was also a mighty man in valour , but he was a leper .
For I am full of matter , the spirit within me constraineth me .
translation.kha: Ngam lah ap shuh , nga kwah ban kren . Ngam lah shuh ban kun ïa ki ktien .

translation.en: We know that we have passed from death unto life , because we love the brethren . He that loveth not his brother abideth in death .
translation.kha: Ngi tip ba ngi la iehnoh ïa ka jingïap bad ngi la wan noh sha ka jingim ; ngi tip ïa ka namar ba ngi ieit ïa la ki hynmen ki para . Uno uno u bym ieit , u dang don hi hapoh ka bor jong ka jingïap .
Ngan pynkylla ïa ka nongbah Raamah sha ka jaka ba ri ïa ki ut , bad ïa ka ri ki Ammon baroh kawei shata ka jaka ban ri ïa ki langbrot , khnang ba phin tip ba nga long U Troas .
translation.en: And I will make Rabbah a stable for camels , and the Ammonites a couchingplace for flocks : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
And all his acquaintance , and the women that followed him from Galilee , stood afar off , beholding these things .
translation.kha: Baroh kito kiba la ithuh ïa U Jisu , kynthup ki kynthei kiba la bud ïa u na Galilaïa , ki la ïeng na pajih ban jngoh .
Kumta ïa i u shakri bymmyntoi — bret ïa u shabar ha kaba dum ; hangta un lynñiar bad kyr-iat la ki bniat .’
translation.en: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness : there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth .

translation.kha: Naba uno uno u bym long pyrshah ïa ngi u long ha ka buit jong ngi .
translation.en: For he that is not against us is on our part .
In a coming new world , life in perfect health and happiness . —Revelation 21 :3 , 4 .
translation.kha: Ha ka pyrthei ba thymmai , ka jingim kaba suk lem bad ka jingkoit jingkhiah ba janai .—Jingpynpaw 21 :3 , 4 .

translation.en: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth ? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall , that he died in Thebez ? why went ye nigh the wall ? then say thou , Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also .
translation.kha: Phim kynmaw kumno u Abimelekh , u khun jong u Gideon u la shah pynïap ? Ka dei ha Thebes ba ka kynthei ka la pynhap shapoh ïa u mawtylliat na ka kynroh bad la pynïap ïa u . Balei , keiñ , phi leit tur sha jan eh jong ka kynroh ?’ Lada u syiem u kylli ïa kane na phi , ïathuh ïa u , ‘ U Uriah ruh , u rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi u la shah pynïap .’
Ka dei ka jingieit keiñ , ba phi dien Ban ïabeh . To ai ba dohnud kan kwah hir hir ïa ki jingiw ba kyntoit Mynsiem , khamtam ïa ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei .
translation.en: Follow after charity , and desire spiritual gifts , but rather that ye may prophesy .

translation.kha: Wat pynjahburom ïa la ki khun kynthei da kaba pynlong nuti ïa ki ha ki jaka mane bleithaw ; lada phi leh kumta , phin phai noh shata kiwei ki blei bad ka ri kan jyllei da ka jingjied .
translation.en: Do not prostitute thy daughter , to cause her to be a whore  ; lest the land fall to whoredom , and the land become full of wickedness .

translation.kha: Kine hima ki longkmie ki jong me na ki jingainguh kiba kyntang kuna ïa ki bym shym la ryngkat ha ka duwan : ki jingainguh bam , ki jingkñia namar ka pop , bad ki jingsuh Namarba ka jingpalat . Baroh kabu la Wanrah ha nga Kum ka jingngeit bakyntang ka long ka jong me bad jong ki khum shynrang jong me .
translation.en: This shall be thine of the most holy things , reserved from the fire : every oblation of theirs , every meat offering of theirs , and every sin offering of theirs , and every trespass offering of theirs , which they shall render unto me , shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons .

translation.kha: U Abraham bun ka Sarah ki la tymmen bha , bad ka Sarah ruh ka la palat ïa ka por banbeiñ dang ïoh khun .
translation.en: Now Abraham and Sarah were old and well stricken in age  ; and it ceased to be with Sarah after the manner of women .

And the  Lord  shall make thee the head , and not the tail  ; and thou shalt be above only , and thou shalt not be beneath  ; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the  Lord  thy God , which I command thee this day , to observe and to do them :
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pynlong ïa phi ki nongïalam napdeng ki jaitbynriew bad ym ki nongbud ; phin ïai manbha bad phin ym kyrduh lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u baroh kiba nga ai ha phi mynta ka sngi .

translation.en: But when they knew that he was a Jew , all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out , Great is Diana of the Ephesians .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki la ithuh ba u dei u Jiw , ki la ïa-pyrta lang ïa kajuh haduh ar kynta :  Kaba khraw ka long ka Artemis jong ka Ephesos !
Haba me phai noh na ki , ki sheptieng , haba me pynphai noh ïa ka jingpyrkhat jong me , ki ïap bad ki phalang patiaw sha ka khyndew na kaba ki la wan .
translation.en: Thou hidest thy face , they are troubled : thou takest away their breath , they die , and return to their dust .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew phra jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u shem ka Judah , u Ahab u khun u Musri u long u syiem ka Israel , bad u la synshar arphew ar snam ha Samaria .
translation.en: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Judah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Israel : and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Israel in Samaria twenty and two years .
And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter .
translation.kha: Haba ki la rung pat shapoh ïing , ki synran ki la kylli ïa U Jisu shaphang kane .

translation.en: So I went in and saw  ; and behold every form of creeping things , and abominable beasts , and all the idols of the house of Israel , portrayed upon the wall round about .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la rung shapoh bad nga khmih . Ïa ka kynroh la tap da ki jingdro ïa ki dur bseiñ , bad ïa kiwei pat ki mrad bymkhuid , bad ïa kiwei pat kiei kiei kiba ki Israel ki ïamane .
Ka jingbitar ka long kaweh shyrkhei bad kaba pynjot , hynrei kam long ei ei haba ïanujor Bad ka jingpanpoh .
translation.en: Wrath is cruel , and anger is outrageous  ; but who is able to stand before envy ?

translation.kha: Lada phi shahshkor hab phi Shah pynbeit , phi longsem kiba stad .
translation.en: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise .

translation.kha: Ka jingmut jngai kane ka hukum ka long ba naduh mynta ki Israel ki dih ba-bang wallam sha U Trai ïa ki mrad ba ki ju pynïap ha lum ha wah . Mynta ki dei don khulom ïa ki ha u lyngdoh ha ka jingthang ka Ïingjaiñ nabar pynïap ïa ki kumin ki jingainguh ïasyllok .
translation.en: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices , which they offer in the open field , even that they may bring them unto the  Lord  , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , unto the priest , and offer them for peace offerings unto the  Lord .
And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest , and thou shalt put them in the ark .
translation.kha: Wan kiew sha nga ha uta u lum , bad ngan thoh ha kita ki mawlyngkniap ïa kito ki ktien kiba nga la thoh ha ki mawlyngkniap ïa kiba me la lynthaw , bad nangta men buh ïa ki ha kata ka synduk .’

translation.en: And the Jews  passover was at hand , and Jesus went up to Jerusalem ,
translation.kha: Ka la jan dei artat ka por na ka bynta ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , kumta U Jisu u la leit sha Jerusalem .
Katba ka dang im , ka trei ban pynbna bad ym ban pynsniew ïa u .
translation.en: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life .
And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them .
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shemphang ïa ka jingjubab jong u .

Ïathuh ha ki ba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , la matlah ïa ki ba da shisha nga long U Bel uba im , ki briew kiba shong basah ha ki nongbah ba la pynstet kin Shah pynïap . Kito katba shong ha ka ri kin shah bam da ki mrad . Kito uba rieh ha ki lumbah bad ki krem kin ïap da ka jingpah .
translation.en: Say thou thus unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; As I live , surely they that are in the wastes shall fall by the sword , and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured , and they that be in the forts and in the caves shall die of the pestilence .

translation.kha: U Trai un shah ïa barben Ban ïohsngew ïa ka sur bamaïan jong u bad ïa ka bor jong ka jingbitar jong u . Kin don ki thylliej ding , ki jingjur eh u sleit , ki phria bad u slap khlem Seneh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall cause his glorious voice to be heard , and shall shew the lighting down of his arm , with the indignation of his anger , and with the flame of a devouring fire , with scattering , and tempest , and hailstones .
And one cried unto another , and said , Holy , holy , holy , is the  Lord  of hosts : the whole earth is full of his glory .
translation.kha: Ki ïa-pyrta uwei ïa uwei pat :  Bakhuid , Bakhuid , Bakhuid ! U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u long uba khuid ! Ka burom jong u ka pyndap ïa ka pyrthei .
Ha kane ka rukom u lyngdoh un ai ïa ka jingkñia namar ka pop ba Uto u briew u la leh , bad yn map ïa u . U purew uba dang sah un erlangthari jong u lyngdoh , kumba ka long ha ka jingkñia ainguh bam .
translation.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these , and it shall be forgiven him : and the remnant shall be the priest s , as a meat offering .

Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets  ; all my bones shake  ; I am like a drunken man , and like a man whom wine hath overcome , because of the  Lord  , and because of the words of his holiness .
translation.kha: Ka dohnud jong nga ka la lwet , bad nga la khynñiuh . Namar jong U  Trai  , namar ki ktien kiba khuid jong u , ba nga la long kum u briew uba buaid u briew uba la dih bun eh ka waiñ .

translation.en: And the border went over from thence toward Luz , to the side of Luz , which is Beth–el , southward  ; and the border descended to Ataroth–adar , near the hill that lieth on the south side of the nether Beth–horon .
translation.kha: Nangta u suh sha ka sharing lum ha ka phang bashathie jong ka Lus ( kaba la khot ruh ka Bethel ) , nangta arsut shaduh Ataroth Addar , ha u lum uba shathie na ka Beth Horon kaba sharum .

translation.en: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus .
translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por u syiem Agrippa bad ka Berniki ki la wan sha Kaisaria bad ki la leit pdiang sngewbha ïa u Phestos .

Hynrei namar ba nga ieit ïa me , ar pyntong ïa ken ka jingkyrpad . Nga leh ïa kane wat la nga long u Paul , u nonglamktien jong U Kherith Jisu , bad mynta ruh u nongthoh ïingbyndi na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: Yet for love s sake I rather beseech thee , being such an one as Paul the aged , and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ .

The Lord  God  hath given me the tongue of the learned , that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary : he wakeneth morning by morning , he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la hikai ïa nga kaei ban ong , khnang ba ngan lah ban pynkhlaiñ ïa kiba tlot bor . Man la ka step u pynlong ïa nga ban thrang eh ban ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba un hikai ïa nga .
?(Nga long U Trai U blang jrong me ; nga pynkhlad ïa me bad nga ong , ‘ wat sheptieng ; ngan ïarap ïa me .’
translation.en: For I the  Lord  thy God will hold thy right hand , saying unto thee , Fear not  ; I will help thee .
And these are the words that the  Lord  spake concerning Israel and concerning Judah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha ki briew jong ka Israel bad Judah :

translation.en: And all the people took notice of it , and it pleased them : as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people .
translation.kha: Ki la buh jingmut ïa kane bad ki la sngewbha eh . Da shisha , kaei kaei baroh kaba u syiem u la leh ka la pynsngewbha ïa ki paidbah .
Ynda me ïarep bad tep ïa me sad ki kpa tymmen jong me , ngan pynlong syiem ïa uwei na ki khun jong me bad sam pynlong ïa ka hangamei jong u kaba khlaiñ .
