translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers , that I will raise up thy seed after thee , which shall be of thy sons  ; and I will establish his kingdom .

translation.kha: Lada phi long ibha shemphang , Phon lah ban kan ïa la ka jingbitar . Haba uno uno u imat bastang ïa phi , ka dei ka jinglong bakhraw ban kun khet ïa ka .
translation.en: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger  ; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression .

translation.kha: Nangta ki ar ngut ki syiem kin ïaishong lang ban ïabam ha khwai ka miej , hynrei ki jingthmu jong ki , kin long kiba sniew , bad kin ïa-lorni uwei ïa uei pat . Kin ym ïoh ïa kaei naba ki kwah , namar ka por na ka bynta kata kam pateng poi .
translation.en: And both these kings  hearts shall be to do mischief , and they shall speak lies at one table  ; but it shall not prosper : for yet the end shall be at the time appointed .

translation.kha: baroh ki pdiang ïa ki kumba ki nongrep ki pdiang sngewlah ïa u snar ha ka na pyrem .
translation.en: And they waited for me as for the rain  ; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain .

translation.kha: Shi lynter ka jingshem jong u , u leh ïa kaei ka pynsngewbha ïa U Trai , namar u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u la hikai ïa u .
translation.en: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him .
And it came to pass , when he was come to Jerusalem to meet the king , that the king said unto him , Wherefore wentest not thou with me , Mephibosheth ?
translation.kha: Haba u Mephibosheth u wan poi na Jerusalem ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem , u syiem u ong ha u ,  Ko Mephibosheth , mem shym la leit bad nga , balei ?
Phi la ïohsngew Shisha shaphang jong u , mala kum ki nongbud jong u , la hikai ha phi ïa kata ka jingshisha kaweh to ha U Jisu .
translation.en: If so be that ye have heard him , and have been taught by him , as the truth is in Jesus :

translation.kha: Bad nalor film ki jinglyngngoh baroh , to bynrap ïa ka jingieit , kiba tehsong lang ïa kiei kiei baroh lang ha ka jingïatylli kaba janai .
translation.en: And above all these things put on charity , which is the bond of perfectness .

All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it . It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire : every one that toucheth them shall be holy .
translation.kha: Ha ki por ki ban wan baroh uno uno na ki shynrang kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ki lah ban bam ïa ka pateng la pateng kum ka bynta na ki jingkñia ainguh bam sha U  Trai . Uno uno uwei pat uba ktah ïa ka jingainguh bam un mynsaw na ka bor ka jingkhuid jong ka .
U Trai u ïapoi pynpaw ïa lade ha Sillah , naba u la paw ha u Samuel , bad u la kren ruh ha u . Bad haba u Jemuel u kren , ki Israel baroh ki shahshkor .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared again in Shiloh : for the  Lord  revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the  Lord .
So the people went out into the field against Israel : and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim  ;
translation.kha: Ka kynhun shipai jong u Dabid ka la leit sha rudnong bad ïaleh ïa ki Israel ha ka khlaw Ephraim .
Ka longïing jongno u Meshelemaïah ka pynmih khatphra ngut ki rangbah kiba tbit .
translation.en: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren , strong men , eighteen .

translation.kha: Hynrei nabar kane baroh , phi ong , ‘ Nga long uba hun jaijai , da pahara U Trai un ym bitar law ïa nga .’ Hynrei ma nga , U Tharai , kan pynshitom ïa phi namar ba phi sam ba phi la leh nongpop .
translation.en: Yet thou sayest , Because I am innocent , surely his anger shall turn from me . Behold , I will plead with thee , because thou sayest , I have not sinned .

translation.kha: nur pynphong ïa me ka ri khlaw junom la julam , bad yn ym don uno uno u ban shongsah shuh ha ki nongbah jong me . Te men sa tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: I will make thee perpetual desolations , and thy cities shall not return : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
For Isaiah had said , Let them take a lump of figs , and lay it for a plaster upon the boil , and he shall recover .
translation.kha: U Isaïah u ïathuh ha u syiem ban buh ka jingtah ba la shna da ki soh Dumbur ha u tohjaw jong u , bad un sa jem .

translation.en: But Jesus beheld them , and said unto them ,  With men this is impossible  ; but with God all things are possible .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la peit shlip sha ki bad u la jubab ,  Kane ka long ka bym lah ha u briew , hynrei ha U Blei kiei kiei baroh ki long kaba lah .

translation.en: And he said , Lift up now thine eyes , and see , all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked , speckled , and grisled : for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee .
translation.kha: ‘ Ha khmih’ u la bteng , ‘ Baroh ki  langsohmoh kiba ïa-pakor ki long kiba thohshuid , kiba thohbria , bad kiba thohbroin . Nga pynlong ïa kane ban jia namar nga la ïohi ïa baroh kaba u Laban u la leh ïa me .

Te nga la ong ïa ka nang Rabbah ba U Trai badonbok Borabor , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong , Phi la kohnguh ïa ka hukum kaba u kpa Thummim jong phiah u Jonadab u la ai ha phi ; phi la bud ïa baroh ki jingbthah jong u , Bad phi la leh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u la hukum ïa phi .
translation.en: And Jeremiah said unto the house of the Rechabites , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Because ye have obeyed the commandment of Jehonadab your father , and kept all his precepts , and done according unto all that he hath commanded you :

translation.kha: To phai noh na ki pop jong phi , u la ong , naba ka Shim ki bneng ka la jlan !
translation.en: And saying , Repent ye : for the kingdom of heaven is at hand .

translation.kha: U Abraham u la dap shispah snem ka rta mynba la kha ïa u Isaïah .
translation.en: And Abraham was an hundred years old , when his son Isaac was born unto him .
A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food .
translation.kha: U briew uba don ha ka bor uba banbeiñ ïa kiba duk u long kum u  lapbah  lapsan uba pynjot thiaw ïa ki jingthung .

translation.en: And the  Lord  delivered it also , and the king thereof , into the hand of Israel  ; and he smote it with the edge of the sword , and all the souls that were therein  ; he let none remain in it  ; but did unto the king thereof as he did unto the king of Jericho .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ruh ha ki Israel ka jingjop ïa kane ka nongbah bad ïa u syiem jong ka . Kim shym la iehnoh wat uwei ruh , hynrei ki la pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u briew uba don ha ka . Ki la leh ïa u syiem jong ka kumba ki la leh ïa u syiem ka Jerikho .
Ka kham bha ban don khyndiat , kaba la kamai da ka hok , shun ïa naba ïoh shibun , ba la lum da ka jingbit .
translation.en: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right .

translation.kha: Namar ka jingleh ïa kaba kum kane ka jingleh barunar , u dei ban baïar mata Shah ïa kaba u la shim .
translation.en: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold , because he did this thing , and because he had no pity .

translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki nongïalam , Ap ïa ngi hangne ha ka jaka shijur dara tad angnud ngi wan phai . U Aaron bad u Hur ki don hangne bad pa’ ; bad kumne uno uno uba don ïano Kanaan ka jingïakajia ban pynbeit , u Lah Ban leit shat ki .
translation.en: And he said unto the elders , Tarry ye here for us , until we come again unto you : and , behold , Aaron and Hur are with you : if any man have any matters to do , let him come unto them .

translation.kha: Ngan wan phai pat sha Jerusalem , ka nongbah bakhuid jong nga , Bad ban shong ban sah hangta . Ïa ka yn tip kum ka nongbah baïaineh , bad ïa u lum jongnga U Trai Benabinadab Baroh yn khor u lum bakyntang .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; I am returned unto Zion , and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem : and Jerusalem shall be called a city of truth  ; and the mountain of the  Lord  of hosts the holy mountain .

translation.kha: Hynrei nga la ong , ‘ Wat thiang ïa kita ki briew .
translation.en: Then I said unto you , Dread not , neither be afraid of them .

And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz , which the kings of Judah had made , and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the  Lord  , did the king beat down , and brake them down from thence , and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron .
translation.kha: Ïa ki duwan kiba ki syiem Judah ki la tei halor tnum ka ïingsyiem hajrong ka jaka sah u syiem Ahas , u syiem Josaïah u la pyntwa lut , ryngkat bad ki duwan ba la pynïeng da u syiem Manasseh ha ki ar tylli ki phyllaw jong ka Templ ; u la pynlwet ïa ki duwan lyngkhot lyngkhai bad bret ïa ki sha ka Them Kidron .
Phi kylla riewspah na ki pop ki brup jong nga , bad kumta phi kwah ïa ki ban nang leh pop Shuh shuh .
translation.en: They eat up the sin of my people , and they set their heart on their iniquity .
He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house  ; but he that hateth gifts shall live .
translation.kha: Kaba pyrshang ban ïohnong da ka bymhok , ka pynngat ïa la ka longïing ha ka jingjynjar . Wat bamsap bad phin ïoh im slem .

Ai ba yn pynkyllaiñ ïa phi da ka jingkhlaiñ baroh kaba wan na ka tam badonburom jong u , haneng ba phoi lah ban shah ïa kiei keiñ baroh da ka jingïaishah . Bad da ka jingkmen to ainguh ïa U Kpa , uba la pynlong ïa phi kiba bit ban ïoh ïa la ka bynta na kaei kaba U Bel u la tyngkai na ka bynta ki bri jong u ha ka hima ka jingshai .
translation.en: Giving thanks unto the Father , which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light :

translation.kha: U Jisu u tdong kren mynsaw u Judas , uwei na ki khaw-eit nguid ki synran u la poi . Long bad u , la don u babha ba la kieng atiar da ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon , ïa uba la phan da ki rangbah lyngdoh , ki nonghikai jong ka Judia , bad ki rangbah nongïalam .
translation.en: And immediately , while he yet spake , cometh Judas , one of the twelve , and with him a great multitude with swords and staves , from the chief priests and the scribes and the elders .

translation.kha: Kan long ka lynti bah hangta , ba la khot Ka Lynti jong ka Jingkhuid . Yn ym don nongïapom u ban ïadih ha kata ka lynti ; ym don ki riewkynthei ki ban ïalam bakla ïa kito kiba buhnud ïa ka .
translation.en: And an highway shall be there , and a way , and it shall be called The way of holiness  ; the unclean shall not pass over it  ; but it shall be for those : the wayfaring men , though fools , shall not err therein .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jakob u mihnoh na Beeshterah . Ki khun shynna jong u ki pynseisoh ïa u , ïa ki khunlung rit jrong ki , bad ïa ki tnga jong ki , ha kita ki kali kiba u sahmiet ka jingpeit u la phah ban kit ïa ki .
translation.en: And Jacob rose up from Beer–sheba : and the sons of Israel carried Jacob their father , and their little ones , and their wives , in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him .

translation.kha: Mari kumta hi U Jisu u la pynlong ïa ki synreit baneh kiew halor ka lieng bad ban leit ha shuwa jong u shai Bethsaida , sha shiliang jong ka duriaw , katba u dang phah noh ïa u paidbah .
translation.en: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship , and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida , while he sent away the people .
Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock ! the sword shall be upon his arm , and upon his right eye : his arm shall be clean dried up , and his right eye shall be utterly darkened .
translation.kha: Uta u nongaplangbrot u bymmyntoi ei ei u long uba la tim ! U la iehnoh ïa la ka kynhun langbrot . Ka thma kan pynjot khoit ïa ka bor jong u . Ka kti jong u kan ïapstai bad ka khmat kamon jong u kan long kaba matlah .

translation.en: And he came to the second , and said likewise . And he answered and said , I go , sir : and went not .
translation.kha: Nangta u kpa u la leit sha uwei pat u khun bad u la ong ïa kajuh . ‘ Ho-oid , pa’ u la jubab , hynrei um shym la leit .

translation.en: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto the  Lord  , and said , If thou shalt without fail deliver the children of Ammon into mine hands ,
translation.kha: U Jephthah u kular ha U  Trai  :  Lada me ai ha nga ka jingjop pyrshah ïa ki Ammon ,

Nangta u Samuel u ong ha u Nadab , Kane ka dei ka Merab ka khunlung jong nga kaba khlam shuwa . Ngan ai ïa ka ha me kum ka tnga jongngi me halor ka kyndon ba me dei ban shakri ïa per kum u shipai khubor sad bajanai , malade ïaleh ïa ki thma U Trai . ( U Saul u nang pyrkhat ba ha kane ka armet ki Philistia kin ïoh pynïap ïa u Dabid bad um da donkam ban leh da lai . )
translation.en: And Saul said to David , Behold my elder daughter Merab , her will I give thee to wife : only be thou valiant for me , and fight the  Lord s  battles . For Saul said , Let not mine hand be upon him , but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him .

translation.kha: Lymda phi leh ïa kaei ka bymneh , yn pynshitom sat ïa phi ; phin ïap lada phim ailad pun pynbeit ïa phi .
translation.en: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way : and he that hateth reproof shall die .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka ryntieh jongno u ka ei khlem khih , Bad ïa ki ksang ti jong u la pynkhlaiñ Da ka bor jong U Blei Uba Khlaiñbor jong u Joab , Da u Nongap langbrot , U nongïada jrong ki Israel .
translation.en: But his bow abode in strength , and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of the mighty God of Jacob  ; ( from thence is the shepherd , the stone of Israel : )

translation.kha: lane tharai kawei ka briew kob don shipai tylli ki sbai phong ka duh noh kawei na ki — khie ba kan leh ? Ka thang ïa ka sharak , ka sar ïa la ka ïing , malade ka khmih biang bajngum kylleng kylliang haduh ba kan da shem ïa ka .
translation.en: Either what woman having ten pieces of silver , if she lose one piece , doth not light a candle , and sweep the house , and seek diligently till she find it ?

translation.kha: Kumta u Moses bad u Aaron ki leit sha u Aaron bad ki lai bania U tharai u la hukum . U Aaron u bret ïa la u diengïap ha khmat u Pharaoh bad ha khmat ki jingbabe pynïaidkam jrong u , bad u kylla bseiñ .
translation.en: And Moses and Aaron went in unto Pharaoh , and they did so as the  Lord  had commanded : and Aaron cast down his rod before Pharaoh , and before his servants , and it became a serpent .

translation.kha: Haba ki Seraïah na badonkam ki la phah ka kynhun shipai ban ïarap ïa u Hadadeser , u Daberath u la tur ïaleh ïa ka bad u la pynïap arphew ar hajir lwet ki pynrangbah .
translation.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah , David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men .

translation.kha: U la leh ïa kaei kaba ïasngewbha ïa U Trai , kumba u khop jong u , u la leh ; hynrei , ym kum u khap jong u , um shym la kun pop da kob thang jingbeh ha ka thalab . Ki briew pynban , ki ïalang ïai kuna pop .
translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father Uzziah did : howbeit he entered not into the temple of the  Lord . And the people did yet corruptly .

Hear therefore , O Israel , and observe to do it  ; that it may be well with thee , and that ye may increase mightily , as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath promised thee , in the land that floweth with milk and honey .
translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa ki , ko Israel , bad kohnguh ïa ki ! Te phin shem bha , bad phin nang roi bad long ka jaitbynriew kaba donbor bad phin ïoh shong ha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , kumba U  Trai  U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la kular .

translation.en: The words of Jehonadab the son of Rechab , that he commanded his sons not to drink wine , are performed  ; for unto this day they drink none , but obey their father s commandment : notwithstanding I have spoken unto you , rising early and speaking  ; but ye hearkened not unto me .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew u Jonadab ki la kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u ban ym dih waiñ , bad haduh kane hi ka sngi ym don uwei ruh na ki uba dih ïa kaba kumno kumno ruh ka waiñ . Hynrei nga la ïai kren ha phi , bad phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga .
Ladan phi! long ki bymïaineh sad ïasnohkti bad kita ki jaitbynriew kiba dang sah” hapdeng jong phi bad pa ïashongkha khleh bad ki ,
translation.en: Else if ye do in any wise go back , and cleave unto the remnant of these nations , even these that remain among you , and shall make marriages with them , and go in unto them , and they to you :

translation.kha: wat la ngi don la u phlang bad ki jingbam ïa ki puta jong ngi , kamut ruh u kpu bad ka waiñ na ka bynda ïa lade bad ïa kane ka tnga kliar jong nga bad ïa Un u shakri jong nga . Ngi don lut kat kaba ngi donkam .
translation.en: Yet there is both straw and provender for our asses  ; and there is bread and wine also for me , and for thy handmaid , and for the young man which is with thy servants : there is no want of any thing .

translation.kha: Kut ki la leit kloi bad ki la shem ïa ka Mari bad u Joseph bad ki la ïohi ïa u khunlung uba thiah ha ka shyngoid .
translation.en: And they came with haste , and found Mary , and Joseph , and the babe lying in a manger .

translation.kha: naba U Blei un bishar ïa phi ha kajuh ka rukom kumba phi bishar ïa kiwei pat , bad un pyndei ha phi ïa kijuh ki jingthew kiba phi pyndei ïa kiwei pat .
translation.en: For with what judgment ye judge , ye shall be judged : and with what measure ye mete , it shall be measured to you again .
For if I do this thing willingly , I have a reward : but if against my will , a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me .
translation.kha: Lada nga la trei ïa la ka kam da ka mon sngewbha , te nga la lah ban khmih lynti ban ïoh ïa ka bainong ; hynrei nga leh ïa ka tang kum ka kamram , namar U Blei u la aiti ha nga ïa kane ka kam .

Un buh ïa la ki kti baroh ar ha ka khlieh jong uta u langsohmoh , sad halor jong u un phla ïa ki jingbymman , ïa ki pop , bad ïa ki jingïaleh pyrthuh baroh jong ki Israel , malade da kumjuh un pynkit ïa ki ha ka khlieh jong uta u langsohmoh . Nangta dih ban ñiah noh ïa uta u langsohmoh shad ka ri shyiap da u briew uba la jied kyrteng na ka pyntha kata .
translation.en: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat , and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel , and all their transgressions in all their sins , putting them upon the head of the goat , and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness :

translation.kha: ïa ki jaiñ babha jong ki , ki jaiñ jynsur , ki jaiñkup bad ki pla kynsit ;
translation.en: The changeable suits of apparel , and the mantles , and the wimples , and the crisping pins ,

translation.kha: Kenan ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Ijipt . U Trai u wan sha Ijipt , u da shnong ha u lyoh uba ïaid stet . Ki bleithaw Jong ki Ijipt ki khynñiuh ha khmat jongki u , bad ki briew jongnga ka Ijipt ki duh noh ïa ka jingshlur jongki ki .
translation.en: The burden of Egypt . Behold , the  Lord  rideth upon a swift cloud , and shall come into Egypt : and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence , and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngur hi ba ki pynïap ïa ki khun jong nga kum ki jingkñia sha ki bleithaw , ki la Wan sha ka Templ Jong nga Bad pyntngit ïa ka !
translation.en: For when they had slain their children to their idols , then they came the same day into my sanctuary to profane it  ; and , lo , thus have they done in the midst of mine house .

translation.kha: Kawei na ki khlieh jong uta u mradkhlaw ka i kumba ka la shahskhor pynmong ju , hynrei ka jingshong ka la ïohkhiah . Ka pynrieh baroh kawei ka la sngewphylla bad ka la bujli ïa uta u riewkhlaw .
translation.en: And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death  ; and his deadly wound was healed : and all the world wondered after the beast .
Now the names of the twelve apostles are these  ; The first , Simon , who is called Peter , and Andrew his brother  ; James the son of Zebedee , and John his brother  ;
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki apostol : uba nyngkong , U Simon ( ïa uba la khot u Petros ) bad u para jong u , u Andriw ; u Jakob bad u para jong u , u Ïoannis , ki khun jong u Sebedi ;
Ki khun ki ksuid jong u Joseph ki ong ha u Joshua , Balei phi ai ïa im tang shi bynta jong ka ri ba ngin kam kynti kum la ka jong ? Ngi ïadon buiñ ngut namar U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa ngi .
translation.en: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua , saying , Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit , seeing I am a great people , forasmuch as the  Lord  hath blessed me hitherto ?
And it came to pass , when Hiram heard the words of Solomon , that he rejoiced greatly , and said , Blessed be the  Lord  this day , which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people .
translation.kha: U Hiram u la kmen shaba palat haba u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor na u Solomon , bad u ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  ha kane ka sngi ba u la ai ha u Dabid ïa u khun uba stad kum une ban long u syiem hadien jong u ïa kata ka jaitbynriew bakhraw !

U Solomon u la kynjat thiah sad u sngewbit ba Dei U Blei’ uba la kren ïa u ha ka jingpynïasoh . Nangta u la longing sha Jerushah bad u la ïeng ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang ka jong U Trai bad u la ai ki jingainguh thang bad ki jingainguh jingïasyllok ha U Trai . Hadlai kata u la ai ka jingkhawai ïa baroh ki pynrangbah synshar jong u .
translation.en: And Solomon awoke  ; and , behold , it was a dream . And he came to Jerusalem , and stood before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and offered up burnt offerings , and offered peace offerings , and made a feast to all his servants .

translation.kha: U buh ha ka templ ïa ki tiar ki tar baroh ïa kiba u kpa jong u , u la pynkyntang Sha U Blei , lym bad ïa ki mar khiar dara mar daw ïa kiba u hi u la pynkieng .
translation.en: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated , and the things which himself had dedicated , into the house of the  Lord  , silver , and gold , and vessels .

translation.kha: Sngewbha da pyrkhat Shaphang kane bad sa rai ïa kawei ban leh . Kane ka lah pun long kaba shyrkhei ïa u kynthih jong ngi bad ïa ka longkmie jong u borbah . U long ibha sniew jinglong ba un ym sngap ïano ïan ruh !
translation.en: Now therefore know and consider what thou wilt do  ; for evil is determined against our master , and against all his household : for he is such a son of Belial , that a man cannot speak to him .

translation.kha: Katba baroh ki paidbah ki dang shahshkor ïa u , U Jisu u la ong ha ki synran jong u ,
translation.en: Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples ,

translation.kha: Ko Israel wat pynlwait ïa ki kjat jong me , Lane shah ïa u pdot jyllang me ban tyrkhong na kaba beh ïa kiwei pud ki blei . Hynrei me ong , ‘ Em ! Ngam lah ban phai dien . Nga la ieit ïa ki blei nongwei bad ngan leit hadien jong ki .’
translation.en: Withhold thy foot from being unshod , and thy throat from thirst : but thou saidst , There is no hope : no  ; for I have loved strangers , and after them will I go .

translation.kha: un-long katba ka long , u Ahimaas u ong bajrong , Nga kwah ba leit . Khie leit , u Joab u ong . Kumta u Ahimaas u mareh bran na ka lynti kaba na ka ih Jordan , bad shen u la tam ïa iathuh u mraw .
translation.en: But howsoever , said he , let me run . And he said unto him , Run . Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain , and overran Cushi .
And there followed him great multitudes of people from Galilee , and from Decapolis , and from Jerusalem , and from Judaea , and from beyond Jordan .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah byllien na Galilaïa bad Dekapolis , na Jerusalem , Judia bad na ka ri ha kawei pat ka liang jong ka Jordan ki la bud ïa u .
U Trai un tim ïa u kew jong phi bad ïa ki jingbam ba phi khreh da u .
translation.en: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store .

translation.kha: Ngam pynrem ïa ki namar ka rukom ba ki im bad ki bor , bad nga la pynsakma ïa ki kylleng ki ri nongwei .
translation.en: And I scattered them among the heathen , and they were dispersed through the countries : according to their way and according to their doings I judged them .
Bless them which persecute you : bless , and curse not .
translation.kha: To kyrpad ïa U Blei ban kyrkhu ïa kito kiba pynshitom ïa phi — ho-oid , to kyrpad ïa u ban kyrkhu , ym ban tim .
Mynta ha kane ka sien to map ïa ka nongpop jong nga bad duwai ha U Terah U Blei jong phi shun shngiam noh na nga ïa kane ka jingpynshitom kabu shyrkhei na nga .
translation.en: Now therefore forgive , I pray thee , my sin only this once , and entreat the  Lord  your God , that he may take away from me this death only .

translation.kha: Ïa ki blei jong ki la thaw da ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ba la pynshong da ki kti jong ki briew .
translation.en: Their idols are silver and gold , the work of men s hands .

translation.kha: U Abraham u ong , Nga kular .
translation.en: And Abraham said , I will swear .

Then sent the king an answer unto Rehum the chancellor , and to Shimshai the scribe , and to the rest of their companions that dwell in Samaria , and unto the rest beyond the river , Peace , and at such a time .
translation.kha: U patsha u phah ïa kane ka jubab :  Ha u Rehum , u lat , ha u Shimshai , u sekretari jong ka probins , bad ha ki paralok jong ki kiba shong ha Samaria bad ha kiba sah jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi , ki jingkhublei .
Lada phi shahshkor ïa nga , phin sa tip kaei kaba dadien , kaba hok , bad kabu ïaid beit . Phin sa tip ïa kaei kob phi dei ban leh .
translation.en: Then shalt thou understand righteousness , and judgment , and equity  ; yea , every good path .

translation.kha: Ïa uno uno kaba pyrshah ïa u , wat u Rangbah Lyngdoh Jong U Blei , un shah sar noh bad Shah pyndih .
translation.en: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him , and shall be broken  ; yea , also the prince of the covenant .

translation.kha: Naba kaei kaba U Kpa jong nga u kwah , ka long ba baroh kiba ïohi ïa U Kun bad ngeit ha u , ki Dei ban ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut . Bad ngan pynmihpat ïa ki ha ka sngi kob khatduh .
translation.en: And this is the will of him that sent me , that every one which seeth the Son , and believeth on him , may have everlasting life : and I will raise him up at the last day .
And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David s spears and shields , that were in the temple of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U la ai ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam ïa ki sum bad ki stieh kiba dei ki jong u syiem Dabid bad ïa kiba la buh ha ka Templ ,

Ki briew’ jong ka Heshbon bad ka Elealeh ki kyang , nabar ïa ka jingkyang jong ki lah ban ïohsngew shat sha Jerah ; lah ban ïohsngew da ki briew ha Soar , malu la ïohsngew shaduh sha Horonaim bad sha Eglath Shelishiyah . Wat ka wahduid Nimrim ka la rngad noh .
translation.en: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh , and even unto Jahaz , have they uttered their voice , from Zoar even unto Horonaim , as an heifer of three years old : for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate .
Ephraim compasseth me about with lies , and the house of Israel with deceit : but Judah yet ruleth with God , and is faithful with the saints .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Ki paid Israel ki la ker sawdong ïa nga da ki jinglamler bad jingshukor , bad ki paid Judah ki dang ïai ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga , U Blei baïaineh bad uba khuid .

Hynrei haba ka por jongu ngi pynlang ki ka la khup , ngi la mihnoh bad ngi la khi leit ha ka jingleit jong ngi . Ma ki baroh , lem bad ki tnga bad ki khun jong ki , ki la ïaleit lem badno ngi na ka nongbah shat ka rud duriaw , ha kaba i'u la ïadem khohsiew bad duwai .
translation.en: And when we had accomplished those days , we departed and went our way  ; and they all brought us on our way , with wives and children , till we were out of the city : and we kneeled down on the shore , and prayed .

translation.kha: U jingdon u la phah ïa ki nongleitkurim sha ka ri lum Hapharaim baroh ban ong , Ale wiang hajir ban ïaleh ïa ki Medad . ïeng skhem ha ka oh Jordan bad ha ki wahduid haduh Bethbarah , ngab khang ïa ki Midian na kaba jam ïa ki sha jingsliang . Ki lapbah Ephraim ki la ïalumlang , bad ki la ïeng skhem ha ka wah Jordan bad ha kita ki wahduid haduh Bethbarah .
translation.en: And Gideon sent messengers throughout all mount Ephraim , saying , Come down against the Midianites , and take before them the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan . Then all the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together , and took the waters unto Beth–barah and Jordan .

translation.kha: A ba ngan da la ïap noh hapoh ka kpoh ka kmie jong nga lane ïap noh ha ka jingpynmihpat ba la kha ïa por .
translation.en: Why died I not from the womb ? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly ?

translation.kha: Ka Syiem jong ka ri Sheba ka bniap shaphang ka nam u Solomon , sad ka leit shaei Jerusalem ïa-ban tynjuh ïa u da ki jingjakhlia kiba eh .
translation.en: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the  Lord  , she came to prove him with hard questions .

translation.kha: U rangbah ai sah jong ka kynhun shipai jong u Saul , u Abiram u khun jong u Ner , u la phet bad u Ishbosheth , u khun jong u Saul sha Mahanaim .
translation.en: But Abner the son of Ner , captain of Saul s host , took Ish–bosheth the son of Saul , and brought him over to Mahanaim  ;

translation.kha: Ko Jeremaïah , tyngab ïa ki briew jong nga , kumba men tynjuh ïa ka nar , malade to ïit ki long kiba kumno .
translation.en: I have set thee for a tower and a fortress among my people , that thou mayest know and try their way .

translation.kha: Hato barieh ki niam ki pynsngewbha ïa U Blang , ne tang Kawei ?
translation.en: Are all religions pleasing to God , or is just one ?

translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Saul u phah khet ïa u Ahimelekh u lyngdoh bad ïa baroh ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jyllang u , kiba la long ruh ki lyngdoh ha Nob , bad ki la ïawan shiah u .
translation.en: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest , the son of Ahitub , and all his father s house , the priests that were in Nob : and they came all of them to the king .

translation.kha: Babha phi ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha , ka don ka jingbishar khor , hynrei ki jingshukor ki ïalum sha ka jingshah bishar bymhok .
translation.en: He that speaketh truth sheweth forth righteousness : but a false witness deceit .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jehoïada u ïalam ïa u Joahas shabar , u buh ïa ka pansngiat ha ka khlieh jong u , bad u ai ha u ïa ka kopi jong ki aiñ ba pynsyaid ïa ka jinglong syiem . Nangta ïa u Joash la pynsleh syiem nabar la pynmanbha kum u syiem . Ki paidbhur ki thab ïa la ki ktieh bad ki ïasyriem , Im slem ko syiem !
translation.en: And he brought forth the king s son , and put the crown upon him , and gave him the testimony  ; and they made him king , and anointed him  ; and they clapped their hands , and said , God save the king .

translation.kha: Rakhe ïa Kanah ka Jingkhawai Niam ha ka por ba la buh man ka snem .
translation.en: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year .

translation.kha: Ngan ïai buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha me , sam ïaroh ïa me haw sha .
translation.en: But I will hope continually , and will yet praise thee more and more .
With Onesimus , a faithful and beloved brother , who is one of you . They shall make known unto you all things which are done here .
translation.kha: Lem bad u , u wan u Onesimos , uta u para ba-ieit bad uba lah ban shaniah , uba dei na ka kynhun jong phi . Kin ïathuh ha phi ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba la jia hangne .

translation.en: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious : but unto them which be disobedient , the stone which the builders disallowed , the same is made the head of the corner ,
translation.kha: Une u maw u long uba kordor eh ïa phi kiba ngeit ; hynrei ha kito ki bymngeit :  U maw ïa uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymmyntoi u la kylla long uba donkam tam na baroh .
Baroh ki la phai noh na U Balei ; baroh ki la leh bym dei ; ym don uno uno uba leh ïa kaba dei , ym khong uwei ruh .
translation.en: They are all gone out of the way , they are together become unprofitable ; there is none that doeth good , no , not one .
How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power : who went about doing good , and healing all that were oppressed of the devil  ; for God was with him .
translation.kha: Phi tip shaphang U Jisu uba na Nasareth bad kumno U Blei u la theh halor jong u ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ïa ka bor . U la leit kylleng , u da leh ki kam babha bad u da pynkhiah ïa baroh kiba la long hapoh ka bor jong u Ksuid , naba U Blei u la don lem bad u .
Nga long U Trai U Blei jong me ; nga pynkhlaiñ ïa me bad la ong , ‘ wat sheptieng ; ngan ïarap ïa me .’
translation.en: For I the  Lord  thy God will hold thy right hand , saying unto thee , Fear not  ; I will help thee .

translation.kha: Ktien kiba la ïohi ïa kata ki la ïathuh ha ki briew kaei kaba la haka jia ïa uta u brup uba don ksuid , bad ïa nia ki sniang .
translation.en: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil , and also concerning the swine .

translation.kha: U Laban u la ïuh ïa ka kali khmut bad ïa ki khadu ha ki ryndang-kti jong ka para jong u , bad u la ïohsngew ïa ka ba ka ïathuh ïa Kiei kaba uta u bri u la ong ha ka . U leit sha u shakri jong u Abraham , uba ïeng hadien ki ut jong u hadien katai ka pukri ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he saw the earring and bracelets upon his sister s hands , and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister , saying , Thus spake the man unto me  ; that he came unto the man  ; and , behold , he stood by the camels at the well .

translation.kha: Naba long ngi la im ka jinglong kum ki biria , ki jingkwah bapop ba la pynkhih da ka praw ki Trei ha ki met jong ngi , mala baroh kaba ngi leh ka kut ha ka jingïap .
translation.en: For when we were in the flesh , the motions of sins , which were by the law , did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death .

And Deborah said unto Barak , Up  ; for this is the day in which the  Lord  hath delivered Sisera into thine hand : is not the  Lord  gone out before thee ? So Barak went down from mount Tabor , and ten thousand men after him .
translation.kha: Nangta ka Deborah ka ong ïa u Barak ,  Khie leit ! U  Trai  u ïalam ïa me ! Ha kane ka sngi u la ai ha me ka jingjop halor u Sisera .  Kumta u Barak u la leit arsut na u Lum Tabor lem bad ki shiphew hajar ngut ki rangbah jong u .
Ym slem hadien U Jisu u la ïasaid lyngba ki kato katne ki lyngkha kew ha ka sngi Sabtah . Ki synran jong u ki la thngan , ba kumta ki la sdang ban ïakheit ïa ki rynjup kew malu bam ïa ki syiad kew .
translation.en: At that time Jesus went on the sabbath day through the corn  ; and his disciples were an hungred , and began to pluck the ears of corn , and to eat .

translation.kha: Wallam ïa ka jinglong rkhiang ha ka ri jong ka bad pynrngad lur ïa ki Wah jong ka . Ka Babilonia ka long ka ri jyllang ki pynlwet ba-ishyrkhei , kiba la pynkylla bieit ïa ki brai .
translation.en: A drought is upon her waters  ; and they shall be dried up : for it is the land of graven images , and they are mad upon their idols .
And next unto them repaired Jedaiah the son of Harumaph , even over against his house . And next unto him repaired Hattush the son of Hashabniah .
translation.kha: U Jedaïah , u khun jong u Harumaph u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , kaba don hajan ka ïing jong u hi . U Hattush , u khun jong u Hashabneïah u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .

translation.en: The labour of the foolish wearieth every one of them , because he knoweth not how to go to the city .
translation.kha: Tang uta uba mutlop shaba palat ban lap ka lynti sha ïing un pynthait ïa lade da ka jingtrei .

translation.en: And he brought me thither , and , behold , there was a man , whose appearance was like the appearance of brass , with a line of flax in his hand , and a measuring reed  ; and he stood in the gate .
translation.kha: U la rah ïa nga kham sha jan , bad nga la ïohi ïa uwei u briew uba phyrnai kum ka rnong . U bat ha ka kti ïa u pita uba da ka jaiñ linen bad ïa u diengthew bad u ïeng hajan ka khyrdop .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Peace be unto thee  ; fear not : thou shalt not die .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Long ka jingsuk . Wat sheptieng . Men ym ïap .
U Jisu u tang shu ïohi ïa ki , u la khot ïa ki ; ki la iehnoh ïa la u kpa jong ki , u Sebedi ha ka lieng ryngkat bad ki pynrangbah kiba trei bylla , bad ki la leit bad U Jisu! .
translation.en: And straightway he called them : and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants , and went after him .
Then I answered them , The word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Kumta nga la ong ha ki ,  U  Trai  u la kren ha nga bad u la ong
Nga ai ïa ka Gilead ha ki Makhir kiba na ka jait Manasseh .
translation.en: And I gave Gilead unto Machir .
And David said unto him , Thy blood be upon thy head  ; for thy mouth hath testified against thee , saying , I have slain the  Lord s  anointed .
translation.kha: bad u Dabid u ong ha uta u nong Amalek ,  Me la wallam ïa kane halor lade . Me la pynrem ïa lade haba me phla ba me la pynïap ïa uta uba U  Trai  u la jied ban long syiem .

translation.en: And it came to pass , while Saul talked unto the priest , that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased : and Saul said unto the priest , Withdraw thine hand .
translation.kha: Katba u Saul u dang kren ha uta u lyngdoh , ka jingkulmar ha ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia ka nang kham jur ; kumta u Saul u ong ha u ,  Ym don por ban kylli ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And he was three days without sight , and neither did eat nor drink .
translation.kha: Haduh lai sngi um shym lah ban ïohi , bad ha kata ka por um shym la bam ne dih ei ei .
mynno kane ka la jia ? Hato ka la lama ha shuwa ne shadien ba la otsher ïa u Ahab ? Ka la long ha shu ym hadien .
translation.en: How was it then reckoned ? when he was in circumcision , or in uncircumcision ? Not in circumcision , but in uncircumcision .
To satisfy the desolate and waste ground  ; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth ?
translation.kha: Mano ba ai um ïa ka khyndew kaba tyrkhong bad kaba thynrang , ba kumta u phlang u mih ?

translation.en: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth , Gog and Magog , to gather them together to battle : the number of whom is as the sand of the sea .
translation.kha: bad un mih shabar ban shukor ïa ki jaitbynriew ïa kiba la pynsakma kylleng ka pyrthei , kata ka Gog bad ka Magog . U Soitan un wallam lang ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingïaleh thma , kiba bun kat ki symboh shyiap harud ka duriaw .

translation.en: And sold their possessions and goods , and parted them to all men , as every man had need .
translation.kha: Ki die noh ïa ka jaka ka puta bad ka jingdon jingem jong ki , bad sam ïa ka pisa hapdeng jong ki baroh , kat kum kaei kaba uwei uwei u donkam .
Khenani kaei ba la ïohi ? U Trai u kylli . Ki phai dien ha ka jingsheptieng . Ki shipa jong ki , ki shah beh noh ; kiba dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki mareh tait kat lah kat ïai bad kim kyrtiang dien .
translation.en: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back ? and their mighty ones are beaten down , and are fled apace , and look not back : for fear was round about , saith the  Lord .
And he gathered an host , and smote the Amalekites , and delivered Israel out of the hands of them that spoiled them .
translation.kha: U ïaleh da kaba shlur bad u jop wat ïa ki paid Amalek . U la pyllait im ïa ki Israel na baroh ki jingtur ïaleh .
Da kynmaw ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki nongïoh ha ki ïing jong phi . Don kiba la kun kumta bad pdiang sngewkhia ïa ki angel khlem da thop ïa kata .
translation.en: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers : for thereby some have entertained angels unawares .
And woe unto them that are with child , and to them that give suck in those days !
translation.kha: A katno kan long kaba shyrkhei ha kito ki sngi ïa ki kynthei kiba armet bad ïa ki kmie kiba don ki khun rit !

translation.en: And Ain with her suburbs , and Juttah with her suburbs , and Beth–shemesh with her suburbs  ; nine cities out of those two tribes .
translation.kha: ka Ain , ka Juttah , bad ka Beth Shemesh , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki : khyndai tylli ki shnong na ki jait Judah bad Simeon .
Hynrei u khun jongngi phad un im kumta ka kada khlaw , un ïaleh pyrshah ïa uwei pa uwei u briew , bad eiei pa uwei u briew un ïaleh pyrshah ïa u . Un shong khlad na la ki kur ki jait Baroh .
translation.en: And he will be a wild man  ; his hand will be against every man , and every man s hand against him  ; and he shall dwell in the presence of all his brethren .

translation.kha: U Trai u la krong pat ha nga bad u la ong ,
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  came also unto me , saying ,

Saying , When will the new moon be gone , that we may sell corn ? and the sabbath , that we may set forth wheat , making the ephah small , and the shekel great , and falsifying the balances by deceit ?
translation.kha: Phi ong ha lade ,  Ngim lah ap slem ïa ki sngi bakhuid ba kin kut noh khnang ba ngi lah ban die ïa u kew jong ngi . Lano ka sngi Sabbaton kan kut , khnang ba ngin ïoh sdang ban die biang ? Nangta ngi lah ban oh dor rem , pyndonkam da ki jingthew bymhok , bad pynbakla ïa ki tarajur ban thok ïa ki nongthied jong ngi .

Kut katba long bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehkmen mala ki bym pynkhuid ïa lade ki ïarung ki bymkhuid , namar ba ym shym la synreit ïa ka um ka jinglongkhuid ba-halor jong ki . Ki pyntngit ïa ka Ïingjaiñ U Trai bad yn ym ñiew shuh ïa ki kum ki briew jong U Blei .
translation.en: But the man that shall be unclean , and shall not purify himself , that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation , because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the  Lord  : the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him  ; he is unclean .

translation.kha: La pynsleh bad la pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh ,
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old , all that enter into the host , to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Hadien shi taïew , haba ka par ka la poi na ka bynta Ban otsher ïa u khunlung , la ai kyrteng ïa u , U Jisu , ka kthang kaba u angel u la lah ai na ka bynta jong U ha shuwa ba yn pun ïa U .
translation.en: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child , his name was called JESUS , which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb .

translation.kha: Kine ki kyndon ki ba-ieit jingbatnud ïa u Hamor bad ïa u Shemesh u khun jong u ,
translation.en: And their words pleased Hamor , and Shechem Hamor s son .

translation.kha: Lada phira kyntait ban shah hikai , phi ñiewbeiñ ïa lade . lada phi pdiang ïa ka jingpynbeit , phin long kiba kham stad .
translation.en: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul : but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding .
But thou , O son of man , behold , they shall put bands upon thee , and shall bind thee with them , and thou shalt not go out among them :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , yn sa khum sa teh ïa me da ki tyllai , bad men ym lah ban leit sha jaka paidbah .
Ma phi , ko ba-ieit jong nga , to pynskuiñ ïa ki rangbah kumba ka kulai ka pynïeng ïa ki kulai jongnga ki kada ïapom jong u Pharaoh .
translation.en: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart : behold , he standeth behind our wall , he looketh forth at the windows , shewing himself through the lattice .

And I , even I Artaxerxes the king , do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river , that whatsoever Ezra the priest , the scribe of the law of the God of heaven , shall require of you , it be done speedily ,
translation.kha: Nga hukum ïa baroh ki rangbah synshar ka ïing jingkynshew ha ka probins jong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi ban pynbiang khlem pynslem ïa u Esra , u lyngdoh bad u riewstad ha ka Hukum jong U Blei ka Bneng , ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba u pan ,
Hadien kane , u Johanan bad ki nongmareh jong ki shipai ki bym skhem la pyndem ki la wan ha u Gedalaïah ha Mispah bad ki la ong ha u ,
translation.en: Moreover Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that were in the fields , came to Gedaliah to Mizpah ,

translation.kha: Uno uno , u da ban ba-im ïa kata ka doh , kiba khuid ne bymkhuid , kumba bam ïa ka doh skei ne ka doh sier .
translation.en: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten , so thou shalt eat them : the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike .

translation.kha: Kumta u Elijah u la leit . Ka nemsniew ha Samaria ka la don ha ka por kaba jur bha ,
translation.en: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab . And there was a sore famine in Samaria .
And they encamped against them , and destroyed the increase of the earth , till thou come unto Gaza , and left no sustenance for Israel , neither sheep , nor ox , nor ass .
translation.kha: Ki sher dara ha ka ri bad ki pynjot ïa ki jingthung baroh shaduh ka jaka bashaphang shathie sawdong ïa ka Gasa . Ki shim ïa baroh ki langbrot , ki jingri , bad ki kada , bad kim shym pynsah ei ei shuh ïa ki Israel ban bam .
U nongleitkurim u la slem ban woh , kumta ki theisotti ki la sdang pun kohnguh samthiah .
translation.en: While the bridegroom tarried , they all slumbered and slept .

translation.kha: Haba u Ïoannis u la ïohi ïa shibun ki Pharisi dara ki Saddusi kiba la wan shata u ban shah pynbaptis , u la ong ha ki , Phi ki bseiñ — uei uba la ïathuh ha phi ba phi lai Ban lait na ka jingpynshitom kaba U Blei! un sa phah ?
translation.en: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees come to his baptism , he said unto them , O generation of vipers , who hath warned you to flee from the wrath to come ?
But with whom was he grieved forty years ? was it not with them that had sinned , whose carcases fell in the wilderness ?
translation.kha: Bad kiei pat kiba U Blei u la bitar haduh sawphew snem ? Bad kita ki briew kiba la leh pop , kiba la kyllon ïap ha ka ri shyiap .

U Trai , u la pynskhem triang ïa nga ha ka khet jong u Dabid , u kpa jong ar ; u la bat ïa la ka kular bad u la ai ïa ka hima ha nga bad ha ki khulom ki ksiew jong ang . Nga syiem da U Trai uba im ba u Adonijah un ïatip ha Kanah hi ka sngi !
translation.en: Now therefore , as the  Lord  liveth , which hath established me , and set me on the throne of David my father , and who hath made me an house , as he promised , Adonijah shall be put to death this day .

translation.kha: Bad lada u briew u put ïa ka ronsing ka bym ai ka jingsawa kaba sha , uei u ban pynkhreh na ka bynta ka thma ?
translation.en: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound , who shall prepare himself to the battle ?
Thou that makest thy boast of the law , through breaking the law dishonourest thou God ?
translation.kha: Phi sngewsarong ba phi don ka Hukum U Blei — hynrei hato phi wallam ka jinglehrain ïa U Blei da kaba pynkheiñ ïa ka Hukum jong u ?

translation.en: Then the king called to Ziba , Saul s servant , and said unto him , I have given unto thy master s son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u phah khot ïa u Siba , u shakri jong u Saul , bad u ong ,  Nga ai ha u Mephibosheth , u ksiew jong u kynrad jong me , ïa baroh kaba dei ka jong u Saul bad ka longïing jong u .
U la dei U ijuh , uba hiarpateng na u Dabid , ïa uba U Blei u la pynlong u Nongpynim ïa ki paid Israel , kumba u la eh kular .
translation.en: Of this man s seed hath God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour , Jesus :
Why not accept this invitation to attend our congregation’s next meeting and experience these things for yourself ?
translation.kha: Ngi khot sngewbha ïa phi ban wan sha ka jingïalang jong ngi , phin sa mad hi dalade ïa kine kiei kiei .
ngan wanrah ki nongshun kiba sniew ban tun ïaleh ïa me . Kin pynjot ïa kiew kiei kiba eitnar barabor katba me la pynïoh da ka jingkit bad jingstad jongno me .
translation.en: Behold , therefore I will bring strangers upon thee , the terrible of the nations : and they shall draw their swords against the beauty of thy wisdom , and they shall defile thy brightness .

translation.kha: Te ka ri kan ïoh lehse ha ki snem ka jingshongthait kaba pura ha kaba phin ym ai ei ei ïa ka ; kan long kaba la iehnoh bad tud ïoh shongthait , katba phi dang kein ha ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki nongshun jong phiah .
translation.en: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest  ; because it did not rest in your sabbaths , when ye dwelt upon it .

translation.kha: Ka long bieit ban rkhiebeiñ ïa kiwei . Lada phi longsyiem uba sngewthuh , pher shu Sngap jar jar .
translation.en: He that is void of wisdom despiseth his neighbour : but a man of understanding holdeth his peace .
And shed innocent blood , even the blood of their sons and of their daughters , whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan : and the land was polluted with blood .
translation.kha: Ki la pynïap ïa kito ki khun balui lui , bad ïa ka ri la pynjyrsieh da kita ki jingpynïap briew .
Nangta u Joseph u wan ïam ïa u Jakob u kpa jong u bad u pynithuh ïa u ha u syiem . U Joab u kyrkhoit kyrdoh ïa u syiem ,
translation.en: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father , and set him before Pharaoh : and Jacob blessed Pharaoh .
There go the ships : there is that leviathan , whom thou hast made to play therein .
translation.kha: Ki liengbah ki ïaid halor jong ka , bad ha ka u Lebiathan u lehkai , u mrad kynsha ka duriaw uba me la thaw .

translation.en: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand , because they dealt faithfully .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba peit halor ka kam ki long kiba da khuid hok , te kim donkam ban hap ai jingkheiñ ïa ka jingmih .
Te phin sa Nakon hajan ka ri ki Ahiman , ki khun ki ksiar jong u Lot . Wat pynjynjar ïa ki lane ïaleh thma bad ki , namar ngan ym ai ei ei ïa phira na kata ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha ki .’
translation.en: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon , distress them not , nor meddle with them : for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession  ; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession .

Therefore the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he sold them into the hand of Chushan–rishathaim king of Mesopotamia : and the children of Israel served Chushan–rishathaim eight years .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la bitar lep ïa ki Israel bad u shah ïa u Kushan Rishathaim u syiem ka Mesopotamia ban jop ïa ki . Bad u synshar halor jong ki haduh phra snem .

Bad kumta U Trai u tip kumno ban pyllait im ïa ki briew kiba riewblei na ki jingtynjuh jong ki Bad kumno ban pynhap ïa ki bymman ha ka jingpynshitom ha ka Sngi ka Jingbishar , khamtam ïa kito kiba beh ïa ki jingkwah brai jakhlia jong ka sien bad ibha ñiewbeiñ ïa ka bor synshar jong U Blei .
translation.en: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations , and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished :

translation.kha: Ki pha ïa por ïa kajuh ka khublei saw sien , bad ha man la ki sien , nga phah ïa kijuh ki jubab .
translation.en: Yet they sent unto me four times after this sort  ; and I answered them after the same manner .

translation.kha: Ïaineh skhem ha U Trai .
translation.en: Thou shalt be perfect with the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Babha uta u briew u ïuh ba um la jop ïa u Jakob , u kura ïa u na ka skhep ; bad kata ka skhep jong u ka la lait .
translation.en: And when he saw that he prevailed not against him , he touched the hollow of his thigh  ; and the hollow of Jacob s thigh was out of joint , as he wrestled with him .

translation.kha: Hangta u la ïakynduh ïa u Jiw uba kyrteng u Akwila , ïa uba la khap ha Pontos , uba dang shu ïan shen na Italy laiñ malu ka Priskila ka tnga jong u , naba u Patsha Klaudius u la lah hukum ïa ki Jiw baroh ban mihnoh na Rom .
translation.en: And found a certain Jew named Aquila , born in Pontus , lately come from Italy , with his wife Priscilla  ; ( because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome : ) and came unto them .

translation.kha: La ong ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa u briew u nongsynshar halor kiei kiei baroh ; kane ka jaw shai ba ka kynthup ïa kiei kiei baroh . Pynban , ngim patiaw ïohi ba u bynriew un synshar halor kiei kiei baïar mynta .
translation.en: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet . For in that he put all in subjection under him , he left nothing that is not put under him . But now we see not yet all things put under him .

translation.kha: Nahath Ngan ong ha ki , ‘ Ngam ju la ithuh ïa phi . Khie leit noh na nga , phi ki briew bymman !’
translation.en: And then will I profess unto them , I never knew you : depart from me , ye that work iniquity .

translation.kha: U Hanani , uwei na kiba shi para mala nga , u wan peh na Judah ryngkat bad ka kynoi jong kiwei pat ki rangbah , bad nga kylli ïa ki shaphang ka Jerusalem bad shaphang ki para Jiw jongu ngi kiba la leit phai na ka jingshah rmiang ha Babilon .
translation.en: That Hanani , one of my brethren , came , he and certain men of Judah  ; and I asked them concerning the Jews that had escaped , which were left of the captivity , and concerning Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ym u briew bhor uba khot ïa nga , ‘ A Trai , A TRAI’ u ban ïongreiñ shapoh Ka Hoham ki bneng , hynrei tang kito kiba leh ïa kai katba U kpa jong nga kiba ha bneng u kwah ïa ki ïa-ban leh .
translation.en: Not every one that saith unto me , Lord , Lord , shall enter into the kingdom of heaven  ; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven .

translation.kha: Haba ïa ka jingpynbna jyllang phi la pynphriang sha pylleng sawdong jong khie ka hima baïar , kawei pa katai ka kynthei Kan ai ha ki tnga jong ki ïa ka burom ba dei , la u riewspah ne duk .
translation.en: And when the king s decree which he shall make shall be published throughout all his empire , ( for it is great , ) all the wives shall give to their husbands honour , both to great and small .

translation.kha: Kumta to mihnoh ïa u briew barim jyllang phiah , uba pynlong ïa phi ban im kumba phi la ju im — u briew uba rim umbah la nang pynjot da ki jingkwah brai bashukor jong ka .
translation.en: That ye put off concerning the former conversation the old man , which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts ;
And the  Lord  said unto me , A conspiracy is found among the men of Judah , and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ki briew jong ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem ki la ïathmu sniew pyrshah ïa nga .
Nga la pynithuh ïa me ha ki , bad lang ïai leh kumta , khnang ba ka jingieit katba me don ïa nga kuna ïoh long bad ki , bad kumin nga hati ngan ioh longsem bad ki .
translation.en: And I have declared unto them thy name , and will declare it : that the love wherewith thou hast loved me may be in them , and I in them .
Hear this , I pray you , ye heads of the house of Jacob , and princes of the house of Israel , that abhor judgment , and pervert all equity .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki nongsynshar ki Israel , phi kiba isih ïa ka jingbishar hok bad pynkylla ïa kaba dei sha kaba bakla .

translation.en: For her blood is in the midst of her  ; she set it upon the top of a rock  ; she poured it not upon the ground , to cover it with dust  ;
translation.kha: Ka la don ka jingpynïap briew ha ka nongbah , hynrei ka snam kam shym pashait ha ka khyndew ha kaba ka khyndew kam lah ban buhrieh ïa ka ; ka la pashait ha u mawsiang basyllen .
Nangta u la phah ïa u mraw uba lai ; ki nongmudui ki la pynïashong ïa u ruh , bad ki la bret ïa u baher .
translation.en: And again he sent a third : and they wounded him also , and cast him out .

translation.kha: Nga pynjot ïa ka Babilon bad nga pynsngap lade ïa ka . Ki kynhun shipai ki tur shapoh kum ki jingat phyllung bakyrhuh bad tur ïaleh da ki jingpyrta bajan .
translation.en: Because the  Lord  hath spoiled Babylon , and destroyed out of her the great voice  ; when her waves do roar like great waters , a noise of their voice is uttered :

translation.kha: Ka la imat ïa kano bun sngi , haduh ba u Saul u la sngew salia eh ba u la phah sawdong bad u la ong ha uta u mynsiem bymman , Ha ka kyrteng jong U Josis Khrist nga praw ïa me ban mihnoh na ka ! Uta u mynjur bymman u la mihnoh na ka ha kata hi ka khyllipmat .
translation.en: And this did she many days . But Paul , being grieved , turned and said to the spirit , I command thee in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her . And he came out the same hour .

translation.kha: U Tharai u kwah ba ki tarajur badno ki mawthew ki dei ban long kiba ngeit mala Baroh ka jingdiah ïadoh kan long ka hok .
translation.en: A just weight and balance are the  Lord s  : all the weights of the bag are his work .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngam shem ba u la leh kawei katei kaba u dei ngab shah rai pynïap . Bad nongmareh ba ma u hi u la lah apil sha u Patsha , nga la rai ban phah ïa u sha u .
translation.en: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death , and that he himself hath appealed to Augustus , I have determined to send him .
And , behold , there was a man named Zacchaeus , which was the chief among the publicans , and he was rich .
translation.kha: La don hangta u nonglum khajna uba ha khlieh duh uba kyrteng , u Sakhaïos , uba riewspah .

translation.en: He casteth forth his ice like morsels : who can stand before his cold ?
translation.kha: U phah ïa u phria kum u mawria ; ym don uba lah ban shah ïa ka jingkhriat ba u phah !

translation.en: She considereth a field , and buyeth it : with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard .
translation.kha: Ka peit bniah ïa ka lyngkha bad ka thied ïa ka , bad da ka kamai ba ka ïoh ka thung ki dieng sohwaiñ ha ka brisoh .

translation.en: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  Asaph and his brethren , to minister before the ark continually , as every day s work required :
translation.kha: U syiem Dabid u buh pynskhem ïa u Asaph bad ïa ki para Lebi ha ka kam kaba ïadei bad ka jingmane ba pynlong ha ka jaka ba la buh ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang . La buh ïa ki ban pyndep ïa ki kamram jong ki hangta man ka sngi .
U Makhir u pynïoh kawei ka tnga ïa u Huppim bad kawei pat ïa u Shuppim . Ka para jong u ka kyrteng ka Maakah . U khun uba ar lad u mirr u Dei u Selophehad , bad u don tang ki khun kyntiew .
translation.en: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim , whose sister s name was Maachah  ; ) and the name of the second was Zelophehad : and Zelophehad had daughters .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u Mushi , Ong ïa u Aaron ban shoh ïa ka khyndew da u diengduh , ba u pui pyut ha ka ri Ijipt baïar kawei un kylla mait .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Stretch out thy rod , and smite the dust of the land , that it may become lice throughout all the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Lydda kane ka long kumno ba nga beh noh ïa ki , da kumno ki nongbud jong phi ki beh noh ïa ki ? Ki nongbud jong phi hi ki pynshisha ba phiah bakla !
translation.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils , by whom do your sons cast them out ? therefore shall they be your judges .

I will get me unto the great men , and will speak unto them  ; for they have known the way of the  Lord  , and the judgment of their God : but these have altogether broken the yoke , and burst the bonds .
translation.kha: Ngan leit sha ki briew kiba ha ka bor ; bad ïakren bad ki . Da shisha ki tip kaei ba U Blei u dawa , kaei ba U  Trai  u kwah ïa ki ban leh .  Hynrei ki baroh ki la kyntait ïa ka iktiar jong U  Trai bad ki kyntait ban kohnguh ïa u .
Shim ïa kane ka kitab ka Aiñ U Blei malade buh ïa ka ha syndah ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai U Blei jong phi , ba kuna don hangtai kum ka sakhi ïa-pyrshah ïa ki briew jong u .
translation.en: Take this book of the law , and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  your God , that it may be there for a witness against thee .

translation.kha: Nga baïaineh ïa kito Kiba la ïap bad kiba la leit noh ; ki un-long kiba kham bha ban ïa kito kiba dang im .
translation.en: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive .

translation.kha: U Jakob u la wait ha shuwa jong ki , u da nguh ngon ïathuh khynraw hynñiew sien katba u nang sien sha jlan u hynmen jong u .
translation.en: And he passed over before them , and bowed himself to the ground seven times , until he came near to his brother .

translation.kha: Ki shipawa Philistia ki mih baneh leit ïabeh ha ki lai kynhun na ka jaka sher dara jong ki : kawei ka kynhun ka saw sanphew Sipporah ha ka ri Shual ,
translation.en: And the spoilers came out of the camp of the Philistines in three companies : one company turned unto the way that leadeth to Ophrah , unto the land of Shual :

translation.kha: Sa shisien la ka punkhun biang bad ka khaïi sa uwei u khun shynrang . Ka ong , Myntan u tnum jong nga un sa kham jan sha nga , nongmareh nga la kha lah ngut ki khun shynrang ïa u ; kumta ka la khot kyr-ang ïa u , u Lebi .
translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son  ; and said , Now this time will my husband be joined unto me , because I have born him three sons : therefore was his name called Levi .

translation.kha: mawshun phi la long kiba ïap ha ka jinglong mynsiem nongmareh ka jingbymkohnguh bad ki pop jong phi .
translation.en: And you hath he quickened , who were dead in trespasses and sins ;

translation.kha: Ka shong ha ka jingkhang jong ka ïing jong ka lane ha ki jaka shongsah kiba jrong kam ha ka shnong ,
translation.en: For she sitteth at the door of her house , on a seat in the high places of the city ,

translation.kha: Ka jingsleh ka la neh baroh shi sngew . U Abimelekh u kurup ïa ka nongbah , u pynïap ïa ki briew jongu ka , u pynkhyllem ïa ka , bad u Tap ïa ka mawdong da ka nguh .
translation.en: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day  ; and he took the city , and slew the people that was therein , and beat down the city , and sowed it with salt .

And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death , and dwelt in a several house , being a leper  ; for he was cut off from the house of the  Lord  : and Jotham his son was over the king s house , judging the people of the land .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingim ba dang sah jong u syiem Ussaïah , u la long u bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam namar ka jingpang jong u . Namar ba um lah shuh ban rung sha ka Templ u shong u sah ha la ka ïing , khlem da leh shuh ïa la ki kamram , katba u Jotham u khun jong u , u synshar ïa ka ri .
Susah haba Phin pan , phim ïoh ïa ka , namar ki jingthmu jong phoi ki long kiba sniew ; phi pan ïa kiei kiei ban pyndonkam na ka bynta ki jingsngewbiang jong phi hi .
translation.en: Ye ask , and receive not , because ye ask amiss , that ye may consume it upon your lusts .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u lapbah pynïaidkam , Khie leit noh sha ïing , bad ïa kaei kaba me ngeit yn sa leh na ka bynta me . Bad ïa u shakri jong u rangbah pynïaid la pynkha ha kata hi ka khyllipmat .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto the centurion ,  Go thy way  ; and as thou hast believed , so be it done unto thee .  And his servant was healed in the selfsame hour .

translation.kha: Haba u Salmon u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba u Shimei u la leh ,
translation.en: And it was told Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath , and was come again .

translation.kha: Wat leh ei ei na ka jingkhwan myntoi lane na ka jingkwah bymmyntoi ban sngewsarong , hynrei , to long kiba sngewrit iwei ïa iwei bapaw , katba ñiew borabor ïa kiwei kiba kham bha ban ïa lade .
translation.en: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory ; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves .

translation.kha: Ka jingklim bunsien ka pynjot ia ka longing longsem . —Proberb 6 :27-29 , 32 .
translation.en: ( Proverbs 6 :27-29 , 32 ) Wisely , therefore , the Bible urges : “Be happy with your wife and find your joy with the girl you married . . .

translation.kha: Ki lehbeiñ ki la pynpoi jai ïa u paidbah bad ong ha ki ban ym sngewbang ha kum kata ka snieh kaba khuid .
translation.en: So the Levites stilled all the people , saying , Hold your peace , for the day is holy  ; neither be ye grieved .

Then went this saying abroad among the brethren , that that disciple should not die : yet Jesus said not unto him , He shall not die  ; but ,  If I will that he tarry till I come , what is that to thee ?
translation.kha: Kumta ka khubor ka la pur hapdeng ki nongbud jong U Jisu ba une u synran un ym ïap . Hynrei U Jisu um shym ong ba un ym ïap ; u la ong ,  Lada nga mon ïa u ba un im tad ynda nga wan , ka pher aïu ïa me ?
La katta duh , lada shah ïa uta u trai baneh siew da ka kuna , ban pyllait im ïa u , u dei banbeiñ siew dep ïa ka dor kabu dei ban siew .
translation.en: If there be laid on him a sum of money , then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him .

translation.kha: Bad ha ka sngi Kaba arphew hynriew jong u bnai babha ar , ka khyndew ka la rkhiang nadong shadong .
translation.en: And in the second month , on the seven and twentieth day of the month , was the earth dried .

When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing , but that rather a tumult was made , he took water , and washed his hands before the multitude , saying , I am innocent of the blood of this just person : see ye to it .
translation.kha: Haba u Pilat u la ïohi ba kam donkam ban pynjlan , hynrei ba kan pynmih pynban ka jingkhynwin , u la shim khyndiat ka um , u la thet ïa la ki kti ha khmat u paidbah , bad u la ong ,  Ngam don jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jong une u briew ! Kane ka dei ka jingleh jong phi !

Kumta u Joseph u leit ïalam san ngut na ki hynmen jong u sha u syiem . U ong , I pa bad ki hynmen ki para jong nga ki la wiang na ka ri Kanaan ryngkat bad ki kynhun langbrot malu ki jingroi jingdup jong ki , bad baroh ruh kat kiba ki don . Mynta ki don ha Goshen .
translation.en: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh , and said , My father and my brethren , and their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have , are come out of the land of Canaan  ; and , behold , they are in the land of Goshen .

translation.kha: Bad kumta nga kyrpad ïa phi , ko Kynthei badonburom : To ai ba baroh ngim ïa-ieit iwei ïa iwei patar . Kane kdew longsem ka hukum kaba thymmai katba la theh sha phin ; ka long ka hukum kaba ngi la ba-don naduh mynnyngkong .
translation.en: And now I beseech thee , lady , not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee , but that which we had from the beginning , that we love one another .

translation.kha: Nyngkong , u Moses u la pynthaba ha u paidlang ïa ki hukum baroh kat kum ba la buh ha ka hukum . Nangta u la shim ïa ka snam ki mangi kyrtong bad ki pla , u la khleh ïa ka bad ka um , bun u la synreit ïa ka halor kata ka kitab ka hukum bad halor u bajaipdeh borbah , da kaba pyndonkam ïa u tnat Hissop bad katto katne u saiwul uba leit .
translation.en: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law , he took the blood of calves and of goats , with water , and scarlet wool , and hyssop , and sprinkled both the book , and all the people ,

translation.kha: Uwei u briew uba ki kjat bad ki kti jongnga u ki la sawphew u la woh sha U Jisu ,
translation.en: And , behold , there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy .

translation.kha: To ai ki jingainguh ïa U Troas ha ki duitara , to ïa-rai ha u da ki jingteinam ksai .
translation.en: Praise the  Lord  with harp : sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings .

translation.kha: Ka mar ka la sah sad ka Elisabeth kumba lai bnai bad nangto ka la leit pat sha ïing .
translation.en: And Mary abode with her about three months , and returned to her own house .

translation.kha: U Trai u phah ïa ki kynha kieng atiar jong ka Babilonia , ka Syria , ka Moab , bad ka Ammon ïa-pyrshah ïa u Jehoïakim ban pynjot ïa ka Judah , kumba U Trai u la ong lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki shakri jong u ba un leh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  sent against him bands of the Chaldeans , and bands of the Syrians , and bands of the Moabites , and bands of the children of Ammon , and sent them against Judah to destroy it , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by his servants the prophets .
And as it was in the days of Noah , so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man .
translation.kha: Kumba ka la long ha ka por jong u Noah kumta kan long ha ki sngi jong U Khun U Briew .
hynñiew hadien ba nga la shimet noh ïa ki , ngan don jingisynei hajir jong ki ; ngan wallam patan ïa kaei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew sha ka ri jongnga ka bad sha ka shnong jong ka .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , after that I have plucked them out I will return , and have compassion on them , and will bring them again , every man to his heritage , and every man to his land .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong na kita ki sngi , phin ïalumlang ban mane Blei’ , phim dei pun leh ïa kano kane ka kam kaba phi ju trei man la ka sngi .
translation.en: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , u pyllew u la oh ka jingpynkhiah ha kaba u la ieh ïa u nongthain Makedonia uba ïeng bad kyrpad ïa u , Ale shane sha Makedonia bad ïarap ïa i !
translation.en: And a vision appeared to Paul in the night  ; There stood a man of Macedonia , and prayed him , saying , Come over into Macedonia , and help us .

translation.kha: Katba phi ïalang khmih ïa ka , u maw kiba khraw u la laitim na ka synrang khlem don mano mano ba ktah ïa u , u la shoh ïa ka kjat nar bad ïabret jong ka durbriew , bad u la pynkhynñiuh ïa ki .
translation.en: Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands , which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay , and brake them to pieces .

translation.kha: Ïa ki kynïan shipai jongu ki la pynap da ka waitlam kaba mihnoh na ka shyntur jong uta uba la shong halor u kulai ; bad ki sim baroh ki la bam baroh kat kaba ki lai na ka doh jong ki .
translation.en: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse , which sword proceeded out of his mouth : and all the fowls were filled with their flesh .
Let them praise his name in the dance : let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp .
translation.kha: To ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng jong u da ka jingshad ; to tem ki ksing bad ki duitara ha ka jingïaroh ïa u .

translation.en: God is jealous , and the  Lord  revengeth  ; the  Lord  revengeth , and is furious  ; the  Lord  will take vengeance on his adversaries , and he reserveth wrath for his enemies .
translation.kha: U  Trai  U Blei um lah shah ïa kino kino ki nongïaleh pyrshah ; u pynshitom ïa kito kiba ïeng pyrshah ïa u . Ha ka jingbitar jong u , u siew kylliang ïa ki .
Katto film thup ba ki briew U Blei kin sa bishar ïa ka pyrthei ? Te , namarkata , lada phi long ki ban bishar ïa ka pyrthei , hato ‘Phim long kiba lah ban bishar ïa kiei kiei kiba rit ?
translation.en: Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world ? and if the world shall be judged by you , are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters ?

translation.kha: Ko ki pyntud Judah , wat ïasam na ka bynta u shem Josaïah , wat ïam pynkad ïa ka jingïap jong u . Hynrei ïakohnguh na ka bynta u Joahas , u khwan jong u ; ki la phah neh ïa u bad un ym wan phai shuh , un ym ïohi shuh ïa ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa u .
translation.en: Weep ye not for the dead , neither bemoan him : but weep sore for him that goeth away : for he shall return no more , nor see his native country .

translation.kha: Ki nongsharai bajlan kiba twa bha kum ki nongïalam ki dei hok ban jingpdiang ar shah ïa ka jingsiew , khamtam tun kiba ba-thurmur jur ha ka jingïalap bad jinghikai .
translation.en: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour , especially they who labour in the word and doctrine .

translation.kha: U don u briew ha ka hima jong phi uba don ïa u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid Hapoh jong u . Mynta u kpa jong phi u hir sahmiet , une u briew u la pyn-i ka jingmut kaba bol , ka jingtip , bad ka jingstad kum ka jingstad jong ki blei . Bad u syiem Nebukhadnessar , u kpa jong phi , u la pynlong ïa u , u khlieh duh jong ki nongbatai kupar , ki nongleh myntor , ki nongleh byrtong , bad ki nongtei kti .
translation.en: There is a man in thy kingdom , in whom is the spirit of the holy gods  ; and in the days of thy father light and understanding and wisdom , like the wisdom of the gods , was found in him  ; whom the king Nebuchadnezzar thy father , the king , I say , thy father , made master of the magicians , astrologers , Chaldeans , and soothsayers  ;

translation.kha: phin Lah ban lait im ïada phi ong bad Phi leh ïa kaba dei . Wat pyndonkam ïa ka kuna lad phi ban shukor ïa kiba hep bad wat pdiang ïa ka peiñ bashukor . Wat ïaskhem bad kito kiba thmu ban pynïap briew lane ban lai ïa kiwei ki ki sniew .
translation.en: He that walketh righteously , and speaketh uprightly  ; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions , that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes , that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood , and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil  ;

translation.kha: Hobab shisien mynshuwa sa la ïohsngew ïa ki sur bakmen , mynta nga ïohsngew tang ka jingïambriew bad ka jingdam .
translation.en: My harp also is turned to mourning , and my organ into the voice of them that weep .
For I have not sent them , saith the  Lord  , yet they prophesy a lie in my name  ; that I might drive you out , and that ye might perish , ye , and the prophets that prophesy unto you .
translation.kha: U  Trai  hi u la ong ba um shym phah ïa ki bad ba ki lamler ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong u . Bad kumta un beh noh ïa phi , bad ïa phi yn pynïap , ïa phi bad ki nongïathuhlypa kiba ïathuh ïa phi ïa kine ki jinglamler .

Ka la leit phai patan sha u Elisha , u nongïathuhlypa , uba la ïong ïa ka , Die ïa ka umphniang Olib bad sleit dep ïa ki ram jongngi phi barben , ban yn don bun ka tyngka Kaba tam na ka bynta jong pa’ bad ki khun shynrang jong phi ban im .
translation.en: Then she came and told the man of God . And he said , Go , sell the oil , and pay thy debt , and live thou and thy children of the rest .

translation.kha: Ym don dieng khiar ha ka kpieng U Blei suba lah ban ïanujor bad u , ym don dieng Kseh uba la ju don kum kita ki tngit , bad ym don u dieng ha madan uba don kum kita ki tnat , ym ba-don u dieng ha ka kpieng jong U blang uba lyntait katta Katta .
translation.en: The cedars in the garden of God could not hide him : the fir trees were not like his boughs , and the chesnut trees were not like his branches  ; nor any tree in the garden of God was like unto him in his beauty .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ai ïa kane ka jubor : To thoh shai ha ki lyngkniap dewbyrtha ïa kaei ba ngan pynpaw ha me , khnang ba haka ban pule mar syn peitbeiñ .
translation.en: And the  Lord  answered me , and said , Write the vision , and make it plain upon tables , that he may run that readeth it .

translation.kha: Phi la jam ïa ka Judah bad wan poi sha ka Jerikho . Ki nongbah ka Jerikho ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi , kumba la leh ki Amor , ki Peris , ki Kanaan , ki slap , ki Girgash , ki Hib bad ki Jebus . hynriew nga la ai ha phi ka jingjot halor jong ki baroh .
translation.en: And ye went over Jordan , and came unto Jericho : and the men of Jericho fought against you , the Amorites , and the Perizzites , and the Canaanites , and the Hittites , and the Girgashites , the Hivites , and the Jebusites  ; and I delivered them into your hand .

translation.kha: u la ai ïa ki ha u Israel , u Shakri jong u ; ka jingtei jong u ka neh bymmyntoi .
translation.en: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: A Trai , ym don uno uno uba kum ma me ; me long suba khrawbor , dara ka Kyrteng jong me ka long kaban khraw nabar kaba donbok .
translation.en: Forasmuch as there is none like unto thee , O  Lord   ; thou art great , and thy name is great in might .

And it shall come to pass in that day , that I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel , the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea : and it shall stop the noses of the passengers : and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude : and they shall call it The valley of Hamon–gog .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Haba kane baroh ka jia , ngan ai ïa u Gog ka jaka tep hangta ha Israel , ha ka them ki nongleit jingleit , shaphang mihngi ka Duriaw Baïap ; hangta yn tep ïa u Gog bad ka kynhun shipai jong u , bad ïa ka them yn khot ïa ka , ‘ Ka them ka kynhun shipai u Gog .’
ngiam slem shuh don im ; ka jingkyrmen jong de ha U Trai ka la duh .
translation.en: And I said , My strength and my hope is perished from the  Lord  :

translation.kha: To pyllait ïa nga na ki jingibeiñ kiba la sheptieng ; A katno naba phylliew long ki jingbishar lad me !
translation.en: Turn away my reproach which I fear : for thy judgments are good .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki briew jyllang ka Judas kim shym khlong ïa U Trai bad u Mahseïah u la ïalam ïa ki ban lai wat ïa ki pop kiba khah khraw ban ïa kito kiba la leh ïa ki jaitbynriew kaba U Trai u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki briew jong u ki tur shaphrang .
translation.en: But they hearkened not : and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom the  Lord  destroyed before the children of Israel .

We encourage you to keep on taking in knowledge of God , to tell the rest of your family and friends about what you are learning , and to associate regularly with us at our Christian meetings . —Hebrews 10 :23-25 .
translation.kha: Ngi pynshlur ïa phi ba phin ïai bteng ban pule shaphang U Blei , ban ïathuh ïa la ki bahaïing hasem bad ki paralok jong phi shaphang kiei kiba phi pule bad ban ïasyllok bad ngi khlem da pud ha ki jingïalang Khristan jong ngi . —Hebru 10 :23-25 .
Bad u Kain u ainong ha U Trai , Kane ka jingpynshitom ka long palat ïa katba nga lah ban shad .
translation.en: And Cain said unto the  Lord  , My punishment is greater than I can bear .

translation.kha: Iddo haba la dep pynbaptis ïa ki briew baroh , la pynbaptis hati ïa u Jisu . Kaba U dang dulir , la plie ïa ka bneng ,
translation.en: Now when all the people were baptized , it came to pass , that Jesus also being baptized , and praying , the heaven was opened ,

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la ïa-ong ha ki , Dei ma nga uta , ki la kynriah shadien bad ki la kyllon ha madan .
translation.en: As soon then as he had said unto them ,  I am he ,  they went backward , and fell to the ground .

translation.kha: Don kiei kiei uba U Trai U Blei jong ine u tdong buhrieh na ka jingtip u biria ; hynmen u la pynpaw ïa ka Aiñ jong u , bad ma ngi lem bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ngi , Ngi dei Ban kohnguh ïa ka junom .
translation.en: The secret things belong unto the  Lord  our God : but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever , that we may do all the words of this law .

translation.kha: To kiar noh na kito kiba leh ïa kiei khie kiba sngew , na kita ki ksew , kita ki briew uba pynbor ïa ka ban ot ïa ka met .
translation.en: Beware of dogs , beware of evil workers , beware of the concision .
