translation.kha: Kumta u Uriah u thaw ïa ka kito thir kum kata , mala u pyndep ïa ka Shuah ba u Aïah un wan phai .
translation.en: And Uriah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus : so Uriah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus .
And also Solomon sitteth on the throne of the kingdom .
translation.kha: U Solomon mynta u long u syiem .

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , thy redeemer , and he that formed thee from the womb , I am the  Lord  that maketh all things  ; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone  ; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself  ;
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  , u Nongpynim jong phi ; nga long uta uba la thaw ïa phi . Nga long U  Trai  , u Nongthaw ïa baroh kiei kiei . Nga marwei hi nga pynpyiar ïa ki bneng ; haba nga thaw ïa ka pyrthei , ym don u ban ïarap ïa nga .

translation.en: But hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel , and hast made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring , like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab , and also hast slain thy brethren of thy father s house , which were better than thyself :
translation.kha: Pynban me la bud ïa ka jingleh jong ki syiem ka Israel bad me la ïalam ïa ki briew ka Judah bad Jerusalem sha ka jinglong bymïaineh shuh ha U Blei , kumba u Ahab bad ki nongmih bujli jong u ki la ïalam ïa ki Israel sha ka jingbymïaineh . Me la pynïap wat ïa la ki para shynrang , kiba long ki rangbah kiba kham bha ban ïa kaba me long .
U rangbah synshar bahakhlieh duh u la ai kyrteng thymmai ïa ki : u Sheshbassar , u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego .
translation.en: Unto whom the prince of the eunuchs gave names : for he gave unto Daniel the name of Belteshazzar  ; and to Hananiah , of Shadrach  ; and to Mishael , of Meshach  ; and to Azariah , of Abed–nego .
Then came he out of the land of the Chaldeans , and dwelt in Charran : and from thence , when his father was dead , he removed him into this land , wherein ye now dwell .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u la iehnoh ïa la ka ri bad u la leit ban shong ban sah ha Haran . Hadien ba u kpa jong u Abraham u la ïap , U Blei u la pynlong ïa u ban kynriah sha kane ka jaka ha kaba phi mynta phi shong phi sah .
Ka don ka jingkyrmen na ka bynta ka lawei jongngi phi ; ki khun jongki phi ktang wan phai paw sha la ka ri . Ma nga , U Trai , sa la krai .
translation.en: And there is hope in thine end , saith the  Lord  , that thy children shall come again to their own border .

translation.kha: U Moses u leh ïa kata baroh kumba U Trai u la sah” ïa u .
translation.en: Thus did Moses : according to all that the  Lord  commanded him , so did he .

translation.kha: mane ban ïalam ïa ka jingtur ïaleh ? u Ahab u kylli . U nongïathuhlypa u la jingbabe , U Trai u ong ba ki shipai samla hapoh ka hukum jong ki lat jong ki distrik kin leh ïa “kata . Mano ban ai hukum ïa ka kynhun ka kongsan ? u syiem u kyllan . Ma me , u nongïathuhlypa u la jubab .
translation.en: And Ahab said , By whom ? And he said , Thus saith the  Lord  , Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces . Then he said , Who shall order the battle ? And he answered , Thou .
And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times , and shall pronounce him clean , and shall let the living bird loose into the open field .
translation.kha: Un synreit ruh hynñiew sien ïa kata ka snam ha ka met uta u briew ïa uba yn dang pynkhuid na ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad hadien kata un sa pynbna ba u long uba khuid . Un pyllait noh ïa kata ka sim kaba dang im ba kan her kat shaba ka mon .
Phim dei don leit rah ïa la ki jingainguh kat shaba pa’ ibit ;
translation.en: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest :

translation.kha: Kane ka la jia lai sien , bad khatduh ïa kata baroh kawei la tun pat sha bneng .
translation.en: And this was done three times : and all were drawn up again into heaven .

translation.kha: Ha man ba ki kynhun langbrot baher ki la ïapoi lang hangta , ki nongkhap langbrot ki ju pyntyllun sharud ïa uta u maw Bad ki ai um ïa ki . Nahath ki buh pang ïa uta u maw ha kajuh ka khak .
translation.en: And thither were all the flocks gathered : and they rolled the stone from the well s mouth , and watered the sheep , and put the stone again upon the well s mouth in his place .
Doth a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter ?
translation.kha: Ym don ka umpohliew kaba pynmih ïa ka um kaba thiang bad ïa ka um kaba kthang na kajuh ka tyllong .
Pynban de ma nga uba shithi ïa ki Jeraïah ban ïadie . Ang la rah ïa ki briew jong nga ha la ki ksang ti , hynrei ktieh shym la pdiang ba nga la sumar ïa ki .
translation.en: I taught Ephraim also to go , taking them by their arms  ; but they knew not that I healed them .

translation.kha: Da kum u samla un lah ban sumar khuid ïa la ka jingim ? Da kaba Kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .
translation.en: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way ? by taking heed thereto according to thy word .
Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria , and preached Christ unto them .
translation.kha: U Philip u la leit sha ka nongbah ha Samaria bad u la ïalap ïa U Messaïah ha ki briew hangta .

Hynrei u ong shuh shuh , Shah ngan pan tang kawei na phi . Uwei pa eiei na phi un ai noh ha nga ïa ki khashor ba phi la shym . ( Ki Midian kum kiwei pat ki jingbhabriew ka ri shyiap , ki deng ki sohshkor ksiar . )
translation.en: And Gideon said unto them , I would desire a request of you , that ye would give me every man the earrings of his prey . ( For they had golden earrings , because they were Ishmaelites . )

translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka sngi , u Hahiroth bad u Pilat ki la ïalong paralok ; ha shuwa jong kane , ki la ïalong ki nongshun .
translation.en: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together : for before they were at enmity between themselves .

translation.kha: Ka Seïon ka la siew na ka bynta ka pop jong ka ; U Trai un ym buh shuh ïa ngi ha ka jingshah ringmraw . Hynrei ko Edom , U Tiras un pynshitom ïa pha ; un pynpaw ïa ki kam bymman jong pha .
translation.en: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished , O daughter of Zion  ; he will no more carry thee away into captivity : he will visit thine iniquity , O daughter of Edom  ; he will discover thy sins .

Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel , and Joshua the son of Jehozadak , the high priest , with all the remnant of the people , obeyed the voice of the  Lord  their God , and the words of Haggai the prophet , as the  Lord  their God had sent him , and the people did fear before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te u Serubbabel bad u Joshua bad ki briew baroh kiba la wan phai na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilonia , ki la leh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong ki u la ong ïa ki ban leh . Ki la sheptieng bad ki la kohnguh ïa u Haggai u nongïathuhlypa , u nonglamktien jong U  Trai .
Hynrei u Akhbor u jubab , Haba phi ong ïa nga ha ka kyrteng U Trai , ong ïa ka jingshisha ! Katno rupa ba nga hap ban ong ha phi ïa kata ?
translation.en: And the king said to him , How many times shall I adjure thee that thou say nothing but the truth to me in the name of the  Lord  ?
And the man departed out of the city from Beth–lehem–judah to sojourn where he could find a place : and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah , as he journeyed .
translation.kha: U mihnoh na Bethlehem ban leit wad jaka shong shawei . Katba u dang don ha ka jingleit kumta , u wan poi ha ka ïing u Mikah kaba ha ri lum Ephraim .

translation.en: Hear attentively the noise of his voice , and the sound that goeth out of his mouth .
translation.kha: To shahshkor , ma phi baroh , ïa ka sur ka jong U Blei , ïa u pyrthat uba mih na ka shyntur jong u .

translation.en: There were once a King and a Queen , and they had a son called Sigurd , who was very strong and active , and good-looking .
translation.kha: Shisien ka por la don u syiem bad ka syiem , bad ki don u khun ba kyrteng u Sigurd uba khlain ba smat , bad ba bhabriew bha .
Ngi la shim ïa ka pisa kabu la buh ha ka thalab bad Ngi la aiti ha ki nongtrei bad ki nongkhmih ba-halor .
translation.en: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the  Lord  , and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers , and to the hand of the workmen .

translation.kha: ha U Blei , uba tang ma u hi U Nongpynim jong ngi , da U Jisu Kherith uba U Trai jong ngi , to long ka burom , ka jingkhraw bor , ka jingïalang , Bad ka jingsynshar , na ki rta ba la leit noh baroh , bad mynta , bad sha ki bymjukut bad bymjukut ! Amen .
translation.en: To the only wise God our Saviour , be glory and majesty , dominion and power , both now and ever . Amen .

translation.kha: Nga nguh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : U mraw um long kham khraw ban ïa u kynrad jong u , bad u nonglamler um Long kham khraw ban ïa ita uba la phah ïa u .
translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto you , The servant is not greater than his lord  ; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him .

translation.kha: Kumjuh u Gideon u la leit sha la ïing bad u shet uwei u khunblang bad u la pyndonkam shiphew kilo u purew baneh thwet ïa u kpu khleiñ thiat . U buh ïa ka doh ha ka shang bad ïa ka shrieh hapoh u khiew , u la wallam ïa ki sha u angel jong U Trai ha trai u dieng Sniew , bad u ai ïa ki ha u .
translation.en: And Gideon went in , and made ready a kid , and unleavened cakes of an ephah of flour : the flesh he put in a basket , and he put the broth in a pot , and brought it out unto him under the oak , and presented it .
And when Athaliah heard the noise of the guard and of the people , she came to the people into the temple of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka syiem Athalaïah ka la ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ba mih na ki nongap phira bad u paidbah , kumta ka pynstet ban leit sha ka Templ , ha kaba u paidbah u la ïalumlang .

translation.en: The  Lord  our God be with us , as he was with our fathers : let him not leave us , nor forsake us :
translation.kha: To U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi un don ryngkat bad ngi , kumba u la don ryngkat bad ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ; to un ym iehnoh ïa ngi lane lyndet ïa ngi ;

translation.en: Grace to you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: To ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: And I will come near to you to judgment  ; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers , and against the adulterers , and against false swearers , and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages , the widow , and the fatherless , and that turn aside the stranger from his right , and fear not me , saith the  Lord  of hosts .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Ngan sa paw hapdeng jong phi ban bishar , bad ngan phla shisyndon pyrshah ïa kito kiba leh myntor , pyrshah ïa kiba klim , pyrshah ïa kito kiba sakhi lamler , kito kiba shukor ïa ki nongtrei ïa ki bainong jong ki , bad kito kiba shim kabu ïa ki riewkynthei , ki khunswet , bad ki nongwei — pyrshah ïa kito baroh ki bym ñiewkor ïa nga .

U Sorek u shim ïa ka jingbuh umphniang Eliab kaba u la wanrah na ka Ïing Ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai , mala u la pynslem ïa u Solomon . Ki la mang ïa ka turoi , bun ki paidbah baroh ki pyrta , Im slem Syiem Shalman !
translation.en: And Zadok the priest took an horn of oil out of the tabernacle , and anointed Solomon . And they blew the trumpet  ; and all the people said , God save king Solomon .

translation.kha: U iehnoh na Bethlehem ban ithuh wad tare shong shawei . Katba u dang don ha ka jingleit kumta , u wan pah ha ka ïing u Mikah kaba ha ri lum Ephraim .
translation.en: And the man departed out of the city from Beth–lehem–judah to sojourn where he could find a place : and he came to mount Ephraim to the house of Micah , as he journeyed .

translation.kha: Mynta , ngan law noh ïa ki kynjri na ki ryndang-kti jongki phi bad pyllait noh ïa phi . Lada phiah kwah ban leit sha bajakhlia ryngkat bad nga , phi lah ban leh kumta , bad ngan sumar ïa phi . Hynrei lada phim kwah ban leit , phi haka ban ym leit . Phi don ïa ka ri baroh kawei ban Jedidah , phi lah ban rupa shano shano ba phi kwah .
translation.en: And now , behold , I loose thee this day from the chains which were upon thine hand . If it seem good unto thee to come with me into Babylon , come  ; and I will look well unto thee : but if it seem ill unto thee to come with me into Babylon , forbear : behold , all the land is before thee : whither it seemeth good and convenient for thee to go , thither go .
And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter : so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men .
translation.kha: U Abijah bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki thom ïa ki Israel da ka jingjop kaba khraw — shiteng na ki shipai bakynsai ka Israel ki la shah pynïap .
Khmut ki la ïalum ïa barhem kaweh la kuna bad ki la pyndap khah khat-ar tukri da ki lyngkhuit kiba la sawa tam na ki san tylli ki Kpu barli kiba ki briew’ ki la bam .
translation.en: Therefore they gathered them together , and filled twelve baskets with the fragments of the five barley loaves , which remained over and above unto them that had eaten .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi Tabbath ngi la mih shabar na ka nongbah sha ka rudwah , ha kaba ngi la pyrkhat ba yn don ka jaka ha kaba ki Jiw ki ïalumlang ban ïarwai . Ngi la ïashong bad ïakren Bad ki kynthei kiba la lumlang hangta .
translation.en: And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side , where prayer was wont to be made  ; and we sat down , and spake unto the women which resorted thither .
If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by , let the first hold his peace .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada don uba shong lang ha ka jingïaseng u ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor na U Blei , uta uba kren u dei ban sangeh noh .
Ki la ïasdang ban ïar para ma ki : U jong ïa kane namar ngim don kpu .
translation.en: And they reasoned among themselves , saying , It is because we have no bread .

translation.kha: Nangta , pynsleh ïa u Aaron bad ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad pynkyntang ïa ki kum ki lyngdoh ha ka jingshakri ïa nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons , and consecrate them , that they may minister unto me in the priest s office .

translation.kha: Lada phi ïohthiah ïa ka masi lane ïa ka langbrot u para Jerusalem ba ka sakma , Wat shuki iehnoh ïa ka ; leit ïam pat ïa ka sha u .
translation.en: Thou shalt not see thy brother s ox or his sheep go astray , and hide thyself from them : thou shalt in any case bring them again unto thy brother .

translation.kha: To leh ïa kane baroh ha ka jingduwai , da kaba kyrpad ïa ka jingïarap jong U Blei . Duwai ha ki por baroh , katba U Mynsiem u ïasam . Namarkata kane ka kot , to sharai bun wat kynran dien ; duwai borabor na ka bynta ki briew jong U Blei baroh .
translation.en: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit , and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints ;

translation.kha: ki ai ruh khyndiat ki soh Dumbur tyrkhong , bad ar rynjup ki soh kismis . Ynda u la dep bam , u la ïohbor biang ; naba um shym la bam la dih ei ei la lai sngi pura .

translation.en: It is not good to eat much honey : so for men to search their own glory is not glory .
translation.kha: Kaba bam than ïa ka ngap kam bha ïa phi ; bad kumta ruh ka long kaba pyrshang ban ïoh palat ka jingïaroh .

translation.en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man , whether he rage or laugh , there is no rest .
translation.kha: Haba u briew uba proh jingmut u wanrah ïa ka mokotduma pyrshah ïa uba bieit , uba bieit u shu rkhie bad u hylla bad u tim .
Un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khleiñ jong ka bad un pynïap ïa ka ha ka phang katba shatei jong ka duwan , ha ka jaka ba ki ju pynïap ïa ki mrad na ka bynshet ki jingkñia ainguh thang .
translation.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering , and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering .

translation.kha: Hynrei to long ka jingnguh ïa U Blei , uba ai ha ngi ïa ka jingjop thiah liengbah U Jisu Kherith uba U Troas jong ngi !
translation.en: But thanks be to God , which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ .
Over against the border were the rings , the places for the staves to bear the table .
translation.kha: U buh ïa kita ki kyrwoh hajan ka rmiang ba kin bat ïa ki dieng jingbah haba rah ïa ka .

translation.en: And they bring unto him one that was deaf , and had an impediment in his speech  ; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him .
Only herein will the men consent unto us for to dwell with us , to be one people , if every male among us be circumcised , as they are circumcised .
translation.kha: Hynrei kine ki briew ki kohnguh ban shong ban sah hapdeng jong ngi tang ha ka kyndon ba ngin otsher ïa ki shynrang jong ngi baroh , kumba ki ruh ki la shah otsher .

translation.en: No man hath seen God at any time  ; the only begotten Son , which is in the bosom of the Father , he hath declared him .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ruh uba la ïohi ïa U Blei . U Khun ba marwei jong u , uba long kumjuh kum U Blei bad uba don ha syndah jong U Kpa , u la pynpaw shynna ïa u .
Hapdeng ki briew ha Japheth ki lap sawspah jrut ki theisotti , kumta ki wan ïalam ïa ki shat ka jaka shong dara ha Shiloh , kaba don ha ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: And they found among the inhabitants of Jabesh–gilead four hundred young virgins , that had known no man by lying with any male : and they brought them unto the camp to Shiloh , which is in the land of Canaan .

translation.kha: Hadien ba uwei uwei baroh u la bam kdang , ki la pynsting ïa ka lieng da kaba bret noh ïa u kew baroh sha ka duriaw .
translation.en: And when they had eaten enough , they lightened the ship , and cast out the wheat into the sea .

translation.kha: Nga khmih kumno baroh ki krenbeiñ ïa nga da ka jingkthang .
translation.en: Are there not mockers with me ? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation ?

translation.kha: Hangta u Joseph u mihnoh kynsan nongmareh ka dohnud jong u ka shlei da ka jingsngewieit ïa la u para . Namar ba um lah sa shuh , u wait sha la ka kamra , bad u la ïam .
translation.en: And Joseph made haste  ; for his bowels did yearn upon his brother : and he sought where to weep  ; and he entered into his chamber , and wept there .
And there went a man of the house of Levi , and took to wife a daughter of Levi .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , uwei u briew na ka jait Lebi u shongkurim ïa ka khun jong uwei u Lebi bad ka la kha khun shynrang ïa u .

translation.en: Is there iniquity in Gilead ? surely they are vanity : they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal  ; yea , their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields .

translation.kha: Shah kin dih bad kan klet ïa la ka jingduk , dara ïa ka jingsngewsih .
translation.en: Let him drink , and forget his poverty , and remember his misery no more .

translation.kha: Ki jingpyrkhat jong u briew ki erlangthari kum ka um ha ka pukri kaba jylla , hynrei uba don ka jingïohi jngai u lah ban tong neh ïa ki shabar .
translation.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water  ; but a man of understanding will draw it out .

translation.kha: U khrong u khun jong u Imnah , u Lebi uba long u rangbah ap phira ha ka khyrdep Mihngi lad ka Templ , u long u khlieh ha ka jingpyntieng ïa ki jingai ba ai sha U Trai nabar ha kaba i ïa ki .
translation.en: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite , the porter toward the east , was over the freewill offerings of God , to distribute the oblations of the  Lord  , and the most holy things .

translation.kha: U Aaron u ïathuh ha ki ïa kiei kiei baher kiba U TRAI’ u la kren ha u Moses , bad Nangta u Mushi u leh ïa ki kambah baroh ha khmat ki paidbah .
translation.en: And Aaron spake all the words which the  Lord  had spoken unto Moses , and did the signs in the sight of the people .
And I will cut off the cities of thy land , and throw down all thy strong holds :
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki nongbah ha ka ri jong phi bad pynpra ïa ki jingïada jong phi baroh .

translation.en: And the  Lord  sent Nathan unto David . And he came unto him , and said unto him , There were two men in one city  ; the one rich , and the other poor .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u phah ïa u Nathan , u nongïathuhlypa sha u Dabid . U Nathan u la leit sha u bad u ong ,  Don ar ngut ki rangbah kiba shong ha kajuh ka shnong ; uwei u long uba riewspah , bad uwei pat uba duk .
Nangta u khun shemphang shithi sha Enshemesh bad nangta pat sha Geliloth , marbl ïa ka khim Samsummim . Nangta u hiar bret shwa u Maw jong u Bohan ( u Bohan u dei u khun jong u Reuben ) ,
translation.en: And was drawn from the north , and went forth to En–shemesh , and went forth toward Geliloth , which is over against the going up of Adummim , and descended to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben ,

translation.kha: Hobab u Barnabas malade u Paul ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba kmen sa leh , ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñphong bad ki la mareh sha pdeng u paidbah , da kaba pyrta ,
translation.en: Which when the apostles , Barnabas and Paul , heard of , they rent their clothes , and ran in among the people , crying out ,

translation.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego . Then they brought these men before the king .

translation.kha: Ka kynthup shiteng jong ka Gilead , lem ruh bad ka Ashtaroth bad Edrei , ki nongbah jong ka hima u Og ha Bashan . Ïa kane baroh la ai ha kaba shiteng jong ki longïing kiba hiarpateng na u Makhir u khun jong u Manasseh .

bad ki bariew jong ki , kin ong , Ïa ngi kiew ïa u lum jong U Trai , shad ka Templ jong U Blei ka Israel . Un hikai ïa ngi kawei kambah u khiah ïa ngi ban leh ; ngin ïadih ha ki lynti kiba u la jied . Naba ka jinghikai jong U tharai ka wanpaw na Jerusalem’ ; na Seïon u kren ha ki briew jong u .
translation.en: And many people shall go and say , Come ye , and let us go up to the mountain of the  Lord  , to the house of the God of Jacob  ; and he will teach us of his ways , and we will walk in his paths : for out of Zion shall go forth the law , and the word of the  Lord  from Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba u briew uba kham khlain u tur ïajah ïa u bad jop ïa u , u paki nong ïa baroh ki tiar ïateh kiba u lad u la shaniah bad u ïasam ïa kai kaweh u la lute .
translation.en: But when a stronger than he shall come upon him , and overcome him , he taketh from him all his armour wherein he trusted , and divideth his spoils .

translation.kha: phira Lah banbeiñ sngewskhem ba ka jingngeit ka long kaba bol ïa ka mynsiem . To ïoh ïa ka jingstad bad ka iau jrong phira kuna long kaba phyrnai .
translation.en: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul : when thou hast found it , then there shall be a reward , and thy expectation shall not be cut off .

translation.kha: Bad kumta ma u bad ki Israel baroh ki la rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U Trai shatei sha Jerusalem da ka jingrisa ken bad ka jingpynsawa ïa ki turoi .
translation.en: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the  Lord  with shouting , and with the sound of the trumpet .

translation.kha: Naba ym don uno ine ruh uba hok ha khmat U Blei da kaba leh ïa khie kabu ka law ka dawa ; kaei kaba ka Hukum ka leh ka long don pynlong ïa u briew’ ban tip ba u la leh pop .
translation.en: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight : for by the law is the knowledge of sin .

translation.en: It is better to dwell in the wilderness , than with a contentious and an angry woman .

translation.kha: bad u la ong , To ai ïa kane ka bor ha sa ruh , khnang ba uno Un ha uba de buh ïa la ki ktien un ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
translation.en: Saying , Give me also this power , that on whomsoever I lay hands , he may receive the Holy Ghost .

translation.en: But think on me when it shall be well with thee , and shew kindness , I pray thee , unto me , and make mention of me unto Pharaoh , and bring me out of this house :

translation.kha: Hynriew lada uwei pa uwei u pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei haba u bymngeit ne u riewkhuid u rung hapoh , un ïoh jingkynduh ïa la ki pop da kaei kaba u ïohsngew .
translation.en: But if all prophesy , and there come in one that believeth not , or one unlearned , he is convinced of all , he is judged of all :

translation.en: If the place which the  Lord  thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee , then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock , which the  Lord  hath given thee , as I have commanded thee , and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after .

kumta ba kin shemphang ïa ki jingmut Ibbah rieh kiba don ha ki probins bad ki jingeh ba ki riewstad ki kyllan .
translation.en: To understand a proverb , and the interpretation  ; the words of the wise , and their dark sayings .

translation.en: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely , he was afraid of him .

translation.en: But as they sailed he fell asleep : and there came down a storm of wind on the lake  ; and they were filled with water , and were in jeopardy .

translation.kha: Kut u Joseph u ïap ha jingïaphet hir u la dap shispah shiphew snieh ka rta . Ki kyllan jingñiewbeiñ ïa ka jingsawa jong u , bad hangta ha Ijipt ki buh ïa u ha ka synduk ïapbriew .
translation.en: So Joseph died , being an hundred and ten years old : and they embalmed him , and he was put in a coffin in Egypt .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada ngam sngewthuh ïa ka ktien kaba la kren , u briew uba pyndonkam ïa ka un long u nongwei ha de bun ngan longïing u nongwei ha u .
translation.en: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice , I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian , and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me .

translation.en: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears : we would know therefore what these things mean .

translation.en: And when we came to Rome , the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard : but Paul was suffered to dwell by himself with a soldier that kept him .
And at the end of three years they took it : even in the sixth year of Hezekiah , that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Israel , Samaria was taken .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai jong ka jingshah kerkut , ka Samaria ka kyllon ; kane ka dei ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u Hesekaïah , bad ka snem kaba khyndai jong ka jingsynshar u Hoshea .
Kumta kita shi para ki shim ïa kita ki jingshai sngewbha , ki rah pisa sa ar shah , bad ki leit nep sha Ijipt ryngkat bun u Bamaïan . Hangta ki la sien ïakynduh ïa u Joseph .
translation.en: And the men took that present , and they took double money in their hand , and Benjamin  ; and rose up , and went down to Egypt , and stood before Joseph .

But I said , How shall I put thee among the children , and give thee a pleasant land , a goodly heritage of the hosts of nations ? and I said , Thou shalt call me , My father  ; and shalt not turn away from me .

translation.kha: Ka jingdum kan tap ïa ka Tahpanhes haba ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong ka Ijipt bad ngan pynkut ïa ka jingkhlaiñ kaba ki sngewsarong palat . U lyoh un kah ïa ka Ijipt , bad ki briew jong ki nongbah jong ka baroh kin shah ïalam kum ki koidi .
hynrei uno uno ïa wahbah la ñiew bymkhuid u bam ïa ka , yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u kumno aiwai na ki briew U Blei .
translation.en: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings , that pertain unto the  Lord  , having his uncleanness upon him , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .

translation.en: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture , Behold , I lay in Sion a chief corner stone , elect , precious : and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded .

translation.kha: Hynrei ban pyn-i ha me ïa ka bor lad nga , per la shah ba men daiñ im , khnang ba yn ïoh pynbna ïa ka kyrteng jong nga ha ka pyrthat Baroh kawei .
translation.en: And in very deed for this cause have I raised thee up , for to shew in thee my power  ; and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth .

translation.kha: Naba ki la wallam katto kat ngut ki rangbah ban ïakhot lamler shaphang jong u . Une u brup , ki la ong , u ïai kren borabor pyrshah ïa ka templ bakyntang bun ïa ka suda u Moses .
translation.en: And set up false witnesses , which said , This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place , and the law :

translation.en: And thou shalt be secure , because there is hope  ; yea , thou shalt dig about thee , and thou shalt take thy rest in safety .

translation.kha: Te nangta , Phin dat jingbam ei ei ? Ai ïa nga san tylli ki kpu ne katno kano kaba phin don .
translation.en: Now therefore what is under thine hand ? give me five loaves of bread in mine hand , or what there is present .

translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord  , according to all that his father had done .
And there went out fire from the  Lord  , and devoured them , and they died before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kynsan U  Trai  u phah ïa ka ding , bad kata ka thang ïa ki hangta ha khmat jong U  Trai  haduh ba kin da ïap .

translation.en: And they laid hands on them , and put them in hold unto the next day : for it was now eventide .

translation.kha: Hynrei wat ki paid Judah ruh kim shym kohnguh ïa ki aiñ U Trai U Blei jong ki ; ki pyrthuh bud ïa ki rukom ba dang bat da ki paid Israel .
translation.en: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the  Lord  their God , but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made .

translation.kha: Lymda phim sumar ïa ka jutang kaba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa phi ba sumar bad lada phi shakri bad maïan ïa kiwei pat ki blang , kumta te ha ka jingbitar jongki u , un pynïapmat ïa phi , bad shem ym don uwei ruh na phi u ngab lait im ha kane ka ri babniah kaba u la ai ha phi .
translation.en: When ye have transgressed the covenant of the  Lord  your God , which he commanded you , and have gone and served other gods , and bowed yourselves to them  ; then shall the anger of the  Lord  be kindled against you , and ye shall perish quickly from off the good land which he hath given unto you .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba lai ba u Belshassar u long syiem , nga la ïohi ïa ka jingïohipaw kaba ar .

translation.en: Why are they late for the meeting ?

translation.kha: Ka jingmane bleithaw jong ki ka pynlong ïa U Trai ban ym lah shah , ki nang bymman jong ki , ki la pynlong ïa u ban bato .
translation.en: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods , with abominations provoked they him to anger .
And Eli blessed Elkanah and his wife , and said , The  Lord  give thee seed of this woman for the loan which is lent to the  Lord . And they went unto their own home .
translation.kha: Nangta u Eli u ju kyrkhu ïa u Elkanah bad ka tnga jong u , bad u ong ha u Elkanah ,  To U  Trai  un ai shuh ki khun ïa phi na kane ka briew ha ka jaka uta uba phi la aiti sha u .  Hadien kata ki sa leit phai sha la ïing .
Ainong ha ki ban thep ïa u ha ka byndi bad ban ai ha u ïa u kpu bad ka um haduh ba ngan da wan pei khlem shah pynïap .
translation.en: And say , Thus saith the king , Put this fellow in the prison , and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction , until I return in peace .

translation.kha: U Paul u la nang leit shuh Derbe bad lumrit , ha kambah uei u Khristan uba kyrteng u Timothi u shong u sah . Ka kmie jong u , kaba long duh ka Khristan , ka long ka Jiw , hynrei u kpa jong u , u long u Grik .
translation.en: Then came he to Derbe and Lystra : and , behold , a certain disciple was there , named Timothy , the son of a certain woman , which was a Jewess , and believed  ; but his father was a Greek :

translation.kha: U nongïalam jong ki Jiw u la kylli ïa U Jisu , Ko nonghikai Baalah , kaei nga dei ban leh ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingtem bymjukut ?
translation.en: And a certain ruler asked him , saying , Good Master , what shall I do to inherit eternal life ?
For the word of the  Lord  is right  ; and all his works are done in truth .
translation.kha: Ki ktien U  Trai  ki long kiba shisha ; bad baroh ki kam jong u ki long kiba lah ban shaniah .

Kynmaw mynta ïa kaei kaba phi la tip shaphang U Terah lyngba ki jingïashem jongngi pa bad u . Dei ma Phi , ym ki khun ki ktem jongu phi kiba la ïohmad ïa kine ki jingïaikren . phiah la ïohi ïa ka jingkren jong u , ïa ka bor jong u , bad ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong u , bad ïa ki kambah jong u .
translation.en: And know ye this day : for I speak not with your children which have not known , and which have not seen the chastisement of the  Lord  your God , his greatness , his mighty hand , and his stretched out arm ,

translation.kha: U Blei u ïaid dum , hynrei ngam ïohi ïa u .
translation.en: Lo , he goeth by me , and I see him not : he passeth on also , but I perceive him not .
She girdeth her loins with strength , and strengtheneth her arms .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba trei shitom , kaba khlaiñ bad kaba minot .

translation.en: And Saul said to him , Whose son art thou , thou young man ? And David answered , I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Beth–lehemite .
translation.kha: U Saul u kylli ïa u ,  Ko samla , me dei u khun jongno ?   Nga dei u khun jong u shakri jong phi , u Jesse , uba na Bethlehem ,  U Dabid u jubab .
Bad mynta pat , to U Trai un lehsbun bun ïaineh skhem bad phi . Ang ruh ngan lehbha ïa ph namar kaei kaba phi la leh .
translation.en: And now the  Lord  shew kindness and truth unto you : and I also will requite you this kindness , because ye have done this thing .

translation.kha: Iathuh hok .
translation.en: Be honest .

And thou shalt consume all the people which the  Lord  thy God shall deliver thee  ; thine eye shall have no pity upon them : neither shalt thou serve their gods  ; for that will be a snare unto thee .
translation.kha: Pynjot ïa kawei pa kawei ka jaitbynriew kat ïa kaba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u aiti ha phi , bad wat sngewsynei ïa ki . Wat mane ïa ki blei jong ki , namar kata kan long ka jingma ïa me .

translation.en: The disciple is not above his master , nor the servant above his lord .
translation.kha: Ym don uba shah hikai uba kham khraw ban ïa u nonghikai jong u ; ym don u mraw uba kham khraw ban ïa u kynrad jong u .

translation.en: And he turned himself about from them , and wept  ; and returned to them again , and communed with them , and took from them Simeon , and bound him before their eyes .
translation.kha: U Joseph u iehnoh ïa ki bad u sdang ban ïam . Haba u la lah ban kren biang , u la wan pat , u shim ïa u Simeon bad u phah teh ïa u ha khmat jong ki .
Uta uba da mutlop u kular ban kitkhlieh ïa ka ram u nongwei u dat hok baneh buh ïa la ka jong ka jingdon jingem ban pynshisha ïa ka jingsiew .
translation.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger , and take a pledge of him for a strange woman .

translation.kha: Ko pher , U Tharai u ong ïa u telephone , baroh kaba u don ki long hapoh ka kuna jong me , hynrei lad ym pynmong ïa u Job hi . Te u “Soitan” u la leit noh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Satan , Behold , all that he hath is in thy power  ; only upon himself put not forth thine hand . So Satan went forth from the presence of the  Lord .
The sea is come up upon Babylon : she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof .
translation.kha: Ka duriaw ka la tyllep ïa ka Babilon bad tap da ki jingat phyllung bakyrhuh .
Mynta ngam mut ïa ki bymngeit kiba awria ne katba lalot ne kiba hir ki nongtuh ne katba mane ïa ki thliew . Ban lait na kino phi Dei ban mynhynne shisyndon na ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world , or with the covetous , or extortioners , or with idolaters ; for then must ye needs go out of the world .

translation.kha: lehse U Blei un kylla ka jingmut jyllang u ; leh-ieit un sangeh noh na kaba bitar , bad ngin ym ïap !
translation.en: Who can tell if God will turn and repent , and turn away from his fierce anger , that we perish not ?

Then Zedekiah the king sent , and took Jeremiah the prophet unto him into the third entry that is in the house of the  Lord  : and the king said unto Jeremiah , I will ask thee a thing  ; hide nothing from me .
translation.kha: Ha kawei pat ka por u syiem Sedekaïah u la phah wallam ïa nga sha u ha ka khyrdop kaba lai sha ka Templ , bad u la ong ,  Ngan kylli ïa phi ka jingkylli , bad nga kwah ba phin ïathuh ïa nga ïa ka jingshisha baroh .
Hynrei U Trai u ong ha u , Long ka jingsuk . Wat sheptieng . Men ym ïap .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Peace be unto thee  ; fear not : thou shalt not die .

translation.kha: U Pharoah un sa taïew ba ki Jerusalem’ ki la phet sakma sad ba ki la shah khang kut ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel , They are entangled in the land , the wilderness hath shut them in .
Who did no sin , neither was guile found in his mouth :
translation.kha: Um shym la leh pop , bad ym shym don mano mano ba la ïohsngew ïa ka jinglamler kaba mih na ki rmiang shyntur jong u .
U la ïakhot ha ki ïa kaei kob la jia malu u la phah noh ïa ki shata Joppa .
translation.en: And when he had declared all these things unto them , he sent them to Joppa .
She hath killed her beasts  ; she hath mingled her wine  ; she hath also furnished her table .
translation.kha: Ka la shah ba kin pynïap ïa ki jingri jong ka na ka bynta ka jingkhawai , ka la khleh jingiwbih ha ka waiñ , bad ka la pynkhreh ïa ka miej .

Ki paidbhur Israel ki ainong , Ngin ïadie beit na lyntang bah , bad lada ma ngi lane ki jingri jong ngi , ngi dih ïa ka um jong phoi , ngin da siewdor ïa ka — baroh katba ngi kwah ka long ban shu ïaid lyngba .
translation.en: And the children of Israel said unto him , We will go by the high way : and if I and my cattle drink of thy water , then I will pay for it : I will only , without doing any thing else , go through on my feet .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada la teh ïa ki briew ha ki kynjri , da kaba shahshitom na ka bynta khie kaba ki la leh ,
translation.en: And if they be bound in fetters , and be holden in cords of affliction  ;

translation.kha: Un shim ruh khyndai ka umphniang na la ka sla ti bad khynñiat ka snam jong u Khunlangbrot bad un tah ha ka shkor kamon , ka thik kamon , bad ka jatkmie kamai jong uta u briew ïa uba yn pynkhuid .
translation.en: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot , upon the blood of the trespass offering :

translation.kha: U Omri u la ni pop pyrshah ïa U Trai kham palat ban ïa kino kino kiba ha shuwa jong u .
translation.en: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of the  Lord  , and did worse than all that were before him .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong na kita ki snieh , ïalumlang pun mane blei , bad wiat trei ei ei kumba phi ju trei man la ka Sngi .
translation.en: On the first day shall be an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .

translation.kha: Ngan map ïa ki jingbakla baroh kiba pha la leh , hyndai phan kynmaw ïa ki bad sngewlehrain palat ban ang ïa la ka shyntur . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: That thou mayest remember , and be confounded , and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame , when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done , saith the Lord  God .
And I raised up of your sons for prophets , and of your young men for Nazarites . Is it not even thus , O ye children of Israel ? saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga la jied katto katne na ki khun shynrang jong phi ban long ki nongïathuhlypa , bad katto katne na ki samla shynrang jong phi ban long ki Nasir . Hato kane kam long kaba shisha , ko ki paid Israel ? Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .

Ngi thoh sha phi shaphang U Ktien ka jingrem , uba la don naduh kiba mynnyngkong eh . Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u , bad ngi la ïohi ïa u da la ki khmat ; ïa-ïuh , im la ioh ïa u , bad ki kti jong ngi ki la ïohktah ïa u .
translation.en: That which was from the beginning , which we have heard , which we have seen with our eyes , which we have looked upon , and our hands have handled , of the Word of life  ;
So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day . The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand  ; because he had forsaken the  Lord  God of his fathers .
translation.kha: Ka Edom ka la laitluid na ka Judah naduh kata ka por . Ha kane kajuh ka por , ka nongbah Libnah ruh ka la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , namar u Jehoram u la iehnoh ïa U  Trai  , U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong u .
Te U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki briew ban ym kren shaphang kata hano hano ruh ; hynrei katba u nang praw ïa ki ban ym ïathuh , katta ki nang ïathuh .
translation.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man : but the more he charged them , so much the more a great deal they published it  ;

translation.kha: To khroh ïa u , phi ki syiem bad phi ki jaitbynriew baroh , ki khun syier shynriah bad baroh Kawei ki nongsynshar ;
translation.en: Kings of the earth , and all people  ; princes , and all judges of the earth :

translation.kha: kumto lada kawei ka kynruh ka ïalaw ïa kawei pat ka kynhun hapoh ka hima-patsha jong u Soitan , kane ka mudui ba ka la da ïaphiah ha ki kynhun mala shna kan sa khyllem ha ka jingphla !
translation.en: And if Satan cast out Satan , he is divided against himself  ; how shall then his kingdom stand ?

translation.kha: Kito ki brai baroh , ki kren shaphang kumno ba phi la pdiang ïa ngi mynshem haba ngi la waiñ jngoh ïa phi , bad kumno ba phira la phai noh na ki bynthiew Sha U blem , ban shakri ïa U Blang uba shisha bad uba im
translation.en: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you , and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God ;
Daniel answered and said , Blessed be the name of God for ever and ever : for wisdom and might are his :
translation.kha: U Blei u long uba stad bad uba donbor ! to ïaroh ïa u junom la junom .

Uei u shipai uba ju dei ngab siew ïa la ki jingpynlut ha ka kam shipai ? Uei u nongrep u bym bam ïa ki soh na la ka bri sohwaiñ ? Uei u nongaplangbrot u bym pyndonkam ïa ka dud na la ki jong ki langbrot ?
translation.en: Who goeth a warfare any time at his own charges ? who planteth a vineyard , and eateth not of the fruit thereof ? or who feedeth a flock , and eateth not of the milk of the flock ?

translation.kha: Ka jingieit kaba khraw kad kaba u bri u lah pun dat na ka bynta ki paralok jong u ka long ban aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: Greater love hath no man than this , that a man lay down his life for his friends .

translation.kha: Nangno baroh ki briew ka Israel ki leit kdew sha Bethel bad ki kthang . Ki shong hangta ha khmat U Trai bad kim syiem smam ei ei haduh jingneit . Ki kñia ki jingainguh ïasyllok bad ki thang ïa ki jingainguh pynïasuk — baïar ha jingdon shrong U Trai .
translation.en: Then all the children of Israel , and all the people , went up , and came unto the house of God , and wept , and sat there before the  Lord  , and fasted that day until even , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the  Lord .
Fire , and hail  ; snow , and vapour  ; stormy wind fulfilling his word :
translation.kha: phi ka leilieh bad u phria , ka ïor bad ki lyoh , ki lyer bakhlaiñ kiba kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u .

translation.en: And you , be ye fruitful , and multiply  ; bring forth abundantly in the earth , and multiply therein .
translation.kha: To phin ïoh bun ki khun ki kti , ba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin sah ha kylleng ka pyrthei .
U Jakob u shim ïa ki tnat ibha dang im na ka dieng lieng , u diengsoh almond , malu u dieng Sning , bad u khoh snep ha katto-katne katne kajuh haduh ba ki tngen dien kin da paw ka met lieh .
translation.en: And Jacob took him rods of green poplar , and of the hazel and chesnut tree  ; and pilled white strakes in them , and made the white appear which was in the rods .
For I will punish them that dwell in the land of Egypt , as I have punished Jerusalem , by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence :
translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa kito kiba shong ha Ijipt , kumba nga pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem — da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad ka jingpang .
Nangta u Moses u khublei ïakhlad Bad u Jethro , sad u Jethro u kitei phai pah sha la ïing .
translation.en: And Moses let his father in law depart  ; and he went his way into his own land .

translation.kha: Phi Ong , Ai ba U Trai un pynjot bad leh ïa kaei kaba u ong ba un leh , ba kumta ine lah ban ïohi ïa ka . Ai ba U Blei bakhuid ka Jeriel un pyndep ïa ki jingthmu jong u , to ngin khmied kaei u don ha ka jingmut jong u .
translation.en: That say , Let him make speed , and hasten his work , that we may see it : and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come , that we may know it !

translation.kha: Uwei u shipai Israel uba kyrteng u Sikhri , u la pynïap ïa u Mesha u khun jong u syiem Ahas , ïa u Asrikam u nongpynïaidkam ha ka ïingsyiem , bad ïa u Elkanah , uba ha ka kyrshan kaba ar ïa u syiem .
translation.en: And Zichri , a mighty man of Ephraim , slew Maaseiah the king s son , and Azrikam the governor of the house , and Elkanah that was next to the king .

translation.kha: Mar kumta u Saul u kyllon katkum dara u taïew lumrit ha khyndew , ba u bthing eh ïa kaei kaba u Shullam u la ong . U la shoh tlot ngai , namarba ba um shym la bam ei ei baroh shi sngi bad baroh shu miet .
translation.en: Then Saul fell straightway all along on the earth , and was sore afraid , because of the words of Samuel : and there was no strength in him  ; for he had eaten no bread all the day , nor all the night .

translation.kha: Hynrei phim dat ban rah ïa kano kano kaba dei ïa ka ngab pynjot ; lada phi leh kumta , phin wanrah ka jingjynjar nabar ka jingpyntieng ïa ka jaka shong dara ki Israel .
translation.en: And ye , in any wise keep yourselves from the accursed thing , lest ye make yourselves accursed , when ye take of the accursed thing , and make the camp of Israel a curse , and trouble it .
An unjust man is an abomination to the just : and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked .
translation.kha: Uba hok u isih ïa u bymman , bad u bymman u isih ïa uba hok .
Ma nga , u Tertios , uba thoh ïa kane ka shatei , per phah ïa phi ki jingkhublei parabangeit .
translation.en: I Tertius , who wrote this epistle , salute you in the Lord .
But when the fourteenth night was come , as we were driven up and down in Adria , about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country  ;
translation.kha: Ka la long ka miet kaba khatsaw , bad ngi la shah ïalam kylleng ha ka duriaw Mediterranian da ka  erïong . Kumba shiteng synñia ki maji ki la antad ba ngi la jan poi hajan ka ryngkew .
U Trai un pynsakma ïa pha kum ïa u phlangïap uba la beh napoh da ka slipar ri shyiap .
translation.en: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness .

translation.kha: Ki wan lem pynlang la ki jingïar bad ki dara kamra rben ki kynhun puit . Ma ki lem malu ki ut jongngi ki , ki bun haduh Iso katta ba ym lah ñiew Shuah ïa ki . Ki wan bad pynngat thiaw ïa ka ri ,
translation.en: For they came up with their cattle and their tents , and they came as grasshoppers for multitude  ; for both they and their camels were without number : and they entered into the land to destroy it .

Now Elisha was fallen sick of his sickness whereof he died . And Joash the king of Israel came down unto him , and wept over his face , and said , O my father , my father , the chariot of Israel , and the horsemen thereof .
translation.kha: U Elisha u nongïathuhlypa u la kem pang na ka jait jingpang kaba shyrkhei , bad katba u dang thiah sa ba un ïap u Jehoash u syiem Israel u leit jngoh ïa u .  Ko pa jong nga , pa jong nga !  u pyrta da kaba ïam .  Phi la long u nongïada bakhlaiñbor jong ka Israel !

translation.en: And it come to pass , when he heareth the words of this curse , that he bless himself in his heart , saying , I shall have peace , though I walk in the imagination of mine heart , to add drunkenness to thirst :
translation.kha: Pynthikna ba yn ym don hangne mynta ka sngi uba ïohsngew ïa ki ktien jong kane ka jutang , pynban uba pynngeit ïa lade ba kaei kaei kan ym jia ïa u wat la u ïaid mon da ka dohnud kaba mutlop . Ka jingmih na kata kan long ba phi baroh phin jot thiaw , kiba bha bad kiba sniew kumjuh .

translation.en: But the God of all grace , who hath called us unto his eternal glory by Christ Jesus , after that ye have suffered a while , make you perfect , stablish , strengthen , settle you .
translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ba phi la shahshitom tang khyndiat por , U Blei jong ka jingaiei baroh , uba la khot ïa phi ban ïoh bynta na ka burom bymjukut jong u ha U Khrist , ma u hi keiñ un pynjanai ïa phi bad un ai ha phi ïa ka jingsngewskhem , ka jingkhlaiñ , bad ka nongrim kaba skhem shisha .
Wat ïathuhlypa shuh hangne ha Bethel . Kane ka dei ka jaka mane Blei jong u syiem , ka Templ jong ka hima .
translation.en: But prophesy not again any more at Beth–el : for it is the king s chapel , and it is the king s court .

translation.kha: U Trei u la pynlong ïa phi u lyngkdong ha ka jaka Jong u Jehosabad , bad mynta ph long u rangbah pynïaidkam ha ka Tep . Ka dei ka kamram jong phi ban khmih ba ïa uwei pa ti u riewlamwir uba leh mynleh ba u long u nongïathuhlypa dei banbeiñ buh ha ki kynjri lymne bad u jingrang ryndang babha da ka nar .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest , that ye should be officers in the house of the  Lord  , for every man that is mad , and maketh himself a prophet , that thou shouldest put him in prison , and in the stocks .
The king of Tirzah , one : all the kings thirty and one .
translation.kha: bad Tirsah — baroh ki long laiphew wei ngut ki syiem .
Ki Israel ki kynriah jaka tang lada uta u lyoh u kiew shajrong na tala ka jingïaineh .
translation.en: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle , the children of Israel went onward in all their journeys :

translation.kha: ba ki samla kynthei kin lytar saw sngi mano la ka snem ban ïa-ïam sngewsih na ka bynta ka khun u Jephthah u Nong Gilead .
translation.en: That the daughters of Israel went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year .

translation.kha: Ki la ïasdang ban ïasaidnia la ma ki , katai ba ngin noh ? dalade ngi ong , ‘ Na U Blei ,’ un ong ha ngi , ‘ Balei , te , ba phim shem la ngeit ïa u Ïoannis ?’
translation.en: And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven  ; he will say , Why then believed ye him not ?
And when he would have put him to death , he feared the multitude , because they counted him as a prophet .
translation.kha: U Herod u la kwah ban pynïap ïa u , hynrei u la sheptieng ïa ki paid Jiw , namar ki la ñiew ïa u Ïoannis kum u nongïathuhlypa .

translation.en: Thou hast seen it  ; for thou beholdest mischief and spite , to requite it with thy hand : the poor committeth himself unto thee  ; thou art the helper of the fatherless .
translation.kha: Hynrei me , me ïohi ; me khmih ïa ka jingjynjar bad ka jingshah shitom , bad me ïailong uba la kloi ban ïarap . U briew u bym don nongïarap u aiti ïa lade ha me ; me la ju ïarap ïa uba kyrduh .
len ieh hangta ïa ki briew uba sngewrit bad naba tukri , ki shun wan shuh ang na ka bynda ka jingïarap .
translation.en: I will also leave in the midst of thee an afflicted and poor people , and they shall trust in the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: bad ban ïathuh ïa ki ba U Trai Benabinadab Baroh u la lah ong , Ngan pynpait ïa kane ka jaitbynriew bad ïa khie ka nongbah , bad kan long kum une u khrup khyndew ba la pait u bym lah ban pyndait pat . Ki brisoh kin tep ïa kiba ïap jong ki ha Netophah namar yn ym don jongno hangno Haei patiaw ban tep ïa ki .
translation.en: And shalt say unto them , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Even so will I break this people and this city , as one breaketh a potter s vessel , that cannot be made whole again : and they shall bury them in Topheth , till there be no place to bury .
And blessed be the most high God , which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand . And he gave him tithes of all .
translation.kha: bad to kan long ka jingïaroh ïa U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh uba ai ha phi ïa ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong phi !  Bad u Abram u ai ha u Melkhisedek ïa kaba shiphew na ka jinglute kaba u la lah pynïoh pat .
Hato u briew un ïong ei ei lada u jop ïa ka pyiar baroh kawei hynrei u hi u duh noh! lane u shahjop ? Em da shisha !
translation.en: For what is a man advantaged , if he gain the whole world , and lose himself , or be cast away ?

translation.kha: U la leit sha u , u la thuh umphniang bad ka waiñ ha ki jingmong jongno u bad u la spaiñ ïa ki ; Nangta u la buh ïa uta u briew Hamor u jingri jongnga u bad u la ïalam ïa u sha ka ïingbishar , ha kaba u la sumar ïa u .
translation.en: And went to him , and bound up his wounds , pouring in oil and wine , and set him on his own beast , and brought him to an inn , and took care of him .

translation.kha: Wah lapbah ki pyntud Israel ki roi khim ki ñiuhmat , ngan phah ïa ka lyer khluit na mangi kaba na ri shahjop , bad kan pynrung ïa ki umpohliew bad ki pung-um jong ki . Kan khrong nala ïa kano kano kaba kordor .
translation.en: Though he be fruitful among his brethren , an east wind shall come , the wind of the  Lord  shall come up from the wilderness , and his spring shall become dry , and his fountain shall be dried up : he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels .

translation.kha: Ngan pha ïa ki nongshun ban khet ïa ki bri shoiñ jong ki briew jong de , hynmen ym ban pynjot khoit ïa ki . Ngi ong ïa ki ban khet noh ïa ki tnat Jong ki , namar kito ki tnat kim dei ki jong nga .
translation.en: Go ye up upon her walls , and destroy  ; but make not a full end : take away her battlements  ; for they are not the  Lord s .

And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father  ; he turned not aside from it , doing that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  : nevertheless the high places were not taken away  ; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places .
translation.kha: Kum u Asa u kpa jong u , uba ha shuwa jong u , u la leh ïa kaei kaba dei ha khmat U  Trai  ; hynrei ïa ki jaka mane blei thala ym shym la pynjot , bad ki briew ki ïai bteng ban ai jingkñia bad thang jingiwbih hangta .

Mynta kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai Nongsynshar u ïa-ong : Namar pha la klet ïa nga nabar pha phai dulan ïa ang , phan sa shahshitom na ka pyntwa ka jingkynjah brai jong pha bad ka jingleh nuti jong pha .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast forgotten me , and cast me behind thy back , therefore bear thou also thy lewdness and thy whoredoms .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki briew kiba nga ieit ki la leh ïa kiei kiei kiba sniew . Ki don hok aïu ngab don hapoh ka Templ jong la ? Hato ki pyrkhat ba ki lah ban ïada na ka jingpynjot da naba pynlong ki jingkular bad da kaba ai ki jingkñia da ki mrad ? Hato kata kan pynkmen ïa ki ?
translation.en: What hath my beloved to do in mine house , seeing she hath wrought lewdness with many , and the holy flesh is passed from thee ? when thou doest evil , then thou rejoicest .

translation.kha: Wat ai ka jingkular ha ka kyrteng jyllang nga lada phim don jingmut ban batbor ïa ka ; sakma ka wanrah ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely , neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kaba ïuh ïa ka jingstad ka long kaei katei kaba dumok tur ba phi dei ban leh . namar Kaei kaei barhem kaweh phi ïoh , to ïoh ruh ïa ka jingshemphang .
translation.en: Wisdom is the principal thing  ; therefore get wisdom : and with all thy getting get understanding .

translation.kha: Hynrei mem dei shun shah ïa u ban lait khulom ka jingpynshitom . Me tip kaei ba “Men leh , badno me dei ban khmih ba u dei ban shait pynïap .
translation.en: Now therefore hold him not guiltless : for thou art a wise man , and knowest what thou oughtest to do unto him  ; but his hoar head bring thou down to the grave with blood .

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki aiñ barben ïa kiba U Tharai U balui jongngi phi u la hukum ïa nga ban hikai ïa phi . Sumar bad sa ïa ki ha kata ka ri sha ka phin sa leit bad ïakyndit .
translation.en: Now these are the commandments , the statutes , and the judgments , which the  Lord  your God commanded to teach you , that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it :
And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna : and it was like coriander seed , white  ; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey .
translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki khot ïa kata ka jingbam ,  ka manna . Ka long kum u symbai balieh uba rit , bad ka shngiam kum u kpu lyngkniap ba la shet bad ka ngap .
Nangta katto katne ngut ki Sebedi , kiba ong ba ki briew kin ym mihpat na ka jingïap , ki la wan ha U Jisu bad ki la ong ,
translation.en: Then came to him certain of the Sadducees , which deny that there is any resurrection  ; and they asked him ,
But this I say , brethren , the time is short : it remaineth , that both they that have wives be as though they had none ;
translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga mut , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ka long kane : Ka por kam don shuh , bad naduh mynta ki rangbah kiba la shongkurim ki dei ban im kumba kim shym la shongkurim ;

Ym dei namar ka hok jong phoi ne ka jinglong beit ha ka dohnud ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jong ki , hynrei ka long namar ka jingbymman jongu kita ki jaitbynriew ba U Trai U Blei jong ph u la beh krad ïa ki na khmied jong phi ; ba un pynskhem ïa la ka kular ba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jongki phi , u Amraphel , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .
translation.en: Not for thy righteousness , or for the uprightness of thine heart , dost thou go to possess their land : but for the wickedness of these nations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee , and that he may perform the word which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob .

translation.kha: Bun U Trai u leh kumin ; ki skain da ki kynhun baher ki wan bang hapoh ïing jong u Pharaoh bad hapoh ïeng jong ki Rangbah synshar jong u . Ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei ka julor ha kita ki shen .
translation.en: And the  Lord  did so  ; and there came a grievous swarm of flies into the house of Pharaoh , and into his servants  houses , and into all the land of Egypt : the land was corrupted by reason of the swarm of flies .
The shield of his mighty men is made red , the valiant men are in scarlet : the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation , and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken .
translation.kha: Ki shipai jong u nongshun ki rah ïa ki stieh rong saw bad ki phong ki sopti rong saw . Ki pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ! Ki kali ïapom jong ki , ki thaba kum ka ding ! Ki kulai jong ki jam stet !
U baroh u khulom jongu u Neraïah u la pynkhih ïa phi pyrshah ïa ngi , kumta ki nong Bithynia kin ïa-ïohbor halor jrong ngi bad ki lah ba-bang pynïap ïa ngi ne ïalam ino ïa ngi sha Babilonia .
translation.en: But Baruch the son of Neriah setteth thee on against us , for to deliver us into the hand of the Chaldeans , that they might put us to death , and carry us away captives into Babylon .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba don ha ki jingjynjar bakhraw ki ïar ïa nga , bad nga la ïarah ïa ki riewkynthei ban ïoh jingshngain .
translation.en: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me : and I caused the widow s heart to sing for joy .

translation.kha: Baroh ar , u nongpynkhiah bad uta uba kyrhai na u , kin ïoh ïa khiah ka jingshah pynïapmat .
translation.en: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity : the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh unto him  ;

translation.en: And Atroth Shophan , and Jaazer , and Jogbehah ,

translation.en: And Moses did as the  Lord  commanded : and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation .

And when the people complained , it displeased the  Lord  : and the  Lord  heard it  ; and his anger was kindled  ; and the fire of the  Lord  burnt among them , and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la sdang ban ujor ha U  Trai  shaphang ki jingjynjar jong ki . Haba U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ïa ki , u la bitar lep bad u phah da ka ding ha kita ki paidbah . Kata ka ding ka klang hapdeng jong ki bad ka la pynjot ïa kawei ka dong jong ka jaka shong dara .

U Syiem Dabid u ong ha u Solomon u khun jongnga u , To long uba sngewskhem bad uba kut jingmut . Sdang ïa ka kam bad wat ai kano kano ruh kan pynsangeh ïa me . U Trai U Blei! , umbah nga shakri un don bad me . Un ym iehnoh ïa me , hynrei un don ryngkat bad me tad haduh ba men pyndep ïa ka kam kaba dei ban trei ha ka Templ jong u .
translation.en: And David said to Solomon his son , Be strong and of good courage , and do it : fear not , nor be dismayed : for the  Lord  God , even my God , will be with thee  ; he will not fail thee , nor forsake thee , until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the  Lord .
And Joshua said unto the children of Israel , How long are ye slack to go to possess the land , which the  Lord  God of your fathers hath given you ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua u ong ha ki paid Israel ,  Sa katno phin ap ha shuwa ban phin rung bad shim kynti ïa ka ri kaba U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u la ai ha phi ?

Ka dang don shuh sa kawei pat . Me kynmaw ïa kaei kaba u Joab u la ar ïa nga da kaba pynïap ïa ki ar lwet ki radbah ai hukum jong ki shipai Jesreel — u Abner , u khun jong u Ner bad u Amasa , u khun jong u Jether . Me kynmaw kumno u la pynïap ïa ki ha ka por suk pyrthei kum ka jingpynhiarkput ïa ka jingpynnang kaba ki la leh ha ka por thma . U la pynïap ïa ki rangbah balui lui , bad mynta nga bah ka jingkitkhlieh ïa kaei kaba u la leh , bad por la shah jynjar na ka bynta said .
translation.en: Moreover thou knowest also what Joab the son of Zeruiah did to me , and what he did to the two captains of the hosts of Israel , unto Abner the son of Ner , and unto Amasa the son of Jether , whom he slew , and shed the blood of war in peace , and put the blood of war upon his girdle that was about his loins , and in his shoes that were on his feet .

translation.kha: Un pham sa ïa ki jait jingong mala jingïapthem baroh’ ïa kiba ym shym la theh ha Kanah ka kitab jong ki aiñ bad ki jinglehkai U Blei , bad phin sa jot thiaw .
translation.en: Also every sickness , and every plague , which is not written in the book of this law , them will the  Lord  bring upon thee , until thou be destroyed .

translation.kha: U Saul u kyllut ïa u , Ko samla , me dei u khulom jongno ? Nga dei u khup jong u shakri Jong phi , u Jesse , uba na Bethlehem , U Dabid u jubab .
translation.en: And Saul said to him , Whose son art thou , thou young man ? And David answered , I am the son of thy servant Jesse the Beth–lehemite .

And that I also have walked contrary unto them , and have brought them into the land of their enemies  ; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled , and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity :
translation.kha: bad kiba la pynlong ruh ïa nga ban phai pyrshah ïa ki bad pynsakma ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri ki nongshun jong ki . Khatduh , ynda ki khun ki ksiew jong phi ki la pyndem rit ïa lade bad ki la shah pynshitom namar ka pop bad ka jingïaleh pyrshah jong ki ,

translation.en: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word , and understandeth it  ; which also beareth fruit , and bringeth forth , some an hundredfold , some sixty , some thirty .
translation.kha: Bad ki symbai kiba la bet ha ka khyndew kaba bha ki ïeng na ka bynta kito kiba ïohsngew ïa ka khubor bad shemphang ïa ka : ki pynmih soh , katto katne shispah tylli , kiwei pat hynriewphew tylli , bad kiwei pat laiphew tylli .
wahbah u Dabid u la ïohi ba ki ïakmen pasiaw para ma ki , u la sngewthuh ba u khunlung u la ïap . Kumta u kylli ïa ki , Hato u kohnguh u la ïap ? Ho-oid , u la ïap , ki la jubab .
translation.en: But when David saw that his servants whispered , David perceived that the child was dead : therefore David said unto his servants , Is the child dead ? And they said , He is dead .

Therefore the king of Israel gathered together of prophets four hundred men , and said unto them , Shall we go to Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall I forbear ? And they said , Go up  ; for God will deliver it into the king s hand .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ahab u khot shapoh ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , kumba sawspah na ki , bad u kylli ïa ki ,  Hato ngan leit bad tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth , ne em ?   Tur ïaleh ïa ka ,  ki jubab .  U Blei un ai jingjop ïa phi .

translation.en: These are the commandments and the judgments , which the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho .
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki aiñ bad jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba U  Trai  u la ai ha ki Israel lyngba u Moses ha ki pyntha ka Moab sha shiliang ka wah Jordan na Jerikho .
Dei ka jingngeit kaweh pynlong ïa U Joseph , ha shuwa ba un ïap , ban kren shaphang ka jingmihnoh ki khun Israel na Ijipt , bad ai ka jingbthah shaphang kaei ba ki dei ban leh ïa ka met jong u .
translation.en: By faith Joseph , when he died , made mention of the departing of the children of Israel  ; and gave commandment concerning his bones .
But charge Joshua , and encourage him , and strengthen him : for he shall go over before this people , and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see .
translation.kha: Hukum ïa u Joshua , bad pynshlur ïa u , naba un ïalam ïa u paidbah shatai sha shiliang ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri kaba me ïohi .’
Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi long u dieng , uba jrong bad uba khlaiñ . Phi la long khrud haduh katta kat ban kynjoh ïa ka sahit bneng , bad ka bor Jong phi ka ïar halor ka pyrthat baroh kawei .
translation.en: It is thou , O king , that art grown and become strong : for thy greatness is grown , and reacheth unto heaven , and thy dominion to the end of the earth .

translation.kha: Kaei ka phi la ïoh jingmyntoi na kaba leh ïa kiei kiei kiba phi la sngewlehrain mynsiem ? Ka jingmih jong kita kiei kiei ka long ka jingïap !
translation.en: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed ? for the end of those things is death .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki pynlong mraw ïa ki khunswet ba dang rit bad ki shim ïa ki khun lad u briew uba duk khim ka jingsiew ïa ki ram .
translation.en: They pluck the fatherless from the breast , and take a pledge of the poor .
But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night , and said to him , Behold , thou art but a dead man , for the woman which thou hast taken  ; for she is a man s wife .
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet , U Blei u mihpaw ha u ha ka jingphohsniew , bad u ong ha u ,  Men sa ïap , namar me la shim ïa kane ka briew ; ka la dep shongkurim .

translation.en: And he had in his right hand seven stars : and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword : and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength .
translation.kha: U bat ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki khlur ha ka kti kamon jong u , bad ka waitlam arliang syrti ka mih na ka shyntur jong u . Ka durkhmat jong u ka la long phyrnai kum ka sngi kaba shai ha ka por shiteng sngi .
hynñiew bun na uta u paidbah u la ngeit ha u badno u la jong , Haba U Messaïah un wan , katto un leh kham bun ki kambah Ban ïa katba une u briew u la leh ?
translation.en: And many of the people believed on him , and said , When Christ cometh , will he do more miracles than these which this man hath done ?

translation.en: All that openeth the matrix is mine  ; and every firstling among thy cattle , whether ox or sheep , that is male .
One day , she told me that she wanted a pet cat .
translation.kha: Shisien ka sngi , ka iathuh ianga ba ka kwah miaw .

U syiemsad ka Syros un pynkhreh ka jinghiarthma , da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka kynoi shiphang jong u baroh kawei . ngat , khnang ban pynjot ïa ka hamsaïa jong u nongshun , un pyntong ka jingïateh lok dara u bad tyrwa ha u ban shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u ; hynrei ka jingrem lad u kan ym kjap .
translation.en: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom , and upright ones with him  ; thus shall he do : and he shall give him the daughter of women , corrupting her : but she shall not stand on his side , neither be for him .
And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the  Lord  : and the  Lord  delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat ki Israel ki la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  , kumta u shah ïa ki Midian ban synshar ïa ki haduh hynñiew snem .

translation.en: So Rabshakeh returned , and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah : for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish .
translation.kha: U rangbah synshar ki Assyria u la tip ba u patsha u la leit sha Lakhish bad u dang ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Libnah ka nongbah ba-marjan ; kumta u leit shata ban ïasyllok bad u .

translation.en: And Gilead s wife bare him sons  ; and his wife s sons grew up , and they thrust out Jephthah , and said unto him , Thou shalt not inherit in our father s house  ; for thou art the son of a strange woman .
translation.kha: u don la ki khun shynrang ; bad kine ynda ki la san ki beh noh ïa u Jephthah na ïing . Ki ong ha u ,  Men ym ïoh bynta ei ei ha ïing i pa jong ngi , naba me dei u khun na kawei pat ka briew .

Lada kin pdiang da ka dohnud jong ki barabor ïa ka niam jong ki briew jongu nga bad kin smai , ‘ Kumba U Trai u im’ — kumba shisien ki la hikai ïa ki briew jong sa ban smai da u Baal — nangta ki ruh Kin long ka bynta jong ki biria jong nga ban kin pynmanbha .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , if they will diligently learn the ways of my people , to swear by my name , The  Lord  liveth  ; as they taught my people to swear by Baal  ; then shall they be built in the midst of my people .

translation.kha: Kane ka dawa ïa ka jingmad . Uno uno uba shemphang u lah ban batai ïa ka jingmut jong u dak jingkheiñ jong u mradkhlaw , namar u dak jingïakhih u ïeng na ka bynta ka kthang jongnga u briew . U dak jingkheiñ jong kata ka Kyrteng u longsyiem hynriewspah hynñiewspah hynriew .
translation.en: Here is wisdom . Let him that hath understanding count the number of the beast : for it is the number of a man  ; and his number is Six hundred threescore and six .

translation.kha: Pynban , to long bakha khoit ha kiei kiei baroh kiba phi! bor , kamra U Blei uba la khot ïa phoi u long uba khuid .
translation.en: But as he which hath called you is holy , so be ye holy in all manner of conversation  ;
But so much the more went there a fame abroad of him : and great multitudes came together to hear , and to be healed by him of their infirmities .
translation.kha: Hynrei ka khubor shaphang U Jisu ka la kham phriang kylleng , bad ki paid byllien ki la wan ban sngap ïa u bad ban ïoh jingpynkhiah na ki jingpang jong ki .
Ki pop u riewbymman ki long ka jingriam . U ngat ha ka jingriam jong ki pop jong u hi .
translation.en: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself , and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins .
Do therefore this that we say to thee : We have four men which have a vow on them  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba ngi kwah ïa me ban leh . Ki don saw ngut ki rangbah hangne kiba la shim jingsmai .

U Trai un phah biang ïa phira da ka lieng shwa ibieit , wat la sa la ong ba kine dei ban leit shuh shata lano hangno ; bad hangta pien sa tyrwa die mraw ïa lade ha ki nongshun jong phi , hynrei yn ym don ba thied ïa phi .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships , by the way whereof I spake unto thee , Thou shalt see it no more again : and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen , and no man shall buy you .

translation.kha: Ki la ithuh sha u Philip ( uba dei na Bethsaida kaba ha Gamaliel ) malu ki la ïai-ong , Ko Rangbah , ngi kwah ban ïohi ïa U Jiw .
translation.en: The same came therefore to Philip , which was of Bethsaida of Galilee , and desired him , saying , Sir , we would see Jesus .

translation.kha: Katba u Josaïah u long syiem , u Neko u syiem ka Ijipt u ïalam ïa ka kynruh shipai shat ka wah Ïuphratis ban ïarap ïa u patsha ka Assyria . U syiem Joahas u la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa ka kynha shipai ki Ieit ha Megiddo bad u la shait pynïap ha ka thma .
translation.en: In his days Pharaoh–neco king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates : and king Josiah went against him  ; and he slew him at Megiddo , when he had seen him .

translation.kha: Kata ka long ruh balei ba phi dei ban siew ki khajna , namar ki bor synshar ki trei na ka bynta U Blei haba ki pyndep ïa la ki kamram .
translation.en: For for this cause pay ye tribute also : for they are God s ministers , attending continually upon this very thing .

translation.kha: Ha —kata ka miet , la pynïaid ïa u Pharaoh , ïa ki jingbabe syiar jongnga u , bad ïa baroh ki nongthain Jingtep . Ka jinglynñiar kaba jam ka la don ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt , namar ym shym don kawei ruh ka ïing kaba ym don u khun uba khlem ïap .
translation.en: And Pharaoh rose up in the night , he , and all his servants , and all the Egyptians  ; and there was a great cry in Egypt  ; for there was not a house where there was not one dead .

translation.kha: Ngin tharai ka bha ba ki kot ki ding don , hynriewphew ki pynsamthiah ia nga .
translation.en: I think it is good that books still exist , but they do make me sleepy .

translation.kha: Pynban , lehbha U Mynsiem un wan , uba pynpaw ïa ka jingshisha shaphang U Blei , un ïalam ïa Phi sha ka jingsma baroh . Un ym kren-ïa ha ka bor jong u hi , hynne un kren ïa kaei kaba u ïasngew , malu un ïathuh ha phi ïa kiei kiei ki ban sa wei .
translation.en: Howbeit when he , the Spirit of truth , is come , he will guide you into all truth : for he shall not speak of himself  ; but whatsoever he shall hear , that shall he speak : and he will shew you things to come .
Then came in all the king s wise men : but they could not read the writing , nor make known to the king the interpretation thereof .
translation.kha: Ki nongai jingmut jong u syiem ki la ïawan sha khmat , hynrei ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban pule ïa ka jingthoh lane ïathuh ha u syiem aïu ka kit jingmut .
Khmut ïa ka durkhmat jong nga . Ngam shukor .
translation.en: Now therefore be content , look upon me  ; for it is evident unto you if I lie .

translation.kha: Ïa u brup uba sniew la rong neh ha ka jingshlei , bad ka khang kaba u long trai ka don hapoh ka jingtim U Blei ; um kitei Shuah ban trei ha la ki bri sohwaiñ .
translation.en: He is swift as the waters  ; their portion is cursed in the earth : he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards .

translation.kha: Ngin shngiam la kwah ïa ka rupa lane ka ksiar lane ka jaiñphong jongno jongno .
translation.en: I have coveted no man s silver , or gold , or apparel .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga la ïohi ka long ka Templ , bad la don ka kynroh sawkyr-ang jong ka . U briew u la shim ïa u diengthew lad u , uba jrong lai mitar bun u la tei ïa kata ka kynroh . Ka long lai mitar ka kyndiang , malade lai mitar ka jingriam .
translation.en: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about , and in the man s hand a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth : so he measured the breadth of the building , one reed  ; and the height , one reed .

translation.kha: Haba u Pilat u la ïohi ba kam donkam ban pynjlan , hynne ba kan pynmih pynban ka jingkhynwin , u la shim kynhied ka um , u la tnat ïa la ki kti ha khmat u paidbah , bad u la ong , Ngam don jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka jingïap jongu une u bariew ! Kane ka dei ka jingleh jong phi !
translation.en: When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing , but that rather a tumult was made , he took water , and washed his hands before the multitude , saying , I am innocent of the blood of this just person : see ye to it .

translation.kha: Jin ym da la sngewrem ïa la ka pop lada ngam shym la wan bad ngam shym la kren ha ki ; kumba ka long , ki ne nia ei ei shuh na ka bynta la ka pop .
translation.en: If I had not come and spoken unto them , they had not had sin : but now they have no cloak for their sin .
And the navy also of Hiram , that brought gold from Ophir , brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees , and precious stones .
