translation.en: Then Jonah prayed unto the  Lord  his God out of the fish s belly ,

And he set a carved image , the idol which he had made , in the house of God , of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son , In this house , and in Jerusalem , which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel , will I put my name for ever :
translation.kha: U buh ïa ka durblei ha ka Templ , ka jaka ha kaba U Blei u la ong ha u Dabid bad ha u Solomon u khun jong u :  Hangne ha Jerusalem , ha kane ka Templ , ka long ka jaka ïa kaba nga la jied na baroh kawei ka ri jong ki khat-ar jait ki Israel kum ka jaka ha kaba yn mane ïa nga .

translation.en: For the stone shall cry out of the wall , and the beam out of the timber shall answer it .
translation.kha: Wat ki maw ha ki kynroh ki kyang pyrshah ïa phi , bad ki shankhung ki pynsawa ïa ka jingkyang .

U pynlong ïa ki paid Benjamin Bad uwei pa uwei uba don ha Jeremaïah ban kular ban sumar ïa ka million . Bad kamut ki briew jong ka Jeremaïah ki kohnguh ïa ki jingdawa ka jutang kiba ki la pynlong malade U blei jong ki kper tymmen jrong ki .
translation.en: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it . And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God , the God of their fathers .

translation.kha: Ym da donkam ban thoh sha phi shaphang ka jingïa-ieit ïa ki parabangeit jong phi . Ma phi hi phira long kaba la ïoh hikai na U blem kumno phi dei ban ieid iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: But as touching brotherly love ye need not that I write unto you : for ye yourselves are taught of God to love one another .

translation.kha: NGA La Wan
translation.en: I came
And the angel of God , which went before the camp of Israel , removed and went behind them  ; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face , and stood behind them :
translation.kha: U Angel jong U Blei uba la ju don ha khmat jong ki paid Israel u la kynriah bad u la leit shadien . U rishot lyoh ruh u kynriah noh tad haduh ba u la don hapdeng ki nong Ijipt bad ki Israel .
Me la ai ha ki ïa kaei ka ri kaba twad da ka dud pynlang ka ngap , kumba me la kutlad ha ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: And hast given them this land , which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them , a land flowing with milk and honey  ;

translation.kha: U Abram u leit noh shaphang shatei na ka ri Ijipt shiah ka phang bashathie jong ka ri Kanaan lem mala ka tnga jong u bad baroh kat kiba u Don , bad u Lot u la leit lem bad u .
translation.en: And Abram went up out of Egypt , he , and his wife , and all that he had , and Lot with him , into the south .

translation.kha: Ka jingim jong u mynta ka sdang ban leit noh sha ka pyllait kiba ïa-ïap .
translation.en: Yea , his soul draweth near unto the grave , and his life to the destroyers .

translation.kha: Nongthaw kan shim por pat sa laiphew lai sngaid ba yn ñiew ïa ka kaba la khuid biang na ka jingmihsnam . Kan daym banbeiñ kwah ïa kaei kaei naba khuid lane rung sha ka Ïingjaiñ tad angnud la kut ka por pynsngaid ïa ka .
translation.en: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days  ; she shall touch no hallowed thing , nor come into the sanctuary , until the days of her purifying be fulfilled .

translation.kha: To kmen ba ngi long ki jong u ; ai ba baroh babha mane ïa u Kin shadkmen .
translation.en: Glory ye in his holy name : let the heart of them rejoice that seek the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki khun shyieng jong u syiem ka Syria kin pynrieh ïa ka thma Bad ki ïalum ka kynhun shipai barabor . Kawei na ki kan sordar kum ka jingshlei um malu kuna tuh ïaleh ïa ka koit jong u nongshun .
translation.en: But his sons shall be stirred up , and shall assemble a multitude of great forces : and one shall certainly come , and overflow , and pass through : then shall he return , and be stirred up , even to his fortress .
But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of , knowing of whom thou hast learned them ;
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , to ïaineh ha ki jingshisha kiba me la ïoh jinghikai bad kiba me ngeit skhem .

Shuh shuh , ïada uno uno u bam ïa ka doh jong kane ka jingainguh hadien ba u la kthaw ïa kaei kaei ka jingbymkhuid , la ka dei kaba na u brup ne na u mrad , ïa u umdih yn ym ñiew shuh kum uwei na ki briew U Blei .
translation.en: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing , as the uncleanness of man , or any unclean beast , or any abominable unclean thing , and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings , which pertain unto the  Lord  , even that soul shall be cut off from his people .
Yea , I will rejoice over them to do them good , and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul .
translation.kha: Ngan sngewbha ha kaba leh kiei kiei kiba bha na ka bynta jong ki , bad ngan buh pynskhem junom ïa ki ha kane ka ri .

translation.en: And now it is true that I am thy near kinsman : howbeit there is a kinsman nearer than I .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba shisha ba nga dei u ba-ha-ïing uba kham ïajan bad ba nga don jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta jong phi , hynrei don u briew uba dei u ba-ha-ïing uba kham ïajan ban ïa nga .
Ïa ki pulom Shabeh ka khyndew Bad ïa ki khapbrip um jong ka suiñbneng la khang noh .
translation.en: The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped , and the rain from heaven was restrained  ;

translation.kha: U Hiram , u syiem Tyros u la ju long u phalang jong u Dabid , bad haba u la ïohsngew ba u Solomon u la long shem hadien jong u Dabid , u kpa jong u , u la phah ki nongkit tiensyiem shaw u .
translation.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon  ; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father : for Hiram was ever a lover of David .

translation.kha: Nga ïai phah sha phi ïa ki shakri jong nga kiba long ki nonghiarthma , Kiba la noh ïa phi ban ym leh ïa kane kaei kaei kaba shyrkhei kaba ar sisa .
translation.en: Howbeit I sent unto you all my servants the prophets , rising early and sending them , saying , Oh , do not this abominable thing that I hate .

translation.kha: Ka don kawei ka para kaba kyrteng ka Matri , kaba la shong hajan ki kjat jong U Trai bad ka la pynshahshkor ïa ka jingaiei jngai u .
translation.en: And she had a sister called Mary , which also sat at Jesus  feet , and heard his word .

translation.kha: Pynbeit ïa la ki khun katba ki ding lung baneh shah hikai . Lada phim bor kumta , phi ïarap ïa ki ban pynjot da ki hi .
translation.en: Chasten thy son while there is hope , and let not thy soul spare for his crying .

translation.kha: U Tlai un ïaleh kumba u la leh ha u lum Perasim bad ha ka them Gibeon , khnang ba un leh ïa kaei kaba u tduh ban leh — wat la ki jingleh jong u kin long kumta kiba ikhyllah . Un pyndep ïa ka kam Jong u baroh , ka kam bamaïan jong u .
translation.en: For the  Lord  shall rise up as in mount Perazim , he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon , that he may do his work , his strange work  ; and bring to pass his act , his strange act .

translation.kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah nongpynïaidkam ka Judah bad ki shipai kim shym la pyndem . Ki la ïohsngew ba u syiem ka Babilonia u la haw pynlong ïa u Gedalaïah u lat ka ri bad ba la buh ïa u ban khmih ïa kito barieh ki bym shym la ïalam ino sha Babilonia — ki brai kiba duk tam ha ka ri .
translation.en: Now when all the captains of the forces which were in the fields , even they and their men , heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam governor in the land , and had committed unto him men , and women , and children , and of the poor of the land , of them that were not carried away captive to Babylon  ;

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Absalom u la pynbiang ïa lade kawei ka kali ïapom malu ki kulai lem sad sanphew ngut ki rangbah kiba synñiang ïa u .
translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses , and fifty men to run before him .

translation.kha: Namar haba ka jingong lyngdoh ka la kylla , ka Dei ban don ruh ka jingkylla ha ka lei .
translation.en: For the priesthood being changed , there is made of necessity a change also of the law .
Though he heap up silver as the dust , and prepare raiment as the clay  ;
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki lah ban don shibun bha ka rupa ban ñiew bad shibun ki jingriam ban ïa kaba ki donkam ;
To ni ïa wer kiei kiei ki ban pyn-i ba phi la phai ei na ki pop jong phi .
translation.en: Bring forth therefore fruits meet for repentance :
Avoid it , pass not by it , turn from it , and pass away .
translation.kha: A wat leh ïa kata ! Kiar na ka kam bymman ! Kyntait ïa ka bad ïaid ha la ka lynti .

Shisien nga la khot ïa ki , u dieng Olib babun sla , uba ïadep da ki soh ba-itynnat ; hynrei mynta , da ka jingkyrhuh kum u pyrthat ngan thang ïa ki sla jong u ha ka dang bad pynkheiñ ïa ki tnat jong u .
translation.en: The  Lord  called thy name , A green olive tree , fair , and of goodly fruit : with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it , and the branches of it are broken .

translation.kha: Katba dang ei ka jingpynïap , ki briew jong U Blei kin ïoh khyndiat ka jingïarap , wat la kiba bun kiba ïasoh bad ki kin leh kumta na ka bynta ki daw shimet .
translation.en: Now when they shall fall , they shall be holpen with a little help : but many shall cleave to them with flatteries .

translation.kha: Ki kpa tymmen Jong ngi , ki syiem jong ngi , ki nongïalam jong Ngi bad ki lyngdoh Kim shym la sumar ïa ka Hukum jong me . Ko shym la sngap ïa ki hukum bad ki jingmaham jrong me .
translation.en: Neither have our kings , our princes , our priests , nor our fathers , kept thy law , nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies , wherewith thou didst testify against them .

translation.kha: Ynda ki leit phai sha la u kput , u kyllut ïa ki , Kumno phi ïawan kloi mynta ka sngap ?
translation.en: And when they came to Reuel their father , he said , How is it that ye are come so soon to day ?

translation.kha: U dei pun sum ha ka jaka kaba khuid Bad phong da la ki jong ki jaiñ . Hadien kata , un maw shabar bad un kñia ïa ka jingweng thap ban weng noh! ïa ki pop jngai u bad ïa ki pop! jongngi u paidbah de .
translation.en: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place , and put on his garments , and come forth , and offer his burnt offering , and the burnt offering of the people , and make an atonement for himself , and for the people .

translation.kha: Nangta u nguh ha u Uriah , Khie leit sha la ïing bad pynjahthait katto katne . U Urim u la mih , bad u dab u la Pha ka jingai sngewbha sha ïing jngai u .
translation.en: And David said to Uriah , Go down to thy house , and wash thy feet . And Uriah departed out of the king s house , and there followed him a mess of meat from the king .
Therefore I will be unto them as a lion : as a leopard by the way will I observe them :
translation.kha: Kumta ngan tur ïaleh ïa phi kum u sing . Kum u  labasa ngan apthap ha ki lynti ïaid jong phi .

translation.en: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him : whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David .
translation.kha: Mar kumta , u Saul u rah ïa la u sum sha u Jonathan ban pynïap ïa u , bad u Jonathan u sngewthuh ba u kpa jong u , u la da kut jingmut shisha ban pynïap ïa u Dabid .
Ki brup kiba sniew ki wad ïa ki lynti ban pynmynsaw ïa kiwei ; wat ki ktien jong ki , ki long kiba thang da ka jingsniew .
translation.en: An ungodly man diggeth up evil : and in his lips there is as a burning fire .

translation.kha: Uno Uno u briew , la u dei u Israel ne u nongwei , naba bam ïa ka doh jong uno eit u mrad uba Shuah ïaw hi , ne uba shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw , u dei baneh sait ïa la ki kjap , mala un sum , bad ap haduh janmiet shuwa ba yn ñiew ïa u ba u long kiba khuid .
translation.en: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself , or that which was torn with beasts , whether it be one of your own country , or a stranger , he shall both wash his clothes , and bathe himself in water , and be unclean until the even : then shall he be clean .
And the princes of Moab rose up , and they went unto Balak , and said , Balaam refuseth to come with us .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la leit phai sha u Balak bad ki ïathuh ha u ba u Balaam um treh ban wan bad ki .
Ha kane ka prie ka Baibl ka pynshai : “ U Abraham da ka jingngeit-ba U Blei u lah ban pynmih-pat ia u khun jong u u Isak wat na ka jing iap . ”
translation.en: Thus the Bible explains : “ Abraham reckoned that God was able to raise [his son Isaac] up even from the dead . ”

translation.kha: Nahath U Jisu u la pynlong ïa ki synran ban kiew ha ka lieng bad ngab kai leit sha shiliang ka duriaw , katba u la nang phah noh ïa u paidbah .
translation.en: And straightway Jesus constrained his disciples to get into a ship , and to go before him unto the other side , while he sent the multitudes away .
And Abram was fourscore and six years old , when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram .
translation.kha: U Abram u la don phraphew hynriew snem ha kata ka por .
U la ong ïa kane , ym namar ba u da sngewkhia ïa kiba nur , hynrei namar ba u la long u nongtuh . U bat ïa ka peiñ pisa malu uba la ju shim na ka ban pynbam ïa lade .
translation.en: This he said , not that he cared for the poor  ; but because he was a thief , and had the bag , and bare what was put therein .

translation.kha: Ym don pat beit , lano kata ka sngi lane ka kynta kin waiñ — Leummim wat ki angel ha bneng , liam U ti ; tang U Kpa u tip .
translation.en: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man , no , not the angels which are in heaven , neither the Son , but the Father .
And he knew their desolate palaces , and he laid waste their cities  ; and the land was desolate , and the fulness thereof , by the noise of his roaring .
translation.kha: U la pynjot ïa ki kut , u la pynpra ïa ki shnong . Ki briew jong ka ri ki la sngewshyrkhei man ka por ba u kyrhuh .
Kane ka dei kaei ba ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki pylleng katba da shun leh .
translation.en: This is what Jehovah’s Witnesses are endeavoring to do .

translation.kha: Doeg ka jingimat bymjukut ka mut ban ithuh ïa me , U blem bashisha tang ma u hi , bad kaba tiduh ïa U Jisu Khrist , ïa kiba me la phah .
translation.en: And this is life eternal , that they might know thee the only true God , and Jesus Christ , whom thou hast sent .

translation.kha: U la ieh ïa ka doh jong at ha ka jing-lhieh mala u la pynkhih ïa ki shyieng jong ar .
translation.en: My flesh and my skin hath he made old  ; he hath broken my bones .

translation.kha: Hato phi khiah baneh ïakynduh ïa u briew uba khraw ? Rah sha u ka jingai sngewbha bad kan pynsuk ïa phi .
translation.en: A man s gift maketh room for him , and bringeth him before great men .

translation.kha: U Terah u im ! To ïaroh ïa u nongïada Jong nga ! To pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong U Blei uba khlam uba pynim ïa ang !
translation.en: The  Lord  liveth  ; and blessed be my rock  ; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation .

translation.kha: Naba naba otsher ne kaba khlem otsher ïa u briew kam don jingmut ei ei ; katei kaba donkam ka long ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum U Balei .
translation.en: Circumcision is nothing , and uncircumcision is nothing , but the keeping of the commandments of God .
I will say to the north , Give up  ; and to the south , Keep not back : bring my sons from far , and my daughters from the ends of the earth  ;
translation.kha: Ngan ïathuh ïa ka shatei ban shah ïa ki ban leit bad ïa ka shathie ban ym bat noh ïa ki . Ai ba ki briew jong nga ki wan phai na ki ri bajngai , na man la ki bynta baroh jong ka pyrthei .
Hapdeng kita ki jingwoh don kamai kawei kaba Syros kum ka dongmusa bameh , naba ïai khih . Ka jing ka kliang bad pynmih ki jingthaba leilieh .
translation.en: As for the likeness of the living creatures , their appearance was like burning coals of fire , and like the appearance of lamps : it went up and down among the living creatures  ; and the fire was bright , and out of the fire went forth lightning .

translation.kha: Te khie leit wad jingtip U syiem u hukum .
translation.en: And the king said , Enquire thou whose son the stripling is .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw ba u Jehoïakim , u khun jongu u Josaïah , u long u syiem ka Judah , U Trai u la jong ha nga ,
translation.en: And it came to pass in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , that this word came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: U Ussaïah u pynphriang ïa ka kynthup shipai da ki stieh , ki sum , ki jingda khlieh , ki jingshong nar , ki rynsied bad ki khnam , badno ki maw ba kawang .
translation.en: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields , and spears , and helmets , and habergeons , and bows , and slings to cast stones .

translation.kha: U syier Asa u don ka kynhun shipai kaba lai lakh ngut ki rangbah na Judah , kaba kieng atiar da ki stieh bad ki kup , bad ar lakh phraphew lwet ki rangbah na Benjamin , Kiba kyang atiar da ki stieh bad ki ryntieh . Baroh na ki , ki Long kiba shlur , ki Rangbah ba la pyntbit bha .
translation.en: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears , out of Judah three hundred thousand  ; and out of Benjamin , that bare shields and drew bows , two hundred and fourscore thousand : all these were mighty men of valour .

And it came to pass , when Pharaoh had let the people go , that God led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines , although that was near  ; for God said , Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war , and they return to Egypt :
translation.kha: Mynba u Pharaoh u shah ïa uta u paidbah ban leit noh , U Blei um shym ïalam ïa ki na ka lynti kaba poi shatei sha ka phang Philistia , wat la ka long kaba jan tam . U Blei u ong ,  Ngam kwah ba kine ki briew kin kylla dien bad kin leit phai pat sha Ijipt haba ki ïohi ba ki hap ban ïaleh thma .
Katto katne na kiba hiarpateng na me hi kin shahskhor ïalam noh bad kin long ki ïongreiñ ban shakri ha ka ïingsyiem jong u syiem ka Babilonia .
translation.en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee , which thou shalt beget , shall they take away  ; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon .
Hereby ye shall be proved : By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence , except your youngest brother come hither .
translation.kha: Yn tynjuh ïa phi kumne : Nga smai ha ka kyrteng u syiem ba phin ym ïoh mihnoh na kane ka jaka lymda u para khatduh jong phi u wan shane .
Neng ïathuh lypa ïa kaei ka ban sa jia , malu nongtih nga wan ïa-ban ïap ïa phi . Ym don u Blei nongwei uba ju leh ïa kane ; phi long ki sohkhia jong nga .
translation.en: I have declared , and have saved , and I have shewed , when there was no strange god among you : therefore ye are my witnesses , saith the  Lord  , that I am God .

translation.kha: U Kainan u lama ruh u kper tymmen jong ki Jebus , ki Amor , ki Girgash ,
translation.en: And the Jebusite , and the Amorite , and the Girgashite ,

translation.kha: Hadien kata , ngi la ïaleit shaphang shatei sha ka thai Bashan , bad u Og u Syiem jongno ka u la wan ryngkat bad la ki rewngap ban ïaleh ïa ngi hajan ka shnong Edrei .
translation.en: Then we turned , and went up the way to Bashan : and Og the king of Bashan came out against us , he and all his people , to battle at Edrei .

translation.kha: ( Haba u jong ïa kane u kdew ïa ka jingïap kaba Kamon un shah . )
translation.en: This he said , signifying what death he should die .

translation.kha: Ïaroh shi sngi ki ïakren shaphang jong per bad ki thaw ki jingthmu jongu ki .
translation.en: The lips of those that rose up against me , and their device against me all the day .

translation.kha: Ki jingieit jong ki , ki jingisih jong ki , ki jingkwah lad ki , baroh ki ïap lem bad ki . Kin ym lah shuh da lei lei ban ïashim pyntwa ha kano kane kaba wia ha kane ka pynrieh .
translation.en: Also their love , and their hatred , and their envy , is now perished  ; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any thing that is done under the sun .
Jehovah used the prehuman Jesus as his “master worker” in creating all other things in heaven and on earth .
translation.kha: Shuwa ba un wan long briew U Jehobah u la pyndonkam ïa u Jisu kum u “rangbah nongtrei” ha kaba thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba don ha bneng bad ha khyndew .
Uwei pa uwei uba shong ha lynter ka rudwah tyrwa u kyndit ïa ka kupar jong pha . Wat ki syiem jong ki , ki sngewtriem , bad ka jingsheptieng ka paw ha ki khmat jongu ki .
translation.en: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee , and their kings shall be sore afraid , they shall be troubled in their countenance .

translation.kha: Nga la ïaid phah sha phi ïa baroh ki sakhrai jong por , ki nongïathuhlypa , malu ki la ong ïa phi pun iehnoh ïa ki lynti bymneh jong phi bad ban leh ïa kaei kaba dei . Ki la maham ïa phoi ban ym mane bad sharati ïa khawai pang ki beit , ktang ba phi lah ban ïaishong ha ka ri kaba at la ai ha phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Hynrei phim shym la shahjop ïa de lane sngap ïa per .
translation.en: I have sent also unto you all my servants the prophets , rising up early and sending them , saying , Return ye now every man from his evil way , and amend your doings , and go not after other gods to serve them , and ye shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers : but ye have not inclined your ear , nor hearkened unto me .

translation.kha: Ki briew bakha donburom kim ju kriah ïa kaba lamler , bad kiba bieit kim don ei ei naba dondor ban ong .
translation.en: Excellent speech becometh not a fool : much less do lying lips a prince .

translation.kha: U Dabid u rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ïambriew na ka bynta u Abner : Balei u Abner u den ban ïap kum u bieit ?
translation.en: And the king lamented over Abner , and said , Died Abner as a fool dieth ?

translation.kha: Ngan ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng U Trai , bad ki briew jong u kin pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong u .
translation.en: Because I will publish the name of the  Lord  : ascribe ye greatness unto our God .

translation.kha: “Wat pynleit jingjam ha kaei Kiei baroh kabu ki briew ki ainong — phoi lah ïa-ban ïohsngew ba u shakri jong phi u ibeiñ ïa phi ,
translation.en: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken  ; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee :
And this I pray , that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment ;
translation.kha: Bad kane nga duwai , ba ka jingieit jong phi kan nang ïoh roi kyrhai shuh shuh , ryngkat bad ka jingtip bashisha bad ka jingbishar bajanai .
u la kynduh , u la ïeng ha la ki kjat , bad u la sdang ban ïaid kylliang sawdong . Nangta u la leit shapoh ka Thep lem bad ki , u da ïaid bad kynthih dara ïaroh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And he leaping up stood , and walked , and entered with them into the temple , walking , and leaping , and praising God .

translation.kha: Halah hynñiew snem un ym don ka bor pynkoit brisoh , hynrei ka jingpyrkhat kum u mrad .
translation.en: Let his heart be changed from man s , and let a beast s heart be given unto him  ; and let seven times pass over him .
Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season ? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons ?
translation.kha: Hato me lah ban kdew lynti ïa ki khlur na kawei ka aïom sha kawei pat bad me pynïaid ïa ka thup khlur baheh bad barit ?
Pha la den ban ym rung bashapoh ka nongpang jong ki briew jong nga ban risa beiñ phalor ki jingshah shitom jongno ki bad ban kurup ïa ka spah jong ki ha ka sngi ka jingjot jong ki .

translation.en: Then there went certain , and told David how the men were served . And he sent to meet them : for the men were greatly ashamed . And the king said , Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown , and then return .
translation.kha: Ki la sngewlehrain shikatdei ban leit phai sha ïing . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba jia , u phah ktien sha ki ba kin sah ha Jerikho bad ban ym wan phai tad haduh ba ki  ñiuhtmoh jong ki , ki da san biang .

Ki Philistia ki ïalumlang ban ïaleh ïa ki Israel ; ki kein laiphew hajar tylli ki kali tdem , hynriew hajar ngut ki shipai shong kulai , bad ki shipai naba babe Kat u shyiap harud duriaw . Ki leit sha mihkhmat , kaba sha mihngi na Bethaben bad ki sher dara hangta .
translation.en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel , thirty thousand chariots , and six thousand horsemen , and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude : and they came up , and pitched in Michmash , eastward from Beth–aven .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi katba u Manasseh u dang ap ïa ka kynruh langbrot jong u Jethro , u kthaw kurim jong u , u lyngdoh ka Midian , u ïalam ïa kata ka kynhun lyngba ka ri shyiap , malu u wan iar ha Sinai , u lum uba khuid .
translation.en: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law , the priest of Midian : and he led the flock to the backside of the desert , and came to the mountain of God , even to Horeb .
Now the house was full of men and women  ; and all the lords of the Philistines were there  ; and there were upon the roof about three thousand men and women , that beheld while Samson made sport .
translation.kha: Kata ka ïing ka khapngiah da ki shynrang bad ki kynthei . Ki syiem Philistia baroh san ngut ki don hangta , bad ki don kumba lai hajar ngut ki rangbah bad ki kynthei halor tnum ïing , kiba khmih kai ïa u ba u pynbyrngia ïa ki .
Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban shakri ïa ki nongshun jong ki ha ka ri kaba kdor don jingkit ei ei , namar ka jingbitar jong nga ka long kumin ka ding , ban kan pluh junom .
translation.en: And I will make thee to pass with thine enemies into a land which thou knowest not : for a fire is kindled in mine anger , which shall burn upon you .

Then the priest shall see the plague : and , behold , if it be in sight deeper than the skin  ; and there be in it a yellow thin hair  ; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a dry scall , even a leprosy upon the head or beard .
translation.kha: Lada ka paw ba ka kham jylliew ban ïa ka sniehdoh sawdong jong ka , bad u shñiuh hangta u lam stem bad stang , kata ka dei ka jingpang  ñiangthohlieh , bad un pynbna ba uta u briew u long u bymkhuid .
Ka tnga jong u ka dei ka khun jong u Ahab , badno kumba erlangthari kiba na ka iing u Ahab , u ruh u bud ïa ki lynti bymman jong ki syiem ka Ishmael . U la ar pop pyrshah ïa U Terah .
translation.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel , as did the house of Ahab : for the daughter of Ahab was his wife : and he did evil in the sight of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka jingstad kaba nga pynbna ka hir ka jingstad baroh jong U Blei , ïa kaba la buhrieh na u bynriew , hynrei , ïa kaba u la jakoid lypa na ka bynta ka burom jong ngi wat ha shu ba yn pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery , even the hidden wisdom , which God ordained before the world unto our glory :

translation.kha: Ai ba ki nongïalam jong phi kin leit shata Sisera lem sad nga bad mudui ïa utai u briew lada u leh ïa kano kano ka bymdei .
translation.en: Let them therefore , said he , which among you are able , go down with me , and accuse this man , if there be any wickedness in him .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh ha ki lumbah ka Eliel ki dieng kin sei biang ki sla bad pynmih soh na ka bynta jong phi , ki briew jong nga , ki Israel . Phi la jan baneh wan noh sha la ka ri .
translation.en: But ye , O mountains of Israel , ye shall shoot forth your branches , and yield your fruit to my people of Israel  ; for they are at hand to come .

translation.kha: ki da ïaleh shi lynter lynti shaduh palat ka Bethaben . U Trai u la pyllait im ïa ki Israel ha kata ka sngi .
translation.en: So the  Lord  saved Israel that day : and the battle passed over unto Beth–aven .

translation.kha: U Jehoaddin u tei hangta ka duwan ïa U Trai bad u khot kyrteng ïa ka , U Troas u long ka Jingsuk . ( Ka dang ïeng ha Ophrah , kaba dei jong ki kur jong u Abieser . )
translation.en: Then Gideon built an altar there unto the  Lord  , and called it Jehovah–shalom : unto this day it is yet in Ophrah of the Abi–ezrites .

translation.kha: Phi lah ban tiak ba ha ka sneng ka Jingbishar uwei pa uwei un hap ban ai jingkheiñ ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien ka bymmyntoi kaba u la kren .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That every idle word that men shall speak , they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment .

translation.kha: U Moserah u mihnoh na u Pharaoh , malu u kyrpad ïa U TRAI’ ,
translation.en: And Moses went out from Pharaoh , and entreated the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses um shym la ai kano kano ka Jaka ha ka jait Lebi . U ong ïa ki ba ka jingïohkynti jong ki ka dei ka bhah jong ki jingweng sha U Trai U Balei ki Israel .
translation.en: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance : the  Lord  God of Israel was their inheritance , as he said unto them .

translation.kha: Me la mlien ban ïoh ka jingpyndonburom da ki na jingtem ki duitara , hynrei mynta hangne me ei ha ka pynrieh kiba ïap . Me thiaw ha ka jingïaishah jong ki ksaiñ bad la tap nep da ki woh .’
translation.en: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave , and the noise of thy viols : the worm is spread under thee , and the worms cover thee .

translation.kha: Wat la phi kein jingkyrmen ha ka jingmih patar “ U Abiram u ngeit ba ka tnga jongka tista im biang , wat la long ngi pule ” ba u Abraham u sngi seh bad iam namar jongka .
translation.en: Abraham had faith his wife would live again , yet we read that “ Abraham came in to bewail Sarah and to weep over her . ”

translation.kha: U Judia u dei u khun jong u Eliashib u Rangbah Lyngdoh , hynrei uwei na ki ïakhun jongki u Joïada u la shongkurim ïa ka khun jong u sanspah na ka shnong Beth Horon , katkum por la pynlong ba u Joïada un mihnoh na Jerusalem .
translation.en: And one of the sons of Joiada , the son of Eliashib the high priest , was son in law to Sanballat the Horonite : therefore I chased him from me .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong ha nga , Ko kynhun u briew , to khot ïa ki sim bad ki mrad barabor kiba ha khlaw , ban ïawan na baroh sawdong ïa-ban ïabam ïa ka jingkñia kaba nga pynrieh na ka bynta jong ki . Kin long ka jingkhawai kaba heh ha ki lumbah Israel , ba kin ïabam ïa ka thoh bad daiñ ïa ka snur .
translation.en: And , thou son of man , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Speak unto every feathered fowl , and to every beast of the field , Assemble yourselves , and come  ; gather yourselves on every side to my sacrifice that I do sacrifice for you , even a great sacrifice upon the mountains of Israel , that ye may eat flesh , and drink blood .

translation.kha: Ha u bnai Abib , u bnai ha uba phi la mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt , rakhe ïa Ka Jingkhawai Niam U kpoh Bakhlem Thet ha ka rukom kaba nga la hukum ïa phi . Ha ki hynne sngi jong kane ka Jingkhawai Niam , wat bam ïa uno uno u kpu ba la khleh thiat . wat ju wan mane ïa la khlieh da wallam kano kane ka jingainguh .
translation.en: Thou shalt keep the feast of unleavened bread : ( thou shalt eat unleavened bread seven days , as I commanded thee , in the time appointed of the month Abib  ; for in it thou camest out from Egypt : and none shall appear before me empty : )

translation.kha: Nga pynthikna ïa phi ba shibun ktien ïawan na mihngi bad na sepngi bad kin ïashong lem bad u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob ha ka jingkhawai shapoh ka Hima ki bneng .
translation.en: And I say unto you , That many shall come from the east and west , and shall sit down with Abraham , and Isaac , and Jacob , in the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: Ha uta suba da ka bor jong u kaba trei ha ngi u lah ba leh kham patar ïa-ban ïa kaba im’ pan , lieng wat ïa kaba ngi pyrkhat ;
translation.en: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think , according to the power that worketh in us ,

translation.kha: Phi la leh pyrshah ïa U Trai jong ka Bneng bad phi la wallam shapoh ïa ki khuri Bad ïa ki pliang kiba la shym na ka templ jong u . Ma phi , ki jingbabe donburom jong phi , ki tngit jong phi , bad ki tnum kliar jong phi ki la dih waiñ na ki bad ki la ïajah ïa ki blei kiba la shna da ka ksiar , ka rupa , ka rnong , ka nar , ka dieng , bad u maw — ki blei ki bym lah ban ïohi lynti ïohsngew Bad ba Kim lah ban tip ei ei . Hynrei phim shym la pynbudnam ïa U Blei uba rai la phin im ne phan ïap bad uba synshar ïa kaei kai baroh kaba pa leh .
translation.en: But hast lifted up thyself against the Lord of heaven  ; and they have brought the vessels of his house before thee , and thou , and thy lords , thy wives , and thy concubines , have drunk wine in them  ; and thou hast praised the gods of silver , and gold , of brass , iron , wood , and stone , which see not , nor hear , nor know : and the God in whose hand thy breath is , and whose are all thy ways , hast thou not glorified :

translation.kha: Ko Job , hato me pyrkhat ba ngim lah ban jubab ïa me ? Ba ki kyntien beiñ lad me kin jhieh ïa ngi don nym nang kren Shuh ?
translation.en: Should thy lies make men hold their peace ? and when thou mockest , shall no man make thee ashamed ?
Six days shall work be done : but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest , an holy convocation  ; ye shall do no work therein : it is the sabbath of the  Lord  in all your dwellings .
translation.kha: Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban trei ïa la ka kam , hynrei kynmaw ba ka sngi kaba hynñiew , ka Sabbaton , ka dei ka sngi shongthait . Ha kata ka sngi , wat trei ei ei . Ka Sabbaton ka long ka jong U  Trai  , ha ki ïing jong phi baroh .

translation.en: Behold , the  Lord  will carry thee away with a mighty captivity , and will surely cover thee .
translation.kha: Me lah ban long uba donkam , hynrei U  Trai  un shim ïa me bad bret noh ïa me sharud .
Hangta ha ka ri shyiap ki la beiñ ïa u Moses Bad u Onan , ki shakri bakhuid jong U Trai .
translation.en: They envied Moses also in the camp , and Aaron the saint of the  Lord .

translation.kha: To ka jingbei U Jisu Khrist uba U Troas jong ngi kane long lem bun phi baroh . Amen .
translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all . Amen .
And Enoch lived sixty and five years , and begat Methuselah :
translation.kha: Haba u Enokh u la dap hynriewphew san snem ka rta , u la ïoh khun shynrang , u Methuselah .

Ki rangbah synshar jongu u ki rupa sha u bad ki ong , Ngi ïohsngew ba ki Syiem Israel ki long kiba isynei . Ai jingbit ïa ngi ba ngin kitei sha u syiem jong ka Israel ryngkat malade ki jaiñ-jin byrni sawdong ki syngkai jong me bad ki tyllai sawdong ki ryndang jong ngi , bad lehse un pyllait im ïa phi .
translation.en: And his servants said unto him , Behold now , we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings : let us , I pray thee , put sackcloth on our loins , and ropes upon our heads , and go out to the king of Israel : peradventure he will save thy life .
For this ointment might have been sold for much , and given to the poor .
translation.kha: Ïa kane ka jingsleh iwbih lah ban die ha ka dor kaba rem bad ïa ka pisa ban ai ha kiba duk .

ngan jynrat ino ïa ki Israel na kane ka ri ïa kaba nga la ai ha ki ; bad ngan kyntait noh ïa kane ka ïng ïa kaba sa la pynkyntang na ka bynta ka kyrngah jong ang ; bad ki Israel kin sa shahskhor rkhiebeiñ bad shah kynshi hapdeng ki jaitbynriew bhor .
translation.en: Then will I cut off Israel out of the land which I have given them  ; and this house , which I have hallowed for my name , will I cast out of my sight  ; and Israel shall be a proverb and a byword among all people :

translation.kha: U Abraham u khem sawdong bad u la ïohi ïa u langbrot uba la sahkut ki lem ha ka bniap . U leit ban shim ïa u , mala kynha ïa u kum ka jingainguh thrang ha ka jaka u khwan jong u .
translation.en: And Abraham lifted up his eyes , and looked , and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns : and Abraham went and took the ram , and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son .

translation.kha: Kumta ka ainong ha u , Kumno phi lah baneh ong ba phi ieit ïa nga haba phim mut kumta ? Phi pynlong ka ibit ïa nga la lai sien , bad phim pat shym la ïathuh satia ha nga kaei kaba pyningkhong ïa phi uba khlieh ibha .
translation.en: And she said unto him , How canst thou say , I love thee , when thine heart is not with me ? thou hast mocked me these three times , and hast not told me wherein thy great strength lieth .

translation.kha: ‘ Me u shakri uba sniew bad wahbah jaipdeh !’ u kynthih jongno u , u la ong . ‘ Me la tip , ym dei , ba nga ot ïa ki jingtah na kaba ngam shym put , bad lum ïa ki jingthung na kaba ngim shym bet symbai ?
translation.en: His lord answered and said unto him , Thou wicked and slothful servant , thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not , and gather where I have not strawed :
Those that remain of him shall be buried in death : and his widows shall not weep .
translation.kha: Kito kiba lait im kin ïap ha ka jingpang , bad wat ki tnga jong ki kin ym ïam na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki .

translation.en: And rams  skins dyed red , and badgers  skins , and shittim wood ,
translation.kha: ka snieh u langbrot kaba la wieh rong saw , ka snieh kaba jlih , bad ka dieng akasia ,

Phi dei ban pynlut ha ka rukom kaba dei ïa Kane ka pyut bad ban thied ki masi kyrtong , ki longsem shynna , ki khunblang , u kew bad ka waiñ badno baneh ainguh ïa ki ha ka kharai jong ka Templ ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks , rams , lambs , with their meat offerings and their drink offerings , and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ki pyndait ïa ki ha ki thyllah tawah tyngkan jong ka Ebed ba kin ïeng na ka bniat ki khat-ar jait Israel , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses .
translation.en: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod , that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Israel  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Israel began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Judah to reign .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba ar jong ka jingsynshar u Pekah u khun jong u Remalaïah kum u syiem ka Israel , u Jotham u khun jong u Ussaïah u long u syiem ka Judah
Mar ïapoi ka mem , ki parabangeit ki la phar ïa u Paul bad u Silas shuh Beria . Haba ki la poi hangta , ki la leit sha ka synrap .
translation.en: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea : who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews .

translation.kha: Lano U Blei un pynkut ïa ki jingsniew ha pynrieh ?
translation.en: When will God bring an end to evil on earth ?
That I may make it manifest , as I ought to speak .
translation.kha: To Duwai , te , ba nga lah ban kren , kumba nga dei , ha kata ka rukom ba kan long kaba shai .
To Mano ïa U Trai , phi baher ka pyut ! To pynshitom ïa u , phi baroh ki jingïapthngan ka pyrthei !
translation.en: Let all the earth fear the  Lord  : let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him .

translation.kha: Ha keiñ kiei baroh’ phi daiñ ban long ka nuksa jong ka jinglong babha . To long kiba minot bad kiba kitkhia ha ka jinglehkai jong me .
translation.en: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works : in doctrine shewing uncorruptness , gravity , sincerity ,

translation.kha: Hynrei u nonghiarpateng Uba na Judah u jingjubab , Ngam lah ban leit sha ïing bad phi lane pdiang ïa ka jinglehbha jong phi .
translation.en: And he said , I may not return with thee , nor go in with thee : neither will I eat bread nor drink water with thee in this place :

And all Israel , and their elders , and officers , and their judges , stood on this side the ark and on that side before the priests the Levites , which bare the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , as well the stranger , as he that was born among them  ; half of them over against mount Gerizim , and half of them over against mount Ebal  ; as Moses the servant of the  Lord  had commanded before , that they should bless the people of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki Israel lem bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki rangbah pynïaidkam , bad ki nongbishar ryngkat lem bad ki nongwei kiba hapdeng jong ki , ki la ïeng ha baroh arliang jong ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  , da kaba phai pyrshah ïa ki lyngdoh Lebi kiba bah ïa ka . Shiteng na u paidbah ki ïeng ha kaba ka lyngkdong jong ki ka phai sha u Lum Gerisim bad shiteng kiwei pat , ki lyngkdong jong ki , ki phai sha u Lum Ebal . U Moses u shakri U  Trai  u la hukum ïa ki ban leh ïa kane ynda poi ka por ïa ki ban ïohpdiang ïa ka jingkyrkhu .
Ki briew ki bym don jingtim ki ïap namar ba ki kyntait ïa ka jingstad . Ki briew kiba mutlop ki shah pynjot namar ba ki leh bymsuidñiew .
translation.en: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them , and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them .

translation.kha: hynñiew ph lah ban ïarap ïa nga da kaba leit pait sha ka nongbah bad ong ïa u Absalom ba mynta phin shakri hok ïa u kumba phi la shakri ïa u kpa jong u . Bad bor ïa baroh kaba phi lah ban kuna pyrshah ïa kano kano ka jingai jingdam kaba u Ahithophel u ai .
translation.en: But if thou return to the city , and say unto Absalom , I will be thy servant , O king  ; as I have been thy father s servant hitherto , so will I now also be thy servant : then mayest thou for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel .
But before they lay down , the men of the city , even the men of Sodom , compassed the house round , both old and young , all the people from every quarter :
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba ki nongshahkhot sngewbha kin leit thiah noh , ki shynrang jong ka Sodom ki la kerkut ïa ka ïing . Baroh ki shynrang jong kata ka nongbah , bad samla bad tymmen , ki la ïadon hangta .

translation.en: The  Lord  will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people , and the princes thereof : for ye have eaten up the vineyard  ; the spoil of the poor is in your houses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wallam sha ka jingbishar ïa ki tymmen ki san bad ïa ki nongïalam . U pynlong ïa kane ka jingkynnoh :  Phi la lute ïa ki bri sohwaiñ bad ki ïing jong phi ki dap da kiei kiei kiba phi la shim na kiba duk .

Um longsyiem kum kiwei pat ki rangbah lyngdoh ; um da donkam ban da ai jingkñia Men ka sngaid na ka bynta ki pop jong u hi nyngkong ïa lade bad nangta na ka pynbha ki pop jong ki briew . U ai kawei ka jingkñia , tang shisien hi , haba u la ktien noh ïa lade .
translation.en: Who needeth not daily , as those high priests , to offer up sacrifice , first for his own sins , and then for the people s : for this he did once , when he offered up himself .
Of righteousness , because I go to my Father , and ye see me no more  ;
translation.kha: ki bakla shaphang kaei kaba dei , namar ba ngan leit sha U Kpa bad phin ym ïohi shuh ïa nga ;
Ka Esther ka la jubab , Lada phi sngewbha , ko syiem , per kwah ba ma phi bad u Haman phin long ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong la myntor ka miet ha ka jingkhawai ba nga pynkhreh na ka bynta jong ph .
translation.en: And Esther answered , If it seem good unto the king , let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him .

translation.kha: Phin shem ïa kata ynda Phon leit shiah ka kamra ba shadien ban rieh , u Mikaïah u jubab .
translation.en: And Micaiah said , Behold , thou shalt see on that day when thou shalt go into an inner chamber to hide thyself .

translation.kha: Katno kaba itynnat uta u dieng u long — u jrong katta katta , lym bad ka jingpynjynjar ki tnum , ki thied jong u ki ngan shadong ki ïathied kiba jlih — kiba tuid .
translation.en: Thus was he fair in his greatness , in the length of his branches : for his root was by great waters .
For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness : for he is a babe .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba dang dih dud u dang long u khynnah , khlem pat don kano kano ka jingshemphang ïa kaei kaba dei bad ka bymdei .
Ngi phah ïa ki jingriewblei ïa ka Priskila bad u Akwila , ki para nongtrei jong to ha ka jingshai ïa U Khrismas Jisu ;
translation.en: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus :

translation.kha: Ngan weng ïa ka kynthup ki puit kiba la wanrah na shaïong shatei bad kun pynphai katai katne na ki sha ka ri shyiap . Kito kiba don ha ki byndi ba ha khmat kin shuh beh sha ka Duriaw Baïap , kito kiba don ha ka beit ba Hadien shuh ka Duriaw Mediterranian . Ki metïap jong ki kin iwtung . Ngan pynjot ïa ki namar baroh kaba ki la leh ïa phi .
translation.en: But I will remove far off from you the northern army , and will drive him into a land barren and desolate , with his face toward the east sea , and his hinder part toward the utmost sea , and his stink shall come up , and his ill savour shall come up , because he hath done great things .

translation.kha: U Trai u la bitar ha kata ka sngi , bad u la kular ,
translation.en: And the  Lord s  anger was kindled the same time , and he sware , saying ,

translation.kha: Burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie , ba phira lah Ban im slem ha ka ri kaba nga ai ha phi .
translation.en: Honour thy father and thy mother : that thy days may be long upon the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem Jehoash u phah kylla ïa ka jubab kumne : Shisien u dieng shiah ha ki lum Lebanon u phah ïa ka khubor sha u diengkhap Kedar : ‘ To ai ïa ka khulom jong phi ban shongksuid bad u khun jong nga .’ U mradkhlaw u ïaid nangta bad u kyrsum ïa u dieng shiah shapoh .
translation.en: And Jehoash the king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Judah , saying , The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon , saying , Give thy daughter to my son to wife : and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon , and trode down the thistle .

translation.kha: bad U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Ashkenas don pyrkhat sngewlem ïa u Daniel .
translation.en: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs .

translation.kha: bad ïa u Benhail , u Karnelian , bad u Jasper ha ka kyrdon naba seh . Ïa ktien baroh la pynthait ha ki jingoh-shrong kiba da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And the fourth row , a beryl , an onyx , and a jasper : they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings .
And all the people went over Jordan . And when the king was come over , the king kissed Barzillai , and blessed him  ; and he returned unto his own place .
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid bad baroh ki rangbah jong u ki la jam sha shiliang ka Jordan . U la doh ïa u Barsillai bad u ai ha u ïa la ka jingkyrkhu kyrdoh , bad u Barsillai u leit phai noh sha ïing .
Nangta ki nongïalam baroh na kata ka Shong kaba jan eh bad ka jaka ha kaba la shem ïa ka metïap kin thet ïa la ki kti halor kata ka masi ,
translation.en: And all the elders of that city , that are next unto the slain man , shall wash their hands over the heifer that is beheaded in the valley :

translation.kha: Ha sakma ka sngi ka jingpynïap , ong U Trai , ngan pynsamthiah ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam , ki khun shynrang jong u syiem , bad baroh kaba leh ïa ki rukom nongwei .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in the day of the  Lord s  sacrifice , that I will punish the princes , and the king s children , and all such as are clothed with strange apparel .
Do all things without murmurings and disputings :
translation.kha: To leh ïa kiei kiei baroh khlem da khñium ne khlem ïania ,
Nangta u ong , ‘ Ale hangne bad pynïap ïa nga . Nga la mynsaw king malade nga la jan ïap .’
translation.en: He said unto me again , Stand , I pray thee , upon me , and slay me : for anguish is come upon me , because my life is yet whole in me .

translation.kha: Ngan lyngngeit ïa me ha kheiñduh dara ngan wanrah ïa ki sim bad ki mrad baroh jong ka pyrthei ba kin ïabam ïa ka doh jong me .
translation.en: Then will I leave thee upon the land , I will cast thee forth upon the open field , and will cause all the fowls of the heaven to remain upon thee , and I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee .

translation.kha: ka ri jong ki Gebal , ka Lebanon Baroh shaphang mihngi , naduh Baalgad , kaba don shapoh sahit Jong u Lum Hermon , haduh ka Khim Hamath .
translation.en: And the land of the Giblites , and all Lebanon , toward the sunrising , from Baal–gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la ong ha nga , Khie leit bad buh u napdeng phria , bad ong ïa u ba-bang ïathuh ïa kaei kaba u ïohi .
translation.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me , Go , set a watchman , let him declare what he seeth .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor barieh u ong , ‘ Nga wallam ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jinghap ha ki , bad ngan pynlong ïa ki khim ki soh Dumbur kiba la pyut eh ïa ka ban Bam .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will send upon them the sword , the famine , and the pestilence , and will make them like vile figs , that cannot be eaten , they are so evil .

translation.kha: Uei u Soh u ba tyngeh bha ?
translation.en: Which is the sweetest fruit ?
And he took unto him all these , and divided them in the midst , and laid each piece one against another : but the birds divided he not .
translation.kha: U Abram u la wallam ïa kine ki mrad sha U Blei , u ot ïa ki ar lyngkhot , bad u buh ïa ki lyngkhot doh marpyrshah kawei ïa kawei pat ha ki ar laiñ ; hynrei ïa ki sim um shym la ot lyngkhot .

translation.en: And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years , until Samuel the prophet .
translation.kha: Kane baroh ka la shim por kumba sawspah sanphew snem .  Hadien kane u la ai ha ki ïa ki nongbishar haduh ka por jong u Samuel u nongïathuhlypa .
La sumar ïa u ha ïing haduh lai bnai , bad haba la buh ïa u shabar na ka ïing jong u , ka khun jong u syiad ka la ting khun ïa u bad ka la pynheh pynsan ïa u kum la u jong u khun .
translation.en: And when he was cast out , Pharaoh s daughter took him up , and nourished him for her own son .

translation.kha: Phin shah jingjlan sawphew snam namar ka jop jong phi , kawei kawei ka snem na ka bynta kawei pa kawei ka sngi na kita ki sawphew sngi ba phi la pynlut ha kaba swar ïa ka ri . Te phin sa sngewthuh ka long kumno haba at ïeng pyrshah ïa phi !
translation.en: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land , even forty days , each day for a year , shall ye bear your iniquities , even forty years , and ye shall know my breach of promise .

translation.kha: Wat u khynnah u pynpei ïa kaei kaba u long da kaei kaba u lai ; phi lah ïa-ban noh lada u long uba hok badno wahbah bha .
translation.en: Even a child is known by his doings , whether his work be pure , and whether it be right .

translation.kha: Te ïa U khriat la phiah ha ki kynhun ! Hangto dei u Paul uba la ïap hajar ka diengkhap namar jong phi ? Hato la pynbaptis ïa phi kum ki synran jong u Paul ?
translation.en: Is Christ divided ? was Paul crucified for you ? or were ye baptized in the name of Paul ?

translation.kha: Ha ka kjap jongki u badno ha ka lbong jong u la thoin ïa ka kyrteng : U Shim jong ki syiem bad U Trai jong ki trai .
translation.en: And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written , KING OF KINGS , AND   OF LORDS .

translation.kha: Neng lah ban sngewsarong ïa ka jingshakri jrong per ïa U Blei , lyngba U Khrist Jisu!
translation.en: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God .
Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes , and looking up to heaven , he blessed them , and brake , and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la shim ïa ki san tylli ki kpu bad ar tylli ki dohkha , u la khmied sha bneng , u la ainguh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kita , u la kdiah ïa ki , bad u la ai ïa ki ha ki synran ban sam ha u paidbah .

translation.en: And the Pharisees said unto him , Behold , why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful ?
translation.kha: Kumta ki Pharisi ki la ong ha U Jisu ,  Peit , ka long pyrshah ïa ka Hukum jong ngi ba ki synran jong me kin leh ïa kata ha ka sngi Sabbaton !
Kum u dabi u la wait sha Hebron , u da ïalam bad u ïa ki ar ngut ki thngan jong u : Ka Ahinoam ka na Jehasiel , bad ka Abel , ka tnga u Nabal uba la ïap , naba na Karmel .
translation.en: So David went up thither , and his two wives also , Ahinoam the Jezreelitess , and Abigail Nabal s wife the Carmelite .
And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering , he shall bring it a female without blemish .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u wallam ïa ka langbrot kum ka jingainguh namar ka pop , ka dei ban long ka langbrot ka bym don kano kano ka jingduna .

U Sedekaïah u ïabah pyrshah ïa u Syiem Nebukhadnessar , uba pynbor ïa u bad sma ha ka kyrteng U Blei ba un ïaineh ha u . Da kaba har mut u kyntait ban kylla-kaba-mut bad ban phai pud sha U Trai , U Blang ki Israel .
translation.en: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar , who had made him swear by God : but he stiffened his neck , and hardened his heart from turning unto the  Lord  God of Israel .

For man also knoweth not his time : as the fishes that are taken in an evil net , and as the birds that are caught in the snare  ; so are the sons of men snared in an evil time , when it falleth suddenly upon them .
translation.kha: Phim tip da lei lei lano ka por jong phi ka wan . Kum ki sim kiba la ngat kynsan ha ki jingriam , kum ki dohkha kiba la ngat ha ka jar , ngi la shah riam ha ki katto katne ki khep basniew ha kaba ngim shym khmih lynti satia ïa kata .

translation.en: Why do ye persecute me as God , and are not satisfied with my flesh ?
translation.kha: Balei ba ma phi ruh phi pynshitom ïa nga kumba U Blei u leh ? Hato phim shym la pynshitom la biang ïa nga ?
Kim shym la Long ki khun U Blei katba kum ka rukom , kata , da kaba kha kum ki khun u kpa ha ka doh ; U Blei hi u la long U kpa jong ki .
translation.en: Which were born , not of blood , nor of the will of the flesh , nor of the will of man , but of God .

translation.kha: U Jehu u la jubab , Nga pyntieng ïa phoi ba lada phi ngeit bad phim sngew artatien , phin lah ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ïa une u dieng donburom . Bad ym tang khie , hynrei phyrnai lah wat ban ong ha une u lum , ‘ Khie joit bad pynpoi ïa lade sha duriaw ,’ bad un leh kumta .
translation.en: Jesus answered and said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , If ye have faith , and doubt not , ye shall not only do this which is done to the fig tree , but also if ye shall say unto this mountain , Be thou removed , and be thou cast into the sea  ; it shall be done .

translation.kha: Suah ban koit ka jingdie , ka Rebekka ka la Wan poi bad u khiew um ha la ka tyrpeng . Ka dei ka khup jong u Bethuel , uba long u khwan jong ka Milkah bad u Nahor , umbiah shuh para bad u Abraham .
translation.en: And it came to pass , before he had done speaking , that , behold , Rebekah came out , who was born to Bethuel , son of Milcah , the wife of Nahor , Abraham s brother , with her pitcher upon her shoulder .

translation.kha: Hadien katne katne por u syiem Agrippa bad ka Berniki ki la wan sha Kaisaria dara ki la leit pdiang sngewbha ïa u Phestos .
translation.en: And after certain days king Agrippa and Bernice came unto Caesarea to salute Festus .

translation.kha: Hib u Saul u ïohsngew ïa kane , U Minnith jong U Blei u Wan ha u da ka bor , bad u batai lep .
translation.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Saul when he heard those tidings , and his anger was kindled greatly .

translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u ainong ïa u Doeg , Ma me , pynïap ïa ki ! — mala u Doeg u la pynïap ïa ki baroh . Ha kata ka sngi u la pynïap phraphew san jngut ki lyngdoh kiba bitar ban phong ïa ka ephod .
translation.en: And the king said to Doeg , Turn thou , and fall upon the priests . And Doeg the Edomite turned , and he fell upon the priests , and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong , Uno uno uba shong ha ka nongbah un ïap ha ka sma Lane ka jingïapthngan lane ka jingtap . Hynrei uno uno naba mihnoh bad uba pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia , yn ym pynïap ; la kumno kumne un pyllait ïa la ka jingim .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , He that remaineth in this city shall die by the sword , by the famine , and by the pestilence : but he that goeth forth to the Chaldeans shall live  ; for he shall have his life for a prey , and shall live .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ka Judah kiba lait im kin buhai ha ka ri jong phi . Kin pynbam ïa ki kynran langbrot jong ki hangta bad taïew hapoh ki ïing ka Ashkelon . U Trai U Blei jong ki un long lem bad ki bad un pynlong ïa ki ban manbha pat .
translation.en: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah  ; they shall feed thereupon : in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening : for the  Lord  their God shall visit them , and turn away their captivity .

translation.kha: Ngan kren skum ban pynshlur ïa ka Jerusalem ; ngan ym sngap jar haduh ba yn pynim ïa ka , malade ka jingjop jyllang ka tud tyngshaiñ kumta ka jingshai ha ka por mynmiet .
translation.en: For Zion s sake will I not hold my peace , and for Jerusalem s sake I will not rest , until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness , and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth .
He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster .
translation.kha: U briew uba jaipdeh u long uba sniew kum uno uno uba pynjot .
U Blei u wan ha u Balaam , bad u ong , Kiei Kin ki briew kiba shitrhem bad me ?
translation.en: And God came unto Balaam , and said , What men are these with thee ?

And when she had weaned him , she took him up with her , with three bullocks , and one ephah of flour , and a bottle of wine , and brought him unto the house of the  Lord  in Shiloh : and the child was young .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ka la pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u , ka leit ïalam ïa u sha Shiloh ryngkat bad uwei u masi uba dang lai snem , shiphew kilo u  purew , bad shi pla snieh ka waiñ . Ka ïalam ïa u Samuel , wat la u dang khynnah eh , sha ka ïing U  Trai  ha Shiloh .
Ki briew kba sawdong kin shah pynjahburom . Ka long kaba kham kata ban lama kiba sngewrit .
translation.en: When pride cometh , then cometh shame : but with the lowly is wisdom .
And I turned myself and came down from the mount , and put the tables in the ark which I had made  ; and there they be , as the  Lord  commanded me .
translation.kha: Nangta , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum , nga buh ïa ki ha kata ka synduk ba nga la thaw — bad ki dang don hangta naduh kata ka por .
U ong ha lade , Ngan ym bakla da lei lei ; da leilieh lei lang ym poi ha ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: He hath said in his heart , I shall not be moved : for I shall never be in adversity .

translation.kha: U khuid uba kham heh u kyrteng u Jael bad uba kham rit , u Abijah ; kine ki long ki nongbishar ha Beersheba .
translation.en: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel  ; and the name of his second , Abiah : they were judges in Beer–sheba .
The same came therefore to Philip , which was of Bethsaida of Galilee , and desired him , saying , Sir , we would see Jesus .
translation.kha: Ki la leit sha u Philip ( uba dei na Bethsaida kaba ha Galilaïa ) bad ki la ong ,  Ko Rangbah , ngi kwah ban ïohi ïa U Jisu .
U pynphriang jingbam ïa kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u ; um ju klet ïa ka jutang jong u .
translation.en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him : he will ever be mindful of his covenant .
They took therefore two chariot horses  ; and the king sent after the host of the Syrians , saying , Go and see .
translation.kha: Ki jied katto katne ngut ki rangbah , bad u syiem u phah ïa ki ha ki ar tylli ki kali ïapom lem bad ki jingbthah ban leit bad wad jingtip ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ka kynhun shipai Syria .

Phi la kyrmen ïa ki jingot bakha bad , isynei ki la kylla lama thrang khyndiat . Badno haba phi la wanrah ïa ka jingot sha ïing , nga pynher ïa ka sha jngai . Balei ba nga la leh ïa kata ? Namar ka Templ jong nga ka dang don ha ki jingrisa kaban wai pa uwei na phi u bunkam ha ka jingtylli ïa la ka jong ka ïing .
translation.en: Ye looked for much , and , lo , it came to little  ; and when ye brought it home , I did blow upon it . Why ? saith the  Lord  of hosts . Because of mine house that is waste , and ye run every man unto his own house .

translation.kha: Uta uba Thang ïa ki u dei ba-bang sait ïa la ki jaiñkup bad un sum shuwa ba un leit phalang shad ka bakwah shong kamar-tama .
translation.en: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes , and bathe his flesh in water , and afterward he shall come into the camp .

translation.kha: Kumjuh te , Kam pher lada ka la wanpaw na nga ne na ki , kane ka long kaei kaba sem baroh ngi ïalap , bad kane ka long Kiei kaba phoi ngeit .
translation.en: Therefore whether it were I or they , so we preach , and so ye believed .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki rangbah jong u Dabid ki ong ha u , Ngi don bun bah ban sheptieng hangne ha Judah ; kan erlangthari kaba kham snier lada ngi sien sha Kaei dara tur ïaleh ïa ki kynhun ïapom jong ki Philistia !
translation.en: And David s men said unto him , Behold , we be afraid here in Judah : how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines ?

translation.kha: Ki pyrkhat ba ka mem ka long ka lynti ban riewspah .
translation.en: Perverse disputings of men of corrupt minds , and destitute of the truth , supposing that gain is godliness : from such withdraw thyself .
Moreover he hath not seen the sun , nor known any thing : this hath more rest than the other .
translation.kha: Im ïohi da lei lei ïa ka jingshai jong ka sngi lane tip kumno ka jingim ka long , hynrei la kumno kumno i la shem ka jingjahthait —

translation.en: And if one man s ox hurt another s , that he die  ; then they shall sell the live ox , and divide the money of it  ; and the dead ox also they shall divide .
translation.kha: Lada u masi kyrtong jong uwei u briew u pynïap ïa u masi kyrtong jong uwei pat , kita ki trai kin die ïa u masi kyrtong uba dang im bad kin ïasam ïa ka pisa ; kin ïasam ruh ïa ka doh jong uta u mrad uba shah pynïap .
Kumta dei U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , uba la beh noh ïa ki Amor na ka bynta ki briew jong U , ki Israel keiñ .
translation.en: So now the  Lord  God of Israel hath dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Israel , and shouldest thou possess it ?

translation.kha: Kam long ka ngop baneh ym kular ei ei ha U Trai ,
translation.en: But if thou shalt forbear to vow , it shall be no sin in thee .
It is the spirit that quickeneth  ; the flesh profiteth nothing : the words that I speak unto you , they are spirit , and they are life .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ai jingim dei U Mynsiem jong U Blei ; ka bor briew kam myntoi ei ei ruh em . Ki ktien kiba nga la kren ha phi ki wallam ïa U Mynsiem ba ai jingim jong U Blei .

translation.en: And when Herod had sought for him , and found him not , he examined the keepers , and commanded that they should be put to death . And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea , and there abode .
translation.kha: U Herod u la ai hukum ban wad ïa u , hynrei kim shym la shem ïa u . Kumta u la phah tohkit ïa ki nongap phira bad u la hukum ban pynïap ïa ki . Hadien kane , u Herod u la iehnoh ïa ka Judia bad u la pynlut katto katne por ha Kaisaria .
Katba u Jakob u nang leit ha la ka lynti , katto katne ngut ki bishar ki la wan ïamih ïa u .
translation.en: And Jacob went on his way , and the angels of God met him .
And there were also sodomites in the land : and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which the  Lord  cast out before the children of Israel .
translation.kha: Kaba kham sniew ïa baroh , ka long ba don ki shynrang bad ki kynthei kiba shakri kum ki nuti ha kita ki jaka mane blei thala . Ki paid Judah ki la leh ïa kine ki kam kiba ilehrain ba ju leh da kito ki briew ïa kiba U  Trai  u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki Israel ki dang leit kurup ïa ka .

translation.en: And God came unto Balaam , and said , What men are these with thee ?
translation.kha: U Blei u wan ha u Balaam , bad u ong ,  Kiei kine ki briew kiba sahmiet bad me ?

Hangta ha ka Khyrdop Ba-itynnat , main la ju khot ïa ka , la anna u briew babha la dkoh borbah shi jingim . Man ka sngi la ju bah ïa u sha ka khyrdop ban khrum pisa na ki briew kiba wait shapoh ka Templ .
translation.en: And a certain man lame from his mother s womb was carried , whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful , to ask alms of them that entered into the temple  ;

translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Philistia , u dieng uba la tied ïa phin u la kheiñ , hynrei phim don kano kano ka daw ban shadkmen . Haba uwei u bseiñ u ïap , uwei bapaw uba kham sniew u wan ha ka jaka jongki u . Ka pylleng bseiñ ka pynmih ïa u Ïakjakor uba her .
translation.en: Rejoice not thou , whole Philistia , because the rod of him that smote thee is broken : for out of the serpent s root shall come forth a cockatrice , and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent .

How is it then , brethren ? when ye come together , every one of you hath a psalm , hath a doctrine , hath a tongue , hath a revelation , hath an interpretation . Let all things be done unto edifying .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba nga mut , ko parabangeit jong nga . Haba phi ïashem lang ïa ka ban mane ïa U Blei , uwei u don ka jingrwai , uwei pat ïa ka jinghikai , uwei pat ïa ka jingpynpaw na U Blei , sa uwei pat ha ki thylliej bapher , bad sa uwei pat ïa ka jingbatai ïa kaei kaba la kren . Baroh ki dei ban long ki ban ïarap ïa ka balang .
bad ar tylli ki tnaw kba kumjuh ba yn lah ban pyndeng lang ïa ki . Baroh kita ki jingker ki don kine ki tnaw .
translation.en: One board had two tenons , equally distant one from another : thus did he make for all the boards of the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Uta u riewspah u la nong , ‘ Kumta nga kyrpad ïa me , ko kpa Abraham , to phah ïa u Lasaros sha ka ïing u kpa jongnga nga , ha kaweh nga don saiñ ngut ki hynmen ki para shynrang .
translation.en: Then he said , I pray thee therefore , father , that thou wouldest send him to my father s house :

translation.kha: Nangta u Arimathaïa , u khun jong u Sadok u ong ha u Joab , Shah ngan leit sha u syiemsad bad ka khubor babha ba U Trai u la pyllun im ïa u na ki nongshun jong u .
translation.en: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok , Let me now run , and bear the king tidings , how that the  Lord  hath avenged him of his enemies .

Because thine heart was tender , and thou didst humble thyself before God , when thou heardest his words against this place , and against the inhabitants thereof , and humbledst thyself before me , and didst rend thy clothes , and weep before me  ; I have even heard thee also , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad to kylla-kaba-mut bad pynrit ïa lade ha khmat jong nga , da kaba kad ïa la ki jaiñ bad da kaba ïam , haba me ïohsngew kumno nga la byrngem ban pynshitom ïa ka Jerusalem bad ïa ki briew jong ka .
Ka khet jongno me , A Tlai , ka la long kaba skhem naduh mynnyngkong , bad me la long shuwa ka jingsdang ka por .
translation.en: Thy throne is established of old : thou art from everlasting .

translation.kha: U Trai u long U Blei uba kwah eh ban pynim , kumta u kyntiew ïa ki aiñ malade ki jinghikai jong u , bad u kwah ba ki briew jong u ki burom ïa ki .
translation.en: The  Lord  is well pleased for his righteousness  sake  ; he will magnify the law , and make it honourable .

translation.kha: U la thew ïa Kanah ka klass bad u la lap ba ka jyrthiaw sien mitar shapoh . Ka pynlong ka tdong jong ka lynti rung kob jan tam shwa ka Templ bad sha bakoit jong ka , ki kynroh ki rben shi mitar .
translation.en: Then measured he the porch of the gate , eight cubits  ; and the posts thereof , two cubits  ; and the porch of the gate was inward .

translation.kha: U loit nala ïa la ki jaiñ bad u shaid bad sangsot ha khmat u saiwul , bad u thiah lyngkhuit ha sakma ka sngi baroh Sei sngi bad ha kata ka miej baroh shi miet . ( Ha khnai ka manna la mih ka jingong , Hato wat u Saul hima u la kylla long u nongïathuhlypa ? )
translation.en: And he stripped off his clothes also , and prophesied before Samuel in like manner , and lay down naked all that day and all that night . Wherefore they say , Is Saul also among the prophets ?

translation.kha: Ki briew jong phi kin wan pait na kylleng — na Assyria kabu ha mihngi , na Ijipt ha ka pynong shathie , na ki thain ka Ïuphratis , na ki duriaw ba shiah jngai bad ki lumbah ba don sha jngai bah .
translation.en: In that day also he shall come even to thee from Assyria , and from the fortified cities , and from the fortress even to the river , and from sea to sea , and from mountain to mountain .
And they put him in ward , because it was not declared what should be done to him .
translation.kha: bad la buh hapoh ka jingkhmih ki nongap , namar ym pat don ka jingpynshai yn leh kumno ïa u .
Kata ka pynlong ïa nga ban khuslai shaphang ka kyrteng bakhuid Jong nga , namar ki Israel ki jingpynjahburom ïa ka kat shaba ki leit .
translation.en: But I had pity for mine holy name , which the house of Israel had profaned among the heathen , whither they went .
And he spake also unto the men of Penuel , saying , When I come again in peace , I will break down this tower .
translation.kha: Kumta u ong ha ki ,  Ngan sa wan pat ha ka jingsuk jingsaiñ , bad haba nga wan , ngan pyntwa phum ïa une u mot !
Ngim da siewdor ïa ka jingbam ba i bameh bad ïa ka um ba Ngi dih . Kaba i kwah ka erlangthari tang ban ïasaid lyntang ïa ka ri jongngi phi ,
translation.en: Thou shalt sell me meat for money , that I may eat  ; and give me water for money , that I may drink : only I will pass through on my feet  ;
Then David went over to the other side , and stood on the top of an hill afar off  ; a great space being between them :
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u leit noh sha shiliang jong ka them bad u ïeng ha kliar uwei u lum uba kham ha pajih ,

translation.en: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father .
translation.kha: Ka dei lyngba U Khrist ba baroh ma ngi , ki Jiw bad ki Jentil , ngi la lah ban wan ha uwei U Mynsiem sha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Kpa .

translation.en: We roar all like bears , and mourn sore like doves : we look for judgment , but there is none  ; for salvation , but it is far off from us .
translation.kha: Ngi la sheptieng bad kordit . Ngi thrang dik dik ba U Blei un pyllait ïa ngi na ka jingbanbeiñ bad jingleh bymdei hynrei kam shym jia long kumta .

translation.en: And the man Micah had an house of gods , and made an ephod , and teraphim , and consecrated one of his sons , who became his priest .
translation.kha: Une u Mikah u don la ka ïing mane blei . U shna katto katne ki bleithaw bad ka ephod , bad u thung ïa uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u kum u lyngdoh .

translation.en: And now I am no more in the world , but these are in the world , and I come to thee . Holy Father , keep through thine own name those whom thou hast given me , that they may be one , as we are .
translation.kha: Bad mynta nga wan noh sha me ; ngam don shuh ha kane ka pyrthei , hynrei ma ki , ki don ha ka pyrthei . Ko Pa Bakhuid ! To ri kyndong ïa ki da ka bor ka kyrteng jong me , ka kyrteng kaba me la ai ha nga , ba kin ïoh long kawei kumba ma me bad nga ngi ïalong kawei .
Hynñiewphew nud ki nongïalam Israel ki kein hangtei , kynthup ïa u Jeshaïah u khunlung jong u Shaphan . Uwei pa uwei u bat ïa u khiew thang jingiwbih , malade ka tdem ka dang kiew na ka jingiwbih .
translation.en: And there stood before them seventy men of the ancients of the house of Israel , and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan , with every man his censer in his hand  ; and a thick cloud of incense went up .

translation.kha: Te u Balak u ong ha u Balaam , Phi leh lei ïa nga kumne ? Nga la wan ïalam ïa phi hangne ban tim ïa ki nongshun jong nga , hynrei phi la kyrkhu pynban ïa ki .
translation.en: And Balak said unto Balaam , What hast thou done unto me ? I took thee to curse mine enemies , and , behold , thou hast blessed them altogether .
And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record , Uriah the priest , and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah .
translation.kha: Wanlam ar ngut ki rangbah ba lah ban shaniah , u Uriah u lyngdoh bad u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Jeberekhaïah , ban long kum ki sakhi .
Jaban kumta nga la ïaid ha ka jingdon ryngkat jongki U Trai ha ka pyrthei jong kiba im .
translation.en: I will walk before the  Lord  in the land of the living .
Moreover , brethren , I would not that ye should be ignorant , how that all our fathers were under the cloud , and all passed through the sea ;
translation.kha: Nga kwah ïa phi ban kynmaw , ko parabangeit jong nga , ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kiba la bud ïa u Moses . Baroh ki la don hapoh ka jingïada jong u lyoh , bad baroh ki la ïaid lyngba ïa ka Duriaw Basaw .

translation.en: The princes refrained talking , and laid their hand on their mouth .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong u paidbah kin sangeh noh na kaba kren ;
Baroh ki la ïatan hadien jongu u sad ki la pyrta , Pynïap ïa u !
translation.en: For the multitude of the people followed after , crying , Away with him .

translation.kha: Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka jingsngewmeng jongu phi ; yn ym don slap , bad ka khyndew jong phi Kan tyllong bad eh kumta u nar .
translation.en: And I will break the pride of your power  ; and I will make your heaven as iron , and your earth as brass :

translation.kha: thaw ïa ka synduk da ka dieng siasia , kaba shahjop shiphew sentimitar ka lynter , hynriewphew hynriewphew sentimitar ka pyngkiang , bad hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka jingjrong .
translation.en: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood : two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof , and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof , and a cubit and a half the height thereof .

translation.kha: Mynba ki Israel ki la mih na Ijipt , mynba ki khup ki ksiew jong u Jakob ki la mihnoh na kata ka ri nongwei ,
translation.en: When Israel went out of Egypt , the house of Jacob from a people of strange language  ;
Ought ye not to know that the  Lord  God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever , even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt ?
translation.kha: Hato phim tip ba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u la pynlong ka jutang bad u Dabid ka bym lah ban pynkheiñ , da kaba ai ha u bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u ïa ka jinglong syiem junom halor ki Israel ?

, u Paul u batai ruh ïa ka jingthmu jong ka praw U Blei bad ka bor jong U Mynsiem U Blei ha ka jingtem jong uba ngeit . Nangta u apostol u ïaleh shitom ban pynshai ïa ka jingkylli Kamon ki Jiw bad ki Jentil ki don ka jingïadei bad ka jingthmu U blem ïa ki jaitbynriew . U pynkut ba ka jingkyntait jong ki Jiw ïa U Jisu ka long ka bynta jrong ka jingthmu U Blei ban wallam ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew hapoh ka jylli jong ka jingaiei jrong U Blei da U Jisu Khrist , bad u ngeit ba ki Jiw kin ym kyndit sah ïa U Josis . Khatduh u Paul u thoh Shaphan kumno ban im ka jingim khriat , khamtam shaphang ka lynti jong ka jingieit ha ka jingïadei bad kiwei pat . U thoh kiwei pat ki phangpdeng kum ka jingshakri ïa U Blei , ka kamram ki Khristan ha ka jingïadih bad ka hima sima mala ka imlang sahlang , bad ki jingkylli shaphang ka jingïatiplem . U pynkut ïa ka shithi da ki khubor bashimet bad ki ktien ïaroh ïa U Blei . Ki jingkdew Ka jinglyngngoh bad ka phangpdeng
translation.en: And he shook off the beast into the fire , and felt no harm .
Then said Jesus unto them ,  Be not afraid : go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee , and there shall they see me .
translation.kha: Wat sheptieng ,  U Jisu u la ong ha ki .  Khie leit bad ïathuh ïa ki para jong nga ban leit sha Galilaïa bad hangta kin ïohi ïa nga .

translation.en: For the king will hear , to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of God .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba phin shahshkor bad pyllait im ïa nga na uta uba pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga bad ïa u khun jong nga , bad kumta ban weng noh ïa ngi na ka ri kaba U Blei u la ai ha ki briew jong u .
U Ahab u kylli ïa ki rangbah synlar jongnga u , Balei ba ngim shym la ni ei ei ban ïohknieh pat ïa ka Ramoth ha Gilead na u syiem Syria ? Ka dei ka jong ngi !
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto his servants , Know ye that Ramoth in Gilead is ours , and we be still , and take it not out of the hand of the king of Syria ?
That ye abstain from meats offered to idols , and from blood , and from things strangled , and from fornication : from which if ye keep yourselves , ye shall do well . Fare ye well .
translation.kha: Wat bam kano kano ka jingbam kaba la kñia ha ki bleithaw ; wat bam kano kano ka snam ; wat bam kano kano ka mrad kaba la khyrwait ; bad sumar ïa lade na ka jingawria . Phin manbha lada phi sumar ban ym leh ïa kine kiei kiei . Da ka jingkhublei babha tam jong ngi .

translation.en: Keep my commandments , and live  ; and my law as the apple of thine eye .
translation.kha: Leh ïa kaei kaba nga ong , bad phin ïoh im . Da sumar bha ban bud ïa ki jinghikai jong nga kumba phi sumar ïa la ki khmat ;

translation.en: In all thy ways acknowledge him , and he shall direct thy paths .
translation.kha: Kynmaw ïa U  Trai  ha kaei kaei kaba phi leh , bad un pyn-i ha phi ïa ki lynti kaba dei .

Hangne hiar u Lum Shion , U tharai Badonbor Baroh un pynkhreh ka jingkhihwin bah na ka bynta ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei — ka jingkhawai bha da ki jingbamsap bakyrhai eh bad ka waiñ bakynsai tam .
translation.en: And in this mountain shall the  Lord  of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things , a feast of wines on the lees , of fat things full of marrow , of wines on the lees well refined .
But if he will not hear thee , then take with thee one or two more , that in the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada um sngap ïa me , ïalam uwei ne ar ngut kiwei pat ki briew lem bad me , khnang ba ‘ kawei pa kawei ka jingkynnoh lah ban kyrshan da ka jingsakhi jong ki ar lane lai ngut ki sakhi .’

translation.en: And all the people were at strife throughout all the tribes of Israel , saying , The king saved us out of the hand of our enemies , and he delivered us out of the hand of the Philistines  ; and now he is fled out of the land for Absalom .
translation.kha: Ha kylleng ka ri ki la sdang ban ïakajia para ma ki .  U syiem Dabid u la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki nongshun jong ngi ,  ki ïa-ong uwei ïa uwei pat .  U la pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Philistia ; hynrei mynta pat u la phet krad na u Absalom bad u la iehnoh ïa ka ri .
U Sebulun un shon hajar duriaw ; Ka jaka shong jong u kan long ka jakarieh ïa ki liengbah , Bad ka khyndew ka shyiap jong u kan ïarap khah Sidon .
translation.en: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea  ; and he shall be for an haven of ships  ; and his border shall be unto Zidon .

translation.kha: Haba u syiem u la pynmih ïa ka jingpynbna bathymmai pynlang shibun ki samla kynthei la wallam sha Susa , ka Ashteroth ka la long kawei na ki . Ïa ka ruh la buh ha ka ïingsyiem hapoh ka jingsumar u Hegai , uba peit ïa ka ïing ki kynthei .
translation.en: So it came to pass , when the king s commandment and his decree was heard , and when many maidens were gathered together unto Shushan the palace , to the custody of Hegai , that Esther was brought also unto the king s house , to the custody of Hegai , keeper of the women .
And spared not the old world , but saved Noah the eighth person , a preacher of righteousness , bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly  ;
