translation.kha: U Blei um shym la shah jem ïa ka pyrthei mynbarim , hynrei u la wanrah ïa ka jingshlei um ha ka pyrthei jong ki briew bymtip Blei ; kita kiba u pyllait im ki long u Noah , uba la ïalap ïa ka hok , bad hynñiew ngut kiwei pat .

Ïa kine ki jingkular baroh la pynlong na ka bniat jong ngi , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong por . Te namarkata , to ngin pynkhuid ïa lade na kaei kaei baroh kaba pyntngit ïa ka met bad mynsiem , bad to ai ba ngin im ka jingim kaba khuid da kaba im ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Having therefore these promises , dearly beloved , let us cleanse ourselves from all filthiness of the flesh and spirit , perfecting holiness in the fear of God .
And Jonathan said , Far be it from thee : for if I knew certainly that evil were determined by my father to come upon thee , then would not I tell it thee ?
translation.kha: Wat nym pyrkhat ïa kaba kum kata ?  u Jonathan u jubab . Lada nga la tip shai ba i pa i la kut jingmut ban pynsniew ïa phi , hato ngan ym ïathuh ïa phi ?

translation.en: Today’s realities are war , crime , hunger , sickness , aging—to mention just a few .
translation.kha: Namar ka jingshisha ka long ka thma , jingsniew , jingïapthngan , jingpang ban kdew tang katto kattne .
Hynrei ha shuwa ka por ba ka jingngeit kan wan , ka Hukum ka sat ïa ngi baroh kamon ki koidi dak haduh don da pynpaw ïa kane ka jingieit .
translation.en: But before faith came , we were kept under the law , shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed .
And if ye call on the Father , who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man s work , pass the time of your sojourning here in fear :
translation.kha: Phi khot ïa u , U Kpa , haba phi duwai ha U Blei , uba bishar ïa ki briew baroh da kajuh ka jingthew , katba kum kaei kaba uwei pa uwei u la leh ; kumta te , to pynlut ïa kaba sah ka jingim jong phi hangne ha ka pyrthei ha ka jingtiengburom ïa U .
ka Hasar Shual , ka Balaam , ka Esekiel ,
translation.en: And Hazar–shual , and Balah , and Ezem ,

translation.kha: ithuh dei ma me , ko Job , uba pynkhlaiñ haduh kor katta ïa ki kulai bad ai ha ki ïa ki treng kba noh rymphum ?
translation.en: Hast thou given the horse strength ? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder ?

translation.kha: Kin ai ka jingkhlaiñ ïa ki kti kiba la thait bad ïa ki khohsiew bakyiuh da ka jingtlot .
translation.en: Strengthen ye the weak hands , and confirm the feeble knees .
And every one that heareth these sayings of mine , and doeth them not , shall be likened unto a foolish man , which built his house upon the sand :
translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba ïohsngew ïa kine ki ktien jong nga bad u bymkohnguh ïa ki u long kum u briew uba bieit uba la tei ïa la ka ïing halor u shyiap .
U ijuh u la jubab ïa u , Lada nga la kren ïa kano kano kaba bakla , to ïathuh ïa borbah jingeh ka dei kaei . jynreiñ ïada ka long kaba dat ha kaei kaba nga la ong , balei ba me da thab ïa nga ?
translation.en: Jesus answered him ,  If I have spoken evil , bear witness of the evil : but if well , why smitest thou me ?
And if any man will sue thee at the law , and take away thy coat , let him have thy cloak also .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u ïalam ïa phi sha ka ïingbishar ban mudui ïa phi na ka bynta ka sopti-poh jong phi , ai ha u ïa ka jaiñkup jynsur ruh .
Sngewbha ai ha ngi ïa kane ka jaka kum ka jingïohkynti jong ngi , bad to wat ai ïa ngi Ban jam sha shiliang ka Jordan pynlang ban shong ban sah hangta .
translation.en: Wherefore , said they , if we have found grace in thy sight , let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession , and bring us not over Jordan .

translation.kha: Kin ïohi ïa ka durkhmat jong u , bad ïa ka ktung jong u yn thoh ha ki jingmatlah jrong ki .
translation.en: And they shall see his face  ; and his name shall be in their foreheads .

translation.kha: Shaphang ka jait Joseph u ong , To U Trai un kyrkhu ïa ka ri jongngi ki da u slap Bad da ka um napoh khynwin .
translation.en: And of Joseph he said , Blessed of the  Lord  be his land , for the precious things of heaven , for the dew , and for the deep that coucheth beneath ,

translation.kha: Phi u riewarsap ! Nyngkong eh weng neh ïa ka lyngkhot dieng na la ka khmat jongngi phi hi , bad nongkit phin lah ban ïohi shai kdar ban khlam ïa u thiat na ka lamkhmat u para jong phi .
translation.en: Thou hypocrite , first cast out the beam out of thine own eye  ; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother s eye .
For who is God , save the  Lord  ? and who is a rock , save our God ?
translation.kha: U  Trai  tang ma u hi u long U Blei ; U Blei tang ma u hi uba long ka jingïada jong ngi .
Kumba ka jingkhot Bakhuid ka ong : U ai sbun mynsiem sha kiba kyrduh ; ka jinglehsbun jong u ka neh jongu .
translation.en: (As it is written , He hath dispersed abroad ; he hath given to the poor : his righteousness remaineth for ever .

translation.kha: Ka jingainong kaba khrup tam jong ngi ka un-long ba uwei pa imat na phi un don ka jingthrang kaba ïaheh Haduh kaba kut , kumta ba Kiei kiei kiba phi kyrmen kin wang urlong .
translation.en: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end :

translation.kha: Ko khun jrong nga , to kynmaw ïa kaei kaba nga kren , bad wat ju kliar don leh ïa kaei kabu nga ong ïa phi ba leh .
translation.en: My son , keep my words , and lay up my commandments with thee .

translation.kha: Nahath na la ïohsngew ïa ka sur na ka jingset kaban ong , Ko Trai uba U Blei Badonbor Baroh ! kabu shisha bad kaba hok ki long da shisha ki jingbishar jong me !
translation.en: And I heard another out of the altar say , Even so , Lord God Almighty , true and righteous are thy judgments .

translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki la iar ha ka Them Rephaim bad ki ïohknieh ïa ka .
translation.en: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim .

translation.kha: ïong ïa ka ban wan hangne , u Elijah u hukum . Ka la wan bad ïeng ha ka jingkhang ,
translation.en: And he said , Call her . And when he had called her , she stood in the door .

translation.kha: U la pah ïa ki nonglamktien ha shuwa jong u , kiba la lytar shat ka nongtrei ha Samaria ba pynkhreh ïa kaei Kaei baroh na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: And sent messengers before his face : and they went , and entered into a village of the Samaritans , to make ready for him .

translation.kha: U jongu u la ïohi ba u la sngewsih bad u la ong , Katno ka longïing kaba eh ïa ki briew bariewspah ban rang shapoh ka Hima U Blei !
translation.en: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful , he said ,  How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God !

translation.kha: Um don ki nonghiarpateng , ym ba-don kiba lait im .
translation.en: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people , nor any remaining in his dwellings .

translation.kha: U Rephaïah , u khum jong u Hur , u nongsynshar ïa shiteng jong ka Jerusalem distrik , u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud .
translation.en: And next unto them repaired Rephaiah the son of Hur , the ruler of the half part of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na ki un long kumto ka jingkah na ka lyer bad ka jaka ban rieh na ki erïong . Kin hir kum ki ïawad kba tuid ha ka ri shyiap , kum ka jingkah syrngiew u mawsiang bah ha ka ri shrah .
translation.en: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind , and a covert from the tempest  ; as rivers of water in a dry place , as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land .
Stablish thy word unto thy servant , who is devoted to thy fear .
translation.kha: Pyndep ïa ka kular jong me ha nga , u shakri jong me — ka jingkular kaba me pynlong ha kito kiba kohnguh ïa me .
Ym don uba stad u ban kren kumba krensih ma me lane ïada ïa lade da kum kita ki ktien bym ba-don jingmut .
translation.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk ? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good ?

And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty . And the third captain of fifty went up , and came and fell on his knees before Elijah , and besought him , and said unto him , O man of God , I pray thee , let my life , and the life of these fifty thy servants , be precious in thy sight .
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u syiem u la phah ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah . U la leit kiew ïa u lum , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat u Elijah , bad u la ïasaid ,  Ko briew jong U Blei , to isynei ïa nga bad ïa ki rangbah jong nga . To pyllait ïa ka jingim jong ngi !

translation.en: And God s anger was kindled because he went : and the angel of the  Lord  stood in the way for an adversary against him . Now he was riding upon his ass , and his two servants were with him .
translation.kha: U Blei u la bitar ba u Balaam u la leit , bad katba u Balaam u dang leit da kaba shong halor ka kada jong u , la synran ïa u da ar ngut ki shakri jong u ; u angel U  Trai  u la ïeng ha ka surok ban khang lynti ïa u .
Phi lah ban rah ka synduk ?
translation.en: Can you lift the box ?
Three times in the year all thy males shall appear before the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Man ka snem ha kine ki lai tylli ki Jingkhawai Niam , ki shynrang baroh ki dei ban wan mane ïa nga , U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
wahbah ki Philistia ki la phet , ki la iehnoh shadien ïa ki bleithaw jong ki , malu u ïaiban bad ki rangbah jong u ki la rah noh ïa ki .
translation.en: And there they left their images , and David and his men burned them .

translation.kha: Kumta u Jotham lem bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki la mih bad ki kali ïapom bad ki hiarthma ïa ka Edom . Hangta ka kynruh shipai jong ki Edom ka la kerkut ïa ki , hynrei ha ka por mynmiet ki la ïohlad ban mih shabar bad laitluid phet .
translation.en: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes , and all his chariots with him : and he rose up by night , and smote the Edomites which compassed him in , and the captains of the chariots .

translation.kha: Hynrei dei U Mynsiem jong U Blei badonbok Beor uba wan sha ki briew bad uba ai ha ki ka jingstad .
translation.en: But there is a spirit in man : and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding .

translation.kha: Ym don uba thang ïa ka shrak bad nangta u buhrieh ïa ka lane buh ïa ka hapoh ka shnong ; pynbun , u bthuh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharak , khnang ba ki briew ki lah ban ïohi ïa ka jingshai katba ki wan rung shapoh .
translation.en: No man , when he hath lighted a candle , putteth it in a secret place , neither under a bushel , but on a candlestick , that they which come in may see the light .

translation.kha: Hynrei u rangbah shipai u la Kwah banbeiñ pyllait im ïa u Paul , kumta u la khang ïa ki na Kaba leh ïa kane . Pynban , u la praw ïa kito kiba lah ban jingjngai ban ryngkoh nyngkong bad ngab jngi sha ryngkew ;
translation.en: But the centurion , willing to save Paul , kept them from their purpose  ; and commanded that they which could swim should cast themselves first into the sea , and get to land :

translation.kha: Hynrei baïar kumjuh ki ïalap malu la tep ïa ki ; ïa ki barieh la tap da ki kruiñ .
translation.en: They shall lie down alike in the dust , and the worms shall cover them .

translation.kha: Te u la hukum ïa u rangbah synshar jngai u , uba ha khlieh ban leit na Lakhish sha Jerusalem lem bad ka kynhun shipawa kaba khraw ban dawa ba u syiem Hesekaïah u dei ban pynjam . U rangbah synsar u ïeng ha ka surok ha kaba ki nongthain jaiñ ki treikam , harud ka nur kaba wanrah um na ka pung kaba haneng .
translation.en: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army . And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller s field .

translation.kha: Nangta de la kyrmen ïa u angel , Ko rangbah , kaei ka jingmut jong kine ki kali ïapom ?
translation.en: Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me , What are these , my lord ?

And if it seem evil unto you to serve the  Lord  , choose you this day whom ye will serve  ; whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the flood , or the gods of the Amorites , in whose land ye dwell : but as for me and my house , we will serve the  Lord .
translation.kha: Te lada phim mon ban shakri ïa u , jied ha kane hi ka sngi ïano phin shakri , ïa ki blei ba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la mane ha Mesopotamia , ne ïa ki blei jong ki Amor , kiba ha ka ri jong ki phi shong phi sah mynta . Hynrei ma nga bad ka ïing jong nga , ngin shakri ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: For I know their works and their thoughts : it shall come , that I will gather all nations and tongues  ; and they shall come , and see my glory .
translation.kha: Nga tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat bad ki kam jong ki , ngan wan ban lumlang ïa ki briew jong ki hima baroh . Haba kin ïawanlang , kin sa ïohi kaei ba ka bor jong nga ka lah ban leh bad kin sa tip ba nga dei uta uba pynshitom ïa ki .
Ki paid Judah bad Israel ki long kiba bun paid kat u shyiap harud duriaw ; ki ïabam ki ïadih , bad ki suk ki saiñ .
translation.en: Judah and Israel were many , as the sand which is by the sea in multitude , eating and drinking , and making merry .

translation.kha: U phah ïa ka jingshai sha ki jaka ba-dum tliw kum ka jingïap .
translation.en: He discovereth deep things out of darkness , and bringeth out to light the shadow of death .
And the men of Israel , beside Benjamin , were numbered four hundred thousand men that drew sword : all these were men of war .
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki jait Israel ki ïalumlang saw lakh ngut ki shipai kiba tbit bha .
Da sum ban ym pei shuh ka jingbitsnam ; ïa ka jingshah shitom jong phi la pha ban pyllait ïa Phin na ka .
translation.en: Take heed , regard not iniquity : for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction .

translation.kha: Ngan pynphong ïa ki dieng Kedar ban mih ha ka Jaka shyiap bad ki dieng Akhish bad ki ngin markhmat bad ki dieng Olib . Bad ki khlaw kin mihnoh ha ki jaka shrah ki khlaw dien Kseh bad dieng Kseh-Juniper pynlang diengthang Kseh-Sypress .
translation.en: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar , the shittah tree , and the myrtle , and the oil tree  ; I will set in the desert the fir tree , and the pine , and the box tree together :
And the chief captain answered , With a great sum obtained I this freedom . And Paul said , But I was free born .
translation.kha: U rangbah ai hukum u la ong ,  Nga la long u traishnong da kaba siew shibun ka pisa .   Hynrei nga long traishnong naduh dang kha ,  u Paul u la jubab .
U Trai u la pyllait ïa ka bor ba-pura jong ka jingbitar jong u ; u la pynmeh ka ding ha Seïon kaba la thang duh ïa ka haduh kheiñduh .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath accomplished his fury  ; he hath poured out his fierce anger , and hath kindled a fire in Zion , and it hath devoured the foundations thereof .

translation.kha: Ka eriong kaba jur ka la ne , kamet ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki la sdang ban bret noh katno katne ki jingkit kiba don ha ka lieng ,
translation.en: And we being exceedingly tossed with a tempest , the next day they lightened the ship  ;
Also I said , It is not good that ye do : ought ye not to walk in the fear of our God because of the reproach of the heathen our enemies ?
translation.kha: Nangta nga ong ,  Kaei kaba phi leh ka long kaba bakla ! Phi dei ban kohnguh ïa U Blei bad leh ïa kaei kaba dei , khnang ba phin ym pynlong ïa ki nongshun jong ngi , ki Jentil , ïa kano kano ka daw ba kin krenbeiñ ïa ngi .

Kumta ka tnga u Samson ka leit ha khmat jong u pyllut bad ki ummat bad ka ong , Pleng , phim ieit satia ïa nga ! Phi isih ïa ar ! Phi buh jingkyntip ha ki paralok jong nga , hynrei ‘Phim shym ïathuh ha nga ka mut aïu ! U ong , Khmih , ïam shym pat la ïathuh ha la i pa pynlang i mei . Balei seiñ kan ïathuh ha phi ?
translation.en: And Samson s wife wept before him , and said , Thou dost but hate me , and lovest me not : thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people , and hast not told it me . And he said unto her , Behold , I have not told it my father nor my mother , and shall I tell it thee ?

translation.kha: Pynban , nga la maham ïa ki samla hapdeng jongnga ki : wiat sumar ïa ki aiñ Ibbah ki kjap tymmen jong phi ki thaw ; woh bud ïa ki rukom jong ki lane pynngeit ïa lade da ki bleithaw jong ki .
translation.en: But I said unto their children in the wilderness , Walk ye not in the statutes of your fathers , neither observe their judgments , nor defile yourselves with their idols :

translation.kha: Lymda u leh pop pyrshah ïa phi hynñiew sien ha ka shi sngi , nabar man ka per u wan sha phi da kaba ong , ‘ nga kylla-kaba-mut ,’ phi dei ban map ïa u .
translation.en: And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day , and seven times in a day turn again to thee , saying , I repent  ; thou shalt forgive him .

And on the morrow , when Agrippa was come , and Bernice , with great pomp , and was entered into the place of hearing , with the chief captains , and principal men of the city , at Festus  commandment Paul was brought forth .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud u Agrippa bad ka Berniki ki la wan ha ka jingpynpaw burom kaba khraw bad ha ka jinglehkmen bad ki la rung sha ka kamra bishar lem bad ki rangbah shipai bad ki rangbah pawkhmat jong ka nongbah . U Phestos u la ai ka hukum , bad ïa u Paul la wallam shapoh .

translation.en: And now , O  Lord  my God , thou hast made thy servant king instead of David my father : and I am but a little child : I know not how to go out or come in .
translation.kha: A  Trai  U Blei , me la shah ïa nga ban long syiem hadien i pa jong nga , wat la nga dang khynnah bad ngam tip kumno ban synshar .
katto katto-katne ngut na kiba ïa-pihuin hangta ki la kylli ïa ki , Phi ïaleh aïu ba phi ïathaw ïa u khun kai ?
translation.en: And certain of them that stood there said unto them , What do ye , loosing the colt ?

translation.kha: U shym u la ai hukum ïa ki briew jong u , kumta ki la shim ïa u Abram bad ki la leit buh ïa u shabar ka ri lem badno ka tnga jong u dara baroh kat kiba u ni .
translation.en: And Pharaoh commanded his men concerning him : and they sent him away , and his wife , and all that he had .
And , behold , seven other kine came up after them out of the river , ill favoured and leanfleshed  ; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river .
translation.kha: Nangta , sa hynñiew tylli kiwei pat ki masi kynthei ki wan mih ; ki long kiba raikhoh bad kiba sah sa ka shyieng suda . Ki la ki wan mih bad ki la ïeng hajan kita kiwei pat ki masi kynthei ha ka rudwah ,
Wat ai ba ka waiñ kan pynshoi ïa phi , wat la ka long kaba saw hain hain , wat la ka phyrnai ha ka khuri , bad ka hiar jem jai .
translation.en: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red , when it giveth his colour in the cup , when it moveth itself aright .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la peit shlip sha ki pynlang u la jubab , Kane ka long ka lai ia ha u briew , hynrei ha U Blei kiei kiei baroh ki erlangthari kaba lah .
translation.en: But Jesus beheld them , and said unto them ,  With men this is impossible  ; but with God all things are possible .
Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace , that we may obtain mercy , and find grace to help in time of need .
translation.kha: To ngin sngewskhem , te , bad leit sha ka khet U Blei , ha kaba don ka jingaiei . Hangta ngin ïohpdiang ïa ka jingisynei bad ngin shem ïa ka jingaiei ka ban ïarap ïa ngi ha ka por ba ngi donkam ïa ka .

bad haba ka Jesebel ka dang pynïap ïa ki nongïathuhlypa lad U Trai , u Obadaïah u la shim bad pynrieh ïa ki shyiap ngut ki nonghiarthma ha ki krem , da kaba phiah ïa ki ha ki ar kynhun kiba sanphew ñiut ha kawei kawei ka kynhun , bad u la pynbiang jingbam bad um ïa ki . )
translation.en: For it was so , when Jezebel cut off the prophets of the  Lord  , that Obadiah took an hundred prophets , and hid them by fifty in a cave , and fed them with bread and water . )
Therefore , as ye abound in every thing , in faith , and utterance , and knowledge , and in all diligence , and in your love to us , see that ye abound in this grace also .
translation.kha: Phi long kiba riewspah katta katta ha baroh kiba phi don : Ha ka jingngeit , ka jingkren , bad ka jingtip , ha ka jingangnud ban ïarap bad ha ka jingieit jong phi ïa ngi . Bad kumta ngi kwah ïa phi ban long kiba sbun ruh ha kane ka jingshakri jong ka jingieit .
U Jisu bad la ki synran ki dang ïapmat jingbam mut . U Ksuid u la Bsuh lypa ha ka dohthang jong u Judas , u khun jong u Simon Ostrit , ka jingpyrkhat ban ikhyllah ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And supper being ended , the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot , Simon s son , to betray him  ;

translation.kha: Kanaan ka long laiphew phra snem hadien ba ngi la Mih na Kadesh Barnea . Ki rangïapom barabor jongngi kata ka pateng ki la ïap lut , kitab U thri u la kren lypa .
translation.en: And the space in which we came from Kadesh–barnea , until we were come over the brook Zered , was thirty and eight years  ; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host , as the  Lord  sware unto them .

translation.kha: Ko ka nongbah Sidon , ka jingkmen jong pha ka la kut , sad ki briew jong pha ki Shah banbeiñ . Wat la kin maji phet sha Sypros , pynban kin ym pat lait na ka jingma .
translation.en: And he said , Thou shalt no more rejoice , O thou oppressed virgin , daughter of Zidon : arise , pass over to Kittim  ; there also shalt thou have no rest .

Therefore night shall be unto you , that ye shall not have a vision  ; and it shall be dark unto you , that ye shall not divine  ; and the sun shall go down over the prophets , and the day shall be dark over them .
translation.kha: Ïa kine ki nongïathuhlypa , U  Trai  u ong ,  Ko ki nongïathuhlypa , ka sngi jong phi ka la jan kut noh ; ka sngi ka la jan wai na ka bynta jong phi . Namar ba phi ïalam bakla ïa ki briew jong nga , phin ym don shuh ki jingïohipaw ban ïathuhlypa , bad phin ym lah ban ïathuh lypa ei ei .

bad ïa ki jaiñphong kiba jingïasuk ba ki Lyngdoh ki dei ban phong haba ki shakri ha ka Jaka Kyntang — ki jaiñphong kiba kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron u lyngdoh , bad na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u .
translation.en: The cloths of service , to do service in the holy place , the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and the garments of his sons , to minister in the priest s office .

translation.kha: La katta ruh , lada shah ïa uta u trai ban thor da ka kuna , ban pyllait im ïa u , u dei ban siew dep ïa ka dor kaba dei ban siew .
translation.en: If there be laid on him a sum of money , then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him .

translation.kha: Ym don kaba sniew kaba jia ha ki briew kiba hok , hynrei ki bymman kim don ei ei tang ka jynjar suda .
translation.en: There shall no evil happen to the just : but the wicked shall be filled with mischief .

translation.kha: U la ong , Shim ïa ki jingshai sngewbha ba la ai da u Heldai , u Tobijah bad u Jedidah kiba la shah ringmraw , nabar lytar shisyndon sha ka ïing jong u Josaïah u khun jong u Sephanaïah . Kine ki rangbah baher ki la wan phai pat na ka jingshah ringmraw ha Babilonia .
translation.en: Take of them of the captivity , even of Heldai , of Tobijah , and of Jedaiah , which are come from Babylon , and come thou the same day , and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah  ;

translation.kha: Ngi don bun ki dkut ha kawei ka tat pynlang baroh kine ki dkhot ki Don ki jingtreikam bapher batip .
translation.en: For as we have many members in one body , and all members have not the same office :

translation.kha: To Shahshkor ïa ka jingsam ka jingïam ha Seïon , La pynjot ïa ngi ! La pynlehrain khoit ïa ngi ! neng den ban iehnoh ïa ka ri jong ngi ; ïa ki ïohnang jong ngi la pynkhyllem .
translation.en: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion , How are we spoiled ! we are greatly confounded , because we have forsaken the land , because our dwellings have cast us out .

translation.kha: lem badno kine ki hukum : raikhoh ha kawei ka liang jong ka nongbah , hynrei Wat leit jngai than na ka ; long ba la khreh ban tur ïaleit .
translation.en: And he commanded them , saying , Behold , ye shall lie in wait against the city , even behind the city : go not very far from the city , but be ye all ready :

translation.kha: Nangta u la shim ïa ki khynnah ha la ki ktang ti , u la buh ïa ki kti jong u halor jong ki , bad u la kyrkhu ïa ki .
translation.en: And he took them up in his arms , put his hands upon them , and blessed them .

translation.kha: Ki kren ki kiei bim don jingtem nabar pynong ki jingkular lamler dara ki jingïateh kular bymlarkam . Ka hok ka kylla long Bokhim , ka nang san kum ki ñiut ba longïng bih ha ka lyngkien ba la dep lur .
translation.en: They have spoken words , swearing falsely in making a covenant : thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field .

translation.kha: Kiba hok ki don kyrhai shun bam , hynrei ki bymnang ki shahthngan badonbor .
translation.en: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul : but the belly of the wicked shall want .

translation.kha: Ha ki hynne sneng naba pahuh , ka khyndew ka pynmeh shikatdei eh ki jingkthang , ïa kiba u Jehoba u lwa bad kynshew ha ki nongbah .
translation.en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls .
Jehoshaphat the son of Paruah , in Issachar :
translation.kha: U Jehoshaphat , u khun jong u Paruah : ka ri Issakhar
Ki pyrkhat ba ki jingphohsniew ba ki ïathuh kan pynlong ïa ki briew jong to ban klet ïa nga , kumba ki kjap jrong ki , ki la klet ïa nga bad phai sha u Balaam .
translation.en: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour , as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal .

translation.kha: Haba u khep u la ih , u bariew u sdang ban ot ïa u da ka rwai , namar ka aïom ot ka la poi .
translation.en: But when the fruit is brought forth , immediately he putteth in the sickle , because the harvest is come .

translation.kha: U Isaak u mihnoh nongbat bad u leit sha Beersheba .
translation.en: And he went up from thence to Beer–sheba .
When Jesus therefore saw her weeping , and the Jews also weeping which came with her , he groaned in the spirit , and was troubled ,
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa ka ba ka ïam , bad u la ïohi kumno ba ki briew kiba la ïadon lem bad ka , ki ruh ki la ïa-ïam ; ka la ktah ïa ka dohnud jong u , bad la pynkhih jur ïa u .

translation.en: He hath said in his heart , I shall not be moved : for I shall never be in adversity .
translation.kha: U ong ha lade ,  Ngan ym bakla da lei lei ; da lei lei ngan ym poi ha ka jingjynjar .
Ha kajuh ka miet u syiem um ïohthiah saitlah , kumne u lawlynnong ban wanrah ïa ki jingbuh jingwoh jong ka hima mala ban pule ha u .
translation.en: On that night could not the king sleep , and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles  ; and they were read before the king .

translation.kha: Ki Briew basniew ki ngat ha la ki jong ki nongpop , katba ki briew bahok ki kmen bad ki laitluid .
translation.en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare : but the righteous doth sing and rejoice .

translation.kha: nga la longsem u nongwei , hynrei phim shym la pdiang sngewbha ïa nga ha ki ïing jong phi , nga la lyngkhuit , hynrei phim shym la pynlip jaiñ ïa nga ; nga la pang bad nga la don ha ïitbniah , hynrei phim shym la sum ïa nga .’
translation.en: I was a stranger , and ye took me not in : naked , and ye clothed me not : sick , and in prison , and ye visited me not .
And it came to pass on the morrow , that Moses sat to judge the people : and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Moses u dang pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng u paidbah , bad kumta u la bunkam naduh mynstep haduh ban da miet .
Mynta , khie ithuh bad khmih ïa ka ri baroh kawei , naba ngan ai ïa ka baroh ha me .
translation.en: Arise , walk through the land in the length of it and in the breadth of it  ; for I will give it unto thee .
But every vow of a widow , and of her that is divorced , wherewith they have bound their souls , shall stand against her .
translation.kha: Ka riewkynthei lane ka kynthei kaba la ïapyllait tnga ka dei ban pyndep ïa kawei pa kawei ka jingkular ba ka la ai ban kyndiah noh na kano kano .
Kynmaw ïa U Trei ha katei kaei kaba phi! leh , bad un pyn-i ha phi ïa ki lynti kaba dei .
translation.en: In all thy ways acknowledge him , and he shall direct thy paths .

translation.kha: Ka ri jong ki ka dap da ki bleithaw , bad ki mane ïa kita kiba ki la shna da ki kti jong ki hi .
translation.en: Their land also is full of idols  ; they worship the work of their own hands , that which their own fingers have made :

translation.kha: Kane bret noh ïa la ka ksiar bad ka rupa ha ki lyndang bah kum Ibbah la kyntait , namar ka ksiar lehniam ka rupa kan ym haka ban pynim ïa ki haba U Trai un theh noh ïa ka jingbitar shla jong u . Jin ym lah ban pyndonkam ïa ki ban pynhun ïa ka jingangnud jong ki ne pyndap ïa ki snier jong ki . Ka ksiar nabar ka dabi ki ïalam ïa ki sha ka jingleh pop .
translation.en: They shall cast their silver in the streets , and their gold shall be removed : their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the  Lord  : they shall not satisfy their souls , neither fill their bowels : because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity .
And he made his seven lamps , and his snuffers , and his snuffdishes , of pure gold .
translation.kha: U shna hynñiew tylli ki sharak na ka bynta uta u diengpynïeng sharak , bad u thaw ruh ïa ki nap bad ki jingdiang jong u da ka ksiar nylla .
Ki keiñ U tharai ki un-long katba shisha ; bad baroh ki kam jongnga u ki long kiba lah ban shaniah .
translation.en: For the word of the  Lord  is right  ; and all his works are done in truth .

translation.kha: Ha ka lynti mawkyrdon ba la ter da u syiem Adah , U Trai un pynlong ïa ka syrngiew ban rupa shiphew jam shadien . Bad ka syrngiew ka kynriah shiphew jam shadien .
translation.en: Behold , I will bring again the shadow of the degrees , which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz , ten degrees backward . So the sun returned ten degrees , by which degrees it was gone down .
Yet the  Lord  hath not given you an heart to perceive , and eyes to see , and ears to hear , unto this day .
translation.kha: Hynrei haduh kane ka sngi um pat shym la ai ha phi ban shemphang ïa kaei kaba phi la mad .

Mynta , aïu kan long ïa kito ki briew kiba la pynbaptis na ka bynta kiba ïap ? Aïu ki kyllan baneh pyndep ? Lada ka long kaba shisha , kumba don kiba kam , ba ïa kiba ïap yn ym pynbat , balei ïa kito ki briew la pynbaptis na ka bynta kaba ïap ?
translation.en: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead , if the dead rise not at all ? why are they then baptized for the dead ?

translation.kha: U Job u jubab , Pha kren bieit ! Haba U Blei u phah ei ei kaban bha , ngi pdiang ïa kata . Kumno i'u haw ïa-ban khñium haba u phah ïa ki jingtap ha ngi ? Wat la u shait ïa ki jingjynjar baroh , u Job um shym la kren ei ei pyrshah ïa U Blang .
translation.en: But he said unto her , Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh . What ? shall we receive good at the hand of God , and shall we not receive evil ? In all this did not Job sin with his lips .

translation.kha: Nga Iohi ïa ka jinglong jakhlia ba-beit jong ka , ba ka para kaba bud ka lama kaba sngur kum Kaba ha shuwa .
translation.en: Then I saw that she was defiled , that they took both one way ,
For all the gods of the nations are idols : but the  Lord  made the heavens .
translation.kha: Ki blei jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew baroh ki long tang ki bleithaw ; hynrei U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ki bneng .
U Blei u la thut ïa nga kum u apostol malade u nonghikai ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha , bad dem na kane ka daw ba nga jingshahshitom ïa kine ktien kai .
translation.en: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher , and an apostle , and a teacher of the Gentiles .
And ye shall keep it up until the fourteenth day of the same month : and the whole assembly of the congregation of Israel shall kill it in the evening .
translation.kha: Nangta , ha ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong une u bnai , ki paid Israel baroh kin ïa-pynïap ïa kita ki mrad .
Ko Syiem Kynrad , phi long uba khraw tam na ki syiem baher . U Blei ka Bneng u la pynong ïa phi u patsha bad u la ai ha phi ka bor , ka jingkhlaiñ , bad ka burom .
translation.en: Thou , O king , art a king of kings : for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom , power , and strength , and glory .

translation.kha: Hato nga taïew , te , ba ka bleithaw ne ka jingbam ba la kñia ha ka , ka long ei ei ?
translation.en: What say I then ? that the idol is any thing , or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing ?

translation.kha: Ka jingpynjot ka la kham jam , bad katto katne thut na ki nonghikai ka praw kiba dei ki jong ka kynhun ki Pharaoh ki la ïeng bad ki la pyrsad jrong : Ngim shem kano kano Kaba bakla dara une u briew ! Lehse u mynsiem lane u ebanjelist u la kren shisha ha u !
translation.en: And there arose a great cry : and the scribes that were of the Pharisees  part arose , and strove , saying , We find no evil in this man : but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him , let us not fight against God .
So Abram departed , as the  Lord  had spoken unto him  ; and Lot went with him : and Abram was seventy and five years old when he departed out of Haran .
translation.kha: Haba u Abram u la dap hynñiewphew san snem ka rta , u la mihnoh na Haran , kumba U  Trai  u la bthah ïa u ban leh ; bad u Lot u la leit lem bad u .

translation.en: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John , and bound him in prison for Herodias  sake , his brother Philip s wife : for he had married her .
translation.kha: U Herod da lade hi u hukum ïa ka jingkem ïa u Ïoannis , bad u la phah teh kynjri ïa u bad phah set ha ka byndi . U Herod u la leh ïa kane namar ka Herodias , ïa kaba u la lah shongkurim , wat la ka la long ka tnga u para jong u , u Philip .

translation.en: Then they went along through the wilderness , and compassed the land of Edom , and the land of Moab , and came by the east side of the land of Moab , and pitched on the other side of Arnon , but came not within the border of Moab : for Arnon was the border of Moab .
translation.kha: Nangta ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri shyiap , ki da ïaid tawiar ïa ka ri Edom bad ka ri Moab haduh ba kin da poi ha ka dong mihngi jong ka ri Moab , sha shiliang ka wah Arnon . Ki sher dara hangta , hynrei kim shym jam ïa ka Arnon namar u dei u pud ki Moab .

Mynta to kynmaw aïu phiah la long , ko ki parabangeit jong na , mynba U Blei u la khot ïa pa . Na ka liang kaba kynja briew tang khyndiat na phi , phi la long kiba pynstad ne kiba khlur ne kiba don kyrduh kaba halor ha ka imlang synñiang .
translation.en: For ye see your calling , brethren , how that not many wise men after the flesh , not many mighty , not many noble , are called :

translation.kha: Ha kaba nyngkong u la ong , Mem shym la mon lane mem shym la sngewbit ïa ki jingkñia bad ïa ki jingiaseng lynti ïa ki mrad ban thang ha ka duwan mala ïa ki jingkieng ïa ka ban paki ino ïa ki pop . U la ong ïa kane wat haba ïa baroh ki jingkñia la ainguh kat kum ka Hukum .
translation.en: Above when he said , Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not , neither hadst pleasure therein  ; which are offered by the law  ;
Then they cry unto the  Lord  in their trouble , and he bringeth them out of their distresses .
translation.kha: Te ha ka jingjynjar jong ki , ki khot kyrpad ïa U  Trai  , bad u pynim ïa ki na ka jingjynjar jong ki .

To rwai ka jingrwai bathymmai ïa U Trai ; ri ïa ka jingïaroh jong u , ko ka pyrthei baroh ! ïakhreh ïa u , phi kiba ïadat lynti ha duriaw ; ïaroh ïa u , ko ki jingthaw baroh ka duriaw ! Rwai , phi ki ri bajanai bad baroh kiba shong hangta .
translation.en: Sing unto the  Lord  a new song , and his praise from the end of the earth , ye that go down to the sea , and all that is therein  ; the isles , and the inhabitants thereof .
Then the spirit entered into me , and set me upon my feet , and spake with me , and said unto me , Go , shut thyself within thine house .
translation.kha: Nga dem khrup da pyllup ha madan , hynrei U Mynsiem jong U Blei u rung hapoh jong nga bad u pynïeng ïa nga . U Trai u la ong ha nga :  Khie leit sha ïing bad set khop ïa lade hapoh ïing .

translation.en: This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth  ; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night , that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein : for then thou shalt make thy way prosperous , and then thou shalt have good success .
translation.kha: Pynthikna ba ïa kane ka kitab ka Hukum dei ban pule borabor ha ka jingmane jong me . Puson ïa ka mynsngi bad mynmiet , bad pynthikna ba men kohnguh ïa kaei kaei baroh ba la thoh ha ka . Te men sa manbha bad long uba jop .
wat ki rangbah bakha kham paw eh ki sngur jar .
translation.en: The nobles held their peace , and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth .

translation.kha: Kumta , katba ngi dang ïohlad bunsien , ngi dei ba-bang lehbha iwei ïa iwei , bad Kham ïa pli kiba na ka un-long ka jingngeit .
translation.en: As we have therefore opportunity , let us do good unto all men , especially unto them who are of the household of faith .

translation.kha: Heldai ba la die ïa u , pynban u dang don hi ka hok ban shah thied wiang .
translation.en: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again  ; one of his brethren may redeem him :

translation.kha: Uta u kpu u Dei na ka bynta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u . Ki dei pun bam ïa u ha ka jaka kaba kyntang , uba uta u long ka bynta kaba kyntang eh na ki jingiw bam ba la kñia sha U Trai na ka bynta jong ki .
translation.en: And it shall be Aaron s and his sons   ; and they shall eat it in the holy place : for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the  Lord  made by fire by a perpetual statute .
So he used a serpent to tell Eve that if she ate the fruit from that tree , she would not die , but she would be like God .
translation.kha: Te u la pyndonkam da u bsein ban kren ha ka Im ba lada ka bam ïa u soh na uta u dieng , kan ym ïap , hynrei kan long kum U Blei .
badno ki la tei ki duwan ïa u Baal khnang ban thang ïa ki khup jong ki ha ka ding kum ki jingkñia . Ngam ju hukum ïa ki ban har ïa kane ; kam shym rung hi shiah ha ka jingpynjot jong ar .
translation.en: They have built also the high places of Baal , to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal , which I commanded not , nor spake it , neither came it into my mind :

translation.kha: Kane ka long laiphew phna sngem hadien ba ngi la mih na Kadesh Barnea . Ki rangïapom baroh jongu kata ka pateng ki la ïarep lut , kumba U Trai u la kren lehbha .
translation.en: And the space in which we came from Kadesh–barnea , until we were come over the brook Zered , was thirty and eight years  ; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host , as the  Lord  sware unto them .
And hath given him authority to execute judgment also , because he is the Son of man .
translation.kha: Bad u la ai ha U Khun ïa ka hok ban bishar , namar u long U Khun U Briew .

Ki da ap ïa ka jingkhih jong ka um , namar u angel U Trai hateng hateng u ju hiar shiah kata ka pungsum ba-bang pynkhie ïa ka um . Ïa u nongpang uba nongtong uba hiar ha ka pynum hadien ba la pynkhih ïa ka um la pynkhia na kano kano ka jingdap kaweh u don .
translation.en: For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool , and troubled the water : whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had .

translation.kha: Nga thoh ïa kane sha phi shngain kito kiba pyrshang ban shukor ïa phira .
translation.en: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki synran , uta ïa uba U Jisu u ieit , u da shong shaniah ha U Jisu .
translation.en: Now there was leaning on Jesus  bosom one of his disciples , whom Jesus loved .

translation.kha: shang ka Synduk la don ki kherub kiba longsyiem ka dak ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Blei , bad ki thapniang jong ki , ki pyiar halor ka dik ha kaban la ju map ïa ki ngop . Hynrei mynta kam dei ka por ban batai bniah nadong shadong .
translation.en: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat  ; of which we cannot now speak particularly .

translation.kha: nabar ki Israel ki la pynher krad ïa ka kynran shipai Syria . U Dabid lem bad ki rangbah jong u ki la pynïap jingpynïasoh nongput ki nongñiah kali ïapom bad sawphew hajar ngut ki shipai shong balui , bad ki la pynkynroi ïa u Shobi , u rangbah ai hukum jong u nongshun , uba la ïap ha ka padun thma .
translation.en: And the Syrians fled before Israel  ; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians , and forty thousand horsemen , and smote Shobach the captain of their host , who died there .

That thou mayest love the  Lord  thy God , and that thou mayest obey his voice , and that thou mayest cleave unto him : for he is thy life , and the length of thy days : that thou mayest dwell in the land which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers , to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob , to give them .
translation.kha: To ieit ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi , kohnguh bad ïaineh ha u ; te ma phi bad ki khun ki ksiew jong phi phin im slem ha kata ka ri ba u la kular ban ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .
( 1 Samuel 1 :12 , 13 ) ka kham bha lama ngi ïadie ha ki jaka ba kynjah ha kaba ym don ba pynlwait ïa i'u .—Markos 1 :35 .
translation.en: ( 1 Samuel 1 :12 , 13 ) It is good to find a quiet place away from other people to say our personal prayers .—Mark 1 :35 .
Now when they heard this , they were pricked in their heart , and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles , Men and brethren , what shall we do ?
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la khuslai shikatdei eh bad ki la ong ha u Petros bad ha kiwei pat ki apostol ,  Kaei kaba ngin leh , ko para ?

translation.en: And Jesus answered and said , while he taught in the temple ,  How say the scribes that Christ is the Son of David ?
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang hikai ha ka Templ , u la kylli ka jingkylli ,  Kumno ki nonghikai jong ka Hukum ki ong ba U Messaïah un long uba hiarpateng na u Dabid ?
Hobah ki briew kiba bha ki waiñ ha ka bor , baïar ki lymne , hynne haba ki briew kiba Sniew ki synshar , ki briew ki buhrieh ïa lade .
translation.en: When righteous men do rejoice , there is great glory : but when the wicked rise , a man is hidden .

And he that was over the house , and he that was over the city , the elders also , and the bringers up of the children , sent to Jehu , saying , We are thy servants , and will do all that thou shalt bid us  ; we will not make any king : do thou that which is good in thine eyes .
translation.kha: Kumta u rangbah uba peit ïa ka ïingsyiem bad u rangbah synshar uba dei peit ïa ka nongbah , ryngkat bad ki riewpawkhmat bad ki nongsumar , ki la phah ïa kane ka khubor sha u Jehu :  Ngi long ki shakri jong phi bad ngi long kiba la kloi ban leh kat ïa kaba phi ong ; hynrei ngin ym thung syiem ïano ïano ; leh katba phi pyrkhat kaba bha tam .

translation.en: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning : when he dresseth the lamps , he shall burn incense upon it .
translation.kha: Man ka step haba u Aaron u wan ban pynkhreh ïa ki sharak , u dei ban thang ïa ka jingiwbih halor jong ka .
Te ngi lah banbeiñ ïalap ïa ka Khubor babud ha kiwei pat ki ri jngai na phi bad yn ym donkam ban leh sarong shaphang ka jingtei ïa kaba la lah leh lypa ha ka lyngkha jong uwei pat u briew’ .
translation.en: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you , and not to boast in another man s line of things made ready to our hand .

translation.kha: Ynda u long syiem , u dei ban ba-don kopi ïa ka kitab jong ki saiñ U Blei bad ki jinghikai kaweh la shna na ka khot aiñ kaba ki lyngdoh Lebi ki bat .
translation.en: And it shall be , when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom , that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of that which is before the priests the Levites :

translation.kha: Ngan leit ngan bad me shat Ijipt , bad len wan ïalam biang ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong me sha kane ka ri . U Joseph duh un don ryngkat bad me ynda me ïap .
translation.en: I will go down with thee into Egypt  ; and I will also surely bring thee up again : and Joseph shall put his hand upon thine eyes .
Now because we have maintenance from the king s palace , and it was not meet for us to see the king s dishonour , therefore have we sent and certified the king  ;
translation.kha: Mynta , namar ba ngi don hapoh ka jingpynïaid jong phi , ko syiem , ngim kwah ban ïohi ïa kane ba kan jia , bad kumta ngi ai jingmut
Ko Nonghikai , ki la kylli , lano kane kan wia ? Bad kaei ka pun jliah kthang ban pyn-i ba ka por ka la poi ïa ka ba kan jia ?
translation.en: And they asked him , saying , Master , but when shall these things be ? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass ?
So when they had further threatened them , they let them go , finding nothing how they might punish them , because of the people : for all men glorified God for that which was done .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Dorbar ka la maham ïa ki kham tyngeh bad nangta la pyllait noh ïa ki . Ki la ïohi ba ka long ka bym lah long ban pynshitom ïa ki , namar ki paidbah baroh ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta kaei kaba la jia .
Te ki jaitbynriew ka pyrthat kin ïohi ba U Tiras u la jied ïa phi ban long ki briew jongnga u , bad kin sheptieng ïa phi .
translation.en: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the  Lord   ; and they shall be afraid of thee .

translation.kha: Kumno phi lah ban ong ba phi long kiba stad , bad ba phi tip ïa ki aiñ Jong nga ? Ha khum , ïa ki aiñ la pyntylli da ki nongthoh bymhok .
translation.en: How do ye say , We are wise , and the law of the  Lord  is with us ? Lo , certainly in vain made he it  ; the pen of the scribes is in vain .

For the king said to Joab the captain of the host , which was with him , Go now through all the tribes of Israel , from Dan even to Beer–sheba , and number ye the people , that I may know the number of the people .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u la ai hukum ïa u Joab , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai jong u :  Khie leit bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi ha kylleng ki jait Israel na kawei ka tduh jong ka ri sha kawei pat , bad ñiew ïa ki briew . Nga kwah ban tip ki don haduh katno .

translation.en: And they appointed two , Joseph called Barsabas , who was surnamed Justus , and Matthias .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la tyrwa ar ngut ki rangbah : U Joseph ïa uba la khot u Barsabbas ( ïa uba la tip ruh kum u Justos ) , bad u Matthias .
‘ Ha ki ngan pynïeng ïa ki jingpynjot bymkut shuh , lang siat lut la ki khnam ha ki .
translation.en: I will heap mischiefs upon them  ; I will spend mine arrows upon them .
And should sleep , and rise night and day , and the seed should spring and grow up , he knoweth not how .
translation.kha: U thiah mynmiet , u khie bad ha ka por mynsngi , bad ha baroh kata ka por ki symbai ki speh bad ki nang san . Pynban um tip kumno kane ka jia .

translation.en: He revealeth the deep and secret things : he knoweth what is in the darkness , and the light dwelleth with him .
translation.kha: U pynpaw ïa kiei kiei kiba jylliew bad kiba rieh ; u tip kaei kaba la buhrieh ha ka jingdum , bad ïa u hi la ker sawdong da ka jingshai .
Ko ka ri , ko ka ri , ko ka ri ! to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la ong ;
translation.en: O earth , earth , earth , hear the word of the  Lord .

Therefore thou shalt deal kindly with thy servant  ; for thou hast brought thy servant into a covenant of the  Lord  with thee : notwithstanding , if there be in me iniquity , slay me thyself  ; for why shouldest thou bring me to thy father ?
translation.kha: Sngewbha leh ïa kane namar jong nga ; bad bat ïa ka jingkular bakyntang kaba phi la ai ha nga . Hynrei lada nga long ba la pynrem , pynïap ïa nga da lade hi ! Balei phin shim ïa nga sha i pa jong phi ban shah pynïap ?
U Abishai , u khun lad ka Seruïah , u khop ïa ki Edom ha ka El Mluh bad pynïap khatphra hajar ngut na ki .
translation.en: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand .

And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman , that is a bondmaid , betrothed to an husband , and not at all redeemed , nor freedom given her  ; she shall be scourged  ; they shall not be put to death , because she was not free .
translation.kha: Lada kano kano ka mraw ka long ka tnga kliar ba la ithuh jong u briew bad ym pat shym la siew dep ïa ka dor jong ka bad pyllaitluid , te lada uno uno u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad ka , yn pynshitom ïa ki , hynrei ym dei ban pynïap namar ka dei ka mraw .
Ki khlur ki ïaleh na sahit bneng ; Katba ki dang ïaid sha shiliang ka sahit bna , Ki la ïabeh pyrshah ïa u Sisera .
translation.en: They fought from heaven  ; the stars in their courses fought against Sisera .

translation.kha: Balei me don jingjanai palat , A Trai ? Balei me babuhrieh ïa lade haba im don ha ka jynjar ?
translation.en: Why standest thou afar off , O  Lord  ? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble ?

translation.kha: Kaba rwai jingrwai ha u briew kaba khuslai mynsiem ka long kumba loit noh ïa ki jaiñ-jin jong u ha ka por khat lane kum kaba kyllan mluh ha ka jingmong .
translation.en: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather , and as vinegar upon nitre , so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart .

translation.kha: Waw wad daw ïa u shem , wat ha kaban jar jam , bad wad daw ïa kiba riewspah , wat ha ka jingkhapnap ka kamra thiaw jong Phi . Ka sim ka lah ban thah ïa ka khubor nabar ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba phi kren .
translation.en: Curse not the king , no not in thy thought  ; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber : for a bird of the air shall carry the voice , and that which hath wings shall tell the matter .

translation.kha: Ki la noh mynsngi namar ka jingsuki jong ka jingïaid ka kam . Hynñiew ktang ïohi ba u Serubbabel u dang ïai tei ïa ka Templ , bad kin long kiba kmen . U angel u la ong ha nga , Ki hynne tylli ki sharak ki long ki Hynñiew tylli ki khmut jong U Trai kiba khmih halor ka pyrthei baroh .
translation.en: For who hath despised the day of small things ? for they shall rejoice , and shall see the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel with those seven  ; they are the eyes of the  Lord  , which run to and fro through the whole earth .
And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end :
translation.kha: Ka jingangnud kaba khraw tam jong ngi ka long ba uwei pa uwei na phi un don ka jingthrang kaba ïaineh haduh kaba kut , kumta ba kiei kiei kiba phi kyrmen kin wan urlong .
Hangta u tei ïa ka reng , bad u la khot kyrteng ïa kata ka jaka kum ka kyrteng U Blei ka Bethel , namar dei hangta U Blei u la pynpaw ïa put ha u mynba u phet ïap na la u Ahiman .
translation.en: And he built there an altar , and called the place El–beth–el : because there God appeared unto him , when he fled from the face of his brother .
And Joseph said unto his brethren , I die : and God will surely visit you , and bring you out of this land unto the land which he sware to Abraham , to Isaac , and to Jacob .
translation.kha: Te u Joseph u ong ha la ki hynmen ,  Nga la jan ïap , hynrei U Blei un ri un da ïa phi , bad un ïalam noh ïa phi na kane ka ri sha kata ka ri kaba u la kular skhem ha u Abraham , ha u Isaak , bad ha u Jakob .

Ko ki sharati , to kohnguh ïa ki kynrad jong phi ha kiei kiei baroh , ym tang lehbha ki ïohi ïa phi Namarba ba Phi kwah ban ïoh ïasngewbha ïa ki ; hynrei to leh ïa ka da ka dohnud bashisha ñiar ka jingsheptieng burom jong phi ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Servants , obey in all things your masters according to the flesh ; not with eyeservice , as menpleasers ; but in singleness of heart , fearing God :
And as they came down from the mountain , Jesus charged them , saying ,  Tell the vision to no man , until the Son of man be risen again from the dead .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang wan hiar na u lumbah , U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ,  Wat ïathuh hano hano ruh ïa kane ka jingïohipaw kaba phi la ïohi tad haduh ba ïa U Khun U Briew la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid narud ka duriaw Gilead , u la ïuh ar ngut ki nongking dohkha , u Simon bad u para jong u , u Andriw , ba ki dang ïatong dohkha da ka jar .
translation.en: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee , he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .

translation.kha: Ki jingjylliew ka duriaw ki sawa ngim , A Trai ; ki bai jam bad ki kyrhuh .
translation.en: The floods have lifted up , O  Lord  , the floods have lifted up their voice  ; the floods lift up their waves .
Then Saul arose , and went down to the wilderness of Ziph , having three thousand chosen men of Israel with him , to seek David in the wilderness of Ziph .
translation.kha: U Saul u leit mar mar ryngkat bad lai hajar ngut ki shipai kiba kynsai tam ha Israel sha ka ri khlaw Siph ban wad ïa u Dabid ,
La pyndap da ka jingkmen ïa ki briew baroh’ , bad ka nongbah ka la shongsuk , mynta ba la pynpoh ïa ka Athalaïah .
translation.en: And all the people of the land rejoiced : and the city was quiet , after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword .

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u la nguh ha u , Mynno te , phi ki Pharisi phi pynkhuid ïa kaba shabar jong ka khuri bad ka pynbang jong phi , hynrei hapoh , phi dap da ka jingleh jubor bad ka jingsniew .
translation.en: And the Lord said unto him ,  Now do ye Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter  ; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness .

translation.kha: Ki nongshun jong ka ki la lute ïa ka jingkynshew jong ka baroh . Ka la ïohi ïa ki , ba ki rung sha ka Templ hi , ha kaba U Trai u la Lah khang ïa ki Jentil don leit .
translation.en: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground , and keep silence : they have cast up dust upon their heads  ; they have girded themselves with sackcloth : the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground .
For John truly baptized with water  ; but ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la pynbaptis da ka um , hynrei ha ki khyndiat sngi yn sa pynbaptis ïa phi da U Mynsiem Bakhuid .

translation.en: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem : thou shalt weep no more : he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry  ; when he shall hear it , he will answer thee .
translation.kha: Ko phi ki briew kiba shong basah ha Jerusalem phin ym ïam shuh lano lano ruh . U  Trai  u long uba sngewsynei , bad haba phi kyang sha u ban ïoh jingïarap , un jubab ïa phi .

translation.en: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound : therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water .
translation.kha: U Trai u ong ,  Nga la bitar namar ba ki nongïalam ka Judah ki la hiarthma ïa ka Israel bad tuh jaka na ka . Kumta ngan theh noh ka jingpynshitom halor jong ki kum ka jingshlei um .

Ka la leit phai pat sha u Elisha , u nongïathuhlypa , uba la ong ïa ka , Die ïa ka bymshemphang Olib malu siew dep ïa ki ram jong phi baroh , ban yn khong bun ka tyngam kaba tam na ka bynta jong phi bad ki khun Shynrang jong phi ban im .
translation.en: Then she came and told the man of God . And he said , Go , sell the oil , and pay thy debt , and live thou and thy children of the rest .

translation.kha: Nangta U Terah u bitar lip ïa ki Israel , bad u Ong , Kane ka jaitbynriew ka la pynkhynñiuh ïa ka million kaba nga la hukum ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki ban sumar . Namar ba kim shym la kumjuh ïa nga ,
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel  ; and he said , Because that this people hath transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers , and have not hearkened unto my voice  ;

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki wallam ïa la ka jong ka jingkhyllong noh da ki kam basniew jong ki , hynne ïa ki briew naba bha la ïada da ka jinglonghok jong ki .
translation.en: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness : but the righteous hath hope in his death .
Pharaoh was wroth with his servants , and put me in ward in the captain of the guard s house , both me and the chief baker :
translation.kha: Phi la bitar ïa nga bad ïa u rangbah ki nongshet kpu , bad phi la buh ïa ngi ha phatok ha ka ïing jong u kapten jong ki nongap phira .

translation.en: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate : and he measured the south gate according to these measures  ;
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop bashathie sha ka phyllaw bashapoh . U la thew ïa ka khyrdop , bad ka la don kajuh ka jingheh kum kito kiba ha ki kynroh kiba shabar .
Kiba sarong ki krenbeiñ borabor ïa nga , hynrei ngam shym pait noh na ka aiñ jong me .
translation.en: The proud have had me greatly in derision : yet have I not declined from thy law .

translation.kha: bathoiñ ba ar kren , nga hap ban ksiang jam bad pyrta , Ka jingleh jrop ! Ka jingpynjot ! A Trai , ïa nga la rkhiebeiñ bad beiñ ha ki por baroh namar nga Pynbna ïa ka khubor jong me .
translation.en: For since I spake , I cried out , I cried violence and spoil  ; because the word of the  Lord  was made a reproach unto me , and a derision , daily .

translation.kha: Man ba sdang u bthei , wanlam ka jingainguh thrang shad U Terah : ar tylli ki mangi lyngraw , Uei u langbrot , malade hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang ibha shisyndon ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingdiang .
translation.en: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , and one ram , seven lambs of the first year without spot  ;
But the Lord is faithful , who shall stablish you , and keep you from evil .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u long uba ïaineh , bad un pynshaitbor ïa phi bad ri sumar ïa phi na Uta u Basniew .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Korah , Hear , I pray you , ye sons of Levi :
translation.kha: U Moses u la bteng ban kren ha u Korah ,  Da sngap bha , phi ki Lebi !
Mynta to jied khat ngut ki rangbah , uwei na kawei kawei ka jaitniam Israel .
translation.en: Now therefore take you twelve men out of the tribes of Israel , out of every tribe a man .

translation.kha: Nga khot kyrpad ïa U Trai , bad u pyllait im ïa nga na ki nongshun jong ar . To ïakhreh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: I will call on the  Lord  , who is worthy to be praised : so shall I be saved from mine enemies .
What will ye ? shall I come unto you with a rod , or in love , and in the spirit of meekness ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba phi kham jied ? Hato ngan wan sha phi da u dieng sympat , ne ha ka mynsiem ka jingieit bad ka jingjemnud ?

translation.en: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God , and laid it upon the ass , and brought it back : and the old prophet came to the city , to mourn and to bury him .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa tymmen u shim ïa kata ka metïap bad u kyntiew ïa ka halor ka kada , bad u leit kit pat ïa ka sha Bethel ban ïam sngewsih bad ban tep ïa ka .
Phi lah ban pynngat ïa kiwei pait ki jait dieng bad pynbunkam ïa ki ha ka ter ïa ki kynton ïada pyrshah ïa kata ka shnong haduh ba kun da kyllon .
translation.en: Only the trees which thou knowest that they be not trees for meat , thou shalt destroy and cut them down  ; and thou shalt build bulwarks against the city that maketh war with thee , until it be subdued .
And Hezekiah slept with his fathers : and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u la ïap , bad u khun jong u , u Manasseh u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
Hattush me la dep ka jingkren jong me kaba kum ka lyer ?
translation.en: How long wilt thou speak these things ? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind ?

translation.kha: U Baasha u khun jongngi u Ahijah , uba na ka jait Issakhar , u la ïasuhbuit pyrshah ïa u Nadab pynlang u la pynïap ïa u kaba u Naba bad ka kynhun shipai jong u ki dang kerkut ïa ka nongbah Gibbethon ha Phrygia .
translation.en: And Baasha the son of Ahijah , of the house of Issachar , conspired against him  ; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon , which belonged to the Philistines  ; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah kiba la ïaid ha khmat jong U Jisu bad kito kiba la bud nangne ki la sdang ban pyrta , To ïahiar ïa U khun u Dabid ! U balui u kyrkhu ïa uta babha wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ! To ïaroh ïa U Blei !
translation.en: And the multitudes that went before , and that followed , cried , saying , Hosanna to the Son of David : Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord  ; Hosanna in the highest .

translation.kha: U Bel u la ong ha nga , Ko khun u briew , peit shaphang shatei . Nga la peit , bad hangta hajan ka duwan harud ka jaka rung ka khyrdop nga la ïohi ïa ka dur bleithaw kaba long ka jingijli ba pynjar ïa U Blei .
translation.en: Then said he unto me , Son of man , lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north . So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north , and behold northward at the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry .
Even all the Jews returned out of all places whither they were driven , and came to the land of Judah , to Gedaliah , unto Mizpah , and gathered wine and summer fruits very much .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la mihnoh na ki jaka ba la pynsakma ïa ki bad ki la wan phai pat sha Judah . Ki la wan sha u Gedalaïah ha Mispah , bad hangta ki la ïalum shibun bah ka waiñ bad ki soh .

translation.en: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity : and the rod of his anger shall fail .
translation.kha: Lada phi bet ïa ki symbai ka jingbymhok , ka jingpynjot kan mih , bad ka jingbanbeiñ jong phi ïa kiwei kan kut noh .
U Elijah u la khie jied , u bam bad u tiduh bad ka jingbam ka la ai bor ïa u ban ïaid syep sngi shata Sinai , u lum bakhuid .
translation.en: And he arose , and did eat and drink , and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of God .
As concerning the sons of Laadan  ; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan , chief fathers , even of Laadan the Gershonite , were Jehieli .
translation.kha: U Ladan , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Gershon , u dei u kpa tymmen jong shibun ki kynhun longïing , kynthup ïa ka longïing jong u Jehiel u khun jong u .
Nga ainguh ïa U Blei jongu nga , man la ka por ba nga pyrkhat shaphang lad phi .
translation.en: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you .

translation.kha: Kumta te , phi dien ban long kiba ïai pynkhreh , namar ba U du U briew’ un wan ha ka kynta kaba phim shym khmied lyndum ïa u .
translation.en: Therefore be ye also ready : for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh .
His head and his hairs were white like wool , as white as snow  ; and his eyes were as a flame of fire  ;
translation.kha: U shñiuh jong u , u la long uba lieh kum u  saiwul lane kum ka ïor , bad ki khmat jong u kiba klang kum ka ding ;
Mynta to ïng jot kum u pynbah bad jubab ïa ki jingkylli kiba nga kylli ïa me .
translation.en: Gird up now thy loins like a man  ; for I will demand of thee , and answer thou me .

translation.kha: To ïathuh ha ki ba ma de , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong ha ki : Ngin pyrsad mynnin ha phi , pynlang ngan wallam patar ïa pa sha ka jingim .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  unto these bones  ; Behold , I will cause breath to enter into you , and ye shall live :

Wherefore ye shall make images of your emerods , and images of your mice that mar the land  ; and ye shall give glory unto the God of Israel : peradventure he will lighten his hand from off you , and from off your gods , and from off your land .
translation.kha: Phi dei ban thaw ïa ki dur jong u thung bad ki dur khnai kiba la pynjulor ïa ka ri jong phi , bad phi dei ban ai burom ïa U Blei ki Israel . Lehse un sa sangeh noh na kaba pynshitom ïa phi , ïa ki blei jong phi , bad ïa ka ri jong phi .

translation.en: And if a kingdom be divided against itself , that kingdom cannot stand .
translation.kha: Lada ka ri ka phiah ïa lade ha ki kynhun kiba ïaleh pyrshah para ma ki , kata ka ri kan kyllon noh .
Namar kata , phin ïoh ïa kaba phi pan khiah , bad ki kam jong ph hi ngin pynkhamti ïa phi .
translation.en: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way , and be filled with their own devices .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Pharaoh s heart is hardened , he refuseth to let the people go .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses ,  U Pharaoh u long uba mutlop eh bad u kyntait ban shah ïa ki paidbah ban leit .
U Isaak u la pyndep ban ai ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u , bad shen hadien ba u jaboh u la leit , u Iso u hynriew jong u , u la wan pah na kiba behmrad .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as Isaac had made an end of blessing Jacob , and Jacob was yet scarce gone out from the presence of Isaac his father , that Esau his brother came in from his hunting .

translation.kha: Katba u dang leit shata , U Mynsiem jongu U balui u wan hiar tyllep ha u ruh , bun u shad bad u risa baroh shi lynter lynti sha Naïoth .
translation.en: And he went thither to Naioth in Ramah : and the Spirit of God was upon him also , and he went on , and prophesied , until he came to Naioth in Ramah .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka Khubor shaphang ka Arabia . Phin ki briew jong ka Dedan , kiba ki kynjoh leit jingleit jong phi ki shong dara ha ka rudnong bashrah jongno ka Arabia ,
translation.en: The burden upon Arabia . In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge , O ye travelling companies of Dedanim .

translation.kha: Ha ka lawlynnong jyllang U Trai , u nongïathuhlypa na Jedaïah u leit shiah Bethel pynlang u la poi hangta hamar ba u Jeroboam u ïeng ha ka duwan ban kñia jingngeit .
translation.en: And , behold , there came a man of God out of Judah by the word of the  Lord  unto Beth–el : and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense .

translation.kha: Kum u la ai ïa ka jingmaham Kaba eh ba un pyningkhong ïa ki ba kin ïap ha ka ri shym
translation.en: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them , to overthrow them in the wilderness :

Either three years  famine  ; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes , while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee  ; or else three days the sword of the  Lord  , even the pestilence , in the land , and the angel of the  Lord  destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel . Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me .
translation.kha: Lai snem ka jingkyrduh bam ? Lane , lai bnai kaba phet krad na ki nongshun jong me ? Lane lai sngi ha kaba U  Trai  u tur ïaleh ïa me da ka waitlam bad phah ka jingïapthem halor ka ri jong me , da kaba pyndonkam ïa u angel jong u ban wallam ka jingïap ha kylleng ka Israel ? Kaei ka jubab ba ngan ai ha U  Trai  ?
A Trai to khie Bad ïarap ïa ngi ! Pyndonkam ïa la ka bor Bad pynim ïa ngi ; pyndonkam ïa ka kum ha ka por mynleh . Dei ma me kiba la ot lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa u Rahab u parad duriaw-bah bakynsha .
translation.en: Awake , awake , put on strength , O arm of the  Lord   ; awake , as in the ancient days , in the generations of old . Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab , and wounded the dragon ?

translation.kha: Naba hadien khie kaba la jia mynta ka sngi , ka don ka jingma ba yn mudui ïa ngi na ka bynta ka jingkhihwin . Ym don kano kano ka jingmap na ka bynta kane ka jingkhynñiuh , bad ngim eh ban ai kano kano ka daw kaban dei na ka bniat kata .
translation.en: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day s uproar , there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse .

translation.kha: Kumta to ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ong . Ngin lumlang ïa ki na ki ri sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ngan ai pat ïa ka ri Israel ha ki .
translation.en: Therefore say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will even gather you from the people , and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered , and I will give you the land of Israel .

translation.kha: Ko Tiras , U Blei jong nga , nga long u shakri jong me . Shahshkor ïa ka jingduwai jong nga , bad to ai ïa ki jingkyrpad bakha nga la pan na me ha kane ka sngi .
translation.en: Yet have thou respect unto the prayer of thy servant , and to his supplication , O  Lord  my God , to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer , which thy servant prayeth before thee to day :
Then will I make their waters deep , and cause their rivers to run like oil , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan shah ïa ki um jong me ban long jai jai bad ngan pynlong sngur bad ngan shah ïa ki wah jong me ba kin tuid jai jai . Ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga la kren .

Kumta uta u bhabriew u leit rung sha kata ka ïing , bad u Laban u pynhiar ïa ki jingsuh na kita ki ut bad u la ai phlangïap bad jingbam ïa ki . Hangta u la wanrah um ïa u shakri jong u Abraham bad ïa ki nongjop jong u ba keiñ set ïa la ki kjat .
translation.en: And the man came into the house : and he ungirded his camels , and gave straw and provender for the camels , and water to wash his feet , and the men s feet that were with him .

translation.kha: Da shisha phi la ïohsngew ba U Blei ha ka jingaiei jong u , u la ai ha nga ïa khnai ka kdew ban trei na ka pynbha ka jingbha jong phi .
translation.en: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward :
And Moses took the rod from before the  Lord  , as he commanded him .
translation.kha: U Moses u la leit shim ïa uta diengduh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum .

translation.en: And I will be found of you , saith the  Lord  : and I will turn away your captivity , and I will gather you from all the nations , and from all the places whither I have driven you , saith the  Lord   ; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive .
translation.kha: Ho-oid , nga ong , phin shem ïa nga , bad ngan buh pat ïa phi ha ka ri jong phi hi . Ngan lumlang ïa phi na kawei pa kawei ka ri bad na kawei ka jaka sha kaba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , bad ngan wallam pat ïa phi sha ka ri na kaba nga la phah noh ïa phi sha ka jingshah ringmraw . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .’
Hynrei u la phah ïa u briew ha shuwa jong ki , u Joseph , ïa uba la die kum u maw .
translation.en: He sent a man before them , even Joseph , who was sold for a servant :

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la khot ïa ki paidbah sha u bad u la ong ha ki , To shahshkor bad to shemphang !
translation.en: And he called the multitude , and said unto them ,  Hear , and understand :

translation.kha: Nalor kata , ym daiñ Ban wanrah ïa ka kamai nuti , la ka dei ka jrong u shynrang ne ka kynthei , sha ka ïing U Trai U Blei! jong phi kumto ka jingpyntieng ïa kano kano ka jingshem , Naaman U Trai u isih ïa ki nuti ha ka jaka mane blei .
translation.en: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore , or the price of a dog , into the house of the  Lord  thy God for any vow : for even both these are abomination unto the  Lord  thy God .

translation.kha: Ki jingbishar jngai u ki long kiba shisha bad kiba khop ! U la pynriam ïa ka nuti kaba pynpyut ïa ka khyndew da ki jingawria jrong ka . U Blei u la pynshitom ïa ka namar ba ka la pynïap ïa ki shakri jong u .
translation.en: For true and righteous are his judgments : for he hath judged the great whore , which did corrupt the earth with her fornication , and hath avenged the blood of his servants at her hand .

translation.kha: Kumta u Joab bad u Abishai u para jong u ki la pynhiarkput ïa u Abner namar ka jingpynïap ïa u Asahel u hynmen u para jongnga ki ha ka thma ha Gibeon .
translation.en: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner , because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle .
Thy name , O  Lord  , endureth for ever  ; and thy memorial , O  Lord  , throughout all generations .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , ïa me yn pynbna borabor kum U Blei ; ki pateng bynriew baroh kin kynmaw ïa me .

translation.en: But he forsook the counsel of the old men , which they had given him , and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him , and which stood before him :
translation.kha: Hynrei u kyntait ïa ka jingai jingmut jong ki riewrangbah bad u leit pynban sha ki samla kiba la ïasan ryngkat bad u bad kiba long mynta ki nongaibuit jong u .
Uta u briew’ u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khrud bashathie sha ka phyllung bashaniah . U la thew ïa ka khyrdop , bad ka la kein kajuh ka jingïoh kum kito kiba ha ki kynjri kiba shabar .
translation.en: And he brought me to the inner court by the south gate : and he measured the south gate according to these measures  ;

translation.kha: bad mynta une u syiem un ïalam ïa phi . Nga te nga la tymmen badno buh ñiuhlieh , hynrei ki khun shynrang jong nga ki don nabar phi . Ang la long u nongïalam jong phi naduh ba la dang samla haduh Myntan .
translation.en: And now , behold , the king walketh before you : and I am old and grayheaded  ; and , behold , my sons are with you : and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day .
And he made the staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold , to bear the table .
translation.kha: U shna ïa kita ki jingbah da ka dieng akasia bad u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .
Ki nongshna da ki kti ki ïabeh Bad ki pynshlur uwei ïa uwei pat .
translation.en: They helped every one his neighbour  ; and every one said to his brother , Be of good courage .
And the man of God said , Where fell it ? And he shewed him the place . And he cut down a stick , and cast it in thither  ; and the iron did swim .
translation.kha: Hangno u hap ?  u Elisha u kylli . Ynda uta u briew u kdew ha u ïa kata ka jaka , bad u Elisha u daiñ ïa uwei u dieng , u pashat ïa u ha ka um , bad u pynper ïa u khlieh sdie .
Hynrei ki jingthmu jong u ki neh junom , ki jingthmu jong u ki long pat la pateng .
translation.en: The counsel of the  Lord  standeth for ever , the thoughts of his heart to all generations .
Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar  ; two lambs of the first year day by day continually .
translation.kha: Man la ka sngi ha ki por ban wan , kñia ha kata ka duwan ar tylli ki khunlangbrot kiba shisnem .
U Trai un wan bad ka ding . Un shong ha ki thapniang jong ka erïong , Ban pynshitom ïa kito kiba u la bitar .
translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  will come with fire , and with his chariots like a whirlwind , to render his anger with fury , and his rebuke with flames of fire .
And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father , and said , My father : and he said , Here am I , my son . And he said , Behold the fire and the wood : but where is the lamb for a burnt offering ?
translation.kha: u Isaak u ong ,  Ko pa !  U jubab ,  Oi , khun ?  U Isaak u kylli ,  Nga ïohi ïa ki rnga barhem bad ïa ki dieng , hynrei hangno pat u khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka jingkñia ?

La ïaheh ïa ki Philistia ba la thung ïa u ïabuaid Kum u shem ki Israel , kumta ka kynhun shaei jong ki ka la miej ba-bang rupa kumta ïa u . Haba u Dabid u ïohsngew ïa kata , u la leit hiar sha ka jaka ba la ker kynroh .
translation.en: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Israel , all the Philistines came up to seek David  ; and David heard of it , and went down to the hold .

translation.kha: Ka la don sa kawei ka thma hapdeng ki Philistia bad ki Israel , bad u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la leit bad ïaheh ïa ki Philistia . Ha kiwei ka thma u Dabid u khie tlot .
translation.en: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel  ; and David went down , and his servants with him , and fought against the Philistines : and David waxed faint .
And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee  ; and the mother of Jesus was there :
translation.kha: Ar sngi hadien , la don ka jingkyntiew kurim ha ka shnong Kana kaba ha Galilaïa .
Ki khun ki ksiew Jong u Joseph ki ong ha u Joshua , Balei phi ai ïa ngi tang sha bynta jong ka ri ba ngin kam kynti kum la ka jong ? Neng ïadon bun ngut namar U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa I .
translation.en: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua , saying , Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit , seeing I am a great people , forasmuch as the  Lord  hath blessed me hitherto ?

translation.kha: Ki la shahjingit bad ki la duwai , ki la buh ïa la ki kti halor jong ki , malu ki la pha noh ïa ki .
translation.en: And when they had fasted and prayed , and laid their hands on them , they sent them away .

translation.kha: Na Miletos u Paul u la phah khubor shaei Eliphas , da kaba kyrpad ïa ki nongsharai balang , ban ïakynduh ïa u .
translation.en: And from Miletus he sent to Ephesus , and called the elders of the church .

translation.kha: U Merari u don ar ngut ki khun shaneng : U Mahli bad u Kushi . Kine ki Long ki jat jong ki Lem lem malade ki khun ki ksiew jong ki .
translation.en: And the sons of Merari  ; Mahli and Mushi : these are the families of Levi according to their generations .

translation.kha: Nangta u syier ka Joppa u ong ha ki nongpynjot khun kiba na ki kynthei Hebru , kawei kaba kyrteng ka Shiphrah bad kiwei pat ka Puah ,
translation.en: And the king of Egypt spake to the Hebrew midwives , of which the name of the one was Shiphrah , and the name of the other Puah :

translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jongngi nga , to ai ba ka dohnud jong phi kan kwah hir hir ïa ka ïa-ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei , hynrei wat adong ïa ka jingkren ha ki thylliej baïar .
translation.en: Wherefore , brethren , covet to prophesy , and forbid not to speak with tongues .
They hatch cockatrice  eggs , and weave the spider s web : he that eateth of their eggs dieth , and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper .
translation.kha: Ki jingïasylla bymman kiba phi pynlong ki long kiba shyrkhei kum ki pylleng jong ki bseiñ kiba don bih . Pynpait ïa kata ka pylleng , un mih u bseiñ .
Nangta U Trai u ai ha nga ïa ki ar tylli ki mawkyntang ha kiba u la thoh da la ka kti ïa kata kaba u la kren ha phi napdeng ka ding ha kato ka snoh ba phi ïalumlang ha uta u lum .
translation.en: And the  Lord  delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God  ; and on them was written according to all the words , which the  Lord  spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly .

translation.kha: U Joash u syiem ka Judah u rim lut ïa baroh ki jingaiei ba kiba ha shwa jong u , u Jehoshaphat , u Jehoram , bad u Ahasaïah ki la pynkyntang sha U Tharai , u kyntiap lang ïa ki jingai jong u bad ka ksiar baroh ka ha ki ïing jingkynshew jong ka Tubal bad ka ïingsyiem , bad u phad ïa kita baroh kum ka jingai sngewbha sha u syiem Asahel , uba ïalam noh ïa ka kynhun shipawa jong u na Jerusalem .
translation.en: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat , and Jehoram , and Ahaziah , his fathers , kings of Judah , had dedicated , and his own hallowed things , and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and in the king s house , and sent it to Hazael king of Syria : and he went away from Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Me la pynjot ïa ki nongbah bad pynpra ïa ki jingtei-kut . Ki ïingsyiem kiba ki nongshun jong ngi ki la Tei ki la jah noh junom .
translation.en: For thou hast made of a city an heap  ; of a defenced city a ruin : a palace of strangers to be no city  ; it shall never be built .
