translation.kha: Khie leit noh sha ïing , u syiem u la jop , sad ngan sa khmih ïa ka kam .
translation.en: And the king said unto the woman , Go to thine house , and I will give charge concerning thee .

translation.kha: Mynba nga dang duwai , u Jabal , uba nga la lah ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw mynshuwa , u la wan her sha tbian sha ka jaka ha kaba nga don . Ka la long ha ka na ban ai ïa ka jingkñia janmiet .
translation.en: Yea , whiles I was speaking in prayer , even the man Gabriel , whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning , being caused to fly swiftly , touched me about the time of the evening oblation .

translation.kha: U Jakob u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih bad u kup da ka jaiñ khwan . U la ïan sngewsih bun sngi na ka bynta u khun jong u .
translation.en: And Jacob rent his clothes , and put sackcloth upon his loins , and mourned for his son many days .

translation.kha: U Dabid u shim ïa ka khlieh u Goliath Bad u rah ïa ka shiah Jerusalem , hynrei u buh ïa ki atiar u Goliath ha la ka dara .
translation.en: And David took the head of the Philistine , and brought it to Jerusalem  ; but he put his armour in his tent .

translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Mane batip ïa ka jingmut U Trai ? Mano ba lah ban ai jingmut ïa u ? Pynban , ma ngi , ngi don ïa ka jingmut U Khrist .
translation.en: For who hath known the mind of the Lord , that he may instruct him ? But we have the mind of Christ .

translation.kha: U la ïap sad la tep ïa u ha Samaria , bad u khun jong u , u Jehoash u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Jehoahaz slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him in Samaria : and Joash his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la leit jngoh Kylleng ki nongbah bad ki nongri . U la hikai ha ki syndah , u la ïarep ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang ka Hiram , bad u la pynjah ïa ki briew kiba don ki jingpang baburom jait nabar ki jingshitom .
translation.en: And Jesus went about all the cities and villages , teaching in their synagogues , and preaching the gospel of the kingdom , and healing every sickness and every disease among the people .

translation.kha: U la pyntwa ruh ïa u per ha Penuel bad pynïap ïa ki rangbah jong kata ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he beat down the tower of Penuel , and slew the men of the city .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei katba u Baasha u la leh bad ki kai shlur jong u baroh la buh jingthoh ha ka Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha , and what he did , and his might , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: U Amasa u ong , U Trei u kyrshut na u Lum Seïon ; Ka Sur jong u ka tied kum u pyrthat na Jerusalem . Ki jaka phlang ki dyngkhong , malade u phlang ha Lum Karmel u ïapstai .
translation.en: And he said , The  Lord  will roar from Zion , and utter his voice from Jerusalem  ; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn , and the top of Carmel shall wither .

translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la mane ïa u , wat la don na ki , kiba la sngew itynnat .
translation.en: And when they saw him , they worshipped him : but some doubted .

translation.kha: Kin sa tip ruh ba nga long U Trei U Blei jong ki , uba la ïalam noh ïa ki na ka ri Ijipt khnang ba kan ïoh shongduh hapdeng jong ki . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And they shall know that I am the  Lord  their God , that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , that I may dwell among them : I am the  Lord  their God .

And , behold , one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips : then I opened my mouth , and spake , and said unto him that stood before me , O my lord , by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me , and I have retained no strength .
translation.kha: Nangta u angel , uba syriem ïa u briew , u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa ki rmiang shyntur jong nga . Nga la ong ha u ,  Ko rangbah , kane ka jingïohipaw ka pyntlot ïa nga haduh katta katta ba ngam lah ban sangeh ban khynñiuh .

translation.en: And I saw a great white throne , and him that sat on it , from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away  ; and there was found no place for them .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ïa ka khet balieh kaba khraw bad ïa uta uba shong ha ka . Ka pyrthei bad ka bneng ki la phet na khmat jong u bad ym shym la ïohi shuh ïa ki .
‘ Wat sakhi lamler ïabna nangno .
translation.en: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet u Saul u pynbynta ïa u paidïapom jong u ha ki lai kynhun , bad ynda mynstep ki tur sha ka jaka shong dara ki nongshun bad tur ïaleit ïa ki Ammon . Ha ka por shiteng sngi ki la lah pynïap ïa ki . Kiba lait im ki pui ïap , marwei marwei ha la ka lyndum .
translation.en: And it was so on the morrow , that Saul put the people in three companies  ; and they came into the midst of the host in the morning watch , and slew the Ammonites until the heat of the day : and it came to pass , that they which remained were scattered , so that two of them were not left together .

translation.kha: Namar ba kim don ka jingngeit , um shym la leh shibun ki ïabam hangta .
translation.en: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief .

translation.kha: daiñ step phyrngab ha ka Sngi U Trai , kato ka ïangat dem , ka Mahli ka nong Magdala ka la leit sha kata ka jingtep bad ka la ioh ba ïa u mawkhang la weng noh na ka jingkhang ka jingtep .
translation.en: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early , when it was yet dark , unto the sepulchre , and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre .

translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , kyrpad jur ïa la ka kmie — wat lada kam dei tngen shu ïa de , bad per ruh ngam dei shuh u tnga jong ka . Kyrpad ïa ka ba kan shniah noh na kaba klim bad ka jingleh nuti .
translation.en: Plead with your mother , plead : for she is not my wife , neither am I her husband : let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight , and her adulteries from between her breasts  ;
Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture , Behold , I lay in Sion a chief corner stone , elect , precious : and he that believeth on him shall not be confounded .
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Nga la jied ïa u maw uba kordor ïa uba nga buh kum u mawdong ha Seïon ; bad uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym noh mynsiem da lei lei .
Ngin thoh ïa kaei sha phi , ym namar ba nga kwah ban pynlehrain ïa phi , hynrei ban sneng ïa phi kum ki khun ba-ieit jong per .
translation.en: I write not these things to shame you , but as my beloved sons I warn you .

And Jesus said unto them ,  Can the children of the bridechamber mourn , as long as the bridegroom is with them ? but the days will come , when the bridegroom shall be taken from them , and then shall they fast .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Hato phi khmih lynti ba kiba shah khot sngewbha sha ka jingkhawai shongkurim kin sngewsih katba u nongleitkurim u dang don lem bad ki ? Em kam long kumta ! Hynrei ka sngi kan poi haba ïa u nongleitkurim yn shim noh na ki , bad kumta keiñ kin sa shahjingit .
Ïa U Khun U Briew yn sa ai noh ha ki briew ki ban pynïap ïa u . Pynban hadien lai sngi , un sa mihpat .
translation.en: For he taught his disciples , and said unto them ,  The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men , and they shall kill him  ; and after that he is killed , he shall rise the third day .
For they came up with their cattle and their tents , and they came as grasshoppers for multitude  ; for both they and their camels were without number : and they entered into the land to destroy it .
translation.kha: Ki wan lem bad la ki jingri bad ki dara kumba rben ki kynhun puit . Ma ki lem bad ki ut jong ki , ki bun haduh katta katta ba ym lah ñiew shuh ïa ki . Ki wan bad pynjot thiaw ïa ka ri ,

translation.en: Behold , I will gather them out of all countries , whither I have driven them in mine anger , and in my fury , and in great wrath  ; and I will bring them again unto this place , and I will cause them to dwell safely :
translation.kha: Ngan sa lumlang ïa ki briew na baroh ki ri na kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki ha ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla jong nga , bad ngan wallam pat ïa ki sha kane ka jaka bad shah ïa ki ban shong ban sah hangne ha ka jingshngain .

translation.en: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  , as did David his father .
translation.kha: U Asa u leh ïa kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , kumba u Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u , u la leh .

translation.en: And Hezekiah king of Judah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish , saying , I have offended  ; return from me : that which thou puttest on me will I bear . And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Judah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold .
translation.kha: U Hesekaïah u phah ïa ka khubor sha u Sennakherib , uba don ha Lakhish :  Nga la leh bakla ; sngewbha pynsangeh ïa ka jingtur ïaleh jong phi , bad ngan siew kat kaba phi dawa .  Ka jubab u nongsynshar ka long ba u Hesekaïah un phah sha u shiphew ton ka rupa bad shi ton ka ksiar .

Hynrei haba ki la lai khum ïa u ban sympat , u Paul u la nong ïa u ïabah pynïaidkam kaba ïeng hangta , Hato ka shong aiñ ïa me ban hati ïa u traishnong ka Hima Rom u bym shym la shah shrah na ka bynta Kana kano ka kur runar ?
translation.en: And as they bound him with thongs , Paul said unto the centurion that stood by , Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman , and uncondemned ?

And the people said unto Saul , Shall Jonathan die , who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel ? God forbid : as the  Lord  liveth , there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground  ; for he hath wrought with God this day . So the people rescued Jonathan , that he died not .
translation.kha: Hynrei ki paidbah ki ong ha u Saul ,  Hato u Jonathan , uba la jop ka jingjop kaba khraw na ka bynta ki Israel , un shah pynïap ? Em ! Ngi kular ha U  Trai  uba im ba uwei u shñiuh na ka khlieh jong u ruh un ym hap ha khyndew . Kaei kaba u la leh ha kane ka sngi la leh da ka jingïarap jong U Blei .  Kumta ki paidbah ki la pyllait im ïa u Jonathan na kaba shah pynïap .

translation.en: I charge you , O daughters of Jerusalem , if ye find my beloved , that ye tell him , that I am sick of love .
translation.kha: Wan bad nga na ki lumbah ka Lebanon , ko ka nongleitkurim jong nga ; wan bad nga na Lebanon . Wan hiar na kliar u lum Amana , na u lum Senir bad u lum Hermon , ha kaba ki sing bad ki  labasa ki shong .

translation.en: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him , I brought him forth into their council :
translation.kha: Nga la kwah ban tip ïa kaei kaba ki la mudui ïa u , kumta nga la ïalam ïa u sha ka Dorbar jong ki .

Kynton kynsan la mihpaw ka kti briew bad ka la sdang ban thoh ha ka kynroh ba la astor jong ka ïingsyiem , ha kaba ka jingshlei na ki sharak ka shai pharia eh . Bad u syiem u la ïoh ïa ka kti katba ka dang thoh .
translation.en: In the same hour came forth fingers of a man s hand , and wrote over against the candlestick upon the plaster of the wall of the king s palace : and the king saw the part of the hand that wrote .
And the harp , and the viol , the tabret , and pipe , and wine , are in their feasts : but they regard not the work of the  Lord  , neither consider the operation of his hands .
translation.kha: Ha ki jingkhawai jong phi , phi don ki duitara , ki shakuriaw bad ki tangmuri — bad ka waiñ . Hynrei phim sngewthuh aïu U  Trai  u leh ,

translation.en: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it : and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it .
translation.kha: Ki briew ka pyrthei kin ïaid ha ka jingshai jong ka , bad ki syiem jong ka pyrthei kin wallam ïa ka spah jong ki shapoh jong ka .
U trep ïa ka metïap ha ka jingtep jong ka longïing jong u hi , bad ma u bad la ki kynhun shynrang ki ïa-ïam sngewsih ïa ka , ki da ong , O u para jong nga , u para jong nga !
translation.en: And he laid his carcase in his own grave  ; and they mourned over him , saying , Alas , my brother !
How that he was caught up into paradise , and heard unspeakable words , which it is not lawful for a man to utter .
translation.kha: Nga ong biang , nga tip ba ïa une u briew la rong noh sha ka Paradais (sa shisien , ngam tip la kane ka da jia shisha ne ka la long tang ka jingïohipaw — tang U Blei uba tip) , bad hangta u la ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei ïa kiba ym lah ban buh ha ki kyntien , kiei kiei kiba ki rmiang shyntur briew kim lah ban kren .

translation.en: And Saul built an altar unto the  Lord  : the same was the first altar that he built unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Saul u tei ka duwan ha U  Trai  ; ka duwan kaba nyngkong kaba u la tei .

translation.en: ( There are eleven days  journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh–barnea . )
translation.kha: ( Ka shim por khatwei sngi ban ïaid na u Lum Sinai sha Kadesh Barnea na shaphang ka ri lum Edom . )

translation.en: And they feared exceedingly , and said one to another , What manner of man is this , that even the wind and the sea obey him ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ki la sheptieng haduh katta katta bad ki la ïa-ong para ma ki ,  Uei une u briew ? Wat ka lyer bad ki jingat phyllung ki kohnguh ïa u !

translation.en: What ? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in ? or despise ye the church of God , and shame them that have not ? What shall I say to you ? shall I praise you in this ? I praise you not .
translation.kha: Hato phim don la ka jong ka ïing ban ïabam ïadih ? Lane hato phi da kwah ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ka balang U Blei bad ban pynlehrain ïa ki briew kiba kyrduh ? Kaei ba phi khmih lynti ïa nga ban ong ha phi shaphang kane ? Hato ngan ïaroh ïa phi ? Em , ngan ym leh kumta!

translation.en: But I will hope continually , and will yet praise thee more and more .
translation.kha: Ngan ïai buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong nga ha me , ngan ïaroh ïa me shuh shuh .
Nangta u Isaïah u pham ïa ka khubor kaba ong ha u syiem Hesekaïah kum ka jubab ïa ka jingduwai u syiad
translation.en: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , That which thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard .
And Pharaoh s daughter said to her , Go . And the maid went and called the child s mother .
translation.kha: Ka khun u Pharaoh ka ong ha ka ,  Khie leit .  Kumta kata ka khynnah ka leit bad ka wan ïalam da ka kmie jong uta u khunlung hi .

Phi la pynlut shibun ka por kaba la leit noh da kaba leh ïa kaei kaba ki bymngeit ki kwah ban leh . Ïa ka jingim jong phi la pynlut ha kaba im awria , jingkwah brai , jingdih buaid , jingleh jakhlia , ki jingïaleh-sngewbha buaid , bad ha ka jingman ba-ijli ïa ki bleithaw .
translation.en: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles , when we walked in lasciviousness , lusts , excess of wine , revellings , banquetings , and abominable idolatries :
But there are some of you that believe not .  For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not , and who should betray him .
translation.kha: Pynban don na phi ki bymngeit .  ( U Jisu u la tip naduh kaba mynnyngkong kino ki dei kita ki ban ym ngeit bad uno na ki u ban shetkylla ïa u . )

translation.en: And when the  Lord  thy God hath delivered it into thine hands , thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword :
translation.kha: Te , ynda U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi ïa kata ka shnong , pynïap lut ïa uwei pa uwei u shynrang .

translation.en: And they all wept sore , and fell on Paul s neck , and kissed him ,
translation.kha: Baroh ki la ïa-ïam haba ki la kdup ïa u bad ki la doh khublei ïakhlad bad u .

kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Nga la pynlong ïa me u kop jong ki jaitbynriew bapaw . Kumta ka jingkular ka long kaba bha ha khmat U Blei , ha ibha u Abram u la thwet — U Blei kiba wallam ïa kiba la ïap sha ka jingtim bad uba ka hukum jong u ka pynlong ïa kaei ka bym shym la don .
translation.en: ( As it is written , I have made thee a father of many nations , ) before him whom he believed , even God , who quickeneth the dead , and calleth those things which be not as though they were .

translation.kha: Kaei ka jynjar jong pha ? Ka jingjubab , Ha kato ka sngi , kaei ka briew hangne ka ai jingmut ba ngin ïabam ïa u khun lad nga , bad ban ïam ïa u khun jong ka ha ka sngi kaba bud .
translation.en: And the king said unto her , What aileth thee ? And she answered , This woman said unto me , Give thy son , that we may eat him to day , and we will eat my son to morrow .

translation.kha: bad u lah ban shakri klang khim u lyngkhuit jong U Trei U Bela jong u , kumno kiwei pang ki Lebi kiba ïashakri hangta .
translation.en: Then he shall minister in the name of the  Lord  his God , as all his brethren the Levites do , which stand there before the  Lord .

translation.kha: Bad ka jyllop kane long , ‘ dei namar ba ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jutang ba U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpa thnum jong ki , u la pynlong Bad ki mynba u wan ïalam ïa ki na Ijipt .
translation.en: Then men shall say , Because they have forsaken the covenant of the  Lord  God of their fathers , which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt :
And all the people came up after him , and the people piped with pipes , and rejoiced with great joy , so that the earth rent with the sound of them .
translation.kha: Nangta ki baroh ki la ïabud ïa u , da ka jingrisa jam bad put ïa ki sharati , da kaba pynmih ka jingsawa kaba jur kat ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka khyndew .
Naba kumba ki Briew barhem ki ïap Naaman ka jingïadei jong ki ha u Adam , kumjuh jin ïa baroh yn pynmihpat namar ka jingïadei jong ki ha U Khrist .
translation.en: For as in Adam all die , even so in Christ shall all be made alive .
That saith to the deep , Be dry , and I will dry up thy rivers :
translation.kha: Da ki ktien ka hukum nga pyntyrkhong ïa ka duriaw-bah .
‘ Ngam sngewkwah ,’ u la jubab , hynmen hadien , u la kylla ka jingmut bad u la leit .
translation.en: He answered and said , I will not : but afterward he repented , and went .
Saying , Master , Moses said , If a man die , having no children , his brother shall marry his wife , and raise up seed unto his brother .
translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai ,  ki la ong ,  u Moses u la ong ba lada u briew u bym don khun u ïap , u para jong u , u dei ban shongkurim ïa ka tnga jong une uba la ïap khnang ba ki lah ban ïoh khun ïa kiba yn lah ban ñiew kum ki khun jong une u briew uba la ïap .

translation.en: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy ,
translation.kha: bad man la ka por nga duwai na ka bynta jong phi baroh , nga duwai da ka jingkmen ,

Nalor kata , da ka bor ka jong U Blei’ phi la pynïap ïa ki ar ngut ki khlieh shihajar jong ki Midian , u Oreb bad u Hib . Nga la leh aïu ba ïanujor bad kata ? Haba u la kren ïa kane , kim shym la bitar shuh .
translation.en: God hath delivered into your hands the princes of Midian , Oreb and Zeeb : and what was I able to do in comparison of you ? Then their anger was abated toward him , when he had said that .

translation.kha: U Joshua u pynïeng ruh khriat tylli ki maw hapdeng Jong ka Jordan , ha kaba ki lyngdoh Kiba bah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ki la ïeng . ( Ktien ki maw ki dang don hangamei . )
translation.en: And Joshua set up twelve stones in the midst of Jordan , in the place where the feet of the priests which bare the ark of the covenant stood : and they are there unto this day .

translation.kha: To ïai duwai namar lad ngi . Ngi sngewskhem ba ngi don ka jingïatiplem kaba khup , namar ngi khoh ban leh ïa kaba dei ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: Pray for us : for we trust we have a good conscience , in all things willing to live honestly .

translation.kha: Lymne ba u Herod u shem ïa u , uba la rem , naba u la phah biang ïa u sha i . Kam shym khong kano kano kob une u bariew u la leh naba u dei ban ïap .
translation.en: No , nor yet Herod : for I sent you to him  ; and , lo , nothing worthy of death is done unto him .

translation.kha: Ki dei ban da thet ïa la ki kti bad sait ïa la ki katjuh , ba ktien ym ïatip . Kane ka long ka lawlynnong kaba ma ki mala ki khun ki ksiew jong ki , ki dei ïa-ban bud junom la jymphong .
translation.en: So they shall wash their hands and their feet , that they die not : and it shall be a statute for ever to them , even to him and to his seed throughout their generations .

translation.kha: bad to kan long ka jingïaroh ïa U Blei bajhieh Tam Eh uba ai ha phi ïa ka jingsop halor ki nongïeng jong phi ! Bad u Abram u ai ha u Melkhisedek ïa kaba shiphew na ka jinglanot kaba u la lah pynïoh pud .
translation.en: And blessed be the most high God , which hath delivered thine enemies into thy hand . And he gave him tithes of all .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki la ïeng hangtai da kaba khmih katba ki nongïalam jong ki Jiw ki krenbeiñ ïa u : U la pynim ïa kiwei ; ai un pynim ïa lade lada u daym U Messaïah ïa uba U Blei u la jied !
translation.en: And the people stood beholding . And the rulers also with them derided him , saying , He saved others  ; let him save himself , if he be Christ , the chosen of God .

translation.kha: (Nga la ïaleh tyngeh ïa ka jingïamareh , sa la pyndep ïa ka jingïaphet , nga la ri ïa ka jingngeit .
translation.en: I have fought a good fight , I have finished my course , I have kept the faith :
And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest , where the scribes and the elders were assembled .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la kem ïa U Jisu ki la ïalam ïa u sha ka ïing jong u Kaïaphas , u Rangbah Lyngdoh ha kaba ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki tymmen ki san ki la ïalumlang .

A to khmied sha ka shet bnoh ! mane ba thaw ïa ki khlur ba ph ïohi ? Uta uba ïalam ïa ki Shabar kum ka kynhun shipai , u tip katno ki don bad u khiat ïa uwei uwei da ka kylleng ! Ka bor jong u ka khlaw katta katta — Ym ei uwei na ki u ban jah noh .
translation.en: Lift up your eyes on high , and behold who hath created these things , that bringeth out their host by number : he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might , for that he is strong in power  ; not one faileth .
And he gave heed unto them , expecting to receive something of them .
translation.kha: Kumta u la peit sha ki , da ka jingkhmih lynti ban ïoh ei ei na ki .
Sneng pynbeit ïa uno uno , bad hadien un ïaroh ïa ka khap dara ban ïa kaba pynroh .
translation.en: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue .
In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him .
translation.kha: Ha U Khrist bad da ka jingngeit jong ngi ha u ngi don ka jingshlur ban leit sha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei da ka jingsngewskhem baroh .
Un hiarthma thew ïa ka Ri ka Jingijli bad un pynïap da ki phew hajar , hynrei ki ri Elam , Moab , bad kaei kaba la iehnoh jong ka Ammon kin lait .
translation.en: He shall enter also into the glorious land , and many countries shall be overthrown : but these shall escape out of his hand , even Edom , and Moab , and the chief of the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: Mynta ki la ïap ne sad kin ym im shuh ; ki sna-ïap lad ki kin ym mih , namar me la pyndem bad pynring ïa ki . Ym don uwei ruh u ban kynmaw haw ïa ki .
translation.en: They are dead , they shall not live  ; they are deceased , they shall not rise : therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them , and made all their memory to perish .

translation.kha: U la ai ha u ïa ka kali syiem kaba ar ba un shong ; bad ki nongkhap ïa ka ïingsyiem ki ïaid ha khmat jong u bad ki pyrta , Kynriah ! kynriah ! Jaban kumta la thung lat ïa u Jehoba halor ka ri Ijipt baïar .
translation.en: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had  ; and they cried before him , Bow the knee : and he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt .
David therefore himself calleth him Lord  ; and whence is he then his son ?  And the common people heard him gladly .
translation.kha: U Dabid hi da lade u la khot ïa u ‘ U Trai’ ; te kumno U Messaïah u lah ban hiarpateng na u Dabid ?  U paidbah babun u dang shahshkor ïa U Jisu da ka jingkmen .
U Trai Badonbor barieh u la bthah ïa u Sekharaïah ban ong ha ki briew , Ma nga , U tharai , to la bitar shikatdei ïa ki kpa tymmen jong phi ,
translation.en: The  Lord  hath been sore displeased with your fathers .
And when they saw him afar off , even before he came near unto them , they conspired against him to slay him .
translation.kha: Na jngai ki la ïohi ïa u , bad katba un da poi hajan jong ki , ki lah da ïasylla pyrshah ïa u bad rai ban pynïap noh ïa u .

translation.en: Behold , I have taught you statutes and judgments , even as the  Lord  my God commanded me , that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it .
translation.kha: Nga la hikai ïa phi ïa ki hukum , kumba U  Trai  U Blei jong nga u la hukum ïa nga . Sumar bad leh ïa ki ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit bad ïohkynti .

translation.en: And Zimri went in and smote him , and killed him , in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Judah , and reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: U Simri u rung hapoh ïing bad u la pynïap ïa u Elah , bad u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u . Kane ka jia ha ka snem kaba arphew hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Asa u syiem ka Judah .
U Jonathan u la leit sha u hangta bad u la pynshlur ïa u da ka jingpynthikna ïa ka jingïada jyllang U Blei ,
translation.en: And Jonathan Saul s son arose , and went to David into the wood , and strengthened his hand in God .

translation.kha: To ïambriew na ka pynbha kata ka hima , phi kiba shong marjan , phi barabor kiba tip ïa ka jingpawnam jong ka . To ong , ‘ Ka jingshlur bakhrawbor jong ka la pyndkut ; ka burom bad ka kun jong ka kam don hajuh .’
translation.en: All ye that are about him , bemoan him  ; and all ye that know his name , say , How is the strong staff broken , and the beautiful rod !

translation.kha: Leit bad ïathuh ha u shakri jongno at u Dabid ba nga ino ha u , ‘ Mem dei uta u ban ter ïa ka paila na ka bynta jongu nga ba ngan shongkha .
translation.en: Go and tell David my servant , Thus saith the  Lord  , Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in :

And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I am against thee , O Zidon  ; and I will be glorified in the midst of thee : and they shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I shall have executed judgments in her , and shall be sanctified in her .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki briew hangta ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong shaphang jong ki : Nga long u nongshun jong pha , ko Sidon ; ki briew kin ïaroh ïa nga namar kaei kaba nga leh ïa pha . Kin ïoh tip ba nga long U  Trai  , haba nga pyn-i katno uba khuid nga long da kaba pynshitom ïa kito kiba im hapdeng jong pha .

translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared unto him in the plains of Mamre : and he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la mihpaw ha u Abraham harud ki dieng kyntang jong u Mamre . Katba u Abraham u dang shong ha ka jingkhang ka ïingjaiñ jong u ha ka por ba dang shit kyr-ang mynsngi , u la khmied bad u la ïohi lai ngut ki rangbah kiba ïeng hangta .

Katba nga dang mudui ha ka nongbah Joahas , nga la ïoh ka jingïohipaw . Nga la ïohi ïa kaei re kaei kaba woh hiar na bnoh kaba i kum ka jaiñ siang katba heh ïa kaba la pynhiar na ki sawphew tylli ki dong jong ka , bad ka la sangeh hajan jong nga .
translation.en: I was in the city of Joppa praying : and in a trance I saw a vision , A certain vessel descend , as it had been a great sheet , let down from heaven by four corners  ; and it came even to me :

Then said they unto him , Say now Shibboleth : and he said Sibboleth : for he could not frame to pronounce it right . Then they took him , and slew him at the passages of Jordan : and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand .

translation.en: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the  Lord  , and make an atonement for it  ; and shall take of the blood of the bullock , and of the blood of the goat , and put it upon the horns of the altar round about .
Hearken to me , ye that follow after righteousness , ye that seek the  Lord  : look unto the rock whence ye are hewn , and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ;  To shahshkor ïa nga , phi kiba kwah ban ïoh jingim , phi kiba wan sha nga ban ïoh jingïarap . Puson halor u mawsiang na uba phi la wan , ka par maw na kaba la tih ïa phi .

translation.en: And immediately he received his sight , and followed him , glorifying God : and all the people , when they saw it , gave praise unto God .
translation.kha: Hangta hi u la lah ban imat pat , bad u la bud ïa U Jisu , da kaba ainguh ïa U Blei . Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohi ïa kata , ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And they took their journey from Succoth , and encamped in Etham , in the edge of the wilderness .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki ïamihnoh na Sukkoth bad ki sher dara ha Etham , ha ka tduh jong ka ri shyiap .
Ha kata ka por ngan jubab ïa ki jingduwai ki briew jong nga ki Israel . Ngan phah ïa u slap ba un hap ha ka khyndew
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , I will hear , saith the  Lord  , I will hear the heavens , and they shall hear the earth  ;

translation.kha: Hangno hangno ha kaba don ka metïap , ki pukni kin ïalumlang .
translation.en: For wheresoever the carcase is , there will the eagles be gathered together .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi : Ym don uno uno uba tar ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai ban syrdep ïa ka jaiñkup kaba rim . Lada u lai kumin , un tar ïa ka jaiñ bathymmai , bad kata ka lynthaw jaiñ bathymmai kan ym ïaid ïa kaba rim .
translation.en: And he spake also a parable unto them  ;  No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old  ; if otherwise , then both the new maketh a rent , and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old .
But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Bad da baroh ka spah bakyrhai jong u lyngba U Khrist Jisu , U Blei jong nga un pyndap ïa ka jingdonkam jong phi baroh .

translation.en: And as I was considering , behold , an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth , and touched not the ground : and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes .
translation.kha: Katba nga dang lyngngoh aïu kane ka mut , u  langsohmoh u la wan mareh na shaphang sepngi , u da mareh stet eh ba ki kjat jong u kim shym kynduh khyndew . U la don tang kawei ka reng hapdeng ki khmat jong u .

translation.en: And one of the elders saith unto me , Weep not : behold , the Lion of the tribe of Judah , the Root of David , hath prevailed to open the book , and to loose the seven seals thereof .
translation.kha: Te uwei na ki nongsharai balang u la ong ha nga ,  Wat ïam . Ha khmih ! U Sing na ka jait Judah , uba hiarpateng na u Dabid , u la ïoh ïa ka jingjop , bad u lah ban pynpait ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndait bad ban plied ïa ka kot kli .
Nangta u la shim ïa ka khuri , u la ainguh ïa U Blei , bad u la ai ïa ka ha ki . To dih ïa ka , phi baroh , u la ong ;
translation.en: And he took the cup , and gave thanks , and gave it to them , saying ,  Drink ye all of it  ;

translation.kha: To long suba sngewnguh ïa kawei pa kawei ka snem ba phi im . Kham pher haduh katno phi im , kynmaw ba phin ïap kham slem . Kam don kano kano ruh ïa ka ban khmih lyndet .
translation.en: But if a man live many years , and rejoice in them all  ; yet let him remember the days of darkness  ; for they shall be many . All that cometh is vanity .

translation.kha: Haba ka plied ïa ka , ka ïohi ïa u khunlung . Uta u khunlung u ïam , badno ka sngewsynei ïa u . uno te u daiñ aiwai na ki khun Hebru , ka la ong .
translation.en: And when she had opened it , she saw the child : and , behold , the babe wept . And she had compassion on him , and said , This is one of the Hebrews  children .
For we which have believed do enter into rest , as he said , As I have sworn in my wrath , if they shall enter into my rest : although the works were finished from the foundation of the world .
translation.kha: Ngi kiba ngeit , te , ngi ïohpdiang ïa kata ka jingjahthait ïa kaba U Blei u la kular . Ka la long kumba u la ong ,  Nga la bitar bad pynlong ka jingkular kyntang : ‘ Kin ym ïohrung da lei lei sha ka ri ha kaba ngan ai ha ki ka jingjahthait !’   U la kren ïa kane wat haba la pyndep ïa ka kam jong u naduh ka por ba u la thaw ïa ka pyrthei .

translation.en: And say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day when I chose Israel , and lifted up mine hand unto the seed of the house of Jacob , and made myself known unto them in the land of Egypt , when I lifted up mine hand unto them , saying , I am the  Lord  your God  ;
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba nga ong . Mynba nga la jied ïa ka Israel , nga la pynlong ka jingkular ha ki . Nga la pynpaw ïa lade ha ki ha Ijipt bad ong ïa ki : Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
ibha u syiem u ïohsngew ba la peiñ ïa ka Lehkmen , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsheptieng ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the king had heard the words of the book of the law , that he rent his clothes .
Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets , and laid them on beds and couches , that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them .
translation.kha: Kaba mih na kaei ba ki apostol ki la leh , ka long ba ïa ki briew kiba pang la rah sha ki lynti bah bad la buh ha ki jingthiah bad ki shylliah khang ba la kumno kumno ka syrngiew jong u Petros kan dei ha ki katto katne ngut na ki katba u dang ïaid najan .
A katno nga long u briew u bym don jingsuk! Uei u ban pyllait noh ïa nga na kane ka met kaba ïalam ïa ar sha ka jingïap ?
translation.en: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death ?
And Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came against the city , and his servants did besiege it .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingkerkut u Nebukhadnessar da lade hi u la wan sha Jerusalem ,
bad ar tyllep ki kynjri kiba da ka ksiar nangta ibha la pynjyrthiaw kum ki tyllai bad pyndait ïa ki ha kita ki shrong .
translation.en: And two chains of pure gold at the ends  ; of wreathen work shalt thou make them , and fasten the wreathen chains to the ouches .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Irijah um shym leit sha ïing ; pynbun u la Thiah ha ka khyrdop ïingsyiem lem bad ki nongap phira jong u syiem .
translation.en: But Uriah slept at the door of the king s house with all the servants of his lord , and went not down to his house .

translation.kha: Hobab u ïohsngew ba na lynñiar , u la mareh shab ïingjaiñ , da kaba iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup hajan jong nga .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried , that he left his garment with me , and fled , and got him out .

translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei ruh ïa u Urbanos , uba ïatrei lem bad ngi ha ka nang U Khrist , bad ïa u Stakhos , u paralok ba-ieit jong nga .
translation.en: Salute Urbane , our helper in Christ , and Stachys my beloved .

translation.kha: Rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Kumba nga la hukum ïa phi , smam ïa u kpu bakhlem thiah hynñiew sngi lynter ha u bnai Abib , nalor dei ha uta u bnai ba pa’ la mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: The feast of unleavened bread shalt thou keep . Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread , as I commanded thee , in the time of the month Abib : for in the month Abib thou camest out from Egypt .

translation.kha: Hadien kato katne para uwei u briew u la ïohi ïa u Petros pynlang u la ong , Me ruh , me long uwei na ki ! Hynrei u Petros u la jubab , Ko rangbah , ngam dei !
translation.en: And after a little while another saw him , and said , Thou art also of them . And Peter said , Man , I am not .
For this cause we also , since the day we heard it , do not cease to pray for you , and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding ;
translation.kha: Na kane ka daw , ngi ju duwai borabor na ka bynta jong phi , naduh ba ngi la ïohsngew shaphang jong phi . Ngi kyrpad ïa U Blei ban pyndap ïa phi da ka jingtip ïa ka mon jong u , da ka jingstad baroh bad ka jingshemphang ba U Mynsiem jong u , u ai .

Kaba ka pukni ka pynneh sngur ïa ka um jong ka , kumta hajuh ka Jerusalem ka pynneh ïa ka jingsniew jongngi ka . Nga ïohsngew ïa ka jingleh jubor bad ka Jingpynjot hapoh ka nongbah , ka jingpang bad ki jingmong ki longïng baroh kiba nga ïohi .
translation.en: As a fountain casteth out her waters , so she casteth out her wickedness : violence and spoil is heard in her  ; before me continually is grief and wounds .

translation.kha: Ki ngab nongjop jong ka Jerusalem kin tur ïaleh ïa ka Edom bad kin synshar halor jong ka . Bad U Trai da put hi un long u Syiem .
translation.en: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion to judge the mount of Esau  ; and the kingdom shall be the  Lord s .

translation.kha: U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la pynurlong ïa u Nongsynshar , u kpa jong me , u syiem uba khraw bad ai ha u ka burom bad ka jinglong syiem .
translation.en: O thou king , the most high God gave Nebuchadnezzar thy father a kingdom , and majesty , and glory , and honour :
This parable spake Jesus unto them : but they understood not what things they were which he spake unto them .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi , hynrei kim shemphang ïa kaei kaba u la mut .

Phim tip seh ïa ka jaka , ko kaba bhabriew Tam napdeng ki kynthei ? Khie leit bad bud ïa ka kynhun lanot ; to wad ïa ki pyntha phlang na ka bynta ki blang jongngi phi hajan ki ïingjaiñ jong ki nongbat nongaplangbrot .
translation.en: The voice of my beloved ! behold , he cometh leaping upon the mountains , skipping upon the hills .
And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside , sealed with seven seals .
translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ïa ka kot kli ha ka kti kamon jong uta uba shong halor ka khet ; kaba la dap da ka jingthoh ha baroh arliang bad kaba la pyndait da ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndait .
Baana katne katne ngut ki briew na ka longïing jong ka Khloi ki la ïathuh ïa nga da kaba shai kdar , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , ba don ki jingkñia phangpdeng jong phi .
translation.en: For it hath been declared unto me of you , my brethren , by them which are of the house of Chloe , that there are contentions among you .

translation.kha: Ka la synshar ïa ka Sudan bad ïa ka Ijipt , ym don pud ïa ka bor jong ka ; ka Libya ka la hir ka paralok jong ka .
translation.en: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength , and it was infinite  ; Put and Libya were thy helpers .

translation.kha: don thrang uwei U Blei’ uba hir U Kpa jong u bynriew baroh , uba longkmie U tharai halor baroh , uba trei lyngba kiei kiei baroh , bad u long ha baroh .
translation.en: One God and Father of all , who is above all , and through all , and in you all .

translation.kha: Hynrei Ladan ma me lane ki khun ki ksiew jongu me phi phai Dieng noh na nga , bad phim kohnguh ïa ki aiñ Bad ki sah” ïa Ibbah nga la ai ha phi , hynrei phi leit mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ,
translation.en: But if ye shall at all turn from following me , ye or your children , and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you , but go and serve other gods , and worship them :
He maketh peace in thy borders , and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat .
translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ki pud jong phi ban long skhem bad u pynkdang ïa phi da u kew babha tam .
naba la kheiñduh ïa la ka jingimat na ka bynshet jong nga . Nga dup da ka jingsngewbiang ïa ki — ym tong ma nga , hynrei baïar ki tong jingtylli kumjuh .
translation.en: Who have for my life laid down their own necks : unto whom not only I give thanks , but also all the churches of the Gentiles .
Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect . For they are not all Israel , which are of Israel :
translation.kha: Ngam ong ba ka kular jong U Blei kam shym la treikam ; namar ym baroh ki paid Israel ki long ki briew jong U Blei .
Phi pynkut ba kaei kambah pa’ ni ka hir kaba dei , hynñiew len pynpaw ïa ki jingleh jong phi , bad ki bleithaw jong phi kin ym lah ban ïabeh ei ei ïa phi .
translation.en: I will declare thy righteousness , and thy works  ; for they shall not profit thee .

translation.kha: Ka bynshet ba ki pule ka kynthup ïa jingbuh jingthoh shaphang kumno u Mordekai u la lap ïa ka jingsylla ban pynap ïa u syier — ka jingthala da u Bigthana bad u Teresh , ki ar ngut ki ïuh ka ïingsyiem kiba ap phira ïa ki klass u syiem .
translation.en: And it was found written , that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh , two of the king s chamberlains , the keepers of the door , who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus .
They say unto him , Caesar s . Then saith he unto them ,  Render therefore unto Caesar the things which are Caesar s  ; and unto God the things that are God s .
translation.kha: Ki jong u Patsha ,  ki la jubab . Kumta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Kumta , te , to siew sha u Patsha ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong u Patsha , bad siew sha U Blei ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong U Blei .
U Pilat u la kwah ban pynïapthngan ïa u Paidbah’ , kumta u la pyllait ïa u Barabbas na ka bynta jong ki . Nangta u la phah sympat ïa u Josis bad aiti ïa u ïa-ban shah shaphang .
translation.en: And so Pilate , willing to content the people , released Barabbas unto them , and delivered Jesus , when he had scourged him , to be crucified .

translation.kha: Mar kumta hi , u syiem Joram u mihnoh na Samaria mala u lumlang ïa ki kynthup shipai jongu u baroh .
translation.en: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time , and numbered all Israel .

translation.kha: Don arspah sanphew ngut ki rangbah synshar katba dei peit ïa ki nongtei ba la pynroh ban Trei ïa kiba bunkam tei jingtrei .
translation.en: And these were the chief of king Solomon s officers , even two hundred and fifty , that bare rule over the people .
For if by one man s offence death reigned by one ; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one , Jesus Christ .)
translation.kha: Ka long ka jingshisha ba lyngba ka pop jong uwei u briew , ka jingïap ka la sdang ban synshar , namar jong uta uwei u briew . Hynrei katno kaba kham khraw ka long ka jingmih jong kaei kaba la leh da uwei u briew , U Jisu Khrist ! Baroh kiba ïohpdiang ïa jingaiei bakyrhai U Blei bad ba la pynïasuk bad u kin synshar ha ka jingim lyngba U Khrist .
To shahshkor , te , lada pa Don ki shkor !
translation.en: He that hath ears to hear , let him hear .
Study his Word each day .
translation.kha: Pule ïa ka ktien jong U man la ka sngi .
Te nangta , nga Ong ba ka por ka poi ba ngan leh ei ei ïa ki bleithaw jong ka Babilon , bad bakha mynsaw kin ud ha ka ri baroh kawei .
translation.en: Wherefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will do judgment upon her graven images : and through all her land the wounded shall groan .

translation.kha: Ngam kyrpad ïa phi , ko ki paralok jong nga , kum ki shongsaiñ bad ki nongphetwir ha kane ka pyrthei ! Wat aiti noh ha ki jingkwah barit jong ka doh , kiba long Badonbor ha ka jingïalang thma pyrsad ïa ka mynsiem .
translation.en: Dearly beloved , I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims , abstain from fleshly lusts , which war against the soul  ;

translation.kha: Da kaba lyngngoh bad shaphang , ki la ïapoi kylli uwei ïa uwei pat , Aïu kane ka kit jingmut ?
translation.en: And they were all amazed , and were in doubt , saying one to another , What meaneth this ?

translation.kha: U Tiglath Pileser , u patsha ka Assyria , u uta ïaleh ïa ka Israel , bad u Menahem u ai ïa u laiphew saw ton ka rupa ïa-ban ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan jrong u ban kad pynkhlaiñbor ïa u Menahem halor ka ri .
translation.en: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land : and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver , that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand .
And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast , these shall hate the whore , and shall make her desolate and naked , and shall eat her flesh , and burn her with fire .
translation.kha: Ki shiphew tylli ki reng kiba me la ïohi , bad u mradkhlaw , kin isih ïa ka nuti ; kin sa knieh noh ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba ka don bad kin iehnoh lyngkhuit ïa ka ; kin bam ïa ka doh jong ka bad kin pynjot ïa ka da ka ding .
Lada uno un u pynmynsaw ïa uwei pat u biria , kam u la leh ïa iathuh , kumta ruh yn imat kylliang ïa u .
translation.en: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour  ; as he hath done , so shall it be done to him  ;
Before I was afflicted I went astray : but now have I kept thy word .
translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba men pynshitom ïa nga , nga la ju ïaid sakma ; hynrei mynta nga kohnguh ïa ka ktien jong me .
U la bat ïa nga na ka ban leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , Bad mandriek nga dang im .
translation.en: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit , and his life shall see the light .

translation.kha: U nong ïa la u shakri , Khie leit peitmat Shaphan ka duriaw . U shakri u saw bad u wan phai bad u ong , Ngam ïohi ei ei . Hynñiew sien u Elijah u ong ïa u ban leit bad ban peit .
translation.en: And said to his servant , Go up now , look toward the sea . And he went up , and looked , and said , There is nothing . And he said , Go again seven times .

translation.kha: Kin wallam pat ïa baroh ki por kur ki para jait jong phi na ki jaitbynriew baroh Kum ka jingai sngewbha ïa de . Kin ïalum ïa ki shad u lym bakyntang jong nga ha Jerusalem ha ki kulai , ki khashor bad ha ki ut , bad ha ki katai ïapom malu ki kali kit jingkit , kumba ki Israel ki wanrah ïa ki jingtah bam sha ka Templ ha ki khiew lehniam kiba khuid .
translation.en: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the  Lord  out of all nations upon horses , and in chariots , and in litters , and upon mules , and upon swift beasts , to my holy mountain Jerusalem , saith the  Lord  , as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: buhai hangta ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang ha kaba don ki Shiphew Hukum , bad kah ïa ka da ka pyrda .
translation.en: And thou shalt put therein the ark of the testimony , and cover the ark with the veil .
Then said Jonathan unto David , Whatsoever thy soul desireth , I will even do it for thee .
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ong ,  Ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba phi kwah .

translation.en: Then he said , I pray thee therefore , father , that thou wouldest send him to my father s house :
translation.kha: Uta u riewspah u la ong , ‘ Kumta nga kyrpad ïa me , ko kpa Abraham , to phah ïa u Lasaros sha ka ïing u kpa jong nga , ha kaba nga don san ngut ki hynmen ki para shynrang .
Namar ba nga la leh kumno , u Messaïah u la kular ïa nga ba ki kynhun ki ktem jong nga pynlang ma la , ngin ïohpdiang da kaba thikna kum ka jingïakhaïi jong im’ ïa kata ka ri kaba nga la ïunukh .
translation.en: And Moses sware on that day , saying , Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance , and thy children s for ever , because thou hast wholly followed the  Lord  my God .

translation.kha: Nga ruh ngan thab ïa la ki kti , bad ka jingbishar jongu ang kan jah noh . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: I will also smite mine hands together , and I will cause my fury to rest : I the  Lord  have said it .

And it came to pass , when we came to the inn , that we opened our sacks , and , behold , every man s money was in the mouth of his sack , our money in full weight : and we have brought it again in our hand .
translation.kha: Haba ngi la poi ha ka jaka ban sahmiet , ngi plied ïa la ki byrni , bad uwei pa uwei na ngi u lap ïa la ki pisa ha la ka jong ka jong ka byrni — ki pisa ki biang thik . Ngi la wanrah biang ïa ki sha phi .
Uta u Pisidia u sdang ban ïaid sha khmat sha u Dabid lem bad u nongrim artatien uba ïasaid ha shuwa jong u .
translation.en: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David  ; and the man that bare the shield went before him .

translation.kha: Hynrei u kpa u la khat ïa la ki shakri . ‘ To pynkhlur !’ u la ong . ‘ To wanlam ïa ka jaiñkup kaba bha tam bad pynkup ïa u . Pyndeng sati ha ka shynriah ti jong u pynlang pynphong ujuh ha ki kjat jong u .
translation.en: But the father said to his servants , Bring forth the best robe , and put it on him  ; and put a ring on his hand , and shoes on his feet :

translation.kha: Ïa ka sanphew sher kob kur na ka lynter jong kata ka jingtep ha baroh arliang dei ban wah ha ki krung jong ka Ïingjaiñ ba kuna thop ïa ka .
translation.en: And a cubit on the one side , and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent , it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side , to cover it .

translation.kha: U Mosah u khot nur ïa ki Israel baroh , bad u ong ha ki , Phi la ïohi da lade hi aïu U Trai u la leh ïa u Pharoah ha Ijipt , ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei .
translation.en: And Moses called unto all Israel , and said unto them , Ye have seen all that the  Lord  did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh , and unto all his servants , and unto all his land  ;

Then David arose from the earth , and washed , and anointed himself , and changed his apparel , and came into the house of the  Lord  , and worshipped : then he came to his own house  ; and when he required , they set bread before him , and he did eat .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u khie joit na madan , u sum u sleh , u sad ïa la u shñiuh , bad u pli ïa la ki jaiñ . Nangta u la leit bad mane ha ka ïing U  Trai . Haba u la wan phai sha ka ïingsyiem ; u pan jingbam , bad u la bam ïa ka mar ïadep sam .

translation.en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked , and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous .
translation.kha: To ai ba baroh kiba pyrshah ïa nga bad kiba ïaleh ïa nga yn pynshitom kum ïa ki briew bymman bad ki briew bymhok .
Mynno napdeng ki blei jong kito ki ri baroh , kiba lah ban ïapyllait ïa la ka ri na ngi ? Te kaei kaba pyntong ïa phi ngab pyrkhat ba U Blei jong phi un pynim ïa phi ?
translation.en: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed , that could deliver his people out of mine hand , that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand ?

translation.kha: Haba ki la ïohsngew ïa kane ka jingsawa , u paidbah babun u la ïalum . Ki la ïasngewtynnat , namar ba uwei pa uwei na ki u la ïasngew ba ki riewngeit ki kren ha ka ktien jong u hi .
translation.en: Now when this was noised abroad , the multitude came together , and were confounded , because that every man heard them speak in his own language .
For the  Lord  will plead their cause , and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ïasaid ïa ka kam jong ki na ka bynta jong ki , bad un byrngem ïa ka jingim jong uno uno uba byrngem ïa ki .
Ki Nongïalam Israel barhem ki shaniah ha la ka jingkhlaiñ bad ki pynïap bynriew .
translation.en: Behold , the princes of Israel , every one were in thee to their power to shed blood .

translation.kha: Um da donkam ïa ka jingwad bniah ban weng noh ïa ki nongaikam bad ban bapli ïa ki da kiwei pat .
translation.en: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number , and set others in their stead .
After them the Tekoites repaired another piece , over against the great tower that lieth out , even unto the wall of Ophel .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Tekoa ki tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , ka bynta kaba ar jong ki , naduh ka bynta kaba marpyrshah ïa ka jaka ap phira ka Templ kaba heh haduh ka kynroh hajan ka Ophel .

Katba u tang ïaid , u la ïohi ïa u nonglum khana , u Lebi u khun jong u Alphaïos , ba u shong ha ka jaka treikam jong u . U Jisu u la ong ha u , buhnud ïa nga . U Lebi u la ïeng joit bad u la bud ïa u .
translation.en: And as he passed by , he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom , and said unto him ,  Follow me .  And he arose and followed him .

Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment : and it was early  ; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall , lest they should be defiled  ; but that they might eat the passover .
translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab la ïalam ïa U Jisu na ka ïing u Kaïaphas sha ka ïing jong u lyngskor . Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw kim shym la rung shapoh ka ïing , naba ki kwah ban sumar khuid ïa lade kat kum ka jinglehniam , khnang ba ki lah ban bam ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait .
U Trai u ong ïa ka Edom , Ngan pynurlong ïa pha kaba tlot kun ; barben kin ibeiñ ïa pha .
translation.en: Behold , I have made thee small among the heathen : thou art greatly despised .

translation.kha: Sngewbha shem hynriew hajar thylliej ki lyngkhot rupa , u Naaman u Jubab . U la ïai ban ïa kata , u la teh ïa ka rupa ha ki ar tylli ki phlait , u la ai ïa ki bad ïa ki ar riam ki jaiñ ba-itynnat ha ki ar ngut ki shakri jong u , mala u la phah ïa ki ha shuwa jong u Gehasi .
translation.en: And Naaman said , Be content , take two talents . And he urged him , and bound two talents of silver in two bags , with two changes of garments , and laid them upon two of his servants  ; and they bare them before him .

translation.kha: Hynrei haba u Ahab u Syiem Israel u la ïap , u Mesha u ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: But it came to pass , when Ahab was dead , that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka Dibon ki kiew ïa u lum baneh ïalum ha ka jaka mane blei . Ki briew jong ka Mephaath ki la ïam ha ka jingsngewieit ïa ki nongbah jong ka Nebo malu Medeba ; ki la khi ïa la ki khlieh pynlang ïa u ñiuhtmoh ha ka jingsngewsih .
translation.en: He is gone up to Bajith , and to Dibon , the high places , to weep : Moab shall howl over Nebo , and over Medeba : on all their heads shall be baldness , and every beard cut off .

translation.kha: U Jingsuk u la nguh , Uno uno uba la dat sum u long uba la khuid bha bad um donkam ban da sait ïa lade , lait noh ïa la ki kjap . Baroh na phi , phi long bakha khup — baroh mlien noh uwei .
translation.en: Jesus saith to him ,  He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet , but is clean every whit : and ye are clean , but not all .
Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt , even unto this day , and in Israel , and among other men  ; and hast made thee a name , as at this day  ;
translation.kha: Naduh mynbarim , me la leh ïa ki kambah bad ki jingphylla ha Ijipt , bad me ïai leh ïa ki haduh kane ka sngi , ha Israel bad hapdeng kiwei ki hima baroh , ba kumta ïa me mynta la tip kylleng sawdong .

Phim kynmaw kumno u Abimelekh , u khun Jong u Gideon u la shah pynïap ? Ka dei ha Thebes ba ka kynthei ka la pynhap shapoh ïa u mawtylliat na ka kynroh bad la pynïap ïa u . balui , keiñ , phi leit tur sha jaiñ eh jong ka kynroh ?’ Lydda u syiem u kylli ïa kñia na phi , ïathuh ïa u , ‘ U Uriah ruh , u rangbah pynïar jyllang phi u la shah pynjop .’
translation.en: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth ? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall , that he died in Thebez ? why went ye nigh the wall ? then say thou , Thy servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also .

translation.kha: Ki khun kynthei jong phi ken hap shna ki jingiwbih ïa u , bad trei kum ki nongtih jinglwet bad ki nongshet kpu jong u .
translation.en: And he will take your daughters to be confectionaries , and to be cooks , and to be bakers .
Also he took away out of all the cities of Judah the high places and the images : and the kingdom was quiet before him .
translation.kha: Namar ba u pynduh noh ïa ki jaka mane blei thala bad ki duwan jingiwbih na baroh ki nongbah jong ka Judah , ka hima ka don ha ka jingsuk hapoh ka jingsynshar jong u .

translation.en: But we have dwelt in tents , and have obeyed , and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us .
translation.kha: Ngim ju tei ki ïing ki sem ban shong ban sah — ngi shong ha ki ïingjaiñ — bad ngim don ki bri sohwaiñ la ki jong , ki lyngkha , lane u kew . Ngi la kohnguh tylli ïa baroh kiei kiei kiba u kpa tymmen jong ngi u Jonadab u la hukum ïa ngi .
Ki synran ki la ïaleit sha u bad kyrsiew ïa u . Pyllait im ïa im , A Trai ! ki la ong . Ngam sa ïap !
translation.en: And his disciples came to him , and awoke him , saying , Lord , save us : we perish .
And Hushai said unto Absalom , The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time .
translation.kha: U Hushai u jubab ,  Ka jingai jingmut kaba u Ahithophel u la ai ha phi ha kane ka por kam long kaba bha .

translation.en: When that year was ended , they came unto him the second year , and said unto him , We will not hide it from my lord , how that our money is spent  ; my lord also hath our herds of cattle  ; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord , but our bodies , and our lands :
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba bud , ki ïawan sha u , bad ki ïa-ong ,  Kynrad , ngin ym buhrieh ïa ka jingshisha na phi ba ki pisa jong ngi baroh ki la lut , bad ba ki jingri jingdup jong ngi ki la dei ki jong phi . Ngim don ei ei shuh ban ai ïa phi lait noh sa tang ki met jong ngi bad ki lyngkha jong ngi .
burom ïa U Trai bad trei bha , namar U Trai U Blei jong ngi um lah shah ïa ka jingleh bymdei jlan ka jingleh jingïailong khamtam lane ka jingshim pisa thok .
translation.en: Wherefore now let the fear of the  Lord  be upon you  ; take heed and do it : for there is no iniquity with the  Lord  our God , nor respect of persons , nor taking of gifts .

translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u Dabid u khot lang ïa ki shipai kiba kynjai tam ha Israel , kiba longïing baroh laiphew hajar jrut ,
translation.en: Again , David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel , thirty thousand .

translation.kha: Ka por ka poi haba ki lumbah ki twa bad ki mawlong baskhem ki kynriang noh .
translation.en: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought , and the rock is removed out of his place .

translation.kha: wat isynei ïa ka ; ot nala ïa ka ktieh jongu ka .
translation.en: Then thou shalt cut off her hand , thine eye shall not pity her .

translation.kha: Khmut ki shakor ki la ïalaw sha ki lynti bthah bad ki la ïalumlang ïa ki briew baroh kiba ki lah ban ïashad , kiba bha nabar kiba sniew kumjuh , bad ïa ka kamra khawai shongkurim la pyndap da ki briew .
translation.en: So those servants went out into the highways , and gathered together all as many as they found , both bad and good : and the wedding was furnished with guests .
For it was said to me by the word of the  Lord  , Thou shalt eat no bread nor drink water there , nor turn again to go by the way that thou camest .
translation.kha: Bad ngan ym bam ne dih ei ei bad phi hangne , namar U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban ym bam ne dih ei ei , bad ban ym leit phai sha ïing na kajuh ka lynti .
Ha ka jingpynïap kaba nyngkong , u Jonathan bad u samla ki la pynap kam arphew ngut ki briew ha ka jaka kaba theh bania shipawa hektar .
translation.en: And that first slaughter , which Jonathan and his armourbearer made , was about twenty men , within as it were an half acre of land , which a yoke of oxen might plow .

translation.kha: U Lasaros u la mihnoh , ïa ki Ki bad ki kjat jong u la kyllaiñ da ki jaiñsop ïa kiba ïap , bad da ka jaiñ la teh ïa ka khamtam jongno u . To law noh na u , U Jisu u la noh ha ki , bad ai ba un ïathied .
translation.en: And he that was dead came forth , bound hand and foot with graveclothes : and his face was bound about with a napkin . Jesus saith unto them ,  Loose him , and let him go .

translation.kha: Ki plie jongngi kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew baroh ki long tang ki bleithaw ; hynrei U Trai u la thaw ïa ki weng .
translation.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols : but the  Lord  made the heavens .

translation.kha: Phim thup wiat ïa kaei ka ban ia ïa ka jingim jong phi ha ka lashai ! Phi long khem ka tdem , kaba paw tang shipor bad nangta ka jah noh .
translation.en: Whereas ye know not what shall be on the morrow . For what is your life ? It is even a vapour , that appeareth for a little time , and then vanisheth away .

translation.kha: U la ong ha uwei pat u briew , Bud ïa nga . Hynrei uta u Briew u la ong , Ko Kynrad , nyngkong to shah ïa nga ban leit phai pat malu ban tep ïa u kjap jong nga .
translation.en: And he said unto another ,  Follow me .  But he said , Lord , suffer me first to go and bury my father .
I the  Lord  have said , I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation , that are gathered together against me : in this wilderness they shall be consumed , and there they shall die .
translation.kha: Nga smai ba ngan leh ïa kane ha phi u paidlang bymman uba la ïalumlang ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Hangne ha ka ri khlaw uwei pa uwei na phi un ïap . Nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .’
Hynrei U Blei ha ka jingaiei jong u , u la lngaid ïa nga wat shuwa ban kah ïa nga , sad u la khot ïa nga ban shakri ïa u .
translation.en: But when it pleased God , who separated me from my mother s womb , and called me by his grace ,
And he led them out as far as to Bethany , and he lifted up his hands , and blessed them .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ïalam ïa ki shabar ka nongbah haduh ha Bethania , ha kaba u la rah ïa la ki kti bad u la kyrkhu ïa ki .
Kumba ki khun Jerusalem ki ïa lymne ban ïaroh ïa U ikwah “ba ki jingiaseng ,” ngi ruh ngi kmen ban ïa Mano lang ïa u ha kumto film ki jingïar bakyrpang .
translation.en: Just as the Israelites rejoiced at praising Jehovah “in assemblies ,” we too enjoy worshipping him together at special events .

translation.kha: U Abner u ong ha u Dabid , Ngan longing noh mynta , bad len pynwan ïa ki Israel baroh sha phi ko Syiem Bakhraw . Kin pdiang ïa phi kumin u syiem , bad nangta phin ïoh ïa kaei kabu phoi la khih bad phin synshar halor ka ri baroh kadei . U Dabid u ai ka jingkular jingshngain ïa u Abner bad u phah noh ïa u .
translation.en: And Abner said unto David , I will arise and go , and will gather all Israel unto my lord the king , that they may make a league with thee , and that thou mayest reign over all that thine heart desireth . And David sent Abner away  ; and he went in peace .

Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men , that went out to war by bands , according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler , under the hand of Hananiah , one of the king s captains .
translation.kha: U don ruh ka kynhun shipai kaba heh kaba la kloi na ka bynta ka thma . Ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh jong ka la sumar da u Jeiel u bad u Maaseïah , ki sekretari jong u hapoh ka jingpeit u Hananaïah , u dkhot jong ki nongtrei jong u syiem .
Lada phi kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga , phin ïakynduh ha ka jingbeit jong nga , kumba per la jongu ïa ki hukum U Ka jrong nga bad nga ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong u .
translation.en: If ye keep my commandments , ye shall abide in my love  ; even as I have kept my Father s commandments , and abide in his love .

translation.kha: Ki mraw , to khongdong ïa la ki kynrad da ka jingïohpateng bad ka jingkhynñiuh ; bad leh ïa ka da ka dohnud basngur , kitab phi shakri ïa U Khrist .
translation.en: Servants , be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh , with fear and trembling , in singleness of your heart , as unto Christ ;

translation.kha: Ynda u Saul u la dep kata ka jingïashad shongshit nabar ka jingrisa , u leit kiew shaw ka duwan kaba ha uta u lum .
translation.en: And when he had made an end of prophesying , he came to the high place .
Then cried Jesus in the temple as he taught , saying ,  Ye both know me , and ye know whence I am : and I am not come of myself , but he that sent me is true , whom ye know not .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang hikai ha ka Templ , u la kren ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Hato phi ithuh da shisha ïa nga bad tip nangno nga wan ? Ngam shym la wan da ka bor jong nga hi . Uta uba la phah ïa nga , pynban , u long uba shisha .
Ka kynthup ïa ka hima jong u Og , uba khatduh jong ki Rephaim , uba la synshar ha Ashtaroth bad Adriel . U Moses u la jop ïa kine ki briew bad u la beh ino ïa ki .
translation.en: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan , which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei , who remained of the remnant of the giants : for these did Moses smite , and cast them out .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang kiew phalor ka lieng , Utai u brai uba shongksuid u la kyrpad ïa u , Shah ïa nga ban leit bad me !
translation.en: And when he was come into the ship , he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him .

translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ngi malu ki brisoh baroh kiba shong ha ka ri jong ngi ki ong ïa ngi ban khrong katto katei ka jingbam na ka bna ka jinglwet bad ban sien ïanguh ïa phi . La ong ba ngi dei ban thuh ïa lade ban shakri ïa phi bad ba-bang kyrpad ïa phi ngab ïathiah lok bad ngi .
translation.en: Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us , saying , Take victuals with you for the journey , and go to meet them , and say unto them , We are your servants : therefore now make ye a league with us .

translation.kha: U la bam .
translation.en: He had eaten .

translation.kha: U mareh shai u , u ïeng halor jong u , u sei ïa ka waitlam u Goliath na ka jingsop jong ka , bad u ot ïa ka khlieh jong u Bad u pynïap ïa u . Haba ki Philistia ki ïew ba u rangkynsai lad ki u la shah pynïap , ki phet krad .
translation.en: Therefore David ran , and stood upon the Philistine , and took his sword , and drew it out of the sheath thereof , and slew him , and cut off his head therewith . And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead , they fled .

Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him , Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high , and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon : then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet . And the thing pleased Haman  ; and he caused the gallows to be made .
translation.kha: Kumta ka tnga jong u bad ki paralok jong u baroh ki ai jingmut ,  Balei ba phim shna da ka diengphasi kaba arphew ar mitar ka jingjrong ? La shai mynstep phi lah ban ong ïa u syiem ban sdien ïa u Mordekai halor jong ka , bad nangta sa leit sha ka jingkhawai da kaba kmen .  U Haman u la pyrkhat ba kane ka long kaba dei , kumta u la phah thaw ïa ka diengphasi .

translation.en: And let us not be weary in well doing : for in due season we shall reap , if we faint not .
translation.kha: Kumta to ai ba ngin ym man thait ha kaba lehbha ; namar lada ngim duh bor noh , ka por kan poi ha kaba ngin lum ïa ka jingot .
Hynrei kynmaw , ïada ki ïashongkurim bad ki shyieng kiba na kawei pat ka jait , ka bri ka khyndew jong ki kan long noh ka jong kata ka jait , bad ka bynta kaba daym ka jong ngi kan nang duna .
translation.en: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel , then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers , and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received : so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance .

translation.kha: U Jehoash u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki shym ha Samaria , bad u khuid jong u , u Jeroboam Uba Ar u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: And Joash slept with his fathers  ; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne : and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel .
Then brought he me the way of the north gate before the house : and I looked , and , behold , the glory of the  Lord  filled the house of the  Lord  : and I fell upon my face .
translation.kha: Te uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga lyngba ka khyrdop bashaphang shatei haduh ha khmat ka Templ . Katba nga dang khmih , nga la ïohi ba ïa ka Templ U  Trai  la pyndap da ka jingshai ba-thaba jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong u .
Ha kawei pat ka jingïohipaw nga la ïohi saw tylli ki reng masi dab .
translation.en: Then lifted I up mine eyes , and saw , and behold four horns .
Then said Joab , I may not tarry thus with thee . And he took three darts in his hand , and thrust them through the heart of Absalom , while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak .
translation.kha: Ngan ym pynsyrwa ei ïa ka por bad me ,  u Joab u ong . U rah lai tylli ki sum , bad u pynngam ïa ki ha ka shadem jong u Absalom katba u dang im , haba u dang sdien ha u dieng Sning .
ka sngi katba dap da ka jingsawa ki turoi thma bad ka jingmap-ei jongnga ki shipai kiba tur ïaleit ïa ki nongbet ba la ka-por kynroh bad ïa ki kut bajrong .
translation.en: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities , and against the high towers .

translation.kha: Phim pat ju ïohsngew ïa ka sur Jong u lane tv pat ju ïohi ïa ka khmat jongno u , bad phim ju sumar ïa ka khubor lad u ha ki dohnud jongki phi , naba tv ngeit ha uto ïa uba u la phah .
translation.en: And ye have not his word abiding in you : for whom he hath sent , him ye believe not .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , U Blei ruh u la ai shuh ïa la ki sakhi ha ki , da kaba leh bun ki kham bad ki kamphylla bad da kaba ïasam ïa ki jngai U Mynsiem Bakhuid kat khim ka mon jong u .
translation.en: God also bearing them witness , both with signs and wonders , and with divers miracles , and gifts of the Holy Ghost , according to his own will ?
If he will contend with him , he cannot answer him one of a thousand .
translation.kha: Da kumno uno uno u lah ban ïasaid bad u ? U lah ban kylli shihajar tylli ki jingkylli , ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban jubab .
Ki brisoh ka —Judah baroh ki jat ïa u Ussiel , u khup jongu u Amasaïah , uba dang khathynñiew snem ka rta , ban long syiem ha ka jaka u kpa jong u .
translation.en: Then all the people of Judah took Uzziah , who was sixteen years old , and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang don ha ka miej ba-bang ïabam , U Jisu u la ong , Ngin ong ïa phi , ba uwei na phi un shetkylla ïa nga — uta uba dang ïabam bad nga .
translation.en: And as they sat and did eat , Jesus said ,  Verily I say unto you , One of you which eateth with me shall betray me .

translation.kha: Kita ki khohruh kin ïaphai markhmat , na jingsliang shuh shiliang ka jingap bad ki thapniang ba-pyiar jong ki , ki kah ïa kata ka jingtap .
translation.en: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high , covering the mercy seat with their wings , and their faces shall look one to another  ; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be .

translation.kha: Ki jingsheptieng jong phi kiba Mynshuwa ïa ki nonglum khajna nongwan badno ki nongsyntiat kin shuh long sa tieng ka jingkynmaw .
translation.en: Thine heart shall meditate terror . Where is the scribe ? where is the receiver ? where is he that counted the towers ?
And they knew not that Joseph understood them  ; for he spake unto them by an interpreter .
translation.kha: Kim shym tip ba u Joseph u sngewthuh aïu ki ong , namar ki ïakren bad u da ka jingïarap u nongbatai ktien .

Katba ka kad ka wan sha ka lyngkha jong u briew umbiah kyrteng u Joshua , uba shong ha Bthah Shemesh , bad ka sangeh hajan u mawbah . Kita ki briew ki smam lyngkhot ïa kata ka kali dieng , ki pynïap ïa kita ki masi kynïan bad ki kñia ïa ki kum ka jingainguh thang ha U Trai .
translation.en: And the cart came into the field of Joshua , a Beth–shemite , and stood there , where there was a great stone : and they clave the wood of the cart , and offered the kine a burnt offering unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Yn sa beh noh ïa u na ka ri jong kiba im , yn sa beh noh na ka jingshai shwa ka jingdum .
translation.en: He shall be driven from light into darkness , and chased out of the world .

translation.kha: ki la leit phai noh na ka jingtep , bad ki la ïathiah ïa kine kiew kiei baroh ha ki khatwei ngut ki synran bad ha baroh kiwei pat .
translation.en: And returned from the sepulchre , and told all these things unto the eleven , and to all the rest .
Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness  ; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday .
translation.kha: ne ïa ki khlam kiba shoh ha kaba dum , ne ïa ki jingsniew kiba pynïap haba shai ka sngi .
Kaba khyndiat kaba phi don shuwa ba ngan wan ka la roi kyrhai , bad U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa Phi kat ibha to otsher . Mynba ka la dei ka por ïa nga ban peit sa na bynta ïa lade .
translation.en: For it was little which thou hadst before I came , and it is now increased unto a multitude  ; and the  Lord  hath blessed thee since my coming : and now when shall I provide for mine own house also ?

translation.kha: U Asalaïah u khong kawei ka na ar kmie , ka Jehosheba , kaba shongkurim ïa u lyngdoh uba kyrteng u Jehoïada . Ka la pyllait im jar jar ïa u Joash , aiwai na ki khun shynriah jong u Ahasaïah , ka la shngiam ïa u na kiwei pat ki khun syiem uba la dei ban shuh pynïap bad ka la buhrieh ïa u bad ka nongring khun ha ka kamra thiaw ha ka Templ . Da kaba ibhabriew ïa u , ka la phlait im ïa u na ka jingshad pynïap ha ki kti jong ka Asaraïah .
translation.en: But Jehoshabeath , the daughter of the king , took Joash the son of Ahaziah , and stole him from among the king s sons that were slain , and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber . So Jehoshabeath , the daughter of king Jehoram , the wife of Jehoiada the priest , ( for she was the sister of Ahaziah , ) hid him from Athaliah , so that she slew him not .

translation.kha: Hynrei ai ba ki riewstad mynbarim keiñ hikai ïa me , to sngap ïa kiei kaba ki don ban ong .
translation.en: Shall not they teach thee , and tell thee , and utter words out of their heart ?
And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness .
translation.kha: Shisyndon U Mynsiem u la pynlong ïa u ban leit sha ka ri shyiap ,

translation.en: And Joash slept with his fathers  ; and Jeroboam sat upon his throne : and Joash was buried in Samaria with the kings of Israel .
translation.kha: U Jehoash u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha Samaria , bad u khun jong u , u Jeroboam Uba Ar u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
Ka jingim jong nga ka ïasaid kum ka lynti kambah thwet tam , kum ka jingshat u pukni uba suh kynsit shab ban kynrup ïa ka rabbit .
translation.en: They are passed away as the swift ships : as the eagle that hasteth to the prey .
And he put the table in the tent of the congregation , upon the side of the tabernacle northward , without the veil .
translation.kha: U buh ïa ka miej hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , ha ka liang kaba shaphang shatei , shabar kata ka pyrda ,

translation.en: Abraham had faith his wife would live again , yet we read that “Abraham came in to bewail Sarah and to weep over her .”
translation.kha: Wat la phi don jingkyrmen ha ka jingmih pat “U Abraham u ngeit ba ka tnga jongu kan im biang , wat la katta ngi pule “ba u Abraham u sngew sih bad iam namar jongka .”
Ha ka jingbuaid ka kiei jong ka , ka la pan na u , To ai ïa nga mynta hangne ïa ka khlieh jong u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ha ka pliang !
translation.en: And she , being before instructed of her mother , said , Give me here John Baptist s head in a charger .

translation.kha: Baroh ki jingjia ha ka jingsynshar u Asaph naduh kaba nyngkong haduh kob kut la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel .
translation.en: And , behold , the acts of Asa , first and last , lo , they are written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .

translation.kha: Hangta u sangeh suba hynriew u la theh noh ïa ka pliang lad u ha ka wahbah Ïuphratis . Ka wah ka la rngad , ban pynbiang ka lynti ïa ki syiem kiba wiang na mihngi .
translation.en: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates  ; and the water thereof was dried up , that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared .

translation.kha: ( Ki nongbanbor jong ka Athalaïah , kata ka kynthei bymshemphang , ki la pynjot ïa ka Tubal bad ki la pyndonkam ïa kiba pung ki thir ki tar bakyntang ha ka jingmane ïa u Baal . )
translation.en: For the sons of Athaliah , that wicked woman , had broken up the house of God  ; and also all the dedicated things of the house of the  Lord  did they bestow upon Baalim .

translation.kha: U syiem u hukum ïa ki Lebi ban shna ka synduk na ka bynta ki jingnoh synñiang dara ban buh ïa ka ha ka khrud ka Templ .
translation.en: And at the king s commandment they made a chest , and set it without at the gate of the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kine ki shym baroh ki la ïashoh plain kawei bad ki la wan lang ban sher dara harud ka Wahduid Meron ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: And when all these kings were met together , they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom , to fight against Israel .

translation.kha: Naba un shim ar tylli ki blang sha ka jingshong jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai .
translation.en: And he shall take the two goats , and present them before the  Lord  at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: To panpoh na U Jehobah ban ïaroh ïa phi ban leh ïa kaba dei .
translation.en: Ask Jehovah to help you do what is good .

translation.kha: un-long ba la Tim ïa u briew uba tei ïa la ka ïing da ka jingbymhok , bad uba pynheh pynïar ïa ka da ka jingleit bymjukut ; uba pynlong ïa la ki para shnong ban trei khlem kam , malade u bym siew bainong ïa ki .
translation.en: Woe unto him that buildeth his house by unrighteousness , and his chambers by wrong  ; that useth his neighbour s service without wages , and giveth him not for his work  ;
And the sons of Javan  ; Elishah , and Tarshish , Kittim , and Dodanim .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Jaban ki long ki briew jong ka Elishah , ka Spain , ka Sypros , bad ka Rhodes ; ki la long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba shong ha ki rud duriaw bad ha ki dewlynnong .
Hynrei ka jingisynei U Blei ka shlei katta katta , bad ka jingieit jong u ïa ngi ka long naba khraw katta katta ,
translation.en: But God , who is rich in mercy , for his great love wherewith he loved us ,
With my whole heart have I sought thee : O let me not wander from thy commandments .
translation.kha: Da ka dohnud jong nga baroh nga pyrshang ban shakri ïa me ; to sumar ïa nga na ka jingbymkohnguh ïa ki hukum jong me .

Hynrei ngan lumlang ïa phi , phi baroh ki paid Israel kiba dang sah . Ngan wallam lang ïa phi kum ki langbrot sha ka kynhun . Kum ka jaka bam phlang ba-dap da ki langbrot , ka ri jongki phi kan dap biang sa shisien da ki pynbah babun .
translation.en: I will surely assemble , O Jacob , all of thee  ; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel  ; I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah , as the flock in the midst of their fold : they shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men .

translation.kha: U Elijah u ïaid baroh sia sngi ha ka ri khlaw . U la sangeh bad shong ha ka jingkah syrwiang u tieng bad u Kwah tang ban ïap noh . Ka la long palat , ko Trai , u la duwai . Shim ne ïa ka jingim jong nga ; ka bha ïa nga Ban ïap napoh .
translation.en: But he himself went a day s journey into the wilderness , and came and sat down under a juniper tree : and he requested for himself that he might die  ; and said , It is enough  ; now , O  Lord  , take away my life  ; for I am not better than my fathers .
And Abraham said unto him , Beware thou that thou bring not my son thither again .
translation.kha: U Abraham u jubab ,  To da khmih bha ba men ym phah noh ïa u khun jong nga shata !
