Nga la pynlong ïa pha ban san kumta u jingong baplung . Pha la nang khlaiñ nabar jrong bad phan la long ka kynthih samla . Ka shadem jong pha ka la wandur itynnat , malade u shñiuh jong pha u la sai , hynrei pha long kaba lyngkhuit .
translation.en: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field , and thou hast increased and waxen great , and thou art come to excellent ornaments : thy breasts are fashioned , and thine hair is grown , whereas thou wast naked and bare .
Son of man , write thee the name of the day , even of this same day : the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to thoh ïa ka tarik mynta ka sngi , namar kane ka long ka sngi kaba u syiem ka Babilonia u sdang ïa ka jingkerkut ïa ka Jerusalem .

translation.en: For if the dead rise not , then is not Christ raised :
translation.kha: Naba lada ïa kiba ïap yn ym pynmihpat , te ïa U Khrist ruh ym shym la pynmihpat .

translation.en: Wherefore also we pray always for you , that our God would count you worthy of this calling , and fulfil all the good pleasure of his goodness , and the work of faith with power :
translation.kha: Dei kata keiñ balei ba ngi ïai duwai borabor na ka bynta jong phi . Ngi kyrpad ïa U Blei jong ngi ban pynlong ïa phi kiba bit ïa ka jingim kaba u la khot ïa phi ban im . Ai ba un pyndap da ka bor jong u ïa ka jingkwah jong phi baroh na ka bynta ka jingbha bad ban pyndep ïa ka jingtrei ka jingngeit jong phi .

balieh yn ym ong te , To ngin leh ïa kaba snieh khnang ba kaba bol kun mih ? Kat katne ngut ki biria , shuwa , ki pynjahburom ïa nga da kaba pharep ïa nga da kaba nong ïa kano Kaei kaei hi ! Kin sha pynkmen , dom ki dei ban shah .
translation.en: And not rather , (as we be slanderously reported , and as some affirm that we say) Let us do evil , that good may come ? whose damnation is just .

translation.kha: Lada ka long kumta , phi don ka lawei kaba phyrnai .
translation.en: For surely there is an end  ; and thine expectation shall not be cut off .

When I shall bring again their captivity , the captivity of Sodom and her daughters , and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters , then will I bring again the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ïa ka Jerusalem ,  Ngan pynlong ïa ki ban manbha pat — ïa ka Sodom bad ki nongrit jong ka bad ka Samaria bad ki nongrit jong ka . Ho-oid ngan pynmanbha ïa pha ruh .

Ka jingïasoh jong de bad U Trai Jisu ka pynlong thngan ïa nga ba ym kein ka jingbam ha ka hi , kaba long bymkut kato kum ka jinglehniam ; hynne lada u bynriew u ngeit ba katto katne ka jingbam ka long ka bymkhuid , te ka long bymkhuid ïa u .
translation.en: I know , and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus , that there is nothing unclean of itself : but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean , to him it is unclean .

translation.kha: kam shym long kaba kynja mynsiem kaba la wanpaw shuwa , hynriewphew kaba kynja doh , malade nangta ka kynja mynsiem .
translation.en: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual , but that which is natural ; and afterward that which is spiritual .

translation.kha: Wat la ni katto katne ngut kiba kwah ban pyndep ïa ka . Da kaba leh mynleh kum ki parabangeit , kine ki rangbah ki la ïohrung shapoh ka kynhun jong ngi kum ki nongsyntiat , khnang ban lap shaphang ka jingjied kaba ngi la mad da ka jingpynïasoh jngai ine ha U Khrismas Jisu .
translation.en: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in , who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus , that they might bring us into bondage :

translation.kha: Ki Jiw ki la kumin ïa une u briew bad sa ba kin pynïap ïa u . Nga la ïoh jingtip ba u longsyiem u traishnong ka Hima Rom , kumta nga la leit bad ki Shipai jong per bad nga la pyllait im ïa u .
translation.en: This man was taken of the Jews , and should have been killed of them : then came I with an army , and rescued him , having understood that he was a Roman .

translation.kha: Ho-oid u jubab . Nga la wan banbeiñ ai ka jingkñia ainguh ha U Trai . Pynkhuid ïa lade , bad wan bad nga . U ainong ruh ïa u Jesse bad ki khun shynrang jong u ban pynsuhthied ïa lade , bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki sha kata ka jingkñia .
translation.en: And he said , Peaceably : I am come to sacrifice unto the  Lord  : sanctify yourselves , and come with me to the sacrifice . And he sanctified Jesse and his sons , and called them to the sacrifice .

translation.kha: Nangta ki shong ha madan bad u haduh hynñiew sneng hynriewphew miet khlem kren syngkien hati , namar ki la ïohi haduh katno u shah jynjar .
translation.en: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights , and none spake a word unto him : for they saw that his grief was very great .

Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , the God of Israel , saying , Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem , and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest , and to all the priests , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ai ha nga ka khubor na ka bynta u Shemaïah jong ka Nehelam , uba la phah ka shithi ha ka kyrteng jong u hi sha baroh ki briew jong ka Jerusalem bad sha u Sephanaïah , u lyngdoh u khun jong u Maaseïah bad sha baroh kiwei pat ki lyngdoh . Ha kane ka shithi , u Shemaïah u la thoh sha u Sephanaïah :

translation.en: To give subtilty to the simple , to the young man knowledge and discretion .
translation.kha: Ki lah ban pynlong ïa u briew uba shida ban long sian bad hikai ïa ki samla kumno ban dap ban biang ka jingim .
Ha kajuh ka por , sam ap ha ka jaka jam ïa ka wah ha ka ri khlaw tad haduh ba ngan da oh khubor na phi .
translation.en: See , I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness , until there come word from you to certify me .
And he said ,  Woe unto you also , ye lawyers ! for ye lade men with burdens grievous to be borne , and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  A katno kaba shyrkhei ruh ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum ! Phi buh ki jingkit halor ki met jong ki briew , kiba eh ïa ka ban kit , hynrei phi hi phim kner wat kawei ka shympriah kti ban ïarap ïa ki ban kit ïa kita ki jingkit .
Haba u long syiemsad , ki paid Judah kin shongshngain bad ki paid Israel Kin im ha ka jingsuk . Yn khot ïa u , ‘ U Trai ka jingpynim jong ngi .’
translation.en: In his days Judah shall be saved , and Israel shall dwell safely : and this is his name whereby he shall be called , THE  Lord  OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS .
When I said , My foot slippeth  ; thy mercy , O  Lord  , held me up .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ,  Nga la kyllon noh  ; hynrei ka jingieit baneh jong me , A  Trai  , ka batskhem ïa nga .
Naba naduh ba ngi la long Kawei pynlang u ha ka jingïap kum ma u , ha kajuh ka rukom ngin ïalong kawei sad u ha ka jingmihpat kum ma u .
translation.en: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death , we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection :

translation.kha: Nangta la khie ka tdam naba shyrkhei , bad u Abner bad ki Israel ki la shispah ha ki rangbah jong u Dabid .
translation.en: And there was a very sore battle that day  ; and Abner was beaten , and the men of Israel , before the servants of David .

translation.kha: Ka jingbitar u syiem ka long kum ka jingkyrhuh u Sing , hynrei ka jingsngewbha jong u ka long kum u slap ba pdiang hun .
translation.en: The king s wrath is as the roaring of a lion  ; but his favour is as dew upon the grass .

Cursed be the man that maketh any graven or molten image , an abomination unto the  Lord  , the work of the hands of the craftsman , and putteth it in a secret place . And all the people shall answer and say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba thaw durblei da u maw , da u dieng , lane da u nar bad uba mane ïa ka ha kaba rieh ; U  Trai  u isih ïa ka jingmane bleithaw .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
Ngi don ka jingieit baskhem ha ka Bible ; ka long ka bor U balui ban pynim ïa baroh ibha ieit , nyngkong ïa ki Jiw bad ïa ki Jentil ruh .
translation.en: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ : for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth ; to the Jew first , and also to the Greek .

translation.kha: Ki khatwei ngut ki synran ki la leit sha u lehbor ha Galilaïa ha kaba U Jisu u la ong ïa ki shun otsher .
translation.en: Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee , into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them .

translation.kha: Nangno nga la ïohi lai tylli ki mynsiem bymkhuid kiba i kum ki jakoid . Ki la ïamih na ka shynraiñ jong u Ïakjakor , na ka shyntur jong u ïalaw , bad na ka shyntur jong u nongïathuhlypa balamler .
translation.en: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon , and out of the mouth of the beast , and out of the mouth of the false prophet .

translation.kha: Ngam Lah shun kriah bad pa’ kham slem , namar u nongsynran jongno kane ka pyrthei un wiang . Um donbor halor jong nga , hynrei , ka pyrthei ka dat ban tip ba nga ieit ïa U Kpu ; na katai ka daw balei ba nga leh ïa ki kiei baroh kumba u hukum ïa nga . Abel’ , ïa ngin ïaleit noh na kane ka jaka .
translation.en: But that the world may know that I love the Father  ; and as the Father gave me commandment , even so I do . Arise , let us go hence .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingbit jong me , me ong ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban leh ; me la bsa ïa ki da ka manna bad ai um ïa ki ban dih .
translation.en: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them , and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth , and gavest them water for their thirst .

translation.kha: Ki la wan sha U Jisu bad ki la khappud jur ïa u , Une u briew u dei thok shiah ban ïoh ïa ka jingïarap jngai me .
translation.en: And when they came to Jesus , they besought him instantly , saying , That he was worthy for whom he should do this :
And it came to pass , when Rachel had born Joseph , that Jacob said unto Laban , Send me away , that I may go unto mine own place , and to my country .
translation.kha: Hadien ka jingkha ïa u Joseph , u Jakob u ong ha u Laban ,  Pyllait noh ïa nga , ba ngan ïoh leit phai noh sha la ïing .
Kam shym la pynshahshkor ïa U TRAI’ lane pdiang ïa ka jingsneng pynbeit jrong u . Kam shym la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha U TRAI’ lane kyrthep ïa ka jingïarap jong u .
translation.en: She obeyed not the voice  ; she received not correction  ; she trusted not in the  Lord   ; she drew not near to her God .

translation.kha: Ngam ïaroh ïa ka bol jong me , A Tharai U Nongsynshar ; tun pynbna ïa ka jingbit jong me , tang ka jong me hi .
translation.en: I will go in the strength of the Lord  God  : I will make mention of thy righteousness , even of thine only .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u la jubab , Me tip ba nga longïng uba duna ha ka ktien ka thylliej ; kumne keiñ u Pharaoh un shahshkor ïa nga ?
translation.en: And Moses said before the  Lord  , Behold , I am of uncircumcised lips , and how shall Pharaoh hearken unto me ?

translation.kha: U Elisha u la ïathuh ha u syiem ba ha kaba kum “kata ka por ha ka sngi kaba bud lai kyllum u kew uba bhah tam lane hynriew kilo u barli yn die ha Samaria ha ka tat-dor shi sbai rupa ,
translation.en: And it came to pass as the man of God had spoken to the king , saying , Two measures of barley for a shekel , and a measure of fine flour for a shekel , shall be to morrow about this time in the gate of Samaria :
When the centurion heard that , he went and told the chief captain , saying , Take heed what thou doest : for this man is a Roman .
translation.kha: Haba uta u rangbah pynïaidkam u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la leit sha u rangbah ai hukum bad u la kylli ïa u ,  Me leh aïu ? Utai u briew u dei u traishnong ka Hima Rom ?
wat leit ban pan jingmut na ki brisoh kiba wad jingtip na ki mynsiem jong ki briew kiba la ïapom . Lada phi leh kumne , yn ñiah ïa Phi ki bymkhuid . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: Regard not them that have familiar spirits , neither seek after wizards , to be defiled by them : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Baroh ki bynriew kiba shong maji ha Lydda bad Sharon ki la ïohi ïa u , bad ki la phai sha U Trai .
translation.en: And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him , and turned to the Lord .
And Moses and Aaron were brought again unto Pharaoh : and he said unto them , Go , serve the  Lord  your God : but who are they that shall go ?
translation.kha: Kumta la wan ïalam biang ïa u Moses bad u Aaron sha u Pharaoh , bad u ong ha ki ,  Phi lah ban leit bad mane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi . Hynrei pynthikna mano ban leit ?
U Abimelekh u ong , Ngam skhem tip mano ba la leh ïa kane . Mem shym la ïathuh ei ei shaphang kane ha nga , bad kane ka lama ka sien kaweh nyngkong ba nga la ïohsngew ïa ka .
translation.en: And Abimelech said , I wot not who hath done this thing : neither didst thou tell me , neither yet heard I of it , but to day .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Akhaikos u shaniah ïa u Dabid , u da ong ha lade , U la hir naba la isih haduh katta katta da ki briew jong u hi ki Israel ba kumjuh un hap long u shakri ïa per baroh shi rta .
translation.en: And Achish believed David , saying , He hath made his people Israel utterly to abhor him  ; therefore he shall be my servant for ever .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka kamra rung , la don saw tylli ki miej , ar tylli ha kawei kawei ka liang jong ka Kamra . Don khlur kine ki miej ba la pynpyut ïa ki mrad ba dei ban ai kum ki jinganna , lane ba thang tylli , lane ban long ki jingkñia sait pop ne kum ki jingriew siew kylliang .
translation.en: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side , and two tables on that side , to slay thereon the burnt offering and the sin offering and the trespass offering .

translation.kha: Shuh ki sopti , ki panpoh , bad ki tupia na ka bynta ki khuid shynrang jong u Aaron ba kin jingseisoh shongkhia bad itynnat .
translation.en: And for Aaron s sons thou shalt make coats , and thou shalt make for them girdles , and bonnets shalt thou make for them , for glory and for beauty .

translation.kha: U pham ïa ki erïong ban lynshop bad pynmong jur ïa nga khlup deng satia ;
translation.en: For he breaketh me with a tempest , and multiplieth my wounds without cause .

translation.kha: Uwei pa imat u ïeng ha la ka bakwah basawdong ka jaka sher dara , bad ka kynhun shipai jong ki nongshun baroh ki phet ïap da kaba lynñiar .
translation.en: And they stood every man in his place round about the camp : and all the host ran , and cried , and fled .

translation.kha: U ruh u ong , Nga mynjur ïa kata , tnga tang uta uba shim ïa ka khuri un long u saraw jong nga ; kiwei pat ki lah ban sien noh .
translation.en: And he said , Now also let it be according unto your words : he with whom it is found shall be my servant  ; and ye shall be blameless .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , Khie leit bad ïathuh ïa uta u pyrshang : ‘ Nga tbeh noh ïa ki ksuid bad nga pynkhiah mynta bad la shai , bad ha ka sngi kaba lai ngan pyndep ïa ka jingtrei jong nga .’
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Go ye , and tell that fox , Behold , I cast out devils , and I do cures to day and to morrow , and the third day I shall be perfected .

And the Spirit of the  Lord  came upon him , and he went down to Ashkelon , and slew thirty men of them , and took their spoil , and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle . And his anger was kindled , and he went up to his father s house .
translation.kha: Hangta hi ka bor jong U  Trai  ka pynshaitbor ïa u , bad u leit hiar sha Ashkelon , ha kaba u pynïap laiphew ngut ki rangbah , u law ïa ki jaiñ jong ki , bad u ai ïa ki jaiñkup baremdor ha kita ki shynrang kiba batai ïa kata ka jingkyntip . Hadien kata , u leit phai noh sha la ïing , da kaba bitar halor kaei kaba la jia ,

translation.en: Therefore said he , Take it up to thee . And he put out his hand , and took it .
translation.kha: Shim ïa u ,  u hukum bad uta u briew u dem bad u la shim ïa u .
Phi ki bseiñ — kumta phi lah Ban ong ïa kiei kiei kiba bha haba phiah long kiba sniew ? Namarkata ka shyntur ka kren ïa kaei kaba la sleh ha ka dohnud .
translation.en: O generation of vipers , how can ye , being evil , speak good things ? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh .

translation.kha: Ulla u briew un wallam uwei u langbrot ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ Ka kyndong lynti jong nga kum ka jingkñia namar ka jingpalat jyllang u ,
translation.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the  Lord  , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , even a ram for a trespass offering .
Speak unto Aaron , and unto his sons , and unto all the children of Israel , and say unto them  ; This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded , saying ,
translation.kha: ban ai ha u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ha baroh ki paid Israel ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .

translation.en: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulders , and carry it forth in the twilight : thou shalt cover thy face , that thou see not the ground : for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel .
translation.kha: Shah ïa ki ban khmih ba me tawah ïa la ka song halor ka tyrpeng jong me bad mih shabar sha kaba dum da kaba tap ïa ki khmat jong me , khnang ba men ym ïohi shano me leit . Kaei kaba me leh kan long ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel .

U Jakob u ong ha ki , Lada kumta te , to kitei rah ïa ki jingmong kaba kynoi tam jong kane ka ri ha ki byrni jong phi kumno ka jingaiei sngewbha ïa uta u lat : kyndiang ka jingibeiñ , khyndiat ka ïap , ki musli musla , ka mrad , ki jait sai-thew , bad ki madan .
translation.en: And their father Israel said unto them , If it must be so now , do this  ; take of the best fruits in the land in your vessels , and carry down the man a present , a little balm , and a little honey , spices , and myrrh , nuts , and almonds :
Thy words were found , and I did eat them  ; and thy word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of mine heart : for I am called by thy name , O  Lord  God of hosts .
translation.kha: Me la kren ïa nga , bad nga la shahshkor ïa kawei pa kawei ka kyntien . Nga long u jong me , A  Trai  U Blei Badonbor Baroh , bad kumta ki ktien jong me ki la pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong nga da kaba kmen bad ka jingsngewkmen .

Nga da kwah ba baroh na phi phyrnai kren ha ki thylliej bapher ; hynrei nga da kwah ba phna ïoh ïa ka jingai ban pynthaba ïa ka nongrah-khubor U Blei . Naba u briew uba pynbna ïa ka kherub U Blei u kham kor ban ïa uta Uba kren ha ki thylliej bapher — lymda don uno Une uba batai ïa kaei kaba u kren , khnang ba kan longkmie ka jingpyiar ïa ka balang baroh kawei .
translation.en: I would that ye all spake with tongues , but rather that ye prophesied : for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues , except he interpret , that the church may receive edifying .

translation.kha: U Jisu Khrist u long ujuh mynjur , myntri bad shiah ki bymjukut .
translation.en: Jesus Christ the same yesterday , and to day , and for ever .

translation.kha: Nga ong shisha ha phi : Ka jingpynjahburom na ka bna kyang ki jingpynïap baroh kan ïahap halor ki brisoh jongno kane ka juk !
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , All these things shall come upon this generation .

translation.kha: Un shim ïa ki shakri jong phi , bad ïa kiba kynsai tam na ki jingri bad ki kada jong phi , dara un pyntrei ïa ki ha ka kam jongno u .
translation.en: And he will take your menservants , and your maidservants , and your goodliest young men , and your asses , and put them to his work .

translation.kha: Haba u briew bymman u sangeh noh na kaba imat pop! bad u leh ïa kaei kaba daiñ nabar kaba Bha , u la pynsum ïa la ka jingim .
translation.en: But if the wicked turn from his wickedness , and do that which is lawful and right , he shall live thereby .

translation.kha: Wat ïa ki rumal bad ki jaiñ-da naba u la pynmong la leit lam sha kito kiba pang , bad ïa ki jingpang jong ki la beh noh , bad ki mynsiem bymman ki ju mihnoh na ki .
translation.en: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons , and the diseases departed from them , and the evil spirits went out of them .

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa kane ka jingshisha barieh : Ngi baher ngin ym ïap , hynrei hajan ka tur bakhatduh kan sawa , ïa ngi barhem yn pynkylla trud ha kaba shikhyllipmat . Naba haba ka turoi kan sima , ïa bakha ïap yn pynmihpat , ba kin ym ïap shuh da lei lei , bad ïa ngi baher yn pynkylla dur .
translation.en: In a moment , in the twinkling of an eye , at the last trump : for the trumpet shall sound , and the dead shall be raised incorruptible , and we shall be changed .
And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed , and sang praises unto God : and the prisoners heard them .
translation.kha: Kumba shiteng synñia , u Paul bad u Silas ki dang duwai bad rwai ki jingrwai ïaroh ïa U Blei bad kiwei pat ki koidi ki dang shahshkor ïa ki .
Phin ne batbor ïa ki bri kiba duk pynlang phi , bad ha kano kan ka por ba phi kwah , phi lah ban ïarap ïa ki . Hynrei phin ym ïoh bhor ïa nga .
translation.en: For ye have the poor with you always , and whensoever ye will ye may do them good : but me ye have not always .

Seek him that maketh the seven stars and Orion , and turneth the shadow of death into the morning , and maketh the day dark with night : that calleth for the waters of the sea , and poureth them out upon the face of the earth : The  Lord  is his name :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la thaw ïa ki khlur , ki Pleïades    bad Orion    , u pynkylla ïa ka jingdum sha ka jingshai mynsngi , bad ïa ka sngi sha ka miet . U khot na ka bynta ki um jong ka duriaw bad theh ïa ki ha sla khyndew . Ka kyrteng jong u ka dei U  Trai .
nur sa ïakynduh ïa me hangta , bad rnong jong ka jingot kaba hapdeng kita ki khohruh ar tylli , ngan ai ha me ïa ki hukum jong nga baroh na ka bynta ki Israel .
translation.en: And there I will meet with thee , and I will commune with thee from above the mercy seat , from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony , of all things which I will give thee in commandment unto the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Ïa ki jingmeng ka Samaria yn ym lah pynkhiah , bad ka Jehud kan shahshitom ha kajuh ka rukom ; ka jingpynjot ka la poi haduh ki khyrdop ka Jerusalem hi , ha kabu ki briew jong nga ki shong .
translation.en: For her wound is incurable  ; for it is come unto Judah  ; he is come unto the gate of my people , even to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Haba ki la wan hangne , te , im shym la pynkyllut ei ei , hynrei ha ka sngi kaba bud nga la shong ha ka ïabishar mala nga la hukum ban wallam shabi ïa uta u briew .
translation.en: Therefore , when they were come hither , without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat , and commanded the man to be brought forth .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kumno ba la tei pat ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah . U Eliashib u Rangbah lynghoh malu ki para lyngdoh lad u ki la tei pat ïa ka Khyrdop Langbrot , ki pynkyntang ïa ka , bad pynngat ïa ki khyrdop . Ki la pynkyntang ïa ka kynroh haduh u Mot ki Shispah bad u Mot Hananel .
translation.en: Then Eliashib the high priest rose up with his brethren the priests , and they builded the sheep gate  ; they sanctified it , and set up the doors of it  ; even unto the tower of Meah they sanctified it , unto the tower of Hananeel .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kadei kaba u ong ha ka Kitab U Hosia : Ki briew ki bym shym la long ki jongngi de ngan khot ‘Ki Briew jong la .’ Ka jaitbynriew kaba ngam shym la ieit len khot ‘Kaba ieit jong la .’
translation.en: As he saith also in Osee , I will call them my people , which were not my people ; and her beloved , which was not beloved .

translation.kha: Ngi la kyrmen ïa ka jingsuk bad ka por ka jingpynkhiah , hynrei kam shym la myntoi ei ei ; ka jingtur ka wan pynban .
translation.en: We looked for peace , but no good came  ; and for a time of health , and behold trouble !

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki paid Israel ki long bymhok kum ki nong Kanaan ; ki sngewthait ban shukor ïa ki nongthied da ki tarajur bymhok .
translation.en: He is a merchant , the balances of deceit are in his hand : he loveth to oppress .

translation.kha: Lada kum kita kiei kiei ki jia , haw phira lytar rah ïa ki ban pynbeit da ki briew ki bym don nongrim ha ka balang ?
translation.en: If then ye have judgments of things pertaining to this life , set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church .

translation.kha: Nga la don bad phi ha ka Templ Man ka sngur , bad phim shym la pyrshang ban kem ïa na . jynreiñ khnai ka dat ka kynta jong phi ban leh , ïahap ka bor jong ka jingdum ka synriah .
translation.en: When I was daily with you in the temple , ye stretched forth no hands against me : but this is your hour , and the power of darkness .

And he said , Open the window eastward . And he opened it . Then Elisha said , Shoot . And he shot . And he said , The arrow of the  Lord s  deliverance , and the arrow of deliverance from Syria : for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek , till thou have consumed them .
translation.kha: Nangta , da kaba kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah u nongïathuhlypa , u syiem u plie ïa ka jingkhang kaba phai khmat sha Syria .  Siat ïa u khnam !  u Elisha u hukum . Hamar ba u syiem u siat ïa u khnam , u nongïathuhlypa u pyrta ,  Me long u khnam jong U  Trai  , da u , un sa ïoh ka jingjop halor ka Syria . Men ïaleh ïa ki Syria ha Aphek haduh ba men da jop thiaw ïa ki .
Ki briew babha sarong ki la ïathuh lamler shaphang jong nga , hynrei da la ka dohnud baroh nga kohnguh ïa ki jingbthah jong me .
translation.en: The proud have forged a lie against me : but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit , bad hajan nga la shem ïa ka khak ha kaba nga la buhrieh ïa ki , nga la ïohi ba ki la sniew dara kim long shuh ban pyndonkam .
translation.en: Then I went to Euphrates , and digged , and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it : and , behold , the girdle was marred , it was profitable for nothing .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u ong ha nga , ‘ Khie lytar hiar khleiñ na un u lum , namar kita ki biria jong me ïa kiba me la ïalam na Ijipt , ki la mut sniew bad ki la leh bymman . Ki lah da kynriah noh na kata ka lynti ïa kaba nga la hukum ïa ki , bad ki la thaw pynap ïa ka durblei na ka bynta ïa lade .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Arise , get thee down quickly from hence  ; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves  ; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them  ; they have made them a molten image .

translation.kha: Ki proberb jong me kim ba-don jingmyntoi shuh kum ki dpei ; ki jingïasaid jong me ki long kiba tlot kum ka dewbyrtha .
translation.en: Your remembrances are like unto ashes , your bodies to bodies of clay .
Then said the  Lord  unto me , Thou hast well seen : for I will hasten my word to perform it .
translation.kha: Me ong kaba dei  U  Trai  u la ong ,  bad nga dang khmih ban ïohi ba ki kyntien jong nga ki wan urlong shisha .
Hadien ka la kha khun kynthei , ïa kaba ka la khot kyrteng ïa ka , ka ïaineh .
translation.en: And afterwards she bare a daughter , and called her name Dinah .

translation.kha: U la sdang ban tim ïa U blang , ïa ka kyrteng jong u , ïa ka jaka shongsah jongki u , bad ïa re baroh kiba shong ha bneng .
translation.en: And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God , to blaspheme his name , and his tabernacle , and them that dwell in heaven .
And they drew Alexander out of the multitude , the Jews putting him forward . And Alexander beckoned with the hand , and would have made his defence unto the people .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki paidbah ki la pynskhem ba u Aleksandar u kitkhlieh , namar ba ki Jiw ki la pynlong ïa u ban leit sha khmat . Te u Aleksandar u la ai dak da la ka kti ba ki paidbah kin sngap jar , bad u la pyrshang ban kren ïasaid da .

translation.en: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the  Lord  , and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the  Lord  , to repair and amend the house :
translation.kha: Nangta ïa kane ka pisa la pynkhamti ha ki lai ngut ki rangbah kiba peit halor ka jingtei pynbha ïa ka Templ ,
Ngan pynpluh ïa ki kynroh jong ka Damaskos da ka ding bad yn thang khoit ïa ki ïingsyiem jong u syiem Benhadad . Ma at , U Trai Benabinadab Baroh , nga la klun .
translation.en: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus , and it shall consume the palaces of Ben–hadad .

translation.kha: U Iso u ainong , Kane ka dei ka shen ka ar ba u la shet shukor ïa nga . Kam long kiba phylla ba ka kyrteng jong u ka dei u Jakob . U la shim noh ïa ki hok ka jinglong khwan nyngkong jong nga , bad mynba pat u la shim sa ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong nga . Hato tv shym la tyngkai ka jingkyrkhu ïa nga ?
translation.en: And he said , Is not he rightly named Jacob ? for he hath supplanted me these two times : he took away my birthright  ; and , behold , now he hath taken away my blessing . And he said , Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me ?

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la kynjoh ka rta kaba la thymmei bha haba u la don shahjop laiphew snem , u la ïap .
translation.en: But Jehoiada waxed old , and was full of days when he died  ; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died .
There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife  ; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife  ; and there I buried Leah .
translation.kha: Dei hangta ba ki la tep ïa u Abraham bad ïa ka Sarah ka tnga jong u ; hangta ruh ki la tep ïa u Isaak bad ïa ka Rebekka ka tnga jong u ; bad dei hangta ba nga la tep ïa ka Leah .

Ha ka sngi kaba U Trai u ai jingjop ïa ki Israel halor ki Amor , u Joshua u kren ha U Trai . Ha khmat ki Israel u ong , Ko Sngi , to ïeng tiak khashor ka Gibeon , Ko Bnai , to sangeh ha ka dem Aijalon .
translation.en: Then spake Joshua to the  Lord  in the day when the  Lord  delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel , and he said in the sight of Israel , Sun , stand thou still upon Gibeon  ; and thou , Moon , in the valley of Aijalon .
For they are impudent children and stiffhearted . I do send thee unto them  ; and thou shalt say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ki long kiba mutlop bad kim burom ïa nga , kumta nga phah ïa me sha ki bad men ong ha ki , ïa kaei kaba ma nga U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ïa ki .
Naba uno uno baïar uba pan un ïohpdiang , bad uno uno uba wad un shym , bad ka jingkhah kan plie ïa uta kaba tied .
translation.en: For every one that asketh receiveth  ; and he that seeketh findeth  ; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened .

translation.kha: Ka long kaba Kham babha ban shahshkor ïa ki ktien kiba pan jar jong uno uno uba stad ba ïa ki jingtyrwa jong u nongsynshar ha ka barabor lad ki ba-bieit .
translation.en: The words of wise men are heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools .
There went up a smoke out of his nostrils , and fire out of his mouth devoured : coals were kindled by it .
translation.kha: Ka tdem ka mih na ki thliew khmut jong u , bad ka ding ba bam duh bad ki rnga kiba rhem na ka shyntur jong u .
ka por ban phylliew jingieit bad ka por ban ym pynlieh jingtied , ka por ban ïadoh badno ka por ban ym ïadoh .
translation.en: A time to cast away stones , and a time to gather stones together  ; a time to embrace , and a time to refrain from embracing  ;
I know that , whatsoever God doeth , it shall be for ever : nothing can be put to it , nor any thing taken from it : and God doeth it , that men should fear before him .
translation.kha: Nga tip ba kaei kaei kaba U Blei u leh kan neh junom . Phim lah ban bynrap ei ei ha ka lane shim noh ïa kano kano na ka . Bad kawei kaba U Blei u leh ka long ban pynlong ïa ngi ban ïeng ha ka jingburom ïa u .
Katba ka jingialeh ka dang bteng hapdeng ki kynjoh jong u Dabid bad ki kynhun kiba ïaisah ïa ka longïing jong u sarew , u Abner u la nang kham khrawbor napdeng ki nongbud jong u Saul .
translation.en: And it came to pass , while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David , that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul .
My soul is weary of my life  ; I will leave my complaint upon myself  ; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul .
translation.kha: Nga la sngewthait ban im . To sngap ïa ki jingud kthang jong nga .

translation.en: All these evil things come from within , and defile the man .
translation.kha: baroh kine kiei kiei ki wan napoh u briew bad pynlong bymkhuid ïa u .
Ka la leh ïa kaei kaba ka la haw banbeiñ ai ; ka la theh ïa ka jingsleh iwbih hajir ka met jong nga ban pynrieh lytar shuwa ka por jong ka jingtip ïa ka met jongu to .
translation.en: She hath done what she could : she is come aforehand to anoint my body to the burying .

translation.kha: Kumno ma Phin pat ? U la kylli ïa ki . Phi ong nga long uei ?
translation.en: He saith unto them ,  But whom say ye that I am ?

translation.kha: Ki lumlang ki khynñiat ha khmat U Trai lad u Lum Sinai , Ha khmied U Trai , U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: The mountains melted from before the  Lord  , even that Sinai from before the  Lord  God of Israel .

O  Lord  , the hope of Israel , all that forsake thee shall be ashamed , and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth , because they have forsaken the  Lord  , the fountain of living waters .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , me long ka jingkyrmen jong ka Israel ; baroh kiba la lyndet ïa me yn buh ha ka jinglehrain . Kin jah noh kum ki kyrteng ba la thoh ha ka khyndew , namar ki la lyndet ïa me , U  Trai  , uba long ka umpohliew ki um basngur .

translation.en: And God said to Jonah , Doest thou well to be angry for the gourd ? And he said , I do well to be angry , even unto death .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u la ong ha u ,  Me don hok aïu ban bitar ïa u jingthung ?  U Jonah u la jubab ,  Nga don ka hok baroh ban bitar — ban bitar eh ban ïap !

translation.en: Much more then , being now justified by his blood , we shall be saved from wrath through him .
translation.kha: Da ka jingïap ba aiti lut jong u , mynta la pynlong ka jingïadei hapdeng jong ngi bad U Blei ; katno tam te , ngin long kiba lait im da u na ka jingbitar U Blei!

translation.en: Return to thine own house , and shew how great things God hath done unto thee .  And he went his way , and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him .
translation.kha: Khie leit noh sha ïing bad ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh na ka bynta jong me .  Uta u briew u la leit lyngba ïa ka shnong , u da ïathuh ïa kaei kaba U Jisu u la leh na ka bynta jong u .

translation.en: And he answered , I have not troubled Israel  ; but thou , and thy father s house , in that ye have forsaken the commandments of the  Lord  , and thou hast followed Baalim .
translation.kha: Ngam dei u nongthaw jingkulmar ,  u Elijah u la jubab .  Dei ma phi — ma phi bad u kpa jong phi . Phim shym la kohnguh ïa ki hukum U  Trai  bad phi mane ïa ki bleithaw u Baal .

translation.en: Will you please explain to me the exact meaning of the word ?
translation.kha: Sngewbha batai ianga ka jingmut ba iahap tam jong ka kyntien .
bad ki ai ïa ka ha ki Mysia ding bad ki nongtei ban thied mraw bad dieng sawdong ban pynsakma ha kaba tei pynbha ïa ki ïohnong kiba ki syiem ka Jehoïada ki la ieh ba kin pyut noh .
translation.en: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it , to buy hewn stone , and timber for couplings , and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed .
The earth mourneth and fadeth away , the world languisheth and fadeth away , the haughty people of the earth do languish .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei ka tyrkhong bad ka stai noh ; ka pyrthei baroh kawei ka kylla tlot ; ka pyrthei bad ka sahit bneng , baroh ar , kin pyut noh .

translation.en: I have declared , and have saved , and I have shewed , when there was no strange god among you : therefore ye are my witnesses , saith the  Lord  , that I am God .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh lypa ïa kaei ka ban sa jia , bad nangta nga wan ban ïarap ïa phi . Ym don u blei nongwei uba ju leh ïa kane ; phi long ki sakhi jong nga .
Nangta u Soitan u mihsnam na khmat U Trai pynlang u pynsaja da ki tohjaw ha baroh shi rynïeng ka met jong u Jehoba .
translation.en: So went Satan forth from the presence of the  Lord  , and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown .

translation.kha: Ka ri jong ki ka dap da ki bleithaw , bad ki mane ïa kita kiba ki la shna da ki ktien jong ki hi .
translation.en: Their land also is full of idols  ; they worship the work of their own hands , that which their own fingers have made :

translation.kha: U Sakhaïos u la hiar pyndait nabar u la pyndeng sngewbha ïa u da ka jingkmen kaba khraw .
translation.en: And he made haste , and came down , and received him joyfully .
And Moses said , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded that ye should do : and the glory of the  Lord  shall appear unto you .
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ,  U  Trai  u la hukum ïa phi ban leh ïa kane baroh , khnang ba ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong u kan paw ha phi .
Kine ki dei ki aiñ ba U Trai u la ai ha u Moses kiba ïadei malade ki jingkular ba la pynlong da ka theisamla kaweh dang sah ha ka ïing u kpa jong ka lane da ka kynthei kaba la shongkurim .
translation.en: These are the statutes , which the  Lord  commanded Moses , between a man and his wife , between the father and his daughter , being yet in her youth in her father s house .

translation.kha: Ka jingpynjot kaba la wan ha ki briew jong nga ka wallam ka jingsngew shyrkhei ; ki kiei kiba ieit ki shet ïa la ki khun ban longïng jingbam .
translation.en: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children : they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people .
Thy servant slew both the lion and the bear : and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them , seeing he hath defied the armies of the living God .
translation.kha: Nga la pynïap ïa ki sing bad ki dngiem , bad ngan leh kumjuh ïa une u Philistia ba mane blei thala , uba ñiewbeiñ ïa ka kynhun ïapom jong U Blei uba im .

translation.en: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow ? doth he open and break the clods of his ground ?
translation.kha: Ym don u nongrep uba lur sah ïa ki lyngkha jong u bad uba pynkhreh ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingbet .
Katba U Jisu u dong ïadat mrad ka duriaw Igdalaïah , u la ïohi ar nud ki nongtong dohkha , u Simon malade u para jong u , u Andriw , ba ki dang ïatong dohkha da ka jar .
translation.en: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee , he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .
In fact , Tom told me never to come back to his house again .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , u Tom u iathuh ia nga ba ngam dei ban wan shuh ha iing jong u .
Katba ki dang Don hangta , ki sngewthuh ïa ka sur kren jong u samla Lehbha , kumjuh ki leit shiah u bad ki kylli , Me leh aïu hangne ? Mano ba wallam ïa me Shano ?
translation.en: When they were by the house of Micah , they knew the voice of the young man the Levite : and they turned in thither , and said unto him , Who brought thee hither ? and what makest thou in this place ? and what hast thou here ?

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por , kun pynlong ka jutang bad baroh ki mradkhlaw bad ki sim , khring ba kin ym pynmynsaw shuh ïa ki briew jong nga . Ngan weng noh ruh ïa baher ki tiar thma na ka ri , baroh ki waitlam nabar ki ryntieh , bad kun ailad ba ki briew jong nga keiñ ïoh im ha ka jingsuk bad jingshngain .
translation.en: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field , and with the fowls of heaven , and with the creeping things of the ground : and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth , and will make them to lie down safely .

translation.kha: Nga phah ia u kumta da jingpeitbha , khnang , ynda phi iohi biang ia u , phin shadkmen , bad ka jingsngewsih jyllang nga kane jah noh .
translation.en: I sent him therefore the more carefully , that , when ye see him again , ye may rejoice , and that I may be the less sorrowful .

Therefore fear thou not , O my servant Jacob , saith the  Lord   ; neither be dismayed , O Israel : for , lo , I will save thee from afar , and thy seed from the land of their captivity  ; and Jacob shall return , and shall be in rest , and be quiet , and none shall make him afraid .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , wat ym sheptieng ; ko ki paid Israel , wat ym sngewshyrkhei . Ngan pyllait im ïa phi na kata ka ri bajngai , na ka ri ha kaba phi long ki koidi . Phin wan phai pat sha ïing bad im ha ka jingsuk ; phin shngain , bad yn ym don mano mano ban pynsheptieng ïa phi .

translation.en: So Joab blew a trumpet , and all the people stood still , and pursued after Israel no more , neither fought they any more .
translation.kha: Nangta u Joab u put ïa ka turoi , kum ka dak ïa ki rangbah jong u ban sangeh noh na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Israel , bad kumta ka jingïaleh ka la sangeh .
ka Taanakh , ka madiah ,
translation.en: The king of Taanach , one  ; the king of Megiddo , one  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei Don ki sem shym shahshkor ïa u Moses , bad ki la tyngkai khyndiat . Ha ka step kaba bud —kata kaba sah ka la boi ksaiñ bad ka sma ieid , bad u Moses u la pisa ïa ki .
translation.en: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses  ; but some of them left of it until the morning , and it bred worms , and stank : and Moses was wroth with them .

translation.kha: U jongu Khrist u long ujuh mynhynnin , mynta bad sha ki bymjukut .
translation.en: Jesus Christ the same yesterday , and to day , and for ever .

translation.kha: U Simon hi ruh u la ngeit ; bad hadien ba la pynbaptis ïa u , u la buiñ ha ktah ha kjat ïa u Philip bad u la sngewpyngngad haba u la ïohi ïa ki kamphylla bad ki kambah ïa kba la leh .
translation.en: Then Simon himself believed also : and when he was baptized , he continued with Philip , and wondered , beholding the miracles and signs which were done .

translation.kha: bad u syiem Jakhin lak bad ka kmie jong u , ki khun shynrang jongno u , ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u , sad ki rangbah synsar ha ka ïingsyiem , ki la pyndem ha ki nong Babilonia . Ha ka snem kaba phra jong ka jingsynshar u Nebukhadnessar u la shim koit ïa u Jehoïakhin
translation.en: And Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon , he , and his mother , and his servants , and his princes , and his officers : and the king of Babylon took him in the eighth year of his reign .
Before their face the people shall be much pained : all faces shall gather blackness .
translation.kha: Katba ki dang wan , uwei pa uwei u sngewshyrkhei ; kawei pa kawei ka durkhmat ka kylla blad .

translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , concerning the houses of this city , and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah , which are thrown down by the mounts , and by the sword  ;
translation.kha: Ma nga , U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , nga ong ba ki ïing ha Jerusalem bad ka ïingsyiem Judah kin sa shah pynkhyllem na ka daw jong ka jingshah kerkut bad ka jingtur ïaleh .

translation.en: ( Romans 6 :19  ; 12 :1  ; 2 Corinthians 7 :1 ) It can be very hard to give up these habits .
translation.kha: ( Rom 6 :19 ; 12 :1 ; 2 Korinth 7 :1 ) Ka lah ban long kaba eh ban iehnoh ïa kine ki jingmlien .
U lapbah synshar ki Kaisaria u ïathuh ha ki ba u Patsha u kwah tip) kiei kaba pynlong ïa u syiem Hesekaïah ba sngewkmen .
translation.en: And Rabshakeh said unto them , Say ye now to Hezekiah , Thus saith the great king , the king of Assyria , What confidence is this wherein thou trustest ?

translation.kha: Ki phet ïap , bad u Sa lem bad ki kynhun Jong u ki beh kthong ïa ki haduh Gerar . Te bun na ki nongri Sodom ki la ïap haduh ba ka kynruh shipai kam shym eh shuh ban lum pat bad ïaleh . Ki la sha pyndem laiñ ha U Terah bad ka kynum shipai jong u , bad ka kynhun shipai ka la ïoh rah lep ka jinglait .
translation.en: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar : and the Ethiopians were overthrown , that they could not recover themselves  ; for they were destroyed before the  Lord  , and before his host  ; and they carried away very much spoil .
And David said to Ittai , Go and pass over . And Ittai the Gittite passed over , and all his men , and all the little ones that were with him .
translation.kha: Ka biang !  u Dabid u la jubab .  Dang ïaid sha khmat !  Kumta u Ittai u la ïaid sha khmat bad la ki rangbah jong u lem bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ki baroh .

translation.en: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem , and the city was besieged .
translation.kha: Ka dei ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u ba ka kynhun shipai Babilonia , ha ka hukum ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u Nebukhadnessar , ki la tur pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem , bad kerkut ïa ka .
Naba ym don ka nongbah kaba ïaineh na ka bynta jong ngi hangne ha pyrthei , ngi ap khmih ïa ka nongbah ka ban sa wan .
translation.en: For here have we no continuing city , but we seek one to come .

translation.kha: Nangta ngan ong ha lade , A u briew badonbok ! Me la don kiei kiei uba bha baroh kiba me donkam na ka bynshet badno Snem . Wat khuslai ïa la ka jingim , to bam , to dih , bad to lehkmen ïa lade !’
translation.en: And I will say to my soul , Soul , thou hast much goods laid up for many years  ; take thine ease , eat , drink , and be merry .
As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard , so is a parable in the mouth of fools .
translation.kha: U bieit uba pyndonkam ïa ka jingong kaba stad u pynkynmaw ïa phi shaphang u nongbuaid uba pyrshang ban phut ïa u shiah ha ka kti jong u .
U Adonijah , ha ka jingsheptieng bhabriew ïa u Solomon , u la leit shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Trai bad u la batbit ïa ki rangsan kiba ha ki dong jong ka duwan .
translation.en: And Adonijah feared because of Solomon , and arose , and went , and caught hold on the horns of the altar .

translation.kha: U lyngngoh ban ïohi ba ym don mano mano ban ïarap ïa kiba shah banbeiñ . Kumta un pyndonkam ïa la ka jong ka har ban pyllait im ïa ki bad wanrah ïa ka jingjop .
translation.en: And he saw that there was no man , and wondered that there was no intercessor : therefore his arm brought salvation unto him  ; and his righteousness , it sustained him .

translation.kha: Namar ba pha la kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong nga ban shahshitom , at ruh ngan ri sumar ïa Phah ha ka por jong ka jingjynjar ka ban wan ha ka pyrthei baneh tyngshaiñ ïa ki briew baroh ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: Because thou hast kept the word of my patience , I also will keep thee from the hour of temptation , which shall come upon all the world , to try them that dwell upon the earth .

translation.kha: Pynban , ki Lebi ngin ym ïor kano kano ka boitha jong ka ri lem sad phi , namar ka bynta jong ki ka hir ban sharak kum ki lyngdoh jongu U Trai . Bad da shisha , ki jait Gadmon , Reuben , Manasseh ba sha Mihngi te ki la la ïohpdiang ïa la ka jaka ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Jordan , ïa kaba u Mushi u shakri jong U Trai u la ai ha ki .
translation.en: But the Levites have no part among you  ; for the priesthood of the  Lord  is their inheritance : and Gad , and Reuben , and half the tribe of Manasseh , have received their inheritance beyond Jordan on the east , which Moses the servant of the  Lord  gave them .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka par ka Hima ki bneng kan long kumne . Shisien la don shiphew ngut ki theisotti uba la rhah ïa la ki sharak bad ki la mih ban ïashem ïa u nongleitkurim .
translation.en: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins , which took their lamps , and went forth to meet the bridegroom .
What are you buying ?
translation.kha: Phin leit thied aiu ?

U Kornelios u la ong , Ka la long kumba ha kane ka por lai sngi mynshuwa ba nga dang duwai ha ka ïing jrong nga ha ka por lai baje nep sngi . Kynsan u briew uba riam ha ki jaiñ kiba phyrnai u la ïeng ha khmat jongno nga , malade u la jong :
translation.en: And Cornelius said , Four days ago I was fasting until this hour  ; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house , and , behold , a man stood before me in bright clothing ,
What ? came the word of God out from you ? or came it unto you only ?
translation.kha: Kaei ? Lane ka lah mo ban long ba ka ktien U Blei ka la wan na phi ? Lane hato dei tang ha phi ba ka la wan ?
hynne , to pyrkhat nalor khie ki baroh ïa ka Hiram U Blei bad ïa kai kaba u dawa na phi , bad un pyndap ïa phin da kine ktien kiei baroh .
translation.en: But seek ye first the kingdom of God , and his righteousness  ; and all these things shall be added unto you .

Yet I will send my servants unto thee to morrow about this time , and they shall search thine house , and the houses of thy servants  ; and it shall be , that whatsoever is pleasant in thine eyes , they shall put it in their hand , and take it away .
translation.kha: Mynta , la kumno kumno ngan phah ïa ki rangbah synshar jong nga ban ïit ha ka ïingsyiem jong me bad ha ki ïing jong ki rangbah synshar jong me , bad ban shim ïa kaei kaei baroh kiba ki kheiñ kordor . Kin poi hangto lashai kumba katne por .
Kaba bha bad kaba sniew kyiuh ki jia ha ka Law jong u .
translation.en: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good ?

translation.kha: lang pynjulor ïa ki tieng sohshnong bad ki jingshoh Dumbur jngai ka , kiba ka ju ong ba kiba ieit jong ka ki ai ïa ka namar ba ka la shakri ïa ki . Ngi pynkylla ri khlieh ïa ki bri shohbeiñ bad ki brisoh jong ka ; ki riewkhlaw kin pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees , whereof she hath said , These are my rewards that my lovers have given me : and I will make them a forest , and the beasts of the field shall eat them .

translation.kha: Hynrei uta umbah pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei u kren ha ki briew bad u ai ha ki ïa ka jingïarap , ka jingpynshlur , bad ka jingpyntngen .
translation.en: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification , and exhortation , and comfort .

translation.kha: U la ong ha ki , Ko Shadrakh , Meshakh , bad Abdon , hato ka long kaba shisha ba phi kyntait ban mane ïa u blei jong nga bad ban dem ngon sha ka durbriew kaba nga la phah pynïeng ?
translation.en: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them , Is it true , O Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , do not ye serve my gods , nor worship the golden image which I have set up ?

translation.kha: U Blei u la Ong ïa nga ba-bang thoh ha ka kot ba ki briew kiba Kamon ki long , khnang ba kan don ka jingthoh jingkynmaw banleh Shi rta , haduh katno ki la lama kiba Sniew .
translation.en: Now go , write it before them in a table , and note it in a book , that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever :
And this shall be a sign unto thee from the  Lord  , that the  Lord  will do this thing that he hath spoken  ;
translation.kha: U Isaïah u jubab ,  U  Trai  un ai ha me ka dak ban pynshisha ba un bat ïa la ka kular .
Men ong ha ki ïa kaei ba nga bthah ïa me ban nong , lada ki sngap ne kim sngap . Kynmaw ba ki un-long ki nongïaleh pyrshah .
translation.en: And thou shalt speak my words unto them , whether they will hear , or whether they will forbear : for they are most rebellious .

translation.kha: Naphtuh kaei nga ruh nga jynjar kumne barieh , Hynrei nga dap da ka jingsngewskhem , namar nga tip hano nga la shaniah , bad nga sngewthikna ba u lah pun sumar ïaskhem haduh kata ka snieh ïa kaei kaba u la aiti ha ang .
translation.en: For the which cause I also suffer these things : nevertheless I am not ashamed : for I know whom I have believed , and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day .

translation.kha: bad ka sur bakyntang jong ki duitara bad ki ksing jongnga ki ka la ruh noh .
translation.en: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth , the noise of them that rejoice endeth , the joy of the harp ceaseth .

translation.kha: Hangno u don U Trai , uba da ka bor jong u , u la kuna ki kam bakhraw lyngba u Moses , u da kad arliang ïa ki um ka dulir nabar ïalam ïa ki briew jong u lyngba ki um kiba jylla , ban ïoh ïa ka nam baneh junom na ka bynta ïa lade” ? Ha ka jingïalam U Trai , ki kjat jrong ki , ki long skhem kum ki Kulai khlaw , malu kim ju jingstet .
translation.en: That led them through the deep , as an horse in the wilderness , that they should not stumble ?
And Jesus rebuked him , saying ,  Hold thy peace , and come out of him .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la hukum ïa u mynsiem ,  Sngap jar bad mihnoh na une u briew !

translation.en: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God , which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation  ; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels , and in the presence of the Lamb :
translation.kha: u hi da lade un dih ïa ka waiñ ka jong U Blei , ka waiñ ka jingbitar shla jong U , kaba u la theh noh ha ka bor jong ka baroh ha ka khuri ka jingbitar jong U ! Baroh kiba leh ïa kane kin shah pynsaja ha ka ding bad ha u kyndok ha khmat ki angel bakhuid bad ha khmat U Khunlangbrot .

translation.en: But if any man say unto you , This is offered in sacrifice unto idols , eat not for his sake that shewed it , and for conscience sake : for the earth is the Lord s , and the fulness thereof :
translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u ong ïa phi ,  Kane ka dei ka jingbam ba la kñia ha ki bleithaw ,  te wat nym bam phi ïa kata ka jingbam , na ka bynta uta uba la ïathuh ïa phi bad na ka bynta ka jingïatiplem —
Nga tyngkhuh ïa la ki Briew , bad lada ki kyntu ban kylla-kaba-mut , kine kiei kiei baroh kin wan jia ha ki .
translation.en: Because it is a trial , and what if the sword contemn even the rod ? it shall be no more , saith the Lord  God .

And his father refused , and said , I know it , my son , I know it : he also shall become a people , and he also shall be great : but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he , and his seed shall become a multitude of nations .
translation.kha: Hynrei u kpa jong u , u kyrngah , bad u ong ,  Nga tip , khun ; nga tip . Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Manasseh ruh kin sa kylla long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw . Hynrei u para jong u un kham khraw ban ïa u , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin kylla long ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw .
Khynnah ïa ka jingiw ïam ha U Tharai , bad waiñ trei ei ei kumba phoi ju triang man la ka snoh .
translation.en: Ye shall do no servile work therein : but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Agrippa u la ong ha u Paul , Ha kaei ka to balyngkot , hato me pyrkhat ba men pynjrong Khristan ïa nga ?
translation.en: Then Agrippa said unto Paul , Almost thou persuadest me to be a Christian .
In the law it is written , With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people ; and yet for all that will they not hear me , saith the Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid la thoh :  Da ki briew kiba kren ha ki ktien kiba pher ngan kren ha ki briew jong nga , ong U Trai . Ngan kren da ki rmiang shyntur jong ki nongwei , hynrei wat la katta ki briew jong nga kin ym shahshkor ïa nga .
Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ka dorbar baroh kawei ki la pyrshang ban wad ki Sakhi pyrshah ïa U Jisu khnang ban pynïap noh ïa u , hynñiew ktien skhem la shem kano kano ruh .
translation.en: And the chief priests and all the council sought for witness against Jesus to put him to death  ; and found none .

If thy people go out to battle against their enemy , whithersoever thou shalt send them , and shall pray unto the  Lord  toward the city which thou hast chosen , and toward the house that I have built for thy name :
translation.kha: Haba me hukum ïa ki briew jong me ban leit ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki nongshun jong ki bad ba ki duwai ha me , hangno hangno ha kaba ki don , ki da phai khmat sha kane ka nongbah ïa kaba me la jied bad sha kane ka Templ ïa kaba nga la tei na ka bynta jong me ,
U kñia arphew ar hajar tyllai ki masi bad shi lakh aiti khashor tylli ki langbrot kum ki jingainguh jingïasyllok . Bad kumta u skhem bad ki paidbah baroh ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
translation.en: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings , which he offered unto the  Lord  , two and twenty thousand oxen , and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep . So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi Sabbaton , U Jehu u dang hawei ha ka synagog .
translation.en: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath .

In his days did Hiel the Beth–elite build Jericho : he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn , and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub , according to the word of the  Lord  , which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun .
translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u , u Hiel uba na Bethel u tei pat ïa ka Jerikho . Kumba U  Trai  u la lah kren da u Joshua u khun jong u Nun , u Hiel u la duh noh ïa u khun nyngkong jong u , u Abiram mynba u buh ïa ka nongrim jong ka Jerikho , bad ïa u khun khatduh jong u , u Segub mynba u tei ïa ki khyrdop jong ka .

translation.en: The  Lord  called thy name , A green olive tree , fair , and of goodly fruit : with the noise of a great tumult he hath kindled fire upon it , and the branches of it are broken .
translation.kha: Shisien nga la khot ïa ki , u dieng Olib babun sla , uba dap da ki soh ba-itynnat ; hynrei mynta , da ka jingkyrhuh kum u pyrthat ngan thang ïa ki sla jong u ha ka ding bad pynkheiñ ïa ki tnat jong u .

Bad u Ahab u kylli ïa u Jehoshaphat , Phin leit lang malu nga shun tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ? Nga la kloi , haba phoi la kloi , u Jehoshaphat u jubab bad kumta ruh ki bariew bad ki shipai badno ki shipai shong kulai jongngi nga ruh .
translation.en: And he said unto Jehoshaphat , Wilt thou go with me to battle to Ramoth–gilead ? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel , I am as thou art , my people as thy people , my horses as thy horses .

And it shall be , if thou have no delight in her , then thou shalt let her go whither she will  ; but thou shalt not sell her at all for money , thou shalt not make merchandise of her , because thou hast humbled her .
translation.kha: Te , lada phim mon shuh ïa ka , phi lah ban pyllait ïa ka . Namar ba phi la pynbor ban ïathiah shongkha bad ka , phim lah ban ñiew ïa ka kum ka mraw bad die ïa ka .
Ki nong Ijipt ki la lum thup ïa ki shi jaka jaka haduh ba la iwtung lut ka ri baroh katai .
translation.en: And they gathered them together upon heaps : and the land stank .

translation.kha: Ha snem kaba saw ba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , u baroh u thoh ïa kawei kaba nga la ong ha u .
translation.en: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah , when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah , in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , saying ,
Thou prevailest for ever against him , and he passeth : thou changest his countenance , and sendest him away .
translation.kha: Me pynduhbor ïa u briew bad phah noh ïa u junom ; ka durkhmat jong u ka sniew dur ha ka por ka jingïap .
U ïada ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah ha ka ri jong ngi ; u ïarap ïa ki riewkynthei bad ki khunswet , hynrei u leit lam ïa ki bymman sha ka jingjot jong ki .
translation.en: The  Lord  preserveth the strangers  ; he relieveth the fatherless and widow : but the way of the wicked he turneth upside down .

translation.kha: Ka mluh ka Long kaba bakha , hynrei lapbah ka duh noh ïa ka jingmad , ym don lyndum shuh da kumno kumno ïa-ban pynbang pat ïa ka .
translation.en: Salt is good : but if the salt have lost his savour , wherewith shall it be seasoned ?

translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh ki la mudui ïa U Jisu shibun kiei ki , kumta u Pilat u la kylli babiang ïa u , Hato men ym jubab ? Sngap ïa ki jingmudui jong ki baroh !
translation.en: And Pilate asked him again , saying , Answerest thou nothing ? behold how many things they witness against thee .

translation.kha: U Asher bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Imnah , u Ishbah , u Ishbi , bad u Beraïah laiñ bad ka Serah ka para jong ki . Ki khun shajrong u Beraïah ki long u Heber bad u Malkhiel .
translation.en: And the sons of Asher  ; Imnah , and Ishuah , and Ishvi , and Beriah , and Serah their sister : and the sons of Beriah  ; Heber , and Malchiel .
Riches profit not in the day of wrath : but righteousness delivereth from death .
translation.kha: Ka spah kan ym lah ban leh ïa kaei kaei kaba bha ha ka sngi ba phi ïashem ïa ka jingïap , hynrei ka jinglehhok kan pyllait ïa ka jingim jong phi .
Linos U Blei un pynkut ïa ki jingkynshew ha pyrem ?
translation.en: When will God bring an end to evil on earth ?
Heaven and earth shall pass away , but my words shall not pass away .
translation.kha: Ka bneng bad ka pyrthei kin leit noh , hynrei ki ktien jong nga kin ym leit noh da lei lei .
Ko khun jong ang , wat ïashang bad ki brai kiba kumin kita . Kiar na ki .
translation.en: My son , walk not thou in the way with them  ; refrain thy foot from their path :
But the Philistines took him , and put out his eyes , and brought him down to Gaza , and bound him with fetters of brass  ; and he did grind in the prison house .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki kem ïa u bad ki khlaw ïa ki khmat jong u . Ki ïalam ïa u sha Gasa , ki teh ïa u da ki kynjri rnong , bad ki pyntrei ïa u ha ka kor tylliat hapoh byndi .

translation.en: For the  Lord  will not cast off his people , neither will he forsake his inheritance .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un ym iehnoh ïa la ki briew ; bad un ym iehnoh ïa kito kiba long ki jong u .
Ïalam ïa u Aaron malu u Eleasar u khun jong u sha kliar u Lum Hor ,
translation.en: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son , and bring them up unto mount Hor :
And when they found them not , they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city , crying , These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei haba kim shym lap ïa ki , ki la paring ïa u Jason bad ïa ki katto katne ngut kiwei pat ki parabangeit ha khmat ki bor synshar jong ka nongbah bad ki la pyrta ,  Kine ki briew ki la thaw jingkulmar kylleng kylleng ! Mynta ki la wan sha ka nongbah jong ngi , bad u Jason u la pynsah ïa ki ha ka ïing jong u .

translation.en: And they shall take other stones , and put them in the place of those stones  ; and he shall take other mortar , and shall plaster the house .
translation.kha: Nangta un bujli da kiwei pat ki maw ha ka jaka kita kiba la weng noh , bad yn sa ñiad astor thymmai ïa kita ki kynroh .
Kumta u —Joshua bad ki rangbah jong u baher ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki ha ka por ba kam poi pyrkhat ha ka Wahduid Meron .
translation.en: So Joshua came , and all the people of war with him , against them by the waters of Merom suddenly  ; and they fell upon them .

translation.kha: Haba u Dabid u la wan peh ha Mahanaim , u Shobi , u khun jong u Nahash , na ka shnong Rabbah kambah ha Ammon , u Makhir , u khun jong u Ammiel , na Lodebar , nabar u Baalis , na Rogelim kaba ha Gilead , ki la wan ïakynduh ïa u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when David was come to Mahanaim , that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon , and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo–debar , and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim ,
The  Lord  taketh pleasure in them that fear him , in those that hope in his mercy .
translation.kha: hynrei u sngewbha ha kito kiba pyndonburom ïa u , ha kito kiba shaniah ha ka jingieit baneh jong u .

U Trai u ong ha u Moses , Mynta ngan pynhap bam na bneng ïa phi baroh . Ki bynriew ki dei baneh mih shalor man ka sngi ban lum katba Ban biang na ka bynta kata ka sngi . Da kumta na lah ban tynjuh ïa ki baneh Shema la kmen kohnguh ne em ïa ki jingbthah jongu nga .
translation.en: Then said the  Lord  unto Moses , Behold , I will rain bread from heaven for you  ; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day , that I may prove them , whether they will walk in my law , or no .

translation.kha: Nangta u Shekhem u ong ha u kpa jong ka Dinah bad ha ki hynmen shynrong jongnga ka , Sngewbha pdiang ïa kane ka jingkyrpad jong nga , bad katno kob phi kwah ngan ai .
translation.en: And Shechem said unto her father and unto her brethren , Let me find grace in your eyes , and what ye shall say unto me I will give .

translation.kha: Katba uei na ki u dang khet ïa uwei u dieng , kynnoh u khlieh sdie jongki u , u hap hapoh um . Ko kyndiang , Ngan ar Kumno ? u pyrta ha u Elisha . U Dei u sdie ba la pan kylliang .
translation.en: But as one was felling a beam , the axe head fell into the water : and he cried , and said , Alas , master ! for it was borrowed .
And Annas the high priest , and Caiaphas , and John , and Alexander , and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest , were gathered together at Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ki la ïakynduh bad u Annas u Rangbah Lyngdoh bad u Kaïaphas , u Ïoannis , u Aleksandar , bad kiwei pat kiba dei na ka longïing jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh .

Hadien san sngi , u Adonijah , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la leit sha Kaisaria lem bad katto katne nud ki tymmen ki san bad uwei u riewsaid aiñ uba kyrteng u Tertullos . Ki la wan ha khmat jongnga u Pheliks Bad ki la ai ïa ki jingmudui jong ki pyrshah ïa u Paul .
translation.en: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders , and with a certain orator named Tertullus , who informed the governor against Paul .

translation.kha: haba ïa ka jingbishar thok la pynkylla khongpong ha ka ïingbishar , u tip .
translation.en: To subvert a man in his cause , the Lord approveth not .
After that , he was seen of James ; then of all the apostles .
translation.kha: Nangta u la paw ha u Jakob , bad hadien ha baroh ki Apostol .
Ma ngi baroh kiba la ih bha ka jinglong mynsiem , ngi daiñ ban ïuh ïa kane kajuh ka jingmut . Khenani Lada don napdeng jong phin kiba don da ka jingat bashabar , U Blei un pynshai ïa kane ha phi .
translation.en: Let us therefore , as many as be perfect , be thus minded : and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded , God shall reveal even this unto you .

translation.kha: Ka jingïalap kaba ka jingpeit ka ai ka long ka bymjukut . Kumta ar la khoh ïa ka Ijipt , ‘ U Ïakjakor bym lah pynmynsaw .’
translation.en: For the Egyptians shall help in vain , and to no purpose : therefore have I cried concerning this , Their strength is to sit still .
But every man in his own order : Christ the firstfruits ; afterward they that are Christ s at his coming .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa uwei pa uwei yn pynmihpat kat kum ka jingbuh ryntih : Ïa U Khrist nyngkong eh na baroh ; nangta ha ka jingwan jong u , sa ïa kito kiba dei ki jong u .
Ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah la tei halor ki khat-ar thylliej ki maw nongrim , kiba halor jong ki la theh ïa ki kyrteng Jong ki khat-ar ngut ki apostol jyllang U Khunlangbrot .
translation.en: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations , and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb .

translation.kha: Phi dei ban rakhe ïa kane ka sngur kum ka Jingkhawai Niam ban pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa Kaei kaba nga , U Trai , nga la leh . Rakhe ïa ka pateng la pateng bynriew .
translation.en: And this day shall be unto you for a memorial  ; and ye shall keep it a feast to the  Lord  throughout your generations  ; ye shall keep it a feast by an ordinance for ever .
The lambs are for thy clothing , and the goats are the price of the field .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban thain jaiñ na u  saiwul jong ki langbrot jong phi bad thied jaka da ka pisa kaba phi ïoh na kaba die na ki katto katne ki blang jong phi .
U ong , Khie leit sha Ninebeh , kata ka nongbam kiba khraw , bad to kren pyrshah ïa ka ; nga tip haduh kano kiba bymman ki briew jong ka ki long .
translation.en: Arise , go to Nineveh , that great city , and cry against it  ; for their wickedness is come up before me .

translation.kha: Uno uno wahbah khlain ïa kaba kumta kane , ne uba pyndonkam ïa ka wat tang khyndiat shiah ha uno uno u briew u bym dei u lyngdoh , yn ym kheiñ shuh ïa u kumta uwei na ki briew jong nga !’
translation.en: Whosoever compoundeth any like it , or whosoever putteth any of it upon a stranger , shall even be cut off from his people .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Gideon bad ki rangbah jong u baher ki la khiew dang step phyrngab bun ki la sher dara harud ka Umpohliew Hadad . Ki Midian pat ki syier dara shaphang shatei na ki , ha ka dem kaba harud u lut Mamre .
translation.en: Then Jerubbaal , who is Gideon , and all the people that were with him , rose up early , and pitched beside the well of Harod : so that the host of the Midianites were on the north side of them , by the hill of Moreh , in the valley .
And thou shalt receive them of their hands , and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering , for a sweet savour before the  Lord  : it is an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta , shim ïa ki na ki kti jong ki bad thang ïa ki ha kata ka duwan , halor kata ka jingainguh thang , kum ka jingainguh bam sha nga . Ka jingiwbih kaba suhsieng na kane ka jingainguh ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .
Ha kawei ka sngi , U Jisu u la kiew khashor ka lieng lym bad ki synran jong u bad u la nong ha ki , Ïa ngin leit sha shiliang sha kawei pat ka liang jong ka duriaw . Kut ki la ïaleit .
translation.en: Now it came to pass on a certain day , that he went into a ship with his disciples : and he said unto them ,  Let us go over unto the other side of the lake .  And they launched forth .
And oil for the light , and spices for anointing oil , and for the sweet incense ,
translation.kha: ka umphniang na ka bynta ki sharak , ki musla na ka bynta ka umphniang pynsleh bad na ka bynta ka jingiwbih ;
Haba ki la dep duwai , ka jaka ha kaba ki la ïakynduh ka la khynñiuh . La pyndap ïa ki baroh da U Mynsiem Bakhuid bad ki la sdang ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei da ka jingsumar .
translation.en: And when they had prayed , the place was shaken where they were assembled together  ; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost , and they spake the word of God with boldness .

translation.kha: Jamynrei yn ym don ka tiar tdem ka ïa-ban lah ban pynmynsaw ïa pha ; phan don ka jubab ïa kito baroh kiba mudui ïa pha . Ngan kyrshan ïa ki shakri Jong nga bad ngan ai jingjop ïa ki . U Trai u la kren .
translation.en: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper  ; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn . This is the heritage of the servants of the  Lord  , and their righteousness is of me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka jingstad kane pynsngewtynnat ïa ka jingim jong Phin nabar ka ai jingsuk lynter ïa phi .
translation.en: Her ways are ways of pleasantness , and all her paths are peace .

translation.kha: Bad kumta nga ïaleh katba lah ban ïoh ka jingïatiplem kaba khuid kdar ha khmat jong U Blei bad ki briew .
translation.en: And herein do I exercise myself , to have always a conscience void of offence toward God , and toward men .

translation.kha: U Messaïah u nguh ha U Trei , Hangne ang ïalumlang ïa ki hynriew lakh ngut ki briew , bad me , me ong ban men ai doh ïa ki ka don biang haduh shi bnai ?
translation.en: And Moses said , The people , among whom I am , are six hundred thousand footmen  ; and thou hast said , I will give them flesh , that they may eat a whole month .

translation.kha: Keiñ pyllait ïa phira na ki tnga jong kiwei pat ki briew , na ki kynther kiba dum ban kren ïa ki ktien kiba pynshohbieit .
translation.en: That they may keep thee from the strange woman , from the stranger which flattereth with her words .
Behold , there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt :
translation.kha: Yn don ka jingseisoh kaba khraw ha ki hynñiew snem ha ka ri Ijipt baroh kawei .

Hato u samla Absalom u dang im ? U syiem u kylli . U Ahikam u jubab , Kynrad , haba u Joab u rangbah pynkdor jngai phi u phah ïa nga , nga ïohi ïa ka jingkhihwin kaba jur , hynrei ngam tip ka dei kaei .
translation.en: And the king said , Is the young man Absalom safe ? And Ahimaaz answered , When Joab sent the king s servant , and me thy servant , I saw a great tumult , but I knew not what it was .
He that committeth sin is of the devil  ; for the devil sinneth from the beginning . For this purpose the Son of God was manifested , that he might destroy the works of the devil .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ïai leh ïa ka pop , u long jong u Soitan , namar u Soitan u la leh pop naduh kaba mynnyngkong eh . U Khun U Blei u la paw na ka bynta kane hi ka daw , ban pynjot noh ïa kaei kaba la leh da u Soitan .
wahbah ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ka barieh da kaba U Trai u jrop ïa ki jingïap , ki la ïeng da kaba tiengburom ïa U Tiras ; bad kumta ki la shaniah ha U Trai bad ha u Moses u sharai jong u .
translation.en: And Israel saw that great work which the  Lord  did upon the Egyptians : and the people feared the  Lord  , and believed the  Lord  , and his servant Moses .

And he spake also a parable unto them  ;  No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old  ; if otherwise , then both the new maketh a rent , and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi :  Ym don uno uno uba tar ïa ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai ban syrdep ïa ka jaiñkup kaba rim . Lada u leh kumta , un tar ïa ka jaiñ bathymmai , bad kata ka lyngkhot jaiñ bathymmai kan ym ïadei ïa kaba rim .
Ko khun u brai , u la ong , to Thoh ïa ka tarik mynta ka sngi , namsop kane ka long ka sngi kaba u syiem ka Babilonia u sdang ïa ka jingkerkut ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: Son of man , write thee the name of the day , even of this same day : the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem this same day .

translation.kha: Ma u bad ki shipai ki ïaleit sha ka khyrdop bah jong ka nongbam bun ki sher dara ha ka phang bashatei , ha kaba ne ka them hapdeng jong ki badno ka Ai .
translation.en: And all the people , even the people of war that were with him , went up , and drew nigh , and came before the city , and pitched on the north side of Ai : now there was a valley between them and Ai .

translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba kumin ki briew’ jongu nga kin da la ñiewkor ïa nga bad ïa-pdiang ïa ka jingsneng pynbeit jong nga , ba kine ym da la klet ïa ka jingïakhaïi kaba na la hikai ïa ki . Hynrei shen shen ki la leh bymman kumba ki ju leh .
translation.en: I said , Surely thou wilt fear me , thou wilt receive instruction  ; so their dwelling should not be cut off , howsoever I punished them : but they rose early , and corrupted all their doings .

translation.kha: U Solomon u phah ïa ken ka khubor sha u Hiram :
translation.en: And Solomon sent to Hiram , saying ,

translation.kha: U Saul u jubab , Nga la leh bakla ; wan phai pat ko Dabid , u khun jongnga nga . Namar ba phi la kheiñ kor ïa ka jingim jong nga ha kaei ka miet , lano lynnong Ngan ym pynmynsaw shuh ïa phi . Nga la leh bieit shisha , bad nga la bakla palat .
translation.en: Then said Saul , I have sinned : return , my son David : for I will no more do thee harm , because my soul was precious in thine eyes this day : behold , I have played the fool , and have erred exceedingly .

translation.kha: Kin long kum ki lyngkhot phlangïap , bad ka ding kan smam lud ïa ki ! Kin ym lah thew ban pyllait im ïa lade — ki thylliej ding kin khluit eh na ka bynta jong ki , yn ym don ka ding kaba rhem ban pynsyaid ïa lade .
translation.en: Behold , they shall be as stubble  ; the fire shall burn them  ; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame : there shall not be a coal to warm at , nor fire to sit before it .

translation.kha: hynrei hapoh ka kpoh jong u ka jingbam ka kylla kthang , ka kthang kum ka bih .
translation.en: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned , it is the gall of asps within him .

translation.kha: hajar u lumbah bakynjang tam jong ka Israel . Un sei ki tnat bad pynim ki symbai bad kylla long u dieng Kedar ba-itynnat eh . Ki sai kiba bun jait kin im hangta bad ïoh jingda ha ka jingkyrsiew jong u .
translation.en: In the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it : and it shall bring forth boughs , and bear fruit , and be a goodly cedar : and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing  ; in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell .

translation.kha: Na ka bynda U Troas , to pynkohnguh ïa lade ha ki har synshar Baroh : Ha u pashait uba Long ka bor kaba ha khlaw tam ,
translation.en: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord s sake : whether it be to the king , as supreme  ;

translation.kha: To pan na U Trai ïa u thret ha ka pyrem jong ka snem . U dei U Trai uba phah ïa ki lyoh slap bad ïa u lap praw , da kaba pynjyrngam ïa ki lyngkha na ka pyntwa uwei pa uwei .
translation.en: Ask ye of the  Lord  rain in the time of the latter rain  ; so the  Lord  shall make bright clouds , and give them showers of rain , to every one grass in the field .
And he said unto them ,  Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God : but unto them that are without , all these things are done in parables :
translation.kha: Ha phi la ai ïa ka jingmaïan jong ka Hima U Blei ,  U Jisu u la jubab .  Hynrei kiwei pat , kiba long shabar , ki ïohsngew ïa kiei kiei baroh lyngba ki pharshi ,
U kren sanphew ki dieng nabar ki jingkthang , naduh ki dieng Hadad Lebanon haduh u Hissop uba mih halor kynroh ; u la kren shaphang ki mrad , ki sim , ki bseiñ , bad ki dohkha .
translation.en: And he spake of trees , from the cedar tree that is in Lebanon even unto the hyssop that springeth out of the wall : he spake also of beasts , and of fowl , and of creeping things , and of fishes .

translation.kha: Naba mem shym la buhrieh na kaba pynbna ha phi ïa ka jingthmu baroh ka jong U Blei .
translation.en: For I have not shunned to declare unto you all the counsel of God .

translation.kha: Don bun jait ki rukom shakri , hynrei ïa ujuh U Trai la shakri .
translation.en: And there are differences of administrations , but the same Lord .
And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer , and brought them to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Dabid u kurup ïa ki ryntieh ksiar ba la rah da ki rangbah synshar jong u Hadadeser bad u rah ïa ki sha Jerusalem .

translation.en: And when the seven thunders had uttered their voices , I was about to write : and I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me , Seal up those things which the seven thunders uttered , and write them not .
translation.kha: Hamar ba ki la kren , nga la sdang ban thoh . Hynrei nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba kren na bneng ,  To buhrieh ïa kaei kaba ki hynñiew tylli ki pyrthat ki la ong ; wat thoh ïa ka !
Namarba lada la buhrieh ïa ka gospel kaba me ïahap , la buhrieh ïa ka tang na kito kiba la jah noh .
translation.en: But if our gospel be hid , it is hid to them that are lost :
These are the statutes and judgments and laws , which the  Lord  made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Kine baroh ki long ki aiñ bad ki hukum ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Moses , ha u Lum Sinai na ka bynta ki paid Israel .

translation.en: Then took they the body of Jesus , and wound it in linen clothes with the spices , as the manner of the Jews is to bury .
translation.kha: Kine ar ngut ki rangbah , ki la shim ïa ka met U Jisu bad ki la sop ïa ka da ki jaiñ linen lem bad ki musla kat kum ka rukom ki Jiw haba pynkhreh ïa ka met shuwa ban tep .
