translation.en: For , behold , the  Lord  cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity : the earth also shall disclose her blood , and shall no more cover her slain .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u wan na ka jaka shong jong u na bneng ban pynshitom ïa ki briew jong ka pyrthei namar ki pop jong ki . Ki jingpynïap briew ha ka pyrthei ïa kiba la leh ha kaba rieh , yn pynpaw , bad ka khyndew kan ym lah shuh ban buhrieh ïa kito ïa kiba la pynïap .
Hynrei u ong , Wat pynsah hajuh ïa ngi . U Trai u la ai jingjop ïa ka jingleit jongnga nga ; to shah ngan leit phai patan sha la u kynran .
translation.en: And he said unto them , Hinder me not , seeing the  Lord  hath prospered my way  ; send me away that I may go to my master .

translation.kha: U Joab u ong ha u , Lada phiah ïohi ba ki Syria ki iap ïa nga , wan malade ïarap ïa nga ; pynlang lada ki Armoni ki jop ïa phi , ngan rupa bad ïarap ïa phi .
translation.en: And he said , If the Syrians be too strong for me , then thou shalt help me : but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee , then I will come and help thee .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi mynba U Jisu u dong duwai mawthew , ki synran ki la Wan ha u . Ki babha ki ïai-ong ba na long uei ? U la kylli ïa ki .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he was alone praying , his disciples were with him : and he asked them , saying ,  Whom say the people that I am ?

translation.kha: Un jingwallam ïa Uto u masi sha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ , un pahuh ïa la ka ktem ha ka khlaiñ jong u , bad un pynïap ïa u hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai .
translation.en: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the  Lord   ; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock s head , and kill the bullock before the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Manoah u ainong ha la ka tnga , Ngin sa ïap shisha , namar ba I la ïohi ïa U Blei !
translation.en: And Manoah said unto his wife , We shall surely die , because we have seen God .

translation.kha: Yn ym don u shun pyrkhat ba uba ba-beit u long uba jingburom lane ban ong ba u riewshukor u long uba khop .
translation.en: The vile person shall be no more called liberal , nor the churl said to be bountiful .

translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ki pun jong phi ban long skhem malu u pynkdang ïa phi da u kew babha tam .
translation.en: He maketh peace in thy borders , and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat .

translation.kha: U Ahab u jong ïa u Jehoshaphat , Haba moi leit sha ka thma , ngan riam pher ïa lade , hynrei ma phi , phong ïa ki jaiñ syiad jyllang phi . kumta u syiem Israel u saw sha thma ha ka jingriam pher .
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , I will disguise myself , and will go to the battle  ; but put thou on thy robes . So the king of Israel disguised himself  ; and they went to the battle .
Rejoice over her , thou heaven , and ye holy apostles and prophets  ; for God hath avenged you on her .
translation.kha: To shadkmen , ko ka bneng , namar ka jingpynjot ïa ka ! to shadkmen , ko ki briew jong U Blei bad ki apostol bad ki nongïathuhlypa ! Naba U Blei u la pynrem ïa ka na ka bynta kaei kaba ka la leh ïa phi !
Ki ha ban Sakhi ïa phi kumno ban im kumin kiba stad bad kynum ba-bang long uba hok , uba lehhok , bad uba ïaid beit .
translation.en: To receive the instruction of wisdom , justice , and judgment , and equity  ;
For as the crackling of thorns under a pot , so is the laughter of the fool : this also is vanity .
translation.kha: Haba u bieit u rkhie , ka long kum ka jingsawa ki dieng shiah ha ka ding . Kam don jingmut ei ei .
Ko Job , me la kob ïa U Blei Borabor Baroh ; hato manna sangeh noh mynta , ne men jubab ?
translation.en: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct him ? he that reproveth God , let him answer it .
Thy seed also had been as the sand , and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof  ; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me .
translation.kha: Ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin roi kum ki symboh shyiap , bad ngan jin da la pynthikna ba yn ym pynjot ïa ki da lei lei .

Ma nga , U Trei , nga hukum ïa phiah shun ar ïa kaei kaba hok bad kaweh beit . Ïada ïa u briew uba shah thok na uta uba shukor ïa u . Wat lehbeiñ ne banbeiñ ïa ki nongwei , ki ksuit , ne ki riewkynthei , bad wat pynïap ïa ki briew kiba lui lui ha kane ka jaka kaba khuid .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Execute ye judgment and righteousness , and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor : and do no wrong , do no violence to the stranger , the fatherless , nor the widow , neither shed innocent blood in this place .

translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki Rangbah synshar , Ussaïah pa uwei na phi un pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u bhabriew na ka jait jong phi Uba la long u nongmane ïa u Babel ki Peor .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel , Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal–peor .
Also cedar trees in abundance : for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David .
translation.kha: U pynbeit ïa ki briew ka Tyros bad Sidon ban wanlam sha u shibun ki dieng Kedar tylli .
Ki jingjylliew jong ki duriaw-bah bad ki durbriew , ki ong ba ïa ka jingstad ym lah ban shem hangta .
translation.en: The depth saith , It is not in me : and the sea saith , It is not with me .
Wealth maketh many friends  ; but the poor is separated from his neighbour .
translation.kha: Borabor kiba riewspah ki ïakynduh ïa ki paralok kiba thymmai , hynrei kiba duk kim lah ban bat ïa kiba khyndiat ngut kiba ki don .
Te un pyn-i ha phi ïa ka kamra kaba haneng kaba heh , ba la pynkhreh bad pynïong , ha katba phin ïoh baroh kiei kiei ba la pynkhreh lypa na ka bynta jong i'u .
translation.en: And he will shew you a large upper room furnished and prepared : there make ready for us .
Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee , he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea : for they were fishers .
translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang ïaid narud ka duriaw Galilaïa , u la ïohi ar ngut ki nongtong dohkha , u Simon bad u para jong u , u Andriw , ba ki dang ïatong dohkha da ka jar .
Uno uno uba ïohi ïa nga u ïohi ruh ïa uta uba la phiah ïa nga .
translation.en: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me .

translation.kha: U briew ibha kren ha la ka jong ka bor u pyrshang ban ïoh burom na ka bynta ïa lade hi . Hynrei umbiah wad ïa ka burom jong uba uba la phar ïa u , u long uba shida , bad ym don ka bymshisha ha u .
translation.en: He that speaketh of himself seeketh his own glory : but he that seeketh his glory that sent him , the same is true , and no unrighteousness is in him .

translation.kha: (Nga la jied ïa me ha shwa ba nga ai jingim ïa me , bad ha shuwa ba yn khia ïa me , nga la jied ïa me banbeiñ erlangthari u nongïathuhlypa sha ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Before I formed thee in the belly I knew thee  ; and before thou camest forth out of the womb I sanctified thee , and I ordained thee a prophet unto the nations .

translation.kha: U Blei Badonburom Baroh u la pynjot ïa ka jingsuhsieng jong nga . Dei U Blang , ym ka jingdum , kata kaba pyntong ïa nga ban sheptieng — wat la ka jingdum ka la pynmatlah ïa nga .
translation.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness , neither hath he covered the darkness from my face .
Wherefore king Darius signed the writing and the decree .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u syiem Darius u la soi ïa ka hukum .
Ka jingkular jong nga ka erlangthari kaba shisha , bad kan ym kylla . “Nga kular shaid da baroh kaba nga long ; baroh kin wan ban dem ha khmat jngai nga bad kular ba ki long khot ha nga .
translation.en: I have sworn by myself , the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness , and shall not return , That unto me every knee shall bow , every tongue shall swear .

translation.kha: Te , to ngin batskhem ïa ka jingngeit ïa kaba ngi phla . Naba ngi Don U Rangbah Lyngdoh uba khynraw uba la leit haduh ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei — U Jisu , U Khun U Blei .
translation.en: Seeing then that we have a great high priest , that is passed into the heavens , Jesus the Son of God , let us hold fast our profession .
A faithful man shall abound with blessings : but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba lehhok kin ïoh ka jingim kaba kyrhai bad kaba suk . Hynrei lada phi long kyrkieh ban riewspah , phin ym lait na kaba shah pynshitom .

translation.en: For we are labourers together with God : ye are God s husbandry , ye are Gods building .

translation.kha: Ha ka por lai baje U Jisu u la pyrta da ka jingpyrta bajam , Eli , Eli , lema Sabakhthani ? kaba mut U Blei lad nga , U Blei jong sa , balei ba me iehnoh ïa nga ?
translation.en: And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice , saying ,  Eli , Eli , lama sabachthani ?  that is to say ,  My God , my God , why hast thou forsaken me ?
And she went down unto the floor , and did according to all that her mother in law bade her .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka leit sha ka jaka dung kew bad ka la leh ïa kaei kaba ka kiaw kurim jong ka , ka la bthah ïa ka .
ïa ka miej , ki jingbah ïa ka , bad baroh ki tarajur ki tar jong ka ; ïa u kpu ba la ainguh sha U Blei! ;
translation.en: The table , and his staves , and all his vessels , and the shewbread ,

translation.kha: lane ban leh myntor , lieng ban ïakren badno ki mynmiet jongnga kiba la ïap .
translation.en: Or a charmer , or a consulter with familiar spirits , or a wizard , or a necromancer .
And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof , all that make sluices and ponds for fish .
translation.kha: Ki nongthain jaiñ bad ki nongtrei kiba tbit kin diaw bad kin noh mynsiem .
Ha kaba kut jong ki to snem naba la buh da u syiad , u Ashpenas u la ïalam ïa baroh ki samla shynrang sha u Nebukhadnessar .
translation.en: Now at the end of the days that the king had said he should bring them in , then the prince of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar .

translation.kha: Hynrei kine baroh kim long ei ei ïa nga katba nga dang ïohi ïa uto u Jiw , u Mordekai ba u shong ha ka khyrdong sha ka ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: Yet all this availeth me nothing , so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king s gate .

translation.kha: La pyndap ïa u da ka jingbabe , kat haduh ba u la ong , Ngan pynduh khoit ïa kyang ki briew kiba nga la thaw , badno ruh ïa ki mrad Bad ki ha-sem , naba nga la sngewrit ba nga la ïakit ïa ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said , I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth  ; both man , and beast , and the creeping thing , and the fowls of the air  ; for it repenteth me that I have made them .

translation.kha: Nangta ki Israel ki kyang jam ha U Trai , ki da ong , Ngin la leh pop pyrshah ïa me , Namar ngi la iehnoh ïa me , U Blei jong ngi , bad me la mane ïa ki Baal .
translation.en: And the children of Israel cried unto the  Lord  , saying , We have sinned against thee , both because we have forsaken our God , and also served Baalim .

If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people  ; then let him bring for his sin , which he hath sinned , a young bullock without blemish unto the  Lord  for a sin offering .
translation.kha: Lada dei u Rangbah Lyngdoh uba leh pop bad da kumta u wanrah ïa ka jingpynrem ha ki paidbah , un ai ïa u masi lyngraw u bym don kano kano ka jingduna bad un kñia sha U  Trai  namar ka pop jong u .
U Jisu u la phai sha ki bad u la ong , Ko kynthei Jerusalem ! Wat ïam na ka bynta lad nga , hynmen na ka bynta ïa lade bad ki khun jong phi .
translation.en: But Jesus turning unto them said ,  Daughters of Jerusalem , weep not for me , but weep for yourselves , and for your children .

translation.kha: Kumba sem eh bynta na ki jingshah shitom babun jongki U khriat , kumta ruh , lyngba U Khrist , im’ ïoh bynta na Kita ki jingïarap bakhrawbor jong U blang .
translation.en: For as the sufferings of Christ abound in us , so our consolation also aboundeth by Christ .

And Saul said to David , Behold my elder daughter Merab , her will I give thee to wife : only be thou valiant for me , and fight the  Lord s  battles . For Saul said , Let not mine hand be upon him , but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him .
translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u ong ha u Dabid ,  Kane ka dei ka Merab ka khun jong nga kaba kham shuwa . Ngan ai ïa ka ha me kum ka tnga jong me halor ka kyndon ba me dei ban shakri ïa nga kum u shipai bashlur bad baïaineh , bad ïaleh ïa ki thma U  Trai .  ( U Saul u nang pyrkhat ba ha kane ka rukom ki Philistia kin ïoh pynïap ïa u Dabid bad um da donkam ban leh da lade . )
Ki khun shynrang jong u Midian ki un-long u Ephah , u Epher , u Hanokh , u Abida , bad u Eldaah . Ktien baroh ki longsyiem ki khun ki ksiar jong ka Keturah .
translation.en: And the sons of Midian  ; Ephah , and Epher , and Hanoch , and Abida , and Eldaah . All these were the children of Keturah .

translation.kha: Nangta , da kambah kumjuh ïa ki jingbit u nongïathuhlypa , u syiem u plie ïa ka jingkhang kaban phai khmat shaei Syria . Shet ïa u khnam ! u Elisha u lei . Hamar ba u syiem u siat ïa u khnap , u nongïathuhlypa u pyrta , Me hir u khnam jong U Trai , da u , un sa ïoh ka jingjop halor ka Syria . Men ïaleh ïa ki Assyria ha Akhish haduh ba men da ngop thiaw ïa ki .
translation.en: And he said , Open the window eastward . And he opened it . Then Elisha said , Shoot . And he shot . And he said , The arrow of the  Lord s  deliverance , and the arrow of deliverance from Syria : for thou shalt smite the Syrians in Aphek , till thou have consumed them .
For we being many are one bread , and one body : for we are all partakers of that one bread .
translation.kha: Namar don uwei u kpu , baroh na ngi , wat la ngi long shibun , ngi long kawei ka met , naba ngi baroh ngi ïoh bynta lem na ujuh u kpu .
Gaal U thri u la bteng , Shahshkor ïa kaei kaba uta u nongbishar ba-dap u la ong .
translation.en: And the Lord said ,  Hear what the unjust judge saith .

translation.kha: Nga la pynpang ka jingkular bakthang ban noh khmih da ka jingkwah brai ïa ka kynthei .
translation.en: I made a covenant with mine eyes  ; why then should I think upon a maid ?
Thus saith the  Lord  concerning the prophets that make my people err , that bite with their teeth , and cry , Peace  ; and he that putteth not into their mouths , they even prepare war against him .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki la shah shukor ha ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la kular ïa ka jingsuk ïa kito kiba da siewdor ïa ki , hynrei ki byrngem da ka thma ïa kito ki bym siew .
Hynrei nga kwah ïa phi! ba phin sngewthuh ba U Khrist u un-long halor tam ïa uwei pa ti briew , u rnga u long halor la ka tnga , malade U Blei u long halor tam ïa U Khrist .
translation.en: But I would have you know , that the head of every man is Christ ; and the head of the woman is the man ; and the head of Christ is God .
Grace be to you and peace from God the Father , and from our Lord Jesus Christ ,
translation.kha: Ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad Jisu Khrist uba U Trai un ai ha phi ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .

translation.en: See , I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah :
translation.kha: Nga la jied ïa u Besalel , u khun jong u Uri bad u ksiew jong u Hur , na ka jait Judah ,
Kynmaw ïa U Trai ha kaei kaei kaba phi leh , bad un pyn-i ha phi ïa ki lynti kaba dei .
translation.en: In all thy ways acknowledge him , and he shall direct thy paths .
So Samuel turned again after Saul  ; and Saul worshipped the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u Samuel u leit phai ryngkat bad u , bad u Saul u la mane ïa U  Trai .

Na ti u briew u la thaw ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ha ka Pyrthei bad u la pynlong ïa ki ban shong ban sah ha kylleng ka pyrthei . U hi da lade u la pynskhem lypa ïa ki por Kiba wiang Bad ïa ki pyut jong ki jaka ha kob kin shong kin sah .
translation.en: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth , and hath determined the times before appointed , and the bounds of their habitation  ;

translation.kha: Phi la pynrem bad phin la pynpoh ïa ki briew kiba jaijai lui , bad kim shym pyneh ïa phi .
translation.en: Ye have condemned and killed the just  ; and he doth not resist you .

translation.kha: To kyrpad ïa U Trai ka jingot ba un phan ïa ki nongrit Ban ïalumlang ha ka jingot jongu u .
translation.en: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest , that he will send forth labourers into his harvest .

translation.kha: U Onan bad u Moses ki la long kita ha kaba U Trai u la ong , Ïalam noh ïa ki jait Israel na Ijipt .
translation.en: These are that Aaron and Moses , to whom the  Lord  said , Bring out the children of Israel from the land of Egypt according to their armies .

translation.kha: Kim Don bad dei ban ñiewbeiñ ïa ki ; ïa ki yn sa pynjot haba U Trai u ïan ban leh ïa ki .
translation.en: They are vanity , the work of errors : in the time of their visitation they shall perish .
The earth is utterly broken down , the earth is clean dissolved , the earth is moved exceedingly .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei kan orpait bad kan kad .
U pynjahburom ïa kito kiba don ha ka bor malu pynkut ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki nongsumar .
translation.en: He poureth contempt upon princes , and weakeneth the strength of the mighty .

translation.kha: Ka lah ban long ba yn don uno uno u ban ym kohnguh ïa ka khubor kaba ngi phah sha ph ha kane ka shithi . Lada ka un-long kumta , khmih ïa u bad dak ïadon bynta ei ei bad u , khnang ba un lehrain .
translation.en: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle , note that man , and have no company with him , that he may be ashamed .

translation.kha: Ko ba-ieit jong nga , phi long kaba bakhraw kum ka Jerusalem , kaba ine-ine kum ka nongbah Tirsah , kaba pynkyndeh mynsiem kum kine ki nongbah bakhraw .
translation.en: Thy neck is as a tower of ivory  ; thine eyes like the fishpools in Heshbon , by the gate of Bath–rabbim : thy nose is as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus .
And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together : for before they were at enmity between themselves .
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka sngi , u Herod bad u Pilat ki la ïalong paralok ; ha shuwa jong kane , ki la ïalong ki nongshun .
hynrei ki la bat ïa u , ki da ong , To sah bad I ; ka sngi la jan Kuth bad ka la khreh dum . Kumta u la leit ban praw bad ki .
translation.en: But they constrained him , saying , Abide with us : for it is toward evening , and the day is far spent . And he went in to tarry with them .

translation.kha: Ki shim katto katne na ki jinglut ba ki ïohknieh ha ka thma bad pynryngkang ïa ki banbeiñ pynbam ha ka Templ .
translation.en: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: katto katne ngut na kiba ïa-ïeng hangta ki la kylli ïa ki , Phi ïaleh aïu ba phi ïalaw ïa u khun kada ?
translation.en: And certain of them that stood there said unto them , What do ye , loosing the colt ?

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la lah ïong ïa kane , u la pyrta da ka sur kaba jam , Ko Lasaros , to mihnoh !
translation.en: And when he thus had spoken , he cried with a loud voice ,  Lazarus , come forth .
And when they were come out of the ship , straightway they knew him ,
translation.kha: Haba ki la hiar na ka lieng , mar kumta hi , ki briew ki la ithuh ïa U Jisu .
Mynno moi la ju ïohi ïa me ba me long u nongwei , bad ba me pdiang sngewbang ïa me ha ki ïinglieng jong ngi , lap ba me lyngkien bad ba ngi pynkup jaiñ ïa me ?
translation.en: When saw we thee a stranger , and took thee in ? or naked , and clothed thee ?

Whether of them twain did the will of his father ?  They say unto him , The first . Jesus saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That the publicans and the harlots go into the kingdom of God before you .
translation.kha: Uno na kine ar ngut uba la leh ïa kaei kaba u kpa u la kwah ?   Uta uba kham san ,  ki la jubab . Kumta U Jisu u la ong ha ki ,  Nga ong ha phi : Ki nonglum khajna bad ki nuti ki leit rung shapoh ka Hima U Blei ha shuwa jong phi .

translation.en: How much more , if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found ? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines ?
translation.kha: Haduh katno kan jin da la kham bha lada ki briew jong ngi ha kane ka sngi ki la bam ïa ka jingbam ba ki la shim haba ki jop ïa ki nongshun . Shu pyrkhat haduh katno ngut shuh shuh ki Philistia kin jin da la pynïap .
Nangta u Jakob u ong , Pynlong ka jinglamler ba phin leh kamut . U Joseph u la pynlong ka jingsmai , bad u Jakob ruh u ainguh hangta ha jingthiah .
translation.en: And he said , Swear unto me . And he sware unto him . And Israel bowed himself upon the bed s head .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngem kaba lai , u Abraham u la ïohi ïa kata ka jaka na jngai .
translation.en: Then on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes , and saw the place afar off .

translation.kha: ïa ka jingsop kaba da ka sniew u langbrot kaba la bhah rong saw , ïa ka jingsop kaba da ka sniang kaba jlih , bad ïa ka jingkah pyrda ;
translation.en: And the covering of rams  skins dyed red , and the covering of badgers  skins , and the veil of the covering ,
He made him lord of his house , and ruler of all his substance :
translation.kha: U la buh ïa u ban pynïaid ïa ka sorkar jong u bad pynlong ïa u , u nongsynshar halor ka ri baroh kawei ,

translation.en: Salt is good : but if the salt have lost his savour , wherewith shall it be seasoned ?
translation.kha: Ka mluh ka long kaba bha , hynrei lada ka duh noh ïa ka jingmad , ym don lynti shuh da kumno kumno ban pynbang pat ïa ka .
Kito ki ban tei pat ïa pha kin sa wan shen , bad kito kiba pynïoh ïa pha keiñ leit noh .
translation.en: Thy children shall make haste  ; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee .
Are they Japanese ?
translation.kha: Ki dei ki nongjapan ?
Hato me ïada jingbam na ka bynda ki sing ban bam , bad pynhun ïa ki sing sum kiba thngan ,
translation.en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion ? or fill the appetite of the young lions ,

translation.kha: Ko khun , to shahshkor bha , bad shah ba ka jingim jong nga ka long ka nuksa ïa phi .
translation.en: My son , give me thine heart , and let thine eyes observe my ways .
And I will break the pride of your power  ; and I will make your heaven as iron , and your earth as brass :
translation.kha: Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka jingsngewmeng jong phi ; yn ym don slap , bad ka khyndew jong phi kan tyrkhong bad eh kum u nar .
Ha ka jingïohipaw , U Mynsiem jngai U blang u la rah shajrong ïa nga bad wallam pat ïa nga sha kiba shah ringmraw ha bakhia . Nalorkata ka jingïohipaw ka jah nala ,
translation.en: Afterwards the spirit took me up , and brought me in a vision by the Spirit of God into Chaldea , to them of the captivity . So the vision that I had seen went up from me .
That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour ;
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei na phi ki shynrang u dei ban tip kumno ban ïashong ïasah bad la ka tnga ha ka rukom kaba khuid bad kaba donburom ,

translation.en: I have remembered thy name , O  Lord  , in the night , and have kept thy law .
translation.kha: Mynmiet nga kynmaw ïa me , A  Trai  , bad nga pyrkhat shaphang ka aiñ jong me .
Kumno ka Jinglait lynti jong phi mynnin ?
translation.en: How was the journey yesterday ?

And the Levites took down the ark of the  Lord  , and the coffer that was with it , wherein the jewels of gold were , and put them on the great stone : and the men of Beth–shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi ki rah ïa ka Synduk ka Jutang U  Trai  bad ïa kata ka synduk ha kaba don kita ki dur kiba da ka ksiar bad ki buh ïa ki halor uta u mawbah . Nangta ki nong Beth Shemesh ki kñia ïa ki jingainguh thang bad ïa kiwei pat ki jingkñia ha U  Trai .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when Solomon had finished the building of the house of the  Lord  , and the king s house , and all Solomon s desire which he was pleased to do ,
translation.kha: Ynda u syiem Solomon u la dep tei ïa ka ïing U  Trai  bad ïa ka ïingsyiem , nalor kiwei pat kiba u la kwah ban tei ,

translation.en: I will walk before the  Lord  in the land of the living .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga la ïaid ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U  Trai ha ka pyrthei jong kiba im .
Ki la shim ïa ki kynhun jingri , ki jingroi , ki nang , mala baroh katba ne ha shnong bad ha lyngkha .
translation.en: They took their sheep , and their oxen , and their asses , and that which was in the city , and that which was in the field ,

Therefore , ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the Lord  God   ; Thus saith the Lord  God  to the mountains , and to the hills , to the rivers , and to the valleys , to the desolate wastes , and to the cities that are forsaken , which became a prey and derision to the residue of the heathen that are round about  ;
translation.kha: Kumta mynta to shahshkor ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha phi ki lumbah bad ki lumrit , ha phi ki wahduid bad ki jaka them , bad ha phi ki jaka kiba sah ha ki jingjot jingpra , bad ha phi ki nongbah ba la iehnoh kynjah kiba la shah lute bad shah rkhiebeiñ da baroh ki jaitbynriew kiba don sawdong .
Kine ki longïing ki khun ki ksiew na u Shem , babha shong ha ki ri Ibbah pher bapher , bad ha la ka jait ka jahthait kaba kren ïa la ka jong ka jngai ka ktien .
translation.en: These are the sons of Shem , after their families , after their tongues , in their lands , after their nations .

translation.kha: Ki leh ïa kiei kiei baroh Haneng ba ki briew kin ïohi ïa ki . Peit ïa ki jingktah sai snieh kiba don ki jingwoh bakhuid ïa kiba ki theh ha ki lamkhmat bad ki ksang ti jong ki , bad khih ïaheh katno ki long kiba heh ! Khmut ruh katno kiba jrong ki ksai jyrthiaw ha ki jaiñkup jong ki !
translation.en: But all their works they do for to be seen of men : they make broad their phylacteries , and enlarge the borders of their garments ,

translation.kha: Hadien kata , U Jiw u la shem ïa u ha ka Templ Bad u la ong , Peit shane , me la khiah mynta ; te sangeh na kaba leh pop , ïoh kaei kaei kaba kham sngi ka lah ban jai ïa me .
translation.en: Afterward Jesus findeth him in the temple , and said unto him ,  Behold , thou art made whole : sin no more , lest a worse thing come unto thee .
Then they sought to take him : but no man laid hands on him , because his hour was not yet come .
translation.kha: Te ki la pyrshang ban kem ïa u , hynrei ym don uba la ktah kti ïa u , namar ba ka kynta jong u kam pat poi .

translation.en: And he said , Peaceably : I am come to sacrifice unto the  Lord  : sanctify yourselves , and come with me to the sacrifice . And he sanctified Jesse and his sons , and called them to the sacrifice .
translation.kha: Ho-oid  u jubab .  Nga la wan ban ai ka jingkñia ainguh ha U  Trai . Pynkhuid ïa lade , bad wan bad nga .  U ong ruh ïa u Jesse bad ki khun shynrang jong u ban pynkhuid ïa lade , bad u khot sngewbha ïa ki sha kata ka jingkñia .

To phalang malade to ud , ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , kum ka briew ka ban sa kha khun , nia Myntan phin sa hap ban ieh ïa ka nongbah bad ban im ha rudnong . Phi dei ban leit sha bapyllun , hynrei hangta U Trai un pyllait ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi .
translation.en: Be in pain , and labour to bring forth , O daughter of Zion , like a woman in travail : for now shalt thou go forth out of the city , and thou shalt dwell in the field , and thou shalt go even to Babylon  ; there shalt thou be delivered  ; there the  Lord  shall redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies .

translation.kha: U Blei u la peit lyndet ïa ki por hato ki bri kim shym la ithuh ïa u , hynñiew myntan u law ïa ki baroh kylleng sawdong ban phai noh ïa ki lynti bymman jong ki .
translation.en: And the times of this ignorance God winked at  ; but now commandeth all men every where to repent :

translation.kha: Pynkhuid ! mareh ! ngan ym la ban leh ei ei tad hapoh ba lad da poi hangta . Namar ba u Lot u khot ïa ka kaba rit , ïa kata ka nongri la ai kyrteng ka Soar .
translation.en: Haste thee , escape thither  ; for I cannot do any thing till thou be come thither . Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar .

translation.kha: Bad da kumjuh u Saul , ki khun shynrang jong u lai thut , bad uta u sumar , ki la ïaw ; baroh ki brup jong u Saul ki ïap ryngkat ha kajuh ka sngi .
translation.en: So Saul died , and his three sons , and his armourbearer , and all his men , that same day together .

translation.kha: Haba u Silas bad u Timothi ki la poi na Makedonia , u Paulos u la pyntlot ïa ka para jong u baroh ha kaba ïalang ïa ka kherub , da kaba sakhi ha ki Jiw ba U Jisu u Dei U Messaïah .
translation.en: And when Silas and Timothy were come from Macedonia , Paul was pressed in the spirit , and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , baroh ki jingri jong ki , ki pun bad ki kha khlem don ka jingeh .
translation.en: Their bull gendereth , and faileth not  ; their cow calveth , and casteth not her calf .
They shall put you out of the synagogues : yea , the time cometh , that whosoever killeth you will think that he doeth God service .
translation.kha: Phin shah beh noh na ki synagog , bad ka por kan poi haba uno uno uba pynïap ïa phi un pyrkhat ba da kaba leh kumta u shakri ïa U Blei .

translation.en: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days , until the days of your consecration be at an end : for seven days shall he consecrate you .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi phim dei ban mih na ka jingkhang ka ïingjaiñ , tat ynda la pyndep lut ïa ki jinglehniam ka jingpynkyntang .
Hynrei ngan ym weng noh na u ïa la ka jingkyrshan kumba nga la sheng noh na u Saul , ïa uba nga la pynkynriah noh! ktang ba nam long syier ma me .
translation.en: But my mercy shall not depart away from him , as I took it from Saul , whom I put away before thee .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud men shim ïa u langsohmoh u bym don Kanaan Kano ka jingduna bad ai ïa u kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop . To pynkhuid ïa ka duwan da ka snam jong u ha kajuh ka rukom kumba me leh da u masi lyngraw .
translation.en: And on the second day thou shalt offer a kid of the goats without blemish for a sin offering  ; and they shall cleanse the altar , as they did cleanse it with the bullock .

translation.kha: Ngan ïathuh ïa ka shatei ban shah ïa ki Ban leit bad ïa ka shathie ban ym batlot noh ïa ki . Ai ba ki brup jong nga ki wei phai na ki ri bajngai , na man la ki bynta baroh Jong ka pyrthei .
translation.en: I will say to the north , Give up  ; and to the south , Keep not back : bring my sons from far , and my daughters from the ends of the earth  ;

translation.kha: hynrei haba la dep baroh , ka khlem ieh ei ei ïa phi hynrei tieng ka jingkthang bad ka jingpang .
translation.en: But her end is bitter as wormwood , sharp as a twoedged sword .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ki nonglamktien jong u Ïoannis ki la leit noh , U Jisu u la sdang Ban krenbeiñ shaphang jong u ha u paidbah : thaba phi la leit sha u Ïoannis ha ka ri shyiap , aïu phi la khmih lyngki ban ïohi ? Hato ïa ka sla phlang kaweh khun ha ka lyer ?
translation.en: And when the messengers of John were departed , he began to speak unto the people concerning John ,  What went ye out into the wilderness for to see ? A reed shaken with the wind ?

translation.kha: Wat trei ïa kano kan ka kam ha kata ka sngi , naba kata ka erlangthari ka sngi ha kob yn pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ban weng noh ïa ka pop .
translation.en: And ye shall do no work in that same day : for it is a day of atonement , to make an atonement for you before the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynbit , U Khun U Briew u long U Trai jyllang ka Sabbaton .

translation.en: And Jacob set a pillar upon her grave : that is the pillar of Rachel s grave unto this day .
And the king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer , and of the kings that were with him , at the valley of Shaveh , which is the king s dale .
translation.kha: Haba u Abram u la wan phai na ka jingjop ïa u Khedorlaomer bad ïa kita kiwei pat ki syiem , u syiem jong ka Sodom u leit ban ïashem ïa u ha ka them Shabeh ( ïa kaba la khot ruh ka Them u Syiem ) .

translation.en: Be silent , O all flesh , before the  Lord  : for he is raised up out of his holy habitation .
translation.kha: To pynjar jar , uwei pa uwei baroh , ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U  Trai  , namar u wan na ka jaka shong kaba khuid jong u .
U Jisu u la ïong ha ki , Ngin la leh shibun ki kur babha ha khamtam jong phi ïa kiba U Kpa u la ai ïa nga ban leh ; kano na kine ba phi khwai ban lynthem maw ïa ang ?
translation.en: Jesus answered them ,  Many good works have I shewed you from my Father  ; for which of those works do ye stone me ?
Wilt thou judge them , son of man , wilt thou judge them ? cause them to know the abominations of their fathers :
translation.kha: Hato me la kloi ban ai ïa ka jingrai halor jong ki , ko khun u briew ? Te to leh kumta . Pynkynmaw ïa ki shaphang kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki kpa jong ki , ki la leh .

translation.en: And I will sow them among the people : and they shall remember me in far countries  ; and they shall live with their children , and turn again .
translation.kha: Wat la nga la pynsakma ïa ki hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , pynban ha ki jaka kiba jngai eh kin kynmaw ïa nga . Ma ki bad ki khun jong ki kin lait im bad kin wan phai lang sha ïing .
Nahum U Blei u la shah ïa sem ban ken , ngin ym khuslai shibun shaphang katno ka jingim ka long kaba lyngkot .
translation.en: For he shall not much remember the days of his life  ; because God answereth him in the joy of his heart .

translation.kha: ▪ KA PYNI IA KA JINGIEID : Ki nongmih bashrah kim “long na ka Jong ka pyrthei ,” ym shyiap la phiah ia ki da ka jait ne ka dustur , sad ki pynpei ba ki ‘ don ka jingioieit paralok hapdeng jong ki .’
translation.en: ▪ PRACTICES LOVE : True worshippers are “no part of the world ,” are not divided by race or culture , and display ‘ love among themselves .’

translation.kha: Hynrei ha ki sngew ki don wan U Trai un pynlong ïa ka Moab kaba dap kyrhai sa shisien . Kane baroh ka long kaei kaba U Trai u la ong ba kane jia ïa ka Moab .
translation.en: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days , saith the  Lord . Thus far is the judgment of Moab .

translation.kha: kamut i kyrpad ïa phi ba phin map ïa ka kam sngew kob ngi , ki sakhrai jong U Blei u kpa jong phi , ngi la leh . U Joseph u ïam haba u ïohsngew ïa kane .
translation.en: So shall ye say unto Joseph , Forgive , I pray thee now , the trespass of thy brethren , and their sin  ; for they did unto thee evil : and now , we pray thee , forgive the trespass of the servants of the God of thy father . And Joseph wept when they spake unto him .

translation.kha: Ka la long mynta ar snieh shuwa ka Jingkhawai Maim Ka Jingijli bad U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat . Ki rangbah lyngngeit pynlang ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la wad ka lad ban kem shkor jar ïa U Jisu bad ban pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: After two days was the feast of the passover , and of unleavened bread : and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might take him by craft , and put him to death .
And it shall come to pass in that day , that a man shall nourish a young cow , and two sheep  ;
translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka wan , wat lada u nongrep u lah ban pynsah im tang iwei i khun masi bad ar tylli ki blang ,

translation.en: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia , but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad ; so that we need not to speak any thing .
translation.kha: Naba ym dei tang ba ka khubor shaphang U Trai ka la mih na phi sha kylleng ka Makedonia bad Akhaïa , hynrei ka khubor shaphang ka jingngeit jong phi ha U Blei ka la par kylleng . Ym don shuh kano kano te ba ngi donkam ban ong .

translation.en: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth , the noise of them that rejoice endeth , the joy of the harp ceaseth .
translation.kha: bad ka sur bakmen jong ki duitara bad ki ksing jong ki ka la duh noh .
Phi dei ba-bang kyrkhoit ïa ngi kum ki shakri U Khrist , ïa kiba la buh ban sumar ïa ki jingshisha barieh jong U Blei .
translation.en: Let a man so account of us , as of the ministers of Christ , and stewards of the mysteries of God .

translation.kha: U Trai u noh , Ko paid Eliel , lada phi kwah ban wan phai , to wan blei noh shwa nga . Lada phi shylliah ha to bad weng noh ïa ki bleithaw kiba per ijli ,
translation.en: If thou wilt return , O Israel , saith the  Lord  , return unto me : and if thou wilt put away thine abominations out of my sight , then shalt thou not remove .

translation.kha: Te kumta kumno shaphang u briew , uta u kruiñ , uta u khring ? u briew u long aïu ha ki khmat U Balei ?
translation.en: How much less man , that is a worm ? and the son of man , which is a worm ?

translation.kha: Bad mynta nga kmen shaphang ki jingshahshitom jong nga na ka bynta jong phi , naba da ki jingshitrhem jyllang nga ha ka doh , nga ïaphah ban pyndep ïa katai kaba dang law na ki jingshahshitom jong U Khrismas na ka bynta ka balang , kaba erlangthari ka met jong u .
translation.en: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you , and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body s sake , which is the church :

translation.kha: Shahshkor ! ong U Josis . Nga wan kloi ! Suh kito kaba kohnguh ïa ki ktien ïathuh kiba hapoh kñia ka kitab !
translation.en: Behold , I come quickly : blessed is he that keepeth the sayings of the prophecy of this book .

translation.kha: Naba kiwei ki la ai ïa ki jingai sngewbha jong ki na katei kaba ki don , ïa-ban ym ktah ïa ka spah jong ki ; hynrei ma ka , ha ka jingduk jong ka , ka la ai ïa baher kaba ka donkam ïa lade .
translation.en: For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God : but she of her penury hath cast in all the living that she had .

translation.kha: U jubab ïa ki baroh ; ym Don kano kano kaba eh than kaba um lah ban batai .
translation.en: And Solomon told her all her questions : and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not .

translation.kha: U Peres u la ong ha ki , Ussi pa uwei na phi u dei ban phai noh! na ki pop jong u bad ba yn pynbaptis ha ka kyrthat jong U Jisu Khrist , khnang ba yn map ïa ki pop jong phi , bad phin ïohpdiang ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid babha long ka jingai jong U blem .
translation.en: Then Peter said unto them , Repent , and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins , and ye shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost .

translation.kha: U Aaron u dei ban phong ïa kane ka barandi ibha u shakri kum u lyngdoh . Haba u wan ha khmied jong nga ha ka Jaka kiba Kyntang , lane haba u mihngi nangta , yn ïohsngew ïa ka jingriew ki shakuriaw , bad un ym shah pynïap .
translation.en: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister : and his sound shall be heard when he goeth in unto the holy place before the  Lord  , and when he cometh out , that he die not .
And a certain man found him , and , behold , he was wandering in the field : and the man asked him , saying , What seekest thou ?
translation.kha: U Joseph u poi ha Shekhem bad katba u dang ïaid sakma kylleng ïa ka shnong ha kaba uwei u briew u ïohi ïa u bad u kylli ,  Phi wad ïano ?

translation.en: Divers weights are an abomination unto the  Lord   ; and a false balance is not good .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u isih ïa ki briew kiba pyndonkam da ki tarajur bad jingthew bymhok .
Ki ha ban sima sngewrit , hynrei wat ngeit ïa u , namar ka dohnud jong u ka dap haduh rymmiang da ka jingisih .
translation.en: When he speaketh fair , believe him not : for there are seven abominations in his heart .
That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God , even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: khnang ba ma phi baroh lang , phi lah ban ïaroh da kawei ka sur ïa U Blei bad U Kpa jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi .
Bad mynta nga kajuh ban pynkynmaw ïa phiah , ko parabangeit jong nga , ïa ka Khubor bakha kaba nga la ïalap ha phi , ïa kaba phi la pdiang , bad ha kaba ka jingngeit jongngi phoi ka ïeng skhem .
translation.en: Moreover , brethren , I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you , which also ye have received , and wherein ye stand ;
And it came to pass , when she came to him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field : and she lighted from off her ass  ; and Caleb said unto her , What wilt thou ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kyntiew kurim , u Othniel u kyntu ïa ka , ban pan lyngkha na u kpa jong ka . Ka la hiar na ka kada jong ka , bad u Kaleb u kylli ïa ka aïu ka kwah .

translation.en: For , behold , I will send serpents , cockatrices , among you , which will not be charmed , and they shall bite you , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Husiar !  U  Trai  u ong ,  nga phah ki bseiñ hapdeng jong phi , ki bseiñ don bih ki bym lah ban pynshohbieit , bad kin puh ïa phi .
Ka jingaiei ka Jong U Jisu Kherith uba U Trai jong ngi kan long lem bad phi . Amen .
translation.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you . Amen .

translation.kha: ha kaba u Sadok bad u Nathan ki dei ban pynsleh ïa u kum u syiem Israel . Nangta put ïa ka turoi bad pyrta , ‘ Im slem syiem Solomon !’
translation.en: And let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet anoint him there king over Israel : and blow ye with the trumpet , and say , God save king Solomon .

translation.kha: Haba ki khot ïa nga , ngan jubab ïa ki ; haba ki don ha ka jingjynjar , ngan long ryngkat bad ki . Ngan pyllait im ïa ki bad kun pyndonburom ïa ki .
translation.en: He shall call upon me , and I will answer him : I will be with him in trouble  ; I will deliver him , and honour him .
Surely he scorneth the scorners : but he giveth grace unto the lowly .
translation.kha: Um donkam ïa kiba sarong , hynrei u lehsbun ïa kito kiba sngewrit .

U la kylliang ïa nga , Amos , me ïuh une ? U Sawar , nga la jubab . Hangta u ong , Nga pyndonkam ïa u ban pyn-i ba ki briew jong nga ki long kum ka kynroh ka bym baïong sawar . Ngan ym kylla shuh la ka jingmut shaphang kaba pynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Amos , what seest thou ? And I said , A plumbline . Then said the Lord , Behold , I will set a plumbline in the midst of my people Israel : I will not again pass by them any more :

translation.kha: Ki briew jong nga ki la dih ïa ka khuid bakthang jong ka jingpynshitom ha u lut bakyntang jong nga . jynreiñ ki jaitbynriew ha baroh sawdong ngin dih ïa ka khuri kaba kham kthang jong ka jingpynshitom ; kin dih ïa ka baroh bad kin ja-um syndon .
translation.en: For as ye have drunk upon my holy mountain , so shall all the heathen drink continually , yea , they shall drink , and they shall swallow down , and they shall be as though they had not been .

translation.kha: Ki jingteh ki ïathuh kumno u la synshar , ïaheh katno u long uba khrawbor , bad ïa kiei keiñ baroh kiba la jia ha u , ha ki Israel , bad ha ki hima baroh naba marbl .
translation.en: With all his reign and his might , and the times that went over him , and over Israel , and over all the kingdoms of the countries .

translation.kha: U Jeroboam u long u samla uba dep shynrang , bad haba u Solomon u ïohi katno ba u long uba trei shitom , u buhai ïa u ban pynïaid ïa ki nongtrei ba shu pynshaitbor ha ka thain jong ki jait Manasseh bad Abraham .
translation.en: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour : and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious , he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph .

translation.kha: To phai sha u Trei , bad ai ba kane ka jingrwai kan long ka jingainguh shad u : To karta ïa ki pop jong i baroh bad pdiang ïa ki jingduwai jong ngi , bad ing ïaroh ïa me kumba ngi la kular .
translation.en: Take with you words , and turn to the  Lord  : say unto him , Take away all iniquity , and receive us graciously : so will we render the calves of our lips .

translation.kha: U Trai un pynong ba u pajwa un ïohsngew ïa ka jingbna wer wer ka pun pynlong ïa u ban leit phai pat sha la ka jong ka ri , bad U thri un shah ba yn pynkup ïa u hangta .
translation.en: Behold , I will send a blast upon him , and he shall hear a rumour , and return to his own land  ; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land .

translation.kha: Ki paidbah ki tang shu ïohi ïa ita u rishot lyoh ba u ïingjaiñ ha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ki dem khrup .
translation.en: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door : and all the people rose up and worshipped , every man in his tent door .

translation.kha: U la plie namar jong ngi ïa ka lyntang naba thymmai , ka lynti kaba im , lyngba Kata ka jingkit — kata ka long , lyngba ka met jong u hi .
translation.en: By a new and living way , which he hath consecrated for us , through the veil , that is to say , his flesh  ;

translation.kha: Ka sngi kan wan ha kaba yn pynkut ïa ka jingsarong ba kynja briew bad yn pynjot thiaw ïa ka jinglehniam ba kyntur briew . Nangta tong ïa U Trai hi yn kyntiew prum .
translation.en: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled , and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down , and the  Lord  alone shall be exalted in that day .

And Elijah said unto him , Tarry , I pray thee , here  ; for the  Lord  hath sent me to Jordan . And he said , As the  Lord  liveth , and as thy soul liveth , I will not leave thee . And they two went on .
translation.kha: Nangta u Elijah u ong ha u Elisha ,  Mynta ap hangne ; U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga ban leit sha ka wah Jordan .  Hynrei u Elisha u jubab ,  Nga smai da ka jingshaniah skhem jong nga ha U  Trai  bad ha phi ba ngan ym iehnoh ïa phi .  Kumta ki la leit ,

Ko ki paid ka Jerusalem , leit shabar ka nongbah bad Shna ka lynti na ka bynta u paidlang u shun wang phan ! Pynkhreh ïa ka lynti bah ; da pynsuhthied ïa ki maw kiba don ha ka ! To sieh ïa ka lama , khnang ba ki jaitbynriew kin tip .
translation.en: Go through , go through the gates  ; prepare ye the way of the people  ; cast up , cast up the highway  ; gather out the stones  ; lift up a standard for the people .

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por , ki shipai Israel kiba u Amasaïah um shym la shah ba kin leit sha ka thma nabar u ki la tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbam ka Judas sohpdung ka Samaria bad ka Beth Horon , ki la pyndap prie ïahiar ngut ki rangbah , bad ki la kurup shikhung ki mar lute .
translation.en: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back , that they should not go with him to battle , fell upon the cities of Judah , from Samaria even unto Beth–horon , and smote three thousand of them , and took much spoil .
And Aaron took as Moses commanded , and ran into the midst of the congregation  ; and , behold , the plague was begun among the people : and he put on incense , and made an atonement for the people .
translation.kha: U Aaron u la kohnguh , u la shim ïa la u khiew buh ding bad mareh sha pdeng ki briew ba la ïalumlang . Haba u ïohi ba ka khlam ka la lah sdang , u buh ïa ka jingiwbih ha uta u rnga ding bad u pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid na ka bynta uta u paidbah .

translation.en: And he brought Aaron s sons , and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear , and upon the thumbs of their right hands , and upon the great toes of their right feet : and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about .
translation.kha: Nangta u wanlam ïa ki khun shynrang u Aaron kham sha khmat bad u tah ïa kata ka snam ha ki shkor kamon jong ki , ha ki  tikmie ba sha kamon , bad ha ki  jatkmie ba sha kamon jong ki . Nangta u Moses u theh ïa ka snam kaba sah ha baroh sawdong ka duwan .

translation.en: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father , and said unto him , Let not the king sin against his servant , against David  ; because he hath not sinned against thee , and because his works have been to thee-ward very good :
translation.kha: U Jonathan u ïaroh ïa u Dabid ha u Saul bad u ong ,  Pa kynrad , wat leh bymdei ïa u shakri jong phi u Dabid . Um pat ju leh palat ïa phi ; ha kawei ka liang , kat kaba u la leh ka la long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa phi .
Te mynta ki paid Israel ki leit sha Bethel bad ki shong hangno ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Blei haduh janmiet . Ha ka sur kaba jam bad ha ka jingkthang ki ïalam sngewsih :
translation.en: And the people came to the house of God , and abode there till even before God , and lifted up their voices , and wept sore  ;
And the children of Israel again did evil in the sight of the  Lord  , when Ehud was dead .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u Ehud u la ïap , ki paid Israel ki leh pop biang pyrshah ïa U  Trai .
Ha ka jingim ba-ijli jong pha kum ka nuti pham ju kynum shisien shwa ïa la ka jingurlong khynnah — mynba phan long kaba lyngkhuit , bad ïaksaid ha la ka jong ka snam .
translation.en: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth , when thou wast naked and bare , and wast polluted in thy blood .

The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee  ; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet  ; and they shall call thee , The city of the  Lord  , The Zion of the Holy One of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong kito kiba la banbeiñ ïa pha kin sa wan ban dem khrup ban burom ïa pha . Baroh kito kiba la ju ibeiñ ïa pha kin dem ngon ha ki kjat jong pha . Kin khot ïa pha , ‘ Ka Nongbah U  Trai  ,’ ‘ Ka Seïon , ka nongbah U Blei U Bakhuid ki Israel .’
Naba U Khrist u la pynkut ïa ka Hukum , khnam ba uei uei baroh uba ngeit u don ka jingïadei bad U Blei .
translation.en: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth .

Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah , which they have done to provoke me to anger , they , their kings , their princes , their priests , and their prophets , and the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Nga la kut jingmut ban pynjot ïa ka namar baroh kaba sniew ba la leh da ki paid ka Judah bad ka Jerusalem , ryngkat bad ki syiem bad ki nongïalam jong ki , ki lyngdoh bad ki nongïathuhlypa jong ki .
Ki briew kiba bymman da shisha kim ïohnong ei ei , hynrei lada phi kuna ïa kaei kaba dei , ka pynbynta ba phin ïoh ïa ka bainong .
translation.en: The wicked worketh a deceitful work : but to him that soweth righteousness shall be a sure reward .

translation.kha: Nga la ong , Ngan ïatim sngewieit na ka bynta ki lumbah bad lip ummat na ka bynta ki jaka pynbamphlang , namar ki la tyrkhong , bad ym don mynshem mian ba leit jingleit lyngba jong ki . Ïa ka jingsam ki jingri ym shym ïohsngew shuh ; ki sih bad ki mradkhlaw ki la phet bad kim don shuh .
translation.en: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing , and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation , because they are burned up , so that none can pass through them  ; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle  ; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled  ; they are gone .
And Pharaoh commanded the same day the taskmasters of the people , and their officers , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka sngi , u Pharaoh u la hukum ïa ki nong Ijipt kiba pyntrei mraw bad ïa ki rangbah Israel kiba pynïaidkam :

translation.en: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the  Lord  their God from that day and forward .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kin tip naduh kata ba nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong ki .

dalade , kumno kumin , u nongbat u ïohi ïa u nongshun ba u wan bad um shitrhem put ïa ka turoi jingmaham , u nongshukor un wan bad un pyndap napoh ïa kita ki nongpop ; hynrei ngan pynkit pop ïa u nongjapan na ka bynta ka jingïap jong ki .
translation.en: But if the watchman see the sword come , and blow not the trumpet , and the people be not warned  ; if the sword come , and take any person from among them , he is taken away in his iniquity  ; but his blood will I require at the watchman s hand .

translation.kha: Ka buh ïa kata ka jingbam ha khmat u Saul bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ki ïabam . Nangta ki ïeng bad rupa noh ha sier hi ka miet .
translation.en: And she brought it before Saul , and before his servants  ; and they did eat . Then they rose up , and went away that night .

translation.kha: Nga tip ba Kiei kaei kaba U Blei u leh kan neh junom . kino haw ban bynrap ei ei ha ka lane shim noh ïa kano kano na ka . Bad kaweh kaba U balui u leh ka long ban pynlong ïa ngi ba ngin ha ka jingbuh ïa u .
translation.en: I know that , whatsoever God doeth , it shall be for ever : nothing can be put to it , nor any thing taken from it : and God doeth it , that men should fear before him .

translation.kha: Mano mano ba ïohi ïa u Lebiathan u ruh ka jingshlur bad u kyllon ha madan .
translation.en: Behold , the hope of him is in vain : shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him ?

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki la mihnoh na u Lum Hor na ka lyntang kaba poi sha ka khmut duriaw Akaba , ban ïasaid sawdong ïa ka ri Edom . Hynrei ha lynti kim la shah Shuah bad ki la kren pyrshah ïa U Blei bad ïa u Moses .
translation.en: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea , to compass the land of Edom : and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way .

translation.kha: U Jehoïada u buh ruh ki nongjapan phira ha ka kam ha ki khyrdop jong ka Templ ban khnang ïa uno uno u bymkut kat kum ka niam .
translation.en: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of the  Lord  , that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in .

Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben–hadad , Tell my lord the king , All that thou didst send for to thy servant at the first I will do : but this thing I may not do . And the messengers departed , and brought him word again .
translation.kha: Kumta u Ahab u jubab ha ki nonglamktien jong u Benhadad ,  Ïathuh ha u syiem u kynrad jong nga , ba nga mynjur ïa ka jingdawa kaba nyngkong jong u , hynrei ngam lah ban mynjur ïa kaba ar .  Ki nonglamktien ki leit noh bad nangta ki wan biang da kawei pat ka khubor na u Benhadad ;

Te U Trai u ong ha u Mesha , Elasah dang step , ithuh ïakynduh ïa u Pharaoh mala ïathuh ha u ba U Trai , U blei Jong ki Hebru , u ong , ‘ pyllait ïa ki briew jong nga , khnang ba ki lah ban mane ïa nga .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Rise up early in the morning , and stand before Pharaoh , and say unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  God of the Hebrews , Let my people go , that they may serve me .

translation.kha: Kumta uta u nonglamktien u la leit Sha u Dabid bad u la ïathuh ha u ïa kaei kambah u Joab u la hukum ïa u ban ong .
translation.en: So the messenger went , and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for .

translation.kha: U Trai u la thaw nyngkong eh ïa nga , kaba iing eh na ki kam jong u , la slem bah .
translation.en: The  Lord  possessed me in the beginning of his way , before his works of old .

translation.kha: Hobah u Serug u la dap laiphew snem ka rta , u la ïoh khunlung shynrang , u Nahor ;
translation.en: And Serug lived thirty years , and begat Nahor :

translation.kha: Ki khun ki lama kiba beh kupar lade ki don u kpa uba beit bad uba leh ïa kaei katba dei .
translation.en: The just man walketh in his integrity : his children are blessed after him .
And they called the name of that place Bochim : and they sacrificed there unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: bad dei namar kata keiñ ba ïa ka jaka la khot ka Bokhim . Hangta ki la ai jingkñia ha U  Trai .
Na suiñbneng me phah ïa u slap halor ki lum , bad ïa ka pyrthei la pyndap da ki jingkyrkhu jong me .
translation.en: He watereth the hills from his chambers : the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works .
Lo , this only have I found , that God hath made man upright  ; but they have sought out many inventions .
translation.kha: Kane ka long baroh kaba nga la tip : U Blei u la thaw ïa ngi kiba synlar , hynrei ngi la pynjyrthiaw shibun eh ïa lade .

Ko khum u briew , u la ong Ki brai kiba shong ha ki nongbah ba la pynring jong ka ri Israel ki ong : ‘ U Abraham u long tang uwei u briew , bad u la ïoh ïa ka ri baroh kawei . Ngi ïadon bun ngut , kumta mynnin ka ri ka dei ka jong ngi .’
translation.en: Son of man , they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak , saying , Abraham was one , and he inherited the land : but we are many  ; the land is given us for inheritance .

translation.kha: Hynrei Ladan ngi phla ïa ki pop jong ngi ha U Blei , un bat ïa la ka kular bad un leh ïa kaei kiba dei : Un map ïa ngi ïa ki Pop jngai i bad un pynkhuid ïa sem na ki ki bymman baroh .
translation.en: If we confess our sins , he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins , and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness .

translation.kha: thaba ka ktien ka la poi ha u syiem ka Judah ba ki kynhun shipai ka Syria ki la da don hapoh ka ri Israel , ma u Bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la sngewshyrkhei shikatdei ha kaba ki la khñiot kum ki dieng ba la pynkhih da ka lyer .
translation.en: And it was told the house of David , saying , Syria is confederate with Ephraim . And his heart was moved , and the heart of his people , as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind .

translation.kha: Kumta ngiam leh sahnar shaphang ka kam kaba kiwei ki la leh Palat shabar u pud ïa uba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta jong ngi . Pynban , ngi kyrmen ba ka jingngeit jong phi ka nang syang bad ba ngi lah ban leh ïa ka kam kaba kham khraw sohpdung jong phi , barabor hapoh ki pud ba U Blei u la buh na ka bynta jong ngi .
translation.en: Not boasting of things without our measure , that is , of other men s labours ; but having hope , when your faith is increased , that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly ,

translation.kha: U Korah u khun jong u Assir na ka jait Lebi jong u Kohath , u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jingïalam jong u Moses . La ïan ïasoh lem bad u da la ngut ki dkhot na ka jwat ribon — u Dathan bad u Abram , ki khun shynrang jong u Eliab , bad u On u khun jong u Peleth — bad da ki arspah sanphew ngut kiwei patiaw ki rangbah Israel , ki nongïalam uba lamkhmat ba la jied da ka kynoi .
translation.en: And they rose up before Moses , with certain of the children of Israel , two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly , famous in the congregation , men of renown :
And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another , saying , Let us go speedily to pray before the  Lord  , and to seek the  Lord  of hosts : I will go also .
translation.kha: Kito kiba na kawei ka nongbah kin ong ha kito kiba na kawei pat , ‘ Ngi leit ban mane ïa U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh bad ban duwai na ka bynta ka jingkyrkhu jong u . To wan bad ngi !’

translation.en: And Shimei arose , and saddled his ass , and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants : and Shimei went , and brought his servants from Gath .
translation.kha: Haba u Shimei u ïohsngew ba ki don ha Gath , u la teh jin ïa la ka kada bad u la leit sha u Syiem Akhish ha Gath , ban wad ïa la ki mraw . U la lap ïa ki bad u wan ïalam pat ïa ki sha ïing .
U Moses u ai ïa ki hukum bad ki jingsuki jongno U Bel ha ki Jesreel .
translation.en: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel :

translation.kha: Ki la pynap ïa ka jaiñkup bakhatduh ha U Jisu , ki la jingaiti ïa ka pansngiat na ki tnat ba ne thiah , bad pynphong ïa ka ha ka khleiñ jong u .
translation.en: And they clothed him with purple , and platted a crown of thorns , and put it about his head ,

translation.kha: To lyngkar da ka jingsngewsih , phi ki briew ka Phoenisia ! pyrshah ban phet ïap shai Spain !
translation.en: Pass ye over to Tarshish  ; howl , ye inhabitants of the isle .
And if the man have none to redeem it , and himself be able to redeem it  ;
translation.kha: U briew u bym don ba-ha-ïing ban thied pat ïa ka , hadien habud haba u la manbha bad dap biang u lah ban thied pat ïa ka da lade .
Ki Israel ki la leh ïa kiei kiei kiba U Trai U Blei lad ki um sngewngiah ïa kita . Ki tei ïa ki jaka mane plie thala ha ki shnong bhor , nongdih ka shong barim eh haduh ki nongbah baheh tam .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the  Lord  their God , and they built them high places in all their cities , from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city .

translation.kha: wat ynda phi la ïoh ban bam kat ïa kaba phi kiaw bad tei la ki ïing kiba itynnat ïa-ban shong ,
translation.en: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full , and hast built goodly houses , and dwelt therein  ;

translation.kha: Nangta de ong ha u Joshua , ‘ Me la ïohi ïa kata baïar kaba U Terah U Blei jong me u la leh ïa Kito ki ar nud ki syiem , u Sihon bad u Og ; un leh kumjuh ïa ine barhem ïa kiba men dang hiarthma ha ka ri jong ki .
translation.en: And I commanded Joshua at that time , saying , Thine eyes have seen all that the  Lord  your God hath done unto these two kings : so shall the  Lord  do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest .
Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did , and his might that he shewed , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Omri u la leh bad baroh ki jingjop jong u la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
U Jakob u jubab , Ngan ai ïa ka lada phira ai suk ha nga ïa ki khah jong phi kum u khun nyngkong .
translation.en: And Jacob said , Sell me this day thy birthright .

translation.kha: Ussaïah na ki , uba kyrteng u Agabos , u la ïohnang joit dara da ka bor jong U Mynsiem u la ïathuh lypa ba ka nemsniew bajur kan sa wan ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei . ( Ka la wang jia mynba u khlad u la long u Patsha . )
translation.en: And there stood up one of them named Agabus , and signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth throughout all the world : which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar .

translation.kha: Sah ha kata kajuh ka ïing , bam bad theh ïa kano kano kaba ki ai ïa phi , uba u nongtrei u dadien shun ïoh ïa ka tieng jongnga u . Wat leit sawdong na kawei ka ïing sha kawei patar .
translation.en: And in the same house remain , eating and drinking such things as they give : for the labourer is worthy of his hire . Go not from house to house .

translation.kha: U syiem Jeshaïah u sngewthuh ïa kano ba ka mut ba tista don ka jingsuk bad jingsngewbiang shi jingim jong u , kumin u jubab , Ka khubor ba me la ai ïa sa na U Trai ka longsem Kaba bha .
translation.en: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah , Good is the word of the  Lord  which thou hast spoken . And he said , Is it not good , if peace and truth be in my days ?

translation.kha: Nangta ki ïa-pyrkhat , Ka Jingkhawai Niam kaba syier shisnem ha U Trai ha Shiloh shen ka la wan poi . ( Ka Sillah ka don shatei na Bethlehem , shathie na Lehsbun , bad sha mih na ka lynti bah khappud ka Bethel bad ka Shekhem . )
translation.en: Then they said , Behold , there is a feast of the  Lord  in Shiloh yearly in a place which is on the north side of Beth–el , on the east side of the highway that goeth up from Beth–el to Shechem , and on the south of Lebonah .

And the king said unto Ziba , What meanest thou by these ? And Ziba said , The asses be for the king s household to ride on  ; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat  ; and the wine , that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u kylli ïa u ,  Men leh aïu ïa kine katne katne ?  U Siba u jubab ,  Ki kada ki dei na ka bynta ki ba-ha-ïing jong u Syiem Kynrad ban shong , u kpu bad u soh ki dei na ka bynta ki rangbah jong phi ban bam , bad ka waiñ ka dei na ka bynta jong ki ban dih haba ki la thait ha ka ri khlaw .

translation.en: Behold , the days come , that I will cut off thine arm , and the arm of thy father s house , that there shall not be an old man in thine house .
translation.kha: Ha sngap , ka por kan poi ha kaba ngan pynïap lut ïa ki samla shynrang baroh kiba na ka longïing jong me bad na ka kur jong me , kumta ba yn ym don uwei ruh u briew u ban im tymmen ha ka ïing jong me .
Ka por kaba dei ka la poi , u ïong , bad ka Hima U Blei ka la hajan ! To phai noh na ki jop jrong phi malade ngeit ïa ka khur Babha !
translation.en: And saying ,  The time is fulfilled , and the kingdom of God is at hand : repent ye , and believe the gospel .

translation.kha: nangta wat ki rangbah kiba shlur tam , ki bym ju tieng khim ki sing , kin sheptieng Namarba eiei pa uwei ha Israel u tip ba u kpa jong phi u de u shipai bakhrawbor bad ba ki rangbah jong u ki de ki nongïaleh kiba satar .
translation.en: And he also that is valiant , whose heart is as the heart of a lion , shall utterly melt : for all Israel knoweth that thy father is a mighty man , and they which be with him are valiant men .

translation.kha: Ki khmat ki long kum ka shalor ïa ka met . Lydda ki khmat jong phi ki bha , ka met jong phi baroh kawei sa ïap da ka jingshai ;
translation.en: The light of the body is the eye : if therefore thine eye be single , thy whole body shall be full of light .

translation.kha: Balei ba phi khmih ïa u thiat ha ka khnam jongngi u para jong phi! , hynrei phim pynshongdor jingmut ïa ka lyngkhot dieng ha ka khmih jong phi ?
translation.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother s eye , but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?

translation.kha: Hynrei u briew uba la shongkurim u pyrkhat kiei kiei kiba kynja pyrthei , kumno ba un pynsngewbha ïa la ka tnga .
translation.en: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world , how he may please his wife .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah jong u Joab ki la ïohsngew ba u Sheba u don hangta , pynlang kumta ki la loit ban khot ïa ka nongbah . Ki tei ka kynton stong marpyrshah ïa ka kynroh kaweh phai shabar bad ki la sdang ruh ban tih sha trai ka kynroh ban pynkhyllem ïa ka .
translation.en: And they came and besieged him in Abel of Beth–maachah , and they cast up a bank against the city , and it stood in the trench : and all the people that were with Joab battered the wall , to throw it down .

And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle , and the fruit of thy land , until thou be destroyed : which also shall not leave thee either corn , wine , or oil , or the increase of thy kine , or flocks of thy sheep , until he have destroyed thee .
translation.kha: Kin bam ïa ki jingri jingdup bad ïa ki jingthung jingtep jong phi , bad phin ïapthngan . Kin ym pynsah ei ei , ïa u kew , ka waiñ , ka umphniang Olib , ki masi , lane ki langbrot ; bad phin ïap .
Hadien kane ang la ïohi ïa ka templ ha bneng ba ka plie , lem bad ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U Blei hapoh jong ka .
translation.en: And after that I looked , and , behold , the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened :

translation.kha: Ka lawar ding ka klang rhem bha , hynrei ka eitnar kam um bad ka tuid nala . Ka long ka bymmyntoi ban ïai phrang ïa ki bri jong nga , namar ïa kito kiba sniew ym shym la wiang noh .
translation.en: The bellows are burned , the lead is consumed of the fire  ; the founder melteth in vain : for the wicked are not plucked away .

translation.kha: Kauda ka khubor ïa Kaba la pynbna da ki angel ha ki kpa tymmen jngai ngi ka long Kaba shisha , bad uno uno u bym shym bud ïa ka lane u i shym kohnguh ïa ka u shah pynshitom kamra ka dei hok ïa u .
translation.en: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast , and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward  ;

And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour : and he made himself treasuries for silver , and for gold , and for precious stones , and for spices , and for shields , and for all manner of pleasant jewels  ;
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah u la kylla riewspah bha , bad uwei pa uwei u burom ïa u . U don ki kamra kynshew ba la shna na ka bynta ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawkordor , ki musla , ki stieh , bad kiwei ki tiar baremdor jong u .

translation.en: When they have a matter , they come unto me  ; and I judge between one and another , and I do make them know the statutes of God , and his laws .
translation.kha: Haba don kano kano ka jingïakajia hapdeng ar ngut , ki wan sha nga , nga hap ban bishar bad rai mano na ki uba dei , bad nga ïathuh ha ki ïa ki hukum bad ki aiñ U Blei ki ong .
Ki nongïalam jong u paidïapom kin sangeh ne na kaba kren ;
translation.en: The princes refrained talking , and laid their hand on their mouth .

translation.kha: Ha sakma ka na , u khun uba la khap ha ka rukom briew u la pynshitom beiñ ïa uta uba la kha namar U Mynsiem U Blei ; bad ka long kum mynnin .
translation.en: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit , even so it is now .

translation.kha: Em , ka long pynban da ka kun ka jong U Blei ba de beh noh ïa ki ksuid , bad kane ka pynjia ba ka Hima jong U Balei ka la da wan ha phi .
translation.en: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils , no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you .

translation.kha: Ki ïa-lorni bad kren sniew uwei ïa uwei patiaw ; ki long kiba shun ïa U Blei , kiba pynbitar , uba sarong nabar kiba sngewmeng ; ki pynkoit ïa kiba pung ki lynti ban leh ïa kaba sniew ; Kim kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki kpa ;
translation.en: Backbiters , haters of God , despiteful , proud , boasters , inventors of evil things , disobedient to parents ,

translation.kha: Ka jingim jong uwei pa uwei u jingthiah uba im ka don ha ka snam , malu de namar kata ba U Trai u la ong ha ki paidbah Jerusalem’ ba kam dei ban bam ïa kano kano ka doh kaba sdang don snam ha ka , bad ba ïa uno uno uba leh kumta yn ym ñiew shuh ïa u Kum uwei na ki briew Jong U Blei .
translation.en: For it is the life of all flesh  ; the blood of it is for the life thereof : therefore I said unto the children of Israel , Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh : for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof : whosoever eateth it shall be cut off .
And he made staves of shittim wood , and overlaid them with gold .
translation.kha: U thaw ïa ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia , u suit ïa ki da ka ksiar ,
U Trai u sngewbha ïa ki briew kiba bha , hynrei u pynrem ïa kito kiba thmu sniew .
translation.en: A good man obtaineth favour of the  Lord  : but a man of wicked devices will he condemn .
And the blind and the lame came to him in the temple  ; and he healed them .
translation.kha: Kiba matlah bad kiba dkoh ki la wan sha u ha ka Templ , bad u la pynkhiah ïa ki .

translation.en: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus , and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead , thou shalt be saved .
translation.kha: Lada phi phla ba U Jisu u long U Trai bad ngeit ba U Blei u la pynmihpat ïa u na ka jingïap , phin lait im .
U ong ha nga , Ka jingpynduh kan thnam na ka phang bashatei halor barben kiba shnong basah ha kane ka ri ,
translation.en: Then the  Lord  said unto me , Out of the north an evil shall break forth upon all the inhabitants of the land .

translation.kha: Naba uno uno uba kwah ban pynni ïa la ka jong ka jingtim un duh noh ïa ka , hynrei uno uno uba haw ïa ka jingim na ka pyntha jong na un pynim ïa ka .
translation.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it : but whosoever will lose his life for my sake , the same shall save it .

Wherefore our elders and all the inhabitants of our country spake to us , saying , Take victuals with you for the journey , and go to meet them , and say unto them , We are your servants : therefore now make ye a league with us .
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ngi bad ki briew baroh kiba shong ha ka ri jong ngi ki ong ïa ngi ban khreh katto katne ka jingbam na ka bynta ka jingleit bad ban leit ïakynduh ïa phi . La ong ba ngi dei ban buh ïa lade ban shakri ïa phi bad ban kyrpad ïa phi ban ïateh lok bad ngi .
Kumba ka Jingthoh bakhatduh ka ong , Na ka bynta jong ph ngi la longkmie ha ka jingma jong ka jingïap ha ki por baroh ; la ai ïa ngi kum ïa ki lanot ba la ïasam sha ka jingpynïap .
translation.en: As it is written , For thy sake we are killed all the day long ; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter .

translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u la wanlam bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga la kamai shiphew tylli ki sbai ksiar da katai ka me la ai ha nga .’
translation.en: Then came the first , saying , Lord , thy pound hath gained ten pounds .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , ki rangbah kur , ryngkat bad ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi , ki leit sha u Esra ban pule bniah ïa ka jinghikai jongno ka Hukum .
translation.en: And on the second day were gathered together the chief of the fathers of all the people , the priests , and the Levites , unto Ezra the scribe , even to understand the words of the law .

translation.kha: Na kata u suh sha ki umpohliew ka Nephtoah bad mih shad ki nongbah hajan u Lus Ephron . Hangta u phai sha Baalah ( lane Kiriath Joram )
translation.en: And the border was drawn from the top of the hill unto the fountain of the water of Nephtoah , and went out to the cities of mount Ephron  ; and the border was drawn to Baalah , which is Kirjath–jearim :
All my state shall Tychicus declare unto you , who is a beloved brother , and a faithful minister and fellowservant in the Lord :
translation.kha: U para ba-ieit jong ngi u Tukhikos , u nongtrei uba lah ban shaniah bad u para shakri ha ka kam jong U Trai , un sa ai ïa phi ka khubor baroh shaphang jong nga .

translation.en: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered mortar , and bring it down to the ground , so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered , and it shall fall , and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga thmu ban pynkhyllem ïa ka kynroh ba la pushara lieh , ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ka , bad ban pynpaw shabar ïa ki maw nongrim . Kan khyllem bad pynïap ïa phi baroh . Te uwei uwei baroh un tip ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And the child Samuel grew on , and was in favour both with the  Lord  , and also with men .
translation.kha: Uta u khynnah Samuel , u nang san bad u nang shem ïa ka jingsngewbha na U  Trai  bad na ki briew .
Da shisha phin kop ba don shikhung ki nongïamareh katba ïashim bynshet ha ka jingmareh thong , hynriewphew tang uwei na ki u ïoh ïa ka prais . Kumta to mareh ha kata ka man ban ïoh ïa ka prais .
translation.en: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all , but one receiveth the prize ? So run , that ye may obtain .

And it came to pass , when Ben–hadad heard this message , as he was drinking , he and the kings in the pavilions , that he said unto his servants , Set yourselves in array . And they set themselves in array against the city .
translation.kha: U Benhadad u la ïohpdiang ïa ka jubab u Ahab katba ma u bad kiba ïateh lok bad u , kiwei pat ki nongsynshar , ki dang ïadih ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki . U la hukum ïa ki rangbah jong u ban pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ka nongbah , kumta ki ïeng ha la ki jaka jaka .
Hato ja u dei u khun jong Phi ? Phi ong ba la kha matlah ïa u ; te kum pat mynta u la imat ?
translation.en: And they asked them , saying , Is this your son , who ye say was born blind ? how then doth he now see ?
Now we command you , brethren , in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ , that ye withdraw yourselves from every brother that walketh disorderly , and not after the tradition which he received of us .
translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong ngi , ngi hukum ïa phi ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi ban kiar noh na ki bangeit baroh kiba im ka jingim bajaipdeh bad ki bym bud ïa ki jingbthah kiba ngi ai ha ki .

Nangta ki phah wallam ïa u syiem Hesekaïah , bad ki ut ngut ki rangbah synshar ki leit ban ïatyngkhuh ïa ki : u Abimelekh u khun jong u Hilkaïah , uba dei peit ïa ka ïingsyiem ; u Shebna , u rep ka jingsyier ; bad u Joah u khun jongngi u Akhshaph , uba dei peit ïa ki jingbang jingthoh .
translation.en: And when they had called to the king , there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah , which was over the household , and Shebna the scribe , and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder .
So Jonah went out of the city , and sat on the east side of the city , and there made him a booth , and sat under it in the shadow , till he might see what would become of the city .
translation.kha: U Jonah u la mih bad leit shaphang mihngi jong ka nongbah bad u la shong hangta . U la shna ka jakarieh tngen ïa lade bad shong ha ka syrngiew jong ka , da kaba ap ban khmih kaei ka ban jia ïa ka Ninebeh .

translation.en: The word which came unto Jeremiah from the  Lord  in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah , saying ,
translation.kha: Mynba u Jehoïakim u khun jong u Josaïah u long u syiem ka Judah , U  Trai  u la ong ha nga .
Kane ka Long ka jutang ïa kaba ngan Pynlong bad ki , ha ki sngi ki ban sa wan , ong U Trai : Ngan buh ïa ki hukum jongki nga hapoh ki dohnud jong ki bad thoh ïa ki ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong ki .
translation.en: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days , saith the Lord , I will put my laws into their hearts , and in their minds will I write them  ;
This I say then , Walk in the Spirit , and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh .
translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba nga ong : Shah ïa U Mynsiem ba un pynïaid ïa ki jingim jong phi , bad phin ym pynhun ïa ki jingkwah brai jong ka doh .

translation.en: Woe unto you , ye blind guides , which say , Whosoever shall swear by the temple , it is nothing  ; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple , he is a debtor !
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonglam lynti kiba matlah ! Phi hikai , ‘ Lada uno uno u smai da ka Templ , ïa u ym shym la teh da ka jingsmai jong u ; hynrei lada u smai da ka ksiar hapoh ka Templ , u long uba la shah teh .’

Ki paid Jeraïah ki la tei ïa ki ïingsyiem , hynrei ki la kliang ïa la U Nongthaw . Ki paid Judah ki la tei ïa ki nongbam ba la ker kynroh . Hynriew lang phah da ka tdong ka ngab thang duh ïa ki ïingsyiem bad ki nongbam jong ki .
translation.en: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker , and buildeth temples  ; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities : but I will send a fire upon his cities , and it shall devour the palaces thereof .

translation.kha: U Elijah u hukum bad ong , Kem ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal ; ki ai ba uno uno na ki un lait phet ! Ki paidbah ki la kem ïa ki borbah , bad u Elisha u la ïalam ïa ki sha ka heh Shisien bad pynsep ïa ki .
translation.en: And Elijah said unto them , Take the prophets of Baal  ; let not one of them escape . And they took them : and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon , and slew them there .

translation.kha: U Terah , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong ha nga , Ko Jeroboam , ki briew ki ïa-ong ba ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka Jingpang kin pyningkhong ïa Kane ka nongbah ban thap ha ki kti jong u syiem ka Babilonia . Mynta , to shahshkor ïa kaei de kaba to don ban ong .
translation.en: And now therefore thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , concerning this city , whereof ye say , It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword , and by the famine , and by the pestilence  ;

translation.kha: Naba u khup ba U Blang u ai u long utai uba waiñ hiar na bneng bad kaba ai jingim ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: For the bread of God is he which cometh down from heaven , and giveth life unto the world .
