translation.kha: Hynrei u Jephthah u ong ha ki , Ma nga bad ki briew jong nga ngi don ka jingïakajia kaba jur bad ki Ammon . (Nga la khot ïa phi , hynrei phim shym la wan phlait ïa nga na ki .
translation.en: And Jephthah said unto them , I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon  ; and when I called you , ye delivered me not out of their hands .

translation.kha: Ïa phi! baroh yn pynjahburom — ma phi babha noh ba u dieng u dei u kpa jong phi bad ba u mawsiang u dei ka kiei jong phin . Kane kad jia namar ba phi la phai nong na nga ha ka jaka ba phna phai sha nga . Hynrei haba phi ni ha ka jingjop , phi kyrpad ïa nga ban waiñ badno pyndam ïa phi .
translation.en: Saying to a stock , Thou art my father  ; and to a stone , Thou hast brought me forth : for they have turned their back unto me , and not their face : but in the time of their trouble they will say , Arise , and save us .

translation.kha: kiwei pat ki jam ïa ka wah Jordan Sha ki ri Gad bad Gilead . U Saul u dang don ha Gilgal , bad ki brisoh bakha bad u ki la khynñiat da ka jingsheptieng .
translation.en: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead . As for Saul , he was yet in Gilgal , and all the people followed him trembling .
And all flesh shall see the salvation of God .
translation.kha: U khunbynriew baroh u dei ban ïohi ïa ka jingpynim ka jong U Blei !’
Uba rangbah duh na ki Libya u dadien u Eleasar u khun jong u Aaron babha longïng lyngngeit . U dei uba khmih ïa kito kiba pyndep ïa ki kamram ha ka Jaka Kyntang .
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them , every one that entereth into the service , to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation .
Pilate answered , Am I a Jew ? Thine own nation and the chief priests have delivered thee unto me : what hast thou done ?
translation.kha: U Pilat u la phai ktien ,  Me tharai nga dei u Jiw ? Dei ki briew jong me hi bad ki rangbah lyngdoh kiba la aiti ïa me sha nga . Kaei kaba me la leh ?
Phi sleit ïa ki jingiwbih bad ki kynja jingsleh , bad leit ban mane ïa u blei mohkhiew . Ban lap ïa ki Blei ban mane phi la phah ïa ki nongsyntiat sha jngai bah , wat shaduh ka pyrta kiba ïap .
translation.en: And thou wentest to the king with ointment , and didst increase thy perfumes , and didst send thy messengers far off , and didst debase thyself even unto hell .

translation.kha: Nongthaw khie leit bun shim ïa u khum masi uba la pynshongduh bha bad pynïap ïa u , bad to ngin ïalehkmen da ka jingkhawai !
translation.en: And bring hither the fatted calf , and kill it  ; and let us eat , and be merry :

translation.kha: Hangta u Abner u thut ïa u Ishbosheth kum u syiem jong ki ri ha Gilead , Asher , Jesreel , Ephraim , bad Bneng , bad pahara halor ka Israhaïah bhor kawei .
translation.en: And made him king over Gilead , and over the Ashurites , and over Jezreel , and over Ephraim , and over Benjamin , and over all Israel .

translation.kha: Titos badonbor : Ha ka kitab banyngkong jong nga , nga la thoh shaphang kiei kiei baroh kiba U Jisu u la leh dara hikai nadong ka por ba u la sdang ïa ka jingtrei jongki u tad haduh ka snieh ha katba la shngiam noh ïa u sha bneng .
translation.en: The former treatise have I made , O Theophilus , of all that Jesus began both to do and teach ,

And Rebekah said to Isaac , I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth : if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth , such as these which are of the daughters of the land , what good shall my life do me ?
translation.kha: Ka Rebekka ka ong ha u Isaak ,  Nga la sngewngiah bad sngewthait ïa ki tnga nongwei jong u Iso . Lada u Jakob ruh u shongkurim ïa kawei na kine ki nong Hit , nga lah ban sa shu ïap noh ruh .
Ki maïan , ki Amalek , bad ki jaitbynriew ka ri shyiap ki la saphriang ha ka them kum ka kynhun ki puit , bad ki la Don bun bah ki ut kat ki symboh shyiap ka rud duriaw .
translation.en: And the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the children of the east lay along in the valley like grasshoppers for multitude  ; and their camels were without number , as the sand by the sea side for multitude .

translation.kha: Phi pyrkhat ba phi kham bha ban ïa nga bad phi ñiew ïa ki jingeh jong nga kumne ka jingpynshisha ïa ka jingkitpop jongngi sa .
translation.en: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me , and plead against me my reproach :

translation.kha: Haba nga leh ban da ïa la ka burom , ma phi ki Jeraïah phira tip ba nga long U Trai , namar ngam shyiap leh ïa phi katei kum ki jingbymman jong phi , ki jingleh basniew kiba ph dei hok don ïoh . U Trai Nongsynshar u la kren .
translation.en: And ye shall know that I am the  Lord  , when I have wrought with you for my name s sake , not according to your wicked ways , nor according to your corrupt doings , O ye house of Israel , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Khie leit shuh ki paramarjan Jong phi bad pan kylliang bun tylli ki khra thylli kat naba Phin lah ban ïoh , u Elisha u la ong ha ka .
translation.en: Then he said , Go , borrow thee vessels abroad of all thy neighbours , even empty vessels  ; borrow not a few .

And said unto me , Behold , I will make thee fruitful , and multiply thee , and I will make of thee a multitude of people  ; and will give this land to thy seed after thee for an everlasting possession .
translation.kha: U la ong ha nga , ‘ Ngan ai ha me bun ki khun ki ksiew ba kumta ki nongmih pateng jong me kin sa long ki jaitbynriew kiba bun . Ngan ai ïa kane ka ri ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me ba kan long ka ri kynti jong ki junom .’
Hato me don jingtip haduh katto ka heh ka pyrem ? To jubab ïa nga lada me tip .
translation.en: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth ? declare if thou knowest it all .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la duwai , A Trai , me tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jong uwei pa uwei , kumta pyn-i ha ngi uno na kine ar ngut uba me la jingdih
translation.en: And they prayed , and said , Thou , Lord , which knowest the hearts of all men , shew whether of these two thou hast chosen ,

translation.kha: Pynthikna ba yn ym don hangne mynta ka sngi uba ïohsngew ïa ki kti jongngi kane ka jutang , pynban Uba pynngeit ïa lade ba kaei kaei kan ym jied ïa u wat la u ïadat mon da ka dohnud kaba mutlop . Ka jingmih na “kata kan long ba pa’ baroh phin jot thiaw , kiba bha bad kiba snieh kumjuh .
translation.en: And it come to pass , when he heareth the words of this curse , that he bless himself in his heart , saying , I shall have peace , though I walk in the imagination of mine heart , to add drunkenness to thirst :

translation.kha: Te nga la dep shang ïa ka jingpynjot bad jingpynpra ïa phi namar ki pop jong phi .
translation.en: Therefore also will I make thee sick in smiting thee , in making thee desolate because of thy sins .

translation.kha: U la ïa-ong ha lade” , Kumba kiei kiei ki long mynta , lada ki biria jong nga ki kitei sha Jerahmeel bad ban kñia ïa ki jingainguh sha U Trai ha ka paila kiba don hangta , kin pynkynmaw ka jingnguh syier na nga sha u Rehoboam u syiem ka Judah bad kmen sa pynïap ïa nga .
translation.en: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of the  Lord  at Jerusalem , then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord , even unto Rehoboam king of Judah , and they shall kill me , and go again to Rehoboam king of Judah .

translation.kha: U Jehoïada u buh ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi don peit ïa ka kam ha ka Templ . Ki dei ban pynïap ïa ki kamram kiba la bynshet ha ki da u syiem Dabid sad ban thang ïa ki jingkñia ibha la ai shad U Trai kat kumin ka Aiñ u Moses . Ki la peit ruh ïa ka jingput jingtem bad ïa ka jinglehniam .
translation.en: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of the  Lord  by the hand of the priests the Levites , whom David had distributed in the house of the  Lord  , to offer the burnt offerings of the  Lord  , as it is written in the law of Moses , with rejoicing and with singing , as it was ordained by David .

translation.kha: U briew uba buhrieh ïa la ka jingshun u dei uba lamler . Uno uno uba pynphriang ïa ka jinglorni u dei uba bieit .
translation.en: He that hideth hatred with lying lips , and he that uttereth a slander , is a fool .

translation.kha: Ka la erlangthari ka mane jong me bad ka jingimat jong me , ban leh ïa kane ; me la leh ïa kino kiei ki kiba khrawbor khnang ban hikai ïa at .
translation.en: For thy word s sake , and according to thine own heart , hast thou done all these great things , to make thy servant know them .

translation.kha: ban ai ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ha ki Israel . Wallam ha u Moses bad u Sharon kawei ka maw lud rong saw ka i kein kano kano ka jingduna bad ïa kaba ym pat shym la pyntreikam ,
translation.en: This is the ordinance of the law which the  Lord  hath commanded , saying , Speak unto the children of Israel , that they bring thee a red heifer without spot , wherein is no blemish , and upon which never came yoke :
Hear counsel , and receive instruction , that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end .
translation.kha: Lada phi shahshkor ïa ka jingai jingmut bad phi kloi ban shah hikai , ha kawei ka sngi phin long uba stad .
Bad u pud un bteng nangta na sepngi shaduh u lum Gareb pynlang nongap sawdong sha Goah .
translation.en: And the measuring line shall yet go forth over against it upon the hill Gareb , and shall compass about to Goath .

translation.kha: Kuth ka khubor ka la pur hapdeng ki nongbud jongu U Jisu ba une u synran un ym ïap . Hynrei U Jingsuk um shym ong ba un ym ïap ; u la ong , Lada nga niam ïa u ba un im haka ynda nga wang , ka pher aïu ïa me ?
translation.en: Then went this saying abroad among the brethren , that that disciple should not die : yet Jesus said not unto him , He shall not die  ; but ,  If I will that he tarry till I come , what is that to thee ?

translation.kha: Don shibun ki kamra ha ka ïing U Kpa jngai nga , bad ngan leit ban pynkhreh ka jaka ïa phi . Ngan ym jin da la ïatyngkhuh ïa phi lada kam long kumta .
translation.en: In my Father s house are many mansions : if it were not so , I would have told you . I go to prepare a place for you .

translation.kha: U la ïa-ong ïa ar to bthuh ïa ki jaiñ rim ha ki ksang ti lad nga , khnang ba ki tyllai kin ym pynmynsaw ïa nga .
translation.en: And Ebed–melech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah , Put now these old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords . And Jeremiah did so .

translation.kha: ki la ïabam ïa Baroh ki jingthung ha ka ri ; bad ki la ïabam ïa baroh ki jingthung ba long jingbam .
translation.en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land , and devoured the fruit of their ground .

translation.kha: Kumta ki Midian ki la shahjop ha ki Jerusalem’ bad kim shym long shuh ka jingma ïa ki . Ka ri ka la don ha ka jingsuk haduh sawphew snem , haduh ba u Gideon u ïap .
translation.en: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel , so that they lifted up their heads no more . And the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon .
Declare ye in Egypt , and publish in Migdol , and publish in Memphis and in Tahpanhes : say ye , Stand fast , and prepare thee  ; for the sword shall devour round about thee .
translation.kha: Pynbna ïa ka ha ki shnong jong ka Ijipt , ha Migdol , Memphis , bad Tahpanhes : ‘ To pynkhreh ban ïada ïa lade ; ïa kiei kiei kiba phi don yn pynjot ha ka thma !

Nga ngan ïeng ha khmat jong me ha u mawsiang ha u Lum Sinai . Tied ïa u mawsiang ; te ka um kan sa mih na u ba u paidbah un ïew dkhoh . U Moses u leh kumjuh ha ka jingdon thang ki nongïalam jong ki Israel .
translation.en: Behold , I will stand before thee there upon the rock in Horeb  ; and thou shalt smite the rock , and there shall come water out of it , that the people may drink . And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Israel .

translation.kha: Ainguh ïa ka jingainguh bam da u purew ba la khleh bad ka bymshemphang Olib : lai kilo u purew lak bad u masi lyngkhot , sa ar kyllon u purew lem bad u langbrot ,
translation.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil , three tenth deals for a bullock , and two tenth deals for a ram ,

translation.kha: Kaba mih na kaei ba ki apostol ki la leh , ka long ba ïa ki briew kiba pang la Rah sha ki lynti bah bad la buh ha ki jingthiah bad ki shylliah khang ba la kumno kumno ka syrngiew jong u Petros kan dei ha ki katto kattne ngut na ki katba u tang ïaid pun .
translation.en: Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets , and laid them on beds and couches , that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them .
His brethren therefore said unto him , Depart hence , and go into Judaea , that thy disciples also may see the works that thou doest .
translation.kha: Ka por jong ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep ka la jan , kumta ki para shynrang jong U Jisu ki la ong ïa u ,  To mihnoh na kane ka jaka bad leit sha Judia , ba ki nongbud jong me kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba me leh .

translation.en: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume .
translation.kha: Ki khñiang kin bam duh ïa ki dieng bad ki jingthung jong phi baroh .

Ki shkor jong phi kin ym ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ha ki lynñiar . Da kaba shitom phin lah ban ïohsngew ïa ka jingtylliat haba ka tylliat , pynlang ïa ka sur jingtem haba ka bai , hynrei woh ka jingmap jongu ka sim ka kyrsiew ïa phi na ka jingïohthiah .
translation.en: And the doors shall be shut in the streets , when the sound of the grinding is low , and he shall rise up at the voice of the bird , and all the daughters of musick shall be brought low  ;
For I know that thou wilt bring me to death , and to the house appointed for all living .
translation.kha: Nga tip me la rah ïa nga sha ka jingïap , sha ka kupar ba la buh ïa baroh .
bad phi ieh hapdeng jong ki ïa ka kynthei kabu bhabriew kaba phi Ijon ban shongkurim ,
translation.en: And seest among the captives a beautiful woman , and hast a desire unto her , that thou wouldest have her to thy wife  ;
And Araunah looked , and saw the king and his servants coming on toward him : and Araunah went out , and bowed himself before the king on his face upon the ground .
translation.kha: Haba u Araunah u la khmih sharum bad u ïohi ïa u syiem bad ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u ba ki ïawan kiew sha u . U rynsied ïa lade ha madan ha khmat jong u Dabid
U Saul u ong ha u , Ai ba U Blei un shoh ïarap ïa sa lade yn ym pynïap ïa me !
translation.en: And Saul answered , God do so and more also : for thou shalt surely die , Jonathan .

translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u phah ïa ki nongpynïaidkam sha u Jesse ban ong , Phah ïa u khun jong me u Dabid , uto kiba sharai ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse , and said , Send me David thy son , which is with the sheep .

translation.kha: U Trai Borabor Baroh u ïong , Ki paid Jeraïah bad Judah ki shad banbeiñ . Baroh kiba kurup ïa ki , ki khmih pyrman ïa ki bad kyang ym pyllait ïa ki .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together : and all that took them captives held them fast  ; they refused to let them go .

translation.kha: Bad u la shukor ïa ki briew baroh Kiba im ha ka pyrthei da ki kambah ïa kiba la shah ïa u banbeiñ leh ha khmat jong uta u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong . U mradkhlaw u la Ong ïa ki ban tei ka duli ha ka jingpyndonburom ïa u riewkhraw ïa uba la shah pynstang da ka waitlam bun pynban umbiah dang im .
translation.en: And deceiveth them that dwell on the earth by the means of those miracles which he had power to do in the sight of the beast  ; saying to them that dwell on the earth , that they should make an image to the beast , which had the wound by a sword , and did live .

translation.kha: ban pyntieng ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma per , U Trai Nongsynshar sa ong ha ki : La don u sting radbah uba don ki sner ba-itynnat bad ki tyrpeng kiba khraw , kiba pyllew heh . U la her sha ki lumbah Lebanon bad u la pynkheiñ ïa ka kliar jong u Dieng Kedar ,
translation.en: And say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; A great eagle with great wings , longwinged , full of feathers , which had divers colours , came unto Lebanon , and took the highest branch of the cedar :

translation.kha: Me ruh ngi la jubab , ‘ Ngi dang don i pa iar la thnum , bad sa iwei u para uba la kha ha ka jinglong tymmen jong i . U hynmen jong u khynnah , u la ïap , bad na ki khun ka kmie jong u , dei sa tong ma u uba dang im ; i pa ruh i da ieit thep mynsiem ïa u .’
translation.en: And we said unto my lord , We have a father , an old man , and a child of his old age , a little one  ; and his brother is dead , and he alone is left of his mother , and his father loveth him .

translation.kha: ban ai ha kito kba ïam sngewsih ha Seïon ïa ka jingkmen bad jingsngewbha ha ka jaka ka jingsngewsynei , ka jingriew jongno ka jingïaroh ha ka jaka ki ummat kthang . Kin long kumta ki dieng ba U Trai da lade hi u la thung . Baroh kin ar ïa kaei kaba dei . Bad ïa U Blei yn ai ka jingïaroh ïa kaei ba u la leh .
translation.en: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion , to give unto them beauty for ashes , the oil of joy for mourning , the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness  ; that they might be called trees of righteousness , the planting of the  Lord  , that he might be glorified .

translation.kha: Ka la long ka por tlang , bad ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam jong ka Jingpynkyntang ïa ka Templ sdang rakhe ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication , and it was winter .

translation.kha: Kaei ken kane ? Ngan duwai da ka mynsiem jong sa , hynrei ngan rwai ruh da ka jingmad jong nga ; ngan rwai da la ka mynsiem , hynrei ngan rwai ruh da ka jingmad jong nga .
translation.en: What is it then ? I will pray with the spirit , and I will pray with the understanding also : I will sing with the spirit , and I will sing with the understanding also .
But if we walk in the light , as he is in the light , we have fellowship one with another , and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin .
translation.kha: Hynrei , lada ngi ïaid ha ka jingshai — kumba ma u , u long ha ka jingshai — te ngi don ka jingïasyllok paralok hi , bad ka snam U Jisu , U Khun jong u , ka pynkhuid ïa ngi na ka pop baroh .
Ym dei u brisoh uba krai , hynrei u blei ! ki la pyrta .
translation.en: And the people gave a shout , saying , It is the voice of a god , and not of a man .

translation.kha: U briew uba shahshkor ïa nga un suk — u briew wahbah ap man ka sngi ha jingkhang jong la , uba ap ha jaka rung ka ïng jong nga .
translation.en: Blessed is the man that heareth me , watching daily at my gates , waiting at the posts of my doors .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid u ong , Kane ka dei ka jaka ha kaba ka Thymmai jong U Trai U Balei kuna don . Hangne ka kein ka duwan ha kambah ki paid Israel ki dei ban ai ki jingainguh thang .
translation.en: Then David said , This is the house of the  Lord  God , and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel .

translation.kha: Kito kiba ong ïa kita kiei kiei , ki ong shai ba ki ïadih ïa ka ri la ka jong hi .
translation.en: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country .

Then said Abishai to David , God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day : now therefore let me smite him , I pray thee , with the spear even to the earth at once , and I will not smite him the second time .
translation.kha: U Abishai u ong ha u Dabid ,  Ha kane ka miet , U Blei u la aiti ïa u nongshun jong phi ha ka bor jong phi . Mynta shah ngan tynrah tang shisien tynrah da une u sum jong u hi haduh khyndew ; ngam donkam ban da tynrah ïa u ar sien !

U Hesekaïah u ïoh jingjop ha kiei kaei baroh kiba u la lai , nabar thew haba ki nonglamktien ka Babilon ki wan ïa-ban kylli shaphang ki jingjia bym ju kham jia kiba jia ha ka ri , U Blei u shah ba u Hesekaïah un leit ha la ka lynti tang baneh tynjuh ïa ka jinglong jong u .
translation.en: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon , who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land , God left him , to try him , that he might know all that was in his heart .

translation.kha: haba U Trai un Wan ban synshar ïa ka pyrthei . Un synshar ïa ki jaitbynriew jongnga ka pyrthei da ka hok dara ka jinglehbeiñ .
translation.en: Before the  Lord  : for he cometh , for he cometh to judge the earth : he shall judge the world with righteousness , and the people with his truth .

translation.kha: Ka la hir ka snem kaba khatsan jong ka jingsynran u pashait Tiberios ; u Pontios Pilat u la long u lyngskor jong ka Jehudi , U Herod u la long u nongsynshar jong ka Gamaliel , bad u Philip u para jong u , u la long u nongsynshar jong ka thiang Ituria bad Trakhonitis ; u Lysanias u la erlangthari u nongsynshar jong ka Abilene ,
translation.en: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar , Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea , and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee , and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis , and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene ,

translation.kha: Ka Edom ka la lyntait na ka Judah narud kata ka por . Ha kane kajuh ka por , ka nongbah Libnah ruh ka la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah , namar u Jehoram u la iohnong ïa U Trai , U Blei’ ki kpa tymmen Jong u .
translation.en: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day . The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand  ; because he had forsaken the  Lord  God of his fathers .

translation.kha: U Jonathan u ïaroh ïa u Dabid ha u Sillah bad u ong , Pa kynrad , waiñ ai bymdei ïa u shakri jong phi u Dabid . Um pat ju leh palat ïa phi ; ha kawei ka liang , kat kaba u la leh ka la long ka jingïarap bakhraw ïa phiah .
translation.en: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father , and said unto him , Let not the king sin against his servant , against David  ; because he hath not sinned against thee , and because his works have been to thee-ward very good :

It came even to pass on the third day , that , behold , a man came out of the camp from Saul with his clothes rent , and earth upon his head : and so it was , when he came to David , that he fell to the earth , and did obeisance .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , uwei u samla u la wan poi na ka jaka sher dara jong u Saul . Ban pynpaw ïa la ka jingsngewsih , u la kad ïa la ki jaiñ bad sleh ïa la ka khlieh da ka khyndew . U leit sha u Dabid bad u dem ngon da kaba burom haduh khyndew .
Mynba kiba na ka longïing jongngi u ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la leit ban syrti ïa u , namar ki brai ki la ïa-ong , U la lamwir !
translation.en: And when his friends heard of it , they went out to lay hold on him : for they said , He is beside himself .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Troas um mon ban pynjot ïa ka Judah , namar ba u la kular ïa u Dedan u sharak jongno u ba ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin ïai bthing ban synshar .
translation.en: Yet the  Lord  would not destroy Judah for David his servant s sake , as he promised him to give him alway a light , and to his children .
And there shall be no remnant of them : for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth , even the year of their visitation .
translation.kha: Nga la buh ka por ïa ka ban wallam ka jingpynjot ha ki briew jong ka Anathoth , bad haba kata ka por ka wan , yn ym don mano mano ruh na ki u ban lait im .
Hangta u ap mynta tad ynda U Blei u la pyndem ïa ki nongshun jong u kumno ka jingïuhkjat hapoh ki kjat jong u .
translation.en: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool .

translation.kha: Baroh kiba kwah ban im ïa ka jingim bariewblei ha U Khrist Jisu kin shah pynkhyllem ;
translation.en: Yea , and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution .
Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar , and Ahuzzath one of his friends , and Phichol the chief captain of his army .
translation.kha: U Abimelekh u la wan na Gerar lem bad u Ahussath u nongaibuit jong u bad u Phikol u rangbah shipai jong u ban ïakynduh ïa u Isaak .

translation.en: And moreover , because the preacher was wise , he still taught the people knowledge  ; yea , he gave good heed , and sought out , and set in order many proverbs .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba u Stad saiñpyrkhat u long uba stad , u ïai hikai ïa ki briew ïa kaei kaba u tip . U la pule bniah ïa ki proberb bad da kaba sngur mynsiem u da tynjuh ïa ka jingshisha jong ki .

Nalorkata u Jehoïada u ïalumlang shabar ïa u Jashar , u buh ïa ka pansngiat halor ka khlieh jong u , bad u ai ha u ïa ka kup Jong ki aiñ kiba ïadei bad ka jingsynshar . U Jehoïada u lyngdoh bad ki khun shynrang jyllang u ki pynsleh ïa u Jeush , bad uwei pa imat u pyrta : To un im slem u syiem .
translation.en: Then they brought out the king s son , and put upon him the crown , and gave him the testimony , and made him king . And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him , and said , God save the king .

Hear another parable : There was a certain householder , which planted a vineyard , and hedged it round about , and digged a winepress in it , and built a tower , and let it out to husbandmen , and went into a far country :
translation.kha: To shahshkor sa kawei pat ka pharshi ,  U Jisu u la ong .  La don shisien u trai jaka uba la thung ka bri sohwaiñ , u la buh ka jingker sawdong jong ka , u la tih ka thliew na ka bynta ka jaka khñiot waiñ , bad u la tei ka jaka ap phira . Nangta u la aiwai ïa ka bri sohwaiñ ha ki nongshimwai bad u la leit jingleit .

translation.en: But when ye go over Jordan , and dwell in the land which the  Lord  your God giveth you to inherit , and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about , so that ye dwell in safety  ;
translation.kha: Ynda phi jam ïa ka wah Jordan , U  Trai  un shah ïa phi ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri bad un ïada ïa phi na ki nongshun jong phi baroh , ba phin ïoh shongsuk shongsaiñ .

Kat katne ngut na ki , ki la sdang ban bynthiew ïa U Jisu bad ki la tap-matlah ïa u bad ki la sien ïa u . Ïathuh uei uba la shoh ïa me ! ki la noh . Bad ki nongap phira ki la shim ïa u bad ki la thab ïa u .
translation.en: And some began to spit on him , and to cover his face , and to buffet him , and to say unto him , Prophesy : and the servants did strike him with the palms of their hands .

translation.kha: wah siew kylliang ïa kaba snep da kaba Sniew rue ïa ka jingtim da ka jingtim ; pynban , to thret kadlieng da ka jingkyrkhu , namar ka jingkyrkhu ka long kaei kaba U Blei u la kli ban ai ïa pa mynba u la khot ïa phi .
translation.en: Not rendering evil for evil , or railing for railing : but contrariwise blessing  ; knowing that ye are thereunto called , that ye should inherit a blessing .

translation.kha: Haba hap ka ïong , kur khuslai Naaman kiba ha ka ïing jong ka ki biang ki jaiñ syaid .
translation.en: She is not afraid of the snow for her household : for all her household are clothed with scarlet .

translation.kha: Ki Ammon ki ïaid bad ki pynskhem ïa ki jaka jrong ki ha ka khyrdop sha Rabbah , ka nongbah jong ka ri jong ki , bad ki syiem kiba la wan ban ïarap , ki apthap ha ki ïatong .
translation.en: And the children of Ammon came out , and put the battle in array before the gate of the city : and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field .
And we said unto my lord , The lad cannot leave his father : for if he should leave his father , his father would die .
translation.kha: Ngi ruh ngi la jubab ba u para um lah ban ieh ïa i pa ; namar lada u leh kumta , i pa in ïap .

Ki shakri jongngi u ki leit sha u , bad ki ïong , Ko kynrad , lada u nongïathuhlypa u la phah ïa phi! shun leh ïa kaei Kaei kob jwat , phin jin da la leh ïa ka . Mynta balei phim shu sait ïa lade , kumba u ong bad ban ïohkhiah ?
translation.en: And his servants came near , and spake unto him , and said , My father , if the prophet had bid thee do some great thing , wouldest thou not have done it ? how much rather then , when he saith to thee , Wash , and be clean ?

translation.kha: Hynrei lapbah kim treh ïasuk , bad ki ïalaw pyrshah pynban ïa phi , kerkut ïa ka .
translation.en: And if it will make no peace with thee , but will make war against thee , then thou shalt besiege it :

translation.kha: Mynta khreh kloi ban leit sha i pa , bad ong ha i ba u Joseph u khun jngai i u ong kumne , ‘ U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga u nongsynran ïa ka ri Ijipt baroh ; waiñ noh shaw nga , bad wat pynslem .
translation.en: Haste ye , and go up to my father , and say unto him , Thus saith thy son Joseph , God hath made me lord of all Egypt : come down unto me , tarry not :

translation.kha: U tharai u ong shngain u Joahas , u khun jong u Josaïah , uba mih bujli ïa u kpa jong u kum u symboh ka Judah , U la leit noh nangne , un ym wan phai shuh .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Judah , which reigned instead of Josiah his father , which went forth out of this place  ; He shall not return thither any more :

translation.kha: u khun jong u Matthat , u khun lad u Lebi , u khun jong u Melkhi , u khun jong u Jannai , u khun jong u Joseph ,
translation.en: Which was the son of Matthat , which was the son of Levi , which was the son of Melchi , which was the son of Janna , which was the son of Joseph ,

translation.kha: bad shi kilo u purew lem bad uwei u khunlangbrot .
translation.en: A several tenth deal for one lamb , throughout the seven lambs :

translation.kha: U call u jubab , U briew un iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh tang ban pynsah ïa la ka jingtim .
translation.en: And Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , Skin for skin , yea , all that a man hath will he give for his life .

translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki Philistia bad ki Arabah ki shong ki sah Ashan ka jaka ha kaba katto katne ngut ki nong Sudan ki la shongduh harud ka duriaw . U Trai u la pynkhih ïa ki ban leit ïaleit thma pyrshah ïa u Jehoram .
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines , and of the Arabians , that were near the Ethiopians :

translation.kha: U bieit uba sngewmeng u thikna ban ïoh ïa ka jingshah umdih .
translation.en: Judgments are prepared for scorners , and stripes for the back of fools .

translation.kha: Ki la ïaid najan ka jaka ap pyrsa kaba nynkong bad nangta ïa kaba ar , pynlang ki la poi khatduh ha ka khyrdop nong kaweh lam sha ka nongbah . Ka khyrdop ka la plie hi na ka bniat jong ki , malu ki la mih shabar . Ki la ïadat ha ka lynti bah , bun kynnoh u angel u la iehnoh ïa u Petros .
translation.en: When they were past the first and the second ward , they came unto the iron gate that leadeth unto the city  ; which opened to them of his own accord : and they went out , and passed on through one street  ; and forthwith the angel departed from him .

translation.kha: Ka jingim ka long kaba donkam kham bun shahskhor ban ïa ka jingbat , malu ka met ka long kaba donkam kham Bun shah banbeiñ ïa ki jaiñphong .
translation.en: The life is more than meat , and the body is more than raiment .

translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab , Syiem kynrad , une u sum jong phi . Ai ba uwei na ki briew jong phi un wang shim ïa u nangne .
translation.en: And David answered and said , Behold the king s spear ! and let one of the young men come over and fetch it .
For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; As I thought to punish you , when your fathers provoked me to wrath , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I repented not :
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u ong ,  Mynba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki pynbitar ïa nga , nga la pynkhreh ka jingpynjot ïa ki bad ngam shym pynkylla ïa la ka jingmut , hynrei nga pyndep ïa ki jingthmu jong nga .
U don ka bor briew , hynrei i don U Trai U Balei jong ngi u ban ïarep ïa ngi ban ïaleh ïa ki thma jong ngi . Ki briew’ ki ïoh ïa ka jingpynshlur da kine ki katei jong u syiem jong ki .
translation.en: With him is an arm of flesh  ; but with us is the  Lord  our God to help us , and to fight our battles . And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah .

translation.kha: Ki nongbishar kiba bamsap ki Pdiang ïa ki jingai ha kaba rieh , dara ngat kam dat ka jingbishar hok .
translation.en: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa u . Nga mon , u la jubab . To men longkmie khwai ! Kishion la pynkhiah ïa u briew na ka jingpang jong u .
translation.en: And Jesus put forth his hand , and touched him , saying ,  I will  ; be thou clean .  And immediately his leprosy was cleansed .
They are not of the world , even as I am not of the world .
translation.kha: Kumba ma nga ngam dei jong ka pyrthei , ma ki kim dei jong ka pyrthei .
Ngan pynlong ïa ka Ijipt bashathie ban sai kynjah bad lang! tbeh ding ïa ka nongbah Soan ha ka phang shatei . Ngan pynthnam ïa ka nongbah Thebes .
translation.en: And I will make Pathros desolate , and will set fire in Zoan , and will execute judgments in No .
To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse : Grace be unto you , and peace , from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Ha ki briew jong U Blei ha Kolossai kiba long ki parabangeit baïaineh ha U Khrist : Ai ba U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi un ai ha phi ka jingaiei bad ka jingsuk .
Ha uta u lyoh sad ha kata ka duriaw la pynbaptis ïa ki baroh kum ki nongbud u Moses .
translation.en: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea ;
When he had caused the tribe of Benjamin to come near by their families , the family of Matri was taken , and Saul the son of Kish was taken : and when they sought him , he could not be found .
translation.kha: Nangta u Samuel u pynwan sha khmat ïa ki ïing na ka jait Benjamin , bad ka ïing u Matri ka la shah jied . Nangta ki rangbah na ka ïing kur u Matri ki wan sha khmat , bad u Saul u khun jong u Kish u la shah jied . Ki wad ïa u hynrei haba kim shem ïa u ,
Kumba nga la ïoh jinghikai ïa ki jingbishar bakha jong me , nur ïaroh ïa me da ka dohnud kaba sngur .
translation.en: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart , when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments .

That search may be made in the book of the records of thy fathers : so shalt thou find in the book of the records , and know that this city is a rebellious city , and hurtful unto kings and provinces , and that they have moved sedition within the same of old time : for which cause was this city destroyed .
translation.kha: ba phin hukum ban wad ïa ki jingbuh jingthoh kiba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la buh . Lada phi leh kumta , phin shem ba kane ka nongbah ka la long borabor kaba ïaleh pyrshah bad ba naduh ki por mynhyndai , ka la ju ai jingshitom ïa ki syiem bad ki nongsynshar ki jylla . Ka long borabor kaba eh ban synshar ïa ki briew jong ka . Dei na kane ka daw ba ïa ka nongbah la pynjot .

translation.en: Unto a stranger thou mayest lend upon usury  ; but unto thy brother thou shalt not lend upon usury : that the  Lord  thy God may bless thee in all that thou settest thine hand to in the land whither thou goest to possess it .
translation.kha: Phi lah ban kheiñ sut haba phi ai ram ïa u nongwei , ym haba phi ai ram ïa la u para Israel , ba kumta U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un kyrkhu kat ïa kaba phi leh ha kata ka ri ba phin ïohkynti .
Hato Man ym khmih ïa nga , A Blei , litar buh ïa nga ha ka jingbishar bad jingtian bishar ?
translation.en: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one , and bringest me into judgment with thee ?

translation.kha: To ngin ieh ïa la ki lynti bad phai pat sha U Troas .
translation.en: Let us search and try our ways , and turn again to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha ka jingjynjar kum kaei nga donkam ïa ki paralok bashisha — la nga la klet ne khulom klet ïa U Blei .
translation.en: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend  ; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty .

translation.kha: Nga iohsngew ba u ia ban pynkylla ktien na ka Arab hajngai .
translation.en: I heard that he could even translate from Ancient Hebrew .

translation.kha: Namar ba mem shym la kohnguh ïa ka hukum U Trai , bad ngam shym la pynjot thiaw ïa ki Ahimelekh bad ïa barben kat kaba ki don . Na kata ka sier U Trai u la sa kumne ïa me mynta .
translation.en: Because thou obeyedst not the voice of the  Lord  , nor executedst his fierce wrath upon Amalek , therefore hath the  Lord  done this thing unto thee this day .
Pray for us : for we trust we have a good conscience , in all things willing to live honestly .
translation.kha: To ïai duwai namar jong ngi . Ngi sngewskhem ba ngi don ka jingïatiplem kaba khuid , namar ngi kwah ban leh ïa kaba dei ha ki por baroh .

U Ahijah , u syiem Israhaïah u la hap na ka jaka jingiehnoh kai halor ka tnum jong ka ïingsyiem jngai u ha Samaria , bad u la mynsaw jur . Kumta u phah katto katai ki nonglamktien ban kulai ïa u Baalsebub , u blei jongno ka Ekron , ka nongbah Philetos , haneng ban tip la un ïoh ne em .
translation.en: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria , and was sick : and he sent messengers , and said unto them , Go , enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease .

translation.kha: Nalor kiei keiñ barben , to ïa-ieit shitrhem eiei ïa iwei pat , namar ka jingngeit ka tap noh lin ïa ki pop babun .
translation.en: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves : for charity shall cover the multitude of sins .

translation.kha: Ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong pa , phi la ngab bam ïa kata kaba dang tama ha kano kano ka jaka , namar ka erlangthari ka bainong ïa ka jingshakri jongno phi ha ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And ye shall eat it in every place , ye and your households : for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: Lada kiwei ka dkhot jong ka met ka shitom , borbah kiwei pat ki dkhot met ki ïashitom lem malade ka ; “lada kawei ka khñiot met ka ïuh jingïaroh , baroh kiwei pat ki dkhot met ki ieh bynta lang ha ka jingkmen .
translation.en: And whether one member suffer , all the members suffer with it ; or one member be honoured , all the members rejoice with it .

translation.kha: Dei ma nga umbah pynlong ïa ka , kaba ngeit bad ngam shym ai ha ka ïa ka jingstad .
translation.en: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom , neither hath he imparted to her understanding .

translation.kha: Ha ka por ka jingsynshar u Artakserksis , u patsha ka Persia , u Bishlam , u Mithredath , u Tabeel malade ki paralok jong ki , ki tah shithi sha u patsha . Ïa ka shithi la thoh ha ka ktien Aramaik bad ban pynkylla ktien ha ka por ba pule ïa ka .
translation.en: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam , Mithredath , Tabeel , and the rest of their companions , unto Artaxerxes king of Persia  ; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue , and interpreted in the Syrian tongue .
To bind his princes at his pleasure  ; and teach his senators wisdom .
translation.kha: bad ka bor halor ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem bad ka iktiar ban ai jingbthah ïa ki nongai jingmut jong u .

translation.en: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia , they came to Thessalonica , where was a synagogue of the Jews :
translation.kha: U Paul bad u Silas ki la leit lyngba ka Amphipolis bad ka Apollonia , bad ki la wan poi sha Thessaloni , ha kaba la don ka synagog .
To rwai bad risa da ka jingkmen , ko ki paid Israel ! To shadkmen da la ka dohnud baroh , ko Jeroboam !
translation.en: Sing , O daughter of Zion  ; shout , O Israel  ; be glad and rejoice with all the heart , O daughter of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Namar ba ki khup shynrang ba la kha nyngkong napdeng ki Israel ki tam arsap hynñiewphew lai lwet ïa ki Libni , ph dadien ban pyllait pat ïa kine ki khun shynrang kiba tam ,
translation.en: Even those that were numbered of them after their families , were three thousand and two hundred .

translation.kha: Khie leit phai noh shwa ïong bad sah bad la ki kmie . Ai ba U Trai un lehbha ïa phira kumba phi la leh ïa nga bad ïa kito kiba la ïap .
translation.en: And Naomi said unto her two daughters in law , Go , return each to her mother s house : the  Lord  deal kindly with you , as ye have dealt with the dead , and with me .
The righteous shall never be removed : but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba hok ki ïoh ka jingsngewskhem borabor , hynrei ki bymman kin ym lah ban im ha ka ri .
To shahshkor ïa nga , phi ki rangbah kiba don jingshahjop ! Hato U Blei Badonbor Borabor u sa ïa katai ka bymdei ?
translation.en: Therefore hearken unto me , ye men of understanding : far be it from God , that he should do wickedness  ; and from the Almighty , that he should commit iniquity .
In hope of eternal life , which God , that cannot lie , promised before the world began ;
translation.kha: kaba pynshong nongrim ha ka jingkyrmen ïa ka jingim bymjukut . U Blei , u bym ju shukor , u la kular ïa ngi ïa kane ka jingim naduh mynnyngkong ,

Ki Israel ki la tlot na ka jingthngan ha kata ka snoh , Naamah u Samuel , da ka jingsmai kynja , u la ai hukum : Ka jingtim kan long ha uno uno uba bam kano kano ka jingbam mynta ka sngi ha shu ba ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki nongshun jong sa . Kumta ym don uwei ruh na ki uba bam ei ei baroh shi sngi .
translation.en: And the men of Israel were distressed that day : for Saul had adjured the people , saying , Cursed be the man that eateth any food until evening , that I may be avenged on mine enemies . So none of the people tasted any food .

translation.kha: Ïa kino ki jingker kiba ha dong la pynïasoh lang naduh trai baroh shi lynter haduh khlieh . La shniah ïa Kinah ki jingker kiba ha dong ha kajuh ka rukom .
translation.en: And they were coupled beneath , and coupled together at the head thereof , to one ring : thus he did to both of them in both the corners .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka snoh ka wan , uwei uwei na phi un khot sngewlah ïa la u paramarjan don wan bad ban lehkmen ïa ka jingsuk dara ka jingshngain , ba la por sawdong da ki bnai sohwaiñ malade ki diengsoh Dumbur .
translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ka sngi ka la poi haba kun pynïeng pat ïa ka hima u Dabid ka long kum ka ïing kaba la khyllem ha ki jingjot . Ngan shna pynthaba ïa ki kynroh lad ka bad ngan pynïeng pat ïa ka . Ngan tei pat ïa ka bad ngan pynlong ïa ka kum ka la ju longïng mynshuwa .
translation.en: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David that is fallen , and close up the breaches thereof  ; and I will raise up his ruins , and I will build it as in the days of old :

translation.kha: hynne ngan pyn-i jingieit ïa ki briew ka Judah . Ma nga U tharai U Blei jongu ki ngan pyllait im ïa ki ; hynrei ngan ym leh ïa sakma da ka thma — da ki waitlam lane ki ryntieh , bad ki khamtam lane ki kular bad ki shaei shong kulai .
translation.en: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah , and will save them by the  Lord  their God , and will not save them by bow , nor by sword , nor by battle , by horses , nor by horsemen .

translation.kha: Sa ar sngi , kumba phi tip , kan long ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka jinglehieit , bad ïa U Khun U Briew yn sa aiti noh ïa ka ban shat sahnarphna .
translation.en: Ye know that after two days is the feast of the passover , and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified .

translation.kha: Te nga la sngew ïa ka jingdon ryngkat Badonburom jong U Trai bad nga la ïohsngew ba u ong ha nga , Ïeng joit bad leit sha ka them . Ngan sa ïakren bad me hangta .
translation.en: And the hand of the  Lord  was there upon me  ; and he said unto me , Arise , go forth into the plain , and I will there talk with thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei kane kam shym la jia ha ita ïa uba U Blei u la pynmihpat na ka jingïap .
translation.en: But he , whom God raised again , saw no corruption .

translation.kha: Nga pyrkhat ba ngan ïoh ïalam ïa kine ki briew’ ! ngan jin da la pynher krad ïa u Abimelekh ! Ngan ïai-ong ïa u , ‘ Pynbun shuh shuh ïa ka kynhun shipai jyllang me , ale to mih ba-bang ïaleh !’
translation.en: And would to God this people were under my hand ! then would I remove Abimelech . And he said to Abimelech , Increase thine army , and come out .

And God heard the voice of the lad  ; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven , and said unto her , What aileth thee , Hagar ? fear not  ; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he is .
translation.kha: U Blei u ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam uta u khunlung , bad na bneng u angel jong U Blei u kren ha ka Hagar ,  Ko Hagar , pha khuslai ïa-ei ? Wat sheptieng . U Blei u la ïohsngew ïa ka jingïam uta u khunlung .
U Moses u ino , U Trei u la lawlynnong ïa phi ban leh ïa kane baroh , khnang ba ka jingshai batyngshaiñ jong ka jingdon ryngkat jong u kan paw ha phi .
translation.en: And Moses said , This is the thing which the  Lord  commanded that ye should do : and the glory of the  Lord  shall appear unto you .

translation.kha: U Dabid u kurup ïa ki ryntieh ksaiñ ba la rem da ki rangbah pynsynjor jong u Hadadeser bad u thah ïa ki sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer , and brought them to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: (Nga leh ïa kano khnang ba yn pyndap ïa ki da ka jingshlur bad ba yn lah ban khring lang ïa ki ha ka jingieit , bad kumne kin ïoh ïa ka jingtap ba-pura ïa ka jingsngewskhem kaba ka jingshemphang ka wallam . Ha kane ka rukom kin tip ïa ka jingmaïan ka jong U Blei , naba erlangthari U Khrist hi .
translation.en: That their hearts might be comforted , being knit together in love , and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding , to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God , and of the Father , and of Christ ;

translation.kha: U Jisu u la Hukum ïa u , wah ïathuh hano hano , hynrei khie leit beit shiah u lyngkhot bad ai un peit bniah ïa me ; nangta un pynshisha ha uwei uwei baroh ba me la koit . To ai ïa ka jingkñia kumba U Messaïah u la hukum .
translation.en: And he charged him to tell no man :  but go , and shew thyself to the priest , and offer for thy cleansing , according as Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .

translation.kha: Te men sa tip ba ma nga , U Trai , nga la ïohsngew ïa ka jingkrenbeiñ jong me ba ïa ki lumbah ka Israel ba ki la sah kynjah bad ba ki long ki jong me ba men bam duh .
translation.en: And thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  , and that I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel , saying , They are laid desolate , they are given us to consume .

translation.kha: U ïeng hajan ka jaka ïeng ki syiem bad u pynlong ka jutang bad U Trai ban kohnguh ïa u , ban satar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong u da la ka dohnud bad mynhyndai baroh , dara ïa-ban pyntreikam ïa ki jingdawa ba ïasoh bad ka jutang , kumba la thoh ha ka ibha .
translation.en: And the king stood in his place , and made a covenant before the  Lord  , to walk after the  Lord  , and to keep his commandments , and his testimonies , and his statutes , with all his heart , and with all his soul , to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book .

Therefore hearken not ye to your prophets , nor to your diviners , nor to your dreamers , nor to your enchanters , nor to your sorcerers , which speak unto you , saying , Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon :
translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong phi lane ïa uno uno uba kam ba u lah ban ïathuh lypa ïa la lawei , la ka long da ki jingphohsniew lane da kaba khot ïa ki mynsiem jong kiba ïap lane da ka myntor . Ma ki baroh kim ong ïa phi ban pyndem ha u syiem jong ka Babilonia .
Ngin pynthikna ïa phi ba don katto katne hangne ki ban ym ïap poi haduh ba kin da ïohi ba U Khun U Briew u wan khim u Syiem .
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , There be some standing here , which shall not taste of death , till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom .
And it is a rare thing that the king requireth , and there is none other that can shew it before the king , except the gods , whose dwelling is not with flesh .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba u Syiem Kynrad u pan ka long kaba eh haduh katta katta ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban leh ïa kata lait tang ki blei , bad kim shong kim sah hapdeng ki bynriew .

Ma phi bad ki khur ki ktah jong phi , lem bad ki shakri shakor jong phi , pynlang ki Lebi ruh kiba shong ha ki shnong jong Phin , phi dei shun bam ïa kine ki jingainguh tang ha khmied U Trai U Bel jrong phi , ha katai ka jaka mane Blei kaba u la jied . Bad hangta phi dei ban sngewkmen na ka bynta kiei kaei baroh kaba phi la leh .
translation.en: But thou must eat them before the  Lord  thy God in the place which the  Lord  thy God shall choose , thou , and thy son , and thy daughter , and thy manservant , and thy maidservant , and the Levite that is within thy gates : and thou shalt rejoice before the  Lord  thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto .

translation.kha: Baroh kin tip ba ma nga , U Trai , nga la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad ba ngan ym buh noh ïa ka .
translation.en: That all flesh may know that I the  Lord  have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath : it shall not return any more .

translation.kha: Naaman kam i sngewkhia ha nga ban phah ïa u koidi khlem da kdew shai ïa ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: For it seemeth to me unreasonable to send a prisoner , and not withal to signify the crimes laid against him .

translation.kha: kumno ba ki kpa thnam jong i ki la leit shaei Ijipt , ha kaba i la shnong la kamar-tama hangta bun pung snem . Ki nong Ijipt ki la lehbeiñ ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ngi bad ïa ngi hajuh ,
translation.en: How our fathers went down into Egypt , and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time  ; and the Egyptians vexed us , and our fathers :

translation.kha: Em , ka la jubab . Ban phah noh ïa nga kumne ka long ka kam sniew kaba kham khraw ban ïa kaei kaba phi dang shu dep leh ! Hynrei u Ammon um sngur ïa ka ;
translation.en: And she said unto him , There is no cause : this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that thou didst unto me . But he would not hearken unto her .

translation.kha: Man la ka janmiet , u Aaron un thang ïa ki pynlang un ieh ba kin miej hapoh mynstep ha khmat U Trai shabar ka jingkup kaba ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ïa kane ka hukum dei ban ai patan la pateng .
translation.en: Without the veil of the testimony , in the tabernacle of the congregation , shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the  Lord  continually : it shall be a statute for ever in your generations .
Thy shepherds slumber , O king of Assyria : thy nobles shall dwell in the dust : thy people is scattered upon the mountains , and no man gathereth them .
translation.kha: Ko Patsha ka Assyria , ki lat jong me ki la ïap , bad ki rangbah donburom jong me ki ïohthiah junom ! Ïa ki briew jong me la pynsakma halor ki lumbah , bad ym don shuh mano mano ban wallam pat ïa ki sha ïing .

translation.en: And thou shalt bring his sons , and clothe them with coats :
translation.kha: Wan ïalam sa ïa ki khun shynrang jong u , bad pynphong sopti ïa ki .

translation.en: And Balak offered oxen and sheep , and sent to Balaam , and to the princes that were with him .
translation.kha: ha kaba u Balak u la pynïap ïa ki masi bad ki langbrot , bad u phah rah de katto katne ka doh sha u Balaam bad kita ki nongïalam kiba ïadon lem bad u .
Nga la ïaheh ha phi! ïa kane khnang ba ka jingkmen jong nga kan ïoh long ha ph bun ba ka jingkmen jong ph kan longïing kaba dap purim .
translation.en: These things have I spoken unto you , that my joy might remain in you , and that your joy might be full .

translation.kha: Katno phi long kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ! Katno ki khmat jong phi hapoh ka jingtap khmat ki phyrnai itynnat da ka jingieit . U shñiuh jongngi phi u shad kum ka kynhun ki blem kiba hiar sha trai ki lum Gilead .
translation.en: I am come into my garden , my sister , my spouse : I have gathered my myrrh with my spice  ; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey  ; I have drunk my wine with my milk : eat , O friends  ; drink , yea , drink abundantly , O beloved .
Neither have we obeyed the voice of the  Lord  our God , to walk in his laws , which he set before us by his servants the prophets .
translation.kha: Ngim shym la shahshkor ïa me , A  Trai  U Blei jong ngi , mynba me la ong ïa ngi ban im kat kum ki aiñ kiba me la ai ha ngi lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa ki shakri jong me .
U Samuel u kylli , Balei te , ba nga jingsngewsih ïa ka jingpanpoh ki masi bad ki langbrot ?
translation.en: And Samuel said , What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in mine ears , and the lowing of the oxen which I hear ?

translation.kha: ‘ Ka maw ka la kyllaiñ ,’ kin jubor , ‘ ïam na ka bynshet jong ka ; la pynkhlaiñbor ïa ka . pynbna ha lynter ka wah Arnon ba ïa ka Moab la pynïoh !’
translation.en: Moab is confounded  ; for it is broken down : howl and cry  ; tell ye it in Arnon , that Moab is spoiled ,

translation.kha: Ki pynkhreh ïa kita ki jingai sngewbha ban ai ha u Joseph ynda u wan ha ka por shiteng sngew , namar la ïathuh ha ki ba ki dei ban ïabam rijied bad u .
translation.en: And they made ready the present against Joseph came at noon : for they heard that they should eat bread there .

translation.kha: Ki Kynhun shynrang jong u Midian ki long u Ephah , u Ether , u Hanokh , u Abida , sad u Eldaah . Kine Baroh ki longïing ki khun ki khiew jong ka Keturah .
translation.en: And the sons of Midian  ; Ephah , and Epher , and Hanoch , and Abida , and Eldaah . All these were the children of Keturah .

translation.kha: La don katto katne ngut ki nongjop langbrot ha dat ka bynta jong ka ri kiba la sahmiet ha ki lum , da kaba sumar ïa ki kynhun langbrot jong ki .
translation.en: And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field , keeping watch over their flock by night .

translation.kha: Ki briew kin shong keiñ sah hangta ha ka jingshngain , kin ym shah byrni shuh da ka jingpynjot .
translation.en: And men shall dwell in it , and there shall be no more utter destruction  ; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi mynjur U Jisu u don ha ka Templ , u da hikai ïa ki briew bad ïap ïa ka Khubor ibha ; ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nongkheiñ ka Hukum , lem bad ki thlim ki san , ki la wan bad ong ha u ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , that on one of those days , as he taught the people in the temple , and preached the gospel , the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders ,

And it was so , that all that saw it said , There was no such deed done nor seen from the day that the children of Israel came up out of the land of Egypt unto this day : consider of it , take advice , and speak your minds .
translation.kha: Kat uba ïohi ïa ka u ong ,  Ngim pat ju ïohsngew ïa kaba kum kane kaei kaei ! Ym pat ju jia mynno mynno kaba kum kane naduh ba ki Israel ki la mih na Ijipt ! Ngi dei ban leh ei ei na ka bynta kane ! Kan jia aïu hadien ?

Ki rangbah ki bur ïa ki hukum jrong u Joshua . Kumba U Terah u la hukum ïa u Jeshua , ki la shim khatduh tylli ki mraw napdeng jong ka Jordan , uwei na ka bynta kawei kawei ka jat Israel , ki la bah ïa ki sha ka kajuh shongsuk dara , malu ki buh ïa ki hangta .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did so as Joshua commanded , and took up twelve stones out of the midst of Jordan , as the  Lord  spake unto Joshua , according to the number of the tribes of the children of Israel , and carried them over with them unto the place where they lodged , and laid them down there .

translation.kha: NGA la iehnoh ïa me ha Krit , khnang ba men buh ryntih ïa kiwei kiei kiba dang donkam shun sa bad ban thung ïa ki nongsharai balang ha man la ki shnong . To kynmaw ïa ki jingbthah jong nga :
translation.en: For this cause left I thee in Crete , that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting , and ordain elders in every city , as I had appointed thee :

translation.kha: U Moses u la bteng ban kren ha u Korah , Da sngap bha , phi ki Loit !
translation.en: And Moses said unto Korah , Hear , I pray you , ye sons of Levi :
In that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way , and makest thine high place in every street  ; and hast not been as an harlot , in that thou scornest hire  ;
translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka lynti bah pha la tei ki jaka ban mane ïa ki bleithaw bad ban ïaleh nuti . Hynrei pham shym beh ïa ka pisa kumba long kano kano ka nuti .
Kumta , ha ka kular sepngi jong ka Jeraïah ki buh bakyrpang ïa ka Kesis ha Galilaïa , ha ka ri lum Naphtali , ïa ka Shekhem ha ka ri lwa Ephraim , dara ïa ka Hebron ha ka ri lum Judah .
translation.en: And they appointed Kedesh in Galilee in mount Naphtali , and Shechem in mount Ephraim , and Kirjath–arba , which is Hebron , in the mountain of Judah .
And said unto them that sold doves ,  Take these things hence  ; make not my Father s house an house of merchandise .
translation.kha: bad u la hukum ïa kito kiba ïadie paro ,  Rah noh ïa ki nangne ! Wat pynlong jaka ïew ïa ka ïing U Kpa jong nga !

translation.en: And when they went from nation to nation , and from one kingdom to another people  ;
translation.kha: Ki ïaidwir na kawei ka ri sha kawei pat , na kawei ka hima sha kawei pat .

translation.en: And Cain said unto the  Lord  , My punishment is greater than I can bear .
translation.kha: Bad u Kain u ong ha U  Trai  ,  Kane ka jingpynshitom ka long palat ïa kaba nga lah ban shah .

translation.en: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way , at the head of the two ways , to use divination : he made his arrows bright , he consulted with images , he looked in the liver .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u ïeng hajan ka dak jingkdew ha kaba ka lynti ka ïakhlad . Ban tip shano ban leit , u pynkhih ïa ki khnam ; u wad jingmut na ki bleithaw jong u ; u khmih thuh ïa u khyllai jong u mrad ba la kñia .

bad pynjot ïa ki Nongbah jongnga ki . Katba ki ïaid lyngba ïa ka Lyngkha baseisoh , uwei pa uwei u Jeriel u ju kawang maw ha ka haduh ba la tap lin ïa baroh ki lyngkha ; ki la pynsangeh ruh ïa ki umpohliew bad ki la pom ïa ki dieng . Ha kaba khiat tang ka nongap Kir Heres ka dang sah , bad ki nongkawang maw ki kerkut ïa ka bun ki tur ïaleh ïa ka .
translation.en: And they beat down the cities , and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone , and filled it  ; and they stopped all the wells of water , and felled all the good trees : only in Kir–hareseth left they the stones thereof  ; howbeit the slingers went about it , and smote it .
And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle , and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle , for the two sides westward .
translation.kha: san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba ha kawei pat ka liang , bad san tylli ïa ki jingker kiba shadien , shaphang sepngi .

translation.en: For ye are all the children of God by faith in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Ka dei lyngba ka jingngeit ba phi baroh phi long ki khun U Blei ha U Khrist Jisu .
U Trai u kynruh ïa ngi , bad un kyrkhu ïa ngi ; un kyrkhu ïa ki dala Israel bad ïa baroh ki lyngdoh jong U Blei .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath been mindful of us : he will bless us  ; he will bless the house of Israel  ; he will bless the house of Aaron .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u la khot ïa u Amraphel , bad u kylli ïa u , Me leh aïu ïa nga ? Bel mem shym la ïathuh ïa nga ba ka dei ka tnga jong me ?
translation.en: And Pharaoh called Abram , and said , What is this that thou hast done unto me ? why didst thou not tell me that she was thy wife ?

translation.kha: Um khuri lane sheptieng ; u thikna ban ioh ba ki nongshun jong u ki shahjop .
translation.en: His heart is established , he shall not be afraid , until he see his desire upon his enemies .

translation.kha: Ki la sngewlehrain shaba pait Ban leit phai Ïing . Haba u Dabid u la tip ïa kaei kaba la jia , u la phah ktien sha ki ban sah ha Jerikho bad ban ym wan phai tad ynda ki ñiuhtmoh jong ki , ki la san biah .
translation.en: When they told it unto David , he sent to meet them , because the men were greatly ashamed : and the king said , Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown , and then return .

translation.kha: U nongkhmih u la nang sngewmeng , hynrei ha ka jingdap rynïeng ka bor jong u , ka reng jong u ka la kheiñ . Ha ka jaka jong ka la ïan miej saw tylli ki reng , kawei kawei ka phai shuh ki liang baïapher .
translation.en: Therefore the he goat waxed very great : and when he was strong , the great horn was broken  ; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven .

translation.kha: Ym dei ban don mano mano ba ïitbniah ïa u , hynrei phi dei ba-bang ïarap ïa u don bteng ïa ka jingleit jong u ha kaba suk , khnang ba un ïoh wan phai pat sha de ; naba nga kham lynti ba un wan phai ryngkat malade ki parabangeit .
translation.en: Let no man therefore despise him : but conduct him forth in peace , that he may come unto me : for I look for him with the brethren .

translation.kha: Neng la sheptieng , kumta nga la otsher bad baheh ïa ka pisa jong me ha ka khyndew . Ha khmih ! Kane hangne ka longïing katba dei ka jyllang me .’
translation.en: And I was afraid , and went and hid thy talent in the earth : lo , there thou hast that is thine .

translation.kha: Ïa ki briew ka Joppa la pynlehrain ; la jop ïa ki da ki briew ba na shatei . Ma de , U Tlai , sa la kren .
translation.en: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded  ; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north .
Ye observe days , and months , and times , and years .
translation.kha: Phi pynleit jingmut kyrpang ïa ki katto katne ki sngi , ki bnai , ki aïom , bad ki snem .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when the judge was dead , that they returned , and corrupted themselves more than their fathers , in following other gods to serve them , and to bow down unto them  ; they ceased not from their own doings , nor from their stubborn way .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba u nongïalam u ïap , ki briew ki phai biang sha la ki rukom barim bad ki im kham sniew ban ïa ka pateng ba ha shuwa . Ki shakri bad mane ïa kiwei ki blei , bad da ka jingtamsneng ki ïai leh ïa la ki rukom bymman .
Kana long ka pyntong ka brup ha phi .
translation.en: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace : a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee .

translation.kha: Katto katne nud na ki un thung kum ki rangbah synshar ki ban Peit ïa ki shihajar ngut ki rangbah bad katto-katne katne ngut ki ban peit ïa ki sanphew nongput ki rangbah : ki khun shynna jyllang phi kin hap ban Lur ïa ki lyngkha jong u , pun lum ïa ki jingmih jong u na ka khyndew , sad ban shna ïa ki tiar thma malu ki tiar kali ïapom jong u .
translation.en: And he will appoint him captains over thousands , and captains over fifties  ; and will set them to ear his ground , and to reap his harvest , and to make his instruments of war , and instruments of his chariots .
So the priests and the prophets and all the people heard Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh , ki nongïathuhlypa , bad baroh ki briew ki la ïohsngew ba nga ong ïa kine kiei kiei ha ka Templ ,

translation.en: Though these three men were in it , as I live , saith the Lord  God  , they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters  ; they only shall be delivered , but the land shall be desolate .
translation.kha: bad wat lada kito ki lai ngut ki rangbah ki shong ki sah hangta — kumba shisha ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga long U Blei uba im — kin ym lah ban pynim wat ïa la ki jong ki khun . Kin lah ban pynim tang ïa la ka jong ka jingim , bad ka ri kan kylla long ka ri khlaw .
U Trai u ïalam ïa u shabar mala u ong , Khlem ïa ka sahit bneng , malu pynryngkang ñiuhlieh ïa ki khleh ; men ïoh bun ki khun ki ksiew Kat kita .
translation.en: And he brought him forth abroad , and said , Look now toward heaven , and tell the stars , if thou be able to number them : and he said unto him , So shall thy seed be .
And oppress not the widow , nor the fatherless , the stranger , nor the poor  ; and let none of you imagine evil against his brother in your heart .
translation.kha: Wat banbeiñ ïa ki riewkynthei , ki khunswet , ki nongwei kiba shong basah hapdeng jong phi , lane mano mano kiwei pat kiba kyrduh . Bad wat pyrkhat ïa ki rukom ban pynmynsaw iwei ïa iwei pat .’

Sah hangne barabor shi miet , bad ha ka por mynmiet ngin sa wad la un shim jingkitkhlieh ne em na ka beit jong phi . Lada ka long kumta , ka la bha ; lada kam long kumta , te nga smai ha U Trai Abda im ba ngan shim ïa ka jingpynkhiah . Mynta to shiah bun kamar-tama hangne haduh mynstep .
translation.en: Tarry this night , and it shall be in the morning , that if he will perform unto thee the part of a kinsman , well  ; let him do the kinsman s part : but if he will not do the part of a kinsman to thee , then will I do the part of a kinsman to thee , as the  Lord  liveth : lie down until the morning .

translation.kha: Katba ki nang ïaleit ha lynti , ki la poi ha ka iaka ha kaba la dat khyndai ka um , bad uta u rangbah synshar u la ong , Hangno ka ba-don ka um . Kaei kaba khang ïa nga na kaba shah pynbaptis ?
translation.en: And as they went on their way , they came unto a certain water : and the eunuch said , See , here is water  ; what doth hinder me to be baptized ?

translation.kha: Baroh kiei ki kiba dei jong ka Pyrthei — kaei kaba ka malade bapop ka brai , kaei kaba ki briew ki ïohi bad khwai , bad baroh ki kiei kiba ha ka pyrthei kiba ki bri ki sngewsarong — ym ba-don na kane kob wan na U Kpa ; barhem ka wan na ka pyrthei .
translation.en: For all that is in the world , the lust of the flesh , and the lust of the eyes , and the pride of life , is not of the Father , but is of the world .
Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee :
translation.kha: Lada ki mraw kiba phet na la u kynrad ki wan wad jingïada na phi , wat phah pat ïa ki sha u kynrad jong ki .
Haba phiah la dep kheit ïa ki soh Olib Kishion , wat leit khiat haw ïa kito kiba dang law ; kita ki dei ka bynta ki nongwei , ki ksuit , bad ki riewkynthei .
translation.en: When thou beatest thine olive tree , thou shalt not go over the boughs again : it shall be for the stranger , for the fatherless , and for the widow .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba ka lawei ka don — Te ngin tip ba phi long ki blang ! Leh katto katne kaba bha ne wanlam katai katne ka jingpyndait ; pyndap ïa ngi da ka jingsheptieng bad jingkhynñiuh !
translation.en: Shew the things that are to come hereafter , that we may know that ye are gods : yea , do good , or do evil , that we may be dismayed , and behold it together .

translation.kha: Haba ka jaitbynriew ka leh pop , sa ioh u nongsynshar ti hadien uwei pat . Hynrei ka jaitbynriew kan long kaba khlaiñ Bad kaba ïaineh hir ka don ki nongsynshar kiba stad pynlang bashemphang .
translation.en: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof : but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged .

translation.kha: Baroh ki la sngewhun ïa u nabar ki la sngewphylla ha ki kyntu basngewtynnat kiba u la kren . Ki la nong , Haseroth une um dei u khun jong u Joseph ?
translation.en: And all bare him witness , and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth . And they said , Is not this Joseph s son ?

translation.kha: U Trai u nguh , Ka pa kane wan Haba ngan long U Blei jong ki jait Israel baroh’ , bad kyang longïng ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: At the same time , saith the  Lord  , will I be the God of all the families of Israel , and they shall be my people .
The sons also of Jediael  ; Bilhan : and the sons of Bilhan  ; Jeush , and Benjamin , and Ehud , and Chenaanah , and Zethan , and Tharshish , and Ahishahar .
translation.kha: U Jediael u don uwei u khun , u Bilhan , bad u Bilhan u don hynñiew ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jeush , u Benjamin , u Ehud , u Khenaanah , u Sethan , u Tarshish , bad u Ahishahar .
Haba u Phinehas , u khun jong u Ellasar bad u ksiew jong u Aaron uba longïing lyngkdong , u la ïohi ïa kane , u ïeng joit bad u mih na kata ka kynhun .
translation.en: And when Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , saw it , he rose up from among the congregation , and took a javelin in his hand  ;

translation.kha: Ka jingdonburom ïa U Trai ka long ka jinghikai na ka hi . Phi dei Ban long kiba sngewrit ha shuwa ba phin Ïoh ïa ki jingkyntiew burom .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the instruction of wisdom  ; and before honour is humility .

translation.kha: Pynban um shym la pynïap ïa ki khun ki kti Jong ki , hynrei u la burom ïa kaei kaba U Trai u la hukum ha Ka Hukum u Moses : Ïa ki kmierad ki kpa ym daym ban pynïap namar ki kam sniew ba la ar da ki khun jong ki , bad ïa ki khun ym dei ban pynïap namar ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki kmie ki kpa jong ki ; ïa u briew de ban pynïap tang namar ka kam snep ka ma u hi u la bor .
translation.en: But he slew not their children , but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses , where the  Lord  commanded , saying , The fathers shall not die for the children , neither shall the children die for the fathers , but every man shall die for his own sin .
And the Lord said ,  If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed , ye might say unto this sycamine tree , Be thou plucked up by the root , and be thou planted in the sea  ; and it should obey you .
translation.kha: U Trai u la jubab ,  Lada phi don ka jingngeit kat u symbai tyrso , phi lah ban ong ha une u diengsoh lyngdkhur , ‘ To jynrat noh ïa lade na ki thied bad thung ïa lade hapoh duriaw !’ bad un kohnguh ïa phi .

translation.en: For your prayers to be heard by God , you must be trying your best to live by his laws .
translation.kha: Khnang ba U Blei un sngap ïa ki jingduwai jong phi , phi dei ban ïaleh ban im katkum ki hukum jong u .

U la long uba khroh katta katta ba ki briew jongu ki hima barabor , ki jait ki kynja , bad ki ktien ki thylliej ki la ïasheptieng ïa u bad khynñiuh . Lada u la kwah ban pynïap ïano ïano u leh kumta ; Lada u kwah ban ri pynim ïano ïano , u leh kumta . U pynbudnam lane pynjahburom ïa uno uno , uba u kwah .
translation.en: And for the majesty that he gave him , all people , nations , and languages , trembled and feared before him : whom he would he slew  ; and whom he would he kept alive  ; and whom he would he set up  ; and whom he would he put down .

translation.kha: Kumta u la phah khot shapoh ïa uta u shakri . ‘ Me u shakri bymmyntoi !’ u la ong . ‘ Nga la map ïa ka riam jong me baroh kaba me shah na nga , namar ba me la kyrpad ïa nga kamut .
translation.en: Then his lord , after that he had called him , said unto him , O thou wicked servant , I forgave thee all that debt , because thou desiredst me :

translation.en: And they cried with a loud voice , saying , How long , O Lord , holy and true , dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth ?

translation.en: Then said Abishai to David , God hath delivered thine enemy into thine hand this day : now therefore let me smite him , I pray thee , with the spear even to the earth at once , and I will not smite him the second time .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah kin aiti noh ïa la ki jongngi ki hynmen bad para ïa ka ban pynïap ïa ki , bad ki kpa kin leh kumjuh ïa la ki khur ; ki khun kin phai ïaleh pyrsad ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad kin phah pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death , and the father the child : and the children shall rise up against their parents , and cause them to be put to death .

translation.kha: Ai ïa ki lem bad kita kiwei pat ki jingainguh baroh kiba la pyndep ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong .
translation.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering  ; beside the continual burnt offering , and the meat offering thereof , and their drink offerings .

They shall cast their silver in the streets , and their gold shall be removed : their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the  Lord  : they shall not satisfy their souls , neither fill their bowels : because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity .

For he was yet in the loins of his father , when Melchisedec met him .

translation.en: For the vision is yet for an appointed time , but at the end it shall speak , and not lie : though it tarry , wait for it  ; because it will surely come , it will not tarry .

translation.en: And the border came down to the end of the mountain that lieth before the valley of the son of Hinnom , and which is in the valley of the giants on the north , and descended to the valley of Hinnom , to the side of Jebusi on the south , and descended to En–rogel ,

translation.kha: Buh ïa ki ha ka sheng , bad wanrah ïa ki sha at ha ka por ba me kñia ïa uto u masi lyngngai mala ïa ki ar tylli ki langbrot shynrang .
translation.en: And thou shalt put them into one basket , and bring them in the basket , with the bullock and the two rams .

translation.kha: Balei ki briew ki long kiba donakor ha me ? Balei me da peit bnai ïa kiei ba ki leh ?
translation.en: What is man , that thou shouldest magnify him ? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him ?

U la rah ïa nga kham sha jat , bad nga la ïohi ïa uwei u brup uba phyrnai kumne ka rnong . U ba-bang ha ka kti ïa u pita uba da ka jaiñ linen bad ïa u diengthew bad u ïeng hajan ka khyrdop .

Nga ai hukum ban leh ka jinglehniam jong ka jingpynkhuid ïa ki kamra bad ïa ki tiar ki tar ka thalab , jingkñia jingbam , bad ki jingiwbih ban buh pat hangta .

translation.en: But these things have I told you , that when the time shall come , ye may remember that I told you of them . And these things I said not unto you at the beginning , because I was with you .

translation.en: So the resurrection tells us about Jehovah’s love and undeserved kindness .

translation.en: And Isaiah said unto them , Thus shall ye say unto your master , Thus saith the  Lord  , Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard , wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me .

translation.en: And there was not a man left in Ai or Beth–el , that went not out after Israel : and they left the city open , and pursued after Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei hadien ngan pynlong ïa ka Ammon ban manbha biang . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la krung .
translation.en: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon , saith the  Lord .

Therefore now thus saith the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; Wherefore commit ye this great evil against your souls , to cut off from you man and woman , child and suckling , out of Judah , to leave you none to remain  ;
translation.kha: Bad kumta ma nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , mynta nga kylli ba balei phi leh kum kata ka kam kaba sniew ïa lade . Hato phi kwah ban wallam ïa ka jingpynjot ha ki rangbah bad ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung , khnang ba yn ym don na ki briew jong phi ban dang sah ?
Nga , U Jingsuk , nga la phah ïa u angel jongu nga ban pynbna ïa kine kiwei kiew ha phi ha ki balang . Neng la hiarpateng na ka erlangthari jong u Arbad ; na longsyiem u khlur step uba pharia .
translation.en: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches . I am the root and the offspring of David , and the bright and morning star .
That which is gone out of thy lips thou shalt keep and perform  ; even a freewill offering , according as thou hast vowed unto the  Lord  thy God , which thou hast promised with thy mouth .

Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai nongshoh-nar u ïai-ong : phi la thad ïa ki kti bad kynthih da ka jingkmen . Phi ñiewbeiñ ïa ka ri ki Israel .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast clapped thine hands , and stamped with the feet , and rejoiced in heart with all thy despite against the land of Israel  ;

translation.en: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of the  Lord  , and in the treasures of the king s house , and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria .

translation.en: Give ye now commandment to cause these men to cease , and that this city be not builded , until another commandment shall be given from me .
And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt , and linen yarn : the king s merchants received the linen yarn at a price .

translation.en: They are not of the world , even as I am not of the world .

translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Are there not twelve hours in the day ? If any man walk in the day , he stumbleth not , because he seeth the light of this world .

And she came in straightway with haste unto the king , and asked , saying , I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi ka khynnah ka la leit phai kloi kloi pat sha u syiem bad ka la dawa ,  Nga kwah ïa phi ban ai mynta hangne ha ka pliang , ïa ka khlieh u Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis !

translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I remember that which Amalek did to Israel , how he laid wait for him in the way , when he came up from Egypt .

translation.en: And after he had seen the vision , immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia , assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us for to preach the gospel unto them .

translation.en: Now therefore let me alone , that my wrath may wax hot against them , and that I may consume them : and I will make of thee a great nation .

translation.kha: nangta u Joshua u khot ïa ki khat-ar ngut ki rangbah kiba u la jied ,
translation.en: Then Joshua called the twelve men , whom he had prepared of the children of Israel , out of every tribe a man :

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki longïing kum u jingtieng uba ki thied ki la tyrkhong bad um pynmong seh ei ei shuh . Kin ym Ïohi khun shuh , hynrei wat lade ki dang ïohi , ngan pynïap ïa ki khun thep mynsiem jong ki .
translation.en: Ephraim is smitten , their root is dried up , they shall bear no fruit : yea , though they bring forth , yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb .

translation.kha: U la tei hangta ïa ka duwan ha U Tharai bad u la ai ki jingainguh thang pynlang ki jingainguh ïasyllok . U la duwai , bad U Trai u la jubab ïa u da kaba phah ïa ka ding na bteng shun thang ïa ki jingainguh halor ka duwan .
translation.en: And David built there an altar unto the  Lord  , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings , and called upon the  Lord   ; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering .

translation.kha: kamut ha ka snam kaba hynñiew Jong u Serksis kum u syiem , ha u Tibhath , u bnai ba-ha-ïing , ïa ka Esther la wallam sha u syiem Serksis ha ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: So Esther was taken unto king Ahasuerus into his house royal in the tenth month , which is the month Tebeth , in the seventh year of his reign .

translation.kha: U briew babha uba ai ha uwei pat uba sniew ka pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa ka umpohliew kaba la pynjngut ne ka pukri kaba la ai bih .
translation.en: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain , and a corrupt spring .
Thou knowest the commandments , Do not commit adultery , Do not kill , Do not steal , Do not bear false witness , Defraud not , Honour thy father and mother .
translation.kha: Me tip ïa ki hukum : ‘ Wat pynïap ; wat klim ; wat tuh ; wat kynnoh bym dei ïano ïano ; wat thok ; burom ïa u kpa jong me bad ïa ka kmie jong me .’
ba u Job u kren da ka jingbymtip bad kano kano kaba u ong kam don jingmut .
