translation.en: Job hath spoken without knowledge , and his words were without wisdom .

translation.kha: U la ong ïa ki , U briew uba pyllait ïa ka tnga jrong u bad shongkurim ïa Kaei pait ka briew , u klim pyrshah ïa la ka tngaw .
translation.en: And he saith unto them ,  Whosoever shall put away his wife , and marry another , committeth adultery against her .

translation.kha: Um long kum kiei pah ki Rangbah lyngkhot ; um da donkam ban da ai jingkhia man ka sngi na ka bynta ki pop jong u hi nyngkong ïa lade bad nangta na ka bynta ki pop jngai ki briew . U ai kawei ka jingjia , tang shisien hi , haba u la kñia noh ïa lade .
translation.en: Who needeth not daily , as those high priests , to offer up sacrifice , first for his own sins , and then for the people s : for this he did once , when he offered up himself .

translation.kha: Haba phi ïaseng lang kum ka kynjoh , nang dei ka Jingkhawai U Troas ba phi ïabam .
translation.en: When ye come together therefore into one place , this is not to eat the Lord s supper .

translation.kha: bad u Darius u nong rta , uba ha kata ka por u anna hynriewphew ar snem ka rta , u la knieh ïa ka bor syiem .
translation.en: And Darius the Median took the kingdom , being about threescore and two years old .

translation.kha: Kumta ki ïaleit baroh sha Gilgal , bad hangtai ha ka jaka kyntang ki pynbna ba u Saul u long u syiem . Ki kñia ïa ki jingsuh jingsyllok , bad u Saul bad ki paid Israel baroh ki ïalehkmen ha kane ka jingjia .
translation.en: And all the people went to Gilgal  ; and there they made Saul king before the  Lord  in Gilgal  ; and there they sacrificed sacrifices of peace offerings before the  Lord   ; and there Saul and all the men of Israel rejoiced greatly .
And if a stranger sojourn with you , or whosoever be among you in your generations , and will offer an offering made by fire , of a sweet savour unto the  Lord   ; as ye do , so he shall do .
translation.kha: Bad lada ha kano kano ka por ki nongwei ki wan ban shong ban sah bad phi , la ka long tang shipor lane baroh shi rta , bad ki ai ka jingainguh bam , ka jingiw kaba pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai  , ki dei ban bud ïa kijuh ki jingbuhbeit ryntih .
Ynda ki poi ha Jeraïah , ki la sdang ïa ka kad .
translation.en: So he went with them . And when they came to Jordan , they cut down wood .

translation.kha: U la ong ruh ïa ngi ban ym tei ki ïing ne rep ki lyngkha , bad ban ym buh ki bri sohwaiñ rue thied ïa ki . U la hukum ïa ngi ba ngin shong ngin sah borabor ha ki ïingjaiñ , khnang ba ngin don ha kane ka ri ha naba ngi im kum ki nongwei .
translation.en: Neither shall ye build house , nor sow seed , nor plant vineyard , nor have any : but all your days ye shall dwell in tents  ; that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers .

translation.kha: U Dabid u rung katto katne ki Lebi ban ïalam ïa ka jingmane ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , ha khmut ka Synduk ka Jutang , da ki jingrwai bad ki jingïaroh ïa u .
translation.en: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the  Lord  , and to record , and to thank and praise the  Lord  God of Israel :
Yet for love s sake I rather beseech thee , being such an one as Paul the aged , and now also a prisoner of Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba nga ieit ïa me , nga pynlong ïa kane ka jingkyrpad . Nga leh ïa kane wat la nga long u Paul , u nonglamktien jong U Khrist Jisu , bad mynta ruh u nongsah byndi na ka bynta jong u .
Baroh ar jngut ki im ka jingim kaba bha ha khmat U Blei bad ki la kohnguh lut ïa baroh ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong U TRAI’ .
translation.en: And they were both righteous before God , walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless .

translation.kha: bad ki la ringmraw ïa ki kynthei baroh ; kim shym la pynïap ïano ïano , hynrei ki la rah noh lem bad ki haba ki leit noh! .
translation.en: And had taken the women captives , that were therein : they slew not any , either great or small , but carried them away , and went on their way .

translation.kha: Da kaba Bud ïa ki nuksa jong u kper jngai u , u Ussi , u Jotham u la kun hi ïa kaei kaba pynsngewsih ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  : he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done .
Thou knowest that I am not wicked  ; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand .
translation.kha: Me tip ba ngam shym leh pop , bad ba ym don uwei ruh uba lah ban pyllait im ïa nga na me .
Ki khun ki ksiew jongki u Aram ki long ki briew jngai ka Us , ka Hul , ka Gether , bad ka Mesha .
translation.en: And the children of Aram  ; Uz , and Hul , and Gether , and Mash .

translation.kha: Lada u kpa jong u um don hynmen ne para shynrang lane ki kynoi , u kur babha ïan eh bad u un iohpateng ïa ka , bad un bat ïa ka kum la ka jong ka nongkynti . Ki Israel ki dei ban kohnguh ïa kane ka Aiñ kam nga , U Tlai , nga la hukum ïa me .
translation.en: And if his father have no brethren , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family , and he shall possess it : and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Pynshad ïa u mawtylliat ! Pynpait ïa u purew ! Weng ïa ka jingkah khmat ! lawbah ei ïa ki jaiñ bani jong pha ! Syndong ïa la ki jaiñphong ban dam ïa ki thohshuid !
translation.en: Take the millstones , and grind meal : uncover thy locks , make bare the leg , uncover the thigh , pass over the rivers .

And I will bring again to this place Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah , with all the captives of Judah , that went into Babylon , saith the  Lord  : for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam pat ruh ïa u syiem ka Judah , u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïakim , lem bad ki briew baroh jong ka Judah kiba la leit sha ka jinglongmraw ha Babilonia . Ho-oid , ngan pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong u syiem ka Babilonia . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
Hobah u la peh hangta , u la khot jam da ka jingkhmih lynti , Ko Daniel , u shakri jong U Blei uba im ! Katto U Blei uba me shatri khak katta dik u la lah mo ban pyllait im ïa me na ki sing ?
translation.en: And when he came to the den , he cried with a lamentable voice unto Daniel : and the king spake and said to Daniel , O Daniel , servant of the living God , is thy God , whom thou servest continually , able to deliver thee from the lions ?
Therefore , when he was gone out , Jesus said ,  Now is the Son of man glorified , and God is glorified in him .
translation.kha: Hadien ba U Judas u la mihnoh , U Jisu u la ong ,  Mynta ïa ka burom U Khun U Briew la pynpaw ; mynta ïa ka burom U Blei la pynpaw lyngba u .

bad ba u nongpdiang ïa phi , uba la khot sngewbha ïa phi baroh ar ngut , un hap ïan bad ong ha phi! , ‘ Ai noh ha u ïa kane ka jaka shong .’ Nongthaw phin sngewlah bad wan ban shong ha ka jaka ba hapoh eh .
translation.en: And he that bade thee and him come and say to thee , Give this man place  ; and thou begin with shame to take the lowest room .

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa nga , ïa kaei phi ïatei ban peit ? Ïa u nongïathuhlypa ? Ho-oid da shisha , hynrei phi la ïohi ïa kaba khem palat ban ïa u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? yea , I say unto you , and more than a prophet .
And Abram said to the king of Sodom , I have lift up mine hand unto the  Lord  , the most high God , the possessor of heaven and earth ,
translation.kha: U Abram u ong ,  Nga la smai ha khmat U  Trai  , U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh , u Nongthaw ïa ka bneng bad ïa ka khyndew , ba ngan ym bat ei ei ïa kaba dei ka jong me , wat ïa u  sai juti ruh .
Phi ki bseiñ — kumno phi lah ban ong ïa kiei kiew kiba bha haba phi long kiba snieh ? namarba ka shimet ka kren ïa kaei kaba la shlei ha ka jemnud .
translation.en: O generation of vipers , how can ye , being evil , speak good things ? for out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaketh .
Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! for ye are like unto whited sepulchres , which indeed appear beautiful outward , but are within full of dead men s bones , and of all uncleanness .
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi long kum ki jingtep ba la pushara lieh , kiba itynnat ha kaba shabar hynrei kiba dap da ki shyieng bad ki metïap bapyut ha kaba shapoh .

translation.en: It is good neither to eat flesh , nor to drink wine , nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth , or is offended , or is made weak .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba dei ban ym bam doh , dih waiñ , lane ban leh kano kano ka ban pynlong ïa la u parabangeit ban kyllon noh .
Ngan ym pynsyrwa ei ïa ka por bad me , u Joab u noh . U rah lai tylli ki meng , sad u pynngam ïa ki ha ka shadem jong u Absalom katba u dang im , haba u dang sdien ha u dieng Sning .
translation.en: Then said Joab , I may not tarry thus with thee . And he took three darts in his hand , and thrust them through the heart of Absalom , while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak .

translation.kha: Kaei kaba Thoh ha ka Shithi ?
translation.en: What is written in the letter ?

translation.kha: U ïaiban u ong , U Trai U Blei ki Israel u la ai ka jingsuk ha la ki briew , bad u hi un shong junom ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: For David said , The  Lord  God of Israel hath given rest unto his people , that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever :

translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakyntang baroh ka un-long kaba la pyrsad mynsiem da U Blei bad ka long kaweh myntoi ban hikai ïa ka jingshisha , ban sneng ïa kaba mad , ban pynbit ïa ki jingïadon , bun ban ai jingkyntu ïa ka jingkem kaba Bha ,
translation.en: All scripture is given by inspiration of God , and is profitable for doctrine , for reproof , for correction , for instruction in righteousness :

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ïa nga ban rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ka jingsngewsih na ka bynta ki ar ngut ki khun syep shynrang jong ki Israel :
translation.en: Moreover take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel ,

translation.kha: Hynrei baroh ki la sdang , uei hadien uwei pat , ban ai daw . Uba sneng u la ïai-ong ha u shakri , ‘ Nga la thied ïa ka lyngkien bad nga dei ban wait mala khmih ïa ka ; sngewbha pdiang ïa ka jingbymlah wan jongki nga .’
translation.en: And they all with one consent began to make excuse . The first said unto him , I have bought a piece of ground , and I must needs go and see it : I pray thee have me excused .

translation.kha: ïada u briew u khap shñiuh na shadien ne na sha khmat ka khlieh lad u , sakma kam pyningkhong ïa u bymkhuid .
translation.en: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face , he is forehead bald : yet is he clean .

translation.kha: Hadien ba u la khublei ïakhlad ïa ki briew , u la leit noh sha u lat ban ïadei .
translation.en: And when he had sent them away , he departed into a mountain to pray .

translation.kha: Ka por ka poi ha kaba ïa ka Tyros yn klet khong hynñiewphew snem , kat ka thet u syiem . Haba kita ki snem ki la kut noh , ka Tyros kan long kum ka nuti ha ka jingrwai :
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years , according to the days of one king : after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot .

Lift up your eyes to the heavens , and look upon the earth beneath : for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke , and the earth shall wax old like a garment , and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner : but my salvation shall be for ever , and my righteousness shall not be abolished .
translation.kha: Khmih sha ki bneng ; peit ha ka pyrthei ! Ki bneng kin jah noh kum ka tdem ; ka pyrthei kan jot noh kum ki jaiñ ba la rim , bad ki briew jong ka baroh kin ïap kum ki skain . Hynrei ka jingpyllait kaba nga wallam kan neh junom ; ka jingjop jong nga kan long kaba kut .
Ka la ktah ïa ka jaiñkup jongno u , bad ka jingmih jong ka , ka la shongsah shisyndon ; bad ka la don ka jingsngewthuh hapoh Jong ka ba ka ïohkhiah na ka jingshitom jong ka .
translation.en: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up  ; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague .
For our comely parts have no need : but God hath tempered the body together , having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked :
translation.kha: U Blei hi da lade u la buh lang ïa ka met ha kata ka rukom ban kham ai burom ïa kito ki dkhot met kiba donkam ïa ka .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Behold , I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Judah , that whosoever heareth of it , both his ears shall tingle .
translation.kha: Kumta nga , U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel ngan wallam ka jingjot ha Jerusalem bad Judah ba uwei pa uwei uba ïohsngew shaphang kata un lyngngoh .
Wat ïasoh ha ki jingïathmu basniew jong ki briew bad wat sheptieng ïa kiei Kiei kiba ki pyrkhing .
translation.en: Say ye not , A confederacy , to all them to whom this people shall say , A confederacy  ; neither fear ye their fear , nor be afraid .
And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves , and they came to the battle : and , behold , every man s sword was against his fellow , and there was a very great discomfiture .
translation.kha: Nangta ma u bad ki rangbah jong u baroh ki ïaid sha ka thma pyrshah ïa ki Philistia , kiba ïaleh iwei ïa iwei pat ha ka jingkulmar bajur .
Ki la leit sha khmat bad ki la ap ïa i'u ha Troas .
translation.en: These going before tarried for us at Troas .

translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki jaka phlang kiba don sawdong ki shnong jong kito kiba na ka jait Lebi , ym dei ban die ïa ki , namar ki long ka hok kynti jong ki shi junom .
translation.en: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold  ; for it is their perpetual possession .

translation.kha: Ka duwan ka pra phum , bad ïa u dpei la pynsaphred ha Madon , kumba u nongïathuhlypa u la kren lwep ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai .
translation.en: The altar also was rent , and the ashes poured out from the altar , according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the  Lord .
That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee , to cause thee to hear it with thine ears ?
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba nga leh ïa kane , uno uno uba lait na ka jingpynjot un wan bad un ïathuh ha phi shaphang jong ka .
Te ki la ong ha u , Ma me bad u Jeremaïah phi daym ïa-ban leit noh malu ban rhah . Wat ai ïano ïano Ban tip hangno pa’ ïadon .
translation.en: Then said the princes unto Baruch , Go , hide thee , thou and Jeremiah  ; and let no man know where ye be .

translation.kha: badno u la phah kem ïa u Joseph bad u set ïa u ha ka byndi ha ka bakwah ba la set ïa ki koidi jong u syiem , bad hangta la pynsah ïa u .
translation.en: And Joseph s master took him , and put him into the prison , a place where the king s prisoners were bound : and he was there in the prison .

And it came to pass , that when he had commanded the man clothed with linen , saying , Take fire from between the wheels , from between the cherubims  ; then he went in , and stood beside the wheels .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u hukum ïa uta u briew uba phong da ki jaiñ linen ban shim ïa ka ding napdeng ki shalyntem kiba don hapoh ki kherub , uta u briew u rung shapoh bad u ïeng hajan kawei na ki shalyntem .

translation.en: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will , working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight , through Jesus Christ  ; to whom be glory for ever and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: U Blei uba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap ïa U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi , uba long u Nongaplangbrot uba khraw jong ki langbrot da kata ka jingïap ha kaba la kñia ïa u , da kaba la pynskhem ïa ka jutang bymjukut . To ai ba U Blei ka jingsuk un pyndap ïa phi da kaei kaei kaba bha baroh kaba phi donkam khnang ban leh ïa ka mon jong u , bad ai ba ma u , da U Jisu Khrist , un leh ha ngi ïa kaei kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa u . Bad ha U Khrist to long ka burom junom la junom , Amen .
Ki da shukor ïa phi bad kin pynlong ïa phi ban shah rah sha jingïohi na ka ri jong phi . Ngan beh noh shabar ïa phoi , bad ïa Phi yn pynjot noh .
translation.en: For they prophesy a lie unto you , to remove you far from your land  ; and that I should drive you out , and ye should perish .
And I will remember my covenant , which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh  ; and the waters shall no more become a flood to destroy all flesh .
translation.kha: ngan kynmaw ïa la ka kular ha phi bad ha ki mrad baroh ba ka jingshlei um da lei lei ruh kan ym pynjot shuh ïa ki jingthaw ba-im baroh .
Nga buh ki mawlynnai ha phad — ki khadu bad ki kieng .
translation.en: I decked thee also with ornaments , and I put bracelets upon thy hands , and a chain on thy neck .

translation.kha: thawsha ka rkhiang kaba hynñiewphew san milimitar baroh sdang bad pynpur da ka ksiar sawdong kata ka rmiang .
translation.en: And thou shalt make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about , and thou shalt make a golden crown to the border thereof round about .

translation.kha: La ïathuh ha baroh ki Israel ba u Saul u la pynïap ïa u rangbah ai hukum jongnga ki Philistia bad ba ki phylliah ki la wer ïa ki . Kumjuh ki paidbah ki jubab ïa ka jingkhot ban ïasoh nabar u Saul ha jingïaleh .
translation.en: And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines , and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines . And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal .
And ye shall eat it in the holy place , because it is thy due , and thy sons  due , of the sacrifices of the  Lord  made by fire : for so I am commanded .
translation.kha: Bam ïa ka ha ka jaka kaba khuid ; ka long ka bynta kaba dei ka jong me bad jong ki khun shynrang jong me na kata ka jingbam ba la kñia ainguh sha U  Trai . Kata ka long kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa nga .

translation.en: And it came to pass , when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried , that he left his garment with me , and fled , and got him out .
translation.kha: Haba u ïohsngew ba nga lynñiar , u la mareh shabar ïing , da kaba iehnoh ïa la ka jaiñkup hajan jong nga .

translation.en: Give unto the  Lord  the glory due unto his name : bring an offering , and come before him : worship the  Lord  in the beauty of holiness .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom U  Trai  ; wallam ka jingainguh bad wan sha ka Templ jong u . To dem ha khmat Uba Khuid haba u wanpaw ;

translation.en: Lest thou give thine honour unto others , and thy years unto the cruel :
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , kiwei pat kin ïoh ïa ka burom kaba phi la ïoh shisien , bad phin ïap samla ha ki kti ki briew ki bym don jingisynei .

translation.en: Notwithstanding the king s word prevailed against Joab , and against the captains of the host . And Joab and the captains of the host went out from the presence of the king , to number the people of Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem u pynlong ïa u Joab bad ïa ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u ba kin kohnguh ïa ka hukum jong u ; ki la mihnoh na khmat jong u bad ki la leit ban ñiew ïa ki paid Israel .
Ïa ka kynroh jong ka Nongbah la tei halor ki khat-ar tylli ki mawleiñ nongrim , uba halor jrong ki la thoh ïa ki kyrteng Jong ki khiat ngut ki apostol jong U Khunlangbrot .
translation.en: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations , and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb .
And Jesus saith unto him ,  See thou tell no man  ; but go thy way , shew thyself to the priest , and offer the gift that Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ha u ,  To shahshkor ! Wat ïathuh hano hano , hynrei khie leit beit beit sha u lyngdoh bad ai un khmih bniah ïa me ; te khnang ban pynshisha ha uwei uwei baroh ba me la khiah , ai ïa ka jingkñia kaba u Moses u la hukum .
Lada phira wan poi ha ka shnong kaba ki briew kim khot sngewkwah ïa phi lane kim sngap ïa Phin , mihnoh na ka bad kynther noh ïa u pui pui na ki kjat Jong phi . Kata kan long ka jingman ïa ki !
translation.en: And whosoever shall not receive you , nor hear you , when ye depart thence , shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them . Verily I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment , than for that city .

translation.kha: kumta ngan phah ka ding ha Judah bad tista thang duh ïa ki khot ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: But I will send a fire upon Judah , and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem .
Jesus said unto him ,  Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart , and with all thy soul , and with all thy mind .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,   ‘ Ieit ïa U Trai U Blei jong me da la ka dohnud baroh , da la ka mynsiem baroh , bad da la ka jingmut baroh .’
Ko ki briew ka Mareshah , U Trai un aiti noh ïa phi ha u nongshun , u ban kyrpang ïa ka shongneh jngai phi . Ki nongïalam ka Israel kin otsher dara rieh ha ka kren ha Adullam .
translation.en: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee , O inhabitant of Mareshah : he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel .

The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation , and condemn them : for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon  ; and , behold , a greater than Solomon is here .
translation.kha: Ha ka Sngi Bishar , ka syiem jong ka Sheba kan ïeng bad mudui ïa ki briew kiba mynta , namar ka la wan jngai na la ka jong ka ri ban shahshkor ïa ka jinghikai bastad jong u syiem Solomon ; bad nga ong ha phi ba don uei re uei hangne uba kham khraw ban ïa u Solomon .
hynrei U Trai un shim noh ïa kiei kiei baroh katba ka don . Un kynting ïa ka spah jong ka sha ka duriaw , bad ïa ka nongbah yn thang haduh khyndew .
translation.en: Behold , the Lord will cast her out , and he will smite her power in the sea  ; and she shall be devoured with fire .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u la ong , u Nibshan u syiem ka bamaïan u la hiarthma ban tur ïaleh ïa ka Syros . U la pynlong ïa ki shipai jongki u ban kit ïa ki jingkit kiba khia haduh ba ki khlieh jong ki , ki la dkhoi ki shngiam bad ki tyrpeng jong ki , ki la tyrkhong khait , hynrei u syiad lymne ka kynhun shipai jyllang u kim shym ioh ei ei na baroh ki jinglehshitom jong ki .
translation.en: Son of man , Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre : every head was made bald , and every shoulder was peeled : yet had he no wages , nor his army , for Tyre , for the service that he had served against it :

And Elisha said unto the king of Israel , What have I to do with thee ? get thee to the prophets of thy father , and to the prophets of thy mother . And the king of Israel said unto him , Nay : for the  Lord  hath called these three kings together , to deliver them into the hand of Moab .
translation.kha: Balei ngan ïarap ïa phi ?  u Elisha u ong ïa u syiem ka Israel .  Khie leit bad kylli na kito ki nongïathuhlypa kiba u kpa bad ka kmie jong me ki la kylli .   Em !  u Joram u jubab .  U dei U  Trai  uba la buh ïa ngi lai ngut ha ka jingisynei jong u syiem ka Moab .
La pynlong khuid lypa ïa phoi da ka jinghikai Kaba nga la ai ha pa .
translation.en: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you .
And Abram fell on his face : and God talked with him , saying ,
translation.kha: U Abram u dem ngon haduh khyndew ; bad U Blei u ong ,
Ka jingtiengburom ïa U Trai ka wanrah ïa ka ïasngewskhem bad ka jingshngain ïa u briew bad ïa ka erlangthari jongki u .
translation.en: In the fear of the  Lord  is strong confidence : and his children shall have a place of refuge .
Not because we have not power , but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us .
translation.kha: Ngi la leh ïa kane , ym namar ba ngim don ka hok ban dawa jingkyrshan ïa ngi ; ngi la leh ïa ka , ban long ka nuksa na ka bynta jong phi ban bud .
hynrei ki jingpynkhuslai jong kane ka jingim , ka jingieit ïa ka spah , bad baroh kiwei ki jait jingkyiuh ki tap bad khup noh ïa ka khubor , bad kim seisoh satia .
translation.en: And the cares of this world , and the deceitfulness of riches , and the lusts of other things entering in , choke the word , and it becometh unfruitful .

translation.kha: Ka Gilead ka long ka nongbah kaba dap da ki riewbymman bad ki nongïapeiñ briew .
translation.en: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity , and is polluted with blood .
Who had his dwelling among the tombs  ; and no man could bind him , no , not with chains :
translation.kha: Ym don shuh uba lah ban teh kynjri ïa u ;
Te ki briew ka Ijipt baroh kyang tip ba nga Long U Trai . U Tlai u ong , Ki Israel ki la shaniah ha Phi ko ki nong Ijipt ban ïarap ïa ki , hynñiew phim long kham bha ban ïa u dieng umbah tlot .
translation.en: And all the inhabitants of Egypt shall know that I am the  Lord  , because they have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel .

translation.kha: hadien u la ainong ïa u , Sngap , wat ïathuh hano hano ruh Shaphan kane . Hynrei lytar beit sha u lyngdoh badno ai ba un khmih ïa me ; te khnang ban pynshah ha baroh ba me la ïohknieh , sa ai ka jingkñia kaba u Moses u la sah .
translation.en: And saith unto him ,  See thou say nothing to any man : but go thy way , shew thyself to the priest , and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded , for a testimony unto them .

translation.kha: Ma to , U Trai Nongsynshar nga ïa-ong : Ka long kaba shispah kob ki briew ki ong ba ka ri ka smam briew , bad ki ong ba ka knieh noh na ka jaitbynriew ïa ki khun jong ka .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because they say unto you , Thou land devourest up men , and hast bereaved thy nations  ;

translation.kha: Tang shipor nga la hynñiew ïa phad ; da ka jingieit kaba jylliew kan shim pah ïa pha .
translation.en: For a small moment have I forsaken thee  ; but with great mercies will I gather thee .

translation.kha: Kumta ki tep khyndew noh ïa ki pukri baroh kiba ki shakri jong u kpa jong u , u Abraham ki la tih mynleh u Abraham u dang im .
translation.en: For all the wells which his father s servants had digged in the days of Abraham his father , the Philistines had stopped them , and filled them with earth .

translation.kha: Ngam lah ap shuh , nga kwah ban kriah . Ngam lah shuh banbeiñ kun ïa ki ktien .
translation.en: For I am full of matter , the spirit within me constraineth me .
And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ong ïa U Jisu ban mihnoh na ka thain jong ki .

translation.en: While he thus spake , there came a cloud , and overshadowed them : and they feared as they entered into the cloud .
translation.kha: Katba u dang kren , u lyoh u la paw bad u la tap ïa ki da ka syrngiew jong u ; bad ki synran ki la sheptieng haba u lyoh u la wan halor jong ki .

translation.en: And when all things shall be subdued unto him , then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him , that God may be all in all .
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ïa kiei kiei baroh la buh hapoh ka jingsynshar U Khrist , te ma u hi , U Khun , un pyndem ïa lade hapoh U Blei uba la buh ïa kiei kiei baroh hapoh jong u ; bad U Blei un synshar lut halor baroh .
Kane ka long ka ri ba ki longrynïeng jong ka jaiñjot Judah ki la ïohsngew kumne ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Judah according to their families .
Not as though I had already attained , either were already perfect : but I follow after , if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la kam ba nga la ïoh jop lypa lane ba la pynlong janai lypa . Nga ïai ïaleh shitom ban ïoh ïa ka prais ïa kaba U Khrist Jisu u la ïoh ïa nga sha lade hi .
U la leit sha u Pilat bad pan ïa ka met jong U Jisu .
translation.en: This man went unto Pilate , and begged the body of Jesus .

translation.kha: U pynhiar shapoh ïa ki nongshoh-nar badonbor um pynlong ei ei shuh ïa ki .
translation.en: That bringeth the princes to nothing  ; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity .

translation.kha: ban ong ha ki Israel , Ka Jingkhawai Niam ki Jingpynïoh ka sdang na ka sngi kaba khatsan jongngi u bnai uba hynñiew , bun ka neh hynñiewphew sngew .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Jehoahas , Wat sheptieng ïa ki . Nga la ai lypa ha me ïa ka jingjop . Yn ym don imat ruh na ki uba da ban ïng pynshisha ïa me .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Fear them not : for I have delivered them into thine hand  ; there shall not a man of them stand before thee .

translation.kha: Ai ba U thri , U Bela ki kpa thymmai jong phi un nang pynroi shuh shuh ïa phi badno hajar shah mala un jingpynbha ïa phi , kumba u la kular !
translation.en: ( The  Lord  God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are , and bless you , as he hath promised you ! )

translation.kha: Te ka jingpynmihpat ka batai ïa ngi shaphang ka jingieit bad jingaiei jongu U Jehobah .
translation.en: So the resurrection tells us about Jehovah’s love and undeserved kindness .

translation.kha: Kawei kiwei ka lyngkhot jreiñ ka daym ban long khatlai mitar ka lynti bad ar mitar ka kynïan . Baroh khatwei tylli kita ki lyngkhot jai ki dei ban long katjuh ka jingheh .
translation.en: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure .

translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba laiphew khyndai ba u Sa u long skhem , u la dkoh na ka jingpangnud kjat kaba jur ; wat la katta umdih um shym la phai sha U Trai na ka bynta ka jingïap , hynrei sha ki nongpynkhiah .
translation.en: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet , until his disease was exceeding great : yet in his disease he sought not to the  Lord  , but to the physicians .

translation.kha: Haba ki thngan , me ai kpu ïa ki na bneng , bad ka um na u mawsiang hato ki sliang . Me ong ïa ki ban shimti bad pynïaid ïa ka ri kaba me la kular ban ai ha ki .
translation.en: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger , and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst , and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them .
And he said unto them ,  What would ye that I should do for you ?
translation.kha: Kaei kata ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki .

translation.en: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad , the son of Hepher , the son of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph : and these are the names of his daughters  ; Mahlah , Noah , and Hoglah , and Milcah , and Tirzah .
translation.kha: Ka Mahlah , ka Noah , ka Hoglah , ka Milkah , bad ka Tirsah , ki long ki khun kynthei jong u Selophehad u khun jong u Hepher , u khun jong u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir , u khun jong u Manasseh , u khun jong u Joseph .
Ka Sarah ka la lama kumta ; ka la kohnguh ïa u Amraphel bad ka Khot ïa u , u kynthih jong ka . Phi long ki khun kynthei jong ka mynta lada phi leh ïa kaba dei sad kine sheptieng ïa Kano kano .
translation.en: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham , calling him lord : whose daughters ye are , as long as ye do well , and are not afraid with any amazement .
To know wisdom and instruction  ; to perceive the words of understanding  ;
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki proberb ki ban ïarap ïa phi ban tip ïa ka jingstad bad ka jinghikai kaba bha , bad ban shemphang ïa ki jingong kiba jylliew jingmut .

translation.en: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel , they sent messengers , and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river : and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them .
translation.kha: Ki Syria ki sngewthuh ba ki la shahjop ha ki Israel , kumta ki la wallam shipai na ki jylla Syria kiba naphang mihngi jong ka wah Ïuphratis bad buh ïa ki hapoh ka jingai hukum u Shobakh , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai u syiem Hadadeser jong ka Sobah .
Kumta u Aaron u rah ïa la u diengduh halor kita ki um ; te ki ïadei ki ïamih bad ki tap lin ïa kata ka ri .
translation.en: And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt  ; and the frogs came up , and covered the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: U Blei u ong , Khot hajir ïa ki brup jong na sha ïingbishar . Ki don ki khmat hynrei ki erlangthari Ibbah Mahalath ; ki don ki khor hynriewphew ki long kiba kyllut !
translation.en: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes , and the deaf that have ears .

translation.kha: Shynrang bad kynthei u la jingaiti ïa ki , U la kyrkhoit ïa ki , bad u la kyrteng ïa ki , Ki Briew . )
translation.en: Male and female created he them  ; and blessed them , and called their name Adam , in the day when they were created .
And he bowed the heart of all the men of Judah , even as the heart of one man  ; so that they sent this word unto the king , Return thou , and all thy servants .
translation.kha: Ki kyntien jong u Dabid ki la pynïoh ïa ka jingshaniah tylli jong baroh ki rangbah ka Judah , bad ki la phah ktien sha u ban wan phai bad ki rangbah synshar jong u baroh .
Lada don ka jingbthuh ha ka kjap la ka jaiñ saiwul ne ka jaiñ linen ,
translation.en: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in , whether it be a woollen garment , or a linen garment  ;
Yea , the fir trees rejoice at thee , and the cedars of Lebanon , saying , Since thou art laid down , no feller is come up against us .
translation.kha: Ki dieng Kseh-Sypress bad ki dieng Kedar jong ka Lebanon ki risa da kaba kmen halor u syiem uba la kyllon , namar ym don mano mano ban khet ïa ki , mynta ba um don shuh !

translation.en: And when forty years were expired , there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sinai an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush .
translation.kha: Hadien ba ki sawphew snem ki la ïaid , u angel u la paw ha u Moses ha ki thylliej ding jong ka  lawlynnong kaba ing hajan u lum Sinai .

Ar ngut na kita ki hynñiewphew ngut ki nongaikam , u Eldad bad u Medad , ki sah ha ka jakarieh shong dara bad kim shym la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ . Hangta ha ka jaka shongkha dara , kata ka bor myn ka wan ha ki , bad ki ruh ki ïasdang ban pyrta jam kum ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But there remained two of the men in the camp , the name of the one was Eldad , and the name of the other Medad : and the spirit rested upon them  ; and they were of them that were written , but went not out unto the tabernacle : and they prophesied in the camp .

translation.kha: La weng ïa u na ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba u la ju im ha ka jingshngain , bad la tan ïa u ban ïohnong markhmat bad u Syiem ka jingpynïap .
translation.en: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle , and it shall bring him to the king of terrors .
For the vision is yet for an appointed time , but at the end it shall speak , and not lie : though it tarry , wait for it  ; because it will surely come , it will not tarry .
translation.kha: To buh ha ka jingthoh , namar kam pat dei ka por ba kan urlong . Hynrei ka por ka wan kloi , bad kaei kaba nga pyn-i ha me kan urlong . Ka i kumba ka wan suki jai , hynrei to ap ïa ka ; kan sa jia long shisha , bad yn ym pyntud ïa ka .

translation.en: And , behold , one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand , and drew his sword , and struck a servant of the high priest s , and smote off his ear .
translation.kha: Uwei na kito kiba la ïadon lang bad U Jisu , u la sei ïa la ka waitlam bad u la shoh ïa u mraw jong u Rangbah Lyngdoh , da kaba mait noh ïa ka shkor jong u .

translation.en: And there shall be upon every high mountain , and upon every high hill , rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter , when the towers fall .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba ïa ki jaka ba la kerkut jong ki nongshun jong phi la kurup bad ba ïa ki briew jong ki la pynïap , ki wahduid kin tuid na baroh ki lumbah bad ki lumrit .
Ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa u , Balei , te , ba u Moses u ai ka hukum ïa u briew ban ai ïa ka jingpynbna pyllait tnga ha ka tnga jongngi u bad phah nep ïa ka ?
translation.en: They say unto him , Why did Moses then command to give a writing of divorcement , and to put her away ?

translation.kha: Bad kumta nga la bitar ïa kita ki briew bad nga la ong , ‘ Ki la iehnoh ïa to borabor bad ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga .’
translation.en: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation , and said , They do alway err in their heart  ; and they have not known my ways .

translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka la teh ïa la ka ïing , bad ka la pyngngad hynñiew tylliat ki rishot ïa ka .
translation.en: Wisdom hath builded her house , she hath hewn out her seven pillars :
And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines , named Goliath , of Gath , whose height was six cubits and a span .
translation.kha: U briew uba kyrteng u Goliath , uba na ka shnong Gath , u wan mih na ka jaka sher dara ki Philistia ban kob ïa ki Israel . U jrong kumba lai mitar

U Nebukhadnessar u la pynryngkang par ïa baroh ki radbah badonkam sha Babilonia , baroh lang hynñiew hajar jrut , bad shihajar ngut ki nongtrei kiba tbit , kynthup ïa ki bania , baroh na ki , ki long ki nongbah bakhlaiñ kiba bit na ka bynta ka ki shipai .
translation.en: And all the men of might , even seven thousand , and craftsmen and smiths a thousand , all that were strong and apt for war , even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon .

translation.kha: Shen hadien , ka Mari ka la khreh bad ka la leit bran bran sha ka shnong ha ka ri lum ha Judia .
translation.en: And Mary arose in those days , and went into the hill country with haste , into a city of Juda  ;

translation.kha: nongthaw la khot ïa ki nongbah na ki jait Naphtali , Asher , bad na ka jait Manasseh baroh ar bynta , ki beh kthong ïa ki Midian .
translation.en: And the men of Israel gathered themselves together out of Naphtali , and out of Asher , and out of all Manasseh , and pursued after the Midianites .

translation.kha: Te nga la jong ha u Sedekaïah ba U Trai badonburom Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong , Lada phi pyndem ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jrong u syiem ka Babilonia , ïa ka jingim jong phiah yn tyngkai , bad ïa kane ka nongbah yn ym thang noh . Ïa phi bad ïa ka longïing jong phi yn pyllait im .
translation.en: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah , Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon s princes , then thy soul shall live , and this city shall not be burned with fire  ; and thou shalt live , and thine house :
And thou shalt make two rings of gold , and thou shalt put them upon the two ends of the breastplate in the border thereof , which is in the side of the ephod inward .
translation.kha: Nangta , thaw ar tylli ki kyrwoh ksiar bad buh ïa ki ha ka bynta ba sha trai jong ka jingdeng shadem ha ka tduh bashapoh hajan ka ephod .
To kmen , ko Israel , namar u nongshahkhot jong phi ; to shadkmen , ko ki briew ka Seïon , na ka bynta u syiem jong phi !
translation.en: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him : let the children of Zion be joyful in their King .

translation.kha: Naba ngi long Kum ka jingbhabriew ba la ai da U Khrist sha U Blei , kambah saphriang hapdeng kito kaba la pynap bad kito bakha la jah noh .
translation.en: For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ , in them that are saved , and in them that perish :

translation.kha: U la jubab , Sha Bethania , ha kabu ngin tei ka templ na ka bynta jngai ka . Hobab la dep shna ïa ka Thep , ïa ka shang yn buh hangta ïa ka ba yn mane .
translation.en: And he said unto me , To build it an house in the land of Shinar : and it shall be established , and set there upon her own base .

translation.kha: U Elisha u phai shad u Gehasi bad u ong , Pynkloi ! Shim ïa u diengduh jong nga bad kiei wait . Wat sangeh ban Khublei ïano ïano ba me ïakynduh , bad lada uno uno u khublei ïa me , wat shim por baneh Jobab . Leit beit sha ka ïong bad buh ïa u diengduh jong nga Halor jong u khynnah .
translation.en: Then he said to Gehazi , Gird up thy loins , and take my staff in thine hand , and go thy way : if thou meet any man , salute him not  ; and if any salute thee , answer him not again : and lay my staff upon the face of the child .

translation.kha: Nangta u Hadien , naba ka kilomitar jong u ka dei ka Haggith , u la leit shaw ka Hashabaïah , kob dei ka kmie jong u Solomon . Haseroth kane ka dei ka jingwan jngoh kaba sngewtynnat ? Ka dei , u jubab ,
translation.en: And Adonijah the son of Haggith came to Bath–sheba the mother of Solomon . And she said , Comest thou peaceably ? And he said , Peaceably .

translation.kha: Ka jait Gad ka tei biang ïa ki shnong ba la ker da ki kut : Dibon , Ararat , Aroer ,
translation.en: And the children of Gad built Dibon , and Ataroth , and Aroer ,

translation.kha: shadien ba la pynïap ïa ki langbrot bad ki blem , ki Lebi ki khoh snieh ïa ki , bad ki lyngdoh ki synriah snam ha ka duwan .
translation.en: And they killed the passover , and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands , and the Levites flayed them .

translation.kha: Ka kynhun baroh Kawei ka la sngap jar katba ki dang Sngap ïa ka jingteh jong u Barnabas malade u Paul ïa ki kambah bad ki kamphylla baroh kiba U Blei u la imat lyngba jong ki hapdeng ki Jentil .
translation.en: Then all the multitude kept silence , and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul , declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them .

translation.kha: Bad mynta phi la shim ïa ka jaka jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi , ka pateng bynriew bathymmai jong ki riewbymman kaba kloi ban pynwan biang ïa ka jingbitar kaba shyrkhei jong U Trai halor ki Israel sa Kishion pat !
translation.en: And , behold , ye are risen up in your fathers  stead , an increase of sinful men , to augment yet the fierce anger of the  Lord  toward Israel .

translation.kha: U Abimelekh u khun jong u Gideon u leit sha ka nongrep Shekhem ha kaba ki ba-ha-ïing baroh jong ka kmie jongnga u ki shongneh ki sah , bad u ong ha ki
translation.en: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother s brethren , and communed with them , and with all the family of the house of his mother s father , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka jingshaïong ban pynpaw ïa ka mon jong me ha ki Jentil bad ban wallam ka burom ha ki briew jong me , ki Israel .
translation.en: A light to lighten the Gentiles , and the glory of thy people Israel .

translation.kha: U Jehosabad u la leit sha u Isaak u kpa jong u ha Mamre , hajan Hebron , ha kaba u Abraham bad u Asekah ki la ju shongsah ju sah .
translation.en: And Jacob came unto Isaac his father unto Mamre , unto the city of Arbah , which is Hebron , where Abraham and Isaac sojourned .
And he said unto them , Defile the house , and fill the courts with the slain : go ye forth . And they went forth , and slew in the city .
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha ki ,  Pyntngit ïa ka Templ . Pyndap ïa ki phyllaw jong ka da ki metïap . Sdang noh ïa ka kam !  Kumta ki la sdang ban pynïap ïa ki briew ha ka nongbah .

translation.en: All these things did Araunah , as a king , give unto the king . And Araunah said unto the king , The  Lord  thy God accept thee .
translation.kha: U Araunah u la ai lut ha u syiem bad u ong ha u ,  To U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un pdiang ïa ka jingainguh jong phi .

translation.en: Then said Agrippa unto Festus , This man might have been set at liberty , if he had not appealed unto Caesar .
translation.kha: Bad u Agrippa u la ong ha u Phestos ,  Ïa une u briew la dei ban pyllait noh lymda u la lah apil sha u Patsha .
Wat sheptieng , u Elisha u jubab . Ngi Don kham bun ha ka lok jong ngi ban ïa kaba ki ne ma ki .
translation.en: And he answered , Fear not : for they that be with us are more than they that be with them .
And with thee will I break in pieces the horse and his rider  ; and with thee will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider  ;
translation.kha: ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ki kulai bad ïa ki nongshong kulai , ban pynkhynñiuh ïa ki kali ïapom bad ïa ki nongñiah jong ki ,

translation.en: Then saith he to the man ,  Stretch forth thine hand .  And he stretched it forth  ; and it was restored whole , like as the other .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ong ha u briew uba don ka kti kaba la ïapshiliang ,  To kner shabar ïa la ka kti .  U la kner shabar ïa ka bad ka la kylla bha pat , kumba long kata kawei pat .

translation.en: And when they had eaten them up , it could not be known that they had eaten them  ; but they were still ill favoured , as at the beginning . So I awoke .
translation.kha: hynrei ym don mano mano batip shaphang kata , namar ki i kumjuh kumba ki long mynshuwa . Nangta nga la kyndit thiah .
Phim bit wat tang ban sliew ding ruh ha la ïing ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: Ye shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day .

translation.kha: Ki briew ngin jubab , ‘ Dei ñiar ba ki la iehnoh na U Trai U Blei uba la wan ïalam ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki na ka ri ibieit . Ki la ai ïa la ka jingnguh ïa kiwei pateng ki blei , bad ki la mane ïa ki . Kata ka long balei ba U Trai’ u la pynngat ha ki ïa kane ka orpait .’
translation.en: And it shall be answered , Because they forsook the  Lord  God of their fathers , which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt , and laid hold on other gods , and worshipped them , and served them : therefore hath he brought all this evil upon them .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha kata ka miej , ha ka jaka jong ka Rakhel , u shim ïa ka Leah nabar leit ïalam ïa ka sha u Jakob , bad u Jakob u la ïateh shongkha bad ka .
translation.en: And it came to pass in the evening , that he took Leah his daughter , and brought her to him  ; and he went in unto her .
Surely the princes of Zoan are fools , the counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish : how say ye unto Pharaoh , I am the son of the wise , the son of ancient kings ?
translation.kha: Ki nongïalam jong ka nongbah Soan ki dei ki bieit ! Ki briew kiba stad tam jong ka Ijipt ki ai ka jingai jingmut ba khlem pyrkhat bha ! Kumno ki nud ban ïathuh ïa u syiem ba ki dei ki nongmih bujli ïa ki riewstad hyndai bad ïa ki syiem ?
NGA pyllait ba ha ka jingdap pura ka jingim , nga la ithuh sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap , ban ym da ban pynkut ïa ka jingim jong nga .
translation.en: I said in the cutting off of my days , I shall go to the gates of the grave : I am deprived of the residue of my years .
And now , O Father , glorify thou me with thine own self with the glory which I had with thee before the world was .
translation.kha: Ko Pa ! To ai ka burom ïa nga ha khmat jong me mynta , kajuh ka burom kaba nga la don lem bad me ha shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .
Ki ai ka jingpynkylla da ka ktien bad ki batai ïa ka khnang ba u paidbah u lah ban sngwthuh ïa ka .
translation.en: So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly , and gave the sense , and caused them to understand the reading .

translation.kha: u Neah , u Joshua .
translation.en: Non his son , Jehoshua his son .

And their border on the north side was from Jordan  ; and the border went up to the side of Jericho on the north side , and went up through the mountains westward  ; and the goings out thereof were at the wilderness of Beth–aven .
translation.kha: Ha ka phang bashatei u pud jong ki u sdang na Jordan bad u kiew artet ïa ka sharing lum kaba shatei na Jerikho bad u suh sha sepngi lyngba ka ri lum haduh ka ri shyiap Bethaben .
U Paul bad u Siloam ki la saw lyngba ka Amphipolis bad ka Amphipolis , malade ki la wan Nakon sha Thessaloni , ha kaba la don ka synagog .
translation.en: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia , they came to Thessalonica , where was a synagogue of the Jews :

translation.kha: Baroh ki pyrshang ban shadem sngewbha bad ki briew kiba khraw ; baroh ki kob ïa ka jingïadei parad dara kito kiba lah ban pynsngewbha .
translation.en: Many will entreat the favour of the prince : and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts .

translation.kha: Ynda phi la jam ïa ka wah Joanan , kine ki jait ki dei ban ainong ha u lum Gerisim kato nang pynbna ïa ki jingkyrkhu : ka jait Simeon , ka jait Lebi , ka jait Judah , ka jait Issakhar , ka khait Joseph , dara ka jait Benjamin .
translation.en: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people , when ye are come over Jordan  ; Simeon , and Levi , and Judah , and Issachar , and Joseph , and Benjamin :
His ways are always grievous  ; thy judgments are far above out of his sight : as for all his enemies , he puffeth at them .
translation.kha: U riewbymman u jop ha kiei kiei baroh . Um lah ban sngewthuh ïa ki jingbishar U Blei ; u rkhiebeiñ ïa ki nongshun jong u .

translation.en: And he said unto him , If they hear not Moses and the prophets , neither will they be persuaded , though one rose from the dead .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Abraham u la ong , ‘ Lada kim shahshkor ïa u Moses bad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , yn ym lah ban pynngeit ïa ki wat lada uno uno un mihpat na ka jingïap .’

Nangta u la phai sha kata ka briew bad u la ïong ha u Simon , Me ïohi ïa kano ka Briew ? Nga la wan Shabeh ka ïing jong me , badno mem shym la ai um ïa nga na ka bynta ki kjat jong nga , hynrei ka la sait ïa ki kjat jong nga da ki ummat jong ka pynlang ka la ñiad ryngkoh ïa ki da u shñiuh jong ka .
translation.en: And he turned to the woman , and said unto Simon ,  Seest thou this woman ? I entered into thine house , thou gavest me no water for my feet : but she hath washed my feet with tears , and wiped them with the hairs of her head .
And when the children of Israel saw it , they said one to another , It is manna : for they wist not what it was . And Moses said unto them , This is the bread which the  Lord  hath given you to eat .
translation.kha: Haba ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ka , kim tip ka dei kaei , bad kumta ki ïakylli para ma ki ,  Kaei mo kane ?  Te u Moses u ong ha ki ,  Une u dei u kpu ba U  Trai  u la ai ha phi ban bam .
U la ai ha ngi ïa U Nongpynim bakhrawbor , uba hiarpateng na u Dabid u Sikhri jngai u .
translation.en: And hath raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David  ;

And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans , but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon , and shall speak with him mouth to mouth , and his eyes shall behold his eyes  ;
translation.kha: Yn aiti noh ïa u ha u syiem ka Babilonia ; un peit ïa u markhmat bad un kren ïa u hi da lade .
Uta u briew u la khyllad bad ong , Ho-oid , nga lah ban ïohi ïa ki Briew , hynrei per ïohi kum ki dieng kiba ïa-ïaid .
translation.en: And he looked up , and said , I see men as trees , walking .

translation.kha: Uto pa uwei uba shong ha lynter ka rud duriaw u kyndit ïa ka khubor jong pha . Wat ki syiem jong ki , ki sngewtriem , bad ka jingsheptieng ka paw ha ki khmat jong ki .
translation.en: All the inhabitants of the isles shall be astonished at thee , and their kings shall be sore afraid , they shall be troubled in their countenance .
The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them  ; and the desert shall rejoice , and blossom as the rose .
translation.kha: Ka ri shyiap kan shadkmen , bad ki syntiew kin phuh ha ka ri khlaw .
Ki briew ibha la shah banbeiñ lane kiba ngap ram lin kiba kthang mynsiem ki la leit sha u , baroh ki don kumba sawspah ngut ki rangbah , bad u kylla long u Nongïalam jong ki .
translation.en: And every one that was in distress , and every one that was in debt , and every one that was discontented , gathered themselves unto him  ; and he became a captain over them : and there were with him about four hundred men .

translation.kha: Ym Dei ïa u Isaia , shynrang lane kyntiew , ban leit long nuti ha ka jaka mane blei .
translation.en: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel , nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel .
Thou shalt not wrest the judgment of thy poor in his cause .
translation.kha: Wat pynduh ïa ka jingbishar hok ïa uba duk haba u wan ha ka ïingbishar .

U Jehoshaphat bad ki shipai Jong u ki leit bad loit , bad ki shem bun ki jingri , ki mar ki mata , ki jaiñ ki nep dara Kiwei ki mar badonburom . Ki pynlut lai sngi ban lum ïa ka jinglute , hynrei la don bun palat haduh ba kim lai shuh ban Rah lut .
translation.en: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them , they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies , and precious jewels , which they stripped off for themselves , more than they could carry away : and they were three days in gathering of the spoil , it was so much .

translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba u Aaron u leit thring sha ka Jaka Kaba Ksuid Tam ba pyndep ïa ka rukom lehburom kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid haduh ba un da mih nangta , ym batip ïasnoh ïano ban don hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ . Ynda u la pyndep ïa kata ka rukom lehniam na ka bynta ïa lade , na ka bynta la ka longsem , bad na ka bynta u paidbah baroh ,
translation.en: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place , until he come out , and have made an atonement for himself , and for his household , and for all the congregation of Israel .

translation.kha: Hynrei balei ngin shu ïap ei ? tala ka ding kaba ishyrkhei kan thang duh ïa ngi . Khlem pop ngin ïap lada ngi jingïashoh biang ba U thri U Blei jyllang ngi u kren .
translation.en: Now therefore why should we die ? for this great fire will consume us : if we hear the voice of the  Lord  our God any more , then we shall die .

translation.kha: To U Terah un pyn-i ïa ka jinglehisynei ha ka longkmie u Onesiphoros , namar ba u la pynïapthngan ïa nga bunsien .
translation.en: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus ; for he oft refreshed me , and was not ashamed of my chain :

translation.kha: Ki nongri Gasa ki shem ba u Simeon u don hangno , kum ki kerkut ïa kata ka jaka bad ki ap ïa u baroh shi mem ha khyrdop shnong . Ki ap jar jar baroh shi miet , da kaba pyrkhat ha lade , Ngin ap haduh ban da kynjai shai , ban nangta ngin sa pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And it was told the Gazites , saying , Samson is come hither . And they compassed him in , and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city , and were quiet all the night , saying , In the morning , when it is day , we shall kill him .
Wisdom is the principal thing  ; therefore get wisdom : and with all thy getting get understanding .
translation.kha: Kaba ïoh ïa ka jingstad ka long kaei kaei kaba donkam tam ba phi dei ban leh . Nalor kaei kaei baroh kaba phi ïoh , to ïoh ruh ïa ka jingshemphang .

Ym don ibha thang ïa ka sharak bad nangta u jingbuhrieh ïa ka lane buh ïa ka hapoh ka shang ; pynban , u buh ïa ka halor u diengpynïeng sharak , khnang ba ki briew ki lah ban ïohi ïa ka jingshai katba ki wan rung shapoh .
translation.en: No man , when he hath lighted a candle , putteth it in a secret place , neither under a bushel , but on a candlestick , that they which come in may see the light .

translation.kha: Dedan jingkyrmen aïu na ka bna ki briew katba khlem blei ha ka kynta ba U Blei un dawa ïa ka jingim jong ki ?
translation.en: For what is the hope of the hypocrite , though he hath gained , when God taketh away his soul ?

translation.kha: U Tobiah umbah ïeng hangta ïasan jngai u , u ong shuh shuh , Kaba Kum kano ka kynroh ki lah don tei ? “Wat u myrsiang u ha ban pynpra ïa ka !
translation.en: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him , and he said , Even that which they build , if a fox go up , he shall even break down their stone wall .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne por u Boas da lat hi u wanlam pei na Bethlehem bad u ai khublei ïa ki nongtrei . To U Troas un longsyiem ryngkat bad phira ! u ong . U Trai u kyrshut ïa phi ! ki jubab .
translation.en: And , behold , Boaz came from Beth–lehem , and said unto the reapers , The  Lord  be with you . And they answered him , The  Lord  bless thee .

translation.kha: Hangta u la ïakynduh ïa u Jiw uba kyrteng u Akaba , ïa uba la kha ha Pontos , uba ïangat shu wan shen na Italy lem bad ka Priskila ka tnga jong u , nabar u Patsha Klaudius u la lah hukum ïa ki Jiw baroh ban mihnoh na Rom .
translation.en: And found a certain Jew named Aquila , born in Pontus , lately come from Italy , with his wife Priscilla  ; ( because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome : ) and came unto them .

translation.kha: Ngi ruh ngi la jubab , ‘ Ngi tang don i pa iba la tymmen , bad sa ti u na uba la kha ha ka jingong tymmen Jong i . U hynmen jong u khynnah , u la ïan , bad na ki khun ka kmie jong u , dei sa tang ma u suba dang im ; i pa ruh i da ieit thep mynsngi ïa u .’
translation.en: And we said unto my lord , We have a father , an old man , and a child of his old age , a little one  ; and his brother is dead , and he alone is left of his mother , and his father loveth him .

translation.kha: ngan ym beh shuh ïa kano kano na ki jyrthiaw kiba dang don ha ka ri haba u Joshua u la ïap .
translation.en: I also will not henceforth drive out any from before them of the nations which Joshua left when he died :

translation.kha: Un pynïap ïa Uto u khunlangbrot dara un shim khyndai ka snam bad un thab ïa ka ha ka sorkar kamon jong utai u Briew , ka tikmie kamon jong u , bad ha ka jatkmie kum jong u .
translation.en: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering , and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering , and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot :

translation.kha: Ma nga U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ïathuh ha phi ba nga hi da ailad ngan wad ïa ki lumlang jong nga bad sumar ïa ki .
translation.en: For thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I , even I , will both search my sheep , and seek them out .

translation.kha: Haba u Nabal u jingphohsniew ba ki Jiw ki la sdang ïa ka jingtei pat ïa ka kynroh , u la bitar bad u sdang ban krenbeiñ ïa ngi .
translation.en: But it came to pass , that when Sanballat heard that we builded the wall , he was wroth , and took great indignation , and mocked the Jews .

Then shall he bring it to the priest , and the priest shall take his handful of it , even a memorial thereof , and burn it on the altar , according to the offerings made by fire unto the  Lord  : it is a sin offering .
translation.kha: Un wanrah ïa u ha u lyngdoh , u ban shim shi kham na u kum ka dak ba la ainguh sha U  Trai  , bad un thang ïa u ha ka duwan kum ka jingkñia ainguh bam . Ka long ka jingkñia ban pynkhuid ïa ka pop .
Katno wahbah kmen u long iathuh u shakri lada u kynrad jongngi u , u shadem ba u leh ïa kane haba u wan sha Ïing !
translation.en: Blessed is that servant , whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing .

translation.kha: Ngan lumlang ïa baher ki jaitbynriew bad ïalam ïa ki sha ka Them jrong ka jingbishar . Hangta ngan bishar ïa ki na ka bynta baroh kaba ki la leh ïa ki briew jongno per . Ki la pynsakma ïa ki Jerusalem sha ki ri nongwei bad ki la peh ïa ka Israel , ka ri jong nga .
translation.en: I will also gather all nations , and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat , and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel , whom they have scattered among the nations , and parted my land .

translation.kha: Dang step phyrngab ha ka sngi kaba bud , u Abraham u ai katto katne ka jingbam bad ka pla snieh ba-dap um ha ka Hagar . U pynrangbah ïa u khun ha ka met jong ka mala u la pham noh ïa ka . Ka la mihnoh bad ka ïaid sakma ha ka ri khlaw jong ka Beersheba .
translation.en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning , and took bread , and a bottle of water , and gave it unto Hagar , putting it on her shoulder , and the child , and sent her away : and she departed , and wandered in the wilderness of Beer–sheba .

translation.kha: Haba ki synran baroh ki la ïawanlang ha Galilaïa , U Jisu u la ïai-ong ha ki , U Khun U Briew u la jlan ba un shah aiti ha ki briew ,
translation.en: And while they abode in Galilee , Jesus said unto them ,  The Son of man shall be betrayed into the hands of men :

translation.kha: Kito kiba wanrah jingeh ha la ki longïing kin ym don ei ei ha katba kut . Ki briew kiba bieit kin long borabor ki shakri jongno babha stad .
translation.en: He that troubleth his own house shall inherit the wind : and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart .

There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families  ; for the children of Abiezer , and for the children of Helek , and for the children of Asriel , and for the children of Shechem , and for the children of Hepher , and for the children of Shemida : these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families .
translation.kha: Ïa ka jaka ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan la ai ïa ki longïing kiba sah na ka jait Manasseh : u Abieser , u Helek , u Asriel , u Shekhem , u Hepher , bad u Shemida . Kine ki long ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u Manasseh , u khun jong u Joseph bad ki long ki khlieh jong ki longïing .
Nga longïing uba lui la , nabar uba shaniah hok , hynrei ki ktien jong nga ki pynsngewrem , bad barben kaba nga ong ka i kumba ka pynrem ïa nga .
translation.en: If I justify myself , mine own mouth shall condemn me : if I say , I am perfect , it shall also prove me perverse .

translation.kha: Ïathuh katno seh ba u briew un kem ïa u Nongshun jong u bad nangta un pyllait ïa u ban lytar noh khlem mynsaw ? U Terah un kyrkhu ïa phi ïa kaei kaba phi! la leh ïa nga ha kane ka sngi !
translation.en: For if a man find his enemy , will he let him go well away ? wherefore the  Lord  reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day .

translation.kha: Thaw ïa kaba shapoh jong ka Ïingjaiñ bakynjang , ka Ïingjaiñ jong ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga na ki shiphew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba da ka Kain kaba ni , ba la thynrang da u saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , pynlang uba rong saw . Suh pynjop itynnat ha ki ïa ka trud ki kherub .
translation.en: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen , and blue , and purple , and scarlet : with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them .

translation.kha: Ka la jan dap artat san bajam haba u la leit sha ka jaka ïew bad u la ïoh katto katne ngut ki Rangbah kiba dang ïeng hi hangta . ‘ Balei ba phi pynsep-ei ïa ka sngi baroh Kawei hangne khlem kdew ?’ u la kylli ïa ki .
translation.en: And about the eleventh hour he went out , and found others standing idle , and saith unto them , Why stand ye here all the day idle ?

translation.kha: Kumta u Sanballat bad u Hushim ki phah khubor sha nga , da kaba ai jingmut ba ngan ïanguh bad ki ha kawei na ki nongrit jong ka Madan Ono . Kane ka la long ka buid sianti jong ki ban pyrshang ban nguh ïa nga ha ka jingmap .
translation.en: That Sanballat and Geshem sent unto me , saying , Come , let us meet together in some one of the villages in the plain of Ono . But they thought to do me mischief .
After all this , when Josiah had prepared the temple , Neco king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates : and Josiah went out against him .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u syiem Josaïah u la leh ïa kane baroh na ka bynta ka Templ , u Neko u syiem ka Ijipt u ïalam ïa ka kynhun shipai ban ïaleh pyrshah ha Karkhemish ha ka wah Ïuphratis . U Josaïah u la pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u , hynrei u Neko u phah sha u Josaïah ïa kane ka khubor :

translation.en: And so it is written , The first man Adam was made a living soul ; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit .
translation.kha: Naba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Ïa u briew uba nyngkong , u Adam , la thaw uba don jingim ;  hynrei u Adam uba khatduh u la long U Mynsiem uba ai jingim .
Uwei pa uwei uba la shah kynthup ha ka jingkheiñbriew u dei ïa-ban siew ïa ka dor ba la buh , kat kumne ka jingthew ha ka jaka kyntang , uwei pa uwei un siew ïa kaei kamon ka jingainguh sha nga .
translation.en: This they shall give , every one that passeth among them that are numbered , half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary : ( a shekel is twenty gerahs : ) an half shekel shall be the offering of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Dabid bad ki Israel baroh ki la ïashad kmen bad ïarwai shitrhem da ka ni baroh ban burom ïa U Trei . Ki da tem ïa ki duitara , ki jingtem ksai , ki ksing , ki kanjari , bad ki shakuriaw .
translation.en: And David and all the house of Israel played before the  Lord  on all manner of instruments made of fir wood , even on harps , and on psalteries , and on timbrels , and on cornets , and on cymbals .

translation.kha: kitab me shadkmen ha ka jingpynjot ïa ka Israel , ka nongkynti jongno at . Ki lumbah ka Sei , ho-oid , baroh ka ri Edom kin sah kynjah . Te Baroh kin sa tip ba nga longsyiem U Trai .
translation.en: As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel , because it was desolate , so will I do unto thee : thou shalt be desolate , O mount Seir , and all Edom , even all of it : and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Lada nga la Phah ïa me sha ki jaitbynriew bakhraw kiba kren ïa ki ktung kiba eh bakha mem sngewthuh , Kin shahshkor ïa me .
translation.en: Not to many people of a strange speech and of an hard language , whose words thou canst not understand . Surely , had I sent thee to them , they would have hearkened unto thee .

translation.kha: Nangta u sia ïa ki doh jem bad ïa ki kjat-dien bun u lane lang ïa ki ha ka duwan halor nam khiew pait ki jingkñia plied thang .
translation.en: And he did wash the inwards and the legs , and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar .
Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me , the works that I do shall he do also  ; and greater works than these shall he do  ; because I go unto my Father .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uno uno uba ngeit ha nga un leh ïa kaei kaba nga leh — ho-oid , un leh wat ïa ki kiei kiei kiba kham khraw , namar ngan leit sha U Kpa .
Ki briew kiba bha ki sumar ïa ki jingri jong ki , hynrei ki riew ba-bymman ki lehbeiñ ïa la ki jong .
translation.en: A righteous man regardeth the life of his beast : but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel .

translation.kha: Haba ki Pharoah ki la ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , ki la rkhiebeiñ ïa U Jingsuk , namar ba ki ieit ïa ka pisa .
translation.en: And the Pharisees also , who were covetous , heard all these things : and they derided him .

translation.kha: ngam pyn-i ha phi ïa ka bor jong nga bad ïa ka jingbitar jong nga haba nga lumlang ïa phi malu wallam pah ïa phi na ki ri baroh sha kiba la pynjam ïa phi .
translation.en: And I will bring you out from the people , and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered , with a mighty hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with fury poured out .

translation.kha: U para nongtuh u long u nongshun uba sniew Tam jong u hi . Un shah pynshitom “lada u ïathuh ïa ka jingshisha ha ka ïingbishar , U Blei un tei ïa u lada um leh kumta .
translation.en: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul : he heareth cursing , and bewrayeth it not .

I will consume man and beast  ; I will consume the fowls of the heaven , and the fishes of the sea , and the stumblingblocks with the wicked  ; and I will cut off man from off the land , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: ïa baroh ki briew bad ki mrad , ki sim bad ki dohkha . Ngan wallam ka jingkyllon jong u bymman . Ngan pynjot ïa u bynriew baroh , bad yn ym pynsah ïa uno uno uba lait im . Ma nga , U  Trai  nga la kren .
U Hushai u jubab , Ka jingai jingmut kaba u Ahithophel u la ai ha phi ha kane ka por kam long katba bakha .
translation.en: And Hushai said unto Absalom , The counsel that Ahithophel hath given is not good at this time .
And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household , and twenty measures of pure oil : thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year .
translation.kha: bad u Solomon u la pynbiang ïa u Hiram da ar hajar ton u kew bad saw lakh litar ka umphniang Olib man ka snem ban bsa ïa ki rangbah jong u .
kaba ing namar kaba ing , ka jingmeng nongmareh ka jingmong , ka jingjngem snam namar ka jingairam snam .
translation.en: Burning for burning , wound for wound , stripe for stripe .
Testifying both to the Jews , and also to the Greeks , repentance toward God , and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ .
translation.kha: Ha ki Jiw bad ki Jentil kumjuh nga la ai ka jingmaham da ka jingsngewkhia ba ki dei ban phai sha U Blei na ki pop jong ki bad ban ngeit ha U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi .
Ki bri sohwaiñ ki la ïapli nabar ka um sohwaiñ ka la nang duna . Baroh kiba la longkmie shisien kiba kmen , mynta ki sngewsih ,
translation.en: The new wine mourneth , the vine languisheth , all the merryhearted do sigh .
And the  Lord  said , Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great , and because their sin is very grievous  ;
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Abraham ,  Ki don ki jingkynnoh pyrshah kiba jur ïa ka Sodom bad ka Gomorrah , bad ka pop jong ki ka long kaba khraw katta katta .

translation.en: In my Father s house are many mansions : if it were not so , I would have told you . I go to prepare a place for you .
translation.kha: Don shibun ki kamra ha ka ïing U Kpa jong nga , bad ngan leit ban pynkhreh ka jaka ïa phi . Ngan ym jin da la ïathuh ïa phi lada kam long kumta .
U ïalade borabor ïa la ki bariew bad u ai ïa ki ka jingsdang bad ka jingtip . Ka jingkynshew spah bakhraw tam jong ki ka long ka jingtiengburom ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times , and strength of salvation : the fear of the  Lord  is his treasure .

translation.kha: U Philip u la kut jingdum ban ïaid lait ïa ka Ephesos , ba kumta yn ym pynsep-ei ïa ka por ha ka kuman jong ka Asia . U la kyrkieh ban poi ha Jerusalem ha ka sngi Pynthikna , lada ka long kaba lah .
translation.en: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus , because he would not spend the time in Asia : for he hasted , if it were possible for him , to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost .

translation.kha: U jingthung u la speh bad u la long u dieng sohwaiñ uba lyngkot bad uba pyiar kylleng . Ki tnaw ki san shajrong shaei u pukni , bad ki thied ki khuid jylliew . La tap ïa u tieng sohwaiñ da ki tnat bad ki sla .
translation.en: And it grew , and became a spreading vine of low stature , whose branches turned toward him , and the roots thereof were under him : so it became a vine , and brought forth branches , and shot forth sprigs .
Soon Jesus will remove all wickedness and suffering from this earth .—Psalm 37 :9-11  ; Proverbs 2 :21 , 22 .
translation.kha: Shen , u Jisu un weng noh baroh ki jingsniew bad jingjynjar na kane ka pyrthei .—Salm 37 :9-11 ; Proberb 2 :21 , 22 .

dien kane keiñ balei nga ong ïa phi ban ym khuslai shaphang ka jingbam malade ka jingdie kaba phi donkam ban im , lane shaphang ki jaiñ na ka bynta ka met jngai phi . nalor baroh , hato ka jingim kam khnam kor shibun shun ïa ki jingbam ? Hato ka set kam khem akor banbeiñ ïa ki daiñ ?
translation.en: Therefore I say unto you , Take no thought for your life , what ye shall eat , or what ye shall drink  ; nor yet for your body , what ye shall put on . Is not the life more than meat , and the body than raiment ?

translation.kha: Ngam la Jedidah katto katne na ki khun shynrang jrong phi ban long ki nongïathuhlypa , pynlang katto katne na ki samla shynrang jong phi ban long ki Nasir . Hato kane kam long kaba shisha , ko ki pangnud Israel ? Ma ang , U Trai nga la kren .
translation.en: And I raised up of your sons for prophets , and of your young men for Nazarites . Is it not even thus , O ye children of Israel ? saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: ka jaka jong ki ka ïar naduh Heshbon haduh Ramath Mephibosheth bad Bethemek , naduh Mahanaim haduh ka khappud jrong ka lawbah .
translation.en: And from Heshbon unto Ramath–mizpeh , and Betonim  ; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir  ;

translation.kha: U Abraham u leit phai pat sha la ki shakri , bad ki ïaleit lang sha Birsha , ha kaba u Absalom u shongneh hangta .
translation.en: So Abraham returned unto his young men , and they rose up and went together to Beer–sheba  ; and Abraham dwelt at Beer–sheba .

translation.kha: U Joash u syiem ka Jehudi u shim lut ïa baroh ki jingai ba kiba ha shuwa jong u , u Jehoshaphat , u Jehoram , bad u Akhsah ki la pynkyntang sha U Trai’ , u kynthup lang ïa ki jingaiei jong u bad ka ksar Baroh kaba ha ki ïing jingkynshew jong ka Templ bad ka ïingsyiem , bad u phah ïa kita barabor khim ka jingai sngewbha sha u syiem Hasael , uba ïalam noh ïa ka kynran Shiphew jong u na Jerusalem .
translation.en: And Jehoash king of Judah took all the hallowed things that Jehoshaphat , and Jehoram , and Ahaziah , his fathers , kings of Judah , had dedicated , and his own hallowed things , and all the gold that was found in the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and in the king s house , and sent it to Hazael king of Syria : and he went away from Jerusalem .

And David girded his sword upon his armour , and he assayed to go  ; for he had not proved it . And David said unto Saul , I cannot go with these  ; for I have not proved them . And David put them off him .
translation.kha: U Dabid u bsuh ïa ka waitlam u Saul ha kata ka jingkieng atiar bad u pyrshang ban ïaid , hynrei um lah , namar ba um ju mlien ban phong ïa kita .  Ngam lah ban leit ïaleh ryngkat bad kine ,  u ong ïa u Saul .  Ngam ju mlien ïa ki .  Kumta u loit noh ïa ki baroh .

translation.en: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even , and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning , and according to the drink offering thereof , for a sweet savour , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kñia ïa u khunlangbrot uba ar ynda janmiet , bad ainguh lang bad u katjuh u kew ba la tylliat ni bha , ka umphniang Olib , bad ka waiñ kumba leh mynstep . Kane ka long ka jingainguh bam sha nga U  Trai  , bad ka jingiwbih jong ka , ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .
haba u Jisu u la ïoh ïa u paidbah shohdoh jong u , u la hukum ïa ki synran jong u ban leit sha shiliang jngai ka duriaw .
translation.en: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes about him , he gave commandment to depart unto the other side .

And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year , then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations : it shall not go out in the jubilee .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada um thied pat ïa ka hapoh kata ka snem , u duh noh ïa kata ka hok ban thied biang , bad kata ka ïing ka sah duh ha uta u nongthied bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u pateng la pateng ; yn ym pyllait ïa ka ha ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .

translation.en: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them : for the Levites and the singers , that did the work , were fled every one to his field .
translation.kha: Nga la tip ruh ba ki nongtem nongput ka Templ bad kiwei ki Lebi ki la mihnoh na Jerusalem bad poi biang sha ki jaka rep , namar ki briew kim shym la ai kaba biang ïa ki ban im .
Ko ki khwan Jong nga , to phin ri kyndong ïa lade na ki Blei’ ba-thala !
translation.en: Little children , keep yourselves from idols . Amen .

translation.kha: U balui u wan biang na Edom ; U Balei bakhuid u wan na ki lumrit ka Paran . Ka baburom jong u ka dap ïa ki bnai , bad ka pynrieh ka dap da ka jingïailong ïa u .
translation.en: God came from Teman , and the Holy One from mount Paran . Selah . His glory covered the heavens , and the earth was full of his praise .
Now hear me therefore , and deliver the captives again , which ye have taken captive of your brethren : for the fierce wrath of the  Lord  is upon you .
translation.kha: Shahshkor , ïa nga ! Kine ki koidi ki dei ki hynmen ki para jong phi . Pyllait noh ïa ki , ne U  Trai  un pynshitom ïa phi ha ka jingbitar jong u .

U Trai u ong , Ki bhabriew ka Ammon ki la ïai leh pop , bad na ka bynta kane ngan pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Ha ki thma jong ki ban pynjuh bun ki jaka , ki la puid wat ïa ki kynthei kiba punkhun ha Gilead .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead , that they might enlarge their border :

translation.kha: U Abram u dem ngon haduh khynñiat ; bad U Blei u jong ,
translation.en: And Abram fell on his face : and God talked with him , saying ,

translation.kha: Ka jingpynshitom jong nga ka la hir kaba bha ïa nga , namar ka pynlong ïa nga ban nang ïa ki hukum jong me .
translation.en: It is good for me that I have been afflicted  ; that I might learn thy statutes .

translation.kha: U Jakob u ong , Ai kan bat ïa kito ki tiar . Ngim kwah ba ki bri kin samrkhie ïa ngi . Nga la Pyrshang ban siew ïa ka , hynrei phim shym lap ïa ka .
translation.en: And Judah said , Let her take it to her , lest we be shamed : behold , I sent this kid , and thou hast not found her .

translation.kha: Ki rep lyngkha badno ki thung ki diengsoh sohshnong bad ki lum ka jingduh kaba dap kyrhai .
translation.en: And sow the fields , and plant vineyards , which may yield fruits of increase .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha la , Kam pher kumno ki nongaplangbrot ki kynhied bad ki pyrta , kim ha ban pynteh ïa u nuti ba un phet na ka jingri ba u la pynïap ; ha kajuh ka rukom , ym khong Kanah kano kaba lah ban khang ïa ang , U Trai Badonbor Berakah na kaba ïada ïa u Lum Sihon .
translation.en: For thus hath the  Lord  spoken unto me , Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey , when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him , he will not be afraid of their voice , nor abase himself for the noise of them : so shall the  Lord  of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion , and for the hill thereof .

translation.kha: Bad u la ong ha U Jisu , To kynmaw ïa nga , ko Jisu , haba me wan kum u Syiem !
translation.en: And he said unto Jesus , Lord , remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom .
So the  Lord  blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning : for he had fourteen thousand sheep , and six thousand camels , and a thousand yoke of oxen , and a thousand she asses .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kyrkhu ïa ka bynta kaba khatduh jong ka jingim u Job kham palat ban ïa kaba u la kyrkhu ha kaba mynnyngkong . U Job u long trai ïa ki khatsaw hajar tylli ki langbrot , hynriew hajar tylli ki ut , ar hajar tylli ki masi , bad shihajar tylli ki kada .

translation.en: For the  Lord  hath chosen Jacob unto himself , and Israel for his peculiar treasure .
translation.kha: U la jied ïa u Jakob na ka bynta ïa lade , ïa ki paid Israel na ka bynta jong u hi .
Hynriew tylli ki tnat ki mih na baroh rkhiang jongnga u , lai tylli na Kaei Kaei ka liang .
translation.en: And six branches going out of the sides thereof  ; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side thereof , and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side thereof :
Nevertheless the  Lord  thy God would not hearken unto Balaam  ; but the  Lord  thy God turned the curse into a blessing unto thee , because the  Lord  thy God loved thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  U Blei jong phi un ym sngap ïa u Balaam ; u pynkylla pynban ïa kata ka jingtim sha ka jingkyrkhu , namar ba u ieit ïa phi .
