Balei ba me pynlong ïa nga ban ïohi ïa kaba kum kano ka jingjynjar ? Kumjuh me lai Ban shu peit ïa kaba kum Kane ka jingleh bymdei ? Ka jingpynjot bad ka jinglehbor ki don baroh sawdong jong nga , bad ka don ka jingïaleh bad jingïakajia ha kylleng .
translation.en: Why dost thou shew me iniquity , and cause me to behold grievance ? for spoiling and violence are before me : and there are that raise up strife and contention .

translation.kha: U Blei Bakhuid bad u nongpynïaid ki Isaia u ong ïa utai uba shah ibeiñ , ïa ibha la Isih da ki jaitbynriew bad ibha Long u shakri jong ki nongsynshar : Ki syiem kin ïohi ba la pyllait ïa me bad kine ïeng ban pynpaw ïa ka jingñiewburom jong ki ; ki khun syiem ruh ktang Ïohi ïa tala , bad kin dem khrup ban pyndonburom ïa me . Kane kan jai ñiar U Trai u la jied ïa la u shakri ; U Blei bakhuid jong ki Israel u bat ïa la ki kular .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , the Redeemer of Israel , and his Holy One , to him whom man despiseth , to him whom the nation abhorreth , to a servant of rulers , Kings shall see and arise , princes also shall worship , because of the  Lord  that is faithful , and the Holy One of Israel , and he shall choose thee .

translation.kha: Phim ju pyrthat da lin lei ban pyndonburom ïa nga , wat la nga phah ïa u sleit synlar Bad ïa u slap pyrem bad ai ha phi ïa ka Aniam ot man la ka snem .
translation.en: Neither say they in their heart , Let us now fear the  Lord  our God , that giveth rain , both the former and the latter , in his season : he reserveth unto us the appointed weeks of the harvest .

translation.kha: Ka pop kam de shuh ban synshar ïa ki met ki jong phi , da ka pynkohnguh sha ki jingkwah jongu ka jinglong tynrai jong pa’ .
translation.en: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body , that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof .
The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even , and shall not eat of the holy things , unless he wash his flesh with water .
translation.kha: Uta u briew uba kylla long u bymkhuid un ïaisah u bymkhuid haduh janmiet , hynrei la katta ruh um lah ban bam ïa ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang tad haduh ba u la dep sum .
U Isaïah u leit noh na u syiad , hawei ha shuwa ba un ïaid lyngba ïa ka phyllaw pdeng ka ïingbishar jong ka jingïam , U Trai u ïai-ong ïa u
translation.en: And it came to pass , afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court , that the word of the  Lord  came to him , saying ,

translation.kha: Nga jubab , Ko Trai Nongsharai , ngam tip kumno baneh krensih ; nga dang khñiang eh .
translation.en: Then said I , Ah , Lord  God  ! behold , I cannot speak : for I am a child .
And we took all his cities at that time , there was not a city which we took not from them , threescore cities , all the region of Argob , the kingdom of Og in Bashan .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ruh ngi ïohknieh ïa ki shnong jong u baroh — ym don kawei ruh kaba lait ; baroh kita ki shnong ki long hynriewphew tylli — ïa ka thain Argob baroh kawei ha kaba u Og u Syiem Bashan u synshar .

translation.en: Go , and gather the elders of Israel together , and say unto them , The  Lord  God of your fathers , the God of Abraham , of Isaac , and of Jacob , appeared unto me , saying , I have surely visited you , and seen that which is done to you in Egypt :
translation.kha: Khie leit lumlang ïa ki tymmen ki san jong ki Israel bad ïathuh ha ki ba nga U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , U Blei jong u Abraham , U Isaak , bad u Jakob , nga la mihpaw ha me . Ïathuh ruh ha ki ba nga la wan jngoh ïa ki , bad nga la ïohi aïu ki nong Ijipt ki la leh ïa ki .

Phi la ïohsngew ïa nga ba per ong ha Phi , ‘ Ngan sa leit noh! , hynrei ngan sa wan pat sha phi .’ Lada pa la ieit ïa nga , phin kmen namar ba ngan sa leit sha U Kpa ; naba u longïng kham khraw don ïa nga .
translation.en: Ye have heard how I said unto you , I go away , and come again unto you . If ye loved me , ye would rejoice , because I said , I go unto the Father : for my Father is greater than I .
But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham , and blessed him that had the promises .
translation.kha: U Melkhisedek um shym la hiarpateng na u Lebi , hynrei u la lum ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew na u Abraham bad u la kyrkhu ïa u , u briew uba la ïohpdiang ïa ki jingkular jong U Blei .

translation.en: And David perceived that the  Lord  had established him king over Israel , and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Israel s sake .
translation.kha: Bad kumta u Dabid u sngewthuh ba U  Trai  u la pynskhem ïa u kum u syiem ki Israel bad u la kyntiew ïa ka hima jong u na ka bynta ki briew jong u .
mynba to hiar noh na ka diengphna bad to pynim ïa lade !
translation.en: Save thyself , and come down from the cross .

translation.kha: Thaw ïa ka pyrem da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba rong saw . Suh pynïap itynnat ha ka da ka dur ki kherub .
translation.en: And thou shalt make a veil of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen of cunning work : with cherubims shall it be made :

translation.kha: Ka dei ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u ba ka kynha shipai Babilonia , ha ka hukum ki rangbah pynïaidkam jrong u Nebukhadnessar , ki la tur pyrshah ïa ka Jerusalem , dara kerkut ïa ka .
translation.en: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against Jerusalem , and the city was besieged .
Take heed that ye despise not one of these little ones  ; for I say unto you , That in heaven their angels do always behold the face of my Father which is in heaven .
translation.kha: To sumar ba phin ym ibeiñ ïano ïano na kine kiba rit . Ki angel jong ki ha bneng , nga ong ha phi , ki ïai don ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong U Kpa jong nga uba ha bneng .

Kine ki Lebi harum ki ai ïa ka jingkhangïit sha ka jingmane : u Jeshua , u Kedemah , u Bani , u Hashabneïah , u Sherebaïah , u Hodaïah , u Shebanaïah , bad u Pethahaïah . Ki noh : Ïeng nabar ïaroh ïa U Tiras U Blei jong phi ; ïaroh ïa u junom la junom ! Ai ba baroh ktien ïaroh ïa ka kyrteng badonburom jong u , wat la ym don ka jingïaroh ba kynja bri kaba khrup palat .
translation.en: Then the Levites , Jeshua , and Kadmiel , Bani , Hashabniah , Sherebiah , Hodijah , Shebaniah , and Pethahiah , said , Stand up and bless the  Lord  your God for ever and ever : and blessed be thy glorious name , which is exalted above all blessing and praise .
But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the  Lord   ; two young bullocks , and one ram , and seven lambs of the first year : they shall be unto you without blemish :
translation.kha: Wanrah ïa ka jingainguh thang kum ka jingainguh bam ha U  Trai  : ar tylli ki masi lyngraw , uwei u langbrot , bad hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot shynrang kiba shisnem ka rta , ki bym don kano kano ka jingduna .
Hangta u pung u khun sha sepngi shaduh Ahussath Tabor , bad nangta sha Hukkok , da kaba kynja ïa ka Sebulun shaphang shathie , ka Asher shaphang sorki , malu ïa ka Jeraïah shaphang mihngi .
translation.en: And then the coast turneth westward to Aznoth–tabor , and goeth out from thence to Hukkok , and reacheth to Zebulun on the south side , and reacheth to Asher on the west side , and to Judah upon Jordan toward the sunrising .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ïa per , Ko Jeremaïah , haba uwei na ki bynriew jong nga ne u nongïathuhlypa ne u lyngdoh u kylli ïa me , ‘ Kaei ka khubor jongngi U Trei ?’ Men ïathuh ha u , ‘ Me long ka jingkit ïa U Trai , bad un sa kynther noh ïa me .’
translation.en: And when this people , or the prophet , or a priest , shall ask thee , saying , What is the burden of the  Lord  ? thou shalt then say unto them , What burden ? I will even forsake you , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Syiem Daberath u la lup ïa ki ïabah jong u baroh , u pynbynta ïa ki ha ki kynhun kiba shihajar ngut bad ibha shispah ngut , bad u buh ki rangbah pynïaidkam ban ai hukum ïa ki .
translation.en: And David numbered the people that were with him , and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them .

Righteous art thou , O  Lord  , when I plead with thee : yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments : Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper ? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously ?
translation.kha: A  Trai  , lada nga ïasaid ïa ka kam jong nga bad me , men pynshisha ba me long ha kaba dei . Pynban nga dei ban kylli ïa me shaphang ki bynta ka jingbishar hok . Balei ba ki rangbah basniew ki manbha katta katta ? Balei ba ki rangbah bymhok ki jop ?

Da ka jingïap jong u halor ka diengphna , U Khrist u la pynpoh thiaw ïa ka jingïashun jyllang ki ; da ka lynti jong ka diengpynïeng u la pynïasoh lang ar ki jingïapthngan ha kawei ka met , bad u la wallam pat ïa ki sha U Blei .
translation.en: And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross , having slain the enmity thereby :
For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost .
translation.kha: U Khun U Briew u la wan ban wad bad ban pynim ïa kiba la jah noh .

Ka jingduh ka Tap ïa ka Tahpanhes haba nur pynkheiñ ïa ka bor jong ka Ijipt bad ngan pynkut ïa ka jingkhlaiñ kaba ki sngewsarong palat . U lyoh un kah ïa ka Ijipt , bad ki briew jong ki nongbud jongngi ka baroh kin shah ïalam kum ki koidi .
translation.en: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall be darkened , when I shall break there the yokes of Egypt : and the pomp of her strength shall cease in her : as for her , a cloud shall cover her , and her daughters shall go into captivity .

translation.kha: Bad mynta U Tiras u la pyndep ïa ka kular jong u . Nga la kiew ïa ka khet u khap jong nga , u sahmiet ki Israel bad nga la tei ïa ka Templ ban mane ïa U Trei U Blei ki Israel .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath performed his word that he spake , and I am risen up in the room of David my father , and sit on the throne of Israel , as the  Lord  promised , and have built an house for the name of the  Lord  God of Israel .

translation.kha: Eliada kita ki dat ki Long bakha leilieh blad , ki den tong ki dak thohbria ha ka sniehdoh jong ; uta u briew’ u long uba khuid .
translation.en: Then the priest shall look : and , behold , if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white  ; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin  ; he is clean .

translation.kha: len ai bapaw ha ka ïa ki bri sohwaiñ jong ka , bad tun Pynlong ïa ka Them Jingshitom sha ka khyrdop ka jingkmen . Hangta kan sa phai ktien ïa nga kumba ka la leh mynba ka dang samla , mynba ka wan mihnoh na ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And I will give her her vineyards from thence , and the valley of Achor for a door of hope : and she shall sing there , as in the days of her youth , and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: ( Mynba u syiad Nebukhadnessar u la rah sha Babilonia ïa u syiem ka Judah , u Jehoïakhin u khun jong u Jehoïada , bad ïa ki rangbah basawbthuh jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem , u la iehnoh ïa ki rishot , ka dabor bai , ki nang tan , bad katto katne tylli kiaw pat ki jingkynshew ka Templ . )
translation.en: Which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon took not , when he carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon , and all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem  ;

translation.kha: Ha kane ka mano , phin ïoh ïa ka hok ba-pura ban rung sha ka Hima bymjukut jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Terah bad U Nongpynim jong moi .
translation.en: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ .
When Leah saw that she had left bearing , she took Zilpah her maid , and gave her Jacob to wife .
translation.kha: Haba ka Leah ka sngewthuh ba ka la wai ban ïoh khun , ka la ai ïa ka mraw jong ka , ka Silpah ha u Jakob kum ka tnga jong u .
Sangeh ! u Shelemaïah u hukum , bad ngan ïathuh ha phi ïa khie kaba U Trai u la ong ha ar hynne mynmiet . Ïathuh ïa nga , ong u Saul .
translation.en: Then Samuel said unto Saul , Stay , and I will tell thee what the  Lord  hath said to me this night . And he said unto him , Say on .
Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle , and were gathered together at Soco , which belongeth to Judah , and pitched between Soco and Azekah , in Ephes–dammim .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïalumlang ban ïaleh thma ha Sokoh , ka shnong kaba ha Judah ; ki sher dara ha kawei ka jaka kaba ki khot Ephes Dammim , kaba hapdeng ka Sokoh bad ka Asekah .

Phi ong ba nga beh noh ïa ki ksuid namar ba u Shebuel u ai ha nga ka bor ban leh kumta . Ñiuma , te , mano ba ai ha ki briew jong phi ka tam ban beh noh ïa ki ? Kaei Kaba ki briew jongno phi hi ki leh ka pynshisha ba Phin bakla !
translation.en: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils , by whom do your children cast them out ? therefore they shall be your judges .

translation.kha: Hato me wan ban kynshew ïa nga , A Balei ? Lada me leh kumta , nga kloi ban shu sngap jar badno ïaw noh .
translation.en: Who is he that will plead with me ? for now , if I hold my tongue , I shall give up the ghost .

translation.kha: Ngin ym shim kynta ïa kano kano ka jingdon jing phangpdeng jong ki ha kawei pang ka pud jongno ka Jordan , Naamah ngi la ïohpdiang ïa la ka bhah shnat ha ka phang mihngi jong ka ïadon .
translation.en: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan , or forward  ; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward .

Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter s clay : for shall the work say of him that made it , He made me not ? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it , He had no understanding ?
translation.kha: Ki pynkylla khongpong ïa kiei kiei baroh . Kano kaba kham donkam , u nongthaw khiew ne ka dewbyrtha ? Hato lah mo ba kaei kaei kaba u briew u la thaw kan ong ha u ,  Phim shym la thaw ïa nga ?  Lane hato ka lah ban ong ha u ,  Phim tip ïa kaei kaba phi leh ?

translation.en: But Gehazi , the servant of Elisha the man of God , said , Behold , my master hath spared Naaman this Syrian , in not receiving at his hands that which he brought : but , as the  Lord  liveth , I will run after him , and take somewhat of him .
translation.kha: haba u Gehasi , u shakri jong u Elisha , u ong ha lade ,  U kynrad jong nga u la pyllait ïa u Naaman ban leit noh khlem da siew ei ei ! U la dei ban pdiang ïa kaei kaba uto u Syria u tyrwa ïa u . Da U  Trai  uba im , ngan mareh hadien jong u bad ngan ïoh ei ei na u .

translation.en: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth  ; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up .
translation.kha: Ym don mano mano ban ïalam ïa pha , ym don uno uno napdeng ki briew jong pha ban btin ïa pha da ka kti .
bad siat ïa nga da ki khnam na baïar sawdong — ki khnam kiba ngan lyngngai ki pynmynsaw ïa nga : dara kam la katta ruh um pyn-i jingisynei .
translation.en: His archers compass me round about , he cleaveth my reins asunder , and doth not spare  ; he poureth out my gall upon the ground .

translation.kha: Mynta de tip ba U Trai u khnam khraw ban ïa ki blei baroh , namar u la leh ïa kane mynba ki nong Ijipt ki la lehbeiñ seng palat ïa ki Jerusalem .
translation.en: Now I know that the  Lord  is greater than all gods : for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them .

translation.kha: Nga ainguh ïa U Bel ba nga kren ha ki thylliej bapher kham bad ban ïa ine ine na phi .
translation.en: I thank my God , I speak with tongues more than ye all :

translation.kha: Haba nga dem ban thiah , ki kynta ki ïaid suki nga khih pisa barabor Shi miet bad ka slem ban kyndat shai .
translation.en: When I lie down , I say , When shall I arise , and the night be gone ? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day .

translation.kha: Lada u briew u don ar ngut ki tngit bad baroh ar ki Ïohi ïakhun shynrang na u , hynrei u khup uba nyngkong um dadien na ka tnga kaba u kham ieit ,
translation.en: If a man have two wives , one beloved , and another hated , and they have born him children , both the beloved and the hated  ; and if the firstborn son be hers that was hated :
And Samson said concerning them , Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines , though I do them a displeasure .
translation.kha: U Samson u ong ,  Mynta ka kynti , ngan ym kitkhlieh ïa kaei ba ngan sa leh ïa ki Philistia .
Balei , te , ba phi khmih ïa u thiat ha ka khmat u para jong phi , bad phoi Khlem pynleit jingmut ïa ka lyngkhot dieng hapoh ka khamtam jongu phi hi ?
translation.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother s eye , but considerest not the beam that is in thine own eye ?

translation.kha: Nangta ki synran hapoh ka lieng ki la mane ïa U Jisu . Da shisha me long U Khun U Blei ! ki la pynbna .
translation.en: Then they that were in the ship came and worshipped him , saying , Of a truth thou art the Son of God .
And by great waters the seed of Sihor , the harvest of the river , is her revenue  ; and she is a mart of nations .
translation.kha: To ïam pangnud , phi ki nongkhaïi ka Sidon ! Phi phah ïa ki rangbah sha shiliang ka duriaw ban thied bad ban die ïa u kew uba mih ha Ijipt bad ban ïakhaïi bad baroh ki jaitbynriew .

translation.en: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years : and he died .
translation.kha: bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah khat-ar snem .
Ka kynhun shipai jongngi u Dabid ka la saw sha rudnong bad ïaleh ïa ki Israel ha ka khlaw Ephron .
translation.en: So the people went out into the field against Israel : and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim  ;
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Thus thou shalt say unto the children of Israel , Ye have seen that I have talked with you from heaven .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses ban ong ha ki Israel :  Phi la ïohi kumno ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren ha phi na bneng .
Ha sakma hi ka kynta jong ka miet , u nongbet phatok u la ïalam ïa ki bad u la sait ïa ki jingmong jong ki ; bad shisyndon la pynbaptis ïa u lem bad ka longïing jongno u .
translation.en: And he took them the same hour of the night , and washed their stripes  ; and was baptized , he and all his , straightway .
And when we cried unto the  Lord  God of our fathers , the  Lord  heard our voice , and looked on our affliction , and our labour , and our oppression :
translation.kha: Te ngi kyang sha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , ban ïarap ïa ngi . U la shahshkor ïa ngi , bad u la ïohi ba ngi shah jynjar , ngi hap trei shitom , bad ngi shah lehbeiñ .
U la long Uba khuid bad uba bha , hynrei phi la kyntait ïa u , bad pynban phi la kyrpad ïa u Pilat ban leh na ka bynta jong phi ban pyllait ïa u nongpynïap briew .
translation.en: But ye denied the Holy One and the Just , and desired a murderer to be granted unto you  ;

translation.kha: katba uba duk pat u don tang iwei i khunlangbrot , wer u la thied . U sumar ïa i , bad i heh i saiñ ha ïing jong u lem sad ki khun ki kti jong u . U ju bsa ïa i na ka jingbam jong u hi , malade shah ïa i ban dih na ka khuid jong u , bad u thum ïa i ha ka pneh jong u . Ita i khunlangbrot i la long kum ka khun kyntiap ïa u .
translation.en: But the poor man had nothing , save one little ewe lamb , which he had bought and nourished up : and it grew up together with him , and with his children  ; it did eat of his own meat , and drank of his own cup , and lay in his bosom , and was unto him as a daughter .

translation.kha: Haba phi tei ïa ka duwan U Trai U Blei jong phi , dak pynïar hajan jong ka ïa a Une u dieng uba don ka dur jong ka bleithaw Asherah .
translation.en: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the  Lord  thy God , which thou shalt make thee .

translation.kha: Nangta u la wan pat sha ki synran bad u la shem ba ki ïohthiah ; kim shym la lah ban khlieh ïa la ki lamkhmat . Bad kim shym la Tip ïa kaei baneh noh ïa u .
translation.en: And when he returned , he found them asleep again , ( for their eyes were heavy , ) neither wist they what to answer him .

Then the king said to Haman , Make haste , and take the apparel and the horse , as thou hast said , and do even so to Mordecai the Jew , that sitteth at the king s gate : let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ong ha u Haman ,  Pynkloi bad shim ïa ki jaiñphong bad ïa u kulai bad pyndonburom kumne ïa u Mordekai , u Jiw . Leh ïa u baroh kata kaba me la ai jingmut . Men shem ïa u ba u dang shong ha ka khyrdop jong ka ïingsyiem .
hynriew , haba u lyngdoh u la khmih bol pat ïa ka , lada kata ka jingbthuh ka la na dadien , u dei ban tar noh ïa sakma ka la bit bthuh na kata ka daiñ ne na kata ka snieh .
translation.en: And if the priest look , and , behold , the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it  ; then he shall rend it out of the garment , or out of the skin , or out of the warp , or out of the woof :
Now when the even was come , he sat down with the twelve .
translation.kha: Haba la janmiet , U Jisu bad ki khat-ar ngut ki synran ki la ïashong ban bam .

translation.en: The godly principles in the Bible show us how to live in a way that brings physical benefits .
translation.kha: Ka tynrai jong ka jingim ba riew Blei kaba don ha ka Baibl ka pyni ïa ngi kumno ban im ban sah ha ka rukom ka ban wanrah ka jingmyntoi shimet .

Man ka sngi , khlei pop , phi dei ban ai ïa ki lyngdoh ha Jerusalem ïa kaei kaei kaba ki ong ïa pa ba ki donkam : ki masi lyngraw , ki lumlang , lane ki khunlangbrot ban kñia kum ki jingainguh sha U Blei jong ka Bneng , lane u kew , ka mluh , ka waiñ , lane ka umphniang Olib .
translation.en: And that which they have need of , both young bullocks , and rams , and lambs , for the burnt offerings of the God of heaven , wheat , salt , wine , and oil , according to the appointment of the priests which are at Jerusalem , let it be given them day by day without fail :

translation.kha: Kine ki long ki proberb ki ban ïarap ïa Phin ban tip ïa ka jingsdang bad ka jinghikai kaba bha , bad banbeiñ shemphang ïa ki jingong uba jlew jingput .
translation.en: To know wisdom and instruction  ; to perceive the words of understanding  ;

translation.kha: U Philip u la Mareshah sha u bad u la ïohsngew ba u dong pule na ka Kitab u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa . U la kylli ïa u , Hato me sngewthuh ïa Kaei kaba me pulom ?
translation.en: And Philip ran thither to him , and heard him read the prophet Esaias , and said , Understandest thou what thou readest ?

translation.kha: Ki rangbah na Dan ki ong , Kan babha ba phin ym buiñ lymda phi khiew ïa kine ki briew don bitar bad ban kynrup ïa phi . Nangta ma Phi bad ka longïing jongno phi baroh Phin ïap .
translation.en: And the children of Dan said unto him , Let not thy voice be heard among us , lest angry fellows run upon thee , and thou lose thy life , with the lives of thy household .

translation.kha: Te ngan theh ïa ka jingat jong nga ha ki , bad kum ka ding ngan pynjot ïa ki na ka bynta kaei kaba ki la leh . U Trai Nongsynshar u la ong .
translation.en: Therefore have I poured out mine indignation upon them  ; I have consumed them with the fire of my wrath : their own way have I recompensed upon their heads , saith the Lord  God .
Am I not an apostle ? am I not free ? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord ? are not ye my work in the Lord ?
translation.kha: Hato ngam long u briew uba laitluid ? Hato ngam long u Apostol ? Hato ngam shym la ïohi ïa U Jisu uba U Trai jong ngi ? Hato phi phim long u soh ka jingtrei jong nga na ka bynta U Trai ?
U la pynhun ïa wer kiba sliang bad pyndap ïa kiba thngan da kiei kiei kiba bha .
translation.en: For he satisfieth the longing soul , and filleth the hungry soul with goodness .

translation.kha: Te u nongïathuhlypa tymmen uba na Bethel u ong ha u , Nga jin nga dei u nonghiarthma khem ma Phi , bad ha ka hukum jong U Trai , u angel u la ong ïa nga ban ïalam ïa phi shwa ïing bad ban ai ïa ka jingpdiang sngewbha ïa phira . Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa tymmen u lamkhmat .
translation.en: He said unto him , I am a prophet also as thou art  ; and an angel spake unto me by the word of the  Lord  , saying , Bring him back with thee into thine house , that he may eat bread and drink water . But he lied unto him .

translation.kha: Buh dak sdang tur u lum khnang ba ki briew kim dei ban jam palat , bad Ong ïa ki ba kin ym leit kiew sha u lum , lane wat ban leit tur sha jan jong u . Lada uno uno u leit ïuhkjat ha u lum , yn pynïap ïa u ;
translation.en: And thou shalt set bounds unto the people round about , saying , Take heed to yourselves , that ye go not up into the mount , or touch the border of it : whosoever toucheth the mount shall be surely put to death :

translation.kha: U bishar hok ïa kiba dukan , bad baroh ki ïaid beit badno u . Kata ka long ka jingmut ban ithuh ïa U Trai .
translation.en: He judged the cause of the poor and needy  ; then it was well with him : was not this to know me ? saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U ju khie dang step pynphieng sad u ju leit ïeng harud lynti ha ka khyrdop shnong . Haba a Une u biria u wan hangta bad ka jingïakajia kaba u kwah ïa u syiem ban pynbeit , u Abiram u ju khot ïa u , pynlang kylli ïa u , u dat uba nangne . Jaban hadien ba u briew u la ïathuh ïa u na nangno ka jait u daiñ ,
translation.en: And Absalom rose up early , and stood beside the way of the gate : and it was so , that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment , then Absalom called unto him , and said , Of what city art thou ? And he said , Thy servant is of one of the tribes of Israel .

translation.kha: yn ym don uwei ruh na kino ki bariew ki ïa-ban im ban ïohrung sha kata ka ri . Ki la ïuh ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ na ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga , bad ïa ki kambah ba nga la leh ha Joppa bad ha ka ri khlaw , hynrei ki la tyngshaiñ ïa ka jingïaishah lad nga la bunsien mala ki la kynta ban kohnguh ïa nga .
translation.en: Because all those men which have seen my glory , and my miracles , which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness , and have tempted me now these ten times , and have not hearkened to my voice  ;

translation.kha: nga kular ba ngan ai ha me ïa ki khun ki kyrsiew kat ki khlur ka sahit banyngkong , lane kat ki symboh shyiap Harhas ka duriaw . Ki khun ki ktieh jong me kin jop ïa ki nongshun jongnga ki .
translation.en: That in blessing I will bless thee , and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven , and as the sand which is upon the sea shore  ; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies  ;

translation.kha: haba u Joseph u wan ha la ki hynmen shynrang jong u , ki law noh ïa ka sloit jynsur jong u kaba jrong katei .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Joseph was come unto his brethren , that they stript Joseph out of his coat , his coat of many colours that was on him  ;
And in that day ye shall ask me nothing . Verily , verily , I say unto you , Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name , he will give it you .
translation.kha: Haba kata ka sngi ka poi , phin ym pan ei ei na nga . Nga ïathuh ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : U Kpa un ai ha phi ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan na u ha ka kyrteng jong nga .
Kumta ki la sdang pun wad dong pun pynshitom ïa U Jisu , namar ba u la leh ïa kane ka jingpynkhiah ha ka sngi Sabbaton .
translation.en: And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus , and sought to slay him , because he had done these things on the sabbath day .

translation.kha: Ka baburom U Blei ka la phet na Israel , ka ong , namsop ba la tyngeh noh ïa ka Synduk ka jinghun U Blei .
translation.en: And she said , The glory is departed from Israel : for the ark of God is taken .

translation.kha: naduh kata ka por , namar jong u Joseph , U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa ka longrynïeng longsem jong u nongïam Ijipt , bad ïa kiei kiei barben kiba u don ha ïing ka sem jong u lane ha lyngkha jongngi u .
translation.en: And it came to pass from the time that he had made him overseer in his house , and over all that he had , that the  Lord  blessed the Egyptian s house for Joseph s sake  ; and the blessing of the  Lord  was upon all that he had in the house , and in the field .

translation.kha: ha kaba u la shong hangta seraph snieh , da kaba shah pynshoi ha u Soitan . Ki mawdong ki la don ruh hangno , hynriew ki angel ki la wan badno ïarap ïa u .
translation.en: And he was there in the wilderness forty days , tempted of Satan  ; and was with the wild beasts  ; and the angels ministered unto him .
And thou shalt put into the ark the testimony which I shall give thee .
translation.kha: Nangta thep hapoh ka synduk ïa ki ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kiba ngan ai ha me , ha kiba la thoh ïa ki hukum jong nga .
Lada u briew u die mraw ïa la ka khum , kam ia ban ïoh ïaleit kumba ki mraw shynrang ki ïoh .
translation.en: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant , she shall not go out as the menservants do .

They that sanctify themselves , and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst , eating swine s flesh , and the abomination , and the mouse , shall be consumed together , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ,  Kaba kut ka la jan ïa kito kiba pynkhuid ïa lade na ka jingmane ba-thala , kiba ïaid paidbah ha ka kynhun sha ki kper bakyntang , bad kito kiba bam ïa ka doh sniang , bad ïa ka doh khnai bad kiwei pat ki jingbam ba-ijli .

U Jisu u la ong ha la ki synran , La don saihon uwei u briew uba riewspah uba la don u shakri uba pynïaid ïa ka jingdon jingong jong u . La ïathuh ha une u briew bariewspah ba u sordar jong u , u la pynsep-ei ïa ka pisa u kynrad jong u ,
translation.en: And he said also unto his disciples ,  There was a certain rich man , which had a steward  ; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods .

translation.kha: Balei phi tuh ïa ka khuri rupa u kynrad jyllang nga ? Ka dei katba u ju pyndonkam ban dih na ka , kaba u ju pyndonkam ha ka kheiñ ka bishar ? phin la leh ïa ka kam kaba shyrkhei .’
translation.en: Is not this it in which my lord drinketh , and whereby indeed he divineth ? ye have done evil in so doing .

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha Antiokh , ki la lumlang ïa ki briew jong ka ïalang bad ki la ïathuh ha ki ïa kamai kaei baroh kaba U Balei u la leh bad ki , bad kumno u la plie ka lyngki na ka bynta ki Nethanel baneh thwet .
translation.en: And when they were come , and had gathered the church together , they rehearsed all that God had done with them , and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles .
Let that day be darkness  ; let not God regard it from above , neither let the light shine upon it .
translation.kha: Pynkylla ïa kata ka sngi sha ka jingdum , A Blei . Wat kynmaw shuh ïa kata ka sngi ; Wat ai ba ka jingshai kan tyngshaiñ pat halor jong ka .

translation.en: And when he was gone , a lion met him by the way , and slew him : and his carcase was cast in the way , and the ass stood by it , the lion also stood by the carcase .
translation.kha: Ha lynti , u la ïakynduh ïa u sing uba la pynïap ïa u . Ka metïap jong u ka don ha ka lynti bah , bad ka kada bad u sing ki ïeng ha syndah jong ka .

translation.en: And there came a voice out of the cloud , saying , This is my beloved Son : hear him .
translation.kha: Ka sur ka la kren na u lyoh ,  Une u long U Khun jong nga , uba nga la jied — shahshkor ïa u !
Haba ki Assyria ki khamtam ïa ka ri jyllang ngi bad tur lyngba ki jingïada jong ngi , ngin phah ïa ki Nongïalam bakhlaiñ den ban ïaleh ïa ki .
translation.en: And this man shall be the peace , when the Assyrian shall come into our land : and when he shall tread in our palaces , then shall we raise against him seven shepherds , and eight principal men .

translation.kha: Semar bha ïa ailad ! Nga la ïathmu ïa kiei kiei baroh’ ha phi shu ba ka por kan poi .
translation.en: But take ye heed : behold , I have foretold you all things .

Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God , and he shall go no more out : and I will write upon him the name of my God , and the name of the city of my God , which is new Jerusalem , which cometh down out of heaven from my God : and I will write upon him my new name .
translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa uta uba jop , u rijied ha ka Templ jong U Blei jong nga , bad un ïailong hangta . Ngan thoh halor jong u ïa ka kyrteng U Blei jong nga bad ka kyrteng jong ka nongbah jong U Blei jong nga , ka Jerusalem bathymmai , ka ban wan hiar na bneng na U Blei jong nga . Ngan thoh ruh halor jong u ïa ka kyrteng bathymmai jong nga .
U Nathan u jubab , Ka jingkyrsiew kaba khraw i pa jong nga i la leh ïa ki briew jong ngi ! Khmih haduh katno nga sngew ïohbat namarba ba ar bam jingkyndit ka nongap !
translation.en: Then said Jonathan , My father hath troubled the land : see , I pray you , how mine eyes have been enlightened , because I tasted a little of this honey .
Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man , and he strengthened me ,
translation.kha: Sa shisien pat u la bat ïa nga , bad nga la kham sngew ïohbor .
Habor u Simri u ïohi ba ka nongbam ka la kyllon , u loit sha ka kut kaba hakpoh jong ka ïingsyiem , u Thang ïa ka ïingsyiem da ka ding bad u la ïap ha ki Thliew ding .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Zimri saw that the city was taken , that he went into the palace of the king s house , and burnt the king s house over him with fire , and died ,
Woe unto us ! who shall deliver us out of the hand of these mighty Gods ? these are the Gods that smote the Egyptians with all the plagues in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Uei keiñ uba lah ban pyllait ïa ngi na kine ki blei kiba khlaiñbor ? Kine ki dei kita ki blei kiba la shoh ïap ïa ki Ijipt ha ka ri shyiap !

translation.en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust , and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill , to set them among princes , and to make them inherit the throne of glory : for the pillars of the earth are the  Lord s  , and he hath set the world upon them .
translation.kha: U kyntiew ïa kiba duk na ka dewmet , bad u rah ïa kiba kyrduh na ka jingjynjar jong ki . U pynlong ïa ki , ki paralok jong ki khun syiem , bad buh ïa ki , ha ki jaka badonburom . Ki nongrim jong ka khyndew ki dei ki jong U  Trai  ; bad ha ki u la pynshong ïa ka pyrthei .
Pule ki Kam 15 :35 , peit kumno ba ha ka spah snem banyngkong , ka kynjah pynïaidkam ka la ïamir jingmut bad pynbeit ïa ka jingïarisa lyngba ki jingkynthoh bakhuid bad u mynhynne bakhuid .
translation.en: Read Acts 15 :1-35 , and see how the first-century governing body discussed and resolved a dispute with the help of the Scriptures and holy spirit .
Then Joshua built an altar unto the  Lord  God of Israel in mount Ebal ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u tei ha u Lum Ebal ïa ka duwan ha U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel .

translation.en: And these three men , Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace .
translation.kha: Te u Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego , kiba dang shah khum , ki la hap sha ka pdeng jong ka ding baklang .
Wai khap ïa u shñiuh ha ki kynriang ka khlieh jong phi lane khih ïa ki tmain
translation.en: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads , neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard .

translation.kha: Nangta u Saul u ong ha ki , Phi baroh ïeng hangtai , u Jonathan bad nga ngin ïong hangne . Leh ïa katno kano kaba phin pyrkhat ka bha tad , ki jubab .
translation.en: Then said he unto all Israel , Be ye on one side , and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side . And the people said unto Saul , Do what seemeth good unto thee .

So Joram went over to Zair , and all the chariots with him : and he rose by night , and smote the Edomites which compassed him about , and the captains of the chariots : and the people fled into their tents .
translation.kha: Kumta u Jehoram u leit sha Sair bad ki kali ïapom jong u baroh , ha kaba ka kynhun shipai Edom ka la kerkut ïa ki . Ha ka por mynmiet ma u bad ki rangbah ai hukum jong ki kali ïapom ki la ïohlad ban lait bad ki phet ïap , bad ki shipai jong u ki phet sakma sha ki ïing jong ki .
Shuh shuh , nga la bahkhlieh ha i pa da la ka jingim na ka bynta u to . Ngam ong ïa i ba lada ngam wan ïalam pat ïa u para sha i , ngan sa kit pop ma nga shi thma .
translation.en: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father , saying , If I bring him not unto thee , then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever .

translation.kha: Keiñ ki bariew kim don ka jingshemphang , hynrei la shem sngewbha ha ka aiñ jong me .
translation.en: Their heart is as fat as grease  ; but I delight in thy law .

translation.kha: Dei ma nga uta uba la jied ïa ki ba-ha-ïing sem lad me , ki Lebi , pangnud ki Israel kum ka jingai sngewbiang ïa me . Ki , ki long kiba la pynkyrpang sha nga , Khnang ba ki lah ban pyndep ïa la ki kamram ha ka Jingpynïoh .
translation.en: And I , behold , I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel : to you they are given as a gift for the  Lord  , to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation .

translation.kha: U Eliakim u la kulai na U Trai ïa kaei ba u Dabid u dem ban leh , bad nangta u la ai katto katne ka jingbam ha u Dabid bad ïa ka waitlam u Goliath u nong Pheliks .
translation.en: And he enquired of the  Lord  for him , and gave him victuals , and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine .
And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn , nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering .
translation.kha: Baroh ki mrad ha ki khlaw jong ka Lebanon kim pat biang na ka bynta ka jingkñia sha U Blei jong ngi , bad ki dieng jong ka ki khyndiat eh ban pynmeh ïa ka ding .
badno u la phah kem ïa u Joseph bad u set ïa u ha ka byndi ha ka jaka ba la set ïa ki koidi jong u syiem , bun hangta la pynjah ïa u .
translation.en: And Joseph s master took him , and put him into the prison , a place where the king s prisoners were bound : and he was there in the prison .
And Jesus answering said ,  A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho , and fell among thieves , which stripped him of his raiment , and wounded him , and departed , leaving him half dead .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ,  Shisien la don u briew uba la leit hiar na Jerusalem sha Jerikho mynba ki nonglute ki la tur ïaleh ïa u , ki la sloit lyngkhuit ïa u , bad ki la shoh ïa u , ki da iehnoh lyngktop ïa u kum uba ïap .

translation.en: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation , and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you , an ordinance for ever in your generations : as ye are , so shall the stranger be before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Pateng la pateng , kijuh ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ki teh ïa phi bad ïa ki nongwei kiba shong basah bad phi . Ma phi bad ma ki phi ïalong kumjuh ha khmat U  Trai .

translation.en: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs , and with wonders , and with a strong hand , and with a stretched out arm , and with great terror  ;
translation.kha: Da ki kambah bad ki jingphylla kiba la pynsngewshyrkhei ïa ki nongshun jong ngi , me la pyndonkam ïa ka bor bad ka borbah jong me ban wallam ïa ki briew jong me , ki Israel , na ka ri Ijipt .
wai la ïa ka jingnoh shikhung la bashyrkhei , un pynrem ïa me ,
translation.en: He will surely reprove you , if ye do secretly accept persons .

Her former husband , which sent her away , may not take her again to be his wife , after that she is defiled  ; for that is abomination before the  Lord  : and thou shalt not cause the land to sin , which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee for an inheritance .
translation.kha: uta u tnga nyngkong um dei shuh ban ïapoi shongkurim bad ka , namar ba ka la shah pyntngit . Lada u leh kumta , kan long kaba ijli ha khmat U  Trai  , bad phim dei ban leh kum kata ka pop kaba sngewshyrkhei ha kata ka ri ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u ai ha phi .

translation.en: And when they were come in , they went up into an upper room , where abode both Peter , and James , and John , and Andrew , Philip , and Thomas , Bartholomew , and Matthew , James the son of Alphaeus , and Simon Zelotes , and Judas the brother of James .
translation.kha: Ki la rung sha ka nongbah bad ki la leit sha ka kamra ha kaba ki la sah : U Petros , u Ïoannis , u Jakob bad u Andriw , u Philip bad u Thomas , u Bartholomai bad u Matthaïos , u Jakob u khun jong u Alphaïos , u Simon u Riew-ieit Ri , bad u Judas u khun jong u Jakob .
Nangta u jop ïa ki Moab . U la phah thiah ïa ki jakoid ha madan malu pynïap ar ngut na man ki lai ngat . Kuth ki Moab ki kylla long noh ki raïot jong u , bad ki siew khajna sha u .
translation.en: And he smote Moab , and measured them with a line , casting them down to the ground  ; even with two lines measured he to put to death , and with one full line to keep alive . And so the Moabites became David s servants , and brought gifts .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta ka jingsynshar jong phi! kan ym bteng . Nimrah ba phim syiem kohnguh ïa u , U Trai un wad ïa u briew uba u kwah bun un thung ïa u ban longkmie nongshniah ïa ki briew jong u .
translation.en: But now thy kingdom shall not continue : the  Lord  hath sought him a man after his own heart , and the  Lord  hath commanded him to be captain over his people , because thou hast not kept that which the  Lord  commanded thee .
Bless the  Lord  , O my soul . O  Lord  my God , thou art very great  ; thou art clothed with honour and majesty .
translation.kha: Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  , ko mynsiem jong nga ! A  Trai  , U Blei jong nga , katno me long uba khraw ! Me kup da ka burom syiem bad ka burom ;

translation.en: Verily , verily , I say unto thee , We speak that we do know , and testify that we have seen  ; and ye receive not our witness .
translation.kha: Nga ïathuh ha me ïa ka jingshisha : Ngi kren ïa kaei kaba ngi tip bad ngi ïathuh ïa kaei kaba ngi la ïohi , pynban , ym don na phi uba mon ban pdiang ïa ka khubor jong ngi .
Phin waiñ lem ne em dara nga ?
translation.en: Will you come with me ?

translation.kha: Kane ka la long ka jingmaham ïa ki Israel ba uno uno u bym shym la hiarpateng na u Aaron um bit ba Wan sha ka duwan ban thang jingiwbih ha khmat U Trai , lym kumjuh un shah pynjot thew kum u Korah bad ki nongbud jong u . Ïa kane baroh’ la leh kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u Eleasar da u Moses .
translation.en: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel , that no stranger , which is not of the seed of Aaron , come near to offer incense before the  Lord   ; that he be not as Korah , and as his company : as the  Lord  said to him by the hand of Moses .
And God came unto Balaam at night , and said unto him , If the men come to call thee , rise up , and go with them  ; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee , that shalt thou do .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet U Blei u la wan ha u Balaam bad u ong ,  Lada kine ki briew ki la wan khot ïa me ban leit bad ki , to khreh ban leit ; hynrei leh tang ïa kata kaba nga ong ha me .

U thri u ong ha to , ‘ Wat pynjynjar ïa ki biria jongki ka ri Maw , ki khun ki ksiew jong u Lot , lane wiat ïaleh thma bad ki . NGA la ai ha ki ïa ka shnong Ar , mala ngan ym ai ei ei ïa phi na ka ri jong ki .’
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , Distress not the Moabites , neither contend with them in battle : for I will not give thee of their land for a possession  ; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession .

translation.kha: U la bthah ïa ki ban ong , Nga u Jakob , u Sikhri bakohnguh jong phi , la pyntip ha u kynrad jongki per u Iso ba nga la shong la sah bad u Ladan , bad nga la pynsum ban wanpaw phai haduh mynta .
translation.en: And he commanded them , saying , Thus shall ye speak unto my lord Esau  ; Thy servant Jacob saith thus , I have sojourned with Laban , and stayed there until now :

translation.kha: Ngi la ñiewbeiñ ïa u bad ngi la kyntait ïa u ; u la shahïap ïa ka jingshitrhem bad jingpang . Ym don mano mano wat ba-bang peit ïa u — ngi la leh bymsalia ïa u kum u bym Long ei ei .
translation.en: He is despised and rejected of men  ; a man of sorrows , and acquainted with grief : and we hid as it were our faces from him  ; he was despised , and we esteemed him not .

translation.kha: Haba u la dep ai ki jingkha , u la ring ïa u paidïapom ha ka kyrteng U Trai Badonbor Baroh
translation.en: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings , he blessed the people in the name of the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Ma phi ki Philistia phi long kiba la tim , phi ki brai kiba shong basah ha shi lynti jong ka rud duriaw . U Trai u la ai ka rai bishar Hamor jongki phi . Un pynstet ïa phi , bad yn ym pynshai ïa uwei ruh .
translation.en: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast , the nation of the Cherethites ! the word of the  Lord  is against you  ; O Canaan , the land of the Philistines , I will even destroy thee , that there shall be no inhabitant .

translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi ki la leit hadien ba U Trai U la shohdoh ïa ka wah .
translation.en: And seven days were fulfilled , after that the  Lord  had smitten the river .

translation.kha: Ka kynthei ba la shongkurim , kum ka nuksa , ka shah ter da ka hukum ha la u tnga katba u dang im ; isynei haba u la ïap , te ka la lait na ka sah” kaba teh ïa ka bad u .
translation.en: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth ; but if the husband be dead , she is loosed from the law of her husband .
Having a form of godliness , but denying the power thereof : from such turn away .
translation.kha: ki bat ïa kaba paw shabar jong ka niam jong ki , hynrei kin kyntait ïa ka bor bashisha jong ka . To kiar noh na kiba kum kita ki briew .

Phi longïing kaba riewspah katta katta ha baroh kiba phi khong : Ha ka jingngeit , ka jingkren , bad ka jingtip , ha ka jingangnud ban ïarap bad ha ka jingtieng jngai phi ïa ngi . Bad kumta ngi khoh ïa phi ban long kiba sbun ruh ha kane ka jingshakri jong ka jingieit .
translation.en: Therefore , as ye abound in every thing , in faith , and utterance , and knowledge , and in all diligence , and in your love to us , see that ye abound in this grace also .

Forasmuch as we have heard , that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words , subverting your souls , saying , Ye must be circumcised , and keep the law : to whom we gave no such commandment :
translation.kha: Ngi la ïohsngew ba katto katne ngut kiba la leit na ka kynhun jong ngi kiba la pynjynjar bad pynkhuslai ïa phi da kaei kaba ki la ong ; pynban , kim shym la ïohpdiang kano kano ka jingbthah na ngi .

translation.en: Jesus and the 144 ,000 form a righteous heavenly government —God’s Kingdom . —Revelation 14 :1-3 .
translation.kha: U Jisu lem bad ki 1 ,44 ,000 ngut kin seng ïa ka hima ha bneng . Kata ka dei ka Hima jong U Blei .—Jingpynpaw 14 :1-3 .

translation.en: My sheep wandered through all the mountains , and upon every high hill : yea , my flock was scattered upon all the face of the earth , and none did search or seek after them .
translation.kha: Kumta ki langbrot jong nga ki ïaid sakma sha ki lumrit bajrong bad ki lumbah . La pynsakma ïa ki kylleng ka pyrthei , bad ym don ba ïit ïa ki ne pyrshang ban wad ïa ki .

U mynhynne jong U Trai u long ha nga , namar ba u la jied ïa nga ban wallam ka khubor babha ha kiba duk . U la phah ïa ar ban pynban ka jingpyllaitluid ïa ki koidi bad ka jingpynjynjar ïa ka jingim ha kiba matlah ; ban pyllut ïa kba la shah banbeiñ
translation.en: The Spirit of the Lord is upon me , because he hath anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor  ; he hath sent me to heal the brokenhearted , to preach deliverance to the captives , and recovering of sight to the blind , to set at liberty them that are bruised ,
Then went Samson down , and his father and his mother , to Timnah , and came to the vineyards of Timnah : and , behold , a young lion roared against him .
translation.kha: Kumta u Samson u leit hiar sha Timnah ryngkat bad la u kpa bad ka kmie . Katba ki dang ïaid lyngba ki bri sohwaiñ hangta , u ïohsngew ïa u sing samla ba u kyrhuh .
Na ka boitha jong nga , ka por ka la poi ïa nga ban shah kñia ; ka por ka long mynta ïa nga ban iaineh ïa kane ka jingim .
translation.en: For I am now ready to be offered , and the time of my departure is at hand .

translation.kha: Phi tharai ngam Shimham kren ei ei hynrei Tang ka lyer ; te bapli phi jubab ïa ki ktung ka jingidiaw jong na ?
translation.en: Do ye imagine to reprove words , and the speeches of one that is desperate , which are as wind ?

translation.kha: Kumjuh Ngi lah ban ïor Jingmyntoi da ka Ïakynduhlang bad La ki Para bangeit ?
translation.en: How Does Association With Fellow Christians Benefit Us ?

translation.kha: U Moses u khot ngan ïa ki Israel baroh , bad u ong ha ki , Phai la ïohi da lade hi aïu U Trai u la kun ïa u Pharpar ha Ijipt , ïa ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad ïa ka ri jong u baroh kawei .
translation.en: And Moses called unto all Israel , and said unto them , Ye have seen all that the  Lord  did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh , and unto all his servants , and unto all his land  ;

And the men of Israel answered the men of Judah , and said , We have ten parts in the king , and we have also more right in David than ye : why then did ye despise us , that our advice should not be first had in bringing back our king ? And the words of the men of Judah were fiercer than the words of the men of Israel .
translation.kha: Ki Israel ki jubab ,  Ngi don shiphew shah ki jingkam halor u syiem kumba phi , phi don , wat la u dei uwei na phi . Balei phi khmih beiñ ïa ngi ? Wat klet ba ngi dei kiba nyngkong ban ïakren shaphang ka jingwallam pat ïa u syiem !  Hynrei ki rangbah ka Judah ki kham pyneh ha kaba pynpaw ïa ki jingkam jong ki ban ïa ki rangbah ka Israel .
Ïa kawei kaba nga ïathuh ïa phi ha kaba ngam phi Dei ban ïathiah ha kaba shai , bad ïa kaei kaba phi la ïohsngew ha kaba rieh phi daym ban pynnep na ki tngen ïing .
translation.en: What I tell you in darkness , that speak ye in light : and what ye hear in the ear , that preach ye upon the housetops .
Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins , which took their lamps , and went forth to meet the bridegroom .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por ka Hima ki bneng kan long kumne . Shisien la don shiphew ngut ki theisotti kiba la rah ïa la ki sharak bad ki la mih ban ïashem ïa u nongleitkurim .
To shahshkor , ma pa baher , ïa ka sur ka jong U Blei! , ïa u pyrthat uba mih na ka shyntur jongnga u .
translation.en: Hear attentively the noise of his voice , and the sound that goeth out of his mouth .

translation.kha: Un ïohpdiang shispah shah shuh shuh ki ïing , ki hynmen ki para Shynrang ne kynthei , ki kmie , ki khun bad ki lyngkhai — bad ki jingshah pynshitom beiñ ruh kumjuh ; pynlang ha ka pateng ka ban sa wan un Ïoh ka jingim bymsuidñiew .
translation.en: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time , houses , and brethren , and sisters , and mothers , and children , and lands , with persecutions  ; and in the world to come eternal life .

translation.kha: Hato ngin ong te , ba U Bela u long bymhok ? Ym kumta .
translation.en: What shall we say then ? Is there unrighteousness with God ? God forbid .

translation.kha: U Blei u la kuna ïa kata ha ka jingstad bad jingïadei jong u bhor ïa kaei kaba u la thuh , bad u la pynjop shynna ha ngi ïa ka jingthmu ba la buhrieh ïa kaba u la lah thmu lypa ban pynnep da U Khereth .
translation.en: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will , according to his good pleasure which he hath purposed in himself :

translation.kha: Ka jingbitar ka long kabu shyrkhei bad kaba pynjot , hynrei kam long ei ei hajan ïanujor nabar ka jingpihuiñ .
translation.en: Wrath is cruel , and anger is outrageous  ; but who is able to stand before envy ?

translation.kha: Tang ma me marwei men wan sha jan jong de ; kita kiwei pat kam bit ban wanlam sha jan . U paidbah lei lei um bit ban wan kiew sha uta u lum .
translation.en: And Moses alone shall come near the  Lord  : but they shall not come nigh  ; neither shall the people go up with him .
For they cast down every man his rod , and they became serpents : but Aaron s rod swallowed up their rods .
translation.kha: Ki la bret ïa la ki diengduh , bad kita ki kylla bseiñ . Hynrei u diengduh jong u Aaron u la nguid ïa ki diengduh jong ki .

Akaba mih ka long ba u syn jong une u sordar bymhok u la ïaroh ïa u ba u leh ïa kaba koum Kanneh kaba shnat ; namar ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei ki long kiba kham sianti ha kaba trei ïa la ki kam ban ïa ki briew kiba long ki jong ka jingshai .
translation.en: And the lord commended the unjust steward , because he had done wisely : for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light .

translation.kha: Ka nongshun kaba khat ïa kaba dem ïa-ban pynjot ka long ka jingap .
translation.en: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death .

translation.kha: Ngi la pynsleh ïa u Absalom kum u syiem jong sem , hynrei u la shah pynsep ha ka thma . Kumta , balei ym Don mano mano ba pyrshang ban wallam biang ïa u syiem Dabid ?
translation.en: And Absalom , whom we anointed over us , is dead in battle . Now therefore why speak ye not a word of bringing the king back ?
That frustrateth the tokens of the liars , and maketh diviners mad  ; that turneth wise men backward , and maketh their knowledge foolish  ;
translation.kha: Nga pynpaw bieit ïa ki nongpeit kti bad pynkulmar ïa ki jingïathuh lypa ki nongbatai kupar . Ki ktien jong kiba stad nga kyntait bad pyn-i ba ka jingstad jong ki ka long ka jingbieit .

translation.en: And she brought up one of her whelps : it became a young lion , and it learned to catch the prey  ; it devoured men .
translation.kha: Ka la pynheh pynsan ïa uwei u khun sing bad hikai ïa u kumno ban behmrad ; u la long u nongbam briew .
Ha ka pyrthei ba thymmai , ka jingim kaba Suk lem dara ka jingtap jingkhiah ba jingjanai .—Jingpynpaw 21 :3 , 4 .
translation.en: In a coming new world , life in perfect health and happiness . —Revelation 21 :3 , 4 .

translation.kha: Ki briew ka Syria ki la thied ïa ki mar khaïi bad ïa ki jingmih ba bun jyllang pha . Ki la ai ïa ki markordor Emerald , ki jaiñ bymnang , ki jingthain ba-itynnat , ki linen bakynsai , ki Koral , pynlang ki mawkordor Rubi kum ka jingsiew na ka bynta ki mar jong phah .
translation.en: Syria was thy merchant by reason of the multitude of the wares of thy making : they occupied in thy fairs with emeralds , purple , and broidered work , and fine linen , and coral , and agate .
Which was the son of Saruch , which was the son of Ragau , which was the son of Phalec , which was the son of Heber , which was the son of Sala ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Serug , u khun jong u Reu , u khun jong u Peleg , u khun jong u Eber , u khun jong u Shelah ,
Baroh kiba ïadon jingset bad nga ki phah ïa ki jingshai khublei ïa me . To ai khublei ïa ki paralok jong ngi kiba ha ka jingngeit . Ka jingaiei U Blei kan long lem bad phira baroh .
translation.en: All that are with me salute thee . Greet them that love us in the faith . Grace be with you all . Amen .
To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality , eternal life :
translation.kha: Katto katne ki briew ki ïai leh ïa kaba bha , bad wad burom , ka nam babha , bad ka jingim bymïap shuh ; ïa ki U Blei un ai ka jingim bymjukut .
Haba kumta , uei uba dei u Jiw bashisha , ba la otsher shisha ? Ym dei uta u briew uba dei u Jiw ha kaba shabi , uba ka jingotsher ka long ha ka doh .
translation.en: For he is not a Jew , which is one outwardly ; neither is that circumcision , which is outward in the flesh :

translation.kha: lait tang u Kalah u khun jong u Jephunneh . U te u ïaineh ha nga , kumta ngan ai ha u dara ha ki khun ki ksiew jngai u ïa Katai ka ri ïa kob u la rupa syntiat .’
translation.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh  ; he shall see it , and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon , and to his children , because he hath wholly followed the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kaba ïoh ïa ka spah da kaba suk eh , tang khyndiat eh kan pynbha ïa phi .
translation.en: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning  ; but the end thereof shall not be blessed .

translation.kha: Uba dang sah ïa uba yn phah u lama u khun ba-ieit jong u trai hi . Ha kaba khatduh , te , u la phah ïa la u ïakhun shai ki nongshimwai . ‘ Nga ngeit sngem kin barhem ïa u Kynhun jong na ,’ u la nong .
translation.en: Having yet therefore one son , his wellbeloved , he sent him also last unto them , saying , They will reverence my son .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki u la mareh bad u spoiñ ba la wieh ha ka waiñ bym bha , bad ba la teh ïa u ha thew jong u dieng . Nangta u la rah shalor ha ki rmiang shym U Jiw bad u la ainong , To ap , ngin ïakhmih la u Eliashib un wan ban pynhiar ïa u na ka diengphna !
translation.en: And one ran and filled a sponge full of vinegar , and put it on a reed , and gave him to drink , saying , Let alone  ; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down .

translation.kha: Ha katai ka to , ym dat syiem ha Israel . Ha kita ki sner ki Dan ki dang wad Jaka la ka jong ban shong ban sah namar kim pateng shym la ïoh la ka jaka hapdeng ki jait Israel .
translation.en: In those days there was no king in Israel : and in those days the tribe of the Danites sought them an inheritance to dwell in  ; for unto that day all their inheritance had not fallen unto them among the tribes of Israel .

translation.kha: Ki la pynkhreh ka jingbam mirr ïa u hangta , ha kaba ka Matthat ka la ïarap banbeiñ sam ; u Lasaros u long uwei na kito katba la ïashong bam ha ka miej lem bad U jongu .
translation.en: There they made him a supper  ; and Martha served : but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him .

translation.kha: Ngin la ai ïa ki ïa khie kaba ki dei ban ïoh na ka bynta ka jingbymkhuid pynlang ka jingman jong ki , bad por la phai noh na ki .
translation.en: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions have I done unto them , and hid my face from them .

translation.kha: Lada don tyngka kiwei ka shnong , ka lynti shata ka la ban jngai than , malu uta uba wad kpoh u lah ban blad ïa u bad ha la ka jingbieit u lah ban pynïap ïa u briew u bym dei khot pun ïap , namar um shyiap don ka jingïashun bad la u paramarjan Mynshuwa .
translation.en: Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer , while his heart is hot , and overtake him , because the way is long , and slay him  ; whereas he was not worthy of death , inasmuch as he hated him not in time past .
Then came to him the disciples of John , saying , Why do we and the Pharisees fast oft , but thy disciples fast not ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki nongbud jong U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis ki la wan sha U Jisu , ki da kylli ,  Balei ba ma ngi bad ki Pharisi ngi shahjingit bunsien , hynrei ki synran jong me kim ju shahjingit da lei lei ?

translation.en: These are the things which defile a man : but to eat with unwashen hands defileth not a man .
translation.kha: Kine ki long kiei kiei kiba pynlong bymkhuid ïa u briew . Hynrei ban bam khlem da thet ïa ki kti jong phi kumba ki ong ïa phi ban leh kumta — Kane kam pynlong bymkhuid ïa u briew .

translation.en: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour s wife  ; and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law  ; and another in thee hath humbled his sister , his father s daughter .
translation.kha: Don kiba klim , bad kiwei ki pynbieit ïa la ki pyrsa kurim ne ïa la ki bakha kynthei .

translation.en: Salute Priscilla and Aquila , and the household of Onesiphorus .
translation.kha: ka jingai khublei ïa ka Priskila bad u Akwila bad ïa ka ïing u Onesiphoros .
U syiem ka Ijipt un long uba khlaiñ . Hynrei , uei na ki nongïalam shipai jongnga u un kham khraw bad un synshar ïa ka hima kaba khap khraw .
translation.en: And the king of the south shall be strong , and one of his princes  ; and he shall be strong above him , and have dominion  ; his dominion shall be a great dominion .

translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba ka long ka jingïatainia shngain ki ktien bad ki kyrteng dara shaphang ka hukum jong phi , phi hi phi dei ïa-ban ïapynbeit ïa ka . Ngan ym long u nongsah ïa kine kiei kiei !
translation.en: But if it be a question of words and names , and of your law , look ye to it  ; for I will be no judge of such matters .

translation.kha: Kynsan ar ngut ki rangbah ki la ïakren bad u . Ki la long u Moses bad u Elijah ,
translation.en: And , behold , there talked with him two men , which were Moses and Elias :

translation.kha: Lada phi dei ki Jong U Khrist , te , phira longïng ki nonghiarpateng u Abraham bad phin ïohpdiang ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la kular .
translation.en: And if ye be Christ s , then are ye Abraham s seed , and heirs according to the promise .

translation.kha: U tharai U Blei jongu phi un kyrkhu ïa ka jingtrei jngai phi bad un pyndap ïa ki sisa jong phi da u kew . Un kyrkhu ïa phi ha kata ka ri ba un ai ha phi .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses , and in all that thou settest thine hand unto  ; and he shall bless thee in the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee .
His legs are as pillars of marble , set upon sockets of fine gold : his countenance is as Lebanon , excellent as the cedars .
translation.kha: Ki umpohliew ki ai um ïa ka kper , ki wah um batuid , ki wahduid kiba tuid sharum na ki lumbah ka Lebanon .
bad u ai ïa ki ha u Arnon bad ki khun Shynrang jong u .
translation.en: According to the commandment of the  Lord  they were numbered by the hand of Moses , every one according to his service , and according to his burden : thus were they numbered of him , as the  Lord  commanded Moses .

translation.kha: Hynrei na ka bynta jongno nga , ko parabangeit , lada por dang bteng ban ïalap ba ka jingotsher ka long kaba donkam , balei te ba nga dang shah pynthnam beiñ ? Lada —kata ka la long kambah shisha , te ka jingïalam jong nga ïa ka diengphna U kyrshut kan ym long ut jingeh ei ei .
translation.en: And I , brethren , if I yet preach circumcision , why do I yet suffer persecution ? then is the offence of the cross ceased .
Thus hath the Lord  God  shewed unto me : and , behold , the Lord  God  called to contend by fire , and it devoured the great deep , and did eat up a part .
translation.kha: Nga la ïoh kawei pat ka jingïohipaw na U  Trai  Nongsynshar . Ha ka , nga la ïohi ïa u ba u dang pynkhreh ban pynshitom ïa ki briew jong u da ka ding . Ka ding ka la thang lut ïa ka duriaw-bah bakhraw hapoh ka sla pyrthei , bad ka la sdang ban bam duh ïa ka khyndew .
Babha ki brai u Saul ki wiang ban kem ïa u Dabid , ka Mikhal ka ïathuh ïa ki ba u phang .
translation.en: And when Saul sent messengers to take David , she said , He is sick .
Then said Jesus unto him ,  Put up again thy sword into his place : for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword .
translation.kha: Thep noh ïa la ka waitlam ha ka jaka jong ka ,  U Jisu u la ong ha u .  Baroh kiba shim ïa ka waitlam kin ïap da ka waitlam .

translation.en: The Revelation of Jesus Christ , which God gave unto him , to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass  ; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John :
translation.kha: Kane ka kitab ka long ka jingbuh jingthoh ïa ki jingjia kiba U Jisu Khrist u la pynpaw . U Blei u la ai ha u ïa kane ka jingpynpaw khnang ban pyn-i ha ki shakri jong u ïa kaei kaba dei ban jia shen . U Khrist u la pynlong ïa kine kiei kiei ban tip da u shakri jong u , u Ïoannis da kaba phah ïa la u angel sha u ,
hynrei ïa ka jingtim , lada phi leh lyndet ïa kine ki hukum bad phai noh ban mane ïa kiei paw ki blei ïa kiba phim pat ju tip mynno mynno .
translation.en: And a curse , if ye will not obey the commandments of the  Lord  your God , but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day , to go after other gods , which ye have not known .

translation.kha: Ngan pyntngen ïa phi ha Jerusalem , kumba ka kmie ka pynïapthngan ïa la i khun .
translation.en: As one whom his mother comforteth , so will I comfort you  ; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ka bneng bad ka pyrthei keiñ leit noh , hawei ki ktien jongngi sa kin ym leit noh lano hangno shwa .
translation.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away : but my words shall not pass away .

translation.kha: Bad kumta u la iehnoh ïa la ka ri bad u la otsher ban shong banbeiñ sah ha Haran . Ahian ba u kpa jong u Abarim u la ïap , U Blei u la pynphong ïa u ban kynriah sha ken ka jaka ha kaba phi mynta phi shong phi sah .
translation.en: Then came he out of the land of the Chaldeans , and dwelt in Charran : and from thence , when his father was dead , he removed him into this land , wherein ye now dwell .

translation.kha: Kumta u phah khot ïa u Jehoïada bad ïa kiwei pat ki lyngdoh malade u kylli ïa ki , Baalis ba phim shym shna pynbha ïa ka Templ ? Naduh mynta phim dei shuh ban bat ïa ka pyrsa kambah Phi ïohpdiang ; phi dei ban aiti noh , khring ban ïoh shna pynbha .
translation.en: Then king Jehoash called for Jehoiada the priest , and the other priests , and said unto them , Why repair ye not the breaches of the house ? now therefore receive no more money of your acquaintance , but deliver it for the breaches of the house .

translation.kha: U pud u kynjoh hajuh ïa ka Tabor , ka Shahasumah , badno ka Beth Shemesh , u da kut noh ha ka Jordan . Ka kynthup khathynriew tylli ki nongbah lem pynlang ki nonglur sawdong Jong ki .
translation.en: And the coast reacheth to Tabor , and Shahazimah , and Beth–shemesh  ; and the outgoings of their border were at Jordan : sixteen cities with their villages .

translation.kha: U TRAI’ Badonbor Baroh u ong , Ngan sa paw sohpdung jong phi ban bishar , malade ngan phla shisyndon pyrshah ïa kito kiba leh myntor , pyrshah ïa kiba klim , pyrshah ïa kito kiba sakhi lamler , kita kba shukor ïa ki nongtrei ïa ki bainong jongu ki , nabar kito kiba skhem kabu ïa ki riewbieit , ki ksuit , bad ki nongwei — pyrshah ïa kito baroh ki bym niewkor ïa nga .
translation.en: And I will come near to you to judgment  ; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers , and against the adulterers , and against false swearers , and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages , the widow , and the fatherless , and that turn aside the stranger from his right , and fear not me , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: Ngam pah ju kyrngah ban ïarah ïa babha duk ; ngim pat ju shah ïa ki riewkynthei ban im jynrat
translation.en: If I have withheld the poor from their desire , or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail  ;
But let us , who are of the day , be sober , putting on the breastplate of faith and love ; and for an helmet , the hope of salvation .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi dei ki jong ka sngi , bad ngi dei ban pyngngad . Ngi dei ban kup ïa ka jingngeit bad ïa ka jingieit kum ka jingda shadem , bad ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ïa ka jingpynim kum ka jingda khlieh .

Adam la ka sngi shuwa ban sep snieh , siew dep ïa ka bainong jong u ha kata ka sngi , namar u dei uba duk bun u ap nadong ban ïoh ïa ka . Lada tv ai ïa ka , un kyang ha U Trai pyrshah ïa phi , bad kata kan long ka pop ïa phin .
translation.en: At his day thou shalt give him his hire , neither shall the sun go down upon it  ; for he is poor , and setteth his heart upon it : lest he cry against thee unto the  Lord  , and it be sin unto thee .
Therefore , son of man , prophesy and say unto Gog , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In that day when my people of Israel dwelleth safely , shalt thou not know it ?
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la phah ïa nga ban ïathuh ha u Gog ïa kaei kaba u ong ïa u :  Mynta katba ki Israel , ki briew jong nga ki dang shong ha ka jingsngewskhem ,
Ki lyngdoh kim dien ban pyntngit ïa kita ki jingkñia ainguh
translation.en: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel , which they offer unto the  Lord   ;

And it came to pass , when I prophesied , that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died . Then fell I down upon my face , and cried with a loud voice , and said , Ah Lord  God  ! wilt thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel ?
translation.kha: Katba nga dang ïathuhlypa , u Pelataïah u la kyllon ïap . Nga la rynsied pyllup ïa lade ha khyndew bad pyrta jam ,  Em , ko  Trai  Nongsynshar ! Hato men pynïap ïa uwei uwei baroh ba dang sah ha Israel ?

translation.en: And straightway all the people , when they beheld him , were greatly amazed , and running to him saluted him .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki la ïohi ïa U Jisu , ki la sngewlyngngoh shikatdei eh , bad ki la wan mareh sha u ban khublei ïa u .

translation.en: And kept back part of the price , his wife also being privy to it , and brought a certain part , and laid it at the apostles  feet .
translation.kha: Bad da ka jingmynjur jong ka tnga jong u , u la buh katto katne ka pisa na ka bynta ïa lade bad u la ai ïa kaba sah baroh ha ki apostol .

translation.en: Hear ye now what the  Lord  saith  ; Arise , contend thou before the mountains , and let the hills hear thy voice .
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ka jingmudui U  Trai  pyrshah ïa ki Israel . To khie , A  Trai  , bad wanrah ïa ka jingmudui jong me ; to ai ba ki lumbah bad ki lumrit kin ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba me ong .
ibha ka jingshai basngewsih jong ka jingdon jong nga ka ïaid najan nangta , ngan buh ïa me ha khmat ka khlem jong uta u mawsiang bad ngan tap ïa me da la ka kti haduh ba ngan da ïaid lait nangta .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , while my glory passeth by , that I will put thee in a clift of the rock , and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by :
But a certain man named Ananias , with Sapphira his wife , sold a possession ,
translation.kha: Hynrei la don u briew uba kyrteng u Ananias , uba , lem bad ka tnga jong u ka Sapphira , ki la die katto katne na ka jaka kaba dei ka jong ki .

translation.en: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee : thy throne shall be established for ever .
translation.kha: Men ïai don ki khun ki ksiew , bad ngan pynlong ïa ka hima jong me ban neh junom . Ka longïing syiem jong me kan ym kut .’
U buh ïa u diengpynïeng shalor hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , ha ka liang kaba shaphang shathie , marpyrshah kata ka miej ,
translation.en: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation , over against the table , on the side of the tabernacle southward .

translation.kha: Da kaba pyndonkam ïa ka jingai kaba U balui u la ai ha nga , nga la trei ïa ka kam u rangbah nongtei uba thet bad nga la seng ïa ka Nongrim , bad uwei pat u tei hiar jong ka . Hynrei uwei pa uwei u dei ban synrum kumno u te .
translation.en: According to the grace of God which is given unto me , as a wise masterbuilder , I have laid the foundation , and another buildeth thereon . But let every man take heed how he buildeth thereupon .

translation.kha: Kumta u Dedan um shym leit rah shuh ïa ka sha Jerusalem . Pynban , u ieh ïa ka ha ka ïing jong u briew uba kyrteng u Obed Edom , u traishnong ka nongbah Gath .
translation.en: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David , but carried it aside into the house of Obed–edom the Gittite .

translation.kha: Shisyndon U Mynsiem u la pynlong ïa u ban leit sha ka ri shyiap ,
translation.en: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness .

translation.kha: Ha ka hukum jong u ki um shalor jong ka suiñbneng ki kherub ; u wallam ïa ki lyoh na Kiba kut jong ka pyrta . U pynlong ïa ka leilieh ban thaba ha u slap bad u phah ïa ka lyer na ka kamra buh tiar jong u .
translation.en: When he uttereth his voice , there is a multitude of waters in the heavens , and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth  ; he maketh lightnings with rain , and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures .

But his sons shall be stirred up , and shall assemble a multitude of great forces : and one shall certainly come , and overflow , and pass through : then shall he return , and be stirred up , even to his fortress .
translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u syiem ka Syria kin pynkhreh ïa ka thma bad ki ïalum ka kynhun shipai bakhraw . Kawei na ki kan sar kum ka jingshlei um bad kan tur ïaleh ïa ka kut jong u nongshun .
U Jehoash u kem koidi ïa u Amaraïah , u turoi shankhung sha Jerusalem , bad u pyntwa ïa ka kynroh ka nongbah naduh Khyrdop Abram haduh Khyrdop Kyndong , ka jingjngai kumba arspah mitar .
translation.en: And Jehoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah , the son of Jehoash the son of Ahaziah , at Beth–shemesh , and came to Jerusalem , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate , four hundred cubits .

translation.kha: la kum ba kun ïa u nongbylla uba trei snieh . U kynrad jong u , um dien ban pynshitom keiñ ïa u .
translation.en: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him : and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight .
Wherefore receive ye one another , as Christ also received us to the glory of God .
translation.kha: To ïa-pdiang iwei ïa iwei te , na ka bynta ka burom jong U Blei , kumba U Khrist u la pdiang ïa phi .
Aïu phi ïaleh pyrshah ïa U Troas ? un pynjot ïa phi . Ym don mano mano uba ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa u palat ïa ka shisien .
translation.en: What do ye imagine against the  Lord  ? he will make an utter end : affliction shall not rise up the second time .

translation.kha: U Mosah u ïalam ïa ki shabar ka jaka sher dara shun ïashem bad U blei , Bad ki la ïeng ha kjat jong u lumlang .
translation.en: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with God  ; and they stood at the nether part of the mount .

And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms , and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen  ; and I will overthrow the chariots , and those that ride in them  ; and the horses and their riders shall come down , every one by the sword of his brother .
translation.kha: bad pynkyllon ïa ki hima bad pynkut ïa ka bor jong ki . Ngan pynkylla khongpong ïa ki kali ïapom bad ïa ki nongñiah jong ki ; ki kulai kin ïap , bad ki nongshong kulai kin ïa-pynïap para ma ki .

translation.en: Yea , I will make many people amazed at thee , and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee , when I shall brandish my sword before them  ; and they shall tremble at every moment , every man for his own life , in the day of thy fall .
translation.kha: Kaei ba ngan leh ïa me ka pynkyndit ïa shibun ki jaitbynriew . Haba nga talain ïa ka waitlam jong nga , ki syiem kin khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng . Ha ka sngi ba me kyllon , baroh na ki kin khynñiuh ha ka jingsheptieng na ka bynta ki jingim jong ki .
Ki shynrang ki dei ban ieit ïa ki tnga jong ki kumba ki ieit ïa la ki jong ki met . U shynrang uba ieit ïa la ka thngan u ibit ïa lade hi .
translation.en: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies . He that loveth his wife loveth himself .

translation.kha: Ka wan pha patar sha ka lieng , bad u Noah u kner ïa la ka kti , bad u rem ïa ka shapoh .
translation.en: But the dove found no rest for the sole of her foot , and she returned unto him into the ark , for the waters were on the face of the whole earth : then he put forth his hand , and took her , and pulled her in unto him into the ark .

translation.kha: wahbah u simpyllieng u paw ha ki lyoh , ngan khmih ïa u , bad ngan kynmaw ïa ka jutang batynrai junom hapdeng jong nga bad ki jingthung ba-im baroh ha ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And the bow shall be in the cloud  ; and I will look upon it , that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is upon the earth .

translation.kha: Ki bariew kiba thaw jingriam ïa kiwei pat kin ngat ïa lade . Ki briew kiba sdang pynhap khyndew ki shah ban ïa lade .
translation.en: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein : and he that rolleth a stone , it will return upon him .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïalap ha na bad ki ong , Kam ïalap ha ngi . Wat ïalap shaphang kata borbah . U Blei un ym pynjahburom ïa ngi .
translation.en: Prophesy ye not , say they to them that prophesy : they shall not prophesy to them , that they shall not take shame .
The people therefore , that stood by , and heard it , said that it thundered : others said , An angel spake to him .
translation.kha: Ki paidbah kiba la ïeng hangta ki la ïohsngew ïa kata ka sur , bad don na ki kiba la ong ba ka dei ka jingtied pyrthat , katba kiwei pat ki la ong ,  U angel u la kren ha u !
Lada phi don ka jingieit iwei ïa iwei , te baroh kin tip ba phi long ki synran jong nga . Kumba na la ieid ïa phi , kumta phiah dei ban ieit Uei ïa iwei .
translation.en: By this shall all men know that ye are my disciples , if ye have love one to another .

translation.kha: Haba ka Rakhel ka la ïap , la thup ïa ka harud ka lynti kaba leit sha Ephrath , ïa kaba la tip mynta kum ka Bethlehem .
translation.en: And Rachel died , and was buried in the way to Ephrath , which is Beth–lehem .
And he charged them straitly that no man should know it  ; and commanded that something should be given her to eat .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ai ïa ki ka hukum bapyrkhing ban ym ïathuh hano hano ruh , bad u la ong ,  Ai ei ei ïa ka ban bam .
hynrei ngam shym la shah kynnoh pop ïa kano kano ka jingïaleh pynsniew , dara ka jingduwai jong nga sha U Blei ka long kaba beit .
translation.en: Not for any injustice in mine hands : also my prayer is pure .

translation.kha: Kin long kum ka jingpynjot , ka ding bashyrkhei , ka ïa-ban smam duh ïa kiei kiei baroh kba nga don .
translation.en: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction , and would root out all mine increase .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Blei u shem jingduna bad ki briew jrong u haba u ong , Ki sngi ki wang , Ong U Tharai , hir ngan pynlong ïa ka jyntang kaba thymmai bad ki paid Jeraïah bad ki paid Judah ruh .
translation.en: For finding fault with them , he saith , Behold , the days come , saith the Lord , when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah :

translation.kha: A katno suk ka long ïa pli ki lai dat jingartatien shaphang jongngi nga !
translation.en: And blessed is he , whosoever shall not be offended in me .

translation.kha: Ka jingmyntoi ban tip kumno ban burom ïa ki jingïohi jong ka Baibl .
translation.en: The benefit of learning how to apply Bible principles .
He also tells us about his purpose and what he wants us to do .
translation.kha: U ïathuh ruh ha ngi shaphang ka jingthmu jong u bad kaei kaba u kwah ïa ngi ban leh .

Ki briew jongki phi kin tei pat ïa kaei kaba la preg la sleh biah , kin tei pat halor ki nongring ba-mynshuwa . Yn tip ïa phi kumne ki briew kiba tei pat ïa ki kynroh , uba pynbha pat ïa ki ïit ba la pra .
translation.en: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places : thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations  ; and thou shalt be called , The repairer of the breach , The restorer of paths to dwell in .

Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols , nor with their detestable things , nor with any of their transgressions : but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces , wherein they have sinned , and will cleanse them : so shall they be my people , and I will be their God .
translation.kha: Kin ym pyntngit shuh ïa lade da ki bleithaw kiba ijli lane pynjot ïa lade da ka pop . Ngan pyllait ïa ki na ki lynti jong ka jingleh pop bad ka jingshetkylla ïa nga . Ngan pynkhuid ïa ki , kin long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .
