Ngan leh ïa kane namar u Solomon u la kyntait ïa ar bad u la mane ïa ki blei nongwei : ka Astarte , ka blei ki shisyndon ; u Khemosh , u blei ki Moab ; bad u Molekh , u blei ki Amon . U Salmone u la lyndet ïa nga ; u la leh palat , bad um shym la sumar ïa ki aiñ malade ki hukum jong na kumba u Dabid u kpa jong u , u la leh .
translation.en: Because that they have forsaken me , and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , Chemosh the god of the Moabites , and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon , and have not walked in my ways , to do that which is right in mine eyes , and to keep my statutes and my judgments , as did David his father .

translation.kha: Kumba U Troas u la don ryngkat Bad u Syiem Kynrad , kumta ruh ai un don ryngkat bad u Solomon , sad pynlong ïa ka jingsynshar jong u kaba kham roi pun ïa ka jong phi .
translation.en: As the  Lord  hath been with my lord the king , even so be he with Solomon , and make his throne greater than the throne of my lord king David .

translation.kha: Nga i-ieit ïa phoi kumba U Kpa u ieit ïa nga ; to ïaineh ha ka jingieit jong nga .
translation.en: As the Father hath loved me , so have I loved you : continue ye in my love .
Then Jethro , Moses  father in law , took Zipporah , Moses  wife , after he had sent her back ,
translation.kha: Kumta u la wan ha u Moses , u da ïalam ruh ïa ka Sipporah , ka tnga jong u Moses , kaba u khlem ïalam lang ,

Ngi lah ban die ïa u kew u bymdondor ha ka dor kaweh heh . Nyngkong smam ïa u bynriew kiba kun u bym kah siew ïa ki ram jong u , wat ym ïa ka dor jong shi jur ki pynsabut , bad ngin thied ïa u kum u mraw .
translation.en: That we may buy the poor for silver , and the needy for a pair of shoes  ; yea , and sell the refuse of the wheat ?
But without faith it is impossible to please him : for he that cometh to God must believe that he is , and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him .
translation.kha: Ym don uno uno uba lah ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei khlem ka jingngeit , naba uta uba wan sha U Blei u dei ban don ka jingngeit ba U Blei u don , bad ba u ainong ïa kita kiba wad ïa u .
bad mudui ha u lyngdoh Lebi dara u nongbishar uba treikam ha kata ka por , bad jhieh kin rai ma ki ïa kata ka mokotduma .
translation.en: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites , and unto the judge that shall be in those days , and enquire  ; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment :
In the tenth year , in the tenth month , in the twelfth day of the month , the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khat-ar jong u bnai uba shiphew ha ka snem kaba shiphew jong ka jingshah ringmraw jong ngi , U  Trai  u la kren ha nga .

translation.en: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river of Chebar  ; and I knew that they were the cherubims .
translation.kha: Nga la ithuh ba kine ki long kijuh ki jingthaw ba-im ba nga la ïohi kiba shong hapoh U Blei ki Israel harud ka wah Khebar .

translation.en: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof , and darkness shall pursue his enemies .
translation.kha: Kum ka jingsyllad ka jingshlei um bakhraw u pynjot thiaw ïa ki nongshun jong u ; u phah sha ka jingïap jong ki ïa kito kiba pyrshah ïa u .
Hynrei ma nga , U Trai , nga la pyntwa noh ïa kaei kiba at la tei dara rat nep ïa kamai kaba nga la thrang . Ngan leh ïa kane ha ka pyrthei baroh kawei .
translation.en: Thus shalt thou say unto him , The  Lord  saith thus  ; Behold , that which I have built will I break down , and that which I have planted I will pluck up , even this whole land .
But by what means he now seeth , we know not  ; or who hath opened his eyes , we know not : he is of age  ; ask him : he shall speak for himself .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngim tip kumno pat ba mynta u la ïoh imat , lymne ngim tip mano ba la pynkoit ïa u na ka jingmatlah jong u . Kylli ïa u ; u la biang ka rta , bad u lah ban jubab da lade hi !

translation.en: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies , which minister questions , rather than godly edifying which is in faith : so do .
translation.kha: Ong ïa ki ban iehnoh ïa kito ki puriskam bad kito ki thup bajrong jong ka jinghiarpateng , kiba pynmih tang ïa ki jingïania ; kim ïadei ei ei bad ka jingthmu U Blei , ïa kaba lah ban tip da ka jingngeit .
Ka jingïasaid nia ka la khia hapdeng ki synran ba ïa uno na ki yn ñiew ba u long uba khraw tam .
translation.en: And there was also a strife among them , which of them should be accounted the greatest .

translation.kha: Ar sngi Hadien ba la kha ïa u khun jong nga , ka ruh ka kha khun Shaneng . ngin ïadon tang ma ngi hi ar lwet ha kata ka ïing — ym don mano mano ba don ryngkat .
translation.en: And it came to pass the third day after that I was delivered , that this woman was delivered also : and we were together  ; there was no stranger with us in the house , save we two in the house .

translation.kha: Te u rangbah pynsynjor u sheng joit bad u pyrda ha ka kiei Hebru , To shahshkor ïa kaei kaba u patsha ka Arsa u ïatyngkhuh ha phi .
translation.en: Then Rabshakeh stood , and cried with a loud voice in the Jews  language , and said , Hear ye the words of the great king , the king of Assyria .

translation.kha: Nangta u Joshua u khot ïa ki rangbah ka Israel baroh bad u hukum ïa ki rangbah shipa kiba la loit ryngkat bad u ngab wan bad Buh ïa la ki katjuh ha ki ryndang jong ki syiem . Ki la leh kumta .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when they brought out those kings unto Joshua , that Joshua called for all the men of Israel , and said unto the captains of the men of war which went with him , Come near , put your feet upon the necks of these kings . And they came near , and put their feet upon the necks of them .

translation.kha: Ki kñia ha ki blei ki bym dei shisha ki phai , ha ki balieh thymmai kiba ki kpa thnam jong ki kim ju tip , ki blei kiba ki Jerusalem kim ju kthong .
translation.en: They sacrificed unto devils , not to God  ; to gods whom they knew not , to new gods that came newly up , whom your fathers feared not .

translation.kha: Don u ban kylli , Kumno lah ban pynmihpat ïa ibha ïap ? Ka met kaba kumno kin don ?
translation.en: But some man will say , How are the dead raised up ? and with what body do they come ?

translation.kha: U Ujuh u la ong ïa ki , Phim tip ïa kaei kaban phi pan . Hato phi lah ban dih na ka khuri jrong ka jingshahshitom kaba to dei ban dei ? Hato phi lah ïa-ban shahskhor pynbaptis ha ka armet ba ka dei ïa nga ban shah pynbaptis ?
translation.en: But Jesus said unto them ,  Ye know not what ye ask : can ye drink of the cup that I drink of ? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai bad u la dumok ïa ki Bad u la ong , Phim tip phi de na u jait Mynsiem Aïu ; naba U Khun U Briew um shem la wan ban pynjot ïa ka jingim jong ki briew , hynrei ban pynim ïa ki .
translation.en: But he turned , and rebuked them , and said ,  Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of .
And not as Moses , which put a veil over his face , that the children of Israel could not stedfastly look to the end of that which is abolished :
translation.kha: Bad ym kum u Moses , uba la hap ban buh da ka jingkah ha ka durkhmat jong u khnang ba ki paid Israel kin ym ïohi ba kata ka jingtyngshaiñ ka lip bad jah noh .

translation.en: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb , sweet to the soul , and health to the bones .
translation.kha: Ki ktien sbun ki long kum ka ngap — kaba thiang ïa ka jingmad bad kaba bha ïa ka jingkoit jingkhiah .
Ynda me ïap , bad la thet ïa me malade ki kpa tymmen jong me , ngan thung syiem ïa uwei na ki ïakhun shynrong jongki me , bad kan pynkhynñiuh ïa ka hima jong u .
translation.en: And when thy days be fulfilled , and thou shalt sleep with thy fathers , I will set up thy seed after thee , which shall proceed out of thy bowels , and I will establish his kingdom .

translation.kha: Baroh ki ki kiba u syiem Hesekaïah u la leh bad ka jingaiti lut jongno u shwa U thri la buh jingthoh ha Ka jingïohipaw jong u nongpynkhiah Isaïah u khun jong u Amos bad ha Ka Histori jongno Ki Syiem Ka Judah Bad Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah , and his goodness , behold , they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .

translation.kha: Nga , U Troas , nga long umbiah nyngkong ban ïathuh ïa ka Seruïah ïa ka khubor ; nga phah ïa u nonglamktien sha Jerusalem ban ong , ‘ Ki briew jong Phin ki wiang ! Ki ïan sha ïeng !’
translation.en: The first shall say to Zion , Behold , behold them : and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings .
This shall be the punishment of Egypt , and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles .
translation.kha: Kane kan long ka jingpynshitom ka ban hap halor ka Ijipt bad ha baroh kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew lada kim rakhe ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam Ki Ïingtrep .
Hynrei uta u briew uba la ïohkhiah um shym tip ba U Jisu u la long uwei , naba la don u paidbah ha kata ka jaka , bad U Jisu u la lah mihnoh jar jar .
translation.en: And he that was healed wist not who it was : for Jesus had conveyed himself away , a multitude being in that place .

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jongno ka Malkhiel ki longïing u Joseph bad u Benjamin .
translation.en: The sons of Rachel  ; Joseph , and Benjamin :

translation.kha: U Jingsuk hadien u la maw paw ha ki synran jongki u .
translation.en: Jesus later appeared to his apostles .

Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold , and said , It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you : but seeing ye put it from you , and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life , lo , we turn to the Gentiles .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul bad u Barnabas ki la nang kham kren shlur :  Ka long kaba donkam ba ïa ka ktien jong U Blei dei ban kren nyngkong ha phi . Hynrei namar ba phi kyntait ïa ka bad ba phim ñiew ïa lade kiba bit ïa ka jingim bymjukut , ngin iehnoh ïa phi bad leit sha ki Jentil .

Ko khun u briew , u la ong , to kren pyrsad ïa ki nongsynshar ka Israel . Ïathuhlypa ha ki , bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar per ïong ha ki : Phi long ki bym ba-don jingman thuh , a phi ki nongsharai ka Israel ! Pi sumar bha tang ïa lade , hynne phim ju bsa bha ïa ki langbrot .
translation.en: Son of man , prophesy against the shepherds of Israel , prophesy , and say unto them , Thus saith the Lord  God  unto the shepherds  ; Woe be to the shepherds of Israel that do feed themselves ! should not the shepherds feed the flocks ?
And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee , and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee , and thou shalt find them no more at all .
translation.kha: Ki nongkhaïi ki ong ha ka ,  Baroh kiei kiei kiba bha kiba pha la angnud ban ïoh ki la jah noh , bad baroh ka spah jong pha bad ka rong phong jong pha ki la leit noh , phan ym shem shuh ïa ki !

translation.en: And it was told the house of David , saying , Syria is confederate with Ephraim . And his heart was moved , and the heart of his people , as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind .
translation.kha: Haba ka ktien ka la poi ha u syiem ka Judah ba ki kynhun shipai ka Syria ki la da don hapoh ka ri Israel , ma u bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la sngewshyrkhei shikatdei ha kaba ki la khynñiuh kum ki dieng ba la pynkhih da ka lyer .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Gideon , By the three hundred men that lapped will I save you , and deliver the Midianites into thine hand : and let all the other people go every man unto his place .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Gideon ,  Ngan pyllait im ïa me bad ngan ai ha me ka jingjop halor ki Midian da ki laispah ngut ki rangbah kiba shu jliah ïa ka um . Ong ïa kiwei pat kin leit noh sha ïing .
Nga pynstet ïa ki , sad ki kylla long kum u pui pui , nga ïuh halor jong ki kum ïa ka ktieh ha ki lynti .
translation.en: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth , I did stamp them as the mire of the street , and did spread them abroad .

translation.kha: kiba ïeng ha ka ïing jngai U Trai , ha ka Templ jong U Blei jong ngi .
translation.en: Ye that stand in the house of the  Lord  , in the courts of the house of our God ,

translation.kha: U Peor u la pynmih ïa ki baroh shabar ka Kamra , bad u la dem khohsiew bad duwai ; nangta u la phai sha ka met bad u la ïong , Ko Tabitha , khie joit ! Ka la plie ïa la ki iitkhmat , bad haba ka la ïohi ïa u Petros , ka la khie shon .
translation.en: But Peter put them all forth , and kneeled down , and prayed  ; and turning him to the body said , Tabitha , arise . And she opened her eyes : and when she saw Peter , she sat up .

translation.kha: Bad kumta U Trai u bitar ngon ïa ki Israel bad u la shah ïa ki nonglute ban tur ïaleh bad lute ïa ki . U shah ïa ki nongshun bakha sawdong lad ki ban thombor ïa ki , bad ki Israel kim lah shuh ban ïada ïa lade .
translation.en: And the anger of the  Lord  was hot against Israel , and he delivered them into the hands of spoilers that spoiled them , and he sold them into the hands of their enemies round about , so that they could not any longer stand before their enemies .

translation.kha: Ki long borabor kiba ïaleh pyrsad ïa U Blei , babha ïai shukor , kiba ïa kyntait ban shahjop ïa ki jinghikai U Trai .
translation.en: That this is a rebellious people , lying children , children that will not hear the law of the  Lord  :

translation.kha: Pynphong , ine dei ban thoh ka sakhi da kaba ong ïa ki ïa-ban ym bam ïa kano kano ka jingbam ka bymkhuid katto kum ka jinglehshitom namar ba la kñia ïa ka ha ki bleithaw ; ban kyndiah na ka jingrai ; bad don ym bam ïa kano kano ka mrad kaba la khyrwait , lane bam ïa kano kano ka snam .
translation.en: But that we write unto them , that they abstain from pollutions of idols , and from fornication , and from things strangled , and from blood .

translation.kha: Hato kin sngewlehrain namar ki la leh ïa keiñ kaei kiei kaba ijuh ? Em , kim shym la sngewlehrain satia ; kim tip hi ruh Kamon ban sawkyr-ang . Bad kumta ktien kyllon kamra kiwei ki la kyllon ; haba at pynshitom ïa ki , Kata ka long kaba kut jong ki . Ma nga , U Trai , nga la kren .
translation.en: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination ? nay , they were not at all ashamed , neither could they blush : therefore they shall fall among them that fall : at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta u la thew sa ïa ka jingtian ka kynroh kaba nadien kawei ka Rum shaduh ka kynroh kaba Sdien jong kawei pah ka khem lyngba ka lynti ïaid na ka , bad ka long khat-ar mitar shiteng .
translation.en: He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another : the breadth was five and twenty cubits , door against door .
Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people , and thine eyes shall look , and fail with longing for them all the day long : and there shall be no might in thine hand .
translation.kha: Ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi yn ai noh kum ki mraw ha ki nongwei katba phi pat phi shu peit . Man ka sngi phin pynshitom sat ïa la ki khmat ba phi ap lehnoh-ei ïa la ki khun ba kin wan phai pat .

translation.en: And as Peter was coming in , Cornelius met him , and fell down at his feet , and worshipped him .
translation.kha: Katba u Petros u dang rung , u Kornelios u la leit kynduh ïa u , u la dem khrup ha ki kjat jong u , bad u la nguh dem ha khmat jong u .
Uno ine u briew lane ka briew kiba leh pynong kan shah lynthem miaw haduh ba kin da ïap ; uno uno u briew uba leh ïa kane u pan kwah hi ïa ka jingïap .
translation.en: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit , or that is a wizard , shall surely be put to death : they shall stone them with stones : their blood shall be upon them .
So when the Samaritans were come unto him , they besought him that he would tarry with them : and he abode there two days .
translation.kha: Kumta haba ki nong Samaria ki la wan ha u , ki la kyrpad ïa u ban sah bad ki , bad U Jisu u la sah hangta ar sngi .
Wat ju pynhiarkput , ko ki paralok jong nga , hynrei pynban , to ai ba ka jingbitar jong U Blei sa sa ïa kata . Nimrah ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Ngan pynhiarkput , ngan siew Kylleng , ong U Trai .
translation.en: Dearly beloved , avenge not yourselves , but rather give place unto wrath : for it is written , Vengeance is mine ; I will repay , saith the Lord .

But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah , whom she bare unto Saul , Armoni and Mephibosheth  ; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul , whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite :
translation.kha: Pynban , u la shim ïa u Armoni bad ïa u Mephibosheth , ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka Rispah , ka khun u Aïah , ba ka la ïoh na u Saul ; u shim ruh ïa ki san ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka Merab , ka khun jong u Saul , ba ka la ïoh na u Adriel u khun jong u Barsillai uba na Meholah .

translation.en: O that there were such an heart in them , that they would fear me , and keep all my commandments always , that it might be well with them , and with their children for ever !
translation.kha: A , ba kin da la ïoh ïa kane ka dohnud ! Ba kin da la sheptieng burom ïa nga bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga borabor , ma ki bad ki khun ki ksiew jong ki kin jin da la manbha junom .
bad da ka jinglong la kloi ban pynbna ïa ka Khubor Babha ka jingsuk , kumto ki juti jong phi .
translation.en: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace ;

translation.kha: Nangta , ka jingsawa jong ka sur ka la wan na ka khet , ka da ong , To ïarap ïa U Blei jong ngi , pa barben ki shakri bun ki briew Jong u , kiba rit bun kiba khraw kumjuh , kiba jingñiewburom ïa u !
translation.en: And a voice came out of the throne , saying , Praise our God , all ye his servants , and ye that fear him , both small and great .

translation.kha: Lane hato phin ai ïa u da ka ñianglartham hab u pan ïa ka pylleng ?
translation.en: Or if he shall ask an egg , will he offer him a scorpion ?
And the  Lord  , he it is that doth go before thee  ; he will be with thee , he will not fail thee , neither forsake thee : fear not , neither be dismayed .
translation.kha: U  Trai  hi un ïalam ïa me bad un don ryngkat bad me . Un ym ieh ïa me lane kyntait ïa me ; kumta wat syier bad wat sheptieng .

Kumta ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa iathuh u briew sa Shisien , Me ong u la pynkoit ïa me na ka jingbymlah jong me — haba Kumta , me ong aiñ shaphang jong u ? U dei u nongïathuhlypa , Uto u briew u la jubab .
translation.en: They say unto the blind man again , What sayest thou of him , that he hath opened thine eyes ? He said , He is a prophet .
But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification , and exhortation , and comfort .
translation.kha: Hynrei uta uba pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei u kren ha ki briew bad u ai ha ki ïa ka jingïarap , ka jingpynshlur , bad ka jingpyntngen .
Yn tynjuh ïa phiah kumne : Ngam smai ha ka kyrteng u syep ba phin ym ïor mihnoh na kane ka jaka lymda u para khatduh jong phi u wan shane .
translation.en: Hereby ye shall be proved : By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence , except your youngest brother come hither .

translation.kha: Ym dei ban bam im ne phon ïa ka , hynrei smam ïa ka da kaba Shuh shi tylli kynthup ïa ka khlieh , ki kjat bad ki doh jem .
translation.en: Eat not of it raw , nor sodden at all with water , but roast with fire  ; his head with his legs , and with the purtenance thereof .

translation.kha: Nangta u Jehu u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem Joram uba dang ni ha Jesreel , ha kaba u la leit ban ïoh jingkoit na ki jingmong kiba u la ïoh ha ka thma ha Ramoth pyrshah ïa u Hasael u syiem ka Sirion . Kumta u Jiw u la ong ha ki para pynrangbah pynïaidkam , Lada phi don bad nga , pynthikna ba uwei ruh na phi un ym leit noh na ramhah pynlang maham ïa ki briew jong ka Jesreel .
translation.en: But king Joram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him , when he fought with Hazael king of Syria . ) And Jehu said , If it be your minds , then let none go forth nor escape out of the city to go to tell it in Jezreel .

translation.kha: U ong ha ki , To longïng kiba kput jingmut bad kiba ïasngewskhem , bad kad sheptieng ïa u patsha ki nong Assyria lane ïa ka kynhun shipai kaba u ïalam . Ngi dat kham bun ka kun ha ka buit jong ngi ban ïa kaba u don ha ka liang jong u .
translation.en: Be strong and courageous , be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria , nor for all the multitude that is with him : for there be more with us than with him :
Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth ? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve ?
translation.kha: Hato me tip mynno la kha ïa ki blang lum ? Hato me ju ïohi ïa ka skei khlaw ba ka kha khun ?

translation.en: You will not see any images , crucifixes , or things like these at the Kingdom Hall .
translation.kha: Phin ym ïohi ïa ki dur , ki diengphna , lane kum kine kiei kiei hapoh ka Kingdom Hall .
Te , ma Phi ki Israel , phin tip ba nga to hapdeng jrong phi bad ba ma nga , U Trai , por long U Blei jong Phi bad ym don uwei pat . Ki briew jong nga kin ym shah ñiewbeiñ shuh .
translation.en: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel , and that I am the  Lord  your God , and none else : and my people shall never be ashamed .

The word of the  Lord  that came unto Hosea , the son of Beeri , in the days of Uzziah , Jotham , Ahaz , and Hezekiah , kings of Judah , and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash , king of Israel .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor ba U  Trai  u la ai ha u Hosia u khun jong u Beri , ha ki sngi mynba u Ussaïah , u Jotham , u Ahas , bad u Hesekaïah ki long ki syiem ha Judah , bad u Jeroboam u khun jong u Joash u long syiem ha Israel .
Uwei u samla u la madiah ban otsher ïathuh ha u Moses shaphang kaei ba u Eldad bad u Medad ki leh .
translation.en: And there ran a young man , and told Moses , and said , Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp .

translation.kha: U Mysia u la leit shim ïa uta diengduh wohnia U Trai u la hukum .
translation.en: And Moses took the rod from before the  Lord  , as he commanded him .

translation.kha: U Petros u la mihnoh bad u la ïam sngewsih eh .
translation.en: And Peter went out , and wept bitterly .

translation.kha: Kumno la pyndonkam ïa ki jingnoh synñiang ?
translation.en: How are the voluntary contributions used ?
And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar s , and to God the things that are God s .  And they marvelled at him .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ong ,  Te kumta , siew sha u patsha ïa kaei kaba long ka jong u patsha , bad siew sha U Blei ïa kaei kaba long ka jong U Blei .  Bad ki la sngewlyngngoh ïa U Jisu .
Ka ong ha la u tnga , Nga thikna ba a u briew uba wei bunsien hangne u dei u riewkhñium .
translation.en: And she said unto her husband , Behold now , I perceive that this is an holy man of God , which passeth by us continually .
Then Jesus turned , and saw them following , and saith unto them ,  What seek ye ?  They said unto him , Rabbi , ( which is to say , being interpreted , Master , ) where dwellest thou ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai , u la ïohi ïa ki ba ki bud ïa u , bad u la kylli ,  Phi ïawad aïu ?  Ki la jubab ïa u ,  Hangno me sah , ko Rabbi ?  ( Kane ka kyntien ka mut  U Nonghikai . )

La thaw ïa ka da uta uba shong halor ka khiat jong u shajrong ka khyndew bad sha lyndet ka sahit bneng ; ki briew Shobab ki i rit tang kum ki dkhiew . U pynpyiar ïa ka suiñbneng kum ka pyrda , kumin ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba yn shong .
translation.en: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth , and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers  ; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain , and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in :
Fear came upon me , and trembling , which made all my bones to shake .
translation.kha: Nga kyiuh bad sngew syier ; ka met jong nga baroh kawei ka khynñiuh da ka jingsheptieng .

Bun ki briew ha Judah ki la ïalong ha ka liang jong u na ka bynta u kthaw jong u , u Shekanaïah , uba long u Jiw , u khun jong u Nahor . Nalor kata , u Jehohanan , u Kynhun jong u , u la shongkurim ïa ka khun u Meshullam , u khun jong u bahkhlieh .
translation.en: For there were many in Judah sworn unto him , because he was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah  ; and his son Jehohanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah .

translation.kha: Nangta U Tharai u la ong ha nga , Khie leit bad buh u nongput phira , nabar ong ïa u ban ïathuh ïa kaei kaba u ïohi .
translation.en: For thus hath the Lord said unto me , Go , set a watchman , let him declare what he seeth .

translation.kha: U la pham ïa ki shakri jongno u ban ïathuh ha ki nongshahkhot sngewma ban woh sha ka jingkhawai , hynrei kim khwai ban wan .
translation.en: And sent forth his servants to call them that were bidden to the wedding : and they would not come .
And when they had set the people , even all the host that was on the north of the city , and their liers in wait on the west of the city , Joshua went that night into the midst of the valley .
translation.kha: Ïa ki shipai la pynbeit na ka bynta ka thma bad ka jaka sher dara kaba shatei jong ka nongbah , bad ïa kiba sah na ki rangbah sha ka phang sepngi . U Joshua u sahmiet ha ka them .

translation.en: Receiving the end of your faith , even the salvation of your souls .
translation.kha: namar phi ïohpdiang ïa ka jingpynim ïa ki mynsiem jong phi , kaba long ka jingthmu jong ka jingngeit jong phi ha U .
U la synshar ha Kherub halor ka Jedaïah haduh hynñiew snem shiteng , bad ha Jerusalem hiar ki Israel malade Jedaïah baroh haduh laiphew lai snem .
translation.en: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months : and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Israel and Judah .

And hath not eaten upon the mountains , neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel , neither hath defiled his neighbour s wife , neither hath come near to a menstruous woman ,
translation.kha: Um ju mane ïa ki bleithaw jong ki Israel lane bam ïa ki jingkñia ba la ainguh ha ki jaka mane ba la mana . Um ju khroh pynbieit ïa ka tnga jong uwei pat u briew lane ïathiah shongkha bad ka kynthei ha ka por poi bnai jong ka .
Ki lumbah ki long ki jaka phlang ha kaba la bseiñ ïa ki , ha kaban ki jar ïa kano kano katba jyrngam ban bam .
translation.en: The range of the mountains is his pasture , and he searcheth after every green thing .

translation.kha: Phi ki khun , ka long ka kum kum kiba ngeit ba-bang kohnguh ïa la ki kmie ki Kpa , namar kane ka long kaba phi dei ban bor .
translation.en: Children , obey your parents in the Lord : for this is right .
The spider taketh hold with her hands , and is in kings  palaces .
translation.kha: Ki  ñiangapïing : phi lah ban bat kawei ha la ka kti , hynrei phi lah ruh ban shem ïa ki ha ki ïingsyiem .

translation.en: Whom dost thou pass in beauty ? go down , and be thou laid with the uncircumcised .
translation.kha: Ong ha ki :  Hato me tharai ba me kham bhabriew ban ïano ïano ruh ? Men leit hiar sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap bad thiah hangta hapdeng ki bymriewblei .
Ka Rakhel ka ong , U blang u la bishar hok ïa nga . U la shakor ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad u la ai khun shynrang ha at ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Dan .
translation.en: And Rachel said , God hath judged me , and hath also heard my voice , and hath given me a son : therefore called she his name Dan .

translation.kha: Iehnoh ïa kabu sngi bad ka bymdei na ka ïong jong me .
translation.en: If iniquity be in thine hand , put it far away , and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles .

translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U balui jong ka bneng ; ka jingieit jong u ka napoh bymsuidñiew .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the God of heaven : for his mercy endureth for ever .
And he went and found his carcase cast in the way , and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase : the lion had not eaten the carcase , nor torn the ass .
translation.kha: Ki ruh ki leh kumta , bad u leit noh bad u la lap ïa kata ka metïap u nongïathuhlypa ha lynti bah , lem bad ka kada bad u sing kiba dang ïeng hajan jong ka . U sing um shym la bam ïa kata ka metïap lymne patar ïa ka kada .
Nga sngewskhem ïa kane bad kumta nga tip ba lang! dang sah . Neng dang ïaisah bad phi barben , ban pynsan shuh shuh ïa phi bad ïa ka jingkmen ha ka jingngeit ,
translation.en: And having this confidence , I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith ;
Thus speaketh the  Lord  God of Israel , saying , Write thee all the words that I have spoken unto thee in a book .
translation.kha: u la ong ha nga :  To thoh ha ka kitab ïa kaei kaei baroh kaba nga la ong ha me ,

translation.en: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul  ; but he that despiseth his ways shall die .
translation.kha: Sumar ïa ki hukum U Blei bad phin im slem ; lada phi ñiewbeiñ ïa ki , phin ïap .

U Jehoba u lyngdoh , u pynlong ïa u syiem Joash bad ïa ki paidbah ba rung sha ka jingïateh jutang bad U Trai ba ken long ki briew jong U Trai ; u pynlong duh ïa ka jingïateh jutang hapdeng u syiem bad ki paidbah .
translation.en: And Jehoiada made a covenant between the  Lord  and the king and the people , that they should be the  Lord s  people  ; between the king also and the people .
And the  Lord  thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little : thou mayest not consume them at once , lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee .
translation.kha: Suki pa suki un beh krad ïa kine ki jaitbynriew katba phi nang tur sha khmat . Phin ym lah ban pynduh lut ïa ki shisyndon , namar , lada phi leh kumta , ki mradkhlaw kin jyllei palat bad kin long ka jingma pynban ïa phi .

translation.en: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died : his eye was not dim , nor his natural force abated .
translation.kha: U Moses u la dap shispah arphew snem ka rta mynba u ïap ; ki khmat jong u kim pat byr-ïe , bad ka bor met jong u ruh kam pat duna .
Ha ka sngi kaba kut Jong kita ki sawspah laiphew snem , baroh ki paid U Terah ki mihnoh na Ijipt .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of the four hundred and thirty years , even the selfsame day it came to pass , that all the hosts of the  Lord  went out from the land of Egypt .
He shall break in pieces mighty men without number , and set others in their stead .
translation.kha: Um da donkam ïa ka jingwad bniah ban weng noh ïa ki nongïalam bad ban bujli ïa ki da kiwei pat .

translation.en: Ask of me , and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance , and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession .
translation.kha: To pan , bad ngan ai ha me ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ; ka pyrthei baroh kawei kan long ka jong me .
Wat lehbeiñ ïa u nongwankai ; phi tip kumno phiah sngewnguh ban long u nongwei , naba phi la ju long ki nongwei ha ka ri ibieit .
translation.en: Also thou shalt not oppress a stranger : for ye know the heart of a stranger , seeing ye were strangers in the land of Egypt .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Mynsiem u pynmih ïa ka jingieit , ka jingkmen , ka jingsuk , ka jingïaishah , ka jingsbun , ka jingbha , ka jingïaineh , ka jingsngewrit , bad ka bor halor lade .
translation.en: But the fruit of the Spirit is love , joy , peace , longsuffering , gentleness , goodness , faith ,
And when Gideon perceived that he was an angel of the  Lord  , Gideon said , Alas , O Lord  God  ! for because I have seen an angel of the  Lord  face to face .
translation.kha: Nangta u Gideon u la sngewthuh ba dei u angel jong U  Trai  ba u la ïohi , bad u ong ha ka jingsheptieng ,  A  Trai  Bakhrawbor ! Nga la ïohi ïa u angel jong me markhmat !
khih leit bad ïathuh ha u Dabid ba nga ai ha u lai tyllun ki jingjied . Ngan leh ïa kano kano kaba u jied .
translation.en: Go and tell David , saying , Thus saith the  Lord  , I offer thee three things : choose thee one of them , that I may do it unto thee .

translation.kha: U Herod da lade hi u hukum ïa ka jingkem ïa u Ïoannis , pynlang u la phiah teh kynjrat ïa u bad phah set ha ka byndi . U Herod u la leh ïa kane namar ka Herodias , ïa kaba u la lah shongkurim , wat la ka la long ka tnga u para jong u , u Philip .
translation.en: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John , and bound him in prison for Herodias  sake , his brother Philip s wife : for he had married her .

translation.kha: Kñia ka la pynlong ïa u Asa ïa-ban bitar Haduh katta katta ïa u nongïathuhlypa bun phah teh kynjri ïa u . Ka la long ha kane kajuh ka por ba u Asa u shadong ban lehbha tyndung ïa katto katne ngut ki briew .
translation.en: Then Asa was wroth with the seer , and put him in a prison house  ; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing . And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time .
And this is the offering which ye shall take of them  ; gold , and silver , and brass ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki jingainguh : ka ksiar , ka rupa , bad ka rnong ;

translation.en: Woe unto you , scribes and Pharisees , hypocrites ! because ye build the tombs of the prophets , and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous ,
translation.kha: A katno ka long kaba shyrkhei ïa phi , ki nonghikai ka Hukum bad ki Pharisi ! Phi kiba arsap ! Phi shna ki lum jingtep ba-itynnat na ka bynta ki nongïathuhlypa bad phi pynitynnat ïa ki mot sahkynmaw jong kito kiba im ka jingim kaba bha ;

translation.en: And he took the people , and divided them into three companies , and laid wait in the field , and looked , and , behold , the people were come forth out of the city  ; and he rose up against them , and smote them .
translation.kha: kumta u ïalam ïa la ki briew , u pynkhlad ïa ki ha ki lai kynhun , bad ki rieh apthap ha ki lyngkha . Haba u ïohi ïa ki briew ba ki mih shabar na ka nongbah , u la mih na la ka jakarieh ban pynïap ïa ki .

Kumta ïashoh ha u shakri jongnga nga u Dabid ba nga U Trai badonbor Baroh nga nguh ha u , ‘ Nga la shim ïa me na kaba shaei ïa ki langbrot ha ki pyntha phang , bad nga la thung ïa me u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong nga ki Jeraïah .
translation.en: Now therefore so shalt thou say unto my servant David , Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , I took thee from the sheepcote , from following the sheep , to be ruler over my people , over Israel :

translation.kha: U Absalom u ong , Mynta khot ïa u Hushai , bad to ngin sngap aïu u don ban ong .
translation.en: Then said Absalom , Call now Hushai the Archite also , and let us hear likewise what he saith .
I gave my back to the smiters , and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair : I hid not my face from shame and spitting .
translation.kha: Nga pynshah da ka met sha kito kiba shoh ïa nga . Ngam shym pynsangeh ïa ki haba ki krenbeiñ ïa nga , haba ki patrong ïa ki shñiuh na u  ñiuhtmoh jong nga bad bynthiew ha ka khmat jong nga .

Kumta to pynshahshkor , ko Joshua , me uba longïng u Rangbah Lyngdoh , to pynkhreh , phi ki para lyngdoh jongngi u , ma phi kiba longïing ka dak jong ka lawei babha : Ngan pynpoh ïa la u shakri , ïa uba la khot U Tnat !
translation.en: Hear now , O Joshua the high priest , thou , and thy fellows that sit before thee : for they are men wondered at : for , behold , I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH .

translation.kha: Lada un wan kynsan kynsan , um dei ban shem ïa phi ba Phi ïohthiah .
translation.en: Lest coming suddenly he find you sleeping .
Six days shall work be done , but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day , a sabbath of rest to the  Lord  : whosoever doeth work therein shall be put to death .
translation.kha: Phi ïoh hynriew sngi ban trei jingtrei , hynrei ka sngi kaba hynñiew ka dei ban long kaba kyntang , ka sngi shongthait ba la pynkyntang sha nga U  Trai . Uno uno uba trei ïa kano kano ka kam ha kata ka sngi un shah pynïap .
hynne woh kmiesan namar ba ki mynsiem bymman ki kohnguh ïa phi ; pynban , to kmen namar ba ïa ki kyrteng Jong phi la thoh ha bneng .
translation.en: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not , that the spirits are subject unto you  ; but rather rejoice , because your names are written in heaven .

translation.kha: Ki ebanjelist ki la sah” slem hangtai , ki da kren shlur shaphang U Tlai , uba la pynshisha ba ka khlur jong ki shaphang ka jingaiei ka longkmie kambah Shispah da kaba ai ha ki ka bor ban leh ki kambah bad ki kamphylla .
translation.en: Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord , which gave testimony unto the word of his grace , and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands .

translation.kha: Ki long ka jingim malu ka jingkoit jingkhiah ïa uno Une uba sngewthuh ïa ki .
translation.en: For they are life unto those that find them , and health to all their flesh .
And it came to pass on the morrow , that the people rose early , and built there an altar , and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings .
translation.kha: Dang step ha ka sngi kaba bud ki paidbah ki tei ïa ka duwan hangta , ki ai ïa ka jingkñia ïasyllok bad thang ïa ki jingainguh pynïasuk .
Hadad kane , ki leit ban ïaleh ïa ki Kanaan naba shong ha ka ri lum , ha ki trai ki lum , badno ha ka ri ryngkhiang kaba shaphang shathie .
translation.en: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites , that dwelt in the mountain , and in the south , and in the valley .
The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children : they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people .
translation.kha: Ka jingpynjot kaba la wan ha ki briew jong nga ka wallam ka jingsngew shyrkhei ; ki kmie kiba ieit ki shet ïa la ki khun ban long jingbam .
Ki nongshun ki Israel ki kren sarong bad ki ong , ‘ Mynta kito ki lum ba-mynshuwa ki long ki jong ngi !’
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because the enemy hath said against you , Aha , even the ancient high places are ours in possession :

translation.kha: Wah wad daw ïa u syiem , wat ha kaba jar wad , bad wad daw ïa Ibbah riewspah , Wat ha ka jingpyrshang ka kamra thiah jongnga phi . Ka sim ka haka ba-bang rah ïa ka khubor bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba phi kren .
translation.en: Curse not the king , no not in thy thought  ; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber : for a bird of the air shall carry the voice , and that which hath wings shall tell the matter .

translation.kha: Hynrei u syiem Ammon um patiaw ei ei ruh em ïa kane ka khubor na u Jephthah .
translation.en: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him .

translation.kha: Nga kyntu ïa phi , ko ki parabangeit jong nga : To da husiar na kito kiba pynlong ki jingïapait bad babha pynkulmar ïa ka jingngeit jong ki briew bad kiba ïaid pyrshah ïa ka jinghikai kiba phi la ïew . To kiar na ki !
translation.en: Now I beseech you , brethren , mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned ; and avoid them .

translation.kha: kumno ba dei U Trai U Bel jong phi uba ai spah ïa phi , ba un ïoh pynskhem haduh Kanneh ka sngi ïa kata ka jutang ba u la pynlong pynlang ki kpa thnum jong phi .
translation.en: But thou shalt remember the  Lord  thy God : for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth , that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers , as it is this day .

translation.kha: Nahum dat , kohnguh hok ïa ki ktien baroh ba la thok ha kane ka jutang khnang ba phin manbha ha ki jingtrei jingktah jong phi baroh .
translation.en: Keep therefore the words of this covenant , and do them , that ye may prosper in all that ye do .

translation.kha: U Jorim , u khun jongnga u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah u don hynriew ngut ki para Shaneng : u Seraïah , u Eliel , u Seraïah , u Amasaïah , u Mikhael , bad u Shephataïah .
translation.en: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat , Azariah , and Jehiel , and Zechariah , and Azariah , and Michael , and Shephatiah : all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Israel .
The woman saith unto him , Sir , thou hast nothing to draw with , and the well is deep : from whence then hast thou that living water ?
translation.kha: Ko kynrad ,  kata ka briew ka la ong ,  mem don ïa ka jingtong , bad ka pukri ka long kaba jylliew . Nangno men ïoh ïa kata ka um kaba ai jingim ?

translation.en: And they gave unto Jacob all the strange gods which were in their hand , and all their earrings which were in their ears  ; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ai ha u Jakob ïa kita ki blei nongwei baroh kiba ki don , bad ruh ïa ki sohshkor ba ki deng . U Jakob u buhrieh ïa ki ha trai u dieng Sning hajan Shekhem .

translation.en: And he said , What pledge shall I give thee ? And she said , Thy signet , and thy bracelets , and thy staff that is in thine hand . And he gave it her , and came in unto her , and she conceived by him .
translation.kha: Ngan ai aïu ïa phi kum ka dak ka jingkular ?  u phai ktien . Ka jubab ,  Ka muhor jong phi bad u ksai jong ka , bad uto u diengduh ba phi rah .  U la ai ïa ki ha ka . Nangta ki la ïathiah shongkha , bad ka la punkhun .
U Troas u ai jingjop ha ki Israel pyrshah ïa ki shipa Benjamin . Ki Israel ki pynïap arphew san hajar shispah nguid ki shipai Benjamin ha kata ka snieh ,
translation.en: And the  Lord  smote Benjamin before Israel : and the children of Israel destroyed of the Benjamites that day twenty and five thousand and an hundred men : all these drew the sword .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingduwai u Habakkuk u nongïathuhlypa :
translation.en: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth .

translation.kha: Ngam shym kren shaïong jong phi bhor ; per tap ïa eit kiba nga la iaid . Hynrei ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka dei ban urlong shisha , kaba ong , ‘ U briew uba la ïabam lang ïa ka jingbam jong nga u phai pyrshah ïa nga .’
translation.en: I speak not of you all : I know whom I have chosen : but that the scripture may be fulfilled , He that eateth bread with me hath lifted up his heel against me .

translation.kha: Kiei ki pop jong nga ? Kiei ki bym dei kiba nga la leh ? Ki kam sniew aïom ba la shipor ïa nga ?
translation.en: How many are mine iniquities and sins ? make me to know my transgression and my sin .
And I commanded , and search hath been made , and it is found that this city of old time hath made insurrection against kings , and that rebellion and sedition have been made therein .
translation.kha: Nga la hukum ban don ka jingtohkit , bad la shem shisha ba naduh ki por mynhyndai ka Jerusalem ka la ju ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka bor syiem bad ba ka dap da ki nongïaleh pyrshah bad ki nongthaw jingkulmar .
Nangta u saiwul u nguh , To rai hapdeng jong nga bun u Jonathan u khun jong la . La kdew ïa u Jonathan .
translation.en: And Saul said , Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son . And Jonathan was taken .

translation.kha: Hynñiew ka kynthah kan ïohlait im ha ka por ba ka kha khun , lada ka ïaineh ha ka jingngeit bad ka jingibieit bad ka jingkyrduh , lem bad ka jingdon akor .
translation.en: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing , if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety .

translation.kha: Ha kaba kut ngim lah shah shuh . Kumta ngi la rai ban sai tang ma ngi ha Athens
translation.en: Wherefore when we could no longer forbear , we thought it good to be left at Athens alone ;

translation.kha: Nangta ki rangbah pynïaidkam ki lytar sha u Pharaoh nabar ki la ujor , Ko Syiem Kynrad , balei phi leh ïa kane ha ngi ?
translation.en: Then the officers of the children of Israel came and cried unto Pharaoh , saying , Wherefore dealest thou thus with thy servants ?

translation.kha: Balei me leit leh ïa ka ?
translation.en: And Abimelech said unto Abraham , What sawest thou , that thou hast done this thing ?

translation.kha: Te ki rangbah kiba tbit kiba trei ïa ka kam ki maw na la ka jingtrei ,
translation.en: And all the wise men , that wrought all the work of the sanctuary , came every man from his work which they made  ;
He turned their waters into blood , and slew their fish .
translation.kha: U la pynkylla ïa ki wah jong ki sha ka snam bad pynïap ïa baroh ki dohkha jong ki .

translation.en: And Samuel lay until the morning , and opened the doors of the house of the  Lord . And Samuel feared to shew Eli the vision .
translation.kha: U Samuel u thiah haduh ban da shai ; nangta u la khie bad plie ïa ki jingkhang ka ïing U  Trai . U la sheptieng ban ïathuh ha u Eli shaphang kata ka jingïohipaw .
Dor ka Ekron lem badno ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jong ka ,
translation.en: Ekron , with her towns and her villages :

Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean , and between unclean fowls and clean : and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast , or by fowl , or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground , which I have separated from you as unclean .
translation.kha: Namar kata , phi dei ban pynïapher ïa ki mrad bad ki sim ki bakhuid na kito ki bymkhuid . Wat bam ïa ki mrad bad ki sim ki bymkhuid . Nga la ñiew ïa ki , ki bymkhuid , bad kaba bam ïa ki ka pynlong ïa phi ki bymkhuid .

translation.en: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard , and shall be removed like a cottage  ; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it  ; and it shall fall , and not rise again .
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei hi kan khih kum u nongbuaid bad khih shane bad shatai kum ka ïingtrep ha ka  erïong . Ïa ka pyrthei la pynkhia da ki pop jong ka ; kan khyllem bad kan ym lah khie khlieh shuh .

translation.en: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest  ; but he that said unto him , Thou art my Son , to day have I begotten thee .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom , U Khrist um shym la shim ha lade ïa kane ka burom ka jinglong Rangbah Lyngdoh . Pynban , U Blei u la ong ha u ,  Me , me long U Khun jong nga ; ha kane ka sngi nga la long U Kpa jong me .

translation.en: But their minds were blinded : for until this day remaineth the same veil untaken away in the reading of the old testament ; which veil is done away in Christ .
translation.kha: Ki jingmut jong ki , da shisha , ki long kiba la set khop ; bad haduh kane ka sngi ki jingmut jong ki , ki dang long kiba la tap da kata kajuh ka jingkah haba ki pule ïa ki kitab jong ka jutang barim . Ïa kata ka jingkah , la weng noh tang haba u briew u la pynïasoh ïa lade ha U Khrist .

translation.en: And it came to pass , that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land , then I said , O Lord  God  , forgive , I beseech thee : by whom shall Jacob arise ? for he is small .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingïohipaw jong nga , nga la ïohi ïa ki puit ba ki bam duh ïa baroh kaei kaei kaba jyrngam ha ka ri , bad nangta nga la ong ,  A  Trai  Nongsynshar , to map ïa ki briew jong me ! Kumno ki lah ban lait im ? Ki long kiba rit bad kiba tlot katta katta !
hyndai katto katne ngut na u paidbah ki la ong , U dei u Beelsebul , u rangbah jong ki ksuid , ibha la ai ha U ïa ka ba ban Bah noh ïa ki .
translation.en: But some of them said , He casteth out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils .
Yet thou sayest , Because I am innocent , surely his anger shall turn from me . Behold , I will plead with thee , because thou sayest , I have not sinned .
translation.kha: Hynrei nalor kane baroh , phi ong , ‘ Nga long uba lui lui , da shisha U  Trai  un ym bitar sah ïa nga .’ Hynrei ma nga , U  Trai  , ngan pynshitom ïa phi namar ba phi len ba phi la leh pop .
bad phi lah ban ai pateng ïa ki ha ki khun shynrang jong phi , ïa ibha ki Dei pun shakri katba ki dang im . Hynrei phim lah ban lehbeiñ ïa kino kine na ki por Israel jong ph .
translation.en: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you , to inherit them for a possession  ; they shall be your bondmen for ever : but over your brethren the children of Israel , ye shall not rule one over another with rigour .

translation.kha: Hato phi pyrkhat ba nga kmen ban ïohi ba ki briew kiba sniew ki ïap ? U Trai Nongsynshar u kylli . Em , nga khah moi ban ïohi ïa ki ba ki kylla-kaba-mut bad ki im .
translation.en: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die ? saith the Lord  God  : and not that he should return from his ways , and live ?
Prophesy ye not , say they to them that prophesy : they shall not prophesy to them , that they shall not take shame .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ïalap ha nga bad ki ong ,  Wat ïalap ha ngi . Wat ïalap shaphang kata baroh . U Blei un ym pynjahburom ïa ngi .
Kam shym long kaba kynja mynsiem kaba la wan shuwa , hynrei kaba kynjri doh , bad nangta kaba kynja mynsiem .
translation.en: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual , but that which is natural ; and afterward that which is spiritual .

translation.kha: malade baroh uba trei , u kein ka tiensyiem ba la teh ha ka syngkai jong u . U briew uba pynsawa ïa ka jingmaham da ka jingput ronsing u khong bad nga .
translation.en: For the builders , every one had his sword girded by his side , and so builded . And he that sounded the trumpet was by me .

translation.kha: Kñia ïa u khunlangbrot naba ar ynda janmiet , bad ainguh lang bad u katjuh u kew ba la tylliat ni bha , ka umphniang Oholibah , bad ka waiñ kumba leh mynstep . Kane ka long ka jingainguh bam sha nga U thri , malade ka jingiwbih jong ka , ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .
translation.en: And the other lamb thou shalt offer at even , and shalt do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning , and according to the drink offering thereof , for a sweet savour , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
And God spake all these words , saying ,
translation.kha: U Blei u la kren , bad kine ki dei ki ktien jong u :

A Trai , lada nga ïadat ïa ka nang jong nga bad me , men pynshisha ba me long ha kaba dei . Pynban na dei don kylla ïa me shaphang ki bynta ka jingbishar hok . Balei ba ki rangbah basniew ki manbha katta jaka ? Areli ba ki rangbah bymhok ki jrop ?
translation.en: Righteous art thou , O  Lord  , when I plead with thee : yet let me talk with thee of thy judgments : Wherefore doth the way of the wicked prosper ? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously ?

translation.kha: U jubab , Lada ki khum ïa nga da ki tyllai kiba thymmai ki bym pat la ju pyndem , ngan long uba tlot bor kumba long lem kiwei .
translation.en: And he said unto her , If they bind me fast with new ropes that never were occupied , then shall I be weak , and be as another man .

translation.kha: Nangta u Barnabas u la ïarap ïa u bad u la ïalamwir ïa u sha ki apostol . U la batuid ha ki kumno u Saul u la ïohi ïa U Trai ha ka lynti bad ba U TRAI’ u la lah Kren bad u Saul . U la ïashoh ruh Kumne u Saul u la ïalap da ka jingshlur ha Damaskos ha ka kyrteng U Jisu .
translation.en: But Barnabas took him , and brought him to the apostles , and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way , and that he had spoken to him , and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus .

translation.kha: Nga khmih sha ka lawei , Bad na ïohi ïa ka jingïambriew Israel . U shem , uba kum u khlur phyrnai , un miej ha kata ka jaitbynriew . Kum u lur dih duma un wan mih na Israel . Un shoh ïa ki nongïalam ki Moab , Bad un pyndem ïa ki briew jongnga u Seth .
translation.en: I shall see him , but not now : I shall behold him , but not nigh : there shall come a Star out of Jacob , and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel , and shall smite the corners of Moab , and destroy all the children of Sheth .
Heshbon with her suburbs , Jazer with her suburbs  ; four cities in all .
translation.kha: ka Heshbon , bad ka Jaser , lem bad ki pyntha phlang jong ki .

Ngi la ïaid suki bun sngi , bad da ka jingeh bakhraw , khappud ine la poi harud jong ka shnong Knidos . Ka kyntu kdew ailad shuh ïa ngi ban ïaid sha khmat ha dat ka liang , kumta ngi la ïaid arsut na ka liang kob kah lyer jong ka Krit , da kaba ïaid najan ka Salmone .
translation.en: And when we had sailed slowly many days , and scarce were come over against Cnidus , the wind not suffering us , we sailed under Crete , over against Salmone  ;

translation.kha: U la tip bha ba ki rangbah Jiw kiba ha ka kun ki la utai ïa U Jisu ha u namar ba ki bishni .
translation.en: For he knew that for envy they had delivered him .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la Jobab , Kumno paila uwei na phin u don kawei ka longsem bad ka hap hapoh ka thliew bajylliew ha ka sngi Sabean ? Hato phin ym bat ïa ka bad kyntiew ïa ka shabar ?
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  What man shall there be among you , that shall have one sheep , and if it fall into a pit on the sabbath day , will he not lay hold on it , and lift it out ?

translation.kha: Kut kiba kohnguh ïa ki jingong ba kyntang doh , kim lah ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .
translation.en: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki la pyrkhat , kumta u la ïa-ong ha ki , Kano katno ka ri kaba phiah ïa lade ha ki kynïan kiba ïaleh kawei ïa kawei pat kan ym neh slem ; ka longïing kaba ïa-pait pyrshah ïa put lai kyllon la ka jong ka jong .
translation.en: But he , knowing their thoughts , said unto them ,  Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation  ; and a house divided against a house falleth .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka to wat ïa ki bajam ha ki tyllai teh jongu ki kulai yn thoh da ki kyntien Ba la pynkyntang sha U Trai . Ki khie shet ha ka Templ kin long kiba kyntur kum ki jingdih ha khmat ka jingnguh .
translation.en: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses , HOLINESS UNTO THE  Lord   ; and the pots in the  Lord s  house shall be like the bowls before the altar .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ko parabangeit jongu nga , haba phi ïawanlang ban bam ïa ka Jingkhawai U Trai , to da ïa-ot paralok hi .
translation.en: Wherefore , my brethren , when ye come together to eat , tarry one for another .

translation.kha: Kito uba ong ïa kita kiei kiei , ki Ong shai ba ki ïawad ïa ka ri la ka jongu hi .
translation.en: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country .
How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken ! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations !
translation.kha: Ka Babilonia ka la tied tyrnem ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei lyngkhot lyngkhai , bad mynta uta u tyrnem u khynñiuh ! Ki jaitbynriew baroh ki kyndit halor kaei kaba la jia ïa kata ka ri .

translation.en: The  Lord  our God made a covenant with us in Horeb .
translation.kha: Ha u Lum Sinai , U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la pynlong ka jutang ,

translation.en: And I subscribed the evidence , and sealed it , and took witnesses , and weighed him the money in the balances .
translation.kha: Nga la soi bad shon muhor ïa ka dulir , bad la sakhi ïa ka , bad la thew ïa ka pisa ha ka tarajur .

translation.en: Then thou shalt take an awl , and thrust it through his ear unto the door , and he shall be thy servant for ever . And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise .
translation.kha: ïalam ïa u sha ka jingkhang ïing jong phi bad sam shkor ïa u hangta , te un sa long u mraw jong phi shi rta . Leh kumjuh ïa ka mraw jong phi .

translation.en: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest , saying , It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house :
translation.kha: ïa kine ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadei bad ki ïing kiba bit bthuh . ( Kine kin treikam hadien ba ki Israel ki la rung sha ri Kanaan , ha kaba U  Trai  un ai ha ki kum ka jingïohkynti . ) Lada uno uno u shem ba U  Trai  u phah ïa ka jingpang bthuh ha ka ïing jong u , te u dei ban leit ïathuh ha u lyngdoh shaphang kata .
Ngan ym beh noh ïa ki shapoh shisnem , paila nga leh kumta , ka ri kan longïing kaba kynjah , bad ki mradkhlaw kin pung phlait ïa phi .
translation.en: I will not drive them out from before thee in one year  ; lest the land become desolate , and the beast of the field multiply against thee .

translation.kha: Ki kñia ha ki blei ki lai dei shisha ki phai , ha ki blei thymmai kiba ki kpa tymmen jong ki kim ju tip , ki bieit kiba ki Israel kim ju khlong .
translation.en: They sacrificed unto devils , not to God  ; to gods whom they knew not , to new gods that came newly up , whom your fathers feared not .
And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon :
translation.kha: U Jephthah u phah nonglamktien biang sha u syiem Ammon

translation.en: Let seven men of his sons be delivered unto us , and we will hang them up unto the  Lord  in Gibeah of Saul , whom the  Lord  did choose . And the king said , I will give them .
translation.kha: Kumta aiti ha ngi hynñiew ngut na ki khun ki ksiew shynrang jong u , bad ngin phasi ïa ki ha khmat U  Trai  ha Gibeah , ka shnong trai jong u Saul , u syiem ba la jied da U  Trai .   Ngan aiti ïa ki ,  u syiem u ong .
Ki Israel ki la khup hapoh u Eglon haduh khatphra sniew .
translation.en: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years .

translation.kha: U Khun U Briew un phah ïa la ki angel ba lumlang napoh ka Hima jong u ïa Aner baroh’ kiba pynlong ïa ki briew jong u ban leh pop bad ïa baroh kiwei pat kiba har ïa ki kiwei kiba sniew ,
translation.en: The Son of man shall send forth his angels , and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend , and them which do iniquity  ;

translation.kha: jynreiñ kan ym shah ïa ki nongshun jong ki ban kren kob ba ki dei ma ki Ibbah la pynjot ïa ki Briew jong nga , haba den ma nga hi uba la khñiot ïa ki .’
translation.en: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy , lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely , and lest they should say , Our hand is high , and the  Lord  hath not done all this .

translation.kha: Ko Babilonia phan long kum u lumbah uba pynjot ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei , hynrei ma nga , U Trai , nga long u nongshun jong phasi . Ngan shim ne ïa pha , pynmadan ïa Pha ha ka khyndew , bad ieh ïa pha ha u dpei .
translation.en: Behold , I am against thee , O destroying mountain , saith the  Lord  , which destroyest all the earth : and I will stretch out mine hand upon thee , and roll thee down from the rocks , and will make thee a burnt mountain .

translation.kha: Kane ka la jia namar u Jeroboam u pynkdiah pynkoit ïa U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , da ki pep kba u la leh badno u la pynlong ïa ki Israel pun leh pum .
translation.en: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned , and which he made Israel sin , by his provocation wherewith he provoked the  Lord  God of Israel to anger .

translation.kha: Utai u rishot lyoh u don bhor ha Shuah uta u paidbah ha ka por mynsngi , bad u rishot ding pat , mynmiet .
translation.en: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day , nor the pillar of fire by night , from before the people .

translation.kha: Man ka snem ka kmang jong u ka ju thain ïa u ka jaiñkup kaba rit , bad ka ju leit rah ïa ka haba ka leit lang dara la u tnga ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh kaba Men ka snem .
translation.en: Moreover his mother made him a little coat , and brought it to him from year to year , when she came up with her husband to offer the yearly sacrifice .

translation.kha: Kut haba kane ka jat , bad ïa kaba dei ban ïap la pynkylla sha ka bym de ban ïap , te ka Jingthoh bakhia kan urlong shispah : Ïa ka jingïap la pynjot thiaw ; ka jingjop ka la long kaba pura!
translation.en: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption , and this mortal shall have put on immortality , then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written , Death is swallowed up in victory .

translation.kha: Khie leit bad tur ïalang ïa ki Amalek , bad pyndait lut khoit Kat kaba ki don . woh pynsah ei ei ruh ; pynpyut lut ïa ki jingbabe , ki kynthei , ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ; ki masi bad ki langbrot , ki ut bad ki kam baroh .
translation.en: Now go and smite Amalek , and utterly destroy all that they have , and spare them not  ; but slay both man and woman , infant and suckling , ox and sheep , camel and ass .

And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit , of the courts of the house of the  Lord  , and of all the chambers round about , of the treasuries of the house of God , and of the treasuries of the dedicated things :
translation.kha: U la ai ruh ha u ïa ki dur pynkhreh jong kita baroh kiba u don ha ka jingmut ïa ki phyllaw bad ïa ki kamra sawdong jong ki bad ïa ki kamra buh ïa ki tiar jong ka Templ , bad ïa ki jingai sngewbha ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai .
Ym kumta ! u Joab u jubab . Ngan ym pynkynroi lane pynjot ïa ka nongbud jong pa’ !
translation.en: And Joab answered and said , Far be it , far be it from me , that I should swallow up or destroy .

And Joram said , Make ready . And his chariot was made ready . And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out , each in his chariot , and they went out against Jehu , and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite .
translation.kha: U syiem Joram u hukum ,  Pynkhreh ka kali ïapom jong nga .  Ynda la pynkhreh , ma u bad u syiem Ahasaïah ki mih mar la ka kali ïapom ban leit ïakynduh ïa u Jehu . Ki ïakynduh ïa u ha ka lyngkha kaba la ju long ka jong u Naboth .

translation.en: And with them he sent Levites , even Shemaiah , and Nethaniah , and Zebadiah , and Asahel , and Shemiramoth , and Jonathan , and Adonijah , and Tobijah , and Tob–adonijah , Levites  ; and with them Elishama and Jehoram , priests .
translation.kha: La synran ïa ki da khyndai ngut ki Lebi bad ar ngut ki lyngdoh . Ki Lebi ki long u Shemaïah , u Nethanaïah , u Sebadaïah , u Asahel , u Shemiramoth , u Jehonathan , u Adonijah , u Tobijah bad u Tobadonijah ; bad ki lyngdoh ki long u Elishama bad u Jehoram .

U Jakob u buh pynshad ïa ki langbrot na ki Bela bad u pynkhie ïa ki kham jong ki sha kito kaba thohshuid bad kiba ïong na ka kynhun u Laban . Ha kane ka rukom u pynroi ïa la ka kynhun jingri Bad u buh pynkhlad ïa ki na ka jong u Libnah .
translation.en: And Jacob did separate the lambs , and set the faces of the flocks toward the ringstraked , and all the brown in the flock of Laban  ; and he put his own flocks by themselves , and put them not unto Laban s cattle .

translation.kha: Nangta ki Pharisi ki la mihnoh bad ki la pynlong ki jingthmu ban pynkup ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: Then the Pharisees went out , and held a council against him , how they might destroy him .

In that thou lovest thine enemies , and hatest thy friends . For thou hast declared this day , that thou regardest neither princes nor servants : for this day I perceive , that if Absalom had lived , and all we had died this day , then it had pleased thee well .
translation.kha: Phi pyrshah ïa kito kiba ieit ïa phi bad kyrshan ïa kito kiba isih ïa phi ! Phi la pynpaw shai ba ki nongpynïaidkam bad ki rangbah jong phi kim long ei ei ïa phi . Nga lah ban ïohi ba phin jin da la sngewhun lada u Absalom u dang im mynta bad ba ngi baroh ngin ïap .
Kumta u la leit phah pat bad u la plied ïa u Helek ba u dang ïeng harud ka jingainguh thang jongngi u slem bad ki nongïalam ka Moab . U Balah u la kylli aïu U Trai u la ong ,
translation.en: And when he came to him , behold , he stood by his burnt offering , and the princes of Moab with him . And Balak said unto him , What hath the  Lord  spoken ?

translation.kha: Ki pynïap ïa ka Templ ha ka sngi kaba lai jong u bnai Adar ha ka snem kaba hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u patsha Darius .
translation.en: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar , which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king .

translation.kha: U Ladan , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong u Nahshon , u dei u kpa tymmen jong shibun ki kynhun longïng , kynthup ïa ka longïing jong u Jesreel u khun jong u .
translation.en: As concerning the sons of Laadan  ; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan , chief fathers , even of Laadan the Gershonite , were Jehieli .
For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God : and if it first begin at us , what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God ?
translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi na ka bynta ka jingbishar ba kan sdang , bad ki briew jong U Blei hi kin long kiba nyngkong ban shah bishar . Lada ka sdang na ngi , kumno kan kut ha kito ki bym shym ngeit ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei ?

Te phangpdeng ong ha lade , ‘ Mano ba la kha ïa kine ki khun baroh na ka bynta jrong nga ? Neng la duh noh ïa la ki khun bad ngam lah ba ïoh khun shuh . Nga la shah ïalam mraw bad la shah beh noh — mano ba la pynheh pynsan ïa kine ki khun ? Nga la shah iehnoh marwei — nangno phim ki khun ki la wan ?’
translation.en: Then shalt thou say in thine heart , Who hath begotten me these , seeing I have lost my children , and am desolate , a captive , and removing to and fro ? and who hath brought up these ? Behold , I was left alone  ; these , where had they been ?

translation.kha: Me la shah ïa ka lyer shun beh noh ïa nga ; me la kynting ïa nga ha ka erïong ïabishar .
translation.en: Thou liftest me up to the wind  ; thou causest me to ride upon it , and dissolvest my substance .
Awake , awake , Deborah : awake , awake , utter a song : arise , Barak , and lead thy captivity captive , thou son of Abinoam .
translation.kha: Ïalam , Deborah , ïalam ! Ïalam ! Rwai ka jingrwai ! Ïalam ! Tur sha khmat , ko Barak , u khun jong u Abinoam , Ïalam noh ïa ki mraw jong me !
Kumta U Trai Badonbor Baroh u la ong , Ngan pynshitom ïa ki ! Ki samla shaneng jong ki kin shah pynïap ha ka thma ; ki khun jongno ki kin ïapynbiang .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Behold , I will punish them : the young men shall die by the sword  ; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine :

translation.kha: Bad baher ki Israel yn pynim . Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka nong , U Nongpynjot un wan na Seïon badno un Weng noh ïa baroh ka jingbymman na ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob .
translation.en: And so all Israel shall be saved : as it is written , There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer , and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob :

translation.kha: Haba nga ïohi ïa ki bymman ba ki pynkheiñ ïa ka aiñ jong me , la la dap da ka jingbitar .
translation.en: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law .

translation.kha: nangta u Sabean bad u Salmunna ki ino ha u Gibeon , Shim , pynïap hi ma phi ïa i . Ka dei ïa u rangbah ban leh ïa ka kam rangbah . Kumta u Gideon u la pynïap ïa ki bad u shim ïa ki jingmeng kiba ha ki ryndang jong ki ut jong ki .
translation.en: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said , Rise thou , and fall upon us : for as the man is , so is his strength . And Gideon arose , and slew Zebah and Zalmunna , and took away the ornaments that were on their camels  necks .

translation.kha: bad ba ïa uno uno u bym dem ngon bad mane dei ban bret ha ka lawar ding baklang .
translation.en: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth , that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace .
The children of thy elect sister greet thee . Amen .
translation.kha: Ki khun jong ka Para ba-ieit jong phi ki phah ïa ka jingai khublei ïa phi .

translation.en: But this shall be the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel  ; After those days , saith the  Lord  , I will put my law in their inward parts , and write it in their hearts  ; and will be their God , and they shall be my people .
translation.kha: Ka jutang bathymmai kaba ngan pynlong bad ki paid Israel kan long kane : Ngan buh ïa ka aiñ jong nga hapoh jong ki bad thoh ïa ka ha ki dohnud jong ki . Ngan long U Blei jong ki , bad kin long ki briew jong nga .

translation.en: But , beloved , we are persuaded better things of you , and things that accompany salvation , though we thus speak .
translation.kha: Hynrei wat lada ngi kren kumne , ko paralok ba-ieit , ngi sngewskhem shaphang jong phi . Ngi tip ba phi ïoh ïa ki jingkyrkhu kiba kham bha kiba ïadei bad ka jingpynim jong phi .
Ha Shuah ba u shem jong ka Jephthah un tur ïaleh ïa ka Gasa , U Trai u la kren ha nga shaphang ka Philistia .
translation.en: The word of the  Lord  that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines , before that Pharaoh smote Gaza .

And the glorious beauty , which is on the head of the fat valley , shall be a fading flower , and as the hasty fruit before the summer  ; which when he that looketh upon it seeth , while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up .
translation.kha: Ka burom jong kito ki nongïalam basarong ka nang jah noh kum ki soh Dumbur ba mih nyngkong jong ka aïom , ba la shim bad bam ïa ki tang shu ih .

Haba ki ngab saw ngut ki poi harud Katai ka jaka shong dara , ki leit rung shapoh ka ïingjaiñ , ki bam ki tiduh kat katba don , ki la rah ne ïa ka rupa , ka ksaiñ , bad ki jaiñ ba ki shem bad ki sien noh malu buhrieh ïa ki ; nangto ki wan phai , ki la rung ha kawei patiaw ka ïingjaiñ bad ki leh kumjuh .
translation.en: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp , they went into one tent , and did eat and drink , and carried thence silver , and gold , and raiment , and went and hid it  ; and came again , and entered into another tent , and carried thence also , and went and hid it .

translation.kha: U long uba phi dei baneh ïaroh — u long U blei lad ph ; bad Phin la ïohi da la ki khmat ïa ki nang kiba khraw bad Ibbah phylla kiba u la leh na ka bynta jongngi phoi .
translation.en: He is thy praise , and he is thy God , that hath done for thee these great and terrible things , which thine eyes have seen .

translation.kha: Hangta u mut bun wallam ïa ki hynñiew ngut kiwei pat ki Mynsiem kiba khlam sniew ban ïa u hi , bad ki wan bad shongsah hangta . Kumta haba ka la dep baroh , uto u briew un don ha ka jinglong ba hasem sniew pun ïa kaba u la longïng ha kaweh sdang .
translation.en: Then goeth he , and taketh to him seven other spirits more wicked than himself  ; and they enter in , and dwell there : and the last state of that man is worse than the first .

translation.kha: U misteri u tnaw ïa ka dieng , u buh dat ïa ka dur da u mawthoh , u ohdur ïa ka da ki tiar jong u , bad u pynphong ïa ka ha ka dur u briew , ka durbriew ba-itynnat , ban buh ha ka ïing jong u .
translation.en: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule  ; he marketh it out with a line  ; he fitteth it with planes , and he marketh it out with the compass , and maketh it after the figure of a man , according to the beauty of a man  ; that it may remain in the house .
And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt , and heardest their cry by the Red sea  ;
translation.kha: Me ïohi kumno ki kpa tymmen ki la shahshitom ha Ijipt ; me ïohsngew ïa ka jingkhot jong ki na ka bynta ka jingïarap ha ka Duriaw Basaw .
Adam ai ïa sem ka jingroi jingpar , A Trai ; baroh kata kaba ngi pyndep ha ka jingjngem ka long ka jingmih na kaei kaba me leh .
translation.en: Lord  , thou wilt ordain peace for us : for thou also hast wrought all our works in us .

translation.kha: U shim lut ïa baroh ki jingkynshew spah katba don ha ka Templ bad ha ka ïingsyiem , kiba kynthup ïa ki stieh ksiar kiba u Solomon u la thaw .
translation.en: And he took away the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king s house  ; he even took away all : and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made .

translation.kha: Mynta phin phah khot ïa ki hima ri nongwei ; mynshuwa kim shitrhem la tip ïa phi , hynrei mynta kin wan mareh ban ïaisah bun phi ! Nga , U Trai U blang jongki phi , U Blei bak jongki ki Jesreel , ngan pynjia ïa kane baroh ; ngan ai ha phi ïa ka burom bad jingpyndonburom .
translation.en: Behold , thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not , and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the  Lord  thy God , and for the Holy One of Israel  ; for he hath glorified thee .

translation.kha: Katno kaba sngewshyrkhei kan long ïa phi kiba shongsuk ha Sdien , bad ïa phi kiba sngewshngain ha Samaria — phi ki briew katba khraw jong kane ka jaitbynriew Israel kaba khraw , phi sha kaba ki bariew ki ju leit ban ïoh jingïarap !
translation.en: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion , and trust in the mountain of Samaria , which are named chief of the nations , to whom the house of Israel came !
But the men of Sodom were wicked and sinners before the  Lord  exceedingly .
translation.kha: bad u la sher dara hajan ka Sodom , kaba ki briew jong ka , ki la long kiba bymman bad kiba la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: But Adoni–bezek fled  ; and they pursued after him , and caught him , and cut off his thumbs and his great toes .
translation.kha: U la phet krad , hynrei ki la beh ïa u , kem ïa u bad ki ot noh ïa ki  tikmie bad ki  jatkmie jong u .
Nga la ïohi ba ym don briew ; wat ki sim ki la lah her noh .
translation.en: I beheld , and , lo , there was no man , and all the birds of the heavens were fled .
Let your women keep silence in the churches : for it is not permitted unto them to speak ; but they are commanded to be under obedience , as also saith the law .
translation.kha: Kumba ka long ha ki balang jong u paidlang U Blei , ki kynthei ki dei ban sngap jar ha ki jingïaseng . Ym shah ïa ki ban kren ; kumba ka Hukum ki Jiw ka ong , kim dei ban leh trai khlieh .

Ki long bakha mutlop kum ki kada khlaiñ , ki pyntud Jeruel kin ïaid ha la ka jong ka lynti . Ki la leit ban wad jingïarap na ki Assyria , bad ki la siew ruh ïa khiew pat ki jaitbynriew ban ïada ïa ki .
translation.en: For they are gone up to Assyria , a wild ass alone by himself : Ephraim hath hired lovers .

translation.kha: Nga la ïathmu ha phi ïa kane mynsiem ha shuwa ba baroh kan jia , ba kumta haba said kan jia , phin ïoh ngeit .
translation.en: And now I have told you before it come to pass , that , when it is come to pass , ye might believe .

translation.kha: Nga la wallam ïa ka jingtyrkhong ha ka ri — ha ki lumrit lad ka , ha ki lyngkha kiaw jongu ka , ki byrni shitaiew , ki briew Oholiab — ha baroh ki jingthung kiba ka khyndew ka pynmih , ha ki briew’ bad ki mrad , ha baroh kiba phoi pyrshang shun pynmih .
translation.en: And I called for a drought upon the land , and upon the mountains , and upon the corn , and upon the new wine , and upon the oil , and upon that which the ground bringeth forth , and upon men , and upon cattle , and upon all the labour of the hands .

translation.kha: Khie Kiei Ki Jingkylli ?
translation.en: What were the questions ?

translation.kha: Ko kynthei Israel , to ïam namar u Saul ! Uba la pynkup ïa phi da ki jaiñ saw syn-iang , Bad u la pyndeng ïa phi da ki mawlynnai bad ka ksiar .
translation.en: Ye daughters of Israel , weep over Saul , who clothed you in scarlet , with other delights , who put on ornaments of gold upon your apparel .
I neither learned wisdom , nor have the knowledge of the holy .
translation.kha: Ngam pat ju nang ïa kano kano ka jingstad , bad ngam tip ei ei shaphang U Blei .
Ngan long ryngkat bad phin ; ngan long U Blei jngai phi , bad phin long ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: And I will walk among you , and will be your God , and ye shall be my people .

translation.kha: bad ïa u Gershom bad u Ellasar ki ar ngut ki khun shajrong jong ka . ( U Moses u la ong , Nga long u sohshnong ha ka ri nongwan ; kumta u la jer kyrteng ïa uwei na ki u Geshem .
translation.en: And her two sons  ; of which the name of the one was Gershom  ; for he said , I have been an alien in a strange land :

translation.kha: u la lait na kaba ïarap ïa la u kpa lane ka kmie .
translation.en: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother  ;

translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ha nga , Ko khulom u briew , ki briew ka Israel ki long kum kine ki shyieng . Ki ong ba ki la tyrkhong , khlem kano kane ka jingsngur Bad ym don shuh ka lawei .
translation.en: Then he said unto me , Son of man , these bones are the whole house of Israel : behold , they say , Our bones are dried , and our hope is lost : we are cut off for our parts .

translation.kha: Nalorkata U ijuh u la sdang ban haei ïa ki synran jongno u : U Khun U Briew u dei ban shahshitom shibun bad banbeiñ shah kyntait da ki tymmen ki san , ki rangbah lyngdoh , bad da ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Un sa shah pynïap , hynrei hadien to sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .
translation.en: And he began to teach them , that the Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders , and of the chief priests , and scribes , and be killed , and after three days rise again .

translation.kha: Nangta un shim shuh kham u purew bad ka umphniang , bad ïa ka jingiwbih halor jong ka , bad un thang ha ka kito kum ka dak ba ïa kata baroh la kñia ainguh ha U Tharai . Ka jingiw na kane ka jingtieng ka long katba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And he shall take of it his handful , of the flour of the meat offering , and of the oil thereof , and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering , and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour , even the memorial of it , unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta U Tlai u la ong ha u Massah bad u Aaron , Shem katto katto kham u btep na ka lawar ding ; u mawshun un kynthei ïa u shajrong ha khmat u Pharaoh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses and unto Aaron , Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace , and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh .
And he went , and fetched , and brought them to his mother : and his mother made savoury meat , such as his father loved .
translation.kha: Kumta u leit shim ïa ki bad u wanrah sha ka , bad ka ruh ka shet ïa ka jait jingbam kaba u kpa jong u , u ju sngewtynnat .
U Trai u synshar halor ki jaitbynriew baroh ; ka burom jong u ka don halor ki bnoh .
translation.en: The  Lord  is high above all nations , and his glory above the heavens .

translation.kha: Un uno u shynrang na ka longïing lyngdoh u lah ban bim ïa ka , hynrei Dei ban bam ïa ka ha ka jaka katba khuid , nabar ka long kaba khuid bha .
translation.en: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof : it shall be eaten in the holy place : it is most holy .
And Ishmael his son was thirteen years old , when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin .
translation.kha: bad u Ishmael u khun jong u pat u la dap khatlai snem ka rta .
U Trai un mihpaw halor ki briew jong u ; un sianti ïa ki khnam jong u kum ka thliew . U Trai nongsynran un pynsawa ïa ka turoi ; un ïathied ha ki erïong na shathie .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall be seen over them , and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning : and the Lord  God  shall blow the trumpet , and shall go with whirlwinds of the south .
Woe to the rebellious children , saith the  Lord  , that take counsel , but not of me  ; and that cover with a covering , but not of my spirit , that they may add sin to sin :
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren :  Kito kiba synshar ïa ka Judah kin jot noh namar ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga . Ki bud ïa ki jingthmu kiba ngam shym la shna , bad ki soi ïa ki jingïateh kular pyrshah ïa ka mon jong nga , da kaba kynton kawei ka pop halor kawei pat .
Suit ksiar ïa kita ki jingker , bad pyndait ha ki ïa ki kyrwoh ksiar ban bat ïa ki diengkhap . Suit ksiar ruh ïa kita ki jinghap .
translation.en: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold , and make their rings of gold for places for the bars : and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold .

translation.kha: Kine ki jingbhasbun ki lah ban nang pynkhraw ïa ka jingtip jong ki riewstad bad kdew lynti ïa kiba la nang la tip ,
translation.en: A wise man will hear , and will increase learning  ; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels :

translation.kha: La thang shibun ki sharak ha ka kamra ba haneng ha kaba ki la ïalang .
