translation.en: And there were many lights in the upper chamber , where they were gathered together .
And Jesus went with him  ; and much people followed him , and thronged him .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la leit bad u . Kumta bun ki briew ki la ïaleit lang bad U Jisu , ki da ïa-thngian sha u na baroh ki liang .
Naba ka Hukum u Moses kam lah shun pynlong janai ïa kano kano . Bad mynta la ai ïa ka jingkyrmen kaba kham bha da kaba i lah ban wan shuh jan U Blei .
translation.en: For the law made nothing perfect , but the bringing in of a better hope did  ; by the which we draw nigh unto God .

translation.kha: U Blei um shym la klet ïa u Noah , pynlang ïa ki nard baroh kiba ïadon lem bad u ha ka lieng ; u la pynlong ïa ka lyer ban tbeh , mala ka um ka la sdang hiar .
translation.en: And God remembered Noah , and every living thing , and all the cattle that was with him in the ark : and God made a wind to pass over the earth , and the waters assuaged  ;

translation.kha: Kane ka mut ba bathoiñ ba phi bameh ïa une u kpu malu phi dih na kane ka khuri phi pynbna ïa ka jingïap U Trai tad ynda un wang .
translation.en: For as often as ye eat this bread , and drink this cup , ye do shew the Lord s death till he come .

translation.kha: Hadien hynriew sngem U Jisu u la ïamareh bad u ïa u Porsius bun ïa ki ar nud shi Para , u Jakob bad u Ïoannis nabar u la ïalumlang ïa ki sha u lumbah uba ïong ha kaba ki la ïadon tang ma ki hi .
translation.en: And after six days Jesus taketh Peter , James , and John his brother , and bringeth them up into an high mountain apart ,

translation.kha: U brai ïa ka kynïan shipai jong ka ibit pynlang ïa ki kali ïamap jong ka sha ka duriaw ; ki rangbah pynïaidkam bakynsai jong ka ki la ïap jyllop ha ka Duriaw Basaw
translation.en: Pharaoh s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea : his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea .
And brake up for it my decreed place , and set bars and doors ,
translation.kha: Nga la buh u pud ïa ka duriaw bad nga la buh ïa ka hadien ki khyrdop kiba la khang .

translation.en: And the archers shot at king Josiah  ; and the king said to his servants , Have me away  ; for I am sore wounded .
translation.kha: Hapdeng ka thma u Syiem Josaïah u la shah siat da ki khnam u nong Ijipt . U hukum ïa la ki shakri ,  Rah noh ïa nga ; Nga la mynsaw jur !

translation.en: And herein I give my advice : for this is expedient for you , who have begun before , not only to do , but also to be forward a year ago .
translation.kha: Bad hangne nga ai jingmut , ka long ba ka kham bha ïa phi ban pyndep mynta ïa kaei kaba phi la sdang mynshem snem . Phi la long kiba nyngkong , ym tang ban trei ïa ka kam , hynrei ban long ruh kiba la kloi ban leh ïa ka .

translation.en: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me . And being turned , I saw seven golden candlesticks  ;
translation.kha: Nga la phai sawdong ban peit uei uba la kren ïa nga , bad nga la ïohi ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki diengpynïeng sharak ksiar ,

translation.en: Then he brought me back the way of the gate of the outward sanctuary which looketh toward the east  ; and it was shut .
translation.kha: Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa nga sha ka khyrdop kaba kham shabar ha ka bynta bashaphang mihngi jong ka Templ .

Ki bynriew jong ka Ninebeh ki la kjit ïa ka khlur U Blei . Kumta ki la ïa-rai ba baroh ki dei ban shongthait , bad ba baroh ki briew , naduh uba ryntih tam haduh uba khraw tam , ban phong jaiñ khain ban pynpaw ba ki la kylla-kaba-mut .
translation.en: So the people of Nineveh believed God , and proclaimed a fast , and put on sackcloth , from the greatest of them even to the least of them .
I am the  Lord  , and there is none else , there is no God beside me : I girded thee , though thou hast not known me :
translation.kha: Nga long U  Trai  ; ym don uwei pat U Blei , ngan ai ïa me ka jingkhlaiñ ba me donkam , wat la mem shym la ithuh ïa nga .

translation.en: And by their prayer for you , which long after you for the exceeding grace of God in you .
translation.kha: Bad kumta da ka jingsngewieit bajylliew kin duwai na ka bynta jong phi namar kata ka jingaiei kaba kor tam kaba U Blei u la pyn-i ha phi .

translation.en: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people , when ye are come over Jordan  ; Simeon , and Levi , and Judah , and Issachar , and Joseph , and Benjamin :
translation.kha: Ynda phi la jam ïa ka wah Jordan , kine ki jait ki dei ban ïeng ha u lum Gerisim katba nang pynbna ïa ki jingkyrkhu : ka jait Simeon , ka jait Lebi , ka jait Judah , ka jait Issakhar , ka jait Joseph , bad ka jait Benjamin .
Jeroboam , ngan pyningkhong ïa me u syiem ki Israel , bad men synshar ïa ka jaka baroh kat kaba me kwah .
translation.en: And I will take thee , and thou shalt reign according to all that thy soul desireth , and shalt be king over Israel .

translation.kha: Ki jingjam jong nga , ong U Tlai , kim hir kum ki jong phi , bad ki lynti Jong ang ki ïapher na ki jong phi .
translation.en: For my thoughts are not your thoughts , neither are your ways my ways , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hadien ba la pynkynriah ïa ka metïap na lynti , ti pa uwei u la bud ïa u Joab ban kitei thwet ïa u Sheba .
translation.en: When he was removed out of the highway , all the people went on after Joab , to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri .

translation.kha: Ym don uba lah ban phrung jubor shapoh ka ïohnong jong u briew uba khlaiñ bad suit noh ïa ki jingdon jingmut jongno u Lymda nyngkong eh u thoh u khum shwa ïa u briew uba khlaiñ , nangta u sa kah ban lute ïa ka ïing jong u .
translation.en: Or else how can one enter into a strong man s house , and spoil his goods , except he first bind the strong man ? and then he will spoil his house .

And they buried him in his own sepulchres , which he had made for himself in the city of David , and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries  art : and they made a very great burning for him .
translation.kha: bad la tep ha ka jingtep mawsiang ïa kaba u la shna na ka bynta ïa lade ha ka nongbah u Dabid . Ki la pyndonkam ki musla bad ki umphniang iwbih ban pynkhreh ïa ka met jong u na ka bynta ka jingontep , bad ki la tei ïa ka ding kaba khraw ban leh sngewsih ïa ka jingïap jong u .

U ong , Ïathuh ha u hynmen jong me u Aaron ba dei tang ha ka por kaba dei ba un leit shadien ka jingkah jong ka khak kaba khuid tam , namar ba dei hangta ba nga mohkhiew ha u lyoh halor ka jingtap ka Synduk ka jutang . Lada um kumjuh , un shah pynïap .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Speak unto Aaron thy brother , that he come not at all times into the holy place within the veil before the mercy seat , which is upon the ark  ; that he die not : for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat .
Recompense to no man evil for evil . Provide things honest in the sight of all men .
translation.kha: Lada uno uno u la leh bymdei ïa phi , to wat siew kylliang ïa u da ka bymdei . To pyrshang ban leh ïa kaei kaba baroh ki ñiew ba ka long kaba bha .

translation.en: Surely it is meet to be said unto God , I have borne chastisement , I will not offend any more :
translation.kha: Ko Job , hato me la phla ïa ki pop jong me ha U Blei bad kular ban nym leh pop shuh ?
Ha kata ka sngi ki Israel ki la jop ïa ki Moab , bad ka jingsuk ka la don ha ka ri haduh phraphew snem .
translation.en: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel . And the land had rest fourscore years .

translation.kha: Nangta nga shim ïa ka jaiñ ba nga teh sawdong ïa ka sepngi jongki nga bad kynther ïa ka . Kumne U Blei un kynther ïano ïatan na phi u bym bat ïa la ka kular , nga ong . U Blei un shim noh ïa ki ïing jong phi bad ïa kiei kiei baïar ba phi to , bad un iehnoh ïa phi khlem don ei ei haw . Baroh kiba dat hangta ki ong , Amen ! bad ki ïaroh ïa U Trai . Bad ki nongïalam ki bat ïa ka kular jong ki .
translation.en: Also I shook my lap , and said , So God shake out every man from his house , and from his labour , that performeth not this promise , even thus be he shaken out , and emptied . And all the congregation said , Amen , and praised the  Lord . And the people did according to this promise .
Again the word of the  Lord  of hosts came to me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Sekharaïah :
Jingkhot ïa ki ngaiñ bad ki Hukum jrong u baroh , kumba la thoh ha ka Aiñ u Moses , khring ba haba me leit shano shano me lah ban manbha ha kaei kaei kaba me leh .
translation.en: And keep the charge of the  Lord  thy God , to walk in his ways , to keep his statutes , and his commandments , and his judgments , and his testimonies , as it is written in the law of Moses , that thou mayest prosper in all that thou doest , and whithersoever thou turnest thyself :

translation.kha: Ynda ki sien phai sha la u kpa , u kulai ïa ki , Kumno phi ïabun khlaiñ mynta ka sngem ?
translation.en: And when they came to Reuel their father , he said , How is it that ye are come so soon to day ?

translation.kha: U Khrist u long ka dur bapaw jongki U Blei u bym lah ban ïohi . U long U Toi ba la kha nyngkong , uba hakhlieh duh jong kiei kai baroh babha la thaw .
translation.en: Who is the image of the invisible God , the firstborn of every creature :

translation.kha: Mar ïalong syiem , u Simri u la pynïap ïa baroh ki dkhot na ka longïing u Baasha . Ïa uwei pa uwei u ba-ha-ïing bad uwei pa uwei u paralok la pynïap .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when he began to reign , as soon as he sat on his throne , that he slew all the house of Baasha : he left him not one that pisseth against a wall , neither of his kinsfolks , nor of his friends .
Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia ;
translation.kha: Hadien kata , nga la leit sha ki thain ha Syria bad Kilikia .

translation.en: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward , and bear fruit upward :
translation.kha: Kito kiba lait im ha Judah kin roi kin san kum ki jingthung kiba ngam jylliew ki thied ha ka khyndew bad pynmih soh .
U Paul u la kwah Ban ïalam bad u ïa u Timotheus , kumta u la ostrit ïa u . U la sa kumta namar barieh ki Jiw kba shong basah ha ngi ki iaka ki tip ba u kpa jrong u Timothi u long u Grik .
translation.en: Him would Paul have to go forth with him  ; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters : for they knew all that his father was a Greek .

translation.kha: U Trai u synshar halor ki jaitbynriew baroh ; ka burom jong u ka to halor ki bneng .
translation.en: The  Lord  is high above all nations , and his glory above the heavens .

And all Israel heard say that Saul had smitten a garrison of the Philistines , and that Israel also was had in abomination with the Philistines . And the people were called together after Saul to Gilgal .
translation.kha: La ïathuh ha baroh ki Israel ba u Saul u la pynïap ïa u rangbah ai hukum jong ki Philistia bad ba ki Philistia ki la isih ïa ki . Kumta ki paidbah ki jubab ïa ka jingkhot ban ïasoh bad u Saul ha Gilgal .
U Trai u la ong , Mynmiet , ko khun u briew , khmih ïa ki kynthei hapdeng ki briew jong me kiba pynlong ki jingïathuh lymda . To kren pyrsa ïa ki
translation.en: Likewise , thou son of man , set thy face against the daughters of thy people , which prophesy out of their own heart  ; and prophesy thou against them ,

translation.kha: U Moses u shim shiteng na ka snam jong kita ki mrad malu u buhai ïa ka ha ki dabor , bad shiteng pat na kata ka snam u synreit ha kata ka jingset .
translation.en: And Moses took half of the blood , and put it in basins  ; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar .

translation.kha: Ïa ki nongbah kiba mynta ki ba-dap da ki briew yn pynjot , bad ïa ka ri yn pynkylla ri khlaw . Nangta te kin tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste , and the land shall be desolate  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Baroh ki tyllai teh ha kito ki liengbah ktien don jingmyntoi ; ki jaiñ pdiang lyer kdor lah ban pyrem ! Ngin knieh noh ïa baroh ka shaw jong ki kynhun shipai nongshniah , bad kan pung haduh katta katta ba wat ki briew kiba dkut duh ngin ïa-ïoh bynta . U Trei hi da lade un lama u syiem jong im ; un synshar halor jong ngi mala un ïaid ïa ngi .
translation.en: Thy tacklings are loosed  ; they could not well strengthen their mast , they could not spread the sail : then is the prey of a great spoil divided  ; the lame take the prey .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka jingainguh kaba man ka sngi ba la thang lut , kaba la leh tyngkong ha u Lum synriah kumta ka jingainguh bam , ka jingngeit kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: It is a continual burnt offering , which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong kito babha la banbeiñ ïa pha kin sa wan Ban ih khrup ban burom ïa pha . Baroh kito kiba la ju ibeiñ ïa phai kin dem ngon ha ki kjat jong Pha . Kin khot ïa pha , ‘ Ka Nongbah U Trai’ ,’ ‘ Ka Senas , ka nongbah U Blei U Bakhuid ki Israel .’
translation.en: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee  ; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet  ; and they shall call thee , The city of the  Lord  , The Zion of the Holy One of Israel .

translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong : Ki briew bhor ki long kum u phlang , bad ka bud jong ki barieh kum ki tiewkhlaw . U phlang u ïapstai noh , bad ki syntiew ki tlor noh ,
translation.en: For all flesh is as grass , and all the glory of man as the flower of grass . The grass withereth , and the flower thereof falleth away :
According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world , that we should be holy and without blame before him in love :
translation.kha: Wat shuwa ban pynlong ïa ka pyrthei , U Blei u la jied lypa ïa ngi ban long ki jong u ha U Khrist , khnang ba ngin ïoh long kiba khuid bad kiba khlem shah kynnoh pop ha khmat jong u .

sohshkor ïa ki , ko Israel , nabar kohnguh ïa ki ! Te phin shem bha , bad phin on ngai bad longïng ka jaitbynriew kabu donbor bad phin ïoh shong ha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , kumba U Trai U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , u la kular .
translation.en: Hear therefore , O Israel , and observe to do it  ; that it may be well with thee , and that ye may increase mightily , as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath promised thee , in the land that floweth with milk and honey .
Shew the things that are to come hereafter , that we may know that ye are gods : yea , do good , or do evil , that we may be dismayed , and behold it together .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba ka lawei ka don — Te ngin tip ba phi long ki blei ! Leh katto katne kaba bha ne wallam katto katne ka jingpynjot ; pyndap ïa ngi da ka jingsheptieng bad jingkhynñiuh !
Da kumta u Moses u ai ha ki Israel ïa ki jingbuhbeit ryntih kiba ïadie bad ka jingrakhe ïa ka jinglehmeng ban pynjahburom ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kita ki nonglamktien ki poi ha Gibeah ha kaba u Saul u shong , bad haba ki la ïathuh ha ki briew ïa kata ka khubor , baroh ki ïalynñiar da ka jingsngewsih .
translation.en: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Saul , and told the tidings in the ears of the people : and all the people lifted up their voices , and wept .

translation.kha: ( U Jisu u la ong ïa kane namar katne kattne ki briew ki ïa-ong , U kein u mynsiem bymkhuid ha u . )
translation.en: Because they said , He hath an unclean spirit .

translation.kha: U Janoah bad baroh ki nongïalam ka kynhun shipai kiba ba-don bad u ki la ïohsngew ïa ka kam runar kaba u Ishmael u la leh .
translation.en: But when Johanan the son of Kareah , and all the captains of the forces that were with him , heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done ,

translation.kha: U dadien ban kham ngeit ïa la ka lok ban ïalade .
translation.en: He should be self-sacrificing in his love for his wife .

translation.kha: Ha man ka jingkwah Niam Ka Jinglait , u Pyrthat kitab long ka rukom u ju pyllait ïa ine uno u koidi uba ki briew ki kwah .
translation.en: Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner , whomsoever they desired .

translation.kha: Ïalang paralok badno uba stad badno phin kylla stad . Lada phi ïalang pakor malade ki briew kiba bieit , phan long kba bieit .
translation.en: He that walketh with wise men shall be wise : but a companion of fools shall be destroyed .

translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest , which I have given to the fire for fuel , so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem .
But the goat , on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat , shall be presented alive before the  Lord  , to make an atonement with him , and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness .
translation.kha: U  langsohmoh uba hap ha u Asasel yn wallam im ha khmat U  Trai  bad nangta yn pyllait ïa u sha ka ri shyiap sha u Asasel , khnang ba un kit noh ïa ki pop u paidbah .
Haba uba bieit u phiah , u pynpaw kumne kumne ba yn tip . Ki briew kiba sian kim pajwa ïa ka jingshah krenbeiñ .
translation.en: A fool s wrath is presently known : but a prudent man covereth shame .
But to us there is but one God , the Father , of whom are all things , and we in him ; and one Lord Jesus Christ , by whom are all things , and we by him .
translation.kha: pynban ha ngi don tang uwei U Blei , U Kpa , uba long u Nongthaw ïa kiei kiei baroh bad uba na ka bynta jong u ngi im ; bad don tang uwei U Trai , U Jisu Khrist , da u ba kiei kiei baroh la pynlong bad ha u ba ngi im .
Kine harum ki dei ki kyrteng jong kine ki jingbabe pynïaidkam sad ki distrik kiba ki dei khmih’ : U Bneng : ka ri lum Ephraim
translation.en: And these are their names : The son of Hur , in mount Ephraim :

translation.kha: U Soitan u jubab , U briew un iehnoh ïa kiei kiei baroh tang banbeiñ pynsah ïa la ka jingim .
translation.en: And Satan answered the  Lord  , and said , Skin for skin , yea , all that a man hath will he give for his life .
Wherefore I desire that ye faint not at my tribulations for you , which is your glory .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa phi , te ban ym noh mynsiem namar nga shahshitom na ka bynta jong phi ; ka dei na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong phi baroh .
Nga la wan ban pynsngew ïa me ïa kiei ka ban jia ha ki briew jong me ha ka lawei . Kana ka dei ka jingpynïap ïa ka lawei .
translation.en: Now I am come to make thee understand what shall befall thy people in the latter days : for yet the vision is for many days .

translation.kha: Kaei ka jingujor jong pha ? Baalis pha la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ?
translation.en: Wherefore will ye plead with me ? ye all have transgressed against me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Wat pynlut ïa la ka bor ha ka jingïathiah shongkhia , bad ïa baroh ka pisa jong phi ha ki kynthih ; ki la pynjot ïa ki syiem .
translation.en: Give not thy strength unto women , nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , To pynkloi shaphang jongno ka , ko paralok ! Nangne ki la ïawan kiew , ki la kem ïa U Jisu , Bad ki la batymmen ïa u .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Friend , wherefore art thou come ?  Then came they , and laid hands on Jesus , and took him .
For so the  Lord  said unto me , I will take my rest , and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs , and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Ngan jngoh sha tbian na bneng kumba ka umjer ka wandur jar jar ha ki miet basyiad ha ka aïom ot , kumba ka sngi ka phyrnai itynnat ha ka jingshit ka sngi .
Wat ñiah shabi ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ , ïoh pa ïaphah , nalor la pynkyntang ïa phi da ka umphniang pynsleh jong U Tharai . kamut ki la leh kitab u Moses u la ong .
translation.en: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , lest ye die : for the anointing oil of the  Lord  is upon you . And they did according to the word of Moses .
Let the prophets speak two or three , and let the other judge .
translation.kha: Ar ne lai ngut kiba ïoh ïa ka khubor U Blei ki dei ban kren , katba kiwei pat kin bishar ïa kaei kaba ki kren .

Lada u pynskuiñ ïa ka shyieng , yn pynkheiñ kylliang ïa kawei na ki shyieng jong u ; lama u pynmatlah ïa u na kawei ka khmat , yn pynmatlah kylliang ïa kawei na ki khmat jong u ; lada u runar ïa kawei ka bniat , yn ïalap kylliang ïa kawei na ki bniat jong u . Kumba u la pynmynsaw ïa un uno u brup , kumta ruh yn pynmynsaw kylliang ïa u .
translation.en: Breach for breach , eye for eye , tooth for tooth : as he hath caused a blemish in a man , so shall it be done to him again .
But many that are first shall be last  ; and the last shall be first .
translation.kha: Hynrei bun kiba mynta ki long kiba ha shuwa kin long kiba khatduh , bad bun kiba mynta ki long kiba khatduh kin long kiba ha shuwa .

translation.en: How goodly are thy tents , O Jacob , and thy tabernacles , O Israel !
translation.kha: Ki ïingjaiñ jong ki Israel ki long kiba itynnat , Kum ki dieng Tlai kiba ïeng laiñ .

translation.en: Moreover , thou son of man , take thee one stick , and write upon it , For Judah , and for the children of Israel his companions : then take another stick , and write upon it , For Joseph , the stick of Ephraim , and for all the house of Israel his companions :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u ong ,  shim ïa u lyngkhot dieng bad thoh ha u ïa ki ktien ‘ Ka Hima Judah .’ Nangta shim sa uwei pat u lyngkhot dieng bad thoh ha u ïa kine ki ktien : ‘ Ka Hima Israel .’

translation.en: So the king commanded Benaiah the son of Jehoiada  ; which went out , and fell upon him , that he died . And the kingdom was established in the hand of Solomon .
translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u ai hukum ha u Benaïah , uba la mih shabar bad pynïap ïa u Shimei . U Solomon mynta u la ïoh ka jingsynshar kaba pura .

translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Joash , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u syiem Joash u la leh la buh jingthoh ha  Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Judah .

Hadien ba la kem ïa u , ïa u Petros la thep ha phatok , ha kaba la ai ïa u ban ap phira da ki saw tylli ki kynhun kiba kawei kawei ka don saw ngut ki shipai . U Jehoaddin u la thmu ban bishar ha khmat u paidbah hadien ka Niam Ka Jinglait .
translation.en: And when he had apprehended him , he put him in prison , and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him  ; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki la ïaleh ban peit ïa kaei kaba la lai Jia , bad haba ki la pah ha U Jeshua , ki la shem ïa u briew na uba ki ksuid ki la mihngi , ba u da shong ha ki kjat jong U Jisu , u la phong jreiñ bad ha ka jingtipbriew ; bad baroh ki la sheptieng .
translation.en: Then they went out to see what was done  ; and came to Jesus , and found the man , out of whom the devils were departed , sitting at the feet of Jesus , clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .

translation.kha: U Moses u thoh lut ïa ka aiñ U Bela ha ka kitab , khlem da ieh kawei ruh ka ktien .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book , until they were finished ,

translation.kha: U Joshua u la leh kumta ,
translation.en: Joshua therefore commanded the priests , saying , Come ye up out of Jordan .

Not for thy righteousness , or for the uprightness of thine heart , dost thou go to possess their land : but for the wickedness of these nations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee , and that he may perform the word which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob .
translation.kha: Ym dei namar ka hok jong phi ne ka jinglong beit ha ka dohnud ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jong ki , hynrei ka long namar ka jingbymman jong kita ki jaitbynriew ba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la beh krad ïa ki na khmat jong phi ; ba un pynskhem ïa la ka kular ba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phi , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .
U leh ïa katjuh kaba u mon ha bneng bad ha pyrthei , ha ki duli bad ha ki jingïabujli bashapoh .
translation.en: Whatsoever the  Lord  pleased , that did he in heaven , and in earth , in the seas , and all deep places .

translation.kha: Ha ka ri baroh kawei ngan pynsangeh ïa ka jingleh jakhlia , kum ka jingmaham ïa borbah ki kynïan ban ym leh awria kumba ki la leh .
translation.en: Thus will I cause lewdness to cease out of the land , that all women may be taught not to do after your lewdness .
Behold , the eye of the  Lord  is upon them that fear him , upon them that hope in his mercy  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u khmih sumar ïa kito kiba kohnguh ïa u , ïa kito kiba shaniah ha ka jingieit baneh jong u ,

translation.en: Being filled with all unrighteousness , fornication , wickedness , covetousness , maliciousness ; full of envy , murder , debate , deceit , malignity ; whisperers ,
translation.kha: La pyndap ïa ki da baroh ki jait jingbymman , ka jingsniew , ka jingkwah lalot bad ka jingthala ; ki dap da ka jingbishni , ka jingpynïap briew , ka jingïaleh , ka jingshukor , ka jingshun .

Uno uno uba pdiang sngewbha ha ka kyrteng jong nga ïa uwei na kine ki khynnah rit , u pdiang sngewbit ïa nga ; bad ine uno uba pdiang sngewbha ïa nga , u jingpdiang sngewbha ym tang ïa nga hynrei ïa uta ruh uba la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name , receiveth me : and whosoever shall receive me , receiveth not me , but him that sent me .

translation.kha: Mynta u Elisha u la lah ïathuh ha ka briew’ kaba shong ha Shuh , ha kaba ïa u khulom jongnga ka u la pynim pat , ba U Trai un phah ïa ka nemsniew ka baneh neh hynñiew snem ha ka ri bad ba ka dei ban mihsnam pynlang ka un-long jong ka bad leit sah shawei pat .
translation.en: Then spake Elisha unto the woman , whose son he had restored to life , saying , Arise , and go thou and thine household , and sojourn wheresoever thou canst sojourn : for the  Lord  hath called for a famine  ; and it shall also come upon the land seven years .
Again , the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man , seeking goodly pearls :
translation.kha: Kumjuh , ka Hima ki bneng ka long kumne . U briew u wad ïa ki mawlynnai kiba kordor ,
Kumjuh te to ngin ïakhlad noh . Jied ïa kano kano ka bynta jong ka ri kaba me mon . Me rupa shawei , bad nga kan saw swai pat .
translation.en: Is not the whole land before thee ? separate thyself , I pray thee , from me : if thou wilt take the left hand , then I will go to the right  ; or if thou depart to the right hand , then I will go to the left .

translation.kha: Barukh ki bajaipdeh jongno u Dabid bad baroh’ ki paidbah ha Israel ki sngewthuh ba u syiem um kein bynta ha ka jingpynïap ïa u Abner .
translation.en: For all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner .

translation.kha: Phi dei ma phi hi ban ai ei ei ïa ki ba kin bam , U Jisu u la jubab . Ki la kylli , Hammoth me kwah ïa ngi ban leit bad pynlut Orpah tylli ki sbai rupa ha u kpu khnang ban bsa ïa ki ?
translation.en: He answered and said unto them ,  Give ye them to eat .  And they say unto him , Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread , and give them to eat ?
By faith Joseph , when he died , made mention of the departing of the children of Israel  ; and gave commandment concerning his bones .
translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba pynlong ïa U Joseph , ha shuwa ba un ïap , ban kren shaphang ka jingmihnoh ki khun Israel na Ijipt , bad ai ka jingbthah shaphang kaei ba ki dei ban leh ïa ka met jong u .
Hynrei naduh mynta kan ym long thuh kaba bam Briew bad kaba knieh noh na ka ïa ki khun jong ka . Ma to , U Trai Nongsynshar , per la kren .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt devour men no more , neither bereave thy nations any more , saith the Lord  God .
And they said unto them , We cannot do this thing , to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised  ; for that were a reproach unto us :
translation.kha: Ki ïa-ong ,  Ngim lah ban ai ïa la ka jong ka para ba kan ïashongkurim bad u briew u bym shym la otsher ; kata kan long ka jingjahburom ïa ngi .
Nangta u la paw ha u Jakob , bad hadien ha baroh ki Apostol .
translation.en: After that , he was seen of James ; then of all the apostles .
And the young men of the princes of the provinces went out first  ; and Ben–hadad sent out , and they told him , saying , There are men come out of Samaria .
translation.kha: Ki shipai samla ki la tur nyngkong . Ki nongsyntiat ba la phah da u Benhadad , ki leit ïathuh ha u ba shi kynhun ki shipai ki la wan mih na Samaria .

translation.en: And they came to the place which God had told him of  ; and Abraham built an altar there , and laid the wood in order , and bound Isaac his son , and laid him on the altar upon the wood .
translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha kata ka jaka kaba U Blei u la ïathuh ha u , u Abraham u tei ïa ka duwan bad u pynbeit ïa kita ki dieng halor jong ka . U la khum ïa la u khun bad pynthiah ïa u halor ka duwan , hajrong kita ki dieng .
U Moses u ai ïa kine ki jingthiah ha ki nongïalam na ki jait Israel .
translation.en: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel , saying , This is the thing which the  Lord  hath commanded .

translation.kha: Anab men long u sorki na ka bynta jong u Ban ïathuh ha uwei pa uwei ïa kaei kaba me la ïohi bad ïasngew .
translation.en: For thou shalt be his witness unto all men of what thou hast seen and heard .

translation.kha: Ki kynhun shynrong u Jehoshaphat ïa kiba la kha ha Ijipt ki long ar ngut ; kumno ki brup barabor kiba na ka ïing u Jakob babha la wan sha Ijipt ki long hynñiewphew ngut .
translation.en: And the sons of Joseph , which were born him in Egypt , were two souls : all the souls of the house of Jacob , which came into Egypt , were threescore and ten .
Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein , and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief :
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ïohsngew nyngkong ïa ka Khubor Babha kim shym ïohpdiang ïa kata ka jingjahthait , namar ba kim shym la ngeit . Ki don , te , kiwei pat ïa kiba la shah ban ïohpdiang ïa ka .
Nangta u Nadab u la phah ktien sha u Joab : Phah sha nga ïa u Uriah u nong Hit . Kumjuh u Joab u pham ïa u shiah u Dabid .
translation.en: And David sent to Joab , saying , Send me Uriah the Hittite . And Joab sent Uriah to David .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ka la pyniehnoh buiñ ïa u , ka leit ïalam ïa u sha Shiloh ryngkat bad uwei u masi suba dang lai snem , shiphew kilo u purew , sad sia pla sniang ka waiñ . Ka ïalam ïa u Samuel , wat la u dang khynnah eh , sha ka ïing U Trai ha Shiloh .
translation.en: And when she had weaned him , she took him up with her , with three bullocks , and one ephah of flour , and a bottle of wine , and brought him unto the house of the  Lord  in Shiloh : and the child was young .
And I will bring you out of the midst thereof , and deliver you into the hands of strangers , and will execute judgments among you .
translation.kha: Ngan ïalam ïa phi shabar ka nongbah bad ngan aiti ïa phi ha ki nongwei . Nga la rai ïa phi ban ïap ,

Nangta ngan pyningkhong ïa ki ksang ti jong u syiem ka bajakhlia katba khlaiñ bad ngan buh ïa ka waitlam jong nga ha ki kti jong u . Hynrei ngan pynkieng ïa ki khñiang ti jong u Syiem ka Ijipt , bad un ud bad ïap ha khmat u nongshun jong u .
translation.en: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon , and put my sword in his hand : but I will break Pharaoh s arms , and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man .

For in the eighth year of his reign , while he was yet young , he began to seek after the God of David his father : and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places , and the groves , and the carved images , and the molten images .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba phra ba u Josaïah u long syiem , haba u dang khynnah bha , u sdang ban mane ïa U Blei jong u syiem Dabid u kpa tymmen jong u . Saw snem hadien u sdang ban pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei thala , ki dur jong ka blei Asherah , bad baroh kiwei de ki bleithaw .

U Hiram jong ka Tyros u la pynbiang ïa u ïa ki diengkhap Kedar bad ki dieng Kseh , bad ïa ka ksaiñ hati , katba u donkam . Iddo la dep tei ïa ki , u Susim Solomon u ai ïa u Hiram arphew tylli ki shaneng ha ka thain Galilaïa .
translation.en: ( Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees , and with gold , according to all his desire , ) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee .

translation.kha: Balei , A blang , me shah ba yn kha ïa nga ? Nga la dei ïa-ban ïap ha shuwa ba uno uno un ïohi ïa nga !
translation.en: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb ? Oh that I had given up the ghost , and no eye had seen me !

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por ki paidbah ki la ïa-ap ïa u Sekharaïah bad ki da sngewlyngngoh balamler ba u pynlut bun to hapoh ka Templ .
translation.en: And the people waited for Zacharias , and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple .
And when he was come , the Jews which came down from Jerusalem stood round about , and laid many and grievous complaints against Paul , which they could not prove .
translation.kha: Haba u Paul u la wan , ki Jiw kiba la wan na Jerusalem ki la ïeng sawdong ïa u bad ki la sdang ban buh shibun ki jingmudui kiba khia pyrshah ïa u , ïa kiba kim lah ban pynshisha .
Ka Baibl ka jubab ïa kata ka jingkylli ha ISAIAH 48 :17 , 18 bad 2 thymmei 3 :16 , 17 .
translation.en: The Bible answers that question at ISAIAH 48 :17 , 18 and 2 TIMOTHY 3 :16 , 17 .
And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice , he said ,  Father , into thy hands I commend my spirit :  and having said thus , he gave up the ghost .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la pyrta ha ka sur bajam ,  Ko Pa ! Ha ki kti jong me nga aiti ïa la ka mynsiem !  U la ong ïa kane bad u la ïap .

Ki khuid ki kiew jong u Ishmael ki la shnong la sah ha ka jaka kaweh hapdeng ka Hobah bad ka Shua , sha ka phang mihngi jong ka ri Ijipt ha ka lynti sha Assyria . Kine ki la shang kyrpang na kiwei pat ki khun ki ksiew jong u Abraham .
translation.en: And they dwelt from Havilah unto Shur , that is before Egypt , as thou goest toward Assyria : and he died in the presence of all his brethren .
And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ïohi ïa nga u ïohi ruh ïa uta uba la phah ïa nga .
Hynrei u nongïathuhlypa u la leit sha u syiem bad u ong ha u , Wat shim ïa kine ki shipai Eliel bad me . U Tlai um don bad kine ki kynhun shipai kiba na ka Hima bashatei .
translation.en: But there came a man of God to him , saying , O king , let not the army of Israel go with thee  ; for the  Lord  is not with Israel , to wit , with all the children of Ephraim .
Oh that I knew where I might find him ! that I might come even to his seat !
translation.kha: Haduh katno nga kwah ba ngan tip hangno ngan shem ïa u , ban tip kumno ngan leit shano ba u don .

translation.en: But he shall not defile himself , being a chief man among his people , to profane himself .
translation.kha: Um dei ban pyntngit ïa lade ha ka jingïap jong kito kiba ïalong ba-ha-ïing bad u na ka jingshongkurim .
Ka jingpang bashyrkhei ka par baroh kawei ka met jrong u bad ka pynlong ïa ki kti bad ki kjat jong u ban pyut .
translation.en: It shall devour the strength of his skin : even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength .
And God said unto Abraham , Thou shalt keep my covenant therefore , thou , and thy seed after thee in their generations .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Abraham ,  Me ruh me dei ban mynjur ban bat ïa ka jutang bad nga , ma me bad ki khun ki ksiew jong me ha ki pateng ban wan .
Baroh ki briew bad ki mrad ki dei ban Phong ki jaiñ shaiñ . Uwei pa Uei u dei ban ïarwai jur ha U Blei bad u dei ban iehnoh ïa ka jinglehhok bymman bad ki kam sniew jong u .
translation.en: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth , and cry mightily unto God : yea , let them turn every one from his evil way , and from the violence that is in their hands .

translation.kha: namar nga khot ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ha ka phang bashatei ban ïakwah . Ki shym jong ki kin pynjngai ïa ki khet jong ki ha ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem bad sawdong ïa ki kynroh jong ka bad ruh sarong ïa kiwei pat ki nongbah jong ka —Judah .
translation.en: For , lo , I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall come , and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem , and against all the walls thereof round about , and against all the cities of Judah .

translation.kha: bad ki nonglamktien ki la leit phai sha u sahmiet . Balei Phi wan phai ei ? u la kylli .
translation.en: And when the messengers turned back unto him , he said unto them , Why are ye now turned back ?

translation.kha: Katto katne na ki rangbah synshar ki la ïohi ïa ka bad ki la ïathuh ha u syiem haduh katno ka la long kaba bhabriew ; kumta te ki la ïalam ïa ka sha ka ïing u Syiem .
translation.en: The princes also of Pharaoh saw her , and commended her before Pharaoh : and the woman was taken into Pharaoh s house .

translation.en: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves , or of the young pigeons , such as he can get  ;

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi , la wan poi u nongwan ha ïing jong uba riewspah . Uto u riewspah um kwah ban pynpyut ïa eiei na ki jingri jong u ngab khreh bam ïa uta u nongwei ; pynban , u la shngiam ïa i khunlangbrot jong uba duk , bad u la khreh jingbam ïa u nongwankai .
translation.en: And there came a traveller unto the rich man , and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd , to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him  ; but took the poor man s lamb , and dressed it for the man that was come to him .

translation.kha: Mynta , ka mut aïu u la kiew shajrong ? Ka mut ba nyngkong u la leit Hiar sha kiba jylliew tam shahïap ka pyut .
translation.en: ( Now that he ascended , what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth ?

translation.kha: U blei um shym la kyntien ïa la ki jyllang ki briew , ïa kiba u la jied naduh kaba sdang . Phi tap ïa kaei kaba ka jingthoh Bakhuid ka ainong ha ka jingïathuh shaphrang u Elisha ba u ïasaid bad U blang pyrshah ïa ki Jeriel :
translation.en: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew . Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias ? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel , saying ,
The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright : but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness .
translation.kha: Haba ki briew kiba stad ki kren , ki pynlong ïa ka jingtip kaba pdiang hun , hynrei ki briew kiba mutlop ki khlei ïa ka jingbieit .
baroh ki mrad ba la pynjuh bad kiba ha khlaw , ki mrad bapar bad ki sai .
translation.en: Beasts , and all cattle  ; creeping things , and flying fowl :

translation.kha: lehse ïa kawei ïa katei kaban phi kwah ïa ki ba kin leh na ka bniat jong phi : Kane ka long ka jingmut jong ka Hukum u Moses bad jong ki jinghikai ki nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you , do ye even so to them : for this is the law and the prophets .

translation.kha: Kaei ka kamram jong ki nongïarap ?
translation.en: What work do the ministerial servants perform for our benefit ?
Their seed is established in their sight with them , and their offspring before their eyes .
translation.kha: Ki don ki khun bad ki khun ksiew , bad ki im ban khmih ïa ki baroh ba ki heh ki san ;
Ki jubab ba sngewhun jong ki jingkylli ba ksiang Shaphan ka jingim Proberb 2 :1-5 .
translation.en: Satisfying answers to life’s big questions . —Proverbs 2 :1-5 .
But Jesus called them unto him , and said ,  Ye know that the princes of the Gentiles exercise dominion over them , and they that are great exercise authority upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la khot lang ïa ki baroh bad u la ong ,  Phi tip ba ki nongsynshar jong ki bymngeit blei ki donbor halor jong ki , bad ki nongïalam ki don ka iktiar ba-pura .

Hadien ba u la ïakren pynlang u paidbah , u sahmiet u lei ïa katto katne ki nongtem nongput ban phong ïa ki jingairam kiba ki ju phong ha ki por bakyntang bad ban ïaid na khmat ka kynhied shipai , da kaba rwai : Ïaroh ïa U Trai ! Ka jingieit jong u ka long bymtip !
translation.en: And when he had consulted with the people , he appointed singers unto the  Lord  , and that should praise the beauty of holiness , as they went out before the army , and to say , Praise the  Lord   ; for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: To ngin ïitkhmih ïa U Messaïah , u syiem ki Israel , un hiar na ka jingpynbna mynta , bad ngin ngeit ha u ! Bad kita ki ar ngut kiba la shah Sansannah bad U Jisu , ki la krenbeiñ ruh ïa u .
translation.en: Let Christ the King of Israel descend now from the cross , that we may see and believe . And they that were crucified with him reviled him .
And when they had blindfolded him , they struck him on the face , and asked him , saying , Prophesy , who is it that smote thee ?
translation.kha: Ki la teh matlah ïa u bad ki la kylli ïa u ,  Mano ba tied ïa me ? To antad !
Ka jingïaleh u Joshua ka ïalam ïa u naduh Kadesh Barnea ha ka phang shathie haduh Khusa hajan ka rud duriaw , kaba kynthup ïa borbah ki jaka ka ri Goshen haduh Gibeon ha ka phang bashatei .
translation.en: And Joshua smote them from Kadesh–barnea even unto Gaza , and all the country of Goshen , even unto Gibeon .

translation.kha: Haba u Sanballat , u Tobiah , bad u nongri Arab uba kyrteng u Geshem ki la ïohsngew ïa kaei kaba ngi la thmu ban leh , ki rkhie ïa ngi bad ong , Kaei kaba phi tharai phin leh ? Hato phin ïajah pyrshah ïa u patsha ?
translation.en: But when Sanballat the Horonite , and Tobiah the servant , the Ammonite , and Geshem the Arabian , heard it , they laughed us to scorn , and despised us , and said , What is this thing that ye do ? will ye rebel against the king ?
So the  Lord  was with Joshua  ; and his fame was noised throughout all the country .
translation.kha: Kumta U  Trai  u la don ryngkat lem bad u Joshua , bad ka nam jong u ka saphriang kylleng kata ka ri .
Wah ïa kata ka lyngkhuh jaiñ katba tam shiteng shadien ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent , the half curtain that remaineth , shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Kiba dih buaid bad kiba bam lalot kin hylla hep . Lada baroh kaba phi leh ka longsyiem tang ban bam bad thiah , shen phin sa phong da ki jaiñjot .
translation.en: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty : and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags .
O that one might plead for a man with God , as a man pleadeth for his neighbour !
translation.kha: Nga kwah ban don u ban ïasaid bad U Blei na ka bynta jong nga , kumba u briew u ïasaid na ka bynta u paralok jong u .

translation.en: And for a rising , and for a scab , and for a bright spot :
translation.kha: shaphang ka prum , u tohjaw , lane ka jingtyrha sniehdoh ; bad shaphang ka jingbthuh ha ki jaiñ lane hapoh ïing .
Wah ai phlangïap shuh ïa kine ki briew ban shna maw-it . Ieh kin leit ïawad phangpdeng hi da biar .
translation.en: Ye shall no more give the people straw to make brick , as heretofore : let them go and gather straw for themselves .

translation.kha: U Elijah u la long u briew kum ma ngi . U la duwai shitrhem ba kan ym hap slap , bad ym shym la hap slap halor ka Khynñiuh haduh to snem shiteng .
translation.en: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are , and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain : and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months .

translation.kha: U Judas bad u Silas , kiba longsyiem hi ki nongïathuhlypa , ki la kriah slem bad ki , da kaba ai ha ki ka jingpynshlur bad ka jingpynkhlaiñ .
translation.en: And Judas and Silas , being prophets also themselves , exhorted the brethren with many words , and confirmed them .

translation.kha: Ki la tan ïa ki lynti sharud duriaw , ki la iehnoh ïa kai kiei baroh bad ki la bud ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And when they had brought their ships to land , they forsook all , and followed him .

translation.kha: Ngam sheptieng , ngan ïai kren beit namar nga tipbriew ïa la ka dohnud .
translation.en: Then would I speak , and not fear him  ; but it is not so with me .
My son , walk not thou in the way with them  ; refrain thy foot from their path :
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , wat ïashang bad ki briew kiba kum kita . Kiar na ki .
Lada me dang ïai kyntait , te ngan wallam ïa ki puit ha ka ri jong me .
translation.en: Else , if thou refuse to let my people go , behold , to morrow will I bring the locusts into thy coast :

translation.kha: Bad nangta u ong , Ngan ym kynmaw shuh ïa ki pop jongu ki bad ïa ki jingleh palat jong ki .
translation.en: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more .
Seest thou how Ahab humbleth himself before me ? because he humbleth himself before me , I will not bring the evil in his days : but in his son s days will I bring the evil upon his house .
translation.kha: Me la ïohi ne em kumno u Ahab u la pynrit ïa lade ha khmat jong nga ? Namar ba u la leh kumne , ngan ym pynjot ïa u katba u dang im ; kan long ha ka pateng u khun jong u , ba ngan wallam ka jingjot ha ka longïing jong u Ahab .
Te u angel u la ong , To panpoh ïa lade bad phong ïa la ki juti . U Patmos u la ar kumta , bad u angel u la ong , To thap ïa la ka jaiñkup sawdong jong me bad wan bad nga .
translation.en: And the angel said unto him , Gird thyself , and bind on thy sandals . And so he did . And he saith unto him , Cast thy garment about thee , and follow me .
I will also send wild beasts among you , which shall rob you of your children , and destroy your cattle , and make you few in number  ; and your high ways shall be desolate .
translation.kha: Ngan phah ïa ki mradkhlaw kiba shyrkhei ba kin leh donbor halor jong phi ; kine kin pynïap ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi , kin pynjot ïa ki jingri jingdup jong phi , bad kin sah sa tang khyndiat eh na phi , ba kumta ki lynti bah jong phi kin kynjah .

translation.en: And he said unto his mother , The eleven hundred shekels of silver that were taken from thee , about which thou cursedst , and spakest of also in mine ears , behold , the silver is with me  ; I took it . And his mother said , Blessed be thou of the  Lord  , my son .
translation.kha: U ong ha la ka kmie ,  Mynba don ba tuh ïa ki shi hajar shispah tylli ki sbai rupa na phi , phi buh ka jingtim halor uta u nongtuh . Nga la ïohsngew phi leh kumta . Khmih , nga don ka pisa . Dei ma nga uba shim ïa ki .  Ka kmie jong u ka ong ,  To U  Trai  un kyrkhu ïa phi , ko khun jong nga !
Na ka bynta kita kiba bud ïa kane ka lap ha ka jingim jong ki , to ai ba ka jingsuk bad ka jingisynei kan erlangthari lem bad ki — ïa ki lem bad baroh ki briew jong U balui !
translation.en: And as many as walk according to this rule , peace be on them , and mercy , and upon the Israel of God .

translation.kha: Nga long , U Jisu u la jubab , malu phin ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew uba shong ha ka liang kamon jong U Badonbor baroh bad ba u wang ha ki lyoh jong ka bnoh !
translation.en: And Jesus said ,  I am : and ye shall see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power , and coming in the clouds of heaven .
I have coveted no man s silver , or gold , or apparel .
translation.kha: Ngam shym la kwah ïa ka rupa lane ka ksiar lane ka jaiñphong jongno jongno .

translation.en: And there was a famine in the land : and Abram went down into Egypt to sojourn there  ; for the famine was grievous in the land .
translation.kha: Hynrei la don ka  nemsniew ha ka ri Kanaan , bad ka la long kaba jur shikatdei eh kat haduh ba u Abram u la leit jngai shaphang shathie sha ka ri Ijipt ban shong ban sah hangta shipor .

translation.en: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth  ; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit  ; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul .
translation.kha: Em ! Ngam lah ban shu sngap jar ! Nga bitar bad nga kthang mynsiem . Nga dei ban kren .
Katai ki dang ïadih waiñ , u syiem u la kylli biang ïa ka , Mynta , ko Esther , ko mahadei , kaei naba pha kwah ? Ïathuh ïa nga bad pham ïoh ïa kata . Ngan ai ha pha wat shit na ka hima .
translation.en: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine , What is thy petition , queen Esther ? and it shall be granted thee : and what is thy request ? and it shall be performed , even to the half of the kingdom .

translation.kha: Ki la jubab ïa u syiem ha ka ktien Aramaik , To u Syiem Kynrad un im junom ! To ïathuh ha ngi ïa ka jingphohsniew jongu phoi , bad ngin batuid ïa ka ha phiah .
translation.en: Then spake the Chaldeans to the king in Syriack , O king , live for ever : tell thy servants the dream , and we will shew the interpretation .
Or who shut up the sea with doors , when it brake forth , as if it had issued out of the womb ?
translation.kha: Mano ba khang ïa ki khyrdop ban bat ïa ka duriaw haba ka bthei na ka kpoh jong ka khyndew ?

translation.en: Whom having not seen , ye love  ; in whom , though now ye see him not , yet believing , ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory :
translation.kha: Phi ieit ïa u , wat haba phim pat ïohi ïa u , bad phi ngeit ha u , wat la phim pat ïohi ïa u mynta . Te phi shadkmen da ka jingkmen kaba khraw bad kaba dap da ka burom kiba ki ktien kim lah ban batai ,

translation.en: Hast thou found honey ? eat so much as is sufficient for thee , lest thou be filled therewith , and vomit it .
translation.kha: Wat ju bam ïa ka ngap palat ban ïa kaba phi donkam ; kaba bam palat ka lah ban pynlong ïa phi ban prie .
Katba u rangbah synshar u leit ban khot ïa u Mikaïah , u ong ha u , Baroh na kiwei ki nongïathuhlypa ki la ïathuhlypa ba u sahmiet un jop malu phi ruh ka bha ba phiah leh kumjuh .
translation.en: And the messenger that was gone to call Micaiah spake unto him , saying , Behold now , the words of the prophets declare good unto the king with one mouth : let thy word , I pray thee , be like the word of one of them , and speak that which is good .

translation.kha: Ko ki bhabriew jongno nga , wat ym sheptieng , ko ki paid Jerusalem , ki ym kyiuh . ngan pyllait im ïa phi na Kata ka ri kaba jngai , na ka ri ha kaba phi la long ki koidi . Phin wan phai pat shad ïing bad im ha ka jingsuk ; phin sngewshngain , bad yn ym don u don pyntieng ïa phi .
translation.en: But fear not thou , O my servant Jacob , and be not dismayed , O Israel : for , behold , I will save thee from afar off , and thy seed from the land of their captivity  ; and Jacob shall return , and be in rest and at ease , and none shall make him afraid .

translation.kha: ( Ki Israel ki mihnoh na ki pukri ki nong Jakarieh bad ki leit shat Moserah . Hangta u Aaron u la ïap , bad hangta ruh la tep ïa u , bad u Eleasar u khwan jong u , u shim ïa ka kajuh jong u kum u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Moserah : there Aaron died , and there he was buried  ; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest s office in his stead .

translation.kha: Hadad ka jingïap jong u Gideon , ki paidbah Ishmael kim shym ïaineh shuh bad U Blei’ bad ki la manla ïa ki Baal . Ki la pynlong ïa u Baal-jong-ka-Jutang ban long u Blei jrong ki ,
translation.en: And it came to pass , as soon as Gideon was dead , that the children of Israel turned again , and went a whoring after Baalim , and made Baal–berith their god .
And when he had opened the seventh seal , there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour .
translation.kha: Haba U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait noh ïa ka jingpyndait kaba hynñiew , ka la don ka jingsngap jar ha bneng kumba shiteng kynta .
Ki la buhai ïa nga hapoh ka jingsumar u Gedalaïah , u khun Jong u Ahikam bad u ksiew jong u Shaphat , u ban peit ba na tad suk sha ïing . Bad kumta nga la law hangta pyndeng ki briew .
translation.en: Even they sent , and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison , and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan , that he should carry him home : so he dwelt among the people .
Then the  Lord  opened the eyes of Balaam , and he saw the angel of the  Lord  standing in the way , and his sword drawn in his hand : and he bowed down his head , and fell flat on his face .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u pynshai ïa ki khmat u Balaam ban ïohi ïa u angel uba ïeng hangta bad la ka waitlam ; bad u Balaam u la dem khrup ha khyndew .
To burom ïa U Trai da kaba ai ha u ka jingainguh da kiei kiei naba bha kuna ba ka lyngkhot jong phi ka pynmih .
translation.en: Honour the  Lord  with thy substance , and with the firstfruits of all thine increase :

translation.kha: Haba ki la pa ha ka ri Kanaan , u Abram u ïaid lyngba ïa ka ri haduh ba un da poi ha u dieng kyntiap jong u Moreh , ka jaka bakhuid ha Shekhem . ( Ha dat ka par , ki Kanaan ki dang don ha ka ri . )
translation.en: And Abram passed through the land unto the place of Shechem , unto the plain of Moreh . And the Canaanite was then in the land .

translation.kha: Lada phi ïaineh ha nga bad ki ktien jong nga ki ïaineh ha Phin , te phin pan ïa kaei kaei kaba phi kwah , bad phin ïoh ïa ka .
translation.en: If ye abide in me , and my words abide in you , ye shall ask what ye will , and it shall be done unto you .

translation.kha: Ha shuwa ba un mih , u la khot ïa ki shiphew ngut ki sharai jong u bad u la ai ha ki kawei kawei ka sbai ksiar bad u la ong ïa ki , ‘ Khmih aïu phi kah ban kadei da kane Kaba nga dang leit jinglah .’
translation.en: And he called his ten servants , and delivered them ten pounds , and said unto them , Occupy till I come .

translation.kha: U Trai u khmih bha ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei , ban ai ka jingkhlaiñ ïa kito kiba ki dohnud jrong ki , ki ïaineh ha u . Me la leh beiñ , bad kumta naduh mynta Man don borabor ha ka jingïaleh thma .
translation.en: For the eyes of the  Lord  run to and fro throughout the whole earth , to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him . Herein thou hast done foolishly : therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars .
And Samuel said , When thou wast little in thine own sight , wast thou not made the head of the tribes of Israel , and the  Lord  anointed thee king over Israel ?
translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ,  Wat la phi ñiew ïa lade ba phim long ei ei , phi dei u nongïalam jong ki jait Israel . U  Trai  u la pynsleh ïa phi ban long u syiem jong ki Israel ,
Ko khun u briew , u la ong , to ïathuhlypa bad pynbna ïa kaei kaban ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga ainong . Men pyrta ïa kine ki ktien : Ka snoh kaba sngewtynnad kan Wan !
translation.en: Son of man , prophesy and say , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Howl ye , Woe worth the day !

translation.kha: Hynrei na ka por sha ka na ki Jiw uba shong hapdeng ki nongshun jong ngi ki wan shun maham ïa ngi ïa ki jingïathmu jong ki nongshun jong ngi pyrshah ïa ngi .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when the Jews which dwelt by them came , they said unto us ten times , From all places whence ye shall return unto us they will be upon you .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah jngai nga keiñ pynpoi ïa ki dieng thylli na Lebanon shathie sha ka duriaw bad kin teh lang ïa ki ha ki bur ban pynkie ïa ki sharum jongu ka rud duriaw sha ka jaka kaba me jied . hangtei ki lapbah jong nga kin law ïa ki jingteh , bad ki rangbah jongnga me ktien shimti ïa ki . Na ka liang jong me , nga kwah ïa me pun pynbiang jingdam ïa ki rangbah jongki nga .
translation.en: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea : and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me , and will cause them to be discharged there , and thou shalt receive them : and thou shalt accomplish my desire , in giving food for my household .

translation.kha: wai tieng ïa ki , Namar U Trai U Blei jong me un ïaleh na ka byndi jong me .’
translation.en: Ye shall not fear them : for the  Lord  your God he shall fight for you .

translation.kha: Lymda phi tih ïa ka thliew , phin hap shiah jrong ka , lada phi phang lyngba ka kynruh , u bseiñ un phew ïa phi .
translation.en: He that diggeth a pit shall fall into it  ; and whoso breaketh an hedge , a serpent shall bite him .

For the eyes of the  Lord  run to and fro throughout the whole earth , to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him . Herein thou hast done foolishly : therefore from henceforth thou shalt have wars .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u khmih bha ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei , ban ai ka jingkhlaiñ ïa kito kiba ki dohnud jong ki , ki ïaineh ha u . Me la leh bieit , bad kumta naduh mynta men don borabor ha ka jingïaleh thma .
U Joshua u la thang ïa ka Ai bad u ioh ïa ka ha ka jingjot . Ka dang sah kumta Myntan .
translation.en: And Joshua burnt Ai , and made it an heap for ever , even a desolation unto this day .

translation.kha: kum ka nuksa , lada u pynphai noh ïa ka bynda ba u sping ïa ka riam lane u pynphai noh ïa kaei ba u la tuh — lada u sangeh kaba leh thup bad u bud ïa ki aiñ kiba ai jingim , un ym ïaw hynrei un im .
translation.en: If the wicked restore the pledge , give again that he had robbed , walk in the statutes of life , without committing iniquity  ; he shall surely live , he shall not die .

translation.kha: u tip mynno ngim skhem ïoh ïa ki hok Jong ngi kiba u la ai ïa ine ;
translation.en: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High ,
For I determined not to know any thing among you , save Jesus Christ , and him crucified .
translation.kha: Naba katba nga dang don bad phi , nga la kut jingmut ban klet ïa kiei kiei baroh lait tang ïa U Jisu Khrist bad khamtam ïa ka jingïap jong u halor ka diengphna .

translation.en: Then the lords of the Philistines gathered them together for to offer a great sacrifice unto Dagon their god , and to rejoice : for they said , Our god hath delivered Samson our enemy into our hand .
translation.kha: Ki syiem Philistia ki ïalumlang ban ïaleh sngewbha bad ban ai ïa ka jingainguh kaba khraw ïa u Dagon u blei jong ki . Ki ïarwai ,  U blei jong ngi u la ai ha ngi ka jingjop ïa u Samson u nongshun jong ngi .
Ki nongshun ki la knieh ïa ka Heshbon nabar ki ïasylla ban pynpait ïa ka hima ki Jobab . Ïa ka shnongrit Madai yn pynsaphriang jar ; ki Shiphew kin tur pyrshah ïa ka .
translation.en: There shall be no more praise of Moab : in Heshbon they have devised evil against it  ; come , and let us cut it off from being a nation . Also thou shalt be cut down , O Madmen  ; the sword shall pursue thee .

translation.kha: Wat itieng ïa ki , namar U Trai U Blei jong me un ïaleh na ka bynshet jong me .’
translation.en: Ye shall not fear them : for the  Lord  your God he shall fight for you .
Non his son , Jehoshua his son .
translation.kha: u Nun , u Joshua .

translation.en: Are we not counted of him strangers ? for he hath sold us , and hath quite devoured also our money .
translation.kha: I ñiew ïa ngi kum ki nongwei . I la die ïa ngi , bad mynta i la pynlut ïa ka pisa baroh kaba long ka dor jong ngi .

translation.en: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation , and shall put off the linen garments , which he put on when he went into the holy place , and shall leave them there :
translation.kha: Nangta u Aaron un leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ , un law noh ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh kiba u la kup shuwa ba un leit rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam , bad un buh ïa ki hangta .

translation.en: Wisdom is good with an inheritance : and by it there is profit to them that see the sun .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei uba im u dei ban long uba stad ; ka long kaba bha kum ka jingïohpdiang ïa ka jingïohpateng
Ki kynthup jong ki nongtei mon jingsngewbha ki sien na kaweh ka balang sha kawei pat ha kajuh ka ri , wat shwa ki jaka ba jingpynduh , ban ïarap twa ïa ki ïinglieng Hima jong ki .
translation.en: Teams of construction servants and volunteers move from one congregation to the next within a country , even in remote areas , assisting the local congregations with the construction of their Kingdom Halls .
For of him , and through him , and to him , are all things : to whom be glory for ever . Amen .
translation.kha: Naba ïa baroh kiei kiei la thaw da u , bad baroh kiei kiei ki long lyngba jong u bad na ka bynta jong u . Ha U Blei , to long ka burom junom ! Amen .

translation.en: But when the king heard thereof , he was wroth : and he sent forth his armies , and destroyed those murderers , and burned up their city .
translation.kha: U syiem u la bitar tyngeh ; kumta u la phah ïa ki shipai jong u , kiba la pynïap ïa kito ki nongpynïap briew bad ki la thang duh ïa ka nongbah jong ki .
Haduh mynta phim ju kupar ei ei ha ka Kyrteng jong nga ; to pan bad phin ïohpdiang , khnang ba ka jingkmen jong phi kan ïoh long kaba dap pura .
translation.en: Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name : ask , and ye shall receive , that your joy may be full .

translation.kha: To kynmaw , ba ngan long ryngkat mala me bad ïada ïa me kat shaba me leit , bad kun wallam pat ïa me sha kane ka ri . Ngan ym iehnoh ïa me kad ïathuh ba ngan da pynnep ïa kata borbah ïa kaba at la kular ha me .
translation.en: And , behold , I am with thee , and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest , and will bring thee again into this land  ; for I will not leave thee , until I have done that which I have spoken to thee of .
But when he defied Israel , Jonathan the son of Shimea David s brother slew him .
translation.kha: U ïeng pyrshah ïa ki Israel , bad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Shammah uba shi para bad u Dabid , u pynïap ïa u .
Ka Hima ka de ka jingshlur ha kaba U Shem u long u khliehduh .
translation.en: A kingdom is a government that is headed by a king .
And he said unto them ,  Why are ye so fearful ? how is it that ye have no faith ?
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ong ïa ki synran jong u ,  Balei ba phi sheptieng ? Hato phim pat don jingngeit satia ?

translation.en: To the only wise God our Saviour , be glory and majesty , dominion and power , both now and ever . Amen .
translation.kha: ha U Blei , uba tang ma u hi U Nongpynim jong ngi , da U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi , to long ka burom , ka jingkhraw bor , ka jingkhlaiñ , bad ka jingsynshar , na ki rta ba la leit noh baroh , bad mynta , bad sha ki bymjukut bad bymjukut ! Amen .
To ïeng beit ha la ki kjat jong me ! Ulla u briew u la kynthih bad u la sdang ban ïaid kylleng .
translation.en: Said with a loud voice , Stand upright on thy feet . And he leaped and walked .
It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle , than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God .
translation.kha: Ka long kaba kham eh ïa u briew uba riewspah ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei ban ïa ka ut ban rung lyngba i thliew thyrnia .

translation.en: Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada nga leh ïa ki , wiat lada phim ngeit ïa na , phi la dei ïa-ban ngeit ïa ki kam jong at , khnang ba phi lah ban tip shu syn tip ba U Kpa u long ha nga bad ba nga long ha U Kaba .
translation.en: But if I do , though ye believe not me , believe the works : that ye may know , and believe , that the Father is in me , and I in him .

translation.kha: U Sebulun un shnong harud duriaw ; Ka jaka shong jong u kan long ka jakarieh ïa ki liengbah , Bad ka khyndew ka shyiap jong u kan ïar haduh Sidon .
translation.en: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea  ; and he shall be for an haven of ships  ; and his border shall be unto Zidon .

translation.kha: Te ki briew Jong nga kin tip ba sa long U Trai U Blei jong ki . Kin sa tip ïa kane , namar nga la phah ïa ki sha ka jinglongmraw bad mynta nga lalot ïa ki bad wallam pat ïa ki sha ka ri jong ki hi , khlam da ieh wat ti na ki shadien .
translation.en: Then shall they know that I am the  Lord  their God , which caused them to be led into captivity among the heathen : but I have gathered them unto their own land , and have left none of them any more there .

translation.kha: U Trai u la krung pat ha por .
translation.en: The  Lord  spake also unto me again , saying ,
The burden of the word of the  Lord  in the land of Hadrach , and Damascus shall be the rest thereof : when the eyes of man , as of all the tribes of Israel , shall be toward the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor jong U  Trai  : U la rai pynshitom ïa ka ri Hadrakh bad ïa ka nongbah Damaskos . Ym tang ki jait Israel hynrei ka nongbah Syria ruh ka long ka jong U  Trai .
Hadien kata ka jingpyndep , kita kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ki la lute ïa kata ka shnong baneh pynhiarkput namar ka jingpynkheiñ burom ïa ka sa jong ki .
translation.en: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain , and spoiled the city , because they had defiled their sister .
For the scripture saith , Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed .
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym ngat ha ka jingsngewsih .

phin ïathmu ïa ki ba ka um jongngi ka Jordan ka la sangot ban thut haba ka Synduk ka Jingot U Trai ka jam ïa ka wah . Kine ki mawthew kin ïaid pyniasngew ïa ki paid Israel shaphang kai kaba la jia hangne .
translation.en: Then ye shall answer them , That the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the covenant of the  Lord   ; when it passed over Jordan , the waters of Jordan were cut off : and these stones shall be for a memorial unto the children of Israel for ever .

translation.kha: Haba kin wan ban pynïap ïa me , hato men dang kim hi ba me long U Blei ? Haba me ïakynduh ïa ki nongpynïap biria , men long uba kyntang briew bad ym satia kaba kynja blei .
translation.en: Wilt thou yet say before him that slayeth thee , I am God ? but thou shalt be a man , and no God , in the hand of him that slayeth thee .

translation.kha: U la ai ïa nga shibun ki khun shynrang bad napdeng jrong ki barabor u la Jedidah ïa u Solomon ban synshar halor ka Israel , ka hima ka jongngi U Trai .
translation.en: And of all my sons , ( for the  Lord  hath given me many sons , ) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the  Lord  over Israel .

translation.kha: U Jiw u la nguh , Shah ïa ki khynnah ba kin Wan sha nga bad wat khang ïa ki , Namar ka Hima ki bneng ka erlangthari ïa uba kum kine .
translation.en: But Jesus said ,  Suffer little children , and forbid them not , to come unto me : for of such is the kingdom of heaven .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Pilat u la kyrhai , Ka kam runar aïu u la leh ? Nangta ki la Sdang pun pyrta da ka sur kaban khim tam : Sahnarphna ïa u !
translation.en: And the governor said , Why , what evil hath he done ? But they cried out the more , saying , Let him be crucified .

translation.kha: Katba baroh ki dang ïa-peit , uta u briew u la ainong joit , u la rahah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad mar kamut hi u la leit ne . Baroh ki la sngewpyngngad haduh katta katta bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei , ki da ong , Ngim pat ju ïohi kum kane kaei kaei !
translation.en: And immediately he arose , took up the bed , and went forth before them all  ; insomuch that they were all amazed , and glorified God , saying , We never saw it on this fashion .
My little children , these things write I unto you , that ye sin not . And if any man sin , we have an advocate with the Father , Jesus Christ the righteous :
translation.kha: Nga thoh ïa kane ha phi , ko ki khun jong nga , khnang ba phin ym leh pop ; hynrei lada uno uno u leh pop , ngi don uwei uba ïasaid bad U Kpa na ka bynta jong ngi — U Jisu Khrist , uta uba hok .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses in Midian , Go , return into Egypt : for all the men are dead which sought thy life .
translation.kha: Katba u Moses u dang don ha Midian , U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Khie leit phai sha Ijipt , namar ba kito baroh kiba thmu ban pynïap ïa me ki la ïap .
U Saul u ong ha u , Ai ba U Blei un shoh ïaphah ïa nga paila yn ym pynap ïa me !
translation.en: And Saul answered , God do so and more also : for thou shalt surely die , Jonathan .

translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba kynrei than ka jingleh pharia , uwei pa aiwai u briew u daiñ ban don la ka jrong ka tngaw , bad kawei pa kawei ka biria ka dei ban don la u jong u tnga .
translation.en: Nevertheless , to avoid fornication , let every man have his own wife , and let every woman have her own husband .

translation.kha: Shano ki syiad jong ki nongbah Hamath , Arpad , Sepharbaim , Hena , bad Ibbah ?
translation.en: Where is the king of Hamath , and the king of Arpad , and the king of the city of Sepharvaim , of Hena , and Ivah ?
Is the seed yet in the barn ? yea , as yet the vine , and the fig tree , and the pomegranate , and the olive tree , hath not brought forth : from this day will I bless you .
translation.kha: Wat la ym don kew ba dang sah , bad ki dieng sohwaiñ , ki diengsoh Dumbur , ki diengsoh Pomkranet , bad ki diengsoh Olib kim pat shym pynmih soh , pynban naduh mynta ngan kyrkhu ïa phi .
jynreiñ ki la ïa-ban kham ju shuh shuh , Da ka jinghikai jong u , u la sdang ka jingpynkhihwin hapdeng ki briew ha baroh kylleng ka Judia . U la Sdang ha Galilaïa bad mynta u la poi haneng .
translation.en: And they were the more fierce , saying , He stirreth up the people , teaching throughout all Judaea , beginning from Galilee to this place .

translation.kha: Ka jingïasoh jong per bad U Trai Jisu ka pyningkhong thikna ïa nga ba ym don ka jingbam ha ka hi , kaba long bymkhuid kat khim ka jinglehniam ; hynrei lada u briew u ngeit ba katto katne ka jingbam ka Long ka bymkhuid , te ka longkmie bymkut ïa u .
translation.en: I know , and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus , that there is nothing unclean of itself : but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean , to him it is unclean .

translation.kha: Hynrei namar ba u la long uba shajrong , naba eh ryndang , bad uba lup , la weng noh ïa u na ka khet syiem bad u la duh ei ïa ka jaka badonburom jong u .
translation.en: But when his heart was lifted up , and his mind hardened in pride , he was deposed from his kingly throne , and they took his glory from him :

translation.kha: Ma nga , bad ki hynñiew ngut ki nongai jingat , ngi phad ïa phi ban wad jingtip ïa ki jinglong jingmaham ha Jerushah bad Judah khnang ba-bang ïohi kumno ïa ka Hukum U Blei jong me , ïa kaba la bymngeit ha me , la Kohnguh .
translation.en: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king , and of his seven counsellors , to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem , according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand  ;
But now , because it is not so , he hath visited in his anger  ; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity :
translation.kha: Me pyrkhat ba U Blei un ym pynshitom , ba um da pynleit jingmut shaphang ka pop .
Ahian ba ki synran ki la dep ,
translation.en: And they did so , and made them all sit down .

translation.kha: Pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh . kumto keiñ uno uno un pynbeit ïa kaei kaba U Blei’ u la pynkdor .
translation.en: Consider the work of God : for who can make that straight , which he hath made crooked ?

translation.kha: Ka la don sa kawei ka thma hateng ki phylla pynlang ki Israel , bad u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la sien bad ïaleh ïa ki Philistia . Ha kawei ka tdam u dab u ktieh tlot .
translation.en: Moreover the Philistines had yet war again with Israel  ; and David went down , and his servants with him , and fought against the Philistines : and David waxed faint .

translation.kha: La slem bah nga la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha ki briew Jong nga : ‘ Phi dei ban peit ba ïa ka jinglehhok la pyndep , bad phi dei ban pyn-i ka jingbhasbun bad ka jingïohi iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , saying , Execute true judgment , and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother :

translation.kha: To kohnguh ïa ki hukum baroh ba nga la ai ha phoi myntri ka Sngi . Kumta te phin lah ban jam sha jingïailong wah bad ban ïohkynti ïa kata ka ri sha ka phin sa leit krong .
translation.en: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day , that ye may be strong , and go in and possess the land , whither ye go to possess it  ;

translation.kha: shisien ne ar sien ki nongkhaïi kiba dei pung jai ki tiar ki pynliem ïa ka mirr shu ka sngi Sabbaton shabar ki kynrei ka nongbah .
translation.en: So the merchants and sellers of all kind of ware lodged without Jerusalem once or twice .

translation.kha: Ka pop! ka la wan sha ka pyrthei lyngba uwei u briew , bad ka pop jong u ka la wallam ryngkat bad ka ïa ka jinghap . Ka jingmih ka long , ba ka jingïap ka la pur sha u bynrap baroh ñiar uwei pa uwei u la har pop .
translation.en: Wherefore , as by one man sin entered into the world , and death by sin ; and so death passed upon all men , for that all have sinned :
And the king said to Absalom , Nay , my son , let us not all now go , lest we be chargeable unto thee . And he pressed him : howbeit he would not go , but blessed him .
translation.kha: Em , ko khun jong nga ,  u syiem u jubab .  Kan bankhia shibun eh ïa phi lada ngi baroh ngi ïaleit .  U Absalom u la ïai ban , hynrei u syiem um shym mynjur , bad u la ong ïa u Absalom ban mihnoh .
Nga kren ïa ka jingshisha , nga longsyiem u jong U Khrist bad ngam kren ïa ka bymshisha . Ka jingïatiplem , ba la synshar da U Mynsiem Bakhuid ruh ka kren skhem ba ngam krong ïa ka bymshisha
translation.en: I say the truth in Christ , I lie not , my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost ,

translation.kha: hangtai ha Susa la don u Jiw uba kyrteng u Mordekai , u khun jong u Jair ; uba na ka jait Benjamin bad u long uba thapniang na u Kish bad u Shimei .
translation.en: Now in Shushan the palace there was a certain Jew , whose name was Mordecai , the son of Jair , the son of Shimei , the son of Kish , a Benjamite  ;

translation.kha: Nga la long ki khmat ïa kiba matlah , bad ki khiat ïa kiba dkoh .
translation.en: I was eyes to the blind , and feet was I to the lame .

translation.kha: U synrai , uwei na ki rangbah pynïaidkam uba peit ïa shiteng ki kali ïalam jong u syiem , u ïasylla pyrshah ïa u . Ha katai ka sngi ha Tirsah , u Elead u bang ha ka ïing jong u Arsa , uba peit ïa ka ïingsyiem .
translation.en: And his servant Zimri , captain of half his chariots , conspired against him , as he was in Tirzah , drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah .

The priests said not , Where is the  Lord  ? and they that handle the law knew me not : the pastors also transgressed against me , and the prophets prophesied by Baal , and walked after things that do not profit .
translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim shym kylli , ‘ Hangno U  Trai  u don ?’ Ki lyngdoh jong nga hi kim ithuh ïa nga . Ki nongsynshar ki la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ; ki nongïathuhlypa ki la kren ha ka kyrteng jong u Baal bad ki la ïamane ïa ki bleithaw bymmyntoi .

translation.en: But if our gospel be hid , it is hid to them that are lost :
translation.kha: Naba lada la buhrieh ïa ka gospel kaba ngi ïalap , la buhrieh ïa ka tang na kito kiba la jah noh .
Bad kata ka um ka la khuid naduh kata ka sngi , kumba u Elisha u la ong ba kan erlangthari kamut .
translation.en: So the waters were healed unto this day , according to the saying of Elisha which he spake .
When the dust groweth into hardness , and the clods cleave fast together ?
translation.kha: u slap uba pyneh ïa u pui pui sha ki  dew tylli ?

Hynrei kumno me eh ban shah ïa kine ki riewshukor , ki briew uba sniew ? Ki khmat jong me ki khuid palat kat ban peiñ ïa kaweh sngi , bad mem lah shah banbeiñ peit ïa ki briew ba har ba-bymman . Te bapli ba me shuh sngap jar jar katba ki dang pynjot ïa ki briew kiba kham hok ban ïa ki ?
translation.en: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil , and canst not look on iniquity : wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously , and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he ?
And every wise hearted among you shall come , and make all that the  Lord  hath commanded  ;
translation.kha: Baroh ki nongtrei kiba tbit napdeng jong phi ki dei ban ïawan shna ïa kita baroh ïa kiba U  Trai  u la hukum :
U leit sha ka harud jong ka lynti dara u ong , To ong , katno phi buh dor ? ( Um shym tip ba ka dei ka pyrsa kurim jong u . ) Ka noh Phin ai aiñ ïa nga ?
translation.en: And he turned unto her by the way , and said , Go to , I pray thee , let me come in unto thee  ; ( for he knew not that she was his daughter in law . ) And she said , What wilt thou give me , that thou mayest come in unto me ?

translation.kha: Baroh ki wad jingtip na u ban sngap ïa ka jingstad ba U Blei u la ai ha u .
translation.en: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon , to hear his wisdom , that God had put in his heart .
For it shall be , that on the day thou goest out , and passest over the brook Kidron , thou shalt know for certain that thou shalt surely die : thy blood shall be upon thine own head .
translation.kha: Lada me tang shu mih bad leit sha shiliang ka wahduid Kidron , men ïap da shisha — bad me hi men shah kynnoh .

translation.en: Study to shew thyself approved unto God , a workman that needeth not to be ashamed , rightly dividing the word of truth .
translation.kha: To leh ïa kaba bha tam ban ïoh ïa ka jingpynksan ba-pura ha khmat U Blei , kum u nongtrei u bymlehraiñ ïa la ka kam , uta uba hikai beit ïa ka khubor jong ka jingshisha U Blei .

translation.en: And king Joram went back to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah , when he fought against Hazael king of Syria . And Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel , because he was sick .
translation.kha: U la leit phai sha ka nongbah Jesreel ban ïoh jingkoit ïa ki jingmong jong u , bad u Ahasaïah u la leit shata ban jngoh ïa u .

translation.en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless , when I saw my help in the gate :
translation.kha: Lada nga la kum shukor ïa u khunswet , da kaba tip ba ngan ksan ha khmat ka ïingbishar ,
Na ka khet jong u ha bneng U Trai u rkhie u rkhiebeiñ ïa ki jingthmu batip jong ki .
translation.en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh : the Lord shall have them in derision .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada u para jong uta uba la ïap um mon ban shongkurim ïa ka , ka den ïa-ban longing ha khmat ki nongriam shnong badno ban ong , ‘ U por kynsi jong nga um treh ban pynngeit ïa ka kyrteng u hynmen jong u hapdeng ki Israel ; um mon ban pynjop ïa la ka kamar .’
translation.en: And if the man like not to take his brother s wife , then let his brother s wife go up to the gate unto the elders , and say , My husband s brother refuseth to raise up unto his brother a name in Israel , he will not perform the duty of my husband s brother .
Two are better than one  ; because they have a good reward for their labour .
translation.kha: Ar ngut ki kham bha ban ïa kaba marwei , namar ryngkat lang ki lah ban trei kham bha shibun .

translation.en: And his servants carried him in a chariot to Jerusalem , and buried him in his sepulchre with his fathers in the city of David .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u ki kit ïa ka met jong u ha ka kali ïapom sha Jerusalem , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid .
