translation.en: I spake unto thee in thy prosperity  ; but thou saidst , I will not hear . This hath been thy manner from thy youth , that thou obeyedst not my voice .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha phi mynba phi dang manbha , hynrei phi kyntait ban shahshkor . Kata ka long kaei kaba phi leh shi lynter ka jingim jong phi , phim ju treh ban kohnguh ïa U  Trai .

Ngi kwah ba phin kylluid ba phin ym pynmynsaw ïa ngi , kitab ngi pajut ngim shym la pynmynsaw ïa phi . Ngi la lehsbun ïa Phin bad im la shah ba phin leit da kaba suk . Mynta ka paw sharai ba U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa phira .
translation.en: That thou wilt do us no hurt , as we have not touched thee , and as we have done unto thee nothing but good , and have sent thee away in peace : thou art now the blessed of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka por ka pei haba ki lumbah ki twa bad ki mawdong baskhem ki kynran noh .
translation.en: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought , and the rock is removed out of his place .

translation.kha: Ngan pynlong ïa phi ki briew jong sa , bad nga ngan long U Blei jong phi . Phin sa tip ba de long U Trai U Blei jong phi haba nga pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka jinglongmraw ha ka ri Ijipt .
translation.en: And I will take you to me for a people , and I will be to you a God : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord  your God , which bringeth you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians .
With clouds he covereth the light  ; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt .
translation.kha: U kem ïa ka leilieh da la ki kti bad u hukum ïa ka ban tied ïa kaba thmu .
manna ka sngem , U Jisu u la hikai ha ka Templ . Ki lapbah lyngngeit , ki nongkhaïi ka Hukum , bad ki nongïalam jongnga ki paidbah ki la kwah ban pynïap ïa u ,
translation.en: And he taught daily in the temple . But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him ,

translation.kha: ( U syiem ka ri Ijipt u tur ïaleh ïa ka Geser bad u la ïohsngew ïa ka , u la pynïap ïa ki traishnong hangta bad u la thang ïa ka . Nangta u la ai ïa ka ha ka khun jong u kum ka jingïoh bynta jong ka ha ka por ba ka shongkurim ïa u Solomon , bad u Solomon u thet thymmai ïa ka . )
translation.en: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up , and taken Gezer , and burnt it with fire , and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city , and given it for a present unto his daughter , Solomon s wife .
And David said unto Gad , I am in a great strait : let me fall now into the hand of the  Lord   ; for very great are his mercies : but let me not fall into the hand of man .
translation.kha: U Dabid u jubab ïa u Gad ,  Nga don ha ka khim khait ! Hynrei ngam kwah ba yn pynshitom ïa nga da ki briew . Ai ba U  Trai  da lade hi un long uta u ban pynshitom ïa nga , namar u long uba dap da ka jingisynei .

To lehkmen , ko ki briew ka Seïon , to shadkmen ha kaei kaba U Trai U Blei’ jong phi u la leh ïa phi! . U la ai ïa ph ïa u slap synreit uba biang ; u la thoh ïa u slap mong na ka bynta jong phi bad ïa u slap pynriam kumba mynshuwa .
translation.en: Be glad then , ye children of Zion , and rejoice in the  Lord  your God : for he hath given you the former rain moderately , and he will cause to come down for you the rain , the former rain , and the latter rain in the first month .

translation.kha: Haba u Joab malu ki pynrangbah jong u ki la poi , la ïathuh ha u ba u Abner u la woh sha u syiem Arbad , Bad ba u Dabid u la phah noh ïa u lem bad ka jingkular jingshngain .
translation.en: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come , they told Joab , saying , Abner the son of Ner came to the king , and he hath sent him away , and he is gone in peace .
Which is his body , the fulness of him that filleth all in all .
translation.kha: Ka Balang ka long ka met U Khrist , kaba pyndap pura ïa u , uba da lade hi u pyndap pura ïa kiei kiei baroh ha kylleng ki jaka .

Nangta u angel bakhlaiñbor u la shim ïa u maw uba heh la katjuh u Melataïah baheh bad u la kawang ïa u sha ka duriaw , da kaba ong , kane ka long kumno ïa ka nongbah Babilon bakhraw yn pynkhyllem ha ka borbah pynlang yn ym ïuh Shuh ïa ka da lei lei .
translation.en: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone , and cast it into the sea , saying , Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down , and shall be found no more at all .
And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour , and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls , having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication :
translation.kha: Kata ka briew ka la riam ha ki jaiñ ba sawbthuh bad basaw hain hain , bad ba la tap da ki jingdeng ksiar , ki mawkordor , bad ki paila . Ha ka kti jong ka , ka la bat ïa ka khuri ksiar kaba dap da kiei kiei kiba isaitmet bad ijakhlia , kiba mih na ka jingawria jong ka .
U Ujuh u mut ban ong ba u Lasaros u la ïap , hynrei ki la pyrkhat ba u mut ba u shu ïohthiah .
translation.en: Howbeit Jesus spake of his death : but they thought that he had spoken of taking of rest in sleep .

translation.kha: Ki jubab , Lada phi kwah ban shakri bha ïa kine ki briew , ai ïa ka jubab kaba biang ïa ka jingkyrpad jong ki , bad kin ïai Sikhri hok ïa phi .
translation.en: And they spake unto him , saying , If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day , and wilt serve them , and answer them , and speak good words to them , then they will be thy servants for ever .
And he had seven hundred wives , princesses , and three hundred concubines : and his wives turned away his heart .
translation.kha: U Solomon u la shongkurim hynñiewspah ngut ki khun syiem kynthei bad laispah ngut ruh ki tnga kliar .
Te u Jakob u khot ïa la ki khun shynrang malade u ong , Ïalumlang bhor , ba nur-um ïathuh aïu kan jat ïa phi ha ka lawei :
translation.en: And Jacob called unto his sons , and said , Gather yourselves together , that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days .
And when David enquired of the  Lord  , he said , Thou shalt not go up  ; but fetch a compass behind them , and come upon them over against the mulberry trees .
translation.kha: Sa shisien u Dabid u kylli na U  Trai  , uba jubab ,  Wat tur ïaleh ïa ki nangne , hynrei leit sawdong bad pynkhreh ban tur ïaleh ïa ki na kawei ka liang , najan ki dieng Balsam .
u la pyllait ïa ngi na ki nongwan jong ngi ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymkohnguh .
translation.en: And hath redeemed us from our enemies : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: To U Blei uba U Kpa jong ngi bad U Jisu Khereth uba U Trai un ai ha phi ïa ka jingisynei bad ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Grace be to you and peace from God our Father , and from the Lord Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: phiah lama kambah barabor eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; katno ki khmat jngai phi ki pharia itynnat da ka jingieit !
translation.en: Take us the foxes , the little foxes , that spoil the vines : for our vines have tender grapes .
But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely , and shall be quiet from fear of evil .
translation.kha: Hynrei jar uba shahshkor ïa nga un shongsuk kynjai . Un lait na ki jingma khlem sheptieng ïa kaba sniew .
kin ïohpdiang khap bun shah ha kane ka pateng bad ïa ka jingim bymjukut ha ka pateng ka ban wan .
translation.en: Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time , and in the world to come life everlasting .

And they did so  ; for Aaron stretched out his hand with his rod , and smote the dust of the earth , and it became lice in man , and in beast  ; all the dust of the land became lice throughout all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta u Aaron u shoh ïa ka khyndew da la u diengduh ; te u pui pui baroh ha Ijipt u kylla mait , bad kumta la boi da u mait ha u briew bad ha u mrad .

To pynïeng ki jingkdew lynti bad pruid dak ha ka surok ; to wan biang ïa ka lynti kaba phi la iehnoh . To wan phai biang , ko phi ki paid Israel , to wiang sha la ka ri , sha ki shnong kiba phi la iehnoh .
translation.en: Set thee up waymarks , make thee high heaps : set thine heart toward the highway , even the way which thou wentest : turn again , O virgin of Israel , turn again to these thy cities .

translation.kha: Uba la lehkai ha ka Baibl , kine ki aiñ ki ïarap ïa im’ ban kyntiew ïa ka long-briew mynbarim , ban burom ïa kiwei , bad ban long kiba sbun bad kiba leh haw .
translation.en: These values , as taught in the Bible , promote well-being and respect for others , along with such qualities as honesty and kindness .
To him that made great lights : for his mercy endureth for ever :
translation.kha: U la thaw ïa ka sngi bad ïa u bnai ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut ;
Te nga la shim ïa bhor ar tylli ki kopi ka dulir thiah jaka — ka kopi ba la shon muhor kambah don ka jingïakut dara ki kyndon , bad ka kopi ba khlem shon muhor —
translation.en: So I took the evidence of the purchase , both that which was sealed according to the law and custom , and that which was open :

translation.kha: Nga u Paul , nga pynlong ka jingkyrpad ïa phi — ïa nga ïa kaba la ong ba nga long uba jemnud bad her jai haba nga ba-don bad phi , hynrei suba eh haba nga don jngai na phi .
translation.en: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Christ , who in presence am base among you , but being absent am bold toward you :

And he shall judge among many people , and rebuke strong nations afar off  ; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares , and their spears into pruninghooks : nation shall not lift up a sword against nation , neither shall they learn war any more .
translation.kha: Un pynbeit ïa ki jingïakajia hapdeng ki jaitbynriew , hapdeng ki bor bakhraw hajan bad hajngai . Kin shoh tyrnem ïa la ki waitlam ban pynlong ki lyngkor bad ïa ki sum sha ki wait ngor tnat dieng . Ki jaitbynriew kin ym ïaleh thma shuh , kin ym pynkhreh shuh ban ïaleh thma .

translation.en: And when this people , or the prophet , or a priest , shall ask thee , saying , What is the burden of the  Lord  ? thou shalt then say unto them , What burden ? I will even forsake you , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ïa nga ,  Ko Jeremaïah , haba uwei na ki briew jong nga ne u nongïathuhlypa ne u lyngdoh u kylli ïa me , ‘ Kaei ka khubor jong U  Trai  ?’ Men ïathuh ha u , ‘ Me long ka jingkit ïa U  Trai  , bad un sa kynther noh ïa me .’
Nga la hikai ha phi ïa ka jingstad bad ka rukom im kaba dei .
translation.en: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom  ; I have led thee in right paths .

translation.kha: Kumta ha ka trep kambah bud u Dabid sad ki briew jong u ki mihnoh ïalang step phyrngab ban leit peiñ sha ka ri ki Philistia , hynrei ki Philistia ki leit kiew sha Jesreel .
translation.en: So David and his men rose up early to depart in the morning , to return into the land of the Philistines . And the Philistines went up to Jezreel .

translation.kha: Haba U Jisu la khih na ka jingtong , u la ïohi ïa une u paidbhur babun , bad ïa ka mynnin jong u la pyndap da ka jingsngewsynei ïa ki , namar ki la long kum ki langbrot khlem u nongri . Kumta u la shadong baneh iaki bun kiei kiei ïa ki .
translation.en: And Jesus , when he came out , saw much people , and was moved with compassion toward them , because they were as sheep not having a shepherd : and he began to teach them many things .

translation.kha: U Trai u isih ïa ki bynriew kiba don jingmut snep , hynrei u ieit ïa kito kba leh ïa kaba daiñ .
translation.en: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to the  Lord  : but such as are upright in their way are his delight .
And he shall shew you a large upper room furnished : there make ready .
translation.kha: Un pyn-i ha phi ïa ka kamra kaba haneng , kaba heh , kaba la pynbit pynbiang , ha kaba phin pynkhreh ïa kaei kaei baroh .
U sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba u kuna bad u sangeh ban ai pop , kumta un ym ïap da shisha , hynrei un ïai im .
translation.en: Because he considereth , and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed , he shall surely live , he shall not die .

translation.kha: Kumba ka erlangthari , ni shibun ki dkhot hawei tang kawei ka met .
translation.en: But now are they many members , yet but one body .

translation.kha: Phira long ki sakhi ïa kine kiew kiei .
translation.en: And ye are witnesses of these things .
And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the  Lord  , and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers , and to the hand of the workmen .
translation.kha: Ngi la shim ïa ka pisa kaba la buh ha ka Templ bad ngi la aiti ha ki nongtrei bad ki nongkhmih ba-halor .

Hynrei u Joshua u la pyllait im ïa ka Rahab ka nuti malade ïa ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jong ka baroh , ñiar ba ka la pynrieh ïa ki ar jrut ki nongsyntiat kiba u la phah sha Jerikho . ( Ki khwan ki ksiew jong ka ki shnong ki sah ha Israel haduh kane ka sngi . )
translation.en: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive , and her father s household , and all that she had  ; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day  ; because she hid the messengers , which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho .

translation.kha: La leit on lynti ïa ki da ka balang ; bad kaban ki dang lytar Lyngba ka Phoenisia bad ka Samaria , ki la ïathmu kumno ba ki Jentil ki la phai shat U Blei ; kane ka khohruh ka la wallam ka jingkmen bakhraw ïa ki parabangeit baroh .
translation.en: And being brought on their way by the church , they passed through Phoenicia and Samaria , declaring the conversion of the Gentiles : and they caused great joy unto all the brethren .
Wherefore , if God so clothe the grass of the field , which to day is , and to morrow is cast into the oven , shall he not much more clothe you , O ye of little faith ?
translation.kha: U long U Blei uba pynkup ïa u phlang khlaw — u phlang uba don hangne mynta bad u bym don shuh lashai , uba la thang duh ha ka lawar ding . Hato un ym da la kham leh thikna ban pynkup jaiñ ïa phi ? Katno kaba rit ka jingngeit phi don !
Haba ka syndah ka Jutang ka poi , ki Israel ki riew jam da ka jingkieng haduh ba ka khyndew ka khynñiuh .
translation.en: And when the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  came into the camp , all Israel shouted with a great shout , so that the earth rang again .

translation.kha: U —Isaïah ngat u la ïathuh ha u syiem , U Trai Badonbor Baroh u ong ba ka por Kan poi ba barieh kaba ha ka ïingsyiem jong me , bhor kaba ki kpa tymmen jong me ki la lum haduh kane ka sngi , yn sa kit noh sha Babilonia . Yn ym don shuh ka ban sah .
translation.en: Behold , the days come , that all that is in thine house , and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day , shall be carried to Babylon : nothing shall be left , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Troas u la ong , Hynñiew sngi lynter phin ym bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat — bam tang ïa u kpu bakhleiñ thiat . Ha ka sngem kaba nongking phi dadien ban bret ne ïa u thiat baroh na ïing jrong phi , Namar lada uno uno u bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat ha kita ki hynñiew sngi , yn ym kheiñ shuh ïa u kum uwei na ki briew jong nga .
translation.en: Seven days shall ye eat unleavened bread  ; even the first day ye shall put away leaven out of your houses : for whosoever eateth leavened bread from the first day until the seventh day , that soul shall be cut off from Israel .

translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua bad ki rangbah jong u baïar ki la ter ïaleh ïa ki ha ka por ba kim poi pyrkhat ha ka Wahduid Meron .
translation.en: So Joshua came , and all the people of war with him , against them by the waters of Merom suddenly  ; and they fell upon them .

translation.kha: Ka Jordan ka dadien ka pud bashongshit sepngi jong ka jait Reuben . Kine ki longkmie ki nongbah bun ki nongrit kiba la ai ha ki longïing jong ka jait Reuben khem ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan , and the border thereof . This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families , the cities and the villages thereof .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha ka sngi kaba san phi lah ban bam ïa u soh . dalade phi leh ïa kane baroh , ki dieng jong phin kin seisoh kham bun . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof , that it may yield unto you the increase thereof : I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Me la buh ïa ka pyrthei ha ki nongrim baskhem , bad yn ym pynkdiah shuh ïa ka .
translation.en: Who laid the foundations of the earth , that it should not be removed for ever .

translation.kha: Ka don hangta haduh lai bnai , bad U Trai u kyrkhu ïa ka longsem u Obed Eden bad baroh kiei keiñ kiba dem ki jongnga u .
translation.en: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed–edom in his house three months . And the  Lord  blessed the house of Obed–edom , and all that he had .

translation.kha: Un ïohpdiang shispah shah shiah shuh ki ïing , ki hynmen ki para shynriah ne kynthei , ki kmie , ki khun bad ki lyngkhuit — bad ki jingshat pynshitom beit ruh kumjuh ; badno ha ka pdang ka ban sa wan un ïoh ka jingim bymjukut .
translation.en: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time , houses , and brethren , and sisters , and mothers , and children , and lands , with persecutions  ; and in the world to come eternal life .

translation.kha: Wanrah ïa kine Nalor ka jingainguh thang kaba ju leh ha ka sngi nyngkong jong u bnoh lem bad ka jingainguh bam jong ka , bad ïa ka jingainguh tdong kaban man ka sngap Lem bad ka jingainguh bam bad ka jingainguh waiñ jong ka . Kine ki jingainguh bam ki long ka jingïoh kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Beside the burnt offering of the month , and his meat offering , and the daily burnt offering , and his meat offering , and their drink offerings , according unto their manner , for a sweet savour , a sacrifice made by fire unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Kumba te , kumba U Mynsiem Bakhuid u ong ; Lada phi ïohsngew ïa ka sur ka jong U Blei ha kane ka sngi ,
translation.en: Wherefore ( as the Holy Ghost saith , To day if ye will hear his voice ,

translation.kha: Nangta nga ong , A Trai nongbishar , to kheiñ noh ! Kumno ki briew jongnga me ki lah ba-bang lait im ? Ki erlangthari kiba rit bad kiba tlot katta dik !
translation.en: Then said I , O Lord  God  , cease , I beseech thee : by whom shall Jacob arise ? for he is small .
But I say unto you , That ye resist not evil : but whosoever shall smite thee on thy right cheek , turn to him the other also .
translation.kha: Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : wat pynhiarkput ïa uno uno uba leh sniew ïa phi . Lada uno uno u thab ïa phi na ka ngab kamon , ai ba un thab ïa ka ngab kadiang jong phi ruh .
Ki la iehnoh ïa ka lynti ka jingshisha malade pynbakla khangkdong ïa ka jingbeit jong ki katto katne ki bangeit da kaba ong ba ka jingpynmihpat ïa ngi ka la dep jia .
translation.en: Who concerning the truth have erred , saying that the resurrection is past already ; and overthrow the faith of some .

translation.kha: U Timon u im ha la ka jngai ka pyiar
translation.en: Tom lives in his own world .
And when she knew Peter s voice , she opened not the gate for gladness , but ran in , and told how Peter stood before the gate .
translation.kha: Ka la sngewthuh ïa ka sur jong u Petros bad ka la kmen haduh katta katta ba ka la mareh pat shapoh khlem da plie ïa ka jingkhang , bad ka la pynbna ba u Petros u ïeng shabar .

translation.en: Mine eyes do fail with tears , my bowels are troubled , my liver is poured upon the earth , for the destruction of the daughter of my people  ; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong ka ki ud katba ki wad ei ei ban bam ; ki ïa-bujli ïa la ki jingkynshew na ka bynta ka jingbam ban pynsah im ïa lade .  To khmih sha nga , A  Trai  ,  ka nongbah ka kyang ;  to peit ïa nga ha ka jinglong rangli jong nga .

Hynrei mem shym iehnoh ïa ki hangta ha ka ri shyiap , namar ka jingisynei jrong me ka long naba khraw . im shym la shim noh ïa u lynghoh lieng ïa ka ding naba pyn-i ha ki ïa ka lynti mynsngi bad mynmiet .
translation.en: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness : the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day , to lead them in the way  ; neither the pillar of fire by night , to shew them light , and the way wherein they should go .

translation.kha: Hynñiew , lehse anna sawphew san ngut ha ka jaka sanphew ngut kiba hok . Hato men pynjot napoh ïa ka nongbah baroh khawai namar ba dala San ngut ? U Trai u ong , Ngan ym pynjot noh ïa ka “lada nga shem sawphew san ngut kiba khot .
translation.en: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous : wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five ? And he said , If I find there forty and five , I will not destroy it .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , ki Israel ki pyrkhing ba ki jingïohipaw bad ki jingïathuhlypa jong me ki dei Shaphan ka khawai kaba dang slem .
translation.en: Son of man , behold , they of the house of Israel say , The vision that he seeth is for many days to come , and he prophesieth of the times that are far off .

translation.kha: Te ka Sarai ka ong ha u Abarim , Dei namar jong me ba ka Hagar ka ïuhbeiñ ïa nga ! Nga hi nga la ai ïa ka ha me , bad naduh ba ka thup ba ka la pyntong , ka ibeiñ ïa nga . Ai ba U Trai un bishar mano ba dei napdeng jong I , ma me jlan ma nga !
translation.en: And Sarai said unto Abram , My wrong be upon thee : I have given my maid into thy bosom  ; and when she saw that she had conceived , I was despised in her eyes : the  Lord  judge between me and thee .

translation.kha: Kumta U Khun U Briew u long U Kynrad jong ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath .
Understand , ye brutish among the people : and ye fools , when will ye be wise ?
translation.kha: Ko ki briew jong nga , kumno phi lah ban long kiba bieit mutlop sat ? Lano phin nang ïa kane ?

translation.en: And the men of David said unto him , Behold the day of which the  Lord  said unto thee , Behold , I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand , that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee . Then David arose , and cut off the skirt of Saul s robe privily .
translation.kha: Ki ong ha u ,  Kane ka dei ka kabu jong phi ! U  Trai  u la ïathuh ïa phi ba un buh ïa u nongshun ha ka bor jong phi bad phi lah ban leh ïa u kat kaba phi kwah .  U Dabid u par sor sor bad u ot shi lyngkhot na ka jaiñkup u Saul khlem ka jingtip u Saul .

translation.en: Then Peter opened his mouth , and said , Of a truth I perceive that God is no respecter of persons :
translation.kha: U Petros u la sdang ban kren :  Mynta nga sngewthuh ba ka long kaba shisha ba U Blei u ñiew kumjuh ïa uno uno baroh .

Suk uta u briew uba ïaineh hapdeng ki jingtynjuh , namar ynda u jop haba u la ïathied lyngba ïa kaba kum kata ka jingïathuh , un ïohpdiang kum ka bainong jong u ïa ka jingim kaba U Balei u la kular ha kito kiba ieit ïa u .
translation.en: Blessed is the man that endureth temptation : for when he is tried , he shall receive the crown of life , which the Lord hath promised to them that love him .

translation.kha: Lada uno Uno u kwah ban kob sarew , u dei ban kob sarong ba u ithuh bad ba u shemphang ïa nga , Naamah ka jingieit jong nga ka longsyiem kaba neh , bad nga har ïa kaba hok bad kaba dei . Kieng ki long kita kiei kiew kiba pynsngewbha ïa nga . Ma nga , U Tharai , nga la krung .
translation.en: But let him that glorieth glory in this , that he understandeth and knoweth me , that I am the  Lord  which exercise lovingkindness , judgment , and righteousness , in the earth : for in these things I delight , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Pilat u la jubab , Ïa kaei kaba ar la thah , la thoh .
translation.en: Pilate answered , What I have written I have written .

translation.kha: Kaba leit tuklar ha ka jingïamai ka bym dei ka kam jongnga phi ka long kumba leit sha lyngkot bah bad kem ïa u ksew na ki shkor .
translation.en: He that passeth by , and meddleth with strife belonging not to him , is like one that taketh a dog by the ears .

translation.kha: Pynban , un pynbudnam ïa u blei uba ïada ïa ki kut . Un ai ka ksiar , ka rupa , ki mawlynnai , malu kiwei! kiwei ki jingai babha sha u blei uba ki kpa tymmen lad u kim shym la ju mane .
translation.en: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces : and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold , and silver , and with precious stones , and pleasant things .

translation.kha: Ngan pynshitom ïa ka Moab , bun kin ïoh tip ba nga long U Trei .
translation.en: And I will execute judgments upon Moab  ; and they shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka shithi kaba u patsha u la thoh ka kren pyrshah ïa U Tiras , U Blei ki Israel . Ka jong , Ki blei jong ki shiah kim shym lah ban Pyllait ïa ki briew jong ki na ka bor jrong na , bad da lei lei U Blei jong u Hesekaïah un ym haw ban pyllait im ïa la ki brup na nga .
translation.en: He wrote also letters to rail on the  Lord  God of Israel , and to speak against him , saying , As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand , so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand .

translation.kha: Bad kumta per ong ha phi ba ngan phah ha phi ïa ki nongïathuhlypa bad ïa ki brai kiba stad bad ïa ki nongai ; phin pynïap katto katne ngut na ki , phin sahnarphna ïa kiwei pat , bad phin sympat ïa kiwei pat ha ki synagog bad beh ïa ki na Kaei ka shngain shat kawei pat .
translation.en: Wherefore , behold , I send unto you prophets , and wise men , and scribes : and some of them ye shall kill and crucify  ; and some of them shall ye scourge in your synagogues , and persecute them from city to city :
And the fish that was in the river died  ; and the river stank , and the Egyptians could not drink of the water of the river  ; and there was blood throughout all the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Ki dohkha ha ka wah ki la ïap , bad ka la sma iwtung eh kat haduh ba ki nong Ijipt kim nud shuh ban dih um na ka . Ka snam ka la don ha kylleng ka ri Ijipt .

translation.en: And their feet were straight feet  ; and the sole of their feet was like the sole of a calf s foot : and they sparkled like the colour of burnished brass .
translation.kha: Ki pung kjat jong ki , ki long kiba beit , bad ki don ki khnap kum ki jong u masi dab , bad ki thaba kum ka rnong ba la shut pynphyrnai .
haduh ba u mynsiem u wan sha khmut , u wan ha U Trai , bad ong , ‘ Ngan shukor ma nga ïa u .’ ‘ Kumno ?’ U Trai u kylli .
translation.en: Then there came out a spirit , and stood before the  Lord  , and said , I will entice him . And the  Lord  said unto him , Wherewith ?

translation.kha: Nangta u Jisu u hukum , Pynbthi ïa ka sngi jong ka jingmane ban lehburom ïa u Baal !
translation.en: And Jehu said , Proclaim a solemn assembly for Baal . And they proclaimed it .

translation.kha: Bad hato u hukum ïa phi na Kadesh Barnea ban leit kur kynti ïa kata ka ri ïa kaba u la ai ha phi , ph ïabeh pyrshah pynban ïa u ; phim shym shaniah bad kohnguh ïa u .
translation.en: Likewise when the  Lord  sent you from Kadesh–barnea , saying , Go up and possess the land which I have given you  ; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the  Lord  your God , and ye believed him not , nor hearkened to his voice .

translation.kha: U la hukum ruh ïa u shakri uba ha khmat eh , Ynda u Katta u hynmen jong nga u ïakdang ïa me , nabar u kylli , ‘ Uei u kynruh jong me ? Shano men leit ? Uei u trai jong kine ki jingri kiba ha khmat jong me ?’
translation.en: And he commanded the foremost , saying , When Esau my brother meeteth thee , and asketh thee , saying , Whose art thou ? and whither goest thou ? and whose are these before thee ?
Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way : and he that hateth reproof shall die .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh ïa kaei ka bymdei , yn pynshitom sat ïa phi ; phin ïap lada phim ailad ban pynbeit ïa phi .

translation.en: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah , and reigned two years over Israel .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba khathynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Jehoshaphat u syiem ka Judah , u Ahasaïah u khun jong u Ahab u sdang ban synshar ha Israel ; bad u synshar ar snem ha Samaria .
Nangta Uto u angel u ïing ha ka lynti kaba khim katba don hapdeng ar tyrnem ki bri shaiñ ba la ker da ka kynroh Maw baroh arliang .
translation.en: But the angel of the  Lord  stood in a path of the vineyards , a wall being on this side , and a wall on that side .
Hath not the scripture said , That Christ cometh of the seed of David , and out of the town of Bethlehem , where David was ?
translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ba U Messaïah un long uba hiarpateng na u Syiem Dabid bad yn kha ïa u ha Bethlehem , ka shnong ha kaba u Dabid u la im .

translation.en: And Jesus arose , and followed him , and so did his disciples .
translation.kha: Kumta U Jisu u la ïeng joit bad u la bud ïa u , bad ki synran jong u ki la ïaleit ryngkat bad u .
Shuh shuh , nga la bahkhlieh ha i pa da la ka jingim na ka bynta u para . Nga ong ïa i ba lada ngam wan ïalam pat ïa u para sha i , ngan sa set pop ma nga shi rta .
translation.en: For thy servant became surety for the lad unto my father , saying , If I bring him not unto thee , then I shall bear the blame to my father for ever .

Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the priest , hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel , while he was zealous for my sake among them , that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy .
translation.kha: Namar kaei kaba u Phinehas u la leh , ngam bitar shuh ïa ki paid Israel . U kyntait ban shah ïa ka jingmane ïa uno uno u blei lait tang ïa nga , bad namar kata ngam shym la pynjot ïa ki wat haba nga la bitar .

translation.en: For therefore he sent unto us in Babylon , saying , This captivity is long : build ye houses , and dwell in them  ; and plant gardens , and eat the fruit of them .
translation.kha: Dei ban pynsangeh ïa u namar u la ong ïa ki briew ha Babilonia ba kin long ki koidi slem bah hangta bad ba kin tei ïa ki ïing , kin shongduh , kin thaw ki kper , bad bam ïa kaei kaba ki thung .
Uno Un u bym shim ïa la ka diengphna nabar bud ha daiñ jat jong nga um long uba bit ban long u synran jongu nga .
translation.en: And he that taketh not his cross , and followeth after me , is not worthy of me .

translation.kha: Kumne te , kam pher lada ka la wan na per ne na ki , khnai ka long kaei kambah ngi baroh ngi ïalap , bad kane ka long kaei kaba phi ngeit .
translation.en: Therefore whether it were I or they , so we preach , and so ye believed .
And immediately he arose , took up the bed , and went forth before them all  ; insomuch that they were all amazed , and glorified God , saying , We never saw it on this fashion .
translation.kha: Katba baroh ki dang ïa-peit , uta u briew u la ïeng joit , u la rah ïa la ka jingthiah , bad mar kumta hi u la leit noh . Baroh ki la ïa-sngewlyngngoh haduh katta katta bad ki la ïaroh ïa U Blei , ki da ong ,  Ngim pat ju ïohi kum kane kaei kaei !
Kane ka khop ïa ka jingstad bad jingpynkheiñ . Ki hynñiew tylli ki khlieh ki longïng hynñiew tylli ki lym , ha kiba sier ka briew ka shong . Ki longïing shwa ki hynñiew ngut ki syiem :
translation.en: And here is the mind which hath wisdom . The seven heads are seven mountains , on which the woman sitteth .

translation.kha: To ngin joit mynta kum u rangbah , bad jubab ïa ki Jingkylli jong nga .
translation.en: Gird up thy loins now like a man : I will demand of thee , and declare thou unto me .
And Moses said unto him , Enviest thou for my sake ? would God that all the  Lord s  people were prophets , and that the  Lord  would put his spirit upon them !
translation.kha: U Moses u jubab ,  Hato me pyrkhat lem shaphang kiei kiei kiba ïadei bad nga ? A ban da U  Trai  u ai ïa la ka bor mynsiem ha ki briew jong u baroh bad u pynlong ïa ki ban pyrta jam kum ki nongïathuhlypa !

translation.en: The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne , and worship him that liveth for ever and ever , and cast their crowns before the throne , saying ,
translation.kha: Haba ki leh kumta , kita ki arphew saw ngut ki nongsharai balang ki la dem khrup ha khmat uta uba shong halor ka khet , bad mane ïa u , uba im junom la junom . Ki bret ïa ki pansngiat jong ki ha khmat jong ka khet bad ki ong ,
Ka jingklim ka long ka jingriam — ka pyntngit ïa kito kiba U Trai u skei .
translation.en: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit : he that is abhorred of the  Lord  shall fall therein .

Now while he was not yet gone back , he said , Go back also to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan , whom the king of Babylon hath made governor over the cities of Judah , and dwell with him among the people : or go wheresoever it seemeth convenient unto thee to go . So the captain of the guard gave him victuals and a reward , and let him go .
translation.kha: Haba ngam shym la jubab , u Nebusaradan u la ong ,  Khie leit phai pat sha u Gedalaïah , u khun jong u Ahikam bad u ksiew jong u Shaphan , ïa uba u syiem ka Babilonia u la pynlong ïa u , u lat jong ki shnong ka Judah . Phi lah ban sah bad u bad im hapdeng ki briew , lane phi lah ban leit shano shano ba phi pyrkhat ba phi dei ban leit .  Kumta u la ai ïa nga ka jingai sngewbha bad katto katne ka jingbam ban rah bad nga , bad u la shah ïa nga ba ngan leit noh ha la ka lynti .

translation.en: They that be slain with the sword are better than they that be slain with hunger : for these pine away , stricken through for want of the fruits of the field .
translation.kha: Kito kiba la ïap ha ka thma ki la long kiba kham bit ban ïa kito kiba ïap hadien , kiba ïap suki ha ka jingthngan , khlem kano kano ka jingbam ban ri pynim ïa ki .

Nangta , sa hynñiew tylli kiwei pat ki masi kynthei ki wan mih ; ki long kiba raikhoh bad kiba sah sa ka shyiap suda . Ki la ki wan mih pynlang ki la ïing hajan kita kiei pat ki masi kynïan ha ka rudwah ,
translation.en: And , behold , seven other kine came up after them out of the river , ill favoured and leanfleshed  ; and stood by the other kine upon the brink of the river .

translation.kha: u khun jong u Abishua , u khun jong u Phinehas , u khunlung jong u Eleasar , u khun jong u Aaron .
translation.en: The son of Abishua , the son of Phinehas , the son of Eleazar , the son of Aaron the chief priest :

translation.kha: Nangta ka dak U Khun U Briew kan paw ha ka sahit bneng , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin ïam haba ki ïohi ïa U Khun U Briew ba u wan ha ki lyoh bneng ha ka bor Bad ka burom bakhraw .
translation.en: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven : and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn , and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory .

translation.kha: Uba nyngkong u dat ka tuh kum u sing ; uba ar u don ka dur kum u maw kyndong ; uba lai u khong ka durkhmat kum ka durkhmat u briew ; bad uba saw u don ka tuh kumno u sting uba her .
translation.en: And the first beast was like a lion , and the second beast like a calf , and the third beast had a face as a man , and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle .
Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I will stretch out mine hand upon the Philistines , and I will cut off the Cherethims , and destroy the remnant of the sea coast .
translation.kha: Bad kumta nga pynbna ba ngan tur ïaleh ïa ki Philistia bad ban pynjah syndon ïa ki . Ngan pynjot ïa kiba sah baroh kiba dang im ha ki jaka madan ka Philistia .

translation.en: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap , neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed : for it is a year of rest unto the land .
translation.kha: Wat ot ruh ïa u kew uba shu mih hi , bad wat kheit soh na ki dieng sohwaiñ kiba phim shym la khyllad ; ka dei ka snem ban iehnoh shrah ïa ka khyndew .

translation.en: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne , and lay them on men s shoulders  ; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers .
translation.kha: Ki teh pynbah ha ki met jong ki briew ïa ki jingkit kiba khia bad kiba eh ban kit , pynban kim mon bad rah la ki kti ban ïarap ïa ki ban kit ïa kito ki jingkit .

translation.en: And he shall take a wife in her virginity .
translation.kha: Un shongkurim ïa ka theisotti ,
Mynba me la sdang ban ïasaid bad U Blei , u la jubab ïa me . U ieit ïa me , bad kumjuh nga la wan ban ïathuh ïa ka Jobab ha me . Mynta to pynshahshkor katba nga dang batai ïa ka jingïohipaw .
translation.en: At the beginning of thy supplications the commandment came forth , and I am come to shew thee  ; for thou art greatly beloved : therefore understand the matter , and consider the vision .

translation.kha: Pynbna , u la shim ïa u Armoni bad ïa u Hephsibah , ki ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka Rispah , ka khun u Aïah , ba ka la ïew na u Saul ; u shim ruh ïa ki sa ngut ki khun shynriah jong ka Merab , ka khun jong u Saul , ba ka la ïoh na u Adriel u khun jyllang u Barsillai uba na Meholah .
translation.en: But the king took the two sons of Rizpah the daughter of Aiah , whom she bare unto Saul , Armoni and Mephibosheth  ; and the five sons of Michal the daughter of Saul , whom she brought up for Adriel the son of Barzillai the Meholathite :

translation.kha: Ki la phah ktem shiah kylleng ka Jerusalem bad ka Judah ïa baroh pun wallam sha U Trai ïa ka khajna ba u Moses , u shakri U Blei , u la lum nyngkong ha ka ri khlaw .
translation.en: And they made a proclamation through Judah and Jerusalem , to bring in to the  Lord  the collection that Moses the servant of God laid upon Israel in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Shim ar tylli ki mawkordor Karnelian , bun thoh ha ki ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki khun shynrang jong u Jakob ,
translation.en: And thou shalt take two onyx stones , and grave on them the names of the children of Israel :

translation.kha: Kumta u Saul u sangeh ino na kaba thwet ïa u Dabid bad u rupa noh ban ïaleh ïa ki Philistia . Na Katai ka daw , ïa kata ka jaka la khot U Lum ka Jingpynïakhlad .
translation.en: Wherefore Saul returned from pursuing after David , and went against the Philistines : therefore they called that place Sela–hammahlekoth .

translation.kha: To kynroh ïa kane , ko parabangeit ba-ieit jyllang por ! Uwei pa uwei u dei ban long uba kloi ban shahskhor , hynrei umbah suki ban krai bad uba suki ban bitar .
translation.en: Wherefore , my beloved brethren , let every man be swift to hear , slow to speak , slow to wrath :
For which of you , intending to build a tower , sitteth not down first , and counteth the cost , whether he have sufficient to finish it ?
translation.kha: Lada uno uno na phi u thmu ban tei ïa ka jaka ap phira , nyngkong u shong bad u kheiñ ïa ka jinglut , ban khmih la u don bun ka pisa ban pyndep ïa ka kam .

Ryngkat bad kita ki kpu , baroh Phon ïa-ai hynñiew tylli ki khunlangbrot kiba shisnem , uwei u malai lyngraw , malade ar tylli ki langsohmoh ki lai don kano kano ka jingduna . Yn ai ïa ki kum ka jingainguh thang sha U Trai ryngkat bad ka jingainguh ba-ima nabar ka jingainguh dih . Ka jingiwbih lad kane ka jingkñia ka lama kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Trai .
translation.en: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year , and one young bullock , and two rams : they shall be for a burnt offering unto the  Lord  , with their meat offering , and their drink offerings , even an offering made by fire , of sweet savour unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Lymne ym don Un uno u ban theh ïa ka waiñ bathymmai hapoh ki lwa snieh kiba la pyndonkam , namar ki snieh kin pdang bad ka waiñ kan tiduh shabar , bad ïa ki lwa snieh yn pynsniew . Hynrei , ïa ka waiñ ka thymmai la theh noh ha ki lehbha snieh bym pat ju pynbam , dara baroh ar kin neh .
translation.en: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles : else the bottles break , and the wine runneth out , and the bottles perish : but they put new wine into new bottles , and both are preserved .

translation.kha: Ngan ym leh lyndet ïa ki jingbthah jong me , namar da ki me la ri pynim ïa nga .
translation.en: I will never forget thy precepts : for with them thou hast quickened me .
And when he sowed , some seeds fell by the way side , and the fowls came and devoured them up :
translation.kha: Katba u dang bet ïa u symbai ha ka lyngkha , khyndiat na u symbai u la hap ha lynter ka lynti ïaid kjat , bad ki sim ki la wan bad bam noh .

Ko parabangeit Jong nga , nga ïakynduh ïa ka jingïap man la ka sngi! Ka jingsngew sarong kiba nga don ha pa , ha ka jingim jong ngi ha U Khrist Jiw kiba U Trai jong ngi , ka pynlong ïa nga ban pynbna ïa kane .
translation.en: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord , I die daily .
And he cried , A lion : My lord , I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime , and I am set in my ward whole nights :
translation.kha: U nongap phira u pyrta ,  Ko kynrad , nga la ïeng ap phira ha ka kam jong nga mynsngi bad mynmiet .
Ym don ma mian hangno hangno , ym don kam ki nongshong jong ki hima nongwei , kiba la ngeit ba uno uno u jinghiarthma un lah ban rung lyngba ki khyrdop ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: The kings of the earth , and all the inhabitants of the world , would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem .

And the men did the work faithfully : and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah , the Levites , of the sons of Merari  ; and Zechariah and Meshullam , of the sons of the Kohathites , to set it forward  ; and other of the Levites , all that could skill of instruments of musick .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba trei ïa ka kam ki long kiba da sngur hok . La peit bniah halor jong ki da ki saw ngut ki Lebi : u Jahath bad u Obadaïah na ka kur Merari , bad u Sekharaïah bad u Meshullam na ka kur Kohath . ( Ki Lebi ki dei ki nongtem nongput batbit bha . )
kiba shim ïa ki khunlung jong pha badno lynthaw ïa ki ha u mawsiang .
translation.en: Happy shall he be , that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones .

translation.kha: Kumta ki sop da ki jaiñ byrni Sawdong ïa ki jingkit jong ki bad ki tyllai sawdong ïa ki ryndang jong ki , ki leit sha u Ahab sad ino , U shakri jong phi u Benhadad u kyrpad ïa Phi na ka bniat ka jingim jong u . U Ahab u jubab , U dang im ? Ka bha shibun ! U long kum ibha shi per bad nga !
translation.en: So they girded sackcloth on their loins , and put ropes on their heads , and came to the king of Israel , and said , Thy servant Ben–hadad saith , I pray thee , let me live . And he said , Is he yet alive ? he is my brother .
Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts , to dishonour their own bodies between themselves :
translation.kha: Bad kumta U Blei u la ai noh ïa kita ki briew sha ka ban leh ïa kiei kiei kiba jakhlia kiba ki dohnud jong ki , ki kwah , bad ki leh ïa kiei kiei kiba khlemrain para ma ki .

Pyndonburom ïa U Trai U Blei jong pa’ da kambah phi rakhe hynñiew sngi ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ha kata ka khang mane Blei . To lehkmen , namar U Trai u la kyrkhu ïa ki jingmih baroh ba phi la ïoh ot sad ïa ka kam jong phi baroh .
translation.en: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the  Lord  thy God in the place which the  Lord  shall choose : because the  Lord  thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase , and in all the works of thine hands , therefore thou shalt surely rejoice .

translation.kha: Ïa ka khlieh jong ka la shna da ka ksiar banylla kad ; ïa ka shadem bad ki katei jong ka la shna da ka saw ; ïa ka tyngkai bad ka sleh jong ka da ka rong ;
translation.en: This image s head was of fine gold , his breast and his arms of silver , his belly and his thighs of brass ,
So I came to Jerusalem , and was there three days .
translation.kha: Nga ïai bteng ïa ka jingleit sha Jerusalem ,

Te u la leit sha ka ïingsyiem , sha ka kamra u sekretari ka ïingbishar , ha kaba baroh ki rangbah synshar ki dang kein ha ka jingïalang . U Elishama , u sekretari ka ïingbishar , u Delaïah u khun jong u Shemaïah , u Elnathan u khun jong u Habor , u Gemaraïah u khuid jong u Shaphan , u Sekharaïah u khun jong u Hananaïah , bad baïar khiew pat ki rangbah synshar ki la don Hangta .
translation.en: Then he went down into the king s house , into the scribe s chamber : and , lo , all the princes sat there , even Elishama the scribe , and Delaiah the son of Shemaiah , and Elnathan the son of Achbor , and Gemariah the son of Shaphan , and Zedekiah the son of Hananiah , and all the princes .

translation.kha: U Trai u la leh kumjuh na ka bynta ki Edom , ki khun ki ksiew u Ishod , katba shong ha ri lum Edom . U pynim ïa ki Hor , kumta ki Edom ki ïohsngew ïa ka ri jong ki bad ki shongsaiñ hangta haduh mynta .
translation.en: As he did to the children of Esau , which dwelt in Seir , when he destroyed the Horims from before them  ; and they succeeded them , and dwelt in their stead even unto this day :

translation.kha: U Baalah u la ïap bad la tep ïa u ha Tirsah , bad u khun jong u , u Elah u la long sahmiet ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: So Baasha slept with his fathers , and was buried in Tirzah : and Elah his son reigned in his stead .
So the altar shall be four cubits  ; and from the altar and upward shall be four horns .
translation.kha: Kane ka bynta ba-halor , ha kaba ïa ki jingkñia la thang , ka long ruh ar mitar ka jingjrong . Ki reng ha ki saw tylli ki dong ki long kham jrong ban ïa kiwei ha ka bynta ba-halor .
( U rangbah nongap jingri jong u sarew , u Doeg uba na Edom , da kaba jia ryngkhat u anna hangta ha kata ka sngi , namar u haw ban pyndep ïa ka kamram lehniam . )
translation.en: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day , detained before the  Lord   ; and his name was Doeg , an Edomite , the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul .

translation.kha: bad kita ki mar kynthei kiba raikhoh ki la ba-im lut plain ïa kita ki masi kynteit kiba sngaid . Nangta u syiem u la kyndit thiah .
translation.en: And the ill favoured and leanfleshed kine did eat up the seven well favoured and fat kine . So Pharaoh awoke .

translation.kha: Haba Kata ka sngi ka wan , ïa ki nongbah kiba la ïawad bha yn iehnoh bad yn ioh ha ka jingjot jingpra kum ki nongbah kiba ki Hib dara ki Amor ki la iehnoh mynba ki kjit ïaphah na ki paid Israel .
translation.en: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough , and an uppermost branch , which they left because of the children of Israel : and there shall be desolation .

Bring forth with thee every living thing that is with thee , of all flesh , both of fowl , and of cattle , and of every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth  ; that they may breed abundantly in the earth , and be fruitful , and multiply upon the earth .
translation.kha: Shim bad me ïa baroh ki sim bad ki mrad , khnang ba ki lah ban ïaroi bad saphriang kylleng ka khyndew .

translation.en: Then he which had received the one talent came and said , Lord , I knew thee that thou art an hard man , reaping where thou hast not sown , and gathering where thou hast not strawed :
translation.kha: Nangta u shakri uba la ïohpdiang shihajar tylli ki sbai u la wan rung bad u la ong , ‘ Ko kynrad , nga tip ba me long u briew uba eh ; me ot ïa ki jingot na kaba mem shym la bet , bad me lum ïa ki jingthung na kaba mem shym la bet symbai .

Hynrei uta u Briew u la leit bad u la sdang ban pynbyrngia ïa ka khubor kylleng . Ha ka jingshisha , u la ïathuh ha baroh haduh ba U Jehu um lah shuh ban rung shapoh shynrong ha kaba paw paidbah . Hynrei , U la shong noh ha ki jaka kynjah , bad ki briew ki la ïawan sha u na kyllan .
translation.en: But he went out , and began to publish it much , and to blaze abroad the matter , insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city , but was without in desert places : and they came to him from every quarter .

translation.kha: Wat shim kabu ïa kiba duk Teng namar ba phi lah ; wat shim Kaba ïa kito kiba ïeng khlem jingïarap ha ka ïingbishar .
translation.en: Rob not the poor , because he is poor : neither oppress the afflicted in the gate :

translation.kha: Uta Uba pynïap ïa uno uno u jingri u dei baneh buria ïa u , hynrei uta uba pynïap ïa la u parabriew u den ban shah pynïap .
translation.en: And he that killeth a beast , he shall restore it : and he that killeth a man , he shall be put to death .
The Bible alone tells us what we must do to please God .—Psalm 1 :1-3  ; Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 .
translation.kha: Dei tang ka Baibl kaba ïathuh ïa ngi ïa kaei kaba ngi dei ban leh khnang ban pynsngewbha ïa U Blei .—Salm 1 :1-3 ; Isaiah 48 :17 , 18 .
U Blei u la thied ïa phi da ka dor ; kumta to wat long ki mraw jongnga ki briew .
translation.en: Ye are bought with a price ; be not ye the servants of men .
He built Elath , and restored it to Judah , after that the king slept with his fathers .
translation.kha: U Ussaïah u kurup biang bad tei pat ïa ka Elath hadien ka jingïap u kpa jong u .
Nga , U Trai , sam pyllait im ïa baroh ki kynhun ki ksiew jyllang u Jakob , bad kin ai ka jingïaroh ïa nga .
translation.en: In the  Lord  shall all the seed of Israel be justified , and shall glory .
And it shall come to pass , when the  Lord  shall have done to my lord according to all the good that he hath spoken concerning thee , and shall have appointed thee ruler over Israel  ;
translation.kha: Bad haba U  Trai  u la pyndep ïa kiei kiei kiba bha baroh kiba u la kular ïa phi bad ba u la pynlong ïa phi u syiem ki Israel ,
Ha ka sngi U Trai , U mynsngi u la shim ïa nga , bad nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur bajam , kaba sawa khem ka turoi , kaba kren na shadien jong sa .
translation.en: I was in the Spirit on the Lord s day , and heard behind me a great voice , as of a trumpet ,

translation.kha: U Anab u ong ha u Jehoash , Hato ngam shym la ïathuh ïa phoi ba um ju ïathuhlypa ei ei kaba bha ïa nga ? Ka long Borabor kaba snieh !
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , Did I not tell thee that he would prophesy no good concerning me , but evil ?

translation.kha: ban pynthaba ïa kane ka khor ha uwei pa uwei ha Jerusalem , Nga kynmaw Kamon phi la long kiba ïaineh mynba pa’ dang khynñiat , kumno phi la ieit ïa nga mynba I dang shongkurim nyngkong ; phi la bud ïa nga lyngba ka ri shyiap , lyngba ka ri ka bym pat shym la thung jingthung .
translation.en: Go and cry in the ears of Jerusalem , saying , Thus saith the  Lord   ; I remember thee , the kindness of thy youth , the love of thine espousals , when thou wentest after me in the wilderness , in a land that was not sown .

translation.kha: Phi lah thied lympat ka ticket jong phi ?
translation.en: Have you already bought your ticket ?

translation.kha: u da ïawad na Shaei jong ka sharing lum jong ka Beth Hoglah , bad u kput ha ka jaka ba ka wah Jordan ka wan tuid ha ka bynta bashatei jong ka Duriaw Baïap . Une u dei u pduh uba shaphang shaei .
translation.en: And the border passed along to the side of Beth–hoglah northward : and the outgoings of the border were at the north bay of the salt sea at the south end of Jordan : this was the south coast .

translation.kha: Un hap ban iehnoh ïa baher kaba u la dap trei ; un ym ïohlad ban lymne halor ka spah jyllang u ,
translation.en: That which he laboured for shall he restore , and shall not swallow it down : according to his substance shall the restitution be , and he shall not rejoice therein .

translation.kha: Ladan ka long kumta , to ïeng ha la ka burom bad ka jingsarong ; kup ïa lade da ka jingryntih bad ka burom ,
translation.en: Deck thyself now with majesty and excellency  ; and array thyself with glory and beauty .

I will break also the bar of Damascus , and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven , and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden : and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkheiñ ïa ki khyrdop nongbah ka Damaskos , bad ngan weng ïa ki nongshong shnong jong ka Them Aben , bad ïa u nongsynshar ka Betheden . Ki briew ka Syria kin shah ring kum ki koidi sha ri Kir .

translation.en: And , behold , two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus , which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs .
translation.kha: Ha kata kajuh ka sngi , ar ngut na ki nongbud jong U Jisu ki dang leit sha ka shnong kaba kyrteng ka Emmaus , kumba khatwei kilomitar na Jerusalem ,

translation.en: ( But he shall have one tribe for my servant David s sake , and for Jerusalem s sake , the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel : )
translation.kha: U Solomon un ïoh kawei ka jait , na ka bynta u Dabid u shakri jong nga bad na ka bynta ka Jerusalem , ka nongbah ïa kaba nga la jied ban long ka jong nga na ka ri Israel baroh .
Kito naba ap phra ïa ka nongbah ki pyrta , ki pyrta lang da ka jingkmen ! Ki lah ban ïohi da la ki jong ki khmat ïa ka jingwan jong U Trai sha Seruïah !
translation.en: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice  ; with the voice together shall they sing : for they shall see eye to eye , when the  Lord  shall bring again Zion .
Then the king s countenance was changed , and his thoughts troubled him , so that the joints of his loins were loosed , and his knees smote one against another .
translation.kha: U la kylla lieh blaid blaid bad u la sheptieng katta katta ba ki khohsiew jong u ki la sdang ban khynñiuh .
Ym don uwei ruh uba phai sha me ha ka jingduwai ; ym don uwei ruh kiba loit sha me pun ïoh jingïarap . Me la buhrieh ïa laiñ na I bad iehnoh ïa Ngi namar ki pop jong ngi .
translation.en: And there is none that calleth upon thy name , that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee : for thou hast hid thy face from us , and hast consumed us , because of our iniquities .

translation.kha: Lada phi kyntait ban shahshkor sakhi , phi! ñiewbeiñ ïa lade . Lada phi pdiang ïa ka jingpynbeit , phin long kiba hasem stad .
translation.en: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul : but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding .

translation.kha: U Pharaoh u phah kylli ïa kaei kambah la jia bad la ïathiah ba na ki jingri jong ki Israel ym anna satia kaba ïap . Hynrei u dang mutlop hi bad um shah ïa u paidbah ban leit .
translation.en: And Pharaoh sent , and , behold , there was not one of the cattle of the Israelites dead . And the heart of Pharaoh was hardened , and he did not let the people go .

translation.kha: Ki kti uwei pa uwei kin sleh , bad ki khohsiew kin kyiuh .
translation.en: All hands shall be feeble , and all knees shall be weak as water .
Therefore , behold , I will open the side of Moab from the cities , from his cities which are on his frontiers , the glory of the country , Beth–jeshimoth , Baal–meon , and Kiriathaim ,
translation.kha: ngan ai ba yn tur ïaleh ïa ki nongbah kiba ïada ïa ki pud jong ka Moab , kynthup wat ïa ki nongbah bakynsai tam — ka Beth Jeshimoth , ka Baal Meon , bad ka Kiriathaim .

translation.en: Their wine is the poison of dragons , and the cruel venom of asps .
translation.kha: kiba ka waiñ na ki ka long kum ka bih bseiñ .

To ngin leh donakor , kum ki briew kiba im ha ka jingshai jong ka sngi — khlem ki jingsngewbha thala bakhynwin ne ka jingïabuaid , khyllem ka jingleh awria lane ka jingleh khlem akor , khlem ka jingïashoh ïada lane ka jingbishni .
translation.en: Let us walk honestly , as in the day ; not in rioting and drunkenness , not in chambering and wantonness , not in strife and envying .

And a stone was brought , and laid upon the mouth of the den  ; and the king sealed it with his own signet , and with the signet of his lords  ; that the purpose might not be changed concerning Daniel .
translation.kha: Ïa u maw la buh halor ka jaka rung shapoh ka thliew , bad u syiem u la buh ïa ka muhor syiem jong u bad ka jong ki rangbah donburom jong u halor jong u maw , khnang ba yn ym don mano mano ba lah ban pyllait im ïa u Daniel .

Ki la nguh ba ki nongïathuhlypa kim long ei ei hynrei ki pla ïadep lawar bad ba kim don ka khubor na U Terah . U Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh u la ong ha ar , Ko Jeremaïah , namar ba keiñ ki briew ki la kren ïa koum phim ki kiei , ngan pynlong ïa ki keiñ jong nga kum ka ding ha ka shyntur jong me . Ki briew kin lama Kum ka dieng , bad ka dieng kan bam duh ïa ki .
translation.en: Wherefore thus saith the  Lord  God of hosts , Because ye speak this word , behold , I will make my words in thy mouth fire , and this people wood , and it shall devour them .

translation.kha: Wan ïamareh ïa la ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem , kiba na ka jait Lebi , ban ïakylliang malade ïarap ïa me katba me malade ki khun shynrang jong me phi dang ïashakri ha ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi , the tribe of thy father , bring thou with thee , that they may be joined unto thee , and minister unto thee : but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness .
And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead , he fell likewise on the sword , and died .
translation.kha: Haba u samla u ïohi ba u Saul u la ïap , u ruh u rynsied ïa lade ha la ka waitlam bad u ïap .
U bud ïa ka jingleh Jingbymman jong u Syiem Ahab bad khawai pud ki syiem Israhaïah , namar u la sohkhram ïa kawei na ki khun kynthei jong u Abijah , u la leh ngop pyrshah ïa U Trai ,
translation.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel , like as did the house of Ahab : for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife : and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of the  Lord .
And when they had bound him , they led him away , and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor .
translation.kha: Ki la teh ïa u ha ki kynjri , ki la ïalam ïa u , bad ki la aiti ïa u ha u Pilat , u lyngskor ka hima Rom .
Kumta sa long ba ïa ki jingduwai babun na bynta jong ngi yn sa jubab , bad U balui un kyrkhu ïa ngi ; bad Bun kmen kyntiew ïa ki per jingïaroh lad ki sha u ha ka jingainguh na ka bynta jong ngi .
translation.en: Ye also helping together by prayer for us , that for the gift bestowed upon us by the means of many persons thanks may be given by many on our behalf .

translation.kha: Mynta , ha ka sngi ba ka kyllon ino , ki dewlynnong ki khynñiuh , bad ki briew jong ki , ki kyndit ha kata ka jingpynjot .
translation.en: Now shall the isles tremble in the day of thy fall  ; yea , the isles that are in the sea shall be troubled at thy departure .

translation.kha: bad dei namar kata keiñ ba ïa ka jaka la khot ka Bokhim . Hangta ki la ai jinganna ha U Trai .
translation.en: And they called the name of that place Bochim : and they sacrificed there unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: Mynta , ïa kane ka jingmaïan la pynpaw ha ar , ym namar ba nga kham stad ban ïa uno uno wai pat , hynrei khnang ba u syiem Kynrad u lah ban ïoh tip ïa ka jingdam jongnga ka jingphohsniew jong phi bad shemphang ïa ki jingpyrshang kiba la wan ha phi .
translation.en: But as for me , this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living , but for their sakes that shall make known the interpretation to the king , and that thou mightest know the thoughts of thy heart .
And they made their father drink wine that night also : and the younger arose , and lay with him  ; and he perceived not when she lay down , nor when she arose .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la pyndih buaid ïa la u kpa ha kata ka miet ruh , bad kata ka khun kaba ar ka leit ïathiah shongkha bad u . Ha kane ka kynti ruh u la buaid shaba palat kat haduh ba um tip ei ei shaphang kata .
Ki bhabriew kiba la ïohsngew ïa kane ki la kylli , Mano , te , uba haw ban lait im ?
translation.en: And they that heard it said , Who then can be saved ?

translation.kha: Balei iing shu ïai khñium haba la pynshitom ïa ngi na ka bynta ka ngop jongki ngi .
translation.en: Wherefore doth a living man complain , a man for the punishment of his sins ?

translation.kha: Kiba bun na ki , ki la ngeit ïa ka khubor jong u bad la pynbaptis ïa ki , bad kumba lai hajar nguid ki briew la pynpoh sha ka kynjah ha kata ka sngi .
translation.en: Then they that gladly received his word were baptized : and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls .

translation.kha: Ki shipai Philistia ki ïalumlang bad ki wan shekel dara ha Shunem ; u Saul pat u lamwir ïa ki Israel baroh bad ki sher dara ha u Lum Gilboa .
translation.en: And the Philistines gathered themselves together , and came and pitched in Shunem : and Saul gathered all Israel together , and they pitched in Gilboa .
Verily I say unto you , that this generation shall not pass , till all these things be done .
translation.kha: To kynmaw ba kine kiei kiei kin jia shuwa ba ki briew kiba dang im mynta , ki la ïap noh .
Hangta ha khmat jong ki Baïap , kim skhem la lah ban kamet daw ïa u ha kano kano , kumta ki la sngap jar , ki da lyngkhot ha ka jingbabe jrong u .
translation.en: And they could not take hold of his words before the people : and they marvelled at his answer , and held their peace .

And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins : also they have dominion over our bodies , and over our cattle , at their pleasure , and we are in great distress .
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ka ri ka pynmih ka leit sha ki syiem kiba me la buh halor jong ngi namar ba ngi la leh pop . Ki leh katba ki sngewbha ïa ngi bad ïa ki jingri jong ngi , bad ngi don ha ka jinglanot kaba khraw !

U Blei u la pynsat ïa ki khmat jong ki bun u la khang Khyrdop ïa ki jingmut jong ki , ba ki kham jong ki kin ym ïohi , bad ba ki jingmut jong ki kin ym peiphang , dara kin ym phai shiah sa , nguh U Blei , ïa nga ba nur-um pynkhiah ïa ki .
translation.en: He hath blinded their eyes , and hardened their heart  ; that they should not see with their eyes , nor understand with their heart , and be converted , and I should heal them .

translation.kha: U Solomon u la shongkurim hynñiewspah nud ki khun sahmiet kynthei bad laispah ngut ruh ki tnga kliar .
translation.en: And he had seven hundred wives , princesses , and three hundred concubines : and his wives turned away his heart .

translation.kha: phet noh na u briew uba shukor , bad nongap yn ym don shuh ki jingiashah , ka jingïamai lane ka jingsin kyrteng .
translation.en: Cast out the scorner , and contention shall go out  ; yea , strife and reproach shall cease .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , u ong , shim ïa u lyngkhot diengduh bad thoh ha u ïa ki ktien ‘ Ka Hima Judah .’ Nangta shim sa uwei pat u lyngkhot dieng bad tah ha u ïa kine ki ktien : ‘ Ka Hima Israel .’
translation.en: Moreover , thou son of man , take thee one stick , and write upon it , For Judah , and for the children of Israel his companions : then take another stick , and write upon it , For Joseph , the stick of Ephraim , and for all the house of Israel his companions :

translation.kha: Ko parabangeit jong nga , uwei pa uwei na phi u dei ban ïaisah ha ka jingïasyllok malade U Blei ha kata kajuh kumba phi la long mynhynne la khot ïa phi .
translation.en: Brethren , let every man , wherein he is called , therein abide with God .

translation.kha: Ym namar kano kano na ki nang babha kiba ma ngi hi ngi la leh , hynrei namar ka jingisynei jong u hi ba u la pynim ïa moi , lyngba U Mynsiem bakhatduh , uba ai ïa ngi ka jingkha thymmai bad ka jingim kaba Thymmai da kaba sait ïa ngi .
translation.en: Not by works of righteousness which we have done , but according to his mercy he saved us , by the washing of regeneration , and renewing of the Holy Ghost ;
And Gilead , and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites , and all mount Hermon , and all Bashan unto Salecah  ;
translation.kha: Ka kynthup ïa ka Gilead , ki thain jong ka Geshur bad ka Maakah , u Lum Hermon baroh , bad ka Bashan baroh haduh Salekah .

translation.en: And unto man he said , Behold , the fear of the Lord , that is wisdom  ; and to depart from evil is understanding .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ïa ki briew ,  Ban long uba stad , phi dei ban don ka jingtiengburom ïa U  Trai . Ban shemphang , phi dei ban phai noh na kaba sniew .
Haba ki briew ki shah lehbor , ki ud ; ki pyrta ba yn kein Mano mano ban pyllait im ïa ki .
translation.en: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry : they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty .
Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me , that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream .
translation.kha: Nga la hukum ban wallam sha nga ïa baroh ki nongai jingmut jong u syiem ha Babilon khnang ba ki lah ban ïathuh ha nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka jingphohsniew .
Nangne u ong thuh shuh , Balei keiñ , syiem kynrad , ba phi thwet ïa u shakri jongngi phi ? Nga la leh aïu keiñ ? Ka kam palat aïu nga la leh ?
translation.en: And he said , Wherefore doth my lord thus pursue after his servant ? for what have I done ? or what evil is in mine hand ?

translation.kha: U ïai wan kham sha jan , bad haba u la ïohi shai ïa u Abda , u la dap da ka jingbitar shla ïa u namar ba u long tang u khynnah uba saw ngab , kiba phyrnai khmat .
translation.en: And when the Philistine looked about , and saw David , he disdained him : for he was but a youth , and ruddy , and of a fair countenance .

translation.kha: ( Kane ka jia hadien ba u Dabid u la jop ïa u Hadadeser bad u la pynïap ïa ki paralok jong u na Syria . ) U rynsan dara ki rangbah jong u ki leit sad sah ha Damaris , ha kaba ki ïabah jong u ki pynlong ïa u , u syiem ka Syria .
translation.en: And he gathered men unto him , and became captain over a band , when David slew them of Zobah : and they went to Damascus , and dwelt therein , and reigned in Damascus .
Jesus answered ,  Are there not twelve hours in the day ? If any man walk in the day , he stumbleth not , because he seeth the light of this world .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Hato ym don khat-ar kynta ha ka shi sngi ? Kumta uno uno uba ïaid haba dang shai ka sngi un ym jynthut , naba u ïohi ïa ka jingshai jong kane ka pyrthei .
U Trai u la ïai-ong , Ka nongbah Jeroham ka rakhe ïa me , ko Sennakherib , mala ka kyntait beiñ ïa me .
translation.en: This is the word that the  Lord  hath spoken concerning him  ; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee , and laughed thee to scorn  ; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee .

translation.kha: Ki pynmihpat ïa ka Templ ha ka sngi kaba kad jong u bnai Adar ha ka snem kob hynriew jong ka jingsynshar u patsha daladie .
translation.en: And this house was finished on the third day of the month Adar , which was in the sixth year of the reign of Darius the king .
And say , How have I hated instruction , and my heart despised reproof  ;
translation.kha: Balei keiñ ba ngam peiphang ? Balei keiñ ba ngam shah ba kiwei kin pynbeit ïa nga ?
Ki ar ngut ki synran ki la ïohsngew ïa u ba u ong ïa kane bad ki la leit lem bad U Jisu .
translation.en: And the two disciples heard him speak , and they followed Jesus .

translation.kha: U Peor u la shim kyrpang ïa U sharud bad u la sdang ban mai ïa u , U Blei un ym shait ïa kata , ko Trai ! u la ong . Kata kan ym jia da laiñ lei ha me !
translation.en: Then Peter took him , and began to rebuke him , saying , Be it far from thee , Lord : this shall not be unto thee .
Ye have multiplied your slain in this city , and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain .
translation.kha: Phi la pynïap bun bah ki briew hangne hapoh ka nongbah ba ki lynti ki dap da ki metïap .

Haba U Jisu u la ïohsngew ïa kane , u la ong ha u , Dang don sa kawei pat kaei katai kaba me donkam ban leh . Die napoh ïa baroh kaba me don bad ai ïa ka pisa ha kba duk , bad men don ka spah ha bneng ; nangta wan bad bud ïa nga .
translation.en: Now when Jesus heard these things , he said unto him ,  Yet lackest thou one thing : sell all that thou hast , and distribute unto the poor , and thou shalt have treasure in heaven : and come , follow me .

translation.kha: Kumta ha man ba u dabi u don hajan jong ki , u bor mynleh kum u bieit bad leh kum u lamwir haba ki pyrshang ban khang ïa u ; u da pluh ha ki khyrdop ka nongbah Bad u lade ïa ka uba ban jaw ha u ñiuhtmoh jong u .
translation.en: And he changed his behaviour before them , and feigned himself mad in their hands , and scrabbled on the doors of the gate , and let his spittle fall down upon his beard .

translation.kha: Ha kawei pa kawei ka shnong ha ka ri nga la kynting ïa phi sha ka lyer kum ïa u phlangïap . Nga la pynjot ïa phi , ki briew jong nga , nga la pynïap ïa ki khun jong phi namar phim shym sangeh ïa ki rukom basniew jong phi .
translation.en: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land  ; I will bereave them of children , I will destroy my people , since they return not from their ways .
Hath the rain a father ? or who hath begotten the drops of dew ?
translation.kha: Hato u slap lane ka umjer ki don u kpa ?

translation.en: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the  Lord  , and went down to Joppa  ; and he found a ship going to Tarshish : so he paid the fare thereof , and went down into it , to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U Jonah pynban , u la leit sha ka jaka kaba marpyrshah khnang ban phet noh na U  Trai . U la leit sha Joppa , ha kaba u la shem ïa ka liengbah ka ban sa leit sha Spain . U la siew ïa ka bai lynti bad u la rung shapoh ryngkat bad ki nongtrei liengbah kiba leit sha Spain , ha kaba un long jngai na U  Trai .

translation.en: And if thou say in thine heart , How shall we know the word which the  Lord  hath not spoken ?
translation.kha: Phi lah ban lyngngoh kumno phi lah ban ong haba ka khubor u nongïathuhlypa kam shym wan na U  Trai .

translation.en: Burning for burning , wound for wound , stripe for stripe .
translation.kha: kaba ing namar kaba ing , ka jingmong namar ka jingmong , ka jingjngem snam namar ka jingjngem snam .
Ki la ïaid sha shiliang ka dewlynnong sha Paphos , ha kaba ki la ïakynduh ïa aiwai u nongleh mynta uba kyrteng u Bar Jehu , u Jiw uba la kai ba u long u nonghiarthma .
translation.en: And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos , they found a certain sorcerer , a false prophet , a Jew , whose name was Bar–jesus :

For thus hath the  Lord  spoken unto me , Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey , when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him , he will not be afraid of their voice , nor abase himself for the noise of them : so shall the  Lord  of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion , and for the hill thereof .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ha nga ,  Kam pher kumno ki nongaplangbrot ki kynhied bad ki pyrta , kim lah ban pyntieng ïa u sing ba un phet na ka jingri ba u la pynïap ; ha kajuh ka rukom , ym don kano kano kaba lah ban khang ïa nga , U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh na kaba ïada ïa u Lum Seïon .

translation.en: Thus have we obeyed the voice of Jehonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he hath charged us , to drink no wine all our days , we , our wives , our sons , nor our daughters  ;
translation.kha: Ngi la kohnguh ïa baroh ki jingbthah ba u Jonadab u la ai ha ngi . Ma ngi hi ngim ju dih waiñ , lymne ki tnga jong ngi , ki khun shynrang jong ngi , lane ki khun kynthei jong ngi .
ka Hasor Suah , ka Beersheba , ka Bisiothaïah ,
translation.en: And Hazar–shual , and Beer–sheba , and Bizjothjah ,

translation.kha: nongthaw ha ka bynta kaba shaphang mihngi jong ka nongbah , nga leit shaphang shait Sha ka Khyrdop Umpohliew bad ka Pynshitom u Syiem . U kada u ba na shong um da ban shem kano kano ka lynti lyngba ki synrum ,
translation.en: Then I went on to the gate of the fountain , and to the king s pool : but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass .
And the sons of Judah  ; Er , and Onan , and Shelah , and Pharez , and Zerah : but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan . And the sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul .
translation.kha: U Judah bad ki khun shynrang jong u : u Shelah , u Peres , bad u Serah . ( Kiwei pat ki khun shynrang jong u Judah : u Er bad u Onan ki la ïap noh ha Kanaan ) ; ki khun shynrang jong u Peres ki long u Hesron bad u Hamul .

translation.en: Let us therefore , as many as be perfect , be thus minded : and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded , God shall reveal even this unto you .
translation.kha: Ma ngi baroh kiba la ih bha ka jinglong mynsiem , ngi dei ban ïoh ïa kane kajuh ka jingmut . Hynrei lada don napdeng jong phi kiba don da ka jingmut baïapher , U Blei un pynshai ïa kane ha phi .
Ki la lap ïa u Adonijah hangto bad ki ïaleh pyrshah ïa u .
translation.en: And they found Adoni–bezek in Bezek : and they fought against him , and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites .

translation.kha: Wat pynshong jingmut ha kaei kaei baher naba ki brai ki ong — phi lah ban ïohpdiang ba u shakri jongki phi u ibeiñ ïa phira ,
translation.en: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken  ; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee :

translation.kha: Ko ki lap ba-ieit jong to , to wat sngewphylla ïa ka jingtynjuh ba-eh kaba phi shahshitom , kumba kiei kiei kiba khyllah ki wan jia ha phi .
translation.en: Beloved , think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you , as though some strange thing happened unto you :
And others save with fear , pulling them out of the fire  ; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh .
translation.kha: to pyllait im ïa kiwei , da kaba knieh kynthet ïa ki na ka ding ; bad ïa kiwei pat , to isynei da ka jingsheptieng , hynrei to da isih ïa ki jaiñphong jong ki hi , kiba la bit tngit da ki jingkwah brai bapop .

translation.en: And Moses said unto Pharaoh , Glory over me : when shall I entreat for thee , and for thy servants , and for thy people , to destroy the frogs from thee and thy houses , that they may remain in the river only ?
translation.kha: U Moses u phai ktien ,  Ngan da sngewbha eh ban duwai na ka bynta jong phi . Buh da ka por lano nga dei ban kyrpad na ka bynta jong phi , na ka bynta ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong phi , bad na bynta ki briew jong phi . Te phin sa lait na kine ki jakoid , bad kin ym don shuh hangno hangno lait sa tang ha ka wah Nile .

translation.en: But what saith it ? The word is nigh thee , even in thy mouth , and in thy heart : that is , the word of faith , which we preach ;
translation.kha: Kaei kaba ka ong ka long kane :  Ka khubor U Blei ka don hajan jong phi , ha ki rmiang shyntur jong phi bad ha ka dohnud jong phi  — kata , ka khubor jong ka jingngeit kaba ngi ïalap .
Te mynta , ka por ka poi haba ngan phah ïa ki briew ban tbeh noh ïa ka Moab khem ka waiñ . Kin pynthylli ïa ki khra buh waiñ bad pynpait lyngkhot ïa ki .
translation.en: Therefore , behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will send unto him wanderers , that shall cause him to wander , and shall empty his vessels , and break their bottles .

translation.kha: Neng kular ba ngan pynlong ïa kane ka nongbah bad ïa kiba shong ha ka kum ka Topheth .
translation.en: Thus will I do unto this place , saith the  Lord  , and to the inhabitants thereof , and even make this city as Topheth :

translation.kha: Naba ki ktien kiba phin Kren kim dat ki jong phi ; kin wan na U Minnith jong U Kpa jong phi babha kren lyndang jong phi .
translation.en: For it is not ye that speak , but the Spirit of your Father which speaketh in you .

Then said Saul unto his armourbearer , Draw thy sword , and thrust me through therewith  ; lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through , and abuse me . But his armourbearer would not  ; for he was sore afraid . Therefore Saul took a sword , and fell upon it .
translation.kha: U ong ha u samla uba rah atiar jong u ,  Sei ïa la ka waitlam bad dung ïap ïa nga , kumta ba kine ki Philistia bymriewblei kin ym ïoh dung bad pynïap ïa nga .  Hynrei uta u samla u la sheptieng eh ban leh ïa kata . Kumta u Saul u shim ïa la ka waitlam bad u rynsied ïa lade ha ka .

La iehnoh ïa nga mareh hangta , da kaba khmih ïa kane ka jingïohipaw kaba phylla . Ngam dorbar Shu , sad ka durkhmat jyllang de ka la kli dur haduh katta kor ba ym don mano mano ba lah ban ithuh ïa nga .
translation.en: Therefore I was left alone , and saw this great vision , and there remained no strength in me : for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption , and I retained no strength .
Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise , and set him over the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Mynta phi dei ban jied ïa u briew uba stad bad uba shemphang bad thung ïa u ba un peit ïa ka ri .
Ka durkhmat jong u ka la long kum ka leilieh , bad ki jaiñ jongnga u ki lieh kumin ka ïor .
translation.en: His countenance was like lightning , and his raiment white as snow :
Now the chief priests , and elders , and all the council , sought false witness against Jesus , to put him to death  ;
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ka Dorbar baroh kawei ki la pyrshang ban lap ki sabut lamler pyrshah ïa U Jisu ban pynïap ïa u ;

Ma nga , U Trai , len kren ha ki , bad ïa kaei kaba nga ino yn pyndep . Yn ym ni shuh ka jingpyntud . Ha ka por ka jong phoi hi , ko ki nongïeng ïaleh pyrshah , ngan leh ïa kiei kob nga la maham ïa phi ba ngan leh . Nga la kren , ong U Troas Nongsynshar .
translation.en: For I am the  Lord  : I will speak , and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass  ; it shall be no more prolonged : for in your days , O rebellious house , will I say the word , and will perform it , saith the Lord  God .

translation.kha: Ka Por ka la poi ba U Trai u shim noh ïa u Elijah sha bneng ha ka erlangthari . U Isaiah bad u Elisha ki la mihnoh na Gamaliel ,

translation.en: If you are able to spend more time or are limited to less time each week , the Witnesses will make themselves available to help you .

translation.kha: Katba u Samuel u dang im , um shym ïohi shuh ïa u syiem ; hynrei u khuslai sat na ka bynta jong u . U  Trai  u la sngewsih ba u la thung ïa u Saul kum u syiem ki Israel .

Nga twa ka Templ ban ai burom ïa U Trai U Blei jong ar . Kan long ka jaka bakhuid ha kaba ki briew jong nga bad ma nga ngin mane ïa u da kaba thang ki jingñiewbeiñ da ki musla iwbih , bad ha kiba ngin ïai ai ki jingainguh ha u da u kpoh kyntang , bad ha kaba ngin ai ki jingainguh Thang man ka step bad jingmad , kumjuh ruh ha ki sngi Segub , ki Jingrakhe Bnai Thymmai , bad kiwei pateng ki sngi khuid ban ai burom ïa U Trai U Blei jong ngi . U la hukum ïa ki Israel ban leh ïa Kanneh junom la junom .
translation.en: Behold , I build an house to the name of the  Lord  my God , to dedicate it to him , and to burn before him sweet incense , and for the continual shewbread , and for the burnt offerings morning and evening , on the sabbaths , and on the new moons , and on the solemn feasts of the  Lord  our God . This is an ordinance for ever to Israel .

translation.kha: phiah dei ban long ibha khuid ïa at , namar de long U Trai bad nga long suba khuid . Nga la pynkyrpang ïa pa na kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew ba Phon long ki jong ar .
translation.en: And ye shall be holy unto me : for I the  Lord  am holy , and have severed you from other people , that ye should be mine .
Then I said , I am cast out of thy sight  ; yet I will look again toward thy holy temple .
translation.kha: Nga la pyrkhat ba ïa nga la beh noh na ka jingdon ryngkat jong me bad ba ngan ym ïohi shuh lano lano ruh ïa ka Templ bakhuid jong me .

U ong , Baroh ki nongïalam , kiba dei ban smam ïa ki briew jong nga , ki long kiba matlah ! Kim tip ei ei . Ki longsem kum ki sew-ap ki bym ju wiar — ki shu thiah bad phohsniew . Katno ki sngewtynnat ban thiah !
