translation.kha: Ïa ka jingsngewsih jong nga ym lah ban pynkhiah ; nga pang ha ka dohnud .

translation.en: He shall flee from the iron weapon , and the bow of steel shall strike him through .
translation.kha: Haba un pyrshang ban phet ïap na ka waitlam nar , ka ryntieh rnong kan siat ban pynkyllon ïa u .

Lada phin pynmong ïa la u parabangeit namar katei kaba phi bam , te phim leh shuh na ka jingbeit . To wat ai ba ka jingbah kaba Phi bam kad pynsniew ïa u briew ïa uba U Khreh u la ïap na ka bynta jong u!
translation.en: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat , now walkest thou not charitably . Destroy not him with thy meat , for whom Christ died .

translation.kha: Ma phi hi phi long kata ka shithi ba ngi don , ïa kaba la thoh ha ki dohnud jong i khnang ba baroh kin tipthuh malade kin pule .
translation.en: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts , known and read of all men :

translation.kha: Ka bneng nabar ka pyrthei kin leit noh , hynrei ki keiñ jong nga kin ym leit ino da lei lei .
translation.en: Heaven and earth shall pass away , but my words shall not pass away .

translation.kha: U la alos ïa phi ban ïohsngew ïa ka ktien jongnga u na bneng khnang ba u da ba hikai ïa phi ; bad Hangne ha pyrthei u la ailad ba phira Iohi ïa ka ding katba kyntang jong u , bad u la kruiñ ha phi na ka .
translation.en: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice , that he might instruct thee : and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire  ; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire .

translation.kha: Shim ïa ki ut jong ki bad ïa baroh ki jingri jong ki ! Ngan pynsakma shaei ki liang baroh ba wer ki bynriew bakha la khak lyngkot ïa la ki shñiuh , bad ngan ïam ka jingjot ha ki na ki liang baroh .
translation.en: And their camels shall be a booty , and the multitude of their cattle a spoil : and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners  ; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof , saith the  Lord .
And all the vessels of the house of God , great and small , and the treasures of the house of the  Lord  , and the treasures of the king , and of his princes  ; all these he brought to Babylon .
translation.kha: U syiem ka Babilonia u lute ïa ka Templ , ïa ka ïing jingkynshew ka Templ , bad ka spah jong u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u , bad u kit baroh sha Babilon .
Kumta na kyrmen ba U Trai un lap ïa nga ïahap nga synran ïa la u syiad sha ka palat u Rimmon , u blei Syria , bad mane ïa u . Da shisha U Trai un map ïa nga !
translation.en: In this thing the  Lord  pardon thy servant , that when my master goeth into the house of Rimmon to worship there , and he leaneth on my hand , and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon : when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon , the  Lord  pardon thy servant in this thing .

translation.kha: Nangne u Jehosheba u hukum ïa ki nongïalam
translation.en: Then Joshua commanded the officers of the people , saying ,

translation.kha: Nangta nga la iohsngew ïa ka sur na ka duwan kaba ong , Ko Trai uba U Blei badonbok Baroh ! Kabbon shisha bad kaba hok ki longkmie da shisha ki jingbishar jong me !
translation.en: And I heard another out of the altar say , Even so , Lord God Almighty , true and righteous are thy judgments .
And they left the house of the  Lord  God of their fathers , and served groves and idols : and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem for this their trespass .
translation.kha: Kumta ki paidbah ki sangeh noh ban mane ha ka Templ jong U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki , bad ki sdang ban mane ïa ki bleithaw bad ïa ki dur jong ka blei Asherah . Ka jingrem jong ki namar kine ki pop ka la wallam ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  halor ka ha Judah bad ka Jerusalem .
Mynta khie leit shai la ka kam ! Yn ym ai phlangïap shuh ïa phira , hynrei phi dei ban pynmih katjuh ki maw-it .
translation.en: Go therefore now , and work  ; for there shall no straw be given you , yet shall ye deliver the tale of bricks .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba stem kaweh long ka sngem kaba arphew lai jong u bnai uba hynñiew , u Salmunna u phah noh ïa ki briew sha la ïing . Ki la kmen ïa baroh ki jingkyrkhu ba U Trai’ u la ai ha ki briew jong u ki Jesreel , ha u Dabid bad ha u Solomon .
translation.en: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents , glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the  Lord  had shewed unto David , and to Solomon , and to Israel his people .

translation.kha: Ko khun u briew , to ud kumba ka dohnud jong me ka la pait ha ka jingjynjar . To ud da ka jingsngewsih ha kaba barhem kin ïakhmih ïa me .
translation.en: Sigh therefore , thou son of man , with the breaking of thy loins  ; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes .

translation.kha: Bad u ïaiban u ong , Ai ba ktang ngat bad suk ha ki jingkhawai jong ki ; ai ba ktien kyllon , ai ba kine shah pynshitom!
translation.en: And David saith , Let their table be made a snare , and a trap , and a stumblingblock , and a recompence unto them :

translation.kha: Ka turoi ka riew bad baroh ki la pynkhreh . Hynrei ym don uwei ruh uba leit sha ka thma , naba ka jingbitar jong U Blei ka long halor baroh kumjuh .
translation.en: They have blown the trumpet , even to make all ready  ; but none goeth to the battle : for my wrath is upon all the multitude thereof .

translation.kha: Ngam pha pyrshah ïa phi , te phin shahjop ha ki nongshun jong phi , bad eit kiba ph isih kin synshar ba-halor jong phi ; phin sngewsheptieng haduh katta katta ba phin kjit ïaw ibha ym don ba beh ïa phi .
translation.en: And I will set my face against you , and ye shall be slain before your enemies : they that hate you shall reign over you  ; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you .

translation.kha: Ha ka step kaba bud u Jonathan u leit sha ki bri ban ïakynduh ïa U Dabid kumba u la ïakut . U ïalam ïa uwei u khynnah jingkam bad u ,
translation.en: And it came to pass in the morning , that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David , and a little lad with him .

translation.kha: U Petros u la bud na jngai , haduh ka phla jong ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh . U la leit shapoh ka phyllaw bad u la shong lakam bad ki nongap byndi ban khmih kumno kan ia baroh .
translation.en: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest s palace , and went in , and sat with the servants , to see the end .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba trei ïa ka kam ki long kiba da sngur hok . La peit bniah halor jong ki da ki saw ngut ki Lebi : u Jahath bad u Obadaïah na ka kur Merari , pynlang u Sekharaïah pynlang u Meshullam na ka kdew khoh . ( Ki Lebi ki den ki nongtih nongput batbit ibha . )
translation.en: And the men did the work faithfully : and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah , the Levites , of the sons of Merari  ; and Zechariah and Meshullam , of the sons of the Kohathites , to set it forward  ; and other of the Levites , all that could skill of instruments of musick .

translation.kha: Phin sngew ruma phi don halor ka duriaw-rit , pa ïohpang duriaw , shah pynshad kynthei shajrong ha ka jingshah pynkhih ka liengbah .
translation.en: Yea , thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea , or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast .

translation.kha: U la ïalam ïa la ki briew lyngba ka ri shyiap ; ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: To him which led his people through the wilderness : for his mercy endureth for ever .
Son of man , set thy face against the Ammonites , and prophesy against them  ;
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  to kren pyrshah ïa ka ri ki Ammon .

translation.en: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins .
translation.kha: Namar ka snam ki masi kyrtong bad ki blang kan ym lah ban kit noh ïa ki pop .

Haba u syiem Ahasaïah u ïohi ïa kaei kaba la jia , kumne u phet ïa-ïap ha la ka kali ïapom sha ka shnong Beh Haggan , ba la beh kthong da u Jehu . Pynïap ïa u ruh ! U Jehu u la hukum ïa ki rangbah lad u , bad ki la pynmynsaw ïa u katba u dang ñiah ïa ka kali ïapom jong u ha ka lynti kaba kew sha Gur kaba hajan ka shnong Leummim . Khenani u la ïohlad ban nang leit tad haduh ba un da poi ha ka nongbah Megiddo , ha kaba u ïap .
translation.en: But when Ahaziah the king of Judah saw this , he fled by the way of the garden house . And Jehu followed after him , and said , Smite him also in the chariot . And they did so at the going up to Gur , which is by Ibleam . And he fled to Megiddo , and died there .

translation.kha: Jied khar ngut ki rangbah , wai na kawei kawei ka jaiñ-da ,
translation.en: Take you twelve men out of the people , out of every tribe a man ,

translation.kha: Wat ai ba ka jingweng bashaniah bad bahynñiew kin iehnoh ïa phi . teh ïa ki sawdong ka ryndang jong phi ; thoh ïa ki ha ka doh jong phi .
translation.en: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee : bind them about thy neck  ; write them upon the table of thine heart :
English
translation.kha: Khasi
Nga la ïohi ïa ki briew ba ki mluh ïa ki lyngkha jong ka jingsniew bad ki bet ïa ka jingbymman kum u syiem ; mynta ki ot da ka jingbitsnam badno ka jingkyntiew .
translation.en: Even as I have seen , they that plow iniquity , and sow wickedness , reap the same .

translation.kha: Mynta hangne u don u symboh uba phi la jied ; phi la pan ïa u , bad mynta U Trai u la ai ïa u ha phi .
translation.en: Now therefore behold the king whom ye have chosen , and whom ye have desired ! and , behold , the  Lord  hath set a king over you .

translation.kha: Yn aiti nong ïa u ha u syiem ka Babilonia ; un peit ïa u markhmat bad un krong ïa u hi da lade .
translation.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans , but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon , and shall speak with him mouth to mouth , and his eyes shall behold his eyes  ;
But who am I , and what is my people , that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort ? for all things come of thee , and of thine own have we given thee .
translation.kha: Pynban ki briew jong nga bad ma nga ngim lah shisha ban ai ei ei ïa me , namar kaei kaei baroh ka dei ka jingai sngewbha jong me , bad ngi la ai biang sha me ïa kaei kaba dei ka jong me hi .

translation.en: But the  Lord  of hosts shall be exalted in judgment , and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  Badonbor Baroh u pyn-i ïa ka jingkhraw jong u da kaba leh ïa kaba dei , bad u pynpaw ïa ka jingkhuid jong u da kaba bishar ïa la ki briew .

Phi khmih lyndet ba ka Ijipt kan ïarap ïa phi , hynrei kata kan longkmie kumba pyndonkam ïa u khah kum u diengduh — un kdiah bad un dung ïa ka kti jong phi . katai ka dei kaei kaba u syiem ka jingïaphet u long haba mynno mano ki shano tylli ha u .
translation.en: Now , behold , thou trustest upon the staff of this bruised reed , even upon Egypt , on which if a man lean , it will go into his hand , and pierce it : so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him .

His substance also was seven thousand sheep , and three thousand camels , and five hundred yoke of oxen , and five hundred she asses , and a very great household  ; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east .
translation.kha: U don ruh shibun ngut ki shakri bad u la long u briew bariewspah tam ha ka ri Mihngi .

translation.en: And he beheld them , and said ,  What is this then that is written , The stone which the builders rejected , the same is become the head of the corner ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la khmih sha ki bad u la kylli ,  Aïu , te , kane ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka kit jingmut ?   ‘ U maw ïa uba ki nongtei ki la kyntait kum u bymmyntoi u la kylla long uba donkam tam na baroh .’

translation.en: Thy dead men shall live , together with my dead body shall they arise . Awake and sing , ye that dwell in dust : for thy dew is as the dew of herbs , and the earth shall cast out the dead .
translation.kha: Kito kiba dei napdeng ki briew jong ngi kiba la ïap kin im biang ! Ki met jong ki kin wan phai biang sha ka jingim . Baroh kito kiba ïohthiah ha ki jingtep jong ki kin kyndit thiah bad kin rwai namar ka jingkmen . Kumba ka umjer baphyrnai ka pynthymmai bor ïa ka khyndew , kumta ruh U  Trai  un pynkhie im pat ïa kito kiba la ïap la slem .
Uta u briew u la ïalam ïa to sha ka khyrdop kaba pah shaphang mihngi ,
translation.en: Afterward he brought me to the gate , even the gate that looketh toward the east :

And I commanded you at that time , saying , The  Lord  your God hath given you this land to possess it : ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel , all that are meet for the war .
translation.kha: Nangta nga ai ruh ha ki ïa kine ki jingbthah : ‘ U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi u la ai ïa kane ka ri kaba sha mihngi na Jordan ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka . Mynta pat , pynkieng atiar ïa ki rangïapom jong phi bad phah ïa ki sha shiliang ka Jordan ha shuwa kiwei pat ki jait Israel ban ïarap ïa ki ban ïohkynti ïa ka bynta jong ki de .
Baroh kaba jia ha kane ka Pyrthei ka jia ha ka por kaba U Blei u jied .
translation.en: To every thing there is a season , and a time to every purpose under the heaven :

translation.kha: U Hamor u kop jong u Shekhem u la leit ban ïakren bad u Jakob , hamar ba ki khun shynrang lad u Jakob ki la wan phai na ki pyntha .
translation.en: And Hamor the father of Shechem went out unto Jacob to commune with him .

translation.kha: kim don ei ei shuh ban ai jingmut haba nga la dep kren . Ki ktien jong nga ki ngam kum ki jingjaw jong u slap ;
translation.en: After my words they spake not again  ; and my speech dropped upon them .
And he said , Blessed be the  Lord  God of Israel , which spake with his mouth unto David my father , and hath with his hand fulfilled it , saying ,
translation.kha: U ong ,  Ïaroh ïa U  Trai  U Blei ki Israel ! uba la bat ïa la ka kular ba u la pynlong bad u Dabid u kpa jong nga , mynba u ong ,

translation.en: Desire not the night , when people are cut off in their place .
translation.kha: Wat kwah ba ka miet kan wan , ka por ha kaba ki jaitbynriew kin duh noh .
U Trai U Nongsynshar badonburom Bahok u la ïong ïa nga ban leit sha u Shebna , u nongpynïaidkam ha ka longïing syiem , Bad ong ha u ,
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God  of hosts , Go , get thee unto this treasurer , even unto Shebna , which is over the house , and say ,

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la ïathuh ha ki ïa kane ka pharshi : La don shisien u briew uba riewpaidbah uba ne ka jaka kaba la pynmih khiar ki jingthung .
translation.en: And he spake a parable unto them , saying ,  The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully :

translation.kha: Nga kylli ïa phi , hato ka long kaba dei ba u Briew un shahshkor ïa U Blei ? Ha ka jingshisha ym dei , pynban phi shukor ïa nga . ‘ Da kumta ?’ phi kylli . Ha kaba ïadei shaphang kawei-na-kaba-shiphew bad ki jingainguh .
translation.en: Will a man rob God ? Yet ye have robbed me . But ye say , Wherein have we robbed thee ? In tithes and offerings .
So Joshua sent messengers , and they ran unto the tent  ; and , behold , it was hid in his tent , and the silver under it .
translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua u phah katto katne ngut ki rangbah kiba mareh sha ka ïingjaiñ bad ki shem ba kita ki mar ba la shah kyntait la tep shisha hangta , bad ka rupa ha trai .

translation.en: They have made all thy ship boards of fir trees of Senir : they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make masts for thee .
translation.kha: Ki pyndonkam ïa ki dieng Kseh-Phir na u lum Hermon kum ki dieng shna ïing . Bad ïa ki dieng Kedar na Lebanon na ka bynta ki dieng sieh lama .

translation.en: And when the child was grown , it fell on a day , that he went out to his father to the reapers .
translation.kha: Katto katne snem hadien , ha ka aïom ot , u khynnah u la mih shabar ha kawei ka step ban leit sha la u kpa jong u , uba don ha lyngkha lem bad ki nongot kew .

translation.en: Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar : and they filled a sponge with vinegar , and put it upon hyssop , and put it to his mouth .
translation.kha: La don ka pliang hangta , kaba dap da ka waiñ ka bym bha ; kumta la wieh ïa spoiñ ha ka waiñ , la teh ha ka khum Hissop , bad la kyntiew ha ki rmiang shyntur jong u .

U la pyndem ïa phi , u la pynshahthngan ïa phi , bad dadien kata u la ai ha phi ïa ka manna ban bam , ka jingbam kaba ma phi bad ki kpa tymmen jong phi phim pat ju ïoh mynno mynno . Ban hikai ïa phi ba u briew um im tang da u kpu hynrei da ka ktien baher kaba mih na U Trai .
translation.en: And he humbled thee , and suffered thee to hunger , and fed thee with manna , which thou knewest not , neither did thy fathers know  ; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only , but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the  Lord  doth man live .

translation.kha: Hynrei u kpa Jong u , u kyrngah , bad u ong , Nga tip , khun ; nga Tip . Ki khun ki ksiew jong u Manasseh mad kin sa kylla long ka jaitbynriew kaba khraw . Hynrei u para jong u un kham khraw ba ïa u , bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin kylla long ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw .
translation.en: And his father refused , and said , I know it , my son , I know it : he also shall become a people , and he also shall be great : but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he , and his seed shall become a multitude of nations .

Then she said , Let me find favour in thy sight , my lord  ; for that thou hast comforted me , and for that thou hast spoken friendly unto thine handmaid , though I be not like unto one of thine handmaidens .
translation.kha: Ka Ruth ka jubab ,  Kynrad , phi la lehsbun shibun ïa nga . Phi la pynlong ïa nga ban kham sngewbiang da kaba kren jem jai jai ïa nga , wat la ngam ïaryngkat kyrdan bad kawei na ki shakri jong phi .
Kiba hok ki ïoh ïa kaei kaba ki thrang , hynrei ki riewbymman ki ïoh ïa kata kaba ki sheptieng eh .
translation.en: The fear of the wicked , it shall come upon him : but the desire of the righteous shall be granted .

translation.kha: Ki synran ki la kylli ïa u , Hangta , ko Trai ? U Jehu u la jubab , Hangno hangno ha kaba don ka metïap , ki pukni kin ïalum hangta .
translation.en: And they answered and said unto him , Where , Lord ? And he said unto them ,  Wheresoever the body is , thither will the eagles be gathered together .
Then hear thou in heaven , and do , and judge thy servants , condemning the wicked , to bring his way upon his head  ; and justifying the righteous , to give him according to his righteousness .
translation.kha: A  Trai  , to shahshkor na bneng bad bishar ïa ki shakri jong me . Pynshitom ïa uta u nongleh palat kumba ka dei hok ïa u ban ïoh , bad pynksan ïa uta uba lui lui .

Lymda kumto ka la dem ïa u ban shah bunktien naduh myn ïalang long ka pyrthei . Pynban , mynta haba ka por baroh ka la jan poi shwa kaba kut , u la thop tang shisien hi , banbeiñ pyndait napoh ïa ka ngop da kaba kñia ïa lade .
translation.en: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world : but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself .
Yet the  Lord  would not destroy Judah for David his servant s sake , as he promised him to give him alway a light , and to his children .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  um mon ban pynjot ïa ka Judah , namar ba u la kular ïa u Dabid u shakri jong u ba ki khun ki ksiew jong u kin ïai bteng ban synshar .

translation.en: And Saul said , There shall not a man be put to death this day : for to day the  Lord  hath wrought salvation in Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Saul u ong ,  Ym dei ban pynïap ïano ïano ha kane ka sngi , naba kane ka dei ka sngi ba U  Trai  u la pyllait im ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: And he said , When ye do the office of a midwife to the Hebrew women , and see them upon the stools  ; if it be a son , then ye shall kill him : but if it be a daughter , then she shall live .
translation.kha: Haba phi ïarap pynkha ïa ki kynthei Hebru , bad phi ïohi ba u dei u shynrang , pynïap ïa u ; hynrei lada dei ka kynthei , ai kan im .
na ka bynta Kawei kawei ka sharak bad uwei uwei u diengpynïeng sharak ,
translation.en: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold , and for their lamps of gold , by weight for every candlestick , and for the lamps thereof : and for the candlesticks of silver by weight , both for the candlestick , and also for the lamps thereof , according to the use of every candlestick .

translation.kha: U Trai da put hi un ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi , bad ïa phi yn sa lute da ki briew kiba shisien ki la longsyiem ki shakor jong phi . Haba kane ka jia , uwei uwei Baroh un tip ba U Tharai Badonbor Baroh u la phah ïa nga .
translation.en: For , behold , I will shake mine hand upon them , and they shall be a spoil to their servants : and ye shall know that the  Lord  of hosts hath sent me .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka kmie ka la ong , Em ! Ka ktung Jong u ka dei ban long u Ïoannis .
translation.en: And his mother answered and said , Not so  ; but he shall be called John .

translation.kha: Anab U Blei um shym la pynlur ïa ka jingmad jong u shaphang jongno ba u iaid bad u kerkut .
translation.en: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance .

translation.kha: “Phi ïatip ba ngam smam la buhrieh ïa kano kano ka ban long ka jingpynhiar ïa phi haba nga ïalap bad hikai ha ki baïap bad ha ki ïing jong phi .
translation.en: And how I kept back nothing that was profitable unto you , but have shewed you , and have taught you publickly , and from house to house ,

translation.kha: Ki um ki ïadait biang bad ki la sawlep ïa ki kali ïapom , ïa ki nongñiah , bad ïa ka kynhun shipai barieh jong u Pharaoh kaba la buddien ïa ki Israel sha duriaw , ym don kawei ruh na ki ïa kaba la iehnoh .
translation.en: And the waters returned , and covered the chariots , and the horsemen , and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them  ; there remained not so much as one of them .

translation.kha: U dei ban long uba batskhem ïa ka khubor kaweh lah shun shaniah bad kaba ïadei badno ka jinghikai shongtynrai . Ha kane ka rukom un lah ban ai mynsiem ïa kiwei da ka jingaiei bashisha bad ban pyn-i ruh ïa ka jingbakla jong kito kiba ïeng marpyrshah ïa ka .
translation.en: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught , that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers .
Behold , here is my daughter a maiden , and his concubine  ; them I will bring out now , and humble ye them , and do with them what seemeth good unto you : but unto this man do not so vile a thing .
translation.kha: Khmih ! Hangne ka don ka tnga kliar jong u bad ka khun jong nga , kaba dang sotti . Ngan wan ïalam ïa ki mynta shabar , bad phi lah ban shim ïa ki . Leh ïa ki katba phi sngewkwah . Hynrei wat leh ïa ka kam bymman ha une u briew !

translation.en: All the while my breath is in me , and the spirit of God is in my nostrils  ;
translation.kha: katba U Blei u dang ai ïa nga ka jingpynhiar mynsiem ,

Shadkmen ha khamtam jong u hangta , lema bun ki khun ki ktha jyllang phi , ki shakri shakor jong phi , bad ki Lebi kiba shong ha ki shang jong phi ; to kynmaw ba ki Lebi kim don bri kein khyndew la ka jong .
translation.en: And ye shall rejoice before the  Lord  your God , ye , and your sons , and your daughters , and your menservants , and your maidservants , and the Levite that is within your gates  ; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you .

translation.kha: U Moses u long uba lah pun shaniah ha ka ïing U Balei kum u shakor , bad u kren ïa kaei kiei uba U Blei un sa kren-ïa ha ki por ki ban sa wan .
translation.en: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house , as a servant , for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after  ;

translation.kha: Kumta U Trai u ong ha nga , ‘ Ki la kyrpad ïa kaba dei eh .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto me , They have well spoken that which they have spoken .
And great earthquakes shall be in divers places , and famines , and pestilences  ; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven .
translation.kha: Yn don ki jingkhynñiuh jumai kiba shyrkhei , ki  nemsniew , bad ki khlam ha kylleng kylleng ; kin don kiei kiei kiba phylla bad kiba pyntriem kiba wan na sahit bneng .

Ko ki brup jong nga , wat ym sheptieng ; ko ki paid Israel , woh ym sngewshyrkhei . Ngan pyllait im ïa phi na kata ka ri bajngum , na ka ri ha kaba Phi long ki kyrdoh . Phin wan blei pat sha ïing badno im ha ka jingsuk ; phin shngain , nabar yn ym don mano mano don pynkyrpang ïa phi .
translation.en: Therefore fear thou not , O my servant Jacob , saith the  Lord   ; neither be dismayed , O Israel : for , lo , I will save thee from afar , and thy seed from the land of their captivity  ; and Jacob shall return , and shall be in rest , and be quiet , and none shall make him afraid .

translation.kha: Ha kawei ka miet u shem Belshassar u la khot sngewbha shisien ngut ki rangbah burom sha ka jingkhawai kaba khraw , bad ki la ïadih waiñ lang .
translation.en: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords , and drank wine before the thousand .

translation.kha: U hajuh ia ka kam jong u lyngba ka jingbymshimkhia jong u .
translation.en: He lost his job through his irresponsibility .

translation.kha: Shi lyndet ka jingim jong u , u leh ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa U Tlai , namar u Jehoïada u lyngdoh u la hikai ïa u .
translation.en: And Jehoash did that which was right in the sight of the  Lord  all his days wherein Jehoiada the priest instructed him .

translation.kha: U syiem Manoah u la leh ïa kine kiei kiei kiba ijli , kiei kiei kiba kham sniew ban ïa kaei kaba ki nong Kanaan ki la lai , sad ryngkat bad ki bleithaw jong u , u la ïalam ïa ki briew jong ka —Judah ban lai ngop .
translation.en: Because Manasseh king of Judah hath done these abominations , and hath done wickedly above all that the Amorites did , which were before him , and hath made Judah also to sin with his idols :

translation.kha: Tahan ki la pyrshang ban ai ïa u ïa ka waiñ ba la khleh bad ka jingdih ba la khot ka mirr , hynrei U Jisu um dih ïa ka .
translation.en: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh : but he received it not .

translation.kha: Hynñiew sngem hadien ba ka kynthei ka kha khun shajrong , kan long ka bymkhuid , kumba ka long ha ka par ba ka poi bnai .
translation.en: Speak unto the children of Israel , saying , If a woman have conceived seed , and born a man child : then she shall be unclean seven days  ; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean .

translation.kha: Hynrei lada uno uno u kyntait ïa nga ha kaba paw , len kyntait ïa u ha khmat U Kpa jong nga wahbah ha bnoh .
translation.en: But whosoever shall deny me before men , him will I also deny before my Father which is in heaven .

translation.kha: Ïa kano kano ka doh kaban law rahah ka sngi kaba na dat ban thang noh ïa ka .
translation.en: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire .
Which were clothed with blue , captains and rulers , all of them desirable young men , horsemen riding upon horses .
translation.kha: Ki long ki shipai ha ka riam shipai ba rong jngum , ki riew kynsai bad ki rangbah shipai bahakhlieh ; baroh na ki , ki long ki samla shipai ba-bhabriew .

translation.en: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him , but slew his son . And when he died , he said , The  Lord  look upon it , and require it .
translation.kha: U syiem u la klet ïa ka jingshakri bahok ba u Jehoïada , u kpa jong u Sekharaïah u la ai ïa u , bad u la phah pynïap ïa u Sekharaïah . Shuwa ba u Sekharaïah un ïap , u pyrta ,  Ai ba U  Trai  un ïohi ïa kaei kaba phi leh bad un pynshitom ïa phi !
Ki long kiba bymman haduh mawria katta ; ot ïa ki kumne ïa u kew ha ka aïom ot ; pynlwet ïa ki kumto ïa ki sohwaiñ ha ka jaka pynmih umsoh haduh ba ka umsoh ka shlei .
translation.en: Put ye in the sickle , for the harvest is ripe : come , get you down  ; for the press is full , the fats overflow  ; for their wickedness is great .

And Moses said unto them , If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan , every man armed to battle , before the  Lord  , and the land shall be subdued before you  ; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession :
translation.kha: Lada ki rangbah na ka jait Gad bad ka jait Reuben ki jam sha shiliang ka Jordan kiba la kloi ban ïaleh thma ha ka hukum jong U  Trai  bad lada da ka jingïarap jong ki phi lah ban jop ïa ka ri , te ai ha ki ïa ka ri Gilead kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .

translation.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold , and couple the curtains together with the taches : and it shall be one tabernacle .
translation.kha: Thaw ruh sanphew tylli ki jingpyndait kiba da ka ksiar , bad pynïasoh ïa ki jingkah da kita ki jingpyndait ba kin long tang kawei .

translation.en: That which was from the beginning , which we have heard , which we have seen with our eyes , which we have looked upon , and our hands have handled , of the Word of life  ;
translation.kha: Ngi thoh sha phi shaphang U Ktien ka jingim , uba la don naduh kaba mynnyngkong eh . Ngi la ïohsngew ïa u , bad ngi la ïohi ïa u da la ki khmat ; ho-oid , ngi la ïohi ïa u , bad ki kti jong ngi ki la ïohktah ïa u .

translation.en: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies , and of all the truth , which thou hast shewed unto thy servant  ; for with my staff I passed over this Jordan  ; and now I am become two bands .
translation.kha: Ngam long uba bit dor ban ïohpdiang ïa baroh ka jinglehisynei bad ka jingieit baïaineh ba me la pynpaw ha nga , u shakri jong me . Nga la jam ïa ka wah Jordan tang bad u diengduh jong nga , bad mynta pat nga la wan phai bad kine ar ki kynhun .
Kan shngiam por ïa ki Israel hynñiew bnai ban tep ïa ki metïap baroh bun ïa-ban pynlong khuid pat ïa ka ri .
translation.en: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them , that they may cleanse the land .

translation.kha: U Blei! un leh ïa kaei katba dei : Un wallam ka jingshah shitaiew ha kito kiba pynpang ïa phi shun shahshitom ,
translation.en: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you ;

translation.kha: Nangta u ong ha ka , Wallam ïa kito ki kpu hangne ha ka jingthiah jong nga badno pyntian ïa nga da ma phi hi . Ka la shim ïa ki kpu bad ka la leit sha u .
translation.en: And Amnon said unto Tamar , Bring the meat into the chamber , that I may eat of thine hand . And Tamar took the cakes which she had made , and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother .
To execute upon them the judgment written : this honour have all his saints . Praise ye the  Lord .
translation.kha: ban pynshitom ïa ki jaitbynriew kumba U Blei u la hukum . Kane ka long ka jingjop jong ki briew jong U Blei . To ïaroh ïa U  Trai  !
Kaei kaba ka jinglong ba kynjoh briew ka leh ka long ka paw shynna . Ka pynpaw ïa lade ha ka klim , ka jingbymkhuid , bad ki jingsuh khlem akor ;
translation.en: Now the works of the flesh are manifest , which are these ; Adultery , fornication , uncleanness , lasciviousness ,

translation.kha: Ym don jingthaw ba-im ba la ban ïohi ïa ka , ym don , wat ka Da kaba her .
translation.en: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living , and kept close from the fowls of the air .

translation.kha: U Tlai un wallam ïa phi Sha ka ri ki Kanaan ïa kaba u la kulmar shem ha phi! bad ha ki kpa tymmen jyllang phi .
translation.en: And it shall be when the  Lord  shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites , as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers , and shall give it thee ,

translation.kha: U Abraham u longing peiñ patan sha la ki shakri , bad ki ïaleit lang sha Beersheba , ha kaba u Absalom u shongneh hangta .
translation.en: So Abraham returned unto his young men , and they rose up and went together to Beer–sheba  ; and Abraham dwelt at Beer–sheba .

translation.kha: U jingkam u jubab , Ïa kano kano kaba phi kwah don leh , nga kein lem bad pa .
translation.en: And his armourbearer said unto him , Do all that is in thine heart : turn thee  ; behold , I am with thee according to thy heart .

translation.kha: To wallam ka jingïabam halor kito kiba pynshitom beiñ ïa nga , hynriew pyllait im ïa nga , A Trai . Pynnep ïa ki da ka jingshyrkhei , hynrei thew pynkynroi ïa por . To ïam ka jingjot ha ki bad pynkdiah lyngkhot ïa ki .
translation.en: Let them be confounded that persecute me , but let not me be confounded : let them be dismayed , but let not me be dismayed : bring upon them the day of evil , and destroy them with double destruction .

translation.kha: Nangta ha ka Khyrdop Ba-itynnat , kumba la ju khot ïa ka , la don u briew uba la dkoh baroh shi jingim . Leit ka sngi la ju bah ïa u shai ka Khyrdop ban khrong pisa na ki Briew kiba leit shab ka Templ .
translation.en: And a certain man lame from his mother s womb was carried , whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful , to ask alms of them that entered into the temple  ;

translation.kha: Ki Jerusalem’ ki ïaleh kumto , don kiba lum kham bun , kiwei pat ki lum kham khyndiat .
translation.en: And the children of Israel did so , and gathered , some more , some less .

translation.kha: khnang ba moi lah ban khong ka jingïadei kaba beit bad U Blei bad ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut kaba ine ap kyrmen .
translation.en: That being justified by his grace , we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life .

translation.kha: Ki lumbah ki khñiang ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai ; ki lumrit ki um nala ha khmih jongnga u . Ka pyrthei ka khih haba U Trai u mawbah ; ka pyrthei bad ki briew’ jong ka borbah ki kyiuh .
translation.en: The mountains quake at him , and the hills melt , and the earth is burned at his presence , yea , the world , and all that dwell therein .
And Gideon had threescore and ten sons of his body begotten : for he had many wives .
translation.kha: U la don hynñiewphew ngut ki khun shynrang , namar u don shibun ki tnga .

Ha kane ka ïing , to Don Kajuh ka itriem kumba u don , mala um shym la tyngka ei ei shuh na nga lait noh tang ïa pa’ . Kumjuh keiñ nga lah ban leh kat ïa kata ka kam runar , badno ban leh Pop pyrshah ïa U Blei ?
translation.en: There is none greater in this house than I  ; neither hath he kept back any thing from me but thee , because thou art his wife : how then can I do this great wickedness , and sin against God ?

Ye have not chosen me , but I have chosen you , and ordained you , that ye should go and bring forth fruit , and that your fruit should remain : that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name , he may give it you .
translation.kha: Phim shym la jied ïa nga ; nga la jied ïa phi bad nga la thung ïa phi ban leit bad ban seisoh shibun , u jait soh uba ïaineh . Bad kumta U Kpa un ai ha phi ïa kaei kaei kaba phi pan na u ha ka kyrteng jong nga .
Kanneh ruh ka kynthup ïa phi kiba ha Rom , ïa kiba U Blang u la khot ban longïng ki jong U Jisu Kherith .
translation.en: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ .

translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa ki nongpynkhiah kiba ong ïa phi ban ym pynum ha u . Ki shukor ïa phi .
translation.en: Therefore hearken not unto the words of the prophets that speak unto you , saying , Ye shall not serve the king of Babylon : for they prophesy a lie unto you .

translation.kha: Da shisha phi kynmaw , ko parabangeit jong ngi , kum ba ngi la minot nabar trei shit ! Ngi la trei mynsngi bad mynshem khnang ba ngin ym bankhia ïa phi haba ngi la ïalap ha phi ïa ka Khubor Babha na U Blei .
translation.en: For ye remember , brethren , our labour and travail : for labouring night and day , because we would not be chargeable unto any of you , we preached unto you the gospel of God .
I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me .
translation.kha: Nga don ka bor ban mad ïa baroh ki jinglong da ka bor kaba U Khrist u ai ïa nga .

Ka Joppa kam khim da Jngai na Lydda , bad haba ki pynrangbah ha Joppa ki la ïohsngew ba u Petros u la don ha Lydda , ki la phah ar ngut ki rangbah sha u lem bad ka khubor , To pynkloi bad waiñ sha ngi .
translation.en: And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa , and the disciples had heard that Peter was there , they sent unto him two men , desiring him that he would not delay to come to them .
And the watchmen of Saul in Gibeah of Benjamin looked  ; and , behold , the multitude melted away , and they went on beating down one another .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah ap phira jong u Saul ha Gibeah ha ri Benjamin ki ïohi ïa ki Philistia ba ki phet ha ka jingkulmar .

translation.en: And there fell of Benjamin eighteen thousand men  ; all these were men of valour .
translation.kha: Khatphra hajar ngut ki shipai Benjamin kiba shlur ki la shah pynïap .
Naba ha U Kynther la pynlong ïa phi kiba Man kyrhai ha kiei kiei baroh , kaba kynthup ïa ka jingkren bad ka jingtap baroh .
translation.en: That in every thing ye are enriched by him , in all utterance , and in all knowledge ;

translation.kha: U Paul u la sien kylleng Kylleng , nabar ha kawei ka sien u la longing ba jngoh ïa ki brup jong U Blei kiba shong basah ha Lydda .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as Peter passed throughout all quarters , he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda .

translation.kha: Ka la jia sa kawei pat ka nemsniew ha —kata ka ri , nalor kata kaba la jia ha ki sngi u Abraham . U Isaak u la leit sha u Abimelekh u syiem jong ki Philistia , ha Gerar .
translation.en: And there was a famine in the land , beside the first famine that was in the days of Abraham . And Isaac went unto Abimelech king of the Philistines unto Gerar .

And say thou unto the people , Sanctify yourselves against to morrow , and ye shall eat flesh : for ye have wept in the ears of the  Lord  , saying , Who shall give us flesh to eat ? for it was well with us in Egypt : therefore the  Lord  will give you flesh , and ye shall eat .
translation.kha: Mynta ong ïa ki paidbah , ‘ Pynkhuid ïa lade na ka bynta lashai ; bad phin sa ïoh ka doh ban bam . U  Trai  u la ïohsngew ba phi ïakren khñium bad ong ba phi mutdur ba phi don khyndiat ka doh , bad ba phi kham ïoh bam bha ha Ijipt . Te mynta U  Trai  un ai ka doh ba phin bam , bad phi dei ban bam ïa ka .
Namar kane balei badno na phi , phi pang bad phoi swai , bad bun bah ki la ïahap .
translation.en: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you , and many sleep .

I thank thee , and praise thee , O thou God of my fathers , who hast given me wisdom and might , and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee : for thou hast now made known unto us the king s matter .
translation.kha: Nga ïaroh ïa me bad pyndonburom ïa me , A U Blei ki kpa tymmen jong nga . Me la ai ha nga ka jingstad bad ka jingkhlaiñ ; me la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong nga bad me la pyn-i ha ngi kaei ba ngin ïathuh ha u syiem .
Uta u briew uba kylla long u bymkhuid un ïaisah u bymkhuid shuh janmiet , hynrei la katta ruh um lah ban bam ïa ki jingkñia ainguh kiba kyntang tad ïaheh ba u la dep sum .
translation.en: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even , and shall not eat of the holy things , unless he wash his flesh with water .

translation.kha: Haba la tep , ka long kaba ijli bad kaba tlot ; haba yn pynmihpat , kan long kaba itynnat malade kaba khlaiñ .
translation.en: It is sown in dishonour ; it is raised in glory : it is sown in weakness ; it is raised in power :

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ïohi ïa u ba u thiah hangta , bad u la tip ba uta u briew u la pang la slem bah ; kumta u la kylli ïa u , Me kwah ban ïoh ?
translation.en: When Jesus saw him lie , and knew that he had been now a long time in that case , he saith unto him ,  Wilt thou be made whole ?
Be ye angry , and sin not : let not the sun go down upon your wrath :
translation.kha: Lada phi bitar , wat ai ba ka jingbitar jong phi kan ïalam ïa phi ban leh pop , wat bitar sah baroh shi sngi .
Phi myntoi ïa lade haba phi bha Shibun . Haba phi leh ki kam runar , phi pynmynsaw hi ïa lade .
translation.en: The merciful man doeth good to his own soul : but he that is cruel troubleth his own flesh .
Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour , for to give repentance to Israel , and forgiveness of sins .
translation.kha: U Blei u la kyntiew ïa u sha ka liang kamon jong u kum u Nongïalam bad u Nongpynim , ban ai ha ki paid Israel ka kabu ban kylla-kaba-mut bad ban ïoh ka jingmap ïa ki pop jong ki .
Ka Ïingjaiñ Ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong U Trai kaba u Messaïah u la thaw ha ka ri khlaw , bad ka duwan ha kaba la thang ïa ki jingïania ka dang ni ha ka jaka mane ha Gibeon ha kane ka por ;
translation.en: For the tabernacle of the  Lord  , which Moses made in the wilderness , and the altar of the burnt offering , were at that season in the high place at Gibeon .

translation.kha: Ha kan hi ka sngi ka ri jong phi kan sawa ha ki jingjot bad ym don mano mano ban shon ban sah ha ka . Ka la long ka jingkhaïi ba-itriem , bad ki briew ki pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong ka kum ka jingim , namar U Trai um lah Shah shuh ïa ki kai bymman bad basniew jongu phi .
translation.en: So that the  Lord  could no longer bear , because of the evil of your doings , and because of the abominations which ye have committed  ; therefore is your land a desolation , and an astonishment , and a curse , without an inhabitant , as at this day .

translation.kha: Ko Nonghikai , u la kylli , kano ka hukum kaba khrud tam hapoh ka Law ?
translation.en: Master , which is the great commandment in the law ?

translation.kha: Balei ba ki bariew jong nga kim jubab haba nga la leit sha ki ban pynim ïa ki ? Balei ba kim phai ktien hajan nga la khot ïa ki ? Hato nga tlot eh ban pynjam ïa ki ? Nga lah banbeiñ pynrngad noh ïa ka duriaw da kaba shu hukum bad pynkylla ïa ki wah sha ka ri shyiap , ba ki dohkha uba anna ha ki kin ïalap na ka jingduna um .
translation.en: Wherefore , when I came , was there no man ? when I called , was there none to answer ? Is my hand shortened at all , that it cannot redeem ? or have I no power to deliver ? behold , at my rebuke I dry up the sea , I make the rivers a wilderness : their fish stinketh , because there is no water , and dieth for thirst .

translation.kha: ba ngan shut pynnep ïa ka waitlam kaba phalang jong na , bad ai ïa ka jingbishar bahok , ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki nongshun jngai nga bun pynshitom ïa kito kiba isih ïa de .
translation.en: If I whet my glittering sword , and mine hand take hold on judgment  ; I will render vengeance to mine enemies , and will reward them that hate me .

translation.kha: Ki Jesreel kin nym Shaniah shuh ha ki ban ïoh jingïarap . Ka buid ki nong Ijipt Kan pynkynmaw ïa ki Israel kumno ka la long kaba kynjoh ban shaniah ha ki . Te ki Israel kin tip ba nga long U Trai Nongsynshar .
translation.en: And it shall be no more the confidence of the house of Israel , which bringeth their iniquity to remembrance , when they shall look after them : but they shall know that I am the Lord  God .
He measured then the gate from the roof of one little chamber to the roof of another : the breadth was five and twenty cubits , door against door .
translation.kha: Nangta u la thew sa ïa ka jingjngai ka kynroh kaba nadien kawei ka kamra shaduh ka kynroh kaba shadien jong kawei pat ka kamra lyngba ka lynti ïaid na ka , bad ka long khat-ar mitar shiteng .
U Jisu u la jubab , Kaei ka kmie jong nga , bad ktieh ki para shynrang jong nga ?
translation.en: But he answered and said unto him that told him ,  Who is my mother ? and who are my brethren ?

translation.kha: U pynbynta ïa ki laispah ngat ki rangbah ha ki lai kynhun , bad u ai ha wai uwei u briew’ kawei ka tyrwa sad uwei u khra umbiah don ka dongmusa hapoh jong u .
translation.en: And he divided the three hundred men into three companies , and he put a trumpet in every man s hand , with empty pitchers , and lamps within the pitchers .

translation.kha: Bad ha Kane ka rukom phin leh pop pyrshah ïa U Khrist keiñ da kaba leh pop pyrsad ïa la ki parabangeit bad pynjyrngam ïa ka jingialeh batlot jong ki .
translation.en: But when ye sin so against the brethren , and wound their weak conscience , ye sin against Christ .

translation.kha: Ynda u la phah ïa ki sha shiliang , u la phah ruh sha shiliang ïa kaei kiei baroh kat kiba u don ,
translation.en: And he took them , and sent them over the brook , and sent over that he had .

translation.kha: Kumta u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jongnga u ki imat ïa kata baroh kaba U thri u la Law lyngba u Moses .
translation.en: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses .
As is the earthy , such are they also that are earthy : and as is the heavenly , such are they also that are heavenly .
translation.kha: Kito kiba dei jong ka pyrthei ki long kum uta uba la thaw na ka dewmet ; kito kiba dei jong ka bneng ki long kum uta uba la wan na bneng .
Pynban , to lehsbun bad long dohnud iwei ïa wei pat , bad to ïamap iwei ïa iwei pat , kumba U Blei u la map ïa phi ha U Khrist .
translation.en: And be ye kind one to another , tenderhearted , forgiving one another , even as God for Christ s sake hath forgiven you .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Paul u la ong ha u , Ngam don pisa ei ei , hynrei nga ai ha me ïa kawei kaba nga dat : Ha ka kyrteng jong U Jisu Khrist uba na Nasareth nga hukum ïa me ban ïeng joit bad ïaid !
translation.en: Then Peter said , Silver and gold have I none  ; but such as I have give I thee : In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk .
This second epistle , beloved , I now write unto you  ; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance :
translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , kane mynta ka long ka shithi kaba ar ba nga thoh sha phi . Ha baroh ar tylli ki shithi nga la pyrshang ban pynkhih ïa ki jingpyrkhat bakhuid ha ki jingmut jong phi da kaba pynkynmaw ïa phi ïa kine kiei kiei .
U Trai un pyn-i ha ngi ïa ka burom Jong u . Ngin shong ngin sah harud ki wah sad ki Wahduid kiba ïar , hynrei ki liengbah jong ki nongshun kin ym ïaid ha ki .
translation.en: But there the glorious  Lord  will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams  ; wherein shall go no galley with oars , neither shall gallant ship pass thereby .

translation.kha: ka Rabbith , ka shisyndon , ka Ebes ,
translation.en: And Rabbith , and Kishion , and Abez ,

translation.kha: Pyndonkam da ki ki kiba sngewngiah ïa kiba yn ym don ba wad rupa , khnam ba yn ïoh pynlehrain ïa ki nongshun jong me da ka bym don ei ei kaba snier ban ïoh Kren pyrshah shaphang jong ngi .
translation.en: Sound speech , that cannot be condemned ; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed , having no evil thing to say of you .
And Jacob rent his clothes , and put sackcloth upon his loins , and mourned for his son many days .
translation.kha: U Jakob u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih bad u kup da ka jaiñ khain . U la ïam sngewsih bun sngi na ka bynta u khun jong u .
“Phi kiba shong ha Aroer , ïeng sharud lynti Bad ap ; kylli na kito kiba ïaphet noh , wad jingtip na ki ïa kaei kaba la jia .
translation.en: O inhabitant of Aroer , stand by the way , and espy  ; ask him that fleeth , and her that escapeth , and say , What is done ?
And they beckoned unto their partners , which were in the other ship , that they should come and help them . And they came , and filled both the ships , so that they began to sink .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ai dak ïa ki paralok jong ki kiba ha kawei pat ka lieng ban wan bad ïarap ïa ki . Ki la wan bad pyndap smam ïa ki lieng baroh ar tylli da ki dohkha , ba ki lieng ki la jan ngam .

translation.en: Blessed are ye , when men shall hate you , and when they shall separate you from their company , and shall reproach you , and cast out your name as evil , for the Son of man s sake .
translation.kha: Suk ma phi haba ki briew ki isih ïa phi ; kiba kyntait ïa phi , ki krenbeiñ ïa phi , bad ki ong ba phi long uba sniew , baroh namar U Khun U Briew !

Hynrei mynta nga ong ha phi : ïa uno uno uba bitar ïa la u para yn wallam shaei ka jingbishar , ïa uno uno uba khot ïa la u para ‘ Me u bymlarkam ei ei !’ yn wallam ha khmat ka Dorbar Bah , bad ïa uno uno uba khot ïa la u para ‘ u baieit bymmyntoi’ un Don ha ka jingma ka jingleit sha ka dujok tdong .
translation.en: But I say unto you , That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment : and whosoever shall say to his brother , Raca , shall be in danger of the council : but whosoever shall say , Thou fool , shall be in danger of hell fire .
Because all those men which have seen my glory , and my miracles , which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness , and have tempted me now these ten times , and have not hearkened to my voice  ;
translation.kha: yn ym don uwei ruh na kine ki briew ki ban im ban ïohrung sha kata ka ri . Ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai batyngshaiñ na ka jingdon ryngkat jong nga , bad ïa ki kambah ba nga la leh ha Ijipt bad ha ka ri khlaw , hynrei ki la tynjuh ïa ka jingïaishah jong nga la bunsien bad ki la kyntait ban kohnguh ïa nga .
bad ibha ki la wan ha U Jisu! , ki la ïor ïa uta u briew umbiah ju don shibun ki kynduh hapoh jong u . U la shong klang , u la Phong jaiñ bad ba u la tipbriew , bun baroh ki la sheptieng .
translation.en: And they come to Jesus , and see him that was possessed with the devil , and had the legion , sitting , and clothed , and in his right mind : and they were afraid .
With whomsoever thou findest thy gods , let him not live : before our brethren discern thou what is thine with me , and take it to thee . For Jacob knew not that Rachel had stolen them .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi shem ïa ki blei jong phi ha uno uno hangne , uta un shah pynïap . Hangne , lem bad ki briew jong ngi kum ki sakhi , peit ïa kano kano ka tiar kaba dei ka jong phi bad shim ïa kaba dei ka jong phi .  U Jakob um shym tip ba ka Rakhel ka la tuh ïa ki blei ïing jong u Laban .

Lada phi ïai bteng ban ym tyngkhuh , te ngan leh ïa kane ka Templ ïa kaei kaba nga la leh ïa ka Shiloh , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew lad ka pyrthei kin pyndonkam ïa ka kyrteng jong kane ka nongbah Kum ka jingtip .
translation.en: Then will I make this house like Shiloh , and will make this city a curse to all the nations of the earth .

translation.kha: Te u Pharaoh u la phah khot ïa u Mushi bad u Haron , bad u la ong , Khie leit bad ai jingkñia ha U Blei’ jong phi hangne ha kane ka ri .
translation.en: And Pharaoh called for Moses and for Aaron , and said , Go ye , sacrifice to your God in the land .

Therefore will I give their wives unto others , and their fields to them that shall inherit them : for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness , from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely .
translation.kha: Kumta ngan ai ïa ki lyngkha jong ki ha ki trai bathymmai bad ïa ki tnga jong ki ha kiwei pat ki rangbah . Uwei uwei baroh , uba rit bad uba khraw , u pyrshang ban thaw pisa da ka jingbymhok . Wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki thok ïa ki briew .

translation.en: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction : but he that refuseth reproof erreth .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shahshkor haba ki shah pynbeit kin ïoh im , hynrei kito ki bym pdiang ba ki bakla ki don ha ka jingma .

Trai uwei na phi u don shispah tylli ki langbrot bad u duh noh kawei na ki — kaei kaba un ai ? U ieh ïa kiwei ki khyndaiphew khyndai tylli ki lbong ha ka jaka bam phrung bad u leit ban wad ïa kata kaba la sakma haduh ba un da shem ïa ka .
translation.en: What man of you , having an hundred sheep , if he lose one of them , doth not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness , and go after that which is lost , until he find it ?

translation.kha: Naba U Khunlangbrot u la pynpait ïa ka jingpyndait kaba kad ; bad nga la ïohsngew ïa u jingwoh bam kaba lai umbah ong , To wanpaw ! Nga la khmih , bad hangta la ni u kulai uba ïong . U nongshong kulai u la bangeit ïa ka tarajur ha la ka kti .
translation.en: And when he had opened the third seal , I heard the third beast say , Come and see . And I beheld , and lo a black horse  ; and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand .
Hast thou not poured me out as milk , and curdled me like cheese ?
translation.kha: Me la ai ka bor ïa u kpa jong nga ba un pynkha ïa nga , Me la pynlong ïa nga ban san ha ka kpoh ka kmie jong nga .

translation.en: And David heard in the wilderness that Nabal did shear his sheep .
translation.kha: bad u Dabid , uba don ha ka ri khlaw , u ïohsngew shaphang kane ,
Kumta hi kaei re kaei kaba kum ki snep dohkha ki la hap na ki khmat jong u Saul , bad u la lah ban ïohi patar . U la ïong joit bad la pynbaptis ïa u ;
translation.en: And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales : and he received sight forthwith , and arose , and was baptized .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem bad ka Nongleitkurim ki ong , To wan ! Uwei uwei baher uba sngewkwah ïa Kane u daym ruh ban ong , To wan ! To wan , ine uno uba sliang , to pdiang ïa ka um ka jingtem kum ka jingai sngewkwah , uno uno uba khoh ïa ka .
translation.en: And the Spirit and the bride say , Come . And let him that heareth say , Come . And let him that is athirst come . And whosoever will , let him take the water of life freely .

translation.kha: ki kynthei bad ki khynnah jong phi , ki nongwei kaba shong bad phi , bad kito kiba long ki nongthoh ding bad ki nongtong um ïa phi ,
translation.en: Your little ones , your wives , and thy stranger that is in thy camp , from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water :

translation.kha: Ka jingshun ka pynjam ïa ki jingïakajia , hynriew ka jingtied ka klet noh ïa ki nang palat barben .
translation.en: Hatred stirreth up strifes : but love covereth all sins .
And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem , that were called  ; and they went in their simplicity , and they knew not any thing .
translation.kha: La don arspah ngut ki rangbah kiba ha ka jingkhot sngewbha u Absalom ki la leit na Jerusalem bad u ; kim tip ei ei shaphang ka jingthmu barieh bad ki la leit da kaba sngur mynsiem .

Kane ka long kaei ba U Trai , U Blei ki Israel , u ong shaphang ki nongsynshar kiba la thri ba kin sumar ïa ki briew jong u : Phim shym la sar bha ïa ki briew jong nga ; phi la pynsakma ïa ki Bad phi la ba-eh nep ïa ki . mynba tun pynshitom ïa phi Namarba ka jingbymman jong phi kaba phi la leh .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people  ; Ye have scattered my flock , and driven them away , and have not visited them : behold , I will visit upon you the evil of your doings , saith the  Lord .
Behold , they say unto me , Where is the word of the  Lord  ? let it come now .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki ong ha nga ,  Hangno kito ki jingbyrngem kiba U  Trai  u la pynlong pyrshah ïa ngi ? To ai ba un pyndep ïa ki mynta !
Nga kloi ban phah ïa ki rangbah jong nga bad ïarap lem ïa ki jong phi ha kaba pynkhreh shibun ki dieng , namar kane ka Templ kaweh nga mut ban tei kan long kaba khraw bad kaba jingshon .
translation.en: Even to prepare me timber in abundance : for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great .
I am distressed for thee , my brother Jonathan : very pleasant hast thou been unto me : thy love to me was wonderful , passing the love of women .
translation.kha: Nga pangnud namar jong me , ko Jonathan u para jong nga ; Katno me long uba nga la sngewieit ! Katno phylla long ka jingieit jong me ïa nga , Kham palat ban ïa ka jingieit ki kynthei .
Nangta ki her noh kum ka lak bad ki jah syndon , kine ki briew kiba ka bor ka long u blei jong ki .
translation.en: Then shall his mind change , and he shall pass over , and offend , imputing this his power unto his god .

translation.kha: U Terah u ong ha ki briew jrong u kiba don ha Babilonia : Phi la lait na ka jingïap ! Mynta to leit ! Wat ap ! wat la phi don jngai na ïing , pyrkhat shaphang jong nga , U Trai jong phi , bad kynmaw ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: Ye that have escaped the sword , go away , stand not still : remember the  Lord  afar off , and let Jerusalem come into your mind .
And Samuel said , How can I go ? if Saul hear it , he will kill me . And the  Lord  said , Take an heifer with thee , and say , I am come to sacrifice to the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumno nga lah ban leh ïa kata ?  U Samuel u kylli .  Lada u Saul u ïohsngew ïa kata , un pynïap ïa nga !  U  Trai  u jubab ,  Shim ïa u khun masi bad ong ba me don hangta ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh ha U  Trai .

Haba u wan mihngi ha khmat u syiem Ahab , u syiem u kylli ïa u , Maakah , katto u syiem Jehoshaphat bad nga ngin leit ne em ban Tur ïaleh ïa ka Ramoth ? Khie tur ïaleh ! u Mikaïah u jubab . Da shisha phin jop . U Trai un ai ha phi ka jingjop .
translation.en: So he came to the king . And the king said unto him , Micaiah , shall we go against Ramoth–gilead to battle , or shall we forbear ? And he answered him , Go , and prosper : for the  Lord  shall deliver it into the hand of the king .

translation.kha: Ki la phut ïa ki jingthung jong ka ri shyiap bad bam ïa ki , woh ïa ki throsh bym don jingdum jngai u diengsynshar !
translation.en: Who cut up mallows by the bushes , and juniper roots for their meat .

translation.kha: ka Kedemoth , ka Lakkum ( ha Karmel ) ,
translation.en: The king of Kedesh , one  ; the king of Jokneam of Carmel , one  ;

translation.kha: bad u ong ha u Jeroboam , Shim shiphew lyngkhot ha lade , Naaman U Trai , U Blei! ki Israel , u jong ïa me , ‘ Ngan nongdih noh ïa ka hima na u Solomon , bad lang! ai ha me shiphew jait .
translation.en: And he said to Jeroboam , Take thee ten pieces : for thus saith the  Lord  , the God of Israel , Behold , I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon , and will give ten tribes to thee :
And he brought his household man by man  ; and Achan , the son of Carmi , the son of Zabdi , the son of Zerah , of the tribe of Judah , was taken .
translation.kha: Nangta u wan ïalam sha khmat ïa ka longïing jong u Sabdi sha khmat , uwei hadien uwei , bad la kdew ïa u Akhan , u khun jong u Karmi bad u ksiew jong u Sabdi .

translation.en: Which Indian state has the largest population ?
translation.kha: Kaei ka jylla kaba hapoh india ba bun briew tam ?

translation.en: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples , he rebuked Peter , saying ,  Get thee behind me , Satan : for thou savourest not the things that be of God , but the things that be of men .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la phai , u la khmih ïa ki synran jong u , bad u la sneng ïa u Petros .  Khie noh na nga , me u Soitan ,  u la ong .  Ki jingpyrkhat jong me kim shym wan na U Blei hynrei na u briew !

translation.en: What shall we do unto the queen Vashti according to law , because she hath not performed the commandment of the king Ahasuerus by the chamberlains ?
translation.kha: U ong ha kine ki rangbah ,  Ma nga , u syiem Serksis , nga la phah ïa ki shakri jong nga sha ka Bashti , ka mahadei ; ryngkat bad ka hukum , bad ka kyntait ban kohnguh ïa ka ! Aïu ka aiñ ka kren ba ngi dei ban leh ïa ka ?
ïa ka duwan ka jingainguh thang bad ki tiar ki tar jong ka baroh , ïa ka thab bad ka jingpynshong jongngi ka ,
translation.en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture , and the laver and his foot ,

translation.kha: Neng la jubab , Ki nongïalam jong ngi ki long bakha mutlop ; kim shem kyrpad ïa U Trai ban ïoh jingïalap . Dei Kane keiñ balei ba ki shahjop , bad ki briew jong ngi ki la shah pynslem .
translation.en: For the pastors are become brutish , and have not sought the  Lord  : therefore they shall not prosper , and all their flocks shall be scattered .

translation.kha: Ki la ïeng kham pajih bad ki la pyrsa , Ko Jisu ! Ko Kynrad ! To isynei ïa ngi !
translation.en: And they lifted up their voices , and said , Jesus , Master , have mercy on us .

translation.kha: U Hagar u ïohi ïa ki , badno u ong ha u Sebul , Ha khmih ! La don ki brisoh uba wan hiar na kliar ki lum ! Kito kim dei ki briew , jubab u Sebul . Ki shu long tong ki syrngiew halor ki lum .
translation.en: And when Gaal saw the people , he said to Zebul , Behold , there come people down from the top of the mountains . And Zebul said unto him , Thou seest the shadow of the mountains as if they were men .
For , behold , the  Lord  commandeth , and he will smite the great house with breaches , and the little house with clefts .
translation.kha: Haba U  Trai  u ai ïa ka hukum , ki ïing kiba rit bad kiba heh kin shah pynpra lyngkhot lyngkhai .

translation.en: But they hearkened not , nor inclined their ear to turn from their wickedness , to burn no incense unto other gods .
translation.kha: Hynrei phim shahshkor satia lane pynleit jingmut . Phim iehnoh noh ïa ki jingmlien basniew ban kñia ha kiwei ki blei .
Nangta u Jehosheba u ong ha ki pynbah shipai , Wat pynsheptieng lane khiew . Long uba kut jingmut triang uba skhem namar kane ka dei kaei kambah U Trai un leh ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto them , Fear not , nor be dismayed , be strong and of good courage : for thus shall the  Lord  do to all your enemies against whom ye fight .
And five of you shall chase an hundred , and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight : and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword .
translation.kha: san ngut na phi phin jop ïa ki shispah ngut , bad shispah ngut na phi phin jop ïa ki shiphew hajar ngut .
Kiwei kawei ka lyngkhot jaiñ ka long khatphra mitar ka lynter Bad ar mitar ka kynïan . Baroh kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ki long katjuh ka jingheh .
translation.en: The length of one curtain was twenty and eight cubits , and the breadth of one curtain four cubits : the curtains were all of one size .

translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ba ïatreilang ryngkat bad ki bymïaineh , naba kam lah ban long . Kumno kaba daiñ bad kaba lud kin ïadon bynta lang ? Kumno ka jingshai bad ka jingdum kin ïajah lang ?
translation.en: Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers : for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness ? and what communion hath light with darkness ?

So they sent and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines , and said , Send away the ark of the God of Israel , and let it go again to his own place , that it slay us not , and our people : for there was a deadly destruction throughout all the city  ; the hand of God was very heavy there .
translation.kha: Kumta sa shisien pat ki khot lang ïa ki syiem Philistia baroh bad ki ong ,  Pynphai noh ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Israel sha ka jaka jong ka , ba kumta kan ym pynïap ïa ngi bad ïa ki longïing jong ngi .  La don ka jingkulmar baroh kawei ka nongbah namar ba U Blei u la pynshitom jur ïa ki .
bad u Petros u la kynmaw ïa kaei kaba U ju u la lah ïathuh ha u : Shuwa ba u syiar un kyn-ih , men ong lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga . U la mihnoh bad u la ïamkthang .
translation.en: And Peter remembered the word of Jesus , which said unto him ,  Before the cock crow , thou shalt deny me thrice .  And he went out , and wept bitterly .

translation.kha: Hynrei hynriewspah jngut na ki , ki lait bad ki phet ïap shemphang ri khlaw shuh u mawshun tymmen , bad ki sawa hangta saw bnai .
translation.en: But six hundred men turned and fled to the wilderness unto the rock Rimmon , and abode in the rock Rimmon four months .

translation.kha: Ko hynmen ko para jongno nga , to dei ban kren shabi shaphang U syiem ïaiban u kput tymmen bapawnam jong i'u . U la ïap bad la tep ïa u , bad ka jinghap jong u ka don hangne bad ngi haduh kane ka sngi .
translation.en: Men and brethren , let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David , that he is both dead and buried , and his sepulchre is with us unto this day .
For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people .
translation.kha: Lada phim shahshkor ïa nga , te U Blei un pyndonkam da ki nongwei kiba kren da kawei pat ka sur ktien ba sngew khyllah ban hikai ïa phi .
Hangta U Jisu u la Khot ïa u babha sha u sa shisien bad ong ha ki , To shahshkor ïa nga , baroh na phi , dara to long kiba shemphang .
translation.en: And when he had called all the people unto him , he said unto them ,  Hearken unto me every one of you , and understand :

translation.kha: U nongsynshar wahbah khlem ka jingshemphang un long u nonglehbeiñ uba lumlang . Uta uba isih ïa ka jingbymlehhok un synshar lem .
translation.en: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor : but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days .

Therefore the children of Israel could not stand before their enemies , but turned their backs before their enemies , because they were accursed : neither will I be with you any more , except ye destroy the accursed from among you .
translation.kha: Dei namar kane ba ki Israel kim lah ban ïeng ïaleh ïa ki nongshun jong ki . Ki kynran dien na ki namar ki hi ki la shah pynrem sha ka jingpynjot ! Ngan ym don ryngkat shuh bad phi lymda phi pynjot thiaw ïa kiei kiei kiba la hukum ïa phi ban ym shim !

Don ki Pharisi kiba la ong , Uta u briew uba la ni ïa kane um ia ban long na U Blei , naba um shym kohnguh ïa ka hukum Sabbaton . Hynrei , kiwei pat , ki la ong , Kumno u briew uba long u nongpop u Lah pun leh kum kita ki kambah kat Kinah ? Bad ka la don ka jingïapait hapdeng jong ki .
translation.en: Therefore said some of the Pharisees , This man is not of God , because he keepeth not the sabbath day . Others said , How can a man that is a sinner do such miracles ? And there was a division among them .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha ki briew jong u , Leh ïa kaei kaba hok bad kaba dei , naba shen tun pynim ïa phi .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , Keep ye judgment , and do justice : for my salvation is near to come , and my righteousness to be revealed .
For now will I break his yoke from off thee , and will burst thy bonds in sunder .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkut mynta ïa ka bor jong ka Assyria halor jong phi bad ngan pyndkut ïa ki kynjri kiba teh ïa phi .
U Goliath u kaban ïa ki Israel man la ka step bad man la ka janmiet rahah sawphew sngi .
translation.en: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening , and presented himself forty days .
That thou mayest remember , and be confounded , and never open thy mouth any more because of thy shame , when I am pacified toward thee for all that thou hast done , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan map ïa ki jingbakla baroh kiba pha la leh , hynrei phan kynmaw ïa ki bad sngewlehrain palat ban ang ïa la ka shyntur .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
Nobah nga la tduh ban wan jngoh ïa phi ha ka lynti jong nga sha Makedonia bad kumjuh ynda ar wan peiñ , khnang don ïoh jingïarap lem na phi na ka bynta ka jingleit jongki nga shwa Judia .
translation.en: And to pass by you into Macedonia , and to come again out of Macedonia unto you , and of you to be brought on my way toward Judaea .

translation.kha: U dei ban pynphai shi bynta na ka dor ha kaba la thied ïa u kat kum ka jingdon jongu ki snem kiba dang sah ,
translation.en: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubilee , then he shall count with him , and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption .
And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years , and begat sons and daughters :

To shahshkor ïa ngi , A Blei ; to khmih sha ngi , bad peiñ ïa ka jingjynjar kaba i'u don bad ïa ka jingshah shitom jongngi ka nongjop kaba kit ïa ka kyrteng jong me . Ngi duwai ha me nongmareh ba me long uba dap da ka jingisynei , ym namar ba ngi la leh ïa kaba dei .
translation.en: O my God , incline thine ear , and hear  ; open thine eyes , and behold our desolations , and the city which is called by thy name : for we do not present our supplications before thee for our righteousnesses , but for thy great mercies .

translation.kha: Phai la pynïap bun bah ki briew hangne hapoh ka nongbeh ba ki lynti ki dap da ki metïap .
translation.en: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city , and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain .

translation.kha: Wallam ïa u syiem Agag hangto ha nga , u Samuel u sah” . U Agag u la wan sha u da kaba khynwin da ka jingtieng , u da pyrkhat ha biar , Kartan ka long kaba kthang ban ïap .
translation.en: Then said Samuel , Bring ye hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites . And Agag came unto him delicately . And Agag said , Surely the bitterness of death is past .

translation.kha: Ka bainong ban lypa ka lam sha ka jingim ; hynrei ka pop ka ïalam ban leh pah shuh shuh .
translation.en: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life : the fruit of the wicked to sin .

translation.kha: Hangta ki la pyrshang ban ai ïa u ïa ka waiñ ba la khleh bad ka jingdih ba la khot ka mirr , hynrei U Jisu um sdieh ïa ka .
translation.en: And they gave him to drink wine mingled with myrrh : but he received it not .
And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness .
translation.kha: bad haduh sawphew snem u la ïaishah bad ki ha ka ri shyiap .

translation.en: And there came a certain poor widow , and she threw in two mites , which make a farthing .
translation.kha: nangta , ka riewkynthei ka wan bad ka la noh ar tylli ki sbai tama , kiba shongdor kumba shi pisa .
A Trai uba U Blei , kiba long ka thymmei jong ka jingjam baroh , nga kyrpad ïa me to thung ïa u briew uba lah ban ïalam ïa u paidlang ,
translation.en: Let the  Lord  , the God of the spirits of all flesh , set a man over the congregation ,

translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha U Trai , Ki bhabriew kim lah baneh wan kiew shajrong , ngab me la hukum ïa ngi ban kheiñduh kyntang ïa u lem bad ban buh dak sawdong jong u .
translation.en: And Moses said unto the  Lord  , The people cannot come up to mount Sinai : for thou chargedst us , saying , Set bounds about the mount , and sanctify it .

translation.kha: Ki synran ki la khih jingmut bad ki la sdang ban kylli ïa u , uwei hadien wai pat , Da shisha , sam shym mut ïa per , haw ym dei kumta ?
translation.en: And they began to be sorrowful , and to say unto him one by one , Is it I ? and another said , Is it I ?

translation.kha: Kumta ka Sarah ka rkhie sammut marwei , bad ka ong , mynba ba nga la thlim bad Ngam donakor shuh , ngan sdang lah mo pun ïoh ïa ka jingsngewbha ? Nalor kata , u tnga jongngi nga ruh u la tymmen .
translation.en: Therefore Sarah laughed within herself , saying , After I am waxed old shall I have pleasure , my lord being old also ?

translation.kha: Me kob sarew ba me la tih ïa ki puk bad thah um ha ki ri nongwei , bad ba ki kjat jong ki shipai jong me ki la ïuh ha ka wahbah Nile rkhiebeiñ .
translation.en: I have digged , and drunk water  ; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places .
And God went up from him in the place where he talked with him .
translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la iehnoh ïa u .
Ki nongjapan jar ki dei ki briew kiba Kamon ?
translation.en: What sort of men are the ministerial servants ?
And Judah said unto his brethren , What profit is it if we slay our brother , and conceal his blood ?
translation.kha: U Judah u ong ha la ki hynmen ki para shynrang ,  Kan myntoi aïu ïa ngi ba ngin pynïap noh ïa la u para bad buhrieh ïa ka kam pynïap briew ?

Ïa ki nongsynshar ka nongbah la tap-lup da ki jingbamsap , ki lyngdoh ki pynbatai ïa ka hukum na ka bynta ka tulop , ki nonghiarthma ki ai ïa ki jingpynpaw jongki ki na ka bynta ka pisa — bad bhor ki kam ba U Trai u khong bad ki . Yn ym dat jingma ka baneh hap halor jong ngi , ki ong . U Trai u long lem malade ngi .
translation.en: The heads thereof judge for reward , and the priests thereof teach for hire , and the prophets thereof divine for money : yet will they lean upon the  Lord  , and say , Is not the  Lord  among us ? none evil can come upon us .

translation.kha: U Jakob u la kyndit thiah , bad u nong , U Trai u don hangne ! U don ha kane ka jaka , pynlang ngam shym tip ïa tala !
translation.en: And Jacob awaked out of his sleep , and he said , Surely the  Lord  is in this place  ; and I knew it not .
And if he have no daughter , then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren .
translation.kha: Lada um don khun kynthei , ki hynmen ki para shynrang jong u kin ïohpateng ïa ka .

Ma me , ki khun shynrang jongu me , malade ki shakri jong me , phin ïarep ha ka khynñiat na ka bna ka longïing jong u Saul , u kynrad jong phi , bad wallam ïa ka jingmih nangta ban pynbiang Bam ïa ki . Hynrei u Mephibosheth hi un ïailong uba shah khot sngewbha sha ka miej bam jong nga . ( U Siba u don khatsan ngut ki khun shynrang dara arphew ngut ki shatri . )
translation.en: Thou therefore , and thy sons , and thy servants , shall till the land for him , and thou shalt bring in the fruits , that thy master s son may have food to eat : but Mephibosheth thy master s son shall eat bread alway at my table . Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants .

translation.kha: Ha-ei u don ? u kylliang ïa la ki khun . Balei phin shu ieh ïa uta u briew ? Khlieh leit khot ïa u ban ïabam bad i .
translation.en: And he said unto his daughters , And where is he ? why is it that ye have left the man ? call him , that he may eat bread .

translation.kha: U Joah u Tip ba u Syiem Dabid u kynmaw iktiar haduh katta katta ïa u Absalom ,
translation.en: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king s heart was toward Absalom .

translation.en: And Jezreel , and Jokdeam , and Zanoah ,
