translation.en: ( John 17 :3 ) Yes , “the world is passing away . . .  , but he that does the will of God remains forever .” —1 John 2 :17 .

translation.kha: bad jingkad pur ki loit sha ka Templ , ba la synran da ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi sad da baroh Kiwei ki briew , kiba riewspah bad kiba duk kumjuh . Ha khmat jong ki baroh , u syiem u pule jam ïa ka kino baroh jong ka Jutang , kaba la shym ha ka Templ .
translation.en: And the king went up into the house of the  Lord  , and all the men of Judah , and the inhabitants of Jerusalem , and the priests , and the Levites , and all the people , great and small : and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the  Lord .
And the lord commended the unjust steward , because he had done wisely : for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light .
translation.kha: Kaba mih ka long ba u trai jong une u sordar bymhok u la ïaroh ïa u ba u leh ïa kaba kum kane kaba sianti ; namar ki briew jong kane ka pyrthei ki long kiba kham sianti ha kaba trei ïa la ki kam ban ïa ki briew kiba long ki jong ka jingshai .
hawei , tang kawei kaba donburom . Ka Mari ka la jied ïa kaei kaba dei , bun yn ym skhem noh ïa kata na ka .
translation.en: But one thing is needful : and Mary hath chosen that good part , which shall not be taken away from her .

translation.kha: Ka tnga kaweh babha ka long ka jingsarong badno jingkyrmen jong u tnga jong ka ; hynrei ka tnga kaba pynlehrain ïa la u tnga ka long kum ka jingpang bampong ïa ki shyieng jong u .
translation.en: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband : but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones .

translation.kha: Dei ka jingngeit kaba la pynlong ïa u Noah Ban shahshkor ïa ki jingmaham U Blei shang kiei kiei ki Ban sa jia ïa kiba um shym lah ba-bang ïohi . U la khunlung ïa U Blei bad u la thaw ïa ka jingnang ha kaba ma u bad ka un-long jong u ki la ïohlait im . Da kane , la pynrem ïa ka pyrthei , bad u napoh u la ïohpdiang na U Blei ïa ka hok kaba wan da ka jingngeit .
translation.en: By faith Noah , being warned of God of things not seen as yet , moved with fear , prepared an ark to the saving of his house  ; by the which he condemned the world , and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith .
Run now , I pray thee , to meet her , and say unto her , Is it well with thee ? is it well with thy husband ? is it well with the child ? And she answered , It is well .
translation.kha: Pynkloi ban leit sha ka bad kylli la kiei kiei baroh ki bit ki biang bad ka , u tnga jong ka , bad u khun jong ka .  Ka ïathuh ha u Gehasi ba kiei kiei baroh ki bit ki biang ,
Naba ka khubor shaphang ka jingïap U Khrist halor ka diengphna ka lama ka jingibieit ha iar kiba jot noh! ; hynrei ïa ngi kiba la pynim , ka long ka bor U blei .
translation.en: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness ; but unto us which are saved it is the power of God .

translation.kha: Kumta ki pynhiar khleiñ kloi ïa la ki byrni ha madan , dara uwei pa uei na ki u plied ïa la ka byrni .
translation.en: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground , and opened every man his sack .
This is what was intended , since God provided a wife to be “a helper for him , as a complement of him .”
translation.kha: Kane ka long khia jingthmu na duh ba sdang , ba u Blei u la pynkhreh , ka tnga kan long “Ka nongiarap jong u kum ka jing sumar ka ba biang .”

translation.en: Whosoever therefore shall humble himself as this little child , the same is greatest in the kingdom of heaven .
translation.kha: Uba khraw tam hapoh ka Hima ki bneng u long uta uba pynrit ïa lade bad uba long kum une u khynnah .
Ki ktien U Trai’ ki long kiba shisha ; bad baher ki kam jongu u ki longsyiem kiba lah ban shaniah .
translation.en: For the word of the  Lord  is right  ; and all his works are done in truth .

translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei u sngewkhia tang ïa la ki jong ki kam , ym ïa kiei kiei ki jong U Jisu Khrist .
translation.en: For all seek their own , not the things which are Jesus Christs .

translation.kha: hynriew u Saul u phah biang ïa ki ba kin da longing peit da lade ïa u Dabid . U hukum ïa ki , Rah lang ïa u hangne ha ka jingthiah jong u bad ngan pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: And Saul sent the messengers again to see David , saying , Bring him up to me in the bed , that I may slay him .
Whosoever abideth in him sinneth not : whosoever sinneth hath not seen him , neither known him .
translation.kha: Kumta uwei pa uwei uba long ha U Khrist , um ïai leh pop ; hynrei uno uno uba ïai leh pop , um pat shym la ïohi ïa u lane ithuh ïa u .
Ka kham kordor ban ïa ka ksing , ban ïa u khiew ksiar lane ïa ka ïit babha den .
translation.en: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it : and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold .
And join them one to another into one stick  ; and they shall become one in thine hand .
translation.kha: Nangta bat ïa kine ki ar tylli ki dieng na tduh ha tduh ha ka kti jong me ba kin i kum uwei u dieng .

translation.en: And when she was come to her house , she found the devil gone out , and her daughter laid upon the bed .
translation.kha: Ka la leit sha ïing bad ka la shem ïa ka khun jong ka ba ka thiah ha ka jingthiah ; u ksuid u la lah mihnoh shisha na ka .

translation.en: Consider the ravens : for they neither sow nor reap  ; which neither have storehouse nor barn  ; and God feedeth them : how much more are ye better than the fowls ?
translation.kha: Khmih ïa ki tyngab : Kim shym bet symbai lane lum ïa ka jingot ; kim don ki jaka kynshew lane ki thiar ; U Blei u bsa ïa ki ! Phi long kiba kor kham bun shah ban ïa ki sim !
A Trai , me la pynlong shibun kiei kiei ! Haduh katno me la pynlong ha ka jingtied Jong me ïa ki baroh ! Ka pyrta ka dap tyngka da ki jingthaw jong me .
translation.en: O  Lord  , how manifold are thy works ! in wisdom hast thou made them all : the earth is full of thy riches .

translation.kha: Im slem ko Syiem ki Jiw ! Bad ki la leit bad thab ïa u .
translation.en: And said , Hail , King of the Jews ! and they smote him with their hands .

translation.kha: Haba u Shimei u ïohsngew ba ki don ha Hangta , u la teh jin ïa la ka kada bad u la leit sha u Syiem Akhish ha Haggith , Ban dam ïa la ki mraw . U la lade ïa ki bad u wan ïalang pat ïa ki sha ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And Shimei arose , and saddled his ass , and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants : and Shimei went , and brought his servants from Gath .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha u syiem Jehoïakhin , u khun jong u Jehoïakim u syiem ka Judah , Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei Uba im . Wat la me longïng kum ka sati jhur ha ka kti kamon jong nga , ngan weng noh ïa me ,
translation.en: As I live , saith the  Lord  , though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah were the signet upon my right hand , yet would I pluck thee thence  ;

translation.kha: Uta nyngkong u Syria kum u sing , hynrei u ni ki thapniang kum u pukni . Katba ang ïalang khem la pynkdiah ïa ki ïapthngan . Ïa u mawkynroh la rah shajrong bun la pynlong ïa u ban ïeng kum u briew . Bad nangta la ai ha u ka jingmut jingpynkoit kum u bariew .
translation.en: The first was like a lion , and had eagle s wings : I beheld till the wings thereof were plucked , and it was lifted up from the earth , and made stand upon the feet as a man , and a man s heart was given to it .

translation.kha: U Tom u im ha la ka jong ka pyrthei
translation.en: Tom lives in his own world .
And Jesus knowing their thoughts said ,  Wherefore think ye evil in your hearts ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la tip ïa kaei kaba ki pyrkhat , kumta u la ong ,  Balei phi ïa-pyrkhat ïa kine kiei kiei kiba sniew ?
U long kum ka pynbna ha ka ri shyiap , katba mih ha ka ri khlup baryngkhiang , halor ka khihwin mluh ha kaba ym don kawei kaei kaba mih . Ym dat kano kano kaba bha kaba la ju jia ha u .
translation.en: For he shall be like the heath in the desert , and shall not see when good cometh  ; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness , in a salt land and not inhabited .
And blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores , and repented not of their deeds .
translation.kha: bad ki la tim ïa U Blei jong ka bneng namar ki jingpang bad ki prum jong ki . Hynrei kim shym la phai noh na ki lynti basniew jong ki .
kadei kaba la jia , ko Duriaw , ban pynlong ïa pha ban phet noh ? Bad ma pha , ko Jordan , balei ba pha Sangeh baneh tuid ?
translation.en: What ailed thee , O thou sea , that thou fleddest ? thou Jordan , that thou wast driven back ?
When he saw Jesus , he cried out , and fell down before him , and with a loud voice said , What have I to do with thee , Jesus , thou Son of God most high ? I beseech thee , torment me not .
translation.kha: Haba u la ïohi ïa U Jisu , u la kyang jam , u la pyndem ïa lade ha ki kjat jong u , bad u la pyrta ,  Ko Jisu , U Khun jong U Blei Uba Hakhlieh Tam Eh ! Me kwah aïu bad nga ? Nga kyrpad ïa me , wat pynshitom ïa nga !

Bad kumin , mar syn ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa ki tiar put tiar tem , ki briew Jong baroh ki ri , ki jaitbynriew , bad ki jait ktien ki la ïadem ngon bad mane ïa ka durbriew ksiar kabu u Syiem nongkyrshan u la phar pynlang .
translation.en: Therefore at that time , when all the people heard the sound of the cornet , flute , harp , sackbut , psaltery , and all kinds of musick , all the people , the nations , and the languages , fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up .

translation.kha: Ki ong ïa nga , ‘ Ngim tip ka la jia aïu ïa Un u Manasseh , u briew uba la ïalam ïa ngi na ka ri ibieit ; kumta , thaw noh ïa ngi u blei u ban ïalap ïa ngi .’
translation.en: For they said unto me , Make us gods , which shall go before us : for as for this Moses , the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt , we wot not what is become of him .

translation.kha: Nga thikna ba me lah , namar me la tymmen bha bad me la don hangta mynsngi la thaw ïa ka pyrthei !
translation.en: Knowest thou it , because thou wast then born ? or because the number of thy days is great ?

translation.kha: Balei keiñ ba ngam peiphang ? Balei keiñ ba ngam shah ba Kiwei kin pynbeit ïa nga ?
translation.en: And say , How have I hated instruction , and my heart despised reproof  ;

translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki na ka ïong jong me ha bneng , map ïa ki , bad ïarap ïa ki . Tang ma me hi uba tip) ïa ki jingmut jong ka dohnud briew .
translation.en: Then hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place , and forgive , and do , and give to every man according to his ways , whose heart thou knowest  ; ( for thou , even thou only , knowest the hearts of all the children of men  ; )

translation.kha: Ka jingkmen ka la duh ei na ki jingkem jongno ngi ; ka jingsngewsih ka la shim ïa ka jaka jong ki jingdiang Jong ngi .
translation.en: The joy of our heart is ceased  ; our dance is turned into mourning .
And the same man had four daughters , virgins , which did prophesy .
translation.kha: U la don saw ngut ki khun kynthei ki bym pat shongkurim kiba la pynbna ïa ka khubor jong U Blei .

Pynban , ka hukum kaba nga thah mynta sha phi ka long kaweh thymmai , namar ka jingrisa jong ka , ka la lip ha U Khrist bad kumjuh ruh ha phi . Naba ka jingdum ka la jah noh , bad ka jingshai kob shisha ka la da tyngshaiñ .
translation.en: Again , a new commandment I write unto you , which thing is true in him and in you : because the darkness is past , and the true light now shineth .

translation.kha: Ynda U Trai u waiñ ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka ri kaba phiah ïohkynti , phin pynbna ïa ka jingkyrkhu nalor u lum Gerisim badno ïa kata ka jingtim nalor u lum Ebal .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass , when the  Lord  thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it , that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim , and the curse upon mount Ebal .

translation.kha: U Jakob u ïohi ïa u Aïu ba u wan lem malade sawspah ñiut ki jingbabe . Kumta u pynïeng ïa ki khun hapdeng ha Leah , ka Rakhel , bad ki tnga krai ar ngut .
translation.en: And Jacob lifted up his eyes , and looked , and , behold , Esau came , and with him four hundred men . And he divided the children unto Leah , and unto Rachel , and unto the two handmaids .

translation.kha: Ha ki por baroh ki ban wan , dei ban ai ïa kane ka jingainguh thang ha khmat jyllang nga ha ka jingkhang jngai ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon lynti jong nga . Kata ka longsyiem ka iaki ha kaba ngan ïashem malu ki briew jongnga nga bad ngan ïakren bad me .
translation.en: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the  Lord  : where I will meet you , to speak there unto thee .
What ailed thee , O thou sea , that thou fleddest ? thou Jordan , that thou wast driven back ?
translation.kha: Kaei kaba la jia , ko Duriaw , ban pynlong ïa pha ban phet noh ? Bad ma pha , ko Jordan , balei ba pha sangeh ban tuid ?

translation.en: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies . He that loveth his wife loveth himself .
translation.kha: Ki shynrang ki dei ban ieit ïa ki tnga jong ki kumba ki ieit ïa la ki jong ki met . U shynrang uba ieit ïa la ka tnga u ieit ïa lade hi .

U Josaïah u la pyntwa ruh ïa ka jaka mane ha Bethel kob la tei da u syiem Jeroboam u khun jongu u Nebat , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh pop . U Josaïah u la pynbynta ruh ïa ka duwan , u pynpait lyngkhot lyngkhai ïa ki maw jong ka , pynlang u pyntlot phum ïa ki ; u la thang ruh ïa ka dur jong ka Asherah .
translation.en: Moreover the altar that was at Beth–el , and the high place which Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel to sin , had made , both that altar and the high place he brake down , and burned the high place , and stamped it small to powder , and burned the grove .

translation.kha: Nangta u Judah u ong ha ka Tamar ka pyrsa khim jong u , Khie kitei pait noh sha ka ïing u kpa jong pha bun to ïaisah riewkynthei tad Haduh ba u Shelah u khun jong nga un da radbah . U ong kumta naba u bthing Ïohi ba u Shelah un shah pynpyut kum ki Heshmon jong u . Kumta ka Tamar ka la lytar phai noh sha la ïing .
translation.en: Then said Judah to Tamar his daughter in law , Remain a widow at thy father s house , till Shelah my son be grown : for he said , Lest peradventure he die also , as his brethren did . And Tamar went and dwelt in her father s house .

translation.kha: Kumta ki paid Israel ki ïohknieh ïa ki nongbah jong ki Amor barben , lem bad ïa ka lehsbun bun ïa ki shnongrit baroh sawdong jongu ka , nabar ki la shong la sah hangta .
translation.en: And Israel took all these cities : and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites , in Heshbon , and in all the villages thereof .
Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills .
translation.kha: Ki briew jong phi ki mane ha ki duwan bad ïa ki dak kiba la pynïeng na ka bynta ka blei Asherah harud jong uwei pa uwei u dieng bajyrngam , ha ki kliar lum

translation.en: Who also hath made us able ministers of the new testament ; not of the letter , but of the spirit : for the letter killeth , but the spirit giveth life .
translation.kha: dei ma u , uba pynlah ïa ngi ban shakri ïa ka jutang kaba thymmai , kaba khlem kynthup ïa ka hukum ba la thoh hynrei kaba da U Mynsiem . Ka hukum ba la thoh ka wallam ïa ka jingïap , hynrei U Mynsiem u ai jingim .
Ki briew kaba sngewthuh ki husiar ban kiar na kaba sniew , ishyrkhei ki brisoh kiba mutlop kim suidñiew bad ki tur ruma kat shaba lap .
translation.en: A wise man feareth , and departeth from evil : but the fool rageth , and is confident .
The cloths of service , to do service in the holy place , the holy garments for Aaron the priest , and the garments of his sons , to minister in the priest s office .
translation.kha: bad ïa ki jaiñphong kiba ishongkun ba ki Lyngdoh ki dei ban phong haba ki shakri ha ka Jaka Kyntang — ki jaiñphong kiba kyntang na ka bynta u Aaron u lyngdoh , bad na ka bynta ki khun shynrang jong u .

translation.en: For every tree is known by his own fruit . For of thorns men do not gather figs , nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes .
translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa uwei u dieng la tip da u soh uba u pynmih ; phim ju kheit soh Dumbur na ki bniap shiah lane lum ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki bniap shiah buid .

translation.en: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year , on the first day of the month , that the tabernacle was reared up .
translation.kha: Kumta ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba nyngkong jong ka snem kaba ar hadien ba ki la mihnoh na Ijipt , la pynïeng ïa kata ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai .

Kumjuh jin , haba nga Dang triang bad ki Jentil , nga im kum u Jentil , shabar ka Hukum ki Jiw , khnang ban jop ïa ki Jingtylli . Kane kam mut ba nga khlem kohnguh ïa ka lawlynnong U Blei ; nga long shisha hapoh ka hukum U Khrismas .
translation.en: To them that are without law , as without law , ( being not without law to God , but under the law to Christ , ) that I might gain them that are without law .
Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished : and the children of Israel did according to all that the  Lord  commanded Moses , so did they .
translation.kha: Kumta keiñ la pyndep ïa ka jingtrei baroh ha ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat U  Trai . Ki Israel ki la thaw ïa kata baroh kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .

U Trai u jong , Kaba kut ka la ïan ïa kito kiba pynkhuid ïa lade na ka jingmane ba-thala , kiba ïaid paidbah ha ka kynruh sha ki kpa bathngan , bad kito kiba bam ïa ka doh sniang , bad ïa ka doh khnai sad kiwei pat ki jingbam ba-ijli .
translation.en: They that sanctify themselves , and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst , eating swine s flesh , and the abomination , and the mouse , shall be consumed together , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: ibha u Ahab u ïohi ïa u Elijah , u ong Me u nongshun jong nga , me la lap mo ïa nga ? Ho-oid , nga la lap , u Elijah u jubor , Me la aiti lut ïa lade Ban leh ïa kaei ka bymdei ha khmat U Trai .
translation.en: And Ahab said to Elijah , Hast thou found me , O mine enemy ? And he answered , I have found thee : because thou hast sold thyself to work evil in the sight of the  Lord .

translation.kha: film ju Tip kaei u syiem u pyrkhat ; ki jingmut jong u ki long sha lyndet ka jingtip jong ngi , dom jrong ka sahit bneng ne kumba jlew ka duriaw-bah .
translation.en: The heaven for height , and the earth for depth , and the heart of kings is unsearchable .

translation.kha: To kynmaw mynta kaei kob me la nong ha u Moses : ‘ Lada ma phi ki briew ka Isaia phin ym ïaineh ha nga , ngan pynsakma ïa phi hapdeng kyiuh ki jaitbynriew .
translation.en: Remember , I beseech thee , the word that thou commandedst thy servant Moses , saying , If ye transgress , I will scatter you abroad among the nations :
Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour , as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal .
translation.kha: Ki pyrkhat ba ki jingphohsniew ba ki ïathuh kin pynlong ïa ki briew jong nga ban klet ïa nga , kumba ki kpa jong ki , ki la klet ïa nga bad phai sha u Baal .

translation.en: There shall the great owl make her nest , and lay , and hatch , and gather under her shadow : there shall the vultures also be gathered , every one with her mate .
translation.kha: Ki dkhoh kin thaw ïa ki skum jong ki , kin kha pylleng bad pynmih ki khun , bad sumar ïa ki hangta . Ki pukni kin ïalum hangta , kiwei hadien kiwei pat .

translation.en: And he commanded a centurion to keep Paul , and to let him have liberty , and that he should forbid none of his acquaintance to minister or come unto him .
translation.kha: U la hukum ïa u rangbah pynïaidkam uba khmih ïa u Paul ban buh ïa u hapoh ka jingap phira , hynrei ban ai ha u katto katne ka jinglaitluid bad ban shah ïa ki paralok jong u ban pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong u .
Na kawei ka sngi sha kawei pat ki ju ïakynduh Kum ka kynhun hapoh ka Tabor , bad ki ïabam jingbam lang ha ki ïing jong ki , ki da bam da ka dohnud kaba kmen bad kaba sngewrit ,
translation.en: And they , continuing daily with one accord in the temple , and breaking bread from house to house , did eat their meat with gladness and singleness of heart ,
Look to yourselves , that we lose not those things which we have wrought , but that we receive a full reward .
translation.kha: To phin sumar ïa lade , namarkata , khnang ba phin ym duh noh ïa kaei kaba ngi , ngi la trei , hynrei phin ïohpdiang ïa ka bainong kaba pura .

translation.en: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth  ; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth  ; because the former troubles are forgotten , and because they are hid from mine eyes .
translation.kha: Te uno uno uba ha ka ri uba pan ïa ka jingkyrkhu , un pan ban ïoh jingkyrkhu na U Blei uba ïaineh . Uno uno uba shim smai un smai ha ka kyrteng U Blei uba ïaineh ; Ki jingjynjar kiba mynshuwa kin leit noh bad yn klet noh .

translation.en: For enquire , I pray thee , of the former age , and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers :
translation.kha: Khmih shipor sha ka jingstad mynbarim ; pyrkhat ïa ki jingshisha ba ki kpa jong ngi ki la nang .
Me pynum ïa la ki briew , A Trai bad ha ka jinglyng-a ki duwai ha me .
translation.en: Lord  , in trouble have they visited thee , they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them .

translation.kha: Kumno me tip ba u Saul bad u Jonathan ki la ïap ? u Dabid u la kylli ïa u .
translation.en: And David said unto the young man that told him , How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead ?

translation.kha: Uwei u briew na u paidbah u la ong ha U Jisu , Ko Nonghikai , to jong ïa u hynmen jyllang na ban ïabynta bad nga ïa ka jingdon jingïam kaba u kpa jong ngi u la iehnoh ïa ngi .
translation.en: And one of the company said unto him , Master , speak to my brother , that he divide the inheritance with me .
He that spared not his own Son , but delivered him up for us all , how shall he not with him also freely give us all things ?
translation.kha: Da shisha ym U Blei , u bym shym la tyngkai wat ïa la u jong U Khun hi , hynrei uba la ai sngewbha ïa u na ka bynta jong ngi baroh ! U la ai ha ngi ïa la U Khun — hato un ym ai sngewbha ïa kiei kiei baroh ?

translation.en: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubilee , then he shall count with him , and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption .
translation.kha: U dei ban pynphai shi bynta na ka dor ha kaba la thied ïa u kat kum ka jingdon jong ki snem kiba dang sah ,
U syiem u lah Ban imat ïa kano katno kaba u mon , katkum mihnoh na khmat jong u ; wat shongkha ha kaba kum kane ka jaka ba ma .
translation.en: Be not hasty to go out of his sight : stand not in an evil thing  ; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him .

translation.kha: bad haba u smat da ka Templ , u smai da ka bad da U Blei , uba don hangta ;
translation.en: And whoso shall swear by the temple , sweareth by it , and by him that dwelleth therein .

translation.kha: Ko ka ri Shebna bad ka ri Nasareth , kaba ha lynti Sha ka duriaw , ha kawei patar ka pud jong ka Jordan , ka Galilaïa , ka ri ki Jentil !
translation.en: The land of Zabulon , and the land of Nephthalim , by the way of the sea , beyond Jordan , Galilee of the Gentiles  ;

translation.kha: La ïathuh ha u Saul ba u Dabid u la leit sha Keilah , bad u ong , U Balei u la buh ïa u ha ka bor jong la . U Dabid u la pynngat ïa lade da kaba rupa sha ka nongrit ba la ker kynroh bad ki khyrdop kiba skhem .
translation.en: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah . And Saul said , God hath delivered him into mine hand  ; for he is shut in , by entering into a town that hath gates and bars .

translation.kha: Katta ka jingud jong ki ka kiew sha U Blei , uba la ïohsngew ïa ka jingud lad ki bad kynmaw ïa la ka jutang bad u Ahab , u Isaak bad u Jakob .
translation.en: And God heard their groaning , and God remembered his covenant with Abraham , with Isaac , and with Jacob .

translation.kha: Kumta ka Hannah ka punkhun malu ka kha khun shynriah . Ka la pynkyrteng ïa u , u Samuel , naba ka ong , Nga la pita ïa u na U Trai .
translation.en: Wherefore it came to pass , when the time was come about after Hannah had conceived , that she bare a son , and called his name Samuel , saying , Because I have asked him of the  Lord .
And he promised , and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude .
translation.kha: U Judas u la mynjur ïa kata bad u la sdang ban khmih ïa ka kabu kaba biang ban aiti ïa U Jisu ha ki khlem ka jingtip jong u paidbah shaphang kata .

translation.en: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous , and his ears are open unto their prayers : but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil .
translation.kha: Naba U Trai u khmih halor kiba hok bad u shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki ; hynrei u pyrshah ïa kito kiba leh ïa kaba sniew .
Naba da ka jingïap ba la kñia Jong U Kherith la pyllaitluid ïa im’ , kata ka long , ïa ki thup Jong ngi la map ei .
translation.en: In whom we have redemption through his blood , the forgiveness of sins , according to the riches of his grace ;

And Joash the king of Israel took Amaziah king of Judah , the son of Joash , the son of Jehoahaz , at Beth–shemesh , and brought him to Jerusalem , and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate , four hundred cubits .
translation.kha: U Jehoash u la ïohkem ïa u Amasaïah bad u ïalam ïa u sha Jerusalem . Hangta u la pynkhyllem ïa ka kynroh nongbah naduh ka Khyrdop Ephraim haduh ka Khyrdop Dong , ka jingjngai kumba arspah mitar .
Tang ma nga hi nga kop ïa ki jingthmu kba nga don na ka bynta jong phi , ki jingthmu ban wallam ha phi ka jingmanbha bad ym ka jingpynkut , ki jingthmu ban ïalamwir ïa ka lawei kaba phi ap kyrmen .
translation.en: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you , saith the  Lord  , thoughts of peace , and not of evil , to give you an expected end .

translation.kha: Haba ki briew ki ïakhawai , bad uwei u shoh da u maw ne u kura da ka kti ïa nawei pat khleiñ da pynïap ïa u , yn ym pynkhamti ïa u ,
translation.en: And if men strive together , and one smite another with a stone , or with his fist , and he die not , but keepeth his bed :
And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli , that the iniquity of Eli s house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever .
translation.kha: Namar kata nga la pynbna da ka jingsngewkhia ba ha ka ïing u Eli yn ym don jingkñia lane ka jingainguh kaba lah ban weng noh ïa kane ka pop bashyrkhei ba ka ïing jong u ka la leh .
Kan ym da donburom ïa phi ban da ong , namsop kin ïohi katno phin long kiba sngur bad ba donbok ha ka jingurlong jingjam jong phi .
translation.en: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba khatsan uta u bnai , ka Jingkhawai Niam U Kpu Bakhlem Thiat ka sdang ; Hynñiew sngi lynter phim dei don bam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .
translation.en: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the  Lord  : seven days ye must eat unleavened bread .
And the waters decreased continually until the tenth month : in the tenth month , on the first day of the month , were the tops of the mountains seen .
translation.kha: Kata ka um ruh ka la nang hiar nang hiar , bad ha ka sngi kaba nyngkong jong u bnai uba shiphew , ki kliar lum ki la paw .
To ai khublei ïa uei pa uwei na ki briew jongu U Blei kiba ha U khriat Jisu . Ki parabangeit hangne lem bad nga ki phah sha phi ki jingkhublei jong ki .
translation.en: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus . The brethren which are with me greet you .

translation.kha: Ki ïohi ïa ka kynhun ki nongïohipaw ba ki ïashad bad ki ïarisa , lem bad ïa u Samuel uba u ïalam na khmat . Nangta U Mynsiem U Blei u wanrah hiar tyllep ha ki rangbah jong u Saul , malade ki ruh ki sdang ngab ïashad bad ïarisa .
translation.en: And Saul sent messengers to take David : and when they saw the company of the prophets prophesying , and Samuel standing as appointed over them , the Spirit of God was upon the messengers of Saul , and they also prophesied .
And in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against the  Lord  : this is that king Ahaz .
translation.kha: Katba ki jingjynjar ki nang jur , u Ahas u la leh pop shuh shuh pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: Even so the tongue is a little member , and boasteth great things . Behold , how great a matter a little fire kindleth !
translation.kha: Kumta ka long bad u thylliej : La u long uba rit , u lah ban sngewsarong shaphang kiei kiei kiba khraw . Shu pyrkhat kat ka  lawbah lah ban pynpluh ïa ka da i thylliej ding iba rit !

Khie leit bad to wad kaei ka jingmut ha ka Jingthoh Bakhuid naba noh : ‘ Dei ïa ka jingrung ba nga kaweh , ym ki jingkynha ïa ki narud .’ nongbam syiem la wan don khot ïa ki briew badonburom , ishyrkhei ïa kiba la shah kyntu .
translation.en: But go ye and learn what that meaneth , I will have mercy , and not sacrifice : for I am not come to call the righteous , but sinners to repentance .
One way is by observing the things he has created and thinking deeply about what they tell us .
translation.kha: Kawei na ki lad ka long da kaba peit bniah ïa ki jingthaw kiba u la thaw bad ban pyrkhat jylliew ïa kaei kaba ki , ki ïathuh ïa ngi .
u Benaïah , u khun jong u Jehoïada u long babha khmih ïa ki nongïada jong u Dabid ; bad ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid ki la un-long ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites  ; and David s sons were chief rulers .

translation.kha: Kino kino kiba ieit ïa ka jingtip ki kwah ban don ba pynong haba ki bakla . Ka long ka jingbieit ban isih haba dat ba pynbeit .
translation.en: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge : but he that hateth reproof is brutish .

translation.kha: Kumta sa Kishion pat ki khot lang ïa ki syiem Philistia baroh bad ki ong , Pynphai noh ïa kane ka Synduk ka Jutang jong U Blei ki Eliel sha ka jaka jrong ka , ba kumta kan ym pynïap ïa ngi nabar ïa ki longïing jong Ngi . La ne ka jingkulmar baroh kawei ka nongbah namar ba U Blei u la pyndem jur ïa ki .
translation.en: So they sent and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines , and said , Send away the ark of the God of Israel , and let it go again to his own place , that it slay us not , and our people : for there was a deadly destruction throughout all the city  ; the hand of God was very heavy there .

translation.kha: bad nangta u la ong ha ka Dorbar , Ko para Israel , da sumar ïa kaei kaba Phi leh ïa kine ki briew .
translation.en: And said unto them , Ye men of Israel , take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men .

translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , ïathuh ha ki Israel ba haba u briew babha u har pop , ka jingleh babha ba u leh kam lai ban pynim ïa u . Lada u briew basniew , u sangeh kaba leh bymman , yn ym pynshitom ïa u , bad lapbah u briew babha u sdang ba-bang leh pop , ïa ka jingim jong u yn ym pynsah .
translation.en: Therefore , thou son of man , say unto the children of thy people , The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression : as for the wickedness of the wicked , he shall not fall thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness  ; neither shall the righteous be able to live for his righteousness in the day that he sinneth .
My son , be wise , and make my heart glad , that I may answer him that reproacheth me .
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , to long uba stad , bad ngan long uba kmen ; ngan don ka jubab ïa uno uno uba kem daw ïa nga .

Nangta u Joseph u ong ha la ki hynmen bad ha ki khun ki kti u khop jongno u , Neng dei ban leit ïathuh ha u syiem ba ki hynmen ki para jong nga bad ki ba-ha-ïing sem i pa kba shongneh ha Kanah ki la wan poi sha nga .
translation.en: And Joseph said unto his brethren , and unto his father s house , I will go up , and shew Pharaoh , and say unto him , My brethren , and my father s house , which were in the land of Canaan , are come unto me  ;

translation.kha: Wat pynbam ïa la u kpa da kaba ïathiah shongkha malu kano kano na ki tnga jong u .
translation.en: The nakedness of thy father s wife shalt thou not uncover : it is thy father s nakedness .

translation.kha: Ki die noh ïa ka jaka ka nang bad ka jingdon jingem jong ki , bad sam ïa ka pisa hapdeng jong ki baroh , katjuh kum kaei kabu uwei uwei u donburom .
translation.en: And sold their possessions and goods , and parted them to all men , as every man had need .

This is the word that the  Lord  hath spoken concerning him  ; The virgin the daughter of Zion hath despised thee , and laughed thee to scorn  ; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ka nongbah Jerusalem ka rkhie ïa me , ko Sennakherib , bad ka kyntait beiñ ïa me .

translation.en: I was wroth with my people , I have polluted mine inheritance , and given them into thine hand : thou didst shew them no mercy  ; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke .
translation.kha: Nga la bitar ïa ki briew jong nga ; nga la shim ïa ki kumba kim dei shuh ki jong nga : Nga buh ïa ki ha ka bor jong pha , bad pham pyn-i jinglehisynei ïa ki ; wat ïa kiba la tymmen pha leh da kaba tyngeh .

Shaphang ka jait Judith u ong , Ko Trai , to shahshkor haba ki kyrpad ban ïoh jingïarap ; Tehsong ïa ki khwai nabar la ki para jaiñjot . Ïaleit na ka bynta jong ki , ko Trai , Bad ïarap ïa ki pyrsad ïa ki Nongshun jong ki .
translation.en: And this is the blessing of Judah : and he said , Hear ,  Lord  , the voice of Judah , and bring him unto his people : let his hands be sufficient for him  ; and be thou an help to him from his enemies .
Every valley shall be exalted , and every mountain and hill shall be made low : and the crooked shall be made straight , and the rough places plain :
translation.kha: To pyndap ha man la ka jaka them ; to pynmadan ïa man la u lumbah , ki lumrit ki kylla madan , bad ïa ki jaka khohruh khohram yn pynjlih .
Ngi jingkit ba U Jisu u la ïaphah bad u la ñiat , bad kumta ngi ngeit ba U Blei un shim pat malu U Jisu ïa kito ibha la ïap da kaba ngeit ha u .
translation.en: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again , even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai’ u la kner ïa la ka kti bad u la ktah ïa ki rmiang shyntur jongno de , bad u la ong ha nga , To shah , nga ai ha me ki kyntien kaba me dei ban kren .
translation.en: Then the  Lord  put forth his hand , and touched my mouth . And the  Lord  said unto me , Behold , I have put my words in thy mouth .

translation.kha: Ki khun shynrang jong u Kanaan — u Sidon , u khulom nyngkong jong u , bad u Heth — kiba long ki kpa tymmen jong ki briew kiba kheiñ jait na ki .
translation.en: And Canaan begat Sidon his firstborn , and Heth ,

translation.kha: Wat pynjahburom ïa la ki khun kyntur da kaba pynhieng nuti ïa ki ha ki jaka mane bleithaw ; lama phoi leh kumta , phin phai noh sha kiwei ki blei bad ka ri kan jyllei da ka jingjyrsieh .
translation.en: Do not prostitute thy daughter , to cause her to be a whore  ; lest the land fall to whoredom , and the land become full of wickedness .

translation.kha: Shna ïa ka jingdeng syiad na ka bynta u Rangbah Lyngdoh ban pynsakma ha kaba sngewthuh ïa ka mon jong U Blei . Shua ïa ka da kijuh ki tiar kiba la pyndonkam ha kaba tiduh ïa ka ephod , bad da kijuh ki jingsuh pynpur itynnat .
translation.en: And thou shalt make the breastplate of judgment with cunning work  ; after the work of the ephod thou shalt make it  ; of gold , of blue , and of purple , and of scarlet , and of fine twined linen , shalt thou make it .
And he said unto Balak , Stand here by thy burnt offering , while I meet the  Lord  yonder .
translation.kha: U Balaam u ong ha u Balak ,  Ïeng hangne harud ka jingainguh thang jong phi , katba nga nang leit ïakynduh ïa U Blei hangtai .
Ym tip ïa uno Un u briew ban ïathiah shongkha para shynrang . U Blei u isih eh ïa kata .
translation.en: Thou shalt not lie with mankind , as with womankind : it is abomination .

translation.kha: bad u Moses u la law noh ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh na u Aaron bad u pynkup ïa ki ha u Eleasar . Hangta ha kliar lum u Aaron u la ïap , bad u Moses bad u Eleasar ki wan hiar noh .
translation.en: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments , and put them upon Eleazar his son  ; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount : and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount .
And it came to pass , as soon as he had made an end of speaking , that , behold , the king s sons came , and lifted up their voice and wept : and the king also and all his servants wept very sore .
translation.kha: Mar ïadep kren ïa kane , ki khun shynrang jong u Dabid ki wan rung ; ki la sdang ban ïam , bad u Dabid lem bad ki rangbah synshar jong u ruh ki la ïa-ïam kthang .
Naba uno uno uba kwah don pynim ïa la ka jong ka jingriam un duh ne ïa ka ; hynrei uno uno u ban duh ino ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong at nabar na ka bynta ka Gospel un pynim ïa ka .
translation.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it  ; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel s , the same shall save it .

translation.kha: U Ahab u jubab , dong sa uwei , u Mikaïah u khun jong u Imrah . Hynrei nga isih ïa u namar um ju ïathuhlypa kaba bha ïa nga ; ka ju long borabor kaei Kaei kaba sniew . Phim dei ïa-ban ïong kumta ! u Jehoshaphat u jingjubab .
translation.en: And the king of Israel said unto Jehoshaphat , There is yet one man , by whom we may enquire of the  Lord  : but I hate him  ; for he never prophesied good unto me , but always evil : the same is Micaiah the son of Imlah . And Jehoshaphat said , Let not the king say so .
Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki synran jong u ban ym ïathuh hano hano ba u long U Messaïah .

translation.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly , when he sinneth by ignorance before the  Lord  , to make an atonement for him  ; and it shall be forgiven him .
translation.kha: U lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingpynkhuid ha ka duwan ban pynkhuid ïa phi na ka pop jong phi ; bad yn sa map ïa phi .

U Paulos u la pynbna , Da lei lei ha kano kano ka por men ym ïoh ban set ïa ki kjat jong nga . lada ngam ïoh ban sait ïa ki kjat jong me , U jongu u la jubab , men ym ïuh longïng thuh u synran jong per .
translation.en: Peter saith unto him , Thou shalt never wash my feet . Jesus answered him ,  If I wash thee not , thou hast no part with me .

translation.kha: A Trai U Bela Jong ki kpa tymmen jong ngi , me synshar ha bneng khlur ki jaitbynriew baroh jong ka pyrthei . Me long babha donbor bad babha khrawbor , bad ym don ba lah ban pyrshah ïa me .
translation.en: And said , O  Lord  God of our fathers , art not thou God in heaven ? and rulest not thou over all the kingdoms of the heathen ? and in thine hand is there not power and might , so that none is able to withstand thee ?

translation.kha: kan long kaba dei ïa phi ba-bang smat da ka kyrteng jong nga . Nangta baroh ki jaitbynriew kin ïakyrpad ïa nga pun ring ïa ki , bad kin ïar ïa nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt swear , The  Lord  liveth , in truth , in judgment , and in righteousness  ; and the nations shall bless themselves in him , and in him shall they glory .

translation.kha: Bad lada uno uno u briew u ong ei ei , ïathuh ha u , ‘ U Kynrad u donkam ïa ki ;’ bad Nangta un sa pyllait ïa ki shisyndon .
translation.en: And if any man say ought unto you , ye shall say , The Lord hath need of them  ; and straightway he will send them .

translation.kha: U angel jongu U Trai u la ong ha u Philip , To khreh bad loit shaphang shathie shuh —kata ka lynti kaba leit na Jerusalem sha Gasa . ( Kane ka longsyiem ka lynti ka im ju pyndonkam shuh mynta . )
translation.en: And the angel of the Lord spake unto Philip , saying , Arise , and go toward the south unto the way that goeth down from Jerusalem unto Gaza , which is desert .
He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack : but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse .
translation.kha: Ai ha kiba duk bad phin ym don ha ka jingkyrduh lano lano ruh . Lada phi khapbrip la ki khmat sha kiba duk , ki briew kiba bun kin tim ïa phi .

translation.en: The sea saw it , and fled : Jordan was driven back .
translation.kha: Ka Duriaw Basaw ka la khmih bad ka phet noh , ka wah Jordan ka la sangeh ban tuid .
pynlang sawphew tylli ki taiew tnaw rupa ha trai jong ki , ar ar tylli ki thliew tnen hapoh kawei ka jingker ban bat ïa kita ki tnaw jong ka ar tylli .
translation.en: And forty sockets of silver he made under the twenty boards  ; two sockets under one board for his two tenons , and two sockets under another board for his two tenons .

translation.kha: Shna ïa kine ki dieng jingbah da ka dieng akasia bad suit ïa ki da ka ksiar .
translation.en: And thou shalt make the staves of shittim wood , and overlay them with gold .

translation.kha: bad nga pisa shikatdei eh ïa ki jaitbynriew ibha sngewkmen ïa ka jingjar jar bad ka jingsuk . namar katba nga dang bat ïa ka jingbitar jong nga pyrsad ïa ki biria jongki ang , kito ki jaitbynriew ki la kham pynkynroi ïa ki jingshitom jong ki brup jong nga .
translation.en: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease : for I was but a little displeased , and they helped forward the affliction .

translation.kha: U Blei um shym la khot ïa ngi ban im ha ka jingthala , hynrei ha ka jinglongkhuid .
translation.en: For God hath not called us unto uncleanness , but unto holiness .

translation.kha: U la khot lang ïa ki synran jong u baroh bad u la ong ïa ki , Nga ong ïa phi! ba kane ka riewkynthei katba duk , ka la pynnoh khampoh bhor ha ka synduk jingtah ban ïa baroh khiew pat .
translation.en: And he called unto him his disciples , and saith unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , That this poor widow hath cast more in , than all they which have cast into the treasury :
For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God .
translation.kha: Ki ieit ïa ka jingpynksan u briew ban ïa ka jingpynksan na U Blei .

translation.en: Just tell me what's going on .
translation.kha: Shu iathuh ianga jia aiu .
Kat kum ki jingbit kiba khatwei jong u Dabid , ïa baroh’ ki Lebi la buh jingthoh ba kin shakri haba ki la ba-dap arphew snieh ka rta ,
translation.en: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above :

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki paidlang Israel ki long kum u kpu bym pat ih bha .
translation.en: Ephraim , he hath mixed himself among the people  ; Ephraim is a cake not turned .

translation.kha: U Troas u la pynlong ka jinghun bad ki bad u la suda ïa ki : Wah mane ïa kiwei ki blei ; kdew dem khlup ha ki lane shakuriaw ïa ki lane ai ki jingkñia ïa ki .
translation.en: With whom the  Lord  had made a covenant , and charged them , saying , Ye shall not fear other gods , nor bow yourselves to them , nor serve them , nor sacrifice to them :

translation.kha: bad u Moses u la leit kiew shata u lum ban ïashem bad U Blei . U Trai u la khot ïa u na u lum bad u la bthah ïa u ban ong ha ki Israel , ki khun ki ksiew u Jakob :
translation.en: And Moses went up unto God , and the  Lord  called unto him out of the mountain , saying , Thus shalt thou say to the house of Jacob , and tell the children of Israel  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei la pynhiar ïa nga ha ka shang na ka jingkynthih kaba ha ka kynroh bad la phlait im ïa nga na u .
translation.en: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall , and escaped his hands .
The nobles held their peace , and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth .
translation.kha: wat ki rangbah kiba kham paw eh ki sngap jar .

translation.en: The  Lord  preserveth the simple : I was brought low , and he helped me .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ïada ïa ki bym don jingïarap ; haba nga la don ha ka jingma , u la pyllait im ïa nga .
Haba u Ur u la wan poi , u Dabid u kyllut ïa u la u Joab bad ki kynoi shipai ki bit ki biang , bad kumno ka jingïaleh ka long .
translation.en: And when Uriah was come unto him , David demanded of him how Joab did , and how the people did , and how the war prospered .

translation.kha: Uno du kaba mon ban leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u kwah , un tip la kaei kaba nga hikai ka wan na U Blei ne la sa krai ha ka bor jong de hi .
translation.en: If any man will do his will , he shall know of the doctrine , whether it be of God , or whether I speak of myself .

translation.kha: Lada phi shahshkor ïa nga , phin sa thup kaei kaba dadien , kaba hok , bad kaba ïadei beit . Phin sa Tip ïa kaei kaba Phi dei banbeiñ leh .
translation.en: Then shalt thou understand righteousness , and judgment , and equity  ; yea , every good path .

translation.kha: Bad dalade ka khat jong phi! ka pynlong ïa phi ban haduh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong phi , to khlur dara to bret noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa phi ban rung sha ka jingimat tang da Kawei ka khmat ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tyllai ki khmat bad ban shah bret shaphang ka dujok ding .
translation.en: And if thine eye offend thee , pluck it out , and cast it from thee : it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye , rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki Jia ki la bishni bad ki la lumrit ïa ki riewkhuid bymsalia na ki lynti bad na u paidlang . Ki la pyningkhong ïa ka shnong baroh kawei bad ki la tur ïa ka ïing jong u briew wahbah kyrteng u Jason , ha ka jingpyrshang ban lap ïa u Paul bad u Silas bad ban wanlam ïa ki shabar sha u paidbah .
translation.en: But the Jews which believed not , moved with envy , took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort , and gathered a company , and set all the city on an uproar , and assaulted the house of Jason , and sought to bring them out to the people .

translation.kha: U nongtuh u wan tang ban ïoh tuh , ban pynïap dara ban pynjot . Nga la wan khnang ba phan ïoh ïa ka jingim — ka jingim ha ka jingdap kyrhai jongngi ka .
translation.en: The thief cometh not , but for to steal , and to kill , and to destroy : I am come that they might have life , and that they might have it more abundantly .
And I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians , and out of the hand of all that oppressed you , and drave them out from before you , and gave you their land  ;
translation.kha: Nga la pyllait ïa phi na ki Ijipt bad na ki briew kiba ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi hangne ha kane ka ri . Nga la beh noh ïa ki katba phi nang tur sha khmat , bad nga la ai ha phi ïa ka ri jong ki .
Nangta U Trai u la ai ha ki Israel ïa ki nongïalam bakha la pyllait im ïa ki na ki nonglute .
translation.en: Nevertheless the  Lord  raised up judges , which delivered them out of the hand of those that spoiled them .

translation.kha: Harud ki wahbah ka Babilon ngi la shongsah ; hangta ngi ïam haba ngi kynmaw ïa ka Seïon .
translation.en: By the rivers of Babylon , there we sat down , yea , we wept , when we remembered Zion .
And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived , and hid herself five months , saying ,
translation.kha: Katto katne por hadien , ka Elisabeth ka tnga jong u , ka la punkhun bad kam shym mih na ïing san bnai .

Ki briew ka Heshbon , ki kyang ! Ïa ka Ai la pynjot ! Ki kynthei ka radbah , ki leit ïam sngewsih ! Ki phong ïa ki jaiñ khain bad ïam pangnud . Ki mareh lamler . Ïa u Molekh u plie lad phi yn ïalam mraw , lem bad ki lyngdoh bad ki khun syiem .
translation.en: Howl , O Heshbon , for Ai is spoiled : cry , ye daughters of Rabbah , gird you with sackcloth  ; lament , and run to and fro by the hedges  ; for their king shall go into captivity , and his priests and his princes together .

translation.kha: Kumta u syiem Balak u la phah ïa ki nonglamktien ïa-ban ïanguh ïa u Balaam u khun jrong u Beor , uba don ha Pethor hajan ka wah Ïuphratis ha ka ri jngai ki Amaw . Ki wallam sha u ïa kane ka khublei na u Balak , Nga kwah ïa phi ban Tip ba kaei ka jaitbynriew baroh kawei ka la wiang na jingpeit ; kita ki briew ki la shiliang kylleng bad ki thmu ban knieh ïa ka ri jong ngi .
translation.en: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor , which is by the river of the land of the children of his people , to call him , saying , Behold , there is a people come out from Egypt : behold , they cover the face of the earth , and they abide over against me :

translation.kha: Haba ki kti u Moses ki la sakhrai , u Aaron bad u Hur ki rah uwei u maw ba un shong , katba ma ki pat ki ïeng ha syndah jong u , uwei sha kadiang bad uwei pat sha kamon , bad ki kyrshan ïa ki kti jong u , ki da kyrshan ïaskhem ïa ki kumta haduh ban da sep ka sngi .
translation.en: But Moses  hands were heavy  ; and they took a stone , and put it under him , and he sat thereon  ; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands , the one on the one side , and the other on the other side  ; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun .

translation.kha: Naba U Tiras u khmih halor kiba hok bad u shahshkor ïa ki jingduwai jong ki ; hynrei u pyrsad ïa kito kiba ai ïa kaba sniew .
translation.en: For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous , and his ears are open unto their prayers : but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohpdiang ïa ka khubor Jong kata ka jingbitar shla malu ka jingsarong jong me , bad mynta ngan buh ïa u khwai ha ka khmut jong me bad u bthuh ha ka shynraiñ jong me bad ngan pynphai pat na ka lynti ha kaba me la wan .
translation.en: Because thy rage against me , and thy tumult , is come up into mine ears , therefore will I put my hook in thy nose , and my bridle in thy lips , and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kren ha per hadien ba u Nebusaradan , u rangbah shipai , u la ia pyllait ïa nga ha rahah . Ïa nga la leit ïalam shata ha ki kynjri , ryngkat bad baroh kiwei pat ki briew na Jerusalem bad Judah ïa kiba la leit ïalam kum ki koidi shiah Babilonia .
translation.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , after that Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah , when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah , which were carried away captive unto Babylon .

translation.kha: To ïong joit bad mihnoh ; naba ym don shuh ka jingthngan hangne . Ki pop jong phi ki la long jingtip sha ka jingpynjot ïa kane ka jaka .
translation.en: Arise ye , and depart  ; for this is not your rest : because it is polluted , it shall destroy you , even with a sore destruction .

translation.kha: Hadien ba ka la mihnoh ngab leit tam kew , u Boses u hukum ïa ki nongtrei , Shah ïa ka ban tam kad na ka jaka ha kaba ki song ki don , bad wat ong ei ei ban khang ïa ka . Nalor kata , sei ruh katto katne ki kew na ki song bad ieh ïa ki ba kan ïoh tam .
translation.en: And let fall also some of the handfuls of purpose for her , and leave them , that she may glean them , and rebuke her not .

translation.kha: Kaei ka ban dei ka ïajubab ?
translation.en: What will be the answer ?

translation.kha: bad ba phi lah ban ïathuh ha ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kumno nga la pynpaw bieit ïa ki nong Ijipt haba at leh ïa kine ki kambah . Phi baroh phin tip ba nga long U Trai .
translation.en: And that thou mayest tell in the ears of thy son , and of thy son s son , what things I have wrought in Egypt , and my signs which I have done among them  ; that ye may know how that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha Kane ka rukom , ka ktah jongki U Trai ka la ïai saphriang bad nang khlaiñbor .
translation.en: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed .
Let not the swift flee away , nor the mighty man escape  ; they shall stumble , and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates .
translation.kha: Kito kiba mareh stet kim shym lah ban phet ; ki shipai kim shym lah ban lait . Ha ka phang bashatei , hajan ka Ïuphratis , ki jynthut bad ki kyllon .
Me un-long U Blei jong la , malu nga ainguh ïa me ; ngan pynbna ïa ka jingkhraw jong me .
translation.en: Thou art my God , and I will praise thee : thou art my God , I will exalt thee .

translation.kha: Ngan pynmihpat ïa ka jutang jong nga bad pha , pynlang phang tip ba nga long U Tharai .
translation.en: And I will establish my covenant with thee  ; and thou shalt know that I am the  Lord  :

translation.kha: U ong ha u samla nongrah atiar jongngi u , shi ïa ka waitlam jong me bad ting ïap ïa nga , Ban ym sha ba kyang ki Philistia ki bym don blei kin ïuhbeiñ halor jong nga . Hynrei uta u kup u la khynñiuh tyngeh ban leh ïa ka . Kumta u Saul u sei ïa la ka waitlam bad u rijied ïa lade ha ka .
translation.en: Then said Saul to his armourbearer , Draw thy sword , and thrust me through therewith  ; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me . But his armourbearer would not  ; for he was sore afraid . So Saul took a sword , and fell upon it .

translation.kha: Ban ïoh ïa ka jingtip , nyngkong phi dei ban don ka jingtiengburom ïa U Trai . Ki briew kiba mutlop kim don ka jingñiewkor ïa ka jingstad dara ki kynta ban shah hikai .
translation.en: The fear of the  Lord  is the beginning of knowledge : but fools despise wisdom and instruction .

translation.kha: Hynrei haduh kane ka sngi um pat shyiap la ai ha phi ban shemphang ïa kaei kaba pa’ la mad .
translation.en: Yet the  Lord  hath not given you an heart to perceive , and eyes to see , and ears to hear , unto this day .

translation.kha: te un tang Shu tip ba u la leh pop kumta , un wallam kum ka jingainguh jong u ïa ka blang kynthei ka im don kano kano ka jingduna .
translation.en: Or if his sin , which he hath sinned , come to his knowledge : then he shall bring his offering , a kid of the goats , a female without blemish , for his sin which he hath sinned .
Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest , who was also chief governor in the house of the  Lord  , heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things .
translation.kha: Mynba u Pashhur u lyngdoh , u khun jong u Immer , uba long u rangbah pynïaidkam bahakhlieh duh jong ka Templ , u la ïohsngew ba nga pynbna ïa kine kiei kiei ,

translation.en: Unless the  Lord  had been my help , my soul had almost dwelt in silence .
translation.kha: Lada U  Trai  um shym la ïarap ïa nga , ngan jin da la leit kloi sha ka ri kaba jar jar .

translation.en: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown : but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish .
translation.kha: Ka ïing jong u briew uba bha kan dang ïeng hi hadien ba la pynjot ïa ka ïing jong u nongleh ïa kaba sniew .
Haba u Shimei u jingïashoh ba ki don ha Gath , u la teh jingim ïa la ka kam bad u la leit sha u Syiem Akhish ha Gath , ban wad ïa la ki mraw . U la lap ïa ki bun u wan ïalam paw ïa ki sha ïing .
translation.en: And Shimei arose , and saddled his ass , and went to Gath to Achish to seek his servants : and Shimei went , and brought his servants from Gath .

translation.kha: Ha man ba ki kynhun langbrot baroh ki la ïabuh lang hangta , ki nongap langbrot ki ju pyntyllun sharud ïa uta u maw bun ki ai um ïa ki . Nangta ki buh pat ïa uta u maw ha kajuh ka jaka .
translation.en: And thither were all the flocks gathered : and they rolled the stone from the well s mouth , and watered the sheep , and put the stone again upon the well s mouth in his place .
And Iron , and Migdal–el , Horem , and Beth–anath , and Beth–shemesh  ; nineteen cities with their villages .
translation.kha: ka Yiron , ka Migdalel , ka Horem , ka Bethanath , bad ka Beth Shemesh : khatkhyndai tylli ki nongbah , lem bad ki nongrit sawdong jong ki .
Hato ka sim kane shu nud ha ka jingriam lymda la pynap jingriam ïa ka ? Hato ka shangkhawiah ka ju bsiat hi lymda ngat ei ei ha ka ?
translation.en: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth , where no gin is for him ? shall one take up a snare from the earth , and have taken nothing at all ?
Thy sons have fainted , they lie at the head of all the streets , as a wild bull in a net : they are full of the fury of the  Lord  , the rebuke of thy God .
translation.kha: Ha ki khongdong ha man ki surok bah ki briew jong pha ki kyllon noh na ka jingtlot ; ki long kum ka skei kaba la ngat ha ka jar jong u nongbeh mrad . Ki la mad ïa ka bor jong ka jingbitar U Blei .
Ïa uno uno uba pynkharoi ïa lade yn pyntrei , bad ïa uno uno uba pynrit ïa put yn pynkhreh .
translation.en: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased  ; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted .

translation.kha: Kine ki lai ngut kiba la shah pynïap ha u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u , ki long kiba hiarpateng na ki ramhah ha Gath .
translation.en: These were born unto the giant in Gath  ; and they fell by the hand of David , and by the hand of his servants .

translation.kha: U Jonadab u ong ha u Amnon , Phi dih u khun jong u syiem ; pynbun na kamai ka sngi shaei kawei pat nga ïohi ba phi i sngewsih . Jia aïu ? Nga lehbha ïa ka Tamar , ka para jong u Absalom , uba ïatong shi na bad nga na ijuh i pa , u la jubab .
translation.en: And he said unto him , Why art thou , being the king s son , lean from day to day ? wilt thou not tell me ? And Amnon said unto him , I love Tamar , my brother Absalom s sister .

translation.kha: To shaniah ha U tharai , phi ki lyngdoh jong U Blei . U ïarap ïa phi bad u ïada ïa phi! .
translation.en: O house of Aaron , trust in the  Lord  : he is their help and their shield .

translation.kha: Ki la kynting pyut pui halor ki khlieh jong ki , ki la lynñiar bad ki la ïambriew , da kaba ong , Katno kaba shyieng ! kato kaba itriem ïa ka nongbah kaba khynraw ! Ka long ka nongbeh ha kaba baroh Ibbah ei ki liengbah kiba ïaid ha ki duriaw ki la kylla riewspah ha ka spah jong ka ! Bad ha ka Sei kyndit ka la duh lwait ïa kiei keiñ baroh !
translation.en: And they cast dust on their heads , and cried , weeping and wailing , saying , Alas , alas , that great city , wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness ! for in one hour is she made desolate .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ha u , Uno uno babha sdang ban lur Bad nangto uba ïai kyrtiang dien um longkmie uba myntoi ïa ka Hoham U Blei .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  No man , having put his hand to the plough , and looking back , is fit for the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: Un aiti ha phi ïa ki syiem jongnga ki . phiah pynïap ïa ki , Bad yn klet noh ïa ki . Yn ym don mano mano ban khang ïa phi ; phin pynjot ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand , and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven : there shall no man be able to stand before thee , until thou have destroyed them .

translation.kha: Baroh ki briew bad ki nongïaleh jong ki , ki la ïamynjur ban pyllaitluid noh ïa la ki mraw mala ban ym pynlong mraw sha ïa ki .
translation.en: Now when all the princes , and all the people , which had entered into the covenant , heard that every one should let his manservant , and every one his maidservant , go free , that none should serve themselves of them any more , then they obeyed , and let them go .

translation.kha: To da pyrkhat ïa kadei kaba u la ïaid lyngba , kumta u la nguh ïa lat ban shah kito ha ki nongpop ! Kumjuh wat ai ba phin noh mynsiem bad kynran dien .
translation.en: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself , lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds .
Don't you want to stop Tom ?
translation.kha: Phim kwah pynsangeh ia u Tom ?
Phai don u briew uba bha shisha , umbah hok bad uba beit .
translation.en: But if a man be just , and do that which is lawful and right ,

translation.kha: Riphath ïa ki sngaid kiba mynbarim , ïa ka por ba la leit noh , kylli na la ki kpa ban ïathuh ha phi aïu ka la jai , kylli na ki tymmen ban ïathuh ha phi ïa ka mynnor .
translation.en: Remember the days of old , consider the years of many generations : ask thy father , and he will shew thee  ; thy elders , and they will tell thee .

translation.kha: Ïa kata ka lynghoh bad ka kem kaba don hangta la dulir na ki Hit . Tep ïa nga hangta .
translation.en: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth .

translation.kha: Pha la pynkdang katto katba tylli ki jaiñ jong phar ïa-ban pynitynnat ïa ki jaka mane jyllang phai , bad kum ka nuti , pha la ai ïa lade ha uei uwei baroh .
translation.en: And of thy garments thou didst take , and deckedst thy high places with divers colours , and playedst the harlot thereupon : the like things shall not come , neither shall it be so .

translation.kha: Haba barabor ki la ïaktah , u la ong ha la ki synriah , To khar ïa ki lyngkhot kiba tam ; ngim dei ban pynsep-ei .
translation.en: When they were filled , he said unto his disciples ,  Gather up the fragments that remain , that nothing be lost .

translation.kha: Naba ki la ïohsngew ïa ki ba ki kren ha ki ktien kiba pher bad ki da ïaroh ïa ka jingkhraw jongu U Blei . U Petros u la kren :
translation.en: For they heard them speak with tongues , and magnify God . Then answered Peter ,

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba sniew ki sngap ïa ki jingman kiba sniew , bad ki nongbishar ki sngap ïa ki jingshukor .
translation.en: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips  ; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue .

translation.kha: Ki Briew kin aiti noh ïa la ki bymman ki para ban pynïap ïa ki , bad ki kpa kin leh kumjuh ïa la ki khun , ki khwan ki ïeng pyrshah ïa la ki Kmen ki kparad bad kin afi ïa ki ba-bang shah pynsep .
translation.en: Now the brother shall betray the brother to death , and the father the son  ; and children shall rise up against their parents , and shall cause them to be put to death .
When a wicked man dieth , his expectation shall perish : and the hope of unjust men perisheth .
translation.kha: Haba ki bymman ki ïap , ka jingkyrmen jong ki ruh ka ïap bad ki . Ka jingsngewskhem halor ka spah kam ïalam shano shano ruh .

translation.en: And if a man shall lie with his uncle s wife , he hath uncovered his uncle s nakedness : they shall bear their sin  ; they shall die childless .
translation.kha: Lada u briew u ïathiah shongkha bad ka tnga jong u kñi jong u , u pynkheiñ burom ïa la u kñi , kumta ma u bad kata ka briew kin kit hi ïa la ka pop ; baroh ar ngut kin ïap khlem khun .

translation.en: In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes ,  Are ye come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me ? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple , and ye laid no hold on me .
translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la kren ha u paidbah ,  Hato phi donkam ban wan bad ki waitlam bad ki dieng tangon ban kem ïa nga , la kumba nga dei u riewsniew ? Man la ka sngi nga la shong bad hikai hapoh ka Templ , bad phim shym la kem ïa nga .

Hato phim tip) ba U Tiras , U Blei ki Israel , u la pynong ka ïong bad u Dabid ka bym lah ban pynkhlaiñ , da kaba ai ha u Bad ha ki khun ki ktieh jongngi u ïa ka jinglong syiem junom khlur ki Israel ?
translation.en: Ought ye not to know that the  Lord  God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David for ever , even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt ?

translation.kha: U briew um dei ban pynïakhlad , te , ïa kadei kaba U Blei u la pynïasoh lang .
translation.en: What therefore God hath joined together , let not man put asunder .

translation.kha: Ong ha u Aaron bad ha ki khun shynrang jong u , ñiewburom ïa ki jingïania kiba kyntang ba ki Israel ki la pynkyntang sha nga , ba kumta phin ym pynkyllaiñ burom ïa ka kyrteng kaba khuid jong nga . Nga long U Trai .
translation.en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons , that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel , and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me : I am the  Lord .
The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise .
translation.kha: Lada phi shahshkor haba phi shah pynbeit , phi long kiba stad .
Men shu khmih ïa kata ka ri na jngai , ka ri ba nga ai ha ki Jesreel , hynrei men ym ïoh leit shok shata .
translation.en: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee  ; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel .
Wherefore will ye plead with me ? ye all have transgressed against me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kaei ka jingujor jong pha ? Balei pha la ïeng ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga ?
Mynba U Trai u la krai ha u mawshun ha ka ri Ijipt , u la ong , Na long U Trai .
translation.en: And it came to pass on the day when the  Lord  spake unto Moses in the land of Egypt ,

translation.kha: Ka long hangta ba u ïohi ïa ka jingstad bad u tynjuh ïa ka pynleit jong ka — U ai ïa ka , ka jingmynjur Jong u .
translation.en: Then did he see it , and declare it  ; he prepared it , yea , and searched it out .
Now therefore the wheat , and the barley , the oil , and the wine , which my lord hath spoken of , let him send unto his servants :
translation.kha: Kumta mynta to phah sha ngi ïa u kew , u barli , ka waiñ , bad ka umphniang Olib ba phi la kular .

Mynta leit noh sha la ïing bad bam bad dih sngewbha . Ïasam ïa ka jingbam bad ka aiñ bad kito ki bym dap bymlah biang . Mynta ka sngi ka long kaba khur ha U Trai jong ngi , kumta dak sngewsih . Ka jingkmen kaba U Trai u la ai ha phi kan pynlong khlaiñ ïa phi .
translation.en: Then he said unto them , Go your way , eat the fat , and drink the sweet , and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared : for this day is holy unto our Lord : neither be ye sorry  ; for the joy of the  Lord  is your strength .

translation.kha: Pynïeng ïa u ha khmat u Eleasar u lyngkdong bad u paidlang baroh , sad hangta ha khmat jong ki baroh to pynbynta ba ma u un long u nongmih bujli jong me .
translation.en: And set him before Eleazar the priest , and before all the congregation  ; and give him a charge in their sight .

translation.kha: Hato phi kwah ban pynlong ïa U Blei ba un thut shen ? Hato ngi pynkoit ba ngi kham khlaw ban ïa u ?
translation.en: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy ? are we stronger than he ?

translation.kha: Bun na ki , ki la ngeit , bad bun ki kynthei Kyrinios kiba ha ka kyrdan ba-halor ha ka jingbynta ka sahlang bad bun ki rangbah Grik hima ki la jingkit .
translation.en: Therefore many of them believed  ; also of honourable women which were Greeks , and of men , not a few .

translation.kha: Ym don jingdum ka ban dum tliw patar ban buhrieh ïa u nongpop na U Blei .
translation.en: There is no darkness , nor shadow of death , where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves .

And he delivered them into the hands of the Gibeonites , and they hanged them in the hill before the  Lord  : and they fell all seven together , and were put to death in the days of harvest , in the first days , in the beginning of barley harvest .
translation.kha: U Dabid u aiti ïa ki ha ki paid Gibeon , kiba la phasi ïa ki halor u lum ha khmat U  Trai  — baroh hynñiew ngut ki la ïa-ïap lang . Ka dei haba jan kut artat ka pyrem , ha kaba sdang ka aïom ot barli , haba la pynïap ïa ki .
U Joshua u ong ha ki , Phi long ki sakhi ïa lade hi ïa ka jingshisha ba phi la lngaid banbeiñ shakri ïa U TRAI’ . Ho-oid , ki ong , ngi long ki sakhi .
translation.en: And Joshua said unto the people , Ye are witnesses against yourselves that ye have chosen you the  Lord  , to serve him . And they said , We are witnesses .

translation.kha: kane ka mut ba ka jingïap ka trei hapoh jong i'u , hynrei , ka jingtem ka trei hapoh jong phi .
translation.en: So then death worketh in us , but life in you .

translation.kha: Lada por phuh samrkhie bad pyrshang ban klet ïa la ka jingpang , baroh ka jingshitom jong nga ka wan biang ban pynkhuslai ïa nga . Nga tip ba U Blei u rai pynrem ïa nga .
translation.en: I am afraid of all my sorrows , I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent .

translation.kha: Nga , U Trai , ngan pyllait im ïa baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob , bad kin ai ka jingïaroh ïa nga .
translation.en: In the  Lord  shall all the seed of Israel be justified , and shall glory .

translation.kha: Ka ri kan long kaba shah ieh kynjah tam ha ka pyrthei , bad ïa ki nongbah jongngi ka yn ieh kum ha ki jingjot .
translation.en: And they shall be desolate in the midst of the countries that are desolate , and her cities shall be in the midst of the cities that are wasted .

translation.kha: U Judas u la mynjur ïa katai bad u la shang ngab khmih ïa ka kabu kaba beiñ ban aiti ïa U Jeshua ha ki khlem ka jingtip jong u paidbah shaphang —kata .
translation.en: And he promised , and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude .

translation.kha: Nga sngewkmen shapoh ka jingkhwan u Stephanas , u Phortunatos , bad u Akhaikos ; ki la bujli ïa ka jingbymdon jong phi bad ki la pynsngewbha ïa nga , kumba ki la pynsngewbha ïa ph .
translation.en: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus : for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied .

translation.kha: pynïap phi iam ïa kaei kaba bha bad phin ngeit ïa katei kiba sner . Phi khoh snieh im ïa ki briew jong nga bad phi tar ïa ka doh na ki shyieng jong ki .
translation.en: Who hate the good , and love the evil  ; who pluck off their skin from off them , and their flesh from off their bones  ;

translation.kha: U syiem Sheshai u sngewthuh ïa kane ba ka mut ba tista don ka jingsuk bun jingshngain shi jingtem jong u , kumta u jubab , Ka khubor ba me la ai ïa nga na U Trai ka long Kaba bha .
translation.en: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah , Good is the word of the  Lord  which thou hast spoken . And he said , Is it not good , if peace and truth be in my days ?
And the man increased exceedingly , and had much cattle , and maidservants , and menservants , and camels , and asses .
translation.kha: Ha kane ka rukom u Jakob u kylla long uba riewspah eh . U la don shibun ki kynhun jingri , ki mraw , ki ut , bad ki kada .
Dang pathaw phrang ha ka sngur kaba bud , uwei pa eiei u la kular bad pynskhem da kaba shim smat . U Isaak u khublei khatduh ïa ki , bad ki ïakhlad kum ki paralok .
translation.en: And they rose up betimes in the morning , and sware one to another : and Isaac sent them away , and they departed from him in peace .

translation.kha: Ki la jingshyrkhei , da kaba pyrkhat ba ki ïohi ïa ka rngai .
translation.en: But they were terrified and affrighted , and supposed that they had seen a spirit .

translation.kha: Jin haduh sawphew snem nga la ijli ïa kito ki briew . Nga la jong , ‘ Khatduh katne ki long kiba shetkylla ! Ki kyndat ban kohnguh ïa ki suda jongki na .’
translation.en: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation , and said , It is a people that do err in their heart , and they have not known my ways :

translation.kha: Namar lada phi map ïa kiew ïa ki jingpalat kiba ki la kun ïa ph , U Kpa jong phi babha ha bneng un map ruh ïa phi .
translation.en: For if ye forgive men their trespasses , your heavenly Father will also forgive you :
And she went , and came , and gleaned in the field after the reapers : and her hap was to light on a part of the field belonging unto Boaz , who was of the kindred of Elimelech .
translation.kha: Kumta ka Ruth ka leit sha ki lyngkha bad ka ïaid nadien jong ki nongot , ka da tam ïa u kew uba ki ieh . Ka leit jia ryngkhat ba ka don ha ka lyngkha kaba dei ka jong u Boas .

A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki nonghikai ka Hukum ! “Phi la bat noh ïa u shabi uba pla ïa ka khyrdop sha ka ïong jngai ka jingtip ; pa hi phim loit thung shapoh , nabar phi khang ïa wer kiba ïapyrshang ban rung shapoh !
translation.en: Woe unto you , lawyers ! for ye have taken away the key of knowledge : ye entered not in yourselves , and them that were entering in ye hindered .

translation.kha: Shisien ka sngi , ka iathuh ianga ba ka kwah miaw .
translation.en: One day , she told me that she wanted a pet cat .

And the great city was divided into three parts , and the cities of the nations fell : and great Babylon came in remembrance before God , to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath .
translation.kha: Ïa ka nongbah kaba khraw la kad ha ki lai bynta , bad ïa ki nongbah jong ki ri baroh la pynjot . U Blei u la kynmaw ïa ka Babilon bakhraw bad u la pynlong ïa ka ban dih ïa ka waiñ na ka khuri jong u — ka waiñ jong ka jingbitar shla jong u .
Hato ngam shym la don lymda bun bthah ki lamwir ? Balei phi wan ïalam sa uwei pat ban pynwit ïa nga da ki jingleh lamwir jong u hangne ha ka ïing jong nga ?
translation.en: Have I need of mad men , that ye have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence ? shall this fellow come into my house ?

translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u la pynsuk , Kumta kiba khatduh Kin un-long ha shuwa , bad kito Ibbah ha shaw kin long khatduh .
translation.en: So the last shall be first , and the first last : for many be called , but few chosen .

translation.kha: U Blei u lai ban jingphohsniew wat ïa ki jingduwai ba jar jar hapoh ka dohnud jongnga ngi .
translation.en: God can hear even silent prayers said in our heart .

translation.kha: Ki tait kiba ki nongshna jong ki , ki rah ; ki sawa malade ki thaba ha ka sngi .
translation.en: The quiver rattleth against him , the glittering spear and the shield .

translation.kha: Ki la shim ïa ki kynhun jinglur , ki jingri , ki kada , bad baroh Katba don ha shnongrit sad ha lyngkha .
translation.en: They took their sheep , and their oxen , and their asses , and that which was in the city , and that which was in the field ,

translation.kha: Te U Troas un ïong ha la ki bhabriew , ‘ Shaei kito ki blei khrawbor ha kba phi shaniah ?
translation.en: And he shall say , Where are their gods , their rock in whom they trusted ,
For the  Lord  giveth wisdom : out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding .
translation.kha: Dei U  Trai  uba ai ïa ka jingstad ; na u ka wan ka jingtip bad ka jingshemphang .

translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; When I shall have gathered the house of Israel from the people among whom they are scattered , and shall be sanctified in them in the sight of the heathen , then shall they dwell in their land that I have given to my servant Jacob .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  Ngan wallam pat ïa ki paid Israel na ki jaitbynriew kiba nga la pynsakma ïa ki , bad ki jaitbynriew baroh kin tip ba nga long uba khuid . Ki paid Israel kin im ha la ka ri , ka ri kaba nga la ai ha u shakri jong nga u Jakob .
bad u ïakren khñium : Kin jin da la kham bha lada ngi la ïap ha khmat ka Ïingjaiñ U Trai lakam bad Kawei pat ki para Israel .
translation.en: And the people chode with Moses , and spake , saying , Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the  Lord  !

translation.kha: Ha ka jingshisha , ka lah ban pyut ïa ka jingim jongno u .
translation.en: Thou shalt beat him with the rod , and shalt deliver his soul from hell .

translation.kha: Hynrei u brisoh uba burom u lehhok bad u ïeng skhem na ka bynta Kiei kaba dei .
translation.en: But the liberal deviseth liberal things  ; and by liberal things shall he stand .

Behold the mounts , they are come unto the city to take it  ; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans , that fight against it , because of the sword , and of the famine , and of the pestilence : and what thou hast spoken is come to pass  ; and , behold , thou seest it .
translation.kha: Ki nong Babilonia ki la tei ïa ki kynton kerkut sawdong ïa ka nongbah ban kurup ïa ka , bad ki tur ïaleh ïa ka . Ka thma , ka jingïapthngan bad ka jingpang kin pynlong ïa ka nongbah ban hap ha ki kti jong ki . Me lah ban ïohi ba baroh kaba me la kren ka la urlong shisha .

translation.en: Behold , the days come , that all that is in thine house , and that which thy fathers have laid up in store unto this day , shall be carried into Babylon : nothing shall be left , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: ba ka por ka poi haba ïa kiei kiei kiba ha ka ïingsyiem , kiei kiei kiba ki kpa tymmen ki la kynshew haduh kane ka sngi , yn rong noh sha Babilonia . Yn ym don ei ei ka ban sah .
‘ Em ,’ u la jubor , ‘ namar haba phi lumlang ïa ki ñiut phi eh ban kum jynthut katto katne u kew lem bad ki .
translation.en: But he said , Nay  ; lest while ye gather up the tares , ye root up also the wheat with them .

translation.kha: Kaei , te , ngan leh ïa U Jisu kiba la khot U Messaïah ? Sahnarphna ïa u ! Baroh ki la jubab .
translation.en: Pilate saith unto them , What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ ? They all say unto him , Let him be crucified .

translation.kha: hynñiew ngim lah pat ban shah ba kin shongkurim ïa ki khun kynthei jong ngi , namar ngi la buh ïa ka jingtim ha uno une na ngi uba shah ïa u bymman ban jingshongkurim ïa kawei na ki khun kynthei jong ngi .
translation.en: Howbeit we may not give them wives of our daughters : for the children of Israel have sworn , saying , Cursed be he that giveth a wife to Benjamin .

translation.kha: U la khmih sawkyr-ang jong ki baroh ; nangta U la ong ha uta u briew , To kynran ïa ka kti jong me . U la leh kumta , bad ka kti jong u ka la bha pat .
translation.en: And looking round about upon them all , he said unto the man ,  Stretch forth thy hand .  And he did so : and his hand was restored whole as the other .

These men are peaceable with us  ; therefore let them dwell in the land , and trade therein  ; for the land , behold , it is large enough for them  ; let us take their daughters to us for wives , and let us give them our daughters .
translation.kha: Kine ki briew ki long kum ki paralok ; ai ba kin shong kin sah bad ngi ha kane ka ri , bad kin leit kin wan laitluid . Ka ri ka long kaba kylluid bad kan biang ïa ki ruh . To ngin ïashongkurim bad ki khun kynthei jong ki , bad ngin ai ruh ïa la ki jong ba kin ïashongkurim bad ki .
Kumta ka pum jong ki khun u Eli ka long kob la shyrkhei palat ha khmat U Trei , namar ba ki la ñiat khlem ka jingburom ïa ki jingainguh ha U Trai .
translation.en: Wherefore the sin of the young men was very great before the  Lord  : for men abhorred the offering of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nga long U Blei uba la mihpaw ha me ha Bethel , ha kaba me la pyngkiang ïa u mawleiñ kum ka jingsah jingkynmaw da kaba me la theh ïa ka jingbymman Olib halor jong u bad ha kaba me la symbai ha nga . Mynta to khreh ngab leit phai pat sha ka ri ha kaba la kha ïa me .’
translation.en: I am the God of Beth–el , where thou anointedst the pillar , and where thou vowedst a vow unto me : now arise , get thee out from this land , and return unto the land of thy kindred .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U Trai u pyllait im ïa ki Ishmael na ki Ijipt , malade ki Israel ki ïohi ïa ki ba ki thik ïarep harud duriaw .
translation.en: Thus the  Lord  saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians  ; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore .
