translation.en: And I said , What shall I do , Lord ? And the Lord said unto me ,  Arise , and go into Damascus  ; and there it shall be told thee of all things which are appointed for thee to do .

translation.kha: Hynrei “lada la tip ba uta u masi kyrtong mynshuwa pajut u dei uba la tyngeh teng , bad u trai jong u um shym suit ïa u , u dei ban buria da kaba ai ïa uta eiei pat da u masi kyrtong Uba im , bad un ioh ma u ïa uta uba ïan .
translation.en: Or if it be known that the ox hath used to push in time past , and his owner hath not kept him in  ; he shall surely pay ox for ox  ; and the dead shall be his own .
And he made them a feast , and they did eat and drink .
translation.kha: U Isaak u pynkhreh ka jingkhawai ïa ki , bad ki ïabam ïadih .

translation.en: For if the blood of bulls and of goats , and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean , sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh :
translation.kha: Ka snam jong ki blang bad ki masi kyrtong bad u dpei jong u masi lud la synreit halor ki briew ïa kiba la ñiew bymkhuid kat kum ka jinglehniam , bad kane ka pynkhuid ïa ki da kaba weng noh ïa ka jingbymkhuid katba kum ka jinglehniam .

translation.en: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign , and he reigned in Jerusalem three months . And his mother s name was Nehushta , the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U Jehoïakhin u la don khatphra snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u la synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Nehushta , ka khun jong u Elnathan uba na Jerusalem .
Hynrei u la phah ïa u briew ha shuwa jong ki , u Joseph , ïa uba la die kum u mraw .
translation.en: He sent a man before them , even Joseph , who was sold for a servant :

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me ka jingkñia nongkit bad ai ka jingduwai shaei me .
translation.en: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving , and will call upon the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Sebul , u nongshniah jong ka nongbah , u bitar lep haba u ïohpdiang aïu u Gaal u ong .
translation.en: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed , his anger was kindled .

translation.kha: Ka bakwah jong ka , ka kynthup ïa ka Hammolekheth , ka Hali , ka Beten , ka Akhshaph ,
translation.en: And their border was Helkath , and Hali , and Beten , and Achshaph ,

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un shim ïa kane ka khleiñ bad un thang ha ka duwan ka jingïania ainguh thang , kumba u ju leh ïa ka khleiñ na u mrad ba la pynïap na ka bynta ka jingainguh ïasyllok .
translation.en: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings : and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering .

translation.kha: U ngab synshar ki Assyria u la tipbriew ba u pynshah u la leit sha Lasha bad u dang ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Libnah ka nongbah ba-marjan ; kumta u leit shata ba-bang ïasyllok nabar u .
translation.en: So Rabshakeh returned , and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah : for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish .
And he took up his parable , and said , Balaam the son of Beor hath said , and the man whose eyes are open hath said :
translation.kha: bad u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Ka khubor u Balaam u khun jong u Beor , Ki ktien jong u briew uba lah ban ïohi shai ,

translation.en: And he sought Ahaziah : and they caught him , ( for he was hid in Samaria , ) and brought him to Jehu : and when they had slain him , they buried him : Because , said they , he is the son of Jehoshaphat , who sought the  Lord  with all his heart . So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom .
translation.kha: La pynlong ka jingleit wad bniah ïa u Ahasaïah , bad la shem ïa u ba u rieh ha Samaria . Ki la leit lam ïa u sha u Jehu bad pynïap ïa u . Hynrei ki la tep ïa ka met jong u naba ki burom ïa u syiem Jehoshaphat u kparad jong u , uba la leh kat kaba u lah ban shakri ïa U  Trai . Ym don uno uno u dkhot jong ka longïing jong u Ahasaïah uba dang sah uba lah ban synshar ïa ka hima .

translation.en: Where they crucified him , and two other with him , on either side one , and Jesus in the midst .
translation.kha: Hangta ki la sahnarphna ïa u ; bad ki la sahnarphna ruh ïa ki ar ngut kiwei pat ki rangbah , uwei ha kawei kawei ka liang bad U Jisu hapdeng jong ki .

translation.en: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them  ; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son , nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son .
translation.kha: Wat ïashongkha khleh bad ki , bad khang ïa ki khun ki kti jong phi ban ïashongkha khleh bad ki ,

translation.en: And he took up his parable , and said , Alas , who shall live when God doeth this !
translation.kha: U Balaam u la kren ïa kane ka jingïathuhlypa :  Kiei kine ki briew kiba ïalumlang shaphang shatei ?

translation.en: And he walked in the way of the kings of Israel , as did the house of Ahab : for the daughter of Ahab was his wife : and he did evil in the sight of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ka tnga jong u ka dei ka khun jong u Ahab , bad kumba long kiba na ka ïing u Ahab , u ruh u bud ïa ki lynti bymman jong ki syiem ka Israel . U la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai .

translation.en: And he said , Let us take our journey , and let us go , and I will go before thee .
translation.kha: U Iso u ong ,  Ïa ngin ïaleit noh ; ngan nang ïaid ma nga sha khmat .

translation.en: According to all these words , and according to all this vision , so did Nathan speak unto David .
translation.kha: U Nathan u la ïathuh ha u Dabid ïa baroh kat kaba U Blei u la pynpaw ha u .
Ka tdem jong ka jingainguh thang ka la kiew shakor ryngkat lem bad ki jingduwai jong ki briew jong U Blei na ki kti u angel uba ïohnong ha khnam U Blei .
translation.en: And the smoke of the incense , which came with the prayers of the saints , ascended up before God out of the angel s hand .

translation.kha: lada phim lah ban sieh , kin nongdih ei wat ïa ka jingthiah jrong Phin duh .
translation.en: If thou hast nothing to pay , why should he take away thy bed from under thee ?

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U Trai Badonbor barieh un pynpoh ïa Uei pa uwei uba khrawburom , ïa uwei pa uwei uba sarong bad uba sngewmeng .
translation.en: For the day of the  Lord  of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty , and upon every one that is lifted up  ; and he shall be brought low :

translation.kha: Ngan pynmutlop haduh katta Katta ïa ki nongri Ijipt ba kin beh nadien jong ki , bad ngan ioh ka jingpyndonburom da ka jingjop Jong nga ïa u Pharaoh , ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u , ïa ki kali ïapom jong u , sad ïa ki nongshniah jngai u .
translation.en: And I , behold , I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians , and they shall follow them : and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh , and upon all his host , upon his chariots , and upon his horsemen .

And it came to pass , before he had done speaking , that , behold , Rebekah came out , who was born to Bethuel , son of Milcah , the wife of Nahor , Abraham s brother , with her pitcher upon her shoulder .
translation.kha: Shuwa ban kut ka jingduwai , ka Rebekka ka la wan poi bad u khiew um ha la ka tyrpeng . Ka dei ka khun jong u Bethuel , uba long u khun jong ka Milkah bad u Nahor , uba shi para bad u Abraham .

Hynrei ki Jiw ki la bishni bad ki la lumlang ïa ki riewkhmat bymsalia na ki lynti malade na u bajaipdeh . Ki la pynkhihwin ïa ka shnong baroh khawai bun ki la tam ïa ka ïing jong u briew uba ktang u Jason , ha ka jingpyrshang ban lap ïa u pyllew bad u Silas bad ban Wallam ïa ki shabar sha u paidbah .
translation.en: But the Jews which believed not , moved with envy , took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort , and gathered a company , and set all the city on an uproar , and assaulted the house of Jason , and sought to bring them out to the people .

translation.kha: Ki nongkhaïi ki ong ha ka , Baroh kiei kiei kiba bha kiba pha la angnud ban ïoh ki la jah noh , pynlang baroh ka spah jong pha bad ka khrong phong jongnga pha ki la leit noh , phan ym shem shuh ïa ki !
translation.en: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee , and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee , and thou shalt find them no more at all .

translation.kha: Uwei u briew u la pyrta na u paidbah , Ko Nonghikai ! Nga kyrpad ïa me , ban khmied ïa u khun jong nga — u khun marwei jong nga !
translation.en: And , behold , a man of the company cried out , saying , Master , I beseech thee , look upon my son : for he is mine only child .

translation.kha: Kumta u Haman u ong ïa u syiemsad . Ka don kawei ka jaitbynriew kaba la saphriang kyllan sawdong ka hima jongno phi bad ba lah ba-bang Shem ha kawei pa kaweh ka probins . Ki bud ïa ki pushara kiba ïapher na ki jong kiwei pat ki jaitbynriew . Nalor kata kim kthong ïa ki aiñ jongngi ka hima , kumno kan ym long kaweh bha ïa phi baneh shahshkor ïa ki .
translation.en: And Haman said unto king Ahasuerus , There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom  ; and their laws are diverse from all people  ; neither keep they the king s laws : therefore it is not for the king s profit to suffer them .

translation.kha: Ki long kum ki dieng kiba mih harud ka wahduid , kiba seisoh ha ka por kaweh dien , bad kiba ki sla jong ki kim tyrkhong . Ki jop ha kiei kiei barabor kiba ki leh .
translation.en: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water , that bringeth forth his fruit in his season  ; his leaf also shall not wither  ; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper .

translation.kha: Ki khanglad ïa kiba duk ba kin ïoh ïa ki hok lad ki bad pynbor ïa kiba kyrduh ban phet rieh .
translation.en: They turn the needy out of the way : the poor of the earth hide themselves together .

translation.kha: Ka jingjur ka bang palat — katno ngi sngewsih ban nguid tylli ïa ka !
translation.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds , and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly .
Blessed is the man that heareth me , watching daily at my gates , waiting at the posts of my doors .
translation.kha: U briew uba shahshkor ïa nga un suk — u briew uba ap man ka sngi ha jingkhang jong nga , uba ap ha jaka rung ka ïing jong nga .
Lada kata ka dak ka purew , u lyngdoh un pynbna ba uta u longsem u bymkhuid ; u la bit jingpang .
translation.en: And if it spread much abroad in the skin , then the priest shall pronounce him unclean : it is a plague .

translation.kha: U Trai un pynpaw ïa lade ha ki nong Ijipt , bad nangta kin tip bad keiñ mane ïa u , bad Kin wallam ha u ïa ki jingkñia malade ki jingngeit . Kin pynphong ki jingkular kyntang ha u mala kin pyndep ïa kaei kaba ki kular .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall be known to Egypt , and the Egyptians shall know the  Lord  in that day , and shall do sacrifice and oblation  ; yea , they shall vow a vow unto the  Lord  , and perform it .
And God remembered Rachel , and God hearkened to her , and opened her womb .
translation.kha: Nangta U Blei u la kynmaw ïa ka Rakhel ; u la jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong ka bad u la pynlah ïa ka ban ïoh khun .
U Trai u ong , Ko khun u briew , to kren ha ki lumbah ki Jerusalem’ bad ong ïa ki ban shahshkor ïa ka khubor kaba ma nga , U Trai Nongsynshar nga dat na ka beit jong ki :
translation.en: Also , thou son of man , prophesy unto the mountains of Israel , and say , Ye mountains of Israel , hear the word of the  Lord  :
And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils , after whom they have gone a whoring . This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations .
translation.kha: Ki Israel kim dei shuh ban lyndet ïa U  Trai  da kaba pynïap ïa ki mrad jong ki ha lum ha wah la kum ba kñia ainguh ïa ki sha ki ksuid . Ki paid Israel ki dei ban sumar ïa kane ka aiñ pateng la pateng .
Ha ka sngi kyntiew kurim , u Iphtahel u kyntu ïa ka ban pan lyngkha na u kpa jong ka . Ka la hiar na ka kada ba ka shong , bad u Kaleb u kylli aïu ba ka Kwah .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as she came unto him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field : and she lighted off her ass  ; and Caleb said unto her , What wouldest thou ?

translation.kha: Thang ïa uta u langbrot baroh Uei ha kata ka iba kum ka jingtieng bah . Ka jingibeiñ jong Kanah ka jingainguh ka pynsngewbha ïa nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt burn the whole ram upon the altar : it is a burnt offering unto the  Lord  : it is a sweet savour , an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .

translation.kha: To shahshkor! ïa ki jingpyrta da kambah kmen ïa ka jingjop ha ki ïingjaiñ jong ki briew jong U Blei : Ka borbah jong U Trai ka la sa ïa ka !
translation.en: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous : the right hand of the  Lord  doeth valiantly .
For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish  ; yea , those nations shall be utterly wasted .
translation.kha: Hynrei ïa ki hima ki bym shakri ïa pha yn pynjot thiaw .

U Gideon bad ki shispah ngut ki rangbah ki la poi ha tduh Katai ka jaka sher dara shuwa ka to shiteng synñia , hamar ba dang dep ïa-bujli ïa ki nongap phiah . Nangta ki lade ïa ki turoi bad ki pynpait ïa ki khra ba ki bat , bad kita ki ar kynhun ruh ki leh kumjuh .
translation.en: So Gideon , and the hundred men that were with him , came unto the outside of the camp in the beginning of the middle watch  ; and they had but newly set the watch : and they blew the trumpets , and brake the pitchers that were in their hands .

translation.kha: shemphang ka jahthait Lebi u ong , Ko TRAI’ , to pynpaw ïa la ka mon da u Urim bad u thnum Lyngba ki Lebi , ki shakri kiba ïaineh jong me . Me la tynjuh ïa ki ha Massah , Gaal me la phrang ïa ki ha ki um ka Meribah .
translation.en: And of Levi he said , Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one , whom thou didst prove at Massah , and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah  ;

And it was so , that , after they had carried it about , the hand of the  Lord  was against the city with a very great destruction : and he smote the men of the city , both small and great , and they had emerods in their secret parts .
translation.kha: Hynrei ynda ka la poi hangta , U  Trai  u pynshitom sa ïa kata ka nongbah ruh bad u pynkhih kulmar ïa ka . U pynshitom ïa ki da ki jingpang thung kiba mih ha baroh ki briew jong ka nongbah , ki samla bad tymmen kumjuh .
Ka kynjoh ki nonglute kin sa wang ïaleh ïa u Gad , Jamynrei un phai kylla ban baheh ïa ki nadien .
translation.en: Gad , a troop shall overcome him : but he shall overcome at the last .
And they that were with me saw indeed the light , and were afraid  ; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba ïadon bad nga ki la ïohi ïa ka jingshai , hynrei kim shym ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong uta uba kren ha nga .
U syiem um ñiewkor ïa ki jingai jingmut ki riewrangbah bad u krong thom ïa kita ki brup ,
translation.en: And the king answered them roughly  ; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men ,

translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka por u Petros u ïai tied . Khatduh ki la plie ïa ka jingnang , bad long ki la ïohi ïa u , ki la sngewtieng .
translation.en: But Peter continued knocking : and when they had opened the door , and saw him , they were astonished .

translation.kha: ka Hasar Shual , ka Sherebaïah , ka Bisiothaïah ,
translation.en: And Hazar–shual , and Beer–sheba , and Bizjothjah ,

translation.kha: hynrei me , ko Israel u sharak jong nga , me long u paidlang ba nga la jingduh , ki khun ki ksiew u Abbim , u paralok jong nga .
translation.en: But thou , Israel , art my servant , Jacob whom I have chosen , the seed of Abraham my friend .

translation.kha: lane pruid dak ha la ka met dawai pynmong ïa la ka doh ban ïambriew ïa kiba ïap . Ang Long U Trai .
translation.en: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead , nor print any marks upon you : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ha kiwei ka sngi ynda ki la dep bam dep dih ha ka ïing U Trai ha Shiloh , ka Hannah ka ïeng joit , ka la sngewbang jynjar stai bad ka la ïamkthang katba ka dang duwai ha iitkhmat U Trai . Ha kata ka por , u lyngdoh Eli u shong ha ka jaka jrong u ha syndah jingkhang .
translation.en: And she was in bitterness of soul , and prayed unto the  Lord  , and wept sore .

translation.kha: U Trai u noh , Kaei ka jingkynnoh ba ki kpa tymmen jong Phin ki la wanrah pyrda ïa nga ? kawei kaba pynlong ïa ki ban phai noh na nga ? Ki la ïamareh ïa ki bleithaw bymdondor ei ei bad ki hi ki la kylla long ki bymdondor .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  , What iniquity have your fathers found in me , that they are gone far from me , and have walked after vanity , and are become vain ?

translation.kha: U Ïoannis u la jingjubab , Nga pynbaptis da ka um , hynrei hapdeng jong phi don uwei naba ïeng uba phim tah .
translation.en: John answered them , saying , I baptize with water : but there standeth one among you , whom ye know not  ;

translation.kha: bad u sam jingdam sha ki baroh . U ai ha uwei pa iwei u shynrang badno ha kawei pa khawai ka kynthei ha Israel mar uwei u kpu , Shi lyngkhot ka dohthang syang , bad katto katne ki soh kismis . Nangta baroh ki la lytar phai sha ïing .
translation.en: And he dealt among all the people , even among the whole multitude of Israel , as well to the women as men , to every one a cake of bread , and a good piece of flesh , and a flagon of wine . So all the people departed every one to his house .

translation.kha: Kajuh ka la jia ha Ikoniom : U Paul bad u Barnabas ki la leit sha ka synagog bad ki la krenbeiñ ha kata ka rukom ba naba buiñ ki jlih bad ki Jentil ki la kylla longïng ki riewbieit .
translation.en: And it came to pass in Iconium , that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews , and so spake , that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed .

translation.kha: Kham pynheh ïa ka ïingjaiñ ha kiba pha Shong ; pynjrong ïa ki tynrai badno pynskhem ïa ki snar !
translation.en: Enlarge the place of thy tent , and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations : spare not , lengthen thy cords , and strengthen thy stakes  ;
And for the other side of the tabernacle , which is toward the north corner , he made twenty boards ,
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh arphew tylli ki jingker na ka bynta ka liang kaba shaphang shatei ka Ïingjaiñ ,

translation.en: And now , behold , we are in thine hand : as it seemeth good and right unto thee to do unto us , do .
translation.kha: Mynta ngi don hapoh ka bor jong phi , leh ha ngi ïa kaei kaba phi pyrkhat ba ka long kaba dei .

U patsha ka Assyria u ïalam ïa ki Israel shat Asaraïah kum ki koidi bad u pynshong pynsah ïa ki katto katne na ki ha ka nongbud Halah , katto katne hajan ka woh Habor ha ka distrik Gosan , bad kat katne ha ki nongbah ka Broadcasting .
translation.en: And the king of Assyria did carry away Israel unto Assyria , and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan , and in the cities of the Medes :
And ye have not his word abiding in you : for whom he hath sent , him ye believe not .
translation.kha: Phim pat ju ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u lane phim pat ju ïohi ïa ka khmat jong u , bad phim ju sumar ïa ka khubor jong u ha ki dohnud jong phi , naba phim ngeit ha uta ïa uba u la phah .

translation.en: As one whom his mother comforteth , so will I comfort you  ; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem .
translation.kha: Ngan pyntngen ïa phi ha Jerusalem , kumba ka kmie ka pyntngen ïa la i khun .
To long uba Bha ïa nga , u shakri jongu me , khnang ba ngan ïoh im , bad kohnguh ïa ki jingïakhaïi jong me .
translation.en: Deal bountifully with thy servant , that I may live , and keep thy word .
And , behold , Cushi came  ; and Cushi said , Tidings , my lord the king : for the  Lord  hath avenged thee this day of all them that rose up against thee .
translation.kha: Nangta u mraw na Sudan u wan poi bad u ong ha u syiem ,  Nga don ka khubor babha ïa u Syiem Kynrad ! Ha kane ka sngi U  Trai  u la ai ha phi ka jingjop halor kito baroh kiba la ïaleh pyrshah ïa phi !
Ka khyndew ka kyiuh bad ka khynñiuh namar ba U Tlai u pyndep ïa ka jingthmu jong u ban pynjrong ïa ka Babilonia ka ri shyiap , ha kaba yn ym don mano mano ban shong ban sah .
translation.en: And the land shall tremble and sorrow : for every purpose of the  Lord  shall be performed against Babylon , to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant .

translation.kha: U Blei u khmih lynti ba ki kmie ki kpa kin shuki bad pynbeit ïa la ki khun .
translation.en: A loving father provides for his family materially and spiritually .

translation.kha: Ynda u poi ha Lehi , ki Philistia ki wan mareh shiah u , ki da ïarisa ïa u . Hangta hi ka bor jong U Trai ka pynshaitbor ïa u , bad u bthat ïa ki tyllai Ibbah la khum ïa ki ksang ti sad ki ktem Jong u kumta ki saihon kiba la kem ding .
translation.en: And when he came unto Lehi , the Philistines shouted against him : and the Spirit of the  Lord  came mightily upon him , and the cords that were upon his arms became as flax that was burnt with fire , and his bands loosed from off his hands .

translation.kha: kim don ka jingïatiplem ; kim bat ïa la ki kular , bad kim pyn-i jingsbun lap jingisynei ïa kiwei! pat .
translation.en: Without understanding , covenantbreakers , without natural affection , implacable , unmerciful :
The word of the  Lord  came again unto me , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren pat ,
Haba kiwei pat ki shipa ngut ki synran ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la pyniaid ïa u Jakob bad u Ïoannis .
translation.en: And when the ten heard it , they began to be much displeased with James and John .
Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles , whom God drave out before the face of our fathers , unto the days of David  ;
translation.kha: Hadien , ki kpa tymmen jong ngi kiba la ïohpdiang ïa ka ïingjaiñ na ki kpa jong ki , ki la bah ïa ka lem bad ki haba ki la leit bad u Joshua bad shimti ïa ka ri na ki jaitbynriew kiba U Blei u la beh katba ki nang tur sha khmat . Bad ka la don hangta haduh ka por jong u Dabid .

translation.en: Go , tell Jeroboam , Thus saith the  Lord  God of Israel , Forasmuch as I exalted thee from among the people , and made thee prince over my people Israel ,
translation.kha: Khie leit ïathuh ha u Jeroboam ba kane ka dei kaei kaba U  Trai  , U Blei ki Israel , u ong ïa u : ‘ Nga la jied ïa me napdeng u paidbah bad nga la pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jong nga ki Israel .
U skhem u buh arphew seh hajar ngut na ki ban pynïaid ïa ka kam ha ka Templ , hynriew hajuh nguh ban buh jingteh bad ba-bang bishar ïa ki kam ïakajia ,
translation.en: Of which , twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the  Lord   ; and six thousand were officers and judges :

translation.kha: phiah ki nong Samaria phim da tip shai ïano pa’ mane ; hynrei ma i ki Jiw ngi tip ïano ngi mane , namar ka long na ki Jiw ba ka jingpynim ka wan .
translation.en: Ye worship ye know not what : we know what we worship : for salvation is of the Jews .

translation.kha: U pyndeng ha u ïa ka jingdeng shadem , bad u buh ha ka ïa u Urim bad u Thummim .
translation.en: And he put the breastplate upon him : also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim .

translation.kha: A Trai , to pynshitom ïa kito ki riewbymman ! To kynmaw ïa kito kiba shahshitom !
translation.en: Arise , O  Lord   ; O God , lift up thine hand : forget not the humble .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u kyntait ban Jubab wat tang shikyntien , kaba da pynlyngngoh shikatdei eh ïa u lyngktop .
translation.en: And he answered him to never a word  ; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly .

translation.kha: Em , tun ai ïa ka jubab jong nga hi myntan bad ngan ïathiah ïa phi kiei kaba nga pyrkhat .
translation.en: I said , I will answer also my part , I also will shew mine opinion .

translation.kha: ïa u bnai bad ki khlur ban synshar halor ka miet ; ka jingtied jongu u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: The moon and stars to rule by night : for his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Nangta u briew kiba skhem na ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh u la wan sha u , u la dem khohsiew ha khmat jongnga u , sad u la ong , Ko kyrdan , lada me myn , me lah ban pynlong khuid ïa per .
translation.en: And , behold , there came a leper and worshipped him , saying , Lord , if thou wilt , thou canst make me clean .

translation.kha: U Jonah pynban , u la leit sha ka jaka kaweh marpyrshah khnang ban phet nong na U Trai . U la leit shaw Joab , ha kaba u la shem ïa ka liengbah ka ban sa leit sha shipa . U la siew ïa ka bai lynti bad u la rung shapoh ryngkat bad ki nongtrei liengbah kiba wait sha Spain , ha kaba un long jngai na U Trai .
translation.en: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the  Lord  , and went down to Joppa  ; and he found a ship going to Tarshish : so he paid the fare thereof , and went down into it , to go with them unto Tarshish from the presence of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ym shym la teh ïa ki kti jong u , Bad ïa ki kjat jong u ym shym la khum ; U la ïap kum umbah la shuh pynïap ha ki nongkamsniew ! Bad ki briew baroh ki la ïam sa shisien pat na ka bynta jong u .
translation.en: Thy hands were not bound , nor thy feet put into fetters : as a man falleth before wicked men , so fellest thou . And all the people wept again over him .
And he said unto me , Son of man , stand upon thy feet , and I will speak unto thee .
translation.kha: Te nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur kaba ong ,  Ko khun u briew ïeng joit . Nga kwah ban ïakren bad me .

Ki nongïalam ki la jubab , Neng leh kumba phi ong . Ngin ai noh ïa ka jaka bad ngi pyrshang ban ym lum shuh ïa ki ram . Nga khot ïa ki lyngdoh bad pynlong ïa ki nongñiah ban smai ha khmat jong ki ban bat ïa ka kylluid kaba ki la da khlei .
translation.en: Then said they , We will restore them , and will require nothing of them  ; so will we do as thou sayest . Then I called the priests , and took an oath of them , that they should do according to this promise .

translation.kha: Haba la pyndep ïa ka jingbitar hok , ki briew ibha bha ki kmen , hynrei ki briew kiba sniew ki sngewsih .
translation.en: It is joy to the just to do judgment : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .

translation.kha: Haba u Judas , u nongshetkylla , u la tip ba ïa U Jisu la dep pynrem , u la kylla-kaba-mut bad u la ithuh rah biang ïa ki laiphew tylli ki sbai spoiñ sha ki rangbah lyngdoh bad sha ki tymmen ki san .
translation.en: Then Judas , which had betrayed him , when he saw that he was condemned , repented himself , and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders ,
For thou saidst , What advantage will it be unto thee ? and , What profit shall I have , if I be cleansed from my sin ?
translation.kha: ne ban kylli ïa U Blei ,  Da kumno ka pop jong nga ka ktah ïa me ? Nga ïohnong aïu na kaba khlem leh pop ?
U syiem Rehoboam u ïasyllok bad ki riewrangbah kiba la Sikhri ïa u Solomon u kpu jong u kum ki nongaibuit . Kaei ka jubab ba phin ai jingmut ïa nga ba ngan ai ha kine ki briew ? u kylli .
translation.en: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived , saying , What counsel give ye me to return answer to this people ?

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ba phi la lyndet ïa ka hukum ba U Trai U blang jong ph u la ai ha phi , bad ba phi la leh nongpop pyrshah ïa u da kaba phi thret na ka bynshet ïa lade ka durblei ba la saiñ ha ka dur u khun basa .
translation.en: And I looked , and , behold , ye had sinned against the  Lord  your God , and had made you a molten calf : ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the  Lord  had commanded you .
If you are able to spend more time or are limited to less time each week , the Witnesses will make themselves available to help you .
translation.kha: Lada phi lah ban pyllut shibun ka por lane tang khyndiat por man ka taiew , ki wongsakhi ki lah ban pyllait ïalade ban ïarap ïa phi .

translation.en: Brethren , be not children in understanding : howbeit in malice be ye children , but in understanding be men .
translation.kha: Wat long kum ki khynnah ha ka rukom pyrkhat jong phi , ko parabangeit jong nga ; to long khynnah ha kaba ïadei bad ka jingbymman , hynrei to long rangbah ha ka rukom pyrkhat .

translation.en: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved : but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once .
translation.kha: Long uba hok bad phin long shngain . Lada phi long bymhok phin kyllon kynsan .

Bad kumta ka jingieit jong u ïa phi ka nang khraw , kumba u kynroh kumno Phi baroh phi la kloi ban jongu ïa ki jingbthah jong u , kumno phi la pdiang sngewbha ïa u da ka jingsheptieng bad ka jingkyiuh .
translation.en: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you , whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all , how with fear and trembling ye received him .

And it shall come to pass , that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink  ; and instead of a girdle a rent  ; and instead of well set hair baldness  ; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth  ; and burning instead of beauty .
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka ba kin sleh jingiwbih kin sma iwkhong ; ha ka jaka ki panpoh ba-itynnat kin teh da ki tyllai barew ; ha ka jaka ban don u shñiuh ba-itynnat kin long kiba lyndum ; ha ka jaka ki jaiñ ba-itynnat kin phong ki jaiñjot ; ka jingbhabriew jong ki kan kylla sha ka jinglehrain .
Ïa kaba sahit jong ka yn pynsaphriang hangta kum ka jingthlia , khnang ba yn ym ne mano mano uba lah ithuh ïa ki .’
translation.en: And the carcase of Jezebel shall be as dung upon the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel  ; so that they shall not say , This is Jezebel .

translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa ka longïing jong u Akhbor main nga leh ïa ka longïing jong u Jeroboam u syiem ka Israel bad jong u Baasha u syiem ka Jeriel .
translation.en: And I will make the house of Ahab like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah :
And it came to pass , when the vessels were full , that she said unto her son , Bring me yet a vessel . And he said unto her , There is not a vessel more . And the oil stayed .
translation.kha: Haba ki la pyndap ïa kita ki khra baroh , ka la kylli la dang don shuh ne em .  Uto u dei uba khatduh ,  uwei na ki khun shynrang jong ka u jubab . Bad ka umphniang Olib ka la sangeh ban tuid .
Te u syiem u la pham ïa u Jehudi ban leit shim ïa ka kot kli . U la leit shimti na ka kamra u Emim bad u la pule ïa ka ha u syiem Bad ha baroh ki rangbah synshar kiba ngin sawdong jong u .
translation.en: So the king sent Jehudi to fetch the roll : and he took it out of Elishama the scribe s chamber . And Jehudi read it in the ears of the king , and in the ears of all the princes which stood beside the king .

translation.kha: Lada phi jubab ïa ka jingkylli bieit , phin long kum u bri uba ibieit uba kylli ïa ka .
translation.en: Answer not a fool according to his folly , lest thou also be like unto him .
Cursed be he that smiteth his neighbour secretly . And all the people shall say , Amen .
translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei kan hap ha uta u briew uba pynïap briew ha kaba rieh .’  Bad u paidbah baroh un jubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
Ka shim ngi Tom katto-katne kynta ban pyndait ia ka jingthiah ba ki jingbatai ki ong ba kan shimet shongkha dala banbeiñ pynthait .
translation.en: It took Tom several hours to assemble a bunk bed that the instructions said would take less than an hour to assemble .
And Philip ran thither to him , and heard him read the prophet Esaias , and said , Understandest thou what thou readest ?
translation.kha: U Philip u la mareh sha u bad u la ïohsngew ba u dang pule na ka Kitab u Isaïah u nongïathuhlypa . U la kylli ïa u ,  Hato me sngewthuh ïa kaei kaba me pule ?

translation.en: Be merciful , O  Lord  , unto thy people Israel , whom thou hast redeemed , and lay not innocent blood unto thy people of Israel s charge . And the blood shall be forgiven them .
translation.kha: A Trai , map ïa ki briew jong me , ki Israel , ïa kiba me la pyllait na Ijipt . Map ïa ngi bad wat pynkit pop ha ngi namar ka jingpynïap ïa uta uba lui lui .’

uba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka kren Shaphan uta : Ha khmih , nga bah ha Seïon ïa u maw u ban pynlong ïa ki briew baneh jynthut , u mawsiang u ban pynlong ïa ki shun kyllon . Hynrei uno uno uba ngeit ha u un ym shem ïa kaba sngewsih .
translation.en: As it is written , Behold , I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence : and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed .
The righteous perisheth , and no man layeth it to heart : and merciful men are taken away , none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha ki ïap , bad ym don uba sngewthuh lane wat ban suidñiew . Hynrei haba ki ïap , yn ym don jingjynjar shuh ki ban ktah ïa ki .

translation.en: Which was a figure for the time then present , in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices , that could not make him that did the service perfect , as pertaining to the conscience  ;
translation.kha: Kane ka long ka dur kaba kdew sha ka por kaba mynta . Ka mut ba ka jingainguh bad ki jingkñia da ki mrad ïa kiba la ai sha U Blei kim lah satia ban pynjanai ïa ka dohnud jong uta uba mane ,

translation.en: And Isaac said unto them , Wherefore come ye to me , seeing ye hate me , and have sent me away from you ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Isaak u kylli ,  Balei ba phi wan sha nga mynta , haba phi la isih ïa nga mynshuwa bad ba phi la pynlong ïa nga ban mihnoh na ka ri jong phi ?
Keiñ ka long ka jingdam jong ka pharshi : U symboh u long ka katei U Blei .
translation.en: Now the parable is this : The seed is the word of God .

translation.kha: U la ai ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam ïa ki sum bad ki stieh kiba den ki jong u sahmiet Dabid pynlang ïa kiba la buh ha ka Templ ,
translation.en: And to the captains over hundreds did the priest give king David s spears and shields , that were in the temple of the  Lord .

Therefore hear now this , thou that art given to pleasures , that dwellest carelessly , that sayest in thine heart , I am , and none else beside me  ; I shall not sit as a widow , neither shall I know the loss of children :
translation.kha: To sngap ïa kane , pha kaba ieit ïa ka jinglehsngewbha , pha kaba pyrkhat ba pha shongshngain bad sngewskhem . Pha kam ba pha long kaba khraw kum U Blei — ba ym don mano mano pat kum ma pha . Pha pyrkhat ba da lei lei phan ym long ka riewkynthei lane mad ïa ka jingduh noh ïa la ki khun .

translation.en: For I am with thee , saith the  Lord  , to save thee : though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee , yet will I not make a full end of thee : but I will correct thee in measure , and will not leave thee altogether unpunished .
translation.kha: Ngan wan sha phi bad pyllait im ïa phi . Ngan pynjot ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh sha kiba nga la pynsakma ïa phi , hynrei ngan ym pynjot ïa phi . Ngan ym shah ïa phi ban leit khlem shah pynshitom ; hynrei haba nga pynshitom ïa phi , ngan long u bym leh shiliang . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .
U Abner bad ki rangbah synshar jong u Ishbak ki la leit na Mahanaim sha ka Nongbah Gibeon .
translation.en: And Abner the son of Ner , and the servants of Ish–bosheth the son of Saul , went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kloi ban kren ïa ka kam jongngi u , u long uba la kloi ban bishar ïa ki brup jong u .
translation.en: The  Lord  standeth up to plead , and standeth to judge the people .

translation.kha: U Trai u la kyrkhu kyrhai ïa u kynrad jong nga bad u la pynpang ïa u , u briew uba riewspah . U la ai ha u ki kynran langbrot bad blang , ki masi , ka rupa , ka ksiar , ki mraw shynrang badno kynthei , ki ut malade ki kada .
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath blessed my master greatly  ; and he is become great : and he hath given him flocks , and herds , and silver , and gold , and menservants , and maidservants , and camels , and asses .
Then Philip opened his mouth , and began at the same scripture , and preached unto him Jesus .
translation.kha: Te u Philip u la sdang ban kren ; da kaba sdang na kane ka bynta jong ka Jingthoh Bakhuid , u la ïathuh ïa u ïa ka Khubor Babha shaphang U Jisu .

translation.en: And strip Aaron of his garments , and put them upon Eleazar his son : and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people , and shall die there .
translation.kha: bad hangta law noh ïa ki jaiñkup lyngdoh na u Aaron bad pynkup ïa ki ha u Eleasar . U Aaron un ïap hangta .
Hynrei , ha khmih ! Uta uba shetkylla ïa nga u Don jingeh ha ka mih slem bun nga !
translation.en: But , behold , the hand of him that betrayeth me is with me on the table .

translation.kha: Katba U Jisu u dang bam , kawei ka kynthei ka la wan sha u lem bad ka dabi alabastar ba la pyndap da ka jingsleh iwbih baremdor , ïa kaba ka la theh halor ka khleiñ jong u .
translation.en: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment , and poured it on his head , as he sat at meat .
Hear , ye children , the instruction of a father , and attend to know understanding .
translation.kha: Ko ki khun jong nga , to shahshkor ïa kaei ba u kpa jong phi u hikai ïa phi . Shahshkor bha , bad phin ïoh ka jingshemphang .

Dei ma me uta uba nga kren la slem bah , haba nga pynbna lyngba ki shakri jong ang , ki nongïathuhlypa ka Israel , ba ha ki sngem ki ban wan sam sa wallam ïa uno uno ban tur ïaleh ïa ki Isaia . U Trai Nongsynshar u la krai .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Art thou he of whom I have spoken in old time by my servants the prophets of Israel , which prophesied in those days many years that I would bring thee against them ?

translation.kha: U Jisu pat , u la sngewthuh ïa ka jingtem basniew jongnga ki , bad kumta u la ong , Phi kiba arsap ! balei phi ïapyrshang ban riam ïa ar ?
translation.en: But Jesus perceived their wickedness , and said ,  Why tempt ye me , ye hypocrites ?

translation.kha: A Trai , me long uta uba ïada ïa nga Bad uba ai ha nga ka jingkhlaiñ ; me ïarah ïa nga ha ki por jingjynjar . Ki jaitbynriew kin wan sha me na kiba koit jong ka pyrthei malade ïong , Ki kpa tymmen jong im kiei shym la don ei ei hynrei tang ki blei tala , ym don ei ei hynrei tang ki thliew bymmyntoi .
translation.en: O  Lord  , my strength , and my fortress , and my refuge in the day of affliction , the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth , and shall say , Surely our fathers have inherited lies , vanity , and things wherein there is no profit .

translation.kha: U Iso u ong , Ka biang hi ! Nga sngew kum ban sa ïap noh ; kita ki hok jong de kin myntoi aiwai pud ïa nga ?
translation.en: And Esau said , Behold , I am at the point to die : and what profit shall this birthright do to me ?

translation.kha: Kynsan , hangne ki wan ! Ki pynrangbah halor jyllang ki kulai , shi jur syang jur . U nongap phira u ai ka khubor , Ka Babel ka la kyllon ! Baroh ki bleithaw kiba ki la mane ki la kyllon ha ka jingtep jingpra ha madan .
translation.en: And , behold , here cometh a chariot of men , with a couple of horsemen . And he answered and said , Babylon is fallen , is fallen  ; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un wieh ïa la ka shylliah ti ha ka snam jong “kata ka mrad , un tah ïa ka ha ki reng kiba don ha ki dong jong ka rangli , bad un theh ïa kaba sah , ha trai ka duwan .
translation.en: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger , and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering , and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar .

translation.kha: Me lah ban pyrkhat ba kin pynlong ïa me umbah khlaiñ ha ka thma , hynrei u dei U Blei uba don ka bor ban ai ka jingjop ne ka jingsop , mala un shah ïa ki nongshun jong me Ban jrop ïa me .
translation.en: But if thou wilt go , do it , be strong for the battle : God shall make thee fall before the enemy : for God hath power to help , and to cast down .

translation.kha: Ki la Wallam ïa ka Synduk bad shuh ïa ka ha ka iaki jong ka shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ kaba u Dabid u la pynïeng na ka bynta jongki ka . Nangta u ainguh ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh jinglakloi ha U Trai .
translation.en: And they brought in the ark of the  Lord  , and set it in his place , in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it : and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the  Lord .

Circumcise yourselves to the  Lord  , and take away the foreskins of your heart , ye men of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem : lest my fury come forth like fire , and burn that none can quench it , because of the evil of your doings .
translation.kha: Sumar ïa ka jutang jong phi bad nga , U  Trai  jong phi , bad pynkyntang ïa lade ha nga , phi ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem . Lymda kumta , ka jingbitar jong nga kan ing kum ka ding namar kiei kiei kiba sniew kiba phi la leh . Kan pluh , bad yn ym don mano mano ba pynlip ïa ka .

U Trai u ainong ha u Moses , Shen men sa ïap noh , bad ynda me ïap u Baïap un sa phai noh na nga bad pynkhiah ïa ka jutang kaba la la pynlong bad ki . Ki kyntu ïa per bad mane ïa ki blei thala jong kata ka ri sha kaba kin sa leit rung .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Behold , thou shalt sleep with thy fathers  ; and this people will rise up , and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land , whither they go to be among them , and will forsake me , and break my covenant which I have made with them .

translation.kha: U Samuel u ong ha ki , U Trai bad u Syiem uba u la jingduh ki longsem ki sakhi myntor ka sngi ba phi la shem ba por long uba lui lui . Ho-oid , U Tlai u Long u sakhi jong ngi , ki jubab .
translation.en: And he said unto them , The  Lord  is witness against you , and his anointed is witness this day , that ye have not found ought in my hand . And they answered , He is witness .

translation.kha: Haseroth uno Un na pa’ kiba long ki kpa phin ai ïa u khun jong phi da u bseiñ haba u pan ïa ka dohkha ?
translation.en: If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father , will he give him a stone ? or if he ask a fish , will he for a fish give him a serpent ?

translation.kha: Hynrei kdor shym beh noh ïa ki Kenan kiba sheng ha Hasor ; kumta ki Kanaan ki la shong la sai hapdeng ki Epaphras haduh kane ka sngi , hynñiew la pynjop ïa ki ban Trei kum ki mraw .
translation.en: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer : but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day , and serve under tribute .
And his disciples asked him , saying , Why then say the scribes that Elias must first come ?
translation.kha: Nangta ki synran ki la kylli ïa U Jisu ,  Balei ba ki nonghikai Aiñ ki ong ba u Elijah u la dei ban wan shuwa ?

translation.en: That they shall drive thee from men , and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field , and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen , and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven , and seven times shall pass over thee , till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men , and giveth it to whomsoever he will .
translation.kha: Yn beh noh ïa phi na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew bad phin shong phin sah bad ki mradkhlaw . Hynñiew snem phin bam phlang kum u masi dab , bad thiah ha bym don jingkah ei ei , ha kaba ka umjer kan hap halor jong phi . Te phin pdiang ba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u bat synshar ïa baroh ki hima ki briew , bad ba u lah ban ai ïa ki ha uno uno uba u jied .
Katba u Beten ïa u Sabbai ha ka lyngkha , katto katto-katne na u , u la tap ha ka lynti ïaid , bad ki sim ki la wang bad bam ïa u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as he sowed , some fell by the way side , and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up .

translation.kha: Kumba ka la long ha ka par jong u Noah kumta kad long ha ki sngi jong U Khun U Briew .
translation.en: And as it was in the days of Noah , so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man .

translation.kha: Ka jingjot kaba ar shah ka la hap halor jong pha : ïa ka jaka jong pha la pynjot ha ka thma , bad ki briew jong pha ki la ïapthngan . Ym anna uno uno kaba pyn-i jingsngewlem ïa pha .
translation.en: These two things are come unto thee  ; who shall be sorry for thee ? desolation , and destruction , and the famine , and the sword : by whom shall I comfort thee ?

translation.kha: U Lah ban bam ïa ka jingbam kaba la kñia nongtuh ha la , ïa ka jingbna ainguh bam Kaba kynthah , bad kaba kyntang eh ;
translation.en: He shall eat the bread of his God , both of the most holy , and of the holy .

translation.kha: Haba kata ka por ka poi , yn ym don nongïathuhlypa u ban sngewtieng ïa ki jingpyniwbih jong u lane leh kum u nongïathuhlypa lane kup ïa ka jaiñkup bakhain jyllang u nongïathuhlypa ktang ban shukor ïa ki briew .
translation.en: And it shall come to pass in that day , that the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision , when he hath prophesied  ; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive :
For the love of money is the root of all evil : which while some coveted after , they have erred from the faith , and pierced themselves through with many sorrows .
translation.kha: Naba ka jingieit ïa ka spah ka long ka thymmei jong ki jait jingsniew baroh . Don kiba da kwah eh ban ïoh ïa ka haduh ba ki la ïaid sakma na ka jingngeit bad ki pait dohnud na ki jingsngewsih babun .

translation.en: And there came also Nicodemus , which at the first came to Jesus by night , and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes , about an hundred pound weight .
translation.kha: U Nikodemos , uba ha kaba nyngkong u la leit ban ïakynduh ïa U Jisu mynmiet , u la leit ryngkat bad u Joseph , u da rah bad u kumba laiphew kilo ki musla , ka jingkhleh lang jong ka mirr bad ka alos .

translation.en: And to devise curious works , to work in gold , and in silver , and in brass ,
translation.kha: ban pyrkhat ïa ki dur kiba itynnat bad ban saiñ ïa ki ha ka ksiar , ha ka rupa , bad ha ka rnong ;

translation.en: And when they go forth into the utter court , even into the utter court to the people , they shall put off their garments wherein they ministered , and lay them in the holy chambers , and they shall put on other garments  ; and they shall not sanctify the people with their garments .
translation.kha: Shuwa ba kin leit sha ka phyllaw ba kham shabar ha kaba don ki paidbah , ki dei ban loit noh shuwa ïa ki sopti ba ki phong haba ki don ha ka kam hapoh ka Templ bad ban iehnoh ïa ki ha ki kamra bakhuid . Kin phong da kiwei pat ki sopti khnang ba kin buh noh ïa ki sopti bakyntang na kaba pynmynsaw ïa ki paidbah .
Nangta u Darius u phah ïa kane ka jubab : Ha u Tattenai , u lat jong ka Ephrath Sepngi , u Shethar Bosenai , bad ki to rangbah synlar ha Ïuphratis Sepngi .
translation.en: Now therefore , Tatnai , governor beyond the river , Shethar–bozenai , and your companions the Apharsachites , which are beyond the river , be ye far from thence :

translation.kha: Da Kino ki ktien , nga pynlong ka jutang bad phi : Nga kular ba lano lano ruh tun ym pynjot shuh ïa ki jingthaw ba-im da ka jingshlei um , da lat lwa ruh ka jingshlei um Kan ym pynjot shuh ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: And I will establish my covenant with you  ; neither shall all flesh be cut off any more by the waters of a flood  ; neither shall there any more be a flood to destroy the earth .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kaba bud , U Jiw bad ki lai ngut ki synran ki la hiar na u lum , bad u paidbah babun u la ïakynduh ïa U Jisu .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that on the next day , when they were come down from the hill , much people met him .

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei banbeiñ pyntngit ïa kita ki jingbna ingiew
translation.en: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel , which they offer unto the  Lord   ;

translation.kha: Nongbah U Trai U Blei jong phira u long uba khrawbor tam halor ki Blei baroh Bad halor ki bor baroh . U long uba khraw bad umbah donbor , bad uba dei ban sheptieng . U bym ñiewshiliang khmat bad u bym ju ïa-pdiang ïa ki jingai kiba da ka ïaduna ka bymkhuid .
translation.en: For the  Lord  your God is God of gods , and Lord of lords , a great God , a mighty , and a terrible , which regardeth not persons , nor taketh reward :

translation.kha: kane Keiñ , ka long kum phi dei ngab duwai : ‘ Ko KA jong ngi uba ha bneng : Ai ba ka kyrteng bakyllut jyllang me kan long kaba la pynjyrngam ;
translation.en: After this manner therefore pray ye : Our Father which art in heaven , Hallowed be thy name .
For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers , specially they of the circumcision :
translation.kha: Naba don shibun , khamtam kiba la kylla na ka niam Jiw , kiba ïaleh pyrshah bad kiba shukor ïa kiwei da ka jingleh bym don jingmut jong ki .
To sngew ïa kane , phi ki jaitbynriew baroh ; to sngewdap ïa kane , ko phiah kiba im ha ka pyrthei ! U Trai Nongsynshar un sakhi byrsha ïa phi . To shakor ! U kren na ka templ ba kynja bneng .
translation.en: Hear , all ye people  ; hearken , O earth , and all that therein is : and let the Lord  God  be witness against you , the Lord from his holy temple .

translation.kha: Namar ba phi long ki briew jong U Blei , kam long kaba dei wat ban ïakren hapdeng Jong phi ïa Kine kino ki kam awria ne ki kam jakhlia ne ki kam kwah lalot .
translation.en: But fornication , and all uncleanness , or covetousness , let it not be once named among you , as becometh saints ;

translation.kha: A Trai , to isynei ïa ine . Ngi la buh ïa ka jingkyrmen ha me . To ïada ïa ngi man la ka sngi mala to pynim ïa ngi ha ki por jong ka jingjynjar .
translation.en: O  Lord  , be gracious unto us  ; we have waited for thee : be thou their arm every morning , our salvation also in the time of trouble .

translation.kha: Haba la pynkhreh ïa u , u long uba shympriah ; ym don mian mian ba nud bad ïeng ha khmat jong u .
translation.en: None is so fierce that dare stir him up : who then is able to stand before me ?

translation.kha: U kwah ban wanrah biang ïa kito kiba u buh jingkynmaw bad ban ïohi ba ki im biang ha pyrthei .—Job 14 :27 , 15 .
translation.en: He yearns to bring back those who are in his memory and to see them live on earth again . —Job 14 :14 , 15 .

translation.kha: Ha kata khih ka miat , u Pharaoh u la phuh khot mar meng ïa u Maaseïah bad u Haran , bad u ong , Khlieh mihnoh na ka ri jong nga , ma phi sad ki Jeruel ! Haei leit bad mane ïa U Trai ruma phi la pan .
translation.en: And he called for Moses and Aaron by night , and said , Rise up , and get you forth from among my people , both ye and the children of Israel  ; and go , serve the  Lord  , as ye have said .
How are the voluntary contributions used ?
translation.kha: Kumno la pyndonkam ïa ki jingnoh synñiang ?
Jngai na kaba ki briew ki shong ki sah ; lane ba ki kjat briew ki ju ïaid , ki briew ki dik ïa ki thliew ha ki to . Haneng ki treh ha ka jingkynjah marwei , da kaba sdieh ïa ki tyllai ha ki taïew .
translation.en: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant  ; even the waters forgotten of the foot : they are dried up , they are gone away from men .

translation.kha: A katno kaba shyrkhei ïa phi ki Pharisi ! Phi ieit ïa ki jaka shong ba la buh kyrpang ha ki synagog mala ban shah khublei da ka jingburom ha ki jaka ïew .
translation.en: Woe unto you , Pharisees ! for ye love the uppermost seats in the synagogues , and greetings in the markets .

translation.kha: Mynta , U Blei u la pynlong ïa ki jingkular jngai u ha u Abraham bad ha u nonghiarpateng lad u . Ka Jingthoh Bakhuid kad Shimham pyndonkam da ki kyntien ki nonghiarpateng , kaba thew sbun ki briew , hynrei ka pyndonkam da ka kyntien u nonghiarpateng , kaba mut tang uwei u briew , kaba mut U Khrist .
translation.en: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made . He saith not , And to seeds , as of many ; but as of one , And to thy seed , which is Christ .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi U Trei , U Mynsiem u la shim ïa nga , bad ar la ïohsngew ïa ka sur bajam , kaba suit kum ka turoi , kaba kren na shaid jong nga .
translation.en: I was in the Spirit on the Lord s day , and heard behind me a great voice , as of a trumpet ,

translation.kha: bad ki Ïohi ba ka khmat Jong u ka tyngshaiñ . Kumta u buh biang ïa kata ka jaiñtapkhmat haduh ba un da leit ïakren bapaw bad U Trai .
translation.en: And the children of Israel saw the face of Moses , that the skin of Moses  face shone : and Moses put the veil upon his face again , until he went in to speak with him .

translation.kha: U Joab bad ki rangbah jong u ki la shimti ïa ka met jong u Asahel malade ki la tep ïa ka ha ka jingtep ka longïing jong u ha Bethlehem . Nangta ki la ïaid baroh shi miet , bad ha ka por kynta shai ki la wan pei biang ha Hebron .
translation.en: And they took up Asahel , and buried him in the sepulchre of his father , which was in Beth–lehem . And Joab and his men went all night , and they came to Hebron at break of day .

translation.kha: Kumjuh ruh ïa ki shynrang ba dang khem apil to kyntu jur ïa ki ïa-ban synshar bha ïa lade .
translation.en: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded .

translation.kha: Ka kharai ka pra phum , bad ïa u diengpynïeng la pynsaphred ha maïan , kumba u nongïathuhlypa u la kren ialap ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai’ .
translation.en: The altar also was rent , and the ashes poured out from the altar , according to the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the  Lord .

Without the veil of the testimony , in the tabernacle of the congregation , shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the  Lord  continually : it shall be a statute for ever in your generations .
translation.kha: Man la ka janmiet , u Aaron un thang ïa ki bad un ieh ba kin meh haduh mynstep ha khmat U  Trai  shabar ka jingkah kaba ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang . Ïa kane ka hukum dei ban leh pateng la pateng .
NGA la jubab , Kam long kumta ! Ngam phet nala . Hynrei u Irijah um Sngap ïa nga . Pynban , u la kem ïa nga bad ïalam ïa at sha ki rangbah synshar .
translation.en: Then said Jeremiah , It is false  ; I fall not away to the Chaldeans . But he hearkened not to him : so Irijah took Jeremiah , and brought him to the princes .
And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden , Come  ; for all things are now ready .
translation.kha: Haba ka la dei ka por ïa ka jingkhawai , u la phah ïa u shakri jong u ban ong ha ki nongshahkhot sngewbha jong u , ‘ To wan , la dep khreh ïa kaei kaei baroh !’
Khreh na ka byndi ki briew ki bym lah ban krai na ka bynta ïa lade . Ïada ïa ki hok jngai baroh ki bym don jingïarap .
translation.en: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction .

translation.kha: Baroh kaba jia ha kane ka pyllait ka jia ha ka pa kaba U Blei u jied .
translation.en: To every thing there is a season , and a time to every purpose under the heaven :
And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices : and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne , which are the seven Spirits of God .
translation.kha: Na ka khet la mih ki jingthaba leilieh , ki jingkyrhuh , ki jingsawa u pyrthat . Ha khmat jong ka khet , la don hynñiew tylli ki dongmusa bameh , kiba long ki hynñiew ki mynsiem jong U Blei .
bad un kñia ïa u bad ka jingainguh bameh halor ka duwan . Kumne keiñ u lyngdoh un pyndep ïa ka lap lehniam kaba ïadei pynlang ka jingpyndep , bad uta u briew un sa long uba khuid .
translation.en: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar : and the priest shall make an atonement for him , and he shall be clean .
But what things were gain to me , those I counted loss for Christ .
translation.kha: Hynrei kita kiei kiei baroh kiba nga lah ban ñiew kum ka jingmyntoi ; ïa kine , nga la ñiew mynta ka jingduh na ka bynta U Khrist .
Nangta U Jingsuk u la hukum ïa ki synran jong u ban ym ïathmu hano hano ba u long U Messaïah .
translation.en: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ .

translation.kha: Ki i kum ki kulai ; ki mareh kamon ki balui thnam .
translation.en: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses  ; and as horsemen , so shall they run .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ïa per
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came to me , saying ,
That they may do evil with both hands earnestly , the prince asketh , and the judge asketh for a reward  ; and the great man , he uttereth his mischievous desire : so they wrap it up .
translation.kha: Ki long kiba tbit baroh ha kaba leh ïa kaba sniew . Ki rangbah synshar bad ki nongbishar ki bamsap . U briew uba lah u ong ha ki ïa kaei kaba u kwah , bad kumta ki ïasylla lang .

translation.en: And he looked round about on them which sat about him , and said ,  Behold my mother and my brethren !
translation.kha: U la peit ïa ki briew kiba shong sawdong jong u bad u la ong ,  Khmih ! Hangne ki don ka kmie jong nga bad ki para jong nga !
Khmih halor kane ka Templ mynsngi pynlang mynmiet , kano ka jaka ha ka me la lngaid ban Mane ïa me . Shahshkor ïa nga haba at phai ka khmat sha kane ka templ Ban duwai .
translation.en: That thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day , even toward the place of which thou hast said , My name shall be there : that thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which thy servant shall make toward this place .
Male and female created he them  ; and blessed them , and called their name Adam , in the day when they were created .
translation.kha: Shynrang bad kynthei u la thaw ïa ki , U la kyrkhu ïa ki , bad u la kyrteng ïa ki ,  Ki Briew . )
ban pynïap ïa ki shynrang bad ïa ki kynthei , ban pynïap ïa kaba la tymmen bad ïa kiba dang samla , ban pynnep ïa ki khñium shynrang bad ki khynnah kynthei ,
translation.en: With thee also will I break in pieces man and woman  ; and with thee will I break in pieces old and young  ; and with thee will I break in pieces the young man and the maid  ;

And the bones of Joseph , which the children of Israel brought up out of Egypt , buried they in Shechem , in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver : and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph .
translation.kha: Ïa ka met jong u Joseph , kaba ki paid Israel ki la wanrah na Ijipt , la tep ha Shekhem , ha kata ka jaka ba u Jakob u la thied ha ka dor shispah tylli ki sbai rupa na ki khun jong u Hamor , u kpa jong u Shekhem . Ïa kane ka jaka la ïohpateng da ki khun ki ksiew jong u Joseph .
Ban leit bieit na ka kpoh sha ka jingtep , kan jin da la long kaba bha kum ka sem shym ni .
translation.en: I should have been as though I had not been  ; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave .
( Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures , )
translation.kha: Ïa ka Khubor Babha la kular la slem bah da U Blei lyngba ki nongïathuhlypa jong u , kumba la thoh ha ki Jingthoh Bakhuid .

ba u Hanamel , u khun jong u kñi jong nga , u Shallum , un wan sha nga bad ka jingkyrpad ban thied ïa ka lyngkhot jong u ha Anathoth ha ka thain Benjamin , namar nga long u ba-ïashun bajan hano bad ba nga don ka hok ban thied ïa ka na ka bynta ïa lade .
translation.en: Behold , Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee , saying , Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth : for the right of redemption is thine to buy it .

translation.kha: don shibun u phlangïap bad ka jingbam ïa ki jingrai ha ïing jong Ngi , bad don hajuh ka jaka na ka beit jong phi ban sah .
translation.en: She said moreover unto him , We have both straw and provender enough , and room to lodge in .

translation.kha: bad u ïa-ong ha u , Kanneh ka long kaei kaba U Trei u ong , ‘ Namar ba me la phah ki nonglamktien ban kylli na u Bathsheba , u blei ka Ekron — i kumba ym don bieit ha Israel ba kylli — men ym ïitkhmih ; men ïap !’
translation.en: And he said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Forasmuch as thou hast sent messengers to enquire of Baal–zebub the god of Ekron , is it not because there is no God in Israel to enquire of his word ? therefore thou shalt not come down off that bed on which thou art gone up , but shalt surely die .
And Abram and Nahor took them wives : the name of Abram s wife was Sarai  ; and the name of Nahor s wife , Milcah , the daughter of Haran , the father of Milcah , and the father of Iscah .
translation.kha: U Abram u la shongkurim ïa ka Sarai , bad u Nahor u la shongkurim ïa ka Milkah , ka khun jong u Haran , uba long ruh u kpa jong ka Iskah .
U briew umbah bha un ym bakla da lei lei ; yn ïai kynmaw Borabor ïa u .
translation.en: Surely he shall not be moved for ever : the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance .

translation.kha: Ka Mari ka la kynmaw ïa kine kiei Kiei baroh bad ka la pyrthuh jylliew shaphang nia .
translation.en: But Mary kept all these things , and pondered them in her heart .

translation.kha: Kiar na ki briew kiba bieit ; kim don ei ei ban hikai ïa phi .
translation.en: Go from the presence of a foolish man , when thou perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge .

translation.kha: Ki hynñiew snem Kiba phah kiba ka ri Ijipt ka la ïoh lehkmen ki la kut , bad ki ingiew snem jong ka nemsniew ki la sdang , kamra u Joseph u la lah ong .
translation.en: And the seven years of plenteousness , that was in the land of Egypt , were ended .

translation.kha: To ainguh ïa U Trai , naba u long kaba bha ; bad ka jingieit jong u ka neh bymjukut .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good : because his mercy endureth for ever .

translation.kha: Mynta , ko khun u briew , por la pynlong ïa me u nongap ïa ka jaitbynriew Israel . Me dei ban pynpoi sha ki ïa ki jingïam ba nga ai ha me .
translation.en: So thou , O son of man , I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel  ; therefore thou shalt hear the word at my mouth , and warn them from me .

translation.kha: lem bad ka jingainguh bam kob sei kilo u purew ba la khleh lang bad sei litar ka umphniang Olib kaba bha tam .
translation.en: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering , mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil .

translation.kha: Ha ka stait kaba bud , u Joshua bad ki dala Israel baroh ki khie dang step phyrngab , bad ki mihnoh na ka jaka sheng dara ha Asasaïah , bad ki la leit shata Jordan , ha kaba ki la sher dara katba ki dang ap ba-bang jam ïa ka .
translation.en: And Joshua rose early in the morning  ; and they removed from Shittim , and came to Jordan , he and all the children of Israel , and lodged there before they passed over .
Yet he sent prophets to them , to bring them again unto the  Lord   ; and they testified against them : but they would not give ear .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la phah ïa ki nongïathuhlypa ban maham ïa ki ban phai pat sha u , hynrei ki paidbah ki kyntait ban shahshkor .

translation.en: Son of man , say unto the prince of Tyre , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thine heart is lifted up , and thou hast said , I am a God , I sit in the seat of God , in the midst of the seas  ; yet thou art a man , and not God , though thou set thine heart as the heart of God :
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong ,  ïathuh ïa u nongsynshar ka Tyros kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar , nga ong ha u : Ba la pynhieng da ka jingsarong , me kam ba me dei U Blei . Me ong ba kum U Blei me shong ha ka khet , ba la ker sawdong da ki duriaw . Me lah ban leh mynleh kum U Blei , hynrei , em , me long uba kynja briew , ym uba kynja blei .

Nangta u Elisha u sha ki bad u ino , Phi la rumal lynter ; kane kam dei kata ka shnong kaba phi wad . Bud ïa nga , bad kun ïalam ïa phi! shai iathuh u briew ïa uba phi buid . Bad u ïalam ïa ki sha Samaria .
translation.en: And Elisha said unto them , This is not the way , neither is this the city : follow me , and I will bring you to the man whom ye seek . But he led them to Samaria .

translation.kha: Kane ka dei ka khubor shaphang ka Babilonia . Kim ka erlangthari kaban sar shai shiliang ka ri shyiap , ka jingjot kan wan na ka ri kaba shyrkhei .
translation.en: The burden of the desert of the sea . As whirlwinds in the south pass through  ; so it cometh from the desert , from a terrible land .

translation.kha: Ha kane ka prie ka jinghikai ba phi ai pateng sha kiei pat ka pynhapoh noh ïa ka ktien jong U Blei . Bad don bun kiwei kiei kiei kum kane kaba phi bor .
translation.en: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition , which ye have delivered : and many such like things do ye .

translation.kha: Ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong la , mynba ine long ki khun U Blei , hynrei kad pah da shai aiu ngin sa long . Khenani ngi tip ba ynda U Khrist un paw , ngin ïoh long kum ma u , namar ngin ïohi ïa u kumba u long da shisha .
translation.en: Beloved , now are we the sons of God , and it doth not yet appear what we shall be : but we know that , when he shall appear , we shall be like him  ; for we shall see him as he is .

translation.kha: U Amasaïah u pynnep kawei-na-kaba-shiphew hajar ngut ki shipai Elam ha ka Them Mluh ; u kurup ïa ka nongbah Sela ha ka thma bad u khot ïa ka , ka Joktheel , ka kyrteng kaba dang ïaisah .
translation.en: He slew of Edom in the valley of salt ten thousand , and took Sela by war , and called the name of it Joktheel unto this day .

translation.kha: Ynda ki Israel ki wan phai na kaba beh kthong ïa ki Philistia , ki lute ïa ka jaka sher kamar-tama jyllang ki .
translation.en: And the children of Israel returned from chasing after the Philistines , and they spoiled their tents .

translation.kha: Te kumta , ko ki nongaplangbrot jong nga , ngi don ka kamar kaba ngi dei ban sa , hynrei kam dei ïa ngi Ban im kat kum ka jingkwah jong ka jinglong ba kynjai doh jong ngi .
translation.en: Therefore , brethren , we are debtors , not to the flesh , to live after the flesh .
And he sought God in the days of Zechariah , who had understanding in the visions of God : and as long as he sought the  Lord  , God made him to prosper .
translation.kha: Katba u Sekharaïah u nongaibuit jong u ha kaba ïadei bad ka niam u dang im ; u la shakri hok ïa U  Trai  bad U Blei u la kyrkhu ïa u .

Kumta ha “kata ka sngi ki la khem shikatdei katba ki ïabam ïadih ha ka jingdon ryngkat U Trai . Ha ka sien kaba ar ki la thung syiem ïa u Solomon . Ha ka kyrteng jong U Tlai ki la pynsleh ïa u kum u nongsynshar jong ki bad ïa u Sadok kum u lyngdoh .
translation.en: And did eat and drink before the  Lord  on that day with great gladness . And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time , and anointed him unto the  Lord  to be the chief governor , and Zadok to be priest .

translation.kha: U Balei um ju pynkyllaiñ ïa ka jingbishar hok , um ju pep ban leh ïa naba dei .
translation.en: Doth God pervert judgment ? or doth the Almighty pervert justice ?

translation.kha: Na la plie ïa ka jaka ha kaba la Buh ïa ki atiar jong nga , bad ha ka jingtur nga la shim noh ïa ki , namar ma nga , U TRAI’ Nongsynshar Badonbor Bahok , nga don ka kur baneh leh ha Babilonia .
translation.en: The  Lord  hath opened his armoury , and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation : for this is the work of the Lord  God  of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans .

translation.kha: u Isaak u ong , Ko pa ! U jingbabe , Oi , khun ? U Isak u kylli , Nga ïohi ïa ki rnga barhem bad ïa ki dieng , hynriew hangno patan u khunlangbrot na ka bynta ka jingkñia ?
translation.en: And Isaac spake unto Abraham his father , and said , My father : and he said , Here am I , my son . And he said , Behold the fire and the wood : but where is the lamb for a burnt offering ?

translation.kha: Ka jingai ban pynbna ïa ka khubor U blem ka dei ban long kaba lah ban syiar da uba kren , Naaman U Blang um kwah ïa ngi ban long ha ka jingmynjur kynram hynrei ha ka jingkyntait bad ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: For God is not the author of confusion , but of peace , as in all churches of the saints .

translation.kha: Hato film tip ? Hattush ym shem la ïathuh slem mynhynne ? Hato phim shym ïohsngew kumno ka pyrthei ka shadong ?
translation.en: Have ye not known ? have ye not heard ? hath it not been told you from the beginning ? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth ?

I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh : for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity ; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness .
translation.kha: (Nga pyndonkam ka ktien kaba ïakren man ka sngi namar ka jingtlot jong ka jingim tynrai jong phi .) Mynshuwa phi la pyndem ïa lade nadong shadong kum ki mraw ka jingbymkhuid bad ka jingbymman na ka bynta ki jingthmu bymman . Ha kajuh ka rukom mynta phi dei ban pyndem ïa lade nadong shadong kum ki mraw jong ka hok na ka bynta ki jingthmu bakhuid .

translation.en: Yet within three days shall Pharaoh lift up thy head from off thee , and shall hang thee on a tree  ; and the birds shall eat thy flesh from off thee .
translation.kha: Hapoh lai sngi u syiem un sa pyllait noh ïa phi — un phah khrai khlieh ïa phi ! Nangta un sa sdien ïa ka met jong phi ha u dieng , bad ki sim kin bam ïa ka doh jong phi .
Ym don ei ei ha ngi naba ngi lah ngab dawa ba ngi longkmie kiba batip ban leh ïa kane ka kam . Ka jingtah jong ngi ka wan na U Blei ;
translation.en: Not that we are sufficient of ourselves to think any thing as of ourselves ; but our sufficiency is of God ;

translation.kha: Katba u Samuel u ïangat ai ïa ka jingkñia , ki Philistia ki tur sha jan ban ïaleh ; hynrei hangta U Trai u kyrhuh kum u pyrthat na bneng pyrshah ïa ki . Ki la shaïong ngaiñ , bad ki la phet thied ha ka jingkulmar .
translation.en: And as Samuel was offering up the burnt offering , the Philistines drew near to battle against Israel : but the  Lord  thundered with a great thunder on that day upon the Philistines , and discomfited them  ; and they were smitten before Israel .
