U Trai u tip lada phi long kiba pynkheiñ . Bad um sngewngiah ïa kata ; bad nangta u lah ban ym pynshitom ïa u .
translation.en: Lest the  Lord  see it , and it displease him , and he turn away his wrath from him .

Surely the isles shall wait for me , and the ships of Tarshish first , to bring thy sons from far , their silver and their gold with them , unto the name of the  Lord  thy God , and to the Holy One of Israel , because he hath glorified thee .
translation.kha: Ki dei ki liengbah kiba wan na ki ri kiba jngai , ki wallam ïa ki paidlang U Blei sha la ïing . Ki wanrah ryngkat bad ki ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar , ban pyndonburom ïa ka kyrteng U  Trai U Blei Bakhuid ka Israel , uba pynlong ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ban pyndonburom ïa ki briew jong u .
Kim lehrain satia ban ïai pynbitar ïa ang . Ki ai jingkñia sha ki blei thala ha ki ksar mawkyntang bad thang jingiwbih ha ki duwan ba-thala .
translation.en: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face  ; that sacrificeth in gardens , and burneth incense upon altars of brick  ;

translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u kham riewspah Bad hasem tari ban ïa uno uno u syiem ,
translation.en: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom .
Jesus saith unto them ,  Have ye understood all these things ?  They say unto him , Yea , Lord .
translation.kha: Hato phi shemphang ïa kine kiei kiei ?  U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki .  Ho-oid ,  ki la jubab .
Ha kaba ka don ka jingpihuiñ nabar ka jingkhwan mynta , hangta ka don ruh ka jingbymïaid ryntih bad ki jait jingsniew baroh .
translation.en: For where envying and strife is , there is confusion and every evil work .
And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward :
translation.kha: Ngi ong ïa kane namar ngi don ka jingsngewskhem ha U Blei lyngba U Khrist .
Naba U Mynsiem Bakhuid um pat shym la wan hiar haei ha-ei ruh na ki ; la pynbyrngia ïa ki tang ha ka kyrteng U TRAI’ Jisu .
translation.en: ( For as yet he was fallen upon none of them : only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus . )

translation.kha: Hato to ba kylli shaphang u Titos , u longïing u nongïatrei lang mala nga ban ïarap ïa phi ; bad shaphang kiwei pat ki parabangeit kiba ïaleit lang bad u , ki mihkhmat ïa ki balang bad ki wallam ka burom ïa U Khrist .
translation.en: Whether any do enquire of Titus , he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you : or our brethren be enquired of , they are the messengers of the churches , and the glory of Christ .

translation.kha: Ko ki paid Israel , ngam shym la dawa ïa ki jingkñia bad ki jingainguh ha re ki sawphew snieh ha kaba nga la ïalam ïa phi lymbung ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: Have ye offered unto me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years , O house of Israel ?

translation.kha: Kine ki nongbah bad ki nongrit jongnga ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaweh ki Long na ka jait Asher ki la ïohpdiang kumne ka jingtyngshaiñ jong ki .
translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Asher according to their families , these cities with their villages .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngin thaw ïa phi u kynjri da ka ksiar bad ki jingpynitynnat da ka rupa .
translation.en: For , lo , the winter is past , the rain is over and gone  ;

translation.kha: Ka la lama ka por tlang , bad ïa ka Jingkhawai Niam jong ka Jingpynkyntang ïa ka Templ Dang rakhe ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And it was at Jerusalem the feast of the dedication , and it was winter .

And the three companies blew the trumpets , and brake the pitchers , and held the lamps in their left hands , and the trumpets in their right hands to blow withal : and they cried , The sword of the  Lord  , and of Gideon .
translation.kha: Baroh ki bat ïa ki dongmusa ha la ki kti kadiang , ïa ki turoi ha la ki kti kamon , bad ki pyrta ,  Ka waitlam ïa U  Trai  bad ïa u Gideon !
Hangta ha khmat U Trai U balui jong phi , uba la kyrkhu ïa phi , ma phi bad ki ba-ha-ïing ha-sem jongnga phin phin ïabam bad ïalehkmen ha ki kiei kiba beh kiba phi la trei snoh .
translation.en: And there ye shall eat before the  Lord  your God , and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto , ye and your households , wherein the  Lord  thy God hath blessed thee .

translation.kha: Hato ym don u ban jubab ïa kñia ka jingkren bieit baroh ? Hato kaba krong Bunni ka pynksan ïa u briew ?
translation.en: Should not the multitude of words be answered ? and should a man full of talk be justified ?

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab phin ïoh kine ki jingtei bakhraw ? Ïa uwei u maw ruh yn ym iehnoh ha ka jaka jong u ; ïa uwei pa aiwai na ki yn sa pynkhyllem noh .
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto him ,  Seest thou these great buildings ? there shall not be left one stone upon another , that shall not be thrown down .

translation.kha: kumta u Sadok , u Nathan , u Benaïah , bad ki nongïada syiem ki pynslem ïa u Salmunna halor u khashor jong u Syiem Dabid bad ki la synran ïa u sha ka Umpohliew Gihon .
translation.en: So Zadok the priest , and Nathan the prophet , and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada , and the Cherethites , and the Pelethites , went down , and caused Solomon to ride upon king David s mule , and brought him to Gihon .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem u Ong ha u Haman , Pynkloi bad shim ïa ki jaiñphong bad ïa u kulai bad pyndonburom kumne ïa u Mordekai , u Jiw . Lem ïa u baroh kata kaba me la ai jingmut . Men shem ïa u ba u daiñ shong ha ka khyrdop jong ka jingïamai .
translation.en: Then the king said to Haman , Make haste , and take the apparel and the horse , as thou hast said , and do even so to Mordecai the Jew , that sitteth at the king s gate : let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken .

Then said some of his disciples among themselves , What is this that he saith unto us ,  A little while , and ye shall not see me : and again , a little while , and ye shall see me : and , Because I go to the Father ?
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut na ki synran jong u ki la ïakylli para ma ki ,  Ka mut aïu kane ? U ïathuh ïa ngi ba sa tang shipor ngin ym ïohi shuh ïa u ; bad nangta sa shipor hadien ngin sa ïohi ïa u ; bad u ong ruh , ‘ Ka long namar ba ngan sa leit noh sha U Kpa .’
Nalor baïar , kine ki Long ki briew kiba me la jied ïa-ban longïng ki jongnga me bad uba me la wallam noh na ka ri Ijipt da ka har bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong me .’
translation.en: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance , which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm .

translation.kha: Ki sanphew ngut ki nongïathuhlypa na Jakeh ki la ïuh ïa u badno ki ong , Ka bor u Elishah ka dat ha u Elisha ! Ki la leit ban ïashah ïa u , ki la buh riang ha khmat jyllang u ,
translation.en: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him , they said , The spirit of Elijah doth rest on Elisha . And they came to meet him , and bowed themselves to the ground before him .

translation.kha: Ka tnga kaba bunktien ka long syriem kum ka um kiba jaw jrop shi jrop ha ka sngi ba plung .
translation.en: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Jehoash u la leh , kambah kynthup ïa ka jingshlur jong u ha ka thma pyrshah ïa u Amasaïah u syiem ka Judith , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori Jong Ki Syiem Ka Jeriel .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Joash , and all that he did , and his might wherewith he fought against Amaziah king of Judah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?

translation.kha: U syiem Josaïah u pynjot ïa baroh ki bleithaw ba-ijli kiba don ha ka ri katba dei jong ki paid Israel , bad katba u dang im , u dawa ba ki briew ktien shakri ïa U Trai , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel , and made all that were present in Israel to serve , even to serve the  Lord  their God . And all his days they departed not from following the  Lord  , the God of their fathers .

translation.kha: Bad U Jisu u ïai bteng ban ino , Bad kumin nga ong ha phi : Pynlong paralok na ka bynta ïa lade da ka spah ba kynja pyrthei , khnam ba haba kam don shuh , yn pdiang jingsngewbha ïa phi sha ka ïing bymjukut .
translation.en: And I say unto you , Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness  ; that , when ye fail , they may receive you into everlasting habitations .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong , Ki briew jong ka Moab ki la ïai leh jop , bun na ka bynta kane kun pynshitom da shisha ïa ki . Kin shym burom ïa ki shynrang u syiem Edom da kaba thang haduh ba kin da kylla dpei .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; For three transgressions of Moab , and for four , I will not turn away the punishment thereof  ; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime :

translation.kha: Bad ïa pham pat ko khambun ! Hato phan khah ban kyntiew ïa lade sha bneng ? Ïa pha yn bret sha tbian sha dkhoh ! Lada ïa ki kambah ïa kiba la leh ha pha , la lah leh ha Sodom , kan jin da la sah haw Mynta !
translation.en: And thou , Capernaum , which art exalted unto heaven , shalt be brought down to hell : for if the mighty works , which have been done in thee , had been done in Sodom , it would have remained until this day .
And it came to pass , when king Hezekiah heard it , that he rent his clothes , and covered himself with sackcloth , and went into the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem Hesekaïah tang mar ïohsngew ïa kaba la ïathuh , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , u phong da ka jaiñ khain , bad u leit sha ka Templ jong U  Trai .
Ka Babilonia kynsan kynsan ka kyllaiñ bad la pynstet noh ! To ïam namar jong ka ! Pynïoh dawai na ka byndi ki jingmeng jong ka , bad lehse yn lah ban pynkhiah .
translation.en: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed : howl for her  ; take balm for her pain , if so be she may be healed .
They shall howl , saying , How is it broken down ! how hath Moab turned the back with shame ! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him .
translation.kha: Ïa ka Moab la pynkhynñiuh ! To kyang jam ! Ïa ka Moab la pynjahburom . Ka don ha ki jingjot , bad baroh ki hima ba don sawdong ki rkhiebeiñ ïa ka . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: So that contrariwise ye ought rather to forgive him , and comfort him , lest perhaps such a one should be swallowed up with overmuch sorrow .
translation.kha: Pynban , mynta , phi dei ban map ïa u bad ban pynshlur ïa u , khnang ban ïada ïa u na kaba sngewsih eh kat ban da kyntait noh shisyndon ïa u .

translation.en: The centurion answered and said , Lord , I am not worthy that thou shouldest come under my roof : but speak the word only , and my servant shall be healed .
translation.kha: O em , ko Kynrad ,  la jubab u rangbah pynïaidkam .  Ngam long uba dei hok ba phin wan shapoh ka ïing jong nga . Shu ai hukum , bad u shakri jong nga un ïohkhiah .
Un ym pynkheiñ ïa u haw ba la dem un ym pynlip ïa ka sharak ba dang mehding , un ïarah ka jingbishar khor baneh ïa baroh .
translation.en: A bruised reed shall he not break , and the smoking flax shall he not quench : he shall bring forth judgment unto truth .

translation.kha: U rangbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw u wanrah ïa ka snam ki mrad ha ka Jaka Kaba Kyntang Tam ïa ka ban ainguh kum ka jingkñia Namar ki pop ; hyndai ïa ki met jong ki mrad la thang shabar ka jaka shong dara .
translation.en: For the bodies of those beasts , whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin , are burned without the camp .

translation.kha: Nahath u Petros u la wan shuh U Jisu bad u la kulai , Ko Trai , lade u imon u para jong nga u ïai lai pop pyrshah ïa ar , haduh katno sien ang dei ban map ïa u ? Haduh hynñiew sien ?
translation.en: Then came Peter to him , and said , Lord , how oft shall my brother sin against me , and I forgive him ? till seven times ?

translation.kha: lane ban pyllut im ïa nga na uno uno u nongshukor ne u nongbanbor ?
translation.en: Or , Deliver me from the enemy s hand ? or , Redeem me from the hand of the mighty ?

Then the king of Israel called all the elders of the land , and said , Mark , I pray you , and see how this man seeketh mischief : for he sent unto me for my wives , and for my children , and for my silver , and for my gold  ; and I denied him not .
translation.kha: U syiem Ahab u khot ïa baroh ki nongïalam jong ka ri bad u ong ,  Phi ïohi ba une u briew u kwah ban pynjot ïa ngi . U la phah khubor sha nga da kaba dawa ïa ki tnga bad ki khun jong nga , ïa ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong nga bad nga la mynjur .
Ki long kiba mawpud kum ki kada khlaw , ki paid Israel kin ïaid ha la ka jong ka lynti . Ki la leit ban wad jingïarap na ki Assyria , bad ki la siew ruh ïa kiwei pat ki jyrthiaw ban ïada ïa ki .
translation.en: For they are gone up to Assyria , a wild ass alone by himself : Ephraim hath hired lovers .
And when the ship was caught , and could not bear up into the wind , we let her drive .
translation.kha: Ka la lynshop ïa ka lieng , bad namar ka long ka bym lah ban king ïa ka lieng sha khmat pyrshah ïa ka lyer , ngi la sangeh ban pyrshang bad ngi la shah ïa ka ban shah kit katba shaba beh ka lyer .
Khynñiuh ki buit jong phi ki wanrah ka jingthrang ha la ka erlangthari ; da kaba pynring ïa ki jaitbynriew babud phi la wallam tang ka jingjot ha put .
translation.en: Thou hast consulted shame to thy house by cutting off many people , and hast sinned against thy soul .
No lion shall be there , nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon , it shall not be found there  ; but the redeemed shall walk there :
translation.kha: Yn ym don sing hangta , ym don ki mrad bashyrkhei ki ban ïaid na kata ka lynti . Kito ïa kiba U  Trai  u la pyllait im kin ïaid sha ïing na kata ka lynti .
ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Rephaim ,
translation.en: And the Hittites , and the Perizzites , and the Rephaims ,
Because the  Lord  hath spoiled Babylon , and destroyed out of her the great voice  ; when her waves do roar like great waters , a noise of their voice is uttered :
translation.kha: Nga pynjot ïa ka Babilon bad nga pynsngap jar ïa ka . Ki kynhun shipai ki tur shapoh kum ki jingat phyllung bakyrhuh bad tur ïaleh da ki jingpyrta bajam .
Wat shim kabu ïano ïatan lane ban lute ïa u . Kam pynsah ïa ka bainong jong ine eit u briew uba phi la khot bylla , wat tieng shi miet jin .
translation.en: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour , neither rob him : the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning .

translation.kha: U Moses bad u Joshua u nongïarap jong u ki la khreh , bad u Moses u la wait kiew sha uta u lum uba kyntang .
translation.en: And Moses rose up , and his minister Joshua : and Moses went up into the mount of God .
Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings , to sacrifice before the  Lord   ; and a meat offering mingled with oil : for to day the  Lord  will appear unto you .
translation.kha: bad sa uwei u masi bad uwei u langbrot ban pynlong ka jingkñia ainguh ïasyllok . Dei ban kñia ïa ki ha U  Trai  ryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam ba la khleh bad ka umphniang . Ki dei ban leh ïa kane namar U  Trai  un wanpaw ha ki mynta ka sngi .

U jyllop , A Trai U Blei Badonbor Baroh , nga la shakri borabor ïa me — tang ïa me hi . Hynrei ki paid Isaia ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka million bad me , ki la pynpra ïa ki duwan jong me bad pynïap ïa baroh ki nongïohipaw jong me . Dei tang ma nga uba dong sah — bad ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ruh !
translation.en: And he said , I have been very zealous for the  Lord  God of hosts : because the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant , thrown down thine altars , and slain thy prophets with the sword  ; and I , even I only , am left  ; and they seek my life , to take it away .

translation.kha: Ki briew kin behmrad hangta da ki riewngeit bad ki khnam . Hodaïah , ka ri Baroh kadei kuna dap da ki shngain bad ki bniap shiah .
translation.en: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither  ; because all the land shall become briers and thorns .

So will I make my holy name known in the midst of my people Israel  ; and I will not let them pollute my holy name any more : and the heathen shall know that I am the  Lord  , the Holy One in Israel .
translation.kha: Ngan pynthikna ba ki briew jong nga ki Israel kin tip ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga , bad ngan ym shah shuh ba ïa ka kyrteng jong nga yn pynjahburom . Te ki jaitbynriew kin tip ba ma nga , U  Trai  , nga long U Blei U Bakhuid jong ki Israel .

translation.en: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates .
translation.kha: Nga ngeit ba phin ïoh tip ba ngim long kiba la shahjop .
Haba ka por ka la kut , ki la kham i khiah kada bad khampoh khlaiñ ban ïa Kito Baroh kiba la bam ïa ka jingbam syiem .
translation.en: And at the end of ten days their countenances appeared fairer and fatter in flesh than all the children which did eat the portion of the king s meat .

And I polluted them in their own gifts , in that they caused to pass through the fire all that openeth the womb , that I might make them desolate , to the end that they might know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nga shah ïa ki ban pyntngit ïa lade da ki jingainguh jong ki hi , bad nga shah ïa ki ban kñia ïa ki khun shynrang banyngkong jong ki . Kane ka la long ban pynshitom ïa ki bad pyn-i ha ki ba nga long U  Trai .

translation.en: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold , within and without shalt thou overlay it , and shalt make upon it a crown of gold round about .
translation.kha: Suit ïa ka da ka ksiar nylla na shapoh bad shabar , bad pynpur da ka ksiar ha ka rmiang jong ka baroh sawdong .
Adam ba nga khang ïa u sleit ba un ym hap lane phah ïa ki puit ban bam ïa ki jingthung jlan phah ïa ka khlam ha ki briew jong ar ,
translation.en: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain , or if I command the locusts to devour the land , or if I send pestilence among my people  ;

translation.kha: Kumta u shim ïa u khun tyngkong jong u , uba dei ban long syiem hadien jong u , bad u la syrwa ïa u halor ka kynroh shnong kum ka jingkñia sha u blei Moab . Ki Eliel ki la sngewshyrkhei bad kumta ki la kynran na ka nongbah Bad ki la leit phai sha la ka ri .
translation.en: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead , and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall . And there was great indignation against Israel : and they departed from him , and returned to their own land .

translation.kha: ïa kine harum na ka bynta ka jingtrei ha ka Templ : Palat ngab ïa ka spah hynñiewphew ton ka ksiar , palat ïa ka laispah sanphew ton ka shoh , bad la jan hynriewspah arphew ton ka rnong , mala palat ban ïa ka lai hajar sawspah ton ka nar .
translation.en: And gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams , and of silver ten thousand talents , and of brass eighteen thousand talents , and one hundred thousand talents of iron .

translation.kha: Nga lah shun ïohi ïa kaei kaei Kaba ïng hangta ; nga peit lyngngoh , hynrei ngam lah ban nguh ka dat kaei .
translation.en: It stood still , but I could not discern the form thereof : an image was before mine eyes , there was silence , and I heard a voice , saying ,
With him is strength and wisdom : the deceived and the deceiver are his .
translation.kha: U Blei u long uba khlaiñ bad uba ïai jop ; baroh ar ngut — uba shah shukor bad u nongshukor ki don hapoh ka bor jong u .
Nga la Khmih ha ka pyrthei — ka la longsyiem ka jingsep ei suda , ha ka sahit bneng — ym don kan kano ka jingshai .
translation.en: I beheld the earth , and , lo , it was without form , and void  ; and the heavens , and they had no light .
Which is a manifest token of the righteous judgment of God , that ye may be counted worthy of the kingdom of God , for which ye also suffer :
translation.kha: Kane baroh ka pynshisha ba ka jingbishar ka jong U Blei ka long kaba hok , bad kumta phin long kiba bit na ka bynta ka Hima jong u , kaba na ka bynta jong ka phi shahshitom .

translation.en: And Abram said unto Lot , Let there be no strife , I pray thee , between me and thee , and between my herdmen and thy herdmen  ; for we be brethren .
translation.kha: Kumta u Abram u ong ha u Lot ,  Ki briew jong me bad ki briew jong nga kim dei ban ïakajia , namar ngi ïalong shi ïing shi sem .

translation.en: When I heard , my belly trembled  ; my lips quivered at the voice : rottenness entered into my bones , and I trembled in myself , that I might rest in the day of trouble : when he cometh up unto the people , he will invade them with his troops .
translation.kha: Nga ïohsngew ïa kane baroh , bad nga kyiuh ; ki rmiang shyntur jong nga ki khih da ka jingsheptieng . Ka met jong nga ka jem lwep , bad ki kjat jong nga ki jynthut hapoh jong nga . Ngan ap jar jar ïa ka por ka ban wan haba U Blei un pynshitom ïa kito kiba tur ïaleh ïa ngi .
Kumba ka Jingthoh bakynjah ka ong , Naba u la kiew shajrong eh , u la ïalam bad u ïa shibun kiba shah ringmraw ; u la ai ki jingai sngewbha ha u Briew .
translation.en: Wherefore he saith , When he ascended up on high , he led captivity captive , and gave gifts unto men .

translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka pynjlan ïa ka rta jong phi kumjuh ruh ka pynïoh ïa ka spah bad ka burom .
translation.en: Length of days is in her right hand  ; and in her left hand riches and honour .

translation.kha: Ka Babilonia ka la tied tyrnem ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei lyngkhot lyngki , malu mynta uta u tynrah u khynñiuh ! Ki jaitbynriew baroh ki kyndit halor kaei kaba la jia ïa kata ka ri .
translation.en: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken ! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations !

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u ong : Haba kata ka sngi ka wan , kan pynkheiñ ïa ka lyngkor kaba don sawdong ka ryndang jong ki bad ngan weng ïa ki kynjri jyllang ki , bad kin ym long shuh ki mirr jong ki nongwei .
translation.en: For it shall come to pass in that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , that I will break his yoke from off thy neck , and will burst thy bonds , and strangers shall no more serve themselves of him :
Now the earth is divided up into many countries .
translation.kha: Ia ka pyrthei mynta la pynïakhlad ha kiba bun tylli ki ri .

Nga kyrmen ba ka khlieh jong nga ka long ka pukni um , bad ba ki khmat jong to ka umpohliew ki ummat , khnang ba nga lah ban ïam mynsngi bad mynmiet na ka bynta ki Briew jong nga kiba la shah pynïap .
translation.en: Oh that my head were waters , and mine eyes a fountain of tears , that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people !
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , saying ,
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ai ha u Moses
Kumta ki la khot ïa ka Rebekka bad ki la kylli , Hato pha kwah ban leit bad une u briew ? Ho-oid , ka ïajubab .
translation.en: And they called Rebekah , and said unto her , Wilt thou go with this man ? And she said , I will go .
But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges , of a cubit length  ; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh .
translation.kha: U Ehud u shna da lade hi kawei ka waitlam arliang syrti kaba shi phut shiteng ka jingjrong . U teh ïa ka ha ka liang kamon jong u hapoh la ki jaiñkup .
A Trai , me la pynong ïa ka hangta jong im ban roi , da kaban pynïar ïa ka ri ha baroh sawdong , bad kane ka la wallam ïa me ka burom .
translation.en: Thou hast increased the nation , O  Lord  , thou hast increased the nation : thou art glorified : thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth .

And they set the altar upon his bases  ; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries : and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the  Lord  , even burnt offerings morning and evening .
translation.kha: Wat la kiba shah ringmraw kiba la wan phai , ki sheptieng ïa ki briew kiba shong basah ha ka ri , pynban ki tei biang ïa ka duwan ha ka jaka ba ka ïeng mynshuwa . Nangta ki sdang biang ban thang halor jong ka ïa ki jingkñia man ka step bad man ka janmiet .
Ïa ki tdem jingbah kah pun ïohi da uno uno uba ïohnang byrsha ha khmat ka Joah Kaba Kyntang Hano , isynei ym nawei pat . ( Kita ki dieng jingbah ki dang don hangta haduh mynta . )
translation.en: And they drew out the staves , that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle , and they were not seen without : and there they are unto this day .

translation.kha: bad ka jaiñspong , ki tupia , ki patlun ,
translation.en: And a mitre of fine linen , and goodly bonnets of fine linen , and linen breeches of fine twined linen ,

translation.kha: ki ban pynïap ïa u , hynrei haei lai sneng yn sa pynmihpat ïa u . Ki synran ki la sngewsih eh .
translation.en: And they shall kill him , and the third day he shall be raised again .  And they were exceeding sorry .

translation.kha: Nga la ïohi ba ym don briew ; wat ki sim ki la lah lui noh .
translation.en: I beheld , and , lo , there was no man , and all the birds of the heavens were fled .
The man , who is the lord of the land , spake roughly to us , and took us for spies of the country .
translation.kha: U lat jong ka ri Ijipt u la kren khor ïa ngi , bad u la kynnoh ba ngi syntiat ïa kata ka ri .
Ki daiñ ban ïarap ïa me bad pyndep ïa la ki kamram kiba ïadei bad ka jingsuki ha ka Ïingjaiñ , hynrei uno uno u bym bit bym beiñ um lah ban ïarap ïa me .
translation.en: And they shall be joined unto thee , and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation , for all the service of the tabernacle : and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you .
For then would they not have ceased to be offered ? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins .
translation.kha: Lada ïa u paidlang uba mane ïa U Blei la pynkhuid phar na ki pop jong ki , kin ym sngewrem shuh ïa la ka pop , bad ki jingkñia ainguh baroh kin ym don shuh .

translation.en: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the  Lord   ; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock s head , and kill the bullock before the  Lord .
translation.kha: Un wanlam ïa uta u masi sha ka jingkhang ka Ïingjaiñ , un buh ïa la ka kti ha ka khlieh jong u , bad un pynïap ïa u hangta ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai .
U la lamler shaphang jong nga ha phi ko Syiem kynruh ; hynrei phi , phi longsem kum u angel U Blei , kumta ai ïa kai kaba krensih ïa pa .
translation.en: And he hath slandered thy servant unto my lord the king  ; but my lord the king is as an angel of God : do therefore what is good in thine eyes .
And thou shalt make the dishes thereof , and spoons thereof , and covers thereof , and bowls thereof , to cover withal : of pure gold shalt thou make them .
translation.kha: Thaw ïa ki pliang , ki khiew bad ki khuri ban pyndonkam ha ka jingainguh dih . Ïa kine baroh dei ban thaw da ka ksiar nylla .

Hynrei kiwei pat ki briew ki long kum ki symbai ba la bet ha ka khyndew kaba bha . Ki ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , ki pdiang ïa ka , bad ki seisoh : katto katne laiphew , katto katba hynriewphew , bad katto katne shispah .
translation.en: And these are they which are sown on good ground  ; such as hear the word , and receive it , and bring forth fruit , some thirtyfold , some sixty , and some an hundred .

translation.kha: Ha kano ka sharum phi thiah ?
translation.en: In which room did you sleep ?

translation.kha: U la iehnoh ïa ki ha ka bor jong ki nongmane bynthiew , bad ki nongshun jong ki , ki synlar halor jong ki .
translation.en: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen  ; and they that hated them ruled over them .

translation.kha: Mynta nga ïam ïa ki sohwaiñ jong ka Sibmah kumba sa ïam namar ka Jair . Ki ummat jrong nga ki hap na ka bynta ka Heshbon bad ka Eltekeh , namar ym don kano kan ka jingkheit soh kaba pynkmen ïa ki briew .
translation.en: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah : I will water thee with my tears , O Heshbon , and Elealeh : for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen .

translation.kha: Ïa ki khun shynrang bad ki khun kynthei jong phi yn ai nep kum ki mraw ha ki nongwei katba phi! pat phi shu peiñ . Man ka sngi phin pynbudnam sat ïa la ki khmat ba phi ap lehnoh-ei ïa la ki khun ba kin wan phah pat .
translation.en: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people , and thine eyes shall look , and fail with longing for them all the day long : and there shall be no might in thine hand .
Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty men which are in the city .
translation.kha: Ka jingstad ka lehbha bun shah ïa u briew ban ïa kaba ki shiphew ngut ki nongsynshar ki lah ban leh ïa ka nongbah .
Kumjuh ruh hikai ïa ki kynthei kiba la Kham san ba kin im donbor kum ki kynthei kiba dei ban bor , Ibbah im ka jingim bakhuid . Ko dei ban long kiba kren thiar lane kiba kyrni ha ka daiñ waiñ .
translation.en: The aged women likewise , that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness , not false accusers , not given to much wine , teachers of good things ;

translation.kha: kawei me ïor ? U la kylli . U diengpynïeng sharak ba la shna da ka ksiar , nga la jubab . Ha ka kliar ka don ka pliang na ka bniat ka umphniang . Halor u diengpynïeng sharak don hynñiew tylli ki sharak , kaei kawei mala ki jaka na ka bynta ki hynñiew tylliat ki ksai sharak .
translation.en: And said unto me , What seest thou ? And I said , I have looked , and behold a candlestick all of gold , with a bowl upon the top of it , and his seven lamps thereon , and seven pipes to the seven lamps , which are upon the top thereof :

translation.kha: Kin mynsaw bun kin ïap ha ki lynti bah jong ki nongbah jong ki .
translation.en: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans , and they that are thrust through in her streets .

translation.kha: Thaw ïa eiei u diengpynïeng sharak da ka ksiar nylla . Shan ïa ka trai bad ka met jong u da ka ksiar ba la shu shoh . Ki syntiew ba la oh-shrong jong u kiba kynthup ïa ki shylluit bad ki sla syntiew jongno ki , kin ïasoh nur kawei bad u .
translation.en: And thou shalt make a candlestick of pure gold : of beaten work shall the candlestick be made : his shaft , and his branches , his bowls , his knops , and his flowers , shall be of the same .
For it is written in the law of Moses , Thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn . Doth God take care for oxen ?
translation.kha: Ngi pule ha ka Hukum u Moses ,  Wat khum ïa ka shyntur u masi dab haba me pyndonkam ïa u ban shoh ïa u kew .  Mynta , hato U Blei u sngewkhia ïa u masi dab ?

translation.en: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs , as the  Lord  commanded by the hand of Moses .
translation.kha: Da kaba kynting sbai , ki paid Israel ki ai ïa kine ki nongbah bad ki pyntha phlang ha ki Lebi , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum lyngba u Moses .
Nga la suda ban wallam sha nga ïa baher ki nongkhaïi jingot jong u syiem ha Babilon khnang ba ki lai ban ïathuh ha nga kaei ka jingdam jong ka jingphohsniew .
translation.en: Therefore made I a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me , that they might make known unto me the interpretation of the dream .
And it was so , that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance , he put forth his hand , and took him , and kissed him .
translation.kha: Haba u briew u wan hajan u Absalom ban nguh ha khmat jong u , u Absalom u ju kner la ki kti , u bat ïa u , bad u doh ïa u .

translation.en: Which sometime were disobedient , when once the longsuffering of God waited in the days of Noah , while the ark was a preparing , wherein few , that is , eight souls were saved by water .
translation.kha: Kine ki la long ki mynsiem jong kito ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa U Blei mynba u la ap da ka jingshahslem ha ki sngi ba u Noah u dang shna ïa ka ïinglieng jong u . Ki briew kiba don tang khyndiat ha ka ïinglieng — phra ngut ha baroh — ki la lait im da ka um ,

translation.en: And he kneeled down , and cried with a loud voice , Lord , lay not this sin to their charge . And when he had said this , he fell asleep .
translation.kha: U la dem khohsiew bad u la kyang da ka ktien bajam ,  A Trai ! wat kynmaw ïa kane ka pop pyrshah ïa ki !  U la ong ïa kane bad u la ïap .
Haba u Saul malu ki briew jong u ki ïohpdiang ïa kane , ki la sngewsheptieng her .
translation.en: When Saul and all Israel heard those words of the Philistine , they were dismayed , and greatly afraid .

translation.kha: Nga la pruh ïa ki sha nga da ka jingsngewieit bad ka jingieit . Nga la rah ïa ki pynlang pyndei ïa ki ha ka ngab jong nga . Nga la dem sha ki bad nga la bsut ïa ki .
translation.en: I drew them with cords of a man , with bands of love : and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws , and I laid meat unto them .

translation.kha: U patsha u la phuh katto katne ki rangbah shipai bad shi kynhun ki nongshong kulai bad per , bad nga lytar sha ka Ïuphratis Kaba shang Sepngi . Hangta nga ai ïa ki shathie u patsha ha ki lat .
translation.en: Then I came to the governors beyond the river , and gave them the king s letters . Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me .

translation.kha: khmied ïa na . Hato kata kam la biang ba phna khmih ïa nga ha ka jingkyndit bad ban sngap noh jar ?
translation.en: Mark me , and be astonished , and lay your hand upon your mouth .

translation.kha: Ha ka hukum u syiem ïa ka Hukum la pyntip paidbah ha Susa , ka nongbah jong ka hima , bad ki nongrah-khubor ki rah ïa ka khohruh shaei ki jylla . U syiem bad u Heman ki sheng bun ïadih sngewbha katba ka nongbah Susa ka la khong hapdeng ka jingkulmar .
translation.en: The posts went out , being hastened by the king s commandment , and the decree was given in Shushan the palace . And the king and Haman sat down to drink  ; but the city Shushan was perplexed .

translation.kha: Ha ki briew kiba kyntait ban sngap ïa kaei kaba nga la noh , ki ïai-ong ba baroh ka longïng bha bad ki . Bad ki ïathuh ïa uwei uwei barieh uba kamut ba ka jingjot kane ym ktah ïa u .
translation.en: They say still unto them that despise me , The  Lord  hath said , Ye shall have peace  ; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart , No evil shall come upon you .
And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years : and he died .
translation.kha: U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun bad u la ïap ha ka rta kaba khyndaispah laiphew snem .

Katno kan longkmie kaba shyieng ïa pha , ko Karshena ! Katto kan long Kaba shyrkhei ïa pha ruh , ko Bethsaida ! Lada ïa ki kambah kiba la leh ha phi la lah leh ha Tyros bad Sidon , la khem slem ki biria hangta ken jin da la phong da ka jaiñ khain mala synreit da u btep halor lade! , don pyn-i ba ki la phai noh na ki pop jyllang ki !
translation.en: Woe unto thee , Chorazin ! woe unto thee , Bethsaida ! for if the mighty works , which were done in you , had been done in Tyre and Sidon , they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes .
Rejoicing in hope ; patient in tribulation ; continuing instant in prayer ;
translation.kha: To ai ba ka jingkyrmen jong phi kan pynkmen ïa phi , to long kiba ïaishah ha ki jingjynjar jong phi , bad to duwai ha ki por baroh .
Ka Miriam ka la rwai na ka bniat jongngi ki : To rwai ha U Trai namar ba u la jop ka jingjop badonburom ; u la bret ïa ki kulai bad ïa ki nongshukor jong ki sha ka dulir .
translation.en: And Miriam answered them , Sing ye to the  Lord  , for he hath triumphed gloriously  ; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea .

translation.kha: Kumno ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Nga la ieit ïa u Jakob , hynrei na la isih ïa u Iso .
translation.en: As it is written , Jacob have I loved , but Esau have I hated .

translation.kha: U ai ha uei pa uwei u shynrang bad ha kamai pa kawei ka kynthei ha Israel ïa u kpu bad ka dohthang malade katto katne ki soh Khajur .
translation.en: And he dealt to every one of Israel , both man and woman , to every one a loaf of bread , and a good piece of flesh , and a flagon of wine .

translation.kha: Wat lyngngoh haba phi ïohi ba ka sorkar ka banbeiñ ïa kiba duk malu kam ai ha ki ïa ka jinglehieit bad ïa ki hok jong ki . Ïa nawei pa uwei u pynbah synrai la ïada da uno uno uba kham hajir bad ïa barabor ar la ïada da ki rangbah synshar kiba kham halor .
translation.en: If thou seest the oppression of the poor , and violent perverting of judgment and justice in a province , marvel not at the matter : for he that is higher than the highest regardeth  ; and there be higher than they .

translation.kha: Kumta ki bret noh ïa la ki blei nongwei badno ki la maïan ïa U Tlai ; bad u la pisa halor ka jingjynjar jong ki Israel .
translation.en: And they put away the strange gods from among them , and served the  Lord  : and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel .

translation.kha: Kiriathaim , Bethgamul , Bethmeon ,
translation.en: And upon Kiriathaim , and upon Beth–gamul , and upon Beth–meon ,
Joash was seven years old when he began to reign , and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem . His mother s name also was Zibiah of Beer–sheba .
translation.kha: U Joash u la don hynñiew snem ka rta mynba u long u syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar sawphew snem ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Sibaïah na ka nongbah Beersheba .
Ïathuh ïa nga , ïa kaei phi la leit ba peit ? Hammoth ïa u nongïathuhlypa ? Ho-oid , da shisha , hynrei phira la iohi Kham bun shah ban ïa u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: But what went ye out for to see ? A prophet ? Yea , I say unto you , and much more than a prophet .

translation.kha: nangta ka sur ktien ka la ong na bneng , A u long U ju uba ieit eh jong ar , ha uba nga sngewbha eh .
translation.en: And lo a voice from heaven , saying , This is my beloved Son , in whom I am well pleased .

translation.kha: U Araunah bad ki khun shynrang jong u ki dei banbeiñ phong ïa ki man ka por ba ki leit rung shapoh ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga ne haba ki leit sha jan ka skei ban shakri kum ki lyngdoh ha ka Jaka kob Kyntang , khnam ba kin ym shah pynïap ba ki thad burom ïa lade . Kane ka long ka ai kaba neh shi sma ïa u Aaron bad ki khun ki ksiew jong u .
translation.en: And they shall be upon Aaron , and upon his sons , when they come in unto the tabernacle of the congregation , or when they come near unto the altar to minister in the holy place  ; that they bear not iniquity , and die : it shall be a statute for ever unto him and his seed after him .
Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory ? and how do ye see it now ? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing ?
translation.kha: Hato don uno uno hapdeng jong phi uba dang kynmaw katno ka jingiphuh ka Templ ka la ju long ? Kumno phi ïohi ïa kane mynta ? Ka paw kumba kam long ei ei ruh .
Khynñiuh ngam shym la leh kumta , naba kata kan jin da la wallam ka jingjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong por hapdeng ki jaitbynriew kiba la lah Ïohi ïa nga ba nga ïalam ïa ki Israel shabar na ka Ijipt .
translation.en: Nevertheless I withdrew mine hand , and wrought for my name s sake , that it should not be polluted in the sight of the heathen , in whose sight I brought them forth .

translation.kha: U Tiras u ïada ïa ki briew kiba ïadih hok ; hynrei u pynïong ïa kito kiba leh ba-bymman .
translation.en: The way of the  Lord  is strength to the upright : but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity .

translation.kha: U Mynsiem jongngi U Blei! u la wan ha u Asaraïah u khun jongno u Ephod , bun u la ithuh ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem Asa .
translation.en: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded :
For the wicked boasteth of his heart s desire , and blesseth the covetous , whom the  Lord  abhorreth .
translation.kha: U riewbymman u sngewsarong ha la ki jong ki jingkwah basniew ; u riewlalot u tim bad kyntait ïa U  Trai .
ithuh kam dei kumne ? Ngi wait kumba ngi wanrah . Ngi thri , da kaba pyrshang ban kem ïa ka lyer bad aïu ngi ïoh ?
translation.en: And this also is a sore evil , that in all points as he came , so shall he go : and what profit hath he that hath laboured for the wind ?

translation.kha: Ki la sheptieng ïa ki nong Babilonia namar ba u Ishmael u la pynïap ïa u Gedalaïah , uba u syiem ka Babilon u la pynlong u lat jong kata ka jaka . Kumta ki la leit noh sha Ijipt , khnang ba kin lait na ki nongot Babilonia . Ha lynti , ki la sangeh ha Shimham , kaba hadien Bethesel .
translation.en: Because of the Chaldeans : for they were afraid of them , because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam , whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land .

translation.kha: U Abraham u la iehnoh ïa kaei kaei Kaba u don ha u Isaak ;
translation.en: And Abraham gave all that he had unto Isaac .

translation.kha: Ki ïing kin dap da ki mei kiba bha kiba phim shym la leit shuh hangta , bad kin don ki pukri kiba khung shem la tyrnem , bad ki bri sohwaiñ nabar ki dieng Olib kiba phim shym la sting . Ynda U Trai u ïalam ïa phi sha kata ka ri bad phi ïoh kat ïa kabu phi khiah ban bameh ,
translation.en: And houses full of all good things , which thou filledst not , and wells digged , which thou diggedst not , vineyards and olive trees , which thou plantedst not  ; when thou shalt have eaten and be full  ;
Nevertheless he left not himself without witness , in that he did good , and gave us rain from heaven , and fruitful seasons , filling our hearts with food and gladness .
translation.kha: Hynrei u la ïai ai ka sakhi ïa ka jingdon jong u da kiei kiei kiba bha kiba u leh : U ai ha phi ïa u slap na sahit bneng bad ïa ki jingthung ha ki por babiang ; u ai ha phi ka jingbam bad u pyndap ïa ka dohnud jong phi da ka jingkmen .
Ki briew kin ïawan na mihngi bad na sepngi , na shait bad na shathie , bad shong ha ka jingkhiah ha ka Hima U Blei .
translation.en: And they shall come from the east , and from the west , and from the north , and from the south , and shall sit down in the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: Ynda wan kaba kut , Mano ban lym ?
translation.en: When the end comes , who will survive ?

translation.kha: Ki rangbah kiba ap ïa ki sniang ki la phet ino malade ki la otsher shapoh ka shong , ha kabu ki la ïathuh ïa ka jingjia baroh kawei bad ïa kaei kambah la jia ha ki rangbah uba shongksuid .
translation.en: And they that kept them fled , and went their ways into the city , and told every thing , and what was befallen to the possessed of the devils .

translation.kha: U Trai u la ong ha ang ,
translation.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , saying ,

translation.kha: ‘Phim shym la iaid ïa nga ; nga la jied ïa phi bad nga la thung ïa phi ban leit mala ban seisoh Shion , u jait soh uba ïaheh . Doeg kumta U Kpa un ai ha pa ïa kaei kaei kaba phi kupar na u ha ka kyrteng jong nga .
translation.en: Ye have not chosen me , but I have chosen you , and ordained you , that ye should go and bring forth fruit , and that your fruit should remain : that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name , he may give it you .
He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker : but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor .
translation.kha: Lada phi banbeiñ ïa ki briew kiba duk , phi ñiewbeiñ ïa U Blei uba la thaw ïa ki ; hynrei ka jingpyn-i ïa ka jinglehsbun ïa kiba duk ka long ka kam jong ka jingmane .

translation.en: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon , he and all the people that were with him  ; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand , and cut down a bough from the trees , and took it , and laid it on his shoulder , and said unto the people that were with him , What ye have seen me do , make haste , and do as I have done .
translation.kha: kumta u la leit kiew sha u Lum Salmon bad la ki rangbah . Hangta u shim uwei u sdie , u pom kawei ka tnat na u dieng , bad u bah ïa ka ha la ka tyrpeng . U ong ïa la ki rangbah ban pynkloi bad ban leh kumjuh .

translation.en: All this , said David , the  Lord  made me understand in writing by his hand upon me , even all the works of this pattern .
translation.kha: U Syiem Dabid u ong ,  Ïa kane baroh la kynthup ha ka dur pynkhreh kaba la thoh kat kum ki jingbthah kiba U  Trai  da lade hi u la ai ha nga ban pyntrei .
Ko ki kmie ki kpa , to wat pynbitar ïa la ki khulom , ïor ba kin noh mynnin .
translation.en: Fathers , provoke not your children to anger , lest they be discouraged .

According to all that thou desiredst of the  Lord  thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly , saying , Let me not hear again the voice of the  Lord  my God , neither let me see this great fire any more , that I die not .
translation.kha: Ha kato ka sngi mynba phi ïalumlang ha u Lum Sinai , phi la kyrpad ba phim kwah ban ïohsngew shuh ïa ka sur U  Trai  , lymne ïohi shuh ïa ka ding ha kaba u don , namar ba phi sheptieng ïoh phi ïap .

translation.en: And Naaman said , Shall there not then , I pray thee , be given to thy servant two mules  burden of earth ? for thy servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods , but unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u Naaman u ong ,  Lada phim pdiang ïa ka jingai jong nga , te shah ïa nga ban rah sha ïing ar kit khashor ka khyndew , namar naduh mynta ngan ym ai jingkñia lane jingainguh thang ha uno uno u blei lait noh tang U  Trai .

La ka long ha ka por bakynjang lane ha ka prie bajlan , u Paul u la jubab , ka jingduwai jong ang ha U Blei ka long ba ma me bad baroh kiwei patar kiba sngap ïa ar ha kane ka sngi ki lah ban long kum ma nga — lait noh , da shisha , ïa kine ki kynjri !
translation.en: And Paul said , I would to God , that not only thou , but also all that hear me this day , were both almost , and altogether such as I am , except these bonds .

translation.kha: Nangta U Terah u ong ha u Moses , Ngan phah sa tang kawei ka jingpynshitom ha u Pharaoh bad ki briew jong u . Hadien Katai , un sa Shah ba phin ïamihnoh . Ha ka jingshisha , un sa ba-eh lut ïa ph nangne .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Yet will I bring one plague more upon Pharaoh , and upon Egypt  ; afterwards he will let you go hence : when he shall let you go , he shall surely thrust you out hence altogether .

translation.kha: Hodaïah kata u syiem Sedekaïah u la phah khot ïa nga , bad hangta ha ka ïingsyiem u la kylli ïa nga ha kaba jarjar lade , Hato don khubor ei ei na U Tlai ? Ka don , nga la jubab , nabar nga ong shuh shuh , Ïa phi yn sa aiti noh ha u syiem ka Babilonia .
translation.en: Then Zedekiah the king sent , and took him out : and the king asked him secretly in his house , and said , Is there any word from the  Lord  ? And Jeremiah said , There is : for , said he , thou shalt be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon .
And they came thither into the midst of the house , as though they would have fetched wheat  ; and they smote him under the fifth rib : and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped .
translation.kha: Ka kynthei ha ka jingkhang ka la shoh samthiah ngai katba ka dang tai kew bad ka ïohthiah , kumta u Rekhab bad u Baanah ki ïohrung shapoh .

translation.en: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up , and lose thy sweet words .

Thou sayest , ( but they are but vain words , ) I have counsel and strength for the war . Now on whom dost thou trust , that thou rebellest against me ?
translation.kha: U dawa ,  Hato phi pyrkhat ba ki ktien ki lah ban shim ïa ka jaka jong ka jingtbit ha ka kam shipai bad ka bor ? Mano phi pyrkhat u ban ïarap ïa phi ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka Assyria ?
Hadien shi taïew , haba ka por ka la tad na ka bynta ban otsher ïa u khunlung , la ai kyrteng ïa u , U Jehu , ka kyrteng kaba u angel u la lah ai na ka bynshet jongngi U ha shuwa ba yn pun ïa U .
translation.en: And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child , his name was called JESUS , which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb .

translation.kha: nongthaw u Sarah u phah khubor sha u Jesse : Nga sngewbha eh ïa u Dabid . Ieh un sah hangne ha ka jingtrei Bad nga .
translation.en: And Saul sent to Jesse , saying , Let David , I pray thee , stand before me  ; for he hath found favour in my sight .
And Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt  ; and the frogs came up , and covered the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Kumta u Aaron u rah ïa la u diengduh halor kita ki um ; te ki jakoid ki ïamih bad ki tap lin ïa kata ka ri .

Ki rangbah ki leit shaduh Jordan , bad baroh shi lynter lynti ki ïohi ïa ki jaiñkup bad ki tarajur ki tar ba ki Syria ki la bran katba ki dang phet ïap . Nahath ki wan phai bad ki leit ïathuh ha u syiem .
translation.en: And they went after them unto Jordan : and , lo , all the way was full of garments and vessels , which the Syrians had cast away in their haste . And the messengers returned , and told the king .
And they brought unto him also infants , that he would touch them : but when his disciples saw it , they rebuked them .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki la wallam ïa ki khunlung jong ki sha U Jisu ba un buh ïa ki kti jong u halor jong ki . Ki synran ki la ïohi ïa ki bad ki la kynhied ïa ki naba ki leh kumta ,

translation.en: For he satisfieth the longing soul , and filleth the hungry soul with goodness .
translation.kha: U la pynhun ïa kito kiba sliang bad pyndap ïa kiba thngan da kiei kiei kiba bha .

Naba moi tip ba haba kan ka jingïoh kaba ngi shong — ka met jong ngi hangne ha pyrthei — ka la jot noh , U Bela un buhai ha bneng ïa ka ïing na ka bynta jong sem ba ngin shong , ka ïing kaba ma u hi u la thaw , ka ban neh junom la junom .
translation.en: For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved , we have a building of God , an house not made with hands , eternal in the heavens .

translation.kha: Ka moi jong phin ban im kan kyrshan ïa phiah haba phi pang , hynrei lada phi duh ïa ka , ka jingmane jong phi kaba sah ka la jah noh .
translation.en: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity  ; but a wounded spirit who can bear ?

translation.kha: Ngin pyntwa ïa phi ba ha ka sneng ka Jingbishar , U Blei un pynim kham pung ka jingiaseng ïa ki briew ka Solomon bad Hamor ban ïa ki briew jong kata ka nongbah !
translation.en: Verily I say unto you , It shall be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment , than for that city .

translation.kha: Ki la pynjlih ïa ki riewngeit pynlang pynshlur ïa ki ban ïaineh skhem ha ka jingngeit . Ngi dei ban ïaid lyngba bun ki jingjlan ban ïohrung sha ka Hima U Blei , ki la khwai .
translation.en: Confirming the souls of the disciples , and exhorting them to continue in the faith , and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God .
In thee have they discovered their fathers  nakedness : in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution .
translation.kha: Don na ki , kiba thiah bad ka tnga u kpa jong ki . Don kiba pynbor ïa ki kynthei ban ïathiah shongkha bad ki ha ka por poi bnai .
kumta u Manasseh u leit phai sha U Trai , bad u ong , Kine ki bariew ki la leh ïa ka pop kaba shyrkhei eh . Ki la thaw ïa u blei umbah da ka ksiang bad ki la ïamane ïa u .
translation.en: And Moses returned unto the  Lord  , and said , Oh , this people have sinned a great sin , and have made them gods of gold .

And Elisha prayed , and said ,  Lord  , I pray thee , open his eyes , that he may see . And the  Lord  opened the eyes of the young man  ; and he saw : and , behold , the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha .
translation.kha: Nangta u la duwai ,  Ko  Trai  , to pynpeit ïa ki khmat jong u bad ai un ïohi .  U  Trai  u jubab ïa ka jingduwai jong u , bad u shakri jong u Elisha haba u peit shajrong bad u la ïohi ïa ka sharing lum ba la dap da ki kulai bad ki kali ïapom kiba da ka ding baroh sawdong jong u Elisha .

translation.en: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them , and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth , and gavest them water for their thirst .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingbha jong me , me ong ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban leh ; me la bsa ïa ki da ka manna bad ai um ïa ki ban dih .
Suk kito Ibbah ka jingangnud bakhraw tam jong ki ka erlangthari ban leh ïa kaei kaba U Blei u dawa ; U Blei un pynhun jrut ïa ki !
translation.en: Blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness : for they shall be filled .

translation.kha: La weng ïa u na ka Ïingjaiñ ha kaba u la ju im ha ka jingshngain , bad la tan ïa u ban ïingjaiñ markhmat bad u Syiem ka Jingïap .
translation.en: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle , and it shall bring him to the king of terrors .

translation.kha: bad kata ka bri ka khyndew kan ym loit na kawei ka jait sha kawei pateng . kaei pa kawei ka jait kan ïai batip ïa la ka bri ka khyndew .
translation.en: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe  ; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance .
Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself , O God of Israel , the Saviour .
translation.kha: U Blei ki Israel , uba pynim ïa la ki briew , u long U Blei uba buhrieh ïa lade .

translation.en: But the  Lord  is the true God , he is the living God , and an everlasting king : at his wrath the earth shall tremble , and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation .
translation.kha: Hynrei ma me , A  Trai  , me long U Blei bashisha , me long U Blei uba im bad u syiem bymjukut . Haba me bitar , ka pyrthei ka khynñiuh ; ki jaitbynriew kim lah shah ïa ka jingbitar jong me .
Nga la ïohi ïa ki briew ba ki lur ïa ki lyngkha jong ka jingsniew bad ki bet ïa ka jingbymman kumta u symbai ; mynta ki ot da ka jingbymman bad ka jingsniew .
translation.en: Even as I have seen , they that plow iniquity , and sow wickedness , reap the same .

translation.kha: Kynsan , Hangno ki wan ! Ki nongbah halor jong ki kulai , shi jur shi jur . U nongap phikir u ai ka khubor , Ka Babilon ka la kyllon ! Baroh ki bleithaw kiba ki la mane ki la syllen ha ka jingpait jingpra ha madan .
translation.en: And , behold , here cometh a chariot of men , with a couple of horsemen . And he answered and said , Babylon is fallen , is fallen  ; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground .

And I fell down before the  Lord  , as at the first , forty days and forty nights : I did neither eat bread , nor drink water , because of all your sins which ye sinned , in doing wickedly in the sight of the  Lord  , to provoke him to anger .
translation.kha: Nangta sa shisien pat nga dem khrup ha khmat U  Trai  sawphew sngi bad sawphew miet , bad ngam shym la bam ne dih ei ei , namar ba phi la leh pop pyrshah ïa U  Trai  bad phi la pynbitar ïa u .

Nangta u Samuel u shimet shi klong ka umphniang Olib bad u theh ïa ka ha ka Khlieh u Saul , u doh ïa u , bad u ong , U Trai u la pynsleh ïa me kum u nongsynshar ki briew jong u , ki Israel . Men syiar ïa ki brisoh jong u nabar men ïada ïa ki na ki nongshna jong ki . Bad kane kane longsem ka jingpynshisha ïa me ba U Trai u la pynjlih ïa me ban hir u nongsynshar ïa ki briew jyllang u :
translation.en: Then Samuel took a vial of oil , and poured it upon his head , and kissed him , and said , Is it not because the  Lord  hath anointed thee to be captain over his inheritance ?

translation.kha: Pynban ma ngi ibha don ïa kane ka jingkynshew kambah kynja mynhynne ngi hir kum ki khiew khyndew , haneng ban pyn-i ba ka bor kaba halor tam ka Long ka jongno U Blei , ym ka jong ngi .
translation.en: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels , that the excellency of the power may be of God , and not of us .

translation.kha: To U Blei hi uba U Kpa jong ngi da lade hi Bad U Jingsuk Khrist uba U Trai jong ngi un plie ka lynti na ka bynta jyllang I ban wan sha phi!
translation.en: Now God himself and our Father , and our Lord Jesus Christ , direct our way unto you .

Then was Daniel brought in before the king . And the king spake and said unto Daniel , Art thou that Daniel , which art of the children of the captivity of Judah , whom the king my father brought out of Jewry ?
translation.kha: Ïa u Daniel la wallam shisyndon shapoh sha ka jaka ba don u syiem , bad u syiem u la ong ha u ,  Hato me dei u Daniel , uto u Jiw uba shah ringmraw ïa uba u kpa jong nga u syiem u la wallam hangne na Judah ?
Na ka jaka jong ka jait Benjamin la ai saw tylli ki nongbah : ka Gibeon , ka Geba ,
translation.en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin , Gibeon with her suburbs , Geba with her suburbs ,

translation.kha: U la ong , Ïathuh ïa ki brai jong ka ri bad ïa ki lyngdoh ba haba ki shahjingit bad ïambriew ha u bnai basan bad bajhieh ha kine ki hynñiewphew snem , kam shym dei ha ka jingñiewburom ïa nga .
translation.en: Speak unto all the people of the land , and to the priests , saying , When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh month , even those seventy years , did ye at all fast unto me , even to me ?

translation.kha: U Balak u ong , Ale bad nga , malu ngan ïalam ïa phi sha kawei pat ka jaka . Lehse U Blei un shah ïa phi ban thlim ïa ki na ka bynta jong nga nangta .
translation.en: And Balak said unto Balaam , Come , I pray thee , I will bring thee unto another place  ; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence .
Give her of the fruit of her hands  ; and let her own works praise her in the gates .
translation.kha: Ai burom ïa ka ïa baroh kaba ka leh . Ka dei hok ban burom da baroh .
Bad kumta u long uba lah , mynta bad borabor , ban pyntam ïa kita Ibbah wan sha U Blei da u , namar u im junom ban ïasah bad U Blei na ka bna jrong ki .
translation.en: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto God by him , seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them .

translation.kha: Haba Phi ïoh ba ki sloit jong ki , ki la sdang ban mih , phi tip ba ka lytar ka la jan .
translation.en: When they now shoot forth , ye see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand .
I can of mine own self do nothing : as I hear , I judge : and my judgment is just  ; because I seek not mine own will , but the will of the Father which hath sent me .
translation.kha: Nga ngam lah ban leh ei ei da la ka jong ka bor ; nga bishar tang kat kaba U Blei u ong ïa nga , kumta ka jingbishar jong nga ka long kaba hok , namar ba ngam pyrshang ban leh ïa kaei kaba nga mon , hynrei ïa kaei kaba uta uba la phah ïa nga u mon .
Hato U Blei un pyndonkam ïa ka bor jong u baroh pyrshah ïa nga ? Em , un sngap ïa nga katba nga dang kren .
translation.en: Will he plead against me with his great power ? No  ; but he would put strength in me .

translation.kha: Ïa ine u khunlung sa la pan na u , Bad u la ai ha nga ïa kaba nga la mat .
translation.en: For this child I prayed  ; and the  Lord  hath given me my petition which I asked of him :

translation.kha: wahbah ki shaniah ha phi , phi kheiñ noh , u dung ïa ki tohtit jong ki , bad pynlong ïa ki baneh pynkdor ïa la ki met .
translation.en: When they took hold of thee by thy hand , thou didst break , and rend all their shoulder : and when they leaned upon thee , thou brakest , and madest all their loins to be at a stand .

translation.kha: Wat trei ïa kano kano ka kam ha kata ka sngi , naba kata ka long ka sngew ha kaba yn pyndep ïa ka jinglum ban weng noh ïa ka pop .
translation.en: And ye shall do no work in that same day : for it is a day of atonement , to make an atonement for you before the  Lord  your God .
And Moses took them from off their hands , and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering : they were consecrations for a sweet savour : it is an offering made by fire unto the  Lord .
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u shim ïa ka jingbam na ki bad u thang ïa ka ha ka duwan , halor ka jingkñia ainguh thang , kum ka jingainguh jingpynkyntang . Kane ka long ka jingkñia ainguh bam , bad ka jingiw na ka , ka pynsngewbha ïa U  Trai .
U la pynhiar ïa ki sahmiet bakhrawbor na ki khet jong ki , badno u la kyntiew shynrong ïa kiba rangli .
translation.en: He hath put down the mighty from their seats , and exalted them of low degree .

translation.kha: ‘ Ka jingtim U Blei Kan hap ha uta u Briew suba ïalam lynti bakla ïa u briew uba matlah .’ Bad u paidbah baroh un jingjubab lang , ‘ Amen !’
translation.en: Cursed be he that maketh the blind to wander out of the way . And all the people shall say , Amen .

translation.kha: Kat katne kin ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki nongïam Babilonia , ki ban pynnep ïa ki ïing da ki metïap jong pli kiba ngan sa pynïap namar ka jingbitar bad ka jingbet shla jong nga . Nga la phai noh na kane ka nongbam namar ktien keiñ bakha sniew kiba ki bhabriew jong ka ki la leh .
translation.en: They come to fight with the Chaldeans , but it is to fill them with the dead bodies of men , whom I have slain in mine anger and in my fury , and for all whose wickedness I have hid my face from this city .

translation.kha: Ka la ong ha u Syiem Solomon , Kata kaba nga la ïohsngew ha la ka jong ka ri shaphang jongno phi bad shaphang ka jingdeng jong phi ka long kaba shisha !
translation.en: And she said to the king , It was a true report that I heard in mine own land of thy acts and of thy wisdom .

translation.kha: Nga la jingïashoh ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u ba-don shiah jong me malade ba me un-long uba tbit bad me don ka jingtip bad ka jingstad .
translation.en: I have even heard of thee , that the spirit of the gods is in thee , and that light and understanding and excellent wisdom is found in thee .

translation.kha: Shuwa ba u Jakob un ïaw , u kut ïa u Joseph u khun jong u , nabar u nguh ha u , Buh ïa la ka kti hapdeng ki jrong jong nga , bad kular da shisha ba phin ym tep ïa nga ha Ijipt .
translation.en: And the time drew nigh that Israel must die : and he called his son Joseph , and said unto him , If now I have found grace in thy sight , put , I pray thee , thy hand under my thigh , and deal kindly and truly with me  ; bury me not , I pray thee , in Egypt :

translation.kha: Bad na ka bynta jong ki nga pynkyntang ïa lade sha me , khnam ba ma ki hima , ki lah ban long ibha la ïoh pynkyntang da shisha shwa me .
translation.en: And for their sakes I sanctify myself , that they also might be sanctified through the truth .

translation.kha: Hadien kane , u Absalom u la pyngkiang ïa put kamai ka kali ïapom bad ki kyllaiñ lem bad sanphew ngut ki rangbah kiba synran ïa u .
translation.en: And it came to pass after this , that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses , and fifty men to run before him .

translation.kha: Na kawei ka por sha kawei pat phi pynjahburom ïa nga bad phim don ka jinglehrain haba phi kren-ïa ïa nga .
translation.en: These ten times have ye reproached me : ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me .

translation.kha: Bad lada phira lehbor tang ïa kito kiba lehbha ïa phi , balei phi dei ban ïohpang ïa ka jingkyrkhu ? Wat ki nongïapom ki leh kumne !
translation.en: And if ye do good to them which do good to you , what thank have ye ? for sinners also do even the same .

translation.kha: shahïap ba ngan pan ar tylli kiei kiei ; to mynjur ïa ki , bad sam nym pyrshang ban buhrieh na me : to sangeh noh ban pynshitom ïa por , bad wat khñiot ïa nga da ka jingsngewtriem .
translation.en: Withdraw thine hand far from me : and let not thy dread make me afraid .
Behold , when it was whole , it was meet for no work : how much less shall it be meet yet for any work , when the fire hath devoured it , and it is burned ?
translation.kha: ka la long ka bymmyntoi wat ha shuwa ba yn thang ïa ka . Mynta ba ka ding ka la thang ïa ka bad pynkylla rnga ïa ka , ka la nang long shuh shuh ka bymmyntoi ei ei .
Phi shaniah ha ki waitlam jong phi . Ki kam jong phi ki long kiba ijli . Uwei pa uwei u kliar . Kaei kaba pynbang ïa phi ban pyrkhat ba ka ri ka dei ka jong phin ?
translation.en: Ye stand upon your sword , ye work abomination , and ye defile every one his neighbour s wife : and shall ye possess the land ?

translation.kha: Uta u shakri u leh kumba la hukum ïa u , bad u sien ïam ïa nam shi para sha ka ïing u Josaïah .
translation.en: And the man did as Joseph bade  ; and the man brought the men into Joseph s house .

translation.kha: Phira kyang jam , ‘ Ka waitlam jong U Trai ! Katno slem phin ïai thain ïa ka ? Khie rupa pait noh! shaw ka jingsop , sah hangthie bad shongthait !’
translation.en: O thou sword of the  Lord  , how long will it be ere thou be quiet ? put up thyself into thy scabbard , rest , and be still .

translation.kha: Baroh Kiei kiei kiba u syiem Asa u la leh , ki kam shlur jong u bad ki shnong kiba u la tei pynskhem , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Histori jrong Ki Syiem Ka Judah . Hynrei ha ka jingsliang tymmen u la dkoh na ka jingpang kjat .
translation.en: The rest of all the acts of Asa , and all his might , and all that he did , and the cities which he built , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet .
And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation , and shalt wash them with water .
translation.kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad ki khun shynrang jong u sha ka jingkhang jong ka Ïingjaiñ ka Jingdon Ryngkat jong nga bad ong ba kin sum kat kum ka jinglehniam .
bad u la hukum ïa eit kiba ïadie paro , Rah noh ïa ki nangne ! Wat pynlong jaka ïew ïa ka ïing U Kpa jong nga !
translation.en: And said unto them that sold doves ,  Take these things hence  ; make not my Father s house an house of merchandise .

translation.kha: Nga longsyiem U Trai uba la thaw ïa phi ; nongdih ka por ba la kha ïa phi , sa la ïarap ïa phi . Wat sheptieng ; phiah long u shakri jong nga , ki briew ba la jied jong nga kiba nga ibit .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  that made thee , and formed thee from the womb , which will help thee  ; Fear not , O Jacob , my servant  ; and thou , Jeshurun , whom I have chosen .

translation.kha: U bteng nangta Sha ka phang mihngi haduh Gog Hepher bad Ethkasin , da kaba phai ha ka liang jong ka Neah ha ka lynti sha Rimmon .
translation.en: And from thence passeth on along on the east to Gath–hepher , to Eth–kazin , and goeth out to Rimmon–methoar to Neah  ;

translation.kha: Ko skhem Agrippa ! Nga ñiew ïa lade uba bunkam ba ha ken ka sngi nga dei ban ïasaid da ïa latai ha khmat jong Phin na baroh kita kiei kiei kiba ki Jiw ki mudui ïa nga ,
translation.en: I think myself happy , king Agrippa , because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews :

translation.kha: Ki nongap langbrot jong ka Gerar ki la ïakajia bad ki nongkhap langbrot jong u Isaak , bad ki ong , Kñia ka um ka dei ka jong ngi . Kum u Isaak u khot kyrteng ïa dat ka pukri Ka Jingïakajia .
translation.en: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac s herdmen , saying , The water is ours : and he called the name of the well Esek  ; because they strove with him .

translation.kha: Ho-oid , U Jisu u la ong ha ki , bad nga pynthikna ïa phi ba uno uno ibha iehnoh ïa ka ïing lane ïa ka tnga lane ïa ki hynmen ki para lano ïa ki kmie ki kpa lane ïa ki khun na ka bynta ka Hima U Blei
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  Verily I say unto you , There is no man that hath left house , or parents , or brethren , or wife , or children , for the kingdom of God s sake ,

translation.kha: Kumta ar ïakren bad u mihkhmat , da kaba shai , bad ym ha ki jingkyntip ; u la ïohi wat ïa ka dur jong nga . Kumno keiñ phi nud ban kren pyrshah ïa u Manasseh u sharati jong nga ?
translation.en: With him will I speak mouth to mouth , even apparently , and not in dark speeches  ; and the similitude of the  Lord  shall he behold : wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses ?

translation.kha: Ïa u panpoh ba la thiang itynnat bha da kijuh ki tiar dei ban pyndait ha ka ephod khnang ba kan ïalong kawei ka lyngkhot bad ka .
translation.en: And the curious girdle of the ephod , which is upon it , shall be of the same , according to the work thereof  ; even of gold , of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen .
In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation : ye shall do no servile work therein .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi nyngkong na kita ki sngi , phin ïalumlang ban mane Blei , phim dei ban leh ïa kano kano ka kam kaba phi ju trei man la ka sngi .

translation.en: For as the new heavens and the new earth , which I will make , shall remain before me , saith the  Lord  , so shall your seed and your name remain .
translation.kha: Kumba ka khyndew bathymmai bad ki bneng kiba thymmai , kin ïaisah da ka bor jong nga , kumta ruh ki khun ki ksiew jong phi bad ka kyrteng jong phi kin ïaisah .
U syiem ka Babilonia u la pynkut ïa ka Jerusalem bad bim ïa ka . U pynthylli ïa ka nongap kum ïa u khra ; kum u mrad kynsha u la nguid ïa ka . U la shim kat ïa kaba u kwah bad bret noh ïa kiba sah .
translation.en: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon hath devoured me , he hath crushed me , he hath made me an empty vessel , he hath swallowed me up like a dragon , he hath filled his belly with my delicates , he hath cast me out .
Then I consulted with myself , and I rebuked the nobles , and the rulers , and said unto them , Ye exact usury , every one of his brother . And I set a great assembly against them .
translation.kha: Nga la pynrem ïa ki nongïalam bad ki rangbah synshar jong ki paidbah bad ong ïa ki ,  Phi la banbeiñ ïa la ki para ki hynmen jong phi !  Nga la khot ïa ka jingïalang paidbah ban pynbeit ïa ka jingeh bad nga ong ,

La pynjot ïa ki ïingjaiñ jong ngi ; ïa ki tyllai ba pynskhem ïa ki la pyndkut . Ki khunlung jongnga ngi ki la leit noh baroh ; ym don thuh mano mano ba dang sah ban pynïeng pat ïa ki ïingjaiñ jyllang ngi ; ym don shuh Mano mano ban wahbah ïa ki pyrda jongngi ki .
translation.en: My tabernacle is spoiled , and all my cords are broken : my children are gone forth of me , and they are not : there is none to stretch forth my tent any more , and to set up my curtains .

translation.kha: Ha ka por Mynmiet ki nongtuh ki rung shapoh ki ïing , hynmen mynsngi ki rieh bad ki kiar ïa ka jingshai .
translation.en: In the dark they dig through houses , which they had marked for themselves in the daytime : they know not the light .

translation.kha: Me longïing iwei , A Trai ? u la kylli . Nga longkmie U Jisu , ïa uba me pynshitom beiñ ! ka sur ka la ong .
translation.en: And he said , Who art thou , Lord ? And the Lord said ,  I am Jesus whom thou persecutest : it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks .

translation.kha: Jamynrei kim shemphang ïa ka jingjubab Jong u .
translation.en: And they understood not the saying which he spake unto them .
The foolishness of man perverteth his way : and his heart fretteth against the  Lord .
translation.kha: Don ki briew kiba pynjot ïa lade da ki kam ba-mutlop jong ki hi bad nangta ki kynnoh ïa U  Trai .
ïa ka skei ka jingainguh thang bad ki tiar ki tar jongnga ka baroh , ïa ka dabor bad ka jingpynshong jong ka ,
translation.en: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture , and the laver and his foot ,

translation.kha: ryngkat bad kiwei ki jaitbynriew ïa kiba u Ashurbanipal bakhlaiñbor bad badonbor , u la pynkynriah ïa ki na ki ïing jong ki bad pynïasoh ïa ki ha ka nongbah Samaria bad shawei shaei ha ka probins jrong ka Ïuphratis Sepngi .
translation.en: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over , and set in the cities of Samaria , and the rest that are on this side the river , and at such a time .

translation.kha: Kumta u Ishar u wanrah ïa ka sha ka jaka kaba u paidbah u la ïalumlang — ki rangbah , ki kynthei sad ki khnai uba la san kiba la lah ban sngewthuh .
translation.en: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women , and all that could hear with understanding , upon the first day of the seventh month .

translation.kha: Nga la jied ka jaka na ka bynta ki briew jong nga ki Israel pynlang la la pynslem pynsan ïa ki hangta , ha kaba kin shongkha shah banbeiñ shuh . nadong ba ki la rung ha kane ka ri , ki la shah tun ïaleh pyrshah ha ki bri kiba runar , hynrei kane sa ym Jia shuh . Nga kular banbeiñ jop ïa baroh ki nongshun jong me bun ban ai ha me ki nonghiarpateng .
translation.en: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel . Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies . Furthermore I tell thee that the  Lord  will build thee an house .
Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the  Lord .
translation.kha: To beh kthong ïa ki bad ñiad noh ïa ki na ka khyndew !

Kane ka bor kaba trei ha ngi ka lama hajuh kumin ka jingkhlaiñbor ba u pyndonkam haba u la pynmihpat ïa U Kherith na kiba ïap , bad u la pynshong ïa u sha ka kti kamon jong u ha ka pyrthei ba kynjri pdeng .
translation.en: Which he wrought in Christ , when he raised him from the dead , and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places ,

translation.kha: Ïa nga la tan ha ki ar bynta . Nga da kwah eh ban iehnoh ïa kane ka jingim bad shun anna bad U kyrshut , kaba long katai kaei kambah kham bha ;
translation.en: For I am in a strait betwixt two , having a desire to depart , and to be with Christ ; which is far better :

translation.kha: Ki khnam jong nga kin jlih da ka snam jong ki , bad ka waitlam jongu nga kane pynïap lut ïa kiba pyrshah ïa nga . Ïa uno a uba ïaleit pyrthuh ïa nga ngan ym map ; thew ki koidi bad kito kiba mynnin ruh kin ïapom .’
translation.en: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood , and my sword shall devour flesh  ; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives , from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy .

But when they shall lead you , and deliver you up , take no thought beforehand what ye shall speak , neither do ye premeditate : but whatsoever shall be given you in that hour , that speak ye : for it is not ye that speak , but the Holy Ghost .
translation.kha: Bad haba la kem ïa phi bad ïalam sha ka ïingbishar , wat khuslai lypa ïa kaei kaba phin kren ; haba ka por kan poi , to kren ïa kaei kaei kaba yn sa ai ha phi ha kata ka por . Namar ki ktien kiba phin sa kren , kin ym long ki jong phi ; kin wan na U Mynsiem Bakhuid .
U Jehoïakim u long uba khraw bad badonbor tam , hynrei u sngap ïa ki jingduwai jongu im’ !
translation.en: Jehovah is so great and powerful , yet he listens to our prayers !

translation.kha: Kham thut ban ïa ki pukni kiba tiduh wia na sahit bnoh , ki eh ktang ïa ngi sha tbian . Ki lap ïa ngi ha ki lumrit ; ki kurup ïa ngi ha ka jingkyndit ha ka ri shyiap .
translation.en: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven : they pursued us upon the mountains , they laid wait for us in the wilderness .

translation.kha: U Bendeker : ki nongbah Makas , Shaalbim , Beth Shemesh , Elon , bad Beth Hanan
translation.en: The son of Dekar , in Makaz , and in Shaalbim , and Beth–shemesh , and Elon–beth–hanan :

translation.kha: Kynmaw ba U Trai un ai ha phi kum ka bainong ïa kaei kaba u la buh na ka beit ki briew jong u . Naba U Khrist u dei U Kynrad bashispah uba phi shakri .
translation.en: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance : for ye serve the Lord Christ .
And he saith unto them ,  Are ye so without understanding also ? Do ye not perceive , that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man , it cannot defile him  ;
translation.kha: Phim long kiba kham stad ban ïa kiwei pat ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa ki .  Hato phim shemphang ? Ym don kaba rung shapoh u briew na shabar kaba lah shisha ban pynlong bymkhuid ïa u ,
To khmih bha ïa ki long-briew dara ïa ki masi jong phi katba phi! kah ,
translation.en: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks , and look well to thy herds .
Alas ! for that day is great , so that none is like it : it is even the time of Jacob s trouble  ; but he shall be saved out of it .
translation.kha: Ka sngi kaba shyrkhei ka wan ; ym don kano kano kawei pat ka sngi kaba lah ban nujor bad ka — ka por ka jingnoh mynsiem na ka bynta ki briew jong nga , hynrei kin lait im .
kumto u Jakob u mihnoh , u da kit lut baroh kat kiba u don , bad u leit sha Beersheba , nabar hangta u kñia ainguh ha U Blei jong u Isaak u kpa jong u .
translation.en: And Israel took his journey with all that he had , and came to Beer–sheba , and offered sacrifices unto the God of his father Isaac .

translation.kha: Wat shahshkor ïa la u par Israhaïah , hawei kohnguh ïa U Trai uba U Balei jong ph .
translation.en: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another  ; but thou shalt fear thy God : for I am the  Lord  your God .

translation.kha: Ym don jingbuh pum ïa ka jingdih wiang ; u syier u la ai hukum ïa ki shakri ka ïingsyiem ba baroh ki lah ban dih kabu ki sngewkwah .
translation.en: And the drinking was according to the law  ; none did compel : for so the king had appointed to all the officers of his house , that they should do according to every man s pleasure .

translation.kha: U Trai Nongsynshar u ong , Ynda haba ngan pynkhuid ïa phi na ki pop jong phi! Baroh , ngan sa shah ba phin shong biang ha ki nongbah jong phi bad shah ba phin tei pat ïa ki jaka ba la jot .
translation.en: Thus saith the Lord  God   ; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause you to dwell in the cities , and the wastes shall be builded .

translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ïa phad ban san kum u jingthung baplung . Pha la nang khlaiñ bad jrong bad pha la long ka kynthei samla . Ka shadem jong phad ka la wandur itynnat , bad u shñiuh jong phalang u la san , hynrei pha longsem kaba lyngkhuit .
translation.en: I have caused thee to multiply as the bud of the field , and thou hast increased and waxen great , and thou art come to excellent ornaments : thy breasts are fashioned , and thine hair is grown , whereas thou wast naked and bare .

translation.kha: kiba la pynïap ïa U Trai Jisu bad ïa ki nongïathuhlypa , bad ki la pynshitom beiñ ïa ngi . A kumno ki la long ki bym pynsngewbha ïa U bieit! A kumno ki la long kiba shun iwei ïa iwei!
translation.en: Who both killed the Lord Jesus , and their own prophets , and have persecuted us ; and they please not God , and are contrary to all men :
And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Go down , charge the people , lest they break through unto the  Lord  to gaze , and many of them perish .
translation.kha: U Moses u leit , bad U  Trai  u ong ha u ,  Khie leit hiar bad maham ïa ki briew ban ym jam ïa u pud ban wan khmih ïa nga ; lada ki leh kumta , bun na ki kin ïap .
U Jotham u la nang khlaiñbor , namar u kohnguh hok ïa U Trai U blei jong u .
translation.en: So Jotham became mighty , because he prepared his ways before the  Lord  his God .

translation.kha: Kumta hamar ba pher ai ïa ka jingshai jrong phi sha U Bela ha ka duwan bad hangta phi kynmaw ba u para jong phi u don ei ei pyrshah ïa phi ,
translation.en: Therefore if thou bring thy gift to the altar , and there rememberest that thy brother hath ought against thee  ;
If ye walk in my statutes , and keep my commandments , and do them  ;
translation.kha: Lada phi im kat kum ki aiñ jong nga , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong nga ,

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto him , Away , get thee down , and thou shalt come up , thou , and Aaron with thee : but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto the  Lord  , lest he break forth upon them .
translation.kha: Te U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Khie leit hiar , bad wan ïalam pat bad me ïa u Aaron . Hynrei ki lyngdoh bad ki briew kim bit ban jam ïa u pud ban wan sha nga , ïoh nga pynshitom ïa ki .

translation.en: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee ? let them arise , if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble : for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods , O Judah .
