translation.kha: Hangno ki blei kiba phi la thaw na ka bynta ïa lade ? Haba phi don ha ka jingjynjar , ai ba ma ki kin pynim ïa phi — lada ki lah ! Ko Judah pha la don shibun ki blei kumba pha don ki nongbah .
Tang da ka jingduwai lah ban beh noh! Kum ïa une , u Jisu u la jubab ; ym don katai pat kaba lah .
translation.en: And he said unto them ,  This kind can come forth by nothing , but by prayer and fasting .
Thy graven images also will I cut off , and thy standing images out of the midst of thee  ; and thou shalt no more worship the work of thine hands .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki bleithaw bad ki rishot maw bakyntang jong phi ; phin ym mane shuh ïa kiei kiei kiba phi hi phi la thaw .
Susah Mynta ang don kawei ka jingkyrpad ; sngewbha wat kyrngah ïa nga . Kaei kata ? ka Hashabaïah ka kylli .
translation.en: And now I ask one petition of thee , deny me not . And she said unto him , Say on .

translation.kha: Nangta ki la ïakynting sbai banbeiñ jied napdeng ki ar ngut ki rangbah , bad uta umbah la jied u la long u Matthias , ïa uba la pynïasoh sha ka kynoi ki khatwei ngut ki apostol .
translation.en: And they gave forth their lots  ; and the lot fell upon Matthias  ; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles .

And Memucan answered before the king and the princes , Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only , but also to all the princes , and to all the people that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus .
translation.kha: Nangta u Memukan u ong ha u syiem bad ki rangbah synshar :  Ka Bashti , ka Mahadei ka la krenbeiñ ym tang ïa u syiem hynrei ïa ki rangbah synshar ruh — ha ka jingshisha , ïa uwei pa uwei u rangbah ha ka hima !

haba mynta u Timothi u la imat ph sha ngi , bad u la wanrah shaw ngi ïa ka khubor kaba sngewkmen shaphang ka jingngeit bad ka jingneit jong phi! . Gera U la ïathuh ïa ngi ba phi ïai pynkoit bha ïa ngi dorbar ba phi kwah hir hir ïa-ban ïohi ïa ngi wohnia ma ngi ruh , ngi khiew ban ieh ïa Phin .
translation.en: But now when Timothy came from you unto us , and brought us good tidings of your faith and charity , and that ye have good remembrance of us always , desiring greatly to see us , as we also to see you :

translation.kha: Ki ïa-ong , Ngi lah ban ai ïa la ka jong ka para ba kun ïashongkurim bad u briew u bym shym la otsher ; kata kad long ka jingjahburom ïa me .
translation.en: And they said unto them , We cannot do this thing , to give our sister to one that is uncircumcised  ; for that were a reproach unto us :

translation.kha: Te jingkad , long ka por ka poi ba ïa ka ri yn ai pat sha ki briew jngai U Tlai , yn ym dat shuh ka bynta ïadon ïano na phi .
translation.en: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast a cord by lot in the congregation of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Moses u la ïakhot ha u Jethro ïa kaei kaei baroh ka U Trai u la leh ïa u Pharaoh bad ïa ki nongthain Ijipt khnap ba un ïoh ïapyllait im ïa ki Israel . U la ïathuh ruh ha u ïa ki jingeh ba ki Israel ki la ïakynduh ha lynti bad kumno U Trai u la pyllait im ïa ki .
translation.en: And Moses told his father in law all that the  Lord  had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel s sake , and all the travail that had come upon them by the way , and how the  Lord  delivered them .
The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof  ; because they have transgressed the laws , changed the ordinance , broken the everlasting covenant .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki la pyntngit ïa ka pyrthei da kaba pynkheiñ ïa ki aiñ jong U Blei bad da kaba ïaleh pyrshah ïa ka jutang kaba u la pynlong ban neh junom .
Akaba ki briew ki dang shahshkor ïa kane , U Ujuh u la btep bad u la iathuh ïa ka phar ha ki . U la ïajan poi artat ha Jerusalem , bad ki la kharai ba ka Hima U Blei ka la jlan paw .
translation.en: And as they heard these things , he added and spake a parable , because he was nigh to Jerusalem , and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Elijah u nongïathuhlypa ,
translation.en: And the word of the  Lord  came to Elijah the Tishbite , saying ,

translation.kha: U tei ruh ki kut kiba shem ha ki rudnong , bad u tih shibun ki pukri , naba u don ki kynhun jinglur Ibbah bun ha kjat ki lum bashaphang sepngi bad ha ki pyntha . Namar ba u ieit ïa ka rep ka riang , u pynseisoh ïa ki briew ban thung dieng swai ha ki jaka lum bad ban Rephan ha ki jaka kiba seisoh .
translation.en: Also he built towers in the desert , and digged many wells : for he had much cattle , both in the low country , and in the plains : husbandmen also , and vine dressers in the mountains , and in Carmel : for he loved husbandry .
And thou saidst unto thy servants , Except your youngest brother come down with you , ye shall see my face no more .
translation.kha: Te phi ong , ‘ Lymda u para khatduh jong phi u wan lang bad phi , yn ym shah shuh ïa phi ban wan ha khmat jong nga .’
Da ka borbah jong ki thir thma kin jop ïa ki Assyria , ka ri jong u Nimrod , bad kin pyllait im ïa ngi na ki Assyria haba ki hiarthma ïa ka ri jongngi im’ .
translation.en: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword , and the land of Nimrod in the entrances thereof : thus shall he deliver us from the Assyrian , when he cometh into our land , and when he treadeth within our borders .

translation.kha: To kynmaw , A Blei , ba ka jingim jngai nga ka long tang ka jynhaw , ka jingsah jong nga ka la kut noh .
translation.en: O remember that my life is wind : mine eye shall no more see good .

translation.kha: Haduh lai sngi um shym da ban ïohi , bad ha kata ka para um shym la smam ne dih ei ei .
translation.en: And he was three days without sight , and neither did eat nor drink .

translation.kha: Hapoh ka jingsynshar jongki u , baroh ki khatduh naba ïapher jong ka met ki ïajubab lang setkut , bad ïa ka saw baroh kawei la bat lang da kamai pa kadei ka jingïapyndait ïa kaba ka la pynpdang . Kumta haba kawei pa kawei ka bynta kaweh ïapler ka ïatrei kam kumba ka dei don trei , ka met barhem kawei ka san bad ka tei ïa lade da ka jingieit .
translation.en: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth , according to the effectual working in the measure of every part , maketh increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love .
Yea , whiles I was speaking in prayer , even the man Gabriel , whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning , being caused to fly swiftly , touched me about the time of the evening oblation .
translation.kha: Mynba nga dang duwai , u Gabriel , uba nga la lah ïohi ha ka jingïohipaw mynshuwa , u la wan her sha tbian sha ka jaka ha kaba nga don . Ka la long ha ka por ban ai ïa ka jingkñia janmiet .

Shisien , katba dang leit ontep , la ïohi ïa kawei na Kino ki kynhun , bad ki paidbah ki pynhap ïa ka metïap ha ka jingtep u Elisha badno ki phet krad . Martl ïadei ka metïap ha ki shyieng u Elisha , uta u briew u im pat bad u ïeng joit .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as they were burying a man , that , behold , they spied a band of men  ; and they cast the man into the sepulchre of Elisha : and when the man was let down , and touched the bones of Elisha , he revived , and stood up on his feet .
The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor : let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined .
translation.kha: Ki bymman ki sarong bad pynshitom beiñ ïa kiba duk ; pynngat ïa ki ha ki jingriam kiba ki la thaw .
Haba kiwei pat ki shiphew ngut ki synran ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la bitar ïa u Jakob bad u Ïoannis .
translation.en: And when the ten heard it , they began to be much displeased with James and John .

translation.kha: Ko ki bhabriew ka Jerusalem , to phet lyngkha ki mad bah jong phi ! To khmih sawdong ! Peit hi da lade ! To wad ïa ki jaka ïew ! Hato phi lah ban shem uwei u briew umbah kuna ïa kaweh dei bad uba pyrshang ban ïaineh ha U Blei ? “lada phi lah , U Trai un map ïa ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem , and see now , and know , and seek in the broad places thereof , if ye can find a man , if there be any that executeth judgment , that seeketh the truth  ; and I will pardon it .
That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me , neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions  ; but that they may be my people , and I may be their God , saith the Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kane ban da ïa ki Israel na kaba klet noh ïa nga bad pynjakhlia ïa lade da ki pop jong ki . Ki dei ban long ki briew jong nga , bad ngan long U Blei jong ki .  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la kren .
ïa-ïoh , ko ki khun jong nga , to ïaisah ha u , khnang ba ynda u wanpaw , ngin long ibha iap da ka jingshlur bad ngim donkam ban rieh ha ka jinglehrain na u ha ka Sngi kaba u wanlam .
translation.en: And now , little children , abide in him  ; that , when he shall appear , we may have confidence , and not be ashamed before him at his coming .
And the people that were encamped heard say , Zimri hath conspired , and hath also slain the king : wherefore all Israel made Omri , the captain of the host , king over Israel that day in the camp .
translation.kha: bad haba ki ïohsngew ba u Simri u la ïasylla pyrshah ïa u syiem bad pynïap ïa u , hangta hi ki baroh ki pynbna ba u nongai hukum jong ki , u Omri , u long u syiem ka Israel .

translation.en: But the children of the murderers he slew not : according unto that which is written in the book of the law of Moses , wherein the  Lord  commanded , saying , The fathers shall not be put to death for the children , nor the children be put to death for the fathers  ; but every man shall be put to death for his own sin .
translation.kha: Pynban , um shym pynïap ïa ki khun jong ki hynrei u kohnguh ïa kaei kaba U  Trai  u la hukum ha ka Aiñ u Moses :  Ki kmie ki kpa kim dei ban shah pynïap na ka bynta ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki khun jong ki , bad ki khun kim dei ban shah pynïap na ka bynta ki kam sniew ba la leh da ki kmie ki kpa jong ki ; ïa u briew dei ban pynïap tang namar ka kam sniew kaba u hi u la leh .
U Eden u ïaid na ka lynti na ki tduh jongnga ka ri shyiap , ha ka phang mihngi jong ka Nobah bad ka Japheth , bad u la tur ïaleh ïa ka kynhun shipai ha kob kim shym poi pyrkhat .
translation.en: And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah , and smote the host : for the host was secure .
Thou knowest the commandments , Do not commit adultery , Do not kill , Do not steal , Do not bear false witness , Honour thy father and thy mother .
translation.kha: Me tip ïa ki hukum : ‘ Wat klim ; wat pynïap briew ; wat tuh ; wat mudui lamler ïano ïano ; burom ïa la u kpa bad ïa la ka kmie .’

translation.en: And whereas thou sawest the feet and toes , part of potters  clay , and part of iron , the kingdom shall be divided  ; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron , forasmuch as thou sawest the iron mixed with miry clay .
translation.kha: Phi la ïohi ruh ba ki kjat bad ki shympriah kjat ki long shi bynta da ka dewbyrtha bad shi bynta da ka nar . Kane ka mut ba kan long ka hima kaba la pynïakhlad . Kan don kaei kaei kaba eh kum ka nar , namar la don ka nar kaba la khleh bad ka dewbyrtha .
U Jisu u la ïathuh ruh ïa kan ka pharshi ha ki bariew kiba la sngewthikna ïa la ka jingbha jong ki hi bad kiba ñiewbeiñ ïa baroh kiwei pat .
translation.en: And he spake this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous , and despised others :

translation.kha: Kito kiba shong basah ha ki shnongrit ha ka ri kin shah pynïap ha ka jingïaleh . Ki nongshun ktang tih ïa ki kharai , Kin tei ïa ki kynton khyndew , bad pynlong ki kynroh baskhem pyrshah ïa pha .
translation.en: He shall slay with the sword thy daughters in the field : and he shall make a fort against thee , and cast a mount against thee , and lift up the buckler against thee .

translation.kha: Bad u Samuel u ïa-ong ha ki , Ïa ngim ïaleit baroh sha Gilgal , bad sa shisien ïng pynbna ïa u Saul kum u syiem jong ngi .
translation.en: Then said Samuel to the people , Come , and let us go to Gilgal , and renew the kingdom there .
Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back ? and their mighty ones are beaten down , and are fled apace , and look not back : for fear was round about , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei kaei ba nga ïohi ?  U  Trai  u kylli .  Ki phai dien ha ka jingsheptieng . Ki shipai jong ki , ki shah beh noh ; kiba dap da ka jingsheptieng , ki mareh stet kat lah kat ïai bad kim kyrtiang dien .
bad thoh ha ki ïa kine ki aiñ bad ki Hukum baroh . Ynda phi la rung sha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud malu ka ngap ba U Trai U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi u la kular ha ph ,
translation.en: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law , when thou art passed over , that thou mayest go in unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , a land that floweth with milk and honey  ; as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath promised thee .
Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch , and mine own clothes shall abhor me .
translation.kha: U Blei u bret ïa nga sha ka thliew kaba jaboh , bad wat ki jaiñphong jong nga ki sngewlehrain ïa nga .

translation.en: And he entered into a ship , and passed over , and came into his own city .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kiew halor ka lieng bad u la leit phai pat sha shiliang ka duriaw sha la ka jong shnong ,

translation.en: Then I went down to the potter s house , and , behold , he wrought a work on the wheels .
translation.kha: Kumta nga la leit hangta bad nga la ïohi ïa u nongthaw khiew ba u trei ha ka shalyntem jong u .

u thang jingiwbih ha ka Them Hinnom , bad u kynoi wat ïa la ki jong ki khun shynrang kum ki jingkohnguh thang ïa ki bleithaw , da kaba bud ïa ka jingleit ba-ijli jyllang ki jaitbynriew ïa kiba U Trai u la beh noh na ka ri katba ki Jerusalem’ ki nang Tur saphriang .
translation.en: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom , and burnt his children in the fire , after the abominations of the heathen whom the  Lord  had cast out before the children of Israel .

translation.kha: Ki riewbymman ki pynphriang ïa ki ktien lorni ; ki pynjynjar pynlang pynpra ïa ka jingïadei paralok .
translation.en: A froward man soweth strife : and a whisperer separateth chief friends .

translation.kha: bad u la jubab , Ïa ka jingtip ïa kiba rieh jong ka Hima U blei la ai ha phi , hynrei ha kiwei pat ka wan ha ki pharshi , khnang ba ki eh ba peit hynrei kim ïohi , bad shahshkor hynrei kim shemphang .
translation.en: And he said ,  Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God : but to others in parables  ; that seeing they might not see , and hearing they might not understand .
And they tied unto it a lace of blue , to fasten it on high upon the mitre  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
translation.kha: Ki teh ïa ka ha khmat ka jaiñspong da u ksai uba jngum , kumba U  Trai  u la hukum ïa u Moses .
Phi lah banbeiñ thok ia ka exam ?
translation.en: Can you write the exam ?
He that loveth father or mother more than me is not worthy of me : and he that loveth son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me .
translation.kha: Uno uno uba ieit kham bun shah ïa la u kpa lane ka kmie ban ïa nga um long uba bit ban long u synran jong nga ; uno uno uba ieit kham bun shah ïa la u khun lane ka khun ban ïa nga , um long uba bit ban long u synran jong nga .

translation.en: And he made boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood , standing up .
translation.kha: Ki shna ïa ki jingker ïa ka Ïingjaiñ da ka dieng akasia .

translation.en: About whom , when I was at Jerusalem , the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me , desiring to have judgment against him .
translation.kha: bad haba nga la leit sha Jerusalem , ki rangbah lyngdoh jong ki Jiw lem bad ki tymmen ki san ki la wanrah ïa ki jingmudui pyrshah ïa u bad ki la kyrpad ïa nga ban rai pynrem ïa u .

translation.en: But ye have set at nought all my counsel , and would none of my reproof :
translation.kha: Phi la ñiewbeiñ ïa ka jingai jingmut jong nga baroh , bad phim mon ba ngan pynbeit ïa phi .
U wan hadien jong nga , hynriew nga ngam longsem uba bit wat ban law ïa ki ksai juti jong u .
translation.en: He it is , who coming after me is preferred before me , whose shoe s latchet I am not worthy to unloose .
He is the tower of salvation for his king : and sheweth mercy to his anointed , unto David , and to his seed for evermore .
translation.kha: U Blei u ai ki jingjop bakhraw ha u syiem jong u ; u pynpaw ka jingieit baïaineh ha uba u la jied , ha u Dabid bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u junom .
( U Jisu u la lah tip lypa ai u ban sa shetkylla ïa u ; na “kata ka daw balei u la ïong , Baroh na pa , lait noh uwei , phi long kiba khup . )
translation.en: For he knew who should betray him  ; therefore said he ,  Ye are not all clean .

translation.kha: Ki la wan sha Kapernam , nabar hadien ba u la rung shapoh ïing U Jisu u la kylli ïa ki synran jong u , Shaphang kaei phiah la ïatainia hapdeng jngai phi ha lyndang ?
translation.en: And he came to Capernaum : and being in the house he asked them ,  What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way ?

translation.kha: bad U Blei u la pynbna ba u long U Rangbah Lyngdoh ha ka manna long lyngkhuh jong u Melkhisedek .
translation.en: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec .

Saul chose him three thousand men of Israel  ; whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Beth–el , and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin : and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent .
translation.kha: u jied lai hajar ngut ki rangbah ; u bat ar hajar ngut na ki bad u ha Mikhmash bad ha ka ri lum jong ka Bethel bad u phah shihajar ngut bad u Jonathan u khun jong u sha Gibeah , ha ka thain Benjamin . Ïa kiba sah pat u phah noh sha la ïing .

Nga la bitar ïa ki bynriew jong ar ; nga la shim ïa ki kumba kim dei shuh ki jong nga : Nga pahuh ïa ki ha ka bor jong pha , bad pham pynum jinglehisynei ïa ki ; woh ïa kiba la thom pha sa da kaba tyndong .
translation.en: I was wroth with my people , I have polluted mine inheritance , and given them into thine hand : thou didst shew them no mercy  ; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke .
(As it is written , He hath dispersed abroad ; he hath given to the poor : his righteousness remaineth for ever .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong :  U ai sbun mynsiem sha kiba kyrduh ; ka jinglehsbun jong u ka neh junom .

translation.en: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God , that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins :
translation.kha: Ïa uno uno u rangbah lyngdoh la jied napdeng ki parabriew , bad la thung ban shakri ïa U Blei na ka bynta jong ki , ban ai ïa ki jingkñia bad ka jingainguh na ka bynta ki pop .

translation.en: Seek good , and not evil , that ye may live : and so the  Lord  , the God of hosts , shall be with you , as ye have spoken .
translation.kha: Pynlong ïa ka jingthmu jong phi ban leh ïa kaei kaba bha , bad ym ïa kaei kaba sniew , khnang ba phin ïoh im . Te U  Trai  , U Blei Badonbor Baroh , da shisha un don ryngkat bad phi , kumba phi kam ba u long .

shem uwei u khiew nar bad pynïar ïa u kum ka kynroh hapdeng jong me bad ka nongbah . pha khmat shiah ka nongbah . Ka anna ha ka jingshah kerkut , bad dei ma me uba Kerkut ïa ka . Kane kan long ka dak ïa ka jingkheiñbriew Israel .
translation.en: Moreover take thou unto thee an iron pan , and set it for a wall of iron between thee and the city : and set thy face against it , and it shall be besieged , and thou shalt lay siege against it . This shall be a sign to the house of Israel .

translation.kha: U Trai u ainong ha u Massah , Wan kiew sha na ha une u lumlang , bad katba me dang don haneng , ngan ai ha me ar tylli ki mawlyngkniap kiba ba-don ïa ki law baroh kiba nga la thoh na ka bynta ban hikai ïa ki briew .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Come up to me into the mount , and be there : and I will give thee tables of stone , and a law , and commandments which I have written  ; that thou mayest teach them .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi U Trei Badonbor Baroh un pynpoh ïa uwei pa uwei kiba khrawbor , ïa uwei pa uei uba sarong bad uba sngewhun .
translation.en: For the day of the  Lord  of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty , and upon every one that is lifted up  ; and he shall be brought low :

translation.kha: U Angel u la mihpaw biah badno u la ong , Ha ïitkhmih ! Ïa kaei re kaei kawei pat kaba wiang !
translation.en: Then the angel that talked with me went forth , and said unto me , Lift up now thine eyes , and see what is this that goeth forth .
Then came the officers to the chief priests and Pharisees  ; and they said unto them , Why have ye not brought him ?
translation.kha: Haba ki nongap phira ki la leit phai noh , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki Pharisi ki la kylli ïa ki ,  Balei phi khlem wan ïalam ïa u ?
Ïa ki rangbah bastad jong phi la buh ha ka jinglehrain ; ki la shaïong nabar shah riam . Ki la kyntait ïa ki katei jong nga ; ka jingstad kaba kumno ki la ïoh myntan ?
translation.en: The wise men are ashamed , they are dismayed and taken : lo , they have rejected the word of the  Lord   ; and what wisdom is in them ?
There is gold , and a multitude of rubies : but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel .
translation.kha: Lada phi tip shaphang kaei kaba phi kren , phi don ei ei kaba kham kordor ban ïa ka ksiar ne ki mawkordor .

translation.en: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you  ; for thee , and for thy servant , and for thy maid , and for thy hired servant , and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee ,
translation.kha: Wat la ka khyndew ha kata ka snem ka sah shrah , kan pynmih jingbam hi ïa phi , ïa ki mraw jong phi , ïa ki nongbylla jong phi , ïa ki nongwei kiba shong bad phi ,
Jamynrei u Jehoshaphat u ïai-ong ha ki , Ma por bad ki briew jong nga ngi Don ka jingïakajia kaba jur bad ki Amana . Nga la khot ïa phi , hynrei phim shym la woh pyllait ïa nga na ki .
translation.en: And Jephthah said unto them , I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon  ; and when I called you , ye delivered me not out of their hands .

translation.kha: Shahshkor ïa nga : Ka long kaba shisha ba ki don shibun ki riewkynthei ha Israel ha ka Por jong u Elijah , haba ym shym la don slap haduh lai snem shiteng bad ba ka nemsniew bajur ka la saphriang kylleng ka ri baroh kamai .
translation.en: But I tell you of a truth , many widows were in Israel in the days of Elias , when the heaven was shut up three years and six months , when great famine was throughout all the land  ;

translation.kha: Thet ki kti .
translation.en: Wash your hands .
And Elijah said unto them , Take the prophets of Baal  ; let not one of them escape . And they took them : and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon , and slew them there .
translation.kha: U Elijah u hukum bad ong ,  Kem ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong u Baal ; wat ai ba uno uno na ki un lait phet !  Ki paidbah ki la kem ïa ki baroh , bad u Elijah u la ïalam ïa ki sha ka wah Kishon bad pynïap ïa ki .
U la shim ïa ka na ka kti bad u la ong ïa ka , Talitha , koum , kaweh mut , Ko Khynnah rit , nga ong ïa pha ban khie joit !
translation.en: And he took the damsel by the hand , and said unto her ,  Talitha cumi  ;  which is , being interpreted ,  Damsel , I say unto thee , arise .

translation.kha: Nangta U Trai u la ong ha u Moses , U Pha u long umbah kamut eh bad u kyntait ban shah ïa ki babha ba-bang leit .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Pharaoh s heart is hardened , he refuseth to let the people go .

translation.kha: Ki ap ha ki riewdum jong ka wah Arnon bad ki ïaid khlem jingmut shane shatai , kum ki sim kiba la shah beh noh! na ki skum lad ki .
translation.en: For it shall be , that , as a wandering bird cast out of the nest , so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon .

translation.kha: U long u khlain jong ka balang kaba long ka met jong u ; u long u synrai jong ka jingim jong ka . U un-long U Khun uba la kha nyngkong , ïa uba la pynmihpat na ka jingïap , kthang ba tang ma u hi un ioh ïa ka bynta kaba nyngkong ha kiei kiei baroh .
translation.en: And he is the head of the body , the church : who is the beginning , the firstborn from the dead ; that in all things he might have the preeminence .
Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand , Come , ye blessed of my Father , inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world :
translation.kha: Nangta u Syiem un ong ha ki briew kiba ha ka liang kamon jong u , ‘ To wan , phi kiba la kyrkhu da U Kpa jong nga ! To wan bad to ïoh ïa ka hima kaba la pynkhreh na ka bynta jong phi naduh kaba pynlong ïa ka pyrthei .

Hynrei , ngan ym knieh ïa ka hima baroh kawei na u Solomon , bad ngan pynneh ïa u ha ka ba katba u ding im . Kane ngan leh na ka bniat u Dabid u shakri jong nga , ïa kaba nga la lngaid bad uba kthong ïa ki daiñ mala ki hukum Jong nga .
translation.en: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand : but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant s sake , whom I chose , because he kept my commandments and my statutes :

Behold , I have done according to thy words : lo , I have given thee a wise and an understanding heart  ; so that there was none like thee before thee , neither after thee shall any arise like unto thee .
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha me bun ka jingstad bad ka jingshemphang ban ïa uno uno uba la don ha shuwa lane u ban sa ïoh pat hadien .

U Trai u la ong ha nga , Ko Jeremaïah , khie leit bad pynbna ïa ka khubor jngai sa ha ka Khyrdop paidïapom , kaba lyngba jong ka ki syiem jong ka Judah ki rung shapoh bad mih shabar ka nongbam ; nangta leit sha baroh kawei pat ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: Thus said the  Lord  unto me  ; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people , whereby the kings of Judah come in , and by the which they go out , and in all the gates of Jerusalem  ;
Then let my wife grind unto another , and let others bow down upon her .
translation.kha: te to ai ba ka tnga jong nga kan shet ïa ka jingbam na ka bynta uwei pat u briew bad ban thiah ha ka jingthiah jong uwei pat .

U Jeroboam u long u samla uba dap shynrang , bad haba u Solomon u ïohi katno ba u long uba trei shym , u buh ïa u ban pynïaid ïa ki nongtrei ba shu pynbor ha ka thiang jong ki jait Manasseh bad Ephraim .
translation.en: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour : and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious , he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph .

translation.kha: Ngan teh ïa u tylli jong me ba kumta men ym lah ban maham ïa kine ki riewkhlaw pyrshah .
translation.en: And I will make thy tongue cleave to the roof of thy mouth , that thou shalt be dumb , and shalt not be to them a reprover : for they are a rebellious house .
Now the name of the Israelite that was slain , even that was slain with the Midianite woman , was Zimri , the son of Salu , a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites .
translation.kha: Ka kyrteng uta u Israel uba la shah pynïap lang bad kata ka kynthei Midian ka long u Simri u khun jong u Salu , u khlieh jong ka longïing kaba na ka jait Simeon .
Pynban , ai ba ka jingbishar hok kan tuid kum ka ïaidwir , bad ka jinglehhok kum ka wah ka bym ju rngad .
translation.en: But let judgment run down as waters , and righteousness as a mighty stream .
And Ebed–melech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah , Put now these old cast clouts and rotten rags under thine armholes under the cords . And Jeremiah did so .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa nga to buh ïa ki jaiñ rim ha ki ksang ti jong nga , khnang ba ki tyllai kin ym pynmynsaw ïa nga .
U long uba shaniah ha U blang , uba la jied ïa u ban leh ïa kano ka nang , kumba u Mosah u la hir kiba lah ban shaniah ha ka kam jong u ha ka ïing U Blei .
translation.en: Who was faithful to him that appointed him , as also Moses was faithful in all his house .

translation.kha: U Trai u ino ha u Moses ha u Lum Sinai bad u law ïa u , ba-bang ai ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ha u paid Isaia .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses in mount Sinai , saying ,

translation.kha: Long kiba beit bad phi pyn-i ba phi don ka jingtiengburom ïa U Trai ; long kiba kyntur bad phi pyn-i ba phim don ïa kata .
translation.en: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth the  Lord  : but he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him .

translation.kha: Hangta i pa i ong ha ngi , ‘ Phin tip ba ka Rakhel ka tnga jong nga ka ïoh tang ar ngut ki khun shynrang na nga .
translation.en: And thy servant my father said unto us , Ye know that my wife bare me two sons :

translation.kha: Lada me kyntait , ngan pynshitom ïa ka ri jong me da kaba pyndep ïa ka da ki ïadoh .
translation.en: And if thou refuse to let them go , behold , I will smite all thy borders with frogs :

And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days  ; neither shall there any thing of the flesh , which thou sacrificedst the first day at even , remain all night until the morning .
translation.kha: Hynñiew sngi lynter ym bit ïa uno uno ha kata ka ri ban don thiat ha ïing jong u ; bad ïa ka doh ba phi kñia ha ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba nyngkong dei ban bam lut ha kajuh hi ka miet .

translation.en: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance , that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs , which were committed before you , and that ye defile not yourselves therein : I am the  Lord  your God .
translation.kha: Bad U  Trai  u la ong ,  Kohnguh ïa ki hukum kiba nga ai bad wat bud ïa ki rukom im jong kito ki briew kiba shong ha kata ka ri ha shuwa jong phi , bad wat pynbyrsieh ruh ïa lade da kaba leh ïa kano kano na kine ki kam . Nga long U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
Haba u wan phai na Damaris , u Amasa u ïohi ba la dep shna ïa ka duwan ,
translation.en: And when the king was come from Damascus , the king saw the altar : and the king approached to the altar , and offered thereon .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta , U ijuh u la noh , uno uno kiba don ka pla pisa lane ka pla u dat ban rah ïa ka ; bad uno du u bih don ka waitsum u dei ban die noh ïa ka jaiñkup jong u bad thied kawei .
translation.en: Then said he unto them ,  But now , he that hath a purse , let him take it , and likewise his scrip : and he that hath no sword , let him sell his garment , and buy one .
Repent ye therefore , and be converted , that your sins may be blotted out , when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord  ;
translation.kha: Te , to kylla-kaba-mut , bad to phai sha U Blei , khnang ba un map ïa ki pop jong phi .

Kumta U Jisu u la loit bad ki . Um shym da jngai na ka ïing mynba u rangbah pynïaidkam u la phah ïa ki paralok ban ong ha U , Kynrad , wat pynshitom ïa lade . Pynngam dih hok ban pdiang ïa me ha ka iing jong nga ,
translation.en: Then Jesus went with them . And when he was now not far from the house , the centurion sent friends to him , saying unto him , Lord , trouble not thyself : for I am not worthy that thou shouldest enter under my roof :
And the  Lord  gave Solomon wisdom , as he promised him : and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon  ; and they two made a league together .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la bat la ka kular bad u la ai ka jingstad ïa u Solomon . La don ka jingïasuk hapdeng u Hiram bad u Solomon , bad kine baroh ar ngut ki pynlong ka jingïateh lok .
U Joshua mynta u la tymmen bha . U Trai u ong ha u , Me la tymmen bha , hynrei dang buiñ ka jaka kaba dei ban ïohkynti .
translation.en: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years  ; and the  Lord  said unto him , Thou art old and stricken in years , and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed .

translation.kha: Kumno nga long U blem uba im , nga rah la ka kti bad nga smai ,
translation.en: For I lift up my hand to heaven , and say , I live for ever .
And the  Lord  said unto Moses and unto Aaron , Take to you handfuls of ashes of the furnace , and let Moses sprinkle it toward the heaven in the sight of Pharaoh .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u la ong ha u Moses bad u Aaron ,  Shim katto katne kham u dpei na ka lawar ding ; u Moses un kynting ïa u shajrong ha khmat u Pharaoh .

translation.en: And he gave some , apostles ; and some , prophets ; and some , evangelists ; and some , pastors and teachers ;
translation.kha: U la long ma u , uba  la ai ki jingai sngewbha ha u bynriew ;  u la thung katto katne ngut ban long ki apostol ; ïa kiwei , ki nongïathuhlypa ; ïa kiwei , ki nongïalap ; ïa kiwei pat , ki nongsharai balang bad ki nonghikai .
Naba kam ka jingïap ka la wan da uwei u Briew , ha kajuh ka rukom ka jingmihpat na ka jingïaiban ka wan da Uei u briew .
translation.en: For since by man came death , by man came also the resurrection of the dead .

translation.kha: kito bakha mane ïa u bad kiba leh ïa kaba dei ki long kiba la pdiang sngewbha da u , kam pher na kano ka jaitbynriew ki long .
translation.en: But in every nation he that feareth him , and worketh righteousness , is accepted with him .
The king spake , and said , Is not this great Babylon , that I have built for the house of the kingdom by the might of my power , and for the honour of my majesty ?
translation.kha: u la ong ,  Ha khmih katno khraw ka Babilon ka long ! Nga la tei ïa ka kum ka nongbah jong nga ban pyn-i ïa ka bor bad ka jingkhlaiñ jong nga , ka burom jong nga bad ka jinglong syiem jong nga .
Kin pynïap ïa me dara ken phad ïa me sha ka jingmihpat bashngain um .
translation.en: They shall bring thee down to the pit , and thou shalt die the deaths of them that are slain in the midst of the seas .

translation.kha: U Dabid u ïohknieh shihajar tylli ki kali ïapom jong u , hynñiew hajar nguid ki nongshong khuri , bad arphew hajar ngut ki shipai ïaid kjat . U buh ki kulai kat ngab biang na ka bynta shispah tylli ki katai ïabam bad u pyndkoh nala ïa kiwei pat .
translation.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots , and seven thousand horsemen , and twenty thousand footmen : David also houghed all the chariot horses , but reserved of them an hundred chariots .
And the wall of the city had twelve foundations , and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb .
translation.kha: Ïa ka kynroh jong ka nongbah la tei halor ki khat-ar tylli ki maw nongrim , kiba halor jong ki la thoh ïa ki kyrteng jong ki khat-ar ngut ki apostol jong U Khunlangbrot .
Phi kiba sniew eh , phi tip kumno ban ai kiei kai kiba bha ïa ki khun jong phi . Kaba katno tam ksaiñ , ba U kpu jong Phin uba ha bneng un ai keiñ kiei kiba bha ha kito kiba pang na u !
translation.en: If ye then , being evil , know how to give good gifts unto your children , how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him ?
Consider the work of God : for who can make that straight , which he hath made crooked ?
translation.kha: Pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la leh . Kumno keiñ uno uno un pynbeit ïa kaei kaba U Blei u la pynkdor .
Khynñiuh nga ong ha phi , ko Jakob , phi la kynroh . U Blei u khim khraw banbeiñ ïa ine uno u Briew .
translation.en: Behold , in this thou art not just : I will answer thee , that God is greater than man .

translation.kha: Hadien , wat hajan ka jingbitar u syiem ka la pnah , u ïai pyrkhat shaphang Kaei kaba ka Bashti ka la leh bad shaphang ka jingpynbna jong u pyrshah ïa ka .
translation.en: After these things , when the wrath of king Ahasuerus was appeased , he remembered Vashti , and what she had done , and what was decreed against her .

translation.kha: Te mynta , ma per , U Trai’ , nga ong ba phim shym la kohnguh ïa nga : phim shym la ai ka jinglorni ïa la ki na Israel . Kumta te , ngan ai ha phira ïa ka jinglaitluid : ka jingsyllad ban ïap da ka thma , ka jingpang , bad ka jingïathong . Ngan pynlong ïa kaweh pa kawei ka jaitbynriew ha ka pyrthei ngab sngewlehrain ïa kaei kaba nga leh ïa phin .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the  Lord   ; Ye have not hearkened unto me , in proclaiming liberty , every one to his brother , and every man to his neighbour : behold , I proclaim a liberty for you , saith the  Lord  , to the sword , to the pestilence , and to the famine  ; and I will make you to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth .
To whom he said , This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest  ; and this is the refreshing : yet they would not hear .
translation.kha: U la ai ka jingshongthait bad ka jingjahthait ïa phi baroh , hynrei phi kyntait ban shahshkor ïa u .
Katba ki dang wan , uwei pa uwei u sngewshyrkhei ; kawei pa kawei ka durkhmat ka sylla blad .
translation.en: Before their face the people shall be much pained : all faces shall gather blackness .
Then the chief captain came , and said unto him , Tell me , art thou a Roman ? He said , Yea .
translation.kha: Kumta u rangbah ai hukum u la leit sha u Paul bad u la kylli ïa u ,  Ïathuh ïa nga , hato me dei u traishnong ka Hima Rom ?   Ho-oid ,  la jubab u Paul .
To siew te , kaei kaba phin dei baneh siew ïa ki ; to siew sha ki ïa ki khajna shimet bad kiba dem ïa ki jingdon jingem jong Phi , bad to pyn-i ka jingburom malu to ai ka burom ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: Render therefore to all their dues : tribute to whom tribute is due ; custom to whom custom ; fear to whom fear ; honour to whom honour .

translation.kha: Nga la smai da ka kyrteng jong nga — U Trai u kren — ba kun kyrkhu kyrhai ïa me . Namar me la leh ïa kane , bad mem shym la tyngkai noh ïa la u khun marwei na nga ,
translation.en: And said , By myself have I sworn , saith the  Lord  , for because thou hast done this thing , and hast not withheld thy son , thine only son :

translation.kha: Pynïap ïa ki shipai jong ki baroh ! Mait ïa ki ! Ki briew ka Babilonia ki la kordit ! Ka por ka la poi ïa ki ban shad pynshitom !
translation.en: Slay all her bullocks  ; let them go down to the slaughter : woe unto them ! for their day is come , the time of their visitation .

translation.kha: Ka Sarah ka ong , U Blei u la wanpaw ka jingkmen bad ka jingrkhie ïa nga . Kat kiba ïohsngew ïa kane kin ïa-rkhie bad to .
translation.en: And Sarah said , God hath made me to laugh , so that all that hear will laugh with me .

translation.kha: Hattush la dei ki kah kiba la pynlong ïa me ban bitar , A Trai ! Hato la dei ka dulir kaba la pynlong ïa me ban bitar shwa ? Me shong kulai halor ki lyoh ; u lyoh ka erïong u la long ka kali ïapom jong me , mynba me la wallam jingpar ha la ki briew .
translation.en: Was the  Lord  displeased against the rivers ? was thine anger against the rivers ? was thy wrath against the sea , that thou didst ride upon thine horses and thy chariots of salvation ?

translation.kha: Dei hadien ba ki la wan mih na Jingtep bad mynba ki ne ha kata ka them ka sha mihngi na ka oh Jordan , marpyrshah ïa ka shnong Bethpeor , ba u ai ha ki ïa kine ki hukum . Kane ka long ha ka hima u Shibun u Syiem Amor , umbah synshar ha ka shnong Hesron . Mynba U Moses bad ki Israel ki la jop ïa u ynda ki la Mih na Ijipt .
translation.en: On this side Jordan , in the valley over against Beth–peor , in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites , who dwelt at Heshbon , whom Moses and the children of Israel smote , after they were come forth out of Egypt :
But if ye believe not his writings , how shall ye believe my words ?
translation.kha: Hynrei ba phim ngeit ïa kaei kaba u la thoh , kumno phi lah ban ngeit ïa kaei kaba nga ong ?

Ym dat mano mano ruh ba haka pun pyllew ïa lade na ka ban ïap lynti pynslem ïa ka sngi ka jingïaiban jong u . katai ka dei ka thma kaba ngi lah ban lait ; ngim Lah ban pyllait ïa lade da ka jingshukor .
translation.en: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit  ; neither hath he power in the day of death : and there is no discharge in that war  ; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it .

And the  Lord  spake unto Moses , Say unto Aaron , Take thy rod , and stretch out thine hand upon the waters of Egypt , upon their streams , upon their rivers , and upon their ponds , and upon all their pools of water , that they may become blood  ; and that there may be blood throughout all the land of Egypt , both in vessels of wood , and in vessels of stone .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Moses ,  Ong ïa u Aaron ban shim ïa la u diengduh bad ban rah ïa u halor ki wah , ki nur-um , bad ki pukri um baroh ha ka ri Ijipt . Ka um kan kylla snam , bad ha ka ri baroh kawei kan don ka snam , wat ha ki khiew dieng bad ki khiew maw ruh .
U Petros u dang ïai pyrshang ban shyieng aïu ka jingïohipaw ka kit jingtim , haba U Mynsiem u la ong , Ha Sngap ! Lai ngut ki rangbah ki ïadait ïa me .
translation.en: While Peter thought on the vision , the Spirit said unto him , Behold , three men seek thee .

translation.kha: Ynda ki pioneer batista ki la trei pura shisnem , ïa ki la ju pynrung kyrteng ha ka skul ba hynriew sngi kiba ju pynlong ha ka Ïing Hima ba jan hano .
translation.en: At the end of a regular pioneer’s first year of full-time service , he or she is enrolled in a six-day school that may be held at a nearby Kingdom Hall .

translation.kha: pynkyntang ha nga ïa uba la kha nyngkong baroh , namar katto uba la kha jingsuk napdeng ki Israel , la u briew ne u mrad , u erlangthari u jong ang .
translation.en: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn , whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel , both of man and of beast : it is mine .
And Judas Iscariot , one of the twelve , went unto the chief priests , to betray him unto them .
translation.kha: Te u Judas Iskariot , uwei na ki khat-ar ngut ki synran , u la mihnoh ban leit sha ki rangbah lyngdoh khnang ban shetkylla ïa U Jisu ha ki .

translation.en: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him  ; for they feared the people .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki nonghikai ka Hukum ki la sheptieng ïa u paidbah , bad kumta ki la pyrshang ban wad lad ban pynïap ïa U Jisu ha kaba jar jar .

Yn beh noh ïa ph na ka imlang ka sahlang u bynriew bad Phin shong phin sah bad ki mradkhlaw . Hynñiew snem phin bam phlang kum u masi dab , bad thiah ha bym don jingkah ei ei , ha kaba ka umjer sa hap halor Jong phi . Te phin pdiang ba U blang Berakhaïah thom Eh u ba-bang synshar ïa Baroh ki shiah ki briew , bad ba u lah ban ai ïa ki ha uno uno uba u jied .
translation.en: That they shall drive thee from men , and thy dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field , and they shall make thee to eat grass as oxen , and they shall wet thee with the dew of heaven , and seven times shall pass over thee , till thou know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men , and giveth it to whomsoever he will .

translation.kha: Wat na ka syndon kabu sha jngai , ki Briew jong nga kiba la sakma kin wallam ki jingainguh shwa nga .
translation.en: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants , even the daughter of my dispersed , shall bring mine offering .

And all the trees of the field shall know that I the  Lord  have brought down the high tree , have exalted the low tree , have dried up the green tree , and have made the dry tree to flourish : I the  Lord  have spoken and have done it .
translation.kha: Baroh ki dieng kin tip ba nga long U  Trai . Nga khet ïa ki dieng bajrong bad nga pynlong ïa ki dieng rit ban san jrong . Nga pynïap stai ïa ki dieng bajyrngam bad pynlong ïa ki dieng ba-tyrkhong ban kylla jyrngam . Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren . Ngan leh ïa kaei kaba nga la ong ba ngan leh .

translation.en: After him repaired Binnui the son of Henadad another piece , from the house of Azariah unto the turning of the wall , even unto the corner .
translation.kha: U Binnui , u khun jong u Henadad u tei ïa ka bynta kaba bud , naduh ka ïing u Asaraïah haduh ka dong jong ka kynroh .
Namar don uwei u kput , baroh na ngi , wat la ngi lama suiñ , I longkmie kawei ka met , naba sem baroh ngi ïoh bynta lem na ujuh u kdup .
translation.en: For we being many are one bread , and one body : for we are all partakers of that one bread .
For the  Lord  hath driven out from before you great nations and strong : but as for you , no man hath been able to stand before you unto this day .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la beh noh ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba khraw bad badonbor katba phi nang ïaid sha khmat , bad ym don mano mano ba la lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa phi .

Ki syiem ki la shna ïa ki phyllaw bad ki shawkad ïingsyiem jong ki marpyrshah ïa ki phyllaw bad ki shawkad jongngi ka Templ jong nga , ba kumta ka kein tang ka kynroh hapdeng jong ngi . Ki la pynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid jong nga da baroh kiei kiei naba ijli kiba ki la leh , bad kumta ha ka jingbat lad nga , nga la pynjot ïa ki .
translation.en: In their setting of their threshold by my thresholds , and their post by my posts , and the wall between me and them , they have even defiled my holy name by their abominations that they have committed : wherefore I have consumed them in mine anger .
But ye have not so learned Christ !
translation.kha: Hynrei kam long kaei kaba phi la nang shaphang U Khrist !

translation.en: And he said unto him , Thus saith the  Lord  , Because thou hast let go out of thy hand a man whom I appointed to utter destruction , therefore thy life shall go for his life , and thy people for his people .
translation.kha: Nangta u nongïathuhlypa u ong ha u syiem ,  Kane ka dei ka ktien U  Trai  : ‘ Namar ba me la shah ïa u briew ban lait phet ïa uba nga la hukum ban pynïap , men hap ban siew da la ka jingim , bad ïa ka kynhun shipai jong me yn pynjot namar ba la pyllait ïa ka kynhun shipai jong u ban lait phet .’

translation.en: The  Lord  hath been mindful of us : he will bless us  ; he will bless the house of Israel  ; he will bless the house of Aaron .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u kynmaw ïa ngi , bad un kyrkhu ïa ngi ; un kyrkhu ïa ki paid Israel bad ïa baroh ki lyngdoh jong U Blei .
Marah kumta hi u angel jong U Trai u la tied ïa u Herod , namar ba um khim ai burom ïa U Balei . La Bam ïa u da ki ksaiñ , bad u la ïa-ïap .
translation.en: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him , because he gave not God the glory : and he was eaten of worms , and gave up the ghost .

translation.kha: Katba U Jingsuk u dang bam ha ka ïing u Matthaïos , shibun ki nongmareh khajna bad kiwei pat kiba la shah kyntait ki la ïawan pynlang sheng bad U Jehu lem bad ki synran jyllang u ha ka miej bam .
translation.en: And it came to pass , as Jesus sat at meat in the house , behold , many publicans and sinners came and sat down with him and his disciples .

translation.kha: To kynmaw ïa ki jingïakhih u Moses u shakri jong sa , ki aiñ bad ki hukum Kiba de la ai ha u ha u Lum Sinai na ka bynta ki paid Israel barieh ban kohnguh .
translation.en: Remember ye the law of Moses my servant , which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel , with the statutes and judgments .

And the letters were sent by posts into all the king s provinces , to destroy , to kill , and to cause to perish , all Jews , both young and old , little children and women , in one day , even upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month , which is the month Adar , and to take the spoil of them for a prey .
translation.kha: Ki nongrah-khubor ki la rah ïa kane ka jingpynbna sha kawei pa kawei ka probins jong ka hima . Ka don ki jingbthah ba tang ha kawei ka sngi , ka sngi kaba khatlai jong u Adar , ïa baroh ki Jiw — samla bad tymmen , kynthei bad khynnah — dei ban pynïap . Ïa ki dei ban pynïap khlem jingisynei bad ba ïa ki jingdon jingem jong ki dei ban shim noh .
( Ki Israel ki iphuh leit sha ki Philistia ban Pha thaw ïa ki nar lyngkor , ki ñiangthohlieh , ki shikatdei , bad ki rashi jongki ki ;
translation.en: But all the Israelites went down to the Philistines , to sharpen every man his share , and his coulter , and his axe , and his mattock .

translation.kha: Namar ngi tip uei uta uba la noh , Ngan sa pynhiarkput , tun siew kylliang ; bad uba la ong ruh , U Trai un bishar ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: For we know him that hath said , Vengeance belongeth unto me , I will recompense , saith the Lord . And again , The Lord shall judge his people .
That which is far off , and exceeding deep , who can find it out ?
translation.kha: Kumno uno uno un shem aïu ka jingim ka mut ? Ka long kaba jylliew eh ïa ngi , kaba eh than ban sngewthuh .

translation.en: Likewise , the way we appear at meetings shows our esteem for “the Judge of all the earth ,” Jehovah God , and for the place where we worship him . —Genesis 18 :25 .
translation.kha: Kumjuh ruh , ka rukom riam jong ngi ha ki jingïalang ka pyni ba ngi burom ïa “U Nongbishar ka pyrthei baroh kawei ,” U Blei Jehobah , bad ïa ka jaka kaba ngi mane ïa u . —Jenesis 18 :25 .

translation.en: Thou hast made us as the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people .
translation.kha: Me la pynlong ïa ngi ka kynton jakhlia jong ka pyrthei .

translation.en: This title then read many of the Jews : for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city : and it was written in Hebrew , and Greek , and Latin .
translation.kha: Shibun ki briew ki la pule ïa ka , namar ka jaka ha kaba la sahnarphna ïa U Jisu kam da jngai na ka nongbah . Ka jingthoh ka la long ha ki ktien Hebru , Latin bad Grik .

translation.en: And the border was drawn thence , and compassed the corner of the sea southward , from the hill that lieth before Beth–horon southward  ; and the goings out thereof were at Kirjath–baal , which is Kirjath–jearim , a city of the children of Judah : this was the west quarter .
translation.kha: Nangta u khun sha kawei pat ka liang , da kaba phai shathie na ka liang sepngi jong uta u lum bad u suh shaduh ka Kiriath Baal ( lane ka Kiriath Jearim ) , kaba dei jong ka jait Judah . Une u dei u pud uba shaphang sepngi .

translation.en: And the king said unto him , Turn aside , and stand here . And he turned aside , and stood still .
translation.kha: Ïeng hangto ,  u syiem u ong ha u ; bad u la leit shajrong bad ïeng hangta .
U syiem u noh ha u Jakob , I pa jong phi bad ki Heshmon ki para jong phi ki la wan sha phi , ka ri Ijipt ka long ka jong ki .
translation.en: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph , saying , Thy father and thy brethren are come unto thee :

translation.kha: U pynlong ïa ka khñiot basboh ban kylla ri khlaw Mluh namar ka jingbymman jong kito kiba shnong hangta .
translation.en: A fruitful land into barrenness , for the wickedness of them that dwell therein .

translation.kha: U Jehu u mih na Jesreel ban leit sha Samaria . Ha lynti , ha ka jaka ba la khot Ka Jakeh Sah ki Nongap Langbrot ,
translation.en: And he arose and departed , and came to Samaria . And as he was at the shearing house in the way ,

translation.kha: Haba u Ahithophel u la ïohi ba ïa ka jingaiei jingman jong u ym shym la pdiang , u la teh jin ïa la ka kada bad u otsher phai noh sha la shongneh . Ishod u la dep pynbeit ïa la ki ki ïing kam sem , u la sdien phasi ïa lade . La tep ïa u ha ka jingtep ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed , he saddled his ass , and arose , and gat him home to his house , to his city , and put his household in order , and hanged himself , and died , and was buried in the sepulchre of his father .

translation.kha: Hynrei mynta per ong ha phi : wat pyndonkam ïa kano kano ka jingsmai lehbha phi pynlong ka jingkular . “Wat sakma da ka bneng , naba ka longïng ka khet jong U Bela ;
translation.en: But I say unto you , Swear not at all  ; neither by heaven  ; for it is God s throne :

translation.kha: Ko Belteshassar , u rangbah jong ki nongtei kupar , nga tip ba u mynsiem jong ki blei bakhuid u don hapoh jong me , bad ba me peiphang ïa ki jingmaïan baroh . Kane ka erlangthari ka jingphohsniew jong ar . To ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka .
translation.en: O Belteshazzar , master of the magicians , because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in thee , and no secret troubleth thee , tell me the visions of my dream that I have seen , and the interpretation thereof .

translation.kha: Ïa nga la thab ha kaba sdang eh , ha kaba nyngkong , shuwa ba ka pyrthei kan sdang .
translation.en: I was set up from everlasting , from the beginning , or ever the earth was .

And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place , until he come out , and have made an atonement for himself , and for his household , and for all the congregation of Israel .
translation.kha: Naduh ka por ba u Aaron u leit rung sha ka Jaka Kaba Khuid Tam ban pyndep ïa ka rukom lehniam kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid haduh ba un da mih nangta , ym bit ïano ïano ban don hapoh ka Ïingjaiñ . Ynda u la pyndep ïa kata ka rukom lehniam na ka bynta ïa lade , na ka bynta la ka longïing , bad na ka bynta u paidbah baroh ,

myntor wat ai ba u Mahseïah un shukor ïa phi lane ïalam bakla ïa ph kumno . “Wat ngeit ïa u ! Ym khong blei jong kano kan ka hima-patsha uba la lah Ban pyllait ïa la ki briew na uno uno u pynshah ka Assyria . Kumta da kaba thikna une U Blei jong phi un ym lah ban pyllait im ïa phi !
translation.en: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you , nor persuade you on this manner , neither yet believe him : for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand , and out of the hand of my fathers : how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand ?

translation.kha: Bad kumta ka la long ba ka balang ha kylleng ka Judia , Galilaïa Bad Semaraim ka la ïohi shongsuk . Da ka jingïarap jong U Mynhyndai Bakhuid la pynshaitbor ïa ka bad ka la nangto san ha ka jingbun briew , haba ka ïaid ha ka jingsheptieng ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria , and were edified  ; and walking in the fear of the Lord , and in the comfort of the Holy Ghost , were multiplied .

translation.kha: Ïasam lang ïa ki jingbamsap jong phi bad kiba thngan , bad ai jaka sah ïa kiba hep ki bym don ïing . Ai jingpynnang ïa tun ki bym don jaiñ ban phong , bad wat kyntait ban ïarap ïa la ki jong ki ba-ha-ïing .
translation.en: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry , and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house ? when thou seest the naked , that thou cover him  ; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh ?

translation.kha: bad u la kren ïa Kanneh ka jingïathuhlypa : Ka khubor u Baalah u khun jyllang u Beor , Ki ktien jong u briew uba lah ban ïohi shai ,
translation.en: And he took up his parable , and said , Balaam the son of Beor hath said , and the man whose eyes are open hath said :

translation.kha: shuwa ba U blem un thaw ïa ka khyndew bad ïa ki pyntha jong ka , ne waiñ shi khem ka khyndew kambah nyngkong .
translation.en: While as yet he had not made the earth , nor the fields , nor the highest part of the dust of the world .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh naduh mynnin U Khun U Beeroth un shongsuk ha ka liang kamon lad U Blei Badonbor Baroh .
translation.en: Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God .

translation.kha: Ngi ïew jingshlur haba ngi ïohsngew ïa ki jingjia ba la mad da kito kiba la jop ïa ki jingkah shun im kum ki Khristan ha Kin ki sngi ba lanot .
translation.en: We are encouraged when we hear the experiences of those who are successfully meeting the challenge of living as Christians in these difficult times .

translation.kha: ‘ Ha khmih’ u la bteng , ‘ Baroh ki langsohmoh uba ïa-pakor ki longkmie kiba thohshuid , kba thohbria , bad kiba thohbroin . Nga pynlong ïa kane banbeiñ jia namar nga la ïohi ïa barhem kambah u Laban u la leh ïa me .
translation.en: And he said , Lift up now thine eyes , and see , all the rams which leap upon the cattle are ringstraked , speckled , and grisled : for I have seen all that Laban doeth unto thee .

translation.kha: Ko Israel , ym don u blei uba kum U Blei jong phi , Uba ïaid ha ka burom ha sahit bneng , Uba ïawad ha ki lyoh ban wan ïarap ïa pa’ .
translation.en: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun , who rideth upon the heaven in thy help , and in his excellency on the sky .
So Saul died , and his three sons , and all his house died together .
translation.kha: Da kumta u Saul bad lai ngut ki khun shynrang jong u baroh ki la ïap lang bad ym don uba na ki khun ki ksiew jong u kiba ïoh ban synshar .
Pha la lehsbun shikatdei eh badno phi la pyllait im ïa nga . Hynrei ki lum ki jngi paila ïa nga ; ka jingjynjar kan lap ïa nga , bad nga lah ban ïap nep shuwa shun peh shata .
translation.en: Behold now , thy servant hath found grace in thy sight , and thou hast magnified thy mercy , which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life  ; and I cannot escape to the mountain , lest some evil take me , and I die :

translation.kha: Ki pyrta ïa u Loit bad kylli ïa u , Hangno kito ki rangbah bakha wan sah bad me ha kane ka miet ? Pynmih ïa ki shabar ! Ki shynrang jong ka Simon ki kwah don ïathiah shongkha bad ki .
translation.en: And they called unto Lot , and said unto him , Where are the men which came in to thee this night ? bring them out unto us , that we may know them .

translation.kha: Nangta sa shim ïa ka samla kaba phi itynnat tam sad pynlong ïa ka , ka mahadei ha ka jaka jong ka Bashti . U syiem u la pyrkhat ba kane ka long ka jingai jingmut kaba bha , kumta u la jingpdiang ïa kata .
translation.en: And let the maiden which pleaseth the king be queen instead of Vashti . And the thing pleased the king  ; and he did so .

translation.kha: Nga , la long kata ka jingkhang . Uno uno uba rang shapoh da nga un ïoh im ; kin ïohrung shapoh bad mih shabar bad shem ïa ka jaka bam phlang .
translation.en: I am the door : by me if any man enter in , he shall be saved , and shall go in and out , and find pasture .

translation.kha: U la pyndonkam ïa ka bor synshar baïar jong u mradkhlaw uba nyngkong ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong u . U la pynbor ïa ka pyrthei bad ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka ban manla ïa u mradkhlaw ibha nyngkong , uba ka jingmynsaw jong u ka la ïohkhiah .
translation.en: And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him , and causeth the earth and them which dwell therein to worship the first beast , whose deadly wound was healed .

translation.kha: Ka ïing jong pha ka long ka duriaw . Ki nongot jong pha ki la shna ïa pha kum ka liengbah kaba itynnat ;
translation.en: Thy borders are in the midst of the seas , thy builders have perfected thy beauty .

translation.kha: Khebar ha ki khlaw ki pah kum ki mrad bad ki ïa-thngian lang hapoh ki lawlynnong .
translation.en: Among the bushes they brayed  ; under the nettles they were gathered together .

But Jehoshabeath , the daughter of the king , took Joash the son of Ahaziah , and stole him from among the king s sons that were slain , and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber . So Jehoshabeath , the daughter of king Jehoram , the wife of Jehoiada the priest , ( for she was the sister of Ahaziah , ) hid him from Athaliah , so that she slew him not .
translation.kha: U Ahasaïah u don kawei ka para ar kmie , ka Jehosheba , kaba shongkurim ïa u lyngdoh uba kyrteng u Jehoïada . Da kaba buhrieh ïa u , ka la pyllait im ïa u na ka jingshah pynïap ha ki kti jong ka Athalaïah .

translation.en: Correct thy son , and he shall give thee rest  ; yea , he shall give delight unto thy soul .
translation.kha: Sneng pynbeit ïa la u khun bad phi lah ban sngewsarong borabor ïa u . Un ym long daw ïa phi ban shah lehrain .

translation.en: And they had hair as the hair of women , and their teeth were as the teeth of lions .
translation.kha: U shñiuh jong ki u long kum u shñiuh kynthei , ki bniat jong ki , ki long kum ki bniat sing .

translation.en: Wherefore I pray you to take some meat : for this is for your health : for there shall not an hair fall from the head of any of you .

translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym beh noh ïa ki Kano kiba shong ha Geser ; kumin ki Kanaan ki la shong la sah hapdeng ki Ephraim hapoh ken ka sngi , hynrei la pynpur ïa ki ïa-ban trei kum ki mraw .
translation.en: And they drave not out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer : but the Canaanites dwell among the Ephraimites unto this day , and serve under tribute .
Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Behold , I will save my people from the east country , and from the west country  ;

To ïai-ong ïa kine ki ktien ha ka jingïaroh ïa U Trai , ma phi baroh ïa kiba u la pynim .
translation.en: Let the redeemed of the  Lord  say so , whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy  ;

translation.kha: U Jisu u la longing phai pat sharud ka duriaw Galilaïa . U paidbah u la waiñ shuh u bad u la sdang ban hikai ïa ki .
translation.en: And he went forth again by the sea side  ; and all the multitude resorted unto him , and he taught them .
He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign , and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem .

And cast him out of the city , and stoned him : and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man s feet , whose name was Saul .
translation.kha: Ki sakhi ki la iehnoh ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsumar u samla uba kyrteng u Saul .

translation.en: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you , do ye even so to them : for this is the law and the prophets .
translation.kha: Leh ïa kiwei ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ïa ki ba kin leh na ka bynta jong phi : Kane ka long ka jingmut jong ka Hukum u Moses bad jong ki jinghikai ki nongïathuhlypa .

U Trai u ong , Ko khun u bariew , ki briew jong me ki ïakhun shaphang jongnga me haba ki ïakynduh hajan ki kynriah ka nongbet ne ha ki lynti hajan jingkhang ki ïing jong ki . Ki ïa-ong para ma ki , ‘ Ïa ngin ïalaw bad sngap ka ktien aïu kaba wan na U Trai mynta .’
translation.en: Also , thou son of man , the children of thy people still are talking against thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses , and speak one to another , every one to his brother , saying , Come , I pray you , and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the  Lord .

translation.kha: Nangta u syiem Serksis u kylli ïa ka Esther , ka mahadei , Mano ba nud ban leh kum ïa kata kaei kiei ? Uei uta u brai ?
translation.en: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen , Who is he , and where is he , that durst presume in his heart to do so ?
Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground , and opened every man his sack .
translation.kha: Kumta ki pynhiar kloi kloi ïa la ki byrni ha madan , bad uwei pa uwei na ki u plied ïa la ka byrni .
U Jisu u la leit lyngba ki nongbah bad ki nongrit , u da hikai ïa ki briew malade u da thew ïa la ka lynti sha Jerusalem .
translation.en: And he went through the cities and villages , teaching , and journeying toward Jerusalem .

translation.kha: U syiem Joram u hukum , Pynkhreh ka kali ïapom jong nga . ianga la pynkhreh , ma u bad u syiem Ahasaïah ki mihnoh mar la ka kali ïam pun wait ïakynduh ïa u Jehu . Ki ïakynduh ïa u ha ka lyngkha kabu la ju long ka jong u Naboth .
translation.en: And Joram said , Make ready . And his chariot was made ready . And Joram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Judah went out , each in his chariot , and they went out against Jehu , and met him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite .

translation.kha: Nangta ki nongshahkhot sngewkwah jong u Adonijah ki la pyrshing , bad baroh ki la ïeng joit malade leit noh , uwei uwei ha la ka lynnong .
translation.en: And all the guests that were with Adonijah were afraid , and rose up , and went every man his way .
Jesus saith to him ,  He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet , but is clean every whit : and ye are clean , but not all .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ,  Uno uno uba la dep sum u long uba la khuid bha bad um donkam ban da sait ïa lade , lait noh ïa la ki kjat . Baroh na phi , phi long kiba khuid — baroh lait noh uwei .

Haba ki paid Israel ki la ïohsngew ïa ka jingrai jong u Solomon , ki la dap da ka jingñiewburom bakhraw ïa u , namar ki tip hangta ba U Blei u la ai ha u ka jingstad ban pynbeit ïa ki jingïashongkha ha ka hok .
translation.en: And all Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged  ; and they feared the king : for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him , to do judgment .

translation.kha: Haba shah khñiot ka jingkyrmen , ka dohnud ruh ka shah khyndew , hynmen ka jingurlong jngai ka jingkhmih lynti ka pynpdang ïa phi da ka jingkmen .
translation.en: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick : but when the desire cometh , it is a tree of life .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la ong ïa ki , Sumar bha , bad kdew ai ïano ïaineh ban shukor ïa phi .
translation.en: And Jesus answering them began to say ,  Take heed lest any man deceive you :
For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine  ; and ye say , He hath a devil .
translation.kha: U Ïoannis u Nongpynbaptis u la wan , bad u la shahjingit bad um dih waiñ , bad phi ong , ‘ U don u ksuid hapoh jong u !’

Hynrei ka lieng ka la tyngkhuh ïa ka jaka shyiap bad ka la sangeh ; ka byndi ba shwa khmat Jong ka lieng ka la shat bad kur lah ban khih , Katba ka bynta ba shadien ka la shah pynpait lyngkhot lyngkha ha ki jingtah phyllung bashyrkhei .
translation.en: And falling into a place where two seas met , they ran the ship aground  ; and the forepart stuck fast , and remained unmoveable , but the hinder part was broken with the violence of the waves .

And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah , which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel , that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria , and besieged it .
translation.kha: Ha ka snem kaba saw jong ka jingsynshar u Hesekaïah — kaba long ka snem kaba hynñiew jong ka jingsynshar u Syiem Hoshea ha Israel — u Shalmaneser u patsha ka Assyria u tur ïaleh ïa ka Israel bad kerkut ïa ka Samaria .

translation.en: I will declare thy righteousness , and thy works  ; for they shall not profit thee .
translation.kha: Phi pyrkhat ba kaei kaba phi leh ka long kaba dei , hynrei ngan pynpaw ïa ki jingleh jong phi , bad ki bleithaw jong phi kin ym lah ban ïarap ei ei ïa phi .

translation.en: And the third row a ligure , an agate , and an amethyst .
translation.kha: u Turkwois , u Agate , bad u Amethyst ha ka kyrdon kaba lai ;

translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  Forbid him not : for he that is not against us is for us .
translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa u bad ïa kiwei pat ki synran ,  namar uno uno u bym pyrshah ïa phi u long ha ka liang jong phi .

translation.en: Son of man , they that inhabit those wastes of the land of Israel speak , saying , Abraham was one , and he inherited the land : but we are many  ; the land is given us for inheritance .
translation.kha: Ko khun u briew ,  u la ong  Ki briew kiba shong ha ki nongbah ba la pynjot jong ka ri Israel ki ong : ‘ U Abraham u long tang uwei u briew , bad u la ïoh ïa ka ri baroh kawei . Ngi ïadon bun ngut , kumta mynta ka ri ka dei ka jong ngi .’

translation.en: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour , especially they who labour in the word and doctrine .
translation.kha: Ki nongsharai balang    kiba trei bha kum ki nongïalam ki dei hok ban ïohpdiang ar shah ïa ka jingsiew , khamtam kito kiba trei jur ha ka jingïalap bad jinghikai .
Ha kajuh ka por , ngan ap ha ka jaka skum ïa ka Wah ha ka ri khlaw tad haduh ba len da ïoh khubor na phi .
translation.en: See , I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness , until there come word from you to certify me .

translation.kha: U Trai u la klun ha nga ,
translation.en: Moreover the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,
And the people , when they knew it , followed him : and he received them , and spake unto them of the kingdom of God , and healed them that had need of healing .
translation.kha: Haba ki paidbah ki la ïohsngew shaphang kata , ki la bud ïa u . U la pdiang sngewbha ïa ki , u la kren ha ki shaphang ka Hima U Blei , bad u la pynkhiah ïa kito kiba donkam ïa ka .
Hynrei mynta , baroh kiba klun ïa phi kin shat klun , mala ïa baroh’ ki nongshun jong phi yn rah nep kum ki koidi . Ïa borbah kiba banbeiñ ïa phi yn banbeiñ , bad ïa baroh katba lute ïa phi yn lute .
translation.en: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured  ; and all thine adversaries , every one of them , shall go into captivity  ; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil , and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey .
And he said , Put thine hand into thy bosom again . And he put his hand into his bosom again  ; and plucked it out of his bosom , and , behold , it was turned again as his other flesh .
translation.kha: Nangta U  Trai  u ong ,  Bsuh biang ïa kato ka kti jong me shapoh ka jaiñkup jong me .  U ruh u leh kumta , bad haba u sei ïa ka , u ïohi ba ka la koit pat , kumba ka long mynshuwa .
U syiemsad Solomon u shwa arspah tylli ki stieh kiba heh , ïa katai pa kawei la sop da ka ksiar ba la shoh kaba khia kumba hynriew kilo ,
translation.en: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold : six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target .
Search the scriptures  ; for in them ye think ye have eternal life : and they are they which testify of me .
translation.kha: Phi pule ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , namar phi pyrkhat ba ha ki phin shem ïa ka jingim bymjukut . Bad kine hi ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki kren shaphang jong nga !

translation.en: If thou hast any thing to say , answer me : speak , for I desire to justify thee .
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phi don ei ei ban ong , to ai ba ngan sngew ïa kata ; ngan pdiang da kaba sngewbha lada kaba phi ong ka long kaba dei .
Nangta u Moses u khublei ïakhlad malu u Jethro , bad u Jethro u leit peiñ pat sha la ïing .
translation.en: And Moses let his father in law depart  ; and he went his way into his own land .

translation.kha: Ki la ïalumlang ha khmat u Moses sad u Aaron bad ki ainong ha ki , “Phi la leh sapphir palat ! Baroh ki dkhot jongnga ka kynhun ki long ki jong U Trai , bad U Trai u don lem badno ngi baher . Balei te Moses me buh ïa lade uba halor lad ka kynjah jong U Trai ?
translation.en: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron , and said unto them , Ye take too much upon you , seeing all the congregation are holy , every one of them , and the  Lord  is among them : wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the  Lord  ?

translation.kha: Ki snem jong nga ki la nang ïaid mynta , bad per ïaid ha ka lynti lai lah peiñ dien shuh .
translation.en: When a few years are come , then I shall go the way whence I shall not return .

And when the Philistines heard that the children of Israel were gathered together to Mizpah , the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel . And when the children of Israel heard it , they were afraid of the Philistines .
translation.kha: Haba ki Philistia ki ïohsngew ba ki Israel ki la ïalumlang ha Mispah , kita ki san ngut ki syiem Philistia ki leit kiew bad la ki briew ban tur ïaleh ïa ki , bad ki Israel ki la ïohsngew ïa kata bad ki la sheptieng ,
Ai ha ki Israel ïa kine ki hukum harum :
translation.en: Now these are the judgments which thou shalt set before them .

I am come into my garden , my sister , my spouse : I have gathered my myrrh with my spice  ; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey  ; I have drunk my wine with my milk : eat , O friends  ; drink , yea , drink abundantly , O beloved .
translation.kha: Katno phi long kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ! Katno ki khmat jong phi hapoh ka jingtap khmat ki phyrnai itynnat da ka jingieit . U shñiuh jong phi u shad kum ka kynhun ki blang kiba hiar sha trai ki lum Gilead .

translation.en: Though they bring up their children , yet will I bereave them , that there shall not be a man left : yea , woe also to them when I depart from them !
translation.kha: Hynrei wat la ki ïoh pynheh pynsan ïa la ki khun , ngan shim noh ïa ki bad ngan ym pynsah im uwei ruh . Haba ngan iehnoh noh ïa kine ki briew , kiei kiei kiba shyrkhei kin wan jia ha ki .

translation.en: Be not afraid of sudden fear , neither of the desolation of the wicked , when it cometh .
translation.kha: Phin ym donkam ban khuslai ïa ka jingpynjot kaba wan kynsan , kum kaba wan ha ki riewbymman kum ka  erïong .

Ha kadei pa kawei ka nongbah bad pun , hangno jongno ba la pule ïa ka jingpynbna u syiem , ki Jiw ki pynlong ki shuti lymne pyntud bad ki jingkhawai sngewkwah bad jingkmen . Ha ka jingshisha , bun kiei ki bariew ki la kylla Jiw , namar mynta ki la sheptieng ïa ki .
translation.en: And in every province , and in every city , whithersoever the king s commandment and his decree came , the Jews had joy and gladness , a feast and a good day . And many of the people of the land became Jews  ; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them .
Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe  ; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance .
translation.kha: bad kata ka bri ka khyndew kan ym leit na kawei ka jait sha kawei pat . Kawei pa kawei ka jait kan ïai bat ïa la ka bri ka khyndew .

translation.en: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh , the abomination of Moab , in the hill that is before Jerusalem , and for Molech , the abomination of the children of Ammon .
translation.kha: Halor u lum uba sha mihngi na Jerusalem u tei ka jaka mane ïa u Khemosh , u blei ba-ijli jong ki Moab , bad ka jaka mane ïa u Molekh , u blei ba-ijli jong ki Ammon .

U Jisu u la jop , A Katto phi ki briew phi long ki bymngeit malu bakla ! Sa katno ar dei ban law bad Phi ? Sa katno nga dei ban don bad phi ? Hangta u la ong ha iathuh u bynriew , Wallam ïa u khun jong me hangne .
translation.en: And Jesus answering said ,  O faithless and perverse generation , how long shall I be with you , and suffer you ? Bring thy son hither .

translation.kha: haba bahynñiew tylli ki masi kynthei kiba sngaid bad uba lup ki la wan miej na ka wah bad ki shang ban ïabam phlang .
translation.en: And , behold , there came up out of the river seven kine , fatfleshed and well favoured  ; and they fed in a meadow :

translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba U Trai U Balei jong Phi u la pynlang ïa ka um jong ka Jordan na ka bynta jong phi hapoh ba phin da la jam sha shiliang , kumba u la pynrngad ïa ka Duriaw Basaw na ka bniat jong ngi .
translation.en: For the  Lord  your God dried up the waters of Jordan from before you , until ye were passed over , as the  Lord  your God did to the Red sea , which he dried up from before us , until we were gone over :
And they had then a notable prisoner , called Barabbas .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don uwei u koidi uba pawnam uba kyrteng u Jisu Barabbas .

Te nga la ong ha u Sedekaïah ba U Trai badonburom Baroh , U Blei ki Israel , u la ong , Lada phi pyndem ha ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong u syiem ka Babilonia , ïa ka jingim jong phi yn tyngkai , bad ïa kane ka nongbah yn ym thang noh . Ïa phi bad ïa ka longïing jong phi yn pyllait im .
translation.en: Then said Jeremiah unto Zedekiah , Thus saith the  Lord  , the God of hosts , the God of Israel  ; If thou wilt assuredly go forth unto the king of Babylon s princes , then thy soul shall live , and this city shall not be burned with fire  ; and thou shalt live , and thine house :

translation.kha: Ki nongai Moab ki ong ha ki nongriam jongki ki Midian , Kenan ka kynhun shen kan sa pynjot ïa kaei Kiei baroh kiba don sawdong jong ngi , kum u masi wahbah bam phlangïap ha ka pyntha phlangïap .
translation.en: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian , Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us , as the ox licketh up the grass of the field . And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka khubor jong U Terah : U la rai pynshitom ïa ka ri Hadrakh bad ïa ka nongbah Damaskos . Ym tang ki joit Israel hynrei ka nongbah Syria ruh ka long ka jong U Trai’ .
translation.en: The burden of the word of the  Lord  in the land of Hadrach , and Damascus shall be the rest thereof : when the eyes of man , as of all the tribes of Israel , shall be toward the  Lord .
Have the gates of death been opened unto thee ? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death ?
translation.kha: Don mano mano ba la pyn-i ha me ïa ki khyrdop kiba ap phira ïa ka pyrthei ba-dum jong kiba ïap ?

translation.en: For , lo , I will call all the families of the kingdoms of the north , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall come , and they shall set every one his throne at the entering of the gates of Jerusalem , and against all the walls thereof round about , and against all the cities of Judah .
translation.kha: namar nga khot ïa baroh ki jaitbynriew ha ka phang bashatei ban ïawan . Ki syiem jong ki kin pynïeng ïa ki khet jong ki ha ki khyrdop jong ka Jerusalem bad sawdong ïa ki kynroh jong ka bad ruh sawdong ïa kiwei pat ki nongbah jong ka Judah .
Ha Kawei ka sner , u Ishmael ïa uba ka Hagar ka nong Ijipt ka la kha na ka bynta u Abraham , u dang ïalehkai bad u Isak , u khun jong ka Sarah .
translation.en: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian , which she had born unto Abraham , mocking .
It is not good to accept the person of the wicked , to overthrow the righteous in judgment .
translation.kha: Kam long kaba dei ban pynksan ïa uba la rem bad ban khang ïa uba lui lui na kaba ïohpdiang ïa ka jingbishar hok .

translation.en: Neither be ye idolaters , as were some of them ; as it is written , The people sat down to eat and drink , and rose up to play .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  U paidbah u la shong ha ka jingkhawai kaba la kylla long ka jingïadih buaid bad ka jingleh nuti .
Te ken long ki Briew jong nga , malade tun long U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: And they shall be my people , and I will be their God :

translation.kha: U Blei u la peit lyndet ïa ki por haba ki briew kim shym la iathuh ïa u , hynrei mynta u lei ïa ki baroh kylleng sawdong ban phad nala ïa ki lynti bymman jong ki .
translation.en: And the times of this ignorance God winked at  ; but now commandeth all men every where to repent :
But Jesus said ,  Forbid him not : for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name , that can lightly speak evil of me .
translation.kha: Wat pyrshang ban pynsangeh ïa u ,  U Jisu u la ong ïa ki ,  namar ym don uba leh ïa ka kambah ha ka kyrteng jong nga , ba shen hadien un ong kiei kiei kiba sniew shaphang jong nga .

translation.en: And I will bring them out from the people , and gather them from the countries , and will bring them to their own land , and feed them upon the mountains of Israel by the rivers , and in all the inhabited places of the country .
translation.kha: Ngan wallam noh ïa ki na ki ri nongwei , ngan lumlang ïa ki , bad ngan wallam biang ïa ki sha ka ri jong ki hi , ngan ïalam biang ïa ki sha ki lumbah bad ki wahduid ka Israel bad ngan bsa ïa ki ha ki jaka bam phlang kiba sngewtynnat .

Ha Katai kajuh ka snem , ha u bnai uba san jong ka snem Kaba saw ba u Sekharaïah u lama syiem , u Hananaïah u khun jong u Asshurim , u nongïathuhlypa na ka shnong Gibeon , u la kren ha nga ha ka Templ . Ha ka jingdon ryngkat jrong ki lyngdoh bad ki paidbah u la ong ïa nga
translation.en: And it came to pass the same year , in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah , in the fourth year , and in the fifth month , that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet , which was of Gibeon , spake unto me in the house of the  Lord  , in the presence of the priests and of all the people , saying ,

translation.kha: bad hikai ïa ki ban jongu ha kiei kiei baroh kba nga la hukum ïa phi . Bad ngan ïai don ryngkat lem bad Phin , haduh kaba kut ka Ïa .
