translation.en: Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you : and , lo , I am with you alway , even unto the end of the world . Amen .

translation.kha: Deborah , ki nongrit jong ka Isaia ki sah kynjah , Ki ïeng thylli tad Ynda pha wan , Pha wanrah kum ka kmie ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: The inhabitants of the villages ceased , they ceased in Israel , until that I Deborah arose , that I arose a mother in Israel .

translation.kha: Nga ïai-ong ha ailad ba nga dei Ban kren , ba ma phi kiba la kham rangbah phi dei ban ïasam lem ïa la ka jingstad .
translation.en: I said , Days should speak , and multitude of years should teach wisdom .

translation.kha: To ïong ïit ïa la ki lynti bad phai pat sha U Trai .
translation.en: Let us search and try our ways , and turn again to the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ka thma kan khie ha ki nongbah jong ki , bad kane pynkheiñ ïa ki khyrdop ka nongbah . Kin pynjot ïa ki briew jong nga namar ki leh ïa kaei kaban ma ki hi ki pyrkhat ba ka long kaba bha tam .
translation.en: And the sword shall abide on his cities , and shall consume his branches , and devour them , because of their own counsels .

translation.kha: Hynrei u la jubab ïa la u kpa , ‘ Ha khmih , baroh kine ki snem nga la trei kum u mraw na ka bynta jong phi , bad ngam pat ju saitlah ïa ki lawlynnong jong phi . Phi la ai aïu ïa nga ? Ym don wat tang kawei ka blang na ka bynta jong nga ban ïakhawai bad ki paralok jong nga !
translation.en: And he answering said to his father , Lo , these many years do I serve thee , neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment : and yet thou never gavest me a kid , that I might make merry with my friends :

And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead , the son of Machir , the son of Manasseh , of the families of the sons of Joseph , came near , and spake before Moses , and before the princes , the chief fathers of the children of Israel :
translation.kha: Ki khlieh jong ki longïing longsem ha ka kur u Gilead , u khun jong u Makhir u ksiew jong u Manasseh u khun jong u Joseph , ki la leit sha u Moses bad kiwei pat ki nongïalam .
Ki ktien jong me ki la pynlong bad pynwandur ïa nga , malu mynta tun kijuh ki kti ki pynjot ïa nga .
translation.en: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about  ; yet thou dost destroy me .
And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas .
translation.kha: Kumta ki la ïaid beit lyngba ka Mysia bad ki la leit sha Troas .

translation.en: Neither did we eat any man s bread for nought ; but wrought with labour and travail night and day , that we might not be chargeable to any of you :
translation.kha: Ngim shym la pdiang ïa ka jingkyrshan jongno jongno khlem da siewdor ïa ka . Pynban , ngi la trei bad minot thop ; ngi ïai trei mynsngi bad mynmiet khnang ban ym long ka jingbankhia ïano ïano na phi .

translation.en: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the  Lord  his God for the wars which were about him on every side , until the  Lord  put them under the soles of his feet .
translation.kha: Phi tip ba namar ki thma ba ïai khie , u Dabid , u kpa jong nga u la dei ban ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki ri jong ki nongshun kiba sawdong jong u , um shym la lah ban tei ka templ na ka bynta ka jingmane ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong u tad haduh ba u la ai ha u ka jingjop halor ki nongshun jong u baroh .
U Mamre nabar ki shipai jong u ki mihnoh na Gibbethon bad leit kerkut ïa ka Tirsah .
translation.en: And Omri went up from Gibbethon , and all Israel with him , and they besieged Tirzah .

translation.kha: Na kawei pateng ka liang jong ka Sarid , u pud u suhjer shaphang mihngi sha u pud jong ka Khisloth Tabor , nangta sha Bethbarah bad artet haduh japung .
translation.en: And turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrising unto the border of Chisloth–tabor , and then goeth out to Daberath , and goeth up to Japhia ,

translation.kha: Lehse nga long u bym da khi ba kren , hynne da kaba sngewthikna ym ha ka jinghap ; ngi la pynshai ïa ken ha phi mano la ka jer bad ha ki jingshem baroh .
translation.en: But though I be rude in speech , yet not in knowledge ; but we have been thoroughly made manifest among you in all things .

translation.kha: Ko Jerusalem , to long khlaiñ bad long khraw biang ! Ko nongbah Bakhuid jong U Blei , to kup ïa lade da ka burom ! Kiba maïan blei thap kin ym ïohrung shuh da lei lei lyngba ki khrud jong Phah .
translation.en: Awake , awake  ; put on thy strength , O Zion  ; put on thy beautiful garments , O Jerusalem , the holy city : for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean .

translation.kha: U syiem Solomon u ai ïa ka syiem jongnga ka Shebna kat ïa kaba ka pan . Kane ka long nala kaei kaweh u la ai markylliang ha ka na ka bynta ki jingjai sngewbha kaba ka la wanrah ïa u . Nalorkata ma ka bad ki nongbud jong ka ki la leit phai sha ka ri Sheba .
translation.en: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire , whatsoever she asked , beside that which she had brought unto the king . So she turned , and went away to her own land , she and her servants .

translation.kha: Kim dei banbeiñ shakri ïa nga kum ki lyngkhot lane kitei hadien kano kano kaba khuid ïa nga lane ban rung shapoh ka Jaka Bakyntang Tam . Kanneh ka dei ka jingpynshitom na ka bynta ktieh kiew kiba ijli kiba ki la leh .
translation.en: And they shall not come near unto me , to do the office of a priest unto me , nor to come near to any of my holy things , in the most holy place : but they shall bear their shame , and their abominations which they have committed .

translation.kha: Nga thrang ban don ka jaka ban sah ha ka ri shyiap ha kaba de lah baneh wai na ki briew jong nga . Ma ki baïar ki long ki bymïaishah , ki paidbhur ki nongsakhi .
translation.en: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men  ; that I might leave my people , and go from them ! for they be all adulterers , an assembly of treacherous men .

translation.kha: U Trai un buh ïa u syiem halor ki Israel u ban pynduh syndon ïa ka longïing syiem jongno u Jeroboam .
translation.en: Moreover the  Lord  shall raise him up a king over Israel , who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day : but what ? even now .

translation.kha: U sumar jongno u , u rben kat u khung ha ka kor u nongthain jaiñ ; bad tang u sop nar jong u , u khah kumba hynñiew kilo . U shipai u ïaid ha shuwa jongno u da kaba rah ïa ka stet .
translation.en: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver s beam  ; and his spear s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron : and one bearing a shield went before him .

translation.kha: Ki bym ju ar ïa ka bymdei ; ki ïaid ha ki lynti U Trei .
translation.en: They also do no iniquity : they walk in his ways .
And I have also established my covenant with them , to give them the land of Canaan , the land of their pilgrimage , wherein they were strangers .
translation.kha: Nga la pynlong ruh ka jutang bad ki , da kaba kular ban ai ha ki ïa ka ri Kanaan , ka ri ha kaba ki la shong la sah kum ki sohshnong .
Lada phi ïoh ïa ka masi ne ïa ka kada u nongshun jong phi ba ka ïaid sakma , leit ïam pat ïa ka sha u .
translation.en: If thou meet thine enemy s ox or his ass going astray , thou shalt surely bring it back to him again .
Pilate said unto them , Ye have a watch : go your way , make it as sure as ye can .
translation.kha: To ïalam ïa ki nongap phira ,  u Pilat u la ong ïa ki ,  Khie leit bad to pynskhem ïa ka jingtep kat kaba phi lah .

translation.en: And Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah s tent , and took Rebekah , and she became his wife  ; and he loved her : and Isaac was comforted after his mother s death .
translation.kha: Nangta u Isaak u ïalam ïa ka Rebekka shapoh ka ïingjaiñ ha kaba ka Sarah ka kmie jong u ka la ju shong , bad ka la kylla long ka tnga jong u . U Isaak u ieit ïa ka Rebekka , bad da kumta u la ïoh jingtngen hadien ba u la duh ïa la ka kmie .

translation.en: To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife , being great with child .
translation.kha: U la leit ban thoh kyrteng lem bad ka Mari , kaba la ïatehktien bad u .

translation.en: As it is written , Jacob have I loved , but Esau have I hated .
translation.kha: Kumba ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong ,  Nga la ieit ïa u Jakob , hynrei nga la isih ïa u Iso .
Hato me lah ban pyrta lawlynnong ïa ki lyoh bad pynlong ïa ki baneh pynjhieh ïa me da u slap ?
translation.en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds , that abundance of waters may cover thee ?
And the Hittites , and the Perizzites , and the Rephaims ,
translation.kha: ki Hit , ki Peris , ki Rephaim ,
Ka Eliel ka her kum ka Parosh kaba bieit ; iing ki bynriew jongu ka ki wad jingïarap na Ijipt , bad nangta ki mareh sha Assyria !
translation.en: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart : they call to Egypt , they go to Assyria .

translation.kha: Haba u paidlang u la ïalum bad sdang ban kylli ïa u Pilat na ka bynda ka jingleh bakyrpang ba ju leh , u la kylli ïa ki , ithuh phi kwah ïa nga pun pyllaitluid na ka bynta jong phi ïa u syiem jong ki Jiw ?
translation.en: But Pilate answered them , saying , Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews ?

translation.kha: To shong to sah hangne , bad ngan long lem bad me , Bad ngan krung ïa me . Ngan sa ai ïa kane ka ri baroh ha me bad ha ki khun ki ksiew jong me . Ngan bat ïa la ka kulai kaban nga la Pynlong ha u Abraham u kpa jongu me .
translation.en: Sojourn in this land , and I will be with thee , and will bless thee  ; for unto thee , and unto thy seed , I will give all these countries , and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father  ;

translation.kha: Hynrei ki pynbah ki ong ha u saiwul , Hato u Jonathan , uba la jop ka jingjop kaban khraw na ka bynta ki Israel , un shah pynïap ? Em ! Naei kylluid ha U Trai uba im ba uei u shñiuh na ka khlieh Jong u ruh un ym hap ha khyndew . Kaei kaba u la leh ha kane ka sngi la har da ka jingïarap jong U Blei . Kumta ki paidbah ki la pyllait im ïa u Jonah na kaba shah pynnep .
translation.en: And the people said unto Saul , Shall Jonathan die , who hath wrought this great salvation in Israel ? God forbid : as the  Lord  liveth , there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground  ; for he hath wrought with God this day . So the people rescued Jonathan , that he died not .

translation.kha: U pud jong ka , u suhjer na Heleph sha u dieng Sning ha Mahanaim , nangta beit beit shat badonkam mala sha Jamin , haduh Leummim , bad u kut ha ka Jordan .
translation.en: And their coast was from Heleph , from Allon to Zaanannim , and Adami Nekeb , and Jabneel , unto Lakum  ; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan :
But let a man examine himself , and so let him eat of that bread , and drink of that cup .
translation.kha: Kumta te , uwei uwei baroh u dei ban ïit nyngkong ïa lade , bad nangta un bam ïa u kpu bad dih na ka khuri .
Baroh ki khun ki ksiew jong u Jakob kiba la leit sha Ijipt , lait noh ki tnga jong ki khun Shynrang jongnga u , ki longsyiem pynkhihwin hynriew ngut .
translation.en: All the souls that came with Jacob into Egypt , which came out of his loins , besides Jacob s sons  wives , all the souls were threescore and six  ;

translation.kha: Kaei kaba ngi ïohi mynta ka lama kumto ka dur kaba byrngut ha ka ïitkhmih ; nangta ngin sa ïohi markhmat . Kaei kaba por tip mandriek ka long tang katto katne ; nangto kan sa long Kaba thep pura — kaba dap pura kum ka jingtip jong U blem ïa nga .
translation.en: For now we see through a glass , darkly ; but then face to face : now I know in part ; but then shall I know even as also I am known .

translation.kha: Neng shahshkor ïa ki don sngur ïa ka bor ka jingbitar lad nga ñiar ki kam pynïap briew ba ki la leh ha ka ri bad ñiar ki bleithaw da kiba la pynsngewtynnat ïa ka .
translation.en: Wherefore I poured my fury upon them for the blood that they had shed upon the land , and for their idols wherewith they had polluted it :

translation.kha: Balei ban pynlut pisa ha kaei ka bym ai jinghun ? Balei ban pynjem ïa ka bainong jong phi bad ïa-ban dang hap shahthngan hi ? To shahshkor! ïa nga bad leh ïa kaei kaba nga noh , bad phin sngewsynei ïa ka jingbam kaba bang tam na baroh .
translation.en: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread ? and your labour for that which satisfieth not ? hearken diligently unto me , and eat ye that which is good , and let your soul delight itself in fatness .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Ka jingmatlah jyllang u kad don ei ei bad ki jop jong u ne ki Pop jong ki kmie ki khop jong u . U la longsem matlah khnang ban ïohi ba ka bor jong U Blei ka treh ha u .
translation.en: Jesus answered ,  Neither hath this man sinned , nor his parents : but that the works of God should be made manifest in him .
And Abram said , Behold , to me thou hast given no seed : and , lo , one born in my house is mine heir .
translation.kha: Mem shym la ai khun ïa nga , bad uwei na ki mraw jong nga un ïohpateng ïa ka spah ka phew jong nga .

Na ka bynta jong phi pat , ko ki parabangeit jong nga , la khot ïa phi ban Long kiba laitluid . Hynrei thew shah ba ken ka jinglanot kan kylla long ka jingailad ïa ki jingkwah brai ka doh banbeiñ synshar ïa phi . Pynban , ai ba ka jingieit kan pynjrong ïa Phi ban ïashakri iwei ïa iwei pat .
translation.en: For , brethren , ye have been called unto liberty ; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh , but by love serve one another .

translation.kha: Haba u Moses u la ïohsngew ïa kan , u la phet noh! na Ijipt bad u la leit noh ban shong ban sah ha ka ri ki Midian . Hangta u la don ar ngut ki khun shynrong .
translation.en: Then fled Moses at this saying , and was a stranger in the land of Madian , where he begat two sons .

translation.kha: Ngi pule ha ka Hukum u Moses , Wai khum ïa ka shyieng u masi dab haba me pyndonkam ïa u ban shoh ïa u keiñ . Mynta , hato U Blei u sngewkhia ïa u Massah dab ?
translation.en: For it is written in the law of Moses , Thou shalt not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treadeth out the corn . Doth God take care for oxen ?

translation.kha: thaba ki la pyndap ïa kita ki khra baroh , ka la kylli la dang ni shuh ne em . Utai u dei uba khatduh , uwei na ki khun shynrang jong ka u jubab . Bad ka umphniang Olib ka la sangeh ngab tuid .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when the vessels were full , that she said unto her son , Bring me yet a vessel . And he said unto her , There is not a vessel more . And the oil stayed .

translation.kha: U Ussiel u la ïap bad la tep ha ka jingtip ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , badno u Jotham u khum jong u , u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
translation.en: So Azariah slept with his fathers  ; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David : and Jotham his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: Haba map , Dei ban leh kumne . Uwei pa eiei uba ai ramhah ha la u para Jeriel u dei ban map ïa kata ka ram ; um dei pun dawa shuh ïa ka , Namar ba U Trai hi u la map ïa ka .
translation.en: And this is the manner of the release : Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it  ; he shall not exact it of his neighbour , or of his brother  ; because it is called the  Lord s  release .

translation.kha: Nga long U Blei jong phi , uta uba pyllait ïa pa na ki jingjop bad ki jingmihsnam jong phi baher hynrei mynta phi la kyntait ïa per bad phi la pan na nga ban ai ïa ph da u Syiem . Namar “kata , ïalumlang ïa lade ha khmat U Trai , shi jait shi jait , bad shi kur shi kam .’
translation.en: And ye have this day rejected your God , who himself saved you out of all your adversities and your tribulations  ; and ye have said unto him , Nay , but set a king over us . Now therefore present yourselves before the  Lord  by your tribes , and by your thousands .

translation.kha: kito kiba pyndonkam ïa ki tiar ba ki ïoh , kumba kim shym lup miet ha wir . Nongbah kane ka pyrthei , wohnia ka long mynta , kad ym neh slem .
translation.en: And they that use this world , as not abusing it : for the fashion of this world passeth away .
So the waters were healed unto this day , according to the saying of Elisha which he spake .
translation.kha: Bad kata ka um ka la khuid naduh kata ka sngi , kumba u Elisha u la ong ba kan long kumta .

translation.en: And he slew it  ; and Moses took of the blood of it , and put it upon the tip of Aaron s right ear , and upon the thumb of his right hand , and upon the great toe of his right foot .
translation.kha: U Moses u shim khyndiat ka snam bad u tah ïa ka ha ka shkor kamon jong u Aaron , ha ka  tikmie ba sha kamon , bad ha ka  jatkmie ba sha kamon jong u .
Mynta ngan wallam pat ïa ki na ki jaka na kiba ki la shah die . Ngan leh ïa phi ïa kaei kaba phi la leh ïa ki .
translation.en: Behold , I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them , and will return your recompence upon your own head :

translation.kha: Kñia uwei u khunlangbrot mynstep bad uwei patiaw Ynda janmiet .
translation.en: The one lamb thou shalt offer in the morning  ; and the other lamb thou shalt offer at even :

translation.kha: Ki bri keiñ leh ïa kine kiei kiei ïa phoi nabar ba kdor pat ithuh ïa U Kpa lymne ïa nga .
translation.en: And these things will they do unto you , because they have not known the Father , nor me .

translation.kha: Hato me wan ban kynshew ïa nga , A Blei ? Lada me leh kumta , nga kloi Ban shu sngap jar bad ïap noh .
translation.en: Who is he that will plead with me ? for now , if I hold my tongue , I shall give up the ghost .

translation.kha: Uwei na ki nongleh kam runar uba la sdien hangta u la krenbeiñ ïa u : Hato mem long U Mareshah ? To pynrem ïa lade sad ïa ngi !
translation.en: And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him , saying , If thou be Christ , save thyself and us .

translation.kha: Kumta nga la ïathuhlypa kumba la bthah ïa por . Katba nga dang kren , nga la iohnong ïa ka jingsawa koum ka jingïakhih shane sharati , bad ki shyieng ki la sdang ban ïadait lang .
translation.en: So I prophesied as I was commanded : and as I prophesied , there was a noise , and behold a shaking , and the bones came together , bone to his bone .

translation.kha: Ngan pynïoh ïa ki nong Assyria ha ka ri Israel jong nga bad nur-um kyrdem shalor jong ki lumlang jongnga nga . nur pyllaitluid ïa ki briew jong nga na ka lyngkor jong ki nong Assyria bad na ki jingkit kiba ki ni ban bah .
translation.en: That I will break the Assyrian in my land , and upon my mountains tread him under foot : then shall his yoke depart from off them , and his burden depart from off their shoulders .

Therefore he said unto Judah , Let us build these cities , and make about them walls , and towers , gates , and bars , while the land is yet before us  ; because we have sought the  Lord  our God , we have sought him , and he hath given us rest on every side . So they built and prospered .
translation.kha: U ong ïa ki paid Judah ,  To ngin pynskhem ïa ki nongbah da kaba tei ïa ki kynroh bad ki kut , bad ki khyrdop kiba lah ban khang khyrdep . Ngi long trai ïa ka ri namar ba ngi la leh ïa ka mon U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . U la ïada ïa ngi bad u la ai jingshngain na ki liang baroh .  Bad kumta ki tei bad ki manbha .

translation.en: Thou shalt not have in thine house divers measures , a great and a small .
translation.kha: Wat shukor haba phi thew jingthew da u mawser ne da u diengthew .

translation.en: He shall eat the bread of his God , both of the most holy , and of the holy .
translation.kha: U lah ban bam ïa ka jingbam kaba la kñia ainguh ha nga , ïa ka jingkñia ainguh bam kaba kyntang , bad kaba kyntang eh ;
Nangta U Khun U Briew un mihpaw , da kaba wan ha ki lyoh ha ka kuna Bakhrawbor bad ka burom .
translation.en: And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory .

translation.kha: Thoh ïa ki ha ki shawkad ki ïing jongki phi bad ha ki khyrdop jong ph .
translation.en: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house , and upon thy gates :

translation.kha: Nangta u sait ïa ki doh jem malu ïa ki kjat-dien bad u thang lang ïa ki ha ka duwan shalor kita kiaw pat ki jingïania ainguh thang .
translation.en: And he did wash the inwards and the legs , and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar .

translation.kha: Nga long U Blei jong phira nabar ngan sumar ïa phi haduh ba pher da tymmen bad ba u shñiuh jong phi u la lieh . Ngin la tiduh ïa phi bad ngan sumar ïa phi ; Ngan ai jingïarap ïa phi bad ngan pyllait ïa phi .
translation.en: And even to your old age I am he  ; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you : I have made , and I will bear  ; even I will carry , and will deliver you .

translation.kha: Uno uno u bym beh ïa la ka diengphna bad wan nadien jong nga , um lah ban long u synran jyllang nga .
translation.en: And whosoever doth not bear his cross , and come after me , cannot be my disciple .

translation.kha: ngan jar ïa iar kiba la jah , ngan wallam pat ïa kito kiba la sakma , ngan sop spaiñ ïa kito kiba la ti , bad ngan pynkhiah ïa kito kiba pang , hyndai ïa kito kiba sngaid dara kiba khlieh nur-um sa pynjot , namar nga longsyiem u Nongaplangbrot uba leh ïa kaei kambah dei .
translation.en: I will seek that which was lost , and bring again that which was driven away , and will bind up that which was broken , and will strengthen that which was sick : but I will destroy the fat and the strong  ; I will feed them with judgment .

translation.kha: Hynrei U Trai u la pynim ïa nga bad u la ai bor ïa nga , ba nga la kah ban ïalap ïa ka gospel , bad ba ki Jentil baroh kin ïohsngew ; U Blei u la pyllait ïa na na ka jinghap .
translation.en: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me , and strengthened me ; that by me the preaching might be fully known , and that all the Gentiles might hear : and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion .

translation.kha: ngam shyiap la ngeit ïa kaei kaba ki ïashoh ïa de tad india nga la wan bad ïohi da latai hi . Ngam Shimham pat jingïashoh wat tang shiteng na ka jingmad jong phi . Phi kham stad shuh shuh ngab ïa kaba ki briew ki ong .
translation.en: Howbeit I believed not their words , until I came , and mine eyes had seen it : and , behold , the one half of the greatness of thy wisdom was not told me : for thou exceedest the fame that I heard .
And as for you , O my flock , thus saith the Lord  God   ; Behold , I judge between cattle and cattle , between the rams and the he goats .
translation.kha: Te mynta , ko ka kynhun jong nga ; ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga ïathuh ha phi ba ngan bishar ïa kawei pa kawei na phi bad ngan pynkhlad ïa kiba bha na kiba sniew , ïa ki langbrot na ki blang .

translation.en: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness , so that there is no place clean .
translation.kha: Ïa ki miej ha kiba ki shong la tap da ka prie bad ym don shuh ka bynta kaba khuid .

Hynrei u Saul u la pyrshang shun pynjot ïa ka balang , da kaba otsher na kawei ka ïing sha kiwei pat , u da paring shabar ïa ki riewngeit , shynrang dara kynthei , pynlang u la thep ïa ki sha ka ïingbyndi .
translation.en: As for Saul , he made havock of the church , entering into every house , and haling men and women committed them to prison .

In journeyings often , in perils of waters , in perils of robbers , in perils by mine own countrymen , in perils by the heathen , in perils in the city , in perils in the wilderness , in perils in the sea , in perils among false brethren ;
translation.kha: Ha ki jingleit jong nga kiba bun nga la don ha ka jingma na ki jingshlei um bad na ki nonglute , ha ka jingma na ki para Jiw bad na ki Jentil ; ki la don ki jingma ha ki nongbah , ki jingma ha ki ri khlaw , ki jingma ha ki duriaw-bah , bad ki jingma na ki paralok kiba shukor .
Haba u Salm u la thlim , u thung nongbishar ïa ki khun shynrang jong u ha Israel .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when Samuel was old , that he made his sons judges over Israel .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi nur-um shim ïa me , ko Serubbabel u shakri jong nga , bad ngan thung ïa me ban synshar ha ka kyrteng jongu na . Me longsyiem uta umbah nga la jied . U Troas barabor Baroh u la kren .
translation.en: In that day , saith the  Lord  of hosts , will I take thee , O Zerubbabel , my servant , the son of Shealtiel , saith the  Lord  , and will make thee as a signet : for I have chosen thee , saith the  Lord  of hosts .

translation.kha: U Asa u leit ban ïabah ïa u , bad baroh arliang ki ïeng ha la ki jaka ha ka Te Sephathah hajan Mareshah .
translation.en: Then Asa went out against him , and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah .

translation.kha: Phi ot ïa u jyntang bad Nangta ot ïa u phlang ha ki sharing lum katba u jyntang ba dang lung u tdong san .
translation.en: The hay appeareth , and the tender grass sheweth itself , and herbs of the mountains are gathered .

translation.kha: ki dkhiew : ki dei kiba sliew , hynrei ki kynshew ïa la ka jingbam mynlyiur ;
translation.en: The ants are a people not strong , yet they prepare their meat in the summer  ;

translation.kha: Don saw tylli kiei kiei ba ka pyrthei da lade kam lah shah :
translation.en: For three things the earth is disquieted , and for four which it cannot bear :

translation.kha: U dei u syiem Hesekaïah uba set ïa ka jingmih ka um na ka Mluh Gihon bad ban pun ïa ka um ba kan tuid lyngba ka nur-um sha ka tduh hapoh ki kynroh jong ka Jerusalem .
translation.en: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon , and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David . And Hezekiah prospered in all his works .

translation.kha: Ma ki baroh ki ïalam bakla ïa la ki paralok , bad ym anna uwei ruh naba ïathiah ïa ka jingshisha ; ki la hikai ïa la ki thylliej ban lamler bad kin ym iehnoh ïa ka jingleh pop jong ki . Ki bor ïa Kawei ka jingleh jubor hadien kawei patiaw , bad kawei ka jingleh shahskhor ka buiñ ïa kadei pat . U Trai u ong ba ki briew jong u ki kyntait ïa u .
translation.en: Thine habitation is in the midst of deceit  ; through deceit they refuse to know me , saith the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ïa ki masi jong phi yn pynïap ha khat jong phi hi , hynrei phin ym oh bam ïa ka doh jong ki . Ïa ki kada jong phi yn rong jubor ha khmih jong pa’ hi , bad yn ym pynphieng pat ïa ki sha phi . Ïa ki byrngut jong phi yn ai ei ha ki nongshun jong phi , bad yn ym don ba ïalap ïa phiah .
translation.en: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes , and thou shalt not eat thereof : thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face , and shall not be restored to thee : thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies , and thou shalt have none to rescue them .

translation.kha: Naba ki la leit bad bor kamut ruma U Trai u la hukum ïa u Moses pynlang u Onan .
translation.en: And the children of Israel went away , and did as the  Lord  had commanded Moses and Aaron , so did they .
And Saul had a concubine , whose name was Rizpah , the daughter of Aiah : and Ish–bosheth said to Abner , Wherefore hast thou gone in unto my father s concubine ?
translation.kha: Ha kawei ka sngi u Ishbosheth u khun jong u Saul u kynnoh sniew ïa u Abner ba u ïathiah bad ka Rispah , ka tnga kliar jong u Saul , ka khun jong u Aïah .
Im ïohi da lin Lai ïa ka jingshaïong jong ka sngi lane tip kamon ka jingim ka long , hynrei la kumno kumno i la shem ka jingjahthait —
translation.en: Moreover he hath not seen the sun , nor known any thing : this hath more rest than the other .
Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes , I considered , and saw fourfooted beasts of the earth , and wild beasts , and creeping things , and fowls of the air .
translation.kha: Nga la khmih bniah shapoh bad nga la ïohi ïa ki jingri bad ki mradkhlaw , ki kynja bapar , bad ki sim khlaw .
Haba u khunlung u la dap shi taïew , ki la wei ban otsher ïa u , nabar ki la mut ban kyrteng ïa u , u Sekharaïah , Kaba bujli ïa u kpa jong u .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child  ; and they called him Zacharias , after the name of his father .

translation.kha: Nangta ki synñiang ki la wan shaei u malu ki la ong , Hammoth me tip ba la pynmong ïa ki jingsngem jong ki Pharisi da kaei kaba me la ong ?
translation.en: Then came his disciples , and said unto him , Knowest thou that the Pharisees were offended , after they heard this saying ?

translation.kha: U la buh biang ïa u nongrah khuri rangbah ha ka kyrdan kob u bat ba-mynshuwa , hynrei u la pynïap ïa u nongshet kpu rangbah .
translation.en: And he restored the chief butler unto his butlership again  ; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh s hand :

translation.kha: Ïaroh kiba don jingtah ha u Jisu! kin ïor map na ki pop bad kin ïoh ïa ka jingim bymjukut .—2 Timothi 2 :5 , 6 ; Ioannis 3 :16 ; Rom 5 :16 , 19 .
translation.en: All who put their faith in Jesus can have their sins forgiven and receive everlasting life .—1 Timothy 2 :5 , 6  ; John 3 :16  ; Romans 5 :18 , 19 .

translation.kha: nga kylluid ba ngan ai ha me ïa ki khun ki ksiew kat ki khohruh ka sahit bneng , lane kat ki syiem shyngkub harud ka duriaw . Ki khun ki ksiew jong me kin jop ïa ki nongshniah jongu ki .
translation.en: That in blessing I will bless thee , and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven , and as the sand which is upon the sea shore  ; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies  ;
In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses , HOLINESS UNTO THE  Lord   ; and the pots in the  Lord s  house shall be like the bowls before the altar .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka por wat ïa ki baje ha ki tyllai teh jong ki kulai yn thoh da ki kyntien  Ba la pynkyntang sha U  Trai .  Ki khiew shet ha ka Templ kin long kiba kyntang kum ki jingdiang ha khmat ka duwan .

Phibi tip kumno ba Ngi la shah lehbha bad shad krenbeiñ ha Philadelphia shuwa ba ngin wang sha phi ha Thessaloni . Badno wat la ka la don ka jingpyrshah kaba jur , U Blei jong i u la ai ha ngi ka jingshlur ban ïathuh ha phoi ïa ka Khubor Babha kaweh wan na u .
translation.en: But even after that we had suffered before , and were shamefully entreated , as ye know , at Philippi , we were bold in our God to speak unto you the gospel of God with much contention .

And I beheld , and heard an angel flying through the midst of heaven , saying with a loud voice , Woe , woe , woe , to the inhabiters of the earth by reason of the other voices of the trumpet of the three angels , which are yet to sound !
translation.kha: Nangta nga la khmih , nga la ïohsngew ïa u pukni uba her shajrong eh jong ka suiñ ba u pyrta ha ka sur kaba jam ,  Kaba kordit ! Kaba kordit ! Katno kaba kordit kan long ïa baroh kiba shong ha ka pyrthei haba ka jingsawa ka mih na ki turoi ïa kaba kita kiwei pat ki lai ngut ki angel kin put .

La katta ruh , at pynnep ïa ka khubor lad ka jingstad sha kito kiba la san ha ka jinglong mynhyndai . Hynrei , kam long ka jingwad jong kane ka pyrthei lane jyllang ki bor kiba shihajar ïa kane ka pyrthei — ki kun ki ba-bang sa duh noh ïa ka bor jong ki .
translation.en: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect : yet not the wisdom of this world , nor of the princes of this world , that come to nought :

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi kyntiew kurim , u Nahaliel u kyntait ïa ka , ban panpoh lyngkha na u kpa jong ka . Ka la hiar na ka puta jong ka , bad u Kaleb u kylli ïa ka aïu ka kaweh .
translation.en: And it came to pass , when she came to him , that she moved him to ask of her father a field : and she lighted from off her ass  ; and Caleb said unto her , What wilt thou ?
Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families , every man in the door of his tent : and the anger of the  Lord  was kindled greatly  ; Moses also was displeased .
translation.kha: U Moses u ïohsngew ba ki briew baroh ki ïakhñium katba ki dang ïa-ïeng lymbung kynhun kynhun ha khmat jingkhang jong ki ïingjaiñ jong ki . U la sngewkhuslai namar ba U  Trai  u la bitar ïa ki ,

Haba ka prie ka poi ban lum ïa ki shitaiew , u la phah ïa u mraw sha ki nongshimwai ban ïohpdiang na ki ïa la ka boitha na ka jingkheit soh . Hynrei , ki nongpynshitom ki shoh ïa uta u mraw badno ki la phah noh thlia ïa u .
translation.en: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen , that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard : but the husbandmen beat him , and sent him away empty .

There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh  ; for he was the firstborn of Joseph  ; to wit , for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh , the father of Gilead : because he was a man of war , therefore he had Gilead and Bashan .
translation.kha: Shi bynta jong ka ri ha ka phang sepngi jong ka Jordan la ai ha ki katto katne ki longïing kiba hiarpateng na u Manasseh , u khun nyngkong jong u Joseph . U Makhir , u kpa jong u Gilead , u dei u khun nyngkong jong u Manasseh bad u khla-ka-wait uba pawnam ; kumta ïa ka Gilead bad ka Bashan , ha ka phang mihngi ka Jordan , la ai ha u .
bad haba ki la ithuh ïa u kum u nongkhrong uba la ju shong ha ka Khyrdop itynnat , baroh ki la kyndit bad lyngngoh ïa kaei kaba la lah jia ha u .
translation.en: And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple : and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him .

Even they sent , and took Jeremiah out of the court of the prison , and committed him unto Gedaliah the son of Ahikam the son of Shaphan , that he should carry him home : so he dwelt among the people .
translation.kha: Ki la buh ïa nga hapoh ka jingsumar u Gedalaïah , u khun jong u Ahikam bad u ksiew jong u Shaphan , u ban peit ba nga poi suk sha ïing . Bad kumta nga la sah hangta hapdeng ki briew .

Ha ka sngi kaba bud , hir u Moses u leit Shabeh ka Ïingjaiñ , u la ïohi ba u diengduh jong u Aaron , uba ïeng na ka bynta ka jait Lebi , u la khie lung . U la shimet , phuh syntiew , bad sei ki soh-ot almond kiba ih !
translation.en: And it came to pass , that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness  ; and , behold , the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded , and brought forth buds , and bloomed blossoms , and yielded almonds .

translation.kha: U jubab , A Trai , U Blei Badonbor Baroh , nga la shakri ïa me borabor — tang ïa me hi . Hynrei ki paid Israel ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka ïong bad me , ki la pynpaw ïa ki duwan jong me bad pynpyut ïa baroh ki nongïathuhlypa jong me . Dang tang ma nga uba dang sah — sad ki la pyrshang ban pynïap ïa nga ruh !
translation.en: And he said , I have been very zealous for the  Lord  God of hosts : for the children of Israel have forsaken thy covenant , thrown down thine altars , and slain thy prophets with the sword  ; and I , even I only , am left  ; and they seek my life , to take it away .

translation.kha: Kumta ma sa , U Trai Nongsynshar , nga kyrhai : Hato une u diengïap sohkew un im Bad san ? Hato u shrong uba nyngkong un ym rat ïa u na ki thied , phut noh ïa ki sohshnong , bad pynkheiñ ïa ki tnat bad shah ïa ki ban ïapstai ? Kam da shim shibun eh ka jingpynkhlaiñ lane ka hima bakhlaiñbor ban rat ïa ka .
translation.en: Say thou , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; Shall it prosper ? shall he not pull up the roots thereof , and cut off the fruit thereof , that it wither ? it shall wither in all the leaves of her spring , even without great power or many people to pluck it up by the roots thereof .

translation.kha: To kylla-kaba-mut , te , na kane ka jingthmu bymman jong me , bad mudui ha U Trai ba un map ïa me na kabu pyrkhat ïa kambah kum kane .
translation.en: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness , and pray God , if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee .

translation.kha: U Trai u kynmaw aïu ki nongshun jong ki , ki la leh ; u ap ïa ka por kaba biang ban pynshitom ïa ki .
translation.en: Is not this laid up in store with me , and sealed up among my treasures ?

And thou shalt go unto the priest that shall be in those days , and say unto him , I profess this day unto the  Lord  thy God , that I am come unto the country which the  Lord  sware unto our fathers for to give us .
translation.kha: Leit sha u lyngdoh uba dei peit kam ha kata ka por , bad ong ha u , ‘ Nga pynbna mynta ka sngi ha U  Trai  U Blei jong nga ba nga la wan rung ha kata ka ri ba u la kular ha ki kpa tymmen jong ngi ban ai ha ngi .’
Phi kiba shong ha Aroer , ïeng harud lyntait mala ap ; kylli na kito babha ïaphet neh , wad jingtip na ki ïa kaei kaba la jia .
translation.en: O inhabitant of Aroer , stand by the way , and espy  ; ask him that fleeth , and her that escapeth , and say , What is done ?

translation.kha: Kumta u otsher mih hadien jong u Naaman . Haba u Naaman u la ïohi ïa u briew uba mareh hadien jong u , u la hiar na la ka kila ïapom ban ïashem ïa u , bad kylli , Dan ei ei naba pher ?
translation.en: So Gehazi followed after Naaman . And when Naaman saw him running after him , he lighted down from the chariot to meet him , and said , Is all well ?

translation.kha: Lehse , nga haka pun pynlong ïa ki briew jong ka jaitbynriew jong nga hi ban sngewbishni , ba kumta yn lai ban pynim Katto Katno na ki .
translation.en: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh , and might save some of them .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por la don u briew uba shong basah ha Jerusalem uba kyrteng u Simeon . U la long u briew uba bha , wahbah sheptieng ïa U Blei bad uba ïai ap na ka bynta ki Israel banbeiñ ïoh jingpynim .
translation.en: And , behold , there was a man in Jerusalem , whose name was Simeon  ; and the same man was just and devout , waiting for the consolation of Israel : and the Holy Ghost was upon him .

translation.kha: Kin rwai ïa kane ka jingrwai ïapbriew na ka bynta jong pha : Ïa nongbah bapawnam la pynjot ! Ïa ki liengbah jong ka la rnong noh na ki duriaw . Ki briew jong kane ka nongbet ki synsar ïa ki duriaw sad pyntriem ïa baroh kiba shong hajar duriaw .
translation.en: And they shall take up a lamentation for thee , and say to thee , How art thou destroyed , that wast inhabited of seafaring men , the renowned city , which wast strong in the sea , she and her inhabitants , which cause their terror to be on all that haunt it !
He said unto him ,  What is written in the law ? how readest thou ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa u ,  Aïu ki Jingthoh Bakhuid ki ong ? Kumno me batai ïa ki ?
U la khmih sawdong jong ki baïar ; nangta U la ong ha uta u briew , To kner ïa ka kti jyllang me . U la sa kumta , pynlang ka kti jong u ka la bha pat .
translation.en: And looking round about upon them all , he said unto the man ,  Stretch forth thy hand .  And he did so : and his hand was restored whole as the other .
The rest said , Let be , let us see whether Elias will come to save him .
translation.kha: Hynrei kiwei pat ki la ong ,  To ap , to ngin peit lada u Elijah un wan bad pyllait im ïa u !

Ngan nongrah ruh khyndiat ka jingbam ; kan ai bor ïa phi katba phi nang bteng ïa ka jingïaid lynti jngai phi . Phi la pyndonburom ïa nga hab phi wan rung ha ïing jong nga , kumto shuh ngan shakri ïa phi . Ki jubab , Khublei shibun ; ngi pdiang sngewbha ïa kata .
translation.en: And I will fetch a morsel of bread , and comfort ye your hearts  ; after that ye shall pass on : for therefore are ye come to your servant . And they said , So do , as thou hast said .

translation.kha: U apostol Paul u la nong ha kawei na ki balang : “Nga kwah hir hir ban iohi ia phi , . . . ba ha pa’ yn pyniasngew tngen lema ia nga bad phi , da la ka jingngeit jingngeit . . . ka jongngi phi ruh malade ka jrong nga de .”
translation.en: The apostle Paul told one of the congregations in his day : “I am longing to see you , . . . that we may have an interchange of encouragement by one another’s faith , both yours and mine .”

translation.kha: Hynrei uno uno uba kito ïa la u hynmen u para u don ha ka jingdoh ; u ïadih ha ka bad um tip shano u leit , namar ka jingduk ka la pynsat ïa u .
translation.en: But he that hateth his brother is in darkness , and walketh in darkness , and knoweth not whither he goeth , because that darkness hath blinded his eyes .
Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers .
translation.kha: To nang ïaid , bad pyndep ïa kaei kaba ki kpa tymmen jong phi ki la sdang !

translation.en: Foursquare it shall be being doubled  ; a span shall be the length thereof , and a span shall be the breadth thereof .
translation.kha: Ka dei ban long kaba sawdong , bad kaba la khylliap ar syrtap , kaba jrong arphew ar sentimitar bad kaba ïar arphew ar sentimitar .

translation.en: When he was come down from the mountain , great multitudes followed him .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la wan hiar na u lum , ki paidbah babun ki la bud ïa u .

translation.en: In the eighth month , in the second year of Darius , came the word of the  Lord  unto Zechariah , the son of Berechiah , the son of Iddo the prophet , saying ,
translation.kha: Ha u bnai uba phra jong ka snem kaba ar kaba u Darius u long u patsha ka Persia , U  Trai  u la ai ïa kane ka khubor ha u Sekharaïah u nongïathuhlypa , u khun jong u Berekhaïah bad u ksiew jong u Iddo .

translation.en: My breath is strange to my wife , though I entreated for the children s sake of mine own body .
translation.kha: Ka tnga jong nga kam lah ban shah ïa ka jingsma ka jingpynhiar mynsiem jong nga , ki hynmen ki para jong nga kim wan hajan jong nga .

Ha ka snem katba khatphra jong ka jingsynshar jong u , dadien ba u la pynkhuid ïa ka ri bad ïa ka Templ da kaba pynkut nep ïa ka jingmane blei thala , u syiem Josaïah u pham lai ngut ki rangbah ban tei pynbha ïa ka Templ jong U Trai U Blei : u Shaphan u khun jong u Asasaïah , Massah , u lat ka Jerusalem , bad u Joah u khun jong u Joahas , u rangbah synshar ba-halor .
translation.en: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign , when he had purged the land , and the house , he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah , and Maaseiah the governor of the city , and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder , to repair the house of the  Lord  his God .
And he hath filled him with the spirit of God , in wisdom , in understanding , and in knowledge , and in all manner of workmanship  ;
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pyndap ïa u da ka bor jong u , bad u la ai ruh ha u ïa ka jingtbit , ka jingnang , bad ka jingshemphang ban trei ïa ki jait kam ohdur kiba har rukom ,
Uwei u brai uba ki kjat bad ki kti jong u ki la shab u la wan shiah U Jisu ,
translation.en: And , behold , there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy .
But the end of all things is at hand : be ye therefore sober , and watch unto prayer .
translation.kha: Kaba kut jong kiei kiei baroh ka la jan . Phi dei ban long kiba lah ban synshar ïa lade bad kiba sharai , ban lah ban duwai .
Lydia phi jubab ïa ka jingkylli bieit , phin long kumin u briew uba bieit uba kylli ïa ka .
translation.en: Answer not a fool according to his folly , lest thou also be like unto him .

And the weight of the golden earrings that he requested was a thousand and seven hundred shekels of gold  ; beside ornaments , and collars , and purple raiment that was on the kings of Midian , and beside the chains that were about their camels  necks .
translation.kha: Ki sohshkor ksiar ba u Gideon u ïohpdiang ki khia la jan arphew kilo , bad kane kam shym kynthup ïa ki jingdeng , ki kpieng bad ki jaiñ sawbthuh ba ki syiem Midian ki kup , lymne ki jingdeng kiba don sawdong ki ryndang jong ki ut jong ki .
Thaw ïa ka jingtap da ka ksai nym , kaba shispah shiphew sentimitar ka lynter badno hynriewphew hynriew sentimitar ka pyngkiang .
translation.en: And thou shalt make a mercy seat of pure gold : two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof , and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof .

translation.kha: Ngam shah ïa ki kynthei ba kin hikai lane leh donbor halor ki shynrang ; ki dei ban longsem katba shkor jam .
translation.en: But I suffer not a woman to teach , nor to usurp authority over the man , but to be in silence .

translation.kha: Kumjuh , sngew ïa ki , tangba me dei ban maham jur ïa ki bad pynshai kumin kita ki syiem kin leh ïa ki .
translation.en: Now therefore hearken unto their voice : howbeit yet protest solemnly unto them , and shew them the manner of the king that shall reign over them .

And he gathered together the priests and the Levites , and said to them , Go out unto the cities of Judah , and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year , and see that ye hasten the matter . Howbeit the Levites hastened it not .
translation.kha: U la hukum ïa ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi ban leit sha ki nongbah jong ka Judah bad ban lum na ki briew baroh kat ban biang ban shna pynbha ïa ka Templ man ka snem . U ong ïa ki ban leh kloi , hynrei ki Lebi ki pyntud ,
U Jisu te u la ong ïa ki synran jong u ba baroh ki briew kin phiah ha ki kynhun kynhun bad shong halor u phlang bajyrngam .
translation.en: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass .

translation.kha: “Wat ai ka jingkular ha ka kyrteng jong nga lada phim ne jingmut ban bat ïa ka ; Katai ka wanrah ïa ka jingpynjahburom ïa ka kyrteng jong nga . Nga long U Trai U Blei jong phi .
translation.en: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely , neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: Phi pynleit jingmut kyrpang ïa ki katto katne ki sngi , ki bnai , ki aïom , bad ki snem .
translation.en: Ye observe days , and months , and times , and years .
And it came to pass , as he had made an end of speaking all these words , that the ground clave asunder that was under them :
translation.kha: Mar ïadep kren ïa kine ki ktien , ka khyndew ha kaba u Dathan bad u Abiram ki ïeng ka la kad arliang
Bad kumta , kat kum ka Khubor Babha kaba nga ïarep , kaei ka dei kaba kumno ka long ha kata ka Sngi ha kaba U Blei lyngba U Jisu Khrist un gospel ïa ki jingmut barieh jong ki brup borbah .
translation.en: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel .

translation.kha: U Moses malu u Joshua ki la leit sha ka Ïingjaiñ bad U Trai u mawpud ha ki Haneng ha u rishot lyoh uba ïeng ha ka jingshong ka Ïingjaiñ .
translation.en: And the  Lord  appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud : and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle .

translation.kha: Ngan sa bret ïa me bad ïa ka kmie jong me Sha ka jinglongmraw . lad leit sha ka ri ha kaba ym shym la khiah ïa me , Bad hangtai phin ïap baroh ar ngut .
translation.en: And I will cast thee out , and thy mother that bare thee , into another country , where ye were not born  ; and there shall ye die .

translation.kha: U la ïathuh ïa ngi kumno ba u la ïohi ïa u ebanjelist uba ïeng ha ka ïing jong u , nabar uba la ong ha u , ‘ Phah ïano nangno Sha Jubab bad sien shym ïa u briew uba ka kyrteng pura ka long u Simon Petros .
translation.en: And he shewed us how he had seen an angel in his house , which stood and said unto him , Send men to Joppa , and call for Simon , whose surname is Peter  ;

translation.kha: Ho-oid , phi dei ban phai shwa U Bel da ka jingsngewrit bad iehnoh ïa baroh kaba sniew kaba ne ha ka ïing jong Phi .
translation.en: If thou return to the Almighty , thou shalt be built up , thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles .

translation.kha: Ïa kito bakha ïoh ka jingit yn pynkup ïa ki kumne ha ki jaiñkup balieh , bad ngan ym weng khong ïa ki kyrteng jong ki na ka kitab lad kiba im . Ha ka jingsdang ryngkat jong U Kpa jong nga bad ki satang jong u , ngan pynbna paidbah ba ki lama ki jong nga .
translation.en: He that overcometh , the same shall be clothed in white raiment  ; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life , but I will confess his name before my Father , and before his angels .
Thou shalt not kill .
translation.kha: ‘ Wat pynïap .
Balei ba la kha ïa nga ? Hato kan dadien Teng ban oh ka jingjynjar bad ka jingsngewsih , ba-bang pynkut ïa ka jingim jong la ha ka jingñiewburom ?
translation.en: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow , that my days should be consumed with shame ?

translation.kha: Ïa baroh ki khuri jong u syiem Salmone la Shna da ka ksiar , bad bhor ki khiew ki pliang ha ka ruma kah jong ka Khlem Lebanon ki long kiba da ka ksiar nylla . Ha ki sngi u Salmone ïa ka rupa ym pah ñiew kaba ikordor .
translation.en: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold , and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold : none were of silver  ; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon .

translation.kha: U dei ban da ïapynbeit dara uta uba thied ïa u , bad ïakheiñ ïa ki snem naduh ka por ba u la die ïa lade haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat ka ban wan bad ïa ka bai Pyllait kin buh dor kat kumno ka jingdon jong kita ki Snem , ha ka nongrim jong ka kyang u nongïaleh .
translation.en: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubilee : and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years , according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him .

The land of Egypt is before thee  ; in the best of the land make thy father and brethren to dwell  ; in the land of Goshen let them dwell : and if thou knowest any men of activity among them , then make them rulers over my cattle .
translation.kha: Ieh kin ïashong ïasah ha Goshen , ka jaka kaba bha tam ha ka ri . Bad lada don napdeng jong ki , ki briew kiba tbit , buh ïa ki ban peit ïa ki jingri jong nga .

translation.en: And thou shalt write upon them all the words of this law , when thou art passed over , that thou mayest go in unto the land which the  Lord  thy God giveth thee , a land that floweth with milk and honey  ; as the  Lord  God of thy fathers hath promised thee .
translation.kha: bad thoh ha ki ïa kine ki aiñ bad ki hukum baroh . Ynda phi la rung sha kata ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap ba U  Trai  U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong phi u la kular ha phi ,
U Trai u ieit ïa ka khop bad ka jingbishar thok ; ka jingieit baneh jong u ka pyndap ïa ka pyrthei .
translation.en: He loveth righteousness and judgment : the earth is full of the goodness of the  Lord .

translation.kha: badno ma me , ko Dannah , to ïaineh haduh kaba kut . Nangta nam sa ïap , hynrei men mihpat ban ïohpdiang ïa ka bainong ha kaba khoit jong ka Por .
translation.en: But go thou thy way till the end be : for thou shalt rest , and stand in thy lot at the end of the days .

translation.kha: Katba u Syiem Kynrad u ïangat peit , u angel u la ïan hiar na bneng bad u la ong , ‘ Pom ïa u dieng bad pynpait ïa u , hynrei iehnoh ïa ka dyngkhong ha ka khyndew . teh da u syrwiang ngat bun rngai sawdong jong ka , nabar iehnoh Hangta ha ka pyntha lem bad u phlang . Ai ba ka tmier kan hap halor jong une u briew , bad shah ïa u shun im hangta sad ki mrad na ka bynta hynriewphew snem .’
translation.en: And whereas the king saw a watcher and an holy one coming down from heaven , and saying , Hew the tree down , and destroy it  ; yet leave the stump of the roots thereof in the earth , even with a band of iron and brass , in the tender grass of the field  ; and let it be wet with the dew of heaven , and let his portion be with the beasts of the field , till seven times pass over him  ;
The  Lord  is well pleased for his righteousness  sake  ; he will magnify the law , and make it honourable .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u long U Blei uba kwah eh ban pynim , kumta u kyntiew ïa ki aiñ bad ki jinghikai jong u , bad u kwah ba ki briew jong u ki burom ïa ki .
Weng noh ïa ki nongai jingmut bymman na khmat u syiem , bad ïa ka jingsynshar jong u yn tip na ka bynta ka Jingbishar dkhoh jong ka .
translation.en: Take away the wicked from before the king , and his throne shall be established in righteousness .

translation.kha: U lah ban buhrieh arsap ïa la ka jingisih , hynrei baroh kin ïohi ïa kiei kiei kiba ba-bymman ba u leh .
translation.en: Whose hatred is covered by deceit , his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation .

And that they should publish and proclaim in all their cities , and in Jerusalem , saying , Go forth unto the mount , and fetch olive branches , and pine branches , and myrtle branches , and palm branches , and branches of thick trees , to make booths , as it is written .
translation.kha: Kumta ki ai ïa kine ki jingbthah bad ki phah ïa ki sha baroh ha Jerusalem bad kiwei pat ki nongbah bad ki shnong :  Khie leit sha ki lum bad pom ïa ki tnat na ki dieng Kseh , ki dieng Olib , ki dieng Martl , ki dieng Tlai bad kiwei ki dieng , ban shna ïingtrep kat kum ki jingbthah ba la thoh ha ka Hukum .
Haba ki kherub ki sangeh , ki shisnem ruh ki sangeh ; bad hato ki kherub ki them , ki shalyntem ruh ki leit lang bad ki , namar ki kherub ki pynïaid ïa ki .
translation.en: When they stood , these stood  ; and when they were lifted up , these lifted up themselves also : for the spirit of the living creature was in them .

translation.kha: Ki buid ïa ka jingshisha U Blei da ka jinglamler ; ki mane sad shakri ïa kai kaba U Blei u la thaw , ha ka iaka shun mane bad shakri ïa U Nongthaw hi , ïa uba dei ban ïaroh jongno ! Amen .
translation.en: Who changed the truth of God into a lie , and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator , who is blessed for ever . Amen .

translation.kha: hynrei u la khang ïa de ban tei ïa ka , namar nga dih u nongïaleh thma bad nga lah pynmong shibun ka snam .
translation.en: But God said unto me , Thou shalt not build an house for my name , because thou hast been a man of war , and hast shed blood .

translation.kha: U phah ïa ka kynhun shipai jngai u ban tur ïaleh ïa nga ; ki tih ïa ki kharai ban rah bad ki kerkut ïa ka ïingjaiñ jong nga .
translation.en: His troops come together , and raise up their way against me , and encamp round about my tabernacle .

translation.kha: U Moses bad u Aaron ki la long ki lyngdoh jong u , Bad u Samuel u la long uwei uba la ïadie ha u ; kiba la khiat Kyrpad ïa U Trai , bad u la jaboh ïa ki .
translation.en: Moses and Aaron among his priests , and Samuel among them that call upon his name  ; they called upon the  Lord  , and he answered them .

translation.kha: bun khang ïa phi na kaba leh ïa ka bymdei . Kin sumar ïa phi na ki briew’ kiba pynkhiah jingkulmar da kaei kaba ki krensih —
translation.en: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man , from the man that speaketh froward things  ;

translation.kha: Ha u Timothi , u khup ba-ieit jong nga : To ai ba U Blei ibha U Kpa bad U Khrist ju uba U Trai jong ngi un ai ha me ïa ka jingaiei , ka jingjanai , mala ka jingsuk .
translation.en: To Timothy , my dearly beloved son : Grace , mercy , and peace , from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord .

translation.kha: To thoh ka jingbuaid shaphang kine ki hynñiew bynta bad wallam ïa ka sha nga . Nangta ngan kynoi sbai ba-bang ïakren bad U Trai U Blei jong ngi na ka bynta jong phoi .
translation.en: Ye shall therefore describe the land into seven parts , and bring the description hither to me , that I may cast lots for you here before the  Lord  our God .

translation.kha: Naduh kata ka por ka Edom ka la loit na ka Judah . Ha kane kajuh ka por ka nongbah Laban ruh ka ainong ïaleh pyrshah .
translation.en: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day . Then Libnah revolted at the same time .

translation.kha: Hynrei Khyndiat ki symbai u la khup ha ka khñiot kaba beh , dara ki jingthung ki la pynmih symboh ; katto katne ki la pynmih shispah tylli , kiwei pat hynriewphew tylli , bad kiwei pat laiphew tylli .
translation.en: But other fell into good ground , and brought forth fruit , some an hundredfold , some sixtyfold , some thirtyfold .

translation.kha: Te U Trai u la ai ïa Kanah ka khubor sha ki briew lyngba u Haggai u nongïalap :
translation.en: Then came the word of the  Lord  by Haggai the prophet , saying ,

Therefore now let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant , that it may continue for ever before thee : for thou , O Lord  God  , hast spoken it : and with thy blessing let the house of thy servant be blessed for ever .
translation.kha: Nga kyrpad ïa me ban kyrkhu ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong nga khnang ba kin ïai ïohpdiang ïa ka jinglehbha jong me . Ma me , A  Trai  Nongsynshar , me la kular ïa kane , bad ka jingkyrkhu jong me kan ïaisah bad ki khun ki ksiew jong nga junom .
U patsha , ryngkat bad ka mahadei kaba shong ha syndah jong u , u la mynjur ïa ka jingpyrsad jyllang nga . U la kylli ïa nga katto slem ngan jah bad ba ngan wan phai patan , Bad nga ïathuh ha u .
translation.en: And the king said unto me , ( the queen also sitting by him , ) For how long shall thy journey be ? and when wilt thou return ? So it pleased the king to send me  ; and I set him a time .

translation.kha: Lada u briew u leh pah pyrshah ïa la u parabriew , U Bel u ha ban ïasaid na ka bynta jong u ; hynrei mano ba lah ba-bang ïadoh na ka pynbha u briew uba leh pop pyrthuh ïa U tharai ? Khynñiuh kim shym sngaid ïa la u kpa , naba U Trai u la thmu ban pynïap ïa ki .
translation.en: If one man sin against another , the judge shall judge him : but if a man sin against the  Lord  , who shall entreat for him ? Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto the voice of their father , because the  Lord  would slay them .

translation.kha: Ki lyngdoh kim dei ban dih Kano ïano ka waiñ shuwa ban leit sping hapoh ka phyllaw kaba kham shapoh .
translation.en: Neither shall any priest drink wine , when they enter into the inner court .

translation.kha: U dat ka bakha , ka Esther , ka ka kyrteng Hebru jong ka , ka longsyiem ka Hadassah ; ka long ka samla ba-bhabriew , bad ka don ka rynïeng ryñiot ba-itynnat . Ha ka jingïap noh ki kmie ki kpa jong ka , u Mordekai u la ri bad pynheh pynsan ïa ka kum la ka jong ka khup .
translation.en: And he brought up Hadassah , that is , Esther , his uncle s daughter : for she had neither father nor mother , and the maid was fair and beautiful  ; whom Mordecai , when her father and mother were dead , took for his own daughter .
Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa , who labour in the Lord . Salute the beloved Persis , which laboured much in the Lord .
translation.kha: Ki jingkhublei jong nga ïa ka Truphina bad ka Truphosa , kiba trei ha ka kam U Trai bad ïa ka paralok ba-ieit jong nga , ka Persis , kaba la trei shibun ka kam na ka bynta U Trai .

translation.en: Then thus came every maiden unto the king  ; whatsoever she desired was given her to go with her out of the house of the women unto the king s house .
translation.kha: Haba ka leit na ka ïing ki kynthei sha ka ïingsyiem , ka lah ban riam kano kano ka jingriam kaba ka kwah .

translation.en: And God said unto Moses , I AM THAT I AM : and he said , Thus shalt thou say unto the children of Israel , I AM hath sent me unto you .
translation.kha: U Blei u ong ha u Moses ,  NGA LONG UBA NGA LONG . Kane ka long kaei kaba me dei ban ong ha ki : ‘ Uta ïa uba la khot UBA NGA LONG u phah ïa nga sha phi .’

translation.en: Because he hath loosed my cord , and afflicted me , they have also let loose the bridle before me .
translation.kha: Namar ba U Blei u la pynlong ïa nga uba tlot bad u bym lah leh ei ei , ki phai pyrshah ïa nga da ka jingbitar jong ki baroh .

translation.en: And they called Barnabas , Jupiter  ; and Paul , Mercurius , because he was the chief speaker .
translation.kha: Ki la khot ïa u Barnabas da ka kyrteng Seus , bad ïa u Paul da ka kyrteng Hermes , namar ba u long u nongkren uba kham ha khmat .

translation.en: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord , Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father , that he hath sent comforters unto thee ? hath not David rather sent his servants unto thee , to search the city , and to spy it out , and to overthrow it ?
translation.kha: ki nongïalam jong ki Ammon ki ong ha u syiem ,  Hato phi pyrkhat ba ka dei na ka bynta ka burom jong u kpa jong phi ba u Dabid u la phah ïa kine ki rangbah ban pynpaw ka jingsngewlem ha phi ? Ym kumta da shisha ! U la phah ïa ki hangne kum ki nongsyntiat ban swar ïa ka nongbah , ba kumta u lah ban jop ïa ngi !
Baroh kin ïor ba ma Nga , U Trai , nga la thang ïa ka bad ba yn ym don mano myn ba lah ban pynlip ïa ka .
translation.en: And all flesh shall see that I the  Lord  have kindled it : it shall not be quenched .

translation.kha: Naba , ka Jingthoh Bakhuid ka ong , Ka khyndew bad kiei kiei kiba don ha ka ki longsem ki jong U Trai .
translation.en: For the earth is the Lord s , and the fulness thereof .

translation.kha: Naba a a uba ai khublei da ka jingsuk , u kylla long uba ïakylliang ha ki kam sniew ba u leh .
translation.en: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds .

translation.kha: Balei Phim sngewtynnad ianga ?
translation.en: Why don't you like me ?

translation.kha: u Us umbiah nyngkong , u Bubastis u para jong u , u Kemuel u kpa jongngi u Aram ,
translation.en: Huz his firstborn , and Buz his brother , and Kemuel the father of Aram ,
And king Solomon , and all the congregation of Israel , that were assembled unto him , were with him before the ark , sacrificing sheep and oxen , that could not be told nor numbered for multitude .
translation.kha: U syiem Solomon bad ki paid Israel baroh ki ïalumlang ha khmat ka Synduk ka Jutang bad ki kñia ainguh da bun bah ki langbrot bad ki masi — bun katta katta bym lah ñiew shuh .

translation.en: And I will destroy your high places , and cut down your images , and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols , and my soul shall abhor you .
translation.kha: Ngan pynjot ïa ki jaka mane blei jong phi kiba ha ki lum , ngan pynpra ïa ki duwan thang jingiwbih jong phi , bad ngan bret ïa ki metïap jong phi halor ki bleithaw jong phi kiba la kyllon .

Ki nongsynran jong ngi ki la da don hapoh ka nongbah Dan ; ngi ïohsngew ïa ka jingsawa pynhiar mynsiem jngai ki kulai jong ki . Ka ri borbah kawei ka khynñiuh hato ki kulai jong ki , ki pah . Ki nongshun jong me ki la wei ban pynjot ïa ka ri jongngi ngi bad ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba ha ka , ka nongbah jong i'u bad baroh ki briew jong ka .
translation.en: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan : the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones  ; for they are come , and have devoured the land , and all that is in it  ; the city , and those that dwell therein .

translation.kha: Ym dih namar ka hok jong phin ne ka jinglong beit ha ka dohnud ba phin ïohkynti ïa ka ri jong ki , hynrei ka longïing namar ka jingbymman Jong kita ki jaitbynriew ba U Trai U Blei jong phi u la beh krad ïa ki na khmat jong phi ; ba un pynskhem ïa la ka Kular ba u la ai ha ki kpa tymmen jong phira , u Abraham , u Isaak , bad u Jakob .
translation.en: Not for thy righteousness , or for the uprightness of thine heart , dost thou go to possess their land : but for the wickedness of these nations the  Lord  thy God doth drive them out from before thee , and that he may perform the word which the  Lord  sware unto thy fathers , Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob .

translation.kha: Kumta ka long malu ka jingngeit : Lada ka long tang ma ka hi bad kam kynthup ïa ki kam , te ka long kaba ïap .
translation.en: Even so faith , if it hath not works , is dead , being alone .

translation.kha: A Trai Nongsynshar , me la thaw ïa ka khyndew bad ka suiñbneng da ka bor Bad ka borbah bakhraw ; ym don katba eh than ïa me .
translation.en: Ah Lord  God  ! behold , thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm , and there is nothing too hard for thee :

translation.kha: Haba u la iar bad u la ïohi kumno U blang u la kyrkhu ïa ki briew’ , u la kmen bad u la kyntu ïa ki baroh don ïaineh bad ban long kiba ba-beit ha U Trai da ka dohnud jong ki baroh .
translation.en: Who , when he came , and had seen the grace of God , was glad , and exhorted them all , that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord .
But these five kings fled , and hid themselves in a cave at Makkedah .
translation.kha: Ki san ngut ki syiem Amor , pynban , ki la phet ïap bad rieh hapoh ka krem ha Makkedah .

translation.en: Is any thing too hard for the  Lord  ? At the time appointed I will return unto thee , according to the time of life , and Sarah shall have a son .
translation.kha: Hato don kaei kaei kaba eh ïa U  Trai  ? Kumba nga la ong , ngan sa wan biang hadien khyndai bnai , bad ka Sarah kan sa ïoh khun shynrang .
Kumta ka Ruth ka la trei sad ki bad ka la kad kiaw haduh ban da dep ot lut ïa u barli bad ïa u khie baroh . Bad ka la ïailong sah bad la ka kiei kurim .
translation.en: So she kept fast by the maidens of Boaz to glean unto the end of barley harvest and of wheat harvest  ; and dwelt with her mother in law .

translation.kha: Namar kata nga la pynbna da ka jingpynshisha ba ha ka ïing u Eli yn ym ei jingkñia lane ka jingainguh kaba lah ban weng noh ïa kane ka pop bashyrkhei ba ka ïing jong u ka la leh .
translation.en: And therefore I have sworn unto the house of Eli , that the iniquity of Eli s house shall not be purged with sacrifice nor offering for ever .
Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God , or that is worshipped ; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God , shewing himself that he is God .
translation.kha: Un pyrshah ïa kaei kaei baroh ba la khot blei , lane ïa kano kano ban mane , bad un buh ïa lade halor jong ki baroh . Wat shapoh un leit rung bad shong hapoh ka Templ U Blei bad kam ba u long U Blei .
Katba u Moses u dang khong ha Midian , U Trai u ong ha u , Khie leit phai sha jingïaphet , namar ba kito baroh kiba thmu Ban pynïap ïa me ki la ïap .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses in Midian , Go , return into Egypt : for all the men are dead which sought thy life .

translation.kha: U hima u leh pop marpyrshah ïa U Trai bad u bud ïa ki jingleh bymman jong u Shimei Jeroboam , uba la ïalam ïa ki Israel ban leh Pop .
translation.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the  Lord   ; he departed not from all the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat , who made Israel sin : but he walked therein .

And then the  Lord s  wrath be kindled against you , and he shut up the heaven , that there be no rain , and that the land yield not her fruit  ; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the  Lord  giveth you .
translation.kha: Lada phi leh kumta , U  Trai  un khie bitar ïa phi . Un khang khop ïa u slap , bad ka khyndew jong phi kan tyrkhong eh ba ki jingthung kin ym mih shuh . Te phin sa ïap shen hangta , wat la kata ka khyndew kaba u ai ha phi ka long kaba seisoh .
Ha ka jingshisha na da kwah ba baroh na phi phin long kum ma nga ; hynrei Uei pa uwei u don ïa ka jingai kaba kyrpang na U Blei , uwei da kane ka jingai , ïa uwei pat da katai ka jingjia .
translation.en: For I would that all men were even as I myself . But every man hath his proper gift of God , one after this manner , and another after that .

translation.kha: U Trai un shoh ïa phoi da ka jingkhrew , da ka khohwah , da ka jingat sting , bad da ka jingshit kyr-ang ; un phan ruh ïa ka jingryngkhiang , ki lyer khluit , ban pynjot ïa ki jingthung jong phi . Kine ki jingpynjot kin ïailong bad phi haduh ba pher da ïap .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall smite thee with a consumption , and with a fever , and with an inflammation , and with an extreme burning , and with the sword , and with blasting , and with mildew  ; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish .
But Jesus turned him about , and when he saw her , he said ,  Daughter , be of good comfort  ; thy faith hath made thee whole .  And the woman was made whole from that hour .
translation.kha: U Jisu u la phai sawdong bad u la ïohi ïa ka , bad u la ong ,  To long shlur , ko ka khun jong nga ! Ka jingngeit jong pha ka la pynkoit ïa pha .  Ha kata ka khyllipmat ka kynthei ka la koit .

Hynrei khawai pat ki briew ki hir kum ki symbai ba la set ha ka khyndew kaba bha . Ki ïohsngew ïa ka khohruh , ki Pdiang ïa ka , bad ki seisoh : katto katba laiphew , katto katne hynriewphew , bad katto katne shispah .
translation.en: And these are they which are sown on good ground  ; such as hear the word , and receive it , and bring forth fruit , some thirtyfold , some sixty , and some an hundred .
But there the glorious  Lord  will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams  ; wherein shall go no galley with oars , neither shall gallant ship pass thereby .
translation.kha: U  Trai  un pyn-i ha ngi ïa ka burom jong u . Ngin shong ngin sah harud ki wah bad ki wahduid kiba ïar , hynrei ki liengbah jong ki nongshun kin ym ïaid ha ki .

translation.en: And they withstood Uzziah the king , and said unto him , It appertaineth not unto thee , Uzziah , to burn incense unto the  Lord  , but to the priests the sons of Aaron , that are consecrated to burn incense : go out of the sanctuary  ; for thou hast trespassed  ; neither shall it be for thine honour from the  Lord  God .
translation.kha: Ki ong ,  Ko Ussaïah ! Phim don hok ban thang jingiwbih ha U  Trai . Dei tang ki lyngdoh kiba hiarpateng na u Aaron ïa kiba la pynkyntang ban leh ïa kane . Khie mihnoh na kane ka jaka kyntang . Phi la pynsngewsih ïa U Trai U Blei , bad phin ym ïoh shuh ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong u .

translation.en: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest :
translation.kha: Phim dei ban leit rah ïa la ki jingainguh kat shaba phi ibit ;

translation.en: Is he the God of the Jews only ? is he not also of the Gentiles ? Yes , of the Gentiles also :
translation.kha: Lane ba U Blei u long U Blei tang jong ki Jiw ? Hato um dei U Blei jong ki Jentil ruh ? Da shisha u dei .

U Ïoannis u la kren shaphang jong u . U la pyrta khim , Une u long uta ïa uba nga la kren shaphang jong u , mynhynne de la ong , ‘ U wan hadien jong nga , hynrei u kham khraw ban ïa nga , namar u la don shuwa ban kha ïa nga .’
translation.en: John bare witness of him , and cried , saying , This was he of whom I spake , He that cometh after me is preferred before me : for he was before me .

translation.kha: hynriew haba nga ong , Ngan klet khong ïa U Trai bad kan ym krai shuh ha ka kyrteng jong u , te ka khohruh jong me ka long kum ka ryndang kabu klang jylliew haw jngai nga . Nga la pyrshang kat kaba nga lah ban kun ïa ka , hawei ngam lah ban bat ïa ka .
translation.en: Then I said , I will not make mention of him , nor speak any more in his name . But his word was in mine heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones , and I was weary with forbearing , and I could not stay .
For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness  ; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely .
translation.kha: Uwei pa uwei , uba khraw bad uba rit , u pyrshang ban shna pisa da ka jingbymhok ; wat ki nongïathuhlypa bad ki lyngdoh ki thok ïa ki briew .

translation.en: See that none render evil for evil unto any man ; but ever follow that which is good , both among yourselves , and to all men .
translation.kha: Khmih ba uno uno un ym siew kylliang ïa kaba sniew da kaba sniew , hynrei ha ki por baroh to kut jingmut ban lehbha iwei ïa iwei pat bad ïa ki briew baroh .
Haoid Nga ieid ia phi .
translation.en: Yes , I love you .

translation.kha: Hangno ka hok jong u Ïing ban pynbaptis ka wan : hato ka long na U Blei ne na u briew ? Ki la sdang ban ïasynran prie ma ki , Aïu ngin ïa-ong ? ïada ngi jubab ‘ Na U Blei ,’ un ong ha im’ , ‘ Balei , te , phim ngeit ïa u Ïoannis ?’
translation.en: The baptism of John , whence was it ? from heaven , or of men ?  And they reasoned with themselves , saying , If we shall say , From heaven  ; he will say unto us , Why did ye not then believe him ?

translation.kha: Ka Gomer ka la khia ïa i khun ba ar — ha kane ka por da i kynthei . U thri u la ong ha u Hosia , Pynkyrteng ïa ka , ‘ ka Lo-Ruhamah’ nalor ngan ym pyn-i jingkheit shuh ïa ki briew ka Israel , lane map ïa ki .
translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a daughter . And God said unto him , Call her name Lo–ruhamah : for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel  ; but I will utterly take them away .
And Moses said unto the children of Israel , See , the  Lord  hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri , the son of Hur , of the tribe of Judah  ;
translation.kha: U Moses u ong ha ki Israel ,  U  Trai  u la jied ïa u Besalel , u khun jong u Uri bad u khun ksiew jong u Hur , na ka jait Judah .
U la jubab , U briew uba la pynkhiah ïa ar u la ong ha nga ba len ramhah ïa ka jingthiah bad ban ïaid .
translation.en: He answered them , He that made me whole , the same said unto me ,  Take up thy bed , and walk .

translation.kha: Hynrei ka ong ha la u kpa , To leh Kanneh kawei ïa nga . Ai nga ïa nga ar bnai ba ngan ioh leit shaw ki lum bad la ki paralok , ban ïa-ïaid sngewsih ba nga dei ban ïap khem kaba dang sotti .
translation.en: And she said unto her father , Let this thing be done for me : let me alone two months , that I may go up and down upon the mountains , and bewail my virginity , I and my fellows .

translation.kha: Ki khem ïa ki sieh Olib na ka bynta ka umphniang , bad ïa ki sohwaiñ na ka bynta ka um sohwaiñ , hynrei ma ki ïa lade pat ki thynrang .
translation.en: Which make oil within their walls , and tread their winepresses , and suffer thirst .
Two men went up into the temple to pray  ; the one a Pharisee , and the other a publican .
translation.kha: Shisien la don ar ngut ki rangbah kiba la leit sha ka Templ ban duwai : Uwei u la long u Pharisi , uwei pat u long u nonglum khajna .
ishyrkhei ki la ïaleh pyrshah ïa u bad ki la pynsngewsih ïa U Mynsiem Bakhuid jong u . Namar kata U Trai u la kylla long u nongshun jong ki bad u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa ki .
translation.en: But they rebelled , and vexed his holy Spirit : therefore he was turned to be their enemy , and he fought against them .

translation.kha: kin kopi da ka jaiñ khain bad kin ktieh ha ki jaka baroh . Yn Kada lyndum ïa ki khlieh jong ki , bad yn pynkyrteng ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth , and horror shall cover them  ; and shame shall be upon all faces , and baldness upon all their heads .

translation.kha: Ki la pyntngit ïa ka Templ jong de da kabu shah ïa ki nongwei bym shym la otsher , ki briew ki bymkohnguh ïa nga ban rung sha ka Thep katba ïa ka khlaw bad ka snam jong ki jingkieng la dang ainguh ha ang . Kumta ki briew lad nga ki la pynkheiñ ïa ka jingong jong nga da baroh kiei kiei kiba ijli kiba ki la leh .
translation.en: In that ye have brought into my sanctuary strangers , uncircumcised in heart , and uncircumcised in flesh , to be in my sanctuary , to pollute it , even my house , when ye offer my bread , the fat and the blood , and they have broken my covenant because of all your abominations .

translation.kha: Phim lah ban dih na ka khuri U Trai bad ruh na ka khuri ki ksuid ; phim da ba ïabam na ka miej U Trei bad ruh na ka miej ki ksuid .
translation.en: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord , and the cup of devils : ye cannot be partakers of the Lord s table , and of the table of devils .
