translation.kha: Ngan pynshisha ha phiah , te ba U Khun U Beeri u don ka bor ha ka pyrthei baneh map ïa ki pop! . Kumta u la ong ha uta u biria ba la ïapshiliang ,
translation.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins ,  ( he saith to the sick of the palsy , )

translation.kha: Ngan sa pynlong ïa ka ri ka jaka kynjah , mala ka bor ka ki ju sngewsarong mawria katta kan sa kut noh . Ki lumbah ka Israel kin long khlur kynjah ba ym don naba nud ban leit jingleit lyngba jong ki .
translation.en: For I will lay the land most desolate , and the pomp of her strength shall cease  ; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate , that none shall pass through .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet ngan ïadait lyngba ïa ka ri Ijipt , da kaba pynïap ïa u khwan jingsuk baroh , la u dei u briew ne u mrad , bad Ngan pynshitom ïa ki phai ka ri jingpeit baroh . NGA un-long U Trai .
translation.en: For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night , and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt , both man and beast  ; and against all the gods of Egypt I will execute judgment : I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: bad ki la pynlut ïa ka por jong ki baroh hapoh ka Templ da kaba jingeh ïa U Blei .
translation.en: And were continually in the temple , praising and blessing God . Amen .

translation.kha: Haba ïa u lehbeiñ ym pud shym la kha , hynrei u la long , kamon ban shu ong , ha ka jingsawa u kpa tymmen jong u , u Abraham lehbha u Melkhisedek u la ïakynduh ïa u .
translation.en: For he was yet in the loins of his father , when Melchisedec met him .
But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days : but , lo , Michael , one of the chief princes , came to help me  ; and I remained there with the kings of Persia .
translation.kha: U angel jong u khun syiem jong ka hima Persia u la ïaleh pyrshah ïa nga haduh arphew wei sngi . Nangta u Mikhael , uwei na ki angel rangbah , u la wan ban ïarap ïa nga , namar nga la shah iehnoh marwei hangta ha Persia .
Ko Moab , pha shane ha la ka jingkhleh bad ha la ka shab , hynrei myntri dak ïa pha ruh yn jop khong ; ïa u blei Khemosh jongno pha yn ringmraw , lem bad ki khun syiem dara ki lyngdoh .
translation.en: For because thou hast trusted in thy works and in thy treasures , thou shalt also be taken : and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together .
For he will finish the work , and cut it short in righteousness : because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth .
translation.kha: naba U Trai un pyndep kloi kloi ïa ka jingainong ba-pura na ka bynta ka pyrthei .

translation.en: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubilee to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month , in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land .
translation.kha: Nangta , ha ka sngi kaba shiphew jong u bnai uba hynñiew , kaba dei ka Sngi ka Jingpynïasuk , phah ïa u briew ban pynsawa ïa ka turoi ha ka ri baroh kawei .

translation.en: Most congregations of Jehovah’s Witnesses have meetings three times each week .
translation.kha: Bun na ki balang jong Ki Nongsakhi U Jehobah ki ju pynlong jingïaseng arsien shitaiew .
Ngan pynpang ruh ïa ki nong ibieit ba kin sngewburom ïa phi khnang ba ynda ki briew jong nga kin mih , kin ym mihnoh thylli .
translation.en: And I will give this people favour in the sight of the Egyptians : and it shall come to pass , that , when ye go , ye shall not go empty :

translation.kha: Nangta ki pyniar hapdeng ki briew , kat kum ki kynjoh longïing , ïa ki jingiw na ka bynta ki jingainguh thang , khnang ba kine lah Ban ai ïa ki kat kamon ki jingbthah ha ka Hukum u Moses .
translation.en: And they removed the burnt offerings , that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people , to offer unto the  Lord  , as it is written in the book of Moses . And so did they with the oxen .

translation.kha: Mynta , phi lah ban iohi bad ïohsngew da lade aïu une u Paul u ni . U noh ba ki blei kiba la shna da ki kti Jong ki briew kim long da shisha ki blei , bad u la jop ha kaba pynkohnguh ïa kiba bun ki briew , hangne ha Ephesos bad hajan barben kawei jong ka probins jong ka Asia .
translation.en: Moreover ye see and hear , that not alone at Ephesus , but almost throughout all Asia , this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people , saying that they be no gods , which are made with hands :

translation.kha: Ki briew ki pynkynriah ïa ki mawpud ban kurup jaka shuh ; ki tuh ïa ki longïng bad buh ïa ki ha la ki jong ki kynjah jong ki .
translation.en: Some remove the landmarks  ; they violently take away flocks , and feed thereof .

translation.kha: Da ka buit shukor u shem un ïoh ïa ka jingkyrshan Jong kito babha la iehnoh ïa la ka niam , hynrei kito uba bud ïa U Blei ngin ïalang pyrshah .
translation.en: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries : but the people that do know their God shall be strong , and do exploits .

translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , haba U Trai u pynpyut ïa phi , da shahshkor bha , bad shim ïa ka kumne ka jingmaham .
translation.en: My son , despise not the chastening of the  Lord   ; neither be weary of his correction :

translation.kha: Katba u syiem bad ki briew jong u baroh ki la iehnoh ïa ka nongbah , ki la sangeh ha ka ïing katba khiat .
translation.en: And the king went forth , and all the people after him , and tarried in a place that was far off .

translation.kha: Katto katne ñiut ki briew ki la wallam ïa ki khunlung jong ki sha U Jisu ba un buh ïa ki kti jong u hajar jong ki . Ki synran ki la ïohi ïa ki malu ki la kynhied ïa ki naba ki leh kumta ,
translation.en: And they brought unto him also infants , that he would touch them : but when his disciples saw it , they rebuked them .
And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem : and he went out again through the people from Beer–sheba to mount Ephraim , and brought them back unto the  Lord  God of their fathers .
translation.kha: Wat la u syiem Jehoshaphat u shong u sah ha Jerusalem , u leit borabor sha ki briew , na Beersheba shaphang shathie shaduh kaba kut jong ka ri lum Ephraim shaphang shatei , khnang ban khot pat ïa ki briew sha U  Trai  , U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong ki .

translation.en: ( Now the children of Benjamin heard that the children of Israel were gone up to Mizpah . ) Then said the children of Israel , Tell us , how was this wickedness ?
translation.kha: Ha kata hi ka por ki paid Benjamin ki ïohsngew ba ki para jait Israel baroh ki la ïalumlang ha Mispah . Ki Israel ki kylli ,  Ïathuh ïa ngi , kumno kane ka kam runar ka la jia ?

translation.en: Now therefore ye with the council signify to the chief captain that he bring him down unto you to morrow , as though ye would enquire something more perfectly concerning him : and we , or ever he come near , are ready to kill him .
translation.kha: Mynta te , ma phi bad ka Dorbar to phah ktien sha u rangbah ai hukum ka kynhun shipai Rom ban wallam ïa u Paul sha phi , da kaba leh mynleh ba phi kwah ban ïoh ka jingtip kaba thikna shaphang jong u . Hynrei ngin long kiba la khreh ban pynïap ïa u ha shuwa ba un poi hangne .

translation.en: And she put her widow s garments off from her , and covered her with a veil , and wrapped herself , and sat in an open place , which is by the way to Timnah  ; for she saw that Shelah was grown , and she was not given unto him to wife .
translation.kha: Kumta ka la kylliang ïa ki jaiñ riewkynthei ba ka phong , ka la tap ïa la ka khmat da ka jingkah khmat , bad ka la leit shong ha ka khyrdop ban rung sha Enaim , ka shnong kaba don ha ka lynti sha Timnah . Kumba ka la tip bha ba u Shelah u khun khatduh jong u Judah , u la rangbah mynta , pynban ym pat shym la ai ïa ka ha u ban shongkurim .

Ale bad bam ïa ka doh jongno ki syiem , ki nongïalam shipai , Bad jong ki shipai , ka deng jong ki kulai bad ki nongshong jong ki , ka doh jongngi ki briew baroh , ki saraw bad kiba laitluid , kiba rit bad kiba khroh !
translation.en: That ye may eat the flesh of kings , and the flesh of captains , and the flesh of mighty men , and the flesh of horses , and of them that sit on them , and the flesh of all men , both free and bond , both small and great .

translation.kha: Kane ka long ka sngi jong U Trai Nongsynshar Badonbor Baroh : ha kane ka sngi un pynmutlop ; ha kane ka sngi un pynshitom ïa ki nongsynran jongngi u . Ka waitlam jong u kuna bam ïa ki haduh ïa-ban da kdang , pynlang dih ïa ka snam jong ki haduh ban da sngewhun . Ha kane ka sngaid u badonbok Baroh u kñia ïa kiba la shah pynmong ha ka phang bashatei , hajan ka Ijipt .
translation.en: For this is the day of the Lord  God  of hosts , a day of vengeance , that he may avenge him of his adversaries : and the sword shall devour , and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood : for the Lord  God  of hosts hath a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates .

translation.kha: Katto katne per hadien Kanah , U Tlai u la bthah ïa nga
translation.en: Then the word of the  Lord  came unto Jeremiah the prophet , after that Hananiah the prophet had broken the yoke from off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah , saying ,
And the sound of the cherubims  wings was heard even to the outer court , as the voice of the Almighty God when he speaketh .
translation.kha: Ka jingriew ki thapniang ki kherub ka sawa shaduh ka phyllaw kaba shabar . Ka sawa kum ka sur kren U Blei Badonbor Baroh .

Hadien sanphew sngi , u Shaniah , u Rangbah Lyngdoh u la wait sha Kaisaria lem bad katai katne ngut ki tymmen ki san bad uwei u riewsaid aiñ uba kyrteng u Tertullos . Ki la wan ha khmat jong u Pheliks bad ki la ai ïa ki jingmudui jongu ki pyrshah ïa u Apollos .
translation.en: And after five days Ananias the high priest descended with the elders , and with a certain orator named Tertullus , who informed the governor against Paul .
Shadrach , Meshach , and Abed–nego , answered and said to the king , O Nebuchadnezzar , we are not careful to answer thee in this matter .
translation.kha: U Shadrakh , u Meshakh , bad u Abednego ki la jubab ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , ngin ym pyrshang ban ïasaid da ïa lade .
nangta u Darius u phah ïa kano ka jubab : Ha u Tattenai , u lytar jongno ka Ïuphratis Sepngi , u Sephathah Bosenai , malade ki para ïabah synshar ha Ïuphratis Sepngi .
translation.en: Now therefore , Tatnai , governor beyond the river , Shethar–bozenai , and your companions the Apharsachites , which are beyond the river , be ye far from thence :

translation.kha: u la ong , To ïamihnoh shabar baroh ! Ka khynnah rit kam shym ïap — ka shu ïohthiah ! Te ki baroh ki la ïa-rkhie ïa u .
translation.en: He said unto them ,  Give place : for the maid is not dead , but sleepeth .  And they laughed him to scorn .

translation.kha: Ki dat ban long kiba pynbhabriew , kiba nep jingput , kiba la ïoh jinghikai bha , bakha tait ban nang , pynlang kiba lehse na ka jinganna , ba katkum kin lah ban long kiba bit ban shakri ha ka ïingbishar jongnga u syiem . U Ashpenas u dih baneh hikai ïa ki ban pule bad ban thoh ïa ka ktien ki nong Babilonia .
translation.en: Children in whom was no blemish , but well favoured , and skilful in all wisdom , and cunning in knowledge , and understanding science , and such as had ability in them to stand in the king s palace , and whom they might teach the learning and the tongue of the Chaldeans .
And they conspired against him , and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U syiem Joash u la ïasnohkti ha ka jingïasylla pyrshah ïa u Sekharaïah , bad ha ka hukum jong u syiem , ki paidbah ki la lynthem maw ïa u Sekharaïah ha ka phyllaw ka Templ .
Haba u syep u la ïohsngew ïa kano , u la sngewsih eh bad u la leh ïa kaba bha tam ban shem lad ban pyllait im ïa u Daniel . U la ïai pyrshang haduh ban da sep sngi .
translation.en: Then the king , when he heard these words , was sore displeased with himself , and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him : and he laboured till the going down of the sun to deliver him .

Wherefore have we fasted , say they , and thou seest not ? wherefore have we afflicted our soul , and thou takest no knowledge ? Behold , in the day of your fast ye find pleasure , and exact all your labours .
translation.kha: Ki briew ki kylli ,  Balei ngin shahjingit , lada U  Trai  um patiaw ? Balei ngi dei ban leit khlem bam lada um shahshkor ?  U  Trai  u ong ïa ki ,  Ka jingshisha ka long ba ha kajuh ka por ba phi shahjingit , phi ïabeh ïa la ki jong ki jingmyntoi bad banbeiñ ïa la ki nongtrei .

translation.en: And he blessed him , and said , Blessed be Abram of the most high God , possessor of heaven and earth :
translation.kha: u la kyrkhu ïa u , bad u ong ,  To U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh , u nongthaw ïa ka bneng bad ïa ka khyndew , un kyrkhu ïa u Abram !
Lymda ka kjat kan ong , Namar ba ngam de ka kti , te meng dei ka jong ka jingsawa , dat kam pynlong ïa ka , ba kdew dei ka dkhot jong ka met .
translation.en: If the foot shall say , Because I am not the hand , I am not of the body ; is it therefore not of the body ?
Also he built Beth–horon the upper , and Beth–horon the nether , fenced cities , with walls , gates , and bars  ;
translation.kha: U Solomon u la tei biang ïa kine ki nongbah : ka Beth Horon Neng bad ka Beth Horon Rum , ( ki nongbah ba la ker kynroh bad ki khyrdop kiba lah ban khang ) ,

translation.en: And Judah said unto Israel his father , Send the lad with me , and we will arise and go  ; that we may live , and not die , both we , and thou , and also our little ones .
translation.kha: U Judah u ong ha la u kpa ,  Phah ïa u para bad nga , bad ngin ïamihnoh kumne kumne . Te yn ym don uwei ruh na ngi u ban ïapthngan .

translation.en: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand , and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes .
translation.kha: Kum ka dak ka jingpynkynmaw , teh ïa ki ha ki ksang ti jong phi bad deng ïa ki ha ki shyllangmat jong phi .

Pynban , paila ki briew na Makedonia kin wan bad nga bad kin Shim ba phim pateng long kiba la kli , katno kan long ka jingpynhun ïa ngi — khlam da kren ïa ka jinglehrain ïa phi — naba ngi la shniah katta ïa phi!
translation.en: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me , and find you unprepared , we ( that we say not , ye ) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting .

translation.kha: Shur ki sohshkor ki un-long ki jingai ba itynnad iaka .
translation.en: A pair of earrings is a nice present for her .

translation.kha: Kane ka jingïohipaw ka la long kum kaba ar la ïohi mynba U Blei u la wan ban pynjot ïa ka Jerusalem , malu kum kaba nga la ïohi tuklar ka wah Khebar . Nangta to la dem pyllup ïa lade ha ka khyndew .
translation.en: And it was according to the appearance of the vision which I saw , even according to the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city : and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar  ; and I fell upon my face .

translation.kha: Hynrei ngan ria da ka jar bad kem ïa ki kum ki sim Katba ki dang ïaid . Ngan pynshitom ïa ki namar ki kam bymneh ba ki la leh .
translation.en: When they shall go , I will spread my net upon them  ; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven  ; I will chastise them , as their congregation hath heard .

translation.kha: Un hiarthma wat ïa ka Ri ka Jingkular bad un pynïap da ki phew hajar , hynrei ki ri Edom , Moab , bad kaei kaba la iehnoh jong ka Ammon kin mait .
translation.en: He shall enter also into the glorious land , and many countries shall be overthrown : but these shall escape out of his hand , even Edom , and Moab , and the chief of the children of Ammon .

translation.kha: Namarkata , to ngin ai jingïaroh ïa U Blei khlem da pud kumin ka jingkñia da U Jisu , kaba long ka jingngeit da ki jingmeng shyntur kiba phla ïa u kum U Tlai .
translation.en: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually , that is , the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name .

translation.kha: Nga tip ïa kaei kaba Pha la leh ; nga tip ba pham lama katba khriat ne kaba shit . Katno nga kwah ba phan jin da la long kawei na kita !
translation.en: I know thy works , that thou art neither cold nor hot : I would thou wert cold or hot .

And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees , branches of palm trees , and the boughs of thick trees , and willows of the brook  ; and ye shall rejoice before the  Lord  your God seven days .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka sngi kaba nyngkong , phin shim ïa ki soh kiba kynsai , ïa ki tnat dieng Tlai , bad ïa ki tnat dieng kiba bun sla , bad sdang ïa kane ka Jingkhawai Niam ban ai burom ïa U  Trai  U Blei jong phi .
Hynñiew ki Pharisi ki la ïong , U dei u rangbah jong ki ksuid uba ai ha u ka bol pun beh noh ïa ki kynhied .
translation.en: But the Pharisees said , He casteth out devils through the prince of the devils .
Who laid the foundations of the earth , that it should not be removed for ever .
translation.kha: Me la buh ïa ka pyrthei ha ki nongrim baskhem , bad yn ym pynkhih shuh ïa ka .
Hangno ki plie kiba phira la thaw na ka bynta ïa laiñ ? Haba ph Don ha ka jingjynjar , ai ba ma ki ktien pyndam ïa phin — ïada ki lah ! Ko Judah Pha la don Sihon ki blem kumba pha don ki nongbah .
translation.en: But where are thy gods that thou hast made thee ? let them arise , if they can save thee in the time of thy trouble : for according to the number of thy cities are thy gods , O Judah .

translation.kha: Nangta U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki synran jong u ban ym ïathuh kur hano ba u longkmie U Messaïah .
translation.en: Then charged he his disciples that they should tell no man that he was Jesus the Christ .
Thus speaketh the  Lord  of hosts , saying , Execute true judgment , and shew mercy and compassions every man to his brother :
translation.kha: La slem bah nga la ai ïa kine ki hukum ha ki briew jong nga : ‘ Phi dei ban peit ba ïa ka jinglehhok la pyndep , bad phi dei ban pyn-i ka jingbhasbun bad ka jingisynei iwei ïa iwei pat .
Ïa ki kynroh den ban tat da shi syrtap ka dieng halor man ki lai syrtap ki mawjam . Ïa baher ki jingpynlut pynsep dei ban siew na ka ïing jingsngewsih syiem .
translation.en: With three rows of great stones , and a row of new timber : and let the expenses be given out of the king s house :

translation.kha: Kumta ngan phah ka ding ha ki kynroh nongbet ka Tyros , bad ka step duh ïa ki kut jong ka .
translation.en: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre , which shall devour the palaces thereof .

translation.kha: To U Blei un kyrkhu ïa uta uba wan ha ka kyrteng jong U Trai ! Na ka Templ jongki U Trai ngi kyrkhu ïa me .
translation.en: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the  Lord  : we have blessed you out of the house of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ym to jingshngain ïa ki nongïapom , ong U Trai .
translation.en: There is no peace , saith my God , to the wicked .
The watchmen that went about the city found me , they smote me , they wounded me  ; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me .
translation.kha: Katno phi long kaba bhabriew eh , ko ba-ieit jong nga ; katno phi long kaba janai !

translation.en: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel , a Pirathonite , judged Israel .
translation.kha: Hadien u Elon , u Abdon u khun jong u Hillel uba na Pirathon u ïalam ïa ki Israel .

translation.en: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Hynrei U  Trai  u la sngewbha eh ïa u Noah .

Ki la ïarah ki pliang , ki khra , mala ki jingap thiah , bad ki jingbam ruh ïa u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u : u kew , u barli , u purew , u khiew sdieh , u rymbai , u mitar , ka ngap , ka ktung dud , ka mawlynnai , bad kato katne ki langbrot . Ki tipthuh ba u Dabid bad ki rangbah jong u ki la ïa-thngan , ki la sliang , sad ki la thait ha ka ri khlaw .
translation.en: And honey , and butter , and sheep , and cheese of kine , for David , and for the people that were with him , to eat : for they said , The people is hungry , and weary , and thirsty , in the wilderness .

translation.kha: Ai ka jingnguh sha U Trei , Naamah u long uba bha’ ; ka jingieit jong u ka long bymïap .
translation.en: O give thanks unto the  Lord   ; for he is good  ; for his mercy endureth for ever .
Say , I am your sign : like as I have done , so shall it be done unto them : they shall remove and go into captivity .
translation.kha: Ïathuh ïa ki ba kaei kaba me la leh ka dei ka dak jong kaei ka ban jia ha ki — kin long ki nongphetwir bad kiba shah ring koidi .

Kiei kaba kham ïa ka kata , u Haman u ïong shuh shuh , ka Esther , ka mahadei , ka la pynpang ka jingkhawai ym na ka bynta jongno jongno , hynrei tang ïa u syiem bad ïa por , bad la khoit sngewkhia biang ïa ngi na ka bynta la shai ka sngi .
translation.en: Haman said moreover , Yea , Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself  ; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king .

translation.kha: Shibun ki briew ki la pule ïa ka , namar ka jaka ha kaba la sahnarphna ïa U Jisu kam da jngai na ka nongkhap . Ka jingthoh ka la long ha ki ktien Hebru , Latin bad Grik .
translation.en: This title then read many of the Jews : for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city : and it was written in Hebrew , and Greek , and Latin .
And Caleb said , He that smiteth Kirjath–sepher , and taketh it , to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife .
translation.kha: Uwei na ki , uba kyrteng u Kaleb u ong ,  Ngan ai ïa ka khun jong nga ka Akhsah ban shongkurim ïa u briew uba jop ha kaba kurup ïa ka Kiriath Sepher .
U Jisu u la ong ha u , Uno uno uba sdang ban lur bad nangta uba ïadei kyrtiang dien um long uba myntoi ïa ka Hima U Blei .
translation.en: And Jesus said unto him ,  No man , having put his hand to the plough , and looking back , is fit for the kingdom of God .

translation.kha: Ko Kynhun jong nga , to pynleit jingmut ïa kaei kaba u kpa bad ka kmie jong phi ki ong ïa phi .
translation.en: My son , hear the instruction of thy father , and forsake not the law of thy mother :

translation.kha: Ko ki Briew jong ka Ijipt , khie leit sha Gilead bad wad ïa ka dawai ! Ki dawai jong pha barben ki la pynshisha ba ktieh myntoi ei ei ; ym don ei ei ba lah ïa-ban pynkhiah ïa pha .
translation.en: Go up into Gilead , and take balm , O virgin , the daughter of Egypt : in vain shalt thou use many medicines  ; for thou shalt not be cured .
And I saw another sign in heaven , great and marvellous , seven angels having the seven last plagues  ; for in them is filled up the wrath of God .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi ha ka suiñbneng ïa kawei pat ka jingïohi kaba maïan , kaba khraw bad kaba iphylla . La don hynñiew ngut ki angel lem bad hynñiew tylli ki khlam , kiba long kiba khatduh , namar ki long ki jingpynpaw kiba khatduh jong ka jingbitar U Blei .

Hynrei kito kiba shaniah ha U Trai ban ïor jingïarap kin shem ba la pynthymmai ïa ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki . Kin ïeng joit ha ki thapniang kum ki pukni ; kin mar bad kin ym sngewlwait ; kin ïaid bad kin ym sngewthait .
translation.en: But they that wait upon the  Lord  shall renew their strength  ; they shall mount up with wings as eagles  ; they shall run , and not be weary  ; and they shall walk , and not faint .
But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven , and destroyed them all .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba u Lot u mih na Sodom , ka ding bad u kyndok ki la hap na bneng bad la pynïap ïa ki baroh .
Kum U Jisu u la sah ïa ki paidbah ban shong ha madan .
translation.en: And he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground .

translation.kha: Ka jingkob jrong ki ka long , U Moses u la shuh ïa u biria ban pynlut da ka jingteh ïa ka jingpynsleh tnga bad iehnoh ïa ka tnga jong u .
translation.en: And they said , Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement , and to put her away .

translation.kha: Ka la im pat , bad ka la khie jied Sidon , bad U Jisu u la hukum ïa ki ban ai ei ei ha ka ba kan bam .
translation.en: And her spirit came again , and she arose straightway : and he commanded to give her meat .

translation.kha: Hynriew ki paidbah ki tang ainong hi sha jngai , bad tang u Moserah uba la leit sha jan u lyoh uba rben ha uba U Blei u don .
translation.en: And the people stood afar off , and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where God was .

translation.kha: U mareh sha u , u ïeng halor jong u , u sei ïa ka waitlam u Goliath na ka jingsop jong ka , bad u ot ïa ka khlieh jong u bad u pynïap ïa u . Ha ki Pisidia ki ïohi ba u rangkynsai jong ki u la shahshkor pynïap , ki phet krad .
translation.en: Therefore David ran , and stood upon the Philistine , and took his sword , and drew it out of the sheath thereof , and slew him , and cut off his head therewith . And when the Philistines saw their champion was dead , they fled .

translation.kha: U Dan un longsem kum u bseiñ harud lynti bah , Gaal kum u seiñpuh Harod lynti , Uba puh na ka khongdong jat jong u khuri Khnang ba u nongshong un shah bret shadien .
translation.en: Dan shall be a serpent by the way , an adder in the path , that biteth the horse heels , so that his rider shall fall backward .

translation.kha: Ïa ki blang jong ki jingtipbriew la shna da ka rupa badno ka ksaiñ ; la pynwandur da ki kti ki briew .
translation.en: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold , the work of men s hands .
And they journeyed from Beth–el  ; and there was but a little way to come to Ephrath : and Rachel travailed , and she had hard labour .
translation.kha: U Jakob bad la ka longïing longsem ki la ïamihnoh na Bethel , bad haba ki la jan poi ha Ephrath , ka por ka la poi ba ka Rakhel kan kha khun , bad ka la don ha ka jingsuh kha kaba shitom .
Ka khie dang step phyrngab bad ka pynkhreh jingbam ïa kiba ha ka ïing jong ka , bad ban ong ïa la ki shakri kynthei ïa kaei kaba ki dei ban leh .
translation.en: She riseth also while it is yet night , and giveth meat to her household , and a portion to her maidens .
Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee , neither did thy foot swell , these forty years .
translation.kha: Ha kine ki sawphew snem ki jaiñkup jong phi kim shym man rim bad ki kjat jong phi ruh kim shym at .

translation.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job , because he was righteous in his own eyes .
translation.kha: Namar ba u Job u sngewskhem ïa ka jinglong balui lui jong u hi , kita ki lai ngut ki rangbah ki iehnoh ïa ka ban pyrshang ban jubab ïa u .
Na ka khet syiem ha ka nongbah Susa jongno ka Persia , u syiemsad Serksis u synshar halor ki shispah arphew hynñiew tylli ki jylla , naduh India haduh Sudan .
translation.en: That in those days , when the king Ahasuerus sat on the throne of his kingdom , which was in Shushan the palace ,

translation.kha: Ngi itynnat ïa ka jingkhlaiñ ka jinglong Gath bad ngi burom ïa u ñiuhlieh ka jinglong tymmen .
translation.en: The glory of young men is their strength : and the beauty of old men is the gray head .

translation.kha: Kane , te , ka hir kaei ba ka mut , ko Syiem Kynther , Bad kane ka long khie kaba U Blei Bahakhlieh Tam Eh u la pynbna ba kan jia ha phi .
translation.en: This is the interpretation , O king , and this is the decree of the most High , which is come upon my lord the king :

translation.kha: Hynrei haba ki ktien jongno me ki wan urlong — bad kin wanrah urlong shisha — te kin sa tip ba pungsum hapdeng jong ki u Don u nongïathuhlypa .
translation.en: And when this cometh to pass , ( lo , it will come , ) then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them .

translation.kha: Nangta u Memukan u ïai-ong ha u syiemsad bad ki rangbah synshar : Ka Bashti , ka Mahadei ka la krenbeiñ ym tang ïa u syiem hynrei ïa ki rangbah synlar ruh — ha ka jingshisha , ïa uwei pa uwei u rangbah ha ka hima !
translation.en: And Memucan answered before the king and the princes , Vashti the queen hath not done wrong to the king only , but also to all the princes , and to all the people that are in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus .
Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven : they pursued us upon the mountains , they laid wait for us in the wilderness .
translation.kha: Kham stet ban ïa ki pukni kiba suh wia na sahit bneng , ki beh kthong ïa ngi sha tbian . Ki lap ïa ngi ha ki lumrit ; ki kurup ïa ngi ha ka jingkyndit ha ka ri shyiap .
Hato nga thiaw , te , ba ka bleithaw ne ka jingbamsap ba la kñia ha ka , ka long ei ei ?
translation.en: What say I then ? that the idol is any thing , or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing ?
Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin , but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord .
translation.kha: Ha kajuh ka rukom phin pyrkhat ïa lade kum kiba la ïap , ha ka jingïadei bad ka pop , hynrei kiba im ha ka jingïasyllok bad U Blei lyngba U Khrist Jisu .
To nang ïaid , bad pynmihpat ïa kaei kaba ki kop tymmen jong phi ki la sdang !
translation.en: Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers .

And the children of Israel said , Who is there among all the tribes of Israel that came not up with the congregation unto the  Lord  ? For they had made a great oath concerning him that came not up to the  Lord  to Mizpah , saying , He shall surely be put to death .
translation.kha: Ki kylli ,  Hato don ka kynhun na ki jait Israel baroh ka bym shym la leit sha ka jingïalumlang ha ka jingdon ryngkat U  Trai  ha Mispah ?  ( Ki la shim ïa ka jingsmai bakyntang ba uno uno u bym shym la leit sha Mispah un shah pynïap . )
Nga ai ha me ïa ki soh nyngkong kiba kynsi tam baroh na ka umphniang Olib , ka waiñ bad u kew ba ki Israel ki ai ïa nga man la ka snem .
translation.en: All the best of the oil , and all the best of the wine , and of the wheat , the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the  Lord  , them have I given thee .

translation.kha: ( Ha kaba ong kumne , U Jisu u la kdew kaba kumno u Petros un ïarep bad pyndonburom ïa U Blei . ) Te U Jisu u la noh ha u , To brup ïa nga !
translation.en: This spake he , signifying by what death he should glorify God . And when he had spoken this , he saith unto him ,  Follow me .

translation.kha: Ynda haba ngan pynpaw ha ki jaitbynriew ïa ka jingkhuid ka kyrteng bakhraw lad nga — ka kyrteng ïa kaba phoi la pynjahburom hapdeng jong ki — te kin sa kop ba nga long U Trai . Ma nga , U Terah Nongsynshar , nga la kren . Ngan pyndonkam ïa phi ban pyn-i ha ki jaitbynriew ba sa long uba khuid .
translation.en: And I will sanctify my great name , which was profaned among the heathen , which ye have profaned in the midst of them  ; and the heathen shall know that I am the  Lord  , saith the Lord  God  , when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes .

translation.kha: Sin ha ka jingbitar bakhraw jyllang nga , ngan pynhiarkput ïa ki jaitbynriew baroh ki bym shym la kohnguh ïa nga .
translation.en: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the heathen , such as they have not heard .

translation.kha: Katto katne na u symbai u la hap hapdeng ki bniap shiah , Ibbah mih bad kiba la kjap noh ïa ki jingong , bad ktem shym la pynmih kew ei ei .
translation.en: And some fell among thorns , and the thorns grew up , and choked it , and it yielded no fruit .

translation.kha: U Jonathan u pynpyut ïa u rangbah ai lei jongu ki Philistia ha Geba , malu ki phylliah baroh ki jingïohknieh shaneng kata . Nangta u Saul u phah ïa ki nonglamktien ban khot ïa ki Hebru sha ka tmoh da kaba put ïa ka turoi ha Kylleng ka ri .
translation.en: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba , and the Philistines heard of it . And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land , saying , Let the Hebrews hear .

translation.kha: Keiñ ka long ka jingduwai u Habakkuk u nongïathuhlypa :
translation.en: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth .

translation.kha: Ki ong , Ngi la wan hangne ban khum ïa me , khnang ba ngin ïoh aiti ïa me ha ki . U Samson u ong , kylluid ha to da ka ktem ba phin ym pynïap ïa nga da pa’ hi .
translation.en: And they said unto him , We are come down to bind thee , that we may deliver thee into the hand of the Philistines . And Samson said unto them , Swear unto me , that ye will not fall upon me yourselves .

translation.kha: Hadien kata u Elijah u ainong ïa u paidbah , Wanrah kham hajan sha nga , bad baroh ki la wan ïalum sawdong ïa u . U shna pynbha ïa ka duwan U Trai kaban la pra .
translation.en: And Elijah said unto all the people , Come near unto me . And all the people came near unto him . And he repaired the altar of the  Lord  that was broken down .

translation.kha: Ïa ka Ninebeh la pynjot , la iehnoh , kaba kynjah ! Ki dohnud ki um da ka jingsheptieng ; ki khohsiew ki khynñiuh , ka jingkhlaiñ ka la jah noh ; ki durkhmat ki la kila lieh blaid blaid .
translation.en: She is empty , and void , and waste : and the heart melteth , and the knees smite together , and much pain is in all loins , and the faces of them all gather blackness .

translation.kha: Ki paid Israel ki don hapoh ka jingshoh bieit ki bleithaw . Ai kin ïaid ha la ka jong ka lynnong .
translation.en: Ephraim is joined to idols : let him alone .

These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness , in the plain over against the Red sea , between Paran , and Tophel , and Laban , and Hazeroth , and Dizahab .
translation.kha: Ki ktien ha kane ka kitab ki long kito kiba u Moses u la kren ha ki Israel mynba ki don ha ka ri khlaw sha mihngi na ka wah Jordan . Ki ïadon ha ka Them Jordan hajan Suph , hapdeng ka shnong Paran ha kawei ka liang bad ki shnong Tophel , Laban , Haseroth , bad Disahab ha kawei pat ka liang .
Lada kim sangeh , ngan lawbah lyngkhuit ïa ka kumba ka la un-long ha ka sngi ba la kha ïa ka . Neng pyntong ïa ka , kum ka ri kaba tyrpeng bad ka bymseisoh , bad kan sa ïap namar ka jingsliang .
translation.en: Lest I strip her naked , and set her as in the day that she was born , and make her as a wilderness , and set her like a dry land , and slay her with thirst .

translation.kha: U riewarsap u ibhabriew ïa la ka jingshun ha lyndet ki ktien pynkhyllew .
translation.en: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips , and layeth up deceit within him  ;

translation.kha: U balui u la pynmihpat ïa une hi U Jisu na ka jingïap , bad im’ borbah ngi long ki sorki ïa kane ka jingshisha .
translation.en: This Jesus hath God raised up , whereof we all are witnesses .
And the  Lord  spake unto Moses and unto Aaron , saying ,
translation.kha: Kine ki long kiba na ka longïing longsem jong u Aaron bad u Moses ha ka por ba U  Trai  u kren ha u Moses ha u Lum Sinai .

translation.en: For it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba U Blei u la thaw ka long kaba bha ; ym dei ban kyntait ei ei , hynrei ïa kiei kiei baroh dei ban pdiang lem bad ka jingduwai sngewnguh , namar ïa ka la pynkyntang da ka ktien U Blei bad ka jingduwai , kiba pynlong ïa ki ba la pdiang da U Blei .
Ki jait Reuben bad ki jait Gad ki la don sbun ki jingijli . Haba ki la ioh ba ka ri Jashar bad ka ri Gilead ka long kaba bit eh na ka bynta ki jingri ,
translation.en: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle : and when they saw the land of Jazer , and the land of Gilead , that , behold , the place was a place for cattle  ;

translation.kha: Don na ki , kiba thiah bad ka tnga u kpa jong ki . Don kba pynbor ïa ki kynthei shun ïathiah shongkha bad ki ha ka por poi bnai .
translation.en: In thee have they discovered their fathers  nakedness : in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution .
For all his judgments were before me : and as for his statutes , I did not depart from them .
translation.kha: Nga la leh ïa ki aiñ jong u baroh ; Ngam shym la lyndet ïa ki hukum jong u .

translation.en: For Jozachar the son of Shimeath , and Jehozabad the son of Shomer , his servants , smote him , and he died  ; and they buried him with his fathers in the city of David : and Amaziah his son reigned in his stead .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong u syiem Joash ki ïasylla pyrshah ïa u , bad ar ngut na kine , u Josakar u khun jong u Shimeath bad u Jehosabad u khun jong u Shomer , ki pynïap ïa u ha ka ïing kaba u la tei halor ka jaka ba la pyndap khyndew kaba shaphang mihngi jong ka Jerusalem , ha ka lynti kaba hiar sha Silla . Ïa u Joash la tep ha ka jingtep ki syiem ha ka Nongbah u Dabid , bad u khun jong u , u Amasaïah u long syiem ha ka jaka jong u .
ha kaba nga la ïohi ïa U Trai , haba u la ong ha nga , ‘ Pynkloi bad Mynno kyrkieh na Jerusalem , namar ki briew hangne kin ym pdiang ïa ka jingaiti jong me shapoh jong nga .’
translation.en: And saw him saying unto me ,  Make haste , and get thee quickly out of Jerusalem : for they will not receive thy testimony concerning me .
And the  Lord  visited Hannah , so that she conceived , and bare three sons and two daughters . And the child Samuel grew before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u da kyrkhu shisha ïa ka Hannah , bad ka ïoh sa lai ngut ki khun shynrang bad ar ngut ki khun kynthei . Uta u khynnah Samuel , u nang san ha kaba shakri ïa U  Trai .
U Jakob u la Bteng ïa ka jingkit jong u nabar u la kitei sha ka ri kaba shaphang mihngi .
translation.en: Then Jacob went on his journey , and came into the land of the people of the east .

translation.kha: Sngewbha jarjar .
translation.en: Please keep your voice down .

translation.kha: Leummim ym shym la thaw ïa u briew na ka bynta ka briew , hynrei ïa ka bariew na ka bynta u briew .
translation.en: Neither was the man created for the woman ; but the woman for the man .

translation.kha: Kine harum ki hynriew nguid ki khun shynrang , ha ka jingbah rynsan kat kum ka jingkha ïa ki ; la kha na ka bynta u ïabuaid ha thohbroin : u Amnon , uba ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Ahinoam , naba na Jesreel ;
translation.en: And unto David were sons born in Hebron : and his firstborn was Amnon , of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess  ;
Art not thou our God , who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Israel , and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever ?
translation.kha: Me long U Blei jong ngi . Mynba u paid Israel jong me u wan sha kane ka ri , me beh krad ïa ki briew kiba shong hangne bad me ai ïa ka ri ha ki khun ki ksiew u Abraham , u paralok jong me , ban long ka jong ki junom .
Haba phi ïaid lynti na ka lyngkha kew jongno jongno , phi lah ban sip ïa u sohkew uba phi kheit da la ki kti , hynrei phim dei ban ot ïa u da ka rashi .
translation.en: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour , then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand  ; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour s standing corn .
Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things , as silver and gold , from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers  ;
translation.kha: Naba phi tip ïa kaei kaba la siew ban pyllaitluid ïa phi na ka rukom im bymmyntoi kaba la ïohpateng na ki kpa tymmen jong phi . Kam shym long kaei kaei ïa kaba lah ban pynjot , kum ka rupa ne ka ksiar ;
To risa lang da ka jingkmen , phi ki jingpra ka Jerusalem ! U Trai un pyllew ïa la ka Nongbah bad un pyntngen ïa la ki briew .
translation.en: Break forth into joy , sing together , ye waste places of Jerusalem : for the  Lord  hath comforted his people , he hath redeemed Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ko khun Jong nga , to kynmaw ïa kadei kiba nga kren , bad Wat ju klet ban leh ïa kaei ka nga ong ïa pa’ ban ni .
translation.en: My son , keep my words , and lay up my commandments with thee .

translation.kha: Shimei ïa kine kiei kiei bad pyndonkam pura ïa la ka iktiar haba me ai mynsiem bad haba sniang ïa ki nongsngap jong me . Wat ai ïano ïano na ki ban ibeiñ ïa me .
translation.en: These things speak , and exhort , and rebuke with all authority . Let no man despise thee .

translation.kha: U Othniel , u khun Jong u Kenas , wahbah shi na bad u Kaleb , u la ïohknieh ïa ka nongbah , kumta u Kabul u ai ïa ka Akhsah ha u ban shongkurim .
translation.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz , the brother of Caleb , took it : and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab , Keiñ noh kaba ïakren khñium hapdeng Jong phi .
translation.en: Jesus therefore answered and said unto them ,  Murmur not among yourselves .
But when the fulness of the time was come , God sent forth his Son , made of a woman , made under the law ,
translation.kha: Hynrei haba ka ïa kaba biang ka la poi , U Blei u la phah ïa la U Khun .
La pynkhreh ïa ki skul bakyrpang na ka bynta kito kiba trei pura ïa ka kad ïalap khnang ba kin lah ban “pyndep ïa la ka kam nongïalap .”—2 Timotheus ( Timothi ) 4 :5 , Baibyl Khasi Katholik .
translation.en: Special schooling is provided for those who devote their full time to the Kingdom-preaching work so that they can ‘ fully accomplish their ministry .’ —2 Timothy 4 :5 .

translation.kha: Naaman kata ngi lah ban sngewrem tyngkan ba baroh ar ngut u Jehobah bad u Jisu ki kwah ban ïarap ïa ine ban ïoh ïa ka lawei kaba sahkut ba kmen .—Salm 72 :4–12 ; 145 :16 ; 2 Petros 3 :9 .
translation.en: So we can be sure that both Jehovah and Jesus want to help us to enjoy a happy future ! —Psalm 72 :12-14  ; 145 :16  ; 2 Peter 3 :9 .

translation.kha: Ïa ka jingpynim dei ban Shem tang lyngba jong u ; ha ka pyrthei baroh ym don uno Uno ïa ibha U blang u la ai uba ia ban pynim ïa ngi .
translation.en: Neither is there salvation in any other : for there is none other name under heaven given among men , whereby we must be saved .
Hear me , O  Lord  , hear me , that this people may know that thou art the  Lord  God , and that thou hast turned their heart back again .
translation.kha: Jubab ïa nga , A  Trai  , jubab ïa nga , khnang ba une u paidbah un tip ba me , U  Trai  , me long U Blei , bad ba men sa wallam pat ïa ki sha lade hi .

translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour , and Lord Jesus Christ , which is our hope ;
translation.kha: Na u Paul , u apostol jong U Khrist Jisu kat kum ka hukum U Blei u Nongpynim jong ngi bad U Khrist Jisu uba long ka jingkyrmen jong ngi —
Kumba ka Jingiathuh Bakhuid ka Ong , un uno umbiah kaweh ban lehkmen ha ka jingim bad uba kwah ban ïohi ïa ki por bakha bha , u dei ban kiar na kaba klun sniew bad ban nym kren lamler .
translation.en: For he that will love life , and see good days , let him refrain his tongue from evil , and his lips that they speak no guile :

translation.kha: U Tom u kylli ianga badno ki jingkylli Kiba meng ia jubab .
translation.en: Tom asked me a lot of questions that I couldn't answer .

translation.kha: Ka pyrthei jyllang kiba ïap ka pynkhreh ban pdiang sngewlah ïa u syiem jong ka Babilonia . Ki sna-ïap jong kito kiba donbor ha ka pyrthei ki ïakhih ksar . Ki sna-ïap jngai ki syiem ki ïohnong na ki khet jongki ki .
translation.en: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming : it stirreth up the dead for thee , even all the chief ones of the earth  ; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations .

translation.kha: Wat rah ïa kano kano ka ksiar , ka rupa , lieng ka pipa haka ha ki plie jong phi ;
translation.en: Provide neither gold , nor silver , nor brass in your purses ,
And this is the record of John , when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him , Who art thou ?
translation.kha: Ki nongsynshar jong ki Jiw ha Jerusalem ki la phah katto katne ngut ki lyngdoh bad ki Lebi sha u Ïoannis , ban kylli ïa u ,  Me dei uei ?

Hynrei haduh kane ka sngi , la ïaroh ïa nga da U Blang , bad kumto nga ïeng hangne ban ai ïa ka jingidiaw jong nga ha baroh , ha uba raïot bad ha uba khraw Khmut . Kaei kaba nga ong ka Long kiaw hi Kaba ki nongïalap bad u Moses ki la ong ba kan sa jia :
translation.en: Having therefore obtained help of God , I continue unto this day , witnessing both to small and great , saying none other things than those which the prophets and Moses did say should come :
And it was broken in that day : and so the poor of the flock that waited upon me knew that it was the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta ïa ka jutang la pyndam noh ha kata ka sngi . Kito kiba la thied bad die ïa ki langbrot ki ap khmih ïa nga , bad ki tip ba U  Trai  u la kren lyngba kaei kaba nga la leh .
Ka bainong jong phi ka shong ha kaei kaba phi! ong bad kaei kaba phi leh ; phin ïoh ïa kaei kaba phin dei hok .
translation.en: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth : and the recompence of a man s hands shall be rendered unto him .

translation.kha: Ha ka Sarah pat u ong , Ngan ai ha u hynmen jong Pha shijur tylli ki sbai rupa kum ka jingpynkhiah ha barabor kiba ïadon lem malu phai ba pha lama naba lui lui ; uwei pa ti borbah un tip ba pham shitrhem la leh bakla .
translation.en: And unto Sarah he said , Behold , I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver : behold , he is to thee a covering of the eyes , unto all that are with thee , and with all other : thus she was reproved .

translation.kha: U Trai u leh ïa kane namar ba u Dabid u la leh ïa kaba pynsngewbha ïa u bad um ju lyngkot ïa kano kano na ki hukum jong u , mlien noh tang ha ka kam kaba ïadei bad u Uriah u nong Hit .
translation.en: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the  Lord  , and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life , save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite .

translation.kha: ‘ Ngi long kiba riewspah’ ki ong . ‘ Ngi lah lum kriah ka sawspah . Bad ym don wai ruh ban mawpud ïa ngi ba ngi ïoh spah da ka lynti bymhok .’
translation.en: And Ephraim said , Yet I am become rich , I have found me out substance : in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin .

translation.kha: To kmen bad to shadkmen junom ha kaei kaba nga thaw . Ka Jerusalem bameh naba nga pynurlong kan ïadep da ka jingkieng , bun ki briew Jong ka kin shem sngewkwah .
translation.en: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create : for , behold , I create Jerusalem a rejoicing , and her people a joy .
The beginning of the words of his mouth is foolishness : and the end of his talk is mischievous madness .
translation.kha: U sdang da ka jingkren bieit bad u kut ha ka jinglamwir .

translation.en: These are the two olive trees , and the two candlesticks standing before the God of the earth .
translation.kha: Ki ar ngut ki sakhi ki long ki ar tylli ki dieng Olib bad ki ar tylli ki diengpynïeng sharak kiba ïeng ha khmat U Trai jong ka pyrthei .
Nga thaw ïa ka jingshai bad ïa ka jingdum ; nga wanrah ka jingkyrkhu bad ka jingjot . Ma nga , U Tharai , na leh ïa kine kiei kiei barhem .
translation.en: I form the light , and create darkness : I make peace , and create evil : I the  Lord  do all these things .

translation.kha: Te kita ki kynthei ki la kynmaw ïa ki kyntien jong u ,
translation.en: And they remembered his words ,

translation.en: Even three thousand talents of gold , of the gold of Ophir , and seven thousand talents of refined silver , to overlay the walls of the houses withal :

translation.en: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan , where John was baptizing .

translation.en: Thy first father hath sinned , and thy teachers have transgressed against me .

translation.en: At her feet he bowed , he fell , he lay down : at her feet he bowed , he fell : where he bowed , there he fell down dead .

translation.en: And Jesus said unto them ,  Because of your unbelief : for verily I say unto you , If ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed , ye shall say unto this mountain , Remove hence to yonder place  ; and it shall remove  ; and nothing shall be impossible unto you .

translation.kha: U phan ïa ki erïong ban lynshop bad pynmong jur ïa ar khleiñ haka satia ;
translation.en: For he breaketh me with a tempest , and multiplieth my wounds without cause .

translation.en: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows , It is good for them if they abide even as I .

translation.kha: ?(Nga la jaboh , Ki nongïalam jongu ngi ki long ibha mutlop ; kim shym kyrpad ïa U Trai ban ïoh jingïalam . Don kane keiñ balei ba ki shahjop , bad ki briew jong ngi ki la shah pynsakma .

translation.en: And Noah builded an altar unto the  Lord   ; and took of every clean beast , and of every clean fowl , and offered burnt offerings on the altar .

Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the  Lord s  wrath  ; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy : for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land .
translation.kha: Ha ka sngi haba U  Trai  un pyn-i ïa ka jingbitar shla jong u , wat ka rupa bad ka ksiar jong ki baroh kan ym lah ban pynim ïa ki . Ïa ka pyrthei baroh kawei yn pynjot da ka ding ka jingbitar jong u . Un pynkut — ka jingkut kaba kynsan — ïa uwei pa uwei uba im ha ka pyrthei .

kumta u la phah khot ïa u nongleitkurim , bad u la ong ha u , U briew’ baroh u ai shuh ïa ka waiñ Kaba bha tam , bad hadien ba kiba la shah khot sngewbha ki la dih bah , u pynbud sa da ka waiñ kaba kham duna ka jingdih . Hynrei ma me , me tyngkai ïa ka waiñ kaba bha tam haduh mynta !

translation.en: Ye shall fall by the sword  ; I will judge you in the border of Israel  ; and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.en: As the partridge sitteth on eggs , and hatcheth them not  ; so he that getteth riches , and not by right , shall leave them in the midst of his days , and at his end shall be a fool .

translation.kha: Sa shisyndon ki la pyrta , To ïaroh ïa U blang ! Ka tdem na ki thylliej ding kiba la bam duh ïa ka nongbah bakhraw ka la kiew shajrong junom la jongu !
translation.en: And again they said , Alleluia . And her smoke rose up for ever and ever .
And Jesus departed from thence , and came nigh unto the sea of Galilee  ; and went up into a mountain , and sat down there .

Me bat ïa la ka kular , me la ïalumlang noh ïa ki briew kiba me la pyllait im ; da ka bor jong me , me la btin ïa ki sha ka ri kaba kyntang jong me .
translation.en: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed : thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation .

translation.kha: U la pynshoh ba u iohi ïa ka lynti mawkyrdon na khyndew sha bneng , bad ki angel kiba ïakiew ïahiar ha ka .
translation.en: And he dreamed , and behold a ladder set up on the earth , and the top of it reached to heaven : and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it .
The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples , and of his doctrine .

Kumba ïa ki ñiut la lumlang bad la thang ïa ki hapoh ka ding , kumta Kajuh hi sa jia ha katba kut ka Ïa :
translation.en: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire  ; so shall it be in the end of this world .
Likewise from Tibhath , and from Chun , cities of Hadarezer , brought David very much brass , wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea , and the pillars , and the vessels of brass .

Un shim ïa ki shakri jong pa’ , bad ïa kiba kynsai tam na ki jingri bad ki kada jong phi , bad un pyntrei ïa ki ha ka kam jong u .
translation.en: And he will take your menservants , and your maidservants , and your goodliest young men , and your asses , and put them to his work .

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba bha ki ïap , bad ym don naba sngewkynduh lane wat ban suidñiew . Hynrei haba ki ïap , yn ym don jingjynjar shuh ki ban ktah ïa ki .
translation.en: The righteous perisheth , and no man layeth it to heart : and merciful men are taken away , none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come .

translation.kha: Naba da ka har U Blei la pynurlong ïa nga u Apostol sha ki Jentil , kamar ïa u Patmos la pynlong u Apostol sha ki Jiw .
translation.en: ( For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision , the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles : )
Their land also is full of silver and gold , neither is there any end of their treasures  ; their land is also full of horses , neither is there any end of their chariots :

translation.en: Save thyself , and come down from the cross .
translation.kha: Mynta to hiar noh na ka diengphna bad to pynim ïa lade !
Lada u brisoh uba riewspah u ïoh ïa la u bhabriew ha ka jingkyrduh , pynban , u khang khyrdep ïa la ka dohnud pyrshah ïa la u parabriew , kumno u ha ba kam ba u ieit ïa U blang ?
translation.en: But whoso hath this world s good , and seeth his brother have need , and shutteth up his bowels of compassion from him , how dwelleth the love of God in him ?

translation.kha: Minnith pat , ngi la lait na ka Hukum , namar I la ïap noh ïa kata kaba shisien ka la khum ïa ngi kum ki koidi . nongmih shakri shuh ha ka rukom bajyrngam jongki ka hukum ba la thoh , hynrei ha ka manna bameh Jong U Mynsiem .
translation.en: But now we are delivered from the law , that being dead wherein we were held ; that we should serve in newness of spirit , and not in the oldness of the letter .

translation.en: And the king said unto him , Why speakest thou any more of thy matters ? I have said , Thou and Ziba divide the land .
Again the word of the  Lord  came unto me , saying ,

Ngam khot shuh ïa phi ki shakri , namar u shakri um tip aïu u kynrad u lai . Pynban , nga khot ïa phi ki paralok , namar nga la ïathuh ïa phi ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba nga la ïohsngew na U Kpa jong nga .
translation.en: Henceforth I call you not servants  ; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth : but I have called you friends  ; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you .

translation.kha: ( Ephesos 5 :18 , 19 ) Ym ju shim bai rung lane jingkynshew .—Mathaios 10 :8 .
translation.en: ( Ephesians 5 :18 , 19 ) Admission is free , and no collections are taken .—Matthew 10 :8 .

translation.en: And he said unto them ,  This kind can come forth by nothing , but by prayer and fasting .

translation.en: Then said he unto him , Because thou hast not obeyed the voice of the  Lord  , behold , as soon as thou art departed from me , a lion shall slay thee . And as soon as he was departed from him , a lion found him , and slew him .

translation.en: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them , and said , It is not reason that we should leave the word of God , and serve tables .

translation.en: And David went up , and all Israel , to Baalah , that is , to Kirjath–jearim , which belonged to Judah , to bring up thence the ark of God the  Lord  , that dwelleth between the cherubims , whose name is called on it .

translation.en: And the altars that were on the top of the upper chamber of Ahaz , which the kings of Judah had made , and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two courts of the house of the  Lord  , did the king beat down , and brake them down from thence , and cast the dust of them into the brook Kidron .

translation.en: And in the wilderness , where thou hast seen how that the  Lord  thy God bare thee , as a man doth bear his son , in all the way that ye went , until ye came into this place .

translation.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer , and brought them to Jerusalem .

translation.en: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of God , and laid it upon the ass , and brought it back : and the old prophet came to the city , to mourn and to bury him .

Specially the day that thou stoodest before the  Lord  thy God in Horeb , when the  Lord  said unto me , Gather me the people together , and I will make them hear my words , that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth , and that they may teach their children .

translation.en: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone , and salt , and burning , that it is not sown , nor beareth , nor any grass groweth therein , like the overthrow of Sodom , and Gomorrah , Admah , and Zeboiim , which the  Lord  overthrew in his anger , and in his wrath :
Wives , submit yourselves unto your own husbands , as it is fit in the Lord .

translation.en: And he saith unto him , Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee , thou wicked servant . Thou knewest that I was an austere man , taking up that I laid not down , and reaping that I did not sow :

translation.en: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend . And they said unto him , Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him .

translation.kha: Ngan ïeng joit bad leit sha i pa jong nga malade Ong , Ko pa , ang la ni pop pyrsad ïa U Blei badno pyrshah ïa phi .
translation.en: I will arise and go to my father , and will say unto him , Father , I have sinned against heaven , and before thee ,

translation.en: Which was the son of Matthat , which was the son of Levi , which was the son of Melchi , which was the son of Janna , which was the son of Joseph ,

translation.en: Blessed shalt thou be in the city , and blessed shalt thou be in the field .

translation.en: But David could not go before it to enquire of God : for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the  Lord .

translation.en: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Judah  ; they shall feed thereupon : in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening : for the  Lord  their God shall visit them , and turn away their captivity .

translation.en: And they shall keep thy charge , and the charge of all the tabernacle : only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar , that neither they , nor ye also , die .
translation.kha: Ki dei ban pynbiang ïa ki kamram jong ki sha me bad ïa la ki jingkitkhlieh na ka bynta ka Ïingjaiñ , hynrei kim bit ban pyndei ïa ki tiar kiba khuid ha ka Jaka Kyntang , lane ïa ka duwan . Lada ki leh kumta , ïa ki bad ïa me yn pynïap noh .
