translation.en: He rebuked the Red sea also , and it was dried up : so he led them through the depths , as through the wilderness .

translation.kha: Naduh mynta dei tang ki Lebi ki ban synrum ïa ka Ïingjaiñ malade kin kitkhlieh nongkyndong shadong ïa ka . Kane ka long ka hukum kaba ïaineh bad ka teh ïa ki khun ki ksiew jong phi pateng la patan .
translation.en: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation , and they shall bear their iniquity : it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations , that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance .

translation.kha: Lymne ba u donkam ei ei kambah ine kah ban ai da kaba trei na ka bynta jong u , namar ba u long ma u hi uba ai ka jingim bad ka jingpyrsad mynsiem bad ïa kaei kaei baroh ha Uei pa uwei .
translation.en: Neither is worshipped with men s hands , as though he needed any thing , seeing he giveth to all life , and breath , and all things  ;

translation.kha: Kumta u syiem u ong ha u Abishag , U Seba un kham pynjynjar ïa ngi ban ïa u Absalom . Shim ïa ki pynrangbah jyllang nga bad leit thwet ïa u , lym kumta u lah ba-bang leit shong shnong ha ki shnong ba la ker kynroh , bad lait phet na me .
translation.en: And David said to Abishai , Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom : take thou thy lord s servants , and pursue after him , lest he get him fenced cities , and escape us .
And Reuben answered them , saying , Spake I not unto you , saying , Do not sin against the child  ; and ye would not hear ? therefore , behold , also his blood is required .
translation.kha: U Reuben u ong ha ki ,  Ngam shym la ong ïa phi ban ym ktah kti ïa u para , hynrei phim shym shahshkor . Kumta ngi hap shahshitom kylla mynta namar kata ka jingïap jong u .

translation.en: But unto them that are contentious , and do not obey the truth , but obey unrighteousness , indignation and wrath ,
translation.kha: Kiwei pat ki briew ki long kiba khwan myntoi bad kiba kyntait ïa kaei kaba dei , khnang ban bud ïa kaei ka bym dei ; halor jong ki U Blei un theh noh ïa la ka jingbitar bad ka jingbitar shla .

translation.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the  Lord  , after that Nebuzar–adan the captain of the guard had let him go from Ramah , when he had taken him being bound in chains among all that were carried away captive of Jerusalem and Judah , which were carried away captive unto Babylon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la kren ha nga hadien ba u Nebusaradan , u rangbah shipai , u la lah pyllait ïa nga ha Ramah . Ïa nga la leit ïalam shata ha ki kynjri , ryngkat bad baroh kiwei pat ki briew na Jerusalem bad Judah ïa kiba la leit ïalam kum ki koidi sha Babilonia .

Ki rangbah na de ki pynïeng ïa ka bleithaw ïa ka ban manla , sad u Jonathan , u khun jong u Heshmon bad u khun ksiew jong u Mushi , ki shakri kum ki lyngngeit ïa ka jait de , bad ki shakri kiba hiarpateng kum ki lyngdoh haduh ka jingshah ringmraw ki briew na “kata ka ri .
translation.en: And the children of Dan set up the graven image : and Jonathan , the son of Gershom , the son of Manasseh , he and his sons were priests to the tribe of Dan until the day of the captivity of the land .

translation.kha: Ka Jingthoh bakhadduh ka ong , ‘ Dei ka jingbhasbun kaba nga kaweh , ym ïa ka jingkñia ïa ki mrad .’ Lada phi la tip kaei ka jingmad jong kane , phin ym da la pynrem ïa ki briew ki bym khim shah pynrem ;
translation.en: But if ye had known what this meaneth , I will have mercy , and not sacrifice , ye would not have condemned the guiltless .
Pilate saith unto them , What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ ? They all say unto him , Let him be crucified .
translation.kha: Kaei , te , ngan leh ïa U Jisu uba la khot U Messaïah ?   Sahnarphna ïa u !  Baroh ki la jubab .

Me u khun jong u Ksuid ! Me long u nongshniah ïa kaei kaei baroh kob bha . Me long uba dup da katba pung jait ki buit bymman , bad me ju ïai pyrshang ban pynphai ïa ki jingshem jrong U Trai sha ki jinglorni !
translation.en: And said , O full of all subtilty and all mischief , thou child of the devil , thou enemy of all righteousness , wilt thou not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord ?

translation.kha: Kata ka ri ka don shibun ki wah bad ka sawspah kyrhai , hynrei ka por jrong ka , ka la kut , bad ïa u ksai jingim jong ka , la pyndkut .
translation.en: O thou that dwellest upon many waters , abundant in treasures , thine end is come , and the measure of thy covetousness .
And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri , who willingly offered himself unto the  Lord   ; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour .
translation.kha: bad uba lai u dei u Amasaïah u khun jong u Sikhri uba don ar lakh ngut ki shipai . ( U Amasaïah u trei mon sngewbha ban shakri ïa U  Trai . )
Ha kata ka sngi , ki Israel ki jop ïa ki Phoenisia , ki da ïabeh shi lynter lynti naduh Mikhmash haduh Aijalon .
translation.en: And they smote the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon : and the people were very faint .

translation.kha: U Gideon u khun jong u Josaïah u la ïarep haba u la tymmen babha , bad la tep ïa u ha ka jingtep u Joash u kpa jngai u , kaba ha Ophrah , ka nongrit jong ka kur Abieser .
translation.en: And Gideon the son of Joash died in a good old age , and was buried in the sepulchre of Joash his father , in Ophrah of the Abi–ezrites .
Saying , Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan , the lot of your inheritance :
translation.kha: Ngan ai ha phi ïa ka ri Kanaan ,  u ong .  Kan long ka jingïohkynti jong phi hi .

translation.en: And he brought out the people that were in it , and cut them with saws , and with harrows of iron , and with axes . Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon . And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem .
translation.kha: U rah ïa ki briew jong ka nongbah bad pyntrei ïa ki ha ki jaka ot dieng , jaka shna mohkhiew bad sdie . U leh kumjuh ïa ki briew jong kiwei ki shnong ka ri Ammon . Nangta ma u bad ki rangbah jong u ki wan phai sha Jerusalem .
Gaal ka jingim bymjukut ka mut ban thiah ïa me , U Blei bashisha tang ma u hi , bad ka ithuh ïa U Jeshua Khrist , ïa babha me la phuh .
translation.en: And this is life eternal , that they might know thee the only true God , and Jesus Christ , whom thou hast sent .

translation.kha: Katba u Mordekai u dang long u nongtrei ha ka ïingsyiem , u Bigthana bad u Teresh , kiba long ar nguid na ki Enokh ka ïingsyiem kiba ap phira ïa ka khyrdong sha ki kamra u syiem , ki la shun ïa u syiem Seresh bad sylla ban pynïap ïa u .
translation.en: In those days , while Mordecai sat in the king s gate , two of the king s chamberlains , Bigthan and Teresh , of those which kept the door , were wroth , and sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus .

translation.kha: Doeg ianga U Nongaplangbrot Rangbah un pang , phin jingïohpdiang ïa ka pyntong badonburom Kaba ka jingtyngshaiñ kan ym jah na ka lano lano ruh .
translation.en: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear , ye shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away .

translation.kha: namar ka khun marwei jong u , Kaba la khat-ar sner ka bta , ka la jan ïaphah . Katba U ju u dang ïaid , ki briew ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u na ki liang baroh’ .
translation.en: For he had one only daughter , about twelve years of age , and she lay a dying . But as he went the people thronged him .
This man went unto Pilate , and begged the body of Jesus .
translation.kha: U la leit sha u Pilat bad pan ïa ka met jong U Jisu .
Ki long kiba tbit baroh ha kaba leh ïa kaba sniew . Ki rangbah synshar bun ki nongbeh ki bamsap . U briew uba lah u ong ha ki ïa kaei kaba u kwah , bad kumta ki ïasylla lang .
translation.en: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly , the prince asketh , and the judge asketh for a reward  ; and the great man , he uttereth his mischievous desire : so they wrap it up .
And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance : but the other holy offerings sod they in pots , and in caldrons , and in pans , and divided them speedily among all the people .
translation.kha: Ki Lebi ki syang ïa ki jingkñia ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait ha ka ding , kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih , bad ki syrwa ïa ki jingainguh bakyntang ha ki khiew , ki khiew heh , ki khiew rit , bad kloi lan ki sam ïa ka doh ha ki briew .

translation.en: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted , and shall kill you : and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name s sake .
translation.kha: Nangta ïa phi yn kem bad yn aiti ban shah pynshitom bad ban shah pynïap . Ki jaitbynriew baroh kin isih ïa phi namar jong nga .

translation.en: It was meet that we should make merry , and be glad : for this thy brother was dead , and is alive again  ; and was lost , and is found .
translation.kha: Hynrei ngi la dei ban lehkmen bad ban sngewkmen , namar u para jong phi uba la ïap , hynrei mynta u dang im ; u la jah , hynrei mynta la shem pat ïa u .’

translation.en: Lest Satan should get an advantage of us : for we are not ignorant of his devices .
translation.kha: Haba phi map ïano ïano ïa kaei kaba u la leh , nga ruh nga map ïa u kumjuh . Naba haba nga map — lada , shisha , ka dei ïa nga ban map ïa kano kano — nga leh ïa kata ha khmat U Khrist namar jong phi , khnang ban ym shah ïa u Soitan ban leh donbor halor jong ngi ; naba ngi tip kiei ki jingthmu jong u ki long .

translation.en: My son , let not them depart from thine eyes : keep sound wisdom and discretion :
translation.kha: Ko khun jong nga , batskhem ïa la ka jingstad bad ka jingsngewthuh . Wat shah lano lano ba kin lait noh na phi .

translation.en: And Moses said , It is not meet so to do  ; for we shall sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians to the  Lord  our God : lo , shall we sacrifice the abomination of the Egyptians before their eyes , and will they not stone us ?
translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u jubab ,  Kam long kaba dei ba ngin leh kumta , namar ki nong Ijipt kin thut haba ngin kñia ïa ki mrad kiba ngi ai sha U  Trai  U Blei jong ngi . Lada ngi pyndonkam ïa kine ki mrad bad pynmong ïa ki nong Ijipt da kaba kñia ïa kine ki jingri ha ka jaka ba ki lah ban ïohi , kin sa lynthem maw ïa ngi .

translation.en: And for thy cattle , and for the beast that are in thy land , shall all the increase thereof be meat .
translation.kha: ïa ki jingri jong phi , bad ïa ki mradkhlaw ha ki lyngkha jong phi . Kat kaba mih nangta lah ban bam .
Ki nonghiarthma kin wan da ki lieng na Sipporah ; Kin jop ïa u Assyria bad u Eber , Hynrei ma ki ruh kin jah noh jar .
translation.en: And ships shall come from the coast of Kittim , and shall afflict Asshur , and shall afflict Eber , and he also shall perish for ever .
Unto thee it was shewed , that thou mightest know that the  Lord  he is God  ; there is none else beside him .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynpaw ha phi ïa kane , ban pynshisha ha phi ba tang ma u hi u long U Blei , bad ba ym don uwei pat lait na u .
Kainan ka pynshisha ba baroh kaba U thri u la ino shaphang ki khun ki ksiew jong u Ahas ka woh jia shisha . U Trai u la bor ïa kaei kaba u la kular lyngba u Eliada u nongïathuhlypa jong u .
translation.en: Know now that there shall fall unto the earth nothing of the word of the  Lord  , which the  Lord  spake concerning the house of Ahab : for the  Lord  hath done that which he spake by his servant Elijah .

translation.kha: U Dabid u leit sha u Ahimelekh u lyngdoh ha Nob . U Ahimelekh u mih da kaba pyrshing ban sien tan ïa u , bad u kylli , Balei ba phi wan hangne tang marwei ?
translation.en: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest : and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David , and said unto him , Why art thou alone , and no man with thee ?

translation.kha: bad ma ki bad ki briew ka Jeremaïah ki ïalumlang ha ka phyllaw bathymmai jongu ka Templ . U syiem Jehoshaphat u leit bad u ïeng ha khmat jrong ki bad duwai jam ,
translation.en: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Judah and Jerusalem , in the house of the  Lord  , before the new court ,
His flesh shall be fresher than a child s : he shall return to the days of his youth :
translation.kha: Ka met jong u kan khie lung kumba dang samla bad ban khlaiñ pat ;
?(Nga long U Blei jong ki kpa tymmen jong me , U Blang jong u Abraham , u Isaak bad u Jakob de . Kumta u Moses u tap ïa la ka khmat , namar um nud ba peit shad U Blei .
translation.en: Moreover he said , I am the God of thy father , the God of Abraham , the God of Isaac , and the God of Jacob . And Moses hid his face  ; for he was afraid to look upon God .

translation.kha: Nga sharai ka bah ba ki kat ki ïangat don , hynne ki pynsngewrem ia nga .
translation.en: I think it is good that books still exist , but they do make me sleepy .
And their coast was from Heleph , from Allon to Zaanannim , and Adami Nekeb , and Jabneel , unto Lakum  ; and the outgoings thereof were at Jordan :
translation.kha: U pud jong ka , u suh na Heleph sha u dieng Sning ha Saanannim , nangta beit beit sha Adaminekeb bad sha Jamnia , haduh Lakkum , bad u kut ha ka Jordan .

Pha ïarwai ba ka long kaei kaei kaba rit ba U Blei ki Israel u la pynkyrpang ïa phi na ka kynhun , ba phi lah ban kitei sha u , ban leh ïa ka kamram jong phi ha ka Ïingjaiñ U Trai , bad ban ai jingshakri ïa ka kynhun bad ban shakri ïa ki ?
translation.en: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you , that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel , to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the  Lord  , and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them ?
And Ham , the father of Canaan , saw the nakedness of his father , and told his two brethren without .
translation.kha: Haba u Ham , u kpa jong u Kanaan , u la ïohi ba u kpa jong u , u la lyngkhuit , u la mih shabar bad ïathuh ha la ki hynmen shynrang baroh ar ngut .
Ha ka sngi ba ang leh ïa kane , uno un uba lait na ka jingpynjot un wan bad un ïathuh ha phi shaphang jong ka .
translation.en: That he that escapeth in that day shall come unto thee , to cause thee to hear it with thine ears ?
Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius  ; and said , Behold , I am he whom ye seek : what is the cause wherefore ye are come ?
translation.kha: Kumta u Petros u la leit hiar bad u la ong ha kita ki rangbah ,  Dei ma nga uta uba phi ïawad . Phi donkam aïu ?

U Jisu , te , u longsem U Rangbah lyngngeit umbah pynbiang ïa ki jingdonkam jong ngi . U un-long naba khuid ; um shym don Kane kano kiba bakla lane ka pop ha u ; la pynkyrpang ïa u na ki nongpop bad la kyntiew ïa u shaei ki bneng .
translation.en: For such an high priest became us , who is holy , harmless , undefiled , separate from sinners , and made higher than the heavens  ;
And he said , What then is to be done for her ? And Gehazi answered , Verily she hath no child , and her husband is old .
translation.kha: U Elisha u kylli ïa u Gehasi ,  Te kaei nga lah ban leh na ka bynta jong ka ?  U jubab ,  Kam don khun shynrang , bad u tnga jong ka ruh u la tymmen .
Ki nongrwai tong kiba trei bha Kum ki nongriam ki dei hok ban ïohpdiang ar shah ïa ka jingsuhsieng , khamtam kito kiba trei jur ha ka jingialeh pynlang jinghikai .
translation.en: Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour , especially they who labour in the word and doctrine .
Greater love hath no man than this , that a man lay down his life for his friends .
translation.kha: Ka jingieit kaba khraw tam kaba u briew u lah ban don na ka bynta ki paralok jong u ka long ban aiti ïa la ka jingim na ka bynta jong ki .

translation.en: Let not a widow be taken into the number under threescore years old , having been the wife of one man ,
translation.kha: To wat kynthup ïa kano kano ka riewkynthei ha ka thup ki riewkynthei lymda ka la dap hynriewphew snem ka rta .

translation.en: The gin shall take him by the heel , and the robber shall prevail against him .
translation.kha: ka jingriam ka ïoh ïa ki khongdong jat jong u bad bat khak ïa u .

Haba ka jingsuk ka la wanlam , ki leh pop biang , pynlang me shah biang ïa ki nongshun Ban jop ïa ki . Pynban ki ba-mutlop bad kyrpad ïa me ban pynim ïa ki , ha bneng me jingïohknieh , bad na ka por shat ka por me pyllait ïa ki ha ka jingisynei Bakhraw jong me .
translation.en: But after they had rest , they did evil again before thee : therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies , so that they had the dominion over them : yet when they returned , and cried unto thee , thou heardest them from heaven  ; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies  ;
And whatsoever house ye enter into , there abide , and thence depart .
translation.kha: Hangno hangno ha kaba la pdiang sngewbha ïa phi , to sah ha kajuh ka ïing tad haduh ba phin da mihnoh na kata ka shnong ;

translation.en: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you , and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ki briew kin shah pynïap kylleng , bad kito kiba lait im kin sa sngewthuh ba nga long U  Trai .

U Rehoboam u synshar ha Jerusalem bad u nang khrong ha ka bor koum u shym . U don sawphew wei snem mynba u long syiem , bad u synshar khathynñiew sner ha Jerusalem , ka nongbah katba U Trai u la jied na ki jaka baroh jong ka Israel kumne ka jaka hangno ba yn mane ïa u . Ka kmie jong u Rehoboam ka dei ka Naamah , na ka ri ki Ammon .
translation.en: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem , and reigned : for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign , and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem , the city which the  Lord  had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel , to put his name there . And his mother s name was Naamah an Ammonitess .
Now my days are swifter than a post : they flee away , they see no good .
translation.kha: Ki sngi jong nga ki mareh stet , ym don kawei na ki kaba bha .
Don ki bri kiba pynlut kad ïa la ka pisa bad ki nang ïai siewspah . Kiwei ki husiar , bad pynban ki nang ïai kyrduh .
translation.en: There is that scattereth , and yet increaseth  ; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet , but it tendeth to poverty .
And they answered him , He was an hairy man , and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins . And he said , It is Elijah the Tishbite .
translation.kha: U phong ka jingkup kaba la shna na ki snieh mrad , ïa kaba la teh da u panpoh snieh ,  ki jubab .  U dei u Elijah !  u syiem u la ong jam .

kata ka hynmen kynsi lad u kan leit sha u ha khmat kita ki nongïalam shnong , kan lanot kawei ka juti jrong u , kan bynthiew ha ka khmat jong u , nabar kan ong , ‘ Kumne yn leh ïa tur u brai u bym treh ban ai symbai ïa la u ingmane .’
translation.en: Then shall his brother s wife come unto him in the presence of the elders , and loose his shoe from off his foot , and spit in his face , and shall answer and say , So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother s house .

translation.kha: U lyngdoh un pyndem ïa ka jinglehniam ka jingbymlongkhuid ha ka duwan ban pynsngaid ïa phi na ka ngop jong phi ; bad yn sa map ïa phi .
translation.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly , when he sinneth by ignorance before the  Lord  , to make an atonement for him  ; and it shall be forgiven him .
For I will restore health unto thee , and I will heal thee of thy wounds , saith the  Lord   ; because they called thee an Outcast , saying , This is Zion , whom no man seeketh after .
translation.kha: Ngan pynkoit pat ïa phi ; ngan pynkhiah ïa ki jingmong jong phi , la ki nongshun jong phi ki ong , ‘ Ka Seïon ka dei kaba shah kyntait ; ym don mano mano ba salia ïa ka .’ Ma nga , U  Trai  , nga la kren .

translation.en: The  Lord  hath taken away thy judgments , he hath cast out thine enemy : the king of Israel , even the  Lord  , is in the midst of thee : thou shalt not see evil any more .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la pynkut ïa ka jingpynshitom ïa phi ; u la weng noh ïa ki nongshun jong phi baroh . U  Trai  , u syiem ka Israel , u long bad phi ; ym don daw mynta ban sheptieng .

translation.en: Now these are the commandments , the statutes , and the judgments , which the  Lord  your God commanded to teach you , that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it :
translation.kha: Kine ki long ki aiñ baroh ïa kiba U  Trai  U Blei jong phi u la hukum ïa nga ban hikai ïa phi . Sumar bad leh ïa ki ha kata ka ri sha kaba phin sa leit bad ïohkynti .

translation.en: And he said unto me , Son of man , thus saith the Lord  God   ; These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it , to offer burnt offerings thereon , and to sprinkle blood thereon .
translation.kha: U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ha nga ,  Ko khun u briew , to sngap ïa kaei kaba ngan ong ha me . Haba la tei ïa ka duwan , me dei ban pynkyntang ïa ka da kaba thang ki jingkñia halor jong ka bad da kaba synreit halor jong ka ïa ka snam jong ki mrad ba la kñia .
To ngin ïawan ha khmat jong u da ka jingainguh bad rwai kmen da ki jingrwai ïaroh !
translation.en: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving , and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms .
And the brother shall deliver up the brother to death , and the father the child : and the children shall rise up against their parents , and cause them to be put to death .
translation.kha: Ki rangbah kin aiti noh ïa la ki jong ki hynmen bad para ïa ka ban pynïap ïa ki , bad ki kpa kin leh kumjuh ïa la ki khun ; ki khun kin phai ïaleh pyrshah ïa la ki kmie ki kpa bad kin phah pynïap ïa ki .
U Dabid u bitar lep ïa u riewspah bad u ong , Nga smai ha U Trai uba im ba u briew uba la leh ïa khie u dei ban ïap !
translation.en: And David s anger was greatly kindled against the man  ; and he said to Nathan , As the  Lord  liveth , the man that hath done this thing shall surely die :
And Jehoiakim the king sent men into Egypt , namely , Elnathan the son of Achbor , and certain men with him into Egypt .
translation.kha: U syiem Jehoïakim , pynban , u la phah ïa u Elnathan u khun jong u Akhbor bad katto katne ngut kiwei pat ki rangbah sha Ijipt ban wallam ïa u Uriah .

translation.en: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house , that he may set his nest on high , that he may be delivered from the power of evil !
translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phi la pynriewspah ïa la ka longïing da kaei kaba phi la shim da kaba leh jubor , bad phi la pyrshang ban pynlong ïa la ka ïing kaba lait na ki jingpynmynsaw bad jingma !
Ha kajuh ka na U TRAI’ u la ong ha u Aaron , Khie leit sha ka ri shyiap ban ïakynton ïa u Moses . Kumta u leit ban ïakynduh ïa u ha uta u lum bakhuid ; bad haba u ïashem bad u , u doh ïa u .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said to Aaron , Go into the wilderness to meet Moses . And he went , and met him in the mount of God , and kissed him .

translation.kha: Nangta u Hiram u phar ïa kane ka khubor harum sha u Solomon : Nga la iohpateng ïa ka khubor jong me , bad por kloi ban ai ïa kaei kaba me pan . Ngan pynbiang ïa ki dieng Kedar bad ki diengthang Kseh .
translation.en: And Hiram sent to Solomon , saying , I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for : and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar , and concerning timber of fir .

translation.kha: Kumne , naduh Mynta , ïanguh ïa U Trai , malu wat long shuh ibha mutlop .
translation.en: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart , and be no more stiffnecked .
Go forth of the ark , thou , and thy wife , and thy sons , and thy sons  wives with thee .
translation.kha: Khie ïamihnoh na kato ka lieng bad la ka tnga , ki khun shynrang jong me lem bad ki tnga jong ki .
U Trai u bitar ïa baroh ki hima-patsha bad baroh ki kynhun shipai jong ki . U la pynjyrngam ïa ki shiah ka jingjop .
translation.en: For the indignation of the  Lord  is upon all nations , and his fury upon all their armies : he hath utterly destroyed them , he hath delivered them to the slaughter .

There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave , all of them slain , fallen by the sword , which are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth , which caused their terror in the land of the living  ; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit .
translation.kha: Ka Elam ka don hangta , lem bad ki jingtep ki shipai jong ka ha baroh sawdong . Ki long baroh kiba la shah pynïap ha ka thma , bad ki la leit hiar , khlem otsher sha ka pyrthei kiba ïap . Ha ka jingim ki pynphriang ïa ka jingpyntriem , hynrei mynta ki thiah ïap bad jahburom .
Ki la te matlah ïa u bad ki la kylli ïa u , Mano ba tied ïa me ? To tawiar !
translation.en: And when they had blindfolded him , they struck him on the face , and asked him , saying , Prophesy , who is it that smote thee ?

translation.kha: U dei ban shong bad phi kum u nongrit bad shakri ïa phi haduh ka Snem ka Jingpynphai pat .
translation.en: But as an hired servant , and as a sojourner , he shall be with thee , and shall serve thee unto the year of jubilee :
Now at that feast he released unto them one prisoner , whomsoever they desired .
translation.kha: Ha man ka Jingkhawai Niam Ka Jinglait , u Pilat kumba long ka rukom u ju pyllait ïa uno uno u koidi uba ki briew ki kwah .
U Moses u la ong ha u Aaron , Shim aiwai u khiew , Tep ar lko ka manna ha u , nangta buh ïa u ha khmat U Trai , na ka bynta ki khun ki ksiew jong ngi .
translation.en: And Moses said unto Aaron , Take a pot , and put an omer full of manna therein , and lay it up before the  Lord  , to be kept for your generations .

translation.kha: Ym dat jingdum ka ban dum tliw palat baneh buhrieh ïa u nongpop na U blang .
translation.en: There is no darkness , nor shadow of death , where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves .

translation.kha: Ma ba bsa ïa ki tyngab haba ki sakma haba thngan , ïahap ki khun rit jong ki , ki kyang shwa nga ban ïoh jingbam ?
translation.en: Who provideth for the raven his food ? when his young ones cry unto God , they wander for lack of meat .

translation.kha: U syiem u la ong ha ki , Neng la kut jingmut ba ph dat ban ïathuh ïa por ïa ka jingsngewdiaw nabar nala ïathuh ïa nga kaei ka jingmut jong ka . Lada phim lah , ngan phah tar ïa ka kti ka kjat Jong phi kamai na kawei pat dara ngan pynhieng ïa ki ïing jong phin ka kynton ki jingjot .
translation.en: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans , The thing is gone from me : if ye will not make known unto me the dream , with the interpretation thereof , ye shall be cut in pieces , and your houses shall be made a dunghill .

translation.kha: U phah ki nonglamktien sha u Abimelekh ha Amasa ban ong , U Gaal u khun Jong u Ebed bad ki hynmen ki to shynna jongngi u ki la wei sha Shekhem , mala kmen ym shat ïa phi ban wan rung shahïap ka nongbah .
translation.en: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily , saying , Behold , Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem  ; and , behold , they fortify the city against thee .

translation.kha: Kumta ynda u Dabid u wan phai sha ka jaka sher dara na kaba pynap ïa u Golgotha , u Abner u ïalam ïa u sha u Saul . U Dabid u dang rah hi ïa ka khlieh u Goliath .
translation.en: And as David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine , Abner took him , and brought him before Saul with the head of the Philistine in his hand .

translation.kha: Ha kata ka por u syiar u kyn-ih ha ka sien kaba ar , bad u Pontios u la kynmaw kumno ba U jongu u la lah ong ïa u , Shuwa ba u syiar un kynjah ar sien , men ino lai sien ba mem ithuh ïa nga . Bad u la pait ka doh malu u la lynñiar kthang .
translation.en: And the second time the cock crew . And Peter called to mind the word that Jesus said unto him ,  Before the cock crow twice , thou shalt deny me thrice .  And when he thought thereon , he wept .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah synshar jong ki Assyria ki btin , Leh phin ïathuh ïa nga ba phi shaniah ha U Trai U Blei jyllang phi ? Ka dei ki khang mane ïa U Trai malade ki duwan babha u Hesekaïah u la pynjot , haba u ïatih ïa ki briew ka Jehud bad ka Jerusalem ban mane thrang ha ka duwan ha Jerusalem .
translation.en: But if ye say unto me , We trust in the  Lord  our God : is not that he , whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away , and hath said to Judah and Jerusalem , Ye shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem ?
How shall we do for wives for them that remain , seeing we have sworn by the  Lord  that we will not give them of our daughters to wives ?
translation.kha: Ngin leh kumno ban pynïoh tnga ïa ki rangbah Benjamin kiba dang sah ? Ngi la ai ïa ka jingkular kaba kyntang sha U  Trai  ba ngin ym ai ha ki ïa la ki khun kynthei .

Namar ba Us ki khun , kumba u khot ïa ki , ki long ki briew na ka doh bad ka snam , U Jisu u la long u briew kum ma ki hi malade ïoh bynta sam na ka jinglongbriew jong ki . U la leh ïa kane , khnang ba da ka jingap jongno u , u lah ba pynpoh ïa u Bymman , uba anna ka bor halor ka jingpynïap ,
translation.en: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood , he also himself likewise took part of the same  ; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death , that is , the devil  ;
Yea , he loved the people  ; all his saints are in thy hand : and they sat down at thy feet  ; every one shall receive of thy words .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ieit ïa la ki briew , bad u ïada ïa la ki jong . Kumta ngi dem ha ki kjat jong u , bad kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
Ka kmie jong me ka la long kum u dieng sohwaiñ uba la thung hajan ka wahduid . Namar ba la don khiar ka um , ïa u dieng sohwaiñ la tap da ki sla bad u soh .
translation.en: Thy mother is like a vine in thy blood , planted by the waters : she was fruitful and full of branches by reason of many waters .

Run ye to and fro through the streets of Jerusalem , and see now , and know , and seek in the broad places thereof , if ye can find a man , if there be any that executeth judgment , that seeketh the truth  ; and I will pardon it .
translation.kha: Ko ki briew ka Jerusalem , to phet lyngba ki surok bah jong phi ! To khmih sawdong ! Peit hi da lade ! To wad ïa ki jaka ïew ! Hato phi lah ban shem uwei u briew uba leh ïa kaba dei bad uba pyrshang ban ïaineh ha U Blei ? Lada phi lah , U  Trai  un map ïa ka Jerusalem .
Nangta u paidbah u ong ha u Joshua , Nyngkong shakri ïa U Trai U balui jong ngi . Ngin kohnguh ïa ki hukum jong u .
translation.en: And the people said unto Joshua , The  Lord  our God will we serve , and his voice will we obey .

translation.kha: Nahath u Jakob bad u Ïoannis , ki khun shynrang jong u Sebedi , ki la wan ha U Jisu , Ko Nonghikai , ki la ïai-ong , ka don kadei kaei naba im kwah ïa me ban leh na ka bynta jong sem .
translation.en: And James and John , the sons of Zebedee , come unto him , saying , Master , we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire .

translation.kha: Ïa ka umphniang kaba tang sah ha ka sla ti un kyllan ha ka khlaiñ jong uta u briew . kumne Keiñ u lyngdoh un pynnep ïa ka rukom lehniam kabu ïaid Bad ka jingpynkhuid .
translation.en: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed : and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the  Lord .

translation.kha: (Nga la khmih , bad hangta la don u kulai Baalah . Halor jong u , u nongshong kulai u la batbit ïa ka ryntieh , bad ha u la ai ïa ka pyntieng . U la shon hajir jong u kum u nongjop shun jop .
translation.en: And I saw , and behold a white horse : and he that sat on him had a bow  ; and a crown was given unto him : and he went forth conquering , and to conquer .

translation.kha: ktang ba ki briew jongno u kmen kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong u bad ban bangeit ïa ki sah” jong u baroh . Ïaroh ïa U Trai !
translation.en: That they might observe his statutes , and keep his laws . Praise ye the  Lord .

translation.kha: Bad u Saul u la mynjur ïa ka jingpyndep ïa u Stephan . Ha kata hi ka sngi , ka balang ha Jerusalem ka la sdang baneh mad ïa ka Jingpynshitom beiñ kaba ishyrkhei . Baroh ki riewngeit , lait neh ki Apostol , ki la sakma sha kylleng jong ki thain ka Judia bad ka Gemaraïah .
translation.en: And Saul was consenting unto his death . And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem  ; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria , except the apostles .

As I live , saith the Lord  God  , surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king , whose oath he despised , and whose covenant he brake , even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die .
translation.kha: Kumba da shisha nga long U Blei uba im ,  U  Trai  Nongsynshar u la ong ,  une u syiem un ïap ha Babilonia namar u la pynkheiñ ïa la ka jingsmai bad ka jingïateh lok bad u syiem ka Babilonia , uba la buh ïa u halor ka khet .

translation.en: This he said , not that he cared for the poor  ; but because he was a thief , and had the bag , and bare what was put therein .
translation.kha: U la ong ïa kane , ym namar ba u da sngewkhia ïa kiba duk , hynrei namar ba u la long u nongtuh . U bat ïa ka pla pisa bad uba la ju shim na ka ban pyndonkam ïa lade .
Hynrei ngam kein sianti ka hok ban jied mano u ngab shong sha kamon jong nga bad sha kthang jong nga . Dei U Blei u ban ai ïa Kine ki iaka ha kita ïa kiba u la pynkhreh ïa ki .
translation.en: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give  ; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared .

translation.kha: Haba ki la poi ha u mawsiang Bah ha Gibeon , u Amasa u la ïakynduh ïa ki . U Jobab u la phong ka jaiñ ïalap thma , Bad ka thliem hapoh ka jingsop jong ka ïa kob la Tei pynskhem ha u panpoh jong u . Katba u wan shad khmat ka waitlam ka la hap .
translation.en: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon , Amasa went before them . And Joab s garment that he had put on was girded unto him , and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof  ; and as he went forth it fell out .
And David went up from thence , and dwelt in strong holds at En–gedi .
translation.kha: U Dabid u mihnoh bad u leit sha ka thain jong ka Engedi , ha kaba u la sah ha kaba rieh .
kan long kaba dei ïa phin ban syiem da ka kyrthat jong nga . Nangta baroh ki jingïapthngan ngin kyrpad ïa nga ban kyrshut ïa ki , badno kin ïaroh ïa nga .
translation.en: And thou shalt swear , The  Lord  liveth , in truth , in judgment , and in righteousness  ; and the nations shall bless themselves in him , and in him shall they glory .

But thou shouldest not have looked on the day of thy brother in the day that he became a stranger  ; neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction  ; neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly in the day of distress .
translation.kha: Pha la dei ban ym risa beiñ halor ka jingshem jynjar jong ki hynmen ki para jong pha ha Judah . Pha la dei ban ym lehkmen ha ka sngi ka jingpynjot ïa ki . Pha la dei ban ym rkhie ïa ki ha ka jingjynjar jong ki .
U Syiem Salome u shna shi kynhun ki lieng ha Bengeber , kaba hajan Elath , harud jong ka Khmut tyrwa Akaba , ha ka ri Edom .
translation.en: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion–geber , which is beside Eloth , on the shore of the Red sea , in the land of Edom .

translation.kha: Hangto ngam long u briew uba laitluid ? Hato ngam long u Apostol ? Hato ngam shym la ïor ïa U Jisu! uba U Trai jong ngi ? Hato phi phim long u soh ka jingtrei jongnga at na ka bynta U Tiras ?
translation.en: Am I not an apostle ? am I not free ? have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord ? are not ye my work in the Lord ?

translation.kha: Me dei shun shim ïa u masi lyngraw ïa uba la ai kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop bad tdong ïa u ha ka jakarieh ba la pynkhreh khnang shabar ka Templ .
translation.en: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering , and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house , without the sanctuary .

translation.kha: To ai Law , te , ba yn da ap phira biang biang ïa ka jingtep jongngi u tad haduh ka sngi kaba lai , khñiang ba ki synrang jrong u kin ym lah ban leit banbeiñ shit ïa ka met , bad nangta ban iathuh ha ki briew ba u la mihpat na ka jingïap . Kane ka jinglamler kaba khatduh kan longkmie kaba kham sniew ban ïa kaba nyngkong .
translation.en: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day , lest his disciples come by night , and steal him away , and say unto the people , He is risen from the dead : so the last error shall be worse than the first .
To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins ,
translation.kha: ban ïathuh ha ki briew jong u ba yn pynim ïa ki da kaba ki ïoh ka jingmap ïa ki pop jong ki .
ka Keilah , ka Akhsib , bad ka Mareshah : khyndai tyllun ki nongbah lem ruh malu ki nongrit kiba sawkyr-ang jong ki .
translation.en: And Keilah , and Achzib , and Mareshah  ; nine cities with their villages :

translation.kha: bad ngi la lyngngoh sha U Terah shun ïoh jingïarap . U la jingsngewsih ïa ka jinglynñiar jong ngi bad u la phah ïa u angel , umbah la ïalam noh ïa ngi na Jingtep . Mynta ngi don ha Kadesh , ka shnong kaba ha khappud ka shem jong phi .
translation.en: And when we cried unto the  Lord  , he heard our voice , and sent an angel , and hath brought us forth out of Egypt : and , behold , we are in Kadesh , a city in the uttermost of thy border :

translation.kha: Ka por ka la poi ïa ka ba Kan kha , bad ka la ïoh ar ngut ki khun synrap shynrang .
translation.en: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled , behold , there were twins in her womb .

And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof  ; and I will destroy the counsel thereof : and they shall seek to the idols , and to the charmers , and to them that have familiar spirits , and to the wizards .
translation.kha: Ngan pynpulom ïa ki jingthmu jong ki nong Ijipt bad ngan pynjot ïa ka jingsngewskhem jong ki . Kin kyrpad ïa ki bleithaw jong ki ban ïarap ïa ki , bad kin leit ban kylli na ki nongleh byrtong bad kylli na ki mynsiem jong kiba ïap ban ïoh jingmut .

Kumno nga lah ban leh ïa kata ? U Samuel u kylli . Lydia u Saul u ïohsngew ïa kata , un pynsep ïa ar ! U Trai u jubab , Shim ïa u khun masi bad ong ba me don hangta ban kñia ïa ka jingainguh ha U Trai’ .
translation.en: And Samuel said , How can I go ? if Saul hear it , he will kill me . And the  Lord  said , Take an heifer with thee , and say , I am come to sacrifice to the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Mysia u la kohnguh bad u la shim
translation.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old , every one that came to do the service of the ministry , and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation ,

translation.kha: Phi da ban shem da lade hi ba dang myntan hapoh ka krem U Trai u la buh ïa phi hapoh ka bor jong nga . katno katne ki jingbabe jong nga ki ong ïa de ban pynkup ïa phi , hynrei nga sngewsynei ïa phira bad ong ba ngan ym pynmynsaw ïa phi , namar phi dei uta uba U Trai u la jat ban long syiem .
translation.en: Behold , this day thine eyes have seen how that the  Lord  had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave : and some bade me kill thee : but mine eye spared thee  ; and I said , I will not put forth mine hand against my lord  ; for he is the  Lord s  anointed .
And by reason hereof he ought , as for the people , so also for himself , to offer for sins .
translation.kha: Bad namar ma u hi u long uba tlot , u dei ban ai ïa ki jingkñia ym tang na ka bynta ki pop jong ki briew hynrei namar ki pop jong u ruh .
U Blei u long uba donbor ; baroh ki dei baneh ïeng ha ka jingsheptieng ïa u ; U pynïeng ïa ka hima ba kynja bneng ha ka jingsuk .
translation.en: Dominion and fear are with him , he maketh peace in his high places .

translation.kha: Kumta te , ko ki paralok ba-ieit jong nga , to ñiar noh na kaba mane ïa ki leilieh .
translation.en: Wherefore , my dearly beloved , flee from idolatry .

translation.kha: Kumta u Joseph u leit ïalam san ngut na ki hynmen lad u shai u syiem . U ong , I pa bad ki hynmen ki para jong nga ki la wan na ka ri Kanaan ryngkat bun ki kynhun langbrot bad ki jingri jingdup jong ki , mala baïar ruh kat kiba ki don . Mynta ki don ha Goshen .
translation.en: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh , and said , My father and my brethren , and their flocks , and their herds , and all that they have , are come out of the land of Canaan  ; and , behold , they are in the land of Goshen .

translation.kha: Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Nadab u la leh , la buh jingthoh ha Ka Hanes jongnga Ki Syiem Ka Israel .
translation.en: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab , and all that he did , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel ?
But made himself of no reputation , and took upon him the form of a servant , and was made in the likeness of men :
translation.kha: Ha ka jaka kane , da ka mon balaitluid u kheiñduh noh ïa baroh kaba u don , bad u la shim ïa ka jinglong u shakri . U kylla long u kum u briew , bad u la wanpaw ha ka dur u briew .

translation.en: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge , and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly .
translation.kha: Kin ym long shuh ki bymïaishah , hynrei kin trei ha ka jingshemphang bad kin ong ïa kaei kaba ki mut .

Ai ba ka dohnud ba la patan jong phi kan pyn-i ïa ka jingsngewsih jong phi ; kaba kad ïa ki jaiñphong jongki phi kam biang . To wan phan pat sha U Trai U Blei jngai phi . U long uba sbun bad uba dap da ka jingisynei ; u erlangthari uba ïashad slem bad uba bat ïa la ka kular ; u hir borabor kaba kloi banbeiñ Kartan sad ym ban pynsum .
translation.en: And rend your heart , and not your garments , and turn unto the  Lord  your God : for he is gracious and merciful , slow to anger , and of great kindness , and repenteth him of the evil .
And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years , and begat sons and daughters :
translation.kha: bad hadien kata u la im sa phraspah khatsan snem . U la ïoh ruh kiwei pat ki khun

translation.en: The earth shall quake before them  ; the heavens shall tremble : the sun and the moon shall be dark , and the stars shall withdraw their shining :
translation.kha: Ka pyrthei ka khih katba ki nang tur ; ka sahit bneng ka khynñiuh . Ka sngi bad u bnai ki kylla dum , bad ki khlur kim shai shuh .
To kmen , to sngewsarong , nabar ïa ka bainong bakhraw la buh na ka pynbha jong phin ha ki pdeng . Kainan ka long da kumno la pynsamthiah bseiñ ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la im ha shata jyllang phi .
translation.en: Rejoice , and be exceeding glad : for great is your reward in heaven : for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you .

translation.kha: Bad ïa phi ruh , ko paralok baïaineh jong nga , nga kwah ïa phira ban ïarap ïa kine ki kynthei ; naba ki la trei shit lem bad nga ban pynsngap ïa ka habar , ryngkat bad u Klemen , mala baroh kiwei pat ki para nongtei lam jong la , kaba ki kyrteng jong ki , ki don ha ka kitab jong kiba im jong U Bela .
translation.en: And I entreat thee also , true yokefellow , help those women which laboured with me in the gospel , with Clement also , and with other my fellowlabourers , whose names are in the book of life .
Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish , and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts .
translation.kha: Ka kyiad ka long ïa ki briew kiba la jan ïap , ïa kito kiba shem jynjar sat .
Baroh kiei kiei kiba u Amasaïah u la kuna la Buh jingthoh ha Ka 1870 jongu Ki Syiem Ka Judia .
translation.en: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah , are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah ?
Now go , write it before them in a table , and note it in a book , that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever :
translation.kha: U Blei u la ong ïa nga ban thoh ha ka kot ba ki briew kiba kumno ki long , khnang ba kan don ka jingthoh jingkynmaw baneh shi rta , haduh katno ki la long kiba sniew .
Ki rangbah kiba ïadon bad sa ki la ioh ïa ka jingshai , hynrei kim shym ïohsngew ïa ka ar jong uta uba krenbeiñ ha nga .
translation.en: And they that were with me saw indeed the light , and were afraid  ; but they heard not the voice of him that spake to me .
For as we have many members in one body , and all members have not the same office :
translation.kha: Ngi don bun ki dkhot ha kawei ka met bad baroh kine ki dkhot ki don ki jingtreikam bapher bapher .
Balei ba me buh ïa nga hapoh u nongap phra ? Me pynkoit ba nga daiñ u mrad kynsha ka duriaw ?
translation.en: Am I a sea , or a whale , that thou settest a watch over me ?

translation.kha: Kumta u Joshua u la lytar noh bad u la kynran bad ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki rangbah pynïaidkam jong ki nongap phira ka thalab shaphang kumno u lah banbeiñ shetkylla ïa U Jisu ha ki .
translation.en: And he went his way , and communed with the chief priests and captains , how he might betray him unto them .

translation.kha: Ïa uwei pa nawei u dieng la thup da u soh uba u pynmih ; kino ju kheit soh Dumbur na ki pynbna shiah lane lum ïa ki sohwaiñ na ki bniap shiah bud .
translation.en: For every tree is known by his own fruit . For of thorns men do not gather figs , nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes .
And I say unto thee , Let my son go , that he may serve me : and if thou refuse to let him go , behold , I will slay thy son , even thy firstborn .
translation.kha: Nga la ong ïa me ban shah ïa u khun jong nga ban leit , khnang ba un ïoh mane ïa nga , hynrei me la kyntait . Mynta te ngan pynïap ïa u khun nyngkong jong me .’

translation.en: And he made a covering for the tent of rams  skins dyed red , and a covering of badgers  skins above that .
translation.kha: Ki shna ruh sa ar tylli ki jingtap , kawei kaba da ka snieh u langbrot kaba la wieh rong saw , bad kawei pat kaba da ka snieh kaba jlih , ban long kum ka jingtap nalor .
Pynban , phi la wan sha u lum Seir bad sha ka nongbah jong U Blei! uba im , ka Jerusalem kaba kynja bneng , ha kaba la ne dara khashor ki angel .
translation.en: But ye are come unto mount Sion , and unto the city of the living God , the heavenly Jerusalem , and to an innumerable company of angels ,

translation.kha: Nangta un pyllait ïa kata ka sim ba kan her khong shabar ka nongbah katjuh shaba ka mon . Da kumta un pyndem ïa ka mai ka man kaba ïadei bad ka jingpynkhuid ïa kata ka ïing , bad kan sa longkmie kaba khuid .
translation.en: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields , and make an atonement for the house : and it shall be clean .

translation.kha: Ngan ai ha ki ka nadong bathymmai mala ka jingot bathymmai . Ngan shim noh ïa ka dohnud maw ba-mutlop sad ngan ai ha ki ka ïaduna bakohnguh .
translation.en: And I will give them one heart , and I will put a new spirit within you  ; and I will take the stony heart out of their flesh , and will give them an heart of flesh :
Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me , which to you-ward is not weak , but is mighty in you .
translation.kha: Phin ïoh ïa ka jingpynshisha baroh kaba phi kwah ba U Khrist u kren ha nga . Haba u pynbeit ïa phi , um long uba tlot , pynban , u pynpaw ïa la ka bor hapdeng jong phi .
Ka Asaraïah ka don hangta , lem bad ki jingtep jong ki shipai jong ka ha bhor shohdoh .
translation.en: Asshur is there and all her company : his graves are about him : all of them slain , fallen by the sword :

translation.en: I am hungry
