translation.en: And said unto them , Ye men of Israel , take heed to yourselves what ye intend to do as touching these men .

translation.kha: Nga kah ban sakhi da lade hi ïa ka jingrkhie shitom jong u na ka bynta jrong phi bad na ka bynta ki bariew kiba ha Libya bad ha Hierapolis .
translation.en: For I bear him record , that he hath a great zeal for you , and them that are in Laodicea , and them in Hierapolis .

translation.kha: A katno nga kyrmen ba ngan long uba ïaineh ha kaba sumar ïa ki jingbthah jong me !
translation.en: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes !

translation.kha: Nangta u Joseph u shimti noh ïa ki na u , bad u nguh u dem ïa u haduh madan .
translation.en: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees , and he bowed himself with his face to the earth .

translation.kha: namsop man u khun U blei u lah ban jop noh thiaw ïa ka pyrthei . Bad ngi ïoh ïa ka jingjop halor ka pyrthei lyngba ka jingngeit jong ngi .
translation.en: For whatsoever is born of God overcometh the world : and this is the victory that overcometh the world , even our faith .

translation.kha: Baroh ar ngut ki im ka jingrem kaba beh ha khmat U Blei bad ki la kohnguh lut ïa baroh ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong U Trai .
translation.en: And they were both righteous before God , walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless .

translation.kha: hynrei ïa ki iaka mane ba-thala ym shym la pynjot . Ki bri kim pat shym la blei da ka dohnud barben baneh shakri ïa U Blei jong ki kpa bymman jyllang ki .
translation.en: Howbeit the high places were not taken away : for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the God of their fathers .

translation.kha: To pynshlur ïa ki bhabriew ka Jerusalem . To ïathuh ha ki ba ki la jynjar slem bakha bad ïa ki pop jong ki la map mynba . Nga la pynshitom ïa ki la biang bha na ka bynta ki Pop jong ki baroh .
translation.en: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem , and cry unto her , that her warfare is accomplished , that her iniquity is pardoned : for she hath received of the  Lord s  hand double for all her sins .

translation.kha: Kumta ki wallam ïa la ki jingri sha u Joseph ; u pat u ïapli ïa ka jingbam bad ki kulai , ki langbrot , ki blang , ki jingrai jingdup , dara ki kada . Ha kata ka sner u pynïap ïa ki da kaba shu ïapli bad ki jingri jingdup jongu ki baïar .
translation.en: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph : and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses , and for the flocks , and for the cattle of the herds , and for the asses : and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year .

translation.kha: Keiñ ka dei kaei ba ngin leh . Haba ki lyngkhuh pynlang ki Lebi ki wan ban pyndep kam ha ka Sabbaton , shi boitha na ka to bynta na ki kin ap phira ïa ki khyrdop ka Templ ,
translation.en: This is the thing that ye shall do  ; A third part of you entering on the sabbath , of the priests and of the Levites , shall be porters of the doors  ;

translation.kha: U Jingsuk u la ong , Ko Pa , to map ïa ki ! Ko tip ïa kaei kaba ki leh . Ki la pynbynta ïa ki jaiñsem jongngi u hapdeng jong ki hi da kaba kynting sbai .
translation.en: Then said Jesus ,  Father , forgive them  ; for they know not what they do .  And they parted his raiment , and cast lots .

translation.kha: nangta phin lah ban im kumba U Trai u kwah bad ba phin ïai leh borabor ïa kaei kaba pynsngewbha ïa u . Ka jingim jongki phi kan pynmih ïa baroh ki jingleh bakha kaban jait , bad phin san ha ka jingtip jong phira ïa U blei .
translation.en: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing , being fruitful in every good work , and increasing in the knowledge of God ;

translation.kha: U Trai un pynshitom ïa u Joab na ka bynta kito ki jingpynïap , kiba u la leh khlem ka jingdap u Dabid u kpa jong nga . U Joab u la pynïap ar ngut ki rangbah balui lui kiba kham bha shun ïa u — u Abner , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shiphew Israel , bad u Amasa , u rangbah ai hukum jong ka kynhun shipai Judah .
translation.en: And the  Lord  shall return his blood upon his own head , who fell upon two men more righteous and better than he , and slew them with the sword , my father David not knowing thereof , to wit , Abner the son of Ner , captain of the host of Israel , and Amasa the son of Jether , captain of the host of Judah .

translation.kha: Don thiang kamai ka met bad uwei U Mynsiem , kumba don tang kamai ka jingkyrmen sha kaba U Blei u la khot ïa phi .
translation.en: There is one body , and one Spirit , even as ye are called in one hope of your calling ;

translation.kha: Ha ka jingjyrsieh jingmut u syiem Belshassar u la nang kham lieh blaid blaid , bad ki rangbah donburom jong u kim tip sha kumta yn ar .
translation.en: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled , and his countenance was changed in him , and his lords were astonished .

translation.kha: Phi hi phi la ju long mynno mynno ha ka jingdum , hynrei namar phi la long ki briew jong U Tlai , Phi long ha ka jingshai . Kut phi dei banbeiñ im kum ki brup kiba don ha ka jingshai ,
translation.en: For ye were sometimes darkness , but now are ye light in the Lord : walk as children of light :

translation.kha: Da khmih bha , te , ba uno uno un ym teh mraw ïa phi da ki buit shukor bymmyntoi jong ka jingstad ba kynja briew , kaba wan na ki jinghikai ba la ai pateng da ki briew bad na ki mynnin kiba synshar ïa ka jingpynlong , bad ym na U Khrist .
translation.en: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit , after the tradition of men , after the rudiments of the world , and not after Christ .
And these are they by the way side , where the word is sown  ; but when they have heard , Satan cometh immediately , and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts .
translation.kha: Katto katne ngut ki briew ki long kum ki symbai kiba hap ha ka lynti ïaid ; ki tang shu ïohsngew ïa ka khubor , u Soitan u wan bad u shim noh ïa ka .

Ha kaba khatduh u ïathuh ha ka ïa ka jingshisha . Ïa u shñiuh jong nga ym pat ju khap , u ong , Ïa nga la pynkyntang sha U Blei khem u Nasir naduh ka to ba kha ïa ar . Lada la khi ïa u jingkhynñiuh jngai nga , ngan duh noh ïa ka bor bad ngan long uba tlot kumba longsem lymne kiwei .
translation.en: That he told her all his heart , and said unto her , There hath not come a razor upon mine head  ; for I have been a Nazarite unto God from my mother s womb : if I be shaven , then my strength will go from me , and I shall become weak , and be like any other man .

translation.kha: U Iso u ong , Kane ka dei ka sien kaba ar ba u la sahit shukor ïa nga . Kam long kaba phira ba ka kyrteng jong u ka dei u Jakob . U la shim noh ïa ki hok ka jinglong khun nyngkong jong nga , bad mynta pat u la shim sa ïa ka jingkyrkhu jong nga . Hato phim shym la tyngkai ka jingkyrkieh ïa nga ?
translation.en: And he said , Is not he rightly named Jacob ? for he hath supplanted me these two times : he took away my birthright  ; and , behold , now he hath taken away my blessing . And he said , Hast thou not reserved a blessing for me ?
Let them be only thine own , and not strangers  with thee .
translation.kha: Ki khun jong phi kin san ban ïarap ïa phi , ym ki nongwei .
Ha hajuh ka por u Shimei u khun jong u dara , na ka khait Benjamin kaba na Bahurim , u la pynkloi ban leit shuh ka Jehoaddin banbeiñ ïanguh ïa u syiemsad Dabid .
translation.en: And Shimei the son of Gera , a Benjamite , which was of Bahurim , hasted and came down with the men of Judah to meet king David .

translation.kha: Kumta iathuh u briew u leit rung sha said ka ïing , bad u Laban u pynïapher ïa ki jingkit na kita ki ut bad u la ai phlangïap bad jingbabe ïa ki . Nangta u la wanrah um ïa u shakri jong u Abraham bad ïa ki nongbanbeiñ jong u ba kin sait ïa la ki kjat .
translation.en: And the man came into the house : and he ungirded his camels , and gave straw and provender for the camels , and water to wash his feet , and the men s feet that were with him .
And as I may so say , Levi also , who receiveth tithes , payed tithes in Abraham .
translation.kha: Bad kum ban shu ong , haba u Abraham u la siew ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew , u Lebi ( kiba hiarpateng na u ki lum ïa kawei-na-kaba-shiphew ) ruh u la siew ïa ka .

translation.en: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit , nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child : even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all .
translation.kha: U Blei u thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , bad phim lah ban shemphang shuh ïa kaei kaba u leh ban ïa kaba phi sngewthuh kumno ka jingim bathymmai ka sdang ha ka kpoh jong ka kynthei kaba armet .

Haduh kat kan jin da la khnam Bha lada ki briew jong ngi ha kane ka sngi ki la bam ïa ka jingbam ba ki la shim long ki jop ïa ki nongshong . Shu pynduk haduh katno ngut shuh shu ki Philistia kyang jingïam da la pynïap .
translation.en: How much more , if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found ? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines ?

translation.kha: Ngan ïarah ïa ki jaitbynriew kiba snep tam hangne bad ailad ïa ki ban shatei ïa ki ïing jong phi . Ki briew kiba khlaiñ tam jong phi kin duh noh ïa la ka jingsngewskhem ynda nga shah ïa ki jaitbynriew ba ken pynjakhlia ïa ki jaka ha kaba phi mane .
translation.en: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the heathen , and they shall possess their houses : I will also make the pomp of the strong to cease  ; and their holy places shall be defiled .

translation.kha: Kumta ïa u Haman la sdien ha ka diengphasi kaba u la Shna na ka bniat u Mordekai . Nangta ka jingbitar u syiem ka la long jai jai .
translation.en: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai . Then was the king s wrath pacified .

translation.kha: Dei ha ka nongrim jong ka jinglong lyngdoh ki Lebi ba la ai ïa ka Hukum ha ki paid Israel . mynba , lada ka kai lynghoh jong ki Lebi ka la long kaba janai , yn ym donkam shuh ïa uwei pat u lyngkdong ban mih , uwei uba na ka jingjrong lyngdoh u Melkhisedek , ym jong u Arnon .
translation.en: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood , ( for under it the people received the law , ) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec , and not be called after the order of Aaron ?
For every house is builded by some man  ; but he that built all things is God .
translation.kha: Man la ka ïing , ha ka jingshisha , la tei da uno uno — Bad uta uba la thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh long U Blei keiñ .

Mynta ! Ka kti kamon jong u ka bat ïa ka jingduk ba la thoh ‘ Meshullam ! Ka ïathuh ïa u ban leit bad buh ïa ki dieng tyndung pynpra kynroh , don pyrta ïa ka jingkyang thma , banbeiñ thuh ïa ki dieng tyndung pynpra kynroh pyrshah ïa ki khyrdop , ba-bang bret shynrong ïa ka khynñiuh ba la tih , bad ban shut ïa ki kharai .
translation.en: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem , to appoint captains , to open the mouth in the slaughter , to lift up the voice with shouting , to appoint battering rams against the gates , to cast a mount , and to build a fort .
And again he said ,  Whereunto shall I liken the kingdom of God ?
translation.kha: U Jisu u la kylli biang ,  Bad kaei ngan ïanujor ïa ka Hima U Blei ?

translation.en: And all mine are thine , and thine are mine  ; and I am glorified in them .
translation.kha: Baroh kaba nga don ka long ka jong me , bad baroh kaba me don ka long ka jong nga ; bad ïa ka burom jong nga la pynpaw lyngba jong ki .

translation.en: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread , and a bottle of wine , and a kid , and sent them by David his son unto Saul .
translation.kha: U Jesse u phah ïa u Dabid sha u Saul lem bad u khunblang , u kada uba kit shikhung u kpu bad ka pla snieh ba-dap da ka waiñ .
U Joshua u ïai-ong ha ki jait Reuben bad jait Gad , malade ha ki shit na ka jait Messaïah ,
translation.en: And to the Reubenites , and to the Gadites , and to half the tribe of Manasseh , spake Joshua , saying ,
And Sheva was scribe : and Zadok and Abiathar were the priests :
translation.kha: u Sheba u dei u sekretari ka ïingbishar ; u Sadok bad u Abiathar ki dei ki lyngdoh ,

translation.en: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you ;
translation.kha: U Blei un leh ïa kaei kaba dei : Un wallam ka jingshah shitom ha kito kiba pynlong ïa phi ban shahshitom ,

translation.en: And Hazael said , But what , is thy servant a dog , that he should do this great thing ? And Elisha answered , The  Lord  hath shewed me that thou shalt be king over Syria .
translation.kha: Kumno keiñ ngan long uba khlaiñbor haduh katta katta ?  u Hasael u kylli .  Ngam long ei ei ruh em !  U Elisha u phai ktien ,  U  Trai  u la pynpaw ha nga ba men sa long u syiem ka Syria .
Wah ïa ka halor ki saw tylli ki riewstad naba da ka dieng akasia ba la suit ksiar , ha Ibbah la buh ïa ki bnoh kiar , malade ïa kiba la thep ha ki thliew tnaw rupa .
translation.en: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold : their hooks shall be of gold , upon the four sockets of silver .
Because to every purpose there is time and judgment , therefore the misery of man is great upon him .
translation.kha: Ka don ka por kaba dei bad ka lynti kaba dei ban leh ïa kiei kiei , hynrei ngi tip tang khyndiat eh !
bad U Trai u ong , khashor ïa kadei kaba u paidbah u ong ha me ; mem long ma me wahbah ki kyntait , Nga long ma nga ïa uba ki la kyntait kum u syiem jong ki .
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Samuel , Hearken unto the voice of the people in all that they say unto thee : for they have not rejected thee , but they have rejected me , that I should not reign over them .

translation.kha: U Iso u ong , Ïa jing ïatyllun khong ; ngan nang ïaid ma nga sha khmat .
translation.en: And he said , Let us take our journey , and let us go , and I will go before thee .

translation.kha: Ngan shim noh napdeng jong phi ïa kito kiba ïng ïaleh pyrshah bad kiba dap da ka pop . Ngin shim noh ïa ki na ki ri ha kiba ki shong ki sah mynta , hynrei ngan ym shah ïa ki ban wan phai pat sha ka ri Eliel . Te phin tip ba por long U TRAI’ .
translation.en: And I will purge out from among you the rebels , and them that transgress against me : I will bring them forth out of the country where they sojourn , and they shall not enter into the land of Israel : and ye shall know that I am the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , Hato phim shym la pule ïa kaei kaba u Dabid u la leh mynba ma u bad ki rangbah jong u ki la thngan ?
translation.en: And Jesus answering them said ,  Have ye not read so much as this , what David did , when himself was an hungred , and they which were with him  ;

Then his brethren and all the house of his father came down , and took him , and brought him up , and buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the buryingplace of Manoah his father . And he judged Israel twenty years .
translation.kha: Ki para bad ki ba-ha-ïing jong u baroh ki wan shim bad rah noh ïa ka met jong u . Ki shim pat ïa u bad ki tep ïa u ha ka jingtep u Manoah u kpa jong u , kaba hapdeng ka Sorah bad ka Eshtaol . U la long u nongïalam ïa ki Israel arphew snem .

translation.en: And the peace of God , which passeth all understanding , shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Bad ka jingsuk U Blei kaba palat ïa ka jingshemphang briew baroh , kan ri jai jai ïa ki dohnud jong phi , bad ïa ki jingmut jong phi ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel  ; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines , and fell down slain in mount Gilboa .
translation.kha: Ki Philistia ki ïaleh thma pyrshah ïa ki Israel halor u lum Gilboa . Shibun na ki Israel ki la shah pynïap hangta bad kiba sah na ki , kynthup ïa u syiem Saul bad ki khun shynrang jong u , ki la phet ïap .
Kumta ki khun Jesreel ki buh ïa ki briew ban apthap ïa ka Gibeah borbah sawdong .
translation.en: And Israel set liers in wait round about Gibeah .

Speak unto Aaron , and to his sons , and unto all the children of Israel , and say unto them , Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel , or of the strangers in Israel , that will offer his oblation for all his vows , and for all his freewill offerings , which they will offer unto the  Lord  for a burnt offering  ;
translation.kha: ban ong ha u Aaron , ha ki khun shynrang jong u , bad ha ki Israel baroh ,  Haba uno uno u Israel lane u nongwei uba ha Israel u ai ïa ka jingainguh thang , la ka long ka jingpyndep ïa kano kano ka jingkular lane kum ka jingainguh mon sngewbha , kata ka jingainguh ,

translation.en: In the first month , on the fourteenth day of the month at even , ye shall eat unleavened bread , until the one and twentieth day of the month at even .
translation.kha: Naduh ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba khatsaw jong u bnai uba nyngkong haduh ka janmiet jong ka sngi kaba arphew wei jong uta u bnai , phin ym ïabam ïa u kpu ba la khleh thiat .
Hynrei kim shym la kohnguh ; ki long ibha mutlop kum ki kpa tymmen jong ki , ki bym shym la shaniah ha U Trai U Blei jong ki .
translation.en: Notwithstanding they would not hear , but hardened their necks , like to the neck of their fathers , that did not believe in the  Lord  their God .

translation.kha: Kynsan ki nongbah bad ki nongkren jong ki , ki don ha ka jaka kaban ki longïing na ka jaiñ Naphtali ki la ïohpateng kum ka jingïohkynti jong ki .
translation.en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of the children of Naphtali according to their families , the cities and their villages .

translation.kha: Nga ngeit ba phin ïoh tip ba jingtem long uba la shahjop .
translation.en: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates .

translation.kha: U Philip u shem ïa lade ha Aretas ; u la nang leit sha Kaisaria , bad ha lynti u la ïalap ïa ka Khroh Babha ha kawei pa kawei ka shaneng .
translation.en: But Philip was found at Azotus : and passing through he preached in all the cities , till he came to Caesarea .

And said unto the king , Let the king live for ever : why should not my countenance be sad , when the city , the place of my fathers  sepulchres , lieth waste , and the gates thereof are consumed with fire ?
translation.kha: Nga la kyndit bad nga jubab ,  Ko Syiem Kynrad , to im junom ! Kumno ngan lah khlem imat sngewsih haba ka nongbah ha kaba la tep ïa ki kpa tymmen jong nga ka don hapdeng ki jingjot bad ïa ki khyrdop jong ka la pynjot ha ka ding ?
Na la bitar bad pynlong ka jingsmai kyntang : ‘ Phin ym ïohrung da lei lei ha ka ri sha ka jaka ha kaba kan ai ka jingïathiah ïa phi! .’
translation.en: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest .

translation.kha: Nga la ong ha ki , Lada phi mon , to ai ïa ka bainong jong nga . Hynrei lada kam long kumta , to bat noh ïa ka . Kumta ki la sleit ïa nga laiphew tylli ki sbai rupa kumno ka bainong jong per .
translation.en: And I said unto them , If ye think good , give me my price  ; and if not , forbear . So they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver .

translation.kha: Ki rangbah ka Judah ki jubab , Me leh ïa kata namar ba u syiem u long utai na me . Balei kane kuna pynbitar ïa phi ? Um shym la siew na ka boitha ka bam jong ngi Lane um shym la ai ei ei ïa ngi .
translation.en: And all the men of Judah answered the men of Israel , Because the king is near of kin to us : wherefore then be ye angry for this matter ? have we eaten at all of the king s cost ? or hath he given us any gift ?
He that laboureth laboureth for himself  ; for his mouth craveth it of him .
translation.kha: Ka jingkwah bam jong u nongbylla sngi ka pynlong ïa u ban kham trei shitom , namar u kwah ban pynhun ïa la ka jingthngan .
U Jisu u la jubab ïa ki , Katno phi la rumal ! Bad phi! tap batylli ? Ka un-long namar ba phim tip ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid lane ïa ka bor jong U Blei .
translation.en: And Jesus answering said unto them ,  Do ye not therefore err , because ye know not the scriptures , neither the power of God ?
Their heart is divided  ; now shall they be found faulty : he shall break down their altars , he shall spoil their images .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba ki dohnud jong ki , ki long kiba shukor , mynta ki dei ban shahshitom namar ki pop jong ki . U Blei un pynpra ïa ki duwan jong ki , bad un pynjot ïa ki rishot kyntang jong ki .
Te ha ka sngi kaba khathynñiew jongngi u bnai uba khyndew , kata ka lieng ka wan neh den halor u lehbha ha ki lynter lum Ararat .
translation.en: And the ark rested in the seventh month , on the seventeenth day of the month , upon the mountains of Ararat .

translation.kha: hynrei Katto ka jingkhlaiñ kaba khrong ka don ha ka jemnud jong u , bad katno ka hab kaba khraw ka don ha ki dohksah jong u !
translation.en: Lo now , his strength is in his loins , and his force is in the navel of his belly .
And Moses spake so unto the children of Israel : but they hearkened not unto Moses for anguish of spirit , and for cruel bondage .
translation.kha: U Moses u la ïathuh ïa kane ha ki Israel , hynrei kim shym sngap ïa u , namar ka mynsiem jong ki ka la pait la pra na kata ka jinglongmraw basohsat jong ki .

translation.en: The people which sat in darkness saw great light  ; and to them which sat in the region and shadow of death light is sprung up .
translation.kha: Ki briew kiba shong ha ka jingdum kin ïohi ïa ka jingshai kaba khraw . Ha kito kiba im ha ka ri ba-dum jong ka jingïap ka jingshai kan tyngshaiñ .

Te u Salmone u duli , A Trai Bakhraw , to kynmaw ïa nga , ai ha nga ïa ka bor sa tyngkan shisien , khnang ba Tang da kane ngan kah ba-bang pynhiarkput ïa ki Philistia nongmareh ba ki la khlieh ïa ki khmat jong nga baroh ar .
translation.en: And Samson called unto the  Lord  , and said , O Lord  God  , remember me , I pray thee , and strengthen me , I pray thee , only this once , O God , that I may be at once avenged of the Philistines for my two eyes .

translation.kha: Nga la ïai-ong borabor ba ka jingstet ka khah bha ban ïa ka jingïalang , hynne ym don mano mano ba pyrkhat ïa u briew uba kun ba u longïng uba stad lane pynshahshkor ei ei ïa kaei kaba u ong .
translation.en: Then said I , Wisdom is better than strength : nevertheless the poor man s wisdom is despised , and his words are not heard .

translation.kha: U Dabid u khun jong u Jesse u synshar sawphew snem halor ki Israel baroh .
translation.en: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Israel .
And , behold , seven thin ears and blasted with the east wind sprung up after them .
translation.kha: Nangta , sa hynñiew tylli kiwei pat ki kop kew ki la shylluit , kiba raikhoh bad ba la pyntyrkhong da ka lyer ri shyiap , bad ki kop kew kiba raikhoh ki la nguid noh ïa kiba met .

translation.en: When the end comes , who will survive ?
translation.kha: Ynda wan kaba kut , Mano ban laitim ?
U Isaïah u duwai ha U Trai , bad U thri u Pynlong ïa ka syrngiew ban leit shiphew kem shadien ha ki mawkyrdon ba la buh da u Syiem Adah .
translation.en: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto the  Lord  : and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward , by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz .

translation.kha: haba nga la ïohsngew ïa ka sur jong u , nga la kyllon ha khyndew khlem tipbriew bad nga thiah pyllup hangta .
translation.en: Yet heard I the voice of his words : and when I heard the voice of his words , then was I in a deep sleep on my face , and my face toward the ground .
And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of the  Lord  , she came to prove him with hard questions .
translation.kha: Ka Syiem jong ka ri Sheba ka bna shaphang ka nam u Solomon , bad ka leit sha Jerusalem ban tynjuh ïa u da ki jingkylli kiba eh .
Kanaan ka long ka khubor shaphang ka Ninebeh , ka jingïathuh shaphang ka jingïohipaw kaba la ïohi da u Nahum , uba dem na Elkosh .
translation.en: The burden of Nineveh . The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite .

translation.kha: Naba u Aram u la ap khmih ïa ka nongbah kaba U balui u la pynwandur bad u la tei , ka nongbah kaba don ki nongrim baneh .
translation.en: For he looked for a city which hath foundations , whose builder and maker is God .

translation.kha: kin jah noh kum ki jaiñ ba la bam khñiang ! Hynrei ka jingpyllait kaba ngan wallam kan neh jingmut ; ka jingit jong nga tista neh ha ki por baroh .
translation.en: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment , and the worm shall eat them like wool : but my righteousness shall be for ever , and my salvation from generation to generation .

translation.kha: Kam kein jingbuh ban thaw ïa ka dur nar don mane khem u blei !
translation.en: Who hath formed a god , or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing ?

translation.kha: Te u Jehosabad u shim ïa ka synduk , u ksam thliew ha ka jingtap , bad u Buh ïa ka syngkien hajan ka duwan , ha ka phang kamon hajan rung sha ka Tep . Ki lyngdoh kiba dei treikam ha ka jaka rung ki thep ha ka syngkien ïa ka pud baroh kaba la ai da ki nongwan Mano .
translation.en: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest , and bored a hole in the lid of it , and set it beside the altar , on the right side as one cometh into the house of the  Lord  : and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the  Lord .
For Sarah conceived , and bare Abraham a son in his old age , at the set time of which God had spoken to him .
translation.kha: Ïa uta u khun la kha ha ka por ba U Blei u la buh ba yn sa kha ïa u .

translation.en: And Moses charged the people the same day , saying ,
translation.kha: Nangta u Moses u ong ha ki paid Israel ,
Kumba phi thop kumno ba moi iohi jingkyrmen bad jingaimynsiem bad jingsiew ïa baroh na phi , kam u kpa u leh ïa la ki khum .
translation.en: As ye know how we exhorted and comforted and charged every one of you , as a father doth his children ,
There is neither Jew nor Greek , there is neither bond nor free , there is neither male nor female : for ye are all one in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Kumta , ym don jingïapher hapdeng ki Jiw bad ki Jentil , hapdeng ki mraw bad kiba laitluid , hapdeng ki shynrang bad ki kynthei ; phi baroh phi ïalong kawei ha U Khrist Jisu .

translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Fear them not : for I have delivered them into thine hand  ; there shall not a man of them stand before thee .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u ong ha u Joshua ,  Wat sheptieng ïa ki . Nga la ai lypa ha me ïa ka jingjop . Yn ym don uwei ruh na ki uba lah ban ïeng pyrshah ïa me .

Ki kular jong ki , ki kham stet ban ïa ki labasa , kham shyrkhei ban ïa ki suri bathngan . Ki nongshong kulai jong ki , ki wan tur na ki jaka ba sha jngai ; ki kulai jong ki , ki trud ïa ka khyndew . Ki wan tiduh wia kum ki pukni kiba tur ha ka jingbam .
translation.en: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards , and are more fierce than the evening wolves : and their horsemen shall spread themselves , and their horsemen shall come from far  ; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat .
But Sihon trusted not Israel to pass through his coast : but Sihon gathered all his people together , and pitched in Jahzah , and fought against Israel .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Sihon um shym shah ïa ki Israel ba kin leh kumta . U lumlang ïa u paidïapom jong u baroh , u sher dara ha Jahas , bad u tur ïaleh ïa ki Israel .
Ka jingjahburom ïa U Trai ka wanrah ïa ka jingsngewskhem bad ka jingshngain ïa u briew bad ïa ka longïing jong u .
translation.en: In the fear of the  Lord  is strong confidence : and his children shall have a place of refuge .
Now after two days he departed thence , and went into Galilee .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la pynlut ar sngi hangta , U Jisu u la mihnoh bad u la leit sha Galilaïa .

translation.en: How many apples are there in my hand ?
translation.kha: Katno tylli ki soh apple ki don ha ka kti jong nga ?

( U syiem ka ri Ieit u tur ïaleh ïa ka Geser bad u la ïohknieh ïa ka , u la pynïap ïa ki traishnong hangtai pynlang u la thang ïa ka . Nangta u la ai ïa ka ha ka khulom jong u kum ka jingïoh bynta jong ka ha ka to ba ka shongkurim ïa u Solomon , bad u Solomon u tei Thummim ïa ka . )
translation.en: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up , and taken Gezer , and burnt it with fire , and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city , and given it for a present unto his daughter , Solomon s wife .

translation.kha: Haba ki nongshun jong ngi kiba kein ha ki jingñiewbeiñ sawdong jongu ngi ki ïohsngew ïa kane , ki la sngewthuh ba ki la poi ha ka jinglehrain , namar baroh ki tip ba ïa ka jingtrei la pyndep da ka jingïarap U Balei .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that when all our enemies heard thereof , and all the heathen that were about us saw these things , they were much cast down in their own eyes : for they perceived that this work was wrought of our God .

translation.kha: U Ladan u don lai ngut ki khun shynrang : u Jeriel , u Setham , bad u Jemuel ,
translation.en: The sons of Laadan  ; the chief was Jehiel , and Zetham , and Joel , three .
My lord , hearken unto me : the land is worth four hundred shekels of silver  ; what is that betwixt me and thee ? bury therefore thy dead .
translation.kha: Ko rangbah , ka khyndew ka shongdor tang sawspah tylli ki sbai rupa — kan long aïu kata hapdeng jong ngi ? To tep ïa la ka tnga hangta .

U Trai u ong , Ko ki pyntud Israel , nga da pyrkhat ïa ki briew ka shadong kumba nga leh ïa phi . Nga la wallam ïa ki nong Philistia na Kut bad ïa ki nong Syria na Kir , kumba sa la wallam ïa phi na Ijipt .
translation.en: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me , O children of Israel ? saith the  Lord . Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt ? and the Philistines from Caphtor , and the Syrians from Kir ?

translation.kha: Da ka bor jong U Mynsiem Bakhuid , umbah im hapoh jong ngi , to sumar ïa kiei kiei kiba bha ïa kiba la pynkhamti ha me .
translation.en: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us .

translation.kha: Don arspah sanphew ngut ki lapbah synshar kiba dei klet ïa ki nongtrei ba la pynbor ban trei ïa kiba bunkam tei jingieit .
translation.en: And these were the chief of king Solomon s officers , even two hundred and fifty , that bare rule over the people .

translation.kha: Wah ïa ka halor ki saw tylli ki rishot kiba da ka dieng akasia ba la suit ksiar , ha kiba la buh ïa ki bnoh ksiar , bad ïa Kiba la thep ha ki thliew tnaw rupa .
translation.en: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold : their hooks shall be of gold , upon the four sockets of silver .
And they cried aloud , and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets , till the blood gushed out upon them .
translation.kha: Kumta ki nongïathuhlypa ki la duwai kham jam bad ki la ot ïa lade da ki tari bad ki waitsum , kat kum ki rukom lehniam jong ki , haduh ba ka snam ka la tuid .
Ki bteng lang san thylli kita ki lyngkhot jaiñ ba kin long tyngkan kawei shi sieh jingbat , bad ki leh kumjuh ïa ki Hynriew tylli ki lyngkhot jaiñ kiba sah .
translation.en: And he coupled five curtains by themselves , and six curtains by themselves .

translation.kha: Un phuh ha phi ïa ka jingpang kawei hadien kawei khih ba yn ym don shuh uwei ruh na phi u ban lehse im ha kata ka ri naba phin sa ïohkynti .
translation.en: The  Lord  shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee , until he have consumed thee from off the land , whither thou goest to possess it .

translation.kha: Me dei ban shim ïa u masi lyngngeit ïa uba la ai kum ka jingkñia na ka bynta ka pop nabar thang ïa u ha ka jakarieh ba la pynkhreh khnang shakor ka Templ .
translation.en: Thou shalt take the bullock also of the sin offering , and he shall burn it in the appointed place of the house , without the sanctuary .

translation.kha: Bad u Mikaïah u pynpait : Kane ka long kaei kaba la jia . U Trai u pynlong ïa ki nongïathuhlypa jong me ban krensih lamler ïa me . hynne ma u hi da lade u la raïot ba phi ngat ha ka jingjot !
translation.en: Now therefore , behold , the  Lord  hath put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these thy prophets , and the  Lord  hath spoken evil concerning thee .

translation.kha: U Thomas ( ïa uba la khot babha Kha Synrap ) u la ong ha la ki para synran , Ïa ngin ïaleit baroh dara u Nonghikai , ba ngin ïa-ïap ryngkat bad u !
translation.en: Then said Thomas , which is called Didymus , unto his fellowdisciples , Let us also go , that we may die with him .

translation.kha: Hadien katto katne per u Boanerjes da lade hi u wan poi na Bethlehem bad u ai ïakhublei ïa ki nongtrei . To U Tiras un long ryngkat bad phi ! u ong . U Trai u kyrkhu ïa phi ! ki jubab .
translation.en: And , behold , Boaz came from Beth–lehem , and said unto the reapers , The  Lord  be with you . And they answered him , The  Lord  bless thee .

translation.kha: Katba ki dang ïabam , kynsan ki la ïohi shi kynhun ki nadong Ishmael kiba wan ïaid lynter na Gilead sha Ijipt . Ïa ki ut jong ki la pyndik ïa ki musli musla bad ki jingiwbih .
translation.en: And they sat down to eat bread : and they lifted up their eyes and looked , and , behold , a company of Ishmaelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh , going to carry it down to Egypt .

translation.kha: Wat ïa ki Lud bad ki jaiñ-da kiba u la pyndonkam la leit lam sha pli kiba pang , bad ïa ki jingpang jong ki la beh noh , bad ki mynsiem bymman ki ju mihpaw na ki .
translation.en: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons , and the diseases departed from them , and the evil spirits went out of them .

translation.kha: Hangno ka don ka jingkyrmen jong nga ? Mano ba ïohi ïa nga ?
translation.en: And where is now my hope ? as for my hope , who shall see it ?

translation.kha: U Trai u Kren ha u Moses hadien ka jingïap jong ki ar ngut ki khun shyieng jong u Aaron kiba la shah pynïap mynba ki kñia ainguh ha U Trai da ka ding bymkhuid .
translation.en: And the  Lord  spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron , when they offered before the  Lord  , and died  ;

translation.kha: Man ka por ba ka langbrot ka shah pynïap ha ki mradkhlaw , ar kitkhlieh hi ma nga . Ngam ju wanpaw ïa Kata ban pyn-i ha phi ba kam shym dei ka jingbakla jngai nga . Phi dawa ba ma nga hi ngan hap buria ïa kaba eh shah tuh la ka long mynsiem lane mynmiet .
translation.en: That which was torn of beasts I brought not unto thee  ; I bare the loss of it  ; of my hand didst thou require it , whether stolen by day , or stolen by night .

translation.kha: Kin ïarap na ka jingtngen bad ka jingong shit ; ktien ïap na ki jingpang kiba ishyrkhei . Te ngan phah ki mawkyrdon ban kyntiap ïa ki , bad ki bnai kiba don bih ban buh ïa ki .
translation.en: They shall be burnt with hunger , and devoured with burning heat , and with bitter destruction : I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them , with the poison of serpents of the dust .
The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight , saying , No eye shall see me : and disguiseth his face .
translation.kha: Uba klim u ap ïa ka por janmiet ba kan wan ; u tap ïa la ka khmat khnang ban ym don mano mano ba lah ban ïohi ïa u .

translation.en: And immediately the angel of the Lord smote him , because he gave not God the glory : and he was eaten of worms , and gave up the ghost .
translation.kha: Mar kumta hi u angel jong U Trai u la tied ïa u Herod , namar ba um shym ai burom ïa U Blei . La bam ïa u da ki ksaiñ , bad u la ïap .
Balei te ka kmie jong nga ka thum ïa nga ha la pneh ? Balei ka ai bur ïa to ha ka shadem jongki ka ?
translation.en: Why did the knees prevent me ? or why the breasts that I should suck ?

translation.kha: Balei ba phi ïai pynïapmat ïa nga da ki kiei ?
translation.en: How long will ye vex my soul , and break me in pieces with words ?

translation.kha: U pyrta sha tbian bad u ïathuh ha u syiem malade U sahmiet u noh , Lada u don tang marwei , u wanrah ka khubor babud . Uba uba mareh u nang jan nang jlan .
translation.en: And the watchman cried , and told the king . And the king said , If he be alone , there is tidings in his mouth . And he came apace , and drew near .

translation.kha: U bariew uba jaipdeh uba kyntait ban trei u shu pynpaw ei ïa lade ; baroh kaba u leh ka long ban pyllait shaphang kaei ba u kwah ngab don .
translation.en: The desire of the slothful killeth him  ; for his hands refuse to labour .
And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth , and to save your lives by a great deliverance .
translation.kha: U Blei u la phah ïa nga ha shuwa jong phi ban pyllait im ïa phi ha ka rukom kaba phylla , bad ba ki khun ki ksiew jong phi kin im .
Kan ym da la sngewrem ïa la ka pop dalade ngam shym la wan bad ngam shngiam la Kren ha ki ; kumba ka long , ktieh don neh ei ei shuh na ka bynda la ka pop .
translation.en: If I had not come and spoken unto them , they had not had sin : but now they have no cloak for their sin .

translation.kha: Ha ka sngi ba U blem u bitar bad u pynshitom , dei u briew uba sngur uba ju lait borabor .
translation.en: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction ? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath .

And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him , and said to king Jehoshaphat , Shouldest thou help the ungodly , and love them that hate the  Lord  ? therefore is wrath upon thee from before the  Lord .
translation.kha: U nongïathuhlypa , u Jehu u khun jong u Hanani , u leit ban ïakynduh ïa u syiem bad ong ha u ,  Hato ka long kaba dei ban ïarap ïa kito ki briew kiba sniew bad ban ïashah bad kito kiba isih ïa U  Trai  ? Kaei kaba phi la leh ka la wallam ïa ka jingbitar U  Trai  halor jong phi .

translation.en: But if thine heart turn away , so that thou wilt not hear , but shalt be drawn away , and worship other gods , and serve them  ;
translation.kha: Hynrei lada phim kohnguh bad phi kyntait ban shahshkor , bad phi shah ïalam bakla ban mane ïa kiwei pat ki blei ,

translation.en: Which make oil within their walls , and tread their winepresses , and suffer thirst .
translation.kha: Ki khem ïa ki soh Olib na ka bynta ka umphniang , bad ïa ki sohwaiñ na ka bynta ka um sohwaiñ , hynrei ma ki ïa lade pat ki thynrang .
Kaba ki dang ïaid shaneng bad shaw jngai ka ri , man ba ki lap ïa ka jingkieng briew , kin Buh dak hajan kata , ba kumta ki nongtih jingtep kin wan bad tep ïa ka ha ka Them ka Kynhun Shipai u Gog .
translation.en: And the passengers that pass through the land , when any seeth a man s bone , then shall he set up a sign by it , till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon–gog .
And as he spake , a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him : and he went in , and sat down to meat .
translation.kha: Haba U Jisu u la dep kren , u Pharisi u la khot sngewbha ïa u ban ïabam bad u ; kumta u la leit shapoh bad u la shong ban bam .
bad u la ong , Nga pynbynta ïa phi ba lymda phi kylla bad long kum ki khynnah , Phin ym ïong da lei lin shapoh ka Hima ki bneng .
translation.en: And said ,  Verily I say unto you , Except ye be converted , and become as little children , ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven .
Behold , the days come , saith the  Lord  , that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ong ,  Ka por kan poi haba ngan pyndep ïa ka kular kaba nga la pynlong bad ki paid Israel bad Judah .

translation.en: Who is wise , and he shall understand these things ? prudent , and he shall know them ? for the ways of the  Lord  are right , and the just shall walk in them : but the transgressors shall fall therein .
translation.kha: To ai ba kito kiba stad kin shemphang ïa kaei kaba la thoh hangne ; bad ai ba kin pdiang ïa ki naduh ka dohnud . Ki lynti U  Trai  ki long kiba beit , bad ki briew kiba hok ki im da kaba bud ïa ki , hynrei ki nongpop ki jynthut bad ki kyllon namar ba kim suidñiew ïa ki .
Ym pat ju don mynno mynno , bad yn ym don lano lano , ba la don kum “kata ka sngi , mynba U Trai u la shahshkor ïa u bynriew . U Tharai u ïaleh ha ka liang ki Israel !
translation.en: And there was no day like that before it or after it , that the  Lord  hearkened unto the voice of a man : for the  Lord  fought for Israel .
