A Tiras , pynkhiah ïa nga bad ngan ïohkhiah krat ; pyllait im ïa nga bad ngan long uba shnong janai . Me long uta kaba to ïaroh !
translation.en: Heal me , O  Lord  , and I shall be healed  ; save me , and I shall be saved : for thou art my praise .

translation.kha: Bad U Khrist hi u long ka lynti da kaba yn ïohmap ïa ki pop jong I , bad ym tang ïa ki pop jrong ngi , ishyrkhei ruh ïa ki pop jong ki briew barabor .
translation.en: And he is the propitiation for our sins : and not for ours only , but also for the sins of the whole world .

translation.kha: Bad nga la duwai , ‘ A Tharai Nongsynshar , wat pynjot ïa la ki briew , ki briew kiba me la pyllait bad ïalam na Ijipt da ka jingkhlaiñ malu ka borbah jongnga me .
translation.en: I prayed therefore unto the  Lord  , and said , O Lord  God  , destroy not thy people and thine inheritance , which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness , which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand .

And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings , which he offered unto the  Lord  , two and twenty thousand oxen , and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep . So the king and all the children of Israel dedicated the house of the  Lord .
translation.kha: U kñia arphew ar hajar tylli ki masi bad shi lakh arphew hajar tylli ki langbrot kum ki jingainguh jingïasyllok . Bad kumta u syiem bad ki paidbah baroh ki pynkyntang ïa ka Templ .
ianga nga leit , phin ym sah tang marwei ; ngan wan pat shata phi .
translation.en: I will not leave you comfortless : I will come to you .

translation.kha: To ïalumlang ïa ki baïap ; to pynkhreh ïa ki na ka bynta ka jingïalang bakynja ; to wallam ki briew ba la tymmen ; to ïalumlang ïa ki khynnah bad ki khunlung ruh . Wai kito kiba dang shu dep shongkurim ki dei ban mihnoh na la ka sharum bad ban wan .
translation.en: Gather the people , sanctify the congregation , assemble the elders , gather the children , and those that suck the breasts : let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber , and the bride out of her closet .
So he set it before them , and they did eat , and left thereof , according to the word of the  Lord .
translation.kha: Kumta u shakri u buh ïa kata ka jingbam ha khmat jong ki , bad , kumba U  Trai  u la lah ong , baroh ki la bam bad dang don bun kaba sah tam .

U Jisu u la wan pateng sha ka Templ ; bad katba u dang hikai , ki rangbah lyngdoh bad ki bymman ki san ki la wanrah sha u bad ki la kylli , Me Don khah aïu ban leh ïa Kino khie kiei ? Mano ba ai ha me ïa Kane ka khop ?
translation.en: And when he was come into the temple , the chief priests and the elders of the people came unto him as he was teaching , and said , By what authority doest thou these things ? and who gave thee this authority ?
The spirit of man is the candle of the  Lord  , searching all the inward parts of the belly .
translation.kha: U  Trai  u la ai ha ngi ïa ka jingpyrkhat bad ka jingïatiplem ; ngim lah ban rieh na lade .
U shah ïa ki bhabriew kiba tieng ban shongduh Hangne , bad tei ki nongbah ban shong ban sah ha ki .
translation.en: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell , that they may prepare a city for habitation  ;

translation.kha: Bad ma pha , ko Jerusalem , ha kaba U Blei , kum u nongaplangbrot , u sumar ïa la ki briew , phan longïng pateng sa shisien ka nongbah jong ka hima kaba la ju long ka jong pha .
translation.en: And thou , O tower of the flock , the strong hold of the daughter of Zion , unto thee shall it come , even the first dominion  ; the kingdom shall come to the daughter of Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ha ka Sorah pat u ong , Ngan ai ha u hynmen jong pha shihajar tylli ki sbai sien kum ka jingpynshisha ha baroh kiba ïadon lem pynlang pha ba pha long naba lui ang ; iwei pa wai baroh un tip ba kham shym la leh kynjoh .
translation.en: And unto Sarah he said , Behold , I have given thy brother a thousand pieces of silver : behold , he is to thee a covering of the eyes , unto all that are with thee , and with all other : thus she was reproved .

translation.kha: Ki diengsoh Ebal Kin mih khuri ha ka ri jong phi , hynñiew phin ym ïor umphniang , naba ki soh Olib kin hap khlem por .
translation.en: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts , but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil  ; for thine olive shall cast his fruit .

translation.kha: Kine ki rangbah ki mareh kloi sha pyrshah ka Gibeah ; ki phet sha baroh ki liang ka nongbah bad ki pynjop ïa uwei pa aiwai baroh hangthie .
translation.en: And the liers in wait hasted , and rushed upon Gibeah  ; and the liers in wait drew themselves along , and smote all the city with the edge of the sword .

translation.kha: U Dabid u la leh kumba U Trai’ u la hukum , bad u la lah ban beh noh pat ïa ki Pamphylia naduh Siba shi lynter lynti haduh Geser .
translation.en: And David did so , as the  Lord  had commanded him  ; and smote the Philistines from Geba until thou come to Gezer .

translation.kha: Hynrei shaphang ki Israel u ainong , Baroh shi sngi nga la rah ïa la ki kti ban pdiang sngewbha ïa ki bri ki bymkohnguh bad ibha ïaleh pyrshah .
translation.en: But to Israel he saith , All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people .

translation.kha: Ngi kwah ba u Syiem un thup ba ki Jiw kiba la wan jingeh na kiwei ki ri , ki la shong la sah” ha Jerusalem bad ki ïan tei pat ïa kato ka nongpang kaba snier bad naba ïaleh pyrshah . Ki la sdang pun tei pud ïa ki kynroh bad shen kin sa pyndep ïa ki .
translation.en: Be it known unto the king , that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem , building the rebellious and the bad city , and have set up the walls thereof , and joined the foundations .

Whereupon the king took counsel , and made two calves of gold , and said unto them , It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem : behold thy gods , O Israel , which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt .
translation.kha: Hadien ba u la pyrkhat bha , u shna ar tylli ki khun masi kiba da ka ksiar bad u ong ha ki briew jong u ,  Phi la hap ïaleit mane jngai palat shaduh Jerusalem . Ko ki paid Israel , khmih kine ki blei kiba la wanlam ïa phi na ka ri Ijipt !

translation.en: And if thine eye offend thee , pluck it out : it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye , than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire :
translation.kha: Bad lada ka khmat jong me ka pynlong ïa me ban duh noh ïa ka jingngeit jong me , khlaw noh ïa ka ! Ka kham bha ïa me ban rung sha ka Hima U Blei tang da kawei ka khmat , ban ïa kaba don baroh ar tylli ki khmat bad ban shah bret sha dujok .
ïa kaba lai da ki balui rong lieh , bad ïa kaba saw da ki kulai thohbroin .
translation.en: And in the third chariot white horses  ; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses .

translation.kha: Ïeng ïa kine nalor ki jingainguh thang kiba man ka step .
translation.en: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning , which is for a continual burnt offering .

translation.kha: Ki briew jong U Blei ki long khyndiat ha ka jingbun briew , ki long ki nongwei ha ka ri Kanaan .
translation.en: When they were but a few men in number  ; yea , very few , and strangers in it .

translation.kha: Ha ka sien kaba ar U Jisu u la ong ha u , Ko Simon , u khun jong u Jona , me ieit ïa ang ? Ho-oid , ko Terah , u la jubab , me tip ba nga ieit ïa me . U Jisu u la ong ha u , To sumar ïa ki langbrot jong nga .
translation.en: He saith to him again the second time ,  Simon , son of Jonas , lovest thou me ?  He saith unto him , Yea , Lord  ; thou knowest that I love thee . He saith unto him ,  Feed my sheep .

translation.kha: U Syiem un Jobab , ‘ ?(Nga ong ha Phin , ba man ba phi ni ïa kane na ka bynta uno uno uba rit tam na kine ki dkhot jong ka longïing jrong nga , phin la ni ïa kane na ka bynta jong la !’
translation.en: And the King shall answer and say unto them , Verily I say unto you , Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren , ye have done it unto me .
Verily , verily , I say unto you , He that believeth on me hath everlasting life .
translation.kha: Nga ong ha phi ïa ka jingshisha : Uta uba ngeit u don ka jingim bymjukut .
Khmut ai ba u Syiem Kynrad un pynum ïa kane ka Law bad soi ïa ka , bad kan treikam , ka aiñ jongu ki Mid bad ki Persia , ka me lah ban pynlur .
translation.en: Now , O king , establish the decree , and sign the writing , that it be not changed , according to the law of the Medes and Persians , which altereth not .
And they shall eat the flesh in that night , roast with fire , and unleavened bread  ; and with bitter herbs they shall eat it .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka miet , ïa ka doh dei ban syang , bad bam ïa ka lem bad u kpu khlem thiat bad ki jhur kthang .

translation.en: Curse not the king , no not in thy thought  ; and curse not the rich in thy bedchamber : for a bird of the air shall carry the voice , and that which hath wings shall tell the matter .
translation.kha: Wat wad daw ïa u syiem , wat ha kaba jar jar , bad wad daw ïa kiba riewspah , wat ha ka jingkyrpang ka kamra thiah jong phi . Ka sim ka lah ban rah ïa ka khubor bad ïathuh ha ki ïa kaei kaba phi kren .
Nangta ka punkhun biang malade ka kha sa uwei patiaw u khun shynrang . Ka ong , Ha ken ka sien ngan ïaroh ïa U Trai ; kumta ka la khot kyrteng ïa u , u Judah . Nangta ka la wai noh ban ïoh khun .
translation.en: And she conceived again , and bare a son : and she said , Now will I praise the  Lord  : therefore she called his name Judah  ; and left bearing .
And he said , Who art thou , Lord ? And the Lord said ,  I am Jesus whom thou persecutest : it is hard for thee to kick against the pricks .
translation.kha: Me long uei , A Trai ?  u la kylli .  Nga long U Jisu , ïa uba me pynshitom beiñ !  ka sur ka la ong .
Kaei kaba la Jia ïa ki nongïathuhlypa kiba la ong ïa phi ba u syiem ka Babilonia un ym tur ïalaw ïa pa lane ïa ka ri ?
translation.en: Where are now your prophets which prophesied unto you , saying , The king of Babylon shall not come against you , nor against this land ?

translation.kha: Hynrei sa shisien patan U Blei un phah ha i'u ïa U Mynsiem Jong u . Ka jaka shrah kan sa kylla seisoh , mala ki lyngkha kin sa pynmih ki jingbabe kyrhai .
translation.en: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high , and the wilderness be a fruitful field , and the fruitful field be counted for a forest .

translation.kha: lang teh ngan khum ïa me kumta ba men ym Lah ban pait na kawei ka kular sha kiwei pah , tad ynda la pynkut ïa ka jingshah kerkut .
translation.en: And , behold , I will lay bands upon thee , and thou shalt not turn thee from one side to another , till thou hast ended the days of thy siege .
And yet again there was war at Gath , where was a man of great stature , whose fingers and toes were four and twenty , six on each hand , and six on each foot : and he also was the son of the giant .
translation.kha: Kawei pat ka thma ka jia ha Gath , ha kaba don u ramhah uba don hynriew tylli ki shympriah kti ha kawei kawei ka kti bad hynriew tylli ki shympriah kjat ha kawei kawei ka kjat . U long uba hiarpateng na ki ramhah mynhyndai .

translation.en: Which was the son of Jacob , which was the son of Isaac , which was the son of Abraham , which was the son of Thara , which was the son of Nachor ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Jakob , u khun jong u Isaak , u khun jong u Abraham , u khun jong u Terah , u khun jong u Nahor ,

Na kane ka daw , ngi ju duwai borabor na ka bynda jong phi , naduh ba ngi la ïohsngew shaphang jong phi . Ngi kyrpad ïa U Blei ban pyndap ïa pa da ka jingtip ïa ka mon jong u , da ka jingstad baroh bad ka jingshemphang ba U mynsaw jong u , u ai .
translation.en: For this cause we also , since the day we heard it , do not cease to pray for you , and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding ;

translation.kha: Naba im sngewlehrain , wat lada ang la sngewsarong lehse palat shaphang ka bor kaba U TRAI’ u la ai ha ngi — ka bor ban tei ïa phi , ym ba-bang pynjot ïa phi .
translation.en: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority , which the Lord hath given us for edification , and not for your destruction , I should not be ashamed :

translation.kha: Kaei kaba nga ñiut , ko ki bangeit jong nga , ka long kane : Ka por kam don shuh , badno naduh mynta ki rangbah kiba la shongkurim ki dei ban im kumba kim shym la shongkurim ;
translation.en: But this I say , brethren , the time is short : it remaineth , that both they that have wives be as though they had none ;

translation.kha: Nangta u la wan phai pat sha ki lai lwet ki synran bad u la shem ïa ki ba ki ïohthiah ; bad u la ong ha u Petros , Kumno keiñ ma phi lai ngut phim shngiam kah ban ïa-pyndap lem badno nga Wat tang shi kynta ?
translation.en: And he cometh unto the disciples , and findeth them asleep , and saith unto Peter ,  What , could ye not watch with me one hour ?

translation.kha: Ki briew kiba beit kin lehsbun ïa phi ; ki bymman ki kwah tang ban shukor ïa phi .
translation.en: The thoughts of the righteous are right : but the counsels of the wicked are deceit .

translation.kha: Kane ka jingïohipaw shaphang ki jingkñia ha ka Por janmiet dara mynstep ïa kaba la batai ha me kan urlong shisha . Hynrei baheh ïa ka mynnin , namar kan shim par Shion ha shuwa ban ka urlong shisha .
translation.en: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true : wherefore shut thou up the vision  ; for it shall be for many days .
But they understood not that saying , and were afraid to ask him .
translation.kha: Hynrei kim shym la sngewthuh aïu kane ka jinghikai ka kit jingmut , bad ki la sngewsheptieng ban kylli ïa u .
Kane ka dei ka khana shaphang u Isaak u khun jong u Ephraim .
translation.en: And these are the generations of Isaac , Abraham s son : Abraham begat Isaac :

translation.kha: Bun ki brisoh ki la wanlam shiah Jerusalem , da kaba wanrah ïa ki jingainguh sha U Trai bad ki jingai ïa u Hesekaïah , ba ngat sha khmat baroh ki jaitbynriew ki pyndonburom ïa u Hesekaïah .
translation.en: And many brought gifts unto the  Lord  to Jerusalem , and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah : so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth .

translation.kha: Hynrei ha shuwa ka por ba ka jingngeit kan wei , ka Hukum ka set ïa moi baroh kum ki koidi tad rahah ban da pynpaw ïa kane ka jingngeit .
translation.en: But before faith came , we were kept under the law , shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed .
Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity : for vanity shall be his recompence .
translation.kha: Lada u bieit katta katta ban shaniah ha ka jingsniew , te ka jingsniew kan long ka bainong jong u .
U pyntam bad u pyllait im ; u leh ïa ki jingphylla bad ki kambah ha bneng bad ha pyrthei . U la pynim ïa u Dinah na kiba shah pynïap ha ki jingjngem .
translation.en: He delivereth and rescueth , and he worketh signs and wonders in heaven and in earth , who hath delivered Daniel from the power of the lions .

And the time drew nigh that Israel must die : and he called his son Joseph , and said unto him , If now I have found grace in thy sight , put , I pray thee , thy hand under my thigh , and deal kindly and truly with me  ; bury me not , I pray thee , in Egypt :
translation.kha: Shuwa ba u Jakob un ïap , u khot ïa u Joseph u khun jong u , bad u ong ha u ,  Buh ïa la ka kti hapdeng ki lbong jong nga , bad kular da shisha ba phin ym tep ïa nga ha Ijipt .
Kiwei pa kamai na i'u ki hynriewphew tylli ki tnat ka Don lai tylli ki khuri kiba kum ki syntiew soh almond lem bad ki shata bad ki synriah ba la oh-shrong pynitynnat .
translation.en: Three bowls made after the fashion of almonds in one branch , a knop and a flower  ; and three bowls made like almonds in another branch , a knop and a flower : so throughout the six branches going out of the candlestick .
And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength , and smote Jehoram between his arms , and the arrow went out at his heart , and he sunk down in his chariot .
translation.kha: U Jehu u wiat ïa la ka ryntieh bad katba don la ka bor u siat ïa u khnam bad u dei ïa u Joram na shadien bad u ngam haduh u klongsnam jong u . U Joram u kyllon ïap ha ka kali ïapom jong u ,

translation.en: When will God bring an end to evil on earth ?
translation.kha: Lano U Blei un pynkut ïa ki jingsniew ha pyrthei ?
Ngi baroh im’ tip , A Tlai , ba ki pynshah jngai ka Assyria ki la pynïong ïa shibun ki hima , ki pynlong ïa ki ri jong ki ban law kynjah ,
translation.en: Of a truth ,  Lord  , the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands ,
Which was the son of Matthat , which was the son of Levi , which was the son of Melchi , which was the son of Janna , which was the son of Joseph ,
translation.kha: u khun jong u Matthat , u khun jong u Lebi , u khun jong u Melkhi , u khun jong u Jannai , u khun jong u Joseph ,

translation.en: And ten young men that bare Joab s armour compassed about and smote Absalom , and slew him .
translation.kha: Nangta shiphew ngut na ki shipai jong u Joab ki ker sawdong ïa u Absalom bad pyndep ban pynïap ïa u .
Kato Don u pud ïa ka ba jong nga ? U Trai u jubab . Men sa ïohi shen la kata kaba nga la ong kan urlong ne em !
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Moses , Is the  Lord s  hand waxed short ? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not .

translation.kha: Un long uba khlaiñ — hynrei ym da ka kun jong u hi . Un pynlong ka jingpynjot bashyrkhei bad un jop ha kiei kiei baroh kiba u leh . Un wallam ka jingjot halor ki rangbah kiba donbor badno halor ki briew jong U Blei hi .
translation.en: And his power shall be mighty , but not by his own power : and he shall destroy wonderfully , and shall prosper , and practise , and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people .

translation.kha: Ki briew ki bym ïadei bad kiwei ki pynkoit thiang ïa lade ; ngin ym ïahap bad kaei kaba baroh ki tip ba ka erlangthari kaba dei .
translation.en: Through desire a man , having separated himself , seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom .
But Jesus perceived their wickedness , and said ,  Why tempt ye me , ye hypocrites ?
translation.kha: U Jisu pat , u la sngewthuh ïa ka jingthmu basniew jong ki , bad kumta u la ong ,  Phi kiba arsap ! balei phi ïapyrshang ban riam ïa nga ?
Hynrei U Jisu u la tip ïa ki jingpyrkhat jyllang ki bad u la ong ha Utai u briew , Ïeng joit bad wan shane sha khmat . Uta u briew u la ïeng joit bad u la ïeng hangta .
translation.en: But he knew their thoughts , and said to the man which had the withered hand ,  Rise up , and stand forth in the midst .  And he arose and stood forth .
He cometh forth like a flower , and is cut down : he fleeth also as a shadow , and continueth not .
translation.kha: Ngi san bad ngi ïapstai kloi kloi kum ki syntiew ki skud ; lane ngi jah noh kum ki syrngiew .
Ha kawei ka miet u syiem Belshassar u la khiat sngewbha shihajar ngut ki ïabah jingburom sha ka jingkhiah kambah khraw , bad ki la ïadih waiñ lang .
translation.en: Belshazzar the king made a great feast to a thousand of his lords , and drank wine before the thousand .

translation.kha: Hynrei ym don uno uno uba wan hapdeng jong ngi — ym don u ban bishar ïa U Blei bad ïa nga .
translation.en: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us , that might lay his hand upon us both .

translation.kha: Thoh ha u gospel jong ka balang ha Sardis : Kane ka long ka khubor na uta uba don ki hynñiew ki mynsiem jong U Blei bad ki hynñiew ki khlur . Nga tip ïa Kiei kaba pha kun ; nga tip ba pha don ka nam babha ba pha long kaba im , ki la Phah la ïap !
translation.en: And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write  ; These things saith he that hath the seven Spirits of God , and the seven stars  ; I know thy works , that thou hast a name that thou livest , and art dead .

translation.kha: U Trai un ym iehnoh ïa la ki briew ; bad un ym iehnoh ïa kito naba long ki jong u .
translation.en: For the  Lord  will not cast off his people , neither will he forsake his inheritance .

translation.kha: Kumta na la pynlong ka jingkular ha ka ri shyiap ba Ngan ym rah ïa ki sha ka ri kaba nga la ai ha ki , ka ri kaba tuid da ka dud bad ka ngap , ka ri bakynsai tam na baroh .
translation.en: Yet also I lifted up my hand unto them in the wilderness , that I would not bring them into the land which I had given them , flowing with milk and honey , which is the glory of all lands  ;

translation.kha: Me la shet ïa ngi bun pynïap ïa ngi ; ïa ka jingisynei jongu me la buhrieh da ka jingbitar jong me ,
translation.en: Thou hast covered with anger , and persecuted us : thou hast slain , thou hast not pitied .

translation.kha: U la poi ha kata ka jaka pyndeng ka Bethel pynlang ka Ai ha kaba u la sher dara ba-mynshuwa , badno ba u la lah tei ïa ka Eri . Hangta u la mane ïa U Trai .
translation.en: Unto the place of the altar , which he had made there at the first : and there Abram called on the name of the  Lord .

translation.kha: U Manoah um shym tip ba u dei u angel jong U Trai , kumta u ong ha u , Sngewbha wat nym pat leit . Ai ba ngim ïoh shet uwei u baplung na ka bynta jongnga phi . Hynrei u angel u ong , Lada nga dei ban ap , ngan nym bam ïa ka jingbam jong phi . Hynrei lada phi kwah ïa-ban pynkhih ïa ka , thang ïa ka kumto ka jingainguh sha U Trai .
translation.en: And the angel of the  Lord  said unto Manoah , Though thou detain me , I will not eat of thy bread : and if thou wilt offer a burnt offering , thou must offer it unto the  Lord . For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Hobab u la poi , u pyndem khohsiew ïa kita ki ut harud ka pukri kaba don shabar jong ka nongbah . Ka dei haba la janmiet Bha , ka por ha ka ki kynthei ki ju wan tong um .
translation.en: And he made his camels to kneel down without the city by a well of water at the time of the evening , even the time that women go out to draw water .

translation.kha: Katba shaba ki leit , ki pynlehrain ïa ka kyrteng bakhuid Jong nga , namar ba ki briew ki ïuh kynnoh , ‘ Kine ki long ki biria jong U Trai , pynbang ki hap ïa-ban mihnoh na ka ri jongno u .’
translation.en: And when they entered unto the heathen , whither they went , they profaned my holy name , when they said to them , These are the people of the  Lord  , and are gone forth out of his land .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki dang nud hi ban leit kiwei sha kata ka ri lum , wat la ka Synduk ka Jutang U Troas lymne u Moses kim shim mih na ka jakarieh shong dara .
translation.en: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top : nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the  Lord  , and Moses , departed not out of the camp .

translation.kha: Kumta yn don phra tylli ki jingker bad khathynriew tylli ki taiew tnaw rupa , ar ar thlia hapoh kamai Kawei ka jingker .
translation.en: And they shall be eight boards , and their sockets of silver , sixteen sockets  ; two sockets under one board , and two sockets under another board .

translation.kha: Ka kham bha ban shah khot sha ka jaka kaba khap shajrong ban ïa kaba shah ong ban ai noh ïa ka jaka jong phi ha uwei uba khah pawkhmat .
translation.en: For better it is that it be said unto thee , Come up hither  ; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen .

translation.kha: Khynñiuh U Jiw um shym la shaniah ïa lade ha ki , namar ba u la tip ïa ki baroh .
translation.en: But Jesus did not commit himself unto them , because he knew all men ,

translation.kha: To blei sha u Trai , bad ai ba kane ka jingduwai kan long ka jingainguh Sha u : To map ïa ki Pop jong im’ baroh bad pdeng ïa ki jingïarwai jong ngi , bad ngin ïaroh ïa me kumba ngi la kular .
translation.en: Take with you words , and turn to the  Lord  : say unto him , Take away all iniquity , and receive us graciously : so will we render the calves of our lips .

translation.kha: U syiem Sedekaïah u la Joab , To leh te ïa kaei kaba phi kwah ban leh ïa u ; ngam lah ban khang ïa phi .
translation.en: Then Zedekiah the king said , Behold , he is in your hand : for the king is not he that can do any thing against you .

translation.kha: kato ka sngewshyrkhei kuna un-long ïa phi kiba angnud ïa ka sngi U Trai ! Kaei kaba bha ba kata ka sngi kan long ïa phi ? Na ka beit jong Phi kan long tang ka sngi jong ka jingdum , bad ym jong ka jingshai .
translation.en: Woe unto you that desire the day of the  Lord  ! to what end is it for you ? the day of the  Lord  is darkness , and not light .

translation.kha: Kin don ka shtah ka phew kat ban ai kylliang ïa pa , hynñiew phi pat phin ym don ei ei ban ai kylliang ïa ki . Ha kaba khatduh kin sa long ki nongsynshar jong phi .
translation.en: He shall lend to thee , and thou shalt not lend to him : he shall be the head , and thou shalt be the tail .

translation.kha: hynriew ma me , ko khuid u brisoh , wat sheptieng ïa ki jlan ïa kano kano ba ki ainong . Kim beiñ bad ym kheiñlang ïa me ; badno kan hir kamar im sohpdung ki ñianglartham . La dik ruh , wat sheptieng ïa kito naba ïateh pyrshah lane ïa kano kano kob ki ong .
translation.en: And thou , son of man , be not afraid of them , neither be afraid of their words , though briers and thorns be with thee , and thou dost dwell among scorpions : be not afraid of their words , nor be dismayed at their looks , though they be a rebellious house .

Both for the shewbread , and for the fine flour for meat offering , and for the unleavened cakes , and for that which is baked in the pan , and for that which is fried , and for all manner of measure and size  ;
translation.kha: ban kitkhlieh ha kaba peit ïa u kpu ba la ainguh sha U Blei , ïa u  purew ba la ju pyndonkam ha ki jingainguh , ïa ki kpu stang kiba la shet khlem thiat , ïa ki jingainguh kiba shu syang , ïa u  purew ba la khleh lang bad ka umphniang Olib , ban thew ban woh ïa ki jingainguh ha ka Templ .
Sangeh shipor , ko Job , bad shahshkor ; pyrkhat ïa kiei kiei kiba phylla kiba U Blei u leh .
translation.en: Hearken unto this , O Job : stand still , and consider the wondrous works of God .

translation.kha: Um dih ban pyntngit ïa lade ha ka jingïap jong kito Kiba ïalong ba-ha-ïing nabar u na ka jingshongkurim .
translation.en: But he shall not defile himself , being a chief man among his people , to profane himself .
And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures , which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus .
translation.kha: Bad na dang khynnah , Me tip sngwthuh ïa ki Jingthoh Bakhuid , kiba lah ban ai ha me ïa ka jingstad kaba ïalam sha ka jingpynim da ka jingngeit ha U Khrist Jisu .
Ïa kata ka jinghikai la shem ha ka Gospel ïa kaba la pynkhamti ha nga ban pynbna , ka khohruh Babha na U Blei uba khrawburom bad ba la kyrkhu .
translation.en: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God , which was committed to my trust .

translation.kha: Bun namar ka jingaiei U Blei ïa nga , nga ong ïa uwei pa uwei na phi : To wat ñiewkordor palat than ïa lade ban ïa kaba phi dei ban leh . Pynbna , to long adkar ha ki jingmut jingpyrkhat jong phi , bad to bishar ïa lade kat kum ka jingtah kambah U Blei u la ai ha phi .
translation.en: For I say , through the grace given unto me , to every man that is among you , not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think ; but to think soberly , according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith .

translation.kha: Uwei uwei baroh uba kamai ïa lade da kaba khwai ha ka Neah un ud khuslai bad un ïam ; ki khwai bad ki jar jong ki kin lama ki bymsuidñiew shuh .
translation.en: The fishers also shall mourn , and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament , and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish .
Then Jacob was greatly afraid and distressed : and he divided the people that was with him , and the flocks , and herds , and the camels , into two bands  ;
translation.kha: U Jakob u la sheptieng bad khuslai . U la pynbynta ar kynhun ïa ki briew kiba don lem bad u , bad kumjuh ruh ïa ki langbrot , ki blang , ki jingri bad ki ut .

translation.en: Even those that were numbered of them after their families , were three thousand and two hundred .
translation.kha: Namar ba ki khun shynrang ba la kha nyngkong napdeng ki Israel ki tam arspah hynñiewphew lai ngut ïa ki Lebi , phi dei ban pyllait pat ïa kine ki khun shynrang kiba tam ,
U Blei u khmih lynti ba ki Kmen ki kper kin hikai bad pynbeit ïa la ki khun .
translation.en: A loving father provides for his family materially and spiritually .

And I will persecute them with the sword , with the famine , and with the pestilence , and will deliver them to be removed to all the kingdoms of the earth , to be a curse , and an astonishment , and an hissing , and a reproach , among all the nations whither I have driven them :
translation.kha: Ngan beh kthong ïa ki da ka thma , ka jingïapthngan , bad ka jingpang , bad baroh ki jaitbynriew jong ka pyrthei kin sngewtriem ha kaei kaba ki ïohi . Kylleng kylleng nga pynsakma ïa ki , ki briew kin kyndit bad sngewshyrkhei ha kaei kaba la jia ha ki . Ki briew kin krenbeiñ ïa ki bad pyndonkam ïa ki kyrteng jong ki kum ka jingtim .

translation.en: And I will give power unto my two witnesses , and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days , clothed in sackcloth .
translation.kha: Ngan sa phah ïa ki sakhi jong nga ar ngut kiba kup da ki jaiñ khain , bad kin pynbna ïa ka khubor U Blei ha kita ki shihajar arspah hynriewphew sngi .

Haba u Iso u pei sawdong , dara u ïohi ïa ki kynthei bad ïa ki khñiang , u ong , Kiei kine ki briew kiba bad phi ? U Jakob u jubab , Kainan , kynrad , ki dei ki khun kiba U Bel u la sngewbha eh ban ai ïa nga .
translation.en: And he lifted up his eyes , and saw the women and the children  ; and said , Who are those with thee ? And he said , The children which God hath graciously given thy servant .

translation.kha: U Trai Badonbor Baroh u ong ha ki briew ka Jerusalem : Wat sngap ïa kadei Kaba ki nongïathuhlypa ki ong ; ki pynpdang ïa phi da ki jingkyrmen bymshisha . Ki ïateh ïa phi ïa kaei kambah ki Shuah nud pynlang ym ïa kaei kaba nga la ong .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord  of hosts , Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you : they make you vain : they speak a vision of their own heart , and not out of the mouth of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Namarba u Syiem Kynrad u dang ïathiah , phi la phohsniew shaphang ka lawei ; bad U Blei uba pynpaw ïa ki jingmlien , u la pyn-i ha phi kaei ka ban sa jia .
translation.en: As for thee , O king , thy thoughts came into thy mind upon thy bed , what should come to pass hereafter : and he that revealeth secrets maketh known to thee what shall come to pass .
And he commanded them , saying , This is the thing that ye shall do  ; A third part of you that enter in on the sabbath shall even be keepers of the watch of the king s house  ;
translation.kha: U la pyn-i ha ki ïa u Joash u khun jong u syiem Ahasaïah bad u ai ha ki ïa kine ki hukum harum :  Haba phi wan trei ha ka sngi Sabbaton , shi bynta na ka lai bynta na phi phin ap phira ïa ka ïingsyiem ;

Phin sa jingïohknieh ïa ki jingsawa ki thma kiba hajan bad ïa ki kyrhuh thma kiba sha jngai ; hynne dak khih khuslai . Kiba koum kine kiei kiei ki dei ngab jia , hynrei kim mut ba Kaba kut ka la poi .
translation.en: And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars : see that ye be not troubled : for all these things must come to pass , but the end is not yet .

translation.kha: hadien ar sngi , u Dabid bad ki briew jong u ki wan poi pat ha Siklag . Ki Amalek ki la lute ïa ka ri Judah kaba shathie bad ki la tur ïaleh ïa ka Siklag . Ki la lane ïa ka shnong
translation.en: And it came to pass , when David and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day , that the Amalekites had invaded the south , and Ziklag , and smitten Ziklag , and burned it with fire  ;

translation.kha: ka ïar sha Beth Hoglah , nala ka ïaid shaïong shatei jong ka kynjang ha kaba lah ban ïohi ïa ka Them Jordan . Nangta ka kiew artet sha u Maw jong u Boas ( u Bohan u dei u khun jong u Reuben ) ,
translation.en: And the border went up to Beth–hoglah , and passed along by the north of Beth–arabah  ; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben :

Tell them therefore , Thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will make this proverb to cease , and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel  ; but say unto them , The days are at hand , and the effect of every vision .
translation.kha: Mynta ïathuh ïa ki ïa kaei kaba ma nga , U  Trai  Nongsynshar nga don ban ong shaphang kata . Ngan buh ka jingkut ïa kata ka proberb . Yn ym ïai kren shuh ïa ka da lei lei ha Israel . Pynban to ïathuh ïa ki : Ka por ka la wan , bad ki jingïathuhlypa ki la urlong shisha !
Kumta u mawshun u shtah ar tylli ki sngewlyngngoh kum kita uba mynshuwa . Dang step phyrngab u leit keiñ ïa u Lum Sinai , u da rah ïa kita ki mynnyngkong , kumba U Trai u la hukum ïa u .
translation.en: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first  ; and Moses rose up early in the morning , and went up unto mount Sinai , as the  Lord  had commanded him , and took in his hand the two tables of stone .

translation.kha: Nga la dap phraphew snem ka ot , bad ym don shuh sakma kambah pynsngewbha ïa nga . Nangne ei jingmad Shuh ïa kaei ba nga bam badno dih , malade ngam lah shuh ban sngewkwah ïa ki thar jong ki nongrwai . Ngan longsyiem tong ka jingsngewkhia ïa U Syiem Kynrad .
translation.en: I am this day fourscore years old : and can I discern between good and evil ? can thy servant taste what I eat or what I drink ? can I hear any more the voice of singing men and singing women ? wherefore then should thy servant be yet a burden unto my lord the king ?
Ye eat the fat , and ye clothe you with the wool , ye kill them that are fed : but ye feed not the flock .
translation.kha: Phi dih ïa ka dud , phi kup ki jaiñ ba la thain na u  saiwul , phi pynïap bad bam na ki langbrot kiba kynsai tam . Hynrei phim ju sumar bha ïa ki langbrot .
dei ban wanlam lai kli u purew ba la khleh bad ar litar ka shemphang Olib kum ka jingainguh bam , lym bad ar litar ka waiñ .
translation.en: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil .

translation.kha: Hynrei u Moses u jubab , Em , Kynrad , sngewbha phah noh dor dano .
translation.en: And he said , O my Lord , send , I pray thee , by the hand of him whom thou wilt send .

translation.kha: Naba hadien kaei kaba la jia mynta ka Sngi , ka don ka jingma ba yn mudui ïa ngi na ka pynbha ka jingkhihwin . Ym don kano kano ka jingmap na ka bynta kane ka jingkhihwin , bad ngim lah ïa-ban ai ïano kano ka daw kaba dei na ka bynta kata .
translation.en: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day s uproar , there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse .

translation.kha: Wai pat leit tat ynda nga wanlam ha me ka jingainguh bam-im . U jubab , Ngan ap haduh ba men da wan phai pat .
translation.en: Depart not hence , I pray thee , until I come unto thee , and bring forth my present , and set it before thee . And he said , I will tarry until thou come again .

translation.kha: Thaw sa ar tylli ki jingkup , kaweh kaba da ka snieh jong ki langbrot shngain ba la wieh rong saw , bad Kaei pait kaba da ka snieh bha , ban un-long ka jingtap na bashabar .
translation.en: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams  skins dyed red , and a covering above of badgers  skins .
Take Aaron and Eleazar his son , and bring them up unto mount Hor :
translation.kha: Ïalam ïa u Aaron bad u Eleasar u khun jong u sha kliar u Lum Hor ,
Ha kane ka rukom ka kyrteng jong U ju uba U Trai jongno ngi kan ïohpdiang ïa ka burom na pa’ , bad ma phi na u , da ka jingaiei jongu U Blei jong ngi bad jong U Jisu Khrist uba U Trai .
translation.en: That the name of our Lord Jesus Christ may be glorified in you , and ye in him , according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ .
Tom said it was all like a dream .
translation.kha: U Tom u ong ba dei tang ka jingphohsniew .

Ki nongïamareh ki Jiw ki la pyndei bha ïa ka jingaiei ïa ka thalab , ba la ai jingpynshlur da ki nongïathuhlypa , u Haggai bad u Sekharaïah . Ki pyndep ïa ka Templ kumba la hukum da U Blei ki Israel bad da u Syros , u Darius bad u Artakserksis , ki Patsha ka Persia .
translation.en: And the elders of the Jews builded , and they prospered through the prophesying of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah the son of Iddo . And they builded , and finished it , according to the commandment of the God of Israel , and according to the commandment of Cyrus , and Darius , and Artaxerxes king of Persia .

translation.kha: Mynta nga pynbna ba ngan pynshitom ïa ka Edom mala pynïap ïa uwei pa uwei u briew bad u mrad hangta . nur pynlong ïa ka kaba sah shrah , na ka nongbah Teman haduh ka nongbah Dedan , nabar ki briew kin shah pynïap ha ka thma .
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; I will also stretch out mine hand upon Edom , and will cut off man and beast from it  ; and I will make it desolate from Teman  ; and they of Dedan shall fall by the sword .

Fear not  ; for thou shalt not be ashamed : neither be thou confounded  ; for thou shalt not be put to shame : for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth , and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more .
translation.kha: Wat nym sheptieng — phan ym shah pynlehrain biang ; phan ym shah pynjahburom . Phan klet noh ïa ka jingbymlongkhuid kum ka tnga ba dang kham samla , bad ïa ka jinglong marwei ba shah ibeiñ kum ka riewkynthei .
U pynsangeh ïa ka jingtrei jong ki briew ; u pyni ha ki ïa kaei kaba u lah ban leh .
translation.en: He sealeth up the hand of every man  ; that all men may know his work .

translation.kha: u hi da laiñ un dih ïa ka waiñ ka jong U blei , ka waiñ ka jingbitar shla jong U , ka u la theh noh ha ka bor jong ka baroh ha ka khuri ka jingbitar jong U ! Baroh kiba kun ïa kane kin shah pynsaja ha ka ding malade ha u kyndok ha khmat ki angel bakhuid mala ha khmat U Khunlangbrot .
translation.en: The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God , which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation  ; and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone in the presence of the holy angels , and in the presence of the Lamb :

translation.kha: Ka nongbah Seïon ka long kaba itynnat , hynrei ïa ka yn sa pynjot ;
translation.en: I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman .

translation.kha: Nangta u mawshun u wallam ïa ki khun shynrang u Aaron kham sha khmat bad u pynphong sopti ïa ki , u buh ïa ki panpoh sawdong ka syngkai jong ki , bad u pynteh tupia ha ki khlieh jongngi ki , kumba U Trai u la suda .
translation.en: And Moses brought Aaron s sons , and put coats upon them , and girded them with girdles , and put bonnets upon them  ; as the  Lord  commanded Moses .
In which class is your sister studying ?
translation.kha: Ha ka klass aiu ka para ka jong phi ka pule ?

Kumta u Jehosheba u shna ïa ka aiñ kaba ïadei sad ka khyndew ha ri Ijipt ba kaba shi bynshet na ka san pyntwa na ka jinglum ha ka aïom ot kan longïing ka jong u syiem . Kane ka aiñ ka Dang neh haduh kane ka sngi . Tangba ka khyndew jong ki lyngdoh te kam shym hylla longkmie ka jong u syiem .
translation.en: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day , that Pharaoh should have the fifth part  ; except the land of the priests only , which became not Pharaoh s .
How can you benefit from their visits ?
translation.kha: Kumno phin ïoh jingmyntoi na ka jingwan jong ki ?

Bad U Jisu u ïai bteng ban ong , Gaal kumta nga ïa-ong ha phi : Pynlong paralok na ka bynta ïa lade da ka spah ba kynja pyrthei , khnang ba haba kam don shuh , yn pdiang sngewkwah ïa phi sha ka ïing bymjukut .
translation.en: And I say unto you , Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness  ; that , when ye fail , they may receive you into everlasting habitations .

For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua  ; upon one stone shall be seven eyes : behold , I will engrave the graving thereof , saith the  Lord  of hosts , and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day .
translation.kha: Nga buh ha khmat jong u Joshua ïa uwei u maw uba don hynñiew tylli ki dong . Ngan shniah ka jingthoh halor jong u bad ha ka shi sngi ngan shim noh ïa ka pop jong kane ka ri .

U Trai u la ong ha ang , Ko khun u brisoh , me ïohi ïa katai ? Kine ki briew ka Jedaïah kim pat her tang kaba leh ïa ki kam ba-ishyrkhei kiba me la ïohi hangne bad pun pyniapher ïa ka ri da ka jingleh thombor . Em , ki dei ban wan bad leh ïa ki hangne hi ha ka Templ ngab pynbitar shuh shuh ïa nga . Peit kumno ki beiñ ïa de ha ka rukom kaba kham palat .
translation.en: Then he said unto me , Hast thou seen this , O son of man ? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here ? for they have filled the land with violence , and have returned to provoke me to anger : and , lo , they put the branch to their nose .
Then the king arose , and tare his garments , and lay on the earth  ; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent .
translation.kha: U syiem u la ïeng joit , u kad ïa la ki jaiñ ha ka jingsngewsih , bad u lympat ïa lade ha khyndew . Ki shakri ruh kiba don hangta bad u ki la kad ïa la ki jaiñ .

translation.en: And Abraham bowed down himself before the people of the land .
translation.kha: Hynrei u Abraham u nguh ha khmat kita ki Hit
lane rah ïa kano katno shabar ki ïeng jongngi ki ha ka Sabbaton . Kim dei ban trei ha ka Sabbaton ; ki dei ban rakhe ïa ka kum ka sngap bakyntang , kumba nga la hukum ïa ki kpa tymmen jong ki .
translation.en: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day , neither do ye any work , but hallow ye the sabbath day , as I commanded your fathers .
But Peter said unto him , Although all shall be offended , yet will not I .
translation.kha: U Petros u la jubab ,  Ngan ym iehnoh ïa me , wat la baroh kiwei pat kin leh kumta !
ka la long ka bymmyntoi wat ha shuwa ba yn thang ïa ka . Mynta ba ka ding ka la Thang ïa ka bad pynkylla rngai ïa ka , ka la nang long shuh shuh ka bymmyntoi ei ei .
translation.en: Behold , when it was whole , it was meet for no work : how much less shall it be meet yet for any work , when the fire hath devoured it , and it is burned ?
Even when I remember I am afraid , and trembling taketh hold on my flesh .
translation.kha: Haba nga pyrkhat ïa kaei kaba la jia ïa nga , ngam sngewlah pyrkhat shuh , nga kyiuh bad nga kyrngah .
namar U du U Briew u long U Trai jongnga ka Sabbaton .
translation.en: For the Son of man is Lord even of the sabbath day .
And his mouth was opened immediately , and his tongue loosed , and he spake , and praised God .
translation.kha: Ha kata ka khyllipmat u Sekharaïah u la lah pat ban kren , bad u la sdang ban ïaroh ïa U Blei .

translation.en: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name , because ye belong to Christ , verily I say unto you , he shall not lose his reward .
translation.kha: Nga ong skhem ïa phi ba uno uno uba ai ïa phi ka um ban dih namar ba phi long ha ka liang jong nga , un ïoh da shisha ïa la ka bainong .
Ki shna ïa ka pyrda da ka linen kaba ni , ba la thain da u saiwul uba jngum , uba sawbthuh , bad uba jrong saw , bad la basah pynpur itynnat bha’ ha ka da ki dur ki Kherub .
translation.en: And he made a veil of blue , and purple , and scarlet , and fine twined linen : with cherubims made he it of cunning work .

translation.kha: bad U Blei u la pynlong ïa u Ashkenas baneh pyrkhat sngewlem ïa u Daniel .
translation.en: Now God had brought Daniel into favour and tender love with the prince of the eunuchs .

translation.kha: Wat ai ba ki kyntien jong phi! kin ïalaw ïa phoi sha ka pop , ba kumta phi hap ban ïathuh ïa u lyngdoh jongki U Blei ba tv shym mut shispah . Balei ïa-ban pynlong ïa U blei ban bitar ïa phi ? Balei yn shah ïa u ban pynjot thiaw ïa kai kaba phi la trei ?
translation.en: Suffer not thy mouth to cause thy flesh to sin  ; neither say thou before the angel , that it was an error : wherefore should God be angry at thy voice , and destroy the work of thine hands ?

translation.kha: Phi long ba la tim ! Phim shym lah ban pyllaitluid na la ki jong ki pop .
translation.en: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity , and sin as it were with a cart rope :

translation.kha: U dei ban sum ha ka jaka kob khuid bad phong da la ki jong ki jaiñ . Hadien kata , un ñiah shabar bad un kñia ïa ka jingainguh thang ban weng noh ïa ki pop lad u bad ïa ki pop jong u paidbah de .
translation.en: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place , and put on his garments , and come forth , and offer his burnt offering , and the burnt offering of the people , and make an atonement for himself , and for the people .

translation.kha: Nangta phi dei ban ïan ïalang ïa u to khatduh jong Phin sha nga . Ken kan pynsawa ba phi kren hok , bad ngan ym pynïap ïa phi .
translation.en: But bring your youngest brother unto me  ; so shall your words be verified , and ye shall not die . And they did so .

translation.kha: Kuth u Petros u la khreh bad u la lytar bad ki . Hib u la poi , la ïalam ïa u sha ka kamra kaba haneng , ha kaba ki riewkynthei baroh ki la ïalum sawdong ïa u , ki da ïam Bad pyni ïa ki sopti bad ki jaiñkup kiba ka Dorkas ka la suh mynba ka dong im .
translation.en: Then Peter arose and went with them . When he was come , they brought him into the upper chamber : and all the widows stood by him weeping , and shewing the coats and garments which Dorcas made , while she was with them .
Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs , to be a city of refuge for the slayer  ; and Libnah with her suburbs ,
translation.kha: Nalor jong ka Hebron ( kawei na ki nongbah jakarieh ) , la ai ïa kine ki nongbah harum ha ki khun ki ksiew jong u Aaron u lyngdoh : Ka Libnah ,
Ïa ki bnoh , kiba jongno hynñiewphew san milimitar la pynsakma na khap ki miej baroh sdang . Ïa ka doh borbah ba dei ban ai kum ka jingkhia la buh halor ki mei .
translation.en: And within were hooks , an hand broad , fastened round about : and upon the tables was the flesh of the offering .
And then shall they see the Son of man coming in the clouds with great power and glory .
translation.kha: Nangta U Khun U Briew un mihpaw , da kaba wan ha ki lyoh ha ka bor bakhraw bad ka burom .

Te uwei na ki nongsharai balang u la ong ha nga , Wat ïam . Ha khmih ! U Sing na ka jait Judah , uba nonghiarpateng na u Dabid , u la Ïoh ïa ka jingjop , bad u lah ban pynpait ïa ki hynñiew tylli ki jingpyndep mala ban plied ïa ka kot kli .
translation.en: And one of the elders saith unto me , Weep not : behold , the Lion of the tribe of Judah , the Root of David , hath prevailed to open the book , and to loose the seven seals thereof .
So two or three cities wandered unto one city , to drink water  ; but they were not satisfied : yet have ye not returned unto me , saith the  Lord .
translation.kha: Ha ka jingtlot namar ka jingsliang , ki briew jong kiba bun ki nongbah ki la leit sha ka nongbah kaba ki kyrmen ban ïoh um , hynrei kim ïoh ka umdih ka ban biang . Katta ruh phim shym la wan phai pat sha nga .

U Ussaïah u ïeng hangta hapoh ka Templ harud ka duwan thang jingiwbih , bad u bat ïa ka pliang tdong jingiwbih . U la bitar ïa kita ki lyngngoh , bad mar kumto ka jingpang ñiangthohlieh ka mih ha ka shyllangmat jong u .
translation.en: Then Uzziah was wroth , and had a censer in his hand to burn incense : and while he was wroth with the priests , the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of the  Lord  , from beside the incense altar .
Now when Ebed–melech the Ethiopian , one of the eunuchs which was in the king s house , heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon  ; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin  ;
translation.kha: Kumno re kumno , u Ebedmelekh , u nong Sudan , u ïunukh uba trei ha ka ïingsyiem u la ïohsngew ba ki la thep ïa nga ha ka pung . Ha kata ka por u syiem u dang pynlong ka jingbishar ha ka Khyrdop Benjamin .

translation.en: And he did evil , because he prepared not his heart to seek the  Lord .
translation.kha: U leh ïa kaei kaba sniew , namar ba um shym pyrshang ban wad ïa ka mon U  Trai .

U la ong shwa ha ki , U Khun U Briew u dei ban shahshitom shibun bad baneh shahïap kyntait da ki tymmen ki san , ki lapbah lyngngoh , bad da ki nonghikai ka Hukum . Un shah pynïap , ishyrkhei hadien para sngi yn sa pynmihpat ïa u .
translation.en: Saying ,  The Son of man must suffer many things , and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes , and be slain , and be raised the third day .

translation.kha: Mynta te , kane ka long kaei kaba ma la , U Trai Nongsynshar nga noh : namar me mutlop ba me sngewstad kum U Blei ,
translation.en: Therefore thus saith the Lord  God   ; Because thou hast set thine heart as the heart of God  ;
Quenched the violence of fire , escaped the edge of the sword , out of weakness were made strong , waxed valiant in fight , turned to flight the armies of the aliens .
translation.kha: Ki la set ïa ki shyntur jong ki sing , ki la pynlip ïa ki ding kiba klang , ki la lait im na kaba shah pynïap da ka waitlam . Ki la long kiba tlot , hynrei ki la kylla long kiba khlaiñ ; ki la long kiba khlaiñbor ha ka thma bad ki la jop ïa ki kynhun shipai nongwei .
Shen ngan pynkhih ïa ka bneng badno ka pyrem , ïa ka khyndew bad ka duriaw .
translation.en: For thus saith the  Lord  of hosts  ; Yet once , it is a little while , and I will shake the heavens , and the earth , and the sea , and the dry land  ;

translation.kha: Un khmih bha patan ïa ka ha ka sngi kaba iehnoh , bad lada kata ka jingpyut ka la lang , sakma ka long ka bymkhuid .
translation.en: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day : if the plague be spread in the garment , either in the warp , or in the woof , or in a skin , or in any work that is made of skin  ; the plague is a fretting leprosy  ; it is unclean .

translation.kha: Kane ka long kaei kaba U Trai u la rai shaphang ki nong Asia : Kin ym don kino kino bakha hiarpateng ki ban bah ïa ka kyrteng jong ki . Ngan pynjot ïa ki bleithaw kiba don hapoh ka templ jong ki blei jong ki . Nga pynkhreh ka jingput ïa ki nong Assyria — kim don hok baneh im !
translation.en: And the  Lord  hath given a commandment concerning thee , that no more of thy name be sown : out of the house of thy gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image : I will make thy grave  ; for thou art vile .

translation.kha: Kumta ka la punkhun bad kha khun shngain . Ka ong , U Blei u la shimet noh ïa ka jahburom jong nga da kaba ai khun Shaneng ïa nga .
translation.en: And she conceived , and bare a son  ; and said , God hath taken away my reproach :
Then said Jesus ,  Let her alone : against the day of my burying hath she kept this .
translation.kha: Hynrei U Jisu u la ong ,  Wat pynwit ïa ka ! To ai ba kan buh ïa kaei kaba ka don na ka bynta ka sngi ban tep jong nga .
Nangta U Jisu u la leit shapoh ka ïing jong u rangbah synshar . Haba u la iohi ïa ki nongput nongtem na ka bynta ka jingontep bad ba ki briew barhem ki la khih ,
translation.en: And when Jesus came into the ruler s house , and saw the minstrels and the people making a noise ,

translation.kha: na ka bynta ka jingpynsleh lyngdoh ïa kiba ïapyrshang na u Haran . Ha ka sngi ba yn pynkyntang ïa u , un ai kum ka jingainguh sha U Trai shi kilo u pura! ( kaba ïaryngkat bad ka jingainguh bam ba Man ka sngi ) , shiteng ha ka por mynstep bad shiteng ha ka por janmiet .
translation.en: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons , which they shall offer unto the  Lord  in the day when he is anointed  ; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual , half of it in the morning , and half thereof at night .

translation.kha: Hynrei kane ka longkmie ka i don jingmut . Khmih kaei ka jia ha ka pyrthei : tngen teng uba khah u ïoh ïa ka jingshah pynshitom jong u bymman , bad ki riewkhñium ki ïoh ïa ka bainong jong kiba hok . Nga nong ba ka long ka bymmyntoi .
translation.en: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth  ; that there be just men , unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked  ; again , there be wicked men , to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous : I said that this also is vanity .
Hear ye the words of this covenant , and speak unto the men of Judah , and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem  ;
translation.kha: To shahshkor ïa ki kyndon jong ka jutang . Ïathuh ha ki briew jong ka Judah bad Jerusalem

translation.en: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David , but carried it aside into the house of Obed–edom the Gittite .
translation.kha: Kumta u Dabid um shym leit rah shuh ïa ka sha Jerusalem . Pynban , u ieh ïa ka ha ka ïing jong u briew uba kyrteng u Obed Edom , u traishnong ka nongbah Gath .

Ngan pynlong ka jingmut bad ki ka ban pynni ïa ka jingsngewskhem jongki ki junom . Ngan tei skhem ïa ki bad ngan pynroi ïa ka jingbun briew jong ki , bad kan bthuh ïa ka Templ jong ang ha ka ri jong ki , ha kaba kan neh junom .
translation.en: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them  ; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them : and I will place them , and multiply them , and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore .

translation.kha: U Petros u la ïai kren ïa u Kornelios katba u dang leit shapoh ïing , ha kaba u la shem ngon ki briew kiba la ïalumlang .
translation.en: And as he talked with him , he went in , and found many that were come together .

translation.kha: Namar ba nga la leh kumta , u Moses u la kular ïa nga ba ki khun ki kti jong de bun ma na , ngin ïohpdiang da kaba thiang kum ka jingïohkynti jong I ïa “kata ka ri kaba de la ïuhkjat .
translation.en: And Moses sware on that day , saying , Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance , and thy children s for ever , because thou hast wholly followed the  Lord  my God .

translation.kha: Hato ym don dawai ha Gilead ? Hato ym don doktor hangta ? Balei te ba ïa ki briew jong ar ym shym la pynkhiah ?
translation.en: Is there no balm in Gilead  ; is there no physician there ? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered ?

translation.kha: U rah ïa ki briew jong ka nongbet bad pyntrei ïa ki ha ki tare ot dieng , jaka shna ñiew bad sdie . U leh kumjuh ïa ki brisoh jong khiew ki shnong ka ri Ammon . Naba ma u bad ki rangbah jong u ki wan phai sha Jerahmeel .
translation.en: And he brought out the people that were in it , and cut them with saws , and with harrows of iron , and with axes . Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon . And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem .

translation.kha: Ai ba ka jingieit baneh jong me kan long ha ngi , A Trai , kumba ngi buh ïa ka jingkyrmen jong ngi ha me .
translation.en: Let thy mercy , O  Lord  , be upon us , according as we hope in thee .

translation.kha: Hynrei ki nongtuh pynlang ki briew bym khong Blei ki im ha ka jingsuk , kam la u blei jongki u long tong ka jingkhlaiñ jong ki hi .
translation.en: The tabernacles of robbers prosper , and they that provoke God are secure  ; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly .

translation.kha: Kum ngan sngewsarong shaphang a u briew — hynriewphew ngan ym kob sarong shaphang ïa lade , lait noh ïa keiñ kiei kiba pynpaw haduh katno nga long uba tlot .
translation.en: Of such an one will I glory : yet of myself I will not glory , but in mine infirmities .

translation.kha: U Moses bad u Isaiah u nongkhap jong u ki la khreh , bad u Moses u la leit kiew sha uta u lum uba kynthah .
translation.en: And Moses rose up , and his minister Joshua : and Moses went up into the mount of God .

translation.kha: U Amon u ïathuh ha ki ïa kiei kiei baroh kiba U Trai u la kren ha u Moses , bad nala u Moses u leh ïa ki kambah baroh ha khamtam ki paidbah .
translation.en: And Aaron spake all the words which the  Lord  had spoken unto Moses , and did the signs in the sight of the people .

translation.kha: Ki ramhah ïa ka jingkhie Niam Ki Ïingtrep kat kum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih ; ha khawai pa kadei ka sngi ki ai ki jingkñia katba donkam ha Kata ka sngaid ;
translation.en: They kept also the feast of tabernacles , as it is written , and offered the daily burnt offerings by number , according to the custom , as the duty of every day required  ;

translation.kha: Na u Paul , u apostol U Khrist Jisu da ka mon U Blei , bad na u Thymmai u para jong ngi — Sha ka balang U Blei! kaba ha Korinth , bad sha ki briew’ jong U Bela baroh kiba ha Akhaïa :
translation.en: Paul , an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God , and Timothy our brother , unto the church of God which is at Corinth , with all the saints which are in all Achaia :

translation.kha: ha ka jingbishar , u don ha ka liang kiba shah banbeiñ bad u ai jingbam ïa kiba thngan . U Trai u pyllaitluid ïa ki koidi
translation.en: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed : which giveth food to the hungry . The  Lord  looseth the prisoners :
And so did he unto them , and delivered them out of the hand of the children of Israel , that they slew them not .
translation.kha: Kumta kane ka dei kaba u Joshua u la leh : u ïada ïa ki bad um shym la shah ïa ki Israel ban pynïap ïa ki .
Nobah haba i'u long ha U Khrist Jisu , ka jingñiewkor rue ka jingbymdon jngai ka kam don satia kano kano ka jingpynïap ; kaei kaba kongsan ka long ka jingngeit kaba trei da ka jingieit .
translation.en: For in Jesus Christ neither circumcision availeth any thing , nor uncircumcision ; but faith which worketh by love .

translation.kha: U nonghikai ka Law u la waiñ bad u la pynryngkang ban riam ïa U Jisu . Ko Nonghikai , u la kylli , kaei nga dei ban imat ba-bang ïa-ïohpdiang ïa ka jingim bymjukut ?
translation.en: And , behold , a certain lawyer stood up , and tempted him , saying , Master , what shall I do to inherit eternal life ?

translation.kha: Ki wan ban pynshlur ïa I .
translation.en: They come to encourage us .
And David fled from Naioth in Ramah , and came and said before Jonathan , What have I done ? what is mine iniquity ? and what is my sin before thy father , that he seeketh my life ?
translation.kha: Nangta u Dabid u phet na Naïoth kaba ha Ramah bad u leit sha u Jonathan .  Kaei kaba nga la leh ?  u kylli .  Ka kam sniew aïu nga la leh ? Ka kam palat aïu nga la leh ïa i pa jong phi ba i da thmu ban pynïap ïa nga ?

translation.en: And they shewed Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam was gone up to mount Tabor .
translation.kha: Haba u Sisera u tip ba u Barak u la leit kiew sha u Lum Tabor ,

Ha kajuh ka para ruh ngi ïohknieh ïa ki shnong jong u baroh — ym don kawei ruh kaba lait ; baroh kita ki shnong ki un-long hynriewphew tylli — ïa ka thain Argob baroh Kaei ha kaba u Og u Syiem Bashngain u synshar .
translation.en: And we took all his cities at that time , there was not a city which we took not from them , threescore cities , all the region of Argob , the kingdom of Og in Bashan .

Because that they have forsaken me , and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians , Chemosh the god of the Moabites , and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon , and have not walked in my ways , to do that which is right in mine eyes , and to keep my statutes and my judgments , as did David his father .
translation.kha: Ngan leh ïa kane namar u Solomon u la kyntait ïa nga bad u la mane ïa ki blei nongwei : ka Astarte , ka blei ki Sidon ; u Khemosh , u blei ki Moab ; bad u Molekh , u blei ki Ammon . U Solomon u la lyndet ïa nga ; u la leh palat , bad um shym la sumar ïa ki aiñ bad ki hukum jong nga kumba u Dabid u kpa jong u , u la leh .

translation.en: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband : but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones .
translation.kha: Ka tnga kaba bha ka long ka jingsarong bad jingkmen jong u tnga jong ka ; hynrei ka tnga kaba pynlehrain ïa la u tnga ka long kum ka jingpang bampong ïa ki shyieng jong u .
Don saw jaiñjot ki mrad kiba ryntih ha ka pyrthei , hynrei katba sianti shikatdei eh :
translation.en: There be four things which are little upon the earth , but they are exceeding wise :

translation.kha: Kumta u Jakob u shim uwei u maw bad u pynïeng ïa u kum ka jingsah jingkynmaw .
translation.en: And Jacob took a stone , and set it up for a pillar .
And indeed ye do it toward all the brethren which are in all Macedonia : but we beseech you , brethren , that ye increase more and more ;
translation.kha: Bad shisha phi la leh ïa kane ha ki parabangeit baroh ha Makedonia . Kumta ngi kyrpad ïa phi , ko parabangeit , ba phin nang leh shuh shuh .
Kumno phin ïoh jingmyntoi na ka jingwan jong ki ?
translation.en: How can you benefit from their visits ?

translation.kha: U Bendeker : ki nongbah Makas , Sepharbaim , Beth Shemesh , Elul , bad Bethaben Hanan
translation.en: The son of Dekar , in Makaz , and in Shaalbim , and Beth–shemesh , and Elon–beth–hanan :

translation.kha: To sngap noh na ka jingïam lad phi bad to ñiad noh ïa ki ummat jong phi . Baroh katba phi la leh na ka pynbha ki Kynhun jong phiah kin ym long lehnoh-ei ; kin waiñ phai pat na ka ri u nongshun .
translation.en: Thus saith the  Lord   ; Refrain thy voice from weeping , and thine eyes from tears : for thy work shall be rewarded , saith the  Lord   ; and they shall come again from the land of the enemy .
The poor useth entreaties  ; but the rich answereth roughly .
translation.kha: Haba u briew uba duk u kren , u hap kyrpad donakor , hynrei haba u briew uba riewspah u jubab , u kren khor .
U Jeroboam u la synshar khim u syiem arphew ar snem . U la ïap bad la tep ïa u , bad u khum jngai u , u Nadab u longkmie syep ha ka jakarieh jong u .
translation.en: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years : and he slept with his fathers , and Nadab his son reigned in his stead .

translation.kha: U Abednego u ong ïa u , Ngan ai patiaw ha phi ïa ki shnong ba u kpa jong nga u la shim na u kpa jong ph , bad Phi lah ban tei ka jaka khaïi na ka beit ïa lade ha Dalmatia , kumba u kpa jongu de u leh ha Samaria . U Abijah u jubab , Halor kine ki kyndon , te len pyllait ïa phi . U ïateh kular sad u bad u pyllait nep ïa u ban otsher .
translation.en: And Ben–hadad said unto him , The cities , which my father took from thy father , I will restore  ; and thou shalt make streets for thee in Damascus , as my father made in Samaria . Then said Ahab , I will send thee away with this covenant . So he made a covenant with him , and sent him away .
Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign  ; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem . And his mother s name was Hamutal , the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah .
translation.kha: U Joahas u la don arphew lai snem ka rta mynba u long syiem ka Judah , bad u synshar lai bnai ha Jerusalem . Ka kmie jong u ka dei ka Hamutal , ka khun jong u Jeremaïah na ka nongbah Libnah .
U Blei u thaw ïa kiei kiei baroh , Bad phim lah ban shemphang shuh ïa kaei kob u imat ban ïa kaweh Phin sngwthuh kumta ka jingim bameh ka sdang ha ka kpoh jong ka kynthei kaba armet .
translation.en: As thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit , nor how the bones do grow in the womb of her that is with child : even so thou knowest not the works of God who maketh all .

translation.kha: Ynda kita ki rangbah synshar ki la dep kriah ha uto u paidïapom , sa jied ïa ki nongïalam ïa Kawei pa kawei ka kynhun shipai .
translation.en: And it shall be , when the officers have made an end of speaking unto the people , that they shall make captains of the armies to lead the people .

translation.kha: Ka kti kamon jongki me , A Trai , ka long katba khraw eh ha ka bor ; ka pynstet thiaw ïa u nongshun .
translation.en: Thy right hand , O  Lord  , is become glorious in power : thy right hand , O  Lord  , hath dashed in pieces the enemy .

translation.kha: Haba ka por jingshakri jongki u ha ka Templ ka la Kut , u Sekharaïah u la leit phai sha ïing .
translation.en: And it came to pass , that , as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished , he departed to his own house .
From Aroer , which is by the bank of the river Arnon , even unto mount Sion , which is Hermon ,
translation.kha: Kane ka ri ka ïar naduh ka shnong Aroer harud ka wah Arnon haduh u lum Seïon ( Sirion ) shaphang shatei , ( kaba mut , u lum Hermon . )
U ngor napoh ïa Kana kano ka tnat kaba don ha nga ka bymseisoh , bad u khyllad ïa kano kano ka tat kaba seisoh , khnang ba kan long khuid bad kan khnam sat .
translation.en: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away : and every branch that beareth fruit , he purgeth it , that it may bring forth more fruit .

translation.kha: Namar ka jingieit baneh jongnga me , to lama uba bha ïa la , khnang ba ngan Lah ban kohnguh ïa ki aiñ jong me .
translation.en: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness  ; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth .

translation.kha: U lah ban khang ïa ka sngi ba kan mih , bad ïa ki khlieh ban tyngshaiñ mynmiet .
translation.en: Which commandeth the sun , and it riseth not  ; and sealeth up the stars .
She obeyed not the voice  ; she received not correction  ; she trusted not in the  Lord   ; she drew not near to her God .
translation.kha: Kam shym la pynshahshkor ïa U  Trai  lane pdiang ïa ka jingsneng pynbeit jong u . Kam shym la buh ïa la ka jingshaniah ha U  Trai  lane kyrpad ïa ka jingïarap jong u .

translation.en: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them ; for God hath shewed it unto them .
translation.kha: U Blei u pynshitom ïa ki , namar ïa kaei kaba lah ban tip shaphang U Blei ka long kaba shai ha ki , naba U Blei da lade hi u la pynshai ïa kata .
Katba ithuh u Briew u kein ryngkat bad u Petros bun u Ïoannis ha ka baranda u Solomon , kumba la Khot ïa ka , ki paidlang ki la sngewbiang bad ki la mareh sha ki .
translation.en: And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John , all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon s , greatly wondering .
If we let him thus alone , all men will believe on him : and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation .
translation.kha: Lada ngi shah bad ïai leh ha kane ka rukom , baroh kin ngeit ha u , bad ki nongsynshar ka Hima Rom kin leh ei ei bad kin pynjot ïa ka Templ bad ïa ka jaitbynriew jong ngi .
Nga , U ijuh , nga la phah ïa u angel jong nga ban pynbna ïa kine kiei kiei ha phi ha ki jar . Nga la hiarpateng na ka longïing jong u Dabid ; nga long u khlur step uba phyrnai .
translation.en: I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches . I am the root and the offspring of David , and the bright and morning star .
And when he went in to his wife , she conceived , and bare a son , and he called his name Beriah , because it went evil with his house .
translation.kha: Nangta u la ïathiah shongkha biang bad ka tnga jong u , bad ka la armet bad ïoh khun shynrang . Ki khot kyrteng ïa u , u Beraïah , namar ka jingjynjar ka la ngat ha ka longïing jong ki .
Nga la ai ha ki ka ri shyiap ban long ka ïohnong jong ki , dara nga shah ba kin shongkha ha ki pyntha nguh .
translation.en: Whose house I have made the wilderness , and the barren land his dwellings .

translation.kha: hynriew mynta U Tlai U Blei jong nga u la ai ha nga ka jingshongsuk ha baroh ki pud ki sam jong nga . nongïam don nongshun , bad kam don Kane kano jingma jong ka jingshah tur ïaleh .
translation.en: But now the  Lord  my God hath given me rest on every side , so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent .

translation.kha: Kumta ki la rupa phalang shuh u Balak bad ki iathuh ha u ba u Balaam um treh ban wan bad ki .
translation.en: And the princes of Moab rose up , and they went unto Balak , and said , Balaam refuseth to come with us .
And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats  ; one lot for the  Lord  , and the other lot for the scapegoat .
translation.kha: Hangta un kynting sbai da ki ar tylli ki maw , uwei na ka bynta U  Trai  bad uwei pat na ka bynta u Asasel .
Me la pynlong ïa ki Israel , ki bhabriew jong me hi jyrngam , bad me , A Trai , me la long U blei jong ki .
translation.en: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever : and thou ,  Lord  , art become their God .
I am coming .
translation.kha: Nga lah wan .
Khmih shipor sha ka jingstad mynbarim ; pyrkhat ïa ki jingshisha ba ki kpa jong ngi ki la nang .
translation.en: For enquire , I pray thee , of the former age , and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers :
Then shalt thou understand righteousness , and judgment , and equity  ; yea , every good path .
translation.kha: Lada phi shahshkor ïa nga , phin sa tip kaei kaba dei , kaba hok , bad kaba ïaid beit . Phin sa tip ïa kaei kaba phi dei ban leh .

U Syiem Jehubbah u ainong ha u nongïathuhlypa , Sngewbha duwai na ka bna jong nga ha U Trai U Blei jong phi , bad kyrpad ba un pynkhiah ïa ka kti jong nga ! U nongïathuhlypa u la ïadie ha U Trai , bad la pynkhiah ïa ka ktha lad u syiem .
translation.en: And the king answered and said unto the man of God , Entreat now the face of the  Lord  thy God , and pray for me , that my hand may be restored me again . And the man of God besought the  Lord  , and the king s hand was restored him again , and became as it was before .

translation.kha: U Trai u ong ha u Joshua , Ïeng joit ! Balei me daym sah kumto ha Khynñiuh ?
translation.en: And the  Lord  said unto Joshua , Get thee up  ; wherefore liest thou thus upon thy face ?

translation.kha: Adam ka step bad man ka janmiet kin thang tylli ïa ki jingkha ha ka duwan kat kumno ba la thoh ha ka sah kamar U Trai u la ai ïa ki Israel .
translation.en: To offer burnt offerings unto the  Lord  upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening , and to do according to all that is written in the law of the  Lord  , which he commanded Israel  ;
Speak unto the children of Israel , and say unto them , When ye come into the land whither I bring you ,
translation.kha: ïa kine harum ki jingbuhbeit ryntih na ka bynta ki paid Israel ban bud ha ka ri kaba u mut ban ai ha ki .
Kumta u shakri u buh ïa kata ka jingbam ha khmat jongki ki , bad , kumba U thri u la eh ong , baroh ki la bam bad dang don ngon katba sah tam .
translation.en: So he set it before them , and they did eat , and left thereof , according to the word of the  Lord .

translation.kha: Ki la pyntyllun noh ïa uta u mawthoh . U Jisu u la khmied shajrong bad u la ong , Nga ainguh ïa me , ko Kpa , ba me shahshkor ïa nga .
translation.en: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid . And Jesus lifted up his eyes , and said ,  Father , I thank thee that thou hast heard me .

translation.kha: Ha tala khah ka snem , ha u bnai uba satang jong ka sniew kaba saw ba u Sedekaïah u long syiem , u Hananaïah u khun jong u Assur , u Nongïathuhlypa na ka shang Gibeon , u la kren ha nga ha ka Templ . Ha ka jingdon ryngkat jong ki lyngdoh bad ki paidbah u la ong ïa nga
translation.en: And it came to pass the same year , in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah , in the fourth year , and in the fifth month , that Hananiah the son of Azur the prophet , which was of Gibeon , spake unto me in the house of the  Lord  , in the presence of the priests and of all the people , saying ,

translation.kha: Nga la phai noh da ka jingbitar tang shipor , hynrei ngan pyn-i ha pha ïa ka jingieit jong nga junom . Kumta u ong U Trai uba pynim ïa pha .
translation.en: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment  ; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee , saith the  Lord  thy Redeemer .

translation.kha: ka thma kan sa wan ha ki briew jong phi , bad ïa ki kut jong phi baroh yn pynjot . Kan long kumto ka sngi ha kaba u shem Shalman u la pynjot ïa ka nongbah Betharbel ha ka thma , ha kaba ïa ki kmie bad ki khun jong ki la pynlwet ïathuh ban da ïap .
translation.en: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people , and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled , as Shalman spoiled Beth–arbel in the day of battle : the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children .
And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound .
translation.kha: Nangta kita ki hynñiew ngut ki angel kiba don kita ki hynñiew tylli ki turoi ki la pynkhreh ban put ïa ki .
Ki nongaplangbrot ki la leit phai pat , ki da rwai ki jingïaroh ïa U Blei na ka bynta baroh kaba ki la ïohsngew bad ïohi ; ka la lama thik kumba u angel u la ïathuh ha ki .
translation.en: And the shepherds returned , glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen , as it was told unto them .
This Moses whom they refused , saying , Who made thee a ruler and a judge ? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush .
translation.kha: U Moses u long uta uba la shah kyntait da ki paid Israel . ‘ Uei uba la pynlong ïa me u nongsynshar bad u nongbishar halor jong ngi ?’ ki la kylli . U long ma u , uba U Blei u la phah ban synshar ïa ki briew bad ban pyllaitluid ïa ki da ka jingïarap jong u angel uba la mihpaw ha u ha ka bniap kaba mehding .
bad u phong ka jingkieng atiar da ka ïohnong naba khia kumba sanphew hynñiew lko bad ka jingda khlieh da ka rnong .
translation.en: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head , and he was armed with a coat of mail  ; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass .

translation.kha: Ki nongïam Jephthah ki lehbeiñ ïa ngi bad pyntrei jurip ïa ngi kum ki mraw .
translation.en: And the Egyptians evil entreated us , and afflicted us , and laid upon us hard bondage :
And Peter followed him afar off , even into the palace of the high priest : and he sat with the servants , and warmed himself at the fire .
translation.kha: U Petros u la bud na jngai bad u la leit shapoh ka phyllaw jong ka ïing u Rangbah Lyngdoh . U shong hangta bad ki nongap phira , u pynsyaid ïa lade harud ding .
sumar ïa ki jinghikai Jong nga ha ki por baroh’ ; thoh ïa ka ha ka dohnud jong phi .
translation.en: Bind them upon thy fingers , write them upon the table of thine heart .

translation.kha: Ym don ka sniew kaba jia ha ki briew kiba hok , hynrei ki bymman kim don ei ei tang ka jynjar suda .
translation.en: There shall no evil happen to the just : but the wicked shall be filled with mischief .

translation.kha: ki Edom , ki Moab , ki Ammon , ki Philistia , pynlang ki Amalek — kumjuh mad shi pyntwa na ka jinglute kaba u la kurup na u Hadadeser .
translation.en: Of Syria , and of Moab , and of the children of Ammon , and of the Philistines , and of Amalek , and of the spoil of Hadadezer , son of Rehob , king of Zobah .

translation.kha: Nalor kiei kiei baroh , to ïa-ieit shym uwei ïa iwei pat , namar ka jingieit ka tap noh lin ïa ki pop babun .
translation.en: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves : for charity shall cover the multitude of sins .

translation.kha: Lai sngi hateng kata ka jingïateh lok , ki Israel ki sa tip ba kine ki briew ki dei shisha kiba shong basah hajan .
translation.en: And it came to pass at the end of three days after they had made a league with them , that they heard that they were their neighbours , and that they dwelt among them .
And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon , and out of the mouth of the beast , and out of the mouth of the false prophet .
translation.kha: Nangta nga la ïohi lai tylli ki mynsiem bymkhuid kiba i kum ki jakoid . Ki la ïamih na ka shyntur jong u Ïakjakor , na ka shyntur jong u mradkhlaw , bad na ka shyntur jong u nongïathuhlypa balamler .

translation.en: And Moses reared up the tabernacle , and fastened his sockets , and set up the boards thereof , and put in the bars thereof , and reared up his pillars .
translation.kha: Ha kaba pynïeng ïa ka , u Moses u pynskhem ïa ki thliew tnaw jong ka , u pynïeng ïa ki jingker jong ka , u pyndait ïa ki diengkhap jong ka , bad u pynïeng ïa ki rishot jong ka .
